Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni Ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kufinyelela kuhilela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, ulwazi, nezinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula kubantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza zifaka phakathi izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, nezikhungo zomphakathi. Ukuze umphakathi ube nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo somnotho, uthole ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Okokuqala, izikhungo zemfundo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekufinyeleleni kwamahhala. Izikhungo ezifana nezikole, amanyuvesi, nezikhungo zokuqeqesha zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokufunda olutholakala kubo bonke. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, okwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bathole ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo kuholela ekwandeni kwemfundo, okukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nekhono eliphezulu, okubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Okwesibili, izikhungo zezempilo zidinga ukuba zibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kumphakathi. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zezempilo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlola, ukuhlinzekwa kwemithi, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Uma abantu bengakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okungathinta umphakathi wonke. Ngakho-ke, izikhungo zezempilo kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngempilo kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihluphekayo. Okwesithathu, izikhungo zomphakathi zibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lezi zikhungo zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokuxhumana, izikhungo zokuzijabulisa, nezikhungo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala kulezi zikhungo kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuthi abantu bahlangane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kudinga ukwesekwa okuqinile kuhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ukuze lezi zinsiza zibe khona, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele, izinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezitholakala kubantu. Ukuze umphakathi ube nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa ukufinyelela kwamahhala, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo, kanye nokwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ukuze lokhu kufinyeleleke, kudingeka ukwesekwa okuqinile kuhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kuyatholakala, ukuze umphakathi ube nempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze aphumelele.
Usuku Lokubamba iqhaza komphakathi luyinsiza yokukhuthaza ingxoxo nokuxhumana phakathi kuk政府 nomphakathi. Lunikeza ithuba kuk政府 ukuze lihlanganise uhlelo lwalo lokusebenza nentuthuko esivele yenziwe. Lukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi nokubambisana phakathi komphakathi kuk政府. Usuku Lokubamba iqhaza komphakathi lunikeza kuk政府 ithuba lokuxhumana nemiphakathi, ukuphendula ekwenzeni uhlelo lokusebenza. Ingxoxo ebusweni-bubuso phakathi kwezinga lezi zikhungo ezintathu zik政府 (ezwe, isifunda, kanye nendawo) nomphakathi iqinisekisa ukuthi kuk政府 uxhumana nabantu bayo. Ngesikhathi salolu suku, imiphakathi kanye kuk政府 izobamba iqhaza ezinkundleni ezisunguliwe ezifana nezinkomiti zezakhamizi nemihlangano yezikhungo ukuze kukhuphuke izinkinga futhi kuhlanganyelwe izixazululo. Ukugxila kuzoba ekwandiseni amandla emiphakathi njengababambiqhaza ekwenzeni izixazululo, ngokuxhaswa kokubambisana okuvela kuk政府. Ihhovisi likaMongameli liphinde lanikeza izinyathelo ezengeziwe zokuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kuk政府 nabantu, kanye nokusheshisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kubantu. Sihlinzeka ngezinkinga ezivele zaziwa ezingxoxweni ezahlukene nasocwaningweni. Sihambe kude kule minyaka engu-15 yokukhululeka, kodwa izinkinga eziningi zisasemhlabeni. Ithuba lezakhamizi ezinomsebenzi ophilayo lenyuke lisuka ku-61.7% ngo-1994 laya ku-91.8% ngoMashi 2009, kodwa kusekhona okuningi okudingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu abasenhla. Siseduze nokufeza umgomo wethu wokukhipha uhlelo lokuhlanzeka lwezimbiza ezakhiwe kuk政府, ngenhloso yokuthi lolu hlelo luphume ngokuphelele ezweni lonke ngaphambi kuka-2014. Sisenokukhathazeka ngezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ubumpofu, izikhungo zezempilo ezinganele, kanye nokungathuthuki, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni. Masisebenzise lezi zinkundla ukuze sixhumane nez representatives zomphakathi futhi sishintshe indlela yokulimaza impahla nezinsiza ezihloselwe ukusiza lezo zindawo. Sikhathazekile ngezikhathi zokulinda ezinsizakalweni ezithembisiwe kumiphakathi; siyazi ukuthi ngokubambisana nezicwangciso singafeza okuningi futhi ngokushesha.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Ngomhla ka-15 kuMfumfu 2023, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika libe nempikiswano ebalulekile mayelana nenkinga kagesi ebhekene nezwe. Lokhu kulalelwa kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhathazeka okukhulu ngemiphumela yokungabi khona kukagesi okuqhubekayo, okubangela ukuphazamiseka emisebenzini nasempilweni yabantu abaningi. Umgqugquzeli wezokuthutha, uMnu. Sipho Mthembu, uveze ukuthi isimo sokungabi khona kukagesi sithinta izimboni eziningi, kubandakanya ezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokudla. "Sibona izinkampani zikhathazekile, zikhubazekile, futhi lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemisebenzi," kusho uMnu. Mthembu. Uphiko lwezokwakha luphinde lwavuma ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zikhula ngokushesha, kodwa ngenxa yokungabi khona kukagesi, imisebenzi eminingi ibhujiswa. UMsizi weZokwakha, uNkk. Thandi Nkosi, uphinde waveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi, "Uma kungenzeka ukuthi i-Escom ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okwanele, sizobona ukwehla kokwakhiwa kwezindlu, okukhona okubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho." Ukwengeza, umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphila nsuku zonke. UMsizi Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, uMnu. Sibusiso Dlamini, uthe: "Abantu bethu bahlupheka, abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka." Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, uMphakathi Uhlangene, inhlangano yezenhlalakahle, ibonisa ukuthi izigaba ezithile zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zikhathazekile kakhulu. UMsizi Wokuphila, uNkk. Zanele Khumalo, uthe: "Abantu abatholi ugesi isikhathi eside, futhi lokho kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezempilo." Ukwaziwa kwalezi zinkinga, iPhalamende lathola iziphakamiso ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene. Umdlali wezemidlalo, uMnu. Themba Mabuza, uphakamise ukuthi kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. "Kumele sithathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo, siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ugesi," kusho uMnu. Mabuza. Iphalamende laphinde lavuma ukuthi kudingeka izinhlelo zokuphucula ubuchwepheshe bokuhlinzeka ngogesi. UMsizi Wokuhlinzeka ngogesi, uMnu. Jabu Mthethwa, uthe: "Sizobheka izindlela ezintsha zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengezikhungo zamandla avuselelekayo, ukuze sigweme izinkinga ezinjengalezi esibhekene nazo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziphakamiso zokubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi nezinkampani zikhuluma ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. UMsizi Wokubambisana, uNkk. Lindiwe Ngcobo, uthe: "Ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani bungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iPhalamende laphinde lavuma ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zamandla avuselelekayo. UMsizi Wokwakha, uMnu. Thabo Ndaba, uthe: "Sizobheka izindlela eziningi zokwakha izikhungo zamandla, ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi." Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa ukuthi izinhlelo eziphakanyisiwe azizwakali kahle. UMsizi Wezemfundo, uNkk. Palesa Moyo, uthe: "Kumele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, hhayi nje iziphakamiso." Lokhu kuphakamisa izinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ngokuphetha, kulalelwa kwePhalamende kukhombisa ukuthi inkinga kagesi ibalulekile futhi idinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Umphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, inkinga kagesi izophinde ibangele izinkinga ezinkulu ezizayo. IPhalamende lizoqhubeka nokulandela lezi zindaba, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola ugesi ophumelelayo.
Ukuguquguquka Kwesimo Sezulu eNingizimu Afrika Eminyakeni edlule, iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu kwesimo sezulu, okukhuluma ngakho abantu abaningi, abacwaningi, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kushintsha kubonakala kuzo zonke izifunda, futhi kudala ukukhathazeka ngokuthi imiphumela yalesi simo izoba nemithelela emikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, kwezomnotho, nasemvelweni. Izimpawu Zokuguquguquka Kwezulu Izimpawu zokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu zifaka phakathi ukwanda kokushisa, izikhukhula, nezomiso ezinzima. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi izinga lokushisa eNingizimu Afrika likhuphuka, okwenza kube nezinsuku ezishisayo kakhulu. Lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi kwezolimo, njengoba isivuno senzulu sithinteka kakhulu. Abalimi baveza ukukhathazeka ukuthi izitshalo zabo zidinga amanzi, kodwa imvula iyanda ngokungalindelekile, futhi izimo zokumisa ziba nzima. Imiphumela Empilweni Yabantu Ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu kuhlobene kakhulu nezimo zokuphila kwabantu. Izindawo ezithinteka kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, ziya zibona ukwehla kwezinsiza ezifana namanzi nezinhlanzi. Lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka kokudla, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Izinkinga zezimali nezokuphila zikhula, njengoba abanye behlangabezana nezimo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi abahlala ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu. Imizamo Yokubhekana Nokuguquguquka Kwezulu Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokubhekana nokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu lukhona ukuze luthuthukise isimo. Uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele, basebenza ukuze baqonde izizathu ezisemqoka zalesi simo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukugqugquzela ukusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, ukugcina amanzi, kanye nokuhlonza izindlela ezintsha zokulima ezithuthukisa umhlaba ophilayo. Izinhlelo zokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokulima zikhona, ezifana nezokulima ezilungiselelwe izimo ezithile zezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, abacwaningi, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kutholakale izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izifundo Ezitholakele Kubantu abathintekayo, ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu akukona nje kuphela umbuzo wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi ubonakala njengomkhankaso wezokuxhumana. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze kudaleke izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izifundo ezitholakele zikhombisa ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika badinga ulwazi olungcono ngalezi zinguquko ukuze bakwazi ukulungiselela izimo ezinzima ezizayo. Ukubheka Phambili Uma sibheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikwazi ukucabanga ngezinto ezizayo. Ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu akusikho okuzofika kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube yinto esiyicabangayo nsuku zonke. Izinselelo ezikhona zidinga ukucophelela nokubambisana ukuze sithole izixazululo ezinempilo. Ukwakha umphakathi onolwazi, onesibopho sokuphila ngendlela ehlelekile, kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukunqoba lezi zinkinga. Umsebenzi wethu uwukwakha umhlaba ongcono, ogculisayo, futhi ophilayo, ukuze sithole ikusasa elihle. Ngakho, ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu eNingizimu Afrika akukhona nje kuphela umkhankaso wezokuhlala, kodwa futhi kuyinselelo esibeka phambili ubuhlakani bethu. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, nabacwaningi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bahlomule bonke abantu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, siphumelele ezinguqukweni eziyingozi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, singabheka izindlela ezithuthuke kakhulu zokwenza ngcono izimo zethu, sithuthukise izindlela zokuphila, sifeze isibopho sethu sokugcina umhlaba ophephile. Ukubambisana kwethu kudinga ukuqhubeka, ukuze sithole impumelelo. Ngalolu hlobo, sizokwazi ukuhlomula ekuguquguqukeni kwesimo sezulu, sibe yisibonelo esihle emhlabeni.
IPhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika inezindlu ezimbili: iNhlangano Yezwe (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-NA), enamalungu angu-400, kanye neNhlangano Yezwe Yezifunda (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-NCOP), enamalungu angama-90 okungenani. Umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP temsilisa izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kwesizwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ikakhulukazi ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokwazisa yesizwe futhi kuhanjiswa umphakathi ipulatifomu yesizwe yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta izifunda. I-NCOP iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zokuphatha zendawo zicatshangelwa ezingeni likamasipala. Abameleli baphathiswa nguMphakathi wezifunda ngasinye, ongomunye wabameleli abakhethekile. Uma kudingeka, uMphakathi angabiza omunye umuntu endaweni yakhe. Umholi, kanye noMholi oMabili, babheke umsebenzi we-NCOP futhi baphatha izingxoxo, beqinisekisa ukuthi abameleli bakhuluma ngokukhululeka uma behambisana nemithetho ebekwe yiNdlu. UMholi oMabili ukhethwa ukuba asebenze isikhathi esigcwele seminyaka emihlanu, kanti oMphakathi bezifunda baphindaphinda njengamaMholi oMabili isikhathi seminyaka eyodwa. I-NCOP kufanele ibonwe njengendawo engasiza ekuphathweni kokubambisana kanye nenhloso enkulu yokubamba iqhaza, futhi ukuthi ikhuthaza ukucatshangelwa kwezidingo zokuphatha zendawo kanye nezifunda ezingeni lesizwe. I-NCOP inikeza izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zaseNingizimu Afrika izwi futhi iphinde inikeze iziphathimandla zendawo ipulatifomu yokubamba iqhaza ekucubunguleni umthetho ezingeni lesizwe. Kumele icabangele yonke imithetho yesizwe. Iphinde ikwazi ukuhlinzeka noma ukulungisa imithetho ephansi kweSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo (lezi zindaba lapho bobabili abenzi bomthetho bezwe nezifunda banegunya lokwenza umthetho ndawonye) neminye imithetho ethinta izifunda. Iningi lemisebenzi yokwazisa lenziwa emakhomithini, kodwa yonke imithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwi-NCOP ukuze ixoxwe futhi ivote ukuthi leyo mithetho yamukelwa noma iyalahlwa. Imithetho engathinti izifunda iphathelene nemisebenzi yesizwe; efana nokuvikela, ezokuhweba, kanye nezobulungiswa. Uma le mithetho yamukelwa yiNhlangano Yezwe, ithunyelwa kwi-NCOP ukuze ivote. Izibonelo zemithetho ethinta izifunda zifaka phakathi imfundo, ukuthutha, usizo lwezenhlalakahle, kanye nempilo. Iningi lemithetho lingangeniswa kwi-NCOP nganoma iyiphi yalezi zindlu; nokho, kukhona imithetho ethile okufanele iqale kwiNhlangano Yezwe. Uma kukhona ukungavumelani phakathi kwe-NA ne-NCOP ngemithetho ethinta izifunda, le mithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwiKomidi Lokuxazulula. Uma umthetho ophushelwa noma ushintsha umthethosisekelo uthinta ngqo izifunda, okungenani eziyisithupha zezifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye kwi-NCOP kumele zivume. Uma umthetho ophushelwa umthethosisekelo ungathinti ngqo izifunda, umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP kumele ibe nengxoxo ngalowo mthetho (ngaphandle kokuthi uvotwe) ngaphambi kokuthi uthunyelwe kwi-NA ukuze uvotwe. Ukubhekwa okwenziwa nguhulumeni njengoba kuphathiswe ngumthethosisekelo kuhlanganisa amaNhlangano Ezifunda aqapha futhi ahlola izenzo zohulumeni. I-NCOP ikwenza ukubhekwa kwezindaba zesizwe ezivela ezifundeni nasezikhungweni zendawo. I-NCOP ingacela ilungu leKabinet, isikhulu sikamasipala, noma isikhulu sikamasipala wesifunda ukuba sibe khona emhlanganweni wayo noma emhlanganweni wekomidi. I-NCOP noma noma yiziphi zezikomidi zayo zingamukela izicelo, izethulo, noma izincwadi ezibhaliwe ezivela kunoma ubani noma izinhlangano ezinomdla. I-NCOP iphinde ibambisane nemiphakathi ukuze ihlole izenzo zohulumeni ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi iqoqe ulwazi ngezidingo nezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo. Ikomidi ngalinye lihlola umsebenzi wesigaba ngasinye sohulumeni. Ikomidi icubungula futhi ilungisa imithetho, futhi ikhuthaza ama-foramu omphakathi uma kukhona udaba olubalulekile lokuthakazelelwa komphakathi. Amakhomidi angamenya noma ubani ukuze ahlinzeke ubufakazi noma athumele imibhalo, futhi angacela noma ubani noma inhlangano ukuthi ibike kubo ngezindaba ezithile. Abameleli besifunda ngasinye banokhetho olulodwa oluphakanyiswa ngumholi wendawo yokumelwa kwesifunda egameni lesifunda. Amalungu omphakathi angadlala indima ebonakalayo ekuhloleni okwenziwa nguhulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula izidingo zabantu. Ukuveza kumkhankaso wephalamende kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokwabelana ngemibono yakho namalungu ekhomidi ngenkathi bexoxa futhi becubungula umthetho othile ngaphambi kokuba uqedwe. Isicelo siyindlela yokuletha ePhalamende izikhalazo noma izindaba ezithakazelelayo zomphakathi ukuze ikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngaphakathi kwamandla ayo. Ilungelo lokufaka isicelo ePhalamende liyilungelo labantu bonke baleli zwe futhi linikezwa umthethosisekelo wethu. Noma ubani, noma amaqembu abantu noma noma iyiphi inhlangano inelungelo lokufaka isicelo ePhalamende. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana namalungu ePhalamende emahhovisi abo ezinkundleni zomphakathi ezweni lonke noma ePhalamende uma befuna ukuthi babasekele endabeni eshisa izikhotha abafuna ukuyixoxa noma uma befuna usizo ngendaba ethile.
Ukudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa kuvumela abantu ukuba bathole izinhlanzi emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kokuhlosile ukuwathengisa. Ukuze uthumele izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kufanele ufake isicelo semvume esinikezwa umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe. Izinhlanzi ezitholwe kwamanye amazwe ezizothengiswa kufanele zisetshenziswe abantu abazitholile. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuthumela izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngaphandle kwemvume efanele. Faka isicelo esisha semvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika uma eyakho yamanje iphelelwe isikhathi. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nemithetho yemvume kungaholela ekutheni imvume yakho suspenswe noma ikhanselwe. Qaphela: Imvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ayihlanganisi izinhlanzi ezitholwe emanzini ahlanzekile. Lezi zinhlanzi zilawulwa umnyango wezolimo. Izicelo zemvume zokuthumela izinhlanzi ezitholwe emanzini ahlanzekile zifakwa kumnyango wezolimo, okuyiwo kuphela umnyango ophathelene nokwethula lezi mvume. Izinhlanzi ezibhalwe kuMthetho Wokuhweba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Ngemikhiqizo Ebulalayo (CITES) azivunyelwe ukutholwa nokulethwa eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi ngale nhlangano, vakashela ku-http://www.cites.org. Imvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika yokusetshenziswa komuntu iphelelwa isikhathi uma umuntu ebuyela ezweni lapho edobe khona. Abantu abavunyelwe ukulethela izinhlanzi eziphilayo. Awukwazi ukuzithengisa uqobo noma ukuthumela ngempahla. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele. Imali yesicelo semvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika yokusetshenziswa komuntu ingu-R120. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kuthathwa umphumela ngummeli womnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe ngokuxhumana nomphumela wezomnotho. Amafomu wezicelo awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane ne-ofisi yakho eseduzane.
ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Nezinkinga Ezihambisana Nayo ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean, olungama-70 million square kilometers, luyindawo ebalulekile emhlabeni. Lolu lwandle luhlanganisa amazwe amaningi, okuhlanganisa e-Afrika, e-Asia, nase-Australia, futhi luthinta ukuphila kwabantu abaningi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo nezinselelo ezithinta le ndawo. Okokuqala, sizoqala ngokubheka impumelelo yezomnotho eyenzeka uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean. Lolu lwandle luwumthombo omkhulu wezinsiza, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Izikebhe ezithutha imikhiqizo zisebenzisa le ndawo, okuvumela ukuhweba phakathi kwamazwe. Lokhu kuhweba kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kuthuthukisa umnotho, futhi kwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Indian Ocean iyindawo ebalulekile yokulima, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokudla. Izinhlanzi ezitholakala kulolu lwandle zibalulekile ekudleni kwabantu abaningi, futhi zenza kube nokwabelana ngezinsiza phakathi kwezizwe. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Uhlanga lwe-Indian Ocean luhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukungcoliswa, ukwehla kwezinsiza, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kungenxa yokukhishwa kwemfucuza emanzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlala kwezinhlanzi nezilwane zasolwandle. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwezinsiza, okungathinta umnotho wezindawo ezikule ndawo. Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuhweba, njengoba izimo zezulu zingashintsha ngokushesha, zidalela izingozi ezinkulu ezithinta izikebhe. Ukuze siqede lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi amazwe ahlanganyele ukuze axazulule lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sithuthukise uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean, kudingeka izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha imfucuza, kanye nokwandisa imikhankaso yokuvikela izilwane zasolwandle. Amazwe kufanele axhumane futhi ahlaziye izinguquko zesimo sezulu ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela kahle futhi balungiselele izimo ezingalindelekile. ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean unikeza amathuba okuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe. Ukubambisana kwezomnotho, ezemvelo, nezokuphepha kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhweba, okwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kuthuthukise izinga lempilo labantu. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwamazwe bungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezinkingeni ezithinta uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean. Ekuphetheni, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungumthombo obalulekile wezinsiza, kodwa uhlanganisa nezinselelo ezinkulu. Kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo nezinselelo ezihambisana nalolu lwandle ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imvelo, ukuthuthukisa umnotho, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwamazwe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamazwe kuzoba yisixazululo esibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo kulolu lwandle. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean luhlala luwumthombo wezinsiza, hhayi umthombo wezinkinga.
Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izimo Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Izimo eziphuthumayo zivame ukwenzeka, futhi zidinga ukuphathwa ngokushesha nangokunembile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusindiswa kwempilo. Izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezithile ezimisiwe ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha lezi zimo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezahlukene ezihilela abaphathi bezimo, odokotela, nezisebenzi zempilo. Ukuhlonza Isimo Esiphuthumayo Isinyathelo sokuqala ekuqondeni isimo esiphuthumayo ukuhlohla izimo zomgibeli. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nesigameko, njengokuthi umgibeli uphila kanjani, iminyaka yakhe, nezinkinga zempilo ezikhona. Ukuhlonza kahle isimo kubalulekile ukuze abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo. Ukuthumela Isicelo Sokuphuthuma Uma isimo sitholakele, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuthumela isicelo sokuphuthuma. Lokhu kungenziwa ngocingo noma ngokuqondile, kuye ngendawo. Kubalulekile ukuthi isicelo sibe nesithombe esicacile sokuthi kwenzekani, ukuze abezimo eziphuthumayo bakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukucacisa ukuthi umgibeli udinga usizo oluphuthumayo, njengokukhathala okukhulu, ukushaywa yinqaba, noma ukungaphefumuli. Ukufika Kwezisebenzi Zokuphuthuma Lapho usizo lufikile, abezimo eziphuthumayo bafika endaweni yokwenzeka. Bahlola isimo somgibeli futhi baqale ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukunika umgibeli umoya, ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, noma ukwelashwa uma kudingeka. Abathintekayo bahlola izimpawu zomgibeli, njengokushisa komzimba, ukuphefumula, nokushaya kwenhliziyo, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Ukudluliselwa Kwezokwelapha Uma umgibeli esebenzisa izinqubo eziphuthumayo, kungenzeka kudingeke ukuthi adluliselwe esibhedlela. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi eziphuthumayo nezibhedlela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umgibeli ufika endaweni efanele. Ukudluliselwa kwenziwa ngokucophelela, kucatshangelwa izimo zomgibeli, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwakhe. Ukuphathwa Kwezimpendulo Zokwelapha Lapho umgibeli efikile esibhedlela, udokotela uthola ithuba lokuhlola isimo sakhe ngokuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izitho zomzimba, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokwelapha ezifanele. Abodokotela bahlala bexhumana nezisebenzi eziphuthumayo ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi kwenzekani ngaphambi kokufika kwesiguli. Ukwelashwa Nokubuyiselwa Empilweni Ngemuva kokuhlola, udokotela uthatha izinqumo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, ukuhlinzwa, noma ukwelashwa okujwayelekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi umgibeli abuyiselwe empilweni ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi zempilo. Uhlelo lokwelashwa lwenziwa ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomgibeli, futhi abodokotela bahlala beqapha impendulo yakhe. Ukwazi Ukuvuselela Ngemuva kokuphathwa, umgibeli udinga isikhathi sokuvuselela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ubuyela empilweni yakhe ejwayelekile. Izisebenzi zempilo zikhumbula ukuthi ukuvuselela akuhlanganisi kuphela impilo yomzimba, kodwa futhi nempilo yengqondo. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komgibeli nodokotela kubalulekile ukuze umgibeli azizwe ephephile futhi ehloniphekile. Ukufundisa Nokuqwashisa Ngemva kokuphila, kubalulekile ukufundisa umgibeli ngezindlela zokuphepha, ukuze agweme izimo eziphuthumayo esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufundisa ngempilo, ukudla okunempilo, nokuzivocavoca. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zinto kuzokwenza umgibeli abe nekhono lokuphila impilo enempilo. Isiphetho Izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuxhumana okuhle, izinqubo ezicacile, nezisebenzi ezilungiselelwe kahle. Ukuhlohla, ukuthumela isicelo sokuphuthuma, ukufika kwezisebenzi, ukudluliselwa, ukuphathwa, nokuvuselela, konke kudinga ukuhamba kwezinqubo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusindiswa kwempilo. Ukufundisa umgibeli ngezindlela zokuphepha nokuphila impilo enempilo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekugwemeni izimo eziphuthumayo esikhathini esizayo. Ngale ndlela, izibhedlela zikhombisa indlela yokuphila nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngendlela efanele.
Isithombe 1: Umhloli ohlola ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba ubonisa okwenziwa ngaphansi komhlaba. Ekubhaleni kwethu, sichaza ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba nokuthi kwenzeka kanjani. Lapha sizochaza ukuthi umhloli wokuhlanganiswa komhlaba usebenza kanjani nezindlela zokuphatha ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Idivayisi ehlola ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba izosibonisa okwenziwa ngaphakathi komhlaba, kodwa kukhona nezinye amathuluzi nezindlela zokuhlola ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Lo mhloli usiza ngoba usebenza njalo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umhlaba uphansi noma usetshenziswe. Uma ucabanga ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba kuvimbela izitshalo ekukhuleni kahle, ungasebenzisa kalula lo mhloli ukuze uthole inkinga. Inani lamanzi emhlabeni kufanele lihambisane nalolo mhlaba. Uma umhlaba umanzi kakhulu noma umanzi kakhulu, ukufundwa komhloli kungase kungathembekile njalo. Umhloli uyisikhonkwane sensimbi esisindayo esingu-30 grams, esinokhandla osiza ukufaka emhlabeni kanye ne-gauge ekhombisa ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Kukhona izikhonkwane ezisebenza emhlabeni othambile nezinye ezisebenza emhlabeni onzima. Imishini ibonisa ngekilopaskali ukuthi umhlaba uhambisana kangakanani. Iphinde ibonise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kukhona kanjani ngaphansi komhlaba. Lokhu kungakusiza ukuthi ubone ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kukhona kanjani kuwo wonke amapulazi akho, kukuvumele ukuthi ulime ngendlela efanele ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukuphatha ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Awufanele ulime kakhulu noma kaningi. Sebenza ngendlela egcina umhlaba kuze kube ufika endleleni ebizwa ngokuthi "ukulima okuncane." Sebenzisa umgibeli nezinye imishini kuphela uma umhlaba ungawumanzile kakhulu. Ungakuhlola kalula lokhu. Bamba umhole ufinyelele ku-15 cm ubukhulu bese uthatha isampula somhlaba. Zama ukwenza ibhola ngalowo mhlaba ngesandla. Uma ibhola lenziwa kalula (umhlaba uyabambeka), khona-ke umhlaba umanzi kakhulu. Uma ibhola lihlukaniswa kalula, khona-ke akufanele usebenzise imishini. Zama ukungasebenzisi ama-ploughs amadala aphazamisa umhlaba. Sebenzisa ama-ploughs anama-tines abukhali angakwazi ukungena ng глубины ukuze aphule izindawo ezihlanganisiwe. Uma usebenzisa lowo plough, qiniseka ukuthi awuphazamiseki umhlaba ophakeme kodwa ungene ngokwanele ukuze uphule ama-layer ahlanganisiwe. Uma uphonsa ngempempe engaphazamisi umhlaba ophakeme, kuzosisiza ukuphula ukuhlanganiswa okubangelwa ukuna kwemvula noma ukuhamba kwemishini esindayo. Qiniseka ukuthi imbewu ibekwe kahle ne-fertilizer emgibeni. Ukuhluza phakathi kwezitshalo kuzophula ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba ophakeme, kuvumele umoya ukuba ungene emhlabeni, futhi uma imvula iyawa, amanzi azongena kalula. Kubalulekile ukujikeleza izinhlobo zezitshalo njalo. Imizi yezitshalo ezahlukene ayifani futhi izosiza ukuvimbela ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Ukulima ama-legumes, amahlanga, kanye ne-soybeans kuzosisiza ukuvimbela ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Izitshalo ezifana namahlanga afana ne-forage zingalima ezindaweni lapho umlimi engafuni khona ukulima isitshalo esingaphindwanga. Lezi zitshalo zingaphinde zifakwe ukuze zihlale umhlaba ngoba imishini ayisebenzi lapho ngaleso sikhathi. Ukukhiqizwa kokudla okukhuliswa ngemuva kweminyaka emibili noma emithathu kule ndawo kuvame ukukhula. Zama ukugcina izindlela zezimoto zihlala zifanayo - imishini kufanele ihambe endaweni ethile. Ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba kulezi zindawo kuzokwenza umgibeli uhambisane kangcono futhi ungadli kakhulu i-diesel. Izigaba lapho izitshalo zikhuliswa khona azihlanganisiwe, futhi umhlaba lapho awuhlanganisiwe. Uma kukhona lezi zindlela ezihlanganisiwe, kuzosisiza uma imvula inyuka kakhulu. Qala ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezizogcina umhlaba futhi uzame ukufaka izinto eziningi eziphilayo (i-mulch) emhlabeni ezinyangeni ezizayo.
Bonke abantu banezithandwa, amalungu omndeni, noma izihlobo ezihlala ne-HIV virus kanye nezinto ezihambisana nayo. Ukuze sikhombise uthando, ukunakekela, nokukhumbula, sikhanyisa amakhandlela ukuze bring ithemba ezimpilweni zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukwethemba uMdali ngoba uyazi ukuqala kwethu nokuphela kwethu, kusho uMnu. Motsa ophuma emkhankasweni weSheshi eMzimvubu. Uphayona uMthethwa, ophatha ithimba elikhuthaza ukuqwashisa ngama-HIV esifundazweni, uphumelele kulabo abaneziqu zokuzwa. Le nkqubo izovumela abashayeli bezinqola ukufinyelela izinsizakalo zezempilo kalula, futhi kubonakala ukuthi izinsizakalo zezempilo ziya kubashayeli bezinqola. Ikliniki yaqala ukusebenza ngoJuni 2006, ngenhloso enkulu yokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo kubashayeli bezinqola kanye nabalingani babo besilisa abaseduze. Cishe abagulayo abangu-40 bavakashela le kliniki nsuku zonke. Lokhu kuyakhuthaza futhi kukhombisa ukuthi uMnyango Wezempilo uyaphumelela empini yokulwa ne-HIV kanye nezinto ezihambisana nayo, kanye nezifo ezihlobene. Kunzima kithi ukuya eklinikini ejwayelekile ngoba izinqola zethu azivunyelwe. Le kliniki izosiza kakhulu ngoba sizofunda ukuthi singazithathela kanjani, sithole ulwazi nge-HIV kanye nezinto ezihambisana nayo, kanye nezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, bese sithumela le mininingwane kubalingani bethu esisebenza nabo futhi sibhakabhaka, kusho uMnu. Clement Mthwane, oshayeli bezinqola ovela eMtubatuba. Le kliniki ivulekile nsuku zonke kusukela ngo-5:00 PM kuze kube phakathi kwamabili. Kukhona ab nurse ababili abaqashwe ukuze basebenze lapha. Kunzima ukuhamba nsuku zonke ngenkathi sikhumbula izidingo zomndeni ngasohlangothini, kodwa konke lokho kwenza kube lula ngoba noma emsebenzini, usebenza ngokuqinile. UMnu. Shushu ugcizelela ukuthi inqobo nje uma imilenze nesikhathi kuvumela, ngeke akhanyise ukuhamba, eqonda ukuthi mhlawumbe uma ethola isikhathi esanele sokuzilolonga, angawina lo mqhudelwano.
Imiyalelo ye-Debit Order kanye nemininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zempilo ziye zathuthuka, zenza kube lula kubantu ukuhlela izimali zabo. Omunye wemigomo ethokozisayo yalesi sikhathi ukuhlinzeka ngezimali zempilo nge-deduction eyaziwa njenge-debit order. Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu ngabasebenzisi be-GEMS, okuyinkampani enezinsizakalo ezinhle emikhakheni yezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthola imiyalelo ecacile mayelana nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza i-debit order, kanye nemininingwane yasebhange edingekayo. Okokuqala, i-debit order iyindlela ephephile yokukhokha izindleko zempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imali ethile ikhululwa ku-akhawunti yakho yebhange njalo ngenyanga ukuze ikhokhe izindleko ezihlobene ne-GEMS. Lokhu kusiza ukuhlela izimali ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqhubekayo kokukhokha. Bonke abahlanganyeli be-GEMS kumele baqonde imiyalelo ethile ukuze le ndlela isebenze kahle. Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuba ne-akhawunti yasebhange evulekile, okuyisidingo esiyisisekelo. Ngemuva kwalokho, kufanele uthole ifomu lokubhaliswa kwe-debit order, elitholakala kalula ku-inthanethi noma ehhovisi le-GEMS. Ngemuva kokugcwalisa ifomu, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane efanele, njengegama, inombolo ye-ID, kanye nemininingwane ye-akhawunti yasebhange, ifakiwe ngendlela efanele ukuze ugweme izinkinga. Uma ifomu selithunyelwe ehhovisi le-GEMS, ungakwenza lokhu ngeposi noma ngokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuthumela. Kubalulekile ukukhetha indlela yokuthumela ehamba phambili kuwe. Uma ifomu lingene, uzothola isiqinisekiso sokuthi i-debit order yakho isiqalile, okuthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwakho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ungase udinge ukubuyekeza imininingwane yakho yasebhange, njengoba izinguquko empilweni yakho zingase zidinge izinguquko ezifanele. Kubalulekile ukufaka izinguquko ezidingekayo ngesikhathi, ukuze ugweme izinkinga ezizovela. Futhi, qaphela izindleko ezihambisana ne-debit order, njengoba izinkampani zempilo zingase zibe nezimali zokubhaliswa. Ukwazi izindleko zakho kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali. Abathengi kufanele bazi futhi ngezinkinga ezingase zenzeke, njengokungafaki kahle imali ku-akhawunti, okungaholela ekutheni ungakhokhi izindleko zakho zempilo. Ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole ukuxhaswa nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga kuyasiza kakhulu. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi bazi kahle imiyalelo ye-debit order nemininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS. Le ndlela yokukhokha iguqula indlela esihlela ngayo izimali zempilo, futhi iyindlela elula yokugcina izindleko zethu zempilo. Ngakho, hlola kahle, qonda izinqubo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uhlala ufinyelela ukwelashwa okudingayo. Ukuphumelela kwe-debit order kudinga ukubambisana okuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS nomsebenzisi ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili empilweni yethu.

Isigaba 32 somthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) ("umthethosisekelo") unikeza amalungelo omphakathi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nganoma iyiphi inhlangano yangasese noma yomphakathi. Umthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kolwazi. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuqinisa isiko lokucacisa nokubhekelela ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezangaphakathi ("DHA") ngokusebenzisa ilungelo lolwazi abantu noma izinhlangano ezidinga ukulisebenzisa nokulivikela noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zabo. Ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwa umthetho kufanele lusetshenziswe ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo evunyelwe umthetho njengoba kunikezwa esigabeni 9 soMthetho (kuhlanganise, kodwa kungagcini lapho, imikhawulo ehlose ukuvikela ubumfihlo, ubufihlo bezentengiselwano, kanye nokuphathwa kahle, ukusebenza kahle, nokuphathwa kahle) nangendlela elinganisa lelo lungelo nezinye izimfanelo, kuhlanganise nalabo abakwiBill of Rights kumthethosisekelo. Ngokusho kwesigaba 14 soMthetho, izinhlangano zomphakathi ezifana ne-DHA kumele ziqoqa ibhukwana ukusiza abantu ekutholeni ulwazi oluvela kule nhlangano. Isigaba 14 sichaza kahle izidingo ezincane zaleli bhukwana. Ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo nomthetho, i-DHA iletha le bhukwana ngenhloso yokuphakamisa isiko lokucacisa nokuphathwa kahle. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhlinzeka abafuna ulwazi ngezindlela nemininingwane yokuxhumana edingekayo ukuze bathole ulwazi ngqo kwi-DHA. Le bhukwana iphinde ihlinzeke incazelo ecacile yesakhiwo, amandla, nemisebenzi ye-DHA, kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi lwabo ngezigaba, ukuze abafuna ulwazi bakwazi ukubona kalula ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo lutholakala kuphi. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga iKomidi leMithetho Yomuntu waseNingizimu Afrika ("SAHRC") ukuthi siqoqe umhlahlandlela wokuthi ungawusebenzisa kanjani umthetho, kuzo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni nangendlela elula ukuyifunda, ngaphambi kukaJulayi 2003. Ngesikhathi le bhukwana ibhalwa, umhlahlandlela we-SAHRc wawungakatholakali. Ulwazi lokuxhumana lwabo bonke ofisa ulwazi kanye nabasizi babo kuzo zonke izinhlangano zomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuthi ungafaka kanjani izicelo zezimfihlo ezivela ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezangasese. Usizo olukhona oluvela kumfisa ulwazi wenhlangano yomphakathi ngokomthetho. Izixazululo zomthetho ezitholakalayo uma inhlangano yomphakathi noma eyangasese ingahambisani nomthetho, kuhlanganise nokuthi ungafaka kanjani isikhalazo sangaphakathi nokufaka isicelo enkantolo (okuyindlela yokugcina uma uzama ukuvula noma yiziphi izimfanelo ezishiwo kumthetho). Ulwazi lokuthi izinhlangano zomphakathi nezangasese ziqoqa kanjani izimfihlo, nokuthi abafuna ulwazi bangazithola kanjani izimfihlo, kanye nokudalula ezinye izinhlobo zezimfihlo ngokuzithandela. Incazelo yezimiso zomthetho ezisunguliwe. Le bhukwana yokuhola izobuyekezwa ngemininingwane emisha futhi iphinde iphumelele njalo eminyakeni emibili. Izincwadi ezikhethiwe kuzo zonke izifunda, ezibizwa "njengamaphuzu okugcina asemthethweni," ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokugcina Osemthethweni (Umthetho No. 54 ka-1997). Zonke izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezisemthethweni. Zonke amahhovisi ezikhungo zomphakathi, kuhlanganise nawo wonke amahhovisi omkhandlu nezamahhovisi eMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa KweMithetho. Kufanele futhi kube khona emahhovisi e-SAHRc nasematheni e-SAHRc ku-http://www.sahrc.org.za. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izophrintwa kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Ingafinyelelwa mahhala kulezi zikhungo ezishiwo ngenhla, nakuba izindleko zokukopisha zingase zikhokhwe. Izicelo zokufinyelela ezimfihlo ze-DHA kumele zenziwe ngofomu olusemthethweni olushicilelwe kuMnotice weHulumeni No. R. 187 owadlalwa ngomhla zingu-15 kuFebhuwari 2002. Umthetho ubhekisela kabanzi kumfisa ulwazi njengomuntu okufanele wamukele futhi abheke izicelo, kodwa kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi isigaba 17 sivumela abantu abaningi ukuba baphakanyiswe ukuze basize umfisa ulwazi. Lezi zinsizwa eziphakanyisiwe zibizwa ngokuthi abasizi bomfisa ulwazi. Le fomu kulula ukuyigcwalisa, kodwa uma kudingeka, kungabizwa umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ukuze asize umfisa ulwazi. Uma umfisa ulwazi engakwazi ukwenza isicelo esibhaliwe, umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu futhi anikeze umfisa ulwazi ikhophi. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bazi ukuthi yiziphi izimfihlo abafuna ukuzithola. Uma umfisa ulwazi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezimfihlo ezidingekayo ukuze kube lula ukuzithola, i-DHA izokwazi ukusiza umfisa ulwazi ngokushesha. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bathole ukuthi ubani ophethe izimfihlo. Kumele basebenzise uhlu lwezihloko nezigaba zolwazi olugcinwe ngumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ukuze bazi ukuthi yimuphi umfisa ulwazi ongena nezimfihlo, bese bethumela izicelo zabo kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi. Umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ngamunye unomsebenzi wokunquma ukuthi avumele ukufinyelela ezimfihlo ngaphansi kokulawula kwabo. Amafomu okufaka izicelo atholakala kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi yomphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi. Angasetshenziswa futhi ngekopya yefomu. Ifomu lokufaka eligcwalisiwe lingaba nolwazi oluningi kangangokuthi umfisa ulwazi angase angakwazi ukulithumela. Kuzokwamukelwa kuphela imali, ama-oda eposi, kanye nezinkokhelo ezivunyelwe yibhange. Ukukhokha kungafakwa ehhovisi le-DHA eliseduze (uma le hhovisi ingenayo i-cashier, izothumela umfisa ulwazi ehhovisi le-DHA elinayo) futhi ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesikweletu kufanele ifakwe kufomu lokufaka isicelo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukukhokha kwakho kungahambisana nefomu lokufaka isicelo kanye nesikweletu ositholile. Ngemuva kokuthi ifomu igcwaliswe, kufanele ithunyelwe kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ofanele. Akudingeki ukuthi ithunyelwe mathupha; empeleni, lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma izinhlelo zangaphambi kokuthunyelwa zenzekile. Idokhumenti egcwalisiwe ingathunyelwa nge-fax, nge-imeyili, ngeposi, noma ithunyelwe nge-courier kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ofanele. Uma umfisa ulwazi engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma ukungasebenzi kahle kumvimbela ekwenzeni isicelo, umfisa ulwazi angacela usizo kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi. Kuvame ukuba ngcono ukuhlela kusenesikhathi ukuze ube nesicelo sokukhuluma futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani lokhu kubalulekile. Ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana ngezinkinga, umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo kumfisa ulwazi futhi anikeze ikhophi yefomu eligcwalisiwe. Ab
Ukuhlolwa kwezimiso zomphakathi kuyindlela yePhalamende yokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uhlala enesibopho kubantu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlola njalo (ukulandela) izinhlelo zohulumeni. IPhalamende kanye neKomidi layo linamandla okukhanga noma ubani noma inhlangano ukuze ihlinzeke ngobufakazi noma ikhiphe imibhalo ethile, bese ibika kubo. Umthethosisekelo uthi iPhalamende inegunya lokuvakashela wonke amalungu ohulumeni, kuhlanganise nalabo abakwezifunda kanye nezinga likamasipala. Ukuvakashela kohulumeni ezindaweni zomphakathi kuyinselelo ebekwe kwiPhalamende nguMthethosisekelo ukuze kuhlolwe futhi kulandelwe uhulumeni. Ngokubhekelela izinhlelo zohulumeni, iPhalamende ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu kuyenzeka, ukuze bonke abantu baphile impilo engcono futhi enhlonipho. IPhalamende ibheka uhulumeni ngezizathu ezilandelayo: ukubheka nokuvimbela ukuziphatha okungafanele ukuvimbela ukuziphatha okungemthetho nokungemthethweni okuvela kuhulumeni ukuvikela amalungelo nezikhala zabantu ukuwenza uhulumeni abe nesibopho ngendlela imali yokuhlawula izintela esetshenziswe ngayo ukuwenza ukusebenza kohulumeni kube sobala futhi kukhuphule ukwethenjwa komphakathi kuhulumeni. IPhalamende inezindlu ezimbili, okungukuthi: iNdlu yeSizwe (eyaziwa njenge-NA), kanye neNdlu yeZifunda (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). Izinhlaka zineqhaza elithile ekuhloleni okufanele lidlale. Umthethosisekelo uthi iNdlu yeSizwe ikhethwe ukuze imele abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni onenhlonipho kubantu ngaphansi komthethosisekelo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuthi: kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ohulumeni angakwiHulumeni kazwelonke angabekwa phansi kwesibopho sokuphatha kwawo, nokubheka ukusebenza kuhulumeni kazwelonke, kanye nokuphumeleliswa kwemithetho egcizelelwe yiPhalamende. I-NCOP imele izifunda ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zixazululwa ngaphakathi komkhakha wohulumeni kazwelonke. Iqhaza le-NCOP ukuhlole ukusebenza kuhulumeni ezingeni likamasipala nezifunda. I-NCOP ingacela ilungu leKhabhinethi, isisebenzi soHulumeni kazwelonke, noma umphakathi wombuso wezifunda ukuba baphumelele emhlanganweni weNdlu noma komidi. AmaKomidi ePhalamende asungulwa njengamathuluzi ezindlu zombili ngaphansi komthethosisekelo ukuze ahlole futhi alandele uhulumeni. La maKomidi "ayizinjini ezinamandla" zePhalamende zokuhlola uhulumeni nokwenza imisebenzi yePhalamende. AmaKomidi abheka imithetho, ahlole ukusebenza kohulumeni, futhi abambisane nomphakathi. Omunye wemibandela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuhlola uhulumeni ezindaweni zomphakathi ukuhlela imibiko yokuhlola yokuhamba kwemali yohulumeni ngamaKomidi, kanye nemibiko ye-Auditor-General. Ngokwezidingo zokuhlola ukusebenza kohulumeni, iKomidi ingacela umbiko omfushane kulungu lesimo noma ingavakashela le ndawo ukuze iqinisekise amaqiniso. UNgqongqoshe WezeMali umemezela izinhlelo zebhajethi zonyaka wezimali ozayo, kanye nezinsuku zebhajethi zazo zonke izigaba. Ngemva kokwethulwa kwezinsuku zebhajethi, iKomidi ngalinye libamba izinkulumo nezinsizakalo zohulumeni ezihlobene lapho lenza ukuhlola komphakathi ngoba amalungu omphakathi abizelwe. Lokhu kusebenza njengokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iSigaba sigcine imisebenzi yaso evela eminyakeni edlule, nokuthi isebenzise imali yokuhlawula izintela ngendlela efanele. Ukubuza imibuzo kuhulumeni kuyindlela eyodwa iPhalamende ebamba ngayo uhulumeni esibopho. Imibuzo okufanele iphendulwe ngokuqondile noma ngokuqopha ingaqondiswa kumongameli, kumongameli ophakathi, kanye noNgqongqoshe mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Isikhathi semibuzo sinikeza Amalungu ePhalamende ithuba lokubuza amalungu ohulumeni mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu, imele amaqembu abo ezepolitiki noma abantu abavotele. Ngokusebenzisa le nqubo, Amalungu ePhalamende angakwenza izitatimende eNdlu nganoma iyiphi indaba. Ngokunikeza Isaziso seMoti, ilungu noma yimuphi umphakathi wezepolitiki lingathumela izinkinga noma ukukhathazeka ukuze kuxoxwe ePhalamende, ngaleyo ndlela kusiza ukuba kuqedwe imisebenzi yokuhlola komphakathi njengohulumeni. Ukuxoxisana kwePhalamende kuyindlela enye yokuletha ulwazi olubalulekile phambi kuhulumeni ukuze luhlolwe mayelana nezinhlelo zohulumeni ezithile noma imithetho edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lesifunda unikeza Amalungu ePhalamende ithuba elihlukile lokwenza ukuhlola komphakathi egameni kuhulumeni kuphela. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lesifunda unikeza indlela eduze yokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu ePhalamende nomphakathi. Amalungu anomsebenzi wokwazisa iPhalamende nganoma yiziphi izinkinga abazithola ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana kokuhlola komphakathi. Ukwenza isethulo kwiKomidi yePhalamende kuyindlela enye yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokuthonya imibono yamalungu eKomidi axoxa ngengxenye ethile ye-bill ngaphambi kokuba ibe umthetho. Wonke umphakathi ophila lapha eNingizimu Afrika unelungelo lokufaka isicelo kuPhalamende, njengoba kubekwe emthethweni. Noma ubani, iqembu labantu, noma inhlangano ingafaka isicelo kuPhalamende. Isicelo siyisicelo esisemthethweni kumagunya ukuze sithathe isinyathelo. Singathatha ifomu lesikhalazo, isicelo sosizo, noma ukuphinda kuthunyelwe izikhalazo. Isimo somnotho womhlaba sisesimweni esinzima kakhulu uma siqhathaniswa neminyaka edlule. Inhlangano Yezabasebenzi Yezwe ibala ukuthi kungaba nabantu abangu-18 million abangase baphume emisebenzini yabo kulonyaka. Lesi simo singaba sibi kakhulu uma ukwehla komnotho kuqhubeka. Akukho sizwe esiphephile kulokhu kubi. Zonke izizwe, kuhlanganise nezithuthukile ezifana ne-United States, iBrithani, neFransi, azithembisi lutho uma kuziwa emnothweni. Nokho, isimo eNingizimu Afrika asibi sibi kangako, futhi sifuna ukusigcina njalo. Empeleni, sifuna umnotho wethu uqhubeke ukhula ukuze sikwazi ukuqhubeka sithuthukisa izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Sizodinga ukusebenzisa ikusasa ukuze sixazulule izinselelo esihlangabezana nazo. Njengoba kwenzeka kuzo zonke izizwe, izinga lokuthuthukiswa komnotho ezweni lethu lehle. Siphinde sihlangabezane nenkinga yokulahlekelwa kwemisebenzi, futhi abaningi bethu bazobhekana nezinkinga zokuhlangabezana nezindleko zethu. Ukwehla komnotho kuzoholela ekutheni uhulumeni uthole imali encane yokuhlawula izintela. Ngokuqinisekile, uhulumeni uzodinga ukuboleka imali ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo zakhe. Nokho, uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokufaka izinsiza zezimali ukusiza labo abadinga usizo, futhi uzogcizelela izinhlelo ezidala imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwe-780 billion rand izobhalwa ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza ezisemqoka eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Iziteshi zokukhiqiza amandla, imigwaqo,
Izilwane nemikhiqizo yezilwane zingathunyelwa kuphela uma ziqhamuka endaweni ehambisana nezindinganiso zomhlaba jikelele ezibekiwe, noma lapho imithetho efanele yezwe elithumelayo ihambisana nalezo zezwe elitholayo. Le ndawo ingaba yindawo yokukhulisa nokuhlinzeka ngezilwane ezamukelekayo, isikhungo sokukhulisa, isikhungo sokuhlanganisa, umhlaba, indawo yokudla, ifektri yokucubungula ukudla, indawo yokugcina ukudla, nokunye. Xhumana nomhloli wezempilo yezilwane kahulumeni esifundeni sakho ukuze ufake isicelo sokuhlolwa ngenhloso yokuthumela. I-raphothi yokuhlolwa ithunyelwa kwiMnyango Wezolimo ukuze yamukelwe kanye nesizathu kanye nesiphakamiso sokugcina se-PSV. Uma isicelo samukelwa, le ndawo ibhaliswa, futhi kukhishwa isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kokuthumela kwezilwane. Isikhathi esithathwa ukuze processing isicelo siyahluka ukusuka esifundeni ukuya esifundeni. Lokhu kuncike esifundeni. Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Xhumana nomhloli wezempilo yezilwane kahulumeni esifundeni sakho noma iMnyango Wezolimo.
Izikole Zikahulumeni Umbuzo 1: Yini izikole zikahulumeni? Izikole zikahulumeni yizikhungo zemfundo ezisuselwa kuhulumeni, ezihlinzeka ngempilo yokufunda kubantwana bezinhlanga ezahlukene. Lezi zikole zisebenza ngaphansi kwemithetho nemigomo ehleliwe uhulumeni, futhi imfundo ethulwa kulezi zikole ivame ukuba mahhala noma ngentela ephansi. Umbuzo 2: Kutheni kubalulekile ukuba nezikole zikahulumeni? Izikole zikahulumeni zibalulekile ngoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantwana, kungakhathaliseki imvelaphi yabo, bathola imfundo efanelekile. Lokhu kuqinisa umphakathi, kunciphisa ubuphofu, futhi kukhuthaza intuthuko yezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza ukufundwa kwemigomo yobumbano, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabafundi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda ezikoleni zikahulumeni? Ezikoleni zikahulumeni, abafundi bethu bahlomula ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, imfundo iyatholakala kalula kumphakathi, futhi akudingi izimali ezinkulu. Okwesibili, izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zinezinhlelo ezivamile, okuvumela ukufunda okulinganayo kwazo zonke izifundo. Okwesithathu, abafundi banethuba lokuhlangana nabanye, kulapho bequkethwe kuzo zonke izinhlanga nasezizindeni, okuhlinzeka ngethuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuhlukahlukene. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezikole zikahulumeni? Noma zinezinhlelo ezimangalisayo, izikole zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukushoda kwemali yokuphatha kudala ukuba kube nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengokuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele. Okwesibili, imithombo yokufunda, njengezincwadi nezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi, iyashoda. Okwesithathu, ab teachers bahlushwa ukungabi neziqu ezanele, okungaholela ekwehleni kwezinga lemfundo. Umbuzo 5: Umalusi wezokufunda udlala muphi umkhiqizo ezikoleni zikahulumeni? Umalusi wezokufunda udlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni izikole zikahulumeni zisebenze kahle. Uqinisekisa ukuthi izigaba zihlala zihlanzekile, ukuthi othisha banikwe ukuqeqeshwa okufanele, futhi bahlola ukusebenza kwabafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umalusi uhola izinhlelo ezithuthukisa izinga lemfundo, okuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano nezikhungo zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola konke abakudingayo. Umbuzo 6: Zithini izinqubomgomo ezithinta izikole zikahulumeni? Izikole zikahulumeni zikhokhelwa yizinqubomgomo ezithile ezibekwe uhulumeni. Lezi zinqubomgomo zifaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwemithetho yokufunda, ukuxhaswa kwezemfundo, nokuphathwa kwezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuhlinzekwa ngemihlahlandlela yokuthi izikole kufanele ziqhube izinhlelo zokufunda nezokusebenza ezithuthukisa abafundi. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele yenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole zikahulumeni? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole zikahulumeni, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni ahlinzeke ngaphezulu kwemali ukuze kusebenze izikole kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezithuthukile, ukuqeqesha othisha, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumanisa imiphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukufaka abafundi emigqumeni yokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo, ukuze baphinde babe nomthelela ezingxoxweni ezithinta ukwakheka kwezinhlelo zemfundo. Umbuzo 8: Yimaphi amakhono abafundi abangawathola ezikoleni zikahulumeni? Abafundi ezikoleni zikahulumeni bangathola amakhono ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kufaka phakathi amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okucabanga, kanye nekhono lokusebenza nabanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundi bazoba nekhono lokuqonda izifundo ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa isayensi, ubuciko, nezezimali. Lezi zinto zibasiza ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emphakathini. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izikole zikahulumeni zinomthelela omuhle empilweni yabafundi? Yebo, izikole zikahulumeni zinemithelela emihle empilweni yabafundi. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantwana bathola ithuba lokufunda, okwandisa amathuba abo okuphumelela empilweni. Lokhu kuqinisa ukuzethemba kwabo, futhi kubasiza ukuba bakhe amaphupho abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zifundisa abafundi ukubaluleka kokubambisana nokuxhumana, okubalulekile empilweni yabo. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ikhuthazwe ukuze kuholele ekuthuthukiseni izikole zikahulumeni? Ukuze kuthuthuke izikole zikahulumeni, kudingeka ukukhuthazwa kokusebenzisana phakathi kukahulumeni, imiphakathi, nezikole. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufaka izinhlelo ezisekelwe kumphakathi, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokufunda, nokwakha imikhiqizo ethuthukisela abafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali, ukuze kuboniswe izidingo nemibono ehlukene. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinto, izikole zikahulumeni zingadlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobuchwepheshe, futhi obumbene.
Impilo Yengqondo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Empilweni Yethu Empilweni yamanje, lapho ubuhlungu bempilo yengqondo buvele ngokukhanya, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngale ndaba ngendlela efanele. Impilo yengqondo iyinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu yonke, kodwa, ngeshwa, ibhujiswa yizinkinga eziningi ezithinta abantu abaningi. Ngaphezulu kokuba yisigaba esibalulekile sempilo, impilo yengqondo ithinta indlela esibona ngayo umhlaba, izinqumo esizithathayo, kanye nobudlelwano bethu nabanye. Okokuqala, kudinga ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayiyona into engatholakala kalula. Akukhona nje ukuthi umuntu uyazizwa engcono noma embi; impilo yengqondo ibhekene nezimo ezinzima, njengokukhathazeka, ukudangala, noma ezinye izifo ezihlobene nomqondo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokwejwayelekile, futhi akukhona ukungajabuli kuphela, kodwa kungaba nezimbangela eziningi zokuthi kungani umuntu ezizwa engcono noma embi. Kungaba yizimo zokuphila, imithombo yokucindezeleka, noma ngisho nokushoda kwezinsiza zokwelapha. Kodwa-ke, kunenkinga enkulu lapho sikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Umphakathi uthanda ukuzama ukufihla lezi zinkinga, futhi abanye abantu bacasulwa uma bekhuluma ngazo. Lokhu kuze kube yinkinga, ngoba ukuvuma ukuthi sinesidingo sokwelashwa kwengqondo kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuphila kahle. Ukuhlonipha lesi sikhathi sokukhuluma, kudinga ukuba sithathe izinqumo ezinzima mayelana nokuthi singakha kanjani umphakathi owelapha. Ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo akukona ukuvuma ukuhlaselwa, kodwa kuyisiqalo sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngesikhathi samanje, usuku nosuku sibona abantu besebenzisa izikhala eziningi zokukhuluma, njengezinkundla zokuxhumana, ukuthola ukwesekwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, kodwa kufanele kabusha nokuqonda ukuthi ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zempilo yengqondo akumele kube okukhathaza, kodwa kufanele kube okujabulisayo. Uhlelo lokuxhumana olukhulayo lungasiza ekwakheni isimo sokuhlonipha nokuqonda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yengqondo ayimkhulu nje, kodwa iyinselele. I-World Health Organization (WHO) ibonisa ukuthi impilo yengqondo ihlobene ngqo nezinga lokuphila. Uma sikhuluma ngalokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isinyathelo sokwakha izinsiza eziwusizo zokuthola usizo. Lokhu kubandakanya izinhlelo zezemidlalo, izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe, nezinye izinsiza ezihlinzeka ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo. Ukwengeza, ukuxhumana nokuhlonipha abanye kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Abantu abavuma ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo kufanele bathole ukwesekwa, okungahlanganisa ukwelashwa, ukufunda, noma ukuxhumana nabanye. Lokhu kuthuthukisa umuzwa wokuba nenhlonipho, kanti futhi kunciphisa umthwalo wezinkinga zengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhuthaze ukufunda ngempilo yengqondo. Imfundo ibalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ezenzakalayo, nokuthi singazixazulula kanjani. Namuhla, izikhungo eziningi zifundisa abantu ngezinselelo zempilo yengqondo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukwenziwa kube yinto ejwayelekile, hhayi nje okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ekugcineni, impilo yengqondo iyinselele enkulu, kodwa ingasixazulula uma siphathelene nayo ngendlela efanele. Umphakathi, izikhungo, nabantu ngabanye kumele basebenzisane ukuze basize othile abakudinga. Ukukhula kwempilo yengqondo kudinga umsebenzi, ubuhlakani, kanye nomqondo ovulekile. Lokhu kwazisa ukuthi impilo yengqondo ikhuluma ngempilo yethu yonke, futhi kufanele siyihloniphe njengengxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakwazi ukusiza ukuvuselela impilo yengqondo, futhi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuphumelelayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, asifuni ukuba namathambo ezinkinga, kodwa sifuna ukubambisana ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngalokho, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyathokoziswa, futhi ibaluleke njengempilo yomzimba. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sikhuluma, sizame, futhi sigxile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo. Lokhu kuzosisiza nonke empilweni yethu, nangenhlonipho yokuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile, kuphila kahle, nokuthi zonke izinsiza zidingeka ukuze sikhulise umphakathi ophilayo nonobudlelwano.
Kubathengi nababambiqhaza, izinga lomsebenzi, ukwaneliseka kwabantu, ukusebenza kwalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo futhi baxhumane nabo, kanye nemiphumela yenhlangano. Imiphumela yocwaningo lolu izokwabelwana nabaphathi abaphezulu be-DOD/neSANDF. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuphendula yonke imibuzo ngokuqotho. Lokhu akusikho ukuhlolwa, futhi awekho amajwayelekile noma amaphutha. Umbono wakho ubalulekile njengempendulo efanele. Icentri izobheka ulwazi olunikeziwe njengoluyimfihlo ngenhloso yokuhlaziywa komthelela. Lokhu ngeke kudalulwe ngoba iCentri Yokuhlaziywa Komthelela izohlaziya ulwazi ngokuhlanganisa, ngokwesibonelo, ngamaqembu obulili ahlukanisiwe. Kulula ukuqedela imibuzo ethulelwe lapha ngoba imibuzo eminingi iphendulwa kalula ngokumaka umjikelezo eduze kwenombolo efanele kakhulu ukukrepresenta wena noma ekhombisa umbono wakho. Ngiyabonga ngokubambisana nathi ekuhlinzekeni ngolwazi oluceliwe. Icentri oyisebenzela iyiphi? Iyini ikhowudi yeqembu lakho emsebenzini (PERSOL)? Uhlangothi luni owawela kulo? Ubulili bakho bungakanani? Abaholi/abaphathi eqenjini/umnyango/iyunithi yakho bayawuqeda umsebenzi wabo ngesikhathi nangokunakekela? Abaholi/abaphathi eqenjini/umnyango/iyunithi yakho bayawulalela yini udaba lwabo abaphansi kwabo? Kulula yini ukuxhumana nabaholi/abaphathi eqenjini/umnyango neyunithi yakho? Abaholi/abaphathi eqenjini/umnyango/iyunithi yakho bachaza kahle yini kulabo abaphansi kwabo okumele kwenziwe? Abaholi/abaphathi eqenjini/umnyango/iyunithi yakho baqinisekisa ukuthi abaphansi kwabo bayakuqonda kahle futhi bayazi ukuthi kulindeleke kubo? Abaholi/abaphathi eqenjini/umnyango/iyunithi yakho baqinisekisa ukuthi abaphansi kwabo baqeqeshwe ngokwanele ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo? Umphathi wakho uyakhuluma nawe ngokwanele mayelana nekusasa lakho emsebenzini owenzayo? Umphathi wakho uyakweluleka ngendlela engcono yokwenza umsebenzi wakho? Uthola ukuqeqeshwa ngenkathi usemsebenzini (uthola ulwazi ngokuqhubeka nomsebenzi) ukuze kukusize uthuthukise ukusebenza kwakho? Ingabe umsebenzi omuhle owenzile eqenjini/umnyango noma iyunithi uyamukelwa? Unethuba elihle lokukhushulwa uma uphumelela emsebenzini wakho? Unethuba elihle lokuthola ibhonasi yokusebenza uma uphumelela emsebenzini wakho? Uyazi ukuthi umsebenzi wakho uwuphi? Abaholi/abaphathi beqembu/umnyango/iyunithi yakho bayabheka yini izindawo zomphakathi? Ingabe imicabango nezenzo zabaholi/abaphathi baleli qembu/umnyango/iyunithi ibonisa intshisekelo ezwenikazi laseNingizimu Afrika? Bonke abantu nezigaba, ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwe-DOD, banothando neqembu, umnyango, kanye neyunithi, njengabasebenzi, abathengi, abahlinzeki, kanye nohulumeni. Ingabe amalungu/abasebenzi beqembu lakho... Yamukela imigomo yeqembu? Bamba iqhaza ngenhloso nabanye amalungu? Bhelphe ngaphandle kokucelwa uma kudingeka? Ingabe umholi/umphathi wezempi weqembu/umnyango/iyunithi yami uqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amalungu aqonda ukuthi umsebenzi wabo uxhumene kanjani nenqubo yonke? Ingabe kuyajwayeleka ukusungula amazinga okwaneliseka kwabathengi kusetshenziswa lezi zindlela ezilandelayo? Ingabe kukhona inzuzo etholelwe yiqembu/umnyango/iyunithi yakho ezinyangeni eziyi-12 ezedlule ehambisana nezinga lakho lomsebenzi/umkhiqizo? Imibiko elandelayo ibonisa imizwa yakho mayelana neqembu/umnyango/iyunithi yakho. Emibikweni ngayinye, khombisa izinga ocabanga ukuthi lifaneleka kuyo yonke ingxenye yeqembu/umnyango/iyunithi yakho njengoba kuchazwe emibikweni ngayinye.
Ukwamukela Imigomo Yenqubomgomo: Iphrofayela kaSipho Ndlovu U-Sipho Ndlovu ungumuntu onomlando ocebile kanye nezenzo ezibalulekile empilweni yakhe. Uthole imfundo yakhe eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho afunda khona ezokuphatha. Njengomuntu onothando lokusiza abanye, uSipho ugxile ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu abakhe. Ubuye abe ngumgqugquzeli omkhulu wezempilo, futhi usebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ezibalulekile. Ubhala ngempumelelo yakhe, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uSipho uvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo yeGEMS, okuyinsiza ebhekelele izidingo zempilo zabantu abasha. Lokhu akukhombisi nje kuphela ukuzimisela kwakhe, kodwa futhi kubonisa ubuhlakani bakhe ekukhetheni izinsiza ezifanele. U-Sipho ufisa ukuba isibonelo sokuthi umuntu angayithola kanjani imiphumela emihle ngokuhlonipha nokulandela imithetho ebekiwe. Ngokwamukela le migomo, uSipho ubonisa ukuthi ukwaziwa kwemigomo yenkampani kudlala indima enkulu ekuphumeleleni. U-Sipho ubona ukubaluleka kokwazisa abantu ngalezi zimo, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi yini elindeleke kubo. Uhlonipha imithetho, futhi ukwazisa abantu ngezinqubomgomo kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. U-Sipho usebenzisa izikhathi ezithile zokuqeqesha ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abanikazi bezinkonzo bayazi ngemigomo yeGEMS. Ubuye ahlele imihlangano yokuxoxa nezithakazelo ezahlukene, lapho abantu bekhona bangabaza khona futhi bebuza ngezinto ezikhathazayo. Lokhu kukhombisa indlela uSipho abamba ngayo imisebenzi yakhe, futhi ubona lokho njengendlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nezakhamuzi. Njengomholi, uSipho uzama njalo ukufundisa abantu abalungiselela ukwamukela le migomo, eqinisekisa ukuthi abayithola kahle imiphumela engakaze ibonwe. U-Sipho uqonda ukuthi ukwamukela imigomo yeGEMS akuhlanganisi nje kuphela ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokuphila kahle kwabantu. Ubonisa ukuzinikela kokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, oqinile futhi osebenzisanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSipho uphinde abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezithinta imiphakathi, efuna ukwakha izinsiza ezenzakalayo ezithinta ukuphepha kwezempilo yabantu. U-Sipho ubona ukubaluleka kokuba nemigomo eqinile, elungiselelwe ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza emculweni wokwakha isizinda esiqinile sokuphila kwempilo. U-Sipho uyazi ukuthi ukuphumelela kwemigomo yeGEMS kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani kanye nohulumeni. Ubuye aqonde ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ezidingekayo, futhi ubhaca ngezindlela ezahlukene zokukhuthaza ukuthula nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho uphinde ahlanganyele nezikhungo ezahlukahlukene ukuze aqhube izinhlelo zokufundisa. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukusiza abantu bazi kahle ngokwamukela izinqubomgomo, nezinsizakalo ezitholakala ngaphansi kweGEMS. U-Sipho ubeka phambili imiqondo emisha yokugcina abantu bejabulile futhi beqonda okufanele bakwenze ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Ukwamukela imigomo yeGEMS akuyona nje into yokufaneleka, kodwa kuwumsebenzi obalulekile oqhubekayo. U-Sipho ubona lokhu njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ophelele, ophumelelayo. Imigomo yeGEMS ayikho emkhathini kuphela, kodwa ihlola izindlela ezithinta imiphakathi, ibhekisisa izidingo zabantu, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi abanye bayazi okuningi futhi basizwa. Ekugcineni, uSipho Ndlovu ungumuntu ongumholi oqinile, okhuthazayo, futhi onomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Ukwamukela imigomo yeGEMS kubonisa indlela adlula ngayo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni eziphumelelayo, futhi ubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. U-Sipho uqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi oqinile, onobumbano, nokuzinikela ekusizeni abanye.
Ezobuhlakani Bokwenziwa: Indaba Yomlando Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa, noma i-Artificial Intelligence (AI), yinsiza ethokozisayo futhi ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukuze siqonde kahle le mboni, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba zayo ezahlukene, kusukela emiqalweni yayo kuze kube yizinsuku zethu. Ukwakhiwa kwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuqala eminyakeni engama-1950, lapho abacwaningi abanjengo-Alan Turing beqala ukucabanga ngempela ngezimiso zokwenza imishini eziphila njengezidalwa. U-Turing, owaziwa kakhulu ngombono wakhe wokuthi imishini ingakwazi ukufunda, waphakamisa umbuzo obalulekile: "Ingabe imishini ingakwazi ukujabulisa?" Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwe-Turing Test, okuyindlela yokuhlola ubuhlakani bemishini. Ngemva kwalokho, eminyakeni yama-1960, abacwaningi baqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokuqala zokufunda. Lezi zinhlelo zaziwusizo kakhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezithile, njengokuhumusha izilimi noma ukuhlela imininingwane. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zazikhawulelwe kakhulu, futhi abacwaningi babebhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kwaholela esikhathini esibizwa ngokuthi "i-AI Winter," lapho ukuncipha kokuxhaswa kwemali nokuthakazelelwa kwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa kwaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, eminyakeni yama-1980, abacwaningi baqala ukuphinda baphinde bahlola izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwenza imishini zibe nobuhlakani. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezibizwa ngokuthi "neural networks," ezazisiza ekufundeni nasekuthuthukiseni izinqumo. Lezi zinhlelo zathola impumelelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nokuhumusha, ukubona, nokuhlaziya idatha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bukhula kakhulu, futhi eminyakeni yama-2000, i-AI yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu. Ukuze kube lula, abacwaningi baqala ukusebenzisa izindlela zokufunda ezijulile, okuyindlela yokufunda eyenza imishini ikwazi ukufunda ngokwakha izakhiwo ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezinjenge-Google DeepMind, eyaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yayo yokudlala i-Go, umdlalo odinga ubuhlakani obukhulu. Namuhla, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenza ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela ezinhlelweni zokuphatha izinkampani, ezokwelapha, ezokuthengisa, kanye nasezokuxhumana. Izinhlelo ezinjenge-Alexa, Siri, kanye ne-Google Assistant zikhombisa indlela ubuhlakani bokwenziwa obuphila ngayo empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa sebuye bube yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu. Nokho, ukuvela kwe-AI akukhombisi kuphela izinzuzo. Kukhona nezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwayo. Izinkinga zokuphepha, ukuvikelwa kwedatha, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlukaniswa kwezobuchwepheshe zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile nezibopho ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenza ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokulimaza abantu noma imiphakathi. Ngokubheka phambili, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buzoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Izinkampani eziningi zisebenza ekwakheni izixazululo ezithuthukile, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa kufanele busebenze njengomsebenzi wethu, hhayi njengomphumela wokuphila kwethu. Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imishini yethu iyasiza, futhi ayithathi indawo yethu. Ekugcineni, indaba yezobuhlakani bokwenziwa iyindida ebanzi, ehlanganisa izifundo eziningi, izinselelo, nezifiso. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha le mboni, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola, sithuthukise, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busebenza ngendlela efanele, bulethe izinzuzo, futhi buphila kahle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuhlakani, nolwazi olujulile.
Ukukhwabanisa okukhuluma: Uma uvuka ekuseni, uthola ukudla kuqala. Abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuthatha ukulawulwa ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze banciphise izindleko, noma ukubona nokuthatha ithuba elivela ukuze bathole inzuzo enhle, ngoba abathathi izinyathelo ezidingekayo uma isikhathi esifanele sifika. Ngamanye amahlandla babhekana nezingozi ezidalwa yizimo zemvelo, ezifana nezomiso noma imvula enzima ethinta umhlabathi ngoba bayakhohlwa ukuthi "kuhle ukugwema isifo kunokuzama ukusipha." Ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela kusho ukuthi kufanele ube nezinhlelo ezibheke phambili futhi wenze lezo zinto ezizovikela izingozi ezingaba khona. Uma ufuna ukuphatha ukulima nokukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ehlala isikhathi eside, lokhu kubalulekile. Ikhalenda yomsebenzi wakho wezolimo (izikhathi zokwenza imisebenzi ethile) kufanele ibe umhlahlandlela wemisebenzi efanele okufanele yenziwe ebhizinisini lakho lezolimo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isikhathi esihle sokutshala (lokhu kuyimsebenzi enkulu epulazini lakho) singaba ekuqaleni kukaJuni uma uthengisa ummbila noma ekuqaleni kukaNovemba uma uthengisa izitshalo zonyaka. Zonke izinkomba nemisebenzi okufanele yenziwe ezinyangeni eziholela ekutshaliseni zizohambisana nalolo suku lokutshala. Cabanga phambili (lungiselela kusenesikhathi) njalo. Lokhu kuyimsebenzi oqhubekayo futhi obalulekile ngoba kusiza umlimi ukwenza izinto ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu okungakwenzi kule nyanga kungakusiza ugweme ukwenza amaphutha nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngonyaka ozayo. Isibonelo: izinhlobo zezithelo ozibona kule nyanga zizokusiza ukukhetha izinhlobo ezifanele zamakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Uma ungakwenzi kahle futhi ungaboni izinkinga kule nyanga, kungenzeka zibuyele ngonyaka ozayo. Phinda uhlole nokuhlola isivuno somhlabathi bese ubala kahle inani le-hectares ofuna ukulima. Bheka lokho emakethe ithi bese ukhetha izinhlobo zokutshala ezizokwenza inzuzo enhle. Hlanganisa noma ulungise isimo sakho sezimali (ibhajethi) futhi ubhale phansi uhlelo lokukhiqiza ephepheni. Ezikhathini zanamuhla, kubalulekile ukukhetha ibhizinisi elithembekile elisekelwe emakethe lapho usayina inkontileka. Inkontileka izokuvikela uma amanani okudla enyuka noma ehla. Qinisekisa inkontileka yezitshalo ezithile futhi zama ukuthola intengo enhle njalo. Uzodinga ukuthola uxhaso uma uhlela ukutshala indawo enkulu ngaphezu kwemali oyitholayo. Ungathatha isikhathi eside ukuya endaweni lapho imali ibolekwa khona, ngakho hamba ngokushesha ngemva kokulungiselela uhlelo lwakho lokukhiqiza. Inqubo yokuthola imali nokuthola imvume ivame ukuthatha isikhathi. Uma ungakwazi ukuzixhasa nokuzitshala, signa inkontileka masisha nomthengisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokulima (amatraktori nezinsiza) izotholakala ngesikhathi uma uhlela ukulima nokutshala. Ngaphambi kokusayina inkontileka, zama ukuhlola imishini yomthengisi ukuze ubone ukuthi isesimweni esihle noma cha. Khumbula, uma imishini iphuka ngesikhathi sokutshala nokulima, kungadala izingozi ngoba isikhathi sishesha. Isikhathi esihle sokuhlola nokulungisa imishini yakho yisikhathi osuphelile ukutshala nokulima. Uma ushiyela lokhu emuva, kungakubiza kakhulu ukukulungisa ngoba kuzodingeka kulungiswe ngokushesha njengoba isikhathi sokutshala esifanele sibalulekile. Uma ulungisa, gcina imishini ihlanzekile ngendlela ezovikela ukugqwala, futhi ngeke kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuyilungiselela ukutshala. Bheka zonke izakhiwo ezivimba amanzi ezifana nezikhukhula nezinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi. Thola isikhathi sokulungisa lezi zakhiwo ngaphambi kokubhekana nezingcuphe, ulahlekelwe umhlabathi omuhle uma kuqala ukuwa. Uma ufuna ukwakha izakhiwo ezintsha, qala ngokushesha ngomsebenzi. Izindlela zokugcina umhlabathi zidinga ukucabangela ngokucophelela futhi zithatha isikhathi. Sebenzisa isikhathi sakho kahle ukuze uthenge izinto ezidingekayo. Qhathanisa amanani ahlukene futhi zama ukuthola intengo ephansi ukuze izindleko zokutshala nge-hectare zinganyuki kakhulu. Futhi hlola ngesikhathi sokutshala ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezisebenza kahle bese ukhetha ezinhle ozosebenzisa ngonyaka ozayo. Ungaphuthelwa ukucindezela abathengisi ukuba banikeze konke okudingayo ngesikhathi njengoba kuvunyelwene. Khumbula, kukhona ochwepheshe abaningi nabantu abanolwazi abangakusiza ngalezi zinto zonke. Kodwa ungasheshisi kubo emuva kokuphela kwesikhathi. Lungiselela wena futhi uxhumane nabo NAMUHLA!
