Lapho umqondo weziningi uqala ngo-1994, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banikela uhulumeni wabo wokuqala wenkululeko ukuba babhekane nesikhumbuzo se-apartheid - ikakhulukazi ukungalingani, ubuphofu, nokucwaswa. Kwakufanele futhi ukubuyisela izwe emphakathini womhlaba owawukhishwa ngenxa ye-apartheid. Ngonyaka ka-2004, ngemuva kweminyaka eyishumi yenhlalakahle, kube nentuthuko enkulu, kodwa okuningi kusasele ukwenza. Nakuba sizame ukubhekana nesikhumbuzo se-apartheid, izinguquko emphakathini wethu zilethe izinselelo eziningi. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka eyisibili yokukhululeka, abaningi bahlala ngaphandle komnotho futhi bengakwazi ukujabulela ukuthuthukiswa. Nakuba kukhona okuthuthukile lapha, uhulumeni ubebambezeleka ezindaweni lapho kwakudingeka ukuba abambisane nabanye, njengokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Uhulumeni uqobo udinga ukusebenza ngokuqinile futhi ubhekane kangcono nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukhetho luka-2004 lwenze ukuthi uhulumeni uqale ukufaka izinhlelo ezizokwakha futhi zixhase - futhi futhi zisheshise - ukuthuthukiswa nokubhekana nezinkinga. Uhulumeni ubize ukubambisana nomphakathi, ubeka izinhloso zokunciphisa ubuphofu nokungasebenzi ngonyaka ka-2014. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kukahulumeni, izikhangiso ezivusa umqondo zokulwa nobugebengu kanye nobudlelwano beNingizimu Afrika namanye amazwe nazo ziqalile. Kwenzekeni ngemuva kweminyaka engu-15? Isisekelo esibekwe eminyakeni yokuqala yokuphatha ngenhlalakahle nezinhlelo ezintsha kusukela ngo-2004 sekwenze ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe nendlela yokukhula okusheshayo. Ngasikhathi sinye, ezinye izinselelo ziqhubekile. Izinselelo ezintsha zivele nezinguquko emphakathini wethu nasemhlabeni esiwutholayo. Njengoba siqhubeka phambili, kudingeka sifunde esikhathini esidlule. Kulokhu kweminyaka engu-15 yokukhululeka, umthelela wezinhlelo zikahulumeni ububekwe kanjani ekusizeni iNingizimu Afrika ukuba ibe nomphakathi ogxile ekulinganeni, ukungacwaswa ngokobuhlanga, nokungacwaswa ngokobulili? Uhulumeni uphumelele kanjani kulokho abekwe khona, futhi lokhu kungenziwa kanjani kube ngcono? Ucwaningo lwenziwe ngaphakathi kukahulumeni nangaphandle. Imiphumela yaphuma njengombiko esizowuxoxa. Inhloso yalezi zindaba ukukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba axoxe ngalezi zindaba njengoba izwe lethu liqhubeka phambili ekwakheni umphakathi omusha. Yiziphi izindlela ezithuthukisile? Yiziphi izinto ezingashintshanga? Yisiphi isichasiso esenziwe ngumphakathi nabantu? Singaqinisekisa kanjani ukubambisana ukuze izinto ziqhubeke phambili? Lo mbhalo uyisifinyezo sokubuyekezwa kweminyaka engu-15. Umbiko ophelele utholakala ku-inthanethi yeHhovisi likaMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika (www.gov.za). Kusukela ngo-2004, kube nokugxila ekusebenzeni ngokuvumelana nomqondo weziningi nasekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kukahulumeni. I-democracy egxile emthethweni - ukuvezwa kwezikole eziphakeme kanye neziqu ezizimele sekubekwe. Abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi - kukhona abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe abangaphezu kuka-3,000. Ukwazi kwabaholi bendabuko ku-democracy - imithetho neminyango emisha inikeza ubuholi bendabuko indima ohlelweni lwethu lwezombusazwe. Izwe elivulekile nelicacile: - Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000 uvumela izakhamuzi ukufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe nguhulumeni. I-Batho Pele ibeka "Abantu kuqala" njengesisekelo sokusebenza kukahulumeni. Izinkomfa ezintathu zokulwa nobugebengu phakathi kuka-2001 no-2008 ziqhube impi yokulwa nobugebengu kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Ukuguqulwa kokusebenza kukahulumeni - iminyaka eyishumi yokuqala ilethe intuthuko emangalisayo ekuhlanganiseni imisebenzi ehlukene ohlelweni oluhlangene lomphakathi. Ukusebenza kukahulumeni kuncike kakhulu emiphakathini. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999 kanye noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomkhandlu, 2003 kuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuhlela, ukuqapha, nokuhlola kube kuqinisiwe. Kukhona izinhlelo zokuphatha ukusebenza kukahulumeni. Umkhankaso omkhulu wokuqeqesha waqala lapho kwavulwa isikhungo sokuqeqesha abasebenzi kukahulumeni ngo-Agasti 2008. Kusukela ngo-2004, iPhrojekthi Ehlanganisiwe isungule umkhawulo wezindawo ezingama-136 ezinomsebenzi othile. Ngo-2006, indlela yokuzihlola yethulwa esikhungweni esaziwa ngokuthi iFive-Year Local Government Strategic Agenda. Ukukhula kwezinkinga kukhombisa isidingo sokukhulisa iziteshi zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizalwane nalabo abaphethe. Umsebenzi womphakathi udinga ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni eziningi. Ukuqala ukusebenza kahle kwehlisa umthelela wezikhangiso zokulwa nobugebengu. Uhulumeni, ikakhulukazi ezingeni likamasipala, ubhekene nezinkinga zokuhola nokugcina abasebenzi abadingekayo. Izinhlelo zomphakathi zenzile okuningi ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, kodwa izixazululo zesikhathi eside zidingeka. Uhlelo lwezikhwama zokuxhaswa - lokhu kube yinto ebalulekile ekunciphiseni inani labantu abaphila ebuphofwini. Kwakukhona abantu abangu-2.5 million abawatholayo ngo-1999 - manje sekuhamba phambili ngaphezu kuka-12 million. Ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, ezokuhlanzeka, kanye ne-electrification. Imindeni emisha ithola izidingo eziyisisekelo mahhala: amalitha angu-6,000 wamanzi kanye ne-50 kilowatts ye-electrification ngenyanga. Ikhwalithi yezinsizakalo zomphakathi idinga ukuthuthukiswa. Naphezu kwesabelomali esikhulu semfundo, leli hlelo likhiqiza imiphumela engaguquki. Uhulumeni uhlose ukudlulisela ama-hectare angama-24.9 emhlabeni okungaba yizivini ngonyaka ka-2014 - kuze kube manje, ama-hectare angama-4.8 adlulisiwe. Kwezinye izigaba, kube nokukhula. Imfundo - izindlela zokuthuthukisa imfundo zikhuphule izinga labafundi. Iningi lemali lisetshenziselwa ukufundisa ezikoleni zomphakathi, Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Ezingakabi Nempilo, Imfundo Yabantu Abakhulile, kanye neMikhakha Yezemfundo Nezokuqeqesha. Inani labafundi beMfundo Ephakeme likhule lisuka ku-300,000 ngo-1986 laya ku-750,000 ngo-2005. Ukubhaliswa ezikoleni zeMfundo Ephakeme Nezokuqeqesha kukhule ngama-34% kusukela ngo-1982 kuya ku-2002. Impilo - ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo, izibhedlela, nezikhungo zezempilo kukhombisa ukuthi u-95% wabaseNingizimu Afrika bahlala ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo emihlanu yezenhlalakahle. Inani lokufa kwabantu abakhulelwe lehle laphuma ngaphezu kuka-50,000 ngo-1990 laya ku-5,000 ngo-2007. Ukwelashwa kwe-tuberculosis (TB) kuphumelele ngama-70%. Ngeminyaka yama-1990, amazinga okuhlaselwa kwe-HIV akhule kakhulu kodwa manje asehle. Phakathi kwabesifazane abangaphansi kweminyaka engama-20 abakhulelwe, izinga
Umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane Isingeniso Ukucishwa kukagesi kwenzeka ngezizathu ezahlukene, kubandakanya ukuguguleka kwezinsiza, izikhala zokusebenza, noma izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kukhansela imisebenzi eminingi, ikakhulukazi emabhizinisini amancane, lapho ukuncishiswa kokusebenza kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, izisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza. Le doko ibhalwe ngenhloso yokuhlola umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi amabhizinisi angazivumelanisa kanjani nezimo ezinjalo. Umthelela Wezomnotho 1. Ukulahlekelwa Kwemali - Ukucishwa kukagesi kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali okukhulu, njengoba amabhizinisi amancane evame ukuncika kumakhasimende. Uma kukhona ukuvinjelwa kokusebenza, amabhizinisi angase ahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, okukhuthaza amakhasimende ukuthi abheke kwezinye izinkampani. 2. Izindleko Zokusebenza - Ukuze amabhizinisi agcine ukusebenza, kudingeka izixazululo eziphuthumayo, njengezizinda zokugcina ugesi, eziholela ezindlekweni ezengeziwe. Lokhu kungaphazamisa isabelomali samabhizinisi amancane, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. 3. Ukunciphisa Imikhiqizo Noma Izinsizakalo - Ukucishwa kukagesi kungaholela ekunciphiseni imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukuthengiswa, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina ibhizinisi. Umthelela Emisebenzini 1. Ukulahleka Kwezisebenzi - Uma amabhizinisi engakwazi ukusebenza, izisebenzi zingase zishiywe ngaphandle kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola abasebenzi abanekhono uma ibhizinisi selithola ugesi. 2. Ukunciphisa Umsebenzi - Ukucishwa kukagesi kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Abasebenzi bangase bahlale bezama ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihambisana nokungasebenzi kukagesi, okwenza kube nzima ukugxila emsebenzini. 3. Ukuphazamiseka Kwezinqubo Zokusebenza - Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezixhomeke kukagesi, njengohlelo lokuphatha, zingase zibe nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kungaphazamisa izinqubo zokusebenza, kuholele ekwehliseni izinga lokusebenza. Izixazululo Zokuphila Ngezimo Zokucishwa Kukagesi 1. Ukusebenzisa Izinsiza Zokugcina Ugesi - Amabhizinisi angafaka izinsiza zokugcina ugesi, njengezibani ezisebenza ngogesi ophumayo, ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza ngesikhathi sokucishwa kukagesi. Lokhu kuzovumela amabhizinisi ukuba aqhubeke nokusebenza ngempumelelo. 2. Ukuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokuhlinzeka Ngogesi - Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumayo, kungasiza amabhizinisi ukuthi azivumelanise nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokuqhubekayo. 3. Ukuhlela Ngaphambi Kwezimo Zokucishwa Kukagesi - Amabhizinisi kufanele ahlele izinhlelo zokuphila nezimo zokucishwa kukagesi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, ukuthuthukisa izinqubo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphila eziphuthumayo. Isiphetho Ukucishwa kukagesi kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emabhizinisini amancane, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwemali, ukunciphisa ukusebenza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila. Nokho, amabhizinisi angathola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ukuze azivumelanise nezimo ezinjalo. Ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zokugcina ugesi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, nokuhlela ngaphambi kwezimo zokucishwa kukagesi, amabhizinisi angazivumelanisa nezimo ezinzima futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane aqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokuphila nezimo zokucishwa kukagesi ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi awalahlekelwa yithuba lokukhula nokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yawo.
Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA Umbuzo 1: Yini i-SITA? Impendulo: I-SITA (State Information Technology Agency) iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngesevisi zobuchwepheshe bolwazi emiphakathini kahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. I-SITA ibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokusebenza, nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zikahulumeni. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi? Impendulo: Izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zobuchwepheshe, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, ukungahambisani nezidingo zomsebenzisi, noma izinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle noma zibe nezinkinga ezinkulu. Umbuzo 3: Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA unjani? Impendulo: Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaba mkhulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni ukusebenza kahle kwezikhungo zikahulumeni, ukwehla kokwaneliseka kwabantu, nokuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezifanele ukuhlinzekwa kubantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bangatholi izinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezifana nezokwelapha, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezithinteka kakhulu? Impendulo: Izinsizakalo ezithinteka kakhulu zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuphatha izinsiza zomphakathi, izinhlelo zokubhalisela imfundo, nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezempilo. Uma lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase bangatholi izinsizakalo ezibalulekile, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuphila kwabantu. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezikhona, ukwandisa izinsiza, nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezikhungo, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezinhlelo ze-SITA. Umbuzo 6: Kuthiwani ngezinselelo ezibhekene ne-SITA? Impendulo: I-SITA ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukungabi khona kwemali eyanele, izinkinga zokuphatha, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe. Lezi zinselelo zingathinta amandla e-SITA okusebenza kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 7: Umphakathi ungawusiza kanjani umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungawusiza ngokubambisana ne-SITA, ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo mayelana nezinsizakalo, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ze-SITA. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo ze-SITA? Impendulo: Uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zisebenza kahle, lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezikhungo zikahulumeni, ukwanda kokwaneliseka kwabantu, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphusile. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile. Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngekusasa le-SITA? Impendulo: Ikusasa le-SITA lincike ekutheni izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza kanjani. Uma i-SITA ikwazi ukwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ukwandisa izinsiza, nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa, ingaba nethuba elihle lokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zikahulumeni, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kungasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zihlala zisebenza? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zihlala zisebenza, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukwakha izinhlelo zokubuyekeza, nokwenza izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho: Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaba mkhulu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zihlala zisebenza kahle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile le-SITA.
Izinqubo zedatha yocwaningo (GEMS research data protocols) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-Global Education Monitoring System, iyiqoqo lezinsiza, imininingwane, nezindlela zokuhlola ezithinta imfundo emhlabeni. Injongo yayo wukwenza imfundo ifinyeleleke kubo bonke abantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahluphekayo. I-GEMS ibalulekile ekutholeni ukuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zenhlalo, ezomnotho, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezithile zedatha? Impendulo: Izinqubo zedatha zibalulekile ngoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluqoqiwe lukhona, luhlanzekile, futhi luyakhazimula. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zisekelwe kudatha ethembekile, okwenza kube lula ukusungula izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphandle kwezinqubo ezisemthethweni, kudinga ukuba kube neziphakamiso eziphikisanayo kanye nezinselelo ezikhona. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo eziyinhloko ezithathwa ekucwaningweni kwedatha? Impendulo: Izinyathelo eziyinhloko zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuchaza inhloso nocwaningo. 2. Ukukhetha indlela yokucwaninga efanele. 3. Ukuqoqa imininingwane ngendlela ehlelekile. 4. Ukuhlaziya idatha. 5. Ukuxhumana nemiphumela. Lezi zinyathelo zenza kube lula ukucwaninga nokwazi kahle. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela ezisetshenziswa ekucwaningweni? Impendulo: Kunezindlela eziningi ezisetshenziswa ekucwaningweni, ezifaka phakathi: - Ukuhlola okwenziwe ngqo (quantitative methods). - Ukuhlola okwakhiwe (qualitative methods). - Ucwaningo lwezinhlelo (mixed methods). Lezi zindlela zenzelwe ukuhlola futhi ziqhathanise imibono ehlukene ukuze kuzuze imiphumela ewusizo. Umbuzo 5: Yikuphi okubalulekile ekulawuleni idatha? Impendulo: Ukulawula idatha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idatha iyatholakala, ifinyeleleka, futhi igcinwa ngokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: - Ukuhlela idatha ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. - Ukuvikela idatha emonakalweni nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimfihlo zihlala ziphephile. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iyatholakala ngesikhathi sokuhlola. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinselelo ezikhona ekuqoqeni nasekuhlaziyeni idatha? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinkinga ezivamile zifaka phakathi: - Ukutholakala kwezinsiza ezanele. - Ukuqonda okungaphelele kwemithetho nezimfuneko. - Imikhawulo yokuxhumana phakathi kwabacwaningi. Lezi zinkinga zingavusa izithiyo ezinkulu ekufezeni imiphumela ebekiwe. Umbuzo 7: Uxhumano phakathi kokucwaninga nedatha yemfundo lukhona kanjani? Impendulo: Uxhumano phakathi kokucwaninga nedatha yemfundo lukhona ngokuthi ucwaningo luhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile yokuhlola izinga lemfundo. Idatha yemfundo isiza abacwaningi ukuba bazi ukuthi yiziphi izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, okwenza kube lula ukusungula izinhlelo ezithinta izidingo zabafundi. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani abacwaningi bangashintsha umphumela wocwaningo? Impendulo: Abacwaningi bangathinta umphumela wocwaningo ngezindlela eziningi, ezihlanganisa: - Ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlola. - Ukusebenzisa izibonelo ezihlukene ukuze kuqhathaniswe imiphumela. - Ukuhlaziya idatha ngendlela ehlukile ukuze kutholakale imibono emisha. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa i-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa i-GEMS zifaka phakathi: - Ukuhlinzeka ngedatha ethembekile nezinsizakusebenza ezisemqoka. - Ukwenza kube lula ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo. - Ukuxhasa izinqumo eziphusile ezimbonini zemfundo. I-GEMS ibalulekile ekwakheni umbono onembile wokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo emhlabeni jikelele. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele siqaphele lapho sisebenzisa idatha? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuba siqaphele: - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha oyisebenzisayo iyatholakala futhi iyasebenza. - Ukubheka izimo zomphakathi nezokuhlala lapho idatha iqoqwe khona. - Ukuhlonipha izinqubomgomo zokuvikela idatha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ethathwa iyakhanya futhi iyathembeka. Isiphetho: Izinqubo zedatha yocwaningo, ikakhulukazi i-GEMS, ziqinisa izisekelo ezibalulekile zokucwaninga. Ukulandela lezi zinqubo kuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ethathwa iyakhazimula, ihlonipha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi inika ithuba lokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo ezithinta imfundo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sihlale siqaphele futhi siqhubekele phambili ngokuhlonipha lezi zinqubo.
Umlando Wezisebenzi Zasezimayini Umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini eNingizimu Afrika ubonisa izigigaba ezithokozisayo nezinzima, ezihlanganisa imizamo yokusebenza, ubuhlungu, nobuhlakani bezakhamuzi. Izimayini ziye zaba yinsika yesizwe, zigcina izigidi zabantu zisebenzela imisebenzi ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ziye zabeka abantu ezinzwaneni ezinzima. Ukuqala Kwemayini Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, ngesikhathi sokukhula komnotho, izimayini ziqala ukuphakamisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Izinsiza zemvelo, ikakhulukazi igolide nezinye izinto ezisemqoka, zatholwa eGoli nasezinye izingxenye zezwe. Lokhu kwadala ithuba elikhulu lokusebenza, futhi abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abamnyama, baqalisa ukuhamba baye ezindaweni ezinezimayini. Imisebenzi Yezisebenzi Zasezimayini Izisebenzi ezazihamba zifika ezimayini zazivame ukuhlala ngaphansi kwemigomo enzima. Umsebenzi emayini wawungeyona nje indlela yokuphila, kodwa kwakuyinselele enkulu. Iziphathimandla ezazihola izimayini zazinokuphatha okukhulayo, futhi izisebenzi zazithola imivuzo emincane kakhulu. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabo, njengoba abantu bahlupheka bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ubugebengu Nokuqhubeka Kwezimayini Kukhona nezinselelo ezinkulu ezazihambisana nezimayini. Ubugebengu, ukungabi nalungelo, nezinye izimo eziphazamisa umphakathi zaba yizinto ezijwayelekile. Izisebenzi zazikhuthazwa ukuba zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, kodwa umphakathi wawugcina uvalekile ezinqubweni zokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinyathelo zokuhlukumeza, futhi izisebenzi zafuna izindlela zokuzivikela. Ukuvukela Ubulungisa Ngesikhathi sokukhula kokungqubuzana, izisebenzi zaqala ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuvukela ubulungisa. Kwakukhona izinyathelo ezinkulu zokuhlangana, zifaka phakathi amafemu ezombusazwe namaqembu omphakathi. Lezi zinyathelo zafaka phakathi izinxushunxushu ezinkulu, ezavusa umoya wokulwa nezinselelo ezazibhekene nezisebenzi zasezimayini. Uhlanga Lwezinguquko Kusukela ngekhulu le-20, isimo sezisebenzi sathuthuka kancane. Izikhungo zokuqala zemfundo zatholakala, futhi abantu baqala ukufunda ngezindaba zomnotho, ezombusazwe, nezenhlalakahle. Ubugebengu obubhekene nezisebenzi bukhuphuke, kodwa izisebenzi zathola indlela yokuvikela amalungelo azo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinyathelo ezibambene, okwakukhombisa umoya wokubambisana. Isikhathi Sokuguquka Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokulwa, izisebenzi zezimayini zathola impumelelo enkulu. Imithetho emisha yabhalwa, ivikela amalungelo ezisebenzi. Lokhu kuholele ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinkulu emikhubeni yokusebenza, kwaholela ekwandeni kwemivuzo, izimo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, nokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo. Isiphetho Umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini ubonisa ukuthi, yize izinselelo zikhona, abantu bangakha impumelelo uma bebandakanya imizamo yokubambisana. Izisebenzi ziye zaba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngezikhathi ezinzima, umoya wokulwa uhlala unamandla. Nokho, ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza amalungelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Umlando ungasifundisa ngezinto ezithile, ukuze sikhemphe izifundo zomlando, sithole indlela engcono yokwakha ikusasa elihle. Ngakho-ke, umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini awuwona nje umfanekiso wezinkinga, kodwa ubonisa imizamo yokuphila, uthando, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Uhlanga lwezimayini luhamba phambili, nokho luhlala lukhumbuza ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi umoya wokubambana ungakha izinguquko eziyinhloko. Uhambo lwezisebenzi luhlala luhamba, nokho, luhlale lukhumbula ukuthi, emzamweni, umphakathi uhlala unamandla.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana: I-GEMS Iphakamisa Izinga Lokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izidingo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zikhula, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokwelapha ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele, i-GEMS ibeka phambili ukugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola imithi, izivivinyo, noma izinqubo ezidingekayo. I-GEMS inezinqubo ezicacile zokuthi odokotela baphumelele kanjani ekugunyazweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo ezisemthethweni, lapho odokotela badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nesimo sezempilo sesiguli. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele, futhi kudala ukwethembana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye ne-GEMS. Ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, i-GEMS ibuye ibhekelele izinguquko ezithinta izinqubo zokugunyazwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zokugunyazwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, odokotela bangakwazi ukufaka izicelo zabo nge-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula futhi kusheshise inqubo yokugunyazwa. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni iziguli zithole ukwelashwa ngokushesha, okubalulekile ekwelapheni izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuxhumana Okuphumelelayo Ukuxhumana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye ne-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi kahle izinqubo nezidingo. I-GEMS ibeka phambili ukwakha izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana, ukuze iziguli zikwazi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-smartphone, ezivumela iziguli ukuthi zixhumane ngqo nodokotela bazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibuye inikeze izinsiza zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngefoni, ukuze iziguli zikwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oludingekayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zihlala zazi kahle izinqubo zokugunyazwa, izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezidingo ezithile ezihambisana nezimo zazo. Izifundo Eziqhamukayo Ngenxa yokwanda kwezidingo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi kudingeka izifundo ezithile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa odokotela mayelana nezidingo ezithile zokugunyazwa, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. I-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukufundisa odokotela nokuxhumana nabantu abathintekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibuye ibheke izindlela zokwenza ngcono izinqubo zayo zokugunyazwa, ukuze kube lula futhi kusheshise inqubo yokuthola ukwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zokugunyazwa. Isiphetho I-GEMS ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ibeka phambili ukugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele, futhi kudala ukwethembana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye ne-GEMS. Njengoba izidingo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zikhula, i-GEMS izoqhubeka nokwenza ngcono izinqubo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okungcono.
Kuthunyelwe kubo. Abaphathi Bezifundo Bezifunda, Abadidiyeli Abaphezulu, kanye Nabaphathi ehhovisi elikhulu nasezikhungweni zendawo. Abaphathi bezikole kanye nabasebenzi babo bezikole zomphakathi ezijwayelekile. Izikole zabafundi abanezidingo ezikhethekile zemfundo. Amalungu ezikhungo zokuphatha izikole. Iphondo leGauteng lezeMfundo lenze izinhlelo eziningi zokweseka ukuhlinzekwa okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle kwemfundo esezingeni eliphezulu kule ndawo. Phakathi kwezinye izinto, lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukulungela ukuvakashela esikoleni. Ukulungiselela ukuvakashela esikoleni kuqala ngoMsombuluko wonyaka ophambi konyaka wesikole omusha. Le nqubo ibandakanya ukuhlela imisebenzi phakathi kwemisebenzi ethintana ngqo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzekwa okuphelele komsebenzi osebenzayo ezikoleni ukuze kuqale ukufundiswa nokufunda kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lonyaka wesikole omusha. Le nqubo iphetha ngezivakashi ezivakashela ezindaweni ezibanjwa ngabaphathi abaphezulu nabasebenzi bezigaba ezinsukwini ezimbili zokuqala zokuvulwa kwezikhungo zomphakathi. Umthetho Wezokufunda Kazwelonke No. 27 ka-1996. Umthetho Wokufunda Nokuhlinzeka Ngemfundo No. 98 ka-1996. Izindinganiso Nezindinganiso Zokuxhasa Izikole Kazwelonke njengoba zishintshiwe. Ukuvakashelwa kokuhlola kuyamenyezelwa futhi ZONKE Iziqu Zokuphatha Izikole kanye Nezikhungo Zokuphatha kumele zilungiselele lezi zivakashi kusenesikhathi.
I-Load Shedding Nomthelela Wayo Emnothweni Isingeniso I-load shedding, noma ukwehliswa kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, kube yinkinga ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkinga ibonakala ikhiqiza umthelela omkhulu emnothweni, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, ezentengiselwano, nakubantu ababhekene nezinsiza zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuhlola kuzobheka imbangela ye-load shedding, izimpawu zayo, kanye nomthelela wayo emnothweni. Imbangela ye-Load Shedding I-load shedding ivame ukwenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, okungathinta izizathu eziningi. Ezinye zezizathu zifaka phakathi ukungabi negesi eyanele, izinkinga zokusebenza ezimbonini zamandla, kanye nezinselelo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Izikhungo zamandla, njenge-Eskom, zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga zokugcina izinga lokukhiqiza amandla eliphezulu, okuholela ekutheni kudingeke ukwehliswa kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi ukuze kugwenywe ukwehla kokusebenza. Izimpawu Zokwehla Kokuhlinzekwa Kukagesi I-load shedding ibonakala ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Izimpawu zayo zifaka phakathi ukwehla kokusebenza kwezinkampani, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa nokungabi namandla okusebenzisa izinto ezisemqoka ezifana nezibani, izitofu, nemishini yokusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, njengoba abantu badinga izixazululo eziphuthumayo, ezifana nezizinda zamandla ezizimele nezinye izindlela zokugcina amandla. Umthelela Emnothweni Umthelela we-load shedding emnothweni ubalulekile. Izinkampani eziningi zihlushwa kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini ezincike kakhulu kumandla. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwemikhiqizo, okwandisa izindleko zokukhiqiza, futhi kuholele ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Izinkampani eziningi ziphinde zibe nezinselelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha amakhasimende. Lokhu kungaholela ekwehleni kwemisebenzi, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukusika izindleko ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela we-load shedding ungabonakala ezingeni lomphakathi. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuphila, njengoba ukungabi namandla kukagesi kuholela ekwehleni kokusebenza kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, okwandisa umthwalo emnothweni. Izinga lokuphila liba phezulu, futhi abantu badinga ukusebenzisa imali eningi ukuze bathole izixazululo eziphuthumayo. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokubhekana Nezinkinga Ukuze kubhekwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zamandla zithuthukise ukusebenza kwazo, zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhulise ukukhiqiza amandla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, okuzogwema i-load shedding. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamalanga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi kuzokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwamandla. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, kufanele kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo zamandla nezinkampani ezizimele. Isiphetho I-load shedding iyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi umthelela wayo emnothweni ubonakala kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinyathelo zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banamandla okuphila kahle, futhi izinkampani zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ngamandla, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela we-load shedding, futhi sakhe umnotho oqinile, onempilo. Umphakathi kumele uqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze siqinisekise ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Ukwelashwa kwababhaliswe esibhedlela kufanelekile kulabo abancike ezidakamizwa, noma kulabo abaphakathi kwesimo esiseduze nokuncika kuzo. Ukuhlanganisa nokugcina isikhungo esinezinsiza ezahlukahlukene eminyakeni ehlukene nezakhiwo nezinhlelo ezikhombisa lokhu futhi zikhangisa kahle. Amanani akhonjiswa kumathebula awashintshi futhi afaniswa unyaka nonyaka. Impilo yephakethe ibhekwa njalo ngonyaka ngodokotela bezilwane, futhi iziphakamiso zenziwa ngokufanele.
