Izinkinga Nezinzuzo Zezokumbiwa Phansi Ezokumbiwa phansi, noma mining, yinkambu ebalulekile emhlabeni wethu, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezomnotho. Isebenzisa izinsiza eziningi, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yokwakha, ezobuchwepheshe, nezokuthutha. Nokho, le mikhakha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezibandakanya ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, ukushoda kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, sithole izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nezokumbiwa phansi. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngezinsiza ezitholakala ezokumbiwa phansi. Izinsiza ezifana negolide, insimbi, amalahle, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka zitholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene zokumbiwa. Lezi zinsiza zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngempahla ezidingekayo emikhakheni eminingi, kuhlanganise nezokwakha izindlu, izimoto, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Ngakho-ke, ezokumbiwa phansi zidlala indima enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho, ikakhulukazi ezwenikazi elikhulayo. Nokho, nakuba izinzuzo zikhona, kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nezokumbiwa phansi. Okwokuqala, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kuyinkinga enkulu. Ukuhamba kwezimayini kuholela ekutheni umhlaba ungcoliswe, amanzi angcoliswe, futhi umoya ungcoliswe. Lokhu kuthinta kakhulu izilwane nezitshalo, futhi kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezindawo zokuhlala ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi bahlaselwa yizinkinga zempilo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa. Okwesibili, ukushoda kwezinsiza kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Njengoba izinsiza zikhula, kuthiwa ziya ngokuya zincipha. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezindleko eziphezulu zokuthola lezi zinsiza, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubathengi nabakhiqizi. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwentengo yezimpahla, okuthinta umnotho jikelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokumbiwa phansi zihlala ziphakathi kwezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi bavame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu, ezifana nokuphazamiseka kwemiphakathi, ukulahleka kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zempilo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo bayaphila kahle, kudingeka izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sikhumbule kuphela izinkinga. Kukhona nezindlela zokwenza kube ngcono. Izinkampani ezibamba izokumbiwa phansi zingasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise ukungcoliswa kwemvelo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izinqubo ezihlanzekile zokumbiwa, kanye nokuhlola izindawo ezithintekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela emibi incishiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zingasebenzisa izinsiza eziphindaphindwayo ukuze zinciphise ukuncika kuzinsiza ezinzima. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila ezithuthukile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile kahle, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Ngokuphetha, ezokumbiwa phansi zinezinsiza eziningi ezibalulekile, kodwa zinezingqinamba ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ukuze sithuthukise le mikhakha, sigcine imvelo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumbiwa phansi baphila kahle. Ngaleyo ndlela, singakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo emhlabeni, ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo noma impilo yabantu. Izokumbiwa phansi ingaba yinsiza enkulu, uma kuphela sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele.
Izingxoxo zePhalamende ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time Isingeniso I-Presidential Question Time iyisikhathi esibalulekile esenzeka ngaphakathi kwePhalamende, lapho abameleli bezakhamuzi bephakamisa imibuzo kumongameli. Lezi zingxoxo zenzelwa ukukhulisa ukubambisana phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezinhlelo zikamasipala, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezimo ezithinta izakhamuzi. Le dokhumenti ibheka izici ezisemqoka ze-Presidential Question Time, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ngcono le nqubo. Izinhloso ze-Presidential Question Time I-Presidential Question Time inezinhloso eziningi ezibalulekile: 1. Ukubambisana: Ukuhlinzeka ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi, okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi. 2. Ukuphendula imibuzo: Ukuvumela abameleli bezakhamuzi ukuba baphakamise imibuzo ethinta izindaba ezibalulekile, okuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuphendula izidingo zomphakathi. 3. Ukukhulisa ukubonakala: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umongameli ubonakala emphakathini, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngokuqondile. 4. Ukuphendula izikhalazo: Ukuvumela umongameli ukuba aphendule izikhalazo ezivela ezakhamuzini, okukhombisa ukuzibophezela ekuphenduleni izidingo zomphakathi. Izici eziyinhloko ze-Presidential Question Time 1. Isikhathi esinqunyiwe: I-Presidential Question Time ibanjwa ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe, okuvumela abameleli ukuba balungiselele imibuzo yabo ngaphambi kwesikhathi. 2. Imibuzo ebhaliwe: Imibuzo ivamise ukuba ibhaliwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umongameli unakho konke okudingekayo ukuze aphendule kahle. 3. Ukuphendula okusheshayo: Umongameli kufanele aphendule imibuzo ngokushesha, okukhombisa ukuzimisela nokuhlonipha izakhamuzi. 4. Izimpendulo ezicacile: Izimpendulo kufanele zibe zicacile, ziqondile, futhi zikhombise ukuqonda okujulile kwezindaba eziphakanyisiwe. Izinzuzo ze-Presidential Question Time 1. Ukukhulisa ukwazi: Izingxoxo zikhulisa ulwazi lwezakhamuzi mayelana nezinhlelo zikamasipala, izinqubomgomo, nezimo ezithinta impilo yabo. 2. Ukuphucula izinqubomgomo: Imibuzo ethile ingaholela ekutheni umongameli abone izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. 3. Ukukhuthaza ukubandakanywa: I-Presidential Question Time ikhuthaza abameleli bezakhamuzi ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezinqubweni zomphakathi, okwakha umphakathi ozinikele. 4. Ukukhulisa ukwethembeka: Ukuvumela umongameli ukuba aphendule imibuzo ngokuqondile kubalulekile ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi. Izindlela zokwenza ngcono i-Presidential Question Time 1. Ukukhulisa ukufinyelela: Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela eziningi zokufinyelela i-Presidential Question Time, njengezinkundla zokuxhumana, ukuze izakhamuzi eziningi zikwazi ukubamba iqhaza. 2. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa: Ukuqeqesha abameleli bezakhamuzi ngendlela yokuphakamisa imibuzo efanele, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. 3. Ukuthuthukisa izinqubo: Ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi. 4. Ukubuyekeza izimpendulo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimpendulo ezitholakalayo zihlala zisesikhathini, futhi ziqondile, ukuze zikhombise izinguquko ezithile ezithinta izakhamuzi. Isiphetho I-Presidential Question Time iyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana phakathi kukamongameli nezakhamuzi. Le nqubo inezinzuzo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ekukhuliseni ukwazi, ukwethembeka, nokubandakanywa komphakathi. Ukuze le nqubo iqhubeke ithuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlala zikhuluma, futhi umongameli uyaphendula. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obumbene, futhi obonisa ukuzimisela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bonke.
Nansi engicela, ngithumele futhi ngikunika imvume yokukhupha imali yami yephenshini ku-akhawunti yasebhange eshiwo ngenhla. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi le mali evunyelwe izokwenziwa ngokuqhubekayo ngendlela ebizwa ngokuthi yi-EFT Magnetic Tape Service, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi akukho mbono wokukhokha ozonikezwa yibhange, kodwa imininingwane yokukhokha ngakunye izobhalwa ku-akhawunti yasebhange noma ku-voucher efanele. (Lokhu akwenzi uma ibhange lingakhishi izitatimende, isibonelo, ama-akhawunti okonga noma ama-akhawunti wokudlulisa). Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi amaphenshini akhokhwa ngosuku lwe-25 lwenyanga, noma uma usuku lwe-25 luhlangana nesonto, ngeSonto, noma ngempelasonto, ukukhokha kuzokwenziwa ngosuku olwandulela lokusebenza. Akukho bufakazi obubonakalayo bokuthi imali isifakiwe. Le mvume ingakhanselwa ngokukunika isaziso esibhaliwe sezinsuku eziyi-30, "ethunyelwe ngeposi elibhalisiwe." Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyafunga ukuthi le mininingwane eyengeziwe iyiqiniso futhi iphelele futhi ukuthi umphathiswa wezokukhokha ngeke abhekane nomthwalo wemfanelo nganoma yikuphi ukukhokha okungaholelwa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso noma olungaphelele oluthunyelwe ngami.
### Izinga Eliphezulu Lobugebengu #### Isingeniso Bubugebengu, noma imisebenzi engahambisani nomthetho, isimo esibucayi emiphakathini eminingi emhlabeni. Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu libonisa ubunzima obukhulu ezinhlelweni zokuphila kwabantu, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubukhulu balesi simo, kudingeka sihlole imikhuba, izizathu, nemiphumela ehlobene nodlame, ubugebengu obubhalwa kumaphoyisa nemiphakathi, kanye nemiqondo ethile esiyithathayo. #### Ukubheka Izinga Lobugebengu Izinga lobugebengu lihlukile ezindaweni ezahlukene, okukhombisa ukuthi le nkinga ithinta impilo ngokukhula kokuthuthukiswa nezimo zomphakathi. Ezinye izindawo zibonisa ubugebengu obukhulu ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ubuphofu, kanye nezinye izimo ezingezinhle empilweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izindawo ezithuthukile zihlala zinezinqubomgomo eziqinile zokulwa nobugebengu, kodwa akukwazi ukususa zonke izici ezibanga ubugebengu. #### Izizathu Zokwanda Kwebugebengu Izizathu ezijwayelekile zokwanda kwebugebengu zifaka phakathi izimo zomnotho, ukungabi nemisebenzi, kanye nezimo zenhlalo. Umnotho ongenampilo uvame ukuheha abantu ukuba bazitholele izindlela zokuphila ngezenzo eziphula umthetho. Isimo sokuphila esinzima, lapho abantu bengatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo, sishiya abaningi besebenzisa ubugebengu ukuze baphile. Futhi, izizathu zengqondo nezempilo zikhona. Lokhu kubandakanya umuzwa wokuphoxeka, ukungaboni kahle kwemiphumela yokuziphatha, kanye nobudlelwano obungafanele phakathi kwabantu. Ubufakazi bokuthi abantu baphenduka ubugebengu ngenxa yezizathu zengqondo bukhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo zengqondo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezingqondweni zabantu, okwenza kube nezimo ezithinta impilo. #### Imiphumela Yobugebengu Emaphakathi eminingi, ubugebengu bunomthelela omkhulu. Ukukhula kwezinga lobugebengu kuholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu kuhulumeni nasemiphakathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindleko zokugcina izinhlelo zokuphepha, ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo ukuze abantu baqonde imithetho, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa labo abaphule imithetho. Ngaphezu kwemali, ubugebengu buye buholele ezinhlekweni zokuhlukumeza, okungabangela ukungahleleki emiphakathini. Izinga lobugebengu libalulekile ekwakheni ulwazi emphakathini, okungaholela ekwehleni kobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphula umthetho. #### Izixazululo Zokulwa Nobugebengu Ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobugebengu, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziqinile zokwakha umphakathi ozinzile. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola izimiso ezahlukene, okubandakanya ukukhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, ukuthuthukisa imfundo, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni. Izinhlangano zomphakathi, imibutho, kanye nezinhlaka zentuthuko zidinga ukusebenzisana nohulumeni ukuze zisebenzise izinhlelo ezihlobene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwelapha izinzwa zengqondo, ukuvikela, nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi zibalulekile. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzisane, kuhlanganisa nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivimbela ubugebengu. #### Isiphetho Izinga eliphezulu lobugebengu liyinkinga enkulu edinga ukuphathwa ngokucophelela. Ukuziqhenya kwezenhlalakahle, imfuneko yokubambisana, kanye nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze kutholwe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuqonda izizathu ezihlobene nobugebengu nempilo yomphakathi kungasiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta umphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abe nesandla ekulweni nale nkinga ukuze kwakhiwe umphakathi oqinile, onobumbano, nohloniphekile.
Amaphrojekthi Okubhekana Nokuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu: Ukuhlaziywa Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kuyinkinga enkulu ebhekene nomhlaba namuhla. Izinguquko ezinzima ezimweni zokukhanya, izikhukhula, nemisebenzi yamandla kagesi kuhlobene ngqo nokwanda kwezinga lokushisa emhlabeni. Amaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene abhekene nale nkinga aqhuba izindlela ezahlukene zokubhekana nalesi simo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu. 1. Amaphrojekthi Okulima Ahlakaniphile Olunye lwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu kubalulekile amaphrojekthi okugcina ukwakheka kokulima. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezihlakaniphile, ezifana nezigaba ezilungisiwe zokulima, izinyathelo zokulima ezilungiselelwe izimo zezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokulima ezisekelwe kumadivayisi e-teknoloji. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zindlela, abalimi bangakwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezimo ezimbi zezulu futhi bathole imiphumela engcono ekukhiqizeni. 2. Amaphrojekthi Wokuphathwa Kwamanzi Ukuphathwa kwamanzi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikeleni imithombo yamanzi. Ngaphansi kwemizamo yokubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, amaphrojekthi okuphathwa kwamanzi afaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokugcina amanzi, izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Lokhu kunciphisa izinkinga zokushoda kwamanzi ezivela ezikhukhulweni nasekufuneni okukhulayo kwemithombo yamanzi. 3. Amaphrojekthi Wokwakha Izindawo Ezizinzile Izinhlelo zokwakha izindawo ezinokuzinza ziqhubeka zikhula, zifaka phakathi amaphrojekthi okwakha izakhiwo ezihlakaniphile nezisebenzisa amandla avuselelwe. Lezi zindawo ziqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle, zinciphisa imithelela emibi yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kanye nokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelwe. Iziqu zezakhiwo ezinjalo zihlanganisa izindonga ezihlakaniphile, amapaneli elanga, nezinhlelo zokugcina ukushisa. 4. Amaphrojekthi Wokunciphisa Ukungcoliswa Ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Amathuba amaningi ako amaphrojekthi okunciphisa ukungcoliswa, njengokwenza imoto zisebenze kahle, ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo esebenzisa amandla avuselelwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphinde zisetshenziswe izinto ezikhishwe. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo eluhlaza futhi zinciphisa imithelela emibi yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. 5. Amaphrojekthi Wokwakha Ulwazi Nokuqwashisa Ukuze abantu baqonde kangcono imiphumela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, amaphrojekthi okwakha ulwazi nokwazisa abantu baphakathi kokubaluleka. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokufundisa, imihlangano yokwabelelana ngolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezinguqukweni zesimo sezulu, kubalulekile ukuthi baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nalokhu futhi bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele. 6. Amaphrojekthi Wokubambisana Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Izinkinga ezihlobene nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu azikwazi ukuxazululwa kalula yizizwe ngamunye. Ngakho, amaphrojekthi okuxhumana phakathi kwamazwe ahlukahlukene abamba iqhaza elikhulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imihlangano yezenhlalakahle, izivumelwano zokuhlanganyela, kanye nemikhankaso yokwabelana ngolwazi. Ukuhlangana kwamazwe kunikeza ithuba lokubambisana ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezibhekene nomhlaba jikelele. Isiphetho Amaphrojekthi okubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu abalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono kumiphakathi eminingi. Ngamaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene, sifunda ukuthi singawavikela kanjani amandla ethu, sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokuphila, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqinile. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu baphakathi komphakathi baqonde futhi babe neqhaza ekunciphiseni imithelela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuze sihlanganise izinsiza, ubuchwepheshe, nolwazi ukuze siphumelele kulolu shintsho olukhulu. Njengoba siqhubeka kuphela ngama-aphrojekthi anjengalezi, sizoba nethuba elingcono lokwakha umhlaba ongcono, onobungane, futhi ozinzile.
Umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenamali mayelana nezimpahla zakhe. Uma ushade ngaphansi komshado wempahla yomphakathi, futhi umyeni wakho ubevele wakhululwa ngumlomo womthetho ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu ngaphansi koMthetho Wokungakhokhi Izikweletu ka-1936, nawe ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenamali (ongakhokhi). Uma umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu efuna ukubuyiselwa esimweni sokukhokha ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi kusukela ngosuku akhululwa ngalo, bangafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle? Umuntu okhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu, ummeli ogunyaziwe womuntu ongenamali, uma lowo muntu ongenamali engahlali eNingizimu Afrika, umfelokazi noma umfelokazi womuntu okhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu, uma behlale emshadweni wempahla yomphakathi nomuntu ongenamali, uma behlale emshadweni wempahla yomphakathi futhi benikezwe ukuba balandele impahla yomuntu osefile. Sekuyisikhathi esingakanani ngemva kokuthi impahla yomuntu ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa kokuphatha ukuthi umuntu angafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle? Kwenziwa ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi izikweletu zikhokhiwe ngokuphelele noma uma umuntu okhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu efaka isicelo sokukhokha izikweletu ngokuphelele, futhi isicelo sakhe sivunywa abakhokhi abathathu, futhi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu ukhokhe izikweletu noma wenze ukuhlela kokukhokha. Uma phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, kungakabi nempikiswano yezikweletu mayelana nempahla yomuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu, futhi futhi ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuthi lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala umuntu akhululwa ngaso ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu futhi ubekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa, futhi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu akanazo ezinye izigameko ezimelene naye. Kusukela ngosuku uMphakathi eqinisekisa i-akhawunti yokuphathwa kwempahla yabo; futhi futhi ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuthi lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala umuntu akhululwa ngaso ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu futhi ubekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa, futhi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu akanazo ezinye izigameko ezimelene naye. Kusukela ngosuku uMphakathi eqinisekisa i-akhawunti yokuphathwa kwempahla, futhi uma umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu esekhulume ngaphambili ukuthi unokufaka isicelo ezimweni ezithile, kodwa ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuthi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu akakaze atholakale enesicelo ezimweni ezithile. Endabeni lapho umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu esekhulume ngaphambili ukuthi unokufaka isicelo ezimweni ezithile. Ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi, umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu uzokwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle - ngaphandle uma inkantolo iyala ngenye indlela, lapho izingxenye ezithintekayo zifaka isicelo. Isicelo kumele senziwe phakathi kweminyaka eyishumi. Ungafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle uqobo, kodwa uzodinga usizo lwezomthetho. Xhumana nommeli noma ehhovisi likaMphakathi ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile nolwengeziwe. Xhumana nommeli wakho ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Xoxa ngezindleko nommeli wakho. Xhumana nommeli wakho noma neMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezimiso.
Ukuxhaswa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni (isiNgisi nesiZulu) Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku zokuqala zesikhathi sokucabanga, umhlaba waba yindawo lapho abantu behlangana, bexhumana, futhi besebenzisa izilimi ezikhethiwe. Konke lokhu kwenzeka ngezizathu eziningi, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu ukufuna ukuqonda, ubudlelwane, nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. E-Afrika, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, ukuxhaswa kwezilimi eziningi kwaba nesibopho esikhulu sokwakha uxolo, ukwamukela, nokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinhlanga ezahlukene. Phakathi kokukhula kwezinhlaka zamasiko nemfundo, isiNgisi nesiZulu sithathwa njengesibonelo sokubambisana okunamandla. Ukwamukelwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziningi kwaholela ekutheni izilimi ezahlukene ziqhathaniswe. Iziqu zamasiko ezifana neziNguni, isiZulu, isiXhosa, nesiNgisi zaba nezinkanyezi ezicacile emikhakheni efana nezemfundo, ezokuxhumana, nezokusebenza. Ngaphakathi kwemiphakathi, isiZulu sasisetshenziswa njengesilimi sokuqala sabantu abaningi, kanti isiNgisi sasisetshenziswa njengolimi oluhlangene, ikakhulukazi emsebenzini nasezifundweni. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi abantu banesidingo sokufunda isiNgisi ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili empilweni yabo, ikakhulukazi njengoba iNingizimu Afrika yahlala ibheke emhlabeni jikelele. Izinyathelo Zokuxhaswa Umnyango wezemfundo wenza imizamo yokukhuthaza ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ngaleso sikhathi. Kwakunesikhumbuzo empilweni yabafundi, lapho kwenziwa izinhlelo zokufundisa ezazihlanganisa izilimi ezimbili. Lolu hlelo lwaba izinsiza ezinkulu ekwenzeni abafundi baqonde isiZulu nezinye izilimi, ngenkathi bephinde bethola ithuba lokukhuluma isiNgisi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, ngaphakathi nasemiphakathini, okwakha ubudlelwane obuphumelelayo. Ubufakazi Obubonakalayo Ngeminyaka edlule, ubufakazi bokuxhaswa kwezilimi eziningi bwabona ukukhula kwezinhlelo eziseduze, ezibandakanya amashumi emisebenzi yocwaningo. Kunemiphumela emihle esekela ukuthi abantu basebenzisa isiZulu nesiNgisi ngokuhlanganyela. Phakathi komphakathi wabantu abasha, isiZulu sasisetshenziswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, izinkanyezi zamasiko, nasemaphakathini, kanti isiNgisi sasisetshenziswa njengendlela yokuxhumana ngokomhlaba. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlaka zezimali zabantu abesebenzisa izilimi ezahlukene ngokuphumelelayo; umphakathi uqhubeke nokukhula. Ukungalungi Nezithiyo Noma kunjalo, nakuba umoya wokuxhaswa kwezilimi eziningi wawumhle, bekukho izithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nabantu. Abanye abantu babengavumi ukuhlohla izilimi ezahlukene, okwakha ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukuhluleka kwezinye izinsiza zokufundisa futhi ukuqonda indlela yokuthuthukisa izilimi eziningi kubangele izinselelo ekufundiseni nasekufundeni. Lokhu kusinika ithuba lokuhlola indlela engcono yokudlula lezi zinqinamba okukhuluma ngazo. Isikhathi Esizayo Nokubhekisisa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wokuxhaswa kwezilimi eziningi uzitholela indlela yokwakha imiphakathi engcono eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuzama ukuqhakambisa ubudlelwane phakathi kweziNguni, isiZulu, nesiNgisi kudinga ukuhlala nezindima ezibhekelela ukuvikelwa kwezilimi. Izinhlelo zokuqwashisa, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo ezibophezelekile kufanele ziqhubeke, ukuze zonke izilimi zikhululeke, zivunyelwe, futhi zikhuthazwe. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthuli lwesizulu lungena, futhi umhlaba, nophenywayo bangaba nobusuku bemihlangano. Isiphetho Ukuxhaswa kwezilimi eziningi akusiyona nje ngendlela yokufundisa kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. IsiNgisi nesiZulu, njengezilimi ezikhuluma kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, sishintshile isikhumbuzo sokuxhumana, ukwamukela nokwakha. Ukuze sibe nempilo engcono, kudingeka sithuthukise imikhankaso yokukhuthaza, sifake izinqumo ezithokozisayo ezizwakalayo, futhi siphakamishe isizinda seziqu zalo mkhakha. Emhlabeni wezilimi eziningi, umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukufunda, ukwakha, futhi siphumelele silula.
UJane uthi... Ngaphezu kwesikhathi kufanele simise futhi sizibuze ukuthi senzeni. Uma sifuna ukuthola impendulo ecacile, kufanele sisho futhi ukuthi singakwenza kanjani. Asisebenzisi abaqashi abamhlophe emapulazini abantu abamnyama. Asizami ukuhlinzeka abantu abalimala ngezindlela zokulima futhi ngaphambi kokuthi kube nezinsuku ezedlule. Asisazami ukwenza izinto ezikhangayo kuphela (ukuhlobisa). Asizami ukuthola ama-BCP ngoba kukhona abantu abathengisa lezi zinto. Asizami ukuthola ama-BCP ngoba kukhona labo abahlinzeka ngezinto. Kodwa, senzeni? Siphucula abakhiqizi abamnyama - abasebenza ngokwabo manje nakusasa. Siqeqesha abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuze baqonde futhi bathole ukuthi yiziphi izizathu zokwenza umsebenzi wezolimo. Siphakamisa abakhiqizi ukuba basebenzise kahle izinsiza zemvelo. Sibonisa abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuthi bahloniphe umhlaba abawusebenzisa. Sisebenzisa abantu ngalokho abanakho, sibasiza ukuba bathole impilo futhi bakhiqize ukudla kwabo, ikhaya labo, kanye nezwe labo. Sikusiza ukuguqula ubuso bokulima - sifuna ukuba baphume ebusweni lapho kukhona kuphela abalimi abamhlophe, sifuna bonke abantu lapha ezweni lethu bakhulume ndawonye. Sikusiza abantu abanomhlaba - umhlaba womphakathi wonke, umhlaba oqashiweyo, noma labo abanomhlaba wabo (amapulazi) ukuze basebenzise lowo mhlaba ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Sizama ukubambisana nazo zonke izigaba zikamasipala ukuze sihlanganise ukwesekwa okunikezwa abalimi. Sakha amasu ukuze abalimi bakwazi ukufinyelela emishini. Sakha amasu ukuze sithole izibonelelo kulawo magunya. Kunzima kimi lapho ngizwa ukuthi abantu balima ukuze abakhiqizi abamnyama. Kukho abantu nezinhlelo ezisebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama ukuze benze inzuzo, bese bethi lokhu "ukuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama." Uma ungumkhiqizi omhlophe usebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama - qasha lowo mhlaba, khokha intengo efanele, uqaphele ukuthi uqasha umhlaba futhi uthola inzuzo. Siyacela ukuthi ungazenzi sengathi usiza abanye abakhiqizi.
Ukuhlaziywa Kohlelo Lokondla Ezikoleni Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni, olwaziwa nangokuthi "ukondla izingane ezikoleni," luhlanganisa izinhlelo ezikhethiwe zokuhlinzeka ukudla okuthuthukile nekhwalithi ezikoleni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola ukudla okunempilo okudingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Lokhu kudala isisekelo esiqinile sokuhlola izinguquko ezithinta imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga usizo kakhulu. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwavela emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa lwaba neqhaza elikhulu eNingizimu Afrika ngemva kokuphuma kwenkululeko ngo-1994. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkinga zokuntuleka kokudla, ubumpofu, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokungabi nempilo phakathi kwezingane zaba yizinto ezazidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingane ezithola ukudla okunempilo ziba nekhono eliphezulu lokufunda, zikhula kahle, futhi ziba nekhwalithi yokuphila engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwaba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngonyaka ka-1994, uhulumeni we-ANC waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ukudla ezikoleni, okwakuhloswe ukusiza izingane ezivela emindenini enezinkinga zezimali. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweMnyango Wezemfundo, owawuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikole, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, zithola ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ngonyaka ka-1999, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwathuthukiswa kakhulu, lwafaka phakathi izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokudla, okuhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, nezinye izinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kwavumela izingane ukuba zibe nokudla okunempilo, okwakuhloswe ukunciphisa izinga lokungabi nempilo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezingane ezincane. Uhlelo lwaba nempumelelo ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezifundo, imindeni, kanye nemiphakathi, okuhloswe ukuqinisa umphakathi. Noma kunjalo, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lwahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ezinye zezinkinga ezazikhona zifaka phakathi ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ukudla okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni uhulumeni abheke izindlela ezintsha zokwenza ngcono uhlelo, kuhlanganise nokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi. Ngonyaka ka-2004, uhulumeni waqala ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsiza ezithile, ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngempahla yokupheka, izitsha, kanye nezinsiza zokugcina ukudla. Lokhu kwavumela izikole ukuba ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ukudla okuphumelelayo, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokondla ezikoleni. Ngalesi sikhathi, izikole zathola ithuba lokubambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ukudla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola ukudla okunempilo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhamba phambili, lwaba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungasebenza kanjani ukuze uthuthukise izimo zokuphila. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezihlukahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza izingane, njengezinhlelo zokufundisa ngemikhuba yokudla, ezazihlose ukufundisa izingane ngokuqonda okungcono kokudla okunempilo. Ngonyaka ka-2010, uhulumeni waqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lokuphila kwezingane ezikoleni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lokondla luyasebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu, njengoba izikole zathola izinsiza eziningi, futhi izinhlelo zokondla zathuthukiswa ukuze zifanele izidingo zezingane. Lokhu kwavumela izingane ukuba zibe nekhono eliphezulu lokufunda, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinga lezemfundo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhamba phambili, luhlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuhlinzeka ukudla, futhi luhloswe ngakho ukuqinisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezihlukahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza izingane, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlala lukhona, luhamba phambili, futhi luhloswe ngakho ukuqinisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezihlukahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza izingane, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlala lukhona, luhamba phambili, futhi luhloswe ngakho ukuqinisa umphakathi.
Noma ubani osebenzisa le webhusayithi kumele alandele futhi avume ukuhamba ngezimo nemigomo yokusebenzisa njengoba kuchaziwe kulokhu kuboniswa komthetho. Uma umsebenzisi engafuni ukuba neqhaza kulezi zimo nemigomo, umsebenzisi akufanele angene kuwebhusayithi, akhombise izinto kuyo, ayisebenzise, noma akhiphe izinto kuyo futhi/noma enze amakhophi noma ahlukanise okuqukethwe kule webhusayithi. Abasebenzisi bangabuka, benze amakhophi, baphonse kumakhompyutha abo, baprinte, futhi bahlukanise okuqukethwe kule webhusayithi, noma ingxenye yayo, ngenhloso yokusebenzisa ulwazi noma ukubhekisela lapho bakutholile kuphela, futhi abavumelekile ukukusebenzisa ukuze bathole inzuzo. Abasebenzisi abafuna ukusebenzisa okuqukethwe kule webhusayithi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo akufanele bakwenze ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe, etholakala kumphathi weWebhu ocingweni: +27 12 314 2140 noma ngokuthumela i-imeyili ku-electronic@gcis.gov.za. Ukukhiqiza nokwenza amakhophi okuqukethwe kuyo noma ingxenye yayo, ngenhloso yezimali kumele kuhambisane nalokhu kuboniswa kwe-copyright ngokuphelele. Wonke amalungelo okuba nefa nokuhlonipha kanye nanoma yimaphi amalungelo okuxhumana koMbuso noma ezinye izikhungo zomthetho mayelana nokuqukethwe kule webhusayithi agcinwe, okusho ukuthi avikelwe. Ulwazi kule webhusayithi luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okufundisayo mayelana nesihloko esithile noma izihloko, futhi aluhlinzeki nganoma yiziphi iziqinisekiso mayelana nalesi sihloko. Kungumsebenzisi ukuthi azihlulele ngaphambi kokungena kule webhusayithi, noma le webhusayithi izohlangabezana nezidingo zabo siqu, kanye nokuhambisana nezinsiza zabo zokusebenza noma isoftware. Ulwazi, imibono, nemicabango kule webhusayithi akufanele kuthathwe njengokwelulekwa kochwepheshe, noma njengendawo esemthethweni ye-GCIS, noma nganoma iyiphi enye inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokomthetho mayelana nolwazi, imibono, noma imicabango ethulwe kule webhusayithi. Abasebenzisi bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baxhumane nochwepheshe ngaphambi kokuthatha noma iyiphi isinyathelo mayelana nolwazi, imibono, noma imicabango ethulwe kule webhusayithi. I-GCIS ayinikezi noma yiziphi izethulo noma iziqinisekiso, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziqondile noma ezingaqondile, ukuthi phakathi kwezinye izinto, okuqukethwe okukhona lapha kanye nobuchwepheshe obutholakalayo kule webhusayithi akukhona amaphutha, kuyakhomba, noma ukuthi insizakalo izophazamiseka futhi itholakale ngo-100%, nokuthi ayinaphutha, noma izohlangabezana nanoma yiziphi izimo ezithile mayelana nokusebenza noma ikhwalithi. Le ndawo inikezwa njengoba ikhona ("as is"). I-GCIS iyakwenqaba wonke ama-akhawunti atholakalayo, kuhlanganise kodwa kungagcini lapho, ama-akhawunti okuthengiswa, ukufaneleka ngenhloso ethile, ukungaphuli amalungelo, ukuhambisana nezokuphepha, nokufaneleka okuqondile noma okungaqondile, futhi ayiqinisekisi okuqukethwe kwewebhusayithi, nokuthi le webhusayithi izohlelwa ngendlela ezohlangabezana nezidingo ezithile zomsebenzisi ngamunye. Umsebenzisi wewebhusayithi wenza lokhu engozini yakhe njengomsebenzisi. Umsebenzisi kumele athwale yonke imithwalo yemfanelo nganoma yiziphi izingozi noma ukulahlekelwa okungase kube khona ngenxa yokusebenzisa okuqukethwe okukhona kule webhusayithi. I-GCIS noma yinoma iyiphi inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokomthetho mayelana nolwazi olukhona kule webhusayithi, noma abasebenzi be-GCIS noma yinoma iyiphi inhlangano efanayo, ngeke babe nemithwalo yemfanelo nganoma yiziphi izinkinga, ezingaqondile, noma eziphumelelayo, noma nganoma yiziphi ezinye izinkinga noma ezimangalisayo, noma ezinye izicelo ezihlobene nokusebenzisa lo mbhalo noma ulwazi. Uma kukhona umthetho otholakala ungasebenzi nganoma yisiphi isizathu, imithetho esele izoqhubeka isebenza. Ngokuhambisana nezigaba 43 no-43 zeMthetho Wokuxhumana Ngezokuxhumana Nezokuthengiselana 25 ka-2002 (umthetho wezokuxhumana nokusebenzisa izinqubo zedijithali), i-GCIS ngeke ibe nemithwalo yemfanelo nganoma yiziphi izinkinga, ukulahlekelwa, noma izicelo zokuhlukumeza ezivela ekusebenziseni noma ekungakwazi ukusebenzisa le webhusayithi, noma izinsizakalo (izinsizakalo), noma okuqukethwe kwewebhusayithi. I-GCIS igcina amazinga afanele obuchwepheshe nezinqubo zokuphepha ukuze ivikele yonke imininingwane enikezwe ngabasebenzisi ekulahlekelweni, ekusetshenzisweni kabi, ekuhlelweni kabusha, noma ekuchithweni. Zonke izinyathelo ezivumelekile zizothathwa ukuze kuvikelwe ulwazi lomsebenzisi. Abasebenzi abavunyelwe abaphatha ulwazi oluyimfihlo enikeziwe kumele bagcine imfihlo yalolo lwazi. Le nqubomgomo isebenza kubo bonke abasebenzi be-GCIS noma izikhungo zikamasipala ezithola ulwazi oluvela ku-GCIS. Kwenziwa umthetho ophikisana nalokho ukuthi noma ubani, ibhizinisi, inhlangano, akavunyelwe ukuthola noma ukuzama ukuthola ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe kunoma iyiphi ikhasi kule webhusayithi, noma ukufaka noma ukuzama ukufaka noma iyiphi ikhodi engagunyaziwe, eyingozi, noma enobungozi kule webhusayithi. Uma umuntu efaka noma ezama ukufaka ikhodi engagunyaziwe, eyingozi, noma enobungozi kule webhusayithi, noma ezama ukuthola ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe kunoma iyiphi ikhasi, lowo muntu uzoba nemithwalo yemfanelo yokwephula umthetho, futhi uma i-GCIS noma iyiphi ingxenye yomphakathi ibhujiswa nganoma iyiphi indlela, bazovula icala lokulahlekelwa. Siyacacisa ukuthi abanye abantu besithathu bangase baxhumanise nolwazi olunikeziwe kulezi zikhasi. Lokhu kungasiza ekuxhumaneni nezinye amawebhusayithi njengokuthokozisa, futhi noma yisiphi isixhumanisi esinjalo asisho ukuthi i-GCIS ivuma lezi zindawo zewebhu. Amawebhusayithi axhunyiwe noma amakhasi awaphansi kokulawulwa kwe-GCIS. I-GCIS ayinayo imithwalo yemfanelo noma imithwalo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi iqondile noma engaqondile, nganoma iyiphi indlela mayelana nokuqukethwe, ukusetshenziswa, noma ukungakwazi ukusebenzisa noma ukuthola noma amawebhusayithi axhunyiwe, noma noma yiziphi izixhumanisi ezitholakala kumawebhusayithi axhunyiwe. Isitatimende sokuvikela sihamba ne-GCIS nanoma iyiphi inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokomthetho ethinta, iqinisekisa, noma isebenzisa ulwazi olungase luhlanganiswe kule webhusayithi. Noma i-GCIS ingase ihlinzeke ngemininingwane yomsebenzisi kulabo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezenzakalayo, ngeke ihlinzeke abantu besithathu ngemininingwane, noma ezinye izikhungo zikamasipala ukuze zisetshenziswe kwezinye izinjongo noma ezihlobene, ngaphandle kokuthi lokho kube kucacisiwe ngesikhathi sokuxhumana. Ulwazi lomuntu siqu lungadluliselwa ezikhungweni zomhlaba jikelele yi-GCIS noma kubantu besithathu ngenhloso ezingenhla. Lokhu ngeke kufake ukudluliselwa ezweni okungekho emthethweni okungakaze kube nemithetho yokuvikela idatha efanele efana naleyo ekhona ezweni lapho umsebenzisi ehlala khona. Ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ku-GCIS
Imidlalo Yamakhompiyutha: Uhlanga Olutsha Lokuzijabulisa Nokuqeqesha Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha, eyaziwa kakhulu njengezivakashi ezihlanganisiwe ezithokozisayo, ingenye yezimboni ezikhulayo kakhulu emhlabeni. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha iba yinto engaphezu kokuzijabulisa, ikhulisa izindlela zokufunda, zokuxhumana, nezokucabanga. Uhlanga lwemidlalo yamakhompiyutha luqukethe izinhlobo ezihlukahlukene, ezihlanganisa imidlalo yezenzakalo, imidlalo yeqembu, kanye nemidlalo yokucabanga, ezihlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezahlukene zabadlali. Imvelaphi nemikhakha yemidlalo yamakhompiyutha Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha yaqala ukuba khona emashumini eminyaka edlule, ngaleso sikhathi ibonakala njengezinto ezithokozisayo zabantu abasha. Njengoba isikhathi sithuthuka, imidlalo yaqala ukujula, ibandakanya izindaba ezinzulu, izimo zempilo, nokuqonda okujule kwezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo inezigaba ezahlukene, njengezokulwa, zokucabanga, nezokwakha, ezikhethela abadlali ukusizakala ngezinhloso ezihlukahlukene. Iziphakamiso ezibalulekile zokuhlangana nokufunda Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ibonisa ukuthuthuka okukhulu ekusebenzeni kwezifundo. Abadlali baqala ukufunda amakhono amasha, njengokucabanga kwe-strategy, ukuphatha izinsiza, nokuxhumana nabanye. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi imidlalo ethile ingathuthukisa amakhono akwazi ukusetshenziswa ezimweni zangempela, njengokusebenza eqenjini, ukuhlela, nokuxhumana kahle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imidlalo ayikhanyi nje kuphela, kodwa futhi ingaba ithuluzi lokufunda elibalulekile. Imithelela yemidlalo yamakhompiyutha emphakathini Kubalulekile ukuqonda imithelela yemidlalo yamakhompiyutha emphakathini. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imidlalo ingakhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma abadlali besebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze baqondise imidlalo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi wezemidlalo, okwenza abantu bahlangane futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imidlalo ingaba nemiphumela emibi, ikakhulukazi uma abadlali behluleka ukuphatha isikhathi sabo sokudlala, okungaholela ekuphazamiseni imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Izifundo ezikhulayo mayelana nezinsiza zempilo Ngokukhuluma ngezinsiza zempilo, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ibonisa umthelela ophawulekayo empilweni yabadlali. Kukhona izifundo eziningi zempilo nezokuhlola ezikhombisa ukuthi imidlalo ethile ingasiza ekunciphiseni ukukhathazeka nasekuthuthukiseni imizwa yokujabula. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphila, okwenza imidlalo ikwazi ukudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabadlali. Izinkinga ezihambisana nemidlalo yamakhompiyutha Noma imidlalo yamakhompiyutha inezinzuzo eziningi, ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Okwamanje, ukweqisa kwedijithali kuholela ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezinjengezokuphepha, izinkinga zempilo, kanye nemiphumela emibi yokuxhumana. Abadlali kumele bazi ukuthi imidlalo ethile ingaba nemiphumela emibi, ikakhulukazi uma kudlalwa isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuphumula. Ukuze kugwenywe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukufundisa abadlali ngokuqonda okufanele bakwenze ukuze bagcine impilo yabo iphephile. Isiphetho: Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha njengendlela yokukhula Ekugcineni, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha iyinsiza ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwengqondo, yokuxhumana, nokuqonda. Njengoba ibhizinisi lemidlalo likhula, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokuqhuba kwemidlalo. Imidlalo ingaba ithuluzi elinamandla lokwakha imiphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo, nokuthuthukisa amakhono, kodwa kumele kuqapheleke izinkinga ezihambisana nayo. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokufundisa ngokubaluleka kokubheka izici ezihlukahlukene zemidlalo yamakhompiyutha ukuze sikwazi ukusiza abantu, ikakhulukazi abasha, ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile.
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni Ngesikhathi sokukhanya emini, izinyanga zikaNhlangula zibhakabhile, kwavela umoya wokudabuka emizimbeni yamadodana edolobheni elincane iTheku. Phakathi kwezindlu ezincane nezikhungo, kwakukhona umphakathi owaziwa ngothando lokufunda, kodwa ubunzima bokungabi nezinsiza zebhuku baphazamisa ukukhula kwawo. Abantu babefisa ukufunda, kodwa izincwadi bezikude kakhulu, futhi ezikhungweni eziningi zazibiza imali eningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNomsa, intokazi ethanda ukufunda, wabona ukuthi uhla lwemfundo lwaluphakathi kokuhlaselwa. Waqala umkhankaso wokwakha isikhungo somphakathi esivumela wonke umuntu ukufinyelela ezincwadini, ukwethula izinhlelo zokufunda nokucwaninga. Abanye abantu bahlanganyela naye, futhi umkhankaso wakhe wahamba kahle, izinsuku zanda, kwathi lapho umkhosi ubamba abahlali. Umoya wothando nezinhloso ufafazwe, abakhulumi baphakamisa izandla, benza isivumelwano sokuxhasa le ndaba. UNomsa uqedile umkhankaso wokukhuthaza ukuthengwa kwezincwadi eziningi, futhi ngesikhathi besakha isikhungo, umphakathi ubonisa izifiso eziphakeme. UNomsa nozakwabo babamba izifundo ezahlukahlukene, behlulela iminyango yokufunda kumuntu wonke. Isikhungo samukele izinto eziningi, sathola ukufinyelela kumagazini, izincwadi zokutadisha, nezinto ezithokozisayo. Abantu abavela emazweni ahlukene babenethuba lokufunda ngezindlela abakhethayo, futhi izinkulumo ezijabulisayo zikhumbuza bonke ukuthi emhlabeni wonke, amandla okufunda avulekile kumuntu wonke. Ngemva kwezinyanga eziningana, uNomsa wajabula njengoba izivakashi eziningi zisebenzisa isikhungo. Umphakathi waqala ukuthola uxhaso oluvela kumasipala wendawo noMnyango wezeMfundo, bemnika isikhuthazo sokugcina inhloso yakhe imile kahle. Imihlangano yabe isiba yinhle, uNomsa eshumayela kumphakathi, enza umoya ube nomdlandla. Okwenzeka esikhungweni kwaba imvelo entsha, abantu behlangana, behlola izinkanyezi ezincane ezishaywa phezulu. Umoya ofuna ukufunda waba yinkanyezi efudumele odongeni, uNomsa obengazaki inyama yentuthuko ngenxa yesikhungo. Ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, umphakathi wawugcwele ugqozi, futhi uNomsa wafunda ukuthi izinsizi kwezokufunda zikhula. Abafundi abaninzi, abavela ezifundazweni ezahlukene, babebhalisela iziqu eziphakeme. Umphakathi wawukhanya njengokukhanya kwelanga, yonke imihlangano ibanjwa khona. Ngesikhathi umphakathi ubona imiphumela yokufunda, umoya kaNomsa uthumele umusa ongenamkhawulo. Ubufakazi bokukhula kwamasiko nemfundo babesondela kuye, umoya wokuhlangabezana waba uphupho olukhulu. UNomsa, umama wezinkanyezi, waba yisibonelo sokuba nomqondo wedlanzana ongenamkhawulo. Ekugcineni, umfana owayefuna imfundo wavuma lesi sikhungo, umkhankaso lokubamba, ezwa ithuba elikhululiwe. ITheku lishaya izinyembezi ezinhle; umhlaba wawuvuleka, ubuchule buhlangana. UNomsa, umfundi, umkhankaso, umphakathi – konke kwahlanganiswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ikusasa lempumelelo, kukhululekile kuzo zonke izizukulwane ezizayo.
uUber - Ingxoxo NgeMisebenzi Yezokuthutha Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnu. Sipho Mthembu, umphakathi wezokuthutha ophumelelayo, ukuze sithole ulwazi olunembile mayelana noUber, inkampani ethuthukisa indlela esihamba ngayo. UUber, njengenkampani yokuhamba, usungule izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuthutha, futhi sithanda ukwazi kabanzi ngalezi zinguquko. Umbuzo 1: UUber uqala kanjani? UMnu. Mthembu: UUber waqala ngo-2009 eSan Francisco, e-United States. Abasunguli bayo, uTravis Kalanick noGarrett Camp, babefuna indlela yokwenza ukuhamba kube lula futhi kube nekhwalithi ephezulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babebhekene nezinkinga eziningi zokuthola izithuthi ezitholakalayo, futhi uUber waba yisixazululo esisha. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezihambisana noUber? UMnu. Mthembu: UUber unikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukwakha umqondo wokuhamba okusheshayo. Abantu bangathola izithuthi kalula ngefoni yabo, futhi izikhathi zokulinda zinciphile. Okwesibili, uUber unikeza amathuba emisebenzi kubantu abaningi, okuhlanganisa abashayeli nabanye abasebenzi. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi ezinamathuba amancane. Umbuzo 3: UUber uthinta kanjani umnotho? UMnu. Mthembu: UUber uthinta umnotho ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, udala amathuba emisebenzi, njengoba sishilo. Okwesibili, uthuthukisa ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu emisebenzini yabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo, okukhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uUber unikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, njenge-Uber Eats, okukhuthaza ukuhweba kwezokudla. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo uUber abhekana nazo? UMnu. Mthembu: Njengoba uUber ethuthuka, ubhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga zomthetho ezihlobene nezimvume zokusebenza. Abashayeli badinga izimvume ezithile ukuze basebenze, futhi lokhu kungaba yinkinga ezindaweni ezithile. Okwesibili, ukuncintisana nezinkampani ezifanayo, njengeLyft, kudinga ukuthi uUber uhlale uphambili. Lokhu kudinga izinguquko ezisheshayo nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 5: UUber ubheka kanjani ikusasa? UMnu. Mthembu: UUber ubheka ikusasa ngeso elibanzi. Bafuna ukuqhubeka nokwandisa izinsizakalo zabo, futhi bahlola amathuba okusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengezimoto ezizimele. UUber ubona ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho ukuhamba kuzoba lula futhi kube nekhwalithi ephezulu. Ubuye abheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zabo ukuze zibe nezindleko eziphansi kumakhasimende. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, uUber usungule izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Ubuye waba nethonya elikhulu emnothweni, udala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi uthuthukisa ukuhamba kwabantu. Nokho, ubhekana nezinselelo eziningi, futhi ikusasa layo lidinga ukuqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha. Uhlelo lwezokuthutha luhlala luthuthuka, futhi uUber uzoba yinxenye ebalulekile yalesi sikhathi esisha. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinkcukacha ezibalulekile.
Ukuphathwa Kwamafucuza Emadolobheni: Izindlela Nezinselelo Isingeniso Ezimfundisweni zethu, ukuphathwa kwemfucuza kugxile ekulawuleni, ekuhlanzekeni, nasekuphuculeni izimo zokuhlala emadolobheni. Njengoba inani labantu emadolobheni liphakamisa, kuba nezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwemfucuza. Lo mbiko uhlanganisa izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, izinselelo ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa kwemfucuza. Izindlela Zokuphatha Imfucuza Emadolobheni amaningi, izindlela zokuphathwa kwemfucuza zithuthukisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kahle komkhiqizo ophumayo. Ukwehlukaniswa kwemfucuza kwenziwa ngezindlela ezihlukene, kuhlanganise nezinye izinhlelo ezifana nezikhwama ezihlukene zomsebenzi, ezivame ukuhlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezifana nemfucuza ephilayo, nemfucuza engaphilile, nemfucuza eyingozi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kube lula ukususa nokuphinda kusetshenziswe imfucuza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amadolobha amaningi asebenzisa imali efanele kulezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinkampani ezizimele ezisiza ekuphathweni kwemfucuza, ezihlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nokuhlunga, ukuwasusa, nokuphinda kusebenzise. Ilungelo lokuhlanzeka liyinto ebalulekile emiphakathini, futhi ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumele emaphikweni okuphathwa kwemfucuza kubalulekile. Izinkinga Eziqhubekayo Nokho, ukuphathwa kwemfucuza akukhona njalo okulula. Zikhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nezinhlelo zethu. Okokuqala, ukungabi nalwazi kwabantu ngalezi zinhlelo kungaba nomthelela omubi. Abantu abaningi abakatholi ukuqonda kahle ukuthi imfucuza kufanele ifakwe kanjani ezikhwameni ezihlukene, okuholela ekudidaneni nasekuphazamisekeni kokuhlolwa kwemfucuza. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwamathuba okuhlanza emikhulu nasemakhaya kubhanga umthelela omubi kokuphatha imfucuza. Amadolobha amaningi abhekene nezinkinga zokuthi azikhona izinsiza ezanele zokuhlanzeka, okuhlanganisa izingxenye zokugcina imfucuza ezakhiweni, izimoto zokuthutha, kanye nezinsiza zokuhlanzwa. Lokhu kubangela ukungcoliswa kwezindawo ezahlukene, okuthinta impilo yomphakathi. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwemfucuza, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kukhona isidingo sokwanda komfundiso nezokwakha ulwazi. Ukukhuthaza imikhankaso yokufundisa abantu kanye nokusiza ukuthi baqonde kahle izinqubo zokuhlunga nokuphathwa kwemfucuza kufanele kube yinto ethokozisayo. Imikhankaso yokuhlola iziphathamandla ezikhuluma ngalesi sihloko ingachitha ukukhathazeka kwayo. Okwesibili, kukhona ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele zokuphatha imfucuza. Ukushintsha izikhungo zokuhlunga ukuze kube nzima ukufinyelela, kanye nokuthuthukisa ezokuthutha ukuze kucutshungulwe imfucuza ngokushesha kubalulekile. Ukuhlanganiswa nezinkampani ezizimele ezingathanda ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kulezi zinhlelo kungasaqhuba phambili. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuphathwa kwemfucuza emadolobheni kube nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa kunezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuthuthukisa lezi zinhlelo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhlakani bemiphakathi buyisihluthulelo sokuphatha ngokuphumelelayo. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuphatha imfucuza, umphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kufanele bushintshwe ukuze kuphuculwe i-ecosystem yethu. Njengoba sithuthuka njengomphakathi, sithola ukuthi ukuhlela nokuphatha imfucuza akuyona nje imisebenzi eyodwa, kodwa yilokho kudinga ukuvuleka, ukuqonda, nokusebenzisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhulisa isimo sokuhlala kahle kubantu bethu besikhathi esizayo.
Omunye wezinkinga ezibalulekile eNingizimu Afrika ukuthola isixazululo ezimweni eziningi zokuhlaselwa kwezimboni ezithinta kabi umphakathi wezolimo. Senza konke okusemandleni ethu ukwenza umehluko obonakalayo mayelana nokuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuphepha kwabafuyi, amathuba angavela ukuze bagxile ekukhiqizeni imikhiqizo yezolimo esebenzayo. Ukuphakanyiswa kwemali okuvela kuMali ye-Agri Securitas kule bhukwana kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekuphakamiseni umphakathi wezolimo ukuba uthathe isikhundla sokuphepha kwawo. Kuyajabulisa kwiNhlangano Yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ukubambisana neNhlangano Yezokuphepha yaseNingizimu Afrika kulolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuletha ulwazi kumphakathi wezolimo wonke. Khumbula: impilo yakho ibalulekile kithi; ndawonye singakwenza umehluko. Le bhukwana ihlelwe ukuze ithuthukise ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ikakhulukazi ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Lezifunda le-Eastern ne-Western Cape (POCOC) lithathe lesi sinyathelo sokwakha umhlahlandlela wokuphepha nokuwuhlanganisa kule bhukwana. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Lezizwe (NOCOC) linqume ukusabalalisa le bhukwana ezwenikazi futhi lisekele lokhu ngemali evela kwabanye ababambiqhaza. Le bhukwana iqukethe ulwazi mayelana neSikhungo Sezokuphepha SaseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS), iMpi Yezwe yaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF), kanye nezinyunyana zabafuyi. Ichaza ukuthi lezi zinhlangano ziqanjwa kanjani futhi zisebenza kanjani ukuze zilwe nokuhlaselwa kwezimboni. Iphinde ikhulume ngePhrojekthi Yokuvikela Izindawo Zasemaphandleni (RPP) nokuthi le phrojekthi ixhumene kanjani neMisebenzi ye-Akantus II, umkhankaso wokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezinsizakalo zokuphepha okukhomba ekuthuthukiseni ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Enye into ebalulekile yale bhukwana yizinhlelo zokuphepha ezikhona. Izinhlelo zokuphepha zibalulekile ngoba izinhlangano zokuphepha (SAPS neSANDF) zibheka ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini yezolimo njengomunye wemibuzo eyashiywa ngaphandle kwenhlelo zokuphepha zasemaphandleni (RPP). Uma zisetshenziswa kahle, izinhlelo zokuphepha zizothinta ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. Uhlelo lweMpi luwuhlelo olwenziwa ngenhloso yokuzithandela olungaphansi kweNhlangano Yezempi yaseNingizimu Afrika olusebenza ngendlela engaphelele. Umphathi ngamunye unesibopho sokwenza uqinisekise ukuphepha nokuvikeleka komphakathi othile (ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezidolobheni). Usizo abahlinzeka ngalo ngokuvamile lubizwa ngokuthi usizo lendawo. Usizo lendawo luhlanganisa umphakathi wonke wendawo, ngakho-ke ngisho nomuntu ong member wohlelo lweMpi angathola ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, nakuba engatholi zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba member wohlelo. Ababamba iqhaza kulolu hlelo lweMpi abanaso isibopho sokuvikela ngaphandle kwemingcele yezindawo abenza kuzo; banelungelo lokuvikela nokwenza uqinisekise ukuphepha kwemiphakathi yabo kuphela. Lolu hlelo lungachazwa kafushane njengokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zibe yizicucu ezincane, ezilawulwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zindawo ezincane zinezinombolo ezithile zezimboni noma izindlu, kuye ngosayizi wendawo kanye nokwabiwa kwezindawo abantu abahlala kuzo. Amalungu endawo axhumana ngefoni noma ngomsakazo njengohlelo lokuxhumana uma imigqa yehluleka. Ezinye izinhlelo zokuxhumana ziyingxenye ebalulekile yephrojekthi yokuphepha ezindaweni. Amalungu endawo axhumana nomholi wabo (okhethwe ngamalungu) onendlela yokuxhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuphendula okusheshayo kwamaphoyisa uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Umholi wePhrojekthi angazisa umphathi waleso sikhathi uma kudingeka amandla aqinile. Inqubo yokuxhumana ingathatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke amalungu endawo kumele akwazi ukuvikela imikhaya yabo futhi athembe ozakwabo nabanye amalungu endawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula okusheshayo esimweni esiphuthumayo. Ngalesi sizathu, indawo kumele ilungiselele ukubhekana nezimo ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Umphathi Wendawo uzosiza le phrojekthi yendawo uma isungula uhlelo lokuphendula ezimweni. Ukubaluleka kokusebenza kahle kwalesi sihlelo kuncike ekubambisaneni okufanayo kwamalungu endawo. Bamba iqhaza - kuzokusiza! Kukhona ama-foramu amaphoyisa (CPF) nemiphakathi esiteshini, endaweni, nasezifundeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi wezolimo ukhuthazwa ukuba ujoyine iSouth African Rural Police Federation (SARPF) lapho bengafunda khona izindlela zokuzivikela nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuxhumana uma kunezingozi. Uma ujoyina i-CPF noma i-SARPF, umphakathi wezolimo uyaziswa ngamalungelo awo, njengelungelo lomuntu ophakathi komphakathi lokuthwala nokusebenzisa isibhamu. I-South African Rural Police Federation (SARPF) iyinhlangano yokuzithandela esebenza ngendlela engaphelele. Amalungu ale nhlangano ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine, okuyi amaphoyisa asebenzayo, amaphoyisa asekelayo, amaphoyisa akhethekile, kanye namaphoyisa asezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni. Amaphoyisa aphakathi kwezigaba zamaphoyisa asezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni yilezo eziseduze kakhulu nokuvikela izimboni. Labo abafuna ukuzinikela bangafaka isicelo esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze ukuze bafakwe ohlwini lwezizinda. Abazinikeli bakhethwa ngendlela efanayo nalabo abafaka izicelo zomsebenzi ophelele, kodwa akudingi ukuba ne-licence yokushayela. Izidingo ezivamile ezifana nezitifiketi zokushayela, izitifiketi zemfundo, nokuhlolwa kwezempilo zengqondo azisebenzi kulabo abafaka izicelo zokufakwa ohlwini lwezizinda emkhakheni wezindawo zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni. NgokweSahluko 5 semithetho eyasungulwa nguMphathi Wezizwe noma uMphathi Wezifunda, bangabizwa ukuba basebenze kunoma iyiphi indawo ngosuku nesikhathi esinqunywe nguMphathi Wezizwe noma uMphathi Wezifunda futhi benze imisebenzi ephathelene namaphoyisa edolobheni noma endaweni yasemaphandleni ngesikhathi noma endaweni eyabelwe nguMphathi Wezizwe noma uMphathi Wezifunda ophathelene. Bangadluliselwa kwenye imikhakha uma behlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zaleyo mikhakha futhi beqeqeshwe noma befuna ukungena eqeqesheni leyo mikhakha; futhi ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe yoMphathi Wezizwe, abavumelekile ukwenza imisebenzi yenhlangano ekhethiwe, iSikhungo Sokuphepha, ezwenikazi, endaweni yokundiza, noma kunoma iyiphi enye igatsha. Umphathi ngamunye kumele anqume ngokwabelana kwamaphoyisa asezindaweni zasemaphandleni esiteshini sakhe, emkhakheni, noma kwezinye izikhungo zeNhlangano ngokwezidingo nezinto ezibalulekile zesiteshi, emkhakheni, noma kwezinye izikhungo. Ochwepheshe bezolimo baphakathi kwale phrojekthi yokuvikela izindawo zasemaphandleni (RPP) ezweni lonke. Lezi zinkampani zixhumene nezinyunyana zezolimo zezifunda.
Ifilimu: Umhlaba Ohlukahlukene Wezinkumbulo Nesiko Emlandweni yesintu sethu, ifilimu ibaluleke kakhulu ekuqhakambiseni nasekugcineni izinkumbulo, izindaba, kanye namasiko. Ifilimu ingankulu, iyingxenye yobuciko, kodwa ikakhulukazi iyinsika yesizukulwane. Uhlanga lwesiko, olukhombisa amaphupho, imicabango, nezifiso zabantu, luthathe indawo enkulu ezinhliziyweni zethu, lungatholakala ezinkundleni zezifundo, ezinsizakalweni, nakubuchwepheshe bamanje. Kukhona okuthile okugxilisa imicabango yami uma ngikhuluma ngokubaluleka kwefilimu. Ngokuvamile, uma sikhuluma ngama-movie, sikhuluma ngezinkanyezi, imidlalo yokudlala, nezinsizakalo zokukhangisa. Nokho, ngezinye izikhathi, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ifilimu iyinhlanganisela yokubona, ukwenza, nokuqonda. Izincwadi zethu zempilo zikhona kule mibono; ngemizwa yokuhlukahlukene esingayithola kulolu hlobo lobuciko, siphila nabanye ngokubona ngezithombe ezaziwayo. Ngokwezifundo eziningi, indawo yefilimu ibalulekile ekuqwashiseni ngezinto ezahlukene. Ngokukhuluma kwezinkanyezi noma izigameko ezithile, ifilimu ingavusa ucwaningo noma ukuvuselela izinkumbulo zempilo yethu. Cishe sonke sinesikhumbuzo esithile esihlobene nefilimu ethile — umcimbi wokuqala, isizathu sokuhleka, noma umuzwa wokucabangela okwenziwa abalingisi bayo. Lesi sici sokuxhumanisa sithinta izimo ezihlukene zempilo, futhi kuzenzakalelayo sinesidingo sokwakha umphakathi. Lapha, ngingathanda ukucacisa ukuthi ifilimu ayigcini nje ngezinhloso zokuheha ababukeli. Izithombe ezikwiqhaza, izindaba ezithokozisayo, namajamo akhombisa ukuze aba nempilo, ngempela akwenzi kuphela umqondo; ziyathinta imizwa, ziphinde zikhuthaze ukuthola indlela yethu emhlabeni. Izinhlaka ezihlukahlukene khona lapha, kubalulekile ukucacisa ukuthi abantu bangeza izinhlelo zempilo zabo ezinhlobonhlobo. Ngokuphathelene nezwe lanamuhla, ifilimu ibalulekile ekwakheni ukuqonda okuhle. Ubulili, ubuhlobo, nomoya wezinkanyezi – konke kuhlangene ukuze kucacise umbono wokuthi abantu bakhuluma ngani. Ngale ndlela, ifilimu ingase ingabi nje umdanso wezithombe, kodwa ibalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Fredrik Backman, umbhali, uthi: “Umuntu ongenawo umlando, uyindlela eholayo engeyona eyeqiniso.” Lokhu kusho ukuthi ifilimu iyisikhungo sokukhumbula, ikakhulukazi uma isikhipha izifundo ezibhekene nezizukulwane ezizayo. Ngibhalela imicabango yami, ngazithokozisa ngokuthi ngabe kanjani izenzakalo ezikhumbulekayo zingenza umkhiqizo omuhle. Ngithokozile ngokuchaza lesi sici sokuxhumanisa; kukhona izifundo ezisemqoka ezitholakalayo kuphela uma abantu besebenzisa ifilimu njengendlela yokuxhumana. Mhlawumbe lokhu kungathinta impilo yethu yansuku zonke, uma sithola izinkumbulo zabantu ablaziyo. Izinselelo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana zomhlaba zikhula ngesivinini. Ukuba nezithombe - umkhuba omusha - ubonisa ukuthi abanye bethu bangase bazithole ezithombeni zefilimu bese bephendulela kwizethulo. Iqiniso liwukuthi isifiso sokuxoshwa kwehlukaniso sobumba sefilimu silokhu sikhula emhlabeni, kwenze kube nemiphumela emisha. Ngokujwayelekile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi sikwenze kube yinsika, singavumeli ukusatshiswa kwezithombe ukukhipha imithambo yethu. Futhi lesi sici sefilimu singesinye sezinto ezahlukene ezikhombisa ukuthi kumalungelo abantu bethu, siphila ngendlela ethinta umlando. Ngakho-ke, uma sibheka izimfanelo ezisemqoka zezimfashini, kungabe kuhamba kahle ukuthi ifilimu iyisisekelo sokwakha abakhulumayo, ukuze ikwazi ukukhulumela zonke izinhlaka zomhlaba. Uma sizoncoma umfundi, kumele sibe nesibindi sokukhuluma ngezinkumbulo nezimo ezijulile, ukuze sithole ubuhlakani bokwabelana. Ukubenga kalula inguquko, sichaze ukuhluka komoya wethu, siphinde sihlanganyele erenjeni yezenzakalo ezisemqoka emhlabeni. Ekuqaleni, ngabe ifilimu ayangabaza? Ngingakusho ukuthi ihamba ngemuva kwentombazane edinga ukukhalipha. Njengoba ikhombisa ubuchwepheshe bethu bemfashini, ifilimu iyatholakala njengenhlangano yokwenza izigameko eziyiqiniso nezivamile. Izenzo ezithokozisayo, izigigaba ezifundisayo, zibhakabhakile emhlabeni; abanye bethu bayazithokozisa, abanye bayazithokozisa, futhi abanye bazahlukanisa njengoba bephendukela ezincwadini zebhizinisi. Ngalokhu, ngifisa ukusho khona ukuthi ifilimu yisikhathi esijulile, imfashini enhle yokucabanga. Ngaphandle kokujula kwayo ezicini zokuhlala sezibala ngaphambi, yenza umbono wokuphila ngendlela ehlukile. Ngiyavuma, ukuklanywa kokukhumbula, izifiso ezijabulisayo, namasu okukhombisa ukuthi umuntu angabhekana kanjani nezinkumbulo. Ifilimu iyimfashini — isikhumbuzo esiveza izinkumbulo, ibonisa isikhumbuzo sempilo yethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sizithokozisa ngezinkumbulo ezibuyisela emuva, futhi sazi ukuthi umhlaba uhlezi uyoqonda izinkumbulo zethu. Kukhona ukwazi okukhona — ifilimu ingelinye lamavela okukhumbuza. Lokhu kuhlobene nesiko; kumele siqhubeke siphila, sinikezwe izithombe zokuthi sikhona. Ngiyavuma, ifilimu ingaphezu kwesithombe; iyinsika yethu emhlabeni.
Umgwaqo wezokulungisa ulethe umthetho ozovumela umphakathi nezinye izithakazelo ezifana noMnyango wezobuJustice kanye neSikhungo sePolisi saseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babe nezwi ezinqumweni eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwabanjwa ngaphambi kokuphela kwezinsuku zabo. Ngesikhathi esizayo, abathintekayo emaphutheni bazovunyelwa ukwenza iziphakamiso kwiBhodi yeParole ezibhekelele izinsizakalo zokulungisa nokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeBhodi mayelana nezimo ezinzima. Kungani kudingeka ushintsho? Uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi luhlala lukhala kakhulu ngenxa yokubona ukuthi abaphathi bezokulungisa bayaphazamisa ezinqumweni ezenziwa yizinkantolo. Nakuba uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi lukhona emhlabeni jikelele futhi luhloselwe ukuhlela ukuziphatha kwabaphuli bomthetho ngokukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle nokubambisana, kanye nokunciphisa umehluko phakathi kokuphila ejele nokuphila okujwayelekile emphakathini. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lolu hlelo lukhala ngenxa yokuntuleka kokucaciswa nokuzimela ngesikhathi sokwenza izinqumo. Lezi zimo kanye nethuba lokubamba iqhaza komphakathi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuholele ekushintsheni komthetho nasekuthumeleni umthetho ngo-1998 owayevumela ukusungulwa kohlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi olucacile nolungakhethi, oluhlanganisa izithakazelo zangaphandle ekwenzeni izinqumo. Kukhona izinselelo ezinkulu ezivimbe ukwamukelwa kwalesi sigaba (isigaba 74) somthetho wezokulungisa, Umthetho 11 ka-1998. Lo mthetho waguqulwa ngo-2001 ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinkinga. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuphumelelisa lolu hlelo ukuze kuqedwe maduze engxenyeni yesibili ka-2004. Yini indima yeBhodi yeParole? AmaBhodi eParole abhekelele ukuhlela izindaba eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwabanjwa kanye nokubhekwa kwabo. Kuze kube manje, lawa mabhodi awanawo amandla okwenza izinqumo eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Okwamanje, amaBhodi enza kuphela iziphakamiso ezihambisana nenqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi izinqumo zenziwa ngabasebenzi abaphethe ngqo, isibonelo; abaphathi bezikhungo zokulungisa, abaphathiswa bendawo, abaphathiswa bezifunda, kanye noNgqongqoshe wezokulungisa, kuye ngokuthi ubukhulu balesi simo nokubuhlungu kwesigwebo. Umthetho omusha unikeza iBhodi amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwabanjwa abathathwa njengobungozi nalabo abathathwa njengobungozi uma amaBhodi enza iziphakamiso ezithunyelwa enkantolo eyayinikile isigwebo, engase iyaphika futhi iguqule isigwebo. Okokuqala, umthetho omusha unikeza amaBhodi eParole amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwabanjwa abathathwa njengobungozi ngokwesigaba 286A soMthetho Wokuphatha Kwecala futhi aguqule izigwebo ezibekwe ngesigaba 276(A) soMthetho Wokuphatha Kwecala mayelana nabanjwa abakukhululwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ezimweni ezishiwo ngenhla, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezanikela isigwebo ekuqaleni bese kwenziwa isinqumo. Okwengeziwe, isinqumo sokuvumela ukukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kubanjwa ngosuku noma ezikhungweni ezithathwa njengobungozi. Kwezizimo, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezanikela isigwebo bese kwenziwa isinqumo. AmaBhodi angama-52 azosungulwa ezweni lonke azoba namalungu akhishwe emphakathini. Amalungu azoba ngabantu abanokwethembeka nokuhlonipheka phakathi kwemiphakathi yabo abamele. Kumele babe ngabantu abakhulile abaqonda impilo futhi belungele ukumelwa izintshisekelo zomphakathi ngokuhlonipha nangokungakhethi. Izihlalo kumele zibe ngabantu abanemfundo efanele ehlanganiswe nesipiliyoni sokuphatha. Ngaphandle kwesihlalo, amalungu amabili angeziwe azothunyelwa kwiBhodi. Izikhala zePhini leSihlalo noMphakathi zigcinwe kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe boMnyango wezokulungisa. Ibhodi izophinde ifake abamele abavela kuSikhungo sePolisi saseNingizimu Afrika kanye noMnyango wezobuJustice. Le miphumela nokumelwa akuyona imfuneko njengoba lezi zinsizakalo zingakhetha ngesikhathi esizothunyelwa noma cha. Ezimweni ezihilela amacala anzima, ummeleli ovela kuMnyango wezobuJustice udinga ukuhlinzeka ngombiko kwiBhodi. Ibhodi ngalinye izosizwa ngamalungu amabili avela emnyangweni wezokulungisa ukuze kube nezinhloso zokuphatha nokweseka. Kwesinye isinyathelo esihlukile emsebenzini wendabuko kanye nomzamo wokunikeza amandla kubantu abathintekayo, abathintekayo beziphambeko ezithile bazoba nelungelo lokwenza iziphakamiso kwiBhodi futhi baphathe imihlangano yeBhodi kuphela uma bexoxa ngezindaba eziphathelene nabantu abashushumbiswa kubo. Lokhu kubhekwa njengesenzo esibalulekile sokwakha nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa obubuyiswayo njengendlela evunywayo, yokwakha nokuhlanganisa. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba amaBhodi amasha eParole azokwenza izicelo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene zabanjwa ezethulwe kubo, izimo ezintsha ezithinta isikhathi esizokhululwa khona umphakathi ngaphambi kokucabangela i-parole zizosebenza kuphela kulabo abathole isigwebo ngemuva kokuthi izinhlinzeko ezithile zomthetho ziqale ukusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bonke abanjwa abathole isigwebo ngaphambi kokuthi umthetho omusha uqale ukusebenza bazophathwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho okhona (Umthetho 8 ka-1959). Ngamanye amazwi, abanjwa abathole isigwebo esikhathini esedlule ngaphambi kokuthi umthetho omusha uqale ukusebenza akufanele balindele ukuthi umthetho omusha uzoba nomthelela omubi esikhathini esizokhululwa ngaphambi kokucabangela i-parole. Abantu abakhonjwa njengabaphuli bomthetho abavame: Ngemuva kokusebenza okungenani iminyaka eyisikhombisa. Umthetho omusha uvumela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokubhekelela iParole ezobhekelela amacala adluliselwa kuyo ukuze ibuyekezwe nguMphathiswa noma uNgqongqoshe wezokulungisa uma bekholelwa ukuthi isinqumo sokuqala seBhodi Yokubhekelela iParole siphikisana noma sithinta inqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Ibhodi Yokubuyekeza izoba nezimfanelo futhi ibanjwe ngamalungu avela kwiNational Council of Correctional Services, uMphathi noma uMphathi oPhindayo wezokuphatha, kanye namamele ababili emphakathini. Isihlalo seBhodi Yokubuyekeza sizoba uJaji weNkantolo Ephakeme, futhi isinqumo seBhodi sizothathwa njengomthetho obophelelayo kumaBhodi Yokubhekelela iParole. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aqonde izinguquko ezilethwe umthetho omusha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu, uMnyango uqale umkhankaso wokwazisa ophakanyiswe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane kubanjwa, abasebenzi bezokulungisa, kanye nomphakathi mayelana nomthelela womthetho omusha. Izikhangiso ezihlosiwe ukuheha amalungu omphakathi ukuba basebenze njengezihlalo zamaBhodi noma amalungu angeziwe ziz
Ukuqashwa Kwamathuba Emisebenzi: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane, abantu babengakaze bacabangele ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi ngendlela esiyiqonda ngayo namuhla. Umphakathi wawuhamba ngezinyathelo ezinzima, lapho abantu bejolise kakhulu ekutholeni ukudla, ukuvikeleka, kanye nezidingo eziyisisekelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, imisebenzi yayihlobene kakhulu nezimboni ezithile, njengezokulima, ezokwakha, kanye nezokuhweba. Abantu babebamba izikhundla ezithile, kodwa imisebenzi yayincane, futhi izinga lokuqashwa belingaphansi kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba wathuthuka. Ngemva kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, izwe laseNingizimu Afrika, njengelinye lamazwe amaningi, laqala ukubona ushintsho olukhulu. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, izimboni, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda kwaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje kuphela ukuthola imali, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, lapho abantu beqonda khona ukuthi kufanele bazithuthukise ukuze baphumelele. Ngalesi sikhathi, izikhungo zemfundo zaba yizikhungo ezibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abantu. Izikhungo zokufunda zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukufunda amakhono ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuphatha. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha emisebenzi, futhi abantu baqala ukuthola izikhundla eziphakeme. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kwaba yinto ebalulekile, futhi abantu baqala ukucabanga ngempumelelo yabo, baphinde baphokophele emisebenzini ethuthukayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zaba nezidingo ezithile. Zafuna abantu abaneziqu, abanolwazi, nabakhono. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuhola, lapho izinkampani ziqasha abantu abaneziqu ezithile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izisebenzi ezikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kwaba yinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje kuphela ukufuna abantu abaneziqu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokusebenza efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, lapho izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokufundisa, zokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izikhundla eziphakeme, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga labo lokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje kuphela ukufuna abantu abaneziqu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokusebenza efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, lapho izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokufundisa, zokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izikhundla eziphakeme, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga labo lokuphila. Namuhla, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi sekuyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wonke. Abantu bahlala befuna amathuba okuthuthukisa amakhono abo, futhi izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuhola ezithuthukayo.
