Umoya (amanzi) ubalulekile ngesikhathi sokutshala lapho izitshalo zikhula ezindaweni ezithola imvula kuphela. Ulwazi mayelana nenani lemvula elizokwanela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lungatholwa kuMnyango Wezolimo oseduze nawe. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa njengomhlahlandlela lapho sihlela izinqubo zethu zokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani kufanele sigcine amanzi emhlabathini? Ukutshala kudinga amanzi - izinhlobo ezihlukene zezithombo zidinga izinga elihlukile lamanzi, ngakho kufanele sithathele phezulu lokhu ngaphambi kokukhetha isithombo esithile sokutshala. Imvula yemvelo ayivamile ukwenzeka ngesikhathi esifanele sesithombo esithile. Ngokuvamile, izindawo eNingizimu Afrika lapho kutshalwa khona izitshalo zokudla ezomile zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele emhlabathini ngesikhathi esifanele sokutshala ukuze imbewu ikwazi ukukhula kalula nezimpande zikhule kahle ekuqaleni. Isikhathi esifanele sokutshala sizobhekelela nezinye izikhathi ezibalulekile lapho isithombo sikhula (isibonelo: imvula ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwezithombo ze-maize kanye naleso sikhathi lapho izimbali ze-pumpkin zikhula). Ukuze izitshalo ezisele emathafeni ziqhubeke zishwabane ngokushesha futhi zandise inani le-'humus' emhlabathini, okwenza izitshalo zithole izakhamzimba. Ingabe zonke izinhlobo zomhlabathi zingagcina amanzi? Yebo, kodwa umhlabathi onodaka kanye nomhlabathi opholile uzokwenza amanzi amaningi aphume. Umhlabathi onamathafa aqinile (njengodaka) ezindaweni ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 meter ugcina amanzi kahle uma utshalwe. Singasiza kanjani umhlabathi ukuthi wamukele imvula? Umhlabathi ophakeme uphumelelayo, ungacindezelwanga, noma kokubili. Kukhona izitshalo ezishwabene phezulu komhlabathi. Amanzi agcinwa kanjani emhlabathini? Amanzi agcinwa ezikhungweni phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi. Izinhlobo zomhlabathi ziyahluka: kukhona udaka, isihlabathi, kanye nodaka. Inani lamanzi angagcinwa kulezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi nayo iyahluka. Lezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi ngokuvamile zingagcina ama-25 mm wamanzi emhlabathini ophakeme ongu-150 mm. (Emhlabathini lapho izimpande zingafinyelela ku-1 meter, ama-180 mm emvula angagcinwa). Yini ebangela ukuthi amanzi aphume emhlabathini? Ukukhanya kwelanga. Umhlabathi uyashisa futhi amanzi ayashwabana. Ukuphakama kwe-capillary emhlabathini. Amanzi ahamba phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, aphakama, futhi aphinde ashwabane emoyeni. Izihlahla ezikhula nezinye izitshalo ezifana nograsi - amanzi aphuma ezithelweni (lokhu kuyimbangela enkulu yokulahleka kwamanzi). Yini esingayenza ukuze sigcine amanzi kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula ingangena emhlabathini. Uma kukhona ungqimba oluqinile phezulu, amanzi awakwazi ukungena, bese amanzi eqala ukuhamba phansi futhi awakwazi ukungena phansi. Zama ukushiya izinsalela eziningi zezithelo zonyaka odlule ukuze imvula ingashayi umhlabathi kanzima, ngaleyo ndlela ivimbele ukuvela kwegatsha eliqinile. Khumbula njalo ukuthi ukuhamba kwezinsalela kuthatha isikhathi, futhi umanyolo onothile ngenyukliya uzodingeka ngoba izinsalela ezishwabene aziniki umanyolo ngokushesha. Uma imvula iningi, phula ungqimba oluqinile phezulu komhlabathi. Ungqimba oluqinile luzovimba imvula eyengeziwe ukuthi ingangeni emhlabathini futhi lwenze ukushwabana kwamanzi kwandise, okwenza umhlabathi umiswe ngokushesha. Qinisekisa ukuthi insimu ihlanzekile futhi ingenazihlahla eziphikisanayo ngemva kokuvuna kuze kube sekufikeni kwesikhathi sokutshala esisha. Izinsalela zezithelo phezulu komhlabathi zivimba ukushwabana kwamanzi futhi azikwazi ukuhamba. Ilanga lishisa izinsalela, kodwa ukushwabana kwamanzi akwenzi ngokushesha. Izinsalela zingaba yizithelo ezisele noma zingaba yizinsalela ezivela lapho kusebenza njalo ngemishini. Ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezomile, qinisekisa njalo ukuthi kukhona izinsalela ukuze amanzi agcinwe emhlabathini ophakeme.
Ukutshala Izingadi: Uhlanga Lokukhula Nokuthokozisa Ezweni elijulile lethu, ukutshala izingadi akusikho kuphela ukuzijabulisa, kodwa kuyisiko elihloniphekile elihlanganisa umhlaba, izitshalo, nemvelo. Ukukhuluma ngale ndaba, sithola ukuthi ukutshala izingadi kudinga ubuchwepheshe, uthando, nokubekezela. Ngakho, sizothatha uhambo olujulile kuleli thuba, sithokozise izinzuzo, izindlela, nezifundo ezitholakala kulolu hlobo lokuphila. Izinto Eziyinhloko Zokutshala Izingadi Uma sikhuluma ngokutshala izingadi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinto eziyisisekelo. Okokuqala, umhlaba. Umhlaba omuhle, onempilo unikeza isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukuze umhlaba ube semthethweni, kufanele ube nezinhlaka ezinhle, okungukuthi, ube ne-nutrients ezanele. Ukuze uthole umhlaba onempilo, ungasebenzisa izinkuni ezibolayo, ama-mulch, noma izithako ezivela emvelweni, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezidingekayo. Okwesibili, izitshalo. Khetha izitshalo ezivumelana nezimo zezulu endaweni yakho. Lolu hlobo lokukhetha luyisisekelo ukuze ube nezingadi eziphumelelayo. Izitshalo ezinjengezimbali, imifino, nezithelo zenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nemvelo. Izindlela Zokutshala Ukutshala izingadi akuyona into eyodwa kuphela; kunezindlela eziningi zokwenza lokhu. Uhlelo lwe-‘companion planting’ lungaba usizo olukhulu. Lokhu kusho ukufaka izitshalo ezihambisanayo eduze komunye nomunye, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela izitshalo ekulweni nezifo. Isibonelo, izinkuni ezinjengezithako ze-basil ne-tomato zikhombisa ukuthi zisebenza kahle uma zihlala eduze. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima eziphumelelayo, njengokufaka umhlaba opholile, kungasiza ekugcineni umswakama, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela izitshalo ezibuthakathaka. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ngokulinganayo, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezishisayo, kubalulekile ukuze izitshalo zihlale zikhula kahle. Izinzuzo Zokutshala Izingadi Izizathu zokutshala izingadi ziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona impilo. Ukudla okukhulelwe ekhaya kuvame ukuba nezinhlobonhlobo eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukugcina impilo. Imifino nezithelo ezikhuliswa ekhaya zihlala zikhazimula, zihlala zisha, futhi zinezithako eziningi ezidingekayo emzimbeni. Okwesibili, ukutshala izingadi kungenza kube lula ukujabulisa. Ukusebenza emasimini, ukugubha izitshalo, nokubona ukukhula kwazo kuyajabulisa. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yengqondo, okwandisa umuzwa wokuthokozisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukutshala izingadi kungaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano. Umndeni ungahlangana, uthokozise, futhi uhlele izinhlelo zokuhlola izitshalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Izifundo Eziphumelele Njengoba sithokozisa ukutshala izingadi, sifunda izifundo ezibalulekile. Ukuze ube nezingadi eziphumelelayo, kudinga ukuzimisela. Ukuhamba phambili, kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi izitshalo zidinga ukunakekelwa. Ukubekezelela, ukugxila, nokuhlola izimo ezihlukahlukene zempilo yezitshalo zenza kube lula ukusiza izitshalo ukuba zikhule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukutshala izingadi kusinika ithuba lokufunda. Njengoba sithola izinkinga, sithola izixazululo. Lokhu kusebenza emhlabeni jikelele, njengoba sithola izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nezinkinga, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kungabe kuyizifo, izilokotho, noma izimo zezulu ezingalindelekile. Isiphetho Ukutshala izingadi akukhona nje okwenziwa emakhaya, kodwa kuyisiko elihloniphekile elihlanganisa abantu, izitshalo, nemvelo. Le ndlela yokuphila inikeza izinzuzo eziningi, kusukela empilweni, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngakho-ke, uma ungakaze uzame ukutshala izingadi, sikhuthaza ukuthi uzame. Uhambo lokutshala izingadi lungaba yinto emnandi, efundisa, futhi ethokozisayo, eyokuhlanganyela nemvelo. Ngakho, phakamisa umhlaba, phakamisa izitshalo, futhi uvule isifiso sokuphila okukhanya. Ukutshala izingadi akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila.
AmaZulu Kwakukhanya ilanga, umoya uthulile, futhi izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu ezulwini. Ekhaya elincane elisemaphandleni, uMnumzane Mkhize wayehamba emasimini akhe, ebona izithelo ezivuthayo. Uhlanga lwezithelo lwaluthokozisa, futhi wayehlale ebona umphakathi wakhe, amaZulu, edlula phansi kwendlela, bejabulile, bejabulela impilo. Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalunothile ngamasiko nezinkolelo. Uhlelo lwabo lokuphila lwalwakhiwe ngothando, ukuhlonipha, kanye nokubambisana. UbuZulu bukhona emoyeni, emanzini, nasemhlabeni. Uhlanga lwabantu lwalubhalwe ngempilo yabo, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu. Ngolunye usuku, uMnumzane Mkhize wathola isikhumbuzo esivela kumama wakhe. Kwakuyincwadi ebhalwe ngezinsuku zakudala, lapho amaZulu abebambelela khona emasikweni abo. Wafunda ngempilo kaDingiswayo, umholi ophumelelayo, kanye noShaka, owakha ubukhosi obukhulu. UShaka wayeziqhenya ngempilo yakhe, kodwa wayephinde ahloniphe izinkolelo zakhe. Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalukhumbula izinkanyezi ezazikhanya phezulu, futhi uMnumzane Mkhize wathola umdlandla wokuhlola imvelaphi yakhe. Ngemuva kokufunda incwadi, wathola umqondo wokubuyisela emuva izinsuku ezinhle. Waqala ukuhlela umkhosi wamasiko, lapho abantu behlangana khona, bejabulela imidlalo, izinkondlo, nezinsizwa ezidansayo. Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalubhalwe ngempilo yabo, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu. UMnumzane Mkhize wakhumbula ukuthi amaZulu abekwazi ukuhamba phambili, kodwa bahlale behlonipha izinkolelo zabo. Wathumela izimemo kubantu bakubo, wathi: “Sizobuyisela emuva izinsuku ezinhle, sizokhumbula amasiko ethu, sizodansa, sizokhuluma ngothando.” Abantu baphendula ngokujabula, bejabulile ngale nhloso. Ngesikhathi umkhosi ufika, izinkanyezi zazikhanya phezulu, futhi umoya wawuphuma kahle. Abantu behlangana emaphandleni, bezinikele emculweni, behlanganyela izinkondlo namaciko. Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalukhanya, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawuzwakala. UMsizi, umculi odumile, wakhuluma ngothando, wathi: “Siyabonga, ngoba uZulu ungumndeni.” Umlingo wamazwi kaMsizi wathinta inhliziyo zabantu. Abesifazane badansa, bezigqaja ngezimpahla zabo ezinhle, kanti abesilisa bahlabelela, bedansa ngezinyawo eziphakeme. Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalubhalwe ngempilo yabo, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu. Ngesikhathi umkhosi uqhubeka, uMnumzane Mkhize wathola umqondo wokuthi lokhu akukhona kuphela umkhosi, kodwa kuyisikhumbuzo sokubuyisela emuva izinsuku ezinhle. Waqonda ukuthi amaZulu kufanele ahlale ehlonipha izinkolelo zabo, futhi akhumbule ukuthi ubumbano lubalulekile. Ngesikhathi umkhosi uphela, abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi, bejabulile, bejabulisa. Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalubhalwe ngempilo yabo, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu. UMsizi waphakamisa isiphuzo, wathi: “Siyabonga, makhulu, sizoqhubeka sikhumbula izinsuku ezinhle.” UMnumzane Mkhize wathokoza, wathi: “Ngiyabonga nonke, ngoba senze lokhu kube yimpumelelo. Masiqhubeke sikhumbula izinkolelo zethu, masibe umndeni omkhulu.” Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalubhalwe ngempilo yabo, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMnumzane Mkhize waqonda ukuthi ubumbano lwamaZulu lwaluyinsika yokuphila kwabo. Ngenxa yokuhlonipha, uthando, nokubambisana, amaZulu azothola indlela yokukhula, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlanga lwamaZulu lwalubhalwe ngempilo yabo, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu. Ngakho-ke, uMnumzane Mkhize wathola injabulo, futhi umoya wamaZulu waphila. Uhlanga lwabo lwalubhalwe ngempilo yabo, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo sokuthi, noma ngabe izikhathi zishintsha, amaZulu kufanele ahlale ehlonipha izinkolelo zabo, futhi akhumbule ukuthi ubumbano luwumgogodla wokuphila kwabo.
Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Kulezi zinsuku, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Ukukhula kwemakethe, izinguquko zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zamakhasimende kudinga ukuthi abasebenzi babe namakhono ahluke kakhulu. Lokhu kudala umbono wokuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa akusikho kuphela okudingekayo ukuze kube nempumelelo yenkampani, kodwa futhi kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngokuqonda ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ziwusizo kanjani ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abasebenzi. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi ngolwazi olusha, amakhono, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala behlakaniphile futhi benza kahle emisebenzini yabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni imikhiqizo ethuthukisiwe, engcono, futhi ethokozisayo kumakhasimende, okugcina kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zikhuthaza umoya wokusebenza kahle phakathi kwabasebenzi. Lapho abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi inkampani ibanakekela futhi ibanikeza amathuba okukhula, bakhuthazwa ukuba benze kahle. Lokhu kudala umoya omuhle emsebenzini, okukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaholi nabasebenzi. Umoya omuhle emsebenzini uphinde ulethe izinzuzo eziningi, njengoba abasebenzi bejabulela umsebenzi wabo, okwenza kube nokwehla kwezinga lokushiya emsebenzini. Kodwa-ke, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa azihlali zisebenza kahle. Kwezinye izimo, izinkampani zingase zinganaki kahle izidingo zabasebenzi, noma zifake izinhlelo ezingenakusebenza. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abasebenzi bazizwe bengafuni ukuqhubeka nokuqeqeshwa, noma baphinde bahluleke ekutholeni amakhono abawadingayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde kahle izidingo zabasebenzi bazo futhi zenze izinhlelo ezihambisana nezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa kufanele zibe nokuqhubeka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akusikho kuphela ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngesikhathi sokungena emsebenzini, kodwa kufanele kube nokuhlanganyela okuqhubekayo. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezihambisana nezinguquko ezisemkhakheni, ukuze abasebenzi bahlale bephambili. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni ethuthukayo, njengobuchwepheshe, lapho izinguquko zenzeka ngokushesha. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bangase baphikise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zidinga izinsiza eziningi, futhi lokho kungaba nomthelela omubi emalini yenkampani. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yiqiniso, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukunganikwa ithuba lokuqeqeshwa kungaholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu. Uma abasebenzi bengatholi amakhono adingekayo, inkampani ingase ibhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu, ezifana nokuncipha kokukhiqiza, ukwehla kwezinga lemikhiqizo, kanye nokulahleka kwamakhasimende. Ngakho-ke, izindleko zokungaqeqeshi kahle abasebenzi zingaba phezulu kakhulu kunezindleko zokuqeqesha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zingaba nethonya elihle ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi jikelele. Uma abasebenzi bethola ukuqeqeshwa okuhle, bangathuthukisa amakhono abo, okungaholela ekutheni babe namathuba angcono emsebenzini. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okugcina kukhuthaza umnotho. Ngakho-ke, izinkampani ezibeka phambili izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zikhuthaza hhayi kuphela ukukhula kwazo, kodwa futhi zikhuthaza ukukhula komphakathi. Ngokuphetha, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza wanamuhla. Zihlinzeka ngokuqonda, amakhono, kanye nomoya wokusebenza kahle, okwenza kube nokukhula okukhulu kwezinye izinkampani. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde kahle izidingo zabasebenzi bazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zisebenza kahle, futhi zibe nokuqhubeka. Ngale ndlela, izinkampani zingathuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu, zikhulise umnotho, futhi ziqinisekise impumelelo yazo esikhathini esizayo.
Okukhuluma lapha akuhlosile ukuba kube umhlahlandlela ophelele ngezincwadi zokugcina nezokuhlala. Incwadi yokugcina iyidokhumenti ekhethekile esincoma ukuthi ibhalwe ngumuntu onolwazi njengomthetho, inkampani eyasungulwa ukuphatha izindlu, noma abanye. Le mininingwane ihloselwe ukwazisa umfundi ngemininingwane ethile ye incwadi yokugcina. Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engu-16 noma ngaphezulu, ngaphandle kokuthi ngesikhathi sokwenza incwadi yokugcina babe nesimo sokungakwazi, bangakha incwadi yokugcina. (Umuntu owenza incwadi yokugcina ubizwa nge-testator uma engumfana noma i-testatrix uma engumfazi). Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphezulu, abababonile incwadi yokugcina, kufanele bakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo. Kusukela ngoJanuwari 1, 1954, incwadi yokugcina kufanele ibe ebhalwe. Ingabhalwa ngesandla, ibhalwe ngekhompyutha, noma ikhiqizwe ngekhompyutha. I-testator kufanele imsign incwadi yokugcina ekugcineni noma ekupheleni kwayo. Uma incwadi yokugcina inamakhasi amaningi, i-testator kufanele imsign ikhasi ngalinye ngaphandle kwekhasi lokugcina (Noma i-testator kufanele imsign wonke amakhasi ababonile, kufanele futhi imsign ikhasi lokugcina futhi imsign ekupheleni kwedokhumenti). Umphakathi wenkantolo kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uyaneliseka ngubani i-testator futhi ukuthi incwadi yokugcina imsignwe ngu-testator wabo. Umphakathi wenkantolo kufanele imsign isiqinisekiso kanye nekhasi ngalinye le incwadi yokugcina. Umphakathi wenkantolo kufanele ube khona lapho incwadi yokugcina imsignwa futhi kufanele enze isiqinisekiso sakhe ngokushesha ngemva kokuba incwadi yokugcina imsignwe noma ngabe i-testator ifa ngokushesha ngemva kokusayinwa. I-addendum noma isixhumanisi se incwadi yokugcina esivele sikhona, esihloselwe ukwengeza noma ukulungisa incwadi yokugcina, kufanele sihlangabezane nazo zonke izidingo ze incwadi yokugcina. I-addendum ayidingi ukusayinwa ngababoni ababesayine incwadi yokugcina yokuqala. Izinguquko ku incwadi yokugcina zingaqalwa ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwayo noma ngemva kokwenziwa kwayo. Izinguquko ku incwadi yokugcina kufanele zihlangabezane nezidingo zokwenza incwadi yokugcina futhi uma ungakwazi ukusayinwa, kufanele futhi zihlangabezane nezidingo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolo hlobo. Ngesikhathi sokulungisa incwadi yokugcina, akudingeki ukuthi ababonile ababesayine incwadi yakho yokugcina yokuqala basayine izinguquko. Iphakheji noma isipho esinikezwe kumkakho encwadini yakho yokugcina, esenziwe ngaphambi kokuphulwa komshado wakho, sizokuqhubeka njengaleso ngisho nangemva kokuhlukaniswa. Umthetho ophathelene nezincwadi zokugcina uthi ngaphandle kokuthi ucacise okunye ebhalwe phansi, isipho esinikezwe kumkakho ophumelele kuzobhekwa njengokukhanselwa uma ufela ezinyangeni ezintathu kusukela ngosuku lokuhlukaniswa. Le mfuneko yomthetho inikeza umuntu ohlukanisiwe izinyanga ezintathu zokulungisa incwadi yakhe yokugcina ngemva kokuhlukana. Nokho, uma ungakwenzi lokhu, umkakho ohlukanisiwe uzothola leso sipho njengoba kuchaziwe encwadini yokugcina. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obhala incwadi yokugcina noma ingxenye yayo ubhala nge-testator. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obonile incwadi yokugcina uyakwenza lokho egameni le-testator noma njengom witness. Xhumana nommeli wakho ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi.
U-Elon Musk: Umuntu Ohlukile U-Elon Musk, lo mholi onamandla, udume emhlabeni jikelele. Uthandwa yabaningi, abanye bayamvuma, kanti abanye baphikisa izinqumo zakhe. Uthole udumo olukhulu ngenxa yemikhiqizo yakhe, kodwa akukona konke okukhanya. Ngizokhuluma ngaye ukuze ngiveze ukuthi kungani engumuntu ohluke kakhulu. U-Elon wazalelwa ePretoria, eNingizimu Afrika, ngo-1971. Kusukela ebuncaneni, wayenothando olukhulu lwezobuchwepheshe. Ngakolunye usuku, ngesikhathi eseneminyaka engu-12, waqala ukuhlela imidlalo ngekhompuyutha, okwakukhombisa ukuthi uzoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo, uMusk wathuthela eMelika, lapho aqala khona ukuhamba phambili. U-Elon waqala izinkampani eziningi eziphumelelayo, kuhlanganise neZip2, eyathuthukisa izixazululo zokuhamba. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi, kodwa uMusk wakwazi ukwakha izinto ezintsha. Ngemuva kwalokho, wathola ithuba lokwakha iPayPal, eyaziwa kakhulu, okwakuwimpumelelo enkulu futhi kumvumela ukuba aqhubeke nezinhlelo zakhe. U-Elon akagcini lapho; uthanda izinselelo, okwaholela ekwakheni iSpaceX, umgomo wakhe wukuthumela abantu emkhathini futhi athole izindlela zokuphila kwezinye izinkanyezi. U-SpaceX waba yimpumelelo enkulu, uMusk waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinto ezinzima zingafezeka uma unethemba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, u-Elon ungumholi weTesla, inkampani edume ngama-ev (izimoto ezihamba ngogesi). Uthanda ukwakha izimoto ezihlanzekile ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. U-Tesla akuyona nje imoto; iyisixazululo sokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. U-Elon uhlala efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi lokho kubonakala emisebenzini yakhe. Nokho, akagcini kuphela ezinkampanini. Ubuye abe nomthelela omkhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, njalo ekhuluma ngezinto ezithinta umhlaba, njengezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Uthi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ukuze silondoloze umhlaba, kudinga ubuchwepheshe obusha. U-Musk akavumi ukuma; uhlala efuna izixazululo ezintsha. Nokho, akukhona konke okukhanya. U-Elon uthola ukugxekwa okuningi. Abanye bathi uhlanganisa izinkinga zokuphatha abantu, kanti abanye baphikisa izinqumo zakhe. Ubuye abe nezinye izinkinga ezithinta izinkampani zakhe, kodwa lokhu akumvimbi ekutheni aqhubeke. U-Elon ungumuntu onamandla, futhi uthanda ukuhamba phambili, kungakhathaliseki izithiyo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elon Musk ubonakala engumuntu ongenakuphikiswa. Uthanda ukuxoxa ngezinto ezithinta ikusasa, futhi ubonakala enethemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ubuye abe nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi lokho kuhle kakhulu. Ngokuphetha, u-Elon Musk ungumuntu ohluke kakhulu. Uthanda izinselelo, futhi akavumi ukuma. Uthanda ukwakha izinto ezintsha, futhi ubonakala enethemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. U-Elon ungumholi, umphakathi, futhi umphakathi udinga abantu abanjengaye ukuze sithole izixazululo ezintsha. Uthanda ukwakha, futhi lokho kuyisifundo esihle kithi sonke.
U- Ms. Jane uthi... Njengomkhiqizi (noma njengomndeni), unani? Ungafinyelela yini emhlabeni, emakethe, emishini, noma ezinsizweni ohlelweni lwethu Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezolimo? Isisekelo sethu sibuza ukuthi unani, nokuthi singakusiza kanjani ukuba usebenzise kahle lokho? Uma unomhlaba ongawufinyelela, usebenzisa kanjani okwamanje? Ingabe ungasebenzisa kahle kunalokho okwamanje, futhi yini ekuvimbela ekwenzeni lokho? Sikholelwa ukuthi wonke umuntu angasizwa ukufinyelela imiphumela engcono ngokusebenzisa kahle izinsiza abangazithola. Ukuba umkhiqizi osebenza ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo kusho ukukhiqiza okungaphezu kwalokho okudingekayo kuwe nasemndenini wakho. Uma uthengisa ukudla okukhishwe, uphonsa itshe emfuleni ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kube khona ukudla njalo futhi ufanele ukwesekwa. NjengoGrain SA, sizibophezele ekutshaleni imali kuwe. Le mpelasonto ibiyinselele kakhulu. Okokuqala, amanani aphansi ezitshalo abangele ukufinyelela ezikweletini zokukhiqiza. Naphezu kwemizamo yethu emihle, uMnyango Wezolimo awukwazanga ukusiza abakhiqizi bethu. Kulabo abangakwazi ukutshala, ukuqala kwentwasahlobo kube nomswakama omncane futhi izimo zokulima zibe zimbi. Kuqale ukuwa imvula, kodwa akukapheli. Manje inselele iwukukhula okungaphathwa kanye nezitshalo eziphuma ngaphandle. Okungenani amanani ezitshalo zokudla kanye nezitshalo ze-oyili athuthuke, futhi labo abashadile kufanele bathole umvuzo wezizakhamuzi zabo. Intengo ye-maize nayo ithuthuke, futhi isikhathi esizayo sibonakala sinesithembiso esikhulu sokutshala i-maize (ezindaweni ezifanele). Sisebenza kanzima ukuze sakhe ubudlelwano obuhle noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezakhamuzi kanye Nezinguquko Zomhlaba. Sithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukubika ngalokhu emhlanganweni olandelayo wePula. Uma singasebenzisana nomnyango, singasiza abakhiqizi abaningi. Sifisela impumelelo yenu zonke ezinyangeni ezizayo - maye izitshalo zenu zikhule futhi nibe nethemba ngekusasa lezolimo eNingizimu Afrika.
Ibhola Lomnqakiswano: Umsebenzi Wokubambisana Nokuhlonipha Ibhola lomnqakiswano, noma i-basketball, liyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yami. Njengomuntu othanda le midlalo, ngithanda ukubona indlela ibhola lomnqakiswano lishintsha impilo yabantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi ezithintekayo. Lokhu akukhona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana, yokubambisana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokokuqala, ibhola lomnqakiswano lishukumisela abantu ukuba basebenze ndawonye. Umphakathi wethu udinga imisebenzi ethokozisayo, futhi ibhola lomnqakiswano iyindlela enhle yokuhlanganisa abantu. Ngibona ukuthi lapho abantu behlangana emidlalweni, bahlala bejabule, bephuma ezindaweni zabo zokuhlala, futhi bejabulisa omakhelwane. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu besebenzisana ukuze bafinyelele umgomo ofanayo – ukuwina umdlalo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu bahlala behlukaniswe khona ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano lishukumisela abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ukudlala ibhola kudinga amandla, ukuzikhandla, nokuzinikela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuzivocavoca, baphume emakhaya abo, futhi baphile impilo enempilo. Ngiyakhumbula izinsuku zami zokudlala, lapho ngazithola ngikhuthazekile, ngithokozisa umzimba wami, futhi ngithola ubungane obusha. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuba umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola lomnqakiswano lishintsha izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Ngibona ukuthi abanye abadlali baphuma ezindaweni ezinzima, baphumelela, futhi baba yizibonelo ezinhle emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abanye abantu badinga abantu abakhuthazayo, abakhombisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuphumelela, noma ngabe izimo zikhona ezinzima. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lishintsha izimpilo, futhi lokho kuyinto engiyithokozelayo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba ibhola lomnqakiswano likhula, kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukuncintisana okukhulu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abadlali baphatheke kabi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo zengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukuthi umphumela omuhle awuhambisani kuphela nokuwina, kodwa futhi nokuhlonipha abanye, nokwakha umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kumele kube yisisekelo sokudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano lidinga ukugxila ekufundiseni. Abadlali abasha badinga ukuqonda ukuthi umdlalo awuhambisani kuphela nezinga lokudlala, kodwa futhi nezimiso zokuhlonipha, ukuzithiba, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Uma ungavumelani, yiziphi izikhalazo onazo ngalolu hlelo? Ingabe umele inhlangano ethile? Lolu hlobo lokuhlola luqaliswe kuzo zonke izikole zikamasipala nezizimele, kanye nasezikoleni zikamasipala ezincane. Ulwazi oluqoqwe phakathi kwalesi senzo luhlanganisa idatha evela kubafundi kanye nenani labafundisi nabasebenzi kuleyo skholo. Ifomu elilungiselelwe ukuqoqa leli ulwazi kumele ligcwaliswe izikole ngosuku lweshumi ngemva kokuvulwa kwezikole, okusho ukuthi ngoJanuwari 24, 2000. Abaphathi bezikole bazonikezwa isaziso esanele esibazisa ngesikhathi inqubo izoqala. Abaphathiswa bazobamba izingxoxo nabafundisi nomphathi wesikole ukuze bazame ukucacisa iqiniso ngenani labafundi. Bazobuyekeza yonke imibhalo (amarejista ezifundo nezinhlu zezifundo) kanye nanoma yiziphi izincwadi noma amaphepha afanele, futhi benze ama-template ale mibhalo namaphepha uma kudingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzoba nokuhlolwa nokubheka okuvele kwabafundi abakuleyo skholo ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokho okurekhodiwe, futhi inani lezifundo lizophinde libhekwe. Ukuvakashela izikole kuzothatha cishe amahora amabili kuya kwamathathu. Kuzokhethwa isampula engu-2% noma engu-3% yezikole ezikhona. Indlela yokukhetha izikole izokwenziwa ngokungahleliwe, kodwa kuzoqinisekiswa ukuthi zonke izingxenye nezinhlobo zezikole ziyavakashelwa.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini: Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mkhize Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukuxoxa noMnu. Thabo Mkhize, ongumholi wezobuchwepheshe enkampanini ethuthukisa izixazululo ze-AI. Uhlelo lwethu lwentatheli lubheke kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwe-AI emsebenzini, kuhlu lwezinto ezishintsha indlela esisebenza ngayo. Mnu. Mkhize, ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuzoxoxa nathi namuhla. Umbuzo 1: Yini i-AI, futhi iyini indima yayo emsebenzini? Mnu. Mkhize: Ngiyabonga. I-AI, noma i-Artificial Intelligence, iyindlela yokwenza izinhlelo zibe nekhono lokucabanga, ukufunda, nokwenza izinqumo ngokwakho. Emsebenzini, i-AI isiza kakhulu ekwenzeni amaphrojekthi aphumelelayo. Isibonelo, ikwazi ukusiza ekucubunguleni idatha enkulu, ibone izitayela, futhi ithuthukise izinqubomgomo eziphusile. Lokhu kusiza izinkampani ukuba zisebenze kahle, zinciphise izindleko, futhi zenze imikhiqizo ethuthukile. Umbuzo 2: Ingabe i-AI ithinta zonke izimboni ngokufanayo? Mnu. Mkhize: Yebo, i-AI iyathinta izimboni eziningi. Emkhakheni wezokwakha, isibonelo, ingasetshenziswa ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphakathi nendawo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Kwezokuhweba, i-AI isiza ekuthengiseni imikhiqizo ngendlela eqondile. Nakuba izimboni zingahluka, umphumela wokusebenzisa i-AI uvame ukuba yimpumelelo. Lokhu kugqugquzela abanye ukuba baqhubeke nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezivela ekusetyenziswa kwe-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, i-AI ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imisebenzi yansuku zonke iyenziwa kahle, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umkhiqizo. Okwesibili, i-AI ingasiza ukunciphisa amaphutha. Ngokuvamile, abantu bayaphutha, kodwa uma usebenzisa i-AI, amathuba okwenza amaphutha ancipha kakhulu. Okwesithathu, ivumela izinkampani ukuthi zibe nezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende, okuyinto engcono kakhulu emqhudelwaneni. Umbuzo 4: Zikhona izinselelo ezihambisana nokusebenzisa i-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Yebo, izinselelo zikhona. Okokuqala, ukungaqondi kahle indlela i-AI esebenza ngayo kungaholela ezinkingeni. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi i-AI ayiyona isixazululo esiphelele, futhi kumele isetshenziswe ngobuchule. Okwesibili, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza zokuthuthukisa i-AI, ezihlanganisa abantu abaneziqu eziphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu, okungase kube inkinga ezinkampanini ezincane. Umbuzo 5: Ucabanga ukuthi i-AI izoshintsha kanjani umhlaba wezokusebenza emasikweni ezayo? Mnu. Mkhize: Ngikholelwa ukuthi i-AI izoba nomthelela omkhulu. Izinkampani zizoba nekhono lokwenza izinqumo eziphusile, ezizocacisa ukuphumelela kwazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, othisha nabaphathi bazoba namathuluzi angcono okuphatha abasebenzi. I-AI izovumela abantu ukuthi bagxile emisebenzini ethuthukisayo, ngenkathi imisebenzi ejwayelekile iphathwa ngama-robot. Lokhu kuzoletha izinguquko ezithokozisayo emsebenzini. Umbuzo 6: Yimaphi amakhono abantu abadinga ukuwathuthukisa ukuze bahlangabezane nezinguquko ezilethwa yi-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Ukuze abantu bahlangabezane nezinguquko, kudingeka baphucule amakhono abo. Izifundo eziphathelene nobuchwepheshe, njengokufunda ngama-algorithms, zizoba usizo olukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amakhono okuxhumana, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, nokucabanga okujulile azoba neqhaza elikhulu. Kumele bazi futhi ukuthi i-AI iyithuluzi eliwusizo, kodwa kubalulekile ukugcina umoya wabantu emsebenzini. Umbuzo 7: Ekugcineni, ungathanda ukwabelana ngakho okwengeziwe mayelana ne-AI? Mnu. Mkhize: Ngiyabonga. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi i-AI ingumngani wezinkampani, kodwa kufanele siyisebenzise ngendlela eqondile. Abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekusebenzeni kwe-AI, futhi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu ne-AI kuzokwenza umhlaba umsebenzi ube ngcono. Ngakho, asiqhubekeleni phambili, sibuye sizinakekele izinselelo ezihambisana nayo. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mkhize, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi lwakho ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini kuyashintsha, futhi kubalulekile ukuba abathintekayo balungiselele izinguquko ezizayo. Uhlelo lwethu lwentatheli luthokozisa ukuhlangana nezinkampani ezisebenzisa i-AI ukuze ziqedele imisebenzi ethile, futhi sizokubona lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
Ezokwakhiwa Kwezindlu: Ukukhula Nokuthuthuka Kwenhlalakahle Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukuxoxa nawe ngendaba ethokozisayo, leyo yokwakhiwa kwezindlu. Njengoba sikhula, sithola ukuthi izidingo zethu zikhula futhi. Abantu abaningi bahlala ezindlini ezincane, noma ngabe bahlala emakhaya, badinga izindawo ezinkulu, ezinokuthula, nezokuhlala kahle. Lokhu kwenza kube nesidingo esikhulu sokwakha izindlu ezintsha. Ngabe ubona kanjani lezi zinhlelo zokwakha? Ngicabanga ukuthi ziningi izinto ezithinta lezi zinhlelo. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngendawo. Indawo yokwakha ibalulekile. Uma sikhuluma ngendawo, sikhuluma ngendawo ezothuthukiswa, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezokuthutha. Uma izindlu zikhona endaweni enezinsiza ezinhle, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngendawo. Kukhona nezinto eziningi ezithinta izindleko zokwakha. Uma sikhuluma ngezindleko, sikhuluma ngempela ngezinto eziningi. Izinto ezinjengokwakhiwa kwezinto, izinsiza, kanye nezisebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kube nezindleko eziphusile. Ngoba uma izindleko ziphakeme, abantu abaningi ngeke bakwazi ukuthenga lezo zindlu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakalayo, kodwa uma zingahlelwanga kahle, zingaholela ezinkingeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abathintekayo, njengabaholi bendawo, izinkampani zokwakha, kanye nabantu bendawo, basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zikhula. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Uma izindlu zikhona, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle, baphile kahle, futhi bakhe imindeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi ophilayo udinga izindlu ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuxhaswa? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Abantu abaningi badinga ukuxhaswa ukuze bakwazi ukuthenga izindlu. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kube nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo. Uma abantu bengekho ezinhlelweni zokuxhaswa, bazoba nezinkinga zokuthola izindlu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uma abantu behlanganyela, bazokwazi ukuhlela kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu behlanganyela, bazokwazi ukuxhumana, futhi bazokwazi ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ubuchwepheshe? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize ekwakheni izindlu ezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize ekwakheni izindlu ezinhle, eziphumelelayo, nezokuhlala kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze sithole izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma izindlu zikhona, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle, baphile kahle, futhi bakhe imindeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuxhaswa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Abantu abaningi badinga ukuxhaswa ukuze bakwazi ukuthenga izindlu. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kube nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo. Uma abantu bengekho ezinhlelweni zokuxhaswa, bazoba nezinkinga zokuthola izindlu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Izinhlelo zokwakha zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze sithole izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma izindlu zikhona, abantu bazokwazi ukuhlala kahle, baphile kahle, futhi bakhe imindeni. Ngakho-ke, asihlanganyeleni ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, onezindlu ezinhle, eziphumelelayo, nezokuhlala kahle.
Umbiko: Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sesisebenzi Sikahulumeni (GEMS Government Employee Status Verification) Isingeniso Ukuqinisekisa isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubaluleke kakhulu emisebenzini yohulumeni, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphatheni nasekulethweni kwezinsizakalo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni, inika abathintekayo ithuba lokuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo. Umbiko lo uzobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokuvumelanisa isimo sesisebenzi, izinqubo zokugcina izinsiza zisebenza kahle, kanye nemiphumela ethintwayo kulabo ababhaliswe ku-GEMS. Ukwaziswa Ngomsebenzi Wokuhlola Isimo Sesisebenzi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo, abasebenzi bakahulumeni badinga ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhaliswe ku-GEMS bahlonishwa futhi banelungelo lokuthola izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile zokuhlola isimo, ukuhlola ubufakazi, nokuhlanganisa imininingwane ebalulekile. Izinyathelo Zokuhlola Isimo Okokuqala, abasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi banemininingwane yabo yokuxhumana efanele ku-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amagama, izibongo, izindawo zokuhlala, nezikhumbuzo ezisemthethweni. Ukuze kutholakale uhlu lwabasebenzi abavumelekile, kudinga ukuxhumana nezikhungo eziphethe imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa, okuhlanganisa izikhungo zezimali nezezemidlalo. Ukwengeza, ukuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane efanele kwamahhala kubalulekile. Abasebenzi kufanele baphendule kahle emibuzweni ethile eyenziwa ngesikhathi sokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusho izizathu zokuthola imvume, izifundo ezitholakele, kanye neminyango ehilelekile. Izindleko Nezinselelo Nokho, kunezindleko nezinselelo ezihambisana nalesi simo. Abasebenzi bangahlangabezana nezinselelo zokuthola ubufakazi obudingekayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokwelashwa zingase zibe phezulu, okwandisa ingcindezi kubasebenzi abakwanayo. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni ahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zokweseka, aqinise izinkampani ezithintekayo, futhi aguqule izinqubo ezintsha zokuhlola. Ukuhlola Imiphumela Ukuhlola imiphumela yokuhlola isimo sesisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqubo zisebenza ngokufanele. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka kwabathintekayo, ukuhlola izimo eziningi ezinomthelela, nokuhlanganisa iziphakamiso zokwenza ngcono izinqubo. Abasebenzi kumele bahlale bexhumana ne-GEMS ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zabo ziphumelele, futhi baphendule kahle ezidingweni zamanje. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubalulekile ekuphatheni nasekulethweni kwezinsizakalo ezisemthethweni. I-GEMS inika ithuba eliyigugu lokuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, kodwa kudinga ukugxila ekwenzeni izinqubo zihlale ziphumelelayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, uhulumeni, kanye nezisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo banikwa ithuba lokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngaleyo ndlela, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinkampanini zempilo kukhuthazwa, kwenze kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukujabulela izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba yingxenye ye-GEMS. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuhlola izinqubo, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni sithuthukiswa, futhi zonke izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze zithuthukise impilo yabantu. Lokhu kuzokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi kaHulumeni, kubaluleka ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ngiyabingelela, abangane! Ngifuna ukuthokozisa kakhulu ngalokhu okukhuluma ngakho: umshwalense wezempilo kazwelonke, noma i-NHI, njengoba sikwazi ukuwubiza. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi le nto ithinta impilo yethu sonke, kunjalo? Kukhona abantu abaningi abakhuluma ngakho, kwezinye izikhathi kushayisana nemibono, kodwa kulungile, sithumele kahle! Kukhona abantu abathi i-NHI izozama ukusisiza. Lokhu kutsho ukuthi sizothola usizo lwezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuthi sizokhokha malini. Khumbulani, siphila ezikhathini ezinzima, futhi ukusebenza kahle kwezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu. Futhi uma uMnyango Wezempilo ufuna ukwazisa ngezinguquko, kudinga ukuba sithathe isikhathi sokulalela, sizwe abanye abantu abahlanganyela imibono yabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kunabanye abantu abanye abathi i-NHI izobe ibangela izinkinga. Bajabulela ukuphikisa ukuthi lokho kungenzeka. Ngabe ube nakho lokho? Lokho bekukukhathaza? Ngoba abantu bathi, "Kutheni kufanele ngikhokhe imishwalense uma ngizokwazi ukuthola usizo mahhala?" Futhi lokhu kuyinqaba. Akukhona nje ukuthi babonisa ubuhlungu bempilo, kodwa baphinde bazibuze nezindleko. Ngabe ngithumele emathubeni ahlukene? Uthanda ukuhlola kahle? Futhi uma sizobe sikhuluma ngalezi zindaba, kufanele siyikhumbule le ndlela esiqhuba ngayo nokuthi yini esizama ukuyenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uyakwenza lokho okukhuluma. Uma ubuka impilo yabantu endaweni ethile, ungakubona ukuthi abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zomphakathi kahle, impilo yabo iyahlupheka. Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, futhi lokho akukhona okumele sikhohlwe. Futhi uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele siqonde ukuthi kuncike emhlabeni wethu wonke, hhayi kuphela kumuntu oyedwa noma inhlangano eyodwa. Ngabe ubona kuphi ukuthi umshwalense wezempilo ungandileka? Umphakathi usekela kanjani lesi qophelo? Kungani impilo ibalulekile kuwe? Umbono wakho ubalulekile, futhi ngiyafisa ukuwazi. Ngikhumbula isikhathi esedlule lapho sikhuluma ngempilo. Kuthiwani uma lengxenye ye-NHI ibhekelele izinkinga zempilo? Abanye abantu bahluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ngenxa yezizathu eziningi — ngabe kusho nokuthi behluleka ukuthola usizo lwezempilo? Lokhu, ngempela, kufanele kutshwe phansi. Futhi kumqondo wami, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole amaqhinga athile. I-NHI kufanele ibheke imiphumela ukuze ibone ukuthi bantu basheshe bashintsha kanjani impilo yabo nokuthi bathola kanjani usizo. Ngabe lokho kuhambisana nezidingo zethu? Ngabe umuntu, njengokuthi mina, uhola kanjani? Ngabe u-NHI uhambelana nezidingo zami? Lokhu kumele sibuze ngazo. Okungama-engxoxweni, kumayelana nokubambisana. Abantu bahlukahlukene banezidingo ezihlukahlukene. Uma sikhuluma ngendawo yomphakathi, kumele sibe nomdlandla ohlanganyela. Ngabe kudinga kube nemihlangano? Ukuthi abantu baphendule imibuzo, baphawule, ukusizakala kwezempilo? Ngabe sizoba nendlela yokubamba ngempela? Ngabe uma kudinga ukufaka iziphakamiso, sizoba thepha izinsuku zethu, bhalile imibono yenu. Kungabangani lezi zinsuku ezinjalo? Ungavula izinkanyezi emqondweni wakho. Ummoya wezempilo ulula, kodwa uphinde ube mningi. Ngabe sikhuluma ngokutholakala kwemithi? Ukutholakala kwezinsizakalo? Ngabe sikhumbula ukuhlonza izici? Izinkombandlela? Amandla ethu okuthola lokho okukhuluma. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngabe uthisha uphakamisa umbuzo? Ngabe lezi zifundo zingasisiza sisebenzise indlela eziphelela empilweni yethu? Yingakho kunemihlangano yezempilo, izinkulumo eziningi ukuze sithole izixazululo. Mina, ngithanda uma abantu bephakama baphendulela, kungaba yinkulumo ephilayo. Lokhu, kuzo zonke izinhlelo, iziphakamiso, nezibopho, akukhona ukuzama ukufaka izinkanyezi ezibhakabhakeni; thina siphila emhlabeni wamabhlogo. Ucwaningo, izindlela zempilo nezidingo zibakhumbuza bonke. Ngaphambi kokuphetha, ngithandeka ukukubuza: Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kuhlanganyela nezinkanyezi kuyasiza? Ngabe lokhu kuzoshintsha impilo yakho? Ukuthi umphakathi uphakamisa izimvo ezithile? Ngabe i-NHI iyazama ukuphendula izidingo zethu? Ngabe sizobe sisheshisa impilo yethu? Siyacela, yehlisa izithiyo, uvule izinkanyezi, khetha impilo enempilo! Ngiyabonga, futhi ngibheke phambili ekutholeni imibono yenu! Kulungile, ngiyabonga!
Impilo yaselokishini iyindawo enomoya opholile, imiphakathi ehlukahlukene, nempilo yom everyday. Uma ubheka izindawo ezinjengokwakho, uzothola abantu abahlukahlukene, ubuhlobo obuqinile, nemigubho eyakhayo. Ngempela, izinsuku zethu zihlala ziwubukhuni, kodwa zikho nezikhathi ezijabulisayo ezikwenza uqonde ukuthi impilo kufanele ithokoziswe, nokuthi abantu baphila kanjani ngezinselelo ezihlala zibakhona. Ukukhuluma ngezinsuku zethu, akudingi ukuba udlule emigwaqweni eyiqoqo yeTownship. Uhlobo lwethu lokuphila lubuhlungu futhi lujabulisa ngasikhathi sinye. Izinkanyezi lezi, izinsuku zikhanya kakhulu, ngenxa yokuhlangana kwabantu – ingane ibhalisela umphakathi. Ungahamba emigwaqweni, uzozwa izitshalo zebhungo, uzwa amaqanda amalangabi, nezinsizwa ezihlekisayo. Umoya uhlezi ukhulu, futhi abantu bahlangene. Izakhamizi zethu zihlala zikhuthaza ukuxhumana. Uhambo lokuphila kwethu luhlobo lokuxhumana. Uma ubona umama ephosa, usuku oluhle lokuvutshelwa ukunakekelwa, ungasondela – "Sawubona Mama, ubhalela ukudla kwasekhaya?" Lokhu kuxhunyaniswe nemikhuba yethu yokuhlala, singavuma ukujabulela ukuphila ngokubambisana. Ngeke kube nebhadi lokubambisana emiphakathini yethu. Ngabe ubani ongeke aphumelele ngaphandle kokubambisana? Ngokwesibonelo, uma kukhona umjikelezo wokuthengisa, izakhamizi ziya emkhumbini. Umfono nje ubonisa izinyathelo ezidingekayo, umoya walezo zinsuku uyancomeka. Njengoba sithokozisa ukudla nezinsiza, sizwa ukuthi sinamandla okupakisha imiphakathi yethu. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi impilo yaselokishini isebenza ngoba abantu basebenza ndawonye. Covid-19 inhlawulo ibangele ukuthi impilo yaselokishini ibonakale inezinhlawulo. Abantu bezwe bezwa, "Bayede! Ngabe lo mkhuba uzoba budlanga kuzo zonke izimboni?" Ukuze singaphezulu uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi. Besibona izinsiza zingalingani, kodwa abantu banesibindi, basiza omunye nomunye, basebenza ukuze bahlale bephila. Lokhu kwaqhubeka ngezikhathi ezinzima, sahlala silungile. Izinsiza zempilo, izifundazweni, imfundo, kuthinta ukuphila kwethu. Lokhu kuhlangana ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ngabe kukhona ezinye izinkinga ezenzakalayo ezingenza sibe nesibhedlela esingahamba phambili? Izinhlelo zempilo ziqhuba indlela yokuxhumana ezinhle, zize zikhumbule izinto eziphansi kuphela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imiphakathi yethu iyacwaninga ukuze ifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu lempilo. Isiko lethu lifana nesikhumbuzo esiyinqaba. Izekafozi, oduma, nemithendezi, lezi zinto zikhumbule imisebenzi yokuqala. Umkhuba wethu ungowokuhlanganisa – umgubho wezinsuku ezinkulu, ukuvota kwezokuphila. Konke lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvakasha kokuziqhenya; umcimbi wokuthokozisa nosuku oluhle. Uthando lutholakala lemali esiyishayayo emaphephandabeni, lokho kuhlobisa impilo, kuhamba kubona umehluko empilweni. Ukuphila kwethu kunomoya okhulayo. Sihlanganyela, siphila, sithokozisa, sihlanganyela. Ingabe akekho owayengeke aphile uma engathokozisa? Njengoba sikhumbula izinsuku eziphila, empilweni yaselokishini, sizobona ukuthi impilo inhlobonhlobo. Kukhona okuthandwa, okukhuluma, nokuvuthwa komphakathi, nanokhuma kokuya phambili, okuholela empilweni engcono. Ezemidlalo, izivakashi, kanye nezifundo zemisebenzi kuyafana. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, kudlalwa othandweni lwezinhlobo zakho, ikakhulukazi emizini eyahlukene. Basikushiya-kukhona umoya, leso simo esiqhubekayo esikwenza sazi izifundo phakathi kwezakhamizi. Uthando nolwazi olwadalwa emiphakathini, luhlala luheha amehlo amasha, lunothi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi impilo ifinyelela kumphakathi wonke. Ngakho lapho uhamba emigwaqweni, hamba nomoya, ubhalela impilo yaselokishini. Ibuye ibonakale iphelele, ihlangene, ikhuluma izindaba ezimnandi – njengenhlangano engokwenziwe ngabantu. Ubuye uthole umfowethu, ubaba, umama nabangani. Kuzinzima, kodwa ukuzimisela okuvamile kuhambisana nezinsuku zempilo yaselokishini. Uthando, ubumbano, kanye neqhaza lelo lidlulela phambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza impilo yaselokishini igcwale ukuphila. Ukwakha imiphakathi yethu, ukuze siphile kahle, sizokwenza umbono ophilayo. Hamba, ubuke, uthokozise; lokho kuwukuhlala kuhle impilo yaselokishini. Impilo yethu ikhuluma, futhi isephila—siyahlangana, siyaziswa, sikhumbule, futhi sizobusa!
Ezokwakhiwa Kwezindlu: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinselelo Nezindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zokuhlala, zikhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banokufinyelela ezindlini ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezihlobene nezokwakhiwa kwezindlu, okuhlanganisa izinselelo, izindlela zokuthuthukisa, kanye nemithetho ethinta le mikhakha. Isingeniso Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu ziqala ngokuhlonza izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izinga lokuhlala, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqhathaniswe nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala ezindlini ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ohulumeni, nabakhi bezindlu. Izinselelo Ezinzima Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemali yokwakha kuyinselelo enkulu. Izindleko zokwakha ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezindlini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, ezihlanganisa imithetho yokwakha, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakhiweni kwezindlu. Imithetho ethile ingavimbela abakhi ekwakheni izindlu ezidingekayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Okwesibili, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengamanzini, ugesi, nezokuthutha, kungaphazamisa izinhlelo zokwakha. Izindawo eziningi ezithuthukayo zidinga izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe ukuze zikwazi ukwakha izindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwezindlu. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokwakha. Okokuqala, ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokwakha kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabakhi, ohulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqonde izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Okwesibili, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ekwakheni izindlu kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko. Ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezihlakaniphile, bungasiza ekwakheni izindlu eziphumelelayo, ezisebenzisa amandla kancane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ngaphandle kokwandisa izindleko. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Ukubambisana komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakhiweni kwezindlu. Ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqonde izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabakhi, ohulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Isiphetho Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zokuhlala. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza ezisemqoka, kanye nemithetho ethinta le mikhakha. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokwakha, ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo, nokubambisana komphakathi. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala ezindlini ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo, futhi sithuthukise izindawo zokuhlala.

Abakhiqizi bezitshalo zokudla nezinsalela zamafutha baccepta kuphela amanani abawatholayo. Ngamanye amazwi, abakwazi ukuhoxisa ukukhuphuka kwezindleko kumkhiqizo wabo. Ngakho-ke, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuqala kwenza ukuhweba kube yingozi ekukhiqizeni izitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha. Phakathi kukaMeyi 2007 noMeyi 2008, amanani wemfertilizer ezweni lethu akhuphukile kakhulu. Isizathu esiyinhloko salokhu ukukhuphuka kokufuna kwemfertilizer emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa ukukhiqiza nokuhlinzeka kwemfertilizer akukhuphukanga. Ikakhulukazi, ukufunwa kwemfertilizer ezindaweni ezifana neNdiya neChina kukhuthaza lokhu. EChina, bafake intela enkulu ekuthumeleni kwemfertilizer, okukhuphule amanani wemfertilizer. Ithebula 1: Ukuthengiswa komhlaba jikelele. Ishadi 1: Amanani okwenziwa kwemfertilizer emhlabeni jikelele. Amanani wemfertilizer ezweni lethu akhuphukile kakhulu kusukela ngoMeyi 2007. Lokhu kukhuphuka kuboniswa kuTebula 2. Tebula 2: Amanani avamile wemfertilizer ezweni lethu. Izindleko zemfertilizer zenze u-25% wezindleko zokuqala zokutshala izitshalo noma izinsalela zamafutha, ngakho lokhu kukhuphuka kubalulekile kithi lapha eGrain SA. Lokhu kukhuphuka kufaka phakathi ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ngendlela ethola inzuzo engozini ephezulu. Imakethe ejwayelekile yezinto zokwakha ezisetshenziswa kwezolimo ikhuphukile kakhulu ngonyaka odlule. Ukufunwa (izindleko) zalawo maphilisi kudlule umthamo wokukhiqiza lezo zinto. Intela efakwe yiChina ekuthumeleni, kanye nenani eliphezulu le-crude oil, kunomthelela ekukhuphukeni kwamanani. Cishe u-99% wezinto ezidingekayo ukukhiqiza izinto zokwakha kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ziza phesheya, futhi isilinganiso esiphansi seRand uma siqhathaniswa nezinye izimali sikhuthaza ukukhuphuka kwamanani ezinto. Imakethe yezinto ezineGlyphosate (njengeRoundup) ikhuphukile ngo-150% kuya ku-240% ngonyaka odlule. Ngokuvamile, imakethe yalezi zinto ikhuphukile ngo-45%. Inani leBrent crude oil likhuphukile ngo-63.2% kusukela ngoMsombuluko 2007. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iRand yehlile ngo-9.6% uma siqhathaniswa nedola laseMelika. Imakethe ejwayelekile ye-diesel ezweni lethu ikhuphukile ngo-63% eGauteng - ukusuka ku-R6.21 nge-litre ngoMeyi 2007 kuya ku-R10.10 nge-litre ngoMeyi 2008 (Ishadi 2). Amanani aqhubeka ekhuphuka ngenyanga - uma sihlanganisa lokhu nezinye izindleko ezikhuphukayo, kusho ukuthi ukuhweba kube yingozi. Ishadi 2: Amanani omkhiqizo weBrent International crude oil kanye namaholo ejenerali edizeli. Iningi lemishini yezolimo esetshenziswa eNingizimu Afrika iza phesheya - futhi isilinganiso esiphansi seRand sinesithakazelo esikhulu uma kubhekwa ukukhuphuka kwamaholo nemishini. Tebula 3: Izinguquko zamaphesenti kumaholo emishini yezolimo unyaka nonyaka. Ubani ozothwala umthwalo wokukhuphuka kwamaholo okudla? Ingabe kuzofanele kube kubakhiqizi bezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha? Njengoba ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuqala zokutshala kuqhubeka, kuzoba nzima kubakhiqizi bezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ukukhiqiza ukudla esikhathini esizayo - lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma imakethe yezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ikhula ngokuhambisana nemakethe yezindleko. Uma sicabangela izindleko zokuqala zamanje kanye nemakethe yezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ezilindelekile, abalimi kuzodingeka baphathe kahle futhi bahlaziye ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukutshala. Abalimi kufanele futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bakhokha intengo efanelekile yokuqala - bheka kwezinye izindawo, ungase uthole amanani aphansi kwenye indawo, futhi futhi uhlole ukuthi imakethe ithi ini. Xhumana neGrain SA ukuze uthole amanani amasha futhi uzokwazi ukuzama ukuthola amanani aphansi. Kuzodingeka uhlele kahle futhi uhlaziye ukuthi iyiphi uhlobo lwezithelo ozoyitshala - kubalulekile ukufinyelela inzuzo ekugcineni uma ufuna ukuba ummeli ophumelelayo. Futhi khumbula ukuthi izindleko zokuqala zokutshala zizokhuphuka futhi ngaphambi kokuthi kufike isikhathi sokutshala esisha.
