Yini eyenzeka uma kuphulwa i-Protection Order? Uma umphenduli ephula i-Protection Order ngokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba noma ngemicabango njengoba kuchaziwe ekuqaleni kwalolu documet, ungafaka isikhalazo esiteshini samaphoyisa bese unikeza i-Warrant of Arrest kumaphoyisa azomgibisela umphenduli. Isinqumo sokusebenzisa i-Warrant of Arrest ngemuva kokuphulwa kwe-Order sikhulu sethu ngokuphelele. Ngemuva kokuboshwa, umphenduli uzobhekana nezinsolo zobugebengu futhi uzobekwa icala eNkantolo yezeMpi Yasekhaya ngokuphula i-Protection Order. Ungafaka isicelo sokuthi i-oda yakho ibuyiswe noma nini, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubonge ukuthi i-Order kufanele ibuyiswe noma cha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-Protection Order izobhekwa njengengasebenzi. Umthetho we-Domestic Violence Act 116 ka-1998 uvumela osizayo wezeMpi Yasekhaya noma ukuhlukunyezwa ukuthi afune i-Protection Order eNkantolo yeMagistrate ngokumelene nomhlukunyezwa. Inhloso yale Ndlela ukuhlinzeka osizayo ngemininingwane abayidingayo ukuze bafake isicelo se-Protection Order ngokuhambisana noMthetho wezeMpi Yasekhaya. Bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa bangaba osizayo futhi bangaba nabahlukunyezwa ezimweni zezeMpi Yasekhaya. Nokho, ngenhloso yale Ndlela, sigxile ekuhlukunyezweni kwabesifazane ngoba lokhu kuyinto evamile kakhulu. Umuntu obambisene nawe ngesithembiso somshado, ubudlelwano bendabuko, noma ubudlelwano obungajwayelekile, okubandakanya ubudlelwano bokuthandana obuqinile noma obungaqondakali, angaba ngumhlukunyezwa. Le ndaba ingabambezela kwenye usuku ukuze kubonakale enkantolo. Umphakathi uzokweseka noma ukukuhola kumuntu ozokwenza ukukubhalela impendulo. Ngosuku lokuhlolwa, umphakathi uzozama ukwenza isinqumo ngokusekelwe kuma-Affidavit abhalwe yizigaba zombili. Umphakathi ungacela omunye wenu noma bobabili ukuba bahlaziye ngezindaba ezithile. Umphakathi ungase uthathe isinqumo sokuvuma i-Order noma ukuyibuyisa futhi ungase ucele ukuthi ubufakazi bukhulunywe. Khumbula ukuthi ngokweMthetho, amaphoyisa kumele akusize nganoma iyiphi indlela echazwe kwi-Protection Order, ngokwesibonelo, ekutholeni izinto zakho, imibhalo yakho yokuzazisa, imibhalo yezingane noma izinto, njll. Uma uthola ukuthi amaphoyisa awasizi noma aphika ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwe-Order, ungabika lokhu kwi-Independent Police Investigative Directorate. Ingabe umphenduli uzoboshwa nge-Protection Order? Umphenduli ngeke aboshwe uma ethola i-Protection Order. Yini ukuphulwa kwe-Protection Order? Yini i-Contempt of Court? Lokhu kwenzeka uma umphenduli engahambisani ne-Order noma engaveli eNkantolo yezeMpi ukuze aphendule ezinsolweni ezimelene naye. Ungafaka kanjani isicelo se-Protection Order? Ikunikeza i-Order noma cha. Izinsiza abangakweluleka ngazo mayelana nalokhu zikhona ekuqaleni kwale Ndlela. Umphakathi uzokweseka ekugcwaliseni amafomu adingekayo nokuwafaka phambi komphakathi. Yikuphi ukwahlulela okufanele ngiye kukho? Yiya enkantolo eseduze nalapho uhlala noma usebenza khona. Uma uphumelelwe ukuba ushiye ikhaya lakho ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa futhi okwamanje uhlala kwenye indawo, ungaya enkantolo eseduze nalapho uhlala khona okwamanje. Yini ezokuthi i-Protection Order yesikhashana? I-Protection Order yesikhashana izocela umphenduli (umhlukunyezwa) ukuthi angakuhlukumezi ngendlela echazwe kwi-Affidavit yakho. Ezimweni ezinzima kakhulu, umphakathi ungathola ukuthi kubalulekile ukuvuma umphenduli ukuthi ahambe ekhaya ababelana ngalo noma ukuvikela ukuba angangeni ezindaweni ezithile zendawo ophila kuyo. Uma izingane zihlukunyezwa kulokhu, umphakathi ungase ube nesinqumo sokuthi umphenduli angaboni izingane nhlobo noma okwesikhashana kuphela. Umphakathi ungakwenza isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali oluphuthumayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma udinga ukufaka isicelo sezezimali zezokwelapha noma izindleko zokuhlala ezihlobene ngqo nokuhlukunyezwa, kufanele uhlinzeke ngobufakazi bezindleko ezitholiwe bese uceli umphakathi ukuthi ucabangele lesi sicelo. Ungase futhi ube nezinsolo zokuphila kwakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ukuze ucabange kahle ngohlobo oluthile lokuhlukunyezwa okwenziwa kuwe, umphakathi usebenzisa i-Affidavit owakwenze ngesikhathi ufaka isicelo sakho. Ngiyenzenjani nge-Temporary Protection Order? I-Temporary Protection Order kumele ihanjiswe kumphenduli (umhlukunyezwa) ngokushesha okukhulu. Awukwazi ukuya uqobo ukuhlinzeka umphenduli nge-Protection Order njengoba lokhu kungaba yindlela engalungile yokwenza inqubo yomthetho. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuhlinzeka nge-Temporary Protection Order kuyisibopho somunye umuntu esikhundleni sokuba kube umthetho othi amaphoyisa. Kumele uhlinzeke i-Temporary Protection Order ehhovisi le-Sheriff noma esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze nendlu noma indawo yokusebenza yomphenduli. Esiteshini samaphoyisa, uyacelwa ukuthi ukhumbule ukubhala phansi igama nokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yomphakathi ophakamisa i-Order. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukulandela i-Order esikhathini esizayo. Iziteshi zamaphoyisa eziningi zine-ofisa ethile yokuphatha izindaba zezeMpi Yasekhaya. Hlela namaphoyisa ukuze uthole i-Return of Service (Ubufakazi bokuhlinzeka). Lokhu kuyobufakazi bokuthi i-Protection Order ihanjiswe kumphenduli futhi ukuthi umuntu wamukela yona uqobo. Awukwazi期待 amaphoyisa ukuba athumele noma athumele i-Return of Service enkantolo ngoba lokhu kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi akufiki enkantolo ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyisa.
Uphuthu: Iphrofayela kaMnumzane Thulani Mthethwa Uphuthu, igama elihloniphekile elihambisana nezimpilo zabantu abaninzi, lihlala lishaya emqondweni wethu uma sikhuluma ngamasiko nezinkolelo zethu. Kulesi sihloko, sizogxila kumuntu ophawulekayo, uMnumzane Thulani Mthethwa, owayengumholi emphakathini, umfundisi, nomphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukwakhiwa Komuntu UMnumzane Thulani wazalelwa edolobheni elincane laseMpumalanga, lapho akhulela khona emndenini ophilayo ngezindlela zendabuko. Uthando lwakhe lwezinkolelo zamasiko lwasungulwa esebancane, lapho ababephila khona imikhuba yamaZulu, efaka phakathi imicimbi yokugubha izinkanyezi, izinkanyezi zamasiko, nezinkolelo ezijulile. UThulani wayehlala ethokozisa umndeni wakhe ngezindaba ezithokozisayo ezazihambisana nezimpilo zabantu bakubo. Imfundo Nezimpumelelo Ngemva kokuphothula isikole samabanga aphansi, uThulani waqhubeka nemfundo yakhe esikoleni samabanga aphezulu, lapho athola khona iziqu zezemfundo eziphakeme. Uthando lwakhe lokufunda lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe ezikoleni eziphezulu, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBachelor of Arts. UThulani wayengumfundi ophumelelayo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni athole izikhundla ezihloniphekile emkhakheni wezokuphatha. Umsebenzi Wokukhonza Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThulani waqala umsebenzi wakhe wokukhonza emphakathini. Waqala njengomfundisi, lapho afundisa khona izingane ezincane ngamasiko nezinkolelo zethu. UThulani wayengumfundisi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola udumo olukhulu ngenxa yokuzinikela kwakhe ekufundiseni. Uthando lwakhe lokufundisa lwamkhuthaza ukuba abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, lapho ahola khona imikhankaso yokukhuthaza imfundo, impilo, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Uphakathi Nezinkolelo Uphuthu, njengomholi, wayengumuntu ophawulekayo emiphakathini. UThulani wayehlala ebamba imicimbi yokuhlanganyela, efaka phakathi imikhosi yokugubha izinkanyezi, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bahloniphe izinkolelo zabo. UThulani wayephinde abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokuphila, izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ukwamukela Izinguquko Ngesikhathi sokushintsha kwezikhathi, uThulani wayehlale elungele ukwamukela izinguquko. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, futhi wathatha izinyathelo zokufundisa umphakathi wakhe ngezindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Waqala izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu abadala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi wakhe ube nekhono lokuxhumana, nokwandisa amathuba okuthola imfundo. Uphuthu Njengomholi Uphuthu, njengomholi, wayengumuntu onobuhlakani, onobuhlakani bokuhola abantu. UThulani wayehlala ethokozisa abanye, futhi wayengumuntu onothando, owayezama ukusiza abanye. Uthando lwakhe lokukhonza lwamkhuthaza ukuba abe nesandla ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. Isiphetho Uphuthu, uMnumzane Thulani Mthethwa, ungumuntu ophawulekayo emiphakathini, owayengumholi, umfundisi, nomphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinkolelo zamasiko, imfundo, nokukhonza kwenze waba yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. UThulani uhlala esikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngothando, ukuzinikela, nokuhola, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinkolelo luhlala lukhanya, futhi luhlala lukhumbuleka emiphakathini, njengomholi ophumelelayo.
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo Isingeniso Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga enkulu ethinta impilo yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude nezinsiza zempilo ezincane. I-Limpopo, enabantu abaningi abahlala ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezinsiza zempilo, okuhlanganisa ukungabi khona kodokotela abaneziqu ezifanele. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bahlupheke ngenxa yokungatholi usizo lwezempilo olufanele, okukhombisa ubungozi obukhulu empilweni yabo. Izizathu zokushoda kodokotela Izizathu eziholela ekushodeni kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo ziningi futhi zihluke-hluke. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemali yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo ezisemakhaya kubalulekile. Izikhungo zempilo ezincane azitholi uxhaso olwanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha odokotela abasha ukuba basebenze kulezi zindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, ezifana nezinsiza ezincane, izimo zokuhlala ezinzima, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuthutha, zenza kube nzima kubodokotela ukuhlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesibili, ukungabi khona kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthuthukisa imfundo yodokotela nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Abafundi abathanda ukuba odokotela bavame ukukhetha izikhungo ezinkulu ezisemadolobheni, lapho bezothola khona amathuba angcono okusebenza, izifundo ezithuthukile, kanye nezinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokushoda kodokotela ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, njengoba abanye bephuma ezindaweni ezincane befuna amathuba angcono. Imiphumela yokushoda kodokotela Imiphumela yokushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya ibonakala ngokucacile. Okokuqala, abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo bahlushwa yizinkinga zempilo eziningi, kodwa bengenakho ukufinyelela odokotela. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezithathelwana, ukungaphili kahle, kanye nokwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Abantu bahlala bephuthuma ezikhungweni zempilo ezikude, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo ngesikhathi esifanele. Okwesibili, ukushoda kodokotela kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zempilo. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya badinga ukuhamba izikhumbuzo eziningi ukuze bafinyelele odokotela, okwandisa izindleko zabo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye baphuthelwe yizinsiza ezibalulekile, okukhombisa ukuthi ukungabi khona kodokotela akuholeli kuphela ezinkingeni zempilo, kodwa futhi nasekutheni abantu bahlupheke ngokwezimali. Izixazululo ezingaba khona Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele anikeze uxhaso olukhulu ezikhungweni zempilo ezisemakhaya. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha odokotela abasha ukuba basebenze kulezi zindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imfundo yodokotela kufanele ziqinisiwe, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuthola amathuba okusebenza ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Okwesibili, kudingeka izinhlelo zokukhuthaza odokotela ukuba bahlale ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo ezinjengokuthola izikhala ezikhethekile, izikhwama zokuhlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthuka emsebenzini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubodokotela ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini. Isiphetho Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Izizathu eziholela ekushodeni kodokotela ziningi, futhi imiphumela yayo ibonakala ngokucacile empilweni yabantu. Ukuze le nkinga ixazululwe, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ezihlanganisa ukuxhaswa kwezikhungo zempilo, ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yodokotela, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza odokotela ukuba bahlale ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi eLimpopo, futhi sithuthukise izinga lokuphila kwabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo.
Ingxoxo Ngenkolo Yokufuya Izilwane Umhlanganyeli: UZola Khumalo, umnini wezifuyo odumile eNingizimu Afrika. Umlobeli: Themba Dlamini, umbhali ophathelene nezifundo zokufuya izilwane. UDlamini: Sanibonani Zola, ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuba nathi namuhla. Sifisa ukwazi kabanzi ngenkolo yakho yokufuya izilwane. Ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi yini eyenza uthande ukuhamba endleleni yokufuya? UKhumalo: Sanibonani, Themba. Ngiyabonga ngokumema. Ukufuya izilwane akusizi kuphela umndeni wami, kodwa kuyajabulisa futhi kuyinsiza empilweni yami. Ngikholelwa ukuthi izilwane zenzelwe ukuba zibe yingxenye yokuphila kwethu, futhi ufuyo luhlala luwumthombo omuhle wokuphila. UDlamini: Lokhu kuhle. Uma sikhuluma ngenkolo yokufuya, yimiphi imikhuba ethile oyisebenzisayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izilwane zakho zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu? UKhumalo: Ngiyaziqhenya ngokuhlonipha izilwane zami. Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele sikhulume futhi sithokozise izilwane ngaphandle kokuzilimaza. Ngisebenzisa imikhiqizo ye-organic futhi ngihlela izindawo ezinhle ezivikela izilwane ekulimaleni, okuthuthukisa impilo yazo. UDlamini: Lokhu kugxila ekuphathweni kahle kwezilwane kuyamangalisa. Ngabe kukhona izinselelo ozithola emkhakheni wokufuya? UKhumalo: Yebo, kunezinkinga eziningi. Omunye wazo izimo zezulu ezishintsha kakhulu, okuthinta ikhono lokufuya izilwane. Izinkinga zokudla nempilo yazo zikhona, futhi kufanele siqhubeke nokuvikela izilwane kumikhuhlane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwanda kwemakethe yokubiza kwemikhiqizo ye-organic kuveza izinkinga zokuhweba. UDlamini: Ngabe uthola ukwesekwa komphakathi neminyango ehambisana nalokhu? Lokhu kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu. UKhumalo: Impela, umphakathi ubalulekile. Ngithola ukwesekwa kwezinkampani ezithengisa imikhiqizo yokufuya izilwane, futhi nginomphakathi ovulekile. Samukela izinhlelo zokufundisa ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane nomphakathi jikelele bayakha izindlela zokufuya ezilwaneni ngendlela efanele. UDlamini: Lokhu kuhle! Ucabanga ukuthi kulungile ukufundisa abantwana ngalezi zindlela zokufuya? UKhumalo: Yebo, kubalulekile. Abantwana bethu bayizizukulwane ezizayo, futhi kufanele sibafundise ngalezi zinto. Sifundisa ngezindlela zokufuya ezihlonipha izilwane nemvelo ukuze bazazi izindawo zabo futhi bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihamba phambili. UDlamini: Kuhle! Ngabe unezinhlelo ezithile zokuqhubeka nebhizinisi lakho lokufuya, noma ungathanda ukwakha ibhizinisi elikhulu? UKhumalo: Ngiyafuna ukwenza ibhizinisi elikhulu, kodwa ngizogxila ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi lokhu kuxhumeke kahle nemiphakathi. Ngifuna ukuqhubekisela phambili izimiso zesimanje zokufuya, ngazi ukuthi izilwane zidinga zihlale zikhululeka. UDlamini: Lokhu kucacile! UZola, ungathanda yini ukuhamba esivivinyweni ezizokwenza umehluko emkhakheni wakho? UKhumalo: Yebo, ngikhuthaza abantu ukuba bazibandakanye nemiphakathi ngemisebenzi, uhlelo lokufunda i-workshops. Ubugebengu bomphakathi buyanda, ngakho sizodinga ukusiza nokwabelana ngolwazi. UDlamini: Lokhu kuhle! Siphinde sicele imibono eyengeziwe ukuze siqhubeke ngezinhlelo esizitholakale kuzo. UKhumalo: Ngiyavuma, Themba! Ngebhizinisi eliku-inthanethi, singenza izinhlelo ezithile zesimanje, futhi sikhuthaza ukukholwa ezikhathini ezinzima zokwakha izindawo ezifanele zezilwane. UDlamini: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Zola, ngalesi sikhathi esihle. Siyabonga ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho, futhi sikhuluma futhi ngekusasa lempilo yokufuya izilwane! UKhumalo: Ngiyabonga, Themba. Ngithemba ukubona kuhle konke abavuna abawufunayo, ikakhulukazi osomabhizinisi abasha!
Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu (GEMS third-party contractor access agreements) Isingeniso Namuhla, sizoxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile emkhakheni wezokwakha, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo. Le ndaba ibalulekile ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngama-‘third-party contractors’ noma osonkontileka besithathu, abenza imisebenzi ehlukahlukene emikhakheni ehlukene. Singakubona kanjani ukuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani ezizimele nezinkampani ezinkulu, futhi ikakhulukazi, izivumelwano zokufinyelela ezibhalwe phakathi kwazo. Uhlaka lwezivumelwano Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zifaka phakathi iziqondiso ezithile ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimfuneko zokuphepha, izinqubo zokusebenza, kanye nezimo ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ngabe izivumelwano zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi osonkontileka bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi bayayazi imithetho nemigomo yokusebenza kulezo zindawo. Ukwakhiwa kwezivumelwano Ukwakhiwa kwezivumelwano zokufinyelela kudinga ukuhlela okucophelela. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile. Uhlelo lokusebenza kufanele luhlanganise izidingo zomsebenzi, izinsuku zokusebenza, kanye nemigomo yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Kubalulekile ukuthi osonkontileka baqonde kahle ukuthi yini elindelekile kubo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kahle. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo Kubalulekile ukufaka izinsiza ezitholakalayo kumavumelwano. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi amathuluzi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze umsebenzi uphumelele. Izivumelwano kufanele zicacise ukuthi ubani ozohlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza, ukuze kungabikho ukungaqondi kahle phakathi kwabathintekayo. Izimo zokuphepha Ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngensiza, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zidinga ukubheka izimo zokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi, bekwazi ukusebenza endaweni ephephile. Izivumelwano kufanele zifake izinqubo zokuphepha, imihlahlandlela yokusebenza, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo uma kwenzeka ingozi. Ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuphumelela Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izivumelwano zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola ukusebenza kosonkontileka, ukuhlola izinga lezinsizakalo, kanye nokubuyekeza izivumelwano uma kudingeka. Ukuhlola njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba zibe yizinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinkampani Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwezivumelwano. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana okukhululekile phakathi kwabaphathi, osonkontileka, kanye nabasebenzi. Ukuxhumana kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga uma zenzeka. Ukubaluleka kwezivumelwano Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zibalulekile emkhakheni wezokwakha, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaziqonda kahle izimfuneko zomsebenzi, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, izivumelwano zifaka isisekelo sokusebenza okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa konke lokhu, singaqonda ukuthi izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqonda izimfuneko zomsebenzi, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ukuxhumana okuhle, izinqubo ezicacile, kanye nezinyathelo zokuphepha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yalezi zivumelwano. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi iyaphumelela.
Ikhomishini eyaziwa ngokuthi "Ikhomishini Yezilinganiso Zezivuno Zesizwe" (NCEC) ibikezela inani lezivuno ezizokwenzeka ngesikhathi esithile, ngamagama amanye, ibika abalimi ukuthi kuzoba nezivuno ezingakanani ezindaweni zokulima ngesikhathi esithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba lezi zilinganiso zixhumene kakhulu nenani lemali abalimi abazolithola uma bethengisa isivuno esithile ngesikhathi esithile. Yini ukubikezela kwezivuno (ukulinganisa)? I-Grain SA iqonda ukuthi lokhu kuyindaba edidayo kakhulu. Kumele sithathe isikhathi sokucabangela kahle nangokucacile ngomsebenzi wale khomishini ngaphambi kokuphakamisa noma ukusikisela izinguquko ezingase zibeke abalimi engozini. Khumbula ukuthi i-NCEC ibikezela inani lezivuno zonke, hhayi kuphela lokho okuthengiswa emakethe yezezimali. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abakwazi ukusho ngokuqinisekile ukuthi zingaki izindawo ezilimiwe, futhi abakwazi ukusho ukuthi kuzoba yini izivuno - konke lokhu kuyisiphakamiso kuphela. Ikhwalithi yalolu hlobo lokulinganisa ingalinganiswa ngekhwalithi yalabo abahlinzeka ngemininingwane. Ekugcineni, inani elikhulu lemininingwane likhulu ezandleni zabakhiqizi. Ngubani amalungu ale khomishini ye-CEC? Kukhona cishe abakhiqizi abangu-3,000 abahlanganyela futhi bathumela imininingwane yabo kule khomishini njalo ngenyanga. Izinhlangano ezifana ne-Spatial Intel ne-Geoterra Image zikhomba izindawo lapho izivuno ezithile zikhuliswa khona zisebenzisa "ama-satellites". I-IARC plant institute kanye ne-Small Grains Institute zisebenza nabalimi ukuze zibale izibalo. Abamele uhulumeni abavela eMnyangweni Wezolimo ezindaweni ezithile banikeza imininingwane mayelana nezimo zokukhiqiza. I-Agri Businesses yenze izilinganiso zezivuno ezindaweni ezisebenza kuzo. Bahlinzeka ngale mininingwane ku-CEC, kodwa izilinganiso zabo zezindawo ezilimiwe azisetshenziswa yi-CEC ukuze kutholakale ukulinganisa kwayo. I-Directorate yeMnyangweni Wezolimo esebenza nezibalo ithatha yonke imininingwane futhi ihlanganise inani eliphelele bese ikhokha ukulinganisa ngokusekelwe kumandla endawo. Uma i-CEC ivimbela ukwenza ukulinganisa, ngeke kube khona ukulinganisa kwesizwe. Impendulo ithi: cha, ngoba kuzoba nezinye izinhlangano ezizokwenza izilinganiso zazo, futhi ngeke kube sobala ukuthi iyiphi isilinganiso esiqondile. Ingabe i-CEC iyazimela noma ikwiwo abanye kule mboni abacindezela ukuba yenze lokho abafuna? Asikwazi ukusho ukuthi kungaba nomuntu oyedwa ozokwenza noma yini afuna noma aguqule indlela i-CEC esebenza ngayo; kuzoba nzima kakhulu ngoba kukhona abanye abahlola njalo ukuthi imininingwane ephumayo iyinqaba. Yini i-Grain SA ithi? Kumele kube nokulinganisa kwezindawo ezilimiwe kanye nezivuno ezikhululiwe ngokusekelwe kumandla endaweni, okunembile, futhi ngesikhathi ukuze imakethe yokudla ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Abakhiqizi, i-CEC, nabanye kule mboni kumele bahlanganyele ukuze bakwazi lokhu. Amalungu e-Grain SA nabo bonke abakhiqizi nabanye abakule msebenzi kumele bacindezelwe ukuba bahlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile njalo manje nangesikhathi esizayo.
Iphasiwedi yesikhashana ikhishwe kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abadinga ukuhamba ngokuphuthumayo futhi bengakwazi ukulinda ukuthi iphasiwedi ejwayelekile ikhishwe. Iphasiwedi yesikhashana iyasebenza isikhathi esingama-12 months. Uma ufaka isicelo sephasiwedi yesikhashana, kufanele futhi ufake isicelo sephasiwedi yesikhathi eside. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Isitatimende esifungwayo sidingeka uma iphasiwedi yakho yaseNingizimu Afrika ilahlekile noma ibhujiswe. Kungathatha ezinsukwini ezi-5 kuya kwezi-10 zebhizinisi.
Kwenzeka ukuthi ukuhluza kube kuhambisana kuzo zonke izindawo futhi lapho zihlangana. Kwenzeka ukuthi imithi eminingi iphume futhi iphume kakhulu ngaphansi kwalowo nozzle. Abahluzi kahle - kwezinye izindawo ukuhluza akuhlangani, kwezinye kuhambisana kakhulu. Lapho ukudla kukhiqizwa, ukuhluza kusetshenziselwa ukubulala izihlahla, ukubulala izilokazane, noma ukufaka umanyolo ezithelweni (umanyolo uyagxilwa ezithelweni). Kule ndatshana, sizobheka izingxenye ze-sprayer nokuthi zisebenza kanjani. Ukuhluza izihlahla kungenzeka ngaphambi kokutshala (uku-hluza ngaphambi kokuphuma), noma ngesikhathi lapho isihlahla sikhula ezindaweni (ngemva kokuphuma). Ngokufanayo, izilokazane nezinyoni zihluzwa - kwesinye isikhathi uzohluza umhlabathi ngemva kokutshala ukuze ubulale izilokazane ezingaba khona emhlabathini; noma uhluze izilokazane uma seziqhakazile (lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuhluza kokuxhumana lapho izilokazane zifa ngokushesha), noma ungahluza izitshalo futhi izilokazane zifa uma zidla esitshalen (lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukufaka umanyolo - izilokazane zifa uma zidla esitshalen, hhayi uma zixhumana ne-pesticide). Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-pesticide kufanele ihluzwe ngempela ukuze isebenze kahle. Akulungile ukuhluza i-pesticide encane kakhulu ngoba ingase ingasebenzi kahle, futhi akusizi ukuhluza i-pesticide eningi kakhulu ngoba ingazama futhi ibangele umonakalo ezitshalweni nasemakhaleni. Ngesikhathi sokuhluza, ama-droplet angaba makhulu noma amancane. Uma uhluza ama-droplet amakhulu, awazukuhamba kalula emoyeni, kodwa azohamba ngokushesha ezithelweni. Ama-droplet amancane angase angahambi ezithelweni ngokushesha kodwa angahamba emoyeni. Ngesikhathi sokuhluza ama-droplet amancane, uzosebenzisa uketshezi okuncane - uma uhluza ama-droplet amakhulu uzosebenzisa uketshezi okuningi. Ngokuvamile, ukuhluza ngama-droplet amancane kuzokh covering the sprayed area ngokwanele, kodwa uma usebenzisa ama-droplet amakhulu, indawo lapho uhluza khona ingase ingagcwaliseki ngokuphelele. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuhluza i-pesticide ngesikhathi esifanele - lapho izihlahla ziqala ukukhula noma lapho izilokazane zizobeka ingozi. Kubalulekile futhi ukulandela imiyalelo mayelana nesikhathi sosuku sokuhluza i-pesticide, futhi uqaphele izimo zezulu ezifana nokoma kwezithombo. Akusizi nhlobo uma ufaka i-pesticide uma izihlahla seziqedile ukwehla kwezinhlamvu zazo, ngoba zihlala phansi futhi zizokhula ngonyaka ozayo - futhi akusizi ukufaka i-pesticide uma izihlahla seziqhakazile futhi ziphikisana nezitshalo zakho zokudla namanzi. Ngokufanayo, akusizi ukufaka i-pesticide ezilokazeni uma zingabonakali. Kodwa akusizi ukufaka i-pesticide uma izilokazane seziqala ukudla ingxenye yokuvuna kwakho. Iziphi izinto ezisebenza kanjani? Ama-nozzles ahlukene aklanyelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezihlukene zokuhluza. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-nozzles futhi ziza ngezilinganiso ezahlukene. Ngokuvamile, iphethini efana ne-fan isetshenziswa lapho uhluza phezu komhlabathi, kuyilapho iphethini efana ne-cone isetshenziswa lapho uhluza phezu kwezithombo. Iphampu iyadingeka ukuze ikhiphe amanzi ethangini. Iphampu kumele ihlinzeke ngengcindezi ukuze i-nozzle ihlule kahle. Kukhona izingxenye ezahlukene lapho ama-sprayers axhunyiwe. Ama-sprayers angafakwa ezimotweni futhi angavulwa - lokhu kungaqhutshwa ngama-hydraulics noma ngesandla. Ekhanda le-sprayer, kukhona izingxenye ezingalungiswa ukuze zinciphise noma zikhuphuke ama-sprayers. Lokhu kulungiswa kuhluka kuma-sprayers ahlukene. Ezinye zingalungiswa ngama-hydraulics, kuyilapho ezinye zinezinqubo ze-bolt ezingashintsha isikhundla se-sprayer. Ama-tanks kufanele akhiwe ngezinto ezingaphuli, njenge-stainless steel, insimbi egaywe, noma i-fiberglass. Lezi zinto ngokuvamile aziphenduli ne-pesticide, ngakho-ke ngeke kube khona okushiywe ngemva kokusebenzisa ithangi. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi zonke izindawo lapho ithangi limbiwe zilungiswe ngokushesha ngoba lokhu kungadala ukuvuza futhi ithangi lizovunguza. Iphampu nazo zonke izingxenye zayo kufanele zisebenze kahle. Ngesikhathi kunezingxenye zokuhlanza (ama-gaskets, ama-O-rings, kanye nama-washers) akhiwe ngelastiki noma ngezinto ezenziwe, zingaguga noma zibe ne-deform uma iphampu ingasebenzi isikhathi eside noma uma ingabekwa kahle. Ezinye kemikhakha ethile ye-pesticides ingalimaza ama-seals, okwenza i-pesticide ivuze futhi iphampu ingasebenzi kahle. Ama-pumps amaningi ahlanzwa ngophethiloli, ngakho kubalulekile ukuhlola izinga le-oli njalo. Shintsha amabhayisikili amadala uma ubona ukuthi aphukile futhi avuza. Khumbula ukuthi amabhayisikili asetshenziselwa ukufaka i-pesticide yokulawulwa kwezilokazane awakwazi ukuhlanzwa ngokuphelele. Ingxenye yale pesticide izohlala ngaphakathi. Ngesikhathi sokulahla amabhayisikili amadala, qaphela ukuthi awaphindwanga ukuze asetshenziswe ngezinye izinjongo. Futhi, sebenzisa ama-filters uma usebenzisa i-sprayer. Lokhu kuzovimba uthuli nezinsalela ekungena kuma-nozzles, okungadala ukuthi i-sprayer ingasebenzi kahle. Ingcindezi yamanzi ohlelweni lokuhluza iboniswa kumagauge engcindezi. I-gauge ibonisa izinga lengcindezi ku-nozzle uma ixhunywe kumgibeli wengcindezi kanye nama-nozzles okuhluza. Ukushintsha ingcindezi kungadala ubungozi. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke ama-gauge asebenza kahle futhi alungiswe kahle. Kukhona ivali ohlelweni engakwazi ukunciphisa ingcindezi uma ufuna ukushintsha ingcindezi. Ingavulwa ukuze ilethe i-pesticide efanele kuma-nozzles athile, i-pesticide esele ibuyela ethangini, noma ivali ingavulwa ngokuphelele futhi i-pesticide ingena ohlelweni lonke lokuhluza. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuvimba ingxenye ye-pesticide ukuthi ihlale ezansi kwethangi uma imishini imisiwe. Kukhona futhi iphampu engakwazi ukuvala ezinye izindawo ze-sprayer uma ufuna ukuhluza indawo encane kakhulu noma ingavulwa ukuze ihluze indawo enkulu. Uma izindawo lapho amabhayisikili axhunyiwe zikhululekile noma ziphukiwe, zingadala ukuvuza kwe-pesticide. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izixhumi nezibambo ziqinile ngaphambi kokuqala ukwandisa ingcindezi nokuqala ukuphumpa. Uma uqala ukuphumpa (ukuhluza), hlola noma yiziphi ukuvuza. Hlola njalo ukuthi ama-nozzles avulekile. Ama-nozzles avinjiwe adala ukuhluza kwe-pesticide okweqile futhi iphethini yokuhluza ayihlanganisi zonke izindawo - lokhu kungadala ukuthi i-pesticide ingasebenzi kahle. Usayizi wezikhala zama-nozzles ungashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi uma i-pesticide egxilile ixutshwa namanzi - lokhu kudala ukuthi ama-nozzles aphume ngokushesha. Shintsha i-nozzle uma uthola ukuthi i-nozzle endala ihlula ngaphezu kuka-5 - 10% uma iqhathaniswa neyesisha.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe: Indlela Yokuthola Nokuqhubeka Nempumelelo Isingeniso Ekukhuleni komhlaba wendawo ye-inthanethi, abadali bokuqukethwe (content creators) bahlala bejabulile futhi befikile ezingeni eliphezulu lokwenza kahle. Abadali bokuqukethwe bangaqukethe abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengezithombe, ividiyo, umculo, nokubhala. Le njongo ihlola izinyathelo ezisemqoka okufanele zicatshangwe ukuze ube ngumkhiqizi wokuqukethwe ophumelelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Thola Umqondo Wakho Ukuze uqale, kubalulekile ukuthola umqondo ohehayo. Cabanga ngezinto ozithandayo, izifundo ozikhumbulayo, noma izihloko ozidumile. Lokhu kuzokwakhela isizinda esiqinile sokwabelana ngempilo yakho nempilo yabanye. Ungabheka izitayela ezidumile, kodwa ujabulele ukuveza izindlela zakho ezihlukile. Khumbula, umqondo omuhle uvame ukumangalisa futhi uncike ekuthandeni kwabantu. Isinyathelo 2: Yenza Ucwaningo Ngemuva kokuba nomqondo, qhubeka ngocwaningo. Bheka okuphathelene nomqondo wakho; funda kabanzi ngakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukhuthazeke futhi inhloso yakho ibe nocwaningo olunembile. Hlanganisa izinsiza ezinjengezincwadi, ama-blog, nezinye izikhungo ze-inthanethi ukuze uqonde ngabafundi, abalandeli, noma izilaleli ozobabamba. Isinyathelo 3: Qamba Isithombe Sakho Somkhiqizo Isithombe somkhiqizo sibalulekile kwabanye abadali bokuqukethwe. Lokhu kusho ukwakha isithombe esibonakalayo sokuhweba komkhiqizo wakho, ngokuhlanganisa izithombe ezinhle, izithombe ezikhangayo, nemibhalo ehlakaniphile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukwazi ukuheha abantu abaningi. Ungakwazi ukuthuthukisa isithombe somkhiqizo wakho ngokubeka kombono obuhlungu, okhombisa umkhiqizo wakho ngendlela ethakazelisayo. Isinyathelo 4: Dala Uqukethwe Nokukhulisa Ukubambisana Ngokuhamba phambili, sebenzisa izikhangiso, izithombe, nevidiyo ukuze uqale ukudala okuqukethwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi okukhuluma kusho okuthakazelisayo, kusemthethweni, futhi kuhlonipha izidingo zezilaleli zakho. Ukuze uthuthukise ukubambisana nabanye abadali, zama ukuxhumana, uvule izithangami, okanye ube nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo nemikhiqizo efana neyakho. Isinyathelo 5: Hlonipha Izilaleli Zakho Abadali bokuqukethwe kumele bahloniphe izilaleli zabo. Lokhu kuthetha ukuba uqonde izidingo, izintshisakalo, nezimpawu zabo. Hlanganisa imibono, iziphakamiso, nezimpendulo ukuze uqonde kangcono. Lokhu kuzokwakha ukwethembana, futhi kubathuthukisa abalandeli. Isinyathelo 6: Thuthukisa Imakethe Yakho Njengoba uhamba phambili, bheka ukuthi ungawenza kanjani amaqhinga akho awasebenzisayo ukuze ufinyelele izithameli eziningi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwenza amaqhinga ezokuxhumana online, ukulandela izithameli zakho ezicelweni, nokuzama izindlela ezintsha zokuthengisa. Hlonipha izimo zomphakathi nezezimali lapho uhlela inqubomgomo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uhlobo lwakho luthandwe kakhulu. Isinyathelo 7: Phikelela Ekuthuthukiseni Ngokuphumela, qhubeka ngenkuthalo, uhlale uzama ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda izinkomba ezintsha, ukwenza izivivinyo, nokulalela iziphakamiso zezithameli zakho. Ukuphikelela ekuthuthukiseni kuzokwenza ube sebenzisa amakhono wakho ukuze ufike ephepheni lempumelelo. Isinyathelo 8: Qonda Ukubaluleka Kokuphuma Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuba umuntu ophumelelayo akwazi ukuphuma. Njengoba usukhule, ungakha umphakathi ozokukhokhela, labhulile, futhi laphinde lukuhehise. Hamba ngezinyathelo ezahlukene zokuphepha, njengoba lokhu kuzokwenza ube ngumholi emkhakheni wakho. Isiphetho Ukuba abadali bokuqukethwe kukusiza ukuba ube nesimo sokuqhuba imikhankaso yokudala, udale izikhathi ezikhumbulekayo, futhi ukhuthaze abanye. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungafinyelela empumelelweni ynqayidule eza phezulu. Qhubeka, bumba izinga lakho, futhi ube ngumthombo wom inspiration kubantu abavela kuzo zonke izigaba zomhlaba. Hamba phambili, futhi okukhulumayo akukho nemigudu ezaqhamuka emndenini!
Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi: Ukuhlola Umthelela Wokuhlonishwa Emsebenzini Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho umnotho ushintsha njalo futhi izidingo zabasebenzi zikhula, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde ukubaluleka kokuhlonishwa nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa akukhona nje kuphela ukugqugquzela ukusebenza kahle, kodwa futhi kudala umoya ophilayo emsebenzini. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ezinzuzweni, izindlela, kanye nemiphumela yokuhlonishwa kwabasebenzi. Izizathu Zokuhlonishwa Kwabasebenzi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kungani ukunikela ngimiklomelo kubalulekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqashelwa kudala isimo sokusebenza esikhuthazayo, lapho abasebenzi bezizwa bebalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, njengoba abasebenzi bejabulela umsebenzi wabo futhi bezimisele ukufaka isandla empumelelweni yezinkampani zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiklomelo iyindlela yokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baphumelele, ikakhulukazi uma imiklomelo ibonisa imiphumela ethile, efana nokusebenza kahle, ubuholi, noma ukusiza abanye. Izinhlobo Zemiklomelo Imiklomelo ingahluka kakhulu, kusukela ezikhawulweni ezincane ezifana nezitifiketi zokuhlonishwa, kuya ezimfanelweni ezinkulu ezifana nemiklomelo yezezimali. Izinkampani zingasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlonipha abasebenzi, njengezinhlelo zokuhlonishwa ezisemthethweni, izinkomfa zokubungaza, noma izinhlelo zokuthola imiklomelo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuncintisana, lapho abasebenzi bezama ukufinyelela izinjongo ezithile ukuze bathole imiklomelo. Umthelela Wokuhlonishwa Emsebenzini Umthelela wokuhlonishwa kwabasebenzi ungabonakala ezindleleni eziningi. Abasebenzi abaqashelwayo bavame ukuba nekhono eliphezulu lokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza, okwenza izinkampani zibe nezinzuzo ezinkulu. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi, kuyilapho bejabulela ukusebenzisana ukuze bafinyelele izinjongo ezithile. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezivela emsebenzini. Izindlela Zokwenza Imiklomelo Ibe Nempumelelo Ukuze imiklomelo ibe nempumelelo, izinkampani kufanele ziqonde izidingo nezifiso zabasebenzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imiklomelo kufanele ihambisane nezinto ezibalulekile kubasebenzi, njengokukhula komsebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, noma ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo engcono. Izinkampani kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo efanele. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nokuhlonishwa Noma kunjalo, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuhlonishwa kwabasebenzi. Uma imiklomelo ingahambisani nezidingo zabasebenzi, kungaholela ekudumazekeni. Abasebenzi bangase bazizwe bengaqashelwa uma imiklomelo ingafaneleki. Okwesibili, uma imiklomelo ibonakala ingekho emthethweni, kungaholela ekunciphiseni isithakazelo sabasebenzi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi imiklomelo yazo iyahambisana nezindinganiso eziphezulu zokuhlonishwa. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umoya ophilayo emsebenzini. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabasebenzi, kanye nokukhula kwezinhlangano. Izinkampani ezibheka ukuhlinzeka ngimiklomelo efanele, ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzi, ziba nezinzuzo ezinkulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokuhlonipha abasebenzi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukufinyelela izinjongo ezinkulu, futhi kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yesikhathi eside.
Isitha esikhulu esinengxaki enkulu kubalimi abasafufusa izitshalo - ngakho-ke sihlose ukulwa nale ngxaki ngazo zonke amandla ethu kulo nyaka ozayo ukuze siyisuse! Ezindaweni eziningi lapho izitshalo zikhuliswa khona ehlobo, kube nokukhiqiza okuhle kulo nyaka. Kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi ukukhula kwezihlahla ezimbi kuyanda. Kube nezinkundla kulo nyaka lapho kungabonakali khona ukuthi izitshalo zokudla zakhuliswa noma ukuthi izihlahla ezimbi zafakwa. Izindleko eziphakeme nokulahleka kokukhiqiza akusikho okuthanda ukukucabanga. Eminyakeni edlule, kube kunzima ukuhweba ukuze uthole inzuzo - manje asikwazi ukukwazi kahle ukulahlekelwa izitshalo zokudla ezidingekayo. Ungazibuza ukuthi kungani sikhathazekile ngale ngxaki yezihlahla ezimbi ngoMsombuluko. Okwamanje, akusizo ukusiza ukuzama ukubulala izihlahla ezimbi ngoba ingozi isivele isunguliwe (ngaphandle kokuthi uvimbele izihlahla ezimbi ekukhuleni kwembewu zazo ezizokhula kulo nyaka ozayo). Nokho, uma sifuna ukulwa nesitha, kumele sazi ukuthi yisiphi isitha - awukwazi ukulwa nento ongayazi noma ongakaze uyibone. Le yisikhathi esihle sokuhamba ezinkundleni zakho futhi ubone ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi ezikhona - izinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi ezikhona njengamanje kungenzeka zibe khona kulo nyaka ozayo (mhlawumbe nasezinyangeni ezizayo uma ungathathi izinyathelo eziqinile zokuzisusa manje). Zithumele kanjani - zikhula embewini, ezimpandeni, ezikhwameni, noma ngenye indlela? Yisiphi isindlela esingakhetha ukusisebenzisa ukuphatha izihlahla ezimbi ezitshalo zethu (ukushintsha izinhlobo zez plants, ukulima ngamakhenikhali, noma ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali)? Nini kufanele silwe nalezi zinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi (kungenzeka kube ebusika ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukufaka izitshalo zonyaka ozayo)? Yiziphi amakhemikhali abhaliswe ukubulala izinhlobo ezithile zezihlahla ezimbi? Nini kufanele amakhemikhali afakwe emhlabathini noma ezihlahleni ezimbi? Uma uqoqe yonke imininingwane mayelana nezinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi ezibeka ingozi kuwe, uzimisele ukuziphatha ngendlela efanele kulo nyaka ozayo - zilungiselele ukuphumelela kulolu banga lokulwa nale sitha sezihlahla ezimbi!
Ezokushicilela - Ingxoxo noMshicileli Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnumzane Sipho Mthethwa, umshicileli ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokushicilela. U-Sipho ungumuntu oneminyaka engama-15 esebenza kulesi sikhala, futhi ubamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izincwadi ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezincwadini zezingane kuya ezincwadini ezinzima. Ngiyajabula ukukwazi, Sipho. Ungangichazela kancane ngempilo yakho njengomshicileli? U-Sipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Impilo yami njengomshicileli iqale ngenkathi ngisemncane, ngithanda ukufunda izincwadi. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami, ngathola ithuba lokusebenza emnyangweni wezokushicilela, futhi ngashintsha umbono wami wokuthi izincwadi zingaba kanjani. Ngiyazi ukuthi umshicileli akasishayeli kuphela, kodwa uphinde abe umxhumanisi phakathi kwababhali nabafundi. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukubaluleka kokushicilela Umbuzo: Kutheni ubona ukuthi ezokushicilela zibalulekile emiphakathini yethu? U-Sipho: Ezokushicilela zibalulekile ngoba zenza kube nokwabelana ngolwazi, izinkolelo, nezindaba. Zisiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukufunda, ukukhuluma, nokuxoxa. Ngaphandle kokushicilela, izincwadi eziningi ezibalulekile zingalahleka, futhi imicabango emisha ingavela. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezweni lethu, lapho sinesiko elicebile lokulandisa. Isigaba sesibili: Izinkinga ezibhekene nezokushicilela Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo ezinkulu obhekene nazo emkhakheni wezokushicilela? U-Sipho: Kunezinkinga eziningi, kodwa eyodwa enkulu yikhono lokufinyelela. Ababhali abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi namathuba okushicilela, ikakhulukazi abavela ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Futhi, izindleko zokushicilela zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima kubabhali abasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhona umncintiswano omkhulu, njengoba izincwadi zedijithali zikhula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokushicilela ukuze sikwazi ukuheha abafundi. Isigaba sesithathu: Ubuchwepheshe obusha Umbuzo: Ucabanga kanjani ngendima yobuchwepheshe ekushicileleni? U-Sipho: Ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula indlela esishicilela ngayo. Izincwadi zedijithali zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezincwadini, futhi zinciphisa izindleko. Lokhu kuvuleka amathuba amasha kubabhali, njengoba bengakwazi ukuzishicilela kalula. Nokho, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abufanele buphumelele kuphela uma sikhumbula ukubaluleka kokubhala okuhle. Akukhona konke okukhona ku-inthanethi okungamukelekile. Isigaba sesine: Ukuthuthukiswa kwababhali Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ababhali abasha? U-Sipho: Sisebenza ngokubambisana nababhali abasha, sibanikeza izifundo zokubhala, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezinsiza zokushicilela. Siphinde sibe nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa, lapho ababhali bengathola khona uxhaso lokushicilela izincwadi zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sithanda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwi lababhali abasha lizwa, futhi izincwadi zabo zifinyelela kubafundi. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ukubheka phambili Umbuzo: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lezokushicilela? U-Sipho: Ngibona ikusasa lezokushicilela linokukhanya. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona izindlela ezintsha zokufinyelela abafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izincwadi ezibhaliwe kahle zizohlala zibalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zishicilelwa kanjani. Umsebenzi wethu njengomshicileli uwukugcina lezi zincwadi zikhona, zifinyeleleke, futhi zibe nomthelela. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Sipho, ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi nathi. Ukukhuluma nawe kuveza kahle ukuthi ezokushicilela zibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, futhi zidinga ukwesekwa ukuze ziqhubeke nokukhula. Ngiyabonga futhi, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izincwadi eziningi ezinhle ezivela kubabhali abasha.
Umhlaba ongathuthukisiwe (ongavakashi) awunani uma uqhathaniswa nomhlaba othuthukisiwe onempahla. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindlu, izithiyo, nezindlela ezisemaphandleni akho zihlala zisesimweni esihle. Izakhiwo ezisemaphandleni kufanele zigcinwe kahle ukuze zisetshenziswe njalo manje nakusasa - ukuze kuqoqwe, kusebenza ngemikhiqizo, kucutshungulwa izinkomo, njll. Kungcono ukugcina ama-traktor nezinye izinsiza ngaphansi kwes roof, njengoba zizonakala uma zishiywe ngaphandle. "Izithiyo ezinhle, eziphilile zidalela ozakwethu abahlanganyela nawe," izilwane zakho kufanele zihlale ngaphakathi kwempahla yakho. Lapho ufaka, kubalulekile ukuthi izilwane zingangeni kulawo makhaya. Uhlelo (istrateji) lokudla izilwane ezindaweni ezithile ngezikhathi ezithile luqinisekisa ukuthi utshani obuthandwayo buyavikelwa futhi bunokuthi bukhule kabusha. Izindawo ezineziqukathi nezindawo lapho amanzi engeziwe angaphuma khona zibalulekile ukuvimbela ukwehla komhlabathi - ukwehla komhlabathi kudala ingozi engalungiseki, futhi kuwumthwalo wethu wonke ukuvikela nokugcina umhlaba ukuze izingane zethu zikwazi ukusebenzisa lowo mhlaba esikhathini esizayo ukuze zibe nokuphila okuhle. Izindlela zibalulekile uma uphatha ezolimo ngokwezimali - izinto ezifana nefertilizer kufanele zifike kahle emaphandleni, futhi ukuvuna kwethu kufanele kukwazi ukuhamba kahle lapho kuzothengiswa khona. Ukuphatha izindlela emapulazini kubalulekile ekulimaleni.
Umlando: Le ngqungquthela inikeza ithuba eliyingqayizivele kithi sonke lokho okukhuthaza ukuthi sithathe izinqumo futhi siqinisekise ukuthi singabantu abahloniphekile, futhi sonke singabamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezibonakalayo, sithuthukise amasu nezinhlelo ezizosisiza ukuthi sibe nempilo ehambisana neNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi (Esekela uMongameli uJacob Zuma). I-MRM iyinhlangano esekelwe ezizindeni ezingafanele ukusetshenziswa ngababusi abaphezulu kodwa ngumphakathi uqobo. Inhloso yayo ukuhlanganisa zonke izindaba eziphathelene nomphakathi ezihlobene nokuhlonipha. Ukuziphatha okuhle kubonakala kuzo zonke izinkolo, futhi abantu bafisa ukuguqula zonke izindlela ezingamukeleki emiphakathini nasezenzweni eziphazamisa izwe lethu. I-MRM izogcizelela umgomo wokuthi umuntu ngamunye kufanele anakekele ukuphila kwabanye, kuqala ekuqondeni ukuthi sikhululeka ezicindezelweni ze-apartheid futhi kufanele sikhululeke emiphumeleni ye-apartheid - uMongameli uThabo Mbeki. I-MRM iyisakhiwo sokukhuthaza, ukweseka, ukwazisa, nokuxhumanisa zonke izimvo ezivela emiphakathini ehlukene. Igxile emphakathini othembekile onemigomo emihle. Inhloso yale nhlangano ukuvivisa umoya we-Ubuntu/Botho, sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo kuhulumeni nasemphakathini. I-MRM izibophezele ekwakheni amazinga amahle okuziphatha ngokusekelwe kumthetho-sisekelo wezwe, "okuyisisekelo esichaza izimiso esizibophezele kuzo futhi sifisa zonke izizwe zomhlaba zikusibone." Ukuhlinzeka ngama-ithuba okucabangela okwenzeka esikhathini esedlule, okwamanje mayelana nezimiso eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuveza amasu nemizamo yokwakha izimiso zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi. Ukusiza ekwakheni inhlangano enkulu yokweseka uhulumeni nomphakathi emizamweni yokuhlela izinhlelo ezizovuselela imiphakathi ngokomoya. Ukwakha izinhlelo ezizinzile zokuvuselela izimiso. Ukwandisa imizamo kazwelonke yokukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngokuqinisekisa umphakathi onemigomo emihle, onakekelayo futhi ongenacala. Ukuqinisa izisekelo zenkululeko yethu esiyitholile ngokwakha umphakathi onemigomo emihle ogxile ekuziphatheni okuhle nasekuhlonipheni. Ukwethula uhlelo lwesizwe oluzolandelwa, luzoqala ngezinhlelo zesizwe nezasezifundazweni ngokubheka izilinganiso ezijwayelekile. Ukusebenzisa isu elivumela izincwadi neziteshi zomsakazo ukuba zibambe iqhaza ekusakazeni imibiko mayelana neMoral Regeneration Movement (MRM) kulo lonke izwe. Ukwakha uhlelo lokubambisana oluhlanganisa umphakathi wonke, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nohulumeni. Ukwakha amasu ajulile asebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene angahlinzeka ngesisombululo sokukhulula umphakathi ekucaleni. Ukwethulwa kwe-MRM kube umcimbi oyingqayizivele ngoba kuhlanganise abantu abangu-1,300 abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe, befika ngezindiza, ngebhasi, nasemotweni, befuna izindlela zokwakha umphakathi onobuntu. Kukhona abaphathiswa, abaphakanyisiwe, amalungu omphakathi, abaholi bezepolitiki, intsha, abaholi bezinkolo, izinhlangano ezizimele, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Baveze ukuzibophezela kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo lokwakha isisekelo sokuvuselelwa kwezomoya kuleli. Ukwethulwa kunikeze ithuba kubantu baleli zwe ukuba beme ndawonye ekuholeni nasekukhulumeni ngolimi olulodwa ngezindaba eziphathelene nokuvuselelwa kwezomoya. Umongameli we-MRM, uMnu. Smangaliswa Mkhatshwa, wamukela bonke ababekhona, kulandela inkulumo ethulwe ukuze kusekelwe uMongameli uMnu. Jacob Zuma, owavula ukwethulwa kwalesi sikhathi futhi kamuva waxolisa kuMnu. Thabo Mbeki, owayengumongameli owayesohambweni. UMnu. Cedric Mayson wanikeza isithombe esibanzi sezindaba ezibhekene nezwe ngaphansi kwesihloko: Yini inkinga? Ukubulala!, ukuhweba!, ukuhlukumeza!, izidakamizwa, ukucala, ubuhlanga, ubugebengu, ukwephulwa kwamalungelo abesifazane nezingane, umgaphezi phakathi kwabacebile nabampofu, ukungaboni ngasolinye kwezinkolo, ubuhlobo, ukucala kuhulumeni nomphakathi. Kungani konke lokhu kwenzeka kithi? Kufanele siqale ngokuhlola imbangela yokwenziwa kwale nkinga. Sihlangabezane nezinkinga ezivela eziphuthumayo, umthelela wokuphathwa kwangaphandle, kanye ne-apartheid, ethintile indlela esicabanga ngayo nendlela esibona ngayo izinto, isishiye nezinkinga ezinkulu. Futhi kukhona ukuphumelela okukhulu okwamanje. Inkululeko yenze kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo zokushintsha kusuka ekucindezelweni kwamandla angaphandle kuya esikweni ledemokhrasi elihambisana nezibopho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nendlela entsha yokubhekana nokuphila kusukela ngo-1994. Abaningi bayagxeka ezindaba, bavame ukugcizelela lokho esingakufuna ukuphucula: ukuhluleka kwamaphoyisa ukubamba abaphula umthetho, izinkantolo, kanye nalabo abaphethe ukugxila ezimisweni, noma bagxeke uhulumeni. Kodwa kufanele sizibuze. Ukuba nefa namandla kuhlambalaza umbono wezwe elisha lokuphatha ukucela amandla amaningi nokuzidela kulolu hlanga. Singabuyisela kanjani ukugxila kwethu ebantwini - uma imali iba unkulunkulu abaninzi abayikhonzile, uma izinqubo zethu zenza abaningi bahlupheke, futhi uma umoya wobuntu nezimiso ezinhle uqhubeka uncipha? Ithemba lethu lokuphendula kulezi zindaba likhulu. Izinhlanga eziningi zinezinselelo ezifanayo, kodwa izindlela esizibophezele kuzo ukuphendula kulezi zindaba zihluke. Amandla ethu ukuthi izinkolo zethu zibophezele ekuphileni okuhle kithi sonke. Izimpande zethu zisezikhaleni zethu lapho abantu behlala, besebenza, futhi bedlala ndawonye. Singakha izwe elisha ngokubambisana kwabantu bonke baleli zwe. Inhloso yethu ukuvivisa izinhlangano zethu nezakhiwo, hhayi ukuqala kabusha. Ukuvuselelwa kwezomoya yikho lapho sikhona. Lapho sikhona nasezinhlanganweni, futhi thina sonke, singaphendula kulezi zindaba ngokubhekana nezinselelo zokuvuselelwa kwezomoya. Iseshini yasekuseni yaholwa nguMnu. Tim Modise, owabamba iqhaza elikhulu, okwenziwa ngokucula, ukudansa, namazwi agxile empumelelweni nakho okunye esingakwenza. Lokhu kuqinisekisa izimiso esinazo ngaphakathi, isithunzi, kanye nobuhle bomoya wobuntu. Labo ababephuza izidakamizwa, abaphila ne-HIV, amaqembu omculo asejele, amaqembu edansa entsha - bonke babonisa ngesenzo nasezobuciko umoya wethemba lapho ukungathembeki kukhula, ukuqina lapho kunenkinga, ukuzibophezela lapho kubhekene nokwehla kwezomoya. Umbiko ofanayo wathunyelwa ngezinkulumo, lapho ababekhona bezwa imicabango nez
Ukubhukuda Ukubhukuda, njengomsebenzi ophilayo, ubonisa ubuhle bemvelo kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Le mikhuba, eyaziwa emhlabeni jikelele, ibalulekile hhayi kuphela empilweni yomuntu, kodwa futhi iyindlela yokuzijabulisa, yokuzivocavoca, kanye nokuxhumana nemvelo. Kulezi zinsuku, ukubhukuda sekuyinto ejwayelekile, kodwa uma sihamba emuva, sithola ukuthi le mikhuba inembali ende, ehlobene nezinkolo, amasiko, nezindlela zokuphila zabantu. Ekuqaleni, ukubhukuda kwaba yindlela yokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziseduze namanzi. Abantu bokuqala babebhukuda ukuze bathole ukudla, baphile, futhi bavikele izimpilo zabo. Izinkanyezi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu baphila ezindaweni eziningi ezihlukahlukene, kusukela emifuleni, olwandle, nasezikhukhulweni. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphinde bakhulelwe emakhaya amasha, benza izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokubhukuda, ezazihambisana nezimo zabo. Namuhla, ukubhukuda sekuyinto ethokozisayo, ethokozisa abantu abaningi. Izikhungo zokubhukuda, izikole, nezinhlelo zokuzivocavoca zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphume baphumelele. Ukubhukuda akusizi kuphela ekwakheni umzimba onempilo, kodwa futhi kukhulisa umoya, kunciphisa ingcindezi, futhi kukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Izifundo zokubhukuda zikhona ezikoleni, zifundisa izingane izindlela zokuphila eziphusile, zikhuthaza ukuzethemba, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabafundi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokubhukuda ziye zashintsha. Kukhona izindlela eziningi zokubhukuda, ezifana nokubhukuda okukhululekile, okukhuluma, nokubhukuda kwezemidlalo. Lokhu kuhluka kwenza ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukukhetha indlela efanele kubo, ngokuhambisana nezifiso zabo. Ukubhukuda okukhululekile kuvumela abantu ukuba bazizwe bekhululekile, bejabule, futhi bephumule. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho abantu bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubhukuda kudinga izinsiza ezithile, ezifana nezimpahla zokubhukuda, izikhumbuzo, nezindawo zokubhukuda. Izindawo zokubhukuda zihluke kakhulu, kusukela ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni, ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, kuya olwandle. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukukhetha indawo efanele, ngokuhambisana nezidingo zabo. Izindawo ezinhle zokubhukuda zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphume, bazijabulele, futhi bakhe izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ukubhukuda akukhona nje kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi kudinga ukucabangela. Ukuze umuntu akwazi ukubhukuda kahle, kudingeka aqonde izindlela zokuphepha, izimo zamanzi, nezimo zomzimba. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila kahle, futhi bahlala bephephile. Izifundo zokuphepha emanzini zibalulekile, zifundisa abantu ukuthi bazi kahle izingozi ezingase zibe khona, futhi bazilungiselele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubhukuda kudinga umoya wokubambisana. Abantu bavame ukubhukuda ndawonye, bejabulela isikhathi esihle, bexoxa, futhi bekwazi ukusiza omunye nomunye. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi kukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Ukubhukuda ndawonye kuyindlela enhle yokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi kukhuthaza umphakathi. Ekugcineni, ukubhukuda kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Kukhuthaza impilo enempilo, kunciphisa ingcindezi, futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baphume, bazijabulele, futhi bakhuthaze ukubhukuda. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bakhe izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ukubhukuda akusizi kuphela emzimbeni, kodwa futhi emoyeni, futhi kuyindlela yokuphila engcono. Ngakho, masiphume, sihamba emanzini, sizijabulise, futhi sithokozise impilo yethu. Ukubhukuda akusizi kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuxhumana, nokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Hamba phambili, bhukuda, futhi ujabulele ubuhle bemvelo!
Bonke abafikayo bazibeka engcupheni ngokungena ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Wonke umuntu ongena ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala kumele aziphathe ngendlela ephephile futhi enhlonipho, ebheka abanye abantu abasebenzisa leli thafa. Kungase kubizwe imali ethile uma ufuna ukwenza imisebenzi ethile noma uma ufuna kuphela ukungena; kulokhu, uzonikezwa imvume ehlukile. Ukungena kuvunyelwe phakathi kuka-06:00 no-18:00 ezinsukwini ezithile, ngaphandle uma uvunyelwe ukuba uhambe, uhambe ebusuku, noma ezinye imisebenzi. Imicimbi ehambisana nokuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokomoya ingabanjwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo. Izikhangiso nezimpawu kumele zihlonishwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Umphakathi awuvunyelwe ukungena ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala noma kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yayo, futhi ukuvutha kwezikhali ezindaweni ezikhethiwe akuvunyelwe ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsindo noma noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungaphazamisa abanye abasebenzisi bezindawo zezulu zikamasipala noma izilwane zasendle akuvunyelwe. Ukuvutha kwezikhali akuvunyelwe, ngaphandle ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo. Izikhali kumele zingashiywa zinganakekelwa, futhi kumele zicinywe ngemuva kokusetshenziswa. Akuvunyelwe ukungcolisa, noma ukususa udoti ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala, ngaphandle uma kudedelwa ezinkombeni ezikhethiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa umngcele, udonga, izimpawu, noma noma yini enye ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuphazamisa imisebenzi yokuphatha ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala, futhi akekho ovunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo lapho abasebenzi benza khona umsebenzi noma lapho impahla yezulu isetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa, noma ukwenza uphawu oluthile emadwaleni, ezihlahleni, noma kunoma yimaphi amahlamvu ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Noma ubani otholakala ehamba noma edoba, ebulala, noma eqoqe izilwane, izinyoni, izinyoka, izinkanyezi, noma ezinye izilwane zasendle ngaphandle kwemvume noma enye imvume uphula umthetho. Ukudla izilwane ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala akuvunyelwe. Izibhamu, amaqanda, izikhali zokudoba, nezikhali zokuhlasela azivunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala ngaphandle kwemvume yokudoba. Izinja, izilwane zasendlini, nezinye izilwane azivunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala, ngaphandle kwamahhashi uma kuvunyelwe ukuhamba ezindleleni zamahhashi. Ukuhamba nokuqhuba akuvunyelwe ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo. Ukuhamba, uma kuvunyelwe, kumele kwenziwe kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo uma imali efanele ikhokhelwe. Ukusebenzisa noma ukuhamba ngeziqhamo, izindiza ezinamandla, ukuhamba ngezindiza, ama-ultralights, amabhola, nezindiza akuvunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Ukusebenzisa noma ukuphatha izinto ezivuthayo akuvunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Akukho mthwalo noma izindleko ezizothwalwa nguhulumeni ngenxa yokulimala kwempahla yabavakashi ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala ezivela ezinyathelweni ezithathwe nguhulumeni noma ezenziwa egameni likamasipala noma ngenxa yanoma yisiphi isizathu, ngaphandle uma lokho kulimala kwenzeka ngenxa yokunganaki kwabasebenzi bakamasipala ngesikhathi benza imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Abavakashi bezindawo zezulu zikamasipala bazoba nemithwalo yokulimala okwenziwe ezinsizeni zezulu kanye nezinye impahla zikamasipala okungase kube ngenxa yezinyathelo zabo. Ezinye izimo, izimali, noma imvume zingadingeka emicimbini ethile, ezindaweni ezithile, nasezikhathini ezithile (buka izixhumanisi nezigaba zemicimbi).
