Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya: Izinselelo Nezixazululo Ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo eNingizimu Afrika. Imiphakathi emakhaya ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, njengokuntuleka kwezinsiza, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokufinyelela ezinsizweni ezisemqoka ezifana nezikole nezibhedlela. Nokho, entuthukweni, kubalulekile ukugxila ekwakheni amathuba, hhayi kuphela ekuxazululeni izinkinga. Okokuqala, sithinta impilo nezezimali zabantu basemakhaya. Abaningi bahlala ezindaweni ezinzile, kodwa bahlupheka ukungabi nezinsiza ezithile. Imizamo yokuthuthukisa izinsiza, njengokwakha izindawo zokulima, ibalulekile. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo—ukufundisa abantu indlela yokulima ngendlela efanele—kungasiza ekwenzeni izimpilo zabo zibe ngcono, futhi lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa kwezempilo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yomsebenzi kubalulekile. Ukuze siqhubeke nokwakha izindawo zasemakhaya, kudinga imisebenzi eyengeziwe. Lokhu kungafezwa ngezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukutshala izimali ezinhlelweni zokwakha, njengokwakha izikole ezintsha nezikhungo zokwelapha, kuzokwakha amathuba emsebenzini, okuzosiza imiphakathi emakhaya. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezolimo nezokwakha imikhiqizo emisha kungasiza abantu emiphakathini. Ukwakha izimboni ezincane, okwaziwa njengama-micro enterprises, kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhweba kahle, abantu bazothola imisebenzi, okuzosiza umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inqubomgomo yokwakha izikhungo zemfundo ezithuthukile ibalulekile. Inkqubo efanele yokufundisa ezindaweni zasemakhaya ingavula amathuba amasha kumakhono, okuzosiza abantu bahlomule ngezifundo nezinsiza zokusebenza. Izikhungo zemfundo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihambisana nezidingo zemakethe. Nokho, izinkinga ezihlobene nezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya azilula. Kunezithiyo eziningi, njengezinkinga zemali, ubuchwepheshe, nezinsiza. Abaholi bemiphakathi badinga ukusebenzisana nezinhlangano ezizwelonke ukuze bathole uxhaso. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezizimele nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuxhasa izindawo zasemakhaya. Kubalulekile ukugcina ubumbano phakathi kwabantu ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa. Inhloso akuwona nje ukuvuselela umnotho, kodwa futhi ukuqinisa ubumbano phakathi kwezizinda nezikole. Umphakathi onobumbano uthuthukisa ukuzwakala kwezimo ezithuthukayo. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya akukhona kuphela ukuphendula izinkinga, kodwa kudinga indlela ehlangene yokuhlela. Abantu basemakhaya badinga imithombo yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, futhi lokhu kudinga umzamo owodwa kulabo abahola kulezi zinhlelo. Uma sithatha izinyathelo, sigxile ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza nezinhlelo, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kulezi zinkalo, kubalulekile ukwakha amathuba, ukudala imithombo emisha, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemfundo efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlela imiphakathi emakhaya futhi kudaleke ithuba lokuphila okungcono. Kulesi simo esinzima, lezi zinhlelo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini, ziqinise umnotho, futhi zishintshe izimpilo zabantu basemakhaya. Isikhathi sesifiso sokwaziswa nezenzo ezinhle, ukuze sithuthukise, sidlule emnothweni ophumelelayo, ngenkathi sithandazela umphakathi ophindaphindayo.
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okulungele Abasebenzisi Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zethu zibe nezakhiwo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi sikhulume ngokuqinile ngendaba yokwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngezindawo zokusebenza, kodwa futhi nakwezokwelapha, ezemfundo, nezokungcebeleka. Ngakho-ke, ngizokhuluma ngalezi zikhungo, ngikhuluma ngempela ngendaba yokuthi kungani kufanele zibe nezakhiwo ezithuthukisiwe. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izikhungo ezikahle zenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Cabanga ngendawo yokwelapha, lapho umuntu efika khona enezinkinga zempilo. Uma izikhungo zihlala zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele zibe nezindawo ezikahle zokuhlala, ezokwelapha, nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo zokuhlala ezikhululekile, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezilula. Uma umuntu efika endaweni yokwelapha, akufanele abhekane nezithiyo eziningi, kodwa kufanele akwazi ukuthola usizo ngokushesha. Ngokufanayo, ezikoleni, izikhungo zokufunda kufanele zibe nezakhiwo ezikahle ezikhuthaza abafundi. Izifundo zidinga izindawo ezikhuthazayo, ezivumela abafundi ukuba bakhulume, babelane ngemicabango, futhi basebenze ndawonye. Uma izikhungo zifaka izindawo zokufunda ezivulekile, ezikahle, nezithokozisayo, abafundi bazoba nethuba elingcono lokuphumelela. Lokhu akukhulumi nje ngendawo yokuhlala, kodwa futhi nakwezinsiza ezifanele, ezifana nezincwadi, ubuchwepheshe, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zokungcebeleka nazo zidinga ukwakheka okulungele abasebenzisi. Cabanga ngendawo yokuphumula, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona. Uma izikhungo zikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele zibe nezindawo ezikahle zokuphumula, ezivumela abantu ukuba baphumule, baphumule, futhi bajabulele isikhathi sabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo zokudlela, izindawo zokuzijabulisa, nezindawo zokuzivocavoca. Uma izikhungo zikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele zibe nezindawo ezithokozisayo, ezikhuthazayo, nezivumela abantu ukuba baphile kahle. Kodwa-ke, akukhona kuphela ukwakheka kwezikhungo, kodwa futhi nezindlela zokuxhumana. Izikhungo kufanele zibe nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, amawebhusayithi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Uma izikhungo zikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele zibe nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo, baphendule imibuzo, futhi bathole ulwazi oludingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezindlela zokuhlola nokuthuthukisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izifundo, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Uma izikhungo zikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ekugcineni, ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi akukhulumi nje ngempilo, kodwa futhi nakwezinye izindawo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zibe nezakhiwo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo zokusebenza, ezokwelapha, ezemfundo, nezokungcebeleka. Uma izikhungo zikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele zibe nezakhiwo ezithuthukisiwe, ezikhuthazayo, nezivumela abantu ukuba baphile kahle. Ngakho-ke, ngiyavuma ukuthi ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi kubalulekile. Lokhu akukhulumi nje ngempilo, kodwa futhi nakwezinye izindawo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zibe nezakhiwo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhulume ngempela ngendaba yokwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila kahle.
Izinkundla Zokuxhumana Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Wezokuxhumana Umxhumanisi: Sawubona, Mnu. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Namuhla sithanda ukuxoxa ngendaba yezinkundla zokuxhumana. Ngabe ungachaza kabanzi ukuthi yini ezinkundleni zokuxhumana? Mnu. Mthembu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga kakhulu ngokungimema. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zingamapulatifomu akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nezithombe phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla ezidumile njenge-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, ne-WhatsApp. Lezi zinkundla zenza kube lula ukuba abantu baxhumane, babelane ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubalulekile impela. Kodwa, yini eyenza izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe nempumelelo enkulu? Mnu. Mthembu: Okokuqala, izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukufinyelela abantu abaningi. Ngaphakathi kwesikhashana, ungathumela umlayezo kumuntu ophakathi kwezinye izinkanyezi zomhlaba. Okwesibili, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi. Abantu bangabelana ngezinto ezibalulekile, izindaba, nemicabango yabo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bezwakalisa imibono yabo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile ezivela ekusebenziseni izinkundla zokuxhumana? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, ziningi izinzuzo. Okokuqala, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi. Abantu bangathola izindaba ezisheshayo, izifundo, nezinsiza ezahlukahlukene. Okwesibili, zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala kude. Okwesithathu, izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi, ukwazisa abantu ngezenzakalo, nokwakha amabhizinisi. Umxhumanisi: Kodwa, kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, akunjalo? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, izinkundla zokuxhumana zinezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga zokuphepha. Abantu bavame ukuvulela izinkundla zabo abantu abangafanele, okungaholela ekutheni ulwazi lwabo lungabi luphephile. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga zokudlwengulwa kolwazi. Abanye abantu bangasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze baphumeze izinhlelo zabo ezingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu babe neziqondiso ezicacile zokuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zinkundla. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungakhipha izeluleko ezithile zokuthi abantu bangazisebenzisa kanjani izinkundla zokuxhumana ngendlela efanele? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngokuqinisekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezinto abazisharelayo. Kufanele bahloniphe abanye, bahloniphe izimfihlo, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinto ezinhle nezimbi. Okwesibili, kufanele babe neziqondiso ezicacile zokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa amagama okufihla, ukuqapha izilungiselelo zabo, kanye nokungavuli izinkundla zabo kubantu abangabazi. Okwesithathu, abantu kufanele babe nesikhathi sokuphumula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ukuphuma kancane kungasiza ekugcineni ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo emhlabeni wangempela. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana zizothuthuka kanjani esikhathini esizayo? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngicabanga ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana zizoba nethuba lokwandisa izici ezintsha, njengokuxhumana okungcono, izici zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobona ukuvela kwezinkundla ezisha ezizokwazi ukuxhumana ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene, njengezithombe eziphilayo, imifanekiso ye-3D, nokunye okuningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokuxoxa. Ngikufisela inhlanhla ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazothola ulwazi oluwusizo kule ngxoxo.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa: Ukuqonda Nokubhekana Nalesi Sifo Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukugula kwezidakamizwa, kuyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Le nkinga ibonakala ikhulayo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nayo. Izizathu Zokusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Izizathu zokusebenzisa izidakamizwa zihluke kakhulu. Abanye abantu bangase basebenzise izidakamizwa ukuze balwe nezinkinga zokucindezeleka, ukungabi nankinga, noma ukungabi nempilo. Abanye bangase bazame ukufuna injabulo noma ukuzizwa bephila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi, izimo zokuphila, kanye nezimo zomndeni nazo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokutholakala kalula kwezidakamizwa, zenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngalesi sifo. Imiphumela Yokusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Imiphumela yokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ingaba yingozi kakhulu. Ngaphandle kokulimala emzimbeni, izidakamizwa zingaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, noma izinkinga zokucabanga. Abantu abathinteka kule nkinga bangase baphinde bahlupheke ezimweni zomphakathi, njengokulahlekelwa umsebenzi, ukwehluleka ezikoleni, noma ukulahlekelwa ubudlelwano. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu babe nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni yabo. Ukwazi Nokuqonda Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kubalulekile ukufunda ngempela ngezidakamizwa ezithile, izimpawu zokusebenzisa, kanye nezindlela zokwelapha. Izidakamizwa zihlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, njengezidakamizwa ezithuthukisa umqondo, ezithuthukisa imizwa, nezidakamizwa ezithinta umzimba. Ukuqonda lezi zigaba kungasiza abantu ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi yini abangayithola uma besebenzisa izidakamizwa. Izindlela Zokubhekana Nalesi Sifo Ukubhekana nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kudinga imizamo eminingi. Ukuze abantu baphume kule nkinga, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwelashwa kwezingqondo, izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, kanye nezifundo zokuphila. Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekwakheni indawo ephephile, lapho abantu bezokwazi khona ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Umphakathi unendima ebalulekile ekulweni nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bonke, kuhlanganise nezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi, basebenzisane. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kungasiza abantu ukuba bazi kahle izingozi zokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kuyinkinga ebalulekile edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuqonda izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nayo kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukusiza abantu abathintekayo. Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngalesi sifo, singenza umphakathi wethu ube indawo engcono, lapho abantu bengahamba phambili bezokwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, ngaphandle kokuthinteka kwezidakamizwa. Ukubambisana komphakathi, ukufundisa, nokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile ekulweni nale nkinga. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo (GEMS claim reimbursements) Ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo, ikakhulukazi ngaphansi kweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kuyisihloko esithokozisayo esithinta izigidi zabantu abasebenza kuhulumeni. Le nqubo ibalulekile, njengoba ihlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, futhi baphinde bahlomule ngokwezimali. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nale nqubo, ezidinga ukuxoxwa ngazo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amalungelo akhe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iGEMS iyinhlangano eyenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo ezihlobene nezokwelapha. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabule uma bezwa ukuthi bangathola imali yabo emuva ngemva kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Nokho, inqubo yokubuyiselwa kwemali ayilula, futhi lokhu kudala ukungabaza phakathi kwabantu abaningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezihambisana nokubuyiselwa kwemali yizithiyo ezikhona ekufakweni kwezicelo. Abasebenzi bavame ukubhekana nezinkinga eziningi, njengokungaqondi kahle izinqubo, izidingo ezithile zokufaka izicelo, kanye nezikhathi ezide zokulinda. Lokhu kudala ukucindezeleka, futhi abanye bangase baphinde baphumele ngaphandle kwemali abayifanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibheke lezi zinkinga futhi ithuthukise izinqubo zayo ukuze kube lula kubasebenzi ukufaka izicelo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi izinqubo zeGEMS zidinga ukuba ziqinise ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuphela abantu abafanele abathola ukubuyiselwa kwemali. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuvinjelwe ubugebengu bokufaka izicelo ezingekho emthethweni, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali. Nokho, lokhu akufanele kube yisizathu sokwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abaqotho abafuna ukusiza imindeni yabo. Kumele kube khona ibhalansi phakathi kokuvikela izinsiza zeGEMS nokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kolwazi olucacile nokufundiswa kubasebenzi mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kuGEMS nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekutheni abantu bangakwazi kanjani ukufaka izicelo. Abasebenzi abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni bangasebenzisi amalungelo abo. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke indlela yokukhuthaza ukufundiswa nokwaziswa ukuze abasebenzi bazi kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Ngokubheka lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa inqubo yokubuyiselwa kwemali. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo. Uma iGEMS ingakwazi ukwenza lokhu, izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bayo, futhi ibasize ekutholeni imali abayifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi iGEMS ibambisane nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zayo zihlala zikhona ezandleni zabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola impendulo ezivela kubasebenzi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukubambisana phakathi kweGEMS nezinyunyana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezithile ezithinta izinkinga ezikhona. Ekugcineni, ukubuyiselwa kwemali yezimangalo ngaphansi kweGEMS kuyinqubo ebalulekile, kodwa kudinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinzuzo ezidingekayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, iGEMS kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, nokubambisana nezinyunyana. Uma lezi zinto zingaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthuthuka okukhulu ekubuyiselweni kwemali, futhi lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abasebenzi bakahulumeni baphile impilo engcono.
Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye (GEMS spouse/partner beneficiary status) Kwakukhona indaba emnandi eMshwati, lapho uThandi, intombazane ethokozisayo, kwakuhamba kahle empilweni. UThandi wayenothando olukhulu lukaSizwe, umyeni wakhe, owamthandele futhi wamkhombisa ubuqotho. Bobabili babehlangene emshadweni obuphilayo, bejabulile futhi benethemba elikhulu ngekusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngamalungelo abantu abashadile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo. Kwakukhuluma ngohlelo lokuxhasa abantu abashadile, iGEMS, elinikezela ngokukhululeka kumalungu alo nasempendulweni zezempilo. UThandi, njengokuphila kwabanye, wayefuna ukuqiniseka ukuthi uSizwe uzothola ukwelashwa okufanele uma kudingeka. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi uvakashele umtapo wezincwadi zasendaweni, afuna ukuthola ulwazi oluthe xaxa ngalesi simo. Wafunda izincwadi eziningi nemibhalo edlalayo, ethola ukuthi amalungelo omshado adinga ukuvikelwa, futhi umenzi wezempilo ungena ngezimo ezihlukahlukene. Wazama ukuqonda ukuthi uma kwenzeka ungozi, uSizwe uzobe edinga ukukhathalelwa ngendlela efanele. Njengoba edlulela ezincwadini, uThandi waqaphela ukuthi uma umyeni wakhe engahlala ethola umvuzo wokwelashwa, kumele kwenziwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokubhalisa uSizwe njengomhlomuli. Wakhumbula izinsuku zokuqala zomshado wabo, lapho babebonisa izithakazelo zendlela efanele yokuphila ngempumelelo. UThandi wakhumbula izingxoxo zabo ezihamba phambili, bemane beqhubeka beshayela impilo yabo. Njengoba ubungcweti bumsiza, uThandi wanquma ukufika emsebenzini wezempilo owawuphakathi. Wafaka isicelo sokubhalisela uGEMS, wabhalela wonke amaphepha adingekayo, wakhumbula ukuhweba ngezinsuku ezinzima, ngaphezu kwamathuba amasha. UThandi wabhalisela uSizwe njengomhlomuli, eqiniseka ukuthi baze phambili futhi balungiselelwe impilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola impendulo ephezulu – umyeni wakhe ubhalisiwe futhi uyinqaba emgibeni wezempilo. Ukukhathalela kwabo kwazisa umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabo, njengoba uThandi ethola ithuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili zeGEMS. Lokhu kwadala umfundaze omkhulu futhi kwavusa ithemba elisha empilweni yabo. UThandi noSizwe baqala ukuhlola izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, bezama ukufunda kabanzi ngemfundo yezeMpilo. Umoya wokwabelana otholakala phakathi kwabo wawuvuselela intokozo yempilo yabo, ngenkathi behlanganyela izinkumbulo ezimnandi kabi ezinkumbulweni. Baziqhenya ngekuhlonipha imithetho yezempilo, futhi kahle ukuthi umfanekiso wabo umhlomuli ulawulwa ngendlela efanele. UThandi wanikeza izeluleko zokugcina nezizathu ezinoshintsho, eziyisisekelo ezibalulekile zomshado. Wafundisa uSizwe ukuthi bangasoze bavele bakhathalele impilo, kodwa kufanele bahloniphe izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Ngalesi sikhathi, waphinde waphawula ukuthi ubudlelwano babo bujolile kumkhakha wezempilo, kanti ngokuzayo, bazothola abesifazane abengeziwe ababonisa ukuthi bangabhalisani. Kukhona imiphumela ethokozisayo emlandweni wabo, njengoba behlangana nezinye izimpilo. Njengoba bezuza izifundo ezithokozisayo, baqedela izinzuzo zeGEMS. Ngalesi sikhathi, uThandi noSizwe babona ngezinsuku ezizayo, behlanganyela izifungo zempilo. Bagcina befunda nomhlomuli, behamba phambili empilweni yabo enothando, behlakanipha kabusha lesi simo. UThandi wayekujabulele ukujabulisa uSizwe, njengoba bobabili benza izinto ezithokozisiwe. UThandi uthi, "Uhlale uthinga emkhakheni wezempilo, siphephe umhlomuli wethu ukuze sibe nempilo engcono." Ngexesha elithile, uThandi noSizwe bathola lezi zifundo ezimnandi. Bafunda ukuthi umhlomuli wayesebenza nomphakathi, besekela abanye abantu bezempilo. Babejabulile ngendlela ababehlanganyela ngayo, futhi bejabulile ekudaleni umphakathi odlalayo ezindabeni zabo. Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye, sakhula sathi "Yebo, sinamalungelo." Ngaleyo ndlela, umshado wabantu ababili kwaba nenqubekela phambili. Baphendula umphakathi, bahlonipha imithetho yezempilo, futhi bafunda izixazululo ezithuthukisa impilo emhlabeni jikelele. UThandi noSizwe babezenza oqeqeshiwe futhi bagcina bezilungiselela ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kwaba umkhuba omuhle kubo, umthombo wokuzimisela nabahola phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi noSizwe bahlala bejabulile empilweni yabo, bexoxa ngothando, bephila kahle neGEMS. Bafisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi ukuqonda izici ezisemqoka, okwakukhona umhlomuli njengenye indlela yokwakha izimpilo ezithembekile nezibungengelekileyo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kulungile futhi kujabulisa ukuba umhlomuli, uthando lwasendaweni, kuzo zonke lezi zinkumbulo ezinjalo. UThandi noSizwe, baqhubeka kahle, besebenzisa lezi zifundo ezivela emlandweni wabo, ukuze bakhe isitayela esiqinile emiphakathini, benze imihlaba emisha, futhi bathuthukise izimpilo zabo. Impilo yabo yahamba njengesipho, kanti umhlomuli wayekudala imiphumela emihle, emenza axhase abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umshado wabo waba uphila nokukhanya, uphumelele, uthokozise, futhi uqhubeke ukwenza impilo yabo ibalulekile. UThandi noSizwe bahlala bejabulile, bephila kahle neGEMS, bephinde bathokozisa abanye abantu ngothando lwabo. Lokhu kwaba ngumkhiqizo wobudlelwane njengoba bephinda bejula naleso sifiso sokuphila izimpilo ezizwakalayo futhi ezingenamkhawulo.
Uhlelo lokuhlela umthetho ophathelene nekhwalithi yomoya ngenhloso yokuvikela nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eRiphabhulikhi, kubhekiswe ekudingeni ukuthuthukiswa endaweni; ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo nezindinganiso zizwe ezilawula ukuqashelwa kwekhwalithi yomoya; ukugcina nokulawula izenzo ezithathwe yizo zonke izikhungo zikamasipala; ezinhlelweni ezithile zokuphathwa kwekhwalithi yomoya; nezindaba eziphathelene nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho. Kulesi sikhungo, igama noma isigaba esikhiqizwe egameni noma esigabeni -1 sinezincazelo ezifanayo ngaphandle uma umongo ukhombisa ukuthi kukhona incazelo ehlukile ehleliwe. a ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika, b ukunciphisa ubungozi empilweni yabantu nasemvelweni futhi kubhekiswe ekudingeni ukuthuthukiswa endaweni. a ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zikamasipala ezisebenzisayo lo mthetho, kufanele zibe nezifiso zokuvikela nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika; futhi b sebenzisa lo mthetho ngendlela ezothuthukisa intuthuko nokuphumelela kwalawo malungelo. a ezingeni likamasipala kazwelonke nasezikhungweni zikamasipala; ngokufanayo b ezikhungweni zikamasipala, ngokuhambisana nesigaba-146 seMthethosisekelo. Ukuhumusha nokuphumeza lo mthetho kufanele kuqondiswe yisisekelo sokuphathwa kwemvelo esakhelwe esigabeni-2 seMthethosisekelo Sokuphathwa Kwezemvelo. c nomthetho wamasipala, umthetho ophansi owakhishwa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho uzokwamukelwa. Ngokwenzela ukuhlinzeka kahle ekuphumezeni isigaba-2b, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba-146 seMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele ahlinzeke kwiNhlangano Yezifunda zonke izinqubomgomo eziphansi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho ezithinta izifunda ukuze zamukelwe. g enye indaba ebhekwa nguNgqongqoshe njengokufanele ukuze kufezwe inhloso yalolu mthetho. d ukunciphisa ezingeni elingalimazi imikhiqizo engase ibe yingozi emoyeni, kanye nokunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kokukhishwa ezikhungweni zokukhiqiza. Isisekelo sikamasipala kufanele silandele isisekelo sezwe ekuphatheni amandla noma ekwenzeni imisebenzi, ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho noma ezinye izinqubomgomo ezilawula ukugcina ikhwalithi yomoya. d kufanele kuphinde kubuyekezwe nguNgqongqoshe ngezikhathi ezithile ezingadluli eminyakeni emihlanu. a Ngaphambi kokushicilela isisekelo sezwe, noma ukwenza izinguquko esisekelweni, uNgqongqoshe kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba-53 no-54. b Indima a ayidingi ukulandela uma isisekelo sishintshwa kancane. imikhiqizo evela emthonjeni owaziwayo, engase ingachazeki kahle futhi ikhiqizwe ngezinsiza ezihambayo. umsebenzi owenziwa yizifunda ekuphumezeni lo mthetho. ukusebenza kwezikhungo zikamasipala mayelana nezinhlelo zokugcina ikhwalithi yomoya kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina ikhwalithi yomoya ezindaweni ezibekwe phambili. ukufinyelela komphakathi kulwazi. i ikhwalithi yomoya ihlobene nezinga elamukelekayo noma ukugxila kwalolo polluter okukhiqizwa emoyeni; noma ii imikhiqizo evela endaweni echazwe, engase ingachazeki kahle futhi ivela kwizinsiza ezihambayo. Izigaba-73a, 4, 5, no-6 ngokuhambisana nezinguquko ezidingekayo umongo zisebenza kumazwi ashicilelwe kuGazethi ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba. mayelana nemikhiqizo evela endaweni echazwe, engase ingachazeki kahle noma ivela kwizinsiza ezihambayo kuleyo sifunda noma kwenye indawo eyakhiwe yalesi sifunda. Uma izindinganiso zizwe zisungulwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 9 mayelana nanoma iyiphi impawu noma inhlanganisela ebonwe, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda angashintsha noma iyiphi isindinganiso sezwe ngaphandle kokuphinda uqiniseke isindinganiso sesifunda noma indawo eyakhiwe yalesi sifunda edlula isindinganiso sezwe. a Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba, noma ukushintsha isaziso, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba-53 no-54. b Akudingeki ukulandela indima-a uma isaziso sishintshwa kancane. b mayelana nanoma iyiphi impawu noma inhlanganisela, engase isungule izindinganiso zendawo ngemikhiqizo evela endaweni echazwe, engase ingachazeki kahle noma ikhiqizwe ngezinsiza ezihambayo endaweni yamasipala. noma-10 mayelana nanoma iyiphi impawu noma inhlanganisela yayo, umasipala akakwazi ukuyishintsha ngaphandle kokusungula izindinganiso zawo ezizokwenza umasipala wonke noma ingxenye ethile yawo. Ngaphambi kokuba umasipala wamukele umthetho wangaphakathi okukhulunywe ngawo esigabeni-, kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana neSahluko 4 seMthetho Wamasipala. a Izindinganiso zeqhwalithi yomoya ezizolandela, b Indlela izindinganiso nezikhungo zikamasipala okufanele zibike ngalezi zindinganiso. Umbiko: Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okufanele Abasebenzisi Isingeniso Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okufanele abasebenzisi kubalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi engcono, enobulungiswa. Ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle, kumele zibe nezici ezithuthukisa ukuxhumana, ukufinyeleka, nokwaneliseka kwabavakashi. Lo mbiko uzogxila ekuchazeni imiqondo ebalulekile ethinta ukufinyeleleka kwezikhungo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasemaphandlwana, abantu abadala, nabantu abakhubazekile. Ukwakhiwa Kokuhambisana Nezidingo Zabasebenzisi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ziqonde kahle izidingo zabavakashi. Lokhu kufanele kubonakale ekwakhiweni kwezindawo zokuhlala, izikhungo zokusebenzela, nezindawo zokuphumula. Izikhungo ezihlonipha izifiso zomphakathi ziba nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze zifeze izidingo zawo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kokuhambisana nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi, kanye nezinsiza ezivula amathuba kubo bonke. Ukwenziwa Kwezikhungo Ukuphila Izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izindawo ziyafinyeleleka kubantu abakhubazekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele, ezifana namathayili okuphakela, izishova, kanye nezindawo zokuhambisa ezilungiselelwe kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile emkhakheni wezokwelapha, imfundo, nezokuthengisa. Kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ezikhuthaza abantu bonke ukuba basebenzise izikhungo ngendlela enempilo. Ubuchwepheshe Bokuxhumana Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha izikhungo ezikhangayo. Ukuxhumana nge-inthanethi nezinsiza zedijithali kuzokwandisa ukufinyeleleka kwezikhungo. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezikhethekile ezivumela abantu ukuthola ulwazi, bahlale bexhumene, futhi benze izicelo online kalula. Uhlelo lokuxhumana oluchumile lwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwamakhasimende nezikhungo. Izikhungo Zokuxhumana Zokwelulekwa Izikhungo ezinkulu kufanele ziqinise ukuxhumana phakathi kwazo. Umqondo wokubambisana udinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nemibono ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko ahlukene ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi kunezinto ezithokozisayo. Izingxoxo eziphumelelayo nezikhala zokukhuluma kulungisa izikhungo, okwenza abantu babe neqhaza ekwakheni izikhungo ezinokuthula. Umsebenzi Wokwehlukana Izinsizakalo ezitholakala ezikhungweni zidinga ukugcina izinsiza ezithakazelisayo. Ngakho-ke, izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zishintsha izinsiza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zifinyelela ezidingweni zabavakashi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqhubekela phambili kwezobuchwepheshe, amakhono, nokuhamba phambili kwemiphumela. Ukwakhiwa Kwamathuba Okukhula Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okufanele abasebenzisi kufanele kube nengqikithi yokwabelana, ukwandisa amathuba okukhula, nemikhuba emihle yokuphila. Izikhungo ezilungisiwe zinikela ngemihlangano, izinkulumo, namaphrojekthi okuqwashisa abantu ngempilo, okuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kuzodala imikhakha yezenhlalakahle evumelana, enesibopho. Isiphetho Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okufanele abasebenzisi akuyona nje inzuzo, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokubhekelwa kwabantu. Ngendlela ezisheshayo nezicacile, singakha izikhungo eziphephile, ezisebenziseka kalula, nezihambisana nezidingo. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu, omasipala, nezikhungo zomphakathi badlale indima ebalulekile ekwakheni izikhungo ezihlanganyela. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwakha umphakathi ogculisayo, ogculisayo, futhi ovulekile kwabanye.
Inhloso yeKomidi ukuhlanganisa nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kweMthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi ka-1997. Umsebenzi oyinhloko weKomidi ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kwiNgqongqoshe ngezindaba ezithinta lo Mthetho, ukwenza izincomo kwiNgqongqoshe mayelana nezikhombisi-ndlela ezithile iNgqongqoshe engazikhupha ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ukuhlela imisebenzi eyenziwa izikhungo zokufaka izincwadi, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ezikhungweni zokufaka izincwadi ngezindaba ezithinta lo Mthetho, nokwakha amaqembu amancane noma amaqembu okusebenza lapho kudingeka khona ukuze kuhlolwe imisebenzi ethinta ukwenzeka kwalo Mthetho. Ababhalisile kumele temsilise abathintekayo abanezinga eliphezulu emkhakheni wezincwadi futhi bazuze kulwazi; umkhakha wokushicilela; ukuphathwa, ezimali, nezindaba zemakethe; kanye/noma ulwazi kanye/noma uthando lwezincwadi ezishicilelwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukuphakamisela umuntu ukuba abe seKomidini Lokufaka Izincwadi kumele aqedele futhi athumele ifomu elisemthethweni lokuphakamisela kwiSikhungo Sezobuciko Nezamasiko. A: Incwadi enikeza amagama aphelele kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana yomphakamiseli, echaza iziqu zabo zokuphakanyiswa ngokusekelwe kumazinga akhuluma ngawo ngenhla, kanye namagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabantu abathathu abaphakanyisiwe. B: Incwadi yokwamukela ukuphakanyiswa ebhalwe ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe. a Isihloko namagama aphelele b Ulwazi lwezempilo olufanele c Inhlanga d Imininingwane yokuxhumana ephelele e Inombolo yokukhomba f Izigaba zamakhono g Ukubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni, amabhodi njll. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi lokhu akukhona ukukhangisa kwemisebenzi. Imali yokukhokhela amalungu eKomidi Lokufaka Izincwadi izokwenziwa kuphela ngokubuyiselwa kwezindleko zokuhamba nezokuhlala uma behlanganyela emihlanganweni kabili ngonyaka (ePitoli noma kwezinye izindawo).
uWinston Churchill: Umholi Ongaguquki Otwala Izenzakalo Zomlando UWinston Churchill uwumuntu ongakaze wamukeleka ngisho ezindleleni eziningi, emlandweni wesikhathi sakhe. Lokhu kwenze ukuthi abhekelele izinselelo ezinzima kakhulu emhlabeni. Njengomholi, inhloso yakhe yayihamba phambili, eqinisa umqondo wokuthi amandla amakhulu angavuselelwa ngezimiso nezimilo eziqinile. Ukuze siqonde kahle lo mholi, kufanele sihlole izici zempilo yakhe, izinqumo zakhe, nemiphumela yazo empilweni yomhlaba. UChurchill wazalelwa eLondon ngo-1874, esuka emndenini othembekile ngaphakathi kombuso. Ukhulelwa phakathi kwezimo zengqondo ezithile, ethola imfundo engaphezulu e-Harrow ne-Oxford. Umehluko wakhe kwenzeka ngesikhathi esebenza njengosokhulumeli, lapho athola khona ithuba lokukhanyisa umbono wakhe nobuholi. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayeka ukugxila kuphela ezindabeni zomphakathi, kodwa waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yomhlaba wonke. Ngokukhula kokungqubuzana kwezombusazwe, uChurchill waba yisithombe esiqinile sokulwa nodlame. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, waba ngumbangi ophumelelayo, futhi lokhu kwakuhambisana nokuhlonishwa kwamasiko ahlukahlukene. Imibono yakhe ibonakala izimbali, inika umbono obalulekile wokuthi ubuholi bethu bukhulu kale uthando olukhangelekile. Uhlanganise izwi elichazayo, elikhombisa umoya wokunqoba emizweni yomhlaba wonke. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi, uChurchill waba nesandla ekwakheni i-United Nations, lapho abona khona ukuthi ukufuna ukuthula kumele kube ngaphambili kwezenzo ezikhalipheleyo. Ubelokhu edlula imingcele yokuphila kwangempela, ehlangabezana nezimpi eziningi. Imizamo yakhe yokwakha uthando phakathi kwezizwe yenza umthelela omkhulu emoyeni wesikhathi sakhe, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwezixazululo ezilungile. Ngokwenyama, ukwakhiwa komqondo okhulayo, uChurchill wenza uqhubekela phambili emphakathini. Ubuye waba nesandla ekuxhumeni izizwe, okuwusizo olukhulu ukuze kuhlonishwe abantu abavela kwiindawo ezahlukene. Ngemibono yezenhlalakahle, wakhuthaza ukuthula nokusebenzisana, nokwenza uMphakathi kukhulise izimpilo zawo. Nokho, uChurchill akazange ahlale yonke isikhathi izimo bezihlale zimnandi. Ubudlelwano bakhe nabantu abahluphekayo buyaqondwa njengokuphuthumayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinqumo zakhe zenziwa ziwubuhlungu; ngisho nalapho enza kahle kwezombusazwe, waphinde wahlinzeka ngemicabango ebanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuholi abuphathelene nje nezimpumelelo, kodwa kuyimfanelo yokubona imiphumela. Ukuhamba kancane kwezikhathi, uChurchill wavezwa njengesibonelo sokwenza okuhle noma ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Izinselelo zakhe zaphakamisa izinkolelo zethu zokuqhubeka; izinhloso ezithile, zomsebenzi wakhe, zathi zikhulisa umqondo wokuthi isenzo sithi makube namandla, yize sikhumbula phambili. UBuyela emuva kubuholi nezimilo zethu, asibona umoya wakhe ongapheli. Emiphumeleni yakhe, uChurchill waba nezinhlinzeko, okwakuhambisana nobuchopho obubanzi nezinhloso ezinkulu. Umphakathi usala emasikweni akhulayo akhuluma ngezinsizakalo Zakhe, okwakungahambisani nephutha. Ubufazi obuhlukahlukane buthuthukisa imikhawulo enye emphakathini, okwenza kube lula ukusungula udumo. Njengoba sihlola izimpande zomlando, uChurchill ufakazela uthando olungapheli. Ngesikhathi sokudla umhlaba, iMpi Yezwe Yesibili, waba ngumbangi ophambili walokhu kokuhlupheka, wathola imiphumela yokuba ngumbangisile. Ubufakazi bokukhanya kukakhanyiselwa kuyabhalwa emlandweni, ubufakazi bokuthi umuntu oyedwa angashintsha umlando. Ukwazi okwengeziwe ngempilo nempumelelo yabo, uChurchill uyilanga elithokozisayo. Iziqhamo zokuhola, sibona ngokukhula, zibalulekile. Nakuba abanye bephikisana ngemikhuba yakhe, kuphinde kubonakale ukuthi uthando, uthando lobuholi, nezehlakalo zivela kuphakathi. UChurchill umemela ithuba lokuthokozela umhlaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuholi bukaChurchill buphathelene nempumelelo enkulu. Ubufakazi bokuphikelela, ukubekezelelana, neqiniso lokuba uphayona emhlabeni, kuni nesihe samazwe amaningi. Kuwumphumela omkhulu izinqumo zakhe ezinkulu, nemiphakathi ewumthombo wezinhlelo ezithile. Ukhankasela najengabe, umholi, njengoba sibhalela umlando. Ngokuphetha, uWinston Churchill ungumphakathi obaluleke kakhulu, esinika isibonelo sokuthi ubuholi buphathelene nezimo ezinzima. Likhona itilosi lapha; sithokozisa izinqumo zethu, sikhuthaza ukususa izithiyo. Ubuye waba nesandla ekutholeni impumelelo, sikhumbula izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa futhi sikhumbula ithuba lokuqhubeka. Wena mholi ongenakuphikiswa, uthumela umyalezo wokuthi ngisho ezikhathini zansuku zonke, umbono awakhambe yini ngempela!
Iphasiwedi esemthethweni iyidokhumenti enamakhasi angama-64 elungiselelwe abahambi abavakashela kaningi. Iphasiwedi esemthethweni ifana nephasiwedi yoturisti, ngaphandle kokuthi inamakhasi amabili ukuze ivumele amakhasi amaningi e-visa. Isebenza iminyaka eyi-10 kusukela ngosuku olukhishwayo. Lapho ufaka isicelo, kufanele ube nekhadi lakho lokwaziswa noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Qedela ifomu le-BI-73 bese ulithumela mathupha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle eliseduzane. Letha kuMphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni uma ufaka isicelo usuka ngaphandle kwelizwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwa izithombe zakho ukuze zirekhodwe ohlwini lwezibalo zabantu. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezincane zepasipoti. Uma ungakabi nekhadi lokwaziswa, futhi isikhathi sisheshisa, ungafaka isicelo sobabili ngesikhathi esisodwa, iphasiwedi kanye nekhadi lokwaziswa. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing.
Ukweba ugesi kubhekisela kunoma yisiphi isenzo esingagunyaziwe sokuphazamisa amathuluzi, izinto, noma izinsiza ukuze uxhumane ngendlela ekhombisa noma engaholela enanini legesi elingafundeki noma elibiwe, noma ukuze uthole inzuzo engafanele ngogesi. Ukweba ugesi kuyinselelo okufanele ibhekwe ukuze kugcinwe imboni yokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Kungani kubalulekile? Kulimaza umthetho: ukweba kubhekwa njengesenzo esiphula umthetho esingaphathwa ngenkatho. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngaphandle kokugunyazwa kokuxhuma noma ukubhalisela ukuba ikhasimende lesikhungo sokuhlinzeka ngogesi lendawo, kanye nokuphazamisa i-meter yogesi, kuyisenzo esiphula umthetho. Ukuze ugweme lesi simo, kufanele uxhumane nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi lendawo bese ufaka isicelo. Kuzodingeka ukuthi ukhokhe imali yokuxhuma ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Akukho ubulungiswa kulabo bakhasimende abangakhokhi ugesi. Ukuhluleka kukagesi: ukuxhumana okungekho emthethweni kuvame ukuholela ekwehlulekeni kwesakhiwo sikagesi, okungase kuwe. Ukuhluleka kungathinta nezindawo eziseduze. Lezi zinkinga zikagesi azibheki umhlinzeki wogesi. Ukuhluleka kukagesi kungaholela nasekuphakamiseni amazinga kagesi angalawulwa, okungalimaza izinto zikagesi, ikakhulukazi kulabo bakhasimende abangakhokhi ugesi. Ingxenye enzima ukuthi abakhasimende abangenacala ngeke babe nendlela yokukhala kumhlinzeki wogesi, njengoba inkinga ingase ingadalwanga umhlinzeki noma ingase ibe ngenxa yokunganaki kwabo. Abahlinzeki bagesi kufanele bathole inzuzo efanelekile emsebenzini wabo ukuze bakhokhe izindleko zogesi abathenga kubakhiqizi bagesi. Inzuzo evela ekuthengiseni ugesi isiza ukugcina ibhizinisi lokuhlinzeka ngogesi futhi ivumela umhlinzeki ukuba uqhubeke nemisebenzi yabo. Ngakho, ukweba ugesi kubeka engcupheni ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ukwehla kwemali engenayo kusho ukuthi imali encane iyangeniswa ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abangenayo ugesi kuzomele balinde isikhathi eside. Ezimweni eziningi zokuxhumana okungekho emthethweni, izingozi zikhona ngoba amakhebula awaphephile, okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwabantu. Ukulahlekelwa kwenzuzo ngenxa yokwehla kokuthengiswa kusho ukuthi kufanele kutholakale indawo ethile ukuze kugcwaliswe leli gap. Lesi simo sichaza ukwanda kwentengo yegesi. Ubani ophazamisekile ngalokhu? Kubathinte abakhasimende abangakhokhi ugesi ngoba inzuzo elahlekile iyakhokhelwa ngokwenyusa intengo? Xhumana nomakhelwane wakho mayelana nomthelela walokhu. Nika umakhelwane wakho iseluleko sokuthi kufanele afake isicelo sokuxhumana ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Xhumana nomakhelwane wakho; bangase babe nesixazululo kulolu daba. Phakamisa le ndaba emhlanganweni womphakathi noma nezinhlangano zendawo. Thumela udaba emnyangweni wezokuxhumana namakhasimende. Xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi uma unemininingwane mayelana nomuntu owebayo ugesi. Njengomthengi osebenzisa ugesi, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhokha insizakalo ethunyelwe kuwe. Uma unenkinga yokukhokha ibhili yakho ngesikhathi, mhlawumbe isixazululo singaba ukusisebenzisa uhlelo lwesistimu yokukhokha ugesi ngaphambi. Ngale ndlela, ungakwazi ukuphatha kangcono ugesi owusebenzisayo. Ukweba ugesi kuphazamisa bonke abakhasimende, hhayi kuphela endaweni yakho kodwa kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu kwezinye izindawo. Njengokugcina, ungathumela ukukhalaza kumlawuli wogesi. Abakhasimende bayakhuthazwa ukuba baxhumane nomhlinzeki wogesi ngqo lapho bengafaka khona izikhalazo. Uma unganelisekile, ungathumela udaba kumlawuli wezeMali Wogesi, ozophenya ngale ndaba ngaphezulu. Ukuhlela imboni yokuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokulandela izinqubomgomo nemithetho kuhlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamanje nezangomuso zabathintekayo emkhakheni wegesi usebenzisa amasu afanele aholela ekugcineni isikhathi eside. Umphakathi wegesi, ngokubambisana nomnyango wezinsizakalo zamakhasimende, uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni izinga lenkonzo emkhakheni wokuhlinzeka ngogesi nasekugcineni amakhasimende enolwazi ngezinkinga ezithinta ukuhlinzeka ngogesi.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekisela kumuntu osekwamukelwe njengomfuduki ofuna ukufuduka eNingizimu Afrika. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi lezeMisebenzi eliseduze endaweni okukhona kuyo. Kufanele ube sebulungwini bomfuduki iminyaka emihlanu ukuze ufake isicelo. Thola ukuqinisekiswa kwiKomidi Elimisiwe Lezindaba Zomfuduki, elikhombisa ukuthi kubonakala ukuthi uzohlala unomphela njengomfuduki odinga ukufuduka. Faka i-affidavit eqinisekisiwe evela kummeli enezinhlamvu zonke ozisebenzisile. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29E. Umthetho Wokuhamba, 2002, njengoba ushintshiwe. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze ukuze uthole usizo.
Izitifiketi Zobungcweti Zabasebenzi Bakahulumeni: Ukubaluleka Nokubhekisisa Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zihlala zikhuluma ngaphezulu kokuqinisa umkhiqizo, kodwa zibuza imibuzo eminingi ebalulekile mayelana nomthelela wazo emsebenzini, ezimfundweni, nasempilweni yabo bonke abasebenzi. Ukubheka lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti ziwusizo olukhulu ezifundweni, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphokophele ukuthola ulwazi olujulile, nokwakha umphakathi onolwazi. Okokuqala, izitifiketi zobungcweti zikhuthaza ukuzinikela emsebenzini. Abasebenzi abanemithwalo ethile yokusebenzisa ulwazi olutholakala ezitifiketini bavame ukuba nomdlandla wokusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emsebenzini kahulumeni, lapho izinga lokusebenza eliphezulu lithembisa izinsiza ezingcono kubantu. Ngendlela ethile, izitifiketi ziba yisikhuthazo sokwenza imisebenzi kahle, njengoba zikhombisa ukuthi umuntu ufunde futhi unaphiwa iziqu ezizothuthukisa ukusebenza kwawo. Nokho, akuhlali kulula. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti zingeza umjikelezo wobufakazi obuthile obudinga ukuxazululwa. Kukhona abakholelwa ukuthi izitifiketi zingaphakathi kumkhankaso wokugxila kumakhono athile, okukhombisa ukusebenza ngaphandle kokubheka ubuchwepheshe obuningi. Ngalesi sikhumba, sifuna ukusungula umbono ophusile wokuthi ukuhlola abantu kubalulekile, kodwa akufanele kube nokukhethwa phakathi kokubuka kumakhono kuphela. Lolu daba lukhumbuza abantu ukuba kube nezinsuku zokufunda, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi umphakathi uphumelela kanjani. Esinye isici okubhekwana naso ukuthinta izitifiketi ezithile kumakhono abantu. Kungaba ngcono ukukhetha izitifiketi eziphathelene nokuqeqeshwa okuthile. Lokhu kudinga ukufundisa ngabathintekayo, ukucacisa izidingo zomphakathi, nokwenza ukuthi uthole izitifiketi eziphathelene nezidingo zemakethe. Uma abantu behlangabezana nezidingo eziphakanyiswa ngalesi sikhathi, bazoba namathuba amahle okuqinisekisa izingxoxo eziqhubekayo nezinsizakalo ezintsha. Kodwa, okuwukuphela kwalesi simo kukhuluma ngesidingo sokuqondisa imfundo nezifundo ezivezwa njengentuthuko. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izitifiketi zobungcweti zisetshenziswa njengendlela yokusebenzisa abantu abaqeqeshiwe. ABaduduzayo babaluleka ekuqiniseni ibhizinisi, nolwazi olunembile. Umphakathi uzuza emithwalweni yesikhumbuzo, eholela emiphumeleni emihle. Lokhu kuyafaneleka kakhulu emisebenzini yangempela lapho izinkampani zinezinselelo ezithile ukuze ziqhubeze izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Ngalokho, izingxoxo zenzeka, nokuthola nokubeka izinsiza ezimfushane kulezi zinsiza. Uma sicabanga ngalesi sikhumbuzo, kudingeka wazi ukuthi izitifiketi azihlinzeki kuphela ngezinsiza zomsebenzi, kodwa ziphinde zikhombise ukuzinikela komuntu. Zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele ekwandiseni ulwazi lwabo, okwakha umphakathi onobuchule. Kuncane kakhulu okukhuluma ngenhlonipho yokuba umholi nokuphatha izinkampani. Kukhona abakholelwa ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele usebenzise izitifiketi ezithinta abantu abakhiqizayo, ukuze kube nezinkampani ezilungile, ezithinta umphakathi ngaphandle kokungena ezindleleni ezinzima. Ekugcwaliseni, ukukhombisa izimvo eziphikisanayo mayelana nezitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinhlonipho ezicacile. Ngakho, ukungaboni ngaso linye into akuwezi kuphela ukuphucula ukuxhumana, kodwa kubalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezicacile nezinembile. Ukuphikisa kulesi sihloko kumele kwenziwe ngenhlonipho, ngaphandle kokuyekethisa izinjongo ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kumele ukhuthazwe ukuba kufanele kube nezinyathelo eziphusile kulokhu ukuze kusebenze ngendlela eqondile. Ngakho-ke, izitifiketi zobungcweti kufanele ziqhubeke zikhula, zikhuthazwa futhi zinakekelwe ukuze kubaluleke izinsiza zomsebenzi wethu nakuba sikhuluma kwezidingo zomphakathi.
Izinqubo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo EziBhedlela Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani, bangane! Namuhla sizoxoxa ngezimo eziphuthumayo ezikhombisa ukuthi isibhedlela siwumthombo wezinsizakusebenza eziphuthumayo. Ngiyajabula ukuba neNhloko yeZokwelapha, uDkt. Zola Nkosi, lapha. Ngiyabingelela, Dkt. Nkosi. UDkt. Nkosi: Ngiyabingelela, futhi ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Lezi zinkulumo zinhle futhi zinomthelela omkhulu. Umxhumanisi: Uma sikhuluma ngezimo eziphuthumayo, singakusho ukuthi kunezinyathelo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela ekwelashweni ngokushesha. Ungathanda ukusichazela lezi zinyathelo ezibalulekile? UDkt. Nkosi: Yebo, ngiyavuma. Izinqubo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukusebenzisa inhliziyo, ukucacisa, nokuhlonipha. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi isibhedlela sibe nezinsizakusebenza eziyinqaba, eziphephile, nezithokozisayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubizelwa emsebenzini odokotela, izisebenzi zempilo, nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukukhishwa kwemiyalo yokuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Umxhumanisi: Kukhona okukhombisa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngodokotela abakhethiwe kubalulekile. Yini okhumbula ngayo inhloso yokuphendula? UDkt. Nkosi: Inhloso yokuphendula izimo eziphuthumayo iwukuthola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, ukuletha imithwalo yempilo ngesikhathi esifanele. Sizama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyazi ngezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo, kusuka ezinhlelweni zezenzo eziphuthumayo zansuku zonke, nokuthola izinhlelo ezinamandla zokwelapha. Lokhu kudinga nezinye izindleko ezikhokhwayo, njengokuhamba imoto ezimotifini ezisheshayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona imibiko ethile yokuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo engcono? UDkt. Nkosi: Yebo, njengabodokotela, sikhumbula izingxenye ezimbili ezahlukene. Okokuqala, khona abantu abavela ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni ethu nangaphezulu. Izimonyo ezithile kufanele zihlolwe ngezinyathelo ezithile. Uma sinamasu, sithola inqubekela phambili ekuphenduleni, silandela izinyathelo ezisemthethweni. Isizathu sokuhlola ukufaka umzamo ogcwele ekuqinisekiseni inhlalakahle yezenzo eziphuthumayo. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Njengoba siqhubeka, ungathanda ukwabelana ngezizathu eziphakeme ezingavela ngaphambili? UDkt. Nkosi: Yebo. Kujabulisa, ngoba ukuhlolwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo akuphuthumali nje, kodwa kufanele uqaphe kahle. Ukubakhona kwezinsizakalo ezilungiselelwe kufanele kube umsebenzi oqhubekayo. Lokhu kubala isikhathi sokuphendula nezinyathelo ezihamba phambili. Ziningi izinyathelo ezisemqoka, ezifana nokwakha izinhlelo zomsebenzi ezicacile, ukuhlela ukuhambela ezimotweni zokuphuthumala, kanye nemiklamo yokuba neze imishini ehlanzekile esebenza kahle. Umxhumanisi: Njengoba sikhuluma, kubalulekile ukuqonda futhi kwenziwa okwenziwayo. Ingabe uthanda ukusichazela izikhathi ezithile ezizwakalayo lapho kwenzeke khona ukuviyela okubucayi? UDkt. Nkosi: Yebo, ngithanda njalo ukuba nezibonelo. Kukhona esesikubekezelela, lapho imoto yephuthumayo ibanjwe. Kwathi lapho beziya endaweni yokugcina abayithumele khona, bephuma kuyo, belinde egumbini le-ICU. Lokhu kwavimbela kabi izinqubo eziningi. Ngokuveza umyalo wokuhlanganyela, saphinda kwaba nesikhathi esibalulekile sokuba usemoyeni. Lokhu kwabanikeza umqondo ocacile ohamba phambili. Umxhumanisi: Kuhlale kukho izifundo ezitholakele okuqhubeke. Ziphawuleni ukuthi izibonelo ezikulthelweyo? UDkt. Nkosi: Kuhle ukuhamba phambili. Kubalulekile ukuthi sisebenze ngokuhlanganyela ukuze sizuze imiphumela emihle. Ukuzwana nezenzo eziphuthumayo kuncike ngokuqinile kwemikhuba eqondile nezinyathelo. Edlula ekhethekile, kulindeleke ukusizakale ekwandiseni imizamo yokubamba umoya onqamulelayo. Isidingo sokukhipha indlela engaphezulu nephambili. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga, uDkt. Nkosi. Ukwazi kwethu ngalokhu kunomthelela omuhle, izinhlelo nezinqubo eziphuthumayo. Ngabe unamaphuzu okugcina ukuze uphumelele? UDkt. Nkosi: Kungcono, nginalo olunye ucezu. Kubalulekile ukucacisela abantu umphakathi izinsizakalo esiphakamisayo. Ukuthi umphakathi ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuphumeleleni kwemizamo yethu. Ngiyabonga futhi ngiyathokozisa ukuba lapha. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga, uDkt. Nkosi, ngokuqhubekayo kwethu. Lesi sikhathi sikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi kufanele sihamba phezulu. UDkt. Nkosi: Ngiyabonga. Isikhathi siza, asidiki ukuqhubeka. Umxhumanisi: Leli sonto, sikhumbula ukuthi izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo zidinga isikhathi, ubuchule, nokubumbana. Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Nkosi, nangemibono yakho. Hamba kahle!
Kungcono ukuba ne makethe ngaphambi kokutshala ukudla ofuna ukukhiqiza, ngoba kunezivuno eziningi ezitshala ngokushesha, bese zithemba ukuthi zizothola imakethe enhle uma zikhululiwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba necebo lokumaketha umkhiqizo wakho ngendlela ezokwenza uzuze inzuzo enhle. Izindlela zokumaketha ezifanele kufanele zihambisane nezinhlelo zokuqala zokutshala isivuno ofuna ukukhiqiza. Ikhono lomlimi lokumaketha ukudla kwabo lingalingana nekhono labo lokutshala nokukhiqiza ukudla okuthile. Kufanele uthuthukise amakhono akho okuthengisa, futhi wandise ulwazi lwakho ngezindlela zokumaketha. Icebo lokumaketha elilandelwa ngumlimi oyedwa noma inkampani yokulima liyingxenye yezinto ezidingekayo uma ufuna ukuphatha izindleko nezingozi ngendlela efanele ukuze uzuze inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Ukulima kunezingozi eziningi, futhi kwesinye isikhathi zingavela ngezindlela ongazilindele. Ukushintsha kwemakethe kwenza kube nzima ukubheka phambili, kodwa kubalulekile. Icebo lokumaketha elihle lingasiza umlimi ukuthi wehlise izindleko kanye nokuphuma kwezingozi ezihlobene nokushintsha kwemakethe komkhiqizo wabo. Isimo sakho mayelana nezingozi ezikhona sizokukhombisa ukuthi yisiphi isikhumbuzo sokumaketha okufanele sikhethe kumkhiqizo wakho. Eminyakeni edlule, bekukhona uhlelo lokubamba imakethe ngentengo ethile, kodwa abalimisi abaningi baphikisa ukuthi abatholanga inzuzo efanele kulowo mkhiqizo. Okwamanje, imakethe yentengo ethile ayisekho; manje kukhona uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi 'imakethe yamahhala,' kodwa manje abalimisi bayaphikisa ngoba abakwazi ukuphatha lezo makethe ezahlukene. Zonke izindlela zokumaketha zihlobene nezinto ezintsha nezinsiza ezilindele phambili, kodwa kubalulekile kumlimi ukuthi athathe ithuba elizayo ukuze alisebenzise ukuze athole inzuzo. Ukwenza amaphutha kuyinto evamile empilweni yethu - ukwenza amaphutha ekulimini nakho kuyenzeka. Nokho, uma siqhubeka saphinda lezo ziphutha, ngeke siqhubeke phambili, ngeke sithuthuke; akufanele siphinde amaphutha endala - kungcono ukubhekana nezingozi ezintsha ezingavela bese sikwazi ukuqhubeka, siqhubeke phambili. Ingabe imakethe obuyifinyelele eminyakeni edlule ikwanelisile noma cha? Yiziphi izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenze kahle? Kungani ucabanga ukuthi izinyathelo ozithathile zisebenze kahle? Ingabe imakethe oyitholile ibaluleke kangakanani uma uyihlola uma uyiqhathanisa nemakethe ephansi, ephezulu emaphandleni noma uma uyihlola uma uyihlanganisa nemakethe ejwayelekile emhlabeni jikelele? Yiziphi izindlela zokumaketha ezingasebenzi kahle? Kungani ezinye zezindlela zakho zokumaketha zingasebenzi kahle? Uhlosile ukuthatha kanjani isu lakho lokulima eminyakeni eyi-12 ezayo nasezinyangeni ezi-5 ezayo - yini umphumela ozoba nayo ezindleleni ofuna ukuzenza ukuze umakethe umkhiqizo wakho ngesikhathi esithile? Yisiphi isimo samanje sebhizinisi lakho lokulima? Kufanele ubheke ukulima kwakho njengokubheka ibhizinisi. Hlola isimo sezomnotho sebhizinisi lakho jikelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi izitatimende zihlobane nezimali zonyaka odlule - lokhu kufanele kufake konke: izitatimende zenzuzo, izitatimende zezimali, imali engenayo nezincwadi ezihambelanayo. Izincwadi ezikhombisa inzuzo yesikhathi esizayo, ukungena kwemali nokuphuma kwemali, nezincwadi ezihambelanayo zizokusiza ukuhlola ukuthi imakethe yenkukhu engahlali ndawonye izoba nempembelelo kanjani ebhizinisini lakho. Ngesinye isikhathi sonyaka lapho ingenamali kwi-akhawunti, kungasiza ukuthola enye indlela yokumaketha yomkhiqizo wakho. Ukuqashwa, ukukhiqiza, nokuba necebo lokumaketha kuhambisana nokuthi uphatha kanjani izimali zakho. Uma ungazi ukuthi izindleko zakho zokutshala zingaki, kuzoba nzima ukunquma ukuthi mangaki umkhiqizo (ngama-ton) okudingayo ukuze uzuze inzuzo. Bala zonke izindleko zakho zokukhiqiza zokudla okuthile ngehektare. Bala izindleko eziphuthumayo - imbewu, umanyolo, idizili, ama-pesticides, izindleko zokusebenza, kanye ne-insurance. Bala izindleko eziyisisekelo ezizokwenziwa ekukhiqizeni izinkukhu bese uqhathanisa nalokho nemakethe yokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi uzokwazi yini ukuhlinzeka ngezindleko futhi uphinde uzuze. Funa imakethe ezokwenza uzuze leyo nzuzo. Izindleko eziyisisekelo zifaka: ukuqasha, intela (uma uthole imali), amaholo abantu abasebenza kuwe, kanye negesi (lezi zindleko ziqhubeka noma uthshala noma ungatshali). "Breakeven" ingachazwa kanje: inani lokuthengisa elizokwenza izindleko eziyisisekelo zilingane nalolo nani, ngaphandle kokwenza inzuzo. Ukukhiqiza izinkukhu ngokuvamile kuyingxenye yezinto ezijwayelekile ezenziwa epulazini ethile. Ukukhulisa izilwane emathunjini noma emapulazini nokuhlanganisa izinkukhu nezinye izimpahla zezilwane kungaba isizathu sokukhiqiza izinkukhu. Futhi izinkukhu zingaba isivuno esibalulekile epulazini lapho izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zishintshashintsha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuhlola nokubala zonke lezi zinto uma ufuna ukuthola inani lemakethe elithi 'minimali' - khumbula ukubala lezo zinsiza ezihlobene nokukhiqiza isivuno esithile. Ubuye ube sebhizinisini, ngakho uma ufuna ukuqhubeka ngebhizinisi lakho, kufanele uhlale uthola inzuzo ezinhlelweni ozisebenzisayo epulazini lakho. Kubalulekile ukuba umlimi ukukhiqiza ukudla - kunezinto eziningi okufanele zihlolwe ngaphambi kokuthatha izinyathelo ezithile. Uma ushiyela ukumaketha umkhiqizo wakho kuze kube sekugcineni, futhi ungawuqondi kahle ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani, kungcono uvakashele ibhizinisi le-Agribusiness eliseduze nawe ukuze uthole iseluleko. Qaphela lapho uthola khona iseluleko; kukhona abantu abaqotho lapho abangakusiza - baphande kuze kube uthola!
Ibhodi Lesizwe Lezifunda (elaziwa nge-NCOP), elinamalungu angaphezu kwe-90. Umthethosisekelo uthi Ibhodi Lesizwe Lezifunda, i-NCOP, temsilisa izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicwaningwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kwesizwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ikakhulu ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokwenza umthetho kazwelonke nokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngenkundla kazwelonke yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta izifunda. I-NCOP iqinisekisa futhi ukuthi izidingo zokuphatha zendawo ziyaqondwa ezingeni likamasipala. I-NCOP yakhiwe ngama-province ayisishiyagalolunye akhombisa abamele abavoti abavela ezikhungweni zomthetho zezifunda, kanye nabamele abavela kwi-South African Local Government Association (eyaziwa nge-SALGA). Abamele baqondiswa nguMphakathi wesifunda ngasinye, ongomunye wabamele abakhethekile. Uma kudingeka, uMphakathi angabeka omunye umuntu endaweni yakhe. Ikhono le-SALGA liphethe ukukhetha abamele be-SALGA abavela kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye kanye nababambisene ababili. Lezi zikhulu zenza umsebenzi we-NCOP futhi ziqondisa izingxoxo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abamele bakhuluma ngokukhululeka uma behambisana nemithetho ebekwe yiNdlu. U-Phakade ofanayo ukhethwa isikhathi eside seminyaka emihlanu, kanti ama-Premiers ezifunda aphindaphinda njengababambisene minyaka yonke. Ngokubambisana nokubambisana, i-NCOP ihlose ukuveza ukubaluleka kokucabangela izidingo zokuphatha zendawo kanye nezifunda ezingeni likamasipala. I-NCOP ihlinzeka ngezwi lezi zifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi inikeza nohulumeni bendawo inkundla yokubamba iqhaza ekucubunguleni umthetho ezingeni likamasipala. Kumele icabangele yonke imithetho kazwelonke. Ingaphinde iphakamise noma ilungise umthetho ngaphansi kweSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo (lezi zindaba lapho umthetho kazwelonke nezikhungo zomthetho zezifunda zinegunya elihambisanayo lokwenza umthetho) neminye imithetho ethinta izifunda. Iningi lale misebenzi yokwenza umthetho lenziwa ezikhaleni, kodwa yonke imithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwi-NCOP ukuze ixoxwe futhi ivote ukuthi le mithetho yamukelwa noma iyalaywa. Umthetho ongathinti izifunda ubandakanya imisebenzi kazwelonke; njengokuvikela, ezangaphandle, kanye nezenzo zobulungiswa. Uma le mithetho yamukelwa yiNdlu Yezwe, ithunyelwa kwi-NCOP ukuze ivote. Uma i-NCOP ifuna ukwenza izinguquko kumthetho, ithumela kumthetho kazwelonke, okuyisikhungo esisodwa esingamukela noma sikhansela lezi zinguquko. Izibonelo zemithetho ethinta izifunda zifaka phakathi imfundo, ukuthuthwa, inhlalakahle, kanye nezempilo. Iningi lale mithetho lingangeniswa kwi-NCOP nganoma iyiphi yalezi Ndlu; nokho, kukhona eminye imithetho okumele iqale kwiNdlu Yezwe. Lapho le mithetho ivotwa kwi-NCOP, isifunda ngasinye sinesikhumbuzo esisodwa esivotelelwa umholi wendawo yokuthumela izifunda. Amalunga omphakathi angadlala indima ebonakalayo ekuqapheleni izenzo zikamasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni uyaphendula ezidingweni zabantu. Ukubeka phambili kwiKomidi lePhalamende kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokwabelana ngemibono yakho namalunga ekomidi ngenkathi behlanganyela futhi becubungula umthetho othile ngaphambi kokuba uqedwe ngabo. Ipetisheni iyindlela yokuletha ePhalamende izikhalazo noma izindaba ezithinta umphakathi ukuze ikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngaphakathi kwamagunya ayo. Ilungelo lokupetisha iPhalamende liyilungelo labantu bonke baleli zwe futhi linikezwa nguMthethosisekelo wethu. Noma ubani, kungaba ngabantu noma amaqembu, unelungelo lokupetisha iPhalamende. Amalunga omphakathi angathintana namalunga ePhalamende emahhovisi abo ezindaweni ezikhethiwe kulo lonke elizwe noma ePhalamende uma befuna ukuthi basize ngendaba ephuthumayo abafuna ukuyixoxa noma uma bedinga usizo ngendaba ethile.
Izinguquko Zomthetho: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, izinguquko zomthetho zazingekho ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezweni lethu, lapho umthetho wawuhambisana kakhulu nezinkolelo namasiko abantu. Umthetho wawubhekwa njengomthetho wezwe, kodwa ngesikhathi esithile, izidingo zabantu zashintsha, kwadingeka ukuthi kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezimo ezikhulayo. Ngonyaka ka-1994, ngemva kokuphumelela kweDemocracy, izinguquko zomthetho zathuthuka kakhulu. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokubuyiselwa kwezinto eziningi, lapho umthetho wawuhloselwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu. Kwakukhona umqondo omusha wokuthi umthetho kufanele ube yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu engathola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ngalesi sikhathi, kwavulwa amathuba okuthi abantu baphendule ezinkingeni ezithinta umthetho. Izinhlelo eziningi zokuqala zafakwa, njengezinhlelo zokufundisa umthetho ezikoleni, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle amalungelo abo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukuthi umthetho awuwona umphakathi kuphela, kodwa uyingxenye yokuphila kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko zomthetho zathinta izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi. Umthetho wezobulili, umthetho wezokuhlalisana, kanye nomthetho wezomnotho, konke kwashintsha ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Umthetho wezobulili, ngokwesibonelo, wathuthukiswa ukuze uvikele amalungelo abesifazane, abantwana, kanye nabantu abanezinye izidingo ezikhethekile. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko zomthetho zafaka izinhlelo zokubuyisela izimpilo zabantu abathintekile yizigameko ezinzima, njengokuhlukunyezwa nokuhlukumezeka. Umthetho wathuthukiswa ukuze uvikele abantu abahlukunyezwayo, futhi kwavulwa amathuba okuthi abantu baphinde baphile impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho abantu bekwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko zomthetho zathinta izinhlelo zokuphatha izinkinga zomphakathi. Umthetho wezokuphatha izinkinga, owawuhloselwe ukuvikela abantu emaphutheni, wathuthukiswa ukuze ube nezinqubo ezicacile zokubhekana nezinkinga. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho abantu bekwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko zomthetho zathinta izinhlelo zokuphatha izinkinga zomnotho. Izikhungo zokucubungula ubisi yizindawo lapho ubisi luphathwa futhi luhlanzekile. Isicelo secebo sokwamukela isikhungo sokucubungula ubisi kumele senziwe ngokubhalwe phansi. Isicelo kumele sihlanganise ulwazi olukhulunywe ngezansi. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela uMnyango Wezempilo. Thumela isicelo esibhaliwe kumaphoyisa endawo lapho ubisi luzocubungulwa khona noma lapho isikhungo sizokwakhiwa khona. Nikeza ulwazi olulandelayo: uhlelo lwesizinda nolwakhiwo lendawo ngesikali esingu-1:100 kuzo zonke izindawo zesikhungo sokucubungula ubisi, kanye nohlelo lwezitezi lendawo, ukubonakala kwesizinda, nokuphakama phezulu kwendawo. Yiba nesineke sokuhlinzeka nganoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi olungacelwa ngamasipala endawo. Amasipala endawo azokwenza ukuhlolwa kwesizinda. Umhloli uzothumela umbiko nokunconywa kumasipala endawo. Isephulelo sokwamukela sikhishwe uma umbiko womhloli ubonakala unenzuzo. Kuhluka ngesifunda ngebhande. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Isicelo secebo sokwamukela isikhungo sokucubungula ubisi. Le fomu itholakala emahhovisi omasipala noma eMnyangweni Wezempilo.
Le ncwadi isekelwe kulwazi olunikezwe yizikhungo ezifanele, noma ngqo noma ngamawebhusayithi azo. Abacwaningi bacabange ukuthi lonke ulwazi lunikezwa ngenhloso enhle futhi luyiqiniso. Asikwazi ukubekwa icala ngokunembile nangokuphelele kolwazi olunikezwe kithi. Uma ufuna ukuthi inhlangano yakho ifakwe ezibuyekezeni ezizayo zalesi sithombe, sicela uthumele i-imeyili ku: kmosweu@deat.gov. Izinhlangano ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu (SMMEs) ziyizinjini zokuthuthukiswa. Zifaka isandla ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi nasekuphakamiseni umnotho. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi ama-SMMEs ezokuvakasha asungulwe ukuze azimele futhi akhule. Ukuze sithole usizo ngalokhu, uMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha, ngokuqhuba iSigaba Sawo Sezokuvakasha, uthuthukise iqoqo lezinsiza ezihloselwe ukusiza osomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha bathuthukise amabhizinisi abo futhi babe nenzuzo. Le ncwadi ibaluleke kakhulu njengoba ihlinzeka ngendawo eyodwa efanele yokufinyelela ulwazi, ikakhulukazi kubasomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha, ngoxhaso lwamabhizinisi olukhona kubo. Lapho iqala, le ncwadi izotholakala nangezinye izilimi ezisemthethweni, okungukuthi isiZulu, isiSetswana, nesiBhunu. Sizophinde sithuthukise le ncwadi minyaka yonke futhi siyihumushe ngezilimi eziningi. Anginankinga yokuthi uzothola le ncwadi iyinsiza ewusizo emizamweni yakho yokwakha ibhizinisi elizinzile nelinenzuzo. Nginecebo elihle! Ngaphi engingathola khona uxhaso lokuqala ibhizinisi lami? Imibuzo - Yini engingayenza ukuze ngibe umthengisi? Yilapho ungene kule ndawo enhle yezokuvakasha. Sithemba ukuthi uzothola le ncwadi ewusizo. Le ncwadi izokunikeza ulwazi oluwusizo ukusiza emizamweni yakho yokwakha ibhizinisi elihlobene nezokuvakasha. Iqukethe izihloko ezivela ekubhaleni kwezinhlelo zebhizinisi ukuya ekutholeni uxhaso lwezezimali nasekunikezeni ulwazi olubalulekile lokuxhumana. Sicela ukhumbule ukuthi le yindlela ejwayelekile, ngakho-ke siphakamisa kakhulu ukuthi ubheke emithonjeni yolwazi ehlukene. Omunye wemisebenzi ebalulekile yale ncwadi ukuthi ihlinzeka ngolwazi ngazo zonke iziqalo ezikhona ukusiza ukwakha ibhizinisi elisha noma ukukhulisa elikhona. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuze uthole ukuthi ubani ongaba ngcono kuwe futhi uxhumane nabo ngqo. Khumbula ukuthi izikhungo eziningi zinikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene nokuxhaso. Ukuze sigcine isikhala kule ncwadi, asiphindi imininingwane yabo kodwa sikunikeze ikhasi elihambelana nalokho okufanele ubheke kulo. Izifunda eziningi zinezikhungo zazo ezizimele nezincwadi ezinhle ezishicilelwe. Xhumana nabo ngqo usebenzisa ulwazi lokuxhumana olunikezwe eMkhakheni 5. Ukusungula ibhizinisi lakho akulula futhi kudinga umsebenzi onzima nokuzinikela. Izokuvakasha zihluke futhi zisebenza ngendlela ehlukile kwezinye izimboni kulokhu. Sifake imibuzo ejabulisayo eMkhakheni 5 ukuze sikunikeze umbono wokuthi unakho yini okudingekayo ukuze ungene ebhizinisini. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuqoqa ulwazi olunembile ngangokunokwenzeka. Funda ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza - lokhu kufaka phakathi amaphephandaba, izincwadi, namawebhusayithi. Kubalulekile ukubheka le ncwadi njengendawo yokuhlanganisa, hhayi njengomhlahlandlela oqinile wokuba nebhizinisi lezokuvakasha eliphumelelayo. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuthola olunye ulwazi futhi ungayeki ukufunda ngibhizinisi lakho nezokuvakasha. Ithuluzi Lebhizinisi. Siphakamisa ukuthi ufike kulolu lwazi ukuze uthole ulwazi olujulile, uma kudingeka. Sikufisela inhlanhla futhi siyakwamukela kule ndawo enhle yezokuvakasha! Kube nokuxoxisana okuthile mayelana nencazelo yegama elithi "umvakashi" nokuthi yiziphi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngempilo kubavakashi. Umvakashi ungumuntu ovakashela futhi ohlala ngaphandle kwendawo ehlukile kulokho abajwayele ukukwenza isikhathi esithile futhi angaba "umvakashi wendawo" - othile ophila eNingizimu Afrika kodwa uvakashele esinye isifunda sezwe nomndeni nabangani ukuze ajabulele; "umvakashi wezebhizinisi" ohamba evela kwezinye izindawo noma ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika ukuze aqhube imisebenzi yebhizinisi noma "umvakashi wamazwe omhlaba" ovakashela eNingizimu Afrika evela kwezinye izindawo ukuze abone lokho esingakuhlinzeka. Izokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika ifaka zonke izigaba ezisebenzela ukwenza isipiliyoni somvakashi ezweni lethu sibe mnandi futhi sikhumbulekayo. Ukuhlinzeka Ngabavakashi (ukuhlala) kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, isibonelo, ukulala nokudla kwasekuseni, izindlu zokwamukela izivakashi, izinsiza zokuzikhethela, amahostela amasha, ama-lodges, amahhotela, njll. I-MICE (Imihlangano, Izikhuthazo, Imicimbi, Nezikhathi) iyisigaba esihloselwe ikakhulukazi ukuhlela nokuphatha imihlangano nezinye izenzakalo ezifana nezinkomfa nokwenza kube nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abameleli abakhethiwe bathola itiye nelunch. Ndawonye sizokwakha umkhiqizo wezokuvakasha ongathengiswa emhlabeni jikelele ngokusebenzisa izinkomfa zamazwe omhlaba, sikhuthaza izivakashi ukuthi zize zibone lokho ezweni lethu elihle elinokuhamba, izindawo ezinhle, izikhumbuzo zomlando, abantu abahle, izindawo zokuthenga, nezindawo eziningi ezihlukile nezithokozisayo eNingizimu Afrika. Izokuvakasha ihlobene nezalmost zonke ezinye izenzo ezweni ngendlela ethile. Kodwa isebenzisa eyodwa noma ngaphezulu (umuntu ophakathi). Ndawonye nokuthi zonke lezi zisebenza kanjani ndawonye, ziletha abavakashi ezindaweni zabo emhlabeni jikelele eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthola ukuqonda okucacile kokuthi ubani ozosebenzisa imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho ekugcineni, ubani okufanele uxhumane naye ohambweni lwakho lokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi. Sifake isithombe ngezansi ukuze sikhombise ukuthi le nqubo ingasebenza kanjani kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela nokuthi ubani ozothola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Uzobona ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi zithola izinzuzo kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela - empeleni, bangaba abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo kumphathi wendawo yokuhlala. Xhumana neNhlangano Yezokuvakasha yendawo ukuze uthole izeluleko zokuthi ungakha kanjani ibhizinisi lakho. Ulwazi oluningi lufakwe esigabeni Sokumaketha seMkhakheni 4. Uhlelo lwecebo luzosungulwa kanjani futhi umsebenzisi uzothenga kanjani iholidi? Kube nolwazi oluningi muva nje mayelana nezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngokwanda kwenani labavakashi abavakashela ezweni lethu elihle.
