Ngokuhambisana neMithetho Emisha neThuthukiswa, phakathi neminyaka eyishumi nambili yokuqala kuhulumeni wenkululeko, sigxile emizamweni yokwenza ushintsho emphakathini. Sifake ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengesisekelo sokuhola inqubo yemithetho kanye nesakhiwo sokwehlisa amazinga obuphofu, kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlalisana emphakathini kubantu abampofu nabaphethwe yizinkinga. Ngenxa yokuzinikela kweSikhungo sethu kuThuthukiswa Komphakathi, eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, kube nokugxila okukhulu ezinsizakalweni zokuhlalisana, ngokuhambisana nemizamo eqhubekayo yokulinganisa izinzuzo nokufinyelela kwabantu ezinsizakalweni zokuhlalisana. Izidingo ebhajethi yokuhlalisana zikhombisile ukuthi ibiyingxenye yokuthola izinsiza zokweseka izidingo eziyisisekelo, njengokuvikela izinsizakalo zokuhlalisana, ukugcina amakhono abalulekile abasebenzi bezokuhlalisana, kanye nokubandakanywa komphakathi kwezinhlangano zokuhlalisana. Njengomphumela, kwasungulwa iHhovisi lezeMali leZokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, futhi uMnyango weZokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ube nomqondo omkhulu kulezi zidingo ezibalulekile. Ngokwesibonelo, eminyakeni yamuva, uMnyango weZokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi waqala isikhungo semithetho mayelana neMali Yabakhi (PFA). Uhlobo lwezwe ludinge ukuthi uhulumeni ubuyekeze ukuthi usebenzisa kanjani izinsiza zawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zabelwa ngokulinganayo kulabo ababephathwe kabi emphakathini wethu. I-PFA iyisicwangciso esibalulekile sokusiza ushintsho lomphakathi nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ngokuxhasa ngempahla abakhi. Njengoba kuvunyelwene ngazo zonke izigaba emphakathini eMhlanganweni Wokukhula Nokuthuthukiswa, kulindeleke ukuthi zonke izigaba zisebenze ndawonye ekuxazululeni izinselelo zomnotho emphakathini wethu. Uhulumeni wedwa akakwazi ukunqoba lezi zinselelo. Ngakho-ke, uMnyango uqhubeka nokuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana okukhulayo phakathi kwezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo (NGOs), Izinhlangano Zenkolo (FBOs), Izinhlangano Zomphakathi (CBOs), kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ukuze siphumelele kule mthethweni, izicwangciso zathuthukiswa ukuze kubalwe izindleko zokubhekana nayo yonke into ehambisana nokuphumeza le mthethweni. Ukuze abakhi bakwazi ukusebenza, kumele baxhaswe kahle, futhi izinga lokukhokha labakhi kumele limiswe kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Ngokufanayo, izicwangciso zokubala izindleko zohlelo lwezokuhlalisana zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izinga elibekiwe nezinsiza zabelwa ngokulinganayo. Iziphakamiso mayelana nokuxhaswa kwezimali kwezinhlelo ezichazwe ku-PFA zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zifika kulawo miphakathi nezinhlelo ezidinga kakhulu, nokuthi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezingezona eziphansi. UMnyango uphinde wathuthukisa Izikhombisi-ndlela zeMithetho neZinqubo Ezivunyelwe, okumele zifundwe kanye nesakhiwo semithetho seMali Yabakhi. Uhulumeni uyabonga umsebenzi onzima nezikhumbuzo zalabo abathintekayo emphakathini ekuletheni izinsizakalo zokuhlalisana. Iphrojekthi efana noHlelo Lokusebenza Olwandisiwe (EPWP) iyisibonelo sokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bethu nohulumeni. Ngenxa yale moya yokubambisana, simema bonke abantu bethu ukuba baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke. Siphinde sikhuthaze futhi sithokozise umsebenzi nezikhumbuzo zabazithandayo, abakhi abazimele, kanye nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi. Ndawonye, sakha umphakathi kanye nezwe elihloniphekile ezinganeni zethu nakubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Inqubo yokuthuthukisa isikhungo semali yokuxhasa yaqala ngo-1996 kodwa yaphazanyiswa ngo-2000. UNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wasungula iKomidi ukuze kwenziwe uphenyo ngezinkinga eziphathelene nesikhungo semithetho, kwathi ngemuva kwalokho wanikeza iziphakamiso kuMphakathi Wezokuthuthukiswa (MINMEC). I-MINMEC yanquma ukuthi isikhungo semali yokuxhasa kufanele sibuyekezwe. Lokhu kwenziwa yiqembu elisebenzayo, futhi umphumela walolu work, iMithetho yeMali Yabakhi, yamukelwa futhi yavunywa ngo-2004 ngemuva kokwethulwa ezikhundleni zeZinsizakalo Zokuhlalisana (HSWS), iKomidi Eliphezulu (EXCO), kanye ne-MINMEC. UMnyango uphinde uthande ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwabantu nezikhungo ezithintekayo ekuthuthukiseni le mthethweni, iminyango yesifunda, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nomphakathi uqobo ngezibopho zabo nezikhumbuzo. Ukubambisana phakathi koMnyango nezinhlangano zomphakathi kuzohlala kuyisici esiyinhloko emizamweni yokufeza impumelelo nokugcwalisa izibopho.
Ukungezwani Phakathi Kwemiphakathi: Izinyathelo Zokusiza Ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi kuyinkinga ehambisana nenhlekelele edinga ukunakekelwa ngokucophelela. Lokhu kudinga ukuba wonke umuntu aziswe ngalezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo ukuze siqonde, sixazulule, futhi sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Umongo Wezinkinga Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda imvelaphi yokungezwani. Lokhu kungase kuhlanganise izizathu ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nokuqonda okungafanele, ukuhlukumeza, noma ukungabi nalwazi oluphumelelayo ngempilo nokholo lwemiphakathi ethile. Ukuxoxa namaqembu ahlukahlukene ukuze uqonde izizathu zokungezwani kuyadingeka. Isinyathelo 2: Ukwakha Ukuxhumana Okuphumelelayo Ngemva kokuqonda umongo wezinkinga, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukusungula ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuhlela imihlangano ebanzi, lapho abantu benganikela ngemibono yabo, izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, nezixazululo ezicatshangelwayo. Ukubiza abantu abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene ukuze badlale indima kubalulekile ekwakheni ukuxhumana okunempilo. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlanganisa Umsebenzi Wokubambisana Ukwakhiwa komsebenzi wokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi kulandela. Lokhu kungafaka ezemidlalo, imicimbi yokufunda, nemisebenzi yokuzithandela. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, kodwa futhi kuqinisa imiphakathi ngokuhlanganyela, kwandisa ukunakwa kumaphuzu kufanele ukuphawula. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlonipha Nokwamukela Umehluko Ukuhlonipha umehluko phakathi kwemiphakathi kudinga ukuba abantu baziqonde kahle izinkolo, izikole, namasiko ahlukene. Ukufundisana nokwazana ngezincwadi, izinkolelo, namasiko kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ukwandisa ukufundwa kwezincwadi ezikhuluma ngalezi zihloko kungasiza ukuqinisa ubudlelwano. Isinyathelo 5: Ukwakha Izinsiza Zokuxhumanisa Kubantu abavela ezintweni ezahlukene, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza kuyasiza ekwakheni ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kungafaka izinkundla zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo, namaphrojekthi ahlangene. Ukuze lezi zinsiza zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezikahle zokuvikela abantu nokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uzizwa ethokozile futhi ephathekile. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuvuselela Izinhlelo Nokuqhubeka Nokuxhumana Ngemuva kokwakha izinyathelo ezilungile, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuvuselela izinhlelo. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuhlola imiphumela yokusebenza, ukwakha izindlela zokuphendula ngokushesha, nokuhlela imihlangano ehambisanayo ukuyoqhubeka nokuxhumana. Izimpendulo ezivela kumiphakathi zonke zidinga ukuba ziqashwe, ngoba ziwusizo ekwakheni izinqumo eziphusile. Isinyathelo 7: Ukusebenzisa Ubuchwepheshe Ukuxhumana Ubuchwepheshe bunalokho ukuguqula indlela esixhumana ngayo. Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, amathuluzi afana ne-WhatsApp, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile zingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuyazuzisa phakathi kwemiphakathi, futhi kube lula ukuqonda izidingo zabo. Isinyathelo 8: Uphenyo Lwemiphakathi Ukuze siqonde kahle izinkinga, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa uphenyo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwenza ucwaningo olucacile lwemiphakathi ukuze uthole izizathu ezibangela ukungezwani. Imiphakathi ibhengeze ukungafani nokuthandwa kwabo ukuze uthole engaphezu kokubona. Isinyathelo 9: Ukweseka Imiphakathi Efaka Ubuntu Ukuba nokwesekwa kwemiphakathi nokuqhubeka ezindleleni ezihloniphekile kuzoqinisekisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuqoqa средства, ukuhlinzeka ngoqeqesho, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Isinyathelo 10: Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zikamasipala Ukubambisana nezikhungo zikamasipala nakho kuyasiza ekugcineni ubudlelwano obuzinzile. Lokhu kungafaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezemfundo, umphakathi kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ukuxhumana neziphathimandla zomphakathi kuzokwakha izinkampani ezihlala kancane ezinhle. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, imiphakathi ingase ikhulise ubudlelwano, ihlukanise ukungezwani, futhi yakhe isisekelo esiqinile sokuqonda. Ukubambisana, ukuhlonipha, nokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela kuzogcina kuphumelelisa inhloso yokwakha umphakathi owengeziwe lapho wonke umuntu ezizwe engowabo.
Izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinhlangano enikeza izinsizakalo zempilo ezihlinzekwa kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS inikeza amalungu ayo izinzuzo ezahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nokwelashwa kwezempilo, ezokwelapha, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Umbuzo 2: Ngubani ongafaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS? Impendulo: Abasebenzi bakahulumeni, abathintekayo emsebenzini, bangafaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abaphathiswa, abaqashwe ngqo, kanye nabanye abasebenzi abahlinzekwa nguhulumeni. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izidingo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo, udinga ukuba ube ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele ube nemininingwane ethile, efana ne-ID yakho, ubufakazi bokusebenza, kanye nemininingwane yomndeni uma ufuna ukufaka amalungu omndeni. Umbuzo 4: Ungafaka isicelo kanjani? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo, ungavakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-GEMS, noma ungathintana ne-ofisi ye-GEMS eduze kwakho. Kukhona ifomu lokufaka isicelo elitholakalayo ku-inthanethi, noma ungathola ifomu lokuphrinta. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uqedele isicelo? Impendulo: Isinyathelo sokuqala ukufaka ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kufanele kuhlanganise nemininingwane yakho, izincwadi ezisemthethweni, kanye nezincwadi zokuxhasa. Ngemuva kwalokho, kufanele uthumele ifomu lakho ku-GEMS ukuze kuhlolwe. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe kukhona izindleko zokufaka isicelo? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona izindleko ezihambisana nokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS. Lezi zindleko zingahluka kuye ngohlobo lobulungu ofuna ukuluthola. Kubalulekile ukufunda kahle izincwadi ezihambisana nesicelo ukuze uqonde kahle izindleko. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe ngizothola kanjani impendulo ngesicelo sami? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokuthumela isicelo, uzothola isaziso sokwamukelwa noma sokwenqatshwa. Lokhu kuzothunyelwa kuwe nge-imeyili noma ngeposi, kuye ngendlela oyikhethile. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma isicelo sami sikhanseliwe? Impendulo: Uma isicelo sakho sikhanseliwe, uzothola imininingwane ethile mayelana nezizathu zokukhansela. Ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole izeluleko zokuthi ungabuyisela kanjani isicelo sakho noma ungakwenza kanjani ukuze uthole ubulungu. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe ngingafaka amalungu omndeni esicelweni sami? Impendulo: Yebo, ungafaka amalungu omndeni, njengomkakho, izingane, noma abanye abantu obathandayo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi uthumele imininingwane yabo efana ne-ID, ubufakazi bokuhlala, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Umbuzo 10: Kuthiwani uma ngithola usizo olungafanele ngemva kokufaka isicelo? Impendulo: Uma uthola usizo olungafanele, ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze ubike le nkinga. I-GEMS inezinqubo zokuphendula ezizokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo olufanele. Umbuzo 11: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakala kubalungu be-GEMS? Impendulo: Amalungu e-GEMS athola izinzuzo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokwelashwa kwezempilo, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa iziguli eziphezulu, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezindleko zokwelashwa. Umbuzo 12: Ngabe i-GEMS inezinhlelo ezikhethekile? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihlinzekwa kumalungu, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwempilo, nezinhlelo zokuvikela impilo. Umbuzo 13: Kuthiwani uma ngithanda ukushintsha uhlelo lwami lwe-GEMS? Impendulo: Uma uthanda ukushintsha uhlelo lwakho, ungaxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole izinqubo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi ufake isicelo sokushintsha, futhi kuzothatha isikhathi esithile ukuze kuqedwe. Umbuzo 14: Ngabe ngidinga ukwenziwa ukuhlola ukuze ngibe yilungu? Impendulo: Akudingeki ukuthi wenziwe ukuhlola ukuze ufake isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS. Nokho, uma uthola izinsizakalo ezithile, ungase udinge ukuhlolwa ukuze uthole ukuqinisekiswa. Umbuzo 15: Yini okufanele ngiyenze ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngithola izinsizakalo ezinhle? Impendulo: Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezinhle, kubalulekile ukuba uqinisekise ukuthi ubhalise kahle, ulandele izinqubo ezidingekayo, futhi uthintane ne-GEMS uma udinga usizo. Isiphetho: Ukufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS kuwumsebenzi obalulekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngokuqonda lezi zinqubo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezinhle nezidingo zakho zempilo zaneliseka. Qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ngokucophelela, uthintana ne-GEMS uma kudingeka, futhi ube nesineke ngesikhathi sokuphendulwa kwesicelo sakho.
Lo msebenzi uhlose abantu noma izinhlangano ezithakazelisayo zokubhalisela ikhaya labadala. Gcwalisa ifomu phambi kwezisebenzi zephoyisa. Thola i-receipt uma uthumela ifomu futhi uyigcine njengobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo. Uma isicelo sakho sitholakale singenamvume, uzothola incwadi echaza izizathu zokwenqatshwa kwesicelo sakho. Uma ungavumelani nesinqumo, thumela isicelo sokuphikisa kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi noma ilungu lekhansela ehhovisi lesifunda noma lesifunda echaza ukuthi kungani ungavumelani nesinqumo. Thumela isicelo sokuphikisa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 ukuze uthole impendulo yakho. Kungathatha amasonto amane ukuhlela isicelo sakho. Umsebenzi wezokuxhumana uzomema abanye abantu abafana nezisebenzi zezempilo kanye nezikhulu zikamasipala ukuze baphande endaweni. Umuntu ngamunye omemekile uzobhala umbiko wakhe ngezinto abatholile ngesikhathi sokuphenya. Le mibiko izothunyelwa ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo sokugcina. Ukubhaliswa kuncike emandleni esifunda futhi kuhluka ngesifunda. Ukuhlolwa kwekhaya kokubhaliswa akukhokhiswa. Amafomu atholakala ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze.
Izikhukhula: Umthelela, Izimbangela, Nezixazululo Izikhukhula zenzeka ezindaweni eziningi emhlabeni, zidalela abantu, izilwane, nomhlaba umonakalo omkhulu. Njengoba imiphakathi ibhekana nalezi zimo ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuba sicabange ngalezi zikhukhula, izimbangela zazo, nemiphumela yazo, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izikhukhula zingavela ngezizathu ezahlukene. Ezinye izikhukhula zenzeka ngenxa yokwehla kwemvula okukhulu, lapho izimvula eziphakeme zenza amanzi agcwele ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kudala ukuthi imifula igcwele kakhulu, kukhuphuke amanzi, futhi kube nokukhukhula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhukhula zingavela ngenxa yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokufudumala komhlaba, okwenza izimo zokukhukhula zibe zinkulu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izikhukhula azikhona nje kuphela ngenxa yezinguquko zemvelo, kodwa futhi zixhumene nokuphathwa kabi kwemvelo. Ngokubheka umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uhilela izici eziningi. Okokuqala, umonakalo wezikhukhula ungaba mkhulu. Abantu bahlushwa ukulahlekelwa kwezimpahla, izindlu, nezinsiza. Imiphakathi ethola ukulahlekelwa kwezakhiwo ibhekana nenkinga yokuphila, kanti abanye bangase baphumelele ngempela ukuphuma ezindaweni zabo. Lokhu kudala imiphumela emibi, efana nezinkinga zempilo, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila. Izikhukhula zishiya abanye abantu beshiywa bephila ezimweni ezinzima, kungase kube nezinkinga zokudla, ukuhlaselwa yizifo, futhi ezikhathini eziningi, abantu bacela usizo lwezinhlelo eziphuthumayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhukhula ziba nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni. Umhlaba ubonakala uthinteka kakhulu, izitshalo zibhujiswa, izilwane ziphila ezindaweni ezihlaselwe amanzi, futhi izinsiza zemvelo zishiywa zihlushwa. Lokhu kudala ukulahleka kwezitho ezisemqoka zemvelo, okwenza kube nzima ukuba imvelo ibuyisele izimo zayo. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngempilo yemvelo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile kumphakathi wabantu, njengoba izinsiza zezemvelo zidingeka ukuze siqhubekele phambili. Ngakho-ke, sinesibopho sokwenza izinto ezithile ukuze sinciphise umthelela wezikhukhula. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izinsiza zamanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezivimbela amanzi, ukwenziwa kwemifula, kanye nokuphathwa kokwakha izindawo ezihlanzekile. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni. Umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zezakhamuzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwanda kokwaziswa nokufundiswa kumphakathi kubalulekile. Abantu kufanele bazi izingozi ezihambisana nezikhukhula, bazi ukuthi bangaziphatha kanjani ezimeni ezinjalo. Ukuze sikhulise ukuqwashisa, izinhlelo zokufundisa zidinga ukufakwa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufaka izinyathelo eziphusile ezimweni ezinzima. Ngokuhlanganisa, izikhukhula zibangela umonakalo omkhulu empilweni yabantu, emvelweni, nakumnotho. Kodwa-ke, uma sisebenzisana, sithola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuqonda izimbangela, umthelela, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela, kungasiza umphakathi ukuba uhlale uphephile. Kumele sihlale silungiselela, sikhulise ukuqwashisa, futhi siphumelele ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ngaleyondlela, singakwazi ukuqhubeka phambili, sithuthukise impilo yethu, nemvelo esiphila kuyo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke siphanda izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuvikela, ukuze sithole isixazululo esisha sokuphila. Izikhukhula ziyinsakavukela, kepha uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, singakwazi ukuvikelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo.
Isikhungo samanje sokusebenza ezindaweni zokudoba... Ukuhanjiswa kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane... Abantu abathintekayo emabhizinisini amancane, bedoba ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo ezisemqoka zempilo noma zokuphila noma kungenzeka babambe iqhaza emisebenzini yezezimali encane. Lezi zinduna zingase zisebenze eduze kwasolwandle noma eduze kwemithombo yamanzi futhi zingase zibe nesiko lokudoba. Ngokuvamile, bedoba ngezinsiza zabo zendabuko futhi/noma ngezinsiza eziphansi zobuchwepheshe futhi bazitholele izinhlanzi. Ngokuvamile, umuntu uqobo udoba izinhlanzi ukuze azisebenzise yena kanye nezitho zomndeni, kuhlanganise nomuntu othengisa izinhlanzi kubantu bendawo noma owenza ukuthengiselana ngento ethile esikhundleni sezinhlanzi, kodwa akuhlanganisi umuntu odoba ngokuhweba ngezinga elikhulu. Ukubambisana kubhekisela kubuhlakani phakathi kuk 정부, imiphakathi yasendaweni, abasebenzisi bezinsiza zemvelo, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, nabanye ababambiqhaza ababelana ngamalungelo nomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha izinsiza zezimali. Ukubambisana kuyisihloko esisekelwe emphakathini esisungulwe ukuze kube nokubambisana nohulumeni futhi kusize ekuphathweni kwemvelo nasekubhekaneni nabasebenzisi bezinsiza zemvelo. Okwamanje, izinhlobo ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu zezinhlanzi noma yimaphi amaphrojekthi okudoba asekelwe kulezi zinhlobo zingabhekwa njengomkhakha othile wokuvikelwa nokuphathwa, kuthathwa kokuqonda isimo sezindawo, ulwazi lwesayensi, ubuchwepheshe, ukuhweba, ezomnotho, nezinye izinto ezihlobene. Abantu abake baphuthelwa ngenxa yokucwaswa okusekelwe kubuhlanga, ubulili, noma ukungakwazi. Umsebenzi omkhulu weMnyango uwukuvikelwa, ukuphathwa, nokusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo kwezinsiza zasolwandle. Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukuthuthukisa ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza njengemihlahlandlela yokwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba ezindaweni zokudoba ezincane, kuhlanganisa nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abodoba ukuze baphile kanye nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane, ngaphakathi kwesikhungo esifanele. Le nqubomgomo iletha izimiso, izinqubo, nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ekuphathweni nasekwabiweni kwamalungelo okudoba. Ulwandle luthatha izigaba ezintathu ezibalulekile zabathwebuli bezinhlanzi noma ukudoba: abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abangekho emalini, nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi bezokungcebeleka. Kukhona futhi enye iqembu labathwebuli bezinhlanzi, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abangekho emalini, abangafaki kunoma yiziphi zezigaba ezishiwo ngenhla. Lokhu kudala isidingo sokuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo esemthethweni kanye nesistimu yokuphatha ezobandakanya laba bathwebuli bezinhlanzi. Ukuze kufakwe leli qembu, izinqubomgomo zokwabiwa kwamalungelo akhona ezikhona kufanele zihlolwe futhi izinguquko ezidingekayo ziqalwe ku-MLRA. Ukwabiwa nokuphathwa kwamalungelo okudoba ngezizathu zokuphila okwamanje akukwazanga ukuhlinzeka ngesikhungo esifanele senqubomgomo. Kuzoba udaba lokushintsha umthetho ukuze kuhlukaniswe ukwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba phakathi kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nalabo abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba noma ukuhlinzeka amalungelo kuphela kubathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abangekho emalini. Ulwandle luhlinzeka uMnyango ngamalungelo phezu kokuphathwa kwezinsiza zasolwandle. Ngokwenzela ukwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba, uNgqongqoshe uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo ngaphansi kwesikhungo somthetho ngaphakathi koMnyango ukuze anikeze amalungelo okudoba kubathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abangekho emalini ngaphansi komthetho wezokuphila ophatha izinsiza zasolwandle. Le nqubomgomo izosiza ekulawuleni amalungelo abhekelele ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamalungelo okudoba ezingeni elincane. Ngokomlando, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba badoba izinhlanzi eduze kwasolwandle besebenzisa amathuluzi okudoba aphansi. Kubalulekile ukuqala inqubomgomo nesistimu yokuphatha kubathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane, kanye nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abakhulu. Nakuba ukusetha imingcele yalezi qembu kuyinselele eyinkimbinkimbi, kuboniswe futhi ukuthi kunezinkinga ekwehlukaniseni phakathi kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane, kanye nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abakhulu. Empeleni, kuhluka kusuka ezingeni lapho abathwebuli bezinhlanzi bedoba khona ukudla kuya kulabo abaphethe amabhizinisi amancane futhi ekugcineni kuya ezinkampanini ezincane nezaphakathi. Lokhu kuzohlolwa ukuze kuqashelwe isigaba esisha esibizwa ngokuthi abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba, echazwa njengabantu emabhizinisini amancane, nalabo abathintekayo ekudobeni ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo ezisemqoka zempilo noma abangase bathinteke ekudobeni ezingeni labathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba. Lesi sigaba sabathwebuli bezinhlanzi siqaphela futhi siqonda umehluko phakathi kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane. Ngenxa yenhloso yale nqubomgomo kanye nesimo somthetho samanje, kubalulekile ukuhlela abathwebuli bezinhlanzi kanye nomkhakha njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla. Incazelo ingashintsha uma kwenziwa izinguquko ku-MLRA. Isikhungo samanje sabasebenzisi balolu hlelo lwezezimali ezindaweni zokudoba ezincane siyinkimbinkimbi. Izindawo zokudoba zinezinhlanzi, zisebenzisa amathuluzi okudoba ezendabuko futhi/noma ubuchwepheshe obuphansi, zithinteka ezimweni ezahlukene zokudoba ukuze zisebenzise izinsiza, ubuchwepheshe bokudoba nokuhambisa izinhlanzi obusetshenziselwa ukuhweba ezindaweni zokudoba zasolwandle ngempela, ngesikhathi esithile, noma ngezikhathi ezithile ikakhulukazi ukuze zisebenzise, emakethe yasendaweni noma yesifunda. Abathwebuli bezinhlanzi uqobo baphinde bathinteke kwezinye izenzo ezisebenzayo ezifana nokwakha izixhumi zabo, ukwakha izikebhe, ukulungisa amajini, nokulungisa izinto, okuvula amathuba emisebenzi ehlobene nokudoba kanye namathuba okwenza imali emiphakathini yokudoba. Lezi ziqephu aziphelele, futhi kuboniswe ukuthi hhayi yonke imiphakathi ingase ibhaliswe kulolu hlu. Isithombe semiphakathi yokudoba encane eduze kwasolwandle saseNingizimu Afrika. Lezi ziqephu aziphelele futhi zingase zingabandakanyi yonke imiphakathi. Lezi zihloko zikhonjisiwe zibhaliwe eduze kwenombolo efanele emmapheshini. Uhlu lwemiphakathi yokudoba efakiwe emdwebeni ophakanyisiwe ngenhla. Izinhlobo zezinhlanzi zasolwandle zibhujiswa ngabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane. Izindlela zokudoba nazo ziyahluka. Ezokuvikeleka Kwezenhlalo: Indaba Yezokuvikeleka Kwamamininingwane Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1970, umhlaba wawubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu kwezobuchwepheshe. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuqala zokuqala zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha emisebenzini yabo yansuku zonke. Kodwa, njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula, kwavela nezinkinga ezinkulu — ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokwakha umkhakha wezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane, owaziwa namuhla njenge-cybersecurity. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkampani zokuqala ziqala ukuqonda ukuthi imininingwane yazo ibalulekile. Imininingwane yamakhasimende, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nemininingwane yezezimali kwakuyizinto ezazidinga ukuvikelwa. Ngakho-ke, izinkampani zathola izixazululo ezilula, ezifana nokusebenzisa amakhodi okungena. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokuvikela imininingwane, kodwa kwakukhona okungahambi kahle. Ngemva kweminyaka embalwa, izigebengu zokuqala ze-cyber zavele. Ngonyaka ka-1988, uRobert Morris, umfundi waseMIT, wathumela i-worm yokuqala ye-inthanethi, eyaziwa njenge-Morris Worm. Le worm yahlasela amakhompyutha amaningi, yenza umhlaba uqonde ukuthi izinkinga zokuphepha zikhona. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuthi izinkampani zidinga ukuqinisa izinyathelo zazo zokuvikela imininingwane. Ngemva kwalokho, izinkampani zathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ezinzima. Kwavela izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ezazihlanganisa ama-firewall, izinhlelo zokubika izigameko, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izingozi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba izinkampani ziqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane akukhona nje kuphela ukusebenzisa amakhodi okungena, kodwa kudinga ukuhlela okuhle nokuhlola okuqhubekayo. Ngonyaka ka-2000, umhlaba wabona ukwanda kokuhlaselwa kwe-cyber. Izigebengu zathola izindlela ezinzima zokungena ezinhlelweni, futhi izinkampani zathola ukuthi zidinga ukuvuselela izinqubomgomo zazo zokuphepha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezikhethekile ezibhekelela ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane, ezifana ne-International Organization for Standardization (ISO) ne-Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). Lezi zinhlangano zathuthukisa izindinganiso ezazisiza izinkampani ukuba ziqinise izinhlelo zazo zokuvikela. Ngemva kweminyaka, izinkampani ziqhubekile nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuvikela. Ngonyaka ka-2013, uEdward Snowden waphula udaba olukhulu lwezokuphepha, lapho ethula izimfihlo ezinkulu ze-NSA (National Security Agency) ezazikhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni ubheka imininingwane yabantu. Lokhu kwavula ingxoxo enkulu mayelana nokuvikeleka kwemininingwane, ubumfihlo, kanye nezimfihlo zomphakathi. Abantu baqala ukucabanga ngempela ngempilo yabo ye-inthanethi, futhi izinkampani zathola ukuthi zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile kumakhasimende abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa kudinga ukwakha isiko lokuvikeleka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, ukuze baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Izinkampani ziqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlola izingozi, ukuze ziqonde kahle izindawo ezibucayi ezidinga ukuvikelwa. Namuhla, ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane sekuvele kwaba umkhakha obalulekile emhlabeni. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-blockchain, ukuze ziqinise ukuvikeleka kwazo. Kodwa, izingozi zihlala zikhona. Izigebengu ziyaqhubeka nokuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlasela, futhi izinkampani zidinga ukuhlala ziqaphele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba uqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane ziyaqhubeka nokuba yinto ebalulekile. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi wezinkampani, kodwa kuyinselele esihlangabezana nayo sonke. Njengoba sithuthuka, kufanele siqhubeke sifunda, sihlola, futhi siqinise izinyathelo zethu zokuvikela imininingwane yethu. Ngakho-ke, indaba yezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane iyindaba yokukhula, yokufunda, nokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizodinga ukuhlala sikhumbula ukuthi ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane kuyinselele esidinga ukubhekelwa ngeso elibukhali, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yethu iphephile, futhi izinkampani zethu ziqhubeke zikhula. Lokhu kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile neliphephile.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala KweSamsung Galaxy Ngonyaka ka-2009, umhlaba wezobuchwepheshe wathola umkhiqizo omusha owaqala ukuhamba phambili, iSamsung Galaxy. Le mveliso yabe iyingxenye yeSamsung Electronics, inkampani eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngama-smartphones, amakhompyutha, nezinto eziningi zobuchwepheshe. IGalaxy yabe iyisixazululo esisha sokuxhumana, esihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili nezici ezithokozisayo, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukuhlinzeka abasebenzisi ngolwazi olungcono lokuxhumana. Isahluko 2: Ukukhula KweGalaxy Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwayo, iSamsung Galaxy yathola impendulo enhle emakethe. Ngonyaka ka-2010, iSamsung Galaxy S yethulwa, yenza umhlaba waba nentshisekelo enkulu. Le foni yayinezinzuzo eziningi, ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye ne-Android OS, eyayihlinzeka ngohlelo lokusebenza oluningi. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Isahluko 3: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlobo Ngonyaka ka-2011, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S II, eyayinezinzuzo ezithuthukisiwe ezifana nekhono lokusebenza okusheshayo, isikhumbuzo esikhulu, kanye nekhono lokuxhumana nge-Wi-Fi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha okuxhumana. Ngalesi sikhathi, iSamsung Galaxy yabe isiqhubeka nokukhula, ithola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi emhlabeni jikelele. Isahluko 4: Ukuqhamuka KweGalaxy Note Ngonyaka ka-2011, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy Note, okuyifoni eyayihlanganisa izici ze-smartphone ne-tablet. Le mveliso yabe yenza umhlaba waba nentshisekelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzisi abathanda ukubhala noma ukudweba. I-Galaxy Note yathuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokuthinta, yenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthi basebenzise izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinhlelo eziningi ezizayo. Isahluko 5: Ukukhula Kwezinhlobo Zokugcina Ngonyaka ka-2013, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S4, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S4 yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, iSamsung yabe isiqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izici ezithokozisayo, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezithombe, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezici zokuxhumana. Isahluko 6: Ukuqhubeka KweGalaxy Ngonyaka ka-2015, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S6, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S6 yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, iSamsung yabe isiqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izici ezithokozisayo, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezithombe, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezici zokuxhumana. Isahluko 7: I-Galaxy S8 ne-Galaxy S9 Ngonyaka ka-2017, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S8, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza iGalaxy S8 yaba yinsika yokukhula kweSamsung, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinto eziningi ezizayo. Ngonyaka ka-2018, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy S9, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Isahluko 8: I-Galaxy Z Fold ne-Galaxy Z Flip Ngonyaka ka-2019, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy Z Fold, okuyifoni eyayihlanganisa izici ze-smartphone ne-tablet. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi kwavula umnyango wezinhlelo eziningi ezizayo. Ngonyaka ka-2020, iSamsung yethula iGalaxy Z Flip, eyayinezinzuzo eziningi ezifana nekhono lokuthwebula izithombe ezinhle, isikrini esikhulu, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi zokuxhumana. Isahluko 9: Ukubheka Phambili Namuhla, iSamsung Galaxy isiqhubeka nokuba yinsika yokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe. Izici ezintsha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithokozisayo zenza iGalaxy ibe yinsika yokuxhumana emhlabeni jikelele. I-Samsung Galaxy isiqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olungcono kubasebenzisi, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Njengoba sihamba phambili, sizobona izinguquko eziningi ezizayo, futhi iSamsung Galaxy izohlala ibalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe.
Kukhona amazwe angama-54 e-Afrika, kanti angama-53 awamalungu e-AU. Izwe laseMorocco alilungu le-AU. I-AU ihlanganisa umhlaba wase-Afrika ukuze ibhekane nezinkinga ezifana nezimpi ezibhedayo, ushintsho lwesimo sezulu, kanye nobubha. I-AU ihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu abaningi, abantu, kanye nezomnotho ezizinzile e-Afrika, ikakhulukazi ngokuphelisa izingxabano nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhweba ezisebenzayo. Umbono we-African Union uthi: "I-Afrika ehlangene, ethuthukile, futhi ethule, ephethwe ngababekhona futhi emelela iqembu elikhethekile ezindabeni zomhlaba." Iqinisa ubumbano kulo lonke umhlaba futhi yakha iphupho elihlanganyelwe lokuthuthuka kubantu base-Afrika. Ekugubheni Usuku lwe-Afrika, sithola isikhathi sokuvuselela ukuzibophezela kwethu kithi, emhlabeni wonke, kanye nezindinganiso zethu ezihlanganyelwe nezifiso. Ngokuvumelana nenqubomgomo yangaphandle yaseNingizimu Afrika, ukunakwa okukhethekile kunikezwa kuzo zonke izwe lase-Afrika ngaphakathi komkhakha wezobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Kulonyaka, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika lizobamba i-African Dialogue ngoMeyi 23, kulandela ingxoxo ngoMeyi 25 ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi "Ukuvuselela i-Afrika, Inqubekelaphambili, Nokuthuthukiswa" ukuze kugubhe Usuku lwe-Afrika. "Kusuka Embonweni Kuya Ezenzweni, Ikhasi Elilandelayo le-Afrika." I-World Economic Forum iyinhlangano ezimele ezibophezele ekuthuthukiseni isimo somhlaba ngokubandakanya amabhizinisi, ezombusazwe, ezemfundo, kanye nabanye abak领导 bezentlalo ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zomhlaba, zendawo, nezimboni. I-Afrika Health Exhibition neKhonsathi izoqala ngoMeyi 2011 eJohannesburg Expo Centre, Nasrec, eNingizimu Afrika. I-Afrika Health Exhibition izothatha izinsuku ezintathu ixoxa ngezihloko ezihlukene zezempilo e-Afrika futhi izodonsela izinkulungwane zabachwepheshe bezempilo abavela eduze nasezindaweni ezikude emhlabeni jikelele. Ukugubha Usuku lwe-Afrika kusukela ngoMeyi 27 - 29 eJohannesburg kuzoba nomcimbi owaziwa ngokuthi i-Sanaa Africa, Umoya Wokugubha, ozokhombisa inhliziyo yase-Afrika kanye nomoya ophilayo ophakanyiswe ubuciko obujabulisayo, ukudla, umculo, nokunye okuningi okuvela e-Afrika.
iTakealot: Indaba Yezitolo Zamanje Kwathi ngesikhathi esithile emhlabeni wezohwebo, umqondo omusha wokuthenga wavela. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elikhulu, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho abantu baqala ukujwayela izindlela ezintsha zokuthenga. Phakathi kwalezi zindlela, iTakealot yaphakama njengomholi, iqhakambisa indlela yokuthenga online ngendlela eyayingakaze ibonwe ngaphambili. UTakealot, owaziwa njengomthengisi omkhulu wezimpahla eziningi, waqala njengomqondo ophusile. Abantu abaningi babejolise ekuthengeni, kodwa bahluleka ukuthola izimpahla ezithile kalula. Ngaleso sikhathi, uTakealot waphakamisa isixazululo esisha: ukuthenga online. Lokhu kuvule amathuba amasha, kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola izinto abazidingayo ngaphandle kokuphuma emakhaya. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTakealot yathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. Abantu baqala ukujabulela ukuthenga izimpahla ezahlukene, kusukela ezincwadini, ezemidlalo, ezokugqoka, kuya kwezobuchwepheshe. Umqondo wokuthenga online waba yinto evamile, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala ku-inthanethi ukuze bathole okuthandayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuthengiswa, futhi iTakealot yaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi izinto ezinkulu ziqala ngezinyathelo ezincane. UTakealot akagxilanga kuphela ekuthengeni. Waqala futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengisi abancane. Lokhu kuvule amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kwasiza abathengisi abancane ukuba bathole izimakethe ezinkulu. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu baqonda ukuthi iTakealot ayiyona nje indawo yokuthenga, kodwa iyindawo yokwakha umphakathi. Abathengisi babezithola bejabulile, okuvuse umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi. Njengoba iTakealot iqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo zayo zanda. Ukuncintisana nezinkampani ezinkulu ezithengisa online kwaba yinto ejwayelekile. Nokho, iTakealot yathola indlela yokuhlala ibalulekile. Yaqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo, yenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola izimpahla, futhi yathuthukisa izindlela zokukhokha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwabathengi, abantu baqala ukuthembela kuTakealot njengomthengisi ophumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTakealot yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokulethwa. Abathengi babefuna ukuthola izimpahla zabo ngokushesha, futhi iTakealot yaphendula ngokwakha izinhlelo zokulethwa ezisheshayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola izinto abazidingayo, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthenga okungcono. Abantu babebona ukuthi iTakealot iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, okuvuselela isithakazelo sokuthenga. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, iTakealot yathola izinkanyezi eziningi. Abantu babebona ukuthi le nkampani iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezimpahla ezisezingeni eliphezulu, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthenga okungcono. UTakealot waba yisibonelo sokuthi umqondo omusha ungashintsha kanjani umhlaba wezohwebo. Abantu babebona ukuthi ukuthenga online akusikho nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ekugcineni, iTakealot yaphenduka isikhumbuzo sokuthi izinto ezinkulu ziqala ngezinyathelo ezincane. Umqondo wokuthenga online waba yinto ejwayelekile, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulela ukuthenga izimpahla ezahlukene. UTakealot waba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabambisana kanjani ukuze ufinyelele impumelelo. Ngakho-ke, iTakealot iyindaba yokuphumelela, yokubambisana, nokwakha umphakathi. Ibonisa indlela umqondo omusha ungashintsha ngayo umhlaba, futhi ibonisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenza ndawonye ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle. UTakealot ungumholi, futhi indaba yayo iyakhuthaza, ibonisa ukuthi uma sithanda, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu.
Imiyalelo ye-Debit Order kanye nemininingwane yaseBhange ye-GEMS Umbuzo 1: Iyini i-debit order? Impendulo: I-debit order iwumqondo wokukhokha lapho umthengi evuma ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo akhiphe imali kwi-akhawunti yakhe yebhange njalo ngenyanga. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izindleko ngokukhokha okungapheli. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kufanele ngisebenzise i-debit order ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Ukusebenzisa i-debit order ye-GEMS kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhokha kwemali yokubhalisela izinsizakalo zempilo kwenziwa ngendlela elula futhi enembile. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okuphuthelwa izinkokhelo futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo zakho ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze ngiqale ukusebenzisa i-debit order? Impendulo: Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho yasebhange, okubandakanya inombolo ye-akhawunti, igama lesikhwama, kanye nemininingwane ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuzodingeka ukuze ukwazi ukuhlela i-debit order yakho. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe kukhona izindleko ezihambisana ne-debit order? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezindleko ezithile ezihambisana ne-debit order, ezivame ukuba yizindleko zokuphatha. Kubalulekile ukufunda imiqathango ye-GEMS ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zindleko. Umbuzo 5: Ngithola kanjani imininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Imininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS ingatholakala kwi-website yabo esemthethweni noma ngokuxhumana ne-ofisi yabo yokwesekwa. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola imininingwane yakamuva ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukhokha kumthombo ofanele. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ngingashintsha i-debit order yami uma kudingeka? Impendulo: Yebo, ungashintsha i-debit order yakho uma kudingeka. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukushintsha inani elikhokhwayo, usuku lokukhokha, noma imininingwane yasebhange. Qiniseka ukuthi uxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinguquko ziqhutshelwa phambili. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngithola izinkinga nge-debit order? Impendulo: Uma uhlangabezana nezinkinga nge-debit order yakho, kubalulekile ukuthi uxhumane ne-GEMS ngokushesha. Bazoqonda kahle isimo sakho futhi bakusize ukuze uthole isixazululo esifanele. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe i-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokwesekwa? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokwesekwa ezitholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene, kuhlanganisa nezingcingo, i-imeyili, kanye nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana. Ungathola usizo oludingayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo zakho zihamba kahle. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko ze-GEMS ngenye indlela? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezindlela eziningi zokukhokha, kuhlanganisa ukukhokha ngokuqondile kwi-akhawunti ye-GEMS. Nokho, i-debit order iyindlela elula futhi esebenzayo yokukhokha izindleko zakho zempilo. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa i-debit order ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokuqala zifaka phakathi ukunciphisa imithwalo yokuphatha, ukuqinisekisa ukukhokha okungapheli, kanye nokuthola izinsizakalo zakho zempilo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ungagxila ekuphumeleleni kwakho kwezempilo. Isiphetho: Ukusebenzisa i-debit order ye-GEMS kuyindlela elula, enembile, futhi esebenzayo yokuphatha izindleko zakho zempilo. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilula ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo zakho ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Uma unemibuzo engaphezulu, unganqikazi ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo oludingayo.
Izinqubo Zokuthunyelwa Kwamabulensi Umbuzo 1: Yini i-ambulensi? I-ambulensi iyimoto ekhethekile eyenzelwe ukuhamba abantu abanezimfuno eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi abanikazi bezimo zempilo eziphuthumayo. Lezi zimoto zifakwe ithuluzi lezokwelapha, abahlengikazi, kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo ukuze baphathe izimo eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 2: Yini edinga ukuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi? Ukuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi kudingeka uma umuntu enezimo eziphuthumayo, njengokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo, ukulimala ngesikhathi sokudlala, noma uma umuntu ebonakala engaphilile. Ukusebenza ngokushesha kungasindisa impilo, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukufaka isicelo se-ambulensi ngokushesha. Umbuzo 3: Yini okufanele ukuyenza uma udinga i-ambulensi? Uma udinga i-ambulensi, kufanele uqale uthintane ne-ambulensi ngokushesha. Lokhu kungenziwa ngefoni, uzodinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, efana nendawo okukhona kuyo, isimilo somuntu odinga usizo, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokwelashwa uma ikhona, njengemithwalo ethile abanye bantu abayisebenzisayo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinqubo ezilandelwayo uma i-ambulensi ifika? Lapho i-ambulensi ifika, abahlengikazi bokuqala bayohlola isimo somuntu. Bazosiza umgibeli ngezinto eziphuthumayo, njengokuthola ukuhweba komoya, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyaphila, nokubheka izinkinga ezithile. Uma kudingeka, bangase baqale ukwelashwa ngaphambi kokuhamba. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenziwa ngesikhathi sokuhamba? Ngesikhathi sokuhamba, abahlengikazi baqhubeka nokunakekela umgibeli. Bacela ukuba umgibeli akhulume uma kungenzeka, ukuze bakwazi ukuqapha izimpawu zabo. I-ambulensi ibuye iqinisekise ukuthi umgibeli unendawo yokuphumula, futhi izinhlelo zokwelapha ziqhubeka ngaso leso sikhathi. Umbuzo 6: Kuthiwani uma i-ambulensi ifika esibhedlela? Uma i-ambulensi ifika esibhedlela, abahlengikazi bayokhuluma nezisebenzi zempilo ezibhedlela ukuze banikeze ngemininingwane yakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa isimo somgibeli, izinyathelo ezenziwayo, kanye nemithi ethathwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, umgibeli udluliselwa esibhedlela ukuze aqhubeke nokwelashwa. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinyathelo zokuphepha okufanele zicatshangelwe? Kubantu abahlala eduze, kubalulekile ukugcina umgwaqo uvulekile ukuze i-ambulensi ikwazi ukufika kalula. Futhi, uma uhamba ne-ambulensi, kubalulekile ukuthobela iziqondiso zabahlengikazi, futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ingane noma omunye umuntu ophumile akakukhulumi ngoba kudinga ukugxila ekunakekeleni. Umbuzo 8: Yini engase ibangele ubunzima ekuthumelweni kwe-ambulensi? Izinkinga ezihlobene nokuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi zingabangelwa ukungatholakali kwesikhathi, izimo zomgwaqo, noma ukungaqondi kahle isimo esidingekayo. Kungase kube nzima uma abahlengikazi bekhathazekile ngemininingwane ethile, ngakho kubalulekile ukunikeza yonke imininingwane ngokucacile. Umbuzo 9: Ukubaluleka kokuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi? Ukuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi kubalulekile kakhulu, ngoba kuvumela ukubuyiselwa kwezimo zempilo eziphuthumayo. Njengoba isimo siba sobala, ukuxhumana okusheshayo nokuphumelelayo kungasindisa izimpilo. Abantu kufanele baqonde ukubaluleka kokuthobela izinqubo ezithile ukuze kube nokuphumelela. Umbuzo 10: Kuthiwani ngemali yokuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi? Imali yokuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi ingahluka kuye ngendawo, uhlobo lwe-ambulensi, kanye nezinselelo ezithintekayo. Kubalulekile ukufunda ngemithetho yezezimali ezikhona ngaphambi kokuhamba, ukuze uqonde kahle izindleko ezihambisana nalokhu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukuze zenzeke ngendlela efanele futhi esheshayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde lezi zinqubo, ukuze ukwazi ukusiza uma kubalulekile. I-ambulensi iyinsiza ebalulekile ekusizeni abantu abanesidingo, futhi ukwazi ukuyisebenzisa kahle kungasindisa izimpilo.
Ikomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithole igunya ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo ka-1996 ukuze ikhuthaze futhi iqinisekise amazinga aphezulu okuziphatha kwabantu abaphakathi kwezikhundla ezisebenzela isizwe. Ngonyaka ka-1997, ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi kwamenyezelwa futhi kwathuthukiswa ngokubizelwa kwemifundaze kanye nezomthetho ezingeni lesizwe nelokishi. Kwakubalulekile ukuthuthukisa incwadi yokuhola mayelana nokuziphatha ukuze kusizakale abantu ukuba baqonde kahle futhi basebenzise lokhu. Ngalesi sikhathi seKomishana esisebenzela isizwe, ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukwethula incwadi echaza ukuziphatha okufanele kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyisisekelo esiyisisekelo sokuphatha kanye nezindlela ezifanele zokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Lokhu kuziphatha futhi kuveza izindaba ezifana nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, umthetho, ukuzinikela, ukuvuleka kukahulumeni, ukuziphatha komuntu siqu, nokujabulela okukhethekile. IKomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi icela bonke abasebenzi, kusukela kulabo abaphansi kakhulu kuya kulabo abaphezulu, ukuba baveze ukuqonda okubonakalayo kwenqubo, imigomo, nemiyalo equkethwe ekuziphatheni okufanele. Lokhu akusizi kuphela kodwa kungasivumela ukuba sihlangabezane nezidingo ezifanele zabantu bethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi labo abaphakathi kwezikhundla benze izinto ngokomthetho, baphumelele ekwamukeleni amathuba nezipho, njengoba lokhu kungabonwa njengokukhwabanisa. Sifuna ukuhlabela bonke abaphathi nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla abahileleke ekukhuthazeni ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ngiyakhuthaza ukuthi niqhubeke nisebenza kahle ngaphandle kokuphenduka ezinselelweni zokuthuthukisa ikhodi yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. IKomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithemba ukuthi le ncwadi echazayo izoba yisikhombandlela esifanele ekukhuthazeni ubuqotho nokwethembeka endaweni yokusebenza futhi futhi idale amathuba amahle kithi sonke ukuze sifinyelele isiko lokungabekezelelani nokukhwabanisa eNingizimu Afrika. Ekugcineni, ngifisa bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi baqinisekise ukuthi ukuziphatha okufanele kuhambisana nendlela evumelekile yokuphatha nokuphatha umphakathi futhi bazi kahle ukuziphatha okufanele kanye nale ncwadi echazayo. Umphathi: IKomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Iminyango kazwelonke kanye nezifunda iyasekela ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi echazayo futhi iphinde ibe negalelo elibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni kwayo. Ihhovisi leMphakathi elivikelayo liphinde lenze igalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwalolu documet ngemicabango ebalulekile. Izinhlangano nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bomphakathi zibe nezinhlangano eziningi nemifundaze futhi zenze iziphakamiso ezibalulekile. Ekugcineni, siyabonga ukwesekwa kukahulumeni waseBrithani ekuthuthukiseni izizwe zangaphandle ngokuhlinzeka ngemali yokushicilela le ncwadi echazayo mayelana nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuveza kahle okuqukethwe kokuziphatha okufanele. Ukusungula ukuziphatha okufanele ngokomthetho kudinga isibindi, ukuqonda, kanye nohlelo lwezaga ezisemthethweni. Le ncwadi ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi baqonda kahle lokhu kuziphatha. Le ncwadi ayethuli imithetho emisha noma ilandele isakhiwo nemithetho efana nedokhumenti ephathelene nokuziphatha, ukuze kube lula ukuhlukanisa. Lapho usebenzisa le ncwadi, iminyango kumele izame ukufaka izibonelo zabo ezihambisana nomongo wabo wendawo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kuthathwe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi kuyinqubo ebalulekile futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi kuhlolwe njalo, njengokukhodi yokuziphatha. Ekukhuthazeni amazinga aphezulu okuziphatha okufanele endaweni yokusebenza, abasebenzi kumele bakhuthazwe ukuba bacabange futhi baziphathe kahle. Ngakho-ke, le ncwadi kufanele ibonwe njengethuluzi ekuthuthukiseni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okufundisa kubo bonke abasebenzi. Le ncwadi iphinde iqukate izibonelo ezikhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele endaweni yokusebenza okufanele kuthathwe njengesisekelo sokufundisa nezifundo eziphumelele. Njengomngane wokuziphatha, le ncwadi izosiza ukuqinisekisa ukuzethemba okuqotho nokungakhethi phakathi kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuncane kokuziphatha okuvumelekile nokubonakalayo. Kuyinto evunyelwe ukuthi umuntu ufunda ngokwazi nokwenza. Umsebenzi obalulekile ubekwa kumqashi, ikakhulukazi labo abanamandla okwenza (Abaqondisi kanye neMECs) ezingeni lezombusazwe, kanye nabaphathi ezingeni lonke lezinsizakalo zomphakathi, ukuze kudaleke indawo lapho indlela efanele yokuziphatha ingaboniswa khona futhi isibonelo esihle sithathwe kubo bonke abasebenzi. Isigaba 195 (a) soMthethosisekelo sidinga ukuthi kuthuthukiswe futhi kugcinwe amazinga aphezulu okuziphatha. Mayelana nesivumelwano esivamile (Isixazululo sePublic Service Coordinating Bargaining Council 2 sika-1999), bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi banendima yokudlala ekulandeleni izimiso ezichazwe ekuziphatheni okufanele. Njengoba lokhu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile esakhiwe ekwenzeni kahle nasekuziphatheni kahle, umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi kahle ukuziphatha okufanele. Kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi umgomo oyinhloko wokuziphatha ukuthi okwamukelekayo, okungukuthi ukukhuthaza isibonelo esihle sokuziphatha. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umqashi angase azithole noma abhekane nezinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele mayelana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo, bese ethola icala ngaphansi kwezindawo ezingu-18 kuya ku-27 eziphakanyiswe ekuziphatheni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi zika-1997, uma umuntu engalandeli ukuziphatha okufanele okwakhiwe. Umqashi kumele abe nesithakazelo kwiRiphabhulikhi futhi ahloniphe noMthethosisekelo ngenkathi egcina noma ewamukela imisebenzi abekwe kuyo nsuku zonke. Lokhu kuhambisana neRiphabhulikhi kumele kubonakale njengokuhambisana ne "zinsizakalo zomphakathi" eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisidingo esiyinhloko esiveza ubuqotho bonke abasebenzi. UMthethosisekelo uhambisana nalezi zindaba eziphathelene namalungelo nezinto ezanelisayo kubo bonke obala. Lezi zinkomba zokuziphatha zidinga kuphela ubuqotho babantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi enhlanganweni yokuphatha ngaphansi kohlelo lwezombusazwe. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi umthethosisekelo wamukelwe futhi uhlonishwe bonke. Okwesithathu, bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele baqonde kahle okuqukethwe nenhloso yoMthethosisekelo njengendlela yokuvikela nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle. Isibonelo 1: Abasebenzi bomphakathi ezingeni elihlukene bavunyelwe ukuhwebelana futhi benze iziphakamiso mayelana nezinqubomgomo. Lezi ziphakamiso kumele zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphikisi umoya noma izinhlinzeko ezithile zoMthethosisekelo. UMthethosisekelo mayelana nokuhwebelana nomphakathi nokuvuleka ezisebenzelweni kumele kulandelwe kahle ekwakhiweni okuqhubekayo kwezinqubomgomo. Isibonelo 2: Is
Isahluko 1: Ukuqhamuka Kwefa U-Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa, umholi onothile, wayezalwa ngo-17 kuMfumfu, 1952, eSoweto, eGoli. Umphefumulo wakhe waseSoweto wathola ubuholi bokuqala ngesikhathi engumfana omncane. Uthando lwezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ibhola, lwamphusha ukuba abe nomfanekiso ophelele wesikhumbuzo somphakathi. Wangena eNyuvesi yaseThekwini ukuze aqhubekele phambili ngomsebenzi wakhe, lapho athola khona iziqu zeziko lezomthetho. Ubuye waba ngumholi weqembu labafundi, ethola izifundo zokuhola phakathi kwenkululeko. Isahluko 2: Izikhumbuzo Zomzabalazo Ngaphansi kukaMengameli u-Apartheid, u-Ramaphosa waba nelungelo lokuzimela kwezombusazwe. Wasungula iNational Union of Mineworkers ngo-1982, ethuthukisa izimfuno zabantu basebenza emigodini. Waba yilungu elikhulu emzaneni, ehambisa izwi leshmba ezinsukwini ezinzima. U-Ramaphosa wajabulela ukuqhubekisela phambili imizabalazo yokukhululeka nokuqhakambisa amalungelo abantu. Ngalesi sikhathi, amashumi eminyaka edlule, uhlanga lwakhe lwashaya emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Isahluko 3: Umoya Wokwakha Ngemuva kokuphothula umzabalazo ngempumelelo, u-Ramaphosa waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni kweSivumelwano seKhawunti yePhalamende ngo-1994. Uhambo lwendaba ye-ANC lwamnika ukudonswa kwabantu abaningi, ulethe umoya wezinhloso eziphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waba ngumphakathi ophumelela kakhulu njengomphakathi ophethe izikhwama zezimali, ubeka izindawo eziningi zokusebenza. Isahluko 4: Uhlanga Lokuphumelela Ngemuva kokusebenza emkhakheni wezomthetho, u-Ramaphosa waqala ukufaka izinyathelo zempumelelo emkhakheni wezomnotho. Waba yinsika yebhizinisi, efaka izimali ezinkulu ezinzulwini zamabhizinisi. Uqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kokuhweba phakathi kokuhlanga, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banethuba lokwakha. Waziwa njengomholi onomsebenzi, owazalayo ngobunhlangothi bokuphila kahle. Isahluko 5: UBusisiwe Bokubusa Ngo-2018, u-Ramaphosa wathola ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokuphatha njengomengameli. Ubuye waba umholi ophakamisa izinjongo zomphakathi. Wayesebenza njengomfundi onothile emkhakheni wezokucebisa, eqinisekiswa ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Waqhubeka efundisa abantu ukunemba nokukhululeka, ebhizinisi, futhi ewusizo kumphakathi. Isahluko 6: Ukubukela Phambili U-Cyril Ramaphosa uphinde wathokozisa umphakathi ngokuphatha kokunga, efaka izinyathelo zokuphila kahle kwabaningi. Emagqumeni ezintweni ezinzima, uphishekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, ukuvuselela isitoko sokuqasha, nokwakha imisebenzi. Umazisi wakhe ubonisa ubuholi obunomgomo, okwenziwa ngothando nomfutho, ngale ndlela ezokwenza ube ngumholi owaziwayo emhlabeni wonke. Isahluko 7: Ubulungiswa Obunokuthula U-Ramaphosa uhlola imiphumela yokusebenza ngenhlonipho kubantu bakhe. Ubuholi bakhe bukaqhubeka nobumbano, nempumelelo ye-South Africa ikakhulukazi eminyakeni ezayo. Uhlanga olungabaziyo lwesabelo sokuqala sokwakha. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, uthando lwakhe lobumbano lwamqoka, sifuna ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizakhe pobumbene, ungalobi isithombe esithembisa izimanga eziningi. U-Cyril Ramaphosa uyinsika yokwakha umphakathi omuhle, kwaye iqhubeka iqhubeka nelanga elisha. Njengenjini yomphakathi, uhlanga lwakhe luyeza, ludinga ukwakha, luya emhlabeni onobubele. Uphakamisa ukuhamba phambili, ebeka umphakathi uqobo fell, umise umsebenzi oqhakazile, okhuluma ngempilo yesizukulwane esisha. Ubuyaqhubeka ukuphila futhi ubambe iqhaza emiphakathini, eqhubeka idebenze nemicabango ezobuholi, ubuyaqhubeka nomfutho wokwakha ikhaya elisha elizokhushulwa ngokuthula.
Izinsuku Zokuhlupheka ZikaMnu. Njabulo Esigodlweni esisemaphandleni, kwakukhona indoda eyaziwa kakhulu ngelikaMnu. Njabulo. Wayeyindoda ejabulisayo, eyaziwa ngama-hlaya akhe aphathelene neziphuzo, izilwane, kanye nezimo zansuku zonke. Ngama-akhawunti akhe, wayekwenza kube sobala ukuthi bukhona ububanzi bokuthola ukuhleka empilweni, noma ngabe izimo zikhathazekile kanjani. Nokho, uNjabulo wayengaphansi kwezimo ezithinta ubuhlungu. Wayengumngane ezikhathini ezithile, kodwa futhi wayenamakholwa akhe ezinsukwini lapho efuna ukuphumula, njengoba impilo yansuku zonke imthukuthelela. Kodwa, kwaba nosuku oluthile olwakuzoqinisekisa ukuthi uNjabulo uzokwazi ukujabulisa abantu. Ngesikhathi esebenza, uNjabulo wathola ithuba lokuphumula. Waphuma ehholo elikhulu, ehamba emfuleni, ukuze ahlale ezungezile. Kulapho wahlangana noMnu. Mpumelelo, umphakathi wendawo owaziwa njengezinto ezimbi. UMnu. Mpumelelo wayengumuntu ongajabuli, futhi uNjabulo wayazi kahle ukuthi uma engatholi ukujabulisa uMnu. Mpumelelo, lokho kuzoba ukudabuka okukhulu. "Sanibonani, Mnu. Mpumelelo!" kusho uNjabulo, ehlikihla isandla sakhe ngothando. "Ngabe usuku lokugcina luhamba kanjani?" "Ngabe uthanda ukuhlupha abantu?" ubuza uMnu. Mpumelelo, nomoya opholile. "Ngicela ungawusiqhenyanga esikhathini esizayo." Njabulo wacela ithuba lokukhuluma kahle, wathi: "Ngabe ubona ukuhamba kwezingane?" Wabhekisela ezinganeni eziphuma emakhaya zinemidlalo yazo emithwaleni yamanzi, zigijima nokuhlekisa. Ubuze: "Ngabe umama wakho ungekho emzini? Ngabe inja isithanda izinyoni?" UMnu. Mpumelelo wathuleka, kodwa uNjabulo wayeqhubeka. "Ngabe ubona lezi zinyoni zikhwela phezulu? Umoya ovunguza – ungubani ocabanga ukuthi ungabe ungababa?" Ngaphandle kokuhlekisa, uNjabulo wabona uMnu. Mpumelelo ephephuka phansi, ezama ukunciphisa imizwa yakhe. Lokhu kwaba yinsizwa ethusayo emizweni yaKwaZulu, noma ngezinga elingaphansi. "Ngabe ubona kahle, uMnu. Mpumelelo? Ngiyazi ukuthi ungumuntu omncane kakhulu, kodwa kufanele ungahluleki! Gijima! Gijima! Gijima!" kusho uNjabulo, ehlekisa. "Uma ungathola isiko, ungakubona kahle. Ngabe ungaphi? Ngokufanayo, nansi indaba." UNjabulo waqala ukwethula izindaba ezihlekisayo. Wayehlekisa ngezitshalo, izinyoni, izilwane ezincane, kanye nabantu abavakashela emfuleni. Izwe laligcwele ukwehluka, futhi uMnu. Mpumelelo ekugcineni wahamba phakathi kokuncipha, egijima phambili kancane. Ngemva kwalesi sikhathi, uNjabulo waphinde wawela emaphandleni, wathola uZiningi, osana ojabulelayo, elungisa isidlo, eyaziwa ngamasondo wakhe. UNkulunkulu, kubonakala, washaya uMnu. Mpumelelo, kwaba ukuhlekisa, kwashintsha izimo zomuntu omubi. "Njengoba ungena emnyango," kusho uNjabulo, "uma uMnu. Mpumelelo ehlala endlini, bonke bazobona umehluko. Abangani bethu, jabulani!" Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNjabulo waqaphela ukuthi izingane zazikhula zinobuchule bokuhlekisa. Zazifuna ukujabulisa uMnu. Mpumelelo, begijima emkhathini. Ubuze, "Ngabe zingakwazi ukukhipha izinyoni ezivela emisebenzini?" Ngemva kwezinye izinsuku ezihamba phambili, umoya ohlanzekile wanqamuka emazingeni obuhlungu. UNjabulo, owazi kahle izinkanyezi, waphumelela, wathola ukuthi kukhona amandla okuhlekisa. Phakathi nezinsuku zehlazo, uMnu. Mpumelelo wayebona umehluko. Ubuza kancane, "Ngabe ngabe lezi zinsuku ziyakubona kahle?" Waphendula: "Ngabe uthanda ukujabulisa abantu? Ngabe inkanyezi osanda kuyibona iyihlaya?" Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, ubuhlungu bayo bujela kwesinye isikhathi. Kwandiswa ubudlelwano bomndeni, nokuqonda okubuhlungu. Njabulo, onguMnu. Mpumelelo, wagcizelela uthando. Kodwa-ke, uNjabulo wathola ngaphakathi komndeni, okwakuhlekisa. Umanzi owaziwayo kwaphela umfundi owayengazi ukuthi uyavuma ukuthi ungabe esebenza. Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zatholakala, uNjabulo wathola impumelelo. Njengoba sibona uMnu. Mpumelelo, izinsuku zaba zihlekisa. Ulwazi lwabo lwenza umphakathi wathokozisa ikakhulukazi. Kwakungelula, kodwa uNjabulo wathola ukuthi ibhande labantu livuselela izinsuku zomoya. Hamba ujabule, uNjabulo wathola isikhathi sokuhlola, ehlanganyela nezinsuku ezithile. Lokhu kwakuhlekisa, futhi umphakathi ubongela uMnu. Njabulo, owathola umuzwa wokuthokozisa nokuqhamuka nokukhumbula ukuthi ukuhleka kuholela empilweni.
Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni: Ingxoxo noMnu. Dlamini, Umsebenzi Kahulumeni Umqondisi Umqondisi: Sawubona, Mnu. Dlamini. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Sifuna ukukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, okuyizingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni. Ungangichazela ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezibangela lezi zingxabano? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, umqondisi. Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni zikhona ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, kunezinga eliphakeme lokunganeliseki phakathi kwabantu abasebenza kuhulumeni. Abanye bahlala bejabule, kodwa abanye bahlala bephikisana nezinga lamaholo abawatholayo, okudala ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabo. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kucacile. Ungangichazela kabanzi ngezizathu ezithile ezibangela lezi zingxabano? Mnu. Dlamini: Impela. Okokuqala, sinesimo sokungalingani emiholweni. Abasebenzi abaninzi baphikisana ngokuthi abatholi imali efanele uma kuqhathaniswa nemisebenzi abawenzayo, okudala umuzwa wokuthi abanye baphakanyiswa ngaphezulu kwabanye, okwenza kube nzima ukuvumelana. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqedwe lezi zingxabano? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo. Uhulumeni uzama ukuhlela izinhlelo zokubuyekeza amaholo, kodwa lokhu akuhambisani kahle. Kukhona nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nabantu, kodwa imiphumela ayikabi yinhle. Abantu badinga ukubona izinguquko ezithile. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyavuma ukuthi kukhona intuthuko, kodwa kudinga isikhathi. Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezinkulu, uhulumeni kufanele abheke izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukucacisa izinqubomgomo, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale emsebenzini? Mnu. Dlamini: Lokhu kuncike kakhulu ekutheni abantu baneliseka kangakanani. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi uhulumeni uyawazisa umsebenzi wabo, bazoba nesifiso sokuhlala. Kodwa uma bezwa ukuthi akekho omqondisa, bazoba nezinye izinketho. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkinga zamaholo zingathinta kanjani ukusebenza kahle komsebenzi kahulumeni? Mnu. Dlamini: Impela, izinkinga zamaholo zingathinta kakhulu ukusebenza. Uma abantu benganeliseki, bazoba nekhono elincane lokusebenza kahle, okungaholela ekutheni izinsizakalo ezitholakala kubantu zingabi sezingeni eliphezulu. Uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi abantu baneliseka ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona iziphakamiso ozithanda ukuzenza ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo samaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, ngincoma ukuthi uhulumeni enze ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze aqonde izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphendule kahle. Futhi, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubuyekeza amaholo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bazothola malini. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabantu kuzokwenza kube lula. Umqondisi: Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubabukeli bethu mayelana nezinkinga zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinkinga zamaholo zidinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela. Uhulumeni kufanele ahlale ethintana nabantu ukuze aqonde izidingo zabo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngiyabonga. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba siqonde kangcono izinkinga zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, umqondisi. Ngiyajabula ukuba lapha.
Ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi lwemvelo kwezomnotho. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nezobuchwepheshe eziphilayo zamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga leziqhamo ezintsha. I-National IKS Fund isebenza njengomphakathi wezimpahla zokuqonda lapho kufanelekile, futhi futhi njengomxhumanisi nomhlinzeki wezinsiza zomthetho ezidingekayo zokugcina zomphakathi wemvelo nezinye izithakazelo ezibambe ulwazi. Uhulumeni weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika uzibophezele ekwaziseni, ekukhuthazeni, ekuthuthukiseni, ekuvikeleni, nasekuqinisekiseni i-IKS. Le nhlinzeko iyimiphumela yokuxoxisana okuningi, ucwaningo, ingxoxo, nokubamba iqhaza kwabathintekayo abaningi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabachwepheshe nabaphathi boLwazi Lwemvelo (IK) kubalulekile. Lokhu kuqhutshwa yizimiso ezivamile zezimfanelo zomuntu futhi kufaka imibono ebalulekile yase-Afrika efana ne-ubuntu kanye ne-batho-pele. Le miphumela ifaka phakathi ukulwa nokucwaswa futhi kufanele iqhubeke ikhuthaza inkululeko ngezinhlelo zolwazi ezivela ekwakheni amandla nasekufihleni. Izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo ezakhiwe nezibhekelelwe abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika zibonisa izinhlelo zezempilo nezokukholelwa kwengxenye enkulu yomphakathi. Lokhu kulwazi lwemvelo kubonakala ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kusukela emicimbini yamasiko nezokukholelwa kuya ezindleleni zokulima nasezinyathelweni zezempilo. "Ulwazi lwemvelo" (IK) lusetshenziswa ngendlela efanayo "nolwazi lwamasiko" kanye "nolwazi bendawo" ukuze kuhlukaniswe phakathi kokuthuthukiswa kolwazi nezindawo ezibukekayo zomphakathi wemvelo ezivela ezinhlelweni zolwazi "zamazwe omhlaba" ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo, ezikhungweni zocwaningo lukahulumeni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele, kwesinye isikhathi ezibizwa ngokungafanele "izinhlelo zolwazi zaseNtshonalanga." Ngaphansi kokucwaswa, Izinhlelo zolwazi (IKS) eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezobuchwepheshe ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo ezinjalo zikhawulelwe futhi zihlukaniswe. Lokhu kunomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni komnotho nasemphakathini eNingizimu Afrika, kunomphumela opholile ekuthuthukiseni komphakathi, kwezamasiko, nakwezomnotho kubantu bayo abaningi. Ukuhlolwa ngakunye kwezinga lezenhlalo nezomnotho nezinkomba zezempilo kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bendabuko bakwi sikhala esinzima. Izinselelo ababhekana nazo zinezinga lokukhulisa futhi ziqhubeke ziqinisa ukungalingani phakathi kwabantu bendabuko nezinye izingxenye zomphakathi eminyakeni ezayo ngaphandle kokuthi kube nemizamo emikhulu manje yokubhekana nokungalingani okuqhubekayo, okungafinyelelwa ngaphandle kokuhlonipha izinhlelo zolwazi zomphakathi wemvelo kanye nolwazi lwamasiko olucacile phakathi kwazo, njengemikhakha yezinyanga zendabuko nolwazi lwamasiko olubanjwe ngabesifazane emphakathini. Ukuhlanganisa nokugubha imibono yase-Afrika ezinhlelweni zolwazi eNingizimu Afrika akukhona nje udaba lokulungisa. Kungasiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo zokucwaninga ezintsha nezakhiwo zemibono, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwamanje. Ukusungulwa kweminyaka eyinkulungwane yokucindezelwa, ekhona emnothweni we-IK ongaphikiswa, kukhuphukile phakathi kwemiphakathi kanye nezakhamuzi. Iningi le-IK liqhubekile liqinisekisa ubukhona bayo futhi liqhubekile lihlinzeka ngolwazi emicabangweni yase-Afrika mayelana nezindaba ezifana nobuciko, umculo, ukholo, nemfundo, ubuholi, ubulungiswa, impilo, nokulima. Ukuzazi nokuhlonipha isiko, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlomula, kuqhubekile kukhulu futhi kuqinisiwe ngokubhekisiswa okuqhubekayo kwabaphethe i-IK, ngaphandle kokuthi indawo ngayinye ibe yük yokuhlupheka kwezokuxhumana nezombusazwe kanye nezinkumbulo zokucindezelwa nokucwaswa. Ngokuvamile, abesifazane bangama-vanguard walezi zinhlelo zolwazi. Impumelelo yedemokhrasi ngaphezu kwezinselelo zokucwaswa idinga ukuba sakhe isakhiwo sikazwelonke sokuthuthukiswa okuphumelelayo kwezinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo. Lesi sakhiwo esivumela sizokwenza ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ngokuphelele amandla abo emphakathini futhi bakhe ibhlogo eliyisisekelo lokufeza zonke izinhloso nezifiso zikazwelonke ngempumelelo. Ukusebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nezobuchwepheshe eziphilayo zamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga leziqhamo ezintsha. Le nhlinzeko ifaka phakathi iminyango ehlukahlukene kaHulumeni ehlotshaniswa nezibopho ezinomthelela ukuze kuhanjiswe izethulo eziphumelelayo ezinqubomgomeni nasezinhlelweni ezihlukene. Inani leziqhamo ezintsha ezinhlelweni (emnyangweni wezempilo, isibonelo, noma mayelana nocwaningo lwe-IKS, usebenzisa i-NRF) sefinyelelwe. Isidingo sesakhiwo sezinqubomgomo esibanzi esisekela isizinda sesikhumbuzo sikhonjiswe njengokwenziwa kwezinyathelo ezisebenzayo ezithathwa ngokuqondile yiKomidi Elijwayelekile eliholwa yi-DST. Ngakho-ke, le nhlinzeko iqhubeka ngesisekelo sokuthi izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo, ngokwemvelo yazo, zidinga indlela "eyihlanganisayo." Imisebenzi eqhubekayo nokwakha kwezinye izinkalo kufanele imele ukuqonda okuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe isendaweni futhi isakhiwo somthetho sesisunguliwe. Ukukhuthaza nokuhlinzeka ngamalungelo okushicilela umculo wendabuko nezindlela zobuciko ezikhombisa umsebenzi owenziwayo. Umthetho wezobuchwepheshe bezempilo bezamasiko usunguliwe futhi ukhuthaza ukusungulwa komzila wokulawula ozobizwa ngokuthi iNational Health Professionals Council, ezobhekelela imisebenzi yabantu abalinganiselwa ku-200,000 eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuqinisekile, ngeke kube nokwenzeka ukukhetha ngokuphelele kulolu hlelo lwezinqubomgomo ukukhetha abenzi bezinqubomgomo emikhakheni enezici zayo ezihlukile. Nokho, kuzodingeka ukudala eminye imisebenzi emisha ukuze kusekelwe ukusebenza okuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Le ngxenye ebalulekile yesakhiwo sezinqubomgomo idinga ukusungulwa kwezinkundla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinise, kuthuthukiswe, futhi kubandakanyeke kwi-IKS, kanye nokwakha umqondo womphakathi ukuze kuhlanganiswe izinhlobo ezahlukene zabachwepheshe. Umphakathi osekelayo, ongase ube uhlobo lwezinkampani, ukusiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela, ukuvikela, nokuhlinzeka ng rewards ezivela emiphakathini ephethe izimpahla zokuqonda nezinye izimfanelo zomphakathi ngaphandle kolwazi lwemvelo. Kwezinye izimo, imiphakathi noma izinhlangano zingakhetha ukusungula izimali zabo ukuze zisebenzise le njongo, lapho kudingeka khona inzuzo ecacile noma ukubuyiselwa. Isici esiyinhloko senqubomgomo sizoba ukusungulwa kohlelo lokurekhoda olusemthethweni lwe-IK. Uma iNingizimu Afrika ikhetha ukufaka i-IK emphakathini obanzi noma izama ukugcina uhlobo lokuvikela, uhlelo lokurekhoda lunomthelela omkhulu.
Le nsizakalo ibheka ukuthi umfaki-sicelo ngempela ungum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngaphambi kokuthi anikezwe idokhumenti yokukhomba. Lokhu kusebenza kubantu abangu citizen baseNingizimu Afrika kuqala ngaphambi kokuhamba phesheya bese befisa ukuvuselela isimo sabo sokuba ngu citizen. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sifakwa ngaphandle kwezwe. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-529. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-1664 ukuze ugweme ukulahlekelwa ilungelo lakho lokuba ngu citizen waseNingizimu Afrika. Imininingwane yomfaki-sicelo iqinisekiswa kuluhlu lwabantu abahlala ezweni. Izicelo zingathatha isikhathi sokucubungula esingamaviki ayeight kuya kweyishumi nambili.

### UShaka Zulu: Umholi Ohlonishwa NgesiZulu UShaka Zulu, igama elivelele, libonisa ugqozi olukhulu lwezinkanyezi ezingakaze ziphume emlandweni wezizwe. Kwakukhona isikhathi sokuqala lapho uShaka Zulu, iNkosi enkulu, waphuma khona. Impilo yakhe akukhulumi kuphela ngezindawo ezisemphumalanga yeNingizimu Afrika, kodwa iphinde ibonise izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Kukhona izinkolelo eziningi ngomlando wakhe, abanye bethi wazalwa ngo-1787, emndenini ophakathi kweSilo esidala, iNkosi uSenzangakhona, okwakuyisizathu sokuthi kube nezinto eziningi ezinkulu ezenzakalayo. UShaka wayengumfana ophakeme, futhi kunzima ukuphawula ukuthi ngabe wayefuna kanjani ukwakha umphakathi wakhe. Ubuhlakani bakhe bukhombisa ukuthi ubhuti wakhe, uDingiswayo, wamsiza kakhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo. UShaka wayelungisa ibutho labesilisa ngezindlela ezintsha, okwakuholela ekutheni aqhubeke nokwakha amandla amaZulu. Lokhu kwashintsha umhlaba wabo. Kuphakanyisiwe ukuthi uShaka nabantu bakhe babekhuluma ngothando, futhi wayeqonda kakhulu ngesidingo sokuvikela umphakathi. Wayezama ukuhuthula izinkinga ezihambisana nezinhlanga, ngakho umqondo wokubambisana waba yinkinga enkulu kwazulu. Waqhubeka nokwakha izinsika ezazidala ukubakhulula ezimeni ezinzima, futhi izimpi zaziyinsakavukela. UShaka wayazi ukuthi akufanele alale, kodwa kumele aqhubeke nokuvikela abantu bakhe. Izimpi ezinkulu zenzeka phakathi kwezizwe, phakathi kweZulu nabaseNguni, futhi uShaka wavimba izitha zakhe. Lokhu kwahlala kuchaza umbono wakhe omkhulu wokuqonda nokuqhuba impilo izakhamuzi ezibandakanyekayo. Ngemva kokuhlangana nezinkinga eziningi, kwavuma ukuthi uShaka wayengumholi onobuhlakani obuhlukahlukene. Wazi ukuthi ubuholi akukhona nje ukuzulazula, kodwa kufanele unikeze abantu bakho lokho okubahlonipha, uthokozise futhi ubanike ithemba. Lokhu kwalesa izimpumelelo eziningi. Nokho, akusoloko kuhle; uShaka wahlushwa nezinkinga ezivela kubaculi nabaholi abavela kumadodana akhe. UShaka wayesebenzisa izindlela ezinzima ukuze afinyelele abantu bakhe, futhi wayenobuhlakani obukwazi ukuzenza zandanisa izikhumbuzo zakhe. UShaka Zulu, owayengumholi omkhulu, wakhumbula izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa wayesazi ukuthi ukukholwa njalo kuyadingeka. Ezakhamuzini zakhe, wayefuna ukwakha umphakathi onothando, futhi wanikela ngothando lokubuyisela. UShaka uhlala enhliziyweni yamaZulu, ezokhuluma ngothando, umoya nemikhuba, futhi kujabulisa ukukhumbula uShaka njengomholi ohlonishwayo.
Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngabazimele okhethweni Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yaphakamisa isinqumo esibalulekile mayelana nezikhundla zabazimele okhethweni, esithinteka kakhulu ezinqubweni zokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Lesi sinqumo sithinta izigaba eziningi zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi abavoti, abezindaba, kanye nezikhungo ezihlukene ezibhekelele ukhetho. Izinqumo ezithathwe yile nkantolo ziqinisekisa ukuthi abazimele, abavota ngokuzimela, bangathola ithuba elilinganayo lokubamba iqhaza ezinkampanini zokhetho. Lokhu kuza ngemva kokukhathazeka okukhulayo ngokuqhubeka kokhetho olungafanele, lapho abanye abazimele bephikisana nezimo ezithile ezibekwe yizikhungo ezibhekelele ukhetho. Umgwaqo walesi sinqumo uqhamuka ngesikhathi lapho abezindaba, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele bezama ukucacisa izinqubo zokhetho. Izinselelo ezitholakele zifaka phakathi ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezanele, ukungabi namathuba alinganayo, kanye nezithiyo ezithile ezibekwe ezikhungweni zokhetho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abavoti bakwazi ukukhetha kahle, futhi kube nezinqumo ezithinta umphakathi wonke.” Uhlanga lwezombusazwe luphendule ngokushesha kulokhu, lapho abezindaba baphawula ukuthi lesi sinqumo sizoba nomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini ezizimele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abavoti bazi kahle ukuthi bangakhetha bani.” Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, izikhungo ezihlukene zikhuthaza abazimele ukuba baphathe izikhundla ezibalulekile, ukuze kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abavoti bakwazi ukukhetha kahle. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abavoti bazi kahle ukuthi bangakhetha bani, futhi lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele.” Izinqumo ezithathwe yile nkantolo zikhombisa ukuthi umthetho kufanele ube yisisekelo sokuphatha izinqubo zokhetho.
