Imiphumela Yezivivinyo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Empilweni Yomfundi Ngokwenyama, imiphumela yezivivinyo ithathwa njengophawu lokuphumelela noma ukwehluleka empilweni yomfundi. Lezi zifundo zenzeka ezikhathini ezithile, futhi abanye bahlala bejabule, kuyilapho abanye bephinde bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi. Imiphumela iyinsika yokuhlola umsebenzi owenziwe ngesikhathi sokufunda, kodwa umqondo wayo udinga ukuba ubhekwe ngokujulile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo ayisho ukuthi umphumela walezi zifundo yindawo yokugcina. Ezinye izici, ezifana nokusebenza kwezemfundo, ukuzimisela, kanye nekhono lokucabanga okujulile, zibalulekile. Abafundi bahlala befundiswa ukuthi kufanele basebenzise lezi zici ukuze baphumelele empilweni, hhayi kuphela ezivivinyweni. Ngakho-ke, uma umfundi engaphumeleli, akufanele abone lokho njengokwehluleka. Kungase kube nemibandela ethile ethinta impumelelo yakhe, njengezimo zomndeni, ukungabi namathuba, noma izinkinga zempilo. Okwesibili, imiphumela yezivivinyo ingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yengqondo yomfundi. Ukuhluleka emivivinyweni kungaholela ekudabukeni, okungaholela ekuhluphekeni kwengqondo noma ukudangala. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yingozi, ikakhulukazi uma umfundi engakwazi ukuhamba phambili nezimo ezinzima. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi othisha, abazali, nabangane babe nesineke nokuqonda lapho imiphumela ingeyinhle. Ukubonisana, ukufundisa, nokukhuthaza kufanele kube yizinyathelo ezibalulekile ukuze umfundi azitholele ukuzethemba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa izifundo eziningi ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukwazi ukubona ukuthi yini engasebenza, nokuthi yini engasebenzi. Umfundi kufanele afunde ekutheni ukuphumelela akukhona kuphela ekubhaleni iziphumo ezinhle, kodwa futhi nasekufundeni eziphumeleni eziphansi. Ukubhekisisa lezi ziphumo kuyavula amathuba okwenza ngcono, futhi kuyakwenza umfundi akhuthazeke kakhulu. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuba afune usizo, agcizelele ezindaweni azidingayo, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima. Bese sikhuluma ngendima ebalulekile yokuhlonza nemiphumela. Uma umfundi ethola imiphumela emihle, lokhu kudinga ukuba kube yithuba lokukhuthazwa. Ukuphumelela kudinga ukubonwa, kudingeka kuxhaswe, ukuze umfundi azizwe eqinisekile. Lokhu kungenza umfundi abheke phambili, agxile ezifundweni zakhe, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze athole okungcono. Noma kunjalo, uma umphumela ungavumi, umphumela ungase ube yithuba lokuba umfundi abone ukuthi akakafiki lapho afuna khona. Ngokujulile, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibalulekile, kodwa kufanele kube kucace ukuthi akufanele kube yisithiyo sokuphumelela. Umfundi kufanele azitholele indlela yakhe, ahlaziye imiphumela, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza. Lokhu kuyokwenza kube lula ukuba akhuthaze abanye, futhi adale umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ubuchwepheshe, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokuxhaswa kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ekugcineni, imiphumela yezivivinyo iyinsika yokufunda, kodwa akufanele ibonakale njengosizo lokugcina. Kuningi okungafundwa, nokufundwa kuphumelelisa abanye ukuze benze kahle empilweni. Njengoba sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokufunda, kubalulekile ukuqonda imiphumela njengengxenye encane ye-journey yempumelelo, hhayi ukuphela kwayo. Ngakho, asivumelani ukuba imiphumela ibe yinkinga, kodwa siyivumele ukuba ibe yithuba lokukhula, ukufundisa, nokuphumelela.
Ngokwehlelo lokubuyisela ubulungiswa oluvimbela ubugebengu, izenzo ezinjalo zixazululwa ngohlelo lwendabuko lokwahlulela. Uma kutholakala ukuthi umsolwa unecala yinkantolo, abasolwa bahlawuliswa ngokubekwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokubhekwa kwiMnyango Wezokulungiswa, bathola isigwebo senhlawulo, bakhokhe inhlawulo, noma inhlanganisela yalezi zijeziso. IMnyango Wezokulungiswa iphinde yanquma ukusungula isu elaziwa ngokuthi iRestorative Justice njengomnikelo oyinhloko. Lolu hlelo lusekelwe ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu kuyisenzo esiqondiswe kumvictim nasemphakathini, futhi luhloselwe ukubhekana nezinselelo ezikhona ngaphakathi kohlelo lobulungiswa. Aluhloselwe ukufaka esikhundleni sokwahlulela okuphikisanayo kumsolwa kodwa kunalokho ukuqinisa uhlelo lobulungiswa jikelele. Yini iRestorative Justice? NgokweMnyango Wezokulungiswa, iRestorative Justice ingachazwa njengesenzo esiqinisa umvictim noma abavictim abahluphekayo ngenxa yobugebengu. Lolu hlelo lugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuba nezindima zabavictim, imindeni, kanye nezakhamuzi zomphakathi ngokubenza babe yingxenye yenqubo yokwahlulela. Luhloselwe ukubamba abasolwa baphendule, ngenkathi bevumela ukuthi babhekane nalabo abalimazile futhi benze imizamo yokubabuyisela esimweni sabo sangaphambili, kuhlanganise nokubhekana nezindleko nezingozi ezitholakele. Lunikeza ithuba lokuxazulula, ukuxhumana, ukubonisana, nokuxazulula izinkinga okungaholela ekwelapheni, esimweni sokuphepha esingcono, futhi kukhuthaze indlela elula yokuhlanganisa labo ababephakathi kokuhlala ejele emiphakathini. IRestorative Justice igcizelela ukubaluleka kokuphakamisa indima yabavictim kanye nomphakathi ngokubenza babe yingxenye yenqubo yokwahlulela, ivumela abasolwa ukuba babhekane ngqo nalabo abalimazile futhi idala amathuba okuxhumana, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izinkinga. IRestorative Justice ihluke kakhulu kuhulumeni wokwahlulela. Ibuye ibe ubulungiswa obwenza umnikelo obalulekile futhi ibonelela ngethemba lesikhathi esizayo, hhayi kuphela ngalokho okudlulelwe. Lolu bulungiswa lugcizelela ukuthi yini okufanele ilapheke, yini okufanele ikhokhwe noma ibuyiselwe, nokuthi yini okufanele ibe isifundo uma ubugebengu bukhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lolu bulungiswa lubheka ukuthi yini okufanele iqinisiwe uma sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu akuphindi kwenzeke esikhathini esizayo. Ukuqinisa umphakathi ukuze kugwenywe ukulimala okwengeziwe. Ukubuyisela izimiso - umthelela wokunciphisa ubugebengu nokuphindaphinda, ukwandisa inani labantu abangena ezinhlelweni zokubuyiselwa, nokuphakamisa izinga lokubandakanywa komphakathi. Ukwamukelwa kanye nethemba okwakhiwe ngokwamukela amaphutha nezinyathelo zokuzithoba nokubuyisana. Ukwehla kwezinga lokwesaba. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuzwelana nokwamukela labo abasolwa. Yiziphi izinhlelo ezilindelekile ngaphansi kweRestorative Justice? Njengoba uhlelo lweRestorative Justice lugxile ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu buholela ekulimazeni kwabavictim, emiphakathini, nasezikhumbuzweni, kuyiqiniso ukuthi zonke izingxenye ezithintekayo kufanele zifakwe lapho kubhekwa umthelela wobugebengu. Okulandelayo kubhekwa njengabathintekayo futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza: izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nabazithandayo. Kukho izinkomba zokuthi iRestorative Justice iyanda emhlabeni jikelele. Izikhungo zikahulumeni ezihlanganisiwe zamukela uhlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ngo-1999, iKomidi Labaphathiswa leBhodi yeYurophu lamukela izincomo zokusebenzisa izixazululo zokubuyisela mayelana nezimo. IRestorative Justice Handbook for Victims yeZizwe Ezihlangene iyavuma ukuthi "ukwakheka kweRestorative Justice kuhilela umsolwa, umvictim, nomphakathi wonke emizameni yokwakha inqubo enomusa eqondiswe kumsolwa, ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo ibheka umvictim." Ukubuyiselwa komvictim kuyisisekelo sohlelo lweRestorative Justice ezweni eliningi elithuthukayo. Izinyathelo zomthetho zinciphise izithiyo ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokubuyisela. Zikhuthaze izinyathelo zomthetho zokwenza izinhlelo zokubuyisela, ukunciphisa izinqubo, nokuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokubuyisela ngenkathi kuvikelwa amalungelo abavictim nezikhumbuzo. Inani lezinhlelo zokubuyisela emhlabeni jikelele liyanda. Kukhona ngaphezu kwe-500 yezinhlelo zokubuyisela eYurophu futhi ngaphezu kwe-300 eMelika. Ucwaningo ngezinhlelo zokubuyisela nezinto ezifanayo eCanada kuholele ekubhaliseni kwezinhlelo eziyi-100. Isu leRestorative Justice alikabi lisha lapha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kukhona izimo lapho lezi zimiso seziye zafakwa ngendlela ethile. IKomidi elaziwa kakhulu leziNhlangano Zokwethembeka Nokubuyisana, elagxila kakhulu ezinhlekeleleni ezenziwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kwakuwumsebenzi weRestorative Justice. Kukhombisa isidingo sokuthi abavictim bakhulume ngezwi labo futhi bafune izixazululo ezimweni zabo njengabavictim. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenkathi kwethulwa ubufakazi bezinto abazihlangabezane nazo futhi kunikezwa ithuba lokulalela lokho abakubhalile labo abalimazile. IMnyango Yentuthuko Yomphakathi ihola uhlelo lokwakha amandla abavictim. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuhlanganisa abavictim ohlelweni lobulungiswa. Isu leSizwe Lokuvimbela Ubugebengu lichaza njengokuthi "ukuphendula emthelelweni wobugebengu kubavictim." Nakuba leli isu lingahlanganyeli ngqo ekunciphiseni ubugebengu, umgomo walo omkhulu uwukulalela lokho abavictim abanokukhuluma. Kuyiqiniso elamukelwe ukuthi ukwakha amandla nokwengeza abavictim kunciphisa eminye imithelela, kukhuthaza ukubambisana nohulumeni, kubuyisela emuva ukuziphatha komphakathi, kuvimba abasolwa abangaba khona, futhi kukhuthaza ukwesekwa kohlelo lobulungiswa. Isu lokuphoqa abasolwa ukuba benze umsebenzi womphakathi liyaqhubeka nokwenziwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi womphakathi uyasiza futhi wenziwa emphakathini owathintekayo ngamalungu atholwe enecala lokwephula umthetho othile. Lesi sigwebo singafakwa kubasolwa nakubantu abathole isigwebo sokubhekwa ngensizakalo zokulungiswa. Ngemuva kwezinguquko kwiRestorative Justice Act ngo-1995, kwasungulwa ikomidi elihlanganisiwe labaphathiswa ukuze lilawule izinguquko ohlelweni lokubuyisela izingane nentsha eNingizimu Afrika. Ngesikhathi kudalwa uhlaka lwezombusazwe lokubuyiselwa kwezingane nentsha, ikomidi lancoma ukuthi: "indlela yokubhekana nengane ephikisana nomthetho kufanele ibe yinhlinzeko: ukuxazulula izingxabano ezikhona, ukuhlanganisa umndeni nomphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo, ukwamukela nokubeka eceleni indima yomphakathi." Ukubhekana nokuziphatha kwabasolwa kuyindaba ejulile engakwazi ukuxazululwa ngokuphelele kuphela ngohlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ukuze kuphumelele ukulapha izilonda zobugebengu, kumele kube nohlelo olunikeza amathuba okuxazulula, ukuxhumana,
Amahlaya Nezimpilo Zethu Ukuqala, sithanda ukujabulisa, futhi amahlaya ayisikhumbuzo sokuthi siphile. Njengoba sihamba ezimpilweni zethu, siyakwazi ukuthi laugh is a universal language. Kodwa-ke, kukhona abanye abantu abakholelwa ukuthi amahlaya ayaphazamiseka, ayinembile, noma ngabe abathokozisi. Lokhu kwenza kube nesidingo sokuxoxa ngale ndaba — ngabe amahlaya ayisikhali esiwusizo empilweni yethu, noma ngabe kudinga ukusho ukuthi siphumelele ngempumelelo? Uma sikhuluma ngama-hlaya, kufanele siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi ahluka kakhulu. Kukhona amahlaya amnandi, amahlaya ahlekisayo, amahlaya aqondile, kanye nama-satire. Uhlobo lokugcina, i-satire, luwusizo uma kudingeka ukuhlambalaza imikhuba engalungile emphakathini. Njengoba umphakathi uhlala ushintsha, amahlaya aqhubeka nokuba nezinto ezithokozisayo eziphathelene nezindaba zamanje, kanti lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele ekutholeni izixazululo ezinhle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye baphikisa ngalokho okukhuluma ngama-hlaya. Bathi amahlaya angaba nemiphumela yokuhlukumeza, noma ahlambalaze abantu abathile, ikakhulukazi uma ehlekisa ngezinkinga ezinzima. Lokhu kuphikisana kuyiqiniso, kodwa akukwazanga ukuphika ukuthi imishado, izinkumbulo, nezenzakalo zempilo zikhuluma ngama-hlaya, zikhuluma ngempilo yethu nsuku zonke. Amahlaya angasiza abantu ukuba baqonde indlela yokubhekana nezinkinga, ngisho noma zikhuluma ngempilo engathandeki. Ngakho-ke, uma sihamba phezulu, amahlaya akha ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kungenzeka uma sihamba ezindaweni zokuzijabulisa, izinkundla zomphakathi, noma nasemakhosini. Ukukhuluma ngama-hlaya kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana, futhi lokhu kudala inhlangano phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlangana nemiphakathi ehlukahlukene, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, nokuthi bangakwenza kanjani ukuphila ngokujabulisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlaya angaba nemiphumela emihle empilweni yethu. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ukuhlekisa kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukucindezeleka, ukukhuthaza impilo enhle, nokwandisa ubudlelwane obuhle. Njengoba uhlekisa, unika amandla omzimba wakho, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba empilweni, umkhuba ophumelelayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uhlekisa akusiyo nje indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Sikhiphe udaba lwama-hlaya ezindabeni zethu zansuku zonke. Ngabe sikhumbula isikhathi lapho uhlekisa khona nabangani? Lokhu kuqhubeka kusisiza ukufaka izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi sihlala sikhumbula ukuthi siphilile. Amahlaya akha izikhathi ezimnandi, zikhumbuza ukuthi kumele sihleke, kungakhathaliseki izinselelo esibhekene nazo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi amahlaya angaba yindlela yokubhekana nezinto ezinzima, futhi ahlinzeka ngethuba lokubhekana nezinkinga zethu ngeso lokuhlakanipha. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi amahlaya awakwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukungabi nandaba maqondana nesimo esinzima. Kodwa yini engcono — ukuhlekisa noma ukuhamba phambili isikhathi sonke? Ukukhuluma amahlaya ngokubhekisela ezinkingeni zempilo kungenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhumbule ukuthi akufanele basabe ukuhlekisa ngezinto ezinzima. Ekugcineni, njengoba siba nomcabango ngeqhaza lama-hlaya ezimpilweni zethu, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amahlaya awanqobi. Abakholelwa ukuthi amahlaya ahlambalaza, akukhona okubhekwayo kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukubhekwa njengenhloso yokuhlekisa. Amahlaya alula, ahlekisayo, kanye nemishado yesikhumbuzo, okwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabanye abantu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nesineke, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhlekisa kuyinsika yokuphila. Lokhu kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sithokozise ngempela amahlaya — kakhulu. Umlando wama-hlaya ungena kulesi sikhala, futhi ngakho-ke kufanele sigcine sikhumbula ukuthi indlela esihlekisa ngayo iyingxenye enkulu yokuphila kwethu. Ukuthi amahlaya angasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwane obuqinile, okwenza impilo yethu ibe mnandi, kufanele sikhumbule njalo. Amahlaya awanqobi, kodwa akha umhlaba onothile, ogcwele uthando, umusa, nokuhlekisa. Lokhu, ngempela, kuyisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi siphile.
UDesmond Tutu Nomsebenzi Wakhe UDesmond Mpilo Tutu, owazalwa ngo-7 kuNhlangulana 1931 eKlerksdorp, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu abahlonishwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe ophawulekayo emkhakheni wezokuhlalisana, ubulungiswa, kanye nezokukhuluma. U-Tutu, ongumfundisi weSonto lamaAnglikani, waba yisithonjana sokulwa nobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ubuhlakani, ubuholi, kanye nokuzinikela ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. U-Tutu waqala ukufunda eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, lapho aqala khona khona khona ukuthola izifundo ezimayelana nezokuphatha, ezokuhlalisana, kanye nezokukhuluma. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, waba umfundisi, futhi wathola ithuba lokusebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika. U-Tutu waba umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola udumo ngenxa yokukhuluma kwakhe ngokuqinile ngokuchasene nobandlululo. Ubugebengu bobandlululo bukhombisa ububi obukhulu, futhi u-Tutu waba yisithonjana sokulwa nalokhu. Ngonyaka ka-1976, u-Tutu waba nguMphakathi weSonto leSonto lamaAnglikani eNingizimu Afrika, futhi waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngokuqinile ngezinkinga ezithinta ubulungiswa, futhi waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. U-Tutu waba ngumholi ophawulekayo emkhakheni wezokuhlalisana, futhi waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. U-Tutu waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni i-Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC) ngemuva kokuphela kobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkampani yayihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto ezinzima abahlangabezane nazo ngesikhathi sobandlululo. R50.00 kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka ka-2003 bese kuba R70. Abanikazi bezindawo zokuhweba kumele bathenge ugesi bona. Imali yokurenta ikhokhwa ngenyanga kusenesikhathi ngosuku lweshumi lwanyanga ngayinye. Indawo yokuhweba enikezwa umuntu izosetshenziswa ukuthengisa nokukhangisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimpahla njengoba kuvunyelwe yiBhodi yabaPhathi ngezikhathi ezithile. Umqashi kumele anikeze umninimzi ikheli lakhe lokuhlala, ikheli leposi, kanye nenombolo yefoni. Umqashi kumele abe ngumuntu ongasebenzi, futhi kuzonikezwa ithuba labo abaxhasa imindeni yabo bodwa. Zonke izimpahla kumele zibe sesimweni esifanele ukuthengiswa ezivakashi futhi zibe nekhwalithi ephezulu kanye nezinhlobonhlobo. Indawo yokuhweba kumele iphephile, futhi umqashi kumele ahambisane nemithetho efakwe kwiMthetho Wokuphepha Nokunakekelwa Kwezempilo No. 85 ka-1993. Indawo yokuhweba ayivunyelwe ukuthi iqashwe komunye umuntu ngumqashi. Abangane abathathu bazovunyelwa ngaphansi kwalolu xhaso. Abangane bazokhuthazwa ukuthi bathengise izimpahla eziphathelene nabanye abantu abasebenza ekhaya. Ukulahla udoti/ukuhlanzwa akuvunyelwe, futhi udoti akumele uqokeleleke ezindaweni zemakethe. Ukuphuza utshwala ezindaweni zemakethe akuvunyelwe, futhi umqashi akumele afinyelele emsebenzini ethwele umphumela wotshwala noma ezinye izidakamizwa. Ukulwa noma ukusebenzisa ulimi oluphambene ezindaweni zemakethe akuvunyelwe. Umsindo omkhulu noma umculo ezindaweni zemakethe akuvunyelwe. Umqashi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina indawo yakhe yokuhweba nezindawo ezizungezile zihlanzekile. Abangane bazothatha izikhathi zokuhlanza igumbi lokugezela nezinye izindawo ezijwayelekile. Izimpahla zingakhiqizwa kuphela ezindaweni zemakethe uma imvume ngaphambi itholiwe kumninimzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngezimali ezishintshwayo. Izimpahla zikagesi kuphela ezivunyelwe kumninimzi zingasetshenziswa. Akukho shintsho okumele kwenziwe ezindaweni zemakethe mayelana nezifaki zagesi, uphahla, noma ezinye. Abangane kumele bathathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvimbela ukuvinjwa noma ukuphazamiseka kwemithombo yamanzi, amapayipi, kanye namapayipi okuphakelayo amanzi lapha ezindaweni zemakethe. Abangane kuzodingeka bakhokhe ugesi ngokusekelwe ekusetshenzisweni kwabo. Izindawo zokuhweba kumele zivuleke kusukela ngo-9:00 AM kuya ku-5:00 PM kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuMgqibelo. Imakethe izovalwa ngoMsombuluko. Izindawo zokuhweba zingavulwa ngezikhathi ezinde ngokuthanda komninimzi. Uma umqashi, noma ozakwabo noma abasebenzi bawo ngasikhathi sinye, baphula noma yiziphi zalezi zimo futhi baqhubeke nokwenza kanjalo ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyishumi zokunikezwa isaziso sokulungisa, lesi sivumelwano sokurenta sizophela ngokushesha, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume kule ndawo yokuhweba ngokushesha. Isaziso esisheshayo sizonikezwa uma kwenzeka isenzo sobugebengu noma ukuphulwa kokuziphatha. Uma kutholakala ukuthi umqashi unikeze ulwazi olungelona iqiniso ukuze athole le ndawo yokuhweba, iBhodi izosebenzisa amandla ayo uma ikhetha ukuvala lesi sivumelwano ngokushesha. Uma umqashi ethola umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, lesi sivumelwano sizophela, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume endaweni yokuhweba ezinsukwini eziyisixhenxe. Uma umqashi efile, lesi sivumelwano sizophela ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho Jikelele. Umninimzi ugcina ilungelo lokukhokhisa umqashi ngezibopho nezijeziso.
Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS Kwathi ngesikhathi esithile, emzaneni omncane ohlangothini lwezintaba, kwaba khona umfana ogama lakhe linguSimphiwe. USimphiwe wayenempilo enhle, kodwa, njengabanye abaningi, wayeseyindoda ewukhezi. Waqhubeka ebamba izifundo zakhe esikoleni, kodwa yayikhona into eyayimjolise kakhulu – ukufuna ukwazi ngokuthi izinsizakalo zempilo, ikakhulukazi i-GEMS, zingenza kanjani umehluko empilweni yakhe nasemndenini wakhe. Ngakhoke, uSimphiwe waqala ukufuna ulwazi ngezinsizakalo i-GEMS ezihlinzekayo. Wafunda ukuthi i-GEMS, okuyinsiza yokwelashwa kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile ezinjengokwelashwa, izidakamizwa, nemishini yokwelapha. Wazi kahle ukuthi, uma efuna ukufinyelela kulezi zinsizakalo, kufanele aqonde ukuthi uhlobo luni lwezinzuzo angezwa. Ngemuva kosuku olukhulu esikoleni, uSimphiwe wahlala phansi nenhliziyo yakhe igcwele ithemba. Wayecabanga ngalokhu: “Kufanele ngiqonde ukuthi ngafaneleka kanjani ukuze ngithole lezi zinzuzo.” Waphuma endlini, wathola umngane wakhe, uThandiwe, oyedwa owayene-GEMS. UThandiwe wayenolwazi olukhulu ngale nsizakalo, futhi uSimphiwe wamkhumbuza ukuthi kuhle ukufunda kulabo abavela endaweni eyinhloko. “UThandiwe,” eshaya itheku, “ungangikhombisa ukuthi ngingabhalisela i-GEMS kanjani? Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo okufanele ngizithathe?” UThandiwe wahleka, ebona ukuthi uSimphiwe ufisa ukufunda. “Yebo, kuba nezinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele ubone ukuthi ungekho yini owomphakathi, ngoba i-GEMS yenzelwe abantu abavuyelela izidingo ezithile. Kufanele udinge ukufakazela ukuthi uyiNhloko yomndeni, noma Umsebenzi Osemthethweni, ngoba lezi zinto zibalulekile ekunqumeni ukufaneleka kwakho,” kusho uThandiwe. Ngemuva kokukhuluma noThandiwe, uSimphiwe wathola ukuthi kumqoka kakhulu ukuba nesikhathi sokuhlola imiyalelo nezithako ezisemthethweni. Waqhubeka nokucwaninga, wafunda ngalesi sikhathi sokufaneleka. Wazitholela ukuthi izinto ezinjengokuphila impilo enempilo, izinga lemali engenayo, kanye nezidingo zomndeni wakhe, zonke zikhona. “Ngeke ngithokoze kuphela ukusho ukuthi ngifuna i-GEMS,” echaza. “Kufanele ngifake isicelo ngokusemthethweni bese ngikela izincwadi ezikhombisayo ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngingakaziswa.” Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uSimphiwe walungisa zonke izincwadi ezazidingeka. Wahlela umsebenzi, wathola ubufakazi bokuthi ukhokhela umndeni, kwaye wahamba uyofaka isicelo se-GEMS. Usuku lokuhlola lwasondela, watusa lapho. Ukuhamba ngamasango amakhulu, imizwa yakhe yayiphezulu. Uhlangane nezinye izihlobo, othandweni, bejabulile ngokubona umphakathi udlalela izinsiza ezinhle. Ngemva kokuhamba bucayi, uSimphiwe waqinisekisa ukuthi ubheke kahle izimpendulo. Kwaphela izinsuku ezingu-7, kwavela impendulo eyayilindelwe, ewumthwalo omkhulu. “Ngiyanqoba!” kusho uSimphiwe, ethi umoya wakhe usufanelwe. UThandiwe, edlulisa izindaba ezinhle, wahle yaphakamisa. “Ngiyavuma, uSimphiwe! Ukwenzile konke! Ngabe uthole ukuze uqhubeke?” USimphiwe wayedidekile, kodwa ethokozile, owazi kahle ukuthi lokhu kusho izinsiza ezinzima ukuze aphilise kangcono. “Ngiyabonga, uThandiwe. Lokhu kuzongisiza nempilo yami. Ngifisa ukuqhubeka ngezinyathelo ezilandelayo.” Waqhubeka nemizamo yokuhlola izinsiza, ezinjengokubhaliswa kwezinhlelo zokwelapha, ukuthola izidakamizwa, nezinye izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Wayenamathuba amaningi, futhi waba nesibopho ekuphatheni izikhathi ezinzima. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila nempilo emangalisayo lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nokufuna ukwazi, futhi uGEMS waba ngempela yinsiza ebabalekayo emndenini wakhe. Ngempela, le ndaba yempilo kaSimphiwe ibonisa ukuthi ukuzinikezela, ukufunda, nokubambisana nabanye kungasiza ukuya phambili. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila kube kwelanga eliqhakazile, futhi kwawuqinisa umoya wakhe lapho efuna izinsiza ezingenza umehluko empilweni yakhe nakwabanye. Ngaphandle kwabantu abanjengoThandiwe, uSimphiwe uphuma kwamanye amahlangano ukuze abambisane nemiphakathi eminingi. Eziwubala zaba yizinsiza eziningi zempilo, zikhona, zikhona zikhona! UChilo, uMnisi, noMakhosi bamkhumbuza inqubekela phambili, kusho ukuthi umphakathi ungathuthukisa impilo yabo sonke uma bexhumana. Ekugcineni, uSimphiwe wabona ukuthi i-GEMS yayiyinsiza ebalulekile, kodwa lokhu kuthola inkonzo bekwakhombisa ukuthi umsebenzi wako ungaphezu kokuthola izinzuzo. Waqonda ukuthi phakathi kokukhula, ufisa ukusiza abanye baphinde baxhumane, ngenxa yokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe. Ngakho, uSimphiwe waba umholi emphakathini, ehlanganisa abantu, evuselela nokuqinisa umqondo wokusebenzelana nomunye. Futhi ke, izinsuku zaqhubeka, uSimphiwe wahamba phambili. Kwaqhubeka ukukhula, kubonisa indlela yokuphila engena esweni lomphakathi, yabelana ngempilo enganqamuki. Waqhubeka nomgomo wakhe wesikhathi eside, ukuqinisekisa nokwenza izuhu empilweni yesisu ehlotshaniswa nemiphakathi. Ngale ndlela, indaba kaSimphiwe yathi igcwele impumelelo, yakhombisa umhlaba ukuthi izinsiza zinganqotshwa, kodwa uthando, ukusizana, nokuqonda, kuna izinzuzo eziphezulu ezithinta izimpilo zethu. Kwaye kwaba khona ithemba, nezindlela ezintsha zokukhuluma ngezinsiza, okukhule laidwaba basebenzisa. Futhi lokho, sekuyindaba yempilo kaSimphiwe, okuyinto ewubala, idolobha elincane lekwaGEMS. Yaqhubeka iphonsa izaba, igcwalisa imizwa, nokuqhubeka nezinzuzo ezintsha. Uma uSimphiwe ephehla, uzakuqonda ukuthi izinsiza ezinikezwayo zingaba nemiphumela emihle, iqhula izimpilo zabantu, futhi inikeza umphakathi ithuba lokukhula.
iNyuvesi yasePitoli Umbuzo 1: Iyini iNyuvesi yasePitoli? INyuvesi yasePitoli, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-University of Pretoria (UP), iyinhlangano yokhigher education eNingizimu Afrika. Yasungulwa ngonyaka we-1908, le nyuvesi iyinhloko-dolobha yalesi sikhathi, futhi ibhekwa njengenye yezikhungo eziphezulu zokufunda e-Afrika. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibaluleke kangaka? INyuvesi yasePitoli ibalulekile ngenxa yokuthi inikeza imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu ezindaweni ezihlukene, kuhlanganise nezobuchwepheshe, ezemfundo, ezomthetho, nezobuciko. Iphinde ibe nezinhlelo eziningi zokucwaninga ezithuthukisa ulwazi nolwazi lwezokwelapha, ezempilo, nezokwakha. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakala eNyuvesi yasePitoli? E-Nyuvesi yasePitoli, abafundi bangakhetha eziningi izifundo ezivela emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo zezeMali, ezobuciko, ezobunjiniyela, ezokwelapha, kanye nezifundo zezenhlalakahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNyuvesi inezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokufundisa abaphambili emikhakheni ethile. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezikhungo zokucwaninga? Yebo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezikhungo zokucwaninga eziningi ezithuthukisa ucwaningo ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lezi zikhungo ziqhuba ucwaningo olujulile emikhakheni efana nezokwelapha, ubuchwepheshe, nezokuphila. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola ithuba lokusebenza ezinhlelweni ezithuthukile. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli itholakala kalula? INyuvesi yasePitoli itholakala kalula, ikakhulukazi kubafundi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Itholakala edolobheni lasePitoli, elinokutholakala okuhle kwezokuthutha. Abafundi bangafinyelela iNyuvesi ngezithuthi zomphakathi, izimoto, noma ngezinyawo uma bephuma edolobheni. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibe yindawo enhle yokufunda? INyuvesi yasePitoli inezinsiza eziningi ezithuthukile, kuhlanganise nezincwadi, ama-laboratories, nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Abafundi banethuba lokuxhumana nabanye abafundi nabafundisi, okwakha umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bejabule futhi bejabulisa ukufunda. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi? Yebo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abafundi, kuhlanganise nezibonelelo, imalimboleko, nezinhlelo zokufunda. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bangenza kahle ezikoleni zabo, noma ngabe bahluphekile ngezinsiza. Abafundi bangathola usizo lwemali ukuze bakwazi ukuqhubeka nezifundo zabo. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda eNyuvesi yasePitoli? Izifundo eNyuvesi yasePitoli zikhanga abafundi abaningi ngenxa yezinzuzo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda ezingeni eliphakeme, ukuthola iziqu ezihlonishwayo, kanye namathuba okusebenza ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo. Abafundi bayakwazi ukujoyina izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukene ukuze bathole ulwazi olungaphezulu. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo zamasiko? Yebo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo eziningi zamasiko nezokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi, amakilabhu, nemihlangano ehlobene nezifundo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kwamasiko kukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bephila impilo enhle. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ngiyazi ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo eNyuvesi yasePitoli? Ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo eNyuvesi yasePitoli, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zokufaka isicelo, izinqubo, nezinsuku zokugcina. Abafundi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi banelungelo lokufunda futhi bahlola izifundo abazithakaselayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukufunda ngamasiko nezinhloso zeNyuvesi ukuze baqonde kahle indawo abazofunda kuyo. Isiphetho INyuvesi yasePitoli iyinhlangano ebalulekile yokufunda eNingizimu Afrika, enikeza abafundi amathuba amaningi okukhula, ukufunda, nokucwaninga. Ngemfundo esezingeni eliphezulu, izinsiza ezithuthukile, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, iNyuvesi yasePitoli iyindawo efanelekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Abafundi bahlala bejabulile futhi bephila impilo enempilo, behlanganyela nabanye ukuze bakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Umbuzo 1: Yini izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela? Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlinzeka ngensizakalo yokusiza abesifazane abakhulelwe ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Lezi zinsizakalo zifaka ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, ukwelashwa, kanye nokunakekelwa okudingekayo ngaphambi, ngesikhathi, nasemva kokubeletha. Zihlanganisa nezinsiza ezifana namawadi, i-ICU, kanye nezinsiza zokuthola usizo lwezempilo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ngaphambi kokubeletha? Ngaphambi kokubeletha, abesifazane bencike ekuhloleni izimo zabo zempilo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha, ukucaciselwa ngezinketho zokubeletha, kanye nokuxhumana nodokotela ukuze kuhlolwe izinkinga ezingase zibe khona. Imihlangano yokuhlanganyela ibalulekile ukuze abesifazane bazi kahle lokho okulindelekile. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenzekayo ngesikhathi sokubeletha? Ngesikhathi sokubeletha, umama uthola ukunakekelwa ngokucophelela. Izinsiza ezinjengamadokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nezinye izisebenzi zempilo ziqinisekisa ukuthi umama nengane bakhishwa ngokuphepha. Ukubhekelwa kuhilela ukugcinwa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, ukuxilongwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nokunikezwa kosizo lwezokwelapha uma kudingeka. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinsiza ezitholakalayo emva kokubeletha? Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama uthola ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukwelashwa kwezinkinga ezingase zivele, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda ubaba nomama mayelana nokunakekelwa kwengane. Izibhedlela zinikeza izinhlelo zokuxhasa, ezifaka phakathi izifundo zokubeletha, izinhlelo zokufundisa abazali, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana nezingane. Umbuzo 5: Kuthiwani ngezinselelo ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zokubeletha? Nakuba izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona, kunezinselelo ezithile. Ukuthola izinsiza ezifanele kudinga imithombo yemali, futhi ezindaweni ezithile, ukufinyelela ezibhedlela kungaba nzima, okwenza kube nzima kwabanye abesifazane ukusizakala. Ubugebengu nokushoda kwezinsiza kungase kube nomthelela ekusebenzeni kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha. Umbuzo 6: Kungani kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela? Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ngoba ziqinisekisa ukuphepha nokunakekelwa kwabakhulelwe. Ukuze kube nezimo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bathole ukwelashwa okutholakala ezibhedlela, okunciphisa izingozi ezihlobene nokubeletha, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta impilo yomama nengane. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokubeletha ezibhedlela? Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zinikeza izinzuzo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukufinyelela kumadokotela abanolwazi, izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nokuphathwa kwezingane okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle, futhi kuqinisekisa impilo enhle yomama nengane. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngezinketho zokubeletha ngaphandle kwezibhedlela? Kukhona nezinye izinketho zokubeletha, ezifana nokubeletha emakhaya, kodwa lezi zidinga ukuqonda kahle izingozi ezihambisana nazo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bakhethe indlela yokubeletha ehambisana nezidingo zabo kuphela uma bezazi kahle izinzuzo nezingozi. Umbuzo 9: Umehluko phakathi kokubeletha emakhaya nezibhedlela? Umehluko omkhulu phakathi kokubeletha emakhaya nezibhedlela ubonakala ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Ezibhedlela, kunezinsiza ezithuthukile nezokwelapha, kanti emakhaya, izinsiza zingase zibe zinqabile, okubalulekile uma kunezimo eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini okudingeka ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, kudingeka ukwenza izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo, ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele, kanye nokufundisa abahlengikazi nabezempilo ukuze babe nolwazi oluphakeme. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kungasiza ekwakheni izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngokufingqa, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ekuphathweni kokubeletha, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane nabantwana bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele, okuyinto ebalulekile emkhakheni wezeMpilo.
Ukushoda Kothisha Ezikoleni: Inselele Enkulu Emfundweni Yethu Ngokubheka isimo semfundo ezikoleni zethu, kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi ukushoda kothisha sekuphawulwe njengensuku zonke ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kuphazamisa imfundo yabafundi, kwenze kube nzima ukufeza izinjongo zemfundo eziphakeme. Kunemibono eminingi evezwa ngabantu abahlukene mayelana nenkinga yokushoda kothisha, kanye nezimbangela zayo, ezinzima kakhulu. Izinsuku eziningi zifike zashintsha isimo sokufunda. Abazali, othisha, kanye nabaholi bezemfundo baveza ukujula kokukhathazeka kwabo. Uthisha, uNkk. Zulu, usemkhulu eMnyangweni wesifunda, uthi: "Siyahluleka ukuhlinzeka abafundi bethu ngoqeqesho oluhle ngenxa yokushoda kothisha. Kukhona abantwana abaninzi abangafundi kahle, futhi lokhu kuyiqiniso elinzima." Lokhu kubonisa impilo yangempela yezikole, lapho izifundo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngothisha abaningi ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi olufanele. Izizathu zokushoda kothisha ziningi. Okokuqala, izinkinga zokuhola zikhulu. Abantu abaningi bahamba phambili bezama ukufuna amabhizinisi angcono, okuholela ekushodeni kwabantu abaneziqu ezidingekayo emfundweni. Ngokwe-Statistics South Africa, umkhakha wezokufundisa ubhekana nezinselele zokukhula kwezinsiza, okwenza kube nzima ukuba othisha bahlale emsebenzini. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho imfundo ihamba phambili ngaphandle kokuthola abantu abaneziqu ezithuthukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza ezikoleni nakho kudinga ukunakwa. Izikole eziningi azinazo izinsiza ezanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuba othisha benze umsebenzi wabo kahle. Uthisha, uMnu. Nkosi, uthi: "Siyamangala uma sikhumbula ukuthi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zezifundo kwenziwa ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuthi abafundi bethu bakhule." Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi udinga ukuba nemithombo ethile ukuze udlule phambili, kodwa uma le mithombo ingekho, umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kokushoda kothisha, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nezinga lokuhlala kothisha. Ukuze othisha bahlale ezikoleni ezithile, kudingeka izimo ezinhle zokuphila. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindlu, izindleko zokuphila, kanye nezidingo ezingokomoya. Uma othisha behlupheka ngenhlalakahle, kunzima ukuba bahlale bebambile emsebenzini. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuvuma izimfuno zempilo yabafundi, njengoba kufanele benze umsebenzi omningi, kodwa bengekho kuleso simo. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga, kunezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Uhlelo lwezikhuthazo zokufundisa lungasiza ekuheheni abantu abasha emkhakheni wezokufundisa. Uhlelo olunikeza izikhuthazo kubafundi abathola iziqu eziphezulu kungenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazibandakanye emfundweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo ezikhuthaza othisha ukuba bahlale ezikoleni ezithile zingasiza ekuvimbeleni ukushoda kothisha. Ukwaziwa komsebenzi wothisha kubalulekile, futhi kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngaphandle kwabo, akukhona ukusungulwa kwemfundo ethuthukisiwe. Uhlelo lwezokuphatha lufanele ukwakha izinhlelo ezivumela othisha ukuba basebenze kahle, futhi baqhubeke nokukhula emkhakheni wabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo zemfundo eqhubekayo, izikhuthazo zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni akuyona nje inkinga yendawo ethile, kodwa kuyinkinga ebhekelele wonke umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi ubuholi bezemfundo, uhulumeni, nabazali basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo efanele. Ukukhulisa izinga lemfundo kuzodinga ukukhipha izinsiza ezidingekayo, kanye nokwakha isimo sokuphila esikahle kothisha. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizoba negalelo elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi jikelele, futhi sigcine imfundo yethu iphakeme. Ukugqugquzela ukusebenza ndawonye, sizokwazi ukuvimbela ukushoda kothisha, futhi sizothuthukisa ikusasa lethu. Uthando nemizamo yethu kufanele kube ngaphezu kokucabanga; kumele kube yisisekelo sokuhlanganyela ukuze sifeze izinjongo zethu zempumelelo.
Uhambo Lwansuku Zonke: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezithuthi Zansuku Zonke Uhambo lwansuku zonke luyingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi luhlobene kakhulu nezinguquko ezikhona empilweni yethu. Njengoba izimo zempilo zishintsha, abantu abaningi bakhetha ukuhamba ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze bafike emsebenzini, ezikoleni, nasemakhaya. Kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi lezi zithuthi zansuku zonke ziwusizo kanjani ekwenzeni impilo yethu ibe ngcono, noma zikhona izinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Izithuthi Zansuku Zonke Izithuthi ezijwayelekile zifaka phakathi izimoto, izithuthuthu, amabhasi, nezitimela. Umgwaqo osezingeni eliphezulu ubalulekile ukuze kube nezithuthi ezihamba kahle. Kunezindawo ezimnandi ezitholakalayo nezikhala ezithuthukisa ukuhamba, kodwa imithwalo yezemidlalo, izithuthi eziningi, nezithuthi ezindizayo zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obufanele ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokuhamba ezisebenzayo. Ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezithuthi zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuba amaphoyisa, abahlinzeki bezokuthutha, kanye nezishoshiso zomphakathi baphathe izidingo zabantu. Izinkinga Zokuhamba Noma kunjalo, uhambo lwansuku zonke lungabangelwa izinselelo. Izinkinga ezifana nokuhlala isikhathi eside emgibeni, ukuphazamiseka kwezokuthutha, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zihlala zikhona. Ukuze kube nokuhamba okuphumelelayo, iziphathimandla kufanele zikwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ukuhlanganisa izinhlelo zamashejuli, izixazululo zedijithali, kanye nezinhlelo zokubika izimo eziphuthumayo kungasiza ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba. Izinkinga zempilo zidinga izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngezokuphepha, ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile bephakathi kwezinye izithuthi. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Uhambo Ukuze uhambo lwansuku zonke luthuthuke, kubalulekile ukuba abantu babe nemininingwane ethile. Izinhlelo zokuhamba ezithuthukisiwe, ezihlanganisa izindlela zokuxhumana, izinhlelo ze-apps, nezinsiza zokuhlola izimo zokuhamba, zidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imininingwane ethile futhi kuthuthukise uhambo. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokupaka engcono, izithuthi ezihamba phambili, nezinhlelo zokuphatha kwezithuthi zomphakathi kuyasiza ekwandiseni ukuhamba okuphumelelayo. Ukwakha Umoya Wokuhamba Ohlanzekile Njengoba sithuthuka, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuhamba okuhlanzekile. Izindlela zokuhamba eziphumelelayo zidinga izinyathelo zokunciphisa umthelela empilweni. Ukuze sithuthukise uhambo lwansuku zonke, kudingeka ukugqugquzela umphakathi mayelana nezindlela zokuhamba ezihlanzekile, ezifana nokuhamba ngezinyawo, ukugibela amabhasi, noma ukusebenzisa izithuthi ezibuyiselwa. Isiphetho Uhambo lwansuku zonke lunokubaluleka okukhulu empilweni yethu. Kuhle ukuba sihlole izithuthi zomphakathi, izinselelo ezikhona, nezindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zethu zokuthutha, sizokwazi ukuthola impilo engcono nephumelelayo. Uhambo lwansuku zonke luwumqondo obalulekile, futhi kudinga ukubambisana ukuze kube nokuphila okuhle sonke. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamizi neziphathimandla kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Khetha izilwane ozothengisa nokuthi uzothengisa ngani. Ukuhlela lezi zilwane ngokuzihlukanisa kuncike eminyakeni, isisindo, ukujabulisa, ukulimala, kanye nobulili. Umuntu osiza ngezokuthengisa angakusiza ukuhlukanisa lezi zilwane. Xhumana nomthengisi ukuze ubuze ngamanani nezindlela zokuthengisa. Nikeza ulwazi olufanele mayelana nekhwalithi nokuhlukaniswa, isimo sokuw weighing, isisindo, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, inani lemali lezilwane zakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izilwane zakho zinephuzu lokuhlonza elisemthethweni. Hlela ukuhamba. Thola isitifiketi sokuhamba kwiMnyango Wokweba Izilwane Zomdabu. Ngaphandle kwalawa madokhumenti, ungakhokhiswa noma izilwane zakho zingathathwa. Gcwalisa ifomu lokwamukela ngegama lakho, ikheli, indawo, kanye nemininingwane yokuhlonza izilwane. Qonda ukuthi izilwane zakho zisekhaya futhi unomthwalo wemfanelo ngazo. Ukuhweba kuzoqedwa uma uthi "kuthengisiwe." Qedela inqubo yokuthengisa. Yenza isitatimende sokukhulula izilwane futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ilungile. Ukukhokha kungaba ngemali noma ngecheki. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane ku-cheki ilungile. Indlela ephephile wukuthi imali yakho ibhange kwi-akhawunti yakho yasebhange. Umthengi udinga incwadi yokukhululwa etholakala kwiMnyango Wokweba Izilwane ukuze ahambe nezilwane. Kuyaqondakala ukuvakashela emnyangweni ngaphambi kokuthengisa izilwane zakho okokuqala. Noma hamba nomuntu osevele eya lapho. Khuluma ngesilinganiso esifanele sezilwane ngaphambi kokuhamba emnyangweni. Indawo yokuhlonza esemthethweni. I-tattoo ibekwe endlebeni yesobunxele noma yesokudla. Ukubhalwa kwenziwa emlenzeni ongemuva nasemathangeni.
Ithini uhlobo lwezokuqeqesha olunikezwa yiGrain SA? Ubhala: Jane McPherson, Umphathi Wohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA luhloselwe ukuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama ngokuqeqesha amakhono okuba abalimi bezomnotho. Ukukhiqiza ukudla njengokhukhamba, ama-soybeans, ufulawa, kanye ne-barley kuhambisana nezindlela ezifanele zokukhiqiza, ukuthengisa, ukusetshenziswa kwemishini, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha amapulazi. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezwe kanye nokuba nendawo. Izihloko esizifakile kulolu hlelo zimi kanje: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ama-Soybean," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ufulawa," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza I-Barley." Njengomlimi othuthukayo, sikholelwa ukuthi kufanele uqale ngalezi zifundo ezihlobene nezitshalo ezikhuliswa endaweni yakho yokulima. Uma ungakhethi lezi zifundo, uzoba nezinkinga zokufunda izifundo ezinzima futhi uzobe uhamba ngemuva kwabanye abafundi. Ulwazi olukhona mayelana nezindlela zomnotho lujwayele ukuba lukhulu, ngakho kube inselelo ukukhetha lokho okufanele kufundiswe ngoba kunolwazi oluningi. Nokho, kukhona izihloko ezibalulekile esifuna ukuzifundisa kulolu hlelo. Ngakho, sikwazile ukufaka zonke izici ezibalulekile kulolu hlelo lokuqala oluhlobene nokukhiqiza nokuthengisa, bese sihlanganisa ne "Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni Nokuthengisa." Ukuqinisekiswa kwezitshalo kanye nokuphathwa kwezingozi kuyizinkinga ezingenzeka. Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni sihlobene nobuchwepheshe obuhambisana nokukhula komhlabathi kanye nokuphakama komhlabathi. Uma ufuna usizo ngalolu hlelo, kufanele uqale ube nesifundo sokwethulwa, futhi kufanele manje ukhiqize ukudla okuthengiswayo. Lolu hlelo lungase lungafaneleki kumlimi ophila ngezinga elincane. Kukhona iziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezisebenza emaphandleni ahlukene, futhi kufanele zibe nolwazi nokwesekwa kwabalamuli. Ngeshwa, iziphathimandla eziningi azikaze ziqeqeshwe kahle futhi zikhona ukungabi nolwazi ekukhiqizeni ukudla. Abanye baphendule (banama-cerificates) kodwa bangezange basebenze emapulazini - okuyinto ebalulekile ekulimaleni. Ngakho-ke, sihlanganisile lolu hlelo: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni Kubaphathi Ababelana Ngolwazi." Sifundise leli zifundo izikhathi eziningi eziphathimandla futhi sizame ukubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kanjani epulazini - sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusizile emsebenzini wabo. Isici esiyinhloko sokukhiqiza ubulukhuni esizokwenza inzuzo sihlobene nezithuthuthu nemishini. Sithole ukuthi isimo semishini kubalimi abathuthukayo sikhona kancane - ngakho-ke singenise leli zifundo. Lolu hlelo lubalulekile kulabo abafuna ukuba abalimi bezomnotho - kufanele uqonde ukuthi imishini yakhiwa kanjani, bese uzokwazi ukuyiphatha kahle. Ukuphatha kahle imishini kuyisikhumbuzo esizovula umnyango wokungena ekulimaleni kwezomnotho. Awukwazi ukuvula lowo mnyango uma ungaphathi izithuthuthu nemishini kahle. Sithole ukuthi kukhona abalimi abancane abaningi, ikakhulukazi eMpumalanga Kapa, abangenamishini nezithuthuthu (Uhlelo Olukhulu Lokudla lweMnyango Wezolimo eMpumalanga Kapa luhlanganise kakhulu abaqashi kodwa alusebenze kahle). Sibone ukuthi kuzosisiza abakhiqizi bobulukhuni ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluchaza umsebenzi wabakwaqashi, lokho okufanele kwenziwe, kanjani, nini, njll. Abakwaqashi bavame ukuba nezinselelo zokusebenza kahle. Nokho, kukhona izindawo lapho abalimi belima ezindaweni ezincane ukuze bathenge izithuthuthu nemishini, ngakho-ke kudingeka abaqashi. Sikholelwa ukuthi leli zifundo labakwaqashi lizobonisa abaqashi abasebenza ezolimo ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka kahle, ngezindinganiso ezifanele, ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi ngemali efanele. Lapho umlimi engatholi inzuzo, abaqashi ngeke babe nomsebenzi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphambi kuka-1994, abalimi abaningi balima ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi "izindawo zokuhlala." Eminyakeni edlule, abalimi abaningi abazi ukuthi kukhona izinkinga eziningi ekulimaleni nokuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi nezimo zezulu azifaneleki ekutshaliseni ezinye izitshalo ezizokwenza inzuzo. Uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi: Ukusetshenziswa Kwepulazi Nokuhlola Izinsiza luhlanganiswe ukusiza abalimi baqonde ukuthi isimo sezinsiza zabo sikhona kanjani bese bezokwazi ukusisebenzisa ngezindlela ezizobabuyisela inzuzo esikhathini esizayo ekulimaleni. Ukusebenza nabalimi abanguye amalungu ezigaba zokufunda iminyaka kukhombisile ukuthi kudingeka olunye uhlelo. Siqale uhlelo olusha olubizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo LweBalimi Oluphakeme," oluvumele abaqondisi bezifunda ukuba basondele kulabo abalimi abazama ukuthuthuka. Siphinde sabona ukuthi abalimi abaningi abawasebenzisi kahle amathuba akhona; badinga usizo lokubheka izici ezibalulekile ukuze baphumelele ekulimaleni. Izindawo nezinto ezibalulekile zok继续 umsebenzi. Iziphathimandla zezifunda zezolimo zineziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezifundile kodwa azinakho amandla okwenza umsebenzi emapulazini. Ngemisebenzi yethu yokuqeqesha nabalimi, sisebenze eduze kakhulu neMnyango Wezolimo futhi sifundise izifundo eziningi. Sikholelwa ukuthi uma singahlinzeka ngezifundo ezizokwenza iziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi zibe namandla okwenza umsebenzi, zizokwazi ukusiza abalimi abaningi ukuba bakhule ngokwezimali. Asihlanganisi abalimi neziphathimandla kulolu hlelo olulodwa ngoba iziphathimandla zikhathazekile ukubuza imibuzo phambi kwabalamuli - azifuni ukuhleka. Izifundo zethu zifaka abafundi nemishini, kodwa sithole ukuthi kuvame ukuba bahluleka ukukala imishini ngokwabo. Ukukala nokuphatha umshini wokuphonsa. Abalimi abaningi abahambile ezifundweni zokuphatha imishini nezithuthuthu bacela olunye uhlelo oluzobafundisa ukuthi injini isebenza kanjani nokuthi iyalungiswa kanjani. Abalimi abaningi bahluleka ngoba bangenalo ulwazi lokulungisa injini. Sifuna ukugcizelela lapha ukuthi leli zifundo alihloselwe ukuqeqesha (ukufundisa) abaphathi bezinjini. Lezi zifundo zihloselwe ukufundisa umlimi izingxenye zenjini nokuthi kufanele ziqhathaniswe kanjani. Ukulungisa injini kuyinto okufanele yenziwe nguchwepheshe. Ukulungisa injini noma ibhande lenjini kubiza kakhulu - uma ungenalo ulwazi, uzobe uchitha imali uzama ukulungisa lezo zinto. Lapho abantu behambela lezi zifundo, babona ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kanjani, kodwa bese beqonda ukuthi kukhona ezinye izidingo. Kukhona abakhiqizi ezindaweni ezifana neTaung/Hartswater abangakwazi ukuncibilikisa, nakwezinye izindawo eNyakatho-ntshonalanga naseFree State. Nokho, izindlela zokutshala ubulukhuni zifana, kunezinye izinto okufanele zicatshangelwe uma uncibilikisa.
