Ukuhlinzeka ngenhlonipho ngezindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu; umthelela emthethweni ophathelene nobudlelwano bomuntu; ukuqashelwa ngokusemthethweni kobudlelwano baphakathi kwasekhaya; ukusebenza komthetho ebudlelwaneni baphakathi kwasekhaya; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. UKUQAPHELA ukuthi ukwenziwa komthetho wezomndeni ngemuva kokuqala kweMthethosisekelo akukwazanga ukusinika isimo samaqabane afanayo ukuze sibe namalungelo nezinsiza ezihlobene nomthwalo wokushada onikezwa ukuhlonishwa kwamaqabane abesilisa nabesifazane. a ukuhlela umcimbi wokuhlanganisa nokubhalisela ubudlelwano babantu; futhi b ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela yomcimbi ngemicabango esemthethweni nokubhaliswa kobudlelwano babantu. Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi wokuhlanganisa abantu abesilisa ababili ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zale ngxenye. Ngokuhambisana nale ngxenye, umphakathi wokushada unawo wonke amandla anikezwa nguMthetho Wokushada ukuze ahole umcimbi ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Noma iyiphi ikholi noma inhlangano ingabhalela uNgqongqoshe bese ifaka isicelo sokuba yisikhungo esingahola ubudlelwano babantu. UNgqongqoshe angase anikeze ikholi noma inhlangano amandla okuphatha imicimbi yokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwalomthetho, futhi kufanele, ngezikhathi ezithile, akhiphe imininingwane yazo zonke izikhungo ezinikwe la mandla kwiGazethi. UNgqongqoshe angase aphinde akhiphe amandla anikezwe kumuntu esigabeni 2, uma ikholi noma inhlangano icela ukuthi ikhiphe futhi lokhu kufanele kukhishwe kwiGazethi. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelele anganika umuntu ongumfundisi wenkolo ethile, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe, igunya lokuba umphakathi wokushada, ngokuthi umfundisi noma ubambe isikhundla esithile kuleyo kholi, amandla okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye nangokwezindlela zendabuko zaleyo nkolo. Wonke amandla omphakathi wokushada ngaphansi kwesigaba 4 kufanele abhaliswe emqulwini futhi kufanele afake usuku lokuqala kwala mandla kanye nezithiyo ezibekwe kuwo ezihlanganiswe kulo mqulu. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelele, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe kumuntu ophumelele ngaphansi kwesigaba 4, bangase baphinde bakhiphe igunya lalowo muntu lokushada ngokubhala mayelana namandla abo okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Le ngxenye, ngokuhambisana nesigaba, ayiphakamiseli umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole umcimbi wokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu: Kukhona uma bekwazile ukwazisa uNgqongqoshe ngempela ukuthi umoya wabo uphikisana nokuhlanganisa amaqembu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Isigaba 1 asisebenzi kumaphoyisa okushada abekwa ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. a ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ohlanganisiwe ubonise ubunikazi bakhe obutholwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho weMazisi; noma b ukuthi umuntu ngamunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngombhalo ophakanyisiwe njengoba kuchaziwe; noma c ukuthi omunye wamaqabane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa ubonise ubunikazi obukhuluma ngesigaba a kumphakathi wokushada ngenkathi omunye ehlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngombhalo ophakanyisiwe njengoba kuchaziwe ngesigaba b. Umuntu angaba umlingani kuphela kubudlelwano obubhalisiwe ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umuntu oshadile akakwazi ukubhalisela ubudlelwano. Umuntu ozoba umlingani kubudlelwano babantu obekeshadile ngaphambili noma obekangumlingani kwelinye ubudlelwano kufanele kuqala akhombise ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yeshadi lokuhlukanisa noma isitifiketi sokufa somuntu abeshadile naye noma owayengumlingani wakhe, njengoba kufanelekile, kumphakathi wokushada njengobufakazi bokuthi ubudlelwano buphelile. Umphakathi wokushada angaqhubeka nomcimbi futhi abhalise ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokuthi kuqala anikezwe imibhalo echazwe ngesigaba 3. Ubudlelwano babantu bangabhaliswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uma, ngaphandle kokuthi baphumelele, kungekho ezinye izithiyo zomthetho ezivimbela ukujola. Noma ubani ofuna ukuveza ukuphikiswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa njengabangane kufanele akhiphe lokho ngokubhala kumphakathi wokushada ozohola umcimbi walolo budlelwano. Kufanele kube ukuthi uma umphakathi wokushada ethola lokho ukuphikiswa, kufanele afune izizathu zakhona ukuze aphikise inhlangano kuze kube sekukhona ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi akukho ukuphikiswa komthetho kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa, bese engase aqhubeke nokuhola umcimbi wobudlelwano. Uma futhi enganelisekile, kufanele aphikise ukuhlanganisa ubudlelwano futhi abhale ngezizathu zakhona. Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi futhi abhalise nganoma yisiphi isikhathi nangezinsuku ezithile zeviki, kodwa akuphakamiseli ukuba ahole umcimbi nganoma yisiphi esinye isikhathi ngaphandle kokuthi phakathi kuka-8 a.m. no-4 p.m. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ahole umcimbi futhi abhalise emnyangweni wombuso noma endlini yangasese noma endaweni ethile enikezwe le njongo, ngezicabha zivulekile futhi amaqembu akhona kanye nezinsizwa ezimbili ezingaqinisekisa, kodwa lezi zimo ezandulelayo kule ngxenye azivimbi umphakathi wokushada ekwenzeni ubudlelwano babantu kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuluma lapha, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwendawo echazwe, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngenxa yokugula okukhulu noma ukuhamba isikhathi eside, noma uma kukhona ukulimala komunye wamaqabane, noma kulabo abesilisa ababili abafuna ukuhlanganiswa. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungena esivumelwaneni sobudlelwano ngaphansi kwale ngxenye egameni lomunye umuntu emcimbini. Mayelana nobudlelwano noma umshado ngesikhathi sokufunda amagama okuhlanganisa. Uma amaqembu engavumelani, umphakathi wokushada kufanele, uma efunda inqubo, akhulume ngombono wezomthetho. Uthembisa, A.B., ukuthi ngokwazi kwakho akukho zithiyo zomthetho ezivimbela ukuba ube nobudlelwano obusemthethweni/umshado no-C.D. okhona phambi kwakho naphambi kwalabo abakule ndawo nabeli ofuna ukuba ngofakazi ukuthi uthatha u-C.D. ukuba kube umlingani wakho/womkakho noma umyeni? Kodwa ubudlelwano obusemthethweni/umshado kufanele buqhutshekwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zale ngxenye, lokho kubudlelwano obusemthethweni/umshado kuzoba, uma kungabikho zithiyo zomthetho, kusemthethweni futhi kubophelelekile. Amaqembu kufanele abhale phansi futhi athembise ukuthi afuna ukusungula ubudlelwano obusemthethweni phakathi kwabo bobabili ngokusayina emqulwini ochazwe futhi uyisayine phambi kwabafakazi ababili. Umphakathi wokushada kanye nabafakazi ababili kufanele futhi basayine emqulwini ochazwe ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi isifungo esenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 112 senziwe phambi kwabo. Lesi sitifiketi esikhishwe sikhombisa ubufakazi bokuthi kukhona ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu ababili abanesiginesha esikulesi sitifiketi. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele agcine amarekhodi wezenzakalo zonke abahole. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ngaleso sikhathi abhalise futhi agcine lezi zikhumbuzo futhi azethule kumphakathi wokush
uChristopher, ophakathi kwekhasi langaphandle, wazalwa enomlomo ophukile nohlanga. Uhlanga lwakhe lwalulungisiwe ngesikhathi eneminyaka emithathu, futhi uphumelele kahle kulokho. Umlomo wakhe uzolungiswa cishe eminyakeni eyodwa. Izingane ezazalwe nohlu ophukile zivame ukuba nezinkinga lapho zikhuluma ngoba umlomo awuhlukanisiwe nezindebe. Ngakho-ke, ingane ayikwazi ukususa kahle, okuholela ezinkingeni zokukhuluma emlonyeni noma ebhodweni. Ukungenelela kanye nohlobo lwephukile, oluhluka phakathi kwezingane, kuyizinkomba zokuthi ingane ingadliwa kanjani. Uma ingane inohlu ophukile kuphela, ngokuvamile akukhona ukuhlaselwa okukhulu kokukhuluma. Ukukhona komlomo ophukile kubalulekile enqubweni yokususa. Inqubo yokukhuluma ihilela ubisi obukhishwe emlonyeni (kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusebhodweni noma emlonyeni), isitho esikhiqiza amaphuzu obisi (amaphuzu amancane ajikelezayo), kanye nokunyakaza kwalawa maphuzu kusuka phambili komlomo kuya emuva, lapho angagwinya khona. Ngokomlando, umntwana kumele akwazi ukuphefumula ngempela ngesikhathi sokukhuluma. Lapho isitho sikh placed emlonyeni, izindebe zivaliwe, futhi ulimi luphakanyiswa ukuze luphakamise isitho emlonyeni ophukile. Ulimi luphinde luphakanyiswe, kudala indawo enkulu phakathi kwezindebe, futhi ulimi/uhlanga luvalela umoya ukuthi ungene endaweni. Ngale ndlela, kudalwa isikhala, futhi ubisi lukhishwa emlonyeni. Isikhala sivimba isitho ukuthi singaphumi emlonyeni futhi siza ingane ukuba igcine ukuthola isitho. Izindebe, ulimi, izindebe, nezinsini zikhupha ubisi emlonyeni. Inqubo yokukhuluma ifana noma ngabe iyiphi indlela yokudla (emlonyeni noma ebhodweni). Nokho, isenzo esihilelekile ekukhuphukeni ubisi emlonyeni sihlukile kulokho kokukhuphuka ubisi ebhodweni. Isitho sebhodweni asisebenzisi izindebe, imisipha yobuso, ulimi, izinsini, nezindebe zengane ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, ukuhamba kobisi ebhodweni kushesha kunokukhuluma emlonyeni; nokho, lokhu kuthonywa yizinto eziningi zomzimba, njengohlobo lwebhodweni nesitho kanye nosayizi wesitho. Ukuhamba kobisi ngesikhathi sokukhuluma emlonyeni kulawulwa yikhono lomlomo lokukhiqiza ubisi, kanti ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzekwa kobisi kukamama kuyanda njengoba ingane ikhipha kakhulu. Ubisi lwemlomo luwumkhiqizo womzimba ongasoze udale ukuphazamiseka emzimbeni njengokudla kwezinye izingane. I-mucosa yomlomo yengane enomlomo ophukile ivulekile, futhi ubisi lwemlomo ngeke lube yiphazamiseko kuyo. Ukukhuluma kubonakala kungakhiqizi izinga elifanayo lok pressure emathunjini njengokudla ebhodweni, njengoba izingane ezinephukile zisebenza kakhulu ezinkingeni zokutheleleka kwezindebe. Ukukhuluma kudala isimo esifanele emathunjini, okunciphisa amathuba okuthola ukutheleleka kwezindebe. Ubisi lwemlomo lunezici zokuvikela ezimelene namagciwane. Luhlanganisa i-lactoferrin kanye ne-immunoglobulins ezisiza ukuvimbela ukutheleleka. Izingane ezinephukile ezikhuluma zinezinkinga ezincane ezibikiwe zokutheleleka. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingane ikhuluma noma ibhodwe, kufanele ihlinzekwe ngokudla okunempilo okwanele. Ukukhuluma kusiza njengoba kukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemisipha edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhuluma okujwayelekile (ukuthuthukiswa kwezwi). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindlela zokudla ingane encane zibalulekile kakhulu. Ingane enempilo ithatha cishe imizuzu engama-20-30 ukuze ikhulume kahle, okuvumela ukukhula okufanele nokudla okunempilo. Izingane ezinephukile zivame ukuba nezinkinga zokukhuluma ngenxa yokukhuluma okungasebenzi kahle nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho bezama ukuhlinzeka isitho. Izingane ezinephukile kuphela azivamile ukuba nezinkinga zokukhuluma. Nokho, iphukile ihlula ekwakheni isivalo esivala isitho. Lokhu kuphazamiseka ngenxa yokuthi ingane isebenzisa ingxenye yangemuva yolimi kanye nengxenye yezinsini (ingxenye ephezulu yezinsini ezibamba amazinyo) ukuze idale isivalo esingaphandle kwesitho. Ukungabi khona kwalolu suku kungaholela ekutheni ubisi luphume ephukile. Ukubamba ohlangothini lwengane enomlomo ophukile ngesikhathi sokukhuluma kusiza ukuvimbela ubisi ukuthi lungaphumi. Nokho, ingane enophukile ayikwazi ukudala isivalo ngemuva komlomo ngoba umlomo nezindebe azihlukanisiwe. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba isivalo esidingekayo sangemuva asikwazi ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhuluma. Ukuze kudalwe isivalo sangemuva, kufanele kwakhiwe umoya ophakeme emlonyeni ukuze kudaleke ukuhlinzeka. Kubantwana abanephukile, ukuzama ukudala ukuhlinzeka kufana nokuzama ukuvula ibhaluni eliphukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngaphandle kokukhuluma, ingane ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ubisi emlonyeni. Nakuba kungaphumeleli ukudala umoya ophakeme, uma isitho sikh placed emlonyeni wengane, ukukhuluma ngokudonsa emuva kuzokwenza ingane iphakamise ulimi lwayo ukuze luphakamise isitho emlonyeni ophukile ukuze kudaleke ubisi. Ukungabi khona kwehlanga eliqinile phezulu kusho ukuthi isitho sizopushwa ephukile. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezimbili. Okokuqala, isitho asicindezelwa ngokuphelele emlonyeni, uma sikhona, futhi ulimi luphakanyiswa emuva, futhi okwesibili, uma isitho sikhona ephukile, uma ubisi lukhishwa, luzogwinya ngqo emlonyeni esikhundleni sokudlula emlonyeni nasemoyeni. Ukuhamba kobisi emlonyeni kuholela ekutheni ubisi bungekho kahle, ngakho-ke inqubo yokukhuluma ingathatha isikhathi eside. Ukukhuluma kungaba yinkinga engane enomlomo ophukile, ongase ube nokukhathala ngesikhathi sokukhuluma futhi angase angadli wonke ubisi lwakhe. Uma ingane ingadli ubisi obuningi ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, ngeke ikwazi ukuthola isisindo esanele. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma ingane ithatha isikhathi eside ukuze ikhulume, ibhujiswa ama-calories ngesikhathi sokukhuluma esikhundleni sokuthola ama-calories okufanele ithole. Ngemuva kokukhuluma, kuvamile ukuthi ingane iphumule. Ngesikhathi sokuphumula, ukudliwa kokudla kwengane kuvame ukwehla, okuholela ekutholeni isisindo. Ngakho-ke, uma ingane enomlomo ophukile ivuka njalo ngoba ithatha isikhathi eside ukuze ikhulume, lokhu kungaba enye yezizathu ezivimbela ingane ekutholeni isisindo ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi ukukhuluma kungathathi isikhathi eside kunesikhathi esivamile (okungaba imizuzu engama-20 kuya kwengama-30). Uma inqubo yokukhuluma ibonisa ukuthi ithatha isikhathi eside, kusho ukuthi abazali nabo bchitha isikhathi eside. Izikhathi ezinde ezichithwa ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, nokungaphumeleli kuholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka kwabazali. Uhlobo lwephukile luzothinta impumelelo yokukhuluma. Ukukhuluma ingane enom
Ucwaningo Ngezinkokhelo Zabasebenzi Embonini Yezimayini Sawubona! Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi sinesikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, okungukuthi izinkokhelo zabasebenzi embonini yezimayini. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi le mboni ibaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wethu? Ngempela, izimayini zenza umsebenzi omkhulu, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngamaholo, sithola ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle. Ucinga kanjani ngalezi zinkampani ezinkulu? Ziyaziqhenya ngokukhuluma ngamaholo aphezulu, kodwa uma sithanda ukuhlola okwenzekayo, sithola ukuthi abanye abasebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yazo, kodwa uma kukhulunywa ngamaholo, zihlala zikhuluma ngezindleko kuphela. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kanjani? Ngikhumbula ngikhuluma nomunye umphakathi wezabasebenzi, futhi wakhuluma ngezinkinga ezikhona. Wathi, “Siyazi ukuthi imboni yezimayini iyakhula, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngamaholo, sithola ukuthi abanye bethu basathola amaholo aphansi.” Lokhu kwangithokozisa, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kudingeka baphakanyiswe. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zikhuluma kanjani ngempilo yabantu? Zithanda ukusho ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi, kodwa uma ubheka kahle, uthola ukuthi izinkampani zikhokha kahle kuphela kulabo abaphezulu. Abasebenzi abavamile, ikakhulukazi laba abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezinga elijwayelekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kanjani? Izinkampani zikhuluma ngempilo yabantu, kodwa uma ubheka kahle, uthola ukuthi abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zikhuluma kanjani ngempilo yabantu? Zithanda ukusho ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi, kodwa uma ubheka kahle, uthola ukuthi izinkampani zikhokha kahle kuphela kulabo abaphezulu. Abasebenzi abavamile, abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezinga elijwayelekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kanjani? Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, kodwa abanye bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezinga elijwayelekile.
Izinkondlo: Umcimbi Wokubhalwa Kwezinkanyezi Ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, umcimbi wokubhalwa kwezinkondlo uhlelwe ngempumelelo emzini omncane, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya khona njengemibala emihle ebhalwe phezulu. Umcimbi lo, owawuhlelwe ngothando, wawuhloselwe ukuvusa umoya wobuciko phakathi kwabantu, nokubavumela ukuba baveze imizwa yabo ngezinkondlo ezithokozisayo. Umsindo wezingoma ezithokozisayo wawuhamba emoyeni, uhlanganisa izwi lempilo nomoya wokudala. Ababhali bezinkondlo, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, babebuthene endaweni ethokomele, bejabulile futhi bephokophele ekubhaleni. Umoya wawugcwele ithemba, njengoba abantu bejabulisa izinkanyezi ngezinkulumo zabo ezijulile. Umcimbi waqala ngenkulumo yokwamukela, lapho umholi wemboni, uMnu. Mthembu, ethula umqondo wokuthi izinkondlo ziwumthombo wokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, izifiso, nezifundo ezitholakala empilweni. Wakhuthaza bonke abathandi bezinkondlo ukuba baveze imizwa yabo, baphinde bahloniphe izinkanyezi ezibhalwe emhlabeni. Ngemuva kwalokho, ababhali baphakanyiswa ukuba baveze izinkondlo zabo. Umoya wawugcwele ubuciko, njengoba izwi lethu lathokozisa izithameli. UThandi, owayebhalile izinkondlo ezimnandi, wakhuluma ngothando, wabelana ngezinkumbulo ezinhle, ezazithinta inhliziyo. Izinkondlo zakhe zazigcwele imizwa, zikhombisa ubuhle bokuphila. UPhumzile, owayebhalile izinkondlo ezithinta izinkinga zomphakathi, wakhuluma ngempilo yabantu abahluphekayo, wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphakamise izwi labo. Izinkondlo zakhe zazingezokukhumbuza, zikhombisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Abantu babemamatheka, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ngezinkulumo ezijulile. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ngezinkondlo zabo. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, njengoba ababhali bephakanyiswa ukuba baphendulane, babelane ngemicabango nemizwa. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wobuciko, kwenza umcimbi ube yimpumelelo enkulu. Ngemuva kokubhalwa kwezinkondlo, umcimbi waphothulwa ngengoma ethokozisayo, lapho bonke abathandi bezinkondlo behlanganyela. Umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubungane, nokuhlonipha. Izinkanyezi zazikhanya, zikhombisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Umcimbi wokubhalwa kwezinkondlo wawungowokukhumbula, ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwabelana. Abantu babebuthene, bejabulisa izinkanyezi, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi bephila ubuciko. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi izinkondlo ziwumthombo wokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, zikhombisa ubuhle bokuphila, nokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi, umcimbi wawuhamba phambili, ubonisa ukuthi izinkondlo ziwumthombo wokukhuluma, zikhombisa imizwa, nezifiso. Abantu babebuthene, bejabulisa izinkanyezi, bephila ubuciko, futhi bephakamisa izwi labo. Umcimbi wawungowokukhumbula, ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwabelana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphothulwa, kodwa imizwa, izinkumbulo, nezinkanyezi zihlala zikhanya ezinkumbulweni zethu. Izinkondlo zaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, zikhombisa ubuhle bokuphila, nokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Umcimbi wokubhalwa kwezinkondlo wawungowokukhumbula, ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwabelana.
Kubahlonishwa kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azi ukuthi iKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ngaphansi kweSahluko 11 seMthetho weKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 46 ka-1997) ifundwa kanye neSahluko 196 (f) (ii) yoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) isungule imithetho ebhalwe kuSheduli 1 lapha. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi omunye umqashi, ummeleli noma isisebenzi sebhizinisi esamukelekayo ubambe iqhaza. Ukuphathwa noma ukusingathwa kwezinkinga kufanele kube ngokushesha, kungakhethi, futhi kube nokuqonda, kube nobudlelwano obuqinile endaweni yokusebenza, nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga zomuntu ngamunye ezingeni eliphansi lelo department. Inkinga kufanele ixazululwe ngumqashi lapho ivela khona noma ezingeni eliseduze. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinkinga zixazululwa ngendlela efanele, engakhethi, futhi ngaphandle kokucwasa, futhi ukuthi izimiso zobulungiswa zilandelwa. Le nqubo kufanele isize futhi ivumele umqashi nomqashi ukuthi baxazulule ukunganeliseki. Akekho umqashi okufanele abhekane nokuhlukunyezwa noma ukuhlukumezeka ngqo noma ngokuqondile ngenxa yokuthi baphakamisile inkinga. Uma umqashi ebhekene nesinyathelo sokuziphatha, ukusetshenziswa kwale nqubo ngumqashi ukuze abhekane nendaba ephathelene nesinyathelo sokuziphatha ngeke kube yinqubo yokuziphatha. Inkinga kufanele ibhalwe phansi lapho ithunyelwa, futhi zonke izinqumo ezenziwe kule nqubo kufanele zibhale. Uma kubhekwa izikhathi ezinqunyiwe, lokhu kufanele kubalwe ngokukhipha usuku lokuqala bese kubalwa usuku lokugcina. Ababandakanyekayo kufanele bahloniphe izikhathi ezibekwe kule nqubo, ngaphandle uma bevuma ukwandisa isikhathi. Inkinga kufanele ithunyelwe kumqashi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 kusukela ngosuku umqashi waqaphela ngalo isenzo esamphazamisayo noma ukungasebenzi. Umqashi angacela ukuthi inkinga yakhe ithunyelwe kuKomishini phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 ngemuva kokuthola isinqumo kusuka kumphakathi ofanele. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ulwazi oludingekayo oludingekayo ukuze aphakamise futhi alandele inkinga, uma kuceliwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwalolu lwazi kuncike kunoma yiziphi izithiyo zomthetho. Umqashi kufanele aziswe ngesimo senkinga yakhe nokuthi isiphumelele kangakanani ekuxazululweni ngosuku oluhlelwe. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ikhophi yefomu lenkinga ngemuva kwazo zonke izigaba lapho inkinga ibhekwa khona ngumphakathi. Umqashi angathumela inkinga yakhe kumqashi oqokiwe noma umxhumanisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izinkinga kulelo department. Ifomu elibekwe ku-Anexure A kufanele lisetshenziswe lapho kuthunyelwa inkinga. Umqashi oqokiwe kufanele axhumane nomphakathi ofanele kulelo department ukuzama ukuxazulula inkinga. Inkinga ingaxazululwa noma yimuphi umuntu kulowo mkhakha ofanele onegunya lokwenza njalo. Umqashi ophakamisile inkinga uzokwaziwa ngumqashi oqokiwe ngesimo nokuqhubeka kwenziwa ekuxazululeni inkinga. Uma inkinga ixazululwe ngendlela efanelekile, umqashi ophakamisile inkinga uzothola ukuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe ngalokhu kumqashi oqokiwe. Uma inkinga ingaxazululwa, umphakathi ofanele kufanele wazise umqashi ophakamisile inkinga. Idepartment (kuhlanganise nomphakathi ofanele) inezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nenkinga. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngenkontileka ebhaliwe. Umphakathi kufanele, ngokweSahluko 35 (1) seMthetho weZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ka-1994, uthumele inkinga nemibhalo efanele kuKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ukuze enze iziphakamiso phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zokuxhumana nomqashi onezinkinga. Uma inkinga ihlanganisa ukuhweba okungafanele njengokuchazwe kuMthetho Wezokuhweba ka-1995, umqashi angazisa umphakathi ofanele ukuthi ufuna ukusebenzisa inqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano esunguliwe kuMthethosisekelo weBhodi yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, noma yisiphi isibalo esihambisanayo (noma yisiphi isikhungo esihambisanayo) futhi ukuthi iKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ayikwazi ukubheka le nkinga. a ngqo kuKomishini; noma b uma kuyinkinga yokuhweba neBhodi yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi noma yisiphi isibalo esihambisanayo noma yisiphi isikhungo esihambisanayo mayelana nenqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano. Uma iKomishini isitholile lonke ulwazi oluvela kumphakathi ofanele, kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30, ibheke le nkinga futhi ibhale kumphakathi ofanele ngeziphakamiso zayo nezizathu zesenzo sayo. Ngemuva kokuthola iziphakamiso zeKomishini, umphakathi ofanele kufanele, phakathi kwezinsuku ezinhlanu, ubhale kumqashi kanye neKomishini ngesinqumo saso. a thumele inkinga yayo kuMongameli uma iyinhloko ye department kazwelonke; noma b thumele inkinga yayo kumphakathi ofanele uma iyinhloko ye department yesifunda. UMongameli noma uMholi weSifunda unezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nenkinga. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngokuvumelana. Imithetho F9 noF10 ifundwa nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo futhi izosebenza kuzo zonke izinkinga zezinhloko ze department. Inhloko ye department kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izixazululo zezingxabano ziqashwa ngokugcina amarekhodi enani lezinkinga ezixazululiwe kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka ngamunye nokubika kuKomishini ngalokhu njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. IKomishini kufanele ibike kwiPhalamende okungenani kanye ngonyaka mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinkinga nokusebenza kahle kwenqubo yokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nezisebenzi zayo, ePhalamende lesifunda. Uma inkinga ithunyelwe ngaphansi kwale nqubo, umqashi ophakamisile inkinga kufanele akhulume uma efuna ukusebenzisa ezinye izinqubo. Inkinga ephakanyisiwe ngaphambi kokukhululwa kweMithetho Yesikhashana, ngaphambi kosuku luka-1 kuJulayi 1999, izophathwa futhi iphethwe ngokweMithetho Yesikhashana yokuxazulula izinkinga ekhishwe ngaphansi kokukhululwa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni No. 20231 ka-1999. Usuku lokusebenza kwale mithetho ngu-19 kuZibandlela 2003, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe kuMthetho K. Le fomu kufanele isetshenziswe ukuze kuphakanyiswe inkinga (ukukhishwa kwezinsolo zokukhishwa okungalungile) uma unganelisekile ngesenzo noma ukungasebenzi futhi ungakwazi ukuxazulula le ndaba ngenkulumo engafanele ngokomthetho. Ungasizwa noma umelelwe omunye umqashi noma ummeleli noma isisebenzi esivela enhlanganweni esamukelekayo. Kubalulekile ukugcwalisa yonke imininingwane ngokunembile. Uma ifomu liphothuliwe, kufanele linikezwe kumqashi oqokiwe ukuze alawule noma abe umxhumanisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izinkinga kulelo centre. Idepartment izobophela le fomu kumanye amadokhumenti ezinkinga futhi izosetshenziswa kuzo zonke izigaba zenqubo yokuxazulula izinkinga. Kuwo wonke amazinga lapho umuntu emkhakheni ofanele womphakathi ezama ukuxazulula inkinga,
Indawo ilandela ezinye izidingo ezingase zifakwe. Thumela ifomu kuwebhusayithi, bese uligcwalisa kathathu. Le fomhu ingacelwa futhi kuMphakathi Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfaki, futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Imali yesicelo kufanele ithunyelwe ngecheki kule ndawo elandelayo: Umqondisi-Jikelele: Ezolimo. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi, njengoba kwezinye izimo, lokhu kuqala ngokwamukela izinhlelo ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwezakhiwo.
Ezomlando: Ukubaluleka Kwezinto Esizifundile Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, akukhona nje okukhona manje. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ezomlando zifundisa, zikhumbuza, futhi ziqondisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Ngabe ubuwazi ukuthi izinto ezenzeka eminyakeni edlule zenza ukuthi sibe nohlu lwemibono nezinkolelo? Ngakho, masiqale kule ndaba ethokozisayo! Ukuqala, sizobheka ukuthi yini ezomlando. Ngokujwayelekile, ezomlando zifaka phakathi izenzakalo, abantu, nezindawo ezibalulekile. Umqondo wokuthi "ukufunda emlandweni" ungase ubonakale ungajwayelekile, kodwa empeleni, kungenxa yokuthi lezi zinto zifana nezikhumbuzo ezithile. Zisitshela ukuthi singenza kanjani okungcono, siphinde sikhumbule ukuthi izinto azihlali zishintsha. Ngicabanga ukuthi kumele sikhumbule abaphambili bethu. Abantu abafana noShaka Zulu, uNelson Mandela, noHendrik Verwoerd. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani sikhumbula laba bantu. UShaka, ngokwesibonelo, wayengumholi ophumelelayo, owashintsha kakhulu izimpi nezinqubomgomo zamasiko. UNelson Mandela, yena, usikhumbuza ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa futhi usinika ithemba. Ukukhumbula lezi zinkanyezi zomlando kusinika amandla okwakha ikusasa el better. Ngokuphathelene nezindawo, akusiyona nje imizi esiyazi, kodwa nezindawo ezibalulekile ezifana neShaka's Kraal, iRobben Island, neGugulethu. Lezi zindawo zikhumbuza izinkumbulo ezinzima, kodwa futhi zikhombisa amandla abantu. Ziyizikhumbuzo eziphilayo, zikhumbuza ukuthi sithathwa kanjani, futhi zikhombisa indlela esihamba ngayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ezomlando zikhona emhlabeni wonke. Akukhona nje eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa nasemhlabeni jikelele. Izwe ngalinye linomlando walo, futhi lezi zindaba zihlala zibalulekile. Ukufunda ngezinye izizwe, izinkolo, nezinkolelo kungasivulela umqondo omusha. Lokhu kusivumela ukuba sibe nobudlelwano obungcono nabanye abantu. Ngabe ubuwazi ukuthi ezomlando zikwazi ukusifundisa ngezinto ezimbi? Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhumbula izimpi, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga ezibuhlungu. Lokhu kufundisa ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa kumele sikhumbule nezikhathi ezinzima. Lokhu kungenza sibe nokuqonda okukhulu, futhi sithole indlela yokuphila ngokuhlonipha abanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezomlando zikhona ezikoleni. Abantwana bethu kufanele bafunde ngempela ngalezi zinto. Ukufundiswa kwezomlando akukhona nje ukufunda izinsuku ezithile, kodwa ukufundiswa kwezifundo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi baphuma kuphi, futhi benze kahle ekwakheni ikusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ezomlando zihlale zishintsha. Njengoba sithola izinsiza ezintsha, izincwadi, nezinsiza zedijithali, kumele sibe nekhono lokuhlola lezi zinto. Lokhu kusivumela ukuba sithole izimo ezihlukahlukene zomlando, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona nje okukhona, kodwa kukhona okungakaze kubonakale. Ngokuphetha, ezomlando zibalulekile empilweni yethu. Zifundisa, zikhumbuza, futhi ziqondisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Ngakho, asifundi nje, kodwa masithathe isikhathi sokucabanga nokuqonda. Lokhu kuzokwenza siphile impilo engcono, sikhumbule abaphambili bethu, futhi sibe nekhono lokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha, futhi ngithemba ukuthi le ngxoxo ikwenze ucabange kabanzi ngezomlando. Hamba kahle, futhi ungakhohlwa ukubheka emuva ukuze uqonde kahle ikusasa!
UMphathiswa weMvula neMithi, ngaphansi kwemvume enikezwe yizigaba ezingu-26 (a) no (g), kanye nesigaba esingu-116 esifundwe ndawonye nesigaba esingu-21(k) seMthetho weMvula Kazwelonke, 1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998), ubonisa ukufuna ukwenza imithetho kuSheduli. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kuhambisana nesu elivunyelwe lokusebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, okuyisu lokwenza imisebenzi ngokuhambisana nomgomo 5 lapho kufanelekile; futhi futhi kuhambisana nezidingo zanyanyiso esithokozisayo sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, lapho kudingeka. Futhi izindlela ezifanele zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; kanye nendawo lapho kukhona izindawo ezithintekayo noma ezivikela uma kungekho isu elivunyelwe lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngendlela enomthelela omkhulu noma ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo yokuzijabulisa kufanele afake isicelo sokuvunyelwa kwesu lokwenza imisebenzi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi okunomthelela omkhulu noma ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 zokuthola isaziso ngendlela efanele ukuze enze kanjalo. Ngokuhambisana nanoma yiziphi izinqubo ezilawulayo eziphathelene nezinsiza kanye nezindawo; nokuvikela nokwandisa izimfanelo namasiko aphathelene nomthombo wamanzi. Lokhu kuhambisana nezidingo zomgomo 2; futhi noma yimuphi umfaki-sicelo obonisile ukuthi angakwazi, noma uzokwazi ukuphatha nokulawula imithelela emibi kumthombo wamanzi njengoba kuhlonishwa kumgomo 2g. Umgomo wokulawula ungase ucele olunye ulwazi kumuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, njengendaba yomgomo 2 futhi ungase ubonise ukuthi isu eliphakanyisiwe lokwenza imisebenzi lishintshiwe njengoba kudingeka umgomo wokulawula. Uma umgomo wokulawula uvumele isu lokwenza imisebenzi, umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa kufanele ahambisane nezinhlinzeko zalesi sikhathi esivunyelwe sokwenza imisebenzi. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi kufanele lithuthukiswe ngumgomo ofanele futhi lezi zinhlinzeko kufanele zethulwe umgomo wokulawula ukuze kuvunyelwe ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kulowo mthombo wamanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, kuhlanganise namanzi angaphezulu emisebenzi kahulumeni, ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-180 kusukela ngosuku umgomo ofanele watshelwa umgomo wokulawula ukuze enze kanjalo. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, njengoba lichazwe kumgomo 1, kufanele libhalwe ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zeMnyango mayelana ne-Integrated Water Resource Management Strategy, ephathelene Nokusetshenziswa Kwamanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, eprintwe ngoMsombuluko 2005. Kufanele kusungulwe umgomo wokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi kufanele kuvumeleke ukuthi kube nezimvo ezibhaliwe ezithunyelwa ngesicelo esiphakanyisiwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokushicilelwa kwesaziso; futhi kufanele kubhekwane nazo zonke izimvo ezamukelekayo. Kungase kushintshwe umgomo wokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi ngokuhambisana nomgomo 3, kushicilelwe isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi ezincwadini nasemithonjeni eminingi ephathelene nomthombo wamanzi othintekayo. Noma yimuphi umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa kufanele abhekane nezidingo zokugcina amarekhodi okusetshenziswa kwamanzi afanele futhi anikeze umgomo wokulawula ngalolo lwazi. Akekho omunye umuntu, ngaphandle kokuba enevumelekile ebhaliwe yoMphathiswa, ongafinyelela kunoma yisiphi isici semisebenzi yamanzi kahulumeni, lapho kungekho indawo yokufinyelela esemthethweni. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo yokuzijabulisa akuvunyelwe kunoma yisiphi isici semisebenzi yamanzi kahulumeni ngaphandle kokuba uMphathiswa evumelekile ngobufakazi obubhaliwe. Akukho imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa ezindaweni zokuphepha zomjaho wamanzi kanye nomlomo wemisebenzi noma ekuphumelelweni kwayo ngaphandle kokuba uMphathiswa akhiphe imvume ebhaliwe; futhi kuphela izimoto ezihamba ngesivinini esingaphazamisi kuphela ezivunyelwe ezindaweni ezibekwe ngaphandle kokuzijabulisa. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophula noma ongahambisani nezinhlinzeko zalemithetho ubhekwa njengomphangi futhi, uma ebanjwa, ubhekene necebo noma ukuvalelwa isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu. Lezi zinhlinzeko zingabizwa ngokuthi Imithetho Yokusetshenziswa Kwamanzi Ngenhloso Yokuzijabulisa. Ingxenye yokuqala ibeka izimo nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ngesikhathi sezigaba zokuqala zokwenza umsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process ngaphakathi komnyango wesifunda. Ingxenye yesibili ibeka izimo ezizokwenziwa ekupheleni kwesigaba sokuhlola ukuze kugcinwe inqubo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokhu kunikeza abasebenzi ithuba lokufaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa kokusebenza kwabo ngenkathi ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhuluma ngokuqhuba nokubuyekezwa kwezinhlelo ezibekwe kanye nokwethembeka kwazo. Inqubo yokuhlola iwumphumela wesivumelwano seSouth African Local Government Bargaining Council (SALGBC) sokuthi kukhona isidingo sokuthi kube nendlela efanayo yokuhlola ukusebenza ngaphakathi komnyango wombuso wendawo. Kubonwa ukuthi le uniformity ibalulekile ezicini ezihlukahlukene zokuhweba njengezinkulumo zokuhola, ukuqonda okwanele kwezikhundla zabasebenzi kanye nezimo zenhlangano, ukuhlela kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa. Lo mbhalo wezinyathelo kufanele ufundwe ngokuhlanganyela nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process, ama-Job Evaluation Training Manuals, kanye namarekhodi omnyango wesifunda mayelana nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process. Uhloswe ukuhlela inqubo ukuze kugwenywe ukubambezeleka ekwenzeni ukuhlola ngenxa yokungavumelani okungadingekile nokuphikisana. Kuqondiswe ukuqeda isigaba sokuqala senqubo yokuhlola ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingangama-18 months. Kubalulekile ukuthi le nqubo ibe nekhono elikhulu ngangokunokwenzeka futhi ivunyelwe kubasebenzi. Akukho umsebenzi ozosala esimweni sokusebenza okungafanele kunalokho okukhona okwamanje okukhona ngenxa yokuhlolwa kokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasebenzi akufanele balindele ukuthi isigaba sokuhlola sizohlinzeka ngenkonzo yokwaneliseka kubo bonke. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukuxoxisana ngokwenyuka kwemiholo nezibuyekezo ezintsha akusho ukuthi kukhona ukukhuphuka kwemiholo kubo bonke abasebenzi kodwa kuwukuguqulwa kwenqubo yokuhlola esivele ikhona ibe yindlela eyodwa. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le ndlela iyasetshenziswa. Ngemuva kwalokho, wonke umuntu uzoba nethuba lokufaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwesikhundla sabo uma bezwa ukuthi isigaba sabo asikhombisi kahle umqondo womsebenzi wabo noma uma bezwa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ushintshile ngemuva kokuhlolwa kokuqala kwezikhundla. Izindawo zokuhlola ziwumkhawulo osemthethweni obekwe ukuze kusungulwe amaKomidi Wokuhlola Imisebenzi (PJECs) kuze kube yilapho inqubo yokuhlola iphelile. Zonke izinkantolo zendawo zizoba Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi. Ezinye Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi zizokwenziwa yiKomidi Eliphezulu le-SALGBC ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiMnyango we-SALGBC. Lezi ziphakamiso kufanele zifake okungenani iNdawo Yezifunda lapho kunezisebenzi eziningi noma ziphakamise ukuhlanganisa izindawo zeZifunda ezinezisebenzi ezincane
Okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala Umbuzo 1: Yini eyaholela ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala? Impendulo: Ukukhathazeka okukhulayo ngezinsolo zenkohlakalo emaphikweni omasipala kube yinto ebalulekile. Abantu baveze ukukhathazeka ngezimali ezichithwa, izinkontileka ezingalingani, nezinsiza ezingatholakali kalula. Lokhu kuholele emaphakathini ukuba aphakamise izinkulumo ezinzima. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinsolo ezibalulekile ezikhuluma ngenkohlakalo? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinsolo eziphakanyisiwe zifaka phakathi ukwephulwa kwezimiso zokuphatha kahle izimali, izinkontileka ezikhethwe ngendlela engafanele, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabaphathi nabathengisi ukukhipha imali engafanele. Lokhu kuthe xaxa kwahlola izimo ezicacile zokungathembeki. Umbuzo 3: Uhlolo lwenziwe kanjani? Impendulo: Uhlolo lwezinsolo lwenziwa ngokubamba izingxoxo nezinhlaka ezihlukene. Izikhungo zocwaningo, izinkantolo, nabahlali baphakathi kwama-committees abekwe ukuhlola izinsolo. Lokhu kudinga ubufakazi obusemthethweni kanye nemibiko yezehlakalo eziyingozi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi iziphakamiso ezivela kulolu hlolo? Impendulo: Iziphakamiso ezivela kulolu hlolo zifaka phakathi ukuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokuphatha izinsiza, ukwandisa ukubonakala kwemali, nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukayo zokubika izinsolo. Ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga, kudingeka ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nezakhamuzi. Umbuzo 5: Zithini izinzuzo zokudluliselwa kolwazi kumasipala? Impendulo: Ukudluliselwa kolwazi kulokhu kukhuthaza ukugunyazwa kobufakazi kanye nokukhulisa ukuzwakala kwakho komasipala. Lokhu kusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zenzelwe impilo yebhizinisi elungile. Izinzuzo zihlanganisa ukwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwezakhamuzi kanye nemiphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe kukhona izinhlelo ezithathwayo ukuze kubhekwane nezinsolo zenkohlakalo? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinhlelo eziningi ezithathiwe. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi, ukwakha izinhlelo zokubika ezivulekile, kanye nokwandisa ithuba lokuhlola izimali. Lezi zinyathelo zenzelwe ukuze zinciphise amathuba okungeqisi nokwehlisa izinga lenkohlakalo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinselelo ezikhona uma kuziwa ekulalelweni kwezinsolo? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinselelo zifaka ukungabikhona kobufakazi obuqinile, ukukhokha kokubhujiswa kwabantu abavela ezinkampanini zokusiza, nokushaqeka kwamaphoyisa nezinhlaka eziphathelene nezokuphatha. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukufakazela izinsolo ezithile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela ezithathwe ukuze kugwenywe inkohlakalo? Impendulo: Izindlela zokuvikela zifaka phakathi ukujolisa emithonjeni yokubika, ukusungula izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nokuphathwa okuhle kwempumelelo. Konke lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe inhlonipho nokusisha phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 9: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kulungiswe lezi zinkinga? Impendulo: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokubika ezivulekile, ukwakha imithombo yobufakazi kanye nezinhlelo zokubonisana, kanye nezehlakalo zokufundisa ebuholini. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bazame ukuhlanganyela. Umbuzo 10: Ubulili besakhamuzi buhlinzeka nobani? Impendulo: Ubulili besakhamuzi busiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana. Abesifazane nabesilisa kufanele babe nesikhala sokubamba iqhaza ekuvikelweni nasekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza. Ubulili buhlangana nezinhloso eziphakeme zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuphatha. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe imiphumela yenkohlakalo ibonakala kanjani? Impendulo: Imiphumela yenkohlakalo ibonakala ngokuncipha kwemali yokuphathwa, ukungabi namathuba alungile omsebenzi, futhi kunezingozi ezingaba khona ekuphileni kwabantu. Lokhu kudala ukuba kube nempikiswano ende phakathi kwezakhamuzi nabaphathi. Umbuzo 12: Umaphakathi ubamba imaphi imisebenzi ekulweni nenkohlakalo? Impendulo: Umasipala uthatha ubumqoka bokwenza ucwaningo olunembile, ukuxhumana nezakhamizi, kanye nokwakha amaqembu ahlose ukubhekana nenkohlakalo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusizakala kubo bonke abantu. Ukwenza kokuqeda: Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokulandela izinsolo zenkohlakalo kumasipala ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuphepha nokuthula. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izisebenzi, kanye nezakhamuzi kuzoba nezithelo ezizwakalayo emiphakathini. Izinyathelo ezithathwe kufanele zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophila kahle, ubumbene, futhi onokukhangeleka okukhulu.
U-Cristiano Ronaldo: Umqeqeshi Wokuphila Nokuhlala Ekhumbuleka U-Cristiano Ronaldo ungomunye wabantu ababhalela igama elikhulu emlandweni wezokudlala. Uqale ukufaka umqondo obalulekile emhlabeni wonke, kusukela esebenzisa amakhono akhe aphawulekayo enkundleni yezeMidlalo, kuze kube yilesi sikhathi esivamile esikukhulumayo. U-Ronaldo akayena nje umgibeli ophumelelayo, U-Ronaldo ungumfanekiso wokuzimisela, uthando, nesibindi. U-Cristiano, owazalelwa eMadeira, ePortugal, unolwazi oluhlukahlukene lapho izinto ziqala khona. Ukuthola izinkanyezi ezikhaliphile kudinga ukudlula ezishadweni, neminyaka ezinzima. U-Ronaldo waziwa kahle, kodwa lokhu akukhona kuphela ngokokumangalisa kwezinyawo zakhe. Kuqala, izinsuku zokuqala zomsebenzi wakhe zikhombisa ukuthi ukwazi kwakhe ukubhekana nezithiyo ezinzima. Lokhu kudlulisa umyalezo obalulekile – izimpumelelo azivamile, impilo yami idinga ukuzimisela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Ronaldo wafika emhlabeni jikelele ukwaziwa esemqhudelwaneni eyaziwa kakhulu, i-UEFA Champions League. Umdlalo wayo ufake izigaba zomphakathi wezomhlaba ophakathi kwezifundo, owagubha ubuhle bokudlala nezithakazelo zomlando. U-Luka Modric, uLionel Messi, njalonjalo babengabobani kwimikhakha emakhulwini. Nokho, lokho akushayisa phansi ithalente le-Ronaldo, obamba isikhala sakhe ngokucacile. U-Ronaldo ubalulekile engqondweni yezinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo, kodwa ubungqabavu bakhe buphinde ubuye kakhulu ngendlela yakhe yokuphila. Okwamanje, u-Ronaldo akaguquki kuphela emkhakheni wezokudlala, kodwa ubuye abe yisibonelo sezimo zokuphila. Uthwala izikhali ezibalulekile emphakathini, futhi ukwazi kwakhe ukuphinda afunde ngemva kokuhluleka kubalulekile. Ubuwena, uyakwazi ukuvuma ukubaluleka komphakathi, futhi ubukeka ezicini ezibarhu. Hhayi nje ukujabulisa abafundi nokuqinisa abaphambi kwakhe emathubeni, u-Ronaldo usikhumbuza ukuthi impumelelo ingalungiseka kuphela uma uthola ubuhlakani. Inline neziqu zami zomgibeli, kuveze izifundo ezibalulekile eziphuma kuma-Instagram nawo ngemikhosi yempumelelo. U-Ronaldo angowemisebenzi emikhulu, kodwa ubuyela emuva ukuze abuyise emiphakathini. Izimfundiso zakhe zikhuluma ngesibopho, uthando lokudlala, nezifundo zokuphila. Umqondo wekosi ophumelela ayikho emsebenzini kuphela, kodwa ungomoya ophilayo. Lokhu kwakhe okusho u-Ronaldo kwenzeka ngaphambili emiphakathini eminingi, okukhombisa ukuthi akakwenzi ngokwakhe kuphela. Ungakholwa othandweni bezemidlalo, lokhu kubukeka kuhlasela izinkanyezi eziningi. I-Ronaldo, kanye nomphakathi, ukhipha ubudlelwano obuhle nalabo abaphila nempilo ngemiyono. Ngelixa lokuchitha umphakathi, uthuthukisa ubudlelwano bezemidlalo, abavela emakhampasini, kuzo ubudlelwano obuqinile ezintweni ezinkulu. Ukuphila kwakhe kusebenza kahle, futhi lokhu kuzenza kube yindlela enkulu yokuziphatha. Ukuba u-Ronaldo uwe emkhakheni njengoba emzimbeni, unompilo oluningi obhalela izithakazelo zempilo. Lo mgibeli uyabamba into eyabamba umoya wenzima, eningacaceli imeko. U-Ronaldo uzisola, ukhumbuze abanye ukuthi yiphupho eliqhakazile, nokho akuyena osebenzayo ukuze abashaye izinkanyezi. Lolu hlobo luphathelene nezinto ezimnandi eziphelile, owanikeza abanye umoya ochichima. U-Cristiano Ronaldo, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubalulekile ezifundweni zamadokhumenti ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Ngaphandle kokubukeka kwamakhono akhe, ukuphilaongeza ubudlelwano, kulokhu umncintiswano akasakhumbuli kuphela. U-Ronaldo ungomunye wezitha ezikhulu, okubonisa ukuthi ungashintsha indaba yethu. Lokhu phakade kulungiswa uthi: "Uze, ungiphe eyakho ebe ngiyiseduze." U-Ronaldo unobungqabavu bakhe obugqokekayo nezinsuku ezizayo. U-Ronaldo akangabazeki – uyaziwa bukhulu kuphela njengobulembu obunothile, kancane sizoshaya umhlaba. U-Ronaldo ubalulekile empilweni, lohnta uyaziqhenya ngemisebenzi yakhe. Lokhu kuvela emihlweni yesikhathi, emhlabeni ozokwaziwa njengekanjani. Ekugcineni, u-Cristiano Ronaldo ungomunye wababhalayo emhlabeni wezokudlala, umphakathi kumehlo kabani; ubunomoya, yena asenamahloni akhe. Empilweni, usheshisa futhi ungitshana, kodwa ubuyile esiyinhloko. U-Ronaldo usakwazi ukufaka izifundo, nokho ubhalela abantu indaba yabo. Ngahluleka, ngiyafunda, ngiyaphila. Ukuphila kwegazi lakhe kunoMoya ophilayo, nendlela ahlekaya ngayo imisebenzi ehamba phambili, umkhankaso, noguquko olwaqinile. Nokho, indebe iyakuthinta kumazwi ahlakaniphile, sengiyavuma, uCristiano Ronaldo, onqoba, unothando lwezinkanyezi, umkhwezi obungadjwa. Nkulu impumelelo, izitokwe zezinsuku, uphumula ebudlelwaneni bomphakathi. Ngiyabonga, Cristiano, uyinsika, ungumusa, ungumqeqeshi onguMsizi, ungumuntu obalulekile emhlabeni.
Fika ekhaya ngokuphepha. Le bhukwana iyisikhumbuzo sokukusiza ukuthi ugcine impilo enhle ngesikhathi uhamba. Bakhululekile ukuphendula noma yimiphi imibuzo ongase ube nayo mayelana nempilo yakho. Uma uqasha abashayeli bezinqola, unegunya kubo. Ingabe ugcina umthetho wezempilo kubo bonke abasebenzi? Ingabe unikeza ulwazi lwezempilo nezifonyo? Ingabe uvumela abashayeli ukuba bathathe izikhawu ukuze bazikhulule uma behamba ngezinsuku ezinde? Ingabe unikeza abashayeli bakho izigqoko zokugqoka uma besiza abalimele? Thatha umzuzu ukuphendula le mibuzo elandelayo. Ingabe nginokuhlukumezeka noma amanxeba ezindaweni zami ezizimele? Kuthiwani ngothandekayo wami? Ingabe kukhona okukhishwayo, ukuvuvukala, noma ukuhamba phezulu? Ingabe uthandekayo wami unokukhishwayo? Uma uphendula ngempela, wenzenjani? Uma uphendula ngempela, wena nethandekayo lakho (noma abanye) kufanele ufune iseluleko sezempilo esibhedlela, esikhungweni sokwelapha, noma endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngoba kulula ukuphatha izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi/IZifo Zokuthathelana. Ngoba uma unayo isifo esithathelwana ngocansi, amathuba okuthola nokudlulisela igciwane le-HIV aphezulu kakhulu. Ingabe uyazi ngama-centre ezempilo nezinsizakalo zolwazi ezisendleleni? Abashayeli bezinqola bamukelwa! Ngabe ngingaya kuphi uma ngigula endleleni? Endleleni ohamba kuyo, ungaya kunoma iyiphi isibhedlela sikamasipala, esikhungweni sokwelapha, noma kudokotela. Kodwa kunzima ukumisa endleleni yakho eqondile. Kuphinde kube nzima ukupaka inqola yakho phakathi nosuku uma uhlela ukuyishiya isikhathi eside. Kukho enye indlela! Zama enye yalezi zikhungo ezihlinzeka ngolwazi endleleni. Kukhona abaphilayo abaqeqeshiwe nabangane, futhi ungathola nezeluleko nolwazi oluvela kubachwepheshe bezempilo mayelana nanoma yisiphi isimo sezempilo ongahlangabezana naso. Ungapaka inqola yakho esikhungweni sokwelapha futhi uthole usizo ngisho nasebusuku. Yini usizo oluhlinzekwa izikhungo zokwelapha ezisendleleni? Ulwazi lokuthi ungaya kuphi uma ufuna ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV/AIDS. Zonke izindlela ezitholakele kulezi zikhungo zokwelapha ezisendleleni zihlala zifihlekile futhi azizweli kumuntu. Umqashi wakho noma umphathi wakho ngeke akutshele ukuthi visited enye yalezi zikhungo. Zonke lezi zikhungo zokwelapha ezisendleleni zivulelekile ntambama kuze kube phakathi kobusuku, phakathi kwesonto. Lezi zikhathi zifanele kakhulu kubashayeli bezinqola ngoba kunzima kubo ukumisa phakathi nosuku njengoba bavame ukusebenza ngesikhathi beshayela endleleni. Izikhungo zokwelapha ezisendleleni zisebenza futhi njengezikhungo zolwazi ezitholakala ezindleleni ezikhonjisiwe kule mappa. Zama enye yalezi zikhungo ezihlinzeka ngolwazi endleleni. Kukhona abaphilayo abaqeqeshiwe nabangane, futhi ungathola nezeluleko nolwazi oluvela kubachwepheshe bezempilo mayelana nanoma yisiphi isimo sezempilo ongahlangabezana naso. Ungapaka inqola yakho esikhungweni sokwelapha futhi uthole usizo ngisho nasebusuku. Kufanele uhlole amehlo akho. Uma kusemidlalweni, hlala endaweni ekhanyayo futhi ubeke le khadi phambi kwakho efasiteleni elikhulu elivimba umoya. Hlala emathafeni akho cishe emitha eyodwa kude nekhadi. Uzenzani? Uma ungakwazi ukufunda zonke izincwadi, kufanele ubone udokotela wamehlo ukuze uhlole. Uma uzwa ubuhlungu bokungabi nendlu, khumbula ikhaya nabathandekayo bakho... Uchitha isikhathi eside kude nekhaya futhi kukhona izikhathi lapho uphoxeka ngokunethezeka nokufudumala kwekhaya nabathandekayo bakho. Izithelo ezisha nemifino zisiza ukuqina kwesistimu yakho yokuvikela futhi zikunike amandla. Zama ukuvikela ukudla okunezinga eliphezulu lefutha. Ukulala enqoleni kungaba confortabile; NOKHO, ukuthola ukulala okwanele kusiza ukuba wenze kahle. Ukuthambekela kwemilenze yakho nokulandela uhlelo lokuzivocavoca nokusebenza ngokomzimba kugcina uqaphele. Ukuphuma enqoleni kuphinde kugcine ingqondo yakho icacile futhi kukunikeze ukuphumula. Ukuhlanzeka - kusuka ekuphileni kuya ekuphileni! Nakuba izindawo eziningi zokumisa izinqola zinezinsiza zokugeza, zama ukugeza nsuku zonke. Ukwenza ukuhlanzeka akukuhle kuphela empilweni yakho; kuphinde kukwenze uzizwe uqhakazile futhi unethemba. Endleleni, ubhekana nezingozi eziningi. Abashayeli bavame ukuphazamiseka futhi baphanga, njengoba wazi. Ngakho qaphela futhi uhlale uvulelekile ukuze ugweme izingozi. I-HIV ingenye yezingozi ezinkulu kubashayeli. I-HIV yigciwane elibangela i-AIDS. Le ndlala ib dangerous kakhulu ngoba uma uyithola, awukwazi ukuyilapha, futhi impilo yakho iyahluleka. Akuyiqiniso ukuthi awukwazi ukuthola igciwane le-HIV ngenxa yokuthi ushaya nomuntu onalo emzimbeni wakhe. Ungathola i-AIDS kuphela uma unocansi olungekho emthethweni nomuntu onale gciwane noma uma igazi lakho lithintana negazi elinokuhlukumezeka. Ngalesi sizathu, kufanele uhlale usebenzisa isifonyo uma unocansi. Ngalesi sizathu, kufanele futhi ugqoke izigqoko uma usiza umuntu olimele. Akuyiqiniso ukuthi i-AIDS iyalapheka. Odokotela abakwazi ukuyilapha. Ngisho nom miracle ngeke ikulaphe. Empeleni, akekho ongakukhipha uma igciwane selingene emzimbeni wakho. Uma unalo, kufanele ufune ukwelashwa futhi uthole izeluleko kubachwepheshe bezempilo. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi owesifazane ophakathi kokukhulelwa ongu-HIV/AIDS angadlulisa igciwane kumntwana wakhe, kungaba ngesikhathi sokubeletha noma ngesikhathi sokuncelisa. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlole igciwane ukuze bazi ukuthi banalo emzimbeni wabo noma cha. Bangathola izeluleko esikhungweni sokwelapha abavakashela kulesi sikhathi. Le nsizakalo ibeka ingane engcupheni yokuphila. Akuyiqiniso ukuthi awukwazi ukubona ubuso bomuntu onale gciwane le-HIV. Abantu bangabukeka bephilile futhi behlanzekile njengezithombe, kodwa bangase babe negciwane ngaleso sikhathi. Futhi ngakolunye uhlangothi, akekho onobuso obuhle futhi ophilile ongasithola lesi sifo. Imiphumela yokuhlola igazi kuphela inganikeza ubufakazi bokuthi umuntu unegciwane noma cha. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi uma uhlolwa kahle nge-HIV, akusho ukuthi usuphelile. Ungaphila impilo ende futhi uqhubeke nokushayela. Udinga kuphela ukuvakashela udokotela ukuze uthole izeluleko. Kufanele futhi ujwayele ukudla kahle nokuzivocavoca njalo, futhi kufanele uyeke ukuphuza nokubhema. Uma uthole igciwane, unegunya lokungadlulisi kumkakho noma kumunye umngane wakho. Khumbula ukuthi noma nini uma unocansi, kufanele usebenzise isifonyo. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi abantu abaneziguli ezithathelwana ngocansi (IZifo Zokuthathelana) banamathuba aphezulu kakhulu okuthola igciwane le-HIV uma benocansi nomuntu onale gciwane. Abalingani babo benocansi baphakathi kwengozi ephezulu yokuthola i-HIV/AIDS. Uma unegciwane elithathelwana ng
Siphindaphinda ukuthi ukuvuselela abalimi akuyona into elula futhi akwenziwa ngobusuku obubodwa - kukhona abantu abaningi abasebenza kulolu hlelo, kunezinto eziningi ezifundwayo futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside. Aaron Motsoaledi, utholakale engaphunyukile kunoma yiziphi izinsolo zokungafaneleki kuye, ngokusho kukaMphakathi Ovikela uLawrence Mushwana kulandela uphenyo lwezinsolo zokusebenzisa amandla ngokweqile nokwephula ubuqotho. Kwakukhuluma ukuthi ngenkathi engumholi wezombusazwe esigabeni seMfundo, uDkt. Aaron Motsoaledi wayeseveza abahlinzeki abathile bezimpahla zesikole nezifundo abathole izinkontileka kuye ukuze bahlinzeke lezi zimpahla kwiMnyango. Umuntu ophikisa uthe abahlinzeki abakhuluma ngabo babezingane zikaDkt. Aaron Motsoaledi futhi wathi uthole isipho esibiza kakhulu esifana nezimoto esivela kumunye wabo. Ngokwephikiso, uMnyango, ngokusho kokuphatha kukaDkt. Aaron Motsoaledi, wephule imithetho yokuthenga eyakhishwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA). Ngenkathi uphenyo luthole ukuthi izinsolo ezibhekiswe kuMEC nabanye abasebenzi azinembile, luphinde lwaveza ukuthi uMnyango awunayo inqubomgomo efanele njengoba kudingeka ngaphansi kwePFMA. "Ukwehluleka ukusungula nokwenza uhlelo lokuphathwa kokuhlinzekwa njengoba kudingeka ngaphansi kwePFMA kuyindaba edinga ukunakwa okukhulu," kusho uMushwana. Uphakamise ukuthi uMnyango uhambisane nePFMA, usungule futhi ugcine uhlelo lokuthenga olufanele, olucacile, oluncintisanayo, nolonga.
A.1 Lezi ziqondiso zizobizwa ngokuthi iMithetho Yezinsizakalo Zikamasipala ka-2001 futhi zizothatha umthelela kusukela ngo-1 Januwari 2001, ngaphandle kweziqondiso III B.2 (b) kanye ne-III F(b) yeSahluko-1, ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku oluthile oluzokwenziwa nguNgqongqoshe ngokusebenzisa isaziso kuGazethi. B.1 Lezi ziqondiso zizofundwa ndawonye neMthetho. c "I-Core" isifinyezo seSikhodi seMiholo, njengoba kuchaziwe kuziqondiso III 1.3 kuya ku-1. r "I-SMS" ibhekisela kubasebenzi abanikwe igama kuziqondiso- l B. v "Iziqondiso Zezezimali" zisho Iziqondiso Zezezimali ezashicilelwa kuSaziso Sokuhulumeni Inombolo R.556 ka-31 Meyi 2000 njengoba kuhlelwe ngezikhathi ezithile futhi kwenziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba -76 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikamasipala; futhi noma iyiphi enye igama izobhekisela kulokho okukhuluma kuMthetho. Isigaba -41 seMthetho sikhuthaza lezi ziqondiso. a kubo bonke abantu abaqashwe kanye nakuzo zonke izikhungo ezilawulwa nguMthetho; futhi b ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho, kubantu abaqashwe ezinsizakalweni, ezikhungweni noma ezikhungweni zemfundo zikamasipala, kodwa kuphela lapho zingaphikisi nemithetho elawula ukuqashwa kwabo. E.1 Iziqondiso Zezinsizakalo Zikamasipala zika-1999 (ezashicilelwa kuSaziso Sokuhulumeni Inombolo R.679 ka-1 Julayi 1999), kuhlanganise nazo zonke izichibiyelo ezenziwe nazo zonke iziqondiso ezenziwe futhi ezisebenza ngaphansi koMthetho, zikhanselwa lapha. E.2 Noma iyiphi isenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kweziqondiso zeZinsizakalo Zikamasipala zika-1999 futhi esingaqhutshwa ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zalezi ziqondiso sizobhekwa sengathi senziwe ngaphansi kwaleyo nhlinzeko. E.3 Nakuba Iziqondiso Zezinsizakalo Zikamasipala zika-1999 zikhanselwa ngaphansi kweziqondiso- l E.1, izinhlelo zokudlulela phambili zizokwenziwa kuZinsizakalo Zikamasipala- 1. Umthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi kanye nezivumelwano ezihlangene zizolawula izinto ezithinta bobabili phakathi kweZinsizakalo kanye noMbuso njengomqashi. Uma kwenzeka izimo zivumela ukuphambuka ezinhlinzekweni nasezithombeni zesiqondiso esithile kulezi ziqondiso mayelana nezimo zokusebenza emsebenzini wombuso, uNgqongqoshe angathatha izinqumo, akhiphe imiyalo noma avume ezinye izimiso ngaphansi kwezimo ezichaziwe futhi azisebenzise. a xhumana naye ngeMenenja-Jikelele: Izinhlaka Zikamasipala kanye Nezokuphathwa; futhi b bhala ngolimi olusemthethweni lezi ziqondiso ezashicilelwa ku. H.2 Umsebenzi uzokhombiswa nganoma yimuphi umbuzo ophathelene nezindaba ngaphansi kwamandla nezibopho zikaNgqongqoshe ophambili emnyangweni wakhe. H.3 Umphathi wengxenye uzokwethula kuMenenja-Jikelele: Izinhlaka Zikamasipala kanye Nezokuphathwa, kusenesikhathi ngokuxoxisana, noma iyiphi imingcele yomthetho noma imingcele yokubhaliswa ethinta amandla noma izibopho zikaNgqongqoshe. H.4 Umphathi wengxenye uzokwakha inqubomgomo mayelana nokuthi abasebenzi bengingxenye yakhe bangasebenzisana kanjani nezindaba zomphakathi nezinye izikhungo zezindaba. H.5 Umsebenzi, emsebenzini wakhe, akavunyelwe ukuhlabela umthetho wombuso endaweni yomphakathi noma emaphephandabeni noma ezindabeni noma kunoma iyiphi imithombo yezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuze anikeze umphathi wengxenye amandla okuphatha ingxenye yakhe ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlinzeka umphathi wengxenye ngamandla adingekayo nezithunywa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphathi wengxenye uzovuma abasebenzi bangaphakathi ngokwabelana ngamandla afanele nezithunywa lapho kudingeka. a bangase babele amandla kubasebenzi noma bavume abasebenzi ukuthi benze lelo thask; futhi b bazokwenze futhi izinqumo mayelana nokusebenzisa lawo mandla noma ukwenza lelo thask. B.2 Umphakathi omkhulu uzobhalela ukwenziwa kwamandla noma izithunywa ngokubhala futhi lokhu kungafakwa nasekutholeni umsebenzi komphathi wengxenye, njengoba kuchaziwe kuziqondiso -VII B.2.1. B.3 Ukudluliswa kwamandla ngumphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wengxenye akuvimbele ukuthi basebenzise lawo mandla bona. C.2 Umphakathi omkhulu akavunyelwe ukuphazamisa noma ukuvumela umphathi wengxenye noma noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi ukuba abambe iqhaza kunoma iyiphi indaba noma enze isinqumo esiphula lezi ziqondiso. a uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bengingxenye yakhe bayahambisana nalezi ziqondiso, izivumelwano ezihlangene kanye nanoma yimiphi imithwalo yomthetho; futhi b uzobhekana ngokushesha nangendlela efanele nanoma yiziphi iziphazamiso ezingaba khona. C.4 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wengxenye uzosebenzisa amandla abo, enze imisebenzi yabo futhi bahlangabezane nezibopho zabo ngaphansi kwezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi kanye nezivumelwano ezihlangene ezisebenzayo. C.5 Umphakathi omkhulu nomphathi wengxenye bazokuqinisekisa ukuthi uMnyango Wezezimali uvuma ngaphambi kokuthi benze isinqumo esihilela ukusetshenziswa kwemali evela emalini. D.1 Lapho kungase kube nokuphikisana kokuthakazelela uma kwenziwa noma yisiphi isinqumo mayelana nokuqashwa, umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi onamandla uzokwenza lelo thask noma enze isinqumo kuphela ngemuva kokucabangela isiphakamiso esivela kwi-panel ezimele equkethe okungenani abantu ababili. D.3 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuthola noma ukufuna noma iyiphi imivuzo ethile emsebenzini noma kumuntu ongase abe ngumsebenzi ngokwenza okuthile noma enza isinqumo mayelana nokuqashwa. Umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuveza emphakathini noma iyiphi imininingwane esemthethweni ngaphandle kwamandla adingekayo. Umphakathi omkhulu uzokwakha imigomo eyilinganiselwe yengxenye yakhe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zinikezwa ngokubuyiselwa kwemali esetshenzisiwe, kusetshenziswa ngokuphelele izinsiza zengxenye kuhlanganise nabasebenzi, futhi futhi kusetshenziswa ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi njengoba kudingeka. Ngokusebenzisa imali etholakalayo futhi eyabelwe ezinjongo nasezibopho zengxenye kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuhanjiswe, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlela ukwenza imisebenzi ngendlela ehlelekile, efanelekile nephumelelayo ngaphakathi kwenhlangano nasemigomeni yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukubekwa obala nokucacile, umphakathi omkhulu uzoshicilela umbiko wonyaka onikeza imininingwane ebalulekile ngengxenye yakhe. ukuxhasa ukuhambisana nezidingo zokubika kuziqondiso III J kanye neziqondiso zeMali Zikamasipala eziphakanyisiwe ezisezingeni eliphansi ezivunyelwe ukuze Zaziwe, futhi ezikhombisa kuziqondiso- VII H; futhi g ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezisezingeni- 5.1 kanye no-5.2 zeziqondiso zeMali.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika 1. Isingeniso Ukudlulela kwedijithali kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo ulwazi nokuxhumana. ENingizimu Afrika, iphrojekthi ye-digital migration ibiyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa isiteshi semiphakathi nezokuxhumana. Nokho, le phrojekthi ibhekene nezithiyo eziningi ezibangela ukubambezeleka. Lo mbhalo uzogxila ezicini eziholela ekubambezelekeni kwalolu hlelo, izinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona. 2. Ukuqonda Ukubambezeleka Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration kuvele ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo, ukungabi bikho kwezimali ezanele, nezinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe nasemigomeni yokuphatha nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekubambezelekeni. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlaziywa kwezinselelo ezihlukahlukene. 3. Izizathu Zokubambezeleka 3.1 Izinkinga Zezimali Enye yezizathu eziyinhloko zokubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika iwukuntuleka kwezimali. Imali edingekayo ukuze kuphumelele le phrojekthi ibiza kakhulu, futhi lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinhlelo ezibalulekile zibe semkhakheni wokubambezeleka. Ukuze kuqedeleke le phrojekthi, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele ezivela kuHulumeni, izinkampani eziPrivate, kanye nohulumeni bamazwe omhlaba. 3.2 Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Iphrojekthi ye-digital migration idinga uxhumano oluqinile phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, izinkampani zezinhlaka, kanye nabaphathi bezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukungabikhona kokuxhumana kahle phakathi kwalezi zinhlaka kuholela ekubambezelekeni kwemigomo ethile. Ukuze kusebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile nokuxhumana okuhle. 3.3 Ukungabi Bikho Kwezinsiza Ubuchwepheshe obuphambili buqhubeka buveza izinselelo ezintsha. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele zokuhlinzeka ngedijithali kuyinto enkulu ethinta iphrojekthi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakusebenza ezifanele, imishini, kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela, kubalulekile ukuba khona kwezinsiza ezanele. 4. Izinyathelo Zokubhekelela Izinkinga 4.1 Ukuxhumana Ngempumelelo Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano oluqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezicacile, ukuze wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza. Ukubamba imihlangano evamile ukuze kuhlanganyelwe izimvo kungasiza kakhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle. 4.2 Ukwandisa Izinsiza Zezimali Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-digital migration iyaphumelela, kudingeka ukwandisa uxhaso lwezimali. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuphakanyiswa kwezinsizakusebenza ezingabhaliswa, noma izinhlelo zokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele. Ukuze uHulumeni akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezifanele. 4.3 Ukuhlola Izinsiza Nokuhlinzeka Kokuqeqeshwa Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bazi kahle ukuthi bangasisebenzisa kanjani isikhala sedijithali, kudingeka ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhlobene. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuphatha kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlola izinsiza ezidingekayo njalo kudinga ukuba kube semgibeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezanele. 5. Imiphumela Yokubambezeleka Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration kungaba nemiphumela emibi kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi nalwazi olufanele kubantu, ukuncipha kokuxhumana, kanye nokwehliswa kokutholakala kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthi baphile kahle ezindaweni ezibhekene nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okubambezeleka kungaholela ekwehleni kokuthembeka kukahulumeni, okuyinto engathinta ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nohulumeni. 6. Isiphetho Iphrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo yabantu nokuxhumana kwezakhamuzi. Nokho, ukubambezeleka kule phrojekthi kudinga ukuhlinzekwa kwezixazululo ezicacile. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela, futhi kuxazululwe izinkinga ezibangelwa ukubambezeleka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo, kudingeka ukwenza izinyathelo ezithile ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Uhlanga lwezixazululo oluqinile nolusebenza kahle luzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi i-digital migration ibe yimpumelelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ngokwezinhlangano ezihloniphekile nezikhungo zezempilo, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yazo. Lokhu kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zidinga ukunakekelwa okhethekile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhula kahle futhi ziphile impilo enempilo. Ezibhedlela eziningi, abezempilo bahlonipha izidingo zempilo yezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukunikezwa kokudla okufanele, kanye nokunakekelwa okujwayelekile. Ngokwesibonelo, umphakathi udinga ukuqonda ukuthi izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulayo, okuhlanganisa ukuxhumana okuhle nomama bazo, ukuze zikwazi ukuthola uthando nokunakekelwa okudingekayo. Ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabazali, abezempilo, kanye nezinhlangano ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izidingo zezingane ziyaqhutshwa. Abazali badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle nomntwana wabo kubalulekile, njengoba lokhu kuthinta kakhulu ukukhula komntwana. Ezibhedlela eziningi zinezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abazali ngezindlela zokunakekela izingane zabo, kanye nokubasiza ukuthi baqonde izidingo zezingane zabo. Abazali baphinde bahlonishwe ngezinto abazidingayo, njengezikhumbuzo zokudla, izindlela zokuphumula, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zithola ukunakekelwa okuhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa imishini ethuthukile yokuhlola impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabazali nabahlengikazi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bazi kahle isimo sempilo yomntwana. Kodwa-ke, kunezinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nezibhedlela, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izinsiza ezikhona zingase zingabi nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngesevisi ezidingekayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo baphendule ngokushesha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ukwengeza, kubalulekile ukuthi abezempilo baqeqeshe kahle ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Izinhlelo zokufundisa abahlengikazi nezisebenzi zezempilo zidinga ukugxila ekunakekeleni izingane ezisanda kuzalwa, ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo ezithile zempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izibhedlela ziyaqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko ezinhle ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabazali nabahlengikazi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yezenhlalakahle. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ngempilo yezingane, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abazali. Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekwakheni isimo esihle sokukhula kwezingane. Ekugcineni, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwemindeni, abezempilo, kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zithola uthando, ukunakekelwa, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze zikhule kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lezingane zethu, sigcine impilo yazo iphilile futhi inempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe isinyathelo sokukhuthaza nokweseka izinhlelo zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa, ukuze sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kuzodala isizukulwane esiqinile, esinempilo, nesizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
AmaKaizer Chiefs: Uhambo Lwenjabulo Nezinkanyezi Zomdlalo Ngaphakathi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo zomhlaba wombhoxo, igama elithi "AmaKaizer Chiefs" lihlala likhanya kakhulu. Leli qembu, elisungulwe ngonyaka ka-1970, lathola udumo olukhulu eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Uhambo lwabo lwalugcwele izinselelo, kodwa futhi lwalugcwele izikhathi zokujabula ezingenakulinganiswa. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukusungulwa Kwakuyisikhathi esinzima eNingizimu Afrika, lapho umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uKaizer Motaung, owayengumgibeli ophumelelayo, wanquma ukusungula iqembu elizokhombisa ubuhle bomdlalo wombhoxo. Waqala ngokuqoka abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ababephuma ezindaweni ezinzima, kodwa bephupha ngempumelelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uKaizer wayengazi ukuthi iqembu lakhe lizoba yisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuhlangana kwabantu, nokwakha umoya wokubambisana. Isigaba sesibili: Ukuqala kokuphumelela Ngemva kokusungulwa, amaKaizer Chiefs aqala ukwakha igama lawo. Ngonyaka ka-1974, baqeda umjaho wabo wokuqala, behlula iMamelodi Sundowns emqhudelwaneni weNedbank Cup. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esikhulu, kwavula umnyango wezimpumelelo ezinkulu ezizayo. Abalandeli baqala ukuhamba bejabulile, bephakamisa izikhumbuzo zothando lwabo lweqembu. Iqembu laqala ukuhamba phambili, lathola izicoco eziningi, futhi laba yisithonjana emhlabeni wombhoxo. Isigaba sesithathu: Izikhathi ezinzima Nokho, uhambo lwabo lwalungelula. Njengoba beqhubeka nokuphumelela, babhekana nezikhathi ezinzima. Ngemva kokuphumelela kwezemidlalo, kwavela izinkinga zokuphatha, nezinguquko ezithinta abadlali. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho iqembu lalidinga ukuhamba phambili, kodwa izinkinga zempilo zabadlali zathinta umphumela. Nokho, amaKaizer Chiefs akhombisa amandla, aqhubeka nokwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabalandeli nabaqeqeshi. Isigaba sesine: Ubuqhawe obungapheli Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaKaizer Chiefs akhombisa ubuqhawe obungapheli. Abadlali abanjengoDoctor Khumalo, Siphiwe Tshabalala, noItumeleng Khune, baphenduka izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, baphakamisa umoya wabalandeli. Umdlalo wabo wawuhambisana nezikhathi ezinzima, kodwa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabalandeli nabadlali bahlala buqinile. Lokhu kwenza amaKaizer Chiefs abe yisithonjana esingapheli, esihlotshaniswa nothando, ukuzinikela, nokusebenza kanzima. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ukubuyela emuva Ngemva kweminyaka ethile yokuphumelela, amaKaizer Chiefs abhekana nezinguquko ezinkulu. Abadlali abaninzi baphuma, kanti abasha bangena. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iqembu lidlale kahle, kodwa kube nezikhathi lapho bahluleka khona. Nokho, abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izwi labo, bebonisa uthando lwabo olungapheli. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi amaKaizer Chiefs awanqobi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa futhi anqoba ezinhliziyweni zabantu. Isigaba sesixhenxe: Ikusasa eliqhakazile Namuhla, amaKaizer Chiefs aqhubeka nokukhanya. Abadlali abasha baphuma, bejolisa emaphusheni abo, futhi abalandeli bahlala bejabulile. Iqembu lihlala linomoya ophakeme, futhi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabalandeli nabadlali buyaqhubeka nokukhula. UKaizer Motaung, owasungula leli qembu, usaqhubeka nokuba yisikhumbuzo sokusebenza kanzima, uthando, nokuzinikela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaKaizer Chiefs azohlala engumfanekiso omuhle wombhoxo, umfanekiso wokuhlangana kwabantu, nokwakha umoya wokubambisana. Uhambo lwabo luhlala lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi, noma izinselelo zingavela, uthando nempumelelo kumele kube yizinto ezihamba phambili. AmaKaizer Chiefs, ngempela, ayisithonjana esingapheli, esizokhanya njalo ezinkanyezi zomhlaba wombhoxo.
I-Microsoft Iqhubeka Nokuhola Emhlabeni Wezobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMicrosoft, inkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, iqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta izinkonzo zayo, imikhiqizo, kanye nezinhlelo zayo. Ngonyaka ka-2023, iMicrosoft ibonakale ibalulekile ekwakheni izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzisi bayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe be-AI, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenziseka kalula. Ukwanda Kwezinsizakalo Zokuxhumana Ngokukhula kokusebenza kwabantu emakhaya, iMicrosoft ibuyekeze izinsizakalo zayo zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi i-Microsoft Teams. Le nsiza isetshenziswa kakhulu ezikhungweni zemfundo, ezinkampanini, nakwezinye izindawo zokusebenza. Ngonyaka ka-2023, iMicrosoft ikhiphe izici ezintsha ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kweTeams, okuhlanganisa izinketho zokuhlanganyela ezithuthukisiwe, izinkulumo eziphumelelayo, kanye nezinsiza zokuphatha imihlangano ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisa uxhumano phakathi kwabantu, nokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imihlangano, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi abantu bakuphi. Ubuchwepheshe be-AI Obusha Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMicrosoft ibonakale ikhuluma kakhulu ngentuthuko ye-AI. Ngonyaka ka-2023, inkampani yethule izinhlelo ezintsha ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-AI ukuze kuthuthukiswe imikhiqizo yayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa i-AI ye-Office 365, eyenza kube lula ukuhlela imibhalo, ukwenza iziphakamiso, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe be-AI buyasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi yansuku zonke ibe lula, futhi lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo bathola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Izinhlelo Zokusebenza Ezithuthukisiwe I-Microsoft ibilokhu ibhekelela izidingo zabathengi bayo, futhi lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zayo zokusebenza. I-Windows 11, esanda kukhishwa, ibonisa izici ezintsha ezithuthukisa ukusebenza, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlanganisiwe, izinketho zokuhlela ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezici zokuphepha eziphezulu. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo bathola isipiliyoni esihle, esiphephile, futhi esisebenziseka kalula. Ukugxila Emphakathini Ngaphezu kokuthuthukisa imikhiqizo yayo, iMicrosoft ibuye ibonakale igxile emiphakathini. Inkampani ibambelela ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo. I-Microsoft ikhiphe izinhlelo zokuxhasa izikole, izinhlelo zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono, okuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abaningi bangathola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhula futhi busebenze kubantu bonke, hhayi kuphela kubantu abathile. Izifundo Zokuphumelela Ngonyaka ka-2023, iMicrosoft ibonakale ibalulekile ekwakheni izifundo eziphumelelayo. Inkampani ibambisene nezikhungo zemfundo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bahlomula ngempumelelo ezinhlelweni zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono, izinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisana nezidingo zemakethe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi abasha. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukubheka Phambili Njengoba iMicrosoft iqhubeka nokuhola emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ziyaqhubeka. Inkampani ibonisa ukuzimisela kwayo ekwakheni izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zayo ezithuthukisiwe, ubuchwepheshe be-AI, nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ziyaqhubeka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMicrosoft izoba yinkampani ebalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinguquko zayo ziyaqhubeka nokuthinta izimpilo zabantu. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhula, busebenze, futhi bukhuthaze abantu abaningi, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithuthukisiwe. I-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezithuthukisayo ziyaqhubeka.
Isinqumo seNkantolo yeMithetho mayelana necala 'Bhe nabanye v Magistrate Khayelitsha nabanye Inombolo yecala 49/03, isinqumo esakhishwa ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2004, sathola ukuthi isigaba 23 seBlack Administration Act 38 ka-1927 kanye neGovernment Notice R200 yemigomo eyashicilelwa kuGovernment Notice 10601 ka-6 February 1987 ayihambisani nemthethosisekelo. Ngokuhambisana nomongo wesinqumo seBhe, uMnyango wezeMthetho kanye nentuthuko yeMithetho kufanele uthuthukise futhi uqinisekise uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo ezishonelwe ngendlela ehambelana nezidingo zomphakathi zabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, iminyaka, noma ukuzalwa. UJaji Omkhulu kufanele athathe ukuphathwa kokubheka zonke izindawo ezishonelwe. Zonke izindawo kufanele ziphathwe ngokuhambisana ne-Administration of Estates Act 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Zonke izindawo zabantu abashonile abangakabeki ukuthi bafuna ziphathwe ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act 81 ka-1987, njengoba kuguqulwe. I-Intestate Succession Act ithintwa yisinqumo seBhe ukuhlinzeka ngezimo lapho umufi wayeshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Abaholi bendabuko bayalahlekelwa amandla okuphatha nokubheka izindawo zabantu abashonile. Nokho, kuzodingeka baqedele izindaba ezibikwe kubo ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2004 noma ngaphambi kwalolo suku. Kumele baqedele zonke lezi zindawo ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act. Ngemuva kwesinqumo seBhe, phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kosuku luka-6 December 2002, lapho isinqumo seMoseneke sathatha umthelela, umthwalo wokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo ezishonelwe wawugxile kakhulu kubuholi bendabuko. UJaji Omkhulu wabheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo zabantu abamhlophe, abamnyama, abamnyama, nabantu abamhlophe abangakabeki abathwali. Amandla kaJaji Omkhulu kanye namandla akhe (okstill asebenza) achazwe ku-Administration of Estates Act 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Umagistrate endaweni lapho umufi ahlala khona wayenomsebenzi wokubheka ukuphathwa kwendawo yomuntu omnyama oshonile ngaphandle kokubeka abathwali kanye nokuphathwa kwendawo yakhe. Umagistrate uthole amandla kusuka esigabeni 23 seBlack Administration Act 38 ka-1927 kanye nemigomo eyashicilelwa ku-Government Notice R200 ku-Government Gazette 10601 ka-6 February 1987. Indawo yomuntu omnyama ngemuva kokushona kwakhe ayiphathwanga nge-Intestate Succession Act 81 ka-1987. Lokhu kwenzeka ezimweni ezimbili. Esimweni sokuqala, lapho umufi ekhombisa ngesikhathi ephila ukuthi akafuni ukuphila ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. Ngokuhambisana ne-Government Notice R200, le mfuneko yakhonjiswa ngezindlela ezimbili: lapho umufi efaka isicelo sesitifiketi esikhulula yena ekusebenzeni komthetho wesiZulu, ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 seBlack Administration Act, nokuthi lapho ebeka umshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiNgisi ngaphandle kokubanjwa ubuholi bendabuko. Okwesibili, indawo yomufi ayikwazi ukuphathwa nge-Intestate Succession Act uma uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho enombono wokuthi kuzoba nomthelela omubi kwezinye izimo ukusabalalisa indawo ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. Izithakazelo ezithintekayo zizokwenza uNgqongqoshe athole isinqumo ngalesi.
