Ngesikhathi sesibili, phakathi kosuku luka-6 December 2002 no-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu wayenamandla okuphatha zonke izindawo zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana nemigomo yomthetho wesiNgisi ngenkathi umagistrate enamalungelo okuphatha izindawo zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesiko. UJaji Omkhulu wayebhujiswa amandla akhe ngaphansi kwe-Administration of Estates Act ngenkathi omagistrate bephatha amandla ngaphansi kwe-Black Administration Act kanye nemigomo eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalolo mthetho. Ngesikhathi sesithathu, ngemuva kosuku luka-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu uzobheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo zonke zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act. Zonke izindawo ezishiywe ngabantu ngaphandle kokubeka izifiso zabo zizophathwa ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Intestate Succession Act ehambelana nezinguquko ezidingekayo ukuhlinzeka ngoshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinguquko ezilethwe yisinqumo seBhe zinefekthi yokubuyisela isimo emuva ku-27 March 1994 mayelana nezindawo ezingakazeki. Impumelelo yohlelo olusha izokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika baphathwa ngokulinganayo nokuthi isithunzi sabo siyahlonishwa. Ngokubheka isimo sangempela mayelana nabantu abashonile ngaphambi kosuku luka-27 March 1994 nezimo ezingabikiwe, lezi zindawo kufanele ziqondiswe kuJaji Omkhulu. UJaji Omkhulu (ofisi kaJaji Omkhulu kanye nezikhungo zikaJaji Omkhulu) kufanele aphathe zonke izindawo lapho umufi eshonile ngemuva kosuku luka-27 March 1994. Indawo izophathwa futhi iphathwe ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Administration of Estates Act. Uma umufi eshonile ngaphandle kokubeka abathwali noma ekhombisa izifiso zabo, indawo kufanele ihlukaniswe ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act. Lezi yizindaba okufanele ziqedwe ngumagistrate ngokuhambisana nesinqumo seBhe. Isimo lapho umufi ebhala izifiso zabo zokwabiwa kwendawo yabo (isivumelwano). Inani lendawo (noma inani elilinganisiwe) lidlula R50,000. Indawo iyisikhwama esingenalutho (izikweletu zidlula indawo). Omunye noma abaningi babatholi kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi basizwe ngumameli wabo. Omunye noma abaningi babatholi kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi indawo inenani eliphelele noma elingxenye elidlula R20,000. Uma noma yiziphi zezizathu ezishiwo ngenhla zisebenza, indawo kufanele idluliselwe kwiOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu endaweni umufi ahlala khona. Bonke abatholi kufanele babe namandla okusebenza ngokuzimela noma omunye noma abaningi babatholi kufanele babe ngabantwana futhi basizwe ngumameli wabo, futhi indawo yezezimali ibalwe ku-R20,000 noma ngaphansi. Isikhungo sokusiza sizoba namandla phezu kwendawo yomuntu owayengumuntu ojwayelekile ngesikhathi sokushona ngaphakathi komthetho weOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu lapho isikhungo sokusiza sitholakala khona. Lapho isicelo siqediwe ngokuphelele futhi akukho ezinye izidingo ezidingekayo ukuze kukhishwe isitifiketi sokuhlonza. Lapho isicelo singaqediwe ngenxa yezinye izidingo ezidingekayo ezidinga ukwenziwa futhi kukhona isikhungo sokusiza esiseduze neOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu yomfaki-sicelo, uJaji Omkhulu kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ngalokhu. Amandla okuphatha iOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu ngalolu sizo akhishwa kumuntu onolwazi owafakile isicelo. Uma ethumela umphakathi wakhe ngaphansi kwesigaba 18, uJaji Omkhulu kufanele azise Isikhungo Sokwesiza ngamandla afanayo ukuze enze lokhu. Ezimeni lapho umufi eshiya isifiso esibhaliwe sokwabiwa kwendawo yabo kodwa uJaji Omkhulu engamukelanga le mfuneko noma isivumelwano, kukhona isiphakamiso sokuthi uJaji Omkhulu kufanele akhiphe isitifiketi sokuhlonza kodwa angabuyisele le
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Ukuhlola Umhlaba Wokudlala Ngobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo ibe yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu abaningi emhlabeni. Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala, lapho imidlalo yayikhiqizwa ngezithombe ezilula, ubuchwepheshe buye bukhula kakhulu, buguqula indlela esidlala ngayo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimboni Zokudlala Imidlalo yevidiyo ikhiqizwa yizinkampani ezinkulu nezincane, okuhlanganisa abathuthukisi, abaculi, nabadali. Lezi zinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezithombe ezicacile, imisindo ethokozisayo, kanye nezinhlelo eziphusile, ukuze zenze imidlalo ejabulisayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni imidlalo edumile, efana ne-‘The Legend of Zelda’, ‘Call of Duty’, kanye ne-‘Fortnite’, eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni. Imiphumela Yokudlala Imidlalo yevidiyo ayigcini ngokuba umthombo wokuzijabulisa, kodwa inemiphumela emihle emiphakathini. Iphinde ibe yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezizukulwane ezahlukene. Abantu bahlala bexhumana nabangani, ngisho noma bahlale kude, ngokudlala. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile futhi kunciphisa ukwehlukaniswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyasiza ekuthuthukiseni amakhono ahlukahlukene, njengoba abadlali bahlala bephendula ngokushesha, benza izinqumo ezisheshayo, futhi befunda ukuhlela kahle. Izinkinga Zokudlala Nokho, imidlalo yevidiyo inezinselelo zayo. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi ukudlala isikhathi eside kungaholela ekwehliseni izinga lokusebenza kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kudlalwa imidlalo enokuhlukumeza. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka ngezempilo yengqondo, njengoba abanye abadlali bengase babe nezinselelo zokuziphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba nomthelela omubi ezimweni zokuxhumana, njengoba abanye bengase bahlale bejolise kumadivayisi, baphuthelwe ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye bukhula, buvumela abadlali ukuba babe nezinhlobonhlobo zokudlala. I-virtual reality (VR) kanye ne-augmented reality (AR) ziye zaba yizinto ezidumile, zenza kube nokwenzeka ukudlala ngendlela engakaze ibonwe ngaphambili. Lokhu kudala umuzwa ophakeme, njengoba abadlali bezwa sengathi baphila ngaphakathi kwemidlalo. Izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa lezi zindlela, zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubadlali. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo izoqhubeka nokuba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Iphinde ibe yindlela yokuxhumana, yokufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Kubalulekile ukuthi abadlali baqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nokudlala, ukuze bagcine impilo yabo ibalulekile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, sizobona izinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni wemidlalo yevidiyo, okuzokwenza kube nentshisekelo enkulu kubo bonke abathanda ukudlala.
Ezokwakha: Ukubaluleka Kwezakhiwo Eziqinile Nezihlakaniphile Ezokwakha zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, izidingo zokwakha izakhiwo eziqinile nezihlakaniphile ziba zibaluleke kakhulu. Ukukhula kwedolobha, ukwanda kwabantu, kanye nezidingo zokuhlala, zifaka umthwalo omkhulu ezinhlelweni zokwakha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izakhiwo zethu zihlala ziqinile, ziphephile, futhi zisebenza kahle. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izakhiwo ezakhiwe kahle zinciphisa izingozi. Uma sikhuluma ngezokwakha, akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izindlu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukwakha izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, nezibhedlela. Lezi zindawo zidinga ukuba ziqinile ukuze zikwazi ukumelana nezimo ezinzima, njengemvula enkulu noma umoya onamandla. Ukungabi nalwazi olufanele ekwakheni kungaholela ezinhlelweni eziphukile, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izakhiwo ezihlakaniphile zikhuthaza ukonga amandla. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga zokushoda kwamandla, kubalulekile ukuthi izakhiwo zethu zisebenzise izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Ukusebenzisa izinto eziphilayo, njengezinto zokwakha ezivuselelekayo, kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthelela wethu emvelweni. Izakhiwo ezisebenzisa amandla elanga, amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula ukushisa, zikhombisa indlela esingathuthukisa ngayo izakhiwo zethu ukuze zibe nezindleko eziphansi zokusebenza. Ngokubheka izinkinga ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abaqeqeshiwe ezokwakha. Ukuze sithole izakhiwo ezinhle, kudingeka ukuba kube nabantu abanolwazi, abaqeqeshiwe, nabathanda umsebenzi wabo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinhlelweni zokwakha, futhi kuzokwandisa ikhono labantu ukuba basebenze kahle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izakhiwo ezihlala isikhathi eside, eziphephile, nezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha izakhiwo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi kubalulekile. Izakhiwo kufanele zibe nezici ezithinta abantu abahlala edolobheni, njengokufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni, izindawo zokuphumula, nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kuzokwandisa umphakathi. Ukubandakanya umphakathi ezinhlelweni zokwakha kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo, futhi kuzokwandisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuphetha, ezokwakha zibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izakhiwo zethu ziqinile, ziphephile, futhi zihlakaniphile. Ukukhula komhlaba kudinga izakhiwo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi lokhu kudinga abantu abaqeqeshiwe, izinsiza eziphusile, kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zethu. Uma sithatha lezi zinyathelo, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onokuthula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuzokwandisa ithemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindawo ezinhle zokuhlala, ukusebenza, nokuphumula. Ngakho, asithathe isinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, eliqinile, nelihlakaniphile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuzokwandisa ithemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindawo ezinhle zokuhlala, ukusebenza, nokuphumula. Izokwakha akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onokuthula. Asiqhubekeni, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, eliqinile, nelihlakaniphile.
Ukukhuluma okuqhumayo: Uma uvuka ekuseni, uthola ukudla kuqala. Abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuthatha ukulawula ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze banciphise izindleko, noma ukubona nokubamba ithuba elivela lokwenza inzuzo enhle, ngoba abathathi izinyathelo ezidingekayo lapho isikhathi esifanele sifika. Ngezinye izikhathi babhekana nezingozi ezidalwe yimicimbi yemvelo, efana nezomiso noma imvula enzima ethululela umhlabathi ngoba bayakhohlwa ukuthi "kuhle ukugwema isiguli kunokuzama ukusiphilisa." Ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela kusho ukuthi kufanele ube nezicwangciso ezibheke phambili futhi wenze lezo zinto ezizovikela izingozi ezingaba khona. Uma ufuna ukuphatha ukufuywa nokukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ehlala isikhathi eside, lokhu kubalulekile. Ikhalenda yomsebenzi wakho wezolimo (izikhathi zokwenza imisebenzi ethile) kufanele ibe yisikhumbuzo somsebenzi ofanele okufanele wenziwe ebhizinisini lakho lezolimo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isikhathi esihle sokutshala (lokhu kuyimsebenzi omkhulu efarmini yakho) singaba ekuqaleni kukaJuni uma utshala u-mazeyise noma ekuqaleni kukaNovemba uma utshala izitshalo zonyaka. Zonke izinkomba nemisebenzi okufanele yenziwe ezinyangeni eziholela ekutshaleni zizohambisana nalolo suku lokutshala. Cabanga phambili (lungiselela kusenesikhathi) njalo. Lokhu kuyimsebenzi oqhubekayo futhi obalulekile ngoba kusiza umulimisi ukwenza izinto ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu okungakwenzi kule nyanga kungakusiza ugweme ukwenza amaphutha nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngonyaka ozayo. Isibonelo: izinhlobo zezitshalo ozibona kule nyanga zizokusiza ukhethe izinhlobo ezifanele zezikhemikhali zonyaka ozayo. Uma ungakwenzi lokhu, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkinga ezivela kule nyanga zibuye zivele ngonyaka ozayo. Bheka futhi uhlaziye umhlabathi ukuze uqinisekise inani le-hectares ofuna ukulima. Bheka ukuthi imakethe ithi yini bese ukhetha izinhlobo zokutshala ezizokwenza inzuzo enhle. Hlanganisa noma ulungise isimo sakho sezimali (ibhajethi) futhi ubhale phansi uhlelo lokukhiqiza ephepheni. Ezikhathini zanamuhla, kubalulekile ukukhetha ibhizinisi elithembekile elisekelwe emakethe lapho usayina inkontileka. Inkontileka izokuvikela uma amanani okudla enyuka noma ehla. Qinisekisa inkontileka yeziqhamo ezithile bese uzama ukuthola intengo enhle njalo. Uzodinga ukuthola uxhaso uma uhlela ukutshala indawo enkulu ngaphesheya kwemali oyitholayo. Ungathatha isikhathi eside ukuya endaweni lapho imali ibolekwa khona, ngakho hamba ngokushesha ngemuva kokulungisa uhlelo lwakho lokukhiqiza. Inqubo yokuthola imali nokuthola imvume ivamise ukuthatha isikhathi. Uma ungabi namandla okuzifundela nokuzitshala, signa inkontileka kusenesikhathi nomthengisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokulima (ama-tractor nezinsiza) izotholakala ngesikhathi lapho uhlela khona ukulima nokutshala. Ngaphambi kokusayina inkontileka, zama ukuhlola imishini yomthengisi ukuze ubone ukuthi isesimweni esihle noma cha. Khumbula, uma imishini iphuka ngesikhathi sokutshala nokulima, kungadala izingozi ngoba isikhathi sihamba. Isikhathi esihle sokuhlola nokulungisa imishini yakho siwukuthi usuphelelwe isikhathi sokutshala nokulima. Uma ushiya lokhu kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi, kungakubiza kakhulu ukukulungisa ngoba kuzodingeka kulungiswe ngokushesha njengoba isikhathi sokutshala esifanele sibalulekile. Ngesikhathi sokulungisa, gcina imishini ihlanzekile ngendlela ezovikela ukugqwala, futhi ngeke kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuyilungiselela ukutshala. Bheka zonke izakhiwo ezivimba amanzi ezifana nezihlahla nezinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi. Thola isikhathi sokulungisa lezi zakhiwo ngaphambi kokubhekana nezingcuphe, ulahlekelwe umhlabathi omuhle uma kuqala imvula. Uma ufuna ukwakha izakhiwo ezintsha, qala ngokushesha ngalo msebenzi. Izindlela zokugcina umhlabathi zidinga ukucabangela ngokucophelela futhi zithatha isikhathi. Sebenzisa isikhathi sakho kahle ukuthenga izinto ezidingekayo. Qhathanisa amanani ahlukene bese uzama ukuthola intengo ephansi ukuze izindleko zokutshala nge-hectare zinganyuki kakhulu. Futhi hlola ngesikhathi sokutshala ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezisebenza kahle bese ukhetha ezinhle ozosebenzisa ngonyaka ozayo. Ungaphuthelwa ukucindezela abathengisi ukuba bahlinzeke konke okudingayo ngesikhathi njengoba kuvunyelwene. Khumbula, kukhona ochwepheshe abaningi nabantu abanolwazi abangakusiza ngalezi zinto zonke. Kodwa ungasheshisi kubo sekupheleni kwesikhathi uma isikhathi siphume. Lungiselela wena futhi uxhumane nabo NAMUHLA!
Ngemuva kwalokhu, okubizwa ngokuthi isivumelwano somphakeli ngakolunye uhlangothi, ngemuva kwalokhu baziwa njengezinqwaba. I-SAPS ingena esivumelwaneni nomPHAKELI ngokwezimo nemigomo echazwe esivumelwaneni, futhi umPHAKELI uyavuma ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwakhe ngqo kwi-SAPS ngokwezimo nemigomo echazwe kulesi SIVUMELWANO, okuzobizwa ngokuthi UMSEBENZI: Uma umPHAKELI engaziswa yi-SAPS ukuthi asebenze kwi-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma iyiphi indawo eyisakhiwo se-SAPS engakabi kuMSEBENZI, kuzoba isikhathi esilinganiselwe. UmPHAKELI, ngenxa yesiSIVUMELWANO, ngeke abe noma abe ngaphansi kokulindela ukuthi lesi SIVUMELWANO sizovuselelwa, futhi ngeke aqashwe kunoma iyiphi isikhundla njengomsebenzi we-SAPS. Kuvunyelwene phakathi kweZINQWABA ukuthi isivumelwano somPHAKELI esenziwe naye njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kukhona ubudlelwano bokusebenza phakathi komPHAKELI ne-SAPS. UmPHAKELI kumele, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-clauses 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo ye-clauses 5 no-9 ngezansi, ahlinzeke i-SAPS ngezinsizakalo njengoba kudingeka futhi ngokwezimo ezibekwe yi-SAPS, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lokuqala kwalesi SIVUMELWANO, bheka i-clause 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene nomPHAKELI izohlanganisa noma iyiphi imisebenzi yezandla engxenye, futhi ehambisana nomsebenzi womPHAKELI. UmPHAKELI uzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe (bheka i-clauses 3.1 - 3.2 ngenhla) kwi-SAPS ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngesonto: Uma umPHAKELI engasebenzi kwi-SAPS ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto, noma ezinsukwini zomkhosi. UmPHAKELI uzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokohlelo oluhlanganisiwe lapha njengeSheduli A. UmPHAKELI ngeke abe nelungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma ezinsukwini ayengabakhona ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. UmPHAKELI ngeke abe nelungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izoba nesibopho sokuhlinzeka umPHAKELI ngezokuthutha ukuya nokubuya kuMSEBENZI ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe, bheka i-clauses 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izokhokhela umPHAKELI ngokuba khona kwakhe nomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yesivumelwano ye-R - ...rand ngehora kubandakanya i-VAT: Uma i-SAPS ingakhuphula le mali yesivumelwano ngehora ngokuthanda kwayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Le mali izokhokhwa ngenyanga ngemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yesivumelwano (bheka i-clause 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo ophelele kanye nazo zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi womPHAKELI, uma le mali ikhokhwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho othile, izofakwa emholweni womPHAKELI. UmPHAKELI uyavikela i-SAPS ngokumelene nanoma iyiphi ukulimala noma ukulahleka okubangelwa ukulimala komzimba, ukulahleka kokuphila, ukulahleka noma uk damage to property whether caused by SAPS or another person or whether caused or due to negligence existing at the time he is a member of SAPS maintaining an order, and indemnifies SAPS against any loss, damage, expense or amount payable in relation to ongoing court proceedings concerning the CONTRACTOR and that may relate to claims for money or arrest in any manner. Lesi SIVUMELWANO sizoqala futhi sibe nezibopho kusukela ngosuku olusayinwe yizigaba zombili zalesi SIVUMELWANO: Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO singasayinwa ngasikhathi sinye yiZINQWABA, usuku lokugcina lokusayinwa komunye wemigomo luzothathwa njengosuku lokuqala lokuqala kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana ne-clauses 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizophumelela isikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi), esizoqala ngosuku lokuqala lapho lesi SIVUMELWANO siqala (bheka i-clause 12.1 ngezansi). Lesi SIVUMELWANO singavuselelwa ngokuthanda kwe-SAPS ngokubhalwa phansi ngokuvuma komPHAKELI isikhathi esichaziwe: Uma i-SAPS ifuna ukwazisa umPHAKELI ukuthi ifuna ukuvuselela lesi SIVUMELWANO, kumele inikeze isaziso esibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-clause 13.2 ngenhla, ngaphambi kokuphela kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla). Okuqukethwe kwalesi SIVUMELWANO kuzoba yisisekelo sesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokuhambisana ne-clause 13.2 ngenhla. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana ne-clauses 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizophela ngokuzenzakalelayo ekupheleni kwesikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi). Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ezibala usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sosuku olunye. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ezibala usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kodwa ngaphambi kokuphela kwesinyanga esisodwa kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sezinsuku ezimbili ezibala usuku nosuku. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela ngemuva kwesinyanga esisodwa ibala usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sesinyanga. Uma i-SAPS ingavuma, ngezimo ezamukelekayo, isaziso esifushane. Noma iyiphi iphathi yalesi SIVUMELWANO ingaqeda lesi SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula noma iyiphi ingxenye yalesi SIVUMELWANO: Uma iphathi ekhuluma ngokuqala inikeze omunye iphathi isaziso esibhaliwe mayelana nalokhu kuphula futhi lokho kuphula akukalwe phakathi kwezinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela ngosuku lokuthola leso saziso. Izihloko ze-clauses kulesi SIVUMELWANO zenzelwe ukubhekisela kuphela, ngakho-ke azingxenye futhi azihlobene nokuhumusha kwe-clause nganoma iyiphi indlela. Ngaphandle kokuthi kubonakale ukuthi kukhona ukungqubuzana noma ukungahambisani nokwenzeka, okwakodwa kuzohlanganisa okwakubili futhi ubulili besilisa kuzohlanganisa ubulili besifazane, futhi kuphinde kube njalo. Lesi SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelele phakathi kweZINQWABA futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esingase sibe khona phakathi kweZINQWABA mayelana nokwenzeka lapha. I-ZINQWABA ivuma ukuthi ngeke kube nezinguquko, ukwengeza, noma izivumelwano zokukhansela noma yini eyakha lesi SIVUMELWANO ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye noma noma iyiphi iphuzu noma isimo salo futhi ukuthi ngeke kube nomthelela ek
AmaKaizer Chiefs - Ingxoxo Ngeqembu Elidumile Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma nokuqonda amaKaizer Chiefs, elinye lamaqembu aphambili emhlabeni wombhoxo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kube yithuba elihle lokuhlola umlando, impumelelo, nezifiso zalesi sikhungo esidumile. Ukuze siqonde kahle, sithintana nomqeqeshi, uNksz. Zanele Ndlovu, onolwazi olunzulu ngale nqola. Umlando WamaKaizer Chiefs UNksz. Ndlovu, singakucacisela ukuthi amaKaizer Chiefs asungulwa ngo-1970. Ngabe ungathanda ukusitshela okwengeziwe ngalesi sikhathi sokwakha? "Yebo, amaKaizer Chiefs asungulwa nguKaizer Motaung, owayengumgadli ophumelele. Waqaphela ukuthi kunezidingo ezinkulu zabalandeli bomjaho, futhi wathola ukuthi udinga ukwakha iqembu elizoba yinto enhle eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwaqala uhambo olukhulu, njengoba amaKaizer Chiefs aba nezinhloso zokubeka imithetho emisha emqhudelwaneni." Imiphumela Nezimpumelelo Kukhona imiphumela ethile eyenzeka eminyakeni edlule. Ingabe ungakuchaza ukufinyelela kweqembu emiqhudelwaneni emikhulu? "Ngempela, amaKaizer Chiefs ayaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yawo emqhudelwaneni. Sineziqhumane eziningi, ikakhulukazi ePremier Soccer League naseNedbank Cup. Lokhu kwenza kube nomoya ophakeme phakathi kwabalandeli bethu. Iqembu lethu lihlala likhumbula izikhathi ezinhle, futhi sihlala sikhuthaza abadlali bethu ukuba bagcine lezi zinsuku zikhumbuleka." Ukwakhiwa Kweqembu Ngabe ungachaza kabanzi ngokuqhuba kwemidlalo, izinqumo zokwakha iqembu, nokuthi umqeqeshi uhlale enamathiselwe kumaphuzu athile? "Ukuze wakhe iqubu elihle, sidinga ukuqonda izidingo zethu. Sihlanganisa abadlali abasha nabadala, abaneziqu ezahlukene. Sizama ukufaka abadlali abasha abanesifiso sokufunda. Umqondo wethu uwukuthi bonke kufanele bazibophezele kulokho okufanele bakwenze, futhi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yeqembu. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bethu kubalulekile, futhi umoya wokubambisana uyasiza kakhulu." Ubuhlakani Bokuphelela Kuyinto ebalulekile ukwazisa ngendlela omqeqeshi abona ngayo ubuhlakani bokuphelela. Ungakuchaza ukuthi lokhu kulawula kanjani impumelelo? "Ubuhlakani bokuphelela buhlobene ngqo nemiphumela. Ngaphezu kokuba nabadlali abahle, kufanele sibe necebo elihle lokuqhuba. Uyazi, umphakathi, abalandeli, nabaphathi bonke banendima ebalulekile. Singabathandi kuphela, kodwa kufanele sikukhumbule ukuthi sikhona ukuze sibe neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wombhoxo." Izinselelo Nezindlela Zokubhekana Nazo Yiziphi izinselelo ezihlangabezana neKaizer Chiefs, futhi uhlela kanjani ukubhekana nazo? "Njengoba sikhula, izinselelo zikhula. Ukuze sibe neqhaza emqhudelwaneni, kufanele sibe nokuqonda okukhulu. Izimo zokuncintisana ziya ngokuya ziba nzima, kodwa sikubona njengethuba lokukhula. Sihamba phambili, sihamba phambili ngempumelelo ethile. Ngabe izifiso zethu zihlala ziphakathi, nokuthi sizothola ithuba lokubuyela emuva." Izifiso Zesikhathi Esizayo Ngabe kukhona izifiso ezithile ezikhona ngaphakathi kweKaizer Chiefs? "Yebo, sinesifiso sokwakha iqembu eliqhubekayo. Njengomqeqeshi, ngifuna ukubona abadlali bethu behluma, bephumelela, futhi bephumelela emikhakheni ehlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umgomo wethu wukubamba izicoco eziningi, ngaphezu kokuba nekhono lokwakha umphakathi onempilo." Isiphetho Ngikubonga kakhulu, uNksz. Ndlovu, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinkumbulo ezisemqoka. IKaizer Chiefs iyinhlangano ebalulekile emlandweni wombhoxo, futhi kucacile ukuthi ibalulekile nakweminye imikhakha. Ngithokozile ngomqondo nangesifiso sokubona iqembu likhula. "Ngiyabonga, nansi inhliziyo yeKaizer Chiefs. Sifisa ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza, nokubambisana nezinkanyezi ezizayo. Ngalunye usuku, sizoqhubeka nokwenza kahle." Ngokuhlala sizolokhu silindele, amaKaizer Chiefs azohlala engumholi emkhakheni wombhoxo, futhi impilo yabo izobe igcwele izinkumbulo ezinhle.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezinkokhelo (GEMS Payment Verification) Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinkokhelo zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezimeni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezimali okuqondile kuzo zonke izigaba zezempilo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bathole ukufinyelela okulinganayo ezinsizeni zempilo. Kulokhu, ngifuna ukugxila ekubalulekeni kokuhlola nokuqinisekisa izinkokhelo ze-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kanye nemiphumela engase ibangele uma lezi zinkokhelo zingaqinisekiswa kahle. Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo, ikakhulukazi ezinsizeni zempilo, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona kulabo abazidingayo. I-GEMS iyinhlangano enikeza ukufinyelela kwezempilo kubasebenzi bakamasipala, kodwa uma izinkokhelo zayo zingaqinisekiswa kahle, umphakathi ubhekana nezinkinga ezinzima. Ukungaqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kungaholela ekuhlulekeni kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi emphakathini. Ngakho-ke, kulezi zikhathi zokuqinisekisa, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkokhelo eziphumelelayo zidinga ukuphathwa kahle ukuze wonke umphakathi uthole izinsiza ezisezingeni eliphakeme. Ukuqinisekisa izinkokhelo kuhilela izinyathelo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhona futhi zenziwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwedatha yemali, ukuqinisekisa ama-akhawunti, nokuhlonza izinkinga ezikhona. Uma lezi zinyathelo zingagcinwanga, umphakathi ungase ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezindleko eziphezulu zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, izinkinga zokufinyelela, kanye nokuncipha kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Kumele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisebenzayo zokuhlola nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhona futhi zenza umsebenzi wazo kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kudinga ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okubandakanya i-GEMS, osomabhizinisi, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kubambisana kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo olufanele. Noma ngabe umuntu uthola insiza yezempilo, ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube khona ukuze kucaciswe izinto ezifanele ukuhlinzekwa. Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zokuhlola izinkokhelo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zikhona ngesikhathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhona phakathi kwezinsuku ezithile kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuhlela izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga uhlelo oluqinile lokuphathwa kwezinkokhelo, oluhlanganisa ukuzinza kwedatha, ukuqonda kwezinselelo zokuphatha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezisebenzayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka nokuhlola izinkokhelo akuphephile; kudinga izinsiza, isikhathi, kanye nokuzikhandla. Ukuze kube nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo, izikhungo ezinjenge-GEMS kumele zifune izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kusebenze ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ezidingweni zempilo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele kube nezinsiza ezanele, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nohlelo olwakhiwe kahle lokuphathwa kwemali. Ngokuqhubekayo, kumele sithumele imiyalezo eqinile emphakathini mayelana nezinsiza zempilo ezifanele, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kuzodala ukwazi kwempilo, lapho abantu bazi nobuchwepheshe bezempilo obukhona, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela kanjani izinkokhelo ze-GEMS. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kufanele kube yinsika yempumelelo ekuphathweni kwezinkokhelo. Uma abantu beqonda ngokuphelele izinqubo, bazokwazi ukuthola izinsiza zempilo ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo ze-GEMS kudinga izinyathelo ezicacile, ukuzinza, kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuhlinzekwe izinsiza zempilo ezikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuqonda okuphezulu kwezinsiza, kanye nokubaluleka kokufinyelela kwezempilo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, akusikho ukuthi izinkokhelo kuphela ezibalulekile, kodwa nokuthi lezi zinkokhelo zibe lula, zisebenze kahle, futhi zifike kubantu abadingayo. Ngaleso sizathu, kumele sikhuthaze izinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo, sithuthukise izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi sigcine umgomo wokuthuthukisa izinsiza zempilo kubantu bonke. Lokhu kuzoletha impumelelo enkulu emiphakathini yethu, futhi sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezikahle, eziphusile, nezifanele.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezinsukwini zethu, izimo eziphuthumayo ziba yinkinga enkulu, futhi zidinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo ukuze kuvinjelwe ukulimala okukhulu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni ezinjalo kubalulekile, futhi kudinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela. Le mboni ibandakanya izici eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuqala, ukuhlela kahle kuyisinyathelo esiyinhloko ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuze kube neqhaza eliphumelelayo, izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngosizo kumele zibe necebo eliqinile lokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusungula izinqubo ezicacile zokuphendula, ukuhlela izinsiza, kanye nokuhlonza abantu abaqavile abangasiza ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Ukuhlela kahle akugcini nje ngokwenza kube lula ukuphendula, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ukwethembana phakathi kwezisebenzi. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kubalulekile ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuze kube nokuphendula okusheshayo, kufanele kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, izisebenzi, kanye nomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo kumele zisetshenziswe. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuxhumana, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuxhumana okukhululekile nokuqondile kunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula, futhi kunciphisa amathuba okuba nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ngendlela efanele kuyasiza ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zikhona, futhi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Izinsiza zingaba yizimoto zokuphuthumayo, izinsiza zokwelapha, noma izinsiza zokuxhumana. Ukuze kube neqhaza eliphumelelayo, izikhungo kufanele zihlale ziqinisa izinsiza zazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle, futhi zihlale zikhumbula ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo azilindelekile. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu mayelana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha kwabantu ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuqwashisa kungasiza ekunciphiseni isikhathi sokuphendula, njengoba abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benzeni futhi bazi ukuthi bangabathola kuphi usizo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu benolwazi olunembile, bangakwazi ukusiza futhi baphendule ngokushesha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye buba nesandla esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izinhlelo zokulandelela, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha, ama-drone, kanye nezinhlelo ezisebenza nge-inthanethi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifinyelela endaweni efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ubuchwepheshe buphinde bunciphise izindleko, ngoba izikhungo zingakwazi ukusungula izinqubo eziphumelelayo ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi esiningi. Noma kunjalo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukwazi ukwenza konke. Ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga abantu abaqavile, abanolwazi, nabangabambisani ukuze kufinyelelwe empumelelweni. Lokhu kwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa abantu bazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi banolwazi olufanele, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezici eziningi. Ukuhlela kahle, ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisa izinsiza, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kuyizinto ezibalulekile ezithinta lesi sikhathi. Uma zonke lezi zici zisebenza ndawonye, izikhungo zingakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha futhi ngempumelelo, ngaleyo ndlela zinciphisa umonakalo nokulimala. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ekugcineni, impilo yabantu ibalulekile, futhi isikhathi sokuphendula esisheshayo singaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni nasemiphumeleni.
Umthetho uhlose ukusungula uhlaka lokuphumeza imithetho nemigomo ezohambelana nomkhakha wezempilo kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze izinsizakalo zempilo zixazululwe kahle, umthetho ufisa ukuba kube nokulingana ekunikezeni izinsizakalo ngokusungula izinqubo nezindinganiso, izinhlelo, nemigomo kazwelonke. Isahluko sokuqala siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezinhloso zomthetho, imithwalo yemfanelo yoMnyango wezempilo, kanye nelungelo lokufinyelela ukwelashwa okukhululekile. Sihlanganisa isicelo nencazelo yomqondo womthetho. Umthetho uhlose ukufakwa ezingeni likazwelonke futhi udlule eminye imithetho ehambelana nezempilo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo, uma kwenzeka ukungqubuzana phakathi komthetho neminye imithetho yezempilo. Izinhloso zangempela zomthetho ukuhlinzeka ngezibopho zik governo ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo mayelana namalungelo ahambelana nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kanye nokusungula uhlelo lwezempilo lwesizwe oluhloswe kubo bobabili abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo zomphakathi nezabPrivate, futhi luzohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezingathengiswa ngemali etholakalayo. Lesi sahluko sizama ukuhlukanisa imithwalo yemfanelo kaNgqongqoshe wezempilo (uNgqongqoshe) kulabo bomnyango ezingeni likazwelonke, izifunda, nezikhashana. Lesi sahluko siphinde sifune ukunika uNgqongqoshe amandla okuphumeza imithetho ehambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo ezikhululekile ezindaweni ezithile zabantu. Isahluko sesibili siqukethe imithetho ehambelana namalungelo nemithwalo yemfanelo yalabo abasebenzisa izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Amalungelo abasebenzisi mayelana nolwazi ngezinsizakalo zempilo, izinsizakalo zokwelashwa eziphuthumayo, kanye nokubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni mayelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo ayavunywa, njengoba nelungelo lomsebenzisi lokuhlinzekwa ngolwazi oluhambelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo. Siphinde sithinte ukukhipha imibiko yokuthi umuntu uphume ohlelweni lokwelashwa nokuhlinzekwa kwemvume eqondile. Kukhona imithetho ethinta ukuhlela ukwelashwa ngenhloso yokucwaninga nokugcina amarekhodi ezikhungo zezempilo. Lesi sahluko siphinde sithinte ukufakwa kwezikhalazo ngabasebenzisi nabanye mayelana nezikhungo zezempilo nezilindelo zabasebenzisi mayelana nezempilo zabo, ukusetshenziswa kwezikhungo zezempilo, kanye nobudlelwano babo nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo. Isahluko sesithathu siqukethe imithetho ehambelana noMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Siphatha ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yezempilo Kazwelonke lapho uNgqongqoshe ezosebenzisana namalungu eBhunga Lezempilo Kazwelonke (okuhlanganisa oNgqongqoshe bezifunda), ibhodi yedolobha emelela uhulumeni bendawo, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha eNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezinye iziphathimandla eminyangweni yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nezifunda. Lesi sahluko sichaza imisebenzi namandla eBhodi Yezempilo Kazwelonke, okuyi ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuNgqongqoshe. Lesi sahluko siphinde sisungule iKomidi Lezempilo Kazwelonke. Amalungu wale komidi angababusi beminyango yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nezifunda, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha eNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezimeya zohulumeni bendawo. Lesi sahluko siphinde sinikeze uMphathi-Jikelele woMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke amandla okuthuthukisa amasu wezempilo kazwelonke. Siphinde sithinte ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokubonisana Ngezempilo Kazwelonke ezosebenza ukuze kuhlanganiswe imikhakha ehlukene yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke. Isahluko sesine siqukethe imithetho ehambelana neminyango yezempilo yezifunda. Lesi sahluko beka umthwalo kule minyango ukuze isebenze ngokuhambisana nemigomo yezempilo kazwelonke ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Siphatha ukusungulwa kwamabhodi wezempilo ezifundeni okuzosebenza ngendlela efanayo neBhodi Kazwelonke, kodwa kuzokwenziwa ezingeni lesifunda. Amakomidi Okubonisana Ngezempilo Ezifundeni azosungulwa, azosebenza imisebenzi efanayo neyeBhodi Kazwelonke, kodwa kuzokwenziwa ezingeni lesifunda. Lesi sahluko siphinde sinikeze amandla okuthuthukisa amasu wezempilo ezifundeni ukuze athunyelwe kuMphathi-Jikelele. Siphinde sithinte isidingo sokuthi oNgqongqoshe bezifunda basungule Amabhodi Okubonisana Ngezempilo Ezifundeni ukuze babelane ngolwazi futhi baxhumane ngezindaba ezihambelana nezempilo nababambiqhaza abahlukene. Isahluko sesihlanu sisungula uhlelo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika, okwenziwa ngokulandela izimiso ezithile. Siphinde sithinte ukuklanywa kwezindawo zezempilo, okwenziwa ngokucabangela imingcele ebekwe ezindaweni zedolobha kanye nokuhlanganiswa nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo. Siphatha ukufakwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo zedolobha futhi sinikezela ngokuqaliswa nokuhlelwa kwamasu wezempilo ezindaweni ezithile. Siphinde sithinte izinhlelo zesikhashana ezihambelana nezinsizakalo zempilo zedolobha. Isahluko sesithupha siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezikhungo zezempilo. Le mithetho ilawula ukuhlukaniswa kwezinhlobo, ukusungulwa, nokusebenza kwezikhungo zezempilo futhi ifaka imithetho elawula izitifiketi zokudinga. Ngokwaleli sahluko, akekho ongakha, akhe, aguqule, noma athole isikhungo sezempilo noma ihhovisi lezempilo ngaphandle kwesitifiketi sokudinga. Siphatha ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo, izimvume, nezixazululo mayelana nokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe ngezitifiketi zokudinga, kanye nezimo ezithile ezihambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo ezikhungweni zikahulumeni, okunika uNgqongqoshe amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaleyo mikhawulo. Siphinde sithinte ukuhlinzekwa kwamabhodi ezibhedlela nguNgqongqoshe kanye noNgqongqoshe bezifunda (MECs). Ukufakwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo ezikhungweni ezingezona ezempilo, njengamashu neminye imikhakha yomphakathi, kuyakhulunywa kulokhu. UNgqongqoshe unikezwa amandla okwenza izinqumo zokwelashwa kwabaphilayo abavela ezindaweni zomdabu. Imithetho elawula ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni nezizimele ifakiwe kulokhu. Izikhungo ezizimele zinesibopho sokuthola umshwalense ukuze zivikela abasebenzisi ezinkingeni ezingase zenzeke. Isahluko sesixhenxe siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nokuhlela izinsiza zabantu nezikhungo zezempilo ezihlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Kukhona imithwalo eminingi ebekwe kuBhodi Yezempilo Kazwelon
Ishadi lokushada lisetshenziselwa ukufakazela ukuthi ushade. Umshado kumele wenziwe phambi kwabantu abashadayo, abafakazi abaneziqinisekiso zokukhomba, kanye nomphakathi. Abantu abashadayo kumele babe neziqinisekiso zokukhomba futhi baqedele ifomu le-BI-31. Qedela ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-130 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Umshado ungaphathwa ngumphakathi owukhethayo ovela eqenjini lezenkolo ethile, inhlangano, noma ummeleli weMnyango WezeMisebenzi. Umshado kumele wenziwe esontweni, endaweni esetshenziselwa kuphela izinhloso zenkolo, ehhovisi likamasipala, noma endlini yangasese. Uma omunye wabantu abashadayo elimele kakhulu noma ebanjwe yisifo esinzima, umshado ungaphathwa esibhedlela. Abantu abangaphandle abashadayo eNingizimu Afrika kumele babe namapasipoti futhi baqedele ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-31. Abantu ababili abashadayo, abafakazi ababili, kanye nomphakathi kumele basayine iMarriage Register ngokushesha ngemva kokuphathwa komshado. Abancane, abachazwa njengabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abake bashada ngaphambili, kumele balandele umthetho. Abantu abake bashada esikhathini esedlule, lapho imishado yabo iphelelwe yimpilo noma yahlukaniswa, ngeke baphinde babhekelwe njengabancane ngaphansi komthetho. Kumele bathumele incwadi yokuvuma ebhaliwe evela kubazali bobabili kanye/noma umgibeli wezomthetho ngokugcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-31. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa kumKomishana Wezingane uma abazali bakho bengatholakali noma uma kungenzeki kahle ukuthi wamukele ishadi. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa eNkantolo Ephakeme endaweni yakho uma abazali bakho kanye/noma uKomishana behluleka ukwamukela umshado. Abantu abahlukanisile abafuna ukushada kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole umyalo wokuhlukanisa eNkantolo. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma kukhona isizathu esiqinile sokuthi abakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa, noma uma behlukanisile kwelinye izwe, bangase bangakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa. I-affidavit kumele ibonise ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uhlukanisiwe ngokomthetho, igama lenkantolo, kanye nosuku lokuhlukanisa. Abafazi abashadile noma abesilisa abafuna ukushada kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole ishadi lokufa lomshado wabo ofile. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma ishadi lokufa lingatholakali. I-affidavit kumele iqinisekise igama nesibongo somuntu ofile, kanye nosuku lokufa. Ishadi lokushada elifushane: likhishwa ngokushesha. Ishadi elingaphelele: izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweight.
uMangosuthu Buthelezi: Umholi Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule UMangosuthu Buthelezi, omunye wabaholi abavelele emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, ubalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki. Uzalwe ngomhla ziyi-27 kuNdasa ka-1928 eMgungundlovu, ubaba wakhe uMphenyane Buthelezi wayengumholi wesizwe samaZulu, umama wakhe uMaMeyi engumama womdabu. Ukuze kuqondwe ubukhona bakaButhelezi, kubalulekile ukufanisa imvelaphi yakhe somdabu kanye nesimo sezepolitiki esangizayo phakathi nezinsuku zeNtshonalanga. Ngokuhamba kwemihla, uButhelezi waba ngumsunguli weZULU, okuyinhlangano eyasungulwa ngo-1975. Le nhlangano, eyayihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane sahamba phambili ezinyathelweni zomphakathi. UButhelezi wathola ukuyisiza le nhlangano ukuze iqinise umehluko phakathi kweZizwe zamaZulu nezinye izizwe. Njengomholi, uMangosuthu Buthelezi ubelokhu engumqondo ophambili wezombusazwe, enza ukukhuluma ngezimvo zakhe ngokukhululekile. Kukhona imikhawulo engokwenkolo eyabe ingekho emthethweni, nolimi alulwanga, okwakubizwa ngokuthi ubuvila kwezombusazwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, ubukhona bukaButhelezi babukhulu ekwenzeni izinqumo ezazingathinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindleleni zamakholwa. UButhelezi wayenelisa ukuba nesibindi ekuphikeni kwemithetho eyayizama ukunciphisa amalungelo abantu. Emzini, uButhelezi waphendula njengezwi labantu, ebonisa izibopho zakhe kumasiko amancane, kanye nomlando wokuhlala nabanye abaholi. Njengomholi weZULU, waqinisekisa ubuqotho bendabuko nemigomo yezomthetho. Phakathi kwezinselelo ezazibhekene nabo, uButhelezi ubebonakala enomsebenzi owagqugquzela, uhola izichibiyelo ezazihlosiwe ukuze kuphumelele ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuphakamisa umoya wokuqonda, uButhelezi wayekhuluma ngekusasa elifanele labantu. Kule mikhiqizo eyamukelwa ngekhulu, izinqumo ezithathwe uMangosuthu Buthelezi zashintsha umqondo wesimanje osesimweni sezombusazwe. Noma kungathi abanye abantu befanekisela ukudideka, uButhelezi uyaziwa ngokucaca kwakhe. Kungakhathaliseki amathuba, ugqugquzela ukuba abasebenzi baphumelele ezindaweni zabo, baphinde bakhuthazwe. Ubuthelezwa bukhombisa impendulo ethile esigabeni esinzima phakathi nezinsuku zakho. UButhelezi ungomunye wezinhlelo ezihlonishwayo, kodwa zonke zikhombisa umoya wakhe wokwandisa uhlelo oluthile ngezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukholo lwakhe olungapheli ekwakheni isizathu sokugcina lobu buthelezwa. Ngokubheka emuva kulokho uMangosuthu Buthelezi akwenze, kuhlanganiswe nezimfanelo zakhe ezivelayo njengomholi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uthando lwakhe lokukhuluma nokukhuthaza abanye kungenzeka kube yimpilo yakhe. Ubuqotho bakhe bungumbonisi emphilweni yengqondo. Kodwa, ungase ubone ukuthi umbuzo wokhetho unika impinduka ekubeni izinkampani ezincintisana ngenhloso yokwakha isimo esisha ziqhubeka nokwakheka. Umthelela kaButhelezi emlandweni uzohlala ukhanya, ngaphandle kokuphikisana nomphakathi. UButhelezi wandisa indlela yokukhetha imikhakha eyabonakala emnothweni, ethinta umkhiqizo waseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhambela kwesikhathi, uMangosuthu Buthelezi ubalulekile emlandweni, akwenzi kuphela ezepolitiki, kodwa futhi ubalulekile emiphakathini, ukwazisa umuntu, kanye nokwakha imiyalezo eyenza kube lula kwabanye. Njengomholi, uButhelezi ubala imiphumela emhlabeni jikelele, wonke umuntu ofuna ukwazi ukuthi igunya lakhe liyalibala emigqeni yezenzakalo. Ngenxa yalezi zinto, uButhelezi ungasali emuva empini yakhe, akamukeli lapho, ngoba ufisa ukuphila esikhathini esizayo. Ukusebenza kwakhe, ukukhulu, ubuchopho, futhi uyabavikela bonke abantu abaseziqhwini, ukuze balwe nezimpilo zabo. Ukugcina umoya wakhe esikhathini esizayo uMangosuthu Buthelezi uhlala ehlinzeka izifundo ezibalulekile kumphakathi wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi, ingikhumbula uMangosuthu Buthelezi. Ngokubuyisela emuva kulokho akwenza, ngiwuthola umqondo omqoka wakhe. Njengomholi ongaguquki futhi onamandla, uyaziwa, kube nempumelelo, futhi skuthetheli phambili emlandweni. Ubudoda bahlonishwa ukuqhubeka nokukhula kohlanga. Konke lokhu kuveza ukuba uMangosuthu Buthelezi ubalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki, futhi imiphumela yakhe ithinta ubudala obuphakeme. Kukhona izifundo ezibalulekile esizifundile, futhi sihamba phambili nendlela yokuphila ngendlela ezwakalayo, edlula ukungabaza, futhi okuhloniphekile. Umuntu omkhulu, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, uhlala ehamba phambili, esimweni sethu.
Lo mthetho uhlose ukuthuthukisa futhi wenze ukuba ukuthutha komphakathi kube yimpumelelo kubagibeli eGauteng. Uhloswe ukudala uhlelo oluhlonipha amalungelo abantu abasebenza ekuthutheni komphakathi; futhi ukukhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane, ikakhulukazi lawo ancane kakhulu, kanye nabaphathi abaphumelele ngenxa yokucwaswa kwangaphambili. Lo Mthetho ufaka esikhundleni seSahluko 3 soMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke ngokwezinhlinzeko ezitholakala kulomthetho. Abasebenzisi babhekene nezindleko zokuhamba ezikhokhwa ngabagibeli, futhi lapho abagibeli bekhokha imali encishisiwe, futhi lapho umphathi wesivumelwano evuselela isivumelwano nomsebenzisi; futhi lapho labo abasebenza ekuthutheni bengatholi uxhaso noma usizo lwezezimali kunoma yiliphi ilungu noma ingxenye yohulumeni, ngakho-ke ngokwesigaba lesi, ukuvuselelwa okwenziwe kulabo abasebenza ekuthutheni ngokusekelwe emalini ekhokhwayo ngeke kubhekwane njengoxhaso noma olunye uhlobo losizo lwezezimali. Izinhlelo kumele ziphakanyiswe ukuze kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwemizila, ukuthutha okutholakala kalula kulabo abanokukhubazeka, ukushintsha nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kanye nabantu ababe nezinketho ezilinganiselwe ngenxa yokucwaswa okungafanele. Kumele babe nezimvume ezifanele, amalayisense okusebenza, noma igunya lesikhashana; futhi kumele babhaliswe ngaphansi kwalomthetho mayelana nezimoto ze-taxi, ama-taxi akhishwe ngemitha, amabhasi, nezimoto zokuzijabulisa ngokwezihloko 69, 77, no-81. Inhlangano ayikwazi ukuba ne-layisense yokusebenza noma imvume. Noma iyiphi imoto ingathola kuphela i-layisense yokusebenza eyodwa. Ukuthutha abantu emkhakheni wokwabelana ngezithuthi, lapho amalungu eshintshana ngezithuthi noma ehlela ukwabelana ngezithuthi namanye amalungu noma labo abanikwe wona ukuze bahambe baye futhi babuye ezindaweni ezithile ngenhloso ethile futhi lapho kungekho uhlelo noma olunye uhlobo lokukhokha lokwabelana ngezithuthi. Bangaba abashayeli; futhi kumele bazi kahle indawo abenza kuyo. Isigaba 1 ngeke sibe khona kubaphathi abasebenza lapho kucacile ukuthi akusikho. I-MEC ingakha imithetho yokuthi bonke abashayeli bezimoto zokuthutha komphakathi kumele baqeqeshelwe okuthile. Ummeleli wehhovisi ungacela ummangali welayisense ukuthi athumele imoto ukuze ihlolwe futhi uma bekungathiwa ayikahle emgwaqweni, noma ngabe le moto yayine-layisense evumelekile yokuba emgwaqweni; futhi bangaphika ukuhlinzeka nge-layisense yokusebenza uma bebona ngokwabo ukuthi imoto ayikahle emgwaqweni. Izimoto ezisetshenziswa ekuthutheni komphakathi kumele zishiye isizinda sazo sihlanzekile, ngaphakathi nangaphandle, ngokwezindinganiso ezihambisanayo, uma kukhona isivumelwano, njengoba kuchaziwe esivumelwaneni. Ngokwezinhlinzeko zoMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke, izimoto ezisetshenziswa ekuthutheni komphakathi kumele zibe sesimweni esihle ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Imoto esebenza ukuthutha abagibeli bomphakathi kumele ibe ne-fire extinguisher eyodwa esebenzayo okungenani kanye ne-first aid kit enezinto zayo. I-fire extinguisher kanye ne-first aid kit kumele zibekwe noma zifakwe ngendlela ethile nendawo ethile emotweni, futhi ama-fire extinguishers kumele ashintshwe ngezikhathi ezithile ezifanele. Izinsizakalo zokuzijabulisa kumele zihlale zikhona njengoba kukhonjisiwe esigabeni 16. Izigaba zezinsizakalo ezishiwo esigabeni 1 mayelana nemithetho ekhombisa esigabeni 3 esikhathini esizayo zikhonjiswe ohlwini B, kuyilapho lezo zokushintsha kwesikhathi zikhonjiswe ohlwini C. Imoto kumele ikhombe ukuthi iyitaxi ngendlela echaziwe. Ibhodi ingasetha imali ephezulu noma ephansi yokuhamba kwamataxi akhishwe ngemitha okumele ikhokhwe kumgibeli. I-taxi ayikwazi ukuthwala umuntu; noma kumele ikwenze ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano esivunywe yiBhodi. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, i-taxi ekhishwe ngemitha ingasebenza ngentengo engakhonjiswa kumitha uma intengo yokuhamba ethile ivunyelwe ngaphambili. Izimoto ze-taxi zingasebenzisa kuphela izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ukuze zisebenze. I-layisense yokusebenza ekhishwe ye-taxi kumele ikhombe ukuthi ukusebenza kwaleyo taxi kulandela umzila noma imephu, ngaphandle uma isimo esihlukile sivunyelwe kulomthetho. Mayelana namabhasi noma ezitimeleni, iBhodi inganciphisa ukusebenza kwe-layisense ezindaweni ezithile noma emizileni ethile. Amabhasi kumele ahlelwe ukuze asebenze ezindaweni ezithile noma emizileni ethile ngokukhokha intengo ekhombisiwe futhi asebenze ngezikhathi ezihlelwe, okungukuthi, uma kukhona uxhaso, kumele kuvunywe nguMnyango ophakamisayo uxhaso. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuze kuthuthwe abafundi bezikole, abafundi bezifundo eziphakeme, abafundi abadala, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi phakathi kwezindawo zabo zokuhlala nezikhungo zemfundo, kodwa kungabandakanya ukuhamba okungahlelwanga ezikhungweni zemfundo uma lezi zinhlelo zihlobene kuphela nezindaba zemfundo. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kungasebenzisa izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, amabhasi ajwayelekile, amabhasi okushuttle, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ukuze zisetshenziswe ngezinhloso ezithile. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka ngesicelo sokwabelana, ukuvuselela, ukushintsha, noma ukudlulisa i-layisense yokusebenza yokuthutha kwezemfundo, iBhodi kumele ithumele isicelo esikoleni esithintekayo noma kwezinye izikhungo zemfundo ukuze izwe imibono yabo noma iziphakamiso ngendlela echaziwe, futhi kumele ibhekise kulezi zibonelo noma iziphakamiso ezitholakele. Ukuthutha kwezivakashi kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuze kube lula ukuhamba kwabavakashi lapho izivakashi zikh accompanied by a registered tour guide ngokuhambisana nesigaba 21 soMthetho Wezokuvakasha. Akukho layisense evumela ukusebenza kokuthutha kwezivakashi okungakhishwa ngaphandle kokuthi iBhodi ithole futhi ihlinzeke ngeziphakamiso ezivela kumphakathi wezokuthutha ngokuvumelana noMEC, kodwa iBhodi ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu kuhlola uma umphakathi ungakakhishanga iziphakamiso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe esicelweni seBhodi. Ekukhishweni kwe-layisense yokusebenza kwezivakashi, iBhodi ingabeka izimo zokuthi imoto kumele ibe nenqubomgomo, izinhlelo zokukhuluma zokudlulisa umculo noma imiyalezo, amathuluzi okupheka, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinto ezitholakala yiBhodi, noma izindawo zokuphumula uma uhambo ludlula amakhilomitha angama-200, noma ezinye izimo. Ibhodi ingasetha inani eliphezulu labagibeli imoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha izivakashi engathwala, noma ngabe usayizi wemoto udlula lelo nani elichaziwe. Uma kufanelekile, iBhodi inganikeza izindawo ezithile noma imizila yokusebenza kokuthutha kwezivakashi. Umshayeli wemoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha izivakashi kumele ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho lezi zinsizakalo
Kufanele uthathe incwadi yokugunyazwa uma ufuna ukwenza okulandelayo: ukuthenga imoto entsha noma esebenzisiwe ezweni elingaphandle, ukuthenga imoto yokuthutha impahla noma ithreyi edonswa enye imoto, noma ukwakha noma ukuguqula kancane imoto. Kufanele ube nencwadi yokugunyazwa noma imoto eyakhiwe kuleli noma eyakhiwe kwenye indawo. Izimoto, amabhasi, nezithuthuthu ezithwala impahla, ama-threyi adonswa ngemuva kwezithuthi, izimoto ezikhethekile kuphela zeJibha, izithuthi ezihambayo, nezithuthi zokuvuna. Zonke izimoto, noma zakhwe lapha eNingizimu Afrika noma phesheya, kufanele zihambisane nezindinganiso ezibekwe nguMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwenhlangano Yezokuthutha Kazwelonke ka-1996. Abathengi bezimoto ngaphandle kwaleli kufanele banikeze ubufakazi bokuthi bahambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe nguMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwenhlangano Yezokuthutha Kazwelonke ka-1996 futhi kufanele zihlolwe yi-SABS, okuyinhlangano ephethe ukwakha izindinganiso zokukhiqiza eNingizimu Afrika. Isixwayiso: ifomu kufanele ligcwaliswe ngumuntu obhaliswe kuyo imoto. Ikhophi yesitifiketi sokukhomba, amandla okuphatha uma kuyinkampani noma inhlangano enkulu, kanye ne-affidavit evela emaphoyiseni aseNingizimu Afrika uma imoto ikhiqizwe kufanele ifakwe. Lokhu kufanele kufake nenombolo yejeneretha, inombolo ye-chassis, kanye nezinye zonke imininingwane yomsebenzi owenziwayo kanye nendawo lapho izingxenye zitholwe khona. Isitifiketi sokuhlola amaphoyisa kanye nesitifiketi sokuthi imoto iyasebenza, kanye nesitifiketi somthwalo wemoto, kanye nezithombe ezimbili zemoto. Khokha imali ethile. Le ncwadi yokugunyazwa izobe isilungile phakathi kwezinsuku ezine kuya kwezingu-6.
Noma ubani ngaphandle kwezinkampani nemibutho ebhaliswe ngokomthetho. Umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 kumele asizwe ngabayeni babo noma umgibeli wezomthetho. Ubani ongabizwa enkantolo? Ngaphandle kukahulumeni, noma ubani angabizwa enkantolo kuhlanganise nezinkampani, imibutho, izindawo zokuhlala, kanye nanoma yini enye esebenza endaweni ephethwe yilowo msebenzi. Ingakanani engenziwa? Uma isicelo sakho sidlula u-R7000, ungathumela izicelo zendawo eziphansi kwalokho ukuze isicelo sakho samukelwe enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane. Izicelo eziphezulu kuka-R7000. Izicelo ezibhekiswe kuhulumeni. Izicelo ezihlobene nesimo sengqondo somuntu. Izicelo ezicela isenzo esithile esingavumeli ukuxhaswa, ngaphandle kwezimo ezihilela ukudluliswa kwezinsiza noma impahla ezinzile noma ezihambayo ezidlula u-R7000 ngenani. Ingabe udinga ukuvusa icala enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane? Cha, ungakhetha ukuvusa icala enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane noma nganoma iyiphi enye inkantolo engathola icala lakho. Ukuthola ummeli kanye nosizo lwabo ekulungiseleleni isicelo. Awuvunyelwe ukuthi umeleke ngumemeli ojwayelekile noma omkhulu. Nokho, ngezindleko zakho, ungacela iseluleko kumemeli ngaphambi kokuthi uqale. Kufanele uhlele kusenesikhathi nomlobi wenkantolo ukuze uthole umhumushi uma ubufakazi buyethulwa ngolimi olungaqondakali kahle komunye wabantu abathintekayo. Wazisa umphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa nesicelo somthetho) noma ngokuqondile, ngefoni, noma ngobufakazi, ucelwa ukuba ahlangabezane nezicelo zakho. Uma umphikisi engaphenduli isicelo sakho, bhalela incwadi yokucela (echaza zonke izimo zaleso sicelo, kuhlanganise nenani lezicelo zakho) umnikeze izinsuku eziyi-14 kusukela ngosuku athola ngalo incwadi yokucela ukuze ahlangabezane nezicelo zakho. Thumela incwadi yokucela ngesandla noma ngeposi elibhalisiwe kumphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa nesicelo somthetho). Noma iyiphi incwadi yokuvumelana noma ukuqinisekisa izimo zezicelo zakho. Igama eliphelele kanye nekheli (ikheli lasekhaya, nekheli lempilo, uma kusebenza) kanye nenombolo yefoni yomphikisi. Bona kanye nosizo lwabo lwezomthetho bazobuyekeza imibhalo onayo futhi bakusize ubhale isikhumbuzo esilula. Bazobhala isikhumbuzo futhi bakunikeze sona. Ungakwazi ukusithumela isikhumbuzo kumphikisi. Ungakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngesikhumbuzo kumphakathi (umphakathi wezokuphepha) lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, ukuze amapolisa akwazi ukusithumela kumphikisi. Yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo? Gcina incwadi yokuvumelana noma noma iyiphi incwadi eqinisekisa izimo zesikhumbuzo osithumelayo. Wazisa abafakazeli bakho ngomhla nesikhathi sokulalelwa kwecala futhi uhlele ukuba babe khona enkantolo ngaleso sikhathi esishiwo. Bangasiza ekuhlangabezaneni nezicelo zomfakazi. Bangathumela isitatimende esibhaliwe kumlobi wenkantolo, esiqukethe imininingwane nezimo zokuzivikela kwabo, bese bethumela kopi kumfakazi. Bangakwazi futhi ukufaka izicelo zabo ngokuphikisa kumfakazi ngokuletha isitatimende esiqukethe imininingwane edingekayo yesikhumbuzo kumlobi wenkantolo. Uma kuvela isicelo sokuphikisa noma izicelo, icala kufanele siqhubeke nokulalelwa. Yini okufanele uyenze uma umphikisi ehambisile nezicelo zakho? Wazise ngokushesha umlobi wenkantolo ukuthi izicelo zakho zihlangabezile futhi ukuthi ngeke uqhubeke nalesi cala. Yini okufanele uyenze ngosuku nesikhathi sokulalelwa kwecala? Kufanele ube khona enkantolo uqobo. Inqubo yokulalelwa kwecala ayinacala futhi ilula. Awuvunyelwe ukufaka imibuzo phakathi komfakazi nomphikisi. Nokho, ngemvume yeKomishini, ungabeka imibuzo embalwa kumphikisi. Lapho iKomishini isizwile lokho okukhuluma wena nomphikisi kanye nanoma yiziphi izifakazelo ezikhona, inkantolo izokhipha isinqumo. IKomishini ingase ibonise ukuthi izokwazi ukukwazisa ngombiko wabo ngobufakazi kamuva. Ukuphathwa kwecala kubalulekile kakhulu. Isinqumo senkantolo siyi-final, ngaphandle kokuba kube nesizathu esamukelekayo sokuphikisa. Uzoba nesibopho sokukhokha noma yiziphi izindleko ezibekwe yinkantolo. Izindleko ezingase zibe khona yilezo ezingenzeka kumfakazi ngokukhokha umphakathi. Landela isinqumo senkantolo. Umphikisi uzokhokha inani lesinqumo kuwe ngokushesha, uma enalo. Mnika ithikithi lelo nani ngokushesha. Uma umphikisi engakwazi ukuhambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ngaleso sikhathi, inkantolo izobuza ngesimo sabo sezezimali nokuthi bangakukhokhela yini mayelana nesinqumo nezindleko futhi izokhipha isinqumo ngalokho. Uma umuntu otholwe enecala ehluleka ukuhambisana nesinqumo noma isinqumo senkantolo yeziqephu ezincane futhi ufuna ukuqinisa leso siqumo, icala lizodluliselwa enkantolo yamaMagistrate, futhi lizolalelwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho WamaMagistrate, 1944 (Umthetho 32 wango-1944). Kunconywa ukuthola ummeli mayelana nokulalelwa kwalesi cala. Le pamphlet ikwazisa kuphela ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele zilandelwe mayelana nokufaka isicelo enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane. Uma udinga noma iyiphi usizo nganoma iyiphi indaba, ikheli nenombolo yefoni yomlobi wenkantolo yeziqephu ezincane zitholakala enkantolo yamaMagistrate endaweni yakho.
Umlando Wezisebenzi Zasezimayini Ukukhuluma ngempilo yezisebenzi zasezimayini, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zindawo ziwumongo ophilayo wezomnotho, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhanya kwelanga, kwazulu, nababekezeli, bonke baqonda ukuthi izimayini ziningi zazo ezikhipha amandla, kodwa zikhona neziqu zomsebenzi ezinzima. Ngakho-ke, ake sithathe lokhu kubhekisiswe ngokuqhubekayo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yezisebenzi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izimayini ziqale zathuthukiswa ngesikhathi sobukoloni. Kwakukhona imfuno enkulu yamalahle, igolide, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka ezazidingeka ukuze kube nezidingo zomnotho. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika, baqala ukuza ezindaweni zasemazweni ukuze bazame ukuthola umsebenzi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezindawo zokuhlala ezibizwa ngokuthi "amaTownship." Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, iminyaka edlule, izisebenzi zathola izinga eliphakeme lokusebenza, kodwa futhi zaba nezinselelo eziningi. Ukusebenza ezimayini kwakuthathwa njengokungasheshisi, futhi abantu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukuphila kwabo kwakuhlobene nezingozi nezingozi ezinzima, kufaka phakathi ukulimala emsebenzini, izifo ezithathelwanayo, nezimo zokuhlala ezimbi. Abesifazane babengabhaliswanga kalula futhi benganikezwa ithuba lokusebenza, ngakho-ke, ubukhona babo bekukholwa ukuthi bukhona kuphela ezindaweni ezincane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukwakha iminyango yokuvikela amalungelo ezisebenzi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezahlukene zokulwa nokucindezelwa. Kwakukuhle kakhulu ukubona abantu bejabula, bephakamisa izikhwama zabo, begqugquzela amalungelo abo. Izinsuku zokuqala zokuvota, izinkulumo ezaziphakanyiswa, nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zaziyingxenye yokuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abo ayavikeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngesikhathi sokukhula kwemibono yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, izisebenzi zasezimayini zaba nemibhikisho eminingi. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa izinsuku ezinzima, lapho abantu besiphakamisa izwi labo, becele ukuthi baphuculwe izimo zabo zokusebenza. Isibonelo, kwaba nezenzakalo ezinjengokuboshwa kwabantu, ukulwa nemali yokuhola enganele, kanye nezimo eziphazamisayo. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yomhlaba Yesibili, izimayini zazibhekwa njengendawo ebalulekile, futhi izisebenzi zaba negalelo elikhulu ekwakheni izinsiza ezazidingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe impi. Abesifazane, ababephuma ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, baqala ukusebenza ezimayini, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekuvuleni amathuba amaningi. Kwakungesikhathi lapho abantu beqala ukubona ukuthi amandla abesifazane ayebalulekile, futhi lokhu kwasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukwamukela izisebenzi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, izimayini zavula amahhovisi amasha, futhi izisebenzi zafika zifuna izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihlukahlukene zokusebenza, ezagcwalisa umhlaba wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izisebenzi ziqonde ukuthi kumele zifunde, ziqhubeke zithuthukisa amakhono azo ukuze zikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezizayo emhlabeni. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izimayini zikhula, izinselelo zazo ziqhubeka. Ukuze kusebenze kahle, izisebenzi zidinga izimo ezinhle zokusebenza, futhi lokhu akusikhona njalo. Zikhona izinsuku lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi akekho ophakeme, kanti izinkinga ezinjengokushoda kwemali yokuhola, izimo zokuhlala ezingezinhle, nemikhawulo yokuphepha ziba yizinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Kuyaphawuleka ukuthi, njengoba izisebenzi ziqhubeka nokwakha impilo yazo, zikhona izindlela eziningi zokuthola ukwesekwa. Izinhlelo zokuziphatha, umphakathi obambisene, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhokhelwa ziyaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukwakha umphakathi ophephile, ophilayo, kudinga ukubambisana. Ukuze sifeze umbono omuhle wezisebenzi zasezimayini, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabo iyingxenye enkulu yezenzakalo zomphakathi wethu. Ngakho-ke, akusikhona kuphela ukubuka izindleko, kodwa futhi ukubheka izinzuzo ezitholakala ekubambeni izisebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi sifeze izinjongo ezinhle, sithuthukise izimo zokusebenza, futhi sigcine isithunzi esihle somsebenzi wezisebenzi zasezimayini. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini ubonisa ukuthi amandla okusebenza, ubuhlakani, nokubambisana kwazo, kungaholela ekuphuculeni izimpilo zazo. Njengoba sikhumbula izinsuku ezinzima nezimpumelelo, sithola ukuthi ukuqhubeka nokubambisana, ukusekela amalungelo ezisebenzi, kanye nokwakha isiko elihle lokusebenza, kubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Futhi ngalendlela, somandla sithola ukuthi umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka, uqhubeka, uhamba phambili.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha: Izinyathelo Zokuhamba Ngempumelelo Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda, ukulungiselela, nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezihambisana nalokhu. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile ezidingekayo ukuze uqonde kahle le nqubo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Ukukhulelwa Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhulelwa kwenzeka kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwazi ukuthi umjikelezo wesikhathi sokukhulelwa uqala kanjani. Umjikelezo wesikhathi sokukhulelwa uqala ngosuku lokugcina lokukhulelwa, lapho umjikelezo wesikhathi uqala khona. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqonde kahle izinsuku ezithile lapho ukukhulelwa kungase kwenzeke khona. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuxhumana Nabazali Ngaphambi kokuba uqale uhambo lokukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuba uxhumane nabazali noma abantu abadala abanolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda ngale nqubo, izinselelo ezihambisana nayo, kanye nezindlela zokuzilungiselela. Abazali bangakunika izeluleko ezibalulekile ezizokwenza uqonde kahle imizwa nezimo ezihambisana nokukhulelwa. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuzilungiselela Ngempilo Ukukhulelwa kudinga umzimba ophilile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuzilungiselela ngokudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokuphumula kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi udla ukudla okunothe ngama-vithamini, amaminerali, kanye nezakhamzimba ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula emzimbeni wakho ukwakha indawo efanele yokukhulelwa. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Impilo Yezokwelapha Ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuvakashela kudokotela ukuze uhlole impilo yakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwezempilo jikelele, ukuhlolwa kwezifo ezithathelwana, kanye nokuhlolwa kokukhulelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle isimo sempilo yakho, futhi kudinge izinyathelo ezithile uma kudingeka. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqonda Izinketho Zokukhulelwa Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokukhulelwa, futhi kubalulekile ukuzazi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhulelwa ngokwemvelo, ukukhulelwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokwelapha, noma ezinye izindlela. Qonda ukuthi yiziphi izinketho ezitholakalayo, bese ukhetha leyo ehambelana nezidingo zakho. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nomlingani Uma usukhuluma ngokuqhubeka nokukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuba uxhumane nomlingani wakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba nokuqonda okuhle phakathi kwenu. Khuluma ngezifiso zenu, izinselelo, kanye nezinto ezithokozisayo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kule nqubo. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubheka Izimpawu Zokukhulelwa Uma usuhamba phambili, qaphela izimpawu zokukhulelwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhamba kancane, ukuvuvukala, noma izinguquko emzimbeni. Uma uzwa lezi zimpawu, kubalulekile ukuthi uvakashele udokotela ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukukhulelwa kuyenzeka. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuphatha Imizwa Ukukhulelwa kungaba nemizwa eminingi, okuhlanganisa injabulo, ukukhathazeka, noma ukungaqiniseki. Kubalulekile ukuphatha le mizwa ngendlela efanele. Thola izindlela zokuzithokozisa, njengezokuphumula, ukuzivocavoca, noma ukuxhumana nabangani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kahle ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa. Isinyathelo 9: Ukulungiselela Ukubeletha Uma usukhulelwa, kubalulekile ukuqala ukulungiselela ukubeletha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda ngempilo yengane, izindlela zokubeletha, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Qiniseka ukuthi unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi ube necebo lokuthi uzokwenza kanjani uma isikhathi sokubeletha sifika. Isinyathelo 10: Ukubamba Umoya Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukubamba umoya. Ukukhulelwa kuyinqubo ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ingaba nezinselelo. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazithokozisa, futhi ungazikhathazi kakhulu ngezinto ezingalungile. Ukubamba umoya kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuhamba ngempumelelo ekukhulelweni kwentsha. Khumbula, le nqubo iyingxenye yokukhula, futhi kubalulekile ukuyithokozisa. Hamba phambili ngokuqonda, uthando, nokuhlonipha, futhi uzokwazi ukuhamba kahle kule nqubo ebalulekile.
Isimo Somhlomuli Somlingani Noma Oshade Naye (GEMS Spouse/Partner Beneficiary Status) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Phakathi kwezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibonakala njengomunye wemithombo ebalulekile yokunikeza usizo lwezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuqonda isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye, okungukuthi, ukuthi ubani ongathola izinzuzo ezihambisana nale nhlangano. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abathintekayo baqonde kahle ukuthi izinzuzo zifaka phakathi kanjani umshado noma ubudlelwano obuseduze. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi kubantu abashadile noma abahlala ndawonye, njengoba izinzuzo zempilo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ngokwezimiso ze-GEMS, umhlomuli ungumlingani ophakathi kokuhlanganyela kwezomnotho, okungukuthi, umyeni, unkosikazi, noma umngani obambisene naye. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umsebenzisi we-GEMS eshadile, umkakhe noma umyeni wakhe bangathola izinzuzo ezihambisana nezinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokwelapha, izivivinyo, kanye nemithi, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuhlela izidingo zabo zezempilo. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo ezithile zingase zibe nomthelela ekutholeni lezi zinzuzo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umshado ungakabhaliswa ngokofficial, umhlomuli angase angatholi izinzuzo eziphelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile baqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo ezisemthethweni zifeziwe ukuze bagweme izinkinga ezizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile mayelana nezimo zokuhlala. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umhlomuli engakahlali nomsebenzisi, kungase kube nzima ukuthola izinzuzo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinzuzo zempilo zifinyelela kulabo abahlala ndawonye futhi abavumelani ngokwezimali. I-GEMS iphinde ibeke izinqubo ezithile zokubhalisela umhlomuli. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezikhombisa ubudlelwano, njengemishado, izivumelwano zokuhlala, noma amanye amadokhumenti afanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlomuli uthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngokubheka izinzuzo ezitholakalayo, umhlomuli ungathola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezifo ezinzima, izivivinyo ezijwayelekile, kanye nemithi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umhlomuli uthola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo, okungaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi abashadile baqonde ukuthi izinzuzo ze-GEMS azikhawulelwanga kuphela ezindleleni zokwelapha. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo zokwelapha ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezikhethekile, ezinjengokwelashwa kwezifo ezithile, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelashwa kwezokwelapha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlomuli uthola ukunakekelwa okugcwele, okungaholela empilweni engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile yokunakekelwa kwezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze umhlomuli athole izinzuzo ezihambisana nezinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile baqonde izinqubo ezisemthethweni nezidingo ezihambisana nezinhlelo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo futhi banakekele izidingo zabo zezempilo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile bahlale beqaphela izinguquko ezithinta izinhlelo ze-GEMS, njengoba izinqubo nezimo zingashintsha. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinzuzo eziphelele, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale ubuyekeza izinqubo ezisemthethweni futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubudlelwano bakho buhlonishwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nezidingo zakho nezomlingani wakho. Ngakho-ke, uma ungumsebenzisi we-GEMS, qiniseka ukuthi uqonda kahle isimo somhlomuli wakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo ezisemthethweni zifeziwe ukuze uthole izinzuzo eziphelele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izidingo zakho zezempilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi wena nomlingani wakho nithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo.
Umbiko: Ukuhlukaniswa Kwelungu Elingaphansi (GEMS Subordinate Member Classification) Isingeniso Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi, okwaziwa futhi njenge-GEMS subordinate member classification, kubalulekile ezempilweni eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezihluphekayo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali, bathola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezicini ezahlukene zokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi, izinzuzo zalo, kanye nezithiyo ezibhekene nalolu hlelo. Uhlaka lwe-GEMS I-GEMS, okuyi-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kuhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, ikakhulukazi, bangakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlukaniswa kwabantu ngokwezinga labo lempilo, izidingo zabo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izizathu zokuhlukaniswa Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kudinga izizathu ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezihluphekayo bahlupheka ngezinkinga ezahlukene, ezifana nokuntuleka kwemali, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala efanele, kanye nezinkinga zezempilo ezivamile. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abanjalo. Okwesibili, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo zisetshenziswa kahle, futhi zifinyeleleka kulabo abadinga kakhulu. Izinzuzo zokuhlukaniswa Izinzuzo zokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi ziningi. Okokuqala, lokhu kuhlukaniswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezihluphekayo bathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola ukwelashwa. Okwesibili, kuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhulu kwezidingo zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokwelapha, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahluphekayo. Izithiyo ezibhekene nohlelo Nokho, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi akukhululekile ezithiyweni. Enye yezithiyo ezinkulu yindlela yokufinyelela kulolu hlelo. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle izinqubo zokufaka izicelo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni bahlale bengekho emkhakheni wezempilo. Okwesibili, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingase zingabi zanele, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abahluphekayo ukuthola ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi kuyasebenza, kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo. Okwesibili, izinsiza ezitholakalayo kufanele zandise, ukuze abantu abahluphekayo bakwazi ukuthola ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokwelapha, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abahluphekayo. Isiphetho Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi ku-GEMS kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Noma kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nalolu hlelo, izinzuzo zalo zikhombisa ukuthi lolu hlelo lungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo kubantu abahluphekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufundisa abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nokwenza lula izinqubo zokufaka izicelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abantu abahluphekayo bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo.
Okutholakele kuphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli Isingeniso Emashumini eminyaka edlule, imiphakathi eminingi eGoli ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuphepha kwempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezibhekelela izakhiwo ezindala nezikhungathekile. Umlilo wesakhiwo esikhulu owaqhamuka eGoli, owenzeka ngoMsombuluko, uveze izinselelo eziphuthumayo ekuphathweni kwezokuphepha kwezindlu. Phakathi kophando olwenziwe ngemuva kwalesi sigameko, kwatholwa izinto eziningi ezibalulekile ezihlobene nezimbangela, izinxephezelo, nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezizothathwa ukuze kugwenywe izigameko ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo. Izimbangela zomlilo Uphenyo lunikeze ubufakazi bokuthi umlilo uqale ngenxa yokukhanya okungafanele, okwakuhambisana nezinsiza zokusebenza ezaziphukile. Ubuchwepheshe obungaphelele, ukudluliswa okungafanele kwemishini, kanye nezinga eliphansi lokuhlolwa kwezokuphepha kwaba izizathu ezidumile zokwandisa amathuba okuba nomlilo. Ukuhlolwa kwabanikazi bezakhiwo kwaphawula ukuthi kunokungahambisani nezinga elidingekayo lemigomo yokwakha, okwakwenza izakhiwo zingabi neziqondiso ezanele zokuphepha. Izimpawu zomlilo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuhlolwa komlilo kwathola ukuthi izakhiwo zikhona ezazizitholele nje kuphela ukwakhiwa, kodwa futhi zazingenayo imithetho ethile yokuzivikela. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwezimoto zomlilo, ukuphazamiseka kwezokuphepha, kanye nokungaqiniseki mayelana nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nezinhlaka ezanele zokuvikela umlilo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuphuthuma, kwaholela ekubeni abahlali bahlupheke kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Izindleko zomlilo Umlilo wesakhiwo eGoli ubangele ukulahleka okukhulu kwempahla, okuhlanganisa nezakhiwo, izimpahla, kanye nezinsiza ezibalulekile. Ukubhekelwa kokuphila kwabantu, okwakuholele ekufingqeni kwabantu abaningi, kwaba nesiphithiphithi esikhulu. Lokhu kubangele izindleko eziphezulu ezihambisana nezokwelapha, izindleko zokuhlenga, kanye nezindleko zokubuyisela impahla. Uphenyo luthole ukuthi izindleko zezimali ezitholwe ngenxa yomlilo zithinteka kakhulu emiphakathini, futhi lokhu kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokuphathwa kwezingozi. Izinqubo zokuphuthuma Lapho kwenzeka umlilo, izinhlelo zokuphuthuma zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphepheni kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinyathelo ezifanele zokuhlanza, izinhlelo zokuphuma, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Uphenyo lwafakazela ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphuma ezazikhona azizange zibe neziphumo ezihle. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudingeka izinyathelo ezinzima zokuphucula izinhlelo zokuphuthuma ukuze ziphumelelise ukuvikela impilo yabahlali. Izinyathelo zokuvikela ezizothathwa Uphenyo luphakamisa izinyathelo ezithile ezenzakalelayo ezizothathwa ukuze kuqedwe izingozi ezihlobene nomlilo wesakhiwo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuhlola izakhiwo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izakhiwo zinezinsiza zokuphepha ezanele, kanye nokuqeqesha abahlali ngezindlela zokuzivikela. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhiwo, izinhlelo zokuphuthuma, nemiphakathi kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo uma kwenzeka umlilo. Isiphetho Ukuphenya komlilo wesakhiwo eGoli kubonisa ubunzima obuhambisana nezokuphepha kwezindlu eGoli. Izimbangela, izimpawu, nezindleko zomlilo zifundisa imiphakathi ukuthi kudingeka izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezokuphepha, izinhlelo zokuphuthuma, nemiphakathi kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlilo awuqhubeki ngokuphindaphindiwe. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila ezindaweni eziphephile, futhi izakhiwo zitholakala kahle, ziqinile, nezingeyona ingozi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi, abanikazi bezakhiwo, nezinsizakalo zokuphepha zibe neziqondiso ezinamandla ukuze bazigcine bezilungiselela izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuzokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphepha kwempilo emiphakathini, kunciphise izingozi zomlilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi isivuno somphakathi sikhula ngokukhula okungapheli.
USuku lwaBasha luka-1976: Q&A Umbuzo 1: Yini uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976?
