Impendulo: USuku lwaBasha luka-1976, olukhunjulwa ngomhla wesishiyagalombili kuNhlangulana, liyinsuku ebalulekile emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Le nsuku ibaluleka kakhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu abasha, njengoba ibonisa umkhankaso wokulwa namalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi abantu baseNyakatho Afrika, okubalwa kubo abafundi, abaqhubela phambili umkhankaso wezokufunda. --- Umbuzo 2: Kwakuyini ukukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha? Impendulo: Ukuze siqonde ukubaluleka kwalesi sikhathi, kufanele sibuye emuva esikhathini som apartheid, lapho abamnyama bephathwa kahle kancane futhi bevinjwa amathuba amaningi. USuku lwaBasha lubonisa iSizotha sokuphikisa lokhu, kuba kwenzeka ubugebengu obuhlobene nokuhlukunyezwa kwabafundi eSoweto, lapho balwela izilimi zabo, ikakhulukazi isiZulu nesiXhosa. --- Umbuzo 3: Yini eyaholela ekuphikeleleni kwabafundi eSoweto? Impendulo: Abafundi baseSoweto bacela ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo abo, nokungabandakanyeki kwendlela okufundiswa ngayo ezikoleni. Bafuna ukuba nethuba lokufunda ngesiZulu nezilimi zabo zomdabu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni bahlangane ndawonye ngomhla wesishiyagalombili kuNhlangulana, babhacka izinsizwa ezingu-2000. Kunoma yisiphi isimo, lokho kwaholela ekuhlaselweni by amaphoyisa. --- Umbuzo 4: Kwakuyini ukuhlaselwa futhi yini emhlabeni waleso sikhathi? Impendulo: Ukuhlaselwa kwenzeka lapho amaphoyisa eqhuba izixhumano ezinzima, ebulala, ephuca, futhi ephethe abanye abafundi abaphezulu. Abafundi bama phezulu bahlaselwe zezimoto zamaRhino, kwathi abanye babaleka baphuma phansi bezama ukusindisa. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuphazamise imibhikisho yabo, kuveza ubudlova bokuqhuba kwezombangazwe. --- Umbuzo 5: Yini ethathwa njengemiphumela yalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwashintsha kakhulu kwasuka ekubhaleni kwamamilestones. Abafundi abahlaseliwe baphinde baba umgogodla wezinguquko, ekugcineni, kwasuqhamuka nezinhlelo ezilungile zezombusazwe ezandleni zabantu, ebalula ezindabeni ezingokwenyama. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSuku lwaBasha baqhubeka nokukhumbulwa, ukukhumbuza abantu ngobudlame nezinselelo ezahlaba umxhwele. --- Umbuzo 6: Ngabe uSuku lwaBasha lusafaneleka namuhla? Impendulo: Yebo, uSuku lwaBasha usagcina imiphetho yebhizinisi, ikakhulukazi ekukhulumeni ngezindaba zabafundi nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusiza ukukhumbula ngabafundi, ukukhumbula ukuhlaselwa nokuvuka kwezinsizakusebenza. Abafundi nabazali bahlala bethembekile ekwenzeni ukuthi kuhlonishwe amalungelo abantu bonke, ukuze bephile impilo engcono. --- Umbuzo 7: Ubani ofanele ukuhlela usuku lokukhumbula? Impendulo: Lima, izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, nezinhlangano ezahlukahlukene zihlala zihamba phambili ekukhiqizeni izinhlelo zokukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha. Lokhu, okuhlanganyela izinsiza, ukusakaza ulwazi kulandela izinyathelo zomphakathi, wonke umuntu kufanele abambe iqhaza elswekile emiphakathini kudala ibhizinisi lokufundisa. --- Umbuzo 8: Umphakathi ungasebenza kanjani ukuze uqhubeke nokukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungasebenza ngezindlela eziningi, kubalwa imicimbi, imibukiso, nemiphakathi yokufundisa. Ukuze kube nezehlo eziningi ukuze ziqwashise, ababhali, othisha, kanye nabazali kufanele bahlanganyele ekunikezeni indawo yokukhumbula uSuku lwaBasha, procendlikle ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kube nezinselelo ezahlukahlukene ezingenza imiphakathi iqonde kahle kakhulu. --- Ngokufingqa, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 akusikho nje isikhathi sokukhumbula, kodwa yinsuku yokuhlola, yokufunda, nokuthola indlela yokuthola izinhlelo zempilo ezinqala. Umphakathi wonke udinga ukucabangela okwenziwayo, ukuze sithakasele zonke izintuthuko ezenzekile.
Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile (GEMS dependent information confidentiality) Ngaphansi kwelanga elikhanyayo, kumadokhumenti ahlanzekile, kudubula indaba yesiZulu ethinta umphakathi wethu. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile, noma i-GEMS dependent information confidentiality, luhlobo lwezinto ezibalulekile eziphathelene nokuvikela ulwazi lomuntu. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kwezimfihlo kubalulekile, hhayi kuphela emhlabeni wezokwelapha, kodwa futhi nasezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, kudingeka ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ulwazi lwabancikile, njengokutholakala kweziguli noma ubudlelwano bazo nemindeni yazo, lungaba yinhlekelele uma lungavikelwe kahle. Njengoba sikhuluma ngale ndaba, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi udaba lwabancikile akukhona nje kuphela kumalungelo abantu, kodwa futhi kumthethosisekelo wethu. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile zikhona ezikhungweni eziningi, ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zokwelapha, nezikhungo zezimali. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi udinga ukuqonda ukuthi idokhumenti ethile ingalahlwa ngobuchwepheshe, kepha izimfihlo zayo kumele zihlale zihlala ziphephile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo eziphakeme zokuvikela ulwazi, ezinjengokufaka izinhlelo zokuphepha, ukuhlola amaqembu angaphakathi, kanye nokugcina izimfihlo zomuntu siqu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa emakethe mayelana ne-GEMS dependent information confidentiality kubalulekile, ukuze wonke umuntu aqonde ukuthi kungani lesi sikhathi sokugcina ulwazi lwabancikile kubalulekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu basebenzise izinqubo ezivumelekile zokubika noma yokubamba ulwazi, ukuze bazivikele ezinkingeni ezingase zivelwe uma ulwazi luphuma ngaphandle. Ubuqotho bokuphatha ulwazi lwabancikile kuphakathi kokuphila kwethu kwezemfundo, umsebenzi, kanye nezinye izindawo zempilo. Abantu badinga ukuba nomuzwa wokuthi bayavikelwa, futhi lokhu kudinga ukwethembeka kwabaphathi balolu lwazi. Ukungathembeki kungaholela ekuphumeni kolwazi, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, ezihlobene nokulahleka kokwaziswa, ukusola, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Njengoba siqhubeka phambili, kubalulekile ukuhlonipha izinqubo ezikhona zokuvikela ulwazi lwabancikile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqwashisa abaqashwa, ukunikeza izifundo ezivamile ezikhuluma ngale ndaba, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana ukuze bonke abathintekayo bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezithinta ubumfihlo. Umphakathi kumele unakekele ubumfihlo balabo abakha izinsiza zempilo, ngoba njengoba sisondela kakhudlwana ezinsukwini ezinzima, kumqoka ukugcina ubudlelwano besithakazelo. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buhumusha futhi bukhombisa indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi sihlanganisa izimfanelo ezinjengokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sihlose ukuvikela lokhu kubalulekile, ukuze siqinisekise ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho wonke umuntu evele ethe kwazulu, elinokuthula nempilo ezingqondweni zabo. Ekugcineni, ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile akukhona nje ukuphepha, kodwa kuyisibonakaliso sokuhlonipha abantu nabantu. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi bawavikela kahle. Ubuqotho bethu njengomphakathi bukhombisa indlela esizobhekelela ngayo lezi zinkinga, futhi lesi sikhathi sokuhlola sisikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuvikela ulwazi lwabanye. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sizilungiselele, sizithathele izinyathelo ezidingekayo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buhlala bukhona, buphephile, futhi bukhombisa isiko lethu lokuhlonipha. Kukhona okukhulu okukhona phambi kwethu, futhi sizobhekana nakho ngokubambisana, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, nonobuhlakani.
Imishado Yesintu: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Nezinguquko Zamanje Imishado yesintu iyinsika ebalulekile ezimpilweni zomphakathi wethu. Izenzo zokuhlangana, ukuzwana, nokuhlonipha izithethe zethu zikhombisa ukwazisa kwethu isiko nezindlela zokuphila. Noma kunjalo, kube nokukhathazeka okukhulayo ngezinguquko eziningi ezithinta le mikhuba, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izinkolelo ezidala kanye nezindlela ezisha zokuphila. Kukho abanye abakholelwa ukuthi imishado yesintu kufanele igcinwe njengoba kube, kanti abanye bapha ithuba izinguquko ukuze zihambisane nezimfuno zamanje. Ukubaluleka kwemishado yesintu kuqala lapho ithinta imindeni, ubuhlobo, kanye nemikhuba esiyicabangayo. Kulokhu, imishado ingumcimbi wobumbano phakathi kwemindeni emibili. Umndeni obhalela umshado ubamba indlela yokuhlonipha nobunye ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizukulwane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imishado yesintu akugcini nje ngokuhlanganisa abashadikazi; iyisikhumbuzo sempilo yomphakathi lapho abanye behlangana futhi bezwakalisa uthando lwabo, imizwa yabo, kanye nezifiso zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imishado yesintu ibhalisa namasiko nezinkolelo ezincike kumagugu omdabu. Lezi zikhumbuzo zikhombisa indlela yokuphila nendlela esikubheka ngayo ubudlelwane. Iphinde ibe yisikhumbuzo somlando, lapho imishado ibongwa ngezindlela ezahlukene ezihambisana namasiko. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nezinsiza zempilo, eziqinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokuphila zabantu zihlala zikhanya. Ukuze imishado yesintu iqhubeke, ibalulekile ukufaka abasha, ukuxhumana nezikhumbuzo zedlule, kanye nokwakha inhlonipho. Nokho, kulezi zinsuku, kubonakala sengathi imishado yesintu ibhekene nezinguquko eziningi. Abakholwa ezinkolelweni ezidala baphikisana nezindlela ezibe jikelele, ngesikhathi abanye benza izinqumo ezintsha ezineziyalezo. Lokhu kudala impikiswano phakathi kwalabo abavumelana nezinguquko nasekuphikisaneni nabaphikisana nokuthi imishado yesintu should be upheld without alteration. Abaningi baveza ukuthi izinguquko zandisa ukukhululeka, inhlangano, kanye nezindlela ezingafiyo zokuphila, njengoba kuxoxwa ngempumelelo emiphakathini ethile. Ngokwezinye izimo, imishado yesintu iyathokozisa, ikakhulukazi uma ibhekwa njengomfanekiso wobunye phakathi kwamaZulu. Izincomo zamasiko ezikhalela abashadikazi ukusho izivumelwano, izinkanyezi, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni. Lokhu kudala ubumbano obujabulisayo, nokunikeza ubuhlobo obujulile phakathi kwalezi zimbungu. Kodwa-ke, akushiyo ukuthi izinguquko azihambisani nezifiso zomphakathi. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi imishado yesintu imikhuba ethile idinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zamanje. Lokhu kubangela ukuba imishado yesintu ivuselelwe, yaziwe, futhi ibhekelele izindawo ezintsha, ezinjengezemfundo, ukungabi nankinga, kanye nomphakathi ozimele. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nalowo ofuna umshado abheke izidingo ezinkulu ezifanele, ngaphandle kokudambisa ubuhlobo obusemoyeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, indlela yokuphila yesimanje nayo ibalulekile. Ukuze imishado yesintu ibe nenhlalakahle, kufanele ibhekelele izimo zemihla ngemihla. Ngaphandle kokuba nemishado yesintu emangalisayo, abashadikazi bayafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abazali, abanye abazali, kanye nabangane bazo bonke baphakathi komcimbi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni amakhono kanye nezinzuzo ezazivame ukungatholakali kumashadi wendabuko sibe seziwusizo. Naphezu kwezinguquko ezivela ezimweni, imishado yesintu ihlale ibalulekile empilweni. Kumele kube nekhono lokuhlanganisa amasiko nezinkolelo, ukuze sikwazi ukuvuma izinguquko ezenzakalayo. Imishado ingaba yindlela yokuhlonipha izisekelo zempilo yomphakathi, yohlanganisa zonke izimfundiso, futhi iza nophenyo olusha. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta umshado. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukusho izifsidelwano zempilo, sikhulume ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, kube yinkulumo ephumelele, futhi siwuphephe umkhuba wethu, ukuze sibe kanjani obhadlayo. Ekugcineni, imishado yesintu iyinsika ebalulekile yomphakathi. Nokho, izinguquko zithinta lesi siko. Ukuphikisana nemvelo nokuhlonipha izinqubo zempilo yindima ebalulekile yokuletha impumelelo, ezogxila ekwethuleni ubudlelwano obunothile, ukuzwana, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zenzakalo zisinikeze izimfundiso, izinsiza, kanye nokuqinisa izinyathelo zempilo kanye nezimo zomkhiqizo. Ubulungiswa kule ndlela yokuphila bukhombisa indlela engafani nezikhalazo zamasiko, ukuze sikhumbule emisha, abahola, nokwakhe izambozelo ezisafufusa.
Ngiyavuma ngesikhathi sokuhlangana kwesithathu sokwahlulela, esilandelayo esedlule, ukuze ngikhulume ngesimo sezwe, ngifisa ukuhamba phambili ngiyifisela amalungu ahloniphekile ePhalamende unyaka omusha ojabulisayo nowempumelelo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi unyaka ka-2008 uzoba yisikhathi esibalulekile kuhulumeni wethu wezenhlalo uma sisebenza ndawonye ukuze sifinyelele amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngiyasho lokhu ngoba, ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwethu, akuvamile ukuthi izwe libizwe ukuba lidlule emizamweni emikhulu ukuze kufezwe amaphupho abantu. Umlando usibeke kulolu suku. Ngikhuluma kini namuhla, Nkosikazi uMthethwa, phambi kukamama wami ongithumele, uEpainette Mbeki, uMaMofokeng, okhona lapha nomyalezo ocacile wabantu basemaphandleni eTranskei abahlala khona iminyaka eminingi. Uthi laba bantu bafuna ukuthi sikhulume nabo njengabaholi babo ukuthi ngabe sizimisele yini ukwenza ikusasa libe ngcono kunanamuhla. Ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalombili ezedlule, ngomhla kaFebhuwari 16, umama wami uzogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-92. Iph gift kuphela esingamnika ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa yiqiniso. Ngiyabonga kuye ngokunginika ithuba lokuba nani namuhla, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi ngeke simdumele. Ngifuna ukuthatha leli thuba ukuze ngibingelele uMongameli uNelson Mandela, omunye wabakhi abavelele bohulumeni bethu wezenhlalo ozogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-90 ngomhla kaJulayi 18 kulo nyaka. Namuhla samukela uMnu. Arthur Margeman orepresenta abavikeli bekhulu ababe khona ngesikhathi izinqola zethulwa e-Alexandra eminyakeni engama-50 edlule, futhi uNelson Mandela naye wayekhona kulolo mcimbi. Sibusisiwe ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uNkk. Jann Turner, indodakazi kaRick Turner owabulawa ngababambiqhaza bohulumeni be-apartheid eminyakeni engama-30 edlule. Siyajabula kakhulu ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMnu. Dinilesizwe Sobukwe, indodana yeqhawe elalilwela izwe lethu, uRobert Sobukwe, owashiya thina eminyakeni engama-30 edlule ngemuva kokubekelwa icala lokuhlala ejele iminyaka eminingi, ebanjwa, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zokucindezelwa. Sikhumbula abasunguli be-United Democratic Front, abanye babo sibhiyozela phakathi kwethu. Bonke laba bahloniphekile bamele inkumbulo nethemba, futhi ukuhamba kwabo kusikhumbuza ukuthi umsebenzi wethu ufana nomjaho wokudlulisela phambili amaphupho okuphila kahle kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngempela, laba baqhawe bamele ukukhumbuza ngesithakazelo esingaguquki sabantu bethu futhi basinika inselelo yokuziphatha ngendlela engaphuli noma engabazi amaphupho abantu bethu. Sesisondele ekuqaleni konyaka wezezimali wokugcina weseshini yesithathu yePhalamende kuhulumeni wezenhlalo, ngemuva kwalokho sizohamba siye emavotelweni kazwelonke wesine. Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima ayidlalile mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi senze intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni izithembiso esazenzile kubantu ngo-2004. Nokho, kubonakala ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi osele. Njengoba sesisondele ekupheleni kwesikhathi esinikeziwe, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokubeka phambili Imisebenzi Ebalulekile okufanele yenziwe, ehlelwe ngokubaluleka, okuzoholelwa emizamweni yohulumeni, ukuze kufezwe izinhloso abantu abakulindele kuhurumeni. Ngiyabonga ngoba isimo sezwe sikhulume ngithole ithuba lokubika ePhalamende nasezweni ngalezi zenzakalo eziyi-24 ezihlelwe ukuze ziphumelele ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifakwe kuwebhusayithi kaHulumeni ngesonto elizayo. Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile okufanele zenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zisho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezingeni lesizwe, ezasezindaweni, nakwezokuphatha, ziqinisekisiwe ukuthi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele, zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Zonke izinhlelo zohulumeni ziqinisekisiwe ukuthi emhlabeni ozayo zizozama ukuhlinzeka kuzo zonke izindawo ukuze zifeze imiphumela elindelekile - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma nge-Inqubo Engajwayelekile, asisho ukuthi izinqubomgomo zohulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sisho isivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, amandla nokusebenza okuzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphila kwabantu kuthuthuka ngokushesha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka, sithathe izinyathelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umgomo oholela ekusetshenzisweni kwemali minyaka yonke, ozokhishwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ngaphambi kokuphela kwale nyanga, usivumela ukuthi sifeze lezi zenzakalo okufanele zenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye. Sizokwandisa ukuvumelanisa nezindawo ezibalulekile ngokubambisana namanye amazwe, sigxile ezindabeni zase-Afrika nasemibhalweni neNingizimu. Isimo esibhekene naso nomsebenzi esizibophezele ukuba siwenzile sidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlangane njengomunye ukuze sifeze zonke izabelo ezidingekayo, singakukhohlwa ukuthi sonke siphethe ikusasa lethu ezandleni zethu! Njengoba sonke sisebenza ndawonye lapha ezweni lethu, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene - ne-Inqubo Engajwayelekile! Ngesikhathi ngilungiselela le nkulumo, omunye wethu wakhuluma kimi ngombono wokuthi izwe lethu liphakathi komoya onamandla okwenza kube nzima ukubona ukuthi izwe lethu lizoba kuphi kusasa. Uthe namuhla ekuseni, njengoba ngibhekene nezinselelo esinazo, ngikhumbule amagama adumile kaCharles Dickens aqala incwadi yakhe ethi A Tale of Two Cities. "Kwake kwaba yizikhathi ezinhle, kwake kwaba yizikhathi ezimbi, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlakanipha, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokuphuthuma, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokukholwa, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokungakholwa, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokukhanya, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokumnyama, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokwethemba, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokudabuka, sasinakho konke phambi kwethu, sonke sasiya phezulu, sonke sasiya phansi - ngokufingqa, lesi sikhathi sasiwufana kakhulu nesikhathi samanje, ukuthi abanye babaphathi bayo bephakamisa ukuthi kufanele yamukelwe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuhle noma kubi, ngendlela ephezulu yokuhlola kuphela." Ungase ubuze ukuthi ngiyavuma yini ngalolu hlobo, futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi sikhona ngesikhathi sokuphazamiseka lapho sonke singalahleka ebunzimeni bezinyathelo zethu, izinyawo zethu zingaphazamiseka, sikhathazekile ngekusasa lethu! Impendulo yami yebo! Njengohulumeni, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi isisekelo esakhiwe eminyakeni eyi-14 edlule siqinile. Kumele siqhubeke nokusebenza kulolu sizo ukuze siqhubeke phambili futhi siqedele amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Nokho, kumele sonke sikhuthaze ukuba sihlale endle
Ingxoxo Nababambiqhaza Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni Isingeniso Namuhla, sizobe sikhuluma nabathengisi basemgwaqeni, abantu ababalulekile emiphakathini yethu, kodwa abavame ukungabhekwa kahle. Njengoba sithola ithuba lokubakhuluma, sizobona ukuthi le mikhakha ibaluleke kangakanani ekwakheni umnotho wendawo, nokuthi baphila kanjani ezinsukwini zabo zansuku zonke. Uhlanga Lwokuqala: Izinjongo Zokuthengisa Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukuqala ngokuqonda ukuthi kungani abantu beqala ukuhweba emgwaqeni. Ngizokhuluma noMnumzane Thabo, umthengisi ophumelelayo ophila eThekwini. UThabo uthi: “Ngangithanda ukudla, ngafunda ukwenza izitsha ezihlukene. Ngiphuma emsebenzini, ngathola ukuthi ngithanda ukuhweba, ngakho ngavula imakethe yami emgwaqeni.” Lapho ebuzwa ngokuqhubeka kokuhweba, uThabo uthe: “Kumangalisayo! Ngithola imali yokuphila, futhi ngiyakwazi ukusiza umndeni wami.” Lokhu kufakazela ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bayakwazi ukusiza umndeni wabo nangaphandle kwemisebenzi esemthethweni. Uhlanga Lwesibili: Izinselelo Abahlangabezana nazo Naphezu kokuphumelela, abathengisi basemgwaqeni babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ngikhuluma noNkk. Zanele, ongumama ophuza amanzi emgwaqeni. Uthe: “Sihlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma kuhlangene nezinsuku zokusebenza. Abaphathi bezinhlaka zomthetho bavame ukusiphazamisela.” UZanele ubonisa ukudabuka, esho ukuthi: “Abanye bethu bahlala bezama ukwenza kahle, kodwa izikweletu zikhula, futhi abathengi abaphindeli.” Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba bephumelela, banenkinga yokuphila, futhi lokho kubangela umuzwa wokukhathazeka. Uhlanga Lwesithathu: Ubuhlobo Nezindawo Zokuthengisa Abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangabantu abangenakuhlonishwa kakhulu emiphakathini. UThabo uthe: “Siyazama ukuhamba kahle nabathengi bethu. Sifuna ukuba nebhizinisi elihle, ngakho sihlonipha izindawo.” Ngokubambisana, uNkk. Zanele uthe: “Kubalulekile ukuba sibambisane nomphakathi. Sinezinsuku lapho sithengisa khona, futhi sinethemba lokuthi sizokwazi ukuvikela izindawo zethu.” Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, ngokuhlanganyela, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangaba nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Uhlanga Lokugcina: Uhlanga Lwamathuba Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengisi basemgwaqeni baveza amathuba amaningi. UThabo uthe: “Ngokuthi ngikhona emgwaqeni, ngikhuluma nezakhamuzi, ngithola iziphakamiso ezilungile. Lokhu kungivulela amathuba okwandisa ibhizinisi lami.” UZanele ubona ukuthi abantu bayafuna ukuxhumana: “Ngiyabona ukuthi uma uphume emgwaqeni, uthola abantu abaningi! Kukhona labo abangithanda kakhulu, futhi lokho kubalulekile.” Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bangenza umthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala besebenzisa amakhono abo, bephila impilo enenhlonipho. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili futhi baveze amathuba empilo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba le mikhakha ingatholakali kalula, ibaluleke kakhulu emithonjeni yokuphila. Izenzo zabo zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukudlula ezitheni, futhi baqhubeke nokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ngiyabonga, uMnumzane Thabo noNkk. Zanele, ngokwabelana ngezinto ezibalulekile empilweni yenu. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlonishwa, futhi kufanele sithathe isinyathelo sokubasiza ukuze baphumelele.
Ukungezwani Phakathi Kwemiphakathi: Izimbangela Nezixazululo Ngokwezindaba ezitholakala emiphakathini ehlukene, ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi kuyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zomnotho, uk shortage of housing, kanye nezinkolelo eziphikisanayo. Lezi zinkinga zenza kube nzima ukuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, okuholela ekungaboni ngaso linye. Izimbangela Zokungezwani Okwamanje, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala kuholela ekwandeni kwezingxabano phakathi kwemiphakathi. Izindawo eziningi zihlupheka, futhi abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekuphikisaneni ngamalungelo nezinsiza, njengoba abanye abantu bezama ukuvikela izinsiza zabo, kanti abanye befuna ukufinyelela kulokho abakubona njengamalungelo abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkolelo eziphikisanayo zenza kube nzima ukuhlanganisa abantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho imiphakathi ehlukene ihlangana khona. Izinkolelo zamasiko, izinkolelo zenkolo, kanye nezinkolelo zomphakathi zenza kube nzima ukuvumelana, okukhuthaza ukungezwani. Lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima, lapho abantu bephikisana khona, kuholele ezimeni ezinzima, ezifana nezinsolo zokuhlukunyezwa. Imiphumela Yokungezwani Imiphumela yokungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi ibonakala ngezindlela eziningi, kufaka phakathi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezimali, ukwanda kwezinga lokuphila, kanye nokungabi nendawo yokuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izimpilo zomphakathi. Abantu bahlala bephikisana, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Iziphakamiso Zokwenza kube Ngcono Iziphakamiso zokwenza kube ngcono zifaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, okuzosiza abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene. Ukufundisa abantu ngamasiko ahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvumelana, kanye nokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinkolelo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Izixazululo Zokuxazulula Ukungezwani Ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlela imicimbi yokuxhumana, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona, befundisana, futhi bebonisa izinkolelo zabo. Imicimbi efana nezinsuku zomdabu, imikhosi yokuhlangana, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukwengeza, izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlanganisa izinkolelo zomphakathi zingasiza ekwakheni ukuqonda okukhulu, okukhuthaza ukuvumelana. Isiphetho Ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi kuyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa kunezixazululo eziningi ezikhona. Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ukuxhumana nokuhloniphana kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngobambiswano, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, lapho abantu bahlala bejabulisa, befundisana, futhi bebonisa izinkolelo zabo.
Ukuze kusungulwe uhlaka oluhlangene lokulawula ukudluliswa kukagesi, igesi emaphaketheni, kanye nezimboni zegesi zamalambu; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho wezeMali wezwe usunguliwe njengomthetho. Umthetho wezeMali uqukethe amalungu amathathu aphethe ngokuphelele kanye namalungu amahlanu alungiselelwe ngokwesikhashana abekwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kufanele akhethe elinye lamalungu abekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 njengomholi woMthetho wezeMali. UNgqongqoshe kufanele abeke elinye lamalungu aphethe ngokuphelele ukuze abhekane ngqo nokulawula ugesi, elinye lokulawula igesi, kanti elinye lokulawula amaphakethe. Uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe nganoma yisiphi isizathu, amalungu amanye kufanele akhethe omunye phakathi kwabo ukuba aphathe njengomholi kuze kube umholi engakwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe noma omunye umholi abekwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angase abeke nelinye ilungu; futhi uma ilungu elingapheli noma eliphelele leMithetho yezeMali linqamuka emsebenzini nganoma yisiphi isizathu, UNgqongqoshe angase abeke omunye umuntu endaweni yabo isikhathi esingadluli ezinyangeni eziyishumi nambili ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67. Amalungu eMithetho yezeMali kufanele akhokhelwe ngomsebenzi wabo ngeziholo nezinzuzo ezithathwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. Kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezithakazelo mayelana nalolu daba. Ngendlela eqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanele phakathi kokuhlala nokwazi ukuhlela. Ilungu akufanele libe khona nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ezingxoxweni, ekwenzeni izinqumo, noma participation in any matter before the Energy Policy where the member or their spouse, partner, child, or someone they have a direct or indirect romantic relationship with is involved. Uma ilungu lithola noma likholelwa ukuthi lingase libe nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungu kufanele lishayele uNgqongqoshe neMithetho yezeMali ngokubhalwe phansi. Uma bejolile noma behlala nomuntu impilo yabo yonke othola noma okholelwa ukuthi ungase ube nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungu kufanele lishayele uNgqongqoshe neMithetho yezeMali ngokubhalwe phansi. Ngaphambi kokubeka ilungu leMithetho yezeMali, uNgqongqoshe kufanele, ngokuqaphela kwiGazethi, acela ukuthi abangu-ukhuluma bakhethwe phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Isaziso esishicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi le mthetho uqale, sicela ukukhethwa kwabantu bokuqala abazakhethwa kuMthetho wezeMali, kufanele sithathwe njengokushicilelwe ngempela ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7. Lokhu kuphula isivumelwano sokwenza umsebenzi ngaphansi kwale mthetho noma iGas Act noma iPipeline Act yokukhanyisa; noma kukhishwa njengelungu ngenxa yanoma yisiphi sezizathu ezikhuluma esigabeni 6 1. UNgqongqoshe angase aqede ukugunyazwa kwelungu leMithetho yezeMali uma lelo lungu liphatha ngendlela ephikisana nemigomo yesigaba 9. Imihlangano yeMithetho yezeMali a IMithetho yezeMali kufanele ihlangane ngezikhathi nezindawo ezinqunywe ngumholi. b Umholi uzobiza imihlangano yeMithetho yezeMali njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe kahle imisebenzi yayo. Umholi, uma ethole isicelo esibhaliwe kusuka kumphathi ophakeme noma kumalungu amabili, uzobiza umhlangano okhethekile ozobanjwa phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili zokuthola isicelo esinjalo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ezinye izinqubo zisetshenziswe, umholi wanoma yimuphi umhlangano weMithetho yezeMali kufanele aphakamise izinqubo ezizolandela kulezi zinhlelo. I-quorum yomhlangano weMithetho yezeMali ibandakanya iningi lamalungu akhona noma amalungu amane, noma yikuphi okukhulu. a Isinqumo seningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni simele isinqumo seMithetho yezeMali. b Uma ukuvota kuhlangana kunoma yisiphi isihloko, umuntu ophatha umhlangano unelungelo lokuvota okungeziwe ngaphezu kwesikhala sokuvota. Akukho isinqumo esenziwe yiMithetho yezeMali esizoba sephukile ngenxa yokuba khona kwesikhala kuMithetho yezeMali noma ngoba omunye umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala njengelungu ubekhona njengelungu ngesikhathi isinqumo sithathwa uma wonke amalungu amanye abekhona emhlanganweni futhi enelungelo lokuhlala njengamalungu emhlanganweni, ngaleyo ndlela kwakha i-quorum nesinqumo sathathwa ngeningi lamalungu akhona futhi enelungelo lokuvota. Umphathi ophakeme noma, uma engasekho, umqashi weMithetho yezeMali obekwe ngumphathi ophakeme, kufanele abekhona emihlanganweni yonke yeMithetho yezeMali futhi kufanele abe nelungelo lokukhuluma kodwa angavoti kulezi zinhlelo. a Noma yimuphi umhlangano weMithetho yezeMali kufanele uvumele umphakathi ukuba ube khona ngaphandle uma umhlangano uthatha isinqumo sokuthi isihloko esizoxoxwa siyi-confidential, noma ulwazi oluthintekayo mayelana nokubambisana, lapho-ke umuntu othintekayo kufanele azise iMithetho yezeMali ukuthi ulwazi olunjalo akufanele luthulwe emphakathini. b Uma iMithetho yezeMali ithatha isinqumo nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle komhlangano osemthethweni, leso sinqumo sithatha umthelela ngokushesha kodwa kufanele sibhale, sigcwaliswe ngeningi lamalungu, futhi sikhonjiswe ukuze siqinisekiswe emhlanganweni wokuqala osemthethweni weMithetho yezeMali kulandela isinqumo. c IMithetho yezeMali kufanele ibe nesizathu sokugcina amarekhodi wezenzo zayo zonke. I-Gas Act; kanye ne iii Akukho Pipeline Act yokukhanyisa. e abavunyelwe ukufinyelela noma ukuhoxa ekuvoteni noma ekuxoxeni nganoma yisiphi isihloko esiphakanyisiwe phambi kweMithetho yezeMali abanentshisekelo ngqo noma engatheni; futhi f ukwenza njengoba kudingeka futhi kulindeleke kubabusi bezikhungo zomphakathi. t ngokubhalwe phansi; futhi g ngokuchaza ngokusobala ukuze kusekelwe uMthetho nezimpikiswano nezizathu zalokho. Noma iMthetho weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 ungumthetho. Manje, uMphathi-Jikelele woMnyango weMvula neZinkuni, njengomholi wehhovisi lolwazi kulo Mnyango, ukhishile incwadi yolwazi yomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kolwazi oluphethwe lo Mnyango njengoba kudingwa isigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi. Le ncwadi iyincwadi yoMnyango weMvula neZinkuni ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000 (UMthetho 2 ka-2000) [lo Mthetho]. Incazelo yesimo soMnyango nemisebenzi yawo. UMnyango, umholi wehhovisi lolwazi, kanye nazo zonke izinsizakusebenza zawo. Ulwazi olunembile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi oluphethwe loMnyango. Isaziso sakamuva ngokwesigaba 15 soMthetho, esiqukethe lonke ulwazi, oluphethwe loMnyango futhi olutholakala kalula kubo bonke ngaphandle kwesidingo sokufaka isicelo kuMnyango. Incazelo yezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo emphakathini nendlela lezi zinsizakalo ezitholakala ngayo. Ukulandela izinqubomgomo ezihlosiwe zokunciphisa isidingo semvula, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukonga amanzi ngokuphatha isidingo sayo. Ukukhuthaza ukusabalalisa okufanele, ukusetshenziswa okwenziwayo, kanye nokuphathwa okunempilo kwezinsiza zamanzi nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhangayo. Izinsizakalo Zamanzi a Ukungenelela ngokuthatha izinyathelo zokutshala imali ekuhlinzekeni ngensizakalo yokuletha amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nokuthutha udoti kulezi zindawo ezazingenayo le nsizakalo b Ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kohlelo lwezinsizakalo zamanzi oluphethwe loMnyango ukuze kwabelwane ngesisekelo sezinsizakalo zamanzi c Ukuphatha nokuhola izenzo zamabhodi amanzi d Ukuxhasa iziphathimandla zendawo ekuqaleni kwenqubo yokuthatha umthwalo wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, nokuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zamanzi e Ukusungula nokwandisa ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zamanzi nezinsizakalo zolwazi f Ukuhlola indlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuthutha udoti ngenhloso yokufeza ukuhlala, ukwaneliseka, ukungabizi kwezinsizakalo, nokuphakamisa umkhankaso wezwe wokuhlaziya inqubekela phambili ethambile yezinsizakalo zokuthutha udoti g Ukusungula uMnyango njengomthuthukisi wenqubomgomo yezinsizakalo zamanzi, isisekelo sokuxhaswa, ukuphathwa, nokulethwa. Ngokwesigaba soMthetho, uMphathi-Jikelele ungumholi wehhovisi lolwazi lwe-DWAF. U-Mphathi-Jikelele, ngokwesigaba soMthetho, unikeze amandla nemisebenzi kubasizi behhovisi lolwazi ukuze kuthuthukiswe lo Mthetho Wokufinyelela Kolwazi. Amagama abo nemininingwane yokuxhumana ibhalwe etafuleni elingezansi. Umphakathi oPhakathi: Imininingwane Yokuphathwa Kwezinsizakalo Zolwazi. Ngokwesigaba 1 sesigaba 10 soMthetho, uMkomishana Wezamalungelo Abantu kufanele, ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-18 ngemuva kokuqala kwalesi sigaba, akhiqize idokhumenti equkethe le mininingwane ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni, ngendlela elula nephumelelayo, njengoba kungadingeka ngumuntu ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yiliphi ilungelo elinikezwe ngalo Mthetho. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele futhi achaze ukuthi ngabe ufuna ikhophi ephrintiwe yedokhumenti eqoshiwe noma ufuna ukuza ukuyibona edokhumenti eqoshiwe ehhovisi lomphakathi. Noma uma idokhumenti eqoshiwe ingeyona incwadi, ingabukwa ngendlela edingekayo, lapho isigaba 292 singase sisebenze. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela ngendlela ethile, umfaki-sicelo kufanele anikezwe ukufinyelela ngendlela efunwayo, ngaphandle kokuthi lokho kuzophazamisa ngokungafanele ukusebenza kwehhovisi elithintekayo, noma kulimaze idokhumenti eqoshiwe, noma kuvinjeze ukusatshalaliswa kwedokhumenti engemthethweni. Uma ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngendlela efunwayo ngenxa yezizathu ezilungile kodwa kunganikezwa ngenye indlela, imali kufanele ibalwe ngendlela umfaki-sicelo afuna ukufinyelela esigabeni 29 cha. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngenye indlela, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kufanele kuboniswe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi ngombono womunye umuntu, izimo lapho isicelo senziwa kufanele zicaciswe esigabeni 18 2f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma unezithiyo, bangafaka isicelo sokuphendula ngolimi olukhuluma. Umphakathi oPhakathi weHhovisi Lolwazi kufanele aqedele ifomu lomfaki-sicelo futhi anikeze ikhophi kubo ngokwesigaba 18 3. Usizi loMphathi weHhovisi Lolwazi kufanele lukhumbuze umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwabafaki-sicelo abazimele) ngezidingo zokukhokha imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuphumelela kwesicelo. Imali yesicelo ethathwa yihhovisi lomphakathi ingama-R35. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka ukukhala ngaphakathi, lapho kufanelekile, noma afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze aphikise isiphakamiso noma akhokhe imali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi Usizi loMphathi weHhovisi Lolwazi lwenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kufanele waziswe ngalesi sinqumo ngendlela umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngayo. Uma isicelo samukelwa, imali yokufinyelela kufanele ikhokhwe ukuze kuhlolwe, kulungiswe, futhi kukhiqizwe, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esedlula amahora abekwe ukuze kuhlolwe nokulungiselela idokhumenti eqoshiwe ukuze ikhululwe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimiso zoMthetho ophathwe loMnyango ziyagcinwa, ngokulandela nokuqoqwa kolwazi. Ukukhala kungafakwa kuNgqongqoshe weMvula neZinkuni. Isicelo senkantolo singafakwa ngemuva kokuthi ihhovisi elinganeliseki lidlule zonke izinqubo zokukhala ngaphakathi, kodwa akukho okwenziwayo mayelana nokukhala kwalo. Ngokwazi kwethu, ulwazi okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 14 (i) asikakafiki kuNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Le ncwadi izobuyekezwa futhi iphumelele minyaka yonke ukuze ibike umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingase zenzeke ku-DWAF. Izinqubo ezilandelwayo ukuze kwenziwe le ncwadi itholakale zizogcinwa ekuhloleni le ncwadi. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ixhumene kakhulu nemisebenzi yezinye izigaba, uNgqongqoshe, uma efisa noma ngokwakhe, angacela lezi zigaba ukuthi zikhulume incwadi eyodwa. I-DWAF kanye nezinye izigaba ezimbili noma ngaphezulu kufanele zabelane ngezindleko zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyenza itholakale njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakuthola. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ingahlangene nanoma iyiphi isigaba yomphakathi, zonke izindleko ezithintekayo zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyenza itholakale zizokwenziwa yi-DWAF. UNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo angakhulula i-DWAF ekunikezeni ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 soMthetho, nganoma yisiphi isizathu sokuvikela, ukuphathwa, noma kwezezimali uma becabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukwenza kanjalo. Ngiyanemukela, ngiyabonga ngokungithinta ngalolu daba olubalulekile. Namuhla sikhuluma ngempesheni, ikakhulukazi mayelana nemibhalo ye-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kanye nesimo sempesheni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma ucabanga ngempilo yakho yesikhathi esizayo. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impesheni iyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu. I-GEMS iyinhlangano ethuthukisa izinsiza zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unempesheni efanele uma usuhamba emuva emsebenzini. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi uqonde kahle ukuthi yimaphi imibhalo edingekayo ukuze uqinisekise isimo sakho sempesheni. Uma sikhuluma ngemibhalo yesimo sempesheni, okokuqala, kudingeka uqinisekise ukuthi unayo yonke imibhalo edingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amafomu akho okungena, izincwadi zokugunyazwa, kanye nemininingwane yokugcina yokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi le mibhalo ibhalwe kahle, futhi ayinaphutha. Uhlanga olungaphelele lungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu uma kufika isikhathi sokuhola impesheni. Ngemuva kwalokho, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyayithola imihlahlandlela ethile ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda izinqubo zokufaka izicelo, izidingo zokuhola, kanye nezinsuku ezithile zokuhola. I-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uqonde ukuthi imaphi amalungelo akho. Uma ungazi kahle, ungase uvule iminyango yokungaqondi kahle, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Kukhona futhi izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze usize abantu abafuna ukuqonda kahle isimo sempesheni yabo. Ungaxhumana nabameli be-GEMS, noma ungavakashela kwiwebhusayithi yabo ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhipha imibuzo yakho, futhi uqonde kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi impesheni yakho ihamba kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale uvuselela imininingwane yakho. Uma kwenzeka ushintsha umsebenzi, noma uthola izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yakho, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinguquko zifakwe kumarekhodi akho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela impesheni yakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ungase ube nezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene nemibhalo yakho. Lokhu kungaba ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwezinqubo, noma ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi ungazidela uma uthola izinkinga. Xhumana nabameli be-GEMS, bese ubacela usizo. Bazi kahle ukuthi izinkinga zingavela, futhi bazokwazi ukukusiza ukuthi uzixazulule. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ungase uthole ukuthi isimo sempesheni yakho sishintsha. Lokhu kungaholela ezinqumweni ezinzima, kodwa kufanele uqonde ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziwusizo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale ubheka izinguquko ezithile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi impesheni yakho ihamba kahle. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi uqonde ukuthi isimo sempesheni sikhona ukuze sikusize. I-GEMS iyinhlangano ehlose ukusiza abasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kufanele uyisebenzise kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi yimaphi amalungelo akho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyawasebenzisa. Ngakho-ke, uma unombuzo noma udinga usizo, ungathandabuzi ukufuna usizo. I-GEMS ikhona ukuze ikusize, futhi ungavuma ukusiza. Impesheni yakho ibalulekile, futhi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi iyahamba kahle. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela ngalolu daba, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumibhalo yesimo sempesheni yakho. Hamba kahle, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uhamba phambili.
Ubulili: Uzimiso Lwenkululeko: Ubhubhane lwezinkumbulo neziqubulo zika-2023 Umgwaqo omuhle, izinsuku ezimnandi kanye nomoya opholile ungenisa usuku lokukhumbula nokuhlonipha - uSuku lweNkululeko. Le njabulo ibanjwa minyaka yonke eNingizimu Afrika, ihlonishwa ngokuhlanganyela kwababebandayo, ovavanaphaneli, and abavoti abanolwazi, bonke behlale behlonipha izimpumelelo ezinkulu zenkululeko esiyifinyelele eminyakeni edlule. Usuku lweNkululeko lwenziwa emaphandleni nasemadolobheni, okwenza ukuba kubonakale isimo sabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Kulesi sikhathi, abantu basendaweni ehlukahlukene, bejabulile futhi behleleka, bathokozisa umoya wempumelelo kwazulu nabaphila kuloluhlu lwezizathu. Izikhumbuzo zempilo, ukwelela ezingeni eliphakeme, zisondeza imiphakathi ukuze ibambisane, ibonakale ifuna uthando nokuhlonipha kwesikhumbuzo esiyisisekelo. Umpetha wokukhumbula, umphakathi wigubha izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwe abaholi benkululeko phakathi neminyaka engama-90. Izinkumbulo ezithokozisayo, lapho umoya wokuzikhandla ubonakaliswa khona, uyakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bencintisana, beyahlala bezama ukufinyelela izigcawu ezithuthukile ezithinta izidingo zempilo, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. UZwelakhe Mbatha, ongumholi ophakathi kwezinhlelo zokuqwashisa ngezimvo zenkululeko, ukhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ngempilo yabo nokuthi bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, ukuze balondoloze isiko nemigomo emihle. Uhlelo lokugubha luqukethe imicimbi ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinkulumo zomphakathi, imicimbi yokuhlomula, kanye nezinselelo zokuwina imiklomelo emiphakathini. Uhlelo lemicimbi luhlanganisa izifundo ezithinta izifundo zenkululeko, nemihlangano ethokozisayo ezindaweni ezihlukene, edalula ubuhlakani nabantu bendawo abasidelelayo ngesiko nemigomo yolwazi. Ngalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni, izikhungo zezifundo, kanye nezifundiswa bahlanganyela ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile futhi bahloniphe izigigaba zomlando ezikhombisa indlela yimina nethemba lesizukulwane esizayo. Ngokwendlela lo mkhosi obhubhayela ngayo, ububanzi bempumelelo bulokhu bukhula, kusiza ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zokukhula kwezemfundo, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo zempilo ezihloniphekile. Izinhlelo ezikhona zenziwa ukwazisa umphakathi ngempumelelo yomhlaba wonke, kuthembisa ukuthi azoba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuliseni ubumbano phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Iziqondiso zenkululeko nezinselelo zoxhaso zempilo ziba yizinsukuzakhe, zenza umoya wokuthi onke amaqhawe azothola isikhala sokukhuluma, baveze ubuhlakani babo, bayokhombisa ukuthi bakuqonda kahle ukubaluleka kokuba nezwi elikhulu. U-Emmanuel Ndlovu, umcwaningi, uveza ukuthi lezi ziqondo ziba nomthelela omuhle ekwakheni umnotho omkhulu, ngamandla esizukulwane esisha elubambene phezulu. Linhlanga yokuphisa umoya, umoya wokukhumbula nezimiso zomphakathi uhluza izimpendulo ezimnandi. Ngokuhlanganisa abantu abanhlobonhlobo, sithola imiphumela ephusile ezweni lethu. Ziningi izindleko zamakhanda ezikhulisa amagama emiphakathi, ezinhlelweni ezithinta indaba yamalungelo abantu nokuhlonishwa. Ukhumbula ukuthi uSuku lweNkululeko luhlala luhlaza, kube khona imizamo yokwenza kube phezulu. Umphefumulo walesi sikhathi uhamba kahle kuzo zonke izimpande zomphakathi, kuqhakambisa izinkumbulo zomlando ezikhumbuza abantu ngeqhaza elibi ezimpi zempilo, ukukhimiza uNtu nokukhuthaza ukukhipha imiqondo emisha. Uhlanga olwakhayo kuzothi lwangcazela, abavoti bazophaka ubuntu, benze izinqumo ezinobuhlakani. Lokhu kuhlanganyela, ngamandla omphakathi, kuhlonishwa phakathi kwabazali nabakhokhelwayo, kuzokwenziwa ukuthula, imiqondo yokwakha izwe eliphumelelayo, okuyoqhubeka. Umgwaqo wempumelelo unzima, kodwa umoya wokujabula, ubumbano nezinqumo eziphusile kuqinisekisa ukuthi uSuku lweNkululeko ngeke lwenqabe. Yiqiniso, uNsuku material, njengoba ubuhlungu besikhathi buyavela, kuhlonishwa kahle kuso sonke isikhathi. Uhambo lwakhe luhamba phambili luhamba ngokucacile phakathi kwabanikazi bazo zonke izifunda, ikakhulu kufinyelela nezigaba ezitholakele. Ngakho, uSuku lweNkululeko wukukhumbula ukuphila, ufunde imikhuba emisha, ubumbane nomoya wesikhumbuzo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikhula ngothando, ifaneleka, futhi inenhlonipho, idlulele phambili ikhuluma ngempumelelo yezenzakalo ezenzeka emhlabeni wethu.
Umdlavuza Kwabesifazane Kwabesifazane Kwakukhanya elangeni elihle eNhlabathi, umuzi ohlanzekile ogcwele izitshalo ezimibalabala nezihlahla ezinkulu. UZanele, intokazi yasendaweni, wayehamba ethokozisa, ephakamisa imindeni emincane. Wathi, "Uthando lukhona emhlabeni, futhi nathi singaluthola." Waqhubeka ehamba, edlula emnyango wezokwelapha, lapho abesifazane abaningi beqashwe khona ukuze baphumelele ekwelapheni izifo. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uZanele wathola izimpawu ezihlukahlukene. Wazizwa enza okuthile okungajwayelekile embhodweni wakhe, okwenza wazizwa engakhululekile. Ngemuva kokuvakashela kudokotela, wathola ukuthi ubhekene nomdlavuza. Lo mzuzu washintsha impilo yakhe. UZanele waba nesibindi, kodwa ubuhlungu buvuselele imizwa yakhe. Wayefuna ukwazi nokuhlola, kodwa wayesaba. Umdlavuza kwabesifazane awukona okuncane. Wafunda ukuthi baningi abesifazane abahluphekayo, abavame ukungakhulumi ngalolu daba. Wathola ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukwazi, udinga ukuxoxa. Ngaleso sikhathi, waqala ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, okhuthazayo. Wabamba izifundo, waphuma emakhaya, wabamba izandla nabanye abesifazane abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngesinye isikhathi, uZanele wathola abanye abesifazane abafana naye, abathintekayo emlandweni wokulwa nomdlavuza. Bahlangana njalo, behlakulela izindlela zokulwa nalolu bhubhane. Imibono yabo yayiyingqayizivele, kanti ubungane babo babuphila kahle. UZanele wagcina esebenzisa imihlangano yabo ukuhlela izinhlelo zokwelashwa, ezokuxhumana, nezokweseka. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uZanele wathola ukuthi ukuba neqembu labantu abahluphekayo kwakuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi akasodwa. Waqonda ukuthi abesifazane abanenhliziyo efanayo badinga izwi, badinga indawo yokukhuluma. Ngalesi sikhathi, umoya weqiniso waze uyashintsha; abesifazane baqala ukukhuluma, bekhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, bese bephakanyiswa. Ngemuva kokulashwa, uZanele wathola ukuthi impilo iphakeme ukuwa. Umdlavuza wawungamphazamisanga, kodwa wawumkhuthaza ukuba aqonde kahle ukuthi impilo yayibalulekile. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabesifazane, ebandakanya umphakathi emisebenzini yokukhuluma, ehlanganisa wonke umuntu. Umphakathi waqala ukufunda, wawazi ukuthi umdlavuza awukona ukuwa, kodwa kuwukuphila. UZanele waqhubeka nokusebenza, edlulisela ulwazi nokuqonda kwabanye abesifazane. Kukhona umphakathi omkhulu ovukile, ungakhathaleli ubuhlungu. Umsebenzi wakhe waba yisibonelo sokuthi abesifazane bangakwazi ukuvivinya, baphumelele, bahlale bephila kahle. UZanele waba yisibonelo esihle, umoya ophilayo, okhuthaza abanye ukuba bakhuthaze futhi baqinise. Ekugcineni, uZanele wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwabesifazane akubona ubuhlungu kuphela, kodwa kuwukubona amandla okukhuluma, okuphila, nokuhlanganyela. Wathi, "Sisebenzise lesi sikhathi, sibe nezwi elikhulu, sikhulume, sizwakalise isizotha sethu." UZanele waba yinkanyezi, ekhanyisela abesifazane abaningi, ebavulela indlela yokuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wawusemkhathini ophilayo, ubuhlungu baphuma emoyeni, ubungane bukhula, futhi uthando lukhula. Umdlavuza wawungasizi, kodwa wawuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umuntu akasodwa, futhi ukunakekelwa komphakathi kuyinto ebalulekile. UZanele waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zingaba zinkulu, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa, bakhuthaze, futhi baphile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZanele wakwazi ukujula emfundweni, waphendukela kwabanye abesifazane abavela ezindaweni ezikude, waba yincwadi yempilo yabo. Wabathokozisa ngezindlela ezahlukene, wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale benempilo. Kwakuwumkhankaso omkhulu, owawuhambisana nolwazi oluqinile lokuthi umdlavuza awumelanga impilo, kodwa ubuhlungu buhlangene nobungane, uthando, nempilo. Ngokuphila kwabo, uZanele nabezinye izintokazi zaphumelela, zashintsha umhlaba, zenza umphakathi waba yindawo engcono. Umdlavuza wawungasathathi izimpilo, kodwa wawuhlonipha ubungane, uthando, nobuqotho. UZanele waba isibonelo sokuthi umuntu, uma esebenza kanye nabanye, angakwazi ukuzitholela impilo ebenza bakhumbule. Umdlavuza waba yisifundo sokuphila, waba umoya ophilayo kuZanele nabanye abesifazane. Wafundisa ukuthi, noma yiziphi izinkinga, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa, bakhulume, baphile. Lokhu kwaba yinsiza, ethokozisa, futhi evuswa. UZanele waba yindlela yokuphila, ekwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza abesifazane, ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuhlukahlukene. Ngale ndlela, impilo kaZanele yathuthuka, futhi umphakathi waba yindawo evulekile, ethokozisayo. Umdlavuza wawungasathathi izimpilo, kodwa wawuhlonipha umqondo wokubambisana, uthando, nobungane. UZanele waba umholi, owahola abanye, ebakhumbuza ukuthi impilo ingaphezu kokuphila, kodwa ingaphezu kokuxhumana, nokuba neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni.

UKWAKHA IZINDAWO ZOKUHLALA - kuhlose ukwakhiwa kwabantu ngabanye kanye nabanikazi abaziwayo balemiphakathi isaziso salokhu ngaphansi kwabaziyo balemiphakathi ngenhloso yeMasipala LU ESTOP 8 NAMIBIA: 946 futhi bangu-1500 abantu balemiphakathi, kuhloswe ukuhambisana nomthetho nakwabanye abanamalungelo asemthethweni okudla kulolu suku - ISIMEMO UKUBA ihlelwe ukuthi ihanjiswe kuMphakathi weDolobha ukuze usebenzise imithetho kazwelonke elawulayo ezindlini, kubo. Nakuba kwenziwe imizamo. IZINDAWO EZITHINTWE ZIKHULUMISANE - mayelana nezinsiza. KuMasipala amalungelo awo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezindlu, 1997, sifunda konke ukuze sithole abanye futhi iMUNICIPALITY ingakha lezi zindlu shana 40.2 yesisombululo nesigaba 2. IMunicipality imema bonke abantu abangalungiswa amalungelo abo ngalesi sikhathi sokusetshenziswa komhlaba ukuhlela kuMasipala, izincwadi zabo kufanele ziqondiswe kuMphakathi weDolobha, zifike kungakapheli uNovemba 13, 2009 (ku-elinye lamakheli alandelayo), ukuze baveze imibono yabo nganoma yini ethinta bona mayelana nale ndlela esemthethweni yokusebenzisa umhlaba.
Isingeniso INingizimu Afrika, ezweni elinamasiko nezemidlalo anothile, ibonakala njengezwa elihloniphekile emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ebholeni. Ibhola, okwaziwa njenge "football" emhlabeni jikelele, liyinsika ebalulekile yokuhlanganyela komphakathi, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuphakamisa impilo enhle. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika ahlukaniswa ngezinga lawo, izifunda, kanye namasiko ahlukene, okuveza izimpawu ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa Kwamathimba Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika akhiwe ngamakhono ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa amaqembu amakhulu njengeKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns. Lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngaphakathi kwePremier Soccer League (PSL), okuwumjaho ophakeme kakhulu ezweni, futhi anemlandvo ocebile, enezinhloso zokuphumelela ezihambisana nezifiso zomphakathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona amaqembu amancane asezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, asebenzela ukuthuthukisa umphakathi wendawo. Izimpumelelo Nezinselelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhudlwana phakathi kwamakilabhu kudala umoya ophilayo emidlalweni, kodwa kuholela nezinselelo ezifana nokuphathwa kwemali, ukushoda kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaqembu abeke izinhlelo eziqinile zokuphatha ukuze aqinisekise impumelelo ezingeni eliphezulu. Izimpawu Zamasiko Ibhola akusikho nje ukuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi kuyinsika yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika adlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umoya wokuhlanganyela, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Izinsuku zokudlala ziba yizikhathi ezibalulekile zokuhlangana, lapho abantu behlangana ukuze basekele amaqembu abo, okuvusa umoya wobumbano. Ukwakhiwa Kwezemidlalo INingizimu Afrika iyaziwa ngempumelelo yayo emkhakheni wezokwakha, okubukeka ngokwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezinkulu zokudlala, njengeFNB Stadium neMoses Mabhida Stadium. Lezi zikhungo zikhangisa izenzakalo ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa imidlalo ye-World Cup, okuveza ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elikhiqizayo emkhakheni wezokwakha. Imiphumela Yezokukhuthaza Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumakilabhu, ibhola linomthelela omuhle ekukhuthazeni impilo. Amaqembu amaningi akha izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo, ezifaka ukufundisa abantwana ngempilo enempilo, ukwakha izikhungo zokuzivocavoca, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, ahlinzeka ngempumelelo, ubudlelwano, kanye nezinsiza ezithinta impilo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamaqabane, izinhlelo zokuphatha, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo kubalulekile ukuze amaqembu akwazi ukuhamba phambili emkhakheni wezokwakha. Njengoba ibhola liqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi amaqembu aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhola lihlala lihlaza, lishisa, futhi linethemba.
Ikota: Umqondo Wokuhlala Ngaphandle Kwezithiyo Ikota, igama elikhiqiza imizwa ehlukene kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi lapho sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke. Ezweni elikhulayo, ikota iyinkomba yokuphila, imisebenzi, nezifiso zethu. Nakuba ikota ingase ibonakale ingathandeki, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele sazi ukuthi ikota ayisiyona nje indawo yokuhlala; iyisikhala sokwakha ubudlelwane. Uma sicabanga ngalezi zindawo, sikhumbula imiphakathi ehlukene, izinkolo, nezinkolelo ezahlukene. Ikota iyindlela yokuxhumana, yokubambisana, nokwakha umuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikota ibalulekile ekwakheni izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izitolo, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Njengoba isikhathi sithuthuka, ikota ibonisa izinkumbulo ezimnandi. Ngikhumbula ngesikhathi ngikhula, ikota yami yayigcwele izinsuku ezijabulisayo, lapho sabelana khona ngezikhathi ezinhle nomndeni nabangane. Lezi zikhumbuzo zikhombisa ukuthi ikota akuyona nje indawo yokuhlala, kodwa iyindawo yokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Ukukhumbula lezi zikhathi kusinika amandla okwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngezinkinga ezihambisana ne ikota. Ezinye izindawo ziye zaba nezinkinga ezinkulu, njengezinga eliphezulu lokuhlala, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokungabi nankinga, nokungahambi kahle komnotho. Nokho, lezi zinkinga zingaxazululwa uma sikhuluma ngokubambisana. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza ikota ibe yindawo engcono yokuhlala. Ikota iyindlela yokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Uma sithola isikhathi sokuhlangana, sithola ithuba lokuxoxa, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Uma singahlangani, sithola ukuthi sihlukaniswe, okungaholela ekutheni sibe nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ikota nayo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Izindawo ezithuthukile zinezinsiza eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukwakha imisebenzi, nokukhulisa umnotho. Uma ikota ithuthukiswa, abantu bathola amathuba amaningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphila okungcono, okubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ikota ingaba yindawo yokwakha ubuciko. Izindawo eziningi zinezindawo zokubukisa, izinkundla zokudlala, nezikhungo zamasiko, okwenza kube lula ukuveza ubuciko bethu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokwakha, okubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ubuciko buvuselela imizwa, bukhuthaza abantu, futhi budala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela. Ekugcineni, ikota iyindawo yokwakha ikusasa. Uma sikhuluma ngekota, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sikhuluma ngekusasa lethu. Ukuthuthukisa ikota yethu kusho ukuthi sithuthukisa ikusasa lethu. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza ikota ibe yindawo engcono yokuhlala. Ngakho-ke, ikota ayisiyona nje indawo yokuhlala; iyisikhala sokwakha ubudlelwane, izinkumbulo, nomnotho. Ngiyavuma, ikota inezinkinga, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izixazululo kuyisihluthulelo sokwenza ikota ibe yindawo engcono, lapho wonke umuntu engaba khona. Masibambisane, sithuthukise ikota yethu, futhi sakhe umphakathi onempilo, onobudlelwano obuqinile, nezinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Ikota yethu ingaba yindawo yokukhula, yokuphila, nokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Lokhu kufanele kube yinjongo yethu sonke.
Imibhalo yephakheji yabaphathi (GEMS management package documentation) Kwakukhona idolobha elincane, elalaziwa ngegama elihle lokuthi iThokoza. Leli dolobha lalihlotshiswe ngezihlahla ezinhle, izindlu ezimibalabala, kanye nabantu abahle. Kodwa, phakathi kwalezi zindawo ezinhle, kwakukhona inkinga ethile ebihamba phambili — ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMnumzane Dlamini, umphathi omkhulu, wathola ukuthi kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi. UMnumzane Dlamini wayazi ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga uhlelo oluqinile. Waqala ukucwaninga ngezinhlelo ezahlukene, futhi wathola iGEMS management package. Le phakheji yayihloselwe ukusiza abaphathi njengezinkanyezi ezikhanyisayo emkhakheni wokuphatha. Ngemva kokuhlangana nabanye abaphathi, uDlamini wathola ukuthi le phakheji iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, izinsiza, nezindlela zokuphatha eziphumelelayo. Ngemuva kokuthola le phakheji, uDlamini wahlela umhlangano nabaphathi abahlukene bezinsiza. Wabafundisa ngale phakheji, wayefuna ukuthi bonke baqonde ukuthi ingaba usizo kanjani. "Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile," kusho uDlamini. "I-GEMS izosiza ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zethu, futhi izosivumela ukuba sithole izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze siphumelele." Ngesikhathi umhlangano uqhubeka, abaphathi baqala ukucabangela izinzuzo ezihambisana neGEMS. UMaMkhize, owayengumphathi wezinsiza, waphakamisa ukuthi le phakheji izosiza ekuphatheni izinsiza ngendlela efanele. "Sizokwazi ukulandelela izinsiza zethu, siqinisekise ukuthi zisetshenziswa kahle, futhi sithole izibalo ezicacile," kusho yena. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bonke abaphathi baqonda ukuthi iGEMS iyithuluzi elibalulekile. Baphakamisa iziphakamiso ezahlukene, futhi uDlamini wathola ukuthi kudingeka ukuba bahlale bexhumene ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi le phakheji iyasetshenziswa kahle. Bahlala behlangene, bexoxa ngale phakheji, futhi baqinisekisa ukuthi bonke bayayiqonda. Kwathi lapho uDlamini esebenzisa iGEMS, waqala ukubona izinguquko ezinhle. Izinsiza zathuthukiswa, futhi ukusebenza kwaba lula. Abantu baqala ukujabula, futhi izinkampani zathola izinzuzo eziphumelelayo. Uthando lweGEMS lwakhula, futhi abantu baqala ukuyisebenzisa ezindaweni eziningi. Ngesikhathi sokuphela konyaka, uDlamini wahlela umcimbi wokubungaza impumelelo yeGEMS. Wamema bonke abaphathi, izisebenzi, kanye nabantu bendawo. Umcimbi wawuhanjiswa ngezinkanyezi, umculo, nezinsuku zokubungaza. Uthando lweGEMS lwalukhanya njengelanga, futhi abantu babebonisa ukujabula kwabo. UMnumzane Dlamini wathatha isikhulumi, waphakamisa indebe yakhe, wathi: "Siyabonga nonke ngokuba yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esihle. I-GEMS ayisiyona nje iphakheji, kodwa isithombe sokubambisana kwethu. Sihlangene, sithuthukile, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze iThokoza ibe yindawo engcono." Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baphakamisa izinkanyezi, beshaya izandla, bejabula ngempumelelo. U-Dlamini waba neqhaza elikhulu, futhi wathola ukuqashelwa ngenxa yokuba ngumholi ophumelelayo. I-GEMS yabe seyiba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwenza konke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iThokoza yaba yidolobha elaziwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi abantu baphila kahle. U-Dlamini wathola ukuthi ukuphathwa kwezinsiza akusiyona into elula, kodwa uma usebenzisa amathuluzi afanele, ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. I-GEMS yabe seyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubumbano, ukuxhumana, nokusebenza ngokubambisana kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngakho-ke, iThokoza yahlala ikhanya, futhi uDlamini waba yisibonelo sokuhola ngendlela efanele. Imibhalo yephakheji yabaphathi yabe seyiyingxenye yomlando, futhi abantu bahlala bephila ngothando, ubumbano, kanye nokuphumelela.
Impilo Yaselokshini: Umlando Wokuphila Kwezingane Ngaphezu kweminyaka engamashumi amabili edlule, impilo yasemalokshini yathola ukunakwa okukhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Izindawo ezibizwa ngamaTownships, ezakhelwe ngemuva kokwahlukaniswa, zaba nezimpawu ezenza zaziwe, ziqhakambisa umlando wobunzima, nokuphila kwamaNtu. Nakuba impilo kulezi zindawo ibinzima, izici ezifana nothando, umndeni, nemigomo yokuphila ngcono zaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyisayo. Uhlanga lwezindawo zokuhlala lwakha imiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Abantu bebehamba ngezinyawo, besuka emsebenzini, behamba bephuma ezindaweni zokuhlala ezimnyama nezihluphekayo, ukuze baqhubeke nokuphila. Izikole zazingekho kahle, kodwa zazigcwele abafundi abanomdlandla, ababephupha ngekusasa elikhanyayo. Nokho, impilo yaselokshini ibivame ukuphathwa ngokuqhekeka nokudabukisa. Abantu babebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengokungabi nezinsiza, ukushoda kwemisebenzi, nokunye okukhathazayo. Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1980, izibhelu zokuqala zenzeka eTownship, lapho abantu bephakamisa izwi labo. Lokhu kwaba yisigaba esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Ukuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ezahlukene zakhula, zihlanganisa abaholi bendawo abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Izinsiza ezibizayo, izinhlelo zokuhlala, nezinhlelo zokusebenza zaba yindlela yokuphikisana nezinqubomgomo zokuhlukaniswa. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, abahlali bezindawo zokuhlala baqhubeka nokwakha izindlela zokuphila. Izimakethe zamahhala, izinhlelo zezenhlalakahle, nezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlobene nezobuciko, ezokungcebeleka, nezindlela zokukhuthaza ubuhlakani. Umculo, ubuciko, nemidlalo zaba izindlela zokudlulisa imiyalezo, nokukhumbuza abantu ngezimo abaphila ngaphansi kwazo. Nokho, ukuphila eTownship akukaze kube lula. Imiphakathi ibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ukuhlukunyezwa, nokushoda kwezimali. Izinsiza zomphakathi ezifana nezibhedlela, izikole, nezindawo zokudlela zaba ngethuba, kodwa zazingabi nazo zonke izidingo. Abantu bahlala bezama ukujolisa izifiso zabo, begxila ezinhlelweni ezicacile, ukuze bakhe impilo engcono. Abesifazane bahlala bephambili emizweni yokwakha impilo engcono. Babanamandla okuba izinkanyezi ezikhanyisayo, bekwenza kube lula ukuthi imiphakathi ibonakale. Izinkulumo ezibandakanya izifundo, imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa, nezinhlelo zomphakathi zakhula ngokusimeme, zaziwa kakhulu. Abesifazane bahamba phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izifundo zokuqwashisa ngempilo, ukulwa nezinsizwa, nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Nakuba bephila ezinkingeni, abantu bahlala bethanda impilo yabo yaselokshini. Izingane zidlala ezitaladini, zikhumbula izikhathi ezithokozisayo. Ubuqhawe obuqhubekayo bukhanya njalo; imiphakathi iyazama ukuphila, nakuba izimo zingezinhle. Izinyanga ziya zihlaba, kodwa umoya wokuphila uqhubeka, ungapheli. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu baselokshini bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo, bephila ngokukhuthazela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindawo zokuhlala zathuthuka zaba nethuba elingcono. Ubuqhawe bokuhlala, ukuthuthukisa izindawo, nezinqubomgomo ezihloniphekayo, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindawo ezinjengamaTownships zaba nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene, izikole ezinhle, nezinsiza ezithuthukile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni impilo engcono, kulandela izifiso zabantu. Ngokubheka emuva, impilo yaselokshini ibonisa indlela yokuphila eqhubekayo, ejulile. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, impilo yaselokshini iyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando wethu, ibonisa amandla, uthando, kanye nesibopho sokuphila. Iziqhamo zalesi simo zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba izimo zingaba nzima, abantu bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Izimpilo zabo zibe yizifundo ezinhle, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukudlula izithiyo futhi sithole impilo engcono.

(a) Ibhodi kufanele ibe nezithunywa ezingaphezu kuka-25, ezine-14 kufanele zibe zibhaliswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 (a) no (b), ezibekwe nguMphathiswa ngokubheka iziqu zabo kwezemfundo yokuhlanganyela, ukuhlinzeka, impilo yomphakathi, usizo lokuqala, impilo yomsebenzi, kanye nempilo yengqondo. Izithunywa kufanele zibe zibekwe nguMphathiswa ngemuva kokuthi amagama aphakanyisiwe yilabo abathintekayo, nangemva kokuthi isaziso sishicilelwe emaphephandabeni kahulumeni sikhuthaza iziphakamiso zamagama ezithunywa ezintsha. UMphathiswa angabeka kabusha umuntu osukwini lwakhe lokugcina, abekwe isikhathi esengeziwe esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu. Lo muntu kufanele, lapho engena emsebenzini, aqhubeke nokulandela isithembiso sokulandela okukhulunywe kulolu sikhumbuzo kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha.
