Ukuqinisekisa Ukunakekelwa Kwezinga Eliphezulu (GEMS Quality Care Assurance) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezimbonini eziningi, futhi ezokunakekelwa kwezempilo akuzange kube ngaphandle kwalokhu. Ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu (GEMS quality care assurance) kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, eziphephile, nezisebenzayo. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngempilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle somkhakha wezempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yini i-GEMS. I-GEMS, noma i-Good Education and Management Systems, ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izinsiza zezempilo. Lokhu kuhilela ukufakwa kwezindlela ezithile zokuhlola, ukusungula izinqubo, nokwenza izinhlelo ezizokwandisa ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Umgomo wokuqala we-GEMS uwukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zomphakathi, ukuze izinsizakalo zempilo zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje ukuthi ukufakwa kwe-GEMS kuzoholela emiphumeleni emihle. Abanye abantu baveza ukukhathazeka mayelana nezindleko ezihambisana nokwakhiwa nokuphathwa kwe-GEMS. Ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi kudinga izinsiza eziningi, ezibandakanya izinsiza zezimali, isikhathi, kanye nezinsiza zabantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo bangase baphendule ngokungathandi, becabanga ukuthi lezi zindleko zingaholela ekwandeni kwentengo yezinsizakalo. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindleko eziphezulu zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zingaholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu zokuphila kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, ukwakhiwa kwe-GEMS kungaba yindlela yokunciphisa lezi zindleko ngokwandisa ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Ngokwesibili, i-GEMS iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi bezempilo, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo. Lokhu kuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo, futhi bonke bayahlanganyela ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, okukhuthaza ukuvuma izimvo ezahlukene, futhi kugqugquzela ubuchwepheshe obusha. Uma abaphathi bezempilo benza izinqumo ezisebenzayo, lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enempilo, engathinta ngempela impilo yabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-GEMS akusikho kuphela ukwakha izinqubo eziphezulu, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinqubo zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola njalo nokwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuba nezinqubo eziqinile zokuhlola ikhwalithi, ezizohlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokuthi yiziphi izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka izinguquko ezidingekayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS iyathinta umphakathi ngokujulile. Uma izinsizakalo zempilo zikhuliswa, lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bathole ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphile impilo enempilo, futhi lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wonke. Umphakathi ophilayo ubonakala ngempela ezingeni lezempilo labantu bawo, futhi i-GEMS iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-GEMS ayinakho konke okudingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Kukhona izici eziningi ezithinta ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa, kufaka phakathi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, izimo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibhekelele lezi zici, futhi ibambisane nezinye izinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu (GEMS quality care assurance) kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili kwezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwezindlela eziphumelelayo, ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi bezempilo, kanye nokuhlola njalo ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umkhakha wezempilo ungase ube sengcupheni yokwehluleka, okungaholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu zokuphila kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, i-GEMS iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa elinempilo kubantu bonke.
b Thuthukisa ukuvikelwa nokufinyelela ekuqinisekisweni kobulili; futhi c ukubheka, ukuhlola nokuhlonza ukuhlonishwa kokulingana kobulili namalungelo abesifazane lapha eRiphabhulikhi. I-Secretariat nayo ibamba iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukene yehhovisi futhi iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu, uNkk. Chana Majake. Imiphumela ebhaliwe mayelana nezindaba ibe yinkinga yokuhlola nokubheka. Amadokhumenti okukhala aqediwe ahlobene nezinsongo ezihlukene zokucwaswa ngokobulili. Umfakisicelo kumele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe ku-Government Gazette [Inombolo Yesaziso Sokuhulumeni R187- edlulelwa ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002] (ifomu A). Umfakisicelo kumele futhi akhombise ukuthi uyacela yini ikhophi yedokhumenti noma ufuna ukuyibona mathupha ehhovisi leKomishini. Uma umuntu efuna ukuboniswa amadokhumenti ngendlela ethile, kumele aboniswe ngendlela ayicelile. Ngaphandle kokuthi ukwenza kanjalo kuzophazamisela ukusebenza kwalolo hulumeni noma kubangele umonakalo kudokhumenti, noma kuphule ilungelo ledokhumenti elingelona idokhumenti yomphakathi. Uma ngezizathu ezithile idokhumenti ingaboniswa ngendlela eceliwe, ingaboniswa ngenye indlela, futhi imali ekhokhwayo kumele ibalwe ngokwejwayelekile ngendlela edokhumenti ezoboniswa ngayo. Uma umfakisicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kumele akhombise isikhundla lapho ukufaka isicelo kwenziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 182f. Uma umfakisicelo engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma engakhubazekile, angafaka isicelo ngokuqhubekayo. Umfakisicelo ofuna idokhumenti equkethe ulwazi lwakhe siqu akadingi ukukhokha imali. Umphathi wolwazi kumele azise umfakisicelo (ngaphandle kwalowo ocela ulwazi lwakhe) ngokuthumela isaziso sokuthi kumele akhokhe imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi ukufaka isicelo kuqhubeke. Imali yokufaka isicelo ekhokhwayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi ingama-R35. Umfakisicelo angafaka isikhalazo ngaphakathi, uma kudingeka, noma afake isicelo enkantolo uma ephikisa ukukhokha imali yokufaka isicelo. Ngemva kokuba umphathi wolwazi enze isinqumo mayelana nalolo suku, umfakisicelo kumele aziswe ngaleso sinqumo ngendlela ayicelile ukuba aziswe. Uma ukufaka isicelo kabulwa, imali eyengeziwe yokufuna, yokuhlela, noma yokukhiqiza kanye nesikhathi esichithwa sokulungiselela idokhumenti kumele ikhokhwe uma exceeds isikhathi esibekiwe sokufuna nokuhlela amadokhumenti okukhululwa. Usizo lweKomishini luwumsebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo noma emaphakathini aqhutshelwa yiKomishini ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zayo. Kungase kube nezinye izinhlelo ezihlukene ezixhumene ngaphansi kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ezichaza umsebenzi weKomishini: isibonelo, uMnyango wezobugebengu, Ucwaningo, Ukuhlola nokuhlola, Imfundo yomphakathi, nolwazi. Izinhlelo ngaphansi koCwaningo, ukuhlola, nokuhlola zingaba yisisekelo solwazi. Umthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili inombolo 39 ka-1996 yinto esungula umsebenzi weKomishini okuwukuvikela, ukukhuthaza, nokuthuthukisa ukuvumelana kobulili nokuqinisa isimo sabesifazane kuhulumeni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, ebhizinisini, nasemkhakheni ongemthetho. Ukuhlola nokuhlola noma yisiphi Isinqumo sePhalamende noma noma yimuphi omunye umthetho noma isivumelwano sokuhlola izikhalazo ezivela noma ngemva kokwamukela isikhalazo bese uzama ukuxazulula noma iyiphi inkinga noma ukulungisa isenzo noma ukungasebenzi. Izinqubomgomo zokuhlola nokuhlola, izinhlelo zokusebenza kuhulumeni, abamele uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nomkhakha ongemthetho. Ukuze uthole usizo lweKomishini, kufanele kufakwe isicelo esibhalwe kuMphathi Omkhulu weKomishini usebenzisa ulwazi olunikeziwe ku-B ngenhla. Amakhomidi ngokwesigaba -5 - seMthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili mayelana nalabo okufanele bamenywe kulawo makhomidi. Izinhlelo zokuzithandela kanye nemisebenzi yesikhashana - kukhona inqubomgomo yokusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze bamenye abantu emphakathini ukuze bagcwalise lezi zikhala. Abacwaningi besikhashana - kukhona inqubomgomo mayelana nokumiswa kwabacwaningi. IKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili nezinye izikhungo ezisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesahluko sesishiyagalolunye (somthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho inombolo 108 ka-1996) azinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokudlulisa izikhalazo njengokwenziwe kwezinye izikhungo zomphakathi. Umuntu onenkinga kufanele asondele enkantolo uma kukhona isikhalazo mayelana nokungahambisani nomthetho yiKomishini. IKomishini izobuyekeza le dokhumenti ngokwesigaba 14, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli unyaka. Ukumelwa kwezilimi ezintathu ezikhuluma kulolo suku lokugcina idokhumenti okukhulunywa ngalo kuMthetho Wokugcina Amadokhumenti ka-1997; zonke izikhungo zeKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili kanye neKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu.
Ukuntuleka KweMisebenzi (Unemployment) Isingeniso Kulolu suku, sithokozile ukuzoxoxa noMnu. Zulu, ongumsebenzi wezemfundo ophothule izifundo zakhe emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwamasistimu, kodwa okwamanje ubhekene nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Sizodlulela emibuzweni ukuze sihlolisise izimbangela, izinkinga, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona kulolu daba olubaluleke kakhulu emphakathini wethu. Umbuzo 1: Mnu. Zulu, singakwadala ukufaka khona umbono wakho mayelana nezimbangela zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi? Impendulo: Ngiyabonga ngokunginika ithuba lokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esiyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kubangelwa izinto ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kukhona ukuncipha kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni ethile efana nokwakha nokuthuthukiswa. Ngesikhathi sokuphola kwezomnotho, abantu abaningi bakhuthazwa ukuthi baqashe, kodwa uma umnotho ushoda, izinkampani zivalela emnyango, eziholela ekuntulekeni kwemisebenzi. Okwesibili, ukungalingani emfundweni kanye nemfundo ephakeme kudala inkinga; abantu baningi abanenqubo zokufunda eziphakeme, kodwa badinga amakhono athile ukuze baphumelele ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Umbuzo 2: Lokhu kuthinta kanjani abantu empilweni yabo yansuku zonke? Impendulo: Lokhu kuthinta abantu ngezindlela eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuholela ekuwohlokeni kwezimali, okwenza kube nzima abantu ukuba bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Lokhu kubangela ukucindezeleka, ukuhamba phambili kwezimali, nokungabi nokuqinisekiswa kokuphila. Abantu abaningi balahlekelwa ukuzethemba, Fansu leso simo singaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo. Izindaba ezimbi zithinta njalo izifunda ezithintekayo; izinga lokuphila lenyuka, abantu bajolise emithonjeni engafanele, okukhona kukhulu ezinkingeni zalolu hlobo. Umbuzo 3: Kukhona yini izixazululo ezitholakalayo kule nkinga? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezixazululo ezithile ezikhona zokubhekana nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele enze imizamo eyengeziwe yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ikakhulukazi kumakholwa amancane naphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlinzekwa ngenkxaso kubafundi, ukwakha izikhungo zokufunda ezihlinzeka ngama-programs afanele, kanye nokukhuthaza ukufundwa kwemikhakha ethile. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi kumele awezise izinhlelo zabantu ukukwazi ukuvuselela amathuba okusebenza, futhi kumele bakhuthaze ukubuyiselwa ezindleleni zomsebenzi. Okwesithathu, ibhizinisi kufanele lisenze izinhlelo zokuxhasa umphakathi, okuzosiza ekuphatheni lo msebenzi oyingozi. Umbuzo 4: Ucabanga ukuthi umphakathi ungawuthatha kanjani umthwalo wokulawula le nkinga? Impendulo: Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekulawuleni ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngobuchule futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bazibandakanye, bahlale bejolisa emisebenzini eyahlukahlukene yokuthuthukisa amakhono. Umphakathi ungasebenzisa izikhungo zendawo ezitholakalayo, ezibalulekile ukuze uthole izinsiza ezithuthukisayo. Ukuze sithole isixazululo esempumelelweni, kufanele kuhlangane izigaba zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nomsebenzi ozimele ukuze sikhulise amathuba. Izinhlangano zomphakathi zingaba nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuthuthukisa amakhono, zonke zisebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqashelwe le nkinga. Umbuzo 5: Ngingakubona yini ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi okukodwa, futhi ubani okufanele abe neqhaza kulokhu? Impendulo: Yebo, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akukodwa; kunezimo ezahlukene ezithinta abantu, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezilungile. Kuba nethuba lapho siphila khona ukungatholi izinsiza ezidingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kube khona ukuhlinzeka ngezinye izikhuthazo ukuze kube namathuba amaningi okuthi ukuthola imisebenzi kube nokwenzeka. Uhlelo lwezempilo, izinhlelo zokuphatha, nebhizinisi elincane yizinto eziyinhloko ezidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Ukuba neqhaza likamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nemboni yezenhlalakahle kubalulekile ukuze kuqondiswe izinqumo ezizothuthukisa umphakathi nokuveza amathuba emisebenzi. Isiphetho Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi yinkinga ebanzi, ethinta abantu abaningi ezimpilweni zabo, kudinga ukugxila, ubuchule, kanye nobumbano phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithumele umyalezo wokubambisana, sithole izixazululo ezinhle, ukuze siphinde sithuthukise amathuba okusebenza. Ngikholwa ukuthi uma sithanda, sizokwakha umphakathi onempumelelo, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphumelela. Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi esithokozisayo sokuxoxisana.
Inhloso ukuhlela uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawulwa kwemigudu ye-petroleum, ukusungula iBhodi lokulawulwa kwemigudu ye-petroleum ezobheka futhi ilandele ukuhlinzekwa kohla lwesizwe neminye imibandela ephathelene nayo. Kubalulekile ukufaka isikhungo sokugcina kanye nanoma iyiphi isikhungo ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kokugcina i-petroleum. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa imiyalelo ethunyelwe nokwaziswa okuhlinzekwe ngaphansi kwawo; futhi "kungabopha" kusho isilinganiso esinqunywe yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, hhayi njengoba kudingwa izibopho zokwenyama. Uthuthukisa ukufinyelela emikhiqizweni ye-petroleum engabizi. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lisungulwa njengomuntu ophethe. Lingakwenza noma yini ephathelene nokusebenza kwemisebenzi yalo; futhi lisebenzise amandla noma lenze noma iyiphi umsebenzi oyiqondiso yokwenziwa yiBhodi ngaphansi komunye umthetho. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum izoba nezikhulu ezinhlanu ezithunywe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kumele athumele omunye ummember ovela ezihlongozweni ezithunywe ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuqala ukuba abe ngumholi weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma ngasiphi isizathu umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, abanye ozakwabo bazokhetha omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuba asebenze njengomholi kuze kube umholi ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe, noma kuze kube omunye umuntu ethunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Umuntu oyiSikhumbuzo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uzokwenza isikhathi seminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda athumele umuntu osevele ethunywe. Uma ummember weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum eshiya isikhundla sakhe, uNgqongqoshe angathumela omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise leso sikhundla kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi okhethwe ngaso. Abamemezeli beBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele bakhokhelwe ngezinsiza zabo, futhi amaholo nezindleko zabo kuzovunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. Akekho umuntu ongathunywa njengommember weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma lowo muntu engowezwe laseNingizimu Afrika futhi engahlali eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uboshwe ngemuva kokuhlulelwa ngesikweletu futhi engakabuyiselwa, noma uma esekwe imisebenzi ngenxa yokungathembeki, noma uma kungase kube nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezithakazelo zakhe njengommember weBhodi nezithakazelo zakhe zomuntu, okuthinta umsebenzi wakhe noma amabhizinisi akhe. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza, ulwazi lwezohwebo, ulwazi lwezomnotho, noma olunye ulwazi oluhlobene nokulawulwa kwemigudu ye-petroleum. Kumele temsilise izithakazelo zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wonke futhi kumele bangabi nokuqonda okungafanele noma ukungathembeki. Ngaphambi kokuthumela abamemezeli beBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, uNgqongqoshe uzokhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, emema umphakathi ukuba wenze iziphakamiso zabantu. Bonke abamemezeli kumele, uma bethunywa kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, bazi uNgqongqoshe nganoma yimiphi imibandela engase ibathinte ngqo, umsebenzi wabo, izithakazelo zabo zebhizinisi, futhi kumele bazi uNgqongqoshe nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. UNgqongqoshe angathatha emuva ukuthunywa kommember kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma lowo member ephatha ngendlela ephikisana nezimiso zesigaba 9. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ihlangane ngezikhathi nezindawo ezinqunywe ngumholi. Umholi kumele abize imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum njengoba kudingeka ukuze ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Umholi kumele, uma ecela nguMphathi Omkhulu noma ngabe abanye ababili, abize umhlangano ophuthumayo ukuze ubanjwe phakathi kweviki ezimbili ngemuva kosuku lokucela. Umholi wanoma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele anqume izinqubo ezizolandela kulowo mhlangano, ngaphandle uma kukhona enye indlela ebekwe ukuba ilandelwe. Iquorum yomhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum iyinani elikhulu labamemezeli. Isinqumo esithathwe inani elikhulu labamemezeli abakhona emhlanganweni sizoba yisinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezivoti nganoma yimuphi umbuzo ophakanyisiwe, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote yokugcina ngaphezu kokuvota kwakhe njengommember. Akukho sinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum esizokwenziwa kube phambene ngenxa yokushiyeka kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum noma ngoba umuntu okwakufanele angathathwa njengommember ubekhona ngesikhathi sinqumo sithathwa, uma bonke abanye abamemezeli bebekhona emhlanganweni futhi benelungelo lokubamba iqhaza njengabamemezeli bequorum futhi isinqumo sithathwa inani elikhulu labamemezeli abakhona emhlanganweni futhi banelungelo lokuvota. UMphathi Omkhulu noma, uma engakabikho, ummember weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum okhethwe nguMphathi Omkhulu, uzophatha yonke imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, enelungelo lokukhuluma emhlanganweni kodwa enganelungelo lokuvota kulowo mhlangano. Noma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uvulekile emphakathini ngaphandle uma kukhona ulwazi olunobungozi noluyimfihlo oluhambelana nokuba ngumnikazi noma ukuhweba okumele kuxoxwe, futhi kulokhu, umuntu ophathelene kufanele anikeze izizathu ezisemthethweni kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum zokuthi kungani lowo msebenzi ungafanele ukwenziwa emphakathini. Uma iBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ithatha isinqumo nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokuba emhlanganweni ohleliwe, leso sinqumo sithatha umthelela ngokushesha futhi kumele sibhale, signwe inani elikhulu labamemezeli, futhi sethulwe emhlanganweni wokuqala ohleliwe weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ngemuva kokwenziwa ukuze kufakwe kumarekhodi. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amarekhodi ayo okusebenza agcinwa. Abamemezeli kumele baphendule futhi kumele bangabambisani ekuvoteni noma ekuxoxeni nganoma yimuphi umbuzo abazi ukuthi uzobathinta ngqo noma ngqo; futhi kumele benze ngendlela elindelekile kumuntu osebenza emphakathini. Wonke amaqiniso eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum nezizathu zawo kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophathwe kabi nganoma iyiphi indlela ngesinqumo sathathwa yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele anikeze le ndaba kwiNkantolo Ephakeme ukuze ibuyekezwe lelo sinqumo. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ithumele uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. UMphathi Omkhulu uzobheka ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kweBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum; futhi uzophatha izindaba ezihlobene nabasebenzi abathunywe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3.
Ukushoda Kwamithi Ezibhedlela: Izimbangela, Imiphumela Nokuxazulula Isingeniso Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela sekuyinkinga ebonakalayo emhlabeni jikelele, futhi ikakhulukazi emazweni aseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kushoda kuholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza ezisemqoka zokwelapha. Lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuba ziqashelwe ngeso elibanzi, ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Izimbangela Zokushoda Kwamithi Izimbangela zokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela ziningi futhi zihluke-hluke. Okokuqala, ukungabikhona kwezinsiza zokukhiqiza imithi, okuhlanganisa imithombo yokwakha, izinsiza zokuhweba, kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, kudala ubunzima ekukhiqizeni imithi. Okwesibili, izinqubo zokuhweba ezinzima nezimfuneko zomthetho ezimweni ezithile zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela emithini ethile. Lokhu kudala ukuthi imithi ethile ingatholakali ezibhedlela, ikakhulukazi emithini edingekayo yokwelapha izifo ezithile. Okwesithathu, ukwanda kwezifo ezibangelwa izimo zokuphila, njengezifo zohlobo lwezifo ezithathelwanayo, kanye nezifo ezihlobene nezimo zokuphila, kufaka umthwalo omkhulu ezibhedlela. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwemithi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphakeli bemithi nezibhedlela nakho kudala ukungahleleki ekuthengeni nasekutholeni imithi. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kwamithi Imiphumela yokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela ingaba mibi kakhulu. Okokuqala, ukungatholakali kwemithi edingekayo kuholela ekwehleni kokwelashwa okufanele, okwandisa amathuba okuthi iziguli zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokufa, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphansi okuphila. Iziguli ezidinga imithi ethile, njengezidakamizwa zokwelapha izifo ezinzima, ziba sengcupheni enkulu uma imithi ingatholakali. Okwesibili, ukushoda kwemithi kudala ukucindezeleka emithini, kudala umfanekiso ongemuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kokwethemba ezibhedlela, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuba bakholelwe ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphume emithini, baphinde bahlale bephila ngezindlela ezingezinhle. Izixazululo Zokuxazulula Ukushoda Kwamithi Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele zokukhiqiza imithi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokukhiqiza ezikhiqiza imithi ethile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi itholakala kalula. Okwesibili, ukwakhiwa kokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphakeli bemithi nezibhedlela kubalulekile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhleleka okungcono ekuthengeni nasekutholeni imithi. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imithi edingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Okwesithathu, uhulumeni kumele aqinise izinqubo zokuhlola imithi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi ethengiswa iyahambisana nezindinganiso eziphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu ekusebenziseni imithi engasebenzi kahle noma engaphephile. Isiphetho Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela kuyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi edinga ukuxazululwa ngokuhlanganyela. Izimbangela zayo ziningi, futhi imiphumela yayo ibalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, abaphakeli bemithi, nezibhedlela basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngokuhlanganyela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi imithi ethile iyatholakala, futhi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okudingekayo ukuze ziphile impilo enempilo.
Imali Yokufunda Emanyuvesi: Iziqondiso Zokuhlola Nokuqonda Ukwazi ukuthi ungayithola kanjani imali yokufunda emanyuvesi kubalulekile kubafundi abaningi abahlose ukuqhubeka nezifundo zabo. Ukuze uthole le mali, kufanele uhlole izinyathelo ezithile ezibalulekile. Lezi zinyathelo zizokwakha isiqondiso esiqinile sokuthi ungabhekelela kanjani izimali zakho zokufunda ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Qonda Izidingo Zokufunda Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izidingo zokufunda emanyuvesi. Lokhu kubandakanya izifundo ezitholakalayo, izinkambiso zempumelelo, nezindleko ezihambisana nokufunda. Hlalani nibheka izikhumbuzo ezivela emanyuvesi ahlukene ukuze nilandele izidingo zabo ezithile. Isinyathelo 2: Bheka Izikhwama Zokufunda Ngokuhamba phambili, kufanele niqonde ukuthi zikhona izikhwama ezahlukene zokufunda ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungaba izikhwama zezimali, izikhwama ezivela kuhulumeni, noma izikhwama ezivela ezinkampanini ezizimele. Qhathanisani lezi zikhwama ukuze niqonde ukuthi yiziphi ezihambelana nezidingo zenu. Isinyathelo 3: Thola Ulwazi Ngemali Yokufunda Ukuze uthole ulwazi oludingekayo, sebenzisa izinsiza ezikhona ezifana nezinkampani ezikhipha izikhumbuzo noma amawebhusayithi anikezela ngemininingwane ethile. Hamba emihlanganweni yokufunda, enze imibuzo, futhi ube nekhono lokuxhumana nabanye abafundi ukuze uthole ukwaziswa okwengeziwe. Isinyathelo 4: Faka Izicelo Zokuxhaswa Ngemva kokuba niqonde izikhwama ezitholakalayo, qhubekani ngokufaka izicelo zokuxhaswa. Qiniseka ukuthi niyafaka zonke izimfuneko ezidingekayo, futhi nithumele izicelo ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba enu okuthola imali yokufunda. Isinyathelo 5: Qonda Izinqubomgomo Zokubuyisela Kubantu abathola imali yokufunda, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubomgomo zokubuyisela. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kwenzeka ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nezifundo zakho. Hlalani nithinte umnyango wezokufunda ukuze niqonde kahle lezi zimpahla. Isinyathelo 6: Hlanganyela Nezikhungo Zokuxhaswa Ukuxhumana nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali kungasiza kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zinganikeza izeluleko, izinsiza, noma ngisho nezinye izikhwama zokufunda. Hlanganani nabanye abafundi abawutholile uxhaso ukuze nabelane ngolwazi. Isinyathelo 7: Landelela Isimo Sokuxhaswa Kwenyu Ngemva kokufaka izicelo, landela isimo sokuxhaswa okwenzekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde uma sekwenzekile noma uma kudingeka ukuthuthukisa izicelo. Isinyathelo 8: Thuthukisa Amakhono Akho Ngaphezu kokucela uxhaso lwezimali, thuthukani namakhono enu. Lokhu kuzokwenza nibe nezinzuzo eziphakeme uma nifaka izicelo. Qhuba nezifundo, thola iziqu, noma ubambe iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukene ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubuchwepheshe benu. Isinyathelo 9: Xhumana Nabafundi Abasafunda Xhumana nabafundi abakhuluma ngempumelelo yokuthola uxhaso lwezimali. Lokhu kuzokwenza niqonde izindlela ezihamba phambili nezinye izindlela ezithuthukayo. Hamba emihlanganweni, ube nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo, futhi uxhumane nabanye. Isinyathelo 10: Yiba Nesineke Ekugcineni, yiba nesineke. Imali yokufunda ayitholakali ngokushesha, futhi izinqubo zingathatha isikhathi. Khumbula ukuthi ukuqhubeka kokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokuthola uxhaso kuzokwenza uthole impumelelo ekugcineni. Isiphetho Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathola ukuqonda okunembile ngendlela yokuthola imali yokufunda emanyuvesi. Qonda izidingo, hlola izikhwama, futhi uqhubeke nokuqonda izinqubomgomo. Ukubambisana nabanye abafundi, nokuthuthukisa amakhono akho, kuzokwenza ufinyelele impumelelo oyifunayo. Ngakho, qhubekani nithobekile, nisebenzisane, futhi niyazethembisa. Imali yokufunda ingaba yithuba elihle lokuqhubekela phambili.
Ekuqaleni, emzaneni omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, kwakuhlala abantu abanothando olukhulu lwezinyawo. Le ndawo yayigcwele abalandeli abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kodwa bonke babebambisene ngokuthanda ibhola. Phakathi kwalesi sikhala, ubuso babantu babugcwele injabulo njengoba bephakamisa izimpahla zabo zeqembu. UThabo, umfana oneminyaka eyishumi nane, wayengumlandeli ophakeme weqembu leMkhumbane United. Wayenothando olujulile lwezinyawo, futhi wayejabula kakhulu lapho edlala ibhola emgwaqweni. Ngaphandle kokuba umgibeli omuhle, wayephinde abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekubukeni imidlalo yeqembu lakhe. Njengoba imidlalo ibiqhubeka, uThabo wayehlala efika ngaphambi kwesikhathi, elindele ukuzwa umsindo weqembu lakhe elibhalwe phansi. Ngolunye usuku, umphakathi wahlangana ukuze ubuke umdlalo obalulekile phakathi kweMkhumbane United neMafikizolo FC. Umoya wawugcwele umdlandla, abalandeli bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane ezazithokozisa. UThabo wayephakathi kwabo, ebona ubuso obujabulayo babangani bakhe, uSipho noNandi. Umdlalo uqale, umoya wawugcwele umdlandla, uThabo wababona umgibeli weqembu lakhe, uMthethwa, edlula abadlali beMafikizolo FC. UThabo wayezwa inhliziyo yakhe iphuphuma, umoya wakhe ugcwele ithemba, ekhala, “Uzozama, Mthethwa! Uzozama!” Umdlalo wawuhamba kahle, kodwa ngesikhathi sokuphela, uMafikizolo FC wathola ithuba lokuphosa ibhola emgibeleni. UThabo waphakamisa izandla zakhe, ethukile, “Hamba, hamba!” kodwa ibhola laphuma emgibeleni. Umdlalo waphela, kwaba umphumela ophakathi. Ngemuva komdlalo, abalandeli babebonakala bejabulile, kodwa uThabo wayephawuleka ethukile. “Sizobuyela, sizobuyela!” kusho uSipho, eduduzela uThabo. “Kukhona imidlalo eminingi ezayo, sizokwenza kahle.” UThabo wathokozisa, wathola ithemba, futhi waba nesithakazelo sokubuka imidlalo ezayo. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, waqhubeka nokubuka imidlalo, futhi ubudlelwano bakhe nabangani bakhe baphumelela. Uthando lwabo lwezinyawo lwabashintsha, lwabavumela ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yabo. UThabo wathola ukuthi abalandeli bebebalulekile, hhayi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa nasempilweni yabo. Ngonyaka olandelayo, uMkhumbane United wathola ithuba lokudlala emqhudelwaneni omkhulu. UThabo, uSipho, noNandi babebonakala bejabulile, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane, bephakamisa izimpahla zabo. Umdlalo wawuhamba kahle, umoya ophakeme, umoya wokuhlanganyela. Umdlalo waphela, futhi uMkhumbane United waphumelela. UThabo waphakamisa izandla zakhe, ejabulela, “Siphumelele! Siphumelele!” Abalandeli babebonakala bejabulile, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane. UThabo wathola ukuthi uthando lwezinyawo lwalungaphezu kokudlala ibhola; kwakuwukuhlanganyela, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngaleso sikhathi, wathola ukuthi abalandeli bebebalulekile empilweni, futhi uthando lwabo lwezinyawo lwalungaphezu kokudlala ibhola. UThabo noSipho noNandi bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezincane, bephakamisa izimpahla zabo, bejabulisa umoya omuhle phakathi komphakathi. UThabo wathola ukuthi ibhola lalingaphezu kokudlala; kwakuwukuhlanganyela, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano.
Ukungcola Kwemvelo - Ingxoxo noMnu. Mthembu Isingeniso Ngiyakwemukela, Mnu. Mthembu, futhi ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukungihlanganyela kulolu cwaningo olukhuluma ngengxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu - ukungcola kwemvelo. Ngabe ungakuchaza kancane ukuthi yini ukungcola kwemvelo? UMnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukungcola kwemvelo kubhekisela ekungcoleni kwemithombo yemvelo, okungaba ngenxa yokukhishwa kwemfucumfucu, imikhakha yokukhiqiza, noma izenzo zabantu ezithinta umoya, amanzi, nomhlaba. Lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinkulu, ezinjengokuphazamiseka kwemvelo, ukuncipha kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zempilo kubantu. Umbuzo 1: Yiziphi izimbangela ezinkulu zokungcola kwemvelo? UMnu. Mthembu: Izimbangela ezinkulu zokungcola kwemvelo ziningi. Okokuqala, sinesimo sokukhula kwabantu, okukhulisa umthamo wokukhiqiza nezidingo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokukhishwa kwegesi ezinjengokungcola komoya. Okwesibili, imboni iyisizathu esikhulu sokungcola. Imikhiqizo eminingi ikhiqizwa ngaphandle kokucabangela imiphumela emibi emvelweni. Futhi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kubangelwa kakhulu ukungena kwemfucumfucu emifuleni nasemathafeni. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinkinga ezibangelwa ukungcola kwemvelo? UMnu. Mthembu: Ukungcola kwemvelo kubangela izinkinga eziningi. Okokuqala, sithola ukwanda kwezifo ezithathelwana emoyeni, njengokuphefumula okunzima. Okwesibili, imvelo iyashabalala; izilwane nezitshalo ziya zincipha, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukudla. Futhi, ukungcola kwamanzi kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezinsiza zamanzi, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile. Umbuzo 3: Yini esingayenza ukuze sinciphise ukungcola kwemvelo? UMnu. Mthembu: Kunezindlela eziningi esingazithatha. Okokuqala, kufanele sithuthukise imikhuba yokuphila. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezilahlwayo, ukusebenzisa kabusha, nokusebenzisa izinto eziphilayo. Okwesibili, imfundo ibalulekile. Kufanele sifundise abantu ngengozi yokungcola kwemvelo, ukuze baqonde ukuthi izenzo zabo zinegalelo elikhulu. Futhi, uhulumeni kufanele abeke imithetho eqinile yokuvikela imvelo. Umbuzo 4: Ucabanga ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuvikela imvelo? UMnu. Mthembu: Yebo, ngicabanga ukuthi imiphakathi ingakwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo ezinhle. Uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangakha izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka, izinhlelo zokulima ezihlala zikhona, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvuselela imvelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imvelo, futhi kuzokhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nesibopho. Umbuzo 5: Yini oyicabangayo ngendima yohulumeni ekulweni nokungcola kwemvelo? UMnu. Mthembu: Uhulumeni unendima enkulu. Kufanele abeke imithetho eqinile yokuvikela imvelo, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi le mithetho iyalandelwa. Futhi, uhulumeni kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsiza zokuhlola ukungcola, ukuze sikwazi ukubona izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba zibe zinkulu. Ukuxhaswa kwezimali ezinhlelweni zokuvikela imvelo kuyasiza kakhulu. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ukungcola kwemvelo kuyinkinga enkulu, kodwa uma sisebenzisana, singakwazi ukuvikela imvelo yethu. Ngiyabonga futhi ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazothola ulwazi oluwusizo kulokhu okukhuluma ngakho. UMnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukusiza. Ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle emvelweni yethu.
Ukungeniswa kweMali yeMinyaka Emithathu (MTEF) yoHulumeni wePhondo laseGauteng ka-2006/07 kubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile emizamweni yethu eqhubekayo yokuhlangabezana nezifiso zabantu baseGauteng ngendlela enenjongo. Le MTEF ibonisa izinto ezibalulekile eziphakanyiswe uhulumeni wesifunda. Ngesikhathi salokhu kubusa, sikhombisile intuthuko ebonakalayo ekufezeni izinhloso esizibekile. Ibhajethi ka-2006/07 yakha phezu kwempumelelo le futhi ivumela ukuthi siqhubeke sihamba phambili ezinhlelweni zethu. Ibhajethi yalesi sikhathi iphinde ikhulise uxhaso lwezinkonzo zomphakathi, ithuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kanye nezindleko zokusebenza, ngaphandle kokuphuthelwa izinselelo ezikhona nezilindelekile. Ukwanda kokwabiwa kwezimali zokusebenza kuqinisa kakhulu ukuzibophezela kwethu ekukhuliseni umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokulwa nobuphofu. Lezi zimali zokusebenza zizodlulisela emisebenzini ephathelene nezinsiza ezizoba yisisekelo sokukhulisa umnotho nokudala imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwemizamo yokukhuthaza umnotho, siphinde sizibophezele ekwandiseni uxhaso olunikezwa ezinkonzo zomphakathi ngokwenza kube nempumelelo ukuthi u-80% wephakethe lethu lezimali unikezelwe kulolu hlobo lomphakathi. Izimali ezinikwe kulesi sikhungo sezokuhlaliswa zizobhekana nezidingo eziphuthumayo ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo, kuhlanganise nokusabalalisa izinsiza ezihlinzeka ngophenyo lwe-HIV ne-AIDS kubaguli, kanye nokuqhubeka kohlelo lokuvimbela i-HIV ne-AIDS. Sithemba ukuthi uzothola le ndatshana iyasiza ekuqondeni nasekuhlaziyeni ibhajethi yoHulumeni wePhondo laseGauteng. Kungani sidinga ibhajethi? Ibhajethi iyithuluzi elikhombisa ukuthi izimali ezitholakalayo zizosebenza kanjani. Ibhajethi ivumela ukuthi sihlele ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ngendlela ezosivumela ukuba sifinyelele izinhloso esizibekile. Sinomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina umphakathi unolwazi ngezinyathelo zoHulumeni nokuthi izimali zisetshenziswa kanjani. Ngokwethula ibhajethi, sikhombisa futhi uhlaka lokwabiwa nokubhekwa kwezimali ezinyathelweni zoHulumeni. Yiziphi izinto ezibalulekile zephondo nezicwangciso ezilandelwa nguHulumeni wePhondo laseGauteng? Emikhakheni yezomnotho, sigxila ekudaleni imisebenzi nasekukhuleni emikhakheni ethuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ezindaweni ezikhethiwe zelizwe, sikhangisa ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisayo nokuthuthukiswa komnotho wesifunda. Sigcizelela iGauteng njengendawo yokutshalwa kwezimali, indawo yokuvakasha, indawo yokusebenza, kanye nendawo yokuncintisana kwezokungcebeleka. Sidlala indima ebalulekile njengabathengi bezimpahla nezinsizakalo ukuze sithuthukise izinhloso zethu zomnotho, kuhlanganise nokweseka abakhiqizi bendawo nokwakha amandla abantu abamnyama nabesifazane emnothweni. Sisebenzisa ngokuphelele umhlaba wezolimo futhi sixhasa abalimi abasha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ezinsizeni nasekufinyeleleni emakethe. Ukwenza iGauteng ibe yisifunda esihlangene futhi esinokuncintisana kakhulu ezweni, lapho imisebenzi yezomnotho ezindaweni ezahlukene zephetho ihambisana nokukhulisa iGauteng njengendawo yokusebenza emnothweni e-Afrika nasemadolobheni azwakalayo kulo lonke izwe. I-Strategy yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa kweGauteng (GDS) ihlose ukubhekana nezinguquko zomphakathi nezomnotho esifundeni, ukugcina ukuzinza kwezepolitiki, ukwakha izinsiza ezisebenzayo zoHulumeni, ukukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho wesifunda, nokunciphisa amazinga aphezulu wokungasebenzi kanye nobuphofu. Ngokwenza: - ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezimo zomphakathi nezomnotho esifundeni ngokusekelwe ekplanini ehlanganisiwe, esezingeni eliphezulu, nasekuthatheni ingxenye. - ukuhlinzeka ukukhula komnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokufeza umbono wesifunda ezinyangeni eziyishumi ezizayo zokubusa ngentando yeningi. - ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kanye nobudlelwano phakathi koHulumeni nezinye izigaba zomphakathi. - ukuthola amathuba kuwo wonke amakhaya nabantu ukuze babambe iqhaza ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni isifunda. Izindawo zokuhlala ezintsha zizoba nazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo umphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi noma ngabe ngemuva kokuthi abahlali bangenile ezindlini ezintsha. Izinsiza zomphakathi zingaguqulwa njengoba umphakathi uthuthuka. Isibonelo, izikole ezindaweni ezikhulayo zingaguqulwa zibe izindawo zokuhlangana zomphakathi; lezi zinsiza kufanele zigcinwe futhi zisetshenziswe ngokuphelele. UHulumeni angakha izinsiza ezindaweni ezingenazo izinsiza noma ezindaweni ezibekelwe ukuhlala kwabantu; kuhlanganise neziteshi zeGautrain ezihlelwe, ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ezinsizweni nokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo. Umphakathi uthola zonke izinhlelo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo, kuhlanganise nokufinyelela emanzini ayisisekelo namandla kagesi mahhala. Izenzo zokuqala ezibaluleke kakhulu zizoba ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi kanye nezokuhlanzeka, ezidlala indima ebalulekile ekukhuthazeni impilo enhle. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezahlukene ezindaweni ezihlelwe kahle kuzofezwa ngokubambisana nomkhakha ozimele nezinye izithakazelo. Ikusasa lezindawo zokuhlala ezisemadolobheni sizobhekana nakho. Ukuvuselelwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezisemadolobheni kuzohilela ukubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zoHulumeni kanye nezitshalomali ezivela kokubili emkhakheni womphakathi nasemkhakheni ozimele ngendlela ethuthukisa izinzuzo. Ukugxila nasekuthuthukiseni imizamo yokukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho wendawo ukuze kuhanjiswe imisebenzi, kwakha izinsiza zomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kumathuba emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. UHulumeni uzogxila ekucwangcweni nasekuphatheni izitshalomali zawo ezindaweni ezithile ukuze wandise ukweseka kwawo. Ukwakhiwa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo ezophatha ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha zomphakathi kuzothuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezokuthutha okuphephile nokufaneleka, kunciphise isikhathi sokuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla esifundeni sethu nasemaphandleni, futhi kunciphise imiphumela emibi yokuphila kwezokuthutha. Ukwakha indawo yomphakathi ephephile nephilile ngokunciphisa ukuveliswa kwemfucumfucu, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo, nokubhekana nokungcoliswa komoya, amanzi, nomhlabathi. Ukubambisana nemiphakathi kanye nezokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha ezindaweni zomphakathi, ezindlini, ezindaweni zokusebenza, nasezikoleni, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane nezingane. Ukukhuthaza ukudla okunempilo nokuphila kahle. Izinhlelo zokuvikela nempilo zizokwakhiwa ukuvimbela izifo nokufa ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka, izingozi zomgwaqo, ingcindezi, i-HIV ne-AIDS, izindlela zokuphila ezingezinhle, nokuphuza utshwala ngokweqile. Ukutshala imali ezinganeni ngokuthuthukisa izinsiza ezib
Bika ochwepheshe bezilwane mayelana nezilwane eziphatha ngendlela engajwayelekile, futhi kuthathwa ukuthi kune-rabies. Abantu abathinteka ekutholeni i-rabies kufanele bavaccine ngaphambi kokungena kulezi zimo. Izikhungo zezempilo, odokotela, ama-Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), kanye nabahloli bezempilo kufanele baziwe ngokushesha. Abahloli bezempilo bahlola isimo, baphenya, futhi banikeza izeluleko (baphakamisa). Abahloli bezempilo baxhumana nochwepheshe bezilwane emikhankasweni yokuvaccine izilwane (ezisemakhaya) futhi bakhuthaze ukuqwashisa. I-rabies task force ikhulise ukufinyelela emphakathini. Isilwane esigulayo sishaywa, bese sithathwa. Kumuntu ogulayo, umusi uqoqwa ukuze uhlole. Isilwane es suspected ukuba ne-rabies siqedwa izinsuku eziyishumi ukuze kubonakale ukuthi sishintsha yini. Uma sikhombisa izimpawu ze-rabies, sihlinzwa ukuze ubuchopho buphathwe. Uma umuntu owashwe treated ngokushesha, ngeke agule noma afe. Umuntu owashwe akufanele ahlale umonakalo ngamanzi kanye ne-disinfectant imizuzu emihlanu ngaphambi kokuvakashela esibhedlela. Hamba esibhedlela esiseduzane. Udokotela noma um nurse uzosungula uhlelo lokuvikela i-rabies, oluhilela ukubulala i-rabies virus emzimbeni. Kubalulekile ukulandela zonke izithako kuze kube sekupheleni. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana nez authorities zezempilo noma isikhungo sezempilo. I-rabies yisifo esithathelwana esibangelwa yi-virus (germ) esinazo izilwane. Yisifo esidluliselwa esilwaneni esinombono ne-gazi elishisayo ukuya kwenye. I-rabies ivela ezilwaneni ezifana nezinja, amafene, amakati, ama-bats, kanye nama-raccoons. I-virus ikhona emusini lapho lesi sifo siqala. Umusi ongu-virus ungena kumuntu ngokushaywa noma ukugwaza, uma nje isikhumba sikhishwe. Le germ ihamba ngezinzwa kuze kube ifika ebuchopheni. Izilwane ezifele ne-rabies zingaba yingozi uma ziphathwa, zithinta ubuchopho, umusi, noma uma zicutshungulwa ngensimbi. Qaphela ukuthi i-rabies ithinta izinhliziyo nezimo, ibonakaliswa njengokuphatha kwezilwane okungajwayelekile. Izinguquko zokuziphatha (ukuhlukumeza), ukugwaza noma yini, ukungazinzi, ukwesaba, umusi omningi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuzilimaza, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela, amehlo agcwele, ukudideka, ukwenza izwi elingajwayelekile, ukungawuhloniphi umnikazi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela izinto ezingaliveki kanye nabantu, ukuzihlukanisa ezikhaleni, umusi omningi, ukugwaza, umusi omningi, kanye namahlo agcwele kungase kwenzeke. Umusi omningi, ukukhala okunamandla, ukuhlasela, ukuhamba okungadingekile, nokugaya amazinyo kungase kwenzeke. Baphenduka bangesabi abantu, bangena ezindlini nasemaphandleni, behlasela abantu nezilwane ngaphandle kokuxwayisa, futhi bafa ngokuzumayo. Kuthatha amasonto amabili kuya kumasonto ayishumi noma ngaphezulu ukuze umuntu owashwe isilwane esine-rabies akhombise izimpawu ze-rabies ezibangelwe yiso. Izimpawu zokuqala: umkhuhlane, headache, ukukhathazeka, ukuhamba, ukwesaba amanzi, ubuhlungu besikhathi, ukulahlekelwa isifiso sokudla, ukucasuka, ukungazinzi, ukuqubuka, bese kufa. Imigomo iphephile; ayizukwenza isilwane sakho sibe nesifo. Ungathinti noma ungasondeli esilwaneni ongasilazi, noma esibonakala singenamuntu, futhi ungakuphazamisi.
Yonke imfuyo ihlobene nokusetshenziswa komhlaba. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezikhathi ezahlukene zokuba nomhlaba. Akukhathazi kakhulu ukuthola uhlelo oluthile, kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi nokuqonda ukuthi yisiphi uhlelo olukhona endaweni okusebenza kuyo. Ingxenye yezinto ezibalulekile lokhu: thola imephu yephango lakho, ngoba uzoqala lapho uma ucabanga ukuthi ungaphumelela kanjani emsebenzini wakho wezolimo. Uma ungakwazi ukuthola imephu (kungase kube emhlabeni wonke umphakathi), zama ukuthola umuntu onenhloso ye-GPS ongakutshela ukuthi umhlaba wakho unjani. Khumbula, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umhlaba unjani ngoba zonke izibalo zezimali zihlobene nenani lamahhektare azokwenziwa. Inkinga enkulu ehambisana nokutholwa komhlaba nokuphathwa komhlaba yindaba yokubolekwa kwemali ngoba kudingeka ube nezehlakalo. Uma ungenayo imibhalo ekhombisa ukuthi ungumnikazi, awukwazi ukusebenzisa lowo mhlaba njengezehlakalo. Lokhu kungaba inkinga, kodwa uma usebenzisa le ndawo ukuthola imali ebolekiwe kulabo abolekayo, ungathola le mali. Uma ungakhiphi imali yakho, bazoba namandla okuthengisa konke okungelakho ukuze babuyise imali yabo. Lokhu kuyisimo esiqinile se "capitalism" (esisebenza emhlabeni jikelele). Kodwa wena, njengomqeqeshi, osaqala ukukhula kwezolimo, kufanele ufunde ukuthi ungangeni engozini yokulahlekelwa yizinto zakho zonke. Yingakho ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele uqale ngezinto ezincane, ungaboleki kakhulu - uma izinkinga zenzeka, ngeke ulahlekelwe yizinto zakho zonke. Uma usebenzisa umhlaba ophathelene nabantu bonke, ungakwazi ukuqala kule ndawo enikezwe umholi. Njengoba uqhubeka ubona ukuthi uzophumelela esikhathini esizayo, ungakwazi ukuqasha izindawo ezivela kumakhelwane abangazilimi. Khumbula, akekho ofuna ukuba umlimi; abathandi. Kukhona abalimi abanebhizinisi elihle kwezolimo kodwa balima emapulazini aphathelene nabantu bonke, bengenayo ngisho ihektare elilodwa elabo. Imvume yokulima umhlaba wesizwe? Imvume esemthethweni yokurenta? Ezinye izindawo kufanele zilimwe ngezindlela ezithile. Inani lokuna, isikhathi sokuqala nesokuphela sesizini yokukhula, kanye nobude bomhlabathi kuzokhombisa indlela yokulima. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi kukhona ithuba lokunisela le ndawo - ukunisela kudinga ukuphathwa njalo, kodwa akufanele ubhekane nenkinga yokushoda kwamanzi ngoba uzokwazi ukunisela uma kudingeka. Ezinye izindlela zokulima zidinga ugesi ukuze usebenzise imishini. Ukuvikelwa kubalulekile kakhulu; uma ungakwazi ukuvikela emapulazini akho, izinkomo zingangena, futhi ngeke uphumelele ekulimaleni kokudla. Kubalulekile ukusho izinombolo zamapulazi nezinkampanini. Thola usayizi wamapulazi nezinkampanini (uzodinga lokhu uma wakhe izinhlelo zomsebenzi wesikhathi esizayo nokubheka izindaba zezimali). Uma usayizi wendawo ungakhonjiswa kumamephu, kufanele uthole ulwazi ngenye indlela. Emhlabeni womphakathi, kuvame ukuthi amamephu angatholakali. Uzodinga imephu ye-GPS ezokunikeza ulwazi ngaleyo ndawo. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuthola usayizi wendawo ethile - ungahamba ulandele izinyathelo zakho, ungasebenzisa isondo elikhombisa ibanga, kodwa uma ufuna ukukala ngokunembile, sebenzisa i-GPS. Uhlobo lomhlabathi luhlobene nenani le-clay ne-sand ekhona emhlabathini. Ubude bomhlabathi bubheka ukuthi kukhona yini izingqimba ezizovimba izimpande ukuthi zikhule - sibona lokhu uma sigcwalisa umgodi ojulile. Kubalulekile ukuhlola isimo somhlabathi ngoba sizokhombisa ukuthi sizosetshenziswa kanjani njengamanje nangesikhathi esizayo. Kuzoba nezindawo lapho kungakabi khona okuzolima - imigwaqo nendawo lapho kuzokwakhiwa khona izindlu. Kubalulekile ukuthatha amasampula njalo eminyakeni emibili. Izindleko ze-fertilizer ziyisici esikhulu uma ulima ukudla, ngakho kufanele uqonde kahle ukuthi yisiphi isihlahla sokufaka kanye nenani elidingekayo emapulazini athile. Umfuyi uzodinga ukukhokha ukuthatha amasampula. Nokho, le mali izosebenza kuwe esikhathini esizayo; ngeke uyichithe. Landela indlela efanele uma uthatha amasampula. Thatha amasampula emhlabathini ophakeme nasezansi. Iphampu ngayinye kufanele ibe nelebula elinamagama kanye nekheli lomfuyi, igama lephango, kanye nenombolo yephampu. Buza ngomyalezo mayelana nohlobo lwe-fertilizer naleso sikhathi. Futhi nenani lokukhiqiza ofuna ukukufeza. Uthola malini amanzi okumele usebenzise?

Lapho sibheka lokhu, sigxila kumasevisi amakhasimende ngaphakathi nangaphandle komsebenzi. Lokhu kusiza ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana ukufaka izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye. Lezi zimiso zisebenza njengophawu lokuthi amakhasimende anelisekile ngosizo abawatholayo noma ukuthi kuthuthukiswa okusemthethweni. Konke lokhu kuyazama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende ayazi futhi aqonde ukuthi angazisebenzisa ngokukhululeka amalungelo awo njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwezinsizakalo zeBatho Pele.
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo Izindawo zasemakhaya eLimpopo zibhekene nenkinga enkulu yokushoda kodokotela, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu abaningi behlupheka ngenxa yokungabi nakho ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokwelapha ezifanele. Uhlaka lwezempilo lukhombisa ukuthi nakuba kunabantu abaningi basemakhaya, inani lamadokotela alindelekile lincane kakhulu. Ngokwezibalo, kunezindawo eziningi ezinemitholampilo engaphansi kokusebenza, futhi ezinye zazo azinamdokotela nhlobo. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, njengoba abantu behluleka ukuthola imithi, izeluleko, kanye nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. UProf. Thandiwe Mkhize, odokotela ophakathi kwezempilo eLimpopo, uthe: “Ukushoda kodokotela kuyingxenye ebalulekile, futhi kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo. Abantu badinga ukwelashwa okusheshayo, kodwa uma kufanele baphumele emitholampilo imizuzu engama-30 noma ngaphezulu, lokho kuyabahlupha.” Izizathu zokushoda kodokotela ziningi. Isizathu sokuqala siwukuhola okuphansi, okuvimbela odokotela abasha ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Abantu abaningi bakhetha ukusebenza ezindaweni ezinkulu, lapho behola kahle futhi bethola izinsiza ezinhle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izindawo ezisemakhaya zihlale zinesimo sokushoda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengemitholampilo efanele, izithuthi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana, kudala ubunzima ekusebenzeni kodokotela. UProf. Mkhize uqhubekile: “Kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zempilo, ukuze sikwazi ukuheha odokotela abasha, futhi sithuthukise izimo zokusebenza.” Abahlali bezindawo zasemakhaya baveza ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngalolu daba. UMaMkhize, ohlala edolobheni elincane laseLimpopo, uthe: “Ngiyazama ukuthola usizo emitholampilo, kodwa ngithola ukuthi akukwaziwa. Ngithumele emitholampilo eminingi, kodwa abanye bahlali bahlala belindile izinsuku eziningi.” Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezindawo zasemakhaya luphinde lwenze kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlale bephila ngaphandle kokwelashwa, okukhombisa izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nezempilo zomphakathi. Izinyathelo zokuxazulula le nkinga zidinga ukuba zibe phezulu. Uhulumeni kufanele aqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokukhuthaza abanikazi bezemfundo ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo kubodokotela abasha, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Uhlelo lwezempilo oluphumelelayo luyadingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu. Ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, odokotela, kanye nohulumeni kudinga ukuba kube namandla, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo zidinga ukuba zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuxazululeni le nkinga. UProf. Mkhize wagcizelela: “Sidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha odokotela, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithola usizo oludingekayo.” Ekupheleni, ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukusizakala ngokuphuthumayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithola usizo lwezempilo olufanele, kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo eziphuthumayo nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lwezempilo kumele luhlelwe kabusha ukuze luhambisane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlali bahlala bezithola usizo lwezempilo olufanele.
Izinkinga zokungcola komoya Ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngikhulume ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile, esithinta impilo yethu sonke. Uma sikhuluma ngengcindezi yomoya, sizobe sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, izindawo esihlala kuzo, nemiphumela yokungcola komoya. Akukhona nje ukuthi umoya opholile uhleli njalo, kodwa izinkinga zokungcola komoya zikhona, zihlala zikhona, futhi ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. Okokuqala, ake sibe nokuqonda okukhulu ngobungozi bokungcola komoya. Umoya opholile ungaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni yethu, kodwa uma kukhona ukungcola, lokho kungenza kube nenkinga. Izinto ezinjengomoya omubi, ukungcola okuvela ezimbonini, ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezithile, kanye nokungcola okuvela ezithuthumelweni, konke lokhu kudala izinkinga. Abanye abantu bangase bahlupheke ngezinkinga zezempilo ezinjengokuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokuphefumula, izifo zesikhumba, nemiphumela emibi kwi-immune system. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma ngezindawo eziphila khona, sizobona ukuthi izinkinga zokungcola komoya zinezimpande ezijulile. Izindawo ezisemadolobheni, lapho abantu behlala bejwayele ukungcola, ziba nemiphumela emibi. Ukuhlanzeka kwendawo kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sigweme lokhu. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhuluma ngempilo yethu kuphela, kodwa futhi kusemqoka ukuthuthukisa izindawo esihlala kuzo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, sithola ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukungcola komoya zibaluleke kakhulu. Izinhlelo ezahlukene zinesibopho sokuthuthukisa isimo somoya. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya, ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo yokuvuselela, nokusebenza ngokuqinile ekulwisaneni nokungcola. Imiphakathi ingaqala izinhlelo zokuhlola umoya, futhi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi izinga lokungcola likuphi, bese bethatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Noma kunjalo, akukhona kuphela amazwe noma izindawo ezikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Kukhona nezindawo ezithile ezifundisa abantu ngokuqonda ubungozi bokungcola komoya. Ukuqwashisa abantu ngezingozi ezingase zibe khona, kunikeza ithuba lokuthi bazi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma abantu bebambisene, ngezenzo ezincane, njenge ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukusebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi, noma ukuzama ukunciphisa ukuhamba ngemoto. Kukhona futhi izifundo ezithathwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe. Abantu bahlala befundiswa ngezindlela zokunciphisa ukungcola. Lokhu kungaba ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezikhiqiza ukungcola, noma ukujolisa ekutholeni izixazululo ezivuselelwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi umuntu ngamunye unendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni isimo somoya. Kodwa, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona okunokuthula. Kunobunzima obukhona uma kuziwa ekuphenduleni lezi zinkinga. Abanye abantu basabela ngezindlela ezithile, futhi lokhu kungadala okungafani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sihloniphe izinkolelo zabanye, futhi sikhulume ngendlela efanele ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokugcinwa kokukhuluma ngezinselelo ezihambisana nokungcola komoya, kufanele siqonde ukuthi sihamba phambili. Ngabe sikhona isinyathelo esithathwayo? Yebo, sikhona! Uma abantu bebandakanyeka, behlangana, futhi besebenza ngokubambisana, bangakwazi ukuqeda lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma kuziwa ekuboniseni abantu ukuthi bahloniphe umoya, baluphathe kahle, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izindawo zabo zihlanzekile. Ngakho, ngemuva kokukhuluma ngezinkinga zokungcola komoya, ngiyafisa ukukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba acabange kahle ngalokhu. Umoya opholile, impilo enhle, nezindawo ezinhle, konke kuxhumene. Khumbulani, sisonke kulesi sikhathi, futhi uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane, sizokwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. Lokhu akuyona nje indaba yokuhlanzeka, kodwa indaba yokuphila kwethu sonke, kanti impilo yethu iyafaneleka. Lokhu kufanele kube umgomo wethu sonke, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umoya esiwuphefumulayo uhle, umphakathi uhle, futhi impilo yethu ihlale iphilile. Ngiyabonga.
Umbiko Ngemikhankaso YeZindiza eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Izindiza zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla emhlabeni jikelele. E-Ningizimu Afrika, izindiza zidlala indima enkulu ekuxhumaneni kwezindawo ezahlukene, zikhuthaza ukuhweba, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezokuvakasha. Lo mbiko uzogxila ekuthuthukisweni kwezindiza, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nemithelela yazo emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezindiza Eminyakeni edlule, umkhakha wezindiza eNingizimu Afrika ube nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabagibeli, izinkampani zezindiza zikhulise izinsizakalo zazo, zengeza izindiza ezintsha, futhi zathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza. Izinkampani ezinjenge-South African Airways, kulindeleke ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bathola ulwazi oluhle. Izinkampani Ezihamba Phambili I-South African Airways (SAA) iyinkampani enkulu kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, inezindiza ezihamba emhlabeni jikelele. I-SAA ibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, ikakhulukazi ezindizeni ezide. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-Mango Airlines, eyaziwa ngokuba nezindleko eziphansi, ibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezishibhile kubagibeli. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinkampani ezincane ezikhula ngokushesha, ezifana ne-FlySafair, ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezishibhile ezindizeni ezimfushane. Imithelela Emnothweni Umkhakha wezindiza unomthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthuthukisa imisebenzi, uthuthukisa ukuhweba, futhi ukhuthaza ukuvakasha. Ngokuhamba kwezindiza, izivakashi zifika eNingizimu Afrika, zikhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi emikhakheni ehlukene, njengokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokwelapha. Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma kunjalo, umkhakha wezindiza ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhulayo, izindleko eziphezulu zokusebenza, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphephile, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye buba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezindiza. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezindiza eziphakeme, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezindiza zenza kube lula ukuhamba. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abahambi bathola ulwazi olusheshayo nolunembile. Izinsiza Zokuhamba Izinsiza zokuhamba zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wezindiza. Izikhumulo zezindiza ezifana ne-O.R. Tambo International Airport, Cape Town International Airport, kanye ne-King Shaka International Airport zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu. Lezi zikhumulo zihlala zithuthukiswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abahambi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, umkhakha wezindiza eNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuze uqhubeke nokukhula, izinkampani zidinga ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwandisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nabanye abathintekayo kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha. Isiphetho Izindiza zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu eNingizimu Afrika. Zikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza ukuhweba, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu. Noma kunezinselelo eziningi, umkhakha wezindiza ubheke phambili, uqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha wezindiza uhlala unempumelelo, uhlanganisa abantu, futhi uthuthukisa umnotho.
Bonke ababukeli bazibeka engozini ngokungena ezihlahleni zik governo. Wonke umuntu ongene esihlahleni zik governo kumele aziphathe ngendlela ephephile nephakeme, ecabangela abanye abantu abasebenzisa le ndawo. Imali ethile ingakhokhiswa uma ufuna ukwenza imisebenzi ethile noma uma ufuna nje ukungena; kulokhu, uzonikezwa imvume ehlukile. Ukungena kuvunyelwe phakathi kuka-06:00 no-18:00 ezinsukwini ezichaziwe, ngaphandle uma uvunyelwe ukuba uhambe, uhambe ebusuku, noma ezinye imisebenzi. Imicimbi ehlobene nokuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokomoya ingabanjwa ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo. Amabhodi wezaziso nezimpawu kumele ahlonishwe ezihlahleni zik governo. Umphakathi awuvunyelwe ukungena ezihlahleni zik governo noma kunoma yisiphi isigaba saso, futhi ukuvutha imililo ezindaweni ezibekiwe akuvunyelwe ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsindo noma noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungaphazamisa abanye abasebenzisi bezihlahleni zik governo noma izilwane zasendle akuvunyelwe. Ukuvutha imililo akuvunyelwe, ngaphandle ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo. Imililo kumele ingashiywa inganakekelwa, futhi kumele icinywe ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Akuvunyelwe ukuhlekisa, noma ukususa udoti ezihlahleni zik governo, ngaphandle uma kudedelwa ezitolo ezibekiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa umngcele, udonga, amabhodi ezaziso, noma noma yini enye ezihlahleni zik governo ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuphazamiseka kwemisebenzi yokuphatha ezihlahleni zik governo, futhi akekho ovunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo lapho abasebenzi benza khona umsebenzi noma lapho impahla yesihlahla isetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa, noma ukwenza uphawu oluthile ezitini, ezihlahleni, noma kunoma yiziphi izitshalo ezihlahleni zik governo. Noma ubani otholakala ethanga noma efinyelela, ebulala, noma eqoqela izilwane, izinyoni, izimpukane, izinhlanzi, noma ezinye izilwane zasendle ngaphandle kwemvume noma enye imvume uphula umthetho. Ukudla izilwane ezihlahleni zik governo akuvunyelwe. Izibhamu, ama-bows, ama-crossbows, nezinye izikhali zokuthunga akuvunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo ngaphandle kwemvume yokuthunga. Izinja, izilwane zasekhaya, nezinye izilwane azivunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo, ngaphandle kwamahhashi uma kuvunyelwe ukuhamba ezindleleni zamahhashi. Ukugeza nokuthanga kuvunyelwe kuphela ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo. Ukukh campa, uma kuvunyelwe, kumele kwenziwe kuphela ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo uma imali efanele ikhishwe. Ukusebenzisa noma ukusebenza ngama-drones, izindiza ezinamandla, ukuhamba nge-paragliding, ama-ultralights, amabhola, kanye ne-parachutes akuvunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo. Ukusebenzisa noma ukuphatha ama-explosives akuvunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo. Akukho mthelela noma izindleko ezizothwalwa nguhulumeni ngenxa yokulimala kwempahla yababukeli ezihlahleni zik governo ngenxa yezenzo ezithathwe nguhulumeni noma ezenziwa egameni likahulumeni noma ngenxa yanoma yisiphi isizathu, ngaphandle uma lokho kulimala kwenzeka ngenxa yokunganaki kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni ngesikhathi benza imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Ababukeli bezihlahleni zik governo bazoba nesibopho sokulimala okwenziwe ezinsizeni zesihlahla nezinye impahla zik governo okungase kube nemiphumela ngenxa yezenzo zabo. Izimo, izimali, noma izimvume ezithile zingadingeka emicimbini ethile, ezindaweni ezithile, nasemazweni athile (buka izixhumanisi nezindawo zemicimbi).
Ubuhle Bemvelo: Ukubuyisela Uthando Lwethu Emhlabeni Emhlabeni wethu, ubuhle bemvelo bujabulisa amehlo futhi budlulisa umoya opholile. Njengoba sihamba ezindaweni ezahlukene, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu, izintaba eziphakeme, nemifula egijimayo, zonke zikhumbuza ukuthi sinesibopho sokuvikela lezi zinto ezinhle. Lezi zinto zembuliwe zempilo zishiwo ngothando nohlonze, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sizigcinile njengezimpahla zomhlaba. Uma ubheka izinkanyezi ebusuku, uzwa umoya opholile uthintwa ubukhazikhazi besibhakabhaka. Ukubona izinkanyezi, umhlaba ubonakala ungowethukile, udinga ukuboniswa. Iphupho lokuba sesihlalweni semvelo, sithokozisa ukuphila, kukhumbuza ngempilo yethu. Kodwa uma sicabanga ngothando lwethu oluphakade endaweni yethu, kudinga ukuthi siqonde ukuthi izinkanyezi azikhaliphile kuphela, kodwa ziqinisekisa ukuthi siphila kancane. Izintaba zikhumbuza ngempilo engapheli, izitshalo ezikhula khona, izinyoni ezindizayo, kanye nezilwane ezihlala kuwo. Izintaba zikhona ukuze ziqinise umoya wethu, zikhumbuze ukuthi siphila kancane, zifundisa uthando lokuba yinxenye yalesi sikhathi esihle. Njengoba sithokozisa lezi zintaba, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuzigcina, ukuze ezizukulwaneni ezizayo zikwazi ukuzithokozisa. Izimanga zemvelo, njengezihlahla ezinkulu nezigodi ezijabulisayo, zibonisa ubuchwepheshe bezimbali. Lezi zinto zikhombisa ukuthi umhlaba unamandla okwakha, wokuphila. Izimanga zikhombisa ukuthi, noma imiphi imizamo yethu, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sinesibopho sokukhetha indlela esizohamba ngayo. Umhlaba unamandla, futhi lesi sikhathi sethu sokubuyisela ubuhle bemvelo kudinga ukuthi siphatheka kahle. Umoya ojulile, imvula ethulile, kanye nezimbali ezihlaza, zonke zikhumbuza ukuthi siphila emhlabeni okhanyayo. Njengoba sihamba emhlabeni, kufanele sithokozise ubuhle bayo, sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuvikela lezi zinto ezinhle. Ubuhle bemvelo abungangeni ezincwadini kuphela, kodwa buxhumene nempilo yethu. Ukugcina ubuhle bemvelo, kusinika amandla okuphila kahle, futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Sesikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo busuke budinga ukuthokoziswa, sithinteke kakhudlwana. Umhlaba unamandla okwakha, futhi kufanele sibe nebanga lokuphila ngokwenhlonipho. Umoya opholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nezintaba eziphakeme, bonke bembula ubuhle besimo, futhi kufanele sithokozise lokhu ngokugcina intshisekelo yokubuyisela umhlaba. Ukubheke phambili, sinesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo buyinkanyezi esikhanyayo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuvikela lezi zinto ezinhle. Umhlaba uhlezi ubuso, ubuhle bayo bukhumbuza ukuba sibe nokuqonda. Ubuhle bemvelo buhamba noxolo, futhi uma sithokozisa lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukubuyisela uthando lwethu emhlabeni. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo abukhona kuphela kumasiko, kodwa bukhona nakwimicimbi yokuphila. Kulabo abahlala eduze kwemvelo, ubuhle bayo buhamba noxolo. Umoya opholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nemvula ethulile, zonke zikhumbuza ukuthi sithokozisa izimanga ezikhona emhlabeni. Ubuhle bemvelo bukhona ukuze busisize, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sinesibopho sokuphila kancane. Ngakho-ke, masithokozise ubuhle bemvelo, masigcine lezi zinto ezinhle, ukuze ezizukulwaneni ezizayo zikwazi ukuzithokozisa. Umhlaba uhlezi ubuso, ubuhle bemvelo bukhona ukuze busikhumbuze ukuthi sinesibopho sokuphila. Ubuhle bemvelo buyinkanyezi esikhanyayo, futhi uma sithokozisa lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukubuyisela uthando lwethu emhlabeni. Sisebenzele umhlaba, sikhumbule ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo buhamba noxolo, futhi kufanele sithokozise lezi zinto ukuze zihlale zikhona.
Ezamabhange - Ingxoxo NgeMali Nezindlela Zokuphatha Isingeniso Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile empilweni yethu: ezamabhange. Njengoba umnotho wethu uqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amabhange adlala kanjani indima ebalulekile ekuphatheni kwemali. Ngakho-ke, ngihlangana noMnu. Ndlovu, umphakathi wezokuphatha imali, ukuze sithole ulwazi olwengeziwe. Ingxenye 1: Ukwazi Amabhange Mnu. Ndlovu, ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukungihlanganyela. Ngicela uqale usichazele ukuthi amabhange ayini futhi adlala kanjani indima empilweni yethu? Mnu. Ndlovu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukusiza. Amabhange, ngokuyisisekelo, angamabhizinisi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlobene nemali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukugcina imali, ukuhweba, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubolekwa kwemali. Amabhange akha isikhala sokuhweba phakathi kwabantu abadinga imali nababambisene nabanye ukuze bathole inzuzo. Ingxenye 2: Izinsizakalo Zokubolekwa Kwezimali Ngabe ungachaza kabanzi ngezinsizakalo zokubolekwa kwemali ezitholakala kumabhange? Mnu. Ndlovu: Yebo, amabhange anikeza izinhlobo ezahlukene zokubolekwa kwemali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izikweletu, izikweletu zezimoto, nezikweletu zokwakha. Umuntu ofuna ukubolekwa imali kufanele ahlangabezane nezidingo ezithile, njengezinga lokubuyisela kanye nomlando wokukhokha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola imali ngendlela efanele. Ingxenye 3: Ukuphatha Imali Kubaluleke kangakanani ukuphatha imali kahle, futhi amabhange angasiza kanjani kulokhu? Mnu. Ndlovu: Ukuphatha imali kahle kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela ikusasa lethu. Amabhange ahlinzeka ngama-akhawunti okonga, okwenza kube lula ukugcina imali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange anikeza izeluleko zokuphatha imali, okungasiza abantu ukuthi baqonde ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani imali yabo ngendlela efanele. Ingxenye 4: Ukuvikeleka Kwezimali Ngabe amabhange anikeza izindlela zokuvikela imali yethu? Mnu. Ndlovu: Impela! Amabhange asebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuvikela ulwazi lwezokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ama-passwords, ama-firewalls, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izigameko eziphawulekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange abhalisela ukuvikela amaklayenti awo ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali okwenziwa ngezinga eliphezulu. Ingxenye 5: Ubuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Ubuchwepheshe busebenza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zamabhange? Mnu. Ndlovu: Ubuchwepheshe buphinde bube nomthelela omkhulu emalini. Amabhange manje asebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezitholakala kumafoni ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlela izimali zabo kalula. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuthi basebenzise izinsizakalo zamabhange, futhi kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imali. Ingxenye 6: Izinkinga Nezinselelo Yiziphi izinkinga ezivamile abantu ababhekana nazo uma bephatha imali? Mnu. Ndlovu: Ezinye zezinkinga ezivamile zifaka phakathi ukungakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu, ukungabi nezinhlelo zokuphatha imali, kanye nokungabi nesiqiniseko sokuthi izinqumo zabo zezimali zifanele. Amabhange azama ukusiza abantu ngokuhlinzeka ngama-seminar nokufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphatha imali. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Ndlovu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile yezamabhange. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukuqonda amabhange kuzosiza abantu abaningi ukuthi baphathe kahle izimali zabo. Ngiyabonga futhi ngiyaphinda ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi. Mnu. Ndlovu: Ngiyabonga, kuyajabulisa ukusiza. Ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazothola ulwazi oluwusizo. Ngokuphetha, amabhange adlala indima ebalulekile ekuphatheni kwemali. Ukuqonda izinsizakalo zawo, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Izimakethe Zebhizinisi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimfuno Nezinguquko Ezibalulekile Ngokubika: UThandiwe Mkhize Ezimakethe zebhizinisi, izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka njengoba izinkampani zibhekana nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zamakhasimende, ubuchwepheshe obusha, kanye nezimo zomnotho eziguqukayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izimakethe zebhizinisi zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umnotho, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe nguMnyango Wezohwebo, izimakethe zebhizinisi zikhula ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kubonakala emikhakheni ehlukene efana nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Izinkampani zikhuthazwa ukuba zisebenzise izindlela ezintsha zokukhangisa, zifake ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zithole izinzuzo ezinkulu emakethe. Ukwanda kokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, njengokufaka i-AI (Artificial Intelligence) kanye ne-automation, kuveze izinguquko ezinkulu ezimakethe zebhizinisi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwandisa ukukhiqiza nokunciphisa izindleko. Izinkampani ezisebenzisa lezi zindlela zikhombisa ukuthi zingakwazi ukuncintisana kangcono emakethe. Mayelana nezidingo zamakhasimende, izinkampani zidinga ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yini efunwa yizigidi zabathengi. Lokhu kudinga ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze kuqondwe izitayela zokuthenga, izifiso, nezidingo ezithile. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekwakheni imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, ethuthukisiwe, futhi ehambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Ukwengeza, izimakethe zebhizinisi zikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu ngenxa yokwanda kokuxhumana. I-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ziguqule indlela izinkampani ezithengisa ngayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuxhumana phakathi kwezinkampani nabathengi, okuvumela ukuxhumana okuqondile nokusheshayo. Izinkampani ezisebenzisa lezi zindlela zikhombisa ukuphumelela okukhulu. Nokho, izimakethe zebhizinisi azikhululi kuphela izinzuzo; ziveza nezinselelo ezinzima. Izinkampani zibhekana nezinkinga ezifana nokuncintisana okuqinile, izindleko eziphezulu zokukhiqiza, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo ezimakethe. Lokhu kudinga izinkampani ukuba zibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha izingozi, ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezimakethe zebhizinisi wukushintsha kwemithetho nemigomo. Izinkampani zidinga ukuhambisana nemithetho emisha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokusebenza, ezokuphepha, kanye nezokukhuthaza imvelo. Lokhu kudinga izinkampani ukuba zihlale ziqaphela futhi ziqonde kahle izinguquko ezenzakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimakethe zebhizinisi zikhombisa ubudlelwano obunamandla phakathi kwezinkampani. Ukuze zikwazi ukuphumelela, izinkampani zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabahlinzeki, abathengisi, kanye nezinkampani ezihlobene. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukwethembana, kanye nokubambisana ukuze kuzuze bonke abathintekayo. Izinkampani ezithola impumelelo emakethe zebhizinisi zikhombisa izici ezithile ezibalulekile, ezifaka phakathi ukufunda okuqhubekayo, ukuhamba phambili ngobuchwepheshe, kanye nokuba necebo eliqinile lokumaketha. Ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili, izinkampani zidinga ukwakha umqondo wokuvula, ukuze zikwazi ukufaka izinguquko ezidingekayo. Ngokuphetha, izimakethe zebhizinisi zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, zikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta izinkampani, abathengi, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili, izinkampani zidinga ukuziqonda kahle izimakethe, zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi zibe necebo eliqinile lokuphatha izingozi. Njengoba izimakethe ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zihlale ziqaphela futhi zisebenzise amathuba avulekile ukuze zibe nempumelelo esikhathini esizayo.
AmaXhosa: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha Isiko Nezinkolelo Ngaphakathi kwezintaba ezinhle zaseMpuma Koloni, umcimbi omkhulu wamaXhosa ubusuku nemini uhlelwe ukuze kuhlonishwe isiko, ubuciko, nezinkolelo zalesi sihlanganyelo esiyingqayizivele. Umcimbi, owawubanjelwe emzaneni waseQonce, wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulile futhi bephakamisela phezulu izinkumbulo zabo ezinhle. Umsindo wezinsimbi zendabuko, izigubhu, nezinsimbi zomculo zashaya umoya, zikhumbuza bonke abakhona ngempilo yamaXhosa. Abantu bahlangana emaphandleni, behamba ngezinyawo, bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo, behlanganisa imindeni, abantwana, nabadala. Umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhlonipha, njengoba abantu bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yokwamukela, lapho abaholi bendawo baphakamisa izwi labo, bechaza ukubaluleka kokugcina isiko lethu. Ubhala izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, uMnu. Mkhize, uthe: “Isiko lethu liyingxenye yethu, futhi kufanele siligcine, silondoloze, futhi sithuthukise.” Le nkulumo yakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza, futhi kwavela umoya wokubambisana. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezinkanyezi ezihlukahlukene zamasiko, lapho abaculi bendawo bephakamisa izwi labo ngezinkondlo, izinganekwane, nezindaba ezithokozisayo. Abantu babebukele, bejabulela ubuciko obuhlukahlukene, futhi bephendula ngezithakazelo zabo. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abantu behlanganyela ezindabeni zabo, bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nezinkanyezi zokudla, lapho abantu bejabulisa izitsha ezilungiselelwe ngothando. Izitsha zendabuko, ezifana ne-umngqusho, i-chakalaka, ne-bobotie, zathokozisa wonke umuntu. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu babelana ngezindlela zabo zokupheka, bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo, futhi bephakamisa izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa imidlalo yendabuko, efana ne-ukuthunga, ne-ukugida, lapho abantu bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo, bephakamisa umoya wokuncintisana. Abantwana babebonisa amakhono abo, bejabulisa bonke abakhona, futhi lokhu kwavusa umoya wokuhlonipha phakathi kwezizukulwane. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, kwavela ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Abaholi bendawo baphakamisa izwi labo, bexoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, beqinisekisa ukuthi izwi labantu lizwa. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abantu behlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Umcimbi wamaXhosa wawungaphezu kokuhlonipha isiko; wawuwumcimbi wokubumbana, wokuhlanganyela, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba ubusuku buhamba, abantu bahlala behlangene, bejabulela umoya wokuhlonipha, ubumbano, kanye nezinkumbulo ezinhle. Umcimbi waphothulwa ngenkulumo yokubonga, lapho abaholi bendawo baphakamisa izwi labo, bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baphuma emcimbini bejabule, bephakamisa izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi bejabulisa izithakazelo zabo. Umoya wokuhlonipha, ubumbano, kanye nezinkumbulo ezinhle wahlala ungena ezinhliziyweni zabo, uqinisekisa ukuthi isiko lamaXhosa lihlala lihlala lukhanya, luthokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Umcimbi wamaXhosa wawungumcimbi obalulekile, owawuhlanganisa abantu, ubuciko, nezinkolelo, uqinisekisa ukuthi isiko lethu lihlala lihlala lukhanya, luthokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi, ngisho noma izikhathi zishintsha, isiko lethu lihlala lihlala lukhanya, luthokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo.
Sawubona bafana, niyaphi? O, cha, thina siphinde siye ePolokwane! O, phuma. Le nkampani ibhadiwe, forget ukushintsha amagama ezindawo ngaphandle kwesizathu. Bafana! Ngalmost ngilahlekelwe ithuba lokuthola ukushayela ngenxa yalokho. Angikuthandi nhlobo. Leli zwe lidinga imali yokwakha izindlu nokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS, kodwa esikhundleni salokho, siphuma ezivakashi ezweni lethu. Asazi ukuthi siya kuphi! Bangobani laba bantu abashintsha amagama ezwe lethu? Vuka mfana, ukushintsha amagama akukhona nje ukuthola ukushayela ukuya endaweni ethile. Kuqondene nokunikeza igama elihle ezweni lethu, umlando wethu, kanye nesiko lethu. Singakuthuthukisa kanjani izwe lethu emphakathini wamazwe omhlaba uma sisasebenzisa amagama athathwe kwamanye amazwe? Sidinga ukuthuthukisa izwe lethu, sikhombise ubunikazi bethu bangempela. Sidinga ukwazisa umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba ukuthi singobani ngempela! Lokhu kushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo zomhlaba kuyindaba ebucayi kakhulu! Bheka lapha kulolu doc, uma usuwenze lokho, sizoxoxa ngalolu daba. Sikude lapho siya khona, ngakho sinesikhathi sokuxoxa ngakho. Ngamagama ezici zomhlaba ezisemthethweni, ezenziwe noma ezishintshwe abantu, zingase zibe nezakhamuzi noma zingabi nazo. I-SAGNC yasungulwa nguMthetho weSouth African Geographical Names Council (Umthetho No. 111 ka-1998) njengesisekelo sokubhekelela ukushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo zomhlaba eNingizimu Afrika. Yasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko. I-SAGNC ifaka ochwepheshe kumagama ezindawo, izilimi ezisemthethweni, umlando wesiko, ummeleli ovela kwiphondo ngalinye, abamele bonke amaprovinsi, kanye nabamele uMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Nezinguquko Zomhlaba, iPosi, iSouth African Languages Board, nezinye izikhungo ezihlobene. Isisekelo sokuphatha se-SAGNC sisebenza ngeKomidi Lezindawo Zomhlaba ZasePhondweni kanti izinga likamasipala lisebenza ngeKomidi Lezindawo Zasekhaya Nezasezindaweni. Kufanele ukwazi ukufinyelela lezi zakhiwo endaweni yakho. Ukuze kube lula, kuhlobene namagama ezici zomhlaba zezinye izinto ezweni. Ngamagama abhaliswe ngokomthetho. Isibonelo, igama lezwe, amagama amaprovinsi, namagama emiphakathi kanye nezinto eziphethwe ngamasipala ezifana nezindlela, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izikwele, amapaki, nezindela. Bese kuba nezakhiwo nezindawo eziphethwe ngabantu abazimele. Ngendlela efanayo, amagama ezici zomhlaba asetshenziselwa ukubhaliswa komhlaba aziwa njengezamaCadastral.
