Nokho, wonke amagama asemthethweni kumele ahambisane nemigomo yokubiza ye-SAGNC. Abantu bavame ukunikeza igama elilodwa ezindaweni ezahlukene noma amagama alingana noma afana kakhulu njengoba abhalwe kwenye indawo. Ezweni elinamagama amaningi njengeNingizimu Afrika, izindawo zivame ukuba namagama amaningi. Lezi zimo zikhokelela ekuqondeni okungalungile nasekudidekeni. Ukuze kugwenywe lokho, emhlabeni jikelele, amagama ezindawo alawulwa ngababusi. Kubalulekile ukuhlela amagama ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando nezimpawu zezwe ziyaqashelwa ngokwezwekazi nezohwebo, ukuthuthwa, ukuxhumana, ukuhlela izifunda nezemvelo, imisebenzi yomphakathi, isayensi nobuchwepheshe, ukhetho nezibalo, ezokuvakasha, ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezokuhlonza nokuhlenga. I-SAGNC yenze isinqumo sokugcina sokuthi amagama azophakanyiswa kuNgqongqoshe. Uma igama liqinisekiswe nguNgqongqoshe, lelo gama libonwa ngokofficial. Lishicilelwa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni ukuze libe semthethweni futhi limemezelwe. Ikhansela ihlangana kathathu ngonyaka. Ngoba ukuhamba kwesikhathi kuvame ukwenzeka ngenxa yolwazi olungaphelele noma olungalungile efomini yokufaka, abafakizicelo kufanele bazi ukuthi ukuvunywa kwegama kungaba yinqubo ende. Kumele kubhekwane nakho lapho kuhlelwa ukuthi isikhathi sokulinda singathatha okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe lapho kugcwaliswa ifomu ukuthi igcwaliswe kahle ukuze kugwenywe ukuhamba kwesikhathi okude. Noma ubani angathola ifomu lokufaka kwiwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko ku-www.dac.gov.za, emahhovisi kazwelonke, amaprovinsi, kanye namahhovisi endawo asebenza namagama ezindawo, noma ungafaka isicelo ku-www.sagns.gov.za. Ngaphambi kokugcwalisa ifomu lokufaka, kufanele ulifunde kahle futhi ugweme lokhu... Amagama abantu abaphilayo kufanele futhi agwenywe. Izici zomhlaba ezibizwa ngamagama abantu kufanele zihambisane nobungcweti balowo muntu. Ngokulula, kukhombisa okuthile okubucayi ngomuntu ophakeme ezweni lonke. Kulungile, ngiyaphendukela lapha. I-Polokwane ikhulu elingu-15 phambili. Jabulela ukuvakashela kwakho! Ngiyabonga ngokusipha uhambo. Impela, ngiyabonga, uhamba ngokuphumelelayo.
Qaphela: 1. Izincwadi ezithunyelwe ngabanye abantu noma eminye imibhalo yokweseka leli cala kumele ifakwe kule fomu. Uyanqotshwa ukuthi inkantolo ye-equity ingadlulisela le ndaba kwenye inkantolo noma itiriyoni. Uma le ndaba ibuyiselwa enkantolo ye-equity, umgibeli wenkantolo uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngalokho. Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, thumela imininingwane bese uyifaka kule fomu, ubhalela zonke amakhasi. Engxenyeni C: IMINININGWANE YE-PLAINTIFF/DEFENDANTS imininingwane elandelayo kumele ihlinzekwe kumuntu ngamunye owayebanga. Uhlobo lokuphikisa: ucela ukuthi unikeze imininingwane ephelele, usuku lapho kwenzeka khona izehlakalo, kanye nemininingwane yabo bonke abangaba ngofakazi. Imibhalo: Ingabe bekukhona imibhalo noma amaphepha angase asekele ukuphikisa kwakho, isibonelo, incwadi yesipho, ithikithi lezimpahla, imibhalo ephathelene, noma ukurekhodwa kwezingxoxo? Ukubuyiselwa okucela: Sitshele ukuthi ufunani ngosizo. I-inkantolo ingakhupha umyalo wesikhashana, noma inqume ukuthi kuhlawulwe inhlawulo, noma inqume ukuthi umphikisi kufanele axolise ngaphandle kwezimo noma noma yisiphi isinqumo esinye. Imibuzo noma usizo olukhona mayelana nalabo abakhuluma ngenhla. Ungakwazi futhi ukuqonda okuqukethwe kwalesi sikhumbuzo esibhaliwe? Uphikisa ukuthatha isifungo/ukuvuma njengoba kuchaziwe? Uthatha isitatimende esifungiweyo njengokubophezela enhliziyweni yakho? Ngiyavuma ukuthi umuntu othatha isifungo uvumile ukuthi bangakwazi futhi baqonde okuqukethwe kwalesi sikhumbuzo esibhaliwe. Umuntu othatha isifungo uthi lezi zisho: "Ngiyafunga ukuthi okuqukethwe kwalesi sikhumbuzo esibhaliwe kuyakwenziwa, uNkulunkulu angisize"/ "Ngiyavuma ukuthi okuqukethwe kwalesi sikhumbuzo esibhaliwe kuyakwenziwa." Umuntu othatha isifungo usayine/benze uphawu phambi kwami ngenkathi ngikhona. Igama eliphelele nesibongo...
Abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali Isingeniso Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, abadali bokuqukethwe (content creators) bahlala phambili ekwakheni umqondo, ubuciko, nemikhiqizo edidiyelwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lezi zinkundla ziguqule indlela abantu ababelana ngayo ngolwazi, izimvo, nezinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuveza amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kubeka nezinselelo ezinkulu. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlola indima yabadali bokuqukethwe, izinzuzo nemiphumela yokusebenza kwabo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo. 1. Indima Yabadali Bokuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe bangabantu abakhuluma ngezinto ezithile, bephakamisa izimvo, noma bekwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi. Bahlala bephendula izidingo zomphakathi, beqonda izifiso zabalandeli babo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bejabulela ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba. Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakathi kokuxhumana, bejolise ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo nabalandeli. 2. Izinzuzo Zabadali Bokuqukethwe Izinzuzo zokuba abadali bokuqukethwe ziningi. Okokuqala, bakwazi ukufinyelela izithameli ezinkulu, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imakethe. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni bakwazi ukuhweba ngemikhiqizo yabo, noma ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali. Okwesibili, abadali bokuqukethwe banethuba lokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe babo, befundisa abanye, futhi bephakamisa izinga lokwakha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bejabulela ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba. 3. Izinselelo Zabadali Bokuqukethwe Nokho, ukuhweba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana akukhululekile. Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala beface izinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuncintisana okukhulu, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kanye nezinkinga zokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ukuncintisana okukhulu kuholela ekutheni kudingeke ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bahlale bephakanyiswa, bephendula izidingo ezishintshashintshayo zabalandeli. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, amandla, kanye nezinsiza eziningi. 4. Ukuvikelwa Kwamalungelo Abadali Bokuqukethwe Ukuze abadali bokuqukethwe bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuvikela amalungelo abo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezivumela abadali bokuqukethwe ukuba baphumelele, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yabo ivikelwe. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuvikela amalungelo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. 5. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Imisebenzi Yabadali Bokuqukethwe Ukuze abadali bokuqukethwe bakwazi ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo, kudingeka ukuthi bahlale befundisa, bephendula izidingo zabalandeli, futhi bahlale bephakanyiswa. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokufunda izifundo ezihlobene, ukuhamba emihlanganweni, nokuxhumana nabanye abadali. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene kungasiza ekwakheni amathuba amasha, futhi kuholele ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. 6. Isiphetho Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakathi kokuguquka kwezinkundla zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali. Ngenxa yokukhula kwalezi zinkundla, abadali bokuqukethwe banethuba lokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, kodwa baphinde bahlale beface izinselelo eziningi. Ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bahlale befundisa, bephendula izidingo zabalandeli. Ngale ndlela, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bephakamisa izinga lokwakha, futhi bejabulisa izithameli zabo. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Ukuze sithuthukise imisebenzi yabadali bokuqukethwe, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ezifana nezifundo, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakanyiswa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadali bokuqukethwe bazoba nethuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bejabulela ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izithameli ezinkulu, futhi kuholele ekutheni bakwazi ukuhweba ngemikhiqizo yabo, noma ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali. Isiphetho Sokugcina Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephakathi kokuguquka kwezinkundla zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali. Ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bahlale befundisa, bephendula izidingo zabalandeli. Ngale ndlela, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bephakamisa izinga lokwakha, futhi bejabulisa izithameli zabo.
Akukho ingxenye yale mibhalo engaphindwa noma idluliselwe nganoma iyiphi enye indlela noma ifomu ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe efanele. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kumuntu ofisa ukuba uchwepheshe kwezomthetho futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukuze usebenzise le thuluzi ngempumelelo nangokwanelisayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu abe nolwazi lwamagama athile abalulekile asetshenziswa njalo ngababhalayo bezincwadi ezahlukene zomthetho mayelana noMthetho Wobufakazi. Inhloso yalolu suku iwukulungiselela nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukuvuma nokujwayela la magama abalulekile asetshenziswa kuMthetho Wobufakazi futhi banikeze ulwazi olufushane oluwasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene noMthetho Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olukhulunywe phambi kwenkantolo ngenhloso yokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo yenze isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi obubonakalayo buhlanganisa yonke imininingwane nezinto ezingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. UMthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimfanelo kanye nomthetho wokuthi izimfanelo zethulwa kanjani ngokwethembeka. Izimfanelo zingethulwa kusetshenziswa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibonakalayo. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezigaba zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi ufaka kuphi isigaba, incazelo kaMthetho Wobufakazi, kanye nokukhombisa ukuthi yini eyakha ubufakazi obubonakalayo nokuthi yini equkethe. Ukuphikisana okukhulunywe nguhulumeni nethimba lokuvikela akubufakazi kodwa kuyisithasiselo esiwusizo esikhuthaza isinqumo. Le mpikiswano yakhiwe ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihlosiwe ukugcizelela isimo somthetho noma izimfanelo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukuze kushintshwe ukuqonda kwenkantolo lapho kwenziwa isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi isinqumo sithathwe, izinhlangothi zinezikhathi zokwethula impikiswano yokugcina ephathelene nobufakazi obukhulunywe encazelweni eqhubekayo. Izimfanelo zecala yilezo ezethulwa yinqwaba ngenhloso yokufakazela icala labo. Izimfanelo zivame ukulethela ubufakazi noma ziwuphikise. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihilela ubudlelwano bobaba, isimo sobaba sizobe sikhulunywa, futhi ubudlelwano nobaba kuzoba yiphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobaba. Ubufakazi obuqinile buhlinzeka ngobufakazi obuqinile noma obungcono kunobufakazi obunye obukhona. Ubufakazi obuphindwe kabili buhlinzeka ngobufakazi obukhona noma obungase bavele. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ibhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti abhekwa njengobufakazi obuphindwe kabili. Igama elithi "prima facie," elihumusha ngokuthi "bufakazi obubonakala buqondile," lichaza ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe phambi kwenkantolo bufanele ukusungula isimo noma icala ngaphandle kokuba kube nobufakazi obuphikisanayo. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo, ubufakazi obubonakalayo luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Ubufakazi obuqondile buhlinzeka ngobufakazi lapho umshushisi ebone ngqo isenzo. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, uC uthembisa ukuthi wayemi ngaphandle kwendlu kaB ngesikhathi ebona uA eqhuba uB. Ukwamukela kubhekisela kubufakazi obuvunyelwe, futhi akukho mthetho osetshenziselwa ukukala izinga lokuvunyelwa kobufakazi. Ubufakazi bungamukelwa noma buphikiswa. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi wamukelwa noma buphikiswa sincike kumphakathi wokuvunyelwa kwabo nokuthi ukwemukela lokho kubufakazi ngeke kubangele ingozi kumshushisi. Ukwamukela ubufakazi okwesikhashana ngaphansi kwesimo esizogcwaliswa ekupheleni kwecala kuchazwa. Uma isimo sigcwaliswa, ubufakazi buzosuswa. Inkantolo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzeni umshushisi nakuba ubuqiniso bedokhumenti buphikiswa yithimba lokuvikela. Kuzoba ngemuva kokuphela kwecala lapho umshushisi ezothola ithuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo nobuqiniso bedokhumenti, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi obuvele ngemuva kokubuza kuzobhekwa ngenkantolo. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi obufanele, inkantolo izobheka ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe buhlobene nezimfanelo zecala. Igunya liyilungelo noma umthwalo odingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu lapho leli qembu likhombisa ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zegunya. Igunya lomuntu siqu kanye negunya likamasipala. Ukukhuluma ngokuvulekile kuyinto eyenziwa enkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqondile futhi obungaphikiswa ngaphandle kokuba izidingo zomthetho ezithile zifeziwe. Ukwamukela okungaqondile kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo edinga ukucaciswa noma ephikisanayo. Ukuphuma kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umshushisi evuma ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, njengoba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo, kuthathwa njengokuvuma icala. Isaziso senkantolo sichaza lapho inkantolo yamukela izimfanelo ezaziwayo nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa lungakaziswa njengokweqiniso ngesikhathi sokubuza. Umthwalo wokufakazela ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emsebenzini weqembu lapho kufanele kube khona ubufakazi obanele. Umthwalo wezomthetho wokufakazela uphakathi komshushisi. Umthwalo wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obubonakalayo ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emsebenzini wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze inkantolo ibize umshushisi ukuba aphendule ezinsolweni futhi ithole ubufakazi obanele ukuze iphikise lokho kubonakala kubufakazi obukhulunywe yinqwaba evula icala.
Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Intuthuko Ecaleni Lokushushiswa KukaJacob Zuma Ngasese 1. Isingeniso Kulolu hlu lwezinhlinzeko, sithuthukisa izinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma, owayenguMengameli waseNingizimu Afrika. UZuma ubhekwa njengenye yezindaba ezinkulu zentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi le d document izogxila ezinqubweni zokushushiswa kwakhe ngasese, izinzuzo, nokuphazamiseka okungenzeka kulolu hlelo. 2. Umqondo Wokushushiswa Ngasese Ukushushiswa ngasese kubhekisela ekutheni izinqubo zokushushiswa zenzeka ngaphandle kokwaziswa kwabantu abaningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwecala, ukuhlolwa kwemibhalo, kanye nezinyathelo zokulawula ukuvuza kolwazi. Lokhu kungenza kube nezizathu ezilandelayo zokuthi kungani kubalulekile: - Ukuphepha Kwabafakizolo: Ukuvikela ubufakazi kanye nabafakizolo ekushushisweni okungafanele. - Ukuphumelela Kwenqubo: Ukugwema izinkinga zokuphazamiseka ezivela ekwandeni kwezithameli. - Ukwethembeka Kwenqubo: Ukukhuthaza ukwethembeka kokuphathwa kwecala. 3. Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Lokhu Kushushiswa 3.1. Ukubekwa Kwezinqubomgomo Izinqubomgomo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zokushushiswa zenzeka ngasese kufanele ziqukethwe ezinhlelweni ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukubeka imithetho ecacile yokuphatha izinqubo zokushushiswa. - Ukubambisana nezinsiza zomthetho nezokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kwezinqubo. 3.2. Ukuqwashisa Nokuqeqesha Kubalulekile ukuqwashisa bonke abasebenzi abathintekayo ngezinyathelo ezidingekayo zokushushiswa ngasese. Ukuqeqeshwa kufanele kugxile: - Kumigomo nemigudu yokuphatha izinqubo. - Ekubalulekeni kokugcina ulwazi lwasendaweni yokushushiswa. 3.3. Ukuhlola Nokuhlela Ukuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo ezikhona kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kufanele kufake: - Ukuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona zokushushiswa. - Ukuhlela izinhlinzeko eziphathelene nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo. 4. Izinzuzo Zokushushiswa Ngasese - Ukwenziwa Kwezinhlelo: Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqubo zokushushiswa zibe neqhaza elikhulu. - Ukuthuthukiswa Kokwethembeka: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zihlala zikhangayo futhi ziphucukile. 5. Imiphumela Yokuphazamiseka Ukuphazamiseka kwenqubo yokushushiswa kungaholela emiphumeleni emibi, okuhlanganisa: - Ukwehla kokuthembeka kwenqubo. - Ukuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokubika ezisemthethweni. 6. Ukuhlaziywa Kwamacala Aphezulu Ukuhlaziywa kwamacala ahluke-hluke kaZuma, okuhlanganisa amacala okubanga ubufakazi, kumele kuphathwe ngokuqinile. Ukwenza kahle kulezi zinyathelo kuzothuthukisa umphakathi, kuqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi kugweme ukuphazamiseka okungafanele. 7. Isiphetho Ukushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle, ukugxila ekuphepheni, nakubufakazi bokwethembeka. Izinqubomgomo ezinhle nezisebenzayo zizokwandisa ukwakhiwa kokwethembeka kwezinqubo zomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Ubufakazi bokuthi ukushushiswa ngasese kusebenza kahle kuzoba yimpumelelo enkulu ezinhlelweni zokuphatha izinqubo zomthetho ezifanele. 8. Izinyathelo Ezinconyiwe - Ukuqoqa imibono nezimvo ezivela kubaphathi bemithetho. - Ukuphathwa kwezemfundo kulabo abathintekayo ezinqubweni zokushushiswa. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zihlala zishintshwa ukuze zihambisane nezidingo zomphakathi. Le d document ibeka izinyathelo ezilindelekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese kudlula kahle, kusebenza ngempumelelo, futhi kuhlanga nezimfuno zomthetho eNingizimu Afrika.
Le mhlahlandlela ubhalwe ngenhloso yokuphila kahle nokuphepha kwabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Akukhona ukujolisa ukushintsha uMthetho Wokuphila Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993. Inhloso enkulu yale mhlahlandlela ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo yalomthetho ngamagama alula, usebenzisa ulimi oluqondile ukuze kucaciswe kubo bonke abantu abathintekayo empilweni nasekuphepheni endaweni yokusebenza lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wababheki bezempilo nokuphepha eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi uchazwe. Amalungelo nemithwalo yabasebenzi, njengoba kuchazwe emthethweni, kubhalwe phansi. Imisebenzi nemithwalo yabanikazi bamabhizinisi, abakhiqizi, abaqashi, abangenisi, abahlinzeki, nabathengisi ekuqinisekiseni impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi nayo ibalwe. Ekugcineni, imisebenzi yabamele bezempilo nokuphepha kanye nezinkomiti ezihambisanayo icacisiwe. UMthetho Wokuphila Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 udinga ukuthi umqashi aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile, ingenazo izingozi eziphazamisa impilo yabasebenzi, futhi ugcizelela ukuthi umqashi kumele akwenze lokhu ngendlela engcono kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ayinazo izinto eziyingozi, ezifana nebenzene, izidakamizwa, nezinto eziyingozi, imishini, nezindlela zokusebenza ezingaphephile. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi kumele axwayise abasebenzi ngalezi zingozi, indlela yokuzigwema, ukusebenza ngokuphepha, futhi asebenzise izinyathelo zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi akukhona kuphela umqashi onemithwalo yokufeza le msebenzi wezempilo nokuphepha. Umthetho usekelwe emgomeni wokuthi izingozi endaweni yokusebenza kumele zixazululwe ngokwakha umgudu wokuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi nomqashi. Abasebenzi nabanikazi bamabhizinisi kumele babelane ngemithwalo yokuphila kahle nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Bobabili kumele bahlaziye izingozi ezingaba khona futhi baphakamise izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze benze indawo yokusebenza iphephile. Ngale ndlela, umqashi nabasebenzi basebenza ndawonye ezinhlelweni lapho ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha bengahlola njalo indawo yokusebenza futhi banikeze imibiko kwinkomiti yezempilo nokuphepha. Le nkampani ingase iphakamise iziphakamiso kumqashi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nkqubo isebenza kahle, bonke abasebenzi kumele bazi ngamalungelo nemithwalo yabo njengoba kuchazwe emthethweni. Kukhona izinhlinzeko eziningi ezikhuluma ngezihloko ezithile ezifakiwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Umthetho noma izinhlinzeko zitholakala kwiGovt Printer, kungaba kwiGazette noma zikhishwe abanye abashicileli. UMthetho Wokuphila Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi uphethwe yiChief Directorate of Health and Safety ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi, amahhovisi asunguliwe kuzo zonke izifunda. Okwamanje, ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza nalabo abahlala ezifundeni benza ukuhlola nokuhlola lapho kudingeka khona ezindaweni zokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuhlola ziqhutshwa ngokulandela izinkomba ezithile esingazibona; ukuvela kwezinto eziyingozi, ukusetshenziswa kwebenzene lapho imikhiqizo ihlaziywa, noma ezindaweni lapho imishini eyingozi ikhona. Kukhona nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezingenziwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, njengokufaka izicelo, izikhalazo zabasebenzi, abaqashi, noma amalungu omphakathi. Lezi zikhalazo noma izicelo zigcinwa zifihliwe. Uma umbhali ethola okuthile okuyingozi noma okungaba yingozi endaweni yokusebenza, angabeka imithetho ethile kumqashi. Ezimweni ezikhombisa ingozi engaba khona, umbhali angavimbela isenzo, inqubo, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini ngokukhishwa kwesaziso esifanele sokuvimbela. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuhoxisa ukubaluleka kwalolo xwayiso; umyalezo owakhiwe kumele ulandelwe ngokushesha. Uma kukhona umthetho othile ophulwe, umbhali angakhupha isaziso sokwephula umthetho kubasebenzi noma kumqashi. Ukwephula umthetho kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuphathwa ngokushesha. Uma inqubo ethile iphuliwe, umqashi anganikezwa ithuba lokulungisa iphutha ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo, ngokuvamile ezinsukwini ezingama-60. Uma umbhali ethola ukuthi izimo zempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi azaneliseki, umbhali angayala umqashi ukuthi athuthukise le ndawo. Isaziso sokuthuthukisa sikhishwe kumqashi, sichaza indlela elindelekile yokuthuthukisa okungamukeleki kumbhali. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha bahlala benza kahle, bavunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo noma imiphakathi lapho imishini, izinto eziyingozi, noma lapho zisetshenziswa zigcinwa, futhi banephuzu lokubuza imibuzo nokucela abantu abathile ukuba bavele phambi kwabo. Umphakathi ungacela noma yiziphi imibhalo ukuthi ithunyelwe kubo, bahlola, futhi benze amakhophi ale mibhalo, futhi bacela ukucaciswa ngokuqukethwe kwabo. Umphakathi ungahlola isimo noma impahla, athathe amasampula ale nto, noma athathe impahla engase ibe ubufakazi. Umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphepha nokungabi khona kwezingozi endaweni yokusebenza nasempilweni yabasebenzi? Umqashi kumele agcine imishini nezinsiza zokusebenza ezifanele, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo ezidingekayo ukuze umsebenzi wenziwe, esimweni engakwenzi kube yingozi empilweni nasekuphepheni kwabasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imishini nezinsiza zokuphepha, umqashi kumele kuqala akhiphe noma asuse noma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zibe nomthelela omubi empilweni nasekuphepheni kwabasebenzi. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi angasebenzisa izinsiza zokuvikela nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngabasebenzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvikela impilo nokuphepha ezingozeni ezingase zivele ekukhiqizeni, ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ekusetshenzisweni, ekuphathweni, ekugcinweni, noma ekuthuthweni kwemikhiqizo noma izinto. Ngamanye amazwi, noma yini engase ibonakale kumsebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, ukuqeqesha, nokuphatha abasebenzi kubonakale njengendlela yabo yokusebenza. Ngamanye amazwi, lokho okufanele bakwenze nokungafanele bakwenze. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphambi kokuthatha zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abaphansi komqashi balandela umthetho futhi baphoqelelwe ukuba bathathe izindlela ezifanele zokugwema izingozi ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umgomo wokuphepha nempilo enhle. Ukuqaphela ukuthi umsebenzi nemishini zisetshenziswa umuntu ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu oqeqeshiwe kulowo msebenzi noma imishini ukuze aqonde izingozi ezihambisana nalowo msebenzi noma imishini. Lo msebenzi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi imizamo yokuvikela iyalandelwa futhi igcinwa. Bonke abasebenzi banelungelo lokwazi. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi futhi baqonde kahle izingozi zempilo nokuphepha ezihambisana nomsebenzi ngamunye abawenzayo, imikhiqizo ekhiqizwayo, ehlelwa, igcinwa, iphathwa, noma ithuthwa, kanye nemishini noma amathuluzi asetshenziswayo
Izinkinga Zokungcola Komoya Isingeniso Ukungcola komoya kube yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele, okuthinta impilo yabantu, izilwane, kanye nemvelo. Le nkinga ibangelwa izizathu ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, izimboni, izimoto, kanye nezindlela zokuphila zabantu. Ukuqonda izinkinga zokungcola komoya kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuthuthukisa izixazululo ezisebenzayo, ezizokwenza kube nokuphila okungcono kubantu nakwemvelo. Izizathu Zokungcola Komoya Izizathu eziholela ekungcolisweni komoya ziningi futhi zihluke kakhulu. Okokuqala, izimboni ziwumthombo omkhulu wokungcola. Imisebenzi yokukhiqiza ikhishwa imisebe eminingi engcolisayo efana ne-carbon dioxide, i-sulfur dioxide, ne-nitrogen oxides. Lezi zinto zikhula emkhathini, zikhubaza umoya, futhi zibangela izinkinga zempilo ezifana nezinkinga zokuphefumula. Okwesibili, izimoto zikhona emgwaqweni, zikhulisa izinga lokungcola komoya. Ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezisebenzisa uphethiloli, kuholela ekukhuleni kokukhishwa kwezinhlayiya ezilimazayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezihlobene nomoya, njengemikhuhlane yokuphefumula ne-asthma. Imiphumela Yokungcola Komoya Imiphumela yokungcola komoya ibonakala kakhulu empilweni yabantu. Izifo ezihlobene nomoya zikhula, futhi abantu abaningi bahlushwa izinkinga zokuphefumula, njengokukhwehlela, umkhuhlane, nezinkinga zezinso. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungcola komoya kuthinta futhi izilwane, lapho izilwane ezithile zishaywa yizifo ezihlobene nokungcola. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwezinga lempilo yezilwane, okungaholela ekuphileni okungafanele. Ngaphandle kwemiphumela emibi empilweni, ukungcola komoya kungaba nemiphumela emibi emvelweni. Ukuhlakazeka kwe-carbon dioxide kuholela ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuvikela imvelo. Izitshalo nezilwane zihlupheka ngenxa yokushintsha kwemvelo, okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwezinsiza ezibalulekile. Izixazululo Zokulwa Nokungcola Komoya Ukuze silwe nokungcola komoya, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqinisa imithetho yokungcolisa umoya. Izifunda nezizwe kufanele zisebenzise imithetho eqinile yokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwezinhlayiya ezilimazayo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlola ezisebenzayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimboni nezimoto zilandela le mithetho. Okwesibili, ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo yamandla avuselelekayo, njengelanga, umoya, ne-hydro, kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukungcola. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi noma ezihamba ngezinyawo noma nge-cycling kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekunciphiseni ukungcola komoya. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuphila okunempilo, futhi kunciphise izinga lokukhishwa kwezinhlayiya. Ukufundisa Nokuqwashisa Ukufundisa abantu ngale nkinga kubalulekile. Imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi mayelana nokungcola komoya, izingozi zayo, nezindlela zokuzivikela, ingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi oqaphelayo. Izikole, izinkampani, nezinhlangano ezizimele zingaba negalelo elikhulu ekwakheni ukuqwashisa. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthelela wokungcola komoya. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokungcola komoya zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba zinemiphumela emibi empilweni yabantu, izilwane, kanye nemvelo. Ukuqonda izizathu zokungcola, imiphumela yazo, kanye nezixazululo ezitholakalayo kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukulwa nale nkinga. Ukusebenza ndawonye, sihlanganise imizamo yethu, singasiza ekwakheni umoya ophilayo, onempilo, okungcono kubo bonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lethu, sikhuthaze impilo nokuphila kahle emhlabeni wethu.
Yiziphi izindawo ezibalulekile? Njengoba ungumlimi, unezizathu zokwenza izinto eziningi. Uhlola futhi uhlela ngokuya ngezinhlobo zomhlabathi wakho, kungani? Ukuze ubone futhi uthole izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba ngendlela efanele. Uthatha amasampula omhlabathi futhi uwahlaziye, kungani? Ukuze uthole ulwazi lokufaka umanyolo ophakathi ukuze ufinyelele izithelo ezinhle. Uvuna noma uhlanganisa izinkambu zakho, kungani? Ukuze amanzi omvula angene emhlabathini. Uhlunga izinkambu ngesikhathi esifanele, kungani? Ukuze ubulale izihlahla ezisiza ukugcina amanzi emhlabathini. Uhlola emakethe ethile ukuze unqume ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo okufanele uzitshale, kungani? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona indawo lapho uzothengisa khona imikhiqizo yakho. Uthumela isivumelwano sokuthengisa emakethe ethile, kungani? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo kuzokwenza ukuthi ube nenzuzo. Uzenza indawo yokutshala, kungani? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ngesikhathi sokutshala, umhlabathi unesimo esihle esizosisiza ukuthi imbewu ingene kahle futhi ixhumane kahle nomhlabathi ukuze ikwazi ukuvutha ngokushesha. Uplantsha inani elithile lezitshalo futhi ukhethe uhlobo olufanele, kungani? Ukuze uvune izithelo ezinhle. Uplantsha izitshalo ngomanyolo othile nangenani elithile, kungani? Ukuze uvune izithelo ezinhle. Uhlambele inkambu nge-herbicide ngaphambi kokutshala, kungani? Ukuze uvimbele izihlahla ukuthi zingancintisani nezitshalo ngamanzi, umanyolo, ukukhanya, nomoya. Uhlambele inkambu nge-pesticide ngemuva kokutshala, kungani? Ukuze izilokazane zingalimazi izitshalo zakho. Uthinta phakathi kwemigqa yezitshalo, kungani? Ukuze uqede izihlahla ezizoncintisana nezitshalo zakho. Ufaka umanyolo ophakeme ezitshalweni zakho, kungani? Ukuze unikeze izitshalo zakho izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze ufinyelele izithelo ezinhle. Uhlola njalo ngezifo futhi uhlambele i-pesticide uma kudingeka, kungani? Ukuze unikeze izitshalo zakho ithuba lokukhula kahle. Uvuna ngesikhathi esifanele, kungani? Ukuze uthole ibanga elihle uma uthengisa imikhiqizo yakho. Ungabhekana nazo zonke lezi zindaba ngokwakho - ungathatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngokuya ngemicabango yakho. Umbuzo olandelayo uwukuthi uzokwazi kanjani ukuthi wenze lezi zinto kahle? Kufanele uzihlolisise: yisiphi isiphumo ofuna ukusifinyelela? Ingabe ufike kulolo suphumo noma cha? Bheka emibuzweni eminingi: eminye ungaphendula ng 'yebo' noma 'cha' - isibonelo: umbuzo mayelana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi - ingabe uwathathile noma cha? Ngaleso sikhathi nangaphakathi kobubanzi obuthile. Ingabe ugcina umswakama owanele emhlabathini ukuze ube nokutshala ukuze izitshalo zikhule kuze kube imvula? Ngeziphi izithelo ezitholakalayo nangani? Ingabe ulungiselele kahle nangasikhathi ukuze ukwazi ukutshala ngesikhathi osikhethile? Ingabe uqonda ukuthi zingaki izitshalo okufanele uzitshale futhi uphumelele? Ingabe uqonda ukuthi zingaki amahektare okufanele uzitshale futhi uphumelele? Yiziphi izinhlobo ozisebenzisayo futhi uyazifaka ngendlela efanele? Ingabe uphumelele ekubulaleni izihlahla? Ingabe uqonda ukuthi yisiphi umanyolo okufanele ufake nokuthi yisiphi owawufakile? Uthole malini ezithelo ngehektare futhi uthole malini? Kukhona umshwalense wezindleko zokuqala zokutshala etholakalayo ku-ARS (namanje ezinye izinkampani) ukuvikela ezimeni ezinjengokushoda kwemvula, imvula eningi, isichotho, umoya, nomlilo. Kodwa akukho abakhiqizi abazohlinzeka ngeshwa yokuvikela ezimeni ezibangelwa ukuphathwa kwakho okungalungile. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuhlela kahle, ukusebenza kahle, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokuphatha eziphakeme.
Ezokuphathwa Kwezinhlekelele: Ukuhlaziywa Nokubaluleka Kwamathuba Nezinselelo Ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele, okuyinqubo yokuphatha izimo ezikahle, inqubo ebalulekile kakhulu emiphakathini yanamuhla. Le nqubo ibonisa indlela abantu, izinhlangano, nohulumeni abaphendula, bephatha, futhi besilungiselela izinhlekelele ezahlukahlukene ezifana nezikhukhula, iziphepho, izikhukhula, noma ezinye izimo eziphathekayo ezithinta impilo nomnotho. Ngakho-ke, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu nokwanda kwezinhlekelele kwanda, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele akuwona nje umsebenzi onyaweni, kodwa kuwumkhakha wemfundo, wezobuchwepheshe noshintsho emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisebenzayo nezikhona ezitholakalayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukwenzeka nokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela okuhle, ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuqinile, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokufunda okuqhubekayo. Ukuhlelwa okulungile kubalulekile, ngoba kuzosiza imiphakathi ukuba ibe necebo lokuphendula ngesikhathi sezinhlekelele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula okuphawulekayo, kufanele kubekwe phambili ukufundiswa komphakathi mayelana nezingozi ezahlukene, ukuze sithole imiphumela engcono ngesikhathi sezinhlekelele. Ukwesshwa kolwazi kudinga ukuzihlanganisa kwezinhlangano zomphakathi, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda izidingo ezithile zomphakathi. Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo phakathi kwezinhlaka zezokuphatha, izakhamizi, nabaholi bendawo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangathola usizo oludinga ekushayweni kwezinhlekelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kuthanda ukuba nendima enkulu ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele. Izinkampani zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuthola ulwazi, njengokuphathwa kwedatha, indiza yamazwe, nezinqubomgomo zokuphendula, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokuphatha ezanelisayo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutholeni ulwazi olukhawulelwe mayelana nezinselakheli eziphathekayo ezishayiswayo, okuholela ezifundweni ezimbalwa mayelana nezimo zempilo zenhlalo. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinhlekelele zikhona, zikhona nezinselelo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusweleka kwezinsiza, ukuhlwithwa kwemithalo nezihlahla, kanye nengcindezi yokukhula komnotho. Imiphakathi eminingi ibhekene nezimo ezinzima zokuphila, okuholela ekutheni izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele zibe nzima ukuyisebenzisela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zazo zibe seamless, futhi ziqhathaniswe nezidingo zezakhamizi. Ukuze kuzuze ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele, ukufaka iziyalezo ezikhethekile ukuze sekuhlangabezwane nezimo ezithile zezinhlale kubalulekile. Lokhu kumele kuhlanganyele nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo ezisekelwe kumqondisi wokukhula, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kolwazi oluqinile kudinga ukusiza izinhlekelele. Izinhlangano zomphakathi zikhethekile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele ziqhamuka nombresho esebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze abafundi nabafundi ukuba baphendule ngobuchwepheshe kulokhu kuhlanganyela. Ngaleso sikhathi, kuzoba nokukhanya okukhulu lapho kudingeka ukuqonda okwengeziwe, kuphume lesi sikhumbuzo sokuthi izinhlekelele zenzeka, kodwa indlela esiphatha ngayo lezi zinto yunikezo lwemiphakathi. Ekugcineni, ezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele kuchaza ukuzama nokuphendula ngezindlela ezilungile nezisebenzayo okuphathelene nezinhlekelele. Imithombo ibalulekile empumelelweni ekuphathweni kwezinhlakadi ezihlekisayo. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuhlola ukwakha izixazululo ezenzakalayo, ukukwazisa ngokubambisana, nezinsizakusebenza ezisebenzayo nasemphakathini ngokujulile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, kuqinisekiswe ukuziphatha kahle kweMiphakathi, nokuqinisa amandla, ukuthembana, nokuhlonipha phakathi kwazo. Izimpilo zethu, impilo yomqondo nokukhula komnotho zixhomeke kulesi sikhumba esibaluleke kakhulu, futhi akufanele siphuthume lapho izimo ziba nzima. Imininingwane ilungile, izinyathelo zifanele, okusho kuthula izinkumbulo ezinzima, kuholwa umoya omuhle, nokuqinisa amakhono ezehlakalo. Khumbula, tanzi, izinhlekelele zingase zibe yinsada, kodwa indlela yokuphatha nokuphendula izithiyo lezi isiyalela indlela yempilo yethu.
Lo mbhalo uveza ukuthi umthetho weziMvelo Zasendle eNingizimu Afrika we-1998 uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungapheli nokuvikelwa kwezimila zasendle eNingizimu Afrika ngokuphathwa kokulondolozwa. Umthetho wenhlalakahle eNingizimu Afrika wavela ngesikhathi sokubusa kwenani elincane labamhlophe ngaphansi kwe-apartheid, futhi inqubo enzima yokufaka umthetho wenhlalakahle kanye nezinguquko iphinde yathinta izimila, lapho abantu abaningi abamnyama benqatshelwa izinzuzo zokusebenzisa kwazo. Imithetho emisha yokulima izihlahla izama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bangafinyelela ezimilaneni ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukusetshenziswa okungapheli kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Isisekelo salokhu nguMthetho Wezihlahla Zasendle, ophawula izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye okufanele zihlale zikhunjulwa lapho kwenziwa izinqumo ezithinta izimila. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye njengesiqondiso, umthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungapheli, ubuholi obubambisene, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke ababambiqhaza. Nokho, izikhungo zomphakathi ezingeni lendawo azikazitholi izinguquko ezifanayo nezepolitiki: okwamanje, inselelo wukufaka izinqubomgomo ezigxile esikhathini esizayo kanye nemithetho ezingeni lokuphathwa kwendawo. Ukhetho: Ngonyaka ka-1994, ukhetho lokuqala lwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika lwenza ukuba kube nohulumeni omusha. NgoMashi 1995, umhlangano kazwelonke wabhala ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, owawusetshenziselwa ukuxoxisana nabo bonke ababambiqhaza. Ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe yaba yisisekelo senqubomgomo ethathwe ngokusemthethweni ekhishwe ngoDisemba 1997, ingxenye yesibili yomthetho ophakanyisiwe. Lokhu kwasetshenziselwa ukuhlela uMthetho Wezihlahla Zasendle. Kusukela ngo-1998, ngosizo lukahulumeni wase-UK, uMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla ubambe iqhaza ekufakweni kwalo mthetho. Ingxenye 24 ithi: "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuba nendawo engalimazi impilo yabo noma inhlalakahle, ukuze benze inzuzo ekusetshenzisweni okungapheli kwezinsiza zemvelo, futhi ukuba nendawo evikelwe ukuze kube nezinzuzo zezigidi zamanje nezizayo ngokusebenzisa izinyathelo ezisemthethweni nezinye ezikhuthaza ukulondolozwa nokuvikela ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli kwezemvelo nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho kanye nezokuhlalisana. Izihlahla zasendle akufanele zilimale ngaphandle uma kunezimo ezikhethekile, futhi ngokombono weNgqongqoshe, ukusetyenziswa kwalelo thafa kungcono uma kubhekwa izinzuzo zomnotho, zomphakathi, nezemvelo. Indawo encane yezihlahla kufanele igcinwe. Khuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwazo nokuphila kwazo isikhathi eside. Gcina izinsiza zomlando futhi ukhuthaze amanani obuhle, isiko, nesipirituality; kanye nokuphakamisa abantu noma imiphakathi ehluphekayo eyayishiywe ngaphandle ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Umthetho ubeka ngqo izimiso zokuphatha izihlahla ngokungapheli, okufanele zisetshenziswe kuzo zonke izinqumo ezithinta izihlahla, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngaphansi koMthetho Wezihlahla Zasendle noma eminye imithetho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimila okungapheli kufanele kuhambisane noma kuhlanganiswe nokuvikelwa kwezihlahla nezihlahla. Abaphathi bezihlahla kanye nezikhulu zezihlahla (ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezihlahla noma ezinye izinhlangano ezifana nezinhlelo zokulondoloza) banesibopho sokufaka le nhlanganisela, besebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izindlela, nezindlela zikaMnyango. Akuvumelekile ukususa noma ukwabela izihlahla kuzo zonke izihlahla zasendle ngaphandle kwemvume. Izihlahla ezithile nezindawo zezimila zingamenyezelwa njengendawo evikelwe. Isihlahla, noma iqembu lezihlahla, indawo yezihlahla, noma uhlobo lwezihlahla lungamenyezelwa njengokuvikelwa. Amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuphatha, nokulawula izihlahla zikahulumeni nemikhiqizo yazo akhishwa ezandleni zeNgqongqoshe Yamanzi Nezihlahla. Nokho, ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe kuMthethosisekelo, angavuma izinhlobo ezahlukene zokusebenzisa ezisunguliwe kulo mthetho: ngempumelelo, ukukhululwa, (bona ibhokisi) amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuqashwa, izivumelwano, kanye Nezivumelwano Zomphakathi Wezihlahla. Ivumela imisebenzi efana nokudoba, ukwakha izakhiwo, noma ukuhweba. Ikhishwa ngaphansi kwezimo. Umthetho uyavuma ukuthi imiphakathi yasemakhaya incike ezinsizeni ezitholakala ezimilaneni futhi ifuna ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abashiywe ngaphandle ngesikhathi se-apartheid kuzo zonke izinhlelo ezithinta izimila. INgqongqoshe isebenzisile iSahluko 24 ukukhulula amalungu emiphakathini eduze kwezimila zikahulumeni ekudingekeni kokuthola imvume uma beqoqa izinkuni noma ezinye izinsiza ezitholakala ezimilaneni ezifana nomhluzi, izithelo, utshani bokwakha, noma izitshalo zokwelapha zemindeni, ngokwesiko noma ngokomoya. Akukho zinkokhelo ezidingekayo. INgqongqoshe ingavuma ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo yezihlahla (njengomhluzana) noma eminye imikhiqizo (njengezinkuni) ezithathwe ezimilaneni zikahulumeni ukuze zithengiswe kwabanye. Imiphakathi ingangena ezivumelwaneni neNgqongqoshe ukuze iphathise noma ibambisane neNgqongqoshe ekuphatheni izihlahla zikahulumeni. INgqongqoshe ingaqasha izihlahla zikahulumeni noma izingxenye zazo kunoma ubani. Umthetho unika noma ubani ilungelo elamukelekayo lokungena ezimilaneni zikahulumeni ngezizathu ezine ezingalimazi noma ezingaphuli: ukufundisa, ukujabulisa, ngokwesiko, nangokomoya. Ukwenza umthetho omusha kuyisinyathelo sokuqala enqubweni ende. Izimiso, izindlela, nezindlela kufanele zisungulwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe umthetho. Thuthukisa uhlelo oluzosetshenziswa kwezombusazwe kanye nomthetho. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni, abaphathi bezihlahla, kanye nezinye izithakazelo kufanele baqeqeshwe ukuze baqonde futhi bakwazi ukufaka umthetho omusha, izindlela, nezindlela futhi basebenzise ulwazi lwabo namakhono ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Uma begcina izindlela ezikhona, kufanele bazame ukuthola ibhalansi noma ukuhlanganisa ushintsho nalokho okukhona.
Imiyalelo ye-Debit Order kanye Nezidingo Zasebhange ze-GEMS Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali ziye zashintsha, zenza kube lula kubantu ukuphatha izindleko zabo. Okwamanje, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ithuthukise imiyalelo yayo ye-debit order ukuze kube lula kubasebenzisi bayo. Lezi zinguquko zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo engcono, ukunciphisa izinkinga zokukhokha, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emalini yokwelashwa. I-GEMS, esebenza ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo bathola ukukhokha kwabo ngesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu akhumbule ukulandela imiyalelo ethile uma efaka i-debit order. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezihlobene nezinkokhelo ezingalungile. Okokuqala, amalungu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi banemali eyanele kwi-akhawunti yabo ukuze i-debit order iyaphumelela. Ukuze uthole imininingwane ethile, amalungu angavakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-GEMS, lapho kuzotholakala khona izinyathelo ezichazwe kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka imininingwane yasebhange, ukukhetha usuku lokukhokha, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe edingekayo. Uma usuhlinzekile ngemininingwane yakho, i-GEMS izoqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungu akhuthazwa ukuba aqaphe izinkokhelo zabo njalo, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinkokhelo ezikhokhwayo nokuthi zikhokhiswa ngempela. Mayelana nemininingwane yasebhange, i-GEMS ibalulekile ekuphatheni izimali zayo. Amalungu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo ibhalwe kahle futhi ibuyekezwa njalo ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezivela ngenxa yokungahambisani kwemali. Njengoba iminyaka idlula, izidingo zezimali zishintsha, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu abuyekeze imininingwane yabo ukuze baqhubeke bejabulile. I-GEMS iphinde inikeze izinsiza eziningi ezithuthukisayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, izaphulelo kumalungu, kanye nezinsiza zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukwandisa izinketho ezitholakalayo kumalungu, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze uthole lezi zinsiza, amalungu kufanele bahlale beqaphela izikhumbuzo ze-GEMS nezibuyekezo ezivela kuwebhusayithi yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izohlaziya indlela yokuphatha izinkokhelo, ukuze ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo engcono kakhulu kumalungu ayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abasha ukuthi bangeze i-debit order, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo bayakholwa ukuthi bakhokhelwa ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde ukuthi i-debit order iyithuluzi eliwusizo lokuphatha izimali zempilo. Ukuze bakwazi ukuzenzela, amalungu kufanele baqonde imiyalelo ye-GEMS, baqinisekise ukuthi banemali eyanele kwi-akhawunti yabo, futhi bahlale beqaphela izinkokhelo zabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekugcineni impilo yabo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo nakubantu abaseduze kwabo. I-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi izimisele ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izindlela zayo zokuphatha izimali ukuze ihlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke abahlanganyela. Ngakho-ke, amalungu akhuthazwa ukuba bahlale beqaphela, baqonde imiyalelo, futhi bahlale bejabulile ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo.
### Izinga Lentela eNingizimu Afrika Kukhuluma kaningi ngentela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, akunjalo? Ngoba nje, abantu bahlala bebuzwa futhi bezwakalisa imicabango yabo ngayo. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke nakweziqhingi, okukhuluma ngayo nakwi-inthanethi. Kuningi okukhuluma ngakho, ngakho sizozama ukusizakala. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi intela ayiyona into ebangela ukujabuliswa, yize kubalulekile. Ijolise ekutheni uhulumeni athole imali yokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi — ezokwelashwa, imfundo, nezokuthutha. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngentela, sikhuluma ngempela ngezimali ezolabanye zethu, ehh, izikhwama zombuso. Isizathu senkathi yokukhuluma ngentela, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, singenxa yeziqephu ezinhle nenhle kakhulu. Mhlawumbe uvele uphakamise ukuthi kanti ini ngempela lezi zinga zimbi? Ngempela, izinga lentela lihluka kakhulu lapho kukhulunywa ngezigaba zabantu – phakathi kwezinga eliphakeme, eliphakathi, neliphansi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abanemali eningi bakhokha intela eningi, kanti labo ababanayo kakhulu bayakhokha kancane. Bengithanda ukukuthokozisa ngalezi zifundo ezithokozisayo. Umazisi ukuba uJoseph Stiglitz, osomabhizinisi abaziwayo, ubelokhu ekhuluma ngalezi zinto. Ukhuluma ngokuthi izinga lentela kufanele libe nokuphakanyiswa okukhulu, ukuze abantu abakophelwayo bakwazi ukusiza umphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle esemthethweni, umphakathi udinga ukuba uqinisekise ukuthi unenkanyezi enyangeni eduzane. Ngakho, ngabe ulwazi lwakho ngalezi zinto lukhona? Izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika lihlukile uma liqhathaniswa namanye amazwe. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinsiza nezidingo zikhula hrh, kanti futhi umoya wokufaka impumelelo uvikela ngemithetho eqinile. Impela, lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube neziphakamiso ezahlukene mayelana nokuthi izinga lentela kufanele likhuphuke, lishintshe, noma lihlale lingashintshi. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngentela, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukufaka imali eningi. Kukhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokho. Ukuba nezimo eziyingozi, zidinga ukucwaningwa ngokuqhubekayo. Ubuze kumuntu othanda izimakethe, uzothola ukuthi izinga lentela liphakamisa izinkinga zokufaka emthethweni izikhala ezithile. Lokhu kukhululwa kusukela ezindleleni ezimnandi, kodwa ekugcineni, abanye abantu basazothola kube nzima. Sihamba phambili sifunde ngama-rate, izinga lentela, iziqhamo zayo nemiphumela. Uhlelo lokuhuza abantu nezingeniso luhluke ngezindlela eziningi. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuzikhandla kemfundo, kodwa lenkathi yokusebenza ibalulekile. Uma ungenayo ingcebo, izinga lokukhokha lentela lincane, kodwa uma ufinyelela ezingeni eliphakeme, kuyahlula, kuzokwenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu. Futhi njengoba sikhuluma ngezinga lentela, akufanele sishayele ingqondo yethu ukukhumbula ukuthi umphakathi uhlala ube nenkinga yokuthola isixazululo. Ukubuyekeza izinga lentela kubalulekile, ubuza impikiswano ngezimali zomphakathi ezibuya, njengoba sikhuluma nezinsiza ezithile. Uma izinga lentela likhuphuka, abakhiqizi bahlala bexaxa nezinkinga, besho ukuthi abathengi bolwazi lwethembiso. Ngokuqinisekile, kuyacaca ukuthi izinga lentela lihanjiwe, ikakhulukazi kulabo abancane nabaphakathi. Kungani? Ngoba kubalulekile ukukhetha indlela ethile yokukhulula umphakathi ngaphandle kokuthi sikhuthaze ukusima kwezomnotho. Noma kunjalo, kufanele nathi sifunde ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngentela, sikhuluma ngezimali ezisebenzayo. Ngakho-ke, uma siqinisekisa ukuthi izinga lentela lisele luhlaza, sikhumbula iziphakamiso zomphakathi ezithile. Kulezi zinsuku, lo mbuzo ohlekayo ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Uhlanganisa ukungabaza ekubeni kufanele ngempela ugcine okukhuluma ngalezi zinto. Kumele sizame ukuletha izinto ezintsha futhi ukuze sizithole, sizidinge izimpendulo. Umusa wandinze kube phezulu nokubaluleka kobuhlanga bethu kanye nempumelelo yethu. Njengoba sithokozisa kakhulu abathumele, kubalulekile futhi sêkudangele ezintweni eziphusile, ngaleso sikhathi sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuhamba phambili kudinga ukuba neziqu zengqondo ezikhuthazayo ekulweni nalesi sifo, ukuze sisize umphakathi. Ngiyabonga ngale mibuzo emihle, sithumele izimpendulo ezingeze implications ezinzima. Uhlanga oluphakeme lunikezwa, nolwazi olunembile lungakha ulimi oluhlala lukhona ngenxa yokuphila kothisha. Ngakho, qhubeka uzithokozise, siciwe uqhuba phambili. Ngiyabonga!
Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni (Life Esidimeni arbitration) I-Life Esidimeni iyindawo yokunakekelwa kwempilo enezinhlaka eziningi ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwengqondo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngemuva kokuhlaselwa kwezimo ezinzima ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zayo, kwavela udlame olukhulu lokuphila kwabantu abaninzi, okwaholela ekubeni kube nesidingo sokulamula. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuthi kudingeka kube ne-arbitration ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukwethula Isimo Ngaphambi kokuba sihlolisise imiphumela yokulamula, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu ezaholela ekubeni kube ne-arbitration. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwezinsizakalo zempilo, abanye abantu abathola usizo e-Life Esidimeni babhekana nezimo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kabi, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala efanele, kanye nokungabi naso isiqiniseko sokuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ziyakhula. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi baphume emakhaya abo, bephinde bahlushwe yizinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Inqubo Yokulamula Inqubo yokulamula ye-Life Esidimeni yahlanganisa abamele iziguli, iziphathimandla, kanye nabanye abathintekayo. I-arbitration yenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxisana, lapho izinkinga ezikhona zingabhekwa khona ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwavumela abathintekayo ukuba baphendule izinkinga ezithile, bakhulume ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabantu, futhi bathole izixazululo ezithile. Imiphumela Yokulamula Imiphumela yokulamula ye-Life Esidimeni ibalulekile, futhi inezinto eziningi ezithinta iziguli, umphakathi, kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo. Nazi ezinye zezimphumela ezibalulekile: 1. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zempilo: Ngemva kokulamula, kwavela iziphakamiso eziningi zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zempilo e-Life Esidimeni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhulu kubasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nokwakha izindawo zokuhlala ezinhle. 2. Ukwaziwa Kwezidingo Zokwelashwa: I-arbitration yaphinde yenza kube lula ukuqonda izidingo ezithile zabantu abathola usizo. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuthi izinsizakalo zempilo ziqonde kahle ukuthi yini efanele ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu. 3. Ukubuyiselwa Kwezinsiza: Imiphumela yokulamula ibuye ibonise ukubaluleka kokubuyisela izinsiza ezilahlekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuphinda kuhlangane izinsiza ezazitholakala ngaphambi kokuthi kube nezinkinga, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele. 4. Ukubuyiselwa Kwesithunzi: I-arbitration yaphinde yenza kube nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kwabantu abathintekayo. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuba bazizwe bebuyiselwe emoyeni, futhi bakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. 5. Izixazululo Zokuphila: Ngaphezu kokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo, imiphumela yokulamula ibuye yathuthukisa izixazululo zempilo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bathole izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwelashwa, okuhlanganisa nezindlela zokwelapha ezihlukene. Izifundo Eziyinhloko Ukwazi imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni kubalulekile ukuze siqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo kufanele zihlale zikhona, ziqhubeke zithuthuka, futhi ziqonde izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo kufanele bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yokulamula ibonisa ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo kubalulekile. I-arbitration iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo zempilo nabantu, okuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okungcono, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Isiphetho Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlola lezi zimpumelelo kuveza indlela yokuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zidinga ukuhlala zikhona, ziqhubeke zithuthuka, futhi ziqonde izidingo zabantu. Ngale ndlela, sithola ukuthi imiphumela yokulamula iyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono kubantu abathola usizo, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
AmaZulu: Isiko, Ubumqoka Nokuhlangenwe Nakho Kwethu AmaZulu, njengabantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, banomlando ocebile, izindlela zokuphila ezihlukile, nezinkolelo ezijulile ezihlanganisa isiko labo. Ngaphandle kokuba ngabe siyiqonda kahle lezi zinto, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ubuhlobo bethu nezinye izizwe, kanye nemithelela yethu emhlabeni, kudinga ukuthi sithathe umcabango omkhulu ngempilo yethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaZulu ahlupheka ezindabeni zokuphila kwansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi emigudwini yokuhlalisana, ezokuphepha, kanye nemfundo. Ngakho-ke, ukukwazi ukuvikelwa kwezakhamizi zeZulu kumele kube inhloso enkulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi isiko lethu, izinkolo zethu, nezindlela zethu zokuphila ziphila ngokuhlukana, kodwa zidinga ukuthi zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqhakaziswe umphakathi. Isiko lamaZulu, elihlanganisa imicabango efana nezinkanyezi, izinkolelo zokuphila, nezinkolo, linomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isizukulwane esisha esihlakaniphile. Njengoba abantu besebenza ndawonye, kuvela amathuba okukhuluma, ukufunda, nokwakha. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuvumela ukusungulwa kwezixazululo ezihle, zezinselele esibhekene nazo. Abantu abavela ezizindeni ezihlukene bangabeka imiqondo yabo phambili, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Eminyakeni edluleyo, amaZulu abhekane nezinselele eziningi, futhi lezi zinto zikhombisa ubunzima obukhona. Ukuphila emiphakathini enezinkinga ezinjengokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukungabi namathuba emfundo, kanye nengcindezi yezezimali, kuyaphazamisa impilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, ukuze siqhubeke nokukhulisa umphakathi wethu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhulume ngezindlela zokwakha amathuba, nokwakha inhlangano ezosiza abantu bethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, indaba yezezimali ifuna ukuba ibhekwe ngokucophelela. AmaZulu kufanele aqonde ukuthi indlela esiphila ngayo, izinqumo esizithathayo, kanye nezinsiza esizisebenzisayo zinesithombe esikhulu emiphakathini yethu. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zezimali ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizweni, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ubulili, ubuhlanga, nezimo zomphakathi kufanele ziqondwe kahle, njengoba zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zethu. AmaZulu anemigubho eminingi, imihlangano, nezidakamizwa ezikhethekile ezikhuthaza umphakathi. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwezizukulwane, futhi kwenza kube lula ukubona indlela esizokhuluma ngayo. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhuthaze imfundiso, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezifundo ezikhuthaza ukuvuselela isiko lethu. Izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele kufanele zikhuthazwe ukuze ziqinise isiko lethu. Ukuze sibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibopho sokukhuthaza abantu bethu ukuba baphumelele. Njengoba sithola amathuba emisha, kufanele siqonde ukuthi isiko lethu, ubuhlanga bethu, nokuhlangenwe nakho kwethu kuyabaluleka. AmaZulu, njengabantu abathembekile, kufanele aqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophakeme, nolwazi. Ngokuhlanganyela, singathuthukisa izindlela zethu zokuphila, sihlale sihlangene, futhi sikhulume ngempumelelo. Lokhu akusikho nje kuphela ukusho, kodwa kuyisivumelwano esiyisisekelo sokuphila kwethu. Siyakhuthazwa ukuba sibe neqhaza eliyigugu empilweni yezizukulwane ezizayo, siqhubeke nokuqhubeka nesiko lethu, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. AmaZulu, ngempela, anethuba lokuphila phambili, kodwa lokho kudinga umsebenzi, ukubambisana, nokuhlonipha isiko lethu. Ngalesi sizathu, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, eliyingxenye yempilo yethu. Ngalesi sikhathi, sikhala ngokubambisana, sikhuthaza isiko, futhi siqhakambisa ubuhlanga bethu. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi amaZulu, njengabantu, azothokoziswa ngempilo yabo, baphile kahle, futhi bahlale bephambili. Kukhona ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, futhi lokho kufanele kube inhloso yethu. Hamba phambili, Zulu!
Ukugcinwa kuyisibopho sokunikeza omunye umuntu, njengabantwana, ngokuhlinzeka ngezindlu, ukudla, izingubo, imfundo, kanye nezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngamakhemikhali, noma ngezindlela ezifanele zokuhlinzeka umuntu ngalezi zinto ezidingekayo. Le msebenzi yomthetho ibizwa ngokuthi 'isibopho sokugcinwa' noma 'isibopho sokuxhasa'. Ubani onesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso? Isibopho sokugcinwa sihlinzekwa ngoxhumano lwezitho zomndeni, ukuvuma ingane engazalwanga ngawe, noma ngoshadile. Abazali noma abaphethe baphinde bafakwe kulokhu, noma ngabe abazali bashadile noma bengashadile. Nokho, lokhu kuyahluka kumacala ngamunye. Isibopho sokugcinwa kwesitho somndeni asihambisani kuphela nokuxhasa ingane. Isitho somndeni esikwazi ukuzixhasa singaziphatha kahle. Isitho somndeni esifuna uxhaso singase sibe nesimo sokuzixhasa. Yiziphi izindleko ezingacelwa? Ungafuna uxhaso ngesizathu esifanele sokuhlinzeka ingane noma umuntu onelungelo lokugcinwa ngezimo ezifanele zokuphila nokukhula kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezidingekayo ezifana nokudla, izingubo, nezindawo zokuhlala, kanye nokukhokhela izindleko zemfundo. Ijaji lingakhupha umyalo wokuthi ubaba akhokhele izindleko zokugcinwa kwengane kusukela ngosuku lokuzalwa kwengane kuze kube ngosuku umyalo ukhishwa. Ijaji lingaphinde likhuphule umyalo wokukhokhela izindleko zokwelashwa, noma lingakhupha umyalo wokuthi ingane ibhaliswe ohlelweni lwezokwelapha lwezimbangi ezithintekayo. Ukuze ijaji likhuphule umyalo ofanele nowokulingana, bobabili abathintekayo kumele banikeze ubufakazi bezindleko zabo. Umbono wakho mayelana nesimo sokuziphatha komzali oyedwa awuthinti ilungelo lengane lokugcinwa. Omunye wabo bangase babe nezinye izingane. Isibopho sakho sokugcinwa kwengane asithinti ilungelo lakho lokubona ingane; lezi zinto zithathwa njengemisebenzi ehlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingane zodwa azithinti isibopho sokugcinwa. Nokho, inani lokugcinwa okukhokhelwayo lingashintshwa ijaji uma omunye wabathintekayo efaka isicelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. Faka isicelo sokugcinwa ejajini elikhulu endaweni yakho. Uma ungabaza, ijaji lendawo lizokwazi ukukwazisa ukuthi iyiphi ijaji okufanele ufake isicelo sokugcinwa. Yiya ejajini elifanele bese ugcwalisa futhi uthumele Ifomu A: Isicelo somyalo wokugcinwa. Ngaphandle kwefomu egcwalisiwe, hlinzeka ngobufakazi bemali yakho engenayo nangezindleko, ezifana nezinkokhelo zokudla, ugesi, kanye/noma izinkokhelo zokuqashisa. Ijaji lizobeka usuku lokuthi wena nomphenduli bavele ejajini. Umphathi wezokugcinwa kanye nomphenyi bazohlola isicelo sakho futhi bahlola izimo zakho. Ijaji lizokhipha izimemo kumphenduli ukuze avele ejajini ngosuku oluthile ukuze kuxoxwe ngalesi sihloko. Umphenduli angakhetha ukuvuma ukukhokha ukugcinwa okuceliwe noma aye ejajini ukuze aphikise lesi sihloko. Uma umphenduli evuma ukukhokha ukugcinwa okuceliwe, ummagistrate uzobuyekeza imibhalo efanele. Ngemuva kwalokho, umyalo uzokhishwa, futhi isinqumo singaphinde sithathwe ngaphandle kokuthi bobabili abathintekayo bavele ejajini. Uma umuntu ofanele ukukhokha ukugcinwa engavumi ukukhipha ukugcinwa, kumele avele ejajini, lapho kuzolalelwa ubufakazi bobabili abathintekayo. Uma ijaji lithola ukuthi ukugcinwa kumele kukhokhelwe, lizokhipha umyalo ochaza ukuthi mangaki okufanele akhokhwe. Ijaji lizophinde lichaze ukuthi nini nokuthi kanjani ukugcinwa kuzokhokhwa. Uzobhekwa ngokufana, ngedumela nokuqashelwa. Izikhalazo zizobhekwa ngokushesha ngendlela esebenzayo nebonakalayo. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Inqubo yonke, kusukela ekufakeni isicelo kuze kube sekutholeni izinkokhelo zokugcinwa, ingathatha amasonto ambalwa, kuye ngokubambisana kwababambiqhaza bobabili. Abafakizicelo abavela emhlanganweni, kuhlanganise nalabo abafuna ukugcinwa, bangathola inani elithile lokugcinwa nezindleko zokuhamba. Nokho, ijaji lizokwenza isinqumo ngokuhlonipha uma lezi zikhokhelo zizokhokhwa kumuntu owenze isicelo nokufaka isicelo somyalo. Umuntu ofuna ukugcinwa kumele afake isicelo kumphathi wezokugcinwa ngokukhokha izindleko zobufakazi. Le sevisi ayikhokhelwa futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa.

Ishadi 4: Izikole esizivakashele ezindaweni ezithile esigabeni sokuqala sika-2011. Ngo-2010, iGrain SA yaqale uhlelo ezikoleni olwakhiwe ngesisekelo seMaize Trust. Lolu hlelo lwaba nomthelela omuhle. Nge-application yethu kuMaize Trust yokuxhaswa ngo-2010/2011, saphinde sathumela isicelo sokuxhaswa ukuze sithuthukise impumelelo yalolu hlelo lwezikole. IMaize Trust ivuma ukuhlinzeka ngama-R360,000 ukuze kudalwe lezi ziqukathi ezintathu ze-DVD. Samukela isithembiso sabo saqala ukukhetha abantu ukuze bakhiqize lezi ziqukathi ze-DVD. Ekugcineni, sakhetha uMartie Williamse ovela kuNoline Productions ukwenza i-DVD yokuqala no-PW van Wyk ovela ku-AgriTV ukwenza i-DVD yesibili. Othisha bakhethwe ezindaweni eziyishumi: Free State, North West, North West/Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape, Northern Cape, kanye neMpumalanga. Esigabeni sokuqala, sivakashele izikole eziyi-180 futhi sabonisa abafundi lezi ziqukathi ze-DVD. I-DVD yakhelwe ngendlela evumela uthisha ukuthi ayivale ezikhathini ezintathu ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuxoxa ngalokho okukhonjiswa nabafundi. Ngemuva kokubuka i-DVD yokuqala, isikole sizothola iphosta ukuze sikhumbuze abafundi lokho i-DVD ebafundisile - Ukudla, Ukudla Okunempilo, Impilo. Lza njengabaxhomekeke bakho banelungelo. Abafakizicelo abavulekile: Sicela ubonise umholo wakho wanyanga zonke. Uma ungumqondisi ophakathi noma ophezulu, sicela ubonise iphakheji yakho yanyanga zonke ngaphandle kokubekwa umkhawulo. Faka iphephandaba lakho lokugcina noma incwadi ethi uqashwe uma ungumsebenzi omusha. Abafakizicelo abathola umhlalaphansi: Sicela ubonise imali yakho yanyanga zonke yomhlalaphansi. Uma kunjalo, ungumfundi omkhulu noma ungumxhomekeki? Uma ungumfundi omkhulu/umxhomekeki, sicela uthumele isitifiketi sakho sokuhlangenwe nakho kwezokwelapha esidala ukuqinisekisa usuku lokugcina (amakhadi okuba yilungu awanele). Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ubudlelwano bakho nezokwelapha obudala buyapheliswa. Zonke izinkokhelo zabasebenzi zikhishwa ngokuzenzakalelayo emiholweni yabo lapho kudingeka. Uma ukhetha ukukhokha nge-debit order, udinga ukuqeda imininingwane yeBhange leLungu ngezansi (Isigaba H). Imininingwane ye-akhawunti yebhange: Idingeka ukuze kubuyiselwe imali yeLungu, nokukhokha okudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe kuHlelo. Abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zezempilo abanezinsiza bangase bangazivezi, njengoba kudingeka ukuze kubhaliswe futhi kubalwe, uma le mininingwane ibhekwa njengobumfihlo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka i-GEMS noma abasebenzi bayo imvume yokuxhumana nodokotela wakho, esibhedlela, noma kunoma iyiphi indawo enikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ulwazi olukhona kule fomu luyiqiniso, luyalungile, futhi luqedile. Uma kukhona okungakwazi ukukukhombisa noma okungakahlukaniswa kahle, ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano bami bungase buphumelele futhi ngidinga ukubuyisela iHlelo nganoma iyiphi inzuzo engafanele ukhokhelwe egameni lami, ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokubizela. Ngikhetha lokho engikukhethile futhi ngiyaneliseka ngesimo sezinzuzo ngaphansi kwalokho engikukhethile. Ngiyavuma ukuhambisana nemithetho yeHlelo. Abaxhomekeki bami, ngaphandle kwalowo engishadile naye/umlingani wami, baphendukela kimi ngokuphelele noma ngaphezulu ngendlela yokuthi abatholi imali yonyaka edlula eyomhlalaphansi wombuso noma baqashwe ngokuphelele ngosuku lokusayina le fomu. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami nolwazi lwezokwelapha (olutholwe kubahlinzeki bezempilo ngemvume yami) kufanele lugcinwe luyimfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami lwezempilo oluyimfihlo nolwabangxomekeki bami lungasetshenziswa ngezinhloso zokucwaninga, idatha yezibalo, ukuphathwa kwezempilo, kanye nezizathu zokubika, futhi noma iyiphi ukuphulwa kwalokhu kusho ukuphulwa kobumfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi uma i-GEMS ifuna ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwami oluyimfihlo noma lwabangxomekeki bami ngezinhloso ezingakhulunywanga kulolu mvume, i-GEMS kufanele ithole imvume eyengeziwe kimi nabaxhomekeki bami. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami siqu nolwazi oluhlobene nezempilo ngeke lusetshenziswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi noma lidayiswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS inikeze abantu abathile ngaphakathi kwenkampani kanye nezinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi oluhambelana namalungu nolwazi lwabo oluhlobene nezempilo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS kanye nezinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lwezokwelapha/health oluhlinzekiwe/ukuhlolwa kwezifo/ukuhlinzwa ngezinhloso ezilandelayo - ukuze processing ifomu lesicelo sokuba yilungu, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlomo kokuthola izinzuzo, nokuphatha ingozi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ingene ezivumelwaneni zobumfihlo nazo zonke izinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo ezinalo ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi lwamalungu ngenhloso yokudlulisela idatha nokuphatha, ukuphatha uhlelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa. Ngizokwazisa uHlelo nganoma yiziphi izinguquko empilweni yami naleso sikhathi sabasebenzi bami noma izimo ezihlobene nathi, njengoba kudingeka ngemicimbi yeHlelo, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokushintsha. Ngizokwazisa i-GEMS okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-48 ngaphambi kokungena esibhedlela okungelona udaba oluphuthumayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukuhamba kokungahambi kahle kuzoholela ekutheni ingxenye yemali ekhokhwayo ikhawulelwe kimi. Imigomo izohlala isebenza, futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi izincwadi, ama-newsletters angaphakathi, nezincwadi zokuqhuba azikhululi imithetho yeHlelo. Ulwazi lwamalungu (ulwazi siqu nolwazi lwezempilo) ngeke lusetshenziswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi noma lidayiswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi. Kukhona izindlela zokuhlola ulwazi olutholakalayo. Uhlelo kanye nezinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lwezokwelapha/health oluhlinzekiwe/ukuhlolwa kwezifo/ukuhlinzwa ngezinhloso ezilandelayo - ukuze processing ifomu lesicelo sokuba yilungu, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlomo kokuthola izinzuzo, nokuphatha ingozi. Sicela ungathumeli lo mhlahlandlela ne fomu yakho egcwalisiwe. Ikhophi ye-ID yomfundi omkhulu. Iphephandaba lakho lokugcina/incwadi yokusebenza. Amafomu e-M2 ne-Z583, uma uthola umhlalaphansi/noma ubungumsebenzi wombuso. Kubalulekile ukuqeda yonke imininingwane kuSicaba A lapho kudingeka. Abahlali: Sicela uhlinzeke ngenombolo yakho yomhlalaphansi njengoba itholakala kumadokhumenti owabhalisile noma kuSertifika yeMhlalaphansi evela kuMnyango WezeMali. Sicela ubonise igama nekhodi yomqashi wakho wamanje. Ikhodi yenkampani ingatholakala kuphephandaba lakho uma ungumsebenzi wombuso. Sicela uqedele imininingwane yabaxhomekeki bakho kuSicaba B se fomu lesicelo. Akukho baxhomekeki ngaphandle kwalabo ababalwe etafuleni elingezansi abanelungelo lokuba yilungu. I-affidavit eqinisekisayo ukuthi umngani wakho uxhomekeke kwezezimali kumfundi. Isigaba esiqediwe sokuxhomekeka efomini lesicelo. Qaphela: Uma isibongo somntwana sahlukile kulowomfundi, i-affidavit eqinisekisayo ukuthi
