Izinhlelo Zokuphendula Ezimweni Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela: Ukuhlaziywa Kokuphathwa Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo zibhekwa njengenhloko-mali ebalulekile ezibhedlela, ngenxa yokuthi zidinga ukuphendula ngokushesha ukuze kuvinjelwe ukwehla kwesimo somtholampilo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zimo zixazululwa ngendlela efanele, izibhedlela kumele zibe nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo nezichwepheshile. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kuzogxila ezinqubweni ezilandelwayo, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Uhlelo Lokuphatha Izinsiza Nezisebenzi Okokuqala, ukuhlela izinsiza kudinga ukunakwa okukhethekile. Izibhedlela kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinhlaka ezanele zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, okubandakanya odokotela abanolwazi, izisebenzi zokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza ezifanele zokwelapha. Ukuhlola izinsiza ezikhona kufanele kwenziwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azikho izikhala. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene zomnyango wezempilo, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukuxhumana kahle ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Izinhlelo Zokuqeqesha Nezokufundisa Okwesibili, ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi ezibhedlela kubalulekile. Ukuze kube neqhaza elingcono ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo, odokotela nezisebenzi zokwelapha kufanele babe neziqu eziphezulu nezifundo ezenzakalayo. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha kumele ziqinise izindlela zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, ziqondise indlela yokuphatha izimo ezinzima, nokwenza kube lula ukufundisa abasebenzi abasha. Izinhlaka ezithuthukisiwe zokufundisa zingasiza ekuqedeni izinkinga ezivamile, ngaleyo ndlela zandise ukuphendula ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Ukuhlela Izinyathelo Zokuphendula Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphendula ezimweni ezithile, njengezingozi zemoto, ukuwa, noma iziguli ezithola izifo eziphuthumayo. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha lezi zimo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuthola, ukuhlola, nokwelapha iziguli. Izinyathelo kufanele zibe lula futhi zicacile, ukuze kube lula ukuzenza ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Ukuxhumana Ngezenzakalo Ukwazi ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zenzeka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi ezibhedlela kubalulekile. Izinqubo zokuxhumana kufanele ziqinise ukuvumelana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene, ukuze kube neqhaza elingcono ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana okuqondile phakathi kwabasebenzi, odokotela, nabaphathi, kanye nomndeni wezinsizakalo zabantu. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile nezinyathelo ezithathwayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngelungelo lokwelashwa oluphuthumayo. Ukubhekana Nezinselelo Kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza kusebenza kahle kungase kube nomthelela omubi. Uma izibhedlela zingenazo izinsiza ezanele, lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaboni ngeso linye phakathi kwezisebenzi nabaphathi kungaholela ekuphumeleleni okuncane kokuphathwa kwezimo. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izibhedlela kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izisebenzi ziqonda izinqubo ezithile futhi zisebenze ngokubambisana. Ukusebenza Kwama-Protocols Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izibhedlela kufanele zicabangele ukusebenza kwemigomo namaphrothokholi. Ukuhlolwa kwemigomo kufanele kwenziwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ihlale ifanele izimo ezithile. Ukusebenza kwama-protocols kufanele kube lula ukuwasebenzisa futhi kumele aqhathaniswe nezimo zomhlaba jikelele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zisesimweni esifanele sokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ukwaneliseka Kweziguli Ekugcineni, ukwaneliseka kweziguli kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile ezinqubweni zezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo akugcini nje ekwelashweni kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi ezwakalayo. Izibhedlela kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zikhuluma ngezinkinga zazo, futhi zaqonda izinyathelo ezithathwe ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo oluphuthumayo. Ukuhlelwa kwezinsiza, ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi, ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuphendula, ukuxhumana kahle, nokubhekana nezinselelo, konke kubalulekile ukuze kube nempumelelo. Ukuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo akugcini nje ngokuphila kweziguli, kodwa kuthinta nempilo yebhizinisi lesibhedlela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqhubeke zisebenza ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zazo ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ngendlela efanele.
I-Radio iyasiza kakhulu emasimini kubalimi abasha. Izinhlelo ezithunyelwa ngesonto ziyasetshenziswa futhi zinikeza ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nezolimo - abalimi bathola inzuzo ngalendlela. I-Radio Umhlobo Wenene (IsiXhosa eMpuma Koloni). Kungani siba nezigaba zokufunda futhi siqala kanjani ukwakha iqembu lokufunda? Imvula izofika. Sizoyisebenzisa kanjani le mvula? Yisiphi isikhathi esifanele sokuqalisa ukusebenza? Lapho inzuzo ihlala iphansi - kuphi abalimi abangafaka khona imali ezitshalweni ezisemqoka? Njalo nsuku zonke silahlekelwa umhlaba ngenxa yokwakhiwa kwezindlu, umhlaba owenza ukudla. Amanzi - ukuze sikwazi ukulungisa umhlabathi ngendlela egcina amanzi emhlabathini, amanzi atholakala ezulwini, noma uma unethuba, nge- irrigation. Ukudla - udinga umanyolo ukuze kukhule kahle. Umanyolo - nini futhi kanjani okufanele uwusebenzisa. Sihlanganisile izici ezinhle nezimbi ezihlobene nokusebenzisa umanyolo. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umsebenzi othile ubiza malini, akufanele nje uhlawule intengo abayishoyo. Uma unemishini, kufanele uyisebenzise. Kungani umgodi ophakanyisiwe ungabukeki ngendlela efanayo nombala nemigodi eminye - iyini inkinga? Ngisanda kuqala izinhlelo ezisebenzisa ulwazi olutholakele encwadini yethu ethi Pula/Imvula ebizwa: Ingabe udaba lokwenyuka kwentengo yokudla luzophakanyiswa kabusha kubalimi? Ungaphumelela kanjani ekukhiqizeni ukudla okuyisisekelo?
Ukulungiselela kwenziwa ukuze kutholwe, kubanjwe, kuphume, kuhlanzwe, kunikezwe kulabo abanelungelo, kusetshenziswe, futhi kudayiswe insimbi eyigugu; kanye nokubhekana nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Insimbi eyigugu ichazwa njengensimbi engahlanzwanga ehlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa nokuhlanganiswa, noma ihlanzwa kuze kube sezingeni elingaphansi kwe-99.9% futhi ingakafakwa emsebenzini wokwakha noma wokukhiqiza ngaphandle kokuhlanzwa noma ukwenza insimbi kodwa hhayi insimbi yokuphosa, ama-ingots, ama-nuggets, amabhathini, intambo, amaphakethe, i-sponge, amasampula, okusanhlamvu, ngaphandle kokusanhlamvu okwenziwe ngensimbi eyigugu ehlanzwe kuze kube sezingeni le-99.9% noma ngaphezulu, kanye nesilinganiso segolide ehlanzekile; noma njengoba kuchaziwe njengengxenye, into ethile noma umkhiqizo walesi sikhathi, into ethile noma umkhiqizo ohlwini lwesigaba a; noma iyiphi into noma ingxenye equkethe noma enensimbi eyigugu njengoba kuxoxwe esigabeni a kodwa ayifaki noma iyiphi into enekhono lokufunda ngempahla yendabuko noma eyenziwe noma ikhiqizwe ukuze isetshenziswe emisebenzini eyodwa noma eminingi yezimboni, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezobuciko. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa okufanele kwamabhizinisi ensimbi eyigugu eRiphabhulikhi; futhi ukuze kuqondwe izinhloso zokwakha umnotho kanye nokwakha umphakathi njengoba kuchaziwe. Umphathiswa unesibopho nganoma yisiphi isihloko esihlobene noma esixoxwa ngalesi sikhathi njengoba kubhekiswe kumphathiswa; futhi ngokujwayelekile, ukwenza yonke imisebenzi edingekayo noma ebalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zayo. Ngesikhathi esithile, ukwenza iziphakamiso kumphathiswa mayelana nanoma yisiphi isihloko esihlobene nalesi sikhathi; futhi ukuqoka noma yimuphi umuntu osebenza kuye njengomhloli ukuze enze imisebenzi ebekwe ukuba yenziwe ngumhloli. Le nsimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga akufanele idlule isisindo esishiwo futhi kufanele itholwe kulandela imvume ekhishwe nguMqondisi ngenhloso yokuzuza noma izinjongo zesayensi noma ngezizathu zobuciko; noma ukubamba noma ukuba nelayisense yokubamba insimbi eyigugu futhi uhambisane nemigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe. UMqondisi angakhipha kuphela isitifiketi esikhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1 d kumuntu ngokuxhumana nezezimali zendawo, futhi uma kuhlobene negolide, kanye noMphathiswa Kazwelonke. a lowo muntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 1; noma b unensimbi eyigugu ngokuhlangabezana noma ukuhambisana nezivumelwano zokusebenza nomunye umuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 1. Akekho umuntu ongenza noma kuletha insimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga ukuze akhokhe isikweletu sakhe, noma sokanye omunye umuntu noma mayelana nensizakalo ayinikezile noma ezokwenziwa ngaye noma omunye umuntu. Kungumuntu kuphela okukhulunywe ngaye kulezi zigaba 1 a, c, e, noma f ongakwazi ukwenza, ukuphuma, noma ukuguqula noma iyiphi insimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga anayo kulandela okukhulunywe kulezi zigaba. f ngelayisense yokuthola insimbi eyigugu; noma g ngovumelekile ukuba umkhiqizi wensimbi eyigugu. a okukhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1; noma b ubamba le nsimbi eyigugu ngokuhlangabezana nezivumelwano zokusebenza nomunye umuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 1. b kufanele akhumbule izidingo zeBroad Economic Empowerment Charter eyasungulwa kulandela izinhlinzeko zesigaba 100 seMineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act ka-2002 uMthetho No. 28 ka-2002; futhi c angahola uphenyo mayelana nesicelo uma ecabanga ukuthi kubalulekile. Noma yisiphi inqubo yokuphatha ethathwe noma isinqumo esithathwe ngokuhambisana nalesi sikhathi kumele senziwe noma sithathwe kulandela iPromotion of Administrative Justice Act ka-2000 uMthetho No. 3 ka-2000, ngaphandle uma lesi sikhathi sisho okuphambene. i kulandela imigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe futhi njengoba kushiwo yilesi sikhathi kumkhiqizi wensimbi eyigugu eNingizimu Afrika noma noma yimuphi umuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 4 1 a, b, d, e, noma f; noma ii ngendlela yesakhiwo esiphelele kumuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 5 1 a, b, d, e, f, noma g. e ukuthenga noma ukuthola kusuka kumhlanzisi onelayisense noma umkhiqizi onelayisense wensimbi eyigugu, umthengisi onegunya noma umkhiqizi noma noma iyiphi insimbi eyigugu ethengwe noma ehlanzwe ngokomthetho, umthengisi onegunya, noma umkhiqizi wensimbi eyigugu futhi ukudayisa le nsimbi noma insimbi eyigugu ehlanzwe bese uyilahla noma uyidayisa ngokuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe futhi njengoba kushiwo yilesi sikhathi; noma f ukuhweba kwensimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga noma engahlanzwanga akulethanga lapha eRiphabhulikhi ngaphansi kwemigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe. b angayala uMqondisi ukuba anikeze lowo muntu ilayisense, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ngezansi kulolu hlaka; noma c enze noma yisiphi isinqumo abona sifanele. Ngaphambi kokuba uMqondisi anikeze ilayisense yokuhlanzwa kumfaki-sicelo welayisense, kufanele akhokhe imali ethile. Ilayisense yokuhlanzwa iphela kulandela imigomo nemibandela ngaphansi kwazo ikhishwe. Umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa angasebenza noma iyiphi imisebenzi evunyelwe ngelayisense kunoma yisiphi esinye isikhungo noma indawo yokusebenza echazwe ngelayisense noma echazwe ngovumelekile okwengeziwe elayisense ngokuhambisana nesigaba 6, futhi umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukutholakala ebamba noma ephethe insimbi eyigugu kunoma yisiphi isikhungo ngaphandle kwendawo yakhe yokusebenza noma indawo echaziwe ngaphandle uma ethutha insimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe esigabeni 11. a Uma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kudingeka ukuthi umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa athumele noma akhulise imisebenzi ekhulunywe ngayo esigabeni 5 kunoma yisiphi isikhungo noma indawo engachazwanga elayisense yakhe, uMqondisi, ngemuva kokuxhumana okukhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1, angabhala kulayisense yalowo muntu le ndawo eyengeziwe entsha futhi kufanele azise ngokushesha iNational Treasury kanye noMphathiswa Kazwelonke ngale ndawo eyengeziwe entsha. b Imvume eyengeziwe ekhulumayo esigabeni a ayivumeli umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa ukuba enze imisebenzi yakhe kule ndawo eyengeziwe entsha noma ngaphansi kwegama elihlukile kunalelo lendawo ekhona. c Uma umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa efisa ukwenza imisebenzi kunoma yisiphi esinye isikhungo ngaphansi kwegama elihlukile kunalelo asetshenziswa endaweni akhona, kufanele afake isicelo seleyisense entsha ngokuhambisana nendawo entsha yokusebenza noma indawo. a Ngemuva kokuxhumana okukhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1, uMqondisi angavuselela ilayisense yokuhlanzwa kube kanye ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu, ngokukhokha imali ethile minyaka yonke
Izindatshana Zokubuyekezwa: Ezokusakaza Ezokusakaza, okuyindlela yokuhambisa ulwazi, ubuciko nemidlalo emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, zidlale indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi osahlangene. Lokhu akukhulu nje kuphela mayelana nemithombo yezokuxhumana, kodwa kuwukuxhumana okusemqoka okuhlanganyela abantu, kugqugquzela ukuhlonipha ukuphila kwabanye, nokuqonda izimo ezihlukene. Ngalesi sikhathi sokushintsha kwemithombo, sizobheka izici ezibalulekile zezakhiwo zokubuyekezwa, izinzuzo zazo, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nazo. Ukwakheka Kwezakhiwo Ezokusakaza ziqala ngezinhlelo ezilawulwa ngendlela ethile, kuhlinzekwa ngezinhlelo ezithile ezitholwa eziteshini zozimele, iziteshi zikamabonakude, nezinye izithombe zedijithali. Lokhu kukhombisa ubuchwepheshe bezwi, obuhlanganisa izikhangiso, izinhlelo zokuhlola umphakathi, nezinhlelo zokucobelela izindaba. Izinhloso zalesi sici zisekelwe ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukuphawula izinkinga ezikhona nesixazululo esinokwenzeka. Izinhlelo Nezithombe Ezitholakala Ngendlela Ehlukile Kuyathakazelisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa zigcizelela umqondo wokudlulisela ulwazi ngendlela ehlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxoxisana, ezithinta ezombusazwe, ezokwelapha, nezemidlalo. Uhlelo lwezindaba lungaba nezingxenye eziphawulekayo ezikhiqizwa ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezifana nezithombe ezigcwele, izinhlelo zokuphila, neziqubu ezibhalwe kahle. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa zidinga ukugxila ezinhlekweni zamhlanje, ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zababukeli, nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwezinhloso eziphakanyisiwe. Ubuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Ngenkathi ezokusakaza zikhula, ubuchwepheshe b balahlekelwa kubangelwa ukuguquka kwezindlela zokuxhumana. Izinhlelo ezidumile zemithombo yedijithali, njengezinhlelo zokwakha izithombe, zikhulisa ukuzibandakanya kwabantu. Izinhlelo ezingekho kumabonakude ziba nezici ezigxile kumaphrojekthi ahluke, abafuna ukufinyelela emishinini yokukhishwa. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokusakaza, kakhulukazi emiphakathini engashintshashintshi, iyefana neziteshi ezihlukene, i-podcasting, namahlelo edijithali. Izinzuzo Zokubuyekezwa Izinzuzo zezakhiwo zokubuyekezwa azilandelwa kuphela imiphumela emihle, kodwa ziba yinzuzo eminingi kumphakathi. Zisiza ekwakhiweni kwemibono, njengoba kuboniswa ngamandla nezinhlelo ezihlukene. Ukuhlola kwabaphromothi kudala isimo sokucabanga kakhulu okuyisidingo samasiko akhona. Ukwazi okuphelele kuhlinzekwa kumphakathi ngokuba nemithombo emisha, ekhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka indawo yokuhambelana kwezinhlaka ezihambisanayo, kusekela izehlo zomphakathi, kanye nezimpumelelo emkhakheni wezamasiko. Izingozi Ezihambisana Nezokusakaza Nokho, akukuphiki ukuthi siziphatha njengokusemthethweni, sicabanga ngezingozini ezithile ezihambisana nezokusakaza. Ukuhweba ngolwazi olungelona iqiniso, izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa komphakathi, kanye nokusabalalisa izikhumbuzo ezingcolile kukhulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzoba nephakathi kokwenza izinqumo ezinzima kulowomkhakha olwakhiwe ngesezindleleni zokubambisana. Kubakhona ukukhathazeka kokuthi ukudluliswa kolwazi kungaphazanyiswa, kudale ukuphazamiseka kokuphila komphakathi uma kungalawulwa kahle. Isiphetho Nendlela Phambili Ngokubheka ensukwini ezinzima, ezokusakaza zifanele ukubhekwa njengomkhakha ohloniphekile ogqugquzela umphakathi. Izidingo zihlala zivaleka, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abawazi ukuthi bahlale beziqhuba. Ukuvika ukuphazamiseka, umphakathi kufanele ubenze bonke abantu kube nomthelela osemqoka, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, futhi kube nezingxoxo ezinemibono enkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezinokwenzeka, kubaluleke okwandayo, ukuze kuthi ekugcineni, ulwazi ludlule kweziphakamiso ezinhle zomphakathi. Ezokusakaza, uma kusebenza kahle, kungaba yinsika eqinile yokuxhumanisa abantu abahlukene, kulandela umkhondo osbingazile, oda emhlabeni wonke. Kumele siqhubeke nayo le ndlela, siphile ezingeni elilungile, siphanculela ikusasa eliqhakazile nesithombe esihle sempilo yomphakathi.
Amalungelo Abantu Besifazane: Impilo Engcono NgeMizamo Yokulingana Amalungelo abantu besifazane abephakathi kwezinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni. Phakathi nezinkulungwane ezedlule, abantu besifazane babenobunzima obukhulu, okuhlanganisa ukungabi namathuba afanele emsebenzini, ezemfundo, kanye nasekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Nokho, eminyakeni yamuva, kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezilungiselelwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane, okuholele ekutheni baphile impilo engcono. INingizimu Afrika ibonisa ukuthuthuka okuhle kulokhu, njengoba imithetho efana ne-Employment Equity Act kanye ne-Promotion of Equality and Prevention of Unfair Discrimination Act iqinisekisa amalungelo alinganayo phakathi kwabantu besifazane nabesilisa. Le mithetho ivikela abantu besifazane ekucindezelweni futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi bathola amathuba alinganayo emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abantu besifazane ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi iyakhula. Lokhu kubandakanya imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abafundi besifazane ukuba baqhubeke nemfundo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi ukuze ziqinisekise ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezifanele. Nokho, nakuba kube nezinyathelo ezithuthukisayo, abantu besifazane basahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuhlukunyezwa, ukungabi namathuba emsebenzini, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala zihlala zikhona, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo eziphuthumayo zokweseka abantu besifazane ukuze baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukuze abantu besifazane bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithuthukisa amakhono abo, kubavulele amathuba emsebenzini, futhi kubanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukubandakanya abantu besifazane ezindaweni eziphezulu zomphakathi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni, kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi baphumelele, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ukwamukela abantu besifazane bezindima eziphezulu kuzokwenza kube nokulingana okukhulu phakathi kwabantu besilisa nabesifazane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amalungelo abantu besifazane azoba yinto ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Njengoba sikhuthaza imikhankaso yokulingana, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okhululekile, futhi onobulungiswa. Ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abantu besifazane bekwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, bephumelela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Amalungelo abantu besifazane awanqandeki, futhi kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuwavikela ukuze sifeze ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukuchaza amalungelo nezibopho zezingane; ukuchaza izibopho namalungelo abazali; ukwakha izinqubomgomo nemihlahlandlela yokuvikela izingane nokukhuthaza impilo yazo; ukuhlela izindaba eziphathelene nokuvikelwa nokuphila kwezingane, ikakhulukazi lezo ezisemngciphekweni omkhulu; ukuhlela imithetho ephathelene nezinsizakalo zokuphila nokuvikela izingane nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezixhomekeke. Izindlu zokunakekela izingane ezikhona zikahulumeni, izindawo eziphephile, izikhungo zokunakekela, izikole zezimboni, kanye nezinye zokulungisa ukuziphatha. Umprofessionali ophakathi kwenqubo yokuthola izingane ezamukelwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wochwepheshe Bezenhlalakahle, uMthetho ka-1978 No. 110 ka-1978, isivumelwano sokusebenza nezingane ezamukelwe, ngokuhambisana nenhloso yesigaba sika-17, sikhuluma ngalesi sivumelwano esibhalwe phansi esisayiniwe yinhlangano ebhalisiwe yokuvikela izingane eNingizimu Afrika kanye nenye inhlangano efana nayo evela kwezinye izizwe ngenhloso yokukhuthaza umsebenzi wokugcina izingane ezamukelwe phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezinye izizwe ezithintekayo. I-High Court, ngokuhambisana nenhloso yeSahluko 20. d ukuqinisekisa umsebenzi noma uhlobo olubi lokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okuvinjelwe yendaba yesigaba sika-141. UMthetho Wokuxazulula Ezinye Izindaba Zokuhlukanisa uchaza uMthetho olawula ukuxazulula izindaba eziphathelene nokuhlukaniswa kwabantu abashadile ka-1987 uMthetho No. 70 ka-1987, udokotela, uchaza uchwepheshe wezempilo obhalisiwe noma ophawulwe njengobhalisiwe ukuze enze umsebenzi wezokwelapha ngaphansi koMthetho Wochwepheshe Bezempilo, uMthetho Wezokwelapha Nezempilo ka-1974 uMthetho No. 56 ka-1974, umkhandlu, uchaza umkhandlu wesifunda, isifunda noma indawo eyasungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba sika-12 soMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwendawo: Uhlelo Lwemikhandlu ka-1996 uMthetho No. 117 ka-1996. Uchwepheshe wezempilo yengqondo uchaza umuntu obhalisiwe osebenza emkhakheni wezempilo yengqondo noma ophawulwe njengobhalisiwe kulolu work ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho Wezokwelapha, uMthetho Wezokwelapha Nezempilo ka-1974 uMthetho No. 56 ka-1974. Ukuxwayisa ngalesi sikhumbuzo, incwadi, noma enye inqubo ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho, kuchaza ukwethulwa kwalolo sikhumbuzo, incwadi, noma enye inqubo ngokuhambisana nenqubo enikeziwe yokwethula inqubo ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wamajaji ka-1944 uMthetho No. 32 ka-1944. I-Foundation of the United Nations Convention Against Trafficking in Persons ichaza ukuthi i-United Nations Convention izovimbela, icindezele futhi iphathe ukuhweba ngababantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nezingane, izokweseka i-2000 United Nations Convention against Transnational Organized Crime, umbhalo ofanayo we-English utholakala ku-Schedule 4. Kulolu mthetho, igama noma isigaba esithathwe egameni noma isigaba esichazwe esigabeni sika-1 sihambisana nencazelo efanayo ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okuphambene. e ukubheka izithelo zezimfanelo zeNingizimu Afrika eziphathelene nokuphila kwezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zezinsiza zomhlaba nezibopho zeNingizimu Afrika; ngaleyo ndlela f ngokujwayelekile, ukukhuthaza izinga lokuvikela, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuphila kwezingane. c nemithetho yasemakhaya ephathelene nokuvikela nokuphila kwezingane, ukungqubuzana kufanele kuqedwe ngokulandela isigaba sika-156 soMthethosisekelo. c nemithetho yasemakhaya, ukungqubuzana kufanele kuqedwe ngokulandela isigaba sika-156 soMthethosisekelo. Ngokwenzela ukuhlela kahle isigaba sika-2, ngokuhambisana nesigaba sika-1466 soMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele wethule zonke izimo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho ezithinta le ndawo kwiNational Council of Provinces ukuze kuvunyelwe. b umthetho ophatha inqubo eyenzeka ezinkantolo zezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sika-521. Lo mthetho kufanele ufezwe yizakhiwo zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke, ezifundazweni, uma kwenzeka ezakhiweni zokuphatha zendawo ngokuhambisana nesigaba esihambelanayo salolu mthetho nezimo ezazihilelekile ngokwehlukana nezibopho. Ngokucabangela ukuthi kukhona izidingo zokuphila nezomnotho ezikhona, ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwalolu mthetho, uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ezihambisana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze athole izindlela zokufinyelela nokufeza izinhloso zawo. c zonke izinqubo, izenzo, nezinsizakalo ezithathwe yizakhiwo zikahulumeni mayelana nanoma iyiphi indaba ethinta ingane noma izingane jikelele. Wezindaba zonke ezithinta ingane, izinga elikhuluma ngalesi sigaba sika-282 soMthethosisekelo ukuthi ilungelo nezidingo zengane zibalulekile kufanele kulandelwe. Izindaba ezibalulekile eziphathelene nengane kufanele ziqukethwe ngokubhekisela esigabeni sika-6 salolu mthetho. d ukuvikela ingane ekuhlukunyezweni nganoma iyiphi imbangela ephathelene nesimo sayo sezempilo noma izimo zomndeni. Uma indaba ethinta ingane ibandakanya ukukhetha phakathi kwabazali abathile nomunye, noma phakathi komgibeli wayo noma omunye umuntu, akufanele kube nokuhlukumeza kubazali, umgibeli, noma umuntu ngenxa yobulili babo. Uma isenzo esithile sizothuthukisa kakhulu ingane, umndeni wengane kufanele unikezwe ithuba lokukhuluma ngemibono yabo nganoma iyiphi indaba ethinta ingane. b imibono nezinto ezikhethwa yizingane kufanele zicatshangelwe ngokuhambisana nobudala bazo, ubukhulu, nesigaba sokuthuthukiswa. b ukungabheki ukwenza noma ukwenza isinqumo okumele sithathwe kufanele kugwenywe ngazo zonke izindlela. Umuntu onemithwalo nezibopho zokuba ngumzali mayelana nengane, uma ecabanga ngempela, ubukhulu, nesigaba sokuthuthukiswa kwengane, uma kudingeka, kufanele aziswe ngalolo sebenza noma isinqumo esithathwe mayelana nendaba ethinta ingane. Kulesi sigaba, "umzali" kubandakanya noma ubani onemithwalo nezibopho mayelana nengane. Amalungelo engane njengoba enikezwe kulesi Sahluko engeza kulawa malungelo engane atholakala ngaphansi kweBill of Rights. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni kuzo zonke izigaba zayo kanye nabasebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nezimeya zalezi zigaba kufanele bahloniphe, bavikele, futhi bakhuthaze amalungelo ezingane aqukethwe kulesi Sahluko. Isimo ngaphansi kwalesi Sahluko sishaya umuntu kanye nezakhiwo ezisunguliwe ngomyalo, kuye ngaleso simo lapho uhlobo lwamalungelo nomsebenzi owenziwa ngalolo lungqondongqondo. a uma lowo mthetho wenza noma ungase uhumushe njengokunciphisa ukufaka isandla ekusebenzeni kwalesi simo esidingekayo futhi okulindelekile emphakathini wabaningi, kusukela ekuqaleni, ekulungeni nasekw freedom uma kubhekwa zonke izindawo, kanye nalabo abhalwe esigabeni sika-36 1 a kuya
Iyini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye noMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? Ubani ophethe izinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke? Le mhlahlandlela ihlobene neMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Njengomthetho, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibhalwe ngolimi olusemthethweni olungelula ukuqonda. Le mhlahlandlela ichaza ukuthi umthetho uthi ini nokuthi kusho ukuthini. Isimiso esiyisisekelo seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke sithi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele bakwazi ukuthatha parte ekuphathweni kwamanzi. Inhloso yale mhlahlandlela ukusiza abasebenzisi bezinsiza zamanzi (imifula, imifula emincane, amanzi edamu, amanzi aphansi, njll.) baqonde umthetho ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha parte ezinqumweni ezihlobene nezindaba zamanzi ezithinta bona. Ubani okufanele afunde le mhlahlandlela? Noma ubani ofuna ukuba neqhaza ekuphathweni kwamanzi. Ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile ngezihloko ezithile, kufanele uxhumane neHhovisi Lesifunda eliseduze leMnyango Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni. Imininingwane yokuxhumana ibhalwe ekhasini lokugcina. Ikhophi yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ingatholakala ku-inthanethi ku-www.dwaf.gov. Le mhlahlandlela iqukethe ini? Le mhlahlandlela ayifaki lutho ngaphakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Ihlinzeka ngombono ojwayelekile weMthetho kanye nolwazi olucacile ngezindawo ezibalulekile zomthetho, okuhloswe ukusiza abasebenzisi bamazwe ukuthi bathathe parte ezindabeni zezinsiza zamanzi. Kukhona izikhungo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi ezisunguliwe. Kungani iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ubalulekile? I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba ibeka izindaba ezihlobene namanzi endaweni efanele ngaphakathi komthethosisekelo. Amanzi abalulekile empilweni yonke. Ngaphandle kwamanzi, akukho muntu, isilwane, noma into ephilayo engaphila. Amanzi akhulisa izivini zabafuyi, anikeza izilwane nezindawo zasemakhaya; anikeza ukujabulisa, asekele izindawo zokuhlala; asekele amadolobha namadolobhana amakhulu, imayini, imboni, futhi akhiqize ugesi. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphuze, bahlale, bakhe ukudla, bathathe izipho, futhi baphile kahle. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinomswakama omncane. Iningi lezinsiza zethu zamanzi zisetshenziswa ngokweqile. Njalo ngosuku, abantu nezinkampani bathatha kakhulu emifuleni nasemifuleni emincane, emanzini aphansi, nasemanzini. Izindawo eziningi ezweni zibhekene nokushoda kwamanzi, lapho sidinga khona amanzi amaningi kunalokho esinakho. Kulokhu, izindawo esihlala kuzo zingase zibe ngaphansi kwengcindezi futhi abanye abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile (okuphuza) noma abatholi ingxenye yabo efanele yamanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba ihlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuvikela izinsiza zamanzi ekusetshenzisweni ngokweqile futhi iqinisekisa amanzi okuthuthukiswa kwezokuxhumana nezomnotho kanye nezizukulwane ezizayo. Kubalulekile futhi ngoba uthi amanzi ayingxenye yabantu bonke ezweni ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke. Yini ezinsizeni zamanzi? Izinsiza zamanzi ziwumthombo wamanzi njengezindlela, imifula, amanzi, izindawo ezinamahlathi, kanye namanzi aphansi. 'Amanzi aphezulu' abhekisela kumanzi phezulu komhlaba. 'Amanzi aphansi' abhekisela kumanzi ngaphansi komhlaba (isibonelo, ama-aquifer). Yini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye noMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? 'Kazwelonke' kusho ukuthi umthetho uhlose wonke amazwe. 'Umthetho' ubhekisela kumthetho odlulisiwe yiPhalamende. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibonisa ukuthi umthetho mayelana namanzi, owakhelwe wonke uNingizimu Afrika. Wavunywa yiPhalamende ngo-1998. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo eyinhloko yabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Ithi amanzi kumele ahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo nangokufanele. Ithi amanzi adingeka njengokudla okuyisisekelo komuntu (njengamanzi okuphuza, ukulungiselela ukudla, nezidingo ezihlobene nempilo) futhi ukuthi amanzi endawo kumele abekwe eceleni ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye izicelo zihlukaniswe. Njengoba amanzi ebalulekile kubantu, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi abantu kumele bathathe parte ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Iphromotha ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi. Iqinisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngokuzilethela eduze kwabantu ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusungula izikhungo ezintsha zesifunda nezendawo, njengezikhungo Zokuphathwa Kwamafutha. Lezi zikhungo ezintsha zizoba nezithunywa zomphakathi futhi zizosisiza umphakathi ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ezinqumweni ezihlobene namanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke isusa yonke imibono yokucwasa mayelana nokufinyelela kwabanye abantu. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Iwandisa ukutholakala kwamanzi ukuze kuthuthukiswe. Yini inhloso yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke? Iqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi avikelwe, asetshenziswe, athuthukiswe, agcinwe, aphathwe, futhi aqashwe ngendlela esheshayo futhi efanele (ngokufanele) ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke. Ubani ophethe izinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke? Uhulumeni kazwelonke (UMnyango Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni) osebenza ngaphansi kukaNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni ungumgibeli wezinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni unomsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke isunguliwe. Le nqubo kumele iboniswe kuGazethi Yombuso. Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke ibophela zonke izikhungo zamanzi kanye nabasebenzisi bamazwe. UNgqongqoshe kumele abuyekeze futhi avuselele Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke njalo eminyakeni emihlanu. Yini inhloso yeNqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke? Inhloso yeNqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke ziphathwa kahle kulo lonke izwe. Iphinde ihlinzeke ngezikhombisi zokuthi amanzi kufanele aphathwe kanjani ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuphathwa kwamanzi. Ithi mangaki amanzi kumele 'agcinwe' ezidingweni eziyisisekelo zabantu nasezindaweni zokuhlala. Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke kumele iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona amanzi esikhathini esizayo nasezidingweni ezikhethekile ezifana nokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi kazwelonke. Ibeka amazinga okuhlukaniswa kwamanzi. Iphinde ithi izikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi (njengezikhungo Zokuphathwa Kwamafutha) kumele zisungulwe. Ukwesekwa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane: Isidingo Esibalulekile Sokukhula Komnotho Emhlabeni wanamuhla, amabhizinisi amancane ayingxenye ebalulekile yomnotho. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi anikeza amathuba emisebenzi, kodwa futhi adlala indima enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo. Nokho, amabhizinisi amancane abhekene nezinselelo eziningi, futhi ukwesekwa kwawo kubalulekile ukuze aqhubeke nokukhula. Ngalesi sihloko, ngizobheka izizathu ezibalulekile zokuthi kungani ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane kubalulekile, kanye nezindlela ezithile zokwenza lokhu. Okokuqala, amabhizinisi amancane anikeza amathuba emisebenzi. Njengoba sikhuluma, izinkampani ezincane zisebenza njengomthombo omkhulu wokuqashwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphezulu okungasebenzi. Uma amabhizinisi amancane ethola ukwesekwa, akwazi ukukhulisa imisebenzi, okwenza kube nokwengeza emnothweni. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa inani labantu abaqashwayo, kodwa futhi kudala umnotho ophilayo, lapho imali ibuyela emiphakathini. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi amancane anikeza ubuchwepheshe obusha nemibono emisha. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane bavame ukuba nezinselelo ezithile, kodwa lokhu kubavumela ukuba bacabangele izixazululo ezintsha. Ukuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane kungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezintsha, okungase kube nomthelela omuhle emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kungenza kube nokuncintisana okukhulu emakethe, okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane kudala umphakathi onobudlelwano. Amabhizinisi amancane avame ukuba neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yawo. Njengoba ethola ukwesekwa, akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, futhi lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi onobudlelwano uhlala unempilo, futhi ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu buvame ukuholela ekwakheni umnotho ophilayo. Kodwa-ke, ukuze amabhizinisi amancane akwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithile zokweseka. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele anikeze izikhuthazo ezithile, njengokunciphisa izintela noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokweluleka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane ukuba baqale futhi bakhule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zemfundo zingase zibe nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufundisa ezizokwenza abanikazi bamabhizinisi babe nekhono elidingekayo ukuze baphumelele. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhona. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokuxhasa ngemali, lapho abanikazi bamabhizinisi bangathola uxhaso lwezezimali ukuze baqale noma bakhule amabhizinisi abo. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezinjalo zingasiza ekunciphiseni ingcindezi yokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhizinisi amancane adinga ukuxhumana. Ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bakwazi ukwazisa abathengi ngemicabango yabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umkhiqizo ophumelelayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amakhasimende. Izinkampani ezincane kufanele zisebenzise izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze zikhulume nabathengi, futhi zikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle. Ekugcineni, ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane akukhona nje kuphela okudingekayo ukuze amabhizinisi akwazi ukuhamba phambili, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophilayo. Amabhizinisi amancane anikeza amathuba emisebenzi, ubuchwepheshe obusha, nemiphakathi enobudlelwano. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithile zokweseka, ezizokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba baphumelele. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze ukwesekwa kwamabhizinisi amancane, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakwazi ukwakha umnotho ophilayo, ogcwele amathuba, futhi okhulisa umphakathi wethu. Lokhu akusizi kuphela abanikazi bamabhizinisi, kodwa futhi kusiza wonke umuntu emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho, masibambisane ukuze sikhulise amabhizinisi amancane, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Bazalwane, umnyango ubize umhlangano okhethekile ukuze kuxoxwe ngembiko mayelana nezinhlelo zamaworkshop ezabanjwa ngonyaka ka-2000 ezweni lonke. Lezi zinhlelo zamaworkshop zazihloselwe ukuhlola intuthuko yokuguqulwa kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi. Sihlole ngokucophelela wonke amadokhumenti akhishwe, sihlole izinkinga eziphakanyisiwe kanye nemibono ewusizo kanye nenhloso ehlelekile yokwakha indlela enhle nebalulekile. Okokuqala, sifuna ukubonga ngenhlonipho ngempela ngokuphendula ngokushesha nangokwethembeka mayelana nalezi zinhlelo zamaworkshop. Ukuhlola intuthuko eyenziwe mayelana nezinguquko, kubhekwa ubuhlakani bezicwangciso, izinhlelo, nezinqubo ezisetshenziswe ekubhaleni isiphakamiso sokuguqulwa, ukusetha imigomo ngokusekelwe ekuhloleni intuthuko noma ukuwohloka kwayo ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi amaworkshop aphumelele yini ekubandakanyeni nasekutholeni ukwesekwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuguqulwa, njengoba kuhlose izinqubomgomo nemithetho kahulumeni, kubonakala kuyinto ebalulekile emehlweni abasebenzi. Ukugxila ebudlelwaneni phakathi kwalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla zokuhola noma zokuphatha nalabo abasebenza ngaphansi kwabo, siqaphele ngenjabulo ukuthi amaworkshop abhekwa njengethuluzi eliwusizo kanye nepulatifomu yokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezihlobene noguquko ngamalungu wonke abasebenzi, okukhombisa nokuthi abasebenzi bayavuma ukuba yingxenye yenqubo futhi bazibophezele ekuguquleni uMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi, nakuba bekukhona abaphikisana noguquko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sijabule ukuthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abaningi sebezokwazi ukujula izinjongo zama-workshop, njengokukhuluma ngezinkathazo ezikhona phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinkinga ezihlobene noguquko nezinselelo zedemokhrasi, ukuxoxisana nokukhuluma ngombono ophelele woguquko njengoba kuboniswe ezishintshweni zomthethosisekelo nakwezinye izinqubo. Umphumela wama-workshop obhekwa phezulu njengethuluzi eliwusizo ukhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi badinga leli thuba, indawo ephephile yokuxhumana kangcono nabanye babo ngokujula kokwehlukana kwabo, okuhlangenwe nakho, namasiko, hhayi nje njengabantu abathile abasebenza enhlanganweni eyodwa. Nokho, izinkinga ezihlobene nokungaboni ngasolinye noma ukungahloniphi umehluko wezamasiko zikhona futhi zidinga ukuxazululwa, futhi sizokwenza lokhu masisha. Kubonakala kucacile ukuthi kukhona ukuvumelana phakathi kwabasebenzi bonke mayelana nesidingo sokuguquka enhlanganweni yethu. Lo mphumela ubonisa izinto ezihlukene kubasebenzi abahlukene. Kubasebenzi abanye, isiko elikhona kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi alikaguquki ngokwanele ukuze babone izifiso zabo zokuba nohulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wedemokhrasi zifeziwe, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokusebenza. Izinga eliphakathi lokuphatha lisagcwele kakhulu ngabantu abamhlophe, kanti umsebenzi owengeziwe wenziwa abantu abamnyama. Nakuba kukhona izinqubomgomo ezikhona mayelana nokusebenza kwabantu ababephansi ngaphambili, amathuba abantu abamnyama ukuba aphakanyiswe ezikhundleni zokuphatha awabonakali, njengoba kuqokonyiswa phakathi kwama-workshop. Bonke abasebenzi bazizwa ukuthi umoya, noma ukuqeqeshwa kokuguquka, awukwazanga ukuhlinzekwa ngokubaluleka okudingekayo. Abanye abasebenzi abamhlophe baphinde bathi akukwanele ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bamukele uguquko njengomgomo, kodwa kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okubavumela ukuba basebenze njengabaphathi noma njengalabo abaguqukile ngempela. Ngaphansi kwezimo zokungaqondi izindlela zokuphatha kule nkathi entsha yokuguquka, kungenzeka ukuthi abaphathi babonwa njengabantu abaphikisana noguquko, ngenxa yokungazi ukuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngokwehlukile. Kukhona izinkomba ezinamandla phakathi kwabantu abamhlophe zokuthi uguquko yinqubo yokubambisana. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama bacabanga ukuthi abantu abamhlophe kuphela abadinga uguquko, hhayi bona. Abasebenzi abamhlophe bazizwa ukuthi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama abawuhloniphi umzamo wabo wokwenza izinto ngokwehlukile. Thina, emnyangweni, siqaphele le mizwa. Ngokuhlanganisa isakhiwo sokuphatha abasebenzi endaweni eyodwa, izinkinga nezinkathazo ezihlobene nenqubo yokuqasha engaphazamisi muntu zingaxazululwa kalula kakhulu kunakuqala lapha kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi. Umnyango usemsebenzini wokuphromotha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zabaphathi abahlose, izinhlelo eziqeqesha ngoguquko nezizobhekana nezinkinga eziphakanyisiwe ngabantu abasebenzi. Indima yethu izoba ukuhlanganisa lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Sizophinde sixhumane nesakhiwo sokuqeqesha somnyango ukuze sithuthukise izikhala zokweluleka ezithembekile ezizohambisana nenqubo yokuqasha engaphazamisi muntu futhi ehlose labo ababephansi ngaphambili. Sizosebenzisa isu lokweluleka, elichazwe kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi, njengesisekelo sokwenza iziphakamiso. Siphinde saqaphela ukuthi izinkinga zokuguquka ezihlobene nezisebenzi zomphakathi kwezincwadi nezincwadi zathathwa ngababambiqhaza abaningi ema-workshop. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezindawo ezithile zokuguquka, njengokushintsha ekubhekaneni nokusebenza kwabasebenzi, ukuthengwa nokutholwa kwezimpahla, ukuhlela nokuchazwa kwayo, azizange zaphikiswa ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuthazwe yilabo abaphatha uhlelo. Abasebenzi abakhulumi ngama-suggestions mayelana nokuthi bangasheshisa kanjani uguquko oludingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Sifuna ukubona ama-workshop exoxa ngezinkinga ezihlobene ngqo nemisebenzi emisha nezinselelo zayo ezivela ku-guquko, lapho singachaza khona inqubo yedemokhrasi yokuphatha abantu, isiko elisha lokubheka, umsebenzi omuhle wokubambisana nokuvuselelwa, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga zomsebenzi wobuchwepheshe azidingi ukubhekwa ngokufana nezinguquko ezihlobene nezisebenzi, futhi sicela abasebenzi baqonde ukuthi izinguquko ezindaweni zomsebenzi njengoba zirekhodiwe emthethweni zizokweseka isisekelo nemisebenzi yeMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi ngokugqamisa indlela ecacile nezinikela yokusebenza. Sizobhekana nalezi zinkinga njengengxenye yesu elisha lokwenza izinto nokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babambe iqhaza. Umnyango uqaphele ngenhlonipho nenjabulo ukuthi izinqubo eziningi nezicwangciso zokuguquka seziqalile ukusebenza kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi. Isibonelo salokhu kungaba ukufezwa kwenqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa nokusebenza kwabo ababephansi ngaphambili kanye nokuqashwa okungahlukanisi. Isingeniso Ukubhikisha komphakathi, okwaziwa nangokuthi "iziteleka zomphakathi," kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuzwakalisa imizwa, izikhalazo, nezidingo zabantu emphakathini. Lezi zenzakalo zenzeka lapho abantu behlangana ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo ngezinto ezithile, njengokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, noma izinqumo ezithathwe nguhulumeni. Ukubhikisha akukhona nje kuphela ukuveza ukunganeliseki, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokufuna ushintsho oluthile, olungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Uhlaka Lokubhikisha Komphakathi Ukubhikisha komphakathi kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle ukuze kube nempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo, ukuxhumana nabantu, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwababhikishi. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi ababhikishi babe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi yini abayifuna. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyavuma futhi uyazi kahle ukuthi ubani ofuna ukufinyelela kuphi. Izizathu Zokubhikisha Izizathu zokubhikisha zingahluka kakhulu, kodwa zihlala zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Ezinye zezizathu ezivame kakhulu zifaka phakathi ukungabi nezinsiza ezifanele, ukungahambisani nezinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umphakathi uthola ukuthi izinsiza ezifana namanzi, ugesi, noma imfundo azitholakali ngendlela efanele, lokhu kungaholela ekubhikisheni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo ezithathwa nguhulumeni, uma zingahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi, nazo zingaholela ekubhikisheni. Imiphumela Yokubhikisha Imiphumela yokubhikisha komphakathi ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma ababhikishi bephumelela, bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinqumweni ezithile ezizothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinsiza, ukwakhiwa kwemigomo emisha, noma ukulungiswa kwezinkinga ezikhona. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma ukubhikisha kuholela ekuphazamisekeni, kungase kube nemiphumela emibi, njengokuphazamiseka kokuthula, ukulimala kwabantu, noma ukwehla kokwethembeka kuhulumeni. Izindlela Zokuphatha Ukubhikisha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukubhikisha kuhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezindlela zokuphatha ezinhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphepha, ukuxhumana nabaphathi bendawo, kanye nokwakha izivumelwano ezithile. Abaphathi bendawo kufanele babe neqhaza elikhulu ekuphatheni ukubhikisha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zababhikishi ziyaqondwa, futhi zikhona izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwababhikishi nabaphathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga zixazululwa ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho Ukubhikisha komphakathi kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuzwakalisa imizwa nezidingo zabantu. Noma kunjalo, kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha ezinhle ukuze kube nempumelelo. Imiphumela yokubhikisha ingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi, kuye ngokuthi ababhikishi baphatha kanjani izimo zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, abaphathi, kanye nohulumeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa. Ukubhikisha akukhona nje kuphela ukuveza ukunganeliseki, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokufuna ushintsho olungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi.
Ubulili obuphakathi kwemindeni noma ukucwaswa kubhekwa nguMthetho Wokulwa Nobudlova Emndenini futhi kusebenza nasekubhekaneni nobudlova obuphakathi kwabantu abanobudlelwano ekhaya. Omunye onengane futhi. Noma yimuphi omunye umthetho wokucindezela noma ukucwaswa ongabangela umonakalo empilweni yakho, ukuphila, noma inhlalakahle. Vula icala lobugebengu emaphoyiseni futhi ufake isicelo sokuvikelwa. Lokhu kuyisiyalo esikhishwe yinkantolo ngesicelo sakho sokucindezela umuntu othile onobudlelwano obuphakathi, ukuba ayeke ukucwaswa futhi avimbele lowo muntu ekutholeni usizo komunye ukuze enze lowo msebenzi wokucwaswa. Isiyalo sokuvikelwa sesikhashana singakhishwa phakathi nosuku noma ebusuku ukuze sikuvikele engcupheni. Uzokwaziswa ngamalungelo akho nezinyathelo ongazithatha. Sizogcina ikhophi yesiyalo sokuvikelwa futhi sigcine amarekhodi wezehlakalo zonke zokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya ezizokwenzeka kamuva. Sizobhala ukukhala kwakho kwi-Register yezehlakalo esiteshini njengengxenye yobufakazi bokuthi ubike le ndaba - lokhu kuzoba ubufakazi obengeziwe ukusisiza lapho sibika ngenqubekela phambili yecala. Sizophenya ekhaya lakho, sithathe noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezikhali ezingatholakala kumuntu ophoxa ukukubulala noma ukukulimaza. Sizokwenze lokhu uma kuqinisekiswa ukuthi umqondo noma ukuziphatha komuntu ohlukunyezayo, ukugqugquzela ubudlova, utshwala, noma imishanguzo kungaholela ekulimaleni komunye umuntu. Futhi sicebisa umuntu ohlukunyezwayo. Futhi ngezikhathi lapho le nsizakalo echazwe itholakala. Sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi insizakalo yokusiza iqoqe futhi ibhalise wonke ubufakazi bokuphila obuzoba yingxenye yokweseka noma yisiphi isicelo sobugebengu esingase sibe khona. Sizokuhambela lapho uhamba ekhaya ukuthatha izinto zakho, uma isiyalo sokuvikelwa esikhishwe sihlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi. Uma amaphoyisa engalandeli lezi zobulungiswa, bika le ndaba kumphathi wesiteshi samaphoyisa. Sizothumela imibiko yenyanga yokukhala ethunyelwe ngamalungu enhlangano yamaphoyisa eqondiswe kwiHhovisi leMaphoyisa. Uma uphakathi kwengozi esheshayo, lowo ohlukunyezayo uzoboshwa. Uma kungekho engcupheni, lowo ohlukunyezayo uzonikezwa isaziso sokuvakasha enkantolo ngosuku olulandelayo. Uma kwenzeka, qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zakho ezisele (nengane) zifakwe zibe ziqinile futhi zigcinwe endaweni ephephile (isibonelo, kwabanye abahlali). Qinisekisa ukuthi uthathe wonke amadokhumenti abalulekile afana nezikhwama, ikhadi lakho leklinikhi, ikhadi lebhange, njll.
INingizimu Afrika inezibopho zomhlaba ngaphansi kwezivumelwano ezibophezela kanye nemithetho elawula amalungelo abantu emhlabeni ekwenzeni amalungelo abantu aphakamisa ukufana futhi avimbela ukwehlukaniswa okungafanele. Lezi zibopho zifaka phakathi imiyalelo yeSivumelwano Sokukhansela Zonke Izinhlobo Zokwehlukaniswa Ngobuhlanga kanye neSivumelwano Sokukhansela Zonke Izinhlobo Zokwehlukaniswa Kwabesifazane, phakathi kokunye. Ukukhona kokwehlukaniswa okwenziwayo nokungafani, ikakhulukazi mayelana nobuhlanga, ubulili, kanye nokukhubazeka kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila ngenxa yokwehlukaniswa okungafanele okwenzeka kokubili okwamanje nangokhistorical okwenziwa ngababusi ababephatha leli zwe bevela kwamanye amazwe, uhlelo lwe-apartheid kanye nesakhiwo sokuphatha esingabantu; kanye nesidingo sokuthatha izinyathelo kuzo zonke izigaba ukuze kususwe lezi zihlukaniso nokungafani. Le mthetho ibopha uhulumeni nabantu bonke. Le mthetho ayisebenzi kumuntu noma kunoma iyiphi indlela lapho iMthetho Wokulingana Emsebenzini, 1998 (Umthetho 55 ka-1998), isebenza kubo. Ngaphandle kokuthi uhulumeni noma yimuphi umuntu angakwenza lokho okungafanele kumuntu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvinjwa kokufinyelela emathubeni, kufaka phakathi ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo noma amathuba okuthola izinkontileka zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo. Kukho ukungafani okwenziwayo ekufinyeleleni amathuba kwabesifazane ngenxa yokwabiwa kwemisebenzi okwenziwa ngokobulili. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuphoxisa izithiyo ezivimbela noma ezivimbela abantu abakhubazekile ekuthokoziseni amathuba alinganayo noma ukuphoxisa izinyathelo ezifanele zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu abanjalo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungathandi noma kukhuthaze ukungathandi. Ngaphandle kokulimaza noma yimaphi amakhambi nganoma iyiphi indlela yokwephula umthetho ngaphansi kwalemthetho, inkantolo, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 21(a) futhi lapho kufanele, ingathumela kumqondisi wezokuphikiswa noma yisiphi isimo esihlobene nokwaziswa, ukukhuthazwa, ukubamba iqhaza, noma ukuveza ukukhuluma okungathandi njengoba kuboniswe esigabeni, ukuze kuqale icala lokukhuluma okungathandi njengoba kuqondiswe nguMthethosisekelo, noma umthetho ofanele. Akekho ongafaka noma iyiphi indlela yokuhlukumeza kumuntu. Noma ubani angakwazi ukwazisa noma ukukhombisa noma iyiphi isikhangiso/ukuphakanyiswa noma isaziso, esingahunyushwa noma siqondwe njengokuba nenhloso ecacile yokwehlukanisa kumuntu: Kucatshangwa ukuthi ukungena emsebenzini wokwakha/ukwakha, ukucwaninga okukhuluma ngezindaba zesayensi, ukuveza kahle ngezindaba zomphakathi, noma ukuhlinzeka nganoma yiluphi ulwazi, isikhangiso/ukuphakanyiswa, noma isaziso ngokuhambisana nesigaba 16 seMthethosisekelo, akuvinjelwe yilesi sigaba. Uma enye noma eziningi zezimo ezibekwe esigabeni (b) sokuchazwa "izizathu ezivinjelwe" ziqiniswa; futhi ngaphandle kokuthi ophendulayo uqinisekise ukuthi ukwehlukaniswa akukhona okungafanele. Akukona ukwehlukaniswa okungafanele ukuthatha izinyathelo ezihlosiwe zokuvikela noma ukuphakamisa abantu noma amaqembu abantu abathintekile kabi ukwehlukaniswa okungafanele kanye/noma amalungu alezi ziqephu noma izigaba zabantu. Noma ukwehlukaniswa okuhlukanisayo kahle noma okuvunyelwe umthetho phakathi kwabantu ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezingase zingathonywa yisiphi esinye isizathu, esidingekayo kulokhu. Ngokuqondene nokukhuluma okungathandi nokuhlukumeza, isigaba 14 asisebenzi. Zonke Izinkantolo Eziphezulu zingamakantolo okulingana kulawa maphuzu ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwazo. Zingashintsha noma zikhansela noma iyiphi isaziso esikhishwe ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba. Umphakathi ophakanyisiwe esigabeni (c) kumele abhale incwadi uma ethatha umuntu noma abantu abaningana, abazobhekelela inkantolo yokulingana, futhi ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba 2. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuphela labo abathathwe njengokuchazwe esigabeni abangathatha zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okungenani umuntu oyedwa ubhekelela inkantolo yokulingana endaweni ababephatha; futhi azise uMqondisi-Jikelele ngokushesha uma kukhona umgibeli, umphakathi, noma umphakathi owengeziwe ophakanyisiwe ukuze aqedele icala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 31 noma noma yisiphi ophakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba. Labo abaphethe ukuqeqeshwa okukhulunywe esigabeni 31 noma labo abaphakanyisiwe ukuba baphathe inkantolo yokulingana njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni. Umuntu ophakanyisiwe ukuba abhekele inkantolo yokulingana kumele enze imisebenzi futhi angasebenzisa amandla anikezwe yilomthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Abaphathi bezinkantolo zokulingana kanye noMqondisi-Jikelele weMnyango, ophathe izinhlinzeko zesigaba 2 kanye nemithetho elawula ukusebenza kweminyango kahulumeni, bangaphakanyisa umuntu noma abantu abaningana kulowo Mnyango, noma bangaphakanyisa umuntu noma abantu abaningana ngendlela ethile, abazoba abaphathi benkantolo yokulingana ukuze basize le nkantolo ukuba yenze imisebenzi yayo ebekwe. Ngaphambi kokuthi izinhlinzeko zesigaba 31 zisebenze; noma njengoba kubekwe esigabeni 31, futhi uma igama labo likhombisa ohlwini olukhulunywe esigabeni, abavunyelwe ukuphakanyiswa njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni (a). UMqondisi-Jikelele unelungelo lokudlulisela imisebenzi ethile noma amandla ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba kunoma iyiphi enye umsebenzi weMnyango ngaphansi kwezimo ezizobekwa ngu yena, kodwa lokhu akukhiphi izikhala zakhe zamandla anikezwe yilokhu, futhi unelungelo lokushintsha noma ukukhansela noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe ngalowo msebenzi ekusebenzeni kwalezi zikhala. Ukukhona kwabafakazi kanye nezinkokhelo zabafakazi ezimweni ezivela ekusebenzeni kwalomthetho kuzokwenziwa nguNgqongqoshe ngendlela ethile. Futhi isikhundla somthetho, ngokuhambisana nesigaba futhi njengoba kungekho enye imithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zesigaba 30 yalomthetho. Zonke izimo phambi kwenkantolo kumele ziqhutshelwe enkantolo evulekile, ngaphandle kokuthi inkantolo ingaqondisa ngokuhlukile ngenxa yemvelo yokuphathwa kobulungiswa. Ukusebenza kwesigaba (a), okuhlobene nokukhulisa umyalo, kuvinjelwe kuze kube yilapho noma yisiphi ukudluliswa okukhulunywe esigabeni 23 kuqedwa. Umuntu ofuna ukufaka isikhalazo njengoba kuchazwe ngalokhu noma ngaphansi kwalomthetho kumele azise umphakathi wenkantolo yokulingana, ngenhloso yokwenza lokhu, ngendlela ethile. Lokhu kuthathwa njengenkantolo ehlukile ngempumelelo yokuphatha kahle udaba njengoba kuchazwe ngamandla nemisebenzi yale nkantolo ehlukile. Uma umphakathi ophakanyisiwe unquma ukuthi udaba luzophenywa enkantolo yokulingana, umphakathi ophakanyisiwe kumele athumele udaba kumaphathi benkantolo yokulingana abathintekayo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe salokhu kuthunyelwa futhi
Ikota: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezakhamuzi Ngaphakathi kwedolobha eliphithizelayo, lapho izikhumbuzo zomlando zixubene nezinto ezintsha, umcimbi obalulekile ubusondela. Ikota, okungukuthi umcimbi wokuqhakambisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizukulwane, izakhamuzi, kanye namasiko, uhlelelwe ukuba wenzeke emaphandleni aseMkhumbane. Lo mcimbi, ophakathi kwezinsuku ezine, uzobanjelwa emhlanganweni omkhulu, lapho abantu bejabulisa, befundisa, futhi bexoxa ngezinto eziphilayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi uqala ngokuphawula, lapho izakhamuzi ziqala ukuhlangana. Umoya uthokozisa, futhi izwi labantu lihlabelela, likhuthaza ubungane obusha. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulile, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, izinkumbulo, nemicabango. Izingane zidlala, zibhakabhaka emoyeni, zikhombisa ubuhle bokukhula, kanti abadala bahlala behlangene, bexoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yansuku zonke. Ngenxa yokubaluleka kokuhlangana, umcimbi uqala ngokukhuluma okujule. Abaholi bendawo, bejabulile, banikeza izinkulumo ezikhuthazayo, bechaza indlela yokwakha umphakathi owakhiwe ngothando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhloniphana. Lezi zinkulumo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephakamisela phezulu izimvo zabo, futhi baphumelele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umoya wokubambisana ubonakala, njengoba izakhamuzi zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wazo. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, umcimbi uqhubeka ngezinhlelo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa imidlalo, umculo, nemisebenzi yezandla. Izinhlelo zenzelwe abantu bonke, kusukela ezinsaneni kuya kwabantu abadala. Izingane zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza, zifunde imidlalo yendabuko, futhi zifunde ngamasiko amasha. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuthi izizukulwane ezahlukene zixhumane, zifunde komunye nomunye, futhi ziqonde izimpilo zabo. Umculo, owudlalwa ngababukeli abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ubonisa ubuhle bamasiko ahlukene. Izinsimbi zomdabu zikhanga, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlanganyele emculweni, baphinde baphinde bahlabelela. Umoya uthokozisa, futhi abantu baphuma ezindlini zabo, bejabulisa, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabumbana ngezindlela ezahlukene, futhi umculo ungumgogodla walesi siko. Ngaphandle kwemidlalo nemicimbi, umcimbi ubandakanya nezinkulumo ezibucayi. Abantu baphinde baxoxe ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, njengemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, futhi bakhuthaze izixazululo ezihlukene. Izingxoxo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephakamisela phezulu izimvo zabo, futhi baphumelele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, izakhamuzi zikhumbula ukuthi ikota akukhona kuphela umcimbi, kodwa kuyisikhumbuzo sokubumbana, ubudlelwano, kanye nokuhlonipha. Umoya wokuhlangana ubonakala, futhi abantu bahlala bejabule, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa. Umcimbi uphinde ubonise ukuthi ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizukulwane busemqoka, futhi kufanele bukhulunywe, buphathwe, futhi bukhuliswa. Ekugcineni, umcimbi we ikota uyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi unamandla uma uhamba phambili ndawonye. Izingxoxo, imidlalo, nomculo kuveza ubuhle bamasiko ahlukene, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulisa, bejabulisa. Umoya wokubumbana uyakhula, futhi abantu baphuma bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa. Lokhu kube umcimbi ongasoze waphuma enhliziyweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi uzokhumbula imicimbi ye ikota ngothando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, ikota ibonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabumbana ngezindlela eziningi, futhi umoya wokuhlangana ubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sizofinyelela kuleso sikhathi esihle uma sikhumbula ukuthi sihamba phambili ndawonye, sikhuthaza, futhi sithokozisa. Umcimbi we ikota ungumgogodla wezinto ezinhle, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa.
UMphathiswa Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, emva kokuxoxisana noMphathiswa Wezindaba Zasemasikweni mayelana nezindaba zokuphatha kahulumeni ekhaya, wenza lokhu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 19 soMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1997) ngokukhishwa kwemiyalelo equkethwe kulolu hlu. a ukuhlinzeka noma ukwamukela noma yisiphi isikhwama esingafanele, ukungena, isipho, noma enye inzuzo engafanele eyenzeka ngoba kufanele noma akufanele uthathe isinyathelo esithile esithinta isivumelwano; b ukufuna, ukuhlinzeka, ukubamba iqhaza, ukudala umjikelezo, nokuzama ukudala izimo ezichazwe emiyalelweni a. e Umthetho Wokulingana Kwezemployment ungumthetho No. 75 ka-1997 futhi f Umthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ungumthetho No. 97 ka-1998. a ucabangela ulimi abathanda noma olusebenzisa endaweni futhi b ucabangela izidingo ezihlukene zabantu abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala nalabo ababe nezinselelo esikhathini esedlule. c chaza izimo nemigomo ngaphansi kwazo abanye abahlinzeki bezamanzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendawo ephethwe yikhabhinethi yamanzi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ingxenye yephrogram yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. d isivumelwano kumele sichaze ububanzi bomsebenzi nezinga lomsebenzi okufanele lenziwe, futhi sizokhomba ukuthi uma kushintsha, kuzoshintsha ngokuya ngezimo zendawo zesivumelwano nezidingo ezithile, kuhlanganise nesikhathi esichaziwe futhi kubalulekile ukuba kuhambisane nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezezimali ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinga lomsebenzi elibekiwe; futhi e chaza lezo zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezizoba yingxenye yesivumelwano kanye nohlelo ukuze umhlinzeki wamanzi akwazi ukufinyelela lezo zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zazo zonke izinhlangothi ekutholeni noma yiziphi izimvume ezidingekayo, ukuze usebenzise amanzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 soMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). b Isivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokuqhathaniswa kwesikhathi somsebenzi owenziwayo; kufanele futhi c ivumele ithuba lokuphinda kuxoxwe ngezinga lomsebenzi nezinkomba ezihilela labo abasebenzisa amanzi. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezimo ezibalulekile okufanele umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi ahlangabezane nazo mayelana nokwenza umsebenzi. Isivumelwano kumele sihlanganise umthetho ozovimbela umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi ekudluliseni amalungelo akhe noma yiziphi zezibopho zakhe zesivumelwano kumuntu nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba athole imvume yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Isivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuhlela kwabasebenzi abakule khabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi abahilelekile ekuhlinzekeni ngamanzi nalabo abathintekile ngesivumelwano mayelana nokuthi bazokhokhelwa kanjani ngokwezomthetho wezabasebenzi. i futhi kuzoletha izinguquko kumali ezikhokhwayo, amaholo, noma kuzoletha izinguquko ezingeni noma izinga lokusebenza ii lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuveza ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezichibiyelo nezinguquko eziphakanyisiwe ku-I ngenhla; futhi h noma yiziphi izijeziso ezingafanele zikhokhwe nganoma ubani onenhlangano yokungaphumeleli ukwenza umsebenzi. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi noma iyiphi uhlelo olubhaliwe, incwadi yemiyalelo, isizinda solwazi, uhlu olunembile, amarekhodi ezimali, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluqoqwe ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano kuzohlala kuyimpahla yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. a ivimbela ukuthengiswa, ukudluliswa kwamalungelo okuphatha, noma ukungabazi kwanoma iyiphi impahla engumhlaba kanye nezakhiwo ezikhona noma ezizayo futhi engelona impahla yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kuhlanganise nanoma iyiphi ingxenye yezenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ngaphandle kokuthi ukuthengiswa, noma ukudluliswa kwamalungelo noma ukungabazi kuhlelwe ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi noma ii kuqinisekiswe ngesisekelo sokuxazulula se kaphalamende yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. b isivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokuqhubeka kokungabazi kwezakhiwo futhi sichaze amasu okugcina impahla isesimweni esisebenzayo ukuze kukhombise ukuthi umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ugcinwa esimweni esifanele; bese c sichaza inqubo yokuthola impahla, ukuthengisa, ukudlulisa amalungelo okuphatha, nokulahla impahla engabazekile. c kumele ihlinzeke ngokuqhathaniswa kwezimali ngezikhathi ezichaziwe mayelana nendlela esetshenziswe; futhi d ihlinzeke ngokwabelana ngezinzuzo zezimali ezizotholakala ngokwenza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele nasezingeni lomhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi. ukuba nohlelo lokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzisi bamanzi iii chaza ilungelo lomsebenzisi wamanzi lokuthi kube nezinkinga ezilungisiwe b qapha ukuhlala kwenqubo ezovumela abasebenzisi bamanzi endaweni lapho isivumelwano sisebenza khona ukuba babambe iqhaza ekubhaleni idokhumenti yamalungelo abasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kumele kuhlelwe ukuthi i kube nemihlangano nemiphakathi lapho, uma ibanjwe, kuhlonishwa ulimi oluthandwa nolukhuluma abantu bendawo lapho isivumelwano sisebenza khona; bese ii kube nendlela yokwamukela, ukuhlaziya, nokucabangela imibono neziphakamiso zabantu abasebenzisa amanzi ezethulwe mayelana nedokhumenti yamalungelo ephakanyisiwe. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi ikhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi izobheka kanjani ukusebenza komhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi ukuze ihambisane nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 27 soMthetho. Isivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi uhlinzeka ngolwazi olungase ludingeke yikhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuze iqaphe ukuhambisana nesivumelwano ukuze ikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo zokubika kuMphathiswa kanye nohulumeni wesifunda ukuthi umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi uyahambisana nomthetho nalesi sikhombandlela. a lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi nezitatimende zezimali ngokulandela incwadi yemithetho ethathwa njengelungelo kwezomnotho futhi yamukelwe Njengoba Yamukelwe Izindlela Zokubala Ezivamile eNingizimu Afrika noma uma kukhulunywa ngezinga elithile likahulumeni, landela umthetho ofanele wokubika kwezezimali; futhi b ivumele ikhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuthola wonke amarekhodi nezitatimende zezimali adingekayo ukuze ahlolwe futhi abhaliswe ngaphansi kwesivumelwano. a qopha bonke abantu abasebenzisa amanzi nalabo abake bawasebenzisa ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano b uhlu lwezimpahla nezakhiwo zezinsizakalo zamanzi kuhlanganise nezimo zazo nezindawo zazo futhi c qopha imisebenzi, ukugcinwa kwemishini nezinsiza, ukuhlolwa, nokucubungula izimo zemishini. Umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi kumele ngaphansi kwesivumelwano aqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo ngabantu abasebenzisa amanzi kanye nalabo abangase bawasebenzise esikhathini esizayo lukhona. e izimali ezikhokhwayo nezinhlelo.
