Lo msebenzi wokukhwabanisa uqala ngumphefumulo ophula umthetho ngokuxhumana nenkampani ethile ngokuthumela ifeksi, incwadi, noma i-imeyili. Kwenziwa isiphakamiso sebusiness, esenziwa iqembu labakhwabanisi abenza sengathi bangabasebenzi bakamasipala. Abakhwabanisi benza amanga bethi banebhajethi enkulu kakhulu, ngokuvamile bethi ikhuluma ngamaRandi aseMelika. Isiphakamiso sebusiness ngokuvamile sichaza ukuthi banemali enkulu kakhulu abafuna ukuyithumela ngaphandle kwelizwe labo bese beyifaka kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yangaphandle. Umuntu othola le ncwadi uvame ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi uma esiza, uzothola ikhomishini engu-20% kuya ku-35% yemali ezothunyelwa ebhange ngokuvuma ukusebenzisa i-akhawunti yabo yasebhange. Labo abavuma ukuhwebelana nabo uvame ukufunwa ukuthi bafake imali kwi-akhawunti ethile yasebhange ukuze basize ukukhokhela izindleko zokuthumela le mali. Uma sebekhokhe le mali, uvame ukuvezwa ukuthi kukhona "ukuphazamiseka," ngakho-ke kumele bafake enye imali. Imihlangano ivame ukuhlelwa nalowo muntu kwezinye izindawo, futhi uma lowo muntu ese kulowo mhlaba, ipasipoti yakhe iyathathwa, futhi baphoselwa emaphoyiseni ukuze bahlele ukufaka enye imali kwi-akhawunti yabakhwabanisi. Amakhasi angamanga angasetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yasebhange, kuthunyelwa imali kwi-akhawunti yomuntu ophoswe emaphoyiseni iye kwi-akhawunti yabakhwabanisi. Ukukhwabanisa kokuziphindisela kuvame ukuqala ngumphefumulo ophula umthetho ngokuxhumana nabantu bonke, ngokuvamile besebenzisa i-imeyili. Umphakathi ophula umthetho uvame ukuveza ukuthi ungumsebenzi omele inkampani ye-Lottery, futhi ubonisa umuntu ukuthi uwine imali ye-lottery, noma ngabe lowo muntu akathenganga ithikithi le-lottery. Banikeza izinombolo eziphumelelayo ezincwadini abazibhala, noma ngabe inkampani ye-Lottery abakhwabanisi abathi basebenza kuyo iyatholakala, izinombolo abakhwabanisi abazinikeza ngempela yizibalo eziphumelelayo, lokhu kuyinkohlakalo yokuziphindisela. Lezi zindlela zokukhwabanisa zisetshenziswa kumakhwabanisi ka-419 ukuze zibe nomthelela emalini yabanjwa. Ukuze uthole eminye imininingwane ngale nkohlakalo yokuziphindisela, ungayithola kuwebhusayithi yePhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika, futhi kukhona izindlela abakhwabanisi abenza ngazo, uhlelo lwabo, ukuze bakhweze abantu emalini yabo, nezindlela zokuvikela ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uthole imininingwane eningiliziwe, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yePhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika. Uma uthola incwadi yokukhwabanisa, thumela incwadi, kanye nolwazi ku-Interpol. Nikeza imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana nezinsiza, noma lezo zomuntu ophakathi. Uma kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kohlelo lwe-"419" kanye neNingizimu Afrika, chaza lokhu ngokucacile ngemininingwane efanele. Nikeza imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana nezinsiza, noma lezo zomuntu ophakathi. Isevisi yePhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika iyona ebeka isikhathi esizothathwa ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ukuze ikhiphe umbiko wokuthi umsebenzi uhamba kanjani. Imibiko ivame ukukhiphwa njalo ezinsukwini eziyi-14 kuye ngokwemvelo yecala. Imibiko yokuthi umsebenzi uhamba kanjani ngeke inikezwe abantu, uma kungakabi khona ukulahleka okwenziweyo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi iPhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika ithole amakhophi ezincwadi zokukhwabanisa ezivela kuhlu lwe-"419", ukuze zifakwe kwi-database yabo. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Akukho, kodwa kubalulekile ukukhombisa emadokhumenti uma kukhona ukulahleka kwezimali okwenzekile.
Umuntu ongumZulu ofuna ukuba nesimo sokuba ngum citizen wezinye izwe kumele afake isicelo eMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi ukuze aqhubeke nokuba ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi ethola isimo sokuba ngum citizen wezinye izwe. Ukuba ne-citizenship ephindwe kabili kusho ukuthi umuntu ubhekwa njengom citizen wezizwe zombili. Isimo se-citizenship ephindwe kabili sinikezwa abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-21. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma le-mission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-1664 kanye ne-BI-529 kunoma yisiphi isikhungo seMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Thumela idokhumenti yokuzazisa esebenzayo. Kungathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili ukuze kuqedwe.
Ngalesi sikhathi sokuqala sokuphatha (1994-1999), uMnyango Wezobumbano Nezokuphatha Zasendaweni (dplg) wawubalulekile ekusebenziseni isivumelwano esisha somthethosisekelo sokudlondlobala. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo emisha kanye nezisekelo zomthetho zokuphatha kwendawo eNingizimu Afrika. Lo msebenzi obenhla uveze imithetho yokuphatha kwendawo, iMthetho Wezinhlelo Zasemakhaya, iMthetho Wamasu Wasemakhaya, iMthetho Wokuhlawula Izindlu Zasemakhaya, kanye neMthetho Wokuhlela Izinhlelo Zasemakhaya phakathi nalesi sikhathi. Ukuqapha okuqondile ngesikhathi sokuqala somsebenzi kwakuwukwakha isikhungo esisha sezepolitiki esibalulekile kuhulumeni odlalayo ezingeni lesizwe nasezindaweni. Ukuqala kwesikhathi sesibili sokuphatha ngo-1999 kwalethe ushintsho egameni lalesi sikhungo, okwaholela emisebenzini yayo emisha. Umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa umthethosisekelo wathunyelwa kuMnyango Wezobulungiswa, owabe usubizwa kabusha ngokuthi uMnyango Wezobumbano Nezokuphatha Zasendaweni (dplg). Amandla amasha e-dplg aba yisisekelo ekuthuthukiseni ukuphathwa, kwandisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, futhi kwavumela ukuthuthukiswa. Ngenxa yalokho, amandla e-dplg aguquka ukusuka ekubeni umgcini womthethosisekelo kuya ekuqineni izikhungo zokuphatha nokwandisa ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa iminyango nokwakha uhlelo olusha lokuphatha kwendawo. Ngokwakhiwa komgomo wezokuphatha kwendawo, ukuqapha kwayo okuqondile kwaba ukusungulwa kwamamunicipality kanye nezinhlelo zawo njengesisekelo nokweseka isimo sokusebenzisa amandla awo omthethosisekelo. Izinhlelo Zokuphatha Ezibanzi: Lezi ziqinisekiso zihlanganisa ukukala ukusetshenziswa kweHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni Ezihlala Zihlala (isrdp), uHlelo Lokuvuselela Izindawo (urp), Izinsizakalo Zesisekelo Mahhala (fbs), ukuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka, kanye nokwakha umgomo wokuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka kanye nezisekelo zomthetho, kanye nokushintsha imithetho enegunya lezi zikhungo zokuhola ezindaweni zokuphatha nasemiphakathini ebandakanya ezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni. Uhulumeni Wesifunda: Ukuqapha okuqondile phakathi nesikhathi esiningi se-term kusekela izifunda ukuze zikwazi ukusebenzisa ukwesekwa kwazo kanye nemisebenzi egcizelelwe mayelana namamunicipality. Uhulumeni Wendawo: Omunye umqondo wokuphepha okuqondile nguMnyango mayelana nohulumeni bendawo wawukusebenza kwemigomo emisha kanye nemithetho yokuphatha kwendawo, usekela ukusungulwa kokuphatha kwamamunicipality kuzo zonke izingxenye zawo futhi uqedela yonke imithetho yawo yokuphatha efana neMthetho Wokuhlawula Izinsizakalo Zasemakhaya (Mthetho Wezintela Zasemakhaya). NgoDisemba 2000, amakhandidethi akhethwe okokuqala aqala ukusebenza ngaphansi kwesakhiwo somthetho esisha. Okufakiwe kule ndawo yemisebenzi kwakuwukuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka, ukusungulwa kwesakhiwo somthetho sokuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka kwazulu, kanye nokwethulwa kwezinyathelo zokuvikela ezimweni ze-Y2K. Ingxenye yesibili yalomsebenzi yayiqondiswe ngokuqondile ekulethweni kwezinsiza zokwakha kanye nezibonelelo ezilinganiselwe kumamunicipality. Lezi zinsiza zemali zakhula unyaka nonyaka, zakhokhela ukusungulwa kwemali yokuqala kumamunicipality kanye nokwandiswa kwezimo zokuhlinzeka ukuze kuqedwe okwakuhamba kancane ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Kusukela ngo-1994, isimo esisebenza njengemishini ye-apartheid saguqulwa saphenduka sibe ngama-1200 ezikhungo zomphakathi ezisekelwe ebuzweni, izifunda ezine zokuphatha, kanye nezindawo eziyi-10, saguqulwa sibe ngama-284 amamunicipality akhethwe, izifunda eziyi-9, kanye nohulumeni wesizwe onamandla. Ukhetho oluthule kanye nedemokhrasi ephelele kwenziwa ngo-1994, ngo-1999, nase-2004 kuhulumeni wesizwe, wesifunda, kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Uhulumeni kuzo zonke lezi zinkalo uphumelele ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zokuhlukumeza ubuphofu nokungathuthukiswa ngokuphelele. Izinhlelo nezinhlelo zafezekiswa ezindaweni ezifana nokudla nokudla okuyisisekelo, amanzi nezinsizakalo, ugesi nokuhlinzekwa kwamandla, izindlu nezindawo zokuhlala, ukulungiswa komhlaba, ukuthutha, imfundo, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ama-SMME, kanye nokuhlanganiswa komphakathi. Ububanzi bezifunda ukuze ziqhubeke zithola izinsiza ezikhululiwe ezivela ku-fiscus zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nakho kwaba yimpumelelo yangempela. Ukuhlolwa okuphelele kwezifunda kukhombise ukuthi zikwazi ukusebenzisa izabelomali eziguquliwe ngempumelelo futhi zakhombisa imiphumela ebonakalayo ekuphathweni kokusetshenziswa kwezimali. Izinhlelo zamamunicipality njengesisekelo zisetshenziswe futhi zakhuliswa ukuze ziqondise ngokuqondile ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, ukuhlanganiswa kokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, kanye nokuphathwa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwesekwa kwezimali kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi kusebenze ekuxazululeni okwakuhamba kancane kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi ezindaweni ezazingenakuphila ngokuphelele. I-MIG iyindlela yokudlulisela izinsiza ezintsha ezihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ukudluliswa kwezimali kumamunicipality ngendlela ecacile futhi eqondile. Imigomo yayo iyashintsha, ihloselwe ukweseka izabelomali zamamunicipality, futhi ilungiselela uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. I-MIG ngeke ikhokhele ezinye izinhlelo, kodwa ihloselwe ukuvumelanisa nezabelomali zamamunicipality (efana ne-grant yokwakha yesifunda). Ukubika ngokusetshenziswa kwezimali kuzobe kuhamba kuyo yonke ibhajethi yamamunicipality, okumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona izabelomali zokusebenza esikhathini esizayo ukuze kusekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ezabelwe. Iminyango yombuso kazwelonke izoqhubeka ihola futhi isekele ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ezinhlelweni futhi ithuthukise izinhloso ezicacile. I-isrdp iyisinyathelo sikahulumeni, esihlinzekwa nguMnyango Wezobumbano Nezokuphatha Zasendaweni. Iqala ukusebenza ngo-Okthoba 2000, emva kokuvunywa nguMkhandlu. Le nhlelo ihlose ukulwa nobuphofu, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, intsha, nabantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Inhloso eyinhloko yohlelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni usebenza ngokubambisana nemiphakathi nabanye abathintekayo ukuze kulwe nobuphofu futhi kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. I-isrdp ihloselwe ukufezekisa ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi kanye nomphakathi osezingeni eliphezulu onomnotho ophilayo futhi oqinile ongagcina isithunzi semiphakathi yasemakhaya. Ukuthuthukiswa kwasemakhaya kuhlose okungenani ukugqiba ukuhamba phambili kwabantu basemakhaya eminyakeni eminingi ngokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kanye nokufinyelela okuphelele ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi ezifana nemidlalo nezokuzijabulisa, izikole, ama-clinic, nj
Ubugebengu Emiphakathini: Uhlolojikelele KaSipho Mthembu USipho Mthembu ungumuntu ophuma emiphakathini ehlukene, futhi izimpilo zakhe zikhombisa izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithile ezisemadolobheni. Ubonile ukuthi ubugebengu buphazamisa ukuthula nokuphepha kwabantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezithwele kanzima. Ekhuluma ngokukhula eThekwini, uSipho waqala ukuqonda izimo ezinzima abantu abaphelela kuzo, futhi lokhu kwaqhubekela phambili empilweni yakhe. U-Sipho, osanda kuphothula izifundo, wathola umsebenzi wokuba umfundisi wezokuphepha emphakathini, lapho efuna ukusebenzisana nabantu bendawo. Njengoba efundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuzivikela, waqonda ukuthi ubugebengu abuthinti kuphela abantu ababi, kodwa buphinde buthinte nemindeni, izingane, kanye nemiphakathi yonke. U-Sipho wakhuthazwa ukuba abe neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi, efuna izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ubuhlungu obuvela ekuhluphekeni kubonisa izimbangela eziholela ekwenzeni ubugebengu. U-Sipho uqonde kahle ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlala ezimweni ezinzima, futhi umnotho omubi, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, kanye nobubha, kuhloswe ukuvusa izinqumo ezingezinhle. Waphawula futhi ukuthi ukuvikeleka komphakathi akupheleli ezinsizeni zomthetho, kodwa kudinga ubambiswano phakathi kwemiphakathi. Waqala imihlangano yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bendawo, lapho ababehlanganyela khona izinkinga zabo neziphakamiso. Lezi zinhlelo zakhombisa izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ezifana nemicimbi yokufundisa, ukusiza abasha ukuthola imisebenzi, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola izindlela eziningi eziphumelelayo zokulwa nobugebengu. Wabamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokwakha umphakathi, ezazihlanganisa abantu abakhethiwe, izikhulu zomphakathi, nabantu abathintekayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuxhumana, futhi kwaqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyakha isithunzi esihle. U-Sipho wanikela isikhathi sakhe emisebenzini yokubambisana, futhi uzitholela umoya ophakeme emsebenzini wakhe. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. U-Sipho ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, njengezinkinga zokubandlululwa phakathi kwamanye amaqembu, nokuqonda okungafanele phakathi kwabantu. Ngenkathi efaka imizamo yokuxhumana, wathola ukuthi abanye abantu besadla umhlane ekuthembeleni ezinhlelweni ezazenziwa. Lokhu kwaba buhlungu, kodwa uSipho wathola ukuthi ukusebenza kanzima kufanele kube yindlela yokuphendula. U-Sipho uqhubekile nokukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obukhona ukuze aqinise imiyalezo yokuxhumana. Waqala izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo phakathi kwemiphakathi, ngoba wabona ukuthi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuxhumana kahle. Ngemva kweminyaka ethile, uSipho wathola ukuthi izinguquko ezincane ziqoqwa ukuze kube nezinto ezinkulu. Ubugebengu buncipha, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinzuzo zokusebenza ndawonye. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuba khona kwakhe emiphakathini, okukhombisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphela, kodwa izinselelo zokuqhubeka zihlala zikhona. U-Sipho ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi umuntu angakha imiphakathi ukuze kube nezinguquko. Ubugebengu abukhona nje kuphela empilweni yomuntu, kodwa buphindaphindiwe emiphakathini. U-Sipho usenkundleni yokubuyisela umphakathi, nokwakha isithunzi esihle sesizukulwane esizayo. U-Sipho Mthembu ubonisa ukuthi abantu banamandla okwenza umehluko. Njengomfundisi, umkhankaso wakhe wokulwa nobugebengu ubonisa indlela yokubambisana, ukuhlela, nokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngomoya omuhle, u-Sipho uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze akhuthaze uthando, ubumbano, nokuphepha emiphakathini. Lokhu kwenza uSipho abe yisibonelo esihle, ebonisa ukuthi, nakuba ubugebengu bukhona, imiphakathi ingathola izixazululo eziphumelelayo uma abantu benza umsebenzi omuhle ndawonye.
Lo mbhalo uveza ukuthi umthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika ka-1998 uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungaguquguquki nokuvikelwa kwezihlahla zaseNingizimu Afrika ngokuphathwa kokongiwa. Umthetho wokubusa kwenani elikhulu eNingizimu Afrika wavela ngesikhathi sokubusa kwenani elincane labamhlophe ngaphansi kwe-apartheid, futhi inqubo enzima yokufaka umthetho wokubusa kwenani elikhulu kanye nezinguquko iphinde yathinta izihlahla, lapho abantu abaningi abamnyama benqatshelwa izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izihlahla. Imithetho emisha yokulima izihlahla izama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bangafinyelela ezihlahleni ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukusetshenziswa okungaguquguquki nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Isisekelo salokhu nguMthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika, ophawula izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye okufanele zihlale zikhunjulwa lapho kuthathwa izinqumo ezithinta izihlahla. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye njengemihlahlandlela, umthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungaguquguquki, ubuholi obubambisene, nokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo. Nokho, izikhungo zomphakathi ezingeni lendawo azikaze zibe nezinguquko ezifanayo nezokupolitiki: okwamanje, inselelo wukufaka izinqubomgomo ezigxile esikhathini esizayo kanye nemithetho ezingeni lokuphatha lendawo. Ukhetho: Ngo-1994, ukhetho lokuqala lwezokhetho olukhululekile eNingizimu Afrika lukhuthaze uhulumeni omusha. NgoMashi 1995, ingqungquthela kazwelonke yabhala ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, owawusetshenziselwa ukuxoxisana nazo zonke izithakazelo. Ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe yaba yisisekelo senqubomgomo esamukelwa ngokusemthethweni esikhishwe ngoDisemba 1997, ingxenye yesibili yomthetho ophakanyisiwe. Lokhu kwasetshenziselwa ukubhala uMthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika. Kusukela ngo-1998, ngosizo lukahulumeni wase-UK, uMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla ubebandakanyeka ekufakweni kwalo mthetho. Ingxenye 24 ibhala: "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuba nendawo engalimazi impilo yabo noma inhlalakahle yabo, ukuze benze inzuzo ekusetshenzisweni okungaguquguquki kwezinsiza zemvelo, futhi ukuba nendawo evikelwe ukuze kube nezinzuzo zezizukulwane zamanje nezizayo ngokusebenzisa izinyathelo ezilungile zomthetho nezinye ezikhuthaza ukongiwa nokuvikela ukuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki kwezinsiza zemvelo ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nokwenhlalo okungakhethi. Izihlahla zemvelo akufanele zilimale ngaphandle kokuba kube nezimo ezikhethekile, futhi ngokombono kaNgqongqoshe, ukusetshenziswa okuhlinzekwayo kwalelo thafa kungcono uma kubhekwa izinzuzo zomnotho, zenhlalo, nezemvelo. Indawo encane yezihlahla kufanele igcinwe. Khuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwazo nokuphila kwazo isikhathi eside. Gcina izinsiza zomlando futhi ukhuthaze amanani obuhle, isiko, nokukholelwa; kanye nokuphakamisa abantu noma imiphakathi ebhujiswe ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Umthetho ubeka ngqo izimiso zokuphatha izihlahla ngendlela eqhubekayo, okufanele zisetshenziswe kuzo zonke izinqumo ezithinta izihlahla, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngaphansi koMthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika noma eminye imithetho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezihlahla okungaguquguquki kufanele kuhambisane noma kuhlanganiswe nokuvikelwa kwezihlahla nezihlahla. Abaphathi bezihlahla kanye nezikhulu zokulima izihlahla (ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezihlahla noma emaphakathini anjengezinhlelo zokongiwa) banesibopho sokufaka le nhlanganisela, besebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izindlela, nezindlela zikaMnyango. Akukhuthazwa ukususa noma ukuhlinzeka ngezihlahla kuzo zonke izihlahla zemvelo ngaphandle kwemvume. Izihlahla ezithile nezindawo zezimila zingamenyezelwa njengezindawo ezivikelwe. Isihlahla, noma iqembu lezihlahla, indawo yezihlahla, noma uhlobo lwezihlahla lungamenyezelwa njengezivikelwe. Amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuphatha, nokulawula izihlahla zikahulumeni nemikhiqizo yazo akhona ezandleni zikaNgqongqoshe Wamanzi Nezihlahla. Nokho, ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe kwiMthethosisekelo, angavuma izinhlobo ezahlukene zokusetshenziswa ezimiswe kulomthetho: ngokuvuma, ukukhulula, (bona ibhokisi) amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuqashwa, izivumelwano, nezivumelwano zeMiphakathi Yezihlahla. Ivumela imisebenzi efana nokudoba, ukwakha izakhiwo, noma ukulima. Ikhishwa ngaphansi kwezimo. Umthetho uyavuma ukuthi imiphakathi yasemaphandleni ixhomeke ezinsizeni ezitholakala ezihlahleni futhi ifuna ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwalabo abashiywe ngaphandle ngesikhathi se-apartheid kuzo zonke izinhlelo ezithinta izihlahla. UNgqongqoshe usebenzisile Ingxenye 24 ukukhulula amalungu emiphakathi eduze kwezihlahla zikahulumeni ekudingekeni kokuthola imvume uma beqoqa ukhuni noma ezinye izinsiza ezitholakala ezihlahleni ezifana nojamu, izithelo, utshani bokwakha, noma izitshalo zokwelapha zemindeni, ngokwenkolo noma ngokomoya. Akukho zindleko ezidingekayo. UNgqongqoshe angavuma ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo yezihlahla (njengojamu) noma eminye imikhiqizo (njengemithi) ethathwe ezihlahleni zikahulumeni ukuba ithengiswe kwabanye. Imiphakathi ingangena ezivumelwaneni noNgqongqoshe ukuze iphathise noma ibambisane noNgqongqoshe ekuphatheni izihlahla zikahulumeni. UNgqongqoshe angaqasha izihlahla zikahulumeni noma izingxenye zazo kunoma ubani. Umthetho unika noma ubani ilungelo elamukelekayo lokungena ezihlahleni zikahulumeni ngezizathu ezine ezingalimazi noma ezingaphuli: ukufundisa, ukuzijabulisa, ngokwenkolo, nokomoya. Ukwenza umthetho omusha kuyisinyathelo sokuqala engozini ende. Izimiso, izindlela, nezindlela kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe umthetho. Hlanganisa uhlelo oluzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe inqubomgomo nomthetho. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni, abaphathi bezihlahla, kanye nezinye izithakazelo kufanele baqeqeshwe ukuze baqonde futhi bakwazi ukufaka umthetho omusha, izindlela, nezindlela futhi basebenzise ulwazi lwabo namakhono ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Uma behlale benza imikhuba ekhona, kufanele bazame ukuhlela noma ukuhlanganisa ushintsho nalokho okusebenzayo.
Siyabonga kakhulu ukwethula le ncwadi. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni wethu wasayina iMvumelwano yeZizwe Ezihlangene Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sivumelene ukuhlonipha imithetho ekhethekile mayelana nokuthi izingane kufanele ziphathwe kanjani emhlabeni jikelele. Uma singahloniphi le mithetho, sizoba nenkinga enkulu neZizwe Ezihlangene! Kodwa okukhombisile lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi, nakuba iMvumelwano ikhuluma ngezingane, ayibhaliwe ngendlela yokuthi izingane zikwazi ukuyiqonda kalula. Sazibuza, yini inzuzo yale nto? Ngempela, ingabe izingane akufanele zikwazi ukuqonda amalungelo azo? Yingakho sathatha isinqumo sokukubhalela le ncwadi. Amalungelo akule ncwadi akho. Ayahlonishwa yizingane zonke eNingizimu Afrika nakuzo zonke izingane emhlabeni jikelele. Akekho ongakuthatha la malungelo. Ngakho qiniseka ukuthi uyawazi! Siyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe lethu! Futhi qiniseka ukuthi uyakujabulela kakhulu! Nginezingane ezingezami. Ngakho ngiyazi ukuthi into ebaluleke kakhulu kumntwana ukujabula, uthole uthando, futhi uzwe. Le ncwadi ikhuluma ngamalungelo ezingane zokuzizwa ziphephile futhi zivikela ezweni lethu. Ngizibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi uyazi amalungelo akho nokuthi bonke abantu abaphakathi kwami basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuvikela wena, imindeni yakho, nabangane bakho. Ngiyabona futhi ukuthi njengamanje, njengengane, udinga ukuzizwa uphephile, uvikelwe, uqashelwe, futhi unakekelwe. Ngiyazi ngoba ngangiyingane futhi. Ngakho umsebenzi wami ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abenza ubugebengu ezinganeni baboshwa futhi bajeziswe ngendlela efanele. Ngithatha umsebenzi wami ngok serious futhi ngizimisele ukuvikela wena. Le ncwadi ikuwe futhi izokusiza ukuthi wazi ukuthi yikuphi ukuziphatha okungamukeleki nokuthi ungabika kanjani labo abadala nezingane abaphula amalungelo akho. Zingane zonke emhlabeni kufanele zijabulele la malungelo. Sonke singamalungu omndeni omkhulu wabantu. Sinezingane nezizalwane emhlabeni wonke. Eminyakeni edlule, ngaphambi kokuba uzalwe, ohulumeni bomhlaba bahlangana ukuze bakhe uhulumeni womhlaba obizwa ngeZizwe Ezihlangene. Labo bahulumeni bavumelana ukuthi wonke umuntu emndenini wethu wabantu unelungelo lokukhululeka, ubulungiswa, nokuthula emhlabeni. Wonke umuntu kusho wonke umuntu ngempela. Akukhathalekile ukuthi siqhamuka kuphi noma ukuthi singobani. Noma ngabe sicebile noma sicebile noma sitholakala phakathi. Noma ngabe umbala wesikhumba sethu, ubuzwe, noma inkolo yethu iyini. Noma ngabe singamadoda, abesifazane, amantombazane, noma abafana. Kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokusizwa kakhulu kunabantu abadala. Yingakho iMvumelwano Ngamalungelo Ezingane yamukelwa yiZizwe Ezihlangene ngomhla ka-20 Novemba 1989. Kunezizathu eziningi ezikwenza iZizwe Ezihlangene ikhathazeke kakhulu ngezingane futhi ikholelwa ukuthi amalungelo akhethekile adingeka. Okokuqala, iZizwe Ezihlangene ikholelwa ngokuqinile ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle kakhulu emndenini noma ekhaya lapho zingajabula, zithandwa, futhi zizwa zikhuluma. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imindeni nalabo abanakekela izingane kufanele ivikelwe ukuze bakwazi ukunakekela izingane zabo futhi bazisize zikhule. Okwesibili, izingane zidinga ukukhula ngendlela ezokwenza zibe ngabantu abadala abangakwazi ukubhekana nezinto abazidingayo futhi babe amalungu emiphakathini yabo. Kufanele zifundiswe ukuphila emhlabeni ngokuthula, ngenhlonipho, ngesineke, ngokukhululeka, ngokulingana, nangobumbano. Okwesithathu, imibhalo eminingi ehlukene yomhlaba nezimemezelo zicela ukunakekelwa okukhethekile, inhlalakahle, ukuphathwa, nokuvikelwa kwezingane. Kwenza kube kuhle ukubhala konke phansi kumqulu owodwa - umqulu wezingane kuphela. Okwesine, nakuba wonke umuntu efuna zonke izingane zikhule zijabule futhi zifezekile, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyazi ukuthi, ezweni jikelele, izingane eziningi zihlala ezimweni ezinzima kakhulu. Ngenxa yalezi nezinye izizathu, kuhle ukuba neMvumelwano ekhethekile Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Le Mvumelwano ikhuluma ngazo zonke izinkinga nezinkinga ezingane emhlabeni jikelele ezingase zibe nazo kanye nawo wonke amalungelo akhethekile okufanele abe nawo izingane. Le yimizamo yakho futhi kubalulekile ukuthi wazi ngayo nokuthi ikhuluma ngani. Iqukethe izingxenye ezahlukene (iZizwe Ezihlangene ziyibiza ngokuthi "izindatshana"). Ibhalwe ngolimi lwezomthetho ukuze ikwazi ukusetshenziswa ezinkantolo ukuvikela wena. Kodwa lokhu kwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuyiqonda. Yingakho sibhale lokhu kuwe ngolimi olulula kule ncwadi. Nokho, kuqala, sifuna ukukuchazela ukuthi iMvumelwano iyini, njengoba isetshenziswa lapha, nokuthi yafika kanjani. Njengoba sikhulume, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyinhlobo yohulumeni womhlaba. Lo hulumeni uhlangana endlini enkulu esakhiweni seZizwe Ezihlangene eNew York. Lapha baphawula ngezindaba ezibalulekile zomhlaba ezifana neMvumelwano Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Khumbula ukuthi le Mvumelwano iyisivumelwano esenziwe phakathi kohulumeni bomhlaba. Uma isivumelwano sesifinyelelwe, izwe ngalinye kufanele liye kwiPhalamende lazo futhi livumelane neMvumelwano lapho. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuvuma iMvumelwano. IPhalamende kufanele livote ukuthi lizohlonipha imithetho yeMvumelwano. Uma iPhalamende yezwe ivumile ukuvuma iMvumelwano, uhulumeni walowo mzabalazo kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yayo. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi hhayi wonke amazwe avuma zonke iMvumelwano. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wavuma (wavuma) iMvumelwano Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yeMvumelwano. IZizwe Ezihlangene inekomidi ekhethekile yabantu okufanele ibuze amazwe ukuthi yini abakwenzayo ukuhlinzeka ngale mithetho. Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika isayina iMvumelwano, benza promises ekhethekile ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izingane zizobekwa phambili kukho konke abakwenza. IMvumelwano ibala ukuthi umntwana ungumuntu oneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-18. Kodwa kwesinye isikhathi izwe lingase libe nemithetho evumela umntwana ukuba abhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kwaleyo minyaka. Ungase ucabangele isizathu sokuthi kungani izwe lingavumela umntwana ukuba abhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kweminyaka engu-18. Ngokwesibonelo, kwamanye amazwe, abantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 bavunyelwe ukushada. Ucabanga ukuthi umuntu ongenaminyaka engu-18 kufanele aphathwe njengomntwana? Izwelonke kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke amalungelo akule Mvumelwano apply kuwo wonke umntwana kulowo mzabalazo. Akekho umntwana okufanele ashiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ungowasendaweni ethile, umbala, ubulili, ulimi, noma inkolo. Akekho umntwana okufanele ashiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ucabanga noma uthi noma uvela kuphi. Izimayini: Ukubaluleka Nokuphikiswa Ezinsukwini zethu, izimayini zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wezwe. Zivula amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza intuthuko, futhi zenza kube nokwabelana ngempahla yokwakha. Nokho, akungabazeki ukuthi lezi zindawo zinezingozi ezinkulu, eziyingozi ezihlobene nemvelo, impilo yabantu, kanye nezindlela zokuphila zabantu bendawo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Okokuqala, sizobheka izinzuzo ezikhandwa izimayini. Umnotho wesizwe ubaluleke kakhulu ekukhiqizeni nasekuthuthukiseni. Izimayini zenza kube khona imisebenzi eminingi, okuhamba phambili kwezimali zabantu. Lokhu kusebenza kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni nasemiphakathini emincane. Kuphinde kulethe izinsiza ezengeziwe ezidingekayo ekwakheni izikole, izibhedlela, nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izimayini zishintsha impilo yabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi lapho kuxhaswa khona izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo nezokukhiqiza. Nokho, akumele sishaye indiva izingozi ezibangelwa izimayini. Ukuvuthwa kwalezi zindawo kubangela ukonakala kwemvelo okukhulu, okubangela ukuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokuphila zemvelo. Ukuhlukaniswa kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa komoya, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezimbi zenza umphakathi ube sengcupheni. Izimayini zenza kube nzima ukuba impilo ibaluleke, kanti abantu abahlala eduze kwazo bahlala besaba ukungcoliswa kwezinsiza zabo. Ngakho, umbono wami uthi kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezibhekelela lezi zingozi. Izimayini akufanele zisebenze kuphela ngenxa yezinzuzo zazo, kodwa kufanele futhi zikhumbule imithetho yokuvikela umnotho. Izinkampani ezisebenza ezimayini kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlanza, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo nemfundo kubantu bendawo, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphila ezizothuthukisa imiphakathi. Izinhlelo ezinjalo zingasiza ekunciphiseni umthelela omubi wezindawo ezihlobene nezimayini. Esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokwakha ezisemthethweni nezisemqoka. Izimayini kufanele zibe nemigomo ethile yokuphatha imvelo, efanele ukusiza ukuvimbela izinkinga ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu bendawo kufanele babizwe ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana nezimayini, ukuze kube nokuqonda okuphelele kwezidingo nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nezinsizakalo ezibhekelela izidingo zomphakathi, okuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani nezindawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa imikhakha yokuvikela imvelo. Izimayini zidinga ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizokwenyusa izindlela zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, ukuhlela izikhala ezisetshenziswayo, nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuphila ezihlanzekile. Kubalulekile ukwakha umbono ophumelelayo, lapho izimayini zikhona kodwa zihlala zikhumbula ukuziphatha kahle emvelweni. Ekugcineni, izimayini zingaba nomthelela omuhle uma ziqhutshwa ngendlela efanele. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wethu kufanele uhlale uphephile, futhi abantu kumele babe nempilo enhle. Izimayini zidinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizohola phambili. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeni sizama ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, ezihlonipha imvelo, futhi zikhuthaze impilo yabantu. Isikhathi sokwakha ikusasa elihle sizotholakala kuphela uma sibambisene.
Iphasiwedi lezingane liyidokhumenti elibalulekile ukuze ingane ikwazi ukuhamba iye kwelinye izwe. Iphasiwedi lezingane ikhishwa ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-16. Isebenza ukuhamba kuyo yonke imikhawulo ngaphandle uma kudingeka imibhalo ethile ekhombisa ukungavunyelwa. Isebenza iminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa. Qedela amafomu B1-73 bese uwafaka ehhovisi leMnyango wezamaNdiya eliseduze. Faka ehhovisi lezithunywa noma emishinini yaseNingizimu Afrika uma uhamba phesheya. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuzalwa sengane. Faka izithombe ezimbili ezincane zephasiwedi zengane. Imvume yabazali ababili noma abaphethe imithwalo ibalulekile ngaphambi kokuthi ingane ikhishwe iphasiwedi. Nikeza ubufakazi besitifiketi sokufa uma omunye wabazali eshonile. Uma imvume inikezwa ngumgibeli, kufanele kuchazwe ukuthi umgibeli uthole kanjani ilungelo lokuba ngumgibeli. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezikhethekile, uma kungavunyelwa ukuthi lowo mzali anikeze imvume efomini lesicelo, imvume ebhaliwe kufanele itholakale encwadini ethile ephuma kumzali ongasekho. Endabeni lapho umzali engafuni ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, inkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele yenze isinqumo ngendaba. Ikhophi ye-oda lenkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele ihambisane nefomu lesicelo sephasiwedi. Uma abazali behlukanisiwe, bobabili abazali badinga ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngaphandle uma i-oda lenkantolo lisho okunye. Iphasiwedi ingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili ukuze ikhishwe.
Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain I-Gautrain iyindlela yokuhamba esheshayo, efaneleka kakhulu emiphakathini yaseGauteng, ikakhulukazi phakathi kweJozini nePretoria. Le ndlela yokuhamba ibalulekile ngoba ihlinzeka ngohambo olusheshayo, oluthembekile, nolungabizi, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokusebenza. Nokho, njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, kudingeka ukuthi i-Gautrain yandiswe ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabahambi. Ukubaluleka Kwandiswa Kwe-Gautrain Ukukhula komphakathi, izikhungo zokusebenza, nezindawo zokuhlala kudinga ukuthi izinsiza zokuhamba zikhulise amandla azo. I-Gautrain, njengendlela yokuhamba, ibalulekile ekunciphiseni izithuthi emigwaqweni, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, nokunciphisa umoya ongcolisayo. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, kuholele ekwandeni kokuhweba, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi emisha. Izindawo Ezihlosiwe Zokwandiswa Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain sikhuluma ngokuqhubeka neziteshi ezintsha ezizokwakhiwa ezindaweni ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo ezifana neCenturion, Midrand, kanye neEast Rand. Lezi zindawo zikhona ezindaweni ezithuthukayo, ezikhula ngokushesha, futhi zidinga izinsiza zokuhamba ezithembekile. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kulezi zindawo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kunciphise isikhathi sokuhamba, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Izinzuzo Zokwandiswa Kwe-Gautrain 1. Ukunciphisa Izithuthi Emigwaqweni: Ngokwandisa i-Gautrain, abantu bazoba nezinye izinketho zokuhamba, okuzokwenza kube nokuncipha kwezithuthi emigwaqweni. Lokhu kuzoholela ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokuhamba, njengezithuthi eziningi ezimigwaqweni. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Komnotho: Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokusebenza, okuzokwenza kube nokukhula komnotho. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi emisha, okuzothuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu. 3. Ukwandisa Izinsiza Zokuhamba: I-Gautrain iyindlela yokuhamba esheshayo, futhi ngokwandiswa kwayo, abantu bazoba nezinye izinketho zokuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu. 4. Ukwandisa Ukutholakala Kwezinsiza: Ngokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, izindawo ezikude nezikhungweni ezinkulu zizothola ukufinyelela okungcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Izindleko Nokuxhaswa Kwezimali Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzodinga izimali ezinkulu. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuhlinzekwa ngoxhaso lwezimali, kungaba kuhulumeni, ezinkampanini, noma ngababambiqhaza. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha lezi zindleko, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona futhi zisetshenziswa kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlangano ezihlanganyela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Izinyathelo Zokwakha Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzodinga izinyathelo ezithile, ezifaka phakathi: 1. Ukwenziwa Kwezifundo Zokuhlola: Kubalulekile ukwenza izifundo zokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindawo ezihlosiwe ziyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona. 2. Ukwakhiwa Kweziteshi Ezintsha: Iziteshi ezintsha zizodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela kalula ezindaweni ezihlosiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, futhi kulethe izinzuzo emiphakathini. 3. Ukuxhumana Nomphakathi: Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyahlangatshezwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uyaziswa ngalezi zinhlelo. 4. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphatha: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-Gautrain iyasinda, kudingeka izinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Isiphetho Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain sikhombisa indlela yokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuhamba eGauteng. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kokuhamba, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi emisha. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu, futhi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kwabantu, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-Gautrain iyasinda futhi iyathuthukiswa.
Umbiko Ngempilo Yezimayini eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Umkhakha wezokumbiwa udlala indima enkulu emnothweni weNingizimu Afrika, ulethe izinsiza, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Le ndaba ibheka izici eziningi zomkhakha wezokumbiwa, kubalwa izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nomthelela kulezi zindawo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimayini Izimayini ziqala ngokuhlola izindawo ezinezinhlobonhlobo zezinsiza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhetha indawo efanele, ukuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokuthola imvume yokusebenza. Izinhlobo zezinsiza ezitholakala ezimayini zifaka igolide, insimbi, amalahle, nezinye izinto eziyigugu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kuthuthukisa ukutholakala kwezinsiza, kusebenza izindlela eziphambili zokuhlola nezokumbiwa. Izinzuzo Zokumbiwa Umkhakha wezokumbiwa uhlinzeka ngezindlela zokusebenza eziningi, udala amathuba emisebenzi emadolobheni nasemaphandleni. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni komnotho, njengoba izinkampani ezimayini zikhokha imisalo kubasebenzi, zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakusebenza zomphakathi, futhi zifaka imali ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izindawo. Ukuze umnotho uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi umkhakha wezokumbiwa uhlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma kunezinzuzo eziningi, umkhakha wezokumbiwa ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukonakaliswa kwemvelo, ukuphazamiseka kokuphila kwabantu abaseduze, kanye nezingozi ezithinta abasebenzi. Ukungcola kwamanzi, umoya, kanye nezindawo ezizungezile kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo yokuphepha ezindaweni zokusebenza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ukukhula Nokuthuthukiswa Umkhakha wezokumbiwa ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ngenxa yokwanda kwemithetho yokuvikela imvelo. Izinkampani kumele zenze izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlala zifanele, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha bokunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokusebenza, ukwakhiwa kwemboni ehlakaniphile, kanye nokwandisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuhlangabezana Nezidingo Zomphakathi Izimayini kufanele ziqhubeke nohlelo lokuhlanganyela nomphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana nabantu bendawo, ukuqonda izidingo zabo, nokwakha izinhlelo ezizobasiza. Ukuze umkhakha wenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhube izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izinhlelo zokunakekela impilo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Umkhakha wezokumbiwa ungumthombo obalulekile wezimali, umhlaba, nezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo empilweni yomphakathi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi lo mkhakha uhlale uhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, uhlole izindlela zokunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle, futhi uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Ngaleyo ndlela, izimayini zingaba yinsiza ethuthukisa umnotho, ziqinise izimpilo zabantu, futhi zishintshe izindawo zibe ngcono. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kuzokwenza kube nempilo engcono kubo bonke.
Ulwazi Oluqondiswa Ngezwi Ezikhungweni Ekuhloleni izikhungo ezahlukahlukene, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwedlula ekubhalweni kuphela. Ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lubalulekile emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni zokuqeqesha, ezifundazweni, nakwindawo zomsebenzi, lapho ukuxhumana okusemthethweni kudinga ukwenziwa kwendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lufinyelela kubantu ngendlela efanele futhi enempumelelo. Ezikhungweni, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi luthinta izici eziningi, kubandakanya imihlangano, izifundo, nezinye izenzakalo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuqondiswa ngezwi kuvumela ukuxhumana okusheshayo nezindlela ezikahle zokwabelana ngemininingwane. Kanjalo, kubalulekile ukuqonda izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana, ezinjengezwi ezivulekile, ezibhalwe phansi, kanye nemibono ehlukene ehlobene nalokhu. Ukuze ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lube nomthelela, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokucaciswa kwemigomo nezimiso zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bayakwazi ukuqonda kahle injongo yokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo ziye zathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bunekhono lokuthuthukisa indlela ulwazi oluqondiswa ngayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo kuholele ekwandeni kokufinyelela kolwazi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwezwi. Izikhungo zokuqeqesha zisebenzisa ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ukuze zibe nezinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kusebenza kahle lapho izikhungo zithumele izikhumbuzo ngezwi, izimemo, noma izinhlelo ezizovela. Ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kusiza abathintekayo ukuba baqonde okufanele bakwenze, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlangano nezinqumo zikhona ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezithuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa ziyaqaphela ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokwabelana ngemininingwane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemikhankaso yokufundisa ebambisana nezwi, evumela abafundi ukuba bahlanganyele ngempumelelo. Ukudluliswa kolwazi ngendlela efanele kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabafundisi nabafundi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olubalulekile. Izikhungo zokuqeqesha zisebenzisa izindlela zokufundisa ezihlukahlukene ukuze zifeze izidingo ezithile zokuqonda kolwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lwemihlangano yokuxoxa, izifundo ezizimele, kanye nemisebenzi yokubambisana ukuze kwandiswe ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi. Ukuphathwa kwemihlangano kumqoka, njengoba kuholela ekutheni abantu bakhulume ngokukhululekile futhi babelane ngemicabango ehlukene. Ngenxa yokuguquka kwezidingo zomphakathi, izikhungo zidinga ukushintsha indlela abaphatha ngayo ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nemihlangano ye-inthanethi. Lezi zindlela zingakhuthaza ukuhlanganyela okukhulu, okwenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi oluphuma ezikhungweni. Ngokwezifundo, abacwaningi basithola ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lungathuthukisa ukusebenza kwezikhungo. Izikhungo eziphumelelayo zisebenzisa ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ukuze zithumele izimpendulo eziphusile, ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyawuqonda umyalezo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni zemfundo, lapho abafundi badinga ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yini okufanele bayilindele. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi aluxhomeki kuphela emithonjeni yedijithali. Izikhungo zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, zigcine ukuxhumana okusemthethweni. Lokhu kusebenza kahle lapho izikhungo zixhumana nemiphakathi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane edingekayo ifinyelela kubo. Ekugcineni, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni ludinga ukuhlinzekwa ngendlela esebenzayo, eqondile, futhi efinyelelekayo. Ukuze lokhu kuzuze, izikhungo zidinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzothuthukisa ukusebenza kwezikole, amabhizinisi, nemiphakathi, kanti lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impumelelo nokwaneliseka kwabantu bonke. Ukugxila kulokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha isimo esihambisanayo, esisebenza kahle ekusizeni abantu abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene.
Imichiza izonakalisa umkhiqizo wakho uma ungayiphathi ngendlela efanele ngokwemiyalelo nasemazwini. Uma ulandela imiyalelo ngendlela efanele, ungumlimi ongavimbela ukulimala okungenzeka ezitshalweni zakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi umthengisi wemithi ethile ubhaliswe lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuze athengise le mithi ethembekile yokubulala izihlahla eziphikisanayo noma isifo esithile. Ingabe intengo yemithi ihambisana namazwi noma cha? Ingabe isimo sezulu ngesikhathi sokufaka imithi nangemva kokufaka kuhambisana namazwi? Ingabe isikhathi sokufaka imithi sihambisana nosayizi wesitshalo ukuvimbela isifo? Ngemuva kwalokho - ingabe imithi izoba yingozi uma kushintshwa izinhlobo zezithombo - ngamagama alula, ingabe izonakalisa izitshalo ezizofakwa ngemuva noma cha? Ingabe imithi ethile ingahlanganiswa nezinye izinhlobo - ngokwesibonelo: ingabe ingahlanganiswa nezinye izihlahla zokubulala noma nezinye izihlahla zokubulala izinyoni? Imiyalelo kufanele ibhalwe phansi, futhi umthengisi kufanele ayisayine. Abalimi kufanele baqaphele kakhulu ukuthi imithi iphephile ngesikhathi sokuphonsa, futhi kufanele bazame ukuvimbela lokhu. Ingcuphe enkulu ingavela uma imithi ingena kwamanye amapulazi lapho kukhona izitshalo ezingakwazi ukulimala kule mithi ethile. Ukuphepha kokudla kubaluleke kakhulu. Uma abalimi befaka imithi ngendlela efanele futhi begcina amarekhodi, bahlangabezana nezidingo zokuphathwa kokuphepha kokudla.
Ezokuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Umthelela Wokuxhumana Nempilo Yethu Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buye baba yingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokuthuthukiswa kwezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, kodwa kudingeka sikhumbule futhi izinselelo ezithile ezivela kule mikhakha. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle imiphumela yalo, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokuxhumana. Ukuqala, ubuchwepheshe bukhulisa ukufinyelela kolwazi. Noma ngabe sikhuluma ngama-smartphone, amakhompyutha, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza, abantu bangathola ulwazi olukhulu ngezikhathi ezimfushane. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukufunda, ukuhweba, nokuxhumana. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, abantu bangakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nemicimbi emihle, okwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuxhumana okukhululekile kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abangakaze sihlangane nabo, futhi kwenza umhlaba ube mncane. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba sikhula kulesi sikhathi sokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, sithola nezinkinga ezithile. Ukuxhumana okungaqondile, okungokwenkolo, kuveza izinselelo ezinkulu. Abantu bahlala bexhumene, kodwa ukuxhumana kwabo kungase kube okungaphelele. Ukukhuluma ngobuso nobuso, ukuxhumana okwenziwa ngempela, kudinga umuzwa ophilayo, okungatholakali kalula ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kungaholela ekudambiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi emoyeni nasempilweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye bukhombise izinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba sabelana ngemininingwane yethu, sithola ubungozi bokuthi le mininingwane ingase ibhujiswe noma itholakale kalula kubantu abangafanele. Ukweba imininingwane, ukuphulwa kwemithetho yokuvikela, konke lokhu kudala ukungathembeki phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neziqinisekiso ezinamandla ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukuvikeleka okufanele, kodwa futhi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuvikeleka akukona kuphela okwenziwayo ngubuchwepheshe, kodwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zethu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisayo, ezithinta imizwa, nezokuxhumana okwenziwa ngempela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, obuhlala isikhathi eside. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, behlola izindlela zokuxhumana ezizwakalayo nezinomthelela omuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhuthaza ukufunda nokukhula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinkundla zokuxhumana kufanele zikhuthaze ukufunda, zifundise abantu ngezinto ezintsha, futhi zikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bejabulile, benza kube lula ukufinyelela kumathuba amasha. Ekuqedeni, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana bunemiphumela eminingi empilweni yethu. Kunezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa kudinga ukuba sibe nekhono lokubhekana nezinselelo ezithile. Ukuze siphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zethu, sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, futhi siqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane yethu. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu, sikhulise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sibe neqhaza elihle emhlabeni. Ngakho, kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola indlela esisebenzisa ngayo ubuchwepheshe, sithuthukise izindlela zokuxhumana, futhi sikhulise umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuqinile, futhi onokukhula okuqhubekayo. Ubuchwepheshe kufanele kube ithuluzi lokwakha, hhayi lokuphula, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwenzeni lokho kube yimpumelelo.
Kubukeka sengathi uyabona izinselelo zokwakhiwa lapha esibhedlela. Sizama ngakho konke okusemandleni ethu ukugcina isibhedlela sibukeka kahle. Kukho ihhovisi elisha eliqediwe ngoMashi, futhi manje selisebenza. Igumbi lokusebenza liphinde lilungiswe, futhi sithemba ukuthi lizobe selilungele ukusetshenziswa masinyane. Ngiyacela ukhumbule, ozakwethu, ukuthi emhlanganweni wabasebenzi sichaze ukuthi thina, njengabaphathi besibhedlela, asinaso isikhwama noma amandla okwakha izakhiwo zesibhedlela. Umnyango Wokwakha unomthwalo walolo msebenzi, hhayi thina siqu. Lo muntu kufanele aqhubeke efundisa abanye egumbini lakhe nasezithweni ezibhedlela ezinyangeni ezizayo. Inhloso yethu ukuhlela izinga lethu lokusiza libe phezulu. Ukubambisana kwethu kuzokhuthazwa kakhulu. Le mali iyasiza kakhulu emphakathini ngalesi sikhathi esiphila kuso. Kumele sizame ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakholelwe kubo futhi ukuthi akukho okungatholakali kumuntu uqobo. Abantu bangakwazi, kodwa uma bebhekene nezinkinga, bavame ukuphonsa ithemba bese befuna omunye ukwenza izinto zabo. Njengoba ngibona ukuthi umncintiswano wekwaya usondela, ngiye kubabukeli bebhayisikobho, futhi ngazizwa ngidinga ukubhala ngokucophelela ngomsindo wakho nowami njengomuntu ophathekayo ezindabeni ezihlobene nokukhuluma. Lokhu kuzosisiza hhayi kuphela abaculi kodwa bonke jikelele bazothola inzuzo, ikakhulukazi labo abakhuluma emphakathini nsuku zonke njengothisha, abapristi, abezombusazwe, abameli, njll. KUTHENI KUKHONA ESIHLANGENI NGENXA YOKUQHUMISA NOMA UKUKHULUMA Uma ujwayele ukuqhuba lapho ukhuluma, lapha esithweni sokukhuluma kuzonakele; kuphi umsindo wakho? Uma uqhuma lapha lapho umsindo wakho uvela khona, imisipha nezicubu zizokhathazeka, futhi lapho inkinga iqala khona. Uma ungakwazi ukukhipha lokhu, kungaba yingozi edala umonakalo omkhulu kumsindo wakho. KUNGANI NGINGAZIVIKELA Kukhona izindlela ongazisebenzisa uma ukhuluma endaweni enomsindo ngaphandle kokuphakamisa umsindo wakho? Sebenzisa izinkomba noma okuthile ukuze uthole ukunakwa. Othisha bangasebenzisa umoya opholile ukubiza izingane uma zidlala, noma baphakamise izandla ukuze babonise ukuthi baphinde babuyela ekilasini. Phakamisa umsindo ngemuva kwakho. Uma ukhuluma nomuntu, phakamisa ivolumu ye-radio noma ithelevishini uma ukhuluma nomuntu; zama ukusebenzisa into eyodwa ngesikhathi uma kunomsindo. Khuluma nomuntu okhulu njengokuthi ungene esikhundleni sakho bese ugcina ibanga elingama-3 kuya kwama-5 uma ukhuluma nomuntu. Funda ukulalela. Uma ubuza omunye ukuthi aphinde akhulume lokho akushilo, noma ukuthi lowo muntu uzophakamisa umsindo wakhe, ngaleyo ndlela bangase baphule umsindo wabo. Asikwazi期待 abantu ukwenza izinto zethu ngoba thina siphila njengabantu, noma ngabe ngiyazi isimo engikuso noma cha. Imicabango yethu isebenza njengabantu abangenavayirasi, futhi kwesinye isikhathi sithanda ukucabanga ngcono kunabo. Abantu abanavayirasi bangazithanda ukuze bagcine impilo yabo. Abangabheki nje ukwesekwa kwabanye uma sevele bakhombisile isimo sabo. Masixhase ozakwethu, sibathande, nabantu emindenini yethu abangenaso lesi sifo futhi sikholelwe kubo. Khuluma ngokuqonda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa umthwalo kumsindo wakho futhi abanye bazolandela indlela okhuluma ngayo. Utshwala, ukuhamba, nezinye izinto zingadambisa isitho sokukhuluma, futhi sizisebenzisa emsebenzini nasemakhaya, futhi emithini ethile ingase iphinde ibe nomthelela omubi kumthondo wakho. KUFANELE NGIKWENZE NINI UMA NGINEZINKINGA ZOMSINDO Uma ubona ushintsho endleleni abanye nabanye babona ngayo umsindo wakho, mhlawumbe ushintsha ube mnyama, ufinyelela, noma ube mncane lapho uwukhiqiza, xhumana nodokotela. Umdokotela uzokuthumele kumkhakha ophathelene nokukhuluma nomthondo kuphela. Uma lokhu kushintsha kuqhubeka ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili noma ezintathu noma umsindo wakho uphaphama ngokushesha, xhumana nalabo abaphatha lezi zindaba. Ngesikhathi esithile lokhu kungalungiswa kalula, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi kungaba yinto ebaluleke kakhulu? Isiko lethu njengabantu abamnyama lidlala indima enkulu emicabangweni yethu. Uma ingane ikhuliswa ngalezi zinkolelo, ukuziphatha, nemigomo yomphakathi abakukhulisayo, lokhu kuyakha ukuziphatha komuntu nemicabango mayelana nokuphila. Uma owesifazane ekhuliswa efundiswa ukuthi owesifazane kufanele aziphathe ngendlela ethile, azithibe, futhi alalele lokho akukhuluma, noma angavumelani nakho, ngeke akhulume lokho; uzokugcina ngaphakathi. Manje uzibuze ukuthi yiziphi izinkantolo ezikhona eziboshwe ezinsukwini ezingama-20 zokubulala abashadile babo. Konke kuvela emvelweni yethu yamasiko, ukuthula nokuthula mayelana nezinto ezithile ezibaholele ekulimaleni isikhathi eside, futhi lokhu kuyakha ababulali. Iningi labesifazane abaphakathi kwezinkantolo bahluphekiwe isikhathi eside nangendlela eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuhlukunyezwa, ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, nangokwezimali ngabalingani babo. Umthetho uyazi lokhu. Bangakugwema lezi zimo, kodwa hhayi isikhathi eside. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi baphenduke benze okuthile abangakwazi ukukwenqaba, njengokubulala. Lokhu kubakhulula ekutheni ukuhlupheka kwabo sekuphelile. Bacela ukuba bashiye izingane zabo ukuze ziboshwe. Kuyamangalisa ukuthi lezi zihlukunyezwayo aziboni ukuthi zihlukunyezwa; zicabanga ukuthi amasiko ayasagcinwa, kodwa ngakolunye uhlangothi, zithola amandla okuhlala. Ngesikhathi ubuholi bezwe bukhishwa ngo-1994 ngaphansi kukaCyril Ramaphosa, amalungelo abesifazane ayebaluleke kakhulu. Sivumele ukuba bathathe amalungelo abo abangenamsindo isikhathi eside. Kumele manje sivuke sikhombise, sakhe ikusasa elisha labesifazane, noma sihloniphe amasiko ethu, kodwa akukho okukhuthaza ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane. Ngicela imibono, izindaba noma yiziphi, ofuna ukuba zishicilelwe ephephandabeni lethu. Ungesabi, noma uma ungafuni ukuveza igama lakho, lokho kulungile. Khumbula ukuthi senza kangcono ngalokho esinakho.
Ukufunda nge-Inthanethi: Amandla Nokuhlupheka Namuhla, ukufunda nge-inthanethi sekubhekwa njengendlela esheshayo, elula, neyokufinyelela ulwazi. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, imfundo iye yathola izindlela ezintsha zokufinyelela kubafundi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene, izizinda ezahlukene, kanye nemigomo eyahlukeneyo. Kodwa, kulokhu kukhululeka, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezibalulekile okufanele sizicabangele. Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole izinzuzo zokufunda nge-inthanethi. Le ndlela ifaka phakathi ukufinyelela kolwazi oluningi, lapho abafundi bengakhetha khona izifundo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kwezobuchwepheshe kuya kwezobuciko. Lokhu kungenza abafundi bazizwe bekhululekile, bephuma emikhawulweni yezikole ezivamile, futhi bakwazi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Ngokufanayo, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kukhulisa ukuhwebelana kolwazi, njengoba abafundi bengakha ubudlelwano nezifundo, othisha, nabanye abafundi emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akukhululekile kubo bonke. Abanye abantu basahlangabezana nezithiyo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukufinyelela okuphansi ku-inthanethi, izinsiza ezibizayo, kanye nolwazi olungavumelekile. Lokhu kudala umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwabafundi abavela ezindaweni ezithuthukile nabavela ezindaweni ezisafufusa. Ukungabi nalwazi olufanele lokusebenzisa izinsiza ze-inthanethi, njengamathuluzi okuxhumana, kungaholela ekunqandeni amathuba okuthola imfundo. Kuyaphawuleka ukuthi, uma kuqhathaniswa nezifundo zendabuko, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu kumfundi. Abafundi badinga ukuba nokuqonda okuhle kokuhlela isikhathi sabo, njengoba izikhala zikhona zokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kudinga ukuzibophezela okukhulu, futhi abanye bangase babe nezinselelo ekugcineni umgomo wabo. Ngakho, ubuchwepheshe buza nezidingo ezithile ezithinta abafundi, futhi umbono wokuthi bonke bangakwazi ukufunda kahle nge-inthanethi awuphumeleli. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinkinga, ukugqamisa imfundo efinyelelekayo kungenzeka kube kuhle. Ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle ekufundeni nge-inthanethi, kudingeka izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo eziphathekayo, ezihlinzeka ngensiza yokuqeqesha, nezinsiza ezingabizi. Abafundi badinga izinsiza ezithile ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa kahle lezi zindlela, futhi lokho kuzosiza ekunciphiseni umehluko phakathi kwabafundi. Ngokuqhubeka, udinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akupheli nje ekufundeni okuthile. Lolu hlobo lokufunda luhlanganisa nezinye izici, njengokuxhumana nabanye, ukuthola ukuqonda okujulile, nokwakha amakhono amasha. Abafundi bangasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, izinkundla zokufunda, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze bakhe umphakathi wabo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imfundo nge-inthanethi ingumkhiqizo owawuhlanganisa umphakathi, hhayi nje ukufunda okungaboni ngeso lengqondo. Ekugcineni, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kulethe ithuba lokukhula, kodwa kudinga ukuba sibe nomqondo oqinile wokuhlinzeka ngensiza ezanele, ukuqeqesha, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzodinga imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nabafundi uqobo. Uma singayifinyelela le miphumela, singenza ukufunda nge-inthanethi kube yindlela eyinhloko yokufinyelela imfundo, okuzosiza ukufezekisa amaphupho emisha nezifiso zabantu abaningi. Ngakho, njengoba sithuthukisa le ndlela yokufunda, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza, sithuthukise, futhi sithole izindlela zokukhuthaza ukufunda okuqhubekayo. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi akuphatheki kahle, kodwa uma sihamba sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa imfundo yethu, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini: Ukubuyekezwa Ukwazi ukuthi amanzi ayinsika yokuphila, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde izinkinga ezihlobene nawo emiphakathini yethu. Izinkinga zamanzi zihlala zikhathaza izindawo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu behlangabezana nezithiyo ezinzima ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile nokwanele. Lokhu kudala imiphumela emibi emikhayeni, emiphakathini nasezinhlelweni zempilo. Izizathu Zokuntuleka Kwamanzi Enye yezizathu eziyinhloko zokuntuleka kwamanzi emiphakathini ithonya lesimo sezulu. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kudala imvula encane, okuholela ekunciphiseni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Lokhu kuthinta izitshalo, amafama, kanye nemithombo yamanzi ejwayelekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi nemithombo yamanzi, okuvela emisebenzini yokukhiqiza, izimayini, nezimboni, kuhlobene kakhulu nezinkinga zamanzi. Imiphumela Emiphakathini Imiphumela yokuntuleka kwamanzi ibonakala ezimpilweni zabantu. Ukuze kutholwe amanzi ahlanzekile, abantu badinga ukuhamba izikhathi ezinde, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela emsebenzini, ezifundweni, noma emindenini. Lokhu kukhulu kakhulu ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho imithombo yamanzi ingekho eduze. Umphakathi ubhekana nezinkinga zemfundo, njengoba abantwana bephumelela kancane ngenxa yokuthi bahlala belahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba ukufuna amanzi. Umthelela Empilweni Yezempilo Ukwanda kwezinkinga zamanzi kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo. Amanzi angcolile ahamba nezifo ezinjengokugula kwesikhumba, izifo zezinso, nezinye izifo ezithathelwana. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemithwalo ezikhathini zezempilo zomphakathi, okubangela izindleko ezinkulu. Umphakathi udinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezifo ezihlobene namanzi. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi kuphathwe izinhlelo ezinamandla zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlukanisa amanzi, ukukhiqiza amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula ukungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokuhlanza amanzi ngezilokazane, bungasetshenziswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lamanzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe lezi zinhlelo. Isimo Sokuziphatha Nokuqwashisa Inhlangano yomphakathi nayo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinkinga zamanzi. Ukuqwashisa ngomsebenzi wokulondoloza amanzi, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda imithombo yamanzi, nesiko lokwaziwa kwezingcindezi ezihlobene, kuzosiza ekwakheni isimo sokuziphatha esifanele. Ukwenza izinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya imiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo eziphusile, ezihambisana nezimfuno zezakhamuzi. Akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile, kodwa futhi ukuvikela nemithombo yamanzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohlonze, nezinhlelo zokwakha inhlalakahle kubalulekile ukuze sizuze impilo engcono. Ngalesi sikhathi, sinesibopho sokusebenzisa izinsiza zethu ukuze siqedele lezi zinkinga, sithuthukise impilo yethu, neyezizukulwane ezizayo. Amathuba anele akhona, sizodinga kuphela ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze sifeze umgomo wethu.
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni: Isingeniso Ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi ezinsizakalweni zabantu. Lokhu kufinyelela, okuhlanganisa izikhungo zomphakathi ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, kudinga ukuqonda okujulile ukuze sikwazi ukubona izinzuzo nezinselelo ezihambisana nakho. Ukubaluleka Kokufinyelela Kwamahhala Ukufinyelela kwamahhala kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali, unethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezithintekayo, lapho abantu abaningi behluleka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabo ezisemqoka. Izikhungo zomphakathi, njengamabhadi, zenza kube lula ukuthola ukwelashwa, kanti izikhungo zemfundo ziqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zithola imfundo efanele ukuze zikwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izikhungo Zokuthuthukisa Umphakathi Ezikhungweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ukufinyelela kwamahhala kudinga ukunakwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezifanele zitholakala, ezifana nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa, nezinhlelo zokweseka imindeni. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngendawo yokubambisana, lapho abantu benza imisebenzi ehlose ukuthuthukisa impilo yabo, futhi bakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Izinkinga Nezinselele Naphezu kwezinhlelo ezinhle zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zamahhala, kunezinselele ezithile ezithinta ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, izinhlelo eziphuthumayo, kanye nokungabi khona kwemali eyanele yokugcina izikhungo. Abanye abantu bangase babhekane nezithiyo zokwaziswa, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo ukuze bathole lezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezisemqoka zokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olukhululekile. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukufinyelela Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kwamahhala, iziphathimandla kufanele zisebenzisane nezinhlelo zabantu, izikhungo zomphakathi, nezikhungo ezizimele. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile, nokwenza izinqubo zokubhalisela ukufinyelela kube lula. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi kumele kube yinto ebalulekile ukuze abantu bathole usizo olufanele. Umthelela Emphakathini Ukufinyelela kwamahhala kulezi zikhungo kubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bonke, ikakhulukazi abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, bangathola ukusizakala. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onempilo, onolwazi, notholakala, okhulisa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Umphakathi onokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile ube nezinga eliphakeme lokuphila, okhulisa ukwakheka kwemiphakathi ezinzile. Isiphetho Ngamafuphi, ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kuyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ikuvumela abantu ukuba bathole izinsizakalo ezisemqoka, bakhe imiphakathi eqinile, futhi benze izinqumo eziphusile ezithinta ikusasa labo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokucabanga ngalezi zinto, kubalulekile ukukhumbula umgomo wethu wokwakha umphakathi lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Lokhu kuzodala umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nohlanganisiwe, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bonke.
Ukunakekelwa Kwabantu Abadala: Iphrofayela KaMnumzane Thandazani Ndlovu UMnumzane Thandazani Ndlovu ungumuntu oneminyaka engama-72, futhi uhlala emzaneni wakwaZulu lapho enza khona umsebenzi wobuholi emphakathini. Uthande abantu, futhi lokhu kwenze waba ngumholi ophumelelayo emsebenzini wakhe wokunakekela abantu abadala. UThandazani ukhomba ubudlelwano obuqinile nezinsizwa nezintokazi, abavakashela kumzala wakhe ukuqonda kakuhle izidingo zabo. UThandazani wazalelwa emakhaya aseMpumalanga, lapho rural lifestyle limthokozisa, akhule nabo onkosikazi abanjengobaba nabomama. Njengoba enza iminyaka, uThandazani waba nomuzwa ophusile wokuhlola izidingo zombuso, ikakhulukazi emphakathini walapha edolobhaneni, lapho abantu abadala bebhekana nezinselelo zempilo, izinsiza, nolwazi olwahlukahlukene. Ukwenza kahle kwakhe, uThandazani uyazisa ukufunda. Yena uthanda ukufunda izincwadi ezikhuluma ngezindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala, ikakhulukazi ezikhuluma ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, kodwa ubeqonda ukuba ukuthokozisa uthando kubaluleke kakhulu kunezimali. Akavumi ukuba kube khona umkhiqizo omubi emphakathini, umkhiqizo ophula ukholo kanye nokuzethemba kwabantu abadala. UThandazani ufunde ukubaluleka kokunakekela impilo yempilo yabo abadala. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukukhiqiza imithi nezinhlaka zempilo; kudinga ukuba imizamo ethile ibekwe ukuze abantu abadala bazizwe bethembekile, benakekelwa, futhi bephila kahle. UThandazani ubelokhu echaza ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle, lapho izizukulwane ezancane zihlala khona nabantu abadala. Lokhu kudala umoya oncomekayo wombuso ophilayo emiphakathini yabo. Umkhiqizo wombono wakhe wahlangana nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa umphakathi, okwakwenza kwaba lula ukusiza abantu abadala ngokwabo naphakathi komndeni. Ithimba lakhe lathola uhlu lwabantu abadala abadingi olunye usizo, kanti ukukhalaza akwenzwa kakhulu. UThandazani uke wagovuzela umphakathi ukuphinya izinhlelo zokuthokozisa abantu abadala, okubandakanya izinsuku zokuhlala, imidlalo, nezifundo ezihlukahlukene zokuphila. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zebhizinisi ezifundisa abantu abadala ukudla okunempilo, ukugijima imidlalo, nokubhalela izincwadi, luveza amandla okwenyusa izinqubo ezizungezile. Njengoba eletha ukugubha, uThandazani uvuselela isithunzi somphakathi, udala ubudlelwano obuhle nezizukulwane. Iphakheji yakhe yokunakekelwa iyaziwa njengemfashini, edabula imihlangano wamanje nabantu abadala. Ngesikhathi esedlula eminyakeni, uThandazani ubona izinguquko ezinhle. Abantu abadala babenhlonipho, baphila kahle, bejabulile njengabantu abavela ezinye izikhumbuzo zabo. Umphakathi wakhe ubonisa uthando nokuqonda, uvuseleleke kulwazi oluwasizayo. UThandazani uphinde wahlanganyela nemikhosi yokuhlonipha abantu abadala, evuma imikhosi ethile, efaka imikhosi yokugubha izinsuku zempilo, kanti lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubonga ezinkundleni zabo. UThandazani udume kakhulu emiphakathini, futhi uhlala efinyelela ngokungapheli imeko ezinzima eziwuphawu. Uheha umphakathi ukuthi senze ukubambisana ukuze sifeze izinhloso eziyinqaba zempilo zabantu abadala. Uthando lwaThandazani nothando lwezimpilo zabo abadala kudinga ukugcina lomoya uhlala unjengoba uthuthuka. Ngokwengeziwe, amandla akhe okuba yisikhumbuzo sephakathi, ukumema, nokubulala izinkinga ezahlukene ekuphileni kwabantu abadala, kwehlulekile ukumshiya ethokozisa. UThandazani uvuma njalo ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga ukusebenza ngaphandle kwemigomo ethile, bebaphinde bebendlela kwezidingo zomphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe uzoletha ithemba lokwethembeka, umphakathi ophilayo, nesibindi sokuhlonipha abangukuthi baphile kahle. Kuwo wonke amazwe yayeyimiphakathi, uThandazani um model oncomekayo wempilo yempumelelo. Uke ubophezela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala kuze kube sekuphumeleni, yena ubalulekile kulesi sikhathi, elwela ukwakha umbono ophilayo kube yimpumelelo ehloniphekile. UThandazani ubonisa ukuthi ubuholi bakhe bungahambisana namandla abantu abadala, bahlabelela impilo ezinhle, futhi bakhuthaze imiphakathi ukuba ithokozise. Ngakho, namuhla, uThandazani uphila kahle, udinga impilo ezikhumbuzwayo. Umbono wakhe nezinselelo azibhekile zifundisa, ziqondisa umphakathi ngemisebenzi nokukhulumisana okuhle, ukwenza kube kuhle empilweni yebantu abadala bakhe. UThandazani ungumuntu ophumelelayo, ophumelele emlandweni wokuziqhenya, ehlonipha ukholo nempilo.
Imoto ethwele impahla eyingozi - iminyaka engu-25. Uma usuhambe le ndlela yemoto futhi uqinisekiswe njengokufanele ngorganisasi eqashelwe, awukaze ujezwe ngokushayela ungaphansi kwethonya, noma ngokushayela ngokungafanele, noma ube nezigwegwe ezihlobene nokulwa, ilayisensi yakho ayikaze iphazamiseke. Kukhona izinhlobo ezithile zezenzo ezingakuvimba ekutholeni imvume yokushayela yobungcweti. Izenzo ezenzeke ngaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu ezedlule ngeke zicatshangelwe. Uzohlolwa ngejaji lokushayela elisebenzayo. Idokhumenti yokuzazisa esebenzayo, ilayisensi yokushayela, noma ipasipoti yaseNingizimu Afrika iyadingeka. Izithombe ezimbili ezinemibala zedokhumenti yokuzazisa, ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, kanye nesitifiketi sokufunda uma kudingeka, isitifiketi sezempilo esingekho ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimvume zokushayela onazo. Khokha imali echazwe. Uzokwaziswa uma ikhadi lakho lemvume yokushayela yobungcweti lilungile ukuze uthole. Kumele ukwazi ukuzazisa uma uthola ikhadi lakho. Amakhadi angatholwa kuze kube ezinsukwini eziyi-120 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwawo.
Ukulungiselela kwenziwa ukuze kutholakale, kubanjwe, kuphume, kuthuthukiswe, kunikezwe kulabo abaneziqu, kusebenze, kanye nokulahla insimbi eyigugu; kanye nokubhekana nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Insimbi eyigugu ichazwa njengensimbi engathuthukisiwe ehlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa nokuhlanganiswa, noma ithuthukiswe ezingeni elingaphansi kuka-99.9% futhi ingakafakwa emsebenzini wokwakha noma wokukhiqiza ngaphandle kokuhlanza noma ukwenza insimbi kodwa hhayi insimbi yokuphosa, ama-ingots, ama-nuggets, ama-buttons, intambo, amapuleti, isikhumba, amasampula, amakhanda, ngaphandle kwamakhanda akhiqizwe kusuka ensimbini eyigugu ethuthukisiwe ezingeni elingu-99.9% noma ngaphezulu, kanye ne-ratio yegolide elihlanziwe; noma njengokuchazwa njengengxenye, into ethile noma umkhiqizo walesi sihlobo, into ethile noma umkhiqizo ohlwini lwekholomu a; noma iyiphi into noma ingxenye equkethe noma inensimbi eyigugu njengoba kuxoxiwe kukholomu a kodwa ingafaki noma iyiphi into enekhono lokufunda ngezinto zendawo noma eyakhelwe noma eyakhiqizwe ukuze isetshenziswe kokunye noma okunye ukusebenza kwezomnotho, kwezobuchwepheshe, noma kwezobuciko. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa okufanele kwamabhizinisi ensimbi eyigugu eRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokunquma izinhloso zokwakha umnotho nokwakha umphakathi njengoba kuchaziwe. UNgqongqoshe unomthwalo wemfanelo nganoma iyiphi into ehambisana noma exoxwa kulolu mthetho njengoba kubhekiswe kuNgqongqoshe; futhi ngokujwayelekile, ukwenza yonke imisebenzi edingekayo noma ebalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zayo. Ngasikhathi sinye, ukwenza izincomo kuNgqongqoshe mayelana nanoma iyiphi into ehambisana nalolu mthetho; futhi ukuqoka noma yimuphi umuntu osebenza naye njengomhloli ukuze enze imisebenzi ebekwe ukuba yenziwe ngumhloli. Le nsimbi eyigugu engathuthukisiwe akufanele idlule isisindo esibekiwe futhi kufanele itholakale kulandela imvume ekhishwe nguMqondisi ngenhloso yokuzuza noma ngezizathu zesayensi noma ngezizathu zobuciko; noma ukubamba noma ukuba nelayisensi yokubamba insimbi eyigugu futhi ulandele imigomo nemibandela yelayisensi yakhe. UMqondisi angakhupha kuphela isitifiketi esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 1 d kumuntu ngokuxhumana nezezimali zesiNdebele, futhi uma kuhlobene negolide, kanye noMphathiswa Wezizwe. a lowo muntu okukhuluma ngaye esigabeni 1; noma b unensimbi eyigugu ngokufeza noma ngokuhambisana nezivumelwano zokusebenza nomunye umuntu okukhuluma ngaye esigabeni 1. Akekho umuntu ongakwazi ukuveza noma ukuza nensimbi eyigugu engathuthukisiwe ukuze akhokhe umthwalo wakhe, noma lowo wemunye umuntu noma mayelana nensizakalo ayinikezile noma ezokwenziwa nguye noma yimuphi omunye umuntu. Kungumuntu kuphela okukhuluma ngaye kulezi zigaba 1 a, c, e, noma f ongakwazi ukwenza, ukuhluza, noma ukuguqula noma iyiphi insimbi eyigugu engathuthukisiwe anayo kulandela okukhuluma kulezi zigaba. f enelayisensi yokuthola insimbi eyigugu; noma g ngovumelekile ukuba umkhiqizi wensimbi eyigugu. a okukhuluma ngaye esigabeni 1; noma b ubamba le nsimbi eyigugu ngokufeza isivumelwano sokusebenza nomunye umuntu okukhuluma ngaye esigabeni 1. b kufanele ukhumbule izidingo zeBroad Economic Empowerment Charter esungulwe kulandela izinhlinzeko zesigaba 100 seMineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act ka-2002 uMthetho No. 28 ka-2002; futhi c angase aqhube uphenyo mayelana nesicelo uma ecabanga ukuthi kubalulekile. Ngaphambi kokuba uMqondisi anikeze ilayisensi yokuhlanza kumfakisicelo welayisensi, kufanele akhokhe imali ethile. Ilayisensi yokuhlanza iphela kulandela imigomo nemibandela ngaphansi kwazo ikhishwe. Kube nokudideka okuningi mayelana namagama wemithi, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zakamuva, ikakhulukazi mayelana namagama ezinto ezisebenza kule mithi. Ngiyethemba ukuthi namuhla ngizokwenza kube sobala lokhu kudideka kubantu. Ngamanye amazwi, umkhiqizi wemithi nguye ophakamisa igama lemithi ngalokho ayikhiphayo. Manje ngikholelwa ukuthi ungabona umehluko emagameni ezinkampani ezikhiqiza imithi efanayo kodwa eyibiza ngamagama ahlukene. Ngakho-ke, kufanele uqaphele izinguquko emagameni ngoba zivame ukushintshwa ngabakhiqizi abahlukene. Kubalulekile ukwazi ngemithi oyisebenzisayo. Ukuba nesisindo esikhulu kakhulu sokuphakama kwakho kungaba yingozi enkulu empilweni yakho, kukubeka engcupheni yezifo ezinzima ezifana nokukhuluphala, isifo sikashukela, kanye nesifo senhliziyo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukwazi isisindo sakho ukuze ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokuthi uzisize. Odokotela bathanda ukusiza bonke abantu abakhuthazekile ukuba banakekele impilo yabo ngokwethula le phrojekthi yokwehlisa isisindo. Bazobheka isisindo sakho, ukuphakama kwakho, bese bebona ukuthi isimo sakho sempilo sikhona noma uma ungase ube sengcupheni yokuba nezifo ezishiwo ngenhla ngokuya ngendlela ophila ngayo. Uzothola inzuzo ngokuthola uhlu lwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla okufanele ulandele nokuthi ungawwehlisa kanjani isisindo uma kudingeka. Kuzodingeka ubuye ngemva kokuvakasha kwakho kokuqala, bese kubonakala uma kukhona umehluko. Le phrojekthi izophathwa kanye ngeviki, kuphela ngoMsombuluko. (Kubalulekile ukubhalisela kuqala). Obhala: T.C.
amaMamelodi Sundowns - Ingxoxo NgeMidlalo Nezinto Ezizayo Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukuhamba phambili kokukhuluma ngamaqembu amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi amaMamelodi Sundowns. Njengoba sihlangana nomqeqeshi weqembu, uMnu. Rulani Mokwena, sizobheka izimpi zabo ezidlulelayo, amathuba abawatholile, kanye nezifiso zabo zokukhula. Ingxenye 1: Ukubaluleka Kwamaqembu Ngokwezemidlalo UMnu. Mokwena, ungakuchaza kanjani ukubaluleka kweMamelodi Sundowns emidlalweni yaseNingizimu Afrika? "Uhlanga lwethu lukhulu kakhulu emlandweni wezokungcebeleka. AmaMamelodi Sundowns awaqhubekela phambili ahlola indlela yokwenza izinto ngendlela entsha. Sizinikele ekwakheni umqondo wobuchwepheshe, kanti lokho kuhluke kakhulu uma siqhathanisa nezinye izinkampani. Sifuna ukuba isibonelo esihle, hhayi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa nasekuthuthukiseni izinkanyezi ezincane." Ingxenye 2: Ukuphumelela Kweqembu Ngokubukwa kwakho, yiziphi izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene neMamelodi Sundowns kulezi zinsuku? "Njengoba siqhubeka, izinselelo zihlala zikhona. Sinobunzima bokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokudlala, ikakhulukazi uma ubhekene nezinye izinkanyezi ezifana neKaizer Chiefs ne-Orlando Pirates. Kodwa, sihamba phambili emsebenzini wethu, siza phambili ekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Siphokophele ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, nokuvumela abadlali bethu ukuba bavelele." Ingxenye 3: Amathuba Nezinhlelo Zesikhathi Esizayo Ngabe unazo izinhlelo ezithile zokukhulisa amaMamelodi Sundowns esikhathini esizayo? "Yebo, sinemigomo emisha. Sikholelwa ekwakheni isizukulwane esisha sabadlali. Sihlose ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezinkanyezi ezincane, nokubafundisa amakhono amasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sithanda ukuqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabalandeli bethu, ngoba yibo abanjalo abangakhuthaza abadlali bethu." Ingxenye 4: Ubudlelwano Nabalandeli Kuyini okukhuthazayo ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kweqembu nabalandeli? "Bengizama ukuhlanganisa abadlali nabalandeli. Ngiyakhumbula izikhathi ezithokozisayo lapho sidlalela emakhaya ethu, futhi umoya wethu uyavela. Sifuna abadlali bethu bazi ukuthi basendaweni ebalulekile, futhi ukuba nebanzi labalandeli, kubalulekile. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwakha ubudlelwano obuhlala isikhathi eside." Ingxenye 5: Isiphetho Nezikhumbuzo Ngabe ungathanda ukwabelana ngombono wakho wokuthi ukufinyelela kuphi amaMamelodi Sundowns eminyakeni ezayo? "Siyabonga, futhi ngithanda ukukholwa ukuthi kulapho sizogcina siphuma phambili. Sifuna ukujabulisa abalandeli bethu, sibe nezinye izicoco neziphakamiso zempumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sihamba phambili, futhi sizobe sithandwa phesheya, ngaphandle kokuphuma emathafeni." Ngokuhlanganyela, amaMamelodi Sundowns awanqobi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa futhi adlondlobala ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga, uMnu. Mokwena, ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi. Sifisela iqembu lethu impumelelo enkulu!
Le nsizakalo iyatholakala kumuntu osekwamukelwe njengomfuduki ofuna ukufuduka eNingizimu Afrika. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leziMisebenzi Zasendlini eliseduzane endaweni okukhona kuyo. Kufanele ube sebandleni labafuduki iminyaka emihlanu ukuze ufake isicelo. Thola ukuqinisekiswa okuvela kwiKomidi Elimisiwe Lezindaba Zobafuduki, okukhombisa ukuthi kubonakala ukuthi uzohlala unguMfuduki okudingayo ukufuduka. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29E.
