Ukukhula Kwamapodcast eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-podcast aseNingizimu Afrika abe yinsiza ebalulekile yokwabelana ngolwazi, izindaba, nemibono. Lokhu kukhula kubonakala ngokwanda kwabantu ababathandayo, abawakhulumayo, kanye nezinkampani ezithola izinzuzo ezinkulu kulolu hlobo lokuxhumana. Ukuze siqonde kahle lesi sikhala esikhulayo, kubalulekile ukuhlole izizathu eziholela ekukhuleni kwama-podcast, izinzuzo zawo, kanye nezinkinga ezithintekayo. Izizathu Zokukhula Okokuqala, ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekwandeni kwama-podcast. Ngokutholakala kwezinsiza eziningi zokulalela ama-podcast, abantu bangakwazi ukuwathola kalula, noma bahlala kuphi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana neSpotify, Apple Podcasts, neGoogle Podcasts zenza kube lula ukuwathola, okukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baqale ukuwulalela. Okwesibili, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendlela yokuxhumana engajwayelekile. Abantu bahlala bezama izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, futhi ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokuzwa izinkulumo ezijulile, izindaba ezithokozisayo, kanye nemibono ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule futhi babonise izithakazelo zabo, okwandisa umphakathi wama-podcast. Okwesithathu, ama-podcast anikeza indawo yokukhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta abantu abaningi, njengezindaba zomphakathi, ezepolitiki, nezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izindaba ezithinta umphakathi zidinga ukuxoxwa ngazo ukuze kube nokwaziswa okwanele. Ama-podcast anikeza abantu ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo. Izinzuzo Zama-Podcast Ama-podcast anikeza izinzuzo eziningi, kokubili kubalaleli nakubakhulumayo. Kubalaleli, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendlela yokufunda nokuzijabulisa ngesikhathi esifanayo. Abantu bangalalela ama-podcast ngesikhathi esifanele kubo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphumile, emsebenzini, noma ekhaya. Lokhu kukhulisa ukufinyelela kolwazi, okwenza kube lula ukufunda ngezihloko ezithokozisayo. Kubakhulumayo, ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokwabelana ngolwazi lwabo, izipiliyoni, nezimvo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha umphakathi, futhi abakhulumayo bangathola izithameli ezinkulu, okungaholela ezinzuzweni ezinkulu, ezifana nezikhangiso noma ukuxhaswa. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nama-Podcast Noma kunjalo, ukukhula kwama-podcast akukhululekile ezinkingeni. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhwalithi yokuqukethwe. Njengoba abantu abaningi beqala ama-podcast, kukhona ingozi yokuthi izinga lokuqhuba lingase lingabi phezulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abalaleli baphumelele, okungathinta umphakathi jikelele. Okwesibili, ukuncintisana kukhula. Njengoba ama-podcast enza umkhankaso, abakhulumayo badinga ukuba nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile ukuze bahlale bephambili. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe bokukhangisa, kanye nezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-podcast akhula futhi ahlale ethokozisa. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa indlela abantu abathanda ngayo ukufunda, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokuxhumana. Noma kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalokhu, izinzuzo zikhombisa ukuthi ama-podcast azoba yinsiza ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwakha, baphinde baphendule ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi, ama-podcast azoba yindlela ebalulekile yokukhuluma, ukufunda, nokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kulindeleke ukuthi ama-podcast aqhubeke nokukhula, ahlinzeke ngolwazi olunembile, futhi abe yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindabeni ezithinta abantu abaningi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izwi labantu lizwa. Njengoba sikhula, ama-podcast azoba yinsiza ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokwabelana ngolwazi eNingizimu Afrika.
### UHuawei: Umlando, Inoveli, Nezimpumelelo Isingeniso UHuawei, inkampani eyaziwa kabanzi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, yatholwa eChina ngo-1987 ngu-Ren Zhengfei, umqondisi osemqoka. Kusukela yasekelwa, le nkampani ibonakale iyinkanyezi eqhubekayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, iphumelele kakhulu ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni amathuluzi kanye nezinsiza ze-inthanethi. Umlando Wokuqala UHuawei yaqala izimpande zayo njengefektri encane eShenzhen, lapho yayikhiqiza khona imikhiqizo yezokuxhumana ephansi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uRen Zhengfei wayenokubuka okukhulu kwezobuchwepheshe, ubehlanganisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje nezinqubomgomo ofuna ukuzithuthukisa. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubekayo, uHuawei wathuthela emikhiqizweni ebalulekile, uqala ukukhiqiza izingcingo eziphathwayo namakhalekhukhwini. Inoveli Nokuthuthukiswa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uHuawei wawina inhlonipho emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, eba ngumnikazi wezincwadi eziyinhloko ezibhalwe yizikhungo zezenhlalo ezifana nezikhumbuzo, ubuchwepheshe bomhlaba, nezikhumbuzo zobuchwepheshe. Izikhumbuzo zayo ze-5G zibhalwe phakathi kokuthuthukiswa okuyinqaba. Yona yayingeyokuqala ukuhwebelana nalolu hlobo lobuchwepheshe, yenza kube nephuzile uma kuziwa ohlelweni lokuxhumana. Ukwanda Kwenkampani Ngemva kokuba uHuawei esethole impumelelo kulesi sikhala, inkampani yanda kakhulu. Kuvula amashbranch amasha emhlabeni wonke, ikakhulukazi eYurophu nase-Asia. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, yashintsha izinhlelo zayo, yathuthukisa imikhiqizo ebizwa nge-Huawei Pwa, eyokutholwa kwamakhompyutha, namaphesenti aphakeme oscillators, okwenze kwavela izinhlelo eziyinkulu zemikhiqizo eyahlukene. Lesi simo sithathe ikhwelo leminyaka eminingi. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Njengoba uHuawei eqhubekele phambili, kuza nezinkinga ezinqunyelwe. Izingqinamba zomhlaba eziqhamuka ezwenikazi ziqhamuka ngenxa yokungathembeki kwezepolitiki, futhi kwezinye izinhlelo ezizimele. Kodwa uHuawei, ngendlela efanele, wafaka amagalelo akhe ezinhlelweni vele, waphinde waba yinkampani eyaziwa kahle ngezinto eziyinkimbinkimbi zezenhlalo nezokuxhumana. Isithombe Esimangalisayo Uhlelo lwe-Huawei lwenziwa ngezigaba ezithuthukisiwe kakhulu, ezifaka phakathi i-IoT, ukuxhumana okuphakeme, kanye ne-AI. Lokhu kukhuthazwe ubuchwepheshe bokwakha imiphakathi yezenhlalo nezokuxhumana nokuxhumana. UHuawei udlale indima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba okukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, egcizelela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezithuthukisa izinga lemisebenzi. Uhlanga Lokugcina Namuhla, uHuawei ubalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, udlula nemikhawulo yokuphatha izinsiza ngendlela ethuthuke kakhulu. Ubuye uthole izitifiketi eziningi, wahlonishwa ngezinto eziningi ezenzakalayo ezithinta umphakathi. Ushalazela phambili emashumini eminyaka yokusebenza, doda uqhubeka nokuzibophezela emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ukuletha okuhle ezizweni ezahlukene nokuthuthukisa uzinzo lokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, uHuawei akagcini nje ngokuba umkhiqizi obalulekile, kodwa futhi usemhlanganweni wezobuchwepheshe ohamba phambili, wenza izinguquko ezithokozisayo emhlabeni jikelele. Ubulungiswa, inoveli, nokusebenza kwamaHuawei kulindeleke ukugcina impumelelo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Ukwamukela isifiso sokukhula, uHuawei ube nesiko eliqhubekayo lokukhiqiza imikhiqizo emisha, ilwela ukuhlala phambili emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuyi-oda kulolu hlelo oluqhubekayo lokuthuthuka, nobuchwepheshe obuthuthukiswe miro, kungenxa yomgomo ophumelelayo. UHuawei, ohambisana nezidingo zezinkonzo zomhlaba, uyacinga uthando nomoya wokusebenza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Umlando kaHuawei umhlopeka bukhoma, futhi izinkanyezi zayo zoqobo zikhanya phezu kwamaholidi azayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lempumelelo yethu, inspirishes izizukulwane ezizayo, kuvula uhla lwezinkangala zemikhiqizo, idolobha lempumelelo ngennium edluleyo.
Ukuhlonza Uhlanga lweMahlaya: Ukunambitheka Kwenjabulo Ezweni lethu eligelezayo, amahlaya adlalela isikhala esibalulekile. Kusho kakhulu ukuhlekisa, ukujabulisa abantu, nokubathokozisa ngaso sonke isikhathi. Umoya we-mahlaya uhamba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo, uqhubeka ungena emibhalweni ehlukene, ezindaweni zemidiya, nakwizinkanyezi ezidumile. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka imisebenzi ethile yehlaya, sihlole izici zayo, sithole imvelaphi, nokuthi ithinta kanjani imizwa yabantu. Ukuqala, amahlaya akha ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuboniswa kahle emidlalweni, kumasimu, nakuhlelo lwamakhasi. Ubulukhuni bempilo bujoliswa ngokuhlekisa ngalokhu okukhona empilweni. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, omuntu uhlala enezinkinga eziningi ezahlukene, amahlaya agqama ezithombeni ezikhaliphile zomphakathi. Izithombe zenzeka ziba ngaphezulu komqondo, ezifakazela izinselelo zokuphila, zibheke ezindleleni ezihlekisayo. Kufanele sikhumbule amandla amahlaya anawo ekuphuculeni impilo. Kumuntu ngamunye, ukuhlekisa kuhlinzeka ngodlame oluhle lokuwina. Sinokholo lokuthi ukuphumelela kwengqikithi yama “stand-up” kuboniswa ezikhukhu, zibahlenganisa futhi zibacingise. Izithombe ezibhalwe kahle zamahlaya zikhetha ukusingatha izinkumbulo zethu nempilo yethu. Ngokwemvelo, zonke izinhlelo ezihlekisayo zihlala zibhekisela ekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Ukuhlekisa ngempilo ethile, imicimbi eyishwa, nempilo yomndeni kubalulekile. Kukhona abaculi abanobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, abahleka baphinde bahlakaniphe ukudala izimo ezihlekisayo. Kwazulu, umculi omkhulu uSiyabonga B ofuna ukwaziwa ngemidlalo yakhe ehlekisayo ethi “Emakhosini.” Ngenxa yeziqubulo ezidumile, uthande ukusebenzisa umehluko phakathi kwempilo yansuku zonke nezimo ezinzima ukuze uhlanganise ahlaya ahamba phambili. Izinhlamvu ezahlukene zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuhlukene nokwakha izimo. Umnqweno unamandla, kanti izindaba ezibhalwe ngendlela ehlekisayo zenza izwe liphumelele. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezithameli nezicukuthwane ziphenya izinqubo ezichaza kahle impilo, bese zidudula izimo ezinzima, zifuna ukwenza abantu bahlale behleka. Umculi owaziwa uThokozani, ubevele wafaka izithombe ezihlekisayo empilweni. Uma uhamba emhlabeni wezokuhlekisa, kufanele unake izinhlelo eziphakeme, njengezokusithokozisa ezikhethekile. Lezi zinhlelo ziba nezinselelo, futhi zifakaza ukuthi amahlaya angagxila ezindabeni ezithile. Nansi isibonelo esivela kuhlelo olwaziwa kakhulu olunokuhlekisa. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amahlaya anomshado phakathi kwezindikimba ezixakile. Ukubuyisela emuva, sithola ukuthi amahlaya akhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nezinhloso ezinhle, aphinde aqinisekise imizwelo ehlukahlukene. Yiqiniso, imivuzo eholela emikhakheni ehlukene yempilo ifuna ukwenziwa ngama-comedians abahluka. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi amahlaya anciphisa ukucindezeleka, aqhuba umoya opholile, futhi akhulise indlela esibona ngayo izinto. Kubalulekile ukufaka uMphakathi lwezothando ezinjalo, ngoba ukudlalela phansi ezincwadini nokubonwa komoya kudinga ukubonga. Ngokubheka ivesi yangempela yama-comedy, ukufakazela ukwenza izinkanyezi eziphumela kuncike ohlelweni olubonisa imiqondo eyisisekelo. Zithokozise umoya wemidlalo ethakazelisayo, kulawa ma-comedians asitafula emhlabeni, ovezwe emithonjeni ehlukahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezithameli nezithombe ezihlekisayo zakwaZulu nezeNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcina izinto ziphilile, ziyavuma ukuthi amahlaya ahamba kahle, aqhubeka nokuhlobisa izimo zocwaningo lwangempela, ezisela imizwa emihle. Ngenxa yokukhalipha okubolile kwabathakathi abasha, ukwaziwa kwama-comedians kusekelwe kwimizamo yokufakazela ispirit spieno. Uhlanga lwezama-luzulu ne-mahlaya kuvuma ukuzicana nezimo zensizwa. Njengoba sihlonipha ubuciko be-mahlaya, kuyabonakala ukuthi ukuhlakanipha kudinga ukuba kube khona kwemibono, futhi udinga ukucabanga ngezindlela ezihlukene zokwandisa ukudlala esikhathini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zama-mahlaya zenziwa ukwakha izinsiza ezibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi. Amakhasi ahlakaniphile nabaculi bakhonjiswa kuzo zonke izinkambu, bezothokozisa izithameli zabo. Lokhu kukhombisa umsebenzi ohlangene, ohloniphekile, nezinga lemibono ehlukene kolwazi, uphinde uthuthukise ukuhlekisa okukhona. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obugculisayo kwehlisa izinqubo, kanti akhazimula umoya oqhakazile. Ekugcineni, amahlaya ayindlela yokuhlanganisa abantu, akha izimvo ezimnandi, kanti ubungcweti bama-comedians bukhona. Umhlaba uhlala uchela ezihlekisayo, ngenkathi sihamba. Njengamanje, kudinga ukuba sihloniphe ubuciko, uma sicabanga ngempilo yethu, ubudlelwane bethu, kanye nemizwa yethu. Ngalokhu, amahlaya ayahlonishwa futhi aqhubeke ehamba phambili, enza umphakathi wethu uhuve endlini yokuhlekisa.

Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni Ngicela sikhulume ngento ebalulekile, okukhuluma ngayo abantu abaningi, kodwa kuthiwani ngezikhungo zethu? Ngabe sikhuluma ngempela ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ungafinyelela ezinsizeni ezikhungweni zethu? Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kungase kubonakale njengokungaqondakali, kodwa ngiyafuna ukucacisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala akukhona nje kuphela ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Okokuqala, ake sithathe isinyathelo sokucacisa ukuthi yiziphi izikhungo esikhuluma ngazo. Lokhu kungaba izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokuzijabulisa, noma ngisho nezikhungo zokusebenza. Njengoba sikhuluma, sizobona ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala kulezi zikhungo kuyasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobumbano, nolwazi. Ngicabanga ukuthi umphakathi wethu kufanele ube nezinhlaka ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulezi zikhungo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, izikhangiso ezikhuthazayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sikhuluma ngezikhungo zemfundo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezikoleni, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa abantu ukuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulezi zikhungo, kanye nokubasiza ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokwelapha akufanele kube yinkinga. Akukhona nje ukuthi kufanele kube nezikhungo eziningi ezitholakalayo, kodwa kufanele futhi kube nezinsizakalo ezitholakala mahhala. Lokhu kuzosiza abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenamali yokuhlawula izindleko zokwelapha. Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokwelapha ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, njengokwelashwa kwemitholampilo, izivakashi ezihamba ngezinyawo, kanye nemishanguzo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma ngezikhungo zokuzijabulisa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele akwazi ukuthokozisa. Lokhu kungaba izikhungo zokudlala, izikhungo zokucula, noma izikhungo zokudansa. Lokhu kufanele kube mahhala, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukujabulela lezi zinsizakalo. Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulezi zikhungo, njengokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, noma ukwakha izikhungo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela. Ngokuphathelene nezikhungo zokusebenza, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufinyelela emathubeni omsebenzi akufanele kube yinkinga. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela emathubeni omsebenzi. Lokhu kungaba nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu amakhono, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, kanye nokwakha izikhungo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emathubeni. Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kungase kubonakale njengokukhuluma okungapheli, kodwa ngiyafuna ukucacisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni akukhona nje kuphela ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ubufakazi bukhona, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, umnotho, kanye nokubumbana komphakathi. Lokhu kuzosiza abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenamali yokuhlawula izindleko, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, umphakathi, nokufinyelela ezikhungweni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobumbano, nolwazi. Ngicela sithathe izinyathelo zokwakha izinhlelo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulezi zikhungo. Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothuthukisa umphakathi wethu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Ngokuphetha, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni akukhona nje kuphela ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngakho, ake sithathe izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onobumbano, nolwazi, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, futhi kuzothuthukisa umphakathi wethu. Ngiyabonga.

Ngokungivumela ukuba ngidale lezi zithombe, kube nokuhlonipha okukhulu kwelizwe elinikeze lokho. U-Mametja usebenza njengoMklami wezimboni e-CSIR ePitoli. Uhlala eKempton Park nomkakhe nezingane ezimbili. U-Gareth Smart usebenze kahle njengomklami ezintweni eziningi kusukela eqeda i-BA yakhe yokuklama e-Midrand Graduate Institute of Higher Education. Izifundo azigxile kuzo zikhombisa ubude, ububanzi, nob depth bezithombe. Iphothifoliyo yakhe ikhombisa uhlu olunembile lwezinkampani azisebenzelayo ngesikhathi esifushane. Kaye, 'kwakuyithuba eliyingqayizivele' lokukhethwa ukuba aklame uphawu olusha lwezwe. Uhlala ePitoli lapho ebhekana nezidingo zamakhasimende njengomklami, umenzi wemodeli, nokukhombisa umqondo ophathelene nokuthile okuzimele. Uqinisekisa ukuthi noma ubani unelungelo lokusebenzisa ulimi lwabo nokubandakanyeka empilweni yamasiko abakhethayo (I-Clause 30). Izikhungo zomphakathi zinesibopho ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi ukuqapha le misebenzi yolimi nezinketho zabantu abakhonzayo lapho bexhumana nabantu, kuhlanganise nezidingo ezikhethekile zalabo abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Uhlelo lweNqubomgomo Yolimi Yezwe luhlinzeka ukuthi lapho isikhungo somphakathi sikhetha izilimi ezizosebenza ezikhethwe yimiphakathi, ngokuxhumana nabo, kumele sithuthukise, sishicilele, futhi silandele inqubomgomo ephethe ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi zombili ezisemthethweni ezikhuluma ngabaningi eThekwini, okuyi-isiZulu nesiNgisi. Iphucula ukufinyelela kulwazi nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni. Ikhuthaza futhi isekela izakhamuzi ukuthi zifunde izilimi ezisemthethweni ngaphezu kolimi lwazo lokuzalwa, okuzosiza ekwakheni nasekugcineni ubunye njengombuso nasekuqinisekiseni ubuhlakani obuhlukahlukene benhlangano. Iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ngokugxila ekuphathweni okufanele kwezilimi. Isebenzisa futhi ilandele izinhlinzeko zeSigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo kanye nezimiso ze-Batho Pele nezinye izimo ezifanayo zokusebenza. Ukukhethwa kwalabo abazosebenza esikhungweni somphakathi. Ukususwa kwezithiyo zokusebenzisa ulimi ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukisa ukufinyelela okufanele kuzinhlelo nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa isikhungo somphakathi. Iqinisekisa ukuthi akukho muntu ophoqelelwa noma ovinjelwe ekusebenziseni ulimi abalukhethayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingabe yinye yezilimi ezizosebenza noma cha. Ikhipha isikhundla esifanayo phakathi kwe-isiZulu nesiNgisi. Izinqubomgomo zalesi sihloko zizosebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zomphakathi. Noma yiliphi ulimi phakathi kwalezi ezimbili olungasetshenziswa esikhungweni somphakathi lungasetshenziswa kunoma yisiphi isithangami noma umhlangano weBhodi noma amaKomidi. Emihlanganweni yeBhodi kanye namaKomidi, kumele kube nabahumushi bezilimi ezilodwa kulezi ezimbili ezingasetshenziswa. Uma noma yiliphi ilungu lithanda ukuthi okukhuluma kwenziwe kuhumushelwe kwenye ulimi engelona olunye lwezilimi ezizosebenza, leli lungu kumele libike uMongameli weBhodi noma leli Komidi kusenesikhathi ukuze kudingeke ukuhumusha. Ulimi lokukhuluma kumele lutholakale uma kudingeka. Noma yimiphi imihlangano yomphakathi noma imicimbi yomphakathi kumele yenziwe ngolimi olungasetshenziswa ngokwezinketho zababekhona. Uma kukhona abavakashi abangakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olukhethiwe, kumele kuhumushelwe. Zonke izimiso, imithetho, nezinqumo zeBhodi kanye namaKomidi kumele zibhale ngazo zombili izilimi zomphakathi ezizosebenza. Zonke izaziso ezisemthethweni nezikhangiso ezikhishwe ukuze zikwazise umphakathi kumele zishicilelwe ngesiZulu nesiNgisi. I-isiZulu noma isiNgisi kungenziwa ukusho okwenziwayo kwangaphakathi. Uma umuntu obhalelwa engakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olusetshenziswayo, bangacela ukuthi babhalelwe ngolimi abaluqondayo. Imizuzu kumele ikhishwe ngazo zombili izilimi ezisetshenziswayo. Ukukhulumisana kwangaphakathi kungenziwa ngesiNgisi noma ngesiZulu kuye ngababonayo. Ukuxhumana nabantu bangaphandle kumele kube ngolunye lwezilimi ezizosebenza, kucatshangelwa ukuthi yiluphi ulimi umamukeli akhetha. Uma incwadi iphendulwa ngaphandle, impendulo kumele ibe ngolimi lapho leyo ncwadi ibhalwe khona. Ukuphuma kwencwadi kumele kubonise ukuthi uma umamukeli efuna ukubhalelwa ngolunye ulimi phakathi kwezilimi ezisetshenziswayo, lokho kuzokwenziwa uma bekucela. Izakhamuzi zinegunya lokusebenzisa ulimi abalukhethayo. Izimpawu ezikhombisa izikhungo noma amahhovisi omphakathi kumele zibe ngazo zombili izilimi ezizosebenza. Bonke abathengi kumele basizwe ngolimi abalukhethayo, ngosizo lomhumushi, uma kudingeka. Isikhungo somphakathi kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abamele izigcawu nezisebenzi bayakuqonda ukubaluleka kwezilimi ezahlukene futhi bakhuthazwe ukuba bamukele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezikhethwe ngababekhona/abathengi, abanye abamele izigcawu, nezisebenzi. Ukuhumusha nokuhumusha esikhungweni somphakathi kufanele kwenziwe ngabantu abanekhono abaqeqeshiwe kulolu work abaqashwe ngemuva kwemnyango wolimi wesikhungo somphakathi. Isikhungo somphakathi kumele sikhuthaze futhi sisekele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono olimi phakathi kwezisebenzi nabamele izigcawu. Izisebenzi nabamele izigcawu kufanele bakhuthazwe ukufunda ezinye izilimi ezingezona ezabo njengoba lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthokoziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene, ukuhlonishwa kwezamasiko ahlukahlukene, nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo. Lapho iminyango yomphakathi iqasha izisebenzi ezintsha, kumele bagcine le nqubomgomo yolimi engqondweni. Ngaphandle kokuthi kuchazwe kule nqubomgomo noma isinqumo seBhodi, le nqubomgomo izothatha umphumela kusukela ngosuku lokuthi kabulwe yiBhodi. Kumele kuqondwe ukuthi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha zokuthi le nqubomgomo kabulwe, uMphakathi weDolobha kumele ubeke izinsuku zokusebenza zokuphumelelisa izimo zalesi sihloko.
Lo mklomelo unikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaveze ub勇勇 ngokubeka impilo yabo engcupheni noma ngokulahlekelwa impilo yabo ngesikhathi bezama ukusindisa impilo yabanye noma ukusiza impahla ngaphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika noma kwezinye izindawo. Ingxenye yesithathu = Insimbi eyenziwe ngohlangothi lwezinsimbi. Ishidi elenziwe ngempahla yepholisi likhanyiswe ngendlela efana neqanda elinophahla oluqinile futhi lifakwe ngesibambo sokhuni. Ibhakede kanye ne-assegai zigcwalisa isikhwama, ezinikwa izivakashi ezivela kwamanye amazwe njengendlela yokubamukela. Itshe elincane eliluhlaza eliyigugu - umoya ophuma lapho izikhali ziqhamuka ubonisa indlela esizoyithatha lapho usizo lunikezwa kulabo abadinga usizo lapho imvelo ibhujiswa, izivunguvungu noma izikhukhula, nezinye izinkinga esibhekana nazo emhlabeni. Ingonyama - ibonisa ubuhle, amandla, nok勇勇. Uyabona ngayo ngezinqwaba zayo ezibambekayo kule mfanekiso. Lokhu kumela ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwethu ngeziqhawe zethu ezizibophezele ekuvikeleni iNingizimu Afrika. Izikhali ezintathu ezikhomba ezweni ziboniswa ngohlangothi lwezimbali ezivela kumuthi wezinyosi, okuyisihlahla sokuqina eNingizimu Afrika esimele ukuhlala, ukusinda engozini, nomsebenzi omkhulu wokuphulukisa komhlaba. Ibhakede kanye ne-assegai - zigcwalisa isikhwama zikhombisa ikhono lokuzivikela nokwethembeka.
uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean, olungamandla amakhulu, luhamba phambili njengomthombo wezimpilo, amasiko, nezinkumbulo eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Njengomuntu ohlala eduze kwalolu lwandle, ngiyazizwa ngithinteka kakhulu yizinto eziningi ezihambisana nalo. ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean akukhona nje kuphela umkhakha wezomnotho, kodwa futhi ubonisa ubuhle bemvelo, ubudlelwano bethu nemvelo, kanye namasiko ahlukene ahlanganiswa yizimpawu zempilo ezikhalweni ezihlukene. Ngokwengqondo yami, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungumhlaba ogcwele izimanga. Uthando lwami nolwazi enginalo ngalo lwalungaqhamukanga nje kuphela ezimpilweni zethu, kodwa futhi lukhombisa indlela esihlangana ngayo nemvelo. Uma ubuka amanzi aluhlaza, ubona izinkanyezi ezikhazimulayo, futhi uthokozisa umoya opholile, uzwa umuzwa wokuthula okungapheli. Lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba siphila ezikhathini ezinzima, uLwandlekazi uhlala unikeza indawo yokuphumula nokucabanga. Ngokubuka umhlaba, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungomunye wezindawo ezibaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni. Uhlanganisa amazwe amaningi, kusukela e-Afrika, e-Asia, nase-Australasia. Lezi zindawo zihlala zihlangene ngezindlela eziningi, kusukela ezokuhamba, ezokuxhumana, nokuhweba. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yendawo, asikwazi ukuhamba sihlukanisa lezi zindawo. Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi uLwandlekazi uhlanganisa abantu, izinkolo, namasiko ahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ube yindawo yokuhweba, lapho izimpahla nezinsiza zidluliselwa khona phakathi kwamazwe. Lokhu kuhweba akukhona nje kuphela okwenziwa ngezimpahla, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukwabelana ngamasiko, izinkolelo, nezindlela zokuphila. Ngikhumbula izinsuku engangihamba ngolwandle, ngibona izikebhe ezihamba phambili, futhi ngikhumbula ukuthi lezi zikebhe zikhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Uhlanga lwezimpahla luhamba, kodwa futhi luhamba nemicabango, izinkolelo, nezifundo ezibalulekile. Nokho, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean awuphelelanga ekuboniseni ubuhle nemisebenzi. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nalolu lwandle. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, ukuwohloka kwemvelo, nokwanda kwezimboni eziphula imithetho yokuvikela imvelo kuyizinkinga ezinkulu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sithathe isinyathelo ukuze sivikele leli lwandle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamazwe, izinkampani, kanye nabantu ngabanye kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean uyahlala unempilo futhi unothile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungumthombo wezinsiza eziningi, njengezinkanyezi, amafutha, nezinsiza zemvelo. Kodwa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinsiza azikhona kuphela ukuze zisetshenziswe. Kumele sibe nomqondo wokuphila ngendlela ehlonipha imvelo. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsiza ziyahlala zikhona, kudingeka sibe necebo eliqinile lokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza, ukusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngendlela ehlonipha imvelo. Ngokuphetha, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ungumthombo omkhulu wezimpilo, amasiko, nezinkumbulo. Njengomuntu okhulele eduze kwalolu lwandle, ngiyaziqhenya ngalesi sikhumbuzo sokuthi uLwandlekazi awukwazi nje ukusinika izinto, kodwa futhi usinika ithuba lokuhlangana, ukufunda, nokukhula. Kumele sithathe isinyathelo sokuvikela leli lwandle, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo nazo zikwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bayo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean uyindawo efanele yokuhlola, yokufunda, nokukhumbula ukuthi sikhona ngenxa yalo. Ngakho, asithathe isinyathelo, sizivikele, futhi sigcine ubuhle bethu obuhlala kuLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean.
Izithombe: Ukugcina umhlabathi: Lokhu kuyinhlanganisela yezitshalo, amaqabunga, nomhlabathi othambile obekwe eduze kwezitshalo ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa (ukungcoliswa komoya), ukuvimbela ukuf freezing okweqile kwemizi, nokuvimba ukukhula kwezihlahla. Imvula ewela emhlabathini ongavikelwe ingadala ubungozi uma imvula imnandi. Kubalulekile kubalimi ukuzama ukunciphisa leli bungozi elenzeka emhlabathini uma imvula imnandi. Incwadi yethu ethi "Imvula ngoFebhuwari" ixoxa ngokuqiniswa komhlabathi, ikakhulukazi ibhekisela ezimeni zokungcoliswa komhlabathi kanye nezinhlobo zokungcoliswa. Lapha sizama ukuchaza ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zobungozi imvula engadala emhlabathini ongavikelwe kanye nosizo esingaluthola uma sigcina umhlabathi. Ingxenye yamandla emvula isetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa ama-particles omhlabathi kuyo yonke indawo. Uma umhlabathi uhlanganiswe, usabalala kahle kuyo yonke indawo futhi umhlabathi omningi ngeke ulahleke, kodwa uma umhlabathi ungenamsebenzi, umhlabathi omningi uzosheshe ulahleke. Ngakho-ke, umhlabathi opholile uzosheshe ulahleke ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kukhona ibhalansi phakathi kwamandla emvula nokungcoliswa komhlabathi. Kaziwa kahle ukuthi ukungcoliswa komhlabathi okukhulu (50% - 80%) kuqala kakhulu uma imvula imnandi ezindaweni lapho kuvamile khona ngesikhathi sehlobo. Ama-particles amaningi ahluleka emzimbeni opholile. Amanzi amaningi azogijima phansi. Amanzi azogijima ngokushesha, eshaya. Ububanzi bokungcoliswa kanye nezindlela zokuphatha lokhu kuzovimbela izinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo ukuba zifakwe kule ndawo uma ukungcoliswa komhlabathi kungaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kubhekisela kakhulu kumandla amanzi okungcolisa umhlabathi kanye nesimo somhlabathi kule ndawo - ezinye izinhlobo zomhlabathi zikhula ngokushesha, ezinye kancane. Zonke izinkundla ezilinywa ezine-erosion rate engaphezulu kuka-3% kufanele zivikelwe ngokwakha izindonga (lokhu kuyisakhiwo esakhiwe ukuphakamisa umhlabathi ukuze kudaleke udonga lapho amanzi amaningi angaphuma khona). Izitshalo ezibekwe emigqeni zingafakwa kuphela ezinkundleni ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-10%. Izitshalo ezineziqhamo ezincane zingafakwa kuphela ezinkundleni ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-15%. Izinkundla ezilinywa zingafakwa kuphela lapho ukungcoliswa kungaphansi kuka-30%. Ukungcoliswa okungaphezu kuka-30% kungasetshenziswa kuphela ukufaka izihlahla noma ukugcina izinsiza zemvelo ezifana nezilwane. Ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo kuyinto ebalulekile evimbela ukungcoliswa komhlabathi ngenxa yemvula. Ikakhulukazi, ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo kudala isakhiwo esifana ne-umbrella - kuvimbela imvula ngaphambi kokufika emhlabathini. Ama-particles emvula ewela ezitshalo naseqabungeni alahlekelwa amandla akhe okudala ubungozi emhlabathini ngoba lawa ma-particles aphinde ahlukaniswe futhi awanawo amandla okusabalalisa umhlabathi, amanzi ahamba ngezitshalo naseqabungeni kuze kube ukufika kancane emhlabathini. Ukugcina umhlabathi ngezitshalo kusebenza kangcono nge-cover ye-vegetative edala i-umbrella. Ukugcina kubamba ama-particles eduze nomhlabathi, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa amandla ama-particles ahamba phambili. Ngisho nasezindaweni lapho ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo kubamba zonke izindawo, ezinye izakhiwo zezitshalo ezidalayo i-umbrella zingasiza ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa komhlabathi. Ukugcina kwemvelo kungafaka izimpande zezingadi, amaqabunga, kanye nothuli olutholakala lapho kukhishwa khona ukhuni nezihlahla. Ekulimaleni, izinto ezisele emhlabeni ngemuva kokuvuna zisebenza kangcono. Umsebenzi wokuvimbela ukungcoliswa komhlabathi uxhumene ngqo nosayizi wokugcina umhlabathi. Singathi futhi okuphambene - ububanzi bokungcoliswa komhlabathi buhlobene nezindawo lapho umhlabathi ungagcinwa khona. Izinsalela ngemuva kokuvuna kufanele zishiywe emhlabathini - kodwa kungase kube nezizathu zokuzisusa, isibonelo: izifo ezingenzeka ezitshalo, i-nitrogen emhlabathini ingancipha ngenxa yokubola kwezinsalela zezithombo, kungase kudingeke ukuthi kuhlwanyelwe ngokushesha noma kungase kudingeke ukuthi kubulawwe izihlahla, njll. Ngakho-ke kukhona umkhuba ojwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika wokusebenzisa izinsalela ukuze kukhuliswe izinkomo nezinkunzi. Uma sicabanga ngezindlela zokulima, kukhona imishini esingayisebenzisa ukuze silime ngaphandle kokulimaza ukugcina umhlabathi. Uma sibhakabhaka emigqeni, ukulima nokuhlanza kungase kwenzeke kuphela emigqeni, futhi izindawo phakathi kwemigqeni zingashiywa zigcinwe. Izihlahla zingalawulwa ngamakhemikhali.
Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-526E kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMali eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lembuso noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thola isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Uma kukhulunywa ngomuntu onengxenye ezimfihlo ezishintshile ngenxa yokuhlinzwa noma ukwelashwa ngama-hormone, bangathumela imibiko echaza uhlobo nemiphumela yokuhlinzwa okwenziwayo noma ukwelashwa okusetshenzisiwe noma okukhishwe odokotela abenzele le nqubo noma abaphatha lelo threatment. Uma kukhulunywa ngomuntu, hlinzeka ngembiko echaza ubulili bamanje bomuntu, ukuze kusekelwe isicelo. Le mibiko kumele yenziwe udokotela ophumelele ukuhlola ummangali ukuze aqinisekise ubulili abakhombisa. Thola umbiko owakhishwa udokotela wezingqondo owanikeze iseluleko ummangali, unikeza imininingwane ephelele ngalesi simo, ikakhulukazi umlando waso, kanye nesimo umuntu abukeka esikuso mayelana nemizwa nemicabango yabo mayelana nokuguquka kwabo. Uma ummangali uneminyaka engu-16 noma ngaphezulu, kufanele kwenziwe isicelo esihlukile sokunye idokhumenti yokuhlonza. Kufanele kuthathwe izithombe zezingalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngokomthetho, kanye nokuvuselela ulwazi kwi-database ye-HANIS. Le sevisi ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-8. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezempilo eliseduzane.
Ukwakhiwa kweMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo; ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kubantu abathile abangenamsebenzi kulolu Fund, nokukhokhela labo abasebenzi abagulayo, abakhulelwe, noma abanezingane, noma labo ababe sebenza ngaphambili uma sebedinga; ukuhlela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo, imisebenzi yale Bhodi kanye nokungethula komphakathi weMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo; nokuhlela ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umbiko womphakathi, ukudluliswa kwamandla okuzonikezwa, amandla, nemisebenzi. Umphakathi angase abheke ukuthi umuntu ubeyisithunywa kuMali. Izingane zisho umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye esigabeni 30 ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 futhi kufaka phakathi umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-25 ongumfundi futhi ohlangene nazo zonke izidingo zezezimali zomuntu obekade esebenza. Umuntu osebenza emndenini njengomshayeli; nomuntu onakekela noma ubani kulelo khaya; kodwa akuhlanganisi umsebenzi wezolimo. Inhloso yale Mthetho ukuhlinzeka ngeMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo lapho izithunywa zizokwenziwa ngabapheki nabasebenzi ukuze uma abanye abasebenzi bephuma emsebenzini noma labo abaxhasayo, bakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ukuze banciphise imiphumela yezezimali nezenhlalo yokungasebenzi kwabantu. Abantu abafika eRiphabhulikhi ngenhloso yokwenza isivumelwano esithile, nalabo abasafunda ukuze basebenze, befunda lapha eRiphabhulikhi uma ekupheleni kwalolo sivumelwano umqashi ebophekile ngokomthetho noma ngokwenkonzo ukubuyisela lowo muntu ezweni lakhe, noma lowo muntu kufanele ahambe eRiphabhulikhi, kanye nabapheki babo. Ngaphandle kwesigaba 1, lo Mthetho ubeka emsebenzini kubasebenzi bendlu, abasebenzi besizini, nabapheki babo isikhathi esingama-12 ezinyangeni kusukela ekuqaleni kwalolu Mthetho. Umphathiswa kufanele, ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi lo Mthetho uqale ukusebenza, akhethe noma abeke umphakathi ukuze ahlole futhi enze izincomo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwalolu mthetho kubasebenzi bendlu nalabo abasebenza ngesizini. Umphathiswa kufanele axoxe neBhodi mayelana nemiphumela yokuhlola. Noma yiziphi izimali ezisele kulolu Fund kusukela ekusatshalalisweni komhlaba noma noma yiziphi izipho ezenziwe kuMali noma ezinye izimali ezingatholakala kulolu Fund. Ukukhokha - kwemiholo nezinsizakalo zamalungu eBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo kanye nekomidi yayo; nezinye izindleko ezingase zenzeke ngokuhambisana nokusebenza kwalolu Mthetho. Noma yimuphi umuntu, isikhungo, inkampani, noma isikhungo sezezimali singanikeza kulolu Fund noma sinikeze kulolu Fund njengomhlaba. Umqondisi-Jikelele angamukela izimali noma umhlaba owenziwe kuMali esikhundleni seMali. Ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezimbili ngemva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, umphakathi kufanele ahlole isimo sezezimali sonke seMali salo nyaka wezezimali bese ekhishwa umbiko wesimo sezezimali kumqondisi-jikelele. Noma yiziphi izinguquko ekusetshenzisweni kwesizathu nezindlela zokukala umbiko wezezimali wonyaka odlule; kanye nezici ezithile noma izithiyo umqondisi-jikelele angase abe nazo ngokusebenzisa umphakathi noma ezisetshenziswa umphakathi ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba sombiko ukuze kuvele izinkinga ezibalulekile ukuze kutholwe umbono oqotho wesimo sezezimali seMali. Izincomo mayelana nokugcina noma ukuthuthukisa impilo yezezimali yeMali. Uma inani elidingekayo ukukhokha izinzuzo likhulu noma lincane kunalokho okudingekayo ukukhokhela izinzuzo ezilindelekile. Noma yiziphi izimali ezibuyisiwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 588; kanye nanoma yiziphi izindaba ezinqunywe umphathiswa. Futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo; nokulandela inqubo echazwe esigabeni 55 nganoma yiziphi izinguquko uma kudingeka. Uma imiholo yehliswa kakhulu ngesikhathi esithile, ukubalwa kufanele kusekelwe enanini ejwayelekile yalowo msebenzi owathumele kuMali. Usuku lapho umsebenzi owathumele kuMali waqala khona kuze kube usuku lapho lowo msebenzi uphelile; nanoma yisiphi isikhathi - umsebenzi wakhokhelwa umholo esikhundleni sokwaziswa. Izinsuku lapho umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele athole izinzuzo njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 3 ngeke zinciphise ukukhokhwa kwezinzuzo zokukhulelwa ngokuhambisana nengxenye D yale sahluko. Isinyathelo 3 - susa kulolu nani izinsuku lapho izinzuzo zitholakele (ukuhlukanisa izinzuzo zokukhulelwa) eminyakeni emine elandela usuku lokufaka isicelo sezinsiza ngokuhambisana nalesi sahluko. Isinyathelo 4 - Inani elisele yilo elinikeza izinsuku zokuthola izinzuzo umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele athole. Uhluleka ukuhlangabezana nezimo zalo Mthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophathelene nokungasebenzi; noma ubephula imithetho yokuthola izinzuzo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 361. Ngalesi sikhathi, isikhathi sokungasebenzi kufanele sibilwe kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, noma usuku lokugcina lokusebenza. Usuku okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 1 lungandiswanga lube usuku ngaphambi kosuku lokufaka isicelo uma umphakathi ophatha izicelo ekholwa ukuthi isizathu sokulibaziseka kokufaka isicelo sasinjengokungaphatheki kahle komuntu owathumele kuMali. Umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele abhalise njengomfuna umsebenzi nezinsizakalo zokusebenza ezakhiwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998 uMthetho No. 97 ka-1998; futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 3, umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele ulungele futhi akwazi ukusebenza. Umuntu owathumele kuMali uhluleka ukuveza phakathi kwezinsuku nezikhathi ezibekwe umphakathi ophatha izicelo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 174d; noma umuntu owathumele kuMali uphika noma uphika ukuqeqeshwa noma ukwelashwa ngezizathu ezithathwa njengezingafanele ngaphansi kwanoma yisiphi uhlelo olwamukelwe umqondisi-jikelele ngokuhambisana nalolu Mthetho noma yimuphi omunye Umthetho. Ngaphezu kwesigaba 1d futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 201a, umuntu owathumele kuMali ophazamisekile yisifo esithole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi uzophinde athole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi isikhathi eside umphakathi ophatha izicelo ekholwa ukuthi lesi sifo ngeke sithinte amathuba alowo muntu owathumele kuMali ukuthola umsebenzi. Isicelo sezinsizakalo zokungasebenzi kufanele senziwe ngokugcwalisa ifomu elakhiwe ngenhloso. Isicelo kufanele senziwe phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, kodwa umphakathi angase wamukele izicelo ezithunyelwe ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi uma kukhona izizathu ezisemthethweni. Umphakathi ophatha izicelo kufanele ahlole isicelo uma kudingeka futhi angacela olunye ulwazi mayelana nokuqhubeka kokungasebenzi komfaki-sicelo. Umqondisi-Jikelele kufanele akhokhele umuntu owathumele kuMali izinzuzo zokungasebenzi ehhovisi lokusebenza lapho isicelo sithunyelwe noma ehhovisi elinye elibekwe ngumfaki-sicelo ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Uma umfaki-sicelo ethola izinzuzo zokungasebenzi futhi ephika noma uphika ukuthola umsebenzi ofanele ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele noma uphika ukuq
Ama-Cryptocurrency Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba wezobuchwepheshe ubone izinguquko ezinkulu, futhi phakathi kwalezi zinguquko, ama-cryptocurrency akhombisa ukuvela okukhulu. Lezi zimali ezisemqoka, ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-blockchain, ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile emnothweni wezwe, zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphendule izindlela zabo zokuhweba, zokutshala, kanye nezimali. I-cryptocurrency, ngokuyisisekelo, iyimali edijithali engavunyelwe noma ilawulwa yizikhungo ezinkulu ezifana nezikhungo zezimali. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukugcina, nokuthumela imali ngaphandle kokudinga izinkampani eziphakathi. Uhlelo lwe-blockchain, olwakhiwe ngama-blocks ahlukanisiwe, lwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuqinisekisa ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, okwenza kube nokuphepha okukhulu. Umcimbi omkhulu, owawubanjelwe eGoli, ububukeleka njengomcimbi obalulekile emhlabeni we-cryptocurrency. Abantu abaningi, kuhlanganise nabathengisi, abathuthukisi, nabathandi bezezimali, bahlangana ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinguquko ezibalulekile. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo-mpikiswano ethokozisayo, lapho ochwepheshe bahlaziya izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ama-cryptocurrency. Uhlelo lwaluhlanganisa izifundo ezihlukahlukene, ezazihlanganisa izihloko ezifana ne-DeFi (Decentralized Finance), i-NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens), kanye nezindlela zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe. Abathandi be-cryptocurrency baphinde banikela ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye, bephakamisa imibono emisha yokuthuthukisa imakethe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwabathengisi nabathuthukisi, okwakha amathuba amasha okutshala izimali. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkampani ezihamba phambili emkhakheni, ezazikhombisa izixazululo ezintsha ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nethuba lokubona izinkampani ezithuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukugcina, nokuphatha ama-cryptocurrency, okwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela lezi zimali. Abathuthukisi baphinde baveza izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuphepha, ezizokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuvikela izimali zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle. Abantu baphinde baxoxa ngezindlela zokwenza ama-cryptocurrency abe yinsika ebalulekile emnothweni, nokuthi zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukuze zandise amathuba emisebenzi. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokubona izinkampani ezithuthukisa izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency. Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha Umbuzo 1: Ngabe kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi uKomidi lePhalamende uqale izingxoxo mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Ukuqonda ukuthi intsha ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile emsebenzini, uKomidi lePhalamende wenza ucwaningo olunzulu. Kubonakale ukuthi izinga lokungasebenzi kwentsha likhulu kakhulu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamasu aqinile ukuze kuthuthukiswe amathuba emisebenzi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimbangela eziyinhloko zokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Izimbangela zihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemfundo efanele, ukungabi nezinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingasebenzi kahle. Ngokwesibonelo, intsha iphinde ibhekane nezithiyo zokungena emisebenzini ethile ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuhlangenwe nakho. Umbuzo 3: UKomidi lePhalamende ubhekephi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga? Impendulo: UKomidi ugxile ekubambeni imihlangano nezikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Izinhloso zethu ukwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizophumelela. Umbuzo 4: Yimaphi amasu ahlongozwayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Amathuba okufunda nokusebenza kufanele avuleke kakhulu. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuthile, ukuvuleleka kwemisebenzi, nokukhuthaza ukuqashwa kwezinsizwa. UKomidi ubuye uphakamise ukwakha izinhlelo zokweseka abaqashi ukuze baqashe intsha. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe uKomidi lePhalamende linethemba lokuthi izinhlelo ezihlongozwayo zizoletha izinguquko? Impendulo: Yebo, sinezinga eliphezulu lokuthemba ukuthi izinhlelo ezihlongozwayo zizolethe izinguquko ezinhle. Njengoba sikhuluma, sithole ukwesekwa okuhle kwiPhalamende, futhi sithande ukubona impumelelo emiphakathini eminingi. Umbuzo 6: UKomidi uthola kanjani impendulo evela emphakathini? Impendulo: Sivula iziteshi zokuxhumana ezahlukahlukene, kubandakanya imihlangano, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezibalo ezithile. Lokhu kusivumela ukuba sithole imibono nemibuzo evela kubantu abasemakhaya, okubalulekile ekuqondeni izidingo zabo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izifundo ezithathwe kwezinye izizwe mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Sifunde kakhulu ezindaweni ezithile ezifana ne-Scandinavia, lapho izinhlelo zokusebenza zisebenza kahle. Izifundo ezitholwe zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nezimfuno zemakethe, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokusekela intsha ekufuneni imisebenzi. Umbuzo 8: UKomidi uhlela kanjani ukubona ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza? Impendulo: Sinomqondo wokubeka izinkomba zokusebenza, ezizokwenza sikwazi ukukala impumelelo. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuqashwa kwentsha, ukutholakala kwemisebenzi, kanye nemiphumela yokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo ezintsha. Umbuzo 9: Ukomidi lePhalamende luthini ngezinsiza ezikhona zokuxhasa intsha? Impendulo: Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezikhona, kodwa zidinga ukuphuculwa. UKomidi ubona ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo azihambisani nezidingo zentsha, ngakho-ke kudingeka kube nokwenza izinguquko ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise lezi zinsiza. Umbuzo 10: Yini eyenza uKomidi lePhalamende uqhubeke nokusebenza, noma kunzima? Impendulo: Uthando lokuthuthukisa ikusasa lentsha lwenza sibe namandla. Siyathemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukuletha izinguquko ezithile, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi intsha iyigugu elikhulu elizokwenza umehluko. Uthando lokubona intsha iphumelela luyisiqhamo sokuqhubeka. Umbuzo 11: UKomidi unezinhlelo zokusebenza ezizayo kulolu daba? Impendulo: Yebo, sihlela imihlangano eyengeziwe nezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze siqhubele phambili izingxoxo. Siphinde sicele ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze siqonde kahle izinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nentsha. Umbuzo 12: Ngabe kunendlela ethile yokuhlanganyela umphakathi kulokhu? Impendulo: Ngokuqinisekile. UKomidi ufuna ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba okuhlanganyela umphakathi, ukuze sithole imibono ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile ezizothuthukisa impilo yentsha. Umbuzo 13: Ngabe uKomidi ubona impumelelo kulolu hlelo? Impendulo: Sinethemba lokuthi kuletha impumelelo, kodwa kumele sibe nomsebenzi onzima. Impumelelo izodinga ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo ethe xaxa phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Umbuzo 14: Yiziphi izinqumo ezivelayo ezithathwa uKomidi? Impendulo: Siphakamisa izinqumo ezihambisana nokwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezinzima zokuxhasa intsha, ezihlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza zokuxhasa emsebenzini, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 15: UKomidi uqhubeka kanjani nokudla izikhumbuzo zokungasebenzi kwentsha? Impendulo: Sihlala sikhumbula ukuthi impilo yentsha ibalulekile. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza ukuthi sizame ukuhlinzeka ngamasu ahlukene, ahlose ukusheshisa izinqubo zokuxhasa nokuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha inezinketho ezanele. Inhloso enkulu yalesi sikhumbuzo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke intsha inethuba lokusebenza, ukuze ikwazi ukuhamba phambili empilweni. UKomidi lePhalamende uzobamba imihlangano eqhubekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza. Isiphetho: UKomidi lePhalamende uzimisele ukugxila ezinkingeni ezibhekene nentsha, futhi uzosebenza ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza ukuze intsha ithole amathuba angcono.
Ukusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abafuna ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezahlukene ezihlinzekwa yiHhovisi lezeMisebenzi, iZwe, kanye neMiphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngenkonzo yokusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zombuso, kuphinde kube yindlela yokuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni. Ukusebenza kahle kwalolu hlelo kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezindlela ezitholakalayo, izinzuzo, kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Izinsizakalo Ezitholakalayo Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo ze-ID, izicelo zokuhlala, kanye nezicelo zezimali. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthi bafake izicelo zabo ngaphandle kokuhamba emaphandleni, okwandisa ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Uhlelo lusebenza ngohlelo oluhlelwe kahle, oluhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi izicelo zingafakwa kanjani, izidingo ezidingekayo, kanye nezikhathi zokuphendula. Izinyathelo Zokusebenza Ukuze uqale ukusebenza ngohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online, umsebenzisi kufanele avakashele iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-Home Affairs. Ngemuva kwalokho, umsebenzisi kufanele abhalise, uma engakabhalisile, bese eqhubeka nokufaka isicelo. Iwebhusayithi inikeza iziqondiso ezicacile nezinyathelo ezilandelwayo, ezisiza umsebenzisi ukuba aqonde kahle inqubo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinyathelo ezilandelayo zidinga ukufakwa kwemininingwane ethile, njengegama, idatha yokuxhumana, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokuhlonza. Izinzuzo Zohlelo Lokusebenza Online Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online lunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, lwenza kube lula kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, okunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda. Okwesibili, luhlinzeka ngenkonzo esheshayo, njengoba izicelo zingabhekwa futhi ziphendulwe ngokushesha. Lokhu kwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu, njengoba kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zendabuko, ezifana nezikhala ezinkulu zokulinda emaphandleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lwe-online luhlinzeka ngokuqina kokuphepha, njengoba imininingwane yomsebenzisi igcinwa ngokuphephile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinsizakalo zidinga ukuvikela imininingwane yomuntu siqu. Izindlela zokuphepha ezifana nezokufihla imininingwane kanye nezokuphepha kwe-inthanethi ziqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane ibhekwa kuphela ngababhaliswe ngokusemthethweni. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nohlelo Noma kunjalo, uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online lunezinkinga ezithile. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga zokufinyelela ezilindelekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba aphansi okuxhumana ne-inthanethi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwe-inthanethi ezindaweni ezikude. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokusebenza kahle kohlelo. Abanye abasebenzisi baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi izicelo zabo aziphenduli kahle, noma ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula sithatha isikhathi eside. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlola okuqhubekayo kohlelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zisebenza kahle, futhi ukuthi abasebenzisi bathola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke, uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngenkonzo ebalulekile kubantu abafuna ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Izinzuzo eziningi zikhona, kodwa izinkinga ezithile zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lusebenza kahle. Ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo, kanye nokwandiswa kokufinyelela kwe-inthanethi, kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezihlinzekwa yiHhovisi lezeMisebenzi, iZwe, kanye neMiphakathi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, kanye nohlanganyela.
UDesmond Tutu Nomsebenzi Wakhe Emphakathini wethu, kade sikhula sikhumbula abantu abanephupho, abahlala benza umehluko. Omunye wabo nguDesmond Tutu, umfundisi, umholi, nomlondi wezokuthula. UDesmond Tutu wazalwa ngomhla zingu-7 kuNhlaba ngonyaka we-1931 eKlerksdorp, eNingizimu Afrika. Kwakuwumhlaba ogcwele izinselelo, lapho ubandlululo belubuswa khona. UDesmond, owayengumfana ophumelelayo, watshala izimpande zempilo yakhe emfundisweni yenkolo. Wafunda eTshwane naseCape Town, lapho athola khona iziqu zakhe zefilosofi. Ubuye wathola iziqu zokuba umfundisi, wabe esebenza njengomfundisi eGroot Schuur. Lapha, waqala ukubona ubuhlungu bebandlululo, okwakuphikisana nemfundiso yeNkosi. Ngesikhathi sokubandlululwa, uDesmond Tutu waba yisithonjana sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Wavuma ukuba yisikhumbuzo sezenzo ezinhle, waphikisa ubandlululo ngezwi lakhe eliqinile nelikhanyayo. Wayesebenzisa umthandazo, kodwa futhi waqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi badinga ukulwa ukuze bathole amalungelo abo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwezombusazwe, i-ANC, lwamkhumbula, futhi waba ngumsizi walo ohamba phambili. Ngemva kokuphumelela kokhetho lokuqala olukhululekile eNingizimu Afrika, uDesmond Tutu waba nguMkhulumeli Wezokuthula. Wazama ukusiza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhloniphana, behlanganyela ukuze bakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ohlelweni lwe-Truth and Reconciliation Commission, olwakhelwe ukuvuselela ubumbano phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Kwakuyinqubo enzima, kodwa uDesmond wakha izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezaziphila ngaphakathi kwempilo yakhe. UDesmond akazange agxile kuphela ezinkambisweni zepolitiki. Wayefundisa ukuthi uthando luyinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Wafundisa ukuthi, noma ngabe izinkinga zikhona, kufanele sihloniphe omunye nomunye. Isikhumbuzo sakhe besikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke siphathe abanye ngezandla zethu. Eminyakeni yakhe yokugcina, uDesmond Tutu wathola izindondo eziningi, wahlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele. Abantu bahlonipha umqondo wakhe wokuthula, futhi izwi lakhe labanjwa njengomthombo wombono. Wafundisa ukuthi, noma izikhathi ziba nzima, kufanele sibe nethemba. UDesmond waba isibonelo esihle sothando lokufundisa, lokuphila, nolwazi. Noma sekuphele iminyaka eminingi, umbono nempilo kaDesmond Tutu udlula emijikelezweni, ubalulekile kuzo zonke izizukulwane. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sothando olusebenza, nokuthi sizokwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga uma sisebenzisana. Kwakungelula, kodwa wayengavumeli ukwehla komoya. UDesmond Tutu waphila impilo egcwele umoya wokuthula, emisha, nokwakha. Umsebenzi wakhe usaqhubeka, njengoba umhlaba uhlala ufunda kulokho akufundisile. Njengoba sigubha iminyaka eminingi, sikhumbula uDesmond Tutu njengomholi ophumelelayo, umthandi wezokuthula, nomphakathi ophilayo. Umsebenzi wakhe usale uthinta imiphefumulo, uyilungelo lokuphila okungcono kubo bonke abantu. Ngakho, nakhu, uDesmond Tutu akazange abe nje umholi, kodwa waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi uthando luhlala lusemthethweni. Uthando lukhona ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi umphakathi uphumelela uma wonke umuntu esebenzisana. UDesmond Tutu waba yinkanyezi, futhi izinkanyezi zihlala zikhanya, zikhumbuza umhlaba ukuthi uthando lungaphezu kwakho konke.
Ibhokisi Endleleni yezimpilo zabantu, kunendlela ebizwa ngokuthi ibhokisi, eyejabulisa, igcwele umdlandla nezinselele. Le ndaba ibhalwe ngaphezulu kwamaqondo, isibani esikhanyayo sezinselelo, imisebenzi eyakha izimpilo. Ngale ndlela, siphinde sithole ukuthi ibhokisi akusona nje umdlalo, kodwa isithombe sokuphila komuntu. UThulani wayengumfana ophuma emndenini ohluphekayo eNingizimu Afrika. Ubutfo bukaThulani buyingxenye yeqhawe labo abaphila ngaphandle kwemisebenzi. Ukuze athole imali yokuphila, wathola ithuba lokufunda ibhokisi emzaneni. Kwakuyinsiza emnandi, kodwa futhi ibiyinselele. UThulani wathola uthisha one'sithakazelo sokufundisa, uMnumzane Nkosi, owabona ukuthi uThulani unezikhono ezikhethekile. Njengoba uThulani eqhubeka nokufunda, waqala ukuba namava amnandi. Ibhokisi lwalungaphezu kokubhaliswa phansi kwezinyathelo, kodwa yindlela yokukhuluma, yokuziphatha nokubambisana. Ubona uqobo izinzwa zakho, uncisha imizwa, ube noqhugo olungapheli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwaba nesikhathi sokuzilungiselela, waphinde wahamba emijukujukwini yamaqumu. Ubuye abone amanye abaqeqeshi nabanye abadlali bebhokisi, bejabulisa nabangama-pugilists abahamba phambili. UThulani wayebona njengoba bebhakabhaka phakathi kwemigqa yezigcawu, bejolela, bejula, beshayisana, bezithokozisa. Uthandweni lwabantu ngokuphelele, kwaba yinto engalindelekile kudala, hobha ehlonishwayo. Kwathi ngesikhathi esisodwa, kwaba usuku lokuqala lokuncintisana. UThulani ubeyisinyathelo esimangalisayo, ezwa ukucasulwa nezithokoziso phakathi kwabadlali. Ujubane lwalungepqile; ubunjalo obungaphezu kokufanele. Akukhona kuphela ukuphupha, kodwa ukufuna ukuziveza, ukuzokwazisa. Emcimbini, uThulani wathola imphumo engeke ibhujiswe. Waqala ukwenyuka, wakhumbula imizamo yokuqeqesha, abanye abakhe abalethe umphefumulo, nemicabango ebhulungela impumelelo. Waqala ukusondela phezulu, wahamba ngebhodi, yebhaka. Umphakathi waba khona, wanqamula iziphakamiso zakhe, waqhubeka phambili. Kodwa wambuza kwazulu - kwakungathandeki neze. Umphakathi waba konke, uqonda ukuthi ngubani ozobona impumelelo. UThulani, ngeziphakamiso zobuchwepheshe, wabambelela. UJohannes, eneminyaka emine ubudala, ungumngani wakhe, wayekhanyisile, wafika eduze, ehlola indlela ngaphandle kokuba noshintsho. Ngenxa yalokhu, uThulani wathola ukufaneleka kumphakathi, wafuna ukusebenzisa izinsiza nezinsuku ezinkulu zeqhubeka phambili. Waqala ukubonisa unyazi, ubuso bakhe bufana ngebhodi elikhulu kwiHholo yamaPugilists. Yayikhanya, igqokiswa kanjani. Wazama, waphindela ngemuva kwezinsuku ezinzima, futhi impumelelo yakhanya kahle. Ngemva kokuphela kweqhaza, wathola umklomelo owawukhombisa wonke umsebenzi wakhe. UThulani wayevuya, enelisiwe kwaze kwaba yisikhathi sokuhamba emzini. Umoya wakhe wawwenza ukuba azimisele. Waqhubeka nohambo, ethinteka kakhulu, ebona ukuthi ibhokisi aliyona nje imidlalo; yindlela yokuphila, yokuvuma, yokukhula, yokuphumelela. Jikelele, le ndaba ibonisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukufezekisa amaphupho. Ibhokisi liyindawo yokuhlola, yokuphula imingcele, ukuphumula phansi, nezinselelo. UThulani udale umhlaba omusha, kanye nezinto ezithinta abanye. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ngesikhathi sokusebenza, singakhonjwa ukuphila kwethu, libuya lokho okudingekayo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sifunda, sithuthukise izimpilo, sikhokhele abanye ebhokisini lempumelelo. Ibhokisi alisona nje isikhumbuzo, kodwa indlela yokuzwakalisa ubuhlakani bethu. Futhi, njengokufika kwezinkanyezi, impilo isiveza kahle, iyazithokozisa kubo bonke abashumayelayo.
Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng Kwathi ngelinye ilanga eGauteng, lapho umoya ubhujiswa khona ngothando lwezithuthi nempilo, kwavuka isimo esibuhlungu. UThando, owayekhululekile emsebenzini, wathola ucingo oluphoqayo. Umngani wakhe, uSipho, wayephuthumile, ekhombisa uphethiloli ezingalweni. Uthando waphuthuma, wabiza i-ambulensi, echasisa isimo sikaSipho. “Ngidinga usizo, umngani wami ucindezelekile,” kusho uThando, ecashile. Kodwa kwaba yisikhathi esengeziwe asindayo. Kwaphela imizuzu eyishumi, futhi i-ambulensi yabe isakufa. Noma kunjalo, umoya wokubamba ithemba wawusemoyeni, ungakufuna noma isimo sikaSipho sishintsha. I-ambulensi yaze yafika, abantu bezobona okubuhlungu bezama ukuthola ukuzola. Umqhubi, uMusa, wenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokuzikhandla. “Siyavuma, sithumele ezigulini,” usho njalo. Wenza kahle ukuhlonipha izinqubo, kodwa emakhosini eyazo, izikhathi zokuphendula zinokuhluka. Ngenxa yobuqhophololo, le nkinga ibonisa ubunzima. Noma i-ambulensi ithola ukufinyelela kalula ezindaweni ezithile, ezinye izindawo zokuhlala zicindezelwe, zifuna ukuxazululwa. Kwakukhona abanye abagibeli abavetshwe ezitaladini ezikhawulelwe, phakathi kwemigwaqo elahlekileyo. UMusa, nozakwethu, bazama ngakho konke okusemandleni ukuphendula, kodwa izinsuku ziwukujeza. Okwenzeka eGauteng kwavame ukulandelwa. Izimo zokuphendula zishintsha ngempela, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziyinkimbinkimbi. Nakuba i-ambulensi ibhoda impi, kwavuleka ithuba lokukhuluma ngezikhathi ezibuhlungu. Abalamuli bezinsiza bazi kahle ukuthi izinsuku zezemidlalo zingahluka, kodwa umphakathi ufisa ukuqonda ukuthi kungani isikhathi sokuphendula singasho lutho. U-Phumla, osebenza njengomphenyi wezokwelapha, wathola ukuthokozisa ngoMsombuluko. Ubuza: “Kungani kufanele kulindwe izinsuku lapho siyobona ukuphendula ngokushesha? Mhlawumbe umphakathi kumele uqonde ukuthi i-ambulensi idinga ukusekelwa.” Njengoba iqembu le-ambulensi, lilwa nokunqoba izithiyo zabo, zindlala ngobuhlungu, izimo ziphindaphindwa. Bobabili uThando noSipho bazi ukuthi akukhona kuphela isiphetho sabo, kodwa konke kwenzeka emhlabeni owaziwa ngezimanga. Uthando ubevele election isikhalazo, “Abaningi bethu balinda isikhathi eside, futhi lokho akukuhle.” Uhlanga lwesithombe lwalulinganiselwa emqondweni. Uthando, uSipho noMusa babephakathi kwepuzzle elingapheli. Phela, izinsuku zokuphendula zaba yindida. Futhi, uma kuxoxwa, izinkanyezi zithembele ezindalweni ezinjengezinsuku, phakathi kwebhodi, zikhona izinkanyezi zomphakathi. Uthando, efuna ukusebenzisa isimo, wanxusa: “Mhlawumbe singasiza ukuhlola izikhalazo zempilo, uma sizoba nabantu abavumelanayo.” Kusuka kulokhu, nezinhlaka zomphakathi zaphenya, zaba nezikhumbuzo. Isikhathi sikaSipho sidlule, futhi uMusa, ongamukeli lokho ngokuphelele. Uthando, uqonda kahle umuzwa, waphindisela, “Mhlawumbe izikhathi zokuphendula akuhluki, kodwa umphakathi uthanda ukufundisa izifundo.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zifundo zaba zintsha, zazama ukuqedwa phakathi ukukhuluma kwegatsha. Uthando, noSipho, ugibeli omuhle benza isiqiniseko sokuthi ukuphila kwezinye kwaba yisikhumbuzo esibalulekile. Uhlaba umxhwele uMusa kanye nemizamo ye-ambulensi. Ngokuhamba kwemizuzu, imikhiqizo ye-ambulensi ibonakale iyavuma. Umphakathi uthembisa ukwakha, ukuze siqhubeke. Ngale ndlela, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zezigiwa, kodwa uthando nemvelo yayihamba phambili. Isiphetho UThando noSipho babona ukuthi ngaphezu kwendlela, umphakathi udinga ukuhamba ubonisise, ukuze sithole isixazululo ngemikhankaso ethile. Umuzwa weziphumo ubonakale, uyiye umlilo futhi uqhubeke, udlula ezinsukwini zaphezulu. I-ambulensi iyakhonza, isiphetho sokuqonda sizosiza ukukhiqiza izinsizakalo eziphakeme eGauteng.
Uhulumeni uqale uhlelo lokwabiwa kwezinsiza zokudla ezindlini ezihluphekayo. Malini okukhishwayo uhulumeni kulolu hlelo lokudla? Kukhona imali eyabelwe u-R230 million kulo nyaka ukuze kusizakale imindeni engama-200,000 ebhekene nezinkinga zokuphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka ezinzima. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imindeni enezingane. Okwamanje, kunezimuli eziyi-12,000 ezithola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Imindeni eminingi izothola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo oluzoqala ngoMashi 2003. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ingathola ukudla okunempilo okugcwele ama-vithamini nezinto ezidingekayo (ukuphuculwa kokudla). Iminyango yezeMidlalo, Ezolimo, Ezempilo, Imfundo, uHulumeni Wezokuxhumana nolwazi (GCIS), iNational Development Agency, kanye ne-Independent Development Trust baphathe izivumelwano nezinhlelo zokukhulekela, amaqembu ezabasebenzi, umkhakha wezebhizinisi, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imindeni ehluphekayo inakho ukudla. Ndawonye - Masizibophele ekudleni!
Le bhukwana lenzelwe njengesiqondiso sokuthi amalunga omphakathi angafinyelela kanjani ulwazi olugcinwe yi-GCIS. Ichaza ukuthi yisiphi ulwazi olukhona kule ndawo futhi ikutshela ukuthi ungafinyelela kanjani kulolo lwazi. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi, 2000, uthi yonke inhlangano kumele ibize uMphakathi Wokwazi nolwazi kanye noMphakathi Wokwazi ozokwenza izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi futhi asize abaceli ekufakeni izicelo zabo. Umbono we-GCIS usiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuxhumana nolwazi lukamasipala nomphakathi, uqinisekisa ukuphila okungcono kubantu bonke. Inhloso ye-GCIS ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa ekuxhumaneni kukamasipala futhi iqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uyazi ngokuqhuba kwalolu phiko. Inhloso yesu ye-GCIS ukuqinisa uhlelo lokuxhumana kukamasipala nemisebenzi yalo ngezindlela ezithuthukisa ukuhlanganiswa okuqhubekayo kokuphathwa kwethu ngokwenkolo futhi ibeke izwe endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa okuphezulu. Ukwakha isakhiwo sokuxhumana ngokubambisana okukhombisa ulwazi olunombono ophelele mayelana nezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa jikelele. Ukuxhumana kukamasipala nobudlelwano bezindaba kukhuthaza (G&ML) ukuxhumana nokuxhumana kokuxhumana kukamasipala kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi kuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zobungcweti ekubambeni izindaba. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi iminyango, amaqoqo, nezifunda zithuthukisa amasu azo okuxhumana ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuxhumana sikazwelonke, ngenkathi izindaba zendawo nezamazwe omhlaba zithola ulwazi lukamasipala ngendlela efanele. I-P&LL isekela ukuhlinzekwa kokuxhumana kokuthuthukiswa futhi yandisa izakhiwo zolwazi lukamasipala ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nezendawo. Iphinde isize ekwakheni Izikhungo Zesevisi ze-Thusong ukuze izinsizakalo nolwazi kube lula ukufinyelela umphakathi, ikakhulukazi abampofu. I-CSA ihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuxhumana ezibalulekile ku-GCIS nakwamanye amaminya kahulumeni, kokubili ngaphakathi nangokucela izinkampani zangaphandle ukuba zenze umsebenzi. Ikhiqiza futhi isabalalise ulwazi isebenzisa amapulatifomu nezindlela ezifanele ukuze ifinyelele umphakathi okukhuluma nawo. Inezindawo ezintathu ze-Directorate: Ukuthuthukiswa KweMikhiqizo; Ukuthuthukiswa Kokuqukethwe; kanye Nezokukhangisa, Ukukhangisa, kanye Nokwabiwa. Vuk'uzenzele igxile ekukhiqizeni iphephandaba likamasipala elikhululekile elikhombisa amathuba ezomnotho nezinye ezidalwe nguhulumeni wethu wenkolo nokuthi lezi zinsiza kufanele zifinyelelwe kanjani. I-Information and Technology Management ibhekana nokusetshenziswa kolwazi nobuchwepheshe njengokubaluleka kwezidingo zestrateji ekusebenzeni kwe-GCIS nasemisebenzini yayo. Le ngxenye inezinhlelo ezincane ezilandelayo: Ukusekela Inethiwekhi neSiphakeli, Ukusekela Kwendawo kanye Nokuqeqeshwa, Ukuthuthukiswa Kwephrojekthi, kanye Nezidingo Zolwazi Olwakhiwe. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, Ukuphathwa Kwezimpahla, kanye Nokusekela kudlula ekuphathweni kwezimali okujwayelekile ku-GCIS futhi kugadwe ukuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999). I-Directorate inezinhlelo ezincane ezilandelayo: Izinsizakalo Zokusekela, Ukuphathwa Kwezimpahla, Ihhovisi Lezabelomali, kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezimali. Abaphenyi Bangaphakathi basiza i-GCIS ukufinyelela imigomo yayo ngensizakalo ehlelekile nencontrolled yokuhlola nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokuphathwa kwezingozi, ukulawula, nezinqubo zokuphatha. I-Project Desk ihlanganisa ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi ngochwepheshe futhi ixhuma izixazululo ukusiza i-GCIS ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuxhumana nolwazi lukamasipala nomphakathi, iqinisekisa ukuphila okungcono kubantu bonke. I-SAHR (ebizwa lapha ngokuthi 'ikhomishini') ngaphansi kweSigaba 10 se-PAIA, 2000, izohlanganisa umbiko mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwalolu mthetho. Lo mbiko uzotholakala kukhomishini. I-Directory Yabantu, I-Directory Yezindaba, kanye Nezithombe zingezinye zezinhlu zokuxhumana zabasebenzi bokuxhumana kukamasipala. Uhlelo lokufunda, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha emsebenzini, kanye nemibhalo yokuqeqesha ifaka phakathi izivumelwano nemibhalo yezomthetho. Amaphephandaba, imizuzu yemihlangano, amasu okuxhumana, amasu ezindaba, imibhalo yokuqondisa yokuxhumana, izindatshana zezindaba, amarekhodi, nezitatimende, kanye noluhlu lwamagama ezindaba kanye nemibhalo yokuqondisa yokuxhumana. Amasu e-Thusong Service Centre, Amasu Okuxhumana Okuthuthukiswa nezinsiza, izinsiza zokukhangisa nezokumaketha, imibiko, nemizuzu yemihlangano. Iziphakamiso, ukukhangisa, nezinhlelo zokudlulisa, amasheya okuthengisa nezokwabiwa, izaziso zokuthenga ezindabeni, imibiko, izithombe, nezithombe zevidiyo, iSouth Africa Yearbook, neSouth Africa Small Book, imizuzu yemihlangano, nezikhadi zendawo zokuzwa, zevidiyo, nezokukhumbula. Ulwazi olukhona kuwebhusayithi ye-GCIS, ulwazi olukhona kuwebhusayithi ye-Government Communication, ulwazi olukhona kuwebhusayithi ye-Government Services, izinqubomgomo nemibhalo yokuqondisa, amabhrosha, ukuxhumana ngezimemo nezikhasimende zangaphakathi nangaphandle, imizuzu yemihlangano, kanye nemibiko. Amabhrosha, imizuzu yemihlangano, imibiko, izikhadi zokukhangisa, kanye nezindawo zokwabiwa. Imibiko, imizuzu yemihlangano. Umceli kumele akhombise ukuthi ufuna ikhophi yerekodi noma ufuna ukuza ku-GCIS ukuyibona emahhovisi e-GCIS. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma irekodi ingeyona imibhalo, ingabukwa ngendlela eceliwe, lapho kungenzeka. C. Uma umceli ecela ukufinyelela ngendlela ethile (isb., ikhophi ephepheni, ikhophi ye-elektroniki, njll.), kumele ihlinzekwe ngaleyo ndlela. Lokhu kungafezeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka okungafanele ekusebenzeni kwenhlangano kahulumeni ethile, noma kubangele umonakalo kurekodi, noma kuphula ilungelo lokushicilela elingelona lelikamasipala. Uma, ngezizathu zokusebenza, ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngendlela ehlukile, imali kumele ibalwe ngokuhambisana nezindlela umceli azicelile ekuqaleni. Uma, ngaphezu kokuphendula okubhaliwe kwesicelo sabo sokufinyelela, umceli efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela, isb., ngocingo, lokhu kumele kukhombiswe.
