Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha EziBhedlela Ukubeletha yisikhathi esibalulekile empilweni yomama nabantwana. Ukuze le nqubo ihambe kahle, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinqubo ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyilindele. Isinyathelo sokuqala: Ukuhlela Ukuvakashela Ngaphambi kokubeletha, kubalulekile ukuhlela ukuvakashela esibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nodokotela wakho noma umphakathi wezempilo ukuze uthole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi ubhaliswe esibhedlela esikhethwe, futhi uthole ulwazi olugcwele mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Uma usuku lokubeletha lufika, qiniseka ukuthi unazo zonke izinto ezidingekayo, njengemithi, amafomu, nezinto zokugqoka. Isinyathelo sesibili: Ukuze Ufinyelele Esibhedlela Uma usuku lokubeletha lufika, kufanele ube necebo lokuthi uzofinyelela kanjani esibhedlela. Ungacela usizo kumngane noma kumndeni, noma ungasebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuthutha ezitholakalayo. Qiniseka ukuthi ufika esibhedlela ngesikhathi ukuze ungabambezeli inqubo yokubeletha. Lapho ufika, uzokwamukelwa yizisebenzi zezempilo ezizokuhola endaweni yokubeletha. Isinyathelo sesithathu: Ukuhlolwa Kwesimo Sokubeletha Ngokufika esibhedlela, uzodlula ohlelweni lokuhlolwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola isimo sokubeletha, ukuze kudingeke ukuthi udokotela abone ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Uzobuzwa imibuzo mayelana nezimpawu zakho, kanye nezimo ezithile ezithinta impilo yakho. Lokhu kuhlola kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umama nomntwana baphila kahle. Isinyathelo sesine: Ukubeletha Uma konke kuhle, uzodlulela endaweni yokubeletha. Lapha, uzoba neziqu zokuqinisekisa ukuthi imizamo yakho yokubeletha iyahamba kahle. Izisebenzi zezempilo zizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze uqedele le nqubo ngendlela ephephile. Uzothola usizo kumadokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nabanye ochwepheshe. Bazosiza ekuphatheni izimo ezinzima, uma zikhona. Isinyathelo sesihlanu: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Kwezingane Ngemuva kokubeletha, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ingane iphephile. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zifaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwezingane, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhula kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuphefumula, izinga lokushisa, kanye neminye imisebenzi ebalulekile. Uma kudingeka, izinsizakalo zokwelashwa zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ingane ithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Isinyathelo sesixhenxe: Ukuhlolwa Kwamama Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama uzodinga ukuhlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uphila kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola isimo se-uterus, izinga lokuphiliswa, kanye neminye imisebenzi ebalulekile. Abahlengikazi bazokunikeza izeluleko zokunakekela impilo yakho, ukuze uqhubeke nokukhula kahle emzamweni wakho wokuba ngumama. Isinyathelo sesishiyagalombili: Ukuxhumana Nezisebenzi Zempilo Ngemuva kokubeletha, kubalulekile ukuthi uqhubeke uxhumana nezisebenzi zezempilo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutholeni izeluleko ezibalulekile zokunakekela ingane, kanye nokuphila kahle. Ungabuzwa noma yiziphi imibuzo onayo, futhi uzothola usizo uma kudingeka. Isinyathelo sesishiyagalolunye: Ukuphuma Esibhedlela Uma konke kuhamba kahle, uzokwazi ukuphuma esibhedlela. Lokhu kuzoba yisikhathi sokujabula, njengoba uzobe usuthole ingane yakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola yonke imininingwane edingekayo yokunakekela ingane, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo uma kudingeka. Izisebenzi zezempilo zizokunikeza imiyalelo yokuthi ungayithola kanjani imithwalo yokunakekela. Isinyathelo sokugcina: Ukubuyela Esibhedlela Uma Kudinga Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, ungabuyela esibhedlela. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona ukuze zikusize, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi wena nomntwana niphephile. Ungazizwa ungakhululekile uma kudingeka, futhi izisebenzi zezempilo zikhona ukuze zikusize. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathola ulwazi olufanele nolusizo oludingekayo ukuze kube nokubeletha okuphumelelayo. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umama nomntwana baphila kahle, futhi ziza nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze le nqubo ibe yimpumelelo. Ngakho-ke, qiniseka ukuthi uyaziqonda izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi uzilungiselele kahle ukuze uthole isipiliyoni esihle.
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo Isingeniso Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onolwazi nolwazi olufanele. Lezi zikhungo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibe khona, zisebenze kahle, futhi zifinyeleleke kalula kubantu bonke. Uhlaka lwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifaka phakathi izibhedlela, izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, nezikhungo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Lezi zikhungo zihlukaniswa ngokwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, izisebenzi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza. Izibhedlela, ngokwesibonelo, zinezinhlaka eziningi ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, ukwelashwa kwezifo ezinzima, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, ngakolunye uhlangothi, zifaka phakathi izikhungo ezincane ezihlinzeka ngempilo yokuvikela, izinsiza zokuhlola, kanye nemfundo yezempilo. Izizathu zokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Izizathu zokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziningi. Okokuqala, lezi zikhungo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu behluleka ukufinyelela ezibhedlela ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zenza kube nokwaziswa okukhona, okubalulekile ekwandiseni ulwazi lwabantu ngezempilo, izifo, nezindlela zokuvikela. Okwesibili, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zikhuthaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, nabantu. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa kwabantu, njengoba izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezindlela zokwelapha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kukhuthaza futhi ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlanganisa imikhakha ehlukene, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Izithiyo ekufakweni kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Noma kunjalo, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo akukhululekile ezitheni. Izithiyo eziningi zikhona, ezifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezisebenzi ezifanelekile. Izikhungo eziningi zikhathazekile ngokuqhubeka kokusebenza, ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali yokusebenza, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Lokhu kudala izinkinga zokufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwezisebenzi ezifanelekile kuyinkinga enkulu. Izikhungo eziningi zihlushwa ukuntuleka kwezisebenzi ezinemfundo efanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlale bengekho ezikhungweni zezempilo, okwandisa izinga lokungaphili kahle. Izixazululo zokuthuthukisa ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo Ukuze sithuthukise ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ezivela kuhulumeni, izikhungo zabantu, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imfundo nezifundo ezikhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izisebenzi zezempilo zihlala ziqeqeshiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola abantu abaqeqeshiwe abangaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bezithuthukisa, izikhungo zingase zisebenzise izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhethekile nezifundo ezithuthukisiwe. Isiphetho Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lezi zikhungo zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, zikhuthaza ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lufinyeleleka kalula. Nokho, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, ezifuna izixazululo ezithile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufakwa kwezikhungo. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali, ukuthuthukisa imfundo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezihlanganisa imikhakha ehlukene, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke. Ukukhuthaza ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, okuholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo.
Ngiyajabula ukukhuluma ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, elihlangene ukuze lenze iseshini yokugcina yePhalamende lethu lesithathu, eliphethwe ngumbono wabantu. Ngimi phambi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngenkonzo ngesikhathi lapho nginethuba lokuba ehhovisi eliphezulu kuleli, ngenxa yesimo esikhethekile esavela esinqumweni seqembu elibusayo sokukhipha uMongameli owayekhona ehhovisi. Umsebenzi wami ezinyangeni ezedlule kube ukuhola iNational Executive ekufezeni umyalo onikezwe iAfrican National Congress emavotelini ka-2004 nokulungiselela ukuvota okuzayo. Lokhu sikwenze ngempumelelo, siqinisekisile ukudlula okungafanele eminyakeni emihlanu edlule futhi siqhubeke nezinhlelo zikahulumeni, kubonga ukuvuthwa kwendlela yethu yokuphatha, ingxenye yayo ibonakala ekubambisaneni kwamalungu amasha namadala eNational Executive kanye nokwesekwa okuqinile kwababonisi bakahulumeni bethu. Ngokubheka emuva eminyakeni eyishumi nanhlanu edlule, ngifuna ukubonga ukuzinikela nomsebenzi onzima kaMongameli uNelson Mandela noThabo Mbeki, kanye nabesifazane nabantu abaningi ababe nomsebenzi wokuhola leli bhasi likahulumeni ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu: ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha, emthethweni phakathi kwezindawo ezintathu zokuphatha, nasemthethweni; bephushwa umnqweno wokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ngimi phambi kwenu ngokuqhakambisa nokholo lokuthi le Ningizimu Afrika esiyigubha namuhla, enezindawo ezihlukahlukene nezihlukaniso, izingxabano, nokukhishwa kweminyaka eyishumi nanhlanu edlule, kuyimiphumela yomsebenzi nokuzinikela kwabantu besifazane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavela kuzo zonke izimpilo. Laba bantu baseNingizimu Afrika bamele ithemba nokubekezela, bebonisa isizwe sethu. Phakathi kwabo kukhona abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlonishwa kakhulu ababezingxenye zePhalamende lethu ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu, esikhathini esidabukisayo sokulahlekelwa kwabo emavotelini edlule. Lokhu kufaka phakathi uBrian Bunting, uBilly Nair, uNcumisa Kondlo, uJohn Gomomo, uJoe Nhlanhla, uCas Saloojee, uJohn Schippers, noJan van Eck. Ngithanda futhi ukufaka uNkk. Helen Suzman, umuntu ophawulekayo ongumZulu owamele izindinganiso zePhalamende lethu elisha ePhalamende elidala. Laba bantu nabanye abavela ezweni lethu bafanele ingxenye enkulu yomvuzo uma sikhuluma ukuthi, naphezu kwanoma yiziphi izivunguvungu zezimali esibhekene nazo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinkinga zezimali ezingasiphazamisa, sihlangene ekuguquleni isizwe sethu sibe sesimweni esingcono. Nokho, akufanele sithukutheze izinselelo esibhekene nazo. Ukwehla kwamandla ezomnotho emhlabeni kubeka umnotho wethu engcupheni enkulu ngenxa yokulahleka kwemisebenzi nezinga lokuphila kwabantu bethu. Ngokuvamile, ukungaqiniseki mayelana nezinguquko zezombusazwe kungase kube nemibuzo eminingi kunalokho esinazo izimpendulo okwamanje. Ngenxa yalokhu, abanye bethu bahlushwa ukungakhululeki okwethulwe yilezi zimo zezimali nezombusazwe. Kodwa thina sithatha uhambo lwethemba nokubekezela. Singasho nokuthi, ngenhlanhla engajwayelekile, izici eziningi zokuphatha kwethu kwezimali zihlolwe phakathi nalesi sikhathi esedlule; futhi zonke zidlule esivivinyweni ukuze zikhombise idemokhrasi ethuthukayo. Uhulumeni wethu wedemokhrasi uyaphila. Kancane kancane, uyakhula, uqinisekiswe nguMthethosisekelo ongafani emhlabeni. Ngempela, amandla ethu okuzibandakanya kwezombusazwe kuleli sikhathi sokhetho azodinga ukuba ahlonipheke futhi aphumule njengesiqinisekiso sokuphila okuqhubekayo nokujulile kukahulumeni wethu wedemokhrasi. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baqinisekise intuthuko yayo; bona futhi bangabavikeli uhulumeni wethu wedemokhrasi eminyakeni ezayo. Ngivumele, uMhlonishwa noSihlalo, kulokhu ngifuna ukuhlinzeka bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavumelekile ukuba babhalise futhi bavote emavotelini kazwelonke nasezindaweni, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha isimo sethu lapho sifuna ukufinyelela khona. Kumele sikwenze lokhu ezinsukwini zokusebenza eziphelele emahhovisi omasipala, ngaphambi kokuba uhlu lokubhalisela ukuvota luvalwe. Kumele futhi sisebenzise le mpelasonto ekhethekile yokubhaliswa ehlelwe yiKomidi Lokhetho kusasa nangeSonto, mhlaka 7 no-8 kuMfumfu. Kumele ngithathe leli thuba ukukwazisa ukuthi ezinsukwini ezizayo ngizophothula izingxoxo neKomidi Lokhetho kanye nabaphathiswa bezifunda bese ngimemezela usuku lokhetho. Siphila lokho njengohulumeni wedemokhrasi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, mhlaka 27 kuMbasa 1994, okokuqala ngqa sithatha ikusasa labo ezandleni zabo. Ngaleso senzo esilula kodwa esiphelele sokuvota kuhulumeni wabantu bonke bezwe lethu ngekhadi, saphendukela emuva esikhathini esabheka phansi isithunzi sethu njengabantu. Ngakho-ke, kuyafaneleka ukuthi kulolu suku sigubhe iminyaka engama-20 yokwamukelwa kwesitatimende seKomidi Lezomthetho le-OAU eNingizimu Afrika eMbuzweni, eNingizimu Afrika, esamukelwa ngoJuni 1989, esaziwa kakhulu njengeHarare Declaration. Lokhu kwazama kwakha isisekelo soxolo emhlabeni, ngokusebenzisa iZizwe Ezihlangene, ohlelweni lokuxoxisana eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, kwaba yisikhuthazo sokwakhiwa kweMibono yeDemokhrasi ka-1989, okuhlanganisa abantu bezwe bonke abavela kuzo zonke izimpilo. Konke lokhu kuholele ohlelweni lokuxoxisana olwakha emavotelini ethu okuqala wedemokhrasi ngo-1994. Kulokhu, kumele sibonge uMongameli we-African National Congress, uOliver Reginald Tambo, ngokusungula nokuhlola ukuthi kuzosebenza kanjani kubantu besifunda nasemphakathini jikelele njengesiqondiso sokuxazulula ngokuthula ukungqubuzana ezweni lethu. Lesi sinyathelo esinamandla sokwakha isikhala esizophushana nokuthula nokuhlangana, esikhundleni sokulwa nokungqubuzana, sithathe isikhathi eside ukulinda okungelona iqiniso iminyaka eyikhulu: umphumela weMibono Yezwe ka-1909 eyayiyisikhumbuzo sokwakhiwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Ngaleso sikhathi, le Mibono yachaza isithombe seNingizimu Afrika njengoba siyazi namuhla, njengoba sasiqinisekiswe ngokucindezelwa kwezenhlalo nokukhishwa. Ngakho-ke, eminyakeni eyishumi nanhlanu yokubusa kwethu wedemokhrasi, singenza sithi ukwesaba, ukungaqiniseki, nokuzonda kweminyaka eyikhulu edlule kwenze ukuthula kube yinto eyahlukanisayo futhi engaphelele kubaholi bezwe ababephakathi; kwakungekho nje kuphela okungafanele kodwa kwangempela kwakukhona endaweni engalungile. Lokhu kwesaba nokungaqiniseki kuholele ezinkathazweni zeminyaka eminingi. Kulokhu, sikhumbula indodana enethemba yabantu bethu,
Ilungelo lokudoba ukuze uthengise liyindlela yokusebenzisa ilungelo lakho lokudoba. Lokhu kulungelo kumele kufunwe ngumuntu okukhulunywe ngaye ukuze bakwazi ukukusebenzisa, ukuze badobe fish olwandle noma babambe iqhaza emisebenzini ethintana nokudoba ukuze bathengise. Kubandakanya ukwenza imisebenzi ethintana nokudoba kodwa awukwazi ukudla lezo zinyoni. Ukuze usebenzise ilungelo lakho lokudoba, thumela isicelo sokuthola imvume yokudoba ukuze uthengise eyakhishwa ngumenzi wezokuthutha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma igunya elikhethiwe. Ilungelo eliphelele noma elilinganiselwe linikwe izinhlobo ezithile zezinhlanzi ngomholo we-DEA&T ngokusekelwe kumkhawulo wokudoba ovunyelwe okukhulunywe ngonyaka ngumenzi wezokuthutha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha. Uqala ngokufaka isicelo selungelo lokudoba ukuze uthengise ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo semvume yokudoba ukuze uthengise. Ngaphezu kwemvume yokudoba ukuze uthengise, uzodinga imvume yokuhambisa izinyoni ukuze ukwazi ukuzithutha. Faka isicelo selungelo lokudoba uma umgovernment ikumema ukuthi wenze kanjalo njengoba kubhalwe encwadini yokwazisa kukahulumeni. Thola ifomu lesicelo emnyangweni ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma uya endaweni ozokhombiswa ukuyithola yi-DEA&T. Funda ifomu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uqedela zonke izidingo zenqubo yesicelo. Gcwalisa, podpis, bese uthumela ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo nezitifiketi kanye ne-akhawunti yokubuyiselwa endaweni ozokhombiswa kuyo noma ehhovisi le-DEA&T eliseduze. Uku processing kwezicelo kuzokwenziwa ngemva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuthumela izicelo, futhi imiphumela izokhulumiswa ngokuxhumana ne-DEA&T. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-1 kuya kwezi-3 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngengcindezi yomsebenzi noma ukutholakala kwezinhlobo zezinhlanzi. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngenani labantu abafake izicelo.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe (National shutdown) Isingeniso Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe, owaziwa ngokuthi i-National Shutdown, ungomunye wemibhikisho emikhulu eyenzeka eNingizimu Afrika, enezizathu eziningi ezihlanganisa ukwenyuka kwezindleko zokuphila, ukungasebenzi kahle kukahulumeni, kanye nezinkinga ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuphepha. Lo mbhikisho ubonisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngempilo yabo, kanye nezinkinga ezibhekene nezwe. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela yawo ezwenikazi, emphakathini, nasezinhlelweni zomphakathi. Umongo wombhikisho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe uqala ngokukhathazeka okujulile kwabantu ngezimo ezinzima abahlangabezana nazo. Izindleko zokuphila zikhuphukile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokudla, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kukhuphuka kwentengo kuholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi labo abaphila ngaphansi komngcele wezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungasebenzi kahle kukahulumeni, okubandakanya ukungabi namasu acacile, kukhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphume emizileni ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo. Umthelela wezenhlalo Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe unomthelela omkhulu ezinhlelweni zempilo yomphakathi. Ukuphuma kwabantu emigwaqweni kuholela ekwandeni kokuphikisana, okungase kuholele ezimweni zokuphazamiseka kwezomnotho. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izinkampani zibe nesikhathi esinzima sokusebenza, okuholela ekwandeni kokungasebenzi. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho ukungasebenzi kuholela ekukhuleni kokuhlupheka, okwandisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthola umthelela omkhulu emithonjeni yokuxhumana. Umbhikisho uvamise ukuholela ekukhuleni kwemithombo yolwazi, lapho abantu bexhumana khona ukuze babelane ngemicabango, izinkinga, nezixazululo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umuzwa wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, kodwa futhi kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zomphakathi. Umthelela wezomnotho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe unomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Izinkampani ezincane nezinkulu zibhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphazamiseka, okuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa izinga lokungasebenzi. Umbhikisho ungenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka, okwenza kube nzima ukuhweba nokuthola izimpahla. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezithintekayo zidinga ukusebenzisa izinsiza eziningi ukuze ziphinde ziqinise izinhlelo zazo zokusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhweba. Umthelela wezomnotho ungaba yingozi enkulu, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Umthelela wezombusazwe Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungaba nomthelela omkhulu kwezombusazwe. Ubonisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngohulumeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokungabaza ngohulumeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Umbhikisho ungase futhi uholele ekwandeni kokubusa kwabantu. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kwemiphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nawo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo. Isiphetho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ubonisa izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nezwe, ezibangelwa ukunganeliseki kwabantu. Umthelela wombhikisho unomthelela omkhulu ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, emnothweni, nasezombusazwe. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu eziholela emibhikishweni, kanye nemiphumela yazo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi bahlanganyele ukuze bathole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, futhi bagcine izinga lokuphila labantu. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolondekile.
UKhisimusi: Umkhosi Wokuhlonipha Nokubungaza UKhisimusi, okungukuthi uMkhosi Wokuzalwa kukaJesu Kristu, ungomunye wemikhosi emikhulu kakhulu emhlabeni wonke. Lo mkhosi ubungaza ukuvela kukaJesu, umphakathi ubonisa uthando, umusa, kanye nokuhlanganyela. UKhisimusi uqala ngemuva kwekhefu le-Advent, okukhombisa isikhathi sokulinda nokpreparedness ngaphambi kokufika kukaJesu. Umkhosi uvame ukuba yisikhathi sokuhlobisa, ukujabulisa, nokubuyisana phakathi kwemindeni, okwenza kube yisikhathi esikhethekile emhlabeni jikelele. Ngokwesiko, uKhisimusi uqala ngokuhlonishwa emaphakathini amaningi, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze baphile izikhathi ezijabulisayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlela imicimbi yokudla, ukuhlobisa izihlahla zeKhisimusi, kanye nokushintshanisa izipho. Izihlahla zeKhisimusi, ezivame ukuhlinzekwa ngezihlahla eziluhlaza, zihlala zihlobisa ngama-ornaments, izibani, nezintambo ezihlotshisiwe. Lokhu kudala umoya wokujabulisa nokubungaza, futhi kubonisa ubuhle bemvelo. Ukwenza kube ngcono, izinkanyezi zikhumbuza abantu ngoKristu, okuwumthombo wothando nempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkanyezi zikhombisa indlela yokuphila eyakhayo, egcwele umusa. Izinkanyezi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlanganyela, bezama ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nemigomo yeKhisimusi, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nomoya wokuphila ngokuhlanganyela, ukuxhasa abanye, nokuba nomusa. Ngaphezu kokuhlonishwa kwezinto eziphilayo, uKhisimusi unomlando ocebile. Umbhali uJohn Milton, emsebenzini wakhe "Paradise Lost," uveza uKhisimusi njengomkhosi obalulekile, okhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu noNkulunkulu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uKhisimusi akukhona nje kuphela umkhosi wokuzalwa kukaJesu, kodwa futhi ubonisa ubudlelwano obujulile phakathi kwabantu noMsindisi. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi uKhisimusi ungumkhosi wokubuyisana, wokuhlonipha, kanye nokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Ngokwesiko, izinkanyezi zikhumbuza abantu ngoKristu, okuwumthombo wothando nempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkanyezi zikhombisa indlela yokuphila eyakhayo, egcwele umusa. Izinkanyezi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlanganyela, bezama ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nemigomo yeKhisimusi, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nomoya wokuphila ngokuhlanganyela, ukuxhasa abanye, nokuba nomusa. UKhisimusi ungumkhosi wezinhloso ezinhle, kodwa futhi unomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini nasezinkulumo zamasiko. Njengoba abantu bejabulisa, izinkampani zikhuthaza ukuthengisa ngezinto ezihlobene noKhisimusi, okuvame ukuletha umnotho omkhulu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uKhisimusi akukhona nje umkhosi wezinkolo, kodwa futhi ungumcimbi obalulekile emnothweni. Lokhu kudala izinselelo ezithile, njengokuthi abantu baphenduke ekuthengeni kakhulu, baphinde baphuthelwe umoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uKhisimusi ubonisa ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinkolo ezahlukene. Ezinye izinkolo, ezifana neJudaísmo, zikhumbula umkhosi weHanukkah ngesikhathi esifanayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba uKhisimusi ungowokholo lweKristu, abantu bahlala behlanganyela ukuze bahloniphe izinkolo zabo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlonipha nokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene, okwenza kube yisikhathi sokubambisana. UKhisimusi akugcini nje ngokuba umkhosi wezinkolo, kodwa futhi ubonisa umoya wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu behlangana ukuze baphile izikhathi ezijabulisayo. UKhisimusi uyisikhathi sokubuyisana, sokuhlonipha, kanye nokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onothando, onomusa, nolwazi. Ekugcineni, uKhisimusi ungumkhosi ophakamisa umoya wokuhlonipha, ubudlelwano, nomusa. Ubonisa ukuthi, nakuba izinkolo zingahluka, abantu bahlala behlanganyela ukuze baphile izikhathi ezijabulisayo. UKhisimusi ungumkhosi wezinhloso ezinhle, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nezifiso zokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onothando, onomusa, nolwazi, okwenza uKhisimusi ube yisikhathi esikhethekile emhlabeni jikelele.
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Umqondo, Ukuhlola, Nokubuyekezwa Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Lokhu kuhlola kudinga ukubaluleka, njengoba izinsizakalo zibhala ibhuku elisha empilweni yomuntu, futhi zidinga ukufaneleka kwezinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa nokusebenzisana. Ukuze siqonde kangcono izinsizakalo zokubeletha, kubalulekile ukuqonda izigaba ezihlukahlukene ezihilelekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwezamakhaza, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, nezinsizakalo ezithinta izingane ezizalwa. Izibhedlela eziphakeme zihlala zibheka ukwakha izindawo ezikahle zokubeletha, lapho abesifazane bezokwazi khona ukuhamba ngokuthula, besebenzisa izinsiza ezithuthukile. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezindlela Zokubeletha Izibhedlela zanamuhla zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bathola izinsizakalo eziphezulu. Izindlela zokubeletha ziye zashintsha kakhulu, kusukela ezindleleni zendabuko kuya ekusebenziseni ubuchwepheshe obufana ne-Caesarean section, okwenza kube lula ukujabulisa abesifazane abanesimo esinzima. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomama nezingane, izibhedlela ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zazo zihlala zishintsha futhi zikhula. Naphezu kwezinguquko ezinhle, kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsizakalo zokuqonda nezokweluleka, njengoba abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlala behamba ngezinselele ezihlukahlukene. Izinselelo zingabandakanya ukungazi kahle ukuthi yini okulindelekile, ukungabaza ngezinyathelo zokubeletha, noma ngabe kukhona ukwesaba okukhona. Ngakho-ke, izibhedlela zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezinhle zokweluleka, ukuze abesifazane bazizwe bekhululekile. Ukwaziswa Nokuqwashisa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane bathola izinsizakalo eziphezulu, izibhedlela zifanele ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile nebanzi ngazo zonke izinqubo zokubeletha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuthi yini okufanele kulindelwe ngesikhathi sokubeletha, izinyathelo zokuphepha ezithathwayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze kubhekwane nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlola kwamakhasimende kungaba usizo olukhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo, njengoba izibhedlela zingathola impendulo efanele kumakhasimende abawasebenzisayo. Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ukuze siqonde kahle izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngombono oqondile kumakhasimende, abasebenzisi bezinsizakalo, kanye nezisebenzi. Ukuhlola okuhle kwezinsizakalo kungenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi izibhedlela zenza kahle kangakanani. Lokhu kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo, njengoba abesifazane abakhulelwe behamba nezinselele ezithile, futhi abanye bangase badinge izinsiza ezikhethekile. Izibhedlela ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezihamba phambili zihlala ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuhlonza izinkinga futhi zisebenze ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuxhumana, izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, kanye nemikhuba yokwelashwa. Ukubuyekezwa kwalezi zinsizakalo kufanele kube okwenziwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane bathola ukunakekelwa okungcono. Isiphetho Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi zidinga ukuqashelwa ngokwanele. Ukuhlonishwa, ukusizwa, nokunakekelwa okuyikhwalithi kubalulekile kumama nangezingane zabo. Izibhedlela zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlala bezwa bephephile, bethokozile, futhi benelisekile ngempela. Ngokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinqubo ezinhle, futhi ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, izibhedlela zingahlinzeka ngensiza ethuthukisiwe futhi ehloniphekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo bobabili abesifazane abakhulelwe kanye nezingane ezintsha ezizalwa, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziyaqhubeka ziphila impilo enempilo nohlanga. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha kufanele zihlale zilungiswa, zilungiswe futhi ziqinisekiswe ukuze kuhlonishwe impilo yomama nezingane zabo.
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni: Umqondo Oqhakazile Ezikhathini zanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili futhi izidingo zomphakathi zikhula, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngempela ngokuqinile ngokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zethu. Lokhu akukona nje kuphela isidingo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, kodwa futhi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha isizwe esiqinile nesibambisene. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni, njengamathala, izikhungo zemfundo, nezikhungo zokwelapha, kudinga ukuba kube umgomo ophakeme kumphakathi wethu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala akukhulumi nje ngokusiza abantu abanemali encane, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ithuba lokuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathalekile isimo sabo sezimali, athole izinsiza ezidingekayo. Uma sikhuluma ngamathala ezincwadi, isibonelo, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zikhungo zibalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wokufunda. Uma abantu bekwazi ukufinyelela ezincwadini, bazoba nekhono lokwandisa ulwazi lwabo, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yabo kanye nokwakha umphakathi onolwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukuba zibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kumphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikole, amanyuvesi, nezikhungo zokuqeqesha kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezitholakalayo ukuze abantu baphumelele. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala kulezi zikhungo kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abavela emiphakathini ethwele kanzima, ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bephumelele khona, futhi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zabo. Ngokufanayo, izikhungo zokwelapha zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zokwelapha kuzovikela abantu abaningi ekuguleni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kungenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi umphakathi uphumelele. Akufanele kube khona umuntu ophila ngaphandle kokwelashwa ngenxa yokungabi namali. Umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga abantu abaphilile, futhi lokhu kuncike ekutholeni izinsiza zokwelapha. Kodwa-ke, ukufinyelela kwamahhala akukhona nje kuphela ngobuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume nangezindlela zokuphatha izinsiza. Izikhungo zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlelo ezihlelekile nezisebenzayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo kumele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izinsiza. Ngaphandle kwalokho, sizobona abantu besaba ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle izinqubo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokuxhumana. Ukuze sithole ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni, kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi uhulumeni, izikhungo, kanye nomphakathi uqobo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi izinsiza zitholakala kanjani, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi bafeze izidingo zabo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezikhungweni zethu. Ekugcineni, ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni akuyona nje into efanele, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathalekile isimo sabo sezimali, uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi, futhi kuzoholela ekwakheni isizwe esiqinile. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeleni phambili, siqinisekise ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni kuyinto engokwemvelo, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu sonke.
Amagama ezindawo amagama asebenza njengokukhombisa nezimpawu emhlabeni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi natural noma abekwe abantu. Lezi zikhombisi nezimpawu zingahlanganyela nabantu noma zingahlanganyeli. Amagama ezindawo aphansi kwegunya lemiphakathi yendawo, okuhlanganisa imigwaqo, izakhiwo zomkhandlu nezikhala, amapaki endawo, nezinqaba, kanye nezakhiwo eziphathelene nabantu. Amagama ezindawo aphinde aphansi kwegunya likamasipala, okuhlanganisa amadolobha, izindawo zokuhlala edolobheni, izindawo zokuhlala abantu, amahhovisi eposi, iziteshi, izikhumulo zezindiza, izikhungo, imigwaqo emikhulu, nezimo zemvelo ezifana nezintaba, imifula, amanzi, ogwini, amaphuzu okungena olwandle, iziqhingi, izindawo ezinamahlathi, nezindawo zokuvakasha zizwe. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa kwegama: Zonke izigaba zikamasipala, uhulumeni bezifunda, imiphakathi yendawo, iSouth African Post Office, abakhi nabathuthukisi bezakhiwo, noma yinoma iyiphi enye inhlangano noma umuntu. Ulimi luwugama olusekelwe emgomeni wegama uma wazi uhlobo lwamagama oluphakanyisiwe, ngokwesibonelo, ihhovisi leposi noma isiteshi sebhayisikili esifundeni saseMantshi noma esifundeni lapho indawo itholakala khona, ukuthi ikude kangakanani noma indlela yayo, uhlobo oluhambelana nedolobha eliseduze noma indawo yendawo eduze. Umbiko NgamaFilimu Isingeniso Amafilimu, njengobuciko bokuxhumana nemizwa, adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Lokhu kuhamba phambili emhlabeni wethu, amafilimu awekho nje ukufaka izithombe ezinkulu ezikholisayo, kodwa kuthiwa ayingxenye yamasiko, imishado, kanye nemininingwane yomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlaziya amafilimu kusuka esikhathini sokudala kuya kwesimanjemanje, kuzo zonke izigaba zempilo. Ukuqala Kwamafilimu Umgomo wamafilimu uqale ngasekuqaleni kwekhulu le-20, lapho amafilimu ephakanyiswa eyisithombe esingenamazwi, azithokozisa abantu ngezenzo ezivela ebuhleni. I-Hollywood, edume kakhulu emhlabeni, yawela esikhathini sokengisa amafilimu emazwe angaphandle, yenza amaphrojekthi ayebheja ezintweni ezinjengokwaziwa ngokuhlekisa, ukulawula imizwa, kanye nokucaciswa kwezindaba. Lezi zinkampani ezingeni eliphezulu zapha umphakathi kwamafilimu anejubane lokukhula. Ukwakhiwa Kwamafilimu Ukwakhiwa kwamafilimu kulandela izigaba ezithile ezibandakanya; ukwakhiwa kwe-script, ukukhetha abadlali (casting), ukukhiqiza, kanye nokuhlela. I-script iyinhliziyo yephrojekthi, ihlinzeka ngesisekelo sezindaba ezizokhuluma ngazo. Ukukhetha abadlali kudinga ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, njengoba abadlali kufanele babonise izimfanelo ezithile ukuze baziveze ngokweqiniso. Njengoba kudlalwa izigaba zokuqhuba kusebenze abezindaba, abakhiqizi benza imisebenzi enkulu yokuhlanganisa imiphetho phakathi kwezinhlelo ezenzakalayo. Uhlanga Lwamafilimu Uhla lwezimakethe zamafilimu selukhula, kanti nezinhlobonhlobo zamafilimu zikhona. Kube nogaxekile, amafilimu abukeka njengemali ethokozisayo, amavidiyo akhuthaza, kanye nolwazi olujulile. Lokhu kugqugquzelwa okwenzeka emhlabeni kusiza ukudala amafilimu ahlukahlukene, afunwa ngamaqembu ahlukene. Izinhlelo zamasiko zenza kube nokuhlukahluka okukhulu, kanti amafilimu amaningi afana nemjolo, umjaho, nezokuhlakanipha azisa abantu ngezindaba ezithinta emphakathini. Amathrendi Nezinguquko Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eminingi edlule, imibono, izinqubo, nezinto ezifanele ziye zaguquka. Ngaleso sikhathi, amafilimu aqala ukugxila ezindleleni zabantu ezikhethekile, ukulwa kwama-viral, nokubheja kulezi zikhathi ezisheshayo. Ubulili, ubuhlanga, kanye nezinkinga zezenhlalo zihatshwe kakhulu ezindabeni zamafilimu, kanti ababhali manje basithola isikhathi sokukhuluma ngalezi zinto ngezindlela ezenzeka kumafilimu. Impact Ngemiphakathi Amafilimu akha imiphakathi njengoba ebonakalisa izinkinga zansuku zonke, izifiso, nemicabango ehlukahlukene. Ayiqondile kuphela njengokuldlalela; ayingxenye yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amafilimu ahlinzeka ngezindlela zokuphucula ukuqonda kwezimanga nokuhlangenwe nakho. Lokhu kukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuthi ingabi namahloni kodwa ivuleke kabanzi, ibonise ukuqonda okukhulu komphakathi. Isikhathi Samanje Nezinguquko Ezingaphezulu Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buye basha, amafilimu athola ukwaziswa okuningi nge-streaming services. Lokhu kuguqula indlela abantu abathenga ngayo amafilimu, njengoba benza kube lula uku-accessa okuqukethwe kwezokuxhumana. Kukhona nohlelo lokwandisa imisebenzi yamafilimu, njengoba abaqhubi beziqhenya ngaphezulu ngempela. Njengoba izinkundla zikhula, kuthiwa umbono wawamafilimu uyaqhubeka futhi uhambisana nezidingo zezwe. Inhlonipho Nokuqonda Selesikhona esikhathini sokujabulisa amafilimu, sibi asihamba siye elwazini. Imazwi ethokozisayo engizithandayo zingafakwe kumafilimu, zikhombisa ukuthambekela. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zinhlelo, akunakuphikwa ukuthi amafilimu awulula, kanye nezinkumbulo eziphathekayo zikhanya emqondweni wabantu. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, amafilimu awaziwa kuphela njengenjabulo, kodwa futhi njengendlela yokufunda, yokuphila, nokuxhumana. Kumnandi ukufaka izithombe ezintsha nezimfashini ezikhuluma ngempilo, isiko, nezenzakalo ezithinta umhlaba. Njengoba uhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe amafilimu njengephuzu elibalulekile lokuxhumana, futhi sigcine isithakazelo sethu kulokhu kubukeka. Ngakho, amafilimu abheke phambili, eqhubeka nokwakha umhlaba omuhle, uyisikhumbuzo sokwenza, futhi uyindlela yokuphila.
Umthetho wezokuphepha ufaneleka ukuthi, njengabaphathi bezokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika, sithande abantu ngobuqotho nangokuhlonipha ukuhlukahluka kwabo kanye nomthetho, ngaleyo ndlela sithuthukise futhi sithuthukise umsebenzi wethu ngendlela evumelekile emphakathini. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha athatha iqiniso njengokubaluleka ngaphambi kwakho konke. Ukuze sichaze: Thina, njengabaphathi bezokuphepha, sizohlale sizama ukugcina inhloso, sibe nolwazi ngezimiso zomthetho wezokuphepha. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohambisana nalezi zimiso. Sizoziphatha ngobuqotho nokuzinikela noma ngabe yisiphi isimo. Sizohlale sikhuluma iqiniso, senza imisebenzi yethu ngenhlonipho, futhi sibe isibonelo emiphakathini esiyisebenzela. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha amukela ukuhlukahluka kwabantu ezweni lethu futhi ahloniphe bonke abantu ngokulinganayo. Ukuze sichaze: Ekufezeni umsebenzi wethu, sizohlale sikhombisa ukuhlonipha sikwazi ukuthi imiphakathi ihlukahlukene, ezamasiko nakwezinye izindlela. Sizobhekana nonke ngokuhlonipha futhi sihloniphe amalungelo abo njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Asizukwehlukanisa ngokungekho emthethweni noma yimuphi umuntu. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha azohlale ehonipha futhi agcine umthetho. Ukuze sichaze: Umsebenzi wethu uhambisana kakhulu nokuphathwa komthetho, ngakho-ke sithi sizohlale siba ngaphansi komthetho nasemthethweni wezwe lethu. Sizohlale sigwema ukuziphatha ngendlela ezosiholela ekuphuleni umthetho. Sizohlale sivikela abantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ezinyathelweni ezingekho emthethweni. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha azama njalo ukwenza imisebenzi yabo kahle. Ukuze sichaze: Sizohlale, kuyo yonke imizamo yethu, senza umsebenzi wethu ngazo zonke izinsiza esinazo. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohlale kukhombisa ubuchwepheshe bomsebenzi wethu. Ukuziphatha kwethu nokubukeka kuzokwandisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekwenzeni kahle. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha asebenza ndawonye nomphakathi ngoba afuna ukwamukelwa nokwesekwa emphakathini. Ukuze sichaze: Sizosebenza ngothando olukhulu lomphakathi, futhi ngazo zonke izizathu zokweseka umthetho, futhi sifuna ukwamukelwa komphakathi wonke.
Siyabonga kakhulu ukwethula le ncwadi. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni wethu wasayinela iSivumelwano seZizwe Ezihlangene Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sivumelene ukuhlonipha imithetho ekhethekile mayelana nokuthi izingane kufanele ziphathwe kanjani emhlabeni jikelele. Uma singahloniphi le mithetho, sizobe sisesimweni esinzima neZizwe Ezihlangene! Kodwa okukhathazayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi, nakuba iSivumelwano ikhuluma ngezingane, ayibhaliwe ngendlela yokuthi izingane zikwazi ukuyiqonda kalula. Sazibuza, yini inzuzo yale nto? Ngempela, ingabe izingane akufanele zikwazi ukuqonda amalungelo azo? Yingakho sithathe isinqumo sokukubhalela le ncwadi. Amalungelo akule ncwadi akuwe. Ayizakhamuzi zonke eNingizimu Afrika kanye neningi lezingane emhlabeni jikelele. Akekho ongathatha lawa malungelo kuwe. Ngakho qiniseka ukuthi uyawazi! Siyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe lethu! Futhi qiniseka ukuthi uyakujabulela kakhulu! Nginezingane ezingezami. Ngakho ngiyazi ukuthi okubaluleke kakhulu enganeni ukujabula nokuvikeleka. Le ncwadi ikhuluma ngamalungelo ezingane zokuba zibe nokuvikeleka nokuphepha ezweni lethu. Ngizibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi uyazi amalungelo akho nokuthi bonke abaphakathi kwami basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuvikela wena, imindeni yakho, nabangane bakho. Ngiyabona futhi ukuthi njengokuthi niyizingane, kufanele nizizwe niphephile, nivikelwe, nikhunjulwa, futhi nikhathalelwe. Ngiyazi ngoba ngangiyingane futhi. Ngakho umsebenzi wami ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abenza ubugebengu ezingeni lezingane baboshwa futhi bajeziswa ngendlela efanele. Ngithatha umsebenzi wami ngokungathí sina futhi ngizibophezele ekuvikeleni wena. Le ncwadi ikuwe futhi izokusiza wazi ukuthi yiziphi izenzo ezingamukeleki nokuthi ungabika kanjani labo abadala nezingane abaphula amalungelo akho. Zonke izingane emhlabeni kufanele zijabulele lawa malungelo. Sonke singamalungu omndeni omkhulu wabantu. Sinezakhamizi nezizalwane zonke emhlabeni. Eminyakeni edlule, ngaphambi kokuba uzalwe, ohulumeni bomhlaba bahlangana ukuze bakhe uhulumeni womhlaba obizwa ngeZizwe Ezihlangene. Labo bahulumeni bavumelana ukuthi wonke amalungu omndeni wethu wabantu unelungelo lokukhululeka, ubulungiswa, nokuthula emhlabeni. Umuntu ngamunye kusho umuntu wonke ngempela. Akukhathalekile ukuthi siphuma kuphi noma ukuthi singobani. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sicebile noma sihluphekile noma sisesimweni esiphakathi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umbala wethu wesikhumba, ubuzwe, noma inkolo yethu iyini. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi singamadoda, abesifazane, amantombazane, noma abafana. Kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokusizwa kakhulu kunabantu abadala. Yingakho iSivumelwano Sokwaziswa Kwezingane samukelwa yiZizwe Ezihlangene ngomhla ka-20 Novemba, 1989. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi iZizwe Ezihlangene ikhuluma kakhulu ngezingane futhi ikholelwa ukuthi amalungelo akhethekile adingeka. Okokuqala, iZizwe Ezihlangene ikholelwa ngokuqinile ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle kakhulu emndenini noma ekhaya lapho zingajabula, zithandwa, futhi zikhuluma khona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imindeni nalabo abakhathalela izingane kufanele ivikelwe ukuze bakwazi ukunakekela izingane zabo futhi bazisize zikhule. Okwesibili, izingane zidinga ukukhula ngendlela ezokwenza zibe ngabantu abadala abakwazi ukubhekana nezinto ezidinga ukuzenza futhi zibe amalungu emiphakathini yazo. Kufanele zifundiswe ukuhlala emhlabeni ngokuthula, ngebhongo, ngokuqina, ngokukhululeka, ngokulingana, nangokuhlanganyela. Okwesithathu, imibhalo eminingi ehlukene yomhlaba nezikhangiso zicela ukunakekelwa okukhethekile, inhlalakahle, ukuphathwa, nokuvikelwa kwezingane. Kubalulekile ukubhala konke phansi kwi-document eyodwa - i-document yeziNgane kuphela. Okwesine, nakuba wonke umuntu efuna zonke izingane zikhule zijabule futhi zifezekile, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyazi ukuthi, ezweni lonke, izingane eziningi zihlala ezimeni ezinzima kakhulu. Ngenxa yalezi nezinye izizathu, kubalulekile ukuba neSivumelwano esikhethekile Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Le Sivumelwano ikhuluma ngazo zonke izinkinga nezinkinga ezingane ezihlangabezana nazo emhlabeni jikelele kanye nawo wonke amalungelo akhethekile okufanele abe nawo izingane. Le yisivumelwano sakho futhi kubalulekile ukuthi wazi ngakho nokuthi ikhuluma ngani. Iqukethe izingxenye ezahlukene (iZizwe Ezihlangene ziyibiza ngokuthi "izigaba"). Ibhalwe ngolimi lwezomthetho ukuze ingasetshenziswa ezinkantolo ukuvikela wena. Kodwa lokhu kwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuyiqonda. Yingakho sibhale lokhu kuwe ngolimi olulula kule ncwadi. Nokho, kuqala, sifuna ukukuchazela ukuthi iSivumelwano iyini, njengoba isetshenziswa lapha, nokuthi yafika kanjani. Njengoba sikhulume, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyindlela yokuphatha umhlaba. Lo hulumeni uhambela endlini enkulu esakhiweni seZizwe Ezihlangene eNew York. Lapha baxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile zomhlaba ezifana neSivumelwano Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Khumbula ukuthi le Sivumelwano iyisivumelwano esenziwe phakathi kohulumeni bomhlaba. Uma isivumelwano sitholakele, wonke amazwe kufanele aye kwiPhalamende lawo avumelane neSivumelwano lapho. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukwamukela iSivumelwano. IPhalamende kufanele livote ukuthi lizohlonipha imithetho yeSivumelwano. Uma iPhalamende lezwe livumelene ukwamukela iSivumelwano, uhulumeni walowo mzwe kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yawo. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi hhayi wonke amazwe avumelana nazo zonke izivumelwano. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wavuma (wamukela) iSivumelwano Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yeSivumelwano. IZizwe Ezihlangene zinekomidi ekhethekile yabantu okufanele ibuze amazwe ukuthi yiziphi izinto abahamba phambili ngazo ukuze bahloniphe le mithetho. Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika yasayina iSivumelwano, benza promises ekhethekile ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izingane zizobekwa phambili kukho konke abakwenza. I-Sivumelwano ibalula ukuthi ingane iy umuntu ongekho eminyakeni engu-18. Kodwa kwesinye isikhathi, izwe lingaba nemithetho evumela ukuthi ingane ibhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kwaleyo minyaka. Ungase ucabangele isizathu sokuthi kungani izwe lingavumela ingane ibhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kweminyaka engu-18. Ngokwesibonelo, kwamanye amazwe, abantu abangenaminyaka engu-18 bavunyelwe ukuba bashade. Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi umuntu ongekho eminyakeni engu-18 kufanele aphathwe njengengane? Wonke umhlaba kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amalungelo akulesi Sivumelwano akhuluma ngawo athinta zonke izingane kulelo zwe. Akekho ingane okufanele ishiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ungowesifazane, umbala, ubulili, ulimi, noma inkolo. Ukumba, ukumba, ukususa, ukujova noma ukuhlanganisa umhlabathi, isihlabathi, itshe noma udoti ogcwalisa indawo edlula ubukhulu obungama-10 meters olwandle noma endaweni enokuphakama okungama-100 meters ukusuka kumkhawulo wamanzi aphezulu olwandle. Ukugcina izinto eziyingozi emhlabeni, kuhlanganise ne-petroleum, i-diesel, igazi le-petroleum njengomkhiqizo ophilayo noma i-asphalt, ezitsheni ezinekhono elingaphezu kwama-30 cubic meters kodwa ngaphansi kwama-1,000 cubic meters kunoma iyiphi indawo noma isayithi. Ukuhlola, ukubikezela, umsebenzi wokumbiwa noma imisebenzi yokumba njengoba kunikezwe kuMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zokumbiwa Kwamaminerali Nezokuphathelene, ka-2002 (uMthetho No. 28 ka-2002), mayelana nalawo mavume, amalungelo, amalayisense, kanye nezivuselelo zawo.
