Ukulahlwa Kwemfucuza Emphakathini Wethu Wanamuhla Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza sekuba yindaba ebalulekile emphakathini wethu, ethinta indlela esiphila ngayo. Njengoba umnotho uqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela esiphatha ngayo imfucuza. Ukuze sifinyelele kuleli phuzu, umcimbi obalulekile uhlelelwe, uzobhekelwa izindaba eziphusile nemisebenzi yansuku zonke yokulahla imfucuza. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngeminikelo emisha yokugcina imvelo iphilile. Umcimbi uzoba ngosuku lwama-15 kuMsombuluko, phakathi nezinsuku ezinzima zomphakathi. Izivakashi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zikhona, kubalwa amalungu ezemvelo, izinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza, nezikhungo zokucubungula imfucuza. Uhlelo lomcimbi luzoba nezinkulumo ezivela kochwepheshe abahamba phambili, izibonelo zempumelelo, nezinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezizokwenza abantu bathole ulwazi oluningi mayelana nezindlela zokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Umcimbi uzovulwa ngomlayezo ophakamisayo ovela kuNgqongqoshe Ophakathi kwezokuhlala nezokuthuthukiswa, ogcizelela ukwandiswa kokusebenza kwemihlangano eminingi kumaphrojekthi ahlakaniphile aqhubekayo. Ngokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano, izinkampani ezithintekayo zathola ithuba lokukhulisa ukusebenza kwayo ukuze kulahlwe imfucuza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlale kukholisa imiphakathi eminingi, ikakhulukazi lezo ezixhomekeke emithonjeni yemali engapheli. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, abantu bazothola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza ezinsizeni ezahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukubona izindinganiso ezintsha zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, ukuzithokozisa izinkampani ezenza kahle emkhakheni, nokubandakanya izinhlelo ezithuthukisa imiphakathi yabo. Izinkampani ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ubuhlakani obuhle kulabo abayibambeleyo, zifundisa ngokubaluleka komsebenzi wazo ekuhlaliseni izinhlelo ezifanele. Umcimbi uzophela ngenkulumo ebalulekile, ekhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza. Lokhu kuhlakanipha kuzokwenza sithathe izinyathelo ezinkulu zokuqinisa ukuqwashisa kulabo abathintekayo. Ukuhlanganyela emkhankasweni wokulahla imfucuza kuzothuthukisa ukuzibandakanya kwendoda, umndeni, nomphakathi, ukuze kube nomthelela omuhle. Umcimbi uzokwakha ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi kanye nemikhiqizo efanele yokulahlwa kwemfucuza, okuzolekelela ukumiselwa kwezimali ezinkulu ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhlelo ezinzile zomphakathi, nokunciphisa umphumela omubi wemfucuza. Izinhlaka ezahlukene, kokubili ezizimele nezomphakathi, zizodingeka zixhumane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukulatshwa kwempilo yomphakathi kuyathuthuka. Egunjini okukhuluma iziphakamiso zengqalasizinda, abaphathi bamaphrojekthi bazokwazi ukuhlaziya izindlela ezivele zaba nemiphumela emihle. Lokhu kuzobhekelwa izindlela ezifanele, futhi umphakathi uzothola imiqondo emisha mayelana nezinsiza ezisemphakathini. Kumqoka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi olunye usizo lutholwa ngokuxhumana namaphakathi, izici eziphathelene nokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwamalunga omphakathi nezinhlaka zomphakathi kuzolekelela ukudala isizwe esinempilo, esimnandi, futhi esithuthukayo. Inhloso yokugcina yomcimbi uwukuhlonipha imvelo, ukuqinisekisa ikusasa elihle, nokwakha imiphakathi edidiyelwe. Izinhlelo zokulahlwa kwemfucuza ezisebenzayo zizobaluleka ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, othuthukayo, nonobala, ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle. Umcimbi uphakamisa umqondo wokujabulela ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani, ukuze siqhamuke nesixazululo esiqinile nesokuziphendulela. Ngale ndlela, umcimbi wokulahlwa kwemfucuza uzothuthukisa indlela esibuka ngayo imfucuza, okuzomelapha imiphakathi yethu nezizwe. Ubuchwepheshe obunikeza izixazululo ezinhle kumkhakha wobuchwepheshe kuzolekelela ukuphucula ubudlelwano bethu nezimpilo zethu, ukuphuhlisa imiphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi imvelo yethu iyaphumelela. Kumele sikhulume, sixhumane, futhi sizame ngaphezu kokulindela, sifune izixazululo ezilisekelo ezinezindleko eziphansi unyaka wonke.
Zonke izimpahla onazo kanye nezikweletu - ungumnikazi noma unedebhithi? Uma ungumsebenzi wezohwebo noma umkhiqizi, kufanele ube nesitatimende esicacile esibonisa zonke izimpahla onazo nezikweletu ozibophezela kuzo. Unazo ezingaki futhi iyini idebhithi yakho? Ukulima kuwuhwebo futhi ukutshalwa kwezimali kudinga imali eningi. Ngokuvamile, umfarmu udinga ukweleta okuthile noma konke okudingekayo ukuze aqale ukutshala (inzuzo). Ababolekisi badinga ukuthola lonke ulwazi mayelana nebhizinisi lomfarmu - badinga ukwazi konke okuhlobene nezimpahla nezikweletu. Njalo, abafarmi bavame ukwesaba ukuhlinzeka ngalo ulwazi, kodwa izikhungo zezimali zingaluthola (njengoba kushiwo kuMthetho Wokubolekwa Kwezimali), futhi uma ungeke uthethele kahle, bazokwazi futhi uzolahlekelwa ukwethembeka kwabo futhi ungaphumeleli ukuthola imali obufuna ukuyiboleka. Uma ufuna ukuba umkhiqizi ohlala phambili esikhathini esizayo, kufanele uvumele zonke izikweletu zakho - beka konke etafuleni futhi uvumele labo abanolwazi ngezindaba zezimali bakusize.
Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elingaphansi (GEMS subordinate member classification) Ngiyabingelela, mngani. Ngifuna ukuxoxa nawe ngendaba ethile ebalulekile, okuyi-GEMS subordinate member classification. Le ndaba ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezinsiza zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwempilo, kanye nezindlela abantu abathola ngazo usizo lwezempilo. Kukhona amaqembu ahlukene ngaphakathi kwe-GEMS, futhi lezi ziqephu zihlukaniswa ngokwezinga lezakhamuzi, ezihlanganisa amalungu angaphansi. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola usizo lwezempilo bahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezihlukene, ukuze kube lula ukulawula izinsiza nezindleko. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi zihlukaniswa zisebenza kanjani? Kulula, ngempela. Uma uhlukaniswa njengelungu elingaphansi, kusho ukuthi ungomunye wabantu abathola izinzuzo ezithile ngaphakathi kwalesi simo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo ezithile zokwelashwa, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nezinye izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile ezichaza ukuthi ubani ongena kulolu hlobo, futhi yini okufanele ayilindele. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umuntu engumsebenzi ophansi, noma engakatholi izinga eliphezulu lemfundo, ungase abe nelungelo lokuba yilungu elingaphansi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindleko zokwelashwa zingase zibe phansi kuye uma kuqhathaniswa nabanye abathola izinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kukhombisa ukuthi i-GEMS iyazama ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubheka izinga labo lemfundo noma izinga labo lomsebenzi. Kodwa-ke, kukhona izinselelo ezihambisana nale ndlela yokuhlukaniswa. Abanye abantu bangase bazizwe bengafaneleki, noma bangakutholi kahle ukuthi kungani behlukaniswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okucacile phakathi kwe-GEMS namalungu ayo, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinqubo ezikhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza, ukuze abantu abahlangabezana nezinguquko ezithile empilweni yabo bakwazi ukushintsha izigaba zabo uma kudingeka. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kahle? Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bangase babe nemibuzo eminingi, futhi lokho kuhle. Ukuze siqhubeke nokwenza ngcono lezi zinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezingxoxo ezivulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi noma baphila kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS iyazama ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezitholakalayo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, noma labo abangenazo izinsiza eziningi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuhlinzeka ngempilo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziqhubeka nokwenza ngcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezihlukene zokuxhasa abantu, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo lwezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela kanjani, futhi yini okufanele bayilindele. Ngiyazi ukuthi le ndaba ingase ibonakale iyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezingxoxo ezivulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS iyini, nokuthi lezi zihlukaniswa zisebenza kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo lwezempilo. Ngakho, mngani, uma uneminye imibuzo, ungathandabuzi ukubuza. Lezi zihlukaniswa zibalulekile, futhi kufanele sibe nezingxoxo ezivulekile ukuze sithole ukuqonda okuhle. Sihlanganyela ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele, ngaphandle kokubheka izinga labo lemfundo noma izinga labo lomsebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, futhi sikhuthaze umphakathi onempilo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi le ngxoxo izokwenza kube lula ukuqonda le ndaba ebalulekile. Hamba kahle!
Othisha - Abaholi Bezizukulwane Othisha bangabantu ababalulekile empilweni yethu, bephakathi kwezinsika ezisemqoka ezakhiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izizukulwane ezilandelayo zithola imfundo efanele. Njengoba sithokozisa imfundo, kubalulekile ukubheka indima ebalulekile othisha abayidlalayo ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onolwazi, nolwazi. Uhlanga Lwezemfundo Othisha bahlala bejolise ekwakheni isizukulwane esiqondayo, esinobuhlakani. Njengoba befundisa, baphinde babe ngababambiqhaza ekwakheni izimiso zokuziphatha, ubudlelwano, kanye nezifundo zokuphila. Ngaphandle kokufundisa izifundo ezisemqoka, othisha baphinde bahloniphe izifiso nezifundo zomfundi ngamunye, beqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umfundi uthola ithuba lokukhula. Ubuhlakani Nobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula indlela othisha abaphatha ngayo imfundo. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza, izifundo eziku-inthanethi, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda, ziye zashintsha indlela yokufundisa. Othisha badinga ukuba bahlale befundisa ukuze bahlale behambisana nezinguquko. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu, njengoba kufanele bahlale bephokophele izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa ezizokwenza abafundi bahlale bejabule futhi bephokophele. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Ubudlelwano phakathi kothisha nabafundi bukhulu kakhulu. Othisha abavuli nje izifundo, kodwa baphinde babe ngababambiqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kothisha nabafundi buvumela abafundi ukuba bazizwe bekhululekile, bephakamisa izinkinga zabo, futhi baphendule imibuzo. Lokhu kudala indawo yokufunda enempilo, lapho abafundi bezizwa bekhululekile ukufunda nokuhlola. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Noma kunjalo, othisha bahlushwa izithiyo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, izinkinga zokuphila, kanye nezimo zomsebenzi ezinzima zenza kube nzima ukuba othisha benze umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi othisha babe nesibindi, bakwazi ukuphatha izimo ezinzima, futhi bahlale bephokophele izixazululo. Ukuxhaswa okuhle, kokubili emndenini nasemphakathini, kubalulekile ukuze othisha bakwazi ukwenza kahle emsebenzini wabo. Umthelela Emphakathini Umthelela othisha abanawo empilweni yomphakathi awukwazi ukwenziwa kube mncane. Othisha abaqeqeshi kuphela abafundi, kodwa baphinde babe ngababambiqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Abafundi abaphumelele bahlala bephakamisa izinga lempilo yomphakathi, bephinde baveze izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi ophilayo udinga abantu abanolwazi, abakhululekile, nabazimisele ukusiza abanye. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, othisha bahlala bebalulekile empilweni yethu. Bahlala bejolise ekwakheni izizukulwane ezizayo, bephinde bahloniphe izifiso nezifundo zomfundi ngamunye. Noma kungekho msebenzi olula, othisha bahlala bephokophele izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, beqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bejabule futhi bephokophele. Umthelela wabo empilweni yomphakathi awukwazi ukwenziwa kube mncane, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokuxhasa othisha bethu, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, masihloniphe othisha bethu, sibabonge ngomsebenzi wabo oncomekayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi sikhuluma ngezidingo zabo, ukuze sithuthukise imfundo yethu kanye nomphakathi wethu. Othisha, ngempela, bangabantu abavula iminyango eminingi, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokubakhumbula njalo.
Umbiko Ngenhlangano Yezomthetho KwaZulu-Natal Isingeniso Kulolu cwaningo, sizobheka izindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta ezomthetho KwaZulu-Natal, sikhuluma ngempumelelo nezithiyo ezibhekene nezinhlelo zomthetho. Izinqubo zomthetho zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onokuthula, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa. Ukwakhiwa Komthetho Ukuze umthetho ube neqhaza eliphumelelayo emphakathini, kubalulekile ukuthi udlule ezinqubweni ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa, ukufaka iziphakamiso, nokuhlolwa kwezinhlelo zomthetho. KwaZulu-Natal, uhulumeni uhlose ukwenza izinguquko ezisemqoka ezindleleni zokwakhiwa komthetho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho uyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga Ezinzima Nokho, izinkinga ezithile zikhona ezweni lethu. Ubulungiswa buphikiswa ngezinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza, ukungabi namathuba alinganayo, kanye nezinkinga zezombusazwe. Lokhu kudala ukuthi kube nezinselelo ezinkulu zokufinyelela ezomthetho kubantu abavamile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezakhamuzi basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ubulungiswa Kukhona izinhlelo ezithile ezibhekelele ukuthuthukiswa kobulungiswa KwaZulu-Natal. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zomthetho nabantu, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ngesimo sezomthetho, zibalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde amalungelo abo, futhi baziswe ngezindlela zokuzifaka emthethweni. Ukubhekana Nezinselelo Zokwephula Umthetho Ukuze kubhekwe izinselelo zokwephula umthetho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokubamba abaphula umthetho. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokubopha, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukufundisa abaphula umthetho ngethuba lokuqala. Izinhlelo zokubuyisela abantu emphakathini ziyasebenza kakhulu ekunciphiseni inani labantu abaphula umthetho. Ukubaluleka Kwezinsizakusebenza Zomthetho Izinsizakusebenza zomthetho, kufaka phakathi izikhungo zomthetho, abameli, kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakala emphakathini, zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomthetho, kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinsizakusebenza zibe sezindaweni ezilula ukufinyelela, futhi zibe nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana. Ukwazi Ukufinyelela Kwezobulungiswa Ukwazi ukufinyelela kwezobulungiswa kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abo. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukufundisa, kanye nemikhankaso yokwazisa ingasiza ekwandiseni ukuqonda kwabantu ngezindlela zokufinyelela ezomthetho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazi lapho kufanele baye khona uma behlangabezana nezinkinga zomthetho. Isiphetho Ngaphezu kwakho konke, umthetho kufanele ube yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onokuthula, futhi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezakhamuzi kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuvikela amalungelo akhe. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezinhle, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwakha umthetho, nokubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona, kuzoletha ushintsho oluhle ezomthethweni KwaZulu-Natal. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zomthetho, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho uyaphumelela. Ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uqhubeke nokusebenzisa izinsiza zomthetho ezitholakalayo kuzogqugquzela ukuqonda okukhulu nokusebenzisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ubulungiswa, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nempilo engcono. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo manje zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezizukulwaneni ezizayo, ngakho sizodinga ukuba sonke sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa.
Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Imijondolo: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Imijondolo iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingaphansi komnotho. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zenzelwe ukukhulisa izinga lempilo yabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinjalo. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo azilokothi zibe nezinzuzo kuphela; zinezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukuxoxwa ngazo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zikhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni ubonisa ukuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ngokwakha imijondolo emisha, abantu banethuba lokuphila endaweni enempilo, enezinsiza eziyisisekelo ezifana namanzi ahlanzekile, ugesi, nezikole. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukufinyelela emathubeni omsebenzi, okwakha umnotho ozinzile. Ngakho, lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zithola ukugxekwa ngenxa yokungahambisani nezinqubomgomo zomphakathi. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhona kuphela ukuze kuhlanzwe izindawo ezidumile, kodwa azinaki izidingo zangempela zabantu abahlala kule mijondolo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokukhathazeka ngokuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingasatshiswa kahle yini, noma zisebenze ngokuphumelelayo ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukuxhaswa ngemali eyanele. Ukuntuleka kwemali kungaholela ekutheni izinhlelo zihluleke, okukhombisa ukuthi ukuxhaswa kwezomnotho kubalulekile. Uma uhulumeni engakabi nezinsiza ezanele, lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhlinzekwa okungafanele, okungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinzuzo ezincane. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nezenzo ezisebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabaxhasi bezimali. Okwesithathu, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukufaka izwi labantu abahlala kulezi zindawo. Abantu bahlala ngaphakathi kwemijondolo, futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubandakanya abantu emaphaketheni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kwandise umuzwa wokuba nempilo. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, bazobe bejabulile futhi bephendula kahle ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona nemiphumela emibi yokuthuthukiswa kwemijondolo. Abanye abantu bakholwa ukuthi imijondolo emisha ingaholela ekutheni kube nokwandiswa kwezindawo ezithile, okukhathaza abanye. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuphazamiseka kwemvelo, kanye nezinkinga zokwandisa izindawo ezingaphansi komphakathi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle lezi zinhlelo ukuze zingalimazi imvelo. Ngokuphetha, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zinezinto eziningi ezinhle, kodwa zidinga ukunakwa okuningi. Ukubandakanya abantu, ukuxhaswa ngemali, kanye nokuhlonza izidingo zangempela zabantu, kuzokwenza lezi zinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngakho, uma uhulumeni efuna ukuthuthukisa imijondolo, kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono, hhayi ukubangela ezinye izinkinga. Umphakathi unelungelo lokuphila endaweni engcono, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo kufanele zibe yinsika yokufeza lokhu. Izenzo ezinhle, ukuhlela okuhle, nokubambisana kuzoholela empumelelweni ekuthuthukiseni imijondolo.
Umbiko: Abafundi Basenyuvesi Isingeniso Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bebamba iqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, bekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango emisha, ubuhlakani, nezixazululo ezidingekayo ezindabeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile njengoba izikhungo zemfundo zikhula, futhi zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphendule izinselelo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezimpilweni zabafundi, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nemithelela yokufunda kwabo ezweni. Isimo Sabafundi Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bephuma ezizindeni ezahlukene, bevela emakhaya ahlukene, futhi bephuma ezimfundisweni ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onohlonze, ogcwele ubuhlakani obuhlukahlukene. Abafundi bahlala bejolise ekutholeni ulwazi olujulile, nokwakha amakhono adingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi wabo ungumthombo wobungane, oxhasa abafundi ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi ubasiza ukuba bakhe izixhumanisi ezibalulekile. Izinselelo Abafundi Abahlangabezana Nazo Noma kunjalo, abafundi basenyuvesi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu kubo iwukushoda kwemali. Imali yokufunda, izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nezindleko zokuphila zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukuhlela izimali zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye badinge ukusebenza ngenkathi befunda, okungaba nomthelela ongemuhle emiphumeleni yabo yokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka kwengqondo kuyinkinga ethinta abafundi abaningi. Ukukhathazeka ngokuhluleka, izivivinyo, kanye nezibopho zomndeni kungadala umqondo wokukhathazeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqhube imikhankaso yokuxhasa abafundi, ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga zengqondo. Izinhlelo Zokuxhasa Abafundi Izikhungo zemfundo ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuxhasa abafundi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelulekwa, izikhungo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthola imithombo yokuxhaswa kwezimali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi banethuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, futhi bathole izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphumelele ezifundweni zabo. Imithelela Yokufunda Ukufunda kwaba yindlela yokukhulisa umqondo, futhi kubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bejolise ekutholeni ulwazi olusha, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni babe neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yabo, bekwazi ukusiza abanye abantu. Abafundi abaphumelelayo bahlala bephakamisa izinga lokufunda, futhi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala benomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Noma beface izinselelo eziningi, izikhungo zemfundo ziyaqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, ukuze baphumelele. Ukufunda akuyona nje indlela yokuthola ulwazi, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhulisa umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abafundi, sibanikeze amandla, futhi sibavumele ukuba babe nomthelela omuhle ezweni. Ukuxhasa abafundi basenyuvesi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nelikhanyayo.
Ngempela kuyinjabulo enkulu kithi ukuhlanganyela nomphakathi waseHlabisa namuhla kulolu suku oluyingqopha-mlando lokwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa le ndawo. Le ndawo ingesinye sezindawo ezithintekile kakhulu ukungabheki kahle kuk government ye-apartheid, enenjongo eyodwa yokucindezela abantu bethu njengababukeli futhi ibavimbele ekuthuthukiseni. Sihlangene namuhla njengohulumeni babantu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indawo yaseHlabisa iyakhuliswa futhi ithathe indawo yayo efanele ngokudlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wethu wesifunda. I-Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs imemezele izinhlelo ezibalulekile ezihloselwe ukuvuselela nokwakha amandla okusebenza kwamamaskandi esifundeni sethu, ukuze kusheshiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zomphakathi abakhonza. Senza lesi sithembiso ngoba njengohulumeni, siqonda kahle ukuthi ohulumeni bendawo basondelene kakhulu nabantu futhi kumele babe nesandla esibonakalayo ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bethu. Njengohulumeni, sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile empini yokulwa nobuphofu nasekuletheni izinsizakalo ezisemqoka kubantu bethu. Naphezu kokuthuthuka esikwenze, siyazi kahle ukuthi kusekhona izinkinga ezithile ezisemqoka ezithinta izimpilo zabantu bethu nsuku zonke. Siyazi ukuthi kwezinye zamamaskandi ethu, njengakuleli eHlabisa, abantu bethu basadinga ugesi, izindlu zangasese ezihlanzekile, namanzi ahlanzekile. Emizamweni yethu yokwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, sethule uhlelo olusha lokweseka amamaskandi olwaziwa ngokuthi i-Project Consolidate, oluhloselwe ukusiza amamaskandi afana neHlabisa ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi ezisemqoka. Ngesikhathi senza uhlolo nocwaningo ngalesi maskandi lapha, iHlabisa municipality yatholakala njengomaskandi odinga ukwesekwa okukhulu kuhulumeni ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi. Sihlangene namuhla eHlabisa ukuze sethule izinhlelo ezihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu kule ndawo. Ukuba lapha namuhla ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu kubonisa ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kwale ndawo kuhulumeni wethu futhi kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kufinyelela kubo bonke ababambiqhaza bomphakathi wethu. Sihlangene namuhla ukuze siqale ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lokweseka ngqo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwalesi maskandi lapha, futhi sizovula ngokusemthethweni ofisi ezintsha zamamaskandi eHlabisa. Sikholelwa ukuthi ukuvulwa kweofisi ezintsha zamamaskandi eHlabisa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuletha ushintsho kule ndawo ukuze ikwazi ukudlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni isifunda sethu. Sibone kulo lonke izwe ukuthi abantu abaningi baveze ukukhala ngokuqhubeka kwezinsizakalo. Njengoba kuvamile, amamaskandi ethu yiyo eyabhekwa kabi ngalokhu. Nokho, kufanele kuthiwe amamaskandi ethu abenokuntuleka okukhulu kwezinsiza zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. Kungathiwa futhi amamaskandi ethu awanazo ngisho neofisi ezisebenzayo, futhi ngisho lapho kukhona ofisi, azinayo imishini yokusebenza efana namakhompyutha nezinye. Amamaskandi ethu awakwazi ukusebenza kahle ukwenza lokho abanikwe khona ngoba awanazo izinsiza ezanele nezakhiwo zokwenza imisebenzi yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, thina njengomnyango wesifunda we-Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, ngokuhambisana nomsebenzi wethu wokweseka, sithuthukisile futhi sizobheka ukusebenza kwamamaskandi ethu, futhi sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso ukuze amamaskandi akhe ofisi ezifanele ezifana nalokho okukhona lapha eHlabisa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kubantu. Umbono wombuso wesifunda ophathiswe nguMholi ohloniphekile uDkt. S.J. Ndebele uwukubona le ndawo ithuthuka ibe yidolobha eliphelele. Ngakho-ke, ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kweofisi zamamaskandi kanye nokwethulwa kwezinhlelo eziningi esizokwethula lapha namuhla kuyisinyathelo esihle sokufeza lo mbono. Ukuvulwa kweofisi zamamaskandi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emphakathini wale ndawo. Abantu bethu ngeke baphinde babe ngabantu abahluphekayo ngenxa yokuntuleka kweofisi ezifanele zokubasiza ngezidingo zabo noma ngenxa yokuthi ofisi zikhona kude futhi zikhala izakhiwo zokuhlangabezana nezinselelo zabo. Lezi zikhungo zizoba izikhungo zokuthuthukiswa kwalesi maskandi. Kumele zibe njengomlilo opholile obamba ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Lezi zikhungo kumele zisebenze kubo bonke abantu baseHlabisa kungakhathalekile ukuthi bangobani emkhakheni wabo wezinkolo noma izepolitiki. Kumele kube njalo ngoba ubuphofu, indlala, nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa akukhethile futhi akubuzi ukuthi umuntu usebenza kuphi. Ngesikhathi sithule uhlelo lwe-Project Consolidate, sakhumbuza ukuthi sizovakashela amamaskandi abamba iqhaza ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo ngenhloso yokwethula izinsizakalo zokweseka. Njengoba abantu lapha bedinga usizo kakhulu, sathi nakuba kunesidingo kwezinye izindawo, sizokwenza ukuqala konyaka omusha ngokuqala okusha ezimpilweni zabantu bethu lapha eHlabisa. Sihlonze izinhlelo ezisheshayo ezizovumela le ndawo ukuba ibe nesandla esibalulekile emnothweni wesifunda nasemhlabeni. Siyazi kahle ukuthi uma izwe lethu linquma ukukhulisa umnotho walo ngo-6 percent, indawo yaseHlabisa nayo kumele ibe nesandla. Indawo yaseHlabisa ikakhulukazi iyindawo yasemakhaya. Ngakho-ke, akumangalisi ukuthi sinezinga eliphezulu lobuphofu nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo ngenxa yesikhathi se-apartheid lapho ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yethu kwashiywa. Akumangalisi futhi ukuthi isisekelo somnotho wale ndawo asikathuthukiswa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sonke kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuze sakhe idolobha elinokwakhiwa kahle kokuphatha nezohwebo. Njengoba ezinye izindawo zasemakhaya, indawo yaseHlabisa inezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ubuphofu, nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa. Kule ndawo, iningi labantu bethu, okufanele baphathe umnotho, alikho emsebenzini ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuthuthukiswa. Imisebenzi yezolimo okwamanje ikhona kuphela ezingeni lokuphila. Kunezinto eziningi ezisafanele zenziwe ukuze kudaleke amathuba kulesi sikhungo sezolimo. Omunye wezinkinga ezinkulu okufanele zibhekwane nazo ukuntuleka kwamakhono okufunda kanye nezobuchwepheshe phakathi kwabantu abasha kule ndawo. Lokhu kuphazamiseka kukhulu ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezikhungo zokufunda kanye nezokufundisa. Izindaba ezinhle ukuthi uhulumeni ukhuluma phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le ndawo ithuthuka. Umphathi woHlelo, ezokuvakasha, ungomunye wezinhlelo zethu ezibalulekile emkhankasweni wethu wokuthuthukisa amathuba okutshala imali kulesi sifunda. Njengoba ngishilo, indawo yaseHlabisa ibusisiwe ngobuhle bemvelo obumangalisayo, obuhlotshiswe ngezintaba, izindawo eziphakeme, nezifudumele. Inokukhula kwemvelo okungama-World-class. Ngeshwa, uk
Umdanso: Ingxoxo Ngemidlalo YamaZulu Isingeniso Umdanso ungumkhuba obalulekile ezimpilweni zethu, ikakhulukazi kubantu baseMzansi nasezimpikweni zabo. Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnumzane Thabo Nkosi, umdansi ophumelelayo, onikeze umdanso wamaZulu ithuba lokudumelela emhlabeni. UThabo uzosiza ekuqondeni umdanso, ukuthi ungathuthukiswa kanjani, nokubaluleka kwawo ezimpilweni zethu. Umdanso Njengomkhuba Wokuxhumana Umbuzo: UThabo, ungachaza ukuthi umdanso ungumkhuba onjani kubantu? Impendulo: Umdanso ungumkhiqizo wezizwe, ungumkhuba wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Umdanso wamaZulu, ngokwesibonelo, ubalulekile ekuchazeni izinkumbulo, izinsiza, nezinsuku ezikhethekile. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma, umdanso usetshenziswa njengendlela yokwabelana ngothando, ubuhlakani, kanye nemizwa. Ubuciko Bemdanso WamaZulu Umbuzo: Yiziphi izici ezihlukile ezenza umdanso wamaZulu uhluke kwezinye izitayela zomdanso? Impendulo: Umdanso wamaZulu uhlanganisa izinzwa ezahlukene — izinyathelo, izwi, nezimpahla. Lokhu kudlalwa kwezinyathelo kuhambisana nemigqa yezenzakalo ezithile, futhi izigqi zawo zihlala zicacile futhi zikhangayo. Abadansi bamaZulu baphinde basebenzise izimpahla ezihlukahlukene — njengezikhindi, izicathulo, nezembatho ezihlotshisiwe — ukuze baveze ubuhle balesi siko. Umdanso Nempilo Yomuntu Umbuzo: Umdanso ungalimpacta kanjani impilo yomuntu? Impendulo: Umdanso ungathuthukisa impilo yomuntu ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, uyasiza ekukhululeni ingcindezi. Umdansi uvame ukuzizwa ejabule futhi ekhululekile uma edansa. Okwesibili, umdanso unika abantu ithuba lokuziveza. Umuntu unezindlela eziningi zokubonisa imizwa yakhe, futhi umdanso uwusizo ekufinyeleleni lokho. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulu empilweni yomntwana njengoba kukhuthaza ukuzethemba. Izifundo Zokudansa Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi izifundo zomdanso zibalulekile emiphakathini yethu? Impendulo: Ngempela! Izifundo zomdanso zibalulekile, ikakhulu ezikoleni. Zisiza abafundi ukuba bakhulise amakhono abo, baziqhenye ngamasiko abo, futhi baqonde kahle umhlaba. Futhi, uma sibheka umdanso wamaZulu, ezemidlalo zethu zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bahlukene, zikhuthaza imiphakathi. Umdanso Njengomsebenzi Umbuzo: UThabo, ungakuchaza kanjani ukubaluleka komdanso njengenhlangano ebambisene? Impendulo: Umdanso ungumsebenzi ongenza abantu babe nempumelelo. Abadansi abaningi baphumelela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdanso ungavula amathuba emisebenzi — kusukela ezinhlelweni zokwakha, ezokungcebeleka, kuze kube ekwakheni imicimbi emikhulu. Ngakho-ke, umdanso akusikho nje ukuzijabulisa, kodwa nakho ukwakha izimboni. Ubuntwana Nemdanso Umbuzo: Kukhona yini umqondo owodwa owakha umdanso ezimpilweni zabantu? Impendulo: Yebo, ngicabanga ukuthi umdanso uthinta wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi abantwana. Umdanso usiza abantwana ukuba baziwe, badlale, futhi bakhulise ubudlelwano. Umdanso uthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abasha, futhi uboza izizathu zokuthi kungani sithanda ukuhlanganyela imicimbi. Umntwana odansayo uzoba nekhono lokuba nezinhloso ezithile empilweni. Isiphetho Umbuzo: UThabo, yiziphi izeluleko ongathanda ukuhlinzeka kulabo abafuna ukuqala umdanso? Impendulo: Ngiyabonga! Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi umdanso umuhle, ungokwakho. Ngakho, ungazicabangeli ukuthi uthanda ukwakha amakhono akho. Qhubeka ufunde, udlale, futhi ungavumi ukuhlala phansi. Umdanso uyindlela yokuphila, futhi umhlaba udinga umdanso. Umlando Wokugcina Umdanso, njengokukhuluma, uyindlela yokuxhumana, ukuxhumana komoya. UThabo Nkosi usitshele ukuthi umdanso awuyona nje into yokuzijabulisa, kodwa ungumsebenzi, ubuciko, nezindlela zokuphila. Ngakho-ke, asithathe umdanso njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana ukuze sithokozise izimpilo zethu.
Ukufuduka Kwabantu Emakhaya Baya Emadolobheni Ekuqaleni, emakhaya amancane aseNingizimu Afrika, abantu babenokuphila okuthokozisayo. Izinkanyezi zazikhanya phezulu, izinkomo zazihamba emaphandleni, futhi imindeni yayihlangana emakhaya ukuze zikhulume, zidle, futhi zabelane ngezindaba. Kodwa, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinto zashintsha. Izinsiza zancipha, amathuba okusebenza ayeshoda, futhi abantu baqala ukufuna izindlela zokuphila ezingcono. UThandi, intombazane encane eyakhulela emakhaya, wayehlala ethokozisa umndeni wakhe ngezindaba ezimnandi. Kodwa, njengoba efunda, waqala ukubona ukuthi umhlaba ungaphezulu kokuphila emakhaya. Wayefuna ukufunda, ukufunda kahle, nokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngakho, ngesikhathi esithile, uThandi wanquma ukuthi kufanele ahambe aye emadolobheni, lapho amathuba okuphila engaphezulu. UThandi wathola umsebenzi endaweni yokudlela edolobheni elikhulu. Uhlanga lwakhe lwaluhlukile, futhi wayezama ukufunda indlela yokuphila edolobheni. Kodwa, izinto zazinzima. Ukuphila edolobheni kwakuhamba kancane, futhi izindleko zaziphakeme. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu abavela emakhaya babebhekene nezinkinga eziningi, njengokuhlala ezindlini ezincane, ukungabi nemali eyanele, kanye nokuhlukumezeka emsebenzini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukujwayela impilo edolobheni. Waqala ukwenza abangane, futhi wathola ukuthi abanye abantu bavele baphuma emakhaya afana naye. Babezama ukwakha impilo entsha, kodwa babezithola bephakathi kwezinkinga eziningi. UThandi waba nesibindi, wathola ukuthi akekho owodwa kuphela ophila lezi zinkinga. Kwakukhona umphakathi, abantu ababephila impilo efanayo, futhi babefuna ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngesikhathi esithile, uThandi waqala ukufunda ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona kuphela ukuhamba emakhaya, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlangana, lapho abantu abavela emakhaya bejabulisa, bexoxa ngezinkinga zabo, futhi befundisana. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Kodwa, uThandi waqaphela ukuthi akekho umuntu ongakhipha imiphumela emihle ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga. Abantu abavela emakhaya babebhekene nezithiyo eziningi, futhi uThandi waqala ukufuna izindlela zokubasiza. Waqala ukuxhumana nezikhungo ezahlukene, wathola izinsiza zokufunda, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu baphila kahle uma bephila ndawonye. Ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola iziqu, futhi waba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Abantu abavela emakhaya baphila kahle, futhi uThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ukufuduka akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi waphinda wavakashela emakhaya akhe. Waqonda ukuthi nakuba efuduke, imizi yakhe yayisakhula. Abantu abavela emakhaya bahlala bejabulile, bexoxa ngezindaba, futhi bejabulisa imindeni yabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi impilo edolobheni yayiyinsiza, kodwa imizi yakhe yayiyisisekelo. Waqonda ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi umphakathi ungakha impilo engcono. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukufuduka kwabantu emakhaya kuya emadolobheni akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukufunda, nokwakha ikusasa elingcono. UThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma ngabe sikhona emakhaya noma emadolobheni, umphakathi wethu uyinsiza enkulu, futhi kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi sitholakala ndawonye.
Isikhathi sokuvuna siseduze futhi kusekhona izinkambu eziningi ezigcwele izihlahla. Izingxoxo zethu zihlala zibuyela kulokhu: izihlahla ziyisitha esikhulu sokukhiqiza ukudla. Into ebaluleke kakhulu uma kukhiqizwa izitshalo zokudla ukuphatha nokususa izihlahla. Uma kukhona izihlahla, umkhiqizo uzobhekana nezinkinga ngezindlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi ukulahlekelwa okukhulu komkhiqizo futhi imbewu izonakala. Emhlabeni jikelele, kunokuntuleka kwembewu yokudla, ngakho asikwazi ukuvumelana nokuthi imbewu iphenywe ngoba ilimele ngenxa yezinhlamvu zezihlahla. Izinhlamvu zommbila azivunyelwe ukuba zibe phakathi kwemikhiqizo ngoba zineziphuzo ezilimazayo futhi ummbila awudliwa abantu noma izilwane. Mayelana nomthetho ophatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo kanye nokuhlanzeka kwezinhlamvu, kunezinhlobo zezihlahla ezingavunyelwe neze phakathi kwemikhiqizo. Ngokwesibonelo, ngokwezimiso zomthetho, akufanele kube khona imbewu eyodwa ye-thorn apple (datura). IDatura inenhlanzeko engalimaza umuntu kakhulu. Izinto ezibalulekile esizifundayo uma sibheka ukuphathwa kwezihlahla ukususa umonakalo wokuqala emibewwini. Ummbila ongenazo izihlahla futhi ongonakele uwumphumela wokuphatha kahle izitshalo zakho njalo, hhayi ukuzama lapha nalapho ukuwabulala izihlahla. Uma ukususa okusheshayo kwezihlahla ngesikhathi sokutshala kungasebenzi kahle, izihlahla kufanele zikhishwe emkhakheni ngaphambi kokuvuna. Uma izihlahla ezinkulu zisuswa emkhakheni ngemuva kokuba nezihloko, kuzoba ngcono ukuwasha lezo zihlahla ukuze kuvinjelwe ekuphakamiseni kwazo futhi ngonyaka ozayo. Khumbula, umkhiqizo omuhle ubonisa ukuthi kukhona izimbewu zommbila eziningi - izimbewu eziningi ezihlanzekile!
Ukubhikisha Kwabafundi – Ukuhlola Emhlabeni Wanamuhla Ukubhikisha kwabafundi sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezikhungweni zemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kukhombisa ubuhlakani nezinselelo abafundi abahlangabezana nazo. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zibhikisho, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu ezisemqoka, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zivele. Izizathu Zokubhikisha Abafundi bahlangana ukuze baveze izizathu ezithinta impilo yabo yokufunda. Izimo ezinjengohlelo lokufunda olungasebenzi kahle, imithetho engahambisani nezidingo zabo, kanye nezindleko zokufunda eziphakeme zenza abafundi bazizwe badinga ukuveza izinkinga zabo emphakathini. Ngokwesibonelo, ukubhikisha ezikhungweni ezinkulu, njengezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, kubonisa isidingo sokuhambelana nezifundo nezidingo zempilo zanamuhla. Abafundi abaphuma emkhakheni we-IT bangase bahlupheke uma imfundo ethuthukile ingatholakali, okukhombisa ukuthi ukufunda kahle kubalulekile empilweni yabo. Imiphumela Yokubhikisha Imiphumela yokubhikisha ingahluka kakhulu. Kwezinye izimo, iziphakamiso zabafundi ziyaqashelwa, okuholela ezinguqukweni ezinhle njengokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha zokufunda noma ukwehliswa kwezindleko. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abafundi kufanele bahlale bejabule futhi baphakamise izinkinga zabo ngendlela efanele. Nokho, kwezinye izimo, ukubhikisha kungaholela ezinkingeni, njengokuphazamiseka kwezemfundo, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ekufundeni kwabo. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Kubhalwe ukuthi abafundi baphakamise izinkinga zabo ngendlela ehloniphekile, ngokuxoxa nezikhungo zemfundo, ukubamba imihlangano nezikhulumi, noma ukuvula izingxoxo nomphakathi. Ukubambisana nabanye kungasiza ekwakheni umfanekiso ophelele wezinkinga ezikhona, okuzodala umphakathi ophumelelayo lapho abafundi bezokwazi ukuveza izinjongo zabo. Isiphetho Ukubhikisha kwabafundi kuyisiko elibalulekile elikhombisa amandla abafundi ekuphenduleni ezinkingeni ezithinta impilo yabo yokufunda. Nakuba kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokubhikisha, kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Ukuze abafundi baphumelele, kudinga ukuba bahlale bephakamisa izinkinga zabo futhi bejabule, bazi kahle ukuthi izinguquko zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ngakho, ukubhikisha akukhona nje ukugxila ezinkingeni, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono kwabafundi.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Kwake kwaba khona umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele abantu abajabule, izinsizwa nezintombi ezidansa emigwaqweni, zikhuluma ngezinto ezinhle. Kodwa phakathi kwalezi zinsizwa, kwakukhona uThabo, umfana owayenokukhanya okukhulu emehlweni akhe, kodwa owayesebenzisa izidakamizwa. UThabo wayengumfana ophumelelayo, efunda kahle esikoleni, kodwa kwaba khona umoya omubi owawumjolisa emhlabeni wezidakamizwa. UThabo waqala ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ngemuva kokuhlangana noSipho, umngane wakhe owayenobudlelwano obubi nezidakamizwa. USipho wayenokuthanda okukhulu kokuphila okusheshayo, futhi wathola uThabo esebenzisa izidakamizwa ukuze akwazi ukujabulisa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThabo wayengazi ukuthi lezi zinto zazingamphuca konke okwakukhona empilweni yakhe. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uThabo waqala ukulahlekelwa yizinto ezibalulekile. Uthando lwakhe lokufunda lwashabalala, futhi izifundo zakhe zaphenduka umthwalo omkhulu. Abangane bakhe baphenduka kancane, behluleka ukuqonda ukuthi kungani uThabo engasekho njengesikhumbuzo esihle. UThabo waba yisithombe esingaphili, edlula phakathi kwabantu, kodwa engaboni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana, uThabo wathola ukuthi ubuhlungu obubangelwa yizidakamizwa buphindaphinda. Waqala ukuhamba ezindaweni ezinzima, ezindaweni ezithile eziphithizelayo, lapho abanye abantu bephila khona. UThabo wathola ukuthi izidakamizwa zazingamphucukile, zamsusa emndenini wakhe, zamsusa ezikoleni, futhi zamsusa empilweni yakhe. Ngesinye isikhathi, uThabo wathola umngane omusha, uNandi, owayenothando olukhulu lokusiza abantu abahluphekayo. UNandi wayenokholo olukhulu ekutheni uThabo angabuyela empilweni yakhe. Wamkhuthaza ukuba abuyele esikoleni, aphinde azame ukuphila impilo engcono. UThabo waqala ukubona ukuthi akekho owaziyo ukuthi uzokwazi kanjani ukuphuma kulokhu, kodwa uNandi wayemkhuthaza njalo. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, uThabo wanquma ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokushiya izidakamizwa. Waqala ukuhamba noNandi, bejolisa emiphakathini yokwelashwa, lapho abanye abantu bephila impilo efanayo. UThabo wathola ukuthi akekho owodwa kuphela ophila ngale ndlela, futhi lokhu kumenze waba nesibindi sokubhekana nezinkinga zakhe. UThabo waqala ukufunda kabusha, futhi wathola ukuthi ukufunda kwakuyindlela yokuphila. Waqala ukubhala izincwadi, echaza izifundo zakhe, nokuthi izidakamizwa zamsusa kanjani empilweni yakhe. Wafunda ukuthi ukuphila akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi ukufuna indlela yokuphila kahle. Ngemuva kokuhamba noNandi, uThabo wathola ukuthi ubuhlungu obubangelwa yizidakamizwa buphelile. Waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabangane bakhe, futhi wathola ukuthi uthando nokuxhaswa kwabangane kungamphatha kahle. UThabo waba yisibonelo esihle emphakathini, ebonisa abanye ukuthi kungenzeka ukuphuma ezinkingeni. UThabo waphinde wathola ithuba lokukhuluma emphakathini, echaza izifundo zakhe. Wafundisa abanye abantu ukuthi izidakamizwa zingamphuca konke, kodwa ukuphila okuhle kungenzeka uma umuntu ethatha isinyathelo sokuphuma. Waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi akekho ophila ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, kodwa umoya wokuphila ungabuyiselwa. Ekugcineni, uThabo waba ngumfana ophilayo, owayenokukhanya okukhulu emehlweni akhe. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola imfundo ephakeme, futhi waba ngumholi emphakathini. UThabo waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma ubani angaphila impilo engcono, uma enokholo, uthando, nokuxhaswa. UThabo waba yisithombe sokuphila, esikhumbuza bonke abantu ukuthi impilo iyigugu, futhi kufanele siyigcine.
Ukuphila Emadolobheni - Ingxoxo noMnumzane Thulani Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnumzane Thulani, ongumhlali wethu odumile emadolobheni, ukuze sihlolisise ukuphila kwansuku zonke emadolobheni. UThulani ungumuntu ohloniphekile, oneminyaka engu-35, ophila eThekwini. Kanjani ukuphila kwakhe emadolobheni? Ake sizwe ngaye. Umbuzo 1: UThulani, ungazichaza kancane ngempilo yakho eThekwini? “Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Ukuphila eThekwini, njengemadolobha amaningi, kunokuhle nokubi. Ngikahle kakhulu, kodwa futhi nginobunzima. Njengomuntu osebenza ezinsizakalweni, ngiyakhumbula ukuthi izindleko zokuphila zanda, ikakhulukazi ezindlini. Nokho, imisebenzi eminingi iyatholakala, futhi kukhona amathuba amaningi okukhula.” Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ozithola emadolobheni? “Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, ubani ongaqondi? Izinhlelo zokuhamba, izimoto zomphakathi, zigcwele kakhulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kubekhona ukuhamba okungahambi kahle. Futhi, ezinye izindawo zinezinga eliphezulu lokuhlukunyezwa, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila kahle. Kodwa-ke, ngithanda isiko lethu, imicimbi, nezindawo ezihlukahlukene ezitholakala lapha.” Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo ziphumelele kangakanani? “Ngicabanga ukuthi izinzuzo zempilo emadolobheni ziningi. Ubuqotho bomphakathi buhle kakhulu. Ukuthola abantu abasha, ukuhlangana nemibono ehlukene, kuyathokozisa. Ngithanda ukufunda ngezamasiko ahlukene, futhi lokho kungenza ngibe nobungane obuningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunemithombo eminingi yokuzilibazisa, izindawo zokudlela, namakhefi.” Umbuzo 4: Uthembisa kanjani ukujabulisa impilo yakho phakathi kwezinselelo? “Njengoba ngishilo, ngizama ukuthola ukufinyelela kumathuba. Ngiyazama ukujolisa emisebenzini yami, kodwa futhi kumele ngithole isikhathi sokuzilibazisa. Ngithanda ukuhamba ngezinyawo emigwaqweni eThekwini, ngibuke izindawo ezinhle. Ngithanda nokubamba iqhaza emicimbini eyimikhuba yamasiko.” Umbuzo 5: Ucabangani ngempilo yempilo yempilo? “Empeleni, imvelo ibalulekile. Njengabantu abahlala emadolobheni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sihlala singabantu bezemvelo. Ngizama ukuvivinya umzimba futhi ngithathe isikhathi sokuphumula, ngikhumbule ukuhamba emaphakathini, nokuba nemvelo. Lokhu kuyasiza ekwakheni impilo eyinhloko.” Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izeluleko ongazinika abantu abasha abafuna ukuphila emadolobheni? “Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalombuzo. Okokuqala, kufanele uqaphele izindleko zokuphila. Qinisekisa ukuthi unayo imali eyanele ukuze ukwazi ukudla, ukuhamba, nempilo. Bamba iqhaza emiphakathini, ungazifihli. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nethuba lokudlula ezinkingeni. Futhi, ungathandabuzi ukufuna usizo lapho kudingeka.” Umbuzo 7: UThulani, kukhona okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokuphila emadolobheni? “Yebo, ngiyazi, isikhathi asimangazi. Ngibona abantu abaningi bejolisa ezinkingeni zomhlaba. Ukuphila emadolobheni kumele kube yindlela yokuphila enempilo, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuhamba phambili. Ngicabanga ukuthi imiphakathi iyashintsha, futhi abantu badinga ukuvumelana nezimo.” Isiphetho Ngokubamba le ngxoxo noMnumzane Thulani, sithole ukuqonda okujulile ngempilo emadolobheni. Ukuphila eThekwini kunokuthokozisa, kepha kunobunzima obuthile. Kubalulekile ukuba sithathe izinyathelo ukuze siqhubeke nenjongo yokuphila kahle. Njengabantu, sithanda ukujabulisa izimpilo zethu, futhi le ngxoxo isibonisa ukuthi, noma izinselelo zikhona, ubuchwepheshe, imikhuba, nezinsiza zingaba yizinsiza ezinkulu ekugcineni. UThulani ungumfanekiso ophumelelayo ohlangabezana nezinsuku zansuku zonke, futhi sitha konke okwaziyo ukuze sizuze impilo engcono.
Ukushoda Kukagesi: Isidingo Sokubheka Izixazululo Zesikhathi Esizayo Kusukela ezikhathini zakudala, ugesi ubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Ugesi usetshenziswa emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, kusukela ezindlini zethu, emabhizinisini, nasezikhungweni zomphakathi, kuze kube sekwakheni izinsiza ezisemqoka ezinjengezibani, amafriji, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Nokho, sekuphele iminyaka ethile sibuye sithole izinkinga ezinkulu zokushoda kukagesi. Ukushoda kukagesi akusikhumbuzi nje kuphela izinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezokusebenza, kodwa futhi kuveza nesidingo sokuthi sifune izixazululo ezisemqoka. Ngokwenyuka kokushoda kukagesi, kucacile ukuthi le nkinga ibangelwa izizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlole izinsiza zokukhiqiza ugesi. Izikhungo zokukhiqiza ugesi ezisebenzisayo amalahle, ikakhulukazi, ziye zaba yingozi emvelweni. Ukuze sibe nempilo engcono, sidinga ukunciphisa ukuncika kwethu ezinsizeni ezilimazayo. Ukwakha izikhungo zokukhiqiza ugesi ezisebenzisa imithombo engrenewable, efana nelanga, umoya, kanye namanzi, kungaba yindlela yokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kukagesi ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Okwesibili, ukujolisa kwezemvelo kubalulekile. Izinhlelo zokuvuselela ugesi, ezibandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezisebenza ngogesi ophuma emithonjeni yemvelo, kulindeleke ukuthi zibe yizixazululo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imithombo yethu yokukhiqiza, kunciphise ukuncika kumalahle, futhi kuvimbele ukwanda kwemiphumela emibi yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kuzodingeka ukuze sifeze lezi zifiso. Ngaphandle kokukhathalela izinsiza, kudingeka futhi sikhulume ngezindlela zokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Izinhlelo zokonga ugesi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi, zingasiza ekunciphiseni ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Ukuze sihlole indlela esisebenzisa ngayo ugesi, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngendlela yokusebenzisa kagesi kahle. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufundisa abantu ngezinsiza ezihamba phambili, njengezibani ze-LED, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zethu zokwakha nezokuthuthukisa zidinga ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuphucula izinsiza ezikhona. Ukuthuthukisa imithombo yokufaka ugesi ezindlini, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi kuzokhulisa ukufinyelela kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lempilo yethu. Izinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi nazo kufanele zikhuthazwe ukuthi zisebenzise izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nokushoda kukagesi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha izikhungo ezintsha zokukhiqiza, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokwandisa imithombo yokukhiqiza. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithombo yokukhiqiza, njengokuhlanganisa ugesi ophuma emithonjeni ehlukahlukene, kuzothuthukisa ukuqina kokukhiqizwa kukagesi. Nakuba kunzima ukubhekana nale nkinga, akufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhamba phambili. Umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, futhi asikwazi ukuhamba emuva. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezinkampani ezizimele kuyadingeka ukuze siphumelele. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomthelela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, futhi abantu kufanele bathathe izinyathelo zokufundisa abanye ngenjongo yokwehlisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Ukushoda kukagesi akuyona inkinga ebalulekile kuphela, kodwa kuyisizathu sokuba sithole izixazululo ezikhona. Sidinga ukujolisa ekwakheni umphakathi othuthukile, ohlonipha imvelo, futhi okwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zesikhathi esizayo. Ukuphinde sibe nesithakazelo ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zethu zokuphila, kanye nokubeka phambili izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokugcina ugesi, kuzoholela ekutheni sifeze izinjongo zethu. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, futhi sithola amathuba amasha nsuku zonke. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obusha, nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu kuzoholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezithembekile. Ngakho, akumele sihlanganyele kuphela ekukhulumeni nganoma iyiphi inkinga, kodwa sizithathele izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sifeze umphakathi onempilo, ongamazulu, futhi ophumelelayo. Ukushoda kukagesi kumele kube yisikhumbuzo sokuthi sihamba phambili, sifuna izixazululo, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa lethu.
Ezomthetho: Ukuqonda Izimiso Zomthetho Nezindlela Zokuziphatha Ezomthetho, noma umthetho, uyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila komphakathi. Uhloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphila ngokuhloniphana, benza izinqumo ezilungile, futhi bagweme izenzo ezingafanele. Umthetho ungumhlahlandlela osetshenziselwa ukulawula izenzo zabantu, ukuvikela amalungelo, nokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Isisekelo Somthetho Umthetho ungahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa umthetho wombuso, umthetho wezomnotho, umthetho wezobudlelwano, nomthetho wezokuphepha. Umthetho wombuso ubhekelela izinqubomgomo ezisemthethweni ezibhekelela izwe, kanti umthetho wezomnotho ugxile ekulawuleni izimakethe, ukuthengiselana, kanye nezinkampani. Umthetho wezobudlelwano ubhekelela ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, njengemishado, izivumelwano, kanye nezinkinga ezivela phakathi kwabantu. Umthetho wezokuphepha, ngakolunye uhlangothi, uhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi, uvikele abantu ezinsongweni. Amalungelo Nezibopho Ngokuhambisana nomthetho, abantu banamalungelo athile, okungukuthi, amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amalungelo okukhuluma, amalungelo okukhuluma, amalungelo okuthola imfundo, kanye namalungelo okuphila. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinto azizange zibe khona ngaphandle kwezibopho. Umuntu ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonipha amalungelo abanye, okungukuthi, akufanele enze okuthile okungalimaza abanye noma ukuphula umthetho. Izindlela Zokuziphatha Umthetho awusikhuthazi kuphela ukuba siphile ngendlela efanele, kodwa futhi usinika izindlela zokuziphatha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqonde ukuthi izenzo zethu zinezimpempe ezithile. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umuntu ephula umthetho, kufanele abhekane nemiphumela ethile, efana nezijeziso, izigwebo, noma amacala. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi izenzo zabo zinezimpempe, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi onokuthula. Izinkantolo Nezinhlelo Zokuphatha Izinkantolo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni komthetho. Ziyizikhungo ezibhekelela ukuxazulula izingxabano, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda, nokwenza izinqumo ezisemthethweni. Uma umuntu ethola ukuthi amalungelo akhe aphuliwe, angaya enkantolo ukuze afune usizo. Izinkantolo zisebenza ngokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo zomthetho, futhi zihlala ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola ithuba lokuzwakalisa izikhalazo zabo. Umthetho Nezinguquko Zomphakathi Umthetho awuhlali unguye; uyashintsha futhi uthuthuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi umphakathi uqhubeka ushintsha, futhi izidingo zabantu ziyaqhubeka zikhula. Izinguquko zomthetho zenzeka ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umthetho uhambisana nezimo zamanje. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umthetho uhlale unempilo futhi ube usizo emphakathini. Ukubaluleka Kwezemfundo Ngomthetho Ukuze abantu baqonde kahle umthetho, kubalulekile ukufundiswa ngawo. Imfundo ngale ndaba ibalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde amalungelo abo, izibopho zabo, nezindlela zokuziphatha. Lokhu kuzosiza abantu ukuba bazi ukuthi bangaziphatha kanjani, futhi bazokwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abo uma kudingeka. Imfundo ngale ndaba ingatholakala ezikoleni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, noma ngokuqhubeka nezifundo ezikhethekile. Isiphetho Ezomthetho zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphila ngokuhloniphana, benza izinqumo ezilungile, futhi bagweme izenzo ezingafanele. Umthetho unikeza izindlela zokuziphatha, uvikele amalungelo, futhi uqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unokuthula. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke siqonde umthetho, siwuhloniphe, futhi siwusebenzise ukuze sakhe umphakathi ongcono. Ukufunda ngale ndaba kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, onokuthula, nolwazi.
Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula isu lokusebenza leMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke ethulwe nguNgqongqoshe. IMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke iwumphumela wezinkulumo eziningi ezazenzeka kusukela ngo-1995 lapho kwanikezwa khona iQembu Lezindaba Zolimi (LANGTAG). Isu lokusebenza linikeza iziqondiso ezizosebenza ekufezeni kahle leMithetho Yezilimi, kuthuthukiswe izakhiwo ezizoba nzima ekusebenzeni kwayo nasekuzameni ukuthuthukisa nokuqhakambisa izilimi zethu zendabuko zase-Afrika. Uhulumeni uyaziqonda izinselelo zokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungakho isu lokusebenza ligcizelela inqubo ethokozisayo yokwamukela ushintsho futhi ibheke phambili. Njengoba ukuthuthukiswa nokukhuthazwa kwezilimi zethu kubhekwa njengesisekelo seMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza lihlose ukusungula izakhiwo zolimi nezinhlelo ezifanele zokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi kwiMisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukubambisana esikubandakanya khona ezingeni likazwelonke, ezindaweni, nasemaphandleni kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi leMithetho Yezilimi isebenza kahle. Uma sicabanga ngezinselelo ezibhekene nohulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamizi zithola izinsizakalo ngokushesha futhi ukuthi ulimi luwumkhiqizo wokuxhumana nomphakathi, kubonakala ukuthi leMithetho Yezilimi kumele iqale ukusebenza ngokuphuthumayo. Ngale ndlela, ngifuna ukucela bonke abanye esibambisene nabo, kuhlanganise nezakhiwo nohulumeni kanye nezinsizakalo, kanye neBhodi Yezilimi Zendabuko yaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le Isu Lokusebenza lishintsha ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene kube yinto eqondile kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Le Isu Lokusebenza iyingxenye yeMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke (NLPF) eyenza ukuba kube namandla ezinhlinzeko zolimi njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 6 soMthethosisekelo ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996). Uma sekuqediwe, yonke leli phakethe izohlanganisa iMibiko yeMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza, uMthethosivivinywa wezilimi ophakanyisiwe kanye nezinhlinzeko zawo, kanye noMthethosivivinywa ophakanyisiwe weBhodi Yezazi Zezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Isu lokusebenza lihlinzekwa njengophakanyiso olwamukela ushintsho futhi lungashintshwa ngezakhiwo ezithile nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza izilimi ezahlukene. I-NLPF Policy Report yamemezelwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe ngomhla ka-3 kuZibandlela 2002. IBhodi yePhalamende yathola le mibiko ngomhla ka-12 kuNdasa 2003. Le mithetho ihlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanelekile kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni ukuze kukhuthazwe ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni, ulwazi, nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Lezi zinhloso zixhomeke empumelelweni yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zendabuko ezisengcupheni. Njengoba ulimi luwumkhiqizo wokuxhumana ezimpilweni nasezindaweni zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukudala izinhlelo zokubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona. Isu lokusebenza lichaza izakhiwo ezidingekayo nezinhlelo zokwenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leMithetho Yezilimi kanye nezinsizakalo zezimali ezikhokhelwa ezikhungweni zikazwelonke nezasezifundazweni zisebenza kahle. Le mithetho icacile mayelana nesikhala salolu suku oluqondile. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni (kazwelonke, zasezifundazweni, nezasekhaya) zibophelelekile ezinhlinzekweni zalesi simiso kanye nanoma yiziphi izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla noma ezisebenza emsebenzini womphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho. Umnyango noma isifunda ngasinye singakhetha ulimi lwabo lokusebenza. Nokho, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi akekho ophoqelelwe ukuthi asebenzise ulimi lwakhe. Uma kudingeka ukuhumusha noma ukuchaza idokhumenti ethile ngolimi oluthile, lokhu kuzokwenziwa. Mayelana nokuxhumana okubhalwe phansi, kufanele kulandelwe uhlelo lokushicilela oluqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene (kubhekwa izethameli, umlayezo, kanye nomongo) kulokhu okungadingi ukuhunyushwa kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11. Uma isikhungo esithile sikahulumeni sifuna ukuveza ulwazi ngokuqondile, kufanele shicilele ulwazi kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Ngaphansi kwezimo lapho imibhalo kahulumeni ingatholakali kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni, izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kazwelonke kufanele zishicilele idokhumenti ngesikhathi esifanayo, okungenani ngolimi lwezingu-6. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba kufanele usebenze uma kukhethwa izilimi ezihlangene neNguni kanye neSotho. Isimo esithile esidingekayo ukuthi silandelwe ukuthi okungenani izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kazwelonke zikhawulelwa ekushicileleni imibhalo esemthethweni ngolimi lwezingu-6 noma ngaphezulu. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba awusebenzi ezifundazweni ngoba zinegunya lokusebenzisa izilimi abazikhethayo. Izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zasekhaya zizokwenza isinqumo sokusebenzisa ulimi njengoba kufunwa umphakathi kulandela umgomo wezilimi owakhiwe esifundeni. Ngemuva kokunquma ulimi oluzosetshenziswa futhi olucelwe umphakathi, uhulumeni wasekhaya kufanele uthuthukise, ushicilele, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umthetho wezilimi ezahlukene uyasebenza, okumele kwenziwe ngokuxhumana eduze nomphakathi. Emibhalweni esemthethweni, ulimi olukhethwe yisakhamuzi kufanele lusetshenziswe. Zonke izindlela zokuxhumana kufanele zenzeke ngolimi olusemthethweni olukhethwe yilabo abantu noma indawo. Uma kudingeka, zonke izindlela kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kusebenze izinsiza zolimi ezifana nokuhumusha (ukulandela ukukhuluma, ukuhumusha ngesikhathi esifanayo, ukuhumusha ngefoni, noma ukuhumusha ngomsindo) uma kukhona indlela. Lokhu kusebenza ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni ezingeni lesifunda nakwazwelonke. Inqubo yokwenza lokhu okwenziwe ibhizinisi iqondiswa yizinhloso nezifiso ezibekwe kule mithetho. Lezi zindawo ezilandelayo zizogxilwa kuzo: a Ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zendabuko kuhambisana nokwakha izakhiwo nokuthuthukisa imikhiqizo efana nezichazamazwi nezincazelo zolimi. b Ukukhulisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinzuzo zezinqubomgomo zomphakathi zabelwa ngokufanele ngokuhlinzeka zonke izakhamizi ithuba lokufinyelela kuzo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yisiphi ulimi abakusebenzisa, inqobo nje uma kukhuthazwa ukubamba iqhaza kwabo nezwi ematsheni kahulumeni. c Ukuphathwa kwezilimi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni zine-ithuba lokusebenza nokukhulisa isithunzi soHulumeni. d Ukukhuthaza ukufunda izilimi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezidingo zeMisebenzi Yomphakathi, ukuthuthukisa ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi nokubonisa kahle izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izilimi ezahlukene. e Ukukhuthaza ukuvikelwa okuqinile ngokuhlanganyela kwezilimi
Ezokushicilela (Publishing) Umbuzo 1: Yini ezokushicilela? Impendulo: Ezokushicilela ziwumkhakha obalulekile emhlabeni wezincwadi, lapho imisebenzi yokubhala, efana nezincwadi, amaphephandaba, nezincwadi zocwaningo, ihlelwa, iphrintwa, futhi ithunyelwa kubafundi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izigaba eziningi, kusukela ekubhaleni, ekuhlelweni, nasekushicilelweni, kuze kube sekuthengisweni kwemikhiqizo yokugcina. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezisemqoka ezokushicilela? Impendulo: Izinyathelo ezisemqoka zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukubhala: Umsebenzi wokuqala uhlanganisa ukubhala okuqukethwe, okungaba yindaba, ucwaningo, noma izifundo. 2. Ukuhlela: Lapha, abahleli bahlola, bahlaziya, futhi benza izinguquko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kulungile futhi kuhlelekile. 3. Ukushicilela: Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izincwadi noma amaphephandaba, kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe bokuphrinta. 4. Ukuthengisa: Ekugcineni, imikhiqizo ithunyelwa ezitolo, kumasayithi e-inthanethi, noma kumakhasimende ngokuqondile. Umbuzo 3: Yini ebalulekile ekubhaleni? Impendulo: Ukubhala kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuthile, njengokwazi ukuhlela imibhalo, ukusebenzisa ulimi olucacile nolunembile, kanye nokuba nekhono lokuxhumana nemizwa yabafundi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba nomqondo ocacile wokuthi ubani ozofunda, ukuze umyalezo ufinyelele kahle. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabashicileli? Impendulo: Abashicileli babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokuncintisana okukhulu emakethe, izinguquko ezisheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zabafundi. Ukuze baphumelele, kufanele bahlale beqaphele izitayela ezintsha, baphendule ngokushesha ezidingweni zabafundi, futhi bahlale bephucula izinqubo zabo zokushicilela. Umbuzo 5: Yini ebalulekile ekuthengiseni izincwadi? Impendulo: Ukuthengisa izincwadi kudinga isu eliqinile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano nabathengisi, ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze kufinyelelwe kubafundi, kanye nokwenza imikhankaso yokukhangisa. Ukubambisana nababhali, abahleli, nabanye abashicileli kungasiza ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kwemikhiqizo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela ezintsha ezithinta ezokushicilela? Impendulo: Izindlela ezintsha, ezifana nezincwadi ezikwi-inthanethi, izincwadi eziphathwayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda, zishintsha indlela abantu abafunda ngayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kubangela izinselelo ezintsha, njengoba abashicileli kufanele baziqhelanise nezinguquko ezisheshayo. Umbuzo 7: Kungani kubalulekile ukugcina izinga eliphezulu? Impendulo: Ukugcina izinga eliphezulu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola okuqukethwe okusezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kudala ukwethenjelwa phakathi kwabafundi, okwenza kube lula ukuthengisa izincwadi ezizayo. Izinga eliphakeme liphinde libonise ubuchwepheshe nokuqonda okujulile komsebenzi. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele uyicabangele uma uthanda ukuba umbhali? Impendulo: Uma uthanda ukuba umbhali, kubalulekile ukuba nekhono lokubhala, kodwa futhi udinga ukuqonda izinqubo zokushicilela. Ukufunda ngezokuthengisa, ukwakha ubudlelwano nabanye ababhali, kanye nokuba nekhono lokuphendula impendulo yabafundi kungasiza ekuphumeleleni. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokushicilela? Impendulo: Ezokushicilela zinikeza ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango, izifundo, nezindaba. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bengaxhumana khona, befundisana, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ababhali bangathola ithuba lokwenza imali, futhi imisebenzi yabo ingaba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo emkhakheni wezokushicilela? Impendulo: Emkhakheni wezokushicilela, kulindeleke ukuthi kube nezinguquko ezinkulu, njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Izincwadi ezikwi-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana zizoba nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni abantu bafunde kanjani. Abashicileli kuzodingeka bahlale beqaphele lezi zinguquko ukuze bahlale bephumelela. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zihloko, sithola umbono ophelele wezokushicilela, izinselelo, nezinzuzo zalesi sikhala esibalulekile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwababhali, abahleli, nabashicileli kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi yokubhala ifinyelela kubafundi ngendlela efanele.
Umbiko: uShaka Zulu Isingeniso UShaka Zulu, umholi ohlonishwayo, ungomunye wababusi abakhulu emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Uzalwe ngo-1787, eMkhumbane, edolobheni elalaziwa njengezindaweni zeZulu, waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni umbuso omkhulu weZulu. UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola, ubuhlakani, nobuqhawe, futhi izimpilo zakhe zashintsha umhlaba wamaZulu nempucuko yalesi sifunda. Ubudlelwano bomndeni noShaka UShaka wazalelwa emndenini ophakathi nendawo, indodana kaSenzangakhona, umholi wesizwe samaZulu. UShaka wakhula enezinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokungamukelwa kahle emndenini wakhe. Ubuye waba nesithakazelo esiqinile emlandweni wamaZulu, okwakuhlanganisa izinkolelo, amasiko, nezinkolelo zomndeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abe nesifiso sokwakha isizwe esiqinile, esihloniphekayo. Ukuqhamuka kwempi Ngemva kokuphuma emndenini, uShaka waqala ukuhlela izimpi ezinkulu ukuze aqinise isizwe sakhe. Wazama ukuthola izinsiza eziningi, futhi waphonsa izikhali eziningi ukuze akhe ithimba elinamandla. UShaka wayengumholi ophumelelayo, futhi izimpi zakhe zashintsha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukahlukene. Waqala ukuhlela amasu amasha, afana ne-‘iklwa’, umkhonto owawusetshenziswa kakhulu empini. Ukwakhiwa kwezwe leZulu UShaka akazange akhombise amandla kuphela empini, kodwa waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isizwe esinokuhlangana. Waqala ukuhlela izifunda, wahlukanisa izindawo ukuze kube lula ukuphatha izinsiza. Ukwakhiwa kwezwe leZulu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha, ezazihlanganisa izinkonzo, izimiso, nemithetho. UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola okuhle, okwakuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Umthelela wezokuxhumana UShaka wayaziqonda kahle izindlela zokuxhumana, futhi wakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe. Waqonda ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano, nokwakha izivumelwano ezinhle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izizwe eziningi ziqhubele phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, okwakuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wazo. UShaka njengoMholi UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi izinqumo zakhe zazihlala zisebenza kakhulu. Wayengumholi onothando, owayenobuhlakani obukhulu, futhi wakhuthaza abantu bakhe ukuba baphile ngokuhlanganyela. UShaka waba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni, futhi izimfundiso zakhe zashintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo. Ukubuyekezwa komlando Ngemuva kokushona kukaShaka ngo-1828, umthetho wakhe wahlala unamandla, futhi izifundo zakhe zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile emlandweni wamaZulu. UShaka waba yisikhumbuzo sokuhola, ubuhlakani, nobuqhawe. Izifundo zakhe ziqhubeka zikhuluma ngezinsuku zethu, futhi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ubuhlakani obuqinile bungaholela ekwakheni izizwe ezinamandla. Isiphetho UShaka Zulu ungumholi ohlonishwayo, futhi umthelela wakhe emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika ungakaze unqandwe. Ube yisibonelo sokuhola nokuqinisa isizwe, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. UShaka ungomunye wabaholi abahlonishwa kakhulu, futhi umhlaba uzohlala ukhumbula igama lakhe. Izimpilo zakhe zashintsha umhlaba, futhi zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile ezizogcina zikhumbuleka ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Ukutholakala kolwazi eState kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi wenza izinqumo ezicacile, okukh leads to a responsive and satisfying Government. I-Department of Labour, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 se-Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (Act 2 of 2000) ("umthetho"), idale le bhukwana elichazayo ukusiza amalungu omphakathi athintekayo ukufinyelela ulwazi oluvela kwi-Department abaludinga. I-Department of Labour iholwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMisebenzi oqokwe nguMongameli ngokuhambisana nesigaba 912 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 Act -108 yeMthethosisekelo. Ngokuvamile, uMongameli uqoka ngokuhambisana nesigaba 12 sePublic Service Act, 1994 kanye neMthethosisekelo. Ngokuvamile, ungumHead of the Office of Information osunguliwe. Imininingwane esekela lo Head of the Office of Information itholakala esigabeni C ngezansi. Futhi isikhala sezomnotho sokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo. UDirector-General uqokwa njengomhead we-ofisi yolwazi, njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 1(a)(ii) somthetho. Abaphathi abaphakeme bangabasebenzi abaxhasi bomhead we-ofisi yolwazi osunguliwe, njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 17 somthetho. Iziqinisekiso zebhajethi, izindleko, kanye nezicabangela ze-Department. Ukufinyelela, ukuthenga; kanye nezenzo zemakethe yezabasebenzi. Imibiko ngeMakethe Yezabasebenzi. Lezi zinsizakalo zitholakala kuzo zonke izikhungo ze-Department ezisemaphandleni, ezikhona kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye. Futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezindinganiso ezincane zomsebenzi, ezempilo, kanye nemithetho yokuphepha. Lezi zinsizakalo zinikezwa ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department ePitoli nasezikhungweni zamasipala. Futhi ukuqapha ukusebenza kweMnyango Wezemfundo Nezokuthuthukiswa. Iziqinisekiso ezihlobene nempilo yomfaki-sicelo nokuthi umfaki-sicelo uyasizwa noma ucela usizo komunye umuntu. Futhi ukuveza umbono ngomthetho ophakanyisiwe, okhuthaza ukubhaliswa kwezinyunyana nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ngokuvumelana nemininingwane yokuxhumana enikeziwe, thumela ukukhala kuPublic Protector. Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni kwenkathi yeziqu, umqondo wokuhlonipha abasebenzi wawungakabi namandla, kodwa njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, kwavela izindlela eziningi zokubakhumbuza nokubahlonipha. Izinkampani zaziqonda ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bangama-essence empumelelweni, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemiklomelo ehlukahlukene. Ngonyaka we-1920, emhlabeni jikelele, kwavela izinhlelo zokuqala zokuhlonipha abasebenzi. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuguquka, lapho izinkampani ziqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukugqugquzela abasebenzi kungaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza. Izinkampani ezinjengeFord Motor Company zathola ukuthi uma zikhuthaza abasebenzi bazo, zikhulisa umkhiqizo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiklomelo yokusebenza, lapho abasebenzi bekwazi ukuthola imiklomelo ethile uma befinyelela imigomo ethile. Ngalesi sikhathi, imiklomelo yayihlanganisa izinzuzo ezinjengokuthola izikhumbuzo, izikhwama zemali, noma izinsuku zokuphumula ezengeziwe. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba basebenze ngempumelelo, futhi kwavula umnyango wokuthi izinkampani ziqonde ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi kubalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiklomelo yathuthuka. Ngonyaka we-1950, izinkampani ziqala ukufaka izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuhlonipha abasebenzi, okuhlanganisa nemiklomelo yokusebenza emihle. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuhlonipha ezinjenge "Umsebenzi Wonyaka" noma "Umsebenzi Omuhle Wonyaka," lapho abasebenzi bekwazi ukuthola izindondo ezihloniphekile uma bephumelela emsebenzini wabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, imiklomelo yathuthuka yaba yinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Izinkampani zaziqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango emihle kubasebenzi kungaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezinjenge "Izinhlelo Zokuhlonipha Abasebenzi," lapho abasebenzi bekwazi ukuthola imiklomelo ethile uma bephumelela emisebenzini yabo. Ngonyaka we-1980, umqondo wokuhlonipha abasebenzi wathuthuka kakhulu. Izinkampani ziqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlonipha ezihlanganisa imiklomelo yokusebenza, izikhumbuzo, nezinsiza ezithile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiklomelo ethile, lapho abasebenzi bekwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ezithile uma bephumelela emisebenzini yabo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba basebenze ngempumelelo, futhi kwavula umnyango wokuthi izinkampani ziqonde ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi kubalulekile. Izinsalela Zempilo: Ukuhlola Izinselelo Zokuphila Empilweni, sithola izinselelo eziningi ezihlukahlukene ezithinta zonke izigaba zethu. Lezi zinsalela zempilo zifaka phakathi izinkinga zemali, ubudlelwano, impilo yomzimba, kanye nezinkinga zengqondo. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinsalela, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izici ezahlukene ezithinta impilo yethu nsuku zonke. Izinkinga Zomnotho Omunye wemithombo enkulu yezinselelo zempilo ubonakala ezinkingeni zomnotho. Ukuphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima zezimali kungaholela ekudambiseni isimo sokuphila. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi namali eyanele yokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabo ezisemqoka, njengokudla, indawo yokuhlala, nezokwelapha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zengqondo. Ukuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yezezimali kudinga ukuthi abantu bathathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze balungiselele ikusasa labo, okungaba yinkinga enkulu. Ubudlelwano Nobudlelwano Enye inkinga enkulu ebhekene nabantu yebudlelwano. Ubudlelwano obunempilo buvame ukuba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni, kodwa uma buphukile, kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima. Ukungaboni ngaso linye, ukungathembani, noma ukungabi nesikhathi sokuxhumana kahle kungaholela ekuphukeni kobudlelwano. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu, kuholele ekudambiseni isimo sokuphila, futhi kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bafunde ukuxhumana kahle, bahloniphe omunye nomunye, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Impilo Yomzimba Impilo yomzimba nayo ibalulekile ekubhekaneni nezinsalela zempilo. Ukungaziphathi kahle, ukungadli kahle, nokungazivocavoci kahle kungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi, ezifana nezifo, ukwanda kwesisindo, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Ukuphila impilo enempilo kudinga ukuzinikela, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi akukhona konke okungokwemvelo. Ukuze sibe nempilo enhle, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile, njengezokudla okunempilo, ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuzivocavoca, nokuphumula ngokwanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinye izinselelo zempilo. Izinkinga Zengqondo Izinkinga zengqondo zikhula ngokushesha emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukukhathazeka, ukudangala, kanye nezinye izinkinga zengqondo ziba yizinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta abantu abaningi. Lezi zinkinga zingavela ngenxa yokucindezeleka, izinkinga zomnotho, noma ukungabi nobudlelwano obuhle. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi akukhona okungokwemvelo ukuhamba bodwa kulezi zinkinga. Ukufuna usizo, ukuxoxa nabangane, noma ukufuna usizo lwezokwelapha kungasiza kakhulu ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. Ukukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga kudinga ukuvuleka, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze omunye nomunye ukuba sithole usizo lapho kudingeka. Isiphetho Izinsalela zempilo zihlala zikhona, futhi zidinga ukuba siqonde ukuthi ziwumsebenzi wethu ukuzithola. Ukubhekana nalezi zinsalela kudinga ukuzinikela, ukuqonda, nokuxhumana. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo, sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi sikhuthaze impilo yomzimba nezingqondo. Noma izinselelo zempilo zingaba nzima, zikhona izindlela zokubhekana nazo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi asihambi bodwa. Ukuxhumana, ukuxhasa, nokufuna usizo kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile ekubhekaneni nezinsalela zempilo. Ngale ndlela, singakha impilo engcono, enempilo, futhi ethokozisayo.
Imibhalo yephakheji yabaphathi (GEMS management package documentation) Emhlabeni wamanje, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle kubaluleke kakhulu. Ngale ndlela, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemisebenzi zidinga ukuhlelwa kahle ukuze zisebenze ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokwaziswa ngendlela efanele ukuze abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bandelekile. Iphakheji ye-GEMS (Governance, Efficiency, Management, Sustainability) iwumkhiqizo obalulekile ohloswe ukusiza abaphathi bezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuholele ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile nokuphathwa kwezinsiza ngendlela efanele. Imibhalo yephakheji ye-GEMS inikeza ulwazi olujulile ngezici ezisemqoka ezibandakanya i-governance, ukusebenza kahle, ukuphathwa, nokusimama. Lokhu kudinga izincazelo ezihlukene eziza kuzoncika kwiwo wonke umphakathi, abaphathi, nabanye ababambiqhaza. Ukuqala, i-Governance ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqumo ezithathwayo zihlala zihlakaniphile futhi ziyahambisana nezinhloso zomphakathi. Imibhalo echaza le ngxenye ibonisa izinhlelo nezindlela zokulawula ukusiza abaphathi bakhe izinqubomgomo ezicacile. Lokhu kudala isisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kwezinsiza, okwenza kube lula ukukhomba ubungozi, ukulawula, nokuhlonza amathuba okuthuthuka. Ngokwehlukana, ukusebenza kahle kubalulekile ekwenzeni uqhenya lokuhola nemithombo. Le ngxenye ibheka ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kanjani ngokuphumelelayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela iqhubeka ingcono. Imibhalo ye-GEMS inikeza izibonelo zokuthi izinsiza zingahlukaniswa kanjani ukuze zithuthukiswe, njengalokho okubandakanya ukuhlaziywa kwemisebenzi, izinqubo, nezindlela ezimangalisayo zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukuze abaphathi baveze ukusebenza kahle, kudingeka babheke izinjongo zabo futhi bahlaziye izinga lokusebenza kwemithombo ethile. Ku-GEMS, ukuphathwa (Management) kubhekana nokuhlela, ukulawula, nokwandisa amandla ezinsiza zomphakathi. Iphakheji iveza izindlela zokuphatha eziqondile nezincomekayo, ezichaza izinyathelo okufanele zithathwe ukukhiqiza imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlela izinsiza, ukwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza ezahlukene, kanye nokwenza ngcono ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezisebenzi. Imibhalo ye-GEMS ifaka iziphakamiso eziphumelelayo zokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa, okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwenhlangano. Okokugcina, ukusimama kubalulekile ekwakheni isu eliqhubekayo lokuphathwa kwemithombo. I-GEMS ibeka phambili izindlela zokwenza uqhakambisa imithombo yokusimama, ukuhlomisa abaphathi ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze banikeze imihlahlandlela efanele.
