Lezi zindlela zigxila ezingxenyeni ezibukhali zokuhlonza indlela enokuthuthuka, okuholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezinzile zesikhathi eside. Imibhalo ye-GEMS ikhuluma ngokuqhathanisa izinyathelo ezithathwa ngamanye amazwe, nokuthi kube nezenzo ezibonisa ukusimama. Ngokuphathelene nalokhu, imibhalo yephakheji ye-GEMS ibalulekile futhi iyisisekelo esiqinile sezinhlaka ezahlukene zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle. Abaphathi kumele baqonde futhi basebenzise le mibhalo ukuze bakhe izinqubomgomo ezihlakaniphe kakhulu, eziphumelelayo, futhi ezinokuthuthuka. Ukusetshenziswa kwemibhalo ye-GEMS kudinga ukuba nekhono lokuhlaziywa kokuqonda izimo zomphakathi, ukwazi ukuphatha imithombo ngendlela efanele, nokukhuthaza indawo yokusimama. I-GEMS iyinsiza ewusizo esize ukwakha izindawo ezinhle zokusebenza, ezilungele ukusiza abantu, izinkampani, nemiphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imibhalo ye-GEMS ibeka izifundo ezibalulekile ezizokwaziwa yiyo yonke imiphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, abaphathi baphakathi kwesibopho sokwenza izinqumo eziphusile, ukuphatha kahle, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyathuthuka ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Ngakho, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa kahle imibhalo ye-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile nefinyeleleka kubo bonke. Abaphathi kumele bathathe lezi zinyathelo ngendlela efanele ukuze uzinzo lwezempilo nentuthuko lwezomnotho kube impumelelo, futhi lokhu kuzoba amandla okukhulisa isizukulwane esizayo. Ngaleyondlela, amaxhama enhle abaphathi angakwazi ukuletha izinguquko ezinhle empilweni yomphakathi, amalungelo abantu, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okuphila kahle.
Izindawo ezikhombisa isilinganiso seziqinisekiso ezinhlanu zikhombisa izinhlinzeko ezithile ezizofakwa kuMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane. Lo Mthetho uzoxoxwa ngemuva kokuhlelwa okwenziwe ngesisekelo somthetho 76 weMthethosisekelo - ngendlela echazwe emthethweni 1 weMemorandum ephathelene Nezinhloso zeMthetho. Uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zezingane njengoba ziqukethwe kuMthethosisekelo; uchaza inqubomgomo ephathelene nokunakekelwa nokuvikelwa kwezingane; uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zabazali; ungeza nezinye izimo ezihlobene nezinkantolo zezingane; unikeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemiyalelo yokunakekela; unikeza uhlelo lwezingane ezidinga usizo; unikeza izingane ezitholwe kwamanye amazwe; uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokwamukelwa Kwezingane Ezivela Kwamanye Amazwe; uvimbela ukuhweba ngezingane futhi uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Emhlabeni Wonke; unikeza isimo somama ongumzali wezingane; udala ezinye izinhlinzeko ezihlelwe njengezindaba eziphathelene nezingane futhi unikeza izindaba ezihlobene. NGAKO, iZizwe Ezihlangene zikhulume ngeMvumelwano Yomhlaba Ngamalungelo Abantu ukuthi izingane zinegunya lokunakekelwa nokusizwa ngendlela ehlukile. Iqoqe ulwazi mayelana nesicelo esiphakanyisiwe sokuthola ingane ngendlela echazwe emthethweni 237; kanye nembiko echazwe emthethweni 2391. Umprofessionali emkhakheni wokuthola izingane obhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezisebenzi Zokusebenza Komphakathi, 1978 Umthetho No. yisivumelwano sokusebenza nezingane ezitholiwe, ngokuhambisana nenhloso yeSahluko 16, ibhekisela esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe esisayiniwe yinhlangano ebhaliswe ukuze ivikele izingane ngaphansi komthetho 259 weMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinye ezilinganayo ezivela kwezinye izindawo ngenhloso yokukhuthaza umsebenzi wokugcina izingane ezitholiwe phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezinye izindawo ezithintekayo. Ingane ephila emndenini ongahlangene ngokomzimba nengane lapho ingane eyinhloko ibamba iqhaza njengomnakekeli. Emaphutheni kahulumeni kazwelonke noma emaphutheni omphakathi; noma b enhlangano eyasungulwa ukuvikela izingane; noma c emkhandlwini. Ukusebenzisa ingane okungavunyelwe ngaphansi komthetho 141; kanye f nokuphulwa kwezingxenye zomzimba ezithile. Umthetho Wokuxazulula Izingxabano Ezithile Zokuhlukanisa uchaza umthetho ophatha ukuxazulula izindaba eziphathelene nokuhlukaniswa kwabantu abashadile bo-1987 Umthetho No. udokotela, uchaza umthengisi wezempilo obhalisiwe noma omunye obhekwa njengobhalisiwe ukwenza umsebenzi wezokwelapha ngaphansi koMthetho Wezempilo Wochwepheshe ka-1974 Umthetho No. ukwazisa mayelana nanoma yisiphi isaziso, incwadi noma enye inqubo ephathelene nezinhlinzeko zalo Mthetho, uchaza ukuvezwa kwalolo saziso, incwadi noma enye inqubo ngokuhambisana nenqubo ehlinzekwe yokwethulwa kwenqubo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkantolo Zabasebenzi ka-1944 Umthetho No. umprofessionali wezokusebenza komphakathi uhlanganisa abasebenzi abaphethe umuntu ongagciniwe, abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa, abasebenzi abaphethe izingane nentsha kanye nezisebenzi zokuphepha komphakathi ezibhaliswe ngalendlela ngaphansi koMthetho Wezisebenzi Zokusebenza Komphakathi ka-1978 Umthetho No. Isisekelo seMvumelwano Yezizwe Ezihlangene Sokuvikela Ukuhweba Ngabantu sichaza inqubo yeZizwe Ezihlangene evimbela, yehlisa futhi iphonsela inselelo Ukuhweba Ngabantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nezingane, isekela iMvumelwano Yezizwe Ezihlangene ka-2000 ephikisana Nobugebengu Obuhlelwe emazweni, umbhalo ofanayo weSiNgisi otholakala kuSheduli 3. Ngaphezu kokuchazwa okunikeziwe kumagama "ukubheka", "ukufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho nasemthethweni ojwayelekile, amagama "ukubheka nokufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kufanele athathwe njengokuchazwa "ukunakekela nokuxhumana ngendlela echazwe kulomthetho. Kulomthetho, igama noma igama elithathwe egameni noma ngaphansi kwegama elichazwe emthethweni 1, linencazelo efanayo ngaphandle uma umongo ukhombisa ukuthi kukhona enye incazelo ehleliwe. Noma yisiphi isenzakalo esiqhubekayo esivela ngemuva kokusebenza koMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane ka-1929 Umthetho 9 ka-1929, Umthetho Wokuhlukanisa, Umthetho Wokunakekela, Umthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwendlu ka-1998 Umthetho 116 ka-1998 kanye noMthetho Wokushadiswa Kwamasiko ka-1998 Umthetho 120 ka-1998, lapho lawa Mthetho aphathelene nezingane engazoxoxwa ezinkantolo zezingane. Umthetho ojwayelekile, ukhuthaza isimo sokuvikela nokuthuthukiswa kwezingane lezi. Umthetho wezakhamuzi, izingxabano kufanele zixazululwe ngokulandela umthetho 156 weMthethosisekelo. Ngokuqondene nokuhlelwa kahle komthetho 2b, ngokuhambisana nomthetho 1466 weMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele akhombise zonke izimo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalomthetho ezithinta le ndawo kuBhunga Lezifunda Zasendaweni ukuze kuvunyelwe. Umthetho ophatha inqubo eyenzeka ezinkantolo zezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho 52. Lo Mthetho kufanele ufezekiswe ngamasu kahulumeni ezingeni lesizwe, ezingeni lezifunda, uma kukhona izakhiwo zomphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ezithile zalo Mthetho nezimo ezihilelekile ngokwehlukana nezibopho. Ukuqaphela ukuthi kukhona izidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezikhona, ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwalomthetho, uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ngokuhambisana nezinsiza ezikhona ukuze athole izindlela zokufinyelela nokufeza izinhloso zalo Mthetho. Ukuqhubeka komthetho ngendlela eyalelwe emthethweni 4, zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni ezingeni lesizwe, ezingeni lezifunda nezakhiwo zomphakathi ezihilelekile ekunakekelweni, ukuvikela nokunakekelwa kwezingane lezi kufanele zisebenze ndawonye ekuthuthukiseni indlela ehlelekile nehlanganisiwe yokusebenzisa izinsiza ezethulwe kuZingane. Zonke izinqubo, izenzo nezinqumo ezithathwe ngamasu kahulumeni kuyo yonke indaba ephathelene nengane noma izingane ngokujwayelekile. Ukwamukela isimo sokukhubazeka kwengane nokwakha isimo esihlangabezana nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zengane. Uma izithakazelo zengane zifezekiswa, umndeni wengane kufanele unikezwe ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta ingane. Ukuqaphela iminyaka, ukuthuthukiswa kwengqondo nesigaba sokuthuthuka komuntu onemithwalo kanye namalungelo athinta ingane kufanele aziswe ngezinyathelo noma izinqumo ezithathwe ezindabeni ezithinta futhi ezingase zibe nomthelela omkhulu kubo. Kulomthetho "umzali" uhlanganisa noma ubani onemithwalo kanye namalungelo athinta ingane. Amalungelo engane njengoba akhulunywa kulomthetho ayengeza kulawa malungelo engane atholakala ngaphansi kweBill of Rights. Zonke iz
I-document yokuhlonza yomuntu iyidokhumenti eqinisekisa ubunikazi bomuntu. Ama-document wokuhlonza akhishwa kubantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika noma kubantu abanamalungelo okuhlala aphakade abaneziminyaka eziyi-16 naphezulu. Lezi zedokhumenti zingakhishwa nakubanye abasebenza kuhulumeni noma enhlanganweni eyasungulwa ngokomthetho ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika, noma kumuntu ocela ukusebenza egameni likahulumeni kwelinye izwe. Lokhu kukhishwa kubandakanya nezihlobo zabo noma izingane. Faka isicelo ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi eliseduzane noma emisebenzini uma uphume eNingizimu Afrika. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-9. Thumela isithombe sokuzalwa noma ipasipoti endala ekhishwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaJulayi 1, 1986. Uma ukuzalwa komuntu kungabhalwanga futhi kungekho sithombe sokuzalwa, gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-24/15 bese uthumela lokhu kanye nenye yezincwadi ezisekelayo, njengesitifiketi sokubhapathizwa, incwadi yesikole, noma isitifiketi sokukhulelwa. Thumela izithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-pasipoti. Kuzothathwa izithombe zezingalo ukuze zengezwe kuluhlu lwezibalo zabantu. Abafaki izicelo abashadile kufanele futhi bathumele amakhophi ezitifiketi zomshado. Owesifazane ofaka isicelo se-document yokuhlonza ofuna ukusebenzisa esinye sezibongo azazi ngaso kufanele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa leso sithombe. Umuntu ophuma phesheya ofaka isicelo se-document yokuhlonza kufanele futhi athumele imvume yokuhlala ephakade, kanye nesitifiketi sokuba yisakhamuzi noma isitifiketi sokukhululeka, kanye nesitifiketi somshado ku-BI-529. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-8 ukuze ziqedwe. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubandakanyeka nehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana nePandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009 enhlangano yakho yokufunda. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni lalesi sifo nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walonyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa njengokuphefumula kwezinkomo ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kuvela ezinkomeni. Manje kuqondwa ukuthi umthombo walesi sifo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, lesi sifo asinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sikhuluma ngalesi sifo njenge-pandemic influenza noma ngamagama alo asemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walonyaka, lesi sifo sishayile izwe elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, lesi sifo sishayile izwe elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, lesi sifo sithinte abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo kukhona abangu-1,457 abashonile. ENingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 nabashonile abangu-6. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo okuhlelwe ngomhla kaJuni 11, 2009, iMnyango Wezempilo Yezwe (WHO) waphawula ukuthi izimfanelo zokukhuluma ngalesi sifo njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke zifeziwe, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, useveze ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho nje ukuthi lesi sifo sithinte amazwe kuzo zonke izifunda ze-WHO futhi kwenziwa ngokushesha. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukukhipha isikhumbuzo se-pandemic akusho ukuthi lesi sifo sinezinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi siqhubeka sithinteka yonke indawo. NgoJulayi 6, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwalesi sifo emazweni athintekile kanye namazwe amasha njengokungamukeleki nokungavinjwa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kwaphinde kwakhuluma ukuthi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngalesi sifo bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nakuleli, sikhathazekile ngempilo yabantu abashonile kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). Lesi sifo sithinta kakhulu abantu abaneminyaka ephakathi kuka-10 no-29 - iningi labo bangabafundi noma baphakathi kwezemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO iphakamisa ukuthi amazwe athintekile kufanele agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela waleli sifo emiphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Lesi sifo sithathelwa ngama-droplets okuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhala noma ephuma, uthola ama-droplets abawakhishile noma atholakala emoyeni. Noma uma bekukhona endaweni evaliwe, ungase uthole umoya lapho ungathinteka khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani ongezimpawu ezilula noma ezinzima kufanele afune usizo lwezokwelapha ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa yiNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule isigaba eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nezeluleko zodokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo lukamasipala akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kwi-laboratory yocwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwenzeka manje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akuwona umthetho owenziwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe amacala abawathola ngokuhambisana nezinga lokudlulisa ulwazi (protocol) olunikezwa yiMnyango Wezempilo. Izinketho zokwelashwa zifaka iTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela eziphethweni ezinhle uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangakwazi ukusindisa izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi lwemhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zokufunda nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwesifo. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi ongezimpawu ezilula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi noma/nomathisha abangenayo, inhlangano ethintekile kufanele ixhumane neMnyango Wezempilo, ozosebenza ngokubambisana nezikhungo zezempilo ukuze anikeze izeluleko ezisemthethweni. Uma ungezimpawu ezilula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuze bazame ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sesixazululo futhi ukukhiqizwa okukhulu akukhona okwanele - isikali esingatholakali e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukubonga ngesikhathi osithathile sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubekayo ngokubambisana ekusakazeni ulwazi nasekunciphiseni umthelela waleli sifo.
Emsebenzini wayo wokubhekelela, iPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ethathwe iyasetshenziswa, kuhlanganise leyo eyenzelwe intsha yaleli zwe. Ukuze iPhalamende ibe lula ukufinyelela, kwasungulwa uhlelo olwaziwa ngokuthi "Interface yeNhlangano" lapho abantu abasha bengahlangana khona neNhlangano yePhalamende ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. Bangaphinde bakhombise imibono yabo ngokukhuluma noma ngokwenza izethulo ezibhaliwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abasha babamba iqhaza ezithangamini zeMihlangano yeKomidi lapho umsebenzi omningi wePhalamende wenziwa khona, futhi bangavakashela ezihlanganweni zephalamende ukuze babone okwenziwayo ukuze bathole ulwazi futhi bazithuthukise. IPhalamende inezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihloselwe imikhakha ehlukene, njengokuthi: iPhalamende leNtsha (eyenzeka ngesikhathi seNyanga yeNtsha) lapho izindaba eziphathelene nabantu abasha zixoxwa khona futhi lapho kuphela bona bevunyelwe ukuba babe khona, futhi okwenziwayo lapho kuhlose ukuhlonipha bona. Umthethosisekelo uyalela iPhalamende ukuba ibandakanye abantu emisebenzini yayo nasemikhakheni eyenziwa ngayo, ngakho-ke abantu abasha njengengxenye yomphakathi bamenywa njalo ukuba babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zephalamende, njengokuhlola umphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngenkulumo yeSimo seSizwe, nezinye izinhlelo zokubandakanya umphakathi, kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokubamba iqhaza komphakathi.
Ingcebo - uyisebenzisa kanjani? Ingcebo ibhekisela kumithombo engasetshenziswa umbulali ukuze enze umsebenzi wakhe wezolimo. Ukuhlola nokusebenzisa kahle le mithombo kubalulekile uma umbulali efuna ukuphumelela kwezolimo nokuthola inzuzo enhle. Umhlaba kanye nefamu - lapha singahlanganisa indlela yokusebenzisa umhlaba, inani lezomnotho lomhlaba, ubunikazi bomhlaba, nezinhlelo zokuphatha ifamu. Amanzi nomhlaba ongeniswa - lapha singahlanganisa izindleko zokungenisa amanzi nezintengo zamandla, izinga lamanzi, isimo sezindawo ezimanzi, nezici zazo. Ulwazi nokuzikhandla ekukhiqizeni - lapha singahlanganisa ubuhlobo bezitshalo nezilwane, ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa, ubuchwepheshe bezolimo, nokukhula kokukhiqizwa kokudla. Ukuphatha ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo - lapha kukhona ukuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo, ukuphatha nokugcina umhlabathi, izindlela zokuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuphatha imithombo yokudla, izindlela zokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukuphathwa kwemvelo, ukuphatha amanzi okungeniswa, ukuphatha ulwazi oluvela kubuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ezihlobene nezindlela zokugcina umhlaba. Enye indlela ehlobene nokuphatha le mithombo yonke ukumaketha - lapho kungekho emakethe umkhiqizo, ukukhiqizwa akusizi. Nokho, konke okukhulunywe ngenhla kubalulekile ekuphatheni ibhizinisi lezolimo eliphumelelayo; le ndatshana izogxila kakhulu ekuphatheni izimo zomhlaba kanye nokukhiqiza umhlabathi ngendlela enenzuzo ezohamba phambili. Kufanele ukhumbule konke okukhulunywe ngenhla uma uhlole izindlela zokukhiqiza ezizokukhombisa uhlelo lwamanje lwezindleko ezithile kanye naleyo edingekayo. Ngakho, uzokwazi ukuhlela ukuthi yiziphi izimali ezizongena ezindaweni ezithile zebhizinisi lakho lezolimo. Umhlaba uyisici esibalulekile sengcebo kunoma yiliphi izwe. Ukukhetha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kwenziwa nsuku zonke ngabaphathi bezifamu - bacabangela izimo zemakethe, balalele lokho uhulumeni akukhuluma ngakho mayelana nemithetho yokuphatha umhlaba, futhi bahlole isimo somhlaba othile. Phakathi kwalezi zindawo zomhlaba, kusenalo umhlaba osebenzisa le ndlela: imigwaqo yokuhamba, amapaki nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, izindawo zomnyango wezokuvikela, nezinye izimboni, izindlu zezimboni, imigwaqo yezifamu, nezindawo zasemaphandleni. Umhlaba osele usetshenziswa kanje: izindawo ezimanzi, izigodi, amachibi, imifula, amadamu, izindawo eziwumqansa, nezindawo lapho kungakhuli lutho. Zandisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphila. Abalimi eNingizimu Afrika bangasebenzisa le ngcebo ngezindlela ezingahlangene ngqo nokukhiqizwa kokudla; bangathola inzuzo ngokukhokhisa imali uma abantu befuna ukuhamba, ukuhamba, noma ukubuka izinyoni. Ingxenye yengcebo etholakala emhlabeni iyahluka ngokuya ngokuqina komhlabathi kanye nendawo yomhlaba. Umhlaba wezolimo onokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi ungachazwa kanje: ungumhlaba lapho izimo zomhlaba zemvelo zihlangana nezici zamakhemikhali ezikhona zokukhiqiza ukudla, izitshalo, kanye namafutha. Umhlaba onjalo kufanele ube khona lapho kukhona umhlabathi onokukhiqiza, lapho isikhathi esidingekayo sokukhula kwezitshalo sikhona, futhi lapho kukhona umswakama okwanele (amanzi). Lokhu kubalulekile ekukhiqizeni ukudla uma umhlaba uphathwa ngendlela efanele yezolimo, futhi uma imithombo yamanzi iphethwe kahle futhi umhlaba wemvelo ugcinwa ngendlela efanele. Ungangenisa amanzi nomoya. Awuvikelwe ekukhukhuleni kwamanzi. Izinhlobo zezithako ezingasetshenziswa emhlabeni wezolimo omuhle zifaka: ummbila, ufulawa, ibhali, ama-ot, isorghum, ikhenela, ama-soybeans, utshani, imifino, izimbali, ikotoni, kanye nemikhiqizo yezilwane ezifana nezinkomo, izinkomo zokukhiqiza ubisi, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezilwane zasendle. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokukhiqiza konke lokhu zisetshenziswa ngabafuyi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukushintsha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kungaba nomthelela ezimweni zokwakheka kwesimo sezulu ekuphumeleleni kokukhiqiza ukudla, nokunye. Ngezinye izikhathi, ukwehla kwezimo zemvelo ezifana nokuhlanza umhlabathi, izinga lamanzi, nezindawo zokuhlala izilwane zasendle akuthathwa kakhulu ngoba abalimi baphakamisela inzuzo kuqala, ngaphandle kokucabangela ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo komhlaba. Ukusebenzisa umhlaba kungase kube usizo kumuntu ngesikhathi esifushane kodwa kungase kungasizi abantu emhlabeni jikelele esikhathini eside. Umnikazi womhlaba uzozama ukuwusebenzisa ngendlela ezokwenza inzuzo enhle.
Umhlaba unamanzi athile, futhi la manzi ahamba - akhuphuka abuyele phansi. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi umjikelezo wamanzi (umjikelezo wezamanzi). Ukuhlangana kwenzeka lapho ilanga likhanyisa amanzi emifuleni nasezikhukhuleni, futhi amanzi aguquka abe yivapour noma ugesi. La manzi manje akhuphukela emifuleni nasezikhukhuleni emoyeni. Lokhu kuyimsebenzi wezitshalo ezikhulula amanzi ngamaqabunga azo. I-vapour nokuhlangana yizinqubo ezivumela amanzi ukuthi abuyele emoyeni. Lapha, i-vapour (ubushushu) emoyeni ibanda futhi iguquke ibe yiziphu, yakha amafu. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho amanzi amaningi emoyeni eqoqana futhi engasakwazi ukuhlala emoyeni. Bese amafu eqala ukuba nzima, futhi amanzi aqala ukuwa phansi - imvula, ukungena, umoya. Lapho amanzi ewa phansi ngoba aphelele, ahamba aye olwandle, emifuleni, ezikhukhuleni, noma emhlabathini. Lapho amanzi ehlangana nomhlabathi, ayawathola futhi sithi kuyamanzi aphansi azosetshenziswa izitshalo, izilwane, nabantu. Okusele kuzohamba emifuleni, ezikhukhuleni, nolwandle - bese umjikelezo uqala futhi. Kungani izitshalo zidinga amanzi? Amanzi asekelwa kahle isakhiwo sezitshalo. Amangqamuzana ezitshalo aqukethe ama-90% amanzi. Lezi zicubu ezineamanzi zisekela isitshalo. Lapho amangqamuzana ezitshalo ehluleka amanzi, isitshalo siyawubamba futhi sishaywa. Uma amanzi aphelelwa ngokuphelele, sonke sizofa. Amanzi asiza isitshalo ukuba baphole uma kushisa (ukuhlangana). Amanzi asiza futhi ekwakheni isitshalo, ehambisana ne-carbon dioxide ukuze akhe ama-carbohydrates. Amanzi ayahlula imithombo futhi athutha le mfoodi ukusuka emhlabathini aye ezimpandeni bese efika esitshalo.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: Isingeniso Imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo futhi ophumelelayo. Lezi zenzakalo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, bathole ulwazi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuhlela, ukuphatha, nokwenza imicimbi enjalo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola okungcono kakhulu. Isinyathelo 1: Ukucacisa Inhloso Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukucacisa inhloso yemicimbi. Lokhu kungaba ukukhuthaza ulwazi ngezempilo, ukuxhasa imindeni, noma ukwandisa ukuqonda ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Uma inhloso icacile, kuzoba lula ukuhlela imicimbi ezohambisana nayo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubamba Iqembu Lokuhlela Ngemuva kokucacisa inhloso, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa iqembu lokuhlela elizoba nomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha imicimbi. Leli qembu kufanele libe nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi, kuhlanganise nezazi zezempilo, abaholi bendawo, nabantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza imicimbi ibe nezinhlobonhlobo ezithokozisayo. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubheka Izinsiza Ngaphambi kokuhlela imicimbi, kubalulekile ukubheka izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimali, izindawo, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Qinisekisa ukuthi unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze umcimbi ube yimpumelelo, okuvumela ukuhlela ngaphandle kwezihibe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukukhetha Indawo Indawo yokubanjwa kwemcimbi ibalulekile. Kubalulekile ukukhetha indawo ethokozisayo, efanele, futhi elula ukufinyelela. Izindawo ezifana nezikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, noma izindawo zokudlela zingaba yizinketho ezinhle. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo inezinsiza ezidingekayo, njengamathoyizi, izindawo zokuhlala, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Isinyathelo 5: Ukukhetha Usuku Ngesikhathi Ukukhetha usuku nesikhathi sokubanjwa kwemcimbi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bangakwazi ukuza. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlela usuku oluhambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi unikeza abantu isikhathi esanele sokuhlela ukuza. Isinyathelo 6: Ukukhangisa Ngemicimbi Ukukhangisa ngemcimbi kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayawazi umcimbi. Sebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokukhangisa, ezifana nezikhangiso eziphrintiwe, izikhangiso ezikwi-inthanethi, kanye nezikhangiso ezisemphakathini. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olufanele lukhona, njengosuku, isikhathi, indawo, kanye nenhloso yomcimbi. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuhlela Uhlelo Lwemcimbi Uhlelo lwemcimbi kufanele luhleleke kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Hlela izinkulumo, imisebenzi, nezinsizakalo ezizokwenziwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengemishini yokukhuluma, izinsiza zokudlala, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuhlela Abakhulumi Nababonisi Uma umcimbi uhilela izinkulumo noma abakhulumi, kubalulekile ukuhlela abakhulumi abanolwazi nokuqonda okukhulu ngezihloko ezizoxoxwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi abakhulumi banezinto ezithokozisayo zokwabelana, futhi banikeze abantu ithuba lokubuza imibuzo. Isinyathelo 9: Ukuhlela Ukuphepha Ukuphepha kubalulekile emicimbini. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlela izinyathelo zokuphepha, njengokuhleleka kwezokuphepha, izinsiza zokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo uma zenzeka. Isinyathelo 10: Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Ngemuva kokubanjwa kwemcimbi, kubalulekile ukuqhuba ukuhlola. Thola impendulo kubantu abahlanganyele, futhi uqonde ukuthi yini eyahamba kahle nokuthi yini engathuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi ezayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uthola okungcono kakhulu. Isiphetho Imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi iyindlela ewusizo yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungahlela imicimbi ephumelelayo ezokwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu. Qhubeka uhlanganyele, wabelane ulwazi, futhi wakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, ukuze umphakathi wakho ube nempilo engcono.
Ngokwesistimu yezenzo zokubuyisela, evimbela ubugebengu, izenzo ezinjalo zixazululwa ngohlelo lwesiko lokwahlulela. Uma kutholakale ukuthi umsolwa unecala enkantolo, abasolwa bahlawuliswa ngokubekwa ohlelweni lokubhekwa eMnyangweni Wezokulungisa, bethola isigwebo sokuhlala ejele, ukukhokha inhlawulo, noma inhlanganisela yalezi zijeziso. UMnyango Wezokulungisa uthathe isinqumo sokwakha isu elaziwa ngokuthi iRestorative Justice njengomnikelo ophambili. Le nqubo isekelwe ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu yisenzo esiqondiswe kumvictim nakumphakathi, futhi ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezikhona ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezobulungiswa. Akukhona ukujolisa ekwahluleleni abasolwa kodwa kunalokho ukuqinisa uhlelo lwezobulungiswa jikelele. Iyini iRestorative Justice? Ngokwemibhalo yeMnyango Wezokulungisa, iRestorative Justice ingachazwa njengesenzo esiqinisa umvictim noma abavictim abahluphekile ngenxa yobubi. Le nqubo igcizelela ukubaluleka kokuba nabantu abathintekayo, imindeni, kanye namalungu omphakathi behlanganyela ohlelweni lwezobulungiswa. Ihlose ukubeka abasolwa phambi kwemiphumela yokulimala abenze, futhi ibavumele ukuthi babhekane nalabo abawalimazile futhi benze imizamo yokubabuyisela esimweni sabo sangaphambili, kuhlanganise nokubhekana nezindleko nezingozi ezitholakele. Iphakela ithuba lokuxazulula, ukuxhumana, ukuxoxisana, nokuxazulula izinkinga okungaholela ekwelapheni, esimweni esingcono sokuphepha, futhi kukhuthaze indlela elula yokubuyisela abasolwa emiphakathini. IRestorative Justice igcizelela ukubaluleka kokuphakamisa indima yabantu abathintekayo nomphakathi ngokubenza babe yingxenye yephrosesi yezobulungiswa, ivumela abasolwa ukuthi babhekane ngqo nalabo abawalimazile futhi idale amathuba okuxoxisana, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izinkinga. IRestorative Justice ihluke kakhulu kusistimu yokwahlulela. Iyi-justice enikela umnikelo obalulekile futhi inikeza ithemba lekusasa, hhayi kuphela kulokho okudlule. Le justice igcizelela lokho okudingeka ukuba kuphumelele, lokho okudingeka ukukhokhelwa noma ukuvunyelwana, nokuthi yini okufanele ibe yisifundo uma ubugebengu benzeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le justice ibheka lokho okudingeka ukuqiniswe uma sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akuphindi kwenzeke esikhathini esizayo. Ukuqinisa umphakathi ukuvimbela ukulimala okwengeziwe. Ukubuyisela izimiso - umthelela wokunciphisa ubugebengu nokuphindaphinda, ukwandisa inani labantu abangena ezinhlelweni zokubuyisela, nokuphakamisa izinga lokubandakanyeka komphakathi. Ukwamukelwa nokwethenjwa okwakhiwe ngokuvuma iziphambeko nezenzo zokuzithoba nokuvunyelwana. Ukwehla kwezinga lokwesaba. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuzwelana nokwamukela labo abasolwa. Yiziphi izinhlelo ezilindelekile ngaphansi kweRestorative Justice? Njengoba uhlelo lweRestorative Justice lugxile ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu buholela ekulimazeni kwabantu abathintekayo, imiphakathi, kanye nababukeli, kuyiqiniso ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kufanele zifakwe lapho kuxazululwa umthelela wobubi. Okulandelayo kubhekwa njengabathintekayo futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza: izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nabazithandayo. Kukhona izinkomba zokuthi iRestorative Justice iyathuthuka emhlabeni jikelele. Izinhlaka zikamasipala zixhasile uhlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ngo-1999, iKomidi Labaphathiswa leBhodi leYurophu lamukela iziphakamiso zokusebenzisa izixazululo zokubuyisela mayelana nezimo. IRestorative Justice Handbook for Victims yeZizwe eziManyeneyo iyavuma ukuthi "ukwakheka kweRestorative Justice kuhlanganisa umsolwa, umvictim, kanye nomphakathi wonke ukuze kudaleke inqubo enobubele eqondiswe kumsolwa, ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo kubhekwa umvictim." Ukukhokhelwa komvictim kuyisisekelo sohlelo lweRestorative Justice ezweni eliningi elithuthukayo. Izinyathelo zomthetho zinciphise izithiyo ekuphumezeni izinhlelo zokubuyisela. Zikhuthaze izinyathelo zomthetho zokuphumeza izinhlelo zokubuyisela, ukuhlela izinqubo, nokuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokubuyisela ngenkathi kuvikelwa amalungelo abavictim nababukeli. Inani lezinhlelo zeRestorative Justice emhlabeni jikelele liyanda. Kukhona ngaphezu kwe-500 yezinhlelo zokubuyisela eYurophu nakakhulu kwe-300 eMelika. Ucwaningo ngezinhlelo zeRestorative Justice nezinto ezifanayo eCanada kuholele ekuqoshweni kwezinhlelo eziyi-100. Isu leRestorative Justice alisha lapha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kukhona izimo lapho lezi zimiso seziqalile ukusetshenziswa ngendlela ethile. IKomidi elidumile leziqinisekiso neZokubuyisela, elagxila kakhulu ezinhlekelweni ezenziwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, bekungumsebenzi weRestorative Justice. Kubonisa isidingo sokuthi abavictim bakhulume ngezwi labo futhi bafune izixazululo ezimweni zabo njengabavictim. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenqubo yokwethula ubufakazi bezinto abazihlangabezane nazo nokuhlinzeka ithuba lokulalela lokho labo abawalimazile ababe nakho. UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uhola uhlelo lokwakha amandla abavictim. Le nqubo ihlose ukuhlanganisa abavictim ohlelweni lwezobulungiswa. Isu leZokuvimbela ubugebengu leNingizimu Afrika lichaza lokhu njengokuthi "ukuphendula emthelelweni wobubi kubantu abathintekayo." Nakuba le nqubo ingathinti ngqo ukunciphisa ubugebengu, umgomo wayo omkhulu ukuwulalela lokho abavictim abahlangabezana nakho. Kuyiqiniso elamukelekayo ukuthi ukuvuselela nokuqinisa abavictim kunciphisa eminye imithelela, kukhuthaza ukubambisana nohlu lwezobulungiswa, kuphinde kuphinde kuhlangane nezindlela zomphakathi, kuphinde kuvimbele abasolwa abangaba khona, futhi kukhuthaze ukwesekwa kohlelo lwezobulungiswa. Isu lokuphonsa abasolwa ukuba benze umsebenzi womphakathi liyaqhubeka nokwenziwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi womphakathi uyasiza futhi wenziwa emphakathini othintekile ngamalungu atholwe enecala elithile. Lesi sigwebo singabekwa kubasolwa nakubantu abahlawuliswa ukuba baphathwe yizinsizakalo zokulungisa. Ngemuva kwezinguquko kuMthetho weRestorative Justice ngo-1995, kwasungulwa ikomidi elihlanganisa abaphathiswa ukuze lilawule izinguquko ohlelweni lokubuyisela izingane nentsha eNingizimu Afrika. Ngesikhathi kudalwa uhlaka lwezombusazwe lokubuyisela izingane nentsha, le komidi laphakamisa ukuthi: "indlela yokubhekana nengane enenkinga nomthetho kufanele ibe yinhla: ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona, ukufaka imindeni nomphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo, nokwamukela nokubeka eceleni indima yomphakathi." Ukubhekana nesimo sabasolwa kuyindaba ejulile engakwazi ukuxazululwa ngokuphelele kuphela ngohlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ukuze kuphumelele izilonda zobubi, kumele kube nohlelo oluhlin
Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yisiphi usizo olunikezwayo? I-TISSA inikeza usizo lokuhumusha ngocingo ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni usebenzisa izilimi zomdabu ezisemthethweni ukuze ufike emathubeni ohulumeni. Kungani lokhu kusizo kunikezwa? Ngokusebenzisa i-TISSA, uhulumeni ufeza umgomo wakhe wombuso ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezisebenzayo zokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu ezisemthethweni. Ingabe umphakathi ungacela usizo kuhulumeni ngolimi lwabo lokukhuluma? Yebo, inqobo nje uma leli limi lingelinye lamalimi asemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lwezimpawu lwabantu abaphefumula luhlanganisiwe? Uma ummember womphakathi kanye nomsebenzi kahulumeni bengakwazi ukuqonda ulimi lomunye, umsebenzi kahulumeni angabiza isikhungo sokushayela se-TISSA. Esikhungweni sokushayela, umsebenzisi uzoxhuma umsebenzi kahulumeni nommember womphakathi kumhumushi okhuluma kokubili lezi zilimi. Umsebenzi kahulumeni uzoba nengxoxo yokubili ukuze yena nommember womphakathi bakwazi ukulalela umhumushi. Umhumushi uzohumusha kokubili abantu. Lokhu kungathatha imizuzwana embalwa kuphela. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma umnyango kahulumeni uzokunikeza usizo lokuhumusha? Uma ihhovisi likahulumeni lingakhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngingakucela lokhu kusizo lokuhumusha? Cha, lokhu kusizo kutholakala kuphela ezindaweni lapho uphawu lwe-TISSA lukhonjiswe khona. Nokho, izindawo ezahlukene zizofakwa esikhathini esizayo. Uzokwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni ngolimi lwakho.
### Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Ukubaluleka Kwezokwelapha Nezidingo Zabantu Umhlaba wabesifazane abakhulelwe uthokozisa, kodwa uphinde ube nobunzima. Kulokhu, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile, njengoba zihlinzeka ngesiqondiso, ukuphathwa, nokwelashwa kwabesifazane ngesikhathi sabo sokubeletha. Ukubeletha akusikho okwenzeka ngokukhawuleza; kunokuthile okwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umama nomntwana baphila kahle. Ezimfundisweni zempilo, izibhedlela zinezigaba ezahlukene zokwelulekwa. Lapha, sithola abezokwelapha abahlonipheka, abanesayensi yokubeletha, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kube nokuphepha. Ukuze lokhu kwehlele phansi, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi imithombo etholakala ezibhedlela ihlinzeka ngcono kakhulu uma ihlukaniswa nezikhungo ezincane. Izibhedlela ezinkulu zinezeluleko ezithile zokwelapha nezinsiza eziphambili ezidingekayo, kuhlanganise nezifundo zokulawula izimo eziphuthumayo. Umoya wokunakekelwa ophathekayo ungumgogodla wempilo yezehlakalo zokubeletha. Abasiza emakhemisi, othisha bezokwelapha kanye nochwepheshe bezokwelapha bahlala belungile ukusiza, beqinisekisa ukuthi umama unokuthula. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezisebenzi ezithintekayo kulezi zinsizakalo kubalulekile; kufanele kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezokwelapha kanye nezibhedlela. Ngokungangabazeki, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibalulekile ekunqobeni nasekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu. Imithetho ehloniphekile nezinsizakalo ezimnandi, ezihloniphekile, kanye nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ziyasiza ekunqobeni izinkinga, kubalulekile ukuphendula izidingo zabesifazane. Kwezinye izikhathi, ukubeletha kudinga ukuxhasswa kwemali, futhi lokhu kucacisa isidingo sothando emndenini, kubalulekile ukukholisa lokhu ukuze kusizakale izinsizakalo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle; izinselelo ezahlukene zibhekene nezibhedlela. Ukuntuleka kwemithombo, izikhala zokuphila ezinzima, nokungabi nalwazi okwanele beziehenza kube nzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ziqashelwe kalula, zithuthukiswe njalo ukuze zihlale zikhona ngangokunokwenzeka. Uma sikhuluma ngezinsizakalo zokubeletha, kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili futhi sihloniphe imikhuba yendabuko. Ezinye izithethe zidla izikhathi ezinzima zokuphila, futhi lesi sikhathi sithinta ngokujulile umama nomntwana. Umnikelo wezinsizwa zomdabu kanye nemikhuba yendabuko kufanele uhlonishwe, ukuze kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezivumelwano zakudala nezokwelapha zanamuhla. Ngakho-ke, njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, kumele siqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zidinga ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezibambekayo ezingavumela umsebenzi omuhle ngaphakathi kwezimali zomphakathi. Emakhosini, izibhedlela kufanele zihlale zinokuxhuma, lapho zonke izinsiza zibalulekile, ukugcina umphakathi uhlezi phambili. Ukubeletha kuyindlela eyakhayo, engapheli yokuphila kwabesifazane. Ngakho, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela kufanele ziqinisekiswe, zikhulise umphakathi, futhi zifake isandla ekuphileni kahle. Ukuze kuba nempilo, zonke izigaba ezithintekayo, nemithombo okufanele ikhulume, kufanele zikwazi ukusebenzisana ukuze ziqhamuke nemithetho eyokwakha isifiso esikhulu. Umphakathi kufanele uthinteke, uzwe, futhi unakekele lezi zinsizakalo. Umoya wokuhlonipha, ukuthanda, nokunakekelana kufanele ube phezulu. Futhi kufanele sikhumbule, ekugcineni, ukuthi i-oda elihamba phambili lihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuhlonipha imikhuba yendabuko, nezinselelo ezithinta umphakathi. Ngakho, sizoba nenqubekela phambili. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi echumayo, lapho izinsizakalo zokubeletha ziba yinzuzo kumama, komntwana, nakubantu abaningi. Izibhedlela zikhombisa indlela, futhi kufanele sihlanganyele ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwazo, sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kuphumeza ubufakazi bokuthi umphakathi udinga izinsizakalo ezinhle nezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuzofaka isandla ekuphakamiseni izinga lempilo yabantu, kubalulekile ukuze sizuze ngesikhathi esizayo.
Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Ukuthathwa komhlaba, noma i-expropriation, kuyinqubo lapho uhulumeni noma omunye umphakathi uthatha umhlaba wabanye abantu ngenhloso yokwakha izinhlelo ezithile, njengokwakha izikhungo zomphakathi, izikhumulo zezindiza, noma izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Le nqubo, nakuba ingase ibonakale iyinsiza yokuthuthukisa, ivame ukuveza izimpikiswano ezinzima zomthetho, ezithinta amalungelo abantu, izinqubo zokuthola imvume, kanye nemithetho yokubuyiselwa kwemali. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kudinga ukulandela izinqubo ezithile ezibekwe emthethweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nenhloso yokuthatha umhlaba, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezizathu ezanele zokuthi kungani kuthathwa leli thuba. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayazi ukuthi izinqubo zenzeka kanjani, futhi bakwazi ukuveza izikhalazo zabo uma kudingeka. Okwesibili, izimpikiswano zomthetho zikhula lapho abanikazi bomhlaba bebona ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kwenziwa ngaphandle kokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abo. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka uma uhulumeni enganiki abanikazi bomhlaba imali efanele yokubuyiselwa. Umthetho uthi abanikazi bomhlaba kufanele bathole imali efanele, okuyi-‘just compensation’, uma umhlaba wabo uthathwa. Nokho, izinkinga zenzeka lapho kunokungaboni ngaso linye mayelana nenani elithile, noma uma abanikazi bomhlaba bezwa ukuthi imali abayitholayo ayihambisani nenani langempela lomhlaba wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpikiswano zomthetho zingavela uma kuthathwa umhlaba ngaphandle kokuhlonishwa kwemithetho yokuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanikazi bomhlaba baphikise izinqumo zikaHulumeni ezithinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Izimo ezinjalo zidinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayalalela futhi bahlonishwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlala ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkantolo ziye zaba nendima ebalulekile ekuxazululeni lezi zimpikiswano. Izinkantolo zihlola izimo ezithile, zifunda izinkulumo ezivela kuHulumeni nabanikazi bomhlaba, bese zenza izinqumo ezithinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izinkantolo zidinga ukuba zihlale ziqaphele izimo zomphakathi, kanye nezidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkantolo zidinga ukuba ziqonde ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayathola izinzuzo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezithile, futhi abanikazi bomhlaba bahlala bejabulile. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zihlala zikhona, futhi zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayahlonishwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezibekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlala ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile. Ekugcineni, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abanikazi bomhlaba bayahlonishwa, futhi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezithile, futhi abanikazi bomhlaba bahlala bejabulile. Ukuthathwa komhlaba akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu ahlonishwa, futhi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinzuzo ezithile, futhi abanikazi bomhlaba bahlala bejabulile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezibekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlala ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile. Ukuthathwa komhlaba kudinga ukuba kube nenhlonipho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ahlonishwa, futhi izinqubo zokuthathwa komhlaba zisebenza ngendlela efanele.
Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kwezohwebo Kwazulu, ebhizinisini eliphumelelayo, ethekwini laseThekwini, kwakukhona umphakathi ophila kahle, kodwa wabhekana nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuminyana. Kwakuyidolobha elikhulu elinabantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kwadala umphumela omkhulu kwezohwebo. UThandiwe, umphakathi ophila eThekwini, wayengumthengisi wezimpahla ezincane. Wayenoshintsho olukhulu empilweni yakhe, kodwa ukukhula kwemakethe kwakuvulelekile. Njalo ekuseni, uThandiwe wayevula itende lakhe lokuthengisa edolobheni. Abantu bejolise emikhiqizweni yakhe, kodwa umnyango wesimo sezulu wabuya nezinye izinkinga. Njengoba abantu benshi bebuya emsebenzini, umnyango wezohwebo wakhula. UThandiwe waqala ukuphupha ngokukhulisa ibhizinisi lakhe, kodwa umthelela wokuminyana wawuhlala unomthelela omkhulu. Amaphrojekthi amancane ayengakabi namathuba okukhula, futhi lokhu kwashiya abathengisi abaningi bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale bejolise emnothweni wobuchwepheshe. UThandiwe, kodwa, wayengakahluleki. Wayazi ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo udinga ukwakha ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze ubhekane nezinselelo. Waqala ukufunda mayelana nezindlela zokuhweba ezikwi-inthanethi, futhi wathola amathuba amasha. Lokhu kwavuleka indlela yokufinyelela emakethe enkulu, lapho abantu bejolise emikhiqizo yakhe. Ngesikhathi sokukhula, umphakathi wezemfundo uThandiwe waqala ukunikeza izifundo eziphathelene nezohwebo, ukuze abanye baphumelele. Wazama ukufundisa abantu ukuthi kuminyana akukhona kuphela ukuhlupheka, kodwa futhi ukuvumelana nezimo ezidingekayo ukuze uthole impumelelo. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabathengisi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokuminyana waqala ukushintsha. Abantu bazi ukuthi bangakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuba bahlale endaweni eyodwa. UThandiwe wahola imihlangano yokuhweba, okuhlanganisa abathengisi abancane. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okukhula, futhi umthelela wezohwebo wabonakala. Kodwa, njengazo zonke izindaba, kwakukhona nezinkinga. Umthelela wezokuphepha waba yinkinga, njengoba abantu beqala ukuzama ukukhwabanisa ukuze bathole inzuzo. UThandiwe waphakela izeluleko ezinhle mayelana nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathengi, okufanele babe namandla okuphila. Ngesikhathi uThandiwe ebona umthelela omuhle, waqala ukujabula. Wabona ukuthi abantu abadala bayakwazi ukufunda nokukhula, futhi lokhu kwakhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlale bephusha imikhawulo. EThekwini, umthelela wokuminyana wawuvula amathuba, kodwa wawudinga abantu abakhuthazayo ukuze bakhulise izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, uThandiwe wahamba phambili. Waphakela iziphakamiso zokwakha izikhungo zokuhweba ukuze abathengisi bahlale bejolise emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokufinyelela ezimakethe zomhlaba. Kwaphela isikhathi, uThandiwe waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaholela ekukhuleni kwezohwebo, uma abantu behlanganyela. Ngakho-ke, uThandiwe wayengasabi umthelela wokuminyana. Wayazi ukuthi uvuma izinselelo, kodwa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe nabantu abakhuthazayo bangachaza indlela yabo. EThekwini, umthelela wokuminyana wawuhamba ngemigudu emisha, unika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Ibhizinisi likaThandiwe lathuthuka, kwavela abanye abathengisi abasha, futhi umphakathi waqala ukubona izinzuzo. Umthelela wokuminyana, owawubonakala njengezinkinga, wawuguqulwa waba yithuba lokukhula. UThandiwe wabona ukuthi umnotho ungathuthukiswa uma abantu bejolise ekubambeni izandla. EThekwini, izixazululo ezintsha zakhula. UThandiwe waba ngumpheki wezohwebo, njengoba eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale bephusha imikhawulo. Umthelela wokuminyana, owawumkhumbuza izinselelo, wakhula waba yithuba lokuphila kwempumelelo. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe wathola uhlelo lokuhweba lwe-inthanethi olwakha ingqalasizinda eyenza kube lula ukufinyelela emakethe. Abathengisi abancane bahlala bejabulile, futhi uThandiwe, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waba ngumholi wezohwebo. Umthelela wokuminyana, owawuholela ezinkingeni, waba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo eThekwini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu emnothweni, futhi abathengisi baqala ukusebenzisana, baphendula izinselelo ngendlela ehlakaniphile. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nokukhuthaza, umthelela wokuminyana wahamba phambili, unika abantu ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Uthando lobudlelwano, ukwakha nokuhlala uqhubekela phambili, kwaba ifa elihle lokuphila kwempumelelo eThekwini. Umthelela wokuminyana wagcina ukhombisa ukuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, banganqoba noma yiziphi izinkinga. UThandiwe, umthengisi ophumelelayo, waba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma ubambisene, ungakwazi ukuvuma izinselelo, futhi wathola umthelela omuhle emnothweni.
Ezokwakhiwa Kwezindlu: Ukubhekisisa Okubalulekile Kwezakhamuzi Nezindawo Zethu Ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu kube yinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu, ngoba izindlu ziwumgogodla wempilo yethu. Ngaphandle kwezindawo ezinhle, ukuphila kwethu kungaba nzima, futhi izidingo zethu zingase zingagcwaliseki. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukukhula kwezindawo ezakhiwayo kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu ezingcono nokuthuthukisa izimo zempilo zabantu. Kodwa-ke, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi izinqubo zokuqhubeka nezokwakha zidinga ukuhamba kahle ukuze zizele izidingo zabantu, hhayi ukugxila kuphela enanini lezindlu ezakhiwayo. Kuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izindlu azizwakali kuphela njengokwakhiwa kwemigoqo emikhulu, kodwa ziwumkhiqizo wokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo ezahlukene. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi uhulumeni, abanye abathintekayo, kanye nezakhamuzi uqobo. Ukuze sithole izindlu ezithuthukile, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalezi zingxenye. Abantu basekhaya kufanele babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqumo, njengokuthi izindlu ezakhiwayo zifanele izidingo zabo, zibe nezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi zihlale endaweni efanele. Ngokuphathelene nezokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu, kubalulekile ukuthi sicabangele izindawo ezibonakalayo. Izindawo eziningi zidinga izindlu eziphumelelayo, kodwa akufanele sizame ukuhlinzeka izixazululo ezisheshayo ngaphandle kokubheka izimo zabantu. Ukuze kube nezindlu ezithokozisayo, kufanele sihlole izici ezinjengokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo, ukufinyelela ezindaweni zomphakathi, nezinsiza ezifana nezikole, izitolo, nezikhungo zempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphile impilo enempilo futhi beneliseke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izindleko zokwakha. Izindlu ezibiza kakhulu zingaphazamisa abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi siqonde ukuthi izindleko zokuqashisa nezokwakha zikhula kanjani, futhi sikhethi izindlela ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthola izindlu ezihamba phambili. Abaphathi bezokwakha badinga ukusungula izinhlelo ezizoletha izindleko eziphansi, okuzosiza abantu abaningi ukuthi bakwazi ukuthola izindlu eziphumelelayo. Kodwa hhayi kuphela izindleko ezibalulekile. Uhlelo lokwakha izindlu luhlobene kakhulu nesimo sezulu. Kuhle ukuhlola ukuthi izindawo ezakhiwayo ziphephile yini, zikhona izinkinga zokuminyana, izikhala zemvelo, noma izingozi ezithile. Ukuze sithole izinhlelo ezithuthukile, kufanele sihlole kahle izindawo ukuze sigweme izinkinga ezizovela esikhathini esizayo. Umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni izinqubo ezizosebenza kahle, ukuze sithole izindawo eziphumelelayo nezivikelekile. Ngemuva kokucabangela konke lokhu, ngingaphakamisa ukuthi izindawo zokwakha kwezindlu zidinga ukuba nendawo yokuxhumana okuhle. Abantu kumele babe neqhaza ekwakheni izindawo ezihambisanayo nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka izindlu ezingcono, futhi kuzodala umphakathi ozinikele. Umphakathi onokubambisana uzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinsiza ezithuthukile, futhi uzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, izokwakhiwa kwezindlu akusikho nje ukwakha izindlu, kodwa kuhlanganisa ukwakha umphakathi onempilo. Sidinga ukuhamba phambili ngokuhlanganyela, sikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwababusi, abathintekayo, nezakhamuzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu eziphumelelayo nezihambisana nezidingo zethu. Ngakho, masithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithole izindawo eziphumelelayo, futhi sithuthuke njengomphakathi. Ukubambisana kwethu kuzodala izindlu ezinhle, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwethu, futhi sithokozise izizukulwane ezizayo.
Ezokuphathwa Kwezinhlekelele Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzaneni omncane iMahlabathini, kwavela izinkanyezi zensuku ezimnandi. Abantu babehamba bejabule, bejabulisa imindeni yabo, bephuza amanzi abandayo, futhi bejabulela umoya opholile. Kodwa, njengokujwayelekile, izinhlekelele azikhumbuli isikhathi noma indawo. Kwathi ngempelasonto, umoya uqala ukuhamba ngamandla, izinkanyezi zashintsha zaba mnyama, futhi izinkanyezi zaphenduka zaba neziphithiphithi. Umoya omkhulu wathumba izihlahla, wakhukhula imizi, futhi izikhukhula zaqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Umphakathi waba nesaba, ubona izinkanyezi zishintsha zibe yizinkanyezi ezimnyama. UThandi, umphakathi wezokuphatha izinhlekelele, wayesebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabantu bendawo, ehlela izinyathelo ezidingekayo. “Sidinga ukuhlanganisa imithombo yethu, sibe namasu okuphuma kulokhu,” kusho yena, ebona ubuhlungu obubangelwa yilesi simo. Kwathi lapho behlangana, uThandi wacacisa ukuba kudingeka bakhe ithimba lokuphendula. “Kumele sithumele abanye abantu ukuba bahlale emaphakathini ahlaselwe, sithumele izinsiza ezinjengezimpahla zokudla, amanzi, nezinto ezisemqoka,” wathi. Abantu babenokukhathazeka, kodwa uThandi waba nesibindi. “Kukhona okukhona, kodwa kumele sibe namandla.” Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uThandi wahamba nebhodi labantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Bafika ezindaweni ezithintekile, behamba ngezinyawo, bephusha izimpahla ezidingekayo. Umoya wawubhubhisa, kodwa ubuhlungu babantu babubavumela ukuba baqhubeke. Babebona izimpahla ezimnandi, umoya opholile, kanye nezinhliziyo ezivulekile. Kwathi lapho befika endaweni ethintekile, babona abantu bejolise ezindaweni ezithintekile. Okwakukhona, izindlu zibhujiswe, abantwana bebhalela emanzini, futhi abantu babezama ukusiza omunye nomunye. UThandi waqonda ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqumo eziphusile. “Sizokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala, sizokwenza izindawo zokugcina izimpahla, sizokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo,” wathi, enza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile. Ngesikhathi abantu bephuma, uThandi wahlangana noMama Nandi, umama omkhulu emzaneni. “Ngiyabonga, mntwanami, ngokuba lapha. Uthando lwakho luthokozisa,” kusho yena, ebheka uThandi ngamehlo agcwele umusa. UThandi wamukeleka, wathi, “Siyabambisana, Mama. Noma yini esingayenza, sizokwenza.” Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, izinhlelo zikaThandi zaba nomthelela omkhulu. Izikhungo zokuhlala zakhuliswa, abantwana bathola ukudla, futhi abantu baqala ukuvakasha izikhungo zokwelashwa. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi abantu bamlandela, beqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bukhulu kakhulu. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, umphakathi wathola amandla. Izindlu zakhazimula, abantu babebuyela emsebenzini, futhi umoya wathokozisa. UThandi waba neqhaza elikhulu, waba yisibonelo sokuphila okukhululekile. “Siyakwazi ukuphila, sithanda, futhi sikhumbula,” wathi, ebheka abantu abajabule. Ngaleso sikhathi, umoya wathokozisa, izinkanyezi zashintsha zaba mnyama, kodwa umphakathi wawukhumbula. UThandi wayazi ukuthi izinhlekelele zikhona, kodwa izinyathelo ezithathwayo zenza umehluko. “Siyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, sithanda, futhi sihlanganyele,” washo, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nomoya opholile. UThandi, noMama Nandi, nabanye abantu, bathola amandla okwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Izinhlekelele zaba yizifundo, futhi abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo busemandleni. Ngaleyondlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuphila, esikhumbuza abantu ukuthi, noma izinhlekelele zikhona, ubudlelwano, uthando, nokuhlanganyela kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umoya wathokozisa, izinkanyezi zashintsha zaba mnyama, kodwa umphakathi wawuphila, wakhula, futhi waqhubeka.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sesisebenzi Sikahulumeni (GEMS Government Employee Status Verification) Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sabasebenzi bakahulumeni kubalulekile emisebenzini yezezimali, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano enikeza izinsizakalo zezempilo ezikhethekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sabo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola izinsiza bahloniphekile futhi banelungelo lokuthola lezi zinsiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bahloniphekile, i-GEMS ibeka izinqubo ezithile ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicelo zokuhlola isimo somsebenzi, lapho umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzisi ungumsebenzi osemthethweni. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwa ukuvikela izinsiza ze-GEMS, ukuze zisetshenziswe kuphela ngabantu abavunyelwe. Isinyathelo sokuqala ekuqinisekiseni isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni siqukethe ukufaka isicelo sokuhlola isimo somsebenzi. Lokhu kungenziwa online, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi anikeze ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zifaka phakathi izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezivela kumqashi, ezikhombisa ukuthi umsebenzisi ungumsebenzi osemthethweni. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo kumuntu ofanele. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, i-GEMS izobuyekeza ulwazi olunikeziwe, okubandakanya ukuhlola izincwadi ezithunyelwe, kanye nokuxhumana nomqashi uma kudingeka. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, umsebenzisi uzothola ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sakhe, okuzomvumela ukuthi aqhubeke nokusebenzisa izinsiza ze-GEMS. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa kubalulekile, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezeMpilo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zifinyeleleka kuphela kubantu abavunyelwe. Kubantu abathola izinsiza ze-GEMS, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubo ezilandelwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina izincwadi ezisemthethweni, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile uma kudingeka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zihlala zikhona, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqonde lezi zinqubo, futhi bazi ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani ukuze baqinisekise isimo sabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibuye inikeze izinsiza zokuxhumana ukuze abasebenzi bakahulumeni bakwazi ukuthola usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nezinhlaka ezithile ezisebenzela i-GEMS, ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bahlala bekwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izinsiza ezithile. Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinsiza ze-GEMS, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Uma abasebenzi bakahulumeni benelisekile ngezinsiza abazitholayo, lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwakha umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi onempilo ubonakala njengesisekelo sokwakha izwe eliqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuqinisekisa isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi baqinisekise isimo sabo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ze-GEMS zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, abaphathi, kanye nezinhlaka ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bahlala bekwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqonde izinqubo ezihambisana nokuhlola isimo sabo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izinsiza ze-GEMS ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unempilo.
Emakhaya asemaphandleni, phakathi kwemvelo ethokozisayo, kwakukhona umndeni kaMnumzane Jabulani. UBaba uJabulani wayengumuntu onobubele, ehola umndeni wakhe ngezindlela ezicacile. Umama, uNandi, wayethanda izingane zabo, uSipho noThandi, futhi wayezama ukubafundisa ngezindlela ezinhle zokuphila. Nokho, empilweni yabo, kwakukhona inkinga — ubukhona bokukhanyisa. Kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka, umuzi wabo wawungakabi nagesi. Kwakulula ukuhlela izinto uma ubheka izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu, ubona umhlaba uhleli emnyama. Nokho, umndeni kaJabulani wawujabulela ukuphila kwabo okukhanyayo. Izindlela zabo zokuphila zakhombisa izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngelinye ilanga, uJabulani wahlangana nomngani wakhe, uThulani, owamkhumbuza isidingo sokusebenza ngempumelelo. UThulani, owazi kahle izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ugesi, waveza ukuthi, "UJabulani, kungani ungathathi isinyathelo sokwenza umuzi wakho ube nagesi? Kubalulekile ukuvuselela impilo yethu." UJabulani wacabanga kakhulu ngaleso sikhathi. Noma wayejabule ngomphakathi wabo, wayefuna ukushintsha izinto ezazithinta impilo yomndeni wakhe. Ngemva kokukhuthazela, uJabulani wenza uhambo lokuvakasha lapho umphakathi wabo uhlinzeka ngogesi. Bahlangana odokotela bempilo, abafundi, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe, becebisa umphakathi. UJabulani wabamba ithuba lokuhlanganyela. "Umphakathi wethu udinga ukushintsha," kusho uJabulani. "Akukhona kuphela ukukhiqiza ugesi, kodwa kumele sakhe impilo engcono." Umphakathi wathola ithuba lokwakha izibani nemigqa yegesi. Kwakukhona izinsiza ezandayo, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Njengoba izinsuku zedlule, lezi zinsiza zaba yisikhumbuzo sokuphila okunempilo. Njengoba uJabulani eqhubeka, ugesi wavula amathuba amasha. Wakhuluma noNandi, obekhuluma ngemiphumela yezinguquko. Nokho, uNandi waveza imibono emihle. "Ngizoba nawe," kusho uNandi. "Umndeni wethu uzokhanyisa izinkanyezi emhlabeni wethu." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umndeni kaJabulani wathola ushintsho olukhulu. Kwakukhona ukukhanya, nemishanguzo eyodwa, lapho baphila khona kahle. Izinto ezilula zaba yizimanga, futhi umndeni wabo waba nezinhliziyo ezijabulayo. Usuku olukhulu lwafika, umndeni wahlanganyela izibani, uSipho noThandi baphuma phambili. Kwakukhona ukuvuka kwezinkanyezi, ezihambisana nemibukiso emihle. UJabulani wabona ukuthi ukukhanya kwakukhanyisa indlu, kwenza umndeni wabo wakhanya. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezine, umuzi wabo wathola ugesi, kanti ubaba noMama benza imisebenzi emihle, umkhanya waba yinjabulo, ubuchwepheshe baphila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uJabulani noNandi bahlala bephambili, babona izinto ezithuthukayo. Ugesi wawuphatha kahle, uvusa umuzwa wokunakekela, wakhuthaza umphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, umndeni kaJabulani waba yisibonelo, wakha ikusasa elikhanyayo, wabonisa umphakathi ukuthi ugesi ungaba yisisombululo ezindaweni ezinzima. UJabulani nomndeni wakhe baba neqhaza elikhulu, bakhuthaza abanye ukuba bakhe impilo engcono. Umoya wokuphila kwabo waba yisikhumbuzo sokusebenza kanzima, nokuthi ugesi usiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwabe kungakabikho izingane zithi: “Sizokwakha iminyango yokuhamba phambili.”
Amaphoyisa: Umsebenzi Wokuzivikela Nokwakha Ubulungiswa Amaphoyisa, njengomnyango obalulekile emphakathini, anendima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amaphoyisa awagcini nje ngokuba yizikhali zokulwa nobugebengu, kodwa futhi ayizinsika zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuqonda izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela esingabathuthukisa ngazo ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo ngempumelelo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amaphoyisa abhekene nezimo ezinzima. Njengoba ububi buqhubeka nokukhula, amaphoyisa ahlale ebhekene nezingozi ezinkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi babe nekhono lokuphatha izimo ezinzima, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nezimo eziphuthumayo. Nokho, akusikho konke okukhuluma ngobubi; amaphoyisa kufanele futhi abe nekhono lokuxhumana nabantu, ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu besebenzisana namaphoyisa, kuba lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa adinga ukwakha isithombe esihle emphakathini. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza imisebenzi yokuzithandela, njengokuhlanganyela emicimbini yomphakathi, noma ukuhlela izifundo zokuphepha. Uma abantu bebona amaphoyisa njengabavikeli, hhayi njengabaphangi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuma ukusiza lapho kudingeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa azithathele izinyathelo zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi akhuthaze abantu ukuba baphendule kahle uma bebuza noma bexhumana nabo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhanya. Kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene namaphoyisa, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinkingeni zokuhlukumeza. Ukukhathazeka ngalezi zinkinga kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa abhekane nezimo ezinzima, futhi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bempilo yomphakathi bayaziswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa amaphoyisa ngendlela yokuphatha izimo ezinzima, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nezimo ezinzima ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla ngokweqile. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa ahlale ebuyekeza izinqubomgomo zawo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola ukusebenza kwabo, ukuze bazi ukuthi yini esebenzayo nokuthi yini engasebenzi. Ukuze bakwazi ukwenza lokhu, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa kufanele aqhubeke nokufunda. Umhlaba ushintsha njalo, futhi izindlela zokusebenza zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kufanele bahlale befundisa futhi beqonda izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezithuthukisiwe, ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, amaphoyisa ayisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubulungiswa buyadingeka emiphakathini yethu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amaphoyisa awagcini nje ngokuba yizikhali zokulwa nobugebengu, kodwa futhi ayizinsika zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukuthi sibe nesithakazelo sokubambisana, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ezikhona. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke amaphoyisa njengabavikeli, hhayi njengabaphangi. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, sizokwenza kube nzima ukuvimbela ubugebengu, futhi sizokwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Amaphoyisa adinga ukwesekwa, futhi thina sonke sinesibopho sokubasiza. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ophephile.
Imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza nomnotho wasekhaya Izitolo zama-spaza zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wasekhaya, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni nasezindaweni ezinezinga eliphansi lokuthuthuka. Lezi zitolo, ezivame ukuba nezimpahla ezilula nezidingekayo, zikhona ukuze zifake isandla ekwakheni umnotho wendawo, ziqhube imisebenzi, futhi zandise ukufinyelela kwezidingo ezisemqoka. Nokho, imithetho ethile ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zitolo zisebenza kahle futhi zihlala zikhona. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza ifaka phakathi izinqubomgomo zokuhweba, ezokuphepha, nezokuphatha. Le mithetho ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitolo zisebenza ngendlela efanele, zivikela abathengi, futhi ziqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ukuze izitolo zikwazi ukuhweba, kufanele zibe nezincwadi ezifanele, zihlale zikhumbula izidingo zamakhasimende, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswayo iyatholakala. Okwesibili, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona ezindaweni ezikahle ukuze zifinyeleleke kalula. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izitolo ezikude zingaholela ekuncipheni kokuthengisa. Ukuze zihlale zikhona, izitolo kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphinde bavakashele lezi zitolo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqhube imisebenzi yokuthengisa ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi baphila ngokuphepha, futhi izitolo zihlale zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu, izitolo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo, ziqinisekise ukuthi izimpahla zitholakala ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi zisebenzise izindlela zokuphatha ezihloniphekile. Ukwengeza, imithetho yokuphatha izitolo zama-spaza ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle izidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izitolo ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ukuthi ziqonda kahle izidingo zamakhasimende, zisebenzisa izindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukuze lezi zitolo zibe nempumelelo, kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zamakhasimende futhi zisebenzise izindlela zokuphathwa ezithuthukile. Ngokuphathelene nemithetho yokuhweba, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza ngokuhambisana nemithetho yendawo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitolo zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele, zivikela abathengi, futhi ziqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ukuze lezi zitolo zihlale zikhona, kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yokuhweba ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitolo zihlala zikhona ezindaweni ezikahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izitolo ezikude zingaholela ekuncipheni kokuthengisa. Ukuze zihlale zikhona, izitolo kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Ukwengeza, izitolo zama-spaza kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa ezisebenzayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswayo iyatholakala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi izitolo zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ukuze lezi zitolo zibe nempumelelo, kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zamakhasimende futhi zisebenzise izindlela zokuphathwa ezithuthukile. Ekugcineni, imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho wasekhaya uyakhula. Lezi zitolo zihlala zisebenza njengemithombo yokukhula komnotho, ziqhuba imisebenzi, futhi zandise ukufinyelela kwezidingo ezisemqoka. Ukuze lezi zitolo zihlale zikhona, kufanele ziqhubele phambili imisebenzi yazo, zisebenzise izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, futhi zikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi. Ngale ndlela, izitolo zama-spaza zizoba nempumelelo, futhi umnotho wasekhaya uzothuthuka.
Ukudlulisela kwenzeka uma umuntu efela, eshiya impahla noma/nenkosi, noma ngenhloso yokuba nekhasi. Ukudlulisela kufanele kuphathwe futhi kwabiwe ngokwezifiso zomuntu ofile, futhi uma ofile engashiyanga ikhasi, ngokwezinhlinzeko ezibekwe emthethweni. Umthetho ophatha ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabafileyo, i-Administration of Estates Act, 1965, ubeka indlela okufanele ilandelwe ekuphathweni kwefa lomuntu ofile. Ifa lomuntu ofile kufanele libikwe emahhovisi kaMaster ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kosuku lokufa. Ukufa kungabikwa noma ubani ophatha noma obamba impahla yomuntu ofile, noma ophatha noma obamba ikhasi noma ikhodikili yomuntu ofile. Uma umuntu efela eNingizimu Afrika eshiya impahla noma/nenkosi noma ngenhloso yokuba nekhasi, noma uma umuntu efela ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika eshiya impahla noma/nenkosi noma ngenhloso yokuba nekhasi. Ifa lomuntu ofile kufanele libikwe kuphi? Nakuba wonke amahhovisi abameli esebenza kuMaster futhi ifa lomuntu ofile lingabikwa lapho, abameli banamandla alinganiselwe futhi bazodlulisa amafa anekhasi, kanti amafa adlula u-R50,000 azodluliselwa emahhovisi kaMaster wesifunda. Uma ufuna ukubika lefa, kungcono ukubika ngqo emahhovisi kaMaster. Uma ofile ehlala eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe, bika ifa kuMaster onegunya endaweni lapho ofile ehlala khona ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe. Uma ofile engahlali eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe, ungabika ifa kunoma yimuphi uMaster. Bika ifa ngokugcwalisa ifomu le-J294: Isaziso Sokufa nezinye izincwadi zokubika ezishiwo ngezansi. Usayizi wefa kanye nohlobo lokuqokwa kuzokwenza kube sobala ukuthi yiziphi izincwadi ezidinga ukugcwaliswa nokuhanjiswa. Uma umuntu efela ngaphandle kwekhasi noma uma ikhasi linganiki umuntu othile njengomphathi noma uma umphathi oqokwe efela, noma enqaba ukuba aqokwe. Isitifiketi somshado sokuqala noma ikhophi eqinisekisiwe - uma lokhu kufanelekile kuzo zonke izikhasi zokuqala noma izikhalazo noma izincwadi ezineleli - uma kukhona uhlu lwabantu abaphethe ofile - uma kukhona isitatimende siqinisekisa ukuthi ifa alikabikwa kwenye i-ofisi kaMaster noma kwezinye izikhungo ezisebenzela uMaster. Uma umuntu efela ngaphandle kwekhasi noma uma ikhasi linganiki umuntu othile njengomphathi noma uma umphathi oqokwe efela, noma enqaba ukuba aqokwe. Isitifiketi sokufa noma ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yaso, isitifiketi somshado sokuqala noma ikhophi eqinisekisiwe - uma lokhu kufanelekile kuzo zonke izikhasi zokuqala noma izikhalazo noma izincwadi ezineleli - uma zikhona. Amahhovisi asebenzela uMaster anegunya uma ofile engashiyanga ikhasi elisemthethweni, futhi uma usayizi wefa lomuntu ofile ungaphansi kuka-R50,000. Izincwadi zomthetho zivumela umuntu oqokiwe ukuphatha ifa ngaphandle kokulandela izinqubo ezibekwe kwi-Administration of Estates Act, 1965. Isikhathi esithathwa ukuqeda le nqubo sincike ekujuleleni kwendaba.
iNetflix: Ukushintsha Kwezokungcebeleka Kwamanye Amabhayisikobho Namashwa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokungcebeleka ziye zashintsha kakhulu, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule. Phakathi kwezinto ezithokozisayo ezikhona, iNetflix ibonakala njengephuzu elikhulu ekuguqulweni kwezokungcebeleka. Le nkundla yokubuka amavidiyo inikeza abantu ithuba lokubuka amabhayisikobho, uchungechunge, nezinhlelo zokwakha ezihamba phambili, konke ngokushaya nje kwesithombe. Ngesikhathi iNetflix iqala, kucace bha ukuthi izobangela ushintsho olukhulu emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Kuqala, yathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu ngenxa yokukwazi kwayo ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezivamile, ezisheshayo. Ukungena kwayo emakethe yama-streaming kushiye izikhala ezinkulu ezitholakala kumasiko esintu. Abantu baye baphendukela ekubukeni amavidiyo, bejabulisa izidingo zabo zokungcebeleka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Enye yezinto ezikhethekile ngamaNetflix ukuthi ibonise amandla okwenza okuqukethwe okuhlukahlukene. Njengenhlangano, iNetflix ikwazi ukugxila emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, ivumela abangu-100% ukuthi bathole okuthandayo. Lokhu kuqhamuke nezinhlelo ezifana ne "Money Heist" ne "Stranger Things," ezithole ukwamukelwa okukhulu emazweni ahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iNetflix ayihlali nje kuphela ezinkundleni zendawo, kodwa ibheka emhlabeni wonke, inikela ngezinhlelo ezihambelana namasiko ahlukahlukene. Ngokuphathelene nekhwalithi, iNetflix ibonakala ikhethekile. Isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ikhulula amavidiyo anekhwalithi ephezulu, okwenza kube lula kubabukeli ukuba bajabulele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yokukhangisa nemiphumela yevidiyo ibukeka izinhle, okwenza kube nokudlalwa okuphelele. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi abanye abakhiqizi bamabhayisikobho bathola ugqozi ukuze bancintisane neNetflix, benza imizamo yokuthuthukisa umkhiqizo wabo. Nokho, ukungena kweNetflix emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka akukhombisi kuphela ukubonakala kwayo. Kunemiphumela ethile ezinzima engase ibonakale kule nkundla. Okokuqala, ukuvela kweNetflix kuholele ekwehleni kwesidingo samakhaya amakhulu. Abantu abaningi baphenduke kumasevisi e-streaming, okwenza kube nzima kumagumbini amakhulu ukusinda. Lokhu kungase kubangele ukwehla kwenani lababukeli, okuthinta kakhulu ukuthuthukiswa kwabanye abakhiqizi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNetflix idinga izindleko ezinkulu ukuze iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okujabulisayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezinkinga zama-licensing, okungaholela ekuphumeleleni kokungasebenzi kahle. Abanye abaphenduli baveza ukuthi ukungabikho kwama-licensing amasha kungabavala ithuba lokubuka amabhayisikobho abathandayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iNetflix iqhubeke ibhalela izinkontileka ezinzima, okubonisa ukuncintisana okukhulu. Kubantu abaningi, iNetflix iyindlela yokungcebeleka engaguquki. Abantu bakhululekile ukukhetha ukuthi bafuna ukubuka ini, futhi ngesikhathi esithile, abakwazi ukuthola izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezihluke kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ama-documentaries, izinhlelo zengcebo, nezinhlelo zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bathole okuthandayo. Noma kunjalo, indlela iNetflix esithinta ngayo ukukhetha kwethu ibonisa izinkinga ezithile. Uhlelo lokubuka luyaqhubeka luthinta izinqumo zabantu, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi lokhu kudala ukuvuka kwemikhuba yokungaboni kahle. Ngokuthola uhla olukhulu lwezinhlelo, abanye babukeli bangase baphuthelwe amathuba okuthola okuthokozisayo emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iNetflix, nakuba inikeza izinzuzo eziningi, nayo ibeka phambili izinkinga ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNetflix ibonakala iyindawo ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Iphinde ibonise ukuthi ibhizinisi lezi zinsuku lidinga ukuba lihlale likhula, ukuze libe nesizinda esiqinile. Njengoba imibono yama-streaming iqhubeka nokukhula, iNetflix izodinga ukuqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko ukuze ihlale ibamba isikhala sayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubabukeli ukuthola izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, kanti iNetflix izoba yinsika ebalulekile ekukhuliseni amasiko ahlukahlukene. Ukuphetha, iNetflix iwumkhiqizo ophumelelayo futhi odumile, osiza abantu ukuba bathole izinhlelo ezihambelana nezifiso zabo. Nokho, kufanele sihlale sikulungele ukufunda nokuhlola izinselelo ezilethwa yile nkundla. Njengoba izokhula, ukuhamba kwayo kuzoba yinto ebalulekile ukuze kutholakale izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, nokugcina umphakathi uthokozisa izidingo zabo zokungcebeleka. INetflix iyinhlangano ebalulekile, futhi izoshintsha umqondo wethu wokungcebeleka emhlabeni wonke.
Akukwazi ukusho ukuthi zonke izilokazane ezivame ukutholakala ezitshalweni azinabungozi. Ziyingxenye yezilokazane eziletha izifo ezitshalweni. Lezo ezinobungozi zingadla imbewu efakwe, ezinye zidle isitshalo ngesikhathi sikhula, ezinye lapho isitshalo sesiqinile, ezinye zidle imizi kanti ezinye zidle amahlamvu uma seziphumelele. Ukuphatha izilokazane kuhlobene kakhulu nezinto zokwakha (izinto ezibulala izilokazane). Kukhona izinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala zonke izilokazane ezinobungozi ezitshalweni. Izindlela zokuphatha izilokazane ezihlanganisiwe zingaba nomthelela omuhle - izindlela ezihlukene zisetshenziselwa ukuvimbela ukukhula kwezilokazane nokunciphisa ubungozi obudala. Kukhona izilokazane ezihlukene ezidlayo imbewu nezitshalo ezisanda kuqala ukukhula, isibonelo: ama-wireworms, ama-beetle anemibala, ama-cutworms, njll. Lezi zilokazane zinciphisa inani lembewu efakwe futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi kufakwe kabusha. Ukuphatha kahle lezi zilokazane kuhlobene nokufaka umuthi wokubulala izilokazane ngendlela efanele, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka. Ukuhlwanyela ebusika kuzosisiza ukuphatha eziningi zalezi zilokazane - kudinga izinsuku eziyi-35 noma ngaphezulu lapho zingatholi isitshalo sokudla futhi eziningi zizofa. Imbewu ezizofakwa ingaphathwa ngummuthi wokubulala izilokazane, noma umuthi wokubulala izilokazane ungafakwa emhlabathini lapho kuzofakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokubeka umthombo phezulu emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Insimu ye-maize ingaphuziswa nomuthi wokubulala izilokazane ofanele. I-beetle enkulu enombala edlayo i-maize (Astylus Atromaculatus), i-cutworm (Agrotis Segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ingalive "doodhouertjie" (Protostrophus Sulcatifrons) kanye ne-harpalus beetle kungadala ubungozi obukhulu futhi kunciphise inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile enhle. Ekugcineni, akukho inzuzo ezotholakala kule nsimu. I-African bollworm (Helicoverpa Armigera) ibhujisa isitshalo se-maize futhi ivula indlela yokungena kwezifo ezifana ne-Rhizopus Microsporus. Izilokazane ezithokozisayo ezifana ne-Nysius Nataensis nazo zingabhaqa imbewu ye-maize ekhula. Kukhona izinhlobo ezihlukene zezinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala izinhlobo ezihlukene zezilokazane ezihlasela isitshalo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi izinhlobo zezilokazane ezinobungozi bese ukhetha umuthi wokubulala izilokazane ofanele ukufaka ngendlela efanele nangasikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kungahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lwezilokazane nokukhula kwesitshalo.
