Ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane ukuze kubulwe izilokazane kungasiza ukuvimbela ubungozi ezitshalweni, kodwa kubiza imali eningi - ngakho-ke umphakathi kufanele abalwe kahle ukuthi izindleko zizoba ziningi kangakanani. Kufanele kubhekwe kahle lapho kudingeka ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane - kuzofika isikhathi lapho umphakathi ubona ukuthi kubalulekile kakhulu ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane ngoba ubungozi ezitshalweni buzoba bukhulu kunenani lokufaka umuthi. Akukuhle ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane ezitshalweni uma izilokazane zingakakhethi ubungozi obukhulu. Isizathu salokhu: kukhona ezinye izidalwa zemvelo ezidlayo lezi zilokazane, kodwa nazo zibhujiswa umuthi wokubulala izilokazane kanti ezinye izilokazane zithola amandla okuphila emithini ethile yokubulala izilokazane. Ukuhlwanyela ngaphambi kokufaka imbewu kuyindlela enhle yokuvimbela ubungozi bezilokazane. Kodwa inani lezilokazane kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zokuvimbela zingakhuphuki kakhulu. Kukhona ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo eziqinile ngokumelene nezilokazane - lokhu kuzosisiza esikhathini esifushane ngoba ngeke kudingeke ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane, futhi esikhathini eside kuzosisiza ngoba inani lezi zilokazane lizoncipha. Kungcono ukuhlela konke futhi usebenzise izindlela ezihlukene ukuphatha lezi zifo - sebenzisa indlela ethile ngesikhathi esifanele ezitshalweni ezithile. Ukuphatha izilokazane kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezolimo jikelele ngoba kunganciphisa noma kukhuphule umkhiqizo kanye nezindleko zokukhiqiza ekugcineni. Izifo zezithombo zinciphisa umkhiqizo kanye nekhwalithi yokudla futhi zingabangela ukuba imikhiqizo kanye nabantu abathokozela leyo ndawo bahlupheke. Ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus abanga izifo ezitshalweni. Lezi zingabhaqa isitshalo sonke - imizi, izimpande, amahlamvu, kanye nezithelo. Lezi zifo ezihlukene zidinga izimo ezihlukene ukuze zikhule futhi zandise. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma izimo zezulu zifanele, uma kukhona isitshalo lapho singakhula khona, futhi uma isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingabizwa ngokuthi (i-triangular) i-triangle eyinhloko yesifo. Uma eyodwa ilahlekile, isifo asikwazi ukukhula. Isifo esingase sibe khona ngesikhathi esithile endaweni ethile singase singabi khona ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba izimo zezulu zingashintsha. Njengoba i-maize ibiza imali eningi ukufaka, kuvame ukuthatha umzamo omningi ukubulala nokuphatha izifo ngezinto zokwakha. Ezinye izifo zivame ukuba khona kodwa azikhuli ngoba eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle ilahlekile. Kungcono ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvimbela izifo futhi zizophathwa kangcono. Kukhona izinto ezihlukene ezingakusiza uvimbele izifo ukuthi ziqale ukukhula. Ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo zithola amandla okulwa nezifo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zikhono zokulwa nezifo zivame ukuhamba kuphela nezifo ezithile, hhayi zonke. Kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi isifo esingase sikhule endaweni ethile bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungakwazi ukulwa naleyo zifo. Ukuphatha ngezinto zokwakha kusho ukusebenzisa umuthi wokubulala izilokazane obhalisiwe ukuze kubulwe ama-fungi namabhaktheriya ezimweni ezithile zezulu. Kufanele ucabangele kahle izindleko zomuthi wokubulala izilokazane ngaphambi kokuwathenga. Izindlela zokuhlwanyela zingaba yinto ebalulekile uma sifuna ukuphatha izifo - izimpande ezisele ensimini zigcina ezinye zalezi zifo. Indlela esihlwanyela ngayo kufanele ibhekane nalokhu futhi kufanele sazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona. Ukuphindaphinda izinhlobo zezitshalo ensimini eyodwa kuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngezimpande ezisele isikhathi esanele sokuphela nokuxhumana nomhlabathi. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezingenzeka ezitshalweni ezithile, ukuze izitshalo ezifanele zikwazi ukukhethwa lapho ziphindaphindwa. Isikhathi sokufaka imbewu singahlanganiswa nokuphuma kwesifo esithile - ukufaka imbewu masinyane noma sekuhleliwe kunganciphisa ukusabalala kwesifo esithile. Ingxenye yezinto ezidala ingcindezi ihlobene nezifo. Izinto ezidala ingcindezi ezitshalweni zifaka: umswakama (okuncane kakhulu noma okuningi), ukushisa, ubanda, ukungabi nezithako ezanele emhlabathini, ubisi, kanye nokulimala kwezilokazane. Lapho sifuna ukuphatha izifo ngendlela efanele, kufanele sizame ukususa eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle yalezi zifo. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sisebenzisa uhlelo lokuphatha iz
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni Ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni, njengamathala ezincwadi, izikhungo zemfundo, nezikhungo zokwelapha, kuyindaba ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuhlobene ngqo nezinga lokuphila kwabantu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni noma ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sixoxe ngale ndaba, sihlole izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokufinyelela kwamahhala. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala kumahhala komphakathi kuveza amathuba amaningi. Uma abantu benokufinyelela ezikhungweni ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile, njengemfundo, impilo, nezinsiza zokuxhumana, banelungelo lokuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane, lapho abantu bengakwazi khona ukukhokhela izinsizakalo ezithile. Ngokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo mahhala, umphakathi uyakhuthazwa ukuba ube nekhono lokukhula, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo mahhala kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu. Izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo zidinga imali yokusebenza, izisebenzi ezikhethekile, nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni uhulumeni noma izikhungo ezizimele zibe nezinselelo zokuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Uma izinsiza zinganele, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, okungaholela ekunciphiseni izinga lokwaneliseka kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kungase kube nomthelela omubi ezikhungweni ezizimele. Uma abantu bejwayele ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni mahhala, bangase baphenduke bahlale begcwele ezikhungweni ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, okungaholela ekunciphiseni izinzuzo ezitholakala ezikhungweni ezizimele. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo kwezikhungo ezizimele, okungase kubangele ukuthi zidinge ukuvala noma zinciphise izinsizakalo zazo. Kodwa-ke, uma sihamba phambili, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala akumele kube yinto engapheli. Kunconywa ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa ukufinyelela kwamahhala nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhungweni ezizimele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni ibhizinisi eliqinile, lapho izikhungo ezizimele zingathola uxhaso oludingekayo ukuze ziqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile, ngenkathi izikhungo ezizimele ziqhubeka nokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni akukhona kuphela okwenziwa nguhulumeni. Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekwakheni izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithombo, izinsiza, nezinsiza zomphakathi kungaholela ekwakheni izikhungo ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile, ngenkathi umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula. Ekugcineni, ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kuyindaba ebalulekile, enezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi nezinselelo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole lezi zinto ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele kufanele basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile, ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokuphila komphakathi wethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula.
Sicela ubike zonke izifo ezibulalayo ezithinta abesifazane ezweni lakho. Xhumana nekliniki, isibhedlela, noma inhlangano eseduze nawe esigxile empilweni yabesifazane. Emhlabeni jikelele, cishe abesifazane abangu-600,000 bafa ngenxa yezizathu ezihlobene nokukhulelwa unyaka nonyaka. Iphesenti elingu-99% (99%) yalezi zifo zenzeka ezweni elithuthukayo noma elingathuthukanga. Ukufa kwabafazi abakhulelwe kuyindaba edabukisayo ngoba iningi layo lingavikeleka. Izimo abesifazane abakhulelwe ababenezona ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, ikakhulukazi izifo zenhliziyo, zingaholela ezinkingeni. Wonke umfazi okhulelwe angahlangabezana nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma sokubeletha. Nokho, izimo namathuba ahluka. Abesifazane abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-34 kufanele baqale ukubonisana nomthandazi noma udokotela ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Labo abaphethe iminyaka yokubeletha kufanele bacabangele ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela noma ukwenza abalingani babo (oyise) bazise. Abesifazane abakhulelwe izikhathi ezinhlanu noma ngaphezulu kufanele bahlale bebona umthandazi noma udokotela ukuze benze ukuhlolwa okujulile ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Abesifazane abanezinhliziyo eziphukile kufanele babonane nochwepheshe bezinhliziyo mayelana nesimo sabo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Omama abathinteka kakhulu yizifo zenhliziyo bakhuthazwa ukuba bacabangele izindlela zokuvikela. Omama abakhulelwe abake benza izinqubo kufanele bahlale bebeletha esibhedlela esingahlinzeka ngempilo yokuhlinzwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi sosuku, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemorning noma kusebusuku. Abesifazane abakhulelwe abahlangabezana nezinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuza, ubuhlungu obuqhubekayo besisu, ukuphefumula okunganele, noma ukuhamba okukhukhumezayo kufanele babike ngokushesha emkliniki noma esibhedlela esiseduze. Hlela ukukhulelwa kwakho uma kungenzeka, futhi kufanele ubhekelwe umuntu onolwazi nolufundisiwe ekubeletheni. Vakashela eklinikini yendawo noma kudokotela uma uphuthuma isikhathi sakho kabili ukuze uhlole. Iya eklinikini noma kudokotela uma ungafuni ukuqhubeka nokukhulelwa futhi ufune usizo. Hlale usebenzisa ikhondomu ngesikhathi sokwenza uthando uma ungafuni ukukhulelwa noma uma usukhulelwe. Sekela umuntu okhulelwe ekhaya ngenkathi ekhulelwe, ngesikhathi sokubeletha, noma ngemuva kokubeletha. Khuthaza ukuvakashela eklinikini yokuhlolwa kwabakhulelwe (ukunakekelwa kwangaphambi kokukhulelwa) futhi uhlela imisebenzi ukuze umuntu okhulelwe akwazi ukuhamba. Sekela ikliniki yakho yendawo ukuze ihlinzeke ngosizo olusezingeni eliphezulu.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekelela labo abazofaka isicelo sokuhlala ngokungapheli njengamalungu omndeni womuntu onobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika noma umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni. Ukuze uthole ilungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli, amalungu omndeni njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni achazwa njengalabo abahlobene ngegazi noma izingane ezibekwe ngokomthetho ngaphansi kokuqondisa kwekhosi noma abazali abazothatha ngokomthetho ukunakekela zona noma abazali ngenxa yokufa noma ukuhlukaniswa kwabazali. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Umuntu onobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ongapheli kumele athumele isitatimende sokuzibophezela mayelana nezimali, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, nokunakekela umfaki-sicelo. Nokho, uma umndeni ungumzali wezingane ezincane, akudingeki ukwenza isitatimende sokuzibophezela. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu shintsho.
Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala Njengoba izinkinga zezimali ziqhubeka nokukhula, izinkampani ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi i-Eskom, ziba nenkinga enkulu. Kulesi sikhathi esinzima, kubalulekile ukuqonda icebo elisha lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala. Lokhu kuza ngesikhathi lapho izinkampani zikagesi zikhathazekile futhi umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga zokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. I-Eskom, njengomphakathi, ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezikweletu. Izikweletu ezikhulayo kumasipala zenza kube nzima ukuthi le nkampani ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo wezingqinamba, lapho izikweletu zikhula, kanti izinsizakalo ziya phansi. Ngakho-ke, icebo lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala lidinga ukuba libe nezinhloso ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom iqonde ukuthi izikweletu kumasipala zikhona ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zezezimali. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngendlela efanele. Okwesibili, icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala kufanele lube nezinqubo ezilula nezicacile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala, ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo. Uma izinqubo zikhona, kuzobe kulula ukuhlela izinkokhelo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo. Okwesithathu, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom ibheke izindlela zokukhuthaza amakhono okuphatha izimali kumasipala. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kumasipala ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo ngendlela efanele. Uma amakhono okuphatha izimali ethuthukiswa, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala kufanele libe nezinhloso zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-Eskom nomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubandakanya umphakathi ekwakheni izixazululo. Uma umphakathi ubamba iqhaza, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Ekugcineni, icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala lidinga ukuba libe nezinhloso ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Uma izinqubo zikhona, kuzobe kulula ukuhlela izinkokhelo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom ibheke izindlela zokukhuthaza amakhono okuphatha izimali kumasipala. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kufanele ubambe iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izikweletu ezikhulayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokubuyisela izikweletu kumasipala lidinga ukuba libe nezinhloso ezicacile nezisebenzayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsizakalo ezinhle.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sokwamukelwa njengomfuduki lunikezwa umfaki-sicelo ukuze wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala ngu muntu ophume ezweni lakubo ngenxa yokwesaba ukucwaswa, futhi ufuna futhi wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala - kulokhu eNingizimu Afrika. Umfaki-sicelo kumele afune ukuhlala ngenkathi isicelo sakhe sisaphenywa. Umfuduki uthola imvume engavuselelwa yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Le mvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-14 futhi ivumela umnikazi wayo ukuba abike endaweni ethile yokwamukela abafuduki ebizwa ngeHhovisi Lokwamukela Abafuduki eduze ukuze afake isicelo sokuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala uthola isimo sokuba umfuduki kanye nokuvikelwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nabafuduki njengoba kubhalwe kwiMthetho Wabafuduki, 1998. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunembile, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ingxoxo yokuqala nomuntu yenziwa ngommeli owaziwa ngokuthi uMphathi Wokwamukela Abafuduki, futhi ifomu le-BI-1590 liqedelwa. Imvume yomfuduki iphrintiwe, isayinwe, isetshenziswe, bese iphumelelwa kumfuduki. Le mvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-30, ivumela umfuduki ukuba ahlale eNingizimu Afrika okwethulwa. Le mvume ingavuselelwa kwezinye izinsuku eziyi-30 bese ibe yisikhathi esithathu. Ngaphambi kokuphela kwemvume, umfuduki kumele abike kwi-RRO ukuze enze ingxoxo yesibili, eyenziwa ngommeli owaziwa ngokuthi uMphathi Wokunquma Isimo Somfuduki. U-RSDO uqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo futhi enze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala. Uma kwenziwa isinqumo sokwamukela, umfuduki kumele afake isicelo sekhadi le-ID elihlakaniphile kunoma iyiphi i-RRO ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15. Ngemva kokuthola le khadi, umfuduki angafaka isicelo seSivumelwano Sokuhamba seZizwe eziManyanayo kunoma iyiphi i-RRO. Isimo sokuba umfuduki siyasebenza iminyaka emibili, kodwa umfuduki kumele athumele incwadi efuna ukubuyekezwa noma ukuvuselelwa kwesimo sakhe somfuduki ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemva kokuphela kwemvume yomfuduki. Umthetho Wokufuduka, 2002 njengoba ushintshiwe. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze zicubungulwe. Le sevisi iyamahala.
Kungani izitshalo ziba nombala ophuzi ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezimanzi zonyaka? Isithombe: Izimo zokuhamba kwamanzi zithinta inqubo yokukhula kwezitshalo eziningi. Umlando wezazi zesiNgisi u-H.G. Willis washilo ukuthi umlando wabantu ungumbono phakathi kokufunda nokuphazamiseka. Mayelana nabakhiqizi bezitshalo ezindaweni ezithola imvula yasehlobo eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasemazweni anomhlabathi owomile, le miphumela iyinto ejwayelekile nsuku zonke. Izindlela zokukhiqiza izitshalo ezindaweni ezingawomile zishintshile ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okungapheli ngenxa yokushoda kwamanzi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokulungisa ubukhulu bezitshalo, kusetshenziswa amafutha afanele ngokusekelwe ezivunweni ezikhona, kusetshenziswa izindlela zokulima ezigcina amanzi ukuze konyuswe ukungena kwamanzi kancane kancane, kusetshenziswa izinsuku ezifanele zokutshala, nokukhetha ukuhlanganiswa kwezithombo ezingakwazi ukujwayela ukushoda kwamanzi, njll. Lezi zikhumba zifaka ngaphakathi kwethimba lezitshalo ezaziwa njenge-mesophytes, eziphumelela emhlabathini omanzi kodwa opholile. Imizi yazo ilungiswe kahle ukuze ifune amanzi nezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini; isibonelo, imizi yommbila ingangena emhlabathini ngesivinini esingu-24 mm ngosuku, ifinyelela ubukhulu obungama-2 kuya kwama-2.4 amamitha, kuye ngendawo yomhlabathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemizi kungavinjwa kakhulu noma kuphazamiseke ngenxa yemvula eningi, njengoba kwenzeka ngesikhathi salonyaka lapho izitshalo zisetshenziswa ngoDisemba noJanuwari. Imvula eningi emhlabathini owomile izoholela ekutheni amanzi agcwalise ezingeni lapho kuzokwenziwa khona umoya okhona. Inqubo yokuqala ebalulekile yokuphila ezothinteka kabi ukrespiration yemizi; izitshalo zidinga amazinga athile omoya (oksyjeni) emizini yazo. Abacwaningi bakhombisile ezihlolweni zabo ukuthi ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhamba kwamanzi ngokuphelele, ukukhula kwemizi kungama kancane ngemizuzu. Nokho, izitshalo zihluka ekubeni nezinga lokubekezelela ukugcwala kwamanzi endaweni eyodwa. Isibonelo, izitshalo ezithandayo amanzi ezaziwa njenge-hydrophytes (njengommbila) ziqhelile ukuhlala ezimeni zomhlabathi ezimanzi. Nokho, lezi zitshalo zingafa emhlabathini anomoya owanele. Imizi yezitshalo ezingakwazi ukubekezelela izimo zokuhamba kwamanzi, njenge-legumes (izinkwa ezomile, ama-soybeans, njll.), izofa ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuhamba kwamanzi. Izimpawu zokuqala zokulimala kokuhamba kwamanzi zingavela ngemva kwamahora amabili, kuyilapho ukulimala okungaguquki kungavela ngemva kwamahora angama-24, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezishisayo. Lapho ukrespiration kwemizi kuphazamisekile, ezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile zezithombo ezifana nokukhula, ukutholwa kwamanzi, nokumuncwa kwezinto ezidingekayo nazo ziphazamiseka. Naphezu kokuba namanzi amaningi, izitshalo azikwazi ukumunca amanzi nezinto ezidingekayo. Ezinye izimpawu zokukhathazeka kwezithombo ziba sobala, kuye ngezinga lokukhula kwazo. Isibonelo, lapho ukrespiration kwemizi kwehla ngesikhathi sokukhula kommbila, ukutholwa kwamanzi nakho kwehla ngokufanele, okuzothinta ukumuncwa kwezinto ezidingekayo. Isibonakaliso esibonakalayo yisimo sokuphuma kweziphuzo (chlorosis) ngenxa yokwehla kwamazinga e-chlorophyll. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwe-nitrogen ezitshalweni, nakuba i-phosphorus, i-potassium, nezinye izinto zingase zibe nokuntuleka. Kulolu suku, isitshalo sithumele i-nitrogen eziphuzeni ezintsha ezivela ezindala ukuze siqhubeke nokukhula kwaso. Ukuqhubeka kokuhamba kwamanzi kuzoholela ekunciphiseni ukukhula kwezithombo nezokulahlekelwa kokuvuna.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukwelulekwa nokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yazo, njengoba lezi zinsuku zokuqala zibalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwengane. UZanele, udokotela wezokwelapha ophumelelayo, ube nesikhathi esiningi sokusebenza ezibhedlela, ikakhulukazi emnyangweni wezokwelapha wezinsana. Uhlangabezana nezimo eziningi ezithokozisayo nezinsiza ezinzima, kodwa uthokoze kakhulu ngempumelelo yokunakekela lezi zinsana. UZanele waqala umsebenzi wakhe ezibhedlela ezinkulu zasedolobheni, lapho abesebenza khona ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuphila kwezingane. Njengomuntu onothando, uZanele ubelokhu eqonda ukuthi lezi zinsana zidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zokuqala. Uhlale eqaphela ukuthi izidingo zazo zihluke kakhulu, futhi lezi zinsuku zokuqala zibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Ezinsukwini zokuqala, uZanele ubona ukuthi izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Ubuza omama ngezindlela zokunakekela izingane zabo, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. UZanele uhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, efana nokuthi kufanele zifakwe ezindlini zokuphumula ezishisayo, zifakwe kahle ukuze zikhululeke, futhi ziphathwe kahle ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhula ngendlela efanele. Ukwelulekwa kukaZanele akupheli lapho, njengoba eqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zokudla nezinzwa zezingane. Ubonisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo, okukhululekile, kubalulekile ukuze izingane zikhule kahle. UZanele uyazi ukuthi omama badinga ukwazi ukuthi izinkanyezi ezincane zidinga ukudla okungcono, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uZanele ubona ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane akupheli kuphela ekunikezeni ukudla nokuphumula. Ubuza omama ukuthi bazame ukuhamba nabantwana babo, ukuze bakwazi ukubanikeza uthando, ukunakekela, nokuxhumana. UZanele uyazi ukuthi uthando luyinsiza enkulu ekukhuleni kwezingane, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze zikhule ziqine. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokunakekela, uZanele ubonisa ukuthi abantwana badinga ukuxhumana nabanye abantu, ikakhulukazi emndenini. Ubuza omama ukuthi baphathe izingane zabo kahle, futhi baziqondise ngendlela efanele. UZanele ubona ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi komama nezingane buvame ukuba yinsiza enkulu ekukhuleni kwengane, futhi lokhu kusebenza kahle ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwengane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uZanele ubonisa ukuthi abantwana badinga ukuvikelwa ezimeni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baziqonde kahle izimo ezinzima. UZanele uyazi ukuthi izinsana zidinga ukuqonda ukuthi zivikela kanjani, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uZanele ubonisa ukuthi abantwana badinga ukuvikelwa ezimeni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baziqonde kahle izimo ezinzima. UZanele uyazi ukuthi izinsana zidinga ukuqonda ukuthi zivikela kanjani, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. Ubonisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo, okukhululekile, kubalulekile ukuze izingane zikhule kahle. UZanele uyazi ukuthi omama badinga ukwazi ukuthi izinkanyezi ezincane zidinga ukudla okungcono, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, uZanele ubonisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo, okukhululekile, kubalulekile ukuze izingane zikhule kahle. UZanele uyazi ukuthi omama badinga ukwazi ukuthi izinkanyezi ezincane zidinga ukudla okungcono, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. Ukwelulekwa kukaZanele akupheli lapho, njengoba eqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zokudla nezinzwa zezingane. Ubonisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo, okukhululekile, kubalulekile ukuze izingane zikhule kahle. UZanele uyazi ukuthi omama badinga ukwazi ukuthi izinkanyezi ezincane zidinga ukudla okungcono, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. Ukwelulekwa kukaZanele akupheli lapho, njengoba eqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zokudla nezinzwa zezingane. Ubonisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo, okukhululekile, kubalulekile ukuze izingane zikhule kahle. UZanele uyazi ukuthi omama badinga ukwazi ukuthi izinkanyezi ezincane zidinga ukudla okungcono, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kangcono izidingo zempilo yezingane zabo. Ngokuphetha, uZanele ungumuntu onothando, onomsebenzi omuhle, futhi onobuchwepheshe bokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Uthanda ukufundisa omama ngezindlela zokunakekela izingane zabo, futhi uthemba ukuthi lokhu kuzobasiza ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokukhula kwengane. UZanele uyazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku zokuqala zibalulekile, futhi uqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze abantwana bakwazi ukukhula kahle.
Isiqalo Sesenzo: Ukuthunyelwa Kwama-Ambulensi Ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule, emzaneni ophawulekayo, kube nesenzakalo esiyinqaba, esaphendula umphakathi ngendlela engakaze ibonwe. Usuku lwaluphethe umoya opholile, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, lapho izakhamuzi ziqhubeka nokuphila izimpilo zabo ezijwayelekile. Kodwa-ke, ngaphansi kwalesi simo sokuthula, kube nohlanga lwezinyembezi nezifudumalo ngenxa yokuphaka okuphuthumayo. Kwathi ngesikhathi sokuqala sokuphuma kwemini, kube nezinsolo zokuthi umama onesikhathi esinzima kudingeka usizo. UThandi, umama oneminyaka engama-40, ubengena ezinkingeni zempilo ezinzima. Abantwana bakhe bamphatha kohlanga, bekwazisa ukuthi kusele kancane ukuthi aphile. Ukwesaba ukukhuze izinqola eziphuthumayo, babe sebenza kuqala ukuhamba kokuphonselela usizo. Ngaleso sikhathi, umngani wakhe uNandi, obegxila ekukhokheni izinkanyezi, wathola ukuthi isikhathi sokuphuthuma sesifike. Wanquma ukuhlela ukubiza i-ambulensi. Usuku lokwenziwa kwamashadi yilo, nezibhedlela bezihlala zicashile. U-Nandi wabamba ucingo, phakathi kokukhathazeka, waphendula izicelo eziphandlwane ezazivela kumama ohlangene nalezi zinkumbulo. "Siqalile ukuhlela indlela, sizokuthola okukhona," waphendula. Emva kwezimpungushe eziningi, uNandi uthola ubufakazi bokuthi ibhizinisi lokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi bebezingavumi ukusebenza ngendlela efanele. Abahlinzeki baba akhohliwe impendulo. Kwakudingeka isikhathi sokulala esandleni, ezokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zazizama. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, udaba lukaThandi luye lwawuqhubeka ubunzima, abantwana bakhe babekhuluma ngezingcindezelo bakhuthaza usizo. Isigaba Sokuphumelela: Ukuhamba Kwenqubo Le ndaba, ngalesi sikhathi, ibonise ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komphakathi, futhi kube nesimo sokukwazi ukuba yinxenye yokubambisana. U-Nandi watheleka uzwe izwi elihlukile, efaka uthando olukhulu ngaleso sikhathi. Ngemuva kokuqala izingxoxo, umphakathi uthenge impendulo ezilula. Kukhona abahlinzeki abazinikele, abesebenzela abantwana kanye nemindeni. Lokhu kwaba ubufakazi bokuthi abantu bephila njengabantu. Ngemva kokuphendula i-ambulensi, uThandi wadlula engozini yempilo. Kwakukuhle ngempela ngenxa yokuthi abasebenzi behlinzeka usizo lwaphezulu, baphinde babakhulu obengekho ezinsukwini ezedlule. Njengoba i-ambulensi idlula, abantu basebenze ndawonye, begubha lo msebenzi wokuhlanganisa. Kwakuyinto enhle kakhulu ukubona uThandi eyiswa esibhedlela, imvula yeqhwa yama-akarari ibamba inhliziyo zabantu. Isigaba Sokuhlola: Izifundo Eziphumelele Ngemuva kokuhamba kwezakhamuzi, uNandi wathola ithuba lokuhlola izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi. Wabuka ukuthi ukuhlanganyela komphakathi bekwazile ukukhipha izinsiza ezinkulu kumabhalane, amankampani ahlinzekayo, nakube izingxoxo eziyinqaba. Ucamela engibhekeni ucezu lokuphumula kwalezi zinsuku. Ngemva kokuhlola imiphumela, kwabhalwa iziphakamiso eziningi. Izifundo ezibonakalayo zatholakala ngale ndlela, kungaba khona amabhizinisi ahlinzeka usizo, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuthuthumela abathintekayo. Njengoba udaba lukaThandi lwandiswa, abakhuluma ngesiqubu selokhu, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zaba yinto ewusizo. Bekukhona izikhungo ezithile eziwumgudu ophumelelayo esisebenza kuwo. Okwesine, uNandi wayehlola indlela ezimele ezincane, ezivela kuzo abezindaba, ezibonga ubumbano nolwazi oluhle. Umenzi, umholi, wazidlula izinkanyezi ezifana nezinkanyezi eziphathelene namazinga wemboni kaThandi. Umlandeli naye wathola ithuba lokurhwebesha, okukhona uhlelo olusha nolwaziyo lokuxhumana, okwakukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezimpendulo ezingcono. Isiphetho: Ubuntu Nokuqhubekayo Uthando lokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi alupheli. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa okwenziwayo uNandi, njengomgwamanda, kubinahala, kubaisisekelo sesimilo sohlanga. Umoya wokuzwana nohlobo lwezindaba zikhumbula othile, sithola ukuthi abanye bahlala benza okungulu. Ngenxa yokuthi ukuphila phakathi kwabantu base-Afrika kunjengokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi, amandla amasha anombono atholakele. Uhambo lukaThandi luholele ekuchazeni izinsizakusebenza zokuphila. Lokhu kwazwakala emikhandweni emisha, lokho okwakhuphuka izitshiyela ezilayisha ukunakekela impilo, zilandela umoya wokuthola impendulo ezilula. Kungokuthola ukuzwana okwandisa izinsiza, kungazimele kodwa kudayisa ukukhathazeka kabusha kumphakathi. Kwazalwa uthando nezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo elindile, ukuze abantu bakhululeka kwezinye izimo. Umphakathi uhlangana, ukhokhiswa umhlala phansi, izindlela zokuhamba zigcizelela ukuthi uma ubumbano, umphakathi wonke uvuma, futhi empilweni kuhamba kahle. Lokhu kuncike ngokujulile ekusebenzeni kokuhlanganyela, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zivinjelwe, zazo zonke, kuze kube phezulu. Ngale ndlela, uNandi noThandi babonisa ukuthi ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi akukhona nje oduma, kodwa ingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwempilo, okukhona ukukhumbula ezingqondweni zethu, kulabo abaphila lapho sikhumbula isizathu sokuphila. Impilo ibhulwa ezingxoxweni, izingxoxo zamaphupho, imikhonjwana yokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi – uthando lunothile lukhanya kithi!
Okwamanje, kukhona impumelelo yezomnotho, umgomo kahulumeni obanzi wokuhlukahluka okukhulu, izinhlelo zamasu, nezinye izinhlelo, lapho ukuhlukahluka komlando kuqhubeka nokuba ingxenye yomnotho wezolimo, kuqhuba njengokulinganisa ukukhula, kuthuthukisa umnotho, kudala imisebenzi, futhi kwehlisa ubuphofu. Ukungalingani okukhulu ngemibala kanye nobulili ekufinyeleleni emnothweni, imali, amakhono, kanye nemisebenzi kuqhubeka. Njengomphumela, lesi sikhungo siqhubeka sisebenza ngaphansi kwamathuba awo. Le dokhumenti esemthethweni ye-NAMC ihloselwe ukwazisa bonke ababambiqhaza emkhakheni wezolimo mayelana namandla e-NAMC kanye nezinhlelo zayo ezihlukahlukene ezihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lesi sikhungo sikhona futhi sishintshile. Ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana, sinikeza amatafula anemininingwane yokuxhumana ngezikhungo ezihlukahlukene zezolimo kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni. Ukunikeza iseluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezolimo kanye namathimba afanele ngqo ngezindaba zonke ezihlobene nokumaketha kwezolimo embonini yokudla nezolimo, ngenkathi sihlinzeka ngezidingo zababambiqhaza. Ukuba ngumeluleki obalulekile kuNgqongqoshe, i-DoA, kanye nomkhakha wokumaketha kwezolimo kanye nemikhiqizo. I-NAMC iqhuba imisebenzi yayo ngezinhlelo ezine zobuchwepheshe kanye nohlelo lokweseka olusebenza ngokuhambisana. Izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza ze-unit zifaka phakathi Izinhlelo Zokumaketha/AgriBEE, Ukumaketha, kanye Nokuncintisana. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ziyizinhlelo ezisemqoka ezitholwe yi-NAMC ezihloselwe ukukhuthaza nokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwabafama abasanda kuvela emkhakheni wezolimo nokumaketha, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhweba kwemikhiqizo evela kubafama abamnyama emkhakheni. Imboni yenyama ebomvu kanye nezimboni zezitshalo zikhonjiswe njengemikhakha ebalulekile kulolu hlelo lwesikhashana. Lesi sikhungo siphinde sibe nesibopho sokunikeza iseluleko kwiKhansela ngezindaba ezihlobene nezintela nokumaketha nokwenza ucwaningo olufanele kule ndawo. Ekugcineni, umkhakha Wokumaketha Nokuthengisa uzobamba amandla abalulekile ekuxhumaneni nocwaningo nokuxoxisana mayelana nezimo zokuncintisana emkhakheni wezolimo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wokumaketha kwezolimo. I-NAMC okwamanje ikhulisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ezihloselwe ukusiza umnotho wezolimo. Inhloso eyinhloko yezi zinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ukuhlinzeka ngama-incentive emakethe ukuze kuthengwe kubakhiqizi abasanda kuvela. Inhloso ukuhlela nokusebenzisa okungenani lezi zinhlelo ezintathu ngonyaka. Lokhu kubhekwa njengomsebenzi obalulekile osekelayo kumakethe yezolimo ye-DoA kanye necebo lokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi kanye necebo lokumaketha kwezolimo ukuze kusungulwe izinhlelo ezine Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ngaphambi kukaMashi 2006. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe zizohlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlanganisa abafama abamnyama ngaphakathi kwezi zinhlelo. Umgomo wezintela ubandakanya ukufaka izintela noma ukuhoxisa izintela noma ukulungisa amazinga ezintela akhona ekuthengiseni kwamazwe ngamazwe ngenhloso yokufeza izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kukahulumeni. Inhloso eyinhloko yomgomo wezintela, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuvikela imboni yasekhaya, ukuthuthukisa isimo sokuncintisana kwabakhangisi bendawo, nokuhlanganisa izintela zokungenisa nezimikhiqizo ezifanayo zendawo. I-NAMC, ngeMkhakha Wayo Wokumaketha Nokuthengisa, izozama ukuqhubeka nobudlelwano bokubambisana ne-ITAC futhi iqale ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ezingxoxweni zomgomo wezintela ezihlobene nezolimo. Iphuzu lokuqala kuzoba ukwakha amandla ethu angaphakathi okuthi sizokwazi ukufinyelela ngokuqasha abantu abasebenza kwezomnotho wokumaketha kwezolimo ngesikhathi sokwethulwa kwalesi sibalo. Umgomo wesikhungo ukuhlela nokubhalisela, sisebenzisa izibonelo zezifundo, izindlela ezinhle zokusekela abafama. Lesi sikhungo sizothuthukisa futhi sikwazise ama-template azoholela ekuxhumaneni kokumaketha okuzofaka Amabhizinisi Aphathwe Ngaphambili emnothweni wezolimo wesibili (umnotho oyinhloko). Ibhizinisi kumele likwazi futhi likwazi ukungena esivumelwaneni sokwabelana ngezindleko ngesixhaso esidingekayo ngesisekelo sokuthola i-NAMC. I-NAMC ihlose ukusungula ifa elihloselwe ukusiza lezi zibhanqa ukufinyelela kwi-database yabahlinzeki ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kwabo emakethe futhi ngaleyo ndlela bakhule futhi baqinise amabhizinisi abo. Usizo luzobhekana ngqo nezindaba ezifana nokuqeqeshwa, ukuthuthukiswa kwecebo lebhizinisi, izinhlelo ezifanele zokufakazela, ukuhola, njll. Lokhu kuzohlinzekwa ngababoneleli bezinsizakalo abanezikhwama zokwethula iziqu. Umgomo ophawulekayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa nokuphathwa kwezimali uzothuthukiswa. I-ATAF ayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali (ukwakhiwa noma izikhwama) noma ukuthenga izimpahla zohlobo oluthile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimoto, izakhiwo, imishini, nezakhiwo zomzimba. I-ATAF futhi ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengefa lokubolekwa noma nganoma iyiphi enye injongo. Ifa le-DoA AgriBEE lizokwakhiwa maduze ukuze liqashe lezi zenzo ezifanele ezithuthukiswe ngokuqhuba i-ATAF. Ukwakha i-database yabahlinzeki bamabhizinisi aphathwe ngaphambili eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhuma labo abakwi-database nezimakethe ezifanele. Qhubeka Nokuthuthukiswa Kokuthekelisa. Umsebenzi obalulekile weMkhakha Wokuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi (ED Sector) ukuhlela izivakashi eziphumelelayo ezikhangisweni zamakethe zababhizinisi abakwi-database yabahlinzeki. Lezi zivakashi zizosebenza ukusiza lezi zibhanqa ezaphathwa ngaphambili abakwi-database yabahlinzeki ukuze ziveze ukuncintisana emakethe yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze zifinyelele emakethe yokuthekelisa enenzuzo. Ukuxhumana kwabahlinzeki kuqala ngokukhiqiza ngemboni yezolimo noma ngezinga layo lokukhiqiza. Imakethe kumele ibe khona ukuze kukhiqizwe. Umkhakha we-ED uzosebenzisa i-ATAF lapho kudingeka ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana kokuhlinzeka. Ukuxhumana kokudinga kuqala ngokudinga kwemakethe. Amabhizinisi amakhulu wezolimo adinga abakhiqizi abancane ukuze babahlinzeke ngempahla ukuze bahlangabezane nezintengo ezibekwe ngaphakathi kwemakethe noma izivumelwano zokuhlinzeka nabathengisi kanye nabathengisi. Umkhakha we-ED uzosebenzisa i-ATAF ukweseka lezi zinkampani zezomnotho ezikwazi ukusebenzisa ukuxhumana okwakhiwe kabi. Lesi sikhungo sihlela zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokuhambisana nemithetho. Umthetho Wokumaketha Imikhiqizo Yezolimo ka-1996 usungula izimo zezenzakalo ezinhlanu zokuhambisana nemithetho, ezihlanganisa izikhwama zomthetho, amarekhodi nez
Le nsizakalo iyatholakala kulabo abazofaka isicelo sokuhlala ngokungapheli ngenxa yokuba yilunga lomndeni wesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli njengenyathelo lokuqala loxhumano. Ukuze uthole ilungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli, amalunga omndeni njengenyathelo lokuqala loxhumano achazwa njengalabo abangabazali bomzimba noma izingane ezibekwe ngokomthetho yinkantolo ukuze zikhululeke noma abazali abazothatha ngokomthetho ukunakekela noma abazali ngenxa yokufa noma ukuhlukaniswa kwabazali. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi lesithunywa saseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ongapheli kumele athumele isitatimende sokuzibophezela mayelana nezimali, ukwelashwa kwezempilo, nokunakekela umfakisicelo. Nokho, uma umndeni ungumzali wengane encane, akudingeki ukwenza isitatimende sokuzibophezela. Akukho sikhathi esibekwe kulolu sevisi.
Umbiko: Ukulahlwa KweMfucuza Isingeniso Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwemvelo, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela efanele yokuphatha imfucuza ukuze kugwenywe umonakalo emvelweni. Imfucuza, uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezindaweni zokuhlala, empilweni yabantu, nasemvelweni jikelele. Kulokhu, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, izinselelo ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuthuthukiswe le nqubo. Izindlela Zokulahlwa KweMfucuza Kunezindlela eziningi zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphinda Kusetshenziswe (Recycling): Le ndlela ibandakanya ukuhlanganiswa kwemfucuza ukuze kudalwe izinto ezintsha. Lokhu kunciphisa inani lemfucuza elingena ezindaweni zokugcina imfucuza, futhi kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo. Izinto ezifana nephepha, ipulasitiki, nezinsimbi zingaphinda zisetshenziswe, zinciphisa umthelela emvelweni. 2. Ukugaya (Composting): Lokhu kuyinqubo yokuguqula imfucuza yemvelo, efana nezitshalo nezinsalela zokudla, ibe umquba. Lokhu kunciphisa imfucuza ethunyelwa ezindaweni zokugcina imfucuza futhi kukhuthaza ukukhula kwezitshalo. 3. Ukushiswa (Incineration): Le ndlela ibandakanya ukushiswa kwemfucuza ukuze kukhiqizwe amandla. Nakuba lokhu kunciphisa inani lemfucuza, kudinga ukuqashelwa izingozi ezihambisana nokukhishwa kwemikhuhlane emoyeni. 4. Ukugcina (Landfilling): Lokhu kuyindlela evamile yokulahlwa kwemfucuza, lapho imfucuza igcinwa ezindaweni ezikhethekile. Nokho, le ndlela ibangelwa ukukhathazeka ngenxa yokungcoliswa komhlaba, amanzi, nomoya. Izinselelo Zokulahlwa KweMfucuza Naphezu kwezindlela ezikhona, kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Okokuqala, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele kubantu abaningi mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha imfucuza kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi basathanda ukulahla imfucuza ngendlela engafanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuphatha kahle imfucuza. Okwesibili, izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe lezi zindlela zihlala zikhona, kodwa zihlala zikhawulelwe. Izikhungo zokuphinda zisetshenziswe, izindawo zokugaya, nezikhungo zokushisa zidinga ukuxhaswa ngokwanele ukuze zisebenze kahle. Okwesithathu, izinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza eminingi, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini, zidinga ukulandela imithetho eqinile yokuphatha imfucuza. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfucuza iphathwa ngendlela efanele. Izixazululo Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokubaluleka kokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikoleni, emiphakathini, nasemiphakathini zingasiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi imfucuza ingaphathwa kanjani kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni kufanele ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele zokuphatha imfucuza, kuhlanganise nezikhungo zokuphinda zisetshenziswe nezindawo zokugaya. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthi baphathe imfucuza yabo ngendlela efanele. Izinkampani nazo zidinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha imfucuza, futhi zidinga ukulandela imithetho yokuphatha imfucuza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imvelo nokunciphisa umthelela omubi wemfucuza. Isiphetho Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Noma kunezindlela eziningi zokulahlwa kwemfucuza, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfucuza iphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ngokufundisa umphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, nokwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile, singathuthukisa indlela esiphatha ngayo imfucuza, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sigcine imvelo yethu iphilile.
### Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikaPistorius Isigameko sikaOscar Pistorius, umjaho ophakeme waseNingizimu Afrika, sathinta izwe lonke ngemuva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp ngomhla kaFebhuwari 14, 2013. U-Pistorius, owaziwa njengomjaho onenhloso yokuphila, watholakala enecala lokubulala, okwaholela ekutheni kudingidwe nokuqondwa kahle kwesinqumo esithathwe yisigungu esiphezulu sokwahlulela. ### Izizathu zokuba nezimo ezinjalo Ukuze siqonde ukuthi izigameko ezifana nalezi zenzeka kanjani, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo zomphakathi zishintsha kanjani ngenxa yokuhlukumeza, ubudlelwano, kanye nokusebenzisa izikhali. U-Pistorius, owayengumfana ophila nezitho zomzimba ezihlukile, waba isibonelo sokuzimisela, kodwa lezi zimo zenzeka endaweni enokuncintisana, lapho izinkinga zomphakathi ziphakamisa imibuzo eminingi mayelana nokuphepha, ubulili, nobuhlanga. ### Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo U-Pistorius watholakala enecala lokubulala uReeva Steenkamp, owayengumthandi wakhe, ngesikhathi eshaya udonga lwesikhumba. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngemuva kokuba abavivinywa bephikisana nezimpikiswano eziningi, ezaziphakanyiswa ngama-advocates ababili, omunye ehamba phambili emthethweni nezinye izimo zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, watholakala enecala lokubulala ngokungaqondile, kodwa umphakathi walwa nokuqonda ukuthi kwenzekeni, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nemithetho yokubulala, nokuthi izinqumo zalesi sigameko zingafaka kanjani umthelela kumphakathi wonke. ### Umthelela wesinqumo Isinqumo sikaPistorius sibe nomthelela omkhulu kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Abantu abaningi babebona lesi sigameko njengomfanekiso wezinkinga ezikhona ezinsukwini zethu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhuluma ngensimu yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhuluma izinto ezihlobene nezobudlelwano. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kuhlanganise nezindlela zokuhlonipha abesifazane, kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane. ### Ukuqonda umthelela wezomthetho Ukuze siqonde umthelela wezomthetho kuPistorius, kudingeka ukuqonda ukuthi izinqumo zomthetho kumele ziqondiswe ngabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi uvule izwi, futhi abezindaba baphakamishe izindaba ezithinta umphakathi. Imiphumela yesinqumo sikaPistorius ibonakala ngokuhlanganiswa kwemicabango emisha ezimweni zomthetho, njengoba izinkantolo zifuna ukwakha izinqumo ezizobhelwa ngempela. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokwakha umqondo wokuhlonipha, kudinga ukuthi izinqumo zomthetho zihlale zisenkingeni yokwesekwa komphakathi. ### Ukubaluleka kokuxoxwa Ukubaluleka kokuxoxwa ngezindaba ezifana nalezi akugcini nje emthethweni, kodwa nakumaqembu omphakathi. Izinkulumo ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zingakhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nezwi, baphendule ezinhlungwini ezikhona. Ukuxoxisana ngezindaba ezinjalo kuveza izinkinga ezibalulekile, futhi kudinga ukuthi wonke umuntu azinake. ### Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikaPistorius kuphakamisa imibuzo eminingi emqoka, okuhlanganisa izinkinga zomthetho, izinjongo nemithetho, kanye nomphakathi. U-Pistorius, njengoba esebenza ekwehlukaniseni phakathi kwesimo somphakathi nesomthetho, waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinqumo zempilo yomphakathi zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Isifundo esibalulekile esitholakala kulolu hlobo lwezimo sithi imithetho akumele ishiywe kuphela ezandleni zomphakathi, kodwa kufanele ibhekiswe emnothweni wezomthetho, umphakathi, nezinkambiso zethu. Lezi zifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukufunda nokuhlaziya izinqumo zomthetho akukhona nje kuphela ukucabanga ngempilo yomuntu, kodwa ukufaka imithetho enothile emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi izinqumo zethu zinomthelela omkhulu, futhi kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, futhi ophumelelayo.
Amabhayisikili Nezithuthuthu Isingeniso Emphakathini wethu wanamuhla, amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu seziwumgogodla kwezokuhamba, zibe nezindima ezinkulu ezithinta impilo yethu, ukuhamba, nezokuthutha. Lezi zinsiza zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zombili zikhombisa izinzuzo ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu, ezemvelo, kanye nezomnotho. Kulolu mbiko, sizobheka izici ezahlukene zamabhayisikili nezithuthuthu, sikhulume ngezinzuzo zazo, izinkinga eziyihambisayo, kanye nezinto ezithinta ukukhetha phakathi kwalokhu kuhambo. Uhlaka Lokuhamba Amabhayisikili ayithuluzi elidala elisiza abantu ukuba bahambe kalula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomthelela omncane kwezokungcola. Uhlaka lwamabhayisikili luthokozisa abantu abaningi, njengoba lungabiza kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezithuthuthu. Abantu abaningi bathanda amabhayisikili ngenxa yokuthi awathathi isikhathi eside ukufunda ukuhamba ngawo, futhi angavumela umsebenzisi ukuba abone imvelo eduze, athokozise umoya opholile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zikhona njengomkhiqizo owakhiwe ukuze zisetshenziswe ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Zivame ukuba nezici ezithokozisayo, ezifana nokushesha, amandla, kanye nokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kude. Nokho, izithuthuthu zikhona nezingqinamba ezithile, njengokungcola kokukhuluma nokubiza kakhulu ukuthenga nokugcina. Izinzuzo Zokuhamba Ngamabhayisikili Amabhayisikili anikeza izinzuzo eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomsebenzisi. Ukuhamba ngamabhayisikili kunika amandla umzimba, kuthuthukisa impilo yomoya, futhi kudala umoya opholile. Lokhu kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho izifo ezihlobene nokungasebenzi kahle zikhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili awathathi indawo eningi, futhi angahamba ezindaweni eziningi ezivimba izimoto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili avumela umsebenzisi ukuba ahlale eduze kwemvelo. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ubudlelwane bomuntu nemvelo, kuyilapho kufaka isandla ekugcineni kwemvelo. Amabhayisikili angatholakala kalula ezimakethe, futhi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nabantu abadala, abantwana, nezimfashini ezahlukene. Izinzuzo Zokuhamba Nezithuthuthu Izithuthuthu zikhombisa izinzuzo ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba okuphuthumayo. Lezi zithuthuthu zenzelwe ukuhamba ngokushesha, okuvumela umsebenzisi ukuba afinyelele ezindaweni ezikude kahle. Ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe kulezi zinsiza kuholele ekwenzeni izithuthuthu zibe nezici eziningi, njengokuphathwa kahle, izinga eliphezulu lokuphepha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izithuthuthu zinezinzuzo zezimali, njengoba zikhokhisa amandla amancane uma kuqhathaniswa nezimoto. Lokhu kunciphisa izindleko zempilo, okwenza kube lula kumuntu ofisa ukuhamba kude ngaphandle kokuchitha imali eningi. Izithuthuthu nazo zikhulisa umkhiqizo, ngoba zenza kube lula ukuhamba ngempumelelo ezindaweni eziyinkimbinkimbi. Izinkinga Nezingozi Nokho, nakuba amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu zinemibono emihle, zikhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Amabhayisikili, nakuba ezinzuzweni, angaholela ezinkingeni zokuphepha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezimoto eziningi. Ukushaya kwabantu, ukungaboni kahle, noma ukungatholi indawo efanelekile yokuhamba kungaholela ezincwadini ezinzima. Izithuthuthu nazo zinalo mthelela wazo. Izingozi ezivela ekusebenziseni izithuthuthu zikhula, ikakhulukazi uma abantu behamba ngokungafanele noma bengalali imigqa. Ukuphuma emgwaqeni, ukushaywa, kanye nezingozi zezokuphepha zibangelwa yizinto eziningi, okuholela ekubeni kube nezingozi ezinzima. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu zinemiphumela emihle kanye nemibi. Zombili lezi zinsiza zikhombisa izinzuzo ezinkulu emhlabeni wanamuhla, zisebenza njengoba kube yinsiza yokuhamba, zikhulisa impilo, futhi zinciphisa ukungcola. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nazo, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphepha kubalulekile. Ngokuhlanganyela, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sithatha izinyathelo eziphephile futhi sikhuthaza indlela yokuhamba ethokozisayo, enempilo, nephephile. Ngale ndlela, singasiza ukufaka isandla empilweni yethu, emvelweni, nasemphakathini wethu.
UMphathiswa Wezimo Zomhlaba Nezokuvakasha wenze imithetho ebekwe kulolu hlu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24 esifundwa nesigaba 44 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimo Zomhlaba, 1998 (Umthetho No. 107 ka-1998). Ku-Notice Yombuso No. R. 386 no. R. Uma ngokuhambisana nale mithetho izinsuku kufanele zibhalwe kusukela ngosuku oluthile kulandela usuku oluthile kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku lokugcina lesikhathi, kodwa uma usuku lokugcina lesikhathi luhlangana neMgqibelo, uMsombuluko, noma usuku lwezivakashi, leso sikhathi kufanele sandiswe kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku olulandelayo olungelona uMgqibelo, uMsombuluko, noma usuku lwezivakashi. Inhloso yale mithetho ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela nezinqubo njengoba kuboniswe esigabeni 5 soMthetho mayelana nokuhanjiswa, ukucutshungulwa, nezinqumo ezithathwa ngezicelo zokuthola izimvume zemvelo nezindaba ezihlobene. Zonke izicelo ngaphansi yale mithetho kufanele zinqunywe ngokuqondile. I-Authority efanele okufanele icabangele futhi ithathe isinqumo ngesicelo mayelana nomsebenzi othile kufanele iphathwe ngokuhambisana ne-Notice Yombuso No. R. 386 no. R. 387 ka-2006, kuhlanganise nezinye izikhumbuzo ezingase zikhishwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24D soMthetho. Noma iyiphi impikiswano noma ukungavumelani mayelana nokuthi iyiphi i-Authority efanele ukuhambisana nanoma yisiphi isicelo esithile kufanele ixazululwe nguMphathiswa kanye nomphathi wephalamende elihlobene noma nguMphathiswa kanye nelungu leziphathimandla elinikezwe ukuhlela lokho, okungafanele. Uma uMphathiswa engumgibeli ofanele wesicelo esithile, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo Sezimo Zomhlaba Nezokuvakasha. Uma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene engumgibeli ofanele, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo sephalamende esibhekele izindaba zemvelo kulolo phalamende. Uma uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene esebenzise noma yiziphi amandla noma imisebenzi ye-Authority efanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 42 soMthetho mayelana nomsebenzi obhalwe esicelweni, kufanele kuhanjiswe kumuntu ofanele weziphathimandla onikezwe amandla. Singase sinikeze umceli noma i-EAP ukufinyelela kunoma yiziphi iziqondiso nolwazi mayelana nezindlela ezibekwe noma nolwazi olunikezwe i-Authority efanele oluhlobene nesicelo; noma b sicele umceli noma i-EAP, ngokubhala noma ngengxoxo, mayelana nohlobo nobubanzi bezinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinhlinzeko zale mithetho. Lapho isicelo sokusebenza kwezimo zemvelo ngaphansi kwale mithetho kufanele senziwe ngokuhambisana neminye imithetho futhi le mithetho eminye ifuna ukuthi ulwazi lunikezwe noma izinqubo zilandelwe njengokugcwele kanye nolwazi noma izinqubo ezidingekayo ngaphansi kwale mithetho, uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene, ngokuhlinzeka ngeSahluko 3 seMthethosisekelo kanye nesigaba 24(g) soMthetho, kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokungena esivumelwaneni sokubhala ne-Authority enesibopho sokuphatha umthetho ophathelene nokulethwa kwezidingo zepolitiki nezimiso zalesi sikhumbuzo ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda ekuthumeleni kwalolo lwazi noma ekwenzeni lezi zinqubo. I-Authority efanele kufanele ithole lonke ulwazi oluhambelanayo noma olunomthelela olungase lube khona mayelana nanoma yisiphi isinqumo ngesicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi lelo lwazi livikelwe ngumthetho, umceli noma i-EAP noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ophatha lelo lwazi, uma ucelwa yi-Authority efanele, kufanele aveze lelo lwazi kwi-Authority efanele, noma ngabe lelo lwazi libeka umceli endaweni ethokozisayo noma engathokozisi. viii noma yimiphi imibono evela kulungu lweziphathimandla olunamandla alinganiselwe emthethweni mayelana nengxenye ethile yomsebenzi ophathelene nesicelo; kanye ix noma yimiphi iziqondiso ezihlobene nesicelo. I-Authority efanele kufanele izame ukuhlangabezana nezikhathi ezibekwe kuma-Authority efanele ngaphansi kwale mithetho. Uma i-Authority efanele ingumgibeli weziphathimandla ophethe amandla anikezwe kuwo nemisebenzi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 42 noma 42A soMthetho futhi leli lungu leziphathimandla lingakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezikhathi ezibekwe kule mithetho, leli lungu leziphathimandla elinikezwe amandla kufanele libike uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene. b sinikeze umceli izizathu zalesi sinqumo; futhi c sikwazise umceli ngendawo yokuthi lesi sinqumo singaphikiswa ngokuhambisana neSahluko 7 sale mithetho, uma leyo mfuneko yokuphikisa ikhona emkhakheni walesi sinqumo. i mayelana nesinqumo ngesicelo; futhi ii mayelana nezizathu zalesi sinqumo; futhi b sikwazise ngendawo yokuthi lesi sinqumo esithathwe singaphikiswa ngokuhambisana neSahluko 7 sale mithetho, uma leyo mfuneko yokuphikisa ikhona emkhakheni walesi sinqumo. a sigcina amarekhodi wezikhalazo zonke ezamukelwe yi-Authority efanele ngaphansi kwale mithetho; futhi b sibhala zonke izinqumo eziphathelene nezimvume zemvelo. I-Authority efanele ayinakubekwa icala nganoma yiziphi izindleko ezithathwe umceli ngokuhambisana nale mithetho. Isicelo sokuthola imvume yemvelo yomsebenzi kufanele sithunyelwe kwi-Authority efanele lapho sithunyelwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho 3. i futhi imvume ebhaliwe ethunyelwe kumthetho 161 noma ubufakazi bokuthi umthetho 163 ulandelwe, uma umceli engum sahibi bomhlaba lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa; futhi ii imali yokufaka isicelo ethile, uma ikhona. b sihambisana nanoma yiziphi imibiko, ezinye imibhalo, nezimali ezidingekayo ngaphansi kwale mithetho; futhi c sibe nolwazi ngazo zonke iziqondiso ezihambelanayo zokuthumela izicelo. a sivuma ukuthi sithole isicelo, uma isicelo sihamba kahle, noma b sithanda isicelo, uma singahambi kahle. I-EAP ephethe isinqumo ingashintsha leso sicelo futhi isithumele kwi-Authority efanele. Ukushintsha nokuthunyelwa kwesicelo esishintshiwe kufanele kuthunyelwe kwi-Authority efanele ngokuhambisana nokushintsha. Uma umceli efuna ukwenza imisebenzi emibili noma ngaphezulu njengengxenye yephrojekthi efanayo, ifomu lesicelo elilodwa kufanele lithunyelwe kuyo yonke le misebenzi. Uma umceli efuna ukwenza imisebenzi engaphezu kweyodwa efanayo ezindaweni ezahlukene, izicelo ezihlukene kufanele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphakathi kwenhlokodolobha efanayo, kodwa i-Authority efanele inganika imvume ngokusekelwe kufomu lesicelo elilodwa elithunyelwe ngumceli, lesicelo elilodwa lezo zonke lezi zisebenzi, noma ngabe isicelo sithunyelwe kufomu lesicelo elilodwa noma kumafomu amaningi. Uma i-Authority efanele inika imvume ngokuhambisana nokushintsha 2, isicelo kufanele futhi sithathwe njengokuhamba okuhlanganisiwe kwemisebenzi yonke ephathelene nesicelo, kodwa umthelela wemvelo ongekho emthethweni walowo msebenzi kufanele ucabangele mayelana nendawo lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa. Iminikelo Nezinkokhelo Zobulungu be-GEMS Ukuba yilungu le-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kubalulekile ukuze uthole usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubulungu bakho busebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda imininingwane yeminikelo nezinkokhelo ezihambisana nalokhu. Nansi indlela yokwenza izinkokhelo zakho zokubulunga ngendlela efanele: Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Iminikelo Zobulungu Iminikelo eyenziwa yilungu le-GEMS ihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, ngokuvamile ngokuhambisana nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Iminikelo ye-GEMS ifaka phakathi iminikelo eyenziwa ngonyaka, ethuthukiswa ngokuhlanganiswa kwemali yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le mikhawulo ingashintsha, ngakho-ke kufanele uhlale ubheka izibuyekezo ezivela ku-GEMS. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubhalisela Ubulungu Ukuze ubhalise njengelungu le-GEMS, kufanele uvakashele kuwebhusayithi yabo noma ehhovisi labo. Uzothola ifomu lokubhalisela ubulungu elidinga ulwazi oluthile njengeminyaka yakho, idatha yomsebenzi, kanye nolwazi lwezezimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi ufaka yonke imininingwane edingekayo ukuze ugweme izinkinga zokuhamba phambili. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhetha Uhlelo Lokuhlinzeka Ngemuva kokubhalisela ubulungu, kuzodingeka ukhethe uhlelo lokuhlinzeka olufanele. I-GEMS inezinhlelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ezokwelashwa, ezokuhlinzwa, nokunye. Qhathanisa izinzuzo nezindleko zohlelo ngalunye ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukhetha lokho okuthokozisayo. Ungacela usizo kumeluleki we-GEMS uma ungazi kahle. Isinyathelo 4: Ukwenza Izinkokhelo Zobulungu Izinkokhelo zakho zidinga ukuba zenziwe ngenyanga futhi zihlala zikhokhelwa emuva. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungumsebenzi, izinkokhelo zingaqhathaniswa nezinye izinxephezelo zakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela izinsuku zokugcina zokukhokha ukuze ungabhekani nezinkinga zokungabi nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqinisekisa Ukukhokha Ngemuva kokwenza izinkokhelo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zifakwe kahle. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokuhlola i-akhawunti yakho ye-GEMS online, noma ngokuxhumana nekhaya le-GEMS. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ibhalwe kahle, futhi uzothola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Njengoba usuku lokukhokha lufika, qinisekisa ukuthi ubuyekeza izimali zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungakwazi ukufaka izinkokhelo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awudluli ezindlekweni ezithile, futhi uzoba nekhono lokuphatha izimali zakho kahle. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuxhumana Ne-GEMS Uma unemibuzo noma izinkinga mayelana nezinkokhelo zakho, ungaxhumana ne-GEMS ngokuqondile. Bahlala bekulungele ukusiza, futhi ungathola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Ungasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana, kufaka phakathi ucingo, i-imeyili, noma iwebhusayithi yabo. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuqonda Izibuyekezo Nezinguquko I-GEMS iyashintsha izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zayo ngezikhathi ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale ubheka izibuyekezo ezivela ku-GEMS ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi ngezinguquko ezithinta ubulungu bakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Isinyathelo 9: Ukulandelela Izinsiza Zempilo Ngemva kokukhokha, ungathola izinsiza ezahlukene ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Lokhu kubandakanya izikhungo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela impilo, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Qiniseka ukuthi uyawasebenzisa la mathuba ukuze uthole usizo olufanele. Isinyathelo 10: Ukuqonda Izinsiza Zokuxhumana I-GEMS inezinsiza eziningi zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo, ezihlanganisa imithombo ye-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazisebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze uthole ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi uqhubeke uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubulungu bakho be-GEMS busebenza kahle, futhi uthola usizo lwezempilo oludingayo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale unolwazi oluqondile, futhi uvuselela izinkokhelo zakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga. Ukwazi kahle imininingwane yokubulunga kuzokwenza ube nekhono lokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele.
Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha Ngiyavuma, lezi zinsuku sithola izinkinga eziningi ezithinta intsha. Ukungasebenzi kwentsha sekuyinkinga enkulu, futhi kubonakala sengathi akuphumi kalula. Ngabe sikhuluma ngani lapha? Ngabe intsha iyazama, noma kukhona okuthile okungahambi kahle? Lokhu kuzoba yinkulumo ethokozisayo, ngicela uhambe nami. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngezizathu eziholela ekungasebenzi kwentsha. Abantu abaningi bahlala bephikisana nezimo zomnotho. Imakethe yomsebenzi ibonakala iyinzima, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi. Abantu abasha baphuma ezikoleni, bephupha ngempilo engcono, kodwa uma befika emhlabeni, bahlushwa ukungabi namathuba. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphoxeka, futhi abanye baphendukela ezindleleni ezingalungile ukuze bazame ukuthola imali. Ngabe ubona lokhu? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokungasebenzi, kodwa akukhona nje ukuthi intsha ayifuni ukusebenza. Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu. Abanye bahlala bezama ukuthola imisebenzi ethile, kodwa imakethe ibonakala inganiki ithuba. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi akekho onakekela intsha, futhi lokhu kungenza abantu bazizwe bengafuni ukuzama. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo yansuku zonke yentsha. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu ngengcindezi yokuphila. Ubulili, ubudala, nezimo zomndeni zidlala indima enkulu. Abanye bahlala bezama ukusiza imindeni yabo, kodwa uma imisebenzi ingekho, lokho kuba nzima. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi akekho onakekela, futhi abanye baphendukela ezindleleni ezingalungile ukuze bazame ukuthola imali. Ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, kufanele sikhulume nangokuthi intsha ibhekana nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Ukungasebenzi kungaholela ekudambiseni, futhi lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola amandla okuzama. Abantu abasha bahlushwa kakhulu ngengcindezi yokuphila, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi akekho onakekela. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho intsha ingakwazi ukuthola usizo, futhi lokhu kuqhubeka. Ngabe sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokungasebenzi, kufanele sikhulume nangokuthi imiphakathi ingasiza kanjani. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezikhona, kodwa abanye abantu abazi ngazo. Imiphakathi ingaba nendima enkulu ekusizeni intsha. Lokhu kungaba ngezinhlelo zokufundisa, izinhlelo zokusebenza, noma ngisho nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Uma imiphakathi ingasebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukusiza intsha ukuthi ibone amathuba. Ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, kufanele sikhulume nangokuthi intsha ingazithola kanjani izindlela zokuziphilisa. Abantu abasha bahlala bezama ukuthola izindlela zokwenza imali, futhi lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe. Kukhona amathuba amaningi, kodwa abanye bahlala bephikisana nezimo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi akekho onakekela, futhi abanye baphendukela ezindleleni ezingalungile. Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu, futhi kufanele sikhulume ngalezi zinto. Imiphakathi ingaba nendima enkulu ekusizeni intsha, futhi uma sikhuluma ndawonye, singakwazi ukusiza intsha ukuthi ibone amathuba. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, futhi kufanele sikhulume ngalezi zinto ukuze sithole izixazululo. Sawubona bafana, niyaphi? O, cha, thina siphinde siye ePolokwane! O, phuma. Le nhlangano ikhohliwe ukushintsha amagama ezindawo ngaphandle kwesizathu. Bafana! Ngalmost ngilahlekelwe ithuba lokuthola ukuhamba ngenxa yalokho. Angikuthandi nakancane. Leli zwe lidinga imali yokwakha izindlu nokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS, kodwa esikhundleni salokho, siphuma ezivakashi ezweni lethu. Asazi ukuthi siphuma kuphi! Bangobani laba bantu abashintsha amagama ezwe lethu? Vuka mfana, ukushintsha amagama akukhona nje ukuhamba. Kuye ngenhloso yokunikeza igama elihle ezweni lethu, umlando wethu, kanye nesiko lethu. Singakwenza kanjani ukukhuthaza izwe lethu emphakathini wamazwe omhlaba uma sisasebenzisa amagama athathiwe kwamanye amazwe? Sidinga ukukhuthaza izwe lethu, ukuze sikhombise ubunikazi bethu bokwenyani. Sidinga ukuveza emphakathini wamazwe omhlaba ukuthi singobani ngempela! Lokhu kushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo zezwe kuyindaba ethinta kakhulu! Bheka lapha kule ndatshana, uma usuwenze lokho, sizoxoxa ngalolu daba. Siphakathi kokuphuma lapho siya khona, ngakho sinesikhathi sokuxoxa ngakho. Ngamagama ezici zemvelo, ezenziwe noma ezishintshiwe ngabantu, zingaba nezakhamuzi noma zingabi nazo. I-SAGNC yasungulwa nguMthetho weSishayamthetho seGeographical Names Council (Umthetho No. 111 ka-1998) njengomgomo ophatha ukushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo eNingizimu Afrika. Yasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko. I-SAGNC ifaka ochwepheshe kumagama ezindawo, izilimi ezisemthethweni, umlando wesiko, ummeleli ovela kwisifunda ngasinye, abamele bonke osifundeni, kanye nabamele uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Nezinguquko Zomhlaba, iPosi, iBhodi Lezilimi ZaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezinye izikhungo ezihlobene. Umgomo ophatha i-SAGNC usebenza ngezinhlelo zePhondo zokuphatha amagama ezindawo kanti izinga lezakhamuzi lisebenza ngezinhlelo Zasekhaya Nezasezifundeni. Kufanele ukwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinhlelo endaweni yakho. Ukuze kube lula, kuhlobene namagama ezici zemvelo zezinhlobonhlobo zezinto ezweni. Ngamagama abhaliswe ngummthetho. Isibonelo, igama lezwe, amagama ezifunda, namagama ezindawo zokuhlala kanye nezinto eziphathwa ngababheki bendawo ezifana nezindlela, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izikhala, amapaki, nezindela. Bese kuba nezakhiwo nezivini eziphethwe ngabantu ngabanye. Ngokufanayo, amagama ezici zemvelo asetshenziselwa ukubhaliswa komhlaba azaziwa njengezindawo zeCadastral. Nokho, wonke amagama asemthethweni kufanele ahambisane nemigomo yokubiza ye-SAGNC. Abantu bavame ukuhlinzeka ngamagama afanayo ezindaweni ezahlukene noma amagama akhangayo noma afana kakhulu njengoba kubhalwe kwenye indawo. Ezweni elinamagama amaningi njengeNingizimu Afrika, izindawo zivame ukuba namagama amaningi. Lezi zimo zikhokelela ekuqondeni okungafanele nasekudidekeni. Ukuze kuvinjelwe lokho, emhlabeni jikelele, amagama ezindawo alawulwa ngababheki. Kubalulekile ukuhlela amagama ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando nezimpawu zezwe ziyaziwa ngokwezizwe nezohwebo, ukuthuthwa, ukuxhumana, ukuhlela izifunda nezemvelo, imisebenzi yomphakathi, isayensi nobuchwepheshe, ukhetho nezibalo, ezokuvakasha, ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlonza nokusiza. I-SAGNC yenze isinqumo sokugcina sokuthi yiziphi noma yiziphi amagama okufanele anconywe kuNgqongqoshe. Uma igama liqinisekisiwe nguNgqongqoshe, lelo gama liyaqashelwa ngokusemthethweni. Libhalwa kwiGazethi yoMnyango ukuze libe semthethweni futhi limemezelwe. Ibhodi ihlangana kathathu ngonyaka. Njengoba ukuhamba kwenzeka ngenxa yokungaphelele noma ulwazi olungalungile kufomu lesicelo, abafakizicelo kufanele bazi ukuthi ukuvunywa kwegama kungaba inqubo ende. Lokhu kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuhlelwa ukuthi isikhathi sokulinda singathatha okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu futhi kufanele kuqinisekiswe lapho kugcwaliswa ifomu ukuthi kugcwaliswe kahle ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuhamba okude. Noma ngubani angathola ifomu lesicelo kwiwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko ku-www.dac.gov.za, emahhovisi kazwelonke, esifundeni, nasezindaweni zomphakathi ezisebenza namagama ezindawo, noma ungafaka isicelo ku-www.sagns.gov.za. Ngaphambi kokugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, kufanele ulifunde kahle futhi ugweme lokhu... Amagama abantu abaphilayo kufanele futhi agwenywe. Izici zemvelo ezibizwa ngamagama abantu kufanele zihambisane nobuhlakani balo muntu. Ngokukhuluma kalula, kubonisa okuthile okubalulekile ngomuntu odumile ezweni lonke. Kulungile, ngiyaphendukela lapha. I-Polokwane ikhulu elingu-15 phambili. Jabulela ukuvakashela kwakho! Ngiyabonga ngokusihamba. Ngempela, ngiyabonga, uhamba ngokuphepha.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Kwakungokwesikhathi sasebusuku, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo. Ebhakabhakeni, umoya wawuhamba kancane, ulethe umuzwa wokuthula. Kodwa ngaphakathi kwezibhedlela, kwabe sekukhanya okukhanyayo, izwi lezingane ezisanda kuzalwa lalisakazeka, likhombisa umhlaba omusha, umhlaba wezithelo ezimnandi. UThandi, umama omncane, wayephakathi kokukhathazeka nokujabula. Uthando lwakhe lwazalwa emhlabeni, kodwa wayesaba. Wayefuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umntwana wakhe, uSipho, uzothola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngemuva kokubeletha, uThandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezinhle zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheli, kodwa ubuhlungu bokubeletha babumkhathaza. Uthandi wakhumbula izifundo azifundile, ukuthi umntwana udinga uthando, ukunakekelwa, nokuphepha. Ngaleso sikhathi, udokotela, uDkt. Mthembu, wangenela. Wayenobungane, enomoya opholile, futhi wakhuluma noThandi ngendlela efanele yokunakekela uSipho. “UThandi,” kusho uDkt. Mthembu, “umntwana wakho udinga ukudla okunempilo, ukulala kahle, nokuthola uthando lwakho. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uSipho uthola konke okudingayo.” UThandi wathokozisa, waba nethemba. Uhlanga lwakhe lwakhe lwalukhanya, njengoba uDkt. Mthembu eqhubeka nokuchaza izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Wafundiswa ukuthi umntwana udinga ukuxhumana nomama wakhe, ukuze akwazi ukujula emhlabeni. Uthandi wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana kwangempela kuqala ngothando, futhi lokho kwaba yisisekelo sokukhula kukaSipho. Izinsuku zedlula, uThandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokunakekela izingane. Kwakukhona abahlengikazi abazinikele, ababeqinisekisa ukuthi uSipho uthola ukunakekelwa okuhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi abahlengikazi babenobungane, bejabulile, futhi bephendula imibuzo yakhe ngothando. “UThandi, ungakhathazeki,” kusho uNandi, omunye wabahlengikazi. “Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze uSipho akhule kahle. Uthando lwakho luwusizo olukhulu.” UThandi waba nethemba, futhi wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje kuphela ukwelashwa, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheli, futhi lokho kwaba yinsika yokukhula kukaSipho. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uSipho wathola ukuvakashelwa ngabazali, abangane, kanye nemindeni. UThandi wathokozisa, njengoba ubudlelwano bukhula. Uthando lwakhe lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile. UThandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela izingane, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokukhulisa izingane, izifundo zokudla okunempilo, kanye nezifundo zokuxhumana. Uthando lwakhe lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi uSipho uqala ukukhula, ethokozisa, futhi ejabulela impilo. Uthando lwakhe lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile.
