Uthando lwakhe lwaba yinsika yokukhula, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda
Umkhakha wezokumbiwa eNingizimu Afrika udlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni womhlaba. Ngo-2001, ukumbiwa kwaba negalelo elingaphezu kuka-6% ku-Gross Domestic Product (GDP) yelizwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhiqizwa kwekhabhoni kuyinsiza eyinhloko yokusebenza yamandla kubakhiqizi bamakhaya eNingizimu Afrika, abaphinde bayithumele kwamanye amazwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhiqizo yensimbi kanye nemikhiqizo engeyona insimbi ibalulekile emkhakheni wokwakha futhi isekela ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi zezwe. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) ibheka ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi bemigodi nabanye abathintekayo emisebenzini yokumbiwa. Iphokophele ukunciphisa izigameko zokulimala nezifo, ngaleyo ndlela ibonise izinselelo ezibhekene nomkhakha wezokumbiwa. Impilo yomsebenzi kunzima ukuyilinganisa nokuyiphatha, njengoba imiphumela yomsebenzi empilweni yomuntu ingase ingaveli ngokushesha. Izifo zamaphaphu nokulahleka kokuzwa ngenxa yomnoise kuyizinkinga ezinkulu zempilo emkhakheni wezokumbiwa, ezibangelwa ukusebenza ezindaweni ezinezinkanyezi nezimnandi isikhathi eside. Imigodi yegolide ithola abasebenzi abaningi emkhakheni wezokumbiwa uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izimboni; ngakho-ke, abasebenzi bayo bahlala besengozini enkulu yezifo zokuphefumula uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abakwi-migodi eminye. Isifo samaphaphu esikhathazayo kakhulu emigodini yegolide yi-silicosis, etholakale kuwo wonke imigodi ye-hard rock, ngesikhathi sokumbiwa nokuphola kwe-ore, lapho ama-particles e-silica angaba phezulu. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezibeka abasebenzi engcupheni ye-silica kanye nesifo se-silicosis kudala ingozi yokuthola i-tuberculosis. I-silicosis nayo iyinkinga enkulu emigodini ye-khabhoni. Kukhona ukuqaphela okukhulayo komnoise njengengozi yempilo kubasebenzi abangaphansi komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika. Umkhakha wethule izinhlelo zokuvikela ukuzwa (HCPs) ngo-1988, njengoba imisebenzi eminingi eyenziwa ekukhishweni kwemaminerali ibangele inani elikhulu labantu abathintekayo kumazinga omsindo aphakeme kunezinga elamukelekayo neliphephile elingu-85 dB. Nakuba izinyathelo zithathwe ukuze kulawulwe izingozi zomnoise, le nkinga isaqhubeka. Kubhekwa ukuthi phakathi kuka-68% no-80% babasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ngaphansi kwamazinga omsindo angu-85 dB noma ngaphezulu, okukhombisa ukuthi iningi labantu laba bahlala besengozini yokulahlekelwa ukuzwa. Imigodi ebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu mayelana nokuphepha emsebenzini yilezo zegolide ne-platinum. Eminyakeni yamuva, ukukhiqizwa kwe-platinum kukhule, kuholela emisebenzini eminingi. Ngeshwa, lokhu kuphinde kwaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokulimala. Kutholakale ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa nokuqwashisa emkhakheni we-platinum kuphansi kulokhu kukhula. Umkhakha wezokumbiwa kwegolide uhola ezimeni zokulimala ngenxa yokujula kokusebenza nokwehla kwezindonga. Nakuba imisebenzi yokumbiwa kwegolide yehlile kakhulu eminyakeni yamuva, le nhlobo ayibonisi ukuthuthuka ezingeni lokuphepha ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ngenkathi kungase kube nezinguquko ngenxa yezinhlobo zomsebenzi wokumbiwa ongaphansi komhlaba nezinga elihlukile lezingcuphe ezimweni zokumbiwa, lezi zingozi zomsebenzi zidinga ukuphathwa kahle. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuwa komhlaba kuhlala kuyinto evamile futhi ebanga impilo emigodini yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukulahlekelwa impilo kanye nenani lokulimala okwenza abasebenzi bangakwazi ukusebenza kulo mkhakha kungancishiswa ngokukhetha nokusebenzisa izinyathelo zokulawula ezifanele nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinga eliphezulu lokuhambisana nemithetho ligcinwa. Ukuphepha emigodini emincane nakho kuyakhathaza ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokulimala okukhona lapho. Kutholakale ukuthi imbangela yalesi simo ukuqeqeshwa okulinganiselwe kanye nezinsiza ezinganele. Abasebenzi kulo mkhakha badinga usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwemigodi, futhi imikhankaso ehlukene isiqalile ukuhlinzeka ngensiza edingekayo. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) isekela imikhankaso ebanzi, efana nokukhuthaza imigodi emincane. Ekugcineni, le ofisi iyingxenye yokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS. Isekela imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi kanye nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukunciphisa ukuvela kwe-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wezokumbiwa. Iphinde yasungula ikomidi le-tripartite elibhekelela i-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wezokumbiwa. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi nezibanzi ezibhekene nomkhakha wezokumbiwa, uhlelo oluqinile lokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo, kuhlanganise nabaqashi nohulumeni, lungahlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. I-Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DME) ibhekelela kahle imikhakha yemaminerali namandla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa. Omunye wemigomo yayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinkampani ziphephile futhi zisebenza kahle. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) iyakwenza lokhu emuva kwe-DME, futhi le ndatshana igxile kakhulu kuyo. I-MHSI yasungulwa ukuze ivikele ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi nabanye emigodini. Umbono wayo uwukubhekana nezibopho zayo ngokuqinile nangendlela ekhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nemiphumela emihle ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe kuleli kanye nakwamanye amazwe mayelana nempilo nokuphepha emkhakheni wezokumbiwa. Imisebenzi ehamba phambili ye-MHSI ifaka phakathi ukuhlola imigodi, ukuhlola nokuphenya izingozi nezinye izigameko ezihlobene nempilo nokuphepha, nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana neMine Health and Safety Act (MHSA) ka-1996, okuyiwo umthetho we-ofisi yokuhlola. Amandla e-MHSI okuqinisekisa umthetho afaka phakathi ukukhipha izaziso zokuhambisana kanye nokuvalela imigodi, ukufaka izijeziso, nokwenza iziphakamiso mayelana nokuphikiswa kwabaphula umthetho. I-MHSI ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukukhipha okuphephile kwemaminerali nokuthi imisebenzi yenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziphilile. Ukulawulwa okungcono kuqhamuka ngemva kokuxoxisana okuningi nazo zonke izithakazelo emkhakheni. Ubudlelwano be-tripartite, ukuhlola izingozi, ukucubungula izinhlelo ezihlelwe, ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kanye nezibuyekezo ezivamile, ucwaningo, nokuphenya konke kubalulekile emisebenzini ye-MHSI ukuze kutholakale imiphumela. Nokho, i-ofisi yokuhlola idinga ukwesekwa kuwo wonke umphakathi wezokumbiwa ukuze ifinyelele lezi zinjongo, njengoba wonke umuntu uzothola inzuzo. Abasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezibeka engcupheni ngenxa yomnoise, ukunyakaza, ukushisa nokubanda, umsebenzi ophindaphindiwe onzima, amakhemikhali ayingozi, uthuli, namagasi ane-levels aphezulu yokutoxicity. Bahlupheka ngokulahlekelwa kokuzwa, i-silicosis, i-pneumoconiosis, i-tuberculosis, isifo samatshe, kanye ne
uMfula iNile: Ibhakabhaka Elikhulu Lezimpilo Ngiyavuma, uMfula iNile ungomunye wemifula emikhulu kakhulu emhlabeni. Abantu abaningi bazi kahle ukuthi lo mfula ungowesiNtu, ungowesibili ngobude emhlabeni, futhi unomlando omkhulu kakhulu. Uqala eNingizimu ye-Afrika, e-Ethiopia, bese uhamba ngokuqhubekayo phezulu futhi phansi, ufika eGibhithe, lapho uthola khona umphakathi owawukhula ngempela ngenxa yalo mfula. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi uMfula iNile unamaqhaza amaningi empilweni yabantu abahlala eduze kwawo? Kukhona abantu abaningi abahlala ezindaweni ezikhethiwe, befuna amanzi, futhi benza imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Ngaphandle kokuba ngumthombo omkhulu wamanzi, lo mfula uphinde ube yindawo yokuhlala nezinye izilwane eziningi, ezinje ngamanzi, izinyoni, nezilwane ezinzima. Ubuqa izilwane ezinjengama-hippo nama-crocodile, okuyinto ebonwa kalula uma ubuka umfula. Kukhona izindawo ezinhle eziphathelene noMfula iNile. Futhi akukhona nje ezamaGibhithe, kodwa nakwezinye izindawo ezithintekayo, njengeSudan ne-Ethiopia. Futhi, asikho isizathu sokukhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, ngoba abantu abahlukene benza izindlela ezahlukene zokuphila, kusukela kumasiko amadala kuya kwezamanje. U-Mfula iNile ubalulekile empilweni yabo, uvumela abantu ukuba badle, baphile, futhi bakhule. Uma ubheka emlandweni, uMfula iNile ubonakala njengemithombo yezenkolo nezamasiko. Abantu baseGibhithe bahlonipha umfula, besenza izinkolelo ezihlukahlukene eziphathelene nawo. Kukhona izinganekwane eziningi ezikukhumbuza ukuthi lo mfula awuphela nje emanzini, kodwa uhambisana nezindaba eziningi, ezokuphiliswa, nezokuthula. Ubuye ubonwe njengomgibeli onamandla, owawukwazi ukuhambisana nezimo ezinzima. Uhlanga lwamaGibhithe lwaluhamba phambili ngenxa yokukhula kwelanga, futhi umfula wawuwusizo kakhulu emkhakheni wentuthuko. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi abahlali baseGibhithe basebenzisa umfula ukuze balime izindawo ezihamba phambili? Uye waba umthombo wemfuyo futhi unika abantu amandla okuphila. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi babephuma kanjani? Bafaka amanzi emasimini ukuze baphumelele futhi baphumele emhlabeni, lokhu kusebenza okwamanje. Kepha, akukhona konke okuhle. Umfula iNile ukubhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Izinguquko zesimo sezulu, izikhukhula, nezimo zempilo zikhombisa ukuthi umfula awusizi kuphela, kodwa ungaba nezinselelo ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umgwaqo wokuthola amanzi ungase ungabi lula, futhi lokhu kudinga abafundi bakudala nezinsiza zamuva ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi kumele benzeni ukuze baphile kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umfula uthinta izindawo zokuvakasha. Kukhona izindawo eziningi ezithandwa ngabavakashi, okubandakanya izinqaba ezinkulu nezinsiza zamasiko. Uhlanga lwezikhumbuzo, izinqaba, nezinye izinto ezithakazelisayo zenza umfula ube yindawo ehlaba umxhwele. Abantu bavame ukuhamba ngezikebhe, bejabulela ubuhle bezwe elijulile. Ngokoqobo, uMfula iNile awugxili kuphela emanzini, kodwa ubuye ube yinkombandlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ubonisa ukuthi abantu bangahlangana kanjani, baphile ndawonye, futhi baziqhenye ngendawo yabo. Ubuye uveze izindlela zokusebenza ezahlukeneyo, ezihlangene nezamasiko ahlukene, okukhombisa ubuhle bokuhlukahluka. Ngokuphetha, uMfula iNile ungomunye wezinto ezibalulekile empilweni, futhi ungumthombo wezinsiza ezibalulekile. Uthinta izimpilo zethu, izinkolelo zethu, namasiko ethu. Noma ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yasendaweni, izindaba zempilo, noma izinkumbulo zethu, uMfula iNile uyisibonelo sokuthi umfula ungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphileni komuntu. Ngakho-ke, uMfula iNile ungumfula obalulekile, okhumbuza abantu ukuthi amanzi anempilo, futhi asenza sikhumbule ukuthi sisonke kule ndawo.
iGautrain: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezokuthutha Esifundazweni SaseGauteng Isingeniso IGautrain iyinhlangano yokuthutha ebukhoma eGauteng, eNingizimu Afrika, eyasungulwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngendlela esheshayo, ephephile, futhi ewusizo yokuhamba phakathi kwemijikelezo emikhulu yedolobha. Le nsiza ithuthukiswe ngokubambisana nohulumeni waseGauteng kanye nezinkampani ezizimele, futhi yaqhamuka njengenqubomgomo yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuthutha eziphumelelayo ngaphansi kwesimo sokukhula kwemijikelezo yedolobha. Ukwakhiwa KweGautrain Uhlelo lweGautrain lwaqala ukusebenza ngoJanuwari 2010, lapho kwavulwa imigqa emibili eyinhloko: iMidrand ukuya eSandton, kanye neHoughton ukuya eGermiston. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zabahambi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziphakeme zokuhlala nezokusebenza. Iziteshi zeGautrain zakhiwe ngokuqapha, zihlala ziphambili emikhiqizweni yokwakha, futhi zifaka izici ezithuthukile zokuphepha kanye nezokwelapha. Izici Zokusebenza IGautrain ibonakala ngemininingwane yokusebenza engcono kakhulu, efaka phakathi izitimela ezisheshayo ezihamba ngokushesha okungama-160 km/h. Lezi zitimela zenzelwe ukuhamba kahle phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, ziqinisekisa ukuthi isikhathi sokuhamba sincishisiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lweGautrain lukhuluma ngaphezulu kwama-85% wokukhishwa kwegesi, olunikeza umthelela omuhle emvelweni. Izinsiza Nezinhlelo Zokuthutha Ngaphezu kokuba uGautrain ulinikeza izitimela, uhlelo luphinde luhlinzeke ngezinsiza ezahlukahlukene ezifana nezimoto zokushayela, ezihlinzeka ngendawo yokupaka eduze neziteshi. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa nezinhlelo zokuhamba kwezithuthi zomphakathi, njengoMetrorail, okuhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kwemigudu yokuhamba. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain luhlinzeka ngohlelo lokukhokha olwakhelwe ngaphakathi, olwenza kube lula kubahambi ukuthola amathikithi. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Naphezu kokuphumelela kwayo, iGautrain ibhekene nezithiyo ezithile. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhamba kungaba umthombo wezinkinga kubahambi, ikakhulukazi kwabanye abasebenzisi abavela emiphakathini engaphansi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuhamba nezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Gautrain zidinga ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi ezikhulayo. Umthelela Womphakathi Nezomnotho IGautrain ibonakale njengephuzu elibalulekile emnothweni waseGauteng, ikakhulukazi ekukhuliseni amathuba emisebenzi, ukwakha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo lemiphakathi. Umsebenzi ohambisana neGautrain ubone ukwanda kwemisebenzi ezindaweni ezizungezile, okukhuthaza ukukhula kwezokuthengisa nezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo. Iphuzu Lokugcina IGautrain iyisibonelo esiyingqayizivele sokwakhiwa kohlelo lokuthutha oluphumelelayo, oluhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi waseGauteng. Ngesikhathi esithile, uGautrain ungaba yisixazululo esiphumelelayo sokuhamba, kodwa udinga ukufaka izinqumo eziphusile ukuze uqhubeke uthola impumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uGautrain uqhubeka ufinyelela izinjongo zawo zokuthuthukisa izimo zokuhamba ezindaweni eziphakeme. Isiphetho Ngenhla kokukhuluma ngakho, iGautrain iyithuluzi elikhulu elibonisa izinga eliphezulu lokuhamba, ukwakha imiphakathi, kanye nokukhulisa umnotho. Ukuqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, iGautrain kufanele iqhubeke ibheka izindlela zokwandisa ukufinyelela kwayo, inikeze izinsizakalo ezithuthukile, futhi iqinise ubudlelwane bayo nomphakathi. Ukuphumelela kwayo kuzobe kuhlobene ngokuqondile nokwaziswa, ukwamukelwa, kanye nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yedolobha.
Ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS (GEMS claim submission and processing) Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyisikhwama sezempilo esisungulwe nguhulumeni wesiNtu, esihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kube nohlelo olusebenzayo, abahlali badinga ukuzazi izinqubo ezihambisana nokufaka izicelo zezimangalo, ukuze bagweme izinkinga ezingase zivele ngesikhathi sokucubungula lezi zicelo. Kokuqala, ukufaka isicelo sezimangalo kumasistimu e-GEMS kudinga ukuthi umsebenzisi abe neziqu ezanele zokuhlonza, okuhlanganisa nezinombolo zezimangalo, imininingwane yomtholampilo, kanye nezinkcukacha zomuntu siqu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngezimpendulo ezithile ezisemthethweni okufanele ziqinisekiswe. I-GEMS inikeza izindlela eziningi zokufaka izicelo, kuhlanganise nezinsiza ze-inthanethi, okuyindlela ekhuthazwayo ngenxa yokuphumelela kwayo. Umsebenzisi kufanele agcwalise ifomu lokucela izimangalo elitholakala kwiwebhusayithi ye-GEMS. Lokhu kudinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imininingwane efakiwe iyiyona efanele. Imininingwane engalungile noma engaphelele ingaholela ekuhlulekeni kokucutshungulwa kwesicelo, okuyinto efanele ukuqaphela kwabafaka izicelo. Ngemuva kokufakwa kwesicelo, i-GEMS izoqala ukulicubungula. Lesi sinyathelo sihamba ngokucophelela, njengoba izinqubo zokuhlola zisetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izicelo zihambisana nemigomo neziqondiso ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abe nezincazelo eziqondile lapho kudingeka futhi, uma kudingeka, izinsizakalo ezithile zempilo kufanele ziqinisekiswe ngodokotela abaqashiwe. Ukucutshungulwa kwezimangalo kudinga ukuthi izinsizakalo zenziwe ngezindlela eziphathekayo, kubandakanya ukuhlaziywa kwemithetho ethile yokubheka ubufakazi. Lesi simo siza ekugcineni ukuthola ukunembileko kokuthola ukuxhaswa kwezimali, okubalulekile ukuze abahlali bakwazi ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza ezifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma isicelo sibuye sithole ukuphikiswa noma izinkinga, i-GEMS izobhalela umsebenzisi incwadi yokuphikisa enezizathu ezicacile. Lokhu kusebenza njengomhlahlandlela ophusile wokuthi umsebenzisi angakwenza ukuphikisa kanjani lesi siphakamiso, futhi uhlinzeka ngamathuba okuba kuhlolwe izinkinga. I-GEMS iyasiza ekulondolozeni ulwazi nokuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka kwabasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusebenzisa izimpendulo ezivela kubasebenzisi, okuyelulekela ukukhulisa izinqubo zayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba umsebenzisi uyawuqonda umkhiqizo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezicaciso ezithile ezitholakalayo kumasistimu e-GEMS. Ngamafuphi, ukufaka nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezinyathelo ezisemthethweni, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Imiphumela efanele ingafezwa uma umsebenzisi ethobela yonke imithetho nemigomo ethile, okuhlanganisa ukukhombisa ubuqotho bemininingwane. Lokhu kusebenza njengesibonelo sokuthi, uma kwenziwa ngezindlela ezifanele, i-GEMS ingaba yinsiza ebalulekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, ihlinzeka ngesixazululo esiqinile kwizidingo zabo zemali nezempilo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqwashisa bonke abasebenzisi mayelana nezici eziphuma kulesi sikhwama. Ukuhlaziya izimangalo ze-GEMS akugcinwa nje ngokuheha izinsizakalo, kodwa kujolise ekwakheni umuzwa wokwethembeka noxhaso kumphakathi, okubandakanya umphakathi jikelele. Ngakho-ke, ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo nezinhlelo zokufaka izicelo kubalulekile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo eziphuthumayo zempilo kubo bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni.

Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) yisiphetho esenziwe ngabaholi base-Afrika, esisekelwe embonweni yabo yokuhlanganyela kanye nokukholwa okuqinile ukuthi banomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphelisa ubumpofu nokufaka amazwe abo, ngokwehlukana noma ngokuhlanganyela, endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi bebamba iqhaza emnothweni nasemphakathini womhlaba. Le nqubo isekelwe ekuzimiseleni kwabantu base-Afrika ukukhulula abazimele kanye nalesi siqhingi ezinselelweni zokungathuthukiswa nokuhlukumezeka emhlabeni. Ubumphofu nokuhlukumezeka e-Afrika kuphikisana nempumelelo yezizwe ezithuthukile. Ukuqhubeka kokuhlukumezeka kwe-Afrika emhlabeni jikelele kanye nokuhlukumezeka kwezobuhlanga nezomnotho kuletha ukwesaba nokungazinzi emhlabeni. Ukukhula komphakathi womhlaba, ukubolekwa kwezimali, kanye nosizo phakathi kwamazwe amabili (okubili) kube yisisekelo somqondo wokuthuthukisa i-Afrika. Ukubolekwa kuholele ekuqoqweni okukhulu kwezinsiza, okukhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokukhokha ngama-inthanethi noma ukulibazisa isikhathi esizayo, futhi kuhlala kuyisithiyo esikhulu ekukhuleni kwamazwe ase-Afrika. Isikhumbuzo sokuzimela sesifinyelelwe. Mayelana nezinye izici zosizo lwamazwe amabili - sibona ukwehla kosizo lwabantu abathile kanye nokuncipha okukhulu kwenani eliphelele losizo, eliwela phansi kwezinga elibekwe ngawo ngeminyaka yama-1970. E-Afrika, cishe abantu abayizigidi eziyi-340 noma ingxenye yokuhlala kwabantu emhlabeni baphila ngaphansi kuka-$1 ngosuku. Ukufa kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu kungalinganiswa ku-140 ngezingane eziyi-1,000, kuyilapho ukuphila okuphakade ekuzalweni kungama-54 kuphela. Kukhona kuphela u-58% wabantu abathola amanzi aphephile. Abantu abangenalo imfundo abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-15 bangalinganiswa ku-41%. Kukhona kuphela imigqa yocingo eyi-18 kubantu abayi-1,000 e-Afrika, uma kuqhathaniswa no-146 emhlabeni jikelele no-567 ezwenikazi elinengeniso ephezulu. Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) ibiza umhlaba ukuthi uphendule kule ndaba ekhathazayo ngokushintsha ubudlelwane obubalulekile kulokhu. Abantu base-Afrika abaceli ukuqhubeka nokuthembele osizini noma ezandleni zezimali. Bajabule ukuthi leli thuba lomlando lizophela ubumpofu bokungathuthukiswa obujolile e-Afrika. Ingcebo, ehlanganisa imali, ubuchwepheshe, amakhono abantu, adingekayo ukuze balwe nobumpofu nokungathuthukiswa, manje isiyatholakala futhi iyatholakala kalula. Lokhu okukhona manje kudinga abaholi abanesibindi kanye nokuzimisela okuvela enhliziyweni ekuthuthukiseni abantu nasekuphumeleleni ubumpofu, nokubamba iqhaza emhlabeni omusha osuselwa ekuzimiseleni kwabo bonke nasekuzuzweni komphakathi. Kulo lonke isiqhingi, abantu base-Afrika bathembisa ukuthi abasoze bavumele ukuba baphathwe njengezimo. Sizokwakha ikusasa lethu futhi sicele umhlaba ukusiza emizamweni yethu. Sekukhona izimpawu zempumelelo ngethemba. Inani lezikahulumeni ezilawulayo ezibophezele ekuvikelweni kwamalungelo abantu, ukuthuthukiswa okubhekiswe kubantu, kanye nezomnotho ezinikeza amathuba ezohwebo kuyanda. Abantu base-Afrika sebevele baqala ukukhombisa ukuthi abasoze bavumele abaholi bezomnotho nezepolitiki ukuthi babaphoshe. Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) igxile ekuqineni nasekusheshiseni lezi zimpumelelo. Kuyisixwayiso sokubambisana okusha phakathi kwe-Afrika nomhlaba, ikakhulukazi lezi zizwe ezinezimboni, ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nesikhala sokuthuthukiswa esiqhubekayo iminyaka eminingi ngenxa yobudlelwane obungalingani noma obuhlukumezayo. Indawo ye-Afrika emphakathini womhlaba ichazwa njengendawo lapho umhlaba unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze ube usizo ngempela kubo bonke abantu iminyaka eminingi. Izindawo zezilwane nezinsiza zakudala ezibonisa uguquko lomhlaba, ukuphila, nomndeni womuntu. Ingxenye I iyindawo eyaziwa kakhulu. Ingxenye II isanda kuvela, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwezindaba zemvelo. Ingxenye III iphinde ivele yona, ibonakala njengento efanele ukunakwa hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wesayensi noma kulabo abathanda ukuvikelwa kwemithombo (izikhumbuzo) nalabo abakubuka. Lokhu kuyingxenye IV, ebonisa amandla abantu base-Afrika, angasetshenziswa noma athuthukiswe ngokuphelele ngezindlela eziningi. Kucacile ukuthi, ngaphandle kokuthi imiphakathi eyakhiwe ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphezulu okushisa ingaguqulwa, ezinye izindlela zokuphila zizobamba iqhaza ekubhujiseni izihlahla. Njengoba ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kuzothokozisa bonke abantu, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Afrika ibekwe endleleni yokuthuthukiswa futhi ingabeki izinsiza zayo engcupheni. Isayensi yesimanje yamukela ukuthi i-Afrika iyisikhungo somuntu. Njengengxenye yokwakha nokuqinisa isithunzi nokuzethemba kwabantu base-Afrika, kubalulekile ukuthi le mnikelo yomuntu ibonwe noma iqashelwe futhi ithathwe njengengcebo ngabo bonke abantu base-Afrika. Isikhundla se-Afrika njengesisekelo somuntu kufanele sibhakanyiswe umhlaba wonke njengomlando wabantu bayo bonke. Ngakho-ke, Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika kufanele igcine leli thongo futhi isebenzise ukuze yakhe ukuqwashisa ngalolu shintsho oluphuthumayo lokuphelisa ukungathuthukiswa nokuhlukumezeka kulolu siqhingi. I-Afrika inendima ebalulekile yokudlondlobala uxhumano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo emhlabeni. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe kugcizelela indima edlalwa abantu ekukhiqizeni, belwa nendawo yabo enqubweni yokukhiqiza besebenzisa amathuluzi abo leso sikhathi noma esizayo. I-flora, fauna, nezilwane ezihlukile ezitholakala kuphela e-Afrika zinikeza abantu ithuba lokugcina uxhumano lwabo nemvelo. I-Afrika isivele idlale indima ebonakalayo emasikweni omhlaba, ezincwadini zizwe, emculweni, emculweni, nasemkhakheni wezamasiko, kodwa amandla ayo awakaze asetshenziswe ngokuphelele ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuhlanganiswa ngokuphelele emnothweni womhlaba. Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika izovumela i-Afrika ukuba ikhulise indima yayo esayensini, emasikweni, nasobuchwepheshe. Kulesi sikhathi esisha, njengoba abantu befuna indlela entsha yokwakha umhlaba ongcono, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlanganise ukuhlukahluka kanye nezifiso zabantu ukuze sibe nalesi siqhingi esikhuluma ngezinga elilinganayo lokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni kwes civilization yomuntu. Ukuncipha kwalolu siqhingi lwe-Afrika kugcizelelwe ukuphathwa kwalesi siqhingi ngamazwe amanye, impi engenemikhonto, ukuhlukumezeka kwesistimu yomnotho yomhlaba, kanye nokwehluleka noma ukunganeliseki kwemigomo elandelwe ngamanye amazwe ngemuva kokuthola uzibuse. Iminyaka eminingi, i-Afrika ibambe iqhaza emnothweni womhlaba njengomthombo wezisebenzi ezishibhile nezinto ezibonakalayo. Lokhu kuholele ekunciphiseni kwezingcebo ze-Afrika esikhundleni sokuthi kusetshenziswe ukuthuthukisa leli siqhingi. Umfutho ngaleso sikhathi wokusebenzisa izinto ezibonakalayo nezinto zokwakha ukuthuthukisa imboni yokukhiqiza
Ukuhlaziywa KweMidlalo: Izindaba Nezindlela Zokubheka Umbuzo 1: Yini ebalulekile ekuhlaziyeni kwemidlalo? Impendulo: Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kubalulekile ngoba kusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile emidlalweni. Ukuhlola izindlela, izindlela zokudlala, nokusebenza kwabadlali kusiza amaqembu ukuba aqonde izifundo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwabo emidlalweni nasemqhudelwaneni. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinto ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe ekuhlaziyeni kwemidlalo? Impendulo: Ekuhlaziyeni, izici ezibalulekile zifaka izibalo zomdlali, ukusebenza kwabo emidlalweni edlule, izimo zomoya, nezinkinga zomzimba. Ukuqonda indlela abadlali abavame ukuyidlala ngayo emidlalweni ethile nokuthi bangakwenza kanjani ezimeni ezihlukahlukene kubalulekile. Futhi, izici zenhlalo nezomnotho zihlala zinemithelela emkhakheni wemidlalo. Umbuzo 3: Kungani izibalo zibalulekile ekuhlaziyeni? Impendulo: Izibalo zidlala indima enkulu ekuhlaziyeni ngoba zisinika umbono ocacile wokusebenza kwabadlali nokuqonda imiphumela emidlalweni. Ngokuhlaziya izibalo, singabona ukuthi imizamo ethile ibonakala kanjani emiphumeleni, futhi sithole ukuqhathaniswa phakathi kwabadlali. Lokhu kusiza abaqeqeshi nabaphathi bezemidlalo ukwenza izinqumo ezinembile. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela zokuhlaziya ezidumile? Impendulo: Kunezindlela eziningi zokuhlaziya, kodwa ezivame ukusetshenziswa kakhulu zifaka phakathi ukuhlaziywa kwedatha, ukuhlaziywa kokusebenza, kanye nokubuyekezwa kwemidlalo. Ukuhlaziywa kwedatha kusiza ekuqoqeni nasekucwaningeni izibalo, kanti ukuhlaziywa kokusebenza kubheka indlela umdlali adlala ngayo. Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kwenziwa ngemuva kokuphela komdlalo ukuze kudingidwe imiphumela nokuthi kungani kwenzeka kanjalo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kungasiza abaqeqeshi? Impendulo: Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kunika abaqeqeshi amathuba okuchaza izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kubanika ithuba lokuhlola izinqumo zabo mayelana nokukhetha abadlali, izinqubo zokusebenza, nokuhlela izifundo ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaqeqeshi bangasebenzisa ukuhlaziywa ukuze baphonse izindlela ezintsha zokudlala, ngokuqonda ukuthi iziphakamiso ezithile zingabathuthukisa kanjani. Umbuzo 6: Uthini umthelela wezobuchwepheshe ekuhlaziyeni kwemidlalo? Impendulo: Ubufakazi bokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa ukuthi bukhuthaza kakhulu ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo. Ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuhlaziya, izixazululo ze-AI, nezinsizakalo zedatha, zenza kube lula ukuqonda imiphumela emidlalweni. Lokhu kusiza ekwandiseni amathuba okuthola ulwazi olunembile nolusebenzayo. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani abadlali bangathola izinzuzo ekusebenziseni ukuhlaziywa? Impendulo: Abadlali bangazuza kakhulu ngokuhlaziywa kwemidlalo. Ngokuhlola izibalo zabo, bazi kahle izindawo abaziphumelelayo nezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kubanikeza ithuba lokulungisa amaphutha abo nokusebenza emakhono abawadingayo. Ukuhlaziywa kuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali bahlala bephuma phambili futhi befinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kungathinta kanjani umphakathi? Impendulo: Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo akugcini nje ngokuyinsiza ezemidlalo; kuthinta umphakathi ngendlela ebanzi. Imiphumela ethokozisayo emidlalweni, ikakhulukazi uma ihlaziywa kahle, ikhulisa ubumqoka bemidlalo emphakathini. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Imiphumela emihle ibuye ibonise izinyathelo ezithile zomphakathi kanye nezinkolo ezithokozisayo. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izaziso zezimali ezihlobene nokuhlaziywa kwemidlalo? Impendulo: Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kukhuthaza izinkampani eziningi ukuba zifake imali emikhiqizweni yemidlalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo kubadlali, amaqembu, nezinkampani ezixhumene nemidlalo. Izinkampani zaziwa ngokuxhaswa kwezemidlalo, okusiza ekwandiseni ubukhona bazo naphakathi kwabadlali. Lokhu kudala umnotho obalulekile emiphakathini nasemphakathini jikelele. Umbuzo 10: Ubulili obuhlukahlukene kufanele bunakekelwe kanjani ekuhlaziyeni? Impendulo: Ukuhlaziywa kufanele kube nokubheka ubulili obuhlukahlukene, njengoba lokho kudala ithuba lokwelula izinsiza kumasiko ahlukahlukene. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izici ezithile zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwabadlali besilisa nabesifazane. Ukuhlaziywa okufaka ubulili obuhlukahlukene kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abadlali bathola amathuba alinganayo. Isiphetho: Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kubalulekile, kunomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Kusiza abadlali, abaqeqeshi, nezinhlangano ukwakha izinqumo eziphusile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kusekela umphakathi jikelele ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kunikeza indawo yokuhlola imiphumela, izinqumo, nemikhuba yokwenza ngcono umphakathi.
Isomiso: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ngiyavuma, isomiso sesiyinkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo. Kukhona izikhathi lapho umhlaba ubonakala ungawuthandi, lapho izitshalo zibhujiswa, izinkanyezi zikhanya kodwa amanzi ayashoda. Kulokhu, sikhuluma ngalesi sifo esibi esithinta abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi isomiso sithinta kanjani impilo yethu? Okokuqala, masikhulume ngempilo yomphakathi. Lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya kodwa amanzi engatholakali, abantu basemaphandleni bayazithola bephila empilweni enzima. Abanye bahlala emakhaya, bejolisa emasimini, kodwa uma izitshalo zibhujiswa, bahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngemfood. Lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu, ngoba umndeni ungase ube nekhanda elibuhlungu lokuthi bazothola kuphi ukudla. Kukhona abanye abathanda ukusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokulima, kodwa uma imvula inganqoba, konke kuyaphuma. Ngokwengxenye, isomiso asithinti kuphela abantu. Izilwane nazo zikhathazekile. Cabanga nje, izinyoni zidinga amanzi ukuze ziphile, izinkomo zidinga amanzi ukuze zihlale ziphilile. Uma amanzi engatholakali, izilwane ziba nezinselelo ezinkulu. Lokhu kudala ukungalingani, ngoba uma izilwane zingatholi amanzi, ziba nezinselelo zokuphila. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izilwane zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu, futhi lokho kuthinta imvelo yethu. Ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izitshalo zibalulekile. Zithokozisa amehlo ethu, zikhulisa umoya, zenza umhlaba ube muhle. Uma izitshalo zibhujiswa, umhlaba uba mnyama. Lokhu kudala umoya omubi, futhi umphakathi uba nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Kukhona izindlela ezithile esingazithatha ukuze silwe nesomiso. Okokuqala, singasebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezihlakaniphile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise indlela esilima ngayo. Uma sithola izindlela zokulima ezisebenzayo, sizokwazi ukuvikela izitshalo zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukudla nempilo engcono. Okwesibili, singenza imizamo yokugcina amanzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokugcina amanzi, njengokusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezivumela ukongiwa kwamanzi. Uma sithola izindlela zokugcina amanzi, sizokwazi ukuvikela izitshalo zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukudla nempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume nabantu abaziwayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sabelane ngolwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho. Uma sabelana ngolwazi, sizokwazi ukufunda okuningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi isomiso asithinti kuphela abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Isomiso sithinta umhlaba wonke. Uma sithola izindlela zokulima ezisebenzayo, sizokwazi ukuvikela umhlaba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imvelo yethu. Ngokuphetha, isomiso yinkinga enkulu, kodwa asithandi ukucasulwa. Uma sithola izindlela zokulima ezisebenzayo, sizokwazi ukuvikela izitshalo zethu. Uma sithola izindlela zokugcina amanzi, sizokwazi ukuvikela izilwane zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela umhlaba. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze silwe nesomiso, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi impilo yethu, izilwane, nezitshalo zihlala ziphilile. Ngiyabonga.

Ukugcina, ukuhlola, ukusebenzisa, ukuphuma, ukuhlukanisa, noma ukuhlinzeka noma ukuqubuka kwanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwegazi elithathwe kumuntu noma igazi elitholwe kwamanye amazwe, ukuze lisetshenziswe, njengoba likhona, ingxenye yalo noma ngendlela yomkhiqizo wegazi kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezitholakala kubantu. Ukukhiqizwa, ukupakisha, ukuvalwa, nokubhala kwanoma yimuphi umkhiqizo wegazi noma ukuhlinzeka ngawo, noma ukuwuphuma nganoma iyiphi indlela, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezikhona. Ukuthatha noma ukugcina igazi elithathwe kumuntu ukuze lisetshenziswe futhi ngaleyo ndlela. Ukuphathwa kwezwi, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi ukuphathwa kwezempilo yomphakathi, ukuphathwa kwemfucumfucu yezokwelapha, nokuphathwa kwezinto eziyingozi. Igama elithi "ukukhulisa" libhekisela emiphumeleni yokuhlangana kweqanda lesifazane ne-sperm yomfana (ukukhulisa). Ngokwesigaba -146 seMthethosisekelo, lapho kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kwalokho okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi nalokho okukhuluma ngeminye imithetho yezempilo, ngaphandle kwemithetho ethinta ngqo lesi sikhathi, lokho okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi kuzosebenza. Izingane zithola izinhlelo eziqondile ezihlobene nosizo lwezempilo; futhi zibuye zibhekane nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umnyango kahulumeni kufanele uhlinzeke ngezinsiza zezempilo njengokubaluleka okukhulu futhi uhlole izidingo zezempilo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinsiza ezikhona. Umnyango kazwelonke kanye nazo zonke izifunda nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele zisungule izinsiza ezifanele zezempilo kanye nosizo lwezempilo lwezikhungo ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo, futhi zonke izikhungo, zonke izikhungo zezempilo zikamasipala kanye nabahlinzeki bezinsiza zezempilo kufanele bahlinzeke ngezinsiza zezempilo ngokwezinga lokukwazi kwabo nezinsiza. UMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke, umnyango wezifunda, izikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nalabo abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo kufanele benze ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo lapho bephatha amandla athile nemisebenzi ethile ehlobene nezempilo. UNgqongqoshe unelungelo lokukhetha, ngaphansi kwezimo ezivumela abantu abathile noma amaqembu abantu ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo zamahhala ezikhungweni zezempilo zikamasipala. Umthelela walezi zimo ekutholakaleni kosizo oluvela kubahlinzeki bezinsiza zezempilo. Izingxenye zikazwelonke nezifunda, amakomidi wezempilo ezifundazweni, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olwaneleyo nolugcwele ludluliselwa ezinsizeni zezempilo ezibhekelele. Abahlinzeki bezinsiza zezempilo nezikhungo zezinsiza zezempilo abakwazi ukuvimbela umuntu ukufinyelela ekwelashweni okuphuthumayo. Wonke umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo yabo nokwelashwa. Uma umsebenzisi engakwazi ukubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo yabo nokwelashwa, noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ophephethe ngokuqondile ngumthetho noma umyalelo wenkantolo ukuze amele umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo nokwelashwa komsebenzisi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile sokwakha idemokhrasi yethu; kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza ukuthi uhulumeni uphendule kulokho abantu abakwenza. IPhalamende ibonise izindlela ezahlukene zokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi enqubweni yokwazisa nokwandisa ukufinyelela ePhalamende labantu. Ukubamba iqhaza emsebenzini wePhalamende akukhathazi njengokubukeka. Enye indlela abantu abangasebenzisa ngayo ilungelo labo leziNhloso ngokusebenzisa isicelo. Isicelo siyisicelo esisemthethweni esiqondiswe eziphathimandla ezifanele ukuze zithathe isinyathelo. Kungaba, phakathi kwezinye izinto, isicelo sokuthi kwenziwe okuthile noma isidingo sokuxazulula ukukhathazeka. Ukuze isicelo sibe nesiphumo, kumele sichaze ukuthi sikhuluma kubani, ukuthi ukukhathazeka kukuphi, futhi sibe nezizathu ezisekelayo, kanye namagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabaceli. Izicelo zihlukaniswa zibe izigaba ezimbili, okuyizicelo ezikhethekile nezicelo zomphakathi noma izicelo ezijwayelekile. Isicelo esikhethekile siwukuthi umuntu wenza isicelo esithile noma ufune ukwesekwa kwezimali kuhulumeni, okungase kungavunyelwe umthetho, njengokucela ipenshini. Isicelo somphakathi siwukuthi iqembu lomphakathi elinokuhlosiwe okufanayo licela ukwesekwa, okungabandakanya noma yiluphi uhlobo lwesicelo. Kuyilungelo elivunywa amalungu omphakathi kuhulumeni odemokhrasi ukuhlela nokwethula izicelo noma nini uma kudingeka. NgokweSahluko 17 seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho 108 ka-1996), sithi: noma iyiphi iqembu labantu kanye nabantu bonke banelungelo lokuhlangana ngokuthula, ukuveza izinkinga zabo nganoma iyiphi indaba, nokwethula isicelo. Nokho, kunezindlela ezifanele okufanele abantu kanye/noma amaqembu azilandele ekuhlelweni kwezicelo zabo. Umuntu oyiNgxenye yePhalamende kuphela ongakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokusemthethweni isicelo ukuze processing sibe sePhalamende. Umuntu ophakathi komphakathi noma iqembu labantu kufanele lithumele izicelo zabo kumMember yePhalamende yabo becela ukuthi bazethule ePhalamende. Kumele ichaze uhlobo losizo oluceliwe kuPhalamende kodwa kufanele kube usizo olungase lutholakale kuPhalamende ngaphakathi kwemvume yalo. Ngoba isicelo kumele sithunyelwe ngokusemthethweni kuPhalamende, umceli noma abaceli kumele bathole ukwesekwa kumMember yePhalamende. Kunconywa ukuthi ngaphambi kokuthumela isicelo, uqale ukhulume noMphakathi wePhalamende ukuze uthole ukuthi bazokweseka yini futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ifomethi nokuqukethwe kwesicelo sakho kulungile. Uma kukhona amadokhumenti asekelayo mayelana nendaba ethunyelwe, kufanele afakwe nesicelo. UmMember wePhalamende uzothumela isicelo sakho kuNobhala wePhalamende ukuze kubuyekezwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ifomethi nokuqukethwe kulungile ngaphambi kokuthi kuvezwe kuMholi noma kuMongameli. Isicelo sizothunyelwa ePhalamende bese sithunyelwa kwiKomidi noma kumaKomidi abhekene nezindaba eziphakanyisiwe esicelweni sakho.
Umthelela Wama-Social Media Entsheni Ngiyavuma ukuthi ama-social media ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu namuhla. Abanye baphikisa, besho ukuthi lokhu akuhambisani nezinto ezinhle, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kunezinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Kubalulekile ukuhlaziya indlela ama-social media aguqule ngayo impilo yethu, ikakhulukazi entsheni. Uma sikhuluma ngentsha, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zimo zihluke kakhulu ezikhathini ezedlule. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi abantwana bethu bahlala kuphi? Kanjani baphila? Abantu abasha, ngesikhathi beqala ukukhumbula impilo yabo, bahlala behlanganyela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, bezithokozisa futhi bebonisa impumelelo, kodwa futhi bahlola imizwa yabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi basebenzisa ama-social media ukuze babelane ngezinto ezithile, imicabango, nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi omkhulu, kodwa akukhona konke okuhle. Cishe sithola ukuthi ama-social media angathinta imizwa yentsha ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kunezikhathi lapho abantu baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo, nezinye lapho bezizwa benomona. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni umphakathi ungabi nempilo, lapho abanye befuna ukuphumelela ukuze bahlale behlaba umxhwele. Lokhu kubuhlungu, ngoba abanye bahlala bephila impilo yomfanekiso kuphela, okungaholela ekuboniseni ukuthi abaphumelelanga. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi ama-social media angaba yinsiza enkulu ezindaweni eziningi. Ngokwesibonelo, abantwana bangathola ulwazi olusha ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, ezokuzivocavoca, kanye nezindlela zokudla. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abanye bethu sikhule ezindaweni lapho ulwazi lungatholakali kalula. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngama-social media, kufanele siwasebenzise ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi ama-social media ahamba nezinye izinkinga. Abantu abasha bahlala bejoliswe ezithombeni ezinhle, okwenza kube nzima ukubona ukuthi impilo ayilona nje umfanekiso omuhle. Kukhona umsebenzi, ukukhathazeka, nezinkinga zokuphila ezidinga ukubhekwa. Lokhu kubangela ukucindezeleka, futhi abanye bethu bahlala befuna ukwenqaba lezi zinkinga, besebenzisa ama-social media njengendlela yokuphila. Abanye abantwana bahlala bephila impilo yokudlala kwezokuxhumana, bejabulela imidlalo, izinhlelo zokukhuluma, kanye nokuhlanganyela kwezithombe. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, kodwa kuphinde kudale umphakathi ocasulayo. Abanye bahlala bephila impilo ehlukile, bagwema ukuxhumana nabanye, kanti abanye bahlala bezama ukuphila ngendlela yokuphila. Lokhu kudinga ukunakekelwa, ngoba umphakathi uthola umbono wokuthi ukuphumelela kubalulekile, futhi lokho kungaholela ekuguleni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ama-social media angaholela ekutheni abantu baphile impilo engcono. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukona konke okunqoba. Umsebenzi wethu, njengezizukulwane ezikhulayo, ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ama-social media kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundisa abantu abasha ukuthi izithombe ezinhle azisho ukuthi impilo iyinhle. Kufanele benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, bazame ukungena emhlabeni omusha ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kuphela. Ngokuphelele, umthelela wama-social media entsheni awukwazi ukubalulwa. Ukukhula kwemibono, ukusabalala kolwazi, nokuxhumana nabanye kuyinto engathuthuka empilweni yethu. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kokubukeka nokweqiniso. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi siphile impilo engcono, enempilo, futhi sifunde indlela yokuphila efanele. Ekugcineni, uma sikhuluma ngama-social media, kufanele sihlose ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, sikhulume ngempilo, futhi sigcine umphakathi uphila kahle. Lokhu akusikhuthazi kuphela ukuba siphumelele, kodwa futhi kusenza sibe nekhono lokwakha umphakathi ophelele. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele sibe nezindlela zokuthola ulwazi, sikhuluma ngezinto ezithakazelisayo, futhi sifunde ukuhamba nalesi sikhathi esisha. Ngakho, thina njengentsha, kufanele sibe nokuqonda okuhle mayelana nama-social media, siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele, bese sikhuluma ngezinto ezithakazelisayo. Lokhu kuzosisiza ekwakheni ikusasa elihle.
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, onolwazi olunzulu, futhi onothando olujulile lokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zomphakathi. UThandiwe wazalelwa eMkhumbane, edolobheni elincane elinabantu abaningi, lapho akhulela khona ethola izifundo ezibalulekile zokuxhumana nabanye. Ukukhula kwakhe kwahlanganiswa nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa waphumelela ngokusebenza kanzima, futhi wathola ithuba lokufunda ezikhungweni ezihlukahlukene. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThandiwe waqala ukusebenza ezikhungweni zomphakathi lapho ahlangana khona nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Wabona ukuthi ukungabi khona kokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithile, njengezincwadi, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zokwelapha, kudala ubumpofu obukhulu emphakathini. Lokhu kwamkhuthaza ukuba abe nesibopho sokwenza umehluko. UThandiwe uqale umkhankaso wokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni, egxile ikakhulukazi ezincwadini, ezemidlalo, nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa, lapho abantu bengavakashela khona izikhungo ukuze bathole ulwazi nolwazi oludingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhankaso wakhe waba yimpumelelo, futhi abantu abaningi baqala ukuvakashela ezikhungweni ukuze bathole izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe waba umholi emphakathini, futhi wathola imiklomelo eminingi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe. Wazama ukufaka izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezikhungweni zomphakathi, njengezinhlelo zokufunda, ezemidlalo, nezokwelapha, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulezi zinsiza. UThandiwe ubelokhu edinga izindlela ezintsha zokwenza ukufinyelela kube lula, futhi wathola ukusiza kwabantu abaningi. UThandiwe uphinde abe nesibopho sokuxhumana nabantu abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazi ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ubuye abambisane nezinhlangano ezahlukene, ezinjengezikhungo zemfundo, izibhedlela, nezikhungo zokuhlala, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. UThandiwe uphinde abambe iqhaza emihlanganweni yokwabelana ngolwazi, lapho abantu bekhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izikhungo zomphakathi, futhi waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Waqala imikhankaso yokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ezinsizeni, futhi abantu baqala ukuthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. UThandiwe ungumholi ophumelelayo, futhi umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zomphakathi kuyinto ebalulekile. Wazi ukuthi abantu badinga ukuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuthola usizo, futhi ubufakazi bokusebenza kwakhe buveza ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka. UThandiwe uqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi unamandla uma ubambisana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zomphakathi akuyona nje into yokufinyelela, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo sokukhuthaza abanye ukuba benze okufanayo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ngothando, ukuzinikela, nokusebenza kanzima, singenza umehluko omkhulu emphakathini. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zomphakathi kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ubonisa ukuthi uma sabelana ngolwazi, sithuthukisa umphakathi, futhi sithuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. UThandiwe uhlala eqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe, futhi ubufakazi bokusebenza kwakhe buveza ukuthi umphakathi unamandla uma ubambisana. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumholi, umfundisi, nomuntu onothando, futhi umsebenzi wakhe uzokhumbuleka njengenye yezindlela zokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ubonisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zomphakathi akuyona nje into yokufinyelela, kodwa kuyindlela yokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono.
Izehlakalo ze-cybersecurity komasipala Umbuzo 1: Yini i-cybersecurity? Impendulo: I-cybersecurity iwumkhakha ophathelene nokuvikela amasistimu, amanethiwekhi, nemininingwane kwi-inthanethi. Kubalulekile ukuze kuvinjwe ukuhlaselwa kwezobuchwepheshe, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwedatha noma emalini. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile kubamasipala? Impendulo: Kubalulekile kubamasipala ngoba amahhovisi omasipala aphatha imininingwane ebalulekile, efana nezinsiza zomphakathi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nemininingwane yabantu. Ukuhlaselwa kwe-cyber kungaholela ekuphulweni kokuphepha, ukulahlekelwa kwemali, kanye nokwehla kokwethembeka komphakathi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izigameko ezivamile ze-cybersecurity ezibhekene namasipala? Impendulo: Izigameko ezivamile zifaka phakathi ukuhlaselwa kwe-ransomware, ukweba imininingwane, nezinsongo ze-phishing. Lezi zigameko zingaholela ekulimaleni kwemisebenzi yamasipala, kanye nokulahlekelwa kwemali. Umbuzo 4: Yini i-ransomware? Impendulo: I-ransomware iyisofthiwe esebenzisa ukuhlasela okwenziwa ngabadlali ababi ukuze ibambelele kudatha yomsebenzisi. Lokhu kubangela umsebenzisi ukuthi akhokhe imali ukuze abuyisele ukufinyelela kwedatha yakhe. Umbuzo 5: Zithini izibonelo zezigameko ze-ransomware kumasipala? Impendulo: Isibonelo esidumile yisigameko se-ransomware esenzeka eBaltimore, Maryland, ngo-2019. Ukuhlaselwa kwaholela ekutheni amasevisi amaningi omasipala aphazamiseke, okubandakanya izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza amaspala abhekane nezinselelo ezinkulu ze-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Amasipala avame ukuba nezinsiza ezincane, izinhlelo ezindala, kanye nezisebenzi ezingaqeqeshiwe kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuvikela izinhlelo zabo ezibalulekile. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela amasipala? Impendulo: Amasipala angathatha izinyathelo eziningi, ezifana nokufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokwenza izivivinyo zokuhlola ukuvikeleka. Ukwazi izinsongo zakamuva nokwenza izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa? Impendulo: Uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa, kufanele kube nehlelo lokuphendula eliqinile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvuselela izinhlelo, ukuxhumana nezinsizakalo zomthetho, nokubuyisela imininingwane ethathwe. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinsiza ezingasiza amaspala ekuthuthukiseni i-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Kukhona izinsiza eziningi, njengezinhlelo zokuvikela ezitholakalayo, izinkampani ezikhethekile kwe-cybersecurity, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakala kumasipala. Ukubambisana nezinye izikhungo kungasiza ekwakheni amandla. Umbuzo 10: Yini eyenza umphakathi ubaluleke ekulweni ne-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Umphakathi udlala indima ebalulekile ekulweni ne-cybersecurity. Ukuqwashisa kwabantu ngalezi zinsongo, kanye nokubafundisa ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha komphakathi. Umbuzo 11: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezitholakalayo zokufundisa umphakathi nge-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi zokufundisa umphakathi, ezifana nezifundo eziku-inthanethi, izinkulumo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela ezihlelwa ngamasipala. Lokhu kuzosiza abantu baqonde izinsongo ezikhona. Umbuzo 12: Kanjani amaspala angathuthukisa ubudlelwano bawo nezinkampani ze-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Amasipala angathuthukisa ubudlelwano bawo nezinkampani ze-cybersecurity ngokubambisana ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlola, nokufunda okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela amasistimu. Umbuzo 13: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuphendula ngokushesha ezimweni ze-cybersecurity? Impendulo: Ukuphendula ngokushesha kunganciphisa umonakalo, kuvikela imininingwane ebalulekile, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi amasevisi ayatholakala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi awulahlekelwa kakhulu. Umbuzo 14: Kuthiwani ngekusasa le-cybersecurity kumasipala? Impendulo: Ikusasa le-cybersecurity kumasipala libonakala linzima, kodwa linethuba. Ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuqwashisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela, amaspala angavikela kahle imininingwane yabo. Umbuzo 15: Yini okufanele ikwenze umphakathi ukuze uqhubeke uvikelekile? Impendulo: Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke ufunda ngalezi zinsongo, uqinisekise ukuthi usebenzisa izindlela zokuphepha ezifanele, futhi ubike noma yiziphi izinsongo ezitholakele kumasipala. Ukuvigilisa njalo kuyasiza. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zindaba, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-cybersecurity iyinselelo enkulu kumasipala, kodwa ngezinyathelo ezifanele, kungenzeka ukuvikela izinsiza zomphakathi. Ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi, amaspala, kanye nezinkampani ze-cybersecurity bukhulu kakhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophephile.
Ubani onelungelo lokufaka isicelo? Abantu abadala abangadingi ukunakekelwa njalo endaweni yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile. Abantu abathola usizo lwezezimali kwabakhulile. Abesifazane abaneminyaka engu-60 noma ngaphezulu, nabesilisa abaneminyaka engu-65 noma ngaphezulu. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo ehhovisi lezentlalo eliseduze nalapho uhlala khona. Khombisa i-ID yakho yaseNingizimu Afrika. Uzophenywa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uyafaneleka ukutholwa nokuthola usizo lwezezimali. Uma isicelo sakho siphumelele, uzocelwa ukuthi usayine isivumelwano nendawo yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile ngesikhathi sokwamukelwa. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanselwa, ungafaka isikhalazo sakho phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 kumphathiswa wezentlalo noma kumuntu ohlanganyela emkhandlwini. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-35 processing isicelo sakho. Kuzoncika kulokho okukhona kwabafake izicelo. Izindleko zinqunywa ukuphathwa kwendawo yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile. Ifomu lokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe uma umuntu efaneleka ukutholwa ngu-IDQ 98, elitholakala endaweni yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile.
Ezamabhizinisi: Ukuhlaziywa Nokusungulwa Kwemikhakha Yezomnotho Isingeniso Ezamabhizinisi, njengengxenye ebalulekile yomnotho wezwe, ziye zaba nendima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba omsebenzi, ekuphuculeni izinga levene kanye nasekukhuliseni umnotho jikelele. Uhlaka lwezamabhizinisi lugcizelela ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo, ukuhweba nokuqondisa, ukwenziwa kwezakhiwo, kanye nezimakethe. Ukukhulisa ulwazi lwethu ngamabhizinisi kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi kwi-Afrika, lapho ubuchwepheshe obusha nobuchwepheshe bezamabhizinisi buye baba nomthelela omkhulu. Izinhlobo Zamabhizinisi Izinhlobo zamabhizinisi zihlukaniswa ngokwezindlela ezithile, okuhlanganisa amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi kanye namakhulu. Amabhizinisi amancane, ngokuvamile akhelekile ebhizinisini eliyingqayizivele, abasebenzi abambalwa, kanye nokusebenza endaweni ethile. Lamabhizinisi adlalela indima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba omsebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amabhizinisi amakhulu anezinsiza ezinkulu kakhulu, imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, kanye nemakethe ebanzi okwenza kube lula ukwandisa imikhiqizo kubathengi. Ubuchwepheshe Kwezamabhizinisi Ubuchwepheshe buye baphawuleka ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zamabhizinisi. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili njengokuhweba kwedijithali, izinhlelo zokuphatha eziphumelelayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza, kunikeza amandla amabhizinisi ukuthi ahlale enza kahle emakethe. Ubuchwepheshe bunciphisa izindleko, kuthuthukiswa ukukhiqizwa, futhi kwandisa ukwaziwa kwemikhiqizo kumakethe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-e-commerce iye yavula amathuba amasha okusebenza kwezamabhizinisi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezizukulwane ezincane ezithokozela izitolo zokuthenga eziku-inthanethi. Umthelela Wamasu Wamabhizinisi Ukuguquka kwemakethe kanye nezidingo zabathengi kuholele ekutheni amabhizinisi enze izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana namasu okukhula. Ukwamukela amasu ashukumisayo, njengokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi, kubalulekile ekukhuleni kwezamabhizinisi. Lokhu kungafaka izindlela zokuphatha ezibandakanya ubuholi obuphumelelayo, kanye nokwakha ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo. Amabhizinisi kufanele futhi ahlale eqapha izinguquko ezithinta imakethe, ezifana nezimo zomnotho, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, kanye nezimo zokuncintisana. Lokhu kudinga ukubhalisela imiphumela emihlungwini, ngokuhlonipha nokuthola ithuba lokuthuthukisa izinhlelo eziphusile nezesikhathi esizayo. Imithetho Nezinqubomgomo Ukuphathwa kwemithetho nezimo ezinqumayo kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni indawo engcono yebhizinisi. Ukuhlonishwa kwemithetho yezezimali, izivumelwano zendawo, kanye nezinye izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni ziyadingeka ukuze kuhlonishwe amalungelo abasebenzi, abathengi, nezinsizakalo. Izinqubomgomo ezahlukene, ezifana nezokugunyazwa kwezamabhizinisi, zingasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga ezivela kumabhizinisi amasha, ziqinisa ukwethembeka kokuhweba. Ubuhlakani Bezemfundo Kwezokuphathwa Kwamabhizinisi Ubuhlakani bezemfundo buwumgogodla ekuphumeleleni kwamabhizinisi. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlukene zihluleke ukwakha abaholi abaqeqeshiwe, abazi kahle izimfundiso ezisemqoka ezimbalini zomnotho, izinhlelo zokuphatha, kanye nezindlela zokukhula. Okwamanje, izikhungo zemfundo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezokuphathwa kwemali, ezentengiselwano, nezokuxhumana, okuyimithombo ebalulekile yokufeza izinjongo zamabhizinisi. Isiphetho Ezamabhizinisi zikhombisa amandla amakhulu okuthuthukisa umnotho, ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi, kanye nokukhulisa impilo yabantu. Njengoba izinsizakusebenza zomhlaba ziqhubeka nezinguquko, kubalulekile ukuthi amabhizinisi aphephe, azivumelanise nezidingo zabathengi, bese edlulela phambili ukuze athole impumelelo. Ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuthi imikhakha yebhizinisi ingathuthuka, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza inhlangano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni namabhizinisi, ukuze kufezwe imiphumela emihle. Ngale ndlela, amathuba okukhula kwezamabhizinisi ayindlela eqondile yok片huthukisa impilo ezindaweni zethu, kanye nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Thabiso Thusi ovela ePort Shepstone. Ngiyabonga bonke abasebenzi bezempilo abaqhubeka nokuthatha izifungo zokwenza imisebenzi yabo ngenhlonipho ngenkathi bebhekene nezinselelo nezithiyo kulolu work. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyishumi, ngibuyela phambi kwenu ngenkulu ukuzithoba ngemuva kokhetho luka-2009 lapho i-African National Congress (ANC) iphinde yakhethwa, okwaholela ekutheni inikezwe ithuba elisha lokuphatha zonke izakhiwo zikamasipala. Kungalesi sukela sokuphumelela ukuthi kwi-Election Manifesto, i-ANC ibekezelele impilo njengenye yezinhlaka ezine eziphezulu ezidinga ukunakwa. Abantu bethu bavote i-ANC ngoba inhlangano yethu ibambelela kakhulu ezindabeni zempilo ezweni futhi lezi ngempela ziyamalungelo abantu. Lokhu kugcizelelwa ngumthethosisekelo wezwe lethu, ikakhulukazi iBill of Rights. Njengoba amanzi ewumsebenzi obalulekile kubo bonke, ukuphila kahle kuyinto ethinta wonke umuntu ophilayo. Ngesikhathi sikhulula ibhajethi ngo-2009, isiqubulo sethu sasingukuthi: "Sisalela ukuphila. Ake senze izinsiza zempilo zifinyeleleke kubantu." Ukuthuthukiswa kokufinyelela ekwelashweni kwababhekelelwa i-tuberculosis kuyisixhumanisi sokuhlaselwa kwabo yi-HIV. Ukwandiswa kwezinsiza zabantu abalele emakhaya nakwabanye abasebenza ezempilo yomphakathi. Ukusindiswa ngendlela efanele. Njengoba sibeka ibhajethi ka-2010, umqondo wethu uthi Impilo Engcono Kubantu Bonke. Lokhu kwakwakhiwe phezu kokuzinikela emsebenzini engiwethulile ngo-2009. Kulolu work, uMnyango wakhetha izibhedlela eziyishumi nanye esisebenzisana nazo ukuze noma ubani ofaka izicabha zazo azizwe sengathi ukhuluma endaweni yokwelashwa. Sikholelwa ukuthi lezi zinto ezishiwo zingenzeka uma siqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi basebenza ngokuzikhandla ngokuhlala bebheka ukuthi kwenzekani ezibhedlela abaphatha, bezwa izikhalazo zabaguli, bephendula izinkinga ezingahambi kahle ekwethulweni kwezinsizakalo zezibhedlela, futhi bejikeleza abasebenzi ukuze bagcine bephila kahle emsebenzini. Ngicela ngichaze lokhu: Abaguli balindele ukwelashwa okuhle nakuba kunezinselelo esibhekene nazo. Ekupheleni kwale nyanga, sizokhipha isaziso sokuthi yiziphi ezinye izibhedlela eziyishumi nanye nezikhungo ezizobandakanywa kulolu hlelo njengoba sizibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi phakathi neminyaka emihlanu zonke izibhedlela zethu zifakwa kulolu hlelo. Ngifuna ukuqokomisa ukuthi izibhedlela zasemaphandleni ziwumfanekiso esingazigqaja ngawo ngezindlela eziningi. Lapha singakhuluma ngeMnyango uMzinyathi, okukhombisa ukuthi uyasebenza kahle kulolu siko. Ngiyacela ungivumele ngifunde le ncwadi ethunyelwe ngomunye wabaguli echaza i-COSH. Ezinye izibalo zikhuluma ngezici zokuphumelela kwe-MDGs. Lokhu kugcizelela nezinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Nakuba lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi kukhona intuthuko ezindaweni eziningi, le ntuthuko ibonakala ingalingani. Asikafiki ezingeni lapho singathi sikwazi ukwenza okwanele ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi omama nezingane zabo ezizalwayo. I-Tuberculosis: Ithuba labantu abane-tuberculosis abathola ukwesekwa nge-DOTS lehle laya ku-80% ngo-2005/6 laya ku-72% ngo-2008/09. Isizathu salokhu wukuthi kunzima ukugcina labo abavuma ukusiza labo abaphakathi kwezinhlelo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungenxa yokwehluleka ukugcina labo abamsiza labo abaphakathi kwezinhlelo ze-DOTS. Ithuba labaguli abangapheli uhlelo lwabo lwezidakamizwa lehle laya ku-14% ngo-2005/6 laya ku-8.7% ngo-2009/10. Ukulethwa kwezokwelapha kuthuthuke kusuka ku-15% ngo-2005/6 kuya ku-53.15% ngo-2009/10. Impumelelo yokwelashwa ithuthuke kusuka ku-35% ngo-2005/6 kuya ku-58.15% ngo-2009/10. Ukuvela komdlavuza wombungu: Isifunda sikhombise ukwehla okungu-90% emdlavuzweni wombungu. Izibalo zikhombisa ukwehla okuvela ezimweni eziyi-606 ngo-2007/8 zaya ku-429 ngo-2008/9 phakathi kwalabo abathintekayo kulolu bhubhane. Kukhona intuthuko enhle wezi zindawo zonke. Kufanele sibhiyozela le mpumelelo esiyifinyelele ekwenzeni ukuthi umdlavuza wombungu unqotshwe. Kufanele sonke sibe nokuqhakambisa ngentuthuko eyenziwa emhlabeni jikelele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi impilo ibhekwa njengokubaluleke kakhulu, ngisho nasezikhathini lapho kunezinkinga ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Ngemuva kweminyaka engaphezu kweshumi nanhlanu selokhu sathola uhulumeni wenkululeko, kukhona izinkomba zokuthi ngokwandisa ibhajethi yomnyango wezempilo, singathola imiphumela ebonakalayo.
