Siyaziqhenya ng food esiyilungisayo ngokulandela iziqondiso zokudla ezinikezwa ezigulini ezamukelwe esibhedlela. Njalo ngosuku ngo-30 ntambama kulabo abafuna ukuthenga okunye. Uma udokotela eqinisekisile ukukhishwa kwakho, lungela ukuhamba. Isikhathi sokukhishwa sokuhamba ekhaya sikhona ngo-10:30 ekuseni, okukunika ithuba lokuthola imithi noma amaphilisi nokuthola okuthile okufanele uthathe ekhaya ngesikhathi. Sizama ngazo zonke izindlela ukuhlinzeka ngothando nokunakekela okudingwa yisiguli ngasinye, siqinisekisa ukuthi sivikela amalungelo eziguli ngokulandela izinqubo ezichazwe kwi-charter yamalungelo eziguli. Abasebenzi bethu abaqeqeshiwe bazinikele futhi bazimisele ukuhlinzeka ngokuqapha okuphephile kubo bonke abaguli. Uma unazo iziphakamiso, izikhalazo, noma izincomo, sinezikhwama zokuphakamisa kuyo yonke isibhedlela, futhi ikomidi elibhekelelayo lizobuyekeza futhi liphendule lapho kudingeka. IZINSUKU ZOKUVAKASHA Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaguli bathola usizo oluphakeme, sicela ukuthi izikhathi zokuvakasha zilandwe. Uma uvakashela isiguli, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi awudluli inani ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo. Uma uthola phakathi kuka-R1,000 no-R36,000 ngonyaka noma uma umndeni uhola ndawonye phakathi kuka-R1,000 no-R50,000, kulindeleke ukuthi ukhokhe u-R30 esibhedlela. Le mali ikhokhwa uma uhlale ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyi-30; uma udlula ezinsukwini eziyi-30, ukhokha u-R30 olwengeziwe ngosuku ngalunye olwandulela. Abesifazane abakhulelwe bavunyelwe ukuhlala kuze kube yizinsuku eziyi-42 ngemuva kokubeletha.
IPhalamende inezindlu ezimbili, okungukuthi iNdlu Yezwe (eyaziwa njenge-NA) neNdlu Yezinhlaka Zamasipala (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). I-NA ivoteleka kabusha njalo eminyakeni emihlanu ngesikhathi sokhetho lwesizwe. Ngesikhathi sokhetho, abavoti bakhetha ukuthi yiziphi amaqembu abafuna ukuba temsilwe ngawo ngokuvota kumapolitiki abawathandayo. Enye yezinhloso ezisemqoka ze-NA ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi yokuphatha izwe. I-NA ithumela amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze ahlaziywe futhi ibamba izingxoxo ngalezi zamaBill. I-NA ingavuma, iphikise, noma ibuyisele amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze abuyekezwe. IPhalamende inesibopho sokuhlaziya, ukuhlola, nokubheka umsebenzi wombuso noma yiliphi ilungu leSifunda, mayelana nokuphathwa kwemithetho, ukusetshenziswa kwezimali, nokubheka uMthethosisekelo. IPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi iKomidi inemfanelo yokuvuma izabelomali, ngokubuza imibuzo yephalamende, ibamba izingxoxo zephalamende ngezindaba ezibalulekile, futhi iphakamisa futhi ivote ngeziphakamiso ezihlobene nomsebenzi wombuso. I-NA inegunya elivela kuMthethosisekelo lokukhetha uMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika phakathi kwamalungu ayo. I-NA inamalungu angama-400 ePhalamende (ama-MPs) akhethwe kuyo. Amalungu e-NA akhethwa ngohlelo olubizwa ngokuthi ukumela ngokufanele. Ngaphambi kokhetho, iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki lidala uhlu lwabafakizicelo ukuze balwe ukhetho lokukhethwa. Lezi zifakizicelo zikhishwa ngokufanele ngenani lemivoto eqembu lezepolitiki elithole ngesikhathi sokhetho. Ngokwesibonelo, uma iqembu lithola isigamu semivoto, lizothola isigamu sezihlalo ku-NA. Emhlanganweni wokuqala we-NA, amalungu e-NA akhetha uMholi noMholi Osenkingeni, kanye nalokho okubizwa ngokuthi amaMandla ePhalamende eNdlu Yezwe. AmaMandla ePhalamende anesibopho sokuphatha izindaba ze-NA. UMholi noMholi Osenkingeni bePhalamende baphatha imihlangano ye-NA. Baqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ePhalamende akhuluma ngokukhululeka, kodwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho yeNdlu Yezwe. Imithetho yeNdlu ibeka ukuthi abaphathi beNdlu basiza amaMandla ePhalamende ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Abaphathi beNdlu bangadingeka futhi ukuba baphathe imihlangano yeNdlu Yezwe. Ukuze banikeze amaMandla ePhalamende ukwesekwa kwezepolitiki nokusebenza. Iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki ku-NA likhetha uMphakathi omkhulu ukuphatha izindaba zalo. Abaphathi babhekelela amalungu abo ngokuhambisana nokuhlukahluka kwabo. UMongameli ukhetha uMholi Wokusebenza Kwezimali ozosebenza nabaholi bezindlu zombili zePhalamende. UMholi Wokusebenza Kwezimali kufanele acabangele izidingo zeNdlu kanye nezinhlelo zombuso ePhalamende. UMholi Wokusebenza Kwezimali uqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu eNdlu enza imisebenzi yawo yephalamende. Iningi lomsebenzi we-NA wenziwa kumaKomidi. AmaKomidi e-NA abizwa ngokuthi amaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe. Umsebenzi wekomidi ngalinye uhambisana nomnyango wombuso ohlobene nawo. Ngokwesibonelo, iKomidi Yezohwebo Nezimboni ibhekana nazo zonke izindaba eziphathelene noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Ikomidi ngalinye lineMphakathi walo ozokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle komsebenzi. AmaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe abhekana nokuxoxa, ukubamba izingxoxo, nokuhlela amaBill. AmaKomidi angabamba Ukuhlolwa KwePublic ngemicimbi yokwethulwa kwemithetho noma ngezindaba ezihlobene nemithetho. AmaKomidi abhekana nokubheka nokuhlola umsebenzi Womnyango wombuso. Ngokwemithetho, iPhalamende idinga ukufaka umphakathi enqubweni yokwethulwa kwemithetho nakwezinye izinhlelo zephalamende. AmaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe adinga ukuxhumana namalungu omphakathi ukuze athole iminikelo yabo ngamaBill noma ukuze azwe imibono yabo ngezindaba ezibalulekile zesizwe. Umphakathi uyakhuthazwa ukuba ube nengxenye ekuxoxeni uma amaKomidi ebamba Ukuhlolwa KwePublic. Abantu noma amaqembu akhuthazwa ukuba athumele izikhalazo ngomlomo noma ngobufakazi mayelana nezindaba ezithinta bona, ukuze afune ulwazi mayelana nomsebenzi wabo ePhalamende. AmaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe. INdlu Yezwe, ngokwesibonelo, iZabelomali. Chaza iPhalamende nganoma iyiphi indaba ethinta bona. Le bhukwana itholakala wezilimi ezisemthethweni zesiNingizimu Afrika.
Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso I-Eskom, njengomphakathi ophakathi kokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wezwe. Kulokhu, sizochaza ukusebenza kwe-Eskom, izinselelo ezibhekene nayo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Ukuze sithole ulwazi olunembile, sikhulume noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, umholi wezokukhiqiza ugesi e-Eskom. Ingxenye 2: Ukusebenza kwe-Eskom UMnu. Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha. Ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi i-Eskom isebenza? “Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. I-Eskom iyinkampani enkulu yokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika. Sihlinzeka ngogesi kumakhaya, ezimbonini, nasemiphakathini. Sisebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukene, njengezikhukhula, amalahle, nezinye izinsiza ezivuselelekayo ukuze sithole ugesi. Ukusebenza kwethu kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze sikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu.” Ingxenye 3: Izinselelo ezibhekene ne-Eskom Kodwana, u-Eskom ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ungakuchaza lokhu? “Yebo, izinselelo zethu ziningi. Okokuqala, sinesidingo sokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu. Amadivayisi amaningi esiwasebenzisayo sephukile noma awasebenzi kahle, okwenza ukukhiqizwa kukagesi kube phansi. Okwesibili, sinesidingo sokuphatha kahle izinsiza zethu zemali; ukuntuleka kwemali kuholela ekubambezelweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa. Futhi, izimo zezulu zidlala indima enkulu; izikhukhula nezomiso zenza kube nzima ukukhiqiza ugesi.” Ingxenye 4: Izixazululo ezitholakalayo Ngabe zikhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo kulezi zinselelo? “Yebo, sikholelwa ukuthi izixazululo zikhona. Okokuqala, sithuthukisa izinhlelo zethu zokuphatha. Sifuna ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze sithole ugesi ngendlela efanele. Okwesibili, sikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo, njengezikhukhula, ukuze sinciphise ukuncika kumalahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo.” Ingxenye 5: Ukubambisana nomphakathi Ngabe i-Eskom ibambisana kanjani nomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwayo? “Ukubambisana nomphakathi kubalulekile. Sihlela imihlangano nezinhlelo zokubambisana ukuze sithole imibono evela kubantu. Siphinde sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise ugesi ngendlela efanele, ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa okungadingekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubo bonke.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubheka phambili Ngabe ubona ikusasa le-Eskom linjani? “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ikusasa le-Eskom linethemba. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, futhi sithuthukise umnotho wezwe. Sifuna ukuba yinkampani ehamba phambili emhlabeni, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sifinyelele kulokho.” Ingxenye 7: Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ukusebenza kwe-Eskom kubalulekile, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabambisana ukuze uthuthukise izinsiza. Siyathemba ukuthi i-Eskom izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, futhi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile eNingizimu Afrika. Ngiyabonga futhi, futhi ngifisela i-Eskom impumelelo emizamweni yayo yokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwayo.
A.1 Lezi ziqondiso zizobizwa ngokuthi Izimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-2001 futhi zizothatha umthelela kusukela ngo-1 Januwari 2001, ngaphandle kwezikhombisi III B.2 (b) kanye ne-III F(b) yeSahluko-1, ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku olukhulunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngalesi sikhangiso esisemthethweni. B.1 Lezi zimiso zizofundwa ndawonye neMthetho. c "I-Core" iyisifinyezo seKhowudi yeMiholo, njengoba kuchazwe esikhombisweni III 1.3 kuya ku-1. r "I-SMS" ibhekisela kubasebenzi abanikwe igama esikhombisweni- l B. v "Izimiso Zezimali" zisho Izimiso Zezimali ezishicilelwe kuSaziso SoHulumeni Inombolo R.556 ka-31 Meyi 2000 njengoba kuguqulwe ngezikhathi ezithile futhi kwenziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba -76 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi; futhi noma iyiphi enye igama izobhekisela kulokho okukhulunywe kwiMthetho. Isigaba -41 seMthetho sikhuthaza lezi zimiso. a kubo bonke abantu abaqashwe kanye nakuzo zonke izikhungo eziphethwe nguMthetho; futhi b ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho, kubantu abaqashwe ezinsizeni, ezikhungweni noma ezikhungweni zemfundo zendawo, kodwa kuphela lapho zingaphikisi nemithetho ephethe ukuqashwa kwabo. E.1 Izimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-1999 (ezashicilelwa kuSaziso SoHulumeni Inombolo R.679 ka-1 Julayi 1999), kuhlanganise nazo zonke izinguquko ezenziwe kanye nazo zonke izimiso ezenziwe futhi ezisebenza ngaphansi kweMthetho, zikhanselwa lapha. E.2 Noma iyiphi isenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kweZimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-1999 futhi esingaqhutshelwa ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zalezi zimiso sizobhekwa njengokwenziwa ngaphansi kwaleyo nhlinzeko. E.3 Nakuba Izimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-1999 zikhanselwa ngaphansi kwesikhombisi- l E.1, izinhlelo zokudlulela phambili zizokwenziwa kuSevisi Yomphakathi- 1. Umthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi kanye nezivumelwano ezihlangene zizophatha izindaba ezithinta bobabili phakathi kweZinsizakalo kanye noMbuso njengomqashi. Uma kwenzeka izimo zivumela ukweqa ezinhlinzekweni nasezikhombisweni zendlela ethile kulezi zimiso mayelana nezimo zokusebenza ku-sevisi yomphakathi, uNgqongqoshe angathatha izinqumo, akhiphe iziqondiso noma avume ezinye izimiso ngaphansi kwezimo ezichaziwe futhi azisebenzise. a xhumana naye ngeMenenja-Jikelele: Isevisi Yomphakathi kanye Nokuphathwa; futhi b bhala ngolimi olusemthethweni lezi zimiso ezashicilelwa ku. H.2 Umsebenzi uzokhombiswa nganoma yimuphi umbuzo ophathelene nezindaba ngaphansi kwamandla nezibopho zikaNgqongqoshe ophakathi kweminyango yakhe. H.3 Umphathi wombutho uzokwethula kuMenenja-Jikelele: Isevisi Yomphakathi kanye Nokuphathwa, kusenesikhathi ngokuxoxisana, noma iyiphi ifreyimu esemthethweni noma ifreyimu yokwethula umthetho noma idokhumenti yepholisi ethinta amandla noma izibopho zikaNgqongqoshe. H.4 Umphathi wombutho uzokwakha ipholisi mayelana nokuthi abasebenzi bomnyango wakhe bangabambisana kanjani nezindaba nezikhungo zezindaba. H.5 Umsebenzi, emsebenzini wakhe, akavunyelwe ukuhlabela umqondo wepholisi kahulumeni endaweni yomphakathi noma emaphephandabeni noma ezindaweni zezindaba noma kunoma iyiphi imithombo yezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuze avumele umphathi wombutho ukuphatha umnyango wakhe ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlinzeka umphathi wombutho ngamandla adingekayo kanye namandla. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphathi wombutho uzovuma abasebenzi emnyangweni ngokudlulisa amandla afanele nezimvume lapho kudingeka. a bangadlulisa amandla kubasebenzi noma bavume abasebenzi ukwenza lelo thaskh; futhi b bazokwenza izinqumo mayelana nokusebenzisa la mandla noma ukwenza lelo thaskh. B.2 Umphakathi omkhulu uzobhalela phansi ukudluliswa kwamandla noma izimvume ngokubhala futhi lokhu kungafakwa futhi esivumelwaneni sokuqashwa somphathi wombutho, njengoba kuchaziwe esikhombisweni -VII B.2.1. B.3 Ukudluliswa kwamandla nguMphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wombutho akuvimbeli ukuba basebenzise la mandla bona. C.2 Umphakathi omkhulu akavunyelwe ukuqinisa noma ukuvumela umphathi wombutho noma noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi ukuba abambe iqhaza kunoma iyiphi indaba noma athathe isinqumo esiphula lezi zimiso. a uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bomnyango wakhe bayahambisana nalezi zimiso, izivumelwano ezihlangene kanye nanoma yiziphi izibopho zomthetho; futhi b uzobhekana ngokushesha nangokwanelisayo nanoma yiziphi iziphazamiso ezingenzeka. C.4 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wombutho bazosebenzisa amandla abo, benze imisebenzi yabo futhi baqede izibopho zabo ngaphansi kwezi zimiso ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi nezivumelwano ezihlangene ezisebenzayo. C.5 Umphakathi omkhulu nomphathi wombutho bazokuqinisekisa ukuthi uMnyango Wezezimali uvuma ngaphambi kokuthi benze isinqumo esihilela ukusetshenziswa kwemali evela emalini engenayo. D.1 Lapho kungase kube nokungqubuzana kwesithakazelo uma kwenziwa noma iyiphi inqumo mayelana nokuqashwa, umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi onamandla uzokwenza lelo thaskh noma athathe isinqumo kuphela ngemva kokucabangela isiphakamiso esivela kuphaneli ezimele equkethe okungenani abantu ababili. D.3 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuthola noma ukufuna noma iyiphi imbuyiselo yemali kunoma iyiphi indlela emsebenzini noma kumuntu ongase abe ngumsebenzi ngokwenza okuthile noma ukuthatha isinqumo mayelana nokuqashwa. Umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuveza emphakathini noma iyiphi imininingwane esemthethweni ngaphandle kwamandla adingekayo. Umphakathi omkhulu uzokwakha imigomo ebonakalayo yomnyango wakhe ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhishwa ngokubuyiselwa kwemali esebenzisiwe, kugcwaliswa ngokuphelele izinsiza zomnyango kuhlanganise nabasebenzi, futhi futhi kusetshenziswa ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi njengoba kudingeka. Ngokusebenzisa imali ethokozisayo futhi echazwe ngezinhlinzeko nemiyalelo yomnyango kanye nohulumeni ukuze ahlinzeke, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlela ukwenza imisebenzi ngendlela ehlelekile, eyanelisayo futhi ephumelelayo ngaphakathi kwenhlangano nezinqubo zokuphatha abasebenzi ezakhiwe. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukubhekelela umphakathi nokukhanya, umphakathi omkhulu uzoshicilela umbiko wonyaka ohlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nomnyango wakhe. ukusekela ukuhambisana nezidingo zokubika esikhombisweni III J kanye neziMiso zezeMali eMnyangeni ophansi avunyelwe ngemininingwane, futhi kukhombiswe esikhombisweni- VII H; futhi g ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhishwe ezigabeni- 5.1 no-5.2 zeziMiso zezeMali. c sichaza izikhundla ezidingekayo ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi ethile ngaphakathi kokuhlinzekwa kwemali okukhona kanye neSikhungo Sokusetshenziswa Kweze
Umfazi owayengumfelokazi owayesebenza eMali Yokubuyiselwa uthole inzuzo yephenshini yom husband wakhe emva kokungenelela kukaMphakathi Ovikela, uLawrence Mushwana. Ihhovisi likaMphakathi Ovikela (OPP) limemezele ukuqala kokuhlola ukulibaziseka okungafanele ekukhokheni izinzuzo yiHhovisi leMali Yabasebenzi (GEPF) kanye neMali Yokubuyiselwa kumlamuli, uNkk. M du Toit. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemva kokuthi i-OPP ifunde ukuthi uNkk. M du Toit, owayesebenza futhi eMali Yokubuyiselwa, wayesalindele izinzuzo okufanele azithole, ezinyangeni ezintathu emva kokushona komyeni wakhe. Izinzuzo zazingenakukhokhwa naphezu kokuthi ube esefake yonke imibhalo edingekayo njengoba kuchaziwe emthethweni weMali Yabasebenzi. Izinzuzo ezazifanele ukukhokhwa kuye zifaka phakathi ipenshini ye-GEPF kanye nezinsiza zokufa ezivela eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi, ngaphansi kwalokho iMali Yokubuyiselwa iphakathi. Phakathi kokuhlola, kwatholakala ukuthi ukulibaziseka kwakubangelwa ukuthi umufi wayengabhaliswanga njengomtaxi ngokuhambisana nomthetho we-Income Tax Act ka-1962. Umthetho ufunela ukuthi noma ubani othola imali engaphezu kuka-R120,000 ngonyaka kufanele akhokhe intela. Isikhundla somufi emsebenzini kanye nemholo yakhe kudlule lesi sikhawu. Ngalesi sizathu, imiyalelo yentela mayelana nezinsiza zokufa yanqatshelwa uma ifakwe kwiNhlangano Yezimali yaseNingizimu Afrika (SARS), nokho, umlamuli wathathwa njengokungatholanga noma iyiphi imiyalezo mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwe yi-GEPF. Mayelana nezinsiza zokufa, kutholakale ukuthi uMnyango Wezabasebenzi awulandanga lokho okukhulunywe ngakho kuMthetho 7 weKhansela Lezabasebenzi ka-2000. Umthetho uthi uma kwenzeka ukufa, izinsiza zokufa kufanele zikhokhwe kubantu abanikazi ababelwe, futhi uma kungekho abanikazi ababelwe, kufanele zikhokhwe kumakoti noma kumlingani womufi. Ngemva kokungenelela kwe-OPP, i-SARS yabeka usuku lokuhlangana noNkk. Du Toit. Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-24, uNkk. Du Toit nomyeni wakhe baphakanyiswa njengabathengi bentela, futhi amafomu okuhlola intela afakwe, ngaleyo ndlela kuqondiswa indlela yokukhokhwa kwezinzuzo okufanele azithole. Uphinde wagqugquzela uMnyango Wezabasebenzi ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi izinhlinzeko zeMthetho 7 ka-2000 mayelana nokukhokhwa kwezinsiza zokufa zilandelwa.
Sithanda imali ukuze sihlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo nokuphepha. Izithombe: Isithombe 1. Yini ibhizinisi? Ibhizinisi liqala kanjani? Uma kuziwa ekuphatheni ibhizinisi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le mibuzo ibaluleke kangakanani. Lo mbhalo uzokusiza uqonde ukuthi le mibuzo zikhuluma ngani. Kusukela ekuqaleni kokuphila kwabantu, umuntu uhlale enezidingo ezisiza ukuba aphile. Ukudla, indawo yokuhlala, nezimpahla zokugqoka zingezinye zalezi zidingo. Ekuqaleni, abantu bahlangabezana nalezi zidingo ngokuzingela, behlola ukudla ezitshalweni zasendle, nasekuhlaleni ezindlini. Njengoba abantu baqala ukuthuthuka, nezidingo zabo zathuthuka, ngakho ukukhiqiza, ukwakha, nokwenza izinto kwaba yinto ejwayelekile empilweni. Yini imali futhi ivela kuphi? Lapho kukhishwa noma yini, sisebenzisa imali. Imali iphepha nje; manje singacabanga futhi sibuze, "kungani ingxenye yephepha ingathenga into enenani?" Ekuqaleni, kwaba nokushintshisana (ukupha ingxenye yento ukuze uthole ezinye izinto ofuna zona uma inani lezo zinto lihambelana). Isibonelo: umuntu angase anikeze inkomo ukuze athole amabhakede amahlanu ommbila. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ngoba uma unenkukhu kodwa ufuna ummbila, kufanele uthole umuntu onommbila ofuna inkomo. Mhlawumbe ungahamba emhlabeni wonke ngaphambi kokuthola umuntu onommbila ofuna inkomo? Lokhu kwakuyinselele enkulu. Abantu bakhumbula ukuthola into ezokwamukelwa ngabo bonke. Le nto kwakuyi-golide. Manje ungashintsha inkomo yakho ngama-30 grams egolide bese uthenga ummbila ngama-10 grams egolide. Nokho, abantu baqala ukwesaba ukuthi igolide labo lizotholwa. Baqala ukugcina igolide labo ezindaweni eziphephile (njengamabhange). Umphathi webhange uzokunikeza i-receipt ye-golide yakho ekhombisa ukuthi unegolide elingakanani. Lapho uveza le receipt, bazokunikeza igolide lakho. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, abantu baqeda ukuya ebhange uma befuna ukuthenga izinto; basebenzisa le receipt abathole kuyo ebhange. Umnikazi omusha wale receipt uzoya ebhange uma efuna igolide. Ngemuva kwalokho, abaqhubeki besebenzisa igolide nhlobo; bagcina besebenzisa le receipt kuphela ukuze bakhombise ukuthi banemali engakanani. Njengamanje, wonke umuntu usebenzisa lephepha. Abantu bathola kanjani imali? Umuntu angathola imali kuphela ngokusebenza ukuze athole umholo noma ukwenza inzuzo ebhizinisini eliphumelelayo. Emhlabeni omusha wanamuhla, amabhizinisi anika umuntu konke akudingayo. Umsebenzi owenziwayo nezimpahla ezithengiswayo zenza imali yamabhizinisi. Izibonelo zezimpahla ezikhiqizwayo zifaka: ukudla, izingubo, izimoto, ifenisha, nezindlu. Izibonelo zomsebenzi owenziwayo zifaka: umsebenzi wezempilo (odokotela nemithi), ukufundisa nokuqeqesha, kanye nomsebenzi wezokuxhumana. Lo mqondo mayelana nemali umuntu ayitholayo ubonisa ukuthi wonke umuntu udinga imali ukuze athole lezi zinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Uma ibhizinisi likhiqiza izimpahla futhi lenza imisebenzi edingekayo, kukhona izindleko futhi kufanele kukhokhwe inani elilungile lemali. Izindleko eziguquguqukayo zisebenzisa izinto ezikhiqizwayo futhi zenzeka kuphela uma kukhona umkhiqizo. Ngakho-ke, kukhona ibhalansi phakathi kwenani lomkhiqizo nezindleko. Uma umbulali enza ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-10, izindleko eziguquguqukayo ezifana nemiholo, ukudla okugcwele, nezinye izindleko zokudla nezokuhamba zizoba phansi kunezindleko zomlimi owenza ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-50. Izibonelo zezindleko eziguquguqukayo zifaka: umanyolo, imbewu, ama-herbicides kanye ne-pesticides, umsebenzi wezinkontileka, imithi yezilwane, usawoti, ama-concentrates, i-diesel ne-petrol, abasebenzi besizini abawasebenzisayo, izinto zokupakisha ezimpahleni ezikhiqizwayo noma emikhiqizweni, nezindleko zokumaketha. Izindleko eziqinile yilezo ezingashintshi uma isu lokukhiqiza elithile limisiwe; azishintshi noma umkhiqizo omncane noma omkhulu ukhiqizwa. Esikhathini esifushane, izindleko eziqinile azishintshi. Lokhu kungashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba isu lokukhiqiza lingashintsha. Uma umbulali enesicwangciso sokwenza ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-50 (isicwangciso sakhe sokukhiqiza), izindleko eziqinile ezifana nentela ye-capital ekhokhwayo kanye nokwehla kwezimpahla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi zihlala ziqinile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umbulali ukhipha ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-10 noma eziyi-50. Nokho, uma umbulali eshintsha isu lokukhiqiza ukuze akhiphe ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-80, izindleko eziqinile nazo zizoshintsha ngoba isu lokukhiqiza lishintshile. Izibonelo zezindleko eziqinile zifaka: ukwehla kwezimpahla (hhayi imali), izintela, umshwalense, irenti, nemiholo yabasebenzi abaqashwe ngokuqinile. Izindleko ziqinile kuphela uma zikhokhwa. Ngaphambi kokuthenga ithrekhtha, zonke izindleko ezihlobene ne-trekhtha zinguquguqukayo. Uma umbulali esethenge into efana nethrekhtha, izindleko zokwehla kwaleyo mshini, izintela, amalayisense, nomshwalense ziba ziqinile. Lezi zindleko azishintshi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umbulali ukhiqiza okuningi noma okuncane esikhathini esifushane. Izindleko zokwehla kwezimpahla. Lokhu kuyindleko engahambisani nemali, ehambisana nokwehla kwezimpahla ngoba zisetshenziswa futhi ziyaqhamuka. Izintshisakalo zikhona uma usebenzisa imali ebolekiwe noma imali ebolekiwe kwabanye. Izindleko eziphelele yilezi zindleko ezihlanganisa izindleko eziqinile nezindleko eziguquguqukayo, njengoba kukhonjisiwe esithombeni 1. Inzuzo ingalinganiswa ngenani eliphelele (imali) elidlula izindleko eziphelele - uma izindleko zidlula inzuzo, kwenzeka ukulahlekelwa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uma ibhizinisi likhiqiza inzuzo, bonke abasebenzi nomnikazi bathola imali ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zabo. Ngakho-ke, inzuzo kufanele iqhubeke ibe khona esikhathini esizayo (esikhathini eside), ngaleyo ndlela ibonisa ukubaluleka kokulima ngendlela ebonisa ikusasa. Uma ibhizinisi lilahlekelwa, uhlelo lwalo lungashintsha. Abasebenzi bazothola imiholo yabo, kodwa umnikazi angase angabi nengeniso futhi uzodinga ukwenza izinguquko ukuze anciphise ukulahlekelwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukususa abanye abasebenzi (ukunciphisa). Ngemuva kwesikhathi, engeniso nezinga lezindleko emabhizinisini ezolimo zikhula ngenxa yokwanda kwenani lezimpahla ezithengiswayo (ukwenyuka kwentengo yemakethe) nezindleko ezikhulayo (ukwenyuka kwentengo). Nokho, ibhalansi yale nyuka ayifani, njengoba umkhawulo phakathi kwayo wehla. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela inzuzo. Abalimi baphushwa ukuthi bamukele intengo yemakethe esethwe; abakwazi ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yabo ngentengo ephezulu eyabelwe bona. Ingeniso ingakhuphuka ngokukhiqiza okuningi
Isingeniso Umlando wezilimi eNingizimu Afrika ubhalwe ezinkampanini ezahlukene, lapho amahlanga ahlukene ehlala khona. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezilimi eziyinhloko kubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ekuhlanganyeleni kwethu, lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba kuhlobene nomqondo wokuhlonipha nokuthokozisa zonke izilimi zethu. Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi, ikakhulukazi isiNgisi nesiZulu, kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kokubaluleka kokuxhumana nokuhlonipha izizinda zomphakathi. Izilimi EzingamaMaqhawe IsiNgisi nesiZulu kuyizilimi ezimbili ezibalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. IsiNgisi, njengesilimi sokuxhumana kwezohwebo nezepolitiki, sithathwa njengomkhiqizo wezinhlelo zamazwe omhlaba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, isiZulu, esiyisilimi sokuqala samasiko amaningi, linomlando ocebile nolokuhlobisa, othinta abantu bemvelo nezinkolelo zabo. Ngokuhlanganisa isiNgisi nesiZulu, sithola izinzuzo ezintsha ekuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu. Lezi zilimi zikhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwabantu bamasiko ahlukene, futhi zenza kube lula ukwabiwa kwesiko. Ukwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha indawo yokusebenza ehlukile. Ukuvuma isiZulu njengolimi olusemthethweni kwenza kube nokwaziswa okwengeziwe phakathi kwezisebenzi. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni imvelo engcono yemisebenzi, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa engenamahloni. Umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana ngesiZulu, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini ezisemadolobheni, lapho isiZulu sikhona njengolimi lwezizukulwane. Izikhungo ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nezempilo, amasiko, nezemfundo, kumele zakhe izinhlelo zokweseka isiNgisi nesiZulu. Ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza ezihambisana nezilimi zombili kunciphisa ukungaqondi kahle. Izicelo Zokwesekwa Kwezilimi Ukuze sithole impumelelo, izikhungo kumele ziqhube izinhlelo zokufundisa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokufunda isiZulu ezikoleni, ukusiza abafundi bathole izinsiza ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubamba imicimbi ethinta isiZulu, efana nemibukiso nemicabango. Imfundo kufanele iqhubeke iminyaka eminingi, iqhubeke nokusiza abaphumeleli abanokukhula okuhle. Izikhungo ezibhekelele imibono yempucuko kumele zisebenzise ubuqotho bokwakha izilimi. Lokhu kuzodinga ubuchwepheshe obufanele, izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nezinsizwa ezizokwazi ukuthinta abaphansi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezinkulu nezincane kuzothuthukisa ukwesekwa kwezilimi, kuhlukanise lezi ziko kulabo abafuna ukufunda isiNgisi nesiZulu. Isiphetho Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni, ikakhulukazi isiNgisi nesiZulu, kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuze sithole umphakathi onokuthula, uthando, nolwazi, ukuxhumanisa izilimi ezahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabantu. Ukwamukela izilimi ezintsha kuzothuthukisa ubuqotho bomphakathi nokwakha ubumbano. Ngokuhlanganyela, singenza izinhlelo zethu zibe wubungane, ziqhakambisa izilimi, futhi zisebenze kuzo zonke izifunda. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi izilimi zethu azisiyena amathuluzi kuphela, kodwa ziyinhloso yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukulalela, nokwazisa bonke abantu, ukuze sifinyelele umgomo wokuxhumana okuvamile.
Uhambo Nokuzijabulisa: Ukuhamba Ngemizwa Nezikhathi Ezinhle Uhambo lokuzijabulisa lusebenza njengomkhumbi obalulekile ophothula ukufisa kwethu kokuhamba nokuhlangana nezindawo ezintsha, abantu abasha, nemikhuba ehlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhathi zibheka izifiso zethu zokuphuma ezindaweni esizijwayeze zona futhi sithola indawo yokuphumula, yokujabulela, nokuhlola. Lokhu akuhambisani nje kuphela nezehlakalo zomphakathi, kodwa futhi nemizwelo esiwuthokozelayo njengabantu. Uhambo olunentshisekelo lukhulu lungasenza sikhulise imizwa yethu. Kwakha izinkumbulo ezingavamile ezihlala nathi olunye usuku. Noma sidlula ezindaweni ezihluke-hluke, sithola izifundo ezithokozisayo kusuka ezimweni ezincane, ezifana nokuqhuba noma ukulungisa ukudla, kuze kube kwezakhiwo nezimo ezinkulu ezibukeka kahle. Ngaleyondlela, sibonisa ukuthi uhambo aluhambisani kuphela nephysicality, kodwa lungumzila wokukhuluma nokuqonda ubunye bethu. Uma sikhuluma ngenkululeko yokuhamba, kunabantu abaningi abazama ukufinyelela kulolu hambo. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezulazula emhlabeni ngemisebenzi yabo, bezama ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula nokuzijabulisa. Ngaphakathi kwezehlakalo ezithokozisayo, sihamba siye ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, simele izinkambo, nabantu baphumula ezindaweni ezinhle. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zibalulekile; zidinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze zibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yethu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uyazibuza: “Kuyini okufanele ngikwenze ukuze ngithole uhambo lwezizathu ezivumelana nezikhathi zami?” Ukubuka kwesikhumbuzo, kubalulekile ugqozi filter. Ama-blogs ezokuvakasha, amalungelo ahlukahlukene kanye nemihlangano yokuzijabulisa, anjengokuxhumana ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kungenza lapho sinezindawo ezikhangayo. Njengoba sibona izinkanyezi zomhlaba, siba nobuchule bokuhlola izwe; sikwazi ukuthola ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani sihamba phansi komhlaba. Kuyadlangaza njalo ukwazi ukugcina umkhakha wethu wokuphumula ucocekile. Ngesikhathi sesimo senhlupho kalula, sithola lokhu kumfudumalo njengoba kunezelela ukushiseka okuxakile, okwenza kube sipho sothakazelo. Kubalulekile ukuhlonipha izinsuku zethu ukuze zibe nezinhloso ezijulile. Uma imfuneko izahlukaniswe ngempela, futhi sihlanganisa izinhlelo ezinhle, isimo sokuthokozisa sinomthelela omuhle. Kukhona umnotho ongaqhuba izimo ezinhle zokuhlolisisa, ezinamasiko ebuhleni bazo. Uhambo alukhawulelwe kuhambo lwesikhathi esifushane kuphela, kodwa kusukela ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Lokhu kucisha ukuhlubula izindawo esizihlala, kuze kube sezingeni eliphakeme, sisebenzisa ithuba lokugcina isikhathi. Nakuba uthola uxolo, uzowuthola umoya omusha, ugcwalisa izifiso zethu. Noma kungekho sikhathi esithile engumoya ofana namakhosikazi esiza izinyanga nezinsuku ezithinta umoya, akufanele siyihambise kalula. Ukuphila phakathi kwezinsuku ezihambisanayo, izinkanyezi ezinwetshiwe nezikhumbuzo, kungenza sithokozise inhliziyo. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinyanga ezihamba phambili zingase zibe yithuba lokuhlola ngezindlela ezahlukene – isimo sokuhlala phansi, ukuhlola imikhakha yokudayiswa kwezindawo, noma ukuhlangana nabantu abasha abavela emazweni ahlukahlukene. Izinkanyezi zomhlaba ziyaqhakaza, kubalulekile ukuchitha isikhathi sokuhamba. Kanjalo, uhambo lungavuma ukuthi sizame ukujabulisa izingxenye ezithile zomcabango, sithole umphakathi wokubambisana nokuhlangenwe nakho. Noma kunjalo, kukhona isici esibalulekile sokuhamba - sizuze ezindaweni eziphindaphindayo, sithandana namakhono abawuthakaselayo. Ngokushayela okufanele, kungenzeka sibone ukuthi isimo sokuhamba siza nezinselele ezinhle, nezikhathi ezilungele. Noma ikuphi lokho enikubona ezinkanyezi zomhlaba, kubaluleke kakhulu emholweni wakho. Kokubili ukufunda nokuzijabulisa, uhamba phambili. Ngokufanayo, uhambo lwethu lungavuma ukwazisa izindawo ezinjengokuhlonipha izinsuku zethu, ukuze sizame ukushintsha umoya, futhi sihambisane nemisebenzi emisha. Ukwazi ukumomotheka kulezi zindawo kuyashiya umqondo odabukisayo emiphakathini ehlukahlukene, ugqugquzela ukwakha ubudlelwane obuphumelelayo. Ngikufisela ukuhamba okuhle, kuhlangabezane nezifiso zakho futhi ube neziqu ezizokhulisa izifiso zakho. Khumbula, uhambo luhlobene nomoya, futhi unesitha esithembekile – izinkumbulo ezinhle nezenzakalo ezimnandi. Makube usuku olukhulu lokulungiselela ukuhlola umhlaba ongaphandle, uqhubeke nokwakha izinkanyezi ezizohlala isikhathi eside.
Mnu. Polsen, unayo yini imiphumela yokuphikisa isinqumo esiceliwe nguMnu. Vally? Empeleni, ngokuqinisekiswa kweMnyango Wezasekhaya, uNkk. Vaish uthe. Ngokuqondile, ukungabikhona kwezindlu zabesifazane kukhombisa ukungalingani okukhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namadoda. Ukuze iNingizimu Afrika ibekwe njengendawo efanele kakhulu njengensiza esebenzayo ezimweni zokuxhumana kwamazwe omhlaba. Inhloso yalolu hlelo kwakuwukugcina isimo semvelo nokuhlangana kwendawo engena olwandle. Kulindeleke futhi ukuthi kuzoba nomdlandla wokubandakanya emkhakheni ongekho emthethweni emkhakheni wamandla. Le ndawo iyakhipha izindawo zokuhlala zezindiza zendawo kulabo abadinga ukuxhumana nezindiza ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Insizakalo yebhasi endala ibhekane nezinselelo ezinkulu ekugcineni amabhasi esebenza futhi ayikwazanga ukugcina uhlelo lokuhamba olubonisa izindlela ezidingekayo zamabhasi. Lokhu kuvela okungajwayelekile mayelana nezici zengqondo zobugebengu kuphakamisa umbuzo kithi sonke emphakathini mayelana nalokho esikwenzayo ukuze stop ubugebengu obuhambisana nokuhlukumeza okukhulu. Gwema ukushayela ezithuthuthwini ezine-pressure ephansi yokungena ngoba umoya ezithuthuthwini eziphansi kakhulu awukhuphuki kakhulu ekugugumeni kwayo, futhi futhi kwehlisa isikhathi esiningi esingase sibe sebenzisa lezi zithuthuthu. Nakuba kukhulunywa okuningi mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nokuhlanganiswa kwedatha mayelana nokwabiwa kwenani ezindaweni abantu bahlala kuzo eThekwini. Masiphinde sizibophezele empilweni engcono kubantu bonke e-Afrika engcono nasemhlabeni ongcono. Amaphoyisa eKirstenhof abophe abasolwa ababili abebeshayela endaweni ngebhasi elibi. Mnu. President, siyabonga ngokukhuluma nathi namuhla. Inselelo ebhekene neUnicity ukuhlela isisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kahle lapho kungakhiwa khona ukuze kusebenze kahle izinsika ezintathu, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, ukuhleleka komphakathi, kanye nokuhlangana kwemvelo. Indawo lapho udoti lokudla luzolungiselelwa futhi luthengiswe ezithuthuthwini ezifana nalezi kufanele ihlelwe. Uhlelo oluhle lwezifundo luzovumela izingane eziningi ukuba zifinyelele ezikoleni eziphakeme. Ngesikhathi esibalulekile emlandweni wethu, asikwazi ukuziphatha sengathi asiboni ukuthi ukuziphatha kwethu nendlela esiphila ngayo kunomthelela omubi emvelweni yethu. Bathi bazoyifuna kodwa abayitholanga. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubungekho emkhakheni wokuhweba kwabantu ezindaweni ezahlukene nokuthi benzenjani ngakolunye uhlangothi ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi. Uhlelo oluhlanganisa i-NHISSA luzokwakhiwa futhi luzoba uhlelo olujwayelekile oluhlanganisa izingxenye ezahlukene. Kuyajabulisa ukubona intshisekelo enkulu emhlabeni jikelele mayelana neFIFA World Cup ibhola lokugcina e-Afrika,' kusho uDkt. Jordaan. Kumele sichaze izindaba zethu eziqhubekayo ezingenela isizathu sobuciko bethu bendabuko bomsindo kanye nezindaba zomlando. Ukuze uthole ulwazi oluphelele mayelana nokuthi ungafaka kanjani isicelo sedokhumenti yokuhlonza, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezasekhaya. Kulolu daba, uhulumeni udlala indima enkulu yokuvuma ukuze kwenzeke futhi indima yokwenza ukuthi kwenzeke, kanti umkhakha ongekho emthethweni ubekwe endaweni enhle yokweseka imicimbi enjengale. INingizimu Afrika ithumela eCuba ikakhulukazi imayini, amakhemikhali okwenziwa kwezolimo, nezinsiza zokulawula izinambuzane, kanye nemishini enama-engines e-diesel. Le mpumelelo ingaphindaphindwa uma siqinisa ukuhlinzekwa komthetho futhi sinciphise ukuvuma emigwaqweni. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngenethiwekhi equkethe izinsiza eziningi zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ezivumela isimo, zikhuthaze futhi zisebenze njalo. Kukhona isidingo sokwakha izikhungo zemidlalo ezindaweni ezibalulekile ngesikhathi sokuhlela. Abantu bokuqala eNingizimu Afrika benza izindaba ezihlobene nelanga kanye nenyanga futhi baphakamisela izinkanyezi. Le mali iyisibonakaliso sokuzibophezela kwethu ekuvuseleleni i-Afrika. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi ulandele ngokucophelela amalebula emikhiqizo yokwenziwa kwezolimo. Kwakuhle kakhulu ngalesi siqembu ukuthi bobabili abazali nabafundisi babo baye bashiya ngenxa yokubandakanyeka kwabo ubugebengu kanye nezinye izenzo zokuphazamisa. Ingabe lokho kwenza babheke ngasenyakatho mpumalanga? Izindawo zokufika kwezindiza ezivela kwamanye amazwe nasekhaya zazihlanganiswe ngokuphelele e-OR Tambo airport ngenyanga kaMeyi unyaka ozayo, lapho isikhungo esiyinhloko sokwakhiwa kwesikhumulo sezindiza sithola ukusebenza. Ngicela bonke abaphathi bezikole ukuthi basize ngokuba khona ezikoleni ngoMsombuluko. Umuntu onobubele oneminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili ophila eflethi ngaphansi kwami uhlale enginika izeluleko. Ukukhuthaza ukuhlinzekwa kabusha kwempahla ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokwabiwa kabusha kwempahla ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lokubala. Bonke amalungu bayahlonishwa ngob勇ness yabo nokuzinikela emsebenzini wabo. Ukungenelela kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kuMnotho Wesibili lapho iningi labantu bethu likhupha khona imali yokuphila. Noma iyiphi uphawu olusemthethweni kule nhlanganisela luzobekwa esisekelweni esakhiwe ngabaqondisi bezakhiwo abaqinisekisiwe. Iziphakamiso ezibhalwe phansi kuphela ezivela kumaphathi ezepolitiki ezibhalisiwe zizokwazi ukufaka amagama abakhankanyiweyo ukuze baphumelele. Ngifuna ukubonga bonke osomabhizinisi bethu abasebenza kanzima ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, futhi ikakhulukazi u-Anneowayeh ophatha ukuhlela konke lokhu. Uma unokwesekwa komqashi okuhlanganiswe nezikweletu, kuzodingeka ukuthi usekele imali ebhange elikubolekileyo. Amabhizinisi amane ezepolitiki azokwenza umncintiswano wezokhetho ezikhungweni zomthetho wesifunda kuphela kwenye noma ngaphezulu. Ukuqina komkhiqizo - ukuba nesibopho somkhiqizo kuyo yonke impilo yawo, kuhlanganise nokuba nesibopho sokulahla umkhiqizo njengodoti ngemuva kokuphuma. UChair, ngiqedile imibuzo yami mayelana noMnu. Cachalia. Lolu hlelo luzohlanganisa izicelo zokuxolelwa kulabo abantu abatholakele nezimo ezihlobene nezepolitiki, futhi ababephikiswa ngokuxolelwa ngu-TRC. Le ncwadi yolwazi oluqinile iqukethe imali evela kumabhange aseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuvela kulowo mnumzane owayekulowo komiti futhi wacelwa emakameleni kaMargo, futhi angifuni ukuphefumula ngalokho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izingxoxo nokubambisana nabo ngezindaba zomphakathi e-NEDLAC. INingizimu Afrika ikhethile umuntu ophatha umkhakha iminyaka emithathu. U-Dkt. Ramashala ungowokugcina ngaphambi kokuthi siye ekudleni. Sisenza ubufakazi obuphuma kuChief Justice Joubert. Izingxenye zeVitamin ngokuvamile zikhululwa ngokuya ngesisindo sokuhlanganiswa esisebenzayo futhi zibizwa ngokuthi i.i.u. Lokhu kuyinto eyodwa yezinto ezikhuthazayo kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwale ndlela yokuhamba komphakathi. Ukukhula okusheshayo
Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa Umbuzo 1: Yiziphi izinkinga ezivamile zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa? Impendulo: EMpumalanga Kapa, izibhedlela zibhekene nezinkinga eziningi zengqalasizinda. Okokuqala, kunenkinga yokuntuleka kwezinsiza kusebenza. Izibhedlela eziningi zinemishini endala futhi ethile ingasebenzi kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yezokwelapha. Okwesibili, kunenkinga yokuntuleka kwabasebenzi. Izibhedlela zihlala zibhekene nokuntuleka kwababhekelele iziguli, okukhathaza kakhulu njengoba lokhu kuholela ekutheni iziguli zingatholi usizo olufanele. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo? Impendulo: Izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zibhekene nezithiyo eziningi ezithinta ukuthola izinsiza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi khona kwemali eyanele yokuthenga imishini nezinye izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubo zokuthenga ezimaphakathi zihlala zibhakabhaka, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisheshayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izibhedlela zihlale zinesimo sokungabi nalutho, futhi iziguli zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga. Umbuzo 3: Ikuphi indawo yokuhlala iziguli ezidinga usizo? Impendulo: Iziguli ezidinga usizo zihlala zidinga indawo yokuhlala ehlinzekwa izibhedlela. Ngaphandle kokuhlala okuhle, iziguli zithola ukuthi kunzima ukuthola ukwelashwa okukhulu. Ezinye izibhedlela zikhona, kodwa zihlala zigcwele, futhi iziguli zidinga ukuma isikhathi eside ukuze zithole usizo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni iziguli zibe nezinhlobonhlobo zezinkinga, ezinjengokungakhathali nokukhungatheka. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela? Impendulo: Kukho izinhlelo eziningi ezikhona zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa. Uhulumeni usebenza ekwandiseni izinsiza, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zethimba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhulu kwabaphathi bezibhedlela, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Futhi, kukhona imikhankaso yokuxhumanisa izibhedlela ngezinsizakusebenza eziphumelelayo, okuyinto engasiza ekwandiseni ukutholakala kwezinsiza. Umbuzo 5: Yini umphakathi angayenza ukuze uthuthukise isimo? Impendulo: Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni isimo sezibhedlela. Okokuqala, abantu bangabamba iqhaza emikhankasweni yokwazisa abantu mayelana nezidingo zezibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo nezempilo yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ungabamba izandla nezinhlangano ezizimele ukuze kube nokuxhaswa kwezinsiza, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Umbuzo 6: Yini edinga ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lezokwelapha? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lezokwelapha, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubo bonke abasebenzi bezempilo. Ukuthuthukisa ingqondo yokusebenza nezinqubo zokuqapha kungase kube nomthelela omuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezokwelapha. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa? Impendulo: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa kuzoletha izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, iziguli zizothola ukufinyelela okukhululekile ezinsizeni zokwelapha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukwelashwa, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela ezithuthukisiwe zizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ekwelapheni iziguli, okuholela ekwehleni kwezifo nezifo ezithathelwana. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholwa kwezinye izifunda? Impendulo: Ezinye izifunda ziye zaba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphathwa kwezibhedlela, ezifanele ukuthathwa njengesibonelo. Izifundo ezitholakalayo zifaka phakathi ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezibhedlela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, nokwakha izinhlelo ezihambisanayo zokuthuthukiswa kwezokwelapha. Lezi zifundo zingasiza eMpumalanga Kapa ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngezindaba zempilo yomphakathi? Impendulo: Izindaba zempilo yomphakathi zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Umphakathi kumele uqonde izidingo zabo ezithinta impilo, futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezithinta impilo. Ukuze lokhu kuzuzwe, kudingeka ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezibhedlela, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungathola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise isimo sezibhedlela. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezizayo? Impendulo: Izinyathelo ezizayo zibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza, ukwandisa iqembu labaphathi, kanye nokwakha imikhankaso yokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuthola izibhedlela ezisebenzayo, ezikhona, nezihlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinsizeni zezemidlalo nezempilo eMpumalanga Kapa. Isiphetho: Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zidinga ukuba zixazululwe ngokubambisana. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, umphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kuzokwenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezibhedlela, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yeziguli. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni isibhedlela esihlala sihlanganyela, esinempumelelo, nesikhona.
Ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo (CASS) kumele kube ingxenye yokufundisa nokufunda futhi kumele kusetshenziswe ezindaweni zokufunda. Umfundi ngeke anikezwe umphumela uma uphawu lwakhe lwe-CASS lungekho. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ifomu lokumemezela (Appendix A) kumele liphothulwe futhi lisayinwe ngombili umfundi kanye neNhloko yeSikhungo. INhloko yeSikhungo kumele iqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi banephuzu le-CASS eduze kwamagama abo kumakhasi wezimpawu, noma incwadi echazayo uma kungekho uphawu olubhalwe, ngaphambi kokuthumela ama-portfolio ku-ABET District Support. Abaphathi be-ABET Centre bazohlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze basebenzisane futhi babelane ngemininingwane mayelana nekhuluma kanye nokuhlola. INhloko yeSikhungo kuyo yonke imikhakha kulindeleke ukuthi ihlanganise umbiko wokuthi i-ICASS iyaphumelela kanjani ezindaweni zokufunda zonke futhi ithumele lo mbiko ku-ABET District Support njalo ngenyanga. Abasebenzi be-ABET District Support kumele bahlanganise umbiko we-CASS besebenzisa imibiko efinyeziwe evela kubaphathi beSikhungo kanye nemibiko yokwesekwa nokuhlola kwezindawo zokufunda njengesisekelo. Umbiko we-CASS ohlanganisiwe kumele uthunyelwe ku-ABET District Support njengoba kukhombisiwe kuhlu lokuphathwa. Abafundi abangakapheli zonke izidingo mayelana ne-CASS kumele banikezwe uphawu. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimpawu kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imibhalo ibhalwe kahle. INhloko yeSikhungo kanye ne-ABET District Support kumele iqinisekise ukuthi ukucubungula ezingeni lesikhungo kwenzeka okungenani kanye nangesikhathi sokufunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindinganiso zokucubungula zesizwe nezwe zigcinwa. Abaphathi beSikhungo kumele bathumele amakhophi emakhasi wezimpawu asebenzayo ukuze baveze intuthuko eyenziwe ezindaweni zokufunda ezithuthukiswa ezikhungweni zabo ku-ABET District Support ngaphambi kosuku lwama-25 kuJulayi 2003. Uhlu lwamagama akhethiwe luzothunyelwa ezikhungweni ngomhla ka-14 kuAgasti 2003. Kuphela amakhasi wezimpawu anemibhalo eguquliwe azobuyiselwa ezikhungweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe. Izikhungo zingafaka izikhalazo uma zinganeliseki ngezimpawu ezitholiwe uma seziphumelele ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesikhalazo (Appendix D). Isikhalazo kumele sithunyelwe ku-ABET District Support phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili zokuthola ama-portfolio. Ukuhlola kuzohambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zomphakathi. Umhloli omkhulu kanye nokwesekwa kwezindawo zokufunda kuzokwazisa abacwaningi ngezindinganiso zokuhlola ezivumelwene emhlanganweni wokuhlola. Uma kukhona ukungavumelani ekuhumusheni phakathi kwale nguqulo eguquliwe nalokhu okuqondile, okuqondile kuzosisiza.
Ukulima nekusasa: kungani kuthatha isikhathi eside? Sizama ukuvuselela abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono ukuze babe abalimi abakwazi ukuziphilisa ngokwabo esikhathini esizayo. Ngoba isimo sezimali samanje emhlabeni sikhulu, lokhu kuzoba nzima - nokho, ungumuntu ophumelelayo. Uma ukulima eNingizimu Afrika kuzothuthuka, sidinga ukufezekisa uguquko oluphelele emhlabeni wezolimo ukuze sikwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezivamile. Ukulima akulula; abalimi babhekana nezinto eziningi futhi kwesinye isikhathi bazibeka engozini. Amanani aphansi ezimpahla zokudla enza kube nzima kubalimi ukwenza inzuzo ezimpahleni zabo. Izinga lenzalo liphezulu futhi izindleko zemishini ziphakamisa. Abalimi abanamakhono kwezomnotho nabo babhekana nezinselelo (bakhathazekile!) - singakusho ukuthini ngalabo abasanda kuvela? Uhulumeni angabasiza kanjani? Njengamanje, ukukhiqiza izimpahla zokudla ukuze uthole inzuzo kunzima; abalimi abasanda kuvela kungenzeka bangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokulima esikhathini esizayo. Sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha; amanani ez food azophakama futhi. Kodwa okwamanje, sidinga ukweseka abalimi ngezimali, njengezikhwama - ukusiza ngezindleko zokuqala zokutshala noma ukuhlinzeka ngama-bonuses ezimpahleni ezikhiqiziwe. Le mikhankaso izoqinisekisa ukuthi labo abasebenza kanzima bazothola ama-bonuses - lokhu kuzosiza abalimi abanamakhono ukuba babe nezomnotho eziphumelelayo. Enye inkinga enkulu isimo semishini nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa abalimi abasanda kuvela - sidinga isisekelo sezimali ukusiza abalimi ukulungisa imishini yabo. Kunengxenye yezigaba zohulumeni ezihlinzeka ngempahla nemishini kubalimi. Lokhu kungasiza ngesikhathi esifushane, kodwa labo abalimi kudingeka baqeqeshwe ukuze baphathe le mishini kahle. Lapho imishini isetshenziswa ngamaqembu abantu, akekho ozothatha umthwalo wokuphatha - kaningi imishini iyashiywa inganakekelwa futhi ngokushesha iyaba unusable. Lo msebenzi awukwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Izikhungo ezabelana ngolwazi kufanele futhi ziqeqeshwe ukuze ziqhubeke nemisebenzi yazo ngempumelelo - kunezikhungo eziningi ezinjalo, futhi kufanele zikwazi ukusiza abalimi ezindaweni zokulima. Ingxenye yezinselelo abalimi abasanda kuvela abahlangabezana nazo ukufinyelela uxhaso lokuqala lokulima. Kuneziningi ezinomhlaba nezinsiza (mhlawumbe ezinye azisebenzi kahle), baqeqeshwe futhi baxhaswe, kodwa badinga imali. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakamisa - kuthatha R4,000 kuya ku-R5,000 ukutshala ihektare eyodwa. Ekuqaleni, sathokoziswa ukubona amabhizinisi ezolimo esiza abalimi abasanda kuvela ngoxhaso lokuqala, futhi kusekhona amabhizinisi ezolimo axhasa abalimi ukuze babe nezomnotho eziphumelelayo. Baxhasa abalimi ekulungiseni nasekuqondiseni izinsiza nemishini yabo. Kanjani kufanele kusetshenziswe abaqashi bezolimo? Ingxenye yezindlela zokuqala zokulima umhlaba wukusebenzisa abaqashi abakhulu. Lokhu sekwenziwe izikhathi eziningi, futhi kuthiwa umqashi uzosetshenziswa kuphela ekuqaleni, ekugcineni umlimi uzosebenza ngokwabo. Umlimi akatholi inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza nemishini. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ziya zanda. Imali ekhokhwa ukuze uthole umqashi ingasetshenziswa ukulungisa nokugcina izinsiza nemishini. Abalimi abangasebenzi nomqashi, ngakho-ke, abafundi ukusebenza ngokwabo. Isimo sezulu esomile ezindaweni eziningi lapha senza isikhathi sokutshala, ukusika, nokuvuna sibe mfushane; kaningi umsebenzi awenziwa ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi umlimi ulahlekelwa umkhiqizo wabo (ukutshala nokufaka umanyolo sekwephuzile). Umqashi ukhokhelwa ngehektare elitshaliwe, hhayi ngokusekelwe kumgangatho womsebenzi wabo - noma umlimi enza inzuzo noma cha, umqashi uthola ukukhokhelwa kwabo. Kukhona abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakhiqiza futhi banemithombo. Laba abalimi kufanele bakwazi ukuqasha izinkambu kubanye abanikazi bomhlaba abangafuni noma abangakwazi ukulima. Njengamanje, izindawo eziningi zikhishwa ngama-agribusinesses, ngakho-ke abanye abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakwazi ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Lapho kukhona abalimi abangenazo izinsiza, kuthiwa bazokwazi ukwenza inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza. Kodwa lokhu akukwenzeka - inzuzo etholakalayo ekulimaleni kwezimpahla zokudla incane kakhulu, futhi abaqashi baphinde banciphise inzuzo. Bonke abasebenza ekulimaleni kufanele babe nesivumelwano sokuxhasa abalimi. Abalimi bafuna ukusebenza ngokwabo; abafuni ukuba balimwe abanye. Nika umlimi ithuba lokuqala ukulima ngalokho abanakho - ukuqala ngezimpahla ezincane endaweni encane akubeki ingozi enkulu. (Khumbula ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukulima emhlabeni wabo usuphila kule ndawo. Uma bengakwazi ukwenza inzuzo encane kuphela ngaphezu kwalokho ababephila kukho, kungabasiza kakhulu. Ngokusebenza kanzima, lowo mlimi uzokhula ekulimaleni). Ungacindezeli umlimi ukuba aqashe umqashi; kungcono ukusiza ukuwulungisa imishini yabo futhi balime ngokwabo ngalokho abanakho - mhlawumbe kungcono kubo ukuqasha izinkambu abangakwazi ukuziphatha. Ukusebenza nomuntu onolwazi (umqeqeshi) kuzosisiza kakhulu - kodwa umqeqeshi kufanele akhethwe ngokucophelela! Kumele kube umuntu ozinikele ofuna ukusiza umlimi akhule - ozothatha isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono futhi abaxhase. Kumele bahlangane futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye ngempumelelo. Hlinzeka abalimi ngemininingwane futhi ungathathi izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuhlangana nabo. Kuthiwa - asifuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu - futhi kufanele kube njalo lapha. Ukuxhasa abalimi ngokuhlola nokunquma zonke izimpahla zabo ezisemhlabeni, izinkambu, izinsiza, imishini, izinkomo, izitshalo, nezinye izinsiza, njll. Kumele baqonde kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani ekulimaleni. Isibonelo: bangaki kW (amandla) umlimi adinga ukuze alime izinkambu ezithile? Qinisekisa ukuthi umlimi ungene ohlelweni oluzomfundisa futhi luthuthukise. Ukuba umlimi ophumelelayo kwezomnotho kuthatha isikhathi, futhi kunezinhlangano eziningi ezingasiza ekuthuthukiseni abalimi. Hlola isimo sokuqeqeshwa esinikezwa. Kukhona abaqeqeshi abaqashwe abangenzi kahle ngoba nabo baphuthuma amakhono okusebenza (awukwazi ukufunda ukulima ngokufunda kuphela izincwadi!). Qinisekisa ukuthi ungasiqali ngephrojekthi enkulu kakhulu. Abalimi abasanda kuvela badinga isikhathi nokuxhaswa; uma iphrojekthi ikhula kakhulu, izinto ziba nzima, futhi konke kuwa. Kungaba kuhle ukuxhasa abalimi abangama-50 noma ngaphezulu (ekuqaleni), kodwa kaningi lokhu kuwa ngoba kungekho izandla ezanele zokwenza umsebenzi. Kungcono ukuqala ngabalimi abangama-15 - 20 bese wandisa inani ngonyaka.
Izivumelwano Zokufinyelela Kosonkontileka Besithathu (GEMS Third-Party Contractor Access Agreements) Ngaphakathi komhlaba wezokwakha, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezinsiza, lapho izinkampani zidinga ukuxhumana nezinkampani zangaphandle ukuze zifeze izinjongo zazo. Izivumelwano zokufinyelela, ezaziwa ngokuthi "GEMS third-party contractor access agreements," zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokusebenza phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene, nakuba zikhona nezinselelo ezithile. Uhlaka lwezivumelwano luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zivumelwano zidinga ukucacisa izimo zokufinyelela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, osonkontileka besithathu kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi bangafinyelela kuphi, ngesikhathi esingakanani, nokuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zifaneleka kanjani. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho ukuphazamiseka emsebenzini, futhi zonke izinhlangothi ziyakwazi ukuhambisana nemigomo ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izivumelwano zidinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kubandakanya izinsiza zemali, izinsiza zabantu, nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe. Ukucacisa lokhu kuzosiza ekugwemeni ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezinkampani, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokusebenza. Ukuze kube nokuhlalisana okuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi osonkontileka besithathu baqonde kahle izinsiza abazitholayo, kanye nezibopho zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivumelwano zokufinyelela zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo yokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imininingwane ethintwayo iphephile. Osonkontileka besithathu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi kufanele bakhumbule izinqubomgomo zokuphepha, futhi bahlale beqaphela izingozi ezingase zibe khona. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, izivumelwano kumele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile ezichaza izinyathelo zokuphepha ezidingekayo. Ngokubheka izinhlelo zokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi izivumelwano zokufinyelela zibe nezinqubo zokuhlola. Lokhu kuzosiza ekutholeni ukuthi osonkontileka besithathu bayahlangabezana yini nezimfuneko ezibekiwe. Ukuhlola kufanele kube yinto ejwayelekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokuhambisana nemigomo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivumelwano zokufinyelela zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zisesikhathini nezinguquko ezisemkhakheni wezinsiza. Ukuvuselelwa kwezivumelwano kuzohlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Ekugcineni, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu ziwumgogodla wokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani. Zihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokusebenza, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokuhambisana nemigomo. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi osonkontileka besithathu baqonde kahle izimfuneko, futhi bahlale beqaphela izingozi ezingase zibe khona. Ngale ndlela, izivumelwano zokufinyelela zizosiza ekwakheni umnotho onempilo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani zikhula ngokuhlanganyela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuzodingeka ukuthi lezi zivumelwano zihlale zisesikhathini, futhi zihlale zifaneleka emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo wezinsiza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana, ukuze zifeze izinjongo zazo. Izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu, uma zisetshenziswa kahle, zingaba yinsika eqinile yokuphumelela emkhakheni wezinsiza.
Uma uhlela ukuthengisa izinkomo zakho emakethe, zibuze lo mbuzo: Kungani ngifuna ukuthengisa izinkomo zami kulolu suku? Izilwane zilungile ukuhamba emakethe futhi zikhulisiwe kahle ukuze zihlabe. Zineminyaka efanele yokuthengwa yilabo abafuna ukuzikhulisa ukuze zihlabe. Izilwane azikwazi ukwenza inzuzo, ikakhulukazi uma zingama-nyama amadala okuzala angasakhiqizi. Akukho ukudla okukhona epulazini ukuze kudle izinkomo. Khetha umhlambi oneminyaka yokuzala bese uthengisa abanye ngaphambi kokuba babe sebekhulile kakhulu noma baphathe izindleko eziphezulu. Izinkomba zokuhlela zitholakala ngokulandela iminyaka, ukukhula kwesisindo, isimo, ukujolisa, kanye nobulili. Ungalindela kuphela intengo enhle yezilwane eziphilile, ikakhulukazi uma zisezigabeni A noB, zingabi mncane kakhulu noma zibe nkulu kakhulu futhi ziqondiswe kahle. I-AB inikeza inani lentengo eliphansi kanti i-C iyona ephansi kakhulu. Ngokulandela imithetho, isimo se-carcass yezilwane sihlolwe futhi sichaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwenyama namathambo. Isimo sokuhlola senziwa ngokuhlola ukujolisa kwezinkomo. Izigaba ziqukethwe ngokuhlola amazinyo. Ubulili bezilwane buwumqondo obalulekile ezilwaneni zokuzala nasemathanjeni ezinkomo ezisemazingeni AB, B, kanye ne-C. Ukuhlola: Ukuhlola iminyaka yezinkomo ngokuhlola amazinyo. Izigaba B: Kusukela eminyakeni engu-2½ kuya kwengu-3 (kuhlonishwa ngokuba khona kwemazinyo okukhanda nokuba namazinyo okukhanda angu-3 kuya kwangu-6). Izigaba C: Amazinyo aphukile futhi aphukile ezilwaneni ezindala.
Ibhola Lombhoxo: Uhlanga Oluhlukile Lokudlalwa Kwezemidlalo Ibhola lombhoxo, noma i-rugby, luhlobo lwezemidlalo oluthokozisa inhliziyo nezithakazelo zabantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Njengoba uhamba emazweni ahlukahlukene, uzothola iziteshi ezilungiselelwe umphakathi, izinkundla zokudlalela, nezinhlangano ezikhandlayo zokuqhakambisa lesi sikhathi esithe xaxa. Nokho, ukuzibandakanya kwebhola lombhoxo kuwukuhluka okukhulu uma siqhathanisa neminye imidlalo, njengoba kudinga isimo esikhethekile sokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuqina. Kuyinto ejwayelekile ukusho ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo linyusa umoya wokubambisana. Esikhathini esithile, imidlalo ibonisa ukuthi kusemthethweni ukuhamba phambili, ukulwa, nokufinyelela emaphusheni. Kulabo abakhuthele emkhakheni wezokudlalela, kuyinto yokwakha futhi yokuxhumana, njengoba abadlali bahlala behlangene, bejolise ethimbeni. Okwamanje, abaphakanyisi bemidlalo benza imizamo eqhubekayo yokuthuthukisa isithakazelo kulaba abancane. Lokhu kusebenza kwenziwa ngokubandakanya izikole, izikhungo, kanye nemithombo yabantu, okwenza umphakathi uzizwe unozwelo nolwaziyo. Ngizokubona kuhle ukufundisa izingane ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo akusekho nje ukukhangwa kwelukuluku, kodwa kuyinsiza eqhubekayo yokwakha izimiso zempilo. Ubuqu, ngithanda ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo linomqondo ohlukile wokuhlala kude nemiphumela engase ibe yingozi yokuphikisana kwezinsiza noma ukungqubuzana okuholela emiphumeleni emibi. Kukhona amathuba okuba imidlalo ihlukaniswe phakathi kwezinsizi, emathubeni, kanye nemiphakathi. Abadlali badinga ukuhlela, balandele imithetho, futhi bahlale bejolise emiphumeleni yabo, ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela. Singenza kumodi eyinhloko yokuhlalisana kwempilo, esebenza kahle kanjalo, nokuhloniphana kwamabhola. Mina, ngizizwa ngithokoziswa kakhulu ngezakhiwo ezitholakala kubadlali abasha, ikakhulukazi ngaholo ngosuku lokugcina lwezilingo. Kuhlukile ukuthi ibhola lombhoxo liziphendukela kanjani uma lihlala lidlalwa ngokuzikhandla neqiniso. Abafana nabesifazane bahlala bejabulile, bezama ukuveza amakhono abo phambi kwabathandi, bahlala bejolise ekhanda emiphumeleni. Izici zokubambisana, ukuhlanganiswa, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabo zikhona lusizo lokwazi umphumela wezokugcina. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yamandla, ibhola lombhoxo linethezekile kakhudlwana phakathi kwelanga lokuhlukunyezwa. Abadlali benza umkhankaso wokuvikela impilo yabo ngokuzikhandla, bawela ukhayanda kuzona zonke izimfuno zokuphila. Lokhu akubalulekile kuphela emiphakathini yamahlaya, kodwa futhi kuhlomula kuwo wonke umuntu odlalayo, ngaleso sikhathi besebenzisa imizamo yabo ibe nomthelela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ibhola lombhoxo liwumnotho obalulekile, ugqozi lokusungula ukwaziswa nokulungele, kanti lesi sikhala singase sibe yindlela yokukhuthaza nokuqinisa imiphakathi. Abaphathiswa bezemidlalo bagxile ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa umphakathi, bakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa izifundo, kanye nokuqinisa ukuzimela kumphakathi. Ngakho, ibhola lombhoxo akukhona ukuthokozisa alone, kodwa kuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza izinzuzo eziningi emiphakathini. Ngokuqhubekayo, uma sifuna ukuhlola ibhola lombhoxo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi yizingcweti zabantu, ikakhulukazi abasafufusa, ezenza sikwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizayo. Uhlanga okukholwa yinsakavukela, futhi lokho kuyisithako esingafeni njengoko belingakhononda. Ngakho, ibhola lombhoxo alikhumbuli, kodwa likhulisa imbiza yama-spirits, livenza sithokoze. Ekupheleni, ibhola lombhoxo liphila phakathi kwezinkunzi ezinamandla, nokuveza imiphumela eyindlala kumphakathi. Kuhle ngesikhathi sethu, ukuba sizigcine sonke, sizihlanganyele, futhi sikhankase ngabobonke. Abadlali, abathandi, nabaphakanyisi badinga ukukhuthaza umoya wokudlalela, ukunqa izinselelo, nokuqhubeka ngekapa lesi sikhathi. Ibhola lombhoxo iyinsika eyingqayizivele yokuhlangana komphakathi, ubudlelwano, kanye namakhono avusa umoya, kanti iqhubeka nokuhola kuzo zonke izindawo ezinhle zokuphila.
Izinselelo Zokungcoliswa Kwamaminerali eGauteng Isingeniso EGauteng, okuyisifunda esiyinhloko somnotho eNingizimu Afrika, kubonakala isimo esinzima sokungcoliswa kwemvelo, okukhathaza kakhulu ngenxa yemisebenzi yokumba amalahle nezinsimbi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu kule ndawo yi-acid mine drainage (AMD), okuyinto evezwa ngokuphuma kwegazi elinobungozi ezindaweni zokumba. Le miphumela ibangela ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, okuthinta izinhlelo zokuphila, ezolimo, kanye nezinsiza zokuhamba. Ukuchaza i-Acid Mine Drainage I-Acid mine drainage iwukuphuma kwamanzi anokungcoliswa okukhulu, okuvame ukwenzeka lapho amalahle noma izinsimbi zikhishwa. Lezi zinsiza zisebenzelana ne-oxygen nemithombo ethile, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-asidi. Lokhu kwenza amanzi abe ne-pH ephansi, okwenza kube nzima ukuba khona kwezinto eziphilayo. E-Gauteng, lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi ezihlobene nokumba, njenge-Randburg, Soweto, nase-Ekurhuleni. Izimpawu Zokungcoliswa I-Acid mine drainage iboniswa ngezimpawu ezithile. Amanzi aphuma ezindaweni zokumba abe ne-pH ephansi, avame ukuba nezinhlayiya ezimnyama, futhi angaba ne-iron, aluminium, kanye nezinye izinto ezinzima. Lokhu kungcoliswa kudala izinkinga ezinkulu emithonjeni yamanzi, okuthinta izitshalo, izilwane, kanye nabantu. Imiphumela Emibi I-Acid mine drainage inemiphumela emibi eminingi. Okokuqala, ikhona ingozi yokungcoliswa kwemithombo yamanzi angaphansi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, okuholela ezinkingeni zokuphila kwabantu. Okwesibili, izitshalo ezithintekayo ziba nezinselelo zokukhula, okuthinta imiphakathi ethile. Izinselelo Zokulawula Ukulawula i-acid mine drainage kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kudinga ukuhlola okuqhubekayo kwemithombo yamanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ayithinteki. Lokhu kuzodinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinyanga zomphakathi, ezokuphatha, kanye nezinkampani ezisebenza ezindaweni zokumba. Okwesibili, kudinga izinhlelo zokuhlanzwa amanzi angcolile ukuze abuyiselwe emithonjeni yamanzi. Izixazululo Zokubhekana Nezinkinga Ukuze kube neziphakamiso eziphumelelayo, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubhekana ne-acid mine drainage, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukusebenza Nezindawo Zokumba: Izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izinqubo ezihlanzekile zokumba ukuze zinciphise ukungcoliswa. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinqubomgomo: Uhulumeni kumele athuthukise izinqubomgomo ezibhekene ne-acid mine drainage, kuhlanganisa nezindlela zokulawula, ukuhlola, nokubika. 3. Ukubambisana Nomphakathi: Umphakathi kufanele ube nengxenye ezinhlelweni zokulawula ukungcoliswa, ukuze kube nokwaziswa nokubambisana. 4. Ukwandisa Imfundo: Kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze baqonde imiphumela yokungcoliswa. Isiphetho I-Acid mine drainage iyinselelo enkulu eGauteng, enezimpawu ezimbi ezithinta imithombo yamanzi, izitshalo, nezilwane. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, izinkampani, nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzovikela imithombo yethu yamanzi, kugcine impilo enhle, futhi kuthuthukise umnotho wesifunda. Ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina imvelo, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile eGauteng.
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqwa ngesikhathi yenziwa imisebenzi yayo yansuku zonke yokuhlanganisa imali yentela kuhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezintela zebhizinisi ezisiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zinhlelo. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, abangabakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, abancintisana namabhizinisi, abameli, kanye nabathengisi ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amaphrofithi akhishwa kwi-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokugcina ubufihlo bolwazi obuphethwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi mayelana nabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi luyimfihlo futhi alukwazi ukukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphuthumayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ubufihlo balolu lwazi, unikeza ukugcina kwalo njengobufihlo ngokuqondile, ngaphandle komuntu onelungelo lokuluthola noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukufinyelela kulolo lwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekana nobufihlo obuhlobene nokudluliswa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kudingeke. Lezi ziqephu ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti olwazi lwe-SARS, futhi uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS isungule umnyango owodwa wezicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandela nokuphendula ngaphakathi kwezikhathi ezibekwe umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nanoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingase zenzeke ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nesiko eligcizelelwa yi-SARS lokwenza izinto ngokucacile, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, kanye nokuziphatha kwe-SARS ngokuhlonipha, ubuqotho, nokwethembeka kulabo i-SARS ibambisana nabo. Umphakathi we-SARS nguMphakathi weMali yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMnu. Pravin Gordhan. Ngaphansi kwakhe kukhona abaphathi abane be-SARS, abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi oluphethwe yi-SARS njengokwenziwa komthetho nsuku zonke. Umphathi ngamunye unikezwe indawo ethile yokusebenza kuye ngokuqonda kwabo nolwazi lomsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo yokusebenza ngezinga labo nolwazi. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti aphethwe yi-SARS, kufanele uqedele ifomu eliku-Anexure 1 bese ulithumela kumphathi ofanele. Abaphathi basebenzisa ikheli le-ofisi kanye neposi elifanayo. Umphathi ofanele uzophendula phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 (60 ezimweni ezithile) ukuze akwazise ukuthi isicelo sakho siye savunywa noma saphikiswa. Ezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma ufike kumarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukucubungula isicelo sakho kungadlula amahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungiselela ulwazi oluceliwe ngemva kokukhokha imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela ocela ngayo noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwa ngayo kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho enye indlela ocela ngayo. Lokhu kuyiphephandaba lokuqala lemibhalo mayelana nokusebenza komthetho we-SARS ngokomthetho. Kuzothuthuka futhi kukhule njengoba i-SARS nabaceli bolwazi bephawula ngempumelelo yalomthetho, kanye nokulinganisa ilungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi namalungelo amanye anikezwa umthetho, njengokufihla, kanye nesidingo sokugcina uMbuso usebenza kahle. Imithetho ngaphansi kokuhlanganiswa kokuqala, amanothi achazayo, nezinye. Ulwazi lokuxhumana nabaphathi bomnyango. Ulwazi olutholakalayo ngaphandle kwesicelo. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo. Ukwenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho. Umhlahlandlela weKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu. Ukuqoqa izintela; nokulawula ukufika kwezimpahla ezweni, ezithunyelwa ngaphandle kwezwe, ezikhiqizwayo, ezithunyelwa, ezigcinwayo, futhi zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo. Umthetho ophatha intela yokuthengiswa kwezabelo (stocks), ka-1948. Umthetho ophatha ukuqoqa intela uma kudluliswa ubunikazi beMali ka-1949. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela kumali yokufela, ka-1955. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela kumholo nezindleko, ka-1962. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela ezimpahleni ezifaka nokuphuma ezweni, ka-1964. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela ngenani, ka-1991. Imithetho ehlukene ebhalwe kuSheduli 1 yomthetho ophatha i-South African Revenue Service, ka-1997. noma yimaphi umthetho, isikhumbuzo somthetho, isaziso sikahulumeni, noma umyalo ophumelele ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokuhlanganiswa kwentela noma ophatha ukuthunyelwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile ezingase zidluliselwe kwi-SARS ngokomthetho noma isivumelwano phakathi kwe-SARS nomnyango kahulumeni noma ibhodi efanele (njengokuhlanganiswa kwentela ngaphandle kokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinkokhelo ze-inshurensi yokungasebenzi). kanye konke okuhlobene nentela; namandla anikezwa uNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla; nokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha mayelana konke okuhlobene nokulawula ukuthunyelwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile. Inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngentela eqoqiwe ukuze ikhiqize izinzuzo ezibonakalayo, ukusiza ukuhweba nokwengeza kubakhokhi bentela ngokwethula abakhokhi bentela abasha ezincwadini ngokukhuthaza ukuqwashisa ngentela ukuze abantu bazi futhi babhekane nezibopho zabo zokweseka lo mnyango nemithetho yentela nezohwebo yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakeme olungakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nakuba i-SARS inomsebenzi wokubhala imithetho yentela, iyakwenza lokhu ngaphansi kokubhekwa nokuphathwa koNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, futhi kwesinye isikhathi uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha. Ngakho-ke, amadokhumenti akhishwe uMnyango Wezezimali kanye noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezokwakha ngokuhambisana nalomthetho kufanele abhekwane nokubhekwa komphakathi ekwakhiweni kwemigomo. Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu: Inkinga Ethinta Bonke Isimo sezulu emhlabeni sishintsha ngokushesha, futhi lokhu sekuyinkinga enkulu esibhekene nayo. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusikhulumi nje ngokunyuka kokushisa emhlabeni, kodwa futhi kuhlanganisa nezinguquko ezinkulu eziphathelene nemvula, izikhukhula, nezimo zokuphila kwezilwane nezitshalo. Lezi zinguquko zidalwa ikakhulukazi abantu, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon dioxide (CO2) nezinye izinto ezilimazayo emoyeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sikhulume ngale nkinga, sihlole izimbangela zayo, kanye nemiphumela ezoba nayo empilweni yethu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izimbangela zokuguquka kwesimo sezulu zikhona emithonjeni eminingi. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla, kanye nezimboni ezikhiqiza kakhulu zenza kube nokukhishwa okukhulu kwegesi ye-carbon. Lokhu kukhishwa kuholela ekwandeni kwegesi ye-greenhouse, okwenza umoya ushise kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo, njengokuhweba ngamafutha, kuveza ingozi enkulu emvelweni. Izimboni ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo eminingi zidinga amandla amaningi, okwandisa ukusabalala kwegesi eluhlaza. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ohlangene, lapho izenzo zethu zikhuphula izinkinga ezithinta isimo sezulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imiphumela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu ibonakala kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Izimo zezulu ezinzima, njengezikhukhula, izivunguvungu, nezomiso, zikhula njalo. Lokhu kuholela ekuhluphekeni kwabantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu, ezinjengase-Afrika nasemazweni asathuthuka. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezibhekene nezingozi ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo, izindlu, nezinsiza zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilwane nezitshalo zihlushwa yizinguquko ezinkulu ezimweni zazo zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlala. Ngokubheka lezi zimo, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela isimo sezulu. Ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa imiphumela yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu, kudingeka ukuthi sishintshe indlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, ukusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokukhiqiza ezihlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze imiphakathi yethu ukuba ibambe iqhaza ekulweni nale nkinga, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikelwa kokuphila kwethu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokunciphisa imiphumela. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokulawula izimo zezulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuvikela ezindaweni ezibhekene nezingozi, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphila ezimeni ezinzima, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Uma singenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuvikela imiphakathi yethu, izilwane, nezitshalo ezithinteka kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusikho okwenziwa yizizwe ezithile kuphela, kodwa kuyinkinga yomhlaba wonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi amazwe ahlanganyele ukuze abhekane nale nkinga. Ukuhlela imihlangano yamazwe omhlaba, njengokuhlangana kwe-Paris Climate Agreement, kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzovumela amazwe ukuthi abambisane, ahlanganyele izinsiza, futhi athole izindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akuyona nje inkinga yesikhathi eside, kodwa futhi kuyinkinga esidinga izixazululo eziphuthumayo. Njengoba izimo zezulu ziqhubeka zishintsha, kufanele sibe nesibindi sokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ikusasa elingcono. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani, ukuqonda, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwethu sonke. Ekugcineni, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa kwethu. Njengabantu, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo, sishintshe indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nale nkinga. Uma singenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuvikela imvelo, izilwane, nezitshalo, futhi sigcine impilo yethu. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhona nje okuthinta izwe, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta wonke umuntu. Ngakho-ke, akusikho isikhathi sokubheka phansi, kodwa isikhathi sokusebenza ndawonye ukuze sakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Izilimi Nezinguqulo Ngiyavuma ukuthi izilimi ziwumhlaba omkhulu, futhi zikhangisa izinkulumo eziningi. Njengoba sikhuluma, siyabona ukuthi izilimi zihluke kakhulu futhi zinezici ezithokozisayo. Ucabanga ukuthi emhlabeni jikelele, kukhona izilimi ezingaphezu kwengu-7,000? Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma uhamba, ungahlangana nezilimi ezahlukene, okwenza kube mnandi. Izilimi zikhuluma ngempilo yethu. Ziyindlela yokuxhumana, zikhuluma ngezinto esizithokozelayo, izinkolelo, namasiko ethu. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sikhuluma ngesiZulu, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu nezinkanyezi zethu. Ngokuphambene, uma sikhuluma ngesiNgisi, sithola izindlela ezahlukene zokubona izinto, ngoba lezi zilimi zinezinhloso ezihlukene. Akukhona nje ukukhuluma, kodwa kukhona futhi umqondo wezinguqulo. Ukuhumusha izilimi kuyinselele enkulu. Ukuhumusha akusikhona ukufaka amagama kuphela, kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwamasiko nezinkolelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umyalezo ufinyelele kahle, ungashintshi umqondo. Umhumushi omuhle kufanele akwazi ukuqonda kahle izilimi zombili, ukuze akwazi ukuhumusha kahle. Umhumushi kufanele futhi abe nekhono lokubona izimo ezithile ukuze akwazi ukuhumusha ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma umhumushi engakwazi ukuhumusha kahle, umyalezo ungashintsha ngokuphelele. Uma sikhuluma ngesiZulu, sikhuluma ngamasiko ethu, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngesiNgisi, sithola umbono omusha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izilimi zikhuluma ngezinto ezahlukene, futhi umhumushi ophumelelayo usinika ithuba lokuxhumana ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilimi ziya zishintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bahlala bephila ngezindlela ezahlukene futhi bexhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izilimi zishintsha, umhumushi kufanele ajwayele lezi zinguquko. Izilimi eziningi ziba nezinguquko ngenxa yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, okuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene zokubona izinto. Ngamafuphi, izilimi zikhuluma ngezinto ezithile, futhi umhumushi ophumelelayo usinika ithuba lokuxhumana ngempumelelo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kudala izinguquko, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi umhumushi akwazi ukujwayela lezi zinguquko ukuze siqhubeke sithola izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokubona izinto.
Imvume yokudlulisela yenkampani inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle odluliselwa inkampani yakhe ukuze asebenze kwi-affiliate yayo eNingizimu Afrika. Isikhathi semvume yokudlulisela yenkampani sithatha iminyaka emibili. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Qedela ifomu le-BI-1738. Thola incwadi evela kwinkampani yomhlaba wonke eqinisekisa ukuthi uzodluliselwa kwi-branch yenkampani eNingizimu Afrika, noma kwi-affiliate yenkampani eNingizimu Afrika. Thola incwadi evela kwenkampani yaseNingizimu Afrika eqinisekisa ukuthi udluliselwa kuyo evela kwinkampani yayo enkulu noma kwi-affiliate yayo yangaphandle, kanye nokuchazwa kwezinhlobo zomsebenzi ozowenza kanye nezinga noma isikhundla ozosebenza kuso. Cela umqashi ofuna ukukuhola ukuthi aqedele ingxenye 13 yefomu le-BI-1738. Faka incwadi evela kumphakathi wezincwadi ezivunyelwe okhulumela umqashi echaza isidingo sokukuhola nokuchaza izinhlobo zomsebenzi ozowenza. Faka incwadi evela kumphakathi wezincwadi ezivunyelwe ethi awusoze waholwa ukuze usebenze ngaphansi kwezimo nezimo ezisebenzayo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezakhamizi ezihlala njalo, nokuthi unazo iziqu ezidingekayo zomsebenzi. Nikeza ubufakazi bokubhaliswa nenhlangano yobungcweti noma ibhodi uma kudingeka. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.
