Uphatha kahle futhi kubonakala ukuthi uWilliam uyazi kahle ukuthi kulima okuzinzile nokukhiqizayo kusho ukuthini. Uhlanganyela kahle nabanye abalimi abafana naye futhi uyabonga ochwepheshe bezamabhizinisi ezolimo abamsizile eminyakeni edlule epulazini lakhe. UPhilip ungumlimi ophumelelayo - wazalwa epulazini ngonyaka ka-1952 futhi okuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe kokuqala bekungokwezilwane nezitshalo. UPhilip waqala ukulima ngo-1973 njengomshayeli we-tractor futhi kamuva walima noSenwes iminyaka eyishumi. UPhilip washada noJulia futhi nakuba uJulia engumfundisi eKgotsong eduze kweBothaville, ubamba iqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yokulima lapho esiza khona uPhilip kakhulu. UPhilip ungumnikazi wepulazi elibizwa ngokuthi uTweespruit elingamakhilomitha angama-5 ukusuka eKgotsong. Akahlali epulazini kodwa izilwane zakhe ziphathwa ngabasebenzi bakhe ababili abaphephile abahlala lapho. UPhilip uqede ibanga lesi-3 kuphela esikoleni, kodwa kubonakala kahle ukuthi lo muntu akavumi ukuncishiswa ukungabi neziqu eziphakeme - uyazi kahle ukuthi kulima kusho ukuthini futhi ulima ngempumelelo. Uthanda ama-tractors futhi ugcina zonke ama-tractors nemishini yakhe ngokuzikhandla. UPhilip ungum member weKgotsong agricultural group futhi uthatha ingxenye ezinhlelweni eziningi zokuqeqeshwa, njenge: Ukuqeqeshwa kokulima okuzinzile kanye ne-soybeans; Ukuphathwa kwe-tractor nemishini epulazini; Ukuqeqeshwa oku

Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni (AI in public administration) Ngonyaka ka-2023, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) busezintweni eziningi ezemukelwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kuhulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezihlukene ze-AI ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emisebenzini yokuphatha, ukuphendula izidingo zabantu, nokwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo nezifanele. Uhlelo lwezempilo, izinsiza zomphakathi, nezinhlelo zokubika kudala kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Uhlelo lwe-AI lusebenzisa ubuciko bokufunda ngomshini ukuze kutholakale ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe, oluphendula izidingo ezithile zomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa i-AI zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngempilo yomphakathi, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsiza zempilo. Izinhlelo ze-AI zisebenza kahle ekuphatheni idatha enkulu. Uhulumeni ungenza izinqumo ezinhle ngokusebenzisa le datha, okuholela ekwenzeni izinhlelo eziphathelene nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ezinhlelweni ezifana nezokuhlola izinga lokuhlala, ukukala izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziyisisekelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo ze-AI zisebenza kahle ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngokuqondisa izinsiza ezikhona ngempumelelo. Ukuhlaziywa kwedatha okwenziwa yi-AI kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ziqhuba ngendlela efanele, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zitholakala ezindaweni ezidingekayo. Ukwenza kahle kwe-AI kuhulumeni akuphathelene kuphela nezinsizwa zomphakathi kodwa futhi kusiza ekwandiseni izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwesikhumbuzo. Uhlelo lwezokukhiqiza, kulapho uhulumeni nesehlakalo sokuhamba kwezinsiza besebenzisa i-AI ukuze kuthuthukiswe imikhiqizo, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni bukhoma ukuze kusetshenziswe izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezindaweni eziningi. Ukwenqatshwa kwemikhawulo yokwakhiwa izifundazwe emhlabeni jikelele kuboniswe kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinhlelo ze-AI zikhuthaza izinyathelo zokwakha umnotho. Umsebenzi wokwakha izikhumbuzo ubonisa indlela i-AI engakwazi ngayo ukuqondisa izinsizakusebenza ezithile, kubandakanya imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa izindawo eziphathelene nezekhulu lemiphakathi. Naphezu kokuba nezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuhulumeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza ngezindlela ezisemthethweni nezichaphazela wonke umuntu. Ukuphathwa kwedatha, ukuqondisa mqoka, kanye nezimiso zokuqonda – zonke lezi zinto kufuneka zibe ngempela ukuze ukusebenzisa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni kube yimpumelelo. Ukuphendula izinkinga eziphakeme zomphakathi kudinga ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihambelana nazo. Uhulumeni kumele athole izindlela zokucwaninga ezinyukwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaphuzu afanele achazwe kahle nge-AI. Lokhu kubalulekile ekugcineni ukwakhiwa okusebenzayo nokusheshayo kwezinhlelo zempilo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi theleka ubudlelwano obubambekayo phakathi komphakathi nomphakathi. Ukwaneliseka komphakathi kube yisona sikhumbuzo esihle sokuqinisekisa ukuthi i-AI iyathuthukiswa. Ukuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka komphakathi futhi kutholakale izimpawu ezithile ezizokwandisa ukusebenza kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi nabaholi bobuhlakani ukuze kudaleke izixazululo ezinhle nezinzile. Ekugcineni, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa kuhulumeni buphehlwa ikakhulukazi emisebenzini emikhulu yokuphatha, kodwa kuhlanganisa nezinye izici ezibalulekile ezifana nezindawo zomphakathi nezinsiza ezithile. Ukuze ube nohlelo oluphilayo nolwakha umphakathi, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela efanele, esebenzisayo ukuze ihlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile emqoka. Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhamba phambili emhlabeni jikelele, futhi buphendula izidingo zomphakathi ngakusasa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuqonda ubuchwepheshe besimanje kanye nezinsiza zokuphila ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela ezayo izoba yinhle kwiNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele.
Ama-Social Media: Iziphumo Zokuxhumana Kwabesifazane Nezizinda Zokubambisana Kuze kube manje, izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Lokhu kubandakanya ama-platforms afana no-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, neTikTok, okuyizindawo lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nolwazi. Lezi zinkundla zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, zengeza umhlaba wethu ngamasiko nezinkolelo ezihlukahlukene. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-social media anemiphumela emihle, kodwa futhi anemiphumela emibi engaletha izinkinga. Okokuqala, ama-social media akha amathuba okuxhumana. Ngalezi zinkundla, abantu bangahlala bexhumene, noma ngabe bekhulu-khulu. Lokhu kubalulekile kubantu abahlala kude, abavela emindenini ehlukene, noma abaphakathi kwemiphakathi eyeqisayo. Isibonelo, abesifazane nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezincane bangasebenzisa ama-social media ukuze babelane ngemicabango, babelane ngezifundo, futhi baxhumane nabanye abesifazane abaphumelelayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhekeni kwemithombo yokwesekwa, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola izixazululo nezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media anikeza indawo yokwabelana ngolwazi. Abantu bangashicilela izifundo zabo, imisebenzi, nezifiso, okuvumela abanye ukuba bathole izifundo ezithokozisayo noma izimvo ezingabathuthukisa. Lokhu kuphinde kuvule amathuba okudala, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukudala okuqukethwe okusha, bephinde benze imihlangano yokubambisana, okukhuthaza ubuciko nemikhuba emisha. Ngokuvamile, lokhu kudala umkhankaso wezinto ezintsha ezithokozisayo ezithokozisa umphakathi. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-social media angase abe nemiphumela emibi. Ukuqhamuka kwegciwane lokuqhathaniswa, lapho abantu beqhathanisa impilo yabo nabanye, kubangela ukuzenqaba kwabanye, ikakhulukazi abesifazane. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, njengoba abantu bezama ukufanisa izithombe ezinkulu zempilo enempilo ezitholakala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Abesifazane baphinde babhekane nezithombe ezikhaliphile, okukhuthaza imicabango yokuthi kumele babe ne-‘ukubukeka okuhle’ ukuze bahlonishwe. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola ukuzethemba nokwaneliseka. Okwamanje, ama-social media akhuthaza ukuxhumana, kodwa futhi akhombisa umfanekiso ophambene. Abantu bangathola injabulo, kodwa baphinde babhekane nosizi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudingeka ukuba sibe nekhono lokukhumbula ukuthi, nakuba sithola izinzuzo eziningi, kufanele sibe nesineke nezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga ezivela. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ekuphatheni impilo yethu yezenhlalo. Ekuqedeni, ngicabanga ukuthi ama-social media ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuxhumana kwethu, kodwa adinga ukuphathwa ngokucophelela. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezindlela zokuziphatha ezifanele lapho sisebenzisa lezi zinkundla. Uma sikhuluma ngabesifazane, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuzethemba kwabo kuxhomeke kulokho abakubonayo, futhi ukuziphatha kwethu kuncike ekwenzeni umphakathi ube yindawo efudumele, ethokozisayo, futhi evumelana nezifiso zethu. Ukuxhumana kuhambisana nomthwalo wemfanelo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sifunde ukusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela ephumelelayo, ethuthukisa ubudlelwano bethu, futhi ikakhulukazi, ibhekise ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwama-social media ukuze sakhe imiphakathi eqinile nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba sithole izixazululo ezikahle, sabelane ngempilo yethu, futhi sakhe izindaba ezinhle ezizoshiyela umhlaba ubuhle. Kukhona amandla amakhulu lapha, futhi kufanele sizisebenzele ukuze senze izinguquko ezithinta impilo yethu.
Isingeniso Ukupheka, njengomsebenzi obalulekile, ungomunye wemisebenzi eyinhloko yabantu, futhi unomlando ocebile nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezithintekayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuhlanganisa izithako ukuze kudalwe ukudla, kodwa kudinga ulwazi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nobuciko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukupheka kudlala indima enkulu emiphakathini ehlukene, kuyindlela yokubonisa uthando, isiko, kanye nemikhuba. Umlando Nokubaluleka Kokupheka Umlando wokupheka uqala ezikhathini zasendulo, lapho abantu bokuqala benza ukudla ngezindlela ezilula, njengokupheka emlilweni. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, abantu baqala ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokupheka, behlanganisa izithako ezahlukene, futhi benza izitsha ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezindlela ezikhethekile ezithinta izindawo, izinkolo, kanye nemikhuba yamasiko. Ukupheka kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu; izenzakalo, izinsuku ezikhethekile, nezitsha ezithile zihlala zixhumene nezikhathi ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukupheka kuwumsebenzi onikeza abantu ithuba lokukhombisa ubuciko babo, okwakha ukuvumelana phakathi kwabantu. Izithako Nezindlela Zokupheka Izithako zibalulekile ekuphekeni, futhi zihluke kakhulu kuye ngendawo, isiko, kanye nezidingo zomuntu. Ukuze kudaleke ukudla okuhle, kubalulekile ukukhetha izithako ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezivela emithonjeni ethembekile. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwenza ukudla kube mnandi, kodwa kuqinisekisa ukuthi kudla kuyaphila, kunempilo, futhi kunothile. Izindlela zokupheka nazo zihluke, futhi zidinga ulwazi olujulile ukuze kudaleke ukudla okuhle. Umuntu ophakathi kokupheka kufanele akwazi ukukhetha indlela efanele yokupheka ngokuhambisana nezithako azisebenzisayo. Ubuciko Bokupheka Ukupheka akuyona nje inqubo yokuhlanganisa izithako, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhombisa ubuciko. Abapheki bahlala benza izinguquko ezithile ezitshalweni, begxila ekwakheni izitsha ezihlukile ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezithako nezindlela ezihlukene zokupheka. Ubuciko bokupheka buhlanganisa nezinye izici, njengokwakheka kokudla, ukunambitheka, nokubukeka. Abapheki abaningi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni izitsha ezihlonipha izinkolelo zendawo, okukhombisa ukuthi ukupheka akuhlangene nje nezinsiza, kodwa futhi kunezimo ezithinta izinkolelo, imikhuba, kanye nezifiso zomphakathi. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ekuphekeni Noma ukupheka kuyinto ejabulisayo, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nakho. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuphila, eziholela ekutheni kube nzima ukuhlela isikhathi sokupheka. Izinkinga zokutholakala kwezithako ezithile zingaphazamisa inqubo yokupheka, kudinga abapheki ukuba babe nekhono lokuhlela kahle. Izixazululo zingafaka phakathi ukuhlela isikhathi, ukufunda izindlela zokupheka ezilula, kanye nokusebenzisa izithako ezitholakala kalula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane, ngaphandle kokudinga isikhathi eside sokupheka. Isiphetho Ukupheka kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, kudinga ulwazi, ubuchwepheshe, nobuciko. Njengoba abantu behlale bejolise ekwakheni izitsha ezihlukile, ukupheka kuqhubeka nokuba yindlela yokukhombisa uthando, ubuciko, kanye nesiko. Ngakho-ke, ukupheka akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano.
Inhloso yale ncwadi ukusiza othisha nabafundi abaphakathi kwezinga le-10 - 12 engozini yokufunda nokufundisa ngezinye zezindlela zokubhala ezikhiqiza imiyalezo ngezindaba nezikhumbuzo. Le ncwadi izosiza kakhulu abafundi ukuba baphumelele ekufinyeleleni Umphumela Wokufunda 3 nasekulungiseleleni izivivinyo zabo. Ibhalwe futhi ihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Kukhona imibhalo eyakhelwe yona, imibhalo emide nemifushane. Ngaphansi kwesigaba ngasinye, izinhlobo zemibhalo zikhona, uhlobo ngalunye luchazwa futhi izibonelo zinikezwa. Ukubhala nokwakha imibhalo kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uthisha anike abafundi ithuba elanele lokuzijwayeza ukubhala okuqhubekayo. Bavame ukunikezwa amathuba okubhala ngokukhululeka ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Ekubhaleni okusekelwe kakhulu ezinjongo ezithile, othisha banconywa ukuba bahlolisise ikhono elithile noma amandla athile asetshenziswayo ngaleso sikhathi sokubhala. Ngokwesibonelo, zonke izakhono zolimi kufanele zikhulunywe ngaleso sikhathi sokubhala, okuyindlela othisha abayisebenzisile esikhathini esedlule. Ngenxa yalokhu, ukubhala njengokwazi kuvame ukungabhekwa ngoba kuhlale kudinga ukuhlolwa okukhulu. Abafundi kufanele bafunde ukuhlela umsebenzi wabanye ngoba lokhu kubalulekile enhlanganweni yokubhala futhi kukhuthaza ukuqashelwa kwenqubo yomfundi kanye neyabanye. Isici esibalulekile salolu phiko ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ebhaliwe. Kungabelana nabanye, othisha, esikoleni sonke, abazali, noma abanye abathintekayo. Umfundi uzothokozisa umkhiqizo ophelele nowokwenziwa. Abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukuchaza ngokufushane izinhlobo zemibhalo eyakhelwe yona njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Le yindaba lapho umbhali noma umxoxi echaza umcimbi othile owawenzeka kuye, noma ungabonwa uphila kumuntu omunye noma ukhuluma ngakho. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi umbhali akhe indaba evela emicabangweni yakhe. Lokhu kuvame ukutholakala phakathi kwabafundi (esikoleni). Kubalulekile ukuthi noma ngabe umfundi udala indaba yakhe emicabangweni yakhe, kufanele kube indaba ethembekile. Ngokuvamile, umbhali walesi sihloko usebenzisa isikhathi esedlule, umuntu okhuluma noma okukhuluma ngaye, ukuze axoxe indaba yakhe. Isigaba sokwethulwa kufanele sithokozise umfundi wendaba. Indaba yokuxoxa kufanele ibe nethembekile noma ngabe iyefikile. Indaba yokuxoxa ivame ukubhalwa ngesikhathi esedlule. Umuntu ofunda le ndaba kufanele njalo alinde ukuzwa okwenzekayo okuzayo kuze kube sekupheleni. Ukuxoxa okuphumelelayo kukhombisa kahle imizwa, njengokubona, ukuzwa, ukunambitha, ukunuka, nokuthinta. Isibonelo sesihloko sendaba yokuxoxa: Usuku Esithole Ngalo Ibhokisi Lezinkomo eBhange Elidumile Enhliziyweni YeDolobha Lethu. Kwakuyimpelasonto yeLwesihlanu ekupheleni kukaJuni. Ubanda wawuthinta isikhumba ezweni laseKwaZulu-Natal. Nakuba ubanda wawuthinta isikhumba, abantu babephuma inani elikhulu ukwenza izidingo zabo edolobheni laseMnambithi. Kwakungabonakala izinhlobo ezahlukene zezingubo, amabhulukwe, amahembe, amajakhethi abizayo, futhi ngisho nezindwangu ezinemibala. Amadoda nabafazi abaningi babephathe izigubhu ze-wool ezimboza izindlebe zabo. Abafazi, ngakolunye uhlangothi, babengathembisa ukuthi babezifaka izindwangu ezikhaleni zabo. I-ABSA ibhange elivame ukuba nabantu abaningi kunabanye. Kwakunjalo ngalolu suku. Kwakukhona umgibeli njengokujwayelekile holding ibhande lakhe kanye nesikhumbuzo esincane esiphonswa emzimbeni uma ungena ebhange. Bonke abangenayo emnyango babengadlula futhi bathole izibusiso kulolo bhande. Nami ngasondela futhi nganika umgibeli ithuba lokwenza umsebenzi wakhe. Ngemva kwesikhashana, ngase ngaphakathi ebhange. Ngabe ngibona indawo lapho kuhlanganyelwa khona imali. Ngakuqonda ukuthi kufanele ngisheshe ngiyise kumshini wokuhoxisa imali futhi ngiqale ukugcwalisa imininingwane edingekayo. Njengoba ngisondela, ngavela nabantu ababeqoqana. Kwathatha isikhathi eside njengoba sisondele kancane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abasebenzi bebha ngathi bephithizela, bekhuluma ngento ethile kubantu ababe sebhange. Owayesondela kithi wahlukanisa abantu babeziqoqe kabili - umugqa wabo abahoxisa imali kanye nalabo abahambisa. Futhi ngakho, kwavela imigqa emibili. Ngabe ngisemugqa wabo abahoxisa imali. Isizathu sokuthi ngiye kuhoxisa imali ngaphakathi ebhange kwaba ukuthi ngifuna amaRandi ayisithupha. Umugqa wabo abahoxisa imali kumshini nalabo abahambisa wawusheshisa kuneyethu. Ngabe ngiqhubeka ngibona bengenela futhi baphuma emigqeni yokuhoxisa nokuhambisa imali. Kwakuyilapho ngathola umqondo wokuthi ngingahoxisa kuphela amaRandi amabili, kodwa ngaziphindisela ngathi kufanele ngibe nesineke kuze kube sekufikeni kwami. Esikhundleni sokwandisa inani labamukeli nabakhokhi, banciphisa. Ngemva kwesikhashana, izindawo abazisebenzisayo zazivele zihlukaniswe uphawu oluthi 'kuvalwe'. Sahlala ngoba sasingadinga imali. Kwakufana nokuthi ngiphupha ngesikhathi sekufika kwami kumthengisi kanye nomphakathi. Uthole ngokushesha uhlelo lwekhompyutha izikhathi ezimbili noma ezintathu ngomzuzu, wabalela imali, waphinde wayinika mina. Ngiyithathe futhi ngambonga ngenkathi ngimthokozisa. Ngesikhathi ngibheka emnyango, ngibona umgibeli evala umnyango kubo abangenayo nabaphuma. Sashangiseka ukubona abavikeli ngaphakathi ebhange bephethe amabhokisi emali. Ababili basondeza kumshini wokuhoxisa nokuhambisa imali, bavula, futhi baqala ukufaka imali. Bonke amehlo abavakashi ababephendukela kulabo bavikeli. Ngabe ngizibiza ukuthi ngeke baphume uma sikhona emnyango wokuphuma ebhange. Noma ngabe umuntu akakaze abambe isibhamu kodwa unomsindo wesibhamu okulungiselelwe ukuhlasela. Lokhu kwaba njalo ngenkathi sisenza uhlelo lokushaywa ngababheki ababephuma imali kumshini. Ngabe sishintsha amakhanda ethu, amehlo ethu abheka lapho izinsimbi ezahlukene zesibhamu ziqhuba ukuhlasela, umuntu owayekhona wabona omunye elele phansi ngesifuba. Ngabe ngibona futhi ngilele phansi ngaphezu kwalokho. Ngenkathi abanye abantu befaka imali kumashini, abanye behoxisa lokho okwakufakiwe ngababheki, kanti abanye behoxisa imali ezikhwameni zethu. Okukhona lapho kwenzeka ngamehlo. Ngemva kwesikhashana, kwavuka udlame. Lokhu akusizanga nhlobo ngoba bekusemva kwendaba. Imali yethu ithathwe. Akekho ofa ngokushaywa ngoba angizange ngife ngaleso sikhathi ngishaywa ngemuva kwalolo mcimbi. Ngisho namuhla, ngiyathola ukushisa uma ngicabanga ngalolo mcimbi. Le yindaba lapho umbhali kufanele achaze isimo esithile, umuntu othile, noma indawo ethile. Njengoba isihloko sisho, umbhali walesi sihloko kufanele asebenzise amagama achaz
Mhlonishwa Ilunga yePhalamende, uDkt. S.C. Ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukuba yingxenye yomphakathi owakha iMuziwabantu Municipality, engxenye ye-uGu municipality, kulolu suku oluyhistorical olugubha omunye wemigqa ebalulekile yomsebenzi omuhle kahulumeni wethu wokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu. Njengoba siqala unyaka omusha, izifiso nezithemba zabantu abaningi ziwukuthi izimpilo zabo, inhlalakahle, nezimo zabo zomuntu siqu zithuthuke. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuvakashela kwethu kule ndawo ukuze sikhombise lezi zinhlelo ezimbili kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokufeza leli phupho. Simi lapha namuhla, sihlonipha ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni ophendula izidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphansi kukahulumeni ophoqayo, abantu basemaphandleni baphumelele ithemba lokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi bamukele njengokuthi bazophinde bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi ngezikhathi lapho futhi bedinga khona ukuze baphile izinkomo zabo. Abantu bethu basemaphandleni bamukele ukuthi izakhiwo zesimanje njengalesi sikhala esisha esakhiwe emphakathini waseCingweni kuyinto ethokozisayo. Uhulumeni wethu uqhubeka nokusebenza ngokungapheli ukuze alungise umonakalo owadalwa uhulumeni wobandlululo. Ukuthuthukiswa nezimo zokuphila ezingcono kubo bonke. Kule ndawo, u-84 percent wezizinda zihlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kanti u-16 percent uhlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Njengoba ezinye izifunda zinezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, u-uGu unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka emphakathini kubhekana nezinselelo ngenxa yokungafani phakathi kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nezasemaphandleni, kanye nokubambezeleka kwezinsizakalo okubangelwa ukuntuleka kwemali nezakhono. Ngalesi sizathu, ngonyaka ka-2000, i-uGu municipality, kanye nezinye izifunda ezintathu esifundazweni, okungukuthi, uMkhanyakude, uZululand, noMzimvubu, zabelwa uhulumeni njengezindawo ezamukelekayo zokuthuthukiswa okuhlangene okungaguquki. Lokhu kusho ukuthi lezi zindawo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngaphezulu kwezinsiza kunezinye izindawo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka ezibhekene ne-uGu district municipality, ezinye zazo zihlobene namanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kanye nogesi. Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, u-74 percent wempilo ephelele ehlala kule ndawo, ikakhulukazi labo basemaphandleni, abanakho ugesi. Cishe ingxenye yesibili yabantu abahlala kule ndawo idinga amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuphela u-50 percent wezizinda ezithola ukufinyelela kumanzi ahlanzekile kokupheka nokuphuza, kanti u-58 percent usadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanza. Imali ibekwe eceleni ukuze isize i-uGu District Municipality ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezihlobene nezomiso. E-Fodo, KwaMbotho, KwaShaweni, Dumisa, naseKwaJali. Le nqubo izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu baphinde bathole isithunzi sabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu bethu ngeke baphoqwe ukuba bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi. Le nqubo yamanzi esiyethulayo lapha namuhla izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu abatholi izifo ezihlobene nokuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nqubo izokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini wendawo futhi ithuthukise amakhono. Njengohulumeni, sikhathazekile ngaso sonke isikhathi ngezindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile ngokushesha kanye nezakhiwo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu. Emizamweni yethu yokubhekana nalezi zinkinga ezihlobene nokubambezeleka ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza, uhulumeni usungule indlela yokuxhasa ebizwa ngokuthi iMunicipal Infrastructure Grant. Sizosebenza ngokubambisana ne-municipality, siqinisekisa ukuthi iRand ngayinye ibalulekile emsebenzini eyenzelwa wona. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza ama-municipalities kulesi sifundazwe ukuba asebenze ndawonye,abelane ngemininingwane, futhi basebenzise indlela yokubambisana ukuze bafeze izidingo zomphakathi kahle. Umsebenzi owenziwe yi-uGu municipality ngonyaka ka-2004/2005 ubonisile ukuthi i-district municipality inekhono lokwenza ngcono ama-municipalities ayisebenzisayo. Ukuqaliswa kwesikhala esisha somphakathi eCingweni kuzohlanganiswa nezakhiwo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ama-MPCCs. Lokhu kusho ukuthi le ndawo ngeke isetshenziswe kuphela ezinhlelweni zomphakathi kodwa izosetshenziswa futhi ngeminye iminyango kahulumeni ukuze izinsizakalo zisondele kubantu. Kulesi sifundazwe, sizibophezele ukuba ne-MPCC kuzo zonke izifunda. Le njongo seyifeziwe, futhi lapha e-uGu, sesikhethiwe ama-MPCC eDududu naseBhomela. Ukuqaliswa kwama-MPCC kuyinxenye yezinjongo zikahulumeni zokuphelisa ubuphofu ngokuletha izinsizakalo eduze nomphakathi. Ngiyajabula futhi ukuzwa ukuthi kunezikhulu ezingama-52 zomphakathi ezithole izinzuzo emsebenzini nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwalesi sikhala. Ngizwe ukuthi izinhlelo zisesimweni sokuhlelwa phakathi kwe-uGu municipality neMuziwabantu ukuze kudluliselwe le ndawo ukusuka e-uGu iye eMuziwabantu; futhi izoxhunyaniswa nezinye iziminyango ezibalulekile ukuze le ndawo isetshenziswe nguhulumeni ukuze ilethe izinsizakalo kubantu empini yokulwa nobuphofu. Namuhla sibhiyozela imiphumela yomsebenzi wokubambisana. Ngokuvulwa kwalesi sikhala, siqinisekisa ukufezeka kwephupho lokuthi abantu bethu ngeke baphinde bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zabo ezisemqoka. Sizama ukulwa nomonakalo owadalwa ubuhlanga obuholele kulolu hlobo. Ngiyabiza bonke bethu njengamalunga omphakathi ukuba bathathe lesi sikhala njengempahla ebalulekile, futhi futhi banakekele kahle izakhiwo ezizoletha amanzi esizowasebenzisa. Thina lapha kule ndawo siyazi kahle ukuthi kuyini ukuntuleka kwamanzi. Ngakho-ke, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi lapho sinesi sikhala, asishiyi amanzi esiwashisayo. Asivumeli izingane ukuba zidlale ngezinsiza ezisemqoka. Kumele sigcine yonke i-drop yamanzi. Njengohulumeni, sizibophezele ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana ne-municipality ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu bethu. Ngabe ukwethulwa kwalesi sikhala samanzi nokuvulwa kwalesi sikhala kube ukuqala kwesikhathi esikhanyayo nesithemba kubantu abakhe le municipality. Nakuba unyaka usanda kuqala, ngifisela unyaka omusha ogcwele izibusiso. Yinsiza ezimele esunguliwe ngemuva koMthetho Wokulungiswa Kwezinsizakalo, uMthetho inombolo 111 ka-1998, ophathwa nguJaji Ohlola. Izinjongo zabaJaji Ohlola ukuhlela ukuhlola iziboshwa ukuze uJaji Ohlola akwazi ukuveza umbiko ngokuqhuba iziboshwa eziboshwe nasemazingeni eziboshwa. Ithimba labahloli liqukethe amaqembu amane, abahloli abaphatha ukuhlola nokuhlola, iyunithi yezinsizakalo zomthetho ebhekene nezikhalazo zeziboshwa, iy
Ukubuyiselwa kwesivumelwano sokusebenza: Qiniseka ukuthi ukubhalwa kwenziwa! Manje sesikwi nyaka ka-2009 futhi singene ebusika. Njengoba izinsuku ziba mfushane futhi zishisa, sethemba ukukulethela ukufudumala nenjabulo nalesi sahluko sesibili seFacet sika-2009. Ukubukeka okusha kweFacet kuthokoziswe kakhulu futhi kwathokozisa amalungu, futhi sethemba ukuthi uthola lezi zindaba zikhangayo, ziwusizo, futhi ziwuthokozisa. Uma umuntu ecabanga ukuthi imisebenzi ye-GEMS igxile ngokuphelele ekugcina amalungu angaphezu kuka-350,000 ejabulile futhi ephephile, kuyamangaza ukuthi sithola kanjani kancane ngendaba yokwabelana ngezindaba eziyiqiniso - ezinezimpumelelo - ezivela kumalungu ethu. Enye yalezi zindaba ikhuluma ngoMzimasi Ngqelu nokuthi wayiphila kanjani isimo esibulalayo, esanda kufika ezihlokweni zethu. Sithintekile kakhulu umthelela i-GEMS enawo empilweni yakhe. Angizukungena emikhakheni eminingi lapha; kodwa uma ujika ekhasini elilandelayo, ungafunda ngendaba yakhe ekhuthazayo. Kulesi sahluko, siphinde sikhulume ngomncintiswano wamalungu ethu, iSis-onke, eyakhanyiswa kakhulu nguMzimasi. Siyacela ukuthi ungene emncintiswaneni ngoba sithanda ukuzwa ukuthi i-GEMS ikwenze kanjani kube ngcono empilweni yakho. Siphinde singenise izinsuku zokuhlola impilo ze-GEMS, eziletha izinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo endaweni yokusebenza. Enye usizo olusha olwenziwe kulesi sahluko yisicelo sefonini esihlonishwayo esibizwa ngokuthi "SMS benefit lookup," sikhuthaza amalungu ukuba basisebenzise. Okudingayo ukwenza ukuze uthole ukuthi yiziphi izinzuzo ongazifaka ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo ukuthumela i-SMS kuhlelo lwakho lokuhlela, futhi sizophendula ngemizuzwana enolwazi oludingayo. Uhlelo ngalunye luchazwa ngemininingwane kulesi sikhangiso - ngakho qiniseka ukuthi ufunda ngakho konke. Ekulungiseleleni lesi sikhangiso, ngizame, njengokujwayelekile, ukukhumbuza amalungu ethu ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeka nokufuna ubungcweti. Amalungu aqhubeka nokwelashwa futhi abhekwa njengabantu abafanele izinzuzo ezinhle kakhulu. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uyawujabulela lo mqulu weFacet kuze kube isikhathi esilandelayo - hlala ufudumele futhi uphilile. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezisebenzi zikahulumeni, elungu le-GEMS, alukaze luphuthelwe usuku aluthola ngalo i-voucher yokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngeposi. "Ngashesha ngaqonda ukuthi ngeke ngikwazi ukukhokhela i-R180,000 ye-bhili yesibhedlela esikhwameni sami," kuchaza uNgqelu. "Inani elikhulu elakhokhwa yi-GEMS ekuthengeni kwami kwesibhedlela liqinisekisile ukuthi ngithole ukwelashwa okuhle kakhulu." Wabe esedluliselwa endaweni yokubuyisela emuva eKensington, eJohannesburg, lapho athola khona ukwelashwa komzimba nokuhlolwa kwengqondo. Ngomhlaka 1 kuJanuwari 2009, wayelungele ukubuyela emsebenzini; into eyayicabanga odokotela abanye ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke. Impilo yakhe yaguquka yaba ngcono. Uhlala ethi, "Ngiyabonga impilo kakhulu futhi ngithole nomkakho." Washada noNqobile Mangena (manje nguNgqelu) ngoNovemba unyaka owedlule. Manje ujabulela impilo yakhe entsha futhi uzama ukukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba babe amalungu e-GEMS. "Ngiyabonga futhi, GEMS," uphetha. "Ningakwenze kuphela umehluko empilweni yami kodwa niphinde nisisize ukuyisindisa." Ingabe ukuba ilungu le-GEMS kuthuthukisile impilo yakho kakhulu selokhu waba ilungu? Sifuna ukuzwa ngazo zonke izinto ezinhle ezenzekile kuwe njengelungu le-GEMS. Uma wabelana ngendaba yakho nathi njengoba uMzimasi Ngqelu enze, ungase ucatshangelwe emncintiswaneni! Awudingi ukuba umbhali ophakeme noma ukhulume ngendaba yakho kahle; udinga kuphela ukuba nendaba enhle yokwabelana. Kulula! Thumela umlayezo, i-imeyili, noma incwadi ngeposi lapho usitshela khona indaba yakho ekhuthazayo. Ungakwenza lokhu ngolimi olusemthethweni - sizofunda zonke. Khumbula ukufaka igama lakho, imininingwane yokuxhumana, kanye nenombolo yakho yokuba ilungu. Kuyajabulisa ukukwazisa ngomncintiswano owenza umehluko. Empeleni, umncintiswano owenziwe ngqo kuwe. Uma ungumuntu oyi-lungu le-GEMS, ungafaka isicelo sokungena. Uma ungumuntu oyi-lungu, unethuba lokuwina umklomelo othandwa abaningi. Umsebenzi wakho ukwabelana nabanye amalungu osebenza nabo ngendaba yakho, okubaluleke kakhulu - nathi. Ingabe ukuba ilungu le-GEMS kusindisile impilo yakho noma kuthuthukise impilo yakho? Uhlelo lwe-GEMS manje lunikeza omama abakhulelwe ukufinyelela ezinzuzweni zokukhulelwa ze-GEMS. Lolu hlelo lwethulwe ngomhla kaMeyi 1, 2009, futhi lunikeza omama abakhulelwe ukwesekwa, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza kuzo zonke izigaba zokukhulelwa nangemva kokubeletha. Lolu hlelo lusebenza kanjani? Lolu hlelo luphathwa ngababheki bezempilo abanolwazi olunzulu lokubeletha. Lezi z nurses zizokweseka ngezinqubo zokubhalisela futhi zingaxhumana nanoma yisiphi isinyathelo sokukhulelwa kwakho ukuze zikweluleke ngendlela yokuphatha ukukhulelwa kwakho. Uzothola ibhukwana le-GEMS elikhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokukhulelwa, linikeza ulwazi olubalulekile kubomama abakhulelwe. Omama bathola isipho esincane kwi-GEMS! Lesi sipho sithunyelwa kubomama ezigabeni ezintathu zokukhulelwa. Uzothola ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo oluzokusiza ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nempilo yakho nokuxoxisana nodokotela wakho noma umama ophilayo. Uxhaso lwezocingo nolwazi lutholakala uma unenkinga ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuba ngumzali. Sicela uqaphele: Lolu hlelo lukhululekile kumalungu futhi izinzuzo ezijwayelekile zokukhulelwa zisasebenza. Lolu hlelo lunikeza izinzuzo eziningi ezibalulekile kumalungu kodwa alufanisi ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha nodokotela. Ngiyabhalela kanjani kulolu hlelo? Kungakanani isikhathi okufanele uhlole izinzuzo zakho kuhlelo lwakho lokwelashwa kwezokwelapha? Siyazi ukuthi lokhu kungaba kubalulekile futhi sithola kaningi kunzima ukuthola isixazululo? Kulula, thumela i-SMS ngemininingwane elandelayo kulolu nombolo: 33489 (i-SMS ibiza u-R1.50): Isinyathelo 1: Uhlobo lwezinzuzo Isinyathelo 2: Bhala inombolo yakho yokuba ilungu ye-GEMS Isinyathelo 3: Khetha inzuzo ofuna ukuyihlola ohlwini olungezansi (Qaphela: uhlu ngalunye luhlolwa nge-SMS eyodwa). Isinyathelo 4: Bhala usebenzisa ikhodi emfushane ethathwe ohlwini olungezansi. Isinyathelo 5: Faka ikhodi yakho yokuxhaswa (ungayithola kule khadi yakho yokuba ilungu ngaphansi kwe "igama," isibonelo, 00, 01, njll.). Uma ungumuntu ongumgibeli ophakeme, bhala "00". Isinyathelo 6: Cindezela "thumela" efoni yakho. Uma i-SMS yakho ingathunyelwa, uzothola impendulo evela ku-GEMS
Sikholelwa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyabandakanya bonke abahlala kuyo, bahlangene nakuba sihluke. Sakhe iNingizimu Afrika ehlangene esebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba sokhetho esikhona sokuthola indawo yayo efanele njengelizwe elizimele phakathi kwemindeni yezizwe. Ngakhetha uNkulunkulu avikele abantu bethu. Nkosi, bless Afrika. UNkulunkulu abusise iNingizimu Afrika. Amaphupho abusise Afrika. Nkosi, busisa Afrika. Isithunzi somuntu, sisebenza ukuze kube nokulingana kwabantu nokuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kanye nenkululeko. Ukungakhethi ngokobuhlanga nangobulili. Ukuhlonishwa komthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho ophumelelayo. Ilungelo lokuvota kubo bonke abantu abadala, uhlu lwabo bonke abavoti, ukhetho ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile ezibekwe zokhetho kanye nohlelo lokuphatha olusebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba sokhetho esivumela ukubamba iqhaza kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukubhekelela, ukunakwa kwezidingo, kanye nensizakalo yomphakathi kuhulumeni. Lo Mthethosisekelo ungumthetho ophezulu weRiphabhulikhi; noma yimuphi umthetho noma isenzo esihambisana nawo awuvumelekile, futhi imiqathango ebekwe nguMthethosisekelo kufanele ilandelwe. Kukho ilungelo lokuba ngum citizen elilinganayo kubo bonke abakhokheli beNingizimu Afrika. Bakhokhelwa ngokufanayo ngokuqondene nezibopho nezibopho ezihambisana nokuba ngum citizen. Umthetho kazwelonke kufanele uhlinzeke ngokutholwa, ukulahleka, kanye nokubuyiselwa kokuba ngum citizen. I-anthem kazwelonke yeRiphabhulikhi izonqunywa nguMongameli ngokukhipha isikhumbuzo ku-Government Gazette. Iflegi kazwelonke inemibala emnyama, igolide, eluhlaza, emhlophe, ebomvu, kanye neblue, njengoba kuchazwe futhi kuboniswe ku-Schedule 1. Izilimi ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika yiSepedi, iSesotho, iSetswana, isiSwazi, isiVenda, isiTsonga, i-Afrikaans, isiNgisi, isiNdebele, isiXhosa, kanye nesiZulu. Ngokubheka ukwehla kwhistorical ekusetshenzisweni nasebuhleni bezilimi zendabuko zabantu bethu, isimo kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezisebenzayo nezithuthukayo zokuphakamisa isimo nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda bangasebenzisa ezinye izilimi ezisemthethweni emsebenzini kahulumeni, ngokubheka ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi, ubunzima bokusebenzisa ezinye izilimi, izindleko, umongo wesifunda, kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezidingo nezinketho zomphakathi jikelele noma esifundeni esithintekile; kodwa uhulumeni kazwelonke noma wesifunda kufanele usebenzise izilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni. Imiphakathi kufanele ibheke lezi zilimi ezisetshenziswe futhi zikhethwe ngababekhona emiphakathini ngayinye. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda kufanele baphathe futhi bahlola ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ngaphansi kwemigomo ye-subsection (2), zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kufanele zihlonishwe ngokulinganayo futhi ziphathwe ngendlela efanele. Isi-Arabhu, isiHebheru, isiSanskrit, nezinye izilimi ezisetshenziswa ngezizathu zokholo ngokuvamile zisetshenziswa yimiphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Le Bill of Rights iyisisekelo sesimo sokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Igcizelela amalungelo omuntu ngamunye ezweni lethu futhi iqinisa ukholo emsebenzini wokhetho obona isithunzi somuntu, ukulingana, kanye nenkululeko. Isimo kufanele sihloniphe, sivikele, sithuthukise, futhi sifeze amalungelo akwiBill of Rights. Amalungelo akwiBill of Rights angavinjwa ngokuhambisana nemigomo ethile noma ethintwa esigabeni 36, noma kwezinye izingxenye zeBill. I-Bill of Rights isebenza kuwo wonke umthetho futhi ibopha umthetho, umphakathi, umphakathi wezomthetho, kanye nazo zonke izingxenye zikaHulumeni. Imigomo kwiBill of Rights ibopha abantu bemvelo kanye nalabo abaqashelwa ngumlomo njengabantu uma, futhi uma lokhu kusebenza, kubhekwa ubunjalo balo lungelo nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe ngalolo lungelo. Uma izimiso zeBill of Rights zisebenza kubantu bemvelo nalabo abaqashelwa ngumlomo njengabantu, ngaphansi kwe-subsection (2), inkantolo ingathuthukisa umthetho ojwayelekile ukuze ivimbe ilungelo, kodwa lokho kuvimbela kufanele kuhambisane nesigaba 36(1). Labo abaqashelwe njengabantu ngumlomo banamalungelo kwiBill of Rights kuphela uma kudingeka ngokwemvelo yalolo lungelo nalolo msebenzi oqashelwe njengomuntu ngumlomo. Bonke balingana phambi komthetho, futhi banelungelo lokuvikelwa okufanayo kanye nezinzuzo zomthetho. Ukulingana kufaka phakathi ukujabulela wonke amalungelo kanye nezinkululeko ngokuphelele nangokulinganayo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kokulingana, izinyathelo zingathathwa ukuze kuqondiswe umthetho nezinye izinyathelo ezizwakalayo zokuvikela noma ukuthuthukisa abantu noma amaqembu abantu abathola ukungakhethi kahle. Isimo asikwazi ukungakhethi kahle kumuntu, ngqo noma ngokuqondile, ngezizathu ezimbalwa, kuhlanganise nobuhlanga, ubulili, ukukhulelwa, isimo somshado, ubuhlanga noma imvelaphi, umbala, ukujolisa kwezocansi, ubudala, ukungabi namandla, ukholo, umqondo, ukukholwa, isiko, ulimi, nokuzalwa. Akekho umuntu ongakhethi kahle omunye nganoma iyiphi indlela, ngqo noma ngokuqondile, ngezizathu ezimbalwa njengoba kuchazwe kwi-subsection (3). Umthetho kazwelonke kufanele udalwe ukuvimbela noma ukuvinjwa kokungakhethi kahle. Ukungakhethi kahle ngezizathu ezimbalwa ezibhalwe kwi-subsection (3) akuvumelekile ngaphandle kokuthi kuboniswe ukuthi lokho kungakhethi kahle kuyafaneleka. Bonke banesithunzi esisemqoka nelungelo lokuthi isithunzi sabo sihlonishwe futhi sivikelwe. Bonke banelungelo lokuphila. ukuba bangaphathwa noma bajeziswe ngendlela ebuhlungu, engabantu, noma ephansi. ukuba bangasetshenziswanga ezivivinyweni zezokwelapha noma zesayensi ngaphandle kwemvume yabo. Akekho umuntu ongabekwa ngaphansi kokukhululwa, umsebenzi, noma umsebenzi ophoqelelwe. ukuba bangaphazanyiswa ekuxhumaneni nabanye. Bonke banelungelo lokukhululeka kwemizwa, ukholo, umcabango, ukukholwa, kanye nemibono. ukuvakashela kulezo zinkonzo akufanele kuphoqwe kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokukhululeka nokukhetha. uhlaka oluthile lwezomthetho oluphatha abantu nemindeni kulezo zindawo ngaphansi kwanoma yisiphi isiko noma esihlonishwayo ngabantu abalandela ukholo oluthile. Ubudlelwano obuqashelwe noma umthetho womphakathi obamukelwe njengoba kuchazwe kwi-subsection (a), kufanele kuhambisane nezimiso zomthethosisekelo. inkululeko yemfundo kanye nenkululeko yokwenza ucwaningo. ukuvusa inzondo ngokobuhlanga, ubuhlanga, ubulili, noma ukholo okukhuthaza udlame. Bonke banelungelo lokuhlangana nabanye, ukuphikisa, ukuheha abanye ukuba basekele lokho kuphikiswa, nokwethula izicelo ezibhaliwe, kodwa uma lokho kwenziwa ngokuthula nangaphandle kwezikhali. Bonke banelungelo lokubamba iqhaza ngokukhululeka. nokukhankasela iqembu lezepolitiki noma izinhloso ezithile zezepolitiki. Umuntu ngamunye un
Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi (GEMS Risk Management) Ekuhloleni izinga lokuphathwa kwezingozi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibaluleke kangakanani emhlabeni wezokuphatha. Ukuphathwa kwezingozi, noma i-GEMS (Government Enterprise Management System) risk management, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ezisekelwe olwazini olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kuhlola kudinga ubuchwepheshe, amasu, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphepha nezokuphatha. I-GEMS risk management igxile ekuqondeni nasekuphatheni izingozi ezihlobene nezinqubo zebhizinisi. Le nqubo ihlukaniswe ngezinyathelo ezithile, ezikhiqiza umphumela ophumelelayo. Okokuqala, ukuhlonza izingozi kuyisinyathelo sokuqala esibalulekile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukucwaninga nokuqonda izimo ezingaholela ezingozini, njengezinguquko ezimakethe, izinguquko kwezomthetho, noma izimo zezimali ezinzima. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zebhizinisi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izingozi zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Ngemuva kokuhlonza izingozi, isinyathelo esilandelayo siwukuhlola ubungozi balezi zingozi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlela izingozi ngokwezinga lazo, lapho kucaciswa ukuthi yiziphi ezibucayi kakhulu ezidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuhlola, ezihlanganisa isilinganiso sebanga lezingozi nezibalo ezithile ezisiza ekuqondeni ubungozi. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ukwaziwa kwabaphathi, kubasiza ukuthi benze izinqumo ezicacile nezisekelwe olwazini. Emva kokuhlola izingozi, isinyathelo esilandelayo siwukuphatha lezi zingozi. Lokhu kuhilela ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zokunciphisa noma zokuphendula ezingeni elithile ngokubheka ubungozi obuhlolwe. Ukwakha umkhankaso wokuphatha izingozi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabeluleki, abaphathi, kanye nabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi kahle izinqubo ezithile. Izinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha zidinga ukuba zibe nezindlela ezicacile, ezitholakalayo, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuphathwa kwezingozi akupheli lapho izinhlelo seziqaliswe. Ukuhlola nokwenza kabusha izinqubo kuyisici esibalulekile sokuphathwa kwezingozi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqubo kufanele zihlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenzi kahle futhi zikhona ezimweni eziguqukayo. Ukubuyekezwa kwezwekazi lokuphathwa kwezingozi kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokusebenza kwe-GEMS, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi ubungani bebhizinisi buhlala bukhona, futhi izingozi ezitholakala zibhekwa njalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezisekelwe kumgomo wokuhlonipha, ukuze kwandiswe ukwethembeka nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Lezi zinqubomgomo kufanele ziqondiswe ngokuqinile, ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zihambisana nezindinganiso zomthetho, nezidingo zamakhasimende. Ukuhlonipha lezi zinqubomgomo kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabaphathi, abasebenzi, kanye namakhasimende, okugcina kuholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle eziphathelene nezingozi. Ngaphandle kokuphathwa kahle kwezingozi, izinkampani zingase zihlangabezane nezinkinga ezinkulu, eziholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimali, izinkinga zomphakathi, noma ngisho nokwehla kwesithunzi. Ukuphathwa kwezingozi kunganciphisa lezi zingozi, kuvikele izinsiza ezibalulekile, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeka nokusebenza kahle. Ukwesekwa okuhle, izinqubo ezicacile, kanye nokuhlakanipha okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ekwakheni umbono oqinile we-GEMS risk management. Ekugcineni, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kufanele kube uhlelo oluqhubekayo, oluhlala lwenza izinguquko nezilungiselelo njengoba kudingekile. Umhlaba wokuphatha uhlala ushintsha, futhi izinkampani kufanele zihlale zisesimweni sokuphendula ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zifinyelela izinjongo zazo. Ukuphathwa kwezingozi akuwona umsebenzi owodwa, kodwa kuyinqubo ethuthukayo, edinga ubuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho ukuze ibe yimpumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkampani ezizothola impumelelo yaziqonda kahle le mfuneko, zithuthukise izinhlelo zazo zokuphatha izingozi, futhi zihlangabezane nezinselelo zamanje nezizayo.

Uyanqotshwa ukuthi inkantolo ye-equity ingadlulisa le ndaba kwenye inkantolo noma ithimba. Uma le ndaba ibuyiselwa enkantolo ye-equity, umphakathi wezinkantolo uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngalokho. Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, thumela imininingwane bese uyihlanganisa nale fomu, ubhalela zonke amakhasi. Imishado Yesintu: Ukuhlonishwa Kwezinkolelo Nezindlela Zokuphila Imishado yesintu ibaluleke kakhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zenzakalo zikhumbuza abantu ngezinkolelo zabo, amasiko, nezindlela zokuphila ezihloniphekile. Ukuze umshado ube yimpumelelo, akugcini nje ngokuhlanganisa abantu ababili, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukuhlonipha imindeni, izinkolo, kanye namasiko. Ukuhlela Imishado Yesintu Ukuhlela umshado wesintu kudinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, kanye nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezithile. Umndeni wesifazane uvame ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efana nezinsuku ezikhethiweyo, izinkanyezi, nezidingo zomndeni. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kwamasiko kubalulekile ukuze umshado ube yimpumelelo. Umndeni wesilisa, ngokuvamile, uzoba nesandla esikhulu ekukhetheni izipho, izindawo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Izinyathelo Zomshado Imishado yesintu ihlukaniswa ngezinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kukhona isinyathelo sokubiza umndeni wesifazane, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-"lobola" noma "ukukhokha". Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kukhombisa ukuhlonishwa komndeni wesifazane. Ngemuva kwalokho, umshado uqhubeka ngokuhlangana kwemindeni, lapho izivakashi zifika khona ukuze ziqhube imicimbi ehlukene. Imicimbi Yesintu Imishado yesintu igcwele imicimbi ehlukene, efaka phakathi ukudla, umculo, nez dances. Ukudla okwenziwa ngalesi sikhathi kuvame ukuba yizitsha ezihlukahlukene, ezivela ezinkambisweni zendawo. Umculo uveza umoya opholile phakathi kokuhlangana, futhi abadansi baveza indlela yokukhombisa injabulo, okwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Izimpawu Zokuhlonipha Izimpawu zokuhlonipha zibalulekile emishadweni yesintu. Abesifazane bavame ukufaka izigqoko ezikhethekile, kanti abesilisa bahlala bejolisa ekugqokeni izimpahla ezihloniphekile. Lokhu kuveza isithombe esihle sokuhlonipha imishado, futhi kubalulekile ukuze kuhlonishwe izinkolelo zomphakathi. Izinkolelo Nezinkumbulo Imishado yesintu ibuye ibe yisikhathi sokukhumbula izinkolelo ezisemqoka. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa imindeni yabo, futhi bephakamisa izinkumbulo ezinhle. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kwezinkolelo kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemindeni. Ukubaluleka Kwezemvelo Ngaphezu kokuhlonipha izinkolelo, imishado yesintu ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. Izenzakalo ezinjalo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlangane, baphile ndawonye, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuhle. Ukushintsha Kwezikhathi Noma imishado yesintu igcwele amasiko, izinguquko zenzeka njengoba izikhathi zishintsha. Abantu abaningi baye bahlala behlanganisa izindlela zesimanje nezamasiko, okwenza imishado ibonakale ihluke. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwezindlela kudala umoya omusha, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale behlonipha izimpande zabo. Isiphetho Imishado yesintu ibalulekile emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zenzakalo zikhumbuza abantu ngezinkolelo zabo, izindlela zokuphila, kanye nezindlela zokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi imishado yesintu ihlonishwe, futhi iqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemindeni. Imishado yesintu ayigcini nje ngokuhlanganisa abantu, kodwa ibuye ibe yisikhathi sokukhumbula, ukujabulisa, nokwakha umphakathi onempilo.
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo Ezindaweni zokuhlala zethu, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Lezi zikhungo ziwumthombo lapho abantu bengathola khona izeluleko zempilo, imishanguzo, kanye namathuba okukhuluma nodokotela. Nokho, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zempilo akuhlangene kuphela nezakhiwo, kodwa futhi kubandakanya izidingo zokuphila kwabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izikhungo zempilo aziphelele ezibhedlela nasemaphoyiseni kuphela. Zifaka zonke izindawo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okuhlanganisa izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokuhlola, kanye nemikhakha ethile yokuhlola impilo. Umgomo wazo uwukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi nokunika abantu amandla okwenza izinqumo ezinempilo. Cabanga uma othile ekhathazekile ngempilo yakhe, kungaba ngenxa yokukhathazeka, ushintsho lwesisu, noma ezinye izinkinga; kubalulekile ukuba nomphakathi onezikhungo ezitholakalayo ukuze bathole usizo ngokushesha. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi lapho kukhulunywa ngezinqubo zokuthola usizo, njengoba abanye abantu bengase babe namahloni okukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo. Isikhungo sokwelapha esifanele sizophendula lezi zidingo, siphinde sibe yisikhala sokuxhumana. Zama ukukhumbula, ngabe uke wahlangana nodokotela? Abanye abantu bayakhathazeka, beziqhenya ngesikhala sokwazi; abanye, bejabule kakhulu ukuphuma ezindleleni, udokodo luhlala luhle! Lokhu kudala ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, lapho bekhuluma ngezimpilo zabo, bezama ukuzazi kangcono. Kodwa uma sihlola ukuthi izikhungo zempilo zithinta kanjani izakhamuzi, kufanele sikhumbule izinto ezibalulekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zempilo zisetshenziswe kahle. Lokhu kusho ukwenza izinhlelo zokuqwashisa, ukuhlinzeka ngazo zonke izidingo zenhlalakahle, nokugqugquzela izihloko ezithinta impilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ulwazi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zempilo nezinye izinhlelo zomphakathi, njengezikole nezikhungo zomphakathi, kudinga ukuba kusebenze. Lokhu kuzojabulisa, njengoba omunye enza omunye abe nolwazi olungcono. Uma izikhungo zempilo zisetshenziswa njengendawo yokufunda, umphakathi ungezeza izinzuzo ezinhle. Sifuna abantu bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi oluqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo zempilo kufanele zihlale zikhuluma nabantu, zibathumele izincwadi, zicacise izincazelo, futhi zinikeze amakhasi e-inthanethi anobungane. Ukuxhumana okuvamile kunciphisa izinkathazo, kuthuthukisa ukwethembana phakathi kwabantu nosizo. Sithanda ukuqonda ukuthi ukufakwa kwezikhungo zempilo akuyona into esheshayo. Izinyathelo ezithile, ngesikhathi sokwakha izikhungo, zidinga isikhathi sokucubungula nezisombululo ezintsha. Ngamafuphi, kumele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile, ezizwakala kahle, nezinhlelo ezihlose kahle. Lokhu kunciphisa umzamo wokuthola abantu abaphezulu ngemithi nemishanguzo engakaze itholakale. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngemigomo nemigomo, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi lezi zikhungo kufanele ziqondiswe kahle. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izidingo zempilo ziyahlangatshezwa. Lokhu kuzonyusa ibambiso lokwazisa umphakathi, futhi uma kudingeka usizo, yiba nethemba lokuthi othanda ukusiza uzokwazi ukufika. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kuncike ekwenzeni abantu benze izinqumo ezifanele, futhi lokhu kuhambelana nempilo yabo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zikhulise izimo zempilo zendawo. Hamba kahle, salakaza izifiso ezinhle, ukuze konke lokhu kugcwaliswe kahle. Ngiyabonga!
Ongqongqoshe, uMphakathi, uDr. S.C. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuba yingxenye yomphakathi owakha iMuziwabantu Municipality, eyingxenye ye-uGu municipality, kulolu suku lomlando olugubha omunye wemigqa ebalulekile yomsebenzi omuhle kahulumeni wethu wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu. Njengoba siqala unyaka omusha, izifiso nezithemba zabantu abaningi ziwukuthi impilo yabo, inhlalakahle, nezimo zabo zibe ngcono. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuvakashela kwethu kule ndawo ukuze sikhombise lezi zinhlelo ezimbili kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokufeza leli phupho. Simi lapha namuhla, siqhenya ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni ophendula izidingo zomphakathi. Phansi kukahulumeni ophoqelelayo, abantu basemaphandleni baphumelele ithemba lokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi bamukela njengokuphila kwabo ukuthi bazoqhubeka behamba izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi ngezikhathi lapho badinga khona nakwempilo yabo. Abantu bethu basemaphandleni bamukele ukuthi izakhiwo zesimanje ezifana nale ndlu entsha eyakhiwe yomphakathi waseCingweni yinkanyezi. Uhulumeni wethu uqhubeka nokusebenza ngokungapheli ukuze alungise umonakalo owenziwe nguhulumeni wobandlululo. Ukuthuthukiswa nezimo zokuphila ezingcono kubo bonke. Kulolu hlobo, u-84 percent wezikhungo zihlala emaphandleni, kuyilapho u-16 percent zihlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Njengemunye yezikhungo zomphakathi, uGu unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile emphakathini. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile emphakathini kubhekana nezinselelo ngenxa yokungafani phakathi kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nezasemaphandleni, kanye ne-backlog yezinsizakalo ezidalwe ukungabi nokuxhaswa nemakhono. Ngalesi sizathu, ngonyaka ka-2000, i-uGu municipality, kanye nezinye izikhungo ezintathu zalesi sifunda, okungukuthi, iMkhanyakude, iZululand, kanye ne-Umzinyathi, zabelwa uhulumeni njengezindawo ezamukelwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe okuzinzile kwasemaphandleni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi lezi zindawo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza eziningi kunezinye izindawo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezibhekene ne-uGu district municipality, ezinye zazo zixhumene namanzi, inhlanzeko, kanye nogesi. Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, u-74 percent wabantu abahlala kule ndawo, ikakhulukazi labo basemaphandleni, abanakho ugesi. Cishe u-50 percent wabantu abahlala kule ndawo badinga kakhulu ukuhlinzekwa ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi u-50 percent kuphela wezikhungo zine-access kumanzi ahlanzekile okuphisa nokuphuza, kuyilapho u-58 percent besadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanzekile. Imali ibekwe eceleni ukuze kusizakale i-uGu District Municipality ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezihlobene nezomiso. E-Fodo, KwaMbotho, KwaShaweni, Dumisa, kanye neKwaJali. Le nkqubo izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu babuyisela isithunzi sabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu bethu ngeke baphoqeleke ukuhamba izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi. Le nkqubo yamanzi esiyethulayo lapha namuhla izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu abatholi izifo ezihlobene nokungabi namanzi ahlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nkqubo izokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini wendawo futhi ithuthukise amakhono. Njengohulumeni, sihlala sikhathazekile ngezindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile ngokushesha kanye nezakhiwo ezizothuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu. Emizamweni yethu yokubhekana nalezi zinkinga ezihlobene ne-backlog ekunikezeni izinsizakalo kanye nokungabi nezakhiwo, uhulumeni usungule indlela yokuxhasa ebizwa ngokuthi iMunicipal Infrastructure Grant. Sizosebenzisana ngokubambisana ne-municipality, siqinisekisa ukuthi iRand ngayinye ibalulekile emsebenzini eyenzelwe. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza izikhungo zalesi sifunda ukuba zisebenze ndawonye, zabelane ngemininingwane, futhi zisebenzise indlela yokubambisana ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi. Umsebenzi owenziwe yi-uGu municipality ngonyaka ka-2004/2005 ubonisile ukuthi i-district municipality inekhono lokuthuthukisa izikhungo ezikhonza. Ukuqaliswa kwendlu entsha yomphakathi eCingweni kuzohlanganiswa nezakhiwo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ama-MPCCs. Lokhu kusho ukuthi le ndlu ngeke isetshenziswe kuphela ezimeni zomphakathi kodwa izosetshenziswa futhi ezinye izigaba zikahulumeni ukuze zisondeze izinsizakalo kubantu. Kulesi sifunda, sizibophezele ukuba ne-MPCC kuzo zonke izikhungo zomphakathi. Le njongo seyifeziwe, futhi lapha e-uGu, sesivele sakhe ama-MPCC eDududu naseBhomela. Ukwakhiwa kwama-MPCC kuyinsiza yezinjongo zikahulumeni zokuphula ubuphofu ngokusondela kwezinsizakalo emphakathini. Ngiyajabula futhi ukuva ukuthi kukhona amalungu angama-52 omphakathi abathole izinzuzo emsebenzini nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwendlu. Ngizwe ukuthi izinhlelo zisasebenza phakathi kwe-uGu municipality neMuziwabantu ukuze kudluliselwe le ndawo ukusuka e-uGu iye eMuziwabantu; futhi izoxhunywa nezinye izigaba ezibalulekile ukuze le ndawo isetshenziswe ukuze uhulumeni ulethwe izinsizakalo kubantu empini yokulwa nobuphofu. Namuhla sibhiyozela izithelo zomsebenzi wokubambisana. Ngokuvulwa kwale ndlu, siqinisekisa ukufezeka kwephupho lokuthi abantu bethu ngeke baphinde bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zabo ezibalulekile. Sizama ukuvimbela umonakalo owenziwe ubuhlanga obuholele kulolu hlobo. Ngiyakhuthaza thina sonke njengamalungu omphakathi ukuba sithathe le ndlu njengomthombo obalulekile, futhi sithathe kahle izakhiwo ezizoletha amanzi esizowasebenzisa. Thina lapha kule ndawo siyazi kahle ukuthi kuyini ukungabi namanzi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi uma sinesikhathi samanzi, asishiyi ama-tap evulekile. Akufanele sivumele izingane ukudlala ngezinsiza ezibalulekile. Kumele sigcine yonke ithontsi lamanzi. Njengohulumeni, sizibophezele ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana ne-municipality ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu bethu. Ngabe ukwethulwa kwale nkqubo yamanzi nokuvulwa kwale ndlu kube ukuqala kwesikhathi esikhanyayo nesithembisayo kubantu abakhe le municipality. Nakuba unyaka usanda kuqala, ngifisela unyaka omusha ogcwele izibusiso. I-office ezimele esunguliwe ngokuhambisana ne-Correctional Services Act, uMthetho inombolo 111 ka-1998, ephethwe nguMphakathi oMhloli. Izinjongo zeMphakathi oMhloli ukuhlela ukuhlolwa kweziboshwa ukuze uMphakathi oMhloli akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombiko mayelana nokuphathwa kweziboshwa eziboshwe nasemazingeni eziboshwa. Ithimba labahloli liqukethe amaqembu amane, abahloli abaphatha ukuhlolwa nokuhlola, iyunithi yezinsizakalo zomthetho ephatha izikhalazo zeziboshwa, iyunithi ye-Independent Prison Visitor (IPV) ephatha ukuqashwa nokuphathwa okujwayelekile kwe-IPVs, kanye neyodwa yokuphatha ephatha ukuph
Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni (GEMS government employee status verification) Isingeniso Siyawamukela wonke umuntu osibukele namuhla, ikakhulukazi labo abathanda ukufunda ngezindlela zokuphila ezithinta izisebenzi zikahulumeni. Namuhla sizoxoxa ngokuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni, okuyinqubo ebalulekile ethinta abanye abaningi emiphakathini yethu. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi i-GEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-Government Employee Medical Scheme, futhi iyinsiza enkulu ewusizo kumakhasimende ezinsizakalo zezempilo. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqonda i-GEMS Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS iyini. I-GEMS iyinhlelo yempilo enikezwa oFakazi bokusebenza kukahulumeni, eqinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi zihlala ziphila kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinhlelo zempilo ezithuthukile. Ukuze usebenzise lezi zinsizakalo, udinga ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sakho sesisebenzi. Ingxenye 2: Inqubo Yokwazisa Isimo Ngokuphathelene nokuqinisekiswa kwesimo, le nqubo ivamise ukuqala lapho umqashi noma uMnyango Wempilo uthola isicelo sokuhlola isimo sesisebenzi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukucela imininingwane ethile, njengemibhalo yokusebenza, izitifiketi, noma amakhadi okungena ezikhungweni zezempilo. Kumele ube nesimo esicacile sokuba yisisebenzi sikahulumeni ukuze uqinisekiswe. Ingxenye 3: Izinzuzo Zokuqinisekiswa Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kube nezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi zikhokhwa kahle futhi zifinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kunciphisa izinkinga zezempilo ezivela ngenxa yokungabi nokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nqubo ivikela izisebenzi ekubeni zisebenze ngaphandle kokuthola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, okungaholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu. Ingxenye 4: Izinkinga Ezingase Zivela Noma kunjalo, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuqinisekiswa kwesimo. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezithiyo ekunikezeni imininingwane edingekayo, noma kube nezinkinga ezinjengokuhamba kahle kwemibhalo. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kwenqubo, okwenza kube nzima kwabanye ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bazo zonke izinhlelo baqonde lezi zinkinga ukuze bakwazi ukusiza izisebenzi. Ingxenye 5: Ukuqinisekisa Isimo Sesisebenzi Ngesikhathi Sokuxhumana Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuthola isiqinisekiso sesimo sesisebenzi sekuyisidingo esibalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi kulabo abahamba emakhaya noma abahamba phesheya. Ukuze uqinisekise isimo sakho, ungaxhumana nezikhungo ezisemthethweni noma usebenzise izinsiza ezitholakalayo ku-inthanethi. Lezi zinsiza zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Ingxenye 6: Ukubaluleka Kokuxhumana Nokuqinisekiswa Kwazulu, ukuxhumana kusebenza njengenjini ewumgogodla yokwazisa abantu ngokuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi kanye nabaphathi bakha indawo evulekile yokwabelana ngemininingwane ebalulekile. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo uma kudingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhlala buhle phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni, noma i-GEMS, kubalulekile ekwakheni isimo esihle sezempilo ezinsizakalweni. Le nqubo yenza kube lula kube khona ukuhamba kahle kwezinsizakalo, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi izisebenzi zikahulumeni zithola ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke siqonde lezi zindlela, sibe nekhono lokuxhumana, nokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise izinga lempilo yethu. Ngakho, sizokwandisa ubuhlakani bethu, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sakhe umphakathi ongcono. Ngiyabonga.
I-Byline: Ulwazi lutholwe ocwaningweni olubizwa ngokuthi "Ukulinganisa Izinsiza Nokuhlela Ukulima." Ngokuvamile, inani lemakethe lephondo lilinganiswa ngamandla ale phondo okukhulisa ukudla. Ngisho nasemaphandleni, abakhiqizi basathenga amapulazi ngentengo ehambelana nenani lezomnotho lendawo ethile ezokhiqiza inzuzo ethile ekulimaleni. Inani lempahla ezikhokhwayo ezikhuphukayo liphinde libe nomthelela ngoba abakhiqizi abaningi basebenza ngemali ebolekiwe. Imali engena ekuthuthukiseni izinto ezithile epulazini ezizokwandisa inani lephondo iphinde ibeke umthunzi enanini lemakethe yezindawo ezilimiwe. Ungangena nenkontileka nabanye abalimi ukuze kube nokushintshaniswa. Inzuzo izotholakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba inani lemakethe lendawo esebenzayo lizokhuphuka njalo. Lezi zinzuzo ezitholakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi zixhumene nenani lenzuzo elikhuphukayo nelinciphayo mayelana nesistimu yezomnotho ngesikhathi esithile. Ngokuvamile, inani lemakethe lendawo elilimiwe likhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kodwa emhlabeni wonke le ndawo ayisagcinwa abantu abaningi; isezandleni zezithile. Ngakho-ke, kunzima kubantu abasha abafuna ukulima ukuba bangene ezolimo ngoba kunzima ukuthola ipulazi nokukhokhela ngempesheni yokuvuna ngesikhathi esifushane. Kodwa lokhu kuyashintsha uma umhlaba utholwa ngezinsiza (LRAD), noma ngokufaka, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngentengo yokukhokha etholelwe usizo (njengohlelo olusha lweMnyango Wezomhlaba olubizwa nge- Proactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS)). Ukuqashwa komhlaba nakho kushintshile; kwakuwumkhuba lapho abalimi abasha beqala khona ukulima, kodwa manje sekuyindlela yokwandisa ukusebenza kwabalimi abakhulu. Lokhu kufanele kuhlolwe ngokucophelela, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni osebenziselwa umphakathi wonke ngoba kukhona indawo enkulu lapho ukulima kungakwenziwanga - lezi zindawo zingalimiwe ngabalimi abanekhono lokwandisa ukulima ngendlela enenzuzo. Ukuqashwa komhlaba kusiza abalimi ukuba bandise ukusebenza kwabo ngaphandle kokubamba izinsizi ezihambisana nokuba ngabapulazi.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula EZimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezinsukwini zethu zokuqhubekela phambili, izimo eziphuthumayo zibe yinsakavukela emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuphendula okusheshayo nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayasindiswa futhi izinsiza zikhona ekufuneni usizo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kubalulekile, njengoba kunciphisa ukulimala nokuwa kwabantu. Ubufakazi bokuthi izigameko eziphuthumayo zidinga ukuphendula okusheshayo bukhona emihlanganweni, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini engaphansi kwenhlekelele. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphendula kudinga ukwakhiwa kwesixazululo esihloniphekile. Kubalulekile ukufaka amakhono ezobuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, nokubambisana phakathi kwezinsiza. Izinhlelo eziqondile zidinga ukuklama imishini yokuphendula ngokushesha, ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo nezikhungo zokusiza, nokuphathwa kwezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto zisebenza kahle. Izinsiza ezilikomidiwe zidinga ukufakwa ocwaningweni lwemiphakathi, ukuze kube nokwaziswa okukhona nezidingo zabantu. Ezinsukwini ezedlule, imiphakathi ibhekane nezinsuku ezinzima ngenxa yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 kanye nezimo zezulu ezibandakanya izixhumi. Lokhu kubonise ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, izikhungo zokuphendula, nokwakhiwa kwemikhankaso yokubambisana ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi. Kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka eziqondile nezinhlelo zokwenza ukuze konke kugcine kukhululekile futhi kuqinile. Umsebenzi wokuqeqesha abantu abaningi uye waqala ukuthathwa ngokweqile. Ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi eziphuthumayo, abezindaba, kanye nabantu bendawo kudinga ukuba zikhulume imishado yokubambisana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bakha izinyathelo eziqine zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanele kakhulu kulandela i-PPR (Pre-Hospital Trauma Life Support) kanye ne-EMT (Emergency Medical Technician) kudinga ukufundiswe emiphakathini. Ukusebenza kahle kwezikhungo zempilo, izikhungo zokusiza, kanye nezinsiza zokuqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela efanele kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinsiza ziqhubeke ziqinise izinqubo zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo ukuze zigculise izidingo zomphakathi. Kunomthelela omkhulu uma izikhungo zempilo zenziwa zanele ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ngesikhathi esifanele. Izifundo zempela zezakhamuzi, okuhlanganisa ezinye izifundo zempilo ezifana nokwephula umthetho, zimqoka ukuze ziphumelelane ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nemikhankaso yokufundisa isizinda esiqinile ukuze abantu bazi imiphumela yokuhlolisisa izimo eziphuthumayo ngokushesha. Imfundo izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle okudingekayo, futhi kunciphise izingozi ezibangelwa ukungaqondi kahle izimo ezinzima. Uhlaka lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo harusho ngqo ezimisele ukuphendula okusheshayo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula kuhlanga okukhulu ekupheleni kwezimpendulo ezinqala. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza nokuqonda okuqinile, imiphakathi izoba namandla okuqinisa ukuhlela ngaphambi kokuba izigameko eziphuthumayo zenzeke. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwezixhobo zempilo, ukuqeqeshwa kwempilo yomphakathi, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezinqubo ezinzima zidinga ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo. Akukhona ukukhuluma nje ngezinsiza, kodwa nokwakha isimo esivumelanayo sokuphendula okuphumelelayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nemiphakathi kuzwelonke kumele kube yisisekelo sokwakha isixazululo esiqinile esihambisana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nasezingeni eliphezulu, kuhlale kuhlelekile ukuze sihlinzeke ngezinsiza nezixazululo ezidingekayo. Umsebenzi wethu ukufaka isiphetho sokuthi ukuhlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo kudinga izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nemizamo eqhubekayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikelwa, ukusindiswa, nokwenza ngcono impilo yabantu ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Iziphakamiso eziqondile, ukwaziswa okufanele, nokuhlanganyela kuhola ekuthuthukiseni izikhathi zokuphendula, phakathi kwemiphakathi nezinhlaka. Lezi zinyathelo zizoqhubeka ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwethu, okuholela empilweni engcono nasemphakathini osizayo.
UMartin Luther King Jr. Kwakukhanya emini, kodwa izinsuku zikaMartin Luther King Jr. zazigcwele ubumnyama obugqugquzelayo. UKing, umfundisi obalulekile, wayengumholi ophikelelayo, owayezama ukugcina ithemba phakathi kwabantu abamnyama e-United States. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuhlanga babuphikisana, futhi ubuhlungu bekukhanya emoyeni. Noma kunjalo, uMartin wayebona ukukhanya okukhanyayo empilweni yabo, futhi wayezimisele ukusiza abantu bakhe bakhuphuke kuleso simo esinzima. Ezinsukwini zokuqala zempilo yakhe, uMartin wakhulela eAtlanta, eGeorgia. Wakhuliswa ngothando, futhi abazali bakhe bamfundisa ukubaluleka kokuphila ngokuhlonipha. Wabona indlela abantu abamnyama abebehlezi ngayo, bezama ukuphila ngendlela efanele, kodwa behlukunyezwa futhi behluleka ukufinyelela amathuba alinganayo. Lokhu kwadala isifiso esijulile enhliziyweni yakhe sokuthi izinto zishintshe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMartin waphuma waba umfundisi. Ubephinde esebenza njengomholi ukuze akhuthaze abantu ukuba baphikise ubuhlanga ngothando, hhayi ngodlame. Wazi kahle ukuthi ubuhlungu bobuhlanga abukwazi ukwelashwa ngodlame, kodwa ngothando, nokubambisana. Waqala ukusungula imibhikisho nokuhamba, efuna ukwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu bomdabu. Kwafika usuku olukhulu, ngosuku lwesimangaliso — usuku lokuthi uMartin akhulume esidlangalaleni eWashington, D.C. Wawuthumele umyalezo ophusile, ohlangene, osesithombeni senhliziyo zabantu. “Ngiyaphila, kodwa nginokuphila okungcono,” kusho uMartin. Uthando lwakhe, umbono wakhe, namandla akhe okuhamba, kwashiya imizwelo ewusizo ezinhliziyweni zabantu abangaphezulu kuka-250,000. Njengoba eshaya ezindaweni eziningi, uMartin wathola izithiyo eziningi. Abanye bebengavumi ukushintsha, bephikisana nemizamo yakhe. Nokho, uMartin waqhubeka, engavumi ukwehla phansi, ngoba wayeqiniseka ukuthi uthando lungaphezu kokuphikisana. Wazi ukuthi, noma izinsuku zishubile, umgomo wakhe wawudinga ukuqhubeka. Kwaze kwaba sekupheleni, lapho uMartin ebhekene nezinsongo eziningi, waphinde wagcizelela indlela, "Yimina, angiyena owodlame. Ngibona ukuthi umhlaba ungashintsha uma sithanda, uma sithanda, sizama ukubambisana." Lokhu kwenza abantu baphinde bakhumbule ukuthi ubumbano bubalulekile. Ngesikhathi esiqhubeka, uMartin wathola ukujula kwezinkinga zempilo, kodwa wayehlale eqinile, edlula emingceleni yokuphikisana. Abantu abamnyama bahlala bematasa, bezama ukuthola amalungelo. UMartin wahamba phambili, efuna ukuthola lokho okwakufanele. Uhlanga lwalubanjwe, kodwa uthando lwezwi lwakhe lwawuhamba lukhazimula, lwalukhumbuza bonke. Kodwa uMartin wathi: “Kukhona okuthile okungavumi. Akukhona okukhathazayo, uma sikhuluma ngothando.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uMartin wahamba emhlabeni, waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi uthando lunamandla, njalo. Noma izinto zibe nzima, uthando lwake lwalubanzi, lwalukhuluma ngezwi lesizotha. Ngemva kweminyaka, uMartin Luther King Jr. waba yisithonjana, umholi owaziyo. Abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa ngezinto azitshala, nezifiso zempilo ezakha umhlaba ozinzile. UMartin waphumelela, waba yisikhumbuzo esihle, futhi izwi lakhe lisasondeza emhlabeni, likhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha. Ngesikhathi sokuphila kwakhe, uMartin wadala umthetho ophakeme, okhumbuza abantu ngothando nokubambisana. Uhlanga lwalubhaqwa, kodwa uthando lwakhe lwalungashintshi. Ukuze sibe nempilo engcono, sithanda, sihambisane, siba yisibonelo — lokho kwaba umgomo kaMartin Luther King Jr. Ngakho-ke, izinsuku zikaMartin Luther King Jr. zihlala zingaphezu kokuphila kwakhe. Zikholwa emhlabeni, zabamba izigidi, zakhumbuza abantu ukuthi uthando lungaphezu kwazo zonke izinto. Ngakho-ke, njengoba siqhubeka, sigcina izwi lakhe lisesimeni, sikhumbula izifiso zakhe: “Sizoba nesikhathi sokuphila esinempilo.”
Isahluko 1: Uhlanga Lwezimoto Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elalibizwa ngeMphakathi, elalithokozisa abantu bayo ngezinto eziningi ezinhle. Phakathi kwezinto ezinhle, kwakukhona uHuawei, inkampani eyaziwa emhlabeni jikelele ngobuchwepheshe bayo obuphambili. UHuawei wayengumholi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ethuthukisa izixazululo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kumafoni aphakeme kuya ezinhlelweni zokuxhumana. UHuawei wathola udumo olukhulu, kodwa akuzange kube lula. Izinkampani eziningi zazifuna ukuncintisana naye, zikhombisa izinsiza ezihlukahlukene nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Nokho, uHuawei wayehlale eqinile, ebheka phambili, futhi ethuthukisa imikhiqizo emisha. Isahluko 2: Ukukhula Nokubhekana Nezinselelo Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo zaphakanyiswa. Izwe langaphandle laqala ukungabaza izinhlelo zayo, lukhombisa ukungathembeki. Lokhu kwaphumela ekutheni uHuawei abhekane nezithiyo ezinzima. Kodwa uHuawei wayengakafiki ekugcineni, waphinde wathola amandla emisha. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lwakhe lwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabanye, lwahlanganyela nemiphakathi emisha, futhi lwazisa abantu ngezinto ezintsha. UHuawei waphinde wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezazihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Isahluko 3: Umphakathi Wokuxhumana Ngesikhathi uHuawei eqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano, umphakathi wathola izinzuzo eziningi. Abantu baqala ukuxhumana kalula, bezithokozisa ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. UHuawei wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokufunda, ezokuxhumana, nezokusebenza, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Izinsiza zikaHuawei zaba yisisekelo sokukhula komnotho, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulisa izimpilo zabo. UHuawei wahamba phambili, eqhuba izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Isahluko 4: Ukuvuma Nokubuyisela Emuva Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, wathola izinkanyezi eziningi. Abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe, futhi izinkampani eziningi zafuna ukusebenzisana naye. UHuawei waphinde wathola ubuhlakani obuphakeme, waphendula izinselelo ezazibhekene naye. UHuawei wathola ithuba lokubuyisela emuva emphakathini, wahlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokufunda, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Lokhu kwasiza abantu abaningi, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Isahluko 5: Ukubuyela Emuva Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, waphinde wabona izinselelo ezithile. Izwe langaphandle laqhubeka nokubheka uHuawei ngeso lokungathembeki, kodwa uHuawei wayehlale eqinile. Wazama ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu. UHuawei wathola izindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga, waphinde wahlanganyela nemiphakathi emisha. Lokhu kwasiza uHuawei ukuba aqhubeke nokukhula, futhi abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe. Isahluko 6: Iphupho Elisha Ngemuva kokubhekana nezinkinga eziningi, uHuawei wathola ithuba lokwakha iphupho elisha. Waqala uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihlakaniphile, ezazihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kwasiza uHuawei ukuba aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. UHuawei waphinde wathola ithuba lokubuyisela emuva emphakathini, wahlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Lokhu kwasiza abantu abaningi, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Isahluko 7: Ukukhanya Kwekusasa Njengoba uHuawei eqhubeka nokukhula, waphinde wathola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Waqhubeka nokwakha izixazululo ezihlakaniphile, ezazihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. UHuawei waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izinselelo zingavela, ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa akupheli. UHuawei wathola uthando nokuqashelwa emhlabeni jikelele, abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe, futhi izinkampani eziningi zafuna ukusebenzisana naye. Lokhu kwasiza uHuawei ukuba aqhubeke nokukhula, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma uqinisa, ungakwenza. Isiphetho UHuawei waba yinkampani ehlonishwayo, eqhubeka nokukhula, futhi abantu baqala ukwamukela imikhiqizo yakhe. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, uHuawei wathola ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kwasiza abantu abaningi, kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, futhi uHuawei waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma uthembekile, ungakwenza.
ISOMISO: UTHINTWA KAHLE KWABANTU NEMVELO Ngonyaka wezi-2023, isimo sezulu sithole ukugxekwa okukhulu njengoba isomiso sithinta izindawo eziningi eNingizimu Afrika. Izifunda ezahlukene ziqhubeka nezikhathi zoshintsho olukhulu lwezimo, kanti abaninimzi bahlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemvula. Isomiso sitholakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezingasogwini, lapho imvula ingase ibonakale kanzima. Lokhu kudalwa yizimo ezihlanganisa izinguquko ezinkulu zokushisa, ukulahleka kwemithombo yokuphuza, kanye nokuphazamiseka kokusebenza kwezolimo. Ezimweni lapho izivunguvungu zeshisayo zikhula khona, umphakathi ubona izindlela ezinkulu zokuphila zigcina ziziwa. Izinyoni zibhakabhaka zikanjengothuli, izilwane zibhugshelwa kuzindonga, futhi omakhelwane bahlala bebuzana ngempilo. Abalimi babona ukuthi izitshalo zabo azikhamile, kanti izitshalo ezindala ziba nezinhlobonhlobo ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kokukhiqizwa kwezokudla, okudala umkhankaso owawuzobangela ukwanda kwezindleko eziphathelene nokudla. Okwamanje, izifunda ezithintekayo zisebenzisana noHulumeni, izikhungo zocwaningo, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kubhekwe izixazululo. Umnyango wezolimo uveze ukuthi, kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo zokubhekana nale nkinga, kubandakanya amaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa ukulawulwa kwemithombo yamanzi, ukusiza abalimi ngezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, nokukhuthaza izindlela zokuqhubeka nokulima ezinzile. Izidingo zokuhlala kohlanga lwezilimo zikhombisa umthwalo omkhulu. Umphakathi uyacasula ngoba izinsuku ezingenamvula zikhula zaba ziningi, futhi lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwamathuba okusebenza. Abalimi baphakathi nezinkinga zokubika izinga lokudla, bahlushwa ukucabanga ukuthi izinyanga ezizayo zizoletha ukuhamba kwempilo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukusiza umndeni, ikakhulukazi uma abanye bekhuluma ngezinkinga zabo. Izinga lemvula eliphansi linyukisa ingcindezi kwezemvelo. Imithombo ethulile ngokurekhoda izinga lempilo, kuthola ukuthi izindawo ezihlukahlukene zibhakabhaka phakathi kwezimo eziphakeme zamazinga okushisa. Lokhu kuthinta ngqo wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezimbi. Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselele ezinkulu, kubalulekile ukuba bonke abantu basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo ezinzile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezinye izifunda ziye zaqaphela ukuphumela phambili kulokhu. Izimboni eziphathelene nezolimo zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wesomiso. Izindlela zokugcina amanzi nokusebenzisa izinsiza zokulungisa umanyolo kuboniswa njengamathuba amasha okubona izinzuzo zenhlalakahle. Lokhu kuvula amathuba amasha kulabo abaningana, kuqinisekisa ukuthi imizamo iyaphumelela. Abaphathiswa bezindawo, imiphakathi, nabalimi bahlanganyela izixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezikhona. Inhloso yabo ukukhuthaza ukulima okungcono nokulawulwa komhlaba, okwenza kube nezinga elifanele lokukhula komnotho. Abalimi baphinde banikezwa ukuthola amakhono okuphatha izimo ezinzima, okwenza kube lula ukuvumelanisa nezimo eziguqukayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi iqhubeke nokuzigcina ikhumbula imiphumela yesomiso. Abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi isikhathi sabo sokulima asikuchithi nje isikhathi, kodwa should kube yithuba lokubona amathuba. Izivumelwano zokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zingaba yisixazululo esibalulekile sokwakha imiphakathi eqinile nenempilo. Ngokuvamile, kubonakala ukuthi isomiso sizoba yinkinga eqhubekayo, kodwa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiphakathi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphila emhlabeni. Njengoba sithokozisa umhlaba, kufanele sicabangele izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphila. Njengabantu, kufanele sifunde ukucabanga ngokungaphezulu kokuphila kwethu, sihlanganyele ukuze sithole izixazululo eziwumqondo. Ngamafuphi, isomiso singaba ubunzima, kodwa akuhambisani nalokho okwakhoza. Ukubambisana kungenza izimo zibe ngcono, sithole izinzuzo ezintsha, futhi sihlinzeke ngezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukugcina imithombo yethu yokuphila iphilile. Ukugqugquzela izinhlelo ezinhle, ukuthuthukisa umqondo wobukhazikhazi, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile kuzothuthukisa umphakathi. Phela, umhlaba ukhula ngendlela engama-alleys, kodwa kumele ukuvikelwe, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizoqhubeka ziphila.
Imali Yokufunda: Uhlanga Oludinga Ukubhekwa Ngokuqinile Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukufunda sekuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu empilweni yomuntu. Ngaphandle kokufunda, umuntu ubhekene nezithiyo eziningi, ikakhulukazi emsebenzini. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngemali yokufunda, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi le mali iyinselele enkulu kubafundi abaningi. Ngiyavuma ukuthi imali yokufunda ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, kodwa kufanele sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga ezihambisana nayo. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imali yokufunda ayitholakali kalula kubantu abaningi. Ezweni lethu, sinesimo sokungalingani kwezimali, lapho abanye abantu bephila impilo yokuhlupheka, kanti abanye behlala ezindlini ezinkulu. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi abaningi bahlupheke uma kuziwa ekukhokheni imali yokufunda. Abafundi abavela emindenini engatholi kahle, bavame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu zokukhokha le mali, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuqhubeka nemfundo yabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi baphendule ngokuqinile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi unethuba lokufunda. Okwesibili, kufanele sikhulume ngempumelelo yokufunda. Imali yokufunda ingaba yinkinga enkulu uma ibhujiswa ngendlela engafanele.
