Abafundi abakhokha imali ephezulu yokufunda bahlala bephoqeleka ukuba benze izifundo ezithile, noma bahlale ezikhungweni ezithile, okungaholela ekutheni baphuthelwe amathuba okwenza izifundo abazithandayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi bahlale bephoqeleka ukuba baphendule ezidingweni zemali, kunokuba baphendule ezidingweni zabo zokufunda. Lokhu akukhuthazi ukufunda, kodwa kunalokho, kubangela ukuthi abafundi babe nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngempumelelo yokufunda ezikhungweni eziphakeme. Imali yokufunda ibalulekile ukuze izikhungo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinsiza zidinga ukwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Izikhungo eziningi zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziphakeme, kodwa lokhu kudinga imali eningi. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izikhungo zikhokhe imali yokufunda ephezulu, okwenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngempumelelo yokufunda ezikhungweni eziphakeme, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephila kahle. Ngokuphetha, imali yokufunda iyinselele enkulu kubafundi abaningi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi baphendule ngokuqinile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi unethuba lokufunda. Abafundi badinga ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, ukuze baphumelele ezikhungweni zemfundo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephila kahle, futhi bakwazi ukufunda ngendlela efanele. Imali yokufunda kufanele ibe yinto ethokozisayo, hhayi eyokuhlupheka. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi sibe nezizukulwane ezizayo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
iKruger National Park: Umhlaba Wokuhlola Imvelo Nezinyoni IKruger National Park, eyaziwa njengomunye wezindawo ezinkulu zokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, iyindawo ehloniphekile futhi ecebile ngemvelo. Le parki, eyasungulwa ngo-1898, ibhalwe emlandweni njengendawo yokugcina izilwane zasendle, futhi iyingxenye yeNhlangano yeMvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika. IKruger ibonisa ubuhle bemvelo obungapheli, izilwane eziningi, nezindawo ezihlukahlukene ezithokozisayo. Ukwakhiwa Nokuthuthukiswa IKruger National Park iyisikhumbuzo sokuzinikela kwabantu abaningi ekugcineni imvelo. Ngemuva kokusungulwa kwayo, le parki yathuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabavakashi. Namuhla, iKruger inezindlela eziningi zokuhamba, izindawo zokuhlala, nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavakashi bayakwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Iphinde ibe nezinhlelo zokuvikela izilwane, ezihlanganisa ukulawulwa kwezifo, ukuvikelwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi yasendaweni. Izilwane Nezindawo IKruger National Park iyikhaya lezilwane eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinyamazane, izindlovu, izimpala, nezinyoni ezahlukene. Abavakashi bangathola ithuba lokubona lezi zilwane zikhuluma emvelweni yazo, zidlala, noma zihlala emanzini. Le parki inezindawo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezindaweni eziphakeme ezinezihlahla ezinkulu, kuya ezindaweni eziphansi ezinamahlathi. Lokhu kuhluka kwemvelo kwenza kube lula ukuhamba nokuhlola, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abavakashi bahlala bejabule. Izinhlelo Zokuvikela Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iKruger National Park ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, ukwehla kwezilwane, kanye nezinsiza ezikhulayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le parki iyahlala ibalulekile, izinhlelo zokuvikela ziqhubeka zisetshenziswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nemiphakathi yasendaweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baziqonda izinzuzo zokuvikela imvelo. IKruger ibuye ibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa abavakashi mayelana nezilwane, imvelo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlala zikhona. Ukubambisana Nezindawo Zokuhlala IKruger National Park ibambisene nezindawo zokuhlala ezikufuphi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavakashi bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kubambisana kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezindaweni zokuhlala eziphakeme kuya ezindaweni ezilula. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abavakashi bahlala bejabule futhi banelisekile, ngenkathi behlanganyela nezilwane nezindawo ezinhle. Isiphetho IKruger National Park iyindawo ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, enikeza ithuba lokuhlola imvelo, ukufunda ngezinto eziphilayo, nokuhlanganyela nezilwane. Ngokuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuvikela, le parki izoqhubeka ibalulekile emlandweni nasemiphakathini. Abavakashi bayeza ukuze bajabulele ubuhle bemvelo, futhi iKruger iyindawo efanele yokuhlola, ukufunda, nokuhlonipha imvelo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuvikela lezi zindawo, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, siqinisekise ukuthi imvelo iyahlala ibalulekile ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezithombe Nemidwebo Ezikhungweni: Umbono Wami Ezikhungweni zethu, lapho abantu behlangana ukuze bathole ulwazi, bakhe ubudlelwano, futhi babelane ngemicabango, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezindlela ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ukufunda nokuqonda. Ngesikhathi sokuphuculwa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo sekubalulekile kakhulu. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokukhombisa ubuciko, kodwa kukhombisa futhi indlela esithola ngayo ulwazi. Ukubona izithombe nemidwebo kudala umuzwa wokujabula phakathi kwabantu. Izithombe zikhuluma ezilimini eziningi, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezifundo ezinzima. Isibonelo, izithombe zihlala zikhanga uma zisetshenziswa ezikhungweni zemfundo, zisiza abafundi ukuqonda izifundo zabo kahle, ikakhulukazi ezifundweni ezinzima ezifana nezibalo noma isayensi. Isithombe esisodwa singakhuluma kakhulu kunamagama amaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidwebo iyindlela enhle yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange futhi bahlolisise. Uma sithatha izikhangiso ezikhungweni, imidwebo edlalayo, noma izithombe ezihlekisayo, konke lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo, kubonisa ukuthi izikhungo zikhathalela abantu abazozithola. Umoya ophilayo ubonisa ukuthi izikhungo azigcini nje ngokuqhuba izifundo, kodwa zikhathalela nezidingo zabafundi. Kodwa-ke, akumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo akufanele kube nje ukufaka izithombe ezinhle kuphela. Kumele kube nezithombe ezikhombisa izimo zomphakathi ezahlukahlukene, izinkinga ezikhona, kanye nemibono ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihlukahlukene. Ngokusebenzisa izithombe ezikhombisa ubuhlungu, injabulo, noma izinselelo, izikhungo zingakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, futhi bahlale bexhumene nezimo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zibe nezinhloso ezicacile. Akufanele kube nje ukugcwalisa isikhala, kodwa kufanele kube nezithombe ezihambisana nezifundo, ezikhuthaza ukuxoxisana, nezithombe ezikhombisa umbono ohlukile. Lokhu kuzokwenza izikhungo zibe yindawo yokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu bengeniswa khona ezindabeni ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngokuphathelene nezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izithombe zidinga ukwenziwa ngendlela ethile. Akufanele kube nezithombe ezithokozisayo kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube nezithombe ezikhombisa izimo ezinzima, ezihlekisayo, nezithombe ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zidinga ukuhamba phambili nempilo yethu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise izithombe ezithinta izinkinga zamanje, njengezokuphepha, ukungabi namsebenzi, nezindaba zezemvelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Ngokuphetha, ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni akukhulunywa nje kuphela ngokuqhakambisa ubuciko, kodwa futhi kukhombisa indlela esithola ngayo ulwazi. Izithombe nemidwebo zikhuluma ezilimini eziningi, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezifundo ezinzima, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila impilo enempilo. Ukusebenzisa izithombe ezikhombisa izimo ezahlukene zomphakathi, izinkinga ezikhona, kanye nemibono ehlukahlukene, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihlukahlukene. Ngakho, izikhungo zethu zidinga ukusebenzisa izithombe nemidwebo ngendlela efanele, ukuze zibe yindawo yokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu bengeniswa khona ezindabeni ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Ngalesi sikhathi sokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, sithuthukise izikhungo zethu, futhi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
Ukukhetha ukudla okufanele kubalulekile kithi sonke, ikakhulukazi uma unegciwane elingapheli njenge-obesity, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV. Ukudla okufanele kuzokwenza kube ngcono uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela ukuze ulwe nezifo, kukhuphule amandla akho omzimba, futhi kukwenze uzizwe ungcono isikhathi eside. Ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa wesisindo abantu abaneziguli ezinzima ezifana nomdlavuza, i-obesity, kanye ne-HIV akufanele kuthathwe kalula. Ezinye izifo nemithi esetshenziselwa ukuwaphula ngokuvamile kuholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle nasekulahlekelweni isisindo. Lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo zizomsiza umuntu onegciwane elingapheli ukuthi abhekane kangcono nezimpawu zalesi simo futhi agweme ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Ubisi olungashaywanga, ikremu, nemikhiqizo yayo (ubisi oluphonswe, ushizi, i-yogurt) kungangezwa ezidleni ukuze kulethe amandla engeziwe kanye neprotein. Faka amafutha afana ne-margarine, ibhotela, kanye ne-mayonnaise ezidleni ukuze uthole amandla engeziwe futhi uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla. Uma uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ungakhululeki ngemuva kokwengeza amafutha engeziwe ezidleni zakho, zama ukuwanciphisa. Ake sihlolisise ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezimpawu zesifo ezingakwenza ungafuni ukudla. Yini engiyenzayo uma ngizwa sengathi angifuni ukudla? Izifo, ukucindezeleka, kanye nokuhlukana kungakwenza ulahlekelwe isifiso sokudla. Zama lokhu okulandelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele ukuze ugcine umzimba wakho uqine. Ukudla okufana noshukela, ubisi oluphonswe, kanye namafutha kunikeza amandla amaningi noma uma kudliwa ngezinga elincane. Uma kungenzeka, kufanele kuhlanganiswe nezinye izidlo. Zama ukudla nomunye umuntu - ukudla nabanye kukwenza ujabulele ukudla kakhulu. Dla izidlo zakho endaweni ekhululekile ukuze ujabulele kakhulu (dlala umculo, ngaphansi kwesihlahla, noma epaki). Ungabambeleli ezikhathini ezithile zokudla - dlani noma kunini uma uzizwa ufisa ukudla. Ukuzivocavoca okukhanyayo njengokuhamba kukhuphula isifiso sokudla. Phuza iziphuzo ezine-amandla phakathi nosuku, ezifana neziphuzo ezisekelwe kubisi, iziphuzo zefruthi ezinamashukela, nezisawoti eziphekiwe. Dla ukudla okuthandayo - kungenzeka udle kakhulu ngalendlela. Gwema ukudla okukhanya kakhulu okufana nekhabe kanye nekhofi uma kukwenza ulahlekelwe isifiso sokudla. Uma imithi oyithathayo ikwenza ulahlekelwe isifiso sokudla, buza umsebenzi wezempilo uma ungathatha imithi ngemuva kokudla. Ingabe uhlangabezana nokungakhululeki noma ukuhamba? Dla izidlo ezincane ezikhathi eziningi ukuze ugweme ukuzizwa ungakhululeki. Linda okungenani amahora amabili ngemuva kokudla ngaphambi kokulala. Gwema ukusmoka nokuphuza utshwala. Lokhu kungakhulisa ukungakhululeki futhi kubi empilweni yakho. Zama ukuphuza amanzi amaningi neziphuzo ezihlanzekile. Zama ukuphuza lezi ziphuzo ngezikhathi lapho ungadli noma ngaphambi kokudla, njengoba lokhu kungakwenza uzwe ukungakhululeki. Ukubhekana nokungakhululeki nokuhamba... Imithi yokwelapha ngokuvamile ibangela ukungakhululeki nokuhamba. Dla izidlo ezincane ezikhathi eziningi - ukungakhululeki kubi uma kungekho lutho esiswini. Linda kuze kube uzwa ungcono ngaphambi kokudla, kodwa ungaphuthelwa izidlo. Gwema ukudla okushisayo kakhulu kanye nokudla okunamafutha. Faka kancane uju lwe-lemon noma ingxenye ye-lemon eziphuzweni ezibandayo. Zama ukudla ukudla okupholile ukuze iphunga olithola ngesikhathi sokupheka lingakubangeli ukungakhululeki. Ngokuvamile, umzimba uthanda ukudla okubandayo. Gcina indawo yokuhlala ikhululekile. Hlala uqonde ngemuva kokudla - linda okungenani imizuzu engama-20 ngaphambi kokulala ukuze ugweme ukuhamba. Uma unomkhuhlane, udinga ukuvuselela amanzi alahlekile uma uphumeza. Phuza amanzi amaningi - ngaphezulu kwalokho okudingayo uma usuphumezile. Uma uzwa sengathi awufuni ukudla, ungakha isobho semibhede, amaphuphu, amakaroti, noma noma yimuphi omunye imifino onayo. Lokhu kunganika umzimba wakho amandla kanye nezinsiza. Ungazizwa unokukhathala uma kunzima futhi kunzima ukudlula udaka. Gwema ukusebenzisa ama-laxatives nanoma yimiphi imikhiqizo "yokucacisa isisu" efana ne-enemas. Ama-laxatives kanye ne-enemas abanga ukuthi umzimba wakho ulahlekelwe izinsiza eziningi ezibalulekile futhi kuyisixazululo esikahle esingasixazululi inkinga yangempela. Dla ukudla okungashaywanga futhi okuncane okwenziwe ngeziphuzo ezimhlophe (amakhekhe, ama-pastries, njll.). Hlala unempilo! Ukuhamba njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa isifiso sokuhamba. Ungazizwa unokungakhululeki uma unokuhamba kathathu ngosuku nezidakamizwa ezimanzi. Ukuhamba kungaholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle ngoba ukudla kudlula emzimbeni wakho ngokushesha kakhulu ukuze umzimba wakho ukwazi ukukwazi. Umuntu uphinde udle kancane ngoba ungenasifiso sokudla. Uma unokuhamba, umzimba wakho uzoba ne-dehydration ngoba ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi - lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-dehydration. I-dehydration ibi kakhulu futhi ingaba yingozi. Yini engiyenzayo uma nginokuhamba? Phuza amanzi amaningi neziphuzo ukuze uvuselele amanzi alahlekile emzimbeni wakho. Ukuze wenze isiphuzo sasekhaya sokubuyisela amanzi alahlekile, thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi aphekiwe bese uvumela kupholile. Faka ama-teaspoons ayisishiyagalombili noshukela kanye ne-teaspoon eyodwa yensipho. Hlanganisa le ngxube ngangokunokwenzeka. Ikhofi nezinye izidlo neziphuzo ezifana ne-cola ne-chocolate ziqukethe i-caffeine futhi zingakhulisa i-dehydration. Kunalokho, dlani kakhulu... Ukudla okufana nezithelo ezinjengezithelo ezinjengezithelo ezinjengezithelo; lezi zinto ziqukethe i-fiber esheshayo esiza ukugcina amanzi esiswini. Ukudla okufana namaphuphu nezithelo ziqukethe i-potassium, elahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. Dla kaningi ukuze uvuselele isisindo alahlekile nezinsiza. Ukuntuleka kokuhlanzeka kungaholela ekuhambeni. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nosawoti ngaphambi kokuphatha, ukulungisa, ukupheka, noma ukugcina ukudla. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nosawoti ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ngemuva kokushintsha i-diaper yomntwana. Uma inyama iphunga noma inambitha njengezinto zensimbi, dlani kuphela inkukhu, inhlanzi, imikhiqizo yobisi, imbewu ezomile ezingashaywanga, kanye nezinsimbi. Ukudla okubandayo noma okubandayo kuvame ukuba nenhliziyo engcono kunokudla okushisayo. Sebenzisa iziphuzo, izisawoti, noma uju lwe-lemon ukuze uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla kwakho. Dla ukudla kwakho kancane ngenkathi uphuza isiphuzo sakho. Kungasiza ukusebenzisa amanzi anensipho ukuze uhlanze umlomo wakho kaningi. Ukuphuza amanzi anenhliziyo ye-lemon ngaphambi kokudla kungas
uMark Zuckerberg: Umholi Oguqula Umhlaba Wezokuxhumana uMark Zuckerberg, umdali weFacebook, ubhekwa njengomholi ophambili emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, okwenza kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezihlobene nokubambisana, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, kanye nezinguquko ezinkulu kubuchwepheshe. Ubulili bakhe buwubufakazi bokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungagcina buhamba phambili emhlabeni. Wazalwa ngo-1984 eWhite Plains, eNew York, waba neziqu zokujabulela ubuchwepheshe kusukela ebuncaneni, lapho aqala khona ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ustudying eHarvard University, uZuckerberg wahlangana nabangane bakhe ababili, uEduardo Saverin, uAndrew McCollum, uDustin Moskovitz, noChris Hughes, bese besungula iFacebook ngo-2004. Le nsizakalo, eyayincane ekuqaleni, yashintsha yaba yinsiza ethokozisayo yokuxhumana, ivumela abantu emhlabeni wonke ukuba baxhumane kalula. Ngemuva kokuthola impumelelo enkulu, iFacebook yaba yinkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. UZuckerberg wengeze ezinye izici ezibalulekile ezifana neMessaging neNews Feed, ezaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwabantu. Ubulunga bakhe emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe buholele ekukhuleni okukhulu kweFacebook, okwenza kube yinkampani enezigidi zabantu abasebenzisi emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, impumelelo kaZuckerberg akukhona ukuhleleka kuphela; iFacebook ibhekane nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubugwegwe, nokukhwabanisa. UZuckerberg uphinde wavuma ukuhluleka kokuphatha kahle idatha yomsebenzisi, okwaholela ezinkulumweni ezinzima mayelana nezokuphepha, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kwezenzakalo ezinjengeCambridge Analytica. UZuckerberg akagxili kuphela kwiFacebook; uthakazelisa ngezinto ezifana nezobuchwepheshe bokwenziwa (AI) kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo emphakathini. Ube nezinhloso zokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze kukhuthazwe abantu ukusiza umphakathi, nokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabo. Umzamo wakhe wokuthuthukisa impilo emphakathini ubonisa isifiso sokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. UMark Zuckerberg uqhubeka nokuhola emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ehlanganisa ubungcweti bakhe ukuze athuthukise izimo zabantu. Ubuyele emiphakathini ehlukene ukuze abone izindlela zokuthuthukisa inhlalakahle yabantu. UZuckerberg ukhombisa ukuzimisela ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezibhekene neFacebook, enikeza izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ukholelwa ekutheni ubuchwepheshe bungasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi kufanele kube nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Uzenzela izinhlelo ezihlobene nokufinyelela ku-Internet, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezintweni ezisemqoka. Ekugcineni, uMark Zuckerberg ungumbhali wesizukulwane esisha somholi wezobuchwepheshe. Uthole ukwazi ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni ibhizinisi lakhe ngenkathi efuna ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibucayi. Ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungahamba phambili, kodwa abantu badinga ukuthatha umthwalo wemfanelo ekusizeleni. UZuckerberg usaqhubeka nokuhola, ekhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe lungasetshenziswa ukuze kuqedwe ukuxhumana okuhlangene, okudala amathuba angcono kubantu bonke. Ngenxa yalesi sithombe, uMark Zuckerberg usazoba ngumholi ophumelelayo ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kumaphrojekthi amahle asazoba khona, futhi ikusasa lilindele uMark Zuckerberg namaphrojekthi azayo.
Okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala Isingeniso Izinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala ziwumthombo wezinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta ukusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili kwezokuphatha, kubalulekile ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwe, ziqhutshekwe, futhi zixazululwe ngendlela efanele. Le dokhumenti ibonisa okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala, izinyathelo ezithathwe, kanye nezinhlelo ezizayo zokuthuthukisa ukulawula nokuqapha. Okutholwe ekulalelweni 1. Ubukhulu bezinsolo Kwenziwe ukuhlaziya okukhulu kwezinsolo ezitholakalayo, okukhombisa ukuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo zikhula ngonyaka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsolo zokungathembeki, ukuhweba ngokungemthetho, nezinsolo zokusebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi ngendlela engafanele. Ukuhlaziywa kwalesi sikhathi kuveza ukuthi izinsolo ezivela emiphakathini zikhombisa ukunganeliseki ngempela ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. 2. Izizathu zokutholakala kwezinsolo Kuboniswe ukuthi izizathu eziholela ekutheni kube nezinsolo zenkohlakalo zifaka phakathi ukungabi bikho kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, ukungabi namasu aqinile okuphatha, kanye nokungaziphathi kahle kwabaphathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ekuphathweni komasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. 3. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ezahlukene, ezifana nezokuphatha, ezokuphepha, nezokuhlola, zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwe ngendlela efanele. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo kuboniswe njengendlela ephumelelayo yokuthola ubufakazi obuqinile nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. 4. Imiphumela yokungabikhona kokuhlola Ukungabikhona kokuhlola okuqinile kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo kuholela ekwandeni kwezinsolo ezingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokuhlola nokubika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlola okungaphelele kuholela ekutheni abaphathi benze izinqumo ezingalungile, okuholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu. Izinyathelo ezithathwe 1. Ukwakhiwa kwemigomo yokuphatha Ukwakhiwa kwemigomo yokuphatha okucacile kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abaphathi bazi kahle izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubaphathi ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokuphatha. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlola Izinhlelo zokuhlola zidinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze zibe nekhono lokuhlola izinsolo zenkohlakalo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngama-audits ajwayelekile nezivivinyo zokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zisebenza ngendlela efanele. 3. Ukukhuthaza ubufakazi obuqinile Kubalulekile ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi ubike izinsolo zenkohlakalo. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngama-hotlines noma izinhlelo zokubika ezivikelekile, ukuze abantu bezwe ukuthi bangabika izinsolo zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. 4. Ukuthuthukiswa kokuxhumana Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi neziphathimandla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile kumphakathi mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Izinhlelo ezizayo 1. Ukwenza izinhlelo zokuhlola zibe sezingeni eliphezulu Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsolo zihlolwa kahle, izinhlelo zokuhlola zidinga ukuba ziqinile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhululekile kubahloli, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izivivinyo eziphusile. 2. Ukukhuthaza ubambiswano phakathi kwemiphakathi Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezikhungo zomphakathi kumele kukhuthazwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu ubamba iqhaza ekulweni nenkohlakalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinsolo zenkohlakalo. 3. Ukwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo Kumele kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngezinsizakalo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangazithola kuphi. Isiphetho Okutholwe ekulalelweni kwezinsolo zenkohlakalo komasipala kukhombisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ekuphathweni nasekuhloleni izinsizakalo. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, izikhungo, umphakathi, kanye nezikhulu zomphakathi bangakwazi ukwakha isimo esingcono sokuphatha, ukufaka isandla ekulweni nenkohlakalo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zomphakathi zisebenza kahle. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili.
Ithenisi: Ingxoxo NoMfundisi Womjaho Wethenisi Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukwakha ingxoxo enomthelela noMfundisi uMnumzane Sipho Ndaba, ongumqeqeshi odumile emkhakheni wethenisi. U-Sipho unomlando ocebile emkhakheni wezokuzijabulisa, futhi sinesithakazelo sokuzwa izimvo zakhe mayelana nezimpilo zethenisi, amathuba, kanye nezinselelo ezihambisana nale midlalo. Umbuzo 1: Uthanda kanjani ithenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Ithenisi, ngombono wami, iyimidlalo ethokozisayo kakhulu. Ikhulisa umqondo wokuncintisana, kodwa futhi ifundisa ubuchule bokubambisana, njengoba abadlali kufanele basebenzisane nabanye kumakhono abo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ithenisi iyindlela ephelele yokukhuthaza impilo enempilo, njengoba kudinga umzimba onempilo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokucabanga okuhle. Umbuzo 2: Uyini umthelela wethenisi empilweni yabantu? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ithenisi ithinta impilo yabantu ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, ithuthukisa impilo yomzimba. Abadlali badinga ukuba nekhono lokujabulela umzimba, kanti lokhu kusiza ekwakheni izindlela eziphusile zempilo. Okwesibili, ithenisi ifundisa ukuzethemba. Abadlali bahlala bephakathi kokuncintisana, futhi lokho kukhuthaza ukuzethemba, okubalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ithenisi inikeza ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abantu, izigidi zabantu zidlala le midlalo emhlabeni jikelele, okukhuthaza ubudlelwano. Umbuzo 3: Yini oyicabangayo ngempumelelo yabantu abasha emkhakheni wethenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Kukhona amathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kukhona nezinselelo. Abantu abasha baphokophele impumelelo, kodwa kudinga ukuzikhandla okukhulu. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zibalulekile, futhi abaqeqeshi kufanele babe nekhono lokuthuthukisa abadlali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufinyelela izinsiza ezifanele, njengemitholampilo, ubuchwepheshe bokuthuthukisa, kanye nemigomo eqinile, kuhlale kubalulekile. Ngokuhlanganyela, uma umphakathi ungabambisana ekuthuthukiseni lezi zinsiza, sizobona intuthuko enkulu. Umbuzo 4: Yini umthombo wokukhuthaza abantu abasha? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ngithanda ukuxoxa ngabadlali abavela ezimpilweni ezahlukene. Izindaba zabo zikhuthaza, njengokubona abantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene bephumelela. Ngitsho noMnqobi, umdlali owayevame ukujabulisa izithameli ngekhono lakhe. Ukubona abantu abasha bebona ukuthi banganqoba izithiyo eziningi, kuphakamisa umoya kubo. Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngikhuthaza abafuna ukulandela izinyathelo zabo ukuthi bangayeki. Umbuzo 5: Yini echaza ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile kumjaho wethenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ubuchwepheshe buphathelene nekhono lokuphatha umjaho, ukuqonda imithetho emisha, nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele. Abadlali kufanele babe nekhono lokuhlola izindawo zedlalwa, bazi kahle izinqumo zabo, futhi babe nekhono lokulungisa imisebenzi yabo emjaho. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa nokuchithwa kwesikhathi, ngoba imidlalo ithatha isikhathi eside. Ubulili, ukuhlela, nokukhumbula ubuchule beqembu, kuyinto ebalulekile ukuze uthole impumelelo. Umbuzo 6: Uthanda kanjani ukuphatha umjaho wethenisi? UMnumzane Ndaba: Ukuphatha umjaho wethenisi kudinga ukwazi kahle izimo zomjaho, futhi kusemqoka ukuba nekhono lokuphendula ngokushesha. Ngikholelwa ekwenzeni umjaho ube mnandi, kodwa futhi ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali bahlonishwa. Ukubambisana nabanye abaqeqeshi, ukwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, nokuxhumana nabadlali kubalulekile. Ngiyazama ukwenza imijaho ibe nesimo esijabulisayo, ngoba umjaho ophumelelayo ubalulekile empumelelweni. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga uMnumzane Sipho Ndaba ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi esihle. Ithenisi iyinsika yempilo, futhi ukuxoxa naye kudalile kuzo zonke izithameli zethu. Sinethemba lokuthi lezi ziqondiso kanye nemibono izokhuthaza abanye ukuba baqhubeke nokulandela amaphupho abo emkhakheni wethenisi. Kukhona amathuba amaningi, futhi abantu abasha kufanele bazitholele izindlela zabo. Ngibona umhlaba wethenisi uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi ukuphila okwenziwe ngothando lwethenisi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Isibopho Samalungu e-GEMS Ngolwazi Olungamanga Emphakathini wethu, ukwethembeka nolwazi oluqondile kubalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziphathelene nezempilo. Imishanguzo, uthando lwezempilo, nezinsiza zidinga ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi ukuze zisebenze kahle. Ngokuqhubeka nokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo ze-GEMS, kudingeka izindlela eziphephile nezinembile zokwabelana ngemininingwane ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuphila kahle. Kulomcimbi, sizobe sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile: isibopho samalungu e-GEMS mayelana nolwazi olungamanga. Umgomo wethu uwukwakha ukuqonda okukhulu ngemithetho nezinyathelo ezikhona uma amalungu engaphumeleli ukunika ulwazi olunembile mayelana nezempilo, izinsiza, noma ukwaziswa kwabo kokwelashwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle ekwabelaneni ngemininingwane. Sizobe sibhunga ngezinjongo ezisemqoka zokuba amalungu abe nolwazi olunembile nemiyalelo ehlobene nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Ngohlelo lokuhlola izinqubo zokuphatha ulwazi, sizokhuthaza amalungu ukuba alandele izinqubo ezilungile zokubheka nokuphatha ulwazi lwabo, ukuze kugwenywe imiphumela emibi engase ibe khona ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nezikhulumeli ezizokwabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezingozi zokwabelana ngolwazi olungamanga. Ngokusebenzisana namalungu, sizokwakha isikhala sokuxoxa esivulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwakha isithombe esihle sokuhlanganyela. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olungamanga kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezempilweni, okungaholela ekunganelisweni kwezokwelapha. Sizobandakanya amalungu kwiworkshop, edlulisa izifundo eziphawulekayo mayelana nezingozi ezihlobene nolwazi olungamanga. Izifundo eziphusile, umdlalo ongenaqophelo, kanye nezingxoxo ezinzulu zizokwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayazi ukuthi kufanele baphathe kanjani ulwazi lwabo, ikakhulukazi ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Amalungu azofaneleka ukuba nocwaningo olucacile lwezimo zomthetho ezibhekene nalolu hlelo, njengoba ukuphula imithetho ye-GEMS kungaholela ekukhishweni kwezinsiza. Kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde lokhu ukuze bagweme izinkinga. Sizohlinzeka ngezifundo ezicacile, ezizokwenza amalungu azuze izinzuzo ezithile. Umcimbi uzoba nethuba lokuhlanganyela ulwazi oluwusizo nokubanga impendulo ezokwenza kube nesiqiniseko sokuthi amalungu akwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele mayelana nezinsizakalo ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwamalungu. Ngokuhambisana nohlaka lwe-GEMS, sizogubha ubuchwepheshe nezindlela ezintsha ezizokhulisa impilo yamalungu, futhi siqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabafundi nababukeli. Umsebenzi wethu uwukugqugquzela umthetho nosizo abalulekile ukuze kuqashelwe imiphumela engathandeki uma amalungu eshaya indiva izinqumo eziphathelene nolwazi lwabo. Umcimbi uzothokozisa wonke amaqembu, kusukela kumalungu, odokotela, nabezindaba, ukuze bakhe umqondo wobudlelwane obusheshayo – umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo wobuchwepheshe, kanye nomphakathi onokufinyelela kwempilo. Ekugcineni, sizokhumbuza amalungu ethu ukuthi ukwethembeka kuyisihluthulelo emhlabeni we-GEMS. Ukubambisana kwethu, ukuphathwa kohlelo, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyiyo kuzokwenza ukuthi sonke sihlinzeke isithombe esihle sokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kumalungu nemiphakathi yethu jikelele. Ngalesi simo, ubuchwepheshe, ubuqotho, kanye nokubambisana kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa elihle kumphakathi. Siyabonga ngokuba nathi kulomcimbi, silindele impumelelo enkulu!
Umdanso: Ubulili, Uhlanga Nokubaluleka Kwawo Emphakathini Umdanso, njengomsebenzi wobuciko, uhlanganisa izici eziningi ezithinta umqondo, isiko, nomphakathi. Umdanso ungumqondo obalulekile emiphakathini ehlukene, uhlanga, nezinkolo, futhi ubonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuziveza, ukuxhumana, nokugubha izikhathi ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdanso ungumsebenzi ohlonishwa kakhulu, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, udlulisela imizwa, izifiso, kanye nezifundo. Umdanso ungahlukaniswa ngohlobo, izitayela, nezimo ezihlukene. Kunezinhlobo eziningi zomdanso, ezihlanganisa umdanso wendabuko, umdanso wesimanje, umdanso wezokuxhumana, kanye nomdanso wokukhuluma. Umdanso wendabuko, ngokwesibonelo, ubonisa izinkolelo, izinkolelo, nemigubho ethile yamasiko. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi yokugubha, imishado, nezikhathi zokuhlonipha. Umdanso wesimanje, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubonisa izinguquko ezithinta umphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuziveza. Umdanso ungumsebenzi obalulekile emiphakathini, njengoba uhlinzeka ngezindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngokusebenzisa izinyathelo, imizamo, nezimo, umdanso ungadlulisa imizwa engaphezu kwemibhalo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho ukukhuluma noma ukuveza imizwa kungase kube nzima. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, njengokuhlukunyezwa, ubuhlungu, noma ukujabulisa, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuhlanganyela emiphakathini ehlukene. Umdanso ungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umdanso ovulekile, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona, ungakhuthaza ukuvumelana, ukuxhumana, nokuhloniphana. Lokhu kubalulekile emiphakathini, njengoba ubudlelwano obuqinile buvumela abantu ukuba basebenzisane, bakhulume, futhi baphile ngokuhlanganyela. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona ezimfundisweni, ezinkolelweni, nasemigubho ethile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umdanso ungaba nomthelela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuzivocavoca, okungaholela empilweni engcono. Umdanso unikeza abantu ithuba lokukhulula ingcindezi, ukwandisa amandla, nokuthuthukisa amakhono okuphila. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuzijabulisa, futhi ungakhuthaza umoya ophilayo, okubalulekile emiphakathini enezinkinga eziningi. Umdanso wendabuko, ngokukhethekile, ubonisa ubuciko nemicabango yamasiko. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokugcina izinkumbulo, izinkolelo, nezinkolelo zomphakathi. Ngokwenza umdanso, abantu bangagcina izifundo ezibalulekile, nezigigaba ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umdanso ungaba yindlela yokudlulisa ulwazi phakathi kwezizukulwane, uqinisekisa ukuthi izinkolelo nezinkumbulo zihlala zikhona. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokwakha isithombe somphakathi. Umdanso ungaveza izici ezibalulekile zomphakathi, njengokuhlonipha, ubumbano, kanye nemigomo ethile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umdanso ungaba yindlela yokukhombisa ubuhle, ubuciko, kanye nezinhloso zomphakathi. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhuthazelele, bahloniphe, futhi babe nomoya ophilayo. Ekugcineni, umdanso ungumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Umdanso uhlanganisa izici eziningi ezithinta umqondo, isiko, nomphakathi, futhi ubonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuziveza, ukuxhumana, nokugubha izikhathi ezibalulekile. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuthuthukisa impilo, nokugcina izinkumbulo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda nokuhlonipha umdanso, njengoba ungumsebenzi obalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi ungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo.
Izwe lesifunda kanye nezwe elinownedwa ngabantu ngabanye lingathathwa ngokungemthetho. Uhulumeni unomsebenzi wezomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi - lapho kudingeka, futhi lapho kukhona imithombo eyanele yokusiza - bonke obala bangathola amalungelo abo okuthola umhlaba kanye/noma izindlu. Ezimweni ezithile, njengokuthi uma iningi labantu lingena emhlabeni ngokungemthetho, uhulumeni unomsebenzi wokweseka umnikazi womhlaba ekuvikeleni umhlaba wabo. Abantu abanemhlaba wezolimo bangaxhumana neMnyango Wezolimo ukuze bathole usizo ekutholeni umhlaba wezolimo ofanele. Abantu abadinga izindlu bangaxhumana nomasipala wendawo noma, uma kudingeka, nomnyango wezindlu wombuso wesifunda noma umnyango wezindlu kazwelonke ukuze bathole usizo. Bangaxhumana neNkantolo ukuze bathole umyalo wokuxoshwa kulabo abathatha umhlaba wombuso ngokungemthetho ngaphansi kokulawula kwawo, uma amalungelo alabo abathatha ngokungemthetho engaphuliwe. Abantu abathatha umhlaba wombuso ngokungemthetho abadinga umhlaba wezolimo bangasizwa nganye ezinye iziphathimandla zikahulumeni ukuze bathole umhlaba ofanele ongabelwa kulabo abathatha ngokungemthetho, labo abadinga izindlu uma kudingeka, futhi ezimweni ezingajwayelekile, ukusiza abantu ngabanye abanjengomnikazi bomhlaba ongenwa ngokungemthetho ukuze bakhishwe kulabo abathatha ngokungemthetho abadinga umhlaba wezolimo ofanele ukuze baphume baye kwenye indawo efanele. Lapho umhlaba wangasese uthathwe ngokungemthetho, futhi kungekho zimo ezingajwayelekile, umnikazi womhlaba angaxhumana neMnyango Wezolimo ukuze athole usizo uma isidingo esibangelwa ukuthathwa ngokungemthetho sikhona sokufuna umhlaba wezolimo. Lapho umhlaba wangasese uthathwe ngokungemthetho futhi kunezimo ezingajwayelekile, umnikazi womhlaba angaxhumana nomasipala wendawo, noma uma kudingeka, nomnyango wesifunda noma umnyango wezindlu kazwelonke, ukuze athole usizo uma isidingo esibangelwa ukuthathwa ngokungemthetho sikhona sokufuna izindlu. Ekuqaleni, kungathatha i-Directorate: Support for People with Land izinsuku eziyi-14 ukuze ifune futhi ibekele omunye umhlaba ofanele. Nokho, ngenxa yesidingo sokubonisana nezithakazelo nokuthola imvume kumphathiswa, le nqubo ingathatha cishe izinyanga ezimbili kuya kwezintathu ukuze iphelelwe. Izindleko ezihilelekile ekutholeni omunye umhlaba ofanele zinciphisa esimweni nasemazingeni. Izinto ezifana nosayizi bomphakathi ofuna umhlaba, kanye nezindleko zomhlaba kule ndawo, nazo zicatshangelwa.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ezikoleni: Izingqinamba Nezinzuzo Ekuqaleni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buye baba yingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, izinhlelo zokufunda ezinokwakhiwa kwezobuchwepheshe zithuthukisa indlela abafundi abafunda ngayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kudala nezingqinamba ezithile. Ngakho-ke, sithumele izimvo ezahlukene ezikhuluma ngezinzuzo nezinkinga zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ezikoleni. Ubufakazi bokuthi ubuchwepheshe bunikeza izinzuzo eziningi bukhona. Okokuqala, ukufunda ngekhompyutha noma ngama-tablets kukhulisa ukufinyelela kolwazi. Abafundi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezincwadini, ezifundweni ezahlukene, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuba baqonde izifundo zabo, baqhubele phambili, futhi bathole ulwazi olujulile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amakhono okuxhumana akhula, njengoba abafundi befunda ukuphendula, ukwenza izinhlelo, futhi babambisane emisebenzini yeqembu. Ngokuphambene, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe kungaholela ekhuluphaleni komqondo nokunciphisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi. Abafundi abavame ukujolisa ezintweni ezikwi-inthanethi, okungaholela ekwenzeni kahle okuncane ezikoleni. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali bubalulekile ukuze kufezwe impumelelo yokufunda. Uma ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomlamli, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi akufanele busebenze njengengxenye eyodwa kuphela yokufunda. Okwesithathu, ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okungaba nzima ezikoleni ezinamathuba amancane. Ukuthenga ama-laptops, ama-tablets, nezinsizakusebenza zama-software akwazi ukuba yinkinga ezikoleni. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza zezimali ezinhle, okungase kube yinkinga ezikhungweni ezithola ukwesekwa okuncane. Abafundi abavela emindenini engakwazi ukukhokhela lezi zinsiza bangase bahluleke ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba othisha befinyeleleka ukuze basize abafundi. Ukufundisa ngendlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kufanele kube yingxenye yohlelo lwezifundo. Othisha kufanele baphinde bafundiswe ngezindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, ukuze bakwazi ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele. Ukuze lokhu kufezwe, izikole kufanele zikhuthaze ukuqhubeka kokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze bahlale belungile futhi bejabulile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubuchwepheshe buye basiza ekwenzeni ukufunda kube mnandi. Uhlelo lokufunda lwezinkanyezi, izinhlelo zokuhlela izifundo, nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa zenza ukufunda kube izinto ezithakazelisayo. Lokhu kwandisa ukuzibophezela kwabafundi, futhi kunikeza ithuba lokucabanga ngokuqhubekayo. Abafundi abajabulela ukufunda ngezinhlobo ezihlukene zokufundisa, futhi ubuchwepheshe budala lezi zindlela ezintsha. Ngakho-ke, uma sizama ukukhokhela izinsiza ezibalulekile, kubalulekile ukuthi siqaphele izinkinga ezitholakala. Ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube yinsiza, hhayi umthwalo. Ukubeka phambili ukufunda komqondo, okukhuthaza ukujula kokucabanga, kubalulekile. Uma izikole ziqhubeka nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, sizokwazi ukuphishekela impumelelo kwabaqhamukayo. Ekugcineni, ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezikoleni kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo eziqondile. Abafundi kumele baqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buwusizo, kodwa abavumele ukuba buphule ubudlelwano obubalulekile obukhona phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi uma ubuchwepheshe busetshenziswa kahle, lungaba ngumkhiqizo omuhle ekuthuthukiseni indlela yokufunda. Lokhu kuzoba yinzuzo ezinkulu, hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumaqembu omphakathi jikelele. Ngalolu hlobo, kufanele siqhubeke sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe ezikoleni, sisondela ekufundeni okuphumelelayo.
Umbiko onikeziwe kanye nazo zonke izimvo zomphakathi zizoba yingxenye yale mibiko. Iningi lomsebenzi we-NA lenziwa kumaKomidi. Umsebenzi wekomidi ngalinye uhambisana nomnyango wezokuphatha ofanele. Isibonelo, iKomidi Lezohwebo Nezimboni libhekana nazo zonke izindaba eziphathelene noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Ikomidi ngalinye linomholi ozokwenza uqinisekise ukuphathwa kahle komsebenzi. AmaKomidi ePhalamende azobhekelela ukuxoxa, ukuphatha izingxoxo, nokuhlela umthetho. AmaKomidi angabamba Ukuhlolwa Komphakathi kumthetho noma ezindabeni ezihlobene nomthetho. AmaKomidi futhi abheka futhi ahlola umsebenzi weminyango kahulumeni. NgokweMthethosisekelo, iPhalamende kudingeka ibandakanye umphakathi enqubweni yokwenza umthetho nakwezinye izinhlelo zePhalamende. AmaKomidi ePhalamende adingeka axhumane namalungu omphakathi ukuze athole iminikelo yabo kumthetho noma ukuze azwe imibono yabo ngezindaba ezibalulekile zizwe. Umphakathi ukhuthazwa ukuba ube neqhaza elivelele ezinkulumweni lapho amaKomidi ebamba Ukuhlolwa Komphakathi. Abantu noma amaqembu akhuthazwa ukuba athumele izikhalazo zomlomo noma ezibhaliwe ngezindaba ezithinta bona. Xhumana namalungu ePhalamende asebenza kwi-NA ukuze ubuze noma ucele ulwazi mayelana nomsebenzi wabo wePhalamende. Hamba ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ezibanjwa amaKomidi ePhalamende. IPhalamende inezindlu ezimbili, okungukuthi iNational Assembly (eyaziwa njenge-NA) kanye neNational Council of Provinces (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). I-NA ivotelekwa kabusha njalo eminyakeni emihlanu ezivotelweni zikaZwelonke. Omunye wemisebenzi eyinhloko ye-NA ukuwuphasa umthetho okumele izwe liphathwe ngawo. I-NA ithumele amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze abhekwane nawo futhi kuphathwe izingxoxo ngalezi zBill. I-NA ingavuma, iphikise, noma ibuyisele amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze kuxoxwe ngaphezulu. IPhalamende inomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlaziya, ukuhlola, nokubheka umsebenzi kahulumeni noma noma yiliphi ilungu le-Executive, mayelana nokuphathwa kwemithetho, ukusetshenziswa kwezimali, nokubheka iMthethosisekelo. Izingxoxo zePhalamende ngezindaba ezibalulekile nokuphakanyiswa nokuvota ngeziphakamiso ezihlobene nomsebenzi kahulumeni. I-NA inegunya elivela kwiMthethosisekelo lokukhetha uMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika phakathi kwamalungu ayo. I-NA inamalungu angu-400 ePhalamende aziwa njenge-MPs. Amalungu e-NA akhethwa ngohlelo olubizwa ngokuthi ukuveza ngokulinganayo. Ngaphambi kokhetho, iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki lidala uhlu lwabafakizicelo abazobamba iqhaza ekhethweni ukuze bakhethwe. Lezi zifakizicelo zikhuluma zikhuluma ngendlela elinganayo nenani lezivote iqembu lezepolitiki elithole ekhethweni. Isibonelo, uma iqembu lithola uhhafu lwezivote, lizothola uhhafu kwezihlalo kwi-NA. Umphakathi kanye noMphakathi wePhalamende baphatha imihlangano ye-NA. Baqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ePhalamende akhuluma ngokukhululeka kodwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho yeNational Assembly. Imithetho yeNdlu inikeza ukuthi abaholi beNdlu basize iziphathimandla zePhalamende ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Abaholi beNdlu bangase badingeke futhi ukuba baphathe izinqubo zeNational Assembly. Iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki kwi-NA likhetha umphakathi omkhulu ozophatha izindaba zalo. UMongameli uqoka umholi wezebhizinisi zikahulumeni osebenza nabaholi bezindlu zombili zePhalamende. Umholi wezebhizinisi zikahulumeni kufanele acabangele izidingo zeBhodi kanye nezinhlelo zikahulumeni kwiPhalamende. Umholi wezebhizinisi zikahulumeni uqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu eBhodi enza imisebenzi yawo yePhalamende.
Ukuhlaziywa KweMidlalo Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imidlalo ibalulekile kakhulu empilweni yabantu. Iphinde ibe yinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi ezweni lethu laseNingizimu Afrika, lapho imidlalo efana nebhola lezinyawo, i-rugby, ne-cricket idume kakhulu. Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kuhilela ukucwaninga, ukuhlola, nokubona izimo ezithile ezithinta imidlalo, abadlali, nezinkampani ezibandakanyekayo. Kulolu hlobo lombiko, sizobheka izici ezahlukene zokuhlaziywa kwemidlalo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nomthelela kwayo emphakathini. Izici Zokuhlaziywa KweMidlalo Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kuhlanganisa izici eziningi ezifana nezibalo, izindlela zokudlala, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Izibalo zibalulekile ngoba zinikeza umbono ocacile ngempumelelo yabadlali nabaphikisi babo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sithatha umphakathi wezemidlalo, izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi abadlali abaphumelele kakhulu bahlala bephumelela ngenxa yokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, kanye nezinhlelo ezinhle zokudlala. Izindlela zokudlala nazo zibalulekile ekuhlaziyeni. Abadlali nabaphathi badinga ukuqonda kahle izindlela ezahlukene zokudlala ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela kahle imidlalo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola amasu, izindlela zokuphatha ibhola, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Ukuhlaziywa kwalezi zindlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola umphumela omuhle. Izinzuzo Zokuhlaziywa KweMidlalo Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kubasiza abadlali ukuthi baqonde kahle amandla namaphutha abo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo. Ngokuhlaziya imidlalo, abadlali bangafunda ukuthi yiziphi izindlela ezisebenza kahle, futhi bangazithuthukisa lapho kudingeka khona. Okwesibili, ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kudala amathuba okuthuthukisa umphakathi. Imidlalo iyindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, futhi uma imidlalo ihlaziywa kahle, abantu bangaba nentshisekelo enkulu. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokubukwa kwemidlalo, okuthuthukisa umnotho wezokungcebeleka. Okwesithathu, ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kusiza abaphathi bezemidlalo ukuthi benze izinqumo ezihamba phambili. Ukuze imidlalo ibenempumelelo, abaphathi badinga ukuqonda izimo zomphakathi, izidingo zabantu, kanye nezimo ezithinta umnotho. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imidlalo iyaphumelela. Umthelela KweMidlalo Emphakathini Imidlalo inomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Iphinde ibe yinsika yokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho abantu bahlukene ngezizinda zabo. Imidlalo ibavumela ukuba bahlangane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo ikhulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Abadlali bahlala befuna ukuphumelela, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokusebenza kanzima. Umphakathi uthola ugqozi olukhulu uma ubona abadlali babo bephumelela, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuzinikela emidlalweni. Ubuchwepheshe Nokuhlaziywa KweMidlalo Ubuchwepheshe buye buba nesandla esikhulu ekuhlaziyeni kwemidlalo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza, izibalo ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezinsiza zokubuka imidlalo zenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukuhlaziya, nokubona izimo ezithinta imidlalo. Lokhu kusiza abaphathi nabadlali ukuba benze izinqumo ezifanele. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokuhlola izimo zomphakathi zingasetshenziswa ukuze kuhlaziywe izithakazelo zabantu emidlalweni ethile. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kungasiza abaphathi ukuthi benze izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nokuthi imaphi imidlalo okufanele igxilwe kuwo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukubukwa. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kwemidlalo kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abadlali, ekwakheni umphakathi, nasekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezokungcebeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye buba nomthelela omkhulu ekuhlaziyeni, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela imidlalo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlola imidlalo, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izinzuzo zokuhlaziywa, ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu, sihlinzeke ngempumelelo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imidlalo iyaphumelela. Imidlalo akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukujabulisa, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Umbiko: Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni Isingeniso Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Zihlinzeka ngempilo, ukwelashwa, nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lezi zibhedlela zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali, uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Kuleli thuluzi, sizobheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta izibhedlela zikahulumeni, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuthuthukiswe lezi zikhungo. Uhlaka lwezibhedlela zikahulumeni Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu. Izibhedlela ezincane, ezivame ukuba sezingxenyeni ezisemaphandleni, zihlala zinikeza imisebenzi eyisisekelo, njengokwelashwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, ukwelashwa kwemindeni, kanye nokunakekelwa kwezifo ezilula. Izibhedlela eziphakathi, ezivame ukuba seziqhingini noma emadolobheni, zihlala zinikeza imisebenzi ebanzi, okubandakanya izinsizakalo ezithuthukile zokwelapha. Izibhedlela ezinkulu, ezivame ukuba seziqhingini ezinkulu, zihlala zinezinhlaka eziningi zokwelapha, zifaka phakathi iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa okukhulu, iziguli ezisengozini, kanye nezinsizakalo zeziguli ezikhethekile. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa odokotela, abahlengikazi, nabanye ochwepheshe bezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho kudingeka khona ukwelashwa, bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezihlukahlukene. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zisebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayazi ngalesi sikhathi, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izivakashi zabo, nokuthi bazi ukuthi izinsiza zikhona. Izinselelo Noma zikhona izinzuzo eziningi, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubantu abaningi. Izibhedlela zihlala zibhekene nokuntuleka kwezinsiza, okuhlanganisa izinsiza zezimali, imishini yokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izibhedlela zingabi namandla okuphendula izidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga zokuphathwa, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. Izixazululo Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abhekelele ukuhlinzeka ngempahla eyanele, kubandakanya izinsiza zezimali, imishini yokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubantu. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezempilo kuzokwenza ukuthi baqhubeke nokuthola ulwazi olusha, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokuxhumana oluphumelelayo phakathi kwezibhedlela nezindawo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Isiphetho Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Noma zikhona izinselelo eziningi, zihlala ziqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubantu abaningi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zisebenza kahle, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziyisibopho sokuhlinzeka ngempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze zisebenze kahle.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuyinqubo ebalulekile emiphakathini eminingi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithola amanzi anhlobonhlobo. Nokho, le nqubo ibandakanya izimpikiswano eziningi ezihlukahlukene, ezithinta izinzuzo, izinkinga, nezindlela zokuphatha. Kulokhu, sizobheka izimpikiswano ezisemqoka ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi, ukuze siqonde kangcono le ndaba. 1. Izizathu Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi kungani amaloli amanzi ethengwa. Ezinye zezizathu zifaka phakathi: - Ukushoda Kwamanzi: Ezinye izindawo zihlala zinesidingo esikhulu samanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomkhuhlane omkhulu noma lapho amanzi engatholakali kalula. Amaloli amanzi anikeza isixazululo esisheshayo sokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. - Ukusebenza Kwezokuthutha: Amaloli amanzi aklanyelwe ukuhamba amanzi ukusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezindaweni ezikude noma ezinzima ukufinyelela. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo: Ezinye izikhathi, izimo eziphuthumayo ezifana nezikhukhula noma izinhlekelele zemvelo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamanzi ngokushesha. Amaloli amanzi angasiza ekuphatheni lezi zimo. 2. Izinzuzo Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Izimpikiswano eziningi zikhuluma ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi: - Ukutholakala Kwamanzi: Amaloli amanzi anikeza ukufinyelela okusheshayo nokulula kwamanzi, okungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokushoda kwamanzi. - Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezempilo: Ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile kubalulekile empilweni. Amaloli amanzi angasiza ekunciphiseni izifo ezithathelwana ngamanzi. - Ukukhuthaza Umnotho: Amaloli amanzi angasiza ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo, njengoba amanzi adingekayo ezimbonini, ezolimo, nakwezinye izinsiza. 3. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi: - Izindleko: Ukuthenga amaloli amanzi kungaba nezindleko eziphezulu, okungase kube yinkinga kumaphrojekthi amancane noma emiphakathini enezinsiza ezilinganiselwe. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuze kuthengwe amaloli amanzi, kudingeka ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. - Ukungabi Nembuyiselo: Uma amaloli amanzi ethengwa, kungenzeka ukuthi abuyele emuva, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezinsiza. 4. Izindlela Zokuphatha Nokuthuthukisa Ukuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuhamba kahle, kunezindlela ezithile eziphakanyisiwe: - Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuthengisa: Ukuze kuthengwe amaloli amanzi ngempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nezikhungo ezithembekile zokuthengisa ezihlinzeka ngamaloli anekhwalithi. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Okunembile: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindleko zihlala ngaphansi kokulawula, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha izimali. - Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi: Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi abaphatha amaloli amanzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi iyenziwa kahle futhi ngokuphepha. 5. Ukubheka Ikusasa Lokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuzodinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ubuchwepheshe Obusha: Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokulawula amanzi, kungasiza ekuphatheni kahle amaloli amanzi. - Izinhlelo Zokuhlola: Ukuhlola njalo izinga lamanzi nokusebenza kwamaloli amanzi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba zibe zinkulu. - Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuhlola: Ukubambisana nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngocwaningo nolwazi olusha kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezintsha. Isiphetho Izimpikiswano ngokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi zibalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Ngokuqonda lezi zimpikiswano, imiphakathi ingathola izixazululo ezisebenzayo nezithuthukisayo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo, umnotho, kanye nezimo zokuphila zabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi le nqubo iyaphumelela.
Izitolo Ezinkulu: Umcimbi Wokuthenga Ohloniphekile Ezindaweni zethu, izitolo ezinkulu, noma "supermarkets" ngesiNgisi, zibe yindawo ebalulekile yokuthenga. Lezi zitolo zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuthengisa obuphambili, futhi zenze kube lula kubathengi ukuthola imikhiqizo eminingi endaweni eyodwa. Umcimbi wethu wokuqala wokuhlola lezi zitolo uhlelwe ukuze sithole ulwazi olujulile, futhi sithokozise abathengi nabanikazi bezitolo. Siqala ngokuhlola ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zaziwa kanjani kuqala. Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, zaba indawo yokuhlangana kwabathengi. Abaningi bezwa ukuthi bayazithokozisa lapho befika ukuze bathole ukudla, izimpahla, nezinsiza ezidingekayo, okukhombisa ukuthi zidlala indima enkulu ekuphuculeni impilo yabantu. Umcimbi wethu wawuhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubanikazi bezitolo, abathengi, kanye nochwepheshe bezokuthengisa. Bakhuluma ngezindlela zokuthengisa, ukuphatha izitolo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, futhi azigcini nje ngokuthengisa. Kwakukhona futhi ithuba lokuhlola imikhiqizo. Abathengi babenethuba lokuhlola okuhlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izimpahla zokugqoka, nezinsiza zasekhaya, futhi baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokubeka izimvo zabo, okubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wagxila ekuthuthukiseni imvelo. Abaningi baphakamisa izindlela zokunciphisa udoti, njengezinto eziphinde zisetshenziswe, okukhombisa ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu ziyakuqonda ukubaluleka kokugcina imvelo. Umcimbi wahlanganisa nezifundo eziphathelene nezokuphepha, lapho abanikazi bezitolo bakhuthaza abathengi ukuba baqaphele izindlela zokuphepha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi baphila kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abathengi bazi ukuthi izitolo zikhathalela impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wethu ubonisa ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokuthenga, zikhuthaza ubudlelwano, futhi zisebenza ekuthuthukiseni imvelo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokusebenzisa lezi zitolo, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukuze sithuthukise ubudlelwano, sithole imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu, futhi sigcine imvelo. Umcimbi uphakamisa ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu azigcini nje ngokuba indawo yokuthenga, kodwa ziba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokufunda, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sizithokozisa lezi zitolo, sihloniphe izinsiza zazo, futhi sibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuthenga. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuthuthukisa impilo yethu, kuqinisekise ukuthi izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zikhona njengendawo ebalulekile empilweni yethu.
Uhlaka: Kuthathwe ku-www.health24. Ukudla ukudla okungcolile nokuphuza amanzi angcolile kungadala izifo eziningi ezithathelwana. Izifo eziningi zingavela uma udla ukudla okungcolile. Isifo esithathelwana ukudla sichazwa ngokukhathala, ukuhamba, ukuhamba okungajwayelekile, kanye nobuhlungu besisu. Amabhaktheriya avame ukudala lesi sifo, kulandelwa amagciwane nezilokazane. Uma ubheka ukudla noma amanzi, akuvamile ukuba kube sobala ukuthi kunezinto ezingadala isifo. Landela umyalezo olandelayo ukusiza ukugwema ukudla ukudla okungcolile noma amanzi. Ngemva kokuphatha inyama eluhlaza noma inhlanzi, geza izandla noma izilonda zakho uma usebenza nokudla. Qinisekisa ukuthi ikhitshi lihlanzekile. Phosa amanzi okuphuza kuqala uma ucabanga ukuthi angcolile. Amanzi aphuma emgqonyeni avamise ukuba acwebile, kodwa amanye avela emifuleni noma emithonjeni angase abe nendle. Amanzi okuphuza ahlanzekile kufanele agcinwe ebhodweni elihlanzekile; uma unendawo yokupholisa, koyise lapho. Qinisekisa ukuthi amanzi asetshenziselwa ukwenza iziphuzo noma iqhwa ahlanzekile. Khumbula ukuthi ungawathathi amanzi angcolile ngesikhathi sokubhukuda noma sokugeza. Hlanza izindawo ezinjengamathafeni nezinsika ngaphambi nangemva kokusebenza nokudla. Hlanza izindawo lapho ukudla kubekwe khona (njengama-shelves namafriji). Hlanza iziphuzo ngokushesha. Sebenzisa ama-cloth ahlukene ekhitshini nakwezinye izindawo zekhaya. Sebenzisa ama-disinfectants (i-bleach) ukugeza ama-cloth, ama-sponge, nama-dishcloth bese uwabeka ngaphandle ukuze omiswe elangeni - lokhu kusiza ukubulala amagciwane. Uma unomikrowave, shisa ama-cloth imizuzwana engama-60. Hlanza phansi kwekhitshi ngama-cloth asetshenziselwa le njongo kuphela. Geza izitsha, ama-knife, ama-fork, kanye nama-cutting boards kahle emanzini ashisayo anensipho - geza ngamanzi amasha uma enezinkinga ezinkulu. Geza izitsha ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Thenga izinto ezintsha uma ezindala zikhubazekile kakhulu. Amagciwane aphila phakathi kwezikhala zezinto zokudlela, izinto ze-plastiki, kanye nama-cutting boards. Sebenzisa i-cutting board eyodwa yokudla okungcolile. Kungaba kuhle ukusebenzisa i-board eyodwa yokusika inyama nenhlanzi kanti enye yokusika ezinye izidlo. Ungaphindi usebenzise izinto zokudlela ezisikiwe inyama ngaphandle kokuzigeza ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Beka udoti ebhodweni elivulekile - phuma udoti njalo futhi ugeza ibhodwe. Umnyango wekhitshi nezinsika kufanele kuvulwe kaningi ukuze kuvumele umoya ohlanzekile, omile ungene ukuze kuvinjezelwe ukwakheka kwe-mold.
Odokotela Nabahlengikazi: Izindima Eziyinhloko Empilweni Yomphakathi KwaZulu-Natali, 22 kuCwaninga 2023 – Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, odokotela nabahlengikazi baqhubeka bephendula ngezimpilo zethu, bezivumelanisa nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezifo, ubhubhane nokunye, lezi zinsiza zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono. Odokotela, njengoba bes Nolwazi olunzulu kwezokwelapha, banezibopho ezinkulu. Bahlinzeka ngeluleko nosizo emithini, balungisa izinkinga ezinzima zempilo, futhi banikeza ithemba kulabo abakhalwe yizinkinga ezinzima. Odokotela bahlala befundisa ngokubaluleka kokugcina impilo kahle, beqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi kabanzi ngempilo yabo. Bayakwazi ukuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, futhi abanamahluleli, bazihlanganisa kakhulu nomsebenzi wabo. Naphezu kokuba odokotela benza imisebenzi ebalulekile, abahlengikazi bayabahlobisa kulezi zinsizakalo. Abahlengikazi banikeza ukunakekelwa okukhulu, behlola izimo zempilo zeziguli nsuku zonke. Basiza ekuphenduleni ezimweni eziphuthumayo futhi balungiselela iziguli ukukhethwa kwemithi efanele. Ngaphandle kokunakekela, abahlengikazi basiza ukuhlelela izinhlelo zokwelapha zansuku zonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kusebenza kwezakhamuzi kunika igunya elikhulu kubo bobabili. Ukuhlobana phakathi kwabo, odokotela nabahlengikazi, kuveza ubudlelwane obubalulekile bokuxhumana. Lokhu kusebenzisana phakathi kwabo kubalulekile, njengoba kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zikhululiwe futhi zinesiqiniseko sokuba nempilo engcono. Odokotela banika abahlengikazi ithuba lokwenza imisebenzi yabo, kanti abahlengikazi benza izinto ezenzakalayo zibe lula kumadokhumenti, okwenza umsebenzi uhambe kahle. Naphezu kwezimo zomsebenzi eziyinkimbinkimbi, odokotela nabahlengikazi baphinde bahlale bephikelela ekuthuthukiseni izimpendulo zempilo. Banamabanga okubambisana nabezindaba, bahlola ukuthuthukiswa kwezokwelapha, futhi beqonda izidingo ezikulu zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kudala umphakathi ophilayo, ophethe izinsiza ezisiza abantu ukuze bahlukane nezimo ezingezinhle. Kodwa-ke, nakuba odokotela nabahlengikazi benza imisebenzi emangalisayo, bayakwenziwa nemithwalo engapheli. Ubunzima obuhambisana nesikhathi sokusebenza, ukungabi nabambiswano ezindaweni eziyinkimbinkimbi futhi dalela isimo somnotho esinzima kudala ukungezwani. Odokotela bathola izinsuku eziyinkimbinkimbi, kanti abahlengikazi bahlushwa phakathi kokuphila kwabantu abanesidingo esiphuthumayo. Kumele sinakekele lezi zinsiza, sigcizelele ukubaluleka kokuxhasa odokotela nabahlengikazi emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kungafaka izinsizakalo zokuqeqeshwa nokubambisana ezindaweni zokwelapha, ukuze kufakwe izindlela ezizokwandisa ukusebenza kwabo. Ngesikhathi umhlaba udlula ezimeni ezinzima, ukwaziwa kwezikhungo zempilo zibalulekile ekukhuseleni impilo, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlinzeka ngeluleko elibalulekile ekuhlangabezaneni nezinselelo ezinzima, bahlala bekhanda ubuthakathaka bezempilo emphakathini. Emhlabeni wokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala beneqhaza elibalulekile. Kufanele sibe nomoya ophakeme, sizigqugquzele kulezi zinsizakalo eziza nabuphukuphuku bokushintsha izimo zempilo, futhi sihlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubantu. Imininingwane yokugcina: Odokotela nabahlengikazi basebenzisa isizinda sabo sokusebenza ukuze benze ukuphila kube ngcono, bazi kahle ukuthi impilo yisantande ibalulekile. Umsebenzi wabo unika izethembiso ezinzile, futhi uhlelo lwemphilo luthola ukwesekwa okuhle, kuhlangene noBaba nomama, abenza kube nokuxhumana okuvelele kokuphila. Impilo ithintwa kakhulu yizinqumo ezenziwe izinsiza, futhi lokhu kuhlangana kugcizelela umsebenzi born, usebenzisana ekwakheni umhlaba ophilayo. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bemelela okuhle ukuthi umphakathi uzothuthuka, futhi basiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho, kufanele sibe nesibopho, sibe neqhaza elihle ekuhlonipheni lolu thando olunikela ekuphileni kwethu.
Umbiko: Izinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi Umphakathi unendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imisakazo yomphakathi, kodwa uhamba nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuxhaswa. Imisakazo yomphakathi iyinsiza ebalulekile yokwazisa, imisebenzi, nemicabango ehlukahlukene, kodwa izinselelo zokuxhaswa kwezimali zenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Uhlelo lwezimali olukhishwe nguhulumeni lunemithetho ethile eyenza kube nzima ukufinyelela kulokhu, okudinga umphakathi ukuba ube neqhaza elikhulu. Lokhu kwehluleka kokuxhaswa kwenza kube nzima ukwabelana ngemininingwane nemibono emisha, kuholele ekuncipheni kwamathuba okusebenza kwemikhankaso. Umlando ubonisa ukuthi imisakazo yomphakathi ivame ukuxhaswa ngencane, njengaseJohannesburg Community Radio Station, ethola uxhaso oluncane, ibhekene nezinkinga zokugcina abasebenzi, okungaholela ekwehleni kwekhwalithi yezinhlelo zayo. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekwakheni okuqukethwe okukhangayo ezindaweni ezingezona ezomnotho. Ngokubheka iNkomba yeMithombo yeZindaba, imisakazo yomphakathi ihluleka ukufinyelela emaphesheni amakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela ubudlelwano bebhizinisi nabaxhasi. Ukuntuleka kwemali yokuxhasa kuyinkinga enkulu esivele eminyakeni edlule, futhi lokhu kuhlobene nezizathu ezahlukene ezifana nezinkinga zezimali, izinqubomgomo eziyinkimbinkimbi, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta abantu abathintekayo. Imithombo engaxhasiwe inezikhiqizayo ezithile, kodwa ibhendi lempumelelo yezenhlalo ibonakala liphansi. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ezinye izikhungo zisebenzisa izindlela ezintsha, ezifana nezinhlelo zokubambisana, ukuze zithuthukise ubudlelwano nemiphakathi. Ngokombiko weMasipala weJozini, imithetho ethile ivimbela imiphakathi ukuba ikhulume ngezindaba ezithinta ubuhlakani, okwenza kube nzima ukwakha imikhankaso ebalulekile. Amashishini amancane nemikhankaso yahlukile ayathola izinselelo ezithinta ubumqoka bempilo, okukhumbuza imiphakathi ukuba ibhange ezikhalweni zayo zamakhaya. Lokhu kuholela ekuthenjweni kumithombo yezenhlalo, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi amancane ukuthola ukuxhaswa. Kubhalwe ukuthi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezenziwe ezimfundazweni zamasiko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisakazo yomphakathi iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali oluyingqayizivele. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi komphakathi, izimanga, nemithombo yempilo. Uhlelo lokuxhasa imisebenzi yomphakathi kumele luhambisane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kudingeka ukuthi uHulumeni nabaxhasi baqale ukuvuma izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Imizamo yokwakha amakhono, ukufundisa abasebenzi, kanye nezikhungo ezikhethekile kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwemithombo eyanele yokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi. Ekuphetheni, imisakazo yomphakathi ibalulekile ekuhlanganiseni izwi, izinkolelo, nemicabango ehlukahlukene. Nokho, izinselelo zokuxhasa kufanele zixazululwe ukuze kuqhubeke ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, okuzodlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Izinzuzo zalesi sikhathi sizothuthukisa umphakathi jikelele, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zomphakathi zisebenze zikhululeke ukuze ziphumelele. Imisakazo yomphakathi izothola izixazululo eziphusile ukuze igweme izinkinga ezithile, futhi ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile.
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Ukujula Kwezemidlalo Emhlabeni Wokuzijabulisa Eminyakeni edlule, imidlalo yevidiyo iye yaba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Emhlabeni wonke, abantu baye bahlola imikhakha eyahlukene yevidiyo, okukhuluma izilaleli ezincane, eziphakathi nendawo, nezinkulu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo akusikho kuphela okwenziwa ngentshiseko, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana, yokufunda, kanye nokukhuthaza ubuciko. ### Ukukhula Kwezimboni Zevidiyo Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ibalulekile, kufanele siqale ngokuhlola ukukhula kwayo eminyakeni edlule. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezifana ne-Activision, Ubisoft, kanye ne-Electronic Arts, zivele zisebenza kanzima ekwakheni imidlalo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kukhula kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza eziphambili, ezinjengezinhlelo zokusebenza, ama-computer, kanye namakhonsoli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyatholakala ku-inthanethi, okuvumela ababukeli abavela emhlabeni wonke ukuba baxhumane futhi badlale ndawonye. ### Umthelela Wokuthuthukiswa KwezeMidlalo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo ithole ukuthandwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha. Abantwana nabantu abadala basenokudlala imidlalo yokwakha, yokuhlasela, neyezemidlalo, okwenza basebenze izinjongo ezihlukene. Lokhu kuhilela ukuzijabulisa, kepha futhi kudinga amakhono ahlukahlukene. Imithetho yevidiyo yokwakha imiphumela yokucabanga, yokuhlela, nesikhathi sokuphendula esisheshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi. Abadlali baye bakwazi ukuhlangana, babelane ngamava, futhi baphumelele ndawonye. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwenza umhlaba ubonakale uhlobo olukhulu lokuxhumana. ### Izinselelo Nezindaba Zamanje Noma imidlalo yevidiyo ijabulela impumelelo enkulu, ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukukhathazeka ngempilo yezeMpilo, ukuhlukunyezwa ku-inthanethi, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha kuhlale kuphakamisa imibuzo eminingi. Izingane eziningi zikhuluma ngengcindezi yokudlala imidlalo isikhathi eside, okwenza kube nezinkinga zempilo ezinjengokungasebenzi, udlame, nokungena ezinhlelweni ezimbi. Izinkampani zidinga ukuhlela imithetho esobala yokuvikela abadlali, ikakhulukazi izingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izilawuli zokudlala, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphepha, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imidlalo ethile ifaneleka kubantu abancane kuphela. ### Ikusasa Lemidlalo Yevidiyo Ngokubheka phambili, ikusasa lemidlalo yevidiyo libukeka likhulu. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, futhi izinkampani ziyaqhubeka nokwakha imidlalo ethokozisayo. Ukusebenzisa i-virtual reality (VR) kanye ne-augmented reality (AR) kuyindlela yokuhamba phambili, evumela abadlali ukuba baqaphele imidlalo ngendlela engakaze ibonakale. Lokhu kuzokwenza imidlalo ibe nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imisebenzi ye-esports iyakhula, futhi imicimbi yokuncintisana ibonisa imisebenzi emisha yokuzijabulisa. Abadlali be-Esports baye bathola ukudlalwa ezingeni eliphezulu, okuhlinzeka ngethuba lokuthola imiklomelo emikhulu. ### Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wokuzijabulisa. Itholakala emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini, futhi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano. Noma izinselelo zikhona, uma ziqhutshwa ngezindlela ezinhle, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba yinsika eqinile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Umhlaba wethu uhlale ushintsha, futhi imidlalo yevidiyo izoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lapho abantu bahlala behlangene, bejabule, futhi besebenza ndawonye. Imidlalo yevidiyo, ngakho-ke, akusikho kuphela ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha umphakathi ongcono. Njengoba sithokozisa imidlalo yevidiyo, kufanele siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokwakha indawo ephephile, evulekile, nenempilo kubo bonke abadlali. Imidlalo yevidiyo akusikho kuphela ukukhumbula, kodwa futhi kuyajabulisa — umhlaba wokuzijabulisa ongenamkhawulo.
Ukunakekelwa Kwabantu Abadala: Izidingo Nezixazululo Isingeniso Emphakathini wethu wamanje, ubudala bungakhethwa njengomthombo wokuhlakanipha, kodwa futhi buphinde bubonise izinselelo eziningi. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala sekuyinselele enkulu emiphakathini yethu, njengoba iminyaka yempilo ibonakala ikhula, futhi abantu abaningi behamba phambili ekugugeni. Lokhu kukhuphula isidingo sokunakekelwa okungcono kwabantu abadala, okumele kuhambisane nezidingo zabo ezithile. Izidingo Zokunakekelwa Abantu abadala banemfuno ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukusekelwa kwezenhlalo, nezidingo zempilo yengqondo. Ukuze abantu abadala baphile kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale bephila endaweni ethule futhi enokuthula, enezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kudinga ukuba abantu abadala bahlale benokuxhumana okuhle nochwepheshe bezempilo, bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza ezisemthethweni zokwelashwa, futhi bathole usizo lapho kudingeka. Kukhona Izinselelo Nokho, kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nokunakekelwa kwabantu abadala. Ukuze abantu abadala baphile kahle, udaba lokuqashwa kwabantu abanothando nolwazi lokunakekela, kuyinselelo enkulu. Abantu abaningi abathandi ukungena emsebenzini wokunakekela abantu abadala, nokwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngensiza eyanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi uthola umgudu omncane wokuhlinzeka ngemithombo yokusekela, okungaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlale bedinga usizo. Izixazululo Zokunakekelwa Ukuze kusizakale abantu abadala, kudinga ukukhula kwemikhankaso yokwazisa abantu ngokuqwashisa ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufundisa imindeni ngokuqonda izidingo ezithile zabantu abadala, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abadala nemiphakathi yabo. Ukwazi ukuthi abantu abadala bangathola usizo olufanele, kunciphisa ukuchithwa kwabantu abadala futhi kubavikela ekutheni bafeze imisebenzi ethile emphakathini. Ukwakhiwa Kwenhlangano Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo ezahlukene. Izinhlelo ezihlanganisa uhulumeni, izikhungo zabantu, kanye nemindeni, zibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekunikezeni ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ukuze abantu abadala bazi ukuthi bahlale bephila kahle, izikhungo zokunakekela kufanele zibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ezibandakanya ukudla okunempilo, imishanguzo, nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezisemthethweni kumele zikhuthaze imisebenzi yokunakekela, ukuze kube nezisebenzi ezihloniphekile ezizokwazi ukunakekela abantu abadala ngendlela efanele. Ukwaziswa Emphakathini Ukuze sikhulume ngezidingo zabantu abadala, imiphakathi kufanele iqhube imikhankaso yokufundisa nokwazisa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi imisebenzi yokungeza abantu abadala emphakathini, ukukhuthaza imindeni ukuthi ibambe iqhaza ekunakekeleni, nokwakha izindawo ezithokozisayo ukuze abantu abadala bazithokozise. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemindeni nabantu abadala kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Izifundo Ezijulile Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akugcini nje ngempilo yabo, kodwa kubalulekile nempilo yethu sonke. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu abadala bazoqhubeka nokuba yizinsika emiphakathini yethu, bese bephila impilo egculisayo. Ukuba nezinselelo akuphikisi ukuphila kwabantu abadala, kodwa kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo ukuze sikulungele. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bathola ukunakekelwa okudinga. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kudinga ubuhlakani, ukuzinikela, nokuqonda okukhulu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele simise imizamo yokukhulisa izinga lokunakekelwa kwabantu abadala, ukuze baphile impilo egculisayo, benothando, futhi bekwazi ukubamba iqhaza emiphakathini yabo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abadala bangomndeni wethu, izinsika zethu, futhi banelungelo lokuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngakho-ke, masithathe izinyathelo ukuze sikhulise ubudlelwano, sikhuthaze ukuthanda, futhi sikhulise umhlaba ophilayo kubantu abadala.
Bahlala bephathwa ngendlela ekhombisa ukuthula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Nokho, ukubekezela kwabantu akusho ukuthi kuphelelwe. Siphothule umhlangano owanika imiphumela eminingi futhi owaba productive. Umkhiqizi wezinhlobo ezahlukene zamathawula: amathawula anama-spring noma lawo anama-foam noma lawo anemathuluzi okusekela phakathi; amathawula e-cellular rubber noma amathawula epulasitiki. Ukuhlinzeka, ukuhambisa, nokwakha itende ngesikhathi esifanele sokuhlala okuhlukahlukene. Izingane eziphilile kakhulu yilezo ezithola ubisi kuphela. Chofoza kuthebhu ye-Backlog ukuze uhlole i-backlog esele. Kunalokho, i-ANC ichitha okungelona iqiniso bonke labo ababelwe ohlakeni lukamasipala njengabantu abahlukunyezwa ngokobuhlanga futhi baqhubeka behlukunyezwa, ama-Abansunzu aseNingizimu Afrika. Asikhethelanga lokho, abaphathi bacelwa ukuthi bangawubheki umhlangano. Kunconyelwe ukuthi iziphathimandla zisebenzise ama-shapefile tablets afanele kuwo wonke umgwaqo obekwe. Lokhu kuphakanyiswa phezulu kwezinguquko zezulu kanye nomthelela wayo omkhulu ezweni elithuthukayo elishintshe indlela abathatha ngayo izinqumo mayelana nezindaba zendawo. Bazoba nokukhathazeka ngohwebo nokuhlangabezana nezibopho zenkontileka nabahlinzeki. Lokhu kufaka nezimuli ezithintekile yimpi nokuphikisana, ngokwesibonelo, ngokugcina i-Central Tracing Agency eGeneva. Uhambe endleleni yezinkanyezi nezinkanyezi. Ikuhlanga kwenethiwekhi yezinkomba ezizimele, ukuze kube lula ukuphonsa phansi ukuphawula. Babizwa ngokuthi ngababheki kule komishana. Ukuqwashisa ngokuqhuba kakhulu amafutha okupheka. Ukuhlonza noma yiziphi izimo nezithiyo ezisebenza ngaphansi kwelayisense. Ubhontshisi uthinteke kakhulu yinkampani yezulu ekuqaleni konyaka nakwamanzi aphakeme kwezinye izingxenye zelizwe. Imiphakathi ethintekile kakhulu yizigameko zokudlula kwabantu abaningi izosizwa ukuze ibhekane nezinye izindawo zomnotho. Ama-poster ajwayelekile aboshwe ezindongeni azovunyelwa kuphela lapho engathinti kabi ukubukeka komgwaqo nasendaweni. Lezi zimbali zaziwa njengezithanda ilanga, ziqina emanzini, futhi zihlala zikhona emhlabathini. Ezinye izimoto ezineziwombe ezimbili zathinteka kakhulu ngesikhathi sokudubula namaphoyisa. Amasosha ethu olwandle azobamba uqeqesho nabalingani babo baseShayina. Lawa ngama-hero nama-heroine, ngokudabukisayo, awaphakanyiswa kakhulu. Kubantu, kudala izifo ezithile, kwesinye isikhathi akuthinti neze. Azikho izitebhisi zensimbi ezizobekwa ngqo lapho ama-poster azoboniswa. Isikhathi esomile ngesikhathi semvula enkulu sidala inkinga enkulu. Ukusebenza okuqinile kwemikhiqizo ethunyelwa phesheya kubeka ukuzinza kwezomnotho endleleni yokukhula. Lokhu akuyona uhlu oluhlanganisa konke, kodwa uhlu oluncane nolunezincazelo ezingase zibe usizo kumphakathi mayelana nalolu daba. Ngethabela ukuhlinzeka ngokudla, amatafula akhombisa ukwakheka kwemikhiqizo yokudla etholakalayo futhi, lapho ukuhlaziywa kokudla kungatholakali, lawa matafula ahlinzeka ngemininingwane esebenziseka. Um husband uthunjwa ngenxa yokuhlasela nokuhlose ukudala umonakalo emzimbeni. Omunye wemigomo ekhona yokulawula ukusabalala ukusebenzisa uhlelo lokuhlola ukuhlanzeka. Uhlelo lwakamuva lokufaka idatha yakamuva nokubhala kabusha imithetho yokundiza. Qala izinsizakalo zokuhlanza udoti ezindaweni ezingakwazi ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsizakalo futhi ezikhona kahle eNingizimu Afrika.
