Nokho, uhlelo lokuthuthukisa ludinga ukuzibophezela okufanayo nokwandisa kakhulu ukusebenza kwethu. Izinhlelo zokuhlala kufanele ziqalwe ngendlela ekhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa. Khuthaza ukususa udoti ngendlela efanele ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze udoti. Kuzoba nokukhuthazwa kokusebenzisa izikhumulo zezindiza ngezindlela eziningi, ngenkathi kugcinwa ukusebenza okufanele nokuphephile. Iflegi yethu kazwelonke ne-emblem kazwelonke nakho kuyizimpawu zokubuyisana. Uqhubeka nethenda yamasiko esakazeka futhi esashintshashintsha. Izikhombisi-ndlela zokubuka izilwane zasolwandle kuqoqo olubizwa ngokuthi ama-cetaceans zikhona futhi umthetho uhlaziywa. Kubekwe endaweni ebonakalayo lapho umphakathi uhamba khona. Isicelo sokwembulwa kufanele sithunyelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bekukhona ingxoxo mayelana ne-check. Izinga nendawo yesizinda esiwile akurekhodwanga kahle. Sithole izixolelo kusukela ekuseni mayelana nokubizwa kwamagama. Uhlelo oluqhubekayo lokufundisa amakhono lunikezwa yiSikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikhono lokwenza umsebenzi. Ngifisa nonke izingxoxo eziphumelelayo nokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika okuzokhula. Ingabe ukhuluma ngendawo efakwe ekhoneni kwesokudla kwesithombe? Sibona kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi sifeze uhlelo lwethu lokuthuthukisa. Sheshisa uhlelo lokuqala izinhlelo zokuthi abafundi basebenze ezindaweni ezihlobene nalokho abakufundile ngokuqinile emkhakheni wezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuhlangana kokuthula nokuzinza kwezomnotho kufanele kugcizelelwe. Lezi zimbili zingase zibe nezithiyo zokufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Leqembu lifaka ukwakhiwa nokulungiswa kweziqhingi zokuzijabulisa nezinye iziqhingi zokuzijabulisa noma zokuncintisana, kuhlanganise nama-trailer, ama-kayak omuntu oyedwa, nezikebhe ezivuthayo. Amaqembu azovuma ukusetshenziswa kolimi oluphikisana nolwazi olungadala ukungezwani, ukungavumelani kwezombusazwe, kanye nenhlonipho yokobuhlanga. Le sikole inezinsimbi eziningi ze-string, kanye nezinsimbi ze-brass. Izikhala zokucwaninga ngezifo kumele zihlinzeke futhi zisheshise umsebenzi ukuze kusizwe ngokushesha ukuhlonza lokho okuthinta isiguli kanye nokwelashwa kwaso. Okulandelayo kuyisitatimende esenziwe futhi sathunyelwa kuwe. Izindawo ezisebenzisa ifoyili yekhwalithi ephezulu zigcinwa zivaliwe nezilwane ezidinga amazinga aphezulu okudla kanti lezo ezisebenzisa ifoyili yekhwalithi ephansi zigcinwa zivaliwe nezilwane ezinezimfuno zokudla eziphansi kakhulu. Ucelwa ukuthi ubheke ukuthi yini engakwenziwa ukuze kusebenze lezi ziqephu ezintathu ukuze kudaleke uhlelo lwezomnotho olusebenzayo noluhlanganisayo. Ngemigwaqo ebekwe ukuze kube khona amanzi nemud thathwe yizinkomo kungancishiswa ngokuqinisa uma izilwane zisuswa ekhempini. Kubonisa ukuthi lokho okuhlolwayo kuqale ngendlela efanayo. Ukwakhiwa okuhlanganisiwe noma ukukhipha kwemikhiqizo efana ne-petroleum jelly, paraffin wax, nezinye i-petroleum waxes, kanye nezinsalela zemikhiqizo efana ne-petroleum coke, ne-petroleum bitumen, njll. Isikhumulo sikhula ngesimo saso njengendawo eyaziwa kahle yokwakha ubuchwepheshe ezweni, emhlabeni, nasezifundazweni. NgokweMseshi Collins, ukuqeqeshwa akutholakali, kusize ukumelana nalokho abebhekene nakho. I-Flying Squad iyinsiza yokubhekana nezimo eziphuthumayo ezihlobene namaphoyisa. Uma ngifuna ukuphendula kumakhasimende ami ngeke ngivule ithawula kodwa ngizokwenza kancane. Kulindeleke
Ubulungiswa bezomthetho bokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya buqondiswa uMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya futhi busebenza nasekukhulumeni okukhona phakathi kwabantu abahlala ndawonye. Omunye onengane futhi. Noma iyiphi enye indlela yokucindezela noma yokuhlukunyezwa engase ibangele umonakalo empilweni yakho, ukuphila, noma inhlalakahle. Vula icala lobugebengu emaphoyiseni futhi ufake isicelo sokuvikelwa. Lokhu kuyisiyalo esikhishwe yinkantolo ngesicelo sakho sokucindezela umuntu othile onobudlelwano obuseduze nawe, ukuba ayeke ukuhlukunyezwa futhi avimbele lowo muntu ukuthola usizo kwabanye ukuze enze lo msebenzi wokuhlukunyezwa. Isiyalo sokuvikelwa esikhashana singakhishwa phakathi nosuku noma ebusuku ukuze sikuvikele engozini. Uzokwaziswa ngamalungelo akho nezinyathelo ongazithatha. Sizogcina ikhophi yesiyalo sokuvikelwa futhi sigcine amarekhodi azo zonke izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya ezizokwenzeka kamuva. Sizobhala ukukhala kwakho kwi-Register yeZigameko esiteshini njengengxenye yobufakazi bokuthi ubike le ndaba - lokhu kuzoba ubufakazi obengeziwe ukusiza thina lapho sibika ngentuthuko yecala. Sizophanda ekhaya lakho, sithathe noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezikhali ezingase zibe khona kumuntu ophazamisa ukuphila kwakho. Sizokwenze lokhu uma kutholakala ukuthi umqondo noma ukuziphatha komhlukunyezwa, umqondo wokuhlukumeza, utshwala, noma imithi kungaholela emonakalweni komunye umuntu. Futhi sicebisa umuntu ohlukunyezwayo. Futhi ngezikhathi lapho le nsizakalo echazwe itholakala. Sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi insizakalo yokusiza iqoqe futhi ibhalise bonke ubufakazi bokuphila obuzoba yingxenye yokweseka noma yisiphi isimo sobugebengu esingase sibe khona. Sizokuhambisana uma uhamba ekhaya ukuze uthathe izinto zakho, uma isiyalo sokuvikelwa esikhishwe sikhombisa lokhu. Uma amaphoyisa engawalandeli la msebenzi, bika le ndaba kumphathi wesiteshi samaphoyisa. Sizothumela imibiko yenyanga yokukhala ethunyelwe ngamalungu enhlangano yamaphoyisa eqondiswe kwiHhovisi Elikhulu Lamaphoyisa. Uma uphakathi kwengozi esheshayo, umhlukunyezwa uzoboshwa. Uma kungelona peligro, umhlukunyezwa uzonikezwa isaziso sokuthi kufanele avele enkantolo ngosuku olulandelayo. Uma kwenzeka, qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zakho (nengane) ziphakanyiswe futhi zigcinwe endaweni ephephile (isibonelo, kubakhelwane). Qinisekisa ukuthi uthathe wonke amadokhumenti abalulekile afana nokukhombisa, ikhadi leklinikhi, ikhadi lebhange, njll.
Ulwazi Oluholwa Ngamazwi Ezikhungweni: Umphumela Wokuxhumana Okuphumelelayo Izikhungo, njengezikole, izibhedlela, noma izinhlangano ezahlukene, ziwumgogodla wobuntu bethu. Njengoba sithuthuka emhlabeni wesimanje, ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka phambili, kodwa uma kukhulunywa ngokuqonda kwemfundo nokwaziswa, izwi, noma "izwi" ngokwesiko, lisaluhlaza. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ulwazi oluholwa ngamazwi ezikhungweni lukhona ezihlalweni eziningi, futhi kubalulekile ukuba nokuqonda okuhle ngalolu hlobo lokuxhumana. Uma sithatha izikole, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali kudinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lufinyelela ezandleni ezifanele. Othisha banendima ebalulekile ekwenzeni lesi simo sibe ngempumelelo. Uthisha ophumelelayo, ophinde akhulume ngokuhlonipha, uthuthukisa izinga lokuxhumana. Umsebenzi wokwethula ulwazi ungabuyiselwa emuva kumchwepheshe obucayi, ongakwazi ukuveza imicabango yakhe ngendlela enembile, evulekile, nethe xaxa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhungo ezifana nezibhedlela zidinga ukuxhumana ngempumelelo kakhulu. Lapha, izwi libalulekile, ngoba kufanele sithole ulwazi oluthile, oluhlobene nezempilo. Ochwepheshe bezempilo, kungaba odokotela, abahlengikazi, noma abanye, kumele bakwazi ukuphendula ngemigomo yokwelashwa, izinqubo, nezindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Ubuchwepheshe buphinde bube yinsika, kodwa izwi lesazi sebenzisa umqondo ojulile. Njengoba sithuthuka, ukuhambisana kokwazi kwenziwa okuhle, okuyinto okufanele ibhekwane kahle. Okubalulekile ukuthi, izwi alifani nohlelo lwe-computer; linomoya, imizwa, nolwazi. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda, okungokwengqondo. Uma sibheka izikhungo, ukudala umuzwa wokuxhumana okukhuluma ngenhlonipho nokwabelana lwezwi kuyadingeka. Umphakathi ungamukeleka uma bonke abahlanganyeli, abangamaqabane, behlanganyela, futhi benza izinqumo ezisenqabeni. Lokhu kukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi nokuphumelela ekusebenzelaneni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngifuna ukufakazela ukuthi izwi lingenza umehluko omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwezikhungo. Njengomphakathi, umphumela okufanele siwufune, ukuhlanganisa izwi halomuntu siqu naleso esakheni umphakathi. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kuholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo, ukufunda, nezinsizakalo abantu abazithola. Ngabe sizothola kanjani lezi zinsiza ngaphandle kokuxhumana okuphumelelayo? Izikhungo kufanele ziphazamise umqondo wokuthi izwi lingocezu olwengeziwe. Ingabe izikhungo eziningi ziyakwazi ukufaka izwi ezinhlelweni zazo? Ukwengeza, ukwenyusa ukuvumelana nokukhuluma phakathi kwabantu, lokhu kungashintsha indlela izikhungo ezisebenza ngayo, zenze ucwaningo, futhi zandise amathuba okukhula. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kwezinga lokwazi nokuqonda, okwenza kube lula ukuzwakala kwamazwi ahlukeneyo. Emphakathini, ulwazi oluholwa ngamazwi lungakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bejola. Umphakathi odinga izwi elidala ubudlelwane, ubuhlobo, nemfuno yokwazisa. Ukubona izinto lapho umphakathi ungababanga kubalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuphinda kuxhumane ezikhungweni zethu. Uhlelo lokukhuluma ngokuhlanganyela nokuqhubeka kwengeza amandla ezwi. Ngokubonayo, izwi aliyona into ethinta ngaphansi okuphathelene; ingxenye yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu ebhalwa ezikhungweni kumele ibuyiselwe emathubeni. Kubhalwe ukuthi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuvikela ukuba izwi lisemthethweni, lisekhona, futhi lihlale luhlaza. Ukuxhumana okukhululekile kuholela emisebenzini ethile, nezimpendulo ezinhle. Uma sikhuluma ngezwi, kufanele sazi imiphumela ezibona uma sithola ulwazi olunembile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo nobuchwepheshe bungakhuthaza umoya wokukhuluma. Umphakathi ofunda kahle uthola ukuthi izwi alibuyisheleli kuphela umqondo, kodwa futhi linikeza izimo ezihlukene. Kubhalwe ukuthi izikhungo ziqhube ukusimama kwezwi, ngenhlonipho, ngezixhumanisi eziqinile. Ekugcineni, ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi oluholwa ngamazwi ezikhungweni luhlobene ngokuqinile nezifiso zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izwi libalulekile ekwenzeni umphakathi, kulungiselela ukuziphatha okuhle, nemfundo eqhubekayo. Izikhungo ezifuna ukuba nesithunzi zidinga ukuqonda ukuthi izwi akusiyona into elula; yinsika yokwakha ubuntu. Ngakho, sizokwazi ukudala umhlaba osemdlalini, okukhombisa impumelelo yokuxhumana kokuphila kwabantu. Sicela sixhume, sithumele izwi lethu ezikhungweni ukuze siphokophele ubuchwepheshe bezwi obukhona.
Impilo Yengqondo: Q&A Umbuzo 1: Yini impilo yengqondo? Impilo yengqondo ibhekisela esimweni sokusebenza kahle kwengqondo, okuhlanganisa imizwa, ukucabanga, nokuziphatha. Kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu abe nempilo yengqondo enhle ukuze akwazi ukuphila impilo egculisayo, enempilo, futhi enezinhloso. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwazi ukuphatha ukukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, nokunye okungase kubangele izinkinga. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza impilo yengqondo ibe yinhle? Impilo yengqondo ithonywa izinto eziningi, kufaka phakathi ubudlelwano obuhle, ukwesekwa komphakathi, imisebenzi ethokozisayo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo. Ukudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokuphumula kahle kubalulekile ekuphatheni impilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda amakhono okuphatha ingcindezi nokukhathazeka kungasiza ekuqiniseni impilo yengqondo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinkinga ezivamile zempilo yengqondo? Izinkinga ezivamile zempilo yengqondo zifaka phakathi ukukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, i-bipolar disorder, ne-schizophrenia. Lezi zimo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu, zishintshe indlela abacabanga ngayo, abaphila ngayo, futhi baphatheka ngayo. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela lezi zinkinga ukuze uthole usizo olufanele. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe abantu bangazithola kanjani izinsiza zokwelashwa? Abantu abangase babe nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo bangathola usizo ezikhungweni zezempilo, kumakliniki, noma kumalungu omphakathi. Ukuze uthole usizo, ungathintana nodokotela, umelaphi, noma umeluleki. Kukhona nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile ezitholakala kumasayithi we-inthanethi, okubandakanya izinhlelo zokwelapha ezikwi-inthanethi. Umbuzo 5: Yini engathuthukisa impilo yengqondo? Ukuze uthuthukise impilo yengqondo, kubalulekile ukufaka izindlela ezithile empilweni yakho. Lokhu kungabandakanya: 1. Ukuzivocavoca: Ukuzivocavoca kuzosiza ukukhulisa imizwa emihle nokunciphisa ingcindezi. 2. Ukudla okunempilo: Ukudla okunezithelo, imifino, nezinye izithako eziphilayo kuzokwenza umzimba wakho ube namandla, okuthinta impilo yengqondo. 3. Ukuphumula: Ukuphumuza ingqondo yakho kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukukhathazeka. Izindlela ezifana nokuphefumula okujulile, ukucabanga, noma ukwenza izinto ozithandayo zingasiza. 4. Ubudlelwano obuhle: Ukuxhumana nabantu abaseduze kwakho, njengabangane nomndeni, kungasiza ukwakha umuzwa wokuxhaswa. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza abantu bangathandi ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo? Abantu bavame ukuba nezingcindezi ezithile zokukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo ngenxa yokwesaba ukusolwa, ukucwaswa, noma ukungaqondi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni bahlale bephila nezinkinga zabo behluleka ukufuna usizo. Kubalulekile ukwakha umphakathi onokuthula, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okungaholela ekutheni umuntu abe nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo? Izizathu ezihlukahlukene zingaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo, kufaka phakathi: 1. Izimo zokuphila: Ukuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ukulahlekelwa, noma izigameko ezinzima kungadala izinkinga. 2. Izici zomndeni: Uma umndeni unokhistory yempilo yengqondo, lokho kungathinta abanye. 3. Izimo zomzimba: Izimo ezinjengokugula noma ukulimala zingaba nomthelela empilweni yengqondo. 4. Izimo zokuphila: Ukungabi nemali, ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, noma ukungatholi imfundo kahle kungaholela ekucindezelweni. Umbuzo 8: Yini okumele uyenze uma ungazizwa kahle? Uma ungazizwa kahle, kubalulekile ukufuna usizo. Ungaqala ngokukhuluma nomuntu omtrustayo, njengomngane noma ilunga lomndeni. Uma kudingeka, ungathintana nochwepheshe bezempilo yengqondo. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo olufanele, zama ukuchaza kahle imizwa yakho nokuthi uzizwa kanjani. Umbuzo 9: Yini eyenza impilo yengqondo ibe yinto ebalulekile? Impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ngoba ithinta zonke izici zempilo yethu. Uma impilo yengqondo ingalungile, kungaba nomthelela omubi emsebenzini, ebudlelwaneni, nasekuphatheni izimo zansuku zonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqaphele impilo yengqondo yethu futhi sithole izindlela zokuyithuthukisa. Umbuzo 10: Yini engafundwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yengqondo? Ukufunda ngezindlela zokuphatha ingcindezi, ukufunda amakhono okuxhumana, kanye nokuhlola izifundo ezithinta impilo yengqondo kungasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kangcono izinkinga zabo. Izincwadi, izifundo, nemihlangano yokuxoxisana zingaba usizo olukhulu. Isiphetho: Impilo yengqondo ibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi siyayiqonda futhi siyayithuthukisa. Ngokukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, singenza umphakathi wethu ube nempilo engcono, futhi sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu nabanye. Ukufunda nokwabelana ngolwazi kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo yengqondo.
Izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan nemithelela yazo Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzaneni waseMkhumbane, kwavela izindaba ezithokozisayo ezazihlobene nohlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) olwakhiwe ukuze luthuthukise amandla kagesi eNingizimu Afrika. UThandi, umphakathi wezokwakha, wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abahlali ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zibuyekezo ezibalulekile. UThandi, owayengumfundi wezokuphathwa kwezinsiza, waba nesithakazelo esikhulu kulolu hlelo. Wazi ukuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zazizokwenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ngakho, wathola ithuba lokuhola umhlangano wendawo, lapho abahlali bezokwazi khona ukufunda nokuxoxa ngalezi zinguquko. Umhlangano waqala ngenkathi uThandi ethula izizathu zokuthi kungani izibuyekezo zibalulekile. "Siyazi ukuthi amandla kagesi ayadingeka ukuze siphile kahle. Kodwa, uma sikhuluma ngohlelo lwe-IRP, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, umnotho wethu, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka ezizothuthukisa umphakathi wethu," kusho yena. Abahlali babemangala ngalezi zindaba. UNomsa, omunye wabahlali, waphakamisa isandla. "Ngabe lezi zibuyekezo zizosiza ekunciphiseni izindleko zamandla kagesi?" ubuza. UThandi wamamatheka, "Yebo, uNomsa. Okwamanje, izibuyekezo zifaka phakathi ukwandisa amandla avuselelekayo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amandla ngentengo ephansi." Uhlelo lwe-IRP lwaluhlose ukunciphisa ukuthembela kumandla avela emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, njengamalahle, futhi lukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, njengelanga nomoya. Lokhu kwakuhambisana nezifiso zabahlali zokuba nomphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula. Njengoba umhlangano uqhubeka, uThandi wabelana ngemininingwane ethokozisayo yokuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zizosiza ekwakheni imisebenzi emisha. "Uma sithuthukisa amandla avuselelekayo, sizokwazi ukudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha," kusho yena. UThandi waphinde wakhuluma ngempumelelo yeziqubulo ezihlobene nezokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi. "Sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza emikhakheni emisha, futhi lokhu kuzothuthukisa umnotho wethu," wengeza. Abahlali babebonakala bejabule, kodwa uSipho, omunye wabahlali, waphakamisa ukukhathazeka. "Kodwa, uThandi, uma sishintsha izinsiza, ingabe sizokwazi ukugcina izinga lokuphila eliphezulu?" ubuza. UThandi wamphendula, "Yebo, Sipho. Izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke." Ngemuva kokuxoxa, abahlali bavuma ukuthi kufanele baphumelele ekutholeni ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe. UThandi wanxusa bonke ukuba babhalise ukuze bathole izindaba ezivela kuhulumeni mayelana nezibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP. "Sidinga ukuba sibe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa lethu," kusho yena. Umhlangano waphothulwa ngenkathi uThandi ebonisa abahlali ukuthi bangabhalisela izinhlelo zokuhlanganyela ezizobanjwa emiphakathini yabo. "Sizoba neqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo," waphawula. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zazingaba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Abahlali baphuma emhlanganweni bejabule, bekwazi ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zizobathinta ngempela. UThandi wayezimisele ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zifeza izinjongo ezinhle, futhi zikhuthaze impilo engcono kubo bonke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zingaba nemithelela emihle, uma abantu bebandakanyeka futhi bephokophele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinguquko ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-IRP zaziyinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, futhi lokho kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu.
Ezinye izindatshana ezibhaliwe lapha kuPula/Imvula zigcizelela izinto ezibalulekile uma kukhethwa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zasehlobo ezizophumelela epulazini lakho, kubhekwa izinsiza zemvelo ezikhona, umkhiqizo womhlabathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezicwangciso zokushintshaniswa kwezinhlobo zezitshalo, kanye nezintengo zazo emakethe esikhathini esizayo. Le Pula/Imvula yalesi sikhathi inezindatshana ezithile ezizoxhumana nalabo abakhiqizayo abakhulume ngama- maize emapulazini abo njengoba bekhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo ezizotshalwa ngonyaka ozayo. Izintengo zesikhathi esizayo zama-maize abomvu kanye nama-maize amhlophe zashintsha zaba ziqinile ngoAgasti 2011, zikhombisa ukuthi intengo yemakethe esikhathini esizayo izofinyelela ku-R1,840 (kwama-maize abomvu) kanye no-R1,815 (kwama-maize amhlophe) uma lawa ma-maize ethulwa ngoJulayi 2012. Singathi umkhiqizi uzokwazi ukuthola u-R1,615 ngentoni yama-maize emaphaketheni akhe ngemuva kokuncishiswa kwezindleko zokuhamba ezingenzeka zifinyelele ku-R215 noma ku-R225 ngentoni. Intengo yama-maize angathengiswa phesheya ingafinyelela ku-R1,717 ngentoni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi intengo ebonakalayo efanayo nentengo yokuthunyelwa phesheya. Ama-maize athengwa phesheya ukuze aze lapha eRandfontein abiza u-R2,894 ngentoni. Singavuma ukuthi izintengo zamanje nezizayo ezweni lethu zisekelwe entengo yokuthunyelwa phesheya. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kusekhona ama-maize amaningi atholakalayo emakethe yethu yasendaweni, futhi kukhona umbono omuhle ngoba kungase kube nokwanele ama-maize ngonyaka ozayo. Ukunqunywa kwentengo yemakethe kubheka zonke izinto ezihlobene nokukhiqiza ezifana nezimo zezulu, izimo zomhlabathi (ukukhiqiza), isidingo salokhu kudla ngabathengi, ukudla okukhona, kanye nama-maize azosatshalwa; ukuqhathaniswa kwezinga lokushintshisana phakathi kwe-rand ne-dollar, izimo zokukhiqiza phesheya, kanye nezindleko zemali ebolekiwe lapha konke kusiza ekunqumeni le ntengo. Ikhwalithi yama-maize ahanjiswa ezilweni ngabakhiqizi ingase ibe phansi ngenxa yemvula eningi ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa kungase kubangele ukuthi intengo emakethe yendawo ikhule uma ama-maize amahle ethola. Khumbula ukuthi konke lokhu kungashintsha uma ama-maize evunwa ngonyaka ozayo ngoJulayi 2012.
Ukwelashwa okuhlukile kokukhululwa kwentela kunikezwa ezinhlanganweni ezingekho phansi kwemali ezisungulwe ukuze zibe nezinzuzo zomphakathi. Nokho, lokhu kukhululwa kwentela kuzotholakala kuphela ezinhlanganweni ezihambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wezinhlangano Ezingezi Nenzuzo, 1997, kanye neminye imithetho ehlobene. Inkampani ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 seMthetho Wamakampani, 1973. Itrust enedokhumenti yokusungula kanye nedokhumenti ye-trust, ebhaliswe noMphakathi Wenkantolo Ephezulu. Okubizwa ngokuthi ukuhlangana kwabantu, okuqondiswa umthethosisekelo. Lapho idokhumenti yokusungula ingahambisani nezinhlinzeko zeSigaba 30 seMthetho Wezinhlangano Ezingezi Nenzuzo, 1997, isicelo kumele sihambisane neposi elibhalwe phansi lokuhlose elisayiniwe ngumfaki-sicelo. Ukukhululwa ngaphansi kwezibopho zangaphambili kuzophumelela kuze kube umfaki-sicelo unikeze isaziso kuMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuhambisana nomthetho omusha. Ezinhlanganweni okwamanje ezingakhululeki enteleni yokwenzela imali zingathumela ifomu lesicelo eliphelele, kanye nemibhalo edingekayo yokwesekwa, kanye nephepha elibhalwe phansi lokuhlose lapho abantu bezimali bekulungele ukusebenza ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeSigaba 30 seMthetho Wezinhlangano Ezingezi Nenzuzo, 1997, ekuhlanganyeleni kwabantu: Thumela ikhophi yakamuva yomthethosisekelo. Ezinhlanganweni ezisungulwe ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngama-scholarship, ama-bursaries, nezindondo zokufunda, ucwaningo, kanye nokufundisa, ngaphezu kwemibhalo yokwesekwa okukhulunywe ngenhla, kumele futhi kuthunyelwe iphepha elibhalwe phansi lokuhlose le-EI 3 Written Undertaking. Yonke imibhalo ethunyelwe kuMnyango Wokukhululwa Kwentela enemininingwane efanele kanye nemibhalo edingekayo yokwesekwa izokwamukelwa ngerekhodi elikhishwe ikhompyutha phakathi kwezinsuku ezine ezivela ngosuku lokuthumela. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa.
Ukwehluleka ukuhlinzeka nge-oda ebhalwe phansi kumlamuli ukuze avele enkantolo. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba noma ngokocansi, njengokushaya noma ukuhlukumeza. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngemicabango, ngokomzwelo nangokwengqondo, njengokuyesabisa, ukulawula ngendlela yokukhathazeka, noma ukuhamba ngokweqile. Ukuhlukunyezwa, njengokwenza izingcingo eziphazamisayo njalo, ukuthumela izincwadi ezisabisa, noma ukuvimbela ekwenzeni izinto, noma ukukulandela. Ukungena endaweni yakho ngaphandle kwemvume yakho. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezimali, njengokuthi umyeni noma umlingani ufuna ukwenza zonke izinqumo zezimali futhi wenqaba ukukhokhela ukudla noma izimali zesikole, phakathi kokunye. Ukuhlekwa, njengokwesabisa ukukubulala uma ufuna ukuya emaphoyiseni. Ukulimaza impahla yakho, njengokushisa izingubo zakho, ukuphula ifenisha yakho, noma ukushaya amatshe emotweni yakho. Ukuphula umyalo wamanje wenkantolo ukuze ukukuvikele. Ukuziphatha nganoma iyiphi indlela ethukisa, esabisa ukuphepha kwakho, impilo yakho, noma inhlalakahle yakho. Faka isikhalazo uqobo, ngokushaya ucingo, ubhale incwadi, noma uthumele i-imeyili kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi le-ICD eliseduzane. Ukuqinisekiswa okubhalwe phansi kwesikhalazo kungathatha cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-30. Le sevisi ikhululekile.
Impilo Yengqondo Entsha: Ukubaluleka Kokukhuluma Ngempilo Yengqondo Kwentsha Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukwazisa ngendaba ebalulekile, impilo yengqondo entsheni. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu? Yebo, ngempela! Ngakho, ake siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi yini impilo yengqondo. Impilo yengqondo ibhekisela esimweni sokuba nekhono lokuphila kahle, ukucabanga kahle, nokubhekana nezinselelo zansuku zonke. Kulabo abasha, lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu. Ngoba, uma ungaphilile kahle engqondweni, konke okunye kuyoba nzima. Ucabanga kanjani uma uhlala ucindezelekile? Lokhu kungenza ungakwazi ukufunda kahle, ungabi namandla okwenza izinto, futhi ungazizwa ungathokozile. Ngiyazi, abanye bethu sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, kodwa akukhona okukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi impilo yengqondo iyinto ethinta abantu abadala kuphela, kodwa akunjalo. Izingane, intsha, nabantu abasha badinga ukwazi ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinkinga zengqondo zingaqala kusenesikhathi? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi intsha ibhekana nezimo eziningi ezinzima, ezifana nokucindezeleka, ukungabi nempumelelo, noma ukungafuni ukujabulisa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto. Uma ungazizwa kahle, ungakhuluma nomngane, umndeni, noma udokotela. Akukhona okubi ekutheni ubonise ukuthi udinga usizo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye kungasiza kanjani? Lokhu kungenza uzizwe ungcono, futhi ungathola izixazululo ezithile ezinkingeni zakho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha kufanele ifunde ukuthi izindlela zokuphila ezinhle zingasiza kakhulu empilweni yengqondo. Ukudla kahle, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphumula kahle kubalulekile. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma umzimba wakho uphilile, ingqondo yakho nayo izoba phakeme. Ngakho, zama ukuthola isikhathi sokuzivocavoca, noma ngabe uhamba nje, noma udlala umdlalo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe ungcono. Futhi, akufanele sikhohlwe ukubaluleka kokuphumula. Ukuphumula akusho ukuthi kufanele uhlale ungasebenzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula, sokwenza izinto ozithandayo, noma sokuchitha isikhathi nomndeni nabangani. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe ujabule, futhi kuzokwenza ingqondo yakho ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukucabanga kahle kungasiza kanjani? Uma ungena ezinkingeni, zama ukucabanga ngezixazululo. Ungazama ukwenza uhlu lwezinto okufanele uzithathe. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe unamandla, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo ezikoleni. Abafundi kufanele bafundiswe ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele babe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo uma bedinga usizo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinkampani zikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu abasha badinga ukwazi ukuthi izinkampani zikhathalela impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, impilo yengqondo izoba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yengqondo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto, futhi sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibonise izinkinga zayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili empilweni. Ngokuphetha, impilo yengqondo iyinto ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi kwentsha. Ngakho, khumbula, akukhona okubi ekutheni ubonise ukuthi udinga usizo. Khuluma nabangani, umndeni, noma udokotela uma uzizwa ungathokozile. Futhi, zama ukuthola izindlela zokuphila ezinhle, ukuze ingqondo yakho ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinto zizokwenza ube nempilo yengqondo engcono.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi Ukuze sithuthukise ukuqwashisa ngezinkinga zokuphepha komphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokuhlola impumelelo yezinkundla zokuphepha ezikhona ezinyangeni ezedlule. Kukhona izindawo ezikhombisa ukwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo nezinhlaka zokuphepha, okuholela ekunciphiseni ubugebengu. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha, kudingeka sihlole izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwazo. Izinkundla zokuphepha zifaka phakathi izinsiza zomphakathi, izithunywa zamaphoyisa, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele ezitholakala ezindaweni eziningi. Umphakathi uqhubekile ukufunda ukubaluleka kokubambisana, lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zokuvikela izindawo zabantu. Isibonelo, eThekwini, iMeya yedolobha ibonise ukwanda kokuxhaswa kwemali kwezinkundla zokuphepha, okukhombisa ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Osomatekisi nabaholi bendawo baphinde bathintwe ukuze bathuthukise izinhlelo zokusebenzisana. Ngokubambisana, abavoti bakha izinkundla zokuxhumana eziphakamisa izindaba zokuphepha, futhi abantu bangathumela izikhalazo ngqo kumaphoyisa, okukhuthaza ukuphendula ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima. Lokhu kuholele ekuqhamukeni kokuphenya okusheshayo ezindaweni ezithile. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-‘app’ ziye zaba usizo, lapho abahlali bengathumela khona izithombe noma babele izinkinga zempilo yomphakathi. Izinkundla zokuphepha zifundisa umphakathi izindlela zokuziphatha eziphephile. Umkhankaso wezokuphepha owawuhlelwe nguMnyango Wezobulungiswa ushaye umoya, ugqugquzela abantu ukuba bathumele iziphakamiso zabo, okukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ubambe iqhaza futhi kukhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Nokho, kunezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nezinkundla zokuphepha. Ubukhona bokungaziwa phakathi kwabantu bendawo namaphoyisa kanye nokungabi bikho kwemali eyanele, kube nezinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukwehluleka kwezinye izindawo kokubambisana nokubhalisela izinkundla zokuphepha kungaholela ekwandeni kobugebengu, njengoba ezinye izindawo zibika ukwanda kwama-cases obugebengu. Ngaphezu kokusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha, ukuhlinzeka ngokwakha inhlonipho kubalulekile. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenzisana nabantu abasha, ikakhulukazi abasha, kubalulekile ekwakheni indawo ethuthukayo. Ukuze kuphumelele, umphakathi kumele ubambisane ukuze uthole izimpendulo ezidingekayo. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezisebenzayo ukuze kuzuze umphumela omuhle. Izinhlelo zokuphepha zidinga ukwazi izinsiza zokuxhumanisa phakathi komphakathi nezinhlaka. Akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinile, kodwa ukufaka abantu abasha abasebenzayo ezinhlelweni zokuphepha kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi yethu. Namuhla, izinkundla zokuphepha zikhona, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze silwe nezinselelo. Uma ukwehla kwezinkinga zokuphila kuncishiswa, umphakathi udinga ukuthola izixazululo ezihambisana nezinkinga abhekene nazo. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kwabantu abahlukene kuzokwazi ukunciphisa obahlaselayo. Muva nje, umhlahlandlela omusha wezinhlaka zomphakathi ubeka phambili ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizolungisa izinkinga zomphakathi. Ukuze sifinyelele ukuphepha, kudingeka ukwenza isifundo sokubheka izindawo ezikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukucatshangelwa njengoba imiphakathi isiya phambili. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye ukuze uthuthukise imizamo yokubambisana. Ukwakha izinkundla zokuphepha ezinomthelela omuhle, umphakathi udinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuyahambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavikeleka. Lokhu kuzoba qiniso kuphela uma sizitholela izimpendulo ezivela kumphakathi mayelana nezokuphepha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizophawula ukuthuthuka nokubuyiselwa kokuthula nezokuphepha emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, ukuqonda izinto eziphakamisa ukuphepha kumphakathi kubalulekile, futhi kumele siqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye ukuze siqinisekise impilo enempilo. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuthola izixazululo zokusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha kwezokuphepha komphakathi, okuzokwakha umphakathi onenhlonipho, ugcwele amathuba, futhi uqondise phambili emakhaya ethu.
Kungenzeka ukuthi izilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziningi zingadala izifo, futhi izilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi zitholakala kabanzi emhlabathini, emanzini, ezilwaneni, nakubantu. Lezi zilwane ezincane zidluliselwa ngezandla, ezikhipha, nasezisetshenziswayo zokudla, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokusika, futhi ukuxhumana okuncane kungazidlulisa kokudla, kuholele ezimweni zokudla ezitholakala. Ukudla okungaphekiwe, ikakhulukazi inyama, izinkukhu, kanye nezilwane zasemanzini, kanye nezikhupha zazo, kungaba nezilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi ezingangcolisa ezinye izidlo ngesikhathi sokulungiselela nokugcina. Qiniseka ukuthi ukudla okufana nezisawoti nezitsha kuphuzwa ukuze kufinyelele ku-700C. Qiniseka ukuthi awekho amanzi enyama nenkukhu, futhi akufanele kube nombala ophuzi. Ngokujwayelekile, sebenzisa ithermometha. Ukupheka kahle kubulala cishe zonke izilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi. Izifundo zocwaningo zikhombisile ukuthi ukupheka ukudla ku-700C kungasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile ukudla. Ukudla okudinga ukunakwa okukhethekile kufaka phakathi inyama eqoshiwe, inyama efakwe emanzini, iziqeshana ezinkulu zenyama, kanye nezinkukhu eziphelele. Izilwane ezincane eziphilayo zingakhula ngokushesha uma ukudla kugcinwa ezingeni lokushisa lekhaya. Ngokugcina izinga lokushisa ngaphansi kwe-50C noma ngaphezulu kwe-600C, ukukhula kwezilwane ezincane eziphilayo kuyancipha noma kuyama. Ezinye izilwane ezincane eziphilayo ziqhubeka nokukhula ngaphansi kwe-50C. Izinto ezingavuthiwe, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqukethe amanzi neqhwa, zingangcoliswa ngezilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi nezinto zokwakha. Izinto ezingalimazi zingakha ezidleni ezonakele nezibola. Ukunakekela ekukhetheni izinto ezingavuthiwe kanye nezindlela ezilula zokuhlola ezifana nokuhlanza nokuphelisa kunganciphisa izinga lesixaka.
Uma izindlela zokwenza imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo seziqaliswe ngokuphelele, futhi izinsiza zabasebenzi nemishini zihlanganiswe, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zindlela zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukwenza imisebenzi nezindlela zisebenze kahle kusho ukufezekisa umgomo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, kungaba yiphutha ukuhlela izindlela nokuhlanganisa kodwa bese unakhohlwa ukuzisebenzisa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuvela komsebenzi ngqo kungavinjwa uma ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezindlela kungahambi kahle. Ake sibheke ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi, okuyimsebenzi wesithathu wokuphatha ibhizinisi. Lapho sifika ezindabeni ezingenzeka, kumele siqhubeke lapho sishiyile khona ngemibhalo yethu (Pula/Imvula kuJuni) echaza ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezindlela, bese kuba nguMeyi 9, 2011, lapho izindlela nokuhlanganiswa kusetshenziswa. Bheka insimu 5. Kuqediwe, bekungekho izifo. Thola insimu 3, amakhilomitha ayishumi. UPadiso, uVosloo, abasebenzi ababili (umsebenzi wengxenye). Amatraktori amabili namathreyi amabili. Amakhilomitha ayisishiyagalolunye aqediwe. Bheka okutholakele nokudla. Susa ensimini, bhalisela izimpawu, phatha imithi, thola izinga lokuphila lama-lambs angu-100. UMoloto, uAbram, uKagiso, noHendrik. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Amathuluzi okuphatha izinkomo, amathuluzi okushisa izinkomo, amathuluzi okuphatha imithi, imithi, isikhali, nencwadi yokurekhoda. Ukudla enkampanini 3 kugcwele. Imisebenzi enama-lambs angu-100 iqediwe. Lungisa indlu 3 (susa ukhuluma okudala). Imisebenzi evamile yansuku zonke, izindlu 1 no-2. UJohanna, uMinah, uJohannes. USarah, uMonica, uDawid. Amathuluzi okuqoqa, amabhakede, ithreyi. Imisebenzi evamile yansuku zonke iqediwe. Amathuluzi amadala, njll. Umsebenzi uqhubeka ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umsebenzi okumele wenziwe uqhutshwa, kumele wenziwe ngabantu balo bhizinisi; kumele bakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi ngendlela efanele. Lapho umsebenzi osebenzayo utholakala, kubalulekile kumphathi (umlimi) ukuba abe nomsebenzi oncomekayo kuzo zonke izici zebhizinisi lakhe, imisebenzi yakhe yokuphatha ifaka phakathi okulandelayo: ukuhola, ukubambisana nokuxhumana, ukunikeza abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi kahle, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela eqinile njalo. Ukuhola nokubamba izintambo ngaphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuthuthuke umsebenzi okumele wenziwe, futhi kubalulekile ukuthola izindlela ezingcono zokuhlanganisa izindlela, njll. Abaphathi kufanele bahole lapho bephatha lokho okumele kwenziwe; akufanele kube kuhle ukuthi benze lowo msebenzi bona; kumele bakwazi ukunikeza abasebenzi babo ukwenza kahle. Abaphathi kufanele banikeze abasebenzi ukufuna umsebenzi. Kumele banikeze abasebenzi ukwenza umsebenzi abangawenza ngazo zonke amandla abo. Ngesikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi, abasebenzi kufanele bathole umlayezo kubaphathi ukuze bafunde; lokhu kusiza ekunikezeni abantu. Ukuxhumana okuhlanzekile kubalulekile uma sifuna umphumela omuhle emsebenzini okumele wenziwe ngezindlela ezibekwe. Umlayezo kufanele ube sobala, ubonakale, futhi uqondile. Bonke abantu abasebenza emsebenzini okumele wenziwe kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi ubani ozokwenza ini, nini, kanjani, futhi baqonde lapho lo msebenzi uya khona. Ngesikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi okumele wenziwe, ukunikeza (ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi) umsebenzi othile kubalulekile. Umphathi akakwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yena. Lokhu kunikezwa komsebenzi kubasebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi noma usayizi wemisebenzi ethile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphathi bafuna ukuzibandakanya kulowo msebenzi okumele wenziwe ngazo zonke amandla abo noma bafuna ukuba ngasohlangothini bese bebalulekile kuphela ekuphatheni umsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukunaka ukuhlanganiswa okuhle phakathi kwezicucu zebhizinisi. Imisebenzi yebhizinisi kufanele iqhube kahle uma umsebenzi okumele wenziwe uzoba nomphumela omuhle. Uma ukuhlanganiswa kuvinjwa, kuzophula isikhathi nemali futhi. Khumbula imali engenayo - izindleko = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa. Isibonelo sethu esingenhla sikhombisa ukuthi uma imithi yokuphatha ama-lambs ingatholakali ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, ukusebenzisa umsebenzi okumele wenziwe kuzomele kumiswe, futhi isikhathi sizophuma. Ngesikhathi sokusebenza, kubalulekile kubaphathi ukuba bathathe isinyathelo esiphuthumayo ukuze umsebenzi okumele wenziwe ube kahle. Uma itraktori inethayi eliphukile, kwenzekani? Ingabe ithayi izophulwa kuqala, noma kuzosebenza itraktori enye? Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngokuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi kubalulekile uma abaphathi befuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Kungase kwenzeke ukuthi umsebenzi uvele kodwa ungawenzi kahle; abaphathi bazokwamukela lokho uma kungekho ukuphatha okuqinile futhi abasebenzi bengawuhloniphi lowo ukuphatha, kungase kube nomthelela omubi emsebenzini okumele wenziwe. Umsebenzi okumele wenziwe uvame ukufaka izinto eziningi ezihlukene; khumbula ukuthi imisebenzi engalindelekile ingavela - umlilo ezindaweni, ibhulu elihle elingena emudeni, njll. Ngokusebenza amahora amaningi, siyazi ukuthi awukwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngasikhathi sinye. Kumele ukwazi ukukhetha umsebenzi okumele wenziwe ngaleso sikhathi esithile - lokhu kuhlobene nokukhetha/ukuhlonza umsebenzi obalulekile. Umsebenzi ophatha kahle izinzuzo noma izindleko, noma ophatha kahle abasebenzi bakho njengokusebenza 'ngamahora angeziwe', kufanele ubhekwe ngokucophelela ngoba kubalulekile. Isisindo esiphansi/ukuphuthuma okuphansi. Umsebenzi onesisindo esiphezulu ngumsebenzi onobukhulu obukhulu obunokuphuthuma. Ukuphuthuma okuphezulu kukhombisa ukuthi lezi zisebenzi zizothinta inzuzo - uma ziqhutshwa ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa inzuzo - uma zingaqhutshwa ngokushesha, kuzokwehlisa inzuzo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezindleko - uma zingaqhutshwa ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa izindleko. Ukuphuthuma kuhlobene nesikhathi esitholakalayo sokwenza umsebenzi othile - kumele kwenziwe manje/namuhla noma ngasikhathi esithile. Uma wenza umsebenzi wokuvuna futhi imishini iphuka, ukulungisa leyo mshini noma itraktori kuzoba yinto efanele ukwenza ngokuphuthuma okukhulu - kubalulekile. Ngokufanayo, kuzoba njengokuthi inkomo ibhekene nenkinga yokubeletha, ikakhulukazi uma iyinkomo yakho 'yokuhlola'. Amafayela nomsebenzi we-ofisi azobekwa eceleni ngoba akuwona umsebenzi ophuthumayo; ungawenza ngasikhathi esithile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda zonke izimo zebhizinisi lakho, futhi ukuba nesineke ekusebenziseni izindlela ukuze zihambisane nezindinganiso zebhizinisi.
Imililo Yasendle: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Noxhaso Lokugcina Imvelo Uhlanga lwezulu, izitshalo, nezilwane, konke kudinga ibhalansi ukuze kuqhubeke ukuphila emhlabeni. Kodwa-ke, imililo yasendle iyinsakavukela emazweni amaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinoshintsho olukhulu kwezokwakhiwa, ezomnotho, kanye nezimo zezulu. Ngokombono wami, imililo yasendle ayigcini nje ngokuba yingozi kuphela, kodwa iyinsiza ebalulekile emvelweni, uma iqhutshwa ngendlela efanele. Ukucacisa, imililo yasendle iwumsebenzi wemvelo, owenzeka lapho imifula yezitshalo iphuka, isihlahla sivaleka, noma izimo zezulu ziba neqhwa elikhulu. Lokhu kudala umoya opholile, owakha ibhalansi phakathi kwemvelo namathuba okuphila. Kodwa, uma imililo yasendle iqhutshwa ngempela, kungenzeka kube nemiphumela emibi, njengokwehla kwemvelo yokuhlala, ukulahleka kwezilwane, kanye nezimo ezinzima zokuphila kwabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imililo yasendle ingaba yinsiza yokuphila. Izithombo ezithile zidinga imililo ukuze zikhule, ngoba lokhu kusiza ekukhuleni kwezithelo nemifino. Ngokwesibonelo, izihlahla ze-"Serotinous" zidinga imililo ukuze zikhule, ngoba imililo ivula izithelo zazo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imililo ingathuthukisa impilo yezitshalo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezitshalo ezinamakhono amancane okukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imililo yasendle ingasiza ekulawuleni izinsalela zezitshalo ezindaweni eziningi. Noma ngabe kudinga imililo engaphumelelanga, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imililo iyinsiza yokwenza kabusha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezilokhu zihlala khona izilwane. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ibhalansi yemvelo, ngakho-ke kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezihambisanayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imililo yasendle iyakhula. Ngokuphathelene nezimo ezikhona, imililo yasendle ivame ukudalwa abantu. Ukuze kube nemiphumela emihle, kudingeka ukwenziwa kwesimo esifanele. Uhlelo lokulawulwa kwemililo, oluhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kudinga ukuba kube yinsiza ebalulekile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ibhalansi phakathi kwemvelo nezidingo zomphakathi. Izindawo eziningi ziwubona umthelela wemililo yasendle emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi lapho imililo idaleka khona ngenxa yokungabibikho kwezinhlelo zokulawulwa. Lokhu kufanele kube yinkomba yokuthi kumele sithathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuvikela imvelo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu mayelana nemiphumela yemililo yasendle kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde izinzuzo nemiphumela emibi yemililo. Ukuphila kwabantu nezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane kuncike ekwakheni ibhalansi emvelweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nomqondo ophusile ngokubheka imililo yasendle, bese sithathwa izinyathelo eziphumelelayo ukuze kulawulwe imiphumela yayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izinhlelo eziqhubekayo ezizokwakha indlela yokuphila engcono, ngenkathi sikhumbula ukubaluleka kwalesi simo sezemvelo. Ekugcineni, imililo yasendle yisici esibalulekile semvelo, okwazi ukusiza ukukhulisa izindawo ezithile, kodwa kudingeka ukuba sibe nezinqubo ezivumelana nezimo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela emibi iyancipha. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe ngabakhathaleli bemvelo, sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imililo yasendle iyasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, igcine ibhalansi yemvelo, futhi ikhulise ukuphila kwabantu nezilwane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuphila okungcono, okuvikelwe ngokuhlonipha imvelo yethu, ukuze sithole injabulo yokuphila emhlabeni.
Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile (GEMS dependent information confidentiality) Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, luhlobene kakhulu nokuhlonishwa kwezimpilo zomuntu kanye nezidingo zabo zokuphepha. Lezi zindaba zibalulekile, njengoba zikhuluma ngamalungelo abantu abancikile, okuhlanganisa izingane, abakhubazekile, kanye nabanye abahluphekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubani ofanele ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi, nendlela yokulugcina luvalwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akuphazamiseki. Ngokwejwayelekile, ubufakazi bokuthi ulwazi lwezempilo nolwazi lwabancikile luhlala luhlonishwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Izinhlangano eziningi, kuhlanganise nezikhungo zezempilo, zisebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezikhethekile ukuze zigcine lezi zinsiza zikhululekile ekubeni zivele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola, izivumelwano zokugcina ubumfihlo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ulwazi. Imigomo ethile, efana ne-Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) e-United States, ibeka izindinganiso eziphakeme zokuvikela ulwazi lwabancikile. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buhlobene kakhulu nemithetho yokuvikela idatha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala lutholakala kuphela kulabo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa, futhi luhlala lukhona kumazinga aphezulu okuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yokuvikela idatha ibalulekile ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kwabantu nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abancikile bazizwa bekhululekile ukwabelana ngolwazi lwabo, beqonda ukuthi lolu lwazi luzogcinwa luhlanzekile. I-GEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme) iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi izinhlelo zokwelapha zingagcina kanjani ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. I-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela ulwazi lwabancikile, kuhlanganisa nezinyathelo zokuphepha ezibucayi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela idatha eziphakeme, kanye nezivumelwano eziqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bahlonipha ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buyahlonishwa, kubalulekile ukuba neziqondiso ezicacile ezichaza ukuthi ulwazi lungasetshenziswa kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile kubantu abathintekayo mayelana nokuthi ulwazi lwabo luzosetshenziswa kanjani, nokuthi banganjani ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Lokhu kuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi bazi kahle ukuthi banamalungelo athile mayelana nolwazi lwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuhlola nokubuyekeza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuvikela ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile ziyasebenza. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izinqubo ezikhona, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi, kanye nokubuyekeza izinqubomgomo uma kudingeka. Ukuze ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile buphumelele, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinyathelo eziphusile ezithathwa njalo. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile akukhona nje kuphela umthetho, kodwa kuyinsika yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luhlala lutholakala kuphela kulabo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa, bakhuthazwa ukuba baphendule ngokukhululekile, okungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, lapho abantu badinga ukwethembela kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele. Ekugcineni, ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile luhlala luhlobene nezimiso zokuhlonipha, ukuvikelwa, nokwethembeka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zimiso ziyagcinwa, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, izinhlelo zokuvikela ezisebenzayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abancikile bahlonishwa, futhi bazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lukhona, luhlanzekile, futhi lutholakala kuphela kulabo abanamalungelo okusebenzisa. Ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile, ngakho, akuwona umgomo, kodwa kuyisidingo esiyisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, ophumelelayo, nolwazi.
I-Load Shedding Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokwakhiwa kwezimoto, kube nezinguquko eziningi ezithinta impilo yethu. Okwamanje, umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo eziyinqaba eziholela ekwandeni kwemfuneko yamanzi kagesi, kodwa naphezu kwalokho, kukhona izinsizakalo zokulawula umoya: i-load shedding. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka, futhi kuthinta kabi izimpilo zethu zansuku zonke. Ugesi ususizwa kakhulu empilweni yethu, usuhlelwa ukuba ube umkhiqizo obalulekile emphakathini wanamuhla. Ukukhanyisa, ukufudumeza, ukudla, kanye namathoyizi abantwana, konke lokhu kuncike ekutholeni ugesi. Ngakho-ke, uma kunenkinga yokuhlinzekwa, kuvela ukukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu. Uhlelo lokuthi kuhlale kusebenza ugesi luholela ekwehleni kwekhwalithi yokuphila. KwaZulu, i-load shedding ibonakala njengezinga elikhulu lokuphazamiseka. Ngaphezu kokuphazamiseka komnotho, lokhu kuthinta amathuba okukhula nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Uhulumeni usebenzisa le ndlela ukuze avimbele ukuxhatshazwa kwenhlalakahle, kodwa abantu baphinde bakhathazeke ngokuntuleka kwezinye izinsiza. Kukhona izinga eliphakeme lokuphazamiseka, okukhombisa ukuthi le nkinga ibangela ukuvinjelwa kwemisebenzi nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Izimboni ziningi seziqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokukhanyisa eziphukhile, okuvumela umphakathi ukuba namathuba okukhula, kodwa lokhu akuhambisani nosuku nosuku. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma imisebenzi iphazamiseka, kuzoba nemiphumela emibi kumabhizinisi. Abanye baveza ukuthi i-load shedding ikhuluma ngezinga eliphakeme neliphansi lokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imisebenzi ethile iyakhishwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola ukukhanya okwanele. Nokho, abanye bakhathazekile ngezithako ezithinta ukwakheka kokuhlanga okuhle. Ukwanda kwe-load shedding kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bavule amakhasimende amasha, balungiselele ukukhanya kumakhaya ngesikhathi se-peak hours. Lokhu kungenzeka kube nomthelela empilweni yansuku zonke. Imikhiqizo emisha iyatholakala, ikakhulukazi ezithengiswa ku-Intanethi. Lokhu kukhombisa indlela abantu abavuma ngayo ukujolisa kwizixazululo ezinzima ekwakheni ubudlelwano bomphakathi. Noma zikhona izinkinga ezibangelwa i-load shedding, kudingeka ukuthi siphendule ngempumelelo. Lokhu kudinga abantu abaqeqeshiwe, okungaholela ekutheni babe nomthelela omuhle ezisekelweni ezisetshenziswayo. Ukuze sinqobe lezi zinkinga, kudingeka izixazululo ezizinzile ezizovumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezingcono. Izindlela ezibalulekile zidingeka ukuze zibuyekeze indlela abantu abahlangana ngayo nomphakathi. Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokwelapha eziphathelene ne-load shedding, ukwaneliseka kwezidingo zansuku zonke kuncike ekucwaningweni. Njengoba sisebenza ndawonye, izinkampani zomphakathi nezahulumeni kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi unika izibopho ezisemqoka, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Ekugcineni, i-load shedding iyinselele eqhubekayo, kodwa ngaphandle kokubambisana, ukungaboni kahle ngeke kube yisixazululo. Umphakathi kumele uqhubeke uhlela izinhlelo ezintsha, aqhubeke nemihlahlandlela yokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ugesi uyatholakala kubantu bonke. Ukusebenza kwethu kufanele kuthokoziswe futhi kukhuthazwe, ukuze kuvikela umphakathi kuzingozi ezihambisana ne-load shedding. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi, ngaphandle kokwehluleka, kumele siqhubeke siphezu kwezinselele ukuze siwusebenzise kahle umthamo wethu wokubambisana. Isinyathelo sokusebenza ngesizotha sizokwenza umphakathi uthokozise, ube nomthelela omuhle ezinsizweni ezitholakala. I-load shedding ingaba inselele, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha nokuhlanganyela ukuze umphakathi unelungelo lokuphila kahle.
Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi (GEMS Risk Management) Ukuphathwa kwezingozi, okwaziwa njenge-GEMS risk management, kubalulekile emkhakheni wezokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezahlukene ezifana nezamabhizinisi, ezokwakha, nezokwelapha. Le nqubo ihlanganisa ukuhlela, ukuhlola, nokuphatha izingozi ezihlobene nezinhlelo, imisebenzi, noma imikhiqizo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuphathwa kwezingozi, kubalulekile ukuba sazi ukuthi izingozi zingaba yiziphi, zenzeka kanjani, futhi zingathinta kanjani inhlangano. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Izingozi Izingozi zingabhekwa njengemiphumela engalindelekile engase ibe nomthelela omubi emsebenzini. Lokhu kungabandakanya izingozi zemali, izingozi zokuphepha, izingozi zemvelo, noma izingozi ezihlobene nezinsiza. Ukuze siqonde izingozi, kufanele sihlole izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta inhlangano, njengezimo zomnotho, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, nezimo zokusebenza. Ukuhlola lezi zici kusiza ekwakheni umbono ophelele wezingozi ezibhekene nenhlangano. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlola Izingozi Ngemva kokuhlonza izingozi, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuhlela ukuhlola ubungozi bazo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuchaza ukuthi ingozi ngayinye ingaba nomthelela omkhulu kangakanani, nokuthi ingase ibangele izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuhlola izingozi kudinga ukucabangela izici ezifana nobukhulu bengozi, ubungozi bokuphindaphinda, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela ezikhona. Lokhu kuhlola kusiza ekwakheni isithombe esicacile sokuthi izingozi zingaba namandla kangakanani ekuthuthukiseni noma ekuphazamiseni imisebenzi yenhlangano. Isigaba 3: Ukuphatha Izingozi Ngemuva kokuhlola izingozi, inhlangano kufanele ithathe izinyathelo zokuphatha lezi zingozi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela izinqubo zokuvikela, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphendula, noma ukunciphisa ubungozi. Izindlela ezivamile zokuphatha izingozi zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukugwema: Ukugwema izingozi ngokushintsha izinqubo noma imisebenzi engase ibangele ingozi. 2. Ukunciphisa: Ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokuvikela ukuze kuncishiswe amathuba okuthi ingozi yenzeke. 3. Ukudlulisa: Ukudlulisa ingozi kwabanye, njengokusebenzisa umshwalense. 4. Ukubhekana: Ukuba nezinhlelo zokubhekana nayo uma ingozi ingagwenywa. Isigaba 4: Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Ukuphathwa kwezingozi akupheli ekuthatheni izinyathelo; kudinga ukuqapha okuqhubekayo nokuhlola. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphatha izingozi zisebenza kahle. Ukuqapha kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingozi ezitholakele zihlolwe njalo, futhi izinyathelo ezithathiwe zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Isigaba 5: Ukubambisana Nokuxhumana Ukuphathwa kwezingozi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zenhlangano. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, bonke abasebenzi kufanele baqonde izingozi ezibhekene nenhlangano, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi, abasebenzi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo. Isigaba 6: Ukufunda Nokuthuthukisa Ekugcineni, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kudinga ukufunda okuqhubekayo. Njengoba izimo zomhlaba zishintsha, izingozi nazo zishintsha. Ukuze inhlangano iqhubeke nokuphumelela, kufanele ibheke izifundo ezitholakele ezivela ezinkingeni ezedlule. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathiwe zisebenze kanjani, nokuthi yini engathuthukiswa. Isiphetho Ukuphathwa kwezingozi (GEMS risk management) kubalulekile ukuze inhlangano ikwazi ukuhamba phambili ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngokuqonda, ukuhlola, nokuphatha izingozi, inhlangano ingathuthukisa ukusebenza kwayo, ivikele izinsiza zayo, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi izinjongo zayo zifezekiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izigaba zenhlangano ziqonde le nqubo, zisebenzisane, futhi zifunde ukuze ziqhubeke zikhula futhi zithuthuke.
Ngokuhambisana neMigomo Emisha Yokuphatha Nokuthuthukisa, phakathi neminyaka eyi-12 yokuqala kuhulumeni wenkululeko, sigxile emizamweni yethu yokwenza ushintsho emphakathini. Sifake ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengomgomo ophambili wenqubo yokuphatha kanye nomgomo wokunciphisa amazinga obuphofu, kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuphila emphakathini wethu kubantu abampofu nabakhelwe ngaphandle. Ngenxa yokuzinikela kweSikhungo sethu kuThuthukiswa Komphakathi, eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, kube nesigxile esibalulekile ezinsizakalweni zokuphila, kanye nemizamo eqhubekayo yokulinganisa izinzuzo nokufinyelela kwabantu ezinsizakalweni zokuphila. Izidingo ezibekwe ebhajethi yezinsizakalo zokuphila zikhombisile ukuthi sekwenziwe izinyathelo zokuxhasa izidingo eziyisisekelo, njengokuvikelwa kwezinsizakalo zokuphila, ukugcina amakhono abalulekile ezisebenzi zokuphila, kanye nokubandakanywa komphakathi kwezinhlangano zokuphila. Ngenxa yalokho, kwasungulwa iHhovisi Lezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, futhi iMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ube nesigxile esibalulekile kulezi zidingo ezibalulekile. Isibonelo, eminyakeni yamuva, iMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi waqala umgomo ophathelene neMali Yabakhi (PFA). Uhlobo lwezwe lufuneke ukuthi uhulumeni abuyekeze indlela asebenzisa ngayo izinsiza zawo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zabelwa ngokulinganayo kulabo abake bakhishwa ngaphandle emphakathini wethu. I-PFA iyisicwangciso esibalulekile sokusiza ushintsho emphakathini nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ngokuxhasa ngokwezimali abakhangisi. Njengoba kuvunyelwene ngazo zonke izithakazelo emphakathini eMhlanganweni Wokukhula Nokuthuthukiswa, zonke izithakazelo kulindeleke ukuthi zisebenze ndawonye ekuxazululeni izinselelo zomnotho emphakathini wethu. Uhulumeni kuphela akakwazi ukunqoba lezi zinselelo. Ngakho-ke, iMnyango uqhubeka nokuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana okukhulayo phakathi kweZinhlangano Ezingenzi Nzuzo (NGOs), Izinhlangano Ezisekelwe Kwenkolo (FBOs), Izinhlangano Ezisekelwe Emphakathini (CBOs), kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ukuze siphumelele kulesi simiso, izicwangciso zathuthukiswa ukuze kubalwe izindleko zokubhekana nakho konke okuhlobene nokuphumeleliswa kwalesi simiso. Ukuze abakhangisi basebenze, kumele baxhaswe kahle, futhi izindinganiso zokukhokha zabakhangisi kumele zibekwe kuwo wonke amaphondo. Ngokufanayo, izicwangciso zokubala izindleko zohlelo lwezinsizakalo zokuphila zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izindinganiso ezibekiwe nezinsiza zabelwa ngokulinganayo. Iziphakamiso eziphathelene nokuxhaswa kwezimali kwezimiso ezichazwe ku-PFA zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zifinyelela kulabo emphakathini nasezinhlangano ezidinga kakhulu, futhi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezingezona ezokwenziwa. IMnyango iphinde ithuthukise Imihlahlandlela yeMigomo Nezindlela Ezivunyelwe, okufanele zifundwe kanye nomgomo ophathelene neMali Yabakhi. Uhulumeni uyawazisa umsebenzi onzima nezifundo zababandakanyekayo emphakathini ekuletheni izinsizakalo zokuphila. Imisebenzi efana noHlelo Lokusebenza Olwandisiwe (EPWP) iyizibonelo zokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bethu nohulumeni. Ngenxa yalolu hlobo lokubambisana, simema bonke abantu bethu ukuba baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke. Siphinde sithokozise futhi sikwazise umsebenzi nezifundo zabazithandayo, abakhangisi abazimele, kanye nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi. Ndawonye, sakha umphakathi kanye nezwe elihloniphekile ezinganeni zethu nakubo bonke abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika. Inqubo yokuthuthukisa umgomo wokuxhaswa kwezimali yaqala ngo-1996 kodwa yaphazanyiswa ngo-2000. UNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wasungula iKomidi lokwenza uphenyo ngezinkinga eziphathelene nomgomo, wabe esethula iziphakamiso kuMbuthano Wengqalasizinda Yezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi (MINMEC). I-MINMEC yanquma ukuthi umgomo wokuxhaswa kwezimali kumele ubuyekezwe. Lokhu kwenziwa yiqembu elisebenzayo, futhi umphumela walolu work, iMigomo Yokukhokha Yabakhi, wamukelwa futhi wavunywa ngo-2004 ngemva kokwethulwa kwiHhovisi Lezinsizakalo Zokuphila (HSWS), iKomidi Eliphezulu (EXCO), kanye ne-MINMEC. IMnyango iphinde ifune ukuhlabela umoya kulabo bantu nezikhungo ezafaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni le migomo, iminyango yasemaphandleni, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nomphakathi uqobo ngezibopho zabo nezifundo zabo. Ukubambisana phakathi kweMnyango nezinhlangano zomphakathi kuzohlala kuyisici esibalulekile emizamweni yokufeza impumelelo nokugcwalisa izibopho.
U-Lionel Messi: Umqeqeshi Wamaphupho ULionel Messi, owazalwa ngoJanuwari 24, 1987, eRosario, e-Argentina, ungomunye wabalingisi bebhola abahamba phambili emhlabeni. Uthole udumo oluningi ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe okukhulu, ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, kanye nesikhono sokuphendula ezimeni ezinzima. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nezithiyo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokukhula okungajwayelekile, okuholele ezinkingeni zempilo ezithinta izitho zakhe. Ngemva kwesikhashana, uMessi wathola ithuba lokudlala kwi-Barcelona, lapho aqala khona ukuvelela. Ngonyaka ka-2004, waba ngumdlali ophambili, futhi waphenduka isithonjana sebhola. Uhlonishwa kakhulu ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe okuhle, okuhlanganisa amakhono okuphosa, ukuhamba, nokuphendula ngokushesha. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni amathuba, okwenza abanye abadlali bakwazi ukufaka amagoli. U-Lionel Messi ungumuntu onobuntu obuhle, futhi ubuhlobo bakhe nabanye abathandi bebhola buphakeme. Uhlala ethanda ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi izingane ezidinga usizo. Ubuye abe nomsebenzi omuhle wokuphila, usebenzisa udumo lwakhe ukuze athuthukise izimpilo zabanye. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi akugcini nje ngokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, kodwa futhi ungumuntu onothando. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMessi wathola izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise neBallon d'Or, okuyisithonjana sokuhlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele. Ubephinde wathola izindondo eziningi zeLa Liga, iChampions League, kanye nezinye izicoco ezibalulekile. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu eqenjini lesizwe le-Argentina, lapho ehlanganyela khona ekutholeni i-Copa America ngo-2021, okuwumcimbi owawulindelwe isikhathi eside. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwezimoto, uMessi wathuthela kwi-Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) ngo-2021, lapho aqhubeka khona nokukhombisa ubuchule bakhe. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ithimba eliqinile, futhi uqhubeka nokudlala kahle, ngisho nangemva kokushintsha kweqembu. U-Lionel Messi ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuphikelela, okwenza kube sobala ukuthi ubuchule bakhe buphuma emoyeni wakhe. Ngaphandle kokudlala, uMessi ungumndeni onothando. Uhlala edlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomndeni wakhe, futhi ubuhlobo bakhe nomkakhe, uAntonela Roccuzzo, bujabulisa abaningi. U-Lionel Messi ungumuntu ophila impilo ejabulisayo, futhi ubuhlobo bakhe nezingane zabo buveza uthando olukhulu. U-Lionel Messi ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuthi, noma ngabe ubhekene nezinkinga, ungakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu uma uzinikele. Uhlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yobuntu bakhe. U-Messi ungumqeqeshi wamaphupho, futhi izimpumelelo zakhe zikhumbuza abantu abaningi ukuthi, uma usebenza kanzima, ungakwazi ukufinyelela noma yiziphi izinjongo zakho. U-Lionel Messi, umqeqeshi, umphakathi, nomuntu onothando, uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi impilo ingaba yinhle uma sithanda lokho esikwenza. Uqhubeka nokukhanyisa izimpilo zabantu abaningi, futhi izinkanyezi zakhe zikhanya kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. U-Lionel Messi, umqeqeshi wamaphupho, uyisithonjana esizohlala sikhumbuleka.
Umbiko Ngemisebenzi Nezimo Zesikole Sikahulumeni Isingeniso Izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo eNingizimu Afrika. Zihlinzeka ngethuba lokufunda kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abavela emindenini engatholakali kalula ezinsizeni zemfundo. Njengoba sithokozisa imfundo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimo, izinselele, kanye nezinzuzo ezihambisana nalezi zikole. Izimo Zesikole Sikahulumeni Izikole zikahulumeni zisebenza ngaphansi kwezinhlelo ezithile ezibekwe uhulumeni. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi imikhawulo ethile emalini ethathwayo, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha othisha. Ngokuvamile, izikole zikahulumeni zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, kusukela ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kuya ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Lokhu kudala umehluko ekutholakaleni kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengemithombo yokufunda, izincwadi, nezikhungo zokuhlola. Izinsiza Nezinhlelo Zokufunda Uhlelo lokufunda ezikoleni zikahulumeni luhlanganisa izifundo ezisemqoka ezifanele zonke izigaba zempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezifana nezibalo, isiZulu, isiNgisi, kanye nezifundo zomphakathi. Nokho, izikole ezithile zihlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza, okwenza kube nzima ukufundisa kahle. Izinsiza ezinjengamakhompyutha, izincwadi, nezikhungo zokufunda zihlala zingatholakali, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni zasemakhaya. Izinselele Eziqhubekayo Izikole zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinselele eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemali yokusebenza kwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Izinhlaka ezithile zihlala zibhala izinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izikole, kodwa imiphumela ibonakala ingaphelele. Othisha, abanye babo bahlupheka ngenxa yokungakhokhelwa kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuba bakwazi ukufundisa kahle. Okwesibili, izikole zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinkinga zokuhlala. Abafundi abaningi bahlala kude nezikole, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abafundi baphuthelwe yizifundo ezibalulekile, okwenza kuncishiswe amathuba abo empumelelo. Izinzuzo Zesikole Sikahulumeni Naphezu kwezinselele ezikhona, izikole zikahulumeni zinezinzuzo ezinkulu. Zihlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenayo imali yokukhokhela izikole ezizimele. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho bonke abantu bezokwazi ukufunda futhi bathole amathuba alinganayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwabafundi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, lapho abafundi baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo. Izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza futhi ukuhweba ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa ukuqonda phakathi kwabafundi. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole zikahulumeni, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni kanye nezakhamuzi basebenzisane. Izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwandisa imali ethathwayo ezikoleni, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okungcono kubo bonke othisha, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokufunda ezithuthukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinsizeni zokufunda. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, izincwadi, kanye nezikhungo zokuhlola. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole, kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezithuthukisayo ezizokwazi ukuxhasa abafundi, othisha, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Isiphetho Izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, zikhuthaza ukufunda nokukhula kwabafundi. Noma zikhona izinselele eziningi, izinzuzo zazo zikhombisa ukubaluleka kwazo empilweni yomphakathi. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole, kubalulekile ukuthi kuqhubeke nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izakhamuzi, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile kubafundi bethu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola amathuba alinganayo emfundweni.
Ukuncintisana kwezinkundla zokusakaza (streaming platforms) Ngaphakathi kweminyaka engama-20 edlule, umhlaba wezokuxhumana uye waguquka kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwezinkundla zokusakaza. Lezi zinkundla, ezihlanganisa iNetflix, iAmazon Prime Video, iDisney+, nezinye, ziye zaba yizinsika ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuncintisana phakathi kwalezi zinkundla, kubalulekile ukubheka umlando wazo, izinguquko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezindlela ezahlukene ezisetshenziswa ukuze zihlale zikhangisa kubasebenzisi. Ukwakhiwa kwezinkundla zokusakaza kuqala ngonyaka ka-2007, lapho iNetflix, eyayiqala njengenkampani yokuhambisa amaDVD, yethula insiza yokusakaza. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba kwavula umnyango omusha wokubuka okuqukethwe. Ngaleso sikhathi, abanye abahlinzeki bokuqala bebelokhu besebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile zokusakaza, kodwa iNetflix yaphendula ngokushesha, yenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukufinyelela kumafilimu nezinhlelo zethelevishini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNetflix yathola izinzuzo ezinkulu ngenxa yokukhula kwenethiwekhi ye-inthanethi, okwakwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kumakhono ayo. Ngonyaka ka-2013, iNetflix yathola udumo olukhulu ngemuva kokukhulula uchungechunge lwezithombe olwakhiwe kahle, iHouse of Cards. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, kwavula umnyango wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe okwakhiwe ngqo ukuze kudlalwe ku-inthanethi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abanye abahlinzeki bokuqala, njengeHulu neAmazon Prime Video, baqala ukuncintisana ngokuqinile. I-Hulu, eyasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2007, yathola udumo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-serials amasha, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezilandelayo kokubukwayo kwethelevishini. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokukhanga abasebenzisi abathanda ukubuka izinhlelo ezithile ngokushesha, ngaphandle kokulinda isikhathi eside. Ngonyaka ka-2019, iDisney+ yethulwa, yenza umhlaba wezokuxhumana ube nezinselelo ezinkulu. I-Disney, enezimpahla eziningi ezidumile, yaziwa ngokukhiqiza amafilimu nezinhlelo ezithandwa kakhulu, okuhlanganisa iStar Wars neMarvel. Lokhu kwavula umncintiswano omusha, njengoba iDisney+ yathola izigidi zababhalisile ezinsukwini zokuqala zayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkundla zokusakaza ziye zathuthukisa izindlela zazo zokukhangisa. Ziqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-algorithms yokuhlola izintandokazi zababhalisile, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhangisa okuqukethwe okufanele. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola okuqukethwe abakuthandayo, futhi kwandisa isikhathi abachitha bejabule kuzo. Nokho, ukuncintisana akupheli lapho. Izinkundla zokusakaza ziqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezikhethekile, zifaka izinkanyezi ezidumile, futhi zenza izivumelwano ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngama-serials nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo wokuncintisana, lapho izinkundla zidinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze zihlale zikhangisa kubasebenzisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokusakaza ziye zathola izinzuzo ezinkulu ngenxa yokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-smartphones nezinye izinsiza ezihambayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukubuka okuqukethwe noma kuphi, noma nini. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabantu ezinkundleni zokusakaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkundla zokusakaza ziye zathola izinselelo ezithile, njengokuncintisana okuqinile, izinkinga zokulawulwa kokuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okungavunyelwe. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkundla zihlale ziqaphele izinguquko emakethe, ziqhubeke nokwakha okuqukethwe okusha, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa kubasebenzisi. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubonakala sengathi ukuncintisana kwezinkundla zokusakaza kuzoba namandla amakhulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, izinkundla zizoshesha ukufinyelela kubasebenzisi, ziqhubeke nokwakha okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa kubabhalisile. Lokhu kuzokwenza umhlaba wezokuxhumana ube nezinselelo ezinkulu, kodwa futhi kuzokwenza kube nezinzuzo ezinkulu kubasebenzisi, njengoba bezokwazi ukufinyelela kumakhono amaningi nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Ngokuphetha, ukuncintisana kwezinkundla zokusakaza kube nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Lezi zinkundla ziye zashintsha indlela abantu abathokozisa ngayo, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumakhono amaningi, futhi ziqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezithokozisayo. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinkundla zokusakaza zizohlala zikhona, ziqhubeke nokuncintisana, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhangisa kubasebenzisi.
Ukubhikisha Kwabafundi: Izwi Lentsha Eliphakamisayo Ngokuqala konyaka, abafundi bezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika bahlangene emzamweni wokukhombisa ukuthokoza kwabo ngezinhlelo ezithile zemininingwane ebekufanele ifinyelelwe kalula. Lokhu kuhlangana kuhambisane nokubhikisha okubuhlungu okwakuhloselwe ukugqamisa izinkinga ezibuhlungu zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, okuhlanganisa nezindleko zempilo, izikweletu, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhalipha abafundi. Ukukhathazeka okukhulu kwabafundi kube kuvela ngenxa yokwanda kwemali yokufunda, okuholela ekutheni abaningi bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindleko eziphezulu zemfundo. UJuliette Mthembu, umfundi oneminyaka engu-21, uthe: "Sizama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwi lethu lizwa. Uma singakwazi ukukhokha imali yokufunda, sizothola kanjani imisebenzi elindelekile? Lokhu kungenza sibe neqhaza elincane emphakathini." Ukubhikisha akwenzekile njengesizathu sokuqala sokukhangisa ngezimali ezihamba phambili. Abafundi bahlala bejolise ezikhungweni zabo, begqugquzela abantu bangesabi ukuphikisana nabaphathi. Ngemva kokuhlangana okukhulu, bacela iziphathimandla ukuba zibe namathuba amaningi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zifundingwa ngendlela efanele. Umdlalo wokubhikisha uqale eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, lapho abafundi behlangana ukuze baqondise izinkinga ezihlukahlukene. Umfundi ophakathi kwezinhlelo, uKabelo Dladla, uthe: "Sifuna ukuba nezwi elikhulu, futhi sibona ukuthi kudingeka izinguquko ezibalulekile. Ngeke sithule! Sifuna ukufakwa ezinqubweni eziphathelene nemfundo yethu." Ukubhikisha kwaze kwahlaba umxhwele, bekukhona izincwadi zokusekela ezikhiqizwa yizikhungo zomfundi ezihlanganisa izimfuno zabo. Lokhu kowukuthi abafundi bahlala besebenzisa izinkanyezi zayo ukuze bakhombise ukuthi kudingeka izinguquko ezikhona. Carina Hlongwane, osihlalo weQembu Lentsha Yezemfundo eNyuvesi yaseWits, uthe: "Abafundi bethu bembula izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Kumele sithole umqondo wezesekeli ezidingekayo ukuze siphumelele." Njengoba izinhlelo ziqhubeka, iziphathimandla ziye zabona banye abafundi besebenzisa izinkanyezi zokuqhuba ukuhamba kwemfundiso yabo. UZandile Khumalo, umfundi osemncane, uthe: "Sikhangca ukuze sithole izindlela zokuphuma emhlabeni wezindleko eziphezulu. Sifuna ukuba nabantu abachwepheshe abakwazi ukusinika izinsiza ezidingekayo." I from lapho, izihlangano zikhuthazwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezikhaliphile ukuze ziqhube phambili izifundo ezibalulekile zamabhizinisi. Abafundi baye bacela kuhulumeni ukuthi anikeze izinsizakalo eziphumelelayo ezifanele ukudlula izinhlelo ezithile, ukuze kuzuzwe ukufinyelela kumathuba amaningi emfundweni. U-Julius Makena, ongumholi wenhlekelele yeMfundo Efundekayo, uthe: "Siyabazi ubuhlungu obuhlonipheka lapho sekubhekene nemikhawulo yokuhlonipha ulwazi. Sihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezibalulekile okulindeleke ukuba zinikezwe ngokushesha." Ngenxa yokukhushulwa kwalesi sikhumbuzo, kunezizathu ezithile ezithinta imfundo yezehlakalo. Ukususa izikhumba ezilungile kuphakathi kwezicwangciso ezinkulu ezingephuli umoya wempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Abafundi baveze ukuzimisela kwabo emizameni yokufinyelela ezimfanelweni zokubheka ubuchwepheshe, ukuze bakwazi ukuzibandakanya ezinhlelweni ezenzakalayo. Iziphathimandla zifunde nzima lokho okufunwa ngababhalisi abavela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, kuthi ekugcineni ziphinde zarhumezela kahle umphakathi. Izinhlangano ezinezikole zibhala ngezinto zobuchwepheshe njengokuhlinzeka ngamasu okukhuluma nabafundi. Ngaphezulu, abaphathi benza kube lula ukufuna izimali ezivela emazweni angaphandle, efunwa yizikhungo eziyinhloko emhlabeni, ukuze kuthuthuke rakhe imfundo. Lokhu kuzinikela emnothweni wezwe, ukuze kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuxhasa abafundi. Ukubhikisha kukaJuliette, uKabelo noZandile kwenze kube sobala ukuthi abafundi banganikeza umbono obalulekile ekukhulumeni ngezinsizakusebenza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuqubuka kuxhunywe kancane kancane ezinsukwini ezizayo, ukuze kube nezinhlelo zokuphucula imiphumela yemfundo, ukuze wonke umfundi azwe imiphumela emihle. Ngakho-ke, umgomo wabafo ukufinyelela ezicini ezithinta impilo yomumo wezimfuno zabo. Uthando nemibono yabo kufanekisela ukuzimisela okukhulu, okusho ukuthi abakudinga bangakwenziwa kudala. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabo kuzokwakha isimo esisha sokufunda, begxila ekukhulumeni ngezinkinga ezithinta abantu bonke. Ngalokho, lesi sikhathi sombiko sikhombisa ukuthi uhlelo olubumbene lwezimpilo zabafundi lungathinta imiphakathi eminingi. Futhi, kudinga ukuba lao bantu baziswe izizathu ezimbi nobuhlungu obukhona kuphela uma besake tadalwa kusuka. Ukukhombisa ubumbano kanye nezinto ezithule ezibhekeni ezinzima, abafundi baveza izwi labo ngendlela eyinhloko elindelekile. Ukwakha ukufunwa komkhiqizo omuhle, kumele sithole ukusekelwa okwengeziwe kumphakathi wagenile, ukuze sithole izinsiza ezisemqoka ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuhlomule abafundi, izikhungo, nomphakathi wezifundo, kuhambahambe umphakathi wonke.
Umbiko Wakho: Izepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Lapho sihlola izepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi leli zwe linomlando ocebile ogcwele izimpikiswano, ububha, namathuba amasha. Ukuphathwa kwezomnotho, ubulungiswa, kanye nezindaba zomphakathi kudala izifiso nezidingo zabasebenzi. Kulesi sikhathi, sifuna ukuqonda kahle izimo ezithinta izepolitiki kuleli. Ukwakhiwa Kwezepolitiki Njengoba izinkanyezi zomhlaba zishintsha, izepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika ziqhubeka zithuthuka. Ukukhula kwabantu abasha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye namathuba embonini ye-digital, kudala amandla amasha ezepolitiki. Izinkampani ezincane, ezibizwa nge-startups, zikhula kakhulu futhi zenza izinguquko ezidingekayo emnothweni. Ukuze sithole impumelelo ema-startups, kubalulekile ukuba nezicwangciso ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izifundo Ezivela emlandweni Ukuze siqonde indlela ezepolitiki ezashintsha ngayo, kudingeka sibheke emlandweni. Ubulungiswa bezepolitiki buwaholela ebuhleni obukhulu, kodwa ngemva kweminyaka yobandlululo, umphakathi uphinde wajikijela emuva. Kuze kube manje, umphakathi usaqhubeka nokuthuthuka futhi awukhohlwa imiphumela emibi yezenzo zomhlaba. Ukuvuma lezi zifundo kungasiza amazwe afuna ukuthuthuka ngendlela efanele. Imibono Ehlukene Kodwa-ke, izepolitiki azinayo imbono eyodwa. Abantu bahlukile, izifiso zabo zihluke, futhi lokhu kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene nezamasiko. Izinkampani ezikhethekile, njengezombusazwe, zidinga ukuthola izisombululo ezihambisana nemibono ehlukene. Ukuvuma le mibono kungenza izinqumo eziphusile, futhi kugqugquzele ukwenziwa kwezinto ezibalulekile. Ubuhlakani Bethu Kulokhu, ubuhlakani bethu budinga ukwelulekwa nemihlangano ehlukahlukene ukuze kubhekwe umphakathi wonke. Akusiyo kuphela imiphakathi ekhona, kodwa ubuhlakani bethu bezepolitiki bouyaziwa futhi kudinga ukubheka izimfuno zomphakathi. Lokhu kubeka isibopho kumaphoyisa, emaphoyiseni, nakwamanye amahhovisi. Imizamo Yokwakha Ubulungiswa Ubulungiswa kuzona zonke izigaba zezepolitiki buhlukile, futhi kudinga imizamo eyengeziwe ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga. Akusona isizathu sokuthi kube khona ukungaboni ngaso linye, kodwa kufanele kube nezinqumo eziphusile ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Imizamo yokwakha ubulungiswa kufanele yenziwe, kuhlanganiswe nokuheha izinqubomgomo ezithinta umphakathi. Izinga LokuHlonipha Nokuqonda Kubahlali, kubalulekile ukuba nezinga eliphezulu lokuhlonipha nokwazi umphakathi. Ukuhlonipha okukhulayo kuzomisa ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nomphakathi. Ukuhlonipha iziko lezemfundo, lambako, kuzosiza ekwakheni imikhakha yengqondo, okuzothuthukisa imiphakathi. Izenzo Zokuphila Kwansuku zonke Izindaba eziphumelelayo zidinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezenzo zansuku zonke. Ukuze ukukhuthaze umphakathi, abazedwe bangakha amasu ahluke kakhulu ukuze kuvezwe izinguquko. Lokhu kudinga imikhakha engokwemvelo nezinyathelo ezithile ezizophumeza izinjongo ezibekwe. Ukuxhumana Nengxenye YamaNingizimu Afrika Ukuziqonda kahle, ukuxhumana nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kuzobeka isimo esisha ezepolitikini. Abantu abahlukene, izinkolo ezahlukene, kanye nemiqondo ehlukene kudala umhlaba ophilayo owawusho umbono. Ukujula komphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sihlole izimo zepolitiki ezinobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Kulokhu, kuzozuzwa okwengeziwe emnothweni, futhi umphakathi uzokwazi ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezaziyo. Isiphetho Ukuze siphumelele futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile, kudinga ubuhlakani obuphakeme ukufaka bonke abantu emphakathini. Ukuhamba phambili noma ukwakha ukuthi lezi zepolitiki zikhona, kumele sihlanganyele, sabelane ngemininingwane, futhi siqhubekele phambili.
