Sifuna umphakathi ozinikele, othobekile, nolwazi olunembile olungagxila ezinhlelweni eziphumelelayo, ukuze sibheke phambili endaweni yezenzakalo ezinhle. Sidinga ukwakha ugqozi oluqhubekayo, ukuze izingane zethu zivikeleke, futhi umphakathi uthuthuke.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi lapho umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga zokuphakelwa kwamanzi. Nokho, le nqubo ibangela izimpikiswano eziningi phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi, ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Izinzuzo Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Okokuqala, amaloli amanzi anikeza isixazululo esisheshayo sokuphakelwa kwamanzi. Ezindaweni lapho amanzi engatholakali kalula, amaloli amanzi angasiza ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ngokushesha, okubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezithintekile yizinhlekelele zemvelo, lapho izinsiza zamanzi zingase zibe ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Okwesibili, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaba yindlela yokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Uma umphakathi ungathola amanzi ahlanzekile kalula, lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu, kunciphise izifo ezithathelwana ngamanzi, futhi kuthuthukise imiphumela yokufunda ezikoleni. Ngakho-ke, amaloli amanzi angaba yinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaba yithuba lokwakha imisebenzi. Izinkampani ezithengisa amanzi zidinga abasebenzi, okungaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi endaweni. Lokhu kungasiza ekunciphiseni bezinga lokungasebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni wendawo. Izinkinga Zokuthengwa Kwamaloli Amanzi Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi. Okokuqala, izindleko zokuthenga amanzi zihlala ziphakeme. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga enkulu kubantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi uma umphakathi ungenayo imali eyanele yokuthenga amanzi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale bephila ngaphandle kwamanzi ahlanzekile, okungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Okwesibili, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuphakelwa kwamanzi emithonjeni yemvelo. Uma abantu bephuza amanzi amaningi kumaloli, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwamanzi emithonjeni yemvelo, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ezilwaneni nasemvelweni. Lokhu kubalulekile uma sikhumbula ukuthi amanzi ayinsiza ebalulekile ekugcineni impilo yomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungabi nabulungisa. Abantu abahluphekayo bangase bangatholi ukufinyelela kalula kumaloli amanzi, kanti abanye abantu bangase bathole amanzi kalula ngenxa yokuthi banemali. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni ukungabi nabulungisa phakathi kwabantu, okungase kube nomthelela omubi emphakathini. Isixazululo Esingaba Khona Ukuze sithole isixazululo esingcono, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Uhulumeni angase aqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zamanzi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile ngaphandle kokuthenga amaloli. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, noma ukwakha iziteshi zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezitholakala kalula. Izinkampani ezithengisa amanzi zingase zisebenzise izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ukuze zinciphise izindleko. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile ngentengo engabizi kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ungase uqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ayatholakala kubo bonke. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi kuyinkinga enezinzuzo nezinkinga. Nakuba amaloli amanzi engasiza ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile, izindleko eziphezulu, ukungabi nabulungisa, kanye nomthelela emithonjeni yemvelo kuyizinto ezidinga ukunakwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ukuze bonke abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwamaloli amanzi. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onobulungisa, futhi ophumelelayo.
Ukulimala Kwezemidlalo: Ukuhlaziywa Nokubuyekezwa Ukulimala kwezemidlalo kuyinkinga ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka, ikakhulukazi kubadlali abavame ukuzibandakanya emidlalweni ehlukene. Lezi zinkinga zenzeka ngezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungafaneleki, ukungaziphathi kahle, noma ukungabi neziqu ezifanele. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu, izinhlobo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Izizathu Zokulimala Izizathu zokulimala kwezemidlalo zihluke kakhulu. Okokuqala, ukungafaneleki komzimba kubalulekile. Abadlali abavame ukungazilungiselelanga kahle ngaphambi kokudlala bangase babhekane nezinkinga ezinjengokulimala kwemisipha noma izitho zomzimba. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emidlalweni efuna amandla amakhulu, njengokugijima, ibhola, noma i-rugby. Okwesibili, ukungaziphathi kahle ngesikhathi sokudlala kungaholela ezimeni ezinzima. Abadlali abavame ukungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha, njengokugqoka izicathulo ezifanele noma ukungaziphathi kahle emidlalweni, bangase babe sengozini yokulimala. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emidlalweni enobungozi obukhulu, njengezokuhamba ngezinyawo ezinzima noma imidlalo yeqembu. Izinhlobo Zokulimala Izinhlobo zokulimala kwezemidlalo zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Okokuqala, sithola ukulimala kwemisipha, okungaba yizinkinga ezinjengokuphuka kwemisipha, ukulimala kwemithambo, noma ukungasebenzi kahle kwemisipha. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka uma umgibeli engazilungiselelanga kahle noma engaziphathi kahle. Okwesibili, sithola ukulimala kwezitho zomzimba, okuhlanganisa ukuphuka, ukulimala kwezinyawo, noma izinkinga ezihlobene nezitho zomzimba. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka emidlalweni efuna ukunyakaza okukhulu, njengokugijima noma ibhola. Izindlela Zokuvikela Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukulimala kwezemidlalo, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela. Okokuqala, ukuhlela kahle ukujolisa emsebenzini wokuzivocavoca kubalulekile. Abadlali kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bazilungiselela kahle ngaphambi kokudlala, ngokwenza izivivinyo ezihlukahlukene ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi imisipha yabo iyasebenza kahle. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukulandela imithetho yokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugqoka izicathulo ezifanele, ukulandela izinqubo zokuphepha, nokuhlala uqaphele ngesikhathi sokudlala. Abadlali kufanele bazi ukuthi ukungaziphathi kahle kungaholela ezimeni ezinzima, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuba bahlale beqaphile. Isiphetho Ukulimala kwezemidlalo kuyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka, kodwa ngokulandela izinyathelo ezifanele, singanciphisa lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sibe nekhono lokudlala, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izizathu, izinhlobo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Ngale ndlela, singagcina abadlali bephila impilo enempilo, bejabule, futhi bephumelela emidlalweni yabo. Ukuzivocavoca, ukulandela imithetho, nokuba neziqu ezifanele kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela ukulimala, futhi lokhu kuzothuthukisa umphakathi wezokungcebeleka.
Imidlalo Yokulwa: Umcimbi Obalulekile Wokuhlola Amaphupho Nezinhlelo NgoMgqibelo, edolobheni elithokozisayo laseMgungundlovu, kuhlelelwe umcimbi omkhulu ozobamba izethameli eziningi. Imidlalo yokulwa, eyi-athikili ebalulekile emasikweni amaningi, izonikezwa ithuba lokukhonjwa kwezinkanyezi zayo. Lo mcimbi uzoba nezinkanyezi ezahlukene zokulwa, ezihlanganisa izitayela ezilandelayo: i-Taekwondo, i-Karate, i-Judo, nezinye eziningi. Umcimbi uzoba nenhloso yokubungaza ubuciko bokulwa, ukuhlinzeka ngothando, nokukhuthaza impilo enempilo kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi intsha. Ngaphambi kokuqala komncintiswano, abaphatheli bazobhala ngokucophelela imithetho nemigomo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imihlanganisela ibambisene ngamanzi nekhono. Abadlali bazoba nezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuzilungiselela ngaphambi kokuba bezelane amakhono abo. Ukuhlangana kwabesifazane nabesilisa kulindeleke ukuthi kubonakale, kulandela isiko elihle lokwamukela. Abazali, abangane, kanye nomphakathi uzobe ubizwa ukuze basize, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulise abaphakathi. Umcimbi uzokwenza abasebenzi abasha babenesimo sokukhula, ikakhulukazi uma kukhonjiswa abadlali abaqeqeshiwe nabakhi bezinkanyezi. Uzoba nezizwakali ezahlukene ezizobizwa ukuba ziqhube izifundo, ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abaqalayo, iminyaka yentsha, kanye nabadlali abavela ezingeni eliphezulu bazokwazi ukuthola ulwazi olunzulu vềzinto ezilula, izindlela ezichwepheshile, kanye nezimfihlo ezibhalwe phezulu kochwepheshe. Khonamanjala, umcimbi uzokwakha umoya wokuncintisana obalulekile. Abadlali bazocindezela imizwa yabo, bazi nomqondo wokubonga umphakathi. Ukuncintisana ngeke kube zinkanyezi ezijwayelekile; kuzoba nethuba lokuthola iziqu eziphezulu, okuhlinzeka ngenjongo ebalulekile kubadlali bonke. Lokhu kuzokwakha umoya obalulekile wokuhlangana, ubudlelwano, nokuthi wonke umuntu akhuthazwe ukuba abone ukuthi ungakha kanjani imisebenzi yempilo. Ngaphambi kokuphothulwa, umcimbi uzophothulwa ngokuhlonipha ababhokisi abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzoba yisikhathi sokubonga, sokubhalela emqondweni, esihlonipha imizamo yabo yonke. Abathandi be-martial arts bakholwa ukuthi umcimbi awugcini nje ngokuqhuba umphakathi, kodwa uthanda ukukhiqiza inzuzo ethile. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ithuba lokusiza imiphakathi ethile, ngokuqondisa amahhovisi ezempilo nezokwelapha. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uzogcwalisa izifiso zabangane bezobuciko bokulwa, kube nephimbo elikhulu lempumelelo nokuqhubekela phambili. Njengoba umcimbi ungena ezinsukwini zawo, othandweni bezobuciko bokulwa bazoza bezothokozisa, bekhuthaza, futhi bedlalisa abanye. Ngakho, umcimbi uzogcina uduzane, uthule, uyajabulisa emoyeni omuhle wezemidlalo. Umongo walokhu kuhlanganiswe, umcimbi wezobuciko bokulwa uzokwenza baziswe ngempela ukuthi ubuhle bokulwa buhlanganisa ukuthakazelelwa, ubuhlobo, nokuthandana. Kulukhuni lokuhamba kwemikhankaso, kodwa kuyinsika yokubuyisana, umoya wokuvikela, nempilo enempilo. Inhloso enkulu ukuze wonke umuntu abone umhlaba ube ngcono, kuzodingeka ukuthi siqonde amandla ezokulwa, ubuchwepheshe bokulwa, nezifundo ezilungele ukuqhubekela phambili ezihamba phambili emiphakathini yethu. Ngale ndlela, umcimbi wezobuciko bokulwa uzoba yisikhathi sokubongela, sokuhlangana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Uzakwethu othembekile, uthando lwezobuciko bokulwa lolu ukuzokwakha ikilabhu ehlanzekile ehlobene nezokwelapha. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, sizophinde sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuhliseni ubuciko bokulwa, sihlinzeke ngezindlela zokuphila ezikhethekile. Ngakho-ke, ungena ngothando, uzoba yilowo nesibopho sokuphakamisa indlela yethu yokuphila ezithakazelisayo.
Ukufunda nge-Inthanethi Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eGoli, lapho uThandi, intombazane enezifiso ezinkulu, ehamba emgwaqweni. UThandi wayenothando lokufunda, kodwa ubunzima bokuhamba ezikoleni ezikude bukhathaze umndeni wakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi, umama wakhe wamthola ethokozisa ngendaba ethokozisayo — ukufunda nge-inthanethi. UThandi wayengakaze azwe ngale ndlela yokufunda, kodwa umama wakhe wamchazela ukuthi ungafunda izifundo eziningi, afunde izincwadi, futhi axhumane nabanye abafundi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla kuThandi, waba nesifiso sokuzama le ndlela entsha yokufunda. Ngemva kokuthola ikhompyutha encane, uThandi waqala ukufunda nge-inthanethi. Waqala ngokuvakashela izindawo ezahlukene ezikwi-inthanethi, ezifana nezikhungo zokufunda, izifundo zamahhala, nezincwadi ezitholakala kalula. Wathola izifundo ezimnandi ezikhuluma ngempilo, isayensi, nezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, waqala ukubona ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akukhona nje kuphela ukufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabanye. UThandi waqala ukuxhumana nabafundi abavela emazweni ahlukene. Waqala ukwakha ubungane noSipho, umfundi ophuma eThekwini, noLindiwe, owayefunda eKapa. Bahlanganyela izifundo, babelana ngemicabango, futhi baphinde baxoxe ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezazibhalwe ezincwadini abazifundayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokufunda eyayijabulisa, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kwakungaphezu kokufunda kuphela; kwakuwukwakha ubudlelwano. Ngesikhathi edlula ezifundweni, uThandi wathola ithuba lokubhalisela umncintiswano wezobuchwepheshe. Umncintiswano wawuhloselwe abafundi abasha, futhi uThandi wayezimisele ukuwina. Waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngesoftware, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokwakha izinhlelo. Ngemva kwezinsuku eziningi zokusebenza kanzima, waphumelela emncintiswaneni, wathola umklomelo omuhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akukhona nje kuphela ukufunda izifundo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha amakhono. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wathola izifundo ezithokozisayo ezimayelana nezobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, nezokuphatha. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, waqala ukwakha umbono omusha wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungamphatha kanjani empilweni. Ngemva kokuhamba phambili, uThandi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emhlanganweni wezobuchwepheshe. Wazizwa ejabule, ngoba wayezokwazi ukuhlangana nabantu abavela emhlabeni wonke, ababelana ngemicabango nezinto abazifundayo. Emhlanganweni, uThandi wathola ukuthi abantu abaningi babebhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo, kodwa bonke babenokholo lokuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuzobasiza. UThandi waphumelela emhlanganweni, wathola ithuba lokuba umxhumanisi wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi, futhi waqala ukufundisa abanye abafundi ngendlela yokusebenzisa i-inthanethi ukuze bathole ulwazi. Waqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi wokufunda, lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango, izinsiza, nezifundo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba ngumfundisi ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ithuba lokuhamba emhlabeni, efundisa abanye abantu ngendlela yokufunda nge-inthanethi. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi wathola ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka kuze kube phakade. UThandi waphinde wakhumbula izinsuku zokuqala lapho aqala khona ukufunda nge-inthanethi. Wayebona ukuthi le ndlela yokufunda yamenza waba umuntu ongcono, futhi wathola ukuthi ukufunda akukhona nje kuphela ukufunda izifundo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Wazi ukuthi, nge-inthanethi, akekho ophoqelekile ukuba yedwa; bonke bangahlanganyela, babelane, futhi bakhule ndawonye. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungashintsha impilo yomuntu. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo yokufunda, futhi wathola injabulo enkulu ekuboniseni abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze bathole ulwazi. UThandi waba yisithonjana sokufunda, futhi wathola ukuthi, nge-inthanethi, izinkanyezi zikhanya kakhulu.
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqa ngesikhathi ikwenza imisebenzi yayo yansuku zonke yokuhlanganisa imali yentela kahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nemali yentela yebhizinisi esiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zinhlelo. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, okungabandakanya abakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, abancintisana ngebhizinisi, abameli, kanye nabathengisi ngenjongo yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amaholo abika ku-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokufihla ulwazi oluqoqwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi lufihliwe futhi alunakukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphoqelelwayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ukufihla kulolu lwazi, unikeza ukugcina kwalo njengolwazi olufihliwe ngokomthetho, ngaphandle komuntu onelungelo lokuluthola noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukuthola lolu lwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekana nokufihla okuhlobene nokudluliselwa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kudingeke. Lezi ziqephu ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti olwazi lwe-SARS, futhi, uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS yenze kube lula ukucubungula izicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandela nokuphendula ngesikhathi njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezingase zenzeke ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nesiko le-SARS lokuvuleka, njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuhlonipha kwe-SARS izimiso zokubopheleka, ubuqotho, nokwethembeka kulabo i-SARS ibambisana nabo. Ngaphansi kwakhe, kukhona abaphathiswa abane abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS njengoba kudingeka umthetho nsuku zonke. Omunye nomunye uMphathiswa unikezwa indawo ethile yokusebenza kuye ngolwazi lwabo kanye nesipiliyoni somsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo yokusebenza ngokusekelwe kulwazi lwabo nesipiliyoni. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS, kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo elitholakala kuSheduli 1 bese ulithumela kumphathiswa ofanele. Abaphathiswa basebenzisa ihhovisi elilodwa kanye nekheli leposi. Kwezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma uthole amarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukucubungula isicelo sakho kuthatha isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungiselela ulwazi oluceliwe ngemuva kokukhokha imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela oyicelile noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwe kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho indlela ethile oyicelile. Zonke izihlanganisi ezingeniswe, ezakhiwe, noma ezithengiswa eNingizimu Afrika kumele zibhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokubhaliswa 36 ka-1947. Umfaki-sicelo kumele abe ngumuntu ongena emthethweni, isibonelo, uJohn Peter Citizen T/A owenza ibhizinisi ngaphansi kwegama: Diepsloot Stud. Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinkampani ezibhaliswe kuleli, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano ebhaliswe ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika zingafaka isicelo sokuhlinzeka ngezihlanganisi. Izihlanganisi zeqembu lesi-2 ziqukethe ama-macro nama-micro organisms njengokwakhiwa okuyinhloko, okwaziwa nangokuthi izihlanganisi zemvelo. Usayizi wamabhakede noma ukupakisha ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela kuMlawuli. Isicelo sokudla kwezilwane nezihlanganisi kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu oqokwe ukuba amele umfaki-sicelo, isitifiketi sokuhlaziywa, noma ishidi ledatha. Amafomu okusebenza kumele athunyelwe ukuze kufakwe izicelo ezintsha kanye nezichibiyelo ezibhalwe phambilini, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ekwakhiweni; thumela amafomu amabili, ugcwalise kahle ifomu elilodwa ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, izinombolo zamakhasi, noma eminye imikhiqizo. Okwesibili kungaba ikhophi. Umuntu oqokwe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ophakathi kokuxhumana noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu okusebenza. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuchibiyela. Thumela amafomu okusebenza ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuthumela amafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzod delay inqubo. Bhala ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akudingeki ukuba kube nezimpawu eziprintiwe ngalezi zilimi zombili. Lonke ulwazi kumasigni kumele luhambisane ngokexactly nalokho okunikezwe efomini lesicelo. Thumela isicelo sakho kanye nezinkokhelo kuMlawuli weMthetho 36 ka-1947. Ukubhaliswa kwezihlanganisi kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.

Iqembu Lophenyo iImperani (eFicksburg). Kukhona amahektare angama-1,510. Kungani umhlaba ophumelelayo ungakhuliswa? Futhi umhlaba owawubizwa ngamaqembu abantu, ngakho kungase kube nzima ukuthola imali yokukhiqiza. Iqembu Lophenyo lihlangana kangakanani? Iqembu lethu lihlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngohlelo lwezolimo, futhi futhi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili, mayelana nohlelo lwezithombo. Yini inzuzo yokuba yilungu leQembu Lophenyo? Manje sesiyazi ukuthi kwenzekani embonini yokudla futhi siphinde sazi ngamathuba atholakalayo kwezolimo. Sinehlelo lokwesekwa esingalithembela kukho uma kunenkinga. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweQembu Lophenyo kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo lwezolimo? Ngezinye izikhathi sihlangana nabakhiqizi ngabanye abathengisa ukuze benze inzuzo emakethe futhi sizizwa sengathi siyingxenye yomphakathi obanzi babalimi. Ingabe ufuna ukuhlangana neQembu Lophenyo labakhiqizi abafuna inzuzo, futhi kungani ucabanga ukuthi kubalulekile? Kubalulekile kithi njengabakhiqizi ukukhuluma ngomsindo owodwa. Umkhiqizi osemncane usemkhakheni wokuba umkhiqizi ofuna inzuzo yokudla. Ukuqala ndawonye, ukuxhumana, nokwesekana kuzokwandisa bonke abakhiqizi.
Ukubona intuthuko esiyenzile mayelana nobuso bobuDemokhrasi, mayelana nezinguquko ezinhlelweni zokwahlulela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kokwahlulela nokubekwa kwenkantolo kwazo zonke izinqubo, ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, isiko, noma isimo sakho. Unelungelo lokwelashwa ngokushesha nangokucophelela, ngenhlonipho yokuhlonipha isithunzi sakho nokugcina ubumfihlo phakathi kwazo zonke izisebenzi zedepartment, izikhungo, izindawo, noma izinhlangano ezihlobene noma ezinikeza usizo kuwe (ezizobizwa ngokuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo). Amaphoyisa, ngesikhathi sokuhlola; abameli bezokwahlulela noma osomthetho ngesikhathi sokulungiselela icala noma ngesikhathi sokuhlola; nabanye abahlinzeka ngosizo bazokwenza imizamo yokunciphisa noma yisiphi ukudideka okubangelwa, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngokubuza imibuzo ngolimi olwakho olukhethayo noma oluqondile uma kudingeka. Unelungelo lokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngesikhathi sokuhlola icala nasemva kokuhlolwa kwalo. Amaphoyisa, ummeli, kanye nomphakathi wezinsizakalo zokulungiswa bazothatha izinyathelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi noma yini ofuna ukuyifaka ekuhloleni, ekwahluleleni, nasekucatshangelweni kokuphikiswa kwesigwebo izokwenziwa futhi icatshangelwe uma kuhlolwa ukuthi kuqhubeke yini nokuhlola noma ukuhweba noma ekuphikisaneni kwesigwebo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uzoba nethuba lokwenza enye isitatimende kumaphoyisa uma uzwa ukuthi isitatimende sakho sokuqala asiphelele; ungakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka, lapho kudingeka, ngesitatimende enkantolo noma unikeze ubufakazi ngesikhathi sokuphikiswa ukuze ubonise umthelela obangelwe yicala enkantolo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ungabhalela uMongameli weBhodi Yokuphikisa isicelo sokuba khona emhlanganweni wokuphikisa isinqumo sokuphikiswa, kuhlanganise nemibono yakho ebhaliwe. Unelungelo lokwaziswa ngamalungelo akho nokuthi ungawasebenzisa kanjani. Njengengxenye yamalungelo akho, ungacela incazelo nganoma yini ongayiqondi kahle ngolimi olwaziwayo. Unelungelo lokuthola ulwazi nokwaziswa ngazo zonke izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ezihlinzekwa ngabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Uzokwaziswa ngendima ozoyidlala kuleli cala kanye nesikhathi esilinganiselwe esingathatha ukuze icala likhuliswe. Ungacela ulwazi mayelana nosuku lokukhuluma kwecala, izimali ezikhokhelwa kubafakazi, kanye noHlelo Lokuvikelwa Kwefakazi. Ungabuza ngesinqumo senkantolo mayelana necalakhe ukuthi sizokwenziwa noma cha. Unelungelo lokuthola izincwadi zomthetho ezikuvumela ukuba uzithole. Ungacela ukuthi uMnyango Wezinsizakalo Zokulungiswa ukukwazisa uma umsolwa ebalekela ejele noma edluliselwa kwenye jele. Unelungelo lokucela usizo futhi, uma kudingeka, ukuthola izeluleko zomphakathi, zezempilo, nezomthetho, kanye nosizo oluzobhekana nezidingo zakho. Umphakathi wezokwahlulela uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo ezibalulekile zilandelwa uma kuziwa ekuhlukunyezweni ngokocansi, ekuhlukunyezweni kwasekhaya, ekunakekeleni izingane, noma okuhlobene nokunakekelwa, lapho-ke, uma kudingeka, lezi zindaba zikhuluma ezinkantolo ezibekiwe. Uma unazo izidingo ezithile, zonke izikhungo zokwesekwa zizozama, ngokwezisebenzi zazo, ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zakho, ziqinisekisa ukuthi uphathwa ngothando. Unelungelo lokubuyiselwa kwempahla yakho noma indawo yakho uma kuthathwe ngokungemthetho, noma uma impahla yakho noma indawo yakho damagewe ngokungemthetho. Ukubuyiselwa kubhekisela ezimweni lapho inkantolo, ngemva kokuthi umsolwa aboshwe, iyala umsolwa ukuba abuyisele impahla yakho noma indawo ethathwe ngokungemthetho, noma ukuba alungise impahla yakho noma indawo eyadliwe ngokungemthetho, ukuze ibuyiselwe esimweni esasikhona ngaphambi kokwenzeka kwalelo cala. Umphakathi wezokwahlulela uzokwazi ukukwazisa ukuthi ukubuyiselwa kuhlobene nani futhi umphakathi wenkantolo uzokusiza ukuqinisekisa leli lungelo. Uma wazi ukuthi unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo sakho, ungaxhumana nalolo mnyango wombuso noma isikhungo sosizo uma unokukhala mayelana nosizo olutholakele, noma uma amalungelo akho engahlinzekwanga. IKomidi Lokulingana Kwamabhizinisi kanye noMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo bhalisela wonke amaqembu angaphansi kukahulumeni kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ngokubonga ngokubamba iqhaza kwabo ekuphumeleleni kokuphumelelisa le Mthetho Wamalungelo Wabantu Abathintekayo.
Umbuzo 1: Yini uGoogle? uGoogle ungumkhiqizo wezobuchwepheshe owakhiwe ngo-1998 nguLarry Page noSergey Brin. Uhlelo lweGoogle luhlanganisa izinjini zokusesha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsizakalo eziningi ezithuthukisa indlela abantu abathola ngayo nolwazi. Njengoba uGoogle ebonakala njengenjini yokusesha, ubonakala futhi njengomholi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, unikeza izixazululo ezahlukene ezifana ne-Gmail, Google Maps, ne-Google Drive. Umbuzo 2: UGoogle usebenza kanjani? Uhlelo lweGoogle lusebenzisa amakhodi akhethekile ukuze luhlaziye imininingwane ethile ku-inthanethi. Uma umsebenzisi efaka umbuzo, uGoogle uthola izimpendulo ezihambisana kakhulu ngokuhlola izigidi zamawebhusayithi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngama-algorithms akhethekile akwazi ukuhlaziya izinga lokubaluleka kwewebhusayithi ngayinye, okwenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi olunembile. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenza uGoogle wahluke kwabanye? Okunye okwenza uGoogle wahluke kwabanye yikhono lalo lokuphendula imibuzo ngokushesha nangempumelelo. UGoogle unezinsiza eziningi, futhi ubuchwepheshe bawo buhlala buhamba phambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, unikeza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana ne-Google Docs ne-Google Sheets, ezivumela abantu ukuba basebenze ndawonye, noma ngabe bakuphi emhlabeni. Umbuzo 4: UGoogle uthinta kanjani impilo yethu? UGoogle uthinta impilo yethu ngendlela enkulu. Njengoba sithola ulwazi kalula, sikwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithuthukisa imfundo, ibhizinisi, nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudala izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, zokuxhumana, nokusebenza, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni ehlukene. UGoogle usiza abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene, befundisa, futhi besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana noGoogle? Nakuba uGoogle ukhula ngokushesha, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yazo iwukuphepha kolwazi. Abantu bahlala bekhathazekile ngokuqinisekiswa kokuthi imininingwane yabo iphephile, futhi uGoogle ubhekene nezinkinga zokuvikela ulwazi lwezabasebenzisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, udaba lokubusa nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu liphinde libe yinkinga, njengoba uGoogle edinga ukugcina ibhalansi phakathi kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo zomthetho. Umbuzo 6: UGoogle uzoba kanjani esikhathini esizayo? Esikhathini esizayo, uGoogle uzoba nesibopho sokwenza ubuchwepheshe bube lula ukufinyelela, kube nokuphepha, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. UGoogle uzophinde uqhubeke nokwenza izinhlelo ezintsha ezizothuthukisa izindlela zokuxhumana, zokusebenza, nezokufunda. Uhlelo lwe-AI (Artificial Intelligence) lukhula ngokushesha, futhi uGoogle uzosebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze uthuthukise izinkonzo zawo, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo ezizokwazi ukufunda izidingo zomsebenzisi. Umbuzo 7: UGoogle ungathuthukisa kanjani umphakathi? UGoogle ungathuthukisa umphakathi ngezindlela eziningi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela kolwazi, uGoogle ungasiza ekwakheni imiphakathi efundile. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-Google for Education zikhuthaza abafundi, zikhulisa amathuba okukhula, futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uGoogle unikeza izinsiza ezikhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba nokukhula. Umbuzo 8: Kukhona yini imikhuba emihle yokusebenzisa uGoogle? Yebo, kunezindlela eziningi zokusebenzisa uGoogle ngendlela efanele. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi sithola kanjani ulwazi. Ukusebenzisa imithombo ethembekile nezinsizakalo ezisemthethweni kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi olufanele. Okwesibili, kufanele siqaphele ukuphathwa kolwazi lwethu, siqinisekise ukuthi sithola izilungiselelo zokuphepha ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi, nakuba uGoogle unikeza izinsiza eziningi, kubalulekile ukuba siphinde sithole ulwazi oluningi emithonjeni ehlukene ukuze sithole umbono ophelele. Isiphetho uGoogle ungumkhiqizo obalulekile empilweni yethu yanamuhla. Uhlelo lwawo luhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi luthinta izinselelo ezithile. Ngokusebenzisa uGoogle ngendlela efanele, singakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kulwazi, sithuthukise imiphakathi, futhi sithole amathuba amasha. Njengoba uGoogle uqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuba sihlale siqaphele izinguquko ezizayo futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sisebenzisa lezi zinsiza ngempumelelo.
Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha: Uhambo Lwakhe uSipho USipho, oneminyaka engama-22, uvezile ukuthi impilo yentsha yamanje ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezimweni zokungasebenzi. Udlule ebunganeni obuhle, kodwa umgwaqo wakhe wokuqashwa ungaphansi kwemithwalo emikhulu. Uhlanga lwakhe, oluthokozisayo, luveza ukukhathazeka okukhulu okukhona enhliziyweni yakhe. Wazalwa eMgungundlovu, uSipho uqale ukufunda ezikoleni eziphakeme lapho abekhuluma khona ngemicabango emihle yokuphila. Wenza kahle ezifundweni zakhe, ikakhulukazi ezemfundo kanye nesayensi. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, umndeni wakhe wawethemba kakhulu ukuthi uzothola umsebenzi osheshayo. Nokho, kwaba nzima, njengoba umnotho wesifunda wathinteka kakhulu ngaleso sikhathi. Ngemuva kokuphothula iDiploma yakhe, uSipho waqala ukufuna umsebenzi. Wathumela izicelo eziningi, waphendula izikhangiso eziningi, futhi even ecela ngezikhala ezikhona, kodwa ukuphendulwa kwakhe kwakuncane. Lokhu kumshiya ebonakala engaphelelwe yithemba, ebona abantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene bephumelela, kanti yena eqhubeka nokuhlala ekhaya. U-Sipho uyazi ukuthi ukungasebenzi akukhona okwenza umuntu ungabi nalutho, kodwa kumphatha kabi. Waqala ukufunda ngezindlela zokwakha imisebenzi emisha, ehamba emihlanganweni yentuthuko yomphakathi, efunda izindlela zokuzimela. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akukamvimba, kodwa kumenze waba nesineke. Uthi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi kukhona amathuba. Kumele ngihambe ngayo le ndlela, ngingavumi ukudikibaleka.” Esikhathini esingamashumi amabili, uSipho wathola ithuba lokufunda umsebenzi wezandla, lapho abekwazi khona ukukha imikhiqizo yezandla. Lokhu kumenze wathola imali encane, kodwa okukhona okukhuthazayo. Waqala ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yakhe emakethe, kanti abathengi baqala ukubona ikhono lakhe. Kodwa ebuka phambili, uSipho uthi: “Ngifuna okungaphezulu. Ngifuna ukuba nebhizinisi elikhulu.” Ngenxa yokusebenza kanzima, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuqala ibhizinisi lakhe, elibhekiswe ekukhiqizeni imikhiqizo yensimbi. Uthathe isinqumo sokuthola uxhaso oluncane, waze wathola abakhethiweyo abamtshela ukuthi baphakamisa izinhlelo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi lakhe laqala ukwenyuka, kanti abanye abasha abavela emiphakathini yabo bakhuthazeke Ngolwazi lwakhe. U-Sipho usebenza ngokucophelela, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukuthola umsebenzi akuwona umgomo kuphela. Ufumene umqondo wokwakha umphakathi onempilo, wabelana nabo bonke abasha abahlangabezana nezinkinga ezifanayo. Ube nesifiso sokwakha uhlelo lokweseka abasha, ukuze baphumelele futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho ufinyelele kulokho ayephupha ngakho. Uthole ithuba lokukhuluma emicimbini ehlukene, enza izethulo ezimnandi ezikhuthaza abanye. Ukukhuluma kwakhe kugcwele amandla, futhi umoya wakhe wokuphila ubonakala kuwo wonke umuntu. U-Sipho uyazi ukuthi akusikho kuphela ukungasebenzi okukhathaza, kodwa umoya wokufunda, wokwakha, nokuzimisela ungakwenza umehluko omkhulu. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi noma kuhlangabezana nezithiyo eziningi, ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, nokusebenza kanzima kuzokwazi ukweqa lezi zinselelo. Ikusasa lentsha, uSipho uthi, likhulu kakhulu kunokungasebenzi. Ngamafuphi, uSipho usikhumbuza ukuthi impilo ingaba yinhle, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezithile zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi sikhumbule ukuba silwele impumelelo yethu. Ngalesi sikhathi, uSipho ubonisa ukuba nokhohlwa kwempilo, uboniswa njengomholi wesizwe esisebenzayo, eshaya umoya omusha ebantwini, abasha, nempilo. Izenzo zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukungasebenzi okukhathaza intsha, kodwa ukuthi impilo ingavuma uma sithatha izinyathelo eziphusile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela empumelelweni, futhi uSipho ubonisa lokhu ngokuphila kwakhe kwansuku zonke.
Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi Umbuzo 1: Yini ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kusho umuzwa wokukhathazeka, ukudangala, noma ukuncipha kwamandla okubangelwa ukucindezeleka emsebenzini. Abahlengikazi bavame ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwabantu abagulayo, ukunakekela izimo eziphuthumayo, nokusebenza ngezikhathi ezinde, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlala bephapheme futhi benethemba. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimbangela zokukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Izimbangela zokukhathala zibandakanya ukungabi namkhawulo wezinsiza, imfanelo emikhulu yokusebenza, izinsuku ezinde, nokungabi nesikhathi sokuphumula. Abahlengikazi bahlala besebenzisa amandla abo ukuze banakekele iziguli, kodwa lokhu kubangela ukuncipha kwemizwa yokwaneliseka emsebenzini. Ukungabikhona kweziguli eziphilayo, izinkinga zomsebenzi, kanye nezimo ezinzima zokusebenza nazo zenza kube nzima kubahlengikazi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izimpawu zokukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Izimpawu zokukhathala zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zifaka phakathi ukungabi namandla, ukushaywa yikhanda, ukuncipha kokugxila, ukudangala, kanye nokukhathazeka. Abahlengikazi bangase babe nezinselele ezinkulu zokuphatha imizwa yabo, okungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingalungile emsebenzini. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kuhlobene nezinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo? Impendulo: Yebo, ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kuhambisana kakhulu nezinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Uma abahlengikazi bekhathala, bangezwa sengathi akakwazi ukunikeza izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela iziguli. Lokhu kungenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu ekwelashweni, okungadala ukuncipha kokwaneliseka kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Umbuzo 5: Yini okungakwenziwa ukunqanda ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqedwe ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, ukuvumela abahlengikazi ukuba bathole izikhala zokuphumula, nokwakha imvelo yokusebenza efaka ukweseka. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo nezifundo zokuphatha ingcindezi kungasiza abahlengikazi ukuba bakwazi ukubhekana nezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuze baxhumane kahle, abahlengikazi kufanele bazi ukuthi bakhuluma kanjani ngezinkinga zabo, babonise izifiso zabo, futhi bahlale bexhumana nabaphathi ukuze kudaleke izixazululo. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe izinkinga zokukhathala zingathinta kahle ubudlelwane phakathi kwabahlengikazi nabanye osomabhizinisi? Impendulo: Yebo, izinkinga zokukhathala zingathinta ubudlelwane phakathi kwabahlengikazi nabanye osomabhizinisi. Uma abahlengikazi bekhathala, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuxhumana, ukungaboni ngamehlo, noma ukungaboni kahle izindleko. Lokhu kungaholela kuzo zonke izinkinga emsebenzini, okungathinta kahle ukuphawula kwabahlengikazi neziguli zabo. Umbuzo 7: Umphakathi ungawusekela kanjani abahlengikazi abakhathalayo? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungawusekela abahlengikazi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuphila kahle, nokwakha imikhankaso yokukhuthaza umphakathi mayelana nezinkinga abahlengikazi ababhekana nazo. Ukuphakamisa isithunzi sabahlengikazi nokubadlulisa izwi kungabavikela ekukhathaleni kakhulu. Umbuzo 8: Uyini umthelela wokukhathala kwabahlengikazi empilweni yabo siqu? Impendulo: Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo siqu. Lokhu kubandakanya izinkinga zempilo ezibonakaliswa ngokweqile, ezinjengokucindezeleka, ukukhuluphala, nokuncipha kokuzivocavoca. Abahlengikazi abakhathalayo bangase babe nezinkinga emndenini nasemiphakathini yabo, okungabakhathaza kakhulu. Umbuzo 9: Zingaki izinzuzo zokunakekela abahlengikazi ukuze bagweme ukukhathala? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokunakekela abahlengikazi ziningi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukwandisa umuzwa wokwaneliseka emsebenzini, nokwandisa umphumela wokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ekugcineni abahlengikazi bephila impilo enempilo, okwenza kube lula ukuthi benze imisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 10: Yini okumele ubenze uma ubona abahlengikazi bekhathala? Impendulo: Uma ubona abahlengikazi bekhathala, kubalulekile ukuzama ukubakhuthaza nokubasiza. Ungabakhuthaza ukuba bathathe izikhathi zokuphumula, uqinisekise ukuthi banokuxhumana nabanye, futhi unikeze ukweseka kwengqondo. Ukwenza imikhankaso yokuvuselela imizwa emihle nokwakha indawo yokusebenza enobungane kungasiza kakhulu. Isiphetho: Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuze siqede lesi simo esinzima, kudingeka ukuba sibe nomoya wokuxhumana, ukusekela, nokwakha indawo yokusebenza enobungani. Abahlengikazi bahlala besebenzisa amandla abo ukuze banakekele abanye, kodwa kumele futhi bazi ukuthi badinga ukunakekelwa nabo ukuze baqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi wabo ophumelelayo.
Nkosi, abaphakanyisiwe, oMeya, abahlali, abaphathiswa, amalungu ePhalamende, abasebenzi bezinhlaka ezahlukene zikamasipala kuhlanganise nalabo abaphakathi kwezokuphepha, kanye nomphakathi wonke waseOsizweni; ngiyanibingelela. Kukhulunywe ukuthi le nsuku kufanele igujwe njalo ngonyaka. Umgwaqo Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi unomthwalo wokugubha le nsuku. Ngiyethemba sonke singabona ukuthi abantu bethu bayakhula ngokushesha kuyilapho isimo sethu sezomnotho sishoda kakhulu. Yingakho namuhla sizokwethula uhlelo lokufundisa abesifazane, ikakhulukazi intsha, ngendlela yokuzithuthukisa kwezomnotho. Ngiyajabula ukumemezela ukuthi lolu hlelo lokufundisa umphakathi luqale izolo, ngoMsombuluko, futhi ngiyethemba luzosiza kakhulu umphakathi wethu ekubhekaneni nesimo esinzima sezomnotho. Ngiyethemba niyazisa ukubaluleka kwenu njengoba lo mcimbi esifundazweni ukhethwe ukuba wenziwe lapha endaweni yenu. Olunye uhlelo wukwabiwa kokudla kulabo abadinga usizo olukhulu okungamaR140 million. Nokho, ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kubambezelekile ngenxa yenani labantu abakhathazekile kangaka. Njengoba nazi, isifunda sethu sathinteka yizinhlekelele ngonyaka odlule kuhlanganisa izivunguvungu, izikhukhula, imililo, nezinye izinhlekelele ezivela eMolweni, KwaMakhutha, nakwezinye izindawo ezahlukene esifundazweni lapho kwalahleka khona izimpilo eziningi, futhi abantu abaningi bahlaselwe, abaningi bashiywa bengenas shelter. Umthwalo walolu hlelo ungena kule Ndaba ukunakekela labo bantu. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ngonyaka odlule izindleko esazithola ekuphathweni kwalezi zinhlekelele ezihlukahlukene esifundazweni zafinyelela ku-R6 million 800 thousand.
Sithanda ukusungula lezi "Izimiso Zokuqala Kubantu" emsebenzini ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. Sizokhuthaza ukwenziwa komsebenzi ofinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza okufanele nezimo ezifanele ngokushesha. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izixoxiswano zenzeka njalo futhi ngendlela ehlelekile ukuze ihhovisi lakho likwazi ukubhekana nezidingo zamakhasimende akho. Izakhamizi kufanele zazi ngezinga nezimo ezifanele zezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abazitholayo ukuze zazi lokho okufanele kulindelwe. Kufanele ubeke phambili izimiso zokwandisa ukufinyelela okuqhubekayo kulabo abangakaze bakuthole, isibonelo, abantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izithiyo zokufinyelela ziyasuswa. Izakhamizi kufanele zihlonishwe futhi zikhathalelwe. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha yeSikhungo ifaka izindinganiso zokuthi amakhasimende kufanele aphathwe kanjani. Izakhamizi kufanele zinikezwe ulwazi oluphelele nolucacile ngezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abazikhethayo. Ekusebenziseni leli thuba lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele, amahhovisi kufanele anikeze ulwazi oluphelele nolucacile, futhi kufanele luhlaziywe mayelana nezinsizakalo abazihlinzekayo. Izakhamizi kufanele zazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zinikezwa kanjani emahhovisi omphakathi nasezindaweni, ukuthi zishoda malini, nokuthi ubani ophatha lezo zinsizakalo. Amakhasimende angaphandle akuwona kuphela okufanele afinyelele kulolu lwazi; abasebenzi bangaphakathi kufanele baphinde bathole. Inqubo yokuphatha akufanele ibe secretive. Kufanele unikeze ulwazi ngomsebenzi wakho mayelana nezindinganiso zokusebenza ezibekiwe, ukuphathwa kwezimali, nokusetshenziswa okufanele. Imininingwane yabasebenzi kanye namalungu aphatha akufanele ibe secretive. Uma izindinganiso ezithembisiwe zingahlangatshezwa, kufanele kwenziwe uxolo ezakhamizini, kubanikeze incazelo ephelele futhi kuphinde kunikezwe isixazululo esisheshayo nesisebenzayo, futhi uma kukhona izikhalazo, izakhamizi kufanele zithole impendulo enomusa futhi ewusizo. Amandla nokufuna ukwenza isenzo uma izinto zingahambi kahle akuwona umsebenzi obalulekile ekubekeni izindinganiso. Kufanele ukhuthaze impendulo ehhovisi lakho. Izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kufanele zinikezwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamizi zithola ukusebenza kwezimali. Kufanele uqaphele izindawo lapho kudingeka khona ukonga futhi uthuthukise ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezizoholela ekongeni.
amaKaizer Chiefs Kuwo wonke umhlaba, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, amaKaizer Chiefs akhuluma izilimi eziningi. Leli qembu, elibizelwa ngegama likaMnumzane Kaizer Motaung, lidlale indima enkulu emlandweni wezemidlalo kuleli. Lokhu kuhanjelwa kwenziwa ngedumela eliqinile, okudlulelwe eminyakeni eyi-50 yempilo yalo. AmaKaizer Chiefs, abizwa kanjalo ngokuthi iAmakhosi, ayikhona nje kuphela ithimba lemidlalwa, kodwa ithimba lenhloso, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Umcimbi wokuzalwa kwaMaKaizer Chiefs ugubha iminyaka engama-53 yokuba khona kwalesi sikhungo semidlalo. Ngaphezu kweminyaka yama-50, leli qembu belihambelana nemiphumela emihle, imicimbi ethokozisayo, kanye nemidlalo yama-derbies anjengeSoweto Derby, lapho phakade kubonakala khona izithameli ezinezinhlobo ezehlukene. Lo mcimbi, okhushulwa ngezinsuku ezimnandi nezikhumbuzo, uzoba yinsukwana ehloniphekile. Umcimbi ungabhalwa nemiphakathi eminingi, kuhlanganise nezindawo zomphakathi, izinkanyezi zokuqala, amaqhawe, abaphathi bomphakathi, kanye namalungu esigaba sezemidlalo. Imicimbi yonyaka iyakhumbuleka, ngaleso sikhathi lapho abalandeli bejoyina udumo lweqembu labo, belwela ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngandlela-thile, umhlaba wezemidlalo uthola ithuba lokubona ubuciko, ubuhlakani, kanye neqhaza labo. Lokhu kuzolungiselela omuhle abathanda ukuqhamuka, bejabulile, behlanganyela, bese belinda ukuhlanganyela nsuku zonke emicimbini, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Ukubamba amaqhuzu kanye namaloya, ukufundisana, nokubamba iqhaza kwabelani ngesiko lemidlalo ebelwa ngaphambi kokuba sazi ukuthi kuzobhalwa emlandweni, kulokhu kuseshimini. Uma uhamba uyojabulisa, umcimbi uzoba yindida, uzomema izihambeli ezivela phezulu kwezindawo ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izaziso zingathunyelwa futhi zibe nomthelela omkhulu ezinkundleni zomsebenzi. Ukuze bonke abathandi beze, iziphakamiso zezinkanyezi zokuqala zizosetshenziswa ukwenza umcimbi uhambe kahle. Izindaba eziwusizo, izimemezelo ezithokozisayo, nemicimbi yokukhumbula ihlotshaniswa nezinhlelo zokuphila. Emhlanganweni wokuhlonipha, umphakathi uzoba nezinye izinhlelo ezilungiselelwe ngamakhosi, ezihlanganisa imizuzu emide yokwenza izinkanyezi zimise, ukugubha imiklomelo, kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokuhlonipha abaphumelele. Lokhu kuzomenza uzizwe efanele umhlaba wonke, eyokuqala kwezithameli namathuba, ngaphandle kokuphoqelelwa. Izinhlelo ezithakazelisayo zizoziqalayo, futhi abathandi beKaizer Chiefs bazobe bejabulile. Izinkanyezi zomphakathi zizothokozisa abalandeli, bezintumbane, kanye nemikhosi edlalayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalesi sikhumbuzo emqoka, kube nesithakazelo emikhakheni ehlukene, kuhlangene nabaphathi bezemidlalo, kokubili endaweni ethile noma izinkampani ezithile, kuzoholela ekutheni umcimbi ubeimpumelelo. Ngenxa yesimo esibucayi, umcimbi uzobe udinga idokhumenti ethile yokuvikela. Lokhu kuzobandakanya konke okuhle okuvela kunoma iyiphi imvelaphi. Umkhankaso wokubambisana wenziwa ukuze uqalise umphakathi kepha ukufisa kukhombisa intshisekelo, ngesikhathi sokuqhubekisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwezikhwepha. Ubudlelwano obuqinile bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi bukhona ubuhlobo obuphumelelayo phakathi kwamalungu ahlukeneyo nabathandi. Umbhoxo wezithameli udinga ukuchaza izizathu zokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo yelungelo, nibaleke emhlabeni jikelele. Umphakathi waKaizer Chiefs uzabonisa ubuhlakani, ubuholi, kanye nezenzo ezinhle ukuze kugcwaliswe umkhankaso wezikhumbuzo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yalesi sikhumbuzo izobonisa umjayelo wemicimbi, evikela izakhono zezingane ezibhalwe emithonjeni. Lolu suku olukhulu luzosiza ukuba amaKaizer Chiefs aqhubeke nokuduma, abakhona, azikhumbuze, nabalandeli baphinde baqonde kahle. Umoya weqembu ungava emoyeni, uhambisane nezizathu zezenzo ezinhle, umoya wothando nempilo. Kungokuhamba phambili, uMaKaizer Chiefs uzobukela phansi izithombe zempumelelo. Ubuqhela balesi sikhumbuzo buphakanyiswe, beze bahloniphe imbali yabo nodumo lwabo. Umcimbi wokugubha amaKaizer Chiefs uzohlonishwa njengenye yezinsuku ezibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yezenhlalakahle, phakathi kwezemidlalo nezokuhlalisana. Lokhu kuzoletha ukukhaza, uthando nofana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, abalandeli bamaKaizer Chiefs bazoqhubeka bezijabulisa, behlanganyela ezindleleni eziphathekayo, bese bebagubha eminyakeni eyinkulungwane ezayo. Ubuqhawe bokuqala bube buvumelwano, umoya weqembu ube shimini. Kuze kube phakade, amaKaizer Chiefs azophakamisa izimpande zawo, uMsindisi, nomoya wesizwe. Ubudlelwano obuphakeme bazokwenza kucace kakhulu imfunda yokuzinikela.
Ukuze kwenziwe eminye imisebenzi efana naleyo eyalelwe nguNgqongqoshe, iBhodi yezimpawu, iKomidi Lezimpawu ngokuhambisana naleli Khowudi. Ngaphezu kwalesi sikhundla seMnyango Wezimpawu, lo Mnyango onesikhungo sokusiza umphakathi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhuthaza izimpawu zendawo, ukwenza izimpawu zibe ne-Afrika ngokwenza ucwaningo, nokuvikela Izimpawu Zesizwe njengempahla eyasungulwa nguMbuso. Impumelelo yale Mnyango Wezimpawu ibonakala ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhishweni kwezihlonipho zesizwe; ngeflegi entsha yeSizwe, iEmblem yeSizwe, kanye neNgoma yeSizwe. Inhloso yokugcina nokugcina ama-archives ukuvumela umphakathi ukuba ufinyelele kumarekhodi angaphezu kweminyaka engamashumi amabili. I-Archive Yesizwe ivulekile emphakathini kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-8:00 kuya ku-16:00, nangeMgqibelo wesithathu wanoma yisiphi isinyanga kusukela ngo-9:00 kuya ku-13:00. I-Archive Yesizwe isebenza ukuqoqa; igcine futhi ikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwamarekhodi omphakathi nakwabo abangawona omphakathi njengempahla engabalulekile; igcina uhlelo lwekhompyutha olugcina ulwazi ngezimangalo kanye nas heritage yesizwe; ukusungula izindinganiso zokweseka izinsizakalo zokugcina umlando kanye neheritage ezindaweni. Ukuqoqa ulwazi ngempahla yesizwe kanye nomlando kuyinto ebalulekile empahleni yesizwe, futhi kusebenza njengendlela yokusiza uhlelo lokukhomba njengombuso, ukwakha isizwe, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo ezweni. Ukuqoqa ama-documents heritage kanye nomlando kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthi ohulumeni bagcine ukubhekelela umphakathi. Njengoba ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kuthuthukiswa kancane kancane kumphakathi, kubonisa kakhulu imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ngakho-ke, i-archive ye-heritage yesizwe contains zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo zokuvikela izakhamuzi kanye nezinhlangano. Ingxenye enkulu ye-Archive ye-heritage yesizwe ayibonisi izipiliyoni zezingxenye eziningi zamaNingizimu Afrika abhekane nezinselelo. Ngokwesibonelo, labo abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika ababephathwa kabi ngaphansi kobandlululo, abesifazane, njll. I-Archive Yesizwe ingene kulolu hlelo lokuqoqa umlando ngokuxhumana nabantu abakholwa ukuthi banezincwadi zokurekhoda nokugcina, ngaleyo ndlela babamba iqhaza enqubweni yokwakha inkumbulo yabahlali abahlukahlukene baseNingizimu Afrika. I-Archive Yesizwe ye-heritage yesizwe igcina amarekhodi ezizwe ezisemthethweni kanye nalawo angase abe nentshisekelo futhi adinge ukugcinwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikhuthaza ukubambisana nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo eziqoqa futhi zigcine amarekhodi angawona omphakathi. Ngesikhungo sokusiza umphakathi, i-Archive Yesizwe ye-heritage yesizwe ihlose ukufinyelela kubantu bomphakathi abangazi ngokuqhubeka kwalesi sikhungo nemisebenzi yaso. Le nqubo igxile ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwalezi ziqoqo "ngokuzilethela kubantu" ngokuvakashela ezikhungweni zemfundo nasemiphakathini eNingizimu Afrika nangokuhlanganyela, izinsuku zokwazisa, nokusebenza kokufinyelela. I-Archive Yesizwe idala futhi igcina uhlelo oluphakeme lwezokuxhumana oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zokweseka ukuthuthukiswa okuphelele komphakathi. Umthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi uqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yomsebenzi ngamunye ophelile eNingizimu Afrika ithunyelwa mahhala ezikhungweni ezichazwe nguMthetho kulo lonke izwe. Ngalesi sikhumbuzo, i-heritage ebhaliwe eNingizimu Afrika igcinwa futhi iyatholakala emphakathini lapho kudingeka.
Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabalimi abasha? Kubalulekile kakhulu emkhakheni wokukhiqiza ukudla ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezivimbela abalimi abasha ekwakheni ukuba abalimi abakhangayo. Uhlelo lokulungiswa komhlaba olwenziwe nguMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube nenkathazo enkulu kubantu abaningi - imvamisa le nqubo ihamba kancane, ithatha isikhathi eside, futhi ngenxa yalokho, abalimi abasha baphuthelwa amathuba amaningi okukhula, futhi abalimi abamhlophe nabo bayakhathazeka bese bethengisa amapulazi abo kwabanye ozakwabo abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba awuvumelani ngentengo nokumaketha. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuba umnikazi womhlaba - lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuba umnikazi wangempela wepulazi, ukuqasha umhlaba womunye, kuya emhlabeni osetshenziswa umphakathi wonke - awekho amavumelwano asemthethweni abopha abanikazi ("kukhona kuphela okuvunyelwe" kubantu ukuba bahlale lapho). Umhlaba ophethwe ngabantu ngabanye ungasetshenziswa njengokubambisana kwezimali, kodwa umhlaba osetshenziswa umphakathi wonke awukwazi ukusiza njengokubambisana ukuze uthole imali. Ezindaweni lapho umhlaba usetshenziswa umphakathi wonke, kuvamile ukuthi umndeni othile ube nendawo ethile (lokhu kuhluka ngendawo), bese umkhiqizi (umlimi) ofuna ukwandisa ukusebenza kwakhe kufanele axhumane nabanye abantu balo mphakathi ukuze athole imvume yokulima endaweni yabo. Akukho mthethosivivinywa ophakamisayo okwenza kube nokubambisana kokulima le ndawo etholeka ngale ndlela esikhathini esizayo. Ukwandisa impilo yomhlabathi kanye nezinga lephosphates kubiza kakhulu - izikhuthazo zidingeka ngoba abalimi abasha abanamandla okukhokha lezi zindleko. Ikakhulukazi, umhlaba okhona ongasebenzisa abalimi abasha awugcinwanga kahle, izinkambu azinakho ukwakheka, futhi awekho amapaki lapho amanzi angahamba khona. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unegatsha leMisebenzi Yomhlaba, kodwa imali abayitholayo iyancipha kakhulu ukuze baqedele lo msebenzi obalulekile. E-Ningizimu Afrika, umhlaba okhula ungakhiqizi, awukwazi ukulima lapho futhi ulindele umkhiqizo omuhle. Kodwa ukuguqula umhlaba okhula ube umhlaba wokugaya kubiza isikhathi eside futhi kubiza kakhulu. Abalimi abasha abanamandla okuguqula futhi baqhubeke nokulima izinkambu ezingasebenzi, kanti abanye bayashiya lezi zinkambu, beyeka ukulima. Konke lokhu akukuhle. Ukwakha imigoqo noma odongeni noma ikhaya kuyinkinga kubalimi abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho umhlaba usetshenziswa umphakathi wonke ngoba imigoqo iyaboshwa futhi izinkomo (izinkomo nezinkunzi) zihlala ezinkambini ngendlela efanele. Kuneziningi abalimi abasha abathola ukufinyelela emhlabeni (noma kunoma yiziphi zezi zindlela ezichazwe ngenhla), kodwa abanakho imishini edingekayo yokulima lowo mhlaba. Imishini emisha ibiza kakhulu, abalimi abasha bahluleka ukuyifinyelela, futhi awekho amabhange noma ezinye izikhungo ezilungele ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuthenga imishini esebenzisiwe. Lapho kukhona imishini engasetshenziswa, le mishini ivame ukuba isesimweni esingesihle. Imvamisa, isivumelwano sokuthenga umhlaba mayelana nokushintsha kobunikazi bomhlaba sithi umthengi kufanele athathe ipulazi lonke nemishini (ukusebenza okuqhubekayo), bese umthengi ethola imishini endala ephukile. Inhlangano yabafuyi ihlinzekwa ngemishini kodwa akekho ozobophela ekugcineni nasekulungiseni le mishini. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo yokulima, ikakhulukazi ekukhiqizeni ukudla okuyisisekelo, ibibhekene nengcindezi. Unyaka odlule wawuphathwa kahle ngoba izitshalo zafakwa ngemali yokuqala yonyaka odlule, umkhiqizo wathengiswa emakethe yalo nyaka, futhi ezindaweni eziningi, imvula ibiphakeme kunjalo. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa kuphela abazokwazi ukulima ngaphandle kokuthola imali. Lapho imikhawulo yenzuzo incipha, izinga lenzalo lemali ebolekiwe liyanda futhi kunezingozi ezingavela ekulimeni ukudla okuyisisekelo, akusasebenzi ukuhweba leyo mali edingekayo ukuze ufake imbewu emhlabathini. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka (amabhange) zifuna 'ibond' emhlabeni othile ukuze kuqinisekiswe imali. Abalimi abaqasha izinkambu, noma labo abalima emhlabeni womphakathi, abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo miphumela ukuze baqinisekise imali, futhi izinhlangano zifuna ukwenqaba ukuvuma izicelo zabo. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka zifuna umshwalense ukuze le mali isetshenziswe ukuze kuqale ukulima (okokufaka). Kodwa umshwalense wokuqala (nxa uvunywa) uqala ukusebenza kuphela lapho izitshalo ziqala ukukhula. Ngaleso sikhathi, umlimi usukhokhele zonke izindleko. Ezinye izinhlangano zifuna ukwenqaba ukuhlinzeka ngemali ngaphambi kokuvunywa komshwalense. Manje uzokwenzenjani? Umlilo ushisa kokubili - akukho ndlela yokuphumelela. Enye inkinga ukuthi: umshwalense uvuma ukukhokha kuphela u-65% wezindleko - ubani ozokhokhela izindleko ezisele? Ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, kufanele sithi kube khona abalimi abasha abangakakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo, ngakho-ke labo abahlinzeka ngemali abasenamfanelo yokuboleka imali kalula. Ukulima kunzima kakhulu, futhi uma ungakabi nolwazi nolwazi, uzobeka engcupheni. Lapho imikhawulo yenzuzo incane, awukwazi ukuzivumela ukwenza amaphutha. Ngakho-ke, abalimi abasha abasafunda ubuchwepheshe bokulima bathola kunzima ukuthola izikweletu ngoba izinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngemali azithembi, ziwabeka icala. Abalimi abasha "bafundi," badinga ukwesekwa, badinga ukuqeqeshwa, badinga ukufundiswa ngabantu abanokwazi. Abantu abasebenza kuMnyango Wezolimo kanye noMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba imvamisa bangenalo ulwazi lokuhlinzeka ngaleso sesekelo esidingekayo. Abaningi abazi lutho ngokuqhubeka, abazi ngempela, abaningi bazama ngoba bafundile kodwa abake "bafake umgibeli emhlabathini." Ukuvuselela abantu kubiza imali futhi kuthatha isikhathi. Izigaba eziningi zomphakathi zinezinhlangano eziningi ezisebenza lapho futhi zikhokhelwa kodwa zingeziwanga. Lapho abantu bangaphandle njengezinkampani befuna ukuza ukuhlinzeka ngensiza, kufanele kube nomthombo wemali - kodwa ekugcineni, ubani ozokhokhela lezo zindleko? Imvamisa abalimi bathola isimo lapho bengazi ukuthi yimaphi imiyalezo okufanele bayilandele - bazokholelwa ukuthi uth authority ehlinzeka ngolwazi ikhuluma iqiniso noma ukuthi uth authority 'we agribusiness' ofuna ukwandisa ukukhiqiza imali noma inhlangano ethi ibasekela noma labo abazama ukufundisa ukulima (Ngokuphathelene, bonke laba bantu bathi into efanayo)? Ukufunda ukulima kusho ukuthi kufanele uthathe izinyathelo ezingenza kube nezinkinga eziningi - uma abantu befuna ukuba abakhiqizi, kuzokwenzeka ukuthi benze amaphutha. Kukhona isidingo esikhulu sokweseka labo abazame kodwa bahluleka. Okwamanje, kukhona abalimi abathile abanenhlanhla yokuthola uxhaso ngokuqhuba 'agribusiness', ngaleyo ndlela banethuba lokuqinisekisa izikwelet
Isikhathi sokuvuna sesisondele futhi kusekhona emapulazini amaningi agcwele izihlahla. Izingxoxo zethu zihlala zibuyela kulokhu: izihlahla ziyisitha esikhulu sokukhiqiza ukudla. Okubalulekile kakhulu lapho kukhiqizwa izitshalo zokudla ukuphatha nokususa izihlahla. Uma kukhona izihlahla, umkhiqizo uzobhekana nezinkinga ngezindlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi ukulahleka okukhulu komkhiqizo nezinkobe zizonakaliswa. Emhlabeni jikelele, kunokushoda kwezinkobe ezidliwayo, ngakho asikwazi ukumukela ukuthi izinkobe zikhishwa ngoba zibhujiswa yizihlahla. Izinkobe zentanga azivunyelwe ukuba zibe khona ezinkobeni ngoba zineziphuzo ezilimazayo futhi abantu noma izilwane azidli. Mayelana nomthetho ophatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo nokuhlanzeka kwezinkobe, kunezinhlobo zezimila ezingavunyelwe nhlobo ezinkobeni. Ngokwesibonelo, ngokwezimiso zomthetho, akufanele kube khona isikhumba esisodwa se-thorn apple (datura). I-datura inenhlanzi engalimaza kakhulu umuntu. Okubalulekile esikufundayo lapho sibheka ukuphathwa kwezihlahla ukususa umonakalo wokuqala ezinkobeni. Ibhontshisi elingenazo izihlahla futhi elinganqotshwa yizihlahla liyisiphumo sokuphatha kahle izitshalo zakho ngokuqhubekayo, hhayi ukuzama lapha nalapho ukuwabulala izihlahla. Uma ukususa okusheshayo kwezihlahla ngesikhathi sokutshala kungasebenzi kahle, izihlahla kufanele zikhishwe emapulazini ngaphambi kokuvuna. Uma izihlahla ezinkulu zisuswa emapulazini ngemuva kokuba nezinkobe, kuzoba ngcono ukuwasha lezo zihlahla ukuvimbela ukuthi ziqale ukuphuma futhi ngonyaka ozayo. Khumbula, umkhiqizo omuhle ubonisa ukuthi kunezinkobe eziningi - izinkobe eziningi ezihlanzekile!
UShakespeare uthe, "Ungabi mboleki noma umbolekisi, ngoba mboleko ivamise ukulahlekelwa yiyo kanye nabangane." Lokhu kuyiqiniso. Nokho, uma ungumlimi okwamanje, uzobhekana nengcindezi yokuboleka imali ukuze ungene ebhizinisini lokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani abalimi befuna ukuboleka imali? Nokuthi ungumnikazi wezindawo noma wazi kanjani ukulima ngenye indlela, khumbula ukuthi ukulima kuyibhizinisi futhi uzodinga imali ukuze uqhube ibhizinisi lakho. Akukhathalekile ukuthi uthola kanjani umhlaba. Mhlawumbe uthola umhlaba ngokusebenzisa umthetho wokulungisa umhlaba, noma mhlawumbe uwuthenga ngemali yakho oyitholile kwenye indawo - kodwa uma ufuna ukulima, uzodinga imali. Umhlaba ubiza kakhulu, ngakho abantu bahlala becabanga ngezindlela zokwandisa imali yokuthenga umhlaba. Kodwa umhlaba ungowengxenye yebhizinisi lokulima. Uma ulima ngezinkomo, uzodinga ukuthenga izinkomo (izinkomo noma izimvu, izinkukhu, noma izinkabi). Uma ufuna ukukhiqiza okusanhlamvu noma imifino, uzodinga ukuthenga ama-traktor nemishini yokulima umhlaba. Akuqedi lapho; uzodinga ukuthenga nezinye izinto ngaphambi kokuthi uqale uk planting (izitshalo, umanyolo, amakhemikhali, i-diesel, njll.). Kungenzeka ukuthi inani lezi zindleko lidlula inani lokuthenga umhlaba. Yini esivumelwaneni sokuboleka? Ukuboleka imali kuyibhizinisi - kukhona umuntu onemali ofuna ukukhulisa leyo mali. Kodwa bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngeke balahlekelwe le mali futhi kamuva bafuna ukuhola okuningi kunalokho okubolekiwe. Abafuni ukuthatha izingozi. Lapho kukhona ingozi, bazokwandisa izinga lenzalo futhi uzokwenza imali eningi ukuze uboleke le mali ekuqaleni. Njalo, uma uboleka imali, uzodinga ukuhlinzeka ngempahla njengempahla. Lokhu kuvikele umbolekisi ekulahlekelweni yimali yabo; bazothengisa lezo zimpahla uma ungabuyiseli mboleko yakho. Esikhathini esedlule, abantu bavame ukuboleka imali endaweni eyodwa, futhi uma behluleka ukukhokha le mboleko, babeyodlula kwenye indawo ukuze baboleke imali yokukhokha le mboleko yokuqala. Abantu babebanjwa ukuba bahlinzeke ngemininingwane mayelana nazo zonke izimbola zabo. I-NCA (Umthetho Wezokukhipha) ishintshe lokhu. Abantu abapheka imali kumuntu bazi ukuthi uma bengakwazi ukukhokha, bazobanjwa baphendule. Manje sekukhona imininingwane ngazo zonke izimbola zabantu; uma inhlangano yokubolekisa ingenakuthola konke kumlimi, bangabona ukuthi ummeli unazo ezingaki izimbola futhi bangase benze isinqumo sokungamukeli le mboleko entsha. Njalo, abalimi bayazithokozisa uma bengakwazi ukuthola mboleko, kodwa uma ungakwazi ukukhokha le mali, kuzobhalwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho liphumelele - bese kwenzeka izinto ezimbili ezimbi. Inhlangano yokubolekisa izolahlekelwa le mali, futhi ngeke ukwazi ukuboleka imali futhi. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imali ebolekiwe kufanele ibuyiswe - uboleke imali, akusiyona nje isipho noma umnikelo. Kungani kunzima kubalimi abasha ukuboleka imali? Ikhono lakho lokukhokha mboleko lincike esimweni sezezimali zakho nasemhlabeni wakho. Umuntu ophakela imali kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uzokwazi ukukhokha le mali ekupheleni kwesikhathi esishiwo. Lapho sibheka uk planting izitshalo, sibona ukuthi uzodinga u-R5,000 ngehektare. Ngamanani wamanje (amanani angonyaka odlule ayengaphansi kuka-R2,000 ngotoni), uzodinga ukuvuna ama-ton angu-2.5 ngehektare ukuze uhlangabezane nezindleko. Khumbula ukuthi kaningi ezindaweni eziningi, kuvunwa ngaphansi kwamatonu amabili ngehektare. Uma umlimi efuna ukuboleka imali ukuze abeke izitshalo, umbolekisi uzobheka umkhiqizo ojwayelekile unyaka nonyaka, amanani azotholakala, kanye nezindleko zokubeka izitshalo. Ngakho-ke, okwamanje, akukho abantu abafuna ukuboleka imali yokubeka izitshalo. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo akuhlinzeki inzuzo. Umkhawulo wenzuzo evela emalini oyifakile ubuncane. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo kunenkinga, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kaningi yonke imisebenzi yokukhiqiza ukudla ibhujiswa. Manje sekukhona ukuhlinzekwa okweqile kokudla, amanani ehla, kodwa izindleko zokukhiqiza ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. Ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zokubolekisa azikathandi ukuboleka ngoba umbolekisi ngeke akwazi ukukhokhela umbolekisi inzuzo eyanele. Ubuchwepheshe bomlimi. Uma uqala umkhankaso omusha noma ibhizinisi, awunalo ulwazi oluningi, ngakho uzokwenza amaphutha. Lokhu kuyiqiniso nakwabanye abalimi abasha - abakhombisanga ukuthi bangalima iminyaka eminingi. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuboleka imali. I-collateral ye mboleko. Sishilo ukuthi umbolekisi ufuna ukwazi ukuthi uma ungakwazi ukukhokha le mboleko, bazokwazi ukuthengisa izimpahla zakho ukuze bazuze imali yabo. Njalo, umlimi ngeke akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombuso njengempahla (okujwayelekile ekulimaleni). Abalimi abaningi abawona abanikazi bezindawo (njengomhlaba wombuso noma umhlaba uqashwe), noma umhlaba unebhondi eyinhloko esiza umlimi ukuthenga lowo mhlaba. Uma umlimi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempahla, umbolekisi uzophika ukuboleka imali ngoba besaba ukulahlekelwa yimali yabo. Bangakwenza kanjani abalimi ukuzama ukuthola mboleko yokubeka ngaphandle kwempahla? Imali edingekayo yokubeka ivamise ukufinyelela ku-R4,500 ngehektare (sithatha lokhu lapha njengomfanekiso). Uma umlimi efuna ukubeka ama-hectare angu-100, uzodinga ukuboleka u-R450,000. Lokhu kuyimali eningi. Ake sithi umlimi unendawo enhle, enomhlaba ophilile, indawo lapho kunenhlama eyanele, umkhiqizo uvamise ukuba muhle, futhi imakethe ivumela ukuba kube nenzuzo, khona-ke umlimi angaya eLand Bank, ezinkampanini zokulima, noma ezinkampanini zokubambisana ukuze athole mboleko yokubeka. Ake sithi umlimi akakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombuso njengempahla, manje umlimi kufanele athole enye indlela yokuhlinzeka ngempahla. Lapha, umshwalense wezimpahla ungase ube nendima (umshwalense wokufaka). Lo mshwalense uvikeleka ezindleleni "zeZinkanyezi," hhayi ekulimaleni okungalungile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi kufanele alime kahle, akhombise ukuthi uvame ukuthola umkhiqizo omuhle unyaka nonyaka, bese angazama ukuthola lowo mshwalense. Inhlangano yomshwalense izobheka inqubekela phambili yomhlaba ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi ingaphika ukuqhubeka nomshwalense nganoma yisiphi isikhathi - bahlola uhlobo nobukhulu bomhlaba, bahlola amasampula omhlaba, bahlola indlela yokubeka, uhlobo lwezithelo, umanyolo osebenzisiwe, ukuphathwa kwezifo nezitshalo - uma konke lokhu kungahambisani nezidingo zabo, le nkampani izophika ukuhlinzeka ngomswalense. "Izinto zeZinkanyezi" ezihlinzekwa umshwalense zingabandakanya ukuntula, isichotho, imvula eningi, umkhovu, kanye nomlilo. Khumbula ukuthi umshwalense awuvikeleki ezindleleni zokulima ezimbi.
