Amaphrojekthi Wamandla Avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa Isingeniso Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ukuvikela imvelo, kanye nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. Lezi zinyathelo zifaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kweziteshi zamandla elanga, amaphrojekthi wamandla omoya, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uqale amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izidingo Zomphakathi 1. Bheka Izidingo Zomphakathi: Qala ngokuhlola izidingo zamandla zomphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuxhumana nabantu bendawo, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni bendawo ukuze uqonde izidingo zabo. 2. Hlanganisa Idatha: Qoqa idatha ethile mayelana nezinga lokusetshenziswa kwamandla, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela amaphrojekthi afanele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Uhlobo Lwamandla Avuselelekayo 1. Hlola Izinhlobo Zokukhiqiza Amandla: Khetha phakathi kwamandla elanga, amandla omoya, amandla amanzi, noma amanye amandla avuselelekayo, kuye ngezidingo zomphakathi nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. 2. Bheka Izimo Zendawo: Qinisekisa ukuthi izimo zendawo zifanele ukukhiqiza amandla, kufaka phakathi ukuhlola izinga lokukhanya kwelanga, umoya, noma amanzi. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuxhasa 1. Xhumana Nezikhungo Zokuxhasa: Thola izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali, izinsiza, noma ulwazi. Lokhu kungafaka uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. 2. Bhalisela Izinhlelo Zoxhaso: Qinisekisa ukuthi ubhalisela izinhlelo zoxhaso ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole uxhaso lwezimali oludingekayo. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlela Nokwakha Amaphrojekthi 1. Hlela Uhlelo Lwamaphrojekthi: Dala uhlelo olucacile lokwakha amaphrojekthi, okufanele kufake izinsuku, izindleko, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. 2. Qasha Abasebenzi Abafanele: Qasha abasebenzi abanolwazi nolwazi olufanele ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha. 3. Qala Ukwakha: Ngemva kokuhlela, qala ukwakha amaphrojekthi. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zilandelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlola Nokugcina 1. Hlola Ukusebenza Kwamaphrojekthi: Ngemva kokwakha, hlola ukusebenza kwamaphrojekthi ukuze uthole izinkinga ezikhona nokuthi zixazululwe. 2. Gcina Amaphrojekthi: Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi agcinwa kahle ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza, okuhlanganisa ukuphakela ukuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nomphakathi 1. Xhumana Nomphakathi: Qhubeka uxhumana nomphakathi ukuze ubazise ngempumelelo yamaphrojekthi, okwenza kube lula ukuheha ukwesekwa. 2. Hlanganisa Izimpendulo: Thola izimpendulo zomphakathi ukuze uthole umbono wabo ngempumelelo yamaphrojekthi, okwenza kube lula ukwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Isiphetho Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa ayisixazululo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ozinzile nowempumelelo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphrojekthi akho aphumelela futhi ahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukubambisana, ukuhlela kahle, nokuxhumana nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze amaphrojekthi akwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo. Qhubeka ube nesibindi, futhi uqhubeke nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umbiko: ITheku Isingeniso ITheku, eyaziwa nangokuthi yiTheku leNingizimu Afrika, iyidolobha elikhethekile elinikeza izinzuzo eziningi kubantu. Le ndawo iyinhloko yezokuthutha, ezomnotho, nezamasiko, futhi ibalulekile emnothweni wezwe. ITheku itholakala eningizimu-mpumalanga yeNingizimu Afrika, eduze nolwandle lwe-Indian Ocean, futhi inezindawo eziningi ezithokozisayo ezifana nezikhumbuzo, izimakethe, nezindawo zokungcebeleka. Umlando Umlando weTheku uqala eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane, lapho amaKhoisan, abahlali bokuqala, bahlala khona. Emva kwalokho, iTheku yaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise amaNgisi, amaBhunu, namaZulu. Ukuze siqonde kahle iTheku yanamuhla, kubalulekile ukuqonda indima yayo emlandweni wezombusazwe nezamasiko eNingizimu Afrika. Izakhiwo Zomlando EThekwini, izakhiwo zomlando zikhumbuza abantu ngempilo yamaNgisi nabantu bendawo. I-Old Fort, eyakhiwa ngo-1843, iyisibonelo esihle sokwakhiwa kwesikhathi esidlule. Lezi zakhiwo zikhangisa izivakashi, zikhombisa ubuciko bokwakha besikhathi esidala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Emperor's Palace, eyaziwa njengendawo yokudlela, ibonisa ubuchwepheshe bokwakha obuphambili. Izindawo Zokungcebeleka ITheku inezindawo eziningi zokungcebeleka ezihamba phambili. I-Umhlanga Rocks, enezihlabathi ezimhlophe, iyindawo ethokozisayo yokuphumula. Izivakashi zingadlala emanzini, zibhakabhake, noma zihlale phansi zikhangela ubuhle balolu lwandle. Futhi, i-Durban Botanic Gardens iyindawo ethokozisayo yokuhlola izitshalo ezahlukene, ibonisa ubuhle bemvelo. Ezokuthutha ITheku iyinhloko yezokuthutha eNingizimu Afrika. I-Port of Durban iyindawo yokuhweba enkulu, ibalulekile ekuthumeleni nasekutholeni imikhiqizo emhlabeni jikelele. Izikhumulo zezindiza, njenge-King Shaka International Airport, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kweTheku nezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuthutha kwenza kube lula kubantu nempahla ukuhamba, futhi kuthuthukisa umnotho wedolobha. Izamasiko ITheku iyindawo ebanzi yamasiko, lapho abantu bahlukene behlangana khona. Izimakethe zendawo, njengemakethe ye-Victoria Street, zikhombisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwezamasiko ahlukahlukene. Lapha, abantu bangathola ukudla kwasekhaya, imikhiqizo yesintu, nezimpahla ezikhethekile. Imicimbi yamasiko, efana ne-Durban International Film Festival, ibonisa ubuciko bendawo futhi ikhulisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umnotho Umnotho weTheku ubonakala ngokukhula okukhulu emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Ukuhweba, ezokuthutha, nezokuvakasha zenza kube lula ukuheha abatshali bezimali. Izinkampani ezinkulu zifaka imali eThekwini, zikhuthaza amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kukhula kwenza iTheku ibe yindawo efanele yokuhlala nokusebenza. Izinkinga Naphezu kokukhula, iTheku ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ubumpofu, nezinkinga zokuhlala zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuba uhulumeni nabezindaba basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathuthukise izimo zokuphila zabantu. Ukuze iTheku iqhubeke nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Isiphetho ITheku iyidolobha elinothile ngamasiko, umlando, nezokuthutha. Ibonisa ubuhle bemvelo, izakhiwo zomlando, nezindawo zokungcebeleka ezihamba phambili. Noma kunjalo, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokuphila zabantu. ITheku, njengendawo, inezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo ezilindelela ukuba zihlolwe, futhi umhlaba uqhubeke ufinyelela kuleli dolobha elinothile.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubaluleke kakhulu, njengezibani ezikhanyayo emini. Lokhu akuhlanganisi nje ukusiza kwezokwelapha, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuphila ukuze lezi zinsizwa zikhule ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngalesi sihloko ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinto ezidinga ukunakwa ukuze izingane zethu zibe neqhaza elihle empilweni. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngaleso sikhathi esibalulekile sokunakekelwa ezibhedlela. Ngemuva kokuzalwa, umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi odokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nezisebenzi ezithintekayo bahlale beqaphele. Ukuhlolwa kwezimpawu zomzimba, ukuhlola izinga lokuphefumula, nokubheka ukuthi umntwana uyakhetha ukudla okunempilo kubalulekile. Lokhu kusebenze kahle kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabazali nezisebenzi zezempilo. Abazali kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuvikelwa kwezingane zabo akupheli nje ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile, kodwa kudinga ukufundiswa okuqhubekayo. Okwesibili, kufanele sigxile kumqondo wokuthuthukiswa kwezingane. Ubulili, ubudala, nezimo zomndeni zifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni izingane. Uhlelo lokunakekela oluqinile luzodinga ukufaka izici eziningi ezithinta impilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umntwana uthola konke akudinga. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukudla okunempilo, imikhuba yokuphepha, kanye nezimo zokuhlala ezikahle. Ukuze umntwana akhule kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabazali, ukuze bakwazi ukwabelana ngolwazi oluwusizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube neqhaza elikhulu lezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yazo. Izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zidinga ukwaziwa, futhi lokhu kudinga ukusungulwa kwemithetho nezinhlelo ezilandelwayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezindlela ezithile zokuxhumana nabazali ukuze babonise izidingo zezingane zabo. Abazali badinga ukuqonda ukuthi banendima enkulu ekunakekelweni kwezingane, futhi kufanele bazi ukuthi bangachitha isikhathi esiningi besondela ezibhedlela ukuze bazi ukuthi izinqumo abazithathayo zibalulekile. Ukwengeza, sisho ukuthi impilo yengane ayikho nje kuphela ezandleni zezisebenzi zezempilo, kodwa ibalulekile nakumndeni. Umndeni unendima ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwezingane, futhi izibhedlela kufanele zisebenze njengabaxhasi ababambisene nemindeni. Uma umndeni uzwa ukuthi unendima ebalulekile, kuyoba lula ukufaka isandla ekunakekelweni kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lokhu kuzokhulisa ukuzethemba kubazali, bese bezwakalisa izidingo nezifiso zabo ngokukhululekile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngezinkinga ezithinta ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela. Ezibhedlela eziningi ziba nezinsiza ezilinganiselwe, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka. Ngenxa yokungabi nalwazi noma izinsiza ezanele, abanye abazali bangazizwa besaba ukuvuma izinkinga ezithinta izingane zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izibhedlela zihlale ziqaphela imithetho nezinhlelo ezithinta izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabikhona kwemithombo yokufunda okujwayelekile kungaholela ekunciphiseni amafuthe amahle ezibhedlela. Abazali badinga ukufundiswa ngcono ukuze baqonde izidingo zezingane zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izibhedlela ziqinisekise ukuthi ukusiza abantwana akupheli kuphela ezibhedlela, kodwa kuqhubeke nasemndenini. Ukufundiswa kwempilo, izindlela zokunakekela, nokukhuthazwa komndeni kudinga ukuba kungowesithunzi esiyiphakathi kwezibhedlela. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akuyona into esingayithanda kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukucabangela okuningi. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabazali, ukwakha izinhlelo ezithinta impilo yengane, kanye nokuxhasa umndeni, konke lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa njengendlela eqinile yokunakekela izingane. Ngokubambisana, singenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yezingane zethu, siqinisekise ukuthi zikhula zibe abantu abanempilo futhi abaphumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onqoba ubunzima, futhi uphumelele ngezinhloso ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, asithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela, siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsizwa zethu zithola ukwelashwa okuhle, impilo enempilo, nokukhula okuhle. Lokhu akusikho nje okwakhiwa kwezibhedlela, kodwa kudinga ukwakhiwa komphakathi wonke. Ubulungiswa, uthando, nokunakekelwa kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yezingane zethu ezisanda kuzalwa, futhi lokho kuzothuthukisa impilo yethu sonke.
Ungayithola kanjani imvume yokufaka umhlaba? Uhlaka: Jane McPherson, umphathi wohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezivuno eGrain SA. Ngokuvamile, singasho ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokulima zidinga umhlaba (izinkambu) - kungaba indawo encane lapho wakhe khona ingadi yezitshalo, noma kungaba izinkambu ezinkulu noma umhlaba omkhulu wokugaya ezindaweni lapho kuvame ukuba khona umswakama omncane. Nokho, uma umhlaba usetshenziswa ekulimaleni, kufanele ube nemvume esemthethweni yokungena nokulima le ndawo - lokhu kubopha isivumelwano phakathi komnini womhlaba nomuntu ozowulima (kungenzeka ukuthi umnini nomqashi bangumuntu oyedwa). Kunendlela ezahlukene zokuthola imvume yokulima endaweni ethile, futhi lezi zindlela zixhumene nezimo ezinhle nezimbi. Into ebalulekile okufanele uyikhumbule ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi: zonke izivumelwano ezihlobene nokulima endaweni ethile kufanele zibhale phansi uma ufuna ukuthi zamukelwe enkantolo - isivumelwano esenziwe ngenkulumo asivamile ukuba sibophe. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi uma isivumelwano sikhona, amaqembu abamba iqhaza avuma ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa kanjani futhi ahlale kahle. Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bangase bangavumi futhi kungase kuphume enkantolo. Ngokuvamile, uma kube nezinkinga ezivela mayelana nokuba nomhlaba noma ukuqashwa komhlaba, kunezindleko eziningi ezihilelekile - ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izivumelwano zibhale phansi ngaphambi kokuthi uqale imisebenzi yokulima ukuze amaqembu abamba iqhaza kuleyo zivumelwano avikelwe uma kwenzeka izinkinga. Iphakethe lomhlaba eNingizimu Afrika, nakwamanye amazwe, linomqulu wesihloko ohlobene nalo ngokomthetho. Uma ungumnini walolo phakethe lomhlaba, kufanele ube nalo mqulu obonisa ukuthi ungumnini ofanele. Lo mqulu uchaza isimo salo phakethe lomhlaba. Umqulu wesihloko ungumqulu wezomthetho osetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuba nomhlaba. Umqulu wesihloko waziwa kakhulu njengendlela yokudlulisela ubunikazi kumuntu oyedwa komunye. Ukudlulisela ubunikazi kubhaliswa ehhovisi leziqu ezibekwe ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika. Umqulu wesihloko usebenza njengobufakazi bokuba nomhlaba. Ngokuvamile, uma ufuna ukweleta imali, izakhiwo ezithengisiwe zidinga umshwalense ngendlela yokwakhiwa. Izakhiwo ezibolekayo, njengezibank, zivikela imali yamakhasimende azo ukuze ikhulise, ngakho-ke izibank zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali ebolekiwe iphephile. Umnini wefamu (umnikazi womqulu wesihloko) angasebenzisa le fomu njengomshwalense wokweleta. Bese umshwalense ubhaliswa kulolo mqulu wesihloko futhi uchaza ukuthi zingaki imali ezibolekiwe. Isibonelo: ake sithi umnini wefamu ufuna ukweleta R100,000 ebhange. Ibhange lizobhalisela umshwalense we-R100,000 kulolo mqulu wesihloko. Uma umuntu obolekayo engakakwazi ukukhokha, umnikazi wombhiyozo (ibhange) angacindezela umnikazi womqulu wesihloko ukuba athengise le fomu ukuze umnikazi wombhiyozo akwazi ukuthola imali yakhe. Uma inani lemali le famu lifinyelela ku-R200,000 (isibonelo), khona-ke ibhange lingathatha inani lemali ebolekiwe. Uma umnikazi womqulu wesihloko ebolile R50,000, ibhange lingathatha R50,000 kuphela noma umshwalense ungama-R100,000. Uma umuntu efuna ukulima efamu yomunye, yena nomnini bangena esivumelwaneni sokuqasha. Kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukuqasha indawo ethile achaze kahle ukuthi ubani umnini waleyo fomu. Isivumelwano sokuqasha siyidokhumenti ebhaliwe echaza imininingwane mayelana nesimo sendawo eqashwe, isikhathi sokuqasha, inani lemali ezokhokhwa, nezikhathi lapho le mali izokhokhwa. Isibonelo: isivumelwano sokuqasha singaba phakathi kukaMnu. X (umnikazi - umnini wefamu) noMnu. Y (umqashi - umuntu ofuna ukusebenzisa ifamu) ukuze aqashe ifamu yaseDawn etholakala endaweni yaseTweespruit, ubukhulu bayo bungu-400 hectares, isikhathi sokuqasha sibe yiminyaka emithathu, izindleko zibe ngu-R150 ngehektare ngonyaka, futhi le mali izokhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezilandelayo (hhayi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezedlule). Kungase kube nezinye izinhlinzeko kuleso sivumelwano - isibonelo: izizathu zokungaqhubeki nalesi sivumelwano, imvume yokukhipha izitshalo, ukuhlola umhlaba, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nale fomu ethile. Umqashi akakwazi ukusebenzisa le fomu njengomshwalense wokweleta - lokhu kungenziwa kuphela ngumuntu onemfuyo. Kukhona futhi enye imfuneko ethi "ukuqasha kuqala kokuthengisa." Ake sithi isikhathi sokuqasha sithinta iminyaka emithathu kodwa umnini ufuna ukuthengisa ifamu ngaphambi kokuphela kwaleyo minyaka emithathu, umnini kufanele axoxe nomqashi ukuze bafeze isivumelwano - kungenzeka ukuthi umnini omusha uvuma ukuqhubeka nokuqasha le fomu kumqashi noma umnini angavuma ukukhokha umqashi inani elithile lemali bese isivumelwano sokuqasha siphela. Lapha emsebenzini wethu wokulima, izivumelwano zokuqasha zivame ukuba phakathi kwabantu ababili - omunye engumnini nomunye ofuna ukulima lapho; noma phakathi kwemiphakathi nomlimi (lapho ifamu ingase ibe endaweni ephethwe yimiphakathi); noma umnini angase abe uhulumeni (uhulumeni) - kunezindawo eziningi ezinkulu eziphethwe uhulumeni ezilimiwa ngabantu abangenela izivumelwano zokuqasha. U-13% womhlaba eNingizimu Afrika usezandleni zezikhalazo zendawo (izizwe) - lokhu kufinyelela ku-17 million hectares. Ngempela, uhulumeni ungumnini walomhlaba - ngokuvamile, uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo, uMnyango Wezomsebenzi Womphakathi kodwa uphethwe yizikhungo zezakhamuzi. Njengoba abanye abantu besho ukuthi awekho amarekhodi abhalwe phansi mayelana nokuba nomhlaba okusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke (izizwe), uhlelo nezindlela zokwabiwa komhlaba ziyaziwa kubo bonke abantu abahlala kulezo zindawo (lokhu kungadinga ukubhalwa phansi, kodwa mhlawumbe ehhovisi lapho kubhaliswa khona iziqu). Abafundi abaningi babhale amaphepha bezama ukuchaza udaba lokusebenzisa izindawo zomphakathi nezalokho ezaphathwa ngokomthetho wesikhumbuzo - ngoba kukhona uhlelo oluqondile olubhalwe phansi lapho abantu abamhlophe bathola ubunikazi bomhlaba othile, kodwa ezindaweni ezisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke, awekho amarekhodi abhalwe phansi. Uma umgomo wokuthola umhlaba uwukwakha umkhiqizo wokulima nokunciphisa ubuphofu, kufanele sithi sekuyisikhathi sokukhuthaza uhlelo lokusebenzisa izizwe, nezinye izindlela zokuphatha le ndaba yokweleta imali nokuqasha izindawo zomphakathi kufanele zitholakale. Siphinde sifise ukuthi indlela yokubhalisela ubunikazi bomhlaba okusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke ibuyekezwe - lokhu kuhlobene nokuhlolwa okuqhubekayo okukhuluma ngale ndaba yokwenza umhlaba ezindaweni zomphakathi ukwazi ukukhiqiza inzuzo yokulima. Umkhandlu wendawo waseMatjhabeng kanye nezinkomiti zawo zendawo zinikeze ulwazi olubalulekile nemifundiso esekelwe kule bhukwana. Umxhumanisi wase-Australia uNkk. Pauline Peel usebenze ngokubambisana nomphakathi noMnu. George Moahloli ophakathi komkhandlu, kanye nomlobi womkhandlu uMnu. TV Matsepe, ezinyangeni eziyi-10 ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezinqubomgomo ezingathuthukisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ngezikomiti zendawo. Amalungu ezinkomiti zendawo nawo abambe iqhaza ekwakhiweni nokuqukethwe kwaleli bhukwana. Ngesikhathi sokuqala uhlelo olusha lukamasipala ngonyaka ka-2000, sakhombisa ukuthi lokhu bekuyisici esibalulekile sokuphatha futhi sikhuluma ngokuqondile nangokucacile ngokuqinisekisa ukuzibophezela kwesisekelo sezombusazwe, okungukuthi abantu bazobusa. Saxwayisa abantu bethu ukuthi ndawonye nohulumeni bendawo, sizoletha ubumbano endaweni ohlala kuyo. Embonini yethu yokuphatha endaweni, saphakanyiswa ukubhekana nalezi zinselele eziyisisekelo ezifana nokuthuthukiswa okunganele, ukungasebenzi, ukuhamba kancane, kanye nobuphofu. Izinkomiti ezisanda kusungulwa zomkhandlu zidlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Njengemikhakha yomphakathi kanye nezakhamizi, kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhandlu uyazi ngezifiso, amakhono, nezinkinga zabantu. Futhi kufanele zakhe ibhuloho ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwekhansela nomphakathi abawumelwa. Umthetho wokuphatha wasekhaya unikeza ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zendawo ezizoba yinxenye ehlanganisa abantu nohlelo lwethu lokuphatha. Izinkomiti zendawo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekubambeni nasekuqondeni uhlelo oluyisisekelo lomkhandlu, njengohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlangene, ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali zomkhandlu, kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu. Ngaphandle kwazo, uhlelo lwethu lokuphatha olwenziwa ngababambiqhaza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kukamasipala ngeke lubonakale njengomsebenzi obhekiswe kubantu. Izinkomiti zendawo zisetshenziswe ezindaweni ezingaphezu kwama-80%. Lezi zinkomiti zinezinga elihlukahlukene lokusebenza. Ngokuhlola amazinga okusebenza kwezinkomiti zendawo kanye nomsebenzi wokwakha ubulungiswa phakathi kwalabo abasala, sizokwandisa lokho okutholakala ezakhamizini ukuze sifikise nakakhulu kubantu bethu. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango esebenzayo, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zendawo. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zomkhandlu uma lezi zinkomiti zisebenza kahle. Isinyathelo 17 Yini uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlangene? Ukwethulwa kufanele kube neqhaza ezifundweni ezibalulekile ezifana nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokweseka nokwakha uhulumeni bendawo, kuhlanganise nezinkomiti zendawo. Lezi zinkomiti azisebenzi kuphela; zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuxhumana okufanele phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zethu zokuphatha. Isici esibaluleke kakhulu kulokhu kuzodingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkomiti zendawo zihlangana njalo futhi zisebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe. Le bhukwana ihlinzeka ngemicabango esebenzayo, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zendawo. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zomkhandlu uma lezi zinkomiti zisebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, le bhukwana izokwandisa ekubambeni iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithathwa ngababambiqhaza nomkhandlu. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngababambiqhaza kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zendawo ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe uma besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ngababambiqhaza kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zendawo ukuhlinzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe uma besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi ezindabeni zikamasipala. Isixwayiso: Qiniseka njalo ukuthi ucabangela izinto eziphilayo zomkhandlu kanye nendawo yakho uma usebenzisa imibono neziphakamiso ezitholakala kule bhukwana. Ezinye zezinto eziphakanyisiwe zingadinga ukulungiswa noma ukuguqulwa ukuze ziqondise umongo othile womkhandlu wakho nendawo yakho. Nansi uhlu lokuhlola lokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe nokuthi yini esivele yenziwe mayelana nezici ezibalulekile zomthetho okufanele uqonde ukuze wazi ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze njengelungu lekomidi lendawo. Le mithetho nemihlahlandlela izosiza futhi uqonde izinhlobo zezinto ezinkomiti zendawo ezingazenza ukusiza imiphakathi kanye nabababambiqhaza bazo. Ukuze ukusize uqaphe lokho okufundile, sebenzisa amabhokisi ukuze umake lapho uqedile ukufunda. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 - Isahluko 7 Isigaba 152 - Imisebenzi yokuphatha yendawo. Isinqumo esithathwe umkhandlu wakho sokusungula uhlelo lwezinkomiti zendawo. Ihhovisi lakho lomlobi womkhandlu lingakuhlinzeka ngamakhophi wezimiso nemihlahlandlela yonke ekhishwe. Uma usuthole ikhophi yedokhumenti ngayinye, ungayifaka kule bhukwana. Inhloso yeKomidi lendawo ukuqinisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuphathweni kwendawo. Izinkomiti zendawo zingezinye zezimpendulo zokukhombisa ukukhathazeka ngezindaba zendawo kumkhandlu wendawo, ukuze kube nezwi ezinqumweni, ukuhlela, nasezenzweni ezithathwa ngummeli noma umkhandlu ezizothinta indawo. Umkhandlu wendawo ungumholi wekomidi lendawo, ngakho-ke ungumuntu obalulekile kule komidi. Umkhandlu umele izintshisekelo zendawo futhi unegunya elivela emkhandlweni lokudlala indima ekusekeleni umkhandlu wendawo kule ndawo. Izinkomiti zendawo zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwezindawo ezikhethiwe ezinqumweni ezithathwa emkhandleni, njengoba yibo abakwazi ukuxhumana nomkhandlu ngqo noma ngokuqondile njengabamele indawo abaxhasa iqembu lezombusazwe kufanele babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezifana nenqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu, isabelomali sonyaka, imisebenzi yomkhandlu, nezinye izici ezibalulekile nezinhlelo njengoba zonke lezi zinto zithinta umphakathi wendawo ukuze babone futhi baqale imisebenzi eqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu endaweni ngenkathi besekela umkhandlu ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezokusebenza zomkhandlu, nokubhekana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nezinsalela, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka, ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo njengoba amalungu azi imiphakathi yawo nezidingo zayo. Khumbula ukuthi umkhandlu wendawo kufanele abhalanse lokho okulindelekile endaweni yakhe nalokho okulindelekile ngohlelo lwakhe lwezombusazwe. Lokhu kwenza indima yabo ibalulekile. Kubalulekile ukwazi lokhu nokucacisa indima yomkhandlu ukuze ukwazi ukuza nomqondo omuhle wokukhombisa imibono yakho kule komidi. Uma indima yomkhandlu icacile, uzokwazi ukuvikela ukuncintisana nokuphikisana nalowo muntu kule ndawo. Umkhandlu ok
Mphakathi ophakeme weSisonke District Municipality, uMphakathi J.P. Omunye wababhali abahlonishwayo emhlabeni wakho uthe la mazwi: "izimo nezindlela umuntu akhulela ngazo zinefuthe esikhathini esizayo salowo muntu." Umthethosisekelo wezwe lethu uveza ngokucacile ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlala endaweni ephephile nephakeme. Leli lungelo lifaka bonke, kuhlanganise nezingane, ngoba intsha iyisikhathi esizayo sezwe lethu. IBill of Rights iphinde iveze ngokucacile ukuthi akekho okufanele aphathwe kabi mayelana nosizo lokuthola izindlu. Simi lapha eKokstad namuhla ukuze siqedele lezi zinhloso ezishicilelwe emthethosisekelweni wezwe lethu. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sakhe ukuqala okusha ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi lezo zomphakathi ezisemazingeni aphansi, okuhlanganisa izingane nabesifazane. Simi lapha namuhla ekhaya lehope ukuze sinikeze ithemba futhi sakhe ikusasa el mejor for our children. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, siphila ngesikhathi lapho sibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Phakathi kwezinselelo esibhekene nazo kukhona ukususa ubuphofu nokuqinisekisa inhlalakahle emiphakathini yethu. Kuyiqiniso elingaphikiswa ukuthi iHIV/AIDS iyisithiyo esikhulu esibhekene nabantu bethu. Ezinye izimuli, izindlu zivaliwe, zishiya izingane zihlala zodwa ngenxa yale mpandana. Kusemva kwethu njengomphakathi nakuHulumeni ukuvimbela le mpi ekubhubhiseni ikusasa lesizwe lethu, okuyizingane zethu. Umnyango wethu ukhona lapha namuhla ukuze ubeke itshe esisekelweni sokugcina ikusasa lethu ngokunakekela izingane ezibe yizintandane, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yale HIV/AIDS. Namuhla sizovula ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esikholwa ukuthi siyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokulwa nale mpandana. Lesi sakhiwo sizoba yindawo yokuphepha yezingane zethu ezingenabantu ngenxa yale disease. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezikhathalela izingane, njengekhaya leComfort, kuyindlela eyodwa uHulumeni akholelwa ukuthi angabhekana nayo nalesi sifo sezingane ezizintandane ukuze nazo zikhule ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele futhi zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu akusho ukuthi sikhuthaza izingane ukuba zifakwe ezindlini zentandane. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi izingane zethu ziphumeza ezitaladini ngenkathi thina, njengomphakathi, sikhaba ukunakekela. Ubuphofu kanye neHIV/AIDS kunezimpempe ezimbi ezicindezela izici zomphakathi nezomnotho. Lokhu kudala inani elikhulu labantu bomphakathi abangasekela. Uhulumeni onakekela, njengathi, ngeke uhlezi phansi ubuke isizukulwane sifa ezitaladini. Njengomhulumeni, sikholelwa ukuthi isifunda sethu kufanele sibe yisifunda esinakekela izingane kahle. Sikholelwa ukuthi akekho umntwana okufanele aye embhedeni engekho ukudla futhi akafanele aye esikoleni ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza. Sikholelwa ukuthi amalungelo ezingane zethu kufanele ahlonishwe njengamalungelo omuntu wonke. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sivule ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esizoba yisibani sethemba ezinganeni zethu ezingenabantu ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Kulesi sakhiwo, izingane zizothola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo ukuze zikhule kahle futhi zijabulele ubuntwana bazo. Ukukhula ngaphandle kwabazali akuyona into ejabulisayo nhlobo, kodwa ngalezi zinyathelo, uhulumeni wethu uyasiza ekunciphiseni ubuhlungu obuhlangabezana nezingane zethu ezilahlekelwe abazali bazo ngesikhathi esincane. Njengomhulumeni, sikhathazekile kakhulu ngeHIV/AIDS kanye nemiphumela yayo. Izinga lokukhula kwezingane ezizintandane liyashaqisa. Inani lezindlu eziholwa izingane liyanda. Njengomnyango wezokwakha, sithole umgomo wokubamba iqhaza ekunikezeni izindlu kulabo abathintekile kakhulu yiHIV/AIDS. Umthethosisekelo wethu kanye neBill of Rights kungenzele kube lula ukuhlola imithetho ukuze ukwesekwa kwezindlu kufike kulabo abathintekile ngalesi sifo. Kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esisanda kuqala esifundeni sethu. Ngikhuluma ngezinhlelo ezifanayo eHlabisa, eManguzi, naseThekwini. Inhloso yethu ukuqhubeka nalesi sihloko, sigxile ezindaweni zethu ezisemazingeni aphansi njengezindlu zasemaphandleni. Kule msebenzi, sisebenzisana nezinye izinyunyana zikaHulumeni kuzo zonke izigaba. Sisebenzisana ngokusondelene noMnyango Wezempilo kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Kuyaqondakala kumnyango wethu ukuthi maduze ngizobuyela eHlabisa naseManguzi ngohlelo olunembile lokwakha ezingeni lezingane ezithintekile ngalesi sifo. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, ngalolu hlelo esizolwakha lapha namuhla, sizokuqinisekisa inhlalakahle kanye neqholo lezingane zethu. Siyanxusa iMuniipality lapha eKokstad kanye nabaphathi beKhaya leComfort ngokuba phakathi kwabathola izinzuzo zalo mgomo osinika amandla lokutshala imali ekwakheni nasekukhuleni izikhungo ezifana nalezi. Kulolu hlelo, ngifuna ukubonga zonke izinyunyana ezisebenze kanzima ukuhlaziya imithetho yazo ukuze sikwazi ukubambisana. Ngivumele ngichaze kafushane izinyathelo ezibalulekile kumgomo wethu ezilethele lapha namuhla. Okokuqala, samukela wonke umuntu njengomuntu onamalungelo alinganayo kungakhathalekile isimo sabo sempilo kanye nesimo somnotho. Okwesibili, sihlaziye izidingo zalabo abaphila nalesi sifo futhi sabeka imigomo ecacile yokwakha izindlu zabo ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Okwesithathu, sibuyele emuva ukuhlaziya ukuthi ubani abathola izinzuzo. Phambilini, sakhuluma ngezizinda eziphila ngaphansi komholo othile. Ukuze sakhe lezi zikhungo, sahlola umgomo ukuze sihlanganise labo abangasebenzi kodwa bangazuza uma bephakathi kwezikhungo ezifanele. Bacela ukuthi umnyango wethu usize ngama-57 embhede. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwazisa ukuthi umnyango wami uphumelele ekwakheni isikhungo esingu-362 square meters. Izindlu ezakhiwe zinkulu ngesisindo. Zifaka izindawo zokulala, amabhavu, amahhovisi, indawo yokuwasha, kanye nendawo yokulinda abagulayo. Lesi sakhiwo sakhiwe ngendlela efanele yokwamukela izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo njengoba isikhungo sikhula futhi inani labantu lenyuka. Ngifuna ukuvuma izinkampani ezizimele ukuba zibambisane nathi njengomhulumeni ekunakekeleni nasekukhuleni impilo engcono yezingane zethu. Siyazi ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukunqoba iHIV/AIDS ngokushesha, kodwa uma sihlala sithobekile, sikhathalela, futhi sisebenza kanzima, ngosuku oluthile sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ithemba kulabo abathintekile yiHIV/AIDS. Ngiyanxusa umphakathi wethu ukuba ubhekane nokukhula kwalesi sifo ngokuqondile. Kuyadabukisa ukuzwa ukuthi naphezu kolwazi oluningi ngalesi sifo, izibalo zakamuva zikhombisa ukukhula okwesabekayo kokwenzeka kwalesi sifo. Sidinga ukuvuka futhi sithathe isinyathelo. Namuhla sikhona lapha njengenhlangano yoMnyango Wezobuholi Nezamasiko ukusiza nokuxhasa iNdlu Yobukhosi ekufezeni imisebenzi yayo, efaka phakathi ukufakwa ngokusemthethweni kwabamakhosi ngokwenkolo nangokuhambisana nomthetho. Nkulunkulu, umthetho osekelwe kahle uveza ukuthi ukufakwa ngokusemthethweni kwabamakhosi endlini yobukhosi kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngokuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko. Lo mthetho esiwakhe esifundazweni uveza ukuthi kuphela iNdlu Yobukhosi enegunya lokufaka abakhosi; ngaphandle kwalokho, uNgqongqoshe angasebenza kuphela ngalolu hlelo ngemvume yeNdlu Yobukhosi, uma singakwazi ukuba khona mathupha. UMbusi Hlongwane ungumkhosi wesithupha okufakwe ngokusemthethweni esikhathini esifushane kusukela le nhlangano yamanje esifundazweni sethu yaqala umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sobukhosi endaweni yaso efanele. Le ndawo, isivinini esihamba ngaso sikhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubukhosi busebenza njengendima ebalulekile njengesisekelo sobuholi ngaphansi kukahulumeni obusisekayo. Abaholi bendabuko ezikhathini zokucindezelwa bavame ukungabhekwa kule msebenzi obalulekile wokufaka abakhosi. Ngesikhathi se-apartheid, lo msebenzi obalulekile wokufaka abakhosi wanikezwa kumakhosi nabanye ozakwethu boMnyango. Umthetho WamaMandla Amnyama ka-1951 wawuhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuholi bendabuko buba ithuluzi kuphela labacindezeli. Umsebenzi wabakhosi wokubika kwiNdlu Yobukhosi uyinsakavukela yamasiko futhi uyisisekelo sobukhosi. Uhulumeni esinawo njengamanje esifundazweni uqale uhlelo lwezomthetho oluhloselwe ukubuyisela isithunzi nesikhundla sobuholi bendabuko ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zedemokhrasi njengoba kulawulwa nguMthethosisekelo. Njengohulumeni, siyazi ngomonakalo owawwenziwe yizimiso zangaphambilini kumkhiqizo wobuholi bendabuko. Siqonda, Mhlaba Womhlabathi, ukuthi uthole ukuthi ungabhekwa ngaphandle ezimweni zokufakwa kwabamakhosi nakwezinye ezaziholwa abaholi bendabuko kodwa zenziwa ngozakwethu boMnyango. Nokho, namuhla siqinisekisa wena, Mhlaba Wombuso, ukuthi ukufakwa kwabamakhosi ngeke kusetshenziswe njengemivuzo noma ukuheha ukwesekwa kwezimboni zezepolitiki. Ubukhosi buyisikhungo esihloniphekile kuMthethosisekelo wethu. Yingakho uhulumeni uphakamise izimiso ezifanele zomthetho zokubambisana (IGR) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabamakhosi nezinye izigaba zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Ngikhuluma lapha namuhla ngoba uhulumeni wethu wesifundazwe saseKwaZulu-Natal uqale ucwaningo lokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni wesifundazwe, ezendabuko nezikahulumeni. Ngifuna ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ukuthi abakhosi kanye nonke sikhishwe ezimweni zomthetho zohulumeni bangaphambilini ekubambeni iqhaza ezinhlelweni zikahulumeni. Kodwa kusukela manje, le mikhawulo iyinto yesikhathi esedlule. Kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa "ukubuyiselwa" kwesithunzi sobukhosi njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuphatha. Nokho, kuyadabukisa ukuthi abanye bethu sebebambelela ekusebenziseni ubuholi bendabuko ngezinhloso zezepolitiki nasemphakathini. Esikhathini esedlule, abepolitiki nabaphathi baphakamisa abanye abakhosi phezu kwabanye. Lo hulumeni wamanje uzokwamukela kuphela ukuphakanyiswa okuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko futhi okuvunyelwe yiNdlu Yobukhosi. Ekupheleni konyaka odlule, ngihambele emhlanganweni wokuthuthukisa amasu okusebenza komnyango wami. Kumele ngithi le njongo ifaka phakathi ukuhlela kabusha isikhungo sobukhosi ukuze sisebenze ngaphandle kokungabaza. Kungalesi sizathu nakwezinye ukuthi ngikhuluma ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuphatha kahle, kuhlanganise nokuhlela kabusha kwezintela ezikhokhiswa ezindaweni zobukhosi. Ngakho-ke, Mhlaba Wombuso, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngiqinisekise neNdlu Yobukhosi ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kwabamakhosi nguhulumeni ophathayo esifundazweni kuyisiko elihle elilandelwa emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kugcinwa ngezinga elihlukahlukene nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukene okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe leli sithunzi; akufanele kusetshenziswe ukukala izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko ngokumelene nezikhundla ezahlukene zikahulumeni. Izikhundla zendabuko ngaphansi kwesakhiwo sobukhosi zingxenye yaleyo miphakathi ngaphansi kukabukhosi. Ngaphezu kokusiza imiphakathi ezindaweni zobukhosi nabaholi bendabuko ukuze bathole ukuhlonishwa ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezikhona, umnyango wami usebenza ngokwakha kabusha izikhungo zokuphatha zendabuko. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuguqula "izinkantolo zobukhosi" ezaziwa ngaphambili zibe izakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenza ngezisebenzi ezahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukusungula ubudlelwano nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza abaholi bethu bendabuko nezakhiwo zabo ukuba bathathe ithuba lezi thuba ezichazwe emthethweni kazwelonke mayelana nokuphathwa kwendabuko (njengokukhulunywa nguMthethosisekelo waseKwaZulu-Natal). Omunye walezi thuba ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni zokubambisana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ukuze zenze imisebenzi ethile lapho isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sinokwakhiwa ukuze kwenziwe njalo. Ngokwesibonelo, mhlawumbe isakhiwo sokuphatha sobukhosi singasiza umphakathi ngezincwadi zokufaka izicelo zomsebenzi, uqeqeshe abantu ngamakhono amanje e-computer. Abakhosi bangengxenye yoHulumeni obukhona bokuphatha. Ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuhambisa izakhiwo zabo nezakhiwo zikahulumeni ezibekiwe. Kumele ngiqhakambisa namuhla ukuthi le nhlanganisela ihloselwe kuphela izinjongo zokusebenza. Ihloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo nokuthuthukiswa. Ubudlelwano phakathi kukabukhosi noMeya abukhombisi ukufana ezikhundleni. Kungaba yiphutha ukukhipha umkhosi ezindabeni zomphakathi ngenxa yokuthi, emicabangweni yethu, kufanele akhulume nomlingani wakhe eKapa noma ePitoli. Singase sibe nomqondo onjalo ovela esikhathini esedlule. Nokho, sigcizelela namuhla ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu, obuhlukahlukene ezakhiweni zikahulumeni, bugxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kuhanjiswa ngokushesha ezizweni zobukhosi. Bonke abakhosi bayazi ukuthi siphuma phi ekuthumeleni izinsizakalo ezindaweni zabo, futhi sidinga ukuba baxhase nathi njengohulumeni ekuthumeleni lezi zidingo ngokushesha. UMbusi Hlongwane kanye nesizwe, njengendawo yaseKwaZulu-Natal, siyajabula ngentuthuko esiyenzayo ekubuyiseni isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko, ukuguqulwa kwaso, nokuhambisana nezinye izakhiwo zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lezikahulumeni. Ngithatha leli thuba ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ngezinto ezibalulekile ezihlobene nesiko mayelana nokufakwa ngokusemthethweni kukabukhosi. Kukhona umthetho oselindelekile esifundazweni onikeza ulwazi olunembile ngalesi sihloko. Nam
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlose ukufaka isicelo sokuba ngababusi kwelinye izwe elingavumeli ubudlelwano bezwe obuphindwe kabili kufanele bafake isicelo sokukhansela ubuzwe babo baseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ngeke usabe ngumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika kusukela emmomentini isicelo sakho samukelwa. Izingane ezincane nazo ngeke zibe ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle uma abazali bazo babe ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Qedela amafomu BI-246, BI-529, kanye ne-BI-9 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emisebenzini uma uphume ezweni. Thumela wonke amadokhumenti okukhomba aseNingizimu Afrika ehhovisi lezeMisebenzi, emibhalweni, noma emisebenzini. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezinomumo wephasi. Le nsizakalo ingathatha amasonto angu-8 kuya kwangu-12. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Amathayi asetshenziswa ezindaweni zokulima abiza kakhulu, kodwa kukhona imiyalezo ebalulekile ezokusiza ukuthi ulondoloze le mali oyichithile futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amathayi ahlala isikhathi eside. Uma ushintsha amathayi aphakanyisiwe kakhulu noma aphansi, awagcini isikhathi eside, umzimba wethayi uyacindezelwa kakhulu futhi uzogcina ushonile - okuthinta kakhulu imali! Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlela ingcindezi yamathayi ngokwezinto ezenziwayo, futhi uhlole ingcindezi njalo. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kanye noma kabili ngesonto, futhi khumbula ukushintsha ingcindezi yamathayi uma udonsa umthwalo onzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, hlola nesimo samathayi nokuthi kuphi okukhathazayo. Uma kubonakala inkinga, kungase kube uphawu lokuthi ithayi likhukhulile, noma ingcindezi ayifanele, noma izingxenye zokuhamba azihambelani kahle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isondo lisebenza ngengcindezi efanele kuzokusiza ukuthi ithayi libambe kahle emhlabathini, lizohlala isikhathi eside, futhi awuzokwenza umoya omningi, okwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi kuphi okungase kube yingozi noma okukhukhulayo. Khumbula ukuhlola ingcindezi uma ithayi lipholile, ngaphambi kokuthi liqhutshwe ngoba uma liqhutshelwa, liyashisa futhi ingcindezi iyanda. Ukulungisa amathayi - hamba kumuntu onolwazi! Umyalezo weGoodyear uthi amathayi kufanele afakwe noma alungiswe ngabantu abanolwazi ngoba lo msebenzi ungaba yingozi. Isibonelo: uma ithayi lingafakwa kahle esondweni, uma liphakanyisiwe kakhulu lingaphuka ngamandla amakhulu. Futhi ithayi lingase lishayeke esondweni uma lidonswa kanzima, kudala ingozi kumathayi, emhlabathini, nasemshinini. Ithayi nesondo kufanele kubekwe endaweni ephephile uma liphakanyiswa. Uma ulungisa i-valve stem, khumbula ukuthi ingase ikhukhule futhi kule ndawo. Uma ithayi liqhutshelwa ngaphandle komoya noma ngengcindezi ephansi, ungayiphakanyisa ngaphandle kokuyikhipha esondweni ukuze uhlole ukuthi ayilimazekile - kungcono ukuyihlola umuntu onolwazi. Okwesibili okufanele ukhumbule: njalo sebenzisa ikhava ye-valve; ungashayi isondo noma ithayi ngensimbi uma liphakanyisiwe ngokuphelele; ungafaki i-valve stem engalingani; ungafaki i-valve stem eguqukile noma elimele; landela imiyalelo yomkhiqizi futhi ungafaki ithayi elikhulu kakhulu noma elincane kakhulu; ngempela ungazami ukulungisa isondo elimele ngokuwelding noma ngenye indlela. Nokho, abantu beGoodyear bazama ukusebenzisa izinto ezizovimbela ukugqoka kwamathayi, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi irabha ithanda ukuabsorba uwoyela, i-grease, i-diesel, nezinye amakhemikhali, futhi ingalimala ukushisa nasezithunzini. Ngakho-ke, amathayi afanele kufanele agcinwe endaweni epholile, emnyama, hhayi eduze kwemishini yokuwelding, ama-generator, noma enye imishini ngoba lokhu kungadala ukulimala kwamathayi futhi azophuka uma esetshenziswa futhi. Ngokufanayo, geza zonke izinkinga kumathayi ngemuva kokuwaphonsa ngokuqhubekayo. Uma ubeka amathayi ezindaweni, yehlisa ingcindezi ibe ngu-10 psi bese uwabeka phezulu. Amathayi akhishwe ezindaweni angabekwa phansi noma abekwe phezulu kodwa hhayi amaningi kakhulu ngoba uma engcindezelwe azocindezelwa. Umshini onezindandatho kufanele uphakamiswe ukuze izindandatho zingathintani nomhlabathi. Uma umshini ubunzima kakhulu, khulisa ingcindezi yamathayi ngo-25% futhi uhambise umshini kancane kancane ukuze amathayi angathintani nomhlabathi endaweni eyodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ukusebenza kweGautrain Isingeniso Gautrain ingumkhumbi wesitimela ophambili owenziwe ukuze uxhume izindawo ezahlukene ezisemadolobheni, ikakhulukazi eGauteng. Ukusebenza kweGautrain kuyinqubo ethile ebhekele ukuletha ukuhamba okulula, okusheshayo, nokuphumelelayo kubakhweli. Kulesi sahlukwana, sizobheka indlela yokusebenzisa iGautrain, izinqubo zayo zokusebenza, nezinto okufanele uzazi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhamba kahle. Ukulungelelaniswa Okokuqala, ngaphambi kokuthi uqale uhambo lwakho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlole izindawo ezisemqoka. I-Gautrain ineziteshi eziningi, njengaseSandton, OR Tambo International Airport, futhi ikakhulukazi ePretoria. Ungathola ulwazi olunembile ngeGautrain kwiwebhusayithi yayo esemthethweni noma ngokuqhafaza kubasebenzi beziteshi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uqonde kahle ukuthi iyiphi indlela okufanele uyithathe. Ukuthenga ithikithi Lapho usulungele ukuhamba, kufanele uthenge ithikithi. I-Gautrain inezindlela ezahlukene zokuthenga ithikithi: ungakwenza lokho kwi-ATM ezizeshini, usebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Gautrain, noma ngokuthenga ithikithi ngokuqondile kumathikithi eziteshini. Qinisekisa ukuthi uwakhetha kahle amathikithi egcwele impela njengokuthola, isikhumbuzo, noma isikhumbuzo senkonzo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi uyakwenza kahle ukuhamba kwakho. Ukuhamba ngethuthuko Uma usuthenge ithikithi, ubheke izikhumbuzo zezimoto zethuthuko. Ngaphandle kokuhlola izikhathi zokuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi uya esitimeleni esifanele. I-Gautrain ineziqu zendawo ezinqunywe kahle ezizokusiza uthole isitimela sawo. Thatha isikhathi sokubona amalebula ahlukahlukene nezinqumo, ukuze uqonde kahle indlela yokungena nokuphuma. Ukwelulekwa nokuqondiswa Ngemuva kokungena esitimeleni, kubalulekile ukuba uhloniphe abanye abahamba nawe. Bheka ibhodi leziqu zendawo ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi uzohamba isikhathi esingakanani. Uma uhamba nezingane, qinisekisa ukuthi uhlanganyela nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezifana nezinkanyezi ezahlukahlukene nemigudu efanelekile. Ukufika eziteshini Lapho usufika eziteshini, qhubeka uhambela phambili ngokushesha. I-Gautrain iyashintsha ngokuhamba nemigudu ehlukene, ngakho qiniseka ukuthi ulandela izikhomba ezenzakalayo ukuze ungaphuthelwa ngesitimela, noma ukweqa umgwaqo. Futhi, uma udinga ukuzama izindawo ezihlukene, khona-ke, ungathola izinsiza ezikhethekile zalabo abahamba ngezinyawo. Ukwemukelwa kokuphumula nokuphumula Ngesikhathi sokuphumula, ungacela usizo kubasebenzi beziteshi uma udinga imihlahlandlela ethile. Bahlale bekulungele ukusiza, futhi bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze uqhubeke nokuqonda kahle zonke izinqubo zokuphuma. Thintana nabanye abahamba, mhlawumbe ungahlangana nabantu abahamba ngezinyawo, lokhu kungabelana ngolwazi oluwusizo. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kweGautrain, ungajabulela ukuhamba ngokushesha, nokuphepha. Uhlelo lwezitimela lwenza kube lula ukuxhuma phakathi kwezindawo eziningi, kukhululeka kakhulu ekuhambeni kwesikhathi. Ukuba ulwazi olufanele nokulandela izinqubo ezichaziwe kuzokwenza ukuthi uhambe kahle futhi ujabulele ukufika endaweni yakho ngendlela esheshayo nenempumelelo. Hamba kahle!
Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo: Ukubuyekezwa Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo kubalulekile emlandweni nasempilweni yomphakathi, njengoba kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha izwe. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila kumaphuzu abalulekile ahlobene nokwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ezenzekile, izinselelo ezibhekene nazo, kanye nemiphumela yazo emphakathini. Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umthethosisekelo ungumthetho ophakeme, okhombisa izimiso ezisemqoka zokuphatha izwe. Uhlelo lokwakha umthethosisekelo luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukucabanga, ukuhlela, nokubuyekeza. Lokhu kuhlangene nezifiso zomphakathi, izifundo ezitholakele emlandweni, kanye nezidingo zamanje. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izwe lethu lidlule ezinguqukweni ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokulwa nokucindezelwa. Lezi zinguquko zafaka isandla ekwakhiweni komthethosisekelo wethu, njengoba abantu baphakamisa izwi labo ukuze babonise izidingo zabo. Umthethosisekelo wokuqala, owawubhalwe ngemuva kokukhululeka, wawuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo ayisisekelo kubantu, kodwa wawungakabi namandla okuphatha izwe ngendlela efanele. Ngemva kokuhlangenwe nakho okunzima, umthethosisekelo wethu wahlangabezana nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola amalungelo akhe, kwadingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezithile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komthethosisekelo omusha, owawuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha, ukulwa nokungabi namthetho, kanye nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukubuyekezwa komthethosisekelo akupheli nje emakhanda ababhali, kodwa kudinga ukubhekwa ngokujulile kumphakathi. Izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthethosisekelo uyabhekwa futhi uyaphumelela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayavikelwa, futhi abantu baphila ngendlela efanele. Naphezu kwalezi zinguquko, umthethosisekelo wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuze uqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinguquko ezithile ezizobhekelela izidingo zamanje. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselela izigaba ezithile zomthethosisekelo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi ziyaqondiswa, futhi zikhuluma ngezidingo zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi umthethosisekelo awupheli nje emthethweni, kodwa uhlanganisa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba neqhaza ekwakheni umthethosisekelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izwi labo liyalalelwa. Ukuze lezi zinguquko zibe nomthelela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaholi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthethosisekelo wethu uzoba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ezothola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesikhathi sokucabanga, sibe nesineke, futhi sibe nokuzimisela ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo akusikho ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo kuphela, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuphetha, ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izwe lethu lihlala linobulungiswa, futhi abantu baphila ngendlela efanelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nesineke, sibe nokuzimisela, futhi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni umthethosisekelo onobulungiswa. Umthethosisekelo akusikho kuphela umthetho, kodwa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube khona ithemba lokwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Inhloso wukwakha uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawula imigudu ye-petroleum, ukuze kwakhiwe iBhodi yokulawula imigudu ye-petroleum ezobheka futhi iqaphe ukwenziwa kohla lwesizwe nezindaba ezihlobene. Isikhungo sokugcina sikhuluma ngaso kanye nanoma iyiphi indawo ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kokugcina i-petroleum. Le mthetho ifaka phakathi iziqondiso ezikhishwe kanye nezaziso ezikhishwe ngaphansi kwayo; futhi "ingabopha" kusho izinga elinqunywe yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, hhayi njengoba kudingwa yizibopho zenkontileka. Iphromotha ukufinyelela kumikhiqizo ye-petroleum engabizi. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lisungulwa njengomuntu ophakathi kwezomthetho. Lingakwenza noma yini ehambisana nokwenza imisebenzi yalo; futhi lisebenzise amandla noma lenze noma yimuphi umsebenzi oqondiswe ukuba wenziwe yiBhodi ngaphansi komthetho omunye. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lizokwakhiwa ngamalungu amahlanu akhethwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhethe ilungu elilodwa kulamalungu akhethwe ngaphansi komsubsection 1 ukuze kube ngumholi weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma ngenxa yanoma iyiphi imbangela umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, amalungu amanye azokhetha omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuba abambe indawo yomholi kuze kube umholi ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe, noma kuze kube omunye umuntu ekhethwe nguNgqongqoshe. Ilungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lizokwenza isikhathi seminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda akhethe umuntu owake wakhethwa. Uma ilungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum likhuphuka endaweni yalo, UNgqongqoshe angakhetha omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise le ndawo kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi akhethwe ngaso. Amalungu eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele akhokhelwe ngezinsizakalo zawo, futhi amaholo nezinsizakalo zabo azovunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Akekho umuntu ongakhethwa njengelungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma lowo muntu engakaze abe ngumuntu ophila eNingizimu Afrika futhi engahlali eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uvalelwe ngenxa yesikweletu futhi engakabuyiselwa, noma ubephunyukile ekubeni nelungelo lokubamba isikhundla ngenxa yokungathembeki, noma uma kungaba nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezithakazelo zalo muntu njengelungu lebhodi nezithakazelo zabo siqu, kuthinta umsebenzi wabo noma amabhizinisi abo. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza, ulwazi lwezebhizinisi, ulwazi lwezezimali, noma olunye ulwazi oluhambisana nokulawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Kumele temsilise izithakazelo zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wonke futhi kumele bangabi nenkohlakalo noma ukungathembeki. Ngaphambi kokukhetha amalungu eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, UNgqongqoshe uzokhipha izaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni, emema umphakathi ukuba wenze iziphakamiso zabantu. Wonke amalungu kumele, uma sebekhethwe kwiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, baziqinisekise kuNgqongqoshe nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingabathinta ngqo, umsebenzi wabo, izithakazelo zabo zebhizinisi, futhi kumele baziqinisekise kuNgqongqoshe nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. UNgqongqoshe angakhipha ukhetho lwamalungu eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma ilungu lelo liphatha ngendlela ephikisana nezimiso zesigaba sika-9. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ihlangane ngezikhathi nezindawo ezinqunywe ngumholi. Umholi kumele abize imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum njengoba kudingeka ukuze ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Umholi kumele, uma ecela nguMphathi Omkhulu noma ngamalungu amabili, abize umhlangano ophuthumayo ozobanjwa phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ngemuva kosuku lokucela. Umholi wanoma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele anqume izinqubo ezizolandela kulowo mhlangano, ngaphandle uma kukhona enye indlela ebekiwe yokulandela. I-quorum yomhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ingama-majority amalungu. Isinqumo esithathwe yizigidi zamalungu akhona emhlanganweni sizoba yisinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezivoti nganoma iyiphi indaba ethathwayo, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote ebonakalayo ngaphezu kokuvota kwakhe njengelungu. Akukho isinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum esizokwenziwa kube sephuliwe ngenxa yokukhala kweBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum noma ngenxa yokuthi umuntu okumele angakhethwa njengelungu ubekhona ngesikhathi isinqumo sithathwa, uma wonke amalungu amanye abekhona emhlanganweni futhi enelungelo lokubamba iqhaza njengamalungu e-quorum futhi isinqumo sithathwa yizigidi zamalungu akhona emhlanganweni futhi anelungelo lokuvota. UMphathi Omkhulu noma, uma engakabikho, ilungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum elinikezwe nguMphathi Omkhulu, uzophatha yonke imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, enelungelo lokukhuluma emhlanganweni kodwa engelungelo lokuvota kulowo mhlangano. Noma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uvulekile kumphakathi ngaphandle uma kukhona ulwazi oluyimfihlo noluyimfihlo oluhambisana nokuphathwa noma ukuhweba okumele kuxoxwe, futhi kulokhu, umuntu ophazamisekile kumele anikeze izizathu ezisemthethweni kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum zokuthi kungani lelo ulwazi lungakhishwa emphakathini. Uma iBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ithatha isinqumo nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokuba emhlanganweni ohlelwe, leso sinqumo sizoqala ukusebenza ngokushesha futhi kumele sibhale phansi, sigcwaliswe yizigidi zamalungu, futhi sikhonjiswe emhlanganweni wokuqala ohlelwe weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ngemuva kokwenziwa ukuze sifakwe kumarekhodi. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amarekhodi ayo okusebenza agcinwa. Amalungu kumele axolise futhi kumele bangabambi iqhaza ekuvoteni noma ekuxoxeni nganoma iyiphi indaba abayazi ukuthi izothinta ngqo noma ngqo; futhi kumele benze ngendlela elindelekile kumuntu osebenza emphakathini. Wonke amaqembu ezinqumo zeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum nezizathu zawo kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophazamisekile nganoma iyiphi indlela ngesinqumo esithathwe yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ilethe le ndaba phambi kweNkantolo Ephakeme ukuze ibuyekezwe leso sinqumo. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ikhethe uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. UMphathi Omkhulu uzobheka ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kweBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum; futhi uzophatha izindaba ezihlobene nabasebenzi abakhethwe ngaphansi komsubsection 3. UMphathi Omkhulu angakhetha abasebenzi noma angene esivumelwaneni esinokuhamba kwesikhathi nomuntu onjengokwenza ukuze
uSiphiwe Tshabalala: Umfanekiso Wokuphumelela Nokuzinikela USiphiwe Tshabalala ungomunye wabadlali abavelele emlandweni wombhoxo waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthole udumo olukhulu ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe okuhle, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, uSiphiwe ungumfanekiso wokuphumelela nokuzinikela. Ukuphila kwakhe, kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokudlala, kuveza izifundo eziningi ezibalulekile, hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wombhoxo, kodwa nasekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Uthole ukuqala kwakhe emkhakheni wombhoxo eKaizer Chiefs, lapho aqala khona khona khona. Lokhu akukaze kube lula, njengoba abanye abaqeqeshi bahlala bemphikisa. Nokho, uSiphiwe akazange ayeke. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuzinikela nokusebenza kanzima kuyizinto ezibalulekile empumelelweni. Lokhu kubonakala kahle emidlalweni yakhe, lapho ahlale ethokozisa izinkulungwane zabalandeli. Uthole izindondo eziningi, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, ube yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umuntu angakwenza kanjani uma ezimisele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSiphiwe waba yisithonjana emhlabeni wombhoxo. Uthole ithuba lokudlala kwiBafana Bafana, iqembu lesizwe, futhi waba nesandla esikhulu ekwenzeni kahle kweqembu. Uthole ithuba lokudlala emqhudelwaneni omkhulu, iFIFA World Cup, lapho abalandeli bakhe bahlabelela igama lakhe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile, hhayi kuphela kuye, kodwa nakubalandeli abaninzi ababejabulile ngokubona umphakathi wabo uphumelela. Ukwaziwa kukaSiphiwe akugcini nje emkhakheni wombhoxo. Ubuye abe nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Uthole ithuba lokuba yisibonelo esihle, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. Ubonisa ukuthi ngezinselelo, umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yokusiza abantwana, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uSiphiwe akakhathali nje ngempumelelo yakhe, kodwa futhi uyazama ukusiza abanye. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba uSiphiwe edlula ezinsukwini ezinzima, ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuphazamiseka kwezempilo, ukungabi nempumelelo emidlalweni, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi, konke lokhu kumphathe kabi. Nokho, uSiphiwe akazange ayeke. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona nje ukuwina, kodwa futhi ukuvuka uma uphumelele. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yimpilo yakhe. Ukwaziwa kukaSiphiwe Tshabalala akugcini nje emkhakheni wombhoxo, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi udinga abantu abanjengaye. Ubonisa ukuthi umuntu angaba nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wakhe, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. Uthole ithuba lokuba yisibonelo esihle, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa kuphela ngokuqhuba kahle emsebenzini, kodwa futhi ngokuba nomthelela omuhle kwabanye. Ngokuphetha, uSiphiwe Tshabalala ungumfanekiso wokuphumelela, ukuzinikela, kanye nomthelela omuhle. Ubonisa ukuthi, noma izinselelo zingaba zinkulu, umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu uma ezimisele. Uthole ithuba lokuba yisibonelo esihle, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa kuphela emkhakheni wombhoxo, kodwa futhi nasempilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Uthole ithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi, uma sikhuthazekile, singakwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu, hhayi kuphela ezimpilweni zethu, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. USiphiwe Tshabalala, ngempela, ungumfanekiso wempumelelo, futhi sizokhumbula igama lakhe emlandweni wombhoxo waseNingizimu Afrika. Ubonisa ukuthi, uma sikhuthazekile, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle kwabanye. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yimpilo yakhe, futhi sizokhumbula njalo.
Umthetho we-apartheid nokucindezelwa wadala isimo lapho zonke izilimi ngaphandle kwezimbili zingazange zicatshangelwe kuphela kodwa zaphinde zaphathwa kabi kakhulu. IsiNgisi nesiAfrikaans banikezwa isikhundla esisemthethweni futhi bathuthukiswa ngendlela ehlelekile, kodwa lokhu kwalimaza izilimi zomdabu zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ka-1996, unikeza ukusetshenziswa okufanayo kwezilimi ezisemthethweni zonke ezweni futhi uthuthukisa izilimi ezaziphathwe kabi ngaphambili. Ngaphezu kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11, umthethosisekelo uqaphela ezinye izilimi ezifana neNama, Khoi, kanye neSan, kanye nolimi lwezimpawu, okufanele futhi kuthuthukiswe. IGauteng iyidolobha elihlanganisa izizwe futhi iyisifunda lapho kuphela izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 zaseNingizimu Afrika (iSepedi, iSesotho, iSetswana, isiSwati, iVenda, iTsonga, isiAfrikaans, isiNgisi, isiNdebele, isiXhosa, nesiZulu) ezingakhuluma, kodwa iyikhaya lezilimi eziningi. Odiplomate, abokufika, ababaleki, nabantu bezamabhizinisi abavela emhlabeni jikelele abahlala eGauteng benze le ndawo ibe yikhaya lezilimi eziningi zangaphandle. I-Gauteng Language Policy Framework (GLPF), ehloswe ukuhlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela ebanzi yokusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenzisa izilimi eziningi, yasungulwa ngezizathu ezihlobene ngqo nezidingo zomthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-National Language Policy Framework (eyamukelwa futhi yethulwa ngoMashi 2003) ethinta amalungelo omthethosisekelo ahlobene nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kolimi. I-National Language Policy Framework ifuna ukuthi zonke izifunda zisungule imithetho yazo ezimele ezidinga ukuhambisana nayo. I-GLPF iyimiphumela yokuxoxisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifunda, kanye nezinga lesizwe. Lezi zithakazelo zifaka iNational Language Institute yeMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, iGauteng Provincial Government (GPG), iminyango enegxile enkulu kwiGauteng Department of Education, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izindawo zokuhlala, iGauteng Legislature, kanye nochwepheshe bezilimi abaningi. Le nqubo yokuxoxisana yaphathwa nguMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuzijabulisa, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, osizayo nochwepheshe bezilimi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Imiphumela yokuqala yocwaningo lwezenhlalo nolimi olwenziwe yiPanSALB ngo-2001 yahlaziywa. Lolu cwaningo lwasebenzisa indlela yokuhlanganisa egxile kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 naphezulu, abathathwe ezigabeni ezahlukene zokuphila, emiphakathini yasemakhaya nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Izindawo ezigxilwayo zazizilimi zasekhaya nezilimi ezisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezizimele, ezokuxhumana, ezemiphakathi, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, emfundweni, izilimi ezindaweni zokusebenza, kanye nombono wemithetho yolimi, ukusetshenziswa kolimi komuntu siqu, kanye nenani lezilimi ezikhuluma ngabantu. Umthethosisekelo uphinde uqaphele imfundo njengendawo ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi. I-GLPF iphinde ibheke izidingo zeSouth African Schools Act ka-1996 ngokuhlola ukuthi izilimi zisetshenziswa kanjani ezikoleni nokuthi ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luhambisana kanjani nezimo zemfundo zamanje. Ihloswe ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle kwezilimi okuthinta ukufakwa, ikhuluma ngezidingo zomphakathi; futhi igcizelela futhi ikhuthaza isizwe esikhulayo, ikhulisa ukuz pride nesibopho phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zolimi namasiko eGauteng. Ic Section 29 ithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ngolimi olusemthethweni alukhethayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi, lapho le mfundo itholakala. I-PanSALB Act ka-1995 iphinde ihlinzeke ngokwamukelwa, ukukhuthazwa, nokusabalalisa isiko eliningi lwezilimi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphathwe kabi ngaphambili. Iphinde iphakamise ukusungulwa kwamakomidi ezilimi ezingeni lesifunda. I-Gauteng Provincial Government, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuzijabulisa, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, isungule iGauteng Provincial Language Committee. Nakuba iSouth African Schools Act (SASA) isaqhuba ukuhlolwa, okwamanje ihlinzeka ngemininingwane yeNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, ngemuva kokuxoxisana neBhodi Yezangqongqoshe, ukuze ichaze amazinga nezindinganiso zomthetho wolimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Iphinde icacise ukuthi ibhodi yokuphatha yesikole somphakathi ingathola umthetho wayo wolimi ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, lo Mthetho (SASA), kanye neminye imithetho efanele yesifunda. Izinhloso zeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi kufanele ziqhube ukuhambisana nomthethosisekelo okuvumela ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe yiState, imizamo ezimele, noma abantu, ngokuhambisana nezimo ezithile ezamukelekayo. Lokhu ukufinyelela akukhona nje kuphela ukuthola ulwazi olufanele kodwa kufanele kube ngolimi olukhethwe ummangali, lapho kungenzeka. Njengoba uhlu lwe-4 lomthethosisekelo lukhuluma ukuthi ulimi luwumkhakha wokubambisana phakathi kukamasipala kazwelonke kanye nezifunda, i-NLPF ibeka ukuthi zonke izikhungo zikamasipala (kazwelonke, zesifunda, nezendawo) kanye nezikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma imisebenzi zibophelelekile ngokuhambisana nomkhankaso. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izilimi eziningi, kulindeleke ukuthi izifunda zisebenzise imithetho yazo yokusebenzisa izilimi ezisekelwe kwi-NLPF, lapho zizobhekana nezimo zendawo, izidingo, nezintandokazi zomphakathi. Ngemuva kwalokho, ohulumeni bendawo bazothuthukisa imithetho yabo yokusebenzisa izilimi ngokuhambisana neProvincial Policy Framework. Uma kudingeka, ohulumeni bendawo bayakhuthazwa ukuthi basekele umkhakha ozimele ekusunguleni nasekukhuliseni umthetho wabo ngendlela ehambisana nalolu mthetho. Ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luwumthetho wolimi kazwelonke osebenza ngaphakathi komkhakha wemfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko igcizelela ukuxhumana okungaphazamiseki phakathi kwemikhawulo yamasiko, ezilimini, kanye nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudala indawo ehlonipha izilimi ezikhuluma abanye. Indlela yokuxhumana ngomlomo izohlonishwa futhi ikhuthazwe kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Uhlelo lweMthetho Wokusebenzisa Izilimi kuMfundo luthi bonke abafundi kufanele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi lomdabu olulodwa, zonke izigaba zolimi zizothola isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla zesifunda kufanele ziqonde imithetho mayelana nezidingo zokuthuthukisa amazinga ezilimi afanele kanye nezifundo, ngokuhambisana nohlelo olujwayelekile lwezizwe. Umkhakha weMithetho Womkhankaso uhlanganisa iminyango ye-GPG, iGauteng Legislature, izindawo zokuhlala (ezibhekele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendawo nezintandokazi), nezikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifunda ezisebenzisa amandla okuqhuba nokuphatha imisebenzi yomphakathi.
