Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka kwazo ezindaweni ezahlukene ezisebenzisa amanzi. Uhlelo olubanzi lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha (NCMP), oluphathwa nguMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla waseNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezithile ezijwayelekile eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlaziywa ezlabhoratri zomnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo kokubili eziphilayo nezingenamoya emvelweni. Ulwazi oluqoqiwe oluvela kuhlelo lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha lusetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda ngesimo se-ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha emanzini esiwasebenzisayo ezweni lonke kubaphathi bezinsiza zamani, ososayensi, abathathi bezinqumo, kanye nomphakathi ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda. I-ikhwalithi yamanzi ihlolwa ukuze ibone ukufaneleka kwayo kokusetshenziswa kwasekhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo, kanti izici eziphezulu ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi ezihlanganiswe kulolu cwaningo zazikhawulelwe kulabo abathathwa njengokufaneleka kulezi zindawo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Izinkinga ezinkulu ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi kubasebenzisi bamanzi asekhaya zifaka izinga eliphezulu le-Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) futhi, kwezinye izindawo, izinga eliphezulu le-fluoride. Ububanzi bokumuncwa kwe-sodium, ukwakheka kukagesi, pH, nezinga le-chloride zingaba izinkinga ezingenzeka ezolimo ezinelanga. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinamanzi ambalwa ngoba likhona ezindaweni ezihlala zinezimo ezinzima nezomhlaba, ezinezimo zezulu ezihlukene ukusuka emathafeni kuya kumathafa aphakathi nendawo engxenyeni esentshonalanga yezwe kuya ezindaweni eziseduze nolwandle olusempumalanga. Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo ezweni kungu-500 mm (Joubert, 2003), okuphansi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga lokwehla kwemvula emhlabeni elingama-860 mm (DWF, 2002). Nakuba amanzi angaphansi komhlaba ebalulekile ekuhlinzekeni ngezindawo zasemaphandleni ezingxenyeni zalesi sizwe, ngenxa yokwakheka kwejiyoloji okuphezulu kweNingizimu Afrika, kunezintaba ezinkulu ezingasetshenziswa ukuhambisa inani elikhulu lamanzi ezindaweni ezinkulu (DWAF, 2002). Ukwehla kwemvula namanzi aphansi kuhanjiswa ngendlela engalingani futhi ngezikhathi ezithile, nezikhathi zokwehla kwemvula ezinzima zenzeka ezindaweni ezinkulu zalesi sizwe. Ngakho-ke, ukuhamba kwamanzi okunokugeleza okukhulu kuvame ukwenzeka, okungaholela ekwandeni kwamanzi ezindaweni eziphansi, ukuthuthukiswa kwedolobha, kanye nemisebenzi yezimboni eyenzeka ezindaweni ezikude nemifula emikhulu - ngenxa yezinsimbi kulezi zindawo nezinye izizathu - kuholela ekudingeni ukuhamba kwamanzi okukhulu kakhulu isikhathi esiningi (DWAF, 2002). Imifula emine emikhulu eNingizimu Afrika ihlukaniswe namanye amazwe, okwenza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi kube umsebenzi obucayi futhi obalulekile. Ukuze kuphathwe izinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, izwe lihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye eziyi-19 zokuphathwa kwamanzi (WMA) (DWAF, 2002). Inhloso yalokhu, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuvumela abasebenzisi bamanzi nezinye izithakazelo ukuba babambe iqhaza kahle ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Ezinye zalezi zikhungo kuzodingeka ukuthi zisungulwe kanti ezinye (kuhlanganisa noMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla) kuzodingeka ziguqulwe ukuze zikhombise imisebenzi emisha noma ethuthukisiwe njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho Wamanzi (Umthetho 36 ka-1998) (DWAF, 2002). Ngenxa yezidingo ezibekwe ezinsizeni zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, imithombo yemvelo yamanzi ithintekile kakhulu kulezi zinhlelo zokulawula ezinjengemifula nezindonga zokugcina amanzi ezakhiwe emifuleni, kanye nemisebenzi yabantu efana nokukhipha amanzi, amanzi abuyela emifuleni, kanye nemiphumela yokusebenzisa umhlaba (DWAF, 2002). Njalo, lokhu kuholele ekwehliseni ikhwalithi yamanzi aphezulu futhi kube nemiphumela emibi ezinhlelweni zokuphila kwezitshalo nezilwane zasemanzini. I-ikhwalithi yamanzi ingase ibe mibi kwezinye izindawo ngenxa zezizathu zemvelo. Izinto ezingaphili ezakha lapho izendlalelo zezitshalo zidalwa, izinto ezisele zokusebenzisa umhlaba, kanye nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezihamba emvelweni, njengezitshalo nezinsalela zezilwane. Izilwane ezincane eziphilayo ezifana namagciwane, ama-virus, nezilwane ezidla igazi, ezivela emhlabathini nasemvelweni, zingase zifake futhi izinsalela zezilwane nabantu. Izinto ezikhulula ukukhanya okuqinile ngokuvamile zenzeka kuphela ngezinga elincane ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo. Ukutholakala kwezamanzi ngendlela efanele, lokho, ibhalansi ekufinyeleleni ezinsizeni zamanzi, ekusetshenzisweni kwezidingo zamanzi nezinzuzo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuqhubekayo, ngokwenza izinguquko ezincane ekusetshenzisweni kwamanzi ukuze kufinyelelwe ebhalansini phakathi kokutholakala kwamanzi nezidingo zomthetho zamanzi, nokuthi kuqale ukwenziwa izindlela zokulondoloza amanzi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle ukuze kufinyelelwe ezinzuzweni ezinkulu zomphakathi nezomnotho. Ukuze lezi zinhloso zifezeke, umthetho weMthetho Wamanzi (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998) wasungulwa. Lona ngumsebenzi obalulekile wezomthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uthi "amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo eyabelwe abantu bonke." Umehluko omkhulu owethulwe yilomthetho uma kuqhathaniswa nemithetho yamanzi yangaphambilini ukuthi ilungelo lokufinyelela emanzini alisancikile ekubeni nomhlaba, ukuthi abantu bonke banelungelo elifanayo lokufinyelela emanzini afanele izidingo eziyisisekelo zomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okokuqala, imvelo iyavuma ukuthi inelungelo lomthetho lokufinyelela emanzini. Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ze-NWA nezinye izidingo zokuhlola ikhwalithi yamanzi. Uhlelo olubanzi lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi, oluphathwa nguMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla eNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezimfushane ezijwayelekile eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlaziywa ezlabhoratri zomnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo nezinto ezingaphili neziphilayo. Inhloso yocwaningo olwakhiwe kule ndatshana kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngolwazi ngezinto ezinkulu ezingaphili ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha emanzini asetshenziswe eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngencazelo emfushane ngesimo se-ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha esetshenziswa ngokuya ngezidingo ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi zabasebenzisi bamanzi abakhulu, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi asekhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo. Ulwazi luphinde lwethulwe ezingeni elihlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe lapho kukhona idatha eqoqiwe eyanele ezindaweni ezihambelanayo. Lolu lwazi luhambelana kakhulu nalabo abahlanganyela ngekhwalithi yamanzi
Imfashini Nobuhle: Indaba Yezitayela Zethu Kwazulu, ngosuku olukhanyayo, lapho umoya ubushelelezi futhi izinyoni zibhakabhaka, abantu emzaneni babezilungiselela umkhosi omkhulu wezobuciko. Imfashini nobuhle kwakuyizihloko ezibalulekile. UZandile, intokazi enobuhle obungapheli, wayengaphakathi kokulungiselela. Wayenothando olukhulu ngemfashini; wayefuna ukufakazela ukuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokuziveza, yokukhuluma ngempilo yakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZandile wahlangana nezingubo ezahlukene egumbini lakhe. Kukhona izingubo ezimnyama ezimfushane, ezilula, nezinemibala egqamile. Wakhumbula nama-accessories anhlobonhlobo, ama-anklets, ama-necklaces, nezicathulo ezinhle. Wayazi ukuthi umkhosi udinga okuthile okukhazimulayo, okuzokwenza abanye baphenduke bamehlo kuye. Ngemuva kokukhetha, uZandile waya kumama wakhe, uMama Nandi, owayesebenza emakhaya. UMama Nandi wayenokuthula, kodwa uZandile wayefuna ukwazi ukuthi umqondo wakhe ngemfashini uyamjabulisa yini. “Mama, ucinga ukuthi lezi zingubo ezikhethiwe zingangiholela empumelelweni emkhosini?” kubuza uZandile, ethokozile. UMama Nandi waphendula ngothando, “Ngiyabonga, mntwanami. Uthando lwakho lwezinto ezinhle lwenza ube yinto eyingqayizivele. Khumbula, ubuhle bukhona ngaphakathi. Imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuziveza, kodwa ubuhle bangempela buvela enhliziyweni.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uZandile waqonda ukuthi imfashini ayikhulumi nje ngokuqhakambisa ubuhle, kodwa ibalulekile ekuboneni ubunikazi bethu. Umkhosi wawuzoba yithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokwazisa, yokwenza umyalezo, nokukhombisa uthando lwethu ngezinhlobonhlobo. Njengoba umkhosi usondela, uZandile wathola isikhathi sokuhlanza. Waqala ngokuhlanzeka kobuso, efaka i-moisturizer, bese esebenzisa i-makeup encane, eyayikhanyisa ubuso bakhe. Wayefuna ukubukeka emuhle, kodwa engafuni ukulahlekelwa umoya wakhe wemvelo. Ngesikhathi umkhosi uqala, umoya wawugcwele injabulo. Abantu bejabulile, behlangana, behlabelela. UZandile waphuma phambili, efaka izingubo zakhe ezinhle, ezimhlophe nezimnyama. Wabhalela wonke umuntu umyalezo wokuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokukhombisa ubunikazi bethu. Lapho efika emkhakheni, uZandile wabona abanye besebenzisa izitayela ezahlukene, abanye bejabulisa ngemibala ehlukahlukene. Wathola ukuthi imfashini ibonisa ubuhlakani bethu, izinkolelo zethu, nezifiso zethu. Ubuhle babuhlukahlukene, futhi wonke umuntu wayebonisa ubuchwepheshe bakhe ngendlela eyingqayizivele. Ngemuva kokuphela komkhosi, uZandile waphuma, ejabule. Wazizwa ejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayehlanganyela umoya wombukiso, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nomoya wokwakha ubuhlobo. Waqonda ukuthi imfashini ayiyona nje indlela yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, yokuhlanganyela, nokukhombisa uthando. UZandile wathi: “Imfashini nobuhle akukhona kuphela okubonwa ngaphandle, kodwa kuyinto esiyithola ngaphakathi. Ngiyabonga, Mama, ngokungifundisa lokho.” UMama Nandi wamomotheka, eqonda ukuthi indodakazi yakhe isiqedile ukufunda okubalulekile empilweni. UZandile waqhubeka nokwakha isitayela sakhe, enza imfashini ibe yindlela yokuziveza, yokukhombisa ubuhle bempilo yakhe. Waqhubeka nokuhlanganyela nezinye, efundisa ngokubaluleka kokuba nekhono lokuba ubani, nokuthi ubuhle bethu buvela ngaphakathi. UZandile waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi imfashini nobuhle akukhona nje okukhanyayo, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhombisa uthando, ubuhlakani, nokuba yinto eyingqayizivele. Imfashini, empeleni, iyindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwakha umhlaba ongcono.
iFIFA World Cup: Umcimbi Ohlanganyela Umhlaba Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup iye yaba umcimbi obaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Le midlalwano, eyenzeka njalo eminyakeni emithathu, ibonisa ubuhle bebhola, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomoya wokuhlanganyela. Njengomuntu othanda ibhola, ngithanda ukuhamba phambili ngale midlalwano, ngibona ukuthi iyinhlangano yokuhlanganyela abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, izinkolo, nezamasiko ahlukene. Ngonyaka we-2022, iFIFA World Cup yabanjwa eQatar, okwakuyinto ethokozisayo kakhulu. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokubona izwe elisha, elinokuthile okuthakazelisayo. I-Qatar, ngaphezu kokuba yizwe elincane, ibonise ukuthi ingakwazi ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu kangaka. Izindawo zokudlala ezinhle, izinsiza ezithuthukile, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezinhle zenza kube lula kubabukeli nabadlali. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umhlaba ungenza izinto ezinkulu uma ubambisene. Ngokubuka iWorld Cup, ngiyavuma ukuthi ibhola liyinsiza yokuxhumanisa abantu. Abantu bahlala behlangene, bejabule, bephakamisa izandla zabo, bejabulisa izwe labo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlanganyela, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngiyakhumbula umcimbi wango-2010 eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izwe lethu labonisa khona amandla okuba umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esikhethekile, lapho abantu bejabulisa, behlanganyela, futhi bebonisa uthando lwabo lwezizwe zabo. Nokho, iFIFA World Cup akukhona nje kuphela umcimbi wokudlala ibhola. Iphinde ibonise izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nomhlaba. Izinkinga ezifana nokungalingani kwezomnotho, izinkinga zokuphepha, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala kwabantu zikhona. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu lapho izizwe ezithile zikhombisa ukungabi nankinga, kanti ezinye zikhombisa ubunzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iFIFA World Cup ibonisa ukuthi ibhola lingaba yinsiza yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Uma abantu behlangana, bejabula, futhi bejabulisa izwe labo, bakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup izoqhubeka nokuba umcimbi obalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo ezinhle, ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi ibhola akukhona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyinsiza yokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo ezinhle, ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngokuphetha, iFIFA World Cup iyinsiza yokuhlanganyela umhlaba. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo ezinhle, ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi ibhola akukhona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyinsiza yokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo ezinhle, ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu. Ngiyabonga.
Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall UMkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uqale ngo-2015, uwumzamo wokuphikisa izinhlelo zokufunda ezibiza kakhulu ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika. Lo mkhankaso, owawuhlanganisa abafundi abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, wakha izwi elihlangene elalizwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngempilo yezemfundo, ikakhulukazi ngokugxila ezindlekweni zokufunda. Umgomo wombhikisho kwaba ukususa izikhwama ezibizayo zokufunda, okwakukholwa ukuthi zivikela ukufinyelela kwabafundi abavela emindenini enezimo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall waphumelela ekwakheni ingxoxo enkulu mayelana nemfundo, ukungalingani, kanye nezinkinga ezibalulekile ezifana nokutholakala kwemali yokufunda. Abafundi, ngezwi labo elikhulu, baphakamisa izinkinga ezinzima ezithinta izimpilo zabo, okwenza umphakathi uqonde kakhulu izinselelo ezibhekene nabafundi baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwakhiwa komkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall kubonakale ukuthi akuwona nje umphumela wesikhashana, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esiholela ekubuyekezweni kwezinhlelo zemfundo. Izinyathelo ezithathwe ngemuva komkhankaso, kufaka phakathi ukwanda kokuxhaswa kwezimali kubafundi, ukufakwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha imfundo engenamkhawulo, nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngezibonelelo kubafundi abahola kancane, zikhombisa umthelela omkhulu kulesi sikhala. Umphakathi uqhubekile nokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezibangelwa ukungabi bikho kwemali, okukhuthaze uhulumeni ukuba abe neqhaza elikhulu ekuphatheni nasekuxhaseni abafundi. Lokhu kuphakamisa isimo sokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Izifundo ezitholakele ezivela emkhankasweni zikhombisa ukuthi ukunikeza abafundi ithuba lokukhuluma nokubamba iqhaza emhlabeni wezokuphatha kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumphumela omuhle. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uphinde waba nomthelela ekwakheni izinkundla zokuxhumana ezivumela abafundi ukuba babelane ngemicabango, izinkinga, nezixazululo. Lokhu kube nomthelela omuhle ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, okwakha umphakathi onokuzwana. Abafundi baqala ukuzizwa bephakathi kwesikole, besebenzisana ukuze bathole izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uvule amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yabafundi, ubonisa izinkinga ezifana nokucindezelwa, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni, nokungabi neqhaza elanele ezinqubweni ezithinta imfundo. Lokhu kudale ukuthi umphakathi uqonde kangcono izinselelo ezikubangela ukungafundi kahle, okwakha isikhala sokuthi abantu baqhamuke nezixazululo ezenzakalayo nezinselelo ezithinta abafundi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphumela yalezi zinguquko ibonakalile. Ukuphakama kwezimali ezitholakalayo kubafundi, ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukahlukene zokuxhasa abafundi, kanye nokwandiswa kwezinhlelo zokufunda, kuveza izinguquko ezinhle ezenzakalayo. Lokhu sekufake pfungwa ethile emiphakathini ethile, okuvusa umqondo wobumbano nokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu kwi-political landscape yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ubuye wagqugquzela izishoshovu eziningi ukuba zibe nemibono ehlukahlukene, zikhulume ngezinkinga ezithinta abafundi, nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ungumfanekiso ogqamile wokuthi umphakathi ungashintsha kanjani izinqumo zepolitiki nezemfundo ngokubambisana. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphikisa, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall usengxoxweni enkulu futhi ubonisa amandla abantu abasha, okwenza kube lula ukubona umthelela ohlala isikhathi eside. Abafundi baqhubeka nokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuqwashisa abantu ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezingokwemvelo ezithinta ukufunda, ukungabi neqhaza, nezinto ezenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zemfundo. Ngaleyo ndlela, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall awuzange ube yisikhathi esidlule, kodwa ube yinsika yokwakha ingxoxo eqhubekayo mayelana nemfundo, ukulingana, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abafundi. Umthelela womkhankaso usaqhubeka nokuzwakala, ukwakha umphakathi onobumbano nolwazi, futhi uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kubafundi baseNingizimu Afrika. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi uma abantu behlangana, benza imizamo yokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, bangakha izinguquko ezinkulu. Imiphumela yalo mkhankaso ibonisa ukuthi ukufunda akuwona umgomo kuphela, kodwa kuyinselelo yokwakha umphakathi obumbene, onobumbano, nolwazi, okukhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphokophele empumelelweni. Ngakho-ke, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uyinsika ebalulekile kulandela umgwaqo oya phambili emfundweni nasezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi.
iMercedes-Benz Ngaphambi kokuba umhlaba uthuthuke, izimoto zaziyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Kwakukhona umphakathi omncinci eNingizimu Afrika, lapho uSipho, ophakathi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili, wandisa khona izifiso zakhe. Wayezithokozisa ngempela ngezithombe zezimoto ezazibhalwe ezincwadini, ikakhulukazi iMercedes-Benz, eyayithuthukiswa ngubuchwepheshe obukhulu nokwakhiwa okujabulisayo. Usuku olulodwa, uSipho wagcina engaphezu kwentshisekelo eqinile, kwathi ngakusasa wezwa izwi elisha emphefumulweni wakhe: “Ngithanda ukuba neMercedes-Benz.” Lokhu kwawukuthanda okwakungenasici. Wayefisa ukuhamba ngevakashi lezi zimoto ezincanyana, eziphithizelayo, ezijabulisayo. KwanguMgqibelo, umama uBusi, uSipho wamtshela ngayo lezi zimoto. "Mama, ngiyafuna! Ngifuna iMercedes-Benz!" Wafundisa ngezithombe nawomoya wobuchwepheshe obuhlobene nalezi zimoto. UMama uBusi, owayezama ukufundisa uSipho ukuthi impilo ayilula, wamjabulisa, futhi wathi, "Umndeni wethu awukwazi ukukhokhela lokho, mntanami." Kodwa lezi zisho zaqinisekisa uSipho ukuba azimisele. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ithuba lokusebenza endaweni yokuhlola izimoto. Le ndawo yayimi eduze kwendawo yokuthengisa izimoto eziphambili, neMercedes-Benz iyona eyakhanga kakhulu. Abanikazi bendawo, bebona ukugqugquzela kukaSipho, bamnika ithuba lokuba abe ngummeli wezimbangi. Njengoba umphakathi ungena ezindleleni zabo zokwenza kahle, uSipho waqala ukuthola ulwazi olukhulu ngalezi zimoto. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wahlangabezana nezinkanyezi ezinhle zomnotho. Uhlobo lwezimoto eziphakelayo lwaqala ukwehla, kanti uSipho wadla amahhashi esikhathini. Ubuqotho bakhe obuqotho buke bukhuphuka, izinsuku zanda, futhi izindleko zokuphila zashintsha. Wayezama uqobo ukwakha imali, nakuba ezinzima, ukuze athole lezi zimoto ezaziphuphuma emaphusheni akhe. Kodwa, kwahluka kahle uma udadewabo, uThandi, esivakasha. "Sipho, yini eyenza ubheke iMercedes-Benz? Kukhona nezinye izimoto," kusho uThandi echaza umbono wakhe. Nokho uSipho wayekwazi kahle ukuthi uMercedes-Benz wayengumkhiqizo ophakeme, ophakeme kakhulu. "Kukhona okuthile, Thandi. Ngiyazi ukuthi kuhle, futhi ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngiyithole." Kwathi ngezinsuku ezedlule, umphakathi wezemisebenzi wafa, uthuthuke, ngezindlela ezithokozisayo. Uthando lwezimoto lwenza imisebenzi yempilo ibelula. USipho ngokushesha wathola izindlela eziningi zokuxhumana nezokuthola izitho. Ngemva kokwaziswa abuya kuMercedes-Benz, umphakathi wathe uma usuku lufika, uSipho uzothola ibhaji. Nokho uSipho waba nobunzima, ukusebenza kwakhe kwavutha. Ngaphambi kokuba umphakathi uqedele uhlelo lokuhlola izimoto, uSipho wavuma ukusebenzisa amafrikhwasi, ngakusasa wayehlanganisa inqwaba encane yeMercedes-Benz. Njengoba efaka wonke umuzwa wakhe, wayesekhombe umphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe waphumelelisa. Emva kwesikhathi, uSipho wakwazi ukuthola uMercedes-Benz. Uthokoze, umoya wakhe, niphephile, wakhumbula konke adlule kukho. Ngesikhathi ethola usuku lokuqala lokuhamba, ubuhlakani bukhanya, uMercedes-Benz, ugibisele ukuthandwa kwakhe. Ngosuku lokuqala, wahamba emgwaqweni, umsebenzi wakhe ubuyisela umphefumulo wezemfashini kanye nezifiso. Umazisi naye wabhanqa ngemfashini ethokozisayo, izimoto eziphithizelayo zashaya iziqhingi. Ubufakazi bobuhlakani bakhe bukhanya, futhi uSipho waqhubeka nokukhula empilweni yakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwezimoto luhlala lukhanya, kwaze kwavela imiphumela emisha eqinile. Kwakungekho kufaneleke, kodwa uthando lwezinto eziphilayo lwezithombe zezimoto luhlala luhamba phambili. NgeMpumelelo yakhe, uSipho wakwazi ukwakha umndeni wakhe ngenxa yeMercedes-Benz, okukhumbuza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungavula amathuba. Kwakungumsebenzi, uthando, nokucindezeleka okwakuletha uSipho kulezi zimoto, emva kwezinsuku eziningi zokusebenza. Ngaphezu всего, uSipho wanqoba konke engakaze akusebenzisa. Ngakho, njengoba edlula eNingizimu Afrika, umoya wakhe waphehla, futhi iMercedes-Benz yaba isithombe sokuphila kwakhe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhande elidala nemihla ngemihla, uSipho washumayela ngezindaba zakhe. Izimota zazidume kakhulu, zakhuthaza abanye, zakhombisa indlela yokuphumelela. Lokhu kwakuveza ukuthi amathuba akhona, futhi amathuba awavuli kuphela izinyawo — kodwa futhi vatidzo oyikholwayo. Uthando lwalukhona, futhi iMercedes-Benz yenza ukuba umphakathi uzwakale, uSipho waba umholi. Uthando, ukuzikhandla, nokuhlakanipha kwakhe kwaba umoya ohloniphekile, umsebenzi wakhe ubukeka kuyinhle kakhulu. UMercedes-Benz, ivela kwiPhutha, yaphetha indaba yakhe njengomuntu onothando, ongaziqhamuka. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuchwepheshe baderaduze uSipho, wavuma ukuthi indlela yokuphila ipakisha impilo. Ngoba iMercedes-Benz iba yindoda yakhe, uSipho wabhalela izinkanyezi eziningi ezikhanya ebusuku, zize ziphakamise umhlaba wakhe. Indaba yakhe yayiyindabuko ezakhamuzini zomphakathi.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzaneni omncane ogama lawo linguMkhumbane, kwavela isimo esiphuthumayo. UThandi, umphakathi wezokwelapha, wayephakathi kokulungiselela umcimbi omkhulu wokwazisa abantu ngezingozi eziphuthumayo. UThandi wayenolwazi olunzulu ngezokwelapha, kodwa wayephinde abe nomuzwa wokuthi isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo singenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wacabanga ngalesi simo esiphuthumayo esingase sibe khona. Wazi kahle ukuthi uma kwenzeka ingozi, abantu badinga ukusiza ngokushesha. Ngakho, wathola umqondo wokuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano nabanye abahlali, abahlinzeki bezokwelapha, kanye nabamele iziphathimandla zomphakathi. Umhlangano wenzeka emzini, lapho abantu abaningi behlangana. UThandi wakhuluma ngokuqinile, echaza ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula singathuthukiswa kanjani. "Uma sinesistimu yokuxhumana esheshayo, sizokwazi ukusiza abantu ngokushesha," kusho yena. "Kumele sibe nezinombolo ezithile zokuxhumana, futhi sithumele izixhumanisi ezisheshayo kumaphoyisa, ezokwelapha, nakubantu abavela emiphakathini." Abantu babemamatheka, bejabule ngalesi sicefe. UThandi waphinde wakhuluma ngokuqonda, echaza ukuthi abantu kumele bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani uma kwenzeka ingozi. "Kumele sibe nezifundo ezithile zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza abanye," wathi. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, futhi bahlangana ukuze bahlele izifundo ezizayo. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uThandi waqala ukuhlela izifundo ezizoba khona. Waqasha ochwepheshe bezokwelapha, abaphathi bezokuphepha, kanye nabanye abanolwazi. Izifundo zafundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, ezifana nokuthi bangasiza kanjani uma kwenzeka ukulimala, noma uma kwenzeka umlilo. Abantu babefunda ngezindlela zokuxhumana, nokuthi bangabika kanjani izimo eziphuthumayo. Njengoba izifundo ziqhubeka, abantu baqala ukujwayela ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. UThandi wabona ukuthi abantu bayeza, bejabulile, futhi bezimisele ukufunda. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, futhi abantu babefuna ukusiza omunye nomunye. Lokhu kwavusa umoya wokuzimisela, futhi uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi lokhu kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu emzaneni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa zokufunda, kwenzeka ingozi enkulu emzaneni. Kwakukhona umjaho wezithuthuthu, futhi abanye abantu baphazamisekile. UThandi, kanye nabanye abahlali, baphendula ngokushesha. Bafika endaweni yengozi, bahlola izimo zabantu abalimala. UThandi wakhumbula konke abakufundile, futhi waqala ukusiza abantu. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abalimala bathola usizo lwezokwelapha ngokushesha. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wabona ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula sithuthukile. Abantu babekwazi ukusiza ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kwenza umehluko omkhulu. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu bayeza, bejabulile, futhi bezimisele ukusiza. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangathuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngemuva kwalesi simo, uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi lokhu kumele kuqhubeke. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokugcina abantu befundiswa ngezokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abanye abahlali bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okusheshayo uma kwenzeka ingozi. UThandi waba yisibonelo esihle emzaneni, futhi abantu baqala ukumlandela. Waba nesithakazelo sokuthi abantu bahlale befundiswa, futhi lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Umphakathi waba namandla, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani uma kwenzeka ingozi. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esikhulu sokuthi isikhathi sokuphendula singathuthukiswa uma abantu bebandakanyeka. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi lokhu kumele kuqhubeke. Waqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unolwazi, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangathuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Umphakathi waba namandla, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi banganqoba izinselelo uma bebandakanyeka. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokuthi umphakathi wakhe ube yisibonelo kwabanye. Wazi ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula singathuthukiswa, futhi lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu emzaneni. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangathuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu empilweni yabo.
Izindaba Zomphakathi: Umbiko Wokubambisana Nabantu Bendawo Isingeniso Izindaba zomphakathi zibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi zikhombisa indlela abantu abahlanganyela ngayo ezimpilweni zabo nsuku zonke. Kuleli mbiko, sizobheka izinkathazo nezixazululo ezitholakala emiphakathini ehlukene, sihlole indlela yokubambisana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nezindawo ezithile. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngokuqonda okujule ngempilo yomphakathi, nokuqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano obunempilo bungasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokuphila. Isigaba 1: Ubudlelwano Nezithakazelo Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umphakathi awususi nje kuphela kubantu, kodwa futhi uhlanganisa izithakazelo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkampani, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwalokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Ngokubambisana, izithakazelo zingase ziqhube imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuhlala, imfundo, nezempilo. Omunye umkhankaso owenziwe emiphakathini eminingi uwukubuyisela emuva izinsiza noma imisebenzi, ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo zokudlala, izindawo zokuphumula, kanye nezikhungo zokwabelana ngolwazi. Ukubambisana kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kudala amathuba okukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi kwenza kube lula ukusiza abanye. Isigaba 2: Izinselelo Zomphakathi Kodwa-ke, izinkinga zihlala zikhona. Ezinye zezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi zihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zezemvelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaqembu ahlale eqinile futhi abambisane ukuze athole izixazululo ezingcono. Umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo samathuba okusebenza, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuphepha zikhona, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini enezinga eliphezulu lokuhlupheka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuvikela, njengoba ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwezithakazelo bukhuthaza ukuphepha nokuthula. Izinhlelo zokuhlanganyela zomphakathi, ezifana nemihlangano yokuxoxa, zingasiza ekwenzeni abantu bazizwe bephephile, bephila impilo enempilo. Isigaba 3: Izixazululo Nezinto Ezinhle Kodwa, uma sibiwa izinkinga, sizichaza futhi izixazululo. Imiphakathi ethile ikhashelwe izinhlelo zokuziphatha ezikhiqizayo. Isibonelo, izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu amakhono amasha, ezifana nezobuchwepheshe, zikhulisa amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kusiza ukunciphisa ubuphofu futhi kuvuselele umnotho. Okwengeziwe, izinhlelo zokuvuselela izinsiza zempilo, njengokuhlinzeka ngempilo yokuvakasha, zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungathola izixazululo ezingcono uma abantu bephatha izinkinga zabo ngokubambisana. Ubulungisa bezemvelo buye bukhuthazwa kakhulu, okwenza kube lula ukulungisa izinkinga ezithinta umhlaba, njengokungcoliswa. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu namabhizinisi, kuhlanganise nokukhuthaza umoya wokuhlalisana phakathi kwemvelo nabantu. Isigaba 4: Ukuqinisekisa Uthando Nokuhlonipha Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, kufanele kube nokuhloniphana phakathi kwabantu. Ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo buncike ezinhlonipheni, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuvumelana phakathi kwabantu bezinhlanga, imikhuba, namasiko ahlukene. Ukuba nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uzizwa ebalulekile. Izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngezinhlelo zomphakathi, ezifana nemihlangano yomphakathi, zingasiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kudala isikhala sokuxoxa ngezinselelo, izidingo, kanye nezixazululo, ngenkathi kusebenza nezinhlaka ezahlukene ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, okukhuthaza uthando nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Isiphetho Njengoba siqhubeka nokuqonda izindaba zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise izimo zokuphila ezithinta wonke umuntu. Ukubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngethuba, nokuhlonipha izithakazelo ezihlukahlukene kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokusho kwalokhu, umphakathi ungakha izixazululo ezikhangayo, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuphila kahle. Izindaba zomphakathi zikhombisa ukuthi lapho abantu bebandakanyeka, umphakathi uthola amandla okukhula futhi ube nempilo engcono.
Idokhumenti yokuhlonza yomphakathi iyidokhumenti eqinisekisa ubuzwe bomuntu. Ikhishwe kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma kubahlali abaphelele abaneminyaka engu-16 nangaphezulu. Kubantu abalahlekelwe, abathathwe, noma abathintekayo ngempahla yabo. Kubantu abafaka isicelo sokushintsha imininingwane yabo. Kubantu abashintshile isimo sabo sibe sobuzwe. Kubafazi abangena emshadweni, noma labo abafisa ukubuyela ezibhengezo zabo zokuqala. Kubantu abahlala phesheya kwesigodi okwesikhashana kodwa abanedokhumenti yokuhlonza. Kubantu ababuya phesheya kwesigodi abanemvume yokuhlala engapheli evumelekile. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-9 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela isitifiketi sokuzalwa noma ipasipoti endala ekhishwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaJulayi 1, 1986. Thumela izithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-pasipoti. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwa izithupha zakho ukuze zirekhodwe ku-rejista yokuhlala kwabantu. Nikeza isitifiketi somshado uma ushade. Owesifazane ofaka isicelo sedokhumenti yokuhlonza ofisa ukubuyela ezibhengezo zakhe zokuqala kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa lezo zibhengezo. Umuntu obuyela phesheya kwesigodi ofaka isicelo sedokhumenti yokuhlonza kumele futhi athumele imvume yakhe yokuhlala engapheli, noma isitifiketi sokwamukelwa, noma isitifiketi sokukhululwa ngaphansi kwemibandela. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze nomnyango oseduzane nawe.
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhalisiwe kuleli, abantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokofficial eNingizimu Afrika ezingafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa kwemithi yezolimo. Umphathi: Umthetho 36 ka-1947 kumele waziswe ngokubhalwe phansi ngenhloso yokwenza imisebenzi edingekayo yokuhlola ukuze kubhaliswe imithi yezolimo ukuze kuhlelwe ukusebenza kwazo. Umphathi angadinga ulwazi olungeziwe ukuze enze isinqumo sokuthi imithi iyamukeleka noma cha, ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zelizwe, ukufaneleka, kanye nokusebenza kwayo kwezemvelo. Thola ifomu lesicelo kuwebhusayithi, bese uligcwalisa ngokuphelele. Lapho kudingeka, ulwazi oluceliwe lungathunyelwa njengama-attachments eduze kwemibhalo enezinombolo. Iphothi noma indawo lapho ivolumu yenqubo izobhalwa khona ukuze kuhlolwe izivivinyo nokubuyekezwa kwemiphumela ngokwesayensi yindawo lapho ucwaningo luzokwenziwa ukuze kuhlolwe izinto ezikhona noma olunye ulwazi olungadingeka nguMphathi mayelana nenani lemithi ezothunyelwa kuleli. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfaki-sicelo, futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlolwa kwezingxenye ezisebenzayo kungathatha unyaka owodwa. Izicelo zokusetshenziswa kokugcina noma zokubhaliswa kabusha ngokuvamile zikhishwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu. Ihhovisi leMphathi lithumela izincwadi minyaka yonke mayelana nezibuyekezo zokubhaliswa nezifomu zokufaka izicelo kubo bonke ababhalisile.
Uhlaka lokuguqula ubuciko, isiko, kanye nezimpahla zomnotho kazwelonke lubhalwe kuMthetho Wezobuciko, Isiko Nezimpahla Zomlando ka-1996. Umthwalo wokuphumeza lezi zinqubomgomo uqinisekiswa nguMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, owawuqala ukuphumeza lokhu ngo-Agasti 1, 2002. Inhloso eyinhloko ukuhlela nokwandisa ibhajethi yezobuciko nezamasiko ukuze kusizakale izidingo zobuciko nezamasiko kulo lonke izwe. Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwenhlangano nakho kubalulekile, futhi ekuqaleni, kubhekiswe ngqo ezikhungweni zokwenza ubuciko ezazincike kakhulu ekuxhaseni esikhathini esedlule. Ubuciko nezamasiko kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuvuselelweni, ubunye, nokubuyisana. Iqembu leMiphakathi Yezobuciko Nezamasiko lilungiselela ukusekela amasu ezikhungo zobuciko nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Zihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kobuciko kodwa futhi zidlala indima ebalulekile mayelana nezinselelo zomphakathi. Zifuna ukubhekana nezinkinga ezihlobene nokufakwa nokuhlanganiswa futhi ukususa ukungalingani emkhakheni wezobuciko nezamasiko ekunikezeni izinsiza. Inqubo ephoqelelwe ifaka phakathi ukufaka amaqembu aphansi njengabakhubazekile, intsha, abesifazane, nezingane. Baphinde banika ukunakwa okukhethekile ezinkingeni zokuguqulwa kwezigaba ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubulungiswa ekunikezeni izinsiza futhi kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni. Izikhungo zobuciko nezamasiko, izikhungo zokuxhasa, nezikhungo zobuciko zomphakathi zithola izibonelelo zonyaka ukuze zifeze izinhlelo nokuthuthukisa ubuciko nezamasiko. Uhlanga lwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika lusekelwa ngokomthetho ukuvikela amalungelo ezilimi nokukhuthaza izilimi zomdabu. Ngo-2003, ikhabhinethi yamukela uHlelo lweMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke, oluhlanganisa isitatimende senqubomgomo, uhlelo lokuphumeza, kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha yezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni futhi luqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwezilimi zomdabu ezazikhishwa phansi. Le nqubomgomo isebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zik gouvernement, futhi iqhubeka nokukhuthaza inani lezilimi emibhalweni esemthethweni eyenziwe, okuzokwenza kube lula futhi kube nempumelelo ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi kusetshenziswa imibhalo yezilimi efanele. Izifunda zizokwakha izinqubomgomo ngokusekelwe ezimweni zendawo. Izinqubomgomo zizokwethulwa kancane kancane. Ukwakhiwa kweNhlangano Yezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke yaseNingizimu Afrika njengomuntu ophakathi ngo-2002 kanye neBhodi Yezimpahla Zomlando Kazwelonke ngo-2003 kwenze ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomlando kazwelonke kanye nokuguqulwa komkhakha kube yimpumelelo. Iphrojekthi eyinhloko kule ndawo nguMnyuziyamu kaAlbert Luthuli ophakanyiswe eKwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal. Ngo-1998, ikhabhinethi yamukela amaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalolunye okuqala kwezimpahla zomlando okuhloswe ngakho ukubhekana nezici ezithile zendaba yomlando wezwe, ukukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwesizwe, nokufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni ezokuvakasha. Kuze kube manje, amaphrojekthi ayisithupha aqalile, kuhlanganise neMnyuziyamu Yabesifazane kanye neMnyuziyamu yeMpi YamaNgisi neBhora eNingizimu Afrika. Umnyango uzobambisana nePhalamende ukuze ufune ukuvunywa kwamaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalombili wezimpahla zomlando kazwelonke. Ukuxhaswa okuvela ebhajethini ekhethekile elinikezwe izikhungo kuhlose ukukhulisa amathuba okuguqulwa ngokwandisa ububanzi bokuxhasa kwezezimali ezikhungweni. Umnyango uqale uhlelo lwesigaba sokuqala ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2002/03 ukuze wandise ukufinyelela ezikhungweni ngokuthuthukisa izakhiwo zamamnyuziyamu nezinsiza. Ukugxila okukhulu kuzobekwa nasekuphathweni kwezinto ezitholakele nasekucwaningeni ngezimpahla zomlando kuzo zonke izikhungo zomlando kazwelonke (amamnyuziyamu nezinye izikhungo) ukuze kuzame ukunciphisa imisebenzi yobugebengu, kuhlanganise nokuhweba kwamanye amazwe nokukhwabanisa. I-Archives and Records Services yaseNingizimu Afrika ithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni imigomo yayo yokuphathwa kahle, uguquko, ukufinyelela ezidingweni zolwazi zomphakathi, nokukhuthaza ukubuyisana kwenhlalakahle ngokuguqulwa kwezimpawu zomlando nezinye. Intuthuko yenziwe nohlelo lwezifunda ukuze kuthathwe izinsiza njengezindawo zokugcina amarekhodi nezimpahla zomlando. IWestern Cape yamanje isesikhathini sokudlulisa lezi zindawo kufunda. Usizo ekugcineni impahla yeNepad nakho kubalulekile ohlwini lwezindaba ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho emithathu emisha kazwelonke isiyamukelwe. Omininisteri basayine isitatimende sokugcina amarekhodi ezimpahla, ukuphathwa kahle, namalungelo abantu avela ezweni elingu-10 lase-Afrika abethulwe ukuze amukelwe njengomsebenzi weNepad. NgoNovemba 2003, iNational Council for Library and Information Services (NCLIS) yasungulwa, nomhlangano wokuqala ubanjwe ngoMashi 2004. Ochwepheshe bokwakha nokwakhiwa bamenywa ukuze baphathe ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo esisha sePretoria seNational Library of South Africa ngoJanuwari 2004. I-Cultural Industries Growth Strategy ihlose ukuhlanganisa amandla omnotho wezobuciko, imisebenzi yezandla, umculo, ifilimu, ukuphrinta, nokwakhiwa. Ukusekela komnyango kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano nokwakha izinto ezintsha nemiphakathi/abazimele, besebenzisa isiko njengendlela yokuvuselela idolobha nokuzama ukuhlanganisa lezi zinkampani. Kukho ukugxila okukhulayo emandleni omkhakha wefilimu. Ingxenye ekhethekile yokunciphisa ubuphofu ihlose ukufinyelela kubabhalisi nezitolo njengendlela yokuvuselela idolobha, ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemaphandleni, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Amaphrojekthi enziwa ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nabezindawo, kanye nohulumeni nezikhungo ezingezona ezikahulumeni. Imizamo yokuthuthukisa iWild Coast, iLebombo, neMaputo Corridor iyizindawo ezibhekelele ukukhuthaza ezokuvakasha ngezamasiko ezihlobene nale mikhankaso. Le mizamo izoqhubeka ngokwabela imali kumaphrojekthi abizwa ngokuthi "Investing in Culture". "Investing in Culture" izozama ukuqinisekisa zonke izici ezihlobene nesiko ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni "imiphakathi" ehlanzekile. Umnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko uxhasa ukuthi imiphakathi eminingi enezimo zomnotho ezinzima ngaphakathi kwemingcele yethu ingaba ngabanikazi bezinsiza, kuhlanganise nezidingo zemvelo nezomuntu, impahla yamasiko, amakhono, nolwazi lwesiko, izinto ezivamile, namasiko angasiza ekuguqulweni kwenhlalo kanye nomnotho. Imiphakathi yethu igcwele ulwazi lwesiko, amakhono, nemiphumela yobuciko evela kubantu abanamakhono aphezulu abath
Usuku lweNkululeko: Ukuhlonipha Umhlaba Wethu Wenkululeko Njengoba sihamba phambili emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nemicabango ejulile ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile, uSuku lweNkululeko, olugujwa minyaka yonke. Lokhu akukhulumi kuphela ngempilo yethu, kodwa futhi kukhombisa isiko, ubuhlakani, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nathi njengenhlalo. Usuku lweNkululeko, oluthathwa ngokujulile ngabaningi, lukhombisa umoya wokuzimela, impilo, nokuqhubekela phambili. Ngokwami, akusiyo nje insuku yokugubha umcimbi, kodwa kuyithuba lokubuyekezwa kokuthi silwela ini. Ngonyaka ka-1994, lapho sithola khona inkululeko, bekukhona umuzwa ophakeme wokuthi izwe lethu lizothuthuka. Ngaleso sikhathi, sathola ithuba lokwakha isizwe esinobumbano, esihlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi. Ubuhlakani bethu, ubumbano, kanye nomzamo wokubuyisela emuva izinhlelo ezazikhona, kwavula umnyango omusha wokuthula. Nokho, njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inkululeko akusiyo into ethola ukuthola kalula. Isebenza njengomgibeli, ehlasela izithiyo ezikhona ekuphileni kwabantu. Ubulili, ubuzwe, kanye nezimo zomnotho kusengaphambili kukhona izithiyo ezisithinta. Ngaleso sizathu, kufanele siqhubeke siphakamisa izwi lethu, sikhulume ngezinkinga ezithinta abantu abaningi, njengoba uSuku lweNkululeko luhloswe ukusikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sihloniphe izwi labanye. Phakathi kwezinto ezithokozisayo ngalesi sikhathi, singabheka izinkumbulo zethu. Ngisakhumbula izithombe zamadodana nentombazane ezaziwela emigwaqweni, zikhangisa izifanekiso zenkululeko. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi siphila emhlabeni lapho akukhona okukhuluma ngempela. Kodwa, akukhona okungapheli. Umhlaba wethu unama-encumbrances, futhi lokhu kusebenza ebuhleni nesimo esikuso. Ngakho, uma siphokophela phambili, kubalulekile ukufaka izinyathelo ezihambisanayo. Siyazi ukuthi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantwana bethu bangase baphinde bacabange ngendlela esibheka ngayo inkululeko. Ubulungiswa, ubumbano, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlala zikhona, kufanele zihlale ziphambili ezinhlelweni zethu. Ubulili obufana nezenzo ezithinta amalungelo abantu kufanele kube phezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwempilo enhle, ezokuthula, nemfundo eqinile. Ubulungiswa bempilo kufanele bube yintshisakalo yethu, ngoba inkululeko ayinakho ukwakha uhlelo olungavumeli ukuba kube nokuwohloka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSuku lweNkululeko akusikho okokuhlonipha kuphela. Kuphinde kube yithuba lokuhlola imiphumela yezenzo zethu. Njengoba sikhumbula izigameko eziphawulekayo zomlando, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi imizamo yethu ayikho ukuze kuphela kwabanye, kodwa futhi kuyisinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngakho, kudinga ukuba sibe nomqondo ophusile, sihlale sihamba nemfundo ezikhaliphile. Kumaqhawe, akusiyona nje imizamo yokukhumbula izinsuku ezithile, kodwa imizamo yokuhlola izinsuku ezizayo. Uthando lokuthula kanye nokuqhubekela phambili kumele kube yinto eyinhloko. Njengoba siqhubeka sikhumbula uSuku lweNkululeko, kufanele siqhubeke nokukhuthaza intuthuko, imfundo, nobuchwepheshe, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uzodlondlobala. Ngokukhuluma ngalezi zinto, ngisebenzisa leli sikhathi ukukhumbula abakhokheli bethu abaphakeme, abashiya imikhondo emihle, ngesikhathi abakhipha izwi labo, benza ngezindlela ezithandekayo. Ukukhumbula uMandela, uHendrik Verwoerd, uOliver Tambo, kanye nabanye, ngenxa yokuthi babe nemfanelo yokukhathalela abantu. Lokhu kuhlonipha umoya wabo, nokuthi sithole ithuba lokwakha umhlaba omusha, akukupheli. Ngakho, uSuku lweNkululeko akusiyo nje insuku yokugubha, kodwa iwubufakazi bokuthi siqhubeka sikhumbula indaba yethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube yindlela yokukhumbula, futhi sikhumbula izinzuzo zenkululeko. Njengoba sihamba phambili, sizokulethela ukuzimisela, ukukhuthazela, kanye nempumelelo, ukuze sithole umhlaba ohlanganyele. U-Suku lweNkululeko, ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuyisa ithemba, ubonisa ukuthi sithanda ukuhlonipha, sikhumbula izinkumbulo, futhi sithole ubumbano. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nesibindi, sikhumbule ukuthi inkululeko ayikuphi ngaphandle kwezinsizakalo zethu. Uthando, ukuxhumana, nokusebenzisana kuzokwenza umhlaba wethu ube indawo engcono. Ngakho-ke, sisemoyeni wokubuyisa umhlaba wethu, sithokozisa, futhi siqhubekele phambili, sikhumbula uSuku lweNkululeko.
Iphrofayela kaSiphiwe Mthethwa: Umholi Wezokuxhumana Nomphakathi USiphiwe Mthethwa, umholi ophumelelayo kwezokuxhumana nomphakathi, ubonakala njengomuntu onomdlandla futhi onobuchule obuphezulu. Wazalelwa edolobheni laseThekwini, uSiphiwe wakhulela emndenini ohlonipha imisebenzi yokuxhumana nabantu, okwakwenza kube lula kuye ukuthola uthando lwakhe lwezokuxhumana. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athole khona iziqu zeBachelor of Arts kwezokuxhumana, waphuma wathola ithuba lokusebenza emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. U-Siphiwe waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengomxhumanisi wezindaba enkampanini encane yokumaketha. Lapha, waphumelela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwekhasimende nezindaba, okwenza kube lula ukwenza imikhankaso ephumelelayo. Ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, uSiphiwe wathola ithuba lokusebenza ebhizinisini elikhulu, lapho aqhubeka khona nokukhulisa amakhono akhe. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezazihlanganisa izinkampani eziningi ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSiphiwe waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umfanekiso omuhle wezinkampani azenzayo. Uhlonishwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwekhasimende nabaphathi, okwandisa ukwaziswa nokwethembeka kwemikhiqizo. U-Siphiwe ubona ukubaluleka kokuxhumana okuhle, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana nezithameli zakhe. U-Siphiwe ungumuntu onothando, futhi ubona ukuthi ukuphumelela emsebenzini kudinga ukusebenzisana nabanye. Uhlale ethola izindlela zokukhuthaza abanye, ebonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle bukhona phakathi kwabantu. Ubuye abe ngumfundisi wezokuxhumana, efundisa abanye ngempumelelo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. U-Siphiwe ubelokhu eyinhloso yokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi ubona ukuthi izokuxhumana nomphakathi ingumgogodla wokufeza lokhu. U-Siphiwe uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe, kodwa akakaze forget ukuthi impumelelo ayitholakali ngaphandle kokusebenza kanzima. Uhlala efundisa abanye ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kudinga ukuzimisela, ukuhlela, nokuba nesineke. U-Siphiwe unethemba lokuthi uzokwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele emikhakheni yabo, futhi unethemba lokuthi uzokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi ukuba bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile emhlabeni. Ngaphandle komsebenzi wakhe, u-Siphiwe uyathanda ukuhamba, ukufunda izincwadi, nokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi. Uthanda ukuxhumana nabantu, futhi uhlala edinga ukufunda izinto ezintsha. U-Siphiwe ubona ukuthi ukuphila kahle kudinga ukuxhumana, futhi uzama njalo ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu abamzungezile. U-Siphiwe Mthethwa ungumholi oqavile kwezokuxhumana nomphakathi, onomdlandla wokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi uyinsika emkhakheni wakhe. Uhlala efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ezokuxhumana nomphakathi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. U-Siphiwe uqhubeka nokwenza umehluko, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abanye baphinde bafunde kumphakathi wakhe. Njengomholi, u-Siphiwe ubonisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezokuxhumana nomphakathi kudinga ukuzinikela, ubuchule, nokuhlonipha abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Siphiwe ubona ukuthi impumelelo ayigcini nje ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba nezinhloso ezicacile. Uhlala efuna izindlela zokukhuthaza abanye, futhi ubona ukuthi umphakathi unamandla okwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. U-Siphiwe Mthethwa ungumholi ophumelelayo, futhi ubalulekile emkhakheni wezokuxhumana nomphakathi. Uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi ubona ukuthi impumelelo yakhe iyinsika yokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele. Ngokubambisana, u-Siphiwe ubonisa ukuthi izokuxhumana nomphakathi iyinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. U-Siphiwe Mthethwa, umholi wezokuxhumana nomphakathi, uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi ubudlelwano obuhle bungakha umhlaba ongcono.
### Umculo WaseNingizimu Afrika Umculo waseNingizimu Afrika unomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, kodwa kuleli zwe, unomoya wemvelo, unothile futhi uhlanganisa izinhlobonhlobo ezahlukene. Umhlaba wakhe ugcwele izwi, imisindo nemigqa yeziqu, edala umoya omuhle ophakamisa imizwa. Umculo awusizi kuphela ekudlaleni, kodwa uphinde uqhakambise ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ngemuva kokuvuka kwelanga, abantu baseMakhaza bahlala bejabulile, behlangana emicimbini yomculo. Umama uGugulethu, umculi wendawo, wayevame ukuhamba ezitaladeni, eqhuba imicimbi emifushane. WayenguMzukulu, umculi ophilayo owayebhalela umculo ophuma ezinyaweni zezingelosi. Owayengabukeli konke lokhu, wathola umoya wakhe ungene ekubhaleni izinkanyezi ngenhliziyo, ngoba umculo uthinta wonke umuntu. Ngonyaka othile, ubaba uThabo, umphakathi wabo wathola ithuba lokuhlangana emikhosini yomculo, lapho bonke abantu baphuma ezimpilweni zabo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuhlangana, kwaqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo weGqom, owawuhamba nezinsuku ezijabulisayo, wawugubha. Umculo weGqom, owavela ezindaweni zamadolobha, uxhasa umoya opholile, uhambelana nemizwa yentshisekelo nezinhlelo zamasiko. Kwakuwumcimbi ophakamisa umoya, amaqembu afana noMampintsha noBabes Wodumo adlala imicimbi emikhulu. Zonke izinsuku, izinsimbi zabantu zaziphakanyiswa, zikhuthaza imicabango nezincwadi. Abantwana bahlala behleka, bejabulile, bedlala phansi kwezinkanyezi zasehlobo. UThabo, umyeni kaGugulethu, wayengumqondisi omkhulu. Waqhubeka phambili waphonsa ama-CDs akhe ahlakaniphile. Wasebenza njengomqondisi, edlala izigqi ezivusa imizwa ezivela ezwenikazi. Ngempela, umculo wawungowokuphila, futhi ekugcineni, uGugulethu wagxila eMarimba, ngendlela ethokozisayo. Ngenkathi ethola izinkanyezi ezintsha, waqala ukusebenza nabaculi abasha. Bahlanganyela emkhankasweni, baphakamisela umculo njengoba umoya wabo uguquka. Umculo, kuleli sonto, wawumangalisa, umphakathi ubonisa indlela yokwakha, izinkanyezi zikhanya, zonke imiphakathi ihlangene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo noGugulethu basungula umkhosi omkhulu, ngenhloso yokuphakamisela umculo waseNingizimu Afrika. Kwakupa ubuciko, ukuzwakala kwemibala, neziya ezivela empilweni, nezikhathi ziduduza nezikhumbuzo. Umphakathi wenza kahle, umculo waba umoya wokuxhumana, ukwaziswa kwezindatshana ezinothile, ngezimfundiso ezithokozisayo. Ekhaya, umculo waxhentshela iAfrika, uqhume imikhumbuzo, nhlangothi zombili zezwe. Abantwana bephonsa izinkanyezi, uGugulethu edlala izinsimbi ezivela ezihlahleni, ophethe amaphuzu avusa impilo. UThabo, odlalisa abantwana, ukuze baqhubeke bejabulisa imiphakathi yabo. Bakha amakhono kulo mkhankaso, ubuchwepheshe, umgaqo-nkqubo, nomoya, konke kithina. Umgubho waze wafika, konke kwahamba kahle. Umphakathi ubhalise konke okwenziwa kulezi zinsuku, nolimi lwezinkanyezi lwezindaba, ube udawe. Kwagcwaliseka izikhumbuzo eziningi, bekhumbula izinsikazi ezinjengamaphupho, nezifiso zamaqiniso. Umculo waqhubeka nokukhanyisela, kanye neziqu ezintsha ezikhanyayo ezivela empilweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wakhumbula umculo wabo, wezwa ukufudumala, uhlanga lwakhe lwawukhumbula izinkanyezi. UThabo noGugulethu bahlala nomndeni, banokuhluka, kodwa baphila ngokuhlangana, uxolo, uthando, nomculo. Umculo ube yimpumelelo, okuwumbono wezinkanyezi, umoya onqobayo, nokuvusa imizwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umculo ungowethemba, uhlanganisa izinkanyezi ezihambisanayo, wonke umuntu wengeza imizwa yothando, uqhubeke ungekho. Umculo, ezinzisa ezinsukwini, ungowomndeni, ungowokholo, ngezimoto ezinhle zomoya, uveza wonke umuntu endaweni evulekile. Umhlaba, ubuthongo, uvuka, ngomculo uyikwa, uSomdaka, iMikhulu, noMsholozi, ubehlelo, umusa, umoya, izinto ezihambisanayo. Kanjalo, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika uyaziqhenya, udinga ukuba uqhubeke, uthokozise, ube yimvelaphi. Ngoba umculo ubonisa ubuhlobo, ubonisa ubuntu. Umuzi wethu ube umculo, umhlaba ube umusa, konke lokho kudinga ukuhamba kancane, njengesikhathi sizophila. Okwamanje, asiphathe umculo, asixoxe ngakho, sizwe izwi, singavuma ukuba uyiqoqe, umculo nokuhlangana. Ngakho umculo owamukelwa eNingizimu Afrika awuthathi nje ibhadi, kodwa ubukeka njengomqondisi, uhlaziya, ubonise izindlela ezingalezi ukuthi umhlaba ubuhlungu, futhi ungakhuluma ngezinto ezinjalo ngendlela ephilayo. Umculo ungowethu, umculi ungowethu, umoya ungowethu, umhlaba ungowethu. Asithokoze, asithokozise ngemihlangano yokuhlala, umculo ube yinsika yethu, iqhubeka, isigqoko sethu, i-Africa.
Ukusiza nokufundisa abalimi ngabanye kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kubiza imali eningi. Kungcono ukuhlanganisa abalimi ndawonye, kwakha i-cooperative enamalungu anemisebenzi efanayo, bese bethola usizo ngokuqhubekayo emihlanganweni evamile. Lo msebenzi uqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wawo - uthumele ukuqeqeshwa, ulwazi, nolwazi kubo bonke abalimi ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sibone ukuthi inani lamalungu kuma-cooperatives okufunda lehle ngoba kuphela abalimi abaqinile abafuna ukukhula ngokwezimali bahlala. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu eNyakatho Nentshonalanga lapho leli hlelo lisebenza khona iminyaka eminingi. Ezindaweni lapho saqala khona ukusungula ama-cooperatives amasha, sibhekene nezinselelo ngoba kunezinkulungwane zababalimi abafuna ukujoyina. Kukhona izindawo lapho kunezabalimi abasha abangafika ku-200 abafuna ukujoyina! Ngalesi sikhathi, sihlangane namalungu angu-128 alezi zifundo ze-cooperatives ezindaweni eziphethwe amahhovisi omasipala. Phakathi kwalezi zifundo, kukhona eziyi-8 ezilungu zephrojekthi yesonto eFree State Mpumalanga. Indlela yokuthuthukisa amasu ukuze silungiselele ukulima ngonyaka ozayo uma uzwa ukuthi izimo zezulu zizoba nzima zokutshala. Ezinyangeni ezedlule, sihlangane nawo wonke amalungu ama-cooperatives okufunda ukuqoqa ulwazi mayelana nenani le-hectares elitshaliwe, inani lemishini kanye nesimo sayo njengezithuthuthu, abathungi, imishini yokufafaza, nezithuthi. Sikholelwa ukuthi sizothola uxhaso nolwazi lwephrojekthi ezozama ukuqapha nokuqeda le mishini - imishini enempilo ibalulekile uma ufuna ukulima ngokwezimali. Okwamanje, ukulima kusemthethweni ngoba inzuzo iphansi, ngakho akukho mali yokubheka nokulungisa imishini. Le nkinga idinga ukuhlolwa ngokucophelela uma abakhiqizi abamnyama befuna ukuthatha indawo yabo ekulimaleni kwezimali.
Njengoba ngimi lapha, nginokuzwa injabulo nokudabuka; ngiyajabula ngoba namuhla sizogcwalisa iphupho lokuletha impilo engcono kubantu bethu eKwaNibela, kodwa ngidabukile kakhulu ngoba ezinsukwini ezedlule, sishonele emoyeni yabantu abahlanu abangenacala baleli zwe ngenxa yezikhukhula zakamuva ezishayile ezindaweni zethu eMshwathi, eMandeni, naseNdwedwe. Lezi zenzakalo zikhumbuza futhi ngempela ubuhlungu bokungabi nezimo zokuhlala ezanele abantu bethu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ekuqaleni kwesikhathi esifushane kusukela ngomhla ka-17 kuZibandlela 2004, kuze kube manje, sibe nezikhukhula eziyi-19 ezinzima, uma ngibala lezo ezivela kuleli Msombuluko esikwi, eziholele ekulimaleni ezindaweni eziningi zempumalanga yethu. Uma sibheka kuphela umonakalo owenziwe yilezi zikhukhula, kubonakala ukuthi abantu abaningi bathinteka, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Siyazi ukuthi akuwona umphumela wabantu bethu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kodwa kungenxa pressure abathola kuyo, okuvela kuhulumeni ophatha ngokucindezela owawungalindele izidingo zokuhlala kwemiphakathi yethu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokuhlala. Ngenxa yomonakalo owenzeka ezindlini zabantu, sibe nezindleko ezingu-19.3 million rand ukusiza abantu abathintekile, futhi sizodinga nezinye izimali ukuze sixazulule izimo eziphuthumayo zakamuva. Lezi yizimali esizozisebenzisa ukwakha izindlu ezintsha ukuze sivalelise umgapho wezindlu ezikhona ngenxa ye-apartheid, kodwa manje kufanele sithuthukise izindlu ezilimele zabantu bethu ezingekho esimweni esifanele sokumelana nezikhukhula. Kubonakala kahle kimi, umphakathi waseKwaNibela, ukuthi uma sifuna ukususa ukungathuthuki ekuthuthukisweni kwezindawo zasemaphandleni okubangelwa yi-apartheid, kufanele sikhulume kahle futhi silwe. I-apartheid ithathe abantu bethu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokuhlala futhi yabasebenzisa; empeleni, lezi zindawo zaziyindawo lapho uhulumeni we-apartheid athola khona abasebenzi abacindezelwe futhi abakhokhelwa kancane. Namuhla sikhona lapha ezweni likaMnumzane Mdluli, ukuze sikhulume kahle futhi silwe nokungathuthuki kokuthuthukiswa okushiywe yi-apartheid ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Esontweni elidlulelwe, sasiMseleni, lapho saphinde saqala umkhankaso wokulwa nomonakalo oshiywe yi-apartheid ngokwethula izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu. Ngempelasonto ezayo sizobe siseKwaMnqobokazi. Sihamba ngesivinini esikhulu emkhankasweni wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lezi zifiso ziqhubeka zikhuluma ukuthi uma intando yabantu ibusa kuleli zwe, abantu bazokwakhelwa izindlu, futhi kuzoba nokuphepha nokuphumelela. Ngempela, bathi bonke abantu kuleli zwe kufanele babe nokufinyelela ezindlini ezifanele; akekho okufanele aphile ezindlini eziphakeme ngenkathi kukhona abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikhululekile nezifanele. Lapho benza lesi sinqumo, kwaba sengathi kuyiphupho, kodwa namuhla le mbono isibe isisekelo senqubomgomo kahulumeni. Siyajabula ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisa umnyango wethu ukuze agcwalise umbono nephupho lokuthi abantu bethu kufanele bakhishwe izindlu ezisezingeni eliphakeme. Uhulumeni ophatha ngokucindezela akazange anakekele abantu bethu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Abantu abaningi baphoqwa ukuba bahlale ezimeni zokuhlala ezingafanele, emhlabeni owomile ongenamsebenzi futhi ongenzuzo. Ukususwa kwabantu ezindaweni zethu kube izilonda ezibuhlungu emandleni ethu. Abaningi benu bayazi ubuhlungu obuhambisana nokwehliswa kwesithunzi sabantu bethu. Imindeni yahlukaniswa, amasiko ethu aphukile kodwa awalahleki, futhi ithemba alizange lishiswe. Abaningi balaba bantu batholakala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni njengeKwaNibela, kanti abanye bakhishwa ezindlini ezizungezile emadolobheni, njengokuhlupheka okukhulu okubhekene neNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kokuhla kukahulumeni we-apartheid. Kulama-11 eminyaka kahulumeni we-democratic, sikwazile ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezingeni lesifunda nezwe ukuze silungise le miphumela. Namuhla sijabule ukusho ukuthi sikwazile ukwakha izindlu eziyi-1,600 zabantu bethu ababe neziqu ezingenalutho, futhi eziningi ziqhubeka zakhiwa njengoba ngikhuluma. Sizibophezele ekwandiseni uhlelo lwezindlu unyaka nonyaka ukuze silwe nokuntuleka kwezindlu ngokushesha. Nakuba lolu hlelo luzothatha iminyaka, sijabule ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zethulwa ngokushesha, ubufakazi balesi sikhathi sikhona phambi kwenu namuhla. Sinethemba lokuthi sinesu eliphumelelayo. Izinqubomgomo zethu azikona nje izifiso zikaHulumeni. Kodwa lezi zinqubomgomo zimele ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ukuze kubhekwe ngqo ukuntuleka kwezindlu futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umphakathi walezi zizwe uphila endlini efudumele. Thina, njengomnyango, sikholelwa ukuthi ukwakha nokuthuthukisa izindlu kufanele kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Sikholelwa ukuthi abantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni nezinsiza, ezifana nezindlela, amanzi, ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo, kanye negesi. Indlu inika umuntu isithunzi nobuqotho; iyindawo ongayibiza ngokuthi ikhaya, ikuvikela ezikhukhuleni nasezimweni ezimbi, iyindawo yakho ephephile futhi ikunika ubunikazi. Namuhla imoto yethu yokuthuthukisa ifike eKwaNibela ukuze iphazamise imiphumela yokuhlupheka okukhishwe ukungabi nezindlu ezanele, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini yethu yasemaphandleni. Lolu hlelo lwezindlu esilwethulayo namuhla, Nkosikazi, uMnumzane Mdluli, kanye nonke abantu, lumele ukuqala okusha emphakathini lapha nasezindaweni zonke zasemaphandleni zempumalanga yethu. Lo msebenzi esiwethulayo namuhla uzoshintsha impilo yabantu abaningi abakhe le ndawo yaseKwaNibela. Le ngxenye yomlando iyisibonakaliso sokuthi sithathe isinyathelo esibalulekile sokufeza umbono wethu wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lolu hlelo luzophinde lwenze amathuba emisebenzi ahlukaniswe ezinkulungwaneni, futhi eziningi zizoze zibe khona okwesikhashana. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizokwenza abantu bakhishwe izindlu ezindaweni abahlala kuzo njengamanje futhi ngeke baphume ezindaweni ezahlukene. Iziqu zayo zizo-42 square meters, okuyindlu enkulu futhi eyakhiwe kahle. Enye into ejabulisayo ngalolu hlelo lapha eKwaNibela ukuthi amabhulokhi okwakha lezi zindlu azothengwa kini, umphakathi, ukuze nithole inzuzo futhi nithuthukise.
