Izinkinga Zokuhamba Ngamatekisi: Iphrofayela kaThabo Mthethwa UThabo Mthethwa, umshayeli wamatekisi oneminyaka engu-35, uhlala edolobheni elikhulu laseGoli. Njengomuntu osebenzela ukuthola imphilo, uThabo ungena emsebenzini wakhe nsuku zonke ekhangisa izinkanyezi zempilo ezihlotshaniswa nokuhamba. Noma ngabe imoto yakhe inezinhlaka ezinhle, uthola ukuthi izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi zikhula kakhulu. Njengomuntu ohlangabezana nezinkinga ezihlobene nomsebenzi ukuhamba, uThabo uthembisa ukuba yisithombe esicacile sokukhathazeka kwabashayeli bamatekisi. Uqala indaba yakhe ngokukhuluma ngokuqonda kwakhe ngesimo sezinto. "Uhambo lokuhamba ngamatekisi luhluke kakhulu. Kunezikhathi lapho izigidi zabantu zikhona, futhi lokhu kudala umnotho omkhulu kuma-taxi," kusho uThabo. Nokho, njengomshayeli, ubona izinselelo ezihambisana nale mboni. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu uThabo abhekana nazo yizithuthi eziningi ezisemgwaqweni. "Izimoto zikhona yonke indawo, futhi lokhu kudala izithiyo ezinkulu," eqhubeka esho. UThabo ubona ukuthi lokhu akubangeli kuphela ukungabi nankinga kokuhamba, kodwa futhi kungaphazamisa izinsiza zamanje. Esikhathini lapho umgwaqo uphakathi kokuba ubuhlungu, uThabo uphinde ahlangabezane nezimo ezinzima zokuhlala esikhathini sokuhamba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo uthola ukuthi abanye abashayeli bamatekisi bahlasela impilo yabo. "Abanye bethu bahlushwa yizinkinga zezimali. Imithetho emisha ibiza imali yokuthenga isikhumbuzo, futhi abanye basuke bephila ngosuku nosuku," echaza. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abheke izinkinga ezinjalo ukuze kwandiswe ubuchwepheshe bokuhamba. UThabo ubonisa ukuthi abashayeli bamatekisi bangabambisana ukuze benze izinkinga zibe lula ngokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwezithiyo zomgwaqo, uThabo ubona isidingo sokuthuthukiswa kwezokuphatha. "Izinkampani eziningi zikhona, kodwa abanye abashayeli basakhungathekile. Umkhakha awusebenzi kahle," kusho uThabo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukungabikhona kwemithetho efanele kuchitha kahle ithuba lokuthola izinzuzo. UThabo uthi udinga ukuxhumana nabanye abashayeli ukuze bazitholele izixazululo. UThabo ubona ukuthi i-technology idlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni uhla lwezinkinga. "Izinhlelo zokusebenza ziye zaqhubeka, kodwa abashayeli abaneziqu kufanele baqhube izicelo zabo," echaza. Lokhu kudinga uchwepheshe bezokuxhumana ukuze baphendule izinkinga ezinzima ezivela kumakhasimende nabashayeli. UThabo uqinisekile ukuthi uma abashayeli besebenza ndawonye, bangakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. UThabo uthi, "Sidinga ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabashayeli nabathengisi." Ubonisa ukuthi lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba phakathi kwabantu. UThabo ubonisa isigaba esisha sokuhamba ngamatekisi, lapho abashayeli bengakwazi ukuxhumana nezinkampani ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Naphezu kwazo zonke izinkinga, uThabo uhlale eqinile. Uthi, "Ngiyazi ukuthi izinkinga zikhona, kodwa uma siphumelela, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili." UThabo ungumholi phakathi kwabashayeli bamatekisi, futhi uthanda ukusiza abanye ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene. Ubonisa ukuthi ukukhula komkhakha kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. UThabo Mthethwa ungumshayeli wamatekisi onobuhlakani obukhulu, ohlangabezana nezinkinga ezihlobene nomsebenzi wakhe nsuku zonke. Noma izinkinga zikhona, uThabo uveza ithemba lokuthi uma abashayeli begxila ekuthuthukiseni uhla lwezokuhamba, bazoba namathuba amahle kakhulu. Indaba yakhe ibonisa ukuthi ubuhlakani, ubumbano, nokuzinikela kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wamatekisi, futhi uThabo uhlala ekulindeleni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS Ukufinyelela izinzuzo ze-GEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme) kubalulekile ukuze udinga izinsizakalo zempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Ukuze uqonde lokhu, kubalulekile ukulandela izinyathelo ezithile ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi uthola izinzuzo ezifanele zesikhwama sokuqashwa. Isinyathelo 1: Ukwazi imithetho ye-GEMS Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufunda nokwazi imithetho ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle izidingo zokufaneleka kanye nezizathu ezenza ukuthi ungathola izinzuzo. I-GEMS inezinqubo ezithile nezimfuneko ezokwenyusa ukufaneleka kwezinhlelo zayo. Ungathola le mifutho emithonjeni ye-GEMS, ezinikeza imininingwane eminingi mayelana nezinqumo ezithintekayo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuqinisekisa ukufaneleka Ngemuva kokuba uziqonde kahle izikhombisi-ndlela, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyafaneleka. Lokhu kuncike ebantwini obawaziyo, kubandakanya imishado, abantwana bakho, nabanye abantu obanikeza ukwesekwa. U-GEMS ubeka izimfuneko ezithile ezithinta ukuthi ubani ofaneleka, kuhlanganise nabantu abasebenza ohlelweni lukamasipala nemigomo ethize efaneleka. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo Uma uqinisekisile ukufaneleka kwakho, kufanele uhlinzeke ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze uthole ukusiza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu, isimo somsebenzi, kanye nezithombe ezidingekayo. Qiniseka ukuthi ulayishe imininingwane emisha futhi eqondile ukuze ugweme ukwehluleka emaphaketheni. Isinyathelo 4: Ukudlulisela isicelo Ngemva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kumele udlulisela isicelo sakho. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhambisa izincwadi ezisemthethweni, i-inthanethi, noma umakhalekhukhwini. Ungakhetha indlela ethokozisayo, kodwa qiniseka ukuthi uyayiqonda indlela yokusebenza ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi isicelo sakho sitholakele. Isinyathelo 5: Ukulinda impendulo Ngemuva kokudlulisela isicelo, kufanele ulinde impendulo. Lokhu kungathatha isikhathi esithile, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuba nomusa. Kufanele ubheke njalo ku-GEMS ukuze uthole ukubuyiselwa kolwazi. Uma uthola ukuphikiswa, unelungelo lokufuna ukucaciselwa, okungakwenza ufinyelele emiphumeleni engcono. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuqhuba izinsizakalo zempilo Uma isicelo sakho siphumelele, ungakwazi ukuqala ukusebenzisa izinzuzo zakho. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo nezidingo okufanele uziqinisekise. Funda izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ezihambisana nezinhlelo zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Isinyathelo 7: Ukugcina Imibhalo Ukugcina imibhalo yakho ibalulekile. Phatha zonke izincwadi ezihambisana ne-GEMS, kuhlanganise neziqinisekiso zokuhlinzeka, izinkokhelo, kanye nemibhalo yokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoba usizo uma udinga ukucela ukwaziswa noma uma kwenzeka izinkinga. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuzama Okwengeziwe Khumbula ukuthi i-GEMS inikeza amathuba okuhlola ukuphakanyiswa kokufinyelela izinzuzo eziphakeme. Bheka amathuba okuchithwa, izinhlelo ezintsha, nezinhlelo ezithuthukile. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono kakhulu kwezinsiza zempilo ezitholakalayo. Isiphetho Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS kuwumsebenzi obalulekile ophetheke ekuphathweni kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungafinyelela kalula ezinsizeni eziphusile nezinzile. Ukuze ugcine impilo yakho iphilile, kubalulekile ukuqonda lezi zinqubo ukuze uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa impilo yakho neyezakho. Kukhona imithombo eminingi etholakalayo ezokwenza uqonde kahle imithetho nezinqubomgomo, ngakho-ke ungakheshi ukudinga usizo. Ngemva Kolandelayo, yiba neziqhamo ezikhona futhi uthole impilo esezingeni eliphezulu.
Ishadi lokungenisa lemikhiqizo ye-alcohol ngaphakathi kwelizwe liyadingeka uma kuimportwa iziphuzo ezine-alcohol eNingizimu Afrika. Ishadi lokungenisa noma ikhophi lizodingeka ngaphambi kokukhululwa kwempahla ezosetshenziswa emnyango wokungena. Umthumeli kufanele afake isicelo se-shadi lokungenisa lemikhiqizo. Ngemuva kwalokho, ishadi lokungenisa lingasetshenziswa, uma kungekho shintsho ekwakhiweni, okuqukethwe ngaphakathi, usayizi webhodlela, kanye nelebula yaleyo mveliso. Ishadi lokungenisa lizodingeka kwemikhiqizo enokuqukethwe kwe-alcohol okungaphezu kwephesenti elilodwa, ethunyelwa ngenhloso yokuphuza, futhi iyingxenye yemithwalo yomuntu efika eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa uma leyo mveliso ingadluli ku-12 liters ngobuningi futhi ilethwa ukuze iphuzwe ngumuntu, umndeni wakhe, kanye nezivakashi zabo abangathengi leyo alcohol. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo. Uma kuimportwa amabhodlela, kufanele uthumele isampula ebhodlelweni elinlebelayo, njengoba ithengiswa. Thumela isampula ye-alcohol ethunyelwe ebhodlelweni elijwayelekile le-750ml. Ukuze uthumele imithwalo emikhulu, imikhiqizo engenayo izobhekwa. Ilebula ibhekwa uma ufaka isicelo se-ovisi yokuthengisa ye-shadi. Umnyango kufanele ukhishwe ngaphambi kokuthi bakhiphe ishadi lokungenisa ngaphakathi kwelizwe. Akukho sikhathi esinqunyiwe salolu sevisi.
Ngiyacela usizo lwakho nokubamba iqhaza ehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-influenza A (H1N1) 2009 pandemic ngaphakathi kwenhlangano yakho yezemidlalo. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni lempilo leli yiPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Iqale eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walonyaka. Ekuqaleni, yayaziwa njengokuphefumula kwezinkomo ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi iqale ezinkomeni. Manje kuqondwa ukuthi umthombo wayo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, le mpilo ayinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje ibizwa nje ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngegama layo elisemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walonyaka, le gciwane isishayile ezizweni eziyi-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, le gciwane isishayile ezizweni eziyi-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, le gciwane ibonakale ibhubhisa abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo lwezempilo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. ENingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 kanye nezinsuku eziyisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo obuhlelwe ngomhla kaJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lezempilo Lomhlaba (WHO) lathola ukuthi izimfuneko zokumemezela le mpilo njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke zifeziwe, kanti uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, umemezele ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho nje ukuthi le mpilo isishayile ezizweni kuzo zonke izifunda ze-WHO futhi yenzeke ngokushesha. Nokho, ngithanda ukufaka emqondweni ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi le mpilo inamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iyaqhubeka nokusabalala yonke indawo. Ngomhla kaJulayi 6, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwale pandemic ezizweni ezithintekile nasezizweni ezintsha njengokungamukeleki futhi okungaphathwa. Ngempela, naphezu kwalokhu, iphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngale gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasesifundazweni, sikhathazekile ngempilo yokushona okukhona kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). Le gciwane ikakhulu ithinta abantu abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-10 no-29 - iningi labo bangabafundi noma baphakathi kwezemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO icele ukuthi izizwe ezifanele zigxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wale mpilo emiphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Le mpilo idluliselwa ngeziphuzo zokuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ehlanza, uphunga lezi ziphuzo abakhishile noma ezisemoyeni. Noma ngabe ukwi-ndawo evaliwe, ungaphunga umoya lapho ungathinteka khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onama-symptoms alula noma abukhali kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule ibhange eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokunconywa udokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka ebhange locwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwenzeka okwamanje emkhakheni wezempilo yangasese, kodwa akukona okudingwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe amacala abekwe phansi ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliswa kolwazi (protocol) ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni kokuphola uma lo muthi usebenza futhi kungavimbela labo abangakwazi ukusindisa izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi olukhona emhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekumelaneni nokusabalala kwale mpilo. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kunconywa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi onama-symptoms alula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kunezithombe eziningi zabafundi kanye/noma othisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenza ndawonye nezikhungo zezempilo ukuhlinzeka ngesiqondiso esifanele. Uma unama-symptoms alula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sokuxazulula futhi ukukhiqizwa okukhulu akukwanele - amandla ayashoda e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukubonga isikhathi osithathile sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubekayo ngokubamba iqhaza kwakho ekusabalaliseni ulwazi nasekunciphiseni imiphumela yale mpilo.
Izinkampani Zobuchwepheshe: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinselelo Nezindlela Zokukhula Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidlala indima enkulu emnothweni, ziguqula indlela abantu abaphila, basebenza, futhi baxhumana. Lezi zinkampani, okuhlanganisa ama-startups, izinkampani ezinkulu, kanye nezinkampani eziphakathi, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zifeze izinjongo zazo, zikhulise imikhiqizo, futhi zandise izinsizakalo zazo. Ukuze siqonde kahle izinkampani zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwazo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokukhula ezithathwayo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimboni Zobuchwepheshe Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe ziqala ngokwakhiwa kwemibono ehlukene, ezivame ukuvela kumathuba okukhula emikhakheni ethile. Lokhu kubandakanya izinkampani ezikhiqiza isoftware, eziphatha idatha, kanye nezinkampani ezithuthukisa imishini yokuxhumana. Ukuze ziqonde kahle izidingo zabathengi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinguquko ezithinta imakethe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zinkampani ziye zathola indlela yokuhlangabezana nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zabantu, okuholela ekwandeni kokuthandwa kwazo. Izinselelo Eziyinselelo Noma zikhona izinzuzo eziningi zokusebenza embonini yobuchwepheshe, izinkampani zibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ubhujiswa obukhulu bokuncintisana buveza inselelo enkulu, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukuba nokuqonda okujulile kwemakethe ukuze zikwazi ukuheha amakhasimende. Okwesibili, izinkampani zidinga ukuphendula ngokushesha ezinguqukweni zobuchwepheshe, okungaholela ekutheni kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihamba phambili. Izinkampani ezisebenza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe zidinga ukuqonda izinguquko ezimakethe, njengezinguquko eziphathelene nemithetho yokuvikela idatha kanye nezinqubomgomo zokuphepha. Izindlela Zokukhula Ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidinga ukuthuthukisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokukhula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye abahlinzeki, ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihlukahlukene, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokumaketha eziphumelelayo. Ukuze zikhulise imikhiqizo zazo, izinkampani zingasebenzisa izindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenza kahle, njengezikhangiso ezikwi-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana. Ukubambisana nabathengi kuyadingeka, njengoba lokhu kuqinisa ukwethembeka nokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka buhamba phambili, futhi izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidinga ukuvuma lezi zinguquko ukuze zihlale zikhona. Ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili, izinkampani zidinga ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphakeme, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa, kanye nezixazululo ze-blockchain. Lezi zindlela zikhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zingazithuthukisa kanjani izinsizakalo zazo, zikhulise imikhiqizo, futhi zandise umkhiqizo. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha kungavula amathuba amasha okukhula, okwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi abasha. Isiphetho Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, futhi zihlala zibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukuze zikhule futhi ziqhubeke nokuphumelela, zidinga ukwakha izindlela eziphumelelayo zokukhula, zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha, futhi ziqonde kahle izidingo zabathengi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zinkampani zizoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, ziguqule indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi zandise amathuba okukhula emnothweni. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zizoba yizikhali ezinamandla zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Imikhawulo ekubonakaliseni nasekuqeqesheni izilwane ezisetshenziswa emisebenzini nasezinja ezisetshenziswa ekuhloleni. Isigaba 1 soMthetho Inombolo 7 ka-1991 sishintsha isigaba 1. Umphakathi ungakhupha ilayisense yokubonakaliswa nasekuqeqesheni izilwane ezibandakanyekayo ezisebenzini noma ukusebenzisa izinja ekuhloleni. - Noma ubani ofuna ukubonakalisa noma ukuqeqesha isilwane ukuze sibe nombukiso, noma ukusebenzisa inja ekuhloleni, angafaka isicelo ngokubhala usebenzisa le fomethi ebekiwe kumagistrate wesifunda lapho lowo muntu ehlala khona, edlala, noma enza ibhizinisi, efuna ilayisense yokwenza kanjalo, futhi umagistrate uzokhipha ilayisense. c Umagistrate angakwenqaba ukuvuselela isicelo seleyisense uma kungekho isizathu esihle nesifanele; futhi d Umphathiswa, ngokukhupha imithetho, angakhetha ifomethi ezosetshenziswa ukufaka isicelo seleyisense, imiqathango ehambisana nale layisense, nemali ekhokhwayo yeleyisense noma yokuvuselela. Isitifiketi esibhekiswe esigabeni 1 sizokhishwa ngumagistrate usebenzisa ifomethi ebekiwe ngemuva kokuba umnikazi weleyisense ethumele ulwazi kubo. Isitifiketi sizonikeza incazelo yokuthi ukuqeqeshwa, ukubonakaliswa, nokusetshenziswa kwezilwane noma izilwane ezihlanganiswe nesitifiketi kuzokwenziwa kanjani. Ukuvinjwa kwamaphoyisa. - Noma ubani ovimbela, ubambe, noma ngokuhlosiwe uphazamise umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo noma ekusebenziseni amandla anikezwe kubo lapha noma afihla isilwane ngenhloso yokuphazamisa ukusetshenziswa kwalawo mandla, noma ophazamisa noma uphazamisa ukusetshenziswa kwalawo mandla uzobe enecala futhi uma etholelwa icala uzokweleta imali engaphansi kuka-R4000 noma ukuvalelwa isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili ngaphezu kwanoma iyiphi enye inhlawulo ebekwe ngenxa yokwephula lo Mthetho noma imithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. kanye nokuphathwa kahle kwezinhloso nezinhlelo zalo Mthetho jikelele. Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS Ngomoya ophakeme, umphakathi wethu ubona ithuba elikhulu lokwakha nokuqonda izinsiza ezitholakala ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nhlangano ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo ezithuthukile kubasebenzi boHulumeni. Ubulungu be-GEMS buhlinzeka ngezidingo eziphathelene nezokwelapha, ukuxhaswa kwezezimali, kanye nokubhekana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubulungu be-GEMS buhlanganisa iminyaka ethile yezezimali, lapho kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezindleko nezikhuthazo ezithile. Iminikelo ehambisana nobulungu ibonisa indlela esithola ngayo izinsiza nezinsizakusebenza, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezempilo nesikhuthazo semisebenzi ebalulekile. Iminikelo yobulungu be-GEMS ibhekelela izinsizakalo zezeMpilo, ezikhokhiswe ngezinyanga ezahlukene. Ukuze uthole ubulungu, abakwa-GEMS badinga iminikelo ethile, okuyizinkokhelo ezisemqoka ezihlinzekwayo ngababambiqhaza. Lezi zinkokhelo zingase zishintshe ngokwemigomo yokusebenza, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amapulani ahlukahlukene angavumelana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye. Abahlinzeki bezempilo abavela ku-GEMS banikezela ngezinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezifo ezithile nezinyathelo zokuphepha. I-GEMS ibhekelele ukufaka izimali emsebenzini wezempilo, iqinisekisa ukuthi abanye bethu bangathola usizo oludingekayo ngaphandle kwezindleko ezinkulu. Ukuze kudalwe umbono ocacile mayelana nezinkokhelo, kubalulekile ukuthi ababhalisile balandele izinyathelo ezifanele zokukhumbuza, ukuze bazi kahle izinsizakalo abazitholayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuzibhala phansi izinkokhelo ezibekwe, izinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo, nezixhaso ezenziwa yi-GEMS. Lezi zinyathelo zifanele ukusiza bonke abahlanganyeli ukuqonda obala izinzuzo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Abakulayo baqonda kahle ukuthi iminikelo nezinkokhelo zombili zinendima enkulu ekuphileni kwabantu. Lokhu akugcinanga kuphela ezinsizeni, kodwa futhi kuthinta umoya wezimali nokuphumelela kwansuku zonke. Izisebenzi zempilo zidinga ukubonwa, kanti ukugqugquzela lesi sikhungo kubalulekile. Ukubona impendulo ethile kumele kube umgomo wakudala, ngenkathi sigqugquzela abanye ukuba babe nesithakazelo ekuthandeni ukulandela lesi simiso. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi konke lokhu kuxhumene nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. I-GEMS akukhona kuphela ukuhlomula kwemali, kodwa ibalulekile kumphakathi wonke. Ubuhlakani obuyisisekelo buncike kulokhu: umphakathi unikwa imiphumela efanele, futhi ukuxhaswa kwezempilo akufanele kube into kuphela yekhwalithi, kodwa kube umphakathi ophilayo. Ukuthathwa kwegama le-GEMS kudinga ukuqondiswa ngezindlela ezithile. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezitholakala, futhi okukhona okwamanje kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sizihlanganisa ngezindlela ezikhethekile. Siyavuma ukuthi isimo somnotho sishintsha, kodwa ikakhulukazi kunenkohlakalo ebukeka ngendlela ezinzile. Lokhu kuthinta ukuhlinzekwa kokwelashwa, okuvimbela ukusaiwa kwempilo. Cabanga ngokuthi i-GEMS ingase ibalazwe izinsizakalo zomphakathi eziwujuqu, ibhekelele izidingo ezihlukahlukene ezikhuluma ngemvelaphi yempilo ezitholakalayo. Ekupheleni, siveza imishanguzo eyenzelwe ukusiza umphakathi uqonde izinzuzo nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Abagibeli bethu bazoba nenhlonipho yokubhekisela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakalayo, bephinde babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi oqinile. Kulezi zinyanga ezizayo, sizobona izinzuzo zalesi simiso, futhi sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza. Ngokuhlanganyela, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sifaka imithombo yokuxhumana phakathi kwethu, ukuze sithole izisombululo ezingcono nezindlela eziphumelelayo. Ukubumbana nokuhlala sinolwazi ngempumelelo ye-GEMS kuyakwenza ukuthi sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo nezinsiza eziqhubekayo. Sigubha amaphuzu afanele namathuba okwakha umphakathi we-GEMS kube yiphupho langempela.
Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain Ngomhlaka Msombuluko, umphakathi ubhekene nokwaziswa okujabulisayo njengoba uhulumeni ethumele isiphakamiso esisha sokwandisa uhlelo lwe-Gautrain, oluhamba phambili eGauteng. Le ngxoxo ikhombisa ithuba lokwabelana ngemibono ezosiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono lokuhamba ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe. Isiphakamiso sihlose ukwandisa umgqa we-Gautrain ukuze ufinyelele ezindaweni eziningi, kuhlanganise neMamelodi, Tembisa, noSoweto. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngezindlela zokuhamba eziphusile, kuholele ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, futhi kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain, olwakhiwa ngonyaka ka-2010, luphumelele ekuthuthukiseni indlela yokuhamba kwabantu, kodwa kudinga njalo ukuba kubhekwane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabahlali. Lokhu kuveza izinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezivela kubadlali abahlukene, abathi, "U-Gautrain uveza izinketho eziningi, kodwa udinga ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude.” Umphakathi uphakamisa imihlangano yokuxoxisana, lapho kuxoxwa khona ngezinkinga ekutholeni izinsiza zokuhamba. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba izwi labantu liwulalela, uhulumeni ukhombisa ukuzimisela ekwakheni ibhodi labantu ukuze babambisane ekwenzeni lesi siphakamiso sibe yimpumelelo. Ulimi olukhuluma ngalesi siphakamiso luthinta izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, izindawo zokupaka, kanye nolwazi olubalulekile kubahlali. Lokhu kuzojoliswa ekwakheni izindawo ezithuthukisiwe ezizodala umphakathi omusha, lapho abahamba ngezitimela bezoba nezinsiza ezithokozisayo. Ukukhathazeka ngodlame lwezokuthutha kuqhubeka nokukhathaza izakhamizi eziningi. Ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele kuyakhathaza, kodwa abantu baphikelela ekuphakamiseni uhlu lwezindlela zokuhamba ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela. Lo mphenyi ubonisa ubukhona obukhulu bezokuthutha, ekhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwemigwaqo nezinye izindlela zokuhamba. "Ngaphandle kokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, sizobe silahlekile — isidingo sokuthutha sikhombisa ubuchwepheshe bemfundo nabangasebenzisi, ungalindela.” Njengoba umphakathi uphakamisa lo mbono omusha, kubalulekile ukukhipha ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ukuhamba phakathi ezindaweni ezikude kuzoba lula, futhi izithuthi ezikhona zizothuthukiswa ukuze zifinyeleleke kalula. Izithuthi zikhona, kodwa abantu abahamba ngezinyawo badinga izinsiza eziphusile. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba elihle lokukhombisa uhulumeni izindleko eziphusile zokuhamba, okulungiswa kuzo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha imihlangano nezikhungo zokuthuthukisa ezokuthutha zikhombisa ukubaluleka kokusebenza ndawonye. Uhlaka lwezimali luzongenisa izinkampani eziningi, ngakho kuhilelekile abantu abaningi abakhuluma ngebhodi, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukuqina kwezomnotho, njengoba kuzokwehlisa izindleko zokuhamba kubantu abaphakathi komnotho ophansi. Njengoba izidingo zomphakathi zikhula, izindlela zokuhamba zizoqhubeka zithuthuka. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imboni yezokuthutha, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi uma i-Gautrain iqhubeka nokwandiswa, kuzoba nezinto ezikhuthazayo ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba komphakathi. Umnikelo wobuqotho udinga ukusheshe, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqinisa izinsiza zokuhamba. Izindlala zomphakathi zikhona, kodwa imizamo kufanele ibe nezimpumelelo. Ukuze kube nokukhanga kwemali nokuxhaswa okuhle, kudinga imizamo emikhulu. Ngokuxhumana nezinye izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezimali, umphakathi ungakhuluma ngalesi siphakamiso, uhamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ohlanzekile, noguquko. Abalaleli basamukela lezi zinhlelo, bejolisa ekuvuseleleni emithonjeni emisha, ukuchuma, nokuqhubekela phambili. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabahlali kuyisiqalo esihle sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain, uma lwandiswa, luzoba yinzuzo enkulu esikhathini esizayo. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, iziphakamiso zamuva zizosiza ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo, ukuze bonke abathintekayo bazuze. Ngokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, umhlaba uzoba yindawo ewusizo nolondekile. Ukungena emishinini yokuhamba kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila, izinkampani zikhuthaza abantu, futhi umphakathi ujabulele izinzuzo zokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain lukhombisa ikusasa elikhanyayo, futhi uma abantu bejolisa ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizophumelela, umkhankaso wethu uzothola impendulo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umnotho ube namandla, kube nezinsiza eziza namathuba amasha kubo bonke abahlali baseGauteng. Uhlelo lwe-Gautrain luzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo nekusasa elizwakalayo.
Umhlahlandlela onenzuzo ukusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okuzokugcina uqine ngenkathi ugula. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kubalulekile kubo bonke, kodwa uma unegciwane elithile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukukhetha izinhlobo zokudla ngokuhlakanipha! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukudla okuletha emzimbeni wakho zonke izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze usebenze kahle futhi kusiza ukuvusa izifo. Izakhi ziyizinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezakhi ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi ama-protein, ama-carbohydrate, amafutha, ama-vitamini, kanye nezinsimbi. Uma unegciwane elingapheli (njengokuphefumula, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), uhlelo lwakho lokuzivikela luba buthaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho awukwazi ukuvikela kahle ngokuphumelelayo ezifo njengoba wawenza ngaphambili. Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluphukile lungaholela ezifo emlonyeni, emaphashini, nasezithweni. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzokunika umzimba wakho izakhi eziqinisa uhlelo lokuzivikela ukuze luphumelele ezifo, kukunike umuzwa wokuba nempilo; futhi kukusize ujabulele impilo engcono. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzokusiza ukuvusa izifo futhi kukuvumele ukuthi uphumelele kangcono uma unegciwane. Izifo ezifana nokuphefumula, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV ngokuvamile zikhokelela emzimbeni ongenamafutha. Ukudla okungafanele kahle kuholela ekutheni uhlelo lokuzivikela lomzimba luphuke, okwenza kube lula ezifo ukuhlasela. Lapho umuntu ehlaselwe yi-HIV, ukudla okungafanele kahle kungaholela ngokushesha kwi-AIDS. Kukhona izinhlobo eziningi zokudla okunempilo ongakhetha kuzo. Umzimba wakho udinga izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla. Akukho ukudla okukodwa okuqukethe zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Khetha futhi ujabulele ukudla okulula ukuthola, okungathengwa futhi okuthandayo. Qaphela kakhulu lokho okudlayo uma usuwazi ukuthi unegciwane elithile. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuvusa izifo futhi kuvikele ukulahleka kwesisindo. Ukuze uthole konke okudingayo ekudleni kwakho, dlala izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ongazithola. Ukudla izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho ekudleni kwakho. Uma uthola kunzima ukudla okuningi, zama ukudla izinkanyezi ezincane ngezikhathi eziningi ngosuku ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele. Ukudla okune-starch njengebhread, amaphilisi, ama-cereal, irayisi, amaphilisi amnandi, ufulawa, kanye ne-pasta kufanele kube ingxenye enkulu yanoma iyiphi imenyu. Ukudla okune-starch kunikeza umzimba amandla nezinye izakhi ukuze usebenze kahle. Faka noma yimiphi eminye imikhiqizo efana nezitshalo, amabhontshisi, inkukhu, noma amaqanda ekudleni okune-starch ukuze wenze ukudla okunambitheka kahle. Ukudla esikuthola ezilwaneni kunikeza emzimbeni wethu izakhi eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Omunye wabo ngu-protein, osiza ukuqinisa uhlelo lwakho lokuzivikela nokwakha izicubu eziqinile. Uma ugula, udinga kakhulu lokhu kudla. Ushukela namafutha nawo ayingxenye yokudla okunempilo. Anika amandla engeziwe ukuze ubhekane nezifo futhi enze ukudla kube mnandi. Sonke kufanele sizame ukusebenzisa usawoti omncane, njengoba usawoti omningi ungaholela ekucindezelweni kwegazi. Nokho, uma unokuhlanza noma uphumelele, ulahlekelwa usawoti nomoya omningi. Ukuphuza amanzi kubalulekile kithi sonke. Phuza amanzi amaningi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubuyisela amanzi alahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhlanza, ukuhamba, noma ukuvuka ebusuku. Amanzi aphuma emthonjeni, emfuleni, noma emgqonyeni kufanele aphekiwe ngaphambi kokuwaphuza. Ungaphuzi noma yiziphi iziphuzo ezine-alcohol. Iziphuzo ezine-alcohol ziwubhubhane emathunjini futhi zenza umzimba ulahlekelwe ama-vitamini avikela emizameni ezifo. Kubalulekile futhi ukungaphuzi i-alcohol ngenkathi uthatha imishanguzo ngoba kungalimaza umthambo wakho. Hlala usebenza kakhulu ukuze ugcine izicubu zakho ziqinile. Ukuhamba umzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukuhlanza indlu, nokulima, kuzothuthukisa umuzwa wakho wokuba nempilo. Ngaso sonke isikhathi geza izandla zakho ngensipho ngaphambi nangemva kokuphatha ukudla. Hlanza zonke izinsiza nezindawo lapho ulungiselela khona ukudla. Faka ukudla ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuthi kuthintwe yizinyoni nezilwane. Bheka usuku "lokusebenzisa" ezimpahleni ozithengayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awuthengi ukudla okudlulelwe usuku lokuphelelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi awudli inyama eluhlaza, inkukhu, inhlanzi, noma amaqanda. Pheka ukudla kahle ukuze ubulale amagciwane. Uma unomshini opholile, gcina ukudla okusele emshinini opholile noma ugcine kuvalwe endaweni epholile. Ukudla okuphekiwe akufanele kugcinwe ngaphezu kosuku olulodwa futhi kufanele kuphumelelwe ngaphambi kokudliwa. Gcina ukudla endaweni epholile kakhulu. Zama ukungavumeli ukudla okuphekiwe ukuthi kube ngaphandle kokupholiswa ngaphezu kwamahora amabili. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuhle kubo bonke! Uma ugula, kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukubuyisela ngokushesha ezifo kusiza izilonda zisheshe ziphole. Ukuphatha kahle nokusebenzisa imishanguzo nokwelashwa.
Izingxoxo zePhalamende ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time Izingxoxo zePhalamende zidlala indima ebalulekile ekubhekaneni nezindaba zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time, lapho uMongameli ephendula khona imibuzo ethunyelwa ngamalungu ePhalamende. Lezi zingxoxo zikhombisa indlela uHulumeni obhekana ngayo nezinkinga ezithinta isizwe, futhi ziwuphawu lwezinkolelo zamasiko okuphathwa kwezindaba zomphakathi. Isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time siba nenhloso yokugcina uMongameli ephendula imibuzo edingekayo, okuyindlela yokubika nokubuyekeza izinqubomgomo. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokubuyisela ukubonisana phakathi kukaMongameli, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye nomphakathi. Izingxoxo ezibanjwa kuleli sikhathi zikhuthaza ukuvulwa kwemibono, nokwenza kube lula ukuhlola izinqumo ezithathwayo uHulumeni. Ngokwesiko, isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time siba nomthelela omkhulu ezinqubweni zokwenza izinqumo. Amangcwethi abona lezi zingxoxo njengendlela yokwakha ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, amalungu ePhalamende, abamele izifunda ezahlukene, babeka izinkinga ezikhathaza izakhamuzi zabo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo esifanele. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zingxoxo ziqala kanjani. Izinsuku ezibekiwe ziba yisikhathi sokuphendula imibuzo, lapho amalungu ePhalamende ethumele khona imibuzo ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi uMongameli kumele aphendule ngalesi sikhathi esinqunyiweyo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuphendula imibuzo yokubaluleka, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ePhalamende ahlola izinqubomgomo ezithile, ukuhlola ukusebenza kukahulumeni. Ukwenza lezi zingxoxo zibe nomthelela, kubalulekile ukuthi uMongameli abe neziqu ezithe xaxa kumkhankaso wakhe. Lokhu kudinga ukuba ahlaziye kahle izinkinga ezitholakala emibuzweni, akhombise ubuhlakani, futhi aphendule ngendlela eqondile. Ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kukaMongameli namaqembu aphikisayo buvame ukuvumela ukuthi kube nezixazululo eziphumelelayo ezitholakala. Naphezu kwalezi zinhlelo, isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time sinezinkinga ezithile. Kwezinye izikhathi, imibuzo ivame ukuhunyushwa ngendlela yokuphikisana, okungaholela ekwakhekeni kwezimo zokungqubuzana phakathi kukaMongameli namalungu ePhalamende. Lokhu kuzwakala kakhulu uma izinkinga ezithile ziqhathaniswa nemiphumela ethile yokuphatha uHulumeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time kudinga ukuthi kudaleke umoya ophilayo phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuba amalungu ePhalamende azise ukuthi izinkinga eziphakanyisiwe zidinga ukwakhiwa kwempendulo esebenzayo, hhayi kuphela ukusiza izakhamuzi kodwa futhi nokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kukaHulumeni nomphakathi. Ngokubuka esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezithathwayo zihlale ziqinile futhi ziqinisa isithunzi sePhalamende. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinkampani zomphakathi, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezikhungo zempilo zidinga ukuba zisebenzisane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zenzeka ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time, iziphakamiso ezithile kufanele zihlolwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziqhuba izinqubomgomo ezizuzisayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda umthelela wezobuchwepheshe kulezi zingxoxo. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe kuholele ekushintsheni indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo, okwenza kube lula ukuveza imibono, iziphakamiso nezinkinga emphakathini. Izingxoxo ezibanjwa ngesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time zingase zisebenzise lezi zinsiza ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano phakathi kukaMongameli, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ngokuphetha, isikhathi se-Presidential Question Time singumcibisholo wokubambisana phakathi kukaMongameli, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye nomphakathi. Lezi zingxoxo zikhombisa ukuthi uHulumeni ubhekephi futhi zidinga ukuba zihlonishwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zihlala zisebenziseka. Ukuthuthukiswa kokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene zomphakathi kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu emiphumeleni yesikhathi se-Presidential Question Time. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwesizinda esiqinile sokuphatha, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezinqubweni zomphakathi.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sepaspoti yokuvakasha luyidokhumenti edingekayo uma uvakashela kwelinye izwe noma ubuya eNingizimu Afrika. Ipasipoti yokuvakasha inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 nangaphezulu. Ivalidi ukuhamba kuwo wonke amazwe ngaphandle uma kukhona imibhalo ethile ekhombisa ukungavunyelwa. Ivalidi iminyaka eyishumi kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa. Kufanele ube ne-ID noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa ukuze ufake isicelo. Izicelo ze-paspoti yokuvakasha ne-ID zingafakwa ngesikhathi esisodwa ne-paspoti yokuvakasha uma ungakwazi ukulinda. Qedela ifomu le-BI-73 bese ulithumela mathupha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Lethwa kwi-Embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emsebenzini uma ufaka isicelo ngaphandle kwelizwe. Izithombe zakho zeminwe zizothathwa ukuze kubhaliswe ulwazi lwakho kuM register wePopulashini. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-paspoti. Ipasipoti ingakhishwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha.
Izindaba Zomphakathi: Uthando Lokubambisana Luthembisa Ukukhula Kwezakhamizi eMgungundlovu UMgungundlovu – Esifundazweni saseKwaZulu-Natal, umphakathi ubambisene ukuze udale izindlela ezinzima zokuxazulula izinkinga ezahlukene ezibhekene nalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kuhlangana kwemiphakathi kwakhula kwazalwa izinhlelo eziningi zentuthuko ezenzakalayo, okukhuluma khona ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Uhlelo lomphakathi, olwaqanjwa ngokuthi "Siyavuma", lwasungulwa ezinyangeni ezimbalwa ezedlule. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi lwahlomula ezinhlelweni ezibandakanya imfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezokuthengisa. Izithakazelo ezicacile zikaHulumeni, ezakhamizini, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele ziye zashumeka nemigomo ethile yokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. UJohnson Mthembu, usomabhizinisi ophumelelayo endimeni yokwentengiselwano, ukhuluma ngezizathu zokungena kulolu hlelo. Uthi: “Ngizizwe ngishaywa ngento yokubambisana. Nakhu ukuthi, uma sibambene singenza izinto ezinkulu. Abantu bethu badinga izindlela zokuphila ezbetter. Ngimnene ngifuna ukusiza umphakathi. Impilo iyashintsha uma sikhulumisana.” Uhlelo lwe-Siyavuma luhlobene nokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abakufinyelela, okuhlanganisa nohlelo lokufundisa abesifazane ngezinhlelo zokuphila, ezokusebenza, nezokuthengisa. Izifundo zifinyelela kubantu abaningi, futhi zikhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane avela ngaphakathi komphakathi. Abesifazane abaninzi baveze ukuthi sebevele benza imisebenzi yezenhlalakahle, ekhombisa impumelelo enkulu phakathi kwezithakazelo ezilindelekile. Ngokuhlanganyela, abesifazane kanye nabesilisa bahlanganisa imizamo yokugcina izinga lemfundo liphezulu, lapho abantu behlanganyela ezicathulweni zamakilasi asekhaya. KwaMhlekazi Primary School, othisha bahlonishwa ngeqhaza labo elikhulu ekwandiseni ukufunda kwabantu abasha. Uthishanhloko, uNksz. Ndlovu, uthi: “Siyabona izinga lempumelelo labafundi lishintshile. Impumelelo yethu ayidingi ukunganqikiwe.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lwenhlalakahle luhlanganisa izinsiza zabantu abahlelekile, njengokusiqinisekisa nokwazisa ngempilo. Abahlali bahlonishwa ngemizamo yabo yokuphakamisa abantu abahlangeneyo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zezempilo, kanye nokufundiswa okuthumelelayo ngomphakathi. Uhlelo lwezempilo oluzenzakalayo luthuthukisa ukuphila kwabantu abaningi, futhi luthumele izikhumbuzo ezinhle zokuthi umphakathi kumele uhambisane. Nokho, akukhona kuphela ukuhamba phambili kwezinyathelo zentuthuko. Umphakathi ubhekana nezinselelo ezithile, njengezinkinga zezokuthutha nezinsiza ezikhulayo. Ukuze baqhubeke bephumelela, umphakathi uhlele izinhlelo zokuhlela imisebenzi eqondile yokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokuthutha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubambisana nezinkampani zezokuthutha, okuthuthukisa ukuhamba kwabantu, nezimpahla zokubiza izimpahla ezithandwayo. Ukwakhiwa kwemibondela eqinile phakathi kwezizinda zomphakathi kudinga ukuthi abantu babambisane, futhi benze izinqumo ezibhekelela ikusasa. Ukuhlomula kwempumelelo kudinga ukunakekela, ukwazisa, nokuthuthukisa izindlela ezahlukene zokukhula. Abantu bahlazile ukuthi ukuphumelela kokuqala kuhlangana nokubambisana. Njengoba uhulumeni, ezikhungweni, kanye nabantu bezinsiza bezama ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihlukene, imiphakathi ifuna ukuphinde ibonakale ibe namandla. Uthando lokuhlanganyela, kanti ukuxoxisana kwezinto ezahlukene kudinga ukusizakala njalo. Impilo enempumelelo isekelwe kwakukhanya okukhulu kwezindlela ezixhumene ndawonye. Uma kudingeka ukwaziswa ngokwandisa izinsiza, izimanga ziyaziwa. I-Siyavuma igxile ngendlela elula yokuphila, ibonisa ukuthi uma umphakathi ubambisene, izinkinga ezingokwenhlalakahle zingaxazululwa kalula. Ngamafuphi, izindaba zomphakathi zikhuluma ngempumelelo, ubumbano, kanye nokukhula. Uhlelo lwe-Siyavuma lukhombisa indlela yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kukhombisa ukuthi uthando lomphakathi lungabuthaka abantu, kuphumelele impilo yezakhamizi. Njengoba sigubha lo msebenzi wobumbano, kuthiwe kulindeleke ukusebenza okwengeziwe nezindlela ezintsha zokuxhasa, ukuze kuhlale kuhamba phambili ukusebenza nakho. Okwamanje, umphakathi ubhalisela ukuba ngosuku olulandelayo, uqhubeke ubonisa indlela yokuphumelela eyeqisayo. Uthando lokubambisana luhlala lukhula, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukukwazi ukwakha ukuxhumana okujulile emiphakathini. Lo mkhankaso ubonisa ukuthi asishiyi muntu ngemuva, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ziqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi wakwaMlaba uhlala uphila omuhle.
Ezokumbiwa Kwezinsiza: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimpikiswano Nezimo Zamanje Ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza, okuyinqubo yokukhishwa kwezinsiza zemvelo ukuze zisetshenziswe ezimbonini, zibalulekile emnothweni wezwe. Le nqubo ihlanganisa ukutholwa, ukukhipha, nokucubungula izinsiza ezifana namafutha, amalahle, izinsimbi, namaminerali. Nokho, lezi zinsiza zitholakala ezindaweni ezithile, futhi ukumbiwa kwazo kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa imali, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nqubo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zenza kube nokutholakala kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithuthukayo lapho umnotho uvame ukuba nezinselelo. Isibonelo, izimayini ezikhiqiza amalahle ziqhakambisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezisemakhaya, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zenza kube nokutholakala kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono kubantu bendawo. Nokho, lezi zinzuzo zihlala zifaniswa nezingozi ezinkulu. Ukumbiwa kwezinsiza kuvame ukuholela ekonakaleni kwemvelo, okubandakanya ukungcoliswa komoya, amanzi, nomhlaba. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane, ukwehla kwezinhlobo ezithile, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezithintekayo zingabhekana nezinkinga zokuhlala, njengoba abantu behlupheka ngenxa yokungcoliswa, okuholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Futhi, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhombisa izinkinga zokuphatha kahle izinsiza. Izinkampani ezinkulu zihlala zikhathazekile ngenzuzo, okungaholela ekutheni zinganaki imithetho yokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kudala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nezakhamuzi, lapho izakhamuzi zifuna ukuvikela imvelo, kanti izinkampani zifuna ukwandisa inzuzo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxoxisana okuqhubekayo ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezithuthukisa umnotho ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Ukwengeza, izokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhombisa izinkinga zokulingana. Izinsiza zemvelo zitholakala ezindaweni ezithile, okudala ukungalingani phakathi kwezizwe. Izizwe ezithuthukayo, ezivame ukuba nezinsiza eziningi, zithola izinzuzo, kanti ezithuthukayo zihlala zihlupheka. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze aphile kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ezibandakanyekayo ziqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuphatha kahle imvelo, okuholela ekusebenziseni ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise umthelela ongemuhle. Ziqala futhi ukusebenzisana nezakhamuzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokumbiwa kwezinsiza zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngokuphetha, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zidlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, kodwa zidinga ukuphathwa kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Ukuze kube nokuthula phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nezakhamuzi, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxoxisana okuqhubekayo, okuzokwenza kube nokutholakala kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono kubantu, ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Ukubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zisebenza ngendlela efanele, zikhuthaza umnotho, futhi zivikela imvelo.
Umfuyi ovela eFouriesburg uphumelele, ungumkhiqizi ophawulekayo! Umfuyi ophumelele emncintiswaneni yeGrain SA Farmer of the Year ubikwe eThe Theatre on the Track eKyalami, ngo-Okthoba 9, 2009. UShimi Makoka ovela eVanderbijlpark, eGauteng. Umkhiqizi Ovela KwiGrain Osemusha Wonyaka ophumelele kulo nyaka nguSamuel Moloi ovela eFouriesburg eNyakatho Nentshonalanga. Sifuna ukusho "Hooray!" kuSamuel nakubanye bonke abaphakanyisiwe.

Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwezinselelo Ezimfundisweni eziningi, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kube yinkinga esikhathini eside. Izinkanyezi zempilo zikhombisa ukuthi izingane zihlala zihluphekile, zishaywa, noma zihlukunyezwa. Lokhu akukhona nje ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa kuyinkinga ebanzi ethinta izindawo eziningi emhlabeni. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akugcini ngokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, kodwa kuhlanganisa futhi ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomoya, ngokwengqondo, nangokwezimali. Isahluko 2: Izizathu Zokuhlukunyezwa Izizathu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihluke kakhulu. Ezinye zazo zifaka ubunzima bezomnotho, izinkinga zempilo, kanye nezinkinga zomndeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkolelo zamasiko nezinkolo zineqhaza elikhulu ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa. Ezinye izindawo zikholelwa ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyindlela yokufundisa, kanti abanye bacabanga ukuthi izingane kufanele zibe nezibopho ezinzima ukuze zifunde. Isahluko 3: Izimpawu Zokuhlukunyezwa Izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihluke kakhulu, futhi zidinga ukuba zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zikhombisa izimpawu ezifana nokukhathazeka, ukungabi nendaba, noma ukungathandi ukuhamba nabantu. Ezinye zikhombisa izimpawu zomzimba, njengezibazi noma izilonda, kanti ezinye zikhombisa izimpawu zokuhlukumezeka ngokomoya, njengezinkinga zengqondo. Ukuqaphela lezi zimpawu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola usizo oludingekayo. Isahluko 4: Umthelela Wokuhlukunyezwa Umthelela wokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ungaba mkhulu. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo ziba nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni yazo, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo, ukungabi nempilo, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana nabanye. Umthelela ungadlulela ezizukulwaneni, njengoba izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zingaba nabazali abahlukunyezayo, okuholela kumjikelezo ongenamkhawulo. Isahluko 5: Ukulwa Nokuhlukunyezwa Kubuhlungu umphakathi ukuba uqonde ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akwamukelekile. Ukuze silwe nalolu daba, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu mayelana nezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubazali, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo kumele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola usizo oludingekayo. Isahluko 6: Izinyathelo Zokugcina Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokukhuluma ngale nkinga. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kudingeka sibe nezingxoxo ezivulekile, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baveze izinkinga zabo, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Izingane zidinga ukuba zizwe ziphephile, zikhululekile, futhi zihlale zikhuluma ngezinto ezibakhathazayo. Isahluko 7: Isiphetho Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyinkinga enkulu, futhi kudinga ukuba sibe nomqondo ophusile. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokuvikela izingane zethu, sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, sizoba nesikhathi esinzima sokulwa nale nkinga. Izingane zethu zifanele ukuphila impilo enempilo, enothando, futhi ephephile. Ngakho-ke, masisebenze ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lezingane zethu, sikhuthaze uthando, nokuhlonipha.
Izilimi Nezinguqulo: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezakhamuzi Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi wethu ubuhlanganyela emcimbini omkhulu obubanjelwe eNyuvesi yaseMphumalanga, ogxile ezilimini nasezinguqulweni. Lo mcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa, ukufundisana, nokwabelana ngolwazi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, bejolise ekubalulekeni kwezilimi ezahlukene emhlabeni wanamuhla. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile eyethulwe nguMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumfundisi wezilimi, owakhuluma ngendaba yokuthi izilimi ziwumgogodla wezokuxhumana. Uthe, "Izilimi azigcini nje ngokuba izindlela zokukhuluma, kodwa ziwumlando, isiko, kanye nezindlela zokucabanga." Le nkulumo yakhuthaza abahlanganyeli ukuba bacabange kabanzi ngendima yezilimi empilweni yabo nasemphakathini. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba neseshini yokwabelana ngolwazi, lapho abahlanganyeli baphendula imibuzo ethokozisayo mayelana nezinguqulo. Abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abahumushi, ababhali, nabafundi, babelana ngemicabango yabo mayelana nezinkinga ezihambisana nezinguqulo. U-Prof. Zanele Nkosi, ongumhumushi ophumelelayo, wabelane ngolwazi lwakhe mayelana nezithiyo ezivame ukubhekana nazo, njengokungaqondi kahle izincazelo noma ukungahambisani kwezinkulumo. Emva kwalokho, kwaba nesikhathi sokuxoxa, lapho abahlanganyeli bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene zokuthi kungani izinguqulo zibalulekile. U-Dr. Sipho Dlamini, ongumcwaningi wezilimi, waphakamisa ukuthi izinguqulo zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bexhumene, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni ophithizelayo. "Uma singakwazi ukuhumusha imicabango nemizwa yethu, sithola ithuba lokuxhumana, lokuhloniphana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile," kusho yena. Ngemuva kokuxoxa, kwaba nesikhathi sokubuka izibonelo ezithile zokuhumusha. Abahlanganyeli babekwazi ukubona izinguqulo ezithile ezithathwe ezincwadini ezidumile, futhi bakhuthazwa ukuba baphendule imibuzo ethile mayelana nezinguqulo ezithile. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokuhumusha, nokuthi izinguqulo zingaba kanjani nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda phakathi kwezizwe. Umcimbi uphothulwe ngenkulumo yokugcina kaNkk. Lindiwe Khumalo, ongumqondisi wezokuxhumana, owakhuthaza abahlanganyeli ukuba baqhubeke nokuxhumana nangemva komcimbi. "Siyazi ukuthi izilimi zikhuluma ngezinto eziningi, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi izinguqulo zidinga ubuchule, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi uyamukelwa," kusho yena. Ngokuphetha, lo mcimbi wawuwusizo kakhulu, unikeza ithuba lokuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokuxhumana. Abahlanganyeli baphuma bejabule, bephinde bahlola izindlela zokuhumusha ezihlukahlukene, futhi benethemba lokuthi imicimbi efana nale izoqhubeka, iqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilimi nezizwe. Izilimi nezinguqulo zihlala zibalulekile, futhi umcimbi wethu ubonisile ukuthi umhlaba ungaba ngcono uma sikhuluma, sihunyushwa, futhi sithokozisa izilimi ezahlukene.
Ihhovisi leMibiko yezeMisebenzi, iMeta-information, ngaphansi koMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, iqala futhi ixhasa ngemali ucwaningo ngezinhlelo zeMithombo yeMibiko nezeMisebenzi (LIS) ezingeni lesizwe. Zonke lezi zenzo ziqondiswe ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala ezingeni lesizwe. Ihhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano yolwazi yesizwe liyinhliziyo yoHulumeni wesizwe ophathelene nezinqubomgomo ezithile mayelana nemithombo yeMibiko nezeMisebenzi (LIS) ezingeni lesizwe. Ulwazi lukhuluma ngokuqonda okuhlobene nolwazi. Umbono wehhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano yesizwe uwukwakha nokugcina uhlelo lolwazi oluphumelelayo oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi, luqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo zikhona emiphakathini yeNhlangano yeMibiko, ezokwenza kube nempumelelo ekuthuthukiseni izwe. Umsebenzi walo ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuNgqongqoshe wezobuciko namasiko, Isayensi neTekhnoloji mayelana nokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlela, nokugcina isikhombimsebenzisi somthetho kanye nezinsiza zolwazi ezingeni lesizwe. Lezi zinhlangano zifaka isandla ekwakheni isakhiwo sesizwe seMithombo yeMibiko nezeMisebenzi, esiphinde sasisize nezinye izinhlobo zemithombo yokunikeza ukwesekwa kolwazi emiphakathini yazo. Ihhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano yesizwe lisebenza njengeSsecretariat yeKomidi elisemthethweni lokugcina amarekhodi nolwazi kanye neBhodi yesizwe eyasungulwa ngokusemthethweni yeMithombo yeMibiko nezeMisebenzi. Ihhovisi lolwazi liphinde lilawule ukuhlela kabusha kwekomidi nebhodi.
Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi kuyigama elivunywa emhlabeni jikelele. Yini "ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni"? Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kuyisibopho somthetho sabashicileli bezinhlobo zonke zezincwadi ukufaka inani elithile lamakhophi alokhu kubhaliswa ezindaweni ezithile lapho lezi zincwadi zibhaliswa khona ngokusemthethweni. Izincwadi kumele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ngokwezimali zomshicileli, futhi lokhu kumele kwenziwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 zokushicilelwa. Inhloso yokubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokwenza kube khona ulwazi namagugu amasiko ezwe, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela mahhala kuzo zonke izincwadi ezitholakalayo. Umthetho ophathelene nalokhu wawukhuliswa nguMthetho Wamalungelo Okushicilela ka-1965 kanye noMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni ka-1982, kuze kube umthetho wamanje, uMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni washicilelwa ngo-1997, obandakanya ukufakwa kwezincwadi ze-elektroniki naleyo ebonakalayo. Incwadi iyinto enezinto ezihlosiwe zokugcina noma ukudlulisa umlayezo ngombhalo, isithombe, umsindo, noma iyiphi indlela yokuxhumana enokuqukethwe okucabangayo. Yini okufanele ifakwe? Amakhadi ezimali noma ama-check. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kuzo zonke izincwadi ezishicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisikhumbuzo sezincwadi zonke ezikhiqizwe yizwe. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yemisebenzi yonke eshicilelwe igcinwa futhi itholakala ukuze ibolekwe. Igcina umsebenzi wababhali nabashicileli ukuze usebenze ngocwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo. Ikha umgogodla wokuhlanganisa Umlando Kazwelonke weNingizimu Afrika, okwenza abathengi bayo bazi ngezincwadi ezikhona, ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukiswe ukusabalalisa nokumaketha kwazo. Inombolo yokuxhumana yokusiza itholakala eMnyangweni Wezincwadi weNingizimu Afrika ukuze kucaciswe izinto eziphathelene nokubhaliswa okusemthethweni.
Amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi kanye namancane (SMMEs) adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo eKwaZulu Natal. Uma izimali ezitshalwe emkhakheni we-SMME zihlonyiswe kahle, zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza komnotho wesifunda kanye nezakhamuzi. Nokho, ukufinyelela usizo lwezezimali kumabhizinisi ahlelwe kahle kuyinselelo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izikhungo zezimali zibeka imiqathango eqinile yokuxhaswa kwezimali. Izicelo zokuxhaswa kwezimali zingaphumelela ngoba amaphrojekthi abhekwa njengokuphepha okukhulu noma ngoba izicelo zabo azihlangabezani nezidingo zesikhungo sezezimali. Le nselelo ibhekwa njengokukhuliswa ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinketho zokuxhaswa kulomkhakha. Le bhukwana ihlose ukukhombisa ezinye zezinselelo ezibhekene ne-SMMEs futhi inikeze ulwazi ngezinhlelo ezahlukene nemikhiqizo ethulwa izikhungo zezimali. Ulwazi olukhona kule bhukwana lukhombisa inqubo okufanele ilandelwe uma kufakwa isicelo sokuxhaswa kwezimali kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana yesikhungo sezezimali ngasinye. Sithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzohlinzeka abantu ngelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olungabasiza ekutholeni uxhaso lwezimali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imali eyanele yokwakha ibhizinisi ngendlela efanele kubalulekile empumelelweni yebhizinisi. Abatshalizimali badinga ukuqonda kangcono imithombo ehlukahlukene yokuxhaswa etholakalayo yokwakha ibhizinisi nokuthi yini edingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kuyo. Kukhona imithombo emibili eyinhloko yokuxhaswa yokwakha ibhizinisi elisha. Eyokuqala yizimali zomtshali-zimali uqobo, kanti eyesibili yileyo lapho umtshali-zimali esebenzisa imali yabanye abantu. Nokho, iqiniso liwukuthi amazinga aphezulu okuhlupheka avimbela abantu ukuba babe nemali yabo yokwakha ibhizinisi, okubaphoqa ukuba baphande ezinye izinsiza zokuxhaswa ukuze basize amabhizinisi abo, kuhlanganise nezikweletu. Kukhona uxhaso oluncane lwezikhwama olukhona ukuze lusekela i-SMMEs noma ukukhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Iningi lezikhwama ezitholakalayo ligxile ekusizeni i-SMMEs ngokuqeqeshwa, izeluleko, kanye nokwesekwa kwemakethe. Izinhlelo ezimbalwa ziqondiswe ekusizeni i-SMMEs ngoxhaso lokuthenga izimpahla, imishini, noma izakhiwo, futhi lokhu kugxilwe kakhulu kumabhizinisi akhona adinga ukukhulisa. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo ezahlukene ezitholakalayo akukatholakali kalula noma ukufinyeleleka. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi ezikhungweni zokuxhaswa kwezimali abangaphatha kahle futhi baphathe izimali ezithunyelwe kwi-SMMEs noma ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Izimali ezitholakalayo ziqondiswe kakhulu kumabhizinisi omphakathi afana nezinkampani zokubambisana, ama-trust, noma izinkampani zeSigaba 21. Amabhizinisi ngabanye, njengalezo ezinezingxenye ezingaphansi kwemibono eyishumi noma (PTY) LTD, awahlangabezani nezidingo. Izinqubo ezilandelwayo kanye nenqubo yokufaka isicelo sokuthola lezi zimali ngokuvamile zifaka izinqubo ezinde nezinzima ezingaqondakali kalula ku-SMMEs kanye nezithakazelo ezingenayo izinsiza ezanele. Izikhathi ezibekwe zokuhola abaphumelele ezicelweni ngokuvamile zide kakhulu. Izinqubo eziyinkimbinkimbi zokuthenga okufanele zilandelwe ngokuvamile azihambisani nezinhloso zebhizinisi. Ukuze kusizakale abatshalizimali, uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Nezokuvakasha usungule uhlu lwemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabaxhasi bezimali, okungatholakala ku: www.kznded.gov.za. Umehluko phakathi kwezikweletu (noma ikhredi) nezimali ezitholwe kubatshalizimali ukuthi izikweletu kufanele zikhokhwe ngenzalo, kanti izimali ezivela kubatshalizimali zitholakala ngokusekelwe ekwenzeni ibhizinisi. Nakuba lezi zimali ezivela kubatshalizimali zingesinye sezindlela ezingalandelwa, abatshalizimali abaningi bangenalo ulwazi lokuthi bangazithola kanjani futhi amakhono okudonsela nokugcina abatshalizimali ababalulekile. Abatshalizimali abakhokhwayo ngokuvamile banokukhathazeka okukhulu kunalabo abahlinzeka ngezikweletu. Ukutshalwa kwabo kwenziwa isikhathi esingachazwanga, futhi bangathola kuphela ukwabiwa kwenzuzo ngemva kokukhokha zonke izikweletu. Ukuxhaswa okungakhokhiwe kubatshalizimali kufanelekile kakhulu kumabhizinisi aphumayo angazi kahle ngokuqhubeka kwemali, okwenza bangenakulungela ukufuna uxhaso kubatshalizimali abanikela ngezinsiza. Ngokungafani nababolekisi, abathengisi abazimele abahlinzeka ngoxhaso olungakhokhiwe banganciphisa ezinye zezingcuphe ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezinkulu ezingase zibe nomthelela noma ziqhubele phambili utshalomali. Lokhu kungasiza ukudala izinhlelo zebhizinisi ezinhle nezisheshayo futhi kuthuthukise ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yebhizinisi ngenkathi kusungulwa nezindlela zokubambisana ezizinzile. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, ungavakashela kwi-South African Venture Capital and Private Equity Association (SAVCA) ku: www.savca.co.za. Izikweletu, ezikhokhwa ngenzalo, zitholakala ezibankini zokuthuthukiswa kanye nezibankini ezithengisayo. Inselelo enkulu ebhekene ne-SMMEs kanye nemiphakathi ehluphekayo ekutholeni izikweletu ukuthi lezi zikhungo zidinga ukuqinisekiswa okufanele. Ngenkathi izikhungo zezezimali zokuthuthukiswa zingaguqula izinqubo zazo, izibankini ezithengisayo zinezinqubomgomo eziqinile mayelana nezidingo zokuphepha. Izikhungo zezimali eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile zokuhlola ubungozi bekhredi lapho zisebenza ngesicelo. Ukuhlola izinkomba zokusebenza kwezimali kuboniswa kumadokhumenti wezabelomali nezokuhlela ezimali. Nansi uhlu lwamadokhumenti avame ukufunwa izikhungo zezimali lapho kufakwa isicelo sezikweletu. Umlando wokubhaliswa kwenkampani. Uhlaka lokuphatha nabasebenzi. Izitatimende zezimali zakamuva noma, uma kuyibhizinisi elilodwa, ukuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe okukhombisa imali engenayo okubhalwe ngungcweti wezimali. Izitatimende zebhange zomuntu siqu (ezeminyaka emithathu noma eyisithupha edlule, kuye ngokuthi ubani obolekayo). Izitatimende zebhange zebhizinisi (ezeminyaka emithathu noma eyisithupha edlule, kuye ngokuthi ubani obolekayo). Izitatimende zezimali zabantu bezinhlangano/zabaphathi/ezokuphatha zezimali. Ukuqinisekiswa okuvela kubahloli mayelana nababeli benkampani kanye nephethini yezabelo abaziphethe. Ukuhlaziywa kweminyaka yokubolekwa nokubolekisa. Incazelo enembile yokwakheka kanye nesitatimende sokuhamba kwemali esingama-6 ezinyangeni zalolo hlaka. Ukuveza noma yiziphi izikweletu, izikweletu ezithile, njll., nezinye izikhungo zezimali. Yini eyenzeka ngokuphathwa nokugcinwa kwemishini? Lezi zithombe ze-traktor esebenza emapulazini kanye ne-toolbox enezingxenye zangaphakathi zikhuluma ngendaba yokuphatha nokugcina imishini. Le regression ayenzeki ngokushesha - kwenzeka ngesikhathi eside sokunganaki imishini yakho. Ukusebenzisa imishini kubalulekile kwezolimo okuletha inzuzo yezezimali - ngaphandle kwemishini, umsebenzi uzoba nokulinganiselwa kokwenziwa ngumuntu oyedwa kuphela. Ukuphatha imishini kahle kufanele kube into eyenziwa nsuku zonke - ukuhlola njalo nokuhlola kuzovimbela izingozi ezingaba khona. Imishini ivame ukuhamba phansi ngesikhathi leyo mishini isebenza - leyo yisikhathi esifanele sithanda le mishini kakhulu. Uma ulandela izinqubo zokuphatha imishini ezovimbela ukuhamba phansi kwayo, kuzokusiza ugweme izindleko eziphezulu nokuchitha isikhathi esiningi. Isikhathi esichithwa uma imishini ihamba phansi ngesikhathi somsebenzi obalulekile singaba yingozi enkulu kumlimi. Le pamphlet kaDisemba ibhalwe ngesikhathi lapho kunezinto eziningi eziphathelene nezolimo futhi abalimi banomsebenzi omningi - ukutshala izitshalo, ukuhluza, ukuhluza imithi yokubulala izimpukane, kanye nokuvuna. Ukuhlola njalo i-traktor yakho nsuku zonke kubalulekile, kodwa le misebenzi ivame ukungaqhubeki. I-air filter ingaba dirty futhi ingavala. Lokhu kuzokwenza i-traktor yakho idle kakhulu i-diesel futhi ilahlekelwe amandla. I-air filter ingawa futhi udoti lungangena emshinini, kudala ingozi enkulu ngokushesha. Izinga le-oyela lingawa, futhi umshini ungonakaliswa kakhulu ngenxa yokunganele ukuhlinzeka ngoyela. I-oyela ingaba dirty kakhulu, futhi izingxenye ngaphakathi komshini zingaguga ngokushesha. Uhlelo lokupholisa lungalahlekelwa yi-coolant, futhi umshini uzoshisa, unikeze umonakalo kuma-bearings, ama-pistons, kanye nezivalo. I-fuel filter engcolile ingavala futhi ibangele umshini ukuthi ungasebenzi kahle futhi ingabangele ukuthi ume. Izingxenye eziphukile noma ezingabhaliswanga kahle zingaphuka, zikhululeke, futhi zibangele umonakalo, futhi i-traktor ingaba yingozi kuwe. Gwema lezi zinkinga ezibizayo kumishini yakho ngokuthatha isikhathi esincane nsuku zonke ngaphambi kokuthi uqale umsebenzi. Hlola futhi uhlanze i-air filter. Hlola izinga le-oyela. Hlola i-coolant futhi uyigcwalise. Faka ama-grease kuwo wonke amaphuzu. Hlola i-fuel filter. Lokhu kungase kubonakale njengomsebenzi omningi othatha isikhathi eside, kodwa uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo nsuku zonke, i-traktor izoqhubeka isebenza isikhathi eside, futhi uzokwazi ukujabulisa imivuzo ekupheleni konyaka. Ekupheleni kwentwasahlobo, imishini eminingi igcinwa kuze kube yisikhathi sokutshala ngonyaka olandelayo. Susa yonke imfucumfucu, umhlabathi onamafutha, kanye ne-grease engcolile.
