Usizo lwabantu abahluphekayo, okwesikhashana, luhloselwe ukusiza abantu abasemazingeni anzima kakhulu okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezisemqoka zemindeni yabo. Ubani ongathola usizo kwabantu abahluphekayo kakhulu? Ungathola usizo lokuhlupheka okukhulu kuhulumeni uma usendaweni ebalulekile futhi ephuthumayo. Udinga usizo ngenkathi ulindele ukwesekwa kwezingane lapho uhulumeni ebhekene nesicelo esiphenduke umonakalo ophuthumayo, njengomlilo endlini; akufanele uthole ukwesekwa kuhulumeni kule ndawo uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngoba impilo yakho ayikuvumeli - lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungekho kahle isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, awukwazi ukuthola ukwesekwa kwezingane noma izingane zakho kumzali omunye uma umzali osiza umndeni eshonile noma esesigodlweni isikhathi esifushane ngenxa yomonakalo, kodwa indawo yakho noma umphakathi akukabikhulumi njengendawo yomonakalo. Usizo lwabantu abahluphekayo lunganikezwa ngendlela yephakethe lokudla noma ama-voucher okuthenga ukudla. Ezinye izifunda zikhokha lokhu ngempesheni. Usizo lwabantu abahluphekayo lunikezwa isikhathi esifushane kuphela - ngokuvamile izinyanga ezintathu, kwesinye isikhathi izinyanga eziyisithupha. Faka isicelo sosizo lwabantu abahluphekayo ehhovisi eliseduzane leMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Isitatimende kufanele siqinisekiswe umuntu ophakanyisiwe emphakathini owaziwa umfaki-sicelo. Lokhu kungaba yilungu lekhansili, umholi wesintu, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, noma umfundisi njengobufakazi bokuthi isicelo sokuthola isitifiketi sokuzalwa noma sokuhlonza sithunyelwe kwi-branch yendawo, idokhumenti yokuhlonza yesikhashana ethunyelwe yi-branch yendawo uma kudingeka, isitifiketi sokuzalwa, ikhadi lekliniki, noma umbiko wesikole. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa ngokushesha. Uma usuthumele isicelo, sizobhekwa ubuqiniso bayo, nokuthi ngempela udinga usizo. Noma ungabi nawo wonke amadokhumenti, uzonikezwa iphakeji yokudla, i-voucher, noma imali esikhathini sokuqala. Khumbula bringinga wonke amadokhumenti kumphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi uthole usizo esikhathini sesibili. Uma ungakwenzi lokhu, awuzotholi usizo lokudla, i-voucher, noma imali esikhathini sesibili nasesesithathu. Uma izinto zingathuthuki empilweni yakho, ngemuva kokuthola usizo izinyanga ezintathu, ungafaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesinye isikhathi sezinyanga ezintathu zosizo. Le nkonzo ayikhokhelwa; iyamahala. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi leMnyango eliseduzane.
Izilimi Nezinguqulo: Indaba Yomlando Kudala, emhlabeni wonke, izilimi zabeziwumgogodla wezokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphandle kokuxhumana, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bube nobunzima. Izilimi zabeziwusizo ekwakheni ubudlelwano, futhi zabeziwumthombo wokwabelana ngemicabango, izinkolelo, nezinkumbulo. Njengoba abantu behamba behamba, izilimi zashintsha, zaba nezinhlobonhlobo, zafaka izici ezahlukene ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ezikhathini zokuqala, abantu babekhuluma izilimi ezilula, ezazilula ukufunda nokuzizwa. Lezi zilimi zazingaqondakali kahle phakathi kwemiphakathi eminingi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Ngakho-ke, kwavela isidingo sokuhumusha, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvumelana. Abahumushi bahlala bebalulekile, behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene ukuze kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zashintsha, zathuthuka, futhi zaba nezinhlobonhlobo. Iziphakamiso ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zaba yizinsika ezinkulu zokwakha izilimi ezintsha. Ngalesi sikhathi, izilimi zazingekho kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa zaziqala ukwandiswa emhlabeni wonke. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezilimi eziningi ezikhona, ezazihlanganisa izimpande ezahlukene, izincazelo, nezindlela zokukhuluma. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo. Ukuhweba phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene kwadinga ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuqonda izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezikhungo ezikhethekile zokuhumusha, lapho abahumushi bebenza khona umsebenzi omkhulu. Abahumushi bahlala bebalulekile, behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene ukuze kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zaba nezinselelo zazo. Izilimi eziningi zathola ukungabi nendima emhlabeni, ngenxa yokuthi ezinye izilimi zaba namandla kakhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izilimi ezithile zishabalale, kanti ezinye zaba namandla. Lokhu kwaholele ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni wezilimi. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi izilimi zidinga ukuvikelwa, ukuze zingashabalali. Ngalesi sikhathi, izilimi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezamasiko. Ukuze abantu baziqonde, kudingeka ukuthi bazi izilimi ezahlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba, ukuhlangana, nokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezifundo ezikhethekile zokufundisa izilimi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene. Izikhungo zokufunda zaba yizinsika ezibalulekile ekufundiseni izilimi, futhi zathola ukwamukelwa emhlabeni wonke. Ngesikhathi sokuhumusha, abahumushi bahlala bebalulekile. Umsebenzi wabo ubalulekile, njengoba behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene. Abahumushi bahlala bebanjwa kakhulu, njengoba behlukanisa izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguqulo eziningi ezikhona, ezazihlanganisa izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zaba yizinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni. Ukuze abantu baziqonde, kudingeka ukuthi bazi izilimi ezahlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukuhweba, ukuhlangana, nokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezifundo ezikhethekile zokufundisa izilimi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene. Izikhungo zokufunda zaba yizinsika ezibalulekile ekufundiseni izilimi, futhi zathola ukwamukelwa emhlabeni wonke. Namuhla, izilimi zihlala zibalulekile. Zenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukuphila, nokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Izilimi zikhombisa ubuhlakani bomuntu, futhi zihlala zibalulekile emhlabeni wezamasiko. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni. Ukwazi izilimi ezahlukene kuyasiza ekwakheni umhlaba ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bengahlangana khona, behlakaniphile, futhi bexhumana. Izilimi nezinguqulo zihlala zibalulekile, futhi zidinga ukuvikelwa ukuze zihlale zikhona. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeni sikhuthaze ukufunda izilimi, ukuze sikwazi ukuxhumana, ukuhweba, nokuphila kahle emhlabeni.
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini Isingeniso Namuhla, sizoxoxa ngezinkinga zamanzi ezithinta imiphakathi yethu. Amanzi ayisisekelo sokuphila, futhi uma engatholakali kahle, kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Sihlangana noMnu. Zulu, umholi emphakathini waseMkhumbane, ukuze siqonde izinselelo ezihambisana namanzi. Ukuhlangana noMnu. Zulu U: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngokuba lapha. Ungachaza izinkinga zamanzi ezithinta umphakathi wakho? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene namanzi. Okokuqala, kunokuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Amathafa amaningi awanawo amanzi ahlanzekile, okwenza kube nemiphumela emibi kwezempilo. Izinkinga Zempilo U: Lokhu kuzwakala kunzima. Yiziphi izinkinga zempilo ezivela ngenxa yokuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile? Mnu. Zulu: Izinkinga zempilo ziningi, kodwa okukhathaza kakhulu yizifo ezifana ne-cholera ne-typhoid. Abantu bethu bahlala besebenzisa amanzi angcolile, okwenza kube lula ukuthi bagule. Izingane zethu zikhathazekile kakhulu, zihlala zikhula zinezinhlungu. Izizathu Zokuntuleka Kwamandla Amanzi U: Yini edala lezi zinkinga? Zikhona izizathu ezithile ezibangela ukuntuleka kwamanzi? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, izizathu ziningi. Okokuqala, ukungcoliswa kwemithombo yamanzi, njengezihlahla nezifunda, kudala ukuthi amanzi angatholakali. Futhi, izinga lokuhlala liphansi, okwenza abantu bangenakufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi bahlale bezama ukuthola amanzi emithonjeni engavikelekile. Izixazululo Ezingaba Khona U: Ngabe kukhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kukhona izixazululo. Okokuqala, kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwemithombo yamanzi ahlanzekile. Umphakathi kumele ube nezinhlaka ezinamandla zokuphatha amanzi. Futhi, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuhlanzeka. Ukubambisana Nezinhlelo Zikamasipala U: Ucabanga ukuthi uhulumeni unendima enkulu kulokhu? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, uhulumeni unendima enkulu. Kudingeka kube nokubambisana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni. Izinhlelo zikamasipala kufanele ziqhube izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zamanzi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ukubaluleka Kokubambisana U: Ngabe ukhona umbono wokuthi imiphakathi ingasebenza kanjani ndawonye ukuze ixazulule lezi zinkinga? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane. Singakha amaqembu okusebenza ukuze sithole izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Isiphetho U: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi. Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokugcina kubantu abahlala emiphakathini abhekene nezinkinga zamanzi? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifisa ukusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi yabo. Akukhona kuphela uhulumeni okumele enze, kodwa thina sonke kumele sibe neqhaza. Uma sibambisene, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, onamanzi ahlanzekile. Ukuvala Namuhla, sihlole ukuthi izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Ubuqotho, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokubambisana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo. Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sokuphila, futhi kufanele siwafake phambili ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Lo mklomelo unikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abakhombise ubuqhawe obukhulu ngokubeka impilo yabo engcupheni noma ngokulahlekelwa yimpilo yabo ngesikhathi bezama ukusindisa impilo yabanye noma ukusiza impahla ngaphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika noma kwezinye izindawo. Ingxenye yesithathu = I-metal eyenziwe ngohlangothi lwezinto ezihlukene. Ishidi elenziwe ngempahla ye-nyama likhanyiswe ngendlela efana neqanda enephezu eliqinile futhi lihlanganiswe nesibambo sewood. I-impisi ne-assegai zigcwalisa ishidi, ezinikwa izivakashi ezivela kwamanye amazwe njengendlela yokubamukela. Itshe elincane eliluhlaza eliyigugu - umoya ophuma lapho izikhali zikhishwa ubonisa indlela esizoyithatha uma usizo lunikezwa kulabo abadinga usizo lapho imvelo ibamba, izivunguvungu noma izikhukhula, nezinye izinkinga esihlangabezana nazo emhlabeni. Ibhubesi - limela ubuhle, amandla, nobuqhawe. Uyakubona ngezinqola zayo ezibambekayo kulokhu. Lokhu kumela ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwethu ezweni ngamaqhawe ethu azinikele ekuvikeleni iNingizimu Afrika. Izikhali ezintathu ezikhomba ezweni zimelelwa ngohlangothi lwezimbali ezivela emthini we-thorn, okuyisihlahla sokuqala eNingizimu Afrika esimelela ukumelana, ukusinda engcupheni, nomsebenzi omkhulu wokwelapha komhlaba. I-impisi ne-assegai - zigcwalisa ishidi zikhombisa ikhono lokuzivikela nokwethembeka.
Uhlaka: Ulwazi luthathwe encwadinini ebizwa ngokuthi, Isingeniso Ekukhiqizeni KweMabele. Zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni lapho zingafaneleki khona zingabizwa ngokuthi "izihlahla eziphikisanayo." Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingabaphikisi bokukhiqiza ukudla - ziphikisana nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, ukukhanya kwelanga, nezithako, zenze izinkinga ngesikhathi sokuvuna, zingangcolisa imbewu noma zishintshe umbala wembewu, imbewu yazo ingaba yingozi futhi ilethe ezinye izifo ezibeka ubungozi ezitshalweni zokudla. Ngokuvamile, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zikhula ngokushesha futhi zikhulisa imbewu eningi, zisasazeka kalula futhi zikhula ngokushesha. Zivame ukuba nezimpande eziqinile futhi zingakhula ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ziyinselele ukuyiphatha, ziqhathanisa, futhi ziphikisana ngokukhuthazayo nezinye izitshalo. Zivame ukuvutha ngokushesha, ngakho-ke zikhula ngokushesha. Izimpande zezihlahla eziphikisanayo zivame ukungena phansi emhlabathini, zivumela ukuba zihlale ziphila ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ezikhula minyaka yonke zivame ukufaka ukudla kwazo ngaphansi komhlabathi - ngaleyo ndlela zingahlala ziphila ngesikhathi esinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingama ngokushesha eminyakeni eyodwa, noma zingakhula iminyaka emibili, noma zingakhula minyaka yonke futhi zikhulise imbewu unyaka nonyaka. Kungani kubalulekile ukuphatha (ukubulala) izihlahla eziphikisanayo? Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziphikisana nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, izithako, isikhala, nokukhanya kwelanga. Lokhu kudala ubungozi ezitshalo zokudla ngoba kuvinjwa ukukhula okufanele kwezitshalo futhi kunciphisa umkhiqizo. Lokhu kuphikisana kungangcolisa imbewu yokudla, kunciphise umkhiqizo, futhi kuthinte ikhwalithi yembewu yokudla. Ukuphikisana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhluka phakathi kwezitshalo ezahlukene - kungadala ubungozi obuphakathi kuka-10% kuya phezulu kuka-98%. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziqala ukuphikisana nezinye izitshalo uma izimpande zazo seziqhakazile. Ukuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhlose ukuvimbela lokhu kuphikisana ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke, futhi ukuvimbela izihlahla eziphikisanayo ekukhuleni nasekuphuma kwemibewu yazo ezizovutha uma ezinye izitshalo zifakwe. Kukhona izindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo - ngokwenziwa (ukuhlanza) nangokwenziwa kwemichiza. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlinzwa kuphela, noma inhlanganisela yokuhlanza nokufaka imichiza kungaba indlela eshibhile. Ukukhetha indlela kusezandleni zomlimi, izintandokazi zabo, ulwazi, kanye namandla okuthola abasebenzi, imishini, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka nokuhamba. Ukuphathwa kwezihlahla eziphikisanayo kufanele kwenziwe njalo lapho kuqala ukulima, lapho kulungiswa izinkambu zokufaka, ngesikhathi sokufaka, nasekukhuleni kwezitshalo. Ngale ndlela, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zihlanzwa ngokwenziwa ukuze kuvinjwe imbewu yazo ekufakweni. Lokhu kungenzeka ngaphambi kokufaka (inkambu kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile) nasekuqaleni kokukhula kwezitshalo. Kubalulekile ukubulala izitshalo eziphikisanayo lapho zincane ukuze zingaphikisi nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi, futhi izimpande zezithako zokudla azizukulimala kalula uma nazo zincane. Uma izitshalo eziphikisanayo zineziqhamo eziqinile, ukuhlinza kuzo kungalimaza nezimpande zezithako zokudla. Kukhona imichiza ethambekileyo emanzini, emigqonyeni, kanye nezinye imichiza engagciniwe esetshenziselwa ukubulala izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi inani lemichiza efakiwe libe nekhono futhi isikhathi sokufaka sibalulekile. Le mikhakha ingahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezimbili: ukukhetha nokungakhethi. Lezo ezingakhethi zibulala zonke izitshalo ezihlangabezana nazo, kanti lezo ezikhethiweyo zibulala kuphela izihlahla ezithile, zishiya izitshalo zokudla zingalimali. Lezo ezingakhethi zingafakwa phakathi kwemigqa yezitshalo ukuze zibulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo lapho kodwa azithinti izitshalo zokudla. Imichiza isebenza ngezindlela ezimbili - eyodwa isebenza ngokuxhumana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo, enye isebenza ngokungena ohlelweni lokukhula kwezitshalo. Imichiza yokuxhumana ibulala amahlamvu, ngakho-ke isihlahla kumele sibe sihlanzekile kahle ngemichiza. Le mikhakha ivame ukusebenza kahle uma izitshalo zincane. Le mikhakha yokwakha ihamba ngaphakathi kwezitshalo, ingafakwa kumahlamvu kodwa izobulalayo nezimpande. Kukhona nezinye izinhlobo zemichiza - imichiza yokwakha ngaphambi kokuvuthwa (efakwa ngaphambi kokuthi isitshalo sikhule) kanye nemichiza yokwakha ngemuva kokuvuthwa (efakwa ngemuva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule). Imichiza yokwakha ngaphambi kokuvuthwa ihlala emhlabathini futhi ithathwa ngezimpande uma isitshalo siqala ukukhula; imichiza yokwakha ngemuva kokuvuthwa ithathwa ngama-leaves nezinsika zezithako. Ukufaka imichiza kuyashesha uma sihlanganisa nokuhlanza. Ezinye izinhlobo zemichiza zisebenza isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke akudingeki ukubuyela futhi ubulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Uma kunenhlabathi enkulu futhi izinkambu zimanzi kakhulu, kungaba nzima ukungena enkambini nge-tractor edonsela umshini wokuhlanza, kodwa ungakwazi ukungena ngomshini ophonsa imichiza. Ukufaka imichiza kuzosebenza kangcono ngaleso sikhathi.
Ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini Embhalweni wethu, sizoxoxa ngendaba ebucayi ehlobene nezimayini, ikakhulukazi ukuqonda izingxoxo zamaholo kulomkhakha. Imboni yezimayini ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi emazweni ahluphekayo, njengoba kudlalwa indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho nasemithonjeni yokuphila kwabantu. Nokho, le mboni ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinkinga ezingokwenhlalakahle, ezemisebenzi, nokumarhambo okuhamba phambili kwezomnotho. I. Ukuqonda Uhlelo Lwamaholo Amaholo embonini yezimayini awelapheki kuphela kumazinga ezinga eliphakeme, kodwa ahlola futhi imithetho esebenzayo kulolu hlobo lomsebenzi. Ukuqonda imithetho ihlukanisa ukuthengiselana phakathi kwabaphathi nabantu abasebenza emathunjini. Ukucwaninga kulokhu kudinga ukuqonda izindlela ezahlukene eziwusizo, okuhlanganisa: 1. Umehluko Wamaholo: Izingxoxo zamaholo zihluke ngokuya ngezigaba zabantu abasebenza eminyakeni yabo yokuhlangenwe nakho, izinga lemfundo, nezinhlobo zomsebenzi abawenzayo. Abalimi, owayebhunywa, kanye nomele abakhokhelwayo bonke banelungelo lokukhuluma nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bahola kahle. 2. Izimpawu Zokuthengisa: Okwamaphuzu amakhulu wokukhuluma ngokwamaholo, izimpawu eziphakeme zizonke zidinga ukucaciswa. Lokhu kungase kubandakanye izinkokhelo ezihambisana nemizamo ethile yokuvikeleka emsebenzini noma ezokuvikela, okubalulekile ekukhangiseni umsebenzi. 3. Iziqinisekiso Nezivumelwano: Ukuxhumana phakathi komqashi nomsebenzi kubhalwa ngezivumelwano. Lezi zivumelwano ngokuvamile ziqukethe imikhawulo yemiholo, izinzuzo, nezimo ezithile ezihambisana nalezi zikhala zokusebenza. II. Ukufunda Ngobusuku Nezithiyo Ezikhona Ukwenza ukusondela okuphezulu emiholweni yemboni yezimayini, siyazithola izithiyo ezihambelanayo. Kanjalo, izikhathi zokuqulwa kwezimali zehluka. Kuhlolwe uhulumeni kulezi zinto, ukuze kunqunywe ukuhuqhalwa kwemithombo yokuvikela ababambiqhaza. Lokhu kubheka: 1. Uhlanga Lwemali: Izimo zomkhakha wezomnotho zibalulekile ekubhalweni kwezingxoxo zokukhuluma ngenhla sindsokolela imiholo. Uma umnotho usubanda, kuholela ekwenzeni kubuhlungu ukuba umqashi avumele imiholo ethile. Izingxoxo ezingathandani ziholela ekutheni abaqashi bangamasheya abe khona ukuze bathole umkhankaso. 2. Izimangaliso, Ubufakazi, Nezinyathelo: Amathuba emisebenzi avame ukuncipha, ikakhulu ngenxa yokwahla kwemali. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga kumazinga ahlotshaniswa nejenerali yemboni. Sicela ubuhlakani obuhlanganisa izinkinga zezishiyagalombili ezidinga ukuvuleka ukuze ziqhutshelwe phambili. III. Izinsiza Zokwenza Ucwaningo Ekuqaleni kokucwaninga ngaphakathi kwemboni, kube kuhle ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze kuqondwe izimo zamaholo. Lokhu kuzoba nenzuzo elungile kulwazi olunikeziwe nabantu ababamba iqhaza kulomkhakha. Izinsiza ezidingekayo zihlanganisa: 1. Inhloranhlaka yamaholo: Kudingeka ukufunda ngamaholo abaqashi ngemali ehlanga ngalinye ukuze kuhlonishwe izinga lenhlonipho ezandleni zeziguli nezimo. 2. Ukwethulwa Kwezinto Eziqondisayo: Abacwaningi badinga ukwenza ucwaningo maqondana nezimo ezithinta izimayini, njengezinga lokuphepha, izikhungo zokuhlonza, nezinsiza zempilo zisebenze kahle. 3. Izivakashi Nezivumelwano: Ukuhlolwa kokusebenza kumaholo kudinga ukusondela eziqinisekisweni ezikhona. Ukuhlola lokhu kuzodingeka ukuthi kube nemigomo yokuqinisekisa, ebonakalayo noma ewusizo. IV. Uqhudelana Kulomkhakha Abantu abavela embonini yezimayini bahlakulela uqhudelana omkhulu phakathi kwemali, nezinsiza, ukunikezwa koThrottle, kanye nezifundo, noma ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Uqhudelana okukhuluma ngezingxoxo zamaholo kudinga ukucabangela ubuchwepheshe obufanele lokho okukhuthaza amabhrandi. 1. Iziqinisekiso Zokusebenza: Ukuhlola okwaziyo kokusebenza okukhona ungabona imikhuba emisha esebenzayo. Lokhu kuhola ekuqinisekiseni ngemali ephansi yokuthola izinzuzo ezikhangayo, lapho abasebenzi begxila ekwakheni okokusebenza komnotho. 2. Ukuhlawulwa Kwamaholo: Ukuqonda indlela yokuhlawulwa kokukhuluma kule mboni kwenza kube nzima ukuvumelana nokuhlangana kwemali nezinzuzo. V. Isiphetho Ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini luhlobene neqhaza elikhulu lokuhlola izinkinga ezivelelayo. Ukwazi ukujula kulesi simo kubalulekile ukuze kahle kufanele uxhaso kanye nezinsizakalo ezithile. Umsebenzi ohlakaniphile kulomkhakha uhlola kahle izimo zayo zezimali, ahlola nokuthola izingxoxo zokusebenza. Lokhu kusebenza kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ezinamandla, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni le mboni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nocwaningo, ukuze sikhethu amathemba amaningi ezintathu ezikhona emhlabeni wezokuphepha, ukuphepha kwabantu komkhathi, nemisebenzi ebhekelele ukuthuthukiswa kwemboni yezimayini. Ngalokhu, sizokwazi ukufaka isandla ekukholweni ukufinyelela kwesizayo esikahle.
Mayelana neMining Qualifications Authority (MQA), iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu (CEO). Umphathi wolwazi anganikeza amandla noma imisebenzi ebekwe kuMphathi Wolwazi ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi kumphathi oPhakathi. U-CEO kumele aqashe umuntu ukuba abe nguMphathi oPhakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-MQA iyatholakala kulabo abafuna ukufaka izicelo zolwazi olutholakalayo kulabo abafuna amarekhodi. Umphathi Wolwazi nguye ongakwazi ukuhola nokubheka uMphathi oPhakathi we-MQA. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi aqukethe ulwazi ngabo, imibono, nemibono yomunye umuntu mayelana nesipho, ithokheni, noma umklomelo onikezwe lowo muntu lapho imibono noma imibono yomunye umuntu ivela; kanye negama lalo muntu uma livela kanye nolwazi lwabo noma luhambisana nalowo muntu noma lapho ukuvezwa kwegama kungaveza ulwazi ngomuntu osefile isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka engama-20. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi ku-MQA. Noma ubani (kuhlanganise noma kungagcini lapho), uhulumeni wangaphandle, inhlangano yomhlaba wonke ngaphandle komfaki-sicelo, futhi futhi ngenhloso yesigaba 34 salolu shintsho, uma kukhulunywa ngencazelo ethi "umuntu" ezigabeni (a) kanye (b) kufanele ihunyushwe njengokukhuluma ngempela "umuntu ophilayo." IKomidi Lokukhuthaza Amalungelo Abantu elikhulunywa ngesigaba 181 (b) seMthethosisekelo. Mayelana ne-MQA, irekhodi libhekisela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olurekhodiwe noma kunoma iyiphi ifomu elingaphansi kokuphathwa noma elilawulwa yisikhungo somphakathi noma elibanjwe yilolo sikhungo somphakathi. Libhekisela kunoma yiluphi usuku ngaphandle kosuku lwesonto, uMsombuluko, nezinsuku zomphakathi, njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 seMthethosisekelo Wezinsuku Zomphakathi ka-1994 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1994). Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi (PAIA), Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000 (lapha okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho) waqala ukusebenza ngoMashi 2, 2001, njengesisekelo sokubaluleka kokufinyelela kolwazi emphakathini, okukhululekile, okukhuthaza ukuveza, futhi kwenza konke kube sobala. Lo mthetho uhambisana nelungelo leMthethosisekelo elikhulunywa esigabeni 32 seBill of Rights seMthethosisekelo futhi kumele uhunyushwe njengomthetho owenza ilungelo elisemthethweni. Noma yiluphi ulwazi oluphathwa uhulumeni; kanye nolwazi oluphathwa omunye umuntu noludingekayo ekusebenzeni kwanoma yiluphi ilungelo. Umthetho kazwelonke kumele ube khona ukuze uphumelele lokhu kulungelo futhi ungase ube nemikhawulo evumelekile yokunciphisa umthwalo wokuphatha nezimali zikahulumeni. Ukwandisa abantu ngolwazi nokufundisa bonke abantu ukuze baqonde amalungelo abo ngaphansi kwalolu shintsho, baqonde imisebenzi nezinsiza zokuphatha zomphakathi, futhi bahlolisise futhi babambe iqhaza ezinqumweni zokwenza izinqumo zezikhungo zomphakathi ezithinta amalungelo abo. Umgomo ophelele wezokuphatha uyatholakala uma ucelwa. Ukuqasha abasebenzi abadingekayo noma abaneziqu ezanele ukuze baqedele imisebenzi yabo; nokwenza noma yimiphi imisebenzi ebekwe kubo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono kanye noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono noma ehambisana nezinhloso yale mithetho. I-MQA inawo wonke amandla adingekayo ukuze iqedele imisebenzi yayo njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla kanye nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. Umbono we-MQA uwukuba nolwazi olwaneleyo nolufanele namakhono ukuze kusizakale umkhiqizo, impilo, nokuphepha kwabasebenzi kanye nezinguquko emkhakheni Wokumba Nezinto. Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-MQA ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko yamakhono emkhakheni wokumba nezinto ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu omphakathi angathola usizo ehhovisi likaMphathi oPhakathi. Zonke izicelo zamarekhodi kumele ziqondiswe kuMphathi oPhakathi usebenzisa ifomu elibekwe. Ifomu elibekwe, uma seliqediwe ngokuphelele, lingathunyelwa, lithunyelwe ngekhoriyeri, noma lithunyelwe nge-imeyili kuMphathi oPhakathi usebenzisa imininingwane yokuxhumana enikezwe ngenhla. UMphathi oPhakathi kumele, uma ethola isicelo solwazi, enze isinqumo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 sokuthi avumele ukufinyelela kumarekhodi aceliwe noma cha. UMphathi oPhakathi okuthunyelwe isicelo samarekhodi angakwazi ukwandisa noma ukulibazisa isikhathi esingu-30 esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 25 ngenye isikhathi esingu-30 uma isicelo sikhuluma ngenani elikhulu lamarekhodi noma uma kudingeka ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezikhungo ukuze kutholwe amarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kumele aziswe ngezizathu zokwandiswa kwesikhathi. Uma isicelo samukelwa, uMphathi oPhakathi kumele azise umfaki-sicelo ngezindleko ezikhokhwayo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 10.4 salolu shintsho ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nesicelo. Uma uMphathi oPhakathi ethola ukuthi isicelo sidinga ukucatshangelwa yisikhungo somphakathi, uMphathi Wolwazi kumele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14, akhulule kumkhakha ofanele futhi azise umfaki-sicelo ngokuqondisa. Inqubo yokuxoxisana ixhaswa yizakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo ezifana neBhodi, iKomidi Eliphezulu (EXCO), nezinye izinkomidi ezahlukene. Amarekhodi atholakala lapha yilawo okumele acelwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Lamarekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi oPhakathi ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Izinhlobo zamarekhodi zihlukaniswe zibe yilezo ezitholakala ngokushesha nezilezo ezitholakala ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo njengoba kuchazwe ngumthetho. Isigaba 5 soMthetho sikhombisa ukuthi i-PAIA isebenza ngaphandle kokubheka eminye imithetho engase ivimbele noma icindezele ukuvezwa kolwazi futhi engahambisani nezinhloso noma izinhlinzeko ze-PAIA. Isigaba 55. Amarekhodi akhishwa lapha atholakala kuphela uma ecela ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Angathintwa ngeMphathi oPhakathi ukuze athole lawa marekhodi, atholakala ukuze ahlolwe, athengwe, noma athathwe izithombe uma izindleko ezibekwe esigabeni 11.4 ngezansi zikhokhelwe. Amarekhodi akhishwa ngezansi atholakala uma ecela ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Lamarekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi oPhakathi ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Imali yokufaka isicelo iyimali ebekwe engu-R35.00. Le mali kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sikwazi обработка, futhi uMphathi oPhakathi kumele azise umfaki-sicelo ukuthi kumele akhokhe le mali, ngaphandle uma umfaki-sicelo efaka isicelo solwazi ngaye. Imali yokuhlinzeka ngolwazi ifaka izindleko zokwenza kopi, ukufuna, ukulungisa, nezindleko zokuthumela uma kudingeka. Uma isikhathi sokulungisa sithatha isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku eziyisithupha, umfaki-sicelo kumele akhokhe imali yokuboleka engu-onyaka wesithathu wemali ephelele, ngaphandle uma kungumuntu ofaka isicelo solwazi ngaye. Iphrofayela Yomnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ungomunye wemithombo ebalulekile yokukhula kwezomnotho e-Afrika. Uhlanga lwezomnotho luhlanganisa izimboni ezahlukene, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle umnotho wethu, kubalulekile ukubheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta ukuhamba kwawo, izinselelo, kanye namathuba akhona. Ukwakhiwa Komnotho Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ungowesithathu ngobukhulu e-Afrika, ulandela i-Nigeria ne-Egypt. Uhlanga lwezomnotho luhlanganisa izimboni ezinkulu ezifana nezokumbiwa phansi, ezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana. Izimayini zisebenza njengesisekelo somnotho, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yokumba amalahle, igolide, nezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kodwa futhi kubangela izinselelo ezinkulu, njengokungalingani komnotho. Izinsiza Zomnotho Izinsiza zomnotho ziwumgogodla wokukhula. Uhlelo lwezokuthutha, izikhungo zokuhweba, kanye nezinsizakalo zezezimali zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwemali, izimpahla, kanye nezinsizakalo. I-Stock Exchange yaseJozini iyinhlangano ebalulekile yokuhweba, lapho izinkampani zikhulisa khona imali ukuze zikhule. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuthembela phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, okubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho oqinile. Izinkinga Zomnotho Nokho, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukungalingani komnotho, okukhombisa umehluko phakathi kwabantu abacebile nabampofu, kusemqoka. Lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki phakathi kwabantu, okukhuthaza izinxushunxushu zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga lokungasebenzi lihlala liphezulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umnotho Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika usebenza ngezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokuhweba, ukwakha izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhula komnotho. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Amathuba Okukhula Ngaphandle kwezinkinga, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika unamathuba amaningi okukhula. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, kudala amathuba amasha. Izinkampani ezincane nezimaphakathi (SMEs) zikhula ngokushesha, zenza kube lula ukuhweba nokwakha imisebenzi. Ukwanda kokuhweba namanye amazwe, ikakhulukazi e-Asia nase-Europe, kudala amathuba okukhulisa umnotho. Isiphetho Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ungumfanekiso wezinselelo nezithakazelo ezihlukahlukene. Ukubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona, kanye nokusebenzisa amathuba akhona, kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umnotho wethu uyakhula futhi ufinyelela kubantu bonke. Ngokuqhubeka nokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umnotho onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho wonke umuntu engaba nethuba lokuphila kahle.
Mphathi ohloniphekile weDolobha laseGu, uMphakathi S. Mphathi, umnyango wami ugcizelela ukubaluleka kwasekhaya kanye nokulethwa kokuthuthukiswa ezweni. Yingakho noma kuphi lapho sihamba khona, sikhumbuza ukuthi "umuntu ungumuntu ngenxa yasekhaya." Ikhaya lingachazwa njengesisekelo somuntu wonke. Ikhaya yindawo lapho izingane zikhuliswe khona ngokuphepha, zithola zonke izidingo ezizovumela ukuba zakhe isizwe sesikhathi esizayo. Kukhona ubudlelwano obubalulekile phakathi kwasekhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, nesizwe esinempilo elandelayo. Ngamanye amazwi, uma singakhethi izindlu, asizukuba nesizwe. Kukhona okuningi okwakha ikhaya, kodwa iphuzu lokuqala lokwakha ikhaya "yindlu." Isithunzi somuntu kanye nazo zonke izinto abazidingayo ukuze baphumelele ziqhutshelwa phansi uma bengekho phansi komoya. UManzankosi ubheke izinga lokushoda kwezindlu emindenini ukuze kuncishiswe ngokushesha ukushoda kwezindlu kule ndawo. Ngemva kokubuyekeza imiphumela, kwaba sobala ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi okufanele wenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bethu babe nezindawo abangazibiza ngokuthi ikhaya futhi baphile kahle. Thina, njengoHulumeni onakekela, sathatha isinqumo sokusebenza kanzima ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola izindlu, okuyilungelo labo lokwenyama. Ngamanye amazwi, lo hulumeni uzinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi wonke umuntu unendawo enokuthula yokuhlala, kungakhathaliseki ngesimo sabo sezomnotho. Lolu lungelo lungokwakho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni noma ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Umphakathi, ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi kule ndawo, sinezinkulungwane zabantu abahluphekayo. Kukhona inani elikhulu labantu abangasebenzi kule ndawo, futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu bethu akukavunywanga. Ukuphazamiseka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuhamba phambili kukahulumeni we-apartheid, owawungakhathaleli ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu lapha. Akumangalisi ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinga elingu-61% labantu abangasebenzi. Ngisho nalabo esithi bayasebenza bathola imiholo ephansi kakhulu. R800.00 ngenyanga. Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi le ndawo idinga uhulumeni ukuthi asize ngezindlu nezinye izinsiza zokuthuthukiswa, ngoba kungenjalo, ngeke bakwazi ukuzisiza ngenxa yesimo sabo sezomnotho esiphansi. Njengoba ngishilo, konke kuqala ngasekhaya. Nakuba umcimbi wethu ungase ungahlangene ngqo nokwethulwa kwezinye izinsiza zomphakathi, kufanele ngithinte kulokho okudingekayo ukuze kwenziwe ikhaya lishise futhi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimpilo zabantu zihlala ziqinile. Enye yezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi kule ndawo yamanzi. Kukhona izimbangela eziningi zalesi simo, okuhlanganisa nezomiso ezivame ukuhlasela le ndawo. Kodwa kuze kube namuhla, uhulumeni wethu usebenza nekhansela laseGu ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu lapha banokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile. Isifiso sikaHulumeni wethu siwukuthi wonke umuntu abe nendawo ephephile yokuhlala. NjengoHulumeni, sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze sakhe izindlu zabantu bethu ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuzigqaja ngokuba nezindlu ezisemqoka futhi babuyisele isithunzi sabo. Umsebenzi esiwethulayo namuhla uhilela nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kuhambisana kahle nezinhloso zikaHulumeni zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Inani labantu abadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele liphakathi nendawo eliphezulu kule ndawo, lihlala ku-73% yemindeni lapha. Njengoba ngichazile, ikhaya kufanele libe shisa. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kubeka izimpilo zabantu engozini futhi kunciphisa isithunzi sabantu bethu. Ngalesi sizathu, sithathe izinyathelo ezibanzi ukusiza wonke amakhansela ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ngokushesha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisa izindlu, amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka eziphephile. Njengoba siqhubeka nalesi sihlelo sokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu lapha, lesi sihlelo sizobhekana nezinye izidingo zomphakathi ezibalulekile. Siyajabula ukubona ukuthi ikhansela laseGu selivele lenze intuthuko ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela komphakathi ezinsizeni zokuhlanzeka ezifanele. R4.6 million ukusiza umphakathi wethu lapha eZinqoleni ukuze uthole izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanzekile. NjengoNgqongqoshe, kuyajabulisa ukubona isivinini sokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa sikhula ngoba abantu bethu bahlale belinde lezi zinto isikhathi eside. Umphakathi, enye inselelo esibhekene nayo ekushiseni izindlu yikuntuleka kukagesi. Ngizogxila kakhulu kulokhu ngoba umsebenzi usuqalile. Sineziindlu eziyi-1789 esidinga ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kulo nyaka njengengxenye yomkhankaso wethu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani wonke umuntu unogesi ngonyaka ka-2012. Umphakathi, simi lapha namuhla ngenjabulo enkulu. Siyajabula ngoba imindeni eyayingenazo izindlu izothola izindlu ezakhiwe zona. Namuhla lezi zimindeni zizovuna izinzuzo zokuthula njengoba siqala uhlelo lokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu kule ndawo. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu lapha kusho ukuthi izingane zethu zizokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wesikole endaweni ephephile futhi engcono, okuzothuthukisa nezinga labo lokusebenza. Ngempela, manje singathi ngokuzethemba ukuthi impilo engcono ifikile lapha eZinqoleni. Thina, njengoMnyango wezokwakha, sikholwa ukuthi ukwakhiwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kufanele kuzuze wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Sikholwa ukuthi abantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni nezinsiza, ezifana nezindlela, amanzi, nogesi. Indlu inika umuntu isithunzi, iyindawo abizwa ngayo ekhaya, indawo yokuphepha, futhi inika umuntu ubunikazi. Umphakathi, Amakhandidethi, kanye Nabaholi Bendabuko, ikhaya yindawo esivela kuyo, lapho sisebenza khona, futhi lapho sibuya khona ntambama. Izindlela ezivela ezindlini zixhumanisa thina nezindawo eziningi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zokuthenga, lapho sisebenza khona, izikhungo zezempilo, nezinye izinsiza esizidingayo. Ngibone ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinkinga zokulungisa izindlela, ikakhulukazi lezo eziholela ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko. Ohlelweni lwemnyango wethu lokwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko, ngiveze ukuthi kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwekhansela nezi zindlu zabaholi bethu bendabuko. Abaholi bendabuko babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlelekile kubantu babo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uma lezi zindlu seziqediwe, akukho okuzosivimba ekuletheni ukuthuthukiswa ngoba wonke umuntu uzoba yingxenye yezakhiwo zohulumeni zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa kubantu. Ithuba lezingane liphethwe ngaphansi kohlelo oluphathwa nguMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme. Lokhu kuyifundo edalwe ukuze ibambe futhi iphathise izimali ezikhokhelwe kuMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme zabantu abaziwayo noma abangaziwayo, ngokwesibonelo; izingane nabantu abangakwazi ukuphatha izinto zabo, abalandeli abangakazalwa, abantu abalahlekile, noma labo abangahlanganyeli ezindabeni zomhlaba, izinzuzo, noma ezihlobene. Lapho ithola noma yiziphi izimali, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme uvula ifundo kumarekhodi ezimali zabantu abaqokwe egameni lomnikazi wombuso kanye nomnikazi waleyo mali. Uma kungaziwa ukuthi izimali zikhona kubani, ifundo ivulwa egameni lomuntu owayilethe noma egameni lombuso ochazwe lapho, kuye ngemicimbi. Imali ebambekile efundweni ibhujiswa kwiKomidi Lezokutshalwa Kwezimali, elihlolwa umhloli ozimele minyaka yonke. Inzalo ikhokhwa ngemali efakwe efundweni, eyenzelwe izingane ezingakwazi ukuzimela, labo abangakwazi ukuphatha izinto zabo, abalandeli abangakazalwa, kanye nabantu abahlanganyela ezimalini, ukuze kusetshenziswe emhlabeni, ezimali ezishiwo kubo, nezinsizakalo ezihlobene. Inzalo ibalwa njalo ngenyanga ngokuya ngesilinganiso esibekwe sonyaka, ngezinga elibuyekezwa njalo nguNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Inzalo ikhokhwa kanye ngonyaka ekupheleni kukaMashi 31 konyaka wezomnotho. Inzalo iyanda ngenyanga ngemva kokuthola izimali kuze kube sekwedlule eminyakeni emihlanu, ngaphandle uma izimali zikhishwa umnikazi ngaphambi kokuphela kwaleso sikhathi. Umuntu obhaliswe efundweni angafaka isicelo semali yokunakekela efundweni. U-Mphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme unelungelo lokukhokha yonke inzalo nezimali kuze kufike ku-R100,000 ezimalini ezihlanganisiwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokunakekela ezifana nezimali zesikole nemfundo ephakeme, izingubo, izindleko zezokwelapha, indawo yokuhlala esikoleni, nezinye izidingo ezichazwe esicelweni. Ukunakekela kungacelwa umuntu ophethe ingane/umgibeli/ukulondoloza noma othile ophatha i-akhawunti yomuntu obhaliswe, kwenziwa ngokufaka isicelo usebenzisa ifomu J341 kanye nezinkokhelo kanye nobufakazi bezikweletu. Minyaka yonke ngo-April, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme umemezela kuGazethi Yombuso izimali ezingakafakwa. Izimali zingakhokhwa ngqo kumhlinzeki wesevisi, njengesikole, isikhungo semfundo ephakeme, isitolo sebhuku, njll. Izingane ezingakwazi ukuzimela zingafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe kanye nezinsalo ezikhulile uma seziphumelele eminyakeni evumela ukuzimela, okuyiminyaka engu-21, umshado, noma umyalo wenkantolo owenza zibe nezimela. Nokho, umuntu obhala isivumelwano angachaza eminyakeni ethile lapho umlandeli enelungelo lokuthola izimali zomhlaba. Izimali zingacelwa ngumuntu obhaliswe ku-akhawunti uma kuvunyelwe ngesicelo esibhaliwe se-form J251, esihambisana kopi yokuhlonza/ithokheni lokuhamba/isitifiketi somshado noma umyalo wenkantolo oqinisekisiwe. Labo abanamalungelo enzalo bangathola inzalo eyandile ekupheleni konyaka, ngemuva kukaMashi 31. Isicelo sokwenza inzuzo sibhaliwe, kanti umceli sikhuluma ngempempe eholela ezizalweni noma imvelaphi yemivini edliwayo (inzalo). Umnikazi we-akhawunti angafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe uma enelungelo lokwenza kanjalo (ngokuvamile ngemuva kokushona komuntu oshiya umhlaba) ngokufaka isicelo esibhaliwe se-form J251 kanye nekhophi eqinisekisiwe yokuhlonza noma ithokheni lokuhamba. Imali ikhokhwa kanjani? Imali/inzalo noma ukunakekelwa ikhokhwa ngecheque ebhalwe egameni lomuntu ofanele. Le cheque idwetshwe ngocingo ukuvimbela ukudluliselwa komunye umuntu. Ngamanye amahlandla, imali ifakwa ku-akhawunti yasebhange yomuntu ofanele. Kwenzekani uma imali ingafakwa ngesikhathi? Ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yezimali ezingakafakwa, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme udlulisa lezi zimali ezingakafakwa kuMali Yezimali. Lokhu akusho ukuthi umnikazi ulahlekelwa ilungelo lokufaka isicelo sezimali kuFundo Lezingane. Nokho, ekupheleni kweminyaka engamashumi amathathu, izimali ezingakafakwa ziya kwelinye izwe. Minyaka yonke ngo-April, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme umemezela kuGazethi Yombuso izimali ezingakafakwa.
Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Emhlabeni wezokusebenza, imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni izindawo zomsebenzi ezikhiqizayo, ezinamandla, nezinobungane. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba benze kahle futhi bazinikele emsebenzini wabo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kusebenza kanjani, njengokuthi kungani kubalulekile, nezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Indlela Yokwazisa Abasebenzi Ukuze sithole umfanekiso ocacile wendlela imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi okusebenza ngayo, kufanele kuqale sikhulume ngokuqashelwa. Ukuqashelwa kuwumsebenzi wokubona nokuhlonipha imisebenzi emihle eyenziwe ngabasebenzi. Lokhu kungaba ngokunikeza okuthile, njengemiklomelo, noma ngokuqhubeka nokuthokozisa abasebenzi ngezikhumbuzo ezinhle. Ukubona ukuthi umphakathi ungenza kanjani izinqumo ezinhle kunciphisa umoya ophakathi kwabantu, okwakha isimo esihle sokusebenza. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimiso Zokwakha Kubalulekile ukuba nezimiso ezicacile zokwakha imiklomelo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani kufanele ziqonde kahle ukuthi yini ebhekwa njengomsebenzi omuhle. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufezekiswa kwezinsiza, ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, noma izindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Ukwakha izimiso ezicacile kunciphisa ukudideka nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayavuma ukuthi imiklomelo ikhethwa ngendlela efanele. Izinhlobo Zemiklomelo Imiklomelo ingahluka kakhulu, futhi izinkampani zingakhetha phakathi kwezindlela eziningi. Ezinye zezindlela ezivame kakhulu zifaka phakathi: 1. Imiklomelo Yezimali: Lokhu kungabandakanya izikhuphulelo, imishwana yokusebenza, noma izinkokhelo ezengeziwe ngenxa yokusebenza kahle. Lokhu kuvame ukujabulisa abasebenzi futhi kuthuthukisa ukuzinikela kwabo. 2. Imiklomelo Yobuchwepheshe: Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, ukufunda okwakha amakhono, noma ukufinyelela kumathuba amasha. Lokhu kusiza abasebenzi ukuba bakhule ezindaweni zabo zomsebenzi. 3. Imiklomelo Yokuhlonishwa: Lokhu kungaba ukubonwa emiphakathini, ukufakwa ezinhlelweni zokuqashelwa, noma ukukhushulwa ezikhundleni. Ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini kuyindlela yokuhlonipha abasebenzi abenza kahle. Umphumela Womsebenzi Imiklomelo ayigcini nje ngokukhuthaza abasebenzi, kodwa futhi iphindelela emiphumeleni emihle yenkampani. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi lapho abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi imizamo yabo iyahlonishwa, kuthuthukiswa umoya wokusebenza, okwenza kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu emsebenzini. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni komkhiqizo, ukukhushulwa kwekhwalithi, nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi yokusebenza enhle. Umoya Wokubambisana Naphezu kokuthi imiklomelo ibalulekile, kubalulekile futhi ukukhumbula ukuthi umoya wokubambisana udinga ukwakhiwa. Ukuqashelwa akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngemiklomelo; kumelwe kube nomqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ukuqonda izinselelo ezibhekene nabasebenzi, nokubahlonipha, kuzokwakha isimo sokusebenza esiqinile, esiphathelene. Izindlela Zokwakha Uhlelo Lokusebenza Oluhloniphekile Ukuthi imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kube neqhaza elihle, izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izindlela ezahlukene: 1. Uphenyo Lwabasebenzi: Ukubamba izimvo zabasebenzi mayelana nezimiso zokuqashelwa kudala ithuba lokuthi bazizwe behlanganyela. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ziqondile ezidingweni zabo. 2. Ukuhlela Imicimbi Yokuhlonipha: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlonipha abasebenzi, njengezinsuku zokubonga, kuphinde kudale umoya wokuhloniphana. Lokhu kukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqhubeke bephakanyiswa. 3. Ukwenza Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa: Izinkampani zingahlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezibhekelela ukukhushulwa kwamakhono abasebenzi, okwenza kube nethuba lokuthi baphumelele. Isiphetho Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kuyisici esibalulekile sokwakha isimo sokusebenza esikhiqizayo. Umqondo wokuhlonipha umsebenzisi wenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ngokuqonda izinqubo nemigomo ebalulekile yokwakha imiklomelo, izinkampani zingathola izinzuzo ezingapheli, ezivuna bonke. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ozinikele, onenhlonipho, nolwazi, lapho abasebenzi benza khona kahle ngaphansi kokukhuthazwa okuhle.
Lo mbhalo ochazayo ushintshwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("Lo Mthetho"). Uqukethe ulwazi mayelana ne-SAMSA nenqubo yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umthetho Wokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Kolwandle ka-1998 wasungula i-SAMSA ngo-April 1998. Sinomthwalo wokubika kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, osethula ibhodi yethu futhi uvuma uhlelo lwethu lwebhizinisi lweminyaka. Ibhodi ibeka uMphathi Omkhulu (CEO) wethu, onemfanelo yokuphatha nezinhlelo. Inhloso yethu ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu nezimpahla olwandle, ukuvikela nokuvimbela imvelo yasolwandle ukuthi ingcoliswe ngamahhashi, nokukhuthaza uthando lwezokuthutha kolwandle eRiphabhulikhi. Imisebenzi yethu yokusebenza ifaka: ukubhalisela nokukhishwa kwemvume yamahhashi; ukuhlola amahhashi nokukhishwa kwezitifiketi; ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezokuthutha kolwandle nokubakhishwa kwezitifiketi; nokuvimbela ukungcoliswa kolwandle. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga ukuthi iKomidi Lezokuphila Kwabantu laseNingizimu Afrika likhiphe imigomo equkethe ulwazi oludingekayo umuntu ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiluphi ilungelo ngaphansi koMthetho. Uma ufuna ukubona irekhodi elihlobene nanoma yiziphi zalezi zigaba, kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo elihlanganisiwe nalolu mbhalo ochazayo (kodwa bheka isigaba 7 salolu mbhalo ochazayo). Kufanele uthumele ifomu lakho eliqediwe, kanye ne-akhawunti yesicelo kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhwama (uma kudingekile), ehhovisi lolwazi kule ndawo yeposi, ngefeksi, noma kule imeyili ekhishwe esigabeni 2 salolu mbhalo ochazayo. Futhi ikheli lakho leposi noma inombolo ye-fax. Uma isicelo osithumelayo sikhuluma ngempela ngomunye umuntu, kufanele unikeze ubufakazi obanele futhi obanelisayo ukuze ubonise ukuthi unegunya lokufaka isicelo ngabo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufinyelela kumarekhodi akuyona into eyenzekayo ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi kubalulekile ukuhlangabezana nazo zonke izimfuneko zoMthetho ezihlobene nesicelo sakho. Uzokwaziswa ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha ngendlela obukhombisa ngayo efomini lakho. Noma ubani angafaka isicelo mathupha uma engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma uma engakhubazekile ngendlela yokuthi angakwazi ukuqedela ifomu. Kulokhu, abasebenzi behhovisi bazoqedela ifomu futhi banikeze usizo oludingekayo. Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi ibalwa ngokuya ngezindleko zokukhiqiza, ucwaningo, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zokuthumela. Lapho umphathi wethu ehhovisi ethola isicelo sakho sokufinyelela irekhodi, uzocela (uma ungumfaki-sicelo) ukuthi ukhokhe imali yesicelo efanele ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uzocelwa ukuthi ukhokhe imali yokuthola irekhodi: le mali ibandakanya izindleko zokuhlola, ukukhiqiza, nezinhlelo, kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo ngaphezu kwamahora akhethiwe ukuze ucele futhi ulungiselele irekhodi ukuze kukhishwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthi kube khona ngendlela oyifunayo. Ungacelwa ukuthi ukhokhe isikhwama ngaphambi kokuthi uthole irekhodi: lesi sikhwama siyingxenye yemali ephelele yokucela irekhodi futhi siyabuyiselwa uma isicelo singaphumelelanga. Lezi zigaba zolwazi zitholakala kalula ukuze zihlolwe, zithengwe, noma zikhishwe, noma zitholakala mahhala. Asinazo izinhlelo ezisunguliwe ze-SAMSA zokubandakanya umphakathi ukuze umphakathi ube nomthelela lapho izinqubomgomo zisungulwa, noma lapho imisebenzi yenziwa. Nokho, isigaba 11 soMthetho Wokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Kolwandle saseNingizimu Afrika No. 5 ka-1998 sisho ukuthi i-SAMSA kufanele ibonane nalabo abathintekayo uma kudingeka, lapho ikwenza imisebenzi yayo. Lokhu sikwenza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, njengokulandela izaziso ezifanele nezibuyekezo zomphakathi lapho umthetho ophakanyisiwe wephalamende wethulwa. Uma kukhona imibuzo mayelana nesimo esithile, wamukelekile ukuba uxhumane nehhovisi elikhulu noma nayiphi enye ihhovisi eseduze. Asinayo inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo ngaphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umphathi wethu ehhovisi ephika isicelo sakho, futhi unekhalazo ngaleyo mkhuba, kuzodingeka ulandele inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo yangaphandle. Uma unekhalazo mayelana nokuphikiswa kwesicelo sakho ngumphathi wethu ehhovisi, unelungelo lokufaka isicelo enkantolo ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30. Noma ubani othintekayo angakwenza lokhu. Isicelo samukelwa ngu: (bhala isikhundla, igama, nesibongo somphathi wehhovisi/noma umphathi wakhe) ngomhla... Imali yesicelo (uma kudingekile): R... Isikhwama (uma kudingekile): R... Imali yokuhlola: R... B. Ulwazi oluceliwe ukuze ufinyelele irekhodi a Ulwazi oluceliwe ukuze ufinyelele irekhodi kufanele lunikezwe ngezansi. b Ikheli/inombolo ye-fax eRiphabhulikhi lapho ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe kufanele lunikezwe. c Ubufakazi begunya lokufaka isicelo, uma kudingeka, kufanele buhlanganiswe. Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... Igunya lokufaka isicelo, uma kudingeka ngomyeni:... Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... D. Ulwazi lwekhoshi a Nikeza imininingwane ephelele ye-rekhodi eceliwe, kuhlanganise nenombolo yokubhekisela uma iyaziwa, ukuze irekhodi likhishwe. b Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, qhubeka kwenye ikhasi ozolithumela nalolu fomu. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asayine wonke amakhasi anikeziwe. Incazelo ye-rekhodi noma ingxenye yayo:... Inombolo yokubhekisela, uma itholakala:... Noma yiluphi olunye ulwazi mayelana ne-rekhodi:... E. Izimali ezikhokhwayo a Isicelo sokufinyelela irekhodi ngaphandle kwalelo rekodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwakho sizobhekwa kuphela ngemva kokukhokha imali yesicelo. b Uzokwaziswa ngemali okufanele uyikhokhe. c Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi izoncika endleleni okudingeka ngayo kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo ukuze ucele futhi ulungiselele irekhodi. d Uma ukhululekile ekukhokheni noma yiziphi izimali, chaza izizathu zokukhululwa kwakho. Uma ungakwazi ukufunda ngenxa yokukhubazeka, sicela ukhombise noma uchaze ukuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi njengoba kuchazwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, ubonise ukukhubazeka kwakho nokuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo. a Ukugcina isicelo sakho sokufinyelela irekhodi ngendlela oyicelile kuzoncika ekutheni le rekodi iyatholakala ngaleyo ndlela. b Ukuthola irekhodi ngendlela eceliwe kungase kube nezithiyo ezithile. Uma kunjalo, uzokwaziswa uma irekhodi izokhishwa kuwe ngenye indlela. c Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi, uma kudingeka, kanye nendlela okudingeka ngayo kuzoba nomthelela. Uma uceli ikhophi noma irekhodi elirekhodiwe (ngaphezulu), ingabe ufuna le khophi ithunyelwe kuwe ngeposi? Sicela uqaphele ukuthi uma irekhodi ingatholakali ngolimi olukhethiwe, ingase ikhish
I-VAT, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-Value Added Tax - kufanele ubhalise? Eminyakeni emine edlule, sibhale kaningi ngalesi sihloko se-VAT. Kodwa manje sibona ukuthi akukhona kakhulu abalimi ababhaliwe. Kuzosiza kanjani uma ngibhalisa? Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakathi, ngakho abalimi kufanele bazame zonke izindlela zokunciphisa lezo zindleko. Ukubhalisela i-VAT kuyindlela eyodwa yokunciphisa izindleko. I-VAT isetshenziswa kuyo yonke imikhiqizo edingekayo yokulima - imbewu, amafutha, amakhemikhali, ukulungiswa kwemishini, nokugcinwa, njll. Lokhu kufaka u-14% wezindleko. Uma ukhokha u-R4,000 ngehektare olima, kusho ukuthi ukhokha u-R560 nge-VAT. Uma ubhalisiwe, uzokwazi ukufaka le mali emuva kwi-SARS. Okwamanje, le mali ingaphezu kwenzuzo abalimi abayithola ngehektare. Uma ungabhaliswanga, ngeke ukwazi ukufaka le nzuzo yokulima. Kungani abalimi bengafuni ukubhalisa? Isidingo sokuphatha amarekhodi wemali engenayo nezindleko siyingxenye yezizathu abalimi abangabhalisi ngoba besaba ukuthi i-SARS izokwazi ukuthi bangakanani abathola futhi izokwazi ukuhlola amarekhodi abo. Uma uqotho ngokuqhubeka njengomlimi wezomnotho, kubalulekile ukugcina amarekhodi amahle. Kufanele wazi ukuthi izindleko zakho ziyi-ziphi, ukuthi inzuzo yakho ingakanani, nokuthi le mali iya kuphi. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bayakugwema ukukhokha intela, bephikisa ukuthi abatholi kakhulu. Basebenza ngemali futhi akukho bufakazi obubhaliwe. Lokhu akuyona indlela efanele yokusebenza. Kukhona izizathu ezimbili. Okokuqala, akuvumelekile ngokomthetho ukungahlinzeki i-SARS ngemininingwane yakho yezezimali. Okwesibili, ngeke ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana nebhizinisi lakho lokulima uma ungenayo amarekhodi akhombisa imininingwane yakho yezezimali. Khumbula ukuthi sihlala sisebenzisa izinsiza ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni, ngakho-ke kuyisibopho sethu ukuhlinzeka ngezimali ezidingekayo. Asikwazi ukugwema le ntela kodwa siphinde sithole inzuzo kuyo. Khumbula ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisa le ntela ukukhokhela ukwakha imigwaqo, izikole, izibhedlela, amaphoyisa, njll. Uma uqotho ngokuqhubeka njengomlimi wezomnotho, bhalisela i-VAT ne-Intela Yengeniso.
Amaholide AseNingizimu Afrika: Umqondo Wokuhlanganyela Nokwakha Izinkumbulo Ngenkathi sikhuluma ngama holide, akusizi nje kuphela ukuchitha isikhathi esithile phesheya kwezilwandle noma ezindaweni ezinhle, kodwa kuyithuba lokuhlangana, ukwakha izinkumbulo, nokubuyisela emuva emndenini. ENingizimu Afrika, lapho izinkolo, izilimi, namasiko ahlukeneyo ahlangana khona, amaholide athokozisa futhi ahlukanisa izikhathi zethu. Ngiyavuma, amaholide akhombisa ubuhle bethu njengabantu, futhi angaphinde abe yithuba lokucabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yethu. Ngokujwayelekile, amaholide aseNingizimu Afrika ahlukaniswe ngama holide omphakathi, amaholide okwenziwa ngabantu, kanye nama holide ezinkolo. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kuveza ukuthi abantu banokuthokozisa okwehlukile, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokuhlanganyela. Amaholide afana noMsombuluko, uNhlangulana, noSuku lweziMpi, akhumbuza abantu ngempilo yabo, izimpilo zabadlulelayo, nezifiso zethu ezizayo. NgokukaNkulunkulu, amaholide anjengalesi sikhathi sokubuyisana nemindeni. Umndeni ungumgogodla wezenhlalo, futhi lapho sikhuluma ngama holide, sikhuluma ngenkathi lapho imindeni ihlangana khona, ikhuluma, ihlabelela, futhi ibhiyozela. Lokhu kuhlangana kuholela ekwakheni izinkumbulo ezihlala zikhumbuleka. Ngiyakhumbula ngenkathi ngisemncane, umndeni wami wawujabulela ukuhamba emakhaya ngalesi sikhathi, siphumula emsebenzini, sithokozisa izinyanya, sithokozisa izinkanyezi, futhi sikhumbula izinsuku ezinhle. Lezi zinkumbulo zihlala zikhona, zenza kube lula ukuba sibe nomoya omuhle. Kodwa, amaholide awaqedi nje kuphela ukuchitha isikhathi, kodwa aphinde abe yithuba lokucabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yethu. Njengoba sikhumbula izinsuku ezinhle, kufanele sikhumbule nezinselelo esibhekene nazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkinga zomnotho, ubumpofu, nezinkinga zempilo. Amaholide angaba yithuba lokuqonda ukuthi singenza kanjani ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu abaseduze nathi. Ngabe singakwazi ukuhlela imicimbi yokusiza abanye? Ngabe singakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo, imfundo, noma izinsiza ezisemqoka? Lawa ngama holide angaba yithuba lokwenza umehluko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaholide angaba yithuba lokuhlola izindawo ezintsha, ukufunda ngezamasiko ahlukeneyo, nokuhlanganyela nezindawo ezahlukene. ENingizimu Afrika, sinezindawo eziningi ezinhle ezithokozisayo, ezifana neKruger National Park, iTable Mountain, neCape Winelands. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwethula ubuhle bemvelo, kodwa futhi kudala ithuba lokuhlangana nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, ukufunda ngezimpilo zabo, namasiko abo. Lokhu kuhlangana kungenza kube lula ukufunda nokuhlonipha izinkolo nezamasiko ahlukeneyo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaholide angasiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana. Njengoba sithokozisa, sabelana ngezinto ezinhle, futhi sikhumbula izinsuku ezinhle, sithola ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga abantu abahlanganyela, abavumelanayo, nabazama ukusiza abanye. Amaholide angaba yithuba lokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enobungane, benza okuhle, futhi bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Ekugcineni, amaholide aseNingizimu Afrika awavuli nje kuphela ithuba lokuphumula, kodwa aphinde abe yithuba lokwakha izinkumbulo, ukuhlola izindawo ezintsha, nokubambisana. Njengoba sithokozisa, sikhumbula izinkumbulo zethu, futhi sithola ithuba lokucabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yethu. Ngakho, ngikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba azithokozise amaholide, ahlanganyele nemindeni, futhi akhumbule ukuthi amaholide awanqandwa kuphela isikhathi, kodwa aphinde abe yithuba lokwenza umehluko. Ngiyavuma, amaholide angama-holiday angama-holiday, kodwa kufanele sibe nezinhloso ezinhle, sikhumbule izinkumbulo, futhi sibe nomoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, onobungane, futhi onothando. Amaholide akhombisa ubuhle bethu, futhi kufanele sithokozise ngalokho.
Lo mhlahlandlela uwusizo ukuze usize ukudla ukudla okunempilo, usebenzisa ukudla okutholakalayo. Uma unegciwane elingapheli (njengokugula kwenhliziyo, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), kubalulekile kakhulu ukudla ukudla okunempilo. Ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuthi ulwe nezifo futhi kukusize ukuthi ubhekane kahle nokugula. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo akusho ukuthenga ukudla okukhethekile okudayiswa ngentengo ephezulu! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukukhetha ngokuhlakanipha ukudla okuzohlinzeka umzimba wakho ngazo zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo. Le pamphlet izokusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okutholakalayo. Zama ukudla izinhlobonhlobo zokudla ngangokunokwenzeka. Lokhu kuzokusiza uthole zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Izakhamzimba yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezizakhamzimba ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi ama-proteins, ama-carbohydrates, amafutha, ama-vitamins, kanye nezimayini. Zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho azitholakali kuphela kulowo mkhiqizo owodwa, ngakho-ke kudingeka ukuthi udle izinhlobonhlobo zokudla. Kuqondile ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile. Zama ukudla okungenani kathathu ngosuku. Uma kungenzeka, zama futhi ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile, ikakhulukazi uma ungumuntu odla kancane. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kuphumelele kakhulu kunezinye izithako ezihambisanayo. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kungaba yiphuthu, ubhontshisi, irayisi, amazambane, noma noma yisiphi isithako esine-starch ongakuthola. Iningi kwalokhu kudla kuyabiza. Ukuze wenze ukudla okunempilo, engeza ukudla okune-starch noma noma yisiphi esinye isithako ongakuthola, njengemifino, amabhontshisi, amaqanda, noma izithelo. Imifino nezithelo zinikeza ama-vitamins nezinye izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze kugcinwe amandla omzimba. Zama ukudla izinhlobo eziningi zemifino nezithelo nsuku zonke. Imifino emnyama, ephuzi, noma eluhlaza efana ne-spinach, beetroot, u-pumpkin, amakaroti, kanye ne-papaya inama-vitamins A amaningi. I-Vitamin A isiza ukugcina amandla omzimba. Zama ukudla okungenani uhlobo olulodwa lwemifino noma izithelo ezine-vitamins A nsuku zonke. Eminye imifino nezithelo ikhiqiza i-vitamin C eningi, esiza ukulwa nezifo. Izibonelo zalokhu zifaka izithelo ezifana nama-oranges, ama-tangerines, i-papaya, nezilimo, kanye nezitolo, ama-mango, ama-guavas, ikhabhishi, namazambane. Zama ukudla imifino nezithelo ezine-vitamins C nsuku zonke. Zama ukudla okungenani izinhlobo ezinhlanu ezahlukene zemifino noma izithelo nsuku zonke. Ukuze ufinyelele ezidingweni zakho zamandla, qala manje ngokutshala imbewu yemifino nezihlahla ezimbili zezithelo. Awudingi isikhala esikhulu ukwenza lokhu, futhi ungasebenzisa neziphuzo zokutshala ukuze ukhule imifino eluhlaza enempilo. Uma kungekho sikhala ekhaya, kungani ungahlanganyeli emkhankasweni wokulima emphakathini, noma usize ukuqala umkhankaso wokulima esikhungweni sakho? Ungaqala futhi igadi encane nabangane bakho. Uma izithelo zikhokha kakhulu, thenga imifino eningi esikhundleni. U-pumpkin, amazambane, amazambane amnandi, amakaroti, i-spinach, kanye nezitolo zinhle ngoba zinikeza ama-vitamins amaningi nezimayini ngaphandle kokuba zibe nentengo ephezulu. Pheka imifino ngamanzi ambalwa. Bese le mansi ingasetshenziswa ukwenza isobho noma isitshulu - noma uyiphuze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izakhamzimba emanzini azichithwa. Izitshalo ezivunyiwe ezifana ne-amaranth noma i-spinach yendalo nazo zindlela ezinhle zokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi udla imifino eyanele. Abantu abaningi bathenga imifino nezithelo kubathengisi bezitaladi. Ngezinye izikhathi ziba zishibhile kunezitolo futhi zitholakala kalula. Thenga imifino nezithelo ezigcinwe emthunzini ngoba ilanga lichitha izakhamzimba eziningi ezibalulekile. Thenga imifino nezithelo ezisemkhathini, njengoba ziba zishibhile. Ukudla okutholakala ezilwaneni ezifana ne-chicken, inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, noma amaqanda kungadliwa nsuku zonke. Nokho, ezinye zalezi zinto, ikakhulukazi i-chicken, inhlanzi, kanye nenyama, zivame ukuba nentengo ephezulu. Ukukhulisa ama-chicken, izinkukhu, izimvu, izinkomo, noma noma yiziphi ezinye izilwane ekhaya kungakuhlinzeka ngenyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho nobisi. Ungajabulela futhi ezinye zokudla ezine-protein eziningi ezifana ne-liver, ama-kidneys, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, izintso, i-tripe, kanye namaqanda. Thenga ubisi fresh esikhundleni sokuthenga izikhumbuzo zobisi, ama-creamer, kanye nobisi oluqinile. Lokhu kudayiswa ngentengo ephezulu ngoba kunokudla okuncane kakhulu. Uma ugula futhi uzizwa ungaphansi, engeza amafutha noma ushukela ekudleni kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukudla kube mnandi futhi kukusize uthole amandla ngaphandle kokudla kakhulu. Jabulela ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile futhi aphephile - akubizi futhi kunempilo kuneti nekhofi. Uma ungazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile noma aphephile, phosa nje uphise bese uvumela kuphole ngaphambi kokuphuza. I-alcohol ichitha imali futhi ikhiphe izakhamzimba emzimbeni wakho. Esikhundleni salokho, sebenzisa imali yakho ukuthenga ukudla okunempilo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukugwema ukuphuza i-alcohol ngenkathi uthatha imithi. Hlala unempilo ngangokunokwenzeka uma uzizwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza ugcine imisipha yakho iqinile. Ukuhamba komzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukusebenza engadini, noma ukuhlanza indlu, akugcini ngokukugcina uqine kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa umoya wakho. Cabanga ngokunikela ngesikhathi sakho noma ukwenza ezinye izinsiza ukuze uthole ukudla. Ungasiza esikoleni, esontweni, ekhishini, noma esitsheni sokuphuza ukuze uthole ukudla okunempilo noma ibhagi yokudla. Khetha ukudla okunomdlandla nokutholakala endaweni yakho. Lezi zibonelo ezilandelayo zingakusiza ngezinsiza zokupheka ukudla okulula, okunempilo okutholakala ngentengo ephansi. Pheka isitshulu samabhontshisi futhi uhlanganise ne-tomato ne-onion stew. Ungase futhi ungeze iziphuzo kule dish ukuze uyicebise. Uma uzwa ukuthi awuthandi kahle ukudla, pheka iphuthu elanelisayo. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokulandelayo: Pheka ikomishi eyodwa ye-cornmeal. Engeza izipuni ezintathu ezincane ezigcwele ubisi oluphakeme, isipuni esisodwa se-oyili noma ibhotela, nezipuni ezimbili ezincane zoshukela kuphuthu bese uhlanganisa. Ukuze wenze ukudla okunempilo kwabo bonke, ungapheka ithini elikhulu le-sardines (khumbula ukusebenzisa amathambo) bese uhlanganisa nehhafu yekomishi yefulawa noma amakhukhi. Engeza amaqanda amathathu aphukile bese uhlanganisa kahle. Yenza ama-patties amancane bese uwafry ngama-oyili ambalwa. Phakela nesaladi esisha, amazambane aphekiwe, noma ubhontshisi kanye nemifino eluhlaza ethathwe engadini yakho. Fry onions, tomatoes
Umbhalo ubonakala ungumbhalo wezomthetho onzima ophathelene namalungelo okumba, imithetho, nemigomo eNingizimu Afrika. Uxoxa ngezici ezahlukene zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamaminerali nezamafutha, kuhlanganise namalungelo okucwaninga nokumba, imithwalo yemfanelo kahulumeni kanye nezinkampani zokumba, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola izimvume nezitifiketi. Uqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokuvikelwa kwemvelo kanye nesidingo sokuhambisana nezindinganiso zomthetho. Umbhalo uveza izindima zababambiqhaza abahlukene, kuhlanganise noNgqongqoshe, uMnyango Wezinsiza Zomhlaba, kanye nomphakathi, ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamaminerali. Ubuye ubhekane nezindaba eziphathelene nezinkokhelo zabaphethe izindawo kanye nomthethonqubo ophatha imisebenzi yokumba.
Ukuhlinzeka umphakathi ngempilo esezingeni eliphezulu, umusa, nokubekezela esifundazweni sethu. Indawo ephephile nephilile. Ilungelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukufihla ngempela mayelana nesifo sakho. Ukuvuma ukuxilongwa. Ukufinyelela embonini yesibili. Ukukhetha ukwelashwa kwezempilo. Ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa okuhle. Ukuhlola/ukugxeka. Ukusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukwelashwa endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eqinisekisiwe. Ukwenqaba ukwelashwa. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa kwezempilo. Ukwelapha abasebenzi bezempilo ngenhlonipho nokuthobeka. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile futhi ebalulekile yokwelashwa. Ukuhambisana nezinhlelo zokwelashwa. Ukubuza ngentela nezindlela zokukhokha. Ukuphathwa kahle kwamarekhodi esibhedlela uma ekhona. Ukuvikela nokuphatha kahle indawo yesibhedlela. Ukusiza ekugcineni isibhedlela sihlanzekile. Izimo eziphuthumayo nezibucayi - amahora angama-24. Ukunakekelwa kwe-AIDS. Ukuvimbela ukudluliswa kokukhulelwa. Iklinikhi yezingane. Iklinikhi yezempilo yengqondo. Endaweni yokulinda. Ukukhomba/pass. Ungathwali imali, amakhadi ebhange, noma amafoni eselula. Kuzodingeka ukuthi uvume ukuhlinzwa eklinikhi noma lapho. Bhalisela encwadini yokugqoka yomguli, uyigcine iphephile ehhovisi lokubhalisela abaguli. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi uthatha lezi zinto uma ushiya. Izinto zakho zibekwe ezikhwameni zabaguli. Isibhedlela asikhokhi ngezinto ezilahlekile. Uma izinto zakho zibekwe esibhedlela zilahlekile ngenxa yomlilo noma ubugebengu, isibhedlela sizokhokha R50 noma ngaphansi. Ngesikhathi sokuvakasha, kuvunyelwe izivakashi ezibulalayo. Izingane zivunyelwe ngemva kwesikhathi sesine uma umguli ebuhlungu kakhulu noma uzohlala isikhathi eside esibhedlela, ngemvume yomhlengikazi ophakeme. Ungaphalazi, sebenzisa izikhwama zokuphonsa ezibekwe. Ungasebenzisi izikhwama ezinephepha elibomvu. Gcina indawo ihlanzekile, sebenzisa. Abazali bazokwaziswa uma umguli ekhishwa esibhedlela.
