Hamba kumxhumanisi osebenzayo. IBHOKISI LOKUPHIKISA - libekwe ezindaweni ezithile, sicela ulisebenzise ukuze ubhale iziphakamiso nezokwelashwa kwethu. Lapho sibheka lokhu, sigxila kumsebenzi wezinsizakalo kumakhasimende ngaphakathi nangaphandle komsebenzi. Lokhu kusiza ekusebenzisaneni kokusebenzisa izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye. Lezi zimiso zisebenza njengophawu lokuthi amakhasimende ayaneliseka ngosizo abawatholayo noma ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kusadingeka. Konke lokhu kuyazama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende ayazi futhi aqonde ukuthi angazisebenzisa ngokukhululeka amalungelo awo njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwezindlela ze-Batho Pele.
Isahluko 1: Ukungena KuloMhlaba Wamanzi Ulwandle, indawo enezimfihlo eziningi, luhlaza ngempilo. Lapha, abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola lokho okuqhakaza phansi kwamanzi - ukudla okuvame ukuba yinsiza yokuphila, okungukudla. Ukuze uqale ukuhamba phansi kulo mhlaba, kubalulekile ukuqonda izimo ezahlukene ze-ulwandle. Noma ngabe ungumfishi omusha noma onesipiliyoni, ukwazi indlela yokusebenza kulolu suku lwamanzi kubalulekile. Isahluko 2: Ukuxhumana Nendalo Uma uhlela ukuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi uzinikele ekuhlonipheni isiko lezakhamuzi zasemanzini. Hlola izimo zezulu, ubuke izinkanyezi, futhi uqonde izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokuphila phakathi kwamanzi. Ungakhohlwa ukuhamba nezinhlaka ezisemthethweni zokudoba, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulandela imithetho evikelekile yokudoba. Isahluko 3: Izinsiza Zokudoba Ukwakha izinsiza zakho zokudoba kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile. Thola umgibeli ophumelelayo, izintambo, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo. Qiniseka ukuthi umgibeli wakho ungaphakathi kwemigomo efanele ukuze uqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwempilo yakho kanye nalabo abakuzungezile. Isahluko 4: Izindlela Zokudoba Uma usuhamba phansi emanzini, sebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokudoba. Ukudoba ngentambo, kudinga ubuchule nezindlela ezithile. Qala ngokuphonsa umgibeli, bese uzama ukusondela ezindaweni ezinamathambo, lapho izilwane zihlala khona. Khumbula, indlela yokudoba iyashintsha, ngakho qhubeka ujabule futhi uzame izinto ezintsha. Isahluko 5: Ukukhetha Izilwane Zokudoba Lapho uthola isilwane, uqiniseke ukuthi uyayazi imithetho ethile yokudoba. Khetha izilwane ezisemthethweni, ezivikelekile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uhambisana namazinga okuphila. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uhlinzeke ngemfundo emnandi, futhi ube nesithakazelo esikhulu emanzini. Isahluko 6: Ukuphila Ngezinsuku Zokudoba Ngemva kokudoba, zamanje uhamba phambili ekuphileni usuku lwakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlanzekile, futhi ulandela imithetho yokugcina izilwane. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba kuvikela izilwane zasemanzini nomhlaba. Ungakhohlwa ukuhamba nezinsiza zokuhlanza, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulwandle luhlala luhlanzekile. Isahluko 7: Ukubuyela Emuva Lapho usufike emkhathini, thina hamba phambili ngalokho okutholile. Thola isikhathi sokuhlola izilwane, futhi uqonde imiphumela yokudoba. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uqhubeke nokuhlola izinto ezintsha, futhi uthuthukise ubuchule bakho. Isahluko 8: Ukuhlanganisa Izifundo Ngemva kokuphuma emanzini, qinisekisa ukuthi ucabangele izifundo ozitholile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uqhubeke uthuthukisa amakhono akho. Hlanganyela nabanye, futhi uqoke izindlela zokwenza ubudlelwane obunempilo nolwandle. Isahluko 9: Ukuxhumana Nabanye Ukudoba akuyona indaba yakho kuphela. Hlanganyela nezinto ezizungezile, futhi ubhale izindaba zakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uthole imiyalezo emisha futhi ubeke isithombe esihle sokudoba. Isahluko 10: Ukuqhubeka Nempilo Ekugcineni, qhubeka uhlola ulwandle. Ukuze uhlale uphila kahle, kufanele uqhubeke ufunda ngezinto eziyinkimbinkimbi ezithinta ulwandle. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ube nesithakazelo esikhulu, futhi uqhubeke ube nesibopho sokuvikela umhlaba wethu. Ukwazi ulwandle nokudoba akukhombisi kuphela ubuchule, kodwa futhi kuhlonipha imvelo. Uhlelo oluhle lokudoba luzokwenza ukuba ube nomphumela omuhle, futhi uphile kahle emanzini. Futhi, ukuthola ithuba lokuxhumana nemvelo kuzokwenza kube nempilo ethokozisayo. Hamba phambili, ube nomoya wokuphila, futhi uqhubeke uhlola ulwandle!
Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal Umbuzo 1: Yini isifo sofuba? Impendulo: Isifo sofuba, esaziwa nangokuthi i-tuberculosis (TB), yisifo esithathelwana kalula esibangelwa yibaktheriya ye-Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Lesi sifo sithinta ikakhulukazi amaphaphu, kodwa singathinta nezinye izingxenye zomzimba. Umbuzo 2: Kungani sifo sofuba sibalulekile eKwaZulu-Natal? Impendulo: KwaZulu-Natal, isifo sofuba sitholakala kakhulu, futhi sithinta impilo yomphakathi. Izinga lokushaywa yilesi sifo liphezulu, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda izinhlelo ezikhona zokulwisana naso ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokulwa nesifo sofuba eKwaZulu-Natal? Impendulo: E-KwaZulu-Natal, kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezihlanganisa: 1. Uhlelo lwezokwelapha: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngama-antibiotics ahlukeneyo ukuze kubhekwane nesifo. 2. Uhlelo lokuhlola: Ukuhlola abantu abathintekayo ukuze kutholakale isifo ngokushesha. 3. Imfundo yomphakathi: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela, izimpawu, nokuthi kufanele benzeni uma bezwa izimpawu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayaziswa ngalesi sifo? Impendulo: Izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifaka: - Ukuhlela imihlangano yokwazisa emphakathini. - Ukusebenzisa iziteshi zomsakazo, amaphephandaba, nezokuxhumana ukuze kufinyelelwe kubantu abaningi. - Ukuhlinzeka ngama-brochures nemibhalo echaza isifo, izimpawu, nezindlela zokuvikela. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zisebenza kahle? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zikhombisa impumelelo. Ukuhlolwa kwenzeka njalo, futhi abantu abathola ukwelashwa bahlala bephakanyiswa ukuze baqhubeke nokulandela imiyalelo yokwelashwa. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza abantu bangatholi ukwelashwa? Impendulo: Kunezizathu eziningi ezibangela ukuthi abantu bangatholi ukwelashwa, okuhlanganisa: - Ukungabi nolwazi ngalesi sifo. - Ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokwelapha. - Ukungaboni isidingo sokwelashwa ngenxa yokwesaba noma ukungaqondi kahle izimpawu. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela abantu ekutholeni lesi sifo? Impendulo: Ukuze uvikeleke, abantu kufanele: - Bagcine izinga eliphezulu lokuhlanzeka. - Bagweme ukusondela kakhulu nabantu abane-TB. - Baphumelele ekuhlolweni njalo uma bephakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izibhedlela, kanye nezinhlelo zikamasipala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwabelana ngemininingwane, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zokwelapha. Umbuzo 9: Yini eyenziwa uma umuntu ethola isifo sofuba? Impendulo: Uma umuntu ethola isifo sofuba, kufanele: - Abike udokotela ukuze ahlolwe. - Alandele imiyalelo yokwelashwa, okuhlanganisa ukuthatha imishanguzo ngendlela efanele. - Abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokwelapha ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abanye abantu abathintekayo bayahlolwa. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokulwa nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zifaka: - Ukunciphisa izinga lokushaywa yilesi sifo. - Ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. - Ukunciphisa izindleko zezokwelapha ezihambisana nesifo. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zidinga ukwesekwa? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zidinga ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo, kungaba ngemali, izinsiza, noma ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwandiseni umphumela wezinhlelo. Umbuzo 12: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze basize ekulwisaneni nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Abantu bangasiza ngokwabelana ngolwazi, ukuhlinzeka ngenkxaso kubantu abathintekayo, nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba bahlolwe. Ukwenza lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukulwa nesifo. Umbuzo 13: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Izinselelo zifaka: - Ukungabi namathuba afanele okwelapha. - Ukungabi nolwazi olufanele kubantu. - Ukungabikhona kwezinsiza ezanele zokwelapha. Umbuzo 14: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo, kufanele: - Sifake izinsiza eziningi zokwelapha. - Sihlinzeke ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwabasebenzi. - Sihlanganise imizamo yokwazisa umphakathi. Umbuzo 15: Yini okukhuluma ngayo emiphakathini mayelana nesifo sofuba? Impendulo: Emiphakathini, abantu baphawula ngezimpawu, izindlela zokuvikela, nezindlela zokwelapha. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale beqaphile futhi baziqhenye ngempilo yabo. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinhlelo, KwaZulu-Natal iyazama ukunciphisa umthelela wesifo sofuba, futhi ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nezinhlelo zikamasipala kubalulekile ukuze sifeze lezi zinhloso.
Imililo Yasendle: Umthelela Nezizathu Zokuyivuma Noma Ukuvusa Ukukhathazeka Imililo yasendle iyinselele enkulu emvelweni, futhi ibalulekile ukuze siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngale ndaba, siqonde ukuthi imililo yasendle ingaba nemiphumela emihle nemibi, futhi sithole izindlela zokuphila ngokuhlanganyela nemvelo. Ukwakhiwa Kwemvelo NokuPhefumla Imililo yasendle ingaqala ngezizathu ezahlukahlukene, njengokushisa kwelanga, imvula encane, noma kwenzeke ngesiphithiphithi somuntu. Nokho, ukuvuma imililo yasendle kungaba nezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, imililo iyasiza ekwakheni isimo esisha somhlaba. Izitshalo ezithile zidinga ukushiswa ukuze zikhule. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukudlula," okwenza izitshalo zibe namandla futhi zibe nekhono lokumelana nezimo eziyingozi. Imililo yasendle futhi ikhulisa ukuhamba komhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezivulekile, lapho izitshalo zishiswa khona. Lokhu kuvula amathuba okukhula kwezinye izitshalo, okwenza kube nezilwane eziningi ezifuna ukudla nemihlambi eyahlukahlukene. Ikakhulukazi, imililo iyasiza ekwandiseni ubuhlobo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane nezitshalo, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisa umphakathi wesimanje. Izingozi Zokunyuka Kwezimililo Noma kunjalo, imililo yasendle ingaba nemiphumela emibi. Ukushiswa kwezindawo eziningi kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezilwane eziningi nezitshalo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi umphakathi ophilayo uqhubeke. Njengoba imililo ibalulekile ekwakheni umhlaba, ingabangela ukulahleka kwezinto eziphilayo ezitholakala endaweni ethile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izilwane ezithile zibe sengozini yokulahleka, futhi kungabangela ukuzinza kwezimo ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imililo yasendle ingaphazamisa abantu. Njengoba imililo iqhubeka, ingasiphazamisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala eduze kwemifula noma ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Ukushisa okukhulu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemizi, futhi izinkanyezi zomlilo zingaba nezingozi ezinkulu ezinokubangela izikhala ezimbi. Ukuze kuvinjwe lezi zinkinga, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokulawula imililo, ezihlanganisa izinyathelo zokubhekelela imvelo nezinqubomgomo zokuphatha izindawo. Ukwamukela Imililo Yasendle NgeZindlela Zokulawula Kunezindlela eziningi zokuphatha imililo yasendle ukuze kube nomthelela omuhle. Abantu bangaqonda ukuthi imililo iyinsiza elungile futhi ingaba yinsiza ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izindlela zokubhekana nemililo, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokuthola imililo, ukufundisa abantu ngezinzuzo nezingozi, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokulawula imvelo. Ukwamukela imililo yasendle akusho ukuthi kufanele sivumele imililo iqhubeke ngaphandle kokubhekelela. Kunalokho, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokulawula imililo, okuhlanganisa ukulawula izindawo ezithinta kakhulu izilwane nezitshalo. Abantu kumele baqonde ukuthi imililo ingaba yinsiza emvelweni, kodwa kufanele sibe nokubheka okuhlakaniphile ukuze sikwazi ukuphila ngokuhlanganyela nemvelo. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Kokuhlola Ngokubheka konke lokhu, imililo yasendle iyinselele enkulu esivumelayo ukwakha nokuphila. Kumele sizame ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezihlanganisa izinzuzo nemiphumela emibi, ukuze sithole ukuthi imililo ingaba insiza emvelweni. Ngokufunda, sikwazi ukuthuthukisa ulwazi lwethu nolwazi lwemvelo, siqonde ukuthi imililo yasendle ingaba nemiphumela emihle, kodwa futhi kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sivimbele izingozi. Ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle ekuphathweni kwemvelo, sizodinga ukuhlola izindlela ezithile zokuphila ngokuhlanganyela nemvelo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imililo yasendle ithathwa ngendlela efanele.
Izithombe: Ukulondolozwa komhlabathi: Lokhu kuyinhlanganisela yemithi, amaqabunga, nomhlabathi othambile obekwe eduze kwezitshalo ukuvimbela ukugqwala (ukugqwala komoya), ukuvimbela ukujula okweqile kwemizi, nokuvimbela ukukhula kwezihlahla. Imvula ewela emhlabathini ongekho ngaphansi kokuvikelwa ingadala ubungozi uma imvula ikhulu. Kubalulekile kubalimi ukuzama ukunciphisa leli bungozi elenzeka emhlabathini uma imvula ikhulu. Incwadi yethu ethi "Imvula ngoFebhuwari" ixoxa ngokuqiniswa komhlabathi ophakeme, ikakhulukazi ibhekisela ezinsongweni zokugqwala komhlabathi kanye nezinhlobo zokugqwala. Lapha sizama ukuchaza ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zobungozi imvula engadala emhlabathini ongekho ngaphansi kokuvikelwa nokuthi singenza kanjani ukuze silondoloze umhlabathi. Ingxenye yamandla emvula isetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa amaqoqo omhlabathi kuyo yonke indawo. Uma umhlabathi uqiniswe, usabalalisa ngokulinganayo kuyo yonke indawo futhi umhlabathi omningi ngeke ulahleke, kodwa uma umhlabathi ungenamsebenzi, umhlabathi omningi uzoshesha. Ngakho-ke, umhlabathi ophumile uzoshesha kancane kancane futhi uzolahleka. Kukhona ibhalansi phakathi kwamandla emvula nokugqwala komhlabathi. Kaziwa kahle ukuthi ukugqwala komhlabathi okukhulu (50% - 80%) kuvame ukwenzeka uma imvula ikhulu ezindaweni lapho kuvame khona ngesikhathi sehlobo. Amaqoqo amaningi ahluleka emizimbeni ethambile. Amanzi amaningi azohamba phansi. Amanzi azohamba ngokushesha, eshaya. Ububanzi bokugqwala kanye nezindlela zokuphatha lokhu kuzovimbela izinhlobo eziningi zezimbali ukuba zifakwe kule ndawo uma ukugqwala komhlabathi kungaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kubhekisela ikakhulukazi kumandla amanzi okugqwala umhlabathi kanye nesimo somhlabathi kule ndawo - ezinye izinhlobo zomhlabathi ziqhume ngokushesha, ezinye kancane. Zonke izinkambu ezilimiwe ezine-erosion rate engaphezu kuka-3% kufanele zivikelwe ngokuhlelwa (lokhu kuyisakhiwo esakhiwe ukuze sikhuphule umhlabathi ukuze kudaleke udonga lapho amanzi amaningi angaphuma khona emkhakheni). Izitshalo ezilimiwe zingafakwa kuphela ezinkambini ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-10%. Izitshalo ezineziqhamo ezincane zingafakwa kuphela ezinkambini ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-15%. Izinkambo ezilimiwe zingafakwa kuphela lapho ukugqwala kungaphansi kuka-30%. Ukugqwala okungaphezu kuka-30% kungasetshenziswa kuphela ukufaka izihlahla noma ukugcina izinsiza zemvelo ezifana nezilwane. Ukuvikelwa kwemithi kuyinto ebalulekile evimbela ukugqwala komhlabathi ngenxa yemvula. Ikakhulukazi, ukuvikelwa kwemithi kudala isakhiwo esifana ne-umbrella - ivimba imvula ngaphambi kokufika emhlabathini. Amaqoqo emvula ewela emithini nasezinqolobaneni alahlekelwa amandla awo okudala ubungozi emhlabathini ngoba lawa maqoqo nawo ayahlakazeka futhi awanawo amandla okusabalalisa umhlabathi, amanzi ahamba ngemithi nasezinqolobaneni kuze kube ukufika kancane emhlabathini. Ukulondolozwa komhlabathi ngemicabango kusebenza kangcono ngokuvikelwa kwemithi okwakha i-umbrella. Ukulondolozwa kugcina amaqoqo eduze nomhlabathi, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa amandla amaqoqo ahamba phambili. Ngisho noma ukuvikelwa kwemithi kuhlanganisa zonke izindawo, ezinye izakhiwo zemithi ezakha i-umbrella zingasiza ukuvimbela ukugqwala komhlabathi. Ukulondolozwa kwemvelo kungabandakanya izimpande zezitshalo, amaqabunga, kanye nothuli olutholakala ngesikhathi kukhishwa izinkuni nezihlahla. Ekulimaleni, izinto ezisele emkhakheni ngemuva kokuvuna zisebenza kangcono. Umsebenzi wokuvimbela ukugqwala komhlabathi uxhumene ngqo nosayizi wokulondolozwa komhlabathi. Singasho futhi okuphambene - ububanzi bokugqwala komhlabathi buxhumene nezindawo lapho umhlabathi ungagcinwa khona. Izinsalela ngemuva kokuvuna kufanele zishiywe emhlabathini - kodwa kungase kube nezizathu zokuzisusa, isibonelo: izifo ezingenzeka ezitshalweni, i-nitrogen emhlabathini ingancipha ngenxa yokubola kwezinsalela zemithi, kungase kudingeke ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha noma kungase kudingeke ukubulala izihlahla, njll. Bese kuba umkhuba ojwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika ukusebenzisa izinsalela ukukhulisa izinkomo nezimvu. Uma sicabanga ngezindlela zokulima, kunezinto esingazisebenzisa ukuze silime ngaphandle kokulimaza ukulondolozwa komhlabathi. Uma sifaka emigqeni, ukuhlinzeka nokuhlanza kungenzeka kuphela emigqeni, futhi izindawo phakathi kwemigqa zingashiywa zigcinwe. Izihlahla zingalawulwa ngamakhemikhali.
Isingeniso Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa, noma i-Artificial Intelligence (AI), kube yinsakavukela emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Le mikhakha ithuthukile kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, futhi ibonakala ikhulisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezokwelapha, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nemithelela ye-AI empilweni yethu. Izinzuzo ze-AI Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu ze-AI ukuthi iyakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ethile ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wezokwelapha, izinhlelo ze-AI zisetshenziswa ekutholeni izifo, zihlaziya idatha enkulu ukuze ziqonde izimo ezinzima. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokwelashwa futhi kwandisa amathuba okuphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuthutha ziye zathuthuka kakhulu ngenxa ye-AI, lapho izimoto ezizimele ziqala ukuvela, zinciphisa izingozi zomgwaqo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-AI iyakwazi ukufunda nokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezintsha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo ze-AI zingathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, zifunde kumaphutha azo, futhi zibe ngcono ekwenzeni izinqumo. Lokhu kubalulekile emikhakheni efana nezokumaketha, lapho izinkampani zisebenzisa i-AI ukuze ziqonde izidingo zamakhasimende futhi zithuthukise imikhiqizo yazo. Izinselelo ze-AI Noma kunjalo, ukuvela kwe-AI akukhululekile ezinkingeni. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuphatha idatha. Njengoba i-AI idinga idatha enkulu ukuze ifunde, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha kwedatha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idatha ayisetshenziswanga kabi, kudingeka izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela ulwazi lomuntu siqu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngempilo yomsebenzi. Njengoba i-AI ithuthukiswa, imisebenzi eminingi iyashintsha noma iyaphela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baphenduke, bafunde amakhono amasha ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekukhathazekeni kwabantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavame ukusebenza emikhakheni ethile. Imithelela ye-AI empilweni yethu Imithelela ye-AI empilweni yethu ibonakala kakhulu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubhekana nezinkinga ezivela. Ngokwesibonelo, ezokuxhumana ziye zathuthuka kakhulu, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukuxhumana kalula, noma ngabe bakuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuxhumana okungaphezulu kungaholela ekunciphiseni ubudlelwano bomuntu nomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-AI ibonakala ikhulisa umnotho. Izinkampani ezisebenzisa i-AI zikhula ngokushesha, zikhulisa imisebenzi, futhi zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola imisebenzi. Isiphetho Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa ziye zaba yinsakavukela emhlabeni wethu, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi zingaba nemithelela emihle kakhulu empilweni yethu. Nokho, kudinga ukuba siqaphele izinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi i-AI iyithuluzi elinamandla, kodwa kufanele lisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi i-AI izoba yinsiza enkulu ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono, kodwa kufanele sihlale siqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ukubambisana, ukufunda, nokuvikela amalungelo abantu kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elinempilo nelinobulungiswa.
Uma kwenzeka izinto ezivamile empilweni yakho, ungase ube nesifo noma ube nolaka, ngakho-ke uzodinga ukuhamba emsebenzini ukuze uphumelele esifweni noma kulaka. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ulaka lapha alukhulumi ngolaka emsebenzini. Izinsuku ezijwayelekile zokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo zingama-36 (36) ezihambisana nemiholo ephelele, okuyilokho okukhokhelwe ukuhamba emsebenzini. Ukukhokhelwa ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo isikhathi esingama-3 eminyakeni elandelanayo. Uma wazi kusenesikhathi ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba emsebenzini ukuze wenze inqubo ethile noma ungagula uma kufanele ube sebhulohweni, thumela isicelo bese uqedela ifomu lakho lesicelo kusenesikhathi. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma uthola ulaka, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ulaka. Umyalezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngamalunga, ozakwethu, noma umngane wamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ulaka sithinta ukukwazi kwakho ukuveza kumphathi wakho. Thumela isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi ubesebenzisa isifo izinsuku ezintathu noma ngaphezulu FUTHI uma usebenzisa ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo ngaphezu kokuphindwe kabili phakathi nesikhathi esingamasonto ayisishiyagalombili, kuzokwenziwa ukuthi kube nokunakwa ngesikhathi sokungasebenzi. Futhi, bheka isigaba sokuvunywa KweziTifiketi Zokuhamba Emsebenzini Ngesifo ngezansi. Sebenzisa futhi uthumele ukuhamba emsebenzini ngokresponsibly nangokuhlakanipha. Gwema ukusebenzisa ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo ngezinye izinjongo ngaphandle kwesifo nolaka, njengoba ungase uzithole ungaphakathi kwesimo esizayo mayelana nokukhokhelwa kwakho ukuhamba emsebenzini. Bheka futhi unikeze ukuhamba emsebenzini njengoba uceliwe. Phenya futhi uhlole amacala athile afana nokusetshenziswa okungafanele kokuhamba emsebenzini okujwayelekile. Bese uthatha isinyathelo uma kudingeka. Umqashi angase, kwezinye izimo, acela isitifiketi sezokwelapha sokungabikhona okwesikhashana okungaphansi kwezinsuku ezintathu uma kutholakala ezinye izimo ezifanayo. Qondisa abasebenzi ngokusetshenziswa okufanele kokuhamba emsebenzini ngokuhlakanipha. Hlinzeka ngezidingo zomsebenzi noma funa umsebenzi omusha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezidinga lokhu. Ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezinsuku ezinganele kuyinzuzo ongayicela uma izinsuku zakho zokuhamba emsebenzini ziqediwe, okuyikhokhelo kwezi-3 zeminyaka zokuhamba emsebenzini. Cela usebenzisa amafomu wesicelo adingekayo. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi kufanele ucele usebenzisa amafomu abekiwe ukuze uthole ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ngokufanele. Awukwazi ukusetha ifomu le-Z1 ngalokhu. Uma wazi kusenesikhathi ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba emsebenzini ukuze wenze inqubo ethile noma ungagula uma kufanele ube sebhulohweni, thumela isicelo bese uthumela ifomu lakho lesicelo kusenesikhathi. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma uthola ulaka, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ulaka. Umyalezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngamalunga, ozakwethu, noma umngane wamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ulaka sithinta ukukwazi kwakho ukuveza kumphathi wakho. Ngaso sonke isikhathi thumela isitifiketi sokugula uma uceliwe. Ungathumela imibhalo esekelayo yezicelo zokwelashwa nolwazi nemibono eyengeziwe ehambisana nesicelo sakho sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele. Gwema ukusebenzisa ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kuyimenenja yeZempilo Nezokuphepha. ngemuva kosuku lokuqala lokungabikhona emsebenzini. Umqashi uzokunikeza ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ngokuya ngemiphumela yokuhlola mayelana nohlobo nesimo sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele. Inqubomgomo nezinyathelo zokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele kanye nokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yokuhamba kwezempilo yi-PILIR. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokuya ngemiphumela. Lokhu kungaba umqashi wakho noma wena uqobo uqala ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo uma kukhona ukungabaza ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukusebenza futhi. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke, ngokwesibonelo, ngemuva kokuhlaselwa kwemoto okukhulu. Uma ufaka isicelo sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele kwesikhathi eside futhi uphenyo lomqashi lukhombisa ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukusebenza futhi, bangase baphakamisela isicelo sakho sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ukuba kube isicelo sokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo. Ungacelwa ukuthi uqedele amafomu wesicelo acacile sokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo. Thumela izitifiketi zokugula nanoma yiziphi imibiko yezokwelapha nolwazi nesicelo. Izinyathelo ezingeziwe zokuhlola zingadingeka njengengxenye yokuhlola ukuze umqashi enze isinqumo esinembile mayelana nokuqhubeka kokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele noma okunye. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokuya ngemiphumela. Ngokwenzela ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele, umqashi uzokwamukela kuphela izitifiketi ezikhishwe ngodokotela abhalisiwe kwiNhlangano Yezempilo YaseNingizimu Afrika futhi abanamalungelo okuxilonga nokwelapha iziguli. Isitifiketi sezokwelapha kufanele, ngovuma lwakho, sichaze uhlobo nobukhulu besifo/ulaka. Igama, ikheli, kanye nezifundo zodokotela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi udokotela uhlinzeka ngesitifiketi ngokuya ngemiphumela yokuhlola, noma ngenxa yolwazi olutholakele kumguli futhi lwamukelwa njengokwelashwa kwezokwelapha okusekela. Isikhathi esiphakanyisiwe sokuhamba emsebenzini kanye nosuku lokukhishwa kwesitifiketi sokugula. Isaziso sodokotela uma usebenzisa izitifiketi eziphrintiwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi, noma yiluphi ulwazi olungahlangene nomguli kumele lususwe. Umqashi ungabheka kuphela futhi aqale uphenyo lwesicelo sakho ngemuva kokuthi usuthumele ifomu lesicelo kanye nazo zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubuyela kudokotela wakho ukuze uqedele umbiko odingekayo oyingxenye yamafomu wesicelo. Ifomu lesicelo lingase libe yingozi ekufinyeleleni kwakho kokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele noma ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo. Umqashi uzokunikeza isikhathi sokuphumula ngalokhu. Umqashi uzogcina amarekhodi ezikhathi ezinjalo ezisetshenziswe njengezikhathi zokuphumula kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku olunye. Lokhu kuzoboniswa kumarekhodi akho okuhamba emsebenzini. Kulindeleke ukuthi kulokhu uzogcwalisa irekhodi lesikhathi esingasetshenziswanga ukuze kuqoqwe amarekhodi. Ubufakazi bezimo ezinjalo kuzodingeka njengoba kudingeka. KuMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, phatha ngaso sonke isikhathi noma yiluphi ulwazi mayelana nesimo sezempilo somsebenzi nganhlonipho nangokufihlekile.
Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni (Life Esidimeni arbitration) Ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi, kwaba nezinsuku ezinzima eNingizimu Afrika, lapho ubuhlungu bukaMaboko, umama oneminyaka engama-42, buhlangana nezinkumbulo ezinzima. U-Maboko wayengumama ophakathi neminyaka emithathu efuna ukulwa nezinkinga zempilo zomntwana wakhe, uSipho, onokuphazamiseka kwengqondo. U-Sipho wayethokozisa uMaboko, kodwa umhlaba wama-mental health services wawungaphansi kokuphatheka kabi. Ngesikhathi uMaboko ebhalela izikhalazo eziningi, kwavela udaba lwe-Life Esidimeni, lapho abantu abaningi abaphila nezinkinga zempilo zengqondo behlukunyezwa. U-Maboko wayezizwa enomoya ophansi, ngoba wayebona abanye abantu bezama ukufinyelela usizo, kodwa benza izithiyo ezinzima. Kwakukhona amacala amaningi abantu abashiya emitholampilo, bephathwa kabi, behlukunyezwa, futhi bengenamathuba okuphila kahle. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavela umphakathi ozinikele ekutholeni izimpendulo. Kwakuyinto ethokozisayo, abantu bephakamisa izwi labo, bebuza ukuthi kwenzekani e-Life Esidimeni. Ngenxa yokufuna ubulungiswa, kwaba nezinye izinkampani ezazidla ubuhlungu bomphakathi obuphila ngaphansi kokuphazamiseka. U-Maboko ubone ukuthi akekho owawuthanda ubungxiwankulu bempilo yengqondo. Kwathi, ngesikhathi sokulamula, uMaboko wathola ithuba lokukhuluma ngolwazi lwakhe. Wayazi kahle ukuthi ukulalela izinkumbulo ezinzima zesimo sikaSipho kungaba yithuba lokwenza umhlaba ungcono. U-Maboko wakhumbula izinsuku lapho uSipho eba nokuthula, futhi wacabanga ngokuthi umphakathi ungazama kanjani ukuvikela abantu abanjengaye. U-Maboko wathola isibindi, wanikela izimpendulo zempilo, uchaza izimo ezinzima abahlangana nazo. Ubufakazi bokuqamba kwalesi sikhathi babungama-odaba angama-100, abelokhu baphikisana nemiphumela yokungaziphathi kahle. Umphakathi wajabula, kodwa waqonda ukuthi ukulwa akupheli lapho kudingeka imiphumela. Bakhuluma ngezinto ezinjengokuthi, "Akukhona ukukhipha abanye, kodwa ukufaka izinyathelo eziphusile." U-Maboko wathola ukuthi, uma bephakanyiswa, umphakathi ungakwazi ukufezekisa izinguquko. Uhlanga lwempilo yengqondo lwathuthukiswa ngokusindisa izimpilo; abantu bahlala bejabulile, beqonda ukuthi ungubani, futhi bahlanganyela. U-Maboko wayekhumbula ukuthi uthando lwezinto eziphilayo lwalungaba yinsika eqinile. Kwabanye, le mithetho yayiyisikhumbuzo sokuthi abanikazi bempilo yengqondo bangabantu abaphilayo, futhi kufanele bahlonishwe. U-Maboko waqhubeka nokukhuluma, efundisa abanye ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ngemva kokulamula, umphakathi waqala ukuba nezinsiza eziningi, izikhungo zokwelapha ezihloniphekile, nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yengqondo. U-Sipho washintsha kwaze kwaba yinsuku yempumelelo, wathola usizo olwakhe, futhi uMaboko wabona ukuthula kumntwana wakhe. Ekugcineni, u-Maboko waphumelela, ngoba akuyena owodwa nje owayebonakalisa ubuhlungu, kodwa waba umholi, umgibeli, ukuveza izinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukulungiswa. U-Justice waba yincwadi, futhi abanye bebelokhu besebenzisa imithetho yokuvikela abantu abaphila nezinkinga zengqondo. U-Maboko waqhubeka nokukhuthaza ubuhlungu, enza umphakathi uqonde ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile, futhi izinsiza zendawo zidingeka kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinto, imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni yaphenduka isikhumbuzo sokuthi ubungane, uthando, nokuhlanganyela kubalulekile empilweni. U-Maboko kanye noSipho bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, behlanganyela emiphakathini eyandayo, futhi bezama ukwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Lokhu kwaba yindaba efundisayo, yokuthi akukhona okungahlala kuhle, kodwa umphakathi ungakwazi ukuvuselela izimpilo zawo.
IShoprite: Iphrofayela Yomuntu IShoprite, njengomkhiqizo ophumelelayo, ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuzinikela, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezidingo zabathengi. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1979 eCape Town, eNingizimu Afrika, futhi yakhula yaba yinye yezitolo ezinkulu kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. IShoprite iyaziwa kakhulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola imikhiqizo ethengiswa ngamanani aphansi, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola ukudla nezimpahla ezisemqoka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iShoprite yathola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza umsebenzi wayo ube lula. Ngaphezu kokuba yisitolo esikhulu, ibuye ibe yindawo yokuhweba enezinhlobonhlobo zemikhiqizo, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izimpahla zokuhlala, nezinsiza ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, njengokuthenga ku-inthanethi, kwenze iShoprite yaba yindawo ethokozisayo yokuthenga. IShoprite iyaziwa ngokuqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathengi bayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, ukwakha izinhlelo zokwethembeka, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ethokozisayo. Abathengi bahlala bejabule ngempela uma bethenga eShoprite, njengoba bekwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ethokozisayo ngamanani aphansi. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, iShoprite ibuye ibhekelele umphakathi. Iphakathi kwezinhlelo zayo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, iShoprite ibamba izinhlelo zokuphila kahle, ezokuthuthukisa imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono, okwenza kube yinkampani enobuntu. IShoprite ibuye ibe nezinhloso ezicacile zokuthuthukisa imvelo. Iphakathi kwezinhlelo zayo zokunciphisa imfucuza, iShoprite isebenzisa izindlela ezihlanzekile zokuphatha imfucuza, futhi ibambisene nezinhlelo zokuvuselela imithombo yemvelo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iShoprite ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, kodwa ibuye ibheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iShoprite ithole izindondo eziningi ngenxa yokusebenza kwayo okuhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindondo zokuhlonishwa kwezokuthengisa, izindondo zokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo, kanye nezindondo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iShoprite iyinkampani ehamba phambili emkhakheni wayo, futhi ibalulekile emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. IShoprite iyinkampani ehlanganisa abantu abaningi, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengi nenkampani bungaba namandla. Ngokuqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, iShoprite ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile emiphakathini, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iShoprite izoqhubeka nokukhula, ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo, futhi iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza iShoprite ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuthenga, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. IShoprite iyinkampani enobuchwepheshe, enobuntu, futhi enezinhloso ezinhle, futhi lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi ibaluleke kangaka emhlabeni wethu. Ngokubheka phambili, iShoprite izoqhubeka nokuba yisibonelo sokuphumelela, ibonise ukuthi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathengi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo, kuyindlela yokuphumelela emkhakheni wezohwebo. IShoprite iyinkampani esebenza ngokuzikhandla, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ibalulekile emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, iShoprite akuyona nje isitolo, kodwa iyindawo yokuhweba enezinhloso ezinhle, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. IShoprite iyinkampani esebenza ngempumelelo, futhi izoqhubeka nokukhula, ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo, futhi iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza iShoprite ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuthenga, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi.
Ukushoda Kothisha Ezikoleni: Inkinga Ethinta Ikusasa Lemiphakathi Emhlabeni wethu wamanje, ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni sekuyindaba ebucayi. Njengomuntu onomuzwa oqinile mayelana nezindaba zemfundo, ngibona le nkinga iyingozi kakhulu, hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumiphakathi yethu yonke. Ukufunda kuyisisekelo sokukhula komuntu, futhi abathisha bamele izikhumbuzo zokufundisa, okukhombisa ukuthi ukushoda kwabo kungenza kube nzima ukufezekisa le njongo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukushoda kothisha akukhona nje ukungabi nabantu abaningi emsebenzini. Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezibangela le nkinga, kuhlanganise nezimo zokusebenza ezimbi, izinkokhelo ezingezinhle, kanye nezidingo ezinkulu zokufunda okukhona. Abathisha abaningi bahlushwa yizimo zempilo ezingezinhle, futhi lokhu kuhlangene nempilo yabo yomuntu siqu. Uma abathisha bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, kuba nzima ukuthi bakwazi ukunikeza abafundi ubuholi obufanele. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise isimo sabo. Ngokuthola abathisha abaningana ezikoleni, sizobona ukuthi abafundi bahlushwa yizifundo eziphansi. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho kunabathisha abaningi, abafundi bathola amathuba angcono okuthola izifundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abathisha abaneziqu eziphakeme, abanamava, nezifundo eziphumelelayo bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekufundeni kwethu. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lemfundo, kufanele sigxile ekutholeni abathisha abafanele, futhi sikwenze lokhu kube yinto ebalulekile esizayo. Esikhathini esedlule, izikhungo zemfundo zazibhekelele kakhulu ukwakha uhlelo oluqinile lokuqhuba imfundo. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, ukuhamba kwesikhathi kube nomthelela omkhulu, futhi izikhungo zethu zihlala zikhonza izidingo ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kufanele silungiselele abathisha bethu ukuze baphumelele, futhi uma bengenakuthola izinsiza ezifanele, sizobona ukushoda okwandayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele siqonde ukuthi imfundo ayiyona nje into yokufundisa abafundi. Imfundo ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esiqinile, esinobuchule, futhi esizithokozisayo. Ngokwesibonelo, abathisha baveza amakhono ahlukahlukene kubafundi, okuvumela abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokucabanga, lokukhiqiza, nokuqonda okujulile. Uma kuncishiswa inani labathisha, lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye abafundi bahluleke ukujwayela lezi zifundo. Esikhathini esizayo, ngibona kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zifake izinhlelo ezinzima zokuthuthukisa imfundo. Lokhu kungakwenza kube lula ukuthola abathisha abaphethe iziqu eziphakeme, futhi kunciphise ukuhamba kwabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abafundi abakhethiweyo ukuba babe abathisha, ukuze bakwazi ukwakha isizukulwane esisha sabafundisi abaqinile. Ngokufingqa, ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni akukhona nje okuphazamisayo emfundweni, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta ikusasa lempucuko yethu. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise isimo sabathisha, sikhuthaze imfundo, futhi sifake izinhlelo ezizohlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ukukhumbula ukuthi abathisha bethu bamele ikusasa lempucuko, kumele sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, sizokwenza imiphakathi yethu ibe nezinselelo ezinzima ezizobangela ukungaphumeleli kwabafundi bethu. Ngakho, asithathe izinyathelo ezinqala namuhla ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle, futhi sithuthukise imfundo ezikoleni zethu.
Amalungelo Abantu Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, emzaneni ophakathi kwezintaba, kwavela udaba oluthusayo. UThandi, intombazane encane, wayehlala nomndeni wakhe emzini ophucukile, kodwa ubuhlungu bokungabi namalungelo abahlala nabo bukhona. UThandi wayephupha ngempilo engcono, lapho wonke umuntu ehlonishwa khona, futhi amalungelo abantu engaziswa khona. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahamba edolobheni eliseduzane, lapho abanye abantu bephila impilo ehlukile. Babebonakala bejabulile, behamba phambili, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Lokhu kwashiya uThandi ecabanga kakhulu. Wazi kahle ukuthi emzaneni wakhe, abantu abaninzi babebhekana nezinkinga ezinzima, njengokungabi namsebenzi, ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, nokungabi namathuba okufunda. Ngemuva kokubona lokhu, uThandi wanquma ukuthi kufanele akhuthaze amalungelo abantu emzaneni wakhe. Waqala ukuhamba emakhaya, wakhuluma nabantu, wabachazela ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo, futhi kufanele bawasebenzise. Wabafundisa ukuthi bonke abantu kufanele babe namathuba alinganayo, ukuthi bonke kufanele bahlonishwe, futhi ukuthi izwi labo kufanele lizwe. Ngesikhathi esebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu, uThandi wathola abanye abantu abavuma ukujoyina umkhankaso wakhe. Babebandakanya abantwana, abadala, nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Bahlangana njalo, behlela imihlangano, baphinde bahlele izinkulumo ezazikhuthaza abanye ukuba bazi ngamalungelo abantu. Kodwa, akukaze kube lula. Kwezinye izikhathi, uThandi nabangane bakhe babebhekene nezithiyo. Abanye abantu emzaneni babengafuni ukuzwa ngalokhu, becabanga ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayizinto ezingenamsebenzi. Kodwa uThandi waba nesibindi, waqhubeka nokukhuthaza, wathola ukuthi ukungaboni kahle kwabanye akwenzi amalungelo abantu angabazweli. Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokusebenza kanzima, uThandi nozakwabo bakwazi ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu. Umcimbi wawuhloswe ukujabulisa abantu, kodwa futhi wawuwumcimbi wokukhumbuza abantu ngamalungelo abantu. Babebhalela izinkulumo, behlola izinkanyezi, futhi benza imidlalo ethokozisayo. Umphakathi waba nomdlandla, futhi abantu baqala ukuveza izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Ngesikhathi somcimbi, uThandi wakhuluma phambi kwabantu abaningi. Wakhumbuza bonke ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo kuphela uma wonke umuntu efuna ukuphila impilo enhlonipho. Wabakhuthaza ukuba baveze imizwa yabo, babeke izinkinga zabo phambili, futhi bazame ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibabhekene nazo. Ngemuva kwalolo mcimbi, umoya emzaneni waguquka. Abantu baqala ukuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi izwi likaThandi labaluleka kakhulu. Bafuna ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho wonke umuntu engahlonishwa khona. Amalungelo abantu aba yinsika yokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. UThandi nozakwabo baqhubeka nokusebenza, bephokophelela ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungisa. Ngesikhathi esithile, umphakathi wabo waba yisibonelo sokuthi amalungelo abantu angashintsha impilo. UThandi waphuma phambili, futhi waba ngumholi ohlonishwayo, owaziwa kabanzi emzaneni nakwezinye izindawo. Kodwa uThandi waqonda ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawungekho kuphela emzaneni. Waba nesifiso sokuhamba phesheya kwezilwandle, afunde kabanzi ngamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Wafunda ukuthi kunezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nabantu ezindaweni eziningi, futhi wathola ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo kuphela uma abantu bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu oyedwa angashintsha umphakathi. Wavula amathuba, wakhuthaza abanye, futhi waba umoya ophilayo wokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu. Umphakathi wakhe, owawubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, waba yindawo yokuhlala enobulungisa, lapho wonke umuntu engahlonishwa khona. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waqonda ukuthi amalungelo abantu awusizo kuphela uma abantu bephila ngokuhlanganyela, behloniphana, futhi bejabulela impilo yabo. Kwakungesikhathi sokuthi bonke abantu bazi ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayisisekelo sokuphila kahle, futhi kufanele ahlonishwe njalo. UThandi, nomsebenzi wakhe, waba yisibonelo esiqinile sokuthi umhlaba ungaba ngcono uma sikhuthaza amalungelo abantu.
Sebenzisa ipeni emnyama noma eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lethenda futhi ugcine ukubhala kwakho ngaphakathi kwezikhala ezinikeziwe. Sicela usebenzise izinhlamvu ezinkulu lapho ugcwalisa leli phepha. UNGASHIYI izikhala ezingenalutho ongazidingi. Sicela ungasebenzisi umoya wokulungisa uma wenza iphutha. Siphinde sicele ukuthi ungayigobi ifomu lakho njengoba lokhu kuzodlula isikhathi sokucubungula. KUFANELE ugcwalise zonke izingxenye ezihambelanayo zefomu. Noma iyiphi ifomu engagcwaliswanga ngokuphelele izobuyiselwa kuwe ibhalwe "ingathunyelwa" kuze kube uyibuyisela igcwaliswe ngokuphelele. Lokhu kungaholela ezijezweni zokuhamba kancane kokuthunyelwa kwefomu lakho. Ukusayina: Ifomu lethenda liyisivumelwano esibophelelayo esidinga ukuthi uvule zonke izimali, ithenda, nezikhala throughout unyaka. Imali etholelwe uma ungazange uthole imali phakathi nonyaka kufanele ikhonjiswe ngokufaka zero (0). Ukuze kube lula kuwe, kulo nyaka i-SARS ilethe ifomu lethenda labantu ababili abasha. I-IT12S iyifomu lethenda labantu. Ikhonzwe ukuba igcwaliswe ngabasebenzi abathola umholo futhi bathola izinzuzo zokuhamba nezikhala zezindleko zezokwelapha kanye nezinkokhelo zokuthatha umhlalaphansi. Banikeza ulwazi lokubala izindleko zokuhamba. Uma ukhetha ukubala usebenzisa izindleko zangempela, kuzodingeka ukuthi unikeze ulwazi oluhambelanayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izindleko ezimisiwe zizosebenza. I-ITC12C iyifomu eyinkimbinkimbi yabantu abanemali efana nemali yokurenta, imali yangaphandle, imali yebhizinisi, imali yokulima, kanye nezindleko/ukulahlekelwa kwebhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwe-IT12S njengoba kuxoxiwe ngenhla, ifomu linikeza abathengi ithuba lokuvula noma iyiphi enye imali engafakwanga kwi-IT12S. Qinisekisa ukunemba kolwazi oluphrintiwe, futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho ezinikeziwe kolwazi oluphrintiwe ukuze ufake imininingwane enembile. Isimo somshado kusukela ngoFebhuwari 28, 2007: Sicela uphakamise ibhokisi elifanele nge "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) nge "X" futhi uma ushadile, khombisa nge "X" ukuthi umshado wabelana ngempahla noma cha. Qinisekisa ukunemba kolwazi oluphrintiwe, futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezimhlophe ezingenalutho kolwazi oluphrintiwe ukuze unikeze imininingwane enembile. Sicela ugcwalise imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho wamanje. Uma usebenze endaweni engaphezu kweyodwa phakathi nesikhathi esivela kuMashi 1, 2006, kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2007, gcwalisa imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho omkhulu - lapho usebenze khona amahora amaningi. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimali ezibuyiswayo kwenziwa kusetshenziswa inombolo yephoyinti, hhayi igama lebhange. Ngakho-ke, akudingeki ugcwalise igama lephoyinti olisebenzisayo. Qaphela: I-SARS ikhishwe ama-check kuphela ezimweni ezingajwayelekile, ngakho kufanele unikeze imininingwane yebhange ukuze uthole ukubuyiselwa. Akukho ukubuyiselwa okuzobekwa ku-akhawunti yebhange yomuntu wesithathu noma ku-akhawunti yomunye umuntu. Khombisa indlela yakho oyithandayo yokuxhumana ngokuphakamisa ibhokisi elifanele usebenzisa izinombolo 1 kuya ku-5. Inombolo 1 ikhombisa inketho oyithandayo kanti 5 ikhombisa inketho engathandwa kakhulu. Uma usebenzisa umxhumanisi wezintela ukuzeugcwalise ukubuyiselwa kwemali yakho, kuzogcwaliswa yilowo mxhumanisi wezintela. Ikhodi esigabeni sokuqala ikhombisa umthombo wemali yakho kanti isigaba sokugcina sikhombisa inani olitholile. Lezi yizigaba kuphela ozodinga ukuzigcwalisa kule ndawo yokubuyiselwa kwemali. Uma uthola kuphela i-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, uzogcwalisa inani kanye nekhodi yomthombo efanele esigabeni sokubuyiselwa kwemali njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. Umsebenzi ofanayo kufanele ulandelwe uma uthola izitifiketi ezintathu ze-IRP5/IT3(a). Izimali zitholakala esigabeni semali ephelele ye-IRP5. Sebenzisa inani elikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 ukuze ugcwalise le ndawo - uma uthola ngaphezulu kwe-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, zonke izimali ezikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 kufanele zengezwe ndawonye bese inani eliphelele lifakwa esigabeni sokubuyiselwa kwemali. Hlanganisa zonke izitifiketi ezitholwe ezivela emabhange noma kwezinye izikhungo zezezimali lapho ufake khona imali. Khombisa ukuthi lezi zitifiketi zikhombisa noma iyiphi inzalo yangaphandle noma ama-dividends angaphandle njengemali. Uma kunjalo, kufanele ugcwalise i-IT12C yemali. Hlanganisa izimali ezikhonjiswe njengenzalo yendawo ezitifiketini ozitholile mathupha nangokwakho. Kufanele ugcwalise inani lemali elingasetshenziswa njengezindleko ezitholakele nguwe nomkakho - noma iyiphi imali engasetshenziswa izobala i-SARS. Hlanganisa izimali ezikhonjiswe njengenzalo yendawo ezitifiketini ozitholile. Sebenzisa ithebula elingezansi, khetha umkhakha wezomnotho lapho imali itholakele. Uma ulwazi lungahambisani nalezi zikhala, kufanele luvele emthonjeni wakho wemali ikakhulu. Faka izinombolo ezimbili zokugcina ezishiywe zingenalutho esibuyiselweni semali. Khombisa inani labaxhasi nezinkokhelo ezenziwe ngabo. Ulwazi oludingekayo lubhekisela ezinkokhelweni ozihlinzeke kwi-fund yezokwelapha kuze kube nguFebhuwari 28, 2007, mayelana nawe nakwabanye abantu abaqashwe kulowo mfundo wezokwelapha. Le mininingwane ivame ukukhonjiswa kumyalezo otholayo kwi-fund yakho yezokwelapha. Ingabe inani lishintshile phakathi nonyaka wezintela? Phakamisa ibhokisi "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) nge "X". Uma impendulo ingeyebo, khombisa inani labaxhasi ngenyanga. Ukuze uqedele le ndawo, usadinga izitifiketi zakho ze-IRP5/IT3(a). Lokhu kubuyiselwa kwemali kuvumela izitifiketi ezintathu, ngakho-ke (ukukhubazeka) inani lezindleko ezihlobene nalokho ukukhubazeka kufanele kuhlukaniswe ngezigaba ezintathu. Izindleko zomzimba kufanele zifakwe lapha uma zingakhokhelwanga yi-Fund Yezokwelapha. Khombisa izinkokhelo zakho kwi-Fund yakho yePension. Okwamanje - Sebenzisa inani elikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 4001 esitifiketini sakho. Izikweletu - Sebenzisa inani elikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 4002 esitifiketini sakho. Uma ugcwalisa ukubuyiselwa kwemali, sebenzisa isitifiketi ositholile enhlanganweni owenze izinkokhelo kuyo. Kuphela lezo zinkokhelo ozihlinzeke kuphrojekthi ezokwenza kube usizo kuwe ezingafanele ukufakwa. NgokweMthetho Wezintela, kuphela ezinye izikhala ezivunyelwe uma uthola umholo. Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Umbuzo 1: Yini ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kubhekisela ekwenzeni noma ekuphatheni izingane ngendlela engafanele, ehlukunyezayo noma ehlukunyezayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, noma ngokocansi. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yengane, kubangela izinkinga zempilo zengqondo, ubudlelwano obuphukile, kanye nezinye izinkinga ezinzima. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Izindlela zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kubandakanya ukushaya, ukwephula amathambo, noma ezinye izinjongo zokulimaza. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokwengqondo kubandakanya ukugxekwa, ukuhlekiswa, noma ukungabikhona kokuthanda. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi kubandakanya ukuhlinzekwa noma ukuvuma ukuxhumana okungafanele. Zombili lezi zinhlobo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yengane. Umbuzo 3: Yini edala ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Izizathu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zingahluka kakhulu. Ezinye izizathu zingabangelwa ubunzima bezimali, ukucindezeleka, izinkinga zomndeni, noma ukungabi nekhono lokuphatha imizwa. Abantu abahlukumezayo bangase babe nezinkinga zabo, njengokuhlukumezeka kwabo esikhathini esedlule. Ngakho, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akukhona kuphela umphumela wokuziphatha kwabantu, kodwa futhi kubangelwa izimo ezinzima. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zingahluka, kodwa ziningi ezivamile. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zingaba nokukhathazeka, ukungabikhona kokuzethemba, ukushintsha kokuziphatha, noma ukungathandi ukuya esikoleni. Ezinye zingase zibe nezinkinga zokulala, zikhathazeke, noma zibe nezinselelo ezingokwengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuba abazali, othisha, nabanye abantu abadala bazi lezi zimpawu ukuze bakwazi ukusiza izingane ezidinga usizo. Umbuzo 5: Yini okufanele yenziwe uma umuntu ebona ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane? Uma umuntu ebona ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, kubalulekile ukuthi abhalise lokho. Lokhu kungafaka ukuvakashela emaphoyiseni, izikhungo zokuxhasa, noma izikhungo ezikhethekile ezibhekelela ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane. Abantu abavikela izingane kumele bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izinkinga futhi bathumele izikhalazo. Ukuthola usizo ngokushesha kungasiza ekuvikeleni ingane. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela izingane ekuhlukunyezweni? Ukuvikela izingane ekuhlukunyezweni kudinga imizamo eminingi. Abazali kufanele babe nekhono lokuxhumana nezingane zabo, babafundise ukuziqhenya, futhi babakhuthaze ukuba baphawule uma bezwa ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Izikole nazo zingaba nezinhlelo zokufundisa izingane ngezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa nokuthi zingabika kanjani. Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele ekwakheni indawo ephephile nekhululekile ukuze izingane zikhule. Umbuzo 7: Yini umthelela wokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane empilweni yazo? Umthelela wokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ungaba mubi kakhulu. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zingase zibe nezinkinga zempilo zengqondo, ezifana nokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, noma izinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni zibe nezinkinga ezinzima empilweni yazo, njengezinkinga zobudlelwano, ukungaphumeleli esikoleni, noma izinkinga zomsebenzi. Umthelela ungaba phezulu kakhulu uma ukuhlukunyezwa kuqhubeka isikhathi eside. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo ezikhona zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo? Yebo, kunezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka izikhungo zokwelashwa, izikhungo zokuxhasa, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abazali. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, kanye neminyango kahulumeni nazo zisebenza ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezingane ezidinga usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi lezi zinsiza ukuze bakwazi ukusiza izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Umbuzo 9: Kungani kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngokuqinile ngalesi sihloko? Ukukhuluma ngokuqinile ngokuqhubekayo ngalesi sihloko kubalulekile ukuze sikhulume ngempilo yengane. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akufanele kube yindaba ethule, kodwa kufanele kube yindaba esikhuluma ngayo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ukukhuluma ngalesi sihloko kusiza ukukhulisa ukuqonda, kuvuse umqondo wokuvikela, futhi kukhuthaze abantu ukuba baphendule uma bebona ukuhlukunyezwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube indawo ephephile nekhululekile ezinganeni. Isiphetho Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyinkinga enkulu emiphakathini yethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho sokuvikela izingane zethu, sizame ukuqonda izimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa, futhi sithole izindlela zokuxhasa. Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko, singakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, nolondekile, lapho izingane zingakhula khona zikhululekile futhi zifinyelele phezulu.
### Ukuphucwa Umhlaba Ngesikhathi Sobandlululo Umbuzo 1: Yini ebizwa ngokuthi "ukuphucwa umhlaba"? Impendulo: Ukuphucwa umhlaba kubhekisela ezinhlelweni ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabantu, ikakhulukazi labo ababephathwa kabi ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwakha, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi ezithuthukisa izinga lempilo. Ngesikhathi sobandlululo, lezi zinguquko zazibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelele. --- Umbuzo 2: Yini eyayiqondile ngalesi sikhathi sobandlululo? Impendulo: Isikhathi sobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika sathinta kakhulu impilo yabantu, ikakhulukazi abamnyama, ababephathwa kabi. Umhlaba wawuhlukaniswe ngokobuhlanga, futhi abantu babengenakufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezibalulekile, ezifana nemfundo, impilo, kanye namathuba emisebenzi, okwaholela ekuphiviseni kwezinhlanga eziningi. --- Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuphuculwe umhlaba ngalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi sobandlululo, kwakukhona izinyathelo ezithathwe, ezifana nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezazihlose ukulwa nobandlululo, njenge-ANC (African National Congress) nezinye izinhlangano ezazimemezela amalungelo abantu. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokufunda ezazihloselwe ukufundisa abantu abamnyama kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho zazibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimo zabantu. --- Umbuzo 4: Kungani imfundo ibalulekile ekuphuceni umhlaba? Impendulo: Imfundo iyinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ngesikhathi sobandlululo, abantu abamnyama bavele benqatshelwe ukufinyelela imfundo efanele. Ukwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, kwakubalulekile ukukhulisa izinga lemfundo, njengoba imfundo ivula amathuba, ikakhulukazi ekutholeni imisebenzi engcono, okuholela ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. --- Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo ezazibhekene nabantu ngesikhathi sokuphucwa umhlaba? Impendulo: Abantu babebhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokungabi nokwaneliseka ezinsizakalweni, ukungabi namathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka, futhi abaninzi balesi sikhathi babengenakufinyelela ezimfanelweni ezibalulekile, ezifana nezempilo nesikhungo semfundo. --- Umbuzo 6: Uphi umthelela wokuphucwa umhlaba namuhla? Impendulo: Umthelela wokuphucwa umhlaba usabonakala namuhla. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zedlule ziye zathuthukisa izimboni, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zathuthukisa izinga lempilo kubantu abaningi. Nokho, kusekhona imizamo eminingi edingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuphila kahle. --- Umbuzo 7: Ingabe kunamathuba angaphezulu okuphucwa umhlaba? Impendulo: Yebo, kunamathuba amaningi okuphucwa umhlaba, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyela nezokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuhlanganiswa kwemiphakathi, nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile, konke lokhu kungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuphuculeni izimo zabantu. --- Umbuzo 8: Yini eyenza kube nzima ukuqeda ubandlululo? Impendulo: Ukuqeda ubandlululo kubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokungabikhona kokuxolelwa phakathi kwabantu, izinkolelo ezijulile, kanye nezinhlelo eziphikisanayo. Umphakathi kumele ube nokuzimisela nokuhlanganyela ukuze ufeze uguquko olukhulu, futhi kube nokuhlonipha wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga babo. --- Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngekusasa lokuphucwa umhlaba? Impendulo: Ikusasa lokuphucwa umhlaba lidinga umsebenzi oqhubekayo. Ukuxhaswa ngemali, izinhlelo zokwakha umnotho, kanye nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi esebenzisanayo kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, izimboni, nezinhlangano zikahulumeni kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. --- Umbuzo 10: Yini eyinhloko okumele sikhumbule uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sobandlululo? Impendulo: Okubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphucwa umhlaba akupheli, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Umqondo wokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha izinkolelo nemvelaphi yomunye nomunye kumele kube yinsika yethu. Umphakathi unamathuba amaningi okwakha ikusasa elingcono, futhi sonke sinesibopho sokuba yingxenye yokuphucula izimo zabanye. --- Ngale ndlela, ukuqonda ukuphucwa umhlaba ngesikhathi sobandlululo kubalulekile ukuze sithole imfundiso nezixazululo ezizosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono.
Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike Kwabanye (GEMS Dependent Member Classification) Isingeniso Sanibonani, ngiyajabula ukukwazi lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngendaba ebalulekile yokuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye ngaphansi kweGEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqonde ukuthi amalungu ancike kwabanye, kanye nezimfuno zefomu elithile, zihlangene kanjani nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngicela ungithumele izinkinga, imibuzo, nemicabango ongase ube nayo. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqonda Uhlaka lweGEMS Ngaphambi kokuba sithinte ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu, kubalulekile ukuqonda uhlelo lweGEMS. GEMS, okuyisifinyezo seGovernment Employees Medical Scheme, iyisikhwama somshwalense wezempilo esihlinzeka ngozakwethu abasebenzi bakamasipala. Lolu hlelo luhlanganisa amalungu ahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nalabo abanezingane, abashadile, nabanye abantu abancike kumalungu. Ingxenye 2: Ubuhlobo phakathi kwamalungu ancike kwabanye Ukuqonda ubani ongena ngaphansi kwesigaba samalungu ancike kwabanye kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhilela ukuthi umqashi noma ilungu elikhulu lungathatha umthwalo wezidingo zempilo zabanye abantu, kuhlanganise izingane, abashadile, kanye nabanye abancike kumalungu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izimfuno zabo ukuze bahlale befakwe esicelweni seGEMS. Ingxenye 3: Uhlaka lokuhlukanisa amalungu Uhlaka lokuhlukanisa amalungu ancike kwabanye luqukethe izigaba ezithile, ezifana nabashadile, izingane, nabanye abancike kumalungu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu athola usizo olufanele nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Umama emsebenzini kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izingane zakhe zifakwe esicelweni seGEMS ukuze zikwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Ingxenye 4: Izinkinga ezivame ukubakhona Naphezu kokuhlukahluka kwezidingo, zikhona izinkinga ezivame ukubakhona. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, noma mhlawumbe nezinkinga zokuhlonza amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okuthola usizo lwezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu banakekele lokhu futhi bazi ukuthi bangakuthola kanjani ukwesekwa. Ingxenye 5: Ukubaluleka kokuhlola izidingo zomndeni Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu ancike kwabanye athola usizo olufanele, kubalulekile ukuhlola izidingo zomndeni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqonda ukuthi ubani ongena ngaphansi kwesigaba samalungu ancike kwabanye, okuholela ekutheni abantu baqonde kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ingxenye 6: Ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza Kubhalwe kahle ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi banganikela kanjani izicelo zokuhlukaniswa. Lokhu kuhilela ukufaka izicelo ezisemthethweni, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, kanye nokulandela izinyathelo ezinzima. Amanye amalungu angase akuthole kalula ukwesekwa uma ethola ukuqonda kahle indlela yokufaka izicelo. Ingxenye 7: Ukubambisana nezinsiza zeGEMS GEMS inikeza izinsiza ezithile ezisiza amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nemihlangano yokwazisa. Kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu ahlanganyele kulezi zinsiza ukuze aqhubeke efunda futhi ethole ulwazi olufanele. Isiphetho Ngokuvamile, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye ngaphansi kweGEMS kudinga ukuqonda okujulile. Abantu kufanele baqonde izimfuno zabo, bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani izinsiza, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bekwazi ukufaka izicelo ezisemthethweni. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu, futhi wonke amalungu ancike kwabanye azokwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele. Ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukuqhubeka nalesi sihloko esibalulekile.
uBafana Bafana: Umbiko Ngemisebenzi Nezimpumelelo zonyaka ongu-2023 Ukwakha imbali yeqembu lemidlalwano yeqhawe laseNingizimu Afrika, uBafana Bafana, kudinga ukugxila emhlabeni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emlandweni nasezimpumelelweni zabo. Ngonyaka ka-2023, uBafana Bafana ubhekane nezinselele ezithokozisayo, izinhlelo zokwenza kahle, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo eqhubekayo. Kuqala, akumele silibale izikhathi eziyinhloko zeqembu, ezazihlanganisa nemidlalo yeziqongo, izifundo ezivela emqedweni nasekuphumuleni okubuhlungu. UJesse Lingard, umqeqeshi omusha ozinikele, ubhajwe ngoMfumfu ka-2022, washintsha umehluko kwezokwakha iqembu. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuhlela kahle isikhala somphakathi ludale umoya omuhle phakathi kwabadlali, kwenze kuhambisane ezicini eziningi zomphakathi. UMqeqeshi Lingard uholele uBafana Bafana ekuzuzeni umphumela omuhle emidlalweni yeCAF Africa Cup of Nations. Ukubambana phakathi kwabadlali abasha nabadala kube yinsika yokuphumelela, kanti izinjongo ezibekiwe nohlaka lwemidlalo ziqhubekile. Umdlalo obalulekile okhumbuleka kakhulu okwenzeka ngoMsombuluko oshiye iNingizimu Afrika ilungiselela iCameroun, kube yindlela yokuhlola amakhono okuphumelela kwegoli. Ukuze uBafana Bafana aqhubeke nokuhlonishwa, ukwenziwa kokuqeqeshwa okwakhelwe phezulu kuphumelele, lapho abadlali behlangene bezama izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza ndawonye. Uhlaka lwezemidlalo olwaziwayo luphinde lwengezwe, kanti imiphumela ibonisiwe nemidlalo eyinqaba. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhumbuzo zeqembu kulimaza uthando lwabantu emidlalweni, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuba neqiniso ngamaqhinga wezombusazwe. Ngokubheka ezikhathini ezizayo, uBafana Bafana uzophinde uthole ithuba lokubambisana nezinye izindawo zezemidlalo. Uhlaka lwezokuxhumana luncike kwi-inthanethi, okuholela ekubumbumeni okwandayo kwabadlali nezinhlangano ezahlukene. Imibiko ethuthukisiwe izosiza ekuqhathaniseni ukuchuma kweqembu elikhulayo, empumelelweni nasekufundeni kwezifundo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubusuku bokudumisa ubuhlakani beqembu buphumelele ngokuphuma kwezinye izikhumbuzo emhlabeni jikelele. Izithombe ezikhumbulekayo zomphakathi zikhombisa ukuthi uBafana Bafana ujoyine izilaleli ezithokozisayo. Ukwakhiwa kokwakhiwa kwezikhumbuzo zomphakathi, ulwazi olunembile nolufanele, kuhumusha impumelelo yeqembu, okubuyisela ezikhaleni ezithakazelisayo. Ngenhlanhla, iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukuthola abalandeli abasha, abavuma ukunakekela imidlalo yeBafana Bafana. Ukulandelana kwemidlalo ehlukahlukene kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi umphakathi othanda umoya omnandi wokudlalela umphako. Umhlangano wezokuxhumana phakathi kwabadlali nabalandeli kusebenza njengesithakazelo sokwakha umphakathi onokholo. Naphezu kwezinselele, uBafana Bafana ubonise amandla okuqhamuka nezinsiza zokuqinisa isikhumbuzo somphakathi. Izimiso zokusebenza ezihlala zikhona ekubhekeni impumelelo yeqembu kubalulekile, kusukela ocwaningweni, ukuhlinzeka ngezimpumelelo ezithile, kuya ekwakhiweni komnotho wezimali. Lokhu kuzinza izindlela zokuqhubeka nokwaziwa kwezokudlala. Ekugcineni, uBafana Bafana uqhubeka uhlanganyela imijikelezo emisha phakathi kokuphumelela, ubonisa izimpilo zabadlali abanesibindi, umoya wokuzikhandla, nokwengeza kuzo zonke izinselelo zempilo. Ukwakhiwa komndeni obumbene phakathi kwezithameli, ukudalwa kwamathuba omphakathi, nokwaziswa komikhankaso yokufinyelela izindinganiso, konke lokhu kuyisinyathelo esiqinile sokuphumelela. Ubuhlakani bokudlala, izinzuzo zeqembu, kanye nezikhulu ezazibonisa umbono ophezulu, kukhuthaza uBafana Bafana ukuba ube yizwe elibukekayo emhlabeni. Umoya wokuphumelela uvula izindlela ezintsha, ezikhuthaza umphakathi, nokuqhubekela phambili eminyakeni ezayo. Lokhu kuza neqhaza lokwenza uBafana Bafana ibe yizinkanyezi ohlangothini lwezokuphumula kukanyoko. Ngamafuphi, uBafana Bafana usezandleni ezinhle, usesithokoziseni ngezindlela ezijulile zokuzithokozisa, nezinzile. Izinhlelo ezinkulu zikhona, kanti imizamo yokwakha ibhuloho kulindeleke ukuba idlule ezimfuneko, zakhela uBafana Bafana impumelelo ewusizo neqhubekayo. Bese kuba nesikhala esikahle sokuphumelela emkhakheni wezokudlalela, uBafana Bafana kulindeleke ukuthi ibonakale njengeqembu elikhulu, elikhombisa umqondo oqinile wokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngemidlalo ezokhuthaza ubuholi, uthando, nezizathu eziyinhloko zokuphumelela.
Isithombe 4: Ubulili obukhulu buqhamuka ngenxa yezinambuzane ezitsheni. Uma lezi zinambuzane ziningi kakhulu, ukukhiqiza izitshalo kungase kungabi nezinzuzo. Kukhona kuphela izinambuzane ezimbalwa ezitsheni esingathi zinkinga - eziningi azinabungozi ezitsheni. Izinambuzane ezingadala ubungozi yilezo ezivame ukudla okusanhlamvu okukhulisiwe, izitshalo ezincane, izithombo ezivela, izitshalo ezikhulayo, imizi, noma ukudla okukhulayo. Ukuphatha izinambuzane kuhilela ukusebenzisa ama-pesticides (imikhiqizo emibi ebulala izinambuzane), ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi esifanele, kanye nenani elifanele le-pesticide - ikakhulukazi ukufaka i-pesticide ethile eqondile ezinamabala athile. Kukhona i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ebulala zonke izinambuzane ezidla izitshalo. Uma usebenzisa le pesticide, uzothola imiphumela emihle. Kufanele uhlanganise izindlela ezahlukene ukuze ulawule izinambuzane ngempumelelo. Le nhlanganisela izosiza ukuvimbela ukukhula kwezinambuzane ezivame ukubangela ubungozi ezitsheni zakho. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinambuzane ezidla okusanhlamvu nezitshalo ezincane, njengokuthi: ama-cutworms, ama-beetles anemibala, nezinye. Lezi zinambuzane zinciphisa inani lezitshalo ezikhulayo - uma zingaphathwa kahle, kuzodingeka ukufaka kabusha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi kemikhali kufanele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kulawulwe izinambuzane ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha lezi zinkinga akubizi kakhulu kodwa kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ukuvimbela ukuthi zidalule ubungozi ezikhathini zokuqala zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukulima ebusika kuzophinde kusize ukubulala izinambuzane eziningi ngoba ebusika zihlala ezinsalela zezithombo ezishiywe emasimini. Uma zihlala ngaphandle kwezitshalo eziphilayo izinsuku eziyi-35, izinkinga eziningi ezidalwa lezi zinambuzane zizokwenyuka. Izimpande ezizofakwa zingaphathwa ngama-pesticides noma i-pesticide ingafakwa emhlabathini lapho kufakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokufaka ibhodi emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Insimu ingaphinde iphonswe nge-pesticide efanele. I-corn earworm (astylus atromaculatus), i-cutworm (agrotis segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ifile (protostrophus sulcatifrons), kanye nama-harpalus beetles angadala ubungozi obukhulu ezitsheni, futhi inani lezitshalo ezinhle lingancipha ngaphandle kokuthola inzuzo. I-African bollworm (helicoverpa armigera) idala umonakalo emqondweni wezithombo futhi ingavula ithuba lokungena kwe-fungus rhizopus microsporus. Izinambuzane ezifana ne-nysius nataensis zingaphinde zidle okusanhlamvu kwezitshalo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-pesticides abhalisiwe ukuze abulale izinambuzane ezahlukene. Kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezinambuzane ezibanga ubungozi. Bese ukwazi ukukhetha i-pesticide efanele - qaphela ukufaka i-pesticide ngokwezincazelo nasemazweni afanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezinambuzane kanye nosayizi bezitshalo. Ukufaka ama-pesticides kungavimbela ukwehla kokukhiqiza, kodwa umlimi kufanele abe nekhono ngoba kuhilela izindleko. Kufanele kuhlolwe kahle lapho izinambuzane zidalula ubungozi obukhulu, noma kungase kubize kakhulu ngaphandle kokusiza ngoba izindleko zizodlula inzuzo. Akukuhle ukuhluza izitshalo uma izinambuzane zingakabangi ubungozi obukhulu. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi kukhona abaphangi bemvelo abakhokhela ezinye izinambuzane. Uma uhluza kakhulu, lezi zinyoni ezidla izinambuzane zizobulawa, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi izinambuzane zizojwayela i-pesticide uma ifakwa njalo futhi ngeke zife. Imikhakha nayo iyingozi futhi ibulala umhlabathi, ngakho kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela uma kudingeka kakhulu. Ukulima ngaphambi kokufaka kusiza ukuvimbela ubungozi bezinambuzane. Nokho, inani lezinambuzane kufanele lilawulwe njalo ukuze izindleko zikwazi ukuphathwa ngempumelelo. Ngokuvamile, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokuvikela ubungozi bezinambuzane - sebenzisa indlela ehambisana nohlobo lwezinambuzane ngesikhathi esifanele sezitshalo ezithile. Ukuphatha izinambuzane kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezitshalo ngoba kuzokhombisa ukuthi kuzoba khona inzuzo ekulimaleni nasekukhiqizeni noma cha. Izifo zezithombo zinciphisa inani kanye nekhwalithi yokukhiqiza futhi zingaba yingozi empilweni yezimpahla nasemakhosini uma zisetshenziswa. Izifo zezithombo zidalwa ikakhulukazi ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus. Lezi zingalimaza zonke izingxenye zesitshalo - imizi, iziqu, amahlamvu, izimbali, kanye nezimpande ezidliwayo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezifo zidinga izimo ezahlukene ukuze zikhule. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma sithintana nezimo zezulu kanye nendawo, uma kukhona isitshalo esifanele futhi isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingathiwa ziwumgogodla wokuhlasela kwesifo. Uma eyodwa iphuthuma, isifo ngeke sikhule futhi sithinte. Isifo esithile esingase sibe khona endaweni ethile kulo nyaka singase singabi khona kule ndawo ngonyaka ozayo uma isimo sendawo nezimo zezulu zihluka kulonyaka. Ngenxa yokubambezeleka okukhulu ekuqaleni kokufaka izitshalo, kuvame ukuba kunzima ukuphatha lezi zifo ngamakhemikhali ngoba kubiza kakhulu. Ezinye izifo zihlala zikhona kodwa azikhuli ngoba azithintani nesitshalo noma nezimo zezulu. Izifo ziphathwa ngokuqapha nezindlela zokuvikela. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izifo ngokuqapha. Kukhona izinhlobo zezithombo ezikhuliswe ukuze zibe nekhono lokumelana nezifo ezithile. Le nselelo yesitshalo ibhekisela ekulweni nesifo esithile; akusho ukuthi ezinye izifo ngeke zilimaze lelo sitshalo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi iyiphi isifo evame ukubangela ubungozi endaweni yakho bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungamelana naleso sifo. Ukuphatha ngamakhemikhali kusho ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ukuze ubulale izifo ezithile ze-fungal nezamabhaktheriya ezimweni ezithile. Kufanele ucabange kahle ngentengo yokuthenga i-pesticide - kungase kube kuhle ukufuna iseluleko kumeluleki wezokulima ukuze uthole izeluleko mayelana nokusebenzisa amakhemikhali athile. Ukulima umhlabathi kungaba yinto ebalulekile uma uzama ukuphatha izifo - ezinye izifo zihlala ezinsaleni ezishiywe emasimini, ngakho kufanele wazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona futhi ukhethe indlela efanele yokulima umhlabathi. Ukuguqula izinhlobo zezithombo kusho ukuhlinzeka isikhathi sokuthi izinsalela ezishiywe emasimini ziqhume. Kubalulekile ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezithanda yiziphi izitshalo bese ubhekana nalolu daba ngokushintsha izinhlobo zezithombo ozifakayo. Isikhathi sokufaka sithinta futhi ukukhula kwesifo esithile - ukufaka masinyane noma ngemuva kwesikhathi kungavimbela isifo esithile ekukhuleni nasekubangeleni ubungozi. Ingxenye ethile edala ubunzima ekukhuleni kwezithombo ingashintsha indlela izifo ezikhula ngayo. Izinto ezidalayo ubunzima ek
Ingxoxo Ngama-Internship Abafundi Abaphothule Umxhumanisi: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba nithumele le ngxoxo. Namuhla sizoxoxa ngezindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule. Ngicela ungazise ngamagama akho kanye nendawo ovela kuyo. Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngiyinhloko ye-Institutions for Learning, ngisebenza ekuphathweni kwama-internship kubafundi abaphothule. Ngivela eGoli. Umxhumanisi: Kulungile, ngizokubuza umbuzo wokuqala. Yini eyenza ama-internship abalulekile kubafundi abaphothule? Umphenyi: Ama-internship abalulekile ngoba anikeza abafundi ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi abaluqoqile esikhathini sokufunda. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba bakhulise amakhono abo, bathole ulwazi olujulile emkhakheni abawuthandayo, futhi bathole ithuba lokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene emsebenzini. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona izindlela ezithile abafundi abangazisebenzisa ukuze bathole ama-internship? Umphenyi: Yebo, kunezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, abafundi bangavakashela amawebhusayithi ezinkampani ezithanda ukuhlinzeka ngama-internship. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkampani ezinkulu nezincane. Okwesibili, bangasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala ezikoleni zabo, njengokuxhumana nabafundisi noma izikhungo zokusebenza. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana nabantu emkhakheni ofanele kungasiza kakhulu; kungaba ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana noma izenzakalo zomphakathi. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyindlela enhle. Ngabe kukhona izinkinga ezivamile abafundi abahlangabezana nazo lapho befuna ama-internship? Umphenyi: Yebo, kunezinkinga ezithile. Abafundi bavame ukuthola ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ulwazi oluthile, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abasha. Futhi, abanye abafundi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhlela isikhathi sabo, ikakhulukazi uma benemisebenzi eminingi. Ukuntuleka kokuzethemba nakho kungaba yinkinga, njengoba abanye abafundi bezwa ukuthi abakwazi ukufaka izicelo. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kucacile. Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokuthi abafundi bangakwenza kanjani ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi baphumelela ekutholeni ama-internship? Umphenyi: Ngiyavuma. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezincwadi ezinhle zokufaka isicelo, kubandakanya i-CV ne-portfolio. Lokhu kufanele kube nezinhlaka ezichaza kahle amakhono, izifundo, nolwazi. Okwesibili, abafundi kufanele baqonde kahle izinkampani abafuna ukuzenzela ama-internship kuzo. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba bakhulume kahle ngesikhathi sokuhlangana. Okwesithathu, ukuhlela kahle isikhathi sokusebenza nokufunda kungasiza kakhulu. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungakhuluma kancane ngendima yokuxhumana nabantu emkhakheni we-internship? Umphenyi: Impela. Ukuxhumana nabantu kubalulekile kakhulu. Abafundi kufanele bazame ukwakha ubudlelwano nabantu abavela ezinkampanini, emiphakathini, noma ezikhungweni zemfundo. Lokhu kungabavulela amathuba amaningi, njengoba imisebenzi ivame ukuphakanyiswa kubantu abakwazi ukuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba emicimbini yokuxhumana, njengemihlangano nezinkulumo, kungasiza abafundi ukuba bazitholele amathuba amahle. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyisiphiwo esihle. Ingabe ungakuchaza ukuthi ama-internship angashintsha kanjani ikusasa labafundi? Umphenyi: Ngempela. Ama-internship angashintsha kakhulu ikusasa labafundi. Ngokuthola ulwazi oluqondile emsebenzini, abafundi bakwazi ukujula emkhakheni abawuthandayo, bathole izinzuzo ezithile zokusebenza, futhi baqonde kahle izidingo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthola imisebenzi emihle ngemva kokuphothula, njengoba izinkampani zikhumbula abantu abaneziqu ezithile. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungakukhumbuza ukuthi abafundi kufanele bakwenze kanjani ukuze baphumelele ngesikhathi se-internship? Umphenyi: Abafundi kufanele bahlale bephokophele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bephuthuma, bezimisele ukufunda, futhi baphendule kahle emisebenzini. Ukubambisana nabanye futhi ukusebenzisana nabaphathi kubalulekile. Futhi, kufanele bazame ukufaka iziphakamiso ezinhle, njengoba lokho kungabakhombisa njengabantu abakhathalelayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubafundi abaphothule? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi ama-internship awakhombisi kuphela amakhono abo, kodwa futhi akha izixhumanisi ezibalulekile. Bafanele bazimisele, baphokophele, futhi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Ukusebenza kanzima kuzobavulela iminyango eminingi. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngifisa ukuthi abafundi baphumelele ekutholeni ama-internship abawafunayo. Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyavuma. Ngithemba ukuthi le ngxoxo izosiza abafundi abaningi.
Ukungondleki Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo eMkhumbane, edolobhaneni elincane elisemaphandleni. Abantu baphila impilo yokusebenza kanzima, kodwa abanye babebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. UNomsa, intombazane encane enezinyanga eziyishumi nane, wayehlala nomama wakhe, uMavis, emzini omncane ophakathi kwezihlahla. UMavis wayengumama onothando, kodwa wayenkinga enkulu — uNomsa wayengatholi ukudla okwanele. Kusihlwa, uMavis wayehlala efaka uNomsa ebhedini, ethokozisa intombazane yakhe ngendaba ezimnandi. Kodwa uNomsa wayengakwazi ukufihla ubuhlungu obubangelwa ukungondleki. Umzimba wakhe wawubukeka ungaphatheki kahle, izitho zihlala zicindezelwe, futhi amehlo akhe abukeka engakhanyisiwe. UMavis wayezama konke okusemandleni akhe ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uNomsa uthola okuthile ukudla, kodwa izinsuku zazidlula, futhi izinsiza zazincipha. Ngolunye usuku, uMavis wahamba edolobheni eliseduzane ukuze athole umsebenzi. Wazama ukuthola okuthile okungamthokozisa, kodwa akuzange kube lula. UNomsa, esekhaya, wayedlala ngaphandle, kodwa wayezwa ubuhlungu besikhumba, futhi umoya wawumshaya ngendlela eyamkhathazayo. Wazama ukudlala, kodwa umuzwa wokukhathazeka wawuphakeme kakhulu. Ngemva kokubuyela, uMavis wathola uNomsa ehlale phansi, ebuka izinyoni zibhakela phezulu. "Ngiyazi, mntwanami," kusho uMavis, "ukudla akukhona okwanele, kodwa sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sithole okuthile." UNomsa wamamatheka, kodwa ubuhlungu obungaphakathi buphinde baphuma. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMavis waqala ukufuna izindlela zokuthola ukudla. Wavakashela emaphandleni, wakhuluma nabanye abantu, futhi wathola izitshalo ezithile ezazikhona. UNomsa wayejabule uma ebona umama wakhe ethokozile, kodwa wayehlala ezwa umuzwa wokunganeliseki. Ngelinye ilanga, uMavis wathola umngani wakhe, uThandi, owayenokudla okuthile. UThandi wayenothando, futhi wayefuna ukusiza. "Ngabe ungathanda ukusiza uNomsa?" ubuze uThandi. UMavis waphendula, "Ngiyabonga, Thandi. UNomsa udinga ukudla okungcono." UThandi wanikela ngamaswidi, izithelo, nezitshalo ezithile. UNomsa wathokozisa kakhulu, futhi wabona umama wakhe ejabule. Lokhu kwenza umama noNdodana bakwazi ukujabulisa izinsuku zabo. Kodwa uMavis wayazi ukuthi lokhu kwakungeyona isixazululo esiqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMavis waqala ukufunda ngezindlela zokutshala izitshalo. Wafunda ukuthi izitshalo zidinga umhlaba, amanzi, kanye nokunakekelwa. Waqala ukutshala izitshalo ezincane emakhaya, futhi uNomsa waba neqhaza ekukhuliseni. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokuthi uNomsa afunde futhi akhule. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izitshalo zakhula, futhi uMavis noNomsa baqala ukuthola ukudla okwanele. UNomsa waqala ukubonakala engcono, izitho zakhe zanda, futhi amehlo akhe aqala ukukhanya. Umama wakhe waba nezenzo ezinhle, futhi uNomsa waba nomuzwa wokuthi impilo yabo iyashintsha. Ngesikhathi esithile, uMavis noNomsa baqala ukwenza izifundo zokudla. Babefunda ngezindlela zokupheka, ukulungisa ukudla, nokubaluleka kokudla okunempilo. UNomsa wathola ukuthi ukudla akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Waqala ukujabulela ukudla, futhi umama wakhe waba nesizotha. Ekugcineni, uNomsa waba yintombazane enempilo, enothando, futhi ethokozile. UMavis wabona ukuthi ukungondleki akukhona nje ukungabi nokudla, kodwa kuyinkinga ebonakalayo. Waqonda ukuthi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo kudinga ukubambisana, uthando, nokukhuthazela. Ukwakha isisekelo esiqinile, uMavis noNomsa baqala ukusiza abanye abantu emzaneni.
