Bafundisa abantu ngendlela yokutshala, ukulungisa ukudla, nokubaluleka kokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNomsa waba yisibonelo sokuthi impilo ingashintsha. Ukungondleki kwaba yinto eyaziwa, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempilo. UNomsa noMavis bahlala bejabulile, futhi umphakathi waba yindawo yokuphila, uthando, nokukhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNomsa waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo, owayekwazi ukusiza abanye. Waqonda ukuthi impilo ayinakho ukungondleki kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuthi impilo ingashintsha, futhi ukungondleki akukona ukuphela, kodwa kungaba yithuba lokukhula. Ukwazi ukuthi uMavis noNomsa baphumelele, umphakathi waba yindawo yokuphila, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izimpilo ezinhle. UNomsa waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngothando, ukhuthazo, nokubambisana, singakwazi ukuphila kahle. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphila, futhi uNomsa noMavis baqhubeka nokukhula, behlanganyela, futhi bejabulela impilo.
Ukusungula uhlaka olulodwa lokulawula ukudluliswa kukagesi, igesi emaphethelweni, kanye nezimboni zegesi zezimoto zokukhanyisa; nokuhlinzeka ngemicimbi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla Waziswa njengento enomthetho. Umthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla uqukethe amalungu amathathu aphezulu kanye namalungu amahlanu wesikhashana aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhethe elinye lamalungu aqokwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 njengomholi woMthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla. UNgqongqoshe kumele aqokwe omunye wamalungu aphezulu ukuze abhekane ngqo nokulawula ugesi, omunye wokulawula igesi, kanti omunye wokulawula amaphethini. Uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe nganoma iyiphi indlela, amalungu amanye kumele akhethe omunye phakathi kwabo ukuze abe umholi kuze kube umholi angabuyela emisebenzini yakhe noma omunye umholi aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angakwazi futhi ukuqoka ilungu; futhi uma ilungu lesikhashana noma eliphelele leMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla linqamuka emsebenzini nganoma iyiphi indlela, uNgqongqoshe angakwazi ukuqoka omunye umuntu endaweni yalo isikhathi esingadluli ezinyangeni eziyishumi nambili ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67. Amalungu eMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele akhokhelwe ngemiholo nezinzuzo njengoba kunqunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezithakazelo mayelana nalolu daba. Ngendlela eqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanele phakathi kokuphindaphinda nokukwazi ukwakha. Ilungu kumele lingabi khona nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ezingxoxweni, ekwenzeni izinqumo, noma lithathe ingxenye kunoma iyiphi indaba phambi kweMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla lapho ilungu noma umkakhe, umlingani, ingane, noma umuntu abambisene naye ngothando ngqo noma ngokuqondile kubandakanyeka. Uma ilungu lithola noma likholelwa ukuthi lingase libe nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungelo kumele lishaywe uNgqongqoshe kanye neMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ngokubhalwe phansi. Uma beshadile noma behlala nomuntu impilo yabo yonke othola noma okholelwa ukuthi ungase ube nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungelo kumele lishaywe uNgqongqoshe kanye neMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ngokubhalwe phansi. Ngaphambi kokuba uNgqongqoshe aqoke ilungu leMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla, uNgqongqoshe kumele, ngokuqaphela kwiGazethi, acela ukuthi abanguqobo bakhethwe phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Isaziso esishicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale lo Mthetho, sicela ukukhethwa kwabantu bokuqala abazokwakhiwa kuMthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla, kufanele sithathwe njengokushicilelwa ngempela ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7. Lokhu kuphula isivumelwano sokwenza umsebenzi ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho noma uMthetho Wegesi noma uMthetho Wamaphethini ukuze kukhanyiswe; noma kukhishwa ekubeni ilungu nganoma yiziphi zezizathu ezikhuluma esigabeni 6 1. UNgqongqoshe angakwazi ukuvalela umsebenzi walungu leMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla uma lelo lungelo lenza ngendlela ephikisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 9. Imihlangano yeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla a Imithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele ihlangane ngezikhathi nezindawo ezinqunywe ngumholi. b Umholi uzobiza imihlangano yeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqhutshekwe kahle nemisebenzi yayo. Umholi, uma esethole isicelo esibhaliwe esivela kumphathi ophakeme noma kumalungu amabili, uzobiza umhlangano okhethekile ozobanjwa phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili zokuthola leso sicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ezinye izinqubo zisetshenziswe, umholi wanoma yimuphi umhlangano weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele uphakamise izinqubo ezizolandela kulawo mahlangano. I-quorum yomhlangano weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ibandakanya iningi lamalungu akhona noma amalungu amane, noma yikuphi okukhulu. a Isinqumo seningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni simele isinqumo seMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla. b Uma ukuvota kuhlangana kunoma iyiphi indaba, umuntu ophatha umhlangano unelungelo lokuvota elengeziwe ngaphandle kokuba nelungelo lokuvota. Akukho isinqumo esenziwe yiMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla esizoba sephukile ngenxa yokuba khona kwesikhala kuMthetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla noma ngenxa yokuthi omunye umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala njengelungu ubekhona njengelungu ngesikhathi isinqumo sithathwa uma wonke amalungu amanye abekhona emhlanganweni futhi enelungelo lokuhlala njengamalungu emhlanganweni, ngaleyo ndlela kwakha i-quorum futhi isinqumo sathathwa ngaphezulu kwamalungu akhona futhi anelungelo lokuvota. Umphathi ophakeme noma, uma engatholakali, umsebenzi weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla oqokwe umphathi ophakeme, kumele abe khona kuwo wonke imihlangano yeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla futhi kumele abe nelungelo lokukhuluma kodwa angavoti kulawo mahlangano. a Noma yimuphi umhlangano weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele uvumele umphakathi ukuba ube khona ngaphandle uma umhlangano unquma ukuthi indaba ezoxoxwa iyimfihlo, noma ulwazi olunobungozi mayelana nokubambisana, lapho-ke umuntu othintekayo kumele azise iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ukuthi ulwazi olunjalo lungafanele lukhululwe emphakathini. b Uma iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ithatha isinqumo nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle komhlangano osemthethweni, leso sinqumo sithatha umthelela ngokushesha kodwa kumele sibhale, sigcwaliswe ngamalungu amaningi, futhi sithunyelwe ukuze siqinisekiswe emhlanganweni wokuqala osemthethweni weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kulandela leso sinqumo. c I-Mithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele ibe nesizathu sokugcina amarekhodi wonke emisebenzi yayo. Uhlelo lwegesi; kanye iii Akukho Mthetho Wamaphethini wokukhanyisa. e abangenakufinyelela noma ukuhoxisa ekuvoteni noma ekuxoxeni nganoma iyiphi indaba ethinta iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla abanakho ukungenelela ngqo noma ngokuqondile; futhi f ukwenza njengoba kudingeka futhi kulindeleke kubabambisene bezikhundla zomphakathi. t ngokubhalwe phansi; futhi g ngokuchaza kahle ukuze kusekelwe kuMthetho kanye nezinto nezizathu zalokho. Noma yisiphi isinqumo seMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kanye nezizathu zaso kumele zivezwe emphakathini ngaphandle uma iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla inquma ukuthi imfihlo, iyabucayi, iyathengiswa, noma iyimakethe. Noma ubani othintekile ngempela ngezinsizakalo zeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla angakwazi ukulethela lezi zinqumo ukuze zihlolwe eNkantolo Ephakeme. I-Mithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele iqoke umphathi ophakeme weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla. b Ukuze uqashe abasebenzi noma ungene ezivumel
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwezifundo Zesayensi Ekuqaleni, eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane eziningi edlule, abantu babebhekene nemibuzo eminingi mayelana nezinto ezibazungezile. Bafuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani izinkanyezi zikhanya, kungani izitshalo zikhula, nokuthi yini eyenza izimo zezulu zishintshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baqale ukwenza izifundo ezithile, okwakuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, imvelo, nezifundo zezenzakalo. Ngaleso sikhathi, abaphenyi bokuqala, njenge-Aristotle no-Plato, baqala ukucabanga ngezinto ezithile, benza izincazelo ezilula kodwa ezibalulekile. Isahluko 2: Ukuvela Kwezibalo Nezibalo Zesayensi Ngemva kokudlula eminyakeni, izifundo zesayensi zathuthuka kakhulu. Kwakukhona abaphenyi abanjengo-Euclid no-Pythagoras, ababephakamisa izimiso ezibalulekile zezimali nezibalo. Lezi zifundo zaba yisisekelo sokwakha izimiso ezinzima, ezasiza ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithile. Ngaleso sikhathi, izibalo zaba yinsika ebalulekile ezesayensi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abaphenyi bangakwazi ukwenza izibalo ezithile ukuze baqonde imvelo. Isahluko 3: I-Scientific Revolution Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, phakathi nekhulu le-16 ne-17, kwavela ushintsho olukhulu olwaziwa ngokuthi i-Scientific Revolution. Abaphenyi abanjengo-Galileo Galilei no-Isaac Newton baqala ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezisemthethweni, behlola imithetho yemvelo ngendlela engakaze ibonwe. U-Galileo, ngokwesibonelo, wathola ukuthi izinkanyezi zazingabantu, futhi u-Newton wathuthukisa umqondo we-gravity, okwakuholela ekutheni abantu baqonde kangcono izinqubo zemvelo. Isahluko 4: Ukuhlola Imvelo Ngemva kokuphumelela kwe-Scientific Revolution, abaphenyi baqala ukuhamba phambili ekutholeni ulwazi olusha. U-Charles Darwin, ngonyaka ka-1859, wakhuluma ngendaba yokuthuthukiswa kwezilwane nezitshalo, ethula umqondo wokuthi zonke izinto zikhula zishintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha umqondo we-evolution, owaba nomthelela omkhulu ezesayensi nasemphakathini. Isahluko 5: Izehlakalo Zesimanje Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izifundo zesayensi zathuthuka kakhulu, zafaka phakathi izifundo ezinjenge-chemistry, biology, ne-physics. U-Albert Einstein, ngonyaka ka-1905, wathuthukisa umqondo we-relativity, owashintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngendawo nesikhathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, okuhlanganisa nezinjini, izindiza, nezokuxhumana. Isahluko 6: Ukubheka Phambili Namuhla, ezesayensi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, zifaka phakathi izifundo ezinzima ezifana ne-genetics, nanotechnology, ne-astrophysics. Abaphenyi bahlola izinkanyezi ezikude, behlola imiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, futhi baphenya ngezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Lokhu kuhlola akugcini nje ngokuthola ulwazi, kodwa futhi kuhloswe nokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, ukugcina imvelo, nokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Isahluko 7: Isiphetho Ezesayensi zidlale indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wethu mayelana nemvelo. Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokucabanga, kuze kube namuhla, abantu bahlale befuna ukuqonda, behlola, futhi bethuthukisa ulwazi. Lokhu kuqhubeka kukhombisa ukuthi ezesayensi azigcini nje ngokuba yizifundo, kodwa ziba yindlela yokuphila, ziqinisekisa ukuthi sithola izixazululo eziphusile ezinkingeni ezibhekene nezenhlalo, ezomnotho, nezemvelo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlola, sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuqonda, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe, futhi sakhe umhlaba ongcono.
Impilo Yabafundi: Indaba Yomlando Kwakukhona isikhathi esithile lapho impilo yabafundi yayingekho nje kuphela emkhakheni wezokufunda, kodwa futhi yayihlanganisa nemicabango, izinselele, kanye nezifiso zomphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, abafundi babegcwele umoya wokuzimisela, befuna ukufunda, ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Iminyaka engama-1950, abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika babebhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, ezazihamba phambili emazweni ahlukahlukene. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babethwele kanzima ngenxa yokuhlukaniswa kwemibono kanye nemithetho yokwakha ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwamagugu. Kangangokuthi, imfundo yayingabantu abaningi ababehluleka ukungena ezikhathini ezijwayelekile. Noma kunjalo, kuhlanga lwabafundi, kwaqhamuka abantu abaziyo nezifiso ezinkulu zokuphungula lezi zinto. Ngalesi sikhathi, abafundi abavela ezikoleni ezahlukene bathutheleka eThekwini, eGoli, nasemhlabeni jikelele ukuze bathekelele izikole ezihamba phambili. Ubuchwepheshe bube bukhulu, obubuhlungu obwakuletha imithombo yokufunda eningilizayo, bese lokhu kudala umoya omusha phakathi kwabafundi. Abafundi babebona njengomsebenzi wabo ukunikeza igalelo emiphakathini yabo, okusho ukuthi, bekudinga ukuthi baze baphikise izimo ezingezinhle ezibhekene nabo. Kodwa-ke, impilo yabafundi akukhona nje ukugijima ezincwadini. Abafundi bahlala behlangana emicimbini yezokuthula, bephikisana nemithetho engahambisani nemigomo yabo. Lokhu kwakuholwa ngababefundi abanjengoSteve Biko, owayeyisigodi sokukholwa ekusebenzeni nsuku zonke. Isikhumbuzo somkhosi omkhulu sokuphikisa ubuphofu behleli endaweni yokubhalela izivivinyo ezazihlala ziphansana; abadala babezama ukuzibandakanya, kambe abafundi babezothi: “Ngempela, sikhumbula imihla ephakeme”. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abafundi baqala ukwakha amabhande okukhumbula, umphakathi wawuzothi abavukile, bazonothola ngesikhathi esithile uma beziphatha kahle. Izijobelelo zomphakathi zanda lapho abafundi bezithokozisa ngezimpumelelo zabo, befundisa abasha indlela yokuphila ngempumelelo. Le mibhikisho emisha yaphinde yazuza ukunwaya okujabulisayo phakathi kwabafundi nakwabashayeli, okwakuhambelana kahle nokubukeka kwabo. Emakhulwini amasha, imfundo yaba yindlela yokulwela amalungelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izikhungo zokucwaninga nezemfundo, nendlela yokwakha izibonelo ezinhle zezimali zokukcredita kwabafundi elizweni. Abafundi babethola ukuthi udumo lozimele, imisebenzi yabo yayiqhubeka. Abafundi baqala ukubona ukuthi kungcono baqhubeke bephikisana, behlanganisa imizamo yabo ngaphandle kokudangala. Naphezu kokuphikisana okukhulu phakathi kwemibono, abasha baqhubeka bephila impilo yazo. Ukuzongena ezinhlelweni zezenhlalakahle kwenkosi kwi Afrika, impilo yabanemibono emisha yakuqala ukufezwa okuthembisayo. Kanjalo, abahlali bezikole babefunda еmiphakathini, bakha izindlela eziphumelela, baphendule abafundi abavela kwezinye izindawo ukuze bathole isikhala, lokho kwadonsa ubudlova obukulu. Izinkanyezi zikhanya emkhakheni wemfundo, abafundi bakwazi ukuwa beshaya umoya ngezinjongo ezivela emafutheni ahlukahlukene. Umsebenzi wobudlelwano bezenhlalakahle wayeqhubeka, ukwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi nakumafundisi. Bakhuthazwe ukuba bathole indlela yokusebenza, bebambisana ukuze bathole impumelelo ezindaweni ezikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wasuke wabona izijobelelo ezimbi ezavela emakhempini omphakathi, imibono eyayithokozisa izinsiza zempilo yomphakathi kwaholela ekukwakheni uhlobo olusha lwezinye izinhlelo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokubamba izanda ezazibhalwe emhlabeni wonke, yimuphi umoya ophakeme abaqhamuka nawo ebudlelwaneni bomphakathi nawo. Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, abahlali bezikole baphuma bahamba eminyakeni edlule, bayithola ithuba lokwandisa izinkumbulo zabo ezinhle ezikhombisa izifundo ezithuthukayo. Ngalokhu, impilo yabafundi yaphenduka, kuhlanganiswe izishoshovu ezihlala zenza umhlaba ube yindawo engcono kakhulu yokuhlala. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi, impilo yabafundi ibonakala iyinto edlulelwa phambili lapho abalimi besikhathi esizayo besebenzisa konke abakufundile. Le ndaba yama-Afrika ayisiyona nje oduma nalokho, isibonelo sokuthi abantu badinga ukuncedisana, bazimisele, futhi baqhubeke nokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono—ngokuhamba kwabo, impilo yabo, neqhaza elinamandla abakubeka emkhakheni wezeMfundiso. Emhlabeni ohlangene, impilo yabafundi iyinsika yokukhanya, ebonisa ukuthi isifiso sokufunda, sokuba umholi, nokuqhubeka nokukhula akupheli. Lokhu kuphila, lokhu kuthutsa, ukuhlwitha okukhulu kwempumelelo—lezi yizinto ezizophinde zikhumbuleke, zifakwa emikhumbulweni yokuphila emisha yabaninimithi lemiyalo emisha ehloselwe ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, impilo yabafundi ayikhaliphe lesi sikhumbuzo, kodwa ikafula ezigabeni zempilo, izinselele, nezimpumelelo eziba yingxenye yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophila ngempumelelo.
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Uhlanga Lokuthuthukiswa Nezimphetho Zokufundisa Ukwazi umhlaba wemidlalo yevidiyo kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, njengoba lezi zinhlelo zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yosuku nosuku. Imidlalo yevidiyo yemukelwa kakhulu, futhi isakaza umqondo wezokuxhumana, ukuzijabulisa, kanye nezifundo kumalungu omphakathi. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuhle nemiphumela emibi yemidlalo yevidiyo, kubalulekile ukuqonda umlando wazo, izakhiwo zabo, kanye nendlela ezisiza ngayo ekwakheni amakhono ahlukene kubadlalayo. Imidlalo yevidiyo iqale ukuvela emashumini eminyaka edlule, igxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezikwi-computer ezisebenza ngezithombe ezihambelayo. Ngokuvamile, lezi zinhlelo zaziwe ngekhwalithi yayo yokusebenza, ukudala umoya wokudlala, nokusebenza kube yinto ephawulekayo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, imidlalo yevidiyo yanwetshwa yaba nezinhlobo eziningi, okuhlanganisa imidlalo yezenzakalo, imidlalo yokudlala ngempumelelo, imidlalo yokuhlola, kanye nezinhlobo ezivamile ezisebenziyo, okwenza kumenyezelwe izithombe ezihlukahlukene. Kubalulekile futhi ukufaka izici zamakhono ekudlaleni kwemidlalo yevidiyo. Imidlalo ethuthukisa amakhono kufanele ihlukaniswe phakathi kwemidlalo ethuthukisa umcabango, efana nemidlalo yokuhlola, nokuthi imidlalo ethokozisayo, efana nemidlalo yokulwa. Imidlalo ethuthukisa umcabango ifaka phakathi izinhlelo ezicacile zokusebenzisa izinqumo ezithuthukile, izixazululo zezinkinga, nokwenza ngcono ukucabanga okulungile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukufana nezindlela ezivamile zokufundisa, okusho ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ingasetshenziswa njengendlela yokufundisa ehloniphekile nempumelelo. Ikakhulukazi, imidlalo yevidiyo idlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ngokubandakanya abantu emidlalweni, kudaleka ithuba lokuxhumana, ukubambisana, nokwakha imiphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza ngokujulile emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, lapho imidlalo yevidiyo ingasetshenziswa njengendlela yokuxhumana okwakha ubuhlobo obujulile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Izinkundla zokuxhumana nezingosi zokuxhumana, ezikhiqiza imiphakathi, zakhayo ukukhulisa ukuthi abantu bangaba sezinhlakeni ezahlukene. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhanyayo. Imidlalo yevidiyo, lapho ibonakala njengewumbuso wokuzijabulisa, ibuye ibe nezingcuphe nemiphumela emibi. Ukuze kube neqhaza lokukhula, kunemithetho ethile okufanele ilandelwe. Ukudlala isikhathi eside kungaholela ekukhubazeni, ukwenza abantu baxhamaze kakhulu, futhi kuphazamise imikhuba yokuziphatha. Ngaphakathi kwalesi simo, kubalulekile ukuba nemikhawulo ethile yokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlola izimo zomphakathi nabantu abadlalayo kuye kwakhomba ukuthi imidlalo ethile ingaba nomthelela ongemuhle ekuziphatheni kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziqathaniswa nezimo ezithile ezinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola ngokucophelela, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ukuthi izici zokuhluka zihlala zikhona phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yevidiyo ifaka izifundo ezibucayi empilweni yethu, futhi kubalulekile ukunakekela izici ezintathu eziyinhloko: ukwakhiwa kwezimo zokuxhumana, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, nokuhlola imiphumela emibi. Ubulungiswa bokusebenzisa imidlalo yevidiyo njengendlela yokufundisa, njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, kudinga ubuqotho, ukuqonda, kanye nomcabango ophusile. Ngokufaka imidlalo yevidiyo ezinhlelweni zethu zokufunda, sizokwazi ukuqhubeka nokuqonda nobuchwepheshe obuxhumene nempilo yansuku zonke ngokwenza isinqumo esifanele ngaphambi kokudlula emhlabeni ongokwemvelo. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yevidiyo iyinsika ebalulekile yokubambisana, ukufunda, nokwakha ubudlelwane. Ukuphuma esikhathini esedlule, bheka iziko lemidlalelo njengendlela eyodwa yokwakha ikusasa elihloniphekile, elinemibono, kanye nezeluleko ezihle. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukuhamba phambili ngengqondo yokufanisa, ukukhathalela, nokuhlonipha imiphakathi elokhu ibhalwa njalo. Imidlalo yevidiyo akuyona nje umculo wokuphila, kodwa iyinsika esiza ekwakheni umhlaba onobuchwepheshe nemigomo ecacile.
Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Umphakathi, Umnotho, Nezinkinga Abathengisi basemgwaqeni, noma abathengisi bezimpahla ezithengiswa emgwaqeni, bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu. Lezi zindawo zokuthengisa zihlala zikhanga abantu abaningi, zikhombisa ubuciko bokuphila kwansuku zonke, futhi zenza kube lula ukuthola ukudla, izimpahla, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola indima yabo emphakathini, umnotho, kanye nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Umphakathi Wabathengisi Basemgwaqeni Abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Bakhombisa ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izindawo zabo zokuthengisa zihlala zikhangisa imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, kusukela ekudleni okushisayo kuya ezimpahleni ezincane. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bavame ukuba nezinhlobonhlobo zezimpahla ezitholakalayo, okuvumela abantu abahlukene ukuba bathole lokho abakudingayo. Umnotho Wabathengisi Basemgwaqeni Ngokwezimali, abathengisi basemgwaqeni banendima enkulu emnothweni wendawo. Bakhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane. Abathengisi abaningi baphila ngokuthengisa, futhi lokhu kubanika ithuba lokwakha izimpilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphinde babe nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, njengoba bethengisa imikhiqizo yendawo, okukhuthaza ukuhweba phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Izinkinga Abahlangabezana Nazo Noma kunjalo, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu abahlangabezana nazo yizithiyo zomthetho. Ezinye izindawo zinezinqubomgomo ezinzima ezivimbela abathengisi ukuthi bathengise emigwaqeni, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhweba. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abathengisi bahlale bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi, futhi abanye baphinde bahlupheke ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala bephikisana nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Izimo zezulu, izinkinga zokuphepha, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala ziba yizithiyo ezinkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abathengisi babe nekhono lokuphila, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili naphezu kwezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, abathengisi basemgwaqeni bahlala beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu. Bakhombisa ubuciko bokuphila, benza kube lula ukuthola izimpahla ezidingekayo, futhi banomthelela omuhle emnothweni. Nokho, izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo zidinga ukunakwa, ukuze sikwazi ukuvuselela le ndima ebalulekile emphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izakhamuzi, kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni baphila kahle, futhi bakwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinzima. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolungele ikusasa.
Umphakathi umphathi uhlezi lapha namuhla ukuze agubhe usuku olubalulekile lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengoba sonke sazi ukuthi lesi yinyanga yethu yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, nakuba kuyinto esiyenzayo nsuku zonke, kodwa le nyanga ikakhulukazi iwukukhombisa. Siqale le nyanga ngempumelelo njengoba ngosuku lokuqala sibe nomcimbi wozukulu eMnambithi; futhi ngaphambi kwalokho, sibathumele ePhalamende. Ngiyafuna ukusho, njengomphakathi umphathi, ukuthi njengomnyango sinesikhumbuzo esiningi esisisebenzisayo emiphakathini yethu. Bheka nje unyaka wezezimali ka-2009/10, sinesikhumbuzo esisethulile ukusiza izingane ezingenabazali ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo njengabanye izingane emphakathini. Ngiyakwazi ukusho ngokuzethemba ukuthi umphakathi owakha izindawo eziphakathi nendawo esifundazweni (indawo yeMidlands) kanye nezindawo ezizungezile uthole kakhulu kuleli suku. R140 million. Nokho, ngiyazi ukuthi kusekhona ukuhamba kancane ngenxa yenani labantu abaphakathi kwalesi simo esinzima. Enye indlela esiyisebenzisayo ukuthuthukisa umphakathi ukuthi siqasha abasebenzi bezokuxhumana abanele futhi kulabo abasafunda, sinikeza izifundo ukuze babuyele bese besebenza ukuthuthukisa umphakathi wethu. Sikhishile izifundo eziyi-700.
Isaziso sikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c), (e), (h) kanye (i) somthetho wezobungcweti bezempilo (Umthetho No. 35 ka-2004) ("okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho"), sithi uNgqongqoshe wezempilo uyamema abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abazokhethwa njengamalungu weBhodi Yesikhashana Yezempilo (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "iBhodi"). Isigaba 7 somthetho sithi iBhodi izokwakhiwa ngamalungu angama-22 akhethwe nguNgqongqoshe. Isigaba h sesigaba 7 somthetho sithi abantu abathathu abamele umphakathi kufanele bakhethwe njengamalungu eBhodi; kuyilapho isigaba i sesigaba 7 sithi ummember oyedwa kufanele akhethwe emkhakheni wezempilo, okungukuthi: umthandazi, umphakathi wezokwelapha ngezinto zemvelo, kanye nodokotela. Umuntu okhethwe njengelungu leBhodi ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(c) kanye (i) zomthetho kufanele abe sebenza njengochwepheshe bezempilo okungenani iminyaka engu-5 emkhakheni wezempilo ofanele. Ukukhethwa kwabantu abazokhethwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c) somthetho kufanele kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma kumuntu oyiLungu leBhodi ophathelene nezempilo esifundeni lapho umphakathi usebenza khona, ngokukhethekile. Ukukhethwa kwabantu abazokhethwa ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(e), (h) kanye (i) zomthetho kufanele kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wezempilo. Ukukhethwa kufanele kuthunyelwe ngendlela echazwe emqulwini ohlangene ophathelene nokukhethwa kwamalungu eBhodi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho.
Uma ukhululiwe ejele futhi unecala elihlobene nezepolitiki elenzeka ngaphambi kosuku lwe-16 kuJuni 1999, noma uma usuphelelwe yisikhathi sokuhlala kwakho futhi unecala elihlobene nezepolitiki, ubheke kahle ukufaka isicelo sokuxolelwa kumongameli wezwe. Qaphela ukuthi uma icala olahlwe ngalo lingahlangene nezepolitiki, awukwazi ukufaka isicelo sokuxolelwa ngaphansi komthetho okhona. Nokho, ungafaka isicelo sokuxolelwa okujwayelekile ngaphansi kweSigaba 84 (j) seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, esinika amandla nomthetho kumongameli wokunikeza ukuxolelwa noma ukususa ezinye izigwebo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo ngokushesha. Emahofisini amakhulu nasezindaweni zomphakathi zeMnyango wezobuJustice kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo www.gcis.gov. Uma udinga usizo ekuqedeni lawa mafomu, iphathi yakho yezepolitiki kufanele ikusize uqedele kahle. Ifomu lakho lesicelo kufanele lithunyelwe umuntu onegunya ophuma ephathini yakho yezepolitiki futhi kufanele lithunyelwe ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona i-affidavit noma ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi icala olahlwe ngalo bekungokwezepolitiki ngaleso sikhathi, nokuthi lokho okwenzile kwenziwa ngaphansi kwemiyalo yephathi yakho. Qaphela lapho uqedela ifomu lesicelo ngoba kuphela lawo aqediwe kahle azobhekwa. Kumele kube nomuntu oyedwa kufomu ngalinye. Lonke ulwazi kumele luqedwe kahle nangokwethembeka, futhi kumele luhambisane nawo wonke amadokhumenti asekelayo adingekayo. Iphathi yakho yezepolitiki ingathumela isicelo egameni lakho; kodwa uma benza kanjalo, kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ifomu lesicelo liqediwe kahle. Kulindeleke ukuthi iphathi yakho iqinisekise ngaphansi kwefunga ukuthi icala olahlwe ngalo liyicala elihlobene nezepolitiki. Wonke amafomu ezicelo azobuyekezwa yiMnyango wezobuJustice. Ngemuva kwalokho, amafomu ezicelo azothunyelwa kwiKomidi okubizwa ngokuthi i-RG, ehlanganisa amalungu amaqembu ezepolitiki anendawo ePhalamende. Le komidi izobuyekeza isicelo ngasinye bese ithumela umbiko ophelele kumongameli wezwe ukusiza ekuthatheni isinqumo sokuthi akwenze noma awamukele isicelo sokuxolelwa. Le komidi izoqhubeka nomsebenzi wayo kuze kube uSepthemba 30, 2008. IMnyango wezobuJustice kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo izohlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlobene nomsebenzi wehhovisi.
Ukushayela ngesivinini esidlula leso esibekwe kumaphuzu emgwaqo kuyimbangela yokuhlaselwa kwemoto okuholela ekulimazeni okukhulu noma ekufeni kwabantu ngaphezu kwama-50% eNingizimu Afrika. Ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kuyingozi ngoba kwenza ukuba yonke imoto ibe yingozi kakhulu. Uma ushaya ngesivinini, kuba nzima ukumisa noma ukulawula imoto yakho. Unesikhathi esincane sokuphendula uma ubhekene nesimo esibucayi. Imikhawulo yesivinini ibekwe ngokwakhiwa nokuhlala kwabantu emgwaqweni. Imigwaqo yasemadolobheni, lapho kunokuhlala kwabantu okuningi, inemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi kunezindlela zasemaphandleni ezinezithuthi ezincane. Imigwaqo eduze kwezikhungo zemfundo nezinye izindawo ezinezigidi zabantu ingase ibe nemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi. Abahamba ngezinyawo: Hamba uqaphele abahamba ngezinyawo. Izikhathi zokuhlala kwabantu: Nciphisa isivinini futhi uqaphele. Iphutha labantu liyimbangela enkulu yokuhlaselwa kwemoto. Isimo sezulu esimanzi: Uma umgwaqo unamanzi, ibanga lokumisa liyanda. Isivinini kumele sincishiswe kakhulu. Isimo sezulu esifudumele kanye nokushayela ebusuku: Nciphisa isivinini uma ukubonakala kungesihle. Khumbula ukuvula izibani zakho zokukhanya ebusuku, hhayi kuphela izibani zokumisa. Izimo zomgwaqo ezimbi: Ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo nezindlela ezimbi kwehlisa amazinga okuphepha. Qaphela izindawo ezingozi emgwaqweni. Ukushayela ngesivinini kuyingozi ngisho nasemigwaqweni emihle futhi ephephile ngokuphelele. Umshayeli oshayelayo ngesivinini uphazamisa ukuhamba kwezithuthi futhi angabeka abanye abashayeli engcupheni. UMthetho AWUVUMELI NOMA YUBANI UKUDLULA IMIKHULULO YESIVININI EBUKWE. Umkhawulo we-alcohol emzimbeni wabashayeli ungama-0.05 g/100 ml. Ngisho noma ungaphansi komkhawulo, ungase ubhekane nezinsolo zokushayela uphuzile uma kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwe-alcohol kuphazamise ukushayela kwakho. Ngakho-ke, kungcono ukuhamba ngomthetho omuhle: Ungazami ukuhamba uma uphuzile!! I-alcohol iphazamisa yonke imisebenzi edingekayo yokushayela ngokuphepha. Iphazamisa ukuqaphela kwakho, ukuhlaziya, ukubona, ukuhlela, ukuzwa, ukuqapha, nesikhathi sokuphendula. Awukwazi ukulawula imoto yakho kahle. I-alcohol ikwenza uzizwe ungaphazamiseki futhi ungazi ngezinto ozenzayo. Ungalahlekelwa ukuphila kwakho, noma ubulale noma ulimele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Ungabhekana necebo elingama-R24,000 NOMA ubhekane neminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ejele. Ilayisense yakho ingavinjwa izinyanga ezintathu uma wephula umthetho okokuqala, unyaka uma wephula okwesibili, neminyaka emihlanu uma wephula okwesithathu. Ukuze kube lula, isivinini ne-alcohol kuyisixazululo esibulalayo. Ungaphuzi uhambe.
Izitolo Ezinkulu: Impumelelo Ngezingozi Izitolo ezinkulu, noma okuthiwa ama-supermarkets, zifaka isandla esikhulu empilweni yabathengi emiphakathini yethu yanamuhla. Ziqukethe imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene, kusukela kokudla kuya ezimpahleni zokuhlobisa, futhi zenza kube lula ukuthenga izinto eziningi endaweni eyodwa. Nokho, lezi zitolo zinezinzuzo eziningi, kepha futhi zikhona nezingcuphe ezidinga ukucutshungulwa. Okokuqala, izitolo ezinkulu zikhuthaza umnotho. Ngokuvamile, zikhulisa amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini, zenza kube nezinkampani ezincane ezithola ithuba lokubambisana nazo. Lokhu kudala umnotho ophilayo, lapho abantu bethola imisebenzi, futhi izinkampani ezincane zikwazi ukuhweba kalula. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izitolo ezinkulu zishintsha indlela abantu abathenga ngayo, zinciphisa isikhathi sokuthenga. Abathengi bangathola imikhiqizo abayidingayo ngokushesha, futhi ngokuvamile, ngamanani aphansi ngenxa yokuncintisana okuvela kwamanye ama-supermarkets. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle kwalezi zitolo. Njengoba zikhula, zenza kube nzima ezitolo ezincane ukusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekuncipheni kwezinkampani ezincane, okukhathaza umphakathi. Izitolo ezincane ziwumthombo obalulekile wezimpahla ezikhiqizwa endaweni, futhi zihlala zixhasa umnotho wendawo. Uma izitolo ezinkulu ziqhubeka nokuthandwa, izitolo ezincane zingase ziqhubeke zishabalala, zishiya izindawo eziningi zinganawo amathuba okuthenga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitolo ezinkulu zinezinye izingozi. Ukuphathwa kwazo ngokuvamile kuncike ekuthengisweni kwemikhiqizo ethile, okungaholela ekugcineni kokuhlukumeza umkhiqizo. Imikhiqizo eminingi etholakala ezitolo ezinkulu ivame ukuba nezinga eliphansi lokuhlola, futhi lokhu kungaba nomphumela omubi empilweni yabathengi. Abathengi bangase baziqhenye ngentengo ephansi, kodwa baphuthelwe ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswa kulezi zitolo ingase ingabi nekhwalithi efanele. Izinselelo zezempilo nezingxaki zezemvelo nazo zikhona. Izitolo ezinkulu zikhuthaza ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo eminingi engokwemvelo, okungaholela ekwandeni kokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Imikhiqizo enezithako eziluhlaza ivame ukungatholakali kalula, kanti izinkampani ezinkulu zihlala zikhangisa imikhiqizo enezithako ezinemiphumela emibi empilweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuba abathengi babe qaphelisise, bazi ukuthi yini abayithengayo, futhi baqiniseke ukuthi bayazithokozisa ngemikhiqizo abayithengayo. Ngokuphetha, izitolo ezinkulu zinezinto ezinhle nezimbi. Zithuthukisa umnotho, zenza kube lula ukuthenga, kodwa zinezingcuphe eziningi ezidinga ukucatshangelwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi bahlale beqaphile, bazi kahle ukuthi yini abayithengayo, futhi basekele izitolo ezincane ukuze bagcine umnotho wendawo uphilile. Ukwazisa konke okutholakalayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusezitolo ezinkulu noma ezincane, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kahle, kanti kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wethu. Uthando lokusebenzisana phakathi kwezitolo ezinkulu nezincane lungaholela ekutheni umphakathi ube namandla, ube nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile, futhi ube nekhwalithi yokuphila engcono. Izitolo ezinkulu zigcwalisa izinsizakalo eziningi, kodwa kumele sibe nabalindeli, siqaphele, futhi sikhuthaze umphakathi wethu.
Yini iWater Users Association (WUA)? I-WUA iyinhlangano esemthethweni eyasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. I-WUA iyiqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi ngabanye abahlanganyela ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi ukuze kuzuzwe izinzuzo ezivumelana. Ikhono eliphethe imisebenzi ye-WUA. Inhloso ye-WUA ukuvumela abantu emiphakathini ukuthi bahlanganyele ukuhlela izinsiza zabo (imali, abantu, nobuchwepheshe) ukuze benze imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi ngempumelelo. Ngaphakathi kwe-WUA, amalungu angabhekana nezidingo zendawo futhi abeke phambili lezi zidingo ohlwini lwezinto ezibalulekile. I-WUA isebenza ezingeni lendawo enezikhala ezichaziwe. I-WUA inganikeza uhlaka lokuphatha izinsiza zomfula ezingeni lendawo. Ama-WUA adlala indima ebalulekile ekwehliseni indlala nasekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kokudla. I-WUA iyisikhungo somthetho esinokuphathwa okuphelele, futhi lezo zikhono zinganikezwa kuphela kumuntu noma isikhungo esisemthethweni ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-WUA ingenza zonke izenzo umuntu angazenza, njengokuvula i-akhawunti yasebhange, ukungena ezivumelwaneni nabahlinzeki nababolekisi. I-WUA ingafaka icala noma ifakwe icala enye inhlangano. UMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye nemigomo ye-WUA kulawula ukuphathwa nokusebenza kwenhlangano. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokusungulwa kwe-WUA kunoma yisiphi isimo sokusetshenziswa kwamanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho. Nokho, kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-WUA ezingasungulwa, i-WUA yomsebenzisi oyedwa kanye ne-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi. I-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi ihlinzeka ngezidingo zabantu abahlukene abasebenzisa amanzi, njengokulima, ukwakha, ukuhweba, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwasekhaya. I-WUA yasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe kulandela izinqubo ezichazwe kuMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe angafuna ukudlulisa imisebenzi, ukuphathwa, nokubhekelela uhlelo lukamasipala emphakathini wendawo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma uhlelo luhloselwe ukusiza lowo mphakathi futhi lungaphathwa ngempumelelo yi-WUA efanele. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukweseka imizamo yezinye izigaba zikamasipala ngokuzinza kwabafuyi abasha noma ngokuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi okulima okuncane. Lapho kukhona ukuthuthukiswa okungahambisani, uNgqongqoshe angase anqume ukuthi i-WUA isebenze njengendlela yokuphatha engcono futhi igweme ukungqubuzana okungenzeka. I-WUA yasungulwa ngemva kokuxoxisana nomphakathi. Uma uNgqongqoshe exoxisana nomphakathi, izindleko zokuxoxisana zingabuyiselwa uma i-WUA isunguliwe. I-WUA eyasungulwa ngenhloso ethile ivamise ukusungulwa ngemva kokuthi kube nephakamiso elenziwe kuNgqongqoshe yilabo abafuna yona. UNgqongqoshe angase afune umuntu noma inhlangano ukuthi ithumele iphakamiso ukuze ibhange izindleko zokuxoxisana nomphakathi ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Noma iyiphi uhlobo noma iqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi lingathumela iphakamiso kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kusungulwe i-WUA. UMsunguli-Jikelele woMnyango Wamanzi Nezinkuni angasiza abasebenzisi bamanzi ekubhaleni iphakamiso. Yini okufanele ifakwe ephakamisweni? Incazelo yokuthi yiziphi izixoxiswano ezenziwe ukuze kudalwe iphakamiso kanye nemiphumela yalezi zixoxiswano. Yiziphi izixoxiswano ezenzekile? Yini eyatholakala? Nini uNgqongqoshe azovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA? UNgqongqoshe uzovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA uma ikhuthaza izinhloso ezibekwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Futhi ukuvikela indawo yokuhlala kwezilwane zasemanzini. Iphakamiso yokusungula i-WUA kufanele ihambisane noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zomfula ze-CMA. Enye indaba okufanele ifakwe yimithetho ephakanyisiwe ye-WUA. UMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke uchaza zonke izindaba okufanele zixoxwe kumthetho we-WUA. Lo Mthetho (Isheduli 5) uphinde uhlanganise imodeli yomthetho engasetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa uhlaka lwezomthetho. Nakuba uhlaka lwezomthetho lwe-WUA lungabandakanya imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, lokho akusho ukuthi i-WUA izoba nazo zonke lezi zisebenzi uma isunguliwe. Abafuna ukusungula i-WUA kufanele, njengengxenye yenqubo yokusungula, baphakamise ngokusemthethweni ukuze baphakanyiswe kwi-WUA. Lokhu kungaqhutshekiswa emqulwini olandelayo iphakamiso lapho ithunyelwa. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukuthi izindaba ezengeziwe zibe khona kumthetho we-WUA. Lezi zindaba kufanele zamukelwe ngamalungu enhlangano futhi ziqinisekiswe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphambi kokuba i-WUA ikwazi ukusebenzisa noma yiziphi izikhono noma ukwenza noma yiziphi imisebenzi. ngokuchaza indawo yokusebenza ngokuya ngesimo nenani lamanzi okufanele aphathwe, kanye nezikhono nemisebenzi ezizodingeka ukuthi kudluliselwe kwi-WUA. Emiphakathini engekho namandla okuhlela nokwenza izinhlelo ezidingekayo zenhlangano. Ikakhulukazi, ukusiza kunganikezwa lapho ukuthuthukiswa kudingeka ukukhuthazwa ngokusungulwa kwe-WUA (njengoba kwenzeka kubafuyi abasha). Zonke izikhungo zokulima namabhodi amanzi abekhona ngaphambi kokuba kuqale lo Mthetho kufanele aguqulwe zibe yi-WUA. Amabhodi amanzi athile asunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi ukuze akwazi ukulima nawo azoguqulwa abe yi-WUA. Ukuhunyushwa kwamabhodi amanzi kusho ukuthi kufanele baphinde basungule izindawo zabo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukuze zimele kahle ukuhlukahluka kwabantu kule ndawo, ngokobuzwe nangokobulili. INingizimu Afrika inembali yokufinyelela ezinsizeni ngokungalingani. Ukuguqulwa kuyindlela eyodwa yokufeza ubulungiswa. UNgqongqoshe uphumelele iziqondiso zokusungula ikomidi eliphethe ukuphathwa kwebhodi lokulima eliguquliwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-WUA ibe nokuzimela kwezezimali ukuze iphumelele. Ukusungulwa kwe-WUA kungenzeka kuphela uma amalungu ekwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokusungula i-WUA kanye nezindleko zokusebenza nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi emikhulu ephathelene ne-WUA. Ngakho-ke, i-WUA ivamise ukuxhaswa ngemali ngezimali ezikhokhiswa kumalungu ezaziwa ngokuthi "izimali zokusetshenziswa kwamanzi." Ezinye izinsiza ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho zifaka izinhlelo zosizo nokuxhaswa kwezezimali okuvela kubanikezeli. I-WUA ingabuyekeza izimali ezikhokhiswa minyaka yonke kumalungu ayo uma umthetho wayo uhlinzeka ngalesi sici. Lezi zimali kufanele zihambisane nesu lokubiza amanzi elibekwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angase anikeze ukusiza kwezezimali kwi-WUA ukuze afinyelele izinhloso zoMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (ngokuhambisana nezimiso zomthetho ezibekwe ngaphansi koMthetho). Umnyango uthuthukise inqubomgomo yokuhlinzeka ngosizo ezinhlelweni ezikhona noma ezintsha zezigaba ezithola ukungabikhona emlandweni zababasebenzisi bamanzi abahl
Okokuqala, umthengi kumele athumele ukukhalaza uma enikwa usizo. Uma enganelisekile ngendlela okukhalazo kwakhe okwenziwe ngayo noma umphumela, angakwazi ukwandisa ukukhalaza kwakhe kumphathi weposi. Thumela ukukhalaza kwakho ehhovisi lomphathi weposi kanye nazo zonke izincwadi ezisemthethweni. Abathengi/abasebenzisi bezinsizakalo zeposi bangathumela ukukhalaza kwabo ngefoni, ngefeksi, ngencwadi, noma ngokukuthumela ngogesi. Iyiphi iposi noma inkampani ethumela amaphakheji? Ubani okhulume naye ephepheni? Uma kukhulunywa ngokukhalaza okuhlobene nezicelo zokulandelela kanye nokutholakala kwamaphakheji noma into ebhalisiwe, nikeza inombolo yalokho kuphakheji noma into ebhalisiwe. Umphathi weposi uhlose ukuthuthukisa usizo nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ethembekile evulekile kubo bonke abathengi. Umphathi weposi ungowesigaba seZokuxhumana. Umphathi weposi wasungulwa ngaphansi kweSigaba 3 soMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zeposi No. 124 ka-1998. Inhloso yokulawula umkhakha wezeposi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola izinsizakalo zeposi ezithembekile nezingcono. Umphathi weposi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo eziyisisekelo zeposi zikhona kubo bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Bhekisisa ukukhalaza kwabathengi mayelana nezinsizakalo zeposi. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi beposi bayavuma noma bayahambisana nomthetho, kanye nemigomo nemibandela yeziqu nezitifiketi zokubhaliswa. Faka isandla empumelelweni nasekuzinikeleni ekufezeni izinhloso zokusebenza zokweseka izinsizakalo zeposi ngenkathi ubhekisisa izidingo zabantu kuzo zonke izigaba. Lungisa kokubili usizo lweposi olwalawulwa nolungelawulwa. Bheka futhi ugcine ukuhambisana nemigomo yeziqu nezitifiketi zokubhaliswa. Khuthaza intshisekelo yokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zeposi mayelana nezindleko, inqubekelaphambili, nezinga lenkonzo. Khuthaza usizo olujwayelekile oluqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanayo kubo bonke abantu. Insiza engalungile. Ngokwakha amazinga enkonzo okukhuluma ngezinsizakalo. Ukuthutha nokuvala iPosi. Ngokubuyekeza nokwakha kabusha izakhiwo zeposi ngokususa ezinye izikhungo zeposi ezindaweni ezineziphakamiso eziningi zeposi zathuthelwa ezindaweni ezingenazo noma ezineziphakamiso ezincane. Ukulethwa kwezincwadi emakhaya. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amakhaya emiphakathini anikezwa izinombolo zokwamukela izincwadi. Ukukhokha ngezikhwama zeposi. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izikhwama zeposi zibhekwa njengendawo eyinhloko yokwamukela izincwadi - azikhokhiswa. Indlela yokuthumela ukukhalaza. Ukulethwa kwephutha. Ukuhamba phambili kokuthumela, ngokwakha ivolumu yezincwadi ezidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngosuku olwandulela lokuthi zifike kulabo okufanele bazithole. Amaphakheji anweight engaphezu kuka-30 kg. Ukuthumela incwadi kuwumthwalo womuntu othumelayo. Izincwadi ezithunyelwa umuntu ongasebenzi enkonzweni yokuthumela izincwadi. Yiziphi izimfanelo zomthengi? Ukuthola usizo oluyisisekelo lokuthumela izincwadi. Ilungelo lokuthola usizo olufinyeleleka nolwakhelwe kahle. Ukuqina nokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo yeposi ngesikhathi. Ukutholakala kosizo nezinsiza ezifanele abantu abaneziphene. Ilungelo lokuthumela ukukhalaza.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni - Ingxoxo Ngenkathi Yamanje Umkhiqizo Wengxoxo: UMalusi Ndlovu, Umhloli Wezombusazwe UMalusi Ndlovu, umhloli wezombusazwe, uveza izinkinga ezikhona kuhulumeni, ikakhulukazi mayelana nenkohlakalo. Kulolu hlelo, sizama ukucacisa izindaba ukuze abahleli bezepolitiki nabantu abavamile baqonde kahle lesi simo. Umlando Wenkohlakalo: UMalusi uthi, "Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, inkohlakalo ibiyinkinga enkulu ezweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibonakale ikakhulukazi kuhulumeni. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi nakuba imithetho nezinqubomgomo zikhona, zihluleka uma abaphathi bengenalo ulwazi olufanele noma izifiso ezinhle." Ubufakazi Bezinkinga: UMalusi uthi, "Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi inkohlakalo ithinta izinsiza zomphakathi, imfundo, nezinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezempilo, okuholela ekutheni izifundo zibe nzima, njengoba izinsiza ziba buthakathaka." Izizathu Zokwanda Kwenkohlakalo: UMalusi ubuza, "Ingabe sikhuluma ngempilo engalungile yokuphatha, ubuholi obungalungile, noma izinhlelo eziphakeme? Yebo, zonke lezi zinto zikhona. Ubugebengu bezombusazwe baziwa ngokuthi 'kuhlanga lesinyama,' okwenza izinto zibe nzima. Abantu abaningi bahlupheka ngenxa yalesi simo." Imiphumela Yokuhulumeni: UMalusi uthi, "Njengoba inkohlakalo ikhula, abantu bayakha ukungathembeki. Lokhu kuholela ekuphikisaneni, ukungaboni ngaso linye, nokwehla kokwazisa phakathi komphakathi. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi abaphathi bahlolwa, ukuze bazi ukuthi izinsiza zithinta kanjani impilo yabo." Izixazululo Zokuqeda Inkohlakalo: UMalusi ubonisa ukuthi, "Kubuhlungu kodwa kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi baziwa, bayahlolwa, futhi banelungelo lokubika. Ukwandisa imithetho eqinile kuzohlinzeka ngokuqondwa nokubika kwezinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele kube nezinkampani ezingathathi hlangothi ezizomelene nezinselelo." Ikhono Lokuthola Usizo: UMalusi uthi, "Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi banamalungelo okubika izigameko zokukhwabanisa, futhi kufanele banikwe ithuba lokwenza lokhu ngaphandle kokwesaba. Ukuhlela izinqubomgomo ezivumela ukufinyelela kumaphoyisa kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhlola okuhle." Isigaba Sokugcina: UMalusi ubonisa ukuzimisela okukhulu ekulweni nenkohlakalo kuhulumeni. Akagxili kuphela kumaphuzu, kodwa uzama ukusiza abanye futhi akhuthaze umphakathi ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekwenzeni izinguquko. Inkohlakalo ibambelela emphakathini, kodwa ngokuhlanganyela, ukuzimisela, nemizamo yokuphatha, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izakhamuzi zomphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele zimenyelwa ukuba zihlomule amalungu eBhodi leMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Ibhodi izoba namalungu ayisixhenxe, azokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe wezobuDlelwano neMiphakathi. Okungenani elilodwa lamalungu kumele libe nolwazi ngezindaba zezimali. Uma kukhethwa abantu, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi abakhethiweyo kumele babe nolwazi olunzulu ng heritage kazwelonke, ubuchwepheshe obubanzi bezimali nokuphathwa, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokubambisana nezithakazelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe uxhaso lwezocwaningo lwezesayensi, kanye nezibopho zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zomphakathi kanye nobuchwepheshe obukhethekile emkhakheni wezokusebenza kweMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Iphaneli yokuhlola izokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze idale uhlu lwabafaneleki/abakhethiweyo ukuze bacatshangelwe. Indima yephaneli yokuhlola izoba ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukhetho lokugcina luhlanganisa abantu abanobuchwepheshe obuphakeme noma ulwazi oluyingqayizivele noma uthando emkhakheni ofanele, futhi ukuthi bamele abantu abahlukene, kahle, emiphakathini nasezindaweni zombili, futhi ukuthi ukukhethwa okuphelele kutholakala kumazinga aphezulu kakhulu. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumfakizolo, siqinisekisa ukwamukela ukufakwa; kanye d Amagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabantu abathathu abangavoucher umfakizolo. Ukufakwa ngeke kucatshangelwe uma konke okukhuluma ngenhla kungafakiwe.
iBolt: Ukushintsha Indlela Esihamba Ngayo Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Namuhla ngifuna ukukhuluma ngento ethokozisayo, iBolt. Kukhona abanye bethu esijwayele ukuhamba ngezinyawo, abanye besebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi, kodwa iBolt ithokozisa kakhulu. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani? Hhayi, ake ngikutshele. Okokuqala, iBolt iyinsizakalo yokuhamba esheshayo, futhi iyatholakala ezindaweni eziningi. Ngabe uke wayibona le app? Kulula ukuyisebenzisa, futhi ungayithola kalula ku-smartphone yakho. Ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kuyinto enhle kakhulu, ngoba akudingeki ukuthi ube nekhadi lempahla, ungasebenzisa nje i-app yakho. Futhi, uma uthanda, ungakhetha phakathi kokuhamba ngebhasi, imoto, noma ngebhayisikili. Lokhu kuhlangene nezidingo zethu ezihlukahlukene. Ngabe uke wazibuza ukuthi kungani iBolt ithandwa kangaka? Ngicabanga ukuthi okokuqala, izindleko zayo zikhangayo. Uma uqhathanisa nezinye izinkampani, iBolt ivame ukuba nezinzuzo ezinhle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungahamba ufinyelela ezindaweni eziningi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuchitha imali eningi. Futhi, uma ungumfundi noma ungumuntu osebenzayo, lokhu kuyasiza kakhulu. Kodwa akukhona lokho kuphela. I-Bolt inikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, njengokuhamba okusheshayo, okungabizi, nezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezikhethekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi noma ngabe uhambo lwakho lungakanani, iBolt inezinketho ezihambisana nezidingo zakho. Futhi, uma ungathanda, ungakwazi nokuhamba nabanikazi bezimoto, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ngabe uke wacabanga ngokuthi iBolt isiza kanjani umphakathi? Lokhu kuyinto engiyithokozelayo. Ngokuhamba ngebhasi, abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni eziningi, futhi lokhu kusiza ekunciphiseni ukungcola emoyeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi. Futhi, uma abantu behamba ngebhasi, kunciphisa nezithuthi eziningi ezisemgwaqweni, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezihambisana neBolt. Njengoba abantu abaningi besebenzisa le nsizakalo, kungenzeka kube nezinkinga ezithile, njengokulibaziseka. Ngabe uke waba nesikhathi lapho ubekade ulinde imoto? Lokhu kungaba yinkinga, ikakhulukazi uma ungenalo isikhathi esiningi. Futhi, abanye abantu baphawula ukuthi izithuthi azihlali zihlanzekile, okungase kube yinkinga uma uhamba ngebhasi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iBolt isebenzisa abaqashi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezithile. Abanye abaqashi bangase bangabi nekhono elidingekayo, noma bangase bangenzi kahle. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga uma uhamba, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abaqashi badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zabo zisebenza kahle. Kodwa, ngikholwa ukuthi iBolt iyinsiza ewusizo. Ngabe uke wayicabanga njengendlela yokuhamba? Uma ungakakwenzi, ngiyakwazi ukusho ukuthi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Futhi, uma ungathanda, ungabhalisela iBolt ukuze uqale ukuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, futhi uzothola izinzuzo eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiyazi ukuthi iBolt izoqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Abantu bayashintsha, izidingo zethu ziyashintsha, futhi iBolt izoba yinsizakalo ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho, mngani, uma usukhuluma ngale nsizakalo, cabanga ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nayo. Ngabe uyavuma? Ngiyabonga ngokulalela. Ngiyathemba ukuthi le ngxoxo ikusize ukuba uqonde kangcono iBolt. Futhi, uma uneminye imibuzo noma iziphakamiso, ngicela ungazise. Ngiyajabula ukuxoxa nawe!
Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Ekuhlangabezaneni nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zemakethe, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi ziba yinsika ebalulekile emsebenzini wanamuhla. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi ngokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini yabo, baphendule kahle ezinguqukweni nasezidingweni zenkampani. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo zazo, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu phakathi kwabantu abasebenza ndawonye. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abasebenzi bejwayelana nemigomo efanayo yokusebenza. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okungcono, okwandisa ukusebenza kahle kwethimba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma abasebenzi beqeqeshwa, bahlomula ngolwazi olusha nolwakhiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini yabo. Ngokwesibili, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu. Abasebenzi abathola ukuqeqeshwa bahlala bejabulile futhi bephokophele phambili, njengoba beqonda ukuthi inkampani ibanakekela futhi ibafuna ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo emsebenzini, okwandisa umkhiqizo nokusebenza kahle. Abasebenzi abathola amathuba okuthuthukiswa bahlala bephakanyiswa, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuncintisana okuhle phakathi kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, izinkampani zidinga abasebenzi abanolwazi olusha ukuze bakwazi ukuncintisana emakethe. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bekwazi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, okwandisa ukusebenza kahle nokunciphisa izinkinga ezivela ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olufanele. Ngokwesithathu, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu phakathi kwezinkampani. Izinkampani ezithola ukuthi ziqeqesha abasebenzi bazo ziba nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle kakhulu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu kumakhasimende, okwandisa ithuba lokuphumelela kwenkampani. Abasebenzi abaqeqeshwe kahle baziqhenya ngomsebenzi wabo, futhi lokhu kubonakala emiphumeleni ethile. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa azisebenzi kahle uma zingahlelwanga kahle. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze, zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuqonda izidingo zabasebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhona. Ukuhlola izidingo zabasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kuhambisana nezifiso zabo kanye nezidingo zenkampani. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyavuma futhi uyawuqonda umgomo wokuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zidinga ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni amakhono ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akufanele kugxilwe kuphela kumakhono athile, kodwa kufanele kube nokubheka konke okuhlobene nemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Ukuqeqeshwa okukhona kufanele kube nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okuphatha isikhathi, kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini, njengoba abasebenzi beqonda ukuthi badinga amakhono amaningi ukuze baphumelele. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo emsebenzini. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baphumelele, zikhulisa umoya wokubambisana, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zikhona emakethe. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze kahle, zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuqonda izidingo zabasebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhona. Ngale ndlela, izinkampani zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi abasebenzi bazokwazi ukuhamba phambili emisebenzini yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokugxila ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle emhlabeni oshintsha njalo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, ogcwele abantu abaqeqeshiwe nabakhuthazekile, okuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini nasempilweni.
Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhamuka, ukuveza, nokusebenzisa impahla yezenzakalo zezilwane ngaphezu kwabanye ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhiqizwa nokuphila kahle kwezilwane ngenhloso yothando lweRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa imiyalelo; futhi isigaba 'udokotela wezilwane' sikhuluma ngomuntu obhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezilwane kanye noMthetho Wempilo Yezilwane, 1982 (Umthetho 19 ka-1982), ukuze alungiselele odokotela bezilwane njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 salo mthetho. Lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezilwane, noma isilwane esihlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo salohlobo njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhangela ngomyalezo kwiGazethi ukuthi isilwane sikhona ngenhloso yalo mthetho. Mayelana nohlobo olusha lwezilwane noma uhlobo olusha lwalesi silwane okufanele lungene ezweni noma lukhulunywe kwiRiphabhulikhi, uNgqongqoshe uzokwenza isitatimende ngemva kokucabangela isicelo, futhi ethatha nokuqonda umthetho wamazwe omhlaba, futhi ngemva kokwamukela imibono yokuphendula kumyalezo womphakathi okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngaphambi kokwenza leso sitatimende. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane noma izizukulwane zalesi silwane zingamenyezelwa njengokuhambisana nezimo zalo mthetho: Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isilwane noma impahla yezenzakalo njengoba kukhulunywa esigabeni 17 izomenyezelwa kuphela ngemva kokuthi isicelo sithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe ngorganisasi efanele yokukhuluma ngezilwane. a endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwiRiphabhulikhi; noma b ezweni elilodwa noma ngaphezulu okukhulunywa ngalo. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha umphakathi kwiSikhungo, onemfundo ephezulu efanele ekuthuthukiseni izilwane, njengomphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izilwane, ozosebenzisa amandla nokwenza imisebenzi enikezwe kubo noma edluliselwa kubo ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. a URegister angadlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 ngokubhala kumphakathi onemfundo efanele nezakhono, noma anganikeza amandla noma aqondise umphakathi ngendlela yokubhala kubo ukuze basebenzise lawo mandla noma benze lezo zisebenzi. c Noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe noma umyalo onikezwe umphakathi osebenzisa amandla ngaphansi kwesigaba a singakhanselwa noma sishintshwe nguRegister, futhi njengoba kuqondiswe nguRegister kuze kube kukhanselwa noma kashintshwa ngaphandle kokuhlosiwe kwalesi sigaba. Amandla kaRegister okusebenzisa ukhetho a Noma yiziphi amandla okhetho anikezwe uRegister ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, ngaphandle kwalawo anikezwe ngezinsuku 16 noma 17, awazokwenziwa ngabo ukuze bahlukanise noma yimuphi ummangali noma omunye umuntu ophakanyiswe phambi kweRegister njengothando, ngaphandle kokunikeza ummangali noma umuntu ithuba lokuzwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingase sikhishwe noma, uma isikhathi singakhishwanga, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esifanele njengoba kuzokhombiswa nguRegister. b Ummangali noma omunye umuntu osebenzisa amandla ngaphansi kwesigaba a angawavuma lawo malungelo okuzwa. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho isikhathi sikhulunywa ngaphakathi kwaso noma yini okufanele yenziwe, uRegister angakhulisa leso sikhathi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuphela kwaso. URegister uzogcina irekhodi labakhulumi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezitshalo, abahlinzeki bezitshalo, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulumi, imiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe noma ezivunyelwe futhi ulwazi olurekhodiwe mayelana nalezi zikhungo zabakhulumi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezitshalo, abahlinzeki bezitshalo, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulumi, imiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe kuzobhalwa. Irekhodi lizovuleka, ngemva kokukhokhwa kwemali efanele, ukuze libonwe ehhovisi likaRegister phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza. URegister uzohlinzeka nganoma yimuphi umuntu, uma ecela futhi ngemva kokukhokhwa kwemali efanele, ikhophi yalolu lwazi olubhaliswe kwi-rekhodi noma isitifiketi esihlobene nakho. Irekhodi lizoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezinto zonke ezihlelwe noma ezinamandla ngalesi mthetho okufanele zibhalwe lapho. Isitifiketi esikhuluma ukuthi sibhaliwe nguRegister sizoba nomthelela wokuthi ubhaliso kwi-rekhodi alwenziwanga noma ukuthi noma yini enye enikezwe ngalesi mthetho ukuba yenziwe, yenziwe noma ingakwenziwe izoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezinto ezichazwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ikhophi yokungena kwi-rekhodi noma ukwehliswa kwi-rekhodi, okukhuluma ukuthi kuqinisekiswe nguRegister, kuzokwamukelwa njengobufakazi kunoma iyiphi inkantolo ngaphandle kokwengeza ubufakazi noma ukukhipha okwenziwayo. b umkhulumi obhaliswe nguRegister ngenhloso leyo uqinisekisile ngendlela ehlinzekwe nguRegister ukuthi umkhulumi, umhlinzeki, umqoqa wezithako, kanye nomhlinzeki wezithako, unolwazi olwaneleyo, isipiliyoni, kanye nezakhono mayelana nokuqoqwa kwezithako, izithako, noma mayelana nokuqoqwa kwezithako, izithako, noma izithako zabesifazane ezitholiwe, zihlolwe, zisetshenziswe, ziphakanyiswe, noma zigcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho, futhi ukuthi ezilwaneni, mayelana nomkhulumi, umhlinzeki wezithako, noma umqoqa wezithako, kungase kube ukuthi izithako zikhishwe noma, mayelana nomqoqa wezithako noma umhlinzeki wezithako, zingeniswe ngezithako zabesifazane noma izithako; futhi c ukuhambisana nezinye izidingo ezingase zikhishwe. Umhlinzeki kufanele futhi abhaliswe uma ethatha isinqumo sokubhalisela uRegister ukuthi uzosebenzisa amalabhorethri namalungelo okukhansela izintela ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhishwe zezo zonke impahla yezenzakalo ezingeniswe ngu yena ezweni noma ezingeniswe kwabanye. b abasebenzisi bezobuchwepheshe kule ndawo, mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezilwane ezigcinwe lapho, bangaqoqwa, bahlolwe, basebenzise, baphakanyiswe, baphakanyiswe, futhi bagcine impahla yezenzakalo, kubhekwa ukuthi kulawulwa ngumuntu olandela izidingo ezikhishwe; futhi c ukuthi le ndawo kufanele ilandele lezo zidingo ezikhishwe. b izilwane zalezi zinhlobo zilandele ezinye izidingo ezikhishwe njengokuhambisana. a le ndawo ibhaliswe njengendawo; noma ii isilwane sivunyelwe njengempahla yezenzakalo nganoma iyiphi indlela, kufanele sithunyelwe ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguRegister nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sihlangane nemali efanele yokubhaliswa noma ukuvunyelwa okufunwa. Iqembu labantu elifuna ukubhaliswa njengemiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane kufanele lithumele isicelo kuRegister ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguRegister nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sihlangane nemigomo yemiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane, kanye nemali yokufaka isicelo efanele. Imiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane noma iqembu lemiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane elifuna ukubhaliswa njengemvume ebhalisiwe kufanele lithumele isicelo kuRegister ngendlela ehlinzekwe nguRegister ngendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sihlangane nemigomo yokubhaliswa, kanye nemali
Umbhalo ubonakala ungumbhalo wezomthetho onzima ophathelene namalungelo okumba, imithetho, kanye nezinqubo eNingizimu Afrika. Uxoxa ngezici ezahlukene zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zezimbiwa nezamafutha, kuhlanganise namalungelo okucwaninga nokumba, imithwalo yemfanelo kahulumeni kanye nezinkampani zokumba, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola izimvume nezitifiketi. Uveza ukubaluleka kokuvikelwa kwemvelo kanye nesidingo sokuhambisana nezindinganiso zomthetho. Umbhalo uveza izindima zababambiqhaza abahlukene, kuhlanganise noNgqongqoshe, uMnyango Wezimbiwa, kanye nomphakathi, ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zezimbiwa. Ubuye uphinde uqhubele phambili izindaba eziphathelene nokukhokhelwa kwabanikazi bezindawo kanye nomthethonqubo ophatha imisebenzi yokumba.
Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngemva Kwezikhathi Zamaholide: Ingxoxo Nombhali Womkhakha Isingeniso Ngalesi sikhathi samaholide, abantu abaningi bayavakasha, behamba nezingane zabo, noma bejabulela isikhathi sokuphumula. Nokho, lezi zikhathi zokuphumula zibuye zifake izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze siqonde kangcono izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezitholakala ngesikhathi samaholide, sithole ithuba lokukhuluma noMnu. Sipho Mthethwa, umphakathi wezokwelapha nophathiswe izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukwaziswa Ngemisebenzi Yezimo Eziphuthumayo Umbuzo: Mnu. Mthethwa, ungakuchaza kanjani umsebenzi wezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo? Impendulo: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Umsebenzi wezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo uhilela ukusiza abantu abahlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo, njengokulimala, ukuhlaselwa yisifo, noma ezinye izimo ezidinga ukunakekelwa okuphuthumayo. Ngalesi sikhathi samaholide, sithola ukwanda kwabantu, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Izimo Eziphuthumayo Ezivame Ukwenzeka Umbuzo: Yiziphi izimo ezivame ukwenzeka kakhulu ngesikhathi samaholide? Impendulo: Izimo ezivame ukwenzeka kakhulu zifaka phakathi ukuwa, izingozi zemoto, kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo ezihlobene nezifo, njengokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo. Abantu bahlala bejabule, kodwa abanye bangase babe nezinye izinkinga zempilo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe sekuqapheni futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele. Ukubaluleka Kwezinsizakalo Zokuphuthumayo Umbuzo: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezitholakala ngesikhathi samaholide? Impendulo: Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezitholakala ngesikhathi samaholide ngoba abantu bahlala behamba, bejabulile, futhi bengenalwazi lokuthi bangahlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ziqinisekisa ukuthi uma kwenzeka into engalindelekile, abantu bangathola usizo ngokushesha. Izinyathelo Zokuphepha Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo abantu abangazithatha ukuze bagweme izimo eziphuthumayo? Impendulo: Abantu bangathatha izinyathelo ezithile ukuze bagweme izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwenza izinhlelo ezicacile zokuhamba, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi banemithi edingekayo, nokuba nezinombolo zokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuphuma nabantu abavela emiphakathini eyahlukene kungase kube yingozi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba neziqondiso ezicacile. Ukuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zokuphuthumayo Umbuzo: Kanjani abantu bangaxhumana nezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo uma behlangabezana nenkinga? Impendulo: Uma umuntu ehamba futhi ehlangabezana nenkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi axhumane nezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ngokushesha. Lokhu kungafaka ukufonela inombolo yokuphuthumayo, noma uma bekhona abantu abathile abaziwayo, bangabathintana ukuze bathole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona, futhi bangazithola kalula. Izinsizakalo Zokwelapha Zesikhathi Samaholide Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakala ngesikhathi samaholide ezithinta izimo eziphuthumayo? Impendulo: Izinsizakalo ezitholakala ngesikhathi samaholide zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokwelapha eziphuthumayo, izibhedlela, kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo ezizimele. Abantu bangathola usizo lwezokwelapha, izivakashi zingathola izinsizakalo ezithile ezitholakala ezindaweni ezivakashelwa kakhulu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangathola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Ukwanda Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Umbuzo: Ngabe ubona ukukhula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngesikhathi samaholide? Impendulo: Yebo, ngiyavuma. Njengoba abantu bejabulile futhi bephumule, izingozi ziyanda. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibe nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphatha izimo ezinjalo. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha, futhi sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi samaholide. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu bazi ukuthi bangathola usizo ngokushesha uma behlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba aqaphe futhi aqinisekise ukuthi unayo yonke imininingwane edingekayo ukuze uphumelele ngesikhathi samaholide. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinto ezibalulekile.
Yonke imfuyo yokudla ethunyelwa, ikhiqizwe, ikhiqizwe, noma ithengiswa eNingizimu Afrika kumele ibhaliswe kuMlawuli, ngaphansi koMthetho 36 ka-1947. Umfakisicelo kumele abe ngumuntu onemithetho, isibonelo, uJohn Peter Citizen, ophatha ibhizinisi ngaphansi kwegama elithi Diepsloot Stud. Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Iziphakamiso zokudla kwezilwane zingafakwa kuphela yizinkampani ezibhaliswe kuleli, umCitizen waseNingizimu Afrika, noma isikhungo esisemthethweni esibhaliswe eNingizimu Afrika. Ukudla kwezilwane akuhlanganisi umquba, isikhumba, ne-chaff, utshani obuphansi, isilage, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinhlanga zokholo, noma ezinye izithako zokudla kwezilwane ezilungiselelwe umnini wezinkomo ukuze zisetshenziswe nezilwane zakhe. Cela iziqondiso mayelana nezidingo zokudla kwezilwane kuMlawuli, uMthetho 36 ka-1947. Incwadi ehambisana nesicelo kumele ivela kumuntu obhalisiwe noma kumuntu oqokwe ukuba umele umuntu obhalisiwe. Amacheki athunyelwa kuphela ngaphandle kwesicelo kumele ahambisane nencwadi yokuchaza. Amacheki nezimfuno zeposi kumele abhalwe kuMphakathi Jikelele: Ezolimo. Thumela ifomu lesicelo sokufaka izicelo ezintsha kanye nezichibiyelo zokubhaliswa okukhona, kuhlanganise nezinguquko zokwakheka. Qedela ifomu ngokuphelele, ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, izinombolo zamakhasi, noma eminye imikhiqizo. Omunye angaba yikhophi. Umuntu osethelekile ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ophatha ukuxhumana noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu wesicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele isetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-sertifika yokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuphuculwa. Thumela amafomu wesicelo ehhovisi eliphethe. Ukuthumela amafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzophazamisa isikhathi ngokubambezela inqubo. Bhala ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Lonke ulwazi kumalebula kumele luhambisane ngokunembile nalokho okuthunyelwe kufomu lesicelo. Kungathatha cishe izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine ukuze ukudla kwezilwane nemikhiqizo yezilwane kubhaliswe.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe Ezinkundleni Zokuxhumana Nemisebenzi Yedijithali Kwazulu, emadolobheni amancane, kwakukhona uSipho, umculi ophumelelayo owayethanda ukudala. U-Sipho wayehlala ethokozisa abantu ngezithombe zakhe ezinhle, ezithathwe emhlabeni wakhe. U-Sipho wayelokhu ehlanganyela izithombe zakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ezithokozisa abantu abaninzi. Kodwa uSipho wayazi kahle ukuthi akukhona konke okwakukhona emhlabeni wezithombe; kwakukhona okuthile okwakufanele akwenze ukuze abe ngumbhali ophumelelayo. Ngosuku oluthile, uSipho wahlangana noThandi, umngani wakhe owayekhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. UThandi wayenobuchwepheshe bokudala okuqukethwe okuhehayo, okwakwenza abantu bazithande. Wamkhumbuza uSipho ukuthi akufanele agxile kuphela ezithombeni, kodwa kufanele akwazi ukuhamba phambili, adale okuqukethwe okukhuluma ngempilo, imizwa, nezifundo. Lokhu kwavusa umcabango kuSipho, wacabanga ukuthi kungani engawenzi kahle lokhu. U-Sipho wathola umqondo omusha: kungani engafundi ukwakha izindaba ezimnandi? U-Sipho waqala ukucabanga ngalezi zindaba ezimnandi, ezithinta abantu, ezikhuluma ngempilo yabo. Waqala ukuhamba emhlabeni, ethola izimfihlo ezincane ezivela kubantu abahlukene, ezimfihlo ezazizwakala kahle ezithombeni zakhe. Wathi, “Ngizokwenza izindaba ezithokozisayo, ezizokhuthaza abantu, ezizobafundisa.” Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana, uSipho wathola isikhala sokubhala izindaba zakhe. Waqala ukudala okuqukethwe okuhlobene nezithombe, lapho abekwazi khona ukufaka izincazelo ezijulile ezithombeni. Ngalesi sikhathi, izithombe zakuye zaba nezinhloso, zaba nezindaba ezinhle ezazihambisana nazo. U-Sipho wathola indlela yokuxhumana nabantu, wathola indlela yokubakhumbuza ukuthi bonke bayahluka, kodwa bonke banemizwa efanayo. Njengoba uSipho eqhubeka, wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili akukhona kuphela ukudala okuqukethwe, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukwakha umphakathi. Waqala ukufaka izithombe zabanye abadali bokuqukethwe, ebakhuthaza ukuba bahlanganyele izindaba zabo. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuxhumana, futhi uSipho waqala ukuthola abalandeli abaningi. Abantu babefuna ukwazi okwengeziwe, babefuna ukuxhumana naye, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waqala ukufunda ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ukuzinikela. Waqala ukufunda izindlela zokuthuthukisa okuqukethwe kwakhe. Wafunda ukuthi izithombe ezinhle zidinga ukuxhumana nezincazelo ezijulile, futhi izindaba ezithokozisayo zidinga ukwakhiwa kahle. Wafunda ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukufaka izikhangiso, nokubhala izindatshana ezithokozisayo. U-Sipho waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo emhlabeni wedijithali, futhi lokhu kwavula iminyango emisha. Kodwa uSipho akazange akhohlwe ukuthi impumelelo ayizange ifike kalula. Wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho abantu bebengamthandi, izikhathi lapho izithombe zakhe zingatholakali, nezikhathi lapho wacabanga ukuthi akazange akwenze kahle. Kodwa uSipho wayazi ukuthi ukuphumelela kudinga ukubekezela. Waqhubeka, wathola izindlela zokwakha okuqukethwe okuhehayo, wathola izindlela zokuxhumana nabantu, futhi wathola indlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningi zokusebenza kanzima, uSipho wathola ukuthi umphakathi wakhe wawukhula. Abantu babebhalela izindaba zabo, bexoxa ngezinto ezazibathinta. U-Sipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma umuntu enza umsebenzi oncomekayo, ungakhuthaza abanye. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokuhlangana, lapho abantu bekwazi khona ukuhlangana, babelane ngezindaba zabo, futhi bakhulume ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Njengoba uSipho eqhubeka, wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili akupheli. Waqhubeka nokufunda, efunda izindlela ezintsha zokudala okuqukethwe. Wafunda ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana zishintsha njalo, futhi kufanele azivumelanise nezinguquko. Waqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi, waba ngumholi, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bangaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabanye. U-Sipho waphenduka umculi, umbhali, nomholi, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona kuphela emalini, kodwa nasekuthokoziseni abantu, nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ngakho, uSipho waba isibonelo sokuthi abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali bangaba nethonya elikhulu, futhi bangashintsha izimpilo zabantu ngezindaba zabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, uSipho wakhumbula ukuthi impumelelo yakhe yayingenxa yokuxhumana, yokubambisana, nokufunda. U-Sipho waqhubeka nokudala, wathola ubuciko obusha, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta abantu. U-Sipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma sabelana ngezindaba zethu, singashintsha umhlaba.
Isikhathi esibalulekile sempilo ye-piglet siqala ekuzalweni kuze kube sekuvunyelweni. Ngokuvamile, ama-piglets amabili azalwa ngalesi sikhathi. Isizathu esikhulu esithinta lokhu ukuphathwa okungafanele, noma isizathu singaba ukuhlinzekwa ngokweqile, ukuvuza kokhuni, i-anemia, ukungondleki, noma isifo. I-sow kumele ihlanzwe futhi iphathwe ngemithi ngaphambi kokuyiswa endaweni yokuzala (okungenani ezinsukwini ezingu-4 kuya kwezi-5 ngaphambi kokuzala). I-sow esondelene nokuzala akufanele ihanjiswe endaweni yokuzala kuze kube ngesonto lokuzala, ukuze ivumeleke ukuthi ijwayele indawo yokuzala futhi yehlise ingcindezi. Indawo kumele ihlolwe kahle ukuze ibonakale izindawo eziqinile noma ama-lumps. Ama-lumps angaphathwa ngempahla yokuhlanzeka. Indawo yokuzala kumele yakhiwe kude nezinye izindawo. Ukuhlanzeka kumele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlanza indawo yokuzala kahle ngemva kokususa i-sow kanye nama-piglets ayo. Zonke izinto eziphumile kumele zisuswe kusetshenziswa umoya ophakeme, ibhulashi lokuhlanzeka, noma isikhuhli esiqinile. Indawo kumele ihlanzwe kusetshenziswa isixazululo sokuhlanzeka esifana nesixazululo se-4% formalin. Kumele ishiywe ingenalutho ezinsukwini ezi-2 kuya kwezi-3. Ukhuni olungcolile noluwetshisiwe kumele lususwe nsuku zonke futhi lufakwe ukhuni olomile. I-sow kumele ibe nokukhiqiza ubisi okwanele; ukuntuleka kobisi kungaholela ekufeni kwama-piglets ngenxa yokungondleki. Ama-piglets kanye nomama wabo kumele aqashelwe futhi anikezwe ukunakekelwa okukhethekile, futhi udokotela wezilwane kumele abizwe ngokushesha. Ubude bokhuni lwe-umbilical bungaba cishe amacentimeter angama-12, kanti ingxenye engama-2 centimeters kumele ishiywe. Lokhu kuvikela ekulimazeni phakathi kwama-piglets ngesikhathi seziqhudelana futhi kuvikela ekubeni nokugwaza nokudonsa izindebe ze-sow. Qaphela lapho usika amazinyo ungalimazi izigaxa. Kuhle futhi kuyasiza ukushiya inyo elingama-50. Kunconywa ukusika amazinyo usebenzisa umshini ofanele wokusika amazinyo. Ama-piglets azalwa enezinsiza ze-iron, futhi ubisi lwe-sow aluhlinzeki ngezidingo ze-iron zama-piglets akhuliswe ezindlini ze-concrete. Ukuhlinzekwa nge-iron kumele kwenziwe ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa (ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7) ngama-injection emzimbeni. Ama-piglets kumele abhalwe ezindlebeni ukuze kube lula ukuwazisa. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-ear tags ezingafakwa ezindlebeni. Izinhlelo zokubhaliswa kwezibalo ze-ear kumele zisetshenziswe ne-South African Pedigree Association ngezinjongo zokufuya.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi Ingxoxo Nenduna Yezempilo Yomphakathi, uMnu. Mthembu Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani, Mnu. Mthembu. Siyakwamukela kulolu hlelo lwezempilo nezokuphila kahle. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngithokozile ukwazi ukusiza nokukhuluma ngalezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Umxhumanisi: Ukuze siqale, ungakwazi ukusichazela ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo yomphakathi ibaluleke kangakanani? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, imicimbi yezempilo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu ngoba ithinta impilo yawo wonke umuntu emiphakathini. Le micimbi ifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokugqugquzela impilo, imikhankaso yokwelapha, kanye nemihlangano yokwakha ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nezifo ezithathelwana, izindlela zokuphila, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuwumsebenzi omkhulu. Ingabe kunemikhankaso ethile obesebenza kuyo muva nje? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, sithumele imikhankaso eminingi ehloswe ngokuqinisa ulwazi lwezempilo. Isibonelo, sibe neqhaza elikhulu emkhankasweni wokuvimbela izifo ezithathelwana, lapho sikhuthaza abantu ukuba bavakashele izikhungo zezempilo ukuze bahlolwe. Ukwengeza, siphinde sabamba imihlangano yokuxhumana nabantu ukuze sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo, okuholele ekwakheni izindawo zokuxhumana eziphephile. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo ayigxili kuphela ezinkingeni zomzimba. Ucabanga ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile kangakanani emiphakathini yethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Impilo yengqondo iyisici esiyinhloko sempilo yonke. Njengoba sithola ukukhathazeka okuningi, ukuziqhenya, kanye nezinkinga zengqondo, kubalulekile ukuthi siphinde sikhulume ngalezi zindaba. Imicimbi yethu ihlanganisa izifundo ezikhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, futhi sikhuthaza abantu ukuthi baziqhelise ukuthola usizo uma bephila nokucindezelwa. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe uhlanganyela kanjani nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo ukuze kusekelwe le micimbi? Mnu. Mthembu: Hhayi, lokhu kudinga ukubambisana. Sisebenza eduze kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezahlukene. Lokhu kusenza sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezivumelana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sithumela izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze sibe nokuqonda okuhle kakhulu kwezidingo zomphakathi. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umphakathi unendima enkulu ezinhlelweni zempilo. Ungakuchaza kanjani ukubaluleka kokubambisana kwababambiqhaza? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, ukubambisana kubalulekile. Uma abantu behlangana, bahlanganyela izinsiza, ulwazi, kanye nemithombo. Lokhu kwenza kube nokuhlakanipha okukhudlwana futhi kwandisa amathuba okuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi amandla akhe akhula lapho abantu benza izinto ndawonye. Umxhumanisi: Noma kunjalo, inkinga yokungabikhona kwezinsiza ezanele iyenzeka. Ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo emiphakathini enezinselelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukusungula imikhankaso yokwakha ulwazi ukuze sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baqonde izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokusebenzisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifinyelela abantu. Lokhu kudinga uthando, ukuzinikela, kanye nemigomo ecacile yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma. Ngabe kukhona okukhumbulekayo ofuna ukukwabelana nabantu? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi bonke abantu bangenza umehluko. Impilo yethu ithinta wonke umuntu, ngakho kufanele sikhuthaze ukubambisana, ukwazisa, nokuxhumana. Ukusebenza ndawonye, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, nolwazi. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu. Uhlanga lwenhlonipho luhamba phambili ekusizeni umphakathi, futhi sithokozisa kakhulu ukuthola imicabango yakho. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngijabule kakhulu ukuba lapha. Hamba kahle!
