Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi Emazweni amaningi, ukuhamba ngezindlela ezinkulu ezilula kubalulekile ekuphatheni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Kunezimo eziningi ezidinga ukuphendulwa ngokushesha, kubandakanya imicimbi eyingozi, izimo zokulahlwa kwemali, noma ezinye iziphithiphithi ezithinta impilo yabantu. Ngenxa yalesi simo, ukuhamba ngezinto ezihamba phambili ezinzima, njengezimoto eziningi ezinokuphendula, kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Izimoto eziningi azijwayelekile kuphela ezikhathini zomphakathi ezivamile, kodwa futhi zisebenza njengenqubomgomo yokuphepha. Lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zenzeka, izinsiza ezifanele ziyadingeka ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nazo. Ukuze ukuqonda lokhu, kubalulekile ukuqala ngokubheka umqondo wokuphendula ngezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa indlela izimoto eziningi ezifaka ngayo isandla ekuqedeni izimo eziyingozi nendlela okukhula ngayo ukusetshenziswa kwazo. Sikhuluma ngezimo eziphuthumayo, izimoto ezinelogo yokuphendula, njengemoto yedlanzana, iyisithonjana. Ziningi izigameko lapho izimoto ezilungele ukusiza, ukuphuthuma, noma ukuhlinzeka ngomsindo ngezimo eziphuthumayo abantu. Izinhlaka zomphakathi ezibandakanya amaphoyisa, abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye nezinsiza zokuhlenga, zonke zifanelwe ukuba zenze ngempumelelo izimo ezimbi. Lezi zinsiza kufanele zibe nezimoto ezikhiqiza okungcono, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi kudinga ukusizwa okuza ngezinga eliphezulu. Kodwa, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngezimoto eziningi. Ukuze ukuphendula kwenzeke ngendlela efanele, izinhlelo zokusebenza, ezifana nohlelo lwezokuhlola, kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziphathekayo ezifanele ukuqhubeka nokukhuthaza ukuqhubeka komphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ngendlela yokubamba izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze kuhlanganiswe ubuchwepheshe nezigaba ezahlukene zokuphendula. Yize izimoto eziningi zikhona, izinhlelo zokwakha izinhlelo zazo azisatholakali. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphakeme zokuqeqesha abantu abanemikhakha ehlukene, ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ngezimo eziphuthumayo. Umsebenzi wabo ungathinta uthando nobuchwepheshe, ukuze thief mkhaya kwazulu kwezindiza, izimo ezinjalo ziqhutshelwe phambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, akufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi izimbiwa eziningi zingabangela izimo eziphuthumayo zibe munye. Ukuze umphakathi uqonde izimo eziyingozi eziphuthumayo, isidingo sokusungula ubuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo buvele kahle. Hamba umphakathi ngumsele kumnotho, ukuze uthole amathuba okuphuthuma ngokufanele. Ukwamukela izimoto eziningi kuhlinzeka ngebhadi lokuphuthuma, lokhu kudinga ukuba kubhalwe ezikhathini ezikahle. Lezimoto kufanele zibe nezinye izinsiza ezifana nokuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kweziguli, izisebenzi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza. kuye kwezizinda ukuthi kubhekelelwe izinqubo eziphansi eziphuma ezinkampanini ezithokozisayo eziningana ezitholakala ngama-oda, umsindo nezinqubomgomo zokuphendula ngezimoto eziningi. Ngaphandle kokushesha kokuphendula kwezinye izinhlelo ezisebenzelana, izimoto eziningi zinozakwabo, nathi kufanele simise umgomo wokwakha izinhlelo eziyoda emigqukezi yokuphendula. Lokhu kusho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi nabantu baziqonda kahle umgomo wentuthuko, nezinga lenzalo yokuphendula ngempela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abantu kufanele babhezela ukusebenza, futhi balwe izifiso ezinkulu. Ukuphendula ngomqondo njalo kwezimo eziphuthumayo kuletha izinselelo ezinkulu kumphakathi. Akukhona nje ukuthi izimoto eziningi zidingeka ukuze ziphendule kalula, kodwa kudinga ukuthi umuntu ube nesisombululo esilungile. Lokhu kuphendula kubalulekile lapho kuhlolwa kahle, ukuze kuhlonishwe imithetho ehambisana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngakho, ngemuva kokuhlola izimo ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuba umphakathi ufunde ukubaluleka kokuphathwa komphakathi nooziqeqeshi bezokuphendula. Lokhu kuzogcina kungumgomo wokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezimotweni eziningi, ukuze ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela engcono yokuphendula. Ekugcineni, ukukhula kwezixazululo ezinhle nezinjongo zokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kuhilela ukuthola imiphumela engcono kunokuphuma okubuhlungu. Ukubhekela izinkinga ezikhona, will ungenza izimoto eziningi zibe nomthelela omuhle kumphakathi, futhi uthumele izimemezelo zomphakathi. Lolu hlelo lwalwazulu nezinyathelo ezithile zizophinde zibe yinto engapheli, futhi kugcine ukugcinwa kwempilo yazo zonke.
Izitifiketi Zobungcweti Zabasebenzi Bakahulumeni Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaqashwe banamakhono afanele ukuphatha izinsiza zomphakathi ngokufanele. Lezi zitifiketi zikhombisa ukuthi umsebenzisi unolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle emkhakheni othile, okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, izinqubo, nezimiso zokusebenza ezibalulekile ekuphatheni imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ukwakhiwa Kwezitifiketi Zobungcweti Lezi zitifiketi zikhishwa ezikhungweni ezihlonishwayo, njengezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izikhungo zokuqeqesha, noma izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi. Ukuze umuntu athole lesi sitifiketi, udinga ukudlula ezivivinyweni ezithile, ahlangabezane nezidingo ezithile, futhi abhale izifundo ezihlobene nomkhakha awuqashile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaqashiwe bahlomuliswa ngolwazi olufanele ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Izidingo Zokuthola Izitifiketi Izidingo zokuthola izitifiketi zobungcweti zingahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezitifiketi. Ngokuvamile, umsebenzisi udinga ukuba neziqu ezithile, njengeziqu zemfundo ephakeme noma ukuqeqeshwa okukhuluma ngaleso sikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaqashiwe badinga ukufakazela ukuthi banezinto ezithile ezifana nokuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini, amakhono okuxhumana, kanye nekhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzisi akasuki kuphela emfundweni, kodwa uyakwazi futhi ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwakhe ezimeni zangempela. Izinzuzo Zokuba Nezitifiketi Zobungcweti Ukuba neziqinisekiso zobungcweti kulethela izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisa amathuba emisebenzi. Abasebenzi abanama-certificates banethuba elingcono lokuqashwa, njengoba abaqashi bazi ukuthi banezinga eliphezulu lokuqonda imisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo, njengoba abasebenzi abaqashwe kahle bahlala bejabulile futhi bephumelela emsebenzini wabo. Okwesibili, izitifiketi zobungcweti zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu. Abasebenzi abathola lezi zitifiketi bahlala befunda futhi bethuthukisa amakhono abo, okuholela ekwandeni kokuzethemba. Lokhu kuvumela abasebenzi ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni eziningi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ukubaluleka Kwezifundo Eziqhubekayo Izifundo eziqhubekayo zibalulekile empilweni yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Njengoba izidingo zomphakathi zishintsha, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baqhubeke nokufunda ukuze bahlale bephambili. Izitifiketi zobungcweti zikhuthaza le mfundiso, njengoba zifaka phakathi izifundo ezivela ezintweni eziphambili, ezinjengezobuchwepheshe, ezokuphathwa kwemali, kanye nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphambili. Izinkinga Ezingavela Noma kunjalo, ukuhlinzeka ngezitifiketi zobungcweti akukhululekile. Kunezinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nalesi simo, njengokuntuleka kwemithombo yokufunda, izindleko eziphezulu zokufunda, kanye nezinkinga zokuthola izikhungo ezifanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abasebenzi bangakwazi ukuthola lezi zitifiketi, okungase kube nomthelela omubi emiphakathini yabo. Ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezisekela abasebenzi, njengezinhlelo zokubolekwa kwemali noma izinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile. Isiphetho Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni ziwumgogodla wokuphathwa kwezinselelo zomphakathi. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi abaqashiwe banamakhono adingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisekelayo ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela kulezi zitifiketi, ukuze bonke abasebenzi bakwazi ukuzuza emsebenzini wabo futhi baphumelele empilweni. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobuchwepheshe, futhi ohloniphekile.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni (GEMS self-employed/pensioner income verification) Ingxoxo: Uma sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nqubo ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi. Ukuze abantu abathola imali ngokuzimela noma impesheni bathole izinsiza ezidingekayo, kudinga ukuhlola kahle izinsiza zabo. Uma ufuna ulwazi oluqondile, sithintane noMnu. Nkosi, ongumeluleki wezezimali onolwazi olunzulu kulolu daba. Mnu. Nkosi, ungakuchaza kanjani ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni? Mnu. Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyavuma. Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola izinsiza zempilo, ezifana ne-GEMS, bahlala bephila kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinkokhelo zempesheni kanye nemali engenayo evela emisebenzini abazenzayo. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe le mali engenayo? Mnu. Nkosi: Okokuqala, abathintekayo badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, efana namaphepha afanele, njengemibhalo yokuhola, izinkontileka, noma izitatimende zezimali. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinkcukacha zibe neqiniso futhi ziqinisekiswe ngababheki bezimali. Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinselelo abantu abahlangabezana nazo kulolu hlelo? Mnu. Nkosi: Izinkinga ezivamile zifaka phakathi ukungabi namaphepha afanele, noma ubufakazi bokuthi imali engenayo iyatholakala. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinselelo zokuhumusha imibhalo, ikakhulukazi uma bephuma ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imininingwane iyahambisana. Umbuzo: Ngabe kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kusizakale abantu abahlangabezana nalezi zinkinga? Mnu. Nkosi: Yebo, kunezinsiza eziningi ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zezimali, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezikhungo ezikhethekile zingasiza abantu ukuthi baqonde le nqubo. Futhi, imihlangano yokufundisa ingaba usizo olukhulu ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. Umbuzo: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo uma umuntu engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo? Mnu. Nkosi: Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kudingeka ukuthi axhumane nezikhungo eziphathelene nezinsizakalo zempesheni noma ezemali. Kuhle ukuthi abhale phansi izizathu ezithile zokungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinkcukacha. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekutholeni izixazululo ezihambisanayo. Umbuzo: Ngabe le nqubo ithinta kanjani abantu abasha abaqala ukusebenza? Mnu. Nkosi: Abantu abasha abaqala ukusebenza badinga ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zikhona ukuze bazilungiselele kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi baqonde izinqubo zokuhola, imithetho, kanye nezidingo zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ukuze bangahlangabezani nezinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Umbuzo: Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokugcina kubantu abathintekayo? Mnu. Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyafuna. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphile futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Ukugcina amarekhodi anembile, ukuxhumana nabachwepheshe bezimali, nokufunda ngalezi zinsizakalo kuzobasiza ekuphumeleleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, akufanele bakhathazeke uma behlangabezana nezinkinga; ukuxhumana kuzobasiza. Umbuzo: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Nkosi, ngempela izeluleko zakho ziwusizo. Ngabe ungathanda ukwengeza okuthile? Mnu. Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngithanda ukuphetha ngokuthi ukuqinisekisa imali engenayo akukhona nje ukulandela izinqubo, kodwa kuyinqubo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabachwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, futhi kunciphise ukungaqondi kahle. Ngokuphetha, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, abantu bangathola usizo olukhulu futhi baphile impilo engcono. Ukuxhumana, ukuqonda, kanye nokubambisana kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwale nqubo.
iTakealot: Ukukhula Kwezohwebo E-Commence eNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-2023, iTakealot, eyaziwa njengomholi wezohwebo ku-inthanethi eNingizimu Afrika, ibonakale ibalulekile ekuguquleni indlela abantu abaningi abathenga ngayo. Le nkampani, eyasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2011, isiqhubekile nokukhula okukhulu eminyakeni edlule, ibonisa indlela ehlangabezana nezidingo zabathengi ezishintshashintshayo. Kusukela ekuqaleni, iTakealot yahlukaniswa ngokunikeza umkhiqizo obanzi, okuhlanganisa izinto zansuku zonke, imishini ye-elekthronikhi, impahla yezingane, nezinto zokwakha. Lokhu kuhlangene nokuzinikela kwayo ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo eziphezulu, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayo bathola isipiliyoni esihle sokuthenga. Ngendlela yokusebenza okwakhiwe kahle, iTakealot ibhujiswe yizithiyo ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi lezo ezivela ezinkampanini ezisebenza ezitolo ezisemthethweni. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi phakathi kobhadane lweCOVID-19, kube nomthelela omkhulu empumelelweni yeTakealot. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu abaningi bakhuthazwa ukuba bathenge ku-inthanethi, okwenza iTakealot ukuba ibe izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili kwezohwebo online. Phakathi neminyaka emibili edlule, iTakealot ithole ukukhula okukhulu kuwo wonke amasegmenti, ibonisa ukujula kokwethembeka kwabathengi. Ngonyaka ka-2023, iTakealot izibophezele ekujabuliseni abathengi bayo, ibeka phambili izinhlelo ezithuthukisa imikhiqizo yayo. Ngaphezu kokwandisa imikhiqizo, iTakealot ikhulise izinhlelo zayo zokulethwa, ikwenza kube lula kubathengi ukuthola izinto zabo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umkhiqizo ufika ngesikhathi, iTakealot isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokulandelela, okubavumela ukuba bazi kahle lapho umkhiqizo wabo utholakala khona. Ukwesekwa kwemakethe ye-e-commerce akupheli lapha. ITakealot isanda kuqamba izinhlelo zokusekela abathengisi bendawo, ivula amathuba amasha emisebenzi. Lezi zinhlelo ziqinisekisa ukuthi abathengisi bendawo banganikela ngemikhiqizo ethile, okwandisa ukwakheka kwemakethe. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokukhuthaza izinkampani ezincane, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa umnotho wezwe lonke. Ngokuhambisana nemigomo yokuphila okuhle, iTakealot ibuye ibheke phambili ekwenzeni imikhiqizo yayo ibonakale ebhizinisini elihlala likhula. Kuleli sonto, ibhizinisi lenze isivumelwano esisha nezinhlangano ezahlukene zokuphila, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza imikhiqizo emisha ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubathengi ukuthola imikhiqizo emisha, kwandisa ukuheha abathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTakealot izame ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayo baneliseka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwensizakalo yokusiza abathengi, enikeza ukwesekwa okusheshayo nokuphumelelayo. Ngokwenza lokhu, iTakealot ibonisa ukuzinikela kwayo ekuphakamiseni izinga lokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Kodwa-ke, nakuba iTakealot ikhipha izinyathelo ezinkulu, ibhekene nezithiyo ezithile. Ukuncintisana okuqhamukayo kwemakethe ye-e-commerce kudinga ukuthi iTakealot iqhubeke nokuzivumelanisa nezidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwandisa imikhiqizo, ukwenyusa izinhlelo zokuthengiselana, nokukhumbuza abathengi bayo ngezinzuzo zokuthenga ku-inthanethi. ITakealot iphinde ithathe izinyathelo eziphusile zokuhlonza imikhuba yabathengi, isebenzisa idatha ukuze iqonde kahle izidingo nezinhloso zabathengi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile ezithinta imikhiqizo, izaphulelo, nezinhlelo zokukhangisa. Emkhakheni wezezimali, iTakealot ibonakala ibaluleke kakhulu, ikhiphe amaholo amaningi futhi ibhanga izigidi zabathengi. Lokhu kuqhubeka kukhuthaza ukutshalwa kwezimali, okuvumela inkampani ukuthi iqhubeke nokwakha futhi ithuthukise amasevisi ayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengoba iTakealot iqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi ibheke phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obukhulu nabathengisi bendawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, kukhuthaze imikhiqizo yasekhaya, futhi kuqinise umnotho. Ngokubuka phambili, iTakealot ibonakala ikwakha isizinda esiqinile sokuhweba ku-inthanethi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngemuva kokubona impumelelo enkulu, inkampani ikholwa ukuthi izoqhubeka nokukhula, ifake ikhefu lokuqhamuka kwezindaba emkhakheni wezohwebo. Lokhu kuhlola nokuhlaziywa kwezidingo zabathengi kuzodala amathuba amaningi okukhula, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo ezintsha zokukhuthaza ukuthenga ku-inthanethi. Ngokuphetha, iTakealot ibonakala iyisibonelo esihle sokuhamba phambili emkhakheni wezohwebo ku-inthanethi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhula kwayo, izinhlelo zayo zokuthuthukisa, kanye nezithiyo ezibhekene nazo, konke lokhu kubonisa indlela iTakealot ehamba ngayo ukuze iqhubele phambili emotweni yokuthengisa ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuthenga, kukhuthaze ubuchwepheshe, futhi kuvingele abathengisi bendawo ukuba bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
iTesla Ngaphakathi kwezindawo ezikhiqiza amandla emhlabeni, kwavela inkampani eyayizoshintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngemoto. Le nkampani, eyaziwa ngokuthi iTesla, yayingathandwa kuphela ngenxa yokusebenza kwayo, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokubuka kwayo phambili. Ngonyaka ka-2003, u-Elon Musk, umphakathi wezemali owaziwayo, wathatha isinqumo sokwakha imoto engasebenzisi uphethiloli. Ngalesi sikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bezimoto ezisebenza ngogesi besiqala ukuthandwa, kodwa u-Elon wayefuna okuthile okungaphezu kwezinto ezilula. Wayefuna ukuhlinzeka imoto engahambisani nezinto ezinjengokungcoliswa komoya, futhi enezinga eliphakeme lokusebenza. Kwathi uma iTesla iqala ukukhiqiza imoto yayo yokuqala, i-Tesla Roadster, umhlaba waphenduka. Le moto yayiwumsebenzi ohlakaniphile, eyakhiwe ngensimbi eyinqaba, futhi ikwazi ukuhamba amakhilomitha angama-390 ngaphandle kokukhokha. Abantu baqala ukuthakazelela lezi zinguquko, benza iTesla ibe isithombe esisha sokuhamba. Njengoba iminyaka ihamba phambili, iTesla yathola izinselelo eziningi. Izinkampani ezinkulu ezikhiqiza uphethiloli zazikhathazekile ngokushintsha kwezomnotho ezazizovela. Kodwa u-Elon Musk wayenamandla okuphikisa. Waqhubeka nokwakha izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, wengezelela nezinhlelo zokukhucululwa kwama-battery ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni ne-Tesla Model S, imoto eyayikhipha umoya opholile, ngaphandle kokukhipha imfucumfucu. U-Elon, ongumholi onenhliziyo, wayengavumeli izinkinga zimbambezise. Waqhubeka nokwenza ubuchwepheshe bukhule, ehlanganisa izici ezintsha ezifana nezinhlelo zokukhiya ezizenzakalelayo nemoto ethola amandla emoyeni. I-Tesla yathola ukuqashelwa okuhle, futhi abantu baqala ukuvikela imvelo, beqonda ukuthi kungaba khona indlela yokuhamba ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa yikhwalithi. Njengoba imoto yokuqala ye-Tesla igxilile ekwakheni izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, uthando lwemoto olwahamba phambili lwakhula. Abantu abaningi bashintshe izimfanelo zabo, besukuma ezitimeleni nasezindaweni zokubasa, bejabulile ukufaka i-Tesla empilweni yabo. Isehlakalo sokwakheka kwemigwaqo eyenzelwe lezi zimoto, nesikhumbuzo sokuthuthuka kwedolobha, sathuthukisa umnotho, sazi ukuthi umhlaba ususwa phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTesla yaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimfanelweni zomhlaba. Abantu baqala ukufunda ukuthi izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi zingaba yisisombululo esingcono kwezokuthutha, futhi nezinkampani ezinkulu zavuma ubuchwepheshe obusha. I-Tesla yaphenduka uphawu lokuzinikela emhlabeni ophilayo, komphakathi ozinikele ekulondolozeni isimo semvelo. Ngemuva kokuthi iTesla ibhalwe emlandweni, u-Elon Musk waba uphawu lwezinguquko. Wazama ukuhamba phambili, ethuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Uhambo lwakhe lwemvelaphi lwaba yinsika yokuthola izixazululo ezizothuthukisa umhlaba. Ubuchwepheshe be-Tesla buye bukhula, bukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba ungathuthuka uma abantu benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. U-Elon Musk, ngezimoto zakhe, waqhubeka nokushaya umoya opholile, ethungatha phambili, ebamba izinkanyezi. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baqonda ukuthi iTesla akuyona nje imoto; kuyindlela yokuphila, umqondo ohlanganisa umhlaba ozinikele emvelweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo we-Tesla waba isibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu benza izinqumo ezizinzile, bangashintsha umhlaba. I-Tesla yaveza ukuthi izinguquko zingavela, ziqhamuke ezindaweni eziphakeme, kodwa zidinga unyawo oluqinile lokukhuthaza. Kusukela kulokhu, kwavela umphakathi ophilayo, ofuna izinto ezingcono, olandela izinyathelo ezithile. I-Tesla yabe isiqhubeka nokugcina umoya wokuthuthuka, ikhuluma ngezindaba zezobuchwepheshe, nezinto eziphilayo ezithuthukile. U-Elon Musk wayenqaba ukuhamba emuva, ehamba phambili, efuna ukuhlinzeka ngothando emhlabeni. Ekugcineni, iTesla yaphenduka isibonelo esiqinile sokuthi, uma abantu besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, bangashintsha umhlaba. Le ndaba, eyayiqala emsebenzini, yaba yimpumelelo eyaziwa emhlabeni wonke. U-Elon Musk wakhumbula ukuthi impumelelo ayifiki ngaphakathi komshini, kodwa ikhuluma ngothando nesimilo somuntu. Ngaleyo ndlela, iTesla yabe iyisiteshi sokuzinikela, esikhuthaza abantu ukuba balwe nezinkinga, benza umhlaba ube ngcono.
Yisiphi uhlobo lwebhizinisi okufanele ukhethe? Ukukhetha uhlobo lwebhizinisi kanye nesakhiwo sakhona kubalulekile. Isizathu salokhu sithi: kunomthelela omkhulu uma sikhuluma ngababusi, ubunjalo babanikazi, nabanye ababusi kanye nezindaba zezimali zebhizinisi elisha. Sizoxoxa ngohlobo lwezinkampani eziyisithupha ezibalulekile lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Ingxoxo izothinta izimo ezibalulekile zokwakheka. Lezi zinkampani zingaba: umnikazi oyedwa, ubambiswano nomunye noma abaningi, inkampani evaliwe (cc), ithemba lebhizinisi, noma ubambiswano. Izimo zokwakheka zihlobene nezinhlobo zebhizinisi ezifana nokuba khona kwabaphathi/abanikazi abathembekile, ukusungula izinqubo zokusebenza, ukuba nezibopho zokuphatha, ukusabalalisa inzuzo kanye nezintela ezihambisanayo, kanye namathuba okukhulisa imali ukuze kuqhubeke nokusebenza. Lapha asizoxoxi ngama-Companies kanye nezibambiso; sizokhuluma ngalokho kusasa ngoba lezi yizindaba ezibalulekile. Kubhizinisi obuncane, kubalulekile ngoba umnikazi oyedwa udinga imali encane futhi kulula ukuqala nokuphatha lelo bhizinisi. Nokho, ukusebenza kwalabo bhizinisi kuvame ukungakhuli futhi kungande. Ukuba umnikazi webhizinisi akusho ukuthi njalo kukhona ababusi, ngakho-ke ibhizinisi lithembele kumnikazi, impilo yabo, izimo zabo zokuphila, nezimali zabo. Lokhu kungadala nezingozi ezimpahleni zomnikazi. Uma ibhizinisi liphuka, kuzothinta nomnikazi. Ukusungulwa kwebhizinisi kulula ngoba umnikazi udinga ukubhalisela igama lebhizinisi nokuthola ilayisensi yokuhweba. Azikho ezinye izidingo ezisemqoka ngaphandle kwemithetho ekhona mayelana nalabo bhizinisi. Lokhu kungafaka nemithetho ephathelene nezempilo uma umnikazi enendawo efana ne-restaurants. Ukuba umnikazi webhizinisi kusho ukuthi uphatha ibhizinisi uqobo. Nokho, umnikazi angakhetha ukufaka umphathi ukuze aphathe ibhizinisi ngaye. Khumbula ukuthi noma ungum sahibi noma unomphathi, akukho thuba lokuthuthuka kulolo bhizinisi. Umphathi womnikazi oyedwa angashintsha ngokushesha indlela ibhizinisi elisebenza ngayo uma izimo zangaphandle zishintsha. Ukuba umnikazi oyedwa kwesinye isikhathi kungaba nzima ngoba umuntu oyedwa akanaso sonke ulwazi oluhambelana nokuphatha ibhizinisi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuphatha zonke izici ezifana nezimali, ukumaketha, ukusebenza, ukuthenga nokuthengisa, ukugcina amarekhodi, nokuphatha abasebenzi. Lapha akukhona ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwezimpahla zomnikazi nezindaba zabo zezimali ezihambelana naleli bhizinisi ngoba konke okwenziwayo kanye nenhlalakahle yebhizinisi kuyinzuzo yomnikazi. Ngakho-ke, zonke izintela ezingakaphumuli ebhizinisini zikhishwa kumnikazi. Nokho, umnikazi angathola ezinye izinzuzo njengomsebenzi. Ukuba umnikazi oyedwa akufani nokuba nebhrendi enabantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, zonke izindaba zezimali zizovela ephaketheni lomnikazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi thuba lokwandisa ibhizinisi ngokuthola uxhaso lwangaphandle luzokhawulelwa ezimpahleni nasezimali umnikazi anazo - uma engenazo eziningi, imali etholakalayo yangaphandle nayo ngeke ibe mkhulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile kumnikazi oyedwa ukuthi aqhubeke efaka ingxenye yezinzuzo zakhe emuva ebhizinisini uma efuna ibhizinisi lakhe likhule. Ukuba umnikazi oyedwa kusho ukuthi ibhizinisi lonke lifana nesikhwama sakhe. Uma efela noma ibhizinisi liphuka ngenxa yezikweletu, lelo bhizinisi lizophela. Uma ibhizinisi lidayiswa, alisasebenzi egameni lomdayisi, kodwa egameni lomthengi. Uma umnikazi efuna ukudayisa ibhizinisi, izexwayiso kufanele zikhishwe ukuze kuvikelwe bonke abanye abakhokhi bezikweletu. Uma umnikazi efuna ukuvala ibhizinisi, akudingi izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Izindaba zezimali zihlala kumphakathi womnikazi; uma beqeda ukusebenza, kusho ukuthi ibhizinisi closed. Ubambiswano uvame ukwenzeka uma abantu abanebhizinisi elifanayo, njengodokotela noma abameli, befuna ukuhlanganisa. Ubambiswano lusebenza kahle uma inani elikhulu lemali lingadingeki ukuze kuqale noma uma amakhono athile omuntu odinga ukuphatha ibhizinisi. Ubambiswano kuyisivumelwano phakathi kwabantu ababili noma abaningi. Inani lababambisene akufanele lidlule ku-20. Ababambisene abakhulumi nabanye bahlala bekhona. Abantu bangaba amalungu obambiswano njengabantu bemvelo. Isibonelo: ezinye izinkampani zakha i-consortium futhi zingaba ababambisane. Ababambisane abavela emsebenzini bahlukaniswa ngesikhathi ababe khona kulolo ubambiswano kanye nenani lemali abahlinzeke ngalo. Ababambisane abavela emsebenzini babamba iqhaza ekuphatheni ubambiswano, kodwa labo abangasebenzi baphatha ibhizinisi. Ababambisane abakhulumi baziwa kwabanye abaneqhaza elithile kubambiswano kodwa abakwazi ukukhuluma egameni lobambiswano. Umphakathi ongaziwa ngaphandle kobambiswano. Ubambiswano uhlose ukwenza ibhizinisi elisemthethweni elizokwenza inzuzo. Ngaphandle kwalokhu kuhloswe, abantu abakwazi ukudala ubambiswano. Umuntu ngamunye ubophelelekile ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokubambisana. Lezi zikhungo zingaba imali, izinsizakalo, noma ezinye izimpahla. Ngenkathi ubambiswano bukhona, izindaba zezimali zihlala kumphakathi wabo bonke ababambisane. Nokho, uma ubambiswano buphuka, izimpahla zizohlukaniswa phakathi kwabobambisane bonke kanye nomuntu ngamunye. Ubambiswano lusungulwa/ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabobambisane. Isivumelwano sithi bonke bazokwenza umzamo wokuthola inzuzo yokubambisana. Izibopho nezibopho zababambisane zihlobene nesivumelwano sobambiswano. Lokhu kufanele kuchazwe kulolo hlelo lobambiswano. Uma kungekho ukucaciswa, umthetho uthi inzuzo kufanele ihlukaniswe ngokuya ngempahla ethile yomuntu ngamunye. Uma kunzima ukunquma ukuthi ubani ohlinzeke ngani, khona-ke bonke ababambisane bazothola inzuzo efanayo. Ubambiswano aludingi ukukhokha intela, kodwa ababambisane kufanele bakhokhe intela ezinzuzweni abathola. Izindaba zezimali zihlanganiswa uma ubambiswano busungulwa phakathi kwabantu ababili noma abaningi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola uxhaso oludingekayo uma kuqhathaniswa nomnikazi oyedwa. Ababolekisi bahlola izimo zabobambisane bonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izimali ezidingekayo. Izikweletu zesikhathi eside zingase zingatholakali kalula ngoba ubambiswano abuyona ibhizinisi njengenkampani; ayiqhubeki ngokungapheli. Ukuqhubeka kobambiswano kufana nokuba umnikazi oyedwa, futhi kungaphela uma omunye wabambisane efela noma omunye ehluleka ngokwezimali. Uma umthetho ophathelene nokusungulwa kobambiswano ushintsha, ubambiswano luyaphela. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubambiswano obusha kufanele busungulwe. Uma umphathi efela, isivumelwano phakathi kwabobambisane siba sephukile. Umbiko Ngobudlelwano Lomndeni Isingeniso Ubudlelwano bomndeni buwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu, buhlanganisa izixhumanisi ezinzima phakathi kwabantu abahlala ndawonye. Lezi zixhumanisi ziqala emndenini, lapho umndeni ubonisa khona izimiso, izinkolelo, nemikhuba ebalulekile. Ubudlelwano bomndeni buphinde buveze indlela esiphila ngayo, indlela esibona ngayo umhlaba, kanye nezindlela esixhumana ngazo nabanye. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimiso Zobudlelwano Ubudlelwano bomndeni buqala ngokwakhiwa kwezimiso ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali nezingane, phakathi kwezihlobo, kanye phakathi kwabazali beqembu. Abazali banelungelo lokufundisa izingane zabo izimiso zokuziphatha, izinkolelo, kanye nemikhuba yendabuko. Lokhu kudala isisekelo esiqinile sokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu omndeni. Izihlobo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezihlobo buvame ukuba namandla, njengoba izihlobo zihlala zikhona ukuze zixhase, zikhuthaze, futhi ziqondise omunye nomunye. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphepha nokuxhaswa, okubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Izinkinga Eziphakathi Kwezakhamuzi Zomndeni Noma ubudlelwano bomndeni bukhona, akukhona njalo ukuthi buphelele. Izinkinga zenzeka phakathi kwamalungu omndeni, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni nasekuphazamisekeni. Izizathu ezivame ukuveza lezi zinkinga zifaka phakathi ukungaboni ngaso linye, ukungabi nesikhathi sokuxhumana, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezifana nezinkinga zezezimali noma izifo. Ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabazali nezingane kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kobudlelwano. Izingane zidinga ukuqonda nokuxhaswa, kanti abazali badinga ukuqonda izidingo nezinselelo zezingane zabo. Uma lezi zidingo zingahlangatshezwana, kungase kube nezinkinga ezinzima. Ukwelashwa Kwezinkinga Zobudlelwano Ukuze ubudlelwano bomndeni buphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu omndeni akwazi ukuxhumana kahle. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga, ukwabelana ngezinkumbulo, nokuxhasana ezimweni ezinzima. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudinga ukuzwelana, ukulalela, nokuhlonipha imizwa yabanye. Izindlela zokwelapha izinkinga zifaka phakathi ukuxhumana okuvulekile, ukuxhumana ngezikhathi ezithile, kanye nokuhlela imihlangano yomndeni. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi wonke umuntu akhulume futhi azwakalise imizwa yakhe. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudala umoya wokubambisana, okubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ubudlelwano Bomndeni Nempilo Yomuntu Ubudlelwano bomndeni buphinde buveze umthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu. Ubudlelwano obuhle buvame ukuholela ekutheni abantu babe nenhlalakahle engcono, baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo, futhi babe nekhono lokubhekana nezinselelo. Ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo buvame ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, njengoba abantu bezwa ukuthi banesekelo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubudlelwano obubi bungaholela ekutheni abantu babe nezinkinga zempilo, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, noma izinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano bomndeni bukhulu kakhulu empilweni yomuntu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle. Isiphetho Ubudlelwano bomndeni buwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu, buhlanganisa izixhumanisi ezinzima phakathi kwabantu abahlala ndawonye. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, sikhulume ngezinkinga, futhi sithuthukise ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu omndeni. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buvame ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi buvumela abantu ukuba baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde futhi sihlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubudlelwano bethu bomndeni.

Ibhola Lombhoxo (Rugby) Umbuzo 1: Yini ibhola lombhoxo? Ibhola lombhoxo, noma i-rugby, umdlalo odlalwa ngamaqembu amabili, lapho umgomo uwukudlulisela ibhola emgqeni ophakeme ukuze uthole amaphuzu. Umdlalo uvame ukudlalwa emhlabeni jikelele, futhi unama-variations ahlukene, njenge-Rugby Union ne-Rugby League. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimiso eziyisisekelo zomdlalo? Izimiso eziyisisekelo zomdlalo zifaka phakathi ukugijima, ukudlulisela ibhola, nokuvikela. Abadlali badinga ukwazi ukusebenzisa amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele, futhi umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaqembu. Umbuzo 3: Yini edlalwa ngempela emkhakheni we-rugby? Emkhakheni we-rugby, umphakathi udlala indima enkulu. Abadlali bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi umphakathi ubakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. Umdlalo ubalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokudlala ibhola lombhoxo? Ibhola lombhoxo inezinzuzo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa impilo yomzimba, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokufundisa amakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo. Abadlali bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, okwenza umphakathi ube namandla. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenza ibhola lombhoxo lihluke kwezinye izemidlalo? Ibhola lombhoxo lihluke kwezinye izemidlalo ngenxa yokugxila kwalo ekubambisaneni. Umdlalo udinga abadlali ukuba basebenze ndawonye, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdlalo unokuhlangenwe nakho okukhulu, okwenza kube mnandi kubadlali nababukeli. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakala emidlalweni ye-rugby? Emidlalweni ye-rugby, abadlali bafunda izifundo ezibalulekile, ezifana nokuhlonipha, ukuzimisela, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Lezi zifundo zibalulekile hhayi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa nasekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Umbuzo 7: Umdlalo we-rugby unethonya kanjani emphakathini? Umdlalo we-rugby unethonya elikhulu emphakathini. Uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi udala amathuba okuxhumana. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onamandla, ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuhle. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele uyazi uma uqala ukudlala ibhola lombhoxo? Uma uqala ukudlala ibhola lombhoxo, kubalulekile ukufunda izimiso zomdlalo, ukwakha amakhono, nokuzivocavoca. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuba neqhaza elihle, ukuze uthole ulwazi olungcono nolwaziyo. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabadlali be-rugby? Abadlali be-rugby babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokulimala, ukuncintisana, nokuphumelela. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinselelo zifundisa abadlali ukuba bahlale beqaphile, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokuzimisela. Umbuzo 10: Kungani ibhola lombhoxo libalulekile emhlabeni jikelele? Ibhola lombhoxo libalulekile emhlabeni jikelele ngoba lihlanganisa abantu, lishintsha izimpilo, futhi likhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Umdlalo unikeza ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi ubonisa amandla okusebenza ndawonye. Isiphetho: Ibhola lombhoxo, njengomdlalo, ungaphezu kokudlala; ungumoya, ubudlelwano, kanye nezifundo ezibalulekile. Umdlalo unikeza ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onamandla, futhi ufundisa izifundo ezibalulekile ezizokwenza impilo ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, uma ungakaze udlale, cabanga ngalesi sikhathi sokuzama, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuthi umphakathi wakho ungakwenza kube mnandi.
Umhlaba Wokwazi Ngolunye usuku, uSipho, umfana owayenothando olukhulu ngezinto eziphilayo, wanquma ukuya emkhakheni wezokucwaninga ezesayensi. Wayenolwazi oluhle ngalesi sikhala, futhi wayefisa ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo emhlabeni. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke efunda, efuna ukujula emhlabeni wezinto eziphilayo. U-Sipho wayehlala edolobheni elincane, lapho abantu besebenza ezicini ezincane zokuphila. Nokho, yena wayefuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani izinto zisebenza ngendlela ethile. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi eziningi eziphathelene nezesayensi, ezimfundisa ngama-atomu, imikhakha yezinto eziphilayo, kanye nezifundo ze-physics. Njengoba efunda, wathola ukuthi imvelo inemithethonqubo yayo, futhi le mithetho ibalulekile ukuze siqonde indlela izinto eziphila ngayo. Ngolunye usuku, uSipho wahlangana noDkt. Mthembu, isazi esidumile emkhakheni wezokucwaninga. U-Dkt. Mthembu wayenolwazi olunzulu ngempilo, futhi waba nomusa wokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi noSipho. U-Sipho wacela uDkt. Mthembu ukuba amfundise kabanzi ngalesi sikhala, futhi uDkt. Mthembu wamvumela ukuba abuyele emsebenzini wakhe. Ngesikhathi uSipho esebenza noDkt. Mthembu, wathola ithuba lokubona izifundo ezahlukene. Wabamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuhlola izitshalo, izilwane, kanye nezimo zomhlaba. Wafunda ukuthi izitshalo zidinga ukukhanya, amanzi, kanye nezinto eziphilayo ukuze zikhule. U-Dkt. Mthembu wamsiza ukuba aqonde indlela imvelo ehamba ngayo, nokuthi izilwane zisebenza kanjani ukuze zigcine ibhalansi emhlabeni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana zokusebenza noDkt. Mthembu, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuhamba naye emhlanganweni wezokucwaninga. Kulokhu, uSipho wathola ithuba lokwabelana ngocwaningo lwakhe noDkt. Mthembu. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwamkhuthaza ukuba ahlale efunda, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza izinto ezinkulu emhlabeni. U-Sipho waqala ukucabanga ngendlela angasiza ngayo umphakathi wakhe. Wafuna ukwenza umkhankaso wokwazisa abantu ngalesi sikhala, ukuze bazi ukuthi izesayensi zibalulekile empilweni yabo. Waqala ukuhlela izifundo ezincane ezikoleni, lapho abantwana bekhuthazwa ukuba baphendule imibuzo, bahlanganyele, futhi bafunde ngezinto eziphilayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwakha umoya opholile phakathi kwabafundi, futhi kwavula amehlo abantu abaningi. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ithuba lokubhalela izincwadi ezincane eziphathelene nezesayensi. Wabhalela abantwana izincwadi ezichaza izimfihlo zomhlaba, izitshalo, nezilwane. Lezi zincwadi zathokozisa abantwana, futhi zakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphinde bakhuthaze izifundo eziphathelene nezesayensi. U-Sipho waphinde wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emaphandleni, lapho abathintekayo bezama ukuphucula impilo yabo. Wafuna ukubona ukuthi izesayensi zingasiza kanjani ekwenzeni imiphakathi ibe ngcono. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokulima ezihlakaniphile, ezazisiza abantu ukuba bakhe izitshalo eziphilayo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa imithi engcolisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi wakhe ube neqhaza elikhulu ekulimaleni kwemvelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba isibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi izesayensi zibalulekile, futhi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi zempilo. Waba ngumholi emkhakheni wezokucwaninga, futhi wathola izindondo eziningi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe oncomekayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nokufuna ulwazi, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Ekugcineni, uSipho waphinde waqonda ukuthi izesayensi azihlanganisi kuphela nezinto eziphilayo, kodwa futhi zikhuluma ngempilo, uthando, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Wafunda ukuthi umhlaba uyinkanyezi, futhi wonke umuntu unendima yokudlala ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono. Ngalokho, uSipho waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi uthando lwezesayensi lungakhuthaza abantu, lwenze umphakathi ube ngcono, futhi lukhulise ulwazi lwethu ngempilo emhlabeni. Ngale ndlela, uSipho waba umholi wezokucwaninga, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphendule imibuzo, bafunde, futhi baphile impilo enobuchwepheshe. Uthando lwakhe lwezesayensi lwaholela ekutheni umhlaba ube yindawo engcono, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umqondo omuhle ungashintsha impilo yabanye. Ngakho, uSipho waphila impilo egcwele uthando, ulwazi, kanye nesifiso sokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono.
Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Umbuzo 1: Yini izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi? Impendulo: Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi ziwumqondo obalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukusiza abasebenzi ukuthi bathole ulwazi olusha, bakhule emakhonweni abo, futhi baphendule kahle ezidingweni ezishintshashintshayo zemboni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okusemthethweni, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezitholakala emsebenzini. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa? Impendulo: Ukuze ibhizinisi liphumelele, kubalulekile ukuba nabasebenzi abanolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe. Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zikhuthaza ukwethembeka, ukunciphisa ukuhamba kwabantu, futhi zikhulisa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izindlela ezisetshenziswa ekuqeqesheni abasebenzi? Impendulo: Kunezindlela eziningi ezisetshenziswa ekuqeqesheni abasebenzi. Ezinye zazo zifaka: ukuqeqeshwa okwenziwa emsebenzini, izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokufunda ezihlanganisa izifundo zokuqeqesha, kanye nezifundo ezisemthethweni ezikhiqizwa ezikhungweni zemfundo. Ukuze izinhlelo zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi zibe nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze zifinyelele ezidingweni ezihlukene zabasebenzi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi? Impendulo: Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kukhuphula ukusebenza kahle, njengoba abasebenzi benza imisebenzi yabo ngokuphumelelayo. Okwesibili, kuqinisa ukuzethemba kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuthi basebenze kahle. Okwesithathu, lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo emsebenzini, okwandisa umkhiqizo. Ekugcineni, ibhizinisi elithuthukisa abasebenzi liboniswa njengendawo enhle yokusebenza, okukhanga abaqashi abasha. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani ibhizinisi lingakha uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuqeqesha? Impendulo: Ukuze ibhizinisi likwazi ukukha uhlelo oluphumelelayo, kufanele liqale ngokuqonda izidingo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza ucwaningo, ukuhlola amakhono akhona, kanye nokuhlola izinjongo zebhizinisi. Ngemva kwalokho, ibhizinisi kufanele lwenze uhlelo oluhlanganisa izifundo ezisemqoka, izinsizakalo zokufunda ezitholakala emsebenzini, kanye nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kube nokubuyekezwa okuvamile kohlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi luhamba phambili nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo. Umbuzo 6: Yini edinga ukucatshangelwa lapho kudalwa izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa? Impendulo: Ukuze izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zibe nempumelelo, kufanele kuqondwe izici eziningana. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinsiza ezanele, okufaka phakathi izinsiza zokufunda, abaqeqeshi abanolwazi, kanye nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi. Okwesibili, izinhlelo kufanele zibe lula ukufinyelela, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukuzifinyelela kalula. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo nokubuyekezwa kwalezi zinhlelo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziyaqhubeka nokuhlangabezana nezidingo. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani abasebenzi bangazuza ezinhlelweni zokuqeqeshwa? Impendulo: Abasebenzi bangazuza ezinhlelweni zokuqeqeshwa ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, bathola ulwazi olusha nolwakhiwe, olungasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Okwesibili, bathuthukisa amakhono abo, okwenza kube lula ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni zabo zomsebenzi. Okwesithathu, lokhu kukhuthaza ukuzethemba, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zenza kube lula ukufinyelela emathubeni amasha, okukhulisa amathuba okukhula. Umbuzo 8: Yini edingekayo ukuze kube neziqinisekiso zokuphumelela kwezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa? Impendulo: Ukuze kube neziqinisekiso zokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhloso ezicacile nezilinganiso. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinjongo ezithile, ezilinganisiwe, ezitholakalayo, ezihambisanayo, nezisikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela zokuhlola impumelelo, njengezivivinyo, ukuhlolwa kokusebenza, kanye nemibuzo yokubuyekeza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle kangakanani nokuthi zingathuthukiswa kanjani. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ibhizinisi lingaqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ziyaqhubeka? Impendulo: Ukuze ibhizinisi liqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ziyaqhubeka, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezivamile. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlola izidingo zabasebenzi, ukubuyekeza izinhlelo ezikhona, kanye nokuhlola imiphumela. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo kwezinsiza, ukuze abasebenzi bahlale benolwazi olusha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhizinisi kufanele libe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuxhasa abasebenzi ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ibhizinisi liyiqaphele ukuze lihlale liphambili emkhakheni wezokuqeqesha? Impendulo: Ukuze ibhizinisi lihlale liphambili emkhakheni wezokuqeqesha, kufanele liqaphe izitayela ezintsha, izindlela zokufunda ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezidingo zemboni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengezinhlelo zokufunda eziku-inthanethi, kanye nokuhlola izinjongo zebhizinisi. Ukubambisana nezinye izinkampani, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nabachwepheshe emkhakheni kungasiza ekutholeni izinsiza ezikhulayo nezindlela ezintsha zokufunda. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zici, ibhizinisi lingakha izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa eziphumelelayo, ezizoholela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abasebenzi, okugcina ibhizinisi liphumelela.
Thina kule Ndawo sithanda ukusungula lezi "Izimiso Zokuqala Abantu" emsebenzini ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. Sizokhuthaza ukufezwa komsebenzi ofinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza okwamukelekayo nezimo ezifanele ngokushesha. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ukuxoxisana kwenziwa njalo nangendlela ehlelekile ukuze ihhovisi lakho likwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zamakhasimende akho. Abantu kufanele baziqhenye ngezinga nesimo esifanele sezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abathola zona ukuze bazi lokho okulindelwe. Kufanele ubeke kahle izimiso zokwandisa ukufinyelela okuqhubekayo kulabo abangakaze bakuthole, isibonelo, abantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izithiyo zokufinyelela ziyasuswa. Abantu kufanele bahlonishwe futhi banakekelwe. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha yeNdawo ifaka izindinganiso zokuthi amakhasimende kufanele aphathwe kanjani. Abantu kufanele banikezwe ulwazi oluphelele nolucacile ngezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abanelungelo lokufinyelela kuzo. Ekusebenzisa leli thuba lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele, amahhovisi kufanele ahlinzeke ngolwazi oluphelele nolucacile, futhi kufanele luhlaziywe mayelana nezinsizakalo abazinikezayo. Abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhishwa kanjani emahhovisi kaZwelonke nasezindaweni, ukuthi zikhokhwa malini, nokuthi ubani ophatha lezi zinsizakalo. Amakhasimende angaphandle akuwona kuphela okufanele afinyelele kulolu lwazi; abasebenzi bangaphakathi kufanele baphinde bathole. Inqubo yokuphatha akufanele ibe yimfihlo. Kufanele unikeze ulwazi ngomsebenzi wakho mayelana nezindinganiso zokusebenza ezibekwe, ukuphathwa kwezimali, nokusetshenziswa okufanele. Imininingwane yabasebenzi kanye namalungu aphatha akufanele ibe yimfihlo. Uma izindinganiso ezithembisiwe zingafezeki, kufanele kube nokuxolisa kubantu, kubanikeze incazelo ephelele futhi kuphinde kunikezwe isixazululo esisheshayo nesisebenzayo, futhi uma kukhishwa izikhalazo, abantu kufanele bathole impendulo enobubele nenhle. Amandla nezifiso zokuthatha isinyathelo uma izinto zingahambi kahle akuwona umphakathi omkhulu enqubweni yokubeka izindinganiso. Kufanele ukhuthaze impendulo ehhovisi lakho. Izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kufanele zikhishwe ngendlela efanele futhi efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ukusebenza kwezimali. Kufanele uqaphele izindawo lapho kudingeka khona ukonga futhi uthuthukise ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezizoletha ukonga.
Izinkinga Zezibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Isimo Esidinga Ukuxazululwa Ezweni lethu, imithombo yokunakekelwa kwezempilo ibaluleke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Lezi zibhedlela ziwusizo olukhulu emphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude nezinhlaka ezizimele. Nokho, kulesi sikhathi, kubonakala ukuthi zikhona izinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nalezi zibhedlela, ezidinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Okokuqala, i-infrastructure yezibhedlela zikahulumeni ibonakala ingahambisani nezidingo zethu zamanje. Izibhedlela eziningi zinezindawo zokwelapha ezindala, ezingasebenzi kahle, futhi ezidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni kube nokunganeliseki emsebenzini wezokwelapha. Abasebenzi bezempilo bahlala bedinga isikhala esinokuthula ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo, kodwa lapho izimo zingalungile, kuba nzima ukufaka isandla esihle emphakathini. Okwesibili, sithola ukuthi abezempilo abaningana baphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Iziguli eziningi zifika ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, futhi ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemithombo, abezempilo bahlushwa umsebenzi omningi. Lokhu kuholela ekuncipheni kokunakekelwa okutholwayo, njengoba kudingeka ukuthi abezempilo bakhuphule isivinini sokusebenza ukuze bafeze izidingo ezikhulayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwenza kube nzima kubo, kodwa futhi kuholela ekunciphiseni izinga lokunakekelwa kweziguli. Kulokhu, iziguli ezithola ukwelashwa zingase zingatholi ukunakekelwa okuhle, okubangela ukuthi zibe sengozini yokungapholi kahle. Okwesithathu, kunezinkinga ezinkulu zemali ezibhekene nezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Isikhala esinganeliseki semali sinomthelela omkhulu ekutholeni imithi, izinsiza, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Iziguli zidinga imithi ethile, kodwa uma izibhedlela zingatholi uxhaso lwezezimali olufanele, lokhu kuyalimaza impilo yomphakathi. Kunjalo, eminyakeni yamuva, sikhuluma ngempela ngokufaneleka kwezindleko zempilo, okuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba ezibhedlela ukuze bathole usizo. Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, futhi kudinga ukuba uhulumeni abheke ngeso lokho ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza zokuxhumana nokwazisa kubangela ukuthi abantu abazi kahle ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Abantu abaningi bazi kahle ukuthi badinga ukuya ezibhedlela uma bephila kahle, kodwa bangase bangazi ukuthi izinsiza ezithile zikhona yini noma ukuthi zisebenza kanjani. Ukubeka izinhlelo ezikhangayo zokuxhumana, ezifana nezikhangiso ezisemphakathini, kungasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi lwezempilo nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi babe nesithakazelo ekuphileni kahle. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga. Uhulumeni kufanele abeke phambili izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni, kuhlanganiswe nokwandiswa kwezinsiza zemali. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abaningi, kuhlanganiswe nezinkampani ezizimele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo iyatholakala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abasebenzi bezempilo, kubandakanya ukuhlinzekwa ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokukhuphula umsebenzi wabo, kodwa kuzosiza nakakhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ekugcineni, siyabona ukuthi izinkinga zezibhedlela zikahulumeni zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Lokhu akusikhumbuzi kuphela ukuthi impilo yethu ibalulekile, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nesithakazelo ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zempilo esizithola. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe nesandla ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga, ukuze sibe nesikhathi esihle sokuphila, sithole ukwelashwa okungcono, futhi siphile impilo enempilo. Hamba phambili, uhulumeni! Sifuna izibhedlela eziphilayo, ezisebenzayo, nezizothokozisa wonke umuntu.
Izindaba Zamanje: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimo Zamanje Izindaba zamanje zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zishintsha izimo zethu futhi zifaka izinqumo ezibalulekile. Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izimo ezithinta iNingizimu Afrika kanye nezindaba ezinkulu ezikhuluma ngazo emaphephandabeni, eziteshini zethelevishini, nakuma-inthanethi. Izimo Zomnotho Okwamanje, umnotho weNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila, ikakhulukazi zokudla, kubangela ukukhathazeka kwabaningi. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi inani labantu abaphila ngaphansi komkhawulo wezomnotho liye lenyuka, okukhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho zidinga ukugxila kakhulu. Uhulumeni uphakamisa izinhlelo zokwakha imisebenzi, kodwa izithiyo ezinjengokuntuleka kwemali yokutshala zihlala zikhona. Ezokuphepha Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izindaba zokuphepha zihlala zikhathaza. Ukukhula kobugebengu ezindaweni ezithile kudinga uhulumeni enze izinyathelo ezinqala. Izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi zikhuthazwa, kodwa umphakathi ubona kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile nezisebenzayo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi bezokuphepha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Ezokuhlalisana Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindaba zokuhlalisana zibalulekile. Ukukhula kokuhlukahluka kwezinkolo, izizinda, nezamasiko kudinga umqondo ovulekile. Izinhlelo zokuhlonipha izinkolo ezahlukene zikhuthazwa, kodwa izinkinga zokuqonda phakathi kwabantu zihlala zikhona. Ukuhlonipha nokwamukela abanye kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Ezokuxhumana Ezokuxhumana zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umbono wethu ngezindaba zamanje. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yinsiza yokwabelana ngolwazi, kodwa zibuye zibe nezinkinga zokuqinisekisa ubuqiniso bolwazi. Ukuqwashisa ngalezi zinkinga kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kweqiniso nokukhwabanisa. Ukuze sibe nolwazi olunembile, kudingeka sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola imithombo yolwazi. Izindaba Zomhlaba Ngaphandle kwezwe lethu, izindaba zomhlaba zikhombisa izimo ezinzima ezibhekene nezizwe eziningi. Ukuphikisana kwezombusazwe, izimpi, kanye nezinhlekelele zemvelo zibonisa ukuthi umhlaba udinga ukuxhumana nokubambisana. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe zidinga ukugxila ekwakheni izixazululo eziphusile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizwe kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezibucayi. Isiphetho Ngokubheka lezi zindaba, kubalulekile ukuba sibe neqhaza empilweni yomphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza ezindabeni zamanje akukhona nje ukukhuluma, kodwa kubandakanya ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Njengabantu, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuhlola izindaba, sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi onokuthula, onobulungiswa, futhi onempilo. Izindaba zamanje zikhombisa ukuthi sithinteka kanjani, zidinga ukuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ukuze sithuthukise izimo zethu.
UMnyango Wezabasebenzi usungule umthetho omusha, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo. Ikhophi yokuhlonza umkhakha iyatholakala kubathengisi bezincwadi eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi futhi iyatholakala ku-inthanethi: www.labour.gov. Yini inhloso yokuhlonza umkhakha? Ukuhlonza umkhakha contains izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo ezifana nezikhathi zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane, kanye nokuphela kwemigomo yokusebenza. Iphinde ibheke emiholweni elindelekile nokuthi yini okufanele ikhokhwe ngabaqashi. Ubani ophazamisekile yile mthetho? Noma yimuphi umsebenzi ophazamisa lowo mqashi, ongagcini ekuthengiseni, ukugcina impahla, noma ukusabalalisa, noma yimuphi umsebenzi osiza ibhizinisi lomqashi noma noma yimuphi umsebenzi owenziwa ezindaweni zalesi bhizinisi okungaphansi kwesisekelo somsebenzi esihlanganiswe nale mthetho. Ubani ongaphazamiseki yile mthetho? Abasebenzi abawasebenzeli amahora angama-24 noma ngaphansi ngenyanga abaphazamiseki. Uma kukhona udaba olungakhulunywanga kulolu hlelo, izinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wezimo Eziyisisekelo Zokusebenza (BCEA) zizosebenza kubaqashi nabasebenzi kule mkhakha. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nemiholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi kumele bathole okungenani imiholo ekhombisa kumathebula 1 kuya ku-3. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo bazothola imiholo efanayo? Abasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo kumele bathole okungenani izimali ezikhuluma kumathebula akhuluma ngenhla. Nokho, abasebenzi abathola imiholo ephezulu kunezikhombisa bazoqhubeka nokuthola lezo zikhombisa ngoba imigomo yokusebenza ayinakushintshwa nganoma iyiphi indlela. Noma okungenani inani ngamahora njengoba kucacisiwe kumathebula 1 kuya ku-3 ngamahora noma ingxenye yayo esebenziswe ngumsebenzi. Uma lowo msebenzi ukhiqiza noma uthengisa ngaphansi kwemiholo encane ebekwe ngenxa yezizathu ezibangelwa umqashi, kumele athole imiholo ekhombisayo. Babalwa ngokusebenzisa amahora asebenze aphelele ngosuku/amahora = imiholo ngamahora aphelele evikini/amahora evikini = imiholo ngamahora aphelele evikini/izinsuku ezisebenze = imiholo ngosuku aphelele ngenyanga/4. Imiholo yabasebenzi evikini lapho ukukhokha kungabalwa ngokubheka isikhathi noma lapho bethola imiholo eguquguqukayo ibalwa ngokusekelwe enanini eliphelele elihlanganiswe ezinsukwini eziyi-13 uma uhlukanisa ngama-13. I-slip yemiholo iyimpahla yomsebenzi. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso sokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa ezinyangeni zokuqala ezingu-12. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso sokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa eminyakeni yesibili ngemuva kokuqala kwalolu hlelo. Uma i-CPIX ingama-10% noma ngaphezulu, imiholo ekhombisayo izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-CPIX. Ukuhlinzekwa kokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokuphepha nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nezikhwama ezikhishwayo emiholweni? Umqashi akufanele akhumbuze umsebenzi ukuthi asayine imali eyengeziwe. Qaphela: Amahora achazwe ngenhla awasebenzi kubaphathi abaphezulu, abathengisi abahamba, noma abasebenzi abathola ngaphezulu kwe-R115,572. Amahora okusebenza kubasebenzi awangaphansi kwamahora angama-27. Ngoba umsebenzi akufanele asebenze ngaphezu kwamahora angama-45 evikini, umsebenzi osebenza amahora ayishumi ezinsukwini ezine akufanele asebenze ngaphezu kwamahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku lwesihlanu. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe akufanele sidlule ezinyangeni ezi-2 phakathi nesikhathi esiyishumi. Isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo kumele sinikezwe kungakapheli inyanga eyodwa ngemuva kokuthola imvume yesikhathi. Nokho, isivumelwano esibhaliwe singakhulisa lesi sikhathi sibe yizinyanga eziyi-12. Ngaphezu kwamahora angama-45 ajwayelekile evikini ngosuku oluthile lwamahora ayishumi okungeziwe evikini; noma ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezinhlanu evikini. Isivumelwano sizophela ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-12. Umsebenzi kumele akhokhelwe kuphela ingxenye yesikhathi sokuphumula, edlula imizuzu engamashumi ayisikhombisa. Isikhathi sokuphumula evikini kumele kube okungenani ngemuva kwamahora angama-36 alandelanayo ngaphandle uma kukhona esinye isivumelwano, okukhuluma ngeSonto. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe singahlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokuphumula okungenani ngemuva kwamahora angama-60 alandelanayo, njalo ngemuva kwesonto lesibili. Ukukhokha ngomsebenzi ngeSonto. Isivumelwano singavumela umqashi ukuba anikeze umuntu osebenza ngeSonto isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo esilingana nomphumela phakathi kwenani elitholwe ngumsebenzi ngokusebenza ngeSonto kanye nezinkokhelo ezivunyelwe ukuba zitholwe ngalowo msebenzi. Kumele bazi ngezimo zokuphepha nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye namalungelo abo okuhlolwa kwezempilo. Umsebenzi osebenza ngosuku lwezinsuku zomphakathi oluhlangana nosuku oluvamile lokusebenza komsebenzi kumele athole ukukhokhelwa kabili ngokuya ngomsebenzi wabo. Yimiphi imikhakha yokuphumula engathathwa ngumsebenzi? Kukhona izinsuku ezingaki ezitholwa ngumsebenzi ngonyaka? Abasebenzi banelungelo lokuphumula izinsuku ezintathu ngonyaka. Kwenzekani uma usuku lwezinsuku zomphakathi luhlangana nesikhathi sokuphumula sonyaka? Yini okufanele ibhekwe mayelana nezinsuku zokugula? Isikhathi sokugula sikhuluma ngenyanga ezingama-36 futhi sibalwa ngokusekelwe enanini lezinsuku ezisebenze ezinsukwini eziyisithupha. Abasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo basebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu evikini. Isikhathi sokugula sibalwa ngokuthatha izinsuku ezinhlanu zaphindwe ngama-6 (5x6) okukhombisa izinsuku ezingama-30 phakathi nesikhathi seminyaka emithathu. Umqashi angacela isitifiketi sezokwelapha uma umsebenzi engasebenzi izinsuku ezimbili ezilandelanayo noma kabili ezinsukwini eziyisithupha. Yini isikhathi sokuphila komndeni? Lokhu kuyisikhathi esinikezwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezithinta umndeni. Ubani onelungelo lesi sikhathi sokuphila? Abasebenzi abaqashwe ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezine futhi abasebenza okungenani ezinsukwini ezine evikini bangathatha izinsuku ezine zesikhathi sokuphila komndeni ngonyaka. Nini lesi sikhathi singathathwa? Lesi sikhathi singathathwa uma kukhulelwa ingane, uma ingane igula, noma uma umkakhe, umkhulu, ingane, umndeni, noma umfowethu womsebenzi eshona. Yiziphi izinto ezithinta isikhathi sokubeletha? Umsebenzi angabuyela emsebenzini ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngemuva kokubeletha ingane ngaphandle uma udokotela noma umphakathi unikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi umsebenzi angabuyela emsebenzini. Kulokhu, isaziso sosuku lokuhamba nokubuyela emsebenzini kumele sinike
Ukulalelwa komphakathi mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) Umbuzo 1: Yini iNHI? Impendulo: I-National Health Insurance (NHI) iyohlelo oluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kokubheka isimo sabo sezimali. I-NHI izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangenayo imali yokukhokhela imishwalense. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile iNHI? Impendulo: I-NHI ibalulekile ngoba izohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Izinhloso zayo zihlanganisa ukunciphisa ukungalingani kwezempilo, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphakeme, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa. Umbuzo 3: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzosebenza kanjani? Impendulo: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzosebenza ngokuhlanganisa izinsiza zezempilo ezikhona, kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni. Abantu bazokwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, izibhedlela, nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokukhokha. Umbuzo 4: Uphi umphumela we-NHI kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene? Impendulo: I-NHI izoba nomthelela omuhle kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude nezinhlaka zezempilo bazokwazi ukufinyelela izinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, okuzoholela ekwandeni kokuphila kahle. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezizotholakala nge-NHI? Impendulo: I-NHI izoletha izinzuzo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi: - Ukufinyelela okungcono kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. - Ukunciphisa izindleko zezempilo kumphakathi. - Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abangenayo imali yokukhokhela imishwalense. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okudingekayo. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe i-NHI izophazamisa izinhlelo ezikhona? Impendulo: I-NHI ayihlosile ukuphazamisa izinhlelo ezikhona, kodwa izosebenzisana nazo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo. Izinhlelo ezikhona zizodlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni uhlelo lwe-NHI. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngifuna ukwazi kabanzi nge-NHI? Impendulo: Uma ufuna ukwazi kabanzi nge-NHI, ungavakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezempilo, noma ujoyine imihlangano yokulalelwa komphakathi lapho ungabeka khona imibuzo nemibono yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe i-NHI izoba nezinselelo? Impendulo: Njengazo zonke izinhlelo ezinkulu, i-NHI izobhekana nezinselelo ezithile, njengokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo bayatholakala, nokwakha ukwethembeka komphakathi. Kodwa-ke, uhulumeni uzosebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinselelo. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-NHI iyaphumelela? Impendulo: Ukuze i-NHI iphumelele, uhulumeni uzothatha izinyathelo eziningana, ezifaka phakathi: - Ukuhlela kahle izinsiza. - Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezempilo. - Ukuxhumana ngempumelelo nomphakathi. - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo 10: Ngabe i-NHI izokwandisa izindleko zezempilo? Impendulo: I-NHI ihloselwe ukunciphisa izindleko zezempilo kumphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula, izindleko zokwelashwa eziphakeme zingancishiswa, okuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi. Umbuzo 11: Ngabe i-NHI izobandakanya izikhungo ezizimele? Impendulo: Yebo, i-NHI izobandakanya izikhungo ezizimele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banokukhetha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, okuzoba yinzuzo kumphakathi. Umbuzo 12: Uphi umphumela we-NHI ezimbonini ezihlobene nezempilo? Impendulo: I-NHI izoba nomthelela omkhulu ezimbonini ezihlobene nezempilo, njengoba izodinga izinsiza eziningi, abasebenzi, nezikhungo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kwamathuba emisebenzi nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 13: Ngabe i-NHI izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo? Impendulo: Yebo, i-NHI izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangenayo imali yokukhokhela imishwalense. Izinsizakalo zizotholakala kalula, futhi abantu bazokwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Umbuzo 14: Yini okufanele ngiyazi ngempela nge-NHI? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-NHI iyohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, izokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela, futhi izohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ukulalela imicabango nemibono yomphakathi kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni i-NHI ephumelelayo. Umbuzo 15: Ngabe i-NHI iyohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke? Impendulo: Yebo, i-NHI ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubheka isimo sabo sezimali. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi wonke. Ngokuhlanganyela, i-NHI iyinsiza ebalulekile ezohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Ukulalelwa komphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo luhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi futhi luthuthukisa impilo yabantu.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe: Umthelela Wabo Emphakathini Wamanje Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, abadali bokuqukethwe (content creators) baye baba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Lezi zinsizwa nezintombi, ezikhiqiza okuqukethwe okuhlukahlukene, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umqondo, ukusakaza ulwazi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngentokozo kubantu abaningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wabo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezihambisana nalolu hlobo lomsebenzi. Ukwanda Kwezinhlobo Zokuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ababhali, abaculi, abavakashi bezinkanyezi, nabadali bama-video. Ngamunye wabo unendlela yakhe yokuxhumana nezithameli, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi ohlangene. Ngokwesibonelo, ababhali bangasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana ne-Twitter noma i-Facebook ukuze babelane ngezindatshana zabo, kuyilapho abaculi besebenzisa ama-platforms afana ne-YouTube noma i-Instagram ukuze baveze ubuciko babo. Umthelela Emphakathini Umthelela wabakhiqizi bokuqukethwe empilweni yabantu ungabonakala kalula. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngentokozo, lezi zinsizwa zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindabeni, lapho abadali bokuqukethwe bephendula khona ngokushesha ezindabeni ezibalulekile, bephinde benze izethulo ezithokozisayo ezithinta izifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bexoxa khona ngezihloko ezibalulekile. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma kunjalo, abadali bokuqukethwe babhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhulu, izinguquko ezisheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezimfuneko ezinzima zokugcina izithameli zikhangekile, konke lokhu kudinga ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bahlale bephambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubungozi bokuphulwa kwamalungelo obunikazi kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha ku-inthanethi zikhona, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi abadali bokuqukethwe baqaphele izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala buguqula indlela abadali bokuqukethwe abakhiqiza ngayo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izinsiza zokuhlela, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe zenza kube lula kubo ukufinyelela izithameli eziningi. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abadali bokuqukethwe bakhule futhi bathuthukise amakhono abo, benza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okuthokozisayo nokwazisayo. Ikhono Lokuxhumana Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bephendula izidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kubasiza ukuthi bahlale bexhumene nezithameli zabo. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabadali bokuqukethwe kudala umuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomphakathi, okwenza abantu bazizwe bebalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima, lapho abantu befuna ukuxhumana nabanye ukuze bazizwe bephila. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadali bokuqukethwe baye baba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Umthelela wabo empilweni yabantu ubonakala ezindabeni, ezokuxhumana, nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Noma bahlushwa nezinselelo eziningi, ubuchwepheshe obusha buvulela amathuba amasha, futhi ikhono labo lokuxhumana lwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okuthokozisayo. Njengoba sithokozisa imisebenzi yabo, kubalulekile ukuqonda nokuhlonipha indima abadayisi bokuqukethwe abayidlalayo empilweni yethu yansuku zonke.
Lo msebenzi uchaza inqubo yokuthatha izinyathelo nokwakha uhlelo lokukhuthaza noma ukuvikela ngokumelene nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abadala. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhlukunyezwa okungahlangabezana nabantu abadala. Ukuhlukunyezwa komzimba: Noma iyiphi isenzo esiholela ekulimaleni noma ekufeni komuntu omdala. Njengokubashaya, ukubashaya ngento, ukubaphusha, ukubaphatha ngokuqinile, ukubabhabhadisa ngenkemba, ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali noma izibopho ukuvimbela ukuba benze okuthile, ukusebenzisa imishanguzo engafanele noma ey excessive, noma noma iyiphi isenzo esiholela ekulimaleni, ukuphazamiseka komzimba, ukubaphoqa ukuba bathathe izidakamizwa ezithulisa noma izinto ezingaholela ekufeni. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezocansi: Noma iyiphi isenzo esiholela ekusebenzeni komuntu omdala njengomlisa wezocansi noma ukuthokozisa ngokocansi ngaphandle kokwazi kwabo, ukuqonda, noma imvume. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwengqondo, ukuhlaselwa kwemizwa, noma ukuhlukunyezwa kwamazwi: Umjikelezo ophindaphindiwe wokuhlukumeza umuntu omdala, okubangela ukuthi ingqondo yabo isebenze kahle futhi umoya wabo uphazamiseke. Njengokubakhumbuza ukuthi abavunyelwe, ukubahlukanisa, ukuvimbela izinto ezithile, ukubadela uthando, nokuthuthukiswa kwengqondo, ukubabiza ngamagama angajabulisi, ukwenza kube yisihloko sokuhlekisa, ukubabeka ezimeni eziphansi, nokubabheka njalo. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezezimali noma ukuhweba ngokwezimali: Ukusebenzisa kabi imali yokubolekwa komuntu omdala, impahla, izinto, noma izimali ngaphandle kwemvume yabo noma ulwazi lokuthi kuzokwenzekani noma ngaphandle kokwaneliseka kwabo ngalokho. Ukunganaki: Ukwehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka ezigcina umzimba nengqondo. Njengokugcina ukudla, ukwehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, noma ukungaqinisekisi ukuthi bajabule futhi banakekelwe. Ukuphikisa amalungelo abantu: Ukuthatha amalungelo omuntu omdala, njengokubapha ukuhlonishwa, isithunzi, ukuvumela ukuba babe nephutha lokucabanga ngalokho abakufunayo, bakholelwe kulokho abakufunayo, bakhulume ngemibono yabo, futhi bakhulume ngendlela abayithandayo mayelana nalapho abafuna ukuya khona. Lokhu kunganaki kungaholela ekubizweni kwabo njengemikhonyovu, ukwehlukaniswa, ukulimala, noma ukufa. Noma ubani obona ukunganaki komuntu omdala noma ukuhlukunyezwa kwabo, noma othile onenkinga yokusola ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa okukhulunywe ngenhla kuyenzeka noma sekukhona. Uma umxhumanisi engumsebenzi wezokuhlalisana ohlanganyela ngqo nalezi zindaba, kufanele aqhubeke nocwaningo futhi anikeze umbiko ophelele obhalwe phansi ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi phakathi kwezinsuku ezine. Uma umxhumanisi engumsebenzi wezokuhlalisana, kubalulekile kumsebenzi omdala wezokuhlalisana ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuba anikeze umuntu ofanele ukwenza lo msebenzi futhi alindele umbiko phakathi kwezinsuku ezine. Uma ukuhlukunyezwa kuhambisana nendlu yabantu abadala, noma inhlangano engakaze ibhekelele, noma inhlangano yomphakathi, umphakathi wezokuhlalisana ofanele kumele abhekane nalesi simo. Uma isimo singahambisani nencazelo engenhla, funa izifiso zomuntu ohlukunyezwayo. Umphathiswa wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, noma ilungu lekhansela kufanele avume omunye umuntu ukusiza. Amafomu atholakala ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze.
Izitshalo zihlukaniswa zibe yizigaba ezimbili - lezo ezinezimpande ezibanzi (i-dicotyledonous) kanye lezo ezinezimpande ezincane (njengezihlahla). Izimpande ezincane zinezinhlaka ezihamba ngokuhambisana ukusuka emzimbeni ziye phezulu. Izimpande ezibanzi zinezinhlaka ezifana nezihlahla. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ngoba amakhemikhali asebenza ngendlela ehlukile kulezi zimbili zezithombo. Izimpande zenzelwe ukuqinisa isitshalo emhlabathini zibe phezulu futhi ziwathathe amanzi nezinsiza emhlabeni. Isitshalo se-maize sinezimpande ezithambile. Lapho isimo sezulu silungile, isitshalo se-maize singaba nezimpande ezihamba ziye ku-1,500 m uma zihlanganiswa. Lapho izimpande zikhula kahle, zingafinyelela ubukhulu obungama-1.5 m ezindaweni zethambo futhi zingangena emhlabathini kuze kube ngu-2 m ubukhulu. Ngokuvamile, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezimpande - impande eyodwa (impande eyodwa eqinile ethambile ekhula phansi, engase ibe nezimpande ezihambisana nayo) kanye nezimpande eziningi (uhlelo lwezimpande ezivela) (izimpande eziningi ezikhula ngasohlangothini, hhayi kuphela phansi). Isitshalo se-maize sinezimpande eziningi, futhi njengoba sikhula, sithuthukisa izimpande zokusekela, ezisiza ukusekela isitshalo ukuze singaweli. Lezi zimpande ziyi-adventitious futhi ziqala ukukhula ngaphezulu komhlaba. Ithambo lesitshalo se-maize lifana necilindeni. Kucacile ukuthi kunezikhala (lapho amahlamvu phuma khona) nezindawo phakathi kwezikhala. Ukuphakama kwethambo kuhluka ngohlobo lwe-maize kanye nezimo zezulu. I-cob ye-maize ingaba nezikhala eziphakathi kuka-8 no-21. Lezi zikhala azinobude obulinganayo. I-cob ye-maize ivamise ukuqala ukuthuthukiswa lapho kunezikhala eziyi-8. Amahlamvu amabili akhula ukusuka kwesikhala esisodwa. Umsebenzi wama-leaves uwukuthatha ukukhanya kwelanga futhi asebenza njengefektri yethambo ukukhiqiza ukudla. Amahlamvu akhula ngokuhambisana ethambeni. Ihlamvu imide, incane, futhi iphumelele phezulu. Ihlamvu ixhaswa yizinhlaka eziqinile ezihamba ukusuka emzimbeni ziye phezulu. Ihlamvu yethambo iphila ngezinhlaka ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-stomata. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ama-stomata." Ama-stomata atholakala ngaphansi kwehlamvu amaningi uma kuqhathaniswa nalawo phezulu. Lapho kushisa futhi kukhukhuleka, ama-stomata akhipha inani elincane lamanzi futhi ihlamvu iyacindezela. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi ihlamvu ivale futhi inciphise ukulahleka kwamanzi. Ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezishisayo kakhulu, ama-stomata abanga amahlamvu ukuba acindezele. Ngobusuku lapho kuqala ukupholisa, amahlamvu avula ukuze enze umsebenzi wawo. Lapho ukushisa nokukhukhuleka kuqhubeka isikhathi eside, ama-stomata awakwazi ukuvula amahlamvu futhi aphile - lokhu kuyisimo esiyingozi esingalungiswanga futhi umkhiqizo uzoncipha. Isitshalo se-maize sinezimbali zomfazi nezomfana - lokhu kusho ukuthi isitshalo se-maize singaziphendulela (ukukhulisa). Ingxenye yomfazi ithuthukiswa ibe yicob, kanti ibhande lomfana liyisicabha phezulu kwesitshalo. I-kernel encane ixhunywe ku-silk (ibhande lomfazi) phakathi kwe-cob. I-pollen (ibhande lomfana) iwela ku-silk futhi ikhulisa leli bhande kuze kufike ku-kernel encane. Ukukhulisa kwenzeka lapho i-pollen ifika kule kernel. Lapho kushisa kakhulu futhi kukhukhuleka, kungenzeka ukuthi i-pollen iyoma futhi ingafiki ku-kernel. Lokhu kuzobonakala ngama-kernel amancane ku-cob. Ibhande lomfazi lingamukela i-pollen phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-10 kuya kweziyi-14. Wonke umsebenzi wokutshala i-maize uhlose ukukhiqiza imbewu yokudla. Ubuningi kanye nekhwalithi ye-kernel kubalulekile uma sifuna ukuthola inzuzo emasimini ethu. Izinto ezingathinta umkhiqizo zifaka: izifo, izidingo zokudla zesitshalo, amanzi atholakalayo, izinga lokushisa ngesikhathi sokukhula, nokukhetha uhlobo olufanele lwe-maize. Ukubaluleka kwalokhu kuhlobene nohlobo lwamakhemikhali asetshenziswe ngoba amanye asetshenziswa ngaphambi kokuthi isitshalo sikhule kanti amanye asetshenziswa ngemuva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule. Le nkathi ivela ngesikhathi sokutshala kuze kube yisikhathi sokukhula kwesitshalo. Le nkathi ichaza isikhathi ngemuva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule emhlabathini. Singahlukanisa izigaba eziyi-10 zokukhula kwesitshalo se-maize. Isigaba 0 - ukusuka ngesikhathi sokutshala kuze kube ukukhula. I-maize itshalwa ngaphezu kuka-2.5 cm kuya ku-5 cm emhlabathini. Lapho kushisa futhi kukhona amanzi anele, imbewu ithatha izinsuku eziyi-6 kuya kweziyi-10 ukuze iqale ukukhula. Uma kubanda noma kukhukhuleka, imbewu ingathatha amasonto amabili ukuze ikhule. Izinga lokushisa elihamba phambili ukusiza imbewu ukuba ikhule liphakathi kuka-20°C kuya ku-30°C. Umoya emhlabathini kufanele ufike ku-60% (amanzi amaningi noma amancane kuzokwandisa isikhathi sokukhula). I-genetics yohlobo lwe-maize ichaza inani lama-leaves nama-ears azokhula. Ihlamvu entsha ivamise ukuvula njalo ezinsukwini ezintathu. Ngalesi sikhathi, indawo lapho isitshalo sikhula isaphansi komhlaba. Isicabha sikhula futhi. Ngalesi sikhathi, usayizi wama-leaves ukhula izikhathi ezinhlanu kuya kwezingu-10, futhi isisindo sethambo sikhula ngo-50x kuya ku-100x. Ukuvela kwesicabha kuqala manje. Izimpande eziphezulu ziqala ukukhula ubukhulu obungama-5 cm kuya ku-7.5 cm phezulu komhlaba. Isicabha siqala ukukhula ngokushesha. Izicabha ezine-silk ziqala ukuvela ngokushesha ezikhala eziyi-6 kuya kweziyi-8 phezulu komhlaba. Inani lemibewu ku-cob limisiwe. Ithambo likhula kakhulu ngobude futhi isicabha sikhule. Amahlamvu avulekile ngokuphelele futhi isicabha sibonakala ezinsukwini ezimbili noma ezintathu. Ithambo eline-sicabha esikhulu kanye nama-leaves esicabha cishe selikhule ngokuphelele. Ngalesi sikhathi, isitshalo sidinga izinsiza eziningi. Isicabha, ithambo, nama-leaves konke sekukhule ngokuphelele. Isisindo se-kernels siqhubeka nokukhula. Imbewu iqala ukuqina. Lapho i-kernel ifika ekupheleni kwesikhathi sokukhula, ama-husks amnyama akhula phezulu lapho i-kernel ihlezi phakathi kwesicabha. Imbewu isiphumelele ngokuphelele, futhi manje ilindele kuze kube yoma ngaphambi kokuvuna. Imbewu idinga ukunciphisa umswakama ukuze iphelelise. Ukuqanduka kwenzeka ku-5% ngeviki kuze kube kufike ku-20%, ngemuva kwalokho ngeke kuqande ngokushesha.
Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, kanti nezidingo zezimboni ziya ngokuya zanda. I-GEMS (Government Electronic Management System) ibonakala iyinsiza ewusizo ekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza zik 정부. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda imikhawulo yokusebenzisa le nsiza, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho lisebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Umkhawulo omkhulu wokusetyenziswa kwe-GEMS ubandakanya imithetho yokuhweba. Ukuze uhwebo luhambe kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu ophakathi kwenqubo aqonde izinqubo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni izinkinga ezivela ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. I-GEMS ibeka izimiso ezicacile zokusebenzisa, ezihlanganisa imikhawulo eminingi yokuthi ubani ongasebenzisa le nsiza nokuthi isetshenziswa kanjani. Lokhu kuzosiza ekugcineni ukwethembeka nobulungiswa, okubalulekile emkhakheni wezohwebo. Ngokwengxenye, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibandakanya izinhlelo zokuphepha. Ukuze uvikele idatha ebalulekile, i-GEMS ibeka imithetho eqinile mayelana nokufinyelela kolwazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuphela abantu abaqinisekisiwe abavunyelwe ukufinyelela kudatha ethile. Lokhu kuqinisa ukuphepha, kepha kungaholela ekutheni kube nezithiyo ezithile kumabhizinisi amancane, ikakhulukazi uma engazi kahle indlela yokufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Enye imikhawulo ibonisa ukuthi i-GEMS ayifuni ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakusebenza ezihlobene nezinhlelo eziphikisanayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zik 정부 zitholakala kubasebenzisi abahamba phambili, futhi azitholakali kubantu abenza amaphutha. Lokhu kuphinde kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza ziqondisiwe futhi zisetshenziswa kahle, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi angafuni ukulandela lezi ziqondiso. Ukuphela komkhawulo wokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ubonisa umthelela wezomnotho. I-GEMS ibhekelela izinqubo ezithile, futhi lokhu kungashintsha umthelela kumabhizinisi amancane. Uma umkhawulo ubonakala ungenza kube nzima ukuhweba, kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, okuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okukhula. Kubalulekile ukuthi abahlinzeki bazi ukuthi imikhawulo ethile ingaba nomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini wabo.
