Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenxa yezinguquko ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinto ezinjengokushintsha kwemithetho yokuhweba, ezokuphepha, noma izinqubomgomo zomnotho. Ngakho-ke, abahlinzeki kufanele bahlale beqaphile ngezinguquko ezingenzeka, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi imikhawulo ikhona yini nokuthi izithiyo zingaba kanjani. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zik 정부 zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abahlinzeki baqonde kahle le mikhawulo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezithiyo ezinzima. Ukuqonda lezi zimo kuzobasiza ekuqhubekeni phambili kwezimboni zabo, beqinisekisa ukuthi bayakwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, uma uhweba usebenzisa i-GEMS, kubalulekile ukulandela le mikhawulo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho liphumelela, futhi ugweme izinkinga ezingase zibe khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, khumbula ukuthi ukuqonda imikhawulo akukhawuleli kuphela ekusebenzeni, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukukhula okuzinzile komnotho. Njengoba uhamba phambili, khumbula ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi iyinsika ebalulekile yokuphumelela.
Le nsizakalo itholakala kunoma ubani osebephathwe kabi. Uma othile esebenzisa ubugebengu, angaxhumana namaphoyisa ngokushaya inombolo: 10111 noma ngokuvakashela emaphoyiseni aseduzane ukuze abike ubugebengu. Uma uphoyisa efika endaweni lapho ubugebengu bwenziwe khona, uzothatha isitatimende kumlamli kanye nanoma ubani obonile uma ekhona. Umlamli kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ugcina inombolo ye-CAS eyanikezwa yona ukuze enze imibuzo yesikhathi esizayo mayelana necala lobugebengu. Umphoyisa uzokhuluma nabo bese ethatha isitatimende kumlamli futhi abhale phansi ubugebengu obubikiwe kwi-CAS. I-docket yecala ebhalisiwe inikezwa umphoyisa ophenya ozokuqhubeka nophenyo. Zonke izicelo kumele ziqondiswe kulomphenyi. Umphenyi ophathiswe leli cala uzophetha uphenyo bese ethumela i-docket enkantolo efanele ukuze abhekane necala. Umphenyi uzokwazisa umlamli uma kudingeka ukuthi aye enkantolo ukuze alalele leli cala. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa. Umphoyisa othatha isitatimende uzogcwalisa ifomu.
Ilungelo lokukopela liyilungelo lokuvikela umsebenzi wakho okungabandakanya imibhalo nezincwadi, izinhlelo zekhompyutha, imisebenzi yobuciko, izinto ezithunyelwa, umculo, amafilimu, noma amavidiyo. Ukuvikelwa kusho ukuvimbela abanye ekukopeleni, noma ekukhiqizeni lowo msebenzi noma impahla, futhi beyisebenzisa ukuze bathole inzuzo yezezimali. Umthetho Wokukopela ka-1978 usungula ilungelo lokukopela. Uma unomqondo wokuqala, awukwazi ukuba nelungelo kulowo msebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi uqale ubonise lowo mbono ngendlela ethile efana nencwadi, ikhadi, i-CD, isithombe esiphekiwe, umdlalo odlalwa esiteji, noma ifilimu. Ngokuvamile, labo ababhala, baphrinta, baphuma, badlale, bakha isithombe esaziwa noma esithathwe, bapenda, benza ifilimu, noma baphawula lowo msebenzi bangabantu abaphethe ilungelo lokukopela kulowo msebenzi. Nokho, kwesinye isikhathi, uma umuntu enikezwa umyalo wokwenza lowo msebenzi futhi ekhokhelwa ukudala le ngxenye yomsebenzi, amalungelo aphuma kumqashi owamukelele ukuba akhe lowo msebenzi. Emisebenzini eminingi, akudingeki ukufaka isicelo sokukopela. Ukuba nelungelo lokukopela kunikeza "ubunikazi" kulowo msebenzi kanye nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwawo ukuze kutholakale inzuzo yezezimali. Uphawu lokukopela oluvame ukubonwa ngu: ©. Ngemuva kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka eyisithupha, kwenziwa ukuhlolwa kwesiko, bese ilungelo lokukopela linikezwa enyangeni yesixhenxe.
### Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngemvakwe Zamahlodidayo Kuyajabulisa uma izinsuku zamaholide zifika, akunjalo? Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa imindeni, bezithokozisa ngeziphuzo ezishisayo, bathokozisa amaholide ezinkanyezi. Kodwa, akukhona konke okukhanya. Ezinye izikhathi, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela, futhi kulapho sizodinga usizo olukhawulezayo. Ukuthi isimo esiphuthumayo siwukuhlupheka kwempilo, ukuhlangana nezingozi noma ezinye izinkinga, kubalulekile ukuba nezinselelo ezithile ezitholakalayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ziba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngakho, ake sithathe isikhathi sikhulume ngalezi zinsizakalo, ukuthi zisebenza kanjani, nokuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuziqonda. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola usizo ngokushesha. Kungaba ngemuva kokuphazamiseka, ukuhlaselwa, noma ngisho nezimo eziphuthumayo ezinjengokungaphatheki kahle. Ngakho, uma abantu beshayela izimoto, kufanele bazi ukuthi uma kwenzeka okuthile, bangabiza usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi zamaholide lapho izithuthi zingaba ziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, seziqala ukufika izinsizakalo ezithile ezikhethekile. Isibonelo, emakhaya nabantu abaningi, izinsizakalo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ziba munye nalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma umuntu ethola ukulimala ngesikhathi sokuhamba, kudingeka ukuthi kube nomuntu ongamsiza ngokushesha. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo nokuthola usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo azizange zikhona emadolobheni kuphela. Ziyatholakala nasemaphandleni, okuyinto ebalulekile. Uma umphakathi ungakabi nezinsiza ezanele, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphileni kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bazi ukuthi bangabiza ini uma kunezimo eziphuthumayo. Uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinsizakalo, kubalulekile futhi ukusho ukuthi zisebenza kanjani. Isinyathelo sokuqala sokubiza usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo yikubiza inombolo ethile, ngokuvamile ethile. Kulezi zinsuku, iningi labantu lihlala nelayisha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithile ezisebenza nge-smartphone. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kakhulu, ngoba ungabiza usizo ngokuqhafaza nje. Ngemva kokubiza, kubalulekile ukuphawula kahle isimo. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abaphuthumayo bafika ngokushesha. Kuhle ukuthola ukuthi ubani othintekayo, ukuthi kwenzekeni, nokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo. Ngokwenza lokhu, ungahlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze usizo lufike kakhulu nakakhulu. Njengoba izinsuku zamaholide ziqhubeka, abantu bahlala behamba, beshaya izithuthi, futhi bejabulela izikhathi ezinhle. Kodwa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zihlala zikhona. Njengoba sithokozisa, sithemba futhi ukuthi zonke izimo zizoba nezenzakalo eziphathekayo. Ngakho, ungakha imininingwane ethile yokuthi ungabiza kanjani usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo, ungakhohlwa ukuba nomyalezo ocacile lapho udinga usizo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi izinsiza zihlala zikhona, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sikhona ezindaweni ezikude noma ezisemadolobheni. Uhlelo lwezimo eziphuthumayo alunamkhawulo. Ngakho, uma ungathi ungathanda ukufunda ngokwengeziwe, ungaxhumana nezikhungo ezifanele ezisemakhaya. Ukuze sibe nokuphepha, kufanele sikhumbule ukuhamba kancane, ukugwema izingozi, nokuhlola izindawo ezihamba phambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi silondoloze izikhathi zethu zamaholide, sikhumbule ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zikhona, futhi sithole ukuqonda ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani lokhu ukuze siphile kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ziyaqhubeka nokuba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu. Noma ngabe sikhuluma ngezinsizakalo zezempilo, ezokuphepha, noma ezokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuqonda lezi zinsizakalo ukuze sibe nokuphepha ngesikhathi samaholide. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi sithokozise kahle futhi sithole ithuba lokujabulela lezi zinsuku ezikhethekile. Ngamafuphi, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi zamaholide. Akukhona nje ukugcina ukuphepha, kodwa futhi kuhlangene nokuba nezinselelo ezilungile ukuze sihlale siphila ngokuthula. Ngakho, phila kahle, bheka izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi ujabulele izinsuku zakho zamaholide!
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Isidingo Esibalulekile Sabantu Amanzi ahlanzekile, nakuba engavami ukutholakala, ayisona kuphela isidingo sokuphila, kodwa futhi yindlela yokuphila. Ezweni lethu, sikhumbula izinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nokungahambi kahle kokuphakelwa kwamanzi, okubangela ukuthi kube nesidingo esikhulu sokugxila ekutholeni nasekuhlonipheni lezi zinsiza. Kule ndatshana, ngizobe ngiphakamisa imibono yami ngalolu daba olubalulekile. Uhlanga lwezimpilo zethu luncike ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile, ngoba amanzi ayisisekelo sokuphila, futhi ngaphandle kwawo, impilo yethu ingase ibhekane nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele bahlaselwa izifo ezibangelwa amanzi angahlanjwa, njengezifo zokuphefumula, isifo somphakathi, nezinye izifo ezinzima. Ngakho-ke, amanzi ahlanzekile abalulekile hhayi kuphela ezindlini zethu, kodwa futhi nasemiphakathini, ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, nasemakolishi nasemanyuvesi. Kodwa-ke, emiphakathini ethile, ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile akulula. Izinkinga eziningi, ezifana nokungabi khona kwesistimu yokuhlanza amanzi, izinyathelo ezingafanele zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, kanye nokungabi nakho kwezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhaswa, zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lwamanzi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni impilo ibe nezinkinga ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awusizo kuphela uma sikhuluma ngazo. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uyaziqonda izindlela zokuvikela amanzi, zokuhlanzeka, nezokuhlala enhlanzini. Uma umphakathi uqonda ukubaluleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile, bazobona ukuthi izindlela zokuhlanzeka ziyadingeka, futhi bazokwazi ukuvikela izinsiza zabo. Ukuze sithole amanzi ahlanzekile, kudingeka sisebenzisane. Abaholi bemiphakathi, izikhungo zempilo, nezikhungo zemfundo kufanele baxhumane ukuze bahlomule. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezihlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile, ukufundisa abantu ngezinhlelo zokuhlanzeka, nokwakha izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze abantu bacacise izidingo zabo, kuyindlela eqinile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundazwe zethu nezwe lonke kufanele zisebenzise izinsiza zazo ukusiza abantu baphile impilo engcono. Ukuxhaswa kwezimali ezinhlelweni zokuhlanza amanzi, ezokuhlanzeka, kanye nezokufundisa umphakathi, kuyadingeka. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuhlonipha labo abahlanganyela emizamo yokuphucula impilo yomphakathi. Ekugcineni, amanzi ahlanzekile ayisici esiyinhloko sokuphila kwethu. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kufanele sizame ukusiza abanye abantu nabazimele. Sihamba phambili, sikhuthaza ukuba sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sibe nemiphakathi enempilo, inhlanzeko, nempilo engcono. Ngakho-ke, umbono wami ucacile: amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esibalulekile. Singabantu abaphezulu uma sithola ukuhamba phambili ekutholeni nasekuhlonipheni lezi zinsiza. Njengoba silwela ukufezekisa izinga eliphezulu lempilo, kufanele sihloniphe, sithuthukise, futhi sikhuthaze amanzi ahlanzekile, ukuze impilo yethu kanye neyezizukulwane ezizayo ibe ngcono. Lokhu akukhona nje umbono wami, kodwa kuyisibopho sobuntu bethu.
Ukuze usebenzise kahle izicwangciso zakho zesikhathi esizayo futhi ufeze izinhloso zebhizinisi lakho, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izicwangciso zakho kusenesikhathi. Imvula kaJuni 2011 ixoxiwe mayelana nesicwangciso sokuphathwa kwebhizinisi. Sathi kungcono ukuba nesicwangciso esiphakathi kunokungabi nesicwangciso esijwayelekile, futhi sathi lokhu kuy umsebenzi obalulekile wokuphathwa kwebhizinisi. Umsebenzi wesibili wokuphathwa kwebhizinisi esizowuxoxa ngawo ukuhlanganisa kahle izicwangciso zakho zokusebenza. Lapho uhambisa izicwangciso, kusho ukuthi kudingeka ulungiselele ukuzenza lapho wenza imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo. Nokho, kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi lapho sisebenza ekwakheni izicwangciso nasekuhlanganiseni izicwangciso, kwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. Ukuhlanganiswa kusho ukukhetha ukuthi ubani ozokwenza umsebenzi onjani, nini, kuphi ngempela, nokuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezizodingeka ezifana nezinsiza, amathuluzi, izikhungo, nezimali ukuze ukwazi ukuqhuba lowo msebenzi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile kumkhiqizi ukuba azi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza abanazo - kokubili ezimali nakubantu abasebenza kubo. Kumele bazi amakhono, imfundo, ukuqeqeshwa, namakhono (amandla okwenza / ukusebenza, ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza imishini, amandla enhliziyo) abasebenzi babo. Abasebenzi kumele basebenze lapho benolwazi lokwenza lowo msebenzi, futhi kungabasiza ukwenza umsebenzi abawuthokozelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlela ukuthutha, izinsiza, nemali yokuqala yokutshala ezindaweni ezifanele nangasikhathi esifanele. Ukuze ukwazi ukuhlanganisa izicwangciso, kudingeka ubheke yonke imisebenzi ekhona ngaphakathi kwalezo zicwangciso futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kuqhutshekwe nalezo zicwangciso ngesikhathi esifanele. Lapho sikhuluma ngokuhlanganisa izicwangciso, singasebenzisa izindlela zokwakha izicwangciso nokuhlanganisa lezo zicwangciso njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni 1. Lokhu kulandela isibonelo esisetshenziswe ngoJuni 2011. Bheka insimu 5. 3 - 10 hectares. Abasebenzi ababili (umsebenzi wesigaba). Amathrekhtha amabili namathreila amabili. Bheka ukudla kwezilwane nezokwenziwa. Susa esiswini, phawula, phatha imithi, ufinyelele izinga lokuphila lama-calves angama-100. Moloto, Abram, Kagiso, noHendrik. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Izinsiza zokuphatha izilwane, izinsiza zokushisa (zokuphawula), amathuluzi okuphakela, izincwadi zokurekhoda. Wakha indlu 3 (susa izinto zokulala ezindala). Imisebenzi evamile yansuku zonke. Izindlu 1 no 2. Johanna, Minah, noJohannes. Sarah, Monica, noDawid. Ukuhlanganisa izinto, amabhakede, namathreila. Amathuluzi akhe, njll. Sikholelwa ukuthi bonke abantu abasebenza kulolu hlobo oluphezulu banolwazi futhi bakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi. Sikholelwa futhi ukuthi zonke ezinye izinsiza zikhona futhi zilungile ukuze zisebenze. Uma lokhu kungelona iqiniso, zonke izicwangciso zakho nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso kuzodingeka kubekwe eceleni ngoba labo basebenzi kudingeka baqeqeshwe kuqala, nezinsiza kudingeka zibe khona futhi zilungiswe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umsebenzi ofana nokutshala noma ukufaka imithi ezilwaneni. Lokhu kuyisibonelo nje sezindlela ezingasetshenziswa ukuhlanganisa izicwangciso; konke kungashintsha ukuze kuhlangane nohlobo lokulima lwemfuyo kanye nezidingo zomlimi othile. Sivame ukubona ukuthi kubalulekile ukubhala phansi lapho kwakhiwa izicwangciso nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso emsebenzini onjengalolu. Njengokwakha izicwangciso, ukuhlanganiswa kwalezo zicwangciso kungabhalwa encwadini, ebhodi, kukhompyutha, noma kwezinye izindawo. Njengokwakha izicwangciso, ngaphakathi kokuhlanganiswa kwalezo zicwangciso, ummeli kufanele azibophezele ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwebhizinisi efana nokuhamba phambili, ukubamba izintambo, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi, ukuthola ugqozi lokusebenzisa abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa. Usayizi webhizinisi uzokutshela ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani konke lokhu. Kumele kube ummeli oqala ngokuqhuba ukuhlanganiswa, ozokwazisa abasebenzi ngalokho okuzohlanganiswa futhi athathe izinyathelo zokuhlanganisa umsebenzi othile (yikuphi ithrekhtha noma imishini ezosetshenziswa nokuthi yibaphi abasebenzi abazosebenza). Kumele futhi baphathe umsebenzi ngokuqinile ekuhlanganiseni kwezinyathelo zebhizinisi. Kumele bakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi othile kumsebenzi othile uma kudingeka; abakwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngokwabo. Khumbula, uma ingxenye yemisebenzi yakho yokuphatha ingaqhutsheki kahle okwamanje, ibhizinisi lakho lizokwenza inzuzo, kodwa ngemva kwesikhathi esithile - mhlawumbe ngemva kweminyaka emihlanu noma eyishumi noma ngemva kwalokhu - ibhizinisi lakho lizoma, lizofa ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Ikusasa lethu libhekene nalolu shintsho (kufanele sibheke phambili kulokho esizokudla kusasa) - uma ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi lakho kungaqhubeki nokukhula njalo ngonyaka - ekugcineni ibhizinisi lizoma ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Asikwazi ukuqhubeka sisebenza ngendlela efanayo njalo. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka uthuthukisa umsebenzi ngokukhulisa imali engenayo nokunciphisa nokuphatha izindleko. Ukuhlanganiswa kahle kwezicwangciso kuzokusiza uphumelele ngendlela esichaze ngenhla.
Umbiko: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphendula Ngemizuzu Eyishumi Nanhlanu Isingeniso Ekuthuthukiseni nasekuhloleni izinga lokuphendula kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukufinyelela isikhathi sokuphendula esibekiwe. Kulokhu, sihlole ukuthi izinsizakalo zethu zikwazi yini ukuphendula ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lo mbiko uzogxila ekuboneni indlela esifezile ngayo isikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15, izinselelo esihlangabezane nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwethu. Uhlolojikelele Ukuze sihlaziye ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula, sathatha izinsuku ezingu-30 ukuze sihloloze ukusebenza kwethu. Lokhu kuhilela izinsizakalo ezahlukahlukene, ezifana nezokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezinsizakalo zokuphuma. Kubalulekile ukusetha izinkomba ezicacile zokusebenza ukuze sikwazi ukukala impumelelo yethu. Izinhloso zethu zazihlanganisa ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula, ukwengeza ukusebenza kahle, nokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Izindlela Zokuhlola Ukuze sithole imiphumela ecacile, sakha uhlelo lokuhlola olwakhiwe ngezinyathelo ezilandelayo: 1. Ukuqoqwa Kwemininingwane: Sasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe ukuze siqoqe idatha ngalesi sikhathi sokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukulandela izikhathi ezithathwa yizinsizakalo zethu ukuze zifeze izicelo eziphuthumayo. 2. Ukuhlaziywa Kwemininingwane: Ngemva kokuqoqwa kwemininingwane, sahlaziya imiphumela ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo eziphumelela kakhulu nokuthi yiziphi ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. 3. Ukwenza Izinguquko: Ngemuva kokuhlaziya, sathatha izinyathelo ezithile zokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, kanye nezinqubo ezintsha. Imiphumela Ngemuva kokuphothula lesi sikhathi sokuhlola, sithole imiphumela emihle. Ukuphendula kwethu kwehlile kusuka ezinsukwini ezingu-20 kuya kwezingu-15, okukhombisa ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu ekusebenzeni kwethu. Izinsizakalo ezinjengokwelashwa zaphakanyiswa, futhi isikhathi sokuphendula saphumelela kakhulu. Nakuba kunezinsizakalo ezithile ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi sizokwazi ukufezekisa izinjongo zethu. Izinselelo Eziqhamukayo Noma sithole impumelelo, sithole nezinselelo ezithile. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu kwakungukusebenza kweqembu. Abasebenzi abaningana babengakakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni elidingekayo lokuphendula, okwakubangelwa yizizathu ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganisa ukungabi neziqu ezanele kanye nezinsiza ezincane. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi sithuthukisa ukuqeqeshwa kwethu futhi sithole izinsiza ezanele ukuze sikwazi ukufeza izinjongo zethu. Izinyathelo Ezithathiwe Ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwethu, sathatha izinyathelo ezilandelayo: 1. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi: Sihlele izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ukuze sithuthukise amakhono abasebenzi bethu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda izinqubo eziphuthumayo, ukuxhumana kahle, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezisheshayo. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza: Siphinde sathola izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphuthumayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangempumelelo. 3. Ukusebenza Ngemva Kokuhlola: Sazisa izinsizakalo ezithile ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa futhi sakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwazo. Isiphetho Ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15 kube yimpumelelo enkulu, nakuba sithole nezinselelo. Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi sithuthukise kakhulu ukusebenza kwethu, futhi sithole izindlela zokwenza ngcono. Njengoba siqhubeka, sizogxila ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zethu, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokwenza izinqubo zethu zibe ngcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezikhiqizayo, okuzothuthukisa ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende nokuqinisekisa ukuthi sifeza izinjongo zethu. Sizokuqhubeka nokuhlola ukusebenza kwethu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola izinga eliphezulu lokuphendula ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi.
Izinyathelo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini okumele ngiyilindele uma ngifika esibhedlela ukuze ngizale? Impendulo: Uma usufika esibhedlela, uzodinga ukuhamba uye endaweni yokwamukela. Lapha, uzobhaliswa, futhi kuzocelwa ulwazi oluthile, njengeminyaka yakho, umlando wezempilo, kanye nezimpawu ozibona. Kubalulekile ukuba nekhadi lakho lokwelashwa noma olunye ubufakazi bokuthi ungumgibeli. Umbuzo 2: Ngabe ngizothola usizo lwezokwelapha ngaphambi kokubeletha? Impendulo: Yebo, ngaphambi kokubeletha, uzothola usizo lwezokwelapha. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bazokuhlola ukuze baqonde isimo sakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izimpawu zakho, izinga lokukhulelwa, kanye nezidingo zakho ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela indlela yokubeletha efanele. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinqubo ezitholakalayo zokubeletha? Impendulo: Kunezindlela ezimbili ezinkulu zokubeletha: ukuhlinzwa (cesarean section) noma ukuhamba (vaginal delivery). Ukuhlinzwa kwenziwa uma kukhona izinkinga ezithile, njengokuthi umntwana akakwazi ukuphuma ngendlela ejwayelekile. Ukuhamba, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kuyindlela ejwayelekile yokubeletha, lapho umama ezama ukuphuma umntwana ngokwemvelo. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe ngizokwazi ukuhamba nomngani noma umndeni wami? Impendulo: Yebo, izibhedlela eziningi zivumela umngani noma ilunga lomndeni ukuba likusize ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Lokhu kungasiza ekwenzeni uzizwe ukhululekile futhi unethemba. Qiniseka ukuthi uxhumana nesibhedlela sakho ukuze uqinisekise izinqubomgomo zabo. Umbuzo 5: Yini engiyidingayo ukuze ngilungiselele ukuhlinzwa uma kudingeka? Impendulo: Uma kudingeka ukuhlinzwa, udokotela uzokunikeza imiyalelo ethile. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukungadli ukudla okuthile ezinsukwini ezithile ngaphambi kokuhlinzwa, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokwelashwa. Kubalulekile ukulandela le miyalelo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe kuzodingeka ngithathe imishanguzo ethile? Impendulo: Kungenzeka ukuthi udokotela uzokunikeza imishanguzo ethile ngaphambi kokubeletha, njengemishanguzo yokunciphisa phezulu kokukhathazeka noma yokuphatha ubuhlungu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazisa udokotela ngezinkinga zakho zempilo noma imishanguzo oyithathayo. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe ngizothola usizo lwezempilo ngemuva kokubeletha? Impendulo: Yebo, ngemuva kokubeletha, uzothola usizo lwezempilo oluqinile. Abahlengikazi bazokuhlola wena nomntwana ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi nikhona kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izimpawu zokubuyisela emuva, izinga lokukhula komntwana, kanye nezidingo zakho zokunakekelwa. Umbuzo 8: Yini engiyidingayo ukuze ngilungiselele umntwana? Impendulo: Ukuze ulungiselele umntwana, kubalulekile ukuba nezingubo ezilungile, izinsiza zokunakekela, kanye nezinto ezidingekayo ezifana nezinkomishi, izikhwama zokulala, nezinsiza zokuhlanza. Qiniseka ukuthi unazo zonke izinto ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokuba umntwana ufike. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe ngizokwazi ukufunda ngempilo yengane yami? Impendulo: Yebo, izibhedlela eziningi zinikeza izifundo zokunakekela ingane, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokuphatha umntwana, ukudla, nokunakekela impilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda nokuzilungiselela ukuphila nomntwana. Umbuzo 10: Yini engiyidingayo ukuze ngiqhubeke nokunakekela impilo yami ngemuva kokubeletha? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokubeletha, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokunakekela impilo yakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudla okunempilo, ukuzivocavoca, nokuthola ukwesekwa emndenini nasemphakathini. Qiniseka ukuthi uhamba njalo emithini yokuhlola ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyaphila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi kubalulekile ukuba uqonde lezi zinyathelo ukuze uzizwe ukhululekile futhi unethemba ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukuxhumana kahle nodokotela nabahlengikazi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kulolu hambo olukhulu.
uBarack Obama: Impilo Nempumelelo Ukukhuluma ngempilo kaBarack Obama, lo muntu onomlando omuhle, kubalulekile. Uzalwe ngonyaka ka-1961 eHonolulu, eHawaii, uBarack ungumfana ophuma emndenini ohlukene. Ubaba wakhe, uBarack Obama Sr., wayengumAfrika ongene e-United States, kanti unina, uStanley Ann Dunham, wayengumNgisi. Lokhu kuhlangana kwezizinda kudala isithombe esihle sezwe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eHawaii, uObama waya e-California, lapho aqala khona ukufunda e-Occidental College, bese eqhubeka eHarvard Law School. Ufinyelele iziqu zeziqu zezakhamizi futhi waba ngumholi kwezokuphila. UBarack waba ngumhleli wombhalo we-Harvard Law Review, okukhombisa ukuthi wayengumuntu ophusile onobuchwepheshe. UBarack Obama ungomunye wabantu abakhombisa amandla okuphumelela, futhi akuyena nje kuphela umuntu ophumelele, kodwa ungumholi. Ngemuva kokufunda, wabuyela eChicago, lapho asebenza khona njengomfundisi wezomthetho. Ngesikhathi esebenza eChicago, waqala ukuthakazelisa ngopolitiki, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza umehluko emphakathini. Lokhu kwakuwukuhamba phambili empilweni yakhe. Ngonyaka ka-2004, uObama waba yisihlabani emhlabeni jikelele ngesikhathi esikhuluma emcimbini wokuvota e-Democratic National Convention. Umhlaba uqaphele uBarack, futhi umoya wokushintsha waqala. Uthando lwakhe lokuhola, kanye namazwi akhe anomthelela, kwaphendula izigidi zabantu. Lokhu kwakuyisikhathi esibalulekile empilweni yakhe, futhi kwaba yisinyathelo esijulile sokuba umholi wezombusazwe. Ngesikhathi esebenza eSenate, uObama waqala ukukhuluma ngezinkinga ezibalulekile, ezifana nokunakekela impilo, ubulungiswa bezomthetho, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihambisanayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wathola ithuba lokukhuphukela phezulu. Ngo-2008, waba umongameli wesithathu omnyama e-United States, okwakuwumcimbi omkhulu emphakathini. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula kubantu abaningi, njengoba uBarack wayephakamisa ithemba lokuthi izinto zingashintsha. Njengomongameli, uObama wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Wabangela ushintsho olukhulu kwezokwelapha ngohlelo lwe-Affordable Care Act, olwakha ithuba lokunakekelwa kwempilo kubantu abaningi. Waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngamalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi amalungelo abantu abamnyama, abesifazane, nabanye abavela ezizindeni ezihlukahlukene. Nokho, umsebenzi wakhe wawungekho maphutsa. Uhlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima, njengezimo zokushisa komhlaba, imikhuba yokungcolisa umoya, nezinkinga zezezimali. UBarack wayengumholi ophokophele phambili, futhi wayefuna ukufaka umqondo wokubheka phambili. Lokhu kwandulela ukuba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, futhi kwasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezithile ezimqoka. Ngemuva kokuphothula ubuholi bakhe, uObama akazange akhululeke kuphela. Waqhubeka nokusebenza ezinhlelweni ezahlukene, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuluma ngezindaba zomhlaba. Waqamba i-Obama Foundation, ebheke ekwakheni abaholi abasezingeni eliphezulu emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uBarack akahambanga phambili kuphela ngenxa yakhe, kodwa ubambisene nabanye abantu abathi bekhuluma ngempumelelo. Ngokubanzi, uBarack Obama ungumuntu ophilayo, onomoya ophakeme, futhi ohlonishwayo. Ube nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela e-United States, kodwa nasezwenikazi lonke. Lokhu kufakazela ukuthi, uma ungumuntu onomgomo, ungakwazi ukushintsha umhlaba. Uhlanga lwenhloso olufana noBarack lubonisa ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke okungcono uma ungathathi isinyathelo sokuhola. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo kaBarack Obama, sikhuluma ngempumelelo yokuphumelela, ubuholi, nokuhola abantu. UBarack usifundisa ukuthi uma sizimisele, sizokwazi ukufinyelela izimpumelelo ezinkulu. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Ngakho, ngabe uyakholwa ukuthi uBarack Obama uyakhombisa ukuthi izifiso zethu zingafezeka? Lokhu kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izinguquko zenzeka uma sithatha izinyathelo. UBarack ungumholi ohloniphekile, futhi sizokwazi ukufunda okuningi kuye.
Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni Kwakuyisikhathi esinzima endaweni yaseSiyaphambili, lapho abantu bahlushwa khona yizinkinga ezinzima. Izinkomo zokuqala zanjwe ziba zinhle, kodwa abantu bezwa ukuthi izinto ziya zibi empilweni yabo. I-hulumeni wabo, obekulungela ukuletha ushintsho, wabe usuhamba emnyango wezinto ezimangalisayo. UThandi, intokazi encane ke, wayehlala nomama wakhe, uMabuyi, endaweni ethokozisayo. UMabuyi wayethanda ukusikhumbuza uThandi ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kuzodinga ukugqugquzela, kodwa uthando lwenkululeko belungakazukanga. UThandi waqala ukufunda izindaba zabantu abahluphekayo, ababejola kuMabuyi bezama ukuthola indlela yokuphila. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wezwa indaba ethusayo. Umnuz’Bheki, ongumholi wendawo, wayesendleleni yokucekelwa phansi ukubusa kwezakhamizi. Ngemuva kokukhuluma nomama wakhe, uThandi wathola ukuthi umnuz’Bheki wayekhipha imali emikhakheni yokwakha izikole nezibhedlela. Imali leyo yayimfushane, isikhangiso sikhulu sezakhamizi, kodwa umnuz’Bheki wayezama ukuzithokozisa ngokwakhe. UThandi wayezwa isikhulumi sikaMabuyi emkhulumeni wokuthi “Uma kudlula isikhathi, izinkanyezi zikhanya njengoba uhulumeni enza izinto ezimbi.” UThandi wachaqiswa, ngoba wayecabanga ukuthi imisebenzi yokwenza izinsiza ezidingekayo izoba nobungane banoma iyiphi inkampani. kodwa umnuz’Bheki wathola ukuthi kwakukhona indlela yokugadla. Lokhu kuphinde kahle kephululwa umoya. UThandi wathola ukuthola amakhasi amabili ezinyangeni ezilandelayo, eqhubeka enza izifundo ngezakhamizi, izinkampani nezinsiza ezichithwa nguMnuz’Bheki. Wayefuna ukuqonda indlela ezinkampani ezisebenza ngayo, abazithokozisayo, nokuthi lezi zinsiza zungele ziphumelele kubantu abahlaba, izimfuno ezithile, kumkhakha omncane omdala. Ngemuva kokuhlola, uThandi uthola izinto ezikhulu. Abantu ababezasizwa bejola, bese ziphumelela uma kuziwa emayaleni. Kwakukhona izincwadi zomthetho ezazicebile, zithi “masiphike lapho kudinga ukuba sithathe isinyathelo.” UThandi wanquma ukuthatha isinyathelo. Wayezothi ngempilo yakhe, ukuze abelane ngalezi zindaba ezinzima. Owayengumngani kaThandi, uSipho, wayebonakala emnandi. UThandi wathembisa uSipho ngokusetshenziswa kwalezi zindaba, ukuze abambisane ekuthatheni izinqumo zamasiko. USipho wayenamahloni, kepha uThandi wamncoma. “Uma siholwa, kufanele siqiniseke ukuthi sithola ithuba ukuyalela, lokho kuzojabulisa abantu.” UThandi wakhumbula isisho sakhe sokuthi “ukubhalwa kwemiyalezo yangempela kudinga ukuzithokozisa.” UThandi noSipho bahamba edolobheni ukuyovakashela izinhlelo zomphakathi. Bafika emhlanganweni, lapho abanye babehamba bangazi noma baskhuluma phakathi. UThandi wenza izicucu ezinhle, futhi wakhuluma ngokukhanya. Belle ngekwazi ukuhlunga abanye, bahlala behlangana. Ngemva kokubamba iqhaza, abakhuluma bakhuluma njengobuhlungu, baphila imizamo. UThandi waguqula izindatshana ukuze ababe kumele bancike. Imali yenkohlakalo yenza kube nzima, futhi abantu babezizwa bekhululekile. Kusukela kulobo su, uThandi wahamba edolobha, ehamba phakathi komphakathi, eyaziqhenya okuphamukayo kwentuthuko. Akubanga nzima kuThandi ukuba qaphela, izinhlelo zomphakathi ezikhuluma ngezinkinga zebhizinisi. UThandi wagcizelela ukukwaziwa kahle kwezinhlelo ezikhalela ukuphikiswa. Izigaba zatholakala, ziqhuba izinsiza eziphoqelelayo. Ekuhlangabezaneni nemiphakathi, uThandi wezwa nothando lwezinhlelo ezipheleshi. Umphakathi waba esijabulisayo, lowo esahamba phambili, wawukhumbula umyalezo wakhe. “Iziele, we must choose wisely” – akusebenzi uma siphalazela. Bazama ukuziphilisa endaweni ebukeka ijwayelekile, kodwa umnyango ukhuluma ngezinsiza ezakhe, unalo umoya oya phambili. Ekujuleni kwemini, uThandi wakwazi ukuthola imiphakathi, ebuka phansi, ebuka izinkanyezi. Izinhloso zabantu zazibalulekile, kodwa wayezwa ukusaba kwemali. Ukubambisana nezinkanyezi kubo kuzokwenza impilo ibe ngcono. Lokhu kw bonwa nakuqala. UThandi wabona izinyathelo zikaMabuyi zikhanye ensizayo. UThandi noSipho baba izigebengu, babekhombisa indlela yokuphila. UThandi wahamba phambili, izinjongo zabantu zazikhanya, kepha eyombono yezehlakalo yayingahlonishwa. UThandi wanikela njengoba abanye bephakamisa imigudu. Ukukhanya kwakukhanye, waphinde waqonda okufanele. Ubulili, kanye ithemba, byazi ngawe. Ezimnqubweni uThandi, wahamba ubuso nemigaqo eyaziwayo, wahlola indlela yokuhamba. Ukubuyiselwa kwemigudu kumphakathi kuphinde kwaze kwanda. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wazi kahle, wayzithokozisa ngokwakhe, wathi: “Hamba phambili, hamba, hamba lapho abantu behamba.” Phakathi kokuphazamiseka, uThandi wakhumbula sinje nokuthanda ezinhlewazweni zomoya. Ukwazi ukuthi isihloko sathathwa ubuthongo, isikhathi eside. UThandi waqonda ukuthi i-hulumeni wafika ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezezeni. UThandi wawazi kahle, ukukhanya kuhle, hayi lokho uthandayo, izinhlelo ezilungisiwe zenzeka, ukukubheka kwandise. Uhlanga lwezokwakha lwaqala ukusisiza. I-hulumeni wabo waphakamisa isinyathelo, kepha uThandi, uSipho, kanye nomphakathi bobabili baqala ukuphendula. Kwaphela izinyathelo ezazinemibono emisha, abantu bephakamisa izinsiza nempilo. Ukukhumbula, uThandi ugcizelela ukuthi ukhona amandla empilweni. Ngoba, “Umlando awumhloniphi nje, kufanele ucindezele emizimbeni.” UThandi waqhubeka, waqhuba emathubeni, waqonda ukuthi inkohlakalo kudinga ukufuna, mencane ezizikweni. Kwakunjalo, ukungathintanwa kwankholo, izinyathelo zalabo abathembekile zajiye. Isikhathi soshintsho siba ngezinsuku ezinhle, umoya wempumelelo ungatholakala, uThandi wagcizelela ukuthi lokhu akuphelile. Uma uthanda, uzoyithola inhloso. “Umhlaba ubonisa, umhlaba upheqa; kufanele siqinise.” Impilo, uThandi, izimpokolphya zabo, kanti uSipho uzalise iHero wabo, udaba oluhle. Umphakathi usanda kuthola ukuqonda ukubamba iqhaza, lapho iyona intsha izithokozisa. UThandi wathola ukusungulwa kwezimiselo, isiphephelo esiyizinyanga, futhi umoya ungenisa, bheka umkhuleko ohlakaniphile. Umhlaba ukhombisa ubuchopho, futhi uThandi, akakaze ahlupheke phakathi kweziqondiso zakhe. Kanjalo, impi ibuyela emuva, inkohlakalo ihamba ngezigaba. UThandi wakujabulela ukusuka phambili nosuku lokukhanya, abantu bathanda ukuzikhandla, futhi isikhathi sokungabi nkulunkulu sigcina silungile. UThandi uNkulunkulu waphakade.
Sithatha isinyathelo endleleni eya esikhathini esizayo. Yebo, uhulumeni kanye nasemkhakheni wezokuzimela. 1. Sigxila empilweni yethu futhi siphila ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, umgomo wethu ukuveza izimanga ukuze sibe isibonelo kubalingani bethu. 2. Siphatha kahle futhi sivikela imvelo nendawo esikuyo, okungavela ekubhekeni phambili ngokuqonda. 3. Sihlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli nabapheki ngokuphelele. Siphikisa ukuphila kahle ngoba sigcizelela ukuthi amathuluzi okusebenza awaphelele. Ukufisa ngaphakathi kwethu ukufisa. 4. Sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza zempilo ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuchitha noma ukungabaza ukuze siphumelele ngaphezu kokulinganiswa, njengamaphiko asenza sibhakabhake njengezinyoni. Ukufisa kwethu ukuthuthukisa. 5. Siqinisekisa ukuthi siyazi ngezinhlelo zempilo eziseduze nezempilo, ngolwazi, futhi ngokufundisa umphakathi esikuyo, futhi ukuthi basiphathe kahle ngendlela ephelele, lokhu kuhambisana. 6. Sinikeza abasebenzi bezempilo ulwazi olufanele nokwesekwa komzimba, kwemizwa, nasengqondweni. Sizinikele ukusiza ocwaningweni, ekwelashweni, nasekuphathweni komuntu ngamunye ngendlela eqotho, ekuhloleni, ekwelashweni, ekubuyiseni, nasezingeni eliphezulu lobuchwepheshe obunolwazi. 7. Sazisa abapheki bezempilo ngentshisekelo yethu yokwenza okudingekayo kumuntu ngamunye, sigxile esimweni sabo kanye nokufa komuntu ngamunye, ubulili babo, iminyaka, nokukholwa kwabo. Ukukholwa okujwayelekile ukuthi. 8. Silandela imithetho yokwelashwa nesikhathi esithi "wenza kwabanye njengoba ungathanda ukuba benze kuwe" okuhlobene nokubuyiselwa. Sizoletha induduzo kulabo. 9. Sibuza ukuthi izindlela zokwelashwa noma zokubuyiselwa zibhujiswe noma zaphukile. Zimi kanjani? Sihlela indlela yokukhokha. Usizo lwezinga eliphezulu. Ukwelapha wonke umuntu ngendlela. Ukwenza ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli ngezindlela zokulandela. Ukuba nomusa kwabanye. Izikhalazo/iziphakamiso: ucingo: 032/4376007 Fax: 032.
Uhambo Nokuzijabulisa: Iphrofayela KaThandiwe Mthethwa UThandiwe Mthethwa ungumuntu ophila impilo egcwele uhambo nokuzijabulisa. Uthandiwe, osanda kufika ezinsukwini zakhe zokugcina ezikoleni, ubonisa uthando olukhulu lokuhamba nokuqonda izindawo ezahlukene. Uthando lwakhe lokuhamba luthokozisa, lwenza abanye abantu baphokophele ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze bakwazi ukujabulisa izimpilo zabo. UThandiwe wazalelwa eThekwini, edolobheni elinomlando ocebile nolwazi olunothile. Ukhulele ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, okwenza waba nomqondo ovulekile nokuqonda okujulile ngezamasiko ahlukene. Uthandiwe ufunde eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBhayoloji. Nokho, akafuni ukuhamba phambili kuphela emkhakheni wezokwelapha; uThandiwe uhlala efisa ukuthola izindlela zokuhamba ezahlukene, ukuze akhulise ulwazi lwakhe. Ngokuhamba, uThandiwe uthola ithuba lokuhlangana nabantu abasha, abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Uthanda ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho engathola khona ubuhle bemvelo. UThandiwe uthi: "Ukuhamba akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokufunda, yokuhlangana, nokuhlonipha izindawo esizivakashelayo." Lokhu kuphakamisa umqondo wokuhamba, okukhombisa ukuthi uhambo lungaba yindlela yokuphila. Uhambo lwakhe olukhulu lwenzeka ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe. UThandiwe wanquma ukuhamba eYurophu, lapho ahlangana khona nezindawo ezinhle ezifana neParis, iRome, neAmsterdam. Ngalesi sikhathi, wathola ithuba lokuhlola izakhiwo zomlando, izimakethe ezimnandi, kanye nezitolo ezinhle. UThandiwe uthi: "Ngiyazithokozisa izimakethe, ngoba zikhombisa isiko lendawo, futhi ngithanda ukuhamba ngihamba phakathi kwabantu." Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThandiwe uphinde abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzijabulisa ezisemakhaya. Uthanda ukuhamba emaphandleni, lapho akwazi khona ukuxhumana nemiphakathi yasekhaya. UThandiwe uthi: "Ngithanda ukuhlanganyela nabantu bendawo, ngoba ngithola ithuba lokufunda ngempilo yabo, izinkolelo zabo, nezindlela zabo zokuphila." Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uThandiwe akakhathali kuphela ngokuhamba, kodwa futhi ubonisa umoya wokuhlonipha abantu abahlala ezindaweni ahambela kuzo. UThandiwe ungumuntu onothando lwezokuzijabulisa. Uthanda ukuya emicimbini yamasiko, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi ezinkulu. Uthanda ukuhamba ngezinyawo emigwaqweni, edlula ezindaweni ezinhle, futhi ezithokozisayo. UThandiwe uthi: "Ngiyathanda ukuhamba, ngoba kwenza ngizizwe ngikhululekile, futhi ngithola ithuba lokuphuma emakhaya ami." Lokhu kuphakamisa umqondo wokuthi uhambo lungaba yindlela yokuphila, hhayi nje umsebenzi. UThandiwe ubona uhambo njengendlela yokuxhumana nemvelo. Uthanda ukuhamba ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, efuna ukujabulisa imizwa yakhe. UThandiwe uthi: "Ngiyazithokozisa izindawo ezinhle, futhi ngithokozisa imvelo. Ukuthola ithuba lokuhamba ezindaweni ezahlukene kuholela ekubeni ngibe nomqondo ovulekile." Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uThandiwe akakhathali kuphela ngempilo yakhe, kodwa futhi ubonisa umqondo wokuhlonipha imvelo. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, ubona ukuthi uhambo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Uthanda ukuhlola izindawo ezahlukene, abanye abantu, nezindlela zokuphila. UThandiwe uthi: "Ngiyavuma ukuthi uhambo lungaba yindlela yokufunda, yokuhlangana, nokuhlonipha izindawo esizivakashelayo." Lokhu kuphakamisa umqondo wokuthi uhambo lungaba yindlela yokuphila, hhayi nje umsebenzi. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe Mthethwa ungumuntu ophila impilo egcwele uhambo nokuzijabulisa. Uthando lwakhe lokuhamba luholela ekubeni abe nomqondo ovulekile, futhi ubonisa ukuthi uhambo lungaba yindlela yokuphila. UThandiwe uqhubeka nokuhamba, efuna ukujabulisa imizwa yakhe, futhi ubonisa ukuthi uhambo lungaba yindlela yokuphila, hhayi nje umsebenzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhambo nokuzijabulisa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi uThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi uhambo lungaba yindlela yokuphila.
Iphasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni ikhishwa kubasebenzi ezikhungweni zikahulumeni uma befisa ukuhamba phesheya ukuze benze imisebenzi kahulumeni. Iphasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni iyasebenza iminyaka emihlanu. Qiniseka ukuthi unokuhlonza noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa nawe ukuze wenze isicelo. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-73 bese ulithumela mathupha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle eliseduze. Letha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma emnyangweni wezwe laseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qiniseka ukuthi kuthathwa izithupha zakho ukuze zirekhodwe kwi-registri yokuhlala kwabantu. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezincane zephasiwedi. Faka isicelo sephasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni kanye nokuhlonza ngesikhathi esisodwa uma ungakwazi ukulinda. Faka incwadi evela kumqashi wakho echaza izizathu zokuthi kungani udinga iphasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Le nsizakalo ingathatha kusukela kwesonto elilodwa kuya kwezinsuku eziyisithupha. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa.
Ngiyajabula ukukwazisa umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ngomyalo ophakanyisiwe mayelana nezemidlalo nokuzijabulisa. Lo myalo ophakanyisiwe umele ukukholwa kwezokudlala nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi imidlalo nokuzijabulisa kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyindlela enhle yokubandakanya intsha emicimbini ezokwakha imiphakathi. Eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, umgomo wokuqala wezokudlala nokuzijabulisa washicilelwa okokuqala emyalo ophakanyisiwe lapho izinselelo, izinqubomgomo, nezinto ezibalulekile zaphawulwa ngokucacile. Kwenziwe okuningi ukuhlangabezana nalezi zinselelo nezinto ezibalulekile, kodwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwesikhathi esanele nezinsiza, indlela phambili isasele nde. Ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zikamasipala kazwelonke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinto ezibalulekile kwezokudlala nokuzijabulisa zibuyekezwe futhi zishintshwe. Ukuze kufezwe umgomo kahulumeni wokuthuthukisa impilo engcono kubo bonke, nokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi isizwe sidlala, ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa laseNingizimu Afrika kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizokuqinisekisa ukuthi imidlalo ifinyelela zonke izingxenye zeNingizimu Afrika. Iminikelo evela kubaxhasi abafana nePoverty Relief, Ukwakhiwa Kwezakhiwo, iminikelo eqoqiwe eMhlanganweni Wezemisebenzi, nemali evela kuMphakathi Wezokudlala ukuze kuthuthukiswe imidlalo nokuzijabulisa ezindaweni ezazishiywe ngemuva kuhulumeni ophakeme kuzoba yindlela efanele yokwenza imidlalo ifinyeleleke kubantu abaningi baleli. Ibhodi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) limi ngalezi zinto ezilandelayo, ezisekelwe kumgomo othi "siyenza isizwe sidlale." a) ukwandisa ukubamba iqhaza emicimbini yezemidlalo nokuzijabulisa b) ukukhuthaza umlando wezokudlala naphezu kwezinto eziphikisanayo c) ukwandisa amathuba okuphumelela emicimbini emikhulu d) ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezibalulekile emizamweni yokubhekana nezinto ezibalulekile zesizwe. Zonke izinto ezibalulekile zithatha indlela yokuguqula futhi le ncwadi ibhekana kahle nalolu work, njengoba singashintshi emsebenzini wethu ohlelweni lukamasipala. Ukwenza isizwe sidlale kuyisithako/umqondo walolu myalo ophakanyisiwe. Ukufeza le njongo kudinga imizamo nokuzinikela kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (NGOs), umkhakha ozimele, kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo ezibandakanyekayo ekwakheni isisekelo sesiko lokudlala nokuzijabulisa. Umthwalo wokwakha izikhungo nezindawo zokudlala nokuzijabulisa uthwalwe ezicathulweni zeBhodi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) kanye neKomidi Lezemidlalo laseNingizimu Afrika (SASC). Ukungalingani phakathi kwemiphakathi ethola izinsiza ezinhle, evame ukuba emadolobheni, kanye nemiphakathi eshiywe, ikakhulukazi leyo emakhaya, kuyacaca. Intsha yaleli zwe kanye nenqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezokudlala nokuzijabulisa ibaluleke kakhulu. Kukhona isidingo sokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ithathe indawo yayo efanele emiphakathini yezemidlalo yomhlaba. Amafedereshini (IFs). Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezepolitiki, yokuxhumana, nezomnotho, njengendima nomthelela wokubambisana kwamazwe, kanye nokuthengiswa kwemidlalo nokukhula komkhakha wezokuxhumana, akufanele kudlulelwe. Kwenziwe imizamo eminingi yokuchaza kahle imidlalo nokuzijabulisa. Nokho, ukuvumelana ngalokhu akukakafiki. Ngokwezinhloso zalo myalo ophakanyisiwe, incazelo elandelayo iyanele. IMIDLALO ingachazwa njengazo zonke izenzo ezidinga ukuzikhandla ngokomzimba, futhi labo abathatha ingxenye kufanele balandele indlela ethile noma engathile yokwenziwa kwayo, ngenhloso yokuzuza umnqobi noma umphumela ophumelelayo, noma ngenye indlela; noma ngenhloso yokuphumula, ukujabula, impilo yomzimba, ukukhula komoya, kanye nokuthuthukiswa. Nokho, mhlawumbe okubaluleke kakhulu, indima yemidlalo iwukuzama ukwakha ubunye besizwe. Umthelela wemidlalo nokuzijabulisa awuphephile kulabo abathatha ingxenye noma abahlanganyela. Uhlanga lwezempilo; imfundo; umnotho; ukuziphatha okungahambisani nokuphila kahle; ukwakha isizwe kanye nezokuxhumana zamazwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi iBhodi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika ihlinzeke ngezidingo zabantu bonke, isebenzisa inani lemali elilinganayo nalelo elalisebenzisa ngaphambili ukuhlinzeka ngama-20% abantu ngesikhathi kuhulumeni ophakeme. Nakuba indlela esibheka ngayo imidlalo nokuzijabulisa kufanele isekelwe ezimisweni nasekukholelweni kwaseNingizimu Afrika, isimo sezwe, imiphakathi yalo, umlando walo, ifa lalo, nenqubomgomo yezemidlalo nokuzijabulisa kumele kuhambisane nezehlakalo zomhlaba. Kutholakale ukuthi kukhona ukungazi kahle ngendima edlalwa yimidlalo nokuzijabulisa kuleli. Abaholi beqembu leHulumeni leCommonwealth ababeHarare bathole okulandelayo mayelana nomthelela wemidlalo emphakathini: Isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi indima ebalulekile edlalwa yimidlalo ekwakheni isizwe ivumelekile ngokuphelele. Imidlalo ingagcina. Okokuqala, zingagcina impilo, ukuphila isikhathi eside, kanye nokukhiqiza kwalezi zinsizwa noma zakha umsebenzi omuhle kubantu. Okwesibili, zingagcina ikusasa. Izinzuzo ezitholakala ekuphumeleleni zihlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemizwa, yokucabanga, kanye nokukhula komoya kubantu bonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abadlali abaphumelelayo baba izibonelo ezinhle zentsha yaleso sizwe, njengabantu abavelele, noma ngabe abavunyelwe kuhulumeni, futhi njengabantu abazinikela ekubambisaneni okulinganayo nokwamukelekayo. Izifo eziningi ezifana ne-hypertension zixhomeke ekwelashweni noma ekuzivocavoceni okufanele kulandelwe. Emazweni asathuthuka, kukhona ukholelwa ukuthi wonke i-rand echithwa emidlalweni nasekuzijabuliseni yehlisa izindleko zempilo ngama-rand amakhulu. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi imidlalo ifaka ingane ngamakhono okuphila ngendlela engathathwa ngenye imisebenzi. Kukhona futhi ubufakazi bokuthi imfundo yomzimba iholela ekusebenzeni kahle ezifundweni. Njengoba zinefuthe elihle empilweni, imisebenzi yomzimba inefuthe elihle ezingeni lokukhiqiza. Ukwehla kwezinga lephutha emsebenzini kuhambisana nokuphila kahle, okuyingxenye ye-23% eholela ekulondolozeni izinsuku nezinsuku zomnyaka. Ngokuphikisana nesisho esithi uSathane uthola umsebenzi ezandleni ezingenalutho, leso sisho sithi ingane emidlalweni ingane engakaboshwa. Ukuziphatha njengomjolo kuhambisana nokuntuleka kokuzethemba, kanti impumelelo emidlalweni nokuzijabulisa kuthuthukisa ukuzethemba. Labo ababa izibonelo ezinhle emidlalweni baphakathi kwabo abavela ezwenikazi eziningi ezinecebo eliphumelelayo lemidlalo efana ne-rugby, ibhola, kanye nebhokisi, kuholela ekwehliseni izigameko zokucwasa ngokobuhlanga kuleli. Impumelelo emidlalweni ilethe ukuhlonishwa, noma eziz
Izitolo Ezinkulu: Indlela Yokuhamba Ngezinyathelo Zokuthenga Isingeniso Izitolo ezinkulu zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokuthenga ezivumela abantu ukuthi bathole izinto eziningi ngasikhathi sinye. Kulokhu, sizobe sikhuluma ngezinyathelo okufanele uzithathe ukuze uhambise kahle ezitolo ezinkulu, uqonde kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi uzuze kokubili ukhetho nezindleko. Isinyathelo Sokuqala: Ukuhlela Ukuhamba Ngaphambi kokuba uhambe, kubalulekile ukuhlela. Qala ngokubhala uhlu lwezinto ozidingayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha izinto ezibalulekile ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. Bheka izaphulelo namathikithi akhona, njengoba izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zikhangisa. Hlela isikhathi sokuhamba, ungahambi ngezikhathi eziphezulu kakhulu ukuze ugweme izixuku. Isinyathelo Sesibili: Ukungena Esitolo Lapho usufikile esitolo, qinisekisa ukuthi ungena ngendlela efanele. Izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zinezingxenye ezahlukene, ngakho qaphela izikhombisi-ndlela ezikuleso sikhungo. Phakathi kokungena, ungathola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, njengemisebenzi yokuphakela, ezinsizeni zamakhasimende, kanye nezikhangiso ezithile. Isinyathelo Sesithathu: Ukuzulazula Esitolo Ngemuva kokungena, sebenzisa uhlu lwakho ukuze uzulazule kahle. Qala endaweni ethile, njengendawo yokudla, bese uqhubeka nezinye izigaba, njengezingubo, imikhiqizo yokuhlobisa, namathoyizi. Lindela izimpawu ezikhombisa imikhiqizo ethile, njengoba izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zihlola izigaba ezihlukene. Isinyathelo Sesine: Ukuze Uthole Okuthile Ngokushesha Uma udinga ukuthola umkhiqizo othile, ungabuza umsebenzi wendawo. Abantu abasebenza ezitolo banolwazi olunembile mayelana nezimpahla ezitholakalayo futhi bazokwazi ukukuholela endaweni efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinto ozidingayo, kanti futhi kunciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba. Isinyathelo Sesihlanu: Ukuthenga Nokusebenza Nezimali Njengoba uqhubeka nokuthenga, qaphela izindleko. Bheka izimpahla ezikhangisiwe, futhi uqaphele ukuthi zikhona izaphulelo noma izinzuzo eziqondile. Uma uthenga, ungasebenzisa ikhadi lesikweletu noma imali. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela izinqubo zokukhokha, njengezinketho zokubuyisela. Isinyathelo Sesithupha: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Ngesikhathi sokuthenga, qaphela ukuphepha kwakho. Gwema ukuhamba ngezixuku ezinkulu ezingenakuhlala kahle. Kuhlale uhlole izimpahla zakho, uqiniseke ukuthi akukho okulahlekile. Uma uthola ukuthi udinga ukusiza, thintana nabaphathi ukuze bakusize. Isinyathelo Sesixhenxe: Ukupakisha Nokuhamba Ngemva kokuphothula ukuthenga, qiniseka ukuthi uthwale kahle imikhiqizo yakho. Izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zinikeza izikhwama zokuthenga, kodwa ungathanda ukuletha zakho. Qiniseka ukuthi izinto eziphakeme zifakwe kahle ukuze zingaphumi ezikhwameni. Hamba kancane, uqaphe izinyathelo zakho, ikakhulukazi uma ubhikisha izikhwama ezinzima. Isinyathelo Sesishiyagalombili: Ukuhlola Imikhiqizo Ngemuva Kokuhamba Ngemva kokubuyela ekhaya, hlola imikhiqizo yakho. Qiniseka ukuthi konke okuvumelekile kuhle, futhi uma kukhona okungalungile, thintana nesitolo ukuze ufake isikhalazo. Lokhu kuzokugcina uqinisekile ukuthi uzuze impumelelo ekuthengeni kwakho. Isiphetho Izitolo ezinkulu zizele ngezinto eziningi ezikhethwayo, futhi ukwenza kahle ukuhamba ezitolo kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungazithokozisa ngokuthenga, uphinde uzuze ngempela esikhathini esisodwa. Hamba uvuleka, udinge kahle, futhi ujabulele ithuba lokuthenga. Izitolo ezinkulu zikhona ukuze zisebenze kahle empilweni yethu, zingcashe izidingo zethu ezahlukene.
U-Elon Musk: Umholi Wezobuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Zomhlaba U-Elon Musk ungomunye wabantu abavelele emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe namuhla. Uzalelwe ePretoria, eNingizimu Afrika, ngo-28 kuNhlangulana 1971. Wakhula enothando lwezifundo, ikakhulukazi ezimayini, ubuchwepheshe, nezincwadi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yasePretoria, wathuthela e-United States ukuze aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yasePennsylvania, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBSc kwi-Physics kanye neBSc kwi-Economics. Ngemva kokuphothula, u-Elon Musk waqala umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ngo-1995, waqala inkampani yakhe yokuqala, i-Zip2, eyasiza amabhizinisi ukuthi akhe amawebhusayithi. Le nkampani yakhula ngokushesha, futhi ngo-1999, u-Musk wayesekwazi ukuyithengisa ngo-$307 million, okuyimpumelelo yokuqala yakhe. Ngemva kokuphumelela ku-Zip2, u-Elon Musk waqhubeka nesinyathelo esikhulu sokwakha i-PayPal, eyaziwa ngaphambilini njenge-Confinity. I-PayPal yathuthukisa indlela yokukhokha ku-inthanethi, yenza kube lula ukuhweba online. Ngo-2002, i-eBay ithenge i-PayPal ngo-$1.5 billion, futhi u-Musk wathola ingxenye enkulu yale mali. U-Elon Musk akazange ame lapho; waqala izinkampani eziningi ezinomthelela emhlabeni. Enye yezinkampani zakhe ezaziwayo yi-SpaceX, eyasungulwa ngo-2002, enhloso yokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo zokuhamba emkhathini. I-SpaceX yaphumelela ekwakheni imikhumbi emisha, efana ne-Falcon 1, i-Falcon 9, kanye ne-Dragon, eyasiza ekuthumeleni abantu nezimpahla emkhathini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, u-Elon Musk waqala i-Tesla Motors ngo-2003, enhloso yokwakha izimoto ezisebenzisa amandla elanga. I-Tesla yaphumelela ekwakheni izimoto eziphakeme, ezifana ne-Tesla Model S, Model 3, Model X, kanye ne-Model Y. U-Musk uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bezimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, futhi i-Tesla yaba yinkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni. U-Elon Musk unomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Ngonyaka ka-2016, waqala i-Neuralink, inkampani ehlose ukuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe be-computer nekhanda lomuntu, ukuze kusizwe abantu abanezinkinga zempilo. Uphinde wathuthukisa i-SolarCity, eyasungulwa ngo-2006, enhloso yokwakha izixazululo zamandla elanga. U-Musk ukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise amandla avuselelekayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukusetshenziswa kwamandla angavuseleleki. U-Elon Musk ungumuntu ophokophele phambili, okhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ngale kokukhona, futhi uhlosile ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezinkulu zomhlaba, njengezinguquko zesimo sezulu, ukuntuleka kwamandla, nokungcoliswa komoya. Ngaphezu kwemisebenzi yakhe, u-Elon Musk ubamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphila. Ubonisa ukuthi umhlaba ungashintsha uma abantu benza izinqumo ezinhle. U-Elon Musk ubonakale engumholi onomthelela, futhi izinkampani zakhe zibe nemiphumela emihle emhlabeni. Uhlale efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto, futhi uyakwenza lokhu ngothando, ukuzinikela, kanye nokukholelwa ekubeni khona kwezinto ezinhle. U-Elon Musk ungumfanekiso wokukhuthazela, futhi ubonisa ukuthi uma umuntu enza umsebenzi oncomekayo, ungashintsha umhlaba. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuphumelela akufanele kube kuphela ngempumelelo yezimali, kodwa kufanele kube nokuhlomula komphakathi. Lokhu kwenza u-Elon Musk abe ngumholi ophakeme, owaziwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi ohlala efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono.
Ukufunda Online kwaqala ngendaba kaSipho, umntwana ophuma emzaneni omncane. U-Sipho wayenothando lokufunda, kodwa ngenxa yezinkinga ezazibhekene nomndeni wakhe, wayengakwazi ukuphumelela esikoleni. Njengoba edlula ezinsukwini, wathanda ukufunda ngezincwadi ezitholakala emtapo wolwazi, kodwa wayezwa ukuthi impilo yakhe idinga ushintsho. Lokhu kwavela lapho umhlaba we-inthanethi waqala ukuvela phambi kwakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, u-Sipho wahlangana nomngane wakhe, uThandi, owafika enezindaba ezimnandi. "Sipho, uyazi ukuthi ungafunda online? Ungafunda izinto eziningi ngaphandle kokuphuma endlini?" uThandi wabuza. U-Sipho wahlala phansi, ethokozile. UThandi wamtshela ngamawebhusayithi ahlukahlukene anikela ngezifundo zezesayensi, ubuchwepheshe, nezinto eziningi. Ngemuva kokukhuluma noThandi, uSipho wathola isikhuthazo sokuzama ukufunda online. Waqala ukukhangela izifundo ezitholakala kwi-inthanethi, wathola imithombo eminingi yokufunda. UThandi wamfundisa indlela yokufinyelela i-inthanethi, futhi uSipho wathola ikhompuyutha endala ekhaya, eyaba isikhumbuzo esithokozisayo sokuphila kwakhe. Noma uSipho wayenokukhawulelwa, wathola indlela yokufinyelela izinsiza eziningi. Waqala ukufunda izifundo zezesayensi, ezokuxhumana, nezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, wathola ukuthi ukufunda online akukhawulelwanga kumalebula, kodwa kumane kube indlela yokukhulisa ulwazi. Wayenokuhlangenwe nakho okukhulu, okwakumjabulisa kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waqala ukuthola iziqu ezincane ezivela ezikoleni ezihloniphekile, okwandisa umuzwa wakhe wokuthi angafinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Wabhalisela izifundo ezengeziwe, wathola umphakathi wabafundi abavela emhlabeni wonke, ababelana ngemicabango nemibuzo. Ukuhlanganyela kwabo kwamuveza ukuthi akakhulumi yedwa kule ndaba yokufunda. U-Sipho wathola abahlobo abasha, abamxhasa futhi bemncoma ngezifundo zakhe. Kodwa uSipho wayenobuhlungu ngezinsuku lapho ubuhlungu bezifundo bamnaka, lapho wayengakwazi ukufunda kahle. Nokho, wathola ukuthi akayena yedwa. UThandi nabanye abafundi baye bakhuluma ngezifundo ezinzima, bahlala bezihlanganisa ukuze bahlolane. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ukufunda online akukhona nje ukufunda izifundo, kodwa futhi ukukhulisa ubudlelwano. Waqhubeka, wathola izifundo ezihluke kakhulu, futhi kwaba usuku oluhle lapho athola khona izifundo zezimali, ezokuphatha, nezokusebenza. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo eziningi, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabasebenzi bezinkampani ezinkulu, waqala ukuthola ama-internship, avula amathuba amaningi. Ngempela, ukufunda online kwamnika ithuba lokuphumelela, kwenze ukuthi afinyelele emaphusheni akhe. Ngezinye izikhathi, uSipho wayehlala ekhumbula izinsuku ezinzima, wazama ukusiza abanye abancane emzaneni wakhe ukuze nabo bakwazi ukufunda online. Wabakhombisa indlela yokuxhumana namathuba avela kwi-inthanethi. Umphakathi waba nomoya opholile, abantu behlanganyela ukuze bazuze. Ekugcineni, uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ukufunda online kungashintsha impilo yomuntu. Wazi ukuthi akekho omele adlule emhlabeni wedwa, kodwa uthando nokubambisana kuyindlela yokuhamba phambili. U-Sipho wagcizelela ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi waqhubeka ehamba phambili, eqhubeka nokuhlola nokufunda kuze kube phakade. Ukufunda online kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi uSipho waba yisithombe sokuphumelela nokuqhubeka phambili, enza ubuhlakani obuhle.
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo Umbuzo 1: Yini izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo yizindawo ezikhethekile ezibizwa ngokuthi zizosiza abantu ukuba bathole ulwazi olunembile nolwakha ngokuphathelene nezempilo. Lezi zikhungo zifaka phakathi amahhovisi ezempilo, izikhungo zokwelapha, nezinye izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezokwelapha, izifo, nezindlela zokuphila ezithuthukile. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kufanelekile ukufaka izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ukuze kwandiswe ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo kubantu. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nezindlela zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Lokhu kufika ngesikhathi lapho izinkinga zempilo zikhula kakhulu, futhi abantu badinga ukufundiswa ukuze baqonde indlela yokuziphatha kahle ukuze bagweme izifo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufaka lezi zikhungo? Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifaka izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangakwazi ukufinyelela odokotela kalula. Okwesibili, lezi zikhungo zithuthukisa ukuqwashisa ngokubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwempilo kanye nokuthuthukisa izindlela zempilo eziphilayo. Okwesithathu, uthola izinsiza zamahhala ezithuthukisa ulwazi lwezempilo, okuhloswe ngakho ukusiza abantu benze izinqumo ezinolwazi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufakwe izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? Ukufaka izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kudingeka ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezikhungo zezemidlalo, uhulumeni, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kudaleke uhlelo oluhlanganyelayo olunikeza abantu ulwazi oluthile. Okwesibili, ukufundiswa kwezisebenzi ezizokwenza izikhungo kumele kube sesikhathini. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzeka ngama-resources akhethiwe kanye nezinye izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwalezi zikhungo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani ukufaka izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kungathinta umphakathi? Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kungathinta umphakathi ngempela. Lokhu kuzolekelela abantu ukuba babe nolwazi oluqondile ngezempilo, okuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Umphakathi othuthukile ophendukela ezinsizeni zolwazi uzoba nempilo engcono, futhi kuzokwenziwa izinto ezincike ekuziphatheni kahle emiphakathini. Umbuzo 6: Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zidinga izinsiza ezikhethekile? Yebo, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zidinga izinsiza ezikhethekile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olumelele noluhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezincwadini zomsebenzi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi kudingeka kube nezingxoxo nezingcazululo ezisiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izifo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zidinga ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukile ukuze zikwazi ukwenza ushintsho olufanele, futhi zihlale zivuselela ulwazi lwazo. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe kuchaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundiso uma kufakwa izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? Yebo, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kuchaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundiso. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokufundisa eziphumelelayo ezithuthukisa ulwazi lwezempilo phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kufundiswa kungabandakanya izifundo ezihlukahlukene ezikhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqapheleميزة emiphakathini yabo. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngezithiyo ezingenzeka lapho kufakwa izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? Ngenkathi kufakwa izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo, kunezithiyo ezithile ezingenzeka. Lena ifaka phakathi ukungabi khona kwemali eyanele, ukuxhumana okungaphumeleli phakathi kwezikhungo ezihlukene, noma ukungafuni kwabantu ukufaka lezi zikhungo ngenxa yokungaziwa kwazo. Ukuze lezi zithiyo zinqandwe, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngezinyathelo ezilandelayo ukuze kuqhubeke nokwaziwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? Ukugcina ukuqwashisa nokuqhubeka nokwaziwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezihlala ziphila, ezifaka phakathi imikhankaso yokufundisa. Lokhu kusebenza kungahlanganiswa nezinkampani zomphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi olunembile lufika kubantu bonke, futhi bazuze ekunakekeleni kwabo empilweni. Umbuzo 10: Ngubani ofanele ukuhlelela ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? Uhlelo lokufaka izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kufanele luhlelwe ngabantu abaningi, ukwenza uqobo nezisebenzi zezemidlalo, ohulumeni, ososayensi, nezithunywa zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni isigcawu esiqinile sokusebenza, esithuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kulabo abafuna ulwazi lwezempilo. Isiphetho: Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kufaka izindlela zokufundisa eziphumelelayo, ukufinyelela kolwazi olungcono, nokwakha umphakathi oqondile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukusungula lezi zikhungo ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu nempilo yethu. Isibopho sethu ukuhlanganyela kulolu daba, siqonde ukuba neqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo.
I-visa yebhizinisi iyimvume enikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula noma ukufaka imali ebhizinisini eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo emahhovisi e-embassy noma emisebenzini yaseNingizimu Afrika noma ehhovisi lezangaphakathi eliseduzane lapho ibhizinisi lizokwakhiwa khona. Imali encane yokutshalwa kwemali ingu-R2.5 million ngempesheni noma okungenani u-R2 million ngempesheni no-R500,000 ngezimali. Le mali phezulu kumele ibe ivela ngaphandle, futhi kumele kube yimali esele engasetshenziswa njengengxenye yebhizinisi. Uhlelo lwebhizinisi kumele lukhombise izimo eziqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lizophumelela, kokubili esikhathini esifushane nangesikhathi eside, ngokufakazela ukuzibophezela ukuthi kuzoba nabantu abahlala njalo abahlala okungenani abahlanu noma izakhamizi ezizosebenza ngokuphelele. Kufanele kwenziwe isimemezelo sokuzibophezela ukuze ubhalise neNhlangano Yezimali yaseNingizimu Afrika ngezizathu zentela. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke ngecebo lokuhlola elivela kuzo zonke izwe lapho umfaki-sicelo nabantu abaxhomekeke kuye bahlala khona eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, kusukela eminyakeni engu-18, kanye nezingane ezixhomekeke ezineminyaka engu-18 naphansi, ezizohamba nomfaki-sicelo kuleli. Isethulo sokuvakasha se-yellow fever sidingeka uma uhamba noma uhlela ukuhamba ezindaweni lapho i-yellow fever itholakala khona. Imali yokubuyiselwa ibalulekile ukuze ubuyisele emhlabeni wakho, efana nekhadi lokubuyela elilodwa lapho ubuya khona noma lapho unokuhlala okungapheli: Le mali izobuyiselwa ngemva kokuhamba noma ngemva kokuthola i-visa. Ukukhokha le mali kungakwenziwa ngecheki eqinisekisiwe yebhange noma ngekhadi lesikweletu ezindaweni lapho le nsiza ikhona. Imibiko yezokwelapha nezimiphumela ze-x-ray zidingeka kumfaki-sicelo ngamunye. Izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwengu-12 nezifazane abakhulelwe akudingeki ukuba nezimiphumela ze-x-ray. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezempilo eliseduzane.
Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika isu leSizwe Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. Lokhu kuyingxenye yemiphumela yokucwaninga okuningi kanye nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezemisebenzi kanye neSikhungo Sezakhono. NgoNovemba 2000, kwakhuluma kakhulu ngohlelo olwakhiwe. IKhansela Lezakhono selibuyekeze iziphakamiso eziningi neziphakamiso phakathi kwalolu daba. NgoJanuwari 2001, leli Khansela langethula kimi iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqala zezwe lethu ezisekela isu elibanzi lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Lezi ziphakamiso nezincazelo zakhuphula umoya wami kakhulu ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, leli su sekuvele lazi izindawo ezibalulekile ezihamba phambili ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono, futhi siqoke izinkomba ezizokwenza sikwazi ukukala impumelelo nentuthuko esiyenzile. Ngakho-ke, leli su lihola umnyango wami, uMnyango Wezemfundo, nezinye izigaba zokuqeqesha. Okwesibili, leli su libonisa kahle ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuzothinta kanjani umkhankaso wesizwe wokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekuthuthukiseni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Yonke iminyango kahulumeni iyasebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bethu bathola imfundo neziqu ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isibonelo, uMnyango Wezemfundo uzibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi kukhona izinguquko emfundweni ejwayelekile nasemfundo ephakeme. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono afanele. Isu Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ligcizelela indima edlalwa uMnyango wami enqubweni yokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi - futhi ikakhulukazi izindlela ezizokala impumelelo yaleyo ndima. Iphinde inikeze eminye iminyango kahulumeni uhlaka lokusebenza njengoba bethuthukisa amakhono ezindaweni zabo. Okwesithathu, ngithole umyalo wokweseka lokho esikutholile ngenkathi sibhala futhi sihlela leli su. Nakuba kube nokuvumelana mayelana nezindlela zokuhlola ukusebenza kahle kwecebo nokukala izinhloso, umqondo walesi simo wawusekelwa ngaphandle kokungabaza. Mayelana nendaba yokusetha izinkomba ezizokhombisa impumelelo nokuhlola indima esiyidlalayo ekufezeni leli su, kwavunyelwene, futhi le nhloso iyinkomba enye yokuthi uMnyango wami uzibophezele ekusebenzeni emphakathini nasekubikeni umphakathi ngakho konke okwenziwayo. Inselelo enkulu ukuwenza lo msebenzi ube nempumelelo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uqhubeka nokusiza umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubandakanya ukukhuthaza abaqashi, izinyunyana, abasebenzi, iminyango kahulumeni, nomphakathi ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Umyango wami uzibophezele ekuqapheleni ukuthi leli su lisebenza kahle futhi liya phambili. Yonke imizamo efanele kumele yenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempumelelo futhi kube nezibalo ezikhona mayelana nentuthuko yecebo, ngokusemthethweni. Ngithemba kakhulu kwiKhansela Lezakhono ukuze ibuyekeze imibiko ebhalwe uMnyango wami, futhi uma kudingeka, iqale uphenyo lwayo, inginikeze izeluleko nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingase zidinge ukubuyekezwa kwenqubomgomo nezinguquko ekwenzeni. Impumelelo nokwehluleka kumele kubhalwe ukuze sonke sikwazi ukufunda kuso futhi silungise amaphutha ethu. Lecebo kumele kube sesimweni esiphezulu. Ngizokwenza njalo ngilindele imibiko yentuthuko evela kumnyango wami, nasemkhankasweni ophathelene nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ngiyamema futhi iKhansela ukuba ibuyekeze njalo izinhloso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziqhubeka zixazulula izidingo ezibaluleke kakhulu zezwe lethu. Ngifuna ukuveza ukubonga kwami okujulile kubantu abangu-1000 besifazane nabesilisa ababe nomthelela ekuthuthukisweni kwaleli su elihle. Izinhloso engizibekile zisezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu, kodwa akukho okungenzeki uma sinesifiso. Ngokufanayo, umdlandla esinawo wokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ungafezwa. Inselelo kithi manje ukuwenza amaphupho ethu abe yiqiniso. Masivule izandla zethu siqale ukusebenza! Kuyaziwa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayikakabi namakhono adingekayo ukuze ithuthukise ngokwezimali, ngokwenhlalo, nasemsebenzini. Ukuze sifinyelele kulolo level, sinesiMthetho Sokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, kanye neMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, owamukelwa ngo-1998 no-1999 ngokulandelana. Le mithetho inika uNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi umthwalo wokwenza amalungiselelo eSizwe Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, ngokubambisana neKhansela Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. IKhansela Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono lasungulwa nguMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu alo amele amabhizinisi, abasebenzi, uhulumeni, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngemuva kocwaningo olunzulu nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezemisebenzi neKhansela elibhekelele Amakhono, amalungiselelo okuphila kwecebo akwenziwe. NgoNovemba, amakhophi aleli cezo aphakanyisiwe kubo bonke ababambiqhaza. Imihlangano yokukhuluma ngepilothi yabanjwa kuzo zonke izifunda. IKhansela ithole iziphakamiso eziningi mayelana nepilothi. Kwabe sekwenziwa ukubuyekezwa, futhi izinkomba zempumelelo zashintshwa. Izinkomba zempumelelo ezibekwe kulolu su zizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke futhi zishintshwe uma kudingeka. Ziyindlela ephumelelayo yokuhlola izindaba ezibalulekile nempumelelo, kodwa izindlela zokuhlanganisa ulwazi zingathuthukiswa, njengoba nezindlela zokuhlola umthelela wecebo. Ngesinye isikhathi, lezi zinkomba ziveze izenzo ezithile kunokukhombisa imiphumela yalezo zenzo. Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkomba zingashintshwa ukuze zikhombise kangcono imiphumela. Ngezikhathi ezibekwe, uMnyango Wezemisebenzi uzokwenza imibiko ngazinye izinkomba. IKhansela Lezakhono izobuyekeza le mibiko. Lokhu kuzovumela uNgqongqoshe ukuba ahlale ethola ulwazi nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingase zivele. Uma kudingeka, uNgqongqoshe angakwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo zamakhono ezwe ngaleso sikhathi. UMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998, kanye neMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezithinta abasebenzi nokuthuthukiswa kwabo. Le mithetho emibili iletha imibono emisha mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezakhiwe ukuze ziqhubeke futhi zikhuthaze uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Kukhona izindaba ezimbili ezibalulekile ezibhekwa yile mithetho. Okokuqala, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho womhlaba kanye nokuncintisana kwemikhakha yethu neyezwe elinye. Okwesibili, ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nokususa ubuphofu. Imithetho yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono seyiqala ukusebenza. NgoAprili 1999, iKhansela Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono lasungulwa. Ngomhla kaM
Izikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Ucwaningo Nokuhlola Kulesi sikhathi samanje, izikhungo zezempilo zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Kunezikhungo eziningi ezinikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, kodwa manje sizogxila ezingama-72 ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, eziphathelene nezidingo ezahlukene zezempilo. Ukuqala: Umqondo Wokuthola Usizo Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 ziqhakambisa amathuba abantu abanawo okuthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izibhedlela, izikhungo zokunakekelwa, nezindawo zokwelapha. Zikhona ezindaweni ezidumile, kanye nezinye ezincane ezikude, kodwa zonke zisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo abaludingayo. Izinsizakalo Ezitholakalayo Ukwahlola izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa yilezi zikhungo, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinsiza ezahlukene. Izikhungo eziningi zinikeza ukwelashwa kwezifo ezithile, izinsiza zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola impilo. Okubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze baphile impilo enempilo, okukhuthaza izinqumo ezinhle ezithinta impilo yabo. Izikhungo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zisebenzisa izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokwelapha, okuhlanganisa imishini ethuthukisiwe nezindlela zokwelapha eziyinkimbinkimbi. Umphakathi Nezikhungo Zezempilo Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibhala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ziba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu, lapho bengakwazi khona ukuxoxa ngempilo yabo, izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthola usizo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okuyinto ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Izifundo Nezaziso Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 azihlinzeki kuphela ngempilo, kodwa zifundisa umphakathi ngokuqwashisa ngezifo ezivamile nokuthi zingavikelwa kanjani. Ukuze abantu bazi kahle futhi banqande izinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo, izikhungo zenza imizamo yokuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa nokufundisa. Izinhlelo zokubamba izifundo zempilo, imihlangano yokweluleka, nemicimbi yokuhamba nempilo, zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi lokhu kube nomthelela omuhle kulwazi lwabantu. Ezokuxhumana Nezikhungo Okwamanje, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana ukuze ziqhubeke zixhumana nabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufaka izicelo zokuthola usizo, baphendule imibuzo, futhi bahlale bexhumene nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Izikhungo eziningi zisebenza namasiteshi wezokuxhumana, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imininingwane ngempilo, izinhlelo, nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Imiphumela Nokuthuthukiswa Ucwaningo lwezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 lubonisa ukuthi zikhona izinzuzo eziningi empilweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kunciphisa izingozi zezifo, futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqaphele impilo yabo. Lezi zikhungo zikhuluma nezinga lokuphila elijwayelekile, elithuthukisa umphakathi ngokuhlanganyela. Nokho, zidinga ukwakhiwa nokuqhubekisela phambili izinhlelo ukuze zisebenze kahle. Isiphetho: Iqhaza Lezempilo Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zineqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlola lezi zindawo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imizamo yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi iyadingeka. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukufundisa abantu, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile kufanele kube umgomo ophakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sikhuthazwa ukuthi siqhubeke sibhala izindaba ezithinta impilo, sinikeze ukwesekwa, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 ziqhubeka ziba isibonelo esihle sokubaluleka kokukhalipha, ukusebenzisana, nokuhlinzeka ngempilo empilweni yomphakathi.
Izinhlelo ze-apartheid kanye nekoloni zidalile ngokuqondile izimo lapho iningi labantu bezwe lalingekho kuphela emaphethelweni kodwa beliphathwa kabi kakhulu. Lokhu kuholele ekuhlukaniseni lapho isiNgisi nesiBhunu banikezwa isimo esisemthethweni futhi baqhutshwa ngokuqhubekayo kuyilapho izilimi zomdabu zezwe zishiywa zinganakiwe. Uhlelo lwezokuphatha lwezilimi lweGauteng lwenziwe njengomphumela oqondile weNgqungquthela yeMthethosisekelo yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, kanye noHlelo lweZilimi lwezwe (olwamukelwa futhi lwashicilelwa ngoMsombuluko 2003) oluhlinzeka ngamalungelo emthethweni mayelana nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi. Uhlelo lweZilimi lwezwe lufuna zonke izifunda ukuthi ziqhube izinqubomgomo zazo zezilimi ngokuhambisana nalo. Uhlelo lweGauteng lwenziwe ngemva kokuxhumana nabathintekayo abahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifunda, kanye nezwe. Lezi zikhungo zifaka phakathi iNational Language Centre yeMnyango wezobuChwepheshe neZamasiko, uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng (GPG), iminyango kanye nokugxilwa okukhulu okuvela kuMnyango wezeMfundo waseGauteng, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izindawo zokuhlala, iLegislative Assembly, kanye nabaphathi bezilimi. Le nqubo yokuxhumana yaphathwa nguMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko kanye Nezamasiko ngosizo lwabaculi abahlukene emikhakheni yezilimi. Lo mcimbi, ohambisana nokuxhumana okuhlakaniphile (futhi kwesinye isikhathi okukhathazayo kakhulu) phakathi kwabaphathi bezilimi nabaphakanyisi, uveza inselelo ejabulisayo kuhlelo lweZilimi lweGauteng, olufuna ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango ejulile yokuphumeza uhlelo olusebenzayo lwezilimi eziningi. Ubuye bukhulume ngemiphumela ebalulekile yokuhlola uhlelo lwezilimi nezilimi ezamukelwe yiSouth African Languages Board ngo-2001, lapho kuthathwa isampula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 naphezulu abahlolwe kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Izindawo ezigxilwe kakhulu zifaka phakathi ulimi lwasekhaya nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi emikhakheni eyimfihlo neyomphakathi, izimo zomphakathi nezokufunda, ulimi lomsebenzi kanye nemfundo, izimo ezithathwa kuhlelo lwezilimi, kanye nokukwazi ukushintsha izilimi kanye nezilimi eziningi. Umthethosisekelo ubheka imfundo njengengxenye ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi. Uhlelo lweZilimi lweGauteng luphinde luthathe izinhlinzeko zeSouth African Schools Act ka-1996 mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezikoleni nokuthi uhlelo lweZilimi emfundweni luhambisana kanjani nesimo semfundo. Inhloso yeGauteng Language Policy Framework ukuhlinzeka nokuqinisa izilimi zomdabu eGauteng ezake zashiywa emaphethelweni esikhathini esedlule. Isigaba 29 sithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ezilimini ezisemthethweni abazincomayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi lapho imfundo ingatholakala khona. Umthetho wePANSALB ka-1995 njengoba ushintshiwe, kanye nezinye izinhlinzeko, uhlinzeka ngokuqashelwa, ukusetshenziswa, nokukhuthazwa kwezilimi eziningi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezake zashiywa emaphethelweni. Ubuye ugcizelele ukusungulwa kwamakomidi ezilimi ezifundeni okumele akhuthaze izilimi eziningi ezweni. Uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko kanye Nezamasiko, usungule iGauteng Language Committee. Nakuba umthetho weSouth African Schools Act (SASA) uhlinzeka ngenqubo yokushintsha ezindaweni ezithile, okwamanje unika uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo nangemva kokuxoxisana neKhansela leMinisters, amandla okwakha izindinganiso zohlelo lwezilimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Ubuye ucacise ukuthi umzimba ophatha isikole somphakathi ungakhetha uhlelo lwezilimi ngokulandela umthethosisekelo, lo mthetho (SASA), nezinye izinqubomgomo ezifanele zesifunda. Izinhloso zeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi kumele zihlinzeke ngokuqinisekiswa kwesizathu somthethosisekelo sokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguHulumeni, emizimbeni ezimele, noma kubantu ngabanye ngaphansi kwemikhawulo efanele. Ukufinyelela akumele kube nje ukuthola ulwazi ngempela kodwa kufanele futhi, lapho kungenzeka, kube ngolimi olukhethwe ummangali.
