Njengoba uSheduli 4 weMthethosisekelo uthi, ulimi luwumkhakha osebenzayo wokwakha nokusabalalisa ulwazi ngaphakathi kwesifunda, uHlelo lweZilimi lwezwe lukhuluma ukuthi zonke izikhungo zikaHulumeni (ezingeni lendawo, lesifunda, kanye nezwe) nezinye izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezenza imisebenzi yomphakathi zibophelelekile kulo hlelo. Izifunda kulindeleke ukuthi ziqhube izinhlinzeko zazo zezilimi ezihambisana noHlelo lweZilimi lwezwe ngenkathi zicabangela izimo zesifunda, izidingo, kanye nezintandokazi zomphakathi wazo. Le nqubo izodluliselwa kuhulumeni bendawo abazokwakha izinqubomgomo zabo zezilimi ngokuhambisana noHlelo lwezokuphatha lwezifunda. Uhulumeni uphinde ukhuthazwe, lapho kudingeka, ukweseka umkhankaso ozimele wokuthuthukisa nokuphumeza izinqubomgomo zabo zezilimi ngokuhambisana nalo hlelo. Uhlelo lweZilimi emfundweni luwuhlelo lwezilimi lwezwe olusebenza ngaphakathi kwesimo semfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano ngokuxhumanisa izigaba, amasiko, izilimi, nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudalwe indawo lapho ukuhlonishwa kwezilimi ezingezona ezomuntu kuhlonishwa. Ukuxhumana kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni kuzokhuthazwa futhi kuhlonishwe. Njengengxenye yezimiso zayo, uHlelo lweZilimi emfundweni lukhuthaza ukuthi bonke abafundi kumele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi olulodwa lwemvelo, wonke umkhakha wezilimi uzonikezwa isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla ezifanele ezingeni lesifunda zizothola iziqondiso zezinqubomgomo mayelana nezidingo zokukhuthaza izilimi njengezifundo, ngokuhambisana nemithetho kazwelonke. Umkhakha weHlelo lweZilimi uzobheka iminyango yeGPG, iGauteng Legislature, izindawo zokuhlala ezinakekela ukusetshenziswa kwazo kwezilimi zesifunda kanye nezinketho, kanye nezikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifunda ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. Amabhizinisi azimele kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni nazo zizokhuthazwa ukuba ziqhube izinqubomgomo zazo ngokuhambisana nalo hlelo. Lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi isiZulu yisilimi sasekhaya esikhuluma ngaphezu kuka-20% wabantu ezingeni lesifunda nasezwenikazi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba isiNgisi sisetshenziswa kabanzi njengolimi lwezohwebo nesayensi, sithola indawo yesine nesezithupha
Izinsizakalo zokuhlenga zikhona kubantu abakhubazekile ukuze zibasize bafinyelele ezingeni lapho bengasebenza khona ngendlela efinyelelekayo. Izinsizakalo zokuhlela eziyisisekelo zingezokuvikela ezakhiwe ukuze zandise amandla omthengi ukuba azimele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokunakekela ekhaya, amaqembu okusekela, nokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuzimela, ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa, nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokukhuthaza nokuphromotha. Ukuvuselelwa kwezinga lesibili kuwuhlelo lokungenelela oluyisisekelo oluhlanganisa imikhankaso yokwenza imali nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukunciphisa ubuphofu, ukuthuthukisa izingane ezincane, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphumula ezikhathazweni. Vakashela endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eduze noma kwi-clinic yokuhlola, lapho uzothunyelwa khona endaweni yokuvuselela esibhedlela noma kwenye indawo yokuvuselela, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ikhethekile, izinga lesibili, noma izinga lesithathu. Kungathatha cishe ezinyangeni ezi-3 ukuxazulula isicelo sakho. Ezindaweni ezithile, abantu babekwa ohlwini lokulinda okungafika ezinyangeni ezi-6. Ezimweni ezithile, usizo luk government kubantu abakhubazekile, olungafika ku-75%, luthathwa njengengxenye yezindleko. Ezinye izindleko zanqunywa yizikhungo uqobo. Ezinye izikhungo zihlola izindleko ngokususelwa kulokho umndeni ongakukhokha. Zonke lezi zindleko zihluka ngempela ngempela. Amafomu okucela adinga ukufakwa anikezwa yisikhungo sokuvuselela noma isikhungo sokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo.
Kusuka kumphathi wesibhedlela... Imithetho yeMidlalo 4 - Siyayithola, iyasiphunyuka... Imibono, iziphakamiso, imicimbi, izimemo, imishado, izaziso, nokunye okuningi. Kumele sazi zonke lezi zindaba. Sitshele! Abaphathi bavumile ukuthi kuzoba nendawo yokufunda. Omunye wabasebenzi uzovakashela wonke amagumbi eziguli ebuzwa ukuthi bayawathanda yini amaphepha okufunda, futhi bazowathatha uma beqeda. Nks. Sibona, sibona ukuthi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu uma abasebenzi besisiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le mizamoyiphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasebenzi bangasebenzisa indawo yokufunda ngesikhathi sabo sokuphumula. Umsebenzi wezempilo uvakashela emakhaya amahlanu ngosuku futhi uba ngama-100 ngenyanga. Baphatha izifo ezilula ukuphatha futhi baqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli abazivakashelayo zithola ukwelashwa. "Sisebenza nezindawo zabakhosi, umkhosi ngamunye unikezwa umsebenzi wezempilo ukuze asebenze endaweni yomkhosi," kusho uNeli Khuzwayo, umsebenzi wezempilo. Abasebenzi bezempilo babalulekile kakhulu kuyo yonke imitholampilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ngoba lezi zindawo zivame ukuba kude nomphakathi, futhi ukuthuthwa akukuhle. Siyi-centre encane kakhulu, enethemba elikhulu, amaphupho amahle, nokusebenza kanzima. Okwamanje, abantu beze ukuhlola igazi labo, kodwa sithumela igazi ukuze lihlolwe esibhedlela iStanger bese sithola imiphumela. Sicebisa iziguli zethu ngakho konke okudingayo ukuze zicebiswe ngalesi sifo bese sithumele ezibhedlela iStanger kulabo abazothola imishanguzo. Siqale iklinikhi lapho, siqeqesha iziguli zethu izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze sibone ukuthi zingakwazi yini ukuthatha imishanguzo ngesikhathi esifanele. Futhi, ukuthi bangavula kanjani ngezimo zabo ukuze bathole ukwesekwa emindenini yabo nasemiphakathini, futhi bazisize. Siyajabula ukuthi noma amaphepha okudlala ambalwa, izingane seziqala ukudlala ngawo. Sinezingane nezincwadi abangazidweba kuzo. Ukungasebenzi Kwentsha: Isizathu Sokukhathazeka Nokufuna Izixazululo Emphakathini wethu wanamuhla, ukungasebenzi kwentsha sekuba yinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengoba sithokozisa izinsuku zethu, sithola ukuthi inani labantu abasha abathola imisebenzi linciphisa ngokushesha. Lokhu akukhombisi kuphela ukungabi namathuba, kodwa futhi kudala umuzwa wokuphelelwa ithemba phakathi kwentsha yethu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sihlole izimbangela zalokhu, imiphumela yalo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze siphumelele. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde izimbangela eziholela ekungasebenzi kwentsha. Enye yezizathu eziyinhloko ukungabi khona kwemisebenzi eminingi ethokozisayo. Imboni ezithile, ezifana nezobuchwepheshe, ithola ukuthuthuka okukhulu, kodwa imikhakha eminingi iyahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi eyanele. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abasha baphenduke bengenamathuba, futhi lokho kudala umuzwa wokuthi baphuma emhlabeni wezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo ezitholakalayo azihlali zifaneleka nezidingo zemakethe. Abantu abasha bahlala besebenzisa isikhathi sabo besenza izifundo, kodwa uma behluleka ukuthola imisebenzi, kubonakala sengathi lezi zifundo azinasidingo. Imiphumela yokungasebenzi kwentsha ibalulekile. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Abantu abasha abangenamsebenzi bavame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu zempilo yengqondo, okubandakanya ukudangala nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphumelele kancane ezimpilweni zabo, futhi imiphumela ingaba yinde kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungasebenzi kwentsha kudala umphakathi ongenankuthalo. Uma abantu bephila ngaphandle kokusebenza, bahlala bezizwa bengenamandla, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zomphakathi, njengokwehla kwemali engenayo, izinga eliphakeme lokuhlukunyezwa, kanye nokwehla kokwethembeka emiphakathini. Kodwa-ke, akumele siphumelele kuphela ekukhathazekeni ngalezi zinkinga, kodwa kufanele futhi sithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa isimo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, nezikhungo zemfundo basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa abasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha amakhono ezokuxhumana nezobuchwepheshe zingasiza kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba okusebenza. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi abasha bathole amathuba okuzithuthukisa. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwenhlalakahle lungasiza ekwakheni amathuba okusebenza, futhi ukuhlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokuzithuthukisa kungasiza ekwakheni izikhala ezintsha. Abantu abasha bangenza imisebenzi emincane, njengokwenza imisebenzi yokuzithandela, ukuze bakhe amakhono nezixhumanisi ezidingekayo ukuze bathole imisebenzi ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onamandla futhi onokuthula. Ekugcineni, ukungasebenzi kwentsha akuyona nje inkinga yomphakathi, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta wonke umuntu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izixazululo zidinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabaholi, izinkampani, nezikhungo zemfundo. Ukuthuthukisa amathuba okusebenza, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nezidingo, nokwakha isimo esivumelanayo, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abasha. Ngakho-ke, akumele sithule, kodwa kufanele sibe nomoya ophakeme wokusebenza ndawonye ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sihamba ndawonye, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nelinokuthuthukiswa kwentsha yethu. Lokhu kuzodinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, nokubambisana, kodwa sizokwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngakho-ke, masiqale manje, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa lethu.

Izinkinga Zokungcola Komoya: Ingxoxo Isingeniso Namuhla, sizobe sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, eyodwa ezinzima kakhulu futhi edinga ukunakwa kwethu, okungcola komoya. Ngikholwa ukuthi kulungile ukuqala ngengxoxo enembile kanye nomuntu osebenza emkhakheni wezempilo, uMnu. Dlamini, ongumeluleki kwezokuhlala kahle komoya. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngokuvuma ukudlula kithi namuhla. Umbuzo: Mnu. Dlamini, ungachaza kanjani izinkinga zokungcola komoya? Impendulo: Yebo, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Kulula ukusho ukuthi izinkinga zokungcola komoya zifaka phakathi izinsiza eziningi ezihambisana nomoya esiwuphefumulayo, ezifaka phakathi udaka, uthuli, nezinto ezibangela ukungcoliswa komoya. Lokhu kungaba ngenxa yokusebenza kwemishini emikhulu, ukwakha, noma ngisho nezinto eziphuma emathunjini abantu. Lokhu kuthinta impilo yethu, kube nomthelela omkhulu ezindaweni esihlala kuzo. Umbuzo: Uthini umthelela wokungcola komoya empilweni yabantu? Impendulo: Umthelela ungashintsha kakhulu. Njengoba uhamba phambili, ungaholela ezinkingeni ezinjengokuphefumula, izifo zenhliziyo, nezinkinga zokuhlala kahle. Unokuthinta iziguli ezikhuluma ngokuthi zihlupheke kanjani, noma ziba nezinkinga ezinzima njenge-asthma noma i-chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Lokhu kuyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomoya omncane. Umbuzo: Zithini izizathu ezikhulu zokungcola komoya eNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: E-Ningizimu Afrika, izizathu ezinkulu zifaka phakathi ukuhamba kwezimoto, ukukhiqiza amandla, nokwakha. Izimoto zikhula ngokushesha, futhi zikhuphula amazinga okungcola komoya. Ukukhiqiza amandla, ikakhulukazi emithonjeni yokushisa, kukhuphula izinga le-sulfur dioxide, okuyingozi emoyeni. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izindawo zokwakha zikhuphula uthuli, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba komoya. Umbuzo: Kukhona yini izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela abantu kulezi zinkinga? Impendulo: Yebo, izinyathelo zikhona. Uhulumeni usebenza ngokuqhubekayo ekwenzeni imithetho eqinile yokongamela umoya. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zilandela izinqubomgomo ezithile. Kukhona futhi imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile, njengokusebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile eziphathelene nemvelo. Umbuzo: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokungcola komoya eNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: Ngicabanga ukuthi umbono wethu udinga ukuba ngowesibili. Uma sibheka izinyathelo ezithathwayo, ngiyavuma ukuthi sinethemba. Kodwa, konke kuncike ekutheni sizimisele kangakanani ukwenza izinguquko. Uma abantu bezokwazi ukwakha imiphakathi ebhekelele imvelo, sizoba nempilo engcono. Ubulunga bokuphila kanye nokuhlala kahle komoya kuyoba nethuba lokuthuthuka. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo umuntu ngamunye angazithatha ukuvikela impilo yabo? Impendulo: Ngempela, izinyathelo ezilula zingaphinde zibe namandla. Umuntu angakhetha ukuhamba ngezinyawo noma ukusebenzisa ibhasi esikhundleni sokusebenzisa imoto. Lokhu kuzonciphisa ukungcola komoya. Ukuze siqinisekise impilo yethu, kufanele futhi sikhuthaze imikhankaso yokuhlunga umoya, njengezikhumbuzo zokuhlanzeka komoya ezivela ezinkampanini. Futhi, uma uhamba emakethe, khetha imikhiqizo enobungane bemvelo. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngalesi sikhathi sokwabelana ngolwazi oluwusizo. Izinkinga zokungcola komoya zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, futhi sicela abantu bazi ukuthi izinyathelo ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngiyabonga kubo bonke ababekhona, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukwenza ushintsho oluhle empilweni yethu. Hayi kuphela ngezinkinga zomoya, kodwa nasezimpilweni zethu.
Ukubuyekezwa Kwezokukhiqiza: Ukuhlola Umgwaqo Wokuhweba Wamanje Ezokukhiqiza, njengomkhakha obalulekile emnothweni, ziwumgogodla wokukwazi ukusiza izwe ukuba likhulise umkhiqizo wesikhathi esizayo. Phakathi neminyaka edlule, ubuchwepheshe budlule ezinguqubweni ezinzima, bulethe ushintsho oluningi kulokho esikubona njengokukhiqiza. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlola ubuchwepheshe, izinqubo, kanye nezinguquko ezenzekayo kulomkhakha. Ukuqala, ubuchwepheshe obusha buyisikhumbuzo sokuthi kukhona okuthuthukayo ezokukhiqiza. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa i-AI, imishini ethuthukisiwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zedijithali (digital applications) zisiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ukukhiqiza kuhamba kahle. Ukusebenzisa i-AI ekwakhiweni kwezakhiwo, kusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kudala imikhiqizo engcono kakhulu, izinga eliphezulu futhi isikhathi sokukhiqiza siphumelela kakhulu. Imishini ethuthukisiwe ifaka phakathi ama-robotics, aqhubekayo athuthukisa izinga lokusebenza nokunciphisa izindleko. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwenzeni uqobo imikhiqizo engabizi kakhulu kubathengi. Kwazulu, lokhu kuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kuletha nokuphuculwa kwezenhlalakahle. Ukwanda kwemisebenzi emisha, njengemikhakha yokusebenza kwezimoto, kwenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalakahle yendawo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imiphakathi iyakha amathuba emisebenzi, abanemithombo ehlukeneyo, nokwenyusa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulula emabhizinisini amancane ukuthi azitholele izinsizakalo ezimakethe ezintsha, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinguquko azizele ngaphandle kwemiphumela emibi. Ukushintsha okukhulu kutshala ingqondo yokuguqula izinto ezivamile nezokwakha kojima. Lokhu kuholela emnothweni ophazamisekile, lapho abanye abantu bezwa ubuhlungu bokungabikhona kwemisebenzi engazwakali ekwakhiweni kwabantu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi imishini ethuthukisiwe isathokoziswa, kudingeka ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi abathengi nabantu abawusebenza baqondiseka kahle nezinguquko ezenzakalayo. Kuwo wonke lo mkhakha wezokukhiqiza, sithola ukuthi izinqubo ezihlala ziphumelela zidinga ukwenziwa ngokuqhubekayo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezifunwa umkhakha ukuze ube nekhono lokuqhubeka, ikakhulukazi uma sicabanga ngobumpofu bokuncintisana phakathi kwamazwe. Lokhu kudinga ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo yezehlakalo eziningi ezitholakalayo ngenhloso yokwakha izixazululo ezibhalwe phezulu ezingasiza ukuvikela imboni. Izinselelo zikhona emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza, njengokungabi khona kwezinsiza zokuhlola nokuvikela imiphakathi evame ukulahlekelwa izinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kusiza ukunciphisa imikhiqizo eziphumelelayo, okukhombisa ukuthi abanye abantu basazama ukuvikela izinkalo zabo ngemikhankaso eyahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi ingase isiqhekeziwe, idalwe inhloso yokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo ezithinta bonke abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zikhumbula izidingo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi baqonde ukuthi imikhiqizo yabo ingaphumelela ngokuqhubekayo uma ingahlangana nezidingo zabasebenzisi. Kwakha ukuthandwa okuthile ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuthengisa, okukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi unendima enkulu ekwakheni imikhuba esebenzayo. Ngenxa yokuthola imiphumela emihle, abankampani kudingeka bakhe ubudlelwano obukhulu nabathengi ukuze baziqinisekise ngokwabo ukuthi bayazwisisa. Ngakho-ke, njengokubuyekezwa kwezekukhiqiza, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlale sithathela phezulu imithombo ethuthukayo, futhi sihlale sithuthukisa ikhono lethu lokuxhumana nezinguquko ezizayo. Ngokuhambela phambili, sizokwazi ukuzithola kulesi sikhathi esishintshayo, sihlanganyela ngamazinga amasha okusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhlola lezi zindawo ezahlukene, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka izixazululo ezithuthuke ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, okuholele ekwakheni umnotho onamandla. Izokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, uma kusebenzelwa ubuchwepheshe nezinqumo zokuqala, kubaluleka ukuba sihlose ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imikhankaso yethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokusebenza okuhle kwezokukhiqiza, okuzoba phezulu eNingizimu Afrika nakwezinye izindawo emhlabeni. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhiqiza akugcini nje ekwenzeni imikhiqizo. Kubalulekile emnothweni, emiphakathini, nasempilweni yomuntu. Kuhle uma sesibuka phezulu esikhathini esizayo, siphinde sihlola konke esikuthathile, siqonde indlela engcono kakhulu yokwakha umphakathi okhulayo. Lokhu kuzoletha impumelelo emqondweni, okukhombisa ukuthi imboni yezokukhiqiza iyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izincwadi: Umcimbi Wokubhalwa Kwezincwadi Ngaphakathi kwesimo esikhulu sokuhlanga, umcimbi omkhulu wokuqhakambisa ubuciko bokubhala wenzeka, uhlotshaniswa nezincwadi ezimnandi. Lo mcimbi, owayehlelwe emnyangweni wezokucabangela eNyuvesi yaseMzanzi, wathatha izinsuku ezimbili ezijabulisayo. Abantu abaningi, okuhlanganisa abakhiqizi bezincwadi, ababukeli, nabanikazi bezincwadi, bafika bejolise emiphakathini yezincwadi, okwakunguyena ophilisa amakhalekhukhwini ezitolo. Uqala umcimbi ngezinkulumo zokuqala ezivela kubabhali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ababeqhuba izifundo ezithokozisayo zokufaka imizwa nempilo emibhalweni yabo. UGladys Ngubane, umbhali odumile, waphakamisa umqondo othi, “Izincwadi zihlala zingenza igama lami labehluleli bezimpilo, ngakho kumele sikubhale kahle okukhona phakathi kwethu.” Lokhu kwavusa izinkanyezi eziningi ezazifuna ukujabulela lezi zifundo. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, umcimbi waphendukela ezinsukwini zokuxoxisana, lapho ababhali bavuma ukwabelana ngemicabango emisha nemibono yokwakha izincwadi eziphawulekayo. UThuli Mkhize, ophumelelayo kumsakazi wezincwadi, wahlakulela izeluleko ezinkulu zokuthi umbhali angakwenza kanjani uma eqhamuka nesibalukiso esikhulu sempilo yakhe. “Zama ukufaka ukwazisa kwabantu kulokho okubhalayo, ngale ndlela uthola ikhono lokuxhumanisa abaphulaphuli,” esho, ethokozisa izihlwele. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba neseshini yokubhalisa, lapho ababhali behlangana, bekwazi ukuxoxa ngobuciko babo. Kwakungelula, kodwa umoya wokubambisana ubukeka uthokozisa. USipho Ngcobo, omunye wababhalayo, wabelana ngendaba yakhe yokulwa nobunzima bokubhala, wathi: “Kubalulekile ukuthi sizame ukwakha izincwadi ezithinta inhliziyo, njalo kumelwe sibekela umbono wethu.” Umgqigqo wesikhathi uhamba kancane, umcimbi uqhubeka uhlangabezana nezikhathi zokuhlonipha ababhali abaphumelelayo, lapho abantu beqonda khona amagugu ezincwadi. U-Nokuthula Baloyi, umbhali ophumelele, ethokozisa ngokuhlonishwa kwalezi zinkanyezi kubantu ababenjengobasekeli kuphela. Amabhuku ahluka-hlukene abekwe kumakhalekhukhwini, abathandi bezincwadi bekhuluma ngokuqinile ngalokho ababona kwincwadi ngayinye. Kwaba nemika yethuba ebabazekayo yokuthenga ezincwadini ezithokozisayo, umcimbi ufinyelela ebantwini abaningi, okwakukhumbuza ngempela ukuthi izincwadi zisekhona njengezibani ezikhanyisayo emhlabeni. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ugcine usiphe imicabango emisha, imishado ehlangene phakathi kwezimvo nezincwadi, edlisa udumo lobuciko. Kwakuyinsuku enenhlonipho, ewusizo, echaza kabanzi ngencwadi nokubhala. Izincwadi zaziphithizela kahle phakathi kwethu, zaba yizikhumbuzo eziphilayo, ezintsha, nezivumelwano ezizayo emphakathini. Ngenkathi umcimbi uthokozisa, ababhali nabathandi bezincwadi bahlala bekhuluma ngokusebenzisa izincwadi njengenhlangano yokubamba iqhaza emhlabeni. Ukuhlelwa kwalesi sikhathi kwahambisana nabantu abanjalo, kwakhumbuza ukuthi izincwadi zidlalela i-ecosystem, zidinga ukuhamba nathi endaweni yethu yokuphila. Lokhu kufezekile, futhi kugcinwa kumasiko nezinhlelo eziningi ezizayo. Umcimbi wenziwa kabusha ukuthuthukisa ukwenza kahle kwababhali, izincwadi, kanye nomphakathi. Abantu bakhumbulile ukuthi izincwadi azigcinwa kubhalwe emakhathalogu kuphela, kodwa ziyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha isiko lethu. Umcimbi ubonise indlela yokuthi izincwadi zicashe emqondweni wethu, zibe yizikhumbuzo ezihlala zikhanya esikhathini esingokomoya. Izincwadi – zihlala zikhanyile, zisenza siphile, zisenza sibe nemibono emisha.
Izimpi ZamaBhunu: Uhlanga Lwezinkumbulo Nezinguquko Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili, izimpi zamaBhunu zaguqula umqondo wezombusazwe, umnotho, kanye nezimpilo zabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zimpilo zashintsha zaba yizinkumbulo eziyinkimbinkimbi, zishiya izilokotho ezinzima emiphakathini ehlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zimpilo, kubalulekile ukuhlola imvelaphi yazo, izigameko ezibalulekile, kanye nemiphumela yazo. Imvelaphi Nezizathu Zokulwa Izimpi zamaBhunu ziqala ngemuva kokufika kwabantu baseYurophu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi amaBhunu abavela eNetherlands, eFrance, naseGermany. Ngemva kwesikhathi, amaBhunu akha izindawo zokuhlala ezazibizwa ngezimpi, lapho abelokhu bephikisana nezizwe zendawo, ikakhulukazi amaXhosa namaZulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezizathu eziningi zokulwa, okuhlanganisa ukulawulwa kwezinsiza, umhlaba, kanye nezinsiza zemvelo. Izimpi Zokuqala: Iziqubu ZamaBhunu Izimpi zokuqala zamaBhunu zenzeka phakathi nekhulu le-19, lapho amaBhunu eqala ukulwa nezinye izizwe zendawo. Iziqubu ezifana neMpi YamaBhunu (1835-1846) zaba yizigameko ezibalulekile, lapho amaBhunu abebhekene nezinkinga zokuphila nezokuphatha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezimpi ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa iMpi YamaBhunu Yezwe (1880-1881) neMpi YamaBhunu Yesibili (1899-1902). Iziphumo Zokulwa Izimpi zamaBhunu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emiphakathini ehlukene. Abantu abaningi bahlupheka, izindawo zashabalala, futhi izinsiza zemvelo zaphazamiseka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezimo ezinzima, lapho izigidi zabantu zashiywa ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baphile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpi zashintsha umqondo wezombusazwe, zakhuthaza imikhankaso yokuzimela, futhi zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izifunda ezahlukene. Ukwakhiwa Kwezizwe Nezinguquko Ngemuva kwezimpi, izwe laseNingizimu Afrika laqala ukwakha izizwe ezihlukene, lapho amaBhunu abebhekene nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umnotho, njengoba izwe laqala ukwakha izimboni ezahlukene. Izinkumbulo Nezifundo Zempilo Izimpi zamaBhunu zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima, zishiya izizukulwane eziningi zikhumbula ubuhlungu nezinkinga ezazihambisana nezimpi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokufundisa, lapho abantu befundiswa ngalezi zimpilo ukuze baziqonde kahle izifundo ezivela emlandweni. Izinkumbulo zempilo zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha, bahloniphe izinkumbulo zabanye, futhi bakhe ikusasa elingcono. Isiphetho: Ukubheka Phambili Izimpi zamaBhunu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, zashintsha izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Njengoba siqhubeka nokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lezi zimpilo, sifunde kuzo, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Ukubheka emlandweni, singathola izifundo ezibalulekile ezizosisiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono, elihlonipha izinkumbulo nezifundo ezivela ezimpilweni zabantu bethu. Ngakho-ke, izimpi zamaBhunu zihlala zibalulekile, zikhumbuza abantu bethu ngempilo, ubuhlungu, kanye nezifundo ezivela emlandweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ohambisana nezidingo zabantu bonke.
Izibuyekezo zohlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan nemiphumela yazo Uhlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) lwasungulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuhlela izinsiza zamandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamandla, kuhlanganise nezinsiza ezivuselelekayo, ezikhanyayo, nezokwakha. Ukubuyekezwa kwalesi hlelo kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu, futhi kube yisigaba esibalulekile emlandweni wezinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Ngo-2010, i-IRP yokuqala yethulwa, yahlola izidingo zamandla ezweni, yaphinde yahlola izinsiza ezikhona. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo eziningi zokwakha iziteshi zamandla, ikakhulukazi ezikhiqiza ugesi. Nokho, imiphumela yalesi hlelo yakhombisa ukuthi izinsiza ezivuselelekayo zidinga ukuba sezingeni eliphezulu, njengoba izinsiza ezivamile, njengezimayini z coal, zikhombisa ukuncipha kokusebenza kahle. Ngo-2018, kwenziwa ukubuyekezwa okukhulu kwe-IRP, okwakuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esisha sokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamandla. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kugxile ekwandiseni amandla okukhanyisa, ukwehlisa ukuncika kumafutha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo. Izinhloso eziphakanyisiwe zazifaka phakathi ukwandisa amandla okukhanyisa ugesi ophuma ezinsizeni ezivuselelekayo, njengezikhukhula, umoya, nelanga. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu abaningi bahlala khona. Lokhu kwanciphisa izindleko zokukhiqiza ugesi, kwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela ugesi. Nokho, izibuyekezo ze-IRP azizange zibe lula. Kwakukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi. Lokhu kwaholela ezinkingeni ezithile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamandla, okwenze kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Ngo-2020, kwenziwa olunye uhlelo lokubuyekezwa kwe-IRP, lapho kwavuma khona ukuthi izinsiza ezivuselelekayo kufanele zibe yizinto ezisemqoka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo eziningi zokwakha iziteshi zamandla ezivuselelekayo, okuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa umthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ohlangene, ophumelelayo, futhi onobungane nesimo sezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibuyekezo ze-IRP zaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ugesi ezindaweni eziningi, okwenze kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kudinga izinsiza eziningi, okudingayo ukuxhaswa kwezimali. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ekuphathweni kwezinsiza, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kwaba yinkinga enkulu, okwenze kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izibuyekezo ze-IRP zaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ugesi, okwenze kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Ngokuqhubeka, izibuyekezo ze-IRP zaba yisigaba esibalulekile emlandweni wezinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika, zaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni, empilweni yabantu, nasempilweni yomhlaba. Ukukhula kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ugesi, okwenze kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuphila impilo engcono. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene ukuze kufinyelelwe ezinhlelweni eziphakanyisiwe. Lokhu kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ohlangene, ophumelelayo, futhi onobungane nesimo sezulu.
Le ncwadi iqukethe ulwazi olujwayelekile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola. Ulwazi oluthile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola ozohlanganyela kuzo noma okukhuthazwa ukuba uhlanganyele kuzo kumele lunikezwe yilabo abahola uphenyo lwezifundo. Uphenyo lwezokwelapha luyisifundo sokucwaninga esihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, nokusebenza kwemithi emisha noma ekhona, izindlela zokwelapha, noma amadivayisi ezokwelapha, usebenzisa ababambiqhaza. Ukuphepha kubhekisela ekutheni ukwelashwa noma imithi kungase kube nezingozi noma umonakalo empilweni yomuntu. Ukusebenza kahle kusho ukuthi kukhona umphumela ekutholeni, ekwelapheni, ekugwemeni, noma ekwelapheni isifo. Lokhu kungase kudinge ukuqhathanisa imiphumela phakathi kwemithi/izindlela zokwelapha ezimbili. Ikhwalithi ibhekisela ekwethembekeni okuphelele kwemithi noma ukwelashwa, noma ukungenelela kwezokwelapha okuvumela ukuba kusebenze kahle nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kulezo zimo ezilindelekile ngesikhathi sokwelashwa komuntu ogulayo, ngaphandle kokubeka engcupheni umsebenzisi wemithi. Igama elithi "imithi" libhekisela emithini esetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo (imithi yokwelapha), ukuvimbela izifo (imithi yokuvimbela, efana nezivithamini), kanye nemithi esetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhlola okuthile (imithi yokuhlola, efana naleyo esetshenziswa kuma-X-ray ukuthola izitho zomzimba). Ngaphambi kokuthi imithi noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwe kubantu, kuqala kufundwa isikhathi eside ezikhungweni zokucwaninga nasemathunjini ahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle kwayo. Ukuhlola imithi emisha, izivithamini, nezindlela zokwelapha kubantu kuvame ukuhamba ngezinyathelo eziningi njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Isigaba sokuqala: Lesi yisigaba sokuqala lapho imithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwa eqenjini elincane labazithandayo abaphilile. Izifundo zokuhlola isigaba sokuqala zihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha okuphelele, umthamo ophephile, nemiphumela emibi engase ibe khona yemithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Isigaba sesibili: Esigabeni sesibili, imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwa eqenjini elikhulu labantu, ngokuvamile amakhulu abantu abaphilile kanye nalabo abane sifo okufanele silashwe ngemithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesibili wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle kwemithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kusebenza. Isigaba sesithathu: Kulesi sigaba, imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwa kumakhulu kuya ezinkulungwaneni zabantu abane sifo okufanele silashwe ngemithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesithathu wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukusebenza kahle nemiphumela emibi engase ibe khona yemithi, izivithamini, noma enye indlela yokwelapha emisha uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa okukhona (okunevumelekile). Isigaba sesine: Kulesi sigaba, ukuhlolwa kwenziwa ngemuva kokuthi imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kube kuqoshwe yi-MCC, okusho ukuthi ngemuva kokuthi imithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kube kuqoshwe, ithole ne-licence yokuthengisa. Ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, nemiphumela emibi yesikhathi eside kuhlolwa emithini emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo njengezingane, abantu abadala, abantu abanezinselelo zezinso, nezifo zezinso, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa (izinkomba) imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Izigaba zalesi sikhathi ngasinye zinezinhloso zazo ezithile nezinsiza ezithile, izingozi, nemiphumela emibi. Kuwo wonke amazinga ezifundo, ababambiqhaza ocwaningweni bavame ukukhokhelwa nganoma yiziphi imiphumela emibi abangase bayihlangabezane nayo noma nganoma yiziphi imiphumela engalindelekile. Imiphumela emibi ingabandakanya noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezimpawu ezimbi nezingenalindelekile, izimpawu, noma izifo ezihlobene nemithi/ukwelashwa okukhuluma ngakho. Imithi yokuhlola iyimithi emisha noma etholelwa muva (imithi) esaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Imithi ethengiswayo iyimithi esivele iqoshwe nezinhlaka ezilawulayo (MCC) futhi ingasetshenziswa njengokwelashwa kwezinhlobo ezithile zezifo. Le mithi idlule esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa, futhi ikhwalithi yayo, ukuphepha, nokusebenza kahle sekwaziwa. Imithi ethengiswayo ibizwa nangokuthi imithi enevumelekile noma imithi eqoshiwe. Umkhiqizo wokuhlola ungumuthi (imithi)/izivithamini (izivithamini)/noma ukwelashwa (imikhiqizo yezokwelapha) okukhuluma ngakho ukuze kuhlolwe ikhwalithi, ukuphepha, nokusebenza kahle uma kwenziwa isifundo sokuhlola esithile. Kungase kube nemikhiqizo engaphezu kweyodwa esifundweni esithile. Imikhiqizo yokuhlola ingabandakanya imithi, izivithamini, noma imikhiqizo yezokwelapha ezibhalisiwe noma ezingabhaliswanga noma imikhiqizo esaphenywa. Umxhaso ungumuntu, inkampani, isikhungo, noma inhlangano enesibopho sokwakha, ukuphatha, nokuxhasa isifundo sokuhlola. Abaxhasi bavame ukuba abakhiqizi bezokwelapha, izikhungo zikamasipala, izikhungo zocwaningo, iHhovisi leMhlaba leMpilo, ohulumeni baphesheya, njll. Umphenyi ungumuntu onemfundo efanelekile onenhloso yokuhlela, ukwenza, ukuhlaziya, nokubika ngalesi sifundo esithile. Abaphenyisi bavame ukusebenza ndawonye njengeqembu. Umphenyi ophambili ubizwa nge-Principal Investigator (PI). I-PI inenhloso yokuphatha izenzo ezihilela umxhaso kanye nezikhungo ezilawulayo. Abaphenyisi bangabandakanya odokotela abelapha, ososayensi bezokwelapha, abaphenyi bemithi, ochwepheshe bezempilo yengqondo, noma amalungu omkhakha wezokwelapha, njll. Noma ubani okhetha ukuhlanganyela noma osevele wahlanganyela ocwaningweni (okuhambisana nabo) esifundweni sokuhlola unelungelo lokuhlinzeka ngovuma olunembile. Umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika inombolo 108 ka-1996: Isigaba 12 sithi "wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlonishwa kokuphila kwabo komzimba nangokwengqondo, okuhlanganisa nelungelo - (c) lokungasetshenziswa ocwaningweni lwezokwelapha noma lwezesayensi ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngovuma olunembile kuqala." Yini ukuvuma okunembile? Ukuvuma okunembile kuyinqubo ekhona mayelana (futhi efanele) ukuhlanganyela ocwaningweni okuhlanganisa ukufunda ngamaqiniso abalulekile mayelana nesifundo sokuhlola esithile esizokwenziwa ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza isinqumo sokuthi aqhubeke noma cha futhi ahlanganyele kulolo phiko lokuhlola. Ukuvuma okunembile akukhona nje ukusayina ifomu lokuvuma futhi akuyona inkontileka, kodwa kuyisendlalelo sokuvuma kumuntu ozohlanganyela ocwaningweni. Ukuvuma kwakho okunembile kuyidingo ebalulekile ocwaningweni ehambisana nezindinganiso zokuziphatha nezocwaningo lwe
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okulungele Abasebenzisi Ngempelasonto edlule, insuku ezimnandi zakhula emkhakheni wezokwakha zezikhungo ezizokhuthaza umphakathi, ngendlela ehlelekile futhi enobungane. Lo mcimbi, owenziwe eGoli, wawuhloselwe ukudala izikhungo eziwusizo, lapho abantu bengahlanganyela khona, benze imisebenzi ehlukene, besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo kalula. Imicimbi yasendaweni ibiyinsika yokwakha izikhungo eziyohlala zihamba phambili empilweni yasemphakathini. Ukuvulwa kwalolu suku lodlame olwenzeka esikhungweni sokuxhumana seMidlalo, kwagcwala abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejabulile, begcwele ithemba lokuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezimqoka empilweni yabo nsuku zonke. Kuqala, umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela nezingcweti eziphezulu ezithinta izakhiwo, ezokwakha, nezindawo zokusebenza nezokuhlanganyela. Omunye wabaqondisi, uMnu. Mkhize, waphawula ngesidingo sokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu, ikakhulukazi lapho kudingeka ukufaka imizamo emisha yokunciphisa ukhula olungokwezemvelo. "Sidinga izikhungo ezikhethekile ezizodlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu nakusizakali," kugcizelela. Abakhangisi baphinde benza iminikelo yokubambisana, behlukanisa izimpendulo ezahlukene maqondana nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezikhethiweyo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo zokudlala izingane, izikhungo zezempilo, nezikhungo zokufunda. Abanye nabo banikela ngezixazululo ezisebenza kahle, ezifana nezinsizakusebenza ezenzakalayo nokwakhiwa kwezindawo eziphilayo. Owokwakha umphakathi, uNkk. Dlamini, uthe: "Umsebenzi wezakhiwo awupheli lapha, ngempela, uqhubeka lapho abantu behlangana nabanye, benza imisebenzi eyisiqalo." Ngalesi sikhathi, izikhungo ezithokozisayo zobuchwepheshe baphinde bandele izinsizakalo zazo. Ukuba khona kwezinhlelo zokufunda nokuhlanganyela, okwakwenziwa ngezingxoxo ezithokozisayo kanye ne-workshop, kwanikeza abantu ithuba lokuhlola izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha izikhungo ezisebenza kahle. Hhayi kuphela izinhlelo zemfundo, kepha namarobhothi athuthukisa izinqubo zomsebenzi baboniswa, ukuze abantu bazi okuthile okusha ekwakheni. Izikhungo ezitoreyishayo zathokozisa izivakashi eziningana, futhi umhlangano wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphuthumayo, okwenza umphakathi uqhubeke uhamba phambili, izwi lemfundo nemfundo yayingashiyi ngemuva. Umhlangano wawwenyusiwe ngemisebenzi eminingi ehlukene, kufaka phakathi imibukiso yama-artisans, imidlalo yeqembu, nezifundo zokwakha phakathi kwabesifazane abasha. Ekugcineni, umphakathi wahlanganyela ukuze uphumeze imiphumela ehlanganyelwe, kuye kwavela imiklamo emisha yokwakha nezikhungo ezizothuthukisa imiphakathi. Kuzwakalise ukuthi abantu baye bazibuza ukuthi bangayithuthukisa kanjani impilo yabo, kwezomnotho, nasekukhangiseni ngempumelelo. Umsebenzi wasendaweni ubumbene kakhulu, wehlisa unesidingo sokwakha izikhungo eziphilayo nezithuthukisiwe. Kulabo abavaka lezi zikhungo, kusobala ukuthi umphakathi uyakwandisa umqondo wokuhlangana komhlaba, njengoba ucela ukuthi baqhube izinkulumo ezijulile phezu kwezidingo ezinzulu zabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi, umcimbi wahamba phambili, kucacile ukuthi ukufaka izidingo zomphakathi ngaphambili kubalulekile ekwakheni izikhungo ezizothokozisa abantu. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza ikusasa lokhula kwezokwakha ezikhungweni, udaba oluzoqhubeka lungxoxwa ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani eziphumelelayo kanye nezazi, uhlu lwezikhungo ezihambelana nezehlukahlukana kwemiphakathi lukhutse, lema nempumelelo izovumela umphakathi wethu ukuba wakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile, elizongenela ezikhathini ezizayo. Umcimbi wokwakhiwa kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi ubuhlakani, ubonisa kahle ukuthi umphakathi ungahlala ube yibo obumbene, uma kukhulunywa ngezinkinga eziphilayo. Ngakho-ke, ukwakha izikhungo ezilungiselelwe abasebenzisi akuhambeli phambili, kodwa kungenzeka, ngempela, kube ngumgomo okukhhekhelayo wethu sonke. Ngalesi sikhathi, iziphakamiso aziphumeli kuphela emicimbini, kodwa zikhuthaza wonke umphakathi ukuba enze izinto ngendlela engcono kuzo zonke izindawo zempilo. Njengoba sizokwakha ikusasa, kumqoka ukuthi siphathe izikhungo ezihlangene, ezizothuthukisa imisebenzi ehlukahlukene nezidingo zamapulazi. Lokhu kuzogcina kwenze kube yimpumelelo enkulu kuthi sonke.
Thina, abasebenzi boMnyango Wezemfundo eKwaZulu-Natal, siqonda futhi sihlonipha ilungelo labantu abangasebenzisi izinsizakalo zethu lokuxhumana, ukuthola ukwelashwa okufanele kanye nensizakalo efanele, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, ukwaziswa ngohlobo nangesigaba senkonzo abazoyithola, ukufaka izikhalazo uma bethola insizakalo engafanele ngesikhathi esifanele nangendlela ehlonipha ukubhekelela kwezimali nokubamba iqhaza ngokuphelele emisebenzini ngenhloso yokuvula nokukhanya. Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlaba wezi-2023, eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, kwenzeka umcimbi obalulekile wezempilo, lapho abafundi basemanyuvesi bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lo mcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka indawo yokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuhlonipha imizamo yabafundi, futhi waba yimpumelelo enkulu. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yokuvula, eyaholwa nguMnu. Ndlovu, isikhulu esiphezulu seNyuvesi, owasikhumbuza ukuthi abafundi bangabashintshi bezwe. Uthe: “Abafundi, niyizigidi ezizayo, eninika ithemba elikhulu. Nibona umkhiqizo wezifundo, kodwa futhi nibona nokwakha ikusasa.” Le nkulumo yakhuthaza abafundi, ibavusa umoya wokuzimisela. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezinkulumo ezivela kubafundi abahlukene, ababeveza izifundo zabo ezihlukahlukene. UThandiwe, umfundi ophumelelayo kwezobuchwepheshe, wabelane ngempumelelo yakhe ekwakheni uhlelo lokusebenza olusiza abafundi ukuba bahlale bexhumene. Uthe: “Ngifuna ukufakazela ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba ithuluzi elinamandla lokwenza impilo yethu ibe lula.” Lokhu kwabangela abanye abafundi ukuba baqhamuke nemibono emisha, bephakamisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza izifundo zibe lula nakakhulu. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, umcimbi wahamba phambili ngemisebenzi yokuxhumana. Abafundi banikezwa ithuba lokuhlangana, baxoxe ngemicabango, futhi babelane ngamaqiniso athokozisayo. Lezi zikhathi zokuxhumana zaba yindawo yokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, lapho abafundi behlanganyela khona imicabango yabo, bezama ukuthola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezibhekene nabo. Isigaba sokugcina somcimbi sahlonishwa ubuciko. Abafundi baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokukhombisa imisebenzi yabo, okuhlanganisa ubuciko bezandla, umculo, nezinkanyezi zokudansa. UThuli, umculi ophumelelayo, wathokozisa bonke ngengoma yakhe ethokozisayo, ekhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungumgogodla wokuphila, futhi bukhombisa ukuthi abafundi bangaphezu kokufunda izifundo. Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi abafundi baphuma bejabule, bephinde bezwa ukuthi bahlala bexhumene. Uhlelo lokuhlanganyela lwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi lukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahlale bephokophele phambili. Umcimbi ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi abafundi basemanyuvesi bangabavukeli, futhi bahlala bephokophela kuzo zonke izifundo zabo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonise ukuthi abafundi basemanyuvesi bangamaqhubu, futhi bahlala bejabulisa, bephokophela phambili, nokuphokophela impumelelo. Umoya wokuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, ubonisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephokophela phambili, futhi bahlala bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lo mcimbi, ngempela, waba yimpumelelo yokuhlanganyela, yokufunda, nokukhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Ngakho, umcimbi waba yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bephokophela phambili, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo, futhi bephokophela impumelelo. Lokhu kuhlelwe kahle, futhi kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, okuhamba phambili empilweni yabo. Umcimbi wakhombisa ukuthi abafundi bangamaqhubu, futhi bahlala bephokophela phambili, ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ulwazi Oluqondiswa Ngwezwi Ezikhungweni Isingeniso Ezikhungweni eziningi, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi luyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezikole, izibhedlela, nezinkampani, lapho ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kudinga ukuba kube khona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi kahle imiyalelo, izinqubo, nezidingo. Kulolu hlobo lombhalo, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngempumelelo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Ukuxhumana Ngomoya Ohlanzekile Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi umkhulumeli alungiselele kahle ngaphambi kokukhuluma. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukucacisa Inhloso: Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyifinyelela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imiyalezo yakho. 2. Ukukhetha Izwi Elifanele: Sebenzisa izwi elikhuluma kahle, elinobungane, futhi elihloniphekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza abanye bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bezwakala. 3. Ukucacisa Izithombe: Uma kudingeka, sebenzisa izithombe noma izibonelo ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umyalezo wakho uyacaca. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhuluma Ngendlela Ehloniphekile Lapho usukhuluma, qiniseka ukuthi: 1. Uhlonipha Abalaleli: Bheka abanye ngeso lokuhlola, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubakhumbuza ukuthi imiyalezo yakho ibalulekile kubo. 2. Sebenzisa Izwi Elikhululekile: Khuluma ngesiZulu esicacile, ugweme amagama anzima noma aphikisanayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubalaleli ukuqonda. 3. Phendula Imibuzo: Nika ithuba lokuthi abanye baphendule imibuzo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe uma kudingeka. Isinyathelo 3: Ukusebenzisa Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Izinsiza zokuxhumana zingasiza kakhulu ekwandiseni ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Izikhangiso: Sebenzisa izikhangiso ezibhalwe phansi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imiyalezo ibhalwe phansi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuyibuyekeza. 2. Izinhlelo Zokuxhumana: Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, ama-imeyili, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze uthumele imiyalezo ebalulekile. 3. Izithombe Nezibonelo: Uma kudingeka, sebenzisa izithombe noma izibonelo ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umyalezo wakho uyacaca. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Ukusebenza Kwezwi Ngemuva kokukhuluma, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lusebenza kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukucela Impendulo: Cela abanye ukuthi banikeze impendulo mayelana nokuthi imiyalezo yakho ibalulekile yini. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi yini engasebenza kahle nokuthi yini engathuthukiswa. 2. Ukubuyekeza Izinhlelo: Uma kudingeka, buyekeza izinhlelo zakho zokuxhumana ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe uma kudingeka. 3. Ukubheka Izinguquko: Qaphela izinguquko ezitholakala ekuxhumaneni. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi yini engasebenza kahle nokuthi yini engathuthukiswa. Isiphetho Ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni luyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiyalezo yakho iyafinyelela, iyacaca, futhi ihloniphekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngempumelelo. Ukuxhumana kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo. Ngakho-ke, qhubeka nokusebenzisa lezi zinyathelo ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni zakho.
Ngiyavuma, sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko esinzima, kodwa ngizokwenza kube kulula. Njengoba sonke sikwazi, izikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngabe ubona kanjani lezi zikhukhula? Yini odinga ukuyazi? Okokuqala, kufanele kuthiwe, izikhukhula zenzeka ngenxa yokungena komoya opholile, izimvula ezinzima, nezimo zemvelo ezimbi. Ngabe ubona lezi zinto zenzeka kangakanani? Impela, ngiyazi ukuthi abantu bahlupheka kakhulu. Izindlu zibhujiswa, abantu bayalahleka, izimpilo ziyanqamuka. Lokhu akukhanyi, akunjalo? Kukhona abangane bethu, imindeni, abathanda, abalahlekile. Lokhu kumosha imiphakathi ngempela. Ngabe sikhumbula izikhukhula ezinkulu ezihambile? Kukhona lezo zenzeka ngo-2022, lapho izimvula zashaya kakhulu. Abantu bahlala bedinga usizo, imizamo yokusiza yayinjalo, kodwa isimo sasingesihle. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kukhona abantwana abahluphekayo, abazali bejolise emizimbeni yabo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi asikwazi ukusindisa bonke. Lokhu kucacisa ubunzima balesi simo. Kodwa uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sithola imiphumela emibi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithinte izinhlelo zokuphila zethu. Izikhukhula zenza kube nzima ukuhamba, izindawo zokuhlala ziba nzima ukufinyelela. Ngabe ubona kanjani lokhu? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo, kodwa-ke, ngabe sizokwazi yini ukuhamba phambili? Izakhiwo zidinga ukwakhiwa kabusha, futhi imiphakathi idinga ukwakha kabusha. Lokhu kungenzeka, kodwa kudinga ukusebenza ngamandla. Abantu badinga ukuvuselela izindawo zabo, ukuze kubuyiswe umoya ophilayo. Ngabe sikhumbula izinhlelo zezimali? Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile ezivumelana nezidingo zabantu. Kodwa, ngabe ukusabela kwethu lokhu kuphumelela? Lokhu kubalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukusabela okusheshayo. Izinhlelo zokuphuma, imindeni eqinile, abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, konke lokhu kubalulekile. Njengoba sithokozisa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula azizwakali, zisebenza, futhi zifuna ukusabela okufanele. Ngiphakamisa ukuthi siphendule kanjani? Ngabe sikhona isinyathelo esithile esingavula indlela yokuletha ushintsho? Thina, njengabantu, kufanele sihlanganyele, sihlinzeke usizo, sibe neqhaza. Lokhu kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Kukhona abaholi bezenhlalakahle, izinkampani ezizimele, nezinhlangano ezizokwazi ukusiza. Lokhu kudinga ukusebenza kahle, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Ngabe sikhuluma ngesimo semvelo kuphela? Cha! Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo ezinzima, sithathe izinyathelo ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kumele sihlale sikhumbula. Izikhukhula zibhujisa, kodwa zifundisa nathi. Zifundisa ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile, siphendule ngendlela efanele. Khumbula, asikwazi ukusindisa bonke, kodwa singenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngabe sikhumbula izinkumbulo zethu? Ngabe izinkumbulo zethu zifundisa ngendlela? Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi sizama kanjani ukusiza imiphakathi yethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo eziphusile, sithumele izinsiza lapho kudingeka khona. Sikhuluma ngezinsiza, kodwa futhi kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphakathi iyakha. Abantu badinga ukwakha kabusha, futhi lokhu kudinga isikhathi, kodwa badinga ukusekelwa. Ngabe sesikukhuluma, sikhumbula izinsiza zethu, izinhlelo, namathuba? Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe neqhaza, sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula zikhombisa ubunzima, kodwa zifundisa futhi. Ngabe sikhumbula izinyathelo ezithathwe? Sithi kulungile, sibe nesibopho, sibe nezinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula. Ngabe uyavuma? Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibopho, sibe nokuqonda. Ngiyazi, izikhukhula zibhujisa, kodwa kumele sithole indlela yokuphila, yokwakha kabusha. Lokhu kungenzeka uma sihlanganyela, sihlanganyela, sibe neqhaza. Ngiyabonga, ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu okukhuluma khona, kudinga ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula, sithinte imiphakathi yethu. Ngabe sikhumbula ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezilungile? Lokhu kudinga ukuba sihamba phambili, sizame, sithumele izinsiza, futhi sibe neqhaza. Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukubambisana. Ngabe uyavuma? Izikhukhula zikhombisa ubunzima, kodwa zifundisa nathi. Hamba kahle, futhi ngiyabonga kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithumele izinsiza, sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile. Ngabe uzobamba iqhaza? Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibopho, sithumele izinsiza, futhi sibe neqhaza. Ngiyabonga!
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhaliswe kuleli, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano esemthethweni ebhaliswe eNingizimu Afrika ezingafaka isicelo sokudla kwezilwane nezithako. Ukudla kwezilwane akuhlanganisi i-hay, straw, ne-chaff, utshani obuphansi, silage, nanoma yiziphi izinhlanga zokholo, noma enye ukudla kwezilwane okwenziwe umkhiqizi ukuze kusebenze nezilwane zakhe. Incwadi ehambisana nesicelo kumele ivela kumabhalisi noma kumuntu okhethwe ukuba ummele umabhalisi. Qedela ifomu ngokuphelele, ungabhekiseli ezicelweni ezedlule, ezinombolweni zamakhasi, noma kwezinye izinto. Kungaba ikhophi. Umuntu okhethwe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena okhuluma nenkampani kanye noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu esicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-sertifiketi yokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi ushintsho, noma ngabe sikhulu kangakanani, kuzobhekwa njengokulungiswa. Thumela amafomu esicelo ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuhlinzeka ngamafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzokwehlisa inqubo. Izicelo kumele zibhale ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akudingeki ukuthi amalebula aphrintwe ngalezi zilimi zombili; kumele abhalwe kahle; kulandela ifomethi efanele ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezixhumanisweni zokuphepha; yonke imininingwane kumalebula kumele ihambisane kahle naleyo enikezwe efomini lesicelo. Kungathatha cishe ezinyangeni ezintathu kuya kwezine ukuze ukudla kwezilwane nezokudla kwezilwane ezifuywayo kubhaliswe.
Uhlelo kumele luthunyelwe uma umuntu efika eminyakeni yokuthatha umhlalaphansi futhi efuna ukusebenzisa izinzuzo ezihlanganisiwe ngokwezinhlinzeko zomthetho wokuthatha umhlalaphansi. Le ncwadi yokufaka ingathunyelwa yilungu elifuna ukudlulisa izinzuzo zakhona kusuka kufundeni yomhlalaphansi eyodwa iye kwenye. Igama lomfakisicelo, inombolo yezezimali, isitifiketi sokuzalwa, inombolo yokukhombisa, noma enye inombolo ehlukile, uhlobo lwe-oda oluceliwe, isizathu sokucela i-oda yezezimali, ikheli lokuhlala, kanye nekhowudi yeposi yomfakisicelo, kanye nekheli leposi kanye nekhowudi yeposi yomqashi, kanye nemali yonyaka yomfakisicelo kumele kuhanjiswe. Uma inombolo yokubhekisela kwezezimali inganikiwe, nikeza izizathu zokungabhaliswanga. Indlela elula yokufaka isicelo se-oda yezezimali ukwenza lokhu ku-inthanethi kwi-website ye-eFiling. Isicelo sakho se-oda yezezimali ngalendlela ngokuvamile siqinisekiswa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-48. Isicelo se-oda yezezimali ku-inthanethi ngokuvamile siyamukelwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-48. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa.
Imvume yokudoba ngenhloso yokuthengisa ivumela abantu ukuba baye kudoba fish emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze ulethe fish ezivela kwamanye amazwe ukuze uthengise, kufanele ufake isicelo semvume yokungenisa esinikezwa umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma emnyangweni ophakanyisiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungenisa fish ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngaphandle kwale mvume. Faka isicelo semvume entsha uma leyo onayo iphelelwe yisikhathi. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wemvume, imvume yakho ingase ibhujiswe noma iqedwe. Qaphela: Imvume yokudoba emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ayifaki fish edobekile emanzini ahlanzekile. Lezi fish zilawulwa umnyango wezolimo. Izicelo zemvume zokungenisa fish edobekile emanzini ahlanzekile zifakwa kumnyango wezolimo. Lo ngumnyango ophumelele ukunika lezi mvume. I-fish ebhalwe kuMthetho Wokuhweba Ngamazwe Ngamazwe Ngemfuyo Nezimbali Ezisengozini (CITES) ayivunyelwe ukudobeka futhi ilethwe eNingizimu Afrika. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi ngale nhlangano, vakashela ku-http://www.cites.org. Imvume yokungenisa i-abalone, i-rock lobster, kanye ne-fish njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho Wezinsiza Zokuphila Zomhlaba Wamanzi ka-1998 appendix 4, 5, & 12 izosebenza kuphela kumthwalo owodwa. Umthwalo ophelele we-squid ophilayo onesisindo esingu-600g ngasikhathi sinye noma umthwalo ongaphansi kwamathani angama-25 ngonyaka uvunyelwe. Abantu abavunyelwe ukungenisa i-squid ephilayo. Thola ifomu ngokuthumela isicelo ehhovisi eliphethe izindaba zezomhlaba nezokwakha noma ehhovisi lephakanyisiwe lomnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma ulayishe ku-http://www.mcm-deat.gov.za. Funda kahle ifomu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uqedela zonke izidingo zenqubo yesicelo kanye nenani le-fish ozokungenisa. Ikhophi ethunyelwe uphiko lwezepolitiki yemvume yokungenisa evela kumnyango wezohwebo nezimboni noma isaziso semvume. Ikhophi ethunyelwe uphiko lwezepolitiki yesitifiketi sokuthi awunayo imali yokubolekwa ethunyelwe yiMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezimali ZaseNingizimu Afrika. Xhumana nebhange eliseduze leSouth African Bureau of Standards mayelana nomthwalo wakho uma i-fish oyingenisayo ingeyemanzini ahlanzekile noma ingeyokudla kwabantu. Qedela, sign, futhi uthumele ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo ehhovisi eliphethe izindaba zezomhlaba nezokwakha. Faka imibhalo yokuqala; kungenjalo, imvume ngeke ikhishwe. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma yonke imibhalo iphelele. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kucatshangwa nguNgqongqoshe womnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umnyango ophakanyisiwe ngokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali. Izicelo zemvume yokungenisa azitholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lephakanyisiwe lomnyango.
UNovak Djokovic – Umgibeli Ophakeme Kakhulu U- Novak Djokovic, igama elikhanyayo emhlabeni we-tennis, uyinkanyezi yezenhlalo nezemidlalo, futhi ubonakala engumgibeli ophakeme kakhulu emlandweni wezokungcebeleka. Njengoba sibheka izimpumelelo zakhe nezimpikiswano ezimzungezile, kubalulekile ukubona ukuthi ubuchule bakhe buye buphinde baphakanyiswe ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe empilweni, okuyinto eyenza ahluke kwabanye abadlali abavela ezikhathini ezahlukene. U- Djokovic, odabuka eSerbia, uthole izifundo zokulwa nezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nezimpilo zakhe. Kusukela ebuntwaneni, wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa ubephikelela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono akhe. Lokhu kuhlola amakhono akhe, nokuba nesibindi sokubhekana nemiphumela, kuveza isimo esinamandla esihlanganisa ubuchule, ukuphikelela, nokuzimisela. Abaningi bangase bacabange ukuthi umgibeli ophakeme kufanele ube nekhono lokudlala kuphela, kodwa u- Djokovic ubonisa ukuthi ukuphila ngendlela ethile, ukufunda nokukhula, kubalulekile empumelelweni. Emhlabeni we-tennis, u- Djokovic uyinhlangano yokusebenza kanzima. Ubuye abe ngumgibeli ophumelelayo kakhulu, eqhathaniswa noRoger Federer noRafael Nadal. Nokho, impumelelo yakhe ayigcini nje ngama-titles ayishumi nane eGrand Slam, kodwa ibonisa ibhuku lokuphikisana, impilo yokusebenza, kanye nemizamo yokwakha umphakathi. U- Djokovic unamaqiniso akhe, abuye abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezokwelapha kanye nezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kuhambisana nokwaziswa komphakathi, okubonisa ukuthi umphakathi nokuphila kahle kubalulekile. Nokho, u- Djokovic akagcini nje ngokuba umgibeli ophumelelayo. Ubuye abe nomthelela ophathelene nezinkinga ezinzima, ezifana nezinkinga zokwelashwa. Izinqumo zakhe zikhombisa ukuthi ungumuntu ophikisana nezinkolelo ezijwayelekile, futhi ubeka phambili izinkolelo zakhe. Lokhu kwenze abanye bamhleke, kanti abanye baphinde bamsize, bayabona ukuthi u- Djokovic ungumuntu ophakathi kokuphikisana nokuphumelelayo. Ingabe lokho kumenza ahluke kwabanye? U- Djokovic ubonisa izici ezinhle zokuba ngumholi, nokuhleleka okuhle kokuphila. Ubuye abe nesimo esiqinile sokumelwa kwabantu abakhuluma ngempumelelo, noma ngabe kungenzeka kubaluleke kakhulu kumuntu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi impilo ayiweli kuphela emikhawulweni yezezimali, kodwa ikhuluma ngezifiso, izinkolelo, kanye nezinto ezibalulekile empilweni. Isimo sika- Djokovic sisesimweni sokuba ngumsebenzi ohlanganyela nabanye. Ubuye abe nomthelela ophathelene nezempilo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ungumgibeli osebenza ngokuhlanganyela nempilo yabanye. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi udinga abantu abanjengaye, abazimisele ukusiza abanye, nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. U- Djokovic uyisibonelo sokuthi impumelelo ayigcini kuphela kumuntu oyedwa, kodwa ibalulekile emndenini nasemphakathini. Njengoba siqhubeka nokubheka u- Djokovic, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lwezemidlalo luhlanganisa izici eziningi. Ubuye abe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqumo eziphusile, okukhombisa ukuthi akafuni kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa ufunela abantu abaninzi impilo engcono. Lokhu kungenza abanye bakhumbule ukuthi umgibeli ophakeme akufanele ukuba yedwa, kodwa kufanele abe nelungelo lokuphila ngekhanda eliphezulu, alwe nezinkinga, futhi abekezelele izimfuno zempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela ka- Djokovic uzohlala ungena emlandweni. Ubonisa ukuthi umuntu angaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, noma ngabe umphakathi ukhathazekile. U- Djokovic akagcini nje ngokuba ngumgibeli ophumelelayo, kodwa ubonisa ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinkolelo eziqinile, sibe nemigomo emihle, futhi sisebenze ukuze sifeze izifiso zethu. Ekugcineni, uNovak Djokovic ungumgibeli ophakeme, owaziwa ngezimpumelelo zakhe, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, ubonisa indlela yokuphila edinga ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela, ukuzibophezela, kanye nemigomo ethile. Njengabantu, kufanele sifunde ku- Djokovic, siqonde ukuthi impumelelo ayikhawulwanga kweminye imikhakha, kodwa ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu, empilweni yabanye, kanye nasemphakathini. Uziqhenyise, u- Djokovic, njengoba ukhombisa ukuthi ubungcweti, ukuzikhandla, kanye nesibindi sokuphikisana, kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela.
Lo mthetho uhlose ukuthuthukisa futhi wenze ukuhamba komphakathi kube yimpumelelo kubagibeli eGauteng. Uhloswe ukudala uhlelo oluhlonipha amalungelo abantu abasebenza ezokuthutha zomphakathi; nokukhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane, ikakhulukazi lawo amancane kakhulu, kanye nabaphathi abaphucukile ngenxa yokucwaswa okwakukhona esikhathini esedlule. Lo Mthetho ufaka esikhundleni iSahluko 3 seMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke ngokwezimiso ezitholakala kule Mthetho. Abasebenzisi babhekene nezindleko zokuhamba ezikhokhwa ngabagibeli, futhi lapho abagibeli bekhokha imali encishisiwe, futhi lapho umphathi wesivumelwano evuselela isivumelwano nomsebenzisi; futhi lapho labo abasebenza ezokuthutha bengatholi uxhaso noma usizo lwezimali kunoma yiliphi ilungu noma ingxenye yohulumeni, ngakho-ke ngokwalolu hlaka, ukuvuselelwa okwenziwe kulabo abasebenza ezokuthutha ngokusekelwe ezindlekweni ezikhokhwayo ngeke kubhekwane njengoxhaso noma enye indlela yokusiza kwezimali. Izinhlelo kumele ziphakanyiswe ukuze kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwezindlela, ukuthutha okutholakala kalula kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile, ukushintsha nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kanye nabantu abathole amathuba alinganiselwe ngenxa yokucwaswa okungafanele. Kumele babe nezimvume ezifanele, izitifiketi zokusebenza, noma igunya lesikhashana; futhi kumele babhaliswe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho mayelana nezimoto ze-taxi, ama-taxi akhokhelwayo, amabhasi, kanye nezimoto zokuzijabulisa ngokwezigaba 69, 77, kanye no-81. Inhlangano ayikwazi ukuba nezitifiketi zokusebenza noma imvume. Noma iyiphi imoto ingathola kuphela isitifiketi sokusebenza esisodwa. Ukuthutha abantu emhlanganweni wokwabelana ngezithuthi, lapho amalungu ehlangana ukuze wabelane ngezithuthi noma ahlele ukwabelana ngezithuthi nabanye amalungu noma labo abaqokwe ngabo ukuya nokuqhubeka ezindaweni ezithile ngenhloso ethile futhi lapho kungekho uhlelo noma noma iyiphi indlela yokukhokha yokwabelana ngezithuthi. Bangaba abashayeli; futhi kumele bazi kahle indawo abahamba kuyo. Isigaba 1 ngeke sibe khona kubaphathi abasebenza lapho kucacile ukuthi akuhambisani. I-MEC ingakha imithetho yokuthi bonke abashayeli bezimoto zokuthutha zomphakathi kumele baqeqeshwe ngento ethile. Ummeleli wehhovisi angacela ummangali wesitifiketi ukuthi athumele imoto ukuze ibuyekezwe uma becabanga ukuthi ayifanele ukuhamba, noma ngabe le moto yayine sitifiketi esivumelekile sokuba emgwaqweni; futhi bangaphika ukukhipha isitifiketi sokusebenza uma bebona ukuthi imoto ayifanele ukuhamba. Izimoto ezisetshenziselwa ukuthutha komphakathi kumele zishiye isizinda zihlanzekile, ngaphakathi nangaphandle, ngokwezimiso eziholwa, uma kukhona isivumelwano, njengoba kuchaziwe esivumelwaneni. Ngokwemiqondo yeMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke, izimoto ezisetshenziselwa ukuthutha komphakathi kumele zibe sesimweni esihle ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Imoto esebenza ukuthutha abagibeli bomphakathi kumele ibe ne-fire extinguisher esebenzayo okungenani eyodwa kanye ne-first aid kit enezinto zayo. I-fire extinguisher kanye ne-first aid kit kumele zibekwe noma zifakwe ngendlela ethile nendawo ethile emotweni, futhi ama-fire extinguishers kumele ashintshwe ngezikhathi ezifanele. Izinsizakalo zokuzijabulisa kumele zihlale zifakwe njengoba kukhonjisiwe esigabeni 16. Izigaba zezinsizakalo ezibhalwe esigabeni 1 mayelana nemithetho ekhombisa esigabeni 3 esikhathini esizayo zikhonjiswe esikhathini B, kanti lezo zokushintsha isikhathi zikhonjiswe esikhathini C. Imoto kumele ikhombe ukuthi iyitaxi ngendlela echaziwe. Ibhodi ingabeka imali ephezulu noma ephansi yokuhamba kwama-taxi akhokhelwayo okufanele ikhokhwe kumgibeli. I-taxi ayikwazi ukuthwala umuntu; noma kumele ikwenze ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano esivunywe yiBhodi. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, i-taxi ekhokhelwayo ingasebenza ngentengo engakhonjiswa kumitha uma intengo yokuhamba ethile ivunyelwe ngaphambi kokuhamba. Izimoto ze-taxi zingasebenzisa kuphela izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ukuze zisebenze. Isitifiketi sokusebenza esikhiphwe se-taxi kumele sikhombise ukuthi ukusebenza kwaleyo taxi kulandela indlela noma imephu, ngaphandle uma isimo esihlukile sivunyelwe ngalo Mthetho. Mayelana namabhasi noma ama-train, iBhodi inganciphisa ukusebenza kwesitifiketi ezindaweni ezithile noma ezindaweni. Amabhasi kumele ahlelwe ukuze asebenze ezindaweni ezithile noma ezindleleni ezithile ngokukhokha intengo ekhombisiwe futhi asebenze ngezikhathi ezihlelwe, ezidinga uxhaso, kumele kuvunywe ngombuso ophakela uxhaso. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuthutha abafundi besikole, abafundi bezifundo eziphakeme, abafundi abadala, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi phakathi kwezindawo zabo zokuhlala nezikhungo zemfundo, kodwa kungabandakanya ukuhamba okungahlelwanga ezikhungweni zemfundo uma lezi zinhlelo zixhumene kuphela nezindaba zemfundo. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kungasebenzisa izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, amabhasi ajwayelekile, amabhasi okushuttle, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ngenhloso ethile. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka ngesicelo sokwabelana, ukuvuselela, ukushintsha, noma ukudlulisa isitifiketi sokusebenza sokuthutha kwezemfundo, iBhodi kumele ithumele isicelo esikoleni esithintekayo noma kwezinye izikhungo zemfundo ukuze izwe imibono yabo noma iziphakamiso ngendlela echaziwe, futhi kumele ibheke lezi zibonelo noma iziphakamiso ezitholiwe. Ukuthutha kwabavakashi kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuze kube lula ukuhamba kwabavakashi lapho izivakashi ziqhutshwa ngumhlahlandlela obhalisiwe ngokwezigaba 21 zeMthetho Wokuvakasha. Akukho sitifiketi esivumela ukusebenza kokuthutha kwabavakashi esingakhiphwa ngaphandle uma iBhodi ithole futhi ihlinzeke ngeziphakamiso ezivela kumphakathi wezokuthutha ngokuvumelana ne-MEC, kodwa iBhodi ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu kuziphakamiso lapho umphakathi ungakhiphi iziphakamiso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe esicelweni seBhodi. Ekukhipheni isitifiketi sokusebenza kwabavakashi, iBhodi ingabeka izimo zokuthi imoto kumele ibe nepolisi, izinhlelo zokwakha umculo noma imiyalezo, amathuluzi okupheka, kanye nanoma yini enye engase ibekwe yiBhodi, noma izindawo zokuphumula lapho uhambo ludlula kumakhilomitha angama-200, noma ezinye izimo. Ibhodi ingabeka inani eliphezulu labagibeli abakwazi ukuthwala imoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha kwabavakashi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi usayizi wemoto udlula lelo nani elichaziwe. Uma kudingeka, iBhodi inganikeza izindawo ezithile noma izindlela zokusebenza kokuthutha kwabavakashi. Umshayeli wemoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha kwabavakashi kumele ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho lezi zinsizakalo zisebenza ahlale ehambisana nemigomo ebekwe umthetho wezokuthutha njengoba kuchaziwe.
