Izilwane nezitshalo eziyingozi zingancishiswa ngokuhlanza. Ngokuwasha nokuhlunga: Hlanza izithelo nezitshalo uma kungenzeka ukuze unciphise uthuli, amabhaktheriya, nezibulala-zinambuzane. Phonsa phansi amaqabunga angaphandle ezithelo aneziqabunga. Hlanza amafutha enyama kanye nesikhumba sezinhlanzi ngoba ezinye izinsalela zezinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalo ziqoqeka lapho nasemafutheni. Ukuhlunga kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zibe zidle. Ukupheka kusiza: Ukupheka kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezinsalela zezinambuzane ekudleni ngokuhlanza nokuhlunga. Uhlobo lokudla: Dla uhlobo lokudla oluhlukahlukene oluvela emithonjeni ehlukene. Ezinye izinsalela zezinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi zisetshenziswa ezitshalweni ezithile. Ukudla uhlobo lokudla oluhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zokudla kuyindlela enempilo. Lokhu kuvikela ukudla ekubeni nezinto eziyingozi zohlobo oluthile noma izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zibe khona. Inani lezinsalela zezinambuzane ezisetshenziswa ekudleni kanye nezinsalela zazo ezidingekayo ukuba zibe khona emikhiqizweni emakethe kulawulwa yizimiso ezahlukene futhi kulawulwa yiMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wezolimo ngokwehlukana. Imikhiqizo eminingi yasekhaya iqukethe izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi. Amafungicides; izibulala-zinambuzane ezithile nezibulala-zinambuzane, njengokubulala izihlahla; kemikhakha ethile esetshenziswa emanzini okubhukuda. Izinsalela zezinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi ezihloselwe izinto eziphilayo, njengokukhiqizwa kwezinambuzane zokubulala izilwane noma izitshalo eziyingozi, ziyaqapheleka kakhulu futhi zivame ukuba ziphephile kunezinsalela zezinambuzane ezijwayelekile noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Izinsalela zezinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi ekudleni. Yini izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Izinsalela zezinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi yizinto ezihloselwe ukuvikela, ukubulala, ukuheha, ukuvimbela, noma ukulawula noma yiziphi izinhlobo zezinambuzane ezilimazayo, kuhlanganise nezinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane ezingase zingabi khona ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza; ukuze zisetshenziswe ekuthumeleni; ukuze zisetshenziswe ekwabeleni nasekudleni; ukuze zisetshenziswe emikhiqizweni yezolimo; noma ukuze zisetshenziswe ekudleni kwezilwane noma noma yini enikezwa ezilwaneni ukuvimbela izinto eziyingozi ekungeni kwezinye izinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezinto ezihloselwe ukusetshenziswa njengokulawula ukukhula kwezilwane; njengokubulala amaqabunga; njengokuthambisa; njengokunciphisa izithelo noma njengokuvimbela ukukhula nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa ezitshalweni ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuvuna ukuvikela umkhiqizo ekuphukeni ngesikhathi sokugcina noma sokuhamba. Yini izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Lokhu kuyinto ethile ekudleni; emikhiqizweni yezolimo noma ekudleni kwezilwane okuvela ekusetshenzisweni kwezinsalela zezinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Le misho iphinde ifake noma yiziphi izinto ezivela ezinsaleni zezinambuzane kanye nokungcoliswa kwezinto eziyingozi nokungcoliswa okucatshangwa ukuthi kubalulekile ocwaningweni lwezinto eziyingozi. Zingena kanjani izinsalela zezinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi ekudleni? Kukho ukungabazeki kokubuyiselwa kokuhlola izinsalela zezinambuzane eziyingozi ezisetshenziswa ekukhiqizeni ukudla ukuthi lezi zinto zingahlala emikhiqizweni efana nezithelo nezitshalo ngisho nangemva kokucutshungulwa. Zisetshenziswa kanjani izinsalela zezinambuzane? Zisetshenziswa ngoba zinezinzuzo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo nasekudleni kwazo. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zinto, abalimi bangakhulisa imizamo yabo ezindaweni zokulima ngenkathi behlisa izindleko zokukhiqiza kumthengi. Ubudlelwano bokudla bunokuxhumana okuningi futhi buhlanganisa zonke izigaba zenqubo yokukhiqiza, kusukela ekusebenziseni izikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo nezinga eliphansi lokukhiqiza kuya ekusebenziseni lokho kudla. Ukudla kungaba umphakeli obalulekile wezinto ezibangela izifo, njengamazinyoni amancane abanga nezifo kanye nezinto ezibangela izifo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla kudinga ukuhlela nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bonke kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokudla. Ukuphepha kokudla kuqala kubahlinzeki bezikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo kubalimi nakubantu abathintekayo ekukhiqizeni ukudla, njengoba izinto ezifana nezinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi nezinto eziphilayo (ezokwelapha) zinezingozi ezahlukene, ngakho-ke kudinga ukunakwa okucophelela. Ukudla kwezilwane okuqukethe (okubangela) izifo, kuhlanganise namabhaktheriya nezinto eziyingozi, kungase kube nezingozi ezithile. Njengoba izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi zinezinhloso eziningi, zingavulwa ngezindlela eziningi.
Ukusebenza Ekhaya: Izinguquko Eziyinselele Nezizathu Zokuphumelela Ngemva kokuphuma komthelela weCOVID-19, ukusebenza ekhaya sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezimpilweni zabantu abaningi. Lokhu kuholele ekuguquleni indlela amahhovisi asebenza ngayo, kwenza kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emsebenzini nasempilweni yomuntu. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nezixazululo ezihambisana nokusebenza ekhaya. Izizathu Zokusebenza Ekhaya Okokuqala, ukusebenza ekhaya kulethe izinzuzo eziningi. Abantu abaningi bathola ukuthi lokhu kwehlisa izindleko zokuhamba, ukugqoka, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezindawo zokusebenza. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba baphinde basebenzise lezi zinsiza ukuze bathuthukise izinga labo lempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kubavumela ukuba bahlale besondelene nemindeni yabo, okukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuqinile. Izinselelo Zokusebenza Ekhaya Nokho, ukusebenza ekhaya akuphelelanga ezinzuzweni. Kukhona nezinselelo, njengokungabi nekhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kwesikhathi somsebenzi nesikhathi sokuphumula. Abantu abaningi bahlala benesithukuthezi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ibhalansi phakathi komsebenzi nomndeni. Futhi, ukungabi nezinselelo ezithile ezihlobene nokuxhumana nabanye abasebenzi kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bephoxekile. Izixazululo Zokuphumelela Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ukuhlela isikhathi sokusebenza nokuphumula kubalulekile ukuze kwakhe umkhuba ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlela izikhathi zokuxhumana, kungaba ngezingxoxo zevidiyo noma izithangami, kungasiza ekwakheni umuzwa wokuxhumana. Ubuchwepheshe Obusiza Ekusebenzeni Ekhaya Ubuchwepheshe buye baba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela kokusebenza ekhaya. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana neZoom, Microsoft Teams, neSlack zikhulise ukuhamba kwemiyalezo, zenza kube lula ukuxhumana. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokusebenza ngokubambisana, nakuba abantu besebenza ezindaweni ezihlukene. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka kahle. Ukubheka Okwamanje Nokuqhubekayo Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukusebenza ekhaya kungase kube yindlela yokuphila esikhathini esizayo. Izinkampani eziningi ziqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela zokwenza lokhu kube yinto ejwayelekile, okudingeka ukuthi abantu baqhubeke bethuthukisa amakhono abo. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi baqhubeke bejolisa ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zabo zokusebenza. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukusebenza ekhaya kube yindlela ewusizo yokwenza umsebenzi, kodwa kuza nezinselelo zakhona. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nalokhu ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuhlela kahle, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, abantu bangathokozisa izinzuzo zokusebenza ekhaya. Njengoba sithokozisa lezi zinguquko, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokufunda nokuthuthukisa ukuze sihlangabezane nezinselelo ezizayo.
Le mhlahlandlela ubhalwe ukuze ubhekane nezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yalo ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo yeMthetho ngezindlela ezilula kubabambiqhaza emkhakheni wezempilo nokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika. Ichaza indima yabalawuli bezempilo nokuphepha (OHS) boMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Imisebenzi namalungelo abasebenzi, njengoba kuhlelwe nguMthetho, kuboniswa ngokuphelele. Imisebenzi nezibopho zabaphathi, abakhiqizi bezimpahla ezithile, abaklami, abangenisi bezimpahla ezivela kwamanye amazwe, abahlinzeki, nabathengisi kugcizelelwa. Ekugcineni, izindima zalabo abamele izempilo nokuphepha kanye nezinkomiti zicaciswa. Igunya ngalinye eliyinhloko lizokwenza, ngokwanele, ukuthi imisebenzi yabaphathi bayo, njengoba kuboniswe kulo Mthetho, yenziwe kahle. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 udinga ukuthi umphathi aqinisekise futhi agcine, ngokwanele, indawo yokusebenza ephephile futhi engaphazamisi impilo yabasebenzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umphathi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ikhululekile ezinsongweni, ezifana nezinto ezikhemikhali, i-chlorine, nezinto eziyingozi, izinto ezithile, imishini, izinqubo, njll., ezingadala ukulimala noma ukugula. Uma lokhu kungasebenzi, umphathi kufanele azise abasebenzi ngalezi zinsongo, ukuthi zingavikelwa kanjani, nokuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngokuphepha, futhi banikeze ezinye izindlela zokwakha indawo yokusebenza ephephile. Nokho, akulindelekile ukuthi umphathi abeke umthwalo wezempilo nokuphepha yedwa. Umthetho ususelwa emgomeni wokuthi izinsongo zendawo yokusebenza kufanele zibhekwane ngokuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi. Abasebenzi nabaphathi kufanele babelane ngomsindo wemithwalo wezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Bobabili kufanele balindele izinsongo futhi bakhe izinyathelo zokulawula ukuze benze indawo yokusebenza iphephile. Ngale ndlela, abaphathi nabasebenzi babandakanyeka ohlelweni lapho abamele izempilo nokuphepha bengabheka njalo indawo yokusebenza futhi babike enkomeni yezempilo nokuphepha, engase ibeke iziphakamiso kumphathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lolu hlelo lusebenza kahle, wonke umphakathi kufanele wazi amalungelo nezibopho zabo njengoba ziqukethwe emthethweni. Umthetho, owaziwa ngokuthi Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 (Umthetho 85 ka-1993), uqukethe izingxenye eziyi-50 ezivunyelwe yiPhalamende. Inhloso yoMthetho ukuhlinzeka ngezempilo nokuphepha kwabantu emsebenzini noma mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwemishini. Iphinde ihlinzeke ngokuvikelwa kwabantu abangabantu abasebenzi ezinsongweni ezivela noma ezihlobene nezisebenzi. Imithetho ehlukene ephathelene nezihloko ezithile iyashicilelwa ngezikhathi ezithile nguMnyango Wezabasebenzi ngokuhambisana noMthetho. Umthetho kanye Nezikhumbuzo zingathengwa kwiHhovisi Lezokuphrinta Lezizwe ngendlela yeGazethi noma ngendlela ehlanganisiwe kubashicileli abahlukene. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi uphethwe yiSikhungo Esiphezulu Sezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi boMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi, amahhovisi ezifundazwe asekelwe kuzo zonke izifundazwe. Ukuze kube lula lokhu, abahloli bezempilo nokuphepha baphumelele ukuhlole nokuhlola ezindaweni zokusebenza. Umhloli ovela kuMnyango Wezabasebenzi, ngesikhathi sokuhlola, uthole isilinda segesi silengiswa phansi esikhundleni sokuba siqinisekiswe odongeni noma esikhwameni. Ukuhlolwa kuvame ukuhlela ngenxa yezizathu zezibalo mayelana nezinsongo, ubukhona bezinto eziyingozi, ezifana nokusetshenziswa kwezinto ezikhemikhali ezindaweni zokuwasha, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini eyingozi endaweni yokusebenza. Ukuhlolwa okwenziwayo kungase kube okungazisiwe, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kungase kube ngenxa yezicelo noma izikhalazo ezenziwe ngabasebenzi, abaphathi, noma amalungu omphakathi. Lezi zikhalazo noma izicelo zicutshungulwa njengezizimele. Uma kwenzeka insongo engase ibe khona, umhloli angavimbela isenzo esithile, inqubo, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini noma amathuluzi ngokukhishwa kwesaziso sokuvimbela. Akekho okufanele aphuthelwe okuqukethwe kwalesi saziso, futhi ukwenziwa kwaso kufanele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokulibazisa. Uma umthetho ophathelene nezimfuneko uphulwa, umhloli angakhishwa isaziso sokuphulwa kubasebenzi noma kumphathi. Ukuphulwa komthetho kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhlasela okuphuthumayo, kodwa uma umthetho ophathelene nezimfuneko uphulwa, umphathi anganikezwa ithuba lokulungisa ukuphulwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile esivame ukusethwa ezinsukwini eziyi-60. Uma izinyathelo zezempilo nokuphepha ezibekwe ngumphathi zivikela kahle impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi, umhloli angacela umphathi ukuthi enze izinyathelo ezengeziwe ezisebenzayo. Umphathi uzothola isaziso sokuthuthukisa esichaza izinyathelo zokulungisa. Abahloli boMnyango bahlola ukuwa kwephondo leCoega lapho abantu ababili bafa futhi abangu-23 balimala. Ukuze kusizakale umhloli ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo, bangangena kunoma iyiphi indawo yokusebenza noma kunoma iyiphi indawo lapho imishini nezinto eziyingozi zisetshenziswa khona futhi bacele imibuzo noma balethe amasampula ukuze abantu bahlangane nabo. Umhloli angaphinde acela ukuthi noma yiziphi imibhalo ilethwe kubo, ahlole, enze amakhophi ale mibhalo, futhi afune ukucaciselwa nganoma yini ebhalwe kule mibhalo. Umhloli angahlola noma yisiphi isimo noma into futhi athathe amasampula, futhi angasebenza njengofakazi. Qaphela: Amandla abahloli akhulunywe ngenhla awaphelele. Noma ubani ophikisana nanoma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe ngumhloli angafaka isikhalazo ngalokho isinqumo ngokubhala kuMhloli Omkhulu, Izempilo Nokuphepha, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, Private Bag X117, Pretoria, 0001. Umphathi kufanele enze ini ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile futhi ayinayo insongo empilweni yabasebenzi bawo? Umphathi kufanele ahlinzeke futhi agcine kahle zonke izinto ezidingekayo ukuze enze umsebenzi, kanye nazo zonke izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ngendlela engathinti kabi impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokuthi kusebenze imishini yokuvikela, umphathi kufanele kuqala azame ukususa noma ukunciphisa noma yisiphi isingo empilweni nokuphepha kwabasebenzi bawo. Imishini yokuvikela kufanele isetshenziswe uma ingenakugwenywa. Umphathi kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokuvikela impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi bawo ezinsongweni ezingase zivele ekukhiqizeni, ekusetshenzisweni, ekuphathweni, ekugcinweni, noma ekuthuthweni kwezinto ezithile, ngamagama, noma yini abangase bahlangabezane nayo emsebenzini. Kumele bahlinzeke ngemininingwane, imiyalelo, ukuqeqeshwa, nokubhekelela okudingekayo ngenkathi begcina engqondweni izinga lobuchwepheshe babasebenzi. Lo msebenzi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izinyathelo zokuvikela zisebenza futhi zigcinwa. Izingubo zokuvikela zifakwa kuphela ngabantu ababili kanti omunye
Umbhalo wesiNgisi uyisiqondiso esisemthethweni seGas Policy Framework... Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa okuhlelekile kwenkampani ye-gas pipeline; ukusungula isakhiwo sikazwelonke; ukuqoka uMphathi weGas Policy ezingeni likazwelonke njengesikhumbuzo somthetho wezokwakha ezingeni likazwelonke; nokubheka ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Amandla angabekwa lapha ahlobene nalawo mandla akhonjiswe nguMphathi weGas Policy mayelana nokuguqulwa kube igesi, ukuvuselelwa kwegesi, ukuhamba, ukugcina, noma ukusabalalisa okungadingi ukuhambisana nezidingo ezisemqoka zalesi sivumelwano. Futhi ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kwegesi ngendlela elula nephumelelayo. Ukusabalalisa, ukucubungula igesi, nokuvuselela igesi; kanye nokuhweba ngegesi. UMphathi weGas Policy unabasebenzi abahlanu abaqokwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umongameli ukhethwa phakathi kwabaphathi be-gas ngokuhambisana nesigaba. Uma ngasiphi isizathu umongameli engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, abanye amalungu kumele akhethe omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuze asebenze esikhundleni somongameli kuze kube umongameli ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe noma kuze kube nguNgqongqoshe eqoka omunye umongameli. Ilungu leGas Policy Director lisebenza isikhathi esiyiminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda aqoke ilungu. Amalungu eGas Policy Director kumele akhokhelwe ngezinsizakalo zawo futhi athole izikhwama njengabaphathi be-gas ngokuvuma kukaNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Ngaphambi kokuba aqoke amalungu kuGas Policy Director, uNgqongqoshe kumele, ngokuqwashisa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, acela amagama kubalungu bomphakathi. Ukusabalalisa, ukugcina, ukuhamba, ukucubungula igesi, noma ukuhweba ngegesi, noma ukuba nentshisekelo ethile kunoma iyiphi inkampani; futhi kumele azise uNgqongqoshe kanye noMphathi weGas Policy uma le ntshisekelo ishintsha. Ilungu akumele libe khona nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho izindaba zixoxwa, noma izinqumo zenziwa, noma libe neqhaza kunoma yisiphi isimo seGas Policy Directorate lapho leli lungu noma umlingani walo, ingane, umlingani wezohwebo, noma umqashi, ngaphandle kweState, enentshisekelo. Noma kungase kudingeke ukuthi kuxoshwe ilungu ngenxa yezizathu ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 6 seGas Policy uma benza okuphikisana nesigaba 9. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele abe nemihlangano ngezikhathi ezibekwe ngumongameli. UMphathi weGas Policy njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi ofanele wenziwa. Ukuze uthole lesi sicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi kube nenqubo ebekiwe, umongameli wanoma imihlangano yeGas Policy Director kumele abeke inqubo ezolandelwa kulolo suku. I-Gas Policy Director ihlanganisa amalungu amaningi. Isinqumo senqwaba yamalungu akhona emhlanganweni yisinqumo seGas Policy Director. Kuyinqwaba elula phezulu kwalokho okujwayelekile. Isinqumo uma abanye amalungu bekhona emhlanganweni futhi benelungelo lokuhlanganyela nokuvota, futhi isinqumo kumele sithathwe futhi ngaphezu kwenqwaba yamalungu akhona anelungelo lokuvota. Umongameli kumele abe khona kuwo wonke emihlanganweni yeGas Policy Director futhi unelungelo lokuphendula, kodwa hhayi lokuvota, kulawo mhlanganweni. I-Gas Policy ivulelekile emphakathini ngaphandle kokuthi kube nolwazi oluyimfihlo, olunamalungelo okuphatha mayelana nezohwebo, lowo muntu ophakathi kumele akhombise uMphathi weGas Policy ukuthi kungani lelo lwazi lungafanele lwenziwe emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy wokuqala ngemuva kokuba eqokwe. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqinisekise ukuthi irekhodi lezo zonke izinqubo ezikhona ligcinwa. Ngokuqondile noma ngokuqondile; futhi abaphathi bezikhungo zomphakathi kumele baziphathe ngendlela efanele futhi njengoba kulindelekile. Kumele kubhalwe phansi; futhi kuchazwe kahle nangokunembile, nomthetho nezizathu zawo. Noma yisiphi isinqumo seGas Policy Director nezizathu zaso kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqoke umphathi omkhulu weGas Policy Director. Ukuze aphathe izindaba zeGas Policy Director; futhi aphathe ukuphathwa kwabo bonke abasebenzi abaqashwe ngasikhathi. Obani, ukuze basize ekusebenzeni kweGas Policy Director. Nakuba kunezihloko 1 no-3, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha ukuthi uMphathi weGas Policy angaqasha noma asebenzise abasebenzi ngokuvumelana nezinye iziphathimandla zokwazisa ngaphansi kwamandla kaNgqongqoshe. Isigaba 9 sithinta noma iliphi ilungu lezakhamuzi zeGas Policy Director, ushintsho lusekelwe esimweni esikhona. Imibhalo yezezimali yeGas Policy Director kumele ihlolwe nguMphakathi wezeMali. Mayelana nezempilo nokuphepha embonini; kanye nezinye izindaba ezithathwa nguMphathi weGas Policy njengokubalulekile. Obani abangase basebenze ekuhambahambeni, ukugcina, ukusabalalisa igesi, ukuyicubungula, kanye nokuvuselela igesi; noma ukuhweba ngegesi. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi okukhulunywe ngawo kuSheduli 1 awudingi isicelo sokungena kulowo msebenzi, kodwa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywe ngakho ezihlokweni 1 no-2 zalesi Sheduli kumele abhalise umsebenzi wabo njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 28. Bangazisa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okudinga ilayisensi ngaphansi kwesigaba ukuthi kumele stop ukwenziwa kwalowo msebenzi. Akukho lutho kule Mthetho olivimba umuntu ukuthi axoxisane ngenhloso yokwakha, ukuguqula izakhiwo, umsebenzi wegesi, ukuwusebenzisa, noma ukuhweba okuhlosiwe ukuze axoxisane noMphathi weGas Policy ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo se-licence. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 29, anikeze umuntu obhekwa ngesigaba (a) ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze afake isicelo. Noma ubani ofanele ukufaka isicelo se-licence ngaphansi kwesigaba 10 kuya ku-15 kumele ayifake ngendlela ebekiwe nangendlela. Ngalolu lwazi oludingekayo mayelana negesi ezobe ihweba ngaphansi kwelayisensi; kanye nolunye ulwazi olungase ludingeke. Umfaki-sicelo angacela ukuthi ulwazi luphathwe ngasese mayelana nokuthinteka kwezomnotho esicelweni futhi, ngokuvumelana nezivumelwano noMphathi weGas Policy, lelo lwazi lingakhululwa ezikopini zesicelo ezithunyelwa emphakathini. Umuntu kumele uphume isikhumbuzo sokufaka isicelo kwabo okungenani ezincwadini ezimbili endaweni abafuna ukusebenza kuyo, ezilimini ezimbili ezisemthethweni (eyodwa yazo kumele ibe isiNgisi). Ikheli leGas Policy Director lapho izikhalazo zokufaka isicelo zingathunyelwa; futhi ukuthi izikhalazo zokufaka isicelo kumele zibe neziqu eziphakanyisiwe noma isitatimende esiphakanyisiwe. Uma kungatholakali zikhala zokufaka isicelo; noma ngemuva kokuthola impendulo kumfaki-sicelo mayelana nezikhalazo ezikhulunywe esigabeni 18c. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuthuthukiswa kwesifunda; noma nganoma iyiphi inhloso yomphakathi. Ukuze kusebenze ekuthuthumeni kwegesi, ukugcina, nokusabalalisa; futhi ukuhweba ngegesi. Akukho ingxenye yale ndatshana engaphindwa noma idluliselwe nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngaphezu kwemithombo ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhalwe kahle. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kunoma ubani ofuna ukuba nguchwepheshe bezomthetho futhi ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukuze usebenzise le thuluzi kahle nangokwanelisayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu abe nolwazi ngamagama athile abalulekile asetshenziswa njalo ngababhali bezomthetho eMthethweni Wobufakazi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuhlela nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukuqaphela nokuzijwayeza nale magama abalulekile asetshenziswa eMthethweni Wobufakazi futhi ukubanika ulwazi olufushane oluwasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene neMthethweni Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olunikezwa phambi kwenkantolo ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi inkantolo ikwazi ukwenza isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi obubalulekile buhlinzeka ngazo zonke izinkcukacha nezinto ezingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. Umthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimo kanye nokulawulwa kokuthi izimo zethulwa kanjani ngendlela ethembekile. Iziqephu zingethulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibalulekile. Umfanekiso olandelayo ukhombisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezigaba zomthetho; ukhombisa ukuthi iMthethweni Wobufakazi ihlangana kanjani nezigaba, incazelo yeMthethweni Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyakha ubufakazi obubalulekile nokuthi yini equkethwe. Iphikiso elethulwa yisimo kanye neqembu lokuvikela alibhekwa njengobufakazi kodwa liyisithako esisiza enqubweni yokwenza isinqumo. Le mbono yakhiwa ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihloselwe ukugcizelela isimo somthetho noma izimo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukuze ithonya ukucabangela kwenkantolo uma ikhipha isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi isinqumo sithathwe, amaqembu anethuba lokwethula iphikiso lokugcina elihlobene nobufakazi obunikezwe kuleli cala eliqhubekayo. Iziqephu zecala yilezo ezethulwe yiphathi ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi ukuze winwe leli cala. Iziqephu zivame ukuhambisa ubufakazi noma ukuziphikisa. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihlobene nobudlelwano bobaba, ubuhlanga bababa buzoba yindaba ezoxoxwa, futhi ubudlelwano bezocansi nobaba kuzoba iphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobudlelwano bobaba. Ubufakazi obuqinisekisayo buchaza ubufakazi obuqinile noma ukuthi akukho okungcono kunobufakazi obukhona. Ubufakazi obuphikiswa buchaza ukuthi kukhona okungcono noma ukuthi bekukhona. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ibhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinisekisayo, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti athathwa njengobufakazi obuphikiswa. Igama elithi "prima facie" liyisisho sesiLatini esisho "ngokokuqala." Isisho esithi ubufakazi obucacile emthethweni sisho ukuthi ubufakazi obunikezwe phambi kwenkantolo bufanele ukusungula isimo noma icala ngaphandle kokuthi kube nobufakazi obuphikisana. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisana, ubufakazi obucacile luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, ubufakazi bungakhombisa ukuthi u-A wayenombono wokubulala u-B futhi wabonwa ephuma endlini ka-B enekhefu elibomvu. U-X ubonisa ukuthi wezwa ingilazi iphuka futhi waphendukela ukubona u-Y emi phambi kwefasitela eliphukile lika-Z, lapho u-Y ebambe itshe esandleni sakhe. Ubufakazi obuqondile buyilokho okubonwe umshushisi. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, u-C ubonisa ukuthi wayemi ngaphandle kwendlu ka-B ngesikhathi ebona u-A emshaya u-B. Ukufaneleka kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi, futhi akukho mthetho wokukala izinga lokufaneleka kobufakazi. Ubufakazi bungamukeleka noma bungamukeleki. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi bumukeleka noma bungamukeleki sincike ekutheni bukhona obuhambelana nezimo zecala noma ukuthi ukwamukelwa kwabo kuzobeka umsolwa engcupheni. Kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi ngokusekelwe ezimweni ezizokwenelisa ekupheleni kwecala. Uma isimo singanelisi, lelo bufakazi alithathwa njengelungile. Inkantolo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzweni komsolwa nakuba ukuvuma kwephepha kwaphikiswa iqembu lokuvikela. Ngemuva kokuthi icala liphothuliwe, umsolwa uzoba nethuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nokuvuma kwephepha. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisana nokuvuma kwephepha, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi esivela ngemuva kokubuzwa sizosuswa yinkantolo. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi okufanele, inkantolo izocabanga ukuthi ubufakazi obunikezwe buhamba kanjani nezimo zecala. Igunya liyilungelo noma umthwalo odingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu uma bethula ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zegunya. Igunya lomuntu siqu kanye negunya lesimo. Ukwamukelwa kwenkantolo kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphakathi kwenkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqinisekisayo futhi engakwazi ukuphikiswa noma ukuhoxiswa ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho ezithile. Ukwamukelwa kwangaphandle kubhekisela ekwamukelweni okwenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo okuthintwa ukuphikiswa noma ukungqubuzana. Ukuphika kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umsolwa evuma ngokuphelele nangaphandle kokungabaza ukwenza lesi senzo, okungathi uma senziwa phambi kwenkantolo kuzobhekwa njengokuvuma icala. Isaziso senkantolo sikhombisa lapho inkantolo yamukela izimo ezaziwayo nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa lungakagcwaliswa ngobufakazi ngesikhathi sokubuzwa. Isinqumo sokukholwa siwukwenza isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni ezithile ezisunguliwe ngumthetho. Umthwalo wobufakazi ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni weqembu ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obuqinisekisayo, emthethweni wobugebengu lo mthwalo ubekwa ezandleni zabameli bezokuhlola. Umthwalo wobufakazi obubalulekile ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze inkantolo ibize umsolwa ukuba aphendule ezinsolweni futhi ithole ubufakazi obanele ukuze iphikise lelo bufakazi elicacile elithulwe yiphathi evula leli cala.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: Ukukhuthaza Impilo Engcono Ngomhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu ka-2023, umphakathi waseMkhanyakude ubungaza imicimbi emikhulu eyahloswe ekuthuthukiseni impilo nenhlalakahle. Lezi zenzakalo zafaka izinhlelo ezahlukene ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba bathole ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngezempilo, futhi ziqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokunakekela impilo yomuntu siqu. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile eyahlanganisa abaholi bendawo, odokotela, kanye nezikhungo zempilo, lapho bakhuluma khona ngezindlela zokwenza impilo yomphakathi ibe ngcono. UMsizi Mkhize, ongumholi wezokungcebeleka, uthe: “Impilo yempilo iyisisekelo sokuphila kahle. Kumele sibe nezindlela ezizokwenza abantu bazi ukuthi bangazithuthukisa kanjani.” Ukuwazisa abantu ngempilo kubalulekile, ngakho imicimbi ibihlanganisa izifundo eziningi eziphathelene nezempilo. Abantu benethuba lokufunda ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilile, ezifana nokudla okunempilo, ukuzivocavoca, nezidingo zokuphumula. UDr. Nandi Mthembu, udokotela obambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo, uthe: “Ukwazi indlela yokuphila engcono kungasiza ekuvimbeleni izifo eziningi. Kumele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphile kahle, ukuze baphile impilo ende.” Ngaphezu kwezifundo, imicimbi ibihlanganisa nezinhlobonhlobo zemidlalo, ezihloswe ukujabulisa abantu nokubakhuthaza ukuba babe nezehlakalo ezinhle. Imidlalo efana nebhola, umjaho, kanye nemidlalo yokuzivocavoca ibibanjelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi abantu babezithokozisa. Lokhu kwakhuthaza umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abantu bekhuthazana ukuba babe nezehlakalo ezinhle. Izikhungo zempilo zabeziqhakambisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo emiphakathini, abantu babenethuba lokuhlangana nochwepheshe bezempilo ababeveza izinhlelo zokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelashwa. UMsizi Mkhize uthe: “Abanye abantu abazi kahle ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Imicimbi efana nale ibalulekile ukuze sikhulume ngalezi zinsizakalo.” Le micimbi ibonisa ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, izikhungo zempilo, nemiphakathi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zinsiza kuholele ekwakheni umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. UDr. Mthembu uthe: “Siyavuma ukuthi uma sisebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukufinyelela emiphumeleni emihle, okudingekayo ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi ibinikeza nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezihlinzekwa mahhala, ezifana nokuhlolwa kwezifo ezithathelwana, ukuhlolwa kwegazi, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abangathola usizo oludingekayo, ikakhulukazi labo abangenayo imali yokuhlawulela izinsizakalo zempilo. UMsizi Mkhize uthe: “Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu athole usizo lwezempilo, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali.” Kodwa, imicimbi ayigcini nje ngokukhuthaza impilo, kodwa futhi ibonisa izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwemithombo yokudla okunempilo, ukuhamba kancane kwezinsizakalo zempilo, kanye nokungabi nalwazi olukhona zikhona. UDr. Mthembu uthe: “Kumele sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza impilo yomphakathi ibe ngcono.” Ekugcineni, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle ibonisa ukuthi ukulwela impilo engcono kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nemiphakathi. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. UMsizi Mkhize uthe: “Siyavuma ukuthi impilo yethu ithinta wonke umuntu. Kumele sibe nesibopho sokukhuthaza impilo engcono, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi.” Umphakathi ubonisa umdlandla wokuthuthukisa impilo, futhi le micimbi iyisibonakaliso sokuthi abantu bayafuna ukushintsha impilo yabo ibe ngcono. Lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa ukuthi uma sikhuthaza impilo, sikhuthaza futhi inhlalakahle yomphakathi, okwenza kube nempilo engcono kubo bonke.
Ingcebo/ukuhlomula kwesizwe yindawo eyisisekelo noma umqondo owenza ubunikazi bayo. Ihlanganisa umlando wesizwe nendlela olandelwa ngayo noma olandelwa ngabanikazi bayo, amasiko, ubuciko, [ukwehluka] nolimi, izinhlobo zokudla abazijabulelayo, umculo abawuthandayo, nendlela abakha futhi bahlobisa ngayo izakhiwo zabo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali ezicebile kweNingizimu Afrika kwenza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahluke kwabanye abantu emhlabeni. Ingcebo yethu isihlukanisa kwabanye amazwe futhi isenza sibe nezehlakalo ezihlukile njengefa lempumlo. Akukho ndawo enye lapho ubunikazi baleli zwe buhlanganiswe kahle futhi bukhanyiswe njengemifanekiso yaleli zwe - ifulegi lesizwe, ingoma yesizwe, kanye ne-emblem yesizwe. Wonke umuntu ongumZulu, izingane, abadala, izikole, abasebenzi, abaqashi, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (NGOs), izinhlangano ezisekelwe emphakathini (CBOs), kanye neminyango kahulumeni bangakwazi ukwazi, ukuqonda, futhi bezwe bejabulile ukuthwala lesi sikhumbuzo nokuthi yini esikuyona. UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi, kanye Nobuchwepheshe. Imifanekiso yesizwe sethu yilezi zimpawu ezibonakalayo nezingenamazwi ezichaza ubunikazi besizwe. Imifanekiso yesizwe ichazwa nguMthethosisekelo futhi iqondwa njengokukhuthaza ukuvumelana nokwakha isizwe. Ilungelo lokuvota linikezwa kumuntu wonke omdala, uhlu lwabavoti lwesizwe olulodwa, ukhetho okuvamile, kanye nohulumeni owenziwe ngizinhlangano ezahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa obala, ukuphendula, nokukhanya. Ingoma yesizwe esiyilalelayo idlalwa noma icula emicimbini ebalulekile yesizwe futhi ifundiswa ezikoleni noma emicimbini yezemidlalo. I-emblem yesizwe ibonakala ezakhiweni zikahulumeni, kumadokhumenti, nakuma-vehikhali kahulumeni, phakathi kokunye. Ifulegi lesizwe elisha laseNingizimu Afrika laqala ukusetshenziswa ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa, 1994. Lwamukelwa ngokushesha ngemuva kokuphuma kokusa/nokuphuma kokuphuma njengoba isizwe esisha sikhula. Ukuklama nemibala yefulegi kuyisithombe semibala ebalulekile emlandweni wefulegi laseNingizimu Afrika, kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo kuze kube manje. Imibala ebomvu, emhlophe, noluhlaza yasungulwa ekuqaleni emlandweni wefulegi laseNingizimu Afrika; kanti imibala emnyama, eluhlaza, negolide yaqala ukuvela efulegini lethu lesizwe ngekhulu le-19. Wonke umbala wesithupha usanda kuba yinto ebonakalayo efulegini laseNingizimu Afrika. Mayelana nalokho le mibala emelela, kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi umbala ngamunye ungachaza noma ubonise izinto ezihlukene kubantu abahlukahlukene. Ngalesi sikhathi, asizokwenza umqondo othile kumuntu ngamunye. Noma ubani ukhululekile ukuba nezehlakalo zabo zokuthi umbala othile umele yini noma ubonisa ini. Lokhu kwavumelana ngesikhathi kuxoxwa ngovoti lwezinkulungwane ngonyaka ka-1994. Ukwakhiwa kwengxenye ephakathi yefulegi, ebukeka njenge "V," kuhlanganiswa phakathi kwefulegi, kuqhubeka njengomugqa oqondile ukuya emaphethelweni, kukhombisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemiphakathi ehlukene yaseNingizimu Afrika, ibamba indlela phambili ndawonye njengento eyodwa. Le mbono ixhumene nomqondo we-emblem yesizwe, obizwa nge-!ke e:/xarra//ke, okuyilimi leKhoisan (/Xam San abantu), okusho ukuthi "abantu abahlukahlukene bahlangana." Lokhu kuklama kwefulegi kuyahluka kodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye ifulegi. Ifulegi lesizwe lizoba nesisekelo esilinganayo esinengxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo nobude obuthathu; ingxenye ephakanyisiwe, umugqa obomvu ophakeme, nomugqa oluhlaza ophansi, kanye ne-triangle emnyama lapho izophakanyiswa khona, nale migqa ihlukanisa umugqa oluhlaza ozoba ingxenye eyodwa kwezihlanu zobubanzi, nomhlophe ohlangene nobomvu noluhlaza; kanye ne-triangle yegolide kwi-triangle emnyama lapho izophakanyiswa khona; kanti ububanzi nokuphakama kuzoba ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu zobubanzi befulegi. Ifulegi kufanele lithathwe ngenhlonipho. Akufanele lidonswe emhlabathini noma kube nezinto ezibekwe phezu kwalo. Ifulegi ngokuyinhloko lifana nencwadi - ukusuka phezulu ukuya phansi nasekhohlo kuya kwesokudla. Uma likhombiswa ngokuqondile, ukuphakanyiswa kufanele kube ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti umugqa obomvu uphakathi. Uma ifulegi likhombiswa ngokuqondile, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi isizwe sisesimweni sokudabuka noma sokuhlupheka. Uma likhombiswa likhuphuka, kufanele lihambisane nomugqa obomvu ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti ukuphakanyiswa kukhulu. Uma likhombiswa eduze noma ngemuva komkhulumeli, kufanele libekwe ngakwesokudla kwalowo mkhulumeli. Ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli, uma likhombiswa kumphakanyisi, umphakanyisi kufanele ube phambi kwamaphakanyisi ezinye ifulegi. Uma likhuphuka eduze kwezinye ifulegi noma nezinye ifulegi, kufanele kube ngakwesokudla. Kufanele kube ngakwesokudla uma likhombiswa nezinye ifulegi zamazwe noma kwamanye amazwe (konke kufanele kube kulingana ngosayizi nobude). I-emblem yesizwe noma i-emblem yeState iyisithombe esibonakalayo esiphezulu. Thatha isikhathi sokucabanga ngezenzakalo ezibalulekile empilweni yakho - ukukhula, umshado, ukufa, nezitifiketi zesikole, ipasipoti yakho, konke lokhu kuyamukelwa ngokomthetho yi-emblem yeState. I-denomination encane yemali ithwala le emblem ngakolunye uhlangothi. Uma ukude kwelinye izwe, ukubona le emblem ezakhiweni zezimboni kuyisithombe sasekhaya noma ngabe awukhona ekhaya. I-emblem yeState iyingxenye ebalulekile yeGreat Seal, evame ukubhekwa njengophawu oluyinhloko lweState. Noma iyiphi idokhumenti ethwele isikhumbuzo seState Emblem inikezwa igunya eliphelele, njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ikhokhelwe nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika. Umqondo - okungowengxenye yesigubhu esiluhlaza: !ke e:/xarra //ke. kubhalwe ngolimi lweKhoisan futhi ukuhumusha okuqondile kusho: "abantu abahlukahlukene bahlangana." Kubiza isizwe ukuba sihlangane ngokubambisana nokuzigqaja - Ukuhlanganyela ekwehlukaneni. I-tusk yehlathi - iyisithombe sokuhlakanipha, amandla, nokuphila okungapheli. Ukuklama okuphakathi - kuyisithombe esakhiwe kusuka kumatshumi ehlathi - iyisithombe sokwaneliseka, ukukhula, nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, kukhuthaza abantu nezici zokulima zomhlaba. Ukumelwa/kubukeka kwabantu - kuthathwe kumakhono eKhoisan - kuthathwe ezithombeni ezidumile ezifana nitshe leLinton - lokhu kuyisibonelo esiyinhloko samakhono ezitsha zaseNingizimu Afrika, manje sekuhlinzekwa eMnyangweni Wezokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika - kuyisithombe sesiko sokubingelela nokuhlangana, kukhombisa: ukuhlanganiswa ekwehlukaneni. I-spear ne-shield - ziyizimpawu ezimbili ezimele ukuvikelwa nokuphatha - futhi zikhombisa imilenze eqinile
Le mhedi inikezwa kubantu bezwe langaphandle (abaqondisi bezwe kanye nohulumeni) nabanye abantu abahloniphekile abavela phesheya. Inikezwa ngenxa yobudlelwano obuboniswe eNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho iyimhedi yokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesithombe sobumbano nokwesekwa. Imhedi iyisithonjana esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Ingxenye 3 = I-Thusi. Umajola (isikhwama esincane) - Isikhwama esivakashela izingane ezizalwayo. Asilimazi ingane noma amalunga omndeni, futhi indlela yokuyisusa ukuthi umama wengane ayisiphakame ngobisi lwebele. Iza engane ukuze iyilungiselele ikusasa elikhanyayo neliphephile ebuncaneni bayo. Iza njengomngane nomvikeli. Ubungane obumele, obusekelwe ekuthandeni, busekelwe emoyeni wokukhombisa ukwesekwa kanye nenhloso yokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yesikhathi esizayo sabantu abasha kanye namalunga omphakathi okhulayo. Lesi sikhwama sibe yingxenye yomlando wabantu ngenxa yesikhathi esidumile esabhala kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba iphikisa umqondo wokuthi isikhwama siyisidalwa esiyingozi nesinobuthi, kodwa ibonisa umbono ophambene we-Afrika, iqonda isikhwama njengomngane kanye nelunga lezwe lemvelo okufanele liphile ndawonye. Isixhumi sokuhamba - esihlotshiswe ngezimilo zendabuko ezimnyama, siyisithombe sokubonga ngokwesekwa nokubekezela okukhonjisiwe, futhi siphinde sikhombise ukuzibophezela ekusekeleni nasekuma nabantu abasisekelayo.
Umbiko Ngemlandvo WaseNingizimu Afrika Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ubalulekile ekuqondeni izimo zomphakathi, izifunda, nemikhuba ehlukene esebenza kuleli. Izici zomphakathi, ezomnotho, kanye nezePolitics zikhombisa imisebenzi ehlukahlukene yabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudala umfanekiso ocacile wezindawo, izifunda, namasiko ahlukene akha isimo samanje saseNingizimu Afrika. Izikhumbuzo Zokuqala Nezamasiko Ngokwezazi, umlando wobuntu bokuqala, okungamaSan namaKhoisan, ubonakaliswa ukuphila kwabo emhlabeni ophilayo, ogxile emanzini nasemithonjeni. Labo bantu baveza inhlonipho emvelweni, behlala impilo elula enezindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Uhlanga lweNguni, olwakhiwa ngezizukulwane ezahlukahlukene, lwafika emhlabeni. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wahlangana nabaphunyukeli, okwakuwuphawu lokuqala lokuhlangana kwezizwe. Izinkanyezi ezinjengamaNguni, amaZulu, namaXhosa zafaka umthelela emlandweni, zaphinde zigcine izindlela zomsebenzi, izinkolo, namasiko aphephile. Ukuhlangana Kwezakhamuzi Namasiko Ngesikhathi sokufika kwabavela ngaphandle, ikakhulukazi amaNgisi namaDutch, kwavela ubuqili obunamandla obabhalisela izikhumbuzo zamasiko. Abafikile bazama ukujolisa izinsiza ezinhle, kwaholela ekwenzeni imiphumela emibi kubantu bendabuko. Lokhu kwabuhlungu kubantu bendabuko, ababecindezelwa ngemali nezinsiza, bephoqwa ukuba baphile ngendlela ethile, inhloso yokwakha umphakathi owodwa, owayeqhamuka kwimibono yomhlaba. Lezi zinkathi zikhumbuza ngempilo eyayingahlala njalonje kulabo abavela ezwekazini lethu ngaphambi kokuhlangabezana nezinkinga zobandlululo, imiphakathi eyayinezinhlonipho nemikhuba ehlukile yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ubuhlobo Bezombusazwe Nezinguquko Ezikhathini ezilandelayo, uhulumeni wezwe kwaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu. Ngo-1948, ubumbano lwezombusazwe lwabaphikisi lwavela, luxhaphaziwe, lunikeza amandla amakhulu kubantu abahluphekayo kulowo nyaka. Ubuhlanga, obubulalayo, buphika ubumkhulu bolimi lwezizukulwane, kwaholela ekwaziseni ukuphikisana kwamasiko kanye nemibono eyohlukeneyo, kusigcizelela umphakathi ongenaphelele. Ipolitiki yokuhlukanisa ibilokhu ifakazela ukuba yingozi ngokuphelele, futhi kufanele ngempela kuboniswe emlandweni ukuthi uNingizimu Afrika ugcwele ubunzima nobunzima obukhulu, okuhlanganisa izimo zokuphila nezimbenge. Izinguquko Zamasiko Nezihlahla Zomlando Umlando wobumbano nezehlakalo ezihlala phansi, kwaholela ekwakheni ibhande elisha. Izikole, izikhumbuzo, namaSonto aveza isithombe esiqinile sokubumba umphakathi, futhi abathintekayo basondelana nemicabango emisha. Ukuwina ubumbano, uNingizimu Afrika wathathwa njengeqembu elisha loshintsho, ubuqotho nezimfuno zamalungelo abantwana, okwakuhulumeni okwandile nokukhula. Iziphakamiso ezazilandelayo zayiwo, ukuphikisana kwamalungelo obuntu, ukuthuthukiswa kwemvume, nokwakha ibhande lokuhlala ngaphandle kwemingcele. Kunemizamo emikhulu yokwakha ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ngokuhlonipha amasiko ahlukeneyo, kuthuthukisa ukwaziwa kwezimfanelo zomphakathi. Imiphumela Yokugcina Nezindlela Zomphakathi Emasontweni aphelile, umzamo ophelele waphokophela kubantu ukuba bakwazi ukuphila impilo ngaphandle kwamaphuzu ethuswa. UBushmen bezwa kahle. Ububha, ukuhlupheka, nomkhuba wobuhlanga buwubufakazi bezimo ezinzima zempilo. Lokhu kuveza ukuphuphutheka kwemizamo yokuqinisa ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Ngo-1994, uNelson Mandela wabalelwa esikhathini esisha, wazinika umuzwa wokubulala ukumemezela ubukhona bezingane ezinyamalalayo ezisondela ukuze zihlomule. Lokhu kwavula imigqa emisha yokwakha, ukufunde ngempilo entsha, ukunqoba ukungaboni ngaso linye, nokuqinisa ubumiselo. Isiphetho Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika usikhumbuza ngokuqinile ukuthi, nakuba inhlupho zikhona, ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhloniphana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene kuhlangene nokubambisana kuhloswe. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga, izinguquko nezinselelo, uNingizimu Afrika uthola ithuba lokubuyisa, uqinisekisa isizinda esikhulu sabantu bayo. Uhlanga lwesizwe lisathuthuka, luguqula izimo zokuhlala, olwezezimali nolwenhlalo, ngakhoke luveza ukuze konke kuhambe phambili.
Umbiko Ngobuhle Bemvelo Isingeniso Ubuhle bemvelo buveza ububanzi bezinto eziphilayo nezingenapheli, obuqhakambisa isimo sendalo nempilo. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, imvelo ibalulekile empilweni yethu, iyisikhungo sezenzakalo ezahlukene ezakha umhlaba esiphila kuwo. Lesi sihloko sizohlola ubuhle bemvelo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezindlela zokuyigcina ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukuyithokozela. Ubuhle Bemvelo Imvelo ibonakala ngokuhlukahluka kwayo. Izintaba eziphakeme, izigodi ezijulile, imifula ejulile, nezilwandle ezimfushane zikhombisa ubuhle obuhlukahlukene. Ukukhanya kwelanga, okuvela phezulu, kuhlangana nezithunzi zezihlahla nemithi, kudala umoya opholile nowokuthula. Ngesikhathi sezulu, imvula ithulisa izwe, ikhipha umoya omusha, futhi ikhulisa izitshalo nezilwane. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo buphila, futhi buphilisa. Izinzuzo Zobuhle Bemvelo Ubuhle bemvelo abukhona nje emehlweni, kodwa busebenza nempilweni yethu. Imvelo inikeza umoya ophilayo, amanzi ahlanzekile, nokudla okudingekayo ukuze siphile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo zemvelo zibalulekile ekuphileni kwethu ngokomoya. Ukuhamba ezindaweni ezinhle, ezinemvelo, kubangela ukuthi abantu bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bephumule. Umoya opholile nemibala ehlukene yezitshalo kudala umphumela omuhle empilweni yengqondo. Izinhlanga eziphila emanzini, izinyoni ezindizayo, nezilwane ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zikhuthaza uthando nokuhlonipha imvelo. Isimo sezulu sinomthelela omkhulu empilweni yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi silondoloze lezi zinsiza. Izingozi Emhlabeni Wethu Nokho, ubuhle bemvelo bukhulu kakhulu buphakathi nezinsongo. Ukuphuculwa kwemizi, ukuchitheka kwezimali, nokungcoliswa kwemvelo kubangela umonakalo omkhulu endleleni esiphila ngayo. Iziphithiphithi ezifana nezikhukhula nezimo zezulu ezingalindelekile zikhombisa ukuthi imvelo ibonisa umuzwa ophakeme wokuphikisana. Umhlaba udinga ukuba siwulondoloze, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizwe ubuhle bemvelo. Ukuhweba ngezinsiza, ukungcolisa amanzi, kanye nokulahla udoti emvelweni kudala izinkinga ezinzima. Ngakho-ke, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sigcine ubuhle bemvelo buphilile. Izindlela Zokugcina Ubuhle Bemvelo Ukuze sigcine ubuhle bemvelo, kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezibucayi. Ukuqwashisa abantu ngokuqhubekayo, ukufundisa abantwana, nokwakha izinhlelo zokulondoloza imvelo kudinga ukuba kube yimpumelelo. Izinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva okukhishwayo, ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphumelelayo, nezinhlaka zokuvikela izindawo zokuhlala kwezilwane namahlathi zibalulekile. Abantu bangaphinde baqokelele izinsiza ezisemqoka esikhathini samanje, njengokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamaplastiki, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuhamba ngezinyawo noma ngezimoto eziphuma emoyeni. Lokhu kudala umphumela omuhle emvelweni futhi kuyasiza ekugcineni ubuhle bemvelo. Isiphetho Ubuhle bemvelo buhamba phambili ekuphatheni impilo yethu. Akukhona nje ukuthi buhle, kodwa busebenzela umphakathi, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ukuze sibe nemvelo enhle, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezibucayi zokulondoloza lezi zinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngokuqonda, ukuhlonipha, nokuzigcina, sizokwazi ukuthokozela ubuhle bemvelo, futhi sizoletha umphakathi ophilayo nezizukulwane ezizayo. Uthando lwemvelo kufanele lube yinjongo yethu, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imvelo yethu igcinwa, ibukeka, futhi ihlanzekile.
Ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini Emiphakathini eminingi yaseNingizimu Afrika, imboni yezimayini ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokukhiqiza izinsiza ezisemqoka, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuthi ibamba izinkulungwane zabantu emsebenzini. Ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezitholakala ezimayini, empeleni, imboni ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima, kakhulu ngokubhekelwa kwempilo, izimo zokusebenza, kanye namaholo. Umgwaqo wokucwaninga ngengxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini uqala eminyakeni ye-1920, lapho imboni yaba yinsika yokukhula komnotho. Kwakukhona ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwezimboni ezahlukahlukene, futhi abaphathi bemayini babefuna ukuvikela inzuzo yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abasebenzi baphinde baphikise izimo zabo zokusebenza, bejolisa kakhulu kumaholo. Ngalesi sikhathi, amaholo abelokhu ephansi, futhi amaholo amancane ahlukaniswa ezingeni lezemisebenzi. Abasebenzi, ikakhulukazi abamnyama, babefuna izinguquko ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, babevele behlangana futhi benza izinyathelo zokuphikisana, okuholele ekwakheni izinhlangano zabasebenzi ezazisekela lezi zidingo. Emzabalazweni wabo, abavukuzi baveza izinkinga eziningi. Ukuze baphumelele, babefanele bahlonze izimbangela ezingaholela ekuphuculeni izimo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhuluma nabanye abasebenzi, ukuthola ukusekelwa kwabanye, kanye nokuhlela izigameko ezinkulu zokuqwashisa. Lezi zinyathelo zenzelwe ukubonisa ubunzima okuyiwo abahlangabezana nawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukunciphisa ukusebenza kahle kwabavukuzi akuhambisani nezidingo zenkampani. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima phakathi kwabaphathi kanye nezinyunyana. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wawubona ukuthi izinyunyana ziba namandla, ziqinisa izwi labavukuzi, futhi zigqugquzela izingxoxo ezinzima ngamaholo. Eminyakeni ye-1980, umphakathi wezokugcina izinsiza wahlangabezana nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ukucindezelwa komnotho, ukuhlinzekwa kwezimali, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima. Abasebenzi baveza indlela yokwakha ubuhlakani phakathi kwabo nabaqhubi bezimayini, ukuze basebenze ndawonye ekutholeni izixazululo. Lokhu kuhlangana kwabavukuzi kwabavusa umoya wokuzwana nokubambisana. Ngenkathi le minyaka ihamba, izinkulumo zamaholo zathuthuka. Abavukuzi baqala ukufuna ukuhweba ngempela, bephikisa izizathu ezikhona zokungahlinzekwa kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izivumelwano ezahlukene, ezaziphakamisa izinga lemaholo, kwazise izinkampani zaziqonda ukuthi ukungathathi hlangothi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Ngemuva kokuphela kweminyaka ye-1990, imboni yezimayini yahamba phambili, kodwa izinkulumo zamaholo zabe seziya phambili kakhulu. Abasebenzi baqhubeka nokufuna izithuthukiso, futhi izinyunyana zaba namandla. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezivumelwano eziningi ezithinta izinqumo zamaholo, ezazikhuthaza izinguquko ezinkulu. Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, abavukuzi bahlala bephikisa, befuna izimo ezinhle zokusebenza, kanye namaholo afanele. Lokhu kwenza imboni yezezimali ibaluleke kakhulu, futhi kuyavuma ukuthi zingxoxo zamaholo ziyaqhubeka nokugcina ubuhlakani phakathi kwabavukuzi nabaphathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zingxoxo zenzeka ezicini eziningi, phakathi kwezinguquko zokuphatha, ubuchwepheshe obuthuthuke, kanye nokwanda kokuncintisana. Lokhu kuthinta imiphumela yengxoxo zamaholo; abavukuzi bahlala beqonda ukuthi ukuxhumana nokubambisana kubalulekile ekutholeni izixazululo. Ngakho-ke, ucwaningo ngezingxoxo zamaholo embonini yezimayini ludinga ukugxila ekwakheni izixazululo ezizinzile, ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukusebenzisana okunamandla phakathi kwezinyunyana, abaphathi kanye nohulumeni. Emzabalazweni wokuthola impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ingxoxo ayikona kuphela phakathi kwabavukuzi nabaphathi, kodwa ikhuluma ngobuhlakani bomphakathi wonke. Ngale ndlela, imboni yezimayini izoba yindawo yokusebenza engcono, futhi izidingo zabasebenzi zizothola ukunakwa okukhulu. Lezi zingxoxo zamaholo zizophinde zibe yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu besebenzisana, bangathola izixazululo ezizokwenza impilo yabo ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, izifundo ezivela kulolu cwaningo zingase zibe nomthelela omkhulu esimweni sokusebenza embonini yezimayini, nakweminye imikhakha ezithinta umphakathi jikelele. Emva kokuhlola lezi zinto, kubonakala ukuthi izinguquko zikhona, futhi ukuqhubeka kokuxoxisana kuyinto eyinhloko ekuthuthukiseni izimo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabavukuzi nabaphathi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni jikelele.
Ukuhlinzekwa Kwegama Len­kampani Ne­khodi (GEMS Company Name and Code Provision) Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi kungani ukuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi kubalulekile, kufanele siqale sithole incazelo ejulile ngalesi sihloko. Kulezi zinsuku, inkinga yokuhlonza izinkampani nobuchwepheshe bazo ibaluleke kakhulu emnothweni. Ukuhlinzeka ngamagama nekhodi ethile kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezidingo zomkhiqizo, izimiso zomthetho, kanye nezidingo zezimakethe. Ngokujwayelekile, igama lenkampani lidinga ukuba liqondakale, libe nesixhumanisi esiqinile nezinsizakalo noma imikhiqizo ethile ehlinzekwa yinkampani. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze amakhasimende akwazi ukukhumbula kalula igama lenkampani, kanye nokwakha isithombe esihle esimqoka emkhakheni wezohwebo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ikhodi, evame ukuba yi-alphanumeric, isetshenziswa njengefomethi yokuhlonza ikakhulukazi ezinhlelweni zokuphatha izinkampani, ukugcina amarekhodi, noma ukufaka izinhlelo zezimali. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngezinqubo eziphathelene nokuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi. I-GEMS, noma i-Global Entity Management System, iyisistimu esetshenziswa amaningi ukuze kuhlonzwe, kuhlelwe, futhi kuqondiswe izinkampani emhlabeni jikelele. Le sistimu iyasebenza ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinkampani zibhala amagama azo ngendlela efanele, ngenkathi zilandela izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Kuleso simo, izinkampani kufanele ziqaphele ukuthi igama elikhethiwe alidingi kuphela ukuhamba phambili kumakhasimende, kodwa futhi kudinga ukungahlangabezani nezinselelo zomthetho nezobuchwepheshe. Kungakuhle ukuthi izinkampani zisebenzise izinsiza ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlola amagama, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukuthi ingabe igama elikhethiwe selivele likhona yini, futhi uma kungenjalo, kulungile ukufaka isicelo. Naphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi igama lenkampani lihambisana nezinhlelo zabo zokumaketha kanye nemigomo yabo yokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, ukuqhamuka negama elisha kudinga ukucabangela izici eziningi, njengezithakazelo zomphakathi, ubuchwepheshe obukhona, kanye nemikhuba yokuhweba. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi igama lenkampani lisendaweni efanele ukuze libe neqhaza elibonakalayo emakethe. Ngemuva kokukhetha igama elikahle, kubalulekile ukwakha ikhodi efanele. Le khodi izogcina ibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinkampani, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kokuhlola, ukukhipha amafa, nokubika. Ikhodi, evame ukwakhiwa ngemininingwane ethile, isiza ekwaziseni izinkampani ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili ezimakethe ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu abaninzi bahlola izinkampani abazifisayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, igama lenkampani nekhodi yokuhlonza zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle. Umphakathi udinga ukuba uqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani zisebenza ngokuhlonipha imithetho, zifaka izinqubo ezivumelekile, futhi zikhumbula ukuziphatha kahle emsebenzini wazo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlinzeka kwegama lenkampani nekhodi akusona isinyathelo esincane. Kuyinqubo ebanzi edinga ukuhweba ngokuqonda, ukuhlola, nokuhlonza. Izinkampani ezikhetha amagama nekhodi ngendlela efanele ziba nethuba elikhulu lokuphumelela, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi zibambisene nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke zihlola izidingo zomkhiqizo wazo, zibe nekhono lokwakha amagama nekhodi ezihambisana nezimiso zomthetho, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhumbula ukuthi inhloso yazo iwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwazo namakhasimende. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okunembile nokwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu namabhizinisi, okhulisa umnotho ngendlela efanele.
### Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona: Indaba Yethu Emphakathini wethu, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zinezimpawu ezinkulu emindenini nasempilweni yabantu. Ukuze siqonde ukuthi lezi zifo ziqala kanjani nokuthi zashintsha kanjani impilo yethu, kubalulekile ukuhlola umlando wazo. Lokhu kuhlola kuhlanganisa izenzakalo, izimo, namagugu esintu abhekane nakho ukuze siqonde ubudlelwano phakathi kwezifo ezingamahlalakhona nomphakathi. Ngokuqala, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zathi ziphuma ngezindlela ezahlukene. Njengoba iminyaka idlula, abantu babeveza lezi zifo kodwa bengenazo izincazelo ezanele. Ngaphansi kwezinkolelo, abantu babexwayiswa ngezindlela zokuphila ezithinta impilo enempilo, bekhuluma ngokuqina, ukudla okungafanele, nokuphila ngendlela enempilo. Izifo ezifana nohlobo lwesifo sohudo, umhlaza, nezinye zazithathwa njengemiphumela yokuphila okungafanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abacwaningi baqonda kahle ukuthi lezi zifo zithinta imiphakathi eminingi. Ngemva kokuhlola izinkolelo nemikhuba yokuphila, kwavela ukuthi izifo ezinjalo zixhumene kakhulu nezimo zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa nezinkinga zokuhlalisana, ukudla okungafanele, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezingezinhle. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwemihlangano yokwelapha, lapho abelusi, ababeletha, nabanye okuhlonishwa bangenela ekuxhumaneni nabantu ukuze balungiselele izindlela ezingcono zokuphila. Ngesikhathi sekhulu le-20, umhlaba wathola ubuchwepheshe obukhulayo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezithombe meteorological, izinhlelo zempilo, nezinsiza zezokwelapha kwasiza ukunciphisa umthelela wezifo ezingamahlalakhona emphakathini. Ukuqonda izindlela zokwelapha kwenze imiphakathi ithole izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, okuholele ekwandeni kolwazi ngokuqakatheka kokudla okunempilo, ukuhamba, nokugcina umqondo ophilayo. Kodwa-ke, ukhetho lwemiphakathi lukhombisa ukuphikiswa ezinqumweni zomphakathi. Amalungelo abantu ahluka phakathi kwezindawo, okubangela ukuba izifo ezingamahlalakhona zikhule ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kahle. Lokhu kugcizelela izinselelo ezithinta ukuqonda izinjongo zempilo yendawo. Izigameko ezifana nezifo zika-diabetes, isifo sikashukela, nezinye, ziyaqhubeka nazo izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuphila nezifo ezingamahlalakhona kuhlobene kakhulu nezinkumbulo, ubuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokuphila zethu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zifo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akukhona nje ukwelashwa, kodwa kudingeka nomkhuba ophilayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu kufanele babheke phambili, benze izinqumo ezinhle, badle ukudla okunempilo, futhi babe nokuphumula okwanele ukuze balungiselele impilo yabo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kufanele sazi ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwezempilo, umphakathi, nezimo zomhlaba kuzodinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Abantu kumele balwele impilo yabo, bakwazi ukufuna usizo, futhi bazi ukuthi izifo ezingamahlalakhona azizenzakaleli. Sifuna ukuba nezingane eziphilayo, nendlela yokuphila enempilo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zifo zikhula phakathi kwezimo ezinzima noshintsho kumakhelwane ethu. Uma sithola ulwazi olungcono, nezinsiza ezinhle, sizoba nempilo enempilo. Ukukholwa emandleni okwenza izinguquko ezintobekeni zethu, sizoba neqhaza elihle ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ovumelayo, nonobuchwepheshe bokuphila. Ekugcineni, izifo ezingamahlalakhona zisetshenziselwa ukudala isithombe esengeziwe sokuhlola impilo yethu. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphakathi kufanele isebenze ndawonye ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga eziphakathi, kuhlangane izindlela zokwelapha ezintsha, nendawo yokupha isimo esifanele sokuphila. Lokhu kuzogcwalisa imithombo yokwelashwa, kuphinde kuphumelele izindinganiso zempilo eziphakeme, futhi kusekele ukuvikeleka kwempilo yempilo yethu nesizukulwane sethu. Ngale ndlela, indaba yezifo ezingamahlalakhona ibalulekile, iba isifundo esikhulu sokuthi sithole indlela yokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, kanye nezimiso zokuphila ezilungile ukuze sihlanganyele emiphakathini. Ngokubambisana, sizokwazi ukusiza abathintekayo, sisize iqulu, futhi siqhubeke nokwenza imiphakathi yethu ibe nezinhlobonhlobo ezinhle, kusebenze kuzo zonke lezi zifo.
Isahluko 1: Ukuvela KweCOVID-19 Kwathi lapho konke kubonakala kulungile emhlabeni, izinkanyezi zahambaklungile. Ngonyaka ka-2019, emzamweni wobuchwepheshe, isifo esisha saqhamuka ngaphakathi kwendawo yaseChina, edolobheni iWuhan. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, beqhuba izimpilo zabo nsuku zonke, begijima ebhizinisini, bephumula nozakwabo, begubha imicimbi. Kodwa-ke, kanti iCOVID-19, isifo esithathelana kalula, saba sekuvele, futhi kwashintsha umhlaba ongenangqondo ngokuphelele. Abantu baqala ukuhamba benganaki, bemisebe ngaphandle, bephuza iziphuzo, kodwa sekungaphakathi kobhontshisi benhliziyo, kube sekuvinjwa ubusuku. Amathuba okuxhumana atholakale ezimpilweni zabo, ezokukhulumisana azishiywa ziqhuqhuqe. Izibhedlela zathuthuka, zaba zindawo ezingenamathambo, lapho iziguli bezidinga usizo oluningi. Isahluko 2: Ukuqwashisa neZinyathelo Zokuvikela Njengoba isifo sisaqhubeka sithathela abantu, kwavela izinhlelo zokuvikela. Izikhungo zezempilo zathumela imiyalezo ezithombeni, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bagcine izikhuhlane. Umphakathi wathi ukwazi, uye nenyunyana yokwakha izitayela zokuhlala kude, ukuhlanzeka, nokuhamba ngezinye izindlela ezimbi kakhulu. Umphakathi wavuka, bahlangana futhi bahlasela lesi sifo, benza konke okusemandleni ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuhamba kwesitho sokugula. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, amakhompiyutha aqhubeka ahlola izinkomba, kwakhululeka imiyalezo eminingi. Ukuzihlanganisa umsebenzi, kubonakala njengomhlaba omunye, umoya wena uhlanganiswe, wasusa ubuhlungu obungaka. Bafunda ngokuhlangana, baqonda ukuthi umphakathi ubulungiswa kukho, futhi amandla omthetho nenkohlakalo awafaneleki. Isahluko 3: Ukuguquguquka Komphakathi Njengoba izinsuku zidlula, umphakathi uzama ukujwayela ukukhalipha kweCOVID-19. Abantu baqala ukufunda ukwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, izinsuku zethu zikhula zathokozisa ngokuhlangana kokusebenza. Okuyintandokazi, abantu baqiniseka ukuthi inkululeko iyavuma ubuhlakani; badlala imidlalo ye-intanethi, besekela omakhelwane, benza ubungane. Ubudlelwane busakhula, futhi umphakathi ubhalela izindaba ezinhle eziphefumlelweyo. Ubuchwepheshe baphinda buvuleleka; abantu baqala ukufunda nokuhlala bexhumekile, zakhele amakhono amasha. Imikhankaso yokuxhaswa ngokwengqondo yabonakala ibalulekile, ngaleso sikhathi abantu beqala ukubeka izimpawu zomphakathi, beba nezimpilo ezithathe ngokwakho, bebonisa ubumbano. Becela abafundi, bese belandela imigqa yezehlakalo, besebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana njengezikhwama zokugcina ukuthula, behlakanipha ukuthola imithombo yokukhuthaza. Isahluko 4: Uhlanga LweMithetho Nokuqhubeka Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izithiyo zathuthukiswa, kubonakala izindlela ezivuma ukuba nemigomo ethile. Umhlaba waba nesikhashana sokugcina ngaphansi kokuvikela, kodwa omunye nomunye wathola ngokuziqhenya impumelelo eminyakeni emithathu. Ukuzithokozisa nezinto ezenzeka emhlabeni zakha ivolumu yokubonisana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu basifundisa isiZulu sokuqala. Bahamba ngebhajethi emisha yokugubha izimbizo, bethola izigidi zomsebenzi, benza izifundo zokuhlala bezithokozisa. Kodwa-ke, okwakukhona akukaze kuphinde kwenzele emhlabeni wesimanje, ukwakha ubudlelwane otatazile bekelele. Isahluko 5: Ukuhlanganisa Ukubuka Kwekusasa Ngokuba isifo seCOVID-19 sawuveza ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, izinsuku zabe zimnthongo, zikhumbuza izinto eziyinkolo. Abantu bamele labo abasebenza, imindeni nabangane bephuma ezikhathini ezinzima. Bahamba embusweni, kubonakala ukuchuma, ubenzisa polokohle ekulungiseni. Izinkanyezi ziqhubeka zihlangana, ubuchwepheshe buvuka emathafeni, sikubona izindlela ezintsha zokuceba. Abantu balungisela izikhathi ezilandelayo, behola izifiso zabo, bephila impilo engcono. Ngendlela, kuze kube namuhla, abafundi basacabanga ukuthi iCOVID-19 ihamba, kodwa kusalisaphila isiZulu sokuqala. Ngaphezu kwamazinga agulayo, umphakathi wobuhlobo baqinisekisa, bazama ukubuyisela okwakukhona, njengoba besebenzisa impilo yabo ngendlela efanele. Uhola izinyathelo, izinyunyana ezimbalwa, kugqugquzelwa ukubambisana — ukuze konke kuqhamuke, kuthi iCOVID-19 ibonakale njengehlelo njengokukhumbula, konke kuhamba, nobuhlobo baphakathi kwabo. Isiphetho: Ngalezi zinsukwana, iCOVID-19 ikhubaza umhlaba, kodwa thina siphumile siphilile, sithokozisa umoya wokubambisana, sikhumbule ubuhle bempilo. Abantu bazazi, bathokozisa ukuphila, behamba ngemigudu emisha, bephila ngezifiso zabo. Impilo isithonjiwe, ubuhlobo ayezothokozisa ngenhlonipho, ngomsakazo wothando, sengibuza umphakathi, ngiyabonga!
Izinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi Ukuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ithola ulwazi olufanele nolwakha. Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu. Sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile zokubhekana nalezi zinselelo. Isinyathelo 1: Qonda Izidingo Zomphakathi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukuhlola izifundo ezitholakala emiphakathini. - Ukuxhumana nabantu bendawo ukuze uqonde izifiso zabo. - Ukuhlola izinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi, njengezokuxhumana, izindaba zomphakathi, noma izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Isinyathelo 2: Thola Izinsiza Zokuxhasa Ngemuva kokuhlola izidingo, thola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uxhaswe imisakazo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Imali yokuxhasa imisebenzi. - Abantu abanamakhono afanele, njengababhalisi, abahleli, nabakhangisi. - Izinsiza zobuchwepheshe, njengezikhangiso eziku-inthanethi, iziteshi zokuxhumana, nezinsiza zokurekhoda. Isinyathelo 3: Hlela Uhlelo Lokuxhasa Hlela uhlelo lokuxhasa imisakazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubeka imigomo ecacile yokuthi yini ofuna ukuyifeza. - Ukubeka isikhawu sokusebenza, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi uzokwenza ini. - Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphromotha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imisakazo ifinyelela kubantu abaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Isinyathelo 4: Xhumana Nababambiqhaza Xhumana nababambiqhaza abahlukene, kubandakanya: - Izinkampani ezizimele, ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza. - Abaholi bendawo, ukuze uthole ukwesekwa. - Abanye abaxhasi, ukuze uthole iminikelo. Isinyathelo 5: Phromotha Imisakazo Phromotha imisakazo yakho ukuze ifinyelele kubantu abaningi. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukusebenzisa iziteshi zokuxhumana, njenge-Facebook, Twitter, ne-Instagram. - Ukuphakela izinhlelo ezikhethekile, ezifana nemicimbi noma izinkulumo. - Ukubambisana nezinye izinkampani noma imiphakathi ukuze uthole ukufinyelela okukhulu. Isinyathelo 6: Qinisekisa Ukubuyekezwa Nokuhlola Ngemuva kokuphromotha, kubalulekile ukuhlola impumelelo yemisakazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuqoqa impendulo evela kubabukeli. - Ukuhlola ukuthi imigomo efakwe ekuqaleni ifezekile yini. - Ukwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise imisakazo esikhathini esizayo. Isinyathelo 7: Qhubeka Nokuxhasa Ukuxhasa imisakazo akupheli. Qhubeka nokubheka izidingo zomphakathi, futhi uhlale uvulelekile ezinguqukweni. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni imisakazo eqhubekayo nehlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Isinyathelo 8: Qinisa Ubudlelwano Qinisa ubudlelwano nababambiqhaza nezinye izikhungo. Lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuxhaswa, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Bamba imicimbi yokuhlangana, noma uhlele izinkulumo ezahlukene ukuze uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Isinyathelo 9: Thuthukisa Amakhono Thuthukisa amakhono akho nabantu abakuzungezile. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukuhlela izifundo noma izinkulumo ezithinta izihloko ezibalulekile. - Ukubamba imihlangano yokufundisana, lapho abantu bangabelana ngolwazi. - Ukuxhasa abantu abasha ukuze bangene emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Isinyathelo 10: Yiba Nezinhlelo Zokubambisana Yiba nezinhlelo zokubambisana ukuze uthuthukise imisakazo. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ukubambisana nezinye izinhlelo zomphakathi. - Ukusebenzisana nabaculi, ababhali, noma abanye abantu abanolwazi. - Ukwakha izinhlelo ezivumelanayo ukuze uthuthukise ukufinyelela. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ukwesekwa, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi imisakazo iyaphumelela futhi iyasebenza. Ukuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ohlanganyela, nolwazi. Ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuxhumana kuyizinto eziyisisekelo ekwakheni imisakazo ephumelelayo.
Lokhu okukhuluma lapha kuhlose ukusekela bonke abalimi abazama ukuthola umhlaba/izindawo zokulima, kodwa kubalulekile futhi kulabo asebevele benazo izindawo zokulima ukuba bakwazi ukuhlola izimo zabo mayelana nokwakha amabhizinisi abo nempilo yabo. Ukuba ngumlandeli wombuso sekubekezelekile futhi kuvame ukusetshenziswa ngababusi ukuze balwe nabanye. Nokho, umalimi ofuna ukuphumelela lapho ethola umhlaba kufanele acabangele kahle zonke lezi zinto ezilandelayo. Kukhona ukungqubuzana ngezindaba ezingafanele mayelana nokuguqulwa kokuphathwa komhlaba; kukhona izindawo zokulima ezithengiswa ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi kumele kube nomuntu ofuna ukuthenga nomuntu ofuna ukuthengisa, kodwa izindawo zokulima eziningi azikafikanga kulabo okufanele bazuze ekutholeni indawo yokulima. Thina, ababheke ngaphandle kwalesi senzo sokuguqulwa kokuphathwa komhlaba, sibuza ukuthi abatholile izindawo zokulima bakhethwa kanjani. Kuvame ukusizwa injabulo yabantu abathole izindawo zokulima, kodwa masinyane sizwa ukuthi le phrojekthi yehlulekile, ifile, futhi ayilethi inzuzo! NgoMashi 2010, uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Nokuguqulwa Komhlaba, uGugile Nkwinti, wamukela ukuthi izinhlelo zokuguqulwa komhlaba zikamasipala azizange zibe nempumelelo ngoba abaningi abathole umhlaba bahluleka ukuwusebenzisa ngendlela elethe inzuzo nezinzuzo zezezimali. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba kubeka engcupheni umgomo kahulumeni ophakathi kokuguqula ukuphathwa komhlaba kwabantu abamnyama ngo-30% ngaphambi kuka-2014. Lokhu kuyicala! Bonke abantu abathintekayo kwezolimo eGrain South Africa nalabo abakwiGrain Value Chain bakholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela kabusha komhlaba kufanele kuqhubeke kahle ukuze ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo ezweni lethu kuqinise ukutholakala kokudla esikhathini esizayo. Kunzima ukuqonda ukuthi abathintekayo ekukhetheni abantu abazozuza ekutholeni umhlaba basebenza kanjani. Kumele sikholwe ukuthi abawukhethanga abangane babo, ukuthi bahlolwe kahle ukuze inqubo yokuguqulwa kokuphathwa komhlaba iqhubeke ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze izwe lonke ngezindlela ezinhle. Kulapho umalimi ofuna ukuba nguchwepheshe emsebenzini wakhe wokukhiqiza ukudla angathatha leli thuba ukuze athuthukise isimo sakhe. Abantu abacabanga futhi abafuna ukulima emathafeni abo nokusekela umthetho wokuhlela kabusha kokuphathwa komhlaba kufanele bahlele izinqubomgomo zabo ngendlela efanele. Kumele baphakamise abalimi abasafufusa abazophumelela. Kuvame ukuba nabantu abathembela kuphela enhlanhleni kodwa bengenalo isifiso sokuzilungiselela ukuba nguchwepheshe abazoba nezindawo zokulima zabo esikhathini esizayo. Bonke amabhizinisi aqala ukukhula njengezimpande - lokhu kuqala ngokwakha isu lebhizinisi. Akukho bhizinisi elingakhula emhlabathini ngaphandle kokusekelwa kwabanye abathintekayo kwezomnotho, ngakho-ke isu lebhizinisi liyithuluzi elichaza konke (inani, izindleko, njll.) ezizokusiza ukutshela ukuthi uzoba umalimi ozophumelela ekulimaleni. Le ndlela izokhombisa ukuthi unguchwepheshe ngoba izokhombisa izinyathelo ozothatha ukuze ufinyelele imiphumela emihle. Isu lakho lebhizinisi lizofaka okulandelayo: imininingwane mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha ibhizinisi nezindlela zokwandisa umsebenzi wakho, futhi lizokhombisa ukuthi uzofinyelela lezi zinto kanjani esikhathini esifushane nasemide. Isu lebhizinisi sizophinde sikhombise lapho ubona khona amathuba ebhizinisi futhi uqonde ukuthi kwenzekani esikhathini esifushane nasemide. Njengochwepheshe, isimo sakho sizokhombisa ukuthi uyazi ngemakethe namathuba kanye nezingozi. Ngoba ufuna ukukshowa kulabo abazokusiza ukuthi unamandla nezakhono zokukhiqiza, futhi ukuthi kukhona abanye abalimi nochwepheshe kwezolimo abazokusekela phambili. Zonke izinqubomgomo zebhizinisi zidinga ukuhlola konke emhlabeni. Kumele kube nemininingwane mayelana nezimali nezabelomali zesikhathi esizayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ebhizinisini lakho ngoba ukuhlela kabusha komhlaba akuhambi kahle, uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngendawo, kodwa kuvame ukuba nenkinga ngoba kulapho uhulumeni ehamba khona, eshiya abatholi ngaphandle kwamandla nolwazi, ngaphandle kwezimali zokuqala zebhizinisi, futhi bengenakusekelwa ekutholeni amakhono, ulwazi, nezikweletu. Kuyinto enhle ukuthola umhlaba, kodwa! Umuntu ohlakaniphile ophupha ngokuqhubeka uyazi ukuthi imali iyadingeka ukuze uqale ukuze iphupho lube yiqiniso elibonakalayo. Noma ubani angafaka isikhumba emhlabathini, kodwa abanye abakwazi ukusikhulisa ukuze sikhule futhi sikhulise ukudla. Kufanele ufune usizo ukuze ukwazi ukusiza ngezindaba zezimali ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wakho wokulima uzoba kahle. Chaza ukuthi ufuna ukwenzani ekulimaleni. Khombisa ulwazi lwakho nezakhono futhi unikeze izizathu zokukhanyisa ukuthi ungubani ofanele ukuthola umhlaba. Khombisa ukuthi ucabangele indawo yokulima ongayithola, uyazi ukuthi izimo zezulu zimi kanjani kulendawo ozokhulima kuyo, uyazi futhi ukuthi imakethe izoba kanjani nokuthi yiziphi amathuba akhona. Qonda kahle imigomo yakho futhi ubheke izingozi ezingase zibe khona ezingenza umphumela webhizinisi ungabi mnandi. Lokhu kubalulekile kubo bonke abalimi ezikhathini zamanje ngoba kumele baphikise nabakhiqizi emhlabeni jikelele. Abakhiqizi kufanele babheke imakethe nsuku zonke ngoba bangase badinge ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wabo ngenkathi u-mazambane usakhula! Isu elihle lokumaketha kufanele lihambisane nohlu lokukhiqiza. Akusizi ukufaka ukudla abantu abazokudla kodwa kungabikho abathengi abazofuna ukukuthenga ngentengo ezoletha inzuzo efanelekile emsebenzini wakho. Izindleko zokuthenga imishini nokuqhubeka nokuyigcina njalo. Izindleko zokuqala zokufaka. Izindleko zokuhamba nezindleko ze-diesel. Izindleko zokuhweba uma ukhetha ukungabi nayo yonke imishini ngokushesha. Indawo ebalulekile yesu lakho iyona: isitatimende esikhombisa ukuhamba kwemali, esidinga usizo olungatholakala kumphakathi wezomnotho noma kumuntu onolwazi lwezibalo.
Izindiza - Ukuhlaziywa Ngezindlela Zokuthengwa Kweminikelo Yezindiza Izindiza zithathwa njengendlela yokuhamba esheshayo, ethokozisayo, futhi efinyelelekayo kubantu abaningi emhlabeni. Njengoba izwe lihamba phambili, amakhasimende abona izindiza njengendlela eyodwa yokuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezikude, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhamba ibhizinisi noma uthokozisa umndeni. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinqubomgomo ezintsha ezivela kwizindiza ezihlukahlukene, okuyizinto ezithinta kakhulu ukukhetha kwethu. ### Ukukhetha Indiza Uma umuntu ehamba, isinyathelo sokuqala ufinyelela emangalisweni ayingqayizivele afika nofuna ukuhamba. Lokhu kuhilela ukukhetha phakathi kwezindiza eziningi ezihlinzeka ngeminikelo ehlukene. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukhetha izindiza zendawo noma ezizimele, ukuqonda izindleko, izinsizakalo, nezinga lempumelelo yenkampani kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile. Abaningi bakhetha izindiza ezinamabhanoyi ahlanzekile, kodwa futhi kufanele bazi ngokuhamba kwabo. ### Izinto Ezigqame Izindiza ezitholakala emakethe zibhekwa ngezinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa kwamakhasimende. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwezindiza kumele luhambisane nezidingo zethu, kungaba ngezinsizakalo zokudla, izinsiza zokuthola intambo ye-inthanethi, noma izinsizakalo zokwakha ubungane nokuhamba. Umsebenzi wezindiza ubalulekile, futhi kufanele kube necebo elikahle eliqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bakhululekile futhi naso sinokuthula kokuhamba. ### Ukuhlola Izindleko Ukuhlola izindleko zezendiza kube enye yezinto ezibaluleka kakhulu kubantu abahamba. Uthole ama-akhawunti amaningi, futhi akhawunti ngamunye uzama ukuncintisana ngezindleko. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkampani ezihlukene zinikeza izinto ezihlukene, ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokuthola ama-odolo, izinsiza zamanje, nemali yokuthengisa. Ngesinye isikhathi, imiklomelo yokuhamba ingase ibuye ibhekelele ukubuyekezwa kwenzuzo, okubeka abahambi endaweni engcono yokukhetha. ### Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Ngaphandle kwezindleko ezitholakalayo, ukuphathelene nobuchwepheshe bokufaka izicelo nokuhweba khona kuhlale kubalulekile. Izinhlelo ezihlinzekwa yizindiza zenzelwe ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi lesi sikhala sinobuchwepheshe obusha bokuhlola izinga lemikhankaso yesikhumbuzo, phakathi kokunye ezikhuluma ngale mikhankaso. Ukuze uqonde kahle izindleko, kubalulekile ukuhlola izindleko zamasiko, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokuthi umthengi vying bejolise ngobunono. ### Ukuhamba Kwezentengiselwano Kwezentengiselwano, izindiza zibaluleke kakhulu ekwakhiweni kwemikhiqizo ethile. Ukuthengwa kwezindiza kuphinde kube nendawo ebalulekile. Ukuze uthole imo engcono yokuhamba, kubalulekile ukucabanga ngezinhlelo zokuhlela izindiza kanye nezindawo ezihlinzekwa imikhiqizo emisha. Lokhu kuletha ukuchuma kwezidingo ezikhethekile zezimali ezidala umqondo osebenzisa amakhulu ezinkampani ukuze uthole okuningi. ### Ukuqondanisa Nezidingo Zokuhamba Ukwazi ukujola nezinsizakalo zezilimi ezahlukene nezinye izidingo kubalulekile. Izindiza eziningi zinikeza ezokuhamba ezihambisana nezidingo zolimi, izinsizakalo ezihlanganisa imibhalo, nezithombe ezenzakalayo zemithwalo. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umthengi uziswa, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo ezinzima, ukuvikela izidingo zentela, futhi uthole izinsiza ezibalulekile. ### Umphumela Wokugcina Izindiza zikhula futhi ziphila kuzo zonke izici. Ngokuqhubekayo, ukuqashwa kwezindiza kumele kube namathuba okulungiswa okuqinisekisiwe, ukuhamba kube nezinqubo ezihambisanayo, futhi uphawu lwammanga lwezindiza ruzokwenza kube lula kuwe. Kuze kube yilapho isimo sadlula, ukuhamba ngokuzenzakalela lapho uhambela khona, umphakathi kabazali, izimangalo zempumelelo, futhi uphumelele emhlabeni. Ngokubuka konke, izindiza zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yamanje. Ukuhamba ngobuchwepheshe, izindleko, nezinsiza eziyinhloko, konke kubalulekile! Ngokuhamba, abahambi bangahamba kalula, bahlala bekhululekile nezindlela ezihlukile. Ngalesi sikhathi, izindiza ziyindlela ebalulekile yokuxhumanisa abantu emhlabeni jikelele.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi Isingeniso Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophephile. Lezi zinkundla zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuvikela, izikhungo zomphakathi, nemisebenzi ehambisana nezokuphepha. Ukuze ube nekhono lokusebenza kahle kwezinkundla zokuphepha, kubalulekile ukulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo. 1. Ukuqonda Izidingo Zomphakathi - Qala ngokubamba imihlangano nomphakathi ukuze uqonde izinkinga ezikhona. - Bhalisela imibono nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu, kuhlanganiswe nabaholi bendawo. - Hlanganisa idatha ngendlela yokuhlola izinga lokuphepha komphakathi, usebenzisa izibalo ezivela ezinsukwini ezahlukene. 2. Ukuhlela Izinhlelo Zokuphepha - Sebenzisa ulwazi oluqoqwe ukuze uhlole izinhlelo ezikhona. - Dala uhlelo lwezokuphepha oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. - Beka izinjongo ezicacile, ezifana nokunciphisa izingozi, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. 3. Ukubambisana Nezinhlangano Zomphakathi - Xhumanisa izinkampani, izikhungo zemfundo, nezikhungo zokuhlala ukuze uthole uxhaso. - Hlela imihlangano yokuxhumana ukuze uthole izimvo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene. - Bamba imikhankaso yokubandakanya umphakathi, ukuze abantu bazibandakanye ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha. 4. Ukuqeqesha Abantu - Hlela izifundo zokuphepha ezihlosiwe kumphakathi, ezifana nezifundo zokuvikela izingozi. - Sebenzisa ochwepheshe ezindaweni ezithile ukuze bafundise abanye. - Dala izinsiza ezifanele zokufunda, njengezincwadi, amavidiyo, noma izinkulumo ezimnandi. 5. Ukuqinisekisa Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokusebenza - Xhumana nezikhungo zokuphepha, njengeziteshi zamaphoyisa kanye nezinhlangano zokuphuthuma. - Dala ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluhambisanayo nolwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. - Bamba imihlangano evamile yokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. 6. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziya - Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezikhona ziyahlolwa njalo ukuze kubhekwane nezinguquko zomphakathi. - Hlanganisa izibuyekezo ezivela kubantu ukuze uthole imibono yokusebenza. - Phumelela ukuhlola izinkinga nezixazululo, uqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. 7. Ukuxhumana Nokwazisa Umphakathi - Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi luhanjiswa kahle. - Sebenzisa iziteshi ezahlukene zokuxhumana, njengezikhangiso, amaphephandaba, nezinkundla zokuxhumana. - Qinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyazi ngezinhlelo zokuphepha ezitholakalayo, ukuze kube nokwaziswa okwanele. 8. Ukuvikela Izinsiza Zokuphepha - Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo zihlala zisesimweni esihle. - Hlela ukuthengwa kwezinsiza ezidingekayo, njengokuphepha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinto zokusebenza. - Phatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele ukuze zisetshenziswe kahle. 9. Ukuvuselela Izinhlelo Zokuphepha - Njalo, hlola izinhlelo ezikhona ukuze uzivuselele lapho kudingeka. - Qonda ukuthi izinguquko emiphakathini zingase zithinte izinhlelo zokuphepha. - Yenza izinhlelo ezinamandla ezihlanganisa izimpendulo eziphuthumayo ukuze ube nesimo esihle sokuphatha izinkinga. 10.
