Ukubuyekeza Nokuqhubeka - Phinda uhlaziye izinhlelo zokuphepha njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. - Bamba imihlangano yokubuyekeza kanye nemihlangano yokuxhumana. - Qhubekela phambili ngokwakha izinhlelo ezintsha ezithuthukisayo, ezifaneleke kumphakathi. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi akusikho kuphela ukusebenza ngezinhlelo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophephile, onobudlelwano obuhle, nolwazi. Ukulandela lezi zinyathelo kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu, ukuzibandakanya okukhuthazayo, nokwakha isimo sokuphepha esiqinile. Ngalokho, umphakathi ungenza izinqumo eziphusile, ezivumela ukuhamba phambili ngokuvikela izinsiza zabo nezimpilo zabo. Uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyabamba iqhaza, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono futhi edlulele phambili.
Iphasi lokwelashwa kwezilwane liyadingeka ukuze kuthunyelwe imikhiqizo yobisi eNingizimu Afrika noma ukuze kudluliselwe ngaphakathi kwelizwe. Lezi zikhwama zokuthumela zinesikhathi esinqunyiwe futhi zisebenza kokubili ukuthunyelwa nokudluliswa. Faka isicelo sephasi okungenani ezinsukwini eziyisithupha kodwa hhayi ngaphezulu kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili ngaphambi kokuthi wenze isenzo osihlosile. Uma imikhiqizo idluliselwa eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele kube nekhophi yephasi lokwelashwa kwezilwane elibuya ezweni lapho imikhiqizo ithunyelwa khona; le khophi yephasi kufanele ihlinzekwe kanye nesicelo sephasi sokudluliswa komkhiqizo, esithunyelwa kudokotela wezilwane waseNingizimu Afrika. Sicela uqaphele: Umthumeli womkhiqizo unesibopho sokukhokha izindleko zebhange, futhi uMnyango ngeke uphumeze iphasi uma inani eliphelele leziyisi-100 rand lingakakhokhiwe. Ukukhokha kungaphinde kwenziwe ehhovisi leMnyango Wezolimo, imininingwane yayo izonikezwa kamuva esigabeni: Indawo nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Uma ufaka isicelo egameni lomunye, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi ukhokha egameni lalo muntu noma inkampani. Akukho sicelo esizobhekwa ngaphandle kokukhombisa ukukhokha. Ubufakazi bokukhokha kufanele buthunyelwe ngefeksi enombolo: 012 329 8292, kubhekiswe ku: Ina Labuschagne. Bonisa kufomu lesicelo ukuthi uzothola iphasi noma uma kufanele ithunyelwe kuwe. Qinisekisa nehhovisi lephasi ngefoni ukuthi iphasi ilungile ngaphambi kokuthi uhambe ukuyithola. Izidingo zokuthumela imikhiqizo yenyama zingatholakala ehhovisi lephasi noma kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezolimo kukheli leMnyango Wezolimo. Kuthatha ezinsukwini ezimbili kuya kwezintathu zokusebenza ukuze kuqedwe isicelo sephasi uma abaphathi bezempilo yezilwane bekwamukela.
Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala Umbuzo 1: Yini icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala? Impendulo: Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala siqukethe izinyathelo ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa ukuqoqa izikweletu ezivela kumasipala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu ezikhona zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala? Impendulo: Ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Uma amasipala engakhokhi izikweletu zawo, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni izinsiza ze-Eskom, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi kubo bonke abathengi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene ne-Eskom ekutholeni izikweletu kumasipala? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinselelo ezibhekene ne-Eskom zifaka phakathi ukungakhokhi kahle kwezikweletu, izinkinga zezimali kumasipala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekutholeni izimali ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhubeke nokuhlinzekwa ngogesi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuqinisa ukuqoqa izikweletu? Impendulo: Ukuqinisa ukuqoqa izikweletu, i-Eskom ithatha izinyathelo ezihlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kumasipala mayelana nezikweletu, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokulandelela izikweletu. Umbuzo 5: Ubuqotho bamasipala busebenza kanjani ekutholeni izikweletu? Impendulo: Ubuqotho bamasipala busebenza njengesisekelo sokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ne-Eskom. Uma amasipala ebonisa ubuqotho ekukhokheni izikweletu, lokhu kudala ukwethembana, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumasipala akhokha izikweletu? Impendulo: Mamasipala akhokha izikweletu, i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungcono, okwandisa ukuthuthukiswa komasipala. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinsiza, ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga lempilo labantu. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokuxhasa amasipala akhokha izikweletu? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokuxhasa amasipala akhokha izikweletu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunikela ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza zokuphatha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amasipala ayakwazi ukuphatha izikweletu zawo kahle. Umbuzo 8: Yini eyenza i-Eskom ikhethe izindlela ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngogesi? Impendulo: I-Eskom ikhetha izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokuya ngezidingo zamakhasimende, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezimo zezimali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele futhi esebenzayo. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo zokubuyekeza izikweletu ezikhona? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokubuyekeza izikweletu ezikhona ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izikweletu ezikhona, ukuxhumana namasipala, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise ukuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala, kufanele sisebenzisane ngokubambisana, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi amasipala ayathola ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqoqa izikweletu futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe i-Eskom ibheka izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa ukuqoqa izikweletu? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom ibheka izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa ukuqoqa izikweletu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Umbuzo 12: Yini okumele ikhokhwe uma umphakathi ungakhokhi izikweletu? Impendulo: Uma umphakathi ungakhokhi izikweletu, i-Eskom ingase ibhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni izinsiza, ukwehla kwezinga lempilo, kanye nezinkinga zezimali kumasipala. Umbuzo 13: Ingabe i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokubambisana namasipala? Impendulo: Yebo, i-Eskom inezinhlelo zokubambisana namasipala ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuqoqa izikweletu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amasipala ayakwazi ukuphatha izikweletu zawo kahle. Umbuzo 14: Yini eyenza i-Eskom ibe yinkampani ebalulekile kumasipala? Impendulo: I-Eskom ibalulekile kumasipala ngoba iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngogesi, okuyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungcono kuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umbuzo 15: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-Eskom namasipala, kufanele sibe nokuxhumana okuhle, sabelane ngemininingwane, futhi sisebenzisane ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqoqa izikweletu futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Eskom izoqhubeka nokwenza izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izikweletu kumasipala zikhokhwa, ngaleyo ndlela iqinisa ubudlelwano bayo namasipala. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza ze-Eskom, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabantu bonke.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo (GEMS payment verification) Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kubaluleke kakhulu emkhakheni wezokwelapha, ikakhulukazi ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zempilo. I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinsiza yokwelapha enikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhokhwayo zifaneleka, kubalulekile ukuba nokuqonda kahle le nqubo. Ukwazi i-GEMS I-GEMS iyinhlangano eyaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika, eyasungulwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo eziphezulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Le nsiza ibalulekile ngoba inikeza ukwesekwa kwezokwelapha, okwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Ukuze lezi zinsizakalo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuqinisekiswa okuphumelelayo kwezinkokhelo. Inqubo Yokuhlonza Izinkokhelo Ukuze uqinisekise izinkokhelo, kufanele uqale ngenqubo yokuhlonza. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqoqa yonke imininingwane edingekayo, efana nezinsiza ezitholakele, izindleko ezikhokhwayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakele. Izinyathelo ezilandelayo zibalulekile: 1. Ukuqoqa Kwedatha: Ukuze uqinisekise izinkokhelo, kufanele uqoqe yonke imininingwane efanele, okuyi-invoice, izincwadi zokwelapha, nezitifiketi zokwelashwa. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le datha ibhalwe kahle futhi iyatholakala. 2. Ukubuyekezwa Kwedatha: Ngemuva kokuhlanganisa imininingwane, kufanele ubuyekeze le datha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ayinaphutha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izindleko ezikhokhwayo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zikhona, futhi ukuthi izinkokhelo zifaneleka. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, kubalulekile ukuxhumana nezinsiza zempilo ukuze uthole ukucaciseleka. 3. Ukuqinisekisa Izinkokhelo: Ngemva kokubuyekeza, kufanele uqinisekise izinkokhelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi izinkokhelo ezikhokhwayo zifaneleka futhi zikhona. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nezinkokhelo. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana I-GEMS inezinsiza ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze zisebenze kahle nezisebenzi zayo. Uma uhlangabezana nezinkinga noma udinga usizo, ungaxhumana ne-GEMS ngocingo noma nge-imeyili. Ukuze uthole usizo olusheshayo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, efana nenombolo yokubhaliswa kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ukubaluleka Kokuqinisekiswa Kwezinkokhelo Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kubalulekile, ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinsizakalo zempilo ezikhokhelwayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhona, okubalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphakeme lezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zisebenza kahle, okuyinto ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Izinkinga Ezijwayelekile Nezixazululo Noma inqubo yokuhlonza izinkokhelo ibalulekile, izinkinga zingavela. Ezinye zezinkinga ezivame ukubonwa zifaka phakathi: - Imininingwane Engalungile: Lokhu kungenzeka uma imininingwane eqoqiwe ingahambisani nezinsizakalo ezitholakele. Ukuze uxazulule lokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlole ukuthi yonke imininingwane ibhalwe kahle. - Izindleko Ezingalindelekile: Kwezinye izimo, izindleko ezikhokhwayo zingase zibe phezulu kunalokho okulindelekile. Lokhu kungavela ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle izinqubo zokwelapha. Ukuze uxazulule lokhu, kubalulekile ukukhuluma nezinsiza zempilo ukuze uthole ukucaciseleka. - Ukuxhumana Okungahambi Kahle: Ezinye izikhathi, ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nezinsiza zempilo kungase kube nezinkinga. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano oluqinile. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo ku-GEMS kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, abasebenzi bakahulumeni bangaqinisekisa ukuthi bathola izinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhona, okubalulekile ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqonde le nqubo futhi bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani izinsizakalo ezidingekayo.
Imfundo eyisisekelo yomsebenzi wezokwelapha ihlose ukuhlinzeka bonke osomthetho ngolwazi oludingekayo nokuqonda ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda imibono yabanye kanye nezimo zabo ezihlukahlukene ukuze izinqubo zabo zibe neqiniso futhi zifanele umphakathi abahlala kuwo. Ezinye izinkolelo zifaka phakathi ukuhlola isici esithile umuntu anaso ngokukwenza uma kuqhathaniswa nezici ezifunwa noma ezingafunwa yithimba elithile. Angiphakamisi ukuthi abantu basebenzise izinkolelo ezithile ezingafanele ngenhloso, kodwa empeleni, ezinye izinkolelo zomdabu nezobulili zikhona ezingqondweni zethu, zigcwele izimo zomphakathi futhi ziqhutshwa yisiko elidumile kanye nezindaba. Ngezinye izikhathi zigxile ezikhungweni zethu. Sijwayele ukuzamukela njengamaqiniso. Uma sibhekene nenkinga, sithatha lokhu ngokuzenzakalelayo ngoba kuyinto yemvelo futhi kulula - kulula kakhulu kunokuhlola ngempela udaba ukuze sithole isiphetho esifanele ngokucabanga nokulalela nokuhlola. Ukufana phakathi kweqembu nezinto ezihlukile phakathi kwezigaba kuvame ukuncishiswa noma kugxilwe. Umsebenzi wokubuka amalungu eqembu langaphandle njengokufana kakhulu noma njengokufana namalungu eqembu langaphakathi. Izifundo zesayensi zikhombisile "ukuthanda okujwayelekile kokubona amadoda njengokwethembeka kakhulu kunabesifazane." Emaphuzwini, inkolelo iyinsiza ebalulekile kakhulu engase ibe khona kumuntu, noma umuntu enegunya njengommeleli, umbonisi, umphikisi, noma umphikisi, futhi ngenxa yalokho, le ndlela yokucwasa ingaba nomthelela omubi emiphumeleni yabo nakuqiniso. Ngokufanayo, abahluleli bangaphuthelwa ububanzi obuthembekile obungaphazamisa isenzo esibalulekile sokubiza (abantu abathile) ngamagama abo noma ukusebenzisa amagama aqukethe uthando. Ukucwasa kungase kusebenze kunoma iyiphi iqembu, kodwa ngokuhambisana nomqondo we-metaphorical "okwehlukahlukene," ikakhulukazi mayelana nodaba noma umuntu, kusala kube inselele enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo, lapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zizosebenza. Nansi uhlu lwezindlela zokulalela ezisezingeni eliphansi kanye neziphakamiso ezithile zokuthi lezi zindlela zingalungiswa kanjani. Ukulalela Okutholakalayo kungase kungabi khona: Le ndlela engasebenzi kahle ivela emaphuzwini okuthi abantu abaningi bacabanga isikhathi eside kakhulu kunesikhathi sokukhuluma somuntu ojwayelekile. Ngakho-ke, umlaleli uneminithi emithathu yemicabango emaminithini alalelwayo. Ngezinye izikhathi umlaleli usebenzisa lesi sikhathi esengeziwe ukuze acabange ngezinkinga zabo, izithakazelo, nezinkinga esikhundleni sokulalela, ukuhambisana, nokufingqa lokho okukhuluma okufanele kukhulumwe. Ukulalela Okunemibhoshongo: Kubantu abathile, amagama afana nesikhumbuzo sebhokisi elibomvu akhuthaza anger nokwenza bame ukulalela. La magama ahluka ukusuka kwelinye inhlangano kuya kwelinye. Kubantu abathile, amagama afana "nobunzima," "ukuvuleka," "intsha yamanje," njll., yizici esiphendula kuzo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma izimpawu zivele, sithatha umkhulumeli. Siphula uxhumano nabo futhi siphumelele ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela ngezindlebe ezivulekile nokuvala ingqondo: Ngezinye izikhathi sithatha isinqumo esisheshayo sokuthi umlaleli noma umkhulumeli uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba, nokuthi lokho okukhulunywayo akunamqondo. Njalo sithatha isinqumo sokuthi singakhuphula lokho esikwaziyo noma lokho abazokukhuluma - futhi baphakamisa ukuthi akukho sizathu sokulalela ngoba akukho okusha okuzokhuluma. Kungcono ukulalela futhi ngempela sithole ukuthi lokhu kuyikho noma cha. Ukulalela ngamehlo agcwele: Ngezinye izikhathi sibheka umuntu ngqo njengoba sikhuluma ngenkathi izingqondo zethu zikhona kwenye indawo noma ezindaweni ezikude. Sifaka endaweni ethokozisayo izinkolelo zethu. Ukukhombisa amehlo agcwele (uma kungelona iphupho) kubonakala ebusweni bethu. Singakutshela uma abantu besibheka kanje. Ngokufanayo, bangase babone okufanayo kithi - sithatha noma ubani njengomphikisi. Transfer daydreaming to them sometimes. Ukulalela okujulile kimi: Uma silalela imibono eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, kufanele siziphoqe ukuba silandele ingxoxo ngensiza yokuzama ukuqonda. Kungenzeka ukuthi sithole umkhulumeli kanye nesihloko okukhulunywa ngaso kuyajabulisa uma silalela futhi siqonda lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela okuhlobene nesihloko esingaphezu kokucabanga: Abaningi bethu abathandi ukuba nemibono ngezilwane ezihlanganyela, ukucwasa, nezikhalazo zethu neziphetho zethu zikhathazeke. Ngakho-ke, uma umkhulumeli ekhuluma ngento ephikisana nalokho esikucabangayo, ukukholwa, nokugcina - sithatha isinqumo sokumisa ukulalela noma sizame ukuzivikela ngokulungiselela ukuhlasela. Noma sifuna ukwenza lokhu noma cha, kungcono ukuthola ukuthi bacabangani, uthole enye icala lombuzo ukuze wenze umsebenzi ongcono wokuqonda nokuphendula. Uma bekhuluma ngakho, sifuna ukuthi bazame ukubona izimbangela nezizathu zezingqinamba zabo futhi bazame ukubona ukuthi yini engase yenziwe ngakho. Sibonisa ukunakwa, sihamba nomunye umuntu, sikhombisa ukunakekela nokuqonda, sikhupha inkinga uma ikhona, silalela ukuze sithole izimbangela zenkinga, sisize umkhulumeli ukuthi aphathe inkinga nezimbangela, sikhuthaze umkhulumeli ukuthi athuthukise ikhono lokwenza futhi simkhuthaze ukuba axazulule izinkinga zabo, sifunda ukuba sithule uma kudingeka ukuthula. Abantu abaphumelelayo ngezinye izikhathi bayazi ukuthi kufanele bathule futhi bagcine ukuzola kwabo. Ukuphikisana nezithiyo ukuze unikeze isinqumo ngokushesha nangokuphuthumayo ukuze unikeze iseluleko. Siphila nezinkinga eziningi ezinzima ezihlanganisa abantu nezimo. Isidingo sokulalela ukuze siqonde sibaluleke kakhulu. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda abantu uma singabalaleli. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda isimo uma sibona ingxenye kuphela yesimo, sisiza kancane. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda izinkinga zabantu uma sinolwazi oluphakeme nolwakhiwo, kuyilapho empeleni, sibhekene nezimpawu, hhayi izimbangela. Kufanele sibone ukuthi ukulalela kuyisici esiyinhloko kulwazi nokuqonda. LENA YINDODA ENYE ETHATHA ISINYATHELO. Uvumela ukuba bakuholele engxoxweni; awubasheshisi ngokushesha ukuze bathathe indlela abafuna ukuyithatha. Lokhu kuhlobene nehlonipho nokuqonda kwabo. LENA YINDODA ENYE EPHUMILE UKUBA NEMVELO. Lokhu kuyithuba elijabulisayo kubantu abaningi, futhi bazothatha leli thuba ngokuthobeka futhi baziphathe ngendlela ejwayelekile futhi nangenhlonipho. Uma ubonisa ukuthi ungathembeka, abanye bazizwa bekhululekile ukwabelana ngezinkinga zabo, izimfihlo, nezibopho. Umphumela uwukuthi - bayakuthola kangcono. ABANTU ABANINGI BAHLOLA INKINGA. Ukulalela okusebenzayo kusiza abantu ukuba babhekane nalabo abakhathalelayo nezinkinga. Bangakwazi ukuhambisa isimo esingasithokozisa ngqo, siqonde kangcono, bese sichaza inkinga ngokucacile nangokufanele. ENYE INDODA
Kucacile ukuthi le mpilo ye-HIV/AIDS izothinta zonke izindawo zokusebenza, lapho abasebenzi bahlupheka ngezifo zesikhathi eside, behluleka ukuya emsebenzini, abanye befa, ukukhiqiza kwehla, nezinsizakalo zabasebenzi zithinteka, kanye nempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini, izindleko zokukhiqiza, kanye nokukhuthazeka emsebenzini. I-HIV ayinabubanzi; ibhujiswa noma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi, kungakhathaliseki ubulili, ubudala, noma isizwe; nokho, manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi isimo sezomnotho sabantu sinefuthe ekuqhamukeni nasekuhlaleni kwalesi sifo. I-HIV iba yinkinga enkulu ezindaweni nasezindaweni ezijolise ebuphofwini, lapho kushintsha ngokushesha, njengokwethulwa kwezindlela zokuphila zasemadolobheni nezindlela, kanye lapho udlame nokungazinzi kukhula. Ukuhamba kwalesi sifo kukhuthazwa ukuhamba kwabantu besuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya beya ezikhungweni zasemadolobheni. Abesifazane, ikakhulukazi, bakhula kakhulu engozini yokuthola leli gciwane ngenxa yezindlela zamasiko nokuthembela kwezomnotho okwenza bangathathi izinyathelo zokulawula ukuphila kwabo. Enye yezindlela ezisebenzayo zokunciphisa nokuphatha umthelela we-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo nolwazi lwe-HIV/AIDS. Ukubhekisisa izinkinga ezithile ze-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza kuzokwenza abasebenzi, amaqembu, kanye nohulumeni babe nethuba lokwenza umnikelo obonakalayo emizamweni yasendaweni, kazwelonke, nasemhlabeni jikelele yokuvimbela nokulawula i-HIV/AIDS. Ngakho-ke, le Nqubomgomo ihloselwe ukuhlela abakhiqizi, amaqembu, kanye nabasebenzi ngendlela yokulinganisa amalungelo nemithwalo yemfanelo yazo zonke izindawo; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezibopho zesiRepublic ezindaweni, njengoba iyilungu le-Southern African Development Community (SADC). Inhloso eyinhloko yeNqubomgomo ukuhlinzeka abakhiqizi namaqembu ngokuqondisa kokuyisebenzisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abane-HIV bayahluleka ukucwaswa endaweni yokusebenza futhi kubhekwe ukuhoxiswa kwabasebenzi; kanye nokuphatha izinqubo zokukhala. Inhloso elandelayo yenqubomgomo ukuhlinzeka abakhiqizi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu ngokuqondisa kokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza. Njengoba i-HIV/AIDS ithinta izindawo zokusebenza kanye nabantu ezingeni elihlukile, kudingeka ibhekwe ngendlela ethatha lezi zinto zonke zibe yinto eyodwa. Ngakho-ke, le Nqubomgomo ibandakanya izimiso ezixoxwe kabanzi ngaphansi kwemithetho ebhalwe esigabeni 5. ukuthuthukisa amasu enqubomgomo ukuze kuhlolwe isimo nokunciphisa umnikelo walolu sifo endaweni yokusebenza; kanye nokweseka labo baphila ne-HIV/AIDS nabathintekayo ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngokukhiqiza isikhathi eside. phakathi kwabakhokhi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu endaweni yokusebenza; kanye phakathi kwendawo yokusebenza nabanye abathintekayo ezingeni lesigaba, emiphakathini, ezifundazweni, nakazwelonke. Ukwakhiwa kwendawo yokusebenza esekelayo kubasebenzi abaphila ne-HIV ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile kubalulekile lapho bezwa ukuthi bangakwazi ukuphatha isimo sabo sempilo. I-HIV/AIDS ithinta abesifazane ngendlela ehlukile kunabesilisa, ngakho lokhu kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa izinqubo zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ukubonisana, okubandakanya bonke, nokukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okuphelele kwazo zonke izindawo kuyisisekelo sezinqubo zonke zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo ze-HIV/AIDS. Bonke abakhiqizi nabasebenzi, kanye nezikhungo zabo, bayakhuthazwa ukuthi basebenzise le Nqubomgomo, ukuthuthukisa, ukuyisebenzisa, nokuyithuthukisa izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zabo ze-HIV/AIDS ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zabo zokusebenza. Ngokusho kwezinhlelo zalesi Sifundo, igama 'indawo yokusebenza' kufanele liqondwe kabanzi kunencazelo enikezwe kwiMthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, Umthetho 66 ka-1995, isigaba 213, ukufaka noma iyiphi indawo lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, hhayi kuphela kulabo abaphansi kokubambisana kokusebenza kodwa futhi kulabo abasebenza ezindaweni ezingalandeli uhlelo nalabo abazimele. Nokho, le Nqubomgomo ayifaki imithwalo yemfanelo yomthetho ngaphezu kwalokho okukhona kwiMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi kanye neMthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, noma yimuphi omunye umthetho okukhulunywa ngawo kule Nqubomgomo. Ukungahambisani akubeki umqashi endaweni yokubhekana nezinqubo zomthetho ezithile ngaphandle uma le Nqubomgomo ikhombe imithwalo ebekwe ngumthetho. Le Nqubomgomo kufanele ifundwe ndawonye nezinye izikhombisi ezinhle zokuziphatha ezingase zikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi. Okuqukethwe kwale nqubomgomo kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa, kuphathwa, noma kubuyekezwa noma yiziphi izinqubo zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo lwezomthetho olukhulunywe ngenhla. Okulandelayo yizigaba ezikhethiwe, ezihlobene nezinye zezimiso ezikhulunywe ngenhla. Lezi kufanele zifundwe ndawonye nezinye izimiso. Le Nqubomgomo ikhululwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 54(a) seMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi, No 55 ka-1998, futhi isisekelo sayo siwumgomo wokuthi akekho umuntu okufanele acwaswe ngendlela engafanele ngoba ungena i-HIV. Ukuze kusizakale abakhiqizi nabasebenzi ekusebenziseni lo mgomo ngokungaguquguquki endaweni yokusebenza, le Nqubomgomo ihlolisise ezinye iziqondiso ezihlobene. Isigaba 6 seMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi sithi kunoma iyiphi inqubo yenqubomgomo nakuwo wonke amaphuzu, akekho umuntu, ophumelele, noma ofaka isicelo sokusebenza, okufanele acwaswe ngoba ungena i-HIV. Uma kukhona noma yiziphi izinqubo zomthetho eziphathelene nezinsolo zokucwaswa okungafanele ngumqashi, umqashi kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi leyo mikhuba yokucwaswa noma yokwelashwa ngokwehlukana yayifanele. Akukho msebenzi noma umfakisicelo wokusebenza okufanele uphathwe ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ungena i-HIV. Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV kungaqhutshelwa ngumqashi noma ngabo, kuphela uma iNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ivumile leyo mikhuba njengokufanele nokufanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7 seMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24(e) seMthetho Wokwelashwa, No 131 ka-1998, uhlelo lwezokwelapha akufanele luhlukumeze ngqo noma ngokuqondile amalungu alo ngokusekelwe "esimweni sempilo" yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67, izinhlelo zokulawula zingase zisetshenziswe ezidinga zonke izinhlelo zokwelapha ukuthi zibe nezinga elincane lezinsizakalo okufanele zibe khona kubo bonke amalungu okungenani. Akukho mqashi ovunyelwe ukusho ukuthi umqashi, noma umfakisicelo, kufanele ahlale ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi unayo noma cha. Ngokuhambisana neMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi, abakhiqizi bangasondela kwiNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ukuze
I-Child Protection Register iqukethe uhlu lwezingane ezidinga ukuvikelwa, ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-18, ezidinga ukuvikelwa. I-Register igcinwa ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana osebenza ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wendawo. Ulwazi olukhona kule Register luyimfihlo futhi lungabelwana kuphela nalabo abaphakathi kweqembu lokuvikela izingane (isb. othisha, odokotela, ab nurse, abaphethe/abaphathiswa, nabanye). Uhlu lwezingane ezidinga usizo lomphakathi lugcinwa. Ingane ixhunywe emndenini wayo nasezinkampanini zomphakathi ngokushesha (ezihlinzeka ngalolo suzi). Izenzakalo zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zomndeni nengane zikhona. NgokweMthetho ophatha ukunakekelwa kwezingane (Inombolo 74 ka-1983), lezi zisebenzi ezilandelayo zinesibopho sokubika noma yiziphi izinsolo zokuthi kungase kube nezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa noma ukunganakwa kwezingane: udokotela wamazinyo, udokotela ojwayelekile, um nurse, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, uthisha, kanye nanoma yimuphi umuntu oqashwe noma ophatha i-Child Care Home noma indawo yokuphepha kwezingane. Uma, ngesikhathi sokuhlola, ubhekene, noma usindisa ingane, kukhona izinsolo zokuthi ingane ingase ihlukunyezwe, lokhu kufanele kubikwe kumsebenzi wezokuxhumana oseduzane lapho ingane ihlala khona. Noma imuphi umphakathi noma umuntu onomuzwa ngalesi simo angakwazi ukubona ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane noma ukunganakwa futhi angabika lokhu ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Amagama abo abambisene kuzogcinwa imfihlo. Ulwazi lokukhomba ingane. Ulwazi ngababheki bezingane/abazali bomntwana. Ikheli lapho ingane ihlala khona, uma ingahlali nabazali bayo, ikheli labazali bayo. Izinsuku lapho izenzakalo zibikwa khona kanye nohlobo lwezenzakalo. Ulwazi ngezimo ezaholela ezinsolweni. Noma iyiphi umlando wezinsuku ezedlule. Noma iyiphi ulwazi lokuxhumana nabanye abantu abangahlinzeka ngobufakazi mayelana nalezi zinsolo. Ulwazi lokuxhumana efayilini luyadingeka, uma izinsizakalo zomphakathi zidinga ukufinyelela mayelana nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nalolu daba. Izinkomba zokuhlukunyezwa: Lokhu kungabandakanya ama-bruises, izibazi, ukushiswa, ukuwa, nabanye. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwemizwa: Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zengane zokuthandwa, ukunakwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuxhumana ngendlela yokukhulisa, ukuzishiya, ukuzisola ngocansi, noma ukuzama ukuzisola. Ukunganakwa: Lokhu kuwukwehluleka ukuvikela ingane ezinsongweni noma kunoma yini, ezimweni ezibandayo, indlala, nokwehluleka ukwenza okudingekayo ukuze bayinakekele, nabanye. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zizovakashela ingane nomndeni wayo ukuze zihlaziye isimo futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi ingane idinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa. Uma umhlukunyezwa ophawulwayo ehlala endlwini efanayo nengane, bangacelwa ukuba bashiye bahlale kwenye indawo. Uma lokhu kungakwenzi, ingane ingahlala nabakhelwane, abangane, izihlobo, noma endaweni yokuphepha kwezingane okwethula. Nokho, kuphela uma impilo yengane ibhekene nengcuphe. Umgomo wokugcina ingane nomndeni wayo ubalulekile kakhulu. Uma kuthathwa isinqumo, kufanele kubhekwane nokuthi yini ebaluleke kakhulu ukuze ingane ithole inzuzo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Imindeni nezingane ziyingxenye yanoma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwayo mayelana nesimo abhekene naso. Nokho, ukuhluza kuphela kule ndaba akuthinti amalungelo abazali bengane noma abaphethe. Ilungelo lithinteka kuphela uma kudingeka kuthathwe izinyathelo zomthetho (isb.: ukususa ingane).
U-Jane uthi... Ngaphezu kwesikhathi kufanele simise futhi sizibuze ukuthi senzeni. Uma sifuna ukuthola impendulo ecacile, kufanele sisho nokuthi singakwenza kanjani. Asisebenzisi abaqashi abamhlophe emapulazini abantu abamnyama. Asizami ukuhlinzeka abantu abalimazekile ngezinsiza zokulima ngaphambi kokuthi kube namuhla. Asisazami ukwenza izinto ezikhangayo kuphela (ukuhlobisa amafasitela). Asizami ukuthola izitifiketi ze-BEE ngoba kukhona abantu abathengisa lezi zinto. Asizami ukuthola izitifiketi ze-BEE ngoba kukhona labo abahlinzeka ngezinto. Kodwa, senzeni? Sithuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama - abasebenza ngokwabo manje nakusasa. Siqeqesha abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuba baqonde futhi bathole ukuthi yiziphi izizathu zokwenza umsebenzi wezolimo. Siphakamisa abakhiqizi ukuba basebenzise kahle izinsiza zemvelo. Sibonisa abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuthi baphawule umhlaba abasebenzisa. Sisebenzela abantu ngalokho abanakho, sibasiza ukuthi bathole impilo futhi bakhiqize ukudla kwabo, ikhaya labo, nezwe labo. Siyasiza ukuguqula ubuso bokulima - sifuna ukuba baphume ebusweni lapho kukhona kuphela abalimi abamhlophe, sifuna bonke abantu lapha ezweni lethu bakhulume ndawonye. Sikusiza abantu abanomhlaba - umhlaba womphakathi wonke, umhlaba oqashisiwe, noma labo abanomhlaba wabo (emapulazini) ukuze basebenzise lowo mhlaba ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Sizama ukubambisana nazo zonke izigaba zikamasipala ukuze sihlanganise ukwesekwa okunikezwa abalimi. Sakha amasu ukuze abalimi bakwazi ukufinyelela kumishini. Sakha amasu ukuze sithole izibonelelo kulezo zigaba. Kunzima kimi lapho ngizwa ukuthi abantu balima ukuze abakhiqizi abamnyama. Kukho abantu nezinhlangano ezisebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama ukuze zenze inzuzo, bese zithi lokhu "ukuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama." Uma ungumkhiqizi omhlophe usebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama - qasha lowo mhlaba, khokha intengo efanelekile, qaphela ukuthi uqasha umhlaba futhi uthola inzuzo. Siyacela ukuthi ungazenzi sengathi usiza abanye abakhiqizi.
Ukufunda Ngaphandle Kwezindonga: Izinzuzo Nezinkinga Namuhla, ukufunda nge-inthanethi sekuyinto ejwayelekile emhlabeni wethu. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu zobuchwepheshe, ngithanda ukwabelana ngemicabango yami ngalolu hlobo lokufunda. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunikeza amathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukucatshangelwa. Okokuqala, kufanele ngikhulume ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nokufunda nge-inthanethi. Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu ukuthi abantu bangafunda noma kuphi, noma nini. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akudingeki ukuthi ube seklasini, futhi ungafunda ngenkathi uhamba, uphumile, noma ngisho nasekhaya. Lokhu kwenza ukufunda kube lula kubantu abanemisebenzi eminingi, abanesibopho emindenini yabo, noma abavela ezindaweni ezikude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuvumela abafundi ukuba bakhethe izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungafunda izinto ezikuthokozisayo, okwenza kube lula ukujabulela ukufunda. Abafundi bangakhetha izifundo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezifundo ezivela emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi, okwakha umphakathi omkhulu wokufunda. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukunakwa. Okokuqala, abanye abantu bangase babe nezinkinga zokuzikhandla. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kudinga ukuzimisela okukhulu, futhi abanye bangase bahluleke ukuhlela isikhathi sabo kahle. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphuthelwe izifundo noma baphazamiseke kalula. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba abafundi bakwazi ukuzilungiselela kahle ukuze baphumelele. Okwesibili, ukungabi khona kokuxhumana okuqondile nabafundisi nabanye abafundi kungaba yinkinga. Eklasini, abafundi bangakwazi ukubuza imibuzo ngqo, futhi lokhu kudala ithuba lokuxoxa. Nokho, online, lokhu kungaba nzima. Abafundi bangase bazizwe behluleka ukufinyelela usizo oludingekayo, okungaholela ekutheni bahluleke ukuqonda izifundo. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi ne-inthanethi efanele kungaba yinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi basemakhaya bangase bangabi ne-access ku-inthanethi, okwenza kube nzima ukufunda online. Lokhu kudala ukungalingani phakathi kwabafundi, njengoba abanye benethuba lokufunda kahle, kanti abanye bahluleka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zicabangele izindlela zokwenza ukufunda kube accessible kubo bonke. Ngokuphetha, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunamathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukucatshangelwa. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kwezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, ngiyavuma ukuthi ukufunda online kuyindlela ebalulekile yokufunda, kodwa kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sithola izixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze sithuthukise le ndlela yokufunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile, ukuze sithuthukise ukufunda online, sithuthukise abafundi bethu, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu jikelele. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi akuyona nje indlela yokufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Uhlelo lokuphuthumayo. IZIMPahla Izinto zakho zizogcinwa endlini yokugcina ukuze zibe nephephile. Izinto ezifana nemali, okhiye bezimoto, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Uma ukhetha ukugcina izinto zakho nawe, qinisekisa ukuthi uzinakekela. Isibhedlela sizobe singaphenduli uma zilahlekile. Cela izinto zakho uma usushiya. IZINHLOKO ZOKUKHOKHA Izindleko zesibhedlela zingakhokhwa ngemali noma ngekhadi lezokwelapha. Uma isiguli singanemali, kukhona indlela enikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Yiba neqiniso lapho unikeza ulwazi lwezempilo. Buza uma kukhona okungaqondi. Buza uma kukhona ofuna ukwazi ngakho okwengeziwe. Gwema izenzo ezingamukeleki nezingafanele. Zama ukuqonda inkinga yakho. Yazi abasebenzi abakwelapha. Hlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli. Landela imithetho, imihlahlandlela, nemigomo yesibhedlela. Khokha izindleko zesibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela iziqondiso ezinikezwe abakhiqizi bezempilo. Bika kubakhiqizi bezempilo uma amalungelo akho ephulwa. Qinisekisa ukugcina izimfihlo zabasebenzi. Cela noma yini oyidingayo mayelana nokwelashwa kwakho kumphakathi noma kudokotela.
Ama-Social Media Influencer: Umthelela Wabo Emphakathini Wethu Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, futhi izinkundla zokuxhumana sezibe yindawo ebalulekile yokuxhumana, ukwabelana ngemicabango, kanye nokuthola ulwazi. Kulawa makhasi, ama-social media influencer abe yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, edlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umbono wethu ngezinto eziningi. Nokho, umthelela wabo empilweni yethu awukwazi ukwenziwa kube lula, njengoba kunezinto eziningi ezithinta indlela abathinteka ngayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ama-influencer awaveli nje emoyeni. Abantu abaningi bahlala bejolise kulabo abakhuluma ngezinto ezithile, okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo nabalandeli babo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu bavame ukuthembela kulabo abakhuluma ngempilo yabo, izimpilo zabo, nezinto abazithanda. Uma umphakathi uthola umuntu onokuthile okuthokozisayo, umphumela ungaba mkhulu. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, kodwa kudinga ukuqaphela ukuthi umthelela ungaba yinhle noma emibi. Ngesinye isikhathi, ama-influencer avame ukwabelana ngempilo yabo, izithombe, nezinto abazithandayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bejabulile, bephila impilo enempilo. Nokho, lokhu kudala umfanekiso ongokoqobo, okungaholela ekutheni abanye bazizwe benganelisekile ngezimpilo zabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazame ukufanisa izimpilo zabo nezika-influencer, okungaholela ekucindezelweni, ukunganeliseki, noma ukungakhululeki. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-influencer anethuba lokuthonya izinqumo zabantu ngezinto ezithile, njengokudla, imfashini, nezinsiza. Lokhu kungaba kuhle uma ethula imikhiqizo enempilo, efundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Nokho, uma bephakamisa imikhiqizo engafanele, kungaholela ekutheni abantu benze izinqumo ezingalungile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi kufanele uqaphele ukuthi akukhona konke okukhanyayo okukhazimulayo. Ukukhetha kahle phakathi kokuthandwa nokufaneleka kubalulekile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ama-influencer angaba nomthelela omuhle ekwenzeni izinguquko emphakathini. Abanye baphakamisa izindaba ezibalulekile, ezifana nezokuhlalisana, amalungelo abantu, kanye nezindaba zemvelo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi kungaholela ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinhle. Uma ama-influencer ethula izindaba ezinjalo, abalandeli babo bangase babe nomthelela omuhle, baphakamise izwi labo, futhi benze umehluko. Kodwa, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi umthelela wama-influencer awuphelele. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinhloso ezimbi, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke ezinqumweni ezingalungile. Ukubaluleka kokuhlola, ukuthola ulwazi oluqondile, nokuhlola izimangalo ezithile kudinga ukuqashelwa. Ama-influencer kufanele baqonde ukuthi banezibopho, futhi njengoba bethola udumo, kufanele bazi ukuthi umphakathi ubabheka njengemithombo yolwazi. Ekugcineni, ama-social media influencer abe yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wanamuhla, kodwa umthelela wabo empilweni yethu awukwazi ukwenziwa kube lula. Kumele siqonde ukuthi banamandla, kodwa banenhloso yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola, sithole ulwazi oluqondile, futhi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimangalo ezithile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuhlakani.
Isahluko 1: Imvelaphi KaNapoleon Bonaparte U-Napoleon Bonaparte wazalwa ngo-15 kuJulayi 1769 e-Ajaccio, edolobheni laseCorsica. Ngomzala owaziwayo, u-Napoleon wakhulela emndenini ophuma ezizweni ezincane, okwenza ukuthi akhule enokukhathazeka ngezombusazwe. Umdabuko wakhe omkhulu wawuhambisana nezinkinga ezazikhona eCorsica, ezaholela ekutheni angene ezinkampanini zempi ukuze athole izikhundla. Isahluko 2: Ukuqala Kwezempi Ukuze uqale impilo yakhe yokuba uNobhala, u-Napoleon wangena eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela eFrance. Lapha, wathola imfundo ephakeme ezimpini, lapho afunda khona amasu okuphumelela. Kanti, ngenxa yokusebenza kahle kwakhe, wakhushulelwa esikhundleni somholi, ophumelele kakhulu empini ye-Italya ngo-1796. Lokhu kwenza uNapoleon waba yisithombe esidumile eFrance. Isahluko 3: Iziphumo Zokuphumelela Ngemva kokuphumelela empini, uNapoleon waba umholi wezwe, wathola umthelela omkhulu ezombusazwe zeseFrance. Waqala ukuhlela izinguquko ezinkulu ezinqubweni zomnotho, izokuhlaliswa, nezomthetho. Okwesikhathi eside, uNapoleon wageza emndenini ezwekazini, wamisa umthetho owaziwa njengemithetho yeNapoleonic Code, ewusizo oluningi kulolu hlangothi lwezomthetho. Isahluko 4: Ukukhula Kwamandla U-Napoleon waqhubeka nokwandisa amandla akhe, wagcina engumholi wezihlangano eziningi, ezibandakanya i-Germany ne-Italy. Umgomo wakhe waba ukufaka ukufika kwamakhamanda aseFrance kulezi zindawo. Nokho, umgoqo abawubona ngezikhali, ukusolwa, akuthokozisi kwaze kube sekupheleni. U-Napoleon waqala ukumanzisa amaqembu omphakathi kanye nemigudu yokuthula, ukuze akhulise ubudlelwano beFrance namazwe aphesheya. Isahluko 5: Izinsuku zokugcina Ngemva kwempumelelo ye-Europian, uNapoleon wabhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu eRussia ngo-1812. Lokhu kwaholela ekwehlulekeni okukhulu, kokukhumbula amaqhawe akhe. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uNapoleon wanqotshwa ngamaNgisi, wathunyelwa esiqhingini se-Elba. Kule ndawo, wakwazi ukufika empini ye-Waterloo, lapho khona wabulawa khona. Isahluko 6: Ubufakazi beMihlola Ubuya kahle kulezi zikhathi ezinzima, u-Napoleon wakhombisa ukutholwa kokuhlanganiswa. Ngaphandle kweziphumu zokuwohloka, kubukeka sengathi izikhumbuzo zikaNapoleon ziqhubeka, ngoba izinguquko zakhe zaluqhuba kuze kube namuhla. Njengomholi ophumelelako kakhulu, ubufakazi bamakhono akhe, umqondo, nobuhlakani budlulile esikhathini. Uhlobo lwakhe lokuphatha nolwakhe olwaluma luhlonishwa eFrance nasezindaweni eziningi emhlabeni jikelele. Isahluko 7: Ukuhlonishwa Nokwandiswa Kwefa Ngemva kokushona kwakhe ngo-1821, izimfundiso zikaNapoleon zaba yingxenye yomlando owaziwa kahle. Ngokuhlonishwa kwamandla akhe, kubonakala ukuthi izifundo ezitholakele zikhona ezincwadini ezivela ezikhathini eziphakeme. U-Napoleon Bonaparte uyisibonelo esihle sokuphila komholi, nakuba ezuke eziningi ezinhle, dasishiwo ekuhlonipheni umphakathi. Isiphetho U-Napoleon Bonaparte, umholi wetheku, ubonisa izifundo eziningi ngezinto ezithathwa efayeleni futhi kuncike emandleni akhe. Ukubhekana nezinselelo eziqine, indawo eshibhile emqondweni, kudlalwa kahle emlandweni. Abaningi bahlala bekhumbula divayidi naka izinganekwane, kodwa umsebenzi wakhe kuhambisana nohlanga lwezombangazwe. U-Napoleon, njengoba ibhuku lemaphoyisa lithi, ungomunye wezinto eziphakeme kumphakathi danzela erhokelweni ezizayo. Lo mbhalo akukhuthaza ukuqhubeka kokucwaninga ngezimpilo zendaba ezivusa imizwa njengezifenqo zomlando ezaziyo. Kuze kube khona imithombo, umoya wephothikizelo uyakwenza kube sobala ukuthi empeleni, umhlaba ugcina unendaba enhle ezihlukahlukene. U-Napoleon uzalwe, waba semhlabeni, ukudlulisa isimo esikhulu nezifundo ezikhazimulayo.
Ukuze kuvinjelwe isimo lapho othisha bengatholakala bephikiswa ngokuziphatha okungafanele, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi ngezinga elisetshenziselwa ukunquma ukuthi yini ebhekwa njengokungafanele nokungamukeleki emsebenzini. a) baphikisa noma baphule imithetho yale mthetho noma eminye imithetho ethinta izindaba zemfundo; b) benza noma benze kwenziwe noma bavumele kwenziwe noma bafihle okuthile okungafanele okungadala ukuhlambalaza ekuziphatheni kwabo nasemkhakheni uMnyango owenza umsebenzi wawo emahhovisi nasemithonjeni; c) abalandeli imiyalelo, noma banqume ukuthi abazolandeli imiyalelo esemthethweni evela kumuntu onegunya, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngokuqhubekayo noma ngezinyathelo ezikhombisa ukungahloniphi; d) abaqhube imisebenzi yabo njengoba kuchaziwe yisikhundla abanakho kahle; e) baqhuba imisebenzi yabo yangaphandle ngaphandle kokuthola imvume kumqashi wabo, futhi uma le misebenzi ihlobene ngqo nomsebenzi wothisha; f) bazama ukufuna usizo kumuntu ongaphandle ongenamsebenzi kuhulumeni noma umuntu ongakhethiwe emkhandlwini mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabo kanye nesimo sabo sokusebenza; ngaphandle kokuthi le nsizakalo izosiza ekuletheni ukuvumelana kumuntu ohlelekile njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho Wokuxhumana Kwezabasebenzi noma ephalamende noma emthethweni wabo wesifunda; g) baziphatha ngendlela yokuhlambalaza, ngendlela engafanele, noma abakhombisi ukuhlonipha ngesikhathi somsebenzi noma bahlasela abanye ngokufuna izinzuzo zobulili nezinye izinhlobo zokuhlukumeza; h) baphuza utshwala noma ezinye izidakamizwa ngesikhathi somsebenzi; i) baxoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi ngendlela engafanele ngaphandle kwemvume yomqashi, noma basebenzise ulwazi lwabo ngalokhu ukwenza imisebenzi abangekho emsebenzini; j) abakhulumanga ngale mininingwane noma ngaphandle kwemvume yomqashi; k) bacele imali ngokwenza umsebenzi ongavunyelwe njengokufundisa, izihlobo zezimali kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngama-commissions, noma imivuzo nezinkokhelo zalolo msebenzi abawenzile abanalo ilungelo kulolo mali. Lezi zindaba zifaka nesimo lapho bengaphumeleli ukuveza kumqashi wabo ukuthi bathole le mali; l) basebenzisa izinsiza noma izikhungo zikahulumeni ngendlela engalungile; m) uma bengasebenzi emsebenzini ngaphandle kwesizathu esivumelekile; n) bakhuluma amanga noma benza izitatimende ezingamanga ngenhloso yokuthola amalungelo emisebenzi kanye nenhloso yokulimaza isithunzi nobungcweti kukahulumeni, noma uMnyango Wezemfundo noma noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi kahulumeni. A1. Uma umqashi ethola icala ngenkantolo noma ekhishwa, lokhu akusho ukuthi uMnyango awukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo zokudinga ngokomthetho kulokhu; futhi noma iyiphi ubufakazi obethulwe ngesikhathi sokuphikiswa, uma kutholakala kuyikho, abakhululi umqashi ekubeni nesibopho nguhulumeni ngokulandela izinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuxhumana Kwezabasebenzi. a) kumele babike ngesenzo esithathwe sokumisa umqashi ngummeli; b) kumele baziqinisekise uthisha ngezizathu ezaholela kulolo mkhuba; c) kumele banikeze uthisha ithuba lokukhombisa izizathu zokuthi kungani engafaneleki ukususwa, okumele kwenziwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kosuku olurekhodiwe edokhumenti.
I-Grade R iyisikhathi sokuqala sephasi eliyisisekelo emfundweni egxile eziphumeleni ezikoleni zikaHulumeni. Le mfundo iklanyelwe izingane ezineminyaka emine nephezulu kuya kwemihlanu nephezulu. Abazali nabagibeli kumele babhalise izingane zabo ezikoleni ngaphambi kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe phakathi kukaAgasti no-Okthoba kulo nyaka ngaphambi kokuthi izingane ziqale. Faka isicelo ngaphambi kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe phakathi kukaAgasti no-Okthoba. Bhalisela esikoleni esiseduzane nawe. Thumela isithombe sokuzalwa kwengane kanye nekhadi lokugonywa, kanye nobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo sokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Isicelo sakho singathatha isonto elilodwa kuya kwezingu-6 ukuze processing. Imali yesikole iyahluka phakathi kwezikole. Amafomu okumele agcwaliswe atholakala ezikoleni.
Lo mthetho uhlanganisa umthetho wesakhiwo. Uthuthukisa ulwazi nokuqonda ngezindaba zase-Afrika ngokusebenzisa ososayensi bezokuxhumana abaziwayo ngokuvumelana nabo bonke abalandela lezi zindaba nangokusebenzisa ukuqeqeshwa nemfundo ngezindaba zase-Afrika; kanye nokuhlanganisa, ukuhlela, nokusabalalisa ulwazi mayelana nezindaba zase-Afrika, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko elifanele nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana nezidingo zazo zonke abantu, amathuba, nezinkinga ezibhekene nazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ibhodi isungulwa ukuze ibheke, iphathe, futhi iqondise izindaba zeZikhungo. Amalungu akufanele adlule kwababili futhi azobekwa yiBhodi ngokubonisana noNgqongqoshe; kanti uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi, ozoba ilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla sakhe, akasoze abe namandla okvotelela. Ekusungulweni kweBhodi, kumele kube nokrepresenta efanele yobulili, ulimi, kanye nokwehluka kwemiphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ilungu leBhodi elikhuluma ngalesi sihloko kumele libe neziqu ezihambisana nezimiso zokucacisa nokwethula. Okungenani elinye lamalungu abekwe yiBhodi kumele libe nolwazi lokuphathwa kwezimali. Bazokwenza umsebenzi noma babe ilungu iminyaka emithathu, ngaphandle uma isikhathi esifushane sithathwa; futhi ilungu eliphelelwe isikhathi singabekwa kabusha. Uma ilungu leBhodi lifa noma lishiya isikhundla sazo ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esibekwe, elinye ilungu lingabekwa ukuze lithathe leso sikhundla ngesikhathi esisele esishiywe yilungu elibekwe. Ilungu leBhodi elingabekwa ngokuphelele nguMbuso lingakhokhelwa yiBhodi ngemisebenzi abawenzayo njengamalungu, nalokho okukhokhelwayo kuzodinga ukuba kucaciswe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokubonisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. Akukho ilungu leBhodi elingabamba isikhundla eqenjini lezepolitiki noma enhlanganweni yezepolitiki. Umuntu ongakabi nezezimali, ophumelele icala eNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwecala elenziwe ngaphambi kosuku lwe-27 kuMbasa, 1994, elihlobene nezinhloso zezepolitiki futhi ohlawulwe ejele ngaphandle kokukhetha inhlawulo, noma uma bekungumkhonyovu, uma behlawulwe ukuba bakhokhe inhlawulo noma ejele noma kokubili; noma ngaphandle uma engum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika noma enephepha lokuhlala okuphakade eNingizimu Afrika. Umuntu ophuthelwe yimihlangano emibili noma ngaphezulu yeBhodi ngokuqhubekayo ngaphandle kokuthola imvume yeBhodi. Kumele bathumele incwadi yokuhoxa kuNgqongqoshe. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zeZikhungo, iBhodi ingaba... neziqu noma amandla abona efanele noma adingekayo. Bangaqasha, baphathe amaholo, noma baphume abantu bezikhungo; futhi benze noma yini eholela ekufezeni izinhloso, futhi kumele bahlaziye njalo isakhiwo, inhlangano, nezinhlelo zeZikhungo. Bangasebenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi obekwe nguNgqongqoshe; futhi benze uphenyo noma ucwaningo mayelana nezinhloso zeBhodi uma kubekwe nguNgqongqoshe. IBhodi ayikwazi ukusungula, ukuthola, noma ukusebenzisa inhlangano noma isikhungo esihlobene nezindaba zase-Afrika, kodwa ingaqala noma iphakamise izinhlelo ezibona ezifanele ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhloso zeZikhungo: Kuze kube yilapho lezi zinhlelo zenzeka ngokubambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona noma izikhungo ezikwazi ukuzenza. Ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zeZikhungo, iBhodi ingahlinzeka ngosizo kunoma yimuphi umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ophila kwelinye izwe ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi. IBhodi kumele ihlangane noma ibambe imihlangano okungenani kathathu ngonyaka, futhi imihlangano izobanjwa ngesikhathi nendawo ezobekwa nguMongameli ngokwazisa amalungu amanye. UMongameli angabiza umhlangano okhethekile weBhodi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, okumele ubanjwe ngesikhathi nendawo ezobekwa nguMongameli. Inani lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni angakwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano nokwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu eBhodi. Noma yiziphi izinqumo zeBhodi kumele zenziwe ngokusekelwa kwenani elikhulu lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni weBhodi, futhi uma kube nokuhlangana kwenkinga ethile, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote yokugcina ngaphezu kokuvota kwakhe njengelungu leBhodi. Ilungu leBhodi lingavota noma lithathe ingxenye ekwenzeni umhlangano weBhodi noma libe khona endaweni lapho umhlangano ubanjwa khona uma likhona izithakazelo ezithinta le ndaba ngaphambi noma ephakanyisiwe yiBhodi ezivimbela ukuba likwenze kahle izibopho zalo njengelungu leBhodi, futhi ngaphandle kokubandlulula futhi ngendlela efanele. UPhakathi koMongameli; kanye namanye amalungu eBhodi, angadluli kwabahlanu, njengoba kubekwe yiBhodi. Ikomidi eliphethe elisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 kumele lenze imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo yiBhodi. UMongameli weBhodi kumele abe nguMongameli wekomidi eliphethe. Ikomidi eliphethe kumele lihlangane ngezikhathi nendawo ezibekwe nguMongameli wale komidi, futhi inani labantu abakhona abakwazi ukwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu wekomidi eliphethe. IBhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwamakomidi, lapho ingase ibeke khona amandla noma imisebenzi ethile ebekwe noma enikezwe iBhodi ngalo Mthetho. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalesi sihloko kumele libe neziqu ezithile zamalungu eBhodi nabasebenzi beBhodi, uma bekhona, abona iBhodi ifanele, futhi iBhodi ingakhipha noma ibuyise noma yikuphi ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanelekile. Uma ikomidi linezithakazelo zamalungu eBhodi ezingaphezu kwelungu elilodwa, iBhodi kumele ibeke elinye lamalungu abo ukuba kube nguMongameli wale komidi. IBhodi ayinakubanjwa icala lokwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi obekwe kunoma yikuphi ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba. Le msebenzi yokudlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi kumele kube kuxhumene ngencwadi kumamukeli. IBhodi ingasungula ithimba labeluleki kunoma iyiphi indawo yesayensi yokuxhumana uma ibona ifanele. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele libe nabantu abahlanu abaphumelelayo abaneziqu noma ulwazi oluthile noma okuhlangenwe nakho endaweni yezindaba zase-Afrika okukhuluma ngayo, futhi abangamalungu eBhodi. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele ibeluleka iBhodi nganoma iyiphi indaba ephathelene nezindaba zase-Afrika ezazisunguliwe. Ilungu lethimba labeluleki kumele libe neziqu ezithile, kuhlanganise nezimo zokuhola, ukuhamba emihlanganweni, nokuhlinzekwa kosizo, okuzobekwa nguNgqongqoshe ngokubonisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. IBhodi ingasusa noma iphelelise ubulungu bokuqashwa kwanoma ilungu lethimba labeluleki nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma kukhona izizathu ezanele zokwenza njalo. Amalungu ethimba labeluleki awazotholi ukwesekwa kwezimali kwiBhodi ngenkathi bebamba lezi zikhundla. IBhodi kumele, ngemuva kokubonisana noNgqongqoshe, ibeke uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi. Lo Mphathi Omkhulu
Ezokusakaza: Umcimbi Wokuhlola Izinga Lokuxhumana Ngomhla wesithupha kuNcwaba ka-2023, umcimbi obaluleke kakhulu ezindabeni zokuxhumana, owaziwa ngokuthi "Ezokusakaza: Umcimbi Wokuhlola Izinga Lokuxhumana," wabanjwa eThekwini. Lo mcimbi wahlanganisa abaholi bezokuxhumana, osomabhizinisi, nabaculi, nangaphezulu, abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejolise ekuhloleni izinguquko kanye nezinto ezintsha ezithinta umkhakha wezokuxhumana. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo yephayona, uMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumholi ophakathi kokwenziwa kwezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Ubonge ithuba lokuqwashisa abantu ngempumelelo yezeMidlalo Yezokuxhumana, ukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba athathe izinyathelo zokuqonda nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Uthe, "Ezokusakaza akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sibe nomoya wokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu." Ngemuva kwalokhu, abezindaba baphinde babamba izingxoxo ezithakazelisayo, zabhala izifundo ezitholakele kumaphrojekthi ahlukeneyo. Ucwaningo olunzulu lwashicilelwa, lukhombisa ukuthi izinguquko ezinkulu zenzekile ezokusakaza, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokukhula kwe-inthanethi nokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezokuxhumana. Okwalandelayo, umcimbi waphinde waziwa ngeminye imicimbi emincane, efana nezinkulumo-mpikiswano nezifundo ezisebenzelana nezitshudeni ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Kwakukhona amaphaneli ahlukahlukene, abakhuluma ngezihloko ezihlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemikhankaso yokuxhumana, indlela yokuphumelela kwezokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokugcina izinsiza. U-Ramona Nkosi, umculi odumile, wabelane ngexperiences yakhe nohlu lwezinkinga ezihambisana nezokuxhumana. Uthe, "Ukubandakanya izethameli, nokwenza ukuthi zibe neqhaza kumculo, kukhulisa ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi komculi nomlistener." Lokhu kwavusa izimvo ezinkulu phakathi kwabantu ababephakathi, kwavusa ukukhuluma ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, umcimbi wahlanganisa nemisebenzi yokuzijabulisa, lapho abaculi bendawo bephakanyiswa. Umculi uSipho Mthethwa, ophumelele izicoco eziningi, uphinde waba nemibono emihle ngokuqhuba umncintiswano wokuhlola amakhono abantu. Lokhu kuveze amakhono amaningi, futhi kwabavakashi ithuba lokubona ubuqhawe bendawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ugcwaliswe ngokuqhubeka nezinkulumompikiswano ezinzulu, ezibandakanya abaholi bezokuxhumana nezincwadi ezikhuluma ngempumelelo. Uhlelo lwenziwe ngothando nolwazi olunamandla, lwehla kwezinkinga ezibhekene nomkhakha wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlola kwavusa umoya wokubambisana, okwandisa imiqondo emisha kanye nezixazululo ezithinta umkhakha. Njengoba umcimbi uphetha, uMnu. Mthembu ubabaza bonke abathintekayo, abavakashi, kanye nabaculi ngokuhlanganyela kwabo. Uvuselela umoya wokuhlanganyela, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokwakha izixazululo ezinzima zokuxhumana ukuze umphakathi ube nobudlelwano obuhle. "Sihamba phambili, sihlanganyela izinzuzo, futhi sihlonipha izinguquko. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwethu," kusho yena. Lo mcimbi ubonisa ukuthi ezokusakaza akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Kwaba ukufunda, ukujabulisa, nokuhlanganyela, okwenza kube yinsakavukela yokwazisa abantu ngempilo yabo, izifiso, nemibono. Umcimbi ubusemthethweni, ubonakalisa izifiso zokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, nezokuxhumana. Ngalolu suku, umphakathi wathola ithuba lokubambisana, wahlola izindlela zokuxhumana eziyimpoqo. Ukuhlola izinga lokuxhumana kwavula amathuba amasha, kwaholela ekutheni abantu baziqhenye ngemisebenzi yabo, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinsuku ezizayo zikhombisa ukuthi ezokusakaza ziyothuthuka, zikhula, futhi ziqhubeke zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wethu.
Uhlelo Lokuxhaswa Kwezokuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi Labaqashi Abamnyama (BBSDP) uhlelo lokwabelana ngezindleko ngesisekelo se-80:20%, oluxhasa amabhizinisi aphethwe ngabantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo lunikeza lezi zinkampani indlela yokufinyelela ezinsizeni zokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi ukuze zandise amakhono azo, zithuthukise amandla okuphatha, futhi zihlukanise ukuze zibe nomncintiswano omkhulu. Izinhlaka eziningi zinezimboni eziphethwe ngabantu abamnyama (ngokubambisana okungama-50+1), futhi kukhona nezinkampani eziningi eziphethwe ngabantu abamnyama. Izinkampani zingathola usizo oluvela ku-BBSDP olungafika ku-R12 million ngonyaka. Isimo esibalulekile sokufaneleka ukuze uthole usizo ukuthi inkampani kumele ibe sebenza okungenani unyaka owodwa futhi ibambe iqhaza kwezohwebo. I-BBSDP ihlose ukukhulisa amabhizinisi aphethwe ngabantu abamnyama ngokuwaxhumanisa nezinkampani ezincane eziphethwe ngabantu abamnyama (SMMEs) futhi ixhumanise nezinhlangano ezinkulu kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo wombuso. I-BBSDP ibambisana futhi ixhumanisa nohlelo lokwabiwa kwemithombo yokuthenga kulabo abake babhekana namathuba alinganiselwe, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngamathuba okuphuma emsebenzini, okuhlinzekwa yizinkampani ezinkulu kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo wombuso. Inhloso wukuthi izimboni zithole ukwabiwa okumele kukhishwe ekutholeni imithombo yokuthenga ezinkampanini ezinkulu kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi kanye namathuba okuphuma emsebenzini. Inani elikhulu lokuxhaswa okungatholwa yizimboni ngalinye lingafika ku-R100,000 (izinkulungwane eziyi-100 rand). Inkampani eyodwa ingavunyelwa ukufaka izicelo zamaphrojekthi ahlukene, kodwa inani eliphelele lokuxhaswa alinakudlula u-R100,000. Zonke izindleko ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo zebhizinisi, kuhlanganise nezokuhamba nezinye izindleko zokuphila, zizokwenziwa ngokwabelana ngezindleko. Izindleko zokushicilela izinto kanye nezindleko ezihlobene nekhompyutha, kuhlanganise nezindleko zokuqala zamaphrojekthi, nazo zizohlinzekwa, uma zingadluli ku-50% yezindleko eziphelele zamaphrojekthi. Izinkampani zingakhetha ukuthi zizosebenzisa kanjani abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kulandela isimo sokuthi okungenani abathathu kumele babe khona ekukhetheni kulabo abaphakamisile imithombo yokuthenga. Amaphrojekthi ahloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokuphatha ezisebenzayo, ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wendawo jikelele nasekuhleleni ukukhiqiza ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ze-ISO 9000 ne-ISO 14000, kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo zebhizinisi zesikhathi eside, phakathi kokunye. Ukuxhaswa ngokwabelana ngezindleko kuzotholakala lapho kudingeka kwezidingo ezihlobene nekhompyutha nezifanekiso noma amabhroshuru asekelayo inqubo yokuphatha ezingeni eliphezulu futhi esebenza kahle. Amaphrojekthi ahloselwe ukusiza ithimba lokuphatha lenkampani ngokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuqeqesha emikhakheni ehlukene, ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kwezokuphatha eziphakeme, izinhlelo zokuphatha noma zokuphatha kwezezimali, ama-workshop okuhlela imithombo yokuthenga ezinkampanini zomphakathi kanye nezinhlangano ezinkulu, phakathi kokunye. Amaphrojekthi ahloselwe ukusiza inkampani ukuthi ingene emkhakheni othile, ngokwesibonelo, ucwaningo lwemakethe nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokumaketha, izifanekiso, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinto zokumaketha, njengezinhlelo zewebhusayithi, phakathi kokunye. Ukwabiwa kwezindleko zokwabelana emikhakheni ethile kuzohlinzekwa ukuze kusizwe ekushicileleni amabhroshuru alwazi nezinto ezihlobene ukuze zisetshenziswe ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokumaketha.
Ukubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezibhedlela: Isingeniso Namuhla, ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlengikazi baqonda kahle izidingo zomtholampilo. Ukubhaliswa okufanele kwenziwa kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olunembile noluphumelelayo. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nqubo, sithintane nosokhemisi, uNkk. Nandi Zulu, ophakathi kulesi sikhungo sosizo lwezempilo. Uhlanga 1: Imininingwane Yokubhaliswa Umxholo: U-Nkk. Nandi, ungachaza kanjani ukubaluleka kokubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela? U-Nkk. Nandi: Ngempela, ukubhaliswa kweziguli kubalulekile ekuphatheni impilo. Lokhu kube lula uma sithola imininingwane efanele evela ezigulini, okuhlanganisa amagama, izigameko zezempilo, nemithi ethathwayo. Lokhu kusiza ohlelweni lokunakekelwa, kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zihlolwa ngendlela efanele. Uhlanga 2: Izinyathelo Zokubhaliswa Umxholo: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ekubhaliseni isiguli? U-Nkk. Nandi: Okokuqala, uma isiguli sifika, qinisekisa ukuthi sinefomu lokubhaliswa. Futhi, sicela imininingwane efanele, njengokubhaliswa kwezakhamuzi nezinombolo zokuxhumana. Uma kudingeka, siphinde sihlola izinga lempilo ukuze siqonde kahle isimo somuntu ofake isicelo. Uhlanga 3: Ubulungiswa Nobuchwepheshe Umxholo: Ingabe izindlela zobuchwepheshe zenza kube lula ukubhaliswa kweziguli? U-Nkk. Nandi: Yebo, ubuchwepheshe budale izinguquko ezinkulu. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokubhalisela ezokwelapha, sikwazi ukuthola amarekhodi eziguli ngokushesha, kunciphisa isikhathi esithathwa ukufaka amafomu. Iziguli zingabhaliswa ngezingcingo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela. Uhlanga 4: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Umxholo: Zikhona izinselelo obhekana nazo, futhi yini izixazululo? U-Nkk. Nandi: Yebo, sihlangabezana nezinselelo ezithile. Abanye abantu bavame ukungabhalisi ngenxa yokukhathazeka ngemininingwane yabo. Siphinde sithole abantu abanezimali ezincane, abavame ukufika sebesebenzisa isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokufika ezibhedlela. Sihlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhululekile, sigqugquzela iziguli ukuba zihlale zikhuluma nathi. Uhlanga 5: Izigaba Zokuhlola Umxholo: Njengoba kubhaliswa, ingabe kukhona izigaba okufanele zihlolwe? U-Nkk. Nandi: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinyathelo ezithile. Njengoba sibhalisa, kudingeka sithole ukwaziswa okunembile ukuze sihlole izinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukene, njengokuthola imithi ethile edinga ukuvakasha njalo, ukusungula isu lokuphathwa kwemithi. Uhlanga 6: Isiphetho Umxholo: Ungahlinzeka ngesixwayiso sokugcina kulabo abathanda ukungena ezibhedlela? U-Nkk. Nandi: Ukugcina impilo yakho kubalulekile, ngakho-ke ukuzihlonipha nokulandela izinyathelo zolwazi kuzokugcina uphephile. Ukubhaliswa akufanele kube sikhumbuzo, kodwa kube yinsiza yempilo yakho. Thola isikhathi sokwazisa imindeni, thintana nathi uma kunemibuzo. Ukubhaliswa kwesiguli akuyona inqubo elula, kodwa iyinsiza ebalulekile yokugcina iziguli ziphilile. Isiphetho Esiyinqaba Lokhu kube yintshisekelo enkulu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aqonde ukuthi ukubhaliswa kweziguli akuyona inqubo elula, kodwa kuyinto ebalulekile eqhubeka neqembu labahlengikazi, abezempilo, nemindeni. Kumele siqhubeke nokuxhumana, sithole izixazululo, futhi sithuthukise ubumba obuphakathi kokubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela.
Ubufakazi Bokukhanselwa Kobulungu Besikhwama Sangaphambilini Ngonyaka ka-2005, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wathola ithuba elisha lokuthola izinsizakalo zezempilo eziphakeme ngokuvulwa kohlelo lweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Lolu hlelo lwenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi lwaba yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, abanye ababeqashwe ngaphansi kwesikhwama baqala ukubona izidingo ezahlukene, okwaholela ekutheni bacabangele ukukhansela ubulungu babo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza izimo eziningi ezithinta izinqumo zabantu. Abanye babebona ukuthi izindleko zokuhlinzekwa kwezempilo zikhuphuka, kanti abanye babenokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo, okwaholela ekutheni badinge izixazululo ezihlukile. Lokhu kwaholela ekukhulumeni okujulile phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi bezempilo, njengoba bekudingeka ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abanye abantu baqala ukufuna ubufakazi bokukhansela ubulungu babo, okuyisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi umuntu usemthethweni ekukhanseleni ubulungu bakhe. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa bukhombisa izinsuku ezithile, izizathu zokukhansela, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokuxhumana, okwenza kube lula kubantu abahamba phambili. Nokho, ukukhansela ubulungu akukhona okwenziwa kalula. Abantu badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nalokhu, okukhona izinyathelo okufanele zithathwe. Lokhu kuhilela ukufaka isicelo sokukhansela, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, kanye nokulinda impendulo evela kubaphathi besikhwama. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, futhi abanye abantu bahlala bephazamisekile ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle izinqubo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu babebona ukuthi ukukhansela ubulungu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni baphinde bacabangele izinzuzo zokuhlala ngaphansi kwesikhwama, njengoba izinsizakalo zezempilo zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enkulu, njengoba abantu bephakathi kokufuna izixazululo ezinhle, kodwa futhi bephakathi kokufuna ukuzimela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abaphathi bezempilo baqala ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe kubantu abakhansela ubulungu babo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe, ezazihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esihle, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhansela ubulungu. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza ukuthi abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi baphinde bahlola izinketho zabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlola izinsizakalo zezempilo, ezazihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinketho ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaba yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, njengoba abantu beqala ukufuna izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ekugcineni, ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza ukuthi abantu badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezihambisana nokukhansela ubulungu kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi bezempilo, ukuze kube nokuhlanganyela okuphumelelayo. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi bahlale bephokophele izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini buveza indaba ebalulekile yokuthi abantu badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezempilo yabo.
Ihhovisi leMenenja yeMuni liphatha ngokubambisana neHhovisi leMeya kanye neHhovisi leSpeaker ukuze kulawulwe Izinhlelo Ezikhethekile. Lezi zihloko ezilandelayo zikhombisa isimo esingashintshi mayelana nokuphumeleliswa kwezinhlelo ezikhethekile. Le hhovisi iphinde ibhekele izinkinga zokuxhumana zomphakathi, okuyingxenye entsha eyasungulwa ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2006/7. Izindawo ezibalulekile zokugxila kule ngxenye zizoba ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kweBhodi, abathintekayo, nomphakathi. Idivayisi ye-Internal Financial Audit kanye ne-IDP/PMS ibhekwa ngqo yiHhovisi leMenenja yeMuni. Ngokufanayo, i-divisi yeM youths isunguliwe futhi ifakwe kule mnyango. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhumbula ukuthi zonke lezi zindawo ezingenhla nemisebenzi yazo zingaphansi kweMnyango Wezokusebenza njengoba kushiwo kuMqulu Wezokwakha, kodwa ngenxa yokungabi nesikhala sokuba uMphathi weMnyango, uMenenja weMuni ubhekele le Mnyango kuze kube isikhala sigcwaliswa. Ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo, iSisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya ngokuba nezakhiwo ze-Intergovernmental Relations (IGR) ezihanjiswa ngempumelelo nezisebenzayo. Izakhiwo ze-IGR azikakabi zisebenza ngokuphelele eSisonke District Municipality. Kukho ukungabi nosizo oluvela kubasekeli, okwenza kube nokushoda kwezinsiza zezimali ukuze kusekelwe lezi zakhiwo. I-HIV/AIDS nezinkinga ezihlobene ne-AIDS zikhona emhlabeni jikelele, futhi izibalo zikhombisa kahle ukuthi e-republic, KwaZulu Natal iyisifunda esinabantu abaningi abathintekile futhi abathintekayo yi-HIV virus kanye ne-AIDS uqobo, futhi iSisonke District Municipality ayiyona eyokuhlukile. I-Sisonke District Municipality isiqalile ukuthatha izinyathelo ezisheshayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi leli zinga lokutheleleka elikhathazayo ligcinwa phansi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni, ama-CBO, izinsizakalo ezingekho kuhulumeni, nezinye izinhlangano kanye nezithakazelo. Lokhu kubambisana kuhlose ukusungula ngokusemthethweni iHhovisi leHIV/AIDS eliphelele lesifunda. Le Ndlu izoba yisakhiwo esihola izindaba ezihlobene ne-HIV/AIDS kanye ne-AIDS uqobo. Okwamanje, iMuni isebenza nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ukuze ihlele umkhankaso wokwazisa ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMuni izobamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokusekela abantu abaphila ne-HIV/AIDS ngokwakha amaqembu okusekela, njengoba iMuni inezidingo eziningi ezivela emphakathini. Kuphinde kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bemuni bangase bathinteke nalesi sifo, yingakho inhloso iwukuba ne-divisi yezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezizogxila kulezi zindaba. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyimuni enezindawo eziningi ezisemakhaya enezinga eliphezulu lokungafundi, ukushoda kwamakhono, kanye nobuphofu. Abesifazane bayathinteka kakhulu kulokhu ngoba emlandweni bashiye ekhaya ukuze banakekele izingane futhi abahambi esikoleni noma emsebenzini. Ngakho-ke, iMuni inomthwalo omkhulu wokukhulula abesifazane emcabangweni wokuncika kwabanye nasebuphofini. Abesifazane abameleki kahle kuzo zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni nezinye izakhiwo ezingekho kuhulumeni ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Kukho ukungabi namandla kwezomnotho kwabesifazane. Ukuze kulwe nalezi zinkinga, iMuni ibambisana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngemininingwane ehlose ukuqinisekisa abesifazane lapho kudingeka, kucatshangelwa ubukhulu balolu bungozi. Phakathi kwezinye izinto, iMuni inezinyathelo ezibekwe ukuze ibhekane nalolu bungozi: uhlelo lokufunda olusebenzayo, isu lokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Imikhankaso yokwazisa ngezindaba zabesifazane nezobulili nayo iyingxenye ebalulekile yohlelo lwethu. Konke okukhuluma ngenhla kuhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuqashwa kwabesifazane nokusebenza kokwakha amandla. Kuhlezi, iSisonke District Municipality izosungula iWomen’s Forum yesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iSisonke District Municipality isekela imizamo yabesifazane ngokuxhasa lezi zinhlelo zezolimo: iphrojekthi yeSukume yeziqhamo eziluhlaza, nephrojekthi yeKraansdraai, njll. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya futhi ihlonipha amalungelo abantu abadala abahlangabezana nokuhlukunyezwa, ukungabi nokufinyelela osizini lwezimali, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezimbi ezindlini zabo. I-Muni ibamba imihlangano eqhubekayo yabantu abadala lapho lezi zinkinga zixoxwa khona. I-Muni ihlose ukuba nemihlangano ehlangene neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi kanye neMnyango Wezangaphakathi ukuze ibhekane nezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abadala. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yomphakathi wayo ehluke-hlukeneyo mayelana namasiko nolimi esifundeni; Nokho, izilimi zethu namasiko adinga ukuvuselelwa nokuvikelwa nganoma yiziphi izindleko. Ngokufanayo, iSisonke District Municipality ibamba imicimbi ehlukahlukene yamasiko/ukuncintisana ukuze ikhuthaze ukuhlukahluka kwamasiko endaweni. I-Mnyango Wezobuciko namasiko ungomunye wabathintekayo abahlanganyela neMuni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi namasiko. Kukhona imicimbi yamasiko nemikhankaso eqhubekayo yokwazisa nokuzinza kokuhlukahluka. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya futhi ihlonipha amalungelo abantu abaphila nezinkinga. Abantu abaphila nezinkinga banokuhlukumezeka; bahlukunyezwa futhi bahlonishwa, yingakho bengameleki kahle ezakhiweni zikahulumeni nasemphakathini. Abanye abakwazi ukufinyelela ezikoleni ngenxa yokushoda kwezikhungo ezikhethekile ngaphakathi kwesifunda. I-Muni ihlose ukulungisa lesi simo ngokubandakanya iMnyango Wezemfundo, ihhovisi leMphakathi, kanye neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. I-Muni inezinqubomgomo zokuphatha ukuqashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaphila nezinkinga bayathola imisebenzi. Imihlangano yokwabelana ngemininingwane yabantu abaphila nezinkinga nayo ibanjwa njalo esifundeni. I-Sisonke District Municipality isungule iforamu yabantu abaphila nezinkinga njengesenzo esifanele sokubhekana nalolu bungozi. Le foramu ihlangana kathathu ngonyaka ukuze ixoxe ngezindaba ezithinta abantu abaphila nezinkinga. I-Sisonke District Municipality, iMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, iMnyango Wezempilo, kanye neminyango yasendaweni baphumelele ukuhlela usuku lwabantu abaphila nezinkinga eVulekani Special School, lapho izithuthuthu zanikwa abantu abaphila nezinkinga abafunda kule sikole. I-Sisonke District Municipality izozama ukuhlinzeka le sikole esikhethekile ngensizakalo ezikhethekile ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2008/09 nakweminye iminyaka ezayo. Ihhovisi leMALUNGelo ABANTWANA (ORC) ngaphansi kweMnyango Wezamalungelo Abantu, elivikelwe yiHhovisi leMphakathi laseKwa
Uma kwenzeka izinto ezivamile empilweni yakho, ungase ube nesifo noma ulimele, ngakho-ke uzodinga ikhefu lesifo ukuze uphumelele esifweni noma kulimala. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ukulimala lapha akukhulumi ngokulimala emsebenzini. Izinsuku ezijwayelekile zokusebenza zezikhefu zesifo zingama-36 (36) ezihambisana nemiholo ephelele, okuyilokho okuvumelekile kwezikhawu zesifo. Ukuvumelekile kwezikhawu zesifo yisikhathi seminyaka emithathu elandelanayo. Uma wazi kusengaphambili ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini othile noma ungene esibhedlela uma kufanele ube sebenza, thumela isicelo futhi uqedele ifomu lakho lesicelo kusengaphambili. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma ulimele, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ukulimala. Umlayezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngozakwethu, umngane, noma omunye umuntu uyamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ukulimala sikuvimbela ekubikeni kumphathi wakho uqobo. Thumela isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi ubesebenzile izinsuku ezintathu noma ngaphezulu FUTHI uma usebenzise izikhawu zesifo ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezimbili phakathi nesikhathi semaviki ayisishiyagalombili, kuzokwenziwa ukunakwa ngesikhathi sokuphuma emsebenzini. Futhi, bheka isigaba sokuvunywa kwezitifiketi zesikhawu sesifo ngezansi. Sebenzisa futhi uthumele izikhawu zesifo ngokresponsibly nangokuhlakanipha. Gwema ukusebenzisa izikhawu zesifo ngenjongo ezingezona izifo nokulimala, njengoba ungase uthole ukuthi ubhekene nesimo esizayo mayelana nezikhawu zakho zesifo. Bheka futhi unikeze izikhawu zesifo ngokwezicelo zakho. Phenya futhi uhlole amacala athile afanayo okusebenzisa okungafanele izikhawu zesifo ezijwayelekile. Bese uthatha isinyathelo uma kudingeka. Umqashi angase, kwezinye izimo, acela isitifiketi sezokwelapha sokungabikhona okwesikhashana okungaphansi kwezinsuku ezintathu uma kutholakala ezinye izimo ezifanayo. Qondisa abasebenzi ngendlela efanele yokusebenzisa izikhawu zesifo ngokuhlakanipha. Hlanganisa izidingo zomsebenzi noma zokuqashwa noma funa umsebenzi omunye, ikakhulukazi ezimeni ezidinga lokhu. Izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ziwumvuzo ongafaka isicelo sazo uma izinsuku zakho ezijwayelekile zesikhawu sesifo seziphelile, okuyilokho okuvumelekile kwezikhawu zesifo zeminyaka emithathu (3). Faka isicelo usebenzisa amafomu afanele. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi kufanele ufake isicelo usebenzisa amafomu abekwe phansi ukuze uthole izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ngokufanele. Awusazodingeki ukusebenzisa ifomu le-Z1 ngenjongo le. Uma wazi kusengaphambili ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini othile noma ungene esibhedlela uma kufanele ube sebenza, thumela isicelo futhi uthumele ifomu lakho lesicelo kusengaphambili. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma ulimele, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ukulimala. Umlayezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngozakwethu, umngane, noma omunye umuntu uyamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ukulimala sikuvimbela ekubikeni kumphathi wakho uqobo. Ngaso sonke isikhathi thumela isitifiketi sesifo uma ufaka isicelo. Ungathumela imibhalo esekelayo yezicelo zokwelashwa nolwazi nemibono eyengeziwe ehambisana nesicelo sakho sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele. Gwema ukusebenzisa izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kungumphathi wezempilo nokuphepha. emva kosuku lokuqala lokungabikhona emsebenzini. Umqashi uzokunikeza izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ngokususelwa kumphumela wokuphenya mayelana nohlobo nesimo sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele. Inqubomgomo nezindlela zokuphatha izikhawu zesifo ezinganele kanye nokuhamba kwezempilo yi-PILIR. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokususelwa kumiphumela. Lokhu kungaba umqashi wakho noma wena uqobo uqala ukuhamba kwezempilo uma kukhona ukungabaza ukuthi ungasebenzi futhi. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke, ngokwesibonelo, ngemuva kokuhlaselwa kwemoto okukhulu. Uma ufaka isicelo sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele zesikhathi eside futhi uphenyo lomqashi lukhombisa ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukusebenza futhi, bangase baphakamise isicelo sakho sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele sibe isicelo sokuhamba kwezempilo. Ungase ucelwe ukuthi uqedele amafomu acacile wezicelo zokuhamba kwezempilo. Thumela izitifiketi zesifo nanoma yiziphi imibiko yezokwelapha nolwazi nezinye izicelo. Izindlela ezengeziwe zokuhlola zingase zidingeke njengengxenye yokuphenya ukuze umqashi enze isinqumo esiqondile mayelana nokuphumelela kwezikhawu zesifo ezinganele noma okunye. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokususelwa kumiphumela. Ngokuqondene nezikhawu zesifo ezinganele, umqashi uzokwamukela kuphela izitifiketi ezikhishwe ngodokotela abhalisiwe kwiNhlangano Yezempilo YaseNingizimu Afrika futhi abaneziqu ezisemthethweni zokuxilonga nokwelapha iziguli. Isitifiketi sezokwelapha kufanele, ngovuma lwakho, sichaze uhlobo nobubanzi besifo/ukulimala. Igama, ikheli, nezifundo zodokotela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi udokotela unikeza isitifiketi ngokususelwa kumphumela wokuhlola, noma ngenxa yolwazi olutholwe kumguli futhi olwamukelwe njengokwelashwa kwezokwelapha okusekela. Isikhathi esinconyiwe sezikhawu zesifo kanye nosuku lokukhishwa kwesitifiketi sesifo. Isaziso sodokotela uma usebenzisa izitifiketi eziphrintiwe, noma yiluphi ulwazi olungahlangene nomguli kufanele lususwe. Umqashi ungase uqale futhi uphenye isicelo sakho kuphela ngemva kokuthi usuthumele ifomu lesicelo kanye nawo wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubuyela kudokotela wakho ukuze uqedele umbiko odingekayo oyingxenye yamafomu wezicelo. Ifomu lesicelo lingase libe yingozi ekufinyeleleni kwakho ezikhawu zesifo ezinganele noma ekuhambeni kwezempilo. Umqashi uzokunikeza isikhathi sokuphumula ngalokhu. Umqashi uzogcina amarekhodi ngezikhathi ezisetshenziswe njengokuphumula kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku olulodwa. Lokhu kuzoboniswa kumarekhodi akho ezikhawu zesifo. Kulindeleke ukuthi kulokhu uzogcwalisa irekhodi lesikhathi esingasetshenziswanga ukuze kugcinwe amarekhodi. Ubufakazi bezimo ezinjalo buzodingeka njengoba kudingeka. KuMnyango Wezikhungo, phatha ngaso sonke isikhathi noma yiluphi ulwazi mayelana nesimo sezempilo sozakwethu nganokuhlonipha nangokufihlekile.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana: Ukuqonda Izidingo Zempilo Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Njengoba izinsizakalo zezempilo zikhula, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi baqonde indlela yokuthola usizo oludingekayo. Nokho, abantu bahlushwa yizinselelo eziningi uma kuziwa ekugunyazweni kodokotela, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngama-authorization ama-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme).
