Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela kuhilela inqubo yokuthola imvume yokwelashwa. Lokhu kudinga ukufaka isicelo sokwelashwa, esivame ukufunwa odokotela abaqeqeshiwe. Nokho, inqubo yokuthola le mvume ingaba yinkimbinkimbi, ikakhulukazi uma abathengi bengazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga uxhumano olucacile phakathi kodokotela, abathengi, kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo. Ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezakhamuzi nezinsizakalo zezempilo kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Uma odokotela beqonda izidingo zamakhasimende, lokhu kungakhuphula amathuba okuthi abathengi bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo. Odokotela kumele babe nekhono lokuxhumana, ukuze bakwazi ukuchaza izinqubo, izinzuzo, nezingozi zokwelashwa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengi kufanele bakwazi ukuveza imibuzo ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo. Nokho, abanye abathengi bahlala bezwa ukuthi izinqubo zokuthola imvume zidinga isikhathi eside, okuholela ekudikibeleni. Lokhu kudala ukungabaza ekutheni izinsizakalo zezempilo zingasiza kanjani. Ukuxhumana okungafanele phakathi kodokotela nabathengi kungaholela ekutheni izinqubo zokwelashwa zibe nzima, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola usizo. Kudingeka kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsizakalo zezempilo nezinsizakalo zempilo. Abathengi badinga ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izinqubo zokugunyazwa, nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole ukwelashwa. Izinsizakalo zempilo kufanele zibe nezinqubo ezicacile zokuxhumana, ukuze abathengi baqonde kahle indlela yokuthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi abathengi bazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izinsizakalo zempilo ezithile, bese beqonda kahle lokho okumele kulindwe. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokufundisa eziphumelelayo ukuze abathengi bazi izinqubo ezidingekayo. Ngokuphathelene nezinkinga ezikhona, izinsizakalo zempilo zidinga ukuqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengama-apps, ukuze abathengi bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula kulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola imvume yokwelashwa, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ezinqubweni zokwelashwa. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kubalulekile ekutholeni izinsizakalo zempilo eziphumelelayo. Abathengi kufanele bazi ukuthi bangakuthola kanjani ukusiza, futhi baziswe kahle ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Izinsizakalo zempilo kufanele ziqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abathengi bathola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, ngaphandle kokubhekana nezithiyo eziningi. Ekugcineni, ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zempilo zabathengi. Abathengi badinga ukwazi ukuthi bangafinyelela kanjani izinsizakalo zempilo, futhi izinsizakalo zempilo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abathengi bazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola ukwelashwa, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba phambili ezinqubweni zokwelashwa. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezinsizakalo zezempilo nabathengi, ukuze sithuthukise izinga lenkonzo yezempilo esiyitholayo.
Ulimi lomuntu ngandlela thile luyisikhumba sesibili, lukhombisa okuthile okukhona kumuntu ongokoqobo, lapho sikhombisa khona ithemba nezifiso, sikhuluma ngemicabango nemigomo yethu, sithola ulwazi nemikhuba yethu, futhi sakha umphakathi wethu nemithetho eyawulawula. Ngolimi, singasebenza njengabantu emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethayo liyavunywa nguMthetho Wamalungelo Nezivumelwano zethu, okukhombisa ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziyinsiza okufanele isetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi, ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eqotho, ekugcineni sikwazi ukwethula uhlaka lwezinhlelo zolimi lweNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuwumphumela womsebenzi oqale ngo-1995, lapho ngibeka khona iQembu Lokuhlela Ulimi (LANGTAG) ukuze linikeze iseluleko ngohlaka oluphelele lwezinhlelo zolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sibalulekile ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuphikiswa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi kanye nomphumela wokuthi "ukusebenza kokukhuluma ngolimi oluningi kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe lusekelwe emiphumeleni yokubambisana ngokubonisana, lusebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG namandla eMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neQembu Lokweluleka Ngolimi. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luyadingeka ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zethu ezahlukene zolimi kanye nokufinyelela kukahulumeni emgomeni wokukhuthaza ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nenhlalakahle yombuso. Kulesi simo esihle, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zezwe lethu, njengoba kukhankanywe nguMthethosisekelo, kube nendawo ebonakalayo kulezi zinhlelo. Lezi zinhlelo ziqhakambisa futhi ukuthi ukubaluleka kwezilimi zethu kukhombisa kakhulu ngokusetshenziswa kwazo ezimeni zomnotho, zomphakathi, nezepolitiki. Uma ulimi lulahlekelwa ukubaluleka kwalo kulezi zimo, isimo salo siyancipha. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luphinde lukhombise ukuthi sibhekene nenkinga yokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele futhi ukuthi izilimi zethu zendabuko kumele zibe yingxenye yephuzu elishintshashintshayo lobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi sizobuyisela isimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendabuko eNingizimu Afrika. Ngiyethemba ngokuhlonipha ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela lezi zinhlelo zesiZwe Zolimi njengezabo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ngokubambisana, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziba yiqiniso elibonakalayo ezimpilweni zethu, zenza sibe neqhaza lokuqhakambisa ubunikazi bethu obuhlukile baseNingizimu Afrika.
Amabhizinisi Amancane: Umhlahlandlela Wokwakha Impumelelo Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, amabhizinisi amancane athola ukuthandwa okujulile emazweni amaningi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abafuna ukuzimela nokwakha impumelelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba amabhizinisi amancane adlala indima enkulu ekukhuliseni umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokugcina amasiko. Kulolu hlelo, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka ezidingekayo ukuze uqale futhi uqhubeke ngokuphumelelayo ekwakheni ibhizinisi elincane. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Imakethe Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ibhizinisi, kubalulekile ukuqonda imakethe ofuna ukuyisebenza kuyo. Lokhu kusho ukwenza ucwaningo lokuhlola izidingo zabathengi, izimbangi, nolwazi olujulile ngezwa nezinselelo. Dala imibuzo efana nale: Yini oyidingayo ukuze uthole ubuhlakani bokwakha ibhizinisi? Yiziphi izidingo ezikhona ngaphandle? Okunye, cabanga ngezinselelo ozobhekana nazo, bese ubheka izixazululo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubhala Ibhizinisi Plan Ngemva kokuhlola imakethe, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukubhala uhlelo lwebhizinisi. Lolu hlelo kufanele luhlanganise izici ezibalulekile ezifana nembono yebhizinisi, izinjongo, iziteshi zokuthengisa, kanye nezikhala zemali. Uhlelo lwebhizinisi lungaba yisikhumbuzo sokhombisa indlela okumele uhambisane nayo, futhi lungada usuqhamuka nezinsiza okufanele zimiswe ukuze uqinisekise ukwakheka kwebhizinisi eliqinile. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuthola Izinsiza Zezimali Ukuze uqale ibhizinisi elincane, kufanele ucabangele izinsiza zezimali ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungafaka izimali ezivela kuma-credit union, amabhange, nokuxhaswa kwezomnotho, njengemali yokutshala. Qiniseka ukuthi ufunde kahle izinketho ezitholakalayo, bese ukhetha okukhona okufanele. Ukuze uthole ukuxhaswa kwezezimali, ungase udinge ukufaka isicelo sebhizinisi elijulile elichaza umbono, izinjongo, nezindlela zokusebenza. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubhalisa Ibhizinisi Umthetho uyadingeka uma usebenza emhlabeni wokuhweba. Qiniseka ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho libhaliswe ngokusemthethweni, futhi uthole izimvume ezidingekayo. Kulokhu, ungaxhumana nezikhungo zomthetho ukuze uthole usizo oludingayo. Bheka imithetho yangakini, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhlonipha zonke izidingo ezikhona. Isinyathelo 5: Ukumaketha Ibhizinisi Ibhizinisi lakho lidinga ukumakethwa ukuze lithandwe. Sebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokumaketha, ezifaka phakathi ukufaka izikhangiso ezikwi-inthanethi, kumaphephabhuku, nasemakhasi ezokuxhumana. Ukumakwa okuhle kuzosiza ukuthola amakhasimende amasha, nokwakha igama elihle elizokwenza ibhizinisi lakho likhule. Sebenzisa ukuxhumana nabantu ukuze udlulisela izindaba zomkhiqizo noma sevisi yakho. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuphatha Ngempumelelo Lapho ibhizinisi seliqalile ukusebenza, kubalulekile ukuphatha kahle futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinsiza zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphatha imali, izinsiza zabantu, nezinsizakusebenza. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ezitholakalayo ukuze uqaphe ukwenziwa kwedatha yebhizinisi. Qiniseka futhi uyazise amarekhodi wonke, ukuze ube nolwazi olunembile lokwenza izinqumo ezicyiwe kakhulu. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuphucula Futhi Uthuthukise Emhlabeni onguye, kudinga ukuba umqondo wokuphucula njalo. Ngemuva kokuhola ibhizinisi, ubheke izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi ube lula nokuthuthukisa imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho. Thola imicabango yokuthengisa, vakashela amabhizinisi ahlukene ukuze uthole umbono, futhi uqhubeke uthola izifundo ezithuthukisayo. Kubalulekile ukuba nekhono lokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezimakethe. Isiphetho Amabhizinisi amancane angumthombo omkhulu wokukhuthaza abantu ezweni. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo eziyisisekelo, ungakha ibhizinisi elinempumelelo elizokwakha amathuba kubanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Zama njalo ukukhuluma nezikhuthazi, unganqikazi ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi uthokozise wonke umzamo wakho. Ngalesi sikhathi, ungaphumelela futhi ube nesithakazelo sokuphumelela emisebenzini yakho.
Umlando Wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal Umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal ubonisa izigameko eziningi ezibalulekile ezihlanganisa izinkolo, amasiko, nezinguquko ezithinta abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Le ndawo, eyaziwa ngempilo yayo ehlukahlukene, ibonisa izimpawu ezithile zomlando wezepolitiki, kusukela ezikhathini zokuqala zeMpi Yezizwe, kuze kube sekuhlanganyeleni kwezepolitiki kwamanje. Ekuqaleni, iKwaZulu-Natal yayiholwa yizinkosi ezihloniphekile, ezazibusa ngamalungelo nezinkolelo zamasiko. Izinkosi ezifana noShaka Zulu zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ubumbano phakathi kwabantu baseZulu. UShaka, owaziwa ngokuba ngumholi onamandla, wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihlanganisa izimpi, ukuhlela izinsiza, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezwe elinokuthula, kodwa futhi kwaba nemiphumela emibi, njengoba izimpi zashintsha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iKwaZulu-Natal yathinteka kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuhlaselwa kwekoloni. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle lezi zinguquko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkolo ezahlukene zafika kule ndawo, zashintsha izimpilo zabantu. Abantu baseZulu babebhekene nezinguquko ezinzima, njengoba izinkosi zabeziqonda ukuthi kufanele ziqhubeke zikhuluma nezakhamuzi ukuze zigcine amandla azo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuphatha, okuhlanganisa izivumelwano ezazihlosiwe phakathi kwezizwe. Ngemva kokuhlaselwa kwekoloni, iKwaZulu-Natal yathola ukulawula kweBrithani, okwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezakhamizi eziningi ezazihlanganyela ezindabeni zezepolitiki. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokwakha izikhungo ezihlukene zokuphatha, okuhlanganisa izifunda ezaziholwa ngababusi abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iKwaZulu-Natal yaba yindawo yokulwa kwezepolitiki, lapho izinkampani ezahlukene zifuna ukwakha amandla. Izinkampani ezinjenge-ANC (African National Congress) ne-IFP (Inkatha Freedom Party) zaba nezimpi ezinzima, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwezindawo ezahlukene zokuphatha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezinzima zokuphatha, lapho abantu bephikisana ngezinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, ubulungiswa, nezinsiza. Ngalesi sikhathi, iKwaZulu-Natal yathola ukwakheka kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ezazihlosiwe, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezazihlosiwe zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, okuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iKwaZulu-Natal yathola ukwakheka kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ezazihlosiwe, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezazihlosiwe zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, okuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Namuhla, iKwaZulu-Natal ibonakala njengendawo ebalulekile kwezepolitiki, lapho abantu behlanganyela ezindabeni ezithinta izimpilo zabo. Izinhlelo zokuphatha zikhula, futhi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, ubulungiswa, nezinsiza. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngokubheka emuva, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal ubonisa izigameko eziningi ezibalulekile ezithinta abantu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu baseKwaZulu-Natal bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi, futhi lokhu kuqhubeka nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha. Umlando wabo ubonisa ukuthi, nakuba bezama ukwakha ubumbano, izinkinga zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu.
Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition Ngomhla ka-15 kuMfumfu 2023, kuzoba nomcimbi obalulekile obizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition" eGoli. Lo mcimbi uzobanjelwa emnyangweni wezokwakha, futhi ubhekelele ukukhuthaza izimboni, abenzi bezinqubomgomo, kanye nezakhamuzi ukuthi ziqonde futhi zisebenzise amathuba anikezwa ushintsho lwamandla olulinganayo. Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition luveza indlela yokuhamba phambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba khona kokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, kuhlonishwe izidingo zomphakathi, futhi kube nokulingana kwezinsiza. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinzima ngenxa yokukhuphuka kokushisa komhlaba, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibhadele lezi zinguquko ngendlela efanele, engathinti kuphela umnotho, kodwa futhi ibhekele izidingo zomphakathi. Lo mcimbi uzohlanganisa izinkulumo ezibalulekile ezivela kubachwepheshe abanolwazi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa, ezokwakha, nezemvelo. Abakhulumeli bazoletha imibono ehlukene ngokuqonda okukhulu kokuthi ushintsho lwamandla lungaholela kanjani ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, kanti kuzoba nezifundo ezivela ezinhlelweni eziphumelelayo ezisunguliwe emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma, kuzoba nezikhangiso ezizokwenza abafundi bacabange ngendlela engapheli. Lokhu kuzobandakanya izinkampani ezihamba phambili emkhakheni wamandla avuselelekayo, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kanye nabasakazi abasebenza ekudluliseni ulwazi oludingekayo mayelana nezinguquko ezisemqoka ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuze bonke. Izinhlelo ezishiwo zizosiza ukwazisa abantu ngamahla okutshala imali, izindawo zokutshala, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa amandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinkampani eziningi, ezokuxhumana, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zamanje. Ukwengeza, lo mcimbi uzohlinzeka ngethuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwamabhizinisi kanye nabaphathi. Abahlanganyeli bazoba nethuba lokuxhumana, ukuphakamisa imibono, futhi benze izixazululo ezihlukene zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani ezihlukahlukene kuzokwandisa amathuba okusebenza ndawonye ukuze kucaciswe indlela yokuphumelela kulesi sikhathi sokuguquka. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinhlelo, kulindeleke ukuthi lo mcimbi ube nezingxoxo ezinzulu, lapho abahlanganyeli bengabeka khona imibono yabo, iziphakamiso, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo ekushintsheni kwangempela. Izinkulumo ezizohlanganisa abaholi emkhakheni wezemvelo, abezindaba, nezikhungo zokucwaninga zizokwenza kube nempumelelo enkulu yokwazisa abantu. Ngokuhamba phambili, lo mcimbi uyavuma ukuthi ushintsho lwamandla kufanele lwenziwe ngezindlela ezithinta wonke umuntu. Lokhu kusho ukufaka izinsiza ezitholakala kalula, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zemfundo, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emisha emphakathini. Umgomo uwukuthi ushintsho lwenziwe ngendlela efanele, ngenkathi kugcinwa umqondo wobulungiswa, ukuze bonke abantu bakwazi ukuzuzwa kulokhu kutshala imali. Sicela ubhalise ku-inthanethi ukuze uqinisekise indawo yakho, ngoba indawo imincane. Lo mcimbi unikeza ithuba elihle lokuthola ulwazi, ukuxhumana, nokwenza umehluko omuhle emiphakathini yethu. Ngokuhlanganyela, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlonipha izidingo zomphakathi futhi luthuthukise amandla avuselelekayo. Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition luyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizoshintsha indlela esibuka ngayo amandla, futhi lusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobulungisa, nolungele ikusasa. Hamba nathi, ungaphutheli leli thuba lokuba yingxenye yalesi sikhumbuzo esiyingqayizivele sokwakha ushintsho olunempumelelo.

Le moto ihlinzekwe ngezici ezikhethwayo phakathi kwakho, ukudluliswa kwedijithali okuphezulu kweTetra, amakhompyutha anama-imeyili, i-inthanethi, ne-fax. Ingagcina amarekhodi ngendlela eyamangalisa. Imishini idlala indima ebalulekile ekudluliseni lokhu ngohlelo olufanele kulabo abanentshisekelo. Futhi kulolo mcimbi obalulekile, ezokuxhumana zaseNingizimu Afrika zaziphazamisekile futhi zaphazanyiswa nguhulumeni ngesikhathi somsebenzi wazo. Usizo oluvela kubantu ngqo emphakathini noma, ngaphandle kwalokho, kulabo abavela emithonjeni yokutshalwa kwezimali, noma ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lokwakha nokusebenza. Ingabe lezi mhlawumbe yizinto ezisetshenziswa umgibeli wekrikethi mayelana nenani lamabhola abholayo? Ezikoleni zabafundisi, bazokwazi ukuphatha, ukusetshenziswa kwabo kokwesekwa kwetheory, izinsiza zabo, kanye nokufundisa kwabo kuzothintwa ngochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe. Omunye wabo wukuthuthukiswa kwamazwe ethu njengoba silwela ukuthula, ubumbano, kanye nokuphumelela kokungahlukanisi ngokobuhlanga. Umvictim waphushwa ngamandla futhi wabekwa endaweni yokugcina izithuthi lapho wahlukunyezwa. Amaphoyisa afika endaweni yobugebengu abona umsolwa eduze kwesitolo. Ngakho, sithuthukise ikhono elithile lokubheka nokuphepha ezingeni lendawo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwalabo abathole izinzuzo ngaphambili nalabo abangenzi, kanye nesici sokugcina sokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Idizayini ehleliwe ngokungahleliwe isetshenziswe ngendlela ethile, incike enanini lemali elitholakalayo ebhizinisini. Abasebenzi abaqokwe muva baveza ukuzinikela kwabo ukusiza imiphakathi yabo. Ukudoba ukuze ube nokuphila kuyasetshenziswa emiphakathini eduze kolwandle ethembele ekudobeni ukuze kudliwe, noma inelungelo lokuthengisa noma ukushintshanisa lokho ngento ethile. Okwamanje, labo abawudobayo ukuze baphile badinga ukuthola imvume yokudoba kuze kube kube nezinqubomgomo zokudoba ezikhona. Ukuze umuntu adobe ukuze aphile, kumele afake isicelo semvume bese freed to fish for subsistence. Ukuze usebenzise ilungelo lakho lokudoba, faka isicelo sokukhululwa esizokwenziwa ngumenzi wezokuphatha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi onelayisensi yokwenza lo msebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 18 soMthetho Wokuphila Kwezilwane Zomhlaba we-1998. Ukuze othile akhululwe, kumele athumele isicelo sakhe kwi komidi esiseduzane esibekwe ukwenza lo msebenzi futhi ahlangabezane nezidingo ezichaziwe. Ngokomthetho, akekho ongadoba ukuze aphile ngaphandle kwemvume. Imvume ivuselelwa minyaka yonke, futhi uma ungawuqondi imithetho yokukhululwa ukuze udobe, imvume yakho izophakanyiswa, iphume, noma ilungelo lakho lizokhanselwa. Faka isicelo sokukhululwa ukuze udobe kukomidi eliphethe lo msebenzi eduze kwakho uma imvume yakho iphelelwe isikhathi ekupheleni konyaka. Abafaki bezicelo zemvume kumele bahlangabezane nezidingo ezichaziwe zokudoba ukuze baphile ngaphambi kokuthi banikezwe imvume. Abafaki bezicelo kumele baveze ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlanzi abazodoba. Isimo semvume yakho sizohlolwa ngaphambi kokuthi unikezwe imvume yonyaka ozayo; uma kukhona izidingo ezingahlangabezaniwe, uzosuswa ohlwini lwabantu abavunyelwe. Abasebenzi boMnyango bazobamba umhlangano womphakathi ukuze banikeze imvume kubo bonke abawudobayo abaqashile. Abasebenzi boMnyango bazochaza imithetho yemvume nokuthi bangadoba kangakanani. Izinqubo zamacala amakhulu enkohlakalo Isingeniso Enkohlakalweni, amacala amakhulu ahlanganisa izenzo ezithinta kakhulu umphakathi, ezokuphatha, nezomnotho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinyathelo ziqhutshelwa phambili, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Lezi zinhlelo zizosiza ekuphatheni amacala enkohlakalo ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Uhlaka Lwenkohlakalo 1. Chaza Uhlaka: Qonda kahle ukuthi yini okukhuluma ngayo. Uhlaka lwenkohlakalo lungaba yizinkampani, uhulumeni, noma abantu ngabanye. 2. Thola Izinsiza: Bheka izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezifana nezincwadi, izifundo, nezifundo ezihlobene nezinkohlakalo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuqoqa Ubufakazi 1. Hlanganisa Ubufakazi: Qala ukuqoqa ubufakazi obukhombisa izenzo zokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kungabandakanya imibhalo, izithombe, noma izinkulumo. 2. Bhalela Izincwadi: Qopha zonke izinsiza ozitholile, ubhale izincwadi ezichaza kahle ubufakazi obuqoqiwe. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubika Ubulungiswa 1. Thumela Umbiko: Ngemva kokuhlanganisa ubufakazi, thumela umbiko kumaphoyisa noma emaphoyiseni akhankanywe. 2. Hlanganyela Nezikhulu: Hlanganyela nezikhulu eziphethe ukuhweba, ukuze ziqonde ubungozi obuhambisana nalolu daba. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Amacala 1. Bheka Ubufakazi: Ubufakazi obuqoqiwe kufanele buhlolwe ngochwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubuqotho bawo. 2. Thola Abafakizolo: Xhumana nabafakizolo abangaqinisekisa ubufakazi obukhona. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphendula 1. Hlela Izinqumo: Ngemva kokuhlola, hlela izinqumo zokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo zokuvikela abathintekayo. 2. Thumela Izinyathelo: Thumela izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bayazi. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuphathwa Kwamacala 1. Bheka Ukuxhaswa: Qinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bathola ukuxhaswa okuhle, kungaba ngokomoya noma ngokwezimali. 2. Phendula Ngomqondo: Hlinzeka ngempendulo engokwemvelo ukuze abathintekayo bazizwe bekhululekile. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubuyekeza Izinyathelo 1. Bheka Imiphumela: Ngemva kokuphothula amacala, hlola imiphumela yokugcina. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda ukuthi izinyathelo zithinteka kanjani. 2. Phakamisa Izinguquko: Uma kudingeka, phakamisa izinguquko ezizothuthukisa izinqubo zokuphatha amacala enkohlakalo. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuqeqesha Abasebenzi 1. Hlela Ukuqeqesha: Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphatha amacala enkohlakalo. 2. Phendula Ngemibuzo: Nikeza ithuba lokuphendula imibuzo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke bayakuqonda. Isinyathelo 9: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuvikeleka 1. Hlinzeka Ngemigomo: Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezikhumbuzo ezicacile ezivimbela izenzo zokukhwabanisa. 2. Bheka Ukusebenza: Hamba phambili ubheke ukusebenza kwezinqubomgomo ezibekwe. Isinyathelo 10: Ukubika Izinkinga 1. Thumela Izinkinga: Uma kunezinkinga ezivela, thumela izinkinga kumaphoyisa noma ezikhungweni eziphethe. 2. Qhubeka Ulandela: Landela izinkinga ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zixazululwa. Isiphetho Izinqubo ezichaziwe lapha zidinga ukugcinwa ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amacala enkohlakalo aphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nezikhulu kubalulekile ekulwisaneni nalesi sifo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophila ngaphandle kwenkohlakalo.
Ama-Robot: Ukuqonda Nokubaluleka Kwabo Emhlabeni Wethu Isingeniso Ama-robot, noma amajazi, ayizinto eziphilayo ezakhiwe ngabantu ukuze zisebenze imisebenzi ethile. Lezi zinto zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuhlanganisa i-artificial intelligence (AI), ukuze zikwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, kusukela ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukuya ekusizeni abantu ezindabeni zempilo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ama-robot akhula futhi athuthuka, eba yizinsiza ezibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukwakhiwa Kwamajazi Ama-robot akhiwa ngama-computer, izinjini, nezinto ezihlukahlukene zokwakha. Ukwakhiwa kwawo kudinga ulwazi olunzulu lwezobuchwepheshe, ubunjiniyela, kanye nezifundo ze-robotics. I-robotics iyinsika yokwakha ama-robot, futhi ibandakanya ukufunda indlela yokuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinjini, nezinto eziphilayo ukuze ama-robot akwazi ukusebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abenzi bama-robot baqonde kahle izimiso zokuqhuba imisebenzi. Izinhlobo Zama-Robot Kunezinhlobo eziningi zama-robot, futhi zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Okokuqala, sinesigaba sama-robot asebenza emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza, njengezinhlelo zokuhlanganisa imikhiqizo ezimbonini. Lezi zinto zisebenza ngokushesha futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ikhiqizwa kahle nangempumelelo. Okwesibili, sinesigaba sama-robot asebenza emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ama-robot asebenza ezibhedlela, afana nezitho ezisiza odokotela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile. Ama-robot angasiza ekwenzeni izivivinyo, ukwelapha, noma ukusiza abantu abanezimfanelo ezithile. Okwesithathu, sinesigaba sama-robot asebenza ezindaweni zokuhlala, njengezindlu ezihlakaniphile. Lezi zinto zingasiza abantu ngezinto ezilula, njengezinhlelo zokulawula ukukhanya, ukufudumeza, noma ukuhamba. Lokhu kwenza impilo ibe lula futhi ithokomele. Ubuchwepheshe Be-Artificial Intelligence Ubuchwepheshe be-artificial intelligence buwusizo olukhulu ekuthuthukiseni ama-robot. I-AI ivumela ama-robot ukuba afunde futhi akhule ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ama-robot angakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ahlaziye izimo, futhi akwazi ukuphendula ngendlela efanele. Ngokusebenzisa i-AI, ama-robot angakwazi ukuxhumana nabantu, aqonde imiyalo, futhi enze imisebenzi ethile ngaphandle kokuba nomuntu ophakathi. Izinhlelo Zokusebenza Zama-Robot Izinhlelo zokusebenza zama-robot zibalulekile ukuze ama-robot akwazi ukusebenza kahle. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokulawula, izinhlelo zokufunda, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zinhlelo, ama-robot angakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ethile, ahlaziye izimo, futhi enze izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abenzi bama-robot baqonde kahle izimiso zokuqhuba imisebenzi. Izinzuzo Zama-Robot Ama-robot anikeza izinzuzo eziningi emhlabeni wethu. Okokuqala, akwazi ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, okwenza kube lula ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo eningi ngesikhathi esifushane. Lokhu kunciphisa izindleko zokukhiqiza, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola imikhiqizo ngentengo ephansi. Okwesibili, ama-robot angasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi eyingozi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imisebenzi efana nokuhlanza izindawo ezinezingozi, noma ukusebenza ezindaweni ezinzima. Lokhu kunciphisa ubungozi kubantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi eyingozi yenziwa ngama-robot. Okwesithathu, ama-robot angasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo. Ngokusebenzisa ama-robot ezibhedlela, abantu bangathola usizo oluphuthumayo, futhi ama-robot angasiza odokotela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Izinkinga Nezingozi Noma ama-robot enezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nawo. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqashwa kwabantu. Njengoba ama-robot ethuthuka, abantu bangase baphume emisebenzini yabo, okungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba emisebenzi. Okwesibili, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqiniswa kwemithetho. Njengoba ama-robot ethuthuka, kudingeka ukuthi kube nemithetho eqinile yokulawula indlela ama-robot asebenza ngayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-robot asebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi akwenzi ubungozi kubantu. Isiphetho Ama-robot ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu wanamuhla. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ama-robot azoba nezindima ezinkulu ezimpilweni zethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle ama-robot, izinzuzo zawo, nezinkinga ezihambisana nawo. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukusebenzisa ama-robot ngendlela efanele, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi azithuthukisi kuphela impilo yethu, kodwa futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenza ngokuhlonipha abantu.
Umthelela wokukhula kwe-Amapiano emhlabeni uThandiwe Mthembu ungumculi, umdansi, nomphakathi ophumelelayo ophuma eGoli, eNingizimu Afrika. UThandiwe, owaziwa ngelika "DJ Thandi," ubonakale njengomunye wabaculi abavela phambili emkhakheni we-Amapiano, umculo ophuma eNingizimu Afrika, odume ngama-rhythms akhe ahlakaniphile, izigqi ezijabulisayo, kanye nezinsimbi ezahlukene. UThandiwe, oneminyaka engu-28, waqala ukuhamba phambili emculweni ngonyaka ka-2019, lapho aqala khona ukudala ama-tracks akhe. Ukudala umculo we-Amapiano, uThandiwe ulandela izinyathelo zabadlali abanjengoKabza De Small noDJ Maphorisa, ababephumelele kakhulu kulomkhakha. UThandiwe uthembisa ukuhlinzeka ngomculo ophilayo, ogcwele imizwa, futhi ubonisa izici zamasiko ahlukahlukene aseNingizimu Afrika. Umculo wakhe uhlanganisa izitayela eziningi, okuhlanganisa i-house, i-jazz, ne-gqom, okwenza kube lula ukuheha izilaleli ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Ngokukhula kwe-Amapiano, uThandiwe ubone umthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Umculo wakhe ufinyelele ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela emazweni ase-Afrika, njengeZimbabwe, Nigeria, naseKenya, kuze kube yizifunda ezikude njengeYurophu neMelika. UThandiwe uthembisa ukuthi umculo we-Amapiano ungumkhiqizo wezobuciko obuhlanganisa abantu, ubavumela ukuba baxhumane ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. UThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungumthombo wokuxhumana, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Uthi, "Umculo ungumhlaba wonke; awunamkhawulo. Ngiyajabula ukuthi umculo wami ungakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene." Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uThandiwe akagcini nje ngokuba umculi, kodwa ungumholi wezobuciko, ophakamisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe ubonile ukuthi umculo we-Amapiano usuhamba phambili, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni izinkanyezi ezintsha. Uthe, "Ngiyazi ukuthi ngikhona ukuze ngithumele umyalezo, futhi ngifuna ukuba yisibonelo sabanye abaculi abasha." UThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yinsiza yokukhuthaza, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi kubantu abasha. UThandiwe akagcini nje ngokuba umculi, kodwa ungumfundisi. Uthanda ukufundisa abanye abaculi abasha izindlela zokwakha umculo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yinsiza yokuphila. Uthi, "Ngifuna ukusiza abanye ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo, njengoba mina ngithole ithuba lokwenza okufanayo." Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uThandiwe ungumuntu onomoya wokubambisana, futhi uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yomphakathi. UThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi umculo we-Amapiano ungumkhiqizo wezobuciko obuhlanganisa abantu, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Uthi, "Ngiyajabula ukuthi umculo wami ungakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene." Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uThandiwe akagcini nje ngokuba umculi, kodwa ungumholi wezobuciko, ophakamisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. UThandiwe Mthembu ungumculi ophumelelayo, kodwa ungumuntu ophila impilo enomoya wokubambisana. Ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungumthombo wokuxhumana, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuphendula kwenqubomgomo yokuphila kahle emlilweni waseMarshalltown Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkinga zomlilo, eMarshalltown, umoya wawuphola, abantu benza imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Bebehamba ezitolo, besebenzisa izithuthi zabo, bengazi ukuthi isiphithiphithi somlilo sasizokwandisa. Umphakathi wawujabule, uhlezi uqine, kodwa izinsuku ezilandelayo zazizoba nezinsuku ezinzima. Ngobusuku bokugcina, phakathi kwezinkanyezi, umphakathi wakwaMarshalltown waphahlazeka. Umoya wawugijimela ezitolo, izindlu zathi ziqweqwediswa abantu ababephila kahle. U-Palesa, umfundi ophumelelayo, waphonsa umandlakudla phezulu, ethola umfundi ophuma ngebhasi elithela izincwadi. Nokho, lokhu akuzange kuhlale isikhathi eside. Ngaphakathi kwemizuzu embalwa, uPalesa wathola izimemezelo eziphuthumayo. Umphumela ovela kumaphoyisa wawufike ngokushesha - "Kunezimpawu zomlilo eMarshalltown! Bona bazalwane, sisonke!” Kwakukhona ukudideka phakathi kwabantu, abanjwe yiphupho lokugwema. UMkhulu Mkhize, owayesebenzela le ndawo iminyaka engama-70, wabona umakhelwane wakhe, uThandiwe, edlulisa uPalesa ngaphesheya kwesiteshi. “UThandiwe, hamba!” wathukile uMkhulu Mkhize. “Umoya usheteleka kuhle! Gcina umahluko!” Ngoba umoya uphonsa umlilo onuka, uPalesa uqhubeke ngokunqoba izinyembezi, ethola isigcawu eceleni. Izinyoni zobumnyama ziqhume zinyakazise umoya, zishayisa iphupha lokuqhubeka – lombhali wakhe uDali, obekhuluma ngezinkanyezi, waba nendaba epholile. Emva kokuhlangana nabantu abasha, uPalesa wathola umyalezo ophusile. “Kulukhuni, thina sonke, ngabe sizokwazi?” Ngaphandle komphakathi, kuqhamuke imibiko, iziphathimandla zeziphakamiso zikhombisa izithombe ezinkulu zemililo, izincwadi zathumela ezikhathini ezikhethekile - akekho omubi. Zama ukuthola ukusiza komphakathi, kanye nomphakathi othintekayo. Kuhlale kube nesithukuthezi sokuhlola esivela ezinhlelweni ezihamba phambili, ezokuphila. Ukukhala kwamaphoyisa nakho kwaba nenhlangano, ababhali bemithombo yabanikazi bezingane, befundisa. Ujjabulo likaMshayisa, isikhulu esisebenzayo, wathi: "Sidllalile! Sidinga ukuvuma imiyalelo yethu yedlanzana yokuphila. Noma sikhathazekile, sonke sidinga ukuba sizoxhumana." Ephendula, uDali wakhipha ikhamera, azama ukuthola izithombe zezingane namahlathi aphephile. Izinyoni zomlilo zaveza umqondisi walolu hlobo olufanele. U-Palesa noMkhulu Mkhize, uThemba kanye noThandiwe baqoka phakathi kwezinhlelo zabalandeli. Nakuba umphakathi ungabekezelelanga, bakha iphrojekthi ezwakalayo nezihlala ziphila kahle. Babheka ithuba lokuphokophela ezindaweni ezinde, bejabulile, beseshandleni. Kufika amakhaya, abakhokheli bemibuthano baphula ubumba, bebuya nemishado ethulile kwazulu. Izinyathelo zenzeka, uDali ube esehamba. Umphakathi wawuhamba ngobunono, uqhamuke ezindaweni zoruba futhi uPriya, umphakathi owazi, wabamba ukujola komlilo. “Sigcwaliswe! Ngabe ubani ofuna sizinike umkhulumela?” ukuthula kudlula phakathi komphakathi. Ukuze babe phambili, umoya ube nokuphila komhlaba, ukwakha kuchaza ukuthi yonke into iyashintsha. Kwathi kube sekuphakanyiswa, isibani somkhosi sakuveza umhlaba. Uhlanga lwabantu lwavuka njengendlela ehlanzekile. Perfector kaMarshalltown, uMshayisa, uqhubeke nokuhlala phambi komphakathi ukuze azobathokozisa. Nokho, izinto zazeziqeda. Umbangi wendlaleko umoya wobuhlungu waba ngaphezu kokubukeka kwezigidi zabantu, uze kube izinsuku eziyisi-30. Uhlanga lwakhe lwegazi luhambela emoyeni opholile, neqhaza lezakhamuzi ekubuyiseleni umphakathi – abantu abahamba abavumi, abadliwe yincithakalo. Okwamanje, izinyoni zize zinike ithuba lokuvuma, okuthakazelisayo – baqinisekile. Ngabe umphakathi uzobona ukuphila? U-Palesa, uMkhulu Mkhize kanye noDali bahlala bephelezela phakathi kwethembiso, bejolisa izinyoni zabo uhulumeni omnyama. "Umhlaba uzoshintsha, futhi sizohamba phambili!" sakhuluma. Ngemuva kwemililo, umcimbi wemimoya yebhubesi umhlaba wathola uhlanga facebook, izigidi zabantu zaphenduka ezinhle. Izinyoni zashintsha imoya, umthombo wabantu wachuma. Kuhlabelela ukugubha, izahluko zafika, kwavela imiphumela emisha—umphakathi wawuwathola emamitha amasha. Ngakho, emgwaqweni ifika intokozo, umthwalo wokusebenza usithole ngesikhathi. Uhlelo lokusiza, iziteshi ezisondelene nezinkanyezi, zakhula. Okugqoka uDali washiywa, njalo ukhona – imizamo ezihambisayo khipha umhlaba wethu, izindawo ezinhle zihlala kuzo. Ekugcineni, umhlaba wavuka, izinyoni zamaphoyisa zayovuka lapho ziqhubekela phambili. U-Palesa, uThandiwe, noMkhulu Mkhize babonisa ukuqhubeka, ngokukhalipha umvuzo, ikakhulukazi emoyeni wobuhlungu. Umphakathi wathola ubumnyama, kodwa wahamba phambili, kuxhumene izinselelo ezihambayo. Ukuphumelela yinto enhle, ukuncintisana ubuhlungu ubukhona, nomsebenzi wabo wawuhamba phambili. "Sesibona!! Phezulu! Umhlaba, ubuhlungu, uzothola ukuthula!” yakhazimula izinqaba zabo ezincane, ziqhubeka ukusebenza, zikhuluma nokukhanya! Umphakathi wawukwazi ukuvuka, umoya rawusa, ukuhluleka kwakhalaza emnyangweni, kube emhlabeni, bese kuze kuphume ubukhosi bemithambo eMarshalltown. Ngakho, emlilweni walolu hlobo lwezinto, umoya womphakathi wathola ubukhulu bokuphinda, wahlala!
Iphrofayela KaMnu. Thabo Mkhize: Umsebenzi Wokulwa Nokungcola Kwemvelo Mnu. Thabo Mkhize, indoda enomlando ocebile kwezokulima, ungomunye wabantu abaziwayo emkhakheni wokuvikela imvelo. Wazalelwa eDurban, edolobheni elidumile, lapho aqala khona ukuthanda imvelo esemncane. Uhlanga lwakhe lwasemakhaya lwamfundisa ukubaluleka kokuhlala imvelo ihlanzekile, futhi imishado yakhe ngemvelo yathuthukiswa kakhulu ngesikhathi efunda ezikoleni eziphakeme. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe ezemvelo, uThabo waqala ukusebenza neqembu labalimi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, behlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokulwa nokungcola kwemvelo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinto eziphilayo lwamvumela ukuba abe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuvuselela imvelo. Waqala imikhankaso yokuhlanza izindawo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezivame ukuba nezingcolile, lapho athi "ukuhlanza akusikho ukuphuma phambili, kodwa kuwukuhlala unempilo." Njengoba edlula ezikhathini ezintsha, uThabo wabona ukuthi ukungcola kwemvelo akukhawulelwanga ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa kuthinta wonke umhlaba. Ngaleso sikhathi, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngezinkinga ezinzima ezibangelwa ukungcola, njengokuguguleka kwemithombo yephunga emanzini, ukungcoliswa komoya, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila ezibangelwa umnotho ongazinzile. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aqale izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi, ethula izinkulumo ezinzulu ezimayelana nezindlela zokunciphisa ukungcola. Uhlanga lwakhe lwezokulandela imikhankaso yokuvuselela imvelo lwamvumela ukuba asebenzise amakhono akhe njengomfundisi. UThabo wenza izifundo ezihlukahlukene ezikoleni, edlulisela abafundi izifundo mayelana nokubaluleka kokuvikela imvelo, nokuthi bangayithokozisa kanjani imvelo yabo. Uqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana baqonda ukuthi imvelo iyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabo, futhi kufanele bahloniphe futhi bayivikele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThabo ube nesandla ekwakheni amaphrojekthi ahlanzekile, afana nezinhlelo zokusebenzisa kabusha izinto ezingasetshenziswanga, futhi abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokugcina izitshalo eziningi, ukuze kugcinwe imvelo ihlanzekile. Uthando lwakhe lokusebenza kahle luholele ekutheni abamemezeli bakhe baqonde ukuthi isimo sezulu sihlukile, futhi kudinga imizamo ejulile ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga ezikhona. UThabo ungumholi onekhono, futhi ubamba iqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayaziswa futhi baqonda izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokugcina imvelo ihlanzekile. Uthanda ukwabelana ngamava akhe nabanye, futhi njalo uthokozisa abanye ngempumelelo yakhe. Ukukhombisa umoya wokubambisana, uhola imihlangano yokuhlola izinyathelo ezenziwa ezindaweni ezithile, futhi akhawunti kaThabo iyakhuthaza njengoba edlulisela uthando lwakhe lokuvikela imvelo. Njengomuntu obonisa ukuzinikela okukhulu, uThabo usaqhubeka nokusebenza ngezinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokwandisa ulwazi mayelana nokungcola kwemvelo. Uhlanga lwakhe lokwenza umehluko luye lwalulekile emiphakathini eminingi, futhi umphakathi uyiwa ngokuziqhenya ngokusebenza kukaThabo. Uthando lwezinto eziphilayo, ukuhlonipha imvelo, nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwenza uThabo Mkhize engumholi ongenakuphikiswa emkhakheni wezemvelo. Uhlanga lwakhe lokuzinikela luye lwagcina imiphakathi ibukeka ihlanzekile, futhi uThabo ubukeka njengomfundi onobuhlakani. Njengoba eqhubeka nokwenza umehluko emhlabeni, uhamba phambili nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphathe kahle imvelo yabo. Uthando lwezinto eziphilayo, ukuhlonipha imvelo, nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla kwenza uThabo Mkhize engumholi ongenakuphikiswa emkhakheni wezemvelo. Njengomuntu owenza umehluko, uThabo usaqhubeka nokusebenza ngezinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokwandisa ulwazi mayelana nokungcola kwemvelo, futhi uthokozisa umphakathi ngempumelelo yakhe. UThabo Mkhize, umphakathi uyakubonga ngokuzinikela kwakho, futhi ubonisa indlela yokuba yisibonelo esihle esifanele ukulandela.
Lokhu okukhuluma lapha kuhlose ukusekela bonke abalimi abazama ukuthola umhlaba/izindawo zokulima, kodwa kubalulekile futhi kulabo asebevele benazo izindawo zokulima ukuba bakwazi ukuhlola izimo zabo mayelana nokuphumelela kwezohwebo zabo kanye nekusasa. Ukuba ngum sahibi womhlaba sekuyindaba edinga ukunakwa futhi kuvame ukusetshenziswa ngababambisene nezepolitiki ukuze baphikise abanye. Nokho, umlimi ofisa ukuphumelela uma ethola umhlaba kufanele acabangele kahle zonke lezi zinto ezilandelayo. Kukhona ukulwa nezindaba ezingafanele mayelana nokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba; kunezindawo zokulima ezithengiswa ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi kumele kube nomuntu ofuna ukuthenga nomuntu ofuna ukuthengisa, kodwa izindawo zokulima eziningi azikafikanga kulabo okufanele bazuze ngokuthola indawo yokulima. Thina, abavela ngaphandle kwalesi senzo sokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba, siphonsa imibuzo ngendlela abatholwe ngayo abantu abathole izindawo zokulima. Kuvame ukuba sithole injabulo yabantu abathole izindawo zokulima, kodwa masinyane sithola ukuthi le phrojekthi yehlulekile, ifile, futhi ayilethi inzuzo! NgoMashi 2010, uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya noMthetho Wokuguqulwa Komhlaba, uGugile Nkwinti, uvumile ukuthi izinhlelo zikamasipala zokuguqulwa komhlaba azizange zibe nempumelelo ngoba abaningi abathole umhlaba bahluleka ukuwusebenzisa ngendlela ethola inzuzo kanye nezinzuzo zezimali. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba kubeka engcupheni umgomo kahulumeni ophokophele ekuguquleni ukuba ngabantu abamnyama ngo-30% ngaphambi kuka-2014. Lokhu kuyicala! Bonke abantu abathintekayo kwezolimo eGrain South Africa nalabo abakwiGrain Value Chain bakholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela umhlaba kufanele kuqhubeke kahle ukuze ukukhiqiza kwezolimo ezweni lethu kuqinise ukutholakala kokudla esikhathini esizayo. Kunzima ukuqonda ukuthi abathintekayo ekukhetheni abantu abazozuza ngokuthola umhlaba basebenza kanjani. Kumele sikholwe ukuthi abakhangele abangane babo, ukuthi bahlolwe kahle ukuze inqubo yokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba iqhubeke ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze wonke amazwe ngezindlela ezinhle. Kulapho umlimi ofisa ukuba professional emsebenzini wakhe wokukhiqiza ukudla angathatha leli thuba lokuthuthukisa isimo sakhe. Abantu abacabanga futhi abafuna ukulima izinkundla zabo nokusekela umthetho wokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba kufanele bahlele izindlela zabo ngendlela efanele. Kumele baphakamise abalimi abasafufusa abazophumelela. Kuvame ukuba nabantu abathembela kuphela enhlanhleni kodwa bengenayo imfuno yokuzilungiselela ukuba babe ochwepheshe abazoba nezindawo zokulima zabo esikhathini esizayo. Zonke izinkampani ziqala ukukhula njengezimbewu - lokhu kuqala ngokwakha isu lebhizinisi. Akukho bhizinisi elingavuka emhlabeni ngaphandle kokusekelwa kwabanye abathintekayo kwezomnotho, ngakho-ke isu lebhizinisi liyithuluzi elichaza konke (inani, izindleko, njll.) ezizosiza ukuthi ubatshele ukuthi uzoba umlimi ozophumelela ekulimaleni. Le nqubo izokhombisa ukuthi unguchwepheshe ngoba izochaza izinyathelo ozothatha ukuze ufinyelele eziphumelweni ezinhle. Isu lakho lebhizinisi lizofaka lokho okulandelayo: imininingwane mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha ibhizinisi nezindlela zokwandisa umsebenzi wakho, futhi izokhombisa ukuthi uzofinyelela kulokho ezinsukwini ezimfushane nezide - futhi esikhathini esizayo. Isu lebhizinisi sizokhombisa futhi lapho ubona khona amathuba ebhizinisi nokuqonda ukuthi kwenzekani ezinsukwini ezimfushane nezide. Njengochwepheshe, isimo sakho sizokhombisa ukuthi uyazi ngemakethe namathuba nezingozi ezingase zibe khona. Ngoba ufuna ukukhombisa labo abazokusiza ukuthi unekhono namakhono okukhulisa, futhi ukuthi kukhona abanye abalimi nochwepheshe kwezolimo abazokweseka uhamba phambili. Zonke izinhlelo zebhizinisi zidinga ukuhlola konke emhlabeni. Kumele kube nemininingwane mayelana nezimali nezabelomali zesikhathi esizayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ebhizinisini lakho ngoba ukuhlela umhlaba akuhambi kahle, uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngendawo, kodwa kuvame ukuba nenkinga ngoba ngaleso sikhathi uhulumeni uyaphela, eshiya abatholi ngaphandle kwamandla nolwazi, ngaphandle kwemali yokuqala yebhizinisi, futhi bengasekelwa ekutholeni amakhono, ulwazi, nezikweletu. Kuyinto enhle ukuthola umhlaba, kodwa! Umuntu onengqondo ophupha ngokuhamba phambili uyazi ukuthi imali iyadingeka ukuze uqale ukuze iphupho libe yinto eqondile. Noma ubani angafaka imbewu emhlabeni, kodwa abanye abakwazi ukuyondla ukuze ikhule futhi ikhiqize ukudla. Kumele ufune usizo ukuze ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba zezimali ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi wakho wokulima uzoba kahle. Chaza lokho ofuna ukukwenza ekulimaleni kwakho. Khombisa ulwazi lwakho namakhono futhi unikeze izizathu zokukhanyisa ukuthi ungubani ofanele ukuthola umhlaba. Khombisa ukuthi ucabangele umhlaba ongawuthola, uyazi ukuthi izimo zezulu zimi kanjani kule ndawo lapho uzobe ufaka khona, uyazi futhi ukuthi imakethe izoba kanjani nokuthi yiziphi amathuba akhona. Qonda kahle imigomo yakho futhi ubheke izingozi ezingase zibe khona ezingenza umphumela wezohwebo khona. Lokhu kubalulekile kubo bonke abalimi ngezikhathi zethu zakhona ngoba kumele baphikise nabakhiqizi emhlabeni jikelele. Abakhiqizi kufanele babheke imakethe nsuku zonke ngoba bangase badinge ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wabo ngenkathi u-ukhukhamba usakhula! Isu elihle lokumaketha kufanele lihambisane nohlelo lokukhiqiza. Akusizi ukufaka ukudla abantu abazokudla kodwa kungabikho abathengi abazofuna ukukuthenga ngentengo ezoletha inzuzo efanele emsebenzini wakho. Izindleko zokuthenga imishini nokuyigcina njalo. Izindleko zokuqala zokufaka. Izindleko zokuhamba nezindleko ze-diesel. Izindleko zokuhola uma ukhetha ukungabi nazo zonke imishini ngokushesha. Isici esibalulekile secebo lakho sithi: isitatimende esikhombisa ukuhamba kwemali, esidinga usizo olungatholwa kumphakathi wezimali noma kumsebenzi wezezimali.
Ikomidi elibhekiswe kumamele amaphathi ezombusazwe lizokwethulwa. Emhlanganweni wokuqala wale komidi, amalungu kumele akhethe uMongameli ozobhekelela yonke imihlangano ye komidi. Bazokwamukela zonke izicelo ezivunyelwe zokuxolelwa ezibuyela eMnyangweni wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Iziqu zizonke zizobhekwa futhi zidluliselwe kuMongameli ngenhloso yokusiza ekwenzeni isinqumo sokugcina. Le komidi izodinga ukusungula imithetho nezindlela zayo ezizosebenza ngaphansi kwayo uma ibheka isicelo ngasinye ukuze ihlinzeke ngombiko ofanele wesicelo ngasinye. Ikomidi kumele ibike uMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ngale mithetho nezindlela ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 zomhlangano wayo wokuqala. Zonke izinhlelo ezihlobene nomsebenzi we komidi zizokwenziwa ngumphathi ozokhethwa ngaphakathi koMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Le komidi izosebenza kusukela ngosuku lokuqala kuze kube usuku lokugcina lapho umsebenzi wayo uqedwa. Zombili lezi zinsuku zifakiwe, futhi usuku lokugcina alungaph surpass September 30, 2008. Uma isicelo sihambisana nezimo ezibekiwe efomini, umsolwa angathumela isicelo kuMongameli ngendlela ebekiwe. Icala elikhuluma ngalesi sahluko a kumele lenziwe ngaphambi kosuku lokunikezwa kukaMongameli ngomhla kaJuni 16, 1999; futhi c isicelo kumele sihambisane ne affidavit noma incwadi yokwaziswa evela emzini owabeka iphathi yezombusazwe noma enye inhlangano elwa namalungelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umfaki-sicelo wayengumuntu ophila ngaphansi kwemiyalo ethile. a uma icala libhekiswe: i. futhi c uma umfaki-sicelo engahambisani nezimo ezibekiwe ezinsukwini ezintathu ezibekwe kubafaki-sicelo. Izicelo ezizokwamukelwa yilezo ezigcwaliswe kahle futhi ezilandela zonke izimo ezibekiwe phakathi nesikhathi sokuhlola esingezinyanga ezintathu. Isicelo esithunyelwe ngumsolwa yiso esizobhekwa. Isicelo kumele sithunyelwe ngumsolwa njengoba kubekiwe uMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Iphathi yezombusazwe yomuntu osolwa nayo ingathumela isicelo egameni lesolwa kuMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Kumele baqinisekise phansi kwesifungo ukuthi ukuboshwa komuntu wabo kuhambisana nezimo zezombusazwe lapho le phathi ibihileleke khona. Zonke iziphakamiso ezenziwe ngezicelo zokuxolelwa kumele zidluliselwe kuMongameli. Iziphakamiso ezivela kule komidi egxile kuzokwenziwa ngemva kwesicelo sokuxolelwa ngasinye. UMongameli unamandla namalungelo okwamukela noma ukuphika iziphakamiso ezenziwe le komidi egxile. Ngemuva kokubheka zonke iziphakamiso ezenziwe le komidi egxile, uMongameli unamandla namalungelo okunika noma ukuphika leyo sicelo sokuxolelwa. Akekho onelungelo lokwamukela ukuxolelwa kuMongameli.
Ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yesikhwama (GEMS member scheme compliance commitment) Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, isikhwama seGEMS, esaziwa ngokuthi yiGovernment Employees Medical Scheme, sathuthukiswa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lesi sikhwama sathathwa njengomnikelo omkhulu kulesi sikhathi esinzima, lapho izinsizakalo zezempilo zazingatholakali kalula kubantu abanempilo emhlabeni wezisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ngakho, ukwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izisebenzi ziyakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle, kwakudingeka ukuthi kube nemithetho eqinile yokulandela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola imiphumela efanele. Kwakungokuhamba kwesikhathi lapho kubonakala khona ukujula kohlanga, kwavela izinselelo ezinkulu. Imithetho nezigaba ezathuthukiswa zazidinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze zihambisane nezidingo ezishintshayo zomphakathi. Njengoba isikhwama seGEMS sakhula, kwavela izidingo ezinkulu zokuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho eyiqondiso. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zihlala ziphumelela, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahlanganyeli besikhwama babengathola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yesikhwama akukhona nje kuphela ukubhalela phansi izinqubomgomo, kodwa kuyisimo sokuphila. Abahlanganyeli beGEMS babefanele ukulandela imithetho, ukuze balondoloze izinga eliphezulu lokuphila. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kudaleke izinhlelo zokufundisa ezazihlinzeka ngokuqonda okunembile ngemithetho yesikhwama, nezindlela zokwenza kahle ekulandeleni le mithetho. Kwakungafanele kube khona ukuhlubuka kuyo, njengoba lokhu kungase kuholele ezinkingeni ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzekwa kwemfundo kwakuhambisana nezinsizakalo eziningi ezazisungulwe; izinsiza ezitholakalayo zaveza ithuba lokukhuthaza abahlanganyeli ukuba baphendule kahle ezidingweni zokuhlinzekwa kwemitholampilo. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS lwaluhlanganisa izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuxhaswa kwezokwelapha, odokotela, kanye nezinye izinsiza ezazimqoka ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yesikhwama bekungokwemvelo, ngakho-ke, kwavela izinqubomgomo ezazihloselwe ukuletha imiphumela emihle. Kuze kube manje, abahlanganyeli beGEMS babefanele bazi ngempela izinjongo nemigomo yesikhwama, ukuze bangabi nezinselelo ngezikhathi ezinzima. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, kanti kwavusa umoya wokuzwana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhulumeni wavuma ukubaluleka kokusiza abahlanganyeli beGEMS, njengoba kwakukhona izinsizwa ezazithuthukisa impilo ezazibuye ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihambelana nemithetho yesikhwama. Uhlanga lwamathuba lwalwakhiwa, futhi izinsizakalo zaphakanyiswa ukuze zifeze izidingo eziphezulu zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo kubantu abaningi. Kodwa, njengoba imithetho yesikhwama yesikhumbuzo yayiqhubeka, kwakumele kube nokuhlola okuqhubekayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabantu zihlala zifezwa. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abahlanganyeli beGEMS bazi kahle ukuthi bazithola kanjani izinsizakalo, nokuthi bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihamba phambili ukuze bagcine impilo yabo. Ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yesikhwama kwaba yisimo sokuphila, okwakuhlanganisa ukuhlelwa kwemihlangano, ukufundiswa, kanye nezinsizakalo ezikhuthazayo. Ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa kwemithetho, abahlanganyeli beGEMS bakhuthazwa ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kubhekwane nezinkinga zomphakathi, kanye nezinsizakalo ezazibhekelele izidingo zempilo zabantu. Ukuzibophezela kwabo ekulandeleni imithetho kwaba isibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungalungisa kanjani izinkinga zawo ngalendlela efanele. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yesikhwama seGEMS akupheli. Lokhu kuqhubeka kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa impilo kubantu akukhona nje umgomo, kodwa kuyisimo sokuphila esiqhubekayo. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, lokhu kuhlonipha umoya wokubambisana, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuvumelana phakathi kwabantu, okumele kube yisisekelo sokuphila kwethu. Ngakho, sithokozisa ukwakhiwa kwemithetho yesikhwama seGEMS, sikhumbula ukuthi ukuzibophezela akuphezi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esiqhubekayo sokukhuthaza impilo engcono kubo bonke. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zihlala zisesimweni esihle, futhi abahlanganyeli beGEMS bahlala bezithokozisa ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuzibophezela kwethu akusizi kuphela thina, kodwa kuhlomula umphakathi wonke, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi sishaya izikhala eziphakeme zokuphila.
Okutholakele kuphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli Isingeniso Umlilo wesakhiwo eGoli ubangele ukugxekwa okukhulu nokuhlolwa. Lesi sihloko sizobheka izinyathelo ezithathwe kuphenyo, izizathu ezitholakele zokuthi kwenzeka umlilo, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezidingekayo ukuze kuvinjezelwe izigameko ezifana nalezi esikhathini esizayo. 1. Ukuqonda Umlilo Umlilo ubonakala njengomcimbi ophazamisa impilo, impahla, nemvelo. Ukuze uqonde izimbangela nemiphumela yalokhu, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umlilo utholakala kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Izinsiza Zomlilo: Izinto ezivumela umlilo ukuvutha, njengezinto zokwakha ezithile, amafutha, noma izinto eziphilayo. - Izimo Zokwakha: Isakhiwo esakhiwe ngezakhiwo ezingavikeli umlilo kahle siba sengozini. 2. Ukuqapha Nokuhlola Phezu kokuba umlilo usuwonke, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphenyo lwenziwa kahle: - Ukubhaliswa Kwesigameko: Ukuqala, izinyathelo zokuqala zifaka ukubhaliswa kwesigameko sokuphuma komlilo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu basendaweni baphume ngokuphepha. - Ubufakazi Bobuchwepheshe: Abahloli baphenyi izinsalela zomlilo, izinsiza zemizila, nezinsizakusebenza zokwakha ukuze babone ukuthi kwenzekeni. 3. Izizathu Ezingaba Nemiphumela Ngemuva kokuhlola izinsiza ezithintekayo, abaphenyi bathola izizathu ezithile ezichaza ukuthi umlilo wenzeka kanjani: - Ugesi Oweqile: Imithombo yokushisa engaphephi ibangele ukwehla kwemigudu kagesi, okuholele emlilweni. - Ukungavikeleki Kwensiza: Izakhiwo zihlolwe zatholakala zingalungile, zinezikali eziphansi zokuvikela umlilo. - Ukwehluleka Kokuphendula: Izinhlangano eziphathelene nokuphendula ziphumelele kakhulu ekuphenduleni, kodwa izinqubo ezihlobene nezenzakalo ezinjalo zidinga ukuphuculwa. 4. Ukuphendula Kwezimpendulo Ngemuva kokuhlonza izizathu, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezithile: - Ukulungiswa Kwemithetho: Kudingeka ukuhlela kabusha imithetho yokwakha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zonke zihlala ziphephile. Lokhu kubandakanya izindinganiso zokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izakhiwo zihlola izidingo zokuvikela umlilo. - Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Abasebenzi badinga ukuqeqeshwa njalo ngemikhuba emihle yokuphendula emlilweni ukuze bathole ulwazi olunembile lokuphuma kulokhu. - Ukwakha Uhlelo Lokuphendula: Ukuze kube nokuphendula okuphumelelayo, izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathelene nezimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa nokuqiniswa. 5. Ukuvikelwa Kwezakhiwo Ukuphepha kwezikhala zomphakathi kumele kube yinto yesibili: - Ukufaka Izinhlelo Zokuvikela: Izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuvikela umlilo ezifana nezishintshi zokuqhuma, ama-alamu, nezinsiza zokuphepha kumele zenziwe zibe yizinjongo eziphakeme. - Izinsiza Zokuphepha: Ukunikeza izinsiza ezifanele, ezifana namafire extinguishers, kumele kube umgomo ophakeme ezakhiweni. 6. Ukuhlola Izinqubomgomo Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zifika kulokho obekuhlosiwe, kuhle ukuhlola izinqubomgomo: - Uphenyo Olwaqhamuka: Izinyathelo ezithathwe kumaphrojekthi okwakha zidinga ukuhlolwa njalo ukujolisa izinhlelo ezithuthukayo. - Ukubuyekeza Izinqubomgomo: Izinqubomgomo kumele zihlolwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisesikhathini futhi zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Uphiko lwezokuphepha luthola izifundo eziningi kuphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli. Ukuze kuvinjwe izigameko ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izinyathelo ezithile zokuphepha, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuvikeleka okungcono, futhi kunciphise amathuba okuthola umlilo ezakhiweni zomphakathi.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe (National shutdown) Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wombhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe, owaziwa ngesiNgisi ngokuthi "National shutdown", kubalulekile ekuboneni ukuthi lezi zenzakalo ziba nomthelela omkhulu ezintweni eziningi, kuhlanganise nezomnotho, ezepolitiki, nesimo sokuphila kwabantu. Lo mbhikisho uvame ukuveza ukukhathazeka kwabantu ngezinkinga ezinkulu ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ukuntuleka kwemali, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kahle. Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungumcimbi ohlanganisa abantu abaningi, okuholela ekuphawuleni kwabo ngokuphathwa kwemali, amalungelo abantu, kanye nezinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlakulele umuzwa wokubambisana, okuvame ukuhamba phambili ekulandeleni izinjongo ezifanayo. Nokho, kumqoka ukuqonda ukuthi umthelela wombhikisho akuhlali uhleli emathubeni, kodwa futhi uhlanganisa nezinselelo ezithile. Umthelela kwezomnotho Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungakha umthelela omkhulu kwezomnotho. Ubuza ukuthi, uma abantu bevala imisebenzi, lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, okungenza kube nezinkinga ezinhlobonhlobo. Isibonelo, uma izitolo zivalwa, abathengisi bahluleka ukuthengisa, okuholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba abantu behluleka ukuthola imiholo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umnotho ungase uphinde ube nezinhlupheko ngenxa yokuncipha kokuthengiswa kwezimpahla. Lokhu kuthinta izinkampani ezincane, ezisemqoka ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuphila zingakhuphuka uma izinsiza zikhona, kodwa abantu bengakwazi ukuzithola ngenxa yokuthi imisebenzi ivaliwe. Umthelela ezepolitiki Umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungaba nomthelela omkhulu ezepolitiki. Njengoba abantu bephakamisa izwi labo, lokhu kudala ingcindezi kuhulumeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekubeni kuhulumeni kube nomuzwa wokuthi kumele benze izinguquko ezithile ukuze baphatheke kahle kwezepolitiki. Izinqumo ezithathwayo zingaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa izimo zokuphila kwabantu. Nokho, kukhona nezinselelo ezikhona. Izinqubomgomo ezithathwa ngemuva kwabambiqhaza zingase zingabi nezinzuzo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekuxabana phakathi kwabantu nezikhulu, okungaholela ekwandeni kokungaboni ngaso linye. Umthelela kwesimo sokuphila Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umthelela wombhikisho ungakhangisa izici ezithile zokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba abantu bephuma emgwaqweni bezwakalisa imizwa yabo, lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana nobunye. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zenzakalo zibe nethonya elihle, njengoba abantu behlangana njengomphakathi, bebonisana ngezinkinga zabo. Nokho, umbiko owandulele umehluko phakathi kwemiphakathi. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokuxabana phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene, njengoba abantu bezwakalisa izinkinga ezihlukene. Ukungaboni ngaso linye kulokho okukhuluma, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kuzuzwe ukuxazululwa kwezinkinga ezikhona. Izindlela zokuxazulula Ukuze umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ube nomthelela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumanisa abantu, ukuze kube nokuhlanganyela okukhulayo phakathi kwemiphakathi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kuhulumeni kube nokubambisana nokuhlonipha izimvo zabantu, ukuze kube nezinguquko ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izindaba ezinzima. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokuxhumana, ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, kungakha umphakathi onobumbano. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuhlanganisa izinsiza phakathi kwabantu, futhi kudale umphakathi ohlangene, ophumelelayo. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa konke, umbhikisho wokumiswa kwezwe ungaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, ezomnotho, nasemiphakathini. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umthelela awuhlali uhleli ubuhle, kodwa uhlanganisa nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlakulele umqondo wokubambisana, futhi bahlale bephakamisa izwi labo lapho kudingeka khona. Njengoba uhulumeni nezakhamuzi behlanganyela, umthelela wombhikisho ungaba yinsakavukela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinguquko Nokuqonda Amazwi Okuzayo Emhlabeni ogcwele izinguquko ezibangelwa ubuchwepheshe, ukusetshenziswa kwe-Artificial Intelligence (AI) emsebenzini kuliqondo elisha elikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. I-AI ibhekwa njengemithombo yokuthuthuka, ehlinzeka ngezixazululo eziningi ezisiza ukwenza imisebenzi ibe lula, enembile, futhi eshibhile. Ubuchwepheshe bokufakelwa bokuhlakanipha buvumela ukuhamba phambili ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo nezifanele, okwenza ukuphatha imisebenzi ethile kube lula. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa I-AI Omunye wemisebenzi eyinhloko ye-AI emsebenzini ukukhulisa ukukhiqizwa. Ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokufunda okujulile nezinqubo ezihlakaniphile, abasebenzi bangakwazi ukulanda imininingwane eminingi, bahlaziye, futhi baphendule ngezinyathelo ezihlukene. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuhlelekile, kunciphisa ukuphazamiseka, futhi kwandise ukukhiqizwa. Izinkampani zikhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisa i-AI kwandise ukukhiqizwa kwazo phakathi kuka-20% kuya ku-40% ezinyangeni ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-AI isiza ekunciphiseni isikhathi sokuhlola imibono nemiphumela. Izinhlelo ze-AI zingakwazi ukucubungula izixazululo ezihlukahlukene, zihlole imiphumela, bese zikhethela abaphathi izinqumo ezikahle. Lokhu kusiza amabhizinisi ukuthi abengabheki kuphela izigameko ezikhona, kodwa futhi abone amathuba amasha okukhula. Ubuchwepheshe obuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo Ngokuthuthuka kwabasebenzi, i-AI isitholelwe indawo ebalulekile ekwenzeni izinqubo zibe lula. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza nge-AI zingaholela ekusebenzisaneni okuhle phakathi kweminyango ehlukene, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imininingwane esheshayo nezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Njengoba abantu behlukaniswa emisebenzini yabo, i-AI ibizanise umphakathi ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezithile. Nokho, ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emisebenzini kudinga ukunakekelwa ukuze kugwenywe ukulahlekelwa kwemisebenzi. Njengoba imishini ikhulisa ukukhiqizwa, abanye abasebenzi bangase bazwe ukuthi imisebenzi yabo ibalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuqonda ukuthi izigameko zizoba zinani elikhulu ukuze kugwenywe ukulahlekelwa okukhulu, nokuthi ukuphakanyiswa kwabaqeqeshiwe kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangaphumelela ezindaweni ezintsha. Izinkinga Zokuziphatha Nezempilo Noma iyiphi indlela ye-AI ingase ibhekane nezinselele ezithile. Njengoba ibhekene nezimo ezithinta abantu, ukushayisana kwezimo zokuziphatha, ukuhlonipha ubumfihlo, kanye nokuthola izixazululo ezicatshangelwayo kubalulekile. Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sithole izixazululo ezithile zokuphatha, futhi sihlinze ngokuqondisa kuyo yonke imisebenzi ye-AI. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yokulawula i-AI ibalulekile. Umphakathi usafuna ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezithile zingenzeka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuze kuncishiswe izinkinga ezikhona. Okukhathazayo, uma abantu bedayiswa nolwazi lwabo, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi ukuphepha komphakathi kuhamba phambili. Ikusasa le-AI emisebenzini I-AI izokwenzeka ezindaweni eziningi, kanti umphakathi uzakha amakhono adingekayo ukuze lokhu kube nempumelelo. Abasebenzi kuzodingeka ukuthi bazi ukuthi imishini ingase ingaphathi kahle izinqubo ezithile, kodwa indawo yokusebenza izoguquka. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa amakhono abantu nezehlakalo zamakhompiyutha kuzokwenza abantu bahlale benethemba lokuthuthukiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi imisebenzi ye-AI ibambisane nabantu. Lapho abasebenzi beqonda izinhlelo ze-AI, bazoba nethuba lokuba nemibono ebalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukwakha ukuzethemba phakathi kwabasebenzi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziphumelelayo. Ngokubambisana, i-AI izokwenza zonke izinkampani zikhulise umphumela. Lokhu kuzodala isimo esisha, lapho wonke umuntu engaphumelela. Isiphetho Emhlabeni we-AI, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buza nezinsiza ezithile. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini kudinga ukukhalipha, ukuqonda, nokuhlakanipha. Ngakho-ke, uma sakha ibhizinisi elizayo, sithumele ukubona izinzuzo, izinkinga, nezinsiza ohlelweni olwakhiwe. Umphakathi uvunyelwa ukufunda ukuthi konke lokhu kuguqula kanjani impilo yethu yansuku zonke. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizoba nabantu abaqhakazile nabahlakaniphile. I-AI ayimfihlakalo; iyisiphetho sokuhamba phambili empilweni yethu.
Umculo we-Hip Hop: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini umculo we-Hip Hop? Umculo we-Hip Hop ungumkhakha wezokungcebeleka odume kakhulu emhlabeni. Uqukethe izici ezintathu ezisemqoka: i-rap, i-DJing, kanye ne-beatboxing. Lo mculo uqala ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1970 eUnited States, ikakhulukazi eBronx, New York. Kwaba khona abantu abaninzi abashisa izikhotha, bephuma nezinhlobo ezintsha zomculo, besebenzisa izinto ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza umculo we-Hip Hop wahluka? Umculo we-Hip Hop uhluke kakhulu kwezinye izinhlobo zomculo ngenxa yokugxila kwawo ekwabelaneni ngezindaba zomphakathi, ezombusazwe, nempilo yabantu. Abaculi bavame ukusebenzisa izinkulumo ezinzima, bephakamisa izinkinga ezifana nobandlululo, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza umculo we-Hip Hop ube yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile emphakathini. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izici ezibalulekile zomculo we-Hip Hop? Kukhona izici eziningi ezithinta umculo we-Hip Hop. Okokuqala, i-rap, okuyindlela yokucaphela, igxile ekwakheni izinkulumo ezihamba phambili, ezinezithako ezibhalwe phansi. Okwesibili, i-DJing, ihlanganisa ukusebenzisa amadivaysi ahlukahlukene ukufaka ama-sample, ukudlala imisindo, nokwakha ama-beats. Okwesithathu, i-beatboxing, ingenye yezindlela zokwakha umculo usebenzisa imisindo yomlomo kuphela, okwenza kube nenhlonipho enkulu emculweni. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izimpumelelo zabadlali be-Hip Hop? Abaculi be-Hip Hop, njengokuthi u-Tupac Shakur, Notorious B.I.G., kanye no-Jay-Z, bahlala bephumelela ezinhlelweni ezihamba phambili. I-Hip Hop izuze udumo olukhulu, futhi abanye bayo babeqhamuka nezinkanyezi ezingama-global. U-Tupac, ngokwesibonelo, ungomunye wabaculi abanethonya elikhulu, njengoba engakha izinkanyezi ezihlala zikhumbuleka kuzo zonke izizukulwane. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenza umculo we-Hip Hop ube namandla? Umculo we-Hip Hop unamandla okukhuthaza abantu, uvuselela imicabango, futhi uthinta imizwa. Ucabanga ngezinto ezinjengobandlululo, ubuphofu, nezinkinga zezenhlalo, okubenza abantu bazi ukuthi abakhuluma ngokwabo. Lokhu kwenza umculo we-Hip Hop ube nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe i-Hip Hop iyathuthuka? Yebo, umculo we-Hip Hop uyathuthuka njalo. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, imikhuba nezitayela ziguquka, kanti abaculi basha baveza izimvo ezihlukahlukene. I-Hip Hop isiphenduke uhlobo oluhlanganisa izinkanyezi ezivela emhlabeni wonke, ezifana ne-Afrobeat, Trap, kanye ne-Lofi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umculo we-Hip Hop ungahlanganisa izici eziningi ezivela ezizindeni ezihlukene. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani nge-Hip Hop eNingizimu Afrika? ENingizimu Afrika, i-Hip Hop ithole ukwamukelwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha. Abaculi abanjengo-K.O., Cassper Nyovest, no-Nasty C bathole udumo, futhi bakhuthaza abanye abaculi ukuba baveze izimvo zabo. I-Hip Hop eNingizimu Afrika ibhalwe ngesiZulu, isiXhosa, nangezinye izilimi zendawo, okwenza kube nethonya elikhulu emiphakathini. Umbuzo 8: Yini ebalulekile kubaculi be-Hip Hop? Kubaculi be-Hip Hop, kubalulekile ukuveza izinkinga nezizathu ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhuthaze abanye, futhi bakhombise ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphumelela nokwenza inguquko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubambisana phakathi kwabaculi, kanye nezinhlangano zomculo, kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuqhakamiseni umculo we-Hip Hop. Umbuzo 9: Uhlelo lwezikhumbuzo nezifundo ezihlobene ne-Hip Hop? Izikhumbuzo ze-Hip Hop zibandakanya imicimbi, izifundo, kanye nezingqungquthela ezihlobene nomculo. Izifundo ze-Hip Hop zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo, kanti umnotho wabo uhamba phambili. Lokhu kudalaithuba lokuthi abaculi baqondise izifundo, bazifundise, futhi bakhuthaze abanye. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo kwi-Hip Hop? Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi umculo we-Hip Hop uzobamba iqhaza elikhulu esikhathini esizayo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, abaculi bazoba namathuba amaningi okukhulisa umculo wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-Hip Hop uzoba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane, uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ngokuhlanganisa izimpendulo kulolu hlobo, umculo we-Hip Hop ubonisa ukuthi ungumculo owaziwayo, ophumelelayo, futhi obalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ungaqhubeka nokuhlola leli khanda elikhulu, uthole imikhuba emisha, futhi uhlole izindaba ezithinta umculo we-Hip Hop.

Ubani uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi (NER)? Ukulawula umkhakha wamandla kagesi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, nezindlela ezinhle zokuqhuba ezingeni lesizwe nelamazwe omhlaba ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa okuzinzile. Ukuba umholi emhlabeni jikelele ekulawuleni amandla kagesi. U-National Energy Regulator angakusiza kanjani? Umthetho Wamandla Kagesi No. 41 ka-1987, njengoba ushintshiwe, unika amandla uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuxazulula izinkinga phakathi kwabathengisi bamandla kagesi nabathengi, kanye phakathi kwabathengisi bamandla kagesi uqobo. Uma ungathanda ukuxoxa ngendlela umthengisi wakho wamandla kagesi abhekane ngayo nezikhalazo zakho, uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi angakusiza. Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinkinga uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi angakusiza ngazo? Hlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezikhalazo. Bonke abathengisi bendawo kumele babe nelayisense etholelwe ku-NER. Akekho umthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo onelungelo lokuhlinzeka noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubathengi ngaphandle kokugunyazwa ngu-NER. Umthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo akakwazi ukudlulisa ilayisense yakhe yokufaka ugesi kumthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Umthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo akanaso isikhala sokukhokhisa amakhasimende nganoma iyiphi imali engagunyaziwe ngu-NER noma ukuguqula ukufakwa ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Amakhasimende asaqhubeka nelungelo lokukhokha izimali ezivunyelwe ngisho noma umthengisi wendawo eqala ukuhlinzeka ngentela entsha. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumuntu noma ohlwini olungama-tent endaweni okufanele ihlinzekwe kuyo uma umthengi ekwazi ukukhokha insizakalo enikeziwe nokuthi baphinde bakhokhe. Umthengisi wendawo kumele anikeze umthengi isakhiwo nezinga lokukhokha elifanele uma umthengi efaka isicelo sokuhlinzekwa kwensizakalo futhi uma kucelwa. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokwazisa amakhasimende abo ngezikhuphukisi ezikhokhwayo, ngezinketho ezahlukene zokukhokha ukuze kuhlinzekwe ngogesi, nokuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezicacile uma befaka izicelo zokuhlinzekwa ngogesi. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengi banelungelo lokubuza ngemali yokukhokha ezohlangabezana kangcono nezidingo zabo. Kulabo abathengi abasebenzisa ugesi ophrepaid, umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokubavulela indawo yokuthengisa lapho bangathenga khona ama-voucher. Lezi zindawo zokuthengisa kumele zibe ezitholakala kalula. Banomsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokuthengisa ivuliwe ngesikhathi sokuthenga phakathi kwesonto, futhi ivuliwe kusukela ngo-8:00 ekuseni kuya ku-12:00 emavikini nakumaholidi. Ngisho noma umthengi engenamali. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokuhlinzeka nokuqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngogesi othembekile kubathengi bawo futhi unomsebenzi wokulungisa noma yiziphi izinkinga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukuhlinzekwa okuhle. Uma umthengi ebhilled, ibhili kumele ibonise lokhu, futhi noma iyiphi imali ekhokhisiwe ngaphezu kokufaneleka komthengi ngesikhathi esithile kumele ibuyiselwe ku-akhawunti yomthengi. Uma umthengi enezinkinga, bangacela umthengisi ukuthi ahlole ukunemba kwe-mita ngokukhokha umthengi imali ethile, ezobuyiselwa umthengisi uma kutholakala ukuthi imitha ayisebenzi kahle. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokwazisa umthengisi wendawo uma ethuthela kwenye indlu, efuna ukuvala ukuhlinzekwa ngogesi, noma efuna ukudlulela kwenye indlu. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokufundisa kubathengi mayelana nokusebenzisa ugesi ngokuphepha, kahle, nangempumelelo noma yini ephathelene nokuhlinzekwa ngogesi engathuthukisa ukuqonda kwabathengi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kukagesi. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokwazisa abathengi ngama-akhawunti ahlukene, indlela yokufaka izicelo, umthelela wabo, kanye nokufaneleka. Khumbula ukuthi iphuzu lokuqala lokuxhumana kufanele kube umthengisi wendawo. Umthengi unelungelo lokukhala ngezinga lenkonzo enikezwe umthengisi wendawo. Uma umthengi enganelisekile ngemiphumela noma ngendlela izikhalazo zaphathwa ngayo, bangaphakamisa udaba ku-NER ukuze bathole usizo. Umthengi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokufaka izintambo zikagesi nogesi endlini yabo noma endaweni yabo yokuhlala noma empahleni. Umthengi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokufuna umuntu onemfundo efanele ukuze asebenze ngogesi. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuhlola iziqu zomuntu ozofaka ugesi kanye nokusebenza kwecebo elikhishwe ngaleso sikhathi. Umthengi unomthwalo wemfanelo wezinto ezenzeka ngaphakathi endlini yabo mayelana nokuhlinzekwa ngogesi. Noma yini enye eyenzekayo (ngaphandle kwemitha) ngaphandle kwemingcele yomhlaba yomthengi ibhekwa njengomthwalo wemfanelo womthengisi wendawo onelayisense. Umthengi kumele abe neSitifiketi Esivumelekile Sokuhambisana esikhishwe ngumgibeli ogunyaziwe ofake noma ohlolile indlu. Umthengi unelungelo lokukhala ku-NER uma umthengisi wendawo enqaba noma ehlisa isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngogesi ngaphandle kokunikeza incazelo efanele. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokukhokha ngalesi sikhathi (njengokuchazwe). Umthengi unelungelo lokukhala kumthengisi wendawo uma enganelisekile ngezinga lenkonzo enikeziwe. Uma umthengi enganelisekile ngendlela izikhalazo zaphathwa ngayo, banelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER, ezokwenza uphenyo ngodaba. Uma usenze isivumelwano nomthengisi wendawo onelayisense sokukuhlinzeka ngogesi, kumele ukhokhe idiphozi njengoba kudingwa umthengisi wendawo onelayisense ngaphambi kokuxhunywa kagesi. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomthengisi wendawo uma bengatholi izaziso zokubhaliswa zenyanga. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuhamba phambili ekukhokheni ukusetshenziswa okwamanje ngisho noma kukhona impikiswano mayelana ne-akhawunti/ibhili kagesi. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuvikela imishini, amadivayisi kagesi, noma yimuphi omunye umhlaba ophathelene nokudluliswa kukagesi. Uma kudingeka ukuhlinzekwa okuqhubekayo, umthengi unomsebenzi wokuhambisa izicelo eziqhubekayo ezingenzeka. Uma sithatha ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi akukwazi ukuvimbela, umthengi unomsebenzi wokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokuphikisa umphumela. Kuyini ukukwazi ukuhweba ngogesi?
