Emathilini, udoti obizwa nge-octane udingeka ukuvikela injini ekushayweni noma ekuphazamisekeni. Ukushaywa kwenjini kwenzeka uma kukhona ukushiswa okungaphathwa kahle kokuhlanganiswa komoya-njengoba emathilini, okungalimaza injini. I-octane etholakala kumafutha iyisilinganiso esivimbela injini ekushayweni - uma ibanga le-octane liphakeme, amathuba okuthi amafutha abangele ukushaywa ancipha. Ukwengeza ama-complexes e-lead emathilini kwakuyindlela evamile yokuthuthukisa izinga le-octane. I-lead yayisetshenziswa kakhulu njengokungezelelwa emathilini kusukela ngeminyaka yawo-1920. Nokho, amathilini awazange asetshenziswe ezimotweni ezihlanganiswe ne-catalytic converter ukuze kuncishiswe ukukhishwa, ngoba i-lead ivula ngokushesha le ngxenye. Lokhu, kanye nokutholakala kokuthi ukukhishwa kwe-lead kungalimaza impilo yomuntu, kuholele ekutheni kuncishiswe kancane, kuqala eNyakatho Melika, kwalandelwa yiYurophu, bese kusakazeka kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni. Kusukela ngosuku luni i-petrol enelead izophelelwa yisikhathi eNingizimu Afrika? Uhulumeni ubeke phansi ukuthi kuzoba nezinhlobo ezintathu zamafutha anebanga le-octane ngaphandle kwe-lead (ULP) ezovunyelwe eNingizimu Afrika (ezindaweni ezisemanzini nasemakhaya) ngemva kokuphela kukaJanuwari 1, 2006, okuyi-91, 93, kanye ne-95 Research Octane Number (RON). Ukudinga lezi zinhlobo kuzokhombisa ukuthi iyiphi efunwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele balindele ukuthi ngeke bathole zonke izinhlobo zonke, kodwa bangalindela ukuthola uhlobo oluhambelana noma olufanele ezimotweni zabo noma kuphi abahamba khona eNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izimboni zokucubungula uwoyela eNingizimu Afrika zifake imali noma zifaka imali kumishini noma ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhulise ama-additives e-octane ngobuningi. I-octane additive ibaluleke kakhulu kunomkhiqizo okhiqizwa izimboni zokucubungula zendawo, ezizothenga izingxenye zokuhlanganisa eziphakeme ze-octane noma amafutha e-octane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kudingeka. Izindleko zezinhlobo ezahlukene zamafutha zizokwenziwa kanjani? Izindleko ezilawulwayo zizokwenziwa usebenzisa indlela efana nale esebenzayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindleko zezinhlobo ezikhona ezingenalead (95 octane emanzini kanye ne-93 emakhaya) zizohlala zifana. Izindleko zezinhlobo ezinelead zizofana nezindleko zamafutha angenelead anebanga le-octane elifanayo. Ezindaweni ezisemakhaya lapho uhlobo lwe-95 olungenalead luzoqala ukuba khona, kuzokwenziwa imali noma "intela yokudinga", ezokwenza izindleko zikhule phakathi kwalo no-93, kuqala ngophawu lwe-10 cents nge-litre. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi izimoto eziningi ezisemakhaya zaneliseka ngama-fuel e-93 octane, okuyi-highest etholakalayo, empeleni, iyona kuphela etholakalayo. Ama-fuel e-95 octane azokwenziwa atholakale emakhaya ukuze anele izimoto zobuchwepheshe besimanje ezethulwe embonini yezimoto. Njengoba abanikazi bezimoto bezokwazi ukukhetha phakathi kwezinhlobo ukuze bavimbele ukusetshenziswa kabi kwe-octane additives, kulindeleke ukuthi labo abadinga i-95 octane bayisebenzise - intela ekhokhwayo emakhaya ihloselwe ukuheha abanikazi bezimoto ukuba bacabange ngezinketho zabo. Emathilini, lapho ama-fuel aphezulu noma amaningi e-octane evame ukufunwa (ngokuvamile eduze nemanzini kukhombisa ukudinga okukhulu kwe-octane ezimotweni), i-95 octane engenelead iyona kuphela etholakalayo, futhi ngeke kube nenye intela kulolu hlobo. Ngizokwazi kanjani ukuthi iyiphi i-petrol efanele imoto yami? Kuzokwakhiwa idatha yolwazi ezokhombisa cishe zonke izinhlobo ezitholakalayo emigwaqweni yethu. Lokhu kuzotholakala yonke indawo, kuhlanganise nedatha yolwazi yeNational Association of Automotive Manufacturers (NAAMSA - www.naamsa.co.za) kanye neSouth African Petroleum Industry Association (SAPIA - www.sapia.co.za). Kulolu dbhuku, uhlobo lwamafutha olufanele ezindaweni ezisemanzini nasemakhaya luzokhombiswa ngokwehlukana (ukuze umkhiqizi asebenze kahle) nokuthi yiziphi ezinye izinhlobo ezingahambisana (lezo ezingenza imoto ihambe kahle ngaphandle kokulimaza injini, nakuba ingase ingasebenzi ngempumelelo ephelele kwezinye izimoto). Abanikazi bezimoto bangakhetha ukusebenzisa noma iyiphi uhlobo olukhombisiwe njengokunconywa noma okufanele kumoto yabo. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi isitayela sabo sokushayela singathinta ukuthi iyiphi i-octane additive abayithola iyahlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Kuzoba nomhlahlandlela okhombisa ama-fuel afanele ukusetshenziswa kulolu dbhuku nolwakho emastation okugcwalisa amafutha. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimoto zidinga ama-octane additives ahlukene. Ukusebenzisa amathilini anebanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yakho edinga akukhona okudingekayo futhi kuyiphutha lemali, ikakhulukazi njengoba kungathuthukisi ukusebenza kwenjini. Ukusebenzisa amathilini anebanga le-octane eliphansi kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kunciphisa ukusebenza kwenjini, okungaholela ekushayweni noma ekulimaleni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi isidingo se-octane semoto ethile sincike kwezinye izinto, kuhlanganise nokusetshenziswa nesitayela sokushayela, izidingo ze-octane zemoto eyalelwe kakhulu, ukuphakama okuphezulu, nezimo zezulu. Kungani ngingafanele ngisebenzise ibanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yami edinga? Amathilini anebanga le-octane eliphezulu adinga ukucubungula okuningi futhi asebenzisa amandla amaningi lapho kukhiqizwa. Uma la mandla engasetshenziswa kahle noma engasetshenziswa kahle yimoto yakho, kusho ukuthi amandla aphezulu abekwe khona ayaphuma noma alahleka. Lokhu kuphutha kuholela ekukhishweni kwe-hydrocarbons ezingashiswa noma i-carbon dioxide, okulimaza imvelo yethu. Ukusebenzisa uhlobo lwe-octane additive oluphakeme kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kuzokwenza noma kuphule umnikazi imali eningi, futhi kunomthelela omubi emvelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngeke kube nezinzuzo ekusebenzeni noma ekushayeleni. Ingabe amathilini angaphandle anelele ezimotweni, emathilini, nasezindaweni zokuhamba? Amathilini angaphandle ngokuvamile anelele ezimotweni, emathilini, nasezindaweni zokuhamba ngaphandle kokuthi amancane asebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obudala. Bheka noma ubuze umthengisi wemishini uma unombuzo. Ingabe izimoto ezidumile nezokuhamba ezindala zingasebenzisa amathilini angaphandle? Ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga, lezi zimoto kufanele ngokuvamile zisebenzise amathilini anelele, nakuba ezinye zingasebenzisa amathilini angaphandle. Uma ufuna ukusebenzisa amathilini angaphandle, xhumana nomkhiqizi waleyo moto. Uma ngisebenzisa amathilini angaphandle, ingabe ipayipi lokuphuma kwemoto yami lizoshintsha libe mhlophe njengoba kwenzeka uma ngisebenzisa amathilini anelele? Cha, lokhu akukhombisi ukwehla kokusebenza kwenjini. Ipayipi elisha liba mhlophe uma usebenzisa amathilini anelele ngenxa yokwakheka kwe-lead emaphumeleni uma imoto idla noma ishisa amafutha. Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo: Umqondo Obalulekile Wokuthuthukisa Impilo Yethu Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho ubuchwepheshe buqhuba khona izinguquko ezinkulu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo. Lokhu akukhulumi nje ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela emithini, kodwa futhi kumele sikhulume nokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yezempilo, ukuqwashisa, nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kuzolekelela kakhulu ekwenzeni impilo yethu ibe ngcono, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde izbenefits zalo mkhiqizo omusha. Ukuqala, kufanele sigcizelele ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibalulekile ekufundiseni abantu ngempilo kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Ezikhungweni ezinjalo, abantu bangathola ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezifo, izindlela zokugwema, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuzenzela izinqumo ezinhle mayelana nempilo yabo. Uma izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zisetshenziswa kahle, zingaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo futhi onokuqonda okuhle kwezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufakwa kwezi zikhungo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imikhankaso yokukhuthaza impilo. Ngokuhlanganisa ulwazi nezinsiza, izikhungo zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi yokukhuthaza impilo, njengokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwemikhuba emihle, izifundo zokudla okunempilo, nezinhlelo zokuzivocavoca. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu, kunciphise izinga lezifo ezivela ezimweni zokuphila ezingezinhle, futhi kuholele ekwenzeni umphakathi onempilo. Umqondo wezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo awupheli nje lapho kuxoxwa ngomphakathi. Izinhlaka ezahlukene, njengeminyango kahulumeni, ezempilo, nezemfundo, kufanele zisebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kudingeka ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lufinyelela kubo bonke abantu. Uma sihamba phambili ngokubambisana, sizothola izixazululo ezisebenzayo ezizoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo akukhona okukhuluma kuphela ngempilo yabantu, kodwa futhi nempilo yokwakha umphakathi. Izikhungo kufanele zakhe umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, zikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kuzolekelela ekuqedeni ukuhlukumezeka nokungabi nempilo ngokuhlanganyela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle mayelana nempilo yethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphumela yokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo izobonakala. Izinga lezifo ezithathelwana kalula lingancipha, abantu bazoba nolwazi olunembile, futhi umphakathi uzoba nenhloso yokwakha impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzokwandisa umqondo wokuhlala ndawonye, ukwenza abantu babe nokuzwana okukhulu, nokwakha umphakathi oqinile. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo akukhona nje umqondo omusha, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha impilo engcono. Ingabe sizokwenza lokhu? Ngaphandle kokungabaza, kufanele sizame futhi sikhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezinjalo. Umphakathi onempilo uqala ngokuqonda futhi uthola ulwazi olufanele ngezempilo. Ngakho, asihlanganyeleni ukudala izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ezizokwenza umehluko empilweni yethu, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo nenhlalakahle. Siyavuma, sithanda, futhi sikhuthaza ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo, ukuze impilo yethu ibe ngcono, futhi siphile impilo egcwele. Lokhu akusikhathazi kuphela, kodwa kulokhu siphila ngezinto esizithanda kakhulu. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sithuthukisa, sikhuthaze, futhi sakhe umphakathi onempilo.
Ukwanda KweSifo Sikashukela: Izizathu, Imiphumela Nezixazululo Isingeniso Ezweni lanamuhla, sikhuluma ngezinto eziningi ezithinta impilo yethu, futhi phakathi kwazo, sifo sikashukela siye saba nesithunzi esikhulu. Lokhu sifo, esaziwa ngokuthi yi-diabetes, sikhula ngokushesha eNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe, sithinta izigidi zabantu. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka ukwanda kwesifo sikashukela, izizathu zalo, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona. Ukukhula KweSifo Sikashukela Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi sifo sikashukela sesibe yinkinga enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngokocwaningo olwenziwe yiZikhungo Zokulawulwa Kwasemaphandleni, sifo sikashukela sikhuphuke ngama-30% phakathi nezinyanga eziyi-12 ezedlule. Lokhu kukhuphuka kuvela ezicini eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukuziphatha kwabantu, izinqubo zokudla, nezimo zokuphila. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezindleni ezindaweni ezinamahlathi, lapho ukudla okunempilo kungatholakali kalula, okwandisa amathuba okukhula kwesifo. Izizathu Zokwanda Isizathu esikhulu sokwanda kwesifo sikashukela sitholakala ekudleni okungelona elinempilo. Ngokwandisa ukudla okunezinga eliphezulu lamafutha, ushokoledi, nezithelo ezinosawoti, abantu baphonsa emathubeni okuba ne-diabetes. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuntuleka kokuzivocavoca, okukhona ezindaweni eziningi, kuhlobene nokwandisa izingozi zokuba nesifo. Izimo zokuphila, njengokucindezela, ukuhlushwa, kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle, nazo zifaka isandla ekwandeni kwesifo. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yizinkinga zempilo yengqondo, okwenza kube nzima ukubhekana nezinguquko ezidingekayo empilweni yabo. Ukuze siqonde ubuhlungu besifo sikashukela, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lesi sifo asithinti umzimba kuphela, kodwa futhi sithinta umoya nomqondo. Imiphumela Yesifo Sikashukela Imiphumela yesifo sikashukela ibalulekile futhi ingathinta zonke izici zempilo yomuntu. Abantu abane-diabetes bangase babhekane nezinkinga ezinzima ezifana nezinkinga zenhliziyo, ukuwohloka kwesikhumba, nezinkinga zokubona. Lokhu kuthinta kakhulu izinga lempilo yabantu, futhi kungaholela ekukhathaleni okukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sifo sikashukela siba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Uma abantu behlangabezana nalezi zinkinga, kungaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokwelashwa, okwenza kube nzima kubantu nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongekho emthethweni lapho abantu bephinde bahlupheka, bephinde baphinde bathola izinkinga zempilo. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Ezingathathwa Noma izingqinamba ezibhekene nesifo sikashukela zinkulu, kunezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngempilo nokudla okunempilo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini zingasiza ukuvusa ukuqonda ngalesi sifo, okwandisa amathuba okuba abantu benze izinqumo ezingcono. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono, abantu kufanele baphume kude nokudla okungelona elinempilo, bagcine isikhumba sabo sihlanzekile, futhi bazivocavoca ngokuqhubekayo. Umphakathi ungenza umehluko omkhulu ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele, njengezikhungo zokuzivocavoca nezindawo zokudlela ezihlinzeka ngokudla okunempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni ungathatha izinyathelo ezilungile zokulawulwa kwesifo. Ukuxhaswa kwemali ezinhlelweni zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokuhlola abantu, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha zempilo zingasiza ukunciphisa ukwanda kwesifo sikashukela. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwesifo sikashukela akuyona into engathandeki, kodwa siyinselelo esibhekene nayo. Ngokuhlanganyela, umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabantu ngabanye bangakwenza okukhulu ukuze kuphazamisa lezi zinkinga. Ukukhuthaza impilo enempilo nokwakha umphakathi onempilo kungasiza ekwehliseni umthelela wesifo sikashukela. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizoba nempilo engcono.
Imininingwane yomuntu ofuna ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kumele ibhalwe ngezansi. Nikeza ikheli kanye/noma inombolo ye-fax eNingizimu Afrika lapho ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe khona. Ubufakazi besikhundla esithathwe kuso lesi sicelo, uma kusebenza, kumele kufakwe. Le ngxenye kumele igcwaliswe kuphela uma isicelo sithathwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Nikeza imininingwane ephelele ye-rekhodi ofuna ukufinyelela kuyo, kufaka phakathi inombolo yokubhekisela uma uyazi, ukuze irekhodi likhunjulwe lapho likhona. Uma kukhona isikhala esanele, sicela uqhubeke kwezinye amakhasi eduze futhi ufake lokhu kufomu. Umuntu ophakamisa isicelo kumele asayine wonke amakhasi engeziwe. Isicelo sokufinyelela kulolu lwazi, ngaphandle kwe-rekhodi equkethe ulwazi ngawe, sizophathwa kuphela uma imali yesicelo ikhokhiwe. Uzokwaziswa ngenani lemali elidingekayo ukukhokhwa njengezindleko zesicelo. Imali ekhokhwayo yokufinyelela kulolu lwazi incike ezimeni zokufinyelela ezidingekayo nasemalini efanele edingekayo ukuze kufundwe futhi kulungiswe irekhodi. Uma ungafaneleki ukuba nezinye izindleko, sicela uchaze isizathu. Uma uvimbekile ekufundeni, ukubona, noma ukuzwa irekhodi ezimeni zokufinyelela ezihlinzekwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, khombisa ukungakwazi kwakho futhi uchaze ngezimo ezithile lapho irekhodi lidingeka. Beka uphawu ebhokisini elifanele nge-X. IZAZISO: (a) Ukukhombisa kwakho izimo ezidingekayo zokufinyelela kulolu lwazi kuncike ezimeni lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. (b) Ukufinyelela ezimeni eziceliwe kungavinjwa kwezinye izimo. Kulokhu, uzokwaziswa uma ukufinyelela kuzokwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezihlukile. (c) Imali ethathwayo yokufinyelela kulolu lwazi, uma ikhona, izokwenziwa ngokwezimo zokufinyelela eziceliwe. Uma irekhodi liqukethe izithombe ezibonakalayo, lokhu kufaka phakathi izithombe, ama-slide, ukuqoshwa kwevidiyo, izithombe ezikhiqizwe ngamakompyutha, imidwebo, njll. Uma ucela ikhophi noma idokhumenti ye-rekhodi (ngaphezulu), ingabe ufuna ikhophi noma idokhumenti ithunyelwe kuwe? Ingabe kukhona imali yokuthumela? Qaphela ukuthi uma irekhodi ingatholakali ngolimi oluthandayo, ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngolimi lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. Uphi ulimi ofuna ukufinyelela ngalo irekhodi? Uzokwaziswa ngembhalo uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe/siqedwe noma cha. Uma ungathanda ukwaziswa ngenye indlela, sicela uchaze ukuthi kanjani futhi unikeze noma yiziphi imininingwane edingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukuhambisana nesicelo sakho. Ungathanda ukwaziswa kanjani ngesinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho sokufinyelela kulolu lwazi?
Abafakizicelo abaneziqu zabo zokuhlonza ezinephutha bangathumela izicelo zokulungisa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Izicelo zingaphinde zenziwe emahhovisi noma emisebenzini yaseNingizimu Afrika uma umfakizicelo engaphandle kwelizwe. Qedela amafomu e-BI-9, e-BI-526, kanye ne-BI-309 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Faka isicelo ehhovisi noma emisebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Nikeza ubufakazi bolwazi, njengencwadi yokuzalwa, incwadi yokushada, incwadi yesikole, noma i-affidavit. Faka izithombe ezimbili ezinomumo wephasiwedi nesicelo sakho. Le sevisi ingathatha amasonto amane kuya kwamasonto ayisithupha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lakho lesikhungo eliseduzane.
Imicimbi Yezempilo NeNhlalakahle Yomphakathi Ngiyakwemukela! Namuhla sizokhuluma ngemicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi, okuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu nasemiphakathini esiphila kuyo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, akusikhathazi kuphela ukufanisa izimpilo zethu kodwa futhi nokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, nonempilo. Ngakho, thina sonke kufanele sibe neqhaza kulokhu, njengoba singabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kambe nenhlalakahle yempilo yalandela. Ukuze siqale, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo yenziwa ngezizathu ezahlukene. Ukukhulisa ulwazi ngempilo, ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu, noma ukusiza abantu abafuna usizo ngezinkinga zabo zempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zempilo, ohulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze imicimbi ibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yethu. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi imicimbi ethuthukisa impilo imumethe ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo, ukufundiswa ngezifo, nokuxhumana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo? Ngokwesibonelo, imicimbi yokuhlola impilo ivame ukwenziwa ezindaweni zomphakathi, lapho abantu bengavakashela khona ukuze bahlolwe, bathole izeluleko, futhi bazi ngempilo yabo. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu ngoba kusiza abantu abahlukene ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo, hhayi kuphela ezibhedlela. Ukukhuluma ngempilo, singathanda ukukhipha umbono mayelana nemicimbi ethile. Imicimbi efana ne-"Health Awareness Days" iyabandakanya. Lezi izinsuku zikhumbuza abantu ngokubaluleka kokubanakekela imicimbi ezithinta impilo yabo. Njengoba sizama ukukhipha imiyalezo ethile, ukubonisana nabantu kudinga ukujula. Kulungile ukuba nezingane zethu ziqale ukufunda ngempilo ngokusemthethweni ukuze zikuqonde kahle lokhu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezindabeni ezifana nokudla okunempilo. Ngaphezu kokukhuluma ngemicimbi yezempilo, sikhuluma futhi ngenhlalakahle yomphakathi. Indaba lapho abantu behlangana, behlanganyela, futhi bezwana khona, kuletha umoya omuhle. Imicimbi enje iphakanyiswa ngezinhloso ezinhle, ezifana nokwenza izifundo zokudla okwenziwa ngezithako ezahlukene. Lokhu kudla kwasendaweni akusizi kuphela emlandweni wesiko kodwa kusebenza nakwezinye izindlela, kufaka phakathi ukusiza abantu abangenamakhaya. Imicimbi ezinje futhi zihlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lapho kudalwa ubudlelwano obukhulu, abantu baqala ukuba nephutha lokukhuthaza izinga phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile, okulungile, futhi kulungile. Ubuntu bethu bumane bukhombisa ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngezempilo, kufanele sibe neqhaza ekwakheni izindlela zokuphila eziqondile futhi ezicacile. Kodwa kufanele sibe neziqondiso namuhla, sihloniphe zonke izinkinga ezimpilweni zethu. Sikhuluma ngenhlalakahle, lezi zindaba zinjengezibopho esizibophezele kuzo. Bayakusa, abanye bethu bahlala ezindaweni lapho izinsizakalo zempilo zihluphekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nochwepheshe, sihlole izinsiza, futhi senze ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwazo zezilimi ezahlukene. Asikhulumi ngezinhloso, kepha lemicimbi nabantu abavela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene, ngabe kulungile? Ngalesi sikhathi, kumele sibe nohlobo lobudlelwano obukhonza osomabhizinisi, izikhungo zempilo, kanye nemiphakathi. Kulokhu, siphakamisa ukuthi sikwazi ukufunda okuthile ngezindlela ezahlukene, futhi sithi yebo, lokho kuhle! Kodwa-ke, akusikhona konke okukhuluma ngemibono. Ukuze sithole impumelelo emicimbini yethu, kufanele senze kube lula kubantu ukuba bahlanganyele. Uhlanga, imiphakathi, nezikhungo zempilo kumele zibe nokuqonda okufanele. Isibonelo, uma sifuna ukuthuthukisa ezempilo phakathi kwabantu, kumele sibe nezinhlelo ezibanzi zokuvimbela izifo ezingaba khona. Kukhona imikhankaso ethinta imikhakha ehlukahlukene, kuhle kakhulu uma izakhamuzi ziqondiswa kahle. Ngemuva kwalokho, sikhulume ngesibopho. Ubani omdayiswayo uma sikhuluma ngokukhuthaza imicimbi? Ngabe ubani okufanele acaba izindleko, futhi ungabhalisela izinsalela ezidinga usizo? Lokhu kudinga ukucwaswa, ngakho kudinga zonke izinhlaka zibe neqhaza ukuze kuqondiswe kahle izinsizakalo zempilo. Ngokuyinhloko, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yokuphila ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngeke siphumule ukwenza izinhlelo ezizwakalayo nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza emicimbini, ukufunda, nokukhuthaza impilo ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngakho, masizame sizame okuningi ukuze sakhe umphakathi onempilo, okuhle, nolwazi, futhi uqhubeke nokuphila!
IDOKHUMENTI YENQUBOMGO: IZINGXABANO ZAMAHOLO EMKHAKHENI KAHULUMENI Isingeniso Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni zibe isihloko esivusa amathuba okuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlangano zabasebenzi, ohulumeni, kanye nabanye abakhiqizi bezinsiza. Ukuze sithole umqondo ophelele ngalezi zingxabano, kudingeka sikhumbule izici ezahlukahlukene ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa, ukuphathwa nokwenziwa kwezimali zendlela yokuphila yabasebenzi ababambisene nohulumeni, kanye nombono omkhulu wokuhlinzeka ngemigomo ethuthukisa izimo zokusebenza. Izingxabano zamaholo nezizathu zazo Izingxabano zamaholo zenzeka ngenxa yezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa: 1. Amathemba Obungcweti: Abasebenzi banelungelo lokulindela ukuthi amaholo afaneleke ukuze ahambisane nezindleko zokuphila, imfuno yokukhuphuka kwesikhwama sokugcina, kanye nezinkokhelo ezincane, okwenza kube lula ukuziphilisa. 2. Amaphutha Emigomweni: Ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo engacacile mayelana namaholo, izikhala ezingenakuhambisana nezinye izixazululo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, kunomthelela ekukhuleni kokuphikiswa phakathi kwezinkathazo zabasebenzi nohulumeni. 3. Izidingo Zokukhushulwa: Ukukhushulwa kwamaholo kumchazela uhlelo lokusebenza okudingekayo, kukhuthaza umnotho, kunika amandla abasebenzi nokuqinisekisa ukuzikhandla, okuyizinto ezibalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele. 4. Ukwehla Kwemali: Izinselelo zezomnotho zenza kube nzima ukugcina amaholo, ngenxa yokwehla kwelanga, okuholela ekukhuleni kwezimali ezincane ezitholakalayo ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga zomphakathi. Umthelela Wokungabi Nezixazululo Ezingafanele Izingxabano zamaholo ezinqandekile zingaholela emiphumeleni emibi ebalulekile: - Ukwehla Kwezemisebenzi: Uma izingxabano zihlala isikhathi eside, zikhuthaza ukwehla kwamathuba emisebenzi, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko. - Ukungabi Nezithakazelo: Ukuze kuncishiswe ukwakhiwa kwezithakazelo eziseqhulwini, izinkampani zingasebenza phansi ukuze zifeze ukukhulisa inzuzo, okwenza kube nzima ukwakha ubudlelwano obumnyama nomphakathi. - Ukungezwani Nabaphathiswa: Uma imiphumela naso ibizwa ngokuthi ingalungile, kuyinkinga evamile yokungezwani phakathi kwabaphathiswa kanye nezinkampani ezikhuluma ngezingxabano zamaholo. Imizamo Yokuxazulula Izingxabano Zamahlengethu Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zingxabano, kubalulekile ukuba kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo: 1. Ubungcweti Bezinqubomgomo: Uhulumeni kufanele anake izidingo zabantu abavela kwezinye izindawo zokusebenza, isibonelo, izinkombandlela ezisemthethweni ezithinta amalungelo kanye nemiholo. 2. Ukusebenzisana Nabezindaba: Ukudalwa kwezinhlaka ezikhuthaza ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izinyunyana zabasebenzi, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzovumela ukuhlangana kwezindlela ezahlukene zokuxazulula izingxabano. 3. Ukwanda Kwenhlalakahle: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokwakha ukulinganiselwa phakathi kokusebenza, uma kubekwe imikhawulo ethile ezindleleni zokuhlola amaholo. Isiphakamiso Ukuze iHhovisi Kahulumeni lithole impumelelo ekuphathweni kwezingxabano zamaholo, kudingeka: - Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezempilo Nezimo Zokusebenza: Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezikhuthaza izindawo zokusebenza ezithembekile nezibhekelelayo, ngokuhlanganyela nabathintekayo. - Inhlonipho Yezinhlaka: Ukusheshisa ukubambisana nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezintsha ezithokozisayo. - Ukuvuselela Izinqubomgomo: Ukuhlola njalo izincomo ezitholakalayo ukuze kuxazulule izingxabano zamaholo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zizodingekayo kumazinga aphansi. Isiphetho Izingxabano zamaholo emkhakheni kahulumeni zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kugweme umonakalo emnothweni nasezimpilweni zabasebenzi. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinsiza, izinyunyana, nohulumeni, kusiza ekubumbaneni izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokwenza uqinisekiso lwemiphumela emihle. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo kufanele zihambe ngokuhlanganyela, zisebenze ezingeni lohlelo, kanti lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi zingaholela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukile nezilungiselelwe kahle. Ubuholi obunamandla, obusebenzisanayo nabazimele, buholela ekuphathweni kahle kwezinsizakusebenza nezinsiza, kubhekelela izidingo zabantu abadlalayo emkhakheni. Ngokwenza lezi zinguquko, sizokwazi ukusiza ekuqedeni izingxabano zamaholo, siphinde sigcine izinga eliphakeme lokuphila nempilo yokusebenza ezimbonini ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzofaka isandla empumelelweni yomnotho wethu nasemphakathini jikelele.
Ithimba leMthonjaneni Municipal Council 156 yeMthethosisekelo yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) ifundwa nezinhlu 11 no-98 zeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000), lapha lenza lezi Zimiso. Zonke izingqungquthela zeCouncil, kanye nezingqungquthela zayo, zizovuleka emphakathini: Kukhona ukuthi le ngxenye ngeke isebenze uma kunesizathu sokwenza okuphambene, kubhekwa uhlobo lwezingqungquthela ezibanjwayo ngokuhambisana nengxenye 20(1)(a) yeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000). Kulezi Zimiso, "izingqungquthela" zisho zonke izingqungquthela zeCouncil. I-Council izobamba ingqungquthela ejwayelekile ukuze iqhube ibhizinisi okungenani kanye njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu. Umkhulumeli noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngokucela okubhalwe phansi okuvela enanini elikhulu lababambiqhaza bomkhandlu, angabiza ingqungquthela esheshayo yeCouncil. Okungenani amahora angamashumi ayisithupha nambili (72) ngaphambi kwengqungquthela ejwayelekile yeCouncil kanye okungenani amahora angamashumi amane n Eight (48) ngaphambi kwengqungquthela esheshayo yeCouncil, kuzoshiywa noma kuthunyelwa isaziso sokuba khona engqungqutheleni, esichaza okuzoxoxwa nokusayinwa nguMkhulumeli noma uMqondisi Wezokuxhumana, ukuze kushiywe endaweni lapho kungatholakala kalula khona ngamalungu eCouncil noma endaweni ethile eyaziwa ngumkhandlu. Ukwehluleka ukuthumela isaziso sengqungquthela ngempazamo kumkhandlu akuzokwenzi ukuthi izinqubo zaleso sikhathi zingasebenzi. Akukho okuzoxoxwa engqungqutheleni ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulunywe ezisazisweni zayo, ngaphandle kwezindaba umphakathi ozithola zibalulekile nezisheshayo, kanye nanoma iyiphi indaba iCouncil noma ikomidi elithola kufanele ixoxwe ngokushesha ngenxa yokuba inani lababambiqhaza lingama-2/3. I-Council noma ikomidi lingabambezela ingqungquthela kunoma yisiphi usuku noma isikhathi, kodwa akukho okuzoxoxwa engqungqutheleni ebambezelwe ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulunywe ezisazisweni zengqungquthela ebambezelwe. Uma ingqungquthela ibambezelwe, isaziso sokubambezela sizothunyelwa kumuntu ngamunye weCouncil noma ikomidi, sichaza isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yengqungquthela ebambezelwe. Inani elikhulu lababambiqhaza kumele libe khona engqungqutheleni yeCouncil ngaphambi kokuthi kuvote ngendaba. Zonke imibuzo ephathelene nezinhlinzeko zengxenye 160(2) yeMthethosisekelo izonqunywa yiCouncil ngokuvota kwenani elikhulu lababambiqhaza. Zonke ezinye imibuzo phambi kweCouncil izonqunywa ngenani elikhulu lokuvota ngokuhambisana nengxenye 34 yeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu, 1998 (Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998) ephathelene nokuphulwa kwamakhansela. Uma kunokulingana kunoma yimuphi umbuzo, umkhandlu oyiChairperson uzovota okwakhe okungeziwe kokuvota njengomkhandlu. Umkhandlu kufanele akhulume neCouncil, noma kunoma ikomidi eliwum member, nganoma yiziphi izintshisekelo zebhizinisi abangase babe nazo ngaphambi kweCouncil noma Ikomidi. Umkhandlu kufanele ahlale angaphakathi ezinqubweni zeCouncil noma engqungqutheleni lapho indaba ixoxwa khona yiCouncil noma Ikomidi, ngaphandle uma iCouncil noma Ikomidi isinqume ukuthi intshisekelo yomkhandlu ngqo noma engaqondile kulowo mbuzo ayibalulekile noma ayifanele. Umkhandlu, yena uqobo, noma umkhandlu wakhe, noma noma yimuphi umuntu ohambisana naye noma omunye osondelene naye, uthola noma usemsebenzini wokuthola inzuzo ngokuqondile kusivumelwano somkhandlu, kufanele akhulume ngemininingwane ephelele yaleyo nzuzo ayazi ngayo engqungqutheleni yokuqala yeCouncil lapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi umkhandlu akhulume ngalokho. Le ngxenye ayisebenzi uma inzuzo itholakala kumkhandlu, noma kumkhandlu wakhe, noma kumuntu osondelene naye noma omunye osondelene naye, kanye nabanye abahlali bomkhandlu. Uma ekupheleni kwesikhathi semizuzu eyishumi ngemuva kwesikhathi lapho ingqungquthela yeCouncil noma Ikomidi ihlelelwe khona, uma kungekho inani elikhulu, ngeke kube khona ingqungquthela, ngaphandle uma kuhlelwe, ngokuvuma kwenani elikhulu lababambiqhaza, ukuthi isikhathi sande, esingeke sidlule imizuzu emihlanu, ukuze kube nenani elikhulu. Kodwa amalungu akhona ngenani elikhulu angase anqume ukubambezela ingqungquthela ngesikhathi esingcono. Uma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi iCouncil noma Ikomidi ihlangene, umphakathi uzokwazi ukuthi inani lababambiqhaza likhona, uzobala, futhi uma kutholakala ukuthi akukho inani elikhulu, iCouncil noma Ikomidi izobamba isikhathi sokuphumula esizothathwa ngamalungu akhona. Kuwo wonke amaqembu eCouncil, umkhulumeli, uma engakabi khona noma ebamba isikhundla somkhulumeli, uzoba nguMphakathi. UMayor uzoba nguMphakathi wezihlangano zeKhomidi, kodwa uma uMayor engakabi khona, uMphakathi Osebenzayo. Ezingqungquthelweni ezihlanganisiwe, inqubo izonqunywa nguMphakathi WaseMunicipal noma njengoba kwenziwa nguMkhulumeli mayelana nezihlangano zeCouncil. Umphakathi, ngokuthanda kwakhe, angangenisa noma iyiphi indaba ohlwini nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Umhumushi uzosetshenziswa ngaphandle uma inani elikhulu lababambiqhaza abakhona lingavumi. Kulindeleke ukuthi abamkhandlu bazosebenzisana nomhumushi ngaphansi kobuholi bukaMkhulumeli. Isicelo sokungahlanganyeli kunoma iyiphi ingqungquthela yeCouncil noma amaqembu kufanele sithunyelwe kuMqondisi Wezokusebenza ngokubhalwe phansi ngaphambi kokuba ingqungquthela ethile iqale. Uma umkhandlu ngenxa yezizathu ezivumelekile engakwazi ukuhambisana nomthetho (1), bangathumela isicelo sokukhululwa kumMqondisi Wezokusebenza, lesi sicelo sizobuyekezwa yiCouncil ngokuhambisana nesicelo esibhalwe phansi. Ngokuqondene nezinhlinzeko zezingxenye 3 no-4 (Ukuhamba kwezingqungquthela) zeKhodi Yokuziphatha kwababambiqhaza (Isheduli 1 yeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu), inqubo yokwephula umthetho njengoba kubhalwe ezinhlinzekweni 66, 67, no-68 zalezi Zimiso izosebenza. Ababambiqhaza abadinga ukuphuma engqungqutheleni yeCouncil ngaphambi kokuba iphele kufanele bacela imvume kuMkhulumeli. Ngokuqondene noMthetho 6 ophathelene nokuhamba kwezingqungquthela, izingqungquthela zokuhlonza noma zokuthuthukiswa ezihlelwe noma ezivunyelwe yiCouncil zicatshangwa njengezingqungquthela. Imizuzu yezinqubo zezingqungquthela zonke izobhalwa ngezimoto ezizenzakalelayo noma ngenye indlela futhi igcinwe ngalokho nguMqondisi Wezokuxhumana. Usain Bolt: Umjaho Ohlonishwayo Nokuphila Kwamandla UUsain Bolt, umjaho wezemidlalo ophakeme, uphumelele izicoco eziningi emhlabeni wokuqhudelana. Ubuye waziwe njengenhloko yezeMidlalo, futhi uyisibonelo esihle sokusebenza kanzima nokuzinikela. UBolt, owazalwa ngomhla ka-21 kuMfumfu ngo-1986 eSherwood Content, eJamayiqa, uqale ukuthola udumo lwakhe ngonyaka ka-2008 lapho ebuya nephayona elisha emkhakheni wezemidlalo. Ukuqala Kwezemidlalo UUsain uqale umjaho wakhe wokuqhudelana eseyingane. Uthole uhlelo lwezemidlalo esikoleni, lapho athola khona ithuba lokukhombisa amakhono akhe. Ngemva kokuhamba esikoleni, uqhubekile nokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe, futhi wathola ithuba lokuphuma emqhudelwaneni wezinga eliphezulu. Uthole ithuba lokudlala eminyakeni yakhe yokukhula, lapho echitha khona isikhathi esiningi eqhuba emijahweni ehlukene. Ukukhula Kwempumelelo Ngonyaka ka-2008, uBolt waphumelela emqhudelwaneni wezigaba ezintathu ze-100m, 200m, kanye ne-4x100m eMidlalweni Yezwe eBeijing. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile empilweni yakhe, ngoba waphula irekhodi lomhlaba we-100m no-200m, okwakuyizinto ezazihlonishwa kakhulu emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBolt waphinde wathola izindondo eziningi emqhudelwaneni wezimpumelelo zezemidlalo, okuhlanganisa neMidlalo ye-Olympic. Isimanje Nezinkanyezi UUsain Bolt ungumuntu ophila impilo ejabulisayo neyingqayizivele. Ubonakale ezinkundleni zomphakathi, edlala izimfashini ezihlukile, nokuhamba kwenhlonipho. Ubuyise umoya omuhle emijahweni, futhi ube yisibonelo sokuthi ukufinyelela empumelelweni kudinga ukuzinikela. Uthakasela umculo, futhi ugqugquzela abanye ukuba benze kahle emikhakheni yabo. Ubuye abe nezinhloso zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, lapho edlala indima ebalulekile ekuxhaseni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izingane ezisematheni. Imiphumela Yempumelelo UUsain Bolt akavumi nje ukujabulisa abalandeli bakhe emijahweni, kodwa uphinde abe yisibonelo sokusebenza kanzima. Ukuphumelela kwakhe kwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu kumjaho wezokuthuthukiswa. Uhlonishwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi izifundo zakhe zokuphila zikhombisa ukuthi yize ubungozi bungahlala, impumelelo ingafinyelelwa. Uthumele umyalezo obalulekile wokuthi, "Kuhle uma uthanda, kodwa kuncono uma ulungiselela." Ukwaziswa Ngesikhathi Esimnandi Njengoba esho, uBolt akashiyi nje imiphumela emijahweni, kodwa uphinde abeyisibonelo sokuhlonipha izifundo, uthando lwezemidlalo, nomsebenzi. Uqhubeke nokugcina umphakathi ubambisene nabanye, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abawuthandayo umjaho. Ukukhula kwakhe kungenxa yokuthi waqonda ukuthi umzamo, ukukhuthazela, kanye nezifundo zibalulekile empilweni. Ukwakha Ikhono Nezinga Eliphezulu UUsain Bolt ungumgibeli ophakeme, futhi izifundo zokuphila zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele phambili. Uhlonishwa njengomunye wezinkanyezi eziphezulu emijahweni. Ukuphumelela kwakhe akugcini nje emijahweni, kodwa kubonakalisa kahle ukuthi amazwe amaningi akwazi ukufinyelela empumelelweni uma kunokusebenza kanzima. Uhlale ejabule futhi eqinisa izixhumanisi phakathi kwezemidlalo nabathandi bazo. Isiphetho Usain Bolt ungomunye wabaphumeleli abaningi emlandweni wezokugijima. Ubuchwepheshe bakhe, okwenza kube lula ukufunda kubathandi bezemidlalo, buye bukhumbuleka emhlabeni wonke. Uhlala ethokozisa futhi emikhakheni yezeMidlalo, kodwa futhi ubonisa ukuthi ukuphila kuhle uma umuntu ebhekisisa indlela yokuphila nezifiso. Ubuye asize ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokhu kumenza abe yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi impumelelo iyenzeka uma umuntu esebenza kanzima. UUsain Bolt, okungukuthi, ungumgibeli ophakeme, ubalulekile emlandweni wezokugijima, futhi uyisibonelo esifanele sokuqhubeka nokwakha.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila: Umbono Wami Namuhla Emaphandleni nasemadolobheni, sithola izinkundla ezahlukene zokuxoxa ngezindleko zokuphila ezikhulayo. Imali esiyidingayo nsuku zonke ibonakala ikhula, futhi lokhu kuthinta kakhulu impilo yomphakathi. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila akuhambisani nje nokwehla kwemali, kodwa kubangelwa yizinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinguquko emnothweni, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, nezimo zomhlaba. Njengoba ngihamba emigwaqweni, ngibona abantu bephikisana ngezindleko ezikhulayo. Izimakethe, lapho sithenga khona ukudla, ziya ziba nezindleko eziphezulu, okukhombisa ukuthi izindleko ziphakama kakhulu, okuholela ekutheni umphakathi ubhekane nezinkinga ezinzima. Izindleko zokuphila zikhula njalo, lokhu kudala ukuthi kubelula ukufakwa ezimotweni eziphansi kodwa ezibizayo, okuholela emiphumeleni emibi kwezimali kumndeni. Lokhu kukhombisa izinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abaphila ngaphansi kwemali ethile. Abantu abaningi bahlala bebhekene nemikhawulo emikhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina izindleko zabo ziphansi. Lokhu kuveza izinkinga ezinzima ezingelula ukuxazulula, futhi kungaholela ekubeni nemiphumela emibi empilweni nasemndenini. Uhlelo lokuphila oluyinkimbinkimbi lungakuzisa inselelo enkulu, njengoba izinto ezithinta imindeni zishintsha, zenza kube nzima ukuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuphila zikhombisa ukuthi kudingeka izixazululo eziwusizo ukuze kusizakale abathengi. Izimpahla ezibalulekile njengokudla, amanzi, nezidingo zabasebenzi ziya zikhula, okuthinta wonke umphakathi. Kukhona abathengisi abathola inzuzo, kodwa izindleko zokuphila ziba phezulu kakhulu. Abazali, abakhululekile nezikole bahlala bebhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kudingeka imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi, uhulumeni, nemiphakathi. Ukuqonda izimo zomnotho kungenza sithuthukise izinhlelo ezithinta imiphakathi, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithinta izindleko zokuphila. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kudinga ukuthi sikhulise amathuba omsebenzi. Umsebenzi ongcono ungathuthukisa izinga lempilo, futhi izinsiza eziphumelelayo zingasiza ukuvuselela umphakathi. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila akukhona nje uhlelo lwezomnotho, kodwa kudinga ukuhlonishwa kwezimpilo zethu. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezihambelanayo ukuze sithuthukise impilo, sithuthukise amathuba okukhula nokuphila ngendlela efanele. Ngokuphila okuphumelelayo, siza ekuxazululeni izinkinga, futhi ukukhetha okungcono kuzokhombisa impumelelo yethu. Ukuze sithole ukuphila okuphilayo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu, futhi kuzothuthukisa imiphakathi yethu, sithole ukuphila okuhle, okungazalwanga kwanda kwezindleko.
Ezokuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwemisebenzi Nezimpilo Zethu Ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana ziye zaba yingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, okwaziwa nangokuthi "information technology," kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwane, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana ngolwazi phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela obuphatha ngayo izimpilo zethu, imisebenzi yethu, kanye nezindlela esixhumana ngazo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana ziye zathuthuka kakhulu. Ekuqaleni, abantu babephila ezikhathini lapho ukuxhumana kwakwenziwa ngokuthumela izincwadi noma ngocingo olungabizi. Kodwa-ke, namuhla, sinesikhathi sokuxhumana esiphumelelayo, esisheshayo, futhi esihlukahlukene. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana ne-WhatsApp, Facebook, ne-Twitter ziye zaguqula indlela esixhumana ngayo. Lokhu kwenze kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi, ukuxhumana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Okwamanje, ubuchwepheshe bukhona emhlabeni wonke, futhi izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukile zokuxhumana ukuze zifinyelele kumakhasimende azo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinkampani zifuna ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana ukuze ziqhube imisebenzi yazo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okukhuthaza umnotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye bukhombisa izinzuzo eziningi empilweni yomuntu. Ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, kudingeka sibe nolwazi olwakhiwe kahle. Ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana buvumela abantu ukuba baphumelele ekufundeni, bakhe amakhono, futhi baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka ukuthi babe nekhono lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele. Noma kunjalo, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukukhula kwezokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuholele ezinkingeni ezithile, ezifana nokungabikhona kokuphepha kolwazi. Abantu bahlala bephazamiseka ngezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba izinkampani zihlala zibhekene nezinsongo ezivela kubaphangi be-inthanethi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha eziqinile ukuze zivikela ulwazi lwamakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana buphinde buveze izinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abanye abantu bahlala bejolise kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuxhumana okuqondile. Lokhu kungaholela ekudambiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bephila ezweni eligcwele ubuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi, nakuba ubuchwepheshe bunikeza izinzuzo, akufanele buphumelele emhlabeni wabo. Ngokubuka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela ezithuthukile zokuxhumana. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo. Izinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nabantu ngabanye kumele basebenzisane ukuze bathuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ovulekile ekwabelaneni ngolwazi. Ekugcineni, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana buye bahlala bujolise ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe. Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba siqinisekise ukuthi sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sakhe ubudlelwane obuqinile. Ngaleso sikhathi, singaqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphumelela empilweni yethu, futhi buhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi.
Iphrofayela kaMfundisi uSiyabonga Ngubane: Umsebenzi Wokholo Nempilo Yomphakathi UMfundisi uSiyabonga Ngubane, owazalwa emzaneni waseMkhumbane, ungumholi wenkolo ohlonishwayo, odume ngokuzinikela kwakhe emisebenzini yokukhuthaza ukholo, uthando, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Uthando lwakhe lokukhonza luqhamuka ezinsukwini zengane, lapho abefunda khona izimfundiso zenkolo ezazihlanganisa izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo kanye nemicabango emihle. U-Siyabonga akazange akhohlwe ukuthi ukholo lungumthombo wamandla, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha impilo yakhe yokukhonza. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zeBhayibheli, uMfundisi uSiyabonga waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengomfundisi ophakeme ebandleni elincane. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokuphila, izifundo zokuziphatha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni ethwele kanzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waqhamuka nezinhlelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa imihlangano yokukhuthaza ukholo, izifundo zempilo, kanye nezifundo zokuphila ezibhekelela izinkinga zomphakathi. U-Siyabonga ungumholi onothando, ohlonipha futhi ophumelelayo. Ubonisa uthando olukhulu kubantu abamzungezile, futhi ubakhuthaza ukuba balwe nezinkinga zabo. Uthanda ukusiza abantu abaphethwe yizinkinga ezingokwenyama, futhi ubona ukuthi ukukhuthaza ukholo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe ungenza abanye bazizwe bephila, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuba abantu baphumelele ezindleleni zabo. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, uMfundisi uSiyabonga uphinde abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ubuye abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa imfundo, ezokuthutha, kanye nezokwelapha. U-Siyabonga uqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokufunda, lokukhula, nokuphila impilo enempilo. Uhlale ethokozisa abantu abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ukwamukela izinkolelo ezahlukene, uMfundisi uSiyabonga ubonisa ukuthi ukholo lungahlanganisa abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphuma kuphi. Ubuye abe nesandla ekwakheni imihlangano yokuxhumana phakathi kwezinkolo ezahlukene, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabule futhi bephila ngokuhlanganyela. U-Siyabonga ubonisa ukuthi ukholo aluhlanganisi kuphela, kodwa luphinde luthuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Uphinde abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlanganisa imikhankaso yokuziphatha, ezokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. U-Siyabonga uqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze baphile kahle. Ubuye abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni ethwele kanzima, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana nabantu abadala bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMfundisi uSiyabonga uqhubekile nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bahlale bejabule, futhi bakhuthazelele ukusebenza ndawonye. Ubonisa ukuthi ukholo lungaba umthombo wamandla, futhi ubonisa ukuthi abantu bangakha umphakathi ophumelelayo uma benza izinto ngokubambisana. U-Siyabonga ungumholi ohloniphekile, futhi umsebenzi wakhe uphinde ubonise ukuthi ukholo lungaba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi ongcono. "Ifamu" kusho ingxenye noma izingxenye zomhlaba wezolimo njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wokuhlela Umhlaba Wezolimo, 1970 (Umthetho No. 70 ka-1970), futhi kubandakanya indawo encane esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza kanye njengomthombo wemvelo osebenza ngawo abantu ukukhiqiza phakathi kokunye ukudla, izitshalo, neziphuzo. Noma iyiphi inja ebonisa ukuziphatha okungafanele noma enobudlova ngaphandle kokuthi le nja igcinwe iboshwe noma ikhefu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izivakashi ezaziwayo kulezo zindawo ziphephile ezinsukwini zokuhlaselwa yizinja. Noma iyiphi inja enezindawo ezingavikelwe ngogogo ezakhiwe ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuthi le nja igcinwa kulezo zindawo noma endaweni efanele evikelwe engaphansi kwama-70m2 lapho inja ingagcinwa khona, ngaphandle kokuthi le nja iboshwe, uma kungenzeka kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngendawo evikelwe engama-70m2 kulezo zindawo, le ndawo evikelwe kufanele ibe usayizi obekwe ngommeli ogunyaziwe, kubhekwa usayizi wendawo, noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka noma izakhiwo, isimo sendawo kanye nesimo sayo kanye nohlobo lwenja. Noma iyiphi inja yentombazane efanele ukuhlinzeka ngaphandle kokuthi le nja yentombazane igcinwe ngaphansi kokulawula okufanele ukuze igweme ukuphazamisa ozakwethu nomphakathi. Ngaphandle kokuthi kube ifamu kanye/noma umphakathi ngaphansi kweNkosi njengoba kuchazwe lapha, izinja ezingaphezu kwezintathu ngenani ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe yeBhodi, le mvume inikezwa ngaphansi kwezimo futhi ingakhanselwa yiBhodi. Umuntu ophumile, mayelana nenja esetshenziselwa lowo muntu njengenjini yokuhola, uma le nja ingahlinzekwa yiNhlangano Yezinja Zokuhola yaseNingizimu Afrika noma enye inhlangano efanayo noma uma le nja iqinisekiswe ngokubhaliwe ngosebenzi wenhlangano okukhulunywa ngayo noma enye inhlangano efanayo noma igatsha layo, njengenjini efanele abantu abanezinselelo zokubona. Noma iyiphi inja ehlasela, ibhite noma enobudlova kumuntu, ngaphandle kokuthi kube khona ubufakazi bokuthi le ndlela yenzeke ukuze ivikele umnikazi noma umgibeli, abathintekayo noma impahla yabo futhi ukuthi umuntu obhitiwe yinja ubengozini enkulu kumnikazi, abathintekayo noma impahla noma umgibeli, noma ukuthi umuntu obhitiwe yinja wangena empahleni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi noma ngamandla. (Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lo mthetho wephuliwe, akudingeki kuboniswe ubufakazi bokuthi le nja ibonakale ibonisa ukuziphatha okungafanele ngaphambili noma ukuthi ibiphatha ngendlela engamukelekile njengoba kulindeleke ezilwaneni zasekhaya). Ukukhala njalo, ukuhamba, ukwenza ezinye izwi, kuphazamisa ukuthula komphakathi noma kuphoxa ozakwethu, kuphula lezi zinhlinzeko zomphakathi uma ukuphazamiseka noma ukuphazamiseka kuqhubeka ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esifanele sokuhlinzekwa esibhalwe phansi nguMphathi Womphakathi noma ummeleli ogunyaziwe, uma sekwamukelwe isikhalazo esibhalwe phansi esisayinwe, sithunyelwe kulowo muntu, sicela ukuthi ukuphazamiseka noma ukuphazamiseka kuze kube sekupheleni; kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi ogunyaziwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphatha KwezeMpi, 1977 (Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977) ungakwenza noma yiziphi izimo lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okufanele kuqedwe ngokushesha, kudlule ekuphakamiseni kwesaziso njengoba kuchazwe lapha futhi uma sibona lezi zinto zikhona thina, sizokhipha isaziso ngokuhambisana nesigaba 341 soMthetho okukhulunywa ngawo ngaphambili kumnikazi waleyo nja noma siqhubeke sithathe izinyathelo zokuqala njengoba kuchazwe kulezi zinhlinzeko zomphakathi. Uma kukhona otholakale enecala lokwephula lo mthetho wesifunda okuphindaphindiwe mayelana naleyo zilwane, kuzoba kufanelekile enkantolo, ethola ukuthi baphula, ukuhlela ukuthi ngaphezu kwanoma yisiphi isijeziso esibekwe, kufanele bakhiphe leyo zilwane ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesifunda 5(a). Uma umnikazi wezindawo engahlali lapho, noma ubani oneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-21 ohlala kulezo zindawo uzobhekwa njengomgibeli waleyo nja kulezo zindawo. Uma kuxoshwa ngaphansi kwalezi zinhlinzeko zomphakathi, kuzoba kufanelekile ukuhlinzeka umnikazi wangempela waleyo nja kungenjalo, xosha umuntu ogcina inja noma obhekwa njengomgibeli waleyo nja. Ekwenzeni okungahambi kahle futhi ngaphandle komnikazi, ingasuswa noma igcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesifunda 5(a) noma (b) futhi, uma itholakala iyingozi, ibhite noma iguliswa, ingabulawa ngummeli ogunyaziwe. Noma iyiphi inja engasiyena umnikazi wombuso noma umnikazi wempahla etholeka kulowo mhlaba, uma inejwayelo lokuhlasela noma iyiphi inja yomnikazi walowo mhlaba, izophathwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 5(a) kuya ku-(g) zalolu hlelo lwemiphakathi; ngaphandle kokuthi kube yisimo lapho kungelula khona kumphakathi ogunyaziwe noma kumnikazi ukuqoqa le nja ngezizathu ezithile, umphakathi ogunyaziwe ungakhipha umyalo kumnikazi waleyo nja noma noma ubani ofanele osethwe ngabo ukuyibulala noma siyibulale thina. Noma kunjalo, izimo eziphathelene nokubulawa kwaleyo nja ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba kufanele zibikwe ebhodini ngokushesha ngemva kwesigameko. Imibhalo yephakheji yabaphathi (GEMS management package documentation) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhula, futhi izinhlelo zokuphatha ziba nezidingo ezinzima. Kulokhu, i-GEMS management package ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile kubaphathi abadinga ukuphatha izinsiza zabo ngendlela efanele. Le mibhalo yephakheji iyinsiza ebalulekile, eqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani leli thuluzi ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS package yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha. Imibhalo yayo ibhalwe ngesiZulu esicacile, okwenza kube lula kubaphathi abakhuluma isiZulu ukuyiqonda. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izilimi eziningi zihlala zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi ukufinyelela kulwazi oluqondile kubalulekile ekuphatheni kahle izinsiza. Ngokubheka izigaba ezihlukene zomsebenzi, imibhalo ye-GEMS ibonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izinsiza, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zezezimali, abantu, nezinsiza zokusebenza. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kwenza kube lula kubaphathi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngokushesha. Imibhalo ibuye ibonise izibonelo ezithile, ezisiza abaphathi ukuba baqonde kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza zezezimali, imibhalo ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuphatha izabelomali, ukuhlela izindleko, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani lokhu. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izabelomali. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza zabantu, imibhalo ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuhola, ukuqasha, nokuphatha abasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangabaphatha kanjani abasebenzi babo, futhi bazi kahle izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bayaziswa futhi bayakhuthazwa. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinqubo zokuphatha abantu. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza zokusebenza, imibhalo ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuphatha izinsiza zokusebenza, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zokusebenza, izinsiza zokuxhumana, nezinsiza zokuphatha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zinsiza ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izinsiza zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imibhalo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ekuchazeni izinqubo zokuhlola nokuhlaziya ukusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangahlola kanjani ukusebenza kwabo, futhi bazi kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo. I-GEMS package ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-templates nezinsiza ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuhlola ukusebenza. Ngokuphetha, imibhalo yephakheji ye-GEMS management package ibalulekile kubaphathi abadinga ukuphatha izinsiza zabo ngendlela efanele. Le mibhalo ibhalwe ngesiZulu esicacile, okwenza kube lula kubaphathi abakhuluma isiZulu ukuyiqonda. I-GEMS package ihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha, futhi imibhalo yayo ibonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izinsiza, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zezezimali, abantu, nezinsiza zokusebenza. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kwenza kube lula kubaphathi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngokushesha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi basebenzise le mibhalo ukuze bathuthukise ukusebenza kwabo, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zabo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS management package izoba yinsiza ebalulekile kubaphathi, futhi imibhalo yayo izoba yinsiza ebalulekile ekuphatheni izinsiza. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abaphathi bazi kahle ukuthi bangaphatha kanjani izinsiza zabo ukuze bafeze izinhloso zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bahlale befundisa futhi behlola le mibhalo ukuze baqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zabo zokuphatha.
I-NPI iyisisekelo somphakathi, ebhekwa njengokwesekwa kweSikhungo Sokuqashwa, ngenhloso yokuphatha kwezezimali zizwe. Ihloselwe ukuba ibe yisikhungo esihola phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindinganiso zomkhiqizo eziphelele, ngezindlela ezintsha nezisindayo zokuthi "kuwusizo kubo bonke ngendlela efanele emphakathini." I-National Product Foundation iyikhandidethi elinophiko oluthathu oluzinikele ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakamiseni izinga lemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika ngokuchaza umoya we-triangle ngokucwaninga, ukusabalalisa ulwazi, ukuqeqesha, ukuvuselela, ukuxhumana, ukuhlola izincwadi, nokuphatha kuyo yonke imisebenzi yomkhiqizo kanye nenkinga yokuphakamisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Vakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi ye-NPI, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezinhlelo zayo. I-NPI ithuthukisile izinhlelo eziyisihlanu zokubhekana nezinkinga ezibalulekile, izinhlelo, nezinyathelo. Umphathi weZinhlelo ubheka zonke izinhlelo. Umthetho Wokuphakanyiswa Kwe-Access to Information, Umthetho 2 ka-2000 (lapha okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umthetho") uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngokufeza ilungelo lesi sikhungo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso kanye nolwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze uqhubeke noma uvikele noma yiziphi iz права, futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. IKomidi leMithetho Yabantu eNingizimu Afrika liphakathi kwemigomo yeSahluko 10 soMthetho, ukukhishwa kwesikhumbuzo esiqukethe ulwazi olungacelwa noma yimuphi umuntu (lapha okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umceli") ukuze umceli uthole ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso kanye/noma omunye umuntu, lapho ulwazi lolu ludingeka ukuze uqhubeke noma uvikele noma yiziphi iz права zomceli. I-NPI, uma kudingeka, izobuyekeza futhi ikhishwe izichibiyelo kulolu documeti oluchazayo uma noma uma kufanelekile, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli unyaka. Akukho kuchazwa kulabo i-NPI inawo ulwazi ngabo noma amarekhodi wezincwadi ezitholakalayo mayelana nabo ukuze kusabalaliswe. Ngokwesimo somthetho, umceli kufanele anikezwe ukufinyelela kumarekhodi omphakathi uma umceli ehambisana nazo zonke izidingo zokusebenza zomthetho ezihlobene nokucela ukufinyelela kulolo rekodi, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi irekhodi elibhalwe alikhululiwe nganoma yiziphi izinkinga ezichazwe kulo mthetho. Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi abhalwe njengoba kuchaziwe emthethweni kufanele sibe nobudlelwano obubalulekile neFomu A yePolisi -187 edlulelwa ngomhla kaFebhuwari 15, 2002, ukushicilelwa kwayo kutholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi lwe-NPI kanye/noma noma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala, noma unenkinga ethile evimbela ekusebenziseni amalungelo akhe njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi abhalwe singaqhutshelwa ngokuqondile kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma noma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Idivayisi Yokuxhumana ye-NPI idlala indima ebalulekile ekuhloleni izenzo zomkhiqizo emkhakheni wezomnotho, wezohwebo, nezomphakathi kanye nezikhungo ezisekelwe emphakathini, futhi inikeza izeluleko zokuthi lokhu kungasetshenziswa kanjani. Iqembu lokuxhumana le-NPI linikeza ulwazi olunembile kanye nobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene obuqoqwe ngokwenza imisebenzi eminingi yomkhiqizo emakethe yasekhaya nasezwenikazi ngonyaka. Uhlelo luthumele izinsizakalo zalo ezindaweni ezine, okungukuthi, iTest Court, Izinqubo Zokufunda, Ukuphathwa Kokumaketha, kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezokusebenza. Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nalezi zinsizakalo lungatholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma noma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Ngokwezinye izikhungo zomphakathi, i-NPI ayinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokufaka izikhalazo. Lapho umceli ekholelwa ukuthi i-NPI ayihambisanga noma yehlulekile ukulandela izibopho zayo ngaphansi komthetho, le ndaba izobhekwa ngamaqembu afanele abambe iqhaza, uma kuvunyelwene, noma noma yiliphi iqembu lingaxhumana nanoma yisiphi isikhungo esinamalungelo kulolu daba.
Imvume yokusebenza ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano iyidokhumenti enikezwa abantu ababuya ngaphandle ukuze bangene eNingizimu Afrika ukuze babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezivunyelwene phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezizwe ezithintekayo kulezi zivumelwano. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI - 1738 ehhovisi le-embassy laseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni oseduze. Incwadi evela kwelinye lamagunya kahulumeni afanele kule sivumelwano, eqinisekisa uhlelo. Le ncwadi izoqinisekisa ukuvunyelwa kohlelo olusetshenziswayo, ukubamba iqhaza komfakisicelo okukhulunywa ngaye kuhlu, kanye nemisebenzi elindeleke ukuthi yenziwe ngumfakisicelo ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano. Isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka kukapolisa somfakisicelo esivela kuzo zonke izindawo lapho umfakisicelo kanye nezincikayo zabo behlale khona, ukusuka eminyakeni engu-18, kanye nezingane ezincikayo ezineminyaka engu-18 nangaphezulu, ezizohamba nomfakisicelo ziye eNingizimu Afrika. Incwadi yokuzibophezela evela kumqashi, lapho bevuma khona ukukhokhela izindleko zokubuyisela umfakisicelo, kanye nalabo abancike kubo uma kudingeka. Uma umqashi engumnyango kahulumeni futhi engakwazi ukukhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela, izwe elithumela lowo muntu lingakhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela.
Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuthandekayo nokunomusa kubaguli abahlala esibhedlela nabangahlali esibhedlela kusekelwe ohlelweni oluthuthukisiwe lwezempilo, futhi kusiza ekufundiseni, ukubhalisela, ukuhlole, ukuhlinzeka ngezins advice, nokudlulisela abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa okungaphezu kwamakhono esibhedlela sethu. Ungafinyelela izinsizakalo ngokulandela imithetho nemigomo ebekwe nguHulumeni Kazwelonke yokusebenza kwesibhedlela sesifunda. Uma udinga usizo olungaphansi kwezinga lethu noma oluncane, sizokudlulisa endaweni yokwelashwa uma kutholakala ukuthi awukwazi ukwelashwa kule ndawo ngemuva kokuhlolwa. Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi wezokusebenza ubebambe umcimbi obalulekile wokuhlanganyela, ogxile ekukhuthazeni izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi. Lo mcimbi, obubanjelwe eGoli, wahlanganisa abaphathi, osomabhizinisi, kanye nezikhungo zokuqeqesha, bonke bejolise ekwakheni izixazululo ezithuthukisa impumelelo yabasebenzi emsebenzini wabo. UMsunguli, uMnu. Sipho Mthethwa, uvule umcimbi ngenkulumo ejabulisayo, egcizelela ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kubalulekile emhlabeni oshintsha ngokushesha. Wathi: "Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa akufanele zicabangele njengezindleko, kodwa ziwumthombo wokukhula kwabantu nezinkampani." Lokhu kwavusa umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabathokozisi, abavuma ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kudala amathuba amaningi. Ngemuva kokuvula, umcimbi waqhubeka nezinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezivela kubachwepheshe abahlukene. UProf. Thandiwe Nkosi, ongumfundisi wezokuphatha, wabelane ngocwaningo lwakhe olukhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezihambelana nezidingo zabasebenzi zikhulisa ukusebenza kahle. Waphinde wathi: "Uma sithuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi bethu, sithuthukisa nempumelelo yenkampani." Lokhu kwaholela ekuxoxeni okujulile phakathi kwabathokozisi, abanye bephakamisa izindlela zokwenza izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zibe ngcono. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, umcimbi wahamba phambili nezingxoxo eziphumelelayo. Abasebenzi baphendula imibuzo ethokozisayo, bechaza izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, okwakubalulekile ekwakheni isimo sokusebenza esivulekile. UMsizi Wokuphatha, uNkk. Zanele Dlamini, uthe: "Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi kubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enempilo." Ngemuva kokuxoxisana, umcimbi waphinde waba nezingxenye zokusebenza ezibandakanya izifundo ezimfushane. Abasebenzi bathola ithuba lokuzama amakhono amasha, njengokuphatha isikhathi, ukuxhumana kahle, nokusebenza eqenjini. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokufunda, futhi abathokozisi babonisa intshiseko enkulu. UProf. Nkosi wakhuthaza bonke ukuba baphokophele ukufunda okungapheli, ethi: "Ukufunda akupheli, futhi amakhono akho kufanele ahlale ethuthuka." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nezingxoxo ezithinta izindlela zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni amakhono. UMsizi Wokuphatha, uMnu. Themba Khumalo, wabelane ngempumelelo yeziqu ze-inthanethi ezithuthukisa amakhono. Wathi: "Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize, futhi kufanele sithathe ithuba lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza." Lokhu kwavusa umoya ophakeme, njengoba abathokozisi bahlola izindlela zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe emsebenzini wabo. Ngokuhamba komcimbi, abathokozisi banikezwa ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye, bephakamisa imibono emisha yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. UMsizi Wokuphatha, uNkk. Lindiwe Mkhize, uthe: "Siyakwazi ukufunda kakhulu kwabanye, futhi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana kubalulekile." Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwezinkampani, okwakuzokwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi. Emva kokuphothula umcimbi, abathokozisi baphinde bahlola izinzuzo ezivela ezinhlelweni zokuqeqeshwa. UProf. Nkosi waphakamisa ukuthi izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zazo, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala bephumelele. Wathi: "Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa akufanele zibe yinto eyodwa kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube inqubo eqhubekayo." Umcimbi uphothulwe ngenkulumo yokubonga, lapho uMnu. Mthethwa ebonga bonke abathokozisi ngokuba khona kwabo. Wathi: "Siyabonga ngokuba lapha, futhi sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba aqhubeke nokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe." Lokhu kwavusa umoya ophakeme, njengoba abathokozisi bephuma emcimbini bejabulile, bejabulisa izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi. Ngokuphetha, lo mcimbi wawuwumcimbi ophumelelayo, ogcizelela ukubaluleka kokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zibalulekile ekwakheni abasebenzi abaphumelelayo, futhi umcimbi ubonise ukuthi umphakathi wezokusebenza unomthwalo wokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Abasebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nezikhungo zokuqeqesha bahlala bejolise ekwakheni izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuze sibe nempumelelo emsebenzini.

Zonke izindawo zangaphandle kumele zibe zihlanzekile futhi zingenadaka. Akukho mfula nezokukhipha amanzi anikezelwe. Izindawo zokubulala kumele zibe nohlelo lokuvalela amanzi nokuqeda udoti ukuze kungene endaweni efanele yamapayipi amanzi angcolile. Izindawo zokulayisha nokukhulula izimoto kumele zivikela, zibe nezindlela ezinhle, futhi zibe nephepha. d ukugcina inyama ethunjiwe kanye nokuhlolwa kwayo kumele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokungcolisa leyo nyama. n yonke imishini, izakhiwo, nezinsiza ezibekwe odongeni kumele zibe okungenani ku-50mm kude. c akufanele kube ne-oyela wenyama. iziqukathi zokugcina inyama kumele zihambisane nesigaba 1, uma phansi nangaphezulu kunezikhala kumele zenziwe ngendlela yokuthi inyama ingaphumi ezikhala noma ithinte umhlaba. Amathoyilethi nezindawo zokuhlanza kumele akhiwe endaweni ehlukile enikeza iminyango ehlukene ezindlini zokushintsha. zonke amathoyilethi kumele abe nezikhwama zokubeka iphepha lokuhlanza, izindawo zokuhlanza izandla, izikhwama zokuphakela ugesi ezibulala amagciwane, nezinsiza zokomisa izandla. Izindawo zokushintsha nezamathoyilethi akufanele zingeze ngqo endaweni noma igumbi lapho inyama igcinwa khona. Noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuhlanza ngokupheka kumele ivunywe ngabaphathi bendawo. f kufanele banikezwe isikhwama esibamba ugesi obulala amagciwane kanye nezinsiza zokomisa izandla ngaphandle uma kungekho mfuneko yokomisa izandla endaweni lapho kukhona isikhala sokuhlanza izandla. Izindawo zokugcina udoti nezikhwama zodoti ngaphambi kokukhipha kumele zihlanzeke, zikhishwe, futhi zibe zingenamanzi futhi kumele zivalwe noma zifakwe izikhwama ezivaliwe kahle. g kumele kube nokukhanya okwanele lapho izilwane zikhululwa ebusuku. d kumele kube nezimo ezingaphansi kuka-1m ezisetshenziselwa ukufaka izilwane eziphawulwe kumele zakhiwe ngodonga oluqinile kanye nesango futhi akumele kuvunyelwe ukuhlanganiswa nezinye izinkomo noma kudaleke ingozi yokungcolisa ezinye izilwane. c ukudla kwezilwane kumele kugcinwe endaweni yokugcina evikelwe ezinyoni futhi ebekelwe le njongo, uma ukudla kuzogcinwa ngaphakathi kwezindawo. c 0.50m² impungushe, imbuzi noma ingane. Indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu ifaka indawo ezizungezile kanye nendawo uqobo, futhi inganwebeka ibe yindawo enkulu. Kulolu suku olungcwele, abacwaningi baqoqana ubufakazi ngenhloso yokukhombisa ukuthi ubugebengu bukhona, befuna izimpawu futhi baxhumanise lezi zimpawu nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Uma ubugebengu benzeka, ababi bleave izimpawu endaweni ngokungena noma ukuphuma ngendlela ethile. Le ndlela iba yingxenye yendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu futhi iyindlela ehlangene ngqo nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Lapho amaphoyisa efika endaweni, awanalo uqiniseko oluphelele ngalokho okwenzekile. Ungasiza ukuhlole le ndawo engcwele ngokubheka zonke izindlela ezisetshenziswe ngababi. Ukuhlola ubugebengu kuhilela ukuqoqwa kobufakazi bokwazi kanye nezimpawu ezibonakalayo. Ubufakazi obubonakalayo bungaba impahla noma izinto ezithile ezingasetshenziswa ngamaphoyisa ukuze axazulule icala. Amaphoyisa asebenzisa isibonelo sokuthi uma izinto ezimbili zihlangana, kukhona izinto ezingajwayelekile ezifana nezinwele, ushokoledi, umswakama, uthuli, nezimpawu zokuthinta. Lezi yizinto zobufakazi okufanele zihlolwe ngamaphoyisa. Ubufakazi bungaba bukhona, njengokuphrinta kwezicathulo, noma bungabonakala kahle ngaphansi kwe-microscope, njengamafibha noma izimpawu zegazi. Ubuchwepheshe besimanje buwenza kube lula kumaphoyisa ukuhlanganisa abantu nendawo kanye nezinto. Ukuze kusebenze ubuchwepheshe, izindawo zokwenziwa kobugebengu kufanele zigcinwe futhi zivikelwe ekuhlanganyeleni okungadingekile okungaphazamisa ubufakazi. Ngokugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, amaphoyisa azokwazi ukuqoqwa ubufakazi obuqondile. Ukuphazamisa indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu kudala isimo lapho ubufakazi obungatholwa futhi obusebenziseka buyehliswa. Ukugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, "indawo engcwele," kuyisibopho esibalulekile. Ungathinti noma ususe izinto endaweni, ezifana nezinto zokuhlala, izingubo, noma ukudla. Ungasebenzisi noma ifoni yakho; okungenani cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane wakho. Sebenzisa enye indlela, hhayi leyo esetshenziswa ngababi. Uma kungenzeka, buyela ekhaya. Cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane noma enye indawo ukuze ubike lesi sehlakalo. Linda amaphoyisa. Lapho ubika ubugebengu, nikeza ulwazi oluphelele mayelana nendawo ongatholakala kuyo, uma amaphoyisa edinga olunye ulwazi ngaphambi kokufika endaweni. Khombisa indlela noma umgwaqo owawusebenzisa. Bonke abakwi ndawo noma eduze bangaba ngofakazi. Tshela amaphoyisa konke okwaziyo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukubona kwakho kubonakala kungabalulekile. Bhala konke phambi kokuxoxa nabanye ngoba ungakhohlwa noma uphazamiseke.
Le nsiza isebenza kumuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika; noma kumuntu osevele enevumelekile yokusebenza ibhizinisi kuleli; noma kumuntu ofuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini elikhona kuleli. Izicelo zingafakwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle esifundazweni lapho ibhizinisi lihlelelwe ukuba lenziwe. Faka isicelo embikweni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Umphakathi wezimali ophathiswe ngawe kufanele uthumele isiqinisekiso sokuthi inani elibekwe ngempela lilingana nenani elibekiwe kumadokhumenti ebhizinisi. Inani elibekwe lokufakwa lihlala ku-R2.5 million, futhi le mali ingabekelwa ngaphandle noma yehliswa uma izohlangabezana nezidingo zesizwe, noma uma iceliwe nguMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuba enze kanjalo. Uma ukuhlala okuphakade sekwanikeziwe, isiqinisekiso somphakathi wezimali kufanele sihlaziywe njalo eminyakeni emibili ngemuva kosuku lokukhishwa kwevumelekile yokuhlala okuphakade, futhi kweminyaka emithathu elandelayo. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nalokhu kuzoholela ekutheni ivumelekile yokuhlala okuphakade ikhanselwe. Akukho sikhathi esichaziwe salensiza.
Izinyathelo ezizolandela uma iziphathimandla zezimoto zifaka isandla ezinyathelweni eziphikisana nomncintiswano. Ukuphathwa nokugcina kweMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke kuyresponsibility yeZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. Ibhodi ibhekisela ebhodini labaphathi beMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke osunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 6. Iziphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke zibhekisela kumphakathi wamaphothi eNingizimu Afrika. "Abasebenzisi bamaphothi" babhekisela kulabo abaqondile abasebenzisa iphothi (abanikazi bezikebhe), nalabo abangasebenzisi iphothi ngqo (abangenisi bezimpahla ezivela phesheya nabaqhamukeli bezimpahla kwezinye izizwe), kanye nabaphakathi ezisebenzelaneni zamaphothi (ababambisene) nabasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphothi (abakhiqizi nabasebenzisi). Abasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphothi bangabantu abakhokha ngezinsizakalo zamaphothi. Ngakho-ke abakhiqizi nabasebenzisi bezwe bangabantu bokugcina bamaphothi. "Amaphothi" abhekisela kumaphothi ezohwebo akhishwe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Kuzokwakhiwa isikhungo esisemthethweni esizophathwa yiMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke, esizoba nebhodi, umkomishana, nabasebenzi. Ukuvikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla nokwenza kube nokuqinisekiswa kokuthi amaphothi asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ngokulandela izimo zokusebenzisa amaphothi. Ukuhlola nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele, uma kudingeka, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iTransnet ayihlanganyeli ezimweni zokuphikisana nomncintiswano ezihlanganyela neZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke nokuthi imali eqoqiwe yiZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke isetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka iziphathimandla, abasebenzisi, futhi ibe nomthelela ezinhlelweni zezezimali nezokuxhumana zomphakathi. Ukuhlela iZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke ekwenzeni imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Ukuqondisa izinyathelo ezifanele ezizolandela uma kukhona okukhuluma ngokuziphatha okuphikisana nomncintiswano. Silawula futhi sihlola iMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. Sivikela futhi senze njengendawo yokudlulisa izikhalazo nokunganeliseki okuqondiswe kuZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. IMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ihlola, ihlaziye, futhi ithatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukusiza ekwenzeni lo mthetho kanye nezinye izinqubomgomo ezihlobene. Sivikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla futhi siqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanele kumaphothi nokutholakala kwezinsizakalo zamaphothi, sihlola futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ayitholi izinzuzo ezingafanele phezu kwezinye izinkampani zokuthutha nokuthi imali eqoqiwe ngamaphothi isetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka nokuthuthukisa isakhiwo sezamaphothi nezisebenzi ukuze kube nomthelela kubasebenzisi bamaphothi. Siqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuphathwa kweMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke yiZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. Siqapha futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphothi ayatholakala, nokuthi izinsiza zamaphothi ziyatholakala ngaphandle kokucwaswa, ngempumelelo, nangokucacile. Ukwandisa ukuphepha; ukuvikeleka kwezimali, kanye nokusebenza kahle kwamaphothi. Ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kwesikhathi esifanele nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezisetshenziswa kumaphothi ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo nezilindelo zabasebenzisi bamaphothi, ukuqinisekisa ukuhlela kahle kwezohwebo phakathi kwalabo abenza ezamaphothi nalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kumaphothi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke zinikeza usizo olufanele futhi zilandela izindinganiso zamazwe omhlaba ezamukelekayo, ukuxhumana nezinsizakalo zikamasipala nezinye izithakazelo ezibalulekile emkhakheni wamaphothi, nokuhlanganisa nokugcina ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi yeZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. Sisebenzisa noma yiziphi amandla, sihlangabezana nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, noma ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano somhlaba. IMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke izoba namalungu angaphansi kuka-5 nangaphezulu kuka-13 abekwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze bisebenze isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu, futhi la malungu angaphinde abekwa kabusha. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, lobuchwepheshe, lwezohwebo, lwezimali, lokuthuthukiswa, nolunye ulwazi olufanele oluhambelana nomkhakha wezokuthutha kwezilwandle. Kumele bakhethwe noma bathathe indawo yabanye ngendlela ekhuthaza intuthuko nokwakhiwa kwamakhono. UNgqongqoshe angabeka isikhundla eMnyangweni Wezokuthutha ukuba kube nguMongameli weMphakathi Wamaphothi Ozimele. Uma ilungu leBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ngaphandle kwaleli lungu elibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3 ngezizathu ezithile lishiya ukuba ilungu, uNgqongqoshe angabeka noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise le ndawo esele. Ilungu leBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke lingathola umholo ngenxa yokusebenza kwalo, ngemiholo ethathwa nguNgqongqoshe ngezikhathi ezithile. Ilungu elinokuphikisana nezithakazelo noma elingase libe nokuphikisana nezithakazelo ezingase zifake engcupheni isikhundla sawo njengelungu kumele lidlulise izithakazelo zawo kuBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. Bonke amalungu kumele baveze izithakazelo zabo kuBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zikhona ezomuntu, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezihlobene nezohwebo, futhi baziwe uMongameli nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. Noma yisiphi isiphulwa senkohlakalo esibekwe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho singase singahlangabezani nezidingo ezibekwe esigabeni 6. Bangakhokhelwa umholo futhi bangakhokhela abasebenzi imiholo, izinzuzo, nezinye izinzuzo ezamukelwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umkomishana kumele aqaphe zonke izinkulumo zokukhala nezikhalazo ezilethwa phambi kweMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. Kumele abhale futhi athumele umbiko wonyaka mayelana nokusebenza kweMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. IMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ingabamba imihlangano uma kudingeka ukuze iqhube imisebenzi yayo. Uma ithola isicelo esibhaliwe esivela kumalungu amane, uMongameli angabiza umhlangano ozobanjwa phakathi kwesonto kusukela ngosuku alutholayo lesicelo. Izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe emihlanganweni kumele zisetshenziswe. Inani lamalungu okumele abe khona emhlanganweni weMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke kumele kube iningi lamalungu.
