Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Ingxoxo noDkt. Mthembu Qala Umsebenzi Usuku lwethu lungumsebenzi omkhulu! Namuhla sikhuluma noDkt. Sipho Mthembu, udokotela onolwazi olukhulu kwezokubeletha. Siza sithole ukuhlakanipha kwakhe mayelana nezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, nemikhiqizo ethinta impilo yabesifazane nabatfwana. Ukubamba Umkhosi U-Dkt. Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokwamukela lesi sikhathi sokukhuluma nawe. Ngabe ungathanda ukusitshela ukuthi yiziphi izinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezihlotshaniswa nokubeletha ezibhedlela? Ngeshwa, Uthando, Kanye Nezindlela Zokubeletha Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha zenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane benza ukuzalwa okuvikelekile, kukhona ukusizakala kwabo nabantwana. Silapha ukusiza ngemuva kokuhlolwa kokugula, ezinhlosweni zokuvikela, ne-cesarean section uma kudingeka. Abesifazane banethuba lokukhetha phakathi kwezinqubo ezahlukene, kusukela ekubeletheni ngendlela yemvelo kuya kwi-epidural, enesizotha sokwehlisa phezulu kobuhlungu. Ukwazi Ngemitholampilo Ukukhuluma ngempilo, uma ngabe sithanda ukukhipha izinsiza kulezi zinsizakalo, ungathanda ukusitshela ukuthi abesifazane bangawakhuluma kanjani amathuba okuba nomntwana? Ikhaya Elihle Ngemva Kokubeletha Ngempela, sikhuthaza abesifazane ukuba babe nemikhandlu yokuxhumana nabangani nabaluleki ngaphambi kokuba kube khona ukukhulelwa. Imithethosisekelo ibalulekile, njengoba kukhulu ukuthola usizo lwezemiphakathi. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo kubandakanya iziguli ezithokozisayo, iziqondiso zokuhlola impilo, kanye ne-psychosocial support okuhloswe ngakho ukuthuthukisa isimo sokuphila kwabazali. Ukubambisana neMindset Phakathi kokubeletha, kukhona indlela yokubambisana ebuhlungu. Ingabe ubona yini izinselelo ezinjani ezingaphephisa abesifazane? Umlando Wokubeleka Yebo, kunezinkinga eziningi ezingabakhona kulolu hlelo. Kungaba ukungaqondi kahle izinsiza, ukungabi namathuba okuxhumana, noma izimo zokungabi nempilo. Kuhle ukuthi siyakwazi ukufundisa abesifazane ngendlela yokuhlangabezana nalezi zinkinga ukuze benze ukufakazela okuhle. Umsebenzi wethu uwukuqhuba ukubekezela, ukujabulisa, nokwenza ngcono impilo yabesifazane. Izinyathelo Ezinzima Njengomsebenzisi wezinsizakalo ezibhedlela, yini efanele ukuba ibhekwane ngayo ngaleso sikhathi? Isibani Sempumelelo Ngamabomu! Umbono wethu uwukwenza kube lula, ukugwema imizamo enokwehluka. Emhlanganweni nabethameli, abuza izinkinga motoris. Kwesinye isikhathi, izicelo ezibhedlela zingavela ezicini zamalungelo nokubambisana komndeni, ukunciphisa izithiyo, nokukhuthaza imiphumela ehlangene. Ukukhula Kokubeletha Emhlabeni we-2023, yiziphi izinguquko obona zenzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubeletha? Bhazala Phila Ukukhula kwemisebenzi, izinsiza eziphakeme, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nezinselelo kubalulekile. Sifaka izipesheli eziningi zokwelapha, ukwakha ezindlela ezifanele ezenzakalayo. Izinsizakalo zethu zifaka ukuphakamisa umoya wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabesifazane. Izenzo Zokugcina Dkt. Mthembu, ukhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, ezingxoxweni, kunjani ukuzama ukwazisa nabesifazane ngezinsizakalo ezitholakala ezibhedlela? Nakhu Uthando Lokuphila Eminyakeni yamuva, sakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana zamakhosikazi nabesifazane abakhulelwe, okubavumela ukuba bacacise izidingo zabo. Ukusungulwa kwama-workshops nabafundi bokuphilisa kudlale indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni ulwazi. Uhlanga olugcwele imishado, lokho kudala ubudlelwano nokwabelana bemibono emisha. Inhloso Yokugcina Ukubeletha kube yindlela ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi edinga ukuqonda okulungile, ubuhlakani, nezinzuzo. Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esijabulisayo sokukhuluma futhi ufisa ukufinyelela izinsizakalo ezikhukhulwayo ezinobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Esihle Konke lokhu kuyakuphakamisa, kuba ubufakazi bokuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukuthokoziswa, ukuqhubeka nokwenziwa kangcono, kube nemiphumela emihle empilweni yabesifazane nakwabazali. Ngiyabonga abantu bethu nomcimbi omuhle ofuna ukuphilisa izimpilo.
Isivumelwano seKhartoum sika-1988 sathi: "Ngoba umuntu uyisisekelo sokuthuthukiswa konke, isimo sokuphila komuntu yiso kuphela esingalinganiswa ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa kwalolo sikhathi sokuphila kwabantu kubalulekile kakhulu kulabo abampofu nabasengozini, abawumjikelezo omkhulu e-Afrika. Abesilisa nabesifazane base-Afrika bangabantu okufanele baqinisekise futhi baqiniswa yisiphi uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa." Sekudlule iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili selokhu lesi sivumelwano sasayinwa ngabesilisa nabesifazane abathwele umthwalo wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, kodwa kuze kube manje umsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlonipha isithunzi sabantu ngokubaphelezela ngosizo lwezempilo awukaphelelanga. Mnumzane ophakeme, ngicela ngithumele umcabango kancane. Ngiyashoda ngamazwi okukhombisa ukubonga ngezwi lokududuza nolwesekelo engilithole kubalaleli baleli zinga kanye nabantu abaningi esifundazweni sethu nakwezinye izindawo ngenkathi ngiphakanyiswa yizinkanyezi ezimnyama. Ngonyaka owedlule, umzukulu wami engimthandayo, engimsebenzelayo, washona engozini yemoto, kwalandela ubaba wami ezinyangeni ezimbalwa kamuva. Ukushona kwabo kuthathe uthando nokwesekwa okwakuyisisekelo sempilo yami. NgoJanuwari walonyaka, indodana yami uMonde yashona ngokungazelelwe. Ukushona kwakhe kungithinte kakhulu. UMonde wayengumuntu owayefunwa yizwe lethu, isizukulwane esisha sabaholi abazosisiza kulo nyaka nakweminye iminyaka ezayo. Ukusekela kwenu nokududuza kwenu kwangisiza ngaleso sikhathi esinzima. Angazi ukuthi ngabe ngabe ngiyini ngaphandle kwenu. Niyakhumbuza sonke ukuthi nakuba imizuzu ibheavy empilweni yethu, niyohlala nikhona ukusisekela, okuyinto esenza sikhumbule ubuntu. Ngiyabonga nonke kakhulu. Mnumzane ophakeme, madoda nabesifazane, ngicela ngethule le nkulumo egameni labantu abathathu engibasebenzelayo kakhulu. Ngithanda futhi ukuthula le nkulumo egameni labasebenzi bethu bezempilo abashiya kithi ngonyaka owedlule nalo nyaka kuze kube namuhla. Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukuze ngithumele izinhlelo zami kumindeni nabangane babo abasala emuva. NjengeSikhungo, kuyasiphoxa kakhulu ukusala kwabasebenzi, ikakhulukazi ngoba sidinga ithimba eliqinile ukuze silwe nezifo nobuphofu. Ngomhla ziyi-7 kuMbasa, sathokozisa Usuku Lomhlaba Lokunakekelwa Kwezempilo. Isihloko salonyaka sithi "Sisebenzisana ukuze sibe nempilo." Ngesikhathi lesi, sahlonipha iminikelo yabasebenzi bezempilo, futhi saphinde saphawula ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Lo msebenzi ungumsebenzi odinga abantu abaningi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba necebo, hhayi nje lokuqasha abasebenzi, kodwa nokugcina labo abasebenzi bejabulile, bethuthukisiwe, futhi besekelwa emsebenzini wabo. Kulonyaka sizokwenza ngcono uhlelo lwethu lokunakekela abasebenzi, siqala ngamaqhinga azokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bethu baqhubeka befunda njalo ukuze le Ndawo ibe yindawo yokufunda nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Njengengxenye yecebo elaqalwa ngonyaka owedlule lokuhlela kabusha le Ndawo, ekuqaleni kwalonyaka kwanikezwa ithimba labaphathi abaphezulu eliholwa nguDkt. Busi Nyembezi, elathatha esikhundleni sikaProfesa Green-Thompson, owayehola le Ndawo iminyaka eyishumi nane. Sifuna ukubonga uProfesa Green-Thompson ngendima ayidlalile ekuletheni usizo lwezempilo esifundazweni sethu. Sifisa ukumthokozisa ngendima yakhe entsha njengomeluleki kuNgqongqoshe wezeMpilo kazwelonke. Ithimba elisha labaphathi lizosebenza phezu kwesisekelo esakhiwe ukuze liphakamise umsebenzi wezempilo ezingeni eliphezulu ngokulwa nezifo, ukulwa nobuphofu, nokunikeza ithemba kubantu. Kulonyaka sizokwakha uhlelo lokuguqula insizakalo yezempilo, i-Health Service Transformation Plan, esizosebenza kuyo kuze kube unyaka ka-2014. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zezempilo zikhishwa ngendlela efanele ezindaweni ezihlukene nasemaphandleni. Ngalolu hlelo, usizo lwezempilo kumele luhambisane nezidingo zabantu, lube nekhwalithi ephezulu, futhi lube nezezimali eziphumelelayo. Lolu hlelo kufanele luphinde luhlolisise udaba lokushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo ngohlelo lwabasebenzi bezempilo kazwelonke olwenziwe ngokofficial ngosuku lweMhlaba Lokunakekelwa Kwezempilo nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Lolu hlelo lubalulekile kakhulu ngoba ukushoda kwabasebenzi kuvimba ukufezekisa Izinhloso Zokuthuthukiswa KweMillennium nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu ezingeni eliphansi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lolu hlelo lwenziwa. NjengeSikhungo kulonyaka, sizosungula izindlela ezintsha zokuqasha, ukuthuthukisa, nokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Umbiko owaziwa njenge- Wealth Report 2006 ubonisa ukuthi isifunda saseMelika seMnyango Wezempilo Womhlaba, esinama-10% ezifo, sinama-37% abasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni futhi sisebenzisa ama-50% ezimali zonke zezempilo emhlabeni, kuyilapho isifunda sase-Afrika, esinama-24% ezifo, sinama-3% abasebenzi futhi sisebenzisa ama-1% ezimali zomhlaba wezempilo. Lo mbiko uqhubeka uthi ukuhamba kwabantu abaqeqeshiwe bezempilo abanezidingo eziphuthumayo kwenza i-Afrika ibhekane kakhulu nokushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ukuze sifeze umgomo wesikhungo sethu - okuwukwethula uhlelo lwezempilo oluhlanganisiwe, oluhlanganisiwe nolubhekelela izidingo zempilo eziphakeme ezindaweni zonke - sizosiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ngokuthenga ama-75 amakhilikhini aphumayo, sakhe amakhilikhini angu-30, nezibhedlela ezintathu ezinkulu kulonyaka wezimali. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, odokotela bezempilo bazophinde baqeqeshwe futhi bakhuphuke ukuze sikwazi ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo. Ukuphathwa kokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo kuzobuyekezwa futhi kuqiniswe. Sizophinde sihlolisise imithetho yethu yokwabiwa kwabasebenzi abasha abaphumelele emaphakathini, kanye nalabo abake bafunda ngaphansi kwezifundo zeSikhungo sethu. Sihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukulingana kulokhu kwabiwa nokuthi yonke imiphakathi iyazuza. Izifundo zethu zinikezwa kubafundi abampofu okwenza umehluko omkhulu, futhi sizophinde siqhubeke nalokhu. Mnumzane ophakeme, sizophinde sikhombise ukuzinikela kwethu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bafinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ngokuqhubeka sithuthukisa uhlelo lwethu lokuhamba kweziguli, oluhamba iziguli ezivela ezibhedlela ziye kwezinye izikhungo noma ezikhungweni ziye ezibhedlela. Ulwazi Oluqondiswa Nggezwi Ezikhungweni: Ukubaluleka Kwezinqubomgomo Zokuxhumana Ezikhathini zanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zethu ziqonde ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphathweni nasekuxhumaneni. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola ulwazi olufanele, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo nezakhamuzi. Ukuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhungo, kungaba izikole, izibhedlela, noma amabhizinisi, zidinga ukuxhumana kahle ukuze zifeze izinhloso zazo. Ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangase babe nezinselelo zokufunda noma zokubhala. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu bengakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi, bahluleka ukuhamba phambili empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo, kanye nezinkulumo ezibukhoma. Ngokwesibonelo, ezikoleni, ukufundisa ngokuqondisa ngezwi kungasiza abafundi abanezinselelo zokufunda. Uma othisha bekwazi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokufundisa ezihambisana nezwi, abafundi bangathola ulwazi ngendlela ethokozisayo futhi elula. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwenza ukufunda kube mnandi, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emfundweni yabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezibhedlela, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lungasiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile. Uma odokotela nabahlengikazi bekhuluma ngokuqondile nabaguli, lokhu kudala isimo sokwethembana. Abaguli bazi ukuthi bangabeka imibuzo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphathelene nezempilo yabo. Lokhu kuxhumana okuhle kuholela ekutheni abaguli bazizwe bekhululekile futhi beqonda kahle izinqubo ezithathwayo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi izikhungo zidinga ukuxhumana kahle; zidinga futhi ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo kufanele ziqonde kahle izidingo zabantu abahlala edolobheni, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinqubo ezicacile zokuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluhambisana nezimo zangempela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lufinyeleleka kubo bonke. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhumana nabantu abanezinselelo ezithile, njengabantu abakhubazekile noma abakhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, izikhungo zingasebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuqonda izilimi ezahlukene, noma zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe bokuhumusha ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ulwazi olufanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zihlale zihlola futhi zithuthukise izinqubomgomo zazo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezikhona, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana nezakhamuzi, ukuze zikwazi ukuthola impendulo ngokuqondile. Ekugcineni, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni luyinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola ulwazi olufanele, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo nezakhamuzi. Uma izikhungo ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zazo zokuxhumana, sizobona umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesandla ekwakheni izikhungo ezihloniphekile, ezisebenzayo, nezisebenzisana kahle nezakhamuzi zazo.
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuguqula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaMasipala awahlukanisi, oluhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, luwumsebenzi obalulekile ekusizeni uhulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo ngokwethula iBhili Yezokuhulumeni Bendawo. Ukuveza uhlaka olusha lwezomthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho WamaMasipala kanye neMthetho Wamasistimu AmaMasipala. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesizinda esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingelinye lamathuluzi ohulumeni bendawo ahloselwe ukubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba nendima yokuhlela eyasungulwa ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengethuluzi lokuphatha amaMasipala futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nezindaba ezifana nokwabiwa kwezimali zamamasipala, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa azizokusiza kuphela ukuphathwa kwamamasipala kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze kukahulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe kuhulumeni, ukwesekwa kwemboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamasipala. Esikhathini esedlule, amaMasipala avame ukuba angakulungelanga ekuhlinzekeni ngezinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. AmaMasipala amaningi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okuguqula) ayenokuntuleka kwezinsiza kanye namakhono okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe kahle ngalokhu, futhi bekungekho izinhlelo zoktraining eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kule ndima benze kahle kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona amaMasipala ambalwa athole intuthuko enkulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezivele zikhona. Izincwadi Zezikhumbuzo ze-IDP, ezasungulwa yiqembu elihlukile le-DPLG elisekelwa yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukhona uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwesizwe lwabaphathi bamamasipala, abasebenzi bezobuchwepheshe, amakhandidethi, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababambiqhaza abakwi-masipala. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zikamasipala (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Inani elikhulu lamamasipala, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yokuhulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi kahulumeni embonini ezweni, iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kule ngqophamlando ye-IDP. Ngibheke phambili kakhulu ukuthi le ngqophamlando yeziqu ezishicilelwe izoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela kwi-IDP nezinselelo zenu zokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ebonisa ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kukhona ukuvumelana ngesidingo sokuba nezikhombisi ezicacile, eziqondile, nezilula zokusebenzisa kanye nesidingo sesu lokuhlela elinikeza indawo yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile, okungabhekwa kuphela ngochwepheshe bokuhlela abakhiqiza imibhalo nomsebenzi wamahhovisi. Inselelo yesu elilula ayilula neze. Inqubo yokuxhumana idinga ukubamba iqhaza okubonakalayo emikhakheni ehlukene yomphakathi ngokwezihlungi ezihlukene zokuhlaziya nokuthi izinqumo zenziwe. Ukubandakanya wonke umuntu kusho ithuba lokubamba iqhaza kulokho okukhuluma ngakho nezinkulumo ngesikhathi esifanele ebhodini, futhi akulula futhi ukuqhuba lo msebenzi. Inqubo yokuqala yesu idinga umqondo ocacile, ukuhlaziywa okuhlelekile ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezifanele, kubhekwa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokucabanga ngama-oda nezikhombisi ezisunguliwe. Lokhu kudlula nje ekwakheni uhlu lwezinto ezithuthukisiwe nokukuhumusha kube iziphakamiso zezimali. Inqubo ehlanganisiwe idinga ukucabanga nokubheka izinto ngokubanzi futhi ukusabalalisa kwezinye izikhala zemboni. Uhlelo oluhlanganisiwe oluqinile oluqhuba umsebenzi futhi lufuna ukuchaza kahle izindleko, isikhathi, ubuningi, izibopho, indawo, izinga lomsebenzi, kanye nendawo lapho umsebenzi uzolethwa khona. Lokhu kudlula nje ohlwini lwezikhundla zomsebenzi ezizokwenziwa. Inselelo yokuhlela i-IDP ukuhlanganisa lezi zidingo ezintathu ngenhloso yokufinyelela inqubo yokwenza izinqumo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ucabanga ngokujulile ngesimo, futhi uqhubekisela phambili impumelelo yomsebenzi uma usuqalile. Kubandakanya inqubo ekhombisa umcimbi lapho i-IDP ihlelwa, hhayi ukukhombisa ithuluzi noma isu. Ukucabanga ngohlelo njengochungechunge lwezikhathi kulula kunokucabanga ngochungechunge lwezithuluzi zokuhlela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhuthaza inqubo yokuxhumana nokucabanga phambili ngezinto ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuhlukanisa kahle phakathi kweGeneral IDP Process (Guideline III) esebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamamasipala kanye nezindlela zokuhlela ezithile kanye nezithuluzi (Guideline IV) ezingase zihluke kakhulu kumasipala owodwa kuya kwelinye. Ihloselwe ukusebenzisa ulimi olulula ngokugwema amagama anzima nezinkinga ezinzima ezisetshenziswa ngabalungisi. Imicimbi yokuhlela ivame ukuba yizihlanganiso noma ama-workshop wesakhiwo sokuhlela esilawula inqubo ye-IDP (Community Representative Council, IDP Steering Committee, Working Group) futhi kwezinye izikhathi, kungabandakanya imisebenzi eyenziwa ngabantu (njengokuhlanganiswa kolwazi, ucwaningo, njll). Umcimbi ngamunye kufanele ube nomphumela othile. Le mpumelelo ingaba uhlobo oluthile lolwazi noma isinqumo. Eminye imiphumela incike ezidingweni zomthetho, ezinye ziwumthelela wezinto ezijwayelekile futhi zisiza ekulandeleni inqubo enephetho. Kuwo wonke umcimbi wokuhlela, kunikezwa iziphakamiso mayelana nohlobo lwezinhlelo kanye nabantu okufanele babambe iqhaza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lubandakanya zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo futhi luhlanganyela. Indlela yokuhlela ayisho okuningi ngama-thuluzi athile okukhona okufanele asetshenziswe kuwo wonke umcimbi. Lezi zithuluzi zihluka kumasipala kuya kumasipala. Amakhansela amamasipala angasebenzisa izindlela zokuhlela ezithuthukile ezinekhompyutha. AmaMasipala eSigaba B angase enze inqubo yokuhlela efanayo kodwa asebenzise indlela ecacile. iFacebook Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uThandi, intombazane encane eyayihlala edolobheni elincane, wathola umqondo omusha. UThandi wayehlala edinga indlela yokuxhumana nabangani bakhe, ikakhulukazi kulabo ababephila kude. Ngakho, wathola ithuba lokubhalisela iFacebook, indawo yokuxhumana eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni. UThandi wathola ukuthi iFacebook iyinsiza enkulu. Wayengakwazi ukwabelana ngezithombe, izindaba, nezinto azithandayo. Ngemva kokubhalisela, wathola abangani abaningi ababephila kude, futhi baqala ukuxhumana njalo. UThandi wathokoziswa kakhulu, ngoba wayezwa sengathi abanye baphila edolobheni lakhe, nakuba bephila kude. Ngesikhathi esebenzisa iFacebook, uThandi waqala ukubona izithombe zabangani bakhe, izenzakalo ezithokozisayo, nezinto ezithokozisayo ezenzakalayo. Waqala nokubhalela izimo zakhe, ezimnandi nezibuhlungu. Kodwa, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, waqala ukubona ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Abangani bakhe babebonakala bejolise kakhulu ezithombeni, kunokuxhumana ngempela. UThandi wathola ukuthi abanye babangani bakhe babezama ukuveza impilo yabo ngendlela ethile, bephakamisa izithombe ezinhle, kodwa bephila impilo ehlukile. Lokhu kwenza uThandi azizwe engakhululekile. Wayefuna ukuxhumana, kodwa wathola ukuthi abantu babezama ukufihla izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kwenza umuzwa wakhe wokuxhumana ungabi namandla. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wathola umyalezo ovela kumngani wakhe, uSipho. USipho wabhala ukuthi wayezwa edangele, futhi wayefuna ukukhuluma. UThandi wathokoziswa kakhulu, ngoba wayefuna ukwazi ukuthi uSipho uphila kanjani. Bahlangana ku-video call, futhi uSipho wabelana ngempilo yakhe, izinselelo, nezifiso zakhe. UThandi wathola ukuthi uSipho wayebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, kodwa wayefuna ukulwa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waqonda ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yinsiza yokuxhumana, kodwa akufanele ibe yindlela yokufihla. Waqala ukugqugquzela abangani bakhe ukuba baveze izinkinga zabo, ukuze bakwazi ukusizana. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu badinga ukuxhumana ngempela, hhayi nje ngokwabelana ngezithombe ezinhle. Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokusebenzisa iFacebook, waqala ukuhlela izigcawu zokuxhumana. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano nabangani, ukuze baxoxe ngezinto ezinzima, futhi bahlale bexhumene. Lokhu kwenza uThandi azizwe enempilo, futhi waqala ukubona ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yinsiza yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngesikhathi esebenzisa iFacebook, uThandi wathola ukuthi abantu badinga ukuxhumana, futhi badinga ukwazi ukuthi abanye baphila kanjani. Waqonda ukuthi impilo ayiyona nje izithombe ezinhle, kodwa ibalulekile futhi izinselelo zempilo. UThandi wathola ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yindawo yokwakha ubudlelwano, uma abantu bephila ngempela. Ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ukuthi iFacebook iyinsiza enkulu, kodwa abantu badinga ukusebenzisa kahle. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabangani bakhe, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. UThandi wathola ukuthi impilo iyinhle, futhi ukuxhumana ngempela kuyasiza. Ngakho, waphuma phambili, ehlonipha ubudlelwano, futhi eqhubeka nokwakha izixhumanisi ezinhle. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo kubangani bakhe, futhi wathola ukuthi iFacebook ingaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi, uma abantu bephila ngempela. UThandi wathokoziswa kakhulu, ngoba wayazi ukuthi ukuxhumana ngempela kuyasiza, futhi impilo iyinhle uma sabelana ngayo.
Ingabe abakhiqizi kufanele benze inzuzo kuphela? Abanye abalimi bazokhuluma ukuthi ukulima akusiyo nje umsebenzi wokwenza inzuzo. Kuneziningi ezithanda, zithanda umhlaba, zijabulela ukusebenza ngaphandle, futhi zithola injabulo ekungahlali njalo ehhovisi nasekulandeleni imithetho yenkampani ethile. Nokho, bazovuma futhi ukuthi abakwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo wokulima uma bengakwenzi inzuzo. Ukuqala kwenzuzo yebhizinisi kukhombisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lizophumelela noma cha. Inani lenzuzo lizokwenza ukuthi umlimi abheke phambili, akhule emsebenzini wakhe ukuze aphumelele esikhathini esizayo. Inzuzo iyinsiza yokusebenza kwabo. Uma umlimi engakwazi ukubala inzuzo yakhe enhle, uzobona ukuthi imali engena emasimini akhe inenhloso, bese ecabanga ngokutshala kabusha futhi efaka imali eningi emsebenzini wakhe wokulima. Bonke abalimi bayazi ukuthi kunezingozi eziningi ekulimeni. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, isimo sezulu sishintsha njalo, futhi imvula ewela ngesikhathi esifanayo ezindaweni ezifanayo yenza ukubala kube nzima. Lezi zingozi zizohlala zikhona, kodwa umlimi ophatha kahle umsebenzi wakhe uzolungiselela ukuphatha lezi zingozi uma zenzeka. Kukhona izinto ezithile umlimi engakwazi ukuzilawula, njengokuphatha kahle izindlela zokulima: ukulungiselela kahle umhlabathi nohlelo lokufaka izithako, ukuncibilikisa izinkambu lapho kungenzeka, ukuthenga imbewu efanele nezithako ezifanele, nokuphatha izifo nezihlahla kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ingxenye yalokho okungaphathwa iyaziwa yomlimi. Abanye abalimi baqala ngolwazi oluncane, kodwa bese befunda ezikoleni zokulima, kanti abanye bathola ulwazi kuhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development Program. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lokhu kuletha ubuchwepheshe ngoba umlimi ufunda njalo ngesikhathi esebenza emasimini akhe. Njengamanje, sonke siyazi ukuthi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kusemkhankasweni ngoba akukho inzuzo. Akukho mqondo wokutshala noma yini. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile manje ukuthi umlimi ngamunye aphathe ibhizinisi lakhe kahle ukuze afinyelele empumelelweni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi kumele abe nolwazi oluhle ngezindleko nezinsiza ezingaba khona kuzo zonke izenzo zakhe emasimini. Akusikho okwanele ukuba ngumkhiqizi ongakwazi ukulima, ukulungisa imishini, noma ukukhulisa izinkomo kuphela - kunezinye izinto ezibalulekile okufanele zenziwe! Thina, njengabalimi, ngabe sisebenza kuphela noma siphatha ibhizinisi eliletha inzuzo? Impumelelo ekulimeni iyinselelo enkulu ngoba kukhona okuthile okubizwa ngokuthi "ubukhazikhazi bokuphuthuma." Lokhu kusho ukuthi ekulimeni, njalo kukhona inkinga ephuthumayo edinga ukuxazululwa - ithrektha iyaphuka, izinkomo ziya zifela, njll. Lokhu kungasenza sikhumbule ukucabanga phambili nokuphatha ezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Ukuphatha ifamu kuhilela ukucabanga phambili nokuhlanganisa amasu okuthuthuka - kudinga isikhathi nomzamo, futhi akuhlali kujabulisa. Noma yimuphi umlimi uzobona injabulo enhliziyweni yakhe uma ebona ithrektha iqala ukulima insimu enomhlabathi ophumelelayo - kodwa mhlawumbe akukhona okwakufanele kulokho kwesikhathi. Isibonelo: ngo-2010 - 2011, abalimi bamaqanda kufanele bacabange ngokucophelela ukuthi kuzobabiza inzuzo yini ngoba osomabhizinisi be-Grain SA bekholelwa ukuthi ukuvuthwa kwamaqanda kuzokwehlisa amanani futhi ngaleyo ndlela inzuzo ngeke ifinyeleleke - mhlawumbe okuthile kuzoshintsha lokhu masinyane. Umlimi ngamunye kumele abheke ukuthi ifamu yakhe ingakhiqiza inani elithile. Kumele abheke izinkambu zakhe, abheke isimo sabo sezimali, acabange ngezingozi ezingaba khona, abasebenzi abadingekayo, futhi abheke amakhono nezinsiza zabo ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kungabasiza ukuba babeke phambili izinto zezimali ukuze bathole inzuzo efanele. Khumbula, inzuzo yakha impumelelo! Yiziphi izinhlobo zezithelo engizotshala? Ngizohlanganisa nazo ezinye izinhlobo. Yiziphi izindawo efamu yami ezifanele ukutshala? Ngabe ngingakhulisa malini izinkomo? Ingabe kukhona okungangenzela kahle kule fomu ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngizothola inzuzo? Ngizotshala kanjani lezi zithelo? Ngifuna ukwesekwa kokuqala kokutshala. Ngizophatha kahle izincwadi zami. Lokhu kuzokhombisa labo abangangisiza ngezimali ukuthi ngiyinsiza ethembekile. Ngidinga ukuqasha ama-traktori nemishini eminye. Ingabe kukhona ezinye izinto ezizokwandisa izindleko zami zokuqala zokutshala? I-Grain SA inabahlaziyi bezomnotho abahlala behlola ukukhuphuka nokwehla kwam prices kanye nezinguquko zemakethe futhi baziqondise abalimi ngezinguquko ezingathinta ukusebenza kokulima. Abalimi kufanele bathole izindlela zokufinyelela kulolu lwazi njalo. Ngokuphathelene nolwazi oluvela ku-Central Energy Fund, intengo ye-petrol ingakhuphuka ngama-51.5 cents nge-litre ngo-April 7, kanti i-diesel ingakhuphuka ngama-54.5 cents nge-litre. Le nkuphuka ingase ibe ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwemali yokuhlala nezindleko ze-Road Accident Fund (RAF) ezizofika ngo-April, njengoba i-Central Energy Fund ilindele ukuthi imali izoba phansi. Intela ye-diesel izokhuphuka ngama-17.5 cents nge-litre, kanti i-RAF levy izokhuphuka ngama-8 cents nge-litre. Le nkuphuka izophinde ikhulise isaphulelo sabalimi, okusho ukuthi intengo ye-diesel izokhuphuka ngama-42.5 cents nge-litre. Kubalulekile ukuhlaziya ukuthi imakethe ifuna ini nokuthi bazokhokha malini ukuthenga umkhiqizo. Akulungile ukusebenza kanzima nokukhokha imali eningi ukuze utshale izithelo ezinhle kuphela ukuze uthole ukuthi lezi zithelo azidingeki, imakethe ayifuni. Kungase kwenzeke futhi ukuthi kukhona ukudla okungaphezu kokwanele futhi intengo yehlile, okusho ukuthi usebenza mahhala ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi awukwazi ukwenza inzuzo. Udinga ukuhlola ngokucophelela futhi uthole iqiniso lokuthi ukudla kwakho kudingeka nokuthi abathengi bazokwazi ukukuthenga ngentengo ezokwenza ukuthi uthole inzuzo. Abakhiqizi bamaqanda kufanele bacabange ngokucophelela ukuthi bazokwenza ini ngonyaka ozayo. Imakethe yamaqanda iphansi kakhulu futhi izohlala njalo isikhathi eside. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, kuthathwa ama-toni ayizigidi eziyi-9 zamaqanda ngonyaka, kodwa silindele ukuvuna ama-toni angama-12.8 ngonyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sitshala amaqanda amaningi kakhulu, kukhona amaqanda amaningi emakethe, ngakho intengo izohlala iphansi kuze kube isidingo samaqanda sikhula. Masigxile ekuthengeni ubhontshisi, inkukhu, nezinkukhu ezivela phesheya futhi sikhulise ukukhiqizwa kwalokhu kudla lapha nathi. Kukhona abalimi abangu-1000 (abakhulu nabancane) kanye nezinkulungwane zamahhektare ezingasetshenziswa ukutshala amaqanda uma singakwazi ukukhulisa imakethe ezokwandisa isidingo. Abalimi abanebhizinisi badinga ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo.
Ezokuvikeleka Kwemininingwane: Ukubaluleka Kwezinqubo Zokuvikela Emhlabeni Oshintshashintshayo Njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane (cybersecurity) sekuba yisihloko esibalulekile emhlabeni wonke. Abantu baye besebenzisa izinsiza eziningi ezikwi-inthanethi, okukhulisa izingozi zokuhlaselwa kwemininingwane. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nabantu ngabanye baphendule ngokushesha ukuze baqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane yabo. Ezinsukwini ezedlule, izigameko zokuhlaselwa kwe-cyber zikhule kakhulu, futhi izinkampani ezinkulu ezifana ne-Equifax ne-Sony zibhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphepha, zikhombisa ukuthi akukhona abantu kuphela abajwayelekile abathintekayo, kodwa nezinkampani ezinkulu zidinga ukuvikela imininingwane yazo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuvikela imininingwane, ezifaka phakathi izinqubo zokuhlola, izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinsiza zokufundisa abasebenzi. Ukwanda kokuhlaselwa kwe-cyber kubonisa ukuthi izindlela ezivamile zokuvikela, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezilula, azisasebenzi. Izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-ML (Machine Learning), ukuze zikwazi ukubona izingozi ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izigebengu ze-cyber zisebenzisa izindlela ezintsha nezihlakaniphile ukuhlasela izinhlelo zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane akuyona nje indaba yezinkampani ezinkulu. Abantu ngabanye badinga ukuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi. Ukusebenzisa amagama ayimfihlo aqinile, ukugwema ukwabelana ngemininingwane yomuntu siqu, kanye nokuhlola izilungiselelo zokuphepha kumadivayisi, kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuvikela imininingwane yomuntu. Uhlelo lwezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi, kusukela ekuhloleni izingozi, ukwakha izinqubo zokuvikela, kuze kube sekuphenduleni ezinhlekeleleni. Ukuhlola izingozi kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezithintekayo, nokuthi iziphi izingozi ezikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zihlale zihlola izinhlelo zazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela eziphambili zokuvikela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Ukuhlela izinqubo ezicacile zokuphendula, kanye nokufundisa abasebenzi mayelana nezinyathelo okufanele zithathwe, kuzosiza ekunciphiseni umthelela wezingozi. Ukuvikela imininingwane akukhona nje umsebenzi wezinkampani, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezihlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa, izinqubo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukuvikeleka okudingekayo. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu nababhali bezinqubomgomo baqonde ukuthi ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane akukhona nje umsebenzi wezinkampani ezinkulu, kodwa kuyisidingo somphakathi wonke. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, izingozi ezihambisana nakho nazo ziyaqhubeka nokwanda. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo, ezihlanganisa wonke umuntu, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu. Ekugcineni, ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane yethu kumele kube phezulu ohlwini lwezinto ezibalulekile.
Izidingo ezengeziwe zokuhola ezikhundleni ezingenalutho zokufundisa zabaPhakathi kanye noMphakathi kufanele zibe kanje: "Amakhono okuhola, ukuphatha, nokuphathwa okuhlobene nezinhlobo ezithile zezikole." Ukungena kweSitatimende soMnyango Wezemfundo Kazwelonke sokufunda okujwayelekile nokuqeqeshwa (GET) (izikole, Iphasi yeSisekelo, Iphasi Ephakathi, kanye neSikole Esiphezulu) kuvumela ukukhangiswa kwezikhala zomsebenzi ezikoleni eziphakeme nezisezingeni eliphansi ngokwezidingo zohlelo lwezemfundo kanye neZakhono Zokuphila. Othisha bePhasi yeSisekelo kufanele, njengomthetho ojwayelekile, bakwazi ukufundisa zonke izinhlelo zokufunda ezintathu. Kule phasi, Izilimi neMathematics kufanele kube izinhlelo zokufunda ezihlukile. Ezinye izikole, uthisha oyedwa angafundisa zonke izinhlelo zokufunda, noma othisha bangafundisa izinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisanayo. EPhasini Eliphezulu, izindawo eziyisishiyagalombili zokufunda zihlelwe zibe izinhlelo zokufunda eziyisishiyagalombili. NjengasePhasini Ephakathi, kwezinye izikole, uthisha oyedwa angafundisa zonke izinhlelo zokufunda eziyisishiyagalombili, noma othisha bangafundisa uhlelo lokufunda oluhambisanayo. Izikole zinganquma inani nobunjalo bezinye izinhlelo zokufunda ngokuya ngezinto ezibalulekile ngaphakathi kwenhlangano yesikole. Njengomthetho ojwayelekile, isikhala esingenalutho kufanele sikhangiswe ngokwezinhlelo zokufunda ezilindelekile ukuze uthisha akwazi ukufundisa. Le fomu iqukethe ulwazi ngezidingo zezikhala zomsebenzi ezidalwe ezikoleni. Kufanele igcwaliswe nguMphakathi wesikole, iphume, futhi ithunyelwe ku-IDSO kanye noMqondisi Wesifunda.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekelela labo abazoze babe nezindawo zokuhlala eziphakeme futhi abafuna ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala okuphakeme ngenxa yokuba yilunga lomndeni wesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala okuphakeme njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni. Ngokuhloswe ukuthola ilungelo lokuhlala okuphakeme, amalunga omndeni njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni achazwa njengalabo abangamalunga egazi noma izingane ezinikwe ngokomthetho ubuholi yinkantolo noma abazali abazothatha ngokomthetho ukunakekela zona noma abazali ngenxa yokufa noma ukuhlukana kwabazali. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi lesiNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ophakeme kumele anikeze isitatimende sokuzibophezela mayelana nezimali, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, nokunakekela umfaki-sicelo. Nokho, uma umndeni ungumzali wezingane ezincane, akudingeki ukwenza isitatimende sokuzibophezela. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi.
Ezokusebenza Kukahulumeni: Ukuhlola Ukusebenza Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zikamasipala Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseMzansi ubonge umkhiqizo omuhle wezinsizakalo zikahulumeni, njengoba izikhulu zikamasipala ziqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zabantu ziyaqondiswa. Uhlelo lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni, oluhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, luye lwathola ukunakwa okukhulu eminyakeni yamuva, njengoba izinkinga eziningi zikhona emiphakathini. Uhlaka lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni luhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinsizakalo zempilo, ezemfundo, nezokuthutha. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukunciphisa ubuphofu, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu. Kodwa-ke, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, okwenza kube nzima ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso. Izinsizakalo Zempilo Nezemfundo Izinsizakalo zempilo zihlala zibalulekile, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethwele kanzima. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, kodwa izinkinga ezinjengokuntuleka kwemithombo, izinsiza ezanele, kanye nezisebenzi ezihloniphekile zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kudala ukungabi nanele kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezemfundo ziyaqhubeka nokuba yinto ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokufunda zenzelwa abafundi, kodwa izinkinga ezinjengokuntuleka kwezinsiza, izikole ezingekho ezingeni eliphezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezingasebenzi kahle zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi bahlupheke, futhi lokhu kudinga ukulungiswa okuphuthumayo. Izinsizakalo Zokuthutha Ezokuthutha nazo zibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Izinhlelo zokuthutha ezisebenzayo zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, izimpahla, nezinsizakalo. Nokho, izinkinga ezinjengokungabi nanele kwezokuthutha, izindlela ezingalungile, kanye nezindleko eziphezulu zokuhamba zikhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela ezindaweni ezahlukene kalula. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zikamasipala Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zikamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kubambisana kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukusungula izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, kanye nokuhlonipha izidingo zomphakathi. Ukubambisana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, izinkinga zihlala zikhona. Ukungabi nanele kwezinsizakalo, ukungabikhona kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha zenza kube nzima ukufezekisa izinhloso zokusebenza kukahulumeni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo, ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle. Uhlelo lwezokusebenza kukahulumeni luphinde luthinteke ezindaweni eziningi, kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukunciphisa ubuphofu, nokwakha umnotho oqinile. Ukuze lokhu kufezwe, uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, aqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa, futhi akhe ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa izinsizakalo ezahlukene, uhulumeni ungalungisa izinkinga ezikhona futhi uthuthukise izinga lempilo labantu. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo baphatheke ngokubambisana, benze izinqumo eziphusile, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nolwazi oluqinile. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi ubheke phambili ekutholeni izinsizakalo ezinhle, ezithembekile, nezisebenzayo ezivela kukahulumeni.
Umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini kwezohwebo Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlolanja 2023, kwaba nomcimbi obalulekile eThekwini, lapho abezindaba, osomabhizinisi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngempumelelo yokuminyana nokuhweba. Lo mcimbi, obizwa ngokuthi "Umthelela Wokuminyana eThekwini: Izinketho Zokukhula Kwezohwebo," wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa umnotho wendawo. Phambi kokuba umcimbi uqale, abavakashi bathola ithuba lokubona izithombe zedolobha ezikhombisa umnotho wezwe ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu ngenxa yokukhula kwezohwebo. Umphakathi waseThekwini ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, njengoba umnotho ubonakala unamandla ngenxa yokuminyana kwababukeli, izinkampani, nezinsizakusebenza. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo edumile kaMnu. Sipho Mthembu, owachaza ukuthi uminyana eThekwini kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngamasu amasha okukhulisa ukuhweba. Uthe, “Ukwakhiwa kwezikhala ezihlukene zokuhweba, izimakethe ezincane, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala zikhuthaza abathengisi ukuba baphile kahle, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo.” Ngemuva kwalokho, kwaba nezingxoxo ezibukhoma phakathi kwababukeli, lapho abathintekayo bephakamisa iziphakamiso ezahlukene. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo udinge ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwababukeli nabathengisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukwakheka kwezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe umnotho. Ukwengeza, abanye abakhuluma baphakamisa ukuthi ukuhweba kumele kube nendawo yokuxhumana, lapho abathengisi bengakwazi ukuhlangana khona ukuze baphendule izidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuzokhuthaza ukuhweba okukhulayo. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezingqungquthela ezahlukene ezazihlanganisa izifundo zokwakha amabhizinisi, izifundo zokumaketha, kanye nezifundo zokuphatha izinsiza. Lokhu kwavumela abavakashi ukuba bathole ulwazi olujulile mayelana nezindlela ezahlukene zokukhulisa amabhizinisi abo. Abafundi baphinde banikwe ithuba lokuxoxa nabachwepheshe bezohwebo, ababelokhu bephendula imibuzo futhi belethe iziphakamiso ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wakhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale befinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuminyana, kudinga izinqubo ezithile ezizothuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabathengisi, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Ubuye waphinde wagcizelela ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana nezikhungo zemfundo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengisi banolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokuhlonipha abathengisi abaphumelele emkhakheni wezohwebo. Abathengisi abaninzi baveze izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, kodwa baphinde baveze nethuba lokukhula. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba kunezithiyo, umnotho ungakhula uma abantu behlanganyela futhi besebenzisana. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wagcina ngokukhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale bephokophele phambili, futhi baphumelele emkhakheni wezohwebo. Ubuye waphinde wagcizelela ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana ukuze ubambisane ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Abavakashi baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinto ezithakazelisayo ezithinta umnotho, futhi bakwazi ukuthola izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini ungathuthukisa umnotho, futhi umcimbi ubonise ukuthi uma abantu behlangana, izixazululo zingatholakala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho weThekwini uhlala unamandla, futhi ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngakho, umcimbi "Umthelela Wokuminyana eThekwini" ube yimpumelelo enkulu, wakhuthaza abathengisi ukuba bahlale bephokophele phambili, futhi wagcizelela ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana ukuze ubambisane ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba kunezithiyo, umnotho ungakhula uma abantu behlanganyela futhi besebenzisana.
Zonke izitshalo zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule, futhi iphuzu elibaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni izitshalo zembewu emhlabathini omanzi kumele kube khona umswakama owanele ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezitshalo zakho ze-maize. Ukuqala kule nyanga, ibhodi le-maize le-Pula Imvula lizothunyelwa kubafundi bonke, hhayi kuphela kubakhiqizi abakhuluma isiSisuthu eFree State. Ngakho-ke, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi iWestern Cape inezimo zokukhanya ezaziwa njengeMediterranean, okusho ukuthi ithola imvula yayo ebusika, isikhathi esifanele sokutshala i-maize. Ukubaluleka kokugcina umswakama emhlabathini kubakhiqizi be-maize eCape akubalulekile kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa neNingizimu Afrika yonke, lapho kudingeka khona ukuthi sigcine imvula yasehlobo emhlabathini ukuze izitshalo zisebenzise ngesikhathi sebusika obomile. Ukutshala kudinga umswakama. Izitshalo ezahlukene zinezimfuneko ezahlukene okumele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuthi kunqunywe ukuthi iyiphi isitshalosuitable yokutshala. Umswakama uphinde ube nesidingo sokukhuthaza ukwehliswa kwezimfucuza zezithombo ezedlule futhi wandise izakhamzimba ezikhona emhlabathini, kuvumela izitshalo ukuba zifinyelele ezakhamzimbini. Ungase ungakakwenzi isinqumo sokuthi uzotshala i-maize noma cha; isinqumo sakho sincike ezinzuzweni ezitholakala ekulimaleni kwe-maize nasekuhleleni kwakho kwesikhathi esizayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa komhlabathi. Abakhiqizi abaningi benza izinqumo zokukhulisa izitshalo ezithile ngokusekelwe kuzinguquko ezithile, ngaphandle kokugxila kumaphuzu okushintsha amanani. Ukutshala i-maize njalo ngonyaka kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi unokulima uma unyaka ubalulekile, futhi ukuthi unama-maize okuthengisa uma amanani emakethe ephezulu (kodwa kungenzeka futhi ukuhweba ngalokhu - uzoba ne-maize nakweminye iminyaka emibi, futhi kuzomele uyithenge ngamanani aphansi uma ethola). Kubalulekile ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zakho zizokwazi ukufinyelela umswakama owanele emhlabathini ngesikhathi sonke sokukhula kwazo. Zonke izindawo zingagcina amanzi, kodwa ezinye zinekhono elingcono lokugcina umswakama emhlabathini. Imhlabathi ye-sandy inekhono eliphansi lokugcina amanzi njengoba amanzi angagcwala emhlabathini futhi alahleke, ngaphandle uma kukhona izingqimba ezingangeni (njengamatshe noma i-clay, ngokwesibonelo) ezovimbela amanzi ukuthi angadluli futhi alahleke. Imhlabathi enezingqimba ezingangeni (njenge-clay ngokwesibonelo) ezindaweni ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 m ilungele ukugcina umswakama emhlabathini kanye nokukhiqiza izitshalo zonyaka. Imhlabathi eminingi ye-sandy eFree State empumalanga iyahambisana nalokhu, yingakho ilungele ukutshala i-maize ebusika nakuba kuyindawo ethola imvula yasehlobo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ube nenhlanhla yokuba namanzi anele okokunisela, kuzomele uthembeke emvuleni ukuze umhlabathi uthole umswakama. Izingqimba eziphezulu zomhlabathi ezithambile zivumela imvula ukuba ingene emhlabathini. Kufanele ubone ukuthi imvula igijima kanjani emhlabathini eliqinile. Umswakama ophakeme usiza ekungeneleleni kwamanzi; uphinde unciphise ukuhamba kwamanzi futhi unikeze isikhathi eside sokuthi amanzi angena. Amanzi agcinwa ezikhala phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi. Ama-sands angahluka kulawo anama-sandy kuya kulawo amnyama bese kuba kulawo anama-clay, futhi uhlobo ngalunye lomhlabathi lungagcina inani elihlukile lamanzi. Imhlabathi ye-sandy, i-clay, kanye nemhlabathi emnyama ingagcina ama-25 mm wamanzi emhlabathini angu-150 mm. (Imhlabathi enobukhulu obusebenzayo obungu-1 m bezimpande ingagcina ama-180 mm emvula). Ikhono lokugcina umswakama emhlabathini lincike ohlotsheni lomhlabathi, isakhiwo nomumo womhlabathi, kanye nobukhulu bomhlabathi. Umswakama emhlabathini ungalahleka emhlabeni ngenxa yokukhanya kwelanga. Umphetho womhlabathi ungashisa, okwandisa ukuvuthwa, okwenza amanzi ahlale emhlabathini (lokhu kuyukuhamba komswakama emhlabathini phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi), efika emaphethelweni omhlabathi lapho evuthwa emoyeni; kusetshenziswa izitshalo ezikhulayo noma ezinye izitshalo ezingathathwa njengezihlahla emkhakheni (lokhu kuyisizathu esikhulu sokulahleka komswakama emhlabathini). Singagcina kanjani umswakama ngempumelelo? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula engena emhlabathini ingangena kulowo mhlaba; gcina umphezulu womhlabathi unempilo. Izingqimba eziphezulu zomhlabathi zisebenza njengovimbela oqinile ukuze amanzi emvula angena ahambe esikhundleni sokungena ngaphansi komhlabathi. Gcina izinsalela zezithombo ezedlule zikhona ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze unciphise umthelela oqondile wezimpukane emhlabathini futhi ngaleyo ndlela unciphise ukwakheka kwesikhumba somhlabathi. Kumele kukhunjulwe ukuthi izitshalo zingase zidinge amafutha e-nitrogen engeziwe ngenxa yokuncipha kwezinsiza ezivela ezinsaleni zezithombo ezedlule, okuzoncika ekwehlisweni kwezithombo ezindala ezisele. Ngemuva kwemvula enkulu, phula noma iyiphi isikhumba esingase sibe sekuvele emaphethelweni omhlabathi. Isikhumba asivimbi kuphela ukungena kweminye imvula kodwa futhi sikhuthaza ukuvuthwa ukuze spread amanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, okwenza umhlabathi ube nomswakama. Gcina umhlabathi ungenazihlahla kusukela ngesikhathi sokuvuna izitshalo ezedlule kuze kube sekuthaleni kwezinye izitshalo. Ukwakhiwa kwesembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe umswakama okwakhiwe uthuli emaphethelweni omhlabathi kuba uvimbela ekuvuthweni kwamanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, kuholela ekulahlekelweni komswakama emhlabathini kuya emoyeni. Nakuba isembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli olomile sigcina umswakama ngokumunca ukushisa kokukhanya kwelanga, ukuvuthwa kungaqhubeka kodwa ngezinga eliphansi emhlabathini omile ogwini lwe-5 cm. Isembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe umswakama singaba yizinsalela zezithombo (uma kuxoxwa kabanzi) noma singaba yisembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli okufanele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi kumele kungaphazanyiswa ngokulima umhlabathi ngama-machinery. Ezinye izindawo ezihlobene nokukhiqiza izitshalo zibalulekile empumelelweni. Udinga ukugcina umswakama ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza futhi ugcine umhlaba wakho ungenazihlahla ngaso sonke isikhathi. Umswakama ungomunye wezinto ezinkulu ezivimbela ukukhiqizwa kwezithombo.
Ukungondleki Ezinganeni: Inkinga Ekhathazayo Ukungondleki ezinganeni kuyinkinga ethinta umphakathi wethu kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithobekile. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukungabi nokudla, kodwa kubukeka kuphinde kube nezimo eziningi ezihambisana nakho, ezifana nezimo zokuhlala, imfundo, nezempilo. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kufanele sihlole izimbangela zayo, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Izimbangela Zokungondleki Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yiziphi izimbangela eziholela ekungondleki ezinganeni. Enye yezimbangela ezinkulu y poverty, okuyinto ebangela ukuthi abazali bangakwazi ukuthola ukudla okwanele ukuze bafeze izidingo zokuphila. Izinga lokungasebenzi, ukungabi namathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezimo ezinzima zomnotho zenza kube nzima kwabanye abazali ukuba bakwazi ukondla izingane zabo ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwaziswa nokufunda zingaphansi kokungasebenzi kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi abazali bazi kahle izidingo zokudla ezinganeni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuhlala zibalulekile. Ezinye izingane zihlala ezindaweni ezingenamathuba okufinyelela ezokudla, okwenza kube nzima kubazali ukuthola ukudla okunempilo. Ngakho, abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, ezinjengama-slums noma emaphandleni, bahlushwa kakhulu yalesi simo. Ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezithinta impilo, ezifana nezibhedlela nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezokudla, kubangela ukuthi izingane zithole ukondleka okunganele. Imiphumela Yokungondleki Imiphumela yokungondleki ingaba mibi kakhulu. Izingane ezingondleki ziba nezigameko eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ukwehla kwezinga lokufunda, kanye nezinkinga zokukhula. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izingane ezingondleki ziba semathubeni amancane okuphumelela empilweni, njengoba ukungondleki kuholela ekwehleni kwamandla okusebenza kwengqondo nomzimba. Lokhu kuphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekufundeni kwazo, njengoba zingakwazi ukugxila ezifundweni ngenxa yokungabi neqhaza elihle empilweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungondleki kubangela ukwanda kwezinga lokushaywa, ukudla okungavumelekile, nokwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Izingane ezithola ukudla okunganele zinezinkinga ezinkulu zokuxhumana nabanye, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni zibe nezinye izinkinga zokuphila, ezifana nokuhlukumezeka. Lokhu kubangela umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho izingane ezingondleki zikhula zibe ngabantu abadala abangakazitholi amathuba okufinyelela ezimpilweni ezinhle. Izixazululo Ezingaba Khona Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kukhona izixazululo ezingaba khona ukuze siqede le nkinga. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuxhasa izimfuno zokudla ezinganeni kufanele zithuthukiswe. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudla okufanele kufinyelelwa kalula ezindaweni ezithile, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ukudla ezikoleni. Izikhungo zokudla okunempilo zingasiza ekwakheni imikhuba emihle yokudla, futhi ziqinise izinga lokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqeqeshwa kwabazali nokwakhiwa kwemithombo yokuthola imisebenzi kungasiza ukunciphisa poverty. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo zebhizinisi, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokuxhasa abaqashi. Uma abazali bekhuthazekile, bazokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezingcono ezinganeni zabo. Ukwengeza, ubambiswano phakathi komphakathi, uhulumeni, nezinhlangano ezizimele kudinga ukuba kuqinisekiswe. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithombo kuyadingeka ukuze kuqede ukungondleki. Uhlelo oluqinile lokubambisana luzokwazi ukuqhuba imikhankaso yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, ukufundisa nokwakha amathuba. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukungondleki ezinganeni kuyinkinga enkulu eNkulunkulu, futhi kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uthathe izinyathelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqedwe le nkinga. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, izikhungo, nezinhlangano zomphakathi kufanele kube yindlela yokulwa nale nkinga. Ngaphandle kokuthi sithathele phezulu le ndaba, sizobona izingane zethu zikhula ziwumthwalo wezinkinga ezibalulekile. Sidinga ukwakha ikusasa elinempilo, lapho izingane zethu zingakwazi ukuphila futhi zifunde ngendlela efanele.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery uqala ngonyaka ka-2006, lapho izinhlelo zokuqala zokuqalisa le mboni zathuthukiswa. Le phrojekthi yaziwa njengomunye wezinto ezibalulekile emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi ezwenikazi lase-Afrika. Ukubuyiselwa kobuchwepheshe bokucubungula uwoyela kwaba yinjongo eyinhloko, njengoba izwe belidinga ukunciphisa ukwethemba kwalo kwi-imports ye-oyela. Ngonyaka ka-2007, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqinisekisa ukuthi le phrojekthi izoba yinsika yokwakha umnotho ophilayo, ngenxa yokuthi uzobangela imisebenzi eminingi futhi uthuthukise izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Icala lokuqala lokwakhiwa kwalesi sikhungo savula ithuba lokuhlola izinzuzo zomnotho nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Ngaleso sikhathi, iMthombo Oil Refinery yayihloselwe ukuba ibe yindawo enkulu yokucubungula uwoyela, izokwazi ukukhiqiza uphethiloli, i-kerosene, nezinye izinto ezibalulekile ezisemqoka emnothweni. Ngonyaka ka-2008, kwavulwa izikhungo zokucwaninga, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi izosebenza kahle. Abacwaningi bacwaninga ngama-technology ahlukahlukene, nezindlela zokucubungula uwoyela ezizothuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, kanti lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kuqale ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali ezinkulu ukuze kuhambisane nezinhlelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkampani eziningi zaxhumana noHulumeni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lezi zinkampani zazihlanganisa izinkampani zomhlaba wonke ezazishaya indiva kumasiko aseNingizimu Afrika, kodwa zafika kuleli ngenxa yezinzuzo eziphathelene nomnotho. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani zangaphandle nohulumeni. Ngonyaka ka-2010, umsebenzi wokwakha iMthombo Oil Refinery uqale ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kube yisikhathi esibalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi behola imisebenzi, kanye nezinkampani eziningi zathola ithuba lokwenza izinto ezithile. Ukwakhiwa kwalesi sikhungo kwafaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaqashwa bahlala ezindaweni ezinhle. Nokho, nakuba iMthombo Oil Refinery yayiqhakambisa izinzuzo, kwakukhona nezinkinga ezithile ezazihambisana nayo. Ukujika kwemali, izinkinga zokuphatha, nokuhlangenwe nakho komphakathi kwaba yizinto ezazidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Okwaneno, umphakathi wakhombisa ukukhathazeka ngezenzo zalesi sikhungo, njengoba umoya ophuma emoyeni ubungakhathaza ezimpilweni zabantu, nokuthi ukuvunguza kwemali ezivela kule phrojekthi kwabe kungaqinisekisiwe. Ngonyaka ka-2015, uhulumeni wathatha izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi le phrojekthi iyahamba phambili. Izinkampani zashintsha izindlela zazo zokwakha, zifaka izindlela ezilungile zokuvikela imvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina umphakathi uzwakala. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi uqhubeke nokuba nokubambisana, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezizungezile zaphakanyiswa. Ngonyaka ka-2018, iMthombo Oil Refinery yagcina icubungula uwoyela. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula, njengoba kwavela imiphumela emihle emnothweni. Ukuvulwa kwalesi sikhungo kwaholela ekukhuleni kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, kanye nesimo sokuphila esithuthukile. Umnotho wendawo waqala ukuthuthuka, futhi abantu abaningi bathola ithuba lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. Nokho, ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery akukapheli. Uhlanga olunzulu lwalesi sikhungo lwalubhekelele izinselelo ezihlobene nokuphatha, ukulawulwa kwemvelo, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. Umphakathi wahamba noHulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuzobhekelwa yonke imiphumela, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisemqoka ziyaqhuba. Ngonyaka ka-2021, umkhankaso wokugcina wokuqinisa iMthombo Oil Refinery uqhubekile, futhi izinkampani zaku-international zazinikeze izinsiza ezikhulayo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthuka zaneqhaza elikhulu, futhi umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphatheni le phrojekthi. Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery ubonisa ukuthi kube nezinto eziningi ezizwakalayo, futhi izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kudingeka ukuba basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuzuzwe inhloso yokwakha umnotho ophilayo. Lokhu kuyindlela ebalulekile yokubona ukuthi uma kukhona ubambiswano, izinkinga ezithile zingahlulwa, futhi umphakathi ungavuselelwa. Ukubheka phambili, iMthombo Oil Refinery izosebenza njengomholi emkhakheni wezokucubungula uwoyela, futhi izoba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi izinhlelo ezinhle zidinga ukubhekelelwa ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Lokhu kugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomnotho, futhi umphakathi uqhubeke uthuthuka.
iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika: Isibopho Sokwakha Ikusasa Elingcono Ngokwezazi, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika liyisikhungo esisemqoka emlandweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Njengosomatekisi, iPhalamende linomsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo, ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, nokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Nokho, uma sihlola ukusebenza nempumelelo yePhalamende, kubalulekile ukuthola umbono ophathelene nobunzima obubhekene naleli bhodi, nezindlela zokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ekuqaleni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi iPhalamende lenza umsebenzi onzima. Abamele izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi bahlukahlukene, futhi baphumelele emavotelweni ayiqiniso, okukhombisa ukuthi kuphakathi kwabo lokho abavoti bakhetha. Kodwa-ke, eminyakeni edlule, sike sabona ukuphoxeka kwabantu emsebenzini wePhalamende. Abantu abaningi baqala ukuphikisa ukusebenza kwezakhamuzi, bethi akuyona indawo yokukhuluma noma yokwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Lokhu kudala ukungabaza nokukhathazeka ngempumelelo yePhalamende. Kukhona izizathu eziningi eziholela kulokhu kuphoxeka. Okokuqala, kunezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphatha nezimfundamakhwela. Abanye abamele bahlala ngaphansi kokpressure yokwanelisa izidingo zabantu abavota kubo, ngenkathi kwezinye izikhathi behluleka ukugcina izethembiso abazenzile. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni zokungathembeki, lapho ukwaziswa okungeyikho nokuphikiswa kwemigomo kwenziwa ngokweqile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umphakathi kumele uqaphele ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezilungile zidinga ukuxhaswa nokusekelwa okuqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphakanyisi bezinhlelo zemithetho bangabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezibhekene nabo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwePhalamende nabantu kuzodala umphakathi ophilayo, ocacile futhi ofuna ukulungisa imiphumela yempilo yezakhamuzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kudingeka ukuthi iPhalamende iguqule indlela yokuphatha. Ukuze kube khona ukuguquleka, izindleko zokuphila zidinga ukwaziwa futhi izinkinga zendlela yokuphila ziyafaneleka. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufikisa izinhlelo ezihambisanayo nezicacile, ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Abaminininingwane badinga ukuvuselela ukubhekelela izinkinga ezikhaliphile, njengokuhlukumeza, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga zezezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwePhalamende nezinduna zomphakathi uyindima ebaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu kusiza ukubhekana nezinkinga ezinzima ezinobungane phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezimbandakanyayo kubalulekile, ukuze kube khona ukuqonda okukhulu kwezinkinga ezikhaliphile nezenhlalo. Empeleni, iPhalamende alikho phansi kwenhliziyo, kodwa lidinga ukuyikhulisa ukuze ikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezisheshayo ezitholakala emhlabeni. Uhlanga lwezobuchwepheshe, ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezimo zomnotho zidinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuphatha. Abamele abavoti kufanele baqonde izidingo zabo futhi baphinde basebenzise indlela esebenzayo yokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika linomthwalo omkhulu wokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuthanda phakathi kwezakhamuzi nabamele. Ukuba khona kwezinguquko ezibalulekile kungavuselela ithemba komphakathi, nokuthi wonke umuntu ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isizwe esiqinile, esiqhubekayo. Ngakho, ake sizame ukubuyisela ithemba, sihlanganyele ngezixazululo ezihlakaniphile, futhi sakhe iPhalamende eseziqhamukile, esiqhubeka siphumelela. Kukhona umphakathi omuhle, umkhumbule, futhi uthubelekile esikhathini esizayo.
Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain: Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, Umphakathi Wokuthuthuka Umphakathi: Sawubona, Mnu. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngalesi siphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain. Ngabe ungakuchaza kancane ukuthi kungani leli phrojekthi ibalulekile? Mnu. Mthembu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga. Ngempela, leli phrojekthi ibalulekile kakhulu. I-Gautrain isiza ekuthuthukiseni ukuhamba kwabantu phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene eGauteng. Ukukhulisa le nsiza kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhamba, kunciphise umjaho wezithuthi emigwaqweni, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni wendawo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Yiziphi izindawo ezihlosiwe zokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain? Mnu. Mthembu: Sihlose ukwengeza imigqa emisha ehlanganisa izindawo ezibalulekile ezifana ne-OR Tambo International Airport, iCenturion, kanye neMidrand. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezikude ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezisemqoka, njengezikhungo zokusebenza nezokuthenga. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kakhulu. Kodwa, yini ezokwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela? Mnu. Mthembu: Ukuze le phrojekthi iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi, ohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Sizodinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobheka izindleko zokwakha, izinsiza ezidingekayo, kanye nezikhathi zokuphothula. Umphakathi: Ngabe kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nalolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, kunezinto eziningi okufanele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, izindleko zokwakha zingaba phezulu, futhi kudingeka ukuthi sithole uxhaso lwezezimali. Okwesibili, sizobhekana nezinkinga zokuhamba kwabantu ngesikhathi sokwakha, okungase kube nomthelela ekuphileni kwansuku zonke kwabantu. Kodwa, uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, lezi zinkinga zingaxazululwa. Umphakathi: Ngabe le phrojekthi izoba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela. Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba, okuzokhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa umnotho, njengoba abantu bezoba nekhono lokufinyelela emisebenzini nasemakethe kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ukwakha, ukuhamba, kanye nezinsizakalo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinsiza enkulu. Ngabe kukhona izinhlelo zokubandakanya umphakathi kulolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubambe iqhaza. Sizohlela imihlangano yokwazisa abantu ngalesi siphakamiso, futhi sizobavumela ukuba baphakamise imibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bazizwe bebamba iqhaza, futhi bazokwazi ukuveza izidingo zabo. Umphakathi: Lokhu kuhle kakhulu. Ngabe kukhona izifundo ezithathwe kwezinye izindawo eziphumelele ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhamba? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, sithole izifundo eziningi ezivela kwezinye izindawo ezifana neLondon neTokyo. Lezi zindawo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuhamba komphakathi kungathuthukiswa uma kunezinhlelo ezicacile nezokuxhumana. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezitimela ezisheshayo nezokuthutha ezisebenza kahle. Umphakathi: Ngabe unayo imiyalelo ethile kubantu abavela emphakathini mayelana nalolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukuba nezinhloso ezicacile. Bafanele bazi ukuthi le phrojekthi izothuthukisa impilo yabo, futhi badinga ukuxhasa lezi zinhlelo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kuzokwenza kube lula ukufezekisa lezi zinhlelo. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngalezi zinkcukacha ezibalulekile. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngithemba ukuthi sizobona impumelelo kule phrojekthi, futhi abantu bazokwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo zayo.
I-akhawunti yeMzansi iyinsizakalo enikezwa yi-SAPO eqondiswe kubantu ngabanye. Kuyindlela elula yokwamukela imali nokukhishwa kwemali noma ukwenza izinkokhelo. Ungaqiniseka ukuthi imali yakho iphephile ngoba awekho amaholo okwenyanga, futhi okusele kwi-akhawunti yakho kuzothola inzalo. Awekhona amakhokhelo abangelwa njalo; ukhokha kuphela ngalokho okusebenzisa. Awudingi iphepha lesikhwama semali ukuze uvule i-akhawunti yeMzansi. Noma ubani angavula i-akhawunti ngoba awekho imiqathango efana nokuba nenani elithile lemali yokuhola edingekayo ukuze uvule le akhawunti. Ungasebenzisa ibhange ezikhungweni ze-1300 ze-Post Office noma kumashini e-ATM angu-8000. Zonke izimali ezingenayo e-Post Office zenziwa mahhala. Qaphela: Abancane abafuna ukuvula le akhawunti kumele bahambe nomgibeli osemthethweni noma umzali. Yiya kwi-Post Office eduze kwakho eNingizimu Afrika futhi ucele umphakathi ukuba akunikeze ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Gcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Bonisa i-ID yakho. Nikeza ubufakazi bendawo ophila kuyo. Njengengxenye yeMthetho wezeMali, bonke abafaka izicelo kumele banikeze ubufakazi bendawo abahlala kuyo. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokukhombisa ibhili ye-utility egameni lakho. Uma uqasha, ikhophi yesivumelwano sokuqashisa iyadingeka. Uma uhlala nabazali bakho, kudingeka isitatimende esivumelwano esiqinisekisa lokhu. Abancane abafuna ukuvula le akhawunti kumele bahambe nomgibeli osemthethweni noma umzali. Amafomu okufaka izicelo atholakala ezikhungweni ze-Post Office kulo lonke izwe.
uBafana Bafana: Uhlanga Lwezokudlala Kwezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika UBafana Bafana, okuyiqembu lesizwe lempilo yezeMidlalo eNingizimu Afrika, ubonisa ubuhle bokudlala ibhola lezinyawo. Igama elithi "Bafana Bafana" lisho "Bafana" okungukuthi "Bafana" ngesiZulu, elihlonipha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafana nabafana, okukhombisa umoya wokubumbana nokuhlanganyela. Le nqola ibalulekile emlandweni wezokudlala eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule, lapho ibhola lezinyawo lathola khona ukuthandwa okukhulu. Ukwakhiwa kweqembu UBafana Bafana waqala ukusebenza ngonyaka ka-1992, ngemuva kokuphela kokubandlululwa kwezenhlalo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubadlali abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezinhlanga ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu, uBafana Bafana wathola abaqeqeshi abavela emazweni ahlukene, okuhlanganisa noCarlos Alberto Parreira, owaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ithimba eliqinile. Imidlalo emikhulu UBafana Bafana ube neqhaza elikhulu emidlalweni emikhulu, kuhlanganise neNdebe yoMhlaba, lapho baqala khona ukuhamba phambili ngonyaka ka-1998. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula umnyango wokubambisana phakathi kwezwekazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBafana Bafana uphumelele neNdebe ye-Afrika, eyayibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika ngonyaka ka-1996, lapho baphumelela khona umqhudelwano, kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Izinkanyezi zikaBafana Bafana Abadlali abanjengoBenni McCarthy, Siphiwe Tshabalala, noItumeleng Khune baye baba izinkanyezi ezidumile, behola uBafana Bafana emidlalweni ehlukene. UBenni McCarthy, ngokukhethekile, waba ngumdlali wokuqala waseNingizimu Afrika ophumelele ukuhamba phambili eNgilandi, lapho adlala khona kwiPremier League. Umdlalo wakhe omuhle, kanye nekhono lakhe lokuphosa amagoli, kwenze waba yisibonelo esihle kubadlali abasha. Umthelela kwezenhlalo UBafana Bafana akugcini nje ngokuba yithimba lezemidlalo, kodwa futhi ubonisa umoya wokubumbana phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Iqembu libonisa ukuthi ibhola lezinyawo lingaba yindlela yokuhlanganisa abantu, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlanga ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni lapho ubuhlanga buphikisana khona. Izinkinga nezinselelo Noma kunjalo, uBafana Bafana ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukungaphumeleli emqhudelwaneni, ukushintsha kwabaphathi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali ziye zaba yizinto ezithinta ukusebenza kweqembu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuthuthukisa umphakathi wezokudlala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uBafana Bafana uqhubeka nokukhula. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa Ukuze uBafana Bafana uqhubeke nokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abadlali abasha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izikole zebhola, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle, kanye nokwakha amathuba okudlala emakhaya. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantwana baphumelele emidlalweni, futhi bakhule babe abadlali abaqavile. Isiphetho UBafana Bafana ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuhlanganyela, ubumbano, nokuphumelela. Njengoba iqembu liqhubeka nokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlale bexhasa, bejabulisa, futhi bephakamisa umoya wokubumbana. Ngale ndlela, uBafana Bafana uzoba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ibhola lezinyawo lingaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, futhi ubonise ukuthi, ngaphezu kokudlala, ibhola lingaba yindlela yokuphila.
Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule Ngokubona kwami, izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zibalulekile kakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengomfundi ophothulile, ngiyazi ukuthi ukufunda kuphela akanele; kudingeka ukuthi sithole ithuba lokusebenzisa lokho esikufundile emsebenzini. Ngakho-ke, izindlela ezitholakalayo zama-internship zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlaka ezicacile, ezithuthukisayo, nezihambisana nezidingo zabafundi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisane nezinkampani ezahlukene ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ama-internship ahambisana nezifundo zabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde kahle imisebenzi ethile, futhi bakwazi ukufaka isandla emisebenzini ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani nazo zidinga ukufunda ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuthola abafundi abasha abaneziqu eziphezulu, ukuze ziqhubeke nokukhula. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zama-internship kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhola abafundi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kumele bazi ukuthi yini okulindeleke kubo, futhi bazi ukuthi bazothola ini ekupheleni kwalesi sikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa okuhle, izinkampani zingasiza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono abalulekile, futhi baqonde kahle izinqubo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukufaka isandla emsebenzini, futhi kuzobasiza ukuba baphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bathole ithuba lokuxhumana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe inethiwekhi ebanzi, futhi bazitholele amathuba amaningi emsebenzini. Ukuxhumana nabantu abanolwazi olukhulu emkhakheni wabo kuzobasiza abafundi ukuba baqonde kahle izidingo zemakethe, futhi bakwazi ukuhlela izinyathelo zabo zokuphumelela. Ngokuphathelene nezinkinga ezithinta ama-internship, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi abathola ama-internship bayakhokhelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba baphumelele, futhi kuzokhuthaza abanye abafundi ukuba baphokophele ama-internship. Ukungakhokhelwa kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bazizwe bengafaneleki, futhi lokhu kungathinta umphumela wokugcina. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi ama-internship ahlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kumele bathole ithuba lokufunda ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, futhi bazi ukuthi bangawasebenzisa kanjani amakhono abo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba baqonde kahle imisebenzi ethile, futhi bazitholele amathuba amaningi emsebenzini. Ngokuphetha, izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisane nezinkampani, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ama-internship ahambisana nezifundo zabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa okuhle, ithuba lokuxhumana, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuba baphumelele. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza bonke abathintekayo ukuthi baphokophele izindlela ezithuthukisayo zama-internship, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezithombe Nemidwebo Ezikhungweni Kwakuyilanga elijabulisayo eZindlini Zokufunda, isikhungo esisha sokufundisa esisemphakathini. Abafundi babebanjelwe emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, befuna izindlela ezintsha zokufunda. UProfesa Mlambo, umfundisi ophambili, wayehlale ebona ukuthi ukufunda kungenziwa kube mnandi ngokusebenzisa izithombe nemidwebo. Wayekholelwa ukuthi lezi zinto zingasiza abafundi ukuba baqonde kahle imiqondo eyinkimbinkimbi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uLindiwe, umfundi oneminyaka engu-12, waba nomdlandla emsebenzini wabo. Wathola ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zenza kube lula ukufunda imisebenzi ethile. Wazi ukuthi uma ethola umfanekiso ophathelene nezifundo, imiqondo iyamsiza kakhulu. UProfesa Mlambo, efuna ukukhuthaza abafundi, wanquma ukuthi bazame ukusebenzisa izithombe nemidwebo ezindabeni zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uLindiwe nabanye abafundi baphenduke izithombe ezimnandi ukuthi zifake ezikhaleni zabo. Basungula imidwebo ezihambisana nezifundo zabo, benza ama-collage ahlanganisa izithombe eziningi ezichaza izifundo ezithile. UProfesa Mlambo wabona ukuthi lokhu kwenza abafundi babe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekufundeni. Abafundi baqala ukujabulisa uma bephendula imibuzo, behlola izithombe futhi besebenzisa imidwebo njengendlela yokwenza izifundo. Ngemva kwesikhashana, uLindiwe wahlanganyela nezinye izingane ekwakheni umkhiqizo omusha. Babebhikisha umcabango wokuthi bangakha isithombe esikhulu esizobonisa izifundo zempilo, ezemvelo, nobuchwepheshe. Bafika emsebenzini, behlola izithombe ezahlukahlukene, behamba ezindaweni ezahlukene, beqopha, bejabulile. UProfesa Mlambo waphinde waba umxhumanisi omuhle, eqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayawuqonda umqondo. Uhlanga lwezithombe nemidwebo lwaba yinsiza enkulu ekufundeni. Abafundi bahlala besebenzisa imidwebo ukuze bafunde izifundo ezinzima, futhi uLindiwe wacabanga ukuthi lezi zinto zingaba zinhle nakakhulu uma besebenzisa izithombe ezivela ezincwadini ezidumile. UProfesa Mlambo wancoma abafundi ukuthi basebenze imidwebo yabo ezincwadini, ukuze babonise izifundo ezithile ngendlela eyakhayo. Njengoba isikhungo siqhubeka, uLindiwe noProfesa Mlambo balungiselela umcimbi wokubonisa umkhiqizo wabo. Abafundi babekwazi ukufaka izithombe nemidwebo zabo ezikhungweni, behlezi bejabulile, becela abanye ukuthi baphumelele. Umcimbi wagcwala abantu abavela emiphakathini eminingi, behamba ngothando, bezithokozisa ngezithombe ezinkulu ezibhalwe ngezincwadi ezahlukene. UProfesa Mlambo wavuma ukuthi ukusebenzisa izithombe nemidwebo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufunda. Uhlanga lwezithombe nemidwebo lwaba yisinqumo esihle esisize abafundi ukuba bahlale bejabulile bezifundela. Uhlanga lwabantu abasha lwalukhuluma ngalezi zinto, luphila ngokujabula okukhulu, futhi lwanika uLindiwe nezinye izingane ithemba elisha lokuthi ukufunda akukona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kube yindlela yokuzijabulisa. Ngemuva komcimbi, uthando lokufunda kwabanye luvele lwaba lula, futhi uLindiwe wathola umbono omusha wokuthi izithombe nemidwebo zingaba yizinsiza ezenzakalayo zokufunda. UProfesa Mlambo wakhumbula ukuthi ukufundisa akufanele kube ngokuqondile kuphela, kodwa futhi kufanele kube ngokubambisana, kube nekhono lokudala. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni bonke abafundi babe neqhaza elikhulu ekufundeni. Ekugcineni, uLindiwe noProfesa Mlambo bahlala bejabule futhi beqonda ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni akugcini nje ngokwenza ukufunda kube mnandi, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ubuciko bokucabanga. Abafundi baphuma bezifundela, bengabazi ukuthi babengaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ukufunda kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi uLindiwe noProfesa Mlambo bahlala bejabulile ngempumelelo yabo.
