Amaphoyisa: Umsebenzi Wabo Nezindlela Zokusebenza Isingeniso Amaphoyisa, njengengxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, anomsebenzi omkhulu wokugcina ukuphepha nokuthula. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekutholeni abaphula umthetho, kodwa futhi uhilela ukuvikela, ukufundisa, nokuxhumanisa umphakathi. Kulolu hlobo, sizobheka izinqubo ezisemqoka ezihambisana nomsebenzi wamaphoyisa, izindlela zokusebenza, kanye nezimfanelo ezibalulekile okufanele zibe nazo. Isigaba 1: Umsebenzi Wamaphoyisa Umsebenzi wamaphoyisa uqala ngokubona izinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhamba ezindaweni ezithile, ukuxhumana nabantu, nokuhlola izimo ezithile. Amaphoyisa kufanele abe nekhono lokubona izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba zibe zinkulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izigameko ezimbi zingavikelwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa kufanele abe nekhono lokuxhumana kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwazi ukulalela, ukuxoxa, nokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene. Ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi abe nekhono lokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Isigaba 2: Izindlela Zokusebenza Amaphoyisa asebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze aqinisekise ukuphepha komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuhamba Ngezinyawo: Ukuhamba ezindaweni ezithile, amaphoyisa angakwazi ukubona izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano nomphakathi, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukufinyelela kalula kumaphoyisa uma kudingeka. 2. Ukusebenza Ngemoto: Amaphoyisa asebenzisa izimoto ukuze afinyelele ezindaweni ezikude. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kudingeka ukuphendula ngokushesha ezimeni eziphuthumayo. 3. Ukubamba Izigameko: Uma kwenzeka isigameko, amaphoyisa kufanele akwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvimbela abaphula umthetho, ukuqoqa ubufakazi, nokuxhumana nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. 4. Ukwenza Izifundo: Amaphoyisa kufanele ahlale efunda ukuze aqhubeke nokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, ukufunda ngezindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, kanye nokuhlola izimo ezithile. Isigaba 3: Izimfanelo Zokusebenza Kwamaphoyisa Ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo kahle, kunezimfanelo ezibalulekile okufanele zibe nazo: 1. Ukwethembeka: Amaphoyisa kufanele abe nethemba elikhulu kumphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukuvuma izinkinga zabo. 2. Ubulungiswa: Amaphoyisa kufanele benze umsebenzi wabo ngokufanele, ngaphandle kokubandlulula. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. 3. Ukwazi Ukuphatha Izimo: Amaphoyisa kufanele akwazi ukuphatha izimo ezinzima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwazi ukujwayela izimo eziphuthumayo, nokwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo. 4. Ukwazi Ukuxhumana: Amaphoyisa kufanele abe nekhono lokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Isigaba 4: Ukuxhumana Nomphakathi Amaphoyisa kufanele axhumane nomphakathi ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayazi ngemisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Izinhlelo Zokuxhumana: Amaphoyisa kufanele benze izinhlelo zokuxhumana nomphakathi, ezifana nemihlangano, izinkulumo, noma izinhlelo zokufundisa. 2. Ukwamukela Izikhalazo: Amaphoyisa kufanele bakwazi ukwamukela izikhalazo zomphakathi, futhi baphendule ngempumelelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukuveza izinkinga zabo. 3. Ukwenza Imisebenzi Yomphakathi: Amaphoyisa kufanele babe neqhaza emisebenzini yomphakathi, njengokuhlanza izindawo, noma ukusiza ezinhlelweni zokufundisa. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Isiphetho Amaphoyisa banendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekutholeni abaphula umthetho, kodwa futhi uhilela ukuvikela, ukufundisa, nokuxhumanisa umphakathi. Ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa amakhono abo, amaphoyisa angakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi aqinisekise ukuphepha nokuthula emiphakathini yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa aqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi.
UMphathiswa Wezempilo Nokuhamba Uhambo wenze imithetho ebekiwe kulolu hlu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24 esifundwa nesigaba 44 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezemvelo Kwamazwe, 1998 (Umthetho No. 107 ka-1998). KuMemezelo Kahulumeni No. R. 386 kanye No. R. Uma ngokuhambisana nale mithetho izinsuku kufanele zibhalwe kusukela noma ngemuva kosuku oluthile kulandela usuku oluthile kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku lokugcina lesikhathi, kodwa uma usuku lokugcina lesikhathi luhlangana neMgqibelo, uSonto, noma usuku lokuphumula, leso sikhathi kufanele sandiswe kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku olulandelayo olungelona uMgqibelo, uSonto, noma usuku lokuphumula. Inhloso yale mithetho ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo nezindlela njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 5 seMthetho mayelana nokwethulwa, ukucutshungulwa, nezinqumo eziphathelene nezicelo zokuthola izimvume zemvelo nezindaba ezihlobene. Zonke izicelo ngaphansi kwale mithetho kufanele zinqunywe ngempela ngabasemthethweni abafanele. Abasemthethweni abafanele okufanele bacabangele futhi benze isinqumo ngesicelo mayelana nomsebenzi othile kufanele baphathwe ngokuhambisana noMemezelo Kahulumeni No. R. 386 kanye No. R. 387 ka-2006, kuhlanganise nezinye izimemezelo ezingase zikhishwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24D seMthetho. Noma yisiphi ukungqubuzana noma ukungavumelani mayelana nokuthi iyiphi imithombo efanele yokuhambisana nanoma yisiphi isicelo esithile kufanele ixazululwe nguMphathiswa kanye nomphathi wephalamende elihlobene noma nguMphathiswa kanye nelungu likamasipala elinikeziwe ukuphatha lokho, okukhona. Uma uMphathiswa engumthombo ofanele wesicelo esithile, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo Sezempilo Nokuhamba. Uma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene engumthombo ofanele, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo sephalamende esiphathelene nezindaba zemvelo kulolo phalamende. Uma uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene esebenzisile noma yiziphi amandla noma imisebenzi yomthombo ofanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 42 seMthetho mayelana nomsebenzi okukhulunywa ngawo esicelweni, kufanele ithunyelwe kumuntu ofanele kukamasipala ophumelele. Singase sihlinzeke umceli noma i-EAP ukufinyelela kunoma yiziphi iziqondiso nolwazi mayelana nezindlela ezibekiwe noma nolwazi olunikezwe umthombo ofanele oluhlobene nesicelo; noma b sicele umceli noma i-EAP, ngokubhala noma ngengxoxo, mayelana nohlobo nobubanzi bezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinhlinzeko zale mithetho. Lapho isicelo sokusebenza okudingayo izimvume zemvelo ngaphansi kwale mithetho kufanele senziwe ngokuhambisana neminye imithetho futhi le mthetho edinga ukuthi ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe noma izinqubo kufanele zilandelwe njengokugcwele nolwazi noma izinqubo ezidingekayo ngaphansi kwale mithetho, uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene, ngokuhlinzeka ngesiqondiso sesi-3 seMthethosisekelo kanye nesigaba 24(g) seMthetho, kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokungena esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe nomthombo ophathelene nokuphathwa komthetho ophathelene nokulethwa kwezidingo zepolitiki nezimfuno zale mithetho ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda ekuwethuleni kwalolo lwazi noma ekwenzeni lezo zindlela. Umthombo ofanele kufanele uthole lonke ulwazi oluhambelana noma olungase luthinteke mayelana nanoma yisiphi isinqumo ngesicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi lokho ulwazi lukhushelwe ngumthetho, umceli noma i-EAP noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu onalo ulwazi, uma kuceliwe umthombo ofanele, kufanele aveze lokho ulwazi kumthombo ofanele, noma ngabe lokho ulwazi lubeka umceli endaweni ethokozisayo noma engathokozisi. viii noma yiziphi izimvo ezivela kulungu lukamasipala olunamandla alinganiselwe emthethweni mayelana nengxenye ethile yomsebenzi okukhulunywa ngawo esicelweni; kanye ix noma yiziphi iziqondiso ezihlobene nesicelo. Umthombo ofanele kufanele uzame ukuhlangabezana nezinsuku ezibekwe ezithile kubasomthetho abafanele ngaphansi kwale mithetho. Uma umthombo ofanele engumuntu lukamasipala ophatha amandla anikezwe kuwo kanye nemisebenzi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 42 noma 42A seMthetho futhi leli lungu likamasipala lingakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinsuku ezibekwe kule mithetho, leli lungu elinikeziwe kufanele libike uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene. b sihlinzeka umceli ngezizathu zesinqumo; futhi c sikwazisa umceli ngendawo yokuthi isinqumo singaphikiswa ngokuhambisana neSahluko 7 sale mithetho, uma leyo mfuneko yokuphikisa ikhona emkhakheni walolo suku. i mayelana nesinqumo ngesicelo; futhi ii mayelana nezizathu zesinqumo; futhi b sikwazisa ngendawo yokuthi isinqumo esenziwe singaphikiswa ngokuhambisana neSahluko 7 sale mithetho, uma leyo mfuneko yokuphikisa ikhona emkhakheni walolo suku. a sigcina irekhodi lezicelo zonke ezamukelwe umthombo ofanele ngaphansi kwale mithetho; futhi b sibhala zonke izinqumo eziphathelene nezimvume zemvelo. Umthombo ofanele akabhekiwe ngezindleko ezithintekayo ezikhokhelwe umceli ngokuhambisana nale mithetho. Isicelo sokuthola izimvume zemvelo zomsebenzi kufanele senziwe kumthombo ofanele okukhulunywa ngawo ngokuhambisana nomthetho 3. i kanye nesivumelwano esibhaliwe esiqondiswe kumthetho 161 noma ubufakazi bokuthi umthetho 163 ulandelwe, uma umceli engumuntu ongenayo indawo lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa; futhi ii imali yesicelo ebekiwe, uma kufanele. b sihlinzeke nganoma yimaphi imibiko, ezinye izincwadi, nezimali ezidingekayo ngaphansi kwale mithetho; futhi c sibe nolwazi nganoma yiziphi iziqondiso ezisebenzayo ekwethuleni izicelo. a sivuma ukuthi sithole isicelo, uma isicelo siqhubeka kahle, noma b sithi asivumi isicelo, uma singaqhubeki kahle. I-EAP ephethe isinqumo ingashintsha leso sicelo futhi isithumele kabusha kumthombo ofanele. Ukushintsha nokuthunyelwa kabusha kwesicelo eshintshiwe kufanele kuthunyelwe kumthombo ofanele ngokuhambisana nokushintsha. Uma umceli efuna ukwenza imisebenzi emibili noma ngaphezulu njengengxenye yephrojekthi efanayo, ifomu lesicelo elilodwa kufanele lithunyelwe kuyo yonke le misebenzi. Uma umceli efuna ukwenza imisebenzi engaphezu kweyodwa yohlobo olufanayo ezindaweni ezihlukene, izicelo ezihlukene kufanele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezihlukene ngaphakathi kwephalamende efanayo, kodwa umthombo ofanele ungavuma ukuhlinzeka ngovumelelo ngokususelwa efomini elilodwa elibhaliwe elenziwe umceli, ukuze kube nesicelo esisodwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi, noma ngabe isicelo sithunyelwe efomini elilodwa noma kumafomu amaningi. Uma umthombo ofanele unika imvume ngokuhambisana nezinguquko 2, isicelo kufanele siphathwe njengokuhlanganyela kwenqubo kuyo yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nesicelo, kodwa umthelela wemvelo ongase ube khona walowo msebenzi kufanele ucabangele mayelana nendawo
Inhloso yokubuyekeza umthetho ophathelene nekhwalithi yomoya ukuvikela, ukubuyisela, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika, kubhekwa isidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki; ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sezwe nezindinganiso zokwamukelwa kwezinga lekhwalithi yomoya, ukuphathwa, nokulawulwa kuyo yonke imikhakha yomphakathi; isisekelo esithile sokuzama ikhwalithi yomoya; nokubheka zonke izindaba ezihambelanayo ngalokhu. Izinyathelo zomthetho ezintsha nezicabangelayo zidingeka ukuvikela, ukubuyisela, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika. Noma iyiphi inqubomgomo ethathwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 46 noma 47; nezinye izinhlinzeko ezincane ezithathwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi. Kulesi sikhathi, igama noma isigaba esithathwe egameni noma isisho esichazwe esigabeni 1 sinezincazelo ezifanayo ngaphandle uma umongo ukhombisa incazelo ehlukile. Inhloso yalesi sikhathi ukuvikela, ukubuyisela, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika, kubhekwa isidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki. a ngezinhlelo zomphakathi ezisebenza kulesi sikhathi, uhulumeni kufanele avikele, abuyisele, futhi athuthukise ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika; noma b uhulumeni kufanele asebenzise lesi sikhathi ukuze afinyelele empumelelweni yalezo zikhala. b kuzo zonke izenzo ezithinta ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika. a emikhakheni kahulumeni kazwelonke nendawo; kanye b emkhakheni kahulumeni wesifunda, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo. b kufanele kuhumusheke futhi kusebenza ngokuhambisana nesisekelo esichazwe esigabeni 2 salesi sikhathi. e ukuphatha ulwazi lwekhwalithi yomoya. d kungashintshwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isisekelo sezwe noma noma yisiphi isichibiyelo kulesi sikhathi, uNgqongqoshe kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukusetshenziswa lapho kukhona isichibiyelo esincane esisekelweni. i mayelana nekhwalithi yemvelo yomoya, ehlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalezo zingxenye noma inhlanganisela yazo ezitholakala emoyeni; noma ii njengento eyakhiwe emoyeni lapho umthombo wayo waziwa noma endaweni lapho umthombo ungatholakali. mayelana nomsebenzi owenziwa yizifunda mayelana nokuhambisana nalesi sikhathi. v ngokuhambisana nezibopho zeNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwezivumelwano zomhlaba. i kanye nekhwalithi yemvelo yomoya, ehlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalezo zingxenye noma inhlanganisela yazo ezitholakala emoyeni; noma ii izingxenye ezakhiwe emoyeni ezivela endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda noma kunoma iyiphi indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Uma amazinga kazwelonke estabalwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 ukuze kube nezingxenye ezithile noma inhlanganisela yezingxenye, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathe lesi sikhathi akakwazi ukushintsha lelo zinga kazwelonke ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile kulolo sifunda noma endaweni ethile ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba, isaziso singahlukanisa phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene ezibekwe ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, noma yisiphi isichibiyelo esenziwe esazisweni, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukusetshenziswa ezichibiyelweni ezincane esazisweni. b kungasungula amazinga endawo ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezinto ezivela endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda, ngezingxenye ezithile noma inhlanganisela yazo. Uma amazinga kazwelonke noma wesifunda estabalwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 noma 9 ukuze kube nezingxenye ezithile noma inhlanganisela yezingxenye, isifunda asikwazi ukushintsha lawo mazingas kazwelonke noma wesifunda ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile esifundeni. Ngaphambi kokuba isifunda sithathe umthetho wangaphakathi esifundeni esikhulunywa ngaso esigabeni 1, kufanele silandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana neSahluko 4 seMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi. a ezizokwenziwa ngokuqhathaniswa nekhwalithi yomoya ezizungezile, b ezizokwenziwa ngento eyakhiwe yindawo ngayinye ebonakalayo noma engabonakali. Ngosaziso kuGazethi, uNgqongqoshe angasungula iKomidi Lezokweluleka LeKhwalithi Yomoya Yezwe ukuze eluleka uNgqongqoshe ngokuqhathaniswa nokuphathwa kwalesi sikhathi. e noma iyiphi indaba ephathelene neKomidi. UNgqongqoshe kufanele aqoke isikhungo kwiSikhungo esizokwenza njengomphakathi ophathelene nekhwalithi yomoya lapho izokwenza ukuhlela izindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwekhwalithi yomoya ezingeni likamasipala. UNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathe ikhwalithi yomoya esifundeni kufanele aqoke isikhungo kwiKhansela lesifunda esizokwenza ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi yomoya nokuhlela izindaba ezihlobene nekhwalithi yomoya esifundeni. Isifunda ngasinye kufanele siqoke isikhungo sekhwalithi yomoya esizokwenza umsebenzi wokuhlela izindaba zokuphathwa kwekhwalithi yomoya esifundeni. Isikhungo sekhwalithi yomoya kufanele senze imisebenzi noma sisebenzise amandla anikezwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi. Isikhungo sekhwalithi yomoya singakwazi ukuhoxisa amandla noma imisebenzi ethile eshiwo esigabeni 4 kumuntu osebenza ehhovisi leso sikhungo, kuphela ngaphansi kwezimo nezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 46. Izikhungo zeqhwalithi yomoya kufanele zihlele imisebenzi yazo ngendlela ethile eyinqunywe ngesikhungo sezwe noma nguNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 46. Isifunda ngasinye noma umnyango wesifunda ophathelene nokuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo somthetho noma isu lokuphathwa kwemvelo ngaphansi kweSahluko 3 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezokuphila Kwendawo kufanele ifake njengengxenye yesu layo, uhlelo lokuphatha ikhwalithi yomoya. KuHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe olukhonjiswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 25 seMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi, isifunda ngasinye kufanele sifake isu lokuphatha ikhwalithi yomoya. c ngokuhambisana nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo esingase sikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi komthetho ophakanyisiwe esigabeni 46. d Imisebenzi yokuhlola ikhwalithi yomoya. b indawo idinga isenzo esithile sokuphatha ikhwalithi yomoya ukuze ilungise isimo esikhona. b indawo extends beyond the boundary of another province; or c indawo if falls under the province where that province has requested the Minister to declare that area as a priority area. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathe ikhwalithi yomoya esifundeni angabiza indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda njenge ndawo ebalulekile. Ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yesikhwama (GEMS member scheme compliance commitment) Kulezi zinsuku, ukuhambisana nemithetho yesikhwama se-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu athola ubuqotho bezinsizakalo zezempilo. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kudinga ukuzibophezela okuqinile kwabantu bonke abahlanganyela kulesi sikhwama, okunceda ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kwemalungu kanye nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngempilo. Izinsizakalo zempilo ziyadingeka kakhulu emiphakathini yethu, futhi i-GEMS ibaluleke njengesikhungo esiqinisekisa ukuthi abarbeiter bakahulumeni bathola ukufinyelela kwezempilo okwakhiwe ngempumelelo. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukulawulwa kwemithetho ye-GEMS kudingekile. Ukuhamba phambili, kube nezinkqubo ezithile ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayawuqonda umgomo wokuhambisana nemithetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu azithola izinzuzo ezilindelekile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Manje, le mithetho ibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngedatha efanele, ukulandela izinqubomgomo zokusebenzisa izinsizakalo, nokugcina imithetho eqinile yokuhumusha. Ukuhlola okuqhubekayo kwezimali nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo kuhlelwa ngokuqinile, kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukugwema izinkinga eziphuma ekungahambisani nemithetho. Ingqikithi yalesi sikhwama ibhalwe phansi kumagugu okufanele ahlonishwe, futhi cada kube umgomo ophelele wokugcina ukhono lokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amalungu adlulele kancane kancane ekulandeleni imihlahlandlela, aqonde ukuthi izinzuzo ezitholwayo zingaholela ekukwaziwa kwezimali kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo ezinhle. Ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo, i-GEMS ibisungula ukuhlola okujule komkhiqizo nezinsizakalo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto ezihlinzekwayo ziyahambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukubaluleka kokuhambisana nemithetho akukhona kuphela kumalungu, kodwa nakwakho konke abafakizelo njengoba kuqhakambisa umoya wokubambisana ophakathi kwezinkampani. Izithangami eziyinkomba zezempilo nezokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukukhuluma ngamathuba nezinselelo ezihlobene nokuhambisana kwemithetho. Lokhu kusiza ukuba kuhlanzwe ezinye izinkinga noma izingozi ezivela ngalesi sikhwama. Kanjalo, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuveza ukuthi bayazibuza imibuzo ethile engabavumela ukuxazulula izingqinamba abahlangabezana nazo. Hamba phambili kwezinye izinyathelo ezithile, i-GEMS iphinde ibonise ukufundayo ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze ithuthukise amasu nokuvuselela imithetho yayo, ija ulwazi olusha, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yezenzo zayo. Lokhu kuzama ukwakha umgubho kubalulekile, okwazi ukwakha ithemba phakathi kwamaGEMS kanye neziphathimandla ezithinta imithombo yezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukholwa kokwaziswa kwependulo kuyisihluthulelo ekuphumeleleni kwezinqubomgomo. Ngokusho kwabalulekile, izincwadi zokuqhuba ezibhalwe phansi zikhombisa izikhalazo ngemithetho, zifaka phakathi nodoliwe. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukusiza kulolu hambo, aqhube imikhankaso yokuhambisana, nokuqhakambisa izinqubomgomo eziyinqaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izoxhumana ukuze ihlonze izinkampani eziphumelelayo emkhakheni wezempilo, ukwandisa amagama agqugquzelayo naso yizingxenyekazi eziwusizo phambi kokuphila komphakathi. Lokhu kuwenza kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni nasekusekeleni ukuhlonishwa kwempilo yomphakathi. Ekugcineni, ukulandela imithetho yesikhwama se-GEMS kunomthelela omkhulu ekutheni abarbeiter benze ngokuzimisela futhi bahlakulele ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthola izinsizakalo ezilungile. Kulabo abahlanganyela, ukuqonda imithetho yokusebenzisa, kanye nama-operations ahambisanayo kuzogqugquzela impumelelo yayo yonke. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuveze indlela ehlanzekile yomugqa wesikhathi wokufinyelela izinsizakalo zempilo ezikhethiwe. Isibopho sokuhambisana kwe-GEMS sizohlala senza umehluko omkhulu, ubuncane bukhonza umphakathi, futhi bunikeze amalungu ithuba lokuphila kahle. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS izobambelela ezimisweni zayo zokuhlonishwa, ikhulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela nosizo. Emva kwalokhu, kubalulekile ukuba wonke amalungu abheke phambili, aqonde umgomo wabo wokulalela imithetho ye-GEMS, okunomthelela omuhle empilo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalokhu, kubalulekile ukuhamba nendlela yokuqhubekela phambili, kukholwe ukuba, sonke sinesibopho sokuqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ye-GEMS iyahlonishwa, okukhuthaza impumelelo yezeMpilo eziphakanyisiwe. Lokhu kuzokwakha isikhumbuzo esinamandla sokuhambisana okulindelekile, okukhuthaza ezempilo zethu sonke.
Umbiko Ngamazwi Ezamahlathi Isingeniso Ezamahlathi, noma ezokulima izihlahla, zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi zisebenza njengomthombo wezinto eziningi ezidingekayo. Zihlanganisa izihlahla, izitshalo, nezilwane ezihlala emahlathini, futhi zidlala indima enkulu ekugcineni ibhalansi yemvelo. Kulesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde kahle izinzuzo ezihambisana nezamahlathi, izinselelo ezibhekene nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sigcine lezi zinsiza ezibalulekile. Izinzuzo Zezamahlathi Ezamahlathi zinezici ezinhle eziningi. Okokuqala, zisebenza njengomthombo omkhulu wezokudla, izinkuni, nezinsiza zokwakha. Izihlahla zikhula zibe yizinkuni ezisetshenziselwa ukwakha izindlu, izinsiza zokusebenza, nezinto zokuhlobisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhizinisi amaningi asekelwe ezamahlathini, okuhlanganisa ukuhweba ngezinkuni, ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuphumula, kanye nezinsiza zokuvakasha. Okwesibili, ezamahlathi zibalulekile ekugcineni umoya. Izihlahla zisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide (CO2) futhi zikhulula umoya-mpilo (oxygen), okwenza kube nokuphila okuhle emhlabeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini lapho izinga lokushisa lomhlaba liphakeme kakhulu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, amabhande ezihlahla anciphisa ukungcoliswa komoya, okwenza kube nempilo engcono kubantu nakwezinye izilwane. Okwesithathu, ezamahlathi zisebenza njengendawo yokuhlala kwezilwane. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukudla, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze izilwane zihlale ziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile ekugcineni ibhalansi yemvelo, njengoba izilwane zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nezamahlathi Noma ezamahlathi zinezici ezinhle, zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuncipha kwezimali ezamahlathi kubangelwa ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, izimboni, nezolimo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezihlahla, okwenza kube nokuncipha kwezinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukwehla kokuhlala kwezilwane, okuthinta ibhalansi yemvelo. Okwesibili, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kubangela izinkinga ezinkulu ezamahlathini. Ukukhishwa kwemikhumbi, imfucumfucu, nezinsiza ezikhiqizwayo zenza kube nokungcoliswa okukhulu emanzini nasemoyeni. Lokhu kuthinta izihlahla nezilwane, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi zihlale ziphilile. Ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ezamahlathi zihlala zikhona. Okwesithathu, izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukuhlela ezamahlathi. Ukushisa okukhulu, imvula engapheli, kanye nezimo ezinzima zenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo zokulima izihlahla. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi bezamahlathi bahlale beqaphela izinguquko ezithinta izimo zemvelo. Izinyathelo Zokugcina Ezamahlathi Ukuze sigcine ezamahlathi, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuphatha ezamahlathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokulima, ukwakha izindawo zokuphumula, kanye nokuvikela izindawo ezibalulekile. Abaphathi bezamahlathi kufanele basebenzisane nabantu bendawo ukuze baqonde izidingo zabo futhi benze izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza umphakathi. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqonda izinzuzo ezihambisana nezamahlathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ngendima ezamahlathi ezimpilweni zabo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela lezi zinsiza. Ukufundisa umphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikelwa kwezamahlathi, njengoba abantu bezoba nentshisekelo yokugcina lezi zinsiza. Okwesithathu, kudingeka izinhlelo zokubuyisela ezamahlathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa uk planting izihlahla ezintsha, ukuvuselela izindawo ezonakele, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokulima ezihlala zikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwanda kwezihlahla, okuzokwenza kube nokuphila okuhle emhlabeni. Isiphetho Ezamahlathi zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zisebenza njengomthombo wezinsiza eziningi. Nokho, zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezidinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze sigcine lezi zinsiza, kudingeka ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuphatha, ukufundisa umphakathi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokubuyisela ezamahlathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvikela lezi zinsiza ezibalulekile, ukuze zihlale zikhona futhi zisebenze kahle empilweni yethu.

Ukuhlola Ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan Ngonyaka ka-2030, iRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika ibheke phambili ekufezeni izinjongo ezinkulu zeNational Development Plan (NDP), okuyisikhumbuzo samasu okuthuthukisa izwe. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifeza kanjani lezi zinjongo, futhi zikhona yini izinselelo ezitholakele phakathi nalesi sikhathi. UHulumeni ubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokwakha, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuthutha, okukhombisa intuthuko ethile. Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuhlola impumelelo nezithiyo ezihambisana neNDP ukuze kucace ukuthi yini edinga ukulungiswa noma ukuthuthukiswa ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo. Ngokuxhumana nabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile, sithola izinkinga ezithile mayelana nemiphumela yeNDP. Ezindaweni eziningi, abahlali baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezifana nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuthutha, ukuhlinzekwa kwezindlu ezintsha, kanye nokwandiswa kwezikole. Nokho, kunezithiyo ezinzima ezisagcwele, njengezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, okukhathaza abantu. Umnyango wezokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalakahle ubonisa ukuthi izintshisekelo zemiphakathi ziyaqhuba. Nakuba izinhlelo zokuqashwa zikhona, kukhona ukuntuleka kwemithombo yokufundisa nokuqeqesha abantu ukuze bakwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko emnothweni. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kunesidingo sokwandisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nezinsiza ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Naphezu kwezithiyo, iNDP ibonakala iyinsika ebalulekile yokwakha umnotho owanelisayo. Uhlelo lokwandisa umnotho lobungani nemisebenzi luphumelele ezinhlelweni ezithile, kuholele ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wezezimali, okwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nakuba kusekhona izinselelo. Ukuze lokhu kuqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuthi uHulumeni aqhubeke nokubheka izidingo zezimakethe zomhlaba. Ukuhweba kufanele kube nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukwakha imithombo yokuxhumana nezinkampani zomhlaba jikelele, okukhuthaza ukuhweba okukhulu. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba kunemifuno engaphelele ngemali yokuthuthukisa, kusekhona ithrafikhi yemali edlulela kuhlelo lokwakhiwa kwezindawo. Lokhu kusiza ukuheha izinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, kodwa kudinga ukubhekwa kokuqondela kahle ekusebenzeni. Ekugcineni, ukuqhubeka kweNDP kudinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, uHulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi kuzoholela ekwandiseni impumelelo yokuthuthukiswa. Kudingeka uqhakambise ilungelo labantu ukuze babe nesandla ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, uHulumeni kufanele abheke phambili, abe nesibopho sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukwabelana ngempumelelo, nokubheka imiphumela ethile kubalulekile ukuze kuzuze abantu bonke. Umsebenzi kumele uqhubeke, futhi kumele kube nezinqumo eziphusile ezisuselé emiphakathini ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Lokhu kuhlola kweNDP kukhombisa ukuhamba kwezwe, nezinselelo nezimpumelelo ezithile ezithinta abantu. Kubalulekile ukubheka phambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uHulumeni uqhubekela phambili ekufezeni izinjongo ezinamandla zalesi sihloko esiyinhloko, njengoba siphokophela ikusasa elingcono kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika.
I-Child Protection Register iqukethe uhlu lwabantwana abadinga ukuvikelwa, abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-18, abafuna ukuvikelwa. I-Register igcinwa ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana osebenza ngaphakathi kweSikhungo Sezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi sendawo. Ulwazi olukhona kule Register luyimfihlo futhi lungabelwana kuphela nalabo abaphakathi kweqembu le-Child Protection (isibonelo, othisha, ab nurse, odokotela, abakhathalela/ozinikele/abameli, nabanye). Kuhlu lwabantwana abadinga usizo lwezenhlalakahle lugcinwa. Umntwana uxhumeke nomndeni wakhe kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokushesha (lezo ezinikeza leyo nsizakalo). Isigameko ngasinye sihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zomndeni nomntwana ziyahlinzekwa. Ngokusho komthetho ophathelene nokunakekelwa kwezingane (Inombolo 74 ka-1983), lezi zikhungo ezilandelayo zinomsebenzi wokubika noma yiziphi izinsolo zokuthi kungase kube nezimpawu zokuhlukumeza noma ukunganaki umntwana: udokotela wamazinyo, udokotela jikelele, um nurse, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, uthisha, nanoma ubani osebenza noma ophatha i-Child Care Home noma indawo yokuphepha yezingane. Uma, ngesikhathi sokuhlola, ubhekene, noma usindisa umntwana, kukhona izinsolo zokuthi bangahlukumezeka, lokhu kufanele kubikwe kumsebenzi wezokuxhumana oseduzane lapho umntwana ehlala khona. Noma yiliphi ilunga lomphakathi noma umuntu onomthwalo mayelana nalolu daba angakwazi ukukhomba ukuhlukumeza noma ukunganaki umntwana futhi angabika lokhu kuzinsizakalo zomphakathi. Amagama abo abamba iqhaza azogcinwa njengemfihlo. Ulwazi lokukhomba umntwana. Ulwazi ngababazi bomntwana/abakhathaleli bomntwana. Ikheli lapho umntwana ehlala khona, uma engahlali nabazali bakhe, ikheli labazali bakhe. Izinsuku lapho izigameko zibikwa khona kanye nohlobo lwezigameko. Ulwazi ngezimo ezaholela ezinsolweni. Noma iyiphi imbali yezigameko ezedlule. Noma yiluphi ulwazi lokuxhumana nabanye abantu abangahlinzeka ngobufakazi mayelana nalezi zinsolo. Ulwazi lokuxhumana efayilini lubalulekile, uma izinsizakalo zomphakathi zidinga ukufinyelela mayelana nezinye izindaba eziphathelene nalolu daba. Izinkomba zokuhlukumeza: Lokhu kungabandakanya ama-bruises, izibazi, ukushisa, ukuhlinzwa, nokunye. Ukuhlukumeza kwemizwa: Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomntwana zokuthanda, ukunakwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuxhumana ngendlela yokunakekela, ukubanqanda, ukubathukutheleza ngokuqinile, noma imizamo yokubakhathaza. Ukunganaki: Lokhu kuwukwehluleka ukuvikela umntwana ezinsongweni noma kunoma yini, ezimweni ezibandayo, indlala, nokwehluleka ukwenza okudingekayo ukuze baphathwe, nokunye. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zizovakashela umntwana nomndeni wakhe ukuze zihlaziye isimo futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa. Uma umhlukumezi ophakanyisiwe ehlala endlini efanayo nomntwana, bangacelwa ukuba bashiye bahlale kwenye indawo. Uma lokhu kungatholakali, umntwana angahlala nabakhelwane, abangane, izihlobo, noma endaweni yokuphepha yezingane okwesikhashana. Nokho, kuphela uma impilo yomntwana isengozini. Umgomo wokugcina umntwana nomndeni wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu. Uma kuthathwa isinqumo, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi yini ebaluleke kakhulu kumntwana ukuze athole inzuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Imindeni nezingane zingxenye yanoma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwayo mayelana nesimo abhekene naso. Nokho, ukuhluza kuphela kulolu daba akuthinti amalungelo abazali bomntwana noma abakhathaleli. Ilungelo lithinteka kuphela uma kudingeka kuthathwe isinyathelo somthetho (isibonelo: ukususa umntwana).
AmaXhosa: Umlando Wabo Naphakathi Kwemiphakathi YaseNingizimu Afrika INingizimu Afrika iyindawo enezizwe eziningi ezinezimfundo nemigubho yazo, futhi phakathi kwalezi zizwe, amaXhosa abamba isikhala esibalulekile emlandweni welizwe. Ukuze siqonde amaXhosa, kubalulekile ukubheka izinjongo zabo, izimpi abazibhekile, kanye nempilo yansuku zonke. Umlando wokuqala wamaXhosa uqala ngenkathi yeMfecane, lapho izizwe ezahlukene ziqhumeza izifunda ezinjengeZwelemehlo neZiyoni. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni amaXhosa athuthele emhlabathini omusha, eza nezinkolelo, izilimi, nemigubho yabo. AmaXhosa, njengengxenye ebalulekile yamaNguni, abamba isiko elikhulu lokubhalwa. Ngesikhathi sikaNgqika, umholi ophakeme, amaXhosa aqala ukwakha uhlelo lokuphatha izifunda zabo. UNgqika wayeyisibonelo somholi onobuhlakani, ekhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwamasiko nobudlelwano phakathi kwamabandla. Nokho, baphinde babhekana nezinselelo ezinzima. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaXhosa namakhosi aseBurghers bahlala buphazamisekile, ngenxa yokwanda kwezifiso ezihlukene. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yangaphakathi, amaXhosa akha ubudlelwano bokusebenza ndawonye ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabo. Uhla lwezimpisi nezinsizakusebenza lwakha ubunzima kulolu hlobo lokuphila. Uhlelo lwamasiko lwalwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, lwabazalwane ezinkundleni zokucwenga. Ngaleso sikhathi, indaba encane yaba yinkinga enkulu - iMpi yeMfecane, ethinta izizwe eziningi. Ngesikhathi sikaDinizulu, amaXhosa aqala ukufuna izindlela zokuzimela. U-Dinizulu waba ngumholi ophakeme, owagqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yomphakathi, kodwa ngenxa yokuncintisana, kwavela izimpi ezinzima. AmaXhosa abhekane nabantu abavela kwiNgilandi, okukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba wawuhlangene ngentando. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaXhosa akha izinkampani zomphakathi, ezathuthukiswa ngababengqongqozi nabanemisebenzi, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwamakhaya aqinile. Izinkambo zobungcweti zathuthukisa umfula wezinto ezivela kumamasiko amasha. Nokho, izinsuku ezinzima zikaJamaica nazo zafika, futhi kwavela ukuphikisana phakathi kwezinhlanga. Ucwaningo lwamaXhosa luhlale lukhuthaza ubuntu, kodwa ubuholi badinga ukwandisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Ngemuva kweMpi YamaNguni, amaXhosa abhekana nezinguquko ezibalulekile. Ubulunga bamaXhosa bukhula, kanti uhlelo olwakhiwa abanye lwalwandisa izihlahla zabo. Imisebenzi yokukhumbula iyaqhubeka, njengoba kubalulekile ukuveza izinkumbulo namasiko abo. Ukuveza ukuphila kwamaXhosa kubalulekile ukuze sihlale sithembekile ekuziloleni kwamaNguni. Uhlanga lwamasiko lwamaXhosa lwalubhekene nezinselelo ezahlukene, kodwa lwenziwa ngendlela yokubanga umhlaba. AmaXhosa agcina imikhuba neziqhamo ezijulile, esebenzisa izindlela zokuphila ezithile. Ubulawa bemikhiqizo bekuvuna impumelelo ezingeni. Izithakazelo zamasiko ezithile zamukelwa emnothweni nasemphakathini. Njengoba kudlula isikhathi, abantu bamaXhosa baqhubeka bephila impilo enempilo, bejabulile. Ukwazisa izinkumbulo zabo kubalulekile, njengoba kudinga imikhuba yamasiko yesikhathi eside. Ukwaziwa kwezinkumbulo zamasiko kunikeza umfanekiso obalulekile wamaXhosa, ubonisa ubufakazi bezinsuku ezedlule. Ubufakazi bukhona, futhi isikhathi sokuphila siqhubeka sikhanya. Ukwakhiwa kwamatraditions akhaliphile kudinga ukholo nolwazi olungapheli. AmaXhosa wayenolwazi olunzulu nokuthanda umhlaba abahlala kuwo. Ngakho, ubuhlakani nobuciko kwenza kube nempilo enhle. Izigidi zempilo zalezi zizwe zithokozisa, zikhanya kufaka izinkumbulo ezinamandla. Kulabo abafisa ukufunda ngamaXhosa nemvelaphi yabo, le ndaba ibalulekile ekucabangeni impilo yomphakathi. Ukuqonda imisebenzi yabo, izimpilo zabo zihlala phansi kwezimpande, futhi ukwenza izinhlelo ezisemqoka kusho ukuba nesibopho ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo nosizo. Lindela imiphumela ebushelelezi, ngaleso sikhathi amaXhosa ayaqhubeka aligugu lempilo. Ekuhlonipheni umlando wamaXhosa, kuhlanganiswe ubunikazi, izindawo, nezinsiza. Ubufakazi bomlando bukhomba ibhodi, futhi bazobaleka ngokuhambisana nezilimi, izinkumbulo nezinkolelo. Kuhlala kuyiqiniso ukuthi amaXhosa ayimfihlo enkulu yempilo eNingizimu Afrika, izithako zayo zikumlilo ogqamile wobuntu. Izoqhuba ubuciko bayo, iphakamisa izifiso ezintsha zobulungisa. Indaba yamaXhosa iyavuma ukufundwa, izalwa khona izinkumbulo, umkhankaso wokuhlonipha imisebenzi yawo emisha. Ngakho, izintaba zigoqe le ndaba ngezinkumbulo nemigenela yomlando, ukuze ubungani bamasiko buphumelele.
Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi (Home Affairs) waphakamisa umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nokusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwezinsiza online. Lo mcimbi wahlanganisa abaphathi, izisebenzi zomnyango, kanye nabanye abathintekayo ukuze baxoxe ngentuthuko nezinguquko ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, eziphephile, nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abafuna ukufaka izicelo zokuhlonza, izincwadi zokuhamba, kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezibalulekile. UMenenja Yezinsizakalo, uNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, uvule umcimbi ngenkulumo ebonisa ukubaluleka kokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Uhlelo lwe-online luhlinzeka ngendlela esheshayo yokusebenza, evumela abantu ukuthi benze izicelo zabo ngaphandle kokuvakashela ehhovisi, okunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda nezinkinga ezikhona emsebenzini wansuku zonke. Uhlelo luhlanganisa izinyathelo ezilula zokubhalisela i-akhawunti, ukufaka izicelo, nokulandela isimo sezicelo. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwephrojekthi, abahlanganyeli bakhuthaza ukusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-online, bejabulisa ngempumelelo yabo. Uhlelo luthuthukiswe ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu, futhi abathintekayo baphendule kahle, bekhombisa ukwaneliseka okukhulu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzimisela koMnyango Wezangaphakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngempumelelo emisebenzini ethile, efana nokubhaliswa kwezinsiza, izicelo zokuhamba, kanye nezincwadi zokuhlonza. Abantu banethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo online, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude lapho ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi kungase kube nzima. Umcimbi uqhubekile ngokwabelana ngempumelelo yokusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-online, lapho abathintekayo baphendula imibuzo ethile. Uhlelo luye lwakhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba basebenzise izinsizakalo ezitholakala online, okuveza ukuthi abantu bahlomula kulolu shintsho. Lokhu kuhlangene nemizamo yokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinye izinsizakalo, kuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo ezithinta ubuzwe, izincwadi zokuhamba, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuphumelela komcimbi, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi ubonisile ukuthi uzokwenza izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-online luhlala luthuthukiswa futhi luhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemqoka, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabo. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukwenza ukuphila kwabantu kube lula, kunciphise izithiyo ezikhona, futhi kuhlinzeke ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenziseka kalula. Umcimbi wokuqala ubufakazela ukuthi uMnyango Wezangaphakathi uyazimisela ukwenza ushintsho oluhle, oluhambisana nezidingo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umnyango uzobe uqhubeka nokuthuthukisa uhlelo, ubheke iziphakamiso nezidingo zabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zisesikhathini, zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhona kubo bonke. Umcimbi wokusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online ubufakazela ukuthi uMnyango Wezangaphakathi uyazimisela ukwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo, uthuthukise ukufinyelela, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abantu banelisekile. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba basebenzise izinsizakalo ezitholakala online, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabo. Ngokuqinisekile, uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngempumelelo emisebenzini ethile, futhi umcimbi wokuqala ubufakazela ukuthi uMnyango Wezangaphakathi uyazimisela ukwenza ushintsho oluhle, okuqhubeka nokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemqoka. Uhlelo luzoqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu, kuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo ezithinta ubuzwe, izincwadi zokuhamba, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi.
Umphakathi Wokuphatha: Umnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezamasiko, Nkk. Ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukuba lapha nomphakathi waseNdaka kule m事件 ebalulekile yokwethulwa ngokofficial kohlelo lokubuyisela isithunzi kubantu balendawo. Kuyakhuthaza ukuba yingxenye yoHulumeni ogcwalisa izibopho zawo nemigomo, kuhlanganise nendlela ehlelekile esiyithathayo yokubambisana nabantu bethu empini yokulwa nobuphofu. Umphathi Wohlelo, namuhla uzokhunjulwa yizizukulwane ezikhona nezizayo njengosuku olukhombisa ukuthathwa kwesinyathelo esisodwa sokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi waseNdaka. Njengelizwe nendawo, sikhuluma ngembali lapho iningi labantu bethu belingakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zabo eziyisisekelo ngenxa kombala wesikhumba sabo, besebenzisa izinhlelo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede, okungasusi kuphela isithunzi sabo kodwa futhi kube nezingozi zezempilo. Sisaqhubeka sikhala kakhulu ekunikezeni abantu bethu ukuhlinzekwa kahle kwezempilo, futhi lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezifana neNdaka lapho iningi labantu beliphathwa nguHulumeni wobandlululo njengabathakathi - bahlala lapha. UHulumeni wobandlululo wadala ukungalingani emphakathini, hhayi kuphela ngokobuhlanga kodwa futhi ekunikezeni izidingo eziyisisekelo zezempilo. Uzothola ukuthi umakhelwane oyedwa ophakathi komgwaqo unamanzi, ithoyilethi elihlanza, kanye nogesi, kanti omunye umakhelwane uhlala ngaphansi kwezimo eziphansi futhi engenayo imithombo yokuhlanza. Ngokucacile, le miphumela yokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo (ezinsizeni eziyisisekelo) ngendlela engalingani yadalwa ngenhloso nguHulumeni wobandlululo ukuze kuncishiswe isithunzi sabantu bethu. Njengoba singena ohlelweni lobumbano, sathi njengohulumeni bezakhamuzi sizibophezele ekulungiseni le miphumela. Umsebenzi wethu obalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izigidi zabantu ababeqedwa izidingo zabo bakwazi ukufinyelela kuzo futhi bazuze. Senze izinqumo eziningi kule ngqungquthela. Nokho, sonke savuma ukuthi indlela yokusebenza okufanele siyilandele njengohulumeni bendawo kufanele ibe yokubambisana ngqo. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sengqungquthela yethu. Siphinde savuma ukuthi lezi zinqumo zizolandela. Ngamanye amazwi, savuma ukuthi akufanele sibe nezingqungquthela nezinkulumo nje kuphela ukuze sikhulume futhi sikhulule imibiko. Savuma ukuthi sizolandela indlela yokusebenza eqondile emsebenzini wethu wokuhlinzeka ngezidingo njengohulumeni bendawo. Sihlangene lapha namuhla ukuze siqale olunye lwezinhlelo, olukhuthaza ukubambisana ngqo. Ngenkathi sixoxa ngendlela yokuhamba phambili mayelana nezinsizakalo ezibhekene nezinkinga njengoba kuboniswe engqungquthelweni, uhulumeni kazwelonke ubheke izindlela zokungenelela ezizokwenziwa esikhathini esifushane ukuze kusizakale izinsizakalo. Lapho kwavela khona iphrojekthi yokubambisana ngqo (Iphrojekthi Yokuhlanganisa). Iphrojekthi yokubambisana ngqo iyohlelo olubhekana nezinselelo ezibhekene nezinsizakalo ezweni lonke. Ngikhuluma ngama-136 ezinsizakalo ezitholakele ezweni jikelele ukuze zibambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Afrika idinga ngokuphuthumayo ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kube nemiphumela ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni zohulumeni bendawo nokwandisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zohulumeni kazwelonke, zendawo, nezokuhlinzeka ezindaweni ezibalulekile zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo (nokubambisana nazo). Ngamafuphi, uhlelo lokubambisana ngqo lugxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu ezingeni lendawo. Umkhandlu wendawo waseNdaka ungomunye wemikhakha etholekile ukuze ibambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuqinisa izinsiza zethu zomkhandlu. Njengohulumeni, sanquma ukuthi sidinga ukubambisana nezinsizakalo ngokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olungeziwe ukuze sikwazi ukusheshisa ukususa izithiyo ekunikezeni izinsizakalo. Iqiniso esikubone ukuthi ukungabi nolwazi nezakhono zobuchwepheshe kuyisizathu esisodwa sokuhamba kancane kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinsizakalweni zethu. Izinsizakalo ezifana neNdaka ziyizinsizakalo ezintsha ezibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuhlangana nezinsizakalo ezidalwe nguHulumeni wobandlululo emiphakathini. Ngenkathi bezama ukulungisa umonakalo owadalwa nguHulumeni wobandlululo, babhekana nezinselelo zokusebenza ngokuphelele ngenxa yokungabi nezakhono ezidingekayo phakathi kwezinye izinsizakalo. UHulumeni uthuthukise uhlelo oluzothuthukisa nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwemikhakha futhi luphinde lusize ekudluliseni izakhono ukuze kuqinisekiswe abantu. Nakuba okwedlule kuyingxenye yomlando wethu, akufanele sihlale sikhuluma ngempela mayelana nazo zonke izinkinga esibhekene nazo. Iqiniso ukuthi ukuqhubeka kokuphila kwezinhlelo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede eNdaka nakwezinye izindawo kule ndawo kuyisiphumo sokungabi khona kwezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ezifanele. Ngenkathi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngoxhaso ngaphansi kohlelo lokuxhasa izinsizakalo ukuze ahlinzeke ngezidingo eziyisisekelo, ezinye izinsizakalo zithola isimo lapho zikhungathekile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi lobuchwepheshe oludingekayo ukuze zenze lo msebenzi. Asikwazi ukuqhubeka sithola izaba; kumele sakhe amathuba okuthuthukisa izakhono ezidingekayo ukuze sihlinzeke ngezidingo ngokushesha emiphakathini yethu. Lezi zisengomunye wemikhakha esibhekene nayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuqhubeka kwethu emkhakheni wethu wesikhathi eside. Lokhu esikwenze namuhla lapha eNdaka kuyukungenelela ngqo ukuze kususwe zonke izithiyo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede ngokusebenzisa amathuba adalwe uhlelo lokubambisana ngqo. Lezi amathuba zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esengeziwe ezinsizakalweni esikhathini esifushane. Lolu hlelo lulethe ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi komkhandlu wendawo, umkhandlu wesifunda, nohulumeni wesifunda futhi lwenze kube nokukhululwa kwemali ngesikhathi esifushane. Konke lokhu kumela amasu amasha okufanele silandele futhi sifunde kuzo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi kuyagcinwa ekunikezeni izinsizakalo. Lokhu esikufundile kulolu hlelo lweNdaka kusinikeze isu lokusheshisa ukuxazulula izinsizakalo emiphakathini yethu. Ngamanye amazwi, ngilindele ukubona zonke izithiyo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede zisuswa emiphakathini kulandela lokho esikufundile lapha eNdaka. Lokhu esikwenze kulula kakhulu. Okokuqala, sahlinzeka ngezinkulumo phakathi kwezinsizakalo zendawo nezinsizakalo zesifunda mayelana nohlelo lokuhlanza amanzi olwakhiwe kulomphakathi lapha. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uhlelo lwezithiyo zokugeza ngebhakede aluhambisani nezindinganiso zezempilo nezokuphepha zabantu bethu. Akukho sizathu esinengqondo esinganikwa kulomphakathi sokuthi kungani bengakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini nasezitholeni zokugeza ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lo mphakathi uyazi ngamakhelwane angama-200 amamitha kude abangakwazi ukufinyelela
Iphrofayela kaSipho Mthethwa: Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi USipho Mthethwa ungumuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwabantu, oneminyaka engama-15 yokuhlangenwe nakho. Uthole iziqu zakhe zeBachelor of Commerce eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho aqala khona khona khona ukujula emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwabantu. U-Sipho ubelokhu ethanda ukufunda, futhi lokhu kumenze waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi. U-Sipho uqale umsebenzi wakhe njengomphakathi wezokuphathwa kwabantu enkampanini encane, lapho aqala khona ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezazihloselwe ukuthuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi. Ngaleso sikhathi, wathola ukuthi izinhlelo ezinhle zokuqeqeshwa zingathuthukisa kakhulu ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, zikhuthaze ubuhlakani, futhi zikhulise ukuzethemba. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni akhe izinhlelo ezintsha ezihlanganisa izifundo ezisemqoka, izinkulumo, kanye nezinye izindlela zokufundisa ezikhuthazayo. Ngemva kokusebenza kule nkampani, u-Sipho wathola ithuba lokusebenza enkampanini enkulu, lapho akwazi khona ukwandisa imisebenzi yakhe. Lapha, waphatha ithimba labaphathi, futhi waba nesandla ekwakheni uhlelo olusha lokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwenqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, eyayihlose ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, okwakuhlanganisa izifundo ezisemqoka, izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikwi-inthanethi, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikhuthazayo. U-Sipho waphinde waphakamisa imihlangano yokuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi, okwakwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho. Ukwaziwa kukaSipho emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwabantu kwaholela ekutheni abizwe ukuba abe yingxenye yezinhlelo ezinkulu zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono emazweni ahlukahlukene. Uhambo lwakhe lwezokufunda luhlanganisa izifundo emazweni ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa i-United Kingdom, i-United States, kanye nezinye izindawo ezithuthukile. Lokhu kumenze waba nesithakazelo esijulile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezithinta izidingo zamazwe ahlukahlukene, futhi waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomhlaba wonke. U-Sipho uphinde wakhuthaza izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokwabelana ngolwazi nokuhlangenwe nakho. Ubuye abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, ezibandakanya izinhlelo zokufunda ezithinta ubuchwepheshe obusha, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha isikhathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye abasebenzi bakwazi ukwandisa amakhono abo, futhi baqhubeke nokusebenza kahle emisebenzini yabo. U-Sipho uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe, kodwa uhlala eqonda ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa yedwa. Uhlala egcizelela ukubaluleka kokusebenza njengethimba, nokuthi ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi kubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza ephumelelayo. U-Sipho ubelokhu edlulisela le mfundiso kubo bonke abathintekayo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza ngokubambisana kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo yokusebenza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Sipho uqhubekile nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zakhe, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Uhlale eqaphela izinguquko emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwabantu, futhi uhlala efuna ukufunda nokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe. U-Sipho ungumholi onobuhlakani, ophumelelayo, futhi onothando lokuthuthukisa abanye, okwenza abe ngumuntu ophawulekayo emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwabantu. Njengoba eqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, u-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza ethuthukayo. Uhlale ebonisa ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi umgomo wakhe uwukuthi abanye baphumelele, baphumelele, futhi bahlale bephumelela. U-Sipho Mthethwa ungumholi ophumelelayo, futhi izinhlelo zakhe zokuqeqeshwa zikhombisa ukuthi ukutshala isikhathi nezinhliziyo emsebenzini wokuqeqesha abasebenzi kuyindlela eqinisekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Imicimbi Yomphakathi: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Ekukhuleni Komphakathi Emphakathini wethu, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile kakhulu. Lezi zenzakalo zikhombisa ubunye bethu, ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi zikhuthaza ukuhlanganyela. Ngiyavuma ukuthi imicimbi yomphakathi, njengemikhosi, izinkonzo, nemihlangano, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Ngokokuqala, imicimbi yomphakathi iyindlela yokuhlangana. Lapho abantu behlangana, baphila izikhathi ezinhle, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zanamuhla lapho abantu behlukaniswa kakhulu ngenxa yezobuchwepheshe. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buvumela abantu ukuba babe nesithakazelo esikhulu emiphakathini yabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobunye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni isiko. Izinkolo, imikhosi yamasiko, nemicimbi yokugubha izinsuku ezibalulekile zikhombisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Lezi zenzakalo zikhumbuza abantu ngezimpande zabo, ziqinisa isiko, futhi zifundisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Ngaphandle kwemicimbi, isiko lingase liphume emoyeni, futhi abantu bangase baphuthelwe ithuba lokwazi nokuhlonipha imvelaphi yabo. Ngokubheka emicimbini ethile, njengezinkonzo zomphakathi, sithola ukuthi zikhona izinzuzo eziningi. Lezi zenzakalo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho abantu bephila ngokuhloniphana. Imicimbi efana nezinsuku zokubonga, imikhosi yokuhlonipha abaphumelelayo, noma imihlangano yokuxoxisana ngezinkinga zomphakathi, zonke zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nesibopho emiphakathini yabo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Imicimbi yomphakathi ingaba nemiphumela emibi uma ingaphathwa kahle. Ukuhlukaniswa kwabantu, ukungaboni ngaso linye, noma ukungabi nendlela yokuxhumana kahle kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemicimbi. Kubalulekile ukuthi imicimbi ihlelwe ngendlela efanele, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe ebalulekile. Ukubandakanya wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, noma isimo somnotho, kubalulekile ukuze imicimbi ibe yimpumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imicimbi yomphakathi ingaba yithuba lokukhuthaza izinhlelo ezinhle. Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangase bakhe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, njengezinhlelo zokufundisa, izinhlelo zokwelapha, noma izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezemidlalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bephila kahle futhi bejabule. Ngokuphetha, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobunye, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuhlanganyela, sabelane ngezikhathi ezinhle, futhi sakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi imicimbi yethu ihlelwe kahle, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe ebalulekile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ongcono, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza emicimbini yomphakathi. Hlanganyela, thokozisa, futhi ube yingxenye yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Imicimbi yomphakathi akukhona nje kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi yindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga.
Izimemo ezikhethekile zeMhlaba, ikakhulukazi kuSihlalo weKomidi le-African Union, uMnu. Dumelang, sanibonani nonke emakhaya! Siyajabula ukuba nani kulolu suku olubalulekile. Ngimi phambi kwenu namuhla, eminyakeni engamashumi amabili kusukela uNelson Rolihlahla Mandela ekhishwa ejele. Sikhethe leli suku ukuze sikhulume ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile sokuhlangana kweZindlu ezimbili zePhalamende ukuze sikhulume ngesimo sezwe, ukuze sikhumbule lesi sikhathi esibalulekile esashintsha izwe lethu. Ukukhululwa kukaMadiba kwadalwa yizimpi ezinamandla zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Babebantu abaphetheke kahle kwezombusazwe nabalwi benkululeko abanjalo namuhla bangab witness kulokhu ngoba babe yingxenye yalolo hlelo. Niya khumbula ukuthi abantu baleli zwe, ngokusebenzisa izinhlangano zabo ezahlukene, baphendule ngokuqinile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izwe alizukuphathwa ngodlame nokuthi ubuhlanga abuzukuphumelela. Sijabula ngalolu suku nabantu ababephakathi kwezombusazwe ababevele bamenywa ukuba baziqhamuke. Sihalalisela ikakhulukazi labo abavela phesheya ukuze babe lapha, uHelene Pastoors, uMichael Dingake ovela eBotswana, uMnu. Andimba Toivo ya Toivo ovela kwiSwapo eNamibia. Siyajabula kakhulu ukuba nabantu beRivonia Trialists - uLord Joel Joffe oseLondon kanye noMphakathi Arthur Chaskalson. Siphinde sikhumbule futhi sihloniphe uMnu. Harry Schwarz, owashona ngesonto elidlule. Phakathi kwezinye izinto, wayengumuntu ophakathi kweqembu elimele abasolwa eRivonia. Sifisa ukubonga abangane bethu nabalingani bethu emhlabeni wonke ngokulwa nathi ukuze sifeze inkululeko. Sihalalisela ikakhulukazi umndeni kaMandela. Waba uphawu lokuzinikela kubaningi abathwele umthwalo wobuhlanga. Sihalalisela ubuholi beqembu elibusayo kanye nabalingani bethu empini, ngoba lokhu kuwumcimbi obalulekile. Kulolu suku olukhethekile, kufanele sikhumbule igalelo labantu ababephakathi kobuholi beNational Party, abaqonde ekugcineni ukuthi ubuhlanga abunayo ikusasa. Ngivumele ngikhulume ngendima edlalwe nguMongameli owayedlule uPW Botha. Yena wayengumuntu oqalise izingxoxo mayelana nokwenzeka kokukhululwa kwabantu abaphetheke kahle kwezombusazwe. UMongameli Botha wasebenza noNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho uMnu. Kobie Coetzee futhi wathola usizo kuDkt. Neil Barnard noMnu. Mike Louw. Kwakubuholi bakhe obuqinile, ukubona phambili, kanye nokucacisa umbono okwaholela i-ANC ekwandiseni ukufuna kwabo isixazululo esivunyelwene. Ubuqotho bakhe buphinde bavele ngesikhathi seHarare Declaration esikhuluma ngaso futhi wayesekela. Lokhu kwakuwukwakha isisekelo seziphakamiso ezibalulekile ezenziwe nguMongameli FW de Klerk eminyakeni engamashumi amabili edlule. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMongameli de Klerk wakhombisa isibindi esikhulu nobuholi ekwenzeni izinqumo. Kulolu suku olukhulu, kufanele ngiphinde ngibonge indima edlalwe nguNkk. Helen Suzman ongasekho nathi. Kwesinye isikhathi, wayenguyena kuphela ophakamisa izwi ePhalamende elwela ushintsho. Siphinde sibonge indima edlalwe nguMholi we-Inkatha Freedom Party, uMphakathi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, owayefuna ukukhululwa kukaMadiba, kanye nabanye abantu abaphetheke kahle kwezombusazwe kanye nokubuyiselwa kwabo ababephumile. Siphinde sibonge umphakathi womhlaba ngezinsizakalo zawo empini yethu. Ngokubambisana, singafeza okuningi. Njengoba lo nyaka uqhubeka, sizobe sikhumbula iminyaka engamashumi ayisithupha yokwakhiwa kweMpi yaseNingizimu Afrika, eyasungulwa ngo-1910. Ngakho-ke, ngibeka iminyaka esele yokuphila kwami ezandleni zenu." Izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS Kwakukhona umphakathi omncane, ogama lawo linguMahlathi, owawuhlala ezindaweni ezinhle, eziphilayo. Abantu baphila ngokubambisana, bejabulile, futhi bephokophele phambili. Kodwa, njengakwamanye amadolobha, bekukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uMnumzane Dlamini, umholi wendawo, wathola ithuba lokwazisa abantu ngohlelo olusha olwakhelwe ukusiza abantu abaningi, olwakhiwe yi-GEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-Government Employees Medical Scheme. UMnumzane Dlamini waqala ngenkulumo yakhe, echaza ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsiza yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni. "Nina nonke, ningabathintekayo kulolu hlelo," kusho yena, "kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sibe ne-GEMS." Abantu babebukele ngamehlo amakhulu, befuna ukwazi ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo zokuba ngamalungu. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi kuhle kube neziqu zokuqonda izinyathelo ezidingekayo. "Okokuqala," eqhubeka, "kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyasebenza kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba i-GEMS iyinsiza ethokozisayo kuphela kubasebenzi bakahulumeni." Abantu baphendula ngokuqonda, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe esisha sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngemuva kwalokho, uMnumzane Dlamini wakhuluma ngencwadi yokufaka isicelo. "Kumele uthole ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kungatholakala kwi-inthanethi noma ehhovisi le-GEMS eliseduzane. Qiniseka ukuthi ufaka yonke imininingwane efanele, njengeminyaka yakho, ubulili, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana." Abantu babebhalela phansi, beqonda ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zibalulekile ukuze baphumelele. Ngemva kokugcwalisa ifomu, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukufaka izincwadi ezidingekayo. "Kufanele ube nezincwadi ezikhombisa ubudlelwano bakho nomsebenzi, njengemibhalo yokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi i-GEMS iqinisekise isimo sakho." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngokwazi ukuthi izinyathelo zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi baphumelela. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, uMnumzane Dlamini waphinde wakhuluma ngokuqinisekisa isicelo. "Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, kuzodingeka ulinde isikhathi esithile ukuze uthole impendulo. I-GEMS izobuyekeza isicelo sakho, futhi uma konke kuhamba kahle, uzothola ubulungu." Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bejabulile ngalesi sithombe sokuba amalungu. Ukwengeza, uMnumzane Dlamini wakhuluma ngokuqonda izinzuzo zokuba ngamalungu e-GEMS. "Uma usungamalungu, uzothola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, ezifana nezibhedlela, odokotela, nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila impilo enempilo." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe esisha sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi abantu baphinde bahlale bexhumana ne-GEMS. "Kubalulekile ukuthi uqhubeke uxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole izibuyekezo, izinhlelo ezintsha, nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola konke okudingayo." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe sokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, uMnumzane Dlamini waphakamisa ukuthi abantu baphinde bahlale bephokophele phambili. "Nina nonke, ningabathintekayo kulolu hlelo. Qhubekani nisebenze kanzima, futhi nithole izinzuzo ezinhle ze-GEMS." Abantu babebonisa ukugqugquzela, bejabulile ngalesi sithombe sokuphila impilo enempilo. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi waseMahlathi wathola ithuba lokuba ngamalungu e-GEMS, futhi abantu baqala ukujabula ngokwazi ukuthi bazoba nezinzuzo eziningi zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu empilweni yabo, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula, uhlanganisa abantu ukuze baphile impilo enempilo.
Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Kuchazwa Ukwehluleka Kwama-Boiler AseMedupi Isingeniso Le doko ibheka ukwehluleka kwama-boiler aseMedupi, okuyingxenye ebalulekile yephrojekthi yeMedupi Power Station, eyakhiwe ngenhloso yokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kukagesi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukwehluleka kwama-boiler kubonisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ugesi, okungaholela ekunciphiseni kokukhiqizwa kukagesi, ukwanda kwezindleko, kanye nemiphumela emibi emnothweni. Uhlaka Lokuhlaziya 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwama-Boiler - Ukubuyekezwa kokwakhiwa kwama-boiler, okuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola, izinga lokwakhiwa, nezinsiza ezisetshenzisiwe. - Ukuhlaziywa kwezinkinga ezitholakele ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa, okuhlanganisa ukungahambisani nezindinganiso ezamukelekayo. 2. Ukusebenza Kwama-Boiler - Ukuhlola ukusebenza kwama-boiler, okuhlanganisa izinga lokusebenza, ukusebenza kahle, nezinkinga ezivamile. - Ukuhlaziywa kwezizathu zokwehluleka, okuhlanganisa izinkinga zokwakhiwa, izinsiza ezingalungile, nokungahambisani nezinhlelo zokusebenza. 3. Izizathu Zokwehluleka - Ukungahambisani nezindinganiso zomhlaba wonke zokwakha ama-boiler. - Ukungabi khona kokuhlola okuhlelekile nokuphathwa kwezinsiza. - Ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokugcina nokulungisa ama-boiler. 4. Imiphumela Yokwehluleka - Ukuncipha kokukhiqizwa kukagesi, okuholela ekwehleni kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. - Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokusebenza, okuhlanganisa izindleko zokulungisa nokugcina. - Umthelela emnothweni, okuhlanganisa ukwehla kwemali engenayo kuhulumeni. 5. Izinyathelo Zokulungisa - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlola nokuphatha ama-boiler. - Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokusebenza. - Ukubuyekezwa kwezinsiza ezisetshenzisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlangabezana nezindinganiso ezamukelekayo. Isiphetho Ukwehluleka kwama-boiler aseMedupi kubonisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinkinga aziphindi, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokwakha, ukusebenza, nokuphatha ama-boiler. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kokukhiqizwa kukagesi, ukunciphisa izindleko, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho wezwe. Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Imininingwane ethile mayelana nezinhlelo zokusebenza, izinqubo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ingatholakala kwiwebhusayithi esemthethweni yeMedupi Power Station noma ngokuxhumana ne-ofisi yephrojekthi. Ngaphambi kokwenza izinto zokuphindaphinda izitshalo zohlobo oluthile, njengoba kuchazwe nguMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezithombo, 1976, okungathengiswa eNingizimu Afrika, ukuhlela kwezinhlobo ezinjalo kumele kufake phakathi okulandelayo okutholakala kuwebhusayithi: Uhlu lwezinhlobo. UMbutho Wezolimo ugcina uhlu lwezinhlobo ezibalulekile zezitshalo ezahlukene zokulima nezithelo. Ukubika izitshalo ngenhloso yokuhambisana nomthetho nokufakwa kwazo ohlelweni lwezinhlobo zezitshalo kwenziwa ngohlelo lokufaka isicelo. Okulandelayo kubalulekile ukuhweba kwezinhlobo zezitshalo emnothweni weNingizimu Afrika. Noma ubani noma inhlangano ingafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa kwenhlobo. Inhlobo iyamukeleka ukufakwa ohlelweni lwezinhlobo uma ihlangabezana nezidingo zendlela ye-DUS ehlanganisa okulandelayo futhi uma inhlobo inegama elamukelekayo - imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kumphakathi, uma ungungumthuthukisi, inhlobo ekhethiwe noma ethuthukisiwe. Sicela uchaze embuzweni ukuthi iyiphi inhlobo okufanele iqhathaniswe nanoma yiziphi izinhlobo ezaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika, izinhlobo ezintsha kumele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kubonakale umehluko wazo. Imoto yeMirai, ethilekiwe nge-hydrogen, ibonisa ukuthi uToyota ungakha okuhlangenwe nakho okungcono ngendlela ebhekele ukwakhiwa kwemoto ehlala isidima. Le nto ibukeka njenge sikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi sizakhele ikamva elihle elisindayo endaweni yokuhamba. Ekuhlosweni kukaToyota, ukwakhiwa kwalezi zinto kuhlotshaniswa nendlela esikwazi ngayo ukufaka isandla esikhulu ezintweni ezenzeka emhlabeni. Ukuthokozisa abathandi bezimoto ezihlukahlukene ngoToyota kwaba nomthelela omuhle, kusiza ukwenza umkhiqizo wanamuhla ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni komnotho. Abantu bahlala behamba neToyota, behlela amaphupho, bekhanyisa izinkanyezi ezakha imiphumela emisha. Lo mcimbi ungumgcele opholile empilweni yeToyota, kuhlanganiswe ngothando olukhona ezithuthwini nasemagcekeni aphephile. Imigubho ebalulekile iqoka abesifazane nabesilisa ngokukhalipha kwezifundo zamaholide, kuqhubeka kuvezwe intuthuko enkulu ekuklanyweni kwezindawo zokuhlala nezokuhamba. Kwakuyigugu ukwazi ukukwenza kahle, ubuhle besigcawu sithokozisa abathandi bezimoto ngokungaphezu kokuhamba ngebhodi le-mobility. Ekugcineni, uToyota uhlala uyisikhumbuzo esihle sokwakha inguquko. Ubusuku obuhlalayo bugubuze umqondo wezemathupha, ubufakazi bokuthi uToyota ungumkhiqizo ogcwele ukuzethemba, ubuchwepheshe nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezizukulwana ezizayo. Umcimbi wenhlangano yeToyota uyisikhumbuzo esihlukile sokwanelisa izidingo zabantu, ubufakazi bokuthi izinkanyezi zesikhathi sethu zithokozisa uma sizithokozisa ngezimoto ezilungisa ukuphila kwethu. Ngakho, uToyota ubalulekile, hhayi kuphela eziteshini, kepha nohlanga lwempilo emhlabeni jikelele, ubufakazi bokuthi isiphakamiso singashintsha impilo yabantu ngendlela eyinkimbinkimbi nehlelekayo.
Impilo Yasemakhaya: Izifundo Nezinselelo Zokuphila Emzaneni Impilo yasemakhaya, ibonisa isiko elijulile nelimnandi, ithinta izigidi zabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Kulezi zindawo, impilo ithathwa njengokuhlala emkhayeni, lapho ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu buphakanyiswa khona. Kanjalo, impilo yasemakhaya ibonisa izifundo ezinzulu ezithinta imvelo, ubudlelwano, kanye nezindlela zokuphila. Uhlanga lwemvelo lwemakhaya luthinta impilo yomuntu. Abantu bahlala eduze kwemithombo yemvelo, befunda ukuphila ngokuhleleka nokuhlanganyela. Umphakathi uvame ukuhlela izinhlelo zokulima, ezokuthutha, nezokwelapha, lapho umphakathi wonke uhileleka khona. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya ibalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile. Abalimi, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bahlala bephokophele ukwakha umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukulima akusikho kuphela ukudla, kodwa futhi kuwumthombo wezimali nezinsiza. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, impilo yasemakhaya ibhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukushoda kwemithombo yokuxhumana nemfundo kuyasondela ekuphileni kwabantu. Abantwana abaningi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezikoleni ezinhle, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinselelo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezanele, njengamakhaya amasha nemitholampilo, kuyasiza ekutheni abantu bahlale behlupheka. Ngokubheka izindlela zokuphila, impilo yasemakhaya iyashintsha. Imininingwane ethile ibonisa ukuthi abahlali baye bacela izindlela zokuphila ezivamile, hamba phambili. Imikhiqizo yendabuko iyathandwa, kodwa ngokuya phambili, imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu edinga ubuchwepheshe iyathandwa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi abantu basemakhaya baye bahlale bephokophele ukuhambisana nezimo ezishintshayo zomhlaba. Ukwakha ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi yempilo yasemakhaya kubalulekile. Abantu basemakhaya bahlale bephokophele ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi impilo iyahlobene kakhulu nokuhlanganyela, futhi abantu bahlala bexhumana ukuze bangaphuthelwa yizinto ezibalulekile. Ubuqotho, ukusizana, nokuhlanganyela kwempilo, kudala umoya ovumelanayo phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukugcina izindlela zomdabu, ukuze kuhlonishwe isiko. Umphakathi uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni ezithinta umculo, imidlalo, nezamasiko, okwenza impilo yasemakhaya ibe mnandi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bahlala bephokophele ukugcina ubuhlobo nemvelo, futhi lokho kuhlobene kakhulu nezindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko ezithinta izindawo zemakhaya ziba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ukukhula kwemizi, ukwanda kwezizinda, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kunciphisa izinselelo ezithinta impilo yasemakhaya. Kodwa-ke, abahlali bahlale bephokophele ukwakha izindlela ezizokwazi ukuthuthukisa izimo zempilo yabo, ukuze baphile kahle. Njengoba abahlali begcina izimpilo zabo, kuhlezi kubalulekile ukuba bahloniphe izimo ezithinta impilo yasemakhaya. Ukufunda, ukuzimela, nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile kubalulekile ukuze impilo yasemakhaya iphumelele. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi abantu bahlala bephokophele ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezihamba phambili nezamasiko, ukuze impilo yasemakhaya ibenokuthula, uthando, nokuphumelela. Ekugcineni, impilo yasemakhaya ibalulekile, ibusa izifundo ezibalulekile kubantu bakuleso sikhathi. Ukukhuthaza umoya wobudlelwano, imfundo, neziqu zokuphila, kubalulekile ukuze impilo yasemakhaya ihlale isebenza kahle. Njengoba abahlali bephokophele ukuhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi umphakathi, imvelo, nezindlela zokuphila zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono emakhaya.
Ezokuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuqonda Nokubaluleka Kwezokuphatha Izimali Ezinzile Ngomhlaba ogcwele izinselelo zezimali, ukuphathwa kwezimali sekuyinto ebalulekile kubantu nababhizinisi. Ukuze ufinyelele impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izimali, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukulawula, kanye nokuhlaziya izimali. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho, ukuze kube nokuphathwa kwezimali okunempumelelo, okungaholela ekukhuleni nasekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ukuhlela Izimali Ukuhlela izimali kubalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kukhuluma ngempilo yomuntu siqu noma ibhizinisi. Umuntu noma ibhizinisi kufanele bazi ukuthi bangakanani imali abayitholayo, nokuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani ukuze bafeze izinhloso zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izindleko, ukugcina imali, nokubeka imigomo ethile yokonga. Ukuhlela kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izindleko ezingagwenywa, nokuthi zingaki izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukulawula Izimali Ngemuva kokuhlela, kulandela ukulawula izimali. Lokhu kusho ukuqapha izindleko, ukugcina amarekhodi, nokuhlola ukuthi izimali zisetshenziswa kanjani. Ukulawula kahle izimali kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukhona okuphuma ngaphandle kokulawulwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezingase zivele, futhi kuvumele umuntu noma ibhizinisi ukuba benze izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze bagweme izinkinga zezimali. Ukusebenzisa amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokuphatha izimali kungasiza kakhulu kulokhu. Ukuhlaziya Izimali Ukuhlaziya izimali kubalulekile ukuze uqonde kahle isimo sezimali. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi izimali zisetshenziswa kanjani, nokuthi zikhona yini izindlela ezingcono zokuphatha izimali. Ukuhlaziya izimali kungasiza ekutholeni amathuba okwandisa inzuzo noma ukunciphisa izindleko. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi kumabhizinisi, lapho ukunciphisa izindleko kungaholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Izindlela Zokuphatha Izimali Ezinzile Kukhona izindlela eziningi zokuphatha izimali ezinokusebenza okuhle. Enye yezindlela ezivame ukusetshenziswa yindlela yokonga. Ukuze ufinyelele ezingeni elithile lokuphila, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo wokonga, futhi lokhu kungasiza ekwakheni isikhwama sokuphila esingaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi ukuhlela izindleko zabo ngesikhathi sokuphila kwabo, kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuphila ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphakeme. Ubuchwepheshe Ezokuphathwa Kwezimali Ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhona emhlabeni wezokuphathwa kwezimali. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zezimali, izinhlelo zokuphatha izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokulawula izindleko ziye zashintsha indlela abantu nababhizinisi abaphatha ngayo izimali. Lezi zinhlelo zenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokuhlaziya izimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye buvule amathuba amasha, njengokuthengiswa kwezimali kwi-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba nokuphatha izimali. Ukubaluleka Kwezemfundo Kwezokuphathwa Kwezimali Ukufundiswa kwezokuphathwa kwezimali kubalulekile. Abantu kufanele bafunde izisekelo zokuphatha izimali ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi izimali zisebenza kanjani. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufunda ngezindlela zokonga, izinhlelo zokutshala izimali, nokuhlola izinketho zokubolekwa kwemali. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo kahle, kubalulekile ukuba neziqu ezisemthethweni noma ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kwezokuphathwa kwezimali. Izinselelo Zokuphathwa Kwezimali Noma kunjalo, ukuphathwa kwezimali akuhlali kulula. Izinkinga ezifana nokungabi nalwazi, ukungabi nezinqumo ezinhle, kanye nezimo zomnotho ezingalindelekile zingaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zezimali. Abantu nababhizinisi kufanele bakwazi ukubhekana nalezi zinsolo, futhi bazi ukuthi izinqumo ezinzima zingathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali zihlala ziphila. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuphathwa kwezimali kuyisici esibalulekile sokuphila kwethu. Ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokuhlaziya izimali kubalulekile ukuze sifeze izinhloso zethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala buhamba phambili ekuphathweni kwezimali, futhi ukufundiswa kwezokuphathwa kwezimali kuyadingeka ukuze sithole ulwazi olufanele. Njengoba siqhubeka nezinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuba siqhubeke sifunda nokuthuthukisa amakhono ethu kwezokuphathwa kwezimali ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo engcono.
Izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS I-GEMS, okuyiGrootte Excellent Medical Scheme, iyinsiza ebalulekile yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo kubantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ekuqaleni kokufaka isicelo sobulungu, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulandela yonke imiyalelo edingekayo. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukusiza abafake izicelo ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Ukuqala, kufanele uqonde ukuthi ubulungu be-GEMS bukhuluma ngokuqala isibhakabhaka sokuzuza izinsiza zezempilo ezikhokhelwayo. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi ubalulekile. Njengomfaki-sicelo, ungabhalisela ubulungu obuhlukene, kuhlanganisa obuvamile, obunikezela ngezinsiza ezikhethekile, nokunye okuningi. Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuvumelanisa idokhumenti yakho, okubalulekile ekufakeni isicelo. Isinyathelo sokuqala sokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS ukuqinisekisa ukuthi unemibhalo ethile edingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa identifikasheni yakho, njenge-ID noma ipasipoti, kanye nemininingwane ethile mayelana nezomnotho, njengemali yakho engenayo kanye nezinsizakusebenza zakho. Kungenzeka futhi udinge ukufaka imininingwane ethile ngezinhlelo zezempilo ozithandayo, uma usushintsha isikhwama sokuqashisa noma ulungisa ulwazi olukhona. Uma zonke izincwadi zakho zilungile, umphakathi kufanele uqale ukufaka isicelo online, usebenzisa iwebhusayithi ye-GEMS. Le nqubo ihlaliswe kahle ukuze ?aqinisekise ukuthi kunobuchule bokupa usizo ngokushesha. Uma ungazi kahle indima ethile, uzothola izikhumbuzo ezinsizayo ezisuka ekhasini lewebhu, okwenza kube lula ukukulandela. Njengoba ulandela lezi zinyathelo, kubalulekile ukuthi uqaphele ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula singahluka, ngakho-ke kufanele ulinde ngezinyanga ezithile ukuze uthole ukuphendula. Lokhu kuzokuthola uhambisana nemihla ethile ethile yokuhlola isicelo sakho. Uma ungenalwazi uthola iziphakamiso, ungabiza emkhakheni wezinsizakalo ukuze ufune ulwazi oluningi. Lapho urhoxisa izinkanyezi ngaleli su, kubalulekile ukuba, uqinisekise nezinsiza zakho uma ubona engathandeki, ukuze ungaphezi izindleko ezingalindelekile. Ukulandela izinqubo ezilungile kuzosiza kakhulu ekupheleni kwesicelo sakho, ukuze umphakathi ezimpilweni zakho ube ngumphefumulo ofanelekileyo kulesi sikhathi. Uma isicelo sakho sivunyelwe, uzothola i-akhawunti yakho ye-GEMS ivuliwe, futhi kulokhu, uzoqondiswa ekusetshenzisweni kwayo. Uzoqonda izinzuzo ezitholakalayo, imishanguzo, nezinhlelo ezihlangene. kuyotholakala izinkomba ezinzima ukuze uqhamuke nemithombo yezempilo ezikhethekile engaphokophela kumaphuzhu nezinye izithuthi. Ukwazi ukuthi ungabhalela uhlelo lweGEMS, ungasithola isixhumi esisodwa, sangaphambili futhi sishintsha indlela yokuphila komphakathi, sigcwalisa impilo enhle. Kungani, ekufakeni isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS, izinyathelo ezihlekisayo, ezingaqinile, nezikhiqizayo zenza kube lula ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ukuphothula lesi sikhumbuzo, singasho ukuthi ukulandela izinqubo zokufaka isicelo sobulungu be-GEMS kudinga ukubekezela, kodwa uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilula, uzofinyelela kalula ezinzuzweni eziyigugu ezihlinzekwa yi-GEMS. Ngakho-ke, cwaninga kahle, hamba kahle, futhi ulinde kahle ukuze uthole okuhle okuhlanganyela ngokuphelele nezinsizakalo zeGEMS ezikufanele.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhloselwe ukuphakamisa abalimi abamnyama ngokubaphelela amandla okukhulisa ukudla ngendlela ehlangene nezomnotho. Lolu hlelo luwuhambo lokugcina lokukhiqiza kwezomnotho. Wonke amaphrojekthi ahlukene ohlelweni lwethu ahlose ukufinyelela ukukhiqiza kwezomnotho - izifundo zoktraining zabalimi, ukuhlolwa kokubonisa, izinsuku zabalimi, ukwakha ubudlelwano, umncintiswano wabalimi boNyaka, uHlelo Lwabalimi Abasebenza Kahle, izifundo zoktraining, ukusakazwa kwezimvo, kanye nePula/Imvula. Umulimisi kufanele abe nezindawo ezivundlile ezingakhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo, futhi kufanele kube nezinye izindawo lapho efisa khona ukwandisa imisebenzi yakhe kuze kube sekukhiqizeni ama-ton angu-250. (Usayizi wezindawo kufanele uqinisekiswe, kodwa akukhathalekile ukuthi umulimisi uyazipha, uyazithenga, noma usebenzisa izindawo ezisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke). Uma kungenzeka, sifuna umulimisi asebenze njengomuntu oyedwa, hhayi njengeqembu. Sibone ukuthi uma abantu abaningi bephuma ndawonye, njengamaqembu, akusebenzi kahle ngoba abantu abahlangani. Bese bengaqhubeki nemisebenzi yokukhiqiza kahle. Kumele babe nezithuthuthu nezinsiza. Kunzima ukuba umulimisi wezomnotho ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezanele.
