(Ngezinye izikhathi kungaba kuhle ukuthola umthengisi wezolimo nokuvuna, kodwa kungcono ukwenza yonke imisebenzi uqobo). Umulimisi kufanele abe yilungu leqembu lokufunda futhi kufanele abekhona ezifundweni ezintathu noma ezine zeGrain SA. Amaqembu okufunda anikeza abalimi ulwazi mayelana nezolimo nokukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo. Izifundo zoktraining nazo ziyasiza ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, bese kufanele baxhaswe epulazini ukuze basebenzise lolwazi. Umulimisi kufanele abe nenhloso yokulima, ukufunda, nokwamukela umyalezo. Ukuba umkhiqizi wokudla okuyisisekelo kudinga ugqozi oluqhubekayo; sibone ukuthi abalimi abaningi abangakhethi ukulima ngaso sonke isikhathi abaphumeleli. Ukuthuthukisa umulimisi ukuba abe umulimisi wezomnotho kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kudinga imali eningi - akusizi ukuchitha leyo mali kumulimisi ongenalo ugqozi mayelana nezolimo. Uma umulimisi engenayo imali eyanele yokulima ngaphandle kwesikweletu, kufanele abe nezimpahla ezingaqinisekisa isikweletu sokuqala ukulima (umthetho omusha wesikweletu (NCA) wenza kube nzima ukuthola isikweletu, bese abalimi bengakwazi ukuqhubeka nokulima). Kungaba kuhle ukuba nezinye izinkampani ezingakha imali, kodwa sifuna umulimisi abe njalo ekhona epulazini. Asisebenzi nomnikazi wepulazi ongakabi epulazini.
iShoprite Isingeniso I-Shoprite, okuyisikhungo esikhulu sokuthengisa ukudla nemikhiqizo ehlukene, sithathwa njengomphakathi omkhulu emkhakheni wezokuthengiselana eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1979, futhi kusukela lapho, ibe yinsika emnothweni wezohwebo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi. I-Shoprite inikezela ngezinketho eziningi zomkhiqizo, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izimpahla zansuku zonke, nezinsiza, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende ahlukeneyo. Uhlaka lwezikhungo ze-Shoprite I-Shoprite inezitolo eziningi ezikhona emadolobheni nasemaphandleni, okuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuthenga ezithokozisayo kumakhasimende. Isitolo ngasinye sisezingeni eliphezulu, sinesikhala esanele sokuhamba, futhi sithokozisa amakhasimende ngokubukeka kwaso okuhle. Ukwaziwa kwe-Shoprite akugcinanga ezitolo zayo, kodwa futhi naku-inthanethi, lapho amakhasimende angathenga khona kalula futhi athumele imikhiqizo emakhaya abo. Izinsizakalo Nezinto Ezitholakalayo I-Shoprite inikeza uhla olubanzi lwezinto ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imikhiqizo yokudla efana nezinhlanzi, inyama, imifino, nezithelo, kanye nemikhiqizo yokuhlobisa, imikhiqizo yezempilo, nezinsiza zansuku zonke. Ukuphathwa kwemikhiqizo kuhlinzekwa ngokucophelela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakhasimende athola imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Shoprite inezinhlelo zokuthenga ezikhethekile, ezifana nezaphulelo ezikhethekile, ezisiza amakhasimende ukuthi akwazi ukuthola imikhiqizo ngentengo engcono. Ubuchwepheshe obusha Ngokubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyashintsha, i-Shoprite isebenzisa izinhlelo zakamuva zokulawula imikhiqizo, ukubala izinzuzo, nokuphathwa kokuthengisa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusetyenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphrinta, izinhlelo zokuphatha impahla, kanye nezinsizakalo zokukhokha ezisheshayo. Ukwazi ukunikeza izinsizakalo eziphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zamakhasimende, futhi i-Shoprite ibonakala iqashelwa kakhulu kulokhu. Ukwazisa Ngezinto Ezinobuchwepheshe Ngaphezu kwemikhiqizo, i-Shoprite ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwazo ezempilo yomphakathi. Iphinde ibambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokukhuthaza impilo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezindlela zokupheka eziphilile, izinto ezitholakalayo ezikhiqizwayo ngendlela enempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lokudla. I-Shoprite ibuye ibhekelele izidingo zempilo zomphakathi ngezinqubo zokuthenga ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Umthelela Emphakathini I-Shoprite ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo, kodwa ibuye idlale indima enkulu emiphakathini lapho ikhona. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuthenga, i-Shoprite iyasiza ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ithuthukisa umnotho wendawo, futhi ibamba imicimbi yokuxhumana nemiphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi udinga izinsiza ezithile ukuze uqhubeke uphila kahle. Izingozi Nezinselelo Nokho, njengazo zonke izinkampani, i-Shoprite ibhekene nezinselelo. Ukuncintisana okujulile emakethe yokuthengisa, izinguquko emthethweni, kanye nemithetho yokuphatha imikhiqizo kungenza kube nzima ukuhlala phezulu. Ukuphendula kulezi zingozi, i-Shoprite ihlale ibhekelela izinqumo zayo, ikhulisa izinsizakalo zayo, futhi izama ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezihamba phambili. Isiphetho I-Shoprite iyinkampani ebalulekile emkhakheni wezokuthengisa eNingizimu Afrika, inikezela ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile kumakhasimende. Ngendlela eyenza ngayo izinqumo, ibambisene nomphakathi, futhi ithuthukisa imikhiqizo, ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili nolwazi olukhulu emkhakheni. Njengoba iqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Shoprite ibhekelele izinguquko ezisemqoka nezidingo zamakhasimende ukuze iqhubeke nokuziphatha kahle. Ukubeka i-Shoprite kwicala elihle, kubalulekile ukuthi ihlale ibhekelelwa izidingo zomphakathi, ibhekelele umnotho, futhi iqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi bayo.
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhaliswe lapha ezweni, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano esemthethweni ebhaliswe eNingizimu Afrika angafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ukubhaliswa kwesicelo esishiwo ngeke kuhluke kulwazi nezinsuku ezamukelwe kumamaki noma kuphakeji futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela kuMlawuli. Imigomo ebekwe ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa kumele ilandelwe; ukubhaliswa okukhulunywa ngakho ngeke kudluliselwe kwezinye usayizi lwezimpahla noma iziqukathi futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela kuMlawuli. Isicelo sokubhaliswa kokudla kwezilwane kanye nefertilizer kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumabhalisi noma kumuntu ophumelele ukumelwa kumabhalisi. Igama lomkhiqizo, inombolo yokubhaliswa uma umkhiqizo ubhalisiwe, isizathu sokufaka isicelo, incwadi yokuvuma uma imvume idingeka kumabhalisi, inani lemali okufanele likhokhwe, ama-check athunyelwe ngokwehlukana angahambisani nesicelo kumele ahambisane nencwadi yokuchaza, isitifiketi sokuhlaziywa, noma ishidi ledatha. Amafomu esicelo kumele athunyelwe ukuze kufakwe izicelo ezintsha kanye nezichibiyelo zokubhaliswa okukhona, kuhlanganise nezinguquko zokwakheka; thumela amafomu amabili, ugcwalise ifomu ngokuphelele, ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, inombolo yephasi, noma emikhiqizweni eminye. Omunye angaba ikhophi. Umuntu ophumelele ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ophatha ubudlelwano nenkampani kanye noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu esicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa yomkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi ushintsho, noma ngabe luncane kangakanani, luzobhekwa njengokuchibiyela. Thumela amafomu esicelo ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuthumela amafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzophula isikhathi ngokulibazisa inqubo. Thumela kabili, bhala ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akukho sidingo sokuba namamaki aphrintiwe ngalezi zilimi ezimbili. Kumele abhalwe kahle; kulandela ifomethi efanele, ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezikhombisweni zokuphepha; yonke imininingwane kumamaki kumele ihambisane ngokunembile nalokho okunikeziwe kufomu lesicelo. Ukubhaliswa kwefertilizer kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.
Ukuntuleka KweMisebenzi emiphakathini YaseMakhaya Emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuyinkinga ebalulekile, ethinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Lokhu kungenxa yezizathu eziningi ezihlanganisa ukushoda kwezinsiza, ukuntuleka kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa, kanye nezinguquko ezibalulekile emnothweni. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akuwona umkhuba omusha; kudala sekukhona abantu abaningi besebenza emakhaya abahamba beshaya imikhawulo ngenxa yokungabi namathuba afanele okuhweba. Kulesi sihloko, sizoxoxa ngokubaluleka kokuxazulula le nkinga, izizathu ezibangela le miphumela, nokuthi singathuthukisa kanjani umnotho wethu emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akuhambisani nje nokungabi khona kwezinsiza, kodwa kubonisa futhi ukungabi nalwazi nokufaneleka ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Abantu abaningi basemakhaya bacindezelwe ngemikhuba ethile yokufunda, eyenza kube nzima ukuba baqonde izidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuthi bahlale bephakathi kwezikhala zomsebenzi, behluleka ukuhweba ngezifundo zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokufunda ziguqulwe ukuze zifundise abantu amakhono adingekayo emnothweni wanamuhla. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuholela ekwandeni kokuhlupheka. Abantu abangenamsebenzi bahlala bezama ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo, kodwa bahluleka ukwenza lokho. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongenamkhawulo lapho kuvela khona izinkinga eziningi ezifana nokuntuleka kwemali, izindlu, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila. Ukuze siqedele lesi simo, kudingeka ukuba imiphakathi ibambisane, ibheke izixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya zidinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni. Uhlelo lokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane lungase lube yisisombululo esikhulu. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo, kungaba yindlela yokunika amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni komnotho, okuthinta kahle ukusimama kwezimali zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhasa, njengokunikeza imali yokwakha amabhizinisi, ukuqeqesha abantu, nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhweba. Kodwa-ke, akusikho konke okuphathelene nemali. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kukhuliswe umqondo wokusebenza ngamahora amaningi. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kanye nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngolwazi lokusebenza kufanele zikhuthazwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni futhi kuvule amathuba angcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngokubaluleka kokufaka izinhlelo zemvelo ezithuthukisa imisebenzi. Izinhlelo zokulima eziqhubekayo, ukuvuselela amabhizinisi emvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza, zingaba yizixazululo ezinhle. Lokhu akukhulisi nje umnotho, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ozinikele, onempilo, nezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisana kakhulu, befinyela emathubeni angcono. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokugcina izinsiza zethu zemvelo. Ukulima ngendlela efanele, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela esebenzayo, nokuhlonipha imvelo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imiphakathi yasemakhaya ikwazi ukuhlala izinzile, ikwazi ukuphila ezindaweni eziphilayo, futhi ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimo zayo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya akuyona nje inkinga yomphakathi, kodwa kuyinkinga ethinta wonke umuntu. Ukuxazulula le nkinga kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nohulumeni. Kumele sihlose ukwakha umnotho osebenzayo, onempilo, futhi ozinikele, ukuze sizuze izinzuzo eziningi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzosisiza ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile, engakhathazeki, futhi elwela impilo engcono. Ngakho-ke, asithathe izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile emiphakathini yasemakhaya.
UMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe nguHulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezilungelo zakhe, futhi umthetho kazwelonke kufanele udalwe ukuze ulethe umphumela kulolu lungelo. I-Information Regulator yasungulwa ukuze inikeze izeluleko kuMphathi Wolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphathi Osenhliziyweni mayelana nezicelo zolwazi futhi ikwazi ukusiza uMphathi Wolwazi kanye nezikhungo ezifanele mayelana nokucubungula izikhalazo. Amakomidi amancane okweluleka ngolwazi (IAASC's) nawo asungulwa ukuze anikeze izeluleko kuMphathi Osenhliziyweni mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. Ihhovisi lolwazi leMnyango Wezokuvikela lasungulwa njengesisekelo sokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Ihhovisi lolwazi lizosisiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalungu omphakathi ukuthi abone isithombe noma uhlobo lwezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi ifaka izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulwazi nezincwadi nokuthi zikhona yini. Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwenhlangano, ukuphepha kwezifunda nezendawo ngokulandela amakhono nezobuchwepheshe bokuphepha abukhali, besimanje futhi abafinyeleleka kalula. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inezibopho zokuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule nenempumelelo kubo bonke. Iphinde isekele noma yisiphi isikhungo sikahulumeni esihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela iqukethe uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uMphathiswa Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumlawuli ophakeme, uMphathiswa Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophethe ukusebenza kwezezimali zeMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti uMphathi Wezokuvikela unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha nokuphatha iNhlangano Yezokuvikela. Ihhovisi lolwazi leMnyango Wezokuvikela lizophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umgcinim records kanye nehistori yeMnyango Wezokuvikela unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina amarekhodi nehistori. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), kanye nemithetho ethile, nezikhombisi ezithunyelwe kuzo zonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphathelene nezokuphepha kwenhlangano kanye nokuhola umkhombandlela wenqubomgomo yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, ukuqapha, nokwamukela inqubomgomo, isu, nezinhlelo zokuphepha ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo kazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuphezulu, okuphumelelayo, nokuziphatha kahle kwezokuphepha. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. UMsunguli ungumholi weMisebenzi efanayo kanye nosizo lwabantu abahluphekayo. Ukuphatha nokubheka iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ukuze kusekelwe ukuvikelwa komhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngemicibisholo mayelana nenqubomgomo yokuvikelwa komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwezempi ngokuhambisana nosizo oluhambisanayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ukuze kusekelwe nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula umkhombandlela wenqubomgomo yokwelashwa kwezempi nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina usizo lwezempilo olubalulekile kubalimi beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincwadi zabo noma labo abaxhaswe ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zosizo nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe lokuvikela nolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina usizo lwezobuchwepheshe emkhakheni wezokuvikela, usizo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezokusebenza. Ukuhola umsebenzi wabasebenzi kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubantu bezempi abakhathalela bonke amalungu eMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezincwadi zabo futhi kuthuthukiswe ukukhula kokomoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngemicibisholo evela kwezempi. Ukuhlinzeka nginqubomgomo yokuxhumana kwezokuvikela, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo yeMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nenqubomgomo yokuxhumana kazwelonke (GCIS) futhi isebenza njengesisekelo sokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo, okuphumelelayo, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nababambiqhaza bawo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olusemthethweni, olugunyaziwe, nolusekela ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukusiza iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono kwezobudlelwano bamazwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngamakhono nezindlela zamaphoyisa kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yobungcweti ukuze kuvinjwe futhi kudalwe amathuba okufunda ngokusebenza. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo okungahlangene nokulwa kumuntu ngamunye weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekuthumeleni kolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi kusekela izinhloso zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Uhlu lwezincwadi (theses) ezigcinwe yiHhovisi Lezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela (Uhlu lutholakala eHhovisi Lezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela). Amarekhodi akhona ezinqolobaneni zeMnyango Wezokuvikela aqala ngo-1912 lapho i-Union Defence Force (UDF) yasungulwa. Amarekhodi akhona ezinqolobaneni kusukela eminyakeni ka-1912 kuya ku-1969 akhombisa imisebenzi eyinhloko yezingxenye zonke ze-UDF kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SADF). Imisebenzi emikhulu ihlobene nokusungulwa, ukuphathwa, kanye nezici zobuchwepheshe bezokusebenza kwezempi futhi iphinde ibheke ezimweni ngesikhathi sokulwa nangesikhathi sokuthula. Amarekhodi okwenziwa afaka ulwazi mayelana nokubamba kwaseNingizimu Afrika kwiMpi Yezwe I (1914 - 1918) kanye neMpi Yezwe II (1939 - 1945), iBerlin Airlift (1948 - 1949), kanye neMpi yaseKorea (1950 - 1953) kanye nokusungulwa kwempi nezivivinyo ngesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kwangaphakathi ezweni njengeziteleka
Ukhuluma ngokuzithoba nangokuhlonipha, ekholelwa ukuthi ukusebenza ngezimpawu zesiNtu ezintsha: 'kwakuyinto emangalisayo engakaze yenzeke empilweni yakhe. Ngokungivumela ukuthi ngidale lezi zithombe, kukhona ukuhlonipha okukhulu kwelakhe elinikeze lokho. UMametja usebenza njengomklami wezimboni e-CSIR ePitoli. Uhlala eKempton Park nomkakhe nezingane ezimbili. UGareth Smart usungule igama lakhe njengomklami ezintweni eziningi kusukela eqedile i-BA yakhe yokuklama eMidrand Graduate Institute of Higher Education. Izifundo abazinikele kuzo zikhombisa ubude, ububanzi, nob depth bezithombe. Iphothifoliyo yakhe ikhombisa uhlu olunembile lwamakhasimende ezinkampani asebenze nawo ngesikhathi esifushane. Kaye, 'kwakuyithuba eliyingqayizivele' lokukhethwa ukuba aklame uphawu olusha lwezizwe. Uhlala ePitoli lapho ebhekana nezidingo zamakhasimende njengomklami, umenzi wemodeli, nokukhombisa umqondo ophathelene nokuthile okuzimele. Uqinisekisa ukuthi noma ubani unelungelo lokusebenzisa ulimi lwabo nokubandakanyeka empilweni yamasiko abawathandayo (Isigaba 30). Izikhungo zedolobha zinesibopho ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zedolobha ukuqapha le misebenzi yolimi nezinketho zabantu abakhonza lapho bexhumana nabantu, kufaka phakathi izidingo ezikhethekile zabantu abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala. I-Framework yeNqubomgomo Yezilimi Zesizwe inikeza ukuthi uma iMiphakathi ikhetha izilimi ezizokwenziwa ezikhethwe ngamasiko, kufanele ithuthukise, iphumeze, futhi ilandele inqubomgomo ephethe ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni ezikhuluma ngabaningi eThekwini, okuyi-isiZulu ne-English. Iphucula ukufinyelela kulwazi nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa uhulumeni. Ikhuthaza futhi isekela abantu ukuba bafunde izilimi ezisemthethweni ngaphezu kolimi lwabo lokuqala, okuzosiza ekwakheni nasekugcineni ubumbano njengelizwe nasekugcineni ubuhlanga obuhlukahlukene obunothile bezwe. Iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ngokugxila ekuphathweni kahle kwezilimi. Iphumeza futhi ilandele izinhlinzeko zeSigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo kanye nezimiso ze-Batho Pele nezinye izimo ezifanayo zokusebenza. Ukukhethwa kwalabo abazokwenziwa yiMiphakathi. Ukususwa kwazo zonke izithiyo ekusetshenzisweni kolimi ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthaza ukufinyelela okufanele kumaphrojekthi nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa yimiphakathi. Iqinisekisa ukuthi akekho ophoqelelwa noma ovinjelwe ekusetshenzisweni kolimi abalukhethayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingabe iyinye yalezo ezizokwenziwa noma cha. Inika isiZulu ne-English isimo esifanayo nokwelashwa. Izinhlinzeko zalolu hlelo zizosebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zomphakathi. Noma yiluphi ulimi phakathi kwalezi ezimbili olungasetshenziswa yiMiphakathi lungasetshenziswa kunoma yisiphi isimo noma umhlangano weBhodi yayo noma amaKhomidi. Emihlanganweni yeBhodi kanye namaKhomidi ayo, kumele kube nabahumushi bezilimi ezilodwa kulezi ezimbili ezingasetshenziswa. Uma noma yiliphi ilungu lifuna ukuthi okwenzeka kuhunyushwe kolunye ulimi olungelona olunye lwezilimi ezizokwenziwa, lelo lungelo kufanele libike kuMongameli weBhodi noma lelo Khomidi kusenesikhathi ukuze kudingeke ukuhumusha. Ulimi lwezandla kumele lutholakale futhi uma kudingeka. Noma yimiphi imihlangano yomphakathi noma imicimbi yomphakathi kumele ihlelwe ngolimi olungasetshenziswa ngokwezinketho zababekhona. Uma kukhona ababekhona abangakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olukhulunywayo, kumele kuhunyushwe. Zonke izinqubomgomo, imithetho, nezinqumo zeBhodi kanye namaKhomidi ayo kumele zibhalwe ngazo zombili izilimi zomphakathi ezisetshenziswayo. Zonke izaziso ezisemthethweni nezikhangiso ezikhishwe ukuze zikwazise umphakathi kumele zishicilelwe ngesiZulu nangesiNgisi. IsiZulu noma isiNgisi singasetshenziswa ukuze kube nokuxhumana okubhaliwe ngaphakathi. Uma umuntu obhalelwa engakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olusetshenziswayo, bangacela ukuba babhalelwe ngolimi abalukhethayo. Izikhumbuzo kumele zikhishwe ngazo zombili izilimi ezisetshenziswayo. Ukuxhumana okukhuluma ngaphakathi kungaba ngesiNgisi noma ngesiZulu kuye ngababonayo. Ukuxhumana nabantu bangaphandle kumele kube ngolunye lwezilimi ezisetshenziswayo, kucatshangelwa ukuthi yiluphi ulimi olukhethwe umamukeli. Uma incwadi ibuyiselwa ngaphandle, impendulo kumele ibe ngolimi lapho leyo ncwadi ibhalwe khona. Ukuphuma kokuxhumana kumele kukhombise ukuthi uma umamukeli efuna ukubhalelwa ngolunye ulimi phakathi kwalawo angasetshenziswa, lokho kuzokwenzeka uma bekucela. Abantu banelungelo lokusebenzisa ulimi abalukhethayo. Izibonakaliso ezikhombisa izikhungo noma amahhovisi omphakathi kumele zibe ngazo zombili izilimi ezisetshenziswayo. Zonke amakhasimende kumele asizwe ngolimi abalukhethayo, ngosizo lomhumushi, uma kudingeka. IMiphakathi kumele iqinisekise ukuthi abamele izigcawu nezisebenzi bayakuqonda ukubaluleka kwezilimi ezahlukene futhi bakhuthazwe ukuba bamukele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezikhethwe ngababhalayo/amakhasimende, abanye abamele izigcawu, nezisebenzi. Ukuhumusha nokuhumusha kwiMiphakathi kufanele kwenziwe ngabantu abanamakhono aqeqeshiwe abaqeqeshwe ngalolu work abaqashwe ngumnyango wezilimi zomphakathi. IMiphakathi kumele iphromothe futhi isekele ukuthuthukiswa kwezakhono zolimi phakathi kwezisebenzi nabamele izigcawu. Izisebenzi nabamele izigcawu kufanele bakhuthazwe ukufunda ezinye izilimi ezingezona ezabo njengoba lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuqonda kwezilimi ezahlukene, ukuhlonipha amasiko ahlukahlukene, nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo. Uma iminyango yomphakathi iqasha izisebenzi ezintsha, kumele bagcine le nqubomgomo yolimi engqondweni. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma kule nqubomgomo noma isinqumo seBhodi, le nqubomgomo izothatha isikhala kusukela ngosuku lokwamukelwa yiBhodi. Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha zokwamukelwa kwale nqubomgomo, uMphakathi kufanele ubeke izinsuku zokuphumeza izimo zalesi siqondiso.
Umthelela wesomiso kwezolimo eFree State Umbuzo 1: Yini elandelayo uma sikhuluma ngesomiso eFree State? Impendulo: Isomiso sisho ukungabi khona kwamanzi okwanele, okuthinta kakhulu izitshalo nezilwane. EFree State, isimo sezulu sithinteka kakhulu yizimo zokushisa eziphezulu nezikhathi zokungabi namvula. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqiza kwezolimo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izitshalo ezithinteka kakhulu ngalesi simo? Impendulo: Izitshalo ezifana nezinkomo, u- maize, ne-soya zikhula kakhulu eFree State, kodwa uma kunesomiso, lezi zitshalo ziba nezinkinga zokukhula. U- maize, okungumkhiqizo obalulekile, uthola umthelela omkhulu uma umswakama unganele. Umbuzo 3: Umthelela wesomiso ungakanani ekukhiqizeni? Impendulo: Isomiso sikwazi ukwehlisa ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo ngaphezu kuka-30%. Lokhu kuholela ekuncipheni kwemali engenayo kubalimi, okwenza kube nzima ukuba baphile. Umphakathi wezolimo ubonakala uthinteka kakhulu, njengoba ukungabi namvula kuthinta zonke izigaba zokukhiqiza. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenza ukuthi iFree State ibe sengozini enkulu yokushoda kwamanzi? Impendulo: IFree State ithola imvula encane uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifunda eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwanda kokushisa kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu kwenza kube nzima ukuthola umswakama owanele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubalimi ukuhlela kahle ukukhiqiza kwabo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izindlela ezisetshenziswa abalimi ukuze balwe nesomiso? Impendulo: Abalimi baseFree State baphendukela ezindleleni ezahlukene zokulima. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi, ezifana nokulima okungaphansi komhlaba, kanye nokusebenzisa izitshalo ezimelana nesomiso. Abanye basebenzisa amasu afana nokubeka izikhukhula ukuze bagcine umswakama. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona izinhlelo zokuxhasa abalimi? Impendulo: Yebo, uhulumeni kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele zisebenza ukuze ziqinise abalimi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza zokulima, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa ngemali. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukusiza abalimi bakwazi ukumelana nezimo ezinzima. Umbuzo 7: Umthelela wesomiso ungaba yini kumphakathi? Impendulo: Isomiso sithinta umphakathi ngezindlela eziningi. Ukuncipha kokukhiqiza kuholela ekwehleni kokudla, okungaholela ekudleni okunganele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abavela emiphakathini ethile. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso? Impendulo: Ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso kungasiza ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, kunciphise ukuncika emanzini, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Lokhu kungakhuthaza ukwakha umnotho oqinile, uphinde ulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu kumalimi. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izinguquko zesimo sezulu ziba nomthelela ekulimaleni kwezolimo eFree State? Impendulo: Yebo, izinguquko zesimo sezulu zikhombisa ukwanda kokushisa, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubalimi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwesomiso, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela ukukhiqiza. Abalimi badinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze baphendule kulezi zinguquko. Umbuzo 10: Yini okudingeka yenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalimi bayakwazi ukumelana nesomiso? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezimboni zokulima zisebenzisane ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuxhasa abalimi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi. Ukuqwashisa umphakathi ngalesi simo nakho kubalulekile. Umbuzo 11: Uthini umbono wesikhathi esizayo kwezolimo eFree State? Impendulo: Uma izinyathelo ezifanele zithathwa, iFree State ingaba neziphumo ezinhle kwezolimo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele, kungasiza abalimi ukuthi baphile kahle ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima. Umbuzo 12: Ingabe umphakathi ungathola izixazululo ezithile? Impendulo: Yebo, umphakathi ungathola izixazululo ngokubambisana. Ukuhlanganisa imithombo, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu nabalimi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokulima ezimelana nesomiso. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela kahle ukukhiqiza. Umbuzo 13: Yiziphi izifundo esingazifunda kulolu hlobo lwesimo? Impendulo: Isifundo esiyinhloko esivela kulolu hlobo lwesimo siwukuthi ukubaluleka kokuhlela kahle nokuba nezinhlelo eziphusile. Ukuze sibe neziphumo ezinhle kwezolimo, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imithombo yethu, siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uyaziqonda izinselelo ezikhona. Umbuzo 14: Ingabe izinhlelo zokulima ezimelana nesomiso zingathuthukiswa? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokulima ezimelana nesomiso zingathuthukiswa ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukufunda ezindaweni eziphumelelayo, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela ukukhiqiza kwethu. Umbuzo 15: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalimi bahlala bephumelela? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalimi bahlala bephumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisiza ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuphatha izinsiza, kanye nokwakha izinkundla zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nezinyathelo ezidingekayo. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuvuselela umnotho wezolimo eFree State, sithuthukise ukuphila kwabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi sizoba neziphumo ezinhle nakusasa.
Ukugonywa Kwezingane Ingxoxo noDkt. Zanele Mthethwa, udokotela wezempilo yomphakathi Umqondisi: Sanibonani, Dkt. Mthethwa. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Namuhla sizobe sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile yokugonywa kwezingane. Ungasichazela ukuthi kungani ukugonywa kwezingane kubalulekile? Dkt. Mthethwa: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ukugonywa kwezingane kubalulekile ngoba kuvikela izingane ezimeni eziningi ezibuhlungu, ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana kalula. Ukuze izingane zikhule zibe nezempilo, kudingeka zibe nezinhlaka ezivikelekile. Ukugonywa kwenza kube lula ukuvimbela izifo ezinjengokukhwehlela, umkhuhlane, nezinye izifo ezinzima. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ngabe ungachaza ukuthi yiziphi izigaba zokugonywa ezibalulekile ezinganeni? Dkt. Mthethwa: Yebo, kunezinyathelo ezithile zokugonywa ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kunezivivinyo ezisemqoka ezifanele ukuba zenzeke ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa i-BCG yokuvikela umkhuhlane, i-DTP yokuvikela izifo ezinjenge-diphtheria, tetanus, ne-pertussis, kanye ne-Polio. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezivivinyo ezithile ezitholakala eminyakeni ethile, njenge-MMR yokuvikela umkhuhlane, umkhuhlane, ne-rubella. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona izizathu ezithile ezibangela ukuthi abanye abazali bangagonyi izingane zabo? Dkt. Mthethwa: Yebo, kunezizathu eziningi. Abanye abazali bangase babe nezinkolelo ezithile ezibavimbela ekugonyeni, noma bangase babe nolwazi olungaphelele mayelana nezins benefits zokugonywa. Abanye bangase babe nesaba sokuthi imithi yokugonya ingaba nemiphumela emibi, noma bangase bahlale ezindaweni ezingenayo ukufinyelela kwezinsiza zokugonywa. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Yini ongayiphakamisa ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga? Dkt. Mthethwa: Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abazali ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nezins benefits zokugonywa. Izikhungo zezempilo zingase zibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa, ezihlanganisa izinkulumo, izincwadi, nezinsiza ezitholakala kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogonyo ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze wonke umphakathi ufinyelele kalula. Umqondisi: Ngabe ukugonywa kwezingane kudinga ukwenziwa njalo, noma kukhona isikhathi esithile? Dkt. Mthethwa: Ukugonywa kwezingane kudinga ukuhamba phambili ngezikhathi ezithile. Izingane zidinga ukuvakashela udokotela ukuze zifinyelele ezivivinyweni ezithile eminyakeni ethile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala zivikelekile ezimeni ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona nezivivinyo eziphindaphindwayo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uhlala uvikelekile. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona okunye okubalulekile okufanele sikhumbule mayelana nokugonywa kwezingane? Dkt. Mthethwa: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi abazali bazi ukuthi ukugonywa akukhona kuphela ukuvikela izingane zabo, kodwa futhi kuvikela umphakathi wonke. Uma izingane zigonywa, zinciphisa amathuba okuthi izifo zibe yingozi emphakathini. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho izifo zingathathelwana kalula. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mthethwa, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile. Ngabe unazo izeluleko zokugcina kubazali? Dkt. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho kubazali ukuthi bahlale bexhumana nodokotela bezempilo, baqonde izidingo zokugonywa, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zikhuluma kahle. Ukugonywa akuyona nje into yokwenza, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqinile nezinhloso ezinhle. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mthethwa, ngalesi sikhathi esihle. Ngiyabonga futhi ngemininingwane ebalulekile oyabelane nathi. Dkt. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngiyethemba ukuthi le ngxoxo izosiza ekwandiseni ulwazi nolwazi mayelana nokugonywa kwezingane.
U-NaJane uthi... Ezindabeni (amaphephandaba, ithelevishini, umsakazo) zalesi sikhathi, kukhuluma okuningi i-ANC Youth League mayelana nendaba yomhlaba (nema bhange kanye nezimayini), futhi kukhuthaza kakhulu ukubona ukuthi abantu abahlukene bathini ngalesi sihloko somhlaba. Ngibona umhlaba njengomthombo okufanele siwusebenzise ukukhiqiza ukudla nobuhle. Izinto eziningi lapha emhlabeni ziya zanda njalo unyaka nonyaka - abantu, izinkomo, izimoto, njll. Kodwa umhlaba awukwazi ukwanda - unamkhawulo. Uma ucabanga ngempilo eyanda njalo, kodwa umhlaba okhiqizayo uyancipha (akukho okukhumbuleka ukuthi abantu badinga isikhala sokwakha izindlu zabo - amadolobha akhula ngokusebenzisa umhlaba), kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba wonke usebenza kahle. ENingizimu Afrika namuhla sinezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi ngoba iningi lomhlaba okhiqizayo liphethwe ngabantu abamhlophe. Manje kukhuluma ngokuthatha lowo mhlaba, hhayi ukuwuthenga, bese unika abantu abamnyama. Kukho futhi okunye okufanele kukhunjulwe, kunenani elikhulu lomhlaba elilawulwa uhulumeni (ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke) kodwa izindawo eziningi zalowo mhlaba azisetshenziswa kahle. Kukho futhi izinkulungwane zehektare ezabelwe uMnyango Wezomhlaba ngohlelo lwawo. Lokhu kuhambisana nombala wesikhumba somuntu. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukuba umphakathi ophumelelayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uyazitholela, uphila endaweni encane, noma ungumlimi wezohwebo akusho lutho ngombala wesikhumba somuntu. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uma ufuna ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo, udinga ulwazi namakhono, imishini, imakethe, kanye ne-capital yokuqala yokutshala. Ukunika umuntu umhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi - nje ngoba uphakathi kwegaraji akusho ukuthi ungimoto! Ngokufanayo, nje ngoba unomhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi. Uma ufuna ukuqashelwa njengomkhiqizi, kumele usebenzise umhlaba wakho ngokuphelele - kumele ukhiqize ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza kulowo mhlaba. Ngifisa ukuphakamisa ukuthi sixhase ngamandla ethu bonke labo abanomhlaba ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa wonke umhlaba okhiqizayo ukukhiqiza ukudla kwethu. Umhlaba uyigugu elikhulu; uma unomhlaba, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuwusebenzisa. Ake sibambisane njengabangakhiqizi ukuze sikwazi ukukhiqiza konke esingakwenza, sithule kulokho okukhuluma abezombusazwe abakhonza kuphela bona.
Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni lesi sifo nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMashi-Avril walonyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa njenge-swine flu ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kuvela ezinkukhu. Manje kuqondwa ukuthi umthombo walo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, lesi sifo asinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sitholakala kuphela njenge-pandemic influenza noma ngamagama alo asemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMashi walonyaka, leli gciwane lisabalale ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje leli gciwane lisabalale ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ndatshana, leli gciwane selithinte abantu abangaphezu kuka-3,000 ezweni lethu, kanti kunezimo eziyi-177,457 eziqinisekisiwe emhlabeni jikelele, kuhlanganise nezinyanga eziyi-1,457 eziqinisekisiwe. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo owawubanjelwe ngoJuni 11, 2009, iMnyango Wezempilo Yezwe (WHO) waphumela esiphethweni sokuthi izimfuneko zokumemezela lesi sifo njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke sezihlangene, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, wamemezela ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njenge-pandemic (izinga lesi-6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi lesi sifo sesabalale kuzo zonke izindawo ze-WHO futhi kwenzeke ngokushesha. Nokho, ngithanda ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi lesi sifo sinesikhumba esikhulu. Lokhu kusho nje ukuthi siqhubeka nokusabalala emhlabeni wonke. NgoJulayi 6, i-WHO yabika ukuthi ukusabalala kwale pandemic kuqhubeka ezweni elithintekile nakwezinye izwe ezintsha njengokwehla okungavunyelwe. Ngempela, naphezu kwalokhu, iphinde yathi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngaleli gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nokho, njengabantu bezempilo, kokubili emhlabeni jikelele nasendaweni, sikhathazekile ngempilo yokufa okwenzekile kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye no-0.1% phakathi kwabantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). I-gciwane ithinte abantu abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-29 - abaningi babo bangabafundi noma baphakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO iphakamisa ukuthi amazwe agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wale sifo emiphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana okusebenzayo kubalulekile. Lesi sifo sithathelwa phezulu ngama-droplets okuphefumula, okusho ukuthi lapho umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ehlanza, uphumeza ama-droplets abawakhishile. Noma uma bekhwehlela endaweni encane, ungase uphumeze umoya waleso sikhala. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banama-symptoms alula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Ngakho-ke, abantu abane-symptoms alula kufanele baphathwe njengokuthi bangaphathwa njenge-influenza ejwayelekile. Noma ubani onama-symptoms abukhali noma abukhali kufanele afune usizo lwezokwelapha ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa yiNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule ibhange eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuphakanyiswa kodokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo lukamasipala akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa ezikhungweni zokucwaninga ngokwabo - kudinga ukuba udokotela wabo enze leli qiniso. Sibonile ukuthi kukhona ukuhlolwa okwenziwa emkhakheni wezempilo ozimele, kodwa lokhu akuphakanyiswa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe izimo eziphawulwe ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela ezitholwe nguMnyango Wezempilo. Imithi esetshenziswa kakhulu ekwelapheni lesi sifo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa kwabo bonke abane-Tamiflu kuzoholela esimweni sokuthi ungakwazi ukwelapha lesi sifo kahle uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangaqhubeka nokuphila kwabo. Ulwazi olukhona emhlabeni jikelele luveze ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akuvimbeli ukusabalala kwalesi sifo. Kunalokho, kuholela ekuphazamisekeni okukhulu emphakathini. Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi onama-symptoms alula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kunezibalo eziningi zabafundi noma/nomathisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozohlanganyela nezikhungo zezempilo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezifanele zithathwa ukuze kuqhubeke nemisebenzi. Uma unama-symptoms alula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabantu. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi emhlabeni jikelele benza konke okusemandleni ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezizayo. Ngithanda ukubonga ngokuthatha isikhathi sokufunda le mlayezo, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokubamba iqhaza kwakho okulindelekile ekusakazeni ulwazi nasekunciphiseni umthelela walolu sifo.
Ngomhla ka-15 kuMfumfu 2023, uhulumeni wendawo wethule imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala, ebonisa izinga lokuphathwa kwezimali ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlolwa kwenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi kubonise ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Uhlolo lwenziwe ezindaweni ezingama-30, lapho abahloli bejolise khona ekubhekeni izincwadi zezimali, izinkokhelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kwenziwa ngenxa yokukhathazeka okukhulayo ngokuqhubeka kokungabi nezezimali ezanele emiphakathini ethile, kanye nezikhalazo ezivela kubantu mayelana nokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. UNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, umsizi weMnyango Wezokuphathwa Kwezimali, uveze ukuthi imiphumela ibonisa izindawo ezithile eziphumelele kakhulu, kanti ezinye zidinga ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu. Uthe, "Siyajabula ukuthi ezinye izindawo zikhombisa ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezidinga ukulungiswa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo." Izindawo eziphumelele kakhulu zifaka phakathi iMasipala waseThekwini, owathola izinga eliphezulu lokuphathwa kwezimali, kanti izinhlelo zokwakha izikole nezikhungo zezempilo zikhombisa impumelelo enkulu. Uhlolo lukhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezibekwe phambili zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhuthaza abanye masipala ukuba bazame ukufunda kulokhu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izindawo ezifana neMasipala waseMkhanyakude zikhombisa izinkinga ezinkulu. Uhlolo lukhombisa ukuthi izincwadi zezimali azihambisani nezinga elidingekayo, okwaholela ezinkingeni zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka. UMasipala waseMkhanyakude ubhekene nezikhalazo eziningi ezivela kubantu abahlala kule ndawo, abathi izinsiza ezifana namanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha azitholakali ngendlela efanele. Uhlolo lwamabhuku komasipala luhlose ukwakha isithombe esicacile sokuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa kanjani, futhi luhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Uhlolo lwenziwa ngamaqembu ahlukene, okubandakanya abahloli bezimali, abamele izakhamuzi, kanye nochwepheshe bezokuphathwa kwezimali, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela ibonisa kahle isimo sangempela.
Umbiko: Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Isingeniso Izinkinga zemigwaqo zihlala zishiya umthelela omkhulu emphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi. Kulesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuhlola lezi zinkinga, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithuthukisa izimo zokuhamba, zikwazi nokukhulisa umnotho wendawo. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezinkingeni ezisemqoka, izimbangela zazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingasetshenziswa. Izinkinga Eziphambili Ezinye zezinkinga ezibhekiswe emigwaqweni zifaka phakathi izimbobo, ukungabi nalungiselelo olufanele, kanye nokuntuleka kwezimpawu zomgwaqo. Izimbobo ezinzima zenza kube nzima ukuhamba, zibangela ukuhamba kancane kwezithuthi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Ukungabi nalungiselelo okufanelekile kwenza kube nzima ukulawula ukuhamba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomthamo omkhulu wezithuthi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokungqubuzana, okuvame ukuholela ezimeni ezinzima zezimoto. Izimbangela Zezinkinga Izizathu eziholela kulezi zinkinga ziningi. Okokuqala, ukungabikhona kwemali yokulungisa imigwaqo kuholela ekutheni izinkinga zihlale zikhona. Ukuze kube nezinhlaka ezihamba phambili kwezokuthutha, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza ezikhona kulimaza ukusebenza kwemigwaqo. Abantu abavame ukuhamba ngemoto, kodwa uma imigwaqo ingalungile, lokhu kuyabaphazamisa. Umthelela Emphakathini Umthelela wezinkinga zemigwaqo emperorshi ubalulekile. Izimbobo ezinkulu zingaholela ezimeni zokuhlala ezingezinhle, njengokungabi bikho kokwaneliseka kwabantu. Lokhu kungathinta ezokuthutha, futhi kuholele ebhizinisini eliphazamisekile. Abanye abantu bayakhetha ukungasebenzisi izithuthi zabo ngenxa yezimo ezingezinhle, okuholela ekwehleni kokuhamba okwenziwa ngamasosha. Lokhu kubangela ukwehla kokuhamba kwabantu, okungakha umphakathi ongenamandla. Izixazululo Ezikhona Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisebenzayo ukuze kuzuze umphakathi. Okokuqala, umnyango wezokuthutha kumele uqinisekise ukuthi kukhuphuka imali yokulawula nokulungisa imigwaqo. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izimo zokuhamba, kunciphise izingozi, futhi kukhuphule ukuhamba kwemithwalo. Okwesibili, ukwenza izinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukulawula izithuthi, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imigwaqo iyahlolwa njalo. Ukwamukela Izindlela Zokuxhumana Ukwamukela izindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi kumphakathi nakubasebenzi ezindaweni zomgwaqo kuzokwandisa ukuqonda ngezinkinga ezikhona. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebonakalayo kumphakathi ngezinhlelo zokwakha, izikhathi zokulungisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhamba kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukubekezela. Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuhlela kahle izinto zabo. Isiphetho Izinkinga zemigwaqo zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsiza ezidingekayo zokuhamba. Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza, ukulawula kahle, kanye nokuhlola izinkinga ezikhona kuzokwenza umphakathi uthuthuke. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha imigwaqo engcono, ethuthukisa ukuphila kwabantu nempilo yansuku zonke. Umsebenzi onzima udinga ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Sifuna ukufinyelela imigwaqo esheshayo, ephephile, nephumelelayo, ukuze sikhulise umnotho nempilo yomphakathi.
Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition (JET) luhloselwe ukusungula umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, nolondolozayo emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza amandla. Lokhu kuhilela ukuguqula izindlela zethu zokukhiqiza, ukuthola amandla, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zethu ukuze zibe nomthelela omuhle emvelweni. I-Just Energy Transition ibalulekile ngoba ibheka izidingo zabantu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola amandla ahlanzekile. ### 1. Yini i-Just Energy Transition? I-Just Energy Transition iyinqubo yokushintsha umthombo wamandla, igxile ekwehliseni ukuthembela kumafutha emvelo, njengegesi ne-coal, bese kuthathwa amandla ahlanzekile, njenge-solar, wind, ne-hydro. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuvimbela ukushisa komhlaba, ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emisha. I-JET ibalulekile ngoba ibheka izici zokulingana, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo kakhulu, ezinjengokuhlupheka, ububha, nezindawo ezinomthelela omubi. ### 2. Izizathu zokutshala imali ku-JET Ukutshala imali ku-JET kunezinzuzo eziningi: - Ukunciphisa Ukungcoliswa: Ukusebenzisa amandla ahlanzekile kunciphisa ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, okwenza kube nokuphila okungcono kubantu nakwezilwane. - Ukudala Imisebenzi: Uhlelo lwe-JET luhlinzeka ngokuqashwa emikhakheni emisha, efana nezokwakha iziteshi zamandla ahlanzekile, ukwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amandla, nokunye. - Ukuthuthukisa Umnotho: Ukutshala imali ku-JET kungakhuthaza umnotho wendawo, njengoba izinkampani ezikhiqiza amandla ahlanzekile zidinga abasebenzi, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo. - Ukuphucula Ukufinyelela Kwamandla: I-JET iqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude noma ezihluphekayo bathola amandla ahlanzekile, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila impilo engcono. ### 3. Izindlela Zokutshala Imali ku-JET Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-JET lungabandakanya izindlela eziningi: - Ukuxhaswa Kwezimali: Izikhungo zezimali zinganikeza uxhaso lwezimali kumaphrojekthi ahlanzekile, okwenza kube lula ukuwakhulisa. - Ukwakhiwa Kwamathuba: Ukuphakamisa izinhlelo zokufundisa nokwakha amakhono kubantu ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza emikhakheni yamandla ahlanzekile. - Ukubambisana Nezinkampani: Izinkampani ezikhiqiza amandla zingabambisana nohulumeni ukuze zisebenzise izinsiza ezikhona, zikhulise imisebenzi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayazuza. - Ukwakha Izinhlelo Zokulawula: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lwe-JET lusebenza kahle, kudingeka izinhlelo ezilawulayo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha izinsiza. ### 4. Izinselelo Zokutshala Imali ku-JET Naphezu kwezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezihambisana nokutshala imali ku-JET: - Ukungabaza Kwezimali: Abanye abantu bangase babe nokungabaza mayelana nokubeka imali emaphrojekthini ahlanzekile, ngenxa yokungaqiniseki ngezimali ezizotholakala. - Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe: Ubuchwepheshe obusha bukhona, kodwa kudingeka isikhathi nemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. - Ukuphikiswa Kwezombusazwe: Ezinye izinhlelo zingase zibe nezithiyo ezivela ezombusazwe, njengoba abanye abantu bengase baphikise izinguquko ezinkulu. ### 5. Ukubaluleka Kokubambisana Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, nabantu bomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze uhlelo lwe-JET luphumelele. Ukuze sifeze izinjongo zethu, kudingeka ukuthi bonke abathintekayo basebenze ndawonye, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhe izixazululo ezihlanganyelwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula, ukulingana, nokuthuthukiswa. ### 6. Isiphetho Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition luhloselwe ukusungula umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, nolondolozayo. Ngokuhlanganisa izinsiza, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, elinokuthula, nelinobulungiswa. Ukutshala imali ku-JET akusizi kuphela ekunciphiseni ukungcoliswa, kodwa futhi kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kuthuthukisa umnotho, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amandla ahlanzekile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sifeze lezi zinjongo, siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi wethu uthola izinzuzo eziphelele zokuguqulwa kwamandla.
Ngo-1974, uhulumeni we-apartheid wanquma ukubuyisela emuva umthetho owawuhlukanise uDr. HF Verwoerd ngesikhathi ezama ukuwusebenzisa ngo-1953, ngenkathi ephethe ikomidi lezemfundo. Uhulumeni ngaleso sikhathi wawuphumelele umthetho "50/50", owayetshela ukuthi isiAfrikaans kufanele sibe yindlela yokufundisa yezibalo, izifundo zomphakathi, kanye ne-arithmetic, ngenkathi isayensi, izifundo ezisebenzayo, ubuciko, nezandla kufanele kufundiswe ngesiNgisi. Isigameko sokuqala sokulwa saqala phakathi kwabafundisi nabazali. Ngo-1975, amabhodi ezikole ayalile abafundisi ukuthi bangafundisi ngesiAfrikaans, okwaholela ekutheni uMnyango Wezemfundo YamaBantu ukhishwe abaphathi abahlanu bamabhodi ezikole. Ngonyaka ka-1976, kwavela umuzwa omkhulu ophikisana nohlelo lwezemfundo lwamaBantu. Njengoba isikhathi sokuphikisana sisondele ngoJuni 16, abafundi baseSoweto bahlangana emnyango wesikole esisodwa, bephakamisa isiqubulo: Faka ukuze Ufundise, Phuma ukuze Usebenze. Ngemva kukaMashi walowo nyaka, kwaphoqeleka ukuba isiAfrikaans sibe yindlela yokufundisa kwezinye izikole eSoweto, okwaholela ekwandeni kokuphikisana nomthetho "50/50". Ngomhla kaMeyi 17, ezinye izikole zaqala ukukhuthaza iziteleka, zicela ukuvalwa kwesiAfrikaans njengendlela yokufundisa. Ngaphambi kukaJuni, ezinye izikole zanqaba ukubhala izivivinyo zezifundo zomphakathi ngesiAfrikaans futhi zath threat to boycott all June exams. Ngempelasonto, ngoJuni 13, kwaba nomhlangano lapho kwavumelana ukuthi ngoJuni 16 no-17 kuzoba nokuhamba kwazulu eSoweto, kuphumelele emhlanganweni ngoMgqibelo, ngoJuni 18. Kulowo mhlangano, kwasungulwa ikomidi elibizwa ngeSoweto Action Committee (SAC), elinamalungu amabili avela esikoleni ngasinye eSoweto. Le komidi yanikezwa umsebenzi wokuhlela ukuhamba kokuthula okuphakanyisiwe. I-SAC nabo bonke ababekhona kulowo mhlangano bathi bayavuma ukugcina konke okwenzeka ngoJuni 13 kuyimfihlo ukuze izinhlelo zingaphazamiseki ngabaphikisi. Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu, kwakhishwa isimemezelo nemiyalo mayelana nalokho okwakudingeka kwenziwe ngalolo suku. Ekuseni kosuku lwangoMgqibelo, ngoJuni 16, 1976, abafundi baseSoweto bahlangana ezindaweni ezingaphezu kwezingu-12 ukuze bahambe. Abaphathi bahlakulela amaphephandaba anemishwana ebhalwe ngesandla ethi: "Phansi nesiAfrikaans" kanye "NgesiAfrikaans kuyilimi lokucindezela." Lolu suku lwabhalwa njengendawo ephezulu empini yentsha eNingizimu Afrika, eyayiqale ngaphambi kwalokhu futhi yaqhubeka kuze kube ukhetho lwabantu abaningi ngo-1994. Ukuvuka kweSoweto, okwakuyisisekelo sokulwa kwentsha, kwavusa uchungechunge lweziteleka ezweni lonke kodwa kwacindezelwa yilabo ababephakeme ngaphansi kohulumeni we-apartheid. Abantu abaningi bafa, amahhashi amaningi aboshwa, futhi abaningi baphuma ezweni ukuze bajoyine izinyathelo zokulwa ezazithulisiwe. Ukubaluleka kosuku lukaJuni 16, 1976, kubonakala ngendlela abantu abazinikela ngayo ekuzibophezeleni kwenkululeko nasekuphindiseni isizwe sabo. Lokhu futhi kwaba nomthelela ekwakheni uhlelo lwezemfundo oluhlonipha ubuntu, ukuhlukahluka kwamasiko, inkululeko yokukhetha, futhi luzama ukuqinisekisa amathuba alinganayo. Izinyathelo zentsha yama-70 zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa lethu. Njengobuholi bezikhathi ezizayo, bakwazi ukubona ikusasa labo futhi baphinde bakhe indlela okufanele bayilandele. Ngemibono yabo, izinyathelo, nokuzinikela, bavusa umlilo wokulwa nohulumeni ocindezelayo, okwagcina kuholela ekunqobeni kwabantu abaningi. Abantu abasha baqhubeka nokudlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini, futhi uhulumeni wabantu abaningi uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni abantu abasha, abangu bobuholi bezikhathi ezizayo nabagadi benkululeko yethu eyatholakala ngempumelelo. Izintshisekelo zabantu abasha manje sezibhekwa yisikhungo esisha esibizwa nge-Youth Development Agency (YDA), esithathe indawo yeNational Youth Commission kanye neRed Youth Fund, njengestructure kahulumeni yokubhekana nezindaba zentsha. Abantu abasha babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nenani eliphezulu labangasebenzi, ubumpofu, kanye nobugebengu. Ukungasebenzi kubandakanya zonke izimo abantu abasha abathola kuzo, kusukela kulabo abanemfundo yeziqu ezingu-10 kuya kulabo abaneziqu zemfundo ephakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abasha eNingizimu Afrika babhekene nenkinga yokuthinteka ngezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, kuhlanganise ne-HIV ne-AIDS. Imindeni ephethwe abantu abasha kanye naleyo ephethwe izingane iyanda ngenxa yokufa kwabazali ezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezihlobene ne-HIV ne-AIDS, njenge-tuberculosis (TB). Inkinga enkulu ebhekene nezwe lethu yikhono lokukhulisa ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu abasha mayelana nokwazi ukuthi bangobani, ukuqonda umlando wabo, nokufaka kubo uthando lokuthanda izwe labo. Lapho sibheka intshisekelo ekhombisa abantu abasha emavotelweni ombuso wesine, kubonisa ukuthi le mpi iyaphumelela. Uhulumeni wabantu abaningi usungule izikhungo ezifana neNational Youth Development Agency (NDA), enikezwe amandla okubhekana nazo zonke izindaba zentsha, kusukela kumgomo kuya ekuthuthukiseni. Le ndawo ibhekwa nguNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likaMongameli. I-NDA iyisikhungo sikahulumeni esakhiwe ukuze ibhekane ngqo nezinselelo zezezimali ezibhekene nabantu abasha futhi iphinde ibe yifundo yokuthuthukiswa eyenzelwe ukudala amathuba kubantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ukubaluleka kwezemfundo kugcizelelwa ngokuhlukaniswa kweminyango emibili yezemfundo: uMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo kanye noMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi yabo iyenziwa kahle. IPhalamende linezinkomidi ezifana neNational Assembly Committee on Women, Children, and Persons with Disabilities, ezidinga ukubhekana nezindaba zentsha. Kungumsebenzi walezi zinkomidi ukuqapha intuthuko yezindaba zentsha nokubhekana nemithetho ethinta abantu abasha, kuhlanganise ne-Employment Equity Act. Emsebenzini wayo wokubhekwa, iPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho eyamukelwe iyasetshenziswa, kuhlanganise naleyo eyenzelwe abantu abasha baleli zwe. Ngaphakathi kwe-"Member's Interface," abantu abasha bangahlangana noMphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. Bangaphinde bakhombise imibono yabo ngokukhuluma noma ngokwenza iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe. Abantu abasha baphinde babe yingxenye yebhodi yokubuka emihlanganweni yeKomidi lapho imisebenzi eminingi yephalamende yenzeka khona, futhi bangavakashela emihlanganweni yephalamende ukuze babone izinqubo ukuze bathole ulwazi futhi bazithuthukise. IPhalamende inezinhlelo ezahlukene ezihloselwe izigaba ezahlukene, isibonelo: iPh
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhloselwe ukusiza labo balimi abaphumelele ekufundeni. Lezi zinkampani zidinga usizo ngabanye mayelana nokwakha isu lokukhiqiza, ukuphatha ukusebenza kwezolimo, ukuphatha izindaba zezimali, njll. Abalimi abakhethiweyo bazothola ukwesekwa okukhulu unyaka wonke. Unyaka nonyaka, abalimi abasha bazokhethwa ukuze bathole le nsizakalo, emva kwalokho bazophila ngokuzimela kodwa bazothola usizo lwefoni kubaphathi ababelana ngolwazi ezindaweni zabo. Uma umlimi ekhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-250 tons ngonyaka, bazokwethulwa kwezinye izinkampani zezimali kule ndawo - lokhu kuzosheshisa ukungena kwabalamuli abamnyama emkhakheni wezomnotho. Bonke abalimi abanguye amalungu ale nhlangano bathola ukwesekwa ekwakheni ipotfoliyo yabo, ehlanganisa isu lebhizinisi lonyaka. Ipotfoliyo izohlinzeka ngethuba lokufaka isicelo sokuxhaswa ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zinkampani zizovakashelwa njalo ngababoni bezifunda abazozisiza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela nokubheka umsebenzi wabo ofana nokulungiselela umhlabathi, ukutshala, ukususa, ukuhluza, ukuvuna, nokumaketha. Sikholelwa ukuthi le nqubekelaphambili yezomnotho kufanele ibhekwane ngokucophelela futhi kufanele sikwazise labo abenza intuthuko. Sinenkambo yokumema abanye abalimi ukuba bajoyine i-250 Ton Club. Kukhona izigaba ze-250 Ton, 500 Ton, kanye ne-1,000 Ton - sithokozisa abalimi futhi sabanika ama-badges akhombisa isimo sabo kulezi zinkundla. Sizama ukukhombisa ibhizinisi lezolimo jikelele ukuthi kukhona intuthuko emsebenzini wethu wokuhlanganisa abalimi emnothweni.
UJohn Bolt: Uhambo Lwakhe Lokuphumelela UJohn Bolt, owaziwa njengo "iBolt," ungumuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Uzalwe ngoJanuwari 15, 1990, eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika. Wakhula emndenini ophilayo, ogxile ekufundeni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono. Umama wakhe, uNandi, wayengumfundisi, kanti ubaba, uThabo, wayengumsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kumfundisa ukubaluleka kwemfundo, ukusebenza kanzima, nokuhlala efuna ulwazi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zeMatrik, uJohn wangenela iNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho afunda khona i-Computer Science. Wathola ithuba lokubamba izifundo ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, okuhlinzeka ngendawo yokucabanga nokudala. Waqeda izifundo zakhe ngo-2011, wabe esethola umsebenzi njengomkhiqizi wezinhlelo zokusebenza emnyangweni wezobuchwepheshe. UJohn wathola ithuba lokusebenza ngesikhathi ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha. Ngemva kweminyaka emibili, wakha iBolt, inkampani ehlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphuthumayo zokuthutha. I-Bolt yakhula yaba yinkampani eyaziwa kakhulu emkhakheni wezinsizakalo zokuthutha, ikhiqiza izinhlelo ezivumela abantu ukuba bahambe kalula nangempumelelo. UJohn akagcini nje ngokwakha ibhizinisi, kodwa futhi waqonda ukubaluleka kokubuyisela emphakathini. Waqalisa ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abantu abasha emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Wabamba izingxoxo eziningi nabafundi, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe, futhi wakhuthaza abantu abasha ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, iBolt yathola imiklomelo eminingi, kubalwa neNkampani Ephumelelayo Yonyaka. UJohn uthole izindondo ezahlukene ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe oncomekayo, okuhlanganisa umklomelo wokuhlonishwa emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ubuye waba ngumholi ophawulekayo, futhi umphakathi uvuma imizamo yakhe yokwakha imisebenzi emisha. UJohn uhlala elwa nezinkinga ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe, ephendula emibuzweni ethile mayelana nokuziphatha okuhle kwezobuchwepheshe. Ukukhuthaza impilo enempilo kumphakathi, uJohn uqhubeka eqinisa izindlela zokuhlala usemthethweni, ezokuphepha, kanye nokuziphatha okuhle. Ngaphezu kokuphumelela kwakhe kwiBolt, uJohn uphinde abe umndeni ojabulayo. Uzakwabo, uThandiwe, ungumculi ophumelelayo, futhi banabantwana abane. UJohn uthi ukuba nomndeni kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yakhe, futhi uhlala enza isikhathi sokuchitha nabo. Uthanda ukuhamba, esho ukuthi ukuphila kuhle uma ubamba isikhathi nabathandekayo. Ngaphandle komsebenzi, uJohn uthanda ukufunda izincwadi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, nezomnotho. Ubuye athande ukuzijabulisa ngokubuka imidlalo yeholide, futhi ungumlandeli omkhulu weqembu lemidlalwana yezemidlalo yaseNingizimu Afrika. UJohn Bolt ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokusebenza kanzima, umphakathi, nomndeni. Uhlale efinyelela phezulu, esebenzisa amasu akhe okucabanga ukuze abheke phambili. Uthi “Iphupho liphila uma ulinakekela” — lokho kuveza impilo yakhe. I-Bolt, njengegama eliyinsika, ibonisa amandla okuhamba phambili, futhi uJohn uyisibonelo sokuthi ngekhono, ukuzinikela, kanye nomoya omuhle, konke kungaba khona. UJohn uphila impilo eyanelisayo, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, hhayi kuphela kwiBolt, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. Uqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo, bazi kahle ukuthi impumelelo ayisiyona nje impumelelo yomuntu, kodwa ingumphumela wezinto eziningi ezihlangene. UJohn usaqhubeka nokuba umthombo wokhuthazo kubantu abamthandayo, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu abaninzi.
Izikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Umbuzo 1: Yini izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72? Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 ziwumkhankaso ohlanganisa izindawo ezahlukene ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kumiphakathi ehlukene. Lezi zikhungo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuvikela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba nezikhungo zezempilo eziningi? Ukuba nezikhungo zezempilo eziningi kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangenza izivakashi eziseduze, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba, kunciphisa izindleko, futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe kahle impilo yabo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakala kulezi zikhungo? Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zihlala zinikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa: - Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo - Ukunakekelwa kwezifo ezithile - Ukuhlinzwa okuncane - Izinsizakalo zokwelapha - Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwezempilo - Izinsizakalo zokuvikela, njengokugomela Umbuzo 4: Zitholakala kuphi lezi zikhungo? Lezi zikhungo zitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, kusukela emadolobheni amakhulu kuya ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizakalweni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izikhungo zezempilo? Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa lezi zikhungo ziningi. Okokuqala, abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okusheshayo, okungasiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu. Okwesibili, izikhungo zihlala zisebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona, zikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi. Okwesithathu, abantu bangathola ulwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezempilo. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe lezi zikhungo zisebenza nabanye abahlinzeki bezempilo? Yebo, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zisebenza ngokubambisana nabanye abahlinzeki bezempilo, njengemitholampilo, izibhedlela, nezikhungo zokwelapha. Lokhu kubambisana kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle kakhulu, futhi izinsizakalo zisebenza kahle. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngokuqashwa kwabasebenzi kulezi zikhungo? Izikhungo zezempilo zidinga abasebenzi abanamakhono ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa odokotela, abahlengikazi, nabanye abachwepheshe bezempilo. Ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezinikezwayo zisezingeni eliphezulu. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza imiphakathi? Yebo, izikhungo zezempilo zikhuthaza imiphakathi ngezindlela eziningi. Zihlinzeka ngokuqwashisa ngempilo, zifundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilile, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imikhankaso yokuvikela, imihlangano yokufundisa, nezinhlelo zokuxhasa. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nalezi zikhungo? Izikhungo zezempilo zingabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemali, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo zisebenze ngokubambisana nohulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze zithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhungo zezempilo? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhungo zezempilo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhaswa okuqinile kwezimali, ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwabasebenzi, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Isiphetho: Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Ngokubambisana, imiphakathi, uhulumeni, nabahlinzeki bezempilo bangathuthukisa lezi zikhungo, benza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, futhi baphucule impilo yabantu. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, okuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele.
Ukulawula imboni kagesi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezindlela ezinhle zokusebenza zik gouvernement ezingeni lesizwe nakwamanye amazwe ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa okukhuthazayo. Ubani uMphakathi Wamandla (NER)? Ukulawula imboni yamandla ngokuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezindlela ezinhle zokusebenza zik gouvernement ezingeni lesizwe nakwamanye amazwe ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa okukhuthazayo. Ukuba ngumholi emhlabeni jikelele ekulawuleni ugesi. U-National Energy Regulator angakusiza kanjani? Umthetho Wokufaka Ugesi No. 41 ka-1987, njengoba ushintshiwe, unika amandla i-National Energy Regulator, phakathi kokunye, ukuxazulula izingxabano phakathi kwabathengisi bagesi nabathengi, kanye phakathi kwabathengisi bagesi uqobo. Uma ungathanda ukuxoxa ngendlela umthengisi wakho kagesi abhekane ngayo nezikhalazo zakho, i-National Energy Regulator ingakusiza. Yiziphi izinhlobo zezikhala i-National Energy Regulator engakusiza ngazo? Nikeza yonke imininingwane efanele yesikhalazo. Bonke abathengisi bendawo kumele babe nelayisense etholelwe ku-NER. Akukho mthengisi wendawo onelungelo lokuhlinzeka noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubathengi ngaphandle kokuba unikezwe igunya yi-NER. Umthengisi wendawo akakwazi ukudlulisa ilayisense yakhe yokufaka ugesi kumthengisi wendawo omunye ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Umthengisi wendawo akanalo ilungelo lokukhokhisa amakhasimende nganoma iyiphi imali engavunyelwe yi-NER noma ukuguqula ukufakwa ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Amakhasimende asenalo ilungelo lokuqhubeka nokukhokha izimali ezivunyelwe noma ngabe umthengisi wendawo uqala ukusebenzisa imali entsha. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumuntu noma umthengisi osemthethweni endaweni okufanele kuhlinzekwe kuyo uma umthengi ekwazi ukukhokha insizakalo enikeziwe nokuthi uma efuna ukukhokha. Umthengisi wendawo kumele anikeze umthengi isakhiwo nezinga lokukhokha elifanele uma umthengi efaka isicelo sokuhlinzekwa kwensizakalo nangokucelwa. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokwazisa amakhasimende abo ngokuqhuba izinga lokukhokha, izinketho ezihlukene zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, nokuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile uma befaka izicelo zokuhlinzekwa ngogesi. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengi banelungelo lokubuza ngemali yokukhokha ezohlangabezana kangcono nezidingo zabo. Kulabo abathengi abasebenzisa ugesi we-prepaid, umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokubavulela indawo yokuthengisa lapho bangathenga khona ama-voucher. Lezi zindawo zokuthengisa kumele zibe ezitholakala kalula. Banelungelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokuthengisa ivuliwe ngesikhathi sokuthenga phakathi kwesonto, futhi ivuliwe kusukela ngo-8:00 AM kuya ku-12:00 PM ngama-wekendi nezinsuku zempilo. Ngisho noma umthengi engenamali. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokuhlinzeka nokuqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngogesi othembekile kubathengi babo futhi unomsebenzi wokulungisa noma yiziphi izinkinga ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga elihle lokuhlinzekwa. Uma umthengi ebhila, ibhili kufanele ibonise lokhu, futhi noma iyiphi imali edlulelwe umthengi ngesikhathi esithile kufanele ibuyiselwe ku-akhawunti yomthengi. Uma umthengi enza isikhalazo, bangacela umthengisi ukuba ahlole ukunemba kwemitha ngokukhokha umthengi imali ethile, ezobuyiselwa umthengisi uma kutholakala ukuthi imitha iyaphuka. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokwazisa umthengisi wendawo uma ethuthela kwenye indlu, efuna ukuvalela ukuhlinzekwa ngogesi, noma efuna ukudlulela endaweni entsha. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokufundisa kubathengi mayelana nokusebenzisa ugesi ngokuphepha, kahle, nangempumelelo noma yini ehlobene nokuhlinzekwa kagesi okungathuthukisa ukuqonda kwabathengi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kagesi. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokwazisa abathengi ngama-charges ahlukene, indlela yokufaka izicelo, umthelela wabo, kanye nokufaneleka. Khumbula ukuthi iphuzu lokuxhumana lokuqala kufanele kube umthengisi wendawo. Umthengi unelungelo lokukhala ngokuqhuba kwezinsizakalo ezinikezwa umthengisi wendawo. Uma umthengi enganeliseki ngesiphumo noma ngendlela isikhalazo esibhekwa ngayo, bangathumela udaba ku-NER ukuze bathole usizo. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokufaka izintambo zikagesi nokuhlinzeka ngogesi endlini yakhe noma endaweni yokuhlala noma empahleni. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokufuna umuntu onemfundo efanele ukuze asebenze ngogesi. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuhlola iziqu zomuntu ozofaka ugesi kanye nokuphumelela kwecala elikhishwe emsebenzini owenziwayo. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuthwala konke okwenzekayo endlini yakhe mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kagesi. Noma yini enye eyenzekayo (ngaphandle kwemitha) ngaphandle kwemingcele yomthengi iyindaba yomthengisi wendawo onelayisense. (Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuthwala zonke izimpahla ngaphakathi endlini yakhe ngaphandle kokuba kuchazwe ngokucacile okuphambene nalokho esivumelwaneni sokuhlinzekwa. Umthengi kumele abe neSithombe Esivumelekile sokuhambisana esikhishwe ngogesi obhalisiwe ofake noma ohlolile indlu. Umthengi unelungelo lokukhala ku-NER uma umthengisi wendawo enqaba noma edlula isikhathi eside ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngaphandle kokunikeza incazelo efanele. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokukhokha ugesi osebenzisa ngesikhathi (njengokuchaziwe). Umthengi unelungelo lokukhala kumthengisi wendawo uma enganeliseki ngezinga lezinsizakalo ezinikezwa. Uma umthengi enganeliseki ngendlela isikhalazo esibhekwa ngayo, banelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER, ezobheka udaba. Uma usenze isivumelwano nomthengisi wendawo onelayisense sokukuhlinzeka ngogesi, kufanele ukhokhe idiphozi njengoba kudingwa umthengisi wendawo onelayisense ngaphambi kokuxhunywa kagesi. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuxhumana nomthengisi wendawo uma engatholi izaziso zebhili zanyanga zonke. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuqhubeka nokukhokha ukusetshenziswa okwamanje ngisho noma kunokuphikisana mayelana ne-akhawunti yegesi/ibhili. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokuvikela imishini, izinsiza zikagesi, noma noma iyiphi enye impahla ehlobene nokudluliswa kagesi. Uma kudingeka ukuhlinzekwa okuqhubekayo, umthengi unomsebenzi wokufaka izicelo eziqhubekayo ezingase zivele. Uma sicabanga ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kagesi akukwazi ukuvimbela, umthengi unomsebenzi wokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokuphikisana nesiphumo. Yini okusho ukuthi ukuhweba ngogesi? Ukuhweba ngogesi kusho ukuthi inhlangano ethile esixhumaneni sokuhlinzeka ithenga ugesi ngamasheya kumthengisi bese iwuhweba kwabanye, ngaleyo ndlela inciphisa izindleko. Lo mbhalo uchaza ubudlelwano bokuthengisa phakathi komthengi ophumayo kanye/noma umninimhlaba othenga kumthengisi wendawo kagesi bese ewuhweba kumsebenzisi wokugcina, umqashi/umninimhlaba. Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ingxoxo NokuChaza Isidingo Samanzi Ahlanzekile Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani, baphumelelayo. Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile, leyo ethinta impilo yethu nsuku zonke — amanzi ahlanzekile. Umhlangano wethu namuhla uyinselelo, ngakho-ke sizoba nenhlolovo noProfesa Thandi Nkosi, onguchwepheshe emkhakheni wezokuhlanzeka kwesikhathi eside. Ngiyabonga, Profesa Nkosi, ngokuthatha isikhathi sakho ukuza lapha. Profesa Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Amanzi ahlanzekile yisihloko esiyinsika empilweni yethu. Umxhumanisi: Uthini ngempela, Profesa, mayelana nokubaluleka kokuba namanzi ahlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Amanzi ahlanzekile abaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi ajabulisa, kodwa akhulisa impilo yethu. Amanzi aphila anobubanzi bayo, axhasa imisebenzi ephilayo kulabo abavuma ukuphila. Uma amanzi engahlanzekile, lokho kuholela ezinkingeni eziningi ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ungasho ukuthi ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile kungenza kube khona ukwanda kwezinhlobonhlobo zezimpathe? Profesa Nkosi: Impela! Izifo njenge-cholera, i-typhoid, kanye nezinye izifo zokugula ziphumelela lapho amanzi engahlanzekile. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abanye abantu basakhumbula amanzi angcono, zib_halalise imithombo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola okuqhubekayo nokuhlanzeka okuhle. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubaluleka kakhulu. Yimiphi imithombo namanethiwekhi atholakalayo ukuze kube nokuhlanzwa kwemithombo yamanzi? Profesa Nkosi: Kukho izindlela eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukukwenza kube nezinye izingxenye ezifana neziteshi zamanzini, ukusebenzisa amafilitha amanzi nezinye izinhlelo zokuphatha. Ukuze umphakathi wokusebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezisebenzayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe abantu abangawuthwala kanjani umthwalo wokuba nekhaya elihlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Ukukhulisa umphakathi kufanele kube yinto ebonakalayo. Abantu kumele bathole isikhalo sokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokufundisa abantu ukuthi banakekele amanzi, bangawasebenzisi ngendlela engekho emthethweni. Ukubamba imikhankaso yokuhlanzeka nokuhlanza amanzi kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe umthelela wezomnotho ubonakala kanjani uma sikhuluma ngamanzi ahlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Akusikhulumi kuphela ngempilo, kodwa kukhona nezindleko ezithintekayo. Izinhlangano ezithile zithi amanzi ahlanzekile zingakhuphula izinga lempilo nokusebenza kahle kwezomnotho. Izindlu ezihamba phambili zidinga amanzi ahlanzekile ukuze zisebenze, futhi kulokhu, imiphumela iyabonakala. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe tuzi ungachaza izinyathelo ezenzayo emiphakathini emincane ukuze kukhuliswe isimo samanzi? Profesa Nkosi: Yebo, izinyathelo ezithile zifaka phakathi imikhankaso yokubambisana, izifundo ezikwelula umphakathi, kanye nemibango yokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu nokubambisana ngezenzo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi umphakathi uzobhekana kanjani nezingozi zamukela amanzi ahlanzekile? Profesa Nkosi: Umphakathi uthanda ukufunda futhi uthanda ukuxhumana. Uma kuboniswa izinzuzo zokuba namanzi ahlanzekile, abantu bazokwenza umzamo. Ukuhlanzeka kuyoba yinsika phakathi kwabo. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ugunyazwe kanjani ukuvala izixhumanisi phakathi kwezinzwa ezimbili, amanzi ahlanzekile nomphakathi? Profesa Nkosi: Lokhu kubalulekile. Imibukiso yokuhlanzeka ingavula indlela yokubambisana. Ukushicilela izindaba zamafutha aphuma emanzini, izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, nezinye izinhlelo ezithinta umphakathi kuzodala isithombe esisekela ukuhlanzeka. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Profesa Nkosi. Sekuyisikhathi samukele. Ngabe kudingeka uthumele ukuphawula kokugcina? Profesa Nkosi: Yebo, ngifuna kuphela ukuthi siqhubeke sifunda. Amanzi ahlanzekile akhombisa ukukhanya kwempilo. Umphakathi wethu udinga usizo lwakho, ukuze sithandazele impilo enempilo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga ngamazwi akho nemibono ecacile. Lokhu kuzoba isikhumbuzo esihle kubantu bakithi. Ngiyabonga, Profesa Nkosi, ngokwabelana nathi nolwazi lwakho. Profesa Nkosi: Ngiyabonga. Please, qhubekani nokuphambili. Amanzi ahlanzekile asivumela ukuphila phila.
