Uma inhlangano yakho iyingxenye yeqembu elikhulu noma ilungu lebhodi eliphethe, sicela usitshele ukuthi iyiphi? Olunye (Sicela uchaze): Inombolo yokubhaliswa kanye negama ngaphansi kokubhaliswa (uma kusebenza):... Inombolo yokubhaliswa elindile:... Yini eyasungulwa inhlangano? Unyaka/ Inyanga: Inhloso:..? Nikeza isithombe esifushane senhlangano yakho nemisebenzi yayo engadluli ekhasini elilodwa. Isibonelo. Bangaki abantu abathintekayo ekusebenzeni kweqembu/inhlangano kanye nephakheji? Nikeza uHlelo Lokuphathwa Kwenhlangano lubonisa isikhundla, ubulili, nenani labantu abathintekayo. Abantu bangena kanjani eqenjini/inhlangano/ isikhungo sakho? Isibonelo. Igama lephakheji ofaka isicelo ngayo:... Chaza izinhloso zephakheji yakho:... Usuku olulindelekile lokuphothulwa:..? Ubani ozothola inzuzo ephakheji yakho futhi bazothola kanjani? Le phakheji igxile ezixhumaneni zabantu bazo ziphi izinsuku: sicela uhlinzeke ngenombolo? Bangaki abantu abazothola inzuzo kulolu xhaso? Iqembu eligxile ku... Kuphi abantu abaningi obagxile kubo bahlala? Isifunda / Iwadi: Umkhandlu: Isifunda:... Ungachaza kanjani abantu eqenjini obagxile kubo ngaleli phakheji? Sicela uphumeze ibhodi efanele? Abantu abaphila noHIV/AIDS Olunye (sicela uchaze):... Uthola malini ukuze ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ofaka isicelo ngayo? Ucelwa ukuthi ubonise ukuthi uzosebenzisa kanjani le mali uqinisekisa ukuthi ibhajethi yakho ibhekela zonke izigaba ezibalulekile? Igama le-akhawunti yephakheji... Inombolo yefoni yasebhange:... Ubani eqenjini lakho ongakwazi ukusayina ama-check kule akhawunti? Usihlalo: (usayina) Igama nesibongo: Inombolo yefoni:... Umphakathi: (usayina) Igama nesibongo: Inombolo yefoni:... Umphakathi: (usayina) Igama nesibongo: Inombolo yefoni:... Igama nesibongo: Inombolo yefoni:... Igama lomphakathi ozimele ozobheka ukuphathwa kwezezimali zenhlangano: Igama nesibongo: Ikheli lokuxhumana nabo:... Nikeza amagama ezibambiso ezimbili ezimele, umholi womphakathi, kanye nomuntu onolwazi olufanele emkhakheni wakho. Ucelwa ukuthi ulethwe ubufakazi obubhalwe phansi obusayinwe yizibambiso ezibhalwe. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ngokwazi kwami nokukholwa, yonke imininingwane enikeziwe kule fomu yesicelo iyiqiniso futhi ilungile. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi imininingwane eyengeziwe yokuxhasa ingadingeka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngesikhathi sokubhekwa kwesicelo. Usihlalo, Usihlalo ophakeme, noma Umphakathi weQembu/Inhlangano/Isikhungo kumele basayine ngezansi. Umqondisi akavunyelwe ukusayina ngezansi. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi ngithole amandla okusayina le doko egameni (igama leqembu/inhlangano) futhi, ngokwazi kwami nokukholwa, yonke imininingwane enikeziwe iyiqiniso futhi ilungile. Isikhundla sakho eqenjini/inhlangano: Igama: Igama lokuqala nesibongo ... Ikheli lapho ungatholakala khona kuhlanganiswe nekheli leposi ... Ikhodi yeposi... Isicelo sakho sizobhekwa kuphela uma zonke imibuzo kule fomu iphenduliwe, amafomu nezivumelwano zisayinwe ngabantu abafanele, futhi wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo atholakala. Ucelwa ukuthi usebenzise leli bhokisi lokuhlola ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uletha amadokhumenti nemininingwane efanele ukuze kube lula ukucubungula isicelo sakho. Ikhophi yale fomu yesicelo kumele yenziwe futhi igcinwe njengobufakazi bakho. Uma usuhlole zonke lezi zikhala, isicelo sakho siqediwe.
Abesifazane benza ingxenye enkulu yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, yingakho izwi labesifazane kufanele lifakwe ezinqumweni nasekudalweni kwemithetho. Le nhlanganisela yabesifazane ezinqumweni iyilungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Abesifazane kufanele babambe iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngoba ukwenziwa kwemithetho nezinhlelo zik 정부 kuthinta impilo yabo nsuku zonke. Kubalulekile, ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi lapho abesifazane bebamba iqhaza ezinqumweni, kuholela ekutheni kube nokunakwa okwengeziwe nokwabiwa kwezinsiza okwenza kube ngcono izinga lempilo kubantu bonke. Ukwanda kokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho kungaholela ekutholeni kalula kwezinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika uthi umphakathi kufanele wazi futhi ubambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende nasemisebenzini yalo. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Abesifazane bangabamba iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngokuvota iqembu lezepolitiki abakholwa ukuthi lizomeleza kangcono imibono nezinkathazo zabo kwiPhalamende. Bangaphinde babambe iqhaza ekuhlela nasekusebenzeni kweqembu abakhethe. Abesifazane baphumelele ezikhundleni eziphakeme ngalendlela. Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi aphinde abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuwukuthi kuyindaba umphakathi ofisa ukuyizwa, iKomidi leZizwe noma iKhansela leNhlangano lingase lenze izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze iziphakamiso. Umphakathi ungazisa iKomidi leZizwe noma iKhansela leNhlangano ngemibono yabo ngezindaba eziphikisayo. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana neMenenja yePhalamende ukuze baveze imibono yabo ngengxenye yemithetho. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhuthaza ukufana kwezigaba nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho. Umthethosisekelo uqukethe izinhlinzeko ezithuthukisa ukufana kwezigaba. IBill of Rights iqinisekisa ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika. Iphika ukucwaswa okungadingekile okusekelwe kumrace nasemazingeni. IBill of Rights igcizelela ukuthi izinyathelo kufanele zithathwe ukuze kukhuthazwe ukufezeka kokulingana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Umthethosisekelo uhlinzeka ngezikhungo ezisekela ukumela kwenani elikhulu, kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane. Lezi zikhungo zifaka iKomidi Lokulingana Kwezigaba kanye neKomidi leMithetho Yamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwezinhlinzeko zomthethosisekelo, iNingizimu Afrika izibophezele ekufaneni kwezigaba ngokusebenzisa izivumelwano zomhlaba wonke ezifana neSivumelwano Sokukhansela Zonke Izinhlobo Zokucwaswa Kwabesifazane (CEDAW) kanye nePlatform for Action eyasungulwa yiBeijing Women's Conference. INingizimu Afrika iyingxenye yezinhlelo ezahlukene zase-Afrika zokusebenza nokuqhubekisela phambili abesifazane, isibonelo, iSouthern African Development Community (SADC) egxile ekufaneni kwezigaba nasekuthuthukiseni. Indlela eyinhloko futhi ebaluleke kakhulu yokuthi abesifazane babambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende ngesikhathi sokhetho. Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweKomidi leZizwe kanye neKhansela leNhlangano. Ukhetho lwesizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abakuthandayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi uhulumeni ubeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa. Umnyango omusha wabesifazane, izingane, nabantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile usunguliwe ukuze uqiniseke imizamo kahulumeni yokukhuthaza nokuvikela abantu abahluphekayo emphakathini wethu. Nakuba abesifazane bengama-majority kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, bahlala bengama-minority uma kuziwa ezinqumweni. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezivimbela abesifazane ekudlaleni indima ephelele nephawulekayo, kanti ubuphofu buyinsiza enkulu. Ubuphofu buwumsebenzi obhekene nabesifazane abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane basemaphandleni. Ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziyisisekelo ezifana nemfundo, amanzi, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kuvinjelwe ubulili, imrace, nezinga lokuphila. Ukuze abesifazane babambe iqhaza ngokuphelele ekudalweni kwemithetho, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziyisisekelo kwabesifazane kufanele kuthuthukiswe. Abesifazane abahluphekayo banokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ezikhungweni zokudala imithetho. Abaningi babesifazane babhekana nokungabi namandla kwezomnotho. Abesifazane ngokujwayelekile bangumkhakha ophuthumayo kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika futhi bavame ukuba nezinga eliphakeme lokungasebenzi noma ukungasebenzi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-HIV/AIDS ithinta ingxenye enkulu yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasha eminyakeni yabo yokukhulelwa. Ubulwane obuphakathi kwabantu besifazane buhlala buphakathi kwezinsiza ezinkulu ezibhekene neNingizimu Afrika. UbuDemokhrasi bethu obukhulayo bukhulise ukufinyelela kwabantu besifazane kumandla ezepolitiki nasezinqwabelweni. INingizimu Afrika iphinde yamukela imithetho eqondile yokukhuthaza ukufana kwezigaba. Inselelo iwukwenza ukuthi amalungelo afinyeleleke kubo bonke abesifazane. Ukumela kwabesifazane kwiKomidi leZizwe sekukhule kakhulu kube ngu-45%. Amadoda adlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni ukufana kwezigaba emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Amadoda amaningi aqala ukuphikisa ubulwane obuphakathi kwabantu besifazane nezingane. Amadoda kufanele aguqule indlela ababona ngayo izinto futhi ahloniphe abesifazane. Bobabili amadoda nabesifazane banendima efanayo futhi ebalulekile ekuguquleni ubudlelwano bezigaba emphakathini. Akukho mphakathi ongaba khona ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokucindezelwa kuze kube abesifazane nabamadoda bekhululekile futhi belingana, futhi ngaphezu kwalokho, amadoda nabesifazane babelana ngenkululeko eyodwa.
Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-20, umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima ezihlanganisa iziMpi, iziqhumane, kanye nezinkinga zomnotho, okuholele ekubeni izigidi zabantu zibe sengcupheni. Uhlanga lwezizwe lwaludinga ukuxhumana, lufuna indlela yokubuyisana, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwe-United Nations (iZizwe Ezihlangene) ngo-1945. Ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili, izizwe eziningi zafuna ukuvikela ukuphindaphinda kwezingozi ezinjengalezi. Umqondo wawuwukuthi abantu badinga ukuhlanganiswa, badinga indawo yokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla. I-United Nations yathathwa njengendlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezizwe ukuze kube nokuthula emhlabeni. Yasungulwa eNew York, lapho izizwe ezingu-51 ziqhube umhlangano wokuqala, umgomo wayo waba ukuvikela ukuthula, ukukhuthaza ubulungiswa, kanye nokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabantu. Abaholi babezama ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, i-United Nations yathola amandla futhi yaqala ukuhlela imihlangano, izinkulumo, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abahluphekayo. Izigaba zayo ezahlukene, ezifana nomnyango wezempilo, umnyango wezokudla, kanye nomnyango wezokuthula, zathola izinsiza ezinkulu ukuze ziqhube umsebenzi wazo. Izinsuku zashintsha, izimpi zashintsha, kodwa i-United Nations yahlala ikhuluma. Kwakukhona izinkinga eziningi ezazidinga ukuxazululwa, okuhlanganisa ukungalingani, ubuphofu, nezinkinga zemvelo. I-UN yaphendula ngokwakha izinhlelo ezahlukahlukene, efuna ukusiza abantu, ikakhulukazi abahluphekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-United Nations yathola udumo emhlabeni, izinhlelo zayo zakhula, zafinyelela ezindaweni eziningi, zakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono. Le nhlangano yenza izinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni, kodwa akuzange kube lula. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho izinhlelo zayo zaziphazamisekile, futhi abaholi baziqhenya ngezizathu ezahlukene. Abanye babebona i-United Nations njengomkhiqizo wezizwe ezithile, okwaholela ezinkulumweni ezinzima. Kodwa i-UN yaphikelela, yazi ukuthi umsebenzi wayo wawubalulekile, futhi izinkinga ezazikhona zidinga ukuxazululwa. Ngasekupheleni kwawo-2000, i-United Nations yenza umkhankaso omkhulu wokubhekana nezinkinga zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezokuphepha, ezemvelo, nezokuthuthukiswa. Umgomo wayo waba ukuvuselela umhlaba, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. I-UN yaphinde yasungula izinjongo ezithile zokuthuthukiswa kwezeMvelo (Sustainable Development Goals) ukuze ikhuthaze izizwe ukuthi zisebenze ndawonye. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni izizwe zisebenzisane, zixoxe ngalezi zinkinga ukuze zithole izixazululo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, abantu baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwe-United Nations, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni umhlaba. I-United Nations yaphinde yaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu, lapho izinkinga zixoxwa khona, futhi izixazululo zifinyelelwa. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi, i-United Nations yahlala ibalulekile, ikhubaza abantu ukuthi, uma benza umsebenzi ndawonye, bangakwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. I-United Nations ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zingaba zinkulu, umoya wokubambisana ungakwenza konke. Ekugcineni, i-United Nations iyisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangahlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze baphumelele. Ngaphezu kokuba yindawo yokuxoxisana, ibuye ibe yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, emhlabeni onobunzima, ukuthula nokubambisana kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngakho, i-United Nations iyinsika yokwakha umhlaba ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bephila ngokuthula, bejabule, futhi bephila impilo enempilo. Ibonisa ukuthi, uma sikhumbula ukuthi sonke singabantu, singenza izimanga.
Uma unok complaint, isiphakamiso, noma ukuncoma... Sazise uma uzwa ukuthi kukhona insiza ekuphathile kahle! Kufanele ukhumbule ukuthi ungathola kuphela izinsiza zezempilo e-Addington uma uhlala ezindaweni ezilandelayo... Kubalulekile ukuqala endaweni yezeMpilo eseduze! Uma wena noma ingane yakho iguliswa, ungachithi imali yakho ngezokuthutha, kodwa hamba endaweni yezeMpilo njengoba uzothola usizo olufanayo nolwakho esibhedlela ngoba kukhona om nurse abaqeqeshiwe abazokuhlola, futhi uma kudingeka ukuthi ubone udokotela noma uthathwe i-X-ray, um nurse uzokuthumela esibhedlela ngenhlamvu yokudlulisa. Yini inhlamvu yokudlulisa? Le yinhlu oyitholayo uma um nurse ekuthumele esibhedlela. Lokhu kuzomsiza udokotela ukuthi azi konke mayelana nesifo sakho noma sesifo sengane yakho. Uma ufika esibhedlela, ungathatha le nhlamvu, uzothola imiyalelo, uphathwe, bese ukhuthazwa noma ukhumbuzwa ukuthi usebenzise indawo yakho yezeMpilo? Ngabe kufanele ngikhokhe malini? Kuzodingeka ukhokhe ngokwezinga lethu lababhali. Kuphela uma uhamba ukuze ubone odokotela endaweni yethu yezeMpilo. Khumbula ukuthi noma yisiphi isifo onaso kufanele sithathwe ngokuhlonipha. Sizokweseka ngokunakekela nangokuhlonipha. Abaguli bethu kufanele benze okufanayo kubasebenzi bethu bezempilo. Uma udinga noma yiluphi ulwazi noma unemibuzo edinga izimpendulo, buza ngoba kuyilungelo lakho. Njengoba sisho lapha e-Addington -- MASEMUKHULUMENI NDLOVU!
Izikhukhula Kwakukhanya emini, izinkanyezi zikhanye phezulu ezulwini, kodwa uThandi wayesebenza kanzima emakhaya. Wazi kahle ukuthi ngesikhathi sehlobo, imvula iyajuluka, futhi isikhathi sokuhlwanyela silindelekile. UThandi wayezama ukugcina umndeni wakhe uphila kahle, kodwa izimo zazingasebenzi kahle. Ngobusuku obuhlwanyelayo, isikhumbuzo senhlekelele sasilungiselela. Imvula eqhubekayo yavela, iphumela kwezintaba, iyokhukhula izindlela eziphakeme. UThandi noMama wakhe babecabanga ukuthi kuzoba nje imvula ejwayelekile, kodwa njengoba izinsuku zedlula, izimvula zanda, zikhanya kancane, zibe zinde. Umoya ubhuhudlile, izihlahla ziqhume, kuyacaca ukuthi into eyenzekayo ibikwenza kube nzima. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi waphuma emzini, ebona umfula ugeleza ngendlela engajwayelekile. Amathafa abebekade efuywa ngempumelelo, sephenduke izinkanyezi ezimnyama. “Mama, ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kuyinto engalungile,” kusho uThandi, ebukeka esaba. UMama wakhe wamaphakathi, emgibisela phansi, “Ngiyazi, mntanami, kodwa asikwazi ukulinda. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo.” Ngokushesha, umndeni wanquma ukulungisa izimpahla zabo, baphakamisa okuthile okubalulekile – ukudla, izingubo, nezithombe zokholo. UThandi wayezizwa edumele, ebona umhlaba wakhe uhlelekile usukhanya, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kufanele baqhamukele phezulu. Uthando kakhulukazi lwenza ukuba baphumelele. Izinsuku zedlula, imvula yayiqhubeka. UThandi noMama wakhe babebuka emihlanganweni yezakhamuzi, bejabulela ukubona abanye bezama ukuncedisa. “Siyafuna ukusiza,” kusho uMnumzane Khoza, ophakamisa isandla. “Kuyabakhona izikhumbuzo zalesi sikhathi, kodwa asikwazi ukukhipha imfudumalo yethu.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umfula waqhubeka nokugeleza, ugcwalisa izindawo ezizungezile. Leba impilo, izigameko zokuqala zenzeka – izindlu ezincane zibhakabhaka, izivunguvungu zimemeza, izinyoni zithokozisa izinsuku eziningi. UThandi noMama wakhe bahamba phezulu, behamba ngezinyawo, bezama ukufuna indawo ephephile. Lapho behamba, uThandi wabona umngani wakhe, uSipho, ehamba nathi. “Uthando lwakho lungaphola, kodwa izikhukhula zifuna uthando lwendlu,” kusho uSipho. UThandi wathi, “Kodwa yilokhu okwakuzokwenza sikhululeke.” USipho waphendula, “Ukwazi ukuyilungisa. Thina akufanele sikhohlwe isiko.” Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyishumi, umfula wagcwala kakhulu, ugcwalise umhlaba. UThandi noMama wakhe bazama ukufuna indawo yokuphepha. Bafika endaweni eyaziwa kakhulu – umuzi owayekwa ngesisekelo sokholo, lapho abantu bezama ukusiza. “Hamba, mntanami,” kusho uMama, “siyakwazi ukusiza.” Ngaphambi kokuthi bakwazi ukufika, uThandi wabona ubuhle obuphuma phakathi kokukhanya. Ekhumbula izinsuku ezinhle, waqala ukuhamba. “Sizoda,” kusho uMama, “ukuba sizoba semathafeni.” UThandi wayezwa umoya othokozisayo, kodwa umoya wawuthokozisa, wawufana nomkhumbi ophuma emanzini. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezinde, umfula waqala ukuhamba phansi, izikhukhula zancipha. UThandi noMama wakhe babuyela emakhaya, behlola izimpawu zokuhlukana. Imizi yayingabikhona, kodwa umndeni wawukwazi ukuhlanganiswa. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba nokuqonda okukhulu – izikhukhula zingashiya umonakalo, kodwa uthando lwabo lungahlala luhlaza. Uthando lungaphola futhi lukhulise ubumnandi bempilo, noma ngabe izikhukhula zikhona. Umndeni wawubona izinto ezinkulu – uthando, umoya, nokuqonda. UThandi wagcina ebhalela incwadi, ethumele izinkanyezi, ezibhalwe ngothando futhi enobuhlakani. “Ngokubukeka, asikwazi ukulinda, kodwa sizokwazi ukuqhubeka.” Kanjalo, izikhukhula zashiya umhlaba, kodwa uthando lwaluhlala lukhona. UThandi noMama wakhe babuyela emakhaya, behamba ngezinyawo, beshaya izinkanyezi ezindaweni ezinhle. Umhlaba wawubumbene, kodwa uthando lwabo lwaluhambisana nabo. Ngaleyondlela, umndeni wathola impilo entsha, ithokozisa, futhi ubumnandi bephila. UThandi wathola ukuthi, ngisho nezikhukhula ezingavela, uthando luhlala lukhona, luhlaza njalo, futhi luzokwazi ukwandisa. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo empilweni yakhe, ukuthi isimo sabantu singaguquka, kodwa uthando lungahlala luhlaza. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi waba nesikhathi sokukhumbula, futhi waba nesifiso sokwenza izinto zibe ngcono.
Ulimi lwabantu ngandlela-thile "luyisikhumba sesibili," lumele okuthile okungokwemvelo kwabantu, ngalo sikhombisa ithemba nezifiso, sikhuluma ngemibono nemigomo yethu, sihlola ulwazi lwethu namasiko, futhi sakhe imiphakathi yethu nemithetho yokuphatha. Ngolimi, singasebenza njengabantu emhlabeni oshintsha njalo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethayo liyaqashelwa yiBill of Rights kanye neSikhumbuzo sethu, esiqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziyinsiza okufanele isetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi, ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eqotho, ekugcineni sikwazi ukwethula uhlaka lwezinhlelo zolimi lweNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuwukuphela komsebenzi oqale ngo-1995, lapho ngathumela iLanguage Planning Working Group (LANGTAG) ukuba iphakamise uhlaka oluhlangene lwezinhlelo zolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sasisibalulekile ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuphikiswa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi kanye nomphumela wokuthi "ukusebenza kwe-multilingualism kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe lusekelwe emiphumeleni yezindlela zokubambisana ngokubonisana, lusebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG kanye nezinsiza zeMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neLanguage Policy Advisory Group. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luyadingeka ekuphatheni izinsiza zethu ezihlukahlukene zolimi nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kukahulumeni ezinjongo zokukhuthaza ubulungiswa, ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nokuhlangana kwesizwe. Kungalesi simo esihle ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zelizwe lethu, njengoba kuhlelwe nguMthethosisekelo, kube nendawo ebonakalayo kulolu hlelo. Lolu Hlelo lweZinhlelo luphinde luphakamise ukuthi ukubaluleka kwezilimi zethu kubonakala kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwazo komnotho, kwezokuxhumana, nasezombusazwe. Uma ulimi lulahlekelwa ukubaluleka kulezi zimo, isimo salo siyehla. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luphinde lukhombise ukuthi sibhekene nezinselelo zokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele nokuthi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye ye-technology eshintshashintshayo. Ngakho-ke, kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi sizobuyisela isimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngiyethemba ngokuhlonipha ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela lolu Hlelo lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe njengelabo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ngokubambisana, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi lolu hlelo luba yimpumelelo ezimpilweni zethu, futhi lusenze siqhenye ngempilo yethu ehlukile yaseNingizimu Afrika. SAQA Ibhodi Yezifundo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona cishe izilimi eziyi-25 ezahlukene ezikhuluma eNingizimu Afrika, ezifaka phakathi izilimi eziyi-11 ezinikwa isimo esisemthethweni ngokulandela isigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996), ngokusekelwe kumfuneko yokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufanele kube ngu-98% wabantu bonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni ziyi-isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, kanye ne-siSwati (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeNguni); Sesotho, Sepedi, kanye neSetswana (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeSotho); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi, kanye ne-Afrikaans. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi. Isici esivelele sokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izilimi eziningi zomdabu zidlula imingcele yezifunda, zikhuluma phakathi kwemiphakathi yalolu limi ezindaweni ezahlukene, okukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezazihlonishwayo ngaphambili futhi kukhuthaza ukwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi, uma nje abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bekhululekile ukusekela izilimi ezingezona ezomdabu njengokubalulekile, okuyizilimi ezisemthethweni zalesi sikhungo. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi eNingizimu Afrika bekukade kunzima ngenxa yokungabi khona kohlelo olucacile lwezilimi, okuholele ekusetshenzisweni kwesiNgisi nesi-Afrikaans njengezilimi ezibusayo ezithinta izici zokuxhumana, umnotho, nezombusazwe zomphakathi wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kuhulumeni wenhlalakahle, INingizimu Afrika ifinyelele endaweni ebalulekile emlandweni wayo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baphendule ekwehlukeni kwabo kolimi nasemasikweni kanye nezinselelo zokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi, yingakho uHlelo lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe lwenziwa. Lolu Hlelo lweZinhlelo aluqali nje indlela entsha yokubhekana nezilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika kodwa futhi lukhuthaza kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu njengezilimi ezisemthethweni ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuqhubeke nokwakha ubunye bezwe. Luhlinzeka ngokuqashelwa okubanzi kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi, ubulungiswa bezokuxhumana, ukufinyelela okufanele ezinhlelweni nasemithonjeni yomphakathi, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Le ndatshana ibeka uhlaka olungasetshenziswa yinhlangano ehlangene yokwenziwa kwezilimi ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeMthethosisekelo. Kusukela ekuqaleni kokuhlala kwabantu baseDutch eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1652, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwezimpi zokubusa kweBrithani, i-Union of South Africa, kanye nohulumeni wobandlululo, kuze kube sekuphumeleleni kukahulumeni wenhlalakahle ngo-1994 nokufakwa kokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi emthethweni, uhlelo lwezilimi lukahulumeni kanye namandla eziphathimandla alwehluleka ukuqashelwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela wale simo kube ukungalingani, lapho ukuphathwa kwesiNgisi nesi-Afrikaans kudala ubudlelwano obungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zabo zomdabu kanye nalezi zilimi. Ngakho-ke, izinqubomgomo zolimi zobandlululo nezobandlululo, ezihlanganiswe nezinqubomgomo zomphakathi, umnotho, nezombusazwe, zaveza ubusuku bezilimi, ukungalingani okukhombisa izakhiwo zobuhlanga nezokuhlukaniswa okwakha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke lezi zimo zehlisa isimo sezilimi zomdabu nezinhlelo zezilimi zabantu bomdabu nezinye izigaba ezaziphikisiwe, kuhlanganisa neKhoi neSan - kuqhubeka nemibono emibi ngezilimi ezimnyama, okungagwenywa kuphela ngabakhuluma isi-Afrikaans nesiNgisi, kodwa futhi ngabanye abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu uqobo. Lesi simo siba sibi kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi, ngenxa yezizathu ezingacacile nezimpi zamandla eziphikisa ukufakwa kwezilimi eziningi, uhulumeni nezikhungo ezizimele zine ndlela ethile yokwenza izinqumo zolimi eziphikisana nezingxenye zomthethosisekelo kanye nezidingo ezihambisana nezilimi. Isigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo sinikeza uhlaka olusemthethweni oluphezulu lwezilimi eziningi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuhlonishwa nokubekezela kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi eNingizimu Afrika. Kuqinisekisa amalungelo
Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabalimi abasanda kuvela? Kubalulekile kakhulu emkhakheni wokukhiqiza ukudla ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezivimbela abalimi abasanda kuvela ekuthuthukiseni ukuba abalimi abakhokhelwayo. Uhlelo lokulungiswa komhlaba olwethulwe nguMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube yinkinga enkulu kubantu abaningi - imvamisa le nqubo ihamba kancane, ithatha isikhathi eside, futhi ngenxa yalokho, abalimi abasanda kuvela balahlekelwa amathuba amaningi okuthuthuka, kanti abalimi abamhlophe nabo bayakhathazeka futhi bagcina bethengisa amapulazi abo kwabanye ozakwabo abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba awuvumelani ngentengo nokumaketha. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuba umnikazi womhlaba - lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuba umnikazi wangempela wepulazi, ukuqasha umhlaba womunye, kuya emhlabeni osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke - awekho amalungelo omthetho abopha abanikazi ("kuvunyelwe" kuphela ukuba abantu bahlale lapho). Umhlaba ophethwe ngabanye ungasebenzisa njengesiqinisekiso semalimboleko, kodwa umhlaba osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke awukwazi ukusebenza njengesiqinisekiso sokuthola imali. Ezindaweni lapho umhlaba osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke, kuvamile ukuthi umndeni othile ube nendawo ethile (lokhu kuyahluka ngendawo), bese umkhiqizi (umalimi) ofuna ukwandisa imisebenzi yokulima kufanele axhumane nabanye abantu balo mphakathi ukuze athole imvume yokulima endaweni yabo. Akukho mfuneko enikeza isiqinisekiso sokulima le ndawo etholelwe ngale ndlela esikhathini esizayo. Ukwenza ngcono impilo yomhlabathi kanye nezinga lephosphate kubiza kakhulu - izikhuthazo zidingeka ngoba abalimi abasanda kuvela abanamandla okukhokha lezi zindleko. Ikakhulukazi, umhlaba okhona ongasebenzisa abalimi abasanda kuvela awugcinwanga kahle, izinkambu azinayo imikhawulo, futhi awekho amabhande lapho amanzi angagijima khona. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unegatsha leMisebenzi Yomhlaba, kodwa imali abanakho ibalulekile kakhulu ukuze kwenziwe lo msebenzi obalulekile. E-Ningizimu Afrika, umhlaba ongaphakanyiswa awukwazi ukulima, awukwazi ukutshala lapho futhi ulindele umkhiqizo omuhle. Kodwa ukuguqula umhlaba ongaphakanyiswa ube umhlaba wokugaya kuyinqubo ende futhi ebiza kakhulu. Abalimi abaningi abasanda kuvela abanamandla okuguqula futhi baqhubeke nokulima izinkambu ezingasebenzi, kanti abanye baphinde bayeke lezo zinkambu, beyeka ukulima. Konke lokhu akukuhle. Ukwakha izithiyo noma odongeni noma indlu yokuhlala kuyinkinga kubalimi abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho umhlaba osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke ngoba izithiyo ziba nezinkinga futhi izilwane (izinkomo nezimvu) zigijima ezinkambini ngendlela efanelekile. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abasanda kuvela abane-access kumhlaba (noma nganoma yiziphi zezi zindlela ezichazwe ngenhla), kodwa abanamathuluzi adingekayo ukuze balime lowo mhlaba. Amathuluzi amasha abiza kakhulu, abalimi abasanda kuvela bahluleka ukufinyelela kuwo, futhi awekho amaningi amabhange noma ezinye izikhungo ezilungele ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuthenga amathuluzi esikhathini esedlule. Lapho kukhona amathuluzi angasetshenziswa, lawa mathuluzi imvamisa awasebenzi kahle. Imvamisa, isivumelwano sokuthenga umhlaba mayelana nokushintsha kobunikazi bomhlaba sithi umthengi kufanele athathe ipulazi lonke kanye namathuluzi (ukusebenza okuqhubekayo), bese umthengi uthola amathuluzi amadala aphukile. Inhlangano yabalimi ihlinzekwa ngamathuluzi kodwa akekho ozokwenza ukuzibophezela ekugcineni nasekulungiseni lawa mathuluzi. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo yokulima, ikakhulukazi ekukhiqizeni ukudla okubalulekile, ibibhekene nengcindezi. Unyaka odlule wawusengaphansi kokulawula ngoba izitshalo zatshalwa ngemali yokuqala yonyaka odlule, umkhiqizo wathengiswa emakethe yonyaka, futhi ezindaweni eziningi, imvula ibingaphezulu kwesisindo. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa abazokwazi ukutshala ngaphandle kokuthola imali. Uma izinzuzo zincipha, izinga lenzalo emalini ebolekiwe liyanda futhi kunezingozi ezingavela ekutshaliseni ukudla okubalulekile, akusasebenzi ukuhweba le mali edingekayo ukuze kuqaliswe imbewu emhlabathini. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka (amabhange) zidinga 'ibond' emhlabeni othile ukuze kuqinisekiswe imali. Abalimi abaqashile izinkambu, noma labo abalima emhlabeni womphakathi, abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo nsizakalo ukuze baqinisekise imali, futhi izinhlangano ziyaphika ukuvuma izicelo zabo. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka zidinga umshwalense ukuze le mali isetshenziswe ukuqala ukulima (okokufaka). Kodwa umshwalense wokuqala (naka uvunywa) uqala ukusebenza kuphela uma izitshalo ziqala ukukhula. Ngaleso sikhathi, umalimi usukhokhele zonke izindleko. Ezinye izinhlangano ziye zaphika ukuhlinzeka ngemali ngaphambi kokuvunywa komshwalense. Manje uzokwenzenjani? Umlilo uphumelela kokubili - akekho umgwaqo wokuphumelela. Enye inkinga yile: umshwalense uphinde uzibophezela ekukhokheni u-65% wezindleko - ubani ozokhokha izindleko ezisele? Ngaphandle kokuthi, kufanele sisho ukuthi kube khona abalimi abasanda kuvela abangenakukhokha imali yabo, ngakho labo abahlinzeka ngemali abasenakufuna ukuhlinzeka ngemali kalula. Ukulima kunzima kakhulu, futhi uma ungabi nolwazi nolwazi, uzobeka impilo yakho engcupheni. Uma izinzuzo zincane, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Ngakho-ke, abalimi abasanda kuvela abasaqondi kahle umkhakha wokulima bathola kunzima ukuthola imali ngoba izinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngemali azithembi, ziwabeka icala. Abalimi abasanda kuvela "bafunda," badinga ukwesekwa, badinga ukuqeqeshwa, badinga ukufundiswa ngabantu abanolwazi. Abantu abasebenza kuMnyango Wezolimo noMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba imvamisa bahluleka ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esidingekayo. Abaningi abazi lutho ngokuqhubeka kokulima, abaqondi kahle, abaningi bazama ngoba bafundile kodwa bangenakufaka "umshayo emhlabathini." Ukuphakamisa abantu kubiza imali futhi kuthatha isikhathi. Izingxenye eziningi zomnyango zikahulumeni zinezinhlangothi eziningi ezisebenza lapho futhi zikhokhelwa kodwa azinayo isipiliyoni. Lapho abantu bangaphandle abafana namabhizinisi befuna ukuza ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo, kufanele kube nomthombo wemali - kodwa ekugcineni, ubani ozokhokha lezo zindleko? Imvamisa abalimi bathola isimo lapho bengazi ukuthi yimuphi umyalezo okufanele balandele - bazokholelwa ukuthi ubuholi obuhlinzeka ngolwazi bukhuluma iqiniso noma ukuthi ubuholi 'be agribusiness' obufuna ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, noma inhlangano ethi ibasekela, noma labo abazama ukufundisa ukulima (Ngaphezu kwalokho, bonke laba bantu bathi into efanayo)? Ukufunda ukulima kusho ukuthi kufanele uthathe izinyathelo ezingaholela ezinkingeni eziningi - uma abantu befuna ukuba abakhiqizi, kuzokwenzeka ukuthi benze amaphutha. Kunomneed enkulu yokusekela labo abazame kodwa bahl
Umbiko: Intsha YaseNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Njengoba izwe lihamba phambili, intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inethuba elikhulu lokwenza umehluko. Le mibiko izobheka izici ezahlukene zempilo yentsha, okuhlanganisa imfundo, amathuba emisebenzi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemiphumela yokuphila kwansuku zonke. Imfundo Imfundo iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yentsha. E-Ningizimu Afrika, uhulumeni usebenzise izinsiza eziningi ukuze uthuthukise imfundo, kodwa izinkinga zikhona. Izikole eziningi zihlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lemfundo. Intsha ibhekene nezithiyo ezinjengokuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezifundo ezithile ezingahambisani nezidingo zempilo yangempela. Nokho, intsha ibonisa ukuzimisela okukhulu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethuthukayo, lapho abafundi bephusha imikhawulo ukuze bathole imfundo engcono. Amathuba Emisebenzi Ngokukhula kwenani labantu, amathuba emisebenzi ayancipha. Intsha ibhekene nenkinga yokungasebenzi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izindlela zokuphila. Izinhlangano eziningi zisebenza ukuze ziqinise amathuba emisebenzi, zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuzithandela, izifundo ezikhethekile, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuholela ekwakheni amakhono amasha, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha ibonisa ubuhlakani bokwakha amabhizinisi amancane, okukhombisa ukuthi inezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Ubuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe buye baba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yentsha. Ngokwanda kokufinyelela ku-inthanethi, intsha ikwazi ukufunda, ukuxhumana, nokwakha amathuba amasha. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi, futhi zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukile, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ezokwakha, nezokuthengisa. Intsha ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, lapho izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze zikhulume nentsha. Imiphumela Yokuphila Kwansuku Zonke Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ubuphofu, ukungabi namsebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphoxeka, kodwa intsha ibonisa amandla okuphila. Izinhlangano eziningi zisebenza ukuze ziqinise intsha, zikhuthaza ukuzibandakanya emiphakathini, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, okukhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe. Nakuba ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, intsha ibonisa amandla okuphila, ubuhlakani, kanye nezindlela zokwakha amathuba. Ukuze intsha iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthola imfundo, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza. Ngale ndlela, intsha izokwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabo, kanye naseNingizimu Afrika jikelele.
Isiqubulo: "IPhalamende enakekela ethuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha ukuze kufezwe inkululeko yezezimali." "Umlando wethu uhlale uphoqelela abantu abasebasha ukuba bakwazi ukubhekana nomsebenzi besesebasha. Bangabantu abalwa nenkululeko kanti kufanele baphume noma babe esikoleni. Manje intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu ngenxa yokungabi namathuba kweminyaka eminingi, ngenxa yobudlova nokuphazamiseka kwezemfundo. Kuzodingeka abantu abanomoya wokukhuthazela futhi bazibophezele ukuze baphumelele ezitheni futhi ukuze abantu abasebasha bakwazi ukujabulela ngokuphelele izinzuzo ezilethwa yidemokhrasi ezinzile." Usuku lweNtsha ngoJuni 16 lwenziwe usuku lokuphumula emphakathini nguhulumeni odemokhrasi ngemuva konyaka ka-1994. Lokhu kuhlonishwa ukuphakama kwentsha okwenzeka ngoJuni ngo-1976. Unyaka wonke unikezelwe ekugubheni impi yentsha eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Kuyisithonjana sempilo yentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika, eqalwe ngo-1976 yaphumelela kuze kube idemokhrasi yafinyelelwa ngo-1994. Le mpilo yentsha yaholela ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lwezemfundo oluhlonipha isithunzi, ukuhlukahluka kwezamasiko, kanye namandla okhetho, futhi ilwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela okufanayo. Intsha yase-70s yadlala indima ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe lethu. Iqhubeka nokudlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini, futhi uhulumeni odemokhrasi uphinde uzibophezele ekuthuthukiseni intsha njengabab领导 bezikhathi ezizayo nabavikeli benkululeko yethu esiyitholile kanzima. Izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha zifaka phakathi ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. Umthelela we-HIV/AIDS nomkhuhlane uqondile kakhulu kubantu abasebasha. Imindeni ephathwa abantu abasebasha nezingane ezincane iyanda ngenxa yokufa kwabazali okubangelwa yizifo ezithathelwana, njengokhuhlane lwezitho zomzimba, oluhlotshaniswa kakhulu ne-HIV ne-AIDS. Ekuhlangabezaneni kwesimo sezwe, uMongameli uJacob Zuma uthe unyaka ka-2011 unyaka wokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Uthe imisebenzi kufanele igxile ekuthuthukiseni intsha. Ukuze kubhekwane nokungabi namisebenzi, uhulumeni utshala imali ukuze akhokhele izindleko zokuhola abantu abasebasha ukuze akhuthaze abaqashi ezinkampanini ezizimele ukuba babaqashe noma bengakaze basebenze ngaphambili. Udaba lokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo, amakhono, kanye namabhizinisi amancane kudlalwe kakhulu engxoxweni yezezimali ethulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2011/2012. UNgqongqoshe wezeMali ubonisile ukuthi usizo lwezezimali lwabafundi luzokwenyuka ukuze lunikeze abantu abasebasha ithuba lokuqhubeka nezifundo zabo nokuqeqeshwa ezikoleni, ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono abo. Imali eyengeziwe inikezwe iNational Skills Fund, okuyimali ebekwe eceleni ukuze iqeqeshe abafuna imisebenzi. Uhulumeni odemokhrasi usungule izinhlelo ezifana neNational Youth Development Agency (NYDA), enikezwe umthetho wokubhekana nazo zonke izindaba ezithinta intsha, kusukela kumgomo kuya ekuthuthukisweni. I-NYDA iyinhlangano esungulwe nguhulumeni ukuze iphendule ngqo ezinselelweni zezimali ezibhekene nabantu abasebasha, futhi iphinde ibe yindlunkulu yokuthuthukiswa kwemali, eyenzelwe ukusungula ipulatifomu yokwakha imisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, nokudluliswa kwamakhono kubantu abasebasha baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcina isiqubulo: "IPhalamende enakekela ethuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha ukuze kufezwe inkululeko yezezimali," iPhalamende isungule izinkundla eziningi ezibhekana nezindaba ezibhekene nentsha. Lezi zikhungo zinomsebenzi wokubheka yonke imisebenzi ehambisana nezindaba zentsha futhi kufanele ziphathe ukuphathwa kwemithetho ethinta abantu abasebasha. IPhalamende isungule izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezimbonini ezahlukene, ngokwesibonelo, iPhalamende leNtsha (elenzeka ngenyanga yentsha) lapho izindaba ezihlobene nentsha zixoxwa khona. Abantu okufanele babambe iqhaza bangabantu abasebasha, futhi imizamo eqhubekayo ibhekiswe kubo. Umthethosisekelo ubopha iPhalamende ukuba ibandakanye umphakathi emisebenzini yayo, ngakho-ke intsha njengengxenye yomphakathi ikhuthazwa ukuba ibambe iqhaza ezithangamini zephalamende, njengemihlangano yomphakathi, iNkulumompikiswano kaMongameli, nezinye izinhlelo zokufinyelela umphakathi. Bangaphinde baveze imibono yabo ngokwenza izethulo zomlomo noma ezibhaliwe. Intsha iphinde ibe yingxenye yomphakathi ozohlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi lapho imisebenzi eminingi yePhalamende yenziwa khona, futhi abantu abasebasha bangahamba ezihlanganweni zephalamende ukuze babone ngokwabo, bathole ulwazi, futhi bazithuthukise.
Joyina ubambiswano phakathi kuk governo kanye nomphakathi ukuze usekele labo abahlukunyezwa. Gqoka iribhoni emhlophe ukuze ubonise ukuzibophezela kwakho. Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ngenkathi sikhuluma ngesimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi leli zwe libhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezinzima. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphazamiseka, umnotho wethu ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima ezifana nokungasebenzi, ukwehla kwemali engenayo, kanye nokwanda kwezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngentshisekelo yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngengxenye yokungasebenzi. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi amazinga okungasebenzi aseNingizimu Afrika aphezulu kakhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okukhathaza umphakathi, kodwa futhi kuthinta umnotho jikelele. Abantu abangenamsebenzi bahlala bezama ukuthola amathuba, kodwa izinkampani zikhathazekile ngokukhula kwezindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile, ezifana nokukhuthaza imfundo ethuthukile kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu amakhono adingekayo emakethe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwehla kwemali engenayo kubonakala njengomunye wemiphumela emibi yokungasebenzi. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezama ukuphila ngezindleko eziphansi, kodwa lokhu akukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukwehla kwemali engenayo kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokukhuthaza umnotho, njengokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okungaba nomthelela omuhle ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Ngokubheka izindleko zokuphila, sithola ukuthi zikhula ngokushesha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izindleko zokudla, ezokuthutha, nezokuhlala zikhuphuka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokulawula lezi zindleko, mhlawumbe ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuthenga ezithengekayo kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo kubantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokwakha umnotho ohlangene. Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika udinga ukuba ube nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi banamathuba amaningi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sikhuthaze ubuchwepheshe, imboni, nezinsizakalo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nemiphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke. Ngokuphetha, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sinesimo esinzima, kodwa akukhona okungapheli. Uma sithatha izinyathelo eziphusile, singakwazi ukwakha umnotho onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi ohlangene. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nethemba, futhi sikhuthaze izixazululo eziphusile ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umnotho wethu ungathuthuka, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, futhi sikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni umnotho onempilo.
Uhulumeni wendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokwakha imiphakathi engakhethi phakathi kuhloswe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokusiza uhulumeni bendawo ukuba benze umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lokukhuthaza inqubomgomo ngokusebenzisa iMthetho Wokuhulumeni Wendawo kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kohla olusha lwezomthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomphakathi kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi kubalulekile. Ngemva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngoDisemba 5, 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zohulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba indima yokuhlela edlule, i-IDP ivele njengezinsiza zokuphatha ezimiphakathini futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo ngezindaba ezifana nokwabiwa kwezimali zomphakathi, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxoxisana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwemiphakathi kuphela kodwa kufanele ziqondise kahle uhlaka lokusebenza kwezikhungo noma ezimbonini eziseduzane nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingekho emthethweni, ukwesekwa kwemboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomphakathi. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi kwesinye isikhathi ibihlangabezana nezinkinga zokulungiselela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Izinhlaka eziningi zomphakathi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Oguquko) zazingenazo izinsiza nezikhono zokuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe kule ndawo, futhi bekungekho izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezibekiwe nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinselelo, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima benze kahle kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kunemiphakathi embalwa esithole intuthuko enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Izikhombisi ze-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elihlukile le-DPLG ngoxhaso lwe-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula yokuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha olwakhiwe kubaphathi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kuhlanganisa bonke ababamba iqhaza abavela emiphakathini. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zomphakathi (PIMSS) luyakhiwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zokuhulumeni bendawo. Inani elikhulu lemiphakathi, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yohulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango ehlukene yezimboni kuhulumeni ezweni lethu iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele ekwakhekeni kwale mikhombandlela ye-IDP. Nginezithemba eziphezulu zokuthi le mikhombandlela ehlanganisiwe ezishicilelwe izoba umhlahlandlela useful futhi umthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enhlanganweni ye-IDP nezizathu zenu zokwenza i-IDP ibe ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ehlobisa ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isikhombisi sesibili sisiza ekwenzeni imiphakathi iphumelele ezinhlelweni zayo ze-IDP. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuhlobene nezinto ezenzeka lapho kulungiselelwa isigaba sokuhlela. Ngamafuphi, umqondo wenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela, incazelo yokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe, kanye nezizathu zakho (1.1) Ukwethula nokuchaza izidingo ezibekwe emthethweni ngokusebenzisa ukuhlela (1. Amadokhumenti ahlaziywe (nokuqukethwe) okufanele akhiwe ngenxa yesigaba sokulungiselela ukuhlela (1.3) ekugcineni, ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wokuqukethwe kwalesi sikhombisi (isikhombisi sesibili siqukethe izinkomba kuzo zonke lezi zinyathelo zenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela nezinyathelo ezidingekayo). Yini okufanele ilungiswe? Ukudweba i-Integrated Development Plan kuthatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye, kuhilela abantu abahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle komphakathi. Le nqubo idinga ukuhlela ngokucophelela nokuqonda. Idinga uhlelo lwezebhizinisi. Ukuhlela ngaphakathi kwenhlangano kufanele kuqale kanye nezinqumo mayelana namalunga eqembu, amaKhansela, nezakhiwo ezizobe zikhona. Uhlelo olwakhiwe kufanele lwenziwe lucacise imisebenzi ehleliwe, isikhathi sokuphothulwa, nezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwenza ukuhlela. Le nqubo yokuhlela ibaluleke kakhulu ekulandeleni nasekuxhumaneni nabanye ababambiqhaza (ikakhulukazi phakathi kwemiphakathi yendawo nezikhulu zesifunda). Kubalulekile ukuba neqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana nezindima nezimo zokubambisana ezizobanjwa umphakathi nabanye ababambiqhaza ngesikhathi sokulungiselela. Ubani okufanele abambe iqhaza kule nqubo, ubani ozothinteka, futhi bazokwaziswa kanjani ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka kwenqubo? Lezi zonke yizinkinga okufanele ziphendulwe ukuze kwaziswe abantu ngesikhathi futhi kuphathwe kahle izinsiza ezidingekayo. Izinhlelo ezifanayo zingahlelwa ngezindima nezimo ezizobekwa kulabo abavela ngaphandle komphakathi, njengemiphakathi eminye, izifunda, kanye nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni. Le misebenzi yokubambisana kufanele ibekwe ngendlela ebindayo kumphakathi ngokusebenzisa uhlaka lokuhlela oluhlanganyelwe oludingeka ukuthi lwenziwe kahle ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti adinga ukucatshangelwa ngaphambi kokuthi uhlelo luqale ayaziwa futhi atholakale. Umsebenzi wokulungiselela i-IDP awuyona imfanelo yezikhulu zamakhansela. Inqubo yokulungiselela kufanele ibe nomthelela ekuzilungiseleleni komphakathi ngokusebenzisa inqubo ye-IDP. Ngakho-ke, akekho ozokwenza isinqumo somphakathi ngaphandle komphakathi uqobo. Isikhombisi sesibili sihlose ukusiza umphathi womphakathi ekwenzeni umsebenzi wokulungiselela ngendlela elula futhi eqondile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nezidingo ezibalulekile ezilindelekile ezingeni lomphakathi uma kudalwa inqubo ye-IDP kanye nokuxhumana okufanele nezakhiwo zikahulumeni, izinhlelo zenqubo kufanele ziphathwe nguMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi ka-2000. Lo Mthetho awubeki lutho oluhlukile mayelana nezimo ezijwayelekile zokwenza izinhlelo. a Ukwamukela uhlelo olubhalwe yimikhiqizo yendawo noma yesifunda futhi luphakanyisiwe ukuze kuhlolwe inqubo yokuhlela, ukuhlela, ukwamukela, nokubuyekeza i-IDP. Lo mbhalo obhalwe nge-IDP uzobizwa ngokufushane ngokuthi "Uhlaka Lwenqubo" lwesikhombisi. Izimo, izindima, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana nokubambisana okufanele kwenziwe nomphakathi, izakhiwo zikahulumeni, amaKhansela endabuko, kanye nabanye ababamba iqhaza enhlanganweni ye-ID
Umbuzo 1: Yini amahlathi? Impendulo: Amahlathi, noma amahlathi amnyama, yizindawo ezinkulu ezinezitshalo nezilwane eziningi. Ziqukethe izihlahla eziphakeme, izimpande ezinamandla, kanye nezitshalo ezahlukene. Amahlathi adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ahlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, umoya opholile, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Umbuzo 2: Kungani amahlathi ebalulekile? Impendulo: Amahlathi abalulekile ngoba ahlinzeka ngempilo ebalulekile. Athuthukisa umoya opholile, avikele umhlaba ekugugumeni, futhi akha izindawo zokuhlala ezahlukene zezilwane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlathi anikela ngezinsiza ezifana nezinkuni, izithelo, nezitshalo ezisetshenziswa emithini. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izilwane ezitholakala emahlathini? Impendulo: Emahlathini, sithola izilwane eziningi ezahlukene njengezinyoni, izinyamazane, izimpungushe, kanye nezilwane ezinkulu ezifana nezindlovu. Lezi zilwane zidinga amahlathi ukuze zihlale, zifune ukudla, futhi zikhule. Amahlathi anika lezi zilwane indawo yokuphepha. Umbuzo 4: Kuthiwani ngempilo yomuntu emahlathini? Impendulo: Amahlathi ayindawo yokuphumula nokuzijabulisa kubantu. Abantu bavame ukuvakashela amahlathi ukuze baphumule, bahambe, noma baphuze amanzi. Ukusebenza emahlathini, njengokulima, kunceda abantu bahlale bephila kahle. Amahlathi anikela ngamathuba okucwaninga nezifundo ngezinto eziphilayo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izingozi ezibhekene namaahlathi? Impendulo: Amahlathi abhekene nezingozi eziningi ezifana nokukhishwa kwezihlahla, ukungcoliswa komoya, kanye nokuguqulwa kwesimo sezulu. Ukukhishwa kwezihlahla kungaholela ekwehleni kwezilwane ezithile, kanti ukungcoliswa komoya kubangela ukuthi amahlathi aphile kancane. Kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amahlathi. Umbuzo 6: Yini esingayenza ukuvikela amahlathi? Impendulo: Ukuze sivikele amahlathi, kufanele sithuthukise imikhuba yokuphila esebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugwema imithi enobungozi, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinkuni, kanye nokuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlala ezihambisana nemvelo. Imicimbi yokuvikela amahlathi, njengokuhlanza, ingasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngamasiko ahlobene namaahlathi? Impendulo: Ezinye izinkolo namasiko ahlobene namaahlathi. Ezinye izizwe zikholelwa ukuthi amahlathi anamandla okuphila, futhi ziwahlonipha njengezindawo ezingcwele. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo, okwenza kube nokuhlonipha amahlathi. Izinkanyezi nezinkolelo zamasiko zikhumbuza abantu ukuba bahloniphe lezi zindawo. Umbuzo 8: Yini esingayifunda emahlathini? Impendulo: Emahlathini, singafunda okuningi ngezindlela zokuphila, izimfanelo zezinto eziphilayo, kanye nezixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu nemvelo. Ukuhamba emahlathini kusiza abantu baqonde ukuthi imvelo iyaphila futhi ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Lokhu kucacisa umthwalo wemfanelo ekuphathweni kwemvelo. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani amahlathi angaguqulwa abe yizindawo zentuthuko? Impendulo: Ukuze amahlathi angaguqulwa abe yizindawo zentuthuko, kufanele kube nokuhlelwa kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokwakha ezihambisana nemvelo, ukugcina izindawo eziluhlaza, kanye nokuvikela izilwane nezitshalo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zentuthuko nezokuphila kwemvelo kubalulekile ukuze sithole ibhalansi. Umbuzo 10: Yini esiyithola ekugcineni? Impendulo: Ekugcineni, amahlathi ayisikhumbuzo sokubaluleka kwemvelo empilweni yethu. Ukubona amahlathi, ukuhamba phakathi kwezihlahla, nokuzwa umsindo wezinyoni, konke lokhu kusinika umuzwa wokuxhumana nemvelo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithokozisa amahlathi, sikhuthaze abanye ukuba bahloniphe futhi bavikele lezi zindawo ezibalulekile. Amahlathi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu, futhi kumele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ukugcina lezi zindawo ziphilile.
uHuawei - Umcimbi Omkhulu Wokwaziswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, idolobha leBeijing labanjelwa umcimbi obalulekileyo wokwaziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, owaziwa ngokuthi "uHuawei Connect 2023". Lo mcimbi wahlanganisa osomabhizinisi, abakhiqizi, ochwepheshe, kanye nabanye abantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, bonke bejolise ekukhuleni kwezobuchwepheshe. UHuawei, inkampani edume ngezixazululo zayo ezithuthukile emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ibonise izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe namabhizinisi. Umsakazo omuhle wavela eBeijing, lapho abavakashi behlangana ukuze bazohlanganyela ulwazi, ukukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha, kanye nokuxoxisana ngezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga zomhlaba wamanje. Umcimbi uhlanganise izethulo ezimnandi, ama-workshops, nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abaziwayo, bonke bejolise ezintweni ezithinta ubuchwepheshe obuvela kuyo yonke imikhakha. Phakathi kwalesi sikhathi, uHuawei wakhombisa ubuchwepheshe bayo obukhulu, ikakhulu emkhakheni wezixazululo ze-5G, ama-robots ahlakaniphile, kanye nezixazululo ze-Cloud. I-5G, eyanelisa umhlaba wakhe, iyisihluthulelo sokuqhubeka komnotho, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezokuxhumana, ezokuthutha, nezokwelapha. Umbono kaHuawei uwukuthi, ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, bangasiza amabhizinisi ukuba akhule futhi abe namandla. Umlando walesi sikhungo, esinqumweni sawo sezobuchwepheshe, ukukhombisa ukuthi uHuawei uyinselelo eqhubekayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ezinye izinkampani zingase zimise imikhakha emisha, kodwa uHuawei usebenza ngokuguqula indlela esiphila ngayo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokwakha izixazululo ezizokusiza ukuthi uphumelele emhlabeni ophuthumayo, ngokusebenzisa amandla wobuchwepheshe namathuba amasha. Ngaphandle kwezethulo zomkhiqizo, umcimbi uphinde uvulwe ngenhlonipho yokucela iziqondiso ezivela kubaholi bezobuchwepheshe. Lezi ziqondiso zibaluleke kakhulu eqhulwini njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga eziphuthumayo, njengezinguquko zezimali, izinguquko zesimo sezulu, kanye nezithiyo zentuthuko. UHuawei ushilo ukuthi, ngezinqubomgomo eziqondiswe kahle, kungenzeka ukuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili ezizosiza umphakathi. Umlayezo ophumelelayo wombhoxo ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengisi kanye neziqu zabaqhudelana. UHuawei uphinde wavula ithuba lokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabathengisi bezezimali, abacwaningi, nabakhiqizi, bonke behlangene ukuze baphumelele. Umsebenzi wokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze kuzuzwe impumelelo udinga ukubambisana okuqinile, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwababambiqhaza. Ngaphezu kokugxila kumkhiqizo, futhi, uHuawei ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokwazi ngokuqonda izidingo zamakhasimende. Abakhiqizi bahlala besebenzisana nabathengi ukuze baqonde kahle izimfuno zabo. Le nqubo yokuxhumana ibaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izidingo zabathengi zikhula ngokushesha, futhi uHuawei uphinde uzinikeze ithuba lokwazisa izixazululo ezihlukile, ezithokozisayo nezisebenzayo. Umsakazo wezobuchwepheshe ucacisiwe umbono omuhle kokubili abaphakanyisi nabathengi. Bhala izinhlelo ezizayo ezifanele ukuthi zisize umphakathi, uthola indlela yokuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Abantu banezinkinga ezithile, futhi uHuawei uthola ithuba lokwenza izinto zibe lula nokuhlangabezana nawe. Ekugcineni, uHuawei unikeze umbono othembisayo, oholayo ngempumelelo emnothweni owandile. Ngamaqhinga amasha ahlakaniphile kanye nobuchwepheshe, ukumisa izixazululo ezintsha ziyindlela enkulu yokuphumelela. Imicimbi efana nalena ihlinzeka indlela yokuba nebhande eliqinile elihlanganya abantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, ngenhloso yokuthola izixazululo ezikhula kulokhu phambili. Umlayezo wokugcina ubonisa ukuthi lokho kuhlanganyela kuzothuthukisa ikakhulukazi umnotho wabantu. Uma zonke izisebenzi ziqhuba phambili, sizokwazi ukuthola umphumela omuhle emhlabeni jikelele. UHuawei uqhubeka phambili, ushowa indlela eqondile yokuhamba phambili ukuze sakhe ikusasa elithembisayo. Lo mcimbi uhlanganisa izifiso zomphakathi, kanye nomgomo wokwakha ubuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili, okuqinisekisa ukuthi sizokwazi ukuthola isixazululo esiqondile emhlabeni onobuhlakani.
uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Namuhla ngizokhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile emlandweni wethu, okungukuthi, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976. Lolu suku luhlonishwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi luhlanganisa izinkumbulo ezinzima, kodwa futhi zinesifundo esibalulekile esithinta izizukulwane eziningi. Sizobuyela emuva kancane, sikhumbule ukuthi kwenzeka ini ngaleso sikhathi. NgoJuni 16, 1976, eSoweto, abantwana bephuma ezikoleni, bephakamisa izwi labo ngokuphikisa ukufundiswa ngolimi lwesiNgisi. Abantwana babenokukhathazeka okukhulu, bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzobathinta kakhulu empilweni yabo. Uhlelo lokufunda lwakha umphakathi, kodwa abantwana babengafuni ukuba bahlupheke ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle isiNgisi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uhlelo lwezemfundo lwaluhamba phambili, kodwa lwalunokungalingani okukhulu. Abafundi abamnyama babenokufunda okungaphansi, kanti abamhlophe babelungiselelwe kahle. Lokhu kwadala umuzwa wokungabi namandla phakathi kwabantu abasha, futhi kwavula umnyango wokuphikisa. Uhlelo lwemfundo lwaluhambisana nezinhlelo zikaHulumeni, ezazigxile ekwakheni umphakathi owodwa, kodwa lokho akuhambelani neqiniso. Abantwana beSoweto bahlala behlupheka, futhi lokho kwaba yisizathu sokuthi baphume emigwaqweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imihlangano yokuqala yamaBasha yenzeka, lapho abantwana behlangana khona, bephakamisa izwi labo. Uhlelo lokuphikisa lwakha umoya ophilayo phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokho kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavela izinkanyezi eziningi, abantu abanjengoHector Pieterson, owayengumfana ophuthumayo, owathinteka kakhulu kulolu suku. Uthando lwakhe nolwazi lwakhe lwashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSuku lwaBasha lwashintsha, lwaba usuku lokukhumbula. Ngonyaka wezi-1976, abantu baqala ukuhamba bephakamisa izikhumbuzo, behlonipha lezi zinsuku ezinzima. Iziphathimandla ziqhubekile nokubamba izinkulumo, zikhumbula labo abashonile, futhi zikhuthaza abantwana bethu ukuba baphakamise izwi labo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSuku lwaBasha lwaba usuku lokubuyisana, lokukhumbula, nokwakha. Abantu baqala ukuhamba bephakamisa izinkumbulo, behlonipha labo abashonile, futhi beqonda ukuthi impilo yabo ibalulekile. Uhlelo lwezemfundo lwalusashintsha, kodwa abantwana basha bahlala behlakanipha, bephakamisa izwi labo. Namuhla, uSuku lwaBasha luhlonishwa emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini. Abantu bayahlangana, behlonipha, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kuhlangana kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, ukuze sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yethu ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sibe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Ngakho, mngani, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 akukhumbuli nje ngempilo yamaBasha, kodwa futhi kukhumbuza ukuthi thina sonke sinesibopho sokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Abantwana bethu badinga ukufunda, badinga ukuba nomoya ophilayo, futhi badinga ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhumbulekayo, kodwa kuyisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi kufanele sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabanye. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinkumbulo zizokwenza ucabange ngempilo yakho, nendlela ongayithinta ngayo. Uthando, umoya ophilayo, nokukhumbula izinsuku ezinzima kumele kube yisifundo esiyinhloko kithi sonke. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sikhumbula, sikhuthaze, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle.
Imvume yokusebenza yokuhlonza amakhono akhethekile inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle onamakhono noma iziqu ezikhethekile. Ingaphinde inikezwe amalungu omndeni walowo muntu. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi le-embassy noma emsebenzini waseNingizimu Afrika. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-1738. Faka ipasipoti yakho okumele ibe semthethweni okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngemva kokuphela kokuvakasha okuhlose. Faka i-curriculum vitae enemininingwane kanye neziqinisekiso ezivela kubaphathi bakho bangaphambilini. Ubufakazi bezimali ezanele ngokuhlinzeka ngamakhasi ebhange, ama-payslips, kanye neleta yokwesekwa evela kumamukeli wakho eNingizimu Afrika, izifundo, izimali zezokwelapha, noma imali uma ikhona, kuhlanganise namakhadi wesikweletu noma ama-checks okuhamba ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindleko zokuphila ngenkathi ungena eNingizimu Afrika. Isitifiketi sokuvakatshelwa, uma kudingeka. Thola incwadi evela kumnyango kahulumeni wangaphandle, noma kumnyango kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, noma esikhungweni semfundo eNingizimu Afrika noma inhlangano yamasiko noma yebhizinisi, eqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono noma iziqu zakho akhethekile. Hlinzeka nganoma iyiphi ubufakazi obukhombisa ukuthi amakhono noma iziqu akhethekile, njengamaphepha akhishwe noma iziqinisekiso. Cela umqashi ofuna ukukuhola ukuthi agcwalise isigaba sika-13 sefomu le-BI-1738. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku ezingu-30.
Ukubhekwa kweqiniso kwemiyalo yezenhlalo yindlela yePhalamende yokwenza ukuthi uhulumeni uhlale enezibopho kubantu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlala kuqapheka (ukulandela) izinhlelo zohulumeni. IPhalamende kanye neKomidi zinegunya lokubiza noma ubani noma isikhungo ukuze lunikeze ubufakazi noma lukhombise imibhalo ethile, bese libika kubo. Umthethosisekelo uthi iPhalamende inegunya lokuvakashela bonke ozakwethu bezwe, kuhlanganise nalabo abakwezifunda kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Yini ukubhekwa kokusebenza kohulumeni? Ukuvakashela kohulumeni emiphakathini kuyimsebenzi onikezwe iPhalamende nguMthethosisekelo ukuze kuqapheke futhi kulandwe ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsizakalo zohulumeni. Kungani indima yePhalamende yokubhekwa kohulumeni ibalulekile? Ngokuhlola izinhlelo zohulumeni, iPhalamende ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu kuyenzeka, ukuze bonke abantu baphile impilo engcono futhi enhlonipho. Lokhu kwenza ukusebenza kohulumeni kube sobala futhi kukhuphule ukwethenjwa komphakathi kuhulumeni. kanye neNhlangano Yezifunda (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). Iziqu zikaPhalamende zinegunya elithile lokubhekwa okufanele zibe nalo. Umthethosisekelo uthi iNhlangano Yezwe ikhethwe ukuze temsilise abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni onobungozi kubantu ngaphansi komthethosisekelo. futhi ukuze ibheke ukusebenza kohulumeni kazwelonke, kanye nokuphumeleliswa kwemithetho edlulisiwe yiPhalamende. I-NCOP temsilisa izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zihlala zixazululwa ngaphakathi komkhakha kahulumeni kazwelonke. Indima ye-NCOP ukuhlole ukusebenza kohulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke lezifunda nohulumeni bendawo. I-NCOP ingacela ukuba ilungu leKhabhinethi, isisebenzi sikahulumeni kazwelonke, noma uNgqongqoshe wezifunda baye emhlanganweni weNdlu noma ikomidi. Amakomidi ePhalamende asungulwa njengamathuluzi omabili amaZwe ngaphansi komthethosisekelo ukuze aqaphe futhi alandele uhulumeni. La makomidi "awumshini onamandla" wePhalamende wokubhekwa kohulumeni nokwenza umsebenzi wezomthetho wePhalamende. Amakomidi ahlaziya imithetho, aqapha uhlelo lokusebenza kohulumeni, futhi axhumana nomphakathi. Ingxenye ebaluleke kakhulu yomsebenzi wokubhekwa kohulumeni emiphakathini ukuhlela imibiko yonyaka yezinhlangano zikaHulumeni ngamakomidi, kanye nemibiko ye-Auditor-General. Ngokwezinhloso zokuhlola ukusebenza kohulumeni, ikomidi lisemsebenzini wokucela umbiko omfishane kulungu leState noma lizovakashela le ndawo ukuze liqinisekise amaqiniso. UNgqongqoshe WezeMali umemezela iziphakamiso zebhajethi zonyaka wezezimali olandelayo, kanye nezivote zebhajethi zazo zonke izinsizakalo. IPhalamende kumele ivume iBhajethi. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwezivote zebhajethi, ikomidi ngalinye linomhlangano neNhlangano ehambisanayo kahulumeni lapho lisebenzisa ukubhekwa komphakathi ngoba amalungu omphakathi abizelwe. Lokhu kusebenza njengokuhlola ukuthi ingabe iNhlangano igcine imisebenzi yayo yokusebenza kusukela konyaka odlule, futhi ingabe isebenzise imali yentela ngendlela efanele. Ukubuza imibuzo kuhulumeni kuyindlela eyodwa iPhalamende elawula ngayo uhulumeni. Imibuzo okufanele iphendulwe ngenkulumo noma ngokubhala ingaqondiswa kuMongameli, kuMongameli Osenyaweni, kanye noNgqongqoshe mayelana nezinkinga ababhekene nazo. Isikhathi semibuzo sinika amalungu ePhalamende ithuba lokubuza amalungu ohulumeni mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu, temsilisa amaqembu abo ezepolitiki noma abantu abavotele bona. Ngokusebenzisa le ndlela, amalungu ePhalamende angakwenza izitatimende endlini, nganoma iyiphi indaba. Ngokunikeza Isaziso Sokuhlangana, ilungu lanoma yisiphi isikhungo sepolitiki ingaletha izindaba noma izinkinga ukuze zixoxwe kwiPhalamende, ngaleyo ndlela kusiza ukuhlinzeka indima yabo yokubhekwa komphakathi njengohulumeni. Ukuxoxisana kwePhalamende kuyindlela ethile yokuletha ulwazi olubalulekile phambi kohulumeni ukuze kubhekwe izinhlelo ezithile zohulumeni noma imithetho edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lezakhamuzi unikeza amalungu ePhalamende ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokubandakanyeka ekubhekweni komphakathi ngokwabo. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lezakhamuzi unikeza indlela eclose yokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu ePhalamende nomphakathi. Amalungu anomsebenzi wokwazisa iPhalamende nganoma yiziphi izinkinga abazitholayo ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana nomphakathi. Ukwenza isethulo kuKomidi lePhalamende kuyindlela ethile yokwenza izwi lakho libonakale kwiPhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokuthonya imibono yamalungu eKomidi axoxa ngengxenye ethile yephrojekthi ngaphambi kokuba ibe umthetho ophumelelayo. Wonke umuntu ophila eNingizimu Afrika unelungelo lokufaka isicelo kwiPhalamende, njengoba kubhalwe emthethosisekelweni. Noma ubani, iqembu labantu, noma inhlangano ingafaka isicelo kwiPhalamende. Isicelo singumbuzo osemthethweni kumagunya ukuthi athathe isinyathelo. Singathatha ifomu lokucela, isicelo sosizo, noma ukuphinda kuthunyelwe izikhalazo.
Abalimi abayisithupha baphakanyisiwe emncintiswaneni okhetha umlimi ophambili obizwa: Umlandeli Wokukhula Kwezimboni Zokudla Konyaka (2008). Umlandeli okhethiwe uzomenyezelwa ngo-Okthoba 17 emcimbini omuhle owenziwa yiGrain SA. U-Deliwe wazalwa ngo-1961 eKrugersdorp Kagiso, wayengumntwana kaMnz noNkz Ntebele ababevele kuqala. Ubaba wakhe wayengumlimi, kanti unina wayengumama ophumula emakhaya. U-Deliwe ushade noMnz Olebogeng Mutlwane futhi banezingane ezimbili. U-Deliwe uthola amandla nokwesekwa kubazali bakhe nenkosana yakhe. U-Deliwe wafunda e-Aobakwe Primary Itsoseng eNyakatho Nentshonalanga futhi waqeda iNdebe yeziNhlanu e-Reeitumetse Secondary. Waqhubeka nezifundo zakhe futhi wafundiswa ukuba uthisha e-Bethel Seminar futhi wafunda i-N6 ekwakheni (ukwakha izindlu). Ngemuva kwalokhu, wasebenza eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya. Ngo-1991, u-Deliwe washiywa emsebenzini wakhe futhi waqala ukulima kancane kancane waze waba umlimi ophakathi nendawo ngo-2002. Uthenga ifamu eMarotse (eduze kweDelareyville) futhi ulima nabazali bakhe. Ungum member weFrischgewaagd farmers' study group endaweni yeDelareyville; ubefunde izifundo ezimfishane (futhi usaqhubeka nokufunda) ezifana: Ukuphatha Nokugcina AmaTractor Nezinsiza Zokulima, Ukwethulwa Kwezokukhiqiza Uthuli, Izifundo Ezithuthukile Kwezokukhiqiza Uthuli Nokumaketha, Ukuphathwa Kwezimboni Zokulima Nokuphathwa Kwephrojekthi; lezi zifundo zixhaswa yiGrain SA, NWK, Promise Farmer, kanye neBusiness Today. U-Deliwe usemsebenzini wokulima okuzimele iminyaka emine - ukhiqiza uthuli nezinkukhu futhi uphila izinkomo, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezimbuzi. U-Isaac Khuto wazalwa ngo-1944 eBoksburg lapho ubaba wakhe ayengumsebenzi wesitolo. Ngesikhathi enezinyanga ezimbili, abazali bakhe bamthumela eFicksburg ukuba ahlale nonkosikazi wakhe nomalume wakhe futhi wakhula efameni. Ngisho namuhla remembers lapho enezinyanga eziyisixhenxe esebenza izimvu, futhi remembers iphunga elimnandi elivela ezindaweni ekuseni kanye nezulu elclear elamvumela ukuba abone izintaba zeLesotho kahle. Bavame ukubuka amaTractor elima ezindaweni zeLesotho futhi wacabanga ukuthi kuzoba kanjani ukushayela lelo tractor. U-Isaac waya esikoleni efameni futhi wabe eseya eSekondari eFicksburg lapho aqeda khona iNdebe yesi-8. Ngemuva kwalokhu, wasebenza eFraser eFicksburg iminyaka eyishumi nambili. Waziswa ngokuthenga nokuthengisa futhi waqala ukusebenza ngokwakhe ngokuthenga nokuthengisa imifino nezithelo. Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, wathola nokuqonda kokuthenga itekisi - waqhubeka nokukhulisa leli bhizinisi kusukela ngo-1978 kuya ku-1998. Ngo-1983, u-Isaac wabona ithuba lokungena ebhizinisini lezokuvakasha wathenga ihhotela/ikhaya labavakashi. Usanalo lelo hhotela futhi unelayisense yokuthengisa utshwala. Njengoba ekhula, u-Isaac waba umqeqeshi ophambili wezokubhokisa. Waqala njengomuntu ophakathi nendawo ngo-1960 waze waba ngochwepheshe. U-Isaac uthi, "emkhakheni wokubhokisa, ungowakho kuphela nesiphiwo sakho sokulwa," - wafunda ukunakekela yena khona. "Lapho kungekho ndawo yokuphunyuka, lapho ufunda khona ukubhekana nokuphila ngqo futhi uqhubeke wedwa." U-Isaac usaqeqesha iklabhu yokubhokisa eFicksburg futhi wayengumholi weFree State Boxing Federation. Ungumholi weGrain SA farmers' study group eFicksburg. Ngo-1998, u-Isaac wathenga ifamu yeDiyatalana enezinkulungwane eziyi-230 futhi waqala ukulima. Wayefuna ukuthenga ifamu yonke enezinkulungwane eziyi-460 kodwa wayesaba ukuthatha umthwalo omkhulu kangaka - ngakho bahlukanisa ifamu wathenga ingxenye. Ngeminyaka engu-2006 wayekwazi ukuqasha izinkulungwane eziyi-65 zomhlaba omuhle eduze. Ngo-2007/2008, u-Isaac wathola isivuno esijwayelekile se-3.5 tons/ha yothuli ezinkulungwaneni eziyi-79 kodwa wabhekana nesiphepho seqhwa kumathuli akhe, isivuno ezindaweni sisasebenza kahle. U-Isaac ushade noLerato futhi bane mwana oyedwa nezingane ezimbili. U-Mapahle wazalwa efameni yeMagdelena, lapho ubaba wakhe ayesebenza khona, endaweni yeFouriesburg ngo-1969. Babekhona izingane eziyisishiyagalombili - abafana ababili nezingane zesifazane eziyisithupha. U-Mapahle waya esikoleni eMashaeng Township ngaphandle kweFouriesburg, eqeda iNdebe yeziNhlanu. Ngamasonto, uvame ukuya efameni eduze kaMnz Linde du Plessis, lapho ashaya khona iTractor futhi asiza emsebenzini wefamu. U-Mapahle ubone ukuthi uMnz du Plessis ulima kahle - wayefuna njalo ukuba nefa lakhe. "UMnz du Plessis ungisizile kakhulu ukuba ngikhule uthando lwami lokulima futhi ngihlale ngilalela iLesedi FM ukuze ngizwe ukuthi uNkz Jane McPherson uthethani ngokuqhuba ukudla efameni okungisizile ukuba ngisebenzele isifiso sami sokuba umlimi," uMapahle uhlala ethi. U-Mapahle wasebenza eMnyangweni Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi eFouriesburg Border Post kusukela ngo-1993 - 2007. Ngo-1996 waqala ukukhulisa izinkomo nezimvu emhlabeni owawusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke eFouriesburg. Ngo-2004 waqasha izinkulungwane eziyi-30 zomhlaba kumlimi wezomnotho uMnz Osborne, efaka uthuli. Ngo-2006 waqasha izinkulungwane eziyi-4,179 zomhlaba kumasipala waseFouriesburg - usaqhubeka nokulima lapho okwamanje. U-Mapahle uthi, "Mhlawumbe ngizokwazi ukuqasha izinkundla ezinhle ezinezivuno ezingu-400 hectares kule nyanga, kodwa ngifuna iGrain SA ukuthi ifike kuqala ukuhlola umhlaba." U-Mapahle ushade noDianne futhi bahlala eMashaeng nezingane zabo ezintathu. U-Boy wazalwa efameni endaweni yeMiddelburg ngo-1948 lapho ubaba wakhe ayesebenza khona. Wayeya esikoleni efameni kule ndawo futhi waqeda iNdebe yesi-5. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubaba wakhe wayelima kancane emhlabeni owawusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke endaweni yeVlaklaagte. U-Boy uthi usakhumbula kahle ukuthi wayelima nobaba wakhe esebenzisa izinkomo ukuze aphume. Ngo-1981, u-Boy waqala ukulima izinkundla ezinqashwe kuhulumeni ezingu-10 hectares. Ngemuva kwalokhu, wanikezwa indawo engu-50 hectares endaweni yeVaalspruit (eduze kweBronkhorstspruit). Okwamanje, u-Boy ulima ifamu enezinkulungwane eziyi-545, eqasha kuhulumeni futhi eqasha izinkulungwane eziyi-300 zezinkundla ezilimiwe kwabanye abalimi. Izinselelo zolayini emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs Emadolobheni amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika, abantu bakhala ngezinhlelo ezinzima zokufinyelela kwezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa ehhovisi leZindaba Zasemaphethelweni, elaziwa njengama-Home Affairs. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngokuqinisekisa ubunjalo, imvume yokuhlala, nezincwadi zokuhamba. Kusukela ezinsukwini zeCovid-19, izinhlelo zokuhamba e-Hom Affairs ziye zanda kakhulu. Izikhungo eziningi zikhala ngokuqashwa okunganele kanye nezinsiza ezincishisiwe, okuholela ekubeni nezinsizakalo ezivela kancane. Lokhu akubanga nje ubunzima kuphela ekutholeni izincwadi ezisemthethweni, kodwa kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuphathweni kwempilo yabantu. UJohn Mthembu, ongumlamli ubenengxoxo nekhanda lefilimi, uthe: "Ngivame ukuzama ukuya ehhovisi le-Home Affairs, kodwa ngibona ukuthi izinsuku ezingu-10 noma ngaphezulu ukuze ngithole indawo. Lokhu kuphazamisa kakhulu izinhlelo zami, futhi ngiyazibuza ukuthi kungani kungafuneki kube phakathi kwemizuzu embalwa." Izinto eziyinqaba zenzeka emashumini edolobha, lapho abanye abantu bekhombisa ukunganeliseki ngezinsuku ezikhuphukayo zokulinda. Izinombolo zabantu ezingenakufinyeleleka ziyavela emoyeni onamandla, njengoba izinsuku zokusebenza ezivamile zingagciniwe ngalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka okukhulu emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi kubantu abayingxenye yezenhlalakahle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uhulumeni uthe ubheke ukuthuthukisa izinqubo zokuqhuba eHaffisi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwandisa inani labasebenzi abanogcozi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi ezizovumela abantu ukuthi bakwazi ukwenza izicelo zabo ngekhompyutha zabo. Nokho, kusalindwe ukuthola ukuthi lokhu kuzoba namathuba aphumelelayo ngaphambi kokuba kugqashuke. Okungabazisayo, izinsuku zomphakathi zikhombisa ukwanda kokuhlaselwa kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Abantu bahlala emigqeni emide, kanti abanye bayeza ukuze bazame ukuthola imvume yokuhlala, noma izincwadi zokuhamba, kodwa babe nezinselelo ezinkulu. UDr. Siphesihle Zulu, owaziwa njengomholi wezokuhlaliswa, uthe: "Lokhu akukhombisi kuphela ubunzima, kodwa futhi kubonisa indlela esizilungiselela ngayo izinsiza." Imithombo yezeMidlalo I-Afrika ibeke phambili ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngama-Home Affairs kwempumelelo enkulu yezenhlalakahle. Ukuhlunguzeka kwezinsiza kusebenza kakhulu ezikhathini ezinzima, njengoba izinto ezilindelekile zikhombisa izinkinga ezifana nezinsiza ezithile ezingenakufinyelelwa. Ophathinhloko bezempilo bahlongoza ukuba uhulumeni aqinise ukukhethwa kwezinsiza, ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo. Lokhu kusebenza ngokuhlakanipha, okulindeleke ukuthi kuzokwenza izinqubo zokubhalisela izinqumo zibe lula. Ukuze kuqinise ukuphathwa kwempela kwezinsizakalo, picha kufanele kube izindlela eziza yena. Umlingani empilweni yansuku zonke uThandi Ndlovu, oshayele uhulumeni izinsuku eziningi ukuxhumana, uthe: "Ngikhethiwe, ngihamba emigqeni, ngihlala kude. Lokhu konke kudinga ukuhamba kahle, kodwa uhlelo olufanelekile alunikezi." Okukhona kungabazisayo, uThandi akagculiseki ngensizakalo enikezelwa kulolu hlelo. Ukuze kube nempumelelo yempilo, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemthethweni kubaluleke kakhulu kwezokuphila kwabantu. Esikhathini esizayo, uhulumeni kufanele abone ukuthi umqondo wezinsiza ubalulekile futhi ungavuma izinhlelo eziseduze ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimpilo zabantu. Okwenziwa yizikhungo ze-Hom Affairs kuzocacisa uma abantu befuna ukwenziwa ngosizo lwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo nezikhuthazayo. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemthethweni, kuzodala ukuhamba kahle eminyakeni ezayo. Kodwa, kwenziwe kahle ukuze kuhlikishwe izinhlelo phakathi kwalabo abaphathe i-Hafice. Njengoba umnyango uzame ukwenza izinguquko ezithile, abanye abantu basaqhubeka nokuhlushwa izinkinga ezibandakanya ubungako obuncane bezinsiza, ubunzima bezinqubo zokubhalisela ezigelezeni. Kuhlala kucacile ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile ku-Hom Affairs zidinga ukwandiswa nokwenziwa ngcono, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ngosuku oluthile. Lolu hlelo luzobhekwa kahle ngethemba lokuthi kuzokwenziwa izinguquko ezifanele ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola okuqukethwe okuthile ukuze baphile impilo engcono. I-Hom Affairs izokhuluma kulolu chungechunge, yazi lokhu kumqoka ngaphansi kwezinsizakalo ezibaluleke kakhulu ezizobukeka kahle.

Uphi umphenduli owazalwa, usuku, inyanga, kanye nonyaka? Yini isimo somshado somphenduli? Ingabe umphenduli uke waya esikoleni? Yiliphi izinga lemfundo abalikhiphe? Yini imvelaphi yabo noma ubuzwe? Manje sifuna ukuthi ukhumbule ukuthi umngane wakho noma umndeni ubeyinjani eminyakeni eyishumi edlule futhi uqhathanise lokho nesimo sabo samanje. Iminyaka eyishumi edlule bekungama-1996. Nansi izimo lapho le ndoda kufanele isebenzise inkumbulo yayo noma ubuhlakani, futhi sifuna ukuthi usho ukuthi lokhu kuthuthuke, kuhlala kufana, noma kubi ngaphansi kwaleso simo eminyakeni eyishumi edlule. Qaphela ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa izenzo zabo zamanje nalokho okuvela eminyakeni eyishumi edlule. Isibonelo, uma eminyakeni eyishumi edlule le ndoda yayihlala ikhohlwa ukuthi ibekephi izinto, futhi isakhumbula manje, singasho kalula ukuthi "akukho shintsho." Uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okwakunjani eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, le ndoda ikanjani manje... Manje ngizoshintsha imibuzo ehambisana ngqo nokuphila komphenduli. Manje ngifuna ukubuyekeza ukusebenza kwabo ngezindlela ezahlukene mayelana nesimo sabo somzimba. Uma uphendula le mibuzo, ngicela ucabangele emavikini angama-30 edlule, ucabanga ngezinsuku ezinhle nezimbi. Uma ngibuza ngobunzima umphenduli angaba nabo, ngicela ucabangele ukuthi ubunzima bukhona kangakanani, kumongo womsebenzi wabo ojwayelekile.
