Ikota: Isikhathi Sokuhlangana Nokuhlobana Kuhle ukuba nathi lapha, sizokhuluma ngekota. Njengoba sazi, ikota ingesinye sezikhathi ezibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ucabanga ukuthi yini eyenza ikota ibe yinhle kangaka? Kukhona izinto eziningi ezihlanganisa lezi zinyanga ezithile, ezikwenza uzwe ubuhlobo bethu namanye abantu. Okokuqala, ake sikhumbule ukuthi ikota ibalulekile ezimpilweni zethu. Ngabe ukhona umuntu ongakaze azwe ngekota? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu basazama ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yini ngempela ikota. Kukhona imikhosi, imihlangano, nokunye okuningi okwenziwa kulezi zinyanga, futhi lokhu kudala ukuphila okuthokozisayo. Ngabe ukhona umkhosi owake wahlangana nawo ecaleni? Kukhona imicimbi eminingi yesiko lapho abantu behlangana khona, kuthi lapho kuboniswa khona imicabango nemigubho. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngakho, ikota isikhumbuzo sokuthi kufanele sihlale sihamba phambili, sithokozise abanye, futhi sikhumbule imindeni yethu. Ngokwengxenye, ikota iyasikhumbuza ukuthi imiphakathi yethu ibalulekile. Abantu bahlangana ukuze babele isiko, baphinde bakhumbule izinkumbulo ezinhle. Lokhu kudala izithombe ezinhle ezinokukhanya, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale bejabulile. Ngokweqile, ikota iyisikhathi sokuhlangana, sokwenza umbono omusha, futhi sokwakha amakhono amasha. Khona-ke, ake sikhulume ngendlela ikota ebonisa ngayo ubuntu bethu. Sizobona ukuthi abantu bahlala behlangana, begubha izinkumbulo. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi izinyanga zikaMfumfu, uNhlolanja, noNhlangulana bezaziwa ngezinkumbulo ezikhethekile? Lokhu kuhle, ngoba akusikho kuphela ukudla nezithombe ezikhumbulekayo, kodwa futhi kube yithuba lokuxoxa, lokuhlanganyela, nokuxhumana. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ikota ibuye ibonise ukuthi izinkumbulo zethu azigcinwa zodwa. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngayo, sikhumbula izindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ikota ingumkhankaso wokugcina isiko lethu, nokuwugcina eminyakeni ezayo. Kodwa-ke, asikho isikhathi esingcono sokukhumbula izinkumbulo nezikhathi ezijabulisayo. Ngabe kukhona okukhumbulelayo? Njengoba sikhuluma, ngiyazi ukuthi sonke sinezikhathi ezithile ezikhethekile ezihambelana ne ikota. Lokhu kudala ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwezizukulwane. Izinkumbulo ezizalayo ziqhubeka zikhula, ziza nazo izindlela ezisha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikota ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ubuhlobo. Uma abantu behlangana, kuchazwa izincwadi, izinkumbulo, nezifundo. Lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yethu, ngoba akusikho kuphela okukhuluma ngempilo yethu, kodwa futhi nokwakha ubuhlobo obuhle. Ngabe uyangikhumbula? Lokhu kuxhumana, kukhuluma, futhi kuchaza okuhle okuhlobene ne ikota. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ikota ibuye ibe yithuba lokwakha amakhono. Siyazi ukuthi imicimbi ayishintshwa kuphela, kodwa ibuye ithuthukise imiphakathi. Uma izinkumbulo zikhula, abantu baphinde bazitholele amathuba amasha. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sikhumbuza abantu ukuthi bangaba yinxenye enkulu yokwakha umphakathi ozinzile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikota inikeza ithuba lokuphila kahle. Uma abantu behlangana, kubalulekile ukuthi baqhubeke bexhunywe, besebenzisana. Lokhu kudala ubuhlobo obuqinile, kube yithuba lokwakha izifundo ezahlukene. Ngabe ukhumbula ukuthi kukhona abanye abantu abaye benza imisebenzi emihle? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ikota ibonisa ukuthi sonke sizosiza ukuze siphumelele. Ekugcineni, ikota iyinhlangano yokuhlangana, yokukhumbula, futhi yokwakha izinkumbulo. Uma sikhumbula, akusikho kuphela ukudla nezithombe, kodwa futhi kube yithuba lokwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile. Ngakho-ke, ngiyabonga ukuthi sikhuluma ngale ndaba ebalulekile. Ngabe singenza kahle uma siqhubeka nalesi sihloko? Ngiyazi ukuthi ikota iyisikhathi esihle sokuhlangana, futhi ngikhumbula izikhathi eziningi ezihambisana nanoma yisiphi isizathu esithile. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sihlanganyele, sabelane ngezinkumbulo, futhi sakhe isiko lethu. Ikota ingesinye sezikhathi ezinhle kakhulu empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sihamba phambili. Hamba kahle, futhi ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela!
IFIFA World Cup: Uhlanga Lwezokudlala Umhlaba I-FIFA World Cup, eyaziwa ngokuthi iNdebe yoMhlaba, iyisiganeko esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, esihlanganisa amaqembu ezizwe ezahlukene emqhudelwaneni omkhulu wombhoxo. Le midlalwano ibanjwa njalo eminyakeni emine, futhi ibonisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwamazwe. I-FIFA, okuyinhlangano ephethe imidlalo yeziqhingi zomhlaba, iyinhlangano eyasungulwa ngo-1904, futhi ibhekelele ukuphatha imidlalo yeziqhingi, ikakhulukazi iNdebe yoMhlaba. Ukwakhiwa KweNdebe yoMhlaba Ukwakhiwa kweNdebe yoMhlaba kuqala ngonyaka we-1930, lapho i-Uruguay yabamba umqhudelwano wokuqala. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuqala lokuhlangana kwamazwe ahlukene, okwakuhlosiwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhombisa amakhono ezokudlala. Ukuze kube neNdebe yoMhlaba, amazwe kufanele abhalise, futhi ahlale enza kahle emqhudelwaneni wendawo. Lokhu kuhlola amakhono amaqembu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphela amaqembu aphezulu angakwazi ukufinyelela emqhudelwaneni omkhulu. Izinguquko Nezithuthukisi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNdebe yoMhlaba ibonile izinguquko eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko kumthetho, izindlela zokudlala, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha. Ngonyaka we-1998, kwaba nesinqumo sokwandisa inani lamazwe abamba iqhaza, kusuka kumazwe angama-24 kuya kumazwe angama-32. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi kumazwe amasha, futhi kwakhuthaza ukuncintisana okukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuhlola imidlalo, ezifana ne-VAR (Video Assistant Referee), zengezelelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo ziqinile futhi ziqondile. Umthelela Wezokuxhumana Nezokuthengisa I-FIFA World Cup ayigcini nje ngokuba umqhudelwano wezokudlala, kodwa iphinde ibe yinsika enkulu kwezomnotho. Iziphakamiso zokuxhumana, izikhangiso, kanye nezinkampani ezithengisa imikhiqizo yazo zikhula kakhulu ngesikhathi somqhudelwano. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo kumazwe abamba iqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNdebe yoMhlaba ibonisa ubuhle bezwe, ikakhulukazi uma ibanjwa ezindaweni ezahlukene, lapho izivakashi zifika khona ukuze zibe yingxenye yomcimbi omkhulu. Umphakathi Nezokuthuthukiswa I-FIFA World Cup ibuye ibe nempumelelo enkulu emiphakathini. Iphakamisa umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma amaqembu ahlukeneyo edlala. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamazwe, futhi kuqinisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphakathi ibonisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana banethuba lokuthola imfundo yezokudlala. Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma kunjalo, i-FIFA World Cup ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Izinkinga zokuphatha, izinkinga zezemidlalo, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha zihlala zikhona. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umqhudelwano uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zithathwa ukuze kuvinjwe izinkinga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuhlukumeza, ezokuhlukana, kanye nezinkinga zokungabi nabulungiswa emqhudelwaneni zidinga ukugxilwa. Isiphetho I-FIFA World Cup iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi imidlalo ingahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma ibhekwa njengomcimbi omkhulu. Ngaphezu kokuba umqhudelwano wezokudlala, iNdebe yoMhlaba ibonisa umoya wokubambisana, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomnotho. Ukuze le midlalwano iqhubeke nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umqhudelwano ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. I-FIFA World Cup izoqhubeka nokuba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokudlala, futhi izoqhubeka nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sokwamukelwa njengomfokazi lwenziwa ngumfaki-sicelo ukuze wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala ungumuntu ophume ekhaya ngenxa yokwesaba ukuphathwa kabi, futhi ofuna futhi wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala kulokhu eNingizimu Afrika. Umfaki-sicelo kumele afune ukuhlala ngenkathi isicelo sakhe sisaphenywa. Umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala uthola imvume yesikhashana yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Le mvume iyasebenza ezinsukwini eziyi-14 futhi ivumela umnikazi wayo ukuba abike endaweni ethile yokwamukela abafokazi eyaziwa njengeHhovisi Lokwamukela Abafokazi eduze ukuze afake isicelo sokuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala ophumelelwe isimo sokuba umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kanye nokuvikelwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wabafokazi, 1998. Uxoxiswano lokuqala nomuntu lwenziwa ngomphakathi owaziwa njengeMenenja Yokwamukela Abafokazi, futhi ifomu le-BI-1590 ligcwaliswa. Imvume yomfokazi ofuna ukuhlala iphrintiwe, isayinwe, igcotshwe, bese iphumelelwa kumfokazi ofuna ukuhlala. Le mvume iyasebenza ezinsukwini eziyi-30, ivumela umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala ukuba ahlale eNingizimu Afrika okwesikhashana. Le mvume inganwetshwa ngenye inyanga engu-30 bese kuba yizinyanga ezintathu. Ngaphambi kokuphela kwemvume, umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kumele abike e-RRO ukuze enze uxoxiswano lwesibili, olwenziwa ngomphakathi owaziwa njengeMenenja Yokunquma Isimo Somfokazi. I-RSDO iqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo bese yenze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala. Uma kwenziwa isivumelwano sokuhlala, umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kumele afake isicelo se-ID smart card sabafokazi kunoma iyiphi i-RRO phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15. Ngemuva kokuthola ikhadi, umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala angafaka isicelo seSivumelwano Sokuhamba seZizwe eziManyeneyo kunoma iyiphi i-RRO. Isimo sokuba umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala sikhona iminyaka emibili, kodwa umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kumele athumele incwadi ecela ukubuyekezwa noma ukwandiswa kwesimo sakhe sokuba umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwaleyo mvume yokuhlala. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze ziqedwe. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi ayikhokhiswa. Isicelo sokuhlala, amafomu e-BI-1590 awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
# Ukubambezeleka kwezimali ze-NSFAS nomthelela kubafundi ## Isingeniso Le mibhalo ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokubambezeleka kwezimali zeNational Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) kanye nomthelela onawo kubafundi. I-NSFAS iyinhlangano ebanzi enikeza uxhaso lwezezimali kubafundi abadingayo ukuze bakwazi ukufunda eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, ukubambezeleka ekudluliseni lezi zimali kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu kubafundi, okudinga ukuxazululwa. ## Ukubambezeleka kwezimali Ukubambezeleka kwezimali ze-NSFAS kungaba ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa: 1. Izinkinga Zokuphathwa Kwezimali: I-NSFAS ingase ibhekane nezinkinga zokuphatha imali, njengokuphazamiseka ezinhlelweni zokuhweba noma ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele. 2. Ukuhlolwa Kwezimali: Ukuhlolwa okweqile kwezimali kungaholela ekubambezelweni kwemali. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukungahambisani kwezidingo zokuhlola abafundi ukuze baqinisekiswe ukuthi bayahlangabezana nezimfuno zokusebenza. 3. Izizathu Zomlando: Izinkinga zomlando zezezimali zabafundi, njengezikweletu ezingakakhokhwa, zingathinta ukufaneleka kwabo ukuthola uxhaso, okungaholela ekubambezelweni. 4. Izinguquko Ezimweni Zokuqashwa: Izinguquko ezinkulu ezimbonini zokuqashwa zikhombisa ukwehla kwezikhalazo zezimali, okuholela ekubambezelweni kwemali. ## Umthelela Kubafundi Ukubambezeleka kwemali ye-NSFAS kunomthelela omkhulu kubafundi, okubandakanya: 1. Ukuphazamiseka Kwezimfundo: Abafundi abangatholanga uxhaso lwezimali bangase babe nezinkinga zokuhamba esikhathini, okuholela ekubambezelweni kokufunda. Lokhu kungaholela ekwehleni kwemiphumela yabo. 2. Ukukhathazeka Kwezimali: Abafundi abaphakathi kwezinkinga zezimali bangase babe nokukhathazeka okukhulu, okungathinta ukusebenza kwabo ezifundweni. 3. Izinkinga Zokuhlala: Abafundi abangatholi uxhaso bangase babhekane nezinselele zokuhlala, okungaholela ekutheni badinge ukuhlala ezindlini ezingafanele. 4. Ukushoda Kwezinselelo: I-NSFAS ibalulekile ekuxhumaneni nasekuxazululeni izinkinga zezezimali zabafundi, kodwa ukubambezeleka kungaholela kumathuba amancane okuqhubeka nemfundo. ## Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwe-NSFAS nokunciphisa ukubambezeleka kwemali, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zingathathwa: 1. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphatha: Umnyango wezezimali kumele uthuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuhweba zisebenza kahle. 2. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Ukuqeqeshwa kwezakhamuzi ezisebenzela i-NSFAS kuzoba nesisekelo ekwenzeni amathuba aguquke kahle. 3. Ukukhuluma Nababambiqhaza: Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabafundi, odokotela, nezikhungo zemali kuzothuthukisa ukuqonda kwezidingo nokuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. 4. Ukwazi Ngokuqhubekayo: Ukuze abafundi bazuze, kufanele kube nokwaziswa okuhle mayelana nezinhlelo ze-NSFAS kanye nemigomo yokufaka izicelo. ## Isiphetho Ukubambezeleka kwezimali ze-NSFAS kungaba nemiphumela emibi kubafundi, kuholele ezinkingeni ezinzima zomsebenzi nezemfundo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola uxhaso lwezimali oludingekayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo nezisebenzayo zokuphatha. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imiphumela yabafundi, kunciphise ukukhathazeka kwezimali, futhi kugqugquzele ukufunda okwengeziwe. Umnyango wezezimali, kanye nezinye izinhlaka ezithintekayo, kumele bazikhandle ukuze bakhe izinqubo eziphumelelayo, eziqinile, nezisebenzayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba abafundi bathola uxhaso oludingekayo ngaphandle kwezithiyo, okuzosiza ekukhuleni kwemfundo eNingizimu Afrika.
Inhloso yale ncwadi ukusiza othisha nabafundi bezigaba zika-10 kuya ku-12 enqubweni yokufunda nokufundisa ngokuqamba okudala okudlulisa imiyalezo ngama-ndaba nezinkanyezi. Le ncwadi izosiza kakhulu abafundi ukuphumelela ekufezeni Umphumela Wokufunda 3 nasekulungiseleleni izivivinyo zabo. Ibhalwe futhi ihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Kukhona imibhalo eyakhelwe yona, imibhalo emide nemifushane. Ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, izinhlobo zemibhalo zikhona, zonke izinhlobo zichazwa futhi izibonelo zinikezwa. Ukubhala nokwakha imibhalo kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uthisha anike abafundi ithuba elanele lokuzijwayeza ukubhala okuqhubekayo. Bavame ukunikezwa amathuba okubhala ngokukhululeka ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Ekubhaleni okusekelwe kakhulu ezinjongo ezithile, othisha baphakanyiswa ukuba bahlola ikhono elithile noma amandla athile asetshenziswayo ngesikhathi esithile senqubo yokubhala. Ngokwesibonelo, zonke izakhono zolimi kumele zikhulunywe ngaleso sikhathi senqubo yokubhala, okuyindlela othisha abayisebenzisile esikhathini esedlule. Ngenxa yalokhu, ukubhala njengokhono kuvame ukunganakwa ngoba kuhlale kudinga ukuhlolwa okukhulu. Abafundi kufanele bafunde ukuhlela umsebenzi wabanye ngoba lokhu kubalulekile engxenyeni yokubhala futhi kuthuthukisa ukuqashelwa kwenqubo yomfundi kanye neyabanye. Isici esibalulekile salolu mphumela ukuveza umsebenzi obhaliwe. Kungabelana nabanye, othisha, esikoleni sonke, abazali, noma abanye ababambiqhaza. Umfundi uzothokozisa ngemikhiqizo ephelele nepholile. Abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukuchaza kafushane izinhlobo zemibhalo eyakhelwe yona njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Le yindaba lapho umbhali noma umnqobi echaza umcimbi othile owenzekile kuye, noma ungabonwa ukwenzeka kumuntu omunye noma ukuxoxwa ngakho. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi umbhali akhe indaba kusuka emicabangweni yakhe. Lokhu kuvame ukutholakala phakathi kwabafundi (ezikoleni). Kubalulekile ukuthi noma ngabe umfundi udala indaba yakhe emicabangweni yakhe, kufanele kube indaba ethembekile. Ngokuvamile, umbhali walesi saga usebenzisa isikhathi esedlule, umuntu okhuluma noma okukhulunywa ngaye, ukuze axoxe ngendaba yakhe. Ingxenye yokwethulwa kufanele ibandakanye umfundi wendaba. Indaba yokuxoxa kufanele ibe nethembekile noma ngabe iyamanga. Indaba yokuxoxa ivame ukubhalwa ngesiqalo esedlule. Umuntu ofundayo le ndaba kufanele njalo alindele ukuzwa okwenzekayo okulandelayo kuze kube sekupheleni. Ukuxoxa ngempumelelo kukhombisa kahle izinzwa, ezifana nokubona, ukuzwa, ukunambitha, ukunuka, nokuthinta. Isibonelo sesihloko sendaba yokuxoxa: Usuku Esithole Ngalo Ibhubesi Ebhange Elidumile Emkhakheni Wethu. Kwakuyisikhathi seMgqibelo ntambama ekupheleni kukaJuni. Ubanda wawukhukhula isikhumba ezweni laseKwaZulu-Natal. Nakuba ubanda wawukhukhula isikhumba, abantu babephuma ngenani elikhulu ukuze benze izidingo zabo edolobheni laseMnambithi. Kwakungabonakala izinhlobo ezahlukene zezingubo, amabhulukwe, amahembe, amajakhethi, futhi ngisho nemishayo eminingi. Abantu abaningi besilisa nabesifazane babegqoke amahhashi enza izindlebe zabo zihlale zikhululekile. Abesifazane, ngakolunye uhlangothi, babengaqinisekisa ukuthi baphuma bexoxa ukuthi bahlonishwa ngama-scarves ezindololwane zabo. I-ABSA ibhange elivame ukuba nabantu abaningi kunezinye. Kwakunjalo nalesi sikhathi. Kwakukhona umgibeli njengokujwayelekile holding ibhande lakhe kanye ne-stick encane ethunywa emzimbeni uma ungene ebhange. Wonke umuntu ongene emnyango wayedlula futhi ethola izibusiso kulowo stick. Nami ngasondela futhi nganika umgibeli ithuba lokwenza umsebenzi wakhe. Ngemuva kwesikhashana, ngabe sengaphakathi ebhange. Ngabe sengibona indawo lapho kuhlawulwa khona imali nokuhlawulwa. Ngakuqonda ukuthi kufanele ngisheshe ngiyokhipha imali kumshini wokukhipha imali futhi ngiqale ukufaka imininingwane edingekayo. Njengoba ngiqeda, ngangihlangana nabantu ababejolile. Kwathatha isikhathi eside njengoba sasondele kancane kancane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, abasebenzi bebha ngabe bezama ukukhuluma ngento ethile nabantu ababephakathi ebhange. Owayeduze kithi wahlukana abantu babeziqoqela ezigabeni ezimbili - umugqa wabantu abakhipha imali kanye nalabo abahlawula. Futhi, kwavela imigqa emibili. Ngabe ngisemugqa wabantu abakhipha imali. Isizathu sokuthi ngihambe ngiyokhipha imali ngaphakathi ebhange kwaba ukuthi ngifuna ama-randi ayisithupha. Umugqa wabantu abakhipha imali kumshini kanye nalabo abahlawula wawuphuthuma kunathi. Ngabe ngiqhubeka ngibona abantu bephuma naphakathi kwemigqa yokukhipha nokuhlawula imali. Kwakungaleso sikhathi enganginombono wokuthi ngingakhipha ama-randi amabili kuphela, kodwa ngiphinde ngiziphinde ngithi kufanele ngibe nesineke kuze kube sekufikeni kwami. Esikhundleni sokwandisa inani labatholi nabakhiphi, banciphisa. Ngemuva kwesikhashana, izindawo abazisebenzisayo zazivele zihlukaniswe nezimpawu ezithi 'zivalwe'. Sasinokubekezela ngoba sasidinga imali. Kwakuzwakala sengathi ngiphupha lapho sekufikile isikhathi sokuhamba phambili kumthengisi kanye nomphakathi. Washesha wacindezela ikhompyutha kathathu noma kathathu ngomzuzu, wabalela imali, wayinika mina. Ngiyithathe futhi ngambonga ngenkathi ngimfisela uhambo oluhle. Ngesikhathi ngibheka emnyango, ngabona umgibeli evala umnyango kulabo abangenayo nalabo abaphuma. Saphazamiseka ukubona abavikeli ngaphakathi ebhange bephatha amabhokisi emali. Bobabili basondeza kumshini wokukhipha nokuhlawula imali, bavula, futhi baqala ukufaka imali. Zonke izinyembezi zaguquka zaba kubo labo bavikeli. Ngabe ngikhuluma nami ukuthi ngeke baphume, kungani sithola ithuba lokuphuma emnyango ukuze siphume ebhange. Noma ngabe umuntu akakaze abambe umkhonto kodwa unomsindo womkhonto olungiselelwe ukuhlela. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenkathi sisathokozisa ngababheki ababephatha imali kumshini. Ngesikhathi siphendukela ezindaweni zethu, amehlo ethu abheka lapho imisindo ehlukahlukene yemikhonto ilungiselelwe ukuhlela, umuntu owayekhona wabona omunye elele phansi enhliziyweni. Ngabe ngibona nami ngilele phansi ngaphezu kwalokho. Ngesikhathi abanye abantu bephatha imali kumashini, abanye bekwamukela lokho okwakuhlawulwe ngabavikeli, kanti abanye bekhipha imali ezikhwameni zethu. Okukhona lapho kwenzeka ngempela. Ngomzuzu, kwavela udlame. Lokhu akusizanga nhlobo ngoba sekukade kudlule emkhakheni. Imali yethu yathathwa. Akukho muntu ofa ngokuphazamiseka ngoba angizange ngithinteka ngalolo suku lapho ngashaywa ngemuva kwalokho. Ngisho namuhla, ngisathola umoya opholile uma ngicabanga ngalolo suku. Le indaba lapho umbhali kufanele achaze isimo esithile, umuntu othile, noma indawo ethile. Njengoba
Umbhalo wesiNgisi ungumbhalo osemthethweni weGas Policy Framework... Ukuze kuthuthukiswe kahle inkampani ye-gas pipeline; ukusungula isakhiwo sezwe; ukugunyaza uMphathi weGas Policy ezingeni likazwelonke njengomgibeli wenqubomgomo ye-infrastructure ezingeni likazwelonke; nokubheka ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Amandla angabekwa lapha abhekisela kulawo mandla akhethwe nguMphathi weGas Policy mayelana nokuguqulwa kube igesi, ukusindiswa kwegesi, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusatshalaliswa okungadingi ukuhambisana nezidingo ezisemqoka zalesi sivumelwano. Futhi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokutholakala kwegesi ngendlela elula nephumelelayo. Ukusatshalaliswa, ukucutshungulwa kwegesi, nokusindiswa kwegesi; kanye nokuhweba ngegesi. UMphathi weGas Policy unabasebenzi abahlanu abaqashwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umongameli ukhethwa phakathi kwabaphathi be-gas ngokuhambisana nesigaba. Uma ngasiphi isizathu umongameli engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, abanye amalungu kumele akhethe omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuba aphathe isikhundla somongameli kuze kube umongameli ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe noma kuze kube nguNgqongqoshe eqasha omunye umongameli. Ilungu leMphakathi yeGas Policy lenza isikhathi seminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda aqashe ilungu. Amalungu eMphakathi yeGas Policy kumele akhokhelwe ngezinsizakalo zawo futhi athole izinzuzo njengabaphathi be-gas ngokuvuma kukaNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Ngaphambi kokuba aqashe amalungu kuMphakathi weGas Policy, uNgqongqoshe kumele, ngomyalezo kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, acela amagama kubalungu bomphakathi. Ukusatshalaliswa, ukugcinwa, ukuthuthwa, ukucutshungulwa kwegesi, noma ukuhweba ngegesi, noma ukuba nentshisekelo ethile kunoma iyiphi inkampani; futhi kumele azise uNgqongqoshe noMphathi weGas Policy uma le ntshisekelo ishintsha. Ilungu akumele likhanye nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho izindaba zixoxwa, noma izinqumo zenziwa, noma libe nengxenye kunoma iyiphi indaba yeMphakathi yeGas Policy lapho leli lungu noma umngani walo, ingane, umngane wezohwebo, noma umqashi, ngaphandle koMbuso, enentshisekelo. Noma kungenzeka kube nesizathu sokungavunyelwa ukuba lihlale njengelungu ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo esigabeni 6 seGas Policy uma lenza okuphikisana nesigaba 9. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele abe nemihlangano ngezikhathi ezibekwe ngumongameli. UMphathi weGas Policy njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi ofanele wenziwa. Ukuze uthole lesi sicelo. Ngaphandle kokuba kube nenqubo ethile ebekiwe, umongameli wanoma yisiphi umhlangano weMphakathi weGas Policy kumele abeke inqubo ezolandelwa kulolo suku. UMphakathi weGas Policy uqukethe amalungu amaningi. Isinqumo sebhola labalungu abakhona emhlanganweni yisinqumo seMphakathi weGas Policy. Kuyinhlangano elula phezulu kwalokho okujwayelekile. Isinqumo uma abanye amalungu bekhona emhlanganweni futhi benelungelo lokuhlanganyela nokuvota, futhi isinqumo kumele sithathwe futhi ngempela ngamalungu abukhona anelungelo lokuvota. Umongameli kumele abe khona emihlanganweni yonke yeMphakathi weGas Policy futhi unelungelo lokuphendula, kodwa hhayi ukuvota, kulawo mhlangano. I-Gas Policy ivulekile emphakathini ngaphandle kokuba kube nolwazi oluyimfihlo, olunamalungelo obunikazi mayelana nezohwebo, lowo muntu ophakathi kufanele akhombise uMphathi weGas Policy ukuthi kungani lelo lwazi lungafanele lwenziwe emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy wokuqala ngemuva kokuba eqashwe. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqinisekise ukuthi irekhodi lezo zinqubo ezikhona zigcinwa. Ngokuqondile noma ngokuqondile; futhi abaphethe izikhundla zomphakathi kumele baziphathise kahle futhi njengoba kulindelekile. Kumele kubhalwe; futhi kuchazwe kahle nangokunembile, ngomthetho nezizathu zawo. Noma yisiphi isinqumo seMphakathi weGas Policy nezizathu zaso kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqashe umphathi omkhulu weMphakathi weGas Policy. Ukuze aphathe izindaba zeMphakathi weGas Policy; futhi aphathe ukuphathwa kwabo bonke abasebenzi abaqashwe ngalesi sikhathi esikahle. Obani, ukuze basize ezisebenzelweni zeMphakathi weGas Policy. Nakuba kukhona izigaba 1 no-3, uNgqongqoshe angase anqume ukuthi uMphathi weGas Policy angaqasha noma asebenzise abasebenzi ngokuvumelana nezinye iziphathimandla zokuhweba ngaphansi kwamandla kaNgqongqoshe. Isigaba 9 sithinta noma yiliphi ilungu labasebenzi beMphakathi weGas Policy, ushintsho lusekelwe esimweni esikhona. Izincwadi zezezimali zeMphakathi weGas Policy kumele zihlolwe nguMphakathi Wezokuhlola. Mayelana nempilo nokuphepha embonini; kanye nezinye izindaba uMphathi weGas Policy abona ukuthi zidingeka. Obani abangase basebenze ekuthuthweni, ukugcinwa, ukusatshalaliswa kwegesi, ukuyicubungula, nokusindiswa kwegesi; noma ukuhweba ngegesi. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngawo kwiSheduli 1 awudingi ukufaka isicelo sokungena kulowo msebenzi, kodwa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywa ezigabeni 1 no-2 yale Sheduli kumele abhalise umsebenzi wabo njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 28. Bangazisa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okudinga ilayisense ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuthi kufanele bame umsebenzi lowo. Akukho lutho kule Mthetho olivimba noma ubani ekwenzeni izivumelwano ngenjongo yokwakha, ukuguqula i-infrastructure ye, umsebenzi wegesi, ukuyisebenzisa, noma ukuhweba okuhlosiwe ukuze kuxoxwe noMphathi weGas Policy ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo se-layisense. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 29, anikeze umuntu obhekwa ngesigaba (a) ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze afake isicelo. Noma ubani ofanele ukufaka isicelo se-layisense ngaphansi kwesigaba 10 kuya ku-15 kumele ayifake ngendlela ebekiwe nangendlela. Ngalolu lwazi oludingekayo mayelana negesi ezoba yohwebo ngaphansi kwelayisense; kanye nolwazi olunye olungase ludingeke. Umfaki-sicelo angacela ukuthi ulwazi luphathwe ngokuyimfihlo mayelana nokuthinteka kwezezimali esicelweni futhi, ngokuvumelana nezivumelwano noMphathi weGas Policy, lelo lwazi lingadalulwa ezikopini zesicelo ezisakazwayo emphakathini. Umuntu kumele uphume umyalezo wesicelo sakhe ezincwadini ezimbili okungenani endaweni afuna ukusebenza kuyo, ezilimini ezimbili ezisemthethweni (eyodwa kufanele ibe isiNgisi). Ikheli leMphakathi weGas Policy lapho okungabekwa khona izikhalazo ngesicelo; futhi ukuthi izikhalazo ngesicelo kumele zisebenze ngezinto eziphakanyisiwe noma isitatimende esiphakanyisiwe. Uma kungekho zinkinga ezitholakele ngesicelo; noma ngemuva kokuthola impendulo kumfaki-sicelo mayelana nezikhalazo ezishiwo esigabeni 18c. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo; noma nganoma iyiphi injongo yomphakathi
Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery Isingeniso Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery ubalulekile ekuqondeni intuthuko yesikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela eNingizimu Afrika. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela esizothuthukisa umnotho, sikhuthaze ukusimama kwemithombo yezobuchwepheshe, futhi sinikeze amathuba ohwebo. Imigomo eyinhloko yalesi sikhungo ibonisa ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi, imisebenzi, nokunciphisa ukuncika ezimakethe zangaphandle. Umkhankaso Wokuqala Uhlelo lokwakha iMthombo Oil Refinery lwaqala ngonyaka ka-2010, lapho abaqalayo behlongoza ukwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela endaweni yeMthombo, enyakatho yeNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhambisana nomgomo kahulumeni wokwandisa ukukhiqiza kwendawo, kugqugquzelwe imisebenzi kwezokwakha, futhi kukhombisa ukuthi kuzodingeka ukusiza ukuhlinzeka ngohwebo lwamafutha. Izinhloso ezihlukahlukene zalesi sikhungo zifaka ukukhula kwemikhiqizo, ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yezolimo, nokwakha amathuba obuchwepheshe obusha. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kudingeka ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu, okuhlanganisa izinkampani zomphakathi, ezemisebenzi, nezokwakha. Inqubo Yokwakha Ngemuva kokuthola indawo efanele, kwenziwa ucwaningo lobuchwepheshe kanye nezifundo zokuhlola umthelela kwemvelo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwemigomo emisha yokwakha nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezazokwenza kube nokuphumelela okukhulu. Uhlelo lokulwa nezingozi lwenziwa, lwamukela izindlela zokuphepha, ukuhlolwa kwemvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhathalela impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi, iMthombo Oil Refinery yahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifaka phakathi izinkinga zezimali, ukwanda kwezidingo, kanye nezimfuno ezishintshashintshayo. Nokho, ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabahlinzeki bezinsiza, abaphathi, kanye nohulumeni baphumelele ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela emihle. Izifundo Zokucatshangelwa Phakathi nesikhathi sokwakha, izifundo ezibalulekile zitholakele, okuhloswe ngazo ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zalesi sikhungo. Lezi zifundo zifaka phakathi: 1. Ubudlelwano: Kubalulekile ukuba nabanye abathintekayo ukuze kuqondwe izidingo zabo. 2. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezimali zisetshenziswa kahle ukuze iphrojekthi iphumelele. 3. Ukuphathwa Kwenhlalakahle: Ukuxhumana nezinhlaka zempilo yomphakathi ukuze imithetho yokwakha ihlale ilungile. Ukuqukethwe Kwenqubo Yokusebenza Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery izobe iyinqubo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuhambisana namazinga aphezulu okuphepha, yize izinhlelo zokuphatha zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngemva kokwakhiwa, kuzodingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokugcina izinto ziphephile, kulungiswe izindleko, futhi kusetshenziswe izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Imiphumela Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery izoba nemiphumela emikhulu, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukukhulisa Umnotho: Ukwakha imisebenzi emisha. 2. Ukwanda Kwezimali: Ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi. 3. Ukwandiswa Kwamathuba: Ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba obuchwepheshe. 4. Ukulethwa Kwenoveli: Ukwenza izinqubomgomo zokuxhasa ubuchwepheshe. 5. Ukuphathwa Kokuphepha: Ukwenza izinqubomgomo eziphephile. Isiphetho Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery uyindida ebanzi ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, nabathintekayo kufanele baqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe amandla, kuhlangane nemiphumela elindelekile yokwakha isithuthukisi sooyela. Imiphumela emihle yephrojekthi izoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ubuchwepheshe, nezemisebenzi. Uhlelo lokwakha iMthombo Oil Refinery luhlala luhlola izinkundla zokuphathwa nezokwakha ibhizinisi elibambisene, okusiza ezikhathini ezizayo.
Ukutshala Izingadi: Imibuzo Nezimpumelelo Umbuzo 1: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngilungiselela ukutshala ingadi? Ukulungiselela ukutshala ingadi kuqala ngokukhetha indawo efanele. Kubalulekile ukuthola indawo enelanga enomhlabathi onempilo. Uhlanga akufanele lube nezinsalela ezinkulu noma ubunkulunkulu obukhulu. Ngemuva kokukhetha indawo, hlanza ibanga, ususe noma yiziphi izithako ezingezinhle, ezifana nezihlahla ezindala nezimpande eziphukile. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zemifino ezilungele ukutshala? Izimfino ozikhethayo zingancika ebudleleni bakho nasemikhiqizweni ofuna ukuyithola. Ezinye zezizitshalo ezilula ukutshala zifaka phakathi u-garlic, u-pepper, u-tomato, no-cabbage. U-garlic uthandwa kakhulu ngoba unamandla okuvikela ezinye izitshalo, futhi ungashiywa phansi isikhathi eside. U-pepper, onjengokuthanda, uhle kakhulu ezindaweni ezishisayo. Umbuzo 3: Ingabe kudingeka ukubulala izilokazi noma ezilwane ezingafuneki? Yebo, kubalulekile ukulawula izilokazi. Izilokazi zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emangcwabisweni akho. Umzamo wokuvimbela izilokazi ungaba nempumelelo enkulu. Ungasebenzisa izindlela zemvelo, njengokukhulisa izitshalo ezivimbela izilokazi, njengezimbali, noma usebenzise izinto ezitholakala ngokwemvelo ukugcina izilokazi kude. Umbuzo 4: Yini engiyidingayo ukuhlinzeka izitshalo zami? Izitshalo zidinga amanzi, ukukhanya, nomhlabathi onempilo. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola umquba omuhle ukuze ukhulise imifino. Ubudlelwano phakathi kokwabiwa kwamanzi nokukhanya busebenza ngendlela efanayo; udinga ukufaka amanzi kuphela uma kudingeka. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe izitshalo zidinga ukulungiswa ukuze zikhule kahle? Yebo, izitshalo zidinga ukulungiswa ukuze zikhule kahle. Hlanganisa umquba noma umquba wokhuni bese ufaka emhlabathini. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukukhulisa imiphumela emihle. Uchwepheshe uthi, ukungabi nembilibe kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka umphumela omuhle emhlabathini. Umbuzo 6: Ngingawathanda kanjani amahlanu amabili abhekise esigabeni sokulungiselela umhlabathi? Ukulungele ukusebenzisa amahlanga amakhulu kuzeka amanzi emhlabathini kufanele kube uhlelo olujwayelekile. Ungabeka amakhilomitha amancane, ungasebenzisa into efana nemithombo yokuwasha, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungawukwazi ukusebenza ngezinsizakalo zezitshalo. Umbuzo 7: Yikuphi ukutshala okungafanele bank-bay? Izitshalo ezithanda izindawo ezinemvula, ezifana ne-nasturtium, lungasebenzi kahle uma zifakwe endaweni engajwayelekile. Lokhu kungakwenza kube nobunzima ekutshaleni. Umbuzo 8: Ngingakuthola kanjani ukusiza kwabanye uma ngisahlanza ingadi? Hamba ujolise ekutholeni olunye usizo emizamweni yokuthwala izingadi. Unezinkundla ezahlukahlukene ezifana ne-microgreens, ezithinta umhlaba. Ukubhalisela izingadi zakho zokusiza kungaba yindlela yokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe ukudla okutshaliwe kungafana nomsebenzi wakho? Yebo, lokhu kudla okwenza umphumela ophilayo kudala umphumela omkhulu. Ungafaka imifino, izinhlanzi ezithombile, nezithako ezinamanzi. Ubulili bemifino bubandakanya izindlela ezilungile zokwakha amafushane amancane ukuze uthole imiphakathi ehlelekile. Umbuzo 10: Kukhona isikhathi esikahle sokutshala? Yebo, kunezikhathi ezifanele zokutshala, njengenkathi yokuqala yasehlobo, nesikhathi sokuthola ukutshala. Ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, unganquma izimfuno zenhlanga nezinhlelo ezisemqoka. Isiphetho: Ukutshala izingadi akuwona umsebenzi onzima, kodwa kudinga ubuchwepheshe. Ukuba nekhono elithile nokuhleleka kuhlanganisa izinyathelo eziphumelelayo. Qhubeka uphumelele kuzo zonke izingadi ozitshala, futhi uvumelekile ukusabela kuzo zonke izidingo zakho!
Uhlelo lwebhizinisi kanye nesu lokusebenza kwemisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo lunikezwa kuNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha futhi luvunywa nguye minyaka yonke, ngendlela yesicelo (uhlelo lwebhizinisi) oluhlanganisa nolwazi olunembile. I-SAMSA ibamba imisebenzi yezomthetho nezok regulation, egameni loNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kanye neNhlangano Yezokuthutha Kazwelonke (NDOT). I-SAMSA ngakho-ke ibamba imisebenzi ethile ezingeni lokusebenza, kanti i-NDOT isebenza ezingeni lesu, lapho ithuthukisa khona imigomo yokuthutha nemihlahlandlela yesu yezinsizakalo. I-SAMSA iqhubeka nokuxhumana nezithakazelo emikhakheni yamanzi, ngokusebenzisa amaKomidi ahlukahlukene ezokuthutha olwandle nokubamba imihlangano yokuxhumana nezinye izindlela ezingezona ezisemthethweni. Inhloso ye-SAMSA ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwempahla nokuphila olwandle, ukuvikela nokulwa nokungcoliswa okuphazamisa imvelo yolwandle yezikebhe, nokukhulisa izinzuzo zezimali zeRiphabhulikhi. Phakathi kwezinye izenzo, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulezi, kukhona ukuhlolwa kwezikebhe, imishini, nezimpahla, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isikebhe nezikebhe zifakwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe. I-SAMSA iphinde ikhishwe futhi inikeze izitifiketi okufanele abantu babe nazo uma besebenza ezikebheni. IKomidi leMithetho Yamalungelo Abantu laseNingizimu Afrika kumele lithuthukise umhlahlandlela oqukethe ulwazi olufanele ukuhlinzekwa kunoma yimuphi umuntu ofisa ukusebenzisa noma yiluphi ilungelo elicacisiwe nguMthetho. Izimemo ezitholiwe zokuhamba/ukuxhumana nezinye izizwe/izinhlangano/okungase kufake amaklayenti nomphakathi. Akukho sikhumbuzo esishicilelwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho. I-SAMSA iphethe ukuvikelwa kokungcoliswa kanye nekhono lokuphendula, ngokubambisana neMnyango Wezokuphila Nokuhamba. Ukwethulwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kufanele kuqondiswe ku-CEO we-SAMSA. Uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sikhanselwa noma sithathwa ngokuhambisana Nezinhlu 22, 26, noma 29 zoMthetho, umceli angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi. Omunye umuntu angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi, ukuze afune ukufinyelela kulwazi. Isikhalazo kufanele sithunyelwe ngendlela ebekiwe ku-2, bese sithunyelwa kuMphakathi Wolwazi endaweni yeposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhulunywe ku-2 ngenhla, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola isikhumbuzo sokwenqaba. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yesikhalazo. Uma umceli engakakhokhi imali yesikhalazo (uma kufanele), isinqumo ngesikhalazo sangaphakathi singabambezela, kuze kube yilapho imali ikhokhiwe. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isikhalazo, ukuthi ingaqinisekisa yini isikhalazo noma yenze isinqumo esisha esikhundleni salo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Uma i-SAMSA ingahlinzeki umceli ngesikhumbuzo sesinqumo ngesikhalazo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokufaka isicelo, i-SAMSA izobhekwa njengokwenqaba isikhalazo sangaphakathi. Umceli noma omunye umuntu angasondela enkantolo ukuze athole usizo olufanele kuphela ngemuva kokuthi umceli noma omunye umuntu esebenzise zonke izinqubo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi mayelana nesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi. Uma umceli noma omunye umuntu ehlupheke ngesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi noma izicelo zabo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi zehlulekile, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kwesinqumo ngesikhalazo. Ikhaya elinokuthula kulolu suku yikhaya eliphezulu noma enye inkantolo enendawo efanayo yokuphatha. Umceli kumele ahambisane nezidingo zokusebenza ezitholakala kuMthetho, ezihlobene nesicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umceli kumele agcwalise ifomu elibekiwe ku-1, bese elithumela, kanye nemali yesicelo kanye nediphozi (uma kufanele), kuMphakathi Wolwazi endaweni yeposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhulunywe ku-2 ngenhla. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yomceli. Uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu, khona-ke umceli kumele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthunyelwa ukwenza lesi sicelo egameni labo. Umceli uzokwaziswa ngokubhalwe phansi ukuthi ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe noma kuyakwenqaba. Uma umceli edinga izizathu zesinqumo ngenye indlela, kumele akhombise indlela nemininingwane edingekayo. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqedela ifomu ngoba engafundile noma engakhululekile, lowo muntu angafaka isicelo ngomlomo. Umceli kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke inqubo. Futhi imali yokufinyelela, ibalwa ngokubheka izindleko zokuphrinta kabusha, ukufuna, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zesicelo kanye nezokuthumela. Uma isicelo sitholiwe nguMphakathi Wolwazi, lowo mphakathi uzodinga isikhumbuzo sokuthi umceli, ngaphandle kokufaka isicelo, kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuba aqhubeke nokucubungula isicelo. Umceli onikezwe ukufinyelela kumarekhodi kumele akhokhe imali yokufinyelela yesicelo, kanye nokuphrinta kabusha, ukulungiselela, kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo sokufinyelela ezinsukwini ezichaziwe zesicelo nokulungiselela kwamarekhodi okuzokhishwa, kuhlanganisa nokwenza amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo. Uma isicelo sokurekhodi senziwe futhi irekhodi ilungisiwe ukuze ikhishwe, kuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izinhlelo zokuthi kube khona ngendlela efunwayo, kudinga amahora adlula lawo abekiwe emthethweni ngenhloso, uMphakathi Wolwazi uzokwazisa umceli ukuthi akhokhe, njengediphozi, ingxenye ebekiwe yemali yokufinyelela ezodingeka ukukhokhwa uma isicelo sivunywa. UMphakathi Wolwazi uzobambezela irekhodi kuze kube isikhathi lapho umceli ekhokha izimali ezibekiwe. Uma idiphozi ikhokhiwe mayelana nesicelo sokufinyelela esinquelekile, khona-ke uMphakathi Wolwazi ophumelelayo uzobuyisela idiphozi kumceli. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo, ukuthi ivume noma inqabe isicelo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Isikhathi esingu-30 sezinqumo lapho i-SAMSA kumele ithathe isinqumo sokuvuma noma sokwenqaba isicelo singandiswe sibe isikhathi esengeziwe ngokuhambisana Nezinhlu 26 zoMthetho.
Izinkinga Zamateksi: Ukuhlola Izimo Nezixazululo Emphakathini Wethu Amatekisi awukwazi ukuphila ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezithile ezinzima. Le mboni ibalulekile ekuletheni abantu ezindaweni zabo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingenamathuba amaningi okubambisana kwezokuhamba. Nokho, izinkinga ezibhekene namatekisi zikhombisa izinselelo ezinkulu zokuphila kwezimoto, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalokhu ukuze siqonde izindlela zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Okokuqala, udlame oluhambisana nomkhakha wamatekisi lukhona ezindaweni ezithile, lapho abashayeli behlukaniswa khona ngamaqembu. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezingozi nasezibhedlela, okuwubufakazi bokuthi umphakathi udinga izinsiza eziphephile. Ukuze silungise le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi osomabhizinisi bamatekisi baxoxe ngokubambisana ukuze bathole izindlela zokuthuthukisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwabo. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngeshoda komthetho. Abashayeli bamatekisi bavame ukwephula imithetho, okwenza kube nokungcoliswa kwezindawo zokupaka. Lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinzima kumjikelezo wokuhamba, njengoba abanye abashayeli bephosa izimoto zabo ezindleleni. Ukuze silungise lokhu, kudingeka imithetho ecacile nezithiyo eziphumelelayo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufaka izimoto. Okwesithathu, izindleko zokusebenza zikhona, futhi abashayeli bamatekisi bahlala bebhekene nezindleko ezinkulu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye baphuthume ukwenza imali, okuthinta ukwethembana kwabakhweli. Ukuze sithole ukusimama, iziphathimandla kufanele zihlaziye izindlela zokukhuthaza abashayeli ukuthi basebenzise amasu ahlakaniphile, njengokunikeza izikhuthazo ezimnandi. Okwesine, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabashayeli namakhasimende buphakathi kwezinkinga ezidinga ukunakekelwa. Abashayeli abathola ukutshudelwa okukhulu bangase babe nezinkinga ngenxa yokuntula ukuxhumana okuhle. Ukuze sithuthukise lokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo ezikhuthazayo ezizokwenza abashayeli baqonde izidingo zamakhasimende. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zamatekisi ziveza ubunzima obukhona emkhakheni wezokuhamba. Izinkinga zemithetho, izindleko eziphakeme, nezimo ezinzima zenza kube nzima kubashayeli bamatekisi ukuphumelela. Nokho, uma sizama ukuhlola lezi zinkinga, sizokwazi ukuhlela izixazululo ezikhuthazayo. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nezinsiza ezithuthukayo, okwenza amatekisi abe yinsika ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu.
Ibhola Lomnqakiswano: Umlando Walo Ibhola lomnqakiswano, noma i-basketball, liyinsimu ethokozisayo futhi edumile emhlabeni wonke. Lo mdlalo wadalwa ngonyaka ka-1891 nguJames Naismith, umfundisi wezokwakha eColumbia University e-United States. U-Naismith wayefuna ukuhlinzeka ngemdla ohlangene owasiza abafundi ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bephila ngesikhathi sebusika, lapho imidlalo yangaphandle ingavumelekile ngenxa yezimo zezulu. Wabhala imithetho eyisisekelo, ethinta izinyathelo ezilula zokudlala, wabe esebenzisa ibhasi elincane, izigubhu ezimbili, nezikhumbuzo ezilula ukuze akhe umphakathi wokuqala wombukiso. Umdlalo wokuqala wabanjwa emnyango, lapho abadlali bejabulisa izithameli ezincane. Ngesikhathi leso, ibhola lomnqakiswano lalingakabi namazinga aphezulu, kodwa lwalukhombisa isithembiso sokuba umdlalo ophumelelayo. Njengoba iminyaka ihamba, ibhola lomnqakiswano laqala ukuthandwa kakhulu. Ngonyaka ka-1936, le midlalo yathathwa njengengxenye ye-Olympics, okwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwandiseni ubukhona bayo emhlabeni, okwakuvulela amathuba amaningi kubadlali, abaqeqeshi, nababukeli. Umdlalo waqala ukuhamba phambili, wathola izinkanyezi ezinkulu ezifana noMichael Jordan, uKobe Bryant, noLeBron James, abaguqula ubuchwepheshe bawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola lomnqakiswano lathola izinguquko eziningi. Imithetho yalo yathuthukiswa, izikhumbuzo zashintshwa, futhi izindlela zokudlala zathuthukiswa. Umdlalo waqala ukufaka izici eziningi, ezinjengokukhuphuka kwezikhumbuzo, izinyathelo ezinzima, nezindlela zokudlala ezihlukahlukene, okwenze kube mnandi kubabukeli. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lathola ukuthandwa emhlabeni wonke, izwe ngalinye laqala ukwakha amaqembu, futhi imiqhudelwano yathuthukiswa. I-NBA (National Basketball Association) yatholakala e-United States, ibe yinhla enkulu yokudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano emhlabeni. I-NBA yenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu, yenza abadlali baziwe, futhi yathuthukisa izinga lokudlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano lathola ukuthandwa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini, lapho abafundi baqala ukudlala emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasezindaweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abadlali abasha, okwakha amathuba amaningi kubantu abasha. Namuhla, ibhola lomnqakiswano seliyinsimu ethokozisayo, edlalwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi abadlali bahlonishwa njengamaqhawe. Umdlalo usaqhubeka nokukhula, uthokozisa izigidi zabantu, futhi akusikho nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, ubungani, nokuhlanganyela. Noma kunjalo, ibhola lomnqakiswano libhekene nezinselelo zakhona, njengezinkinga zokuncintisana, izimali, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Nokho, umoya wombukiso, wokuhlanganyela, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana kuqhubeka kukhuthaza abadlali nababukeli. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lihlala linethemba, lishukumisela abantu ukuba baphumelele, futhi lihlale lingenakuphikiswa njengomdlalo ophumelelayo, ophilayo. Umdlalo ubonisa ukuthi, noma izimo zishintsha, umoya wokudlala, wokuhlanganyela, kanye nowokuncintisana kuhlala kukhanya. Ibhola lomnqakiswano lihlala lingenakuphikiswa, lishukumisela abantu ukuba baphumelele.
Ubugebengu Emiphakathini: Iziphumo Nezindlela Zokulwa Nalesi Simo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubugebengu emiphakathini bukhula, buholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu ezithinta ubumpofu, ukuphepha, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezithile lapho izinga lokuhlala lisezingeni eliphansi, khona-ke abantu abanenkinga yokukwazi ukuthola imithombo yezimali ngendlela efanele. Ubugebengu buhlanganisa izinto eziningi, okubalwa kuzo ubugebengu obuvamile, ubugebengu obuphakathi, kanye nezinto ezithinta izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa. Ukwanda kwalezi zinkinga kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathekayo ukuze kubhekwane nezimbangela zazo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi uma imiphakathi inezinsiza ezanele, njengesikole, imisebenzi, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, kuba nokuncipha kwezinga lobugebengu. Kodwa-ke, lapho lezi zinsiza zingatholakali, abantu bathola indlela yokuphila ngokungafanele, okwenza kube lula ukuba basemkhakheni wobugebengu. Esigabeni sokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubugebengu buvame ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezithile. Ngokuvamile, izigameko zobugebengu zenzeka lapho kukhona ukuwohloka kwemiphakathi, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ezintweni ezinjengokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukungabi nezinsiza zokuthuthukisa, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokungabi nabulungiswa. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokungabi nalwazi, okwenza abantu bazitholele izixazululo ezingekho emthethweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo ezisemadolobheni ziboniswa ngokuba nemisebenzi eminingi, kodwa futhi zikhumbula izingozi ezithile. Izindawo eziningi zinezikhungo zokuphila, kodwa uma kuhlangene nezinga eliphakeme lokuhlukunyezwa kanye nezifo ezithathelwana, izigameko zobugebengu ziba ziningi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane ukuze kudalwe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Esigabeni sesibili, kufanele sikhulume ngendima yokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano zomphakathi, izikhungo zokusebenza, kanye neziphathimandla. Ukubambisana phakathi kwalezi ziqephu kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezinzima. Izinhlelo zokubambisana, ezinjengezinhlelo zokuvikela umphakathi, zidinga ukusungulwa ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile. Ukubambisana kwabo bonke abathintekayo, kusukela kumalungu omphakathi kuze kube sezikhungweni eziphezulu, kuyindlela ewusizo yokulwa nobugebengu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphila eziphekwe kahle zingakusiza kakhulu ekunciphiseni ubugebengu. Lokhu kuhilela ukwethula izinhlelo zokuqwashisa ezihlose ukufundisa abantu ngezingozi ezihambisana nobugebengu, kanye nezindlela zokuzivikela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphucula izinga lokuphepha emiphakathini. Esigabeni sokugcina, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi abantu abahlala emiphakathini bangenza umehluko omkhulu. Ukuzibophezela kwabantu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekunciphiseni ubugebengu. Uma abantu behlanganyela, bakha imiphakathi eqinile, lapho abantu bekhuthazwa ukuba baxhumane, basize omasipala, futhi babelane ngolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, obuzokwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezinkingeni ezikhona. Ekugcineni, ukulwa nobugebengu emiphakathini akuyona into engathathwa kalula. Kudinga ubumbano, ukuzinikela, kanye nezinsiza ezanele. Umsebenzi wokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, enempilo, ungabhekwa njengomgomo ophambili. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukudala izindawo eziphephile, ezikhululekile, nezithokozisayo, lapho wonke umuntu ezothola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ubugebengu buyinselele, kodwa kungenziwa ukuzama ukwenza ngcono izimo zempilo emphakathini.
Ezamandla Kwathi kube khona isikhathi lapho abantu bephila khona ngokuxhumana nemvelo, lapho umoya, amanzi, nomhlaba kwakuyizinsiza eziningi ezingesiyo kuphela ezamandla, kodwa futhi zazingamaqhawe empilweni yansuku zonke. Kule ndaba, sizogxila kumfana ogama lakhe linguThando, owayengumntwana ophumelelayo, kodwa okwakunzima kuye ukuqonda amandla akhe. UThando wayehlala edolobheni elincane elibizwa ngeMfuleni. Leli dolobha lalizungezwe izintaba eziluhlaza nezihlahla ezinkulu. Umoya wawubanda, futhi ubumnandi bezinsuku ezishisayo babudlula phansi. UThando wayehlala noMama, oyayazi kahle ukuthi izinsiza ezivela emhlabeni zibalulekile empilweni. Wayephila enza imisebenzi yokuhlinzeka, ehlunga amanzi, embiza emkhathini. Ngelinye ilanga, uThando wanquma ukuphuma eMfuleni, efuna ukusondela edwaleni elikhulu eliseMpumalanga. Wazi ukuthi lapho kuhlala abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, abahamba ngezinyawo bephila ngesimo esihle, bahlala benazisa amandla emvelo. Njengoba ehamba, wahlangabezana nabantu abahlukene, futhi wathokozisa kakhulu ngezindaba zabo. UThando wathola uNandi, intombazane enamandla, eyayikhuluma ngesimo sezulu. U-Nandi wayenobuchule bokuhlola ngezinkanyezi. “UThando, ubona lezi zinkanyezi? Zikhombisa amandla omhlaba. Ubuyele emuva, uzothola izindlela eziningi zokusebenzisa amandla akho,” kusho yena. UThando wavuma, kodwa akakazitholi kahle. Wayecabanga kakhulu ngalezi zinkanyezi, kodwa wayefuna ukuqonda ngaphezulu. Emva kwesikhathi, uThando wahlangabezana noDali, indoda eqinile enomoya ophilayo. UDali wayeyiphoyisa lendawo futhi wayesebenzisa amandla akhe ukugcina abantu bephephile. “UThando, amandla akho akhona, udinga kuphela ukuwasebenzisa ngezindlela ezilungile. Futhi khumbula, amandla akukhathazi, awubona umoya ungaphansi,” kusho uDali. Lokhu kwathinta uThando, waba nesifiso sokufunda. UThando waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, efuna izindlela zokusebenzisa amandla emhlabeni. Wafika kuyoMzi, indawo eyayizungezwe ngamanzi amaningi. Abantu babefuna ukugcina amandla amancane ngempela. UThando wathi: “Kungani ningagxili ekuthuthukiseni amandla enu? Amanye amanzi angasetshenziswa njengenhlokomo yokukhanyisa.” Abantu babemjabulisa, kodwa abanye babemshaya indiva. “UThando, ubona ukuthi kudinga isikhathi,” kusho omunye. UThando, engapheli ithemba, waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe. Wabuyela eMfuleni, ethwele izifundo eziningi. Wakhumbula izinsuku ezedlule, lapho wayengazi kahle ukuthi amandla akhe awatholakali kalula. Kodwa manje wayeqonda ukuthi amandla akukhona kuphela emoyeni, kodwa angasebenza nasemizweleni nasemoyeni. Ngesikhathi esebuyela ekhaya, uThando wanquma ukuba noMama wakhe. “Mama, sengifunde okuningi,” kusho yena. “Amandla emvelo ayebalulekile, kodwa kufanele sikwazi ukuwasebenzisa kahle. Ngizokwenza umehluko.” UMama wakhe wamomotheka, “Ngiyazi, Thando. Amandla akho ayiqiniso. Khumbula, amandla akho asondelene nemvelo.” UThando wagxila emisebenzini yokuhlinzeka abantu. Wanika izeluleko zokuhlala befaneleka, waba nesibindi sokukhuluma ngempilo, futhi wabasiza ukuthi baphile ngesimo esifanele. UThando waba umholi, futhi abantu bamlandela. Wafundisa ukuthi amandla akhuluma ngothando, umoya, nomhlaba, futhi wathola ukuthi lokho kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThando wathola ukuthi amandla emvelo ayengakwazi ukusiza abantu ukuba babe nezehlakalo ezinhle. Abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuphila, basebenzisa amandla amasha, bafunda ukuhlonipha umhlaba, futhi bagcina imvelo yabo. UThando waba yisibonelo sokuphila ngokuhlanganyela nezinsiza, futhi impilo yakhe yaguquka. UThando wakhumbula uNandi noDali, nabantu abahlukahlukene ahlangabezana nabo. Wazi ukuthi amandla akhe akukhona kuphela emoyeni, kodwa asendaweni yakhe. Wabamba imithandazo ngokwakhe, efuna ukugcina amandla emvelo, futhi wakhumbula ukuthi amandla empilo awabizwa ngaphezu kokuhluka. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThando waqonda ukuthi amandla akhe awazange aphume emzimbeni wakhe, kodwa aqhamuka nasemoyeni, emhlabeni, nasemzimbeni. UThando waba nesibindi sokuphila, uqhubeke nokuba umholi, futhi waba umkhumbuzi omkhulu kubantu baseMfuleni. UThando waphila impilo egcwele amandla, enza umhlaba ube indawo engcono, futhi wathokozisa abantu ngalokho akwabelana nabo. Futhi, njengoba uThando eqhubeka nokufunda nokukhulisa amandla akhe, waqonda ukuthi wonke umuntu angaba namandla. Ngoba amandla, akukhona kuphela emoyeni, kodwa nasemizweni, nakubudlelwano bethu. Lokhu kwafakazela ukuthi amandla awazange abe yinto ethile, kodwa kuwumgogodla wobuntu bethu. Kwaya kulokho, uThando waba isibonelo sokuphila, futhi impilo yakhe yahlala ibonisa indlela yokuphila ngendlela efanele, futhi wahlala esebenzisa amandla akhe ukuze akhuthaze abanye. Lokhu kwagcwalisa umhlaba, kwashintsha izimpilo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha kubantu bonke.
Yini edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ibhizinisi? Ukuhlanganisa uhlelo lwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshekwe ibhizinisi kahle kungaba umsebenzi obalulekile futhi ohlukile. Izidingo nezinsiza zingashintsha kuye ngohlobo lwebhizinisi, usayizi bayo, isikhathi esitholakalayo, njll. Ibhizinisi lezolimo lizoba nezidingo ezifana nomhlaba, amanzi, izinkomo, izakhiwo, indawo yokusebenza (iworkshop), indawo yokucubungula, imishini yokuphonsa, izimoto, imishini, ama-tractors, amathuluzi, abasebenzi, izimali, kanye nokuphathwa. Lezi zinsiza ezidingekayo zingahlukaniswa kanje: kukhona ukuphathwa, izindaba zomhlaba, izindaba zezimali, nezindaba zabasebenzi. Umhlaba - lokhu kungaba yifama noma izinkundla, izinkomo, izakhiwo, nezinye izakhiwo ezifana nezinsiza, izinqaba, izindawo zokuhlala izilwane, nezindonga. Imali yokusebenza - ibhekisela kumali uqobo nezinye izimpahla ezifana nama-tractors, izimoto, nezilwane. Abasebenzi - ibhekisela kubantu abasebenza efameni ngaphansi komninimfuyo noma umphathi. Ukuphathwa - umuntu noma abantu abaphatha ukusebenza kwebhizinisi. Ngaphandle kwezinto zokusebenza, konke okunye okuhlobene nokukhiqiza kungokwezimali zebhizinisi noma kukhishwe noma kuqashwe kwezinye izindawo. Uma umhlaba, imali yokusebenza, nokuphathwa kukhishwe noma kuqashwe, kubizwa ngokuthi izinsiza zangaphandle (ezivela kwezinye izindawo - omninimfuyo abanye). Lo mninimfuyo wangaphandle kufanele akhokhelwe ukusetshenziswa kwaleyo nsiza - okusho ukuthi kukhona izindleko ezihilelekile. Imiholo - ukukhokhelwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi/nabaphathi abavela kwezinye izindawo. Qaphela ukuthi abasebenzi abakwazi ukuba yimpahla yebhizinisi (ibhizinisi alikho emnini), kodwa akubizwa ngokuthi izinsiza zangaphandle. Ngakho-ke, zonke izindleko zabasebenzi - imiholo nezinye azibhekwa njengezindleko zangaphandle. Abasebenzi nezindleko zazo zibhekwa njengezindleko ezijwayelekile lapho kukhiqizwa khona goods. Umsebenzi unikeza ibhizinisi amandla noma ulwazi bese ethola umholo.
Amabhizinisi Amancane: Indaba Yempumelelo Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elalibizwa ngokuthi uMzimkhulu. Leli dolobha laligcwele abantu abahlala khona, abathanda ukusizana, futhi abanesifiso sokwakha ikusasa elihle. Phakathi kwalezi zindawo, kwavela indaba ethokozisayo yokuphumelela kwamabhizinisi amancane, okwakuhlanganisa izifiso, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokusebenza kanzima. Ngonyaka owodwa, uThandi, intombazane enomoya ophakeme, wathola umqondo wokuvula ibhizinisi lokuthengisa izithelo ezisemqoka. UThandi wayenothando olukhulu lwezithelo, futhi wayazi kahle ukuthi abantu badinga ukudla okunempilo. Ngakho, wanquma ukuthi uzothengisa izithelo ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ezinjengezithelo ezivela eMpumalanga naseNingizimu Afrika. UThandi waqala ngokuqasha indawo encane edolobheni, eyayitholakala eduze kwemakethe. Waqala ngokuthenga izithelo ezisemqoka ezivela kubalimi bendawo, eqinisekisa ukuthi izithelo azithengisayo zisezingeni eliphezulu. Ngemva kokuhlela kahle, waqala ukuhlela izithelo ngendlela ebonakalayo, ezithokozisayo, ukuze abathengi bakwazi ukuzibona kahle. UThandi wayekwazi ukuthi ukubukeka kwempahla kubalulekile, futhi lokhu kwamsiza ukuba akhe igama elihle. Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe liqala ukuhamba kahle, uThandi wathola ukuthi abathengi bayeza, bethi bazokuthenga izithelo ezisemqoka. Waqala ukufaka izithombe ezinhle zezithelo zakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, okwakwenza abantu bazi kahle ukuthi uthengisa ini. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi abathengi baphenduka abavakashi abajabule. Kodwa, impilo ayizange ibe lula. UThandi wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma kuza ezindleleni zokuthutha izithelo. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho izithelo zifika zishwabene, noma zifika zikhuluma. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga, kodwa uThandi akazange ayeke. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabalimi, eqinisekisa ukuthi uthola izithelo ezisemqoka, futhi wathola izindlela zokuthutha eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi likaThandi laqala ukuhamba kahle kakhulu. Waqala ukuthola abathengi abavela kwezinye izindawo, futhi lokhu kwamsiza ukuba akhule. Waqala ukufaka izithelo ezihlukahlukene, ezinjengezithelo ezibhalwe phansi, izithelo ezivela phesheya, kanye nezithelo ezikhethekile ezitholakala kuphela ngesikhathi esithile sonyaka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe alisiyona nje kuphela indlela yokwenza imali, kodwa futhi lisenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa abantu ngokuqhuba izifundo zokudla okunempilo, lapho abathengi bangaqonda khona ukuthi izithelo zingaba kanjani yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabo. Lokhu kwenza abantu baziqhenye ngempilo yabo, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe selikhule kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi udinga usizo. Waqasha abanye abantu abaninzi ukuze basize, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba emisebenzi emisha. Abantu bendawo baqala ukuthola imisebenzi, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsiza enkulu emndenini nasemphakathini. UThandi waphinde wathola ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe lidinga ukwandiswa. Waqala ukucabanga ngokuqhubeka nokuthengisa izithelo, kodwa futhi wathola ukuthi angathengisa nezinye izinto ezihlobene, njengezithako zokupheka ezivela ezithelweni. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi uThandi waba nebhizinisi elikhulu elihlanganisa izithelo, izithako, kanye nezinsiza zokupheka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana nabanye abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane, behlanganyela izifundo, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Umphakathi waba nempilo engcono, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma umuntu enza kanzima, angakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba nebhizinisi elikhulu, kodwa akazange akhohlwe ukuthi ibhizinisi elikhulu lidinga umoya wokusebenza kanzima. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, eqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe lihlala lisezingeni eliphezulu. Waqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuthengisa, futhi wathola ukuthi umphakathi udinga izinsiza eziningi. UThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo, futhi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma umuntu enza kanzima, angakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane awanqotshwa, futhi akha umphakathi onempilo, onothando, nolwazi. Ngale ndlela, indaba kaThandi ibonisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma umuntu enza kanzima, angakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo, futhi amabhizinisi amancane angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza uMzimkhulu waba yindawo engcono, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela.
Amalungu omphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele ayamenywa ukuthi anikeze amagama amalungu eNational Heritage Council (NHC). Inhloso ye-NHC ukuhlinzeka, ukuthuthukisa, nokuvikela ifa lemvelo laseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuletha ukufana ekuphathweni kwefa lemvelo. Izothola ukuvunywa kwephalamende kusuka kuMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko futhi izohlinzeka, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngoxhaso lwezimali ngediphozi zebhange ezikhungweni nasezinhlelweni/imisebenzi ezithunyelwe. I-NHC yasungulwa njengomzimba ophakanyisiwe ngaphansi komthetho weNational Heritage Council Act ka-1999 (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999). Amalungu e-NHC azoba nesibopho sokwenza izinhlinzeko zalo mthetho futhi kulindeleke ukuthi azijwayeze ukuphathwa okuphezulu kwe-NHC ngokulandela umthetho wePublic Finance Management Act, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999). Ababiziwe kumele babe nolwazi emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, amasiko aphilayo, umlando, nokuvikelwa, kumele bahlonishwe ngalesi sikhungo kuzo zonke izigaba ze-fa lemvelo, kumele baziwe njengabantu abanokwethembeka abazibophezele ekuvikeleni nasekuthuthukiseni ifa lethu lemvelo eliyingqayizivele, futhi akumele babe nesikhundla kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yezombusazwe. Amalungu e-NHC azothola umholo wanyanga zonke kodwa azokhokhelwa izindleko ezitholakele emsebenzini wabo ne-NHC. Amalungu azothola futhi uphawu lokwazisa ngezabelo zabo. Ikomidi lokukhetha lizokwakhiwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze lenze uhlu lwababiziwe bazo zonke izifundazwe, kulandelwe izingxoxo zomphakathi nezifundazwe. Incazelo ye komidi elisunguliwe izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kufaka phakathi wakhiwo ezivela kuzo zonke izigaba ze-heritage kazwelonke, zonke izindawo, nobulili bobabili, futhi ukuthi ukukhethwa konke kuhlangabezana nezinga eliphezulu kakhulu. Ikomidi lokukhetha lizokwethula uhlu lwamalungu angama-15 kuNgqongqoshe, ozokwenza ukukhethwa kokugcina kwe-NHC kulolu hlu. Okungenani amalungu amahlanu e-NHC angakhethwa ngalendlela, kanti uMEC ophatha ifa lemvelo nokuvikelwa ezweni ngalinye kufanele akhethe omunye ummeleli kuleyo ndawo. a Incwadi equkethe amagama aphelele, ikheli, izinombolo zocingo, kanye nezifakazelo zababiziwe, kanye nezizathu zokubizwa kwabo. b I-curriculum vitae noma umlando ophathelene nezimpilo zababiziwe ohlola iziqu zabo zokuhlonishwa. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngababiziwe, sikhombisa ukuvuma kokubizwa. d Amagama nezindawo zokuxhumana zababoni ababili. Akekho okubizwa ozokwamukelwa uma konke okukhuluma ngenhla kungafakiwe. Ukubizwa kufanele kufike kuMphathiswa oPhakathi, uMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, ngaphambi kosuku lwe-14 kuFebhuwari 2003.
Ukulondolozwa Kwezilwane Ngomhlaka 15 kuNcwaba, umphakathi wethu ubuhlanganyela emcimbini obalulekile wokulondolozwa kwezilwane, owawuhlelwe eMnyangweni Wezokuhlalisana Nezinto Zomhlaba. Lo mcimbi ube nesihloko esithi "Izilwane Zethu, Ikusasa Lethu," futhi wahlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi izazi, abathandi bezilwane, kanye nabantu abavela ezinhlelweni zokulondoloza. Umsakazo wokuqala wecala, umholi womphakathi, uMnu. Dlamini, uvule umcimbi ngenkulumo ethokozisayo, echaza ukubaluleka kokulondolozwa kwezilwane emiphakathini yethu. Ubonise ukuthi izilwane azikhona nje kuphela ukuze zihlale emhlabeni, kodwa zinemisebenzi ebalulekile ekugcineni ibhalansi yemvelo. Uthe, "Uma silondoloza izilwane, silondoloza umhlaba wethu, izinsiza zethu, kanye nekusasa lezingane zethu." Emva kwalokho, izazi ezahlukene zethule izethulo ezimnandi. UProf. Mthembu, osebenza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezilwane, wakhuluma ngempumelelo yezenzo zokulondoloza, ezibandakanya ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphephile nezokuvikela izilwane ezisengozini. Uveze izibonelo eziphumelelayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokulondoloza i-Black Rhino eNingizimu Afrika, ezithuthukise inani lezilwane lezi eminyakeni edlule. Uhlelo lwemihlangano lwalunemisebenzi ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinkulumo, izifundo, nezethulo. Abantu babenethuba lokuxhumana nezazi, baphinde babuze imibuzo ethokozisayo. UMs. Khumalo, ongumholi wezinhlelo zokulondoloza izilwane, wakhuluma ngendaba yokuvikela izilwane ezisengozini, futhi wagcizelela ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube nengxenye ekuvikelweni kwezilwane. Uthe, "Akukona nje umsebenzi wezazi, kodwa wonke umuntu unendima yokudlala." Ngemuva kokuphothula izethulo, umcimbi ube nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa. Kwakukhona imidlalo yokufundisa, lapho izingane zifunda ngezinto ezahlukene ezihlobene nezilwane, zifunda ukuthi zingabavikeli kanjani. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokukhuthaza abantwana ukuthi bathande izilwane, baqonde ukubaluleka kokulondolozwa kwazo. Ngemuva kwemisebenzi, umphakathi waba nesikhathi sokuxoxa, lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango yabo, izifiso, nemibono. UMs. Ndlovu, ongumthandi wezilwane, wabelane ngendaba yakhe yokuhlangana nezingwe, echaza ukuthi lezi zinto zihlala zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi kufanele silondoloze imvelo yethu. Uthe, "Uma sithanda izilwane, sithanda imvelo, futhi lokho kuholela ekukhuleni komphakathi." Emva kokuba umcimbi usuphelile, abahlanganyeli baphinde bakhumbuleka ukuthi ukulondolozwa kwezilwane akupheli lapha. UMs. Mkhize, owayengumengameli wombuthano, waphakamisa ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye, ube nezinhlelo ezithile zokulondoloza. Uthe, "Kufanele sibe nomqondo ophakeme wokuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zincane noma zikhulu." Lo mcimbi wawuhlanganisa abantu abanothando, abathanda imvelo, futhi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sinesibopho sokulondoloza izilwane. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi izilwane zisebenza njengomphakathi, futhi uma sikhuthaza ukulondolozwa kwazo, sikhuthaza futhi impilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi uthathe isinyathelo sokuhlanganyela, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izilwane zethu zihlala zikhona, zikhula, futhi ziphila kahle emhlabeni wethu. Emva kokuphothula umcimbi, kwaba nesikhumbuzo sokuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekulondolozeni izilwane. Abantu baphinde bakhuthazwa ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezinhlelweni zokuvikela izilwane, bephinde bahloniphe imvelo. Umcimbi wawuhamba phambili, ubonisa ukuthi uma sikhuthaza umoya wokubambisana, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobungane nezilwane zethu. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu sokuthi baphinde bahlanganyele emicimbini efana nale, ukuze baqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukulondolozwa kwezilwane. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umphakathi unokuqonda okukhulu kokubaluleka kokulondoloza izilwane, futhi lokhu kuzoholela ekukhuleni kokuhlanganyela emsebenzini wokulondoloza. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenza ndawonye, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izilwane zethu zihlala zikhona, ziphila kahle, futhi zihlala zikhumbuleka emhlabeni wethu.
Ithuba ngalinye linikezwa ngezithombe ukuze zihlolwe bese kuvunyelwana ngalokho okubukwayo. Umphakathi uhlukanisa izithombe ngezindlela ezintathu: "ezinhle," "ezimbi," kanye "nezingathathi hlangothi." Izingathathi hlangothi - ukungaqiniseki mayelana nokuthi kuhle noma kubi. Le chati iyasiza ngoba ivumela umphakathi ukuba uphenye, uhlaziye, futhi ubheke isimo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuqonda ukuthi izifo zidluliselwa kanjani komunye umuntu, nokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezingavikela ukusabalala kwezifo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba xoxa ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezilula ukuzisebenzisa. Inqubo yokuchaza ngokobulili: Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezintathu zabesifazane nabesilisa, kanye nabesifazane nabesilisa ndawonye. Izithombe zabesifazane zihlala zisebenza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene. Enye imfuneko uk counting beans. Le thuluzi ihlose ukwenza abantu bazi ngobulili babo emphakathini. Bangabona ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo emihlanganweni yabo yezempilo futhi baphinde bacabange ukuthi lezi zinkinga zingavimbela kanjani ukuthuthuka kwabo. Kukhona izithombe eziyi-20-25 zezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kanye nezokuhlanzeka, njenge ukusetshenziswa kwezihlahla ukuze kube nezindlu zangasese ezisebenzisa amanzi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi avela emifuleni kuya ezitophini ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba abheke izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi avela emifuleni kuya ezitophini ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukubona izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezokuhlanzeka emphakathini. Ibhokisi lemibuzo: Le thuluzi isebenzisa ibhokisi elilodwa elinovimba ukuze umphakathi uthumele imibuzo yabo. Umphakathi unethuba lokubuza imibuzo ngendlela engabafaka engcupheni yokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo emphakathini. Lokhu kusiza umphakathi ukuba ubuze imibuzo ngendlela engathinti ubuhlungu, okungabavimbi noma kubangele ukungqubuzana. Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezahlukene zezenzakalo ezedlule nezamanje ukuze ibonise umehluko phakathi kokuthile okuphukile nokuthile okulungisiwe. Uhlelo lwe-PHAST lwakhiwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ushintsho lwesimo sokuziphatha mayelana nezokuhlanzeka kanye nentuthuko yezindlela ezifanele zokulahla udoti. Lwakhiwe ukuze kuhlanzwe udoti kahle, kube nokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, kanye nempilo yemvelo, njengoba lezi zaziwa njengezinye zezinkinga ezihlobene nalokhu. Le ndlela isebenzisa izithombe ezivumela abantu ukuba babone ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi nezokuhlanzeka emphakathini ngendlela ebonakalayo. Le ndlela isebenzisa izindlela nezinto ezikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabesilisa, abesifazane, nezingane. Ukwandisa ukuqwashisa, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kwezokuhlanzeka, nokulahla udoti ngendlela efanele. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba babhekane nezinkinga ezihlobene nokushintsha kokuziphatha. Ngokuhlola ulwazi lwabantu. Ukuhlola izimo abantu abaphila kuzo. Ngokubheka izimo ezingaba khona esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlaziya izinkinga ezingavimbela ushintsho. Ukulungiselela ushintsho. Ekugcineni, ukwenza ushintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokubambisana. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungaxazulula kanjani izinkinga. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ngokusekelwe kulwazi abanalo. Ukwamukela izindlela ezahlukene emphakathini ngokwokuqonda ukusabalala nokuvikela kwezifo. Ukubona izinkinga: Umphakathi uxoxa ngezinkinga zezempilo ezikhona emphakathini. Ukuhlaziywa kwezinkinga Uma sibheka izinkinga, asicabangi ngesimo samanzi nokulahla udoti emphakathini kodwa esikhundleni salokho sisiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi ushintshela ezindleleni zokuhlanzeka ezingcono. Kubheka futhi ucwaningo lokwenza umphakathi futhi kubona ukuthi izifo zisabalala kanjani. Ukuhlela izixazululo Ngenkathi umphakathi uthola ukuthi kuphi inkinga, kumele baphakamise izindlela zokuvikela ukusabalala kwezifo. Ukukhetha izindlela. Lapha umphakathi uphakamisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwedoti emphakathini futhi ukhethe izindlela zokuhlanzeka ezingcono njengoba behlola izindlela ezinhle nezimbi. Ukuhlela ushintsho lokuziphatha nezinsiza ezintsha. Lapha umphakathi uhlunga abantu ukuze bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezizoletha ushintsho. Umphakathi uphinde ubheke ukuthi yini engahamba kahle ezinhlelweni zabo. Lezi yizithombe eziyi-15 ezisetshenziswe ezinhlelweni ezimbili ezibonisa izindawo ezinezimo ezahlukene. Umphakathi uhlukaniswe ngamaqembu amancane ukuze akhe ithimba ngalinye elinikezwa izithombe ezikhuluma ngezindaba eziphelele. Bese amaqembu axoxa ngezindaba zabo. Ngesikhathi sokusebenzisa le thuluzi, kukhona inhloso yokucwaninga ngezinkinga zomphakathi nezinye izindaba ezihlobene naleso sikhala.
Inombolo 8 ka-2001: Umthetho Wokwakhiwa Kwezokuthutha, ka-2001. Ukuze kuhlanganiswe imithetho ephathelene nezindlela kanye nezinye izakhiwo zokuthutha eGauteng; nokuhlinzeka ngohlelo, ukuklama, ukuthuthukisa, ukwakha, ukuxhasa, ukuphatha, ukulawula, ukugcina, ukuvikela, nokuthuthukisa izindlela zomphakathi, izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi, nezinye izakhiwo zokuthutha eGauteng: nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. Ububanzi obujwayelekile bezindlela zomphakathi, izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi, nezindlela ezincane. Ukumemezela ukusungulwa kokusebenza kwezindlela zomphakathi, izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi, nezindlela ezincane. Izakhiwo nezinye izisebenzi phezulu noma phansi kwezindlela zomphakathi noma izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi noma ezinye izindawo. Futhi umuntu ophatha ukuthengwa komhlaba, uma umnikazi eshonile; "imoto" kusho imoto njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezindlela Kazwelonke, ka-1996 (Umthetho 93 ka-1996). Kuveziwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezindlela ka-1957 (Umthetho 22 ka-1957) kodwa akuhlanganisi izindlela ezikhonjiswe esigabeni. b Ihlaziywa noma kungekho indlela yomphakathi entsha. Ukusetshenziswa kwalesi sigaba kusebenza uma iMEC isebenzisa amandla ngaphansi kwesigaba a mayelana nokubekwa kwendlela nokuklama izindlela zomphakathi noma izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi. a Ukubekwa kwendlela; futhi b ukuklama njengengqikithi. Ukubekwa kwendlela kumele kuhambisane nanoma iyiphi izakhiwo noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi olwakhiwe ngaphansi komthetho wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, kungenjalo, ukuvunywa komuntu oyiSithunywa esiphezulu, okuyiwo ohlela ukuthuthukiswa, kumele kutholwe ngaphambi kokuba indlela ibekwe ngaphakathi kwalesi sigaba. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana nomphakathi, ikomidi kumele lilungise umbiko obhaliwe ngakho, lihlinzeka ngama-policy akhiwe esigabeni 3 soMthetho Wokuhlinzeka Ngentuthuko, ka-1995 (Umthetho 67 ka-1995) kanye noMthetho Wokuhlela Nokuthuthukisa wesifunda.
