Isimo ngalesi sikhathi asikwazi ukusebenzisa isivumelwano sokwenqaba abantu amalungelo abo noma labo abafuna ukufinyelela emhlabeni. Abasebenzi nabantu abafuna ukufinyelela emhlabeni kufanele bakhombise ukuqonda isimo esibucayi samanje emapulazini futhi akufanele bazizwe bephoxekile ngokuziphatha ngendlela yokwesaba noma yokuphikisana, futhi akufanele baphakamisela imikhawulo ezicelweni zokuvuma ukufinyelela emapulazini ukuze bavakashele ngezizathu ezibalulekile noma ezisemthethweni. Sifuna ukubonga lezi zikhungo ezilandelayo ngempumelelo yazo nokusiza ekwenzeni leli documeti likhulu. Uma umsebenzi engakwazi ukuhlela isikhathi ngoba engakutholi ukuxhumana nomnikazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba, noma ngoba isicelo sokufinyelela siphikisiwe, kufanele axhumane nenhlangano yabafuyi noma i-union yezolimo yendawo noma i-SAPS ukuze athole usizo ngalolu daba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abantu abanamalungelo okuvakashela abantu emapulazini ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikela Ukusetshenziswa Komhlaba, ngokwesibonelo. Kuphela uma izivumelwano/zikhathi zenzelwe umnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba. Umvakashelayo kufanele asebenzise indlela eshiwo ngaphambili ukuya ezindlini zabasebenzi epulazini noma ezindaweni zokungcwaba zabokhokho babo. Kumele kube nesivumelwano esicacile ngesikhathi sokuvakasha. Umvakashelayo akufanele abambe iqhaza kunoma yiziphi ezinye izenzo ngaphandle kwalokho abavunyelwe. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abacwaningi, abahlanganyeli bezombusazwe, abahleli bezenzakalo, abasebenzi bezinkolo, njll. Abafuyi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi babo bayahlanganyela kulawa mhlangano futhi, lapho kungenzeka, banikeze ukuhamba kulawa madolobha. Ezimweni ezikhethekile lapho abantu kufanele bangavunyelwa ukufinyelela epulazini, kufanele kube kuphela ngemva kokuhlelwa kwangaphambili okucacile nezinqumo ezithathwe nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba, futhi kuncike ezimweni ezishiwo ngumnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba. Ukubhekwa kwemibono yezenhlalakahle kanye nomphakathi wezolimo jikelele kufanele kube ukuvuselela ukuphepha esimweni esijwayelekile. Ngo-2002, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zamukela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi asizukuphazamiseka ngokuqondile emisebenzini yabo efanele. (Bheka inothi elingezansi). 1 Ngasikhathi sinye, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zizoba nesithakazelo ezinkathazweni zomphakathi wezolimo futhi zizolandela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngangokunokwenzeka. Abanikazi bomhlaba bazibophezela ekubambisaneni ngokuphelele nezikhungo zokuvikela ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Leqembu lifaka abahloli abavela emaphandleni ezeMpilo, Ezokuphatha, Ezomsebenzi, Ezolimo, njll. Kuphela uma izivumelwano/zikhathi zenzelwe umnikazi noma omunye umuntu ophatha umhlaba. Uma uthola ilungelo lokungena noma ukufinyelela emhlabeni noma ezindlini, bika ngokushesha kumnikazi noma kumuntu ophatha umhlaba. Umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngaye kufanele azichaze kahle, achaze uhlobo lomsebenzi wakhe, futhi aveze isikhathi asithanda ukuba khona kulowo mhlaba. Umsebenzi akufanele enze noma iyiphi imisebenzi noma izenzo abengenayo ilungelo lokwenza. a. Ukuphulwa komthetho ngabo bonke abantu - Ukuhlasela, ukubulala, ukuhlinzwa, ukulimaza okungamanga empahleni, noma noma yiziphi izizathu ezinjalo. Kuwo wonke amacala lapho ukufinyelela kuphikisiwe ngokuqinile emhlabeni oqashiweyo, amarekhodi kufanele agcinwe kahle ukuze kube nobufakazi. Ngo-2001, ngenxa yokukhathazeka nokwanda kweziqhumane emapulazini, kanye nenani elikhulu labantu ababulawa noma abalimala, i-Agri SA yenze isivumelwano sokusebenza sokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwabantu abahamba noma abahamba emhlabeni wepulazi. Ezinye zalezi ziqhumane zenzeka ngokudabukisayo ngabantu abenza sengathi bangamalungu ezinsizakalo zokuphepha futhi begqoke izikhwama. Isivumelwano Sokusebenza sakhulunywa neziMali Zokuphepha (i-SAPS ne-SANDF) kanye nezinsizakalo zabo zomthetho. Izichibiyelo ezithile zenziwa ngu-sheriff wamacala ngoMeyi, ozokwenza imiyalo yokukhishwa ezindaweni ezithile. Ezinye izimo lapho kukhona ulwazi oluningi olukhombisa ukuthi u-sheriff kanye nabasebenzi bakhe bangase babe sengozini yokulimala, ukufa, noma ukulimala kwemali, iSouth African Police Service izophatha umthetho futhi ikhiphe imiyalo, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Abangena ngokungemthetho kufanele baboshwe ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka futhi baphakanyiswe phambi kwenkantolo. Umnikazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba kufanele afake isikhalazo esisemthethweni ngokushesha kwiSouth African Police Service. Uma kuvela ukuthi umsolwa uhlala kulowo mhlaba isikhathi eside, umnikazi kufanele axwayiswe ukuthi umngeni ongavunyelwe kufanele akhishwe ngomyalo wenkantolo. c. Lokhu umnikazi, umhlali onemvume, noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba akavumelanga; futhi d. Umngeni akanaso isizathu esisemthethweni sokungena emhlabeni, ngokwesibonelo. Uma iphoyisa ibikwe ngokuqhamuka komhlaba endaweni enkulu, kubalulekile ukuthi kwenziwe isenzo ngesikhathi esifushane kakhulu. Ukuhlasela emhlabeni kuvame ukuhlobana nokuhlala ngokungemthetho emhlabeni. Umnikazi angathola umyalo wokukhishwa ngokushesha ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlala Ngokungemthetho Emhlabeni (PIE). Abasebenzi abavulekile bangakhishwa kuphela ngomyalo wenkantolo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphathwa Komhlaba (isigaba 5 se-LTA). Lo myalo utholwa ngumuntu onikezayo ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Abahlali abavunyelwe bangakhishwa kuphela ngomyalo wenkantolo yedolobha noma yenkantolo ephakeme. b. Uthola umyalo wenkantolo uma umhlali engashiyi umhlaba ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe; futhi c. Futhi ukusetshenziswa komyalo wokukhishwa. Abahlali abavunyelwe bangakhishwa kuphela ngomyalo wenkantolo yedolobha noma yenkantolo ephakeme. Lo myalo utholwa ngumuntu onikezayo ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Kuyiphutha elibuhlungu ukwamukela ngqo noma ngokuqondile noma ukufuna ukukhokhwa kwanoma yimaphi imali noma noma yini ebhekwa njengokubuyiselwa noma ukuhlela noma ukuvumela umuntu ukuba ahlale emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi noma umuntu ophatha lowo mhlaba. Umhlali ongavunyelwe ungumuntu ophatha umhlaba ngaphandle kwemvume echazwe ngumuntu onikezayo ngokuqondile. Abahlali ngaphansi ko-ESTA abavunyelwe. Amalungelo abahlali abavunyelwe avikelwe nguMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlala Ngokungemthetho Nokuhlala Ngokungemthetho Emhlabeni, 1998. Le ngxenye yabahlali izoba ikakhulu laba abaziwa njenge "squatters" abahlala ezindaweni ngaphandle kwemvume. Umthetho we-PIE uthatha indawo yoMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlala Ngokungemthetho ka-1951. Umuntu ongenayo imvume yokungena ungumuntu ongena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi, futhi amaphoyisa angamthumba. Uma umuntu ongene ngaphandle kwemvume "uhlala" emhlabeni womnikazi, kufanele abhekwane njengomhlali ongavunyelwe. "Uhlala" kusho ukuthi umuntu unendawo yokuhlala noma uhlala ngaphandle kokuphela kwaleso sikhathi kulowo mhlaba. Inkantolo ethola
Yiziphi izimfuneko zokubhaliswa? Thumela imali efanele okufanele ikhokhwe ngokuhambisana nesicelo sakho. Ibhodi izokubhalisela bese ikhishwa isitifiketi sokubhaliswa uma uhambisana nezimfuno ezidingekayo nezifanele zemfundo kanye nolwazi olukhuluma ngakho iBhodi. Umphumela wokuhlola ngeke uthunyelwe kuze kube sekupheleni komhlangano weBhodi. Uma, ngemuva kokusungulwa koMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, umfakisicelo utholakala enecala eRiphabhulikhi noma kwenye indawo futhi unikezwa isigwebo esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu noma imali njengendlela yokuhlwithwa. Uma iNkantolo Ephakeme ithola ukuthi umfakisicelo unengqondo engalungile noma unezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, noma uma bephumelele endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo ngaphansi koMthetho Wempilo Yengqondo, 1973. Uma ukubhaliswa komuntu kuvinjelwe ngenxa yephutha elingafunwanga ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu esuswa endimeni yokwethembeka ngenxa yokuziphatha okungafanele. Uma umuntu etholwa yinkantolo engakakhokhi izikweletu futhi engakabuyiselwa esimweni esihle mayelana nezikweletu, futhi ukungakhokhi izikweletu kwakubangelwa ukungaziphathi kahle emsebenzini ophathelene nokufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ibhodi izokwazi ukukwazisa ngokubhala uma isicelo sokubhaliswa sakho sikhanseliwe. Ungaphikisa isinqumo seBhodi ezinsukwini ezingama-30. Kufanele ufake isicelo kuBhodi sokuvuselela ukubhaliswa okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokubhaliswa kwakho. Ukuze ukhokhe ngedijithali nokuqondile: Sicela usebenzise iziqu zamagama akho nesibongo ukuze uqinisekise ukukhokha kwethu embikweni wethu webhange bese uthumela ubufakazi bokukhokha ngefeksi, kanye neKHASI LOKUQALA lesicelo, kule nombolo: 841 1057.
Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo: Ukubuyekezwa Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zibalulekile ekwakheni izindawo ezinhle nezihlala kahle kubantu. Zihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila, ukuvuselela izindawo ezindala, nokwakha amakhaya anokuthula. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo, izinselelo, nezindlela zokuphumelela kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi izici eziningi, njengezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemijondolo emisha, ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ugesi, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezikole nezindawo zokudlela. Izinhlelo ezinhle ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni enempilo, enokuthula, futhi ethuthukisiwe. Izinzuzo zalezi zinhlelo ziningi. Zikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwezindawo ezindala, okwenza kube nokuthuthukiswa kwezokwakha nezokuthutha, kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, futhi kukhuphule ukuncintisana kwezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zifaka imihlangano yomphakathi, lapho abantu bebanjwa khona ukuze baphawule ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi banikezwa ithuba lokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nalezi zinhlelo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo, njengoba izinsiza eziningi zidinga imali eningi, futhi kube nzima ukuthola uxhaso lwezezimali. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye abantu baphumeze izinhlelo zabo, kanti abanye bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuhle phakathi kwabantu. Uma umphakathi ungavumelani, izinhlelo zingase zingaphumelelanga. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile nezisebenzayo, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali oluqinile. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze baqonde izinqubo zokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwazisa phakathi kwabantu, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni imijondolo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zikhombisa ukuthi zingaba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokuhlanganyela, baphinde bakhuthaze izinhlelo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okuzoholela ekwakheni izindawo ezinhle ezihlala kahle. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwezindawo, zikhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni enempilo. Nokho, izinselelo ezihambisana nalezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuqashelwa ukuze kutholakale izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nomphakathi bahlanganyele ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo ziya phambili, ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imijondolo zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngokuqinile, ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle, futhi zihlale ziqhuba izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, okuzoholela ekwakheni izindawo ezinhle ezihlala kahle. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuxhasa lezi zinhlelo, ukuze sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Unyaka wezezimali odlule ubungunyaka onzima kakhulu kuBhodi ekhona njengoba bekudingeka ukuthi baqedele izakhiwo nemigomo futhi babeke isisekelo seBhodi entsha ukuze ithathe izintambo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Le bekuyiqembu elisebenze iminyaka emihlanu, iPANSALB, kusukela ngoMsombuluko 24, 1996, kuze kube nguMsombuluko 25, 2001. Le mbiko ibonisa izenzakalo ezenzeke unyaka wezezimali odlule mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezimiso zolimi ezweni. Le bekuyonyaka obalulekile kubalungu beBhodi njengoba bekungunyaka wabo wokugcina ezikhundleni zabo. Ibhodi igxile kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi zonke izinqubo, imigomo, nezakhiwo zizosekela iPANSALB ekufezeni izinhloso zayo. Iqedile ukusungulwa kweKomidi Yolimi Lwezifunda kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye, Imibutho Yolimi Kazwelonke, kanye Nezikhungo Zolimi Kazwelonke. Kulindeleke ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izogcina izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihloswe kubasebenzi kanye neBhodi Yabaphathi abazobamba iqhaza ezikhungweni zolimi kazwelonke. Amakomidi Olimi Kazwelonke kanye namalungu eZikhungo Zolimi Kazwelonke kufanele anikezwe iziqondiso eziphelele mayelana nokusebenza kwale mibutho futhi imisebenzi yabo kufanele yenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zemigomo ezibekiwe. Imibutho yokweluleka izosiza kokubili iBhodi kanye nezishayamthetho zezifunda ekutholeni ulwazi mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nolimi emiphakathini emelelwe yile mibutho. Le Bhodi ekhona iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi iziqondiso zihlala zifakwa kuzo zonke izigaba zokugxila ukuze kusekelwe iPANSALB emsebenzini wayo ophakanyisiwe. Imisebenzi eyenziwe unyaka wezezimali odlule, kuhlanganise nocwaningo nemikhankaso yokuthuthukisa, izosiza iPANSALB ukuqhubeka nokuhlola izinqubo zayo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphansi kwezimiso zocwaningo zolimi mayelana "nokusetshenziswa nobudlelwano bezilimi eNingizimu Afrika," kusizile iBhodi ukuba iqonde kangcono isimo solimi futhi ihlanganise kahle iziqondiso nezinqubo zemigomo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kolimi nokubhekwa. Idokhumenti ejwayelekile yokuhola yashicilelwa ukusiza izikhungo ekuqhubekeni kokuthuthukisa imigomo yolimi. Ucwaningo oluxhaswe ngezimali ngalokhu, kanye nocwaningo oluqhubekayo, luzoba usizo eqenjini elisha njengoba lihlola izinqubo zeBhodi ukwenza izincomo ezihloswe kuhulumeni kanye nezikhungo zawo mayelana nemigomo yolimi. Nakuba bekungelula ukusungula ubudlelwano bokubambisana phakathi kweBhodi kanye neHhovisi likaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo ngenkathi sisekhona, sithemba ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalolo budlelwano. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yocwaningo nemikhankaso eyaxhaswa ngaphansi kwezilimi mayelana nemfundo eminyakeni emihlanu edlule iyabelwana nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla zemfundo ezingeni lesizwe nasezifundeni. Kungenzeka ukuthi kuqhutshwe imikhankaso ezokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yolimi emfundweni ingasebenza ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda nokuphindaphinda kwendaba eyodwa ethinta umnotho, kanye nokukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemibutho. Mayelana nokuphakanyiswa kobuchwepheshe ekuhumusheni nasekuqondiseni, iPANSALB iphumelele ekukhiqizeni idokhumenti ezosetshenziswa ekubhaleni umthetho ozoba yisisekelo semigomo yobuchwepheshe. Lokhu sekuphakanyisiwe kuNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi, kanye neTekhnoloji ukuze kuqhubeke nalesi sici somthetho. Ibhodi entsha izodinga ukubambisana nomzimba ozosungulwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe inhlonipho yalolu shishino. Inselelo enkulu iPANSALB ebhekene nayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi ezake zaba nezehlakalo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi izilimi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezisemthethweni, zithuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzovumela lezi zilimi ukuthi zisebenze njengezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ukusungulwa kweZikhungo Zolimi kuyisinyathelo esisodwa salokho. Ezinye izindlela ezithathwe yiBhodi zifaka ukuqeqeshwa kwababhali be-TV, iradiyo, nevidiyo kulezi zilimi, kanye nokuxazulula izinqubo ezizosheshisa ukusakazwa kwezincwadi zendawo. Lokhu kuyisigaba esisodwa okufanele sigxile kuso ukuze kusekelwe izinqubo ezizosiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakanyiseni lezi zilimi, kanye nabanye ozakwethu abathintekayo ezinhlelweni ezifana nalezi. Ibhodi iphinde yenza uphenyo ngezikhalazo eziningi ezethulwe phambi kwayo. Ngeshwa, le msebenzi isadinga ukuhlela ukuze isetshenziswe kahle ukusiza ekuqapheleni izilimi nokukhuthaza izikhungo ukuba zithuthukise nezimiso zazo zolimi ezizokwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezingalingani zomlando. Kuyafunwa yiPANSALB ukubona abakhuluma izilimi zendawo bephila amalungelo abo olimi. Izinqubomgomo zokwenza ukuthi Amakomidi Olimi Lwezifunda aphakanyise ukuqwashisa ngezizilimi phakathi kwabakhuluma izilimi ezake zaphathwa kabi ziyaqhubeka. Impumelelo yayo izobonakala eminyakeni ezayo futhi izokwakhiwa, uma kudingeka, ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo. I-PANSALB iphinde yabambisana nemibutho ehlukahlukene ukuze ifinyelele impumelelo. Ubudlelwano obakhe nemibutho efana neNhlangano Yezobuciko Kazwelonke, iNhlangano Yezithombe Nevidiyo Kazwelonke, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi kukahulumeni kufanele bukhuliswe. Umsebenzi onikezwe iBhodi ungaphathwa kuphela yiBhodi; kufanele ibambisane neminye imibutho esebenzela izinhloso ezifanayo neBhodi. Le Bhodi ekhona izibophezele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nemibutho efana neSABC, abakhiqizi, kanye nezinye imibutho ezizimele. Nokho, sikhuthaza leli qembu elisha ukuthi liqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano bokubambisana nemibutho yalo. Ukuba nabasebenzi abaneziqu, isipiliyoni sokubambisana nokuxhumana kuzosisiza ukufezekisa le njongo. Ekuphetheni, ngiyabonga kuMphakathi Ohloniphekile uNkk. Zubeida Desai, bonke balungu beBhodi, uMphathi Omkhulu, uProfesa Cynthia Marivate, kanye nabasebenzi bakhe ngomsebenzi ophakeme abawenzayo kanye nokuzinikela kwabo ekuthuthukiseni izilimi nezilimi zendawo eNingizimu Afrika.
Isikhathi esibalulekile sempilo ye-piglet siqala ekuthwaleni kuze kube yilapho ifika ekwakheni. Ngokuvamile, ama-piglet amabili azalwa ngalesi sikhathi. Isizathu esikhulu esithinta lokhu ukuphathwa okungafanele, noma isizathu singaba ukuhlanganiswa, ukuhamba kwegazi kusuka emathanjeni, i-anemia, ukungondleki, noma isifo. I-sow kumele ihlanzwe futhi iphathwe ngemedikali ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa endaweni yokuzala (okungenani ezinsukwini ezingu-4 kuya kwezi-5 ngaphambi kokuzala). I-sow eduze kokuzala akufanele ihanjiswe endaweni yokuzala kuze kube sekwindla yokuzala, ukuze ivumeleke ukuba ijwayele indawo yokuzala futhi yehlise ingcindezi. Indawo kumele ihlolwe kahle ukuze ibonakale izindawo eziqinile noma ama-lumps. Ama-lumps angaphathwa ngensipho yokuhlanzeka. Indawo yokuzala kumele yakhiwe kude nezinye izindawo. Ukuhlanzeka kumele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlanza indawo yokuzala kahle ngemva kokususa i-sow kanye nama-piglet ayo. Zonke izinto eziphumayo kumele zisuswe zisebenzisa umoya onamandla, ibhulashi lokuhlanzeka, noma isikhuhlu esinamandla. Indawo kumele ihlanzwe ngesisombululo sokuhlanzeka esifana nesixazululo se-4% formalin. Kumele ishiywe ingenalutho izinsuku ezi-2 kuya kwezi-3. Izikhwama ezingcolile nezimanzi kumele zisuswe nsuku zonke futhi zishintshwe ngezikhwama ezomile. I-sow kumele ibe nokukhiqizwa kwe-milk okwanele; ukungabi namanzi kungaholela ekufeni kwama-piglet ngenxa yokungondleki. Ama-piglet kanye nomama wabo kumele bahlolwe futhi banikezwe ukwelashwa okukhethekile, futhi udokotela wezilwane kumele abizwe ngokushesha. Ubude be-umbilical cord bungaba cishe ama-centimeter angu-12, kanti ingxenye engu-2 centimeters kumele ishiywe. Lokhu kuvikela ekulimazeni phakathi kwama-piglet ngesikhathi seziphakathi futhi kuphinde kuvikele ekugibeleni nasekudonseni izitho ze-sow. Qaphela lapho usika amazinyo ungakalimazi imilomo. Kuhle futhi kuyasiza ukushiya ucezu lwezinyawo. Kunconywa ukusika amazinyo usebenzisa umshini ofanele wokusika. Ama-piglet azalwa enezinhlamvu zensimbi, futhi ubisi lwe-sow aluhlinzeki ngezidingo zensimbi zama-piglet akhuliswe ezindaweni zekhonkolo. Ukwengeza insimbi kumele kuqinisekiswe ngokushesha ngemuva kokuzalwa (ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7) ngezinhlamvu emathangeni. Ama-piglet kumele ahlukaniswe ezindlebeni ukuze kube nokuhlonza. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitikha ezingenziwa ezindlebeni. Izinhlelo zokubhalisa zezinombolo zezinhlamvu kumele zisetshenziswe ne-South African Pedigree Association ukuze zisetshenziswe ezokwelapha.
Gwema ukusondela eduze kwabantu abangase babe nesifo. Nciphisa isikhathi osichitha ezindaweni ezinamahlalakhona. Zilungiselele imikhuba emihle yokuphila ehlanganisa ukuthola ubuthongo obanele, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, nokugcina umzimba wakho uhlelekile. Awuzokwazi ukusho umehluko phakathi kokubanda okujwayelekile ne-Influenza A (H1N1) ngaphandle kosizo lwekhemisi. Izimpawu ongazibona zifana nezokubanda okujwayelekile, kuhlanganise nomkhuhlane, umphimbo ophukile, headache, ubuhlungu bomzimba, umphimbo ophukile, nokukhululeka emathunjini. Kuphela udokotela wakho (noma um nurse) kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala eklinikini yakho ezingakusiza uqinisekise ukuthi unayo i-Influenza A (H1N1). Hlala ekhaya, ungahambi emsebenzini, esikoleni, noma uhambisane nabantu abaningi. Faka isambulela emlonyeni nasemakhaleni uma ukhwehlela noma uhleka, futhi uma usebenzisa ama-tissues ukuhlanza umoya, qiniseka ukuthi uwaphosa endaweni efanele. Cha, akufanele uyeke ngaphandle uma umuntu okunikezayo imithi esho njalo. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngeminye imikhuhlane lukhombisa ukuthi ukuphuza ubisi lwebele kuvikeleka izingane ngokudlulisa ama-antibodies omama avikela ingane ezifo futhi kunciphisa inani lezifo ezingadluliselwa ezinganeni. Ukuphuza ubisi lwebele kunikeza izingane ukudla okuphelele futhi kukhulisa ikhono lazo lokulwa nezifo. Umuntu kufanele afune usizo lwezempilo uma engasatholi umoya noma ephefumula kanzima, noma uma enomkhuhlane ophakeme odlula ezinsukwini ezintathu. Abazali abanezingane ezincane ezinesifo kufanele bafune usizo uma ingane iphefumula ngokushesha noma kanzima, inomkhuhlane oqhubekayo, noma inezinkinga zokulawula. Le mikhuba ingavikela ozakwethu emsebenzini nakwabanye. Uma ungazizwa kahle noma unezimpawu ze-flu (influenza), akufanele uvakashele. Uma unokungabaza mayelana nesimo sakho sempilo, kufanele uhlole isimo sakho sempilo ngodokotela wakho. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi, bese uzomisa kahle. Sebenzisa i-hand sanitizer enosawoti uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini nasensipho.
Osaziwayo: Impilo Yabo Nezinto Abazithandayo Ngabe uyazi ukuthi osaziwayo bahlala kanjani? Kukhona okuthile okukhanga ngempela ngempilo yabo, futhi ngithanda ukukwabelana ngalezi zinto. Ngicabanga ukuthi sonke sithanda ukwazi ukuthi abanye abantu abaziwayo baphila kanjani, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngama-celebrities. Ngakho, ake sithathe isikhathi sithole ukuthi lezi zinkanyezi ziphila kanjani empilweni yazo. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngempilo yabo yangasese. Abantu abaziwayo, njengabaculi, abadlali bebhola, nabalingisi, bahlala ezindaweni ezinhle kakhulu. Ngabe ubona izithombe zabo ezindaweni ezinhle? Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi kubonisa ukuthi bahlala kanjani. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Abanye bahlushwa yizinkinga zempilo, izinkinga zokucindezeleka, noma ukungabi nesikhathi sokuphumula. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba sithola ukuthi, nakuba bephila impilo ethokozisayo, bahlushwa yizinkinga ezithile. Ngokwesibonelo, uBeyoncé, omunye wabaculi abaziwayo kakhulu emhlabeni, ubonisa ukuthi ukugcina ibhalansi phakathi komsebenzi nomndeni kubalulekile. Uthanda ukuhamba nozakwabo, futhi ubeka isikhathi sokuphumula. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma ungaphumuli, ungase ube nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ngakho, ngabe sithanda kanjani ukulandela izinyathelo zabo? Ngabe sithanda ukufunda ukuthi baphila kanjani, noma sithanda nje ukubona izithombe zabo ezinhle? Ngokuphathelene nezinto abazithandayo, osaziwayo bahlala bejabulisa. Abanye bahlala bejolise emculweni, abanye bathanda ukudlala imidlalo yevidiyo, kanti abanye bahlala bephuma bezijabulisa ezindaweni ezinhle. UJustin Bieber, isibonelo, uthanda ukuhamba ngebhasi, futhi uthanda ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba engumculi ophumelelayo, uyazama ukuhlala ejwayelekile. Lokhu kuyasithokozisa, ngoba sithola ukuthi bahlala bejabulile, futhi bahlala bephila impilo ejwayelekile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye osaziwayo bahlala bephila impilo enezinkinga. UBritney Spears, isibonelo, ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi empilweni yakhe, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi impilo yama-celebrities ayilula. Uthola ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala bephikisana nezinkinga zempilo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sithola ukuthi, nakuba bephila impilo ethokozisayo, bahlushwa yizinkinga ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, osaziwayo bahlala bejabulisa ngezinto abazithandayo. UKim Kardashian, isibonelo, uthanda ukufaka izithombe ezinhle ku-Instagram. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba engumuntu odumile, uthanda ukwabelana ngezinto ezijwayelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithande ukubona ukuthi baphila kanjani, futhi sithole ukuthi bahlala bejabulile. Uthanda ukuhamba, ukudla, nokwenza izinto ezijabulisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sithola ukuthi, nakuba bephila impilo ethokozisayo, bahlala bejabulile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi osaziwayo bahlala bejabulisa ngezinto ezahlukene. UDrake, isibonelo, uthanda ukudlala imidlalo yevidiyo, futhi uthanda ukuhamba nozakwabo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba engumculi ophumelelayo, uthanda ukuhlala ejwayelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithande ukubona ukuthi baphila kanjani, futhi sithole ukuthi bahlala bejabulile. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yama-celebrities, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi bahlala bejabulile, kodwa bahlushwa yizinkinga ezithile. Abanye bahlala bejabulisa ngezinto abazithandayo, kanti abanye bahlala bephikisana nezinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithande ukubona ukuthi baphila kanjani, futhi sithole ukuthi bahlala bejabulile. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngama-celebrities, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabo ayilula, kodwa bahlala bejabulile. Ekugcineni, osaziwayo bahlala bejabulisa ngezinto ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithande ukubona ukuthi baphila kanjani. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngama-celebrities, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi bahlala bejabulile, kodwa bahlushwa yizinkinga ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithande ukubona ukuthi baphila kanjani, futhi sithole ukuthi bahlala bejabulile. Ngakho, sithanda ukubona izithombe zabo, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabo ayilula.
Gwema ukusondela eduze kwabantu abangase babe noshukela. Nciphisa isikhathi osichitha ezindaweni ezigcwele abantu. Zilungiselele izindlela zokuphila ezinhle ezihlanganisa ukuthola ukulala okwanele, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, nokugcina umzimba wakho uhlelekile. Awukwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kokubanda okujwayelekile ne-Influenza A (H1N1) ngaphandle kosizo lukadokotela. Izimpawu ongazibona zifana nezokubanda okujwayelekile, kufaka phakathi umkhuhlane, ukukhwehlela, isikhala, ubuhlungu bomzimba, ubuhlungu besitho, kanye nokukhathala enhliziyweni. Kuphela udokotela wakho (noma um nurse) kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala esibhedlela sakho ezizokwazi ukukusiza uqinisekise ukuthi unayo i-Influenza A (H1N1). Hlala ekhaya, ungayi emsebenzini, esikoleni, noma uqoqe nabantu abaningi. Faka isikhumba nomlomo wakho uma ukhwehlela noma uthululela, futhi uma usebenzisa ama-tissue ukuze usule umunwe, qiniseka ukuthi uwafaka endaweni efanele. Cha, akufanele uyeke ngaphandle uma umuntu okhipha imithi yakho ekutshela njalo. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngeminye imikhuhlane ye-flu lubonisa ukuthi ukuncelisa kuvikele izingane ngokudlulisela ama-antibodies omama avikela ingane ezimweni zokugula futhi kunciphisa inani lezifo ezingadluliselwa ezinganeni. Ukuncelisa kuhlinzeka izingane ngempilo ephelele futhi kukhuphula ikhono lazo lokulwa nezifo. Umuntu kufanele afune usizo lwezempilo uma engaphefumuli kahle noma uphuphuma kakhulu, noma uma enomkhuhlane ophakeme okhula ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezintathu. Abazali abanabantwana abancane abagulayo kufanele bafune usizo uma ingane iphefumula ngokushesha noma kakhulu, inomkhuhlane oqhubekayo, noma inezinkinga zokulawulwa. Lezi zixwayiso zingavikela ozakwethu emsebenzini nakwabanye. Uma ungazizwa kahle noma unezimpawu ze-flu (influenza), akufanele uvakashele. Uma unokungabaza ngempilo yakho, kufanele uhlole isimo sakho sezempilo ngumnikazi wezempilo. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi, bese uzomile kahle. Sebenzisa i-hand sanitizer enokhilimu uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini nasensipho.
Thina, abasebenzi lapha eGrain SA ngohlelo lweMfundo Yabalimi, sijabule futhi sinesibusiso ngoba sikholwa ukuthi lolu hlelo luzoletha ushintsho ekulimaleni eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lweGrain SA Farmer Development lugxile ekuthuthukiseni abalimi abamnyama ukuze bakhule babe abalimi abakhokhelwayo, abanamakhono abazokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Umsebenzi wokukhiqiza ukudla okwenziwe ngembewu, ikakhulukazi kubalimi, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi njengamanje nasekusaseni. Sibhekene nokwabiwa komhlaba, izinguquko emthethweni wokuphathwa komhlaba, kumele silwe nezimpahla zokudla zangaphandle, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuqala zokulima, silima ezindaweni eziningi ezingatholi imvula, futhi kukhona okuthiwa "ukushisa komhlaba" okuphinde kushintshe isimo sezulu. Ngamafuphi, kunezinkinga eziningi, asinaso isifiso sokuthi zibe khona - njengamanje, sifuna izixazululo, asinazo! Kumele siqhubeke sikhumbula izibusiso zethu kulolu hlelo, sinesibusiso - sinethimba elinabantu abahamba phambili. Kufanele siqale ngamalungu eGrain SA Executive (ukuphatha okuphakeme). Umongameli wethu nguNkk. Jenny Mathews, umuntu onolwazi olukhulu osisekela kuyo yonke imisebenzi esiyenzayo. Siphinde sibe nesibusiso ngoba uMnu. Schalk Viljoen ovela eWestern Cape uvumile ukusebenza nathi ethimbeni lethu. Ubuye wakhethwa ukuba abe umphakathi ophakeme wekomidi lethu. SK Makinana ovela eUgie, noMnu. Papi Nkosi ovela eHazyview. Kulo nyaka sijabule futhi ukuba noMnu. Karabo Peele ethimbeni lethu lokusebenza. Umelela iMaize Trust, inhlangano enkulu esisekela ngezezimali. Siphinde sathukuthela uMnu. Dirk van Rensburg ukuba ajoyine ethimbeni lethu, wayengumuntu wecouncil ephezulu. Ukuze wenze umsebenzi wobungcweti usebenzisa isihloko esisemthethweni sokuba ngumsunguli wemvelo, noma ukufaka isifinyezo ngemuva kwegama lakho, usebenza emkhakheni wezokubonisana ukuze ube nesimo sobungcweti futhi uthole inzuzo ethuthukiswa yizikhungo zezimali ukuze uthole ukwesekwa kwiKhansela kanye nokuqinisekisa okungaphazamisi ikhono lakho lokuvikela nokukhulisa lo msebenzi. Okungenani u-50% wezifundo ohlelweni kumele kube ngendlela yezifundo zesayensi yemvelo. Kumele ubonise ubufakazi bokuqeqeshwa kuSayensi yezeMpi noma uphenyo, ngokwesibonelo, ukuhlolwa kwemibhalo, uphenyo lwezangoma, ukuhlolwa kwemikhono yezinsimbi, ubuchwepheshe bezob crime, izinqubo zomthetho namacala, ubufakazi bobuchwepheshe, noma ezinye izifundo ezimfushane ezivunyiwe. Kumele ube nehistori yomsebenzi ehambisana nesayensi yezeMpi nocwaningo, uhlole futhi uxhume izikhali/izikhali ezihlobene nobugebengu, ugxile endaweni yobugebengu futhi uhlole ubufakazi bezeMpi. Ukusekela kwezobuchwepheshe ekuphenjeni kwezehlakalo zomgwaqo, ukuhlela ukuthi izenzakalo zakhokelela kanjani ekuphahlazweni, uphenyo olunembile lwezingxenye zezimoto, ulwazi oluthile mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezimoto lungaba usizo. Thumela imali ethile okufanele ikhokhwe ukuze ubhalise kanye nesicelo. IKhansela izokubhalisela futhi bese ikhishwa isitifiketi sokubhaliswa uma uhambisana nemfundo efanele kanye nesipiliyoni njengoba kubekwe yiKhansela. Umphumela wokuhlola ngeke uxoxwe kuze kube sekupheleni komhlangano weKhansela. Uma, ngemuva kokusungulwa kweMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, umfaki-sicelo utholakale enecala eRiphabhulikhi noma kwenye indawo futhi uthole isigwebo esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu noma ihlazo njengokunye kokuboshwa. Uma iNkantolo Ephakeme ithola ukuthi umfaki-sicelo akafaneleki emoyeni noma unokugula kwengqondo, noma uma efakwa endaweni yokunakekelwa kwengqondo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwengqondo, 2002. Uma ukubhaliswa komuntu kuvinjelwe ngenxa yephunga elingahlinzekwanga ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu esuswa esikhundleni sokwethembeka ngenxa yokungafaneleki. Uma umuntu ethole ukuthi akakhokhi izikweletu futhi akakabuyiselwa esimweni esihle mayelana nezikweletu, futhi ukungakhokhi izikweletu kwakubangelwa ukunganaki kwakhe ekwenzeni umsebenzi ophakathi kwezigaba zokufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. IKhansela izokunikeza izaziso ngokubhala uma isicelo sokubhaliswa kwakho sikhanseliwe. Ungafaka isikhalazo ngesinqumo seKhansela ezinsukwini ezingama-30. Kumele ufake isicelo kwiKhansela sokuvuselela ukubhaliswa okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokubhaliswa kwakho. Ukuze uthumele imali nge-inthanethi futhi uthumele imali ngqo: Sicela usebenzise izincwadi zokuqala zamagama nezibongo ukuze uthole ukukhokha okwenziwe ngubani kwi-akhawunti yethu yasebhange bese uthumela ubufakazi bokukhokha nge-fax, kanye nephepha lokuqala lesicelo kumakheli: 841 1057.
Ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uMnumzane Mthembu, umphakathi ophakathi kwezinsuku ezinzima, wathola ukuthi udinga ukwelashwa. Uhlangabezana nezinkinga zempilo ezazimkhathaza isikhathi eside, kodwa ngenxa yokungabi nesikhathi, wayephuthelwa yithuba lokuvakashela udokotela. Ngemva kokucabanga, wanquma ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuthola usizo. Wazi ukuthi, njengoba engumsebenzi osemthethweni, unelungelo lokusebenzisa i-GEMS, uhlelo lwezempilo olwakhelwe ukusiza abantu abaningi. Uhambo lukaMnumzane Mthembu lwaqala lapho efika ehhovisi le-GEMS. Wathola ukuthi ukufaka isicelo sezimangalo akukhona okunzima, kodwa kudinga ukucophelela. Uhlangabezana noNksz. Ndlovu, umphathi ophumelelayo, owayezokwenza konke okusemandleni akhe ukuze amsize. U-Nksz. Ndlovu wamchazela ukuthi isinyathelo sokuqala ukufaka isicelo sokwelashwa. "Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi unazo zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo, Mnumzane," kusho yena, ebheka uMnumzane Mthembu ngeso elibukhali. UMnumzane Mthembu wathola uhlu lwezincwadi ezidingekayo, okuhlanganisa ubufakazi bokwelashwa, izincwadi zodokotela, kanye nemininingwane yezezimali. Wazithokozisa ngalesi sikhathi, ngoba wayezokwazi ukufaka isicelo sakhe. Ngemva kokuhamba phambili, wathola ukuthi kumele agcwalise ifomu elithile. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, ngoba ifomu lalisiza ekuchazeni kahle isimo sakhe sezempilo. Ngemuva kokugcwalisa ifomu, uMnumzane Mthembu wathumela isicelo sakhe. Wazizwa enethemba, kodwa futhi enesizungu, njengoba wayezazi kahle izinselelo ezihambisana nezicelo zezimangalo. U-Nksz. Ndlovu wathola isicelo sakhe, wathi: "Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sithole impendulo ngokushesha. Kodwa kufanele uqaphele ukuthi izinqubo zingathatha isikhathi." Kwakungelula, njengoba uMnumzane Mthembu ehlangabezana nezinkinga ezithile. Kwakukhona izinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwehhovisi le-GEMS nabanye odokotela. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni isicelo sakhe sithathe isikhathi eside. Kodwa uMnumzane Mthembu wayengakaze ayeke. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana noNksz. Ndlovu, ebuyekeza isimo sakhe njalo. U-Nksz. Ndlovu waba ngumngane wakhe, emtshela ukuthi kumele aqhubeke nokubekezela. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-14, uMnumzane Mthembu wathola imiyalezo ethokozisayo. Isicelo sakhe saphumelele! Wazizwa ethokozile, njengoba lokhu kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni yakhe. U-Nksz. Ndlovu wamkhumbuza ukuthi kumele aqhubeke nokulandela izinqubo zokwelashwa. "Manje, Mnumzane, kufanele uqhubeke nokuhamba phambili. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS lukhona ukuze lusekele," kusho yena. Ukwamukelwa kwesicelo sakhe kwaholela ekutheni uMnumzane Mthembu athole ukwelashwa okwakudingeka. Wavakashela udokotela, wathola imishanguzo, futhi waba nethuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo kuye, njengoba waqonda ukuthi ukufaka izicelo zezimangalo akukhona kuphela ukulandela izinqubo, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuzinikela nokubekezela. Ngemuva kokwelashwa, uMnumzane Mthembu wathola ukuthi uhlelo lwe-GEMS lwalungaphezu kokulindelekile. Waqonda ukuthi izinqubo zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abafana naye bathola usizo oludingekayo. Wazizwa enesibopho sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye, ukuze nabo bakwazi ukufaka izicelo zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. Uhambo lukaMnumzane Mthembu lwaba yindaba yokuphumelela, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izinqubo zingaba nzima, ukwethembela kumuntu ofanele, njengokuthi u-Nksz. Ndlovu, kungaholela empumelelweni. Waqonda ukuthi ukufaka izicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS akukhona nje ukulandela izinyathelo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ekugcineni, uMnumzane Mthembu waba nesifiso sokuba umphakathi wakhe wazi kahle ngalezi zinqubo. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi, ukuze abanye bakwazi ukufaka izicelo zabo zezimangalo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Wazi ukuthi, uma abantu beqonda kahle izinqubo, bazokwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube namandla. Ngale ndlela, uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, ukwethembela, nokubekezela, umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela empumelelweni, futhi akwazi ukusiza abanye ukuba benze okufanayo. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS lwalungaphezu kokwelashwa; lwaluwumgudu wokwakha umphakathi onempilo.
Ukuhlaziywa Kwezokuxhumana: Izinguquko Nezimpikiswano Isingeniso Ezokuxhumana ziyingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke, zidlala indima enkulu ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwabantu, emiphakathini nasemabhizinisini. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula, izindlela zethu zokuxhumana nazo ziguquka, zishintsha ubunikazi bethu nezinhloso zethu. Le ndaba izogxila ekuhlaziyeni izinguquko ezibalulekile ezokuxhumana, nemiphumela yazo, kanye nezimpikiswano ezithinta lezi zinguquko. Izinguquko Ezibalulekile Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithombo yezokuxhumana ibe yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abahlala kude. Izinkundla ezifana ne-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, kanye ne-WhatsApp zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi omusha, lapho abantu bekhuluma, babelana ngemicabango, futhi behlanganyela ngezinto ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ubuchwepheshe obusha, obuvumela abantu ukuthi baxhumane kalula, bathumele imiyalezo ngesikhathi sangempela, futhi bahlale bexhumene, noma bahlale kumazwe ahlukene. Ukwengeza, ubuchwepheshe be-smartphone buye baba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinkundla zokuxhumana. Abantu manje bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngezikhathi zonke, okwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemicabango nemicimbi yansuku zonke. Lokhu kukhuthaze abantu abaningi ukuba benze izixhumanisi ezinamandla, futhi kube nomthelela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhlala isikhathi eside. Imiphumela Yezokuxhumana Nakuba izokuxhumana zinikeza amathuba amaningi, zibuye zibuye nemiphumela emibi. Eyokuqala, izinkundla zokuxhumana ziye zaba yindawo yokuxabana, lapho abantu behlukaniswa khona ngenxa yezinhloso ezihlukene. Ukusabalala kolwazi olungelona iqiniso, noma ama-fake news, kudinga abantu ukuba babe nekhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kweqiniso nobuzwe. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuvikela ukwethembeka kolwazi, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule ngezindlela ezingafanele. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga ezithinta impilo yengqondo. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ukuhlala unxenxeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana kungaholela ekukhuleni kokukhathazeka, umona, nokucindezeleka. Abantu banesidingo sokuqonda ukuthi ukuxhumana okufanele akuyona kuphela okwenziwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kodwa futhi kudinga ubudlelwano obubukhali nabanye abantu. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela impilo yengqondo, kubalulekile ukufunda ukuhlela isikhathi sokuqhubeka kwezokuxhumana, futhi sithole isikhathi sokuphumula, sibuyele ebuhleni bokuphila bempilo yangempela. Izimpikiswano Nezinkinga Zokuziphatha Ezokuxhumana zibuye ziveze izinkinga ezithinta ukuziphatha kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlukunyezwa, ukuxhashazwa, nokuthola ulwazi olungekho emthethweni. Ngenxa yokuthi abantu bavame ukusebenzisa amagama anobudlova noma ahlekisayo ukuze baphonse izinkanyezi emiphakathini, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu buba namahloni. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezinzima ezivela kumakhasimende, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavikelwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana ziya ziba neqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile. Abantu bakhuthazwa ukuba bacabange futhi bahlaziye izinqumo zabo, beqhathanisa imibono ehlukene, futhi benze izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ukuze bahlale bexhumene, beqhubeka nokufunda, futhi bahlalisane. Isiphetho Ezokuxhumana ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemicabango, izenzakalo, kanye nezindaba ezibalulekile. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izinselelo ezihambisana nalezi zinguquko. Ukuxhumana okufanele kudinga ukubambisana okuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphumela emihle, kanti nangaphandle kwalokho, izinkinga ezithinta impilo yengqondo nezokuziphatha zidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Njengoba siqhubeka ukwakha umphakathi wethu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela nokukhulisa izokuxhumana ngendlela efanele, ukuze sithole izinzuzo zayo ngendlela esebenzayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi wethu uhlala unempilo.
Yini ukuhlela umphakathi? Lokhu kuyindlela elula, lapho indawo eqashwayo ihlukaniswa yaba izingxenye ezincane ezilula ukuziqapha ezaziwa ngokuthi ukuhlela umphakathi. Umphakathi ophathwayo ubekwa ukuze aqaphe umphakathi othile futhi ungumuntu osebenza ngokubambisana nezakhamuzi nakuzo zonke izithakazelo ekuvimbeleni ubugebengu obuvamile kulolo mphakathi. Bonke ababamba iqhaza bangaqhamuka nezidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha ezithile zomphakathi wabo futhi bazame ukuthola umthombo wobugebengu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubugebengu buyaphathwa kulolo mphakathi. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela niqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buyaphathwa emiphakathini yenu. Ukubamba kwenu kuzokhipha imiphumela, futhi ngeke nibe nokwesaba ubugebengu emphakathini wenu futhi nithole izixazululo kubugebengu obujolile endaweni yenu uma ninenhlangano zomphakathi zokulwa nobugebengu, ninikeza amaphoyisa ngemininingwane mayelana nezenzo zobugebengu ezenzakalayo emphakathini wenu ukuze basebenzise izindlela ezihloniphekile nezisuselwe emphakathini ekutholeni izixazululo zobugebengu emphakathini wenu; futhi lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwenu nomphakathi ophathwayo ovela kwiSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela niqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buyaphathwa emiphakathini yenu.
UJulius Caesar: Umlando Ohlangene Nezenzakalo Zombusazwe UJulius Caesar, ungumuntu ohlukile emlandweni weRoma, waba yisithunzi esikhulu esihlangene nezinguquko ezibucayi ephathini yezombusazwe. Ukuphila kwakhe, okuhlanganisa nezinqumo zakhe eziphusile, kwaholela ekubeni abe yinsika ejulile ekwakheni isiko lezombusazwe eRoma. UCaesar wazalwa ngomhla we-12 kuNtulikazi, eminyakeni engu-100 ngaphambi kokuzalwa kwesintu, futhi wakhulela emndenini onezizathu ezinhle. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwakhe, ubona izikhathi ezinzima nezinzima, okwenza waba nesifiso esikhulu sokuthuthukisa ezombusazwe. Ngesikhathi esebenza njengeMeya eRoma, uCaesar wagxila ekuphuculeni isimo samalunga omphakathi. Ukwazi kwakhe ukuhlaziya izinkinga zomphakathi kwaholela ekuqhamukeni kwama-proposals ahlukahlukene, okwakha umoya ophelele phakathi kwalabo ababehamba phambili nezindlela eziphumelelayo. Ubuqu bakhe babukhombisa ukuthi ubani owenza izinto ukuze athuthukise impilo yomphakathi ngezindlela ezingenakubalwa. Njengoba ubhulungisa izinkinga zomphakathi, uJulius Caesar waqhubeka nokwandisa ububanzi bokuphila kwakhe ezombusazwe. Wazifaka ensimini yeziqubulo, kwavela izifungo ezimnandi ezifana nesigaba sokuvota nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa imindeni. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila ngendlela ehloniphekile lwazisa indlalifa yokugxila kweziqubulo ezihlakaniphile nezisebenza phambili, okwenza abanye babonakale besebenzisa konke okusemandleni abo ukuze bathuthukise ubuchwepheshe bezombusazwe. Ukwakha izimpilo zezenhlalakahle njengeCésar, kusitfupha enza izinkathazo ezinkulu kumazinga amahle ambalwa emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Yize izimbangi zikhona, umoya uvulekile kudala uCaesar abe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni isimo somphakathi esingcono. Umkhiqizo wezombusazwe Ukuqhamuka kukaGaius Julius Caesar kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni weRoma. Kwakhathalelwa imihlangano emikhulu ephakeme neziqubulo ezithakazelisayo, uCaesar wanikeza amandla amakhulu kubantu bakwaRoma. Umyalo wakhe obukhali phakathi kwezinto ezinkulu nohlangothi lwempilo yamasiko kwaba nethuba elikhulu lokuhlonipha izinqola zezinhloso. Lokhu kwaholela ekuqhamukeni kwezinhlelo ezintsha ezidonsa abahlala edolobheni ukuba bazithuthukise, nokwenza umphakathi waba nezinqumo eziningi ezinhle. Nokho, impilo kaCaesar ayizange ithathe izinyathelo ezivumelana nezinselele ezivela kubantu abanye. Njengoba ehamba phambili emizimbeni, ubudlelwano wakhe nezingane kanye nesikhathi sokuhola kwawagxila kumhlangano wezingane. Lokhu kunikela ngesifiso sokuphila esiyingqayizivele kwezinye zezingane, ezahola kwenze isimo sichume. Ukwenza uCaesar abe yimpumelelo enkulu ngokwengqalasizinda, lesi sikhumbuzo sokuphila sikulamula izikhumbuzo eziyingqayizivele, ezazifanekisela umoya wokuqhubeka nokuthola impilo engcono. Ubuqotho bakhe, intshisekelo yakhe yokuphila, nobuchule bakhe obuphezulu bafeza izinkanyezi ezinenjongo. UJulius Caesar ubeka isiqongo kweimithetho, wathola ukuvuma okukhulu emhlabeni. Naphezu kokuhlonipheka impilo yakhe, ukuphila kukaJulius Caesar kwaba nomphumela omuhle. Izinyanga zempilo zamuva zabe ziwumzamo omkhulu, okuholele ekufakweni kwezimpi ezinzima nelanga lokugadla kuze kube sekukhumbuleka. Impi yakhe yeGaul, yathanda ukuthola ngezikhathi ezinzima ezilishumi lamawele. Umsebenzi wakhe owafaka uRoma edolobheni wabanika izithakazelo ezenzakalayo, ehamba phambili emaqhulwini, wabhekana nezikhali ezinesizathu. Ekuqaleni, iziphakamiso zomphakathi zaqala ukuhlangana nezenzakalo ezimbi kakhulu. Ukuvota nokwahlula, uCaesar waba nohlaka oluqinile, alungile ukuze aqhase umkhankaso wezempi. Kodwa iRoma ibuyela ngaphandle kobudlelwane obuhlukahlukene, uJulius Caesar waba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yolwazi. Ukuphila kwempilo yakhe kube umlando omkhulu ngoMphakathi, okwakhiwa ngezinyathelo ezinhle, kwezombusazwe ezinomoya. Ekugcineni, uJulius Caesar ungumuntu okhumbuleka, ohlonishwayo, nakuba imposters bephikisa impumelelo yakhe. Uvaleleka kwiRoma futhi wathola akhawunti ezihlukahlukene. Umoya wakhe wehlukene, owashintsha indlela izinto ezibukwa ngayo. Ngakho uJulius Caesar uhamba phambili emlandweni, edlula isikhathi, futhi zonke izinyathelo zakhe zihlala ziphila ezindaweni zomphakathi.
Amasu okulwa nokuzingelwa kobhejane Kulo nyaka, ubhejane, noma i-rhinoceros, ubhekene nezinsongo ezinkulu ezivela ekuncipheni kwezindawo zawo zokuhlala, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, nokuzingelwa okungapheli. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle lesi simo, kubalulekile ukuhlola amasiko, izindlela, nezinhlelo ezisetshenziswayo ukuze kulwe nokuzingelwa kobhejane. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzoqonda izindlela eziphumelelayo, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezixazululo eziphakanyisiwe. Izindlela Zokulwa Nokuzingelwa Izindlela ezisetshenziswayo zokulwa nokuzingelwa kobhejane zihluke kakhulu, kodwa zihlala ziqondiswe ekwandiseni ukuvikeleka kwalezi zinyoni ezinkulu. Okwamanje, izinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala evikelekile, ukulawulwa kwezinsiza, kanye nokwakha ubambiswano phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi nezokuphila kwendalo ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ukwakha Izindawo Zokuhlala Eziphephile Enye yezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuvikela ubhejane iwukwakha izindawo ezivikelekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuvikelwa kwezimila ezisemqoka, ukuvimbela ukufinyelela kwabantu, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala ezihlala zihlala ziphephile. Izindawo ezinjalo zidinga ukugcinwa kahle, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa kwezimali okuqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindawo zihlala ziphephile. Ukubambisana Nezindawo Zokuhlala Ukubambisana phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlala nezinhlelo zomphakathi kubalulekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundisa abantu bendawo mayelana nokubaluleka kokuvikela ubhejane, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibandakanya umphakathi. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana, futhi abantu bazizwa bekhululekile ukuvikela lezi zinyoni ezinkulu. Izinselelo Ezinzima Noma kunjalo, izinselelo zihlala zikhona. Ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, izinguquko zezulu, kanye nokwanda kokuhlala kwabantu kudala imiphumela emibi ezindaweni zokuhlala. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukufundisa abantu, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokulawula izinsiza. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye buvele njengomgqugquzeli omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa kobhejane. Izinhlelo zokubona izilwane ezisemqoka, izinhlelo zokulawula izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izithombe ezivela phezulu, izinhlelo zokulandelela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibandakanya abantu bendawo. Izinhlelo Zokufundisa Izinhlelo zokufundisa zibalulekile ekubhekaneni nezinsongo ezibhekene nobhejane. Ukuze abantu bazi ngezinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi mayelana nemiphumela yokuzingelwa. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokufundisa ezibandakanya izingane nabantu abadala, ukuze wonke umuntu aqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikela lezi zinyoni ezinkulu. Izixazululo Eziphakanyisiwe Izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganisa abantu, izinhlelo zokuphila kwendalo, kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya umphakathi, ukusiza abantu bendawo ukuba baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikela ubhejane, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokulawula izinsiza. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, amasu okulwa nokuzingelwa kobhejane adinga ukuba ahlaziywe ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinyoni ezinkulu zihlala ziphephile, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, izinhlelo zokuphila kwendalo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlala. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zindlela, singenza umthelela omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa kobhejane, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinyoni zihlala zikhona ezweni lethu. Ukubuyekezwa kwezinselelo nezixazululo eziphakanyisiwe kuzoqhubeka nokuba nomthelela omkhulu ekulweni nokuzingelwa kobhejane, futhi kuzoqhubeka nokuba yinto ebalulekile emkhakheni wokuvikela imvelo.
Akukho ingxenye yalolu bhali engaphindwa noma idluliselwe ngenye indlela noma ifomu ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe efanele. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kunoma ubani ofisa ukuba uchwepheshe bezomthetho futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukuze usebenzise le thuluzi kahle futhi ngokwanelisayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu abe nolwazi ngezisho ezithile ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa njalo ngababhalayo bezincwadi ezahlukene zomthetho mayelana noMthetho Wobufakazi. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhlela nokufundisa abantu ukuba baqonde futhi bazijwayeze nalezi zisho ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa kuMthetho Wobufakazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emifushane ebasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene noMthetho Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olukhulunywa phambi kwenkantolo ngenhloso yokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo ithathe isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi bomzimba bukhuluma ngazo zonke izindaba nemikhiqizo engasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. UMthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimo kanye nokulawulwa kokuthi izimo zethulwa kanjani ngendlela ethembekile. Izimo zingethulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto zomzimba. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicathulo zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi uhambisana nani, incazelo kaMthetho Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyakha ubufakazi bomzimba nokuthi yini equkethe. Impikiswano ethulwa yisimo kanye neqembu lokuvikela ayisebenzi njengobufakazi kodwa iyinhloso ewusizo ekhuthaza isinqumo. Le mpikiswano yakhiwa ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihloselwe ukugqamisa isimo somthetho noma izimo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukususa ukuqonda kwenkantolo lapho kuthathwa isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi kuthathwe isinqumo, amaqembu anethuba lokwethula impikiswano yokugcina ephathelene nobufakazi obethulwe eceleni. Izimo zecala yilezo ezethulwa yiphathi enenjongo yokufakazela icala labo. Izimo zivame ukuhambisa ubufakazi noma ukuwuphikisa. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihilela ubudlelwano bobaba, isimo sobaba sizoba yindaba ezoxoxwa, futhi ubudlelwano nobaba kuzoba iphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobaba. Ubufakazi obuqinile bukhuluma ngobufakazi obuqinile noma obungcono kunezinye ubufakazi ezitholakalayo. Ubufakazi besibili bukhuluma ngobufakazi obukhona noma obungavela. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ibhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti abhekwa njengobufakazi besibili. Igama elithi "prima facie," elihumusha ngokuthi "bufakazi obubonakala buqondile," lichaza ukuthi ubufakazi obethulwe phambi kwenkantolo bufanelekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo noma icala ngaphandle kokuba kube nobufakazi obuphikisanayo. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo, ubufakazi obubonakalayo luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Ubufakazi obuqondile bukhuluma ngobufakazi lapho umshushisi ebone ngqo isenzo. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, uC uveza ukuthi wayemi ngaphandle kwendlu kaB ngesikhathi ebona uA eqhuba uB. Ukwamukela kubhekisela kubufakazi obuvumelekile, futhi akukho standard yokulinganisa izinga lokuvunyelwa kobufakazi. Ubufakazi bungamukelwa noma buphikiswa. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi wamukelwa noma buphikiswa sincike kumphumela wokuvunyelwa kwabo nokuthi ukwamukela lelo bufakazi ngeke kube yingozi kumshushisi. Ukwamukela kobufakazi okwamanje ngaphansi kwemigomo ezogcwaliseka ekupheleni kwecala kuchazwa. Uma imigomo igcwaliseka, ubufakazi buphuma. Inkantolo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzeni umshushisi nakuba ubuqiniso bedokhumenti buphikiswa neqembu lokuvikela. Kuzoba ngemva kokuphela kwecala lapho umshushisi ezothola ithuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi esivela ngemva kokubuza kuzobekwa eceleni yinkantolo. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi obufanele, inkantolo izocabanga ukuthi ubufakazi obethulwe buhlobene nezimo zecala. Igunya liyilungelo noma umthwalo odingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu lapho bethula ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zegunya. Igunya lomuntu siqu kanye negunya lesimo. Ukukhuluma ngokukhululeka kuyinto eyenziwa enkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqondile futhi obungaphikiswa ngaphandle kokuba izidingo zomthetho ezithile zifeziwe. Ukwamukela okungaqondile kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo edinga ukucaciswa noma iyaphikisana. Ukuphuma kweqiniso kuyisenzo lapho umshushisi evuma ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokungabaza, njengoba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo, kuthathwa njengokuphika kokuhluleka. Isaziso senkantolo sichaza lapho inkantolo yamukela izimo ezaziwayo nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa lungakaziswa njengokweqiniso ngesikhathi sokubuza. Umthwalo wokufakazela ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni weqembu lapho kufanele baphakamise ubufakazi obanele. Umthwalo wezomthetho wokufakazela utholakala kumshushisi. Umthwalo wokukhiqiza ubufakazi bomzimba ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze inkantolo ibize umshushisi ukuphendula ezimangweni nasekutholeni ubufakazi obanele ukuze uphikise lelo bufakazi elibonakalayo elithulwe yiphathi evula icala.
"Umthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wabaphathi Bezempilo Yendabuko, 2004 (Umthetho No. 35 ka 2004); kanti "umphakathi" ubhekisela kumuntu ophakathi kokwenza imithi yendabuko njengoba kuchaziwe nguMthetho. Ukuze kukhethwe amalungu abhekiswe ezahlukweni c, e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yoMthetho, uNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe isaziso kwiGazethi yoHulumeni nasezincwadini ezimbili okungenani ezithunyelwa emhlabeni wonke nasemaphandleni, emema abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abafuna ukuwafaka njengamalungu eBhodi. Isaziso esibhekiswe kule Mthethosisekelo 2 kumele sichaze ulwazi oluzobhekwa uma kukhethwa njengelungu kanye nesikhathi sokuthumela amagama akhethiwe. a ye-subsection 7c yoMthetho kumele ithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma kumuntu oyiLungu leBhodi ophatheka kwezempilo lapho umphakathi okhethiwe enza khona; b izindima e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe kazwelonke. Ilungu leBhodi noma uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kumele lithumele amagama abaphathi abathathu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kubhekwe mayelana nokukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7c yoMthetho. Uma uNgqongqoshe engatholi amagama akhethiwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlobo noma uma amagama akhethiwe enganele njengoba kuchaziwe kule mema, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha inani elanele labantu abafanelekayo ukuze bakhethwe ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7 yoMthetho noma acela ukuthi amagama engeziwe akhethwe ukuze kuzuzwe le njongo. Umuntu ogama lakhe lithunyelwe ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo 5 ukuze akhethwe ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7i yoMthetho kumele abe esebenza ngempela kulolo mkhakha okungenani iminyaka emihlanu ngaphambi kosuku lapho angakhethwa khona njengelungu. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni amagama abantu abakhethwe njengamalungu eBhodi kanye nosuku abazoph开始a imisebenzi yabo njengamalungu eBhodi. Ngiyafunga ukuthi ngifuna ukuvuma ukukhethwa kwegama lami futhi ngiyavuma ukuba ngisebenze kwiBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Yendabuko uma uNgqongqoshe engikhetha kulolu sikhundla. Mina (igama eliphelele lomuntu okhethiweyo kanye nesikhundla sabo) ngiyafunga ukuthi ulwazi olunikeziwe lapha lungamanga, futhi ukuthi kusemandleni kaNgqongqoshe ukukhetha mina njengelungu leBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Yendabuko.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nenkinga enkulu yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kuhlobene nezimo eziningi ezithinta umnotho, okuhlanganisa ukwanda kwentengo yezimpahla, izindleko zokuthutha, kanye nezindleko zokuhlala. Lokhu kukhuphuka kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yansuku zonke yabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izindleko zokuphila zikhuphuka kanjani. Izinto ezilula ezifana nokudla, izimpahla, nezinsiza zansuku zonke zikhuphuke kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokwanda kwezindleko zokukhiqiza, okukhuluma ngezindleko zokuthola izinto ezisemqoka, kanye nezindleko zokuhamba. Izinkampani eziningi zikhuluma ngokuthi zikhokha kakhulu ukuze zithole izinto ezidingekayo, futhi lokhu kudlulisela kumakhasimende, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuhlala nazo zikhuphuke. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlala ezindlini, kufanele bakhokhe imali eningi, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abangenamali eningi. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, njengoba abantu abaningi bephoqwa ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezingezinhle noma bahlale emakhaya amakhulu, okungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi. Ngokubheka izimo zomnotho, izinkampani zikhuluma ngokuthi zikhathazekile ngalesi simo. Abantu abaningi baphendula ngokunciphisa izindleko zabo, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuthengwa kwezimpahla. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinkampani zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengoba zidinga ukuthola izindlela zokugcina izindleko ziphansi, kodwa futhi zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zikhuluma ngokuthi zikhathazekile ngalesi simo. Abantu abaningi baphendula ngokunciphisa izindleko zabo, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuthengwa kwezimpahla. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izinkampani zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengoba zidinga ukuthola izindlela zokugcina izindleko ziphansi, kodwa futhi zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle kumakhasimende. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqala ukujwayela lezi zinguquko, kodwa lokhu akukwenzi kube lula. Abantu badinga ukucabanga ngamasu amasha ukuze baphile kahle. Lokhu kuhilela ukufunda ukuhlela kahle izimali, ukunciphisa izindleko ezingadingekile, nokufuna izindlela zokuthola imali eyengeziwe. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuphatha izimali, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukulawula izindleko zabo. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole usizo. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo zikhona, futhi abantu kufanele bazisebenzise ukuze bathole usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokudla, izinhlelo zokuhlala, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokuxhasa abanye, ukuze bonke bakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngokuphetha, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuyinselele enkulu, kodwa akumele kube yinto engapheli. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokubambisana, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukucabanga, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi singenza umehluko uma sisebenzisana. Ngakho-ke, masibambisane ukuze sithole izindlela zokuphila ezinhle, futhi sithuthukise impilo yethu sonke.
Lapha, umthetho ka-1998 mayelana nokulawulwa kwezinsolo zokuhamba emgwaqweni uguqulwa ukuze kulawulwe ukwakheka kweBhodi; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqokwa nguNgqongqoshe kwabantu abaphethe ukuqhuba umthetho (ama-sheriffs); ukuthola nokwandisa isikhathi sokukhokha izijeziso zokwephula umthetho wezokuhamba emgwaqweni nokubhekana nezinye izindaba ezihlobene, ukuhlela lokho okubhalwe; nokuhlinzeka ngeminye imibandela ehlobene. a ukukhuthaza ukuhlonishwa kwemithetho kazwelonke [nokuh] imithetho yesifunda nemunicipal ehlobene nemigwaqo nokukhuthaza ukuphepha emigwaqweni; futhi b ukususa isigaba f.
