futhi b cabanga ngamakhasimende nezikhalazo ezitholiwe njengempendulo kulowo mzamo. ngizokhokha kwiKhansela isijeziso, izimali ezichaziwe zokwakhiwa, kanye nezindleko zencwadi ebhalwe noma ngizohlela neKhansela ngendlela echaziwe yokukhokha kancane, ngaphakathi [28] 32 izinsuku ngemuva kokukhishwa kwesaziso esibika ukwephula umthetho; futhi ii ukuthi ukungakhokhi isijeziso nezimali ezidingekayo noma ukungahleleli ukukhokha kancane kuzoholela ekukhishweni kwesaziso sokumangalela lowo ophule umthetho, futhi kuzokwenza ophule umthetho abhekane nokukhokha isijeziso, ezinye izimali ezidingekayo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izimali ezinqunywe yokuqhubeka komthetho. c uma ophule umthetho ekhetha ukuvela enkantolo, okungenzeka kuphela uma kucelwa ummeleli, izinhlinzeko zesigaba 22 zizosebenza. b ukukhishwa kwesaziso sokuthi ophule umthetho kufanele, ngaphakathi [28] 32 izinsuku ngemuva kosuku aluthola ngalo isaziso sokwephula umthetho --. a ithuba lokukhokha isijeziso nezimali ezidingekayo uma zikhona, noma ukuhlela ukukhokha kancane, le ndaba kufanele ibhekwane ngaphandle kokuthi ezinye izinyathelo zicatshangelwe; futhi b kwezinye izimo ezihilela isinyathelo sokuthi le ndaba iyokwenziwa enkantolo, le nyathelo akufanele lisetshenziswe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nale ndaba ngaphandle kokuthi ithathwe enkantolo ngokulandela inqubo yokubhekwa echaziwe kulo mthetho. a ukuthi inani eliphelele elikweletwayo, kuhlanganise nenani elichaziwe lesaziso, kumele likhokhwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-32 ngemuva kokuthola isaziso, futhi b ukuthi ukungahambisani nesaziso esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni a kungaholela ekukhishweni kwesaziso sokumangalela kuye ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 21. a kwiKhansela ephethe ukubhaliswa; noma b emsakazweni ophatha izitifiketi zokushayela. kwiKhansela yendawo ephethe ukubhaliswa noma emsakazweni wendawo ophatha izitifiketi zokushayela. IKhansela yendawo ephethe ukubhaliswa noma emsakazweni ophatha izitifiketi zokushayela kufanele ibuyekeze njalo irekhodi lesizwe labaphula umthetho, futhi ibike iKhansela ngendlela echaziwe uma kukhona izimali ezikhokhwayo futhi ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni futhi idlulisele le mali ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo futhi uma lokho kungasebenzi, iKhansela kufanele ifune inzalo ebaliwe ngezinga elichaziwe. Uma umyalo wokuphathwa uphumelelwa, imiphumela ehilelekile kufanele ibuyiselwe, futhi uma ihilela ukusula kwesitifiketi sokushayela somuntu noma ukusetshenziswa kwemoto, irekhodi lesizwe labaphula umthetho kufanele lifake le mininingwane b ophule umthetho kufanele abike ngendlela echaziwe ukuthi isitifiketi sakhe sokushayela noma imvume noma ikhadi lokushayela kuzobuyiselwa kuye noma ukuthi ukuvinjelwa kwesitifiketi kuzokhishwa ngaphandle kokuthi ukuvinjelwa kwenziwe ngezimo ezihlukile. b ukuguqulwa esigabeni I sesigaba esilandelayo. b ukukhishwa kwesaziso sokumangalela ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 211 akukhombisi impahla engathathwa noma ethengiswa noma ophule umthetho engahambisani nomyalo wokuphathwa ngemuva kokukhishwa komyalo, iKhansela kufanele ibike iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso, ezidinga ukusula isaziso sokwephula umthetho futhi iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso kufanele [kukhishwe] kulungiswe amarekhodi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho ka-1977 mayelana nenqubo yezindaba Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977. a ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1 a nokungaveli noma ukufika, inkantolo akufanele ikhishwe umyalelo wokubamba nakuba izinhlinzeko zesigaba 55 zomthetho wezindaba zikhuluma ngalokho kodwa umgibeli wenkantolo kufanele abike iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso, ezidinga ukuhlinzeka iKhansela futhi umgibeli kufanele aqhubeke nokukhishwa komyalo wokuphathwa ophule umthetho okukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 201; futhi b ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1 b le ndaba kufanele ibhekwane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho ka-1977 mayelana nenqubo yezindaba. Nakuba kungase kube nomthetho omunye, ophule umthetho [obhekwana] mayelana neye ndaba yakhe ngaphansi kwaleli sahluko akavunyelwe ukuba abhekane nezindaba ezindala futhi akukho futhi ukuhlinzekwa kokuthi abanjwe ngezizathu ezifanayo. A Ukuqoshwa kwamaphuzu ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi okukhuluma ngamasigaba 3 no-4, umgibeli wenkantolo kufanele abike iKhansela ngemiphumela yalokho kanye naleyo sikhathi senkantolo noma ukudluliselwa kwayo. Uma umuntu ethola amaphuzu ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi, lapho ehambisana nalawo maphuzu lowo muntu unawo kwi-rekhodi lesizwe labaphula umthetho futhi le mali isuswa njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 28 inani [lidlula] inani elikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 29d, lowo muntu uzokwenqaba ukuba ashaye noma asebenzise imoto [ngokulandela inqubo echaziwe] lokhu kuzothatha umphumela ezinsukwini eziyi-32 ngemuva kokuthi unikezwe lawo maphuzu adlula inani. Noma ubani ongahambisani nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 3 a noma oshayela noma asebenzisa imoto ngesikhathi sokuvinjelwa kwakhe uphula umthetho futhi lokho kungaholela ekubeni akhokhelwe isijeziso noma aboshwe isikhathi esingadluli unyaka noma abanjwe kokubili isijeziso nokuvalelwa. Uma isikhathi sokuvinjelwa siphelelwe, umuntu okukhuluma ngaye esigabeni 3 angafaka isicelo ngendlela echaziwe eziphathimandleni ezikhishile isaziso ukuze abuyiselwe isitifiketi sokushayela, imvume, noma ikhadi. Isaziso esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 1 kumele sithunyelwe kwiKhansela, okufanele ibike iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso, kanye neziphathimandla zendawo lapho umuntu okukhuluma ngaye ehlala khona. a Umuntu othole amaphuzu ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi futhi uvinyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 25 sokushayela nokusebenzisa
Izikhulu zezempilo zingasebenza ukuvimbela lokhu. Ngakho-ke, vikela ekuxhumaneni nezilwane. Nakuba le ndlala inganqandwa, ibulalayo uma ingaphathwa ngesikhathi. Izilwanyana ezincane zingagwenywa futhi zixoshwe ngokwenza ukuthi zibe nendawo yazo kanye nokudla. Izinto ezincane zingasiza futhi zivikela le mfucumfucu engadini. Amamitha angamashumi amane. Hlola isakhiwo sakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi azikho izindawo zokungena noma izindawo ezamukela izilwanyana ezikhona. Imfucumfucu engafani nezincwadi eziphukile nezinsalela eziphukile nezinye izinsalela ezikona lapho zihlala khona nakwezinye izindawo. Izimpawu zokudla izithelo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezintathu zeplaki ezithinta abantu. Ubuhlungu bemisipha; ubuhlungu bekhanda; ubuhlungu nokukhuluphala kwezitho zomzimba, kanye nomphimbo, nomphakathi. Sithole ukuphathwa kusenesikhathi. Kulezi zindlela zokwelapha, kukhona ukucekelwa phansi kwezifo. Inhloso ukuvikela, ukunciphisa amathuba abantu ukuba baphukiswe izilwanyana ezincane noma baphathe izicubu zezinyama zezilwane. Susa izikhala, imfucumfucu, noma noma yini engase idliwe izilwanyana ezincane njengokudla kwezilwane zasekhaya nezilwane zasendle. Gqoka izigqoko uma uphatha isilwane esigulayo. Uma uhlala endaweni lapho kukhona ubhubhane bezilwanyana ezincane, gcina amakati akho nezinkunzi zihlanzekile, ukuze kungabi khona lezi zilwanyana futhi ungavumeli ukuba zibe yinkinga noma zihlale zikhona.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ungenele izinqubo zokhetho emakhandleni eNingizimu Afrika, uhlelo lokhetho oluthinta izigidi zabantu. Le mthetho wahlukahlukene udinga ukucubungula zonke izinselelo eziphathelene nezinguquko eziphakanyisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho lwenziwa ngokufanele, ngokobulungiswa, nangokwemigomo evumelekile. U-Elias Mthembu, umphakathi ophawulekayo kulesi sikhala, ungumfundi ophothule izifundo zakhe kwezobulungiswa. U-Elias waba nenhloso yokuhlola izinselelo ezibhekene nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act, ngenxa yoxhaso olwekanye nolwakha imiphakathi. U-Elias ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obuqinile nokubhala izincwadi ezisemthethweni kungasiza ekudluliseni izinkinga ezikhona. U-Elias uqala ukuveza ukuthi imithetho emisha ibonakala iyinselele enkulu ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo ngokuzalwa kwabantu. Uhlanga lwezizinda zomthetho olukhulu lubhalwe phansi izinkinga ezahlukene, ezihlanganisa ukuvinjwa kwabantu abasha ekuthatheni izinqumo zokhetho. U-Elias uthi, "Ukuthola abantu abasha ukuthi bathathe ingxenye emikhandlwini yokhetho kubalulekile. Ngaphansi kwemithetho emisha, izigidi zezizinda zomthetho ezikhona zingase zibe nomthelela omubi." U-Elias ugxila nakwezinye izinselelo ezithinta abamele abavoti, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethile. Uhlanga lwezinselelo lukhombisa indlela yokuhlukanisa imiphakathi, lapho abavoti bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale bezinyaniso emiphakathini ethile. Lezi zimo zikhombisa ukuthi imithetho emisha ingaphazamisa ukuhwebelana kwezinkolo, izinkolelo, nezikhumbuzo ezihlukene phakathi kwemiphakathi. U-Elias ubonisa ukuthi ubukhona bomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act buholela emiphumeleni emibi yokuphikisana kwezombusazwe. Lokhu kusebenza ngezigameko eziningi eziveza ubukhosi kwezombusazwe lapho imithetho ingahambisani nezinqubomgomo zomphakathi. U-Elias uthi, "Ukuphikisana phakathi kwezombusazwe akusizi, kudala ukukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu." U-Elias ubona izinselelo ezinzima zokufinyelela kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zomthetho olukhona lubonisa ukuthi imithetho emisha ingase ibe nemiphumela emibi ezindaweni ezithile. U-Elias uthi, "Kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokugcina umphakathi unolwazi nolwazi oluqinile ngemithetho emisha." U-Elias ukholelwa futhi ekutheni izinkinga ezikhona zidinga ukuxoxwa ngokubambisana nozakwethu. Ubuza, "Ngabe sikhona yini isikhala sokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezikhona? Kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi bethu bahlale bexhumana nomphakathi ukuze kuhlonyiswe izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elias ubonisa ukuthi ezikhathini ezizayo, izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act zidinga ukubhekelelwa ngokuqhubekayo. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zomthetho olukhona lubonisa ukuthi abavoti bangase bahlale bephoqeleka ukuba baphendule ekubeni neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezombusazwe. U-Elias uthi, "Sifuna imiphakathi ethokozisayo, futhi lokho kuncike ekutheni abantu bazi ukuthi imithetho ibathinta kanjani." U-Elias Mthembu, umphakathi ophumelelayo, uqhubeka nokubeka phambili izimvo zakhe nezifiso zakhe ukuze athole izixazululo ezinzima ezibhekene nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act. Ubuza, "Ngabe sikhona yini indlela yokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise izinqubo zokhetho?" U-Elias ugcizelela ukuthi lo mthetho ungaba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi oqinile, kufanele bezwe izinselelo ezikhona futhi bahlale bephokophele phezulu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokhetho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elias uqinisekisa ukuthi izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act zidinga ukwenziwa kwazulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ubuza, "Ngabe sizokwazi yini ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukuze iNingizimu Afrika ibe yindawo lapho abantu bephila khona ngokuthula?" U-Elias ubelokhu edlulisela izinzwa zakhe ezithinta uhlelo lwama-oda, nokuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act udinga ukubhekelwa ngeso elibukhali ukuze uqinisekise izinguquko ezizothuthukisa isimo sokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Ngale ndlela, u-Elias Mthembu uqhubeka nokuba yisithunywa somphakathi esiphakamisayo, echaza futhi evalelisa izinselelo ezihambisana nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act, ukuze kube nokuvuka kokuthula nokubumbana phakathi kwabantu.
Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo ze-GEMS (Government Electronic Management System) ibalulekile kakhulu emnothweni wanamuhla, njengoba amabhizinisi edlala indima enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho wezwe. Kubalulekile ukuqonda le mikhawulo, ngoba ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphumeleleni kwezimali nasekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zamabhizinisi. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bakwaMasipala kufanele baqonde ukuthi imikhawulo ethile yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ayigcini nje ngokuba imithetho, kodwa iphinde ibalulekile ekwakheni impumelelo. Izinsiza ze-GEMS ziwusizo, kodwa zidinga ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Imikhawulo yokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza kufanele ibhekelwe ukuze amabhizinisi angalahlekelwa amathuba okuthola izinkontileka. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kubalulekile ukuba nezincazelo ezicacile mayelana nezimfuneko ezithile ze-GEMS, ukuze abanikazi bamabhizinisi bakwazi ukuzijwayeza nezindlela zokuphumelela. Imikhawulo ibonakala njengokuthile okuphazamisayo kwabanye, kodwa emabhizinisini, ingaba yithuba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umnikazi webhizinisi ehamba ngendlela efanele, angakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo. Ukuqhubeka nokulandela imithetho nezinhlelo ze-GEMS kukhombisa ukuthi kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zamathuba atholakalayo. Ukuphumelela ebhizinisini kudinga ukuzimisela, ikhono, nokuhlonipha imikhawulo. Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo ze-GEMS iyashintsha, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi ukuqonda izindlela ezamukelekayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho ayiphuliwe, kumele kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuhlola. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umqondo ofanele wokusebenza. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS lungahlanganiswa nemikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukusebenzisa amathuba ezebhizinisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu abafaka isandla ezinsizakalweni bathola izinzuzo. Ukuze sithuthukise izinga lempumelelo yamabhizinisi, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo. Ngokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezithile, kubalulekile ukufuna izixazululo eziqondile eziphathelene nezinsiza ze-GEMS. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa amabhizinisi futhi kusize ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Umphakathi wempumelelo kahulumeni ungakhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane uma kungekho ukuphazamiseka kumthetho. Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo ze-GEMS ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuzinza komnotho, futhi kufanele ibhekelwe ukuze kube lula kubanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuphumelela. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ibalulekile emabhizinisini namuhla. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene nezinsizakalo, ukuze kukhuliswe ukuphumelela. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, izinsizakalo zikamasipala, kanye nohulumeni kuyadingeka ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezivela kumathuba amasha, okwandisa umnotho. Ngokuhlonipha imikhawulo, kufanele sikhuthazwe ukulandela izinqubo ezinhle zokusebenza, ukuze sithole izindlela zokwenza ibhizinisi lethu linciphe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nemiphumela emihle ezinkonzweni ezenzakalayo, futhi imikhawulo ye-GEMS iyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lamabhizinisi.
Ukubambisana komphakathi; - Ukuthuthukisa nokuphromotha inhlalakahle yomphakathi kanye nentuthuko yezomnotho; - Ukuphepha, ukuvikeleka, nokulwa nokusabalala kwe-HIV/AIDS; - Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo eziphuthumayo; - Ukuphathwa kwezimali ngokwethembeka; - Ukuhola okwenziwa ngokuqonda; - Ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. i Ukulethela intuthuko ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. ii Ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko kwezindawo ezihlelwe nezingeziwe, ezikhona nezindawo zokuhlala ezintsha. iii Ukuvimbela ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okungemthetho. iv Ukuphromotha intuthuko esheshayo yomhlaba. v Ukukhuthaza intuthuko efanele futhi ehlanganisiwe yomhlaba. Ukuphromotha intuthuko yomhlaba ehlanganisa ukuhlela kwezokuxhumana, ezomnotho, nezokwakha, kanye nokwakheka kwemvelo komhlaba, ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko ehlanganisayo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni, ukukhuthaza ukuba khona kwezindawo zokuhlala namathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni eziseduze noma ukuhlanganisa lezi zindawo. Umkhakha okhona kufanele uhlanganise kahle imikhakha ethinta ezolimo, umhlaba, imayini, izinsiza, ukuthutha, nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukuphromotha ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okuxubile, kungakhathaliseki kumhlaba owodwa noma emhlabeni ohlukanisiwe. Ukuvimbela ukuhamba phambili kwedolobha, ngenkathi kusekelwa intuthuko yezindawo ezihlanganisiwe zasemadolobheni. Ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo. Ukuphromotha ukulandela izinqubo nezindlela ezigxile kwemvelo. Le plan ibonisa izindawo ezidinga ukunakwa okuqondile, kanye nezindawo lapho izinhlelo eziphakeme seziqediwe noma lapho izinhlelo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Lezi zindawo zifaka phakathi izindawo ze-Edendale ne-Imbali, ingxenye enkulu yedolobha (Indawo Ephakathi), kanye nomhlaba ocebile ngezolimo engxenyeni esentshonalanga yomphakathi (Vulindlela). Le plan ifaka phakathi nezinhlelo zokwandisa imiphakathi, ukuvikela izakhiwo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa ezisebenzayo kwezinye izindawo. ii Ekuphumeleleni kokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zalemizindawo emine, izinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa libalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe intuthuko ephumelelayo. Umlando i Ukuhlonza izinkinga ezihlobene nesimo sedolobha, nokuhlela okudingeka kwenziwe ukuze kulungiswe lesi simo, kufanele kusikhumbuze ukuthi imingcele yomphakathi ivela kanjani. Njengoba kukhombisiwe kuTebhu 1, umphakathi waseMsunduzi uhlukaniswe ngamaqembu amathathu, okwakhiwe abantu abangu-200,000. iv Ngeminyaka yama-1970, indawo yase-Edendale yasungulwa njenge ndawo yokubhaliswa ehlukile ngaphansi kuk governo ye-apartheid. Ngasikhathi sinye, emizamweni yokususa abantu ezindaweni zokuhlala, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindawo ezibizwa ngokuthi izindawo ezimhlophe, ukutshalwa kwezimali ezinsizeni kwakuncane, okuholele ekugcinweni kwezindawo ezifana ne-Sobantu zibe sezingeni eliphansi, okuholela ezindlini eziphansi. Nokho, lezi zindawo ezifanayo manje seziwumphakathi owodwa, nezinye zezindawo ezithuthukisiwe zisasebenza njengezindawo zokuhlala ezakha iPietermaritzburg, lapho ukuhweba kwenziwa kakhulu. Enye yezinjongo zale msebenzi wokuthuthukiswa kwesikhala (SDF) wukunciphisa ukuhlukaniswa kwemibala, intuthuko engalingani eyayidalwe ngaphambili ngenxa yokuphathwa komhlaba ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Ukwakhiwa kwe-N3 bypass kube lula ukufinyelela kwezinye izixeko ezinkulu nezifunda ezizungezile. Isimo samanje sentuthuko sifaka phakathi ukuhlanganiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala nezokusebenza, kanye nokuba khona kwezidingo eziphuthumayo emiphakathini. Izinga lezinsiza zokuthutha ligxile kakhulu endaweni ephakathi yomphakathi, ngenkathi izinga lokuxhumana ezindaweni ezisemaphethelweni omphakathi liphansi. Kukhona izinga eliphansi lokufinyelela kwezinsiza nezinye izidingo zomphakathi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Ubumpofu, ukungasebenzi, nezinga eliphansi lokubandakanywa kwezomnotho kubonisa imiphakathi ehamba phambili. Isingeniso i Izikhombisi-ndlela zokuhlela nezindlela ezilawula i-SDF zibalulekile futhi zisebenza, ikakhulukazi lezo ezihambisana nemithetho eyisisekelo, etholakala esigabeni sesibili ngenhla. iv Ekusebenzeni kwayo, le ndlela ikhuthaza ukufakwa kwezakhiwo ezihlukene kulezi zindlela. Akukaze kukhombiswe ukuthi le ndlela isekela lokho okwaziwa njenge "Ribbon Development" ekwakhiweni kwale ndlela. Le ndlela yokuhlela intuthuko ikhombisa ukuthi "ama-nodes" akufanele abe nezehlakalo ezifanayo futhi kufanele ahlukaniswe kahle, ngokuvamile ahlukaniswe ngezinga elingama-2km ukusuka komunye nomunye. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuvumela abantu abaningi ukuba bahambe bayofika kulezi zindawo. Kukhona kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethiwe, lapho i-cluster yokusetshenziswa komhlaba itholakala eduze kwalezi zindlela ezinkulu, okuthiwa "Mixed-use corridor." v Ngeshwa, le ndlela ye-corridor ixhumene nezindawo zokusetshenziswa okuxubile, okungesiyo inhloso noma into enhle nhlobo. Kukhona futhi umkhuba wokubeka "ama-nodes" noma kuphi kulezi zindlela. Ngokuqinisekile, kukhona amazinga ahlukene "ama-nodes" okuthengisa, njengoba ezindaweni ezinkulu kukhona "ama-nodes" ezingeni lokuba yisigaba sesihlanu kanye nokwengeza izinhlobo ezintsha ze-cluster zokuthengisa. Ezinye "ama-nodes" ezingaba khona zingaba amahhovisi, izibhedlela, noma ukubhaliswa kokuphatha okungase kube kude nalezi "ama-nodes" ezinye. Akufanele kube yindlela yokwenza izinto ukuzama ukufaka wonke la "ama-nodes" ezigabeni "Ezisemqoka, Ezisemqoka, Nezisebenzayo" ezinhlelweni ezakhiwayo, ikakhulukazi ezingeni le-SDF, lokhu akuyona indlela efanele. Ukwethulwa kwe "Mobility and Arterial roads" kuzokwenza lezi zindlela zisebenze kahle, ngokuba nezindlela eziningi zokuhamba. Kuphinde kuthuthukise ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezazidlelekile ngaphambili. Ukwakhiwa kwama "ama-nodes" amaningi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni zasemaphandleni kufanele kube ezindaweni ezilula ukufinyelela ukuze abantu bathole izidingo eziphuthumayo ezitholakala kulezi "ama-nodes." Ukuhlinzekwa kwalezi zindlela eMsunduzi kuhlose ukuvimbela ukuxhumana, ekusebenzeni kwalezi zindlela, lezi zisho zizosebenza. Isithombe esikhona ngezansi sikhombisa izinto ezihlukene ezihlanganisa lezi zindlela zonke. "Arterial Roads" Lezi zindlela zizoba "ama-Nodes" ezihlangana nezindlela ezikahle. Kungenzeka ukuthi kungaba nezakhiwo ezithile eduze kwalezi "Spines" izindlela, njengezikhungo zemidlalo ezinkulu, izibhedlela, izikole eziphakeme, nezinye izakhiwo ezingafanele, ezingase zingabi yingxenye yale "Node." Lezi zindlela ezintsha eziphakanyisiwe ukuze kusekelwe ukuxhumana seziphinde zehlise izinga lokuhlala kwezimoto, okukhombiswa futhi ku-SDF. "Mixed-Use Corridors" Lokhu kuzoba kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethiwe, ngamagama, kulezi zindawo lapho "Arterial Road" idlula khona edolobheni (CBD) noma ed
Umlando Wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal KwaZulu-Natal, le ndawo enezinhlobonhlobo zamasiko, ibalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki waseNingizimu Afrika. Umlandvo uqala ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwezizwe, lapho amaZulu, ngaphansi kobuholi bukaShaka, akha umbuso onamandla. UShaka waba yisibonelo sokuhola, ehlanganisa izizwe eziningi ngaphansi kokubusa kwamaZulu, okwakuholela ezimpini eziningi, kodwa futhi kwaba nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihlanganisa izindawo eziningi. Ngemva kokuhlaselwa kwekoloni, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal waphenduka. Ngeminyaka yama-1800, iNgilandi yathola izizathu zokungena kule ndawo, ikhuluma ngempilo engcono nokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezimpi ezinzima phakathi kwamaZulu neNgilandi, okwakuholela ekutheni amaZulu aphumelele ngamandla, kodwa ekugcineni, iNgilandi yathola ukujula kwezombusazwe. Ngemva kokuhlaselwa kweNgilandi, kwavela izinkinga eziningi. Ipolitiki yendawo yahlukaniswa, futhi amaZulu akhombisa ukungavumi ukuvuma ubukhosi bezwe elisha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinkampani ezahlukene, ezazihlanganisa izimfuno zabantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Ubugebengu, ubuphofu, nokungalingani kwaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu umphakathi. Ngeminyaka yama-1940, i-ANC (African National Congress) yathola ukwamukelwa eKwaZulu-Natal. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuphikisana, njengoba i-ANC yayingathandi ukugunyazwa kwezepolitiki okwakwenziwa ngamaNgisi. Uhlelo lwe-Apartheid lwaba yingozi, lwaholela ezimpini ezinzima phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene. AmaZulu abamba iqhaza elikhulu kulokhu, eba nezinhlangano ezifana ne-IFP (Inkatha Freedom Party) ezazihlanganyela ekulweni ne-ANC. Ngemva kokuphela kwe-Apartheid ngo-1994, KwaZulu-Natal yahlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki. Ukhetho lokuqala lweminyaka yama-1990 lwaludinga ukwakha ubumbano phakathi kwamaZulu nezinye izizwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi emisha, kodwa futhi kwavula izinkinga eziningi, njengoba izinkolelo zamasiko nezepolitiki zazihlangana. Ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo zomphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho kwaba yizinto ezazidingekayo. Uhlelo lwezempilo, ukufinyelela emanzini, kanye nezinsiza zempilo zaba yizinto ezazidingeka kakhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ezazihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, KwaZulu-Natal yahlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki. Ubugebengu, ubuphofu, nokungalingani kwaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu umphakathi. Izinkampani ezihlukahlukene zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, kodwa izinkinga zazihlala zikhona. Namuhla, KwaZulu-Natal iyindawo ebalulekile emlandweni wezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho, ziyaqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa elinempilo. Nokho, izinkinga ezazikhona zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu bahlala befuna izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula nempilo engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal ubonisa ukuthi abantu bahlala befuna ubumbano, baphikisana nezinkinga, futhi bahlala bephokophela phambili. Le ndawo iyisibonelo sokuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, besebenzisa umlando wabo ukuze bakhe ikusasa elingcono. Uthando, ubumbano, kanye nezifiso zokuphila kahle zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Ngakho, umlando wezepolitiki eKwaZulu-Natal uyindida ehlobene nezinselelo, izifiso, nezifundo, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephokophela phambili, bephila ngokuhlanganyela, futhi bephokophela impilo engcono. Le ndaba ibalulekile, njengoba ibonisa indlela abantu abahamba ngayo, balwa nezinkinga, futhi bephokophela ikusasa elingcono.
Umbiko: Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi Isingeniso Imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo futhi ozinze. Kulokhu, siphawula izinhlelo ezahlukene ezithinta impilo yomphakathi, njengokufinyelela ezinsizeni zempilo, imikhankaso yokuvikela izifo, kanye nemisebenzi yokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila. Siphinde sigadile ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izikhungo zikamasipala, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nokuphila okunempilo kubantu bonke. Izinhlelo Zokwelapha Zasekhaya Ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zempilo kuyalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ezinye izinhlelo zokuqwashisa mayelana nokwelashwa kwezifo zenzeka ezindaweni zasemadolobheni, kodwa zikhona nezikhungo zokwelapha emaphandleni. Lokhu kusemqoka ngoba izindawo ezisemaphandleni ngokuvamile zihlwempu kakhulu ezinsizeni zempilo, futhi abahlali bazo babhekene nezinselelo eziningi zokufinyelela ezokwelapha. Izinhlelo zokwelapha ezifana nezinye zokwelapha eziphumelela, zifaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zempilo ezitholakala kalula, ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuvikela izifo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempilo eyezempilo, okuhlobene nezidingo zempilo zendawo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwezazi zezempilo, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kanye nabantu bomphakathi ukuze kudaleke izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Imikhankaso Yokuvikela Izifo Imikhankaso yokuvikela izifo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bavikeleka ezimeni eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukuvaxhwa, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele mayelana nokudla okunempilo, nezindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Ukukhuthaza ukuvaxhwa, ikakhulukazi ezintweni ezibucayi, njengemikhuhlane ye-flu noma uCovid-19, kubalulekile ekunciphiseni ukusabalala kwezifo. Ngesikhathi sokuhlola, kutholakale ukuthi imikhankaso ethuthukisa ukuhlonipha izindlela zokuvikela izifo ikhulisa ukuqwashisa kwabantu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlelwa kwemihlangano, imidwebo, nezikhangiso ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba balandele iziqondiso eziyimpoqo zokuvikela impilo yabo nemiphakathi yabo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikole, nezinkampani zomphakathi kuhlangene ukuze kuqashelwe izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuhlaliswa Komphakathi Ukuhlaliswa komphakathi kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukuhlaliswa ziphakathi kwezinto ezisemqoka eziphathelene nenhlalakahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwemizila yokuhamba, izindawo zokudlala, nezinye izinsiza ezithokozisayo ezisheshayo. Ukuze kube nezimo ezinhle zokuphila, kubalulekile ukwakha izikhala ezihlanganisayo ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kukhuthaza impilo yemizwa, ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, kanye nemidlalo eyokwenza abantu bahlale bejabule. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ethile, njengokudlala, ukusebenza ndawonye ekwakheni indawo, kanye nemihlangano yamasiko, zifaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ubuhlakani benhlalo Ubuhlakani benhlalo kubalulekile ekugcineni impilo yomphakathi. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ezixhasa izidingo zabantu, njengokuhlinzeka ngempilo yengqondo, kufanele zifake ukuphathwa, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuxhaswa. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabanikazi bezinsizakalo nezakhamuzi buba usizo ekuxhumaneni nasekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubandakanya imizamo yokufundisa abantu bezehlakalo zenhlalo, ukuhlola izinkinga ezibucayi, futhi kuthuthukiswe izixazululo ezithinta inhlalakahle. Umphakathi ophethe imikhankaso ethile, njengokuxhasa iminyango yomphakathi nabazali, uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu ekwenzeni izinhlelo ezisemqoka zempilo. Isiphetho Imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi iyinselelo enkulu kepha ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuze kudaleke izimo ezinhle zokuphila, kusiza ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlanganisayo, ukuxhaswa kwempilo, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo ezikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle. Kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili ngogqozi, sibambisene ukuze sithuthukise impilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi. Impilo enempilo ibonakala njengomgomo onqenqemeni konke okwenziwayo emiphakathini yethu, ngoba kuncika kithi sonke gqoka ukubhikisha impilo yethu.
Ukungenisa izinsizakalo zomphakathi ezweni kuzohlale kuba yük enkulu. Uhlaka lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ludinga uhlelo lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi ezihlobene, okuhlanganisa imikhakha futhi kuhlukanise iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni kanye nemikhakha yabo. Le nhlanganisela nokubambisana kungenzeka kuphela uma kwakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo sokusebenza kanye nezindinganiso zenqubo yokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke, zendawo, nezasekhaya. Emdlalweni weminyaka eyishumi edlule, ingxoxo ngezinto ezakha umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ibibe phambili ezingxoxweni, ivame ukuba nencazelo engacacile futhi engaziwa kahle. Kusukela ngo-1994, sibe nengxoxo ezingeni elihlukene ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zethu zifinyelela ezingeni elifanele ukuze sikhuthaze imikhakha ethukile futhi enezimo ezinzima zomphakathi. Indlela entsha emlandweni wezwe ibonisa ushintsho enqubweni yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi okuhlose ukufinyelela ezigidini zabantu abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka, ukungabi nezinsiza, nokungatholakali kwezinsiza. Le shintsho yakhiwe phezu kokubona ukuthi abantu kufanele bathuthukiswe ukuze baqonde lokho abakufunayo empilweni yabo. Le shintsho, ehlukile endleleni yokuphakela abampofu, ihlose ukuthuthukisa nokuhlinzeka ngamathuba kubantu, amaqembu, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze ibe nekhono lokuzimela, okuzosiza umnyango futhi kubambisane nabo ekubhekaneni nezinselelo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezibhekene nomnyango kanye nezwe lethu. Sizokwenza lokhu ngoba sikholwa ukuthi lezi zifiso zizokwandisa uhlelo lapho izidingo zethulwa khona futhi inhlalakahle jikelele ithuthukiswe, kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu bethu. Uhlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi lucacisa kahle imizamo yethu eqhubekayo yokwethula kahle isimo sezidingo zomphakathi kubantu abahluphekayo kakhulu kanye nemiphakathi ethukile. Ngasikhathi sinye, siqoqe idatha nezinkomba zezidingo zezinsiza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka kahle. Sithemba ukuthi le Nqubo izosiza wonke umuntu ekubhekaneni ngezinkinga esihlangabezane nazo eminyakeni eyishumi edlule mayelana nokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, sithemba ukuthi uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi luzokwandisa futhi luqinisekise ukubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zokuthuthukisa ubulungiswa bomphakathi nokubambisana okuhlose ukufezekisa umgomo owodwa othi "Impilo Engcono Kubo Bonke." Umnyango ufisa ukuveza ukubonga okukhulu kwiThimba Lezabelo elizinikele kuShintsho elinikeze kakhulu ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi. Le thimba ihlanganisa amalungu avela ezingeni likazwelonke nasephakathini, kanti uMongameli wabo nguNksz. N. Kela, uMphakathi-Jikelele Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zokuhlala (ezingeni likazwelonke). Kungokubambisana kwaleli thimba ukuthi singenza ngokuzithoba sithi sakhe isisekelo esedlula izinselelo ezikhona ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indima edlalwa ikhulisa ngempela izigidi zabantu abahluphekayo eNingizimu Afrika abakulindele ngokulangazela umsebenzi wethu. Umnyango ufisa futhi ukuqaphela iminikelo eyenziwe abanye ababambiqhaza kuyo yonke imiphakathi eyisishiyagalolunye, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, iBhodi Yezokusebenza Komphakathi, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, ama-NGOs, ama-FBOs, ama-CBOs, nezinye izikhungo ezathatha ingxenye ngesikhathi senqubo yokubonisana futhi zabelane ngemibono yazo kulolu documet. Ukubambisana nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi kuzohlale kuba yinto ebalulekile emizamweni kahulumeni nasemsebenzini wawo wokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo nokufeza lokho okuzinikele. Izindlela ezilindelekile nezindinganiso zoHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izinqumo zezinqubomgomo nezimfanelo zeMthethosisekelo... Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi olukhombisa izidingo ezigxile ekuthuthukisweni... Uhlobo nobuningi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi... Abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo/Izindlela zezikhungo... Ukuxhasa uHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izindlela zokuphumeza umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokuphatha izinguquko... Umnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ubonisa izidingo ezihlanganiswe ezintweni ezintathu ezibanzi: inhlalakahle yomphakathi, izidingo zokuhlala zomphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo kufanele zihlelwe futhi zisebenzisane nemiphakathi eqondiwe ekubhekaneni nazo zonke izinkinga zomphakathi nezimo ezifana nempilo yengqondo, ukuhlupheka okukhulu, ukungabi nokudla, nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Lezi zimo zidalile isidingo sokugxila ekuthuthukisweni okuhlose ukukhuthaza abantu, amaqembu, noma imiphakathi, futhi kuqaphele amandla abo okukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuqaphela isidingo sokukhuthaza imigomo yokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi kubhekwa ukungalingani kwhistorical, umkhakha wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi uthathile indlela yokuthuthukiswa njengendlela yokwethula izidingo ezihlose ukuhlela izinhlelo zomphakathi nezokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Eminyakeni yamuva, abathuthukisi bomphakathi baphoqelekile ukuba bamukele izinyathelo zesikhashana eziphakanyiswe yizinkinga zezinsiza ezikhona, noma lezi zibe izidingo eziphuthumayo, izidingo zomthetho, noma izibopho ezichazwe ezingeni lomhlaba. Ngakho-ke, umgomo ophakeme woHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi kuMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uwukwethula uhlaka olubanzi lukazwelonke oluchaza kahle uhlobo, ububanzi, ubuningi, kanye nezinga lomsebenzi okwakha uhlelo lokwethulwa kwezidingo zomphakathi emnyangweni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi futhi luzosebenza njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa izindlela ezijwayelekile nezinga elifanele lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi. Umphumela olindelekile woHlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi uwukwethula nokuphumeza uhlelo olubanzi, olusebenza kahle ngendlela eqondiwe futhi esezingeni eliphezulu elizuzisa umphakathi ozimela onobudlelwano nezindlela ezibekwe kuMqulu Omhlophe Womnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi kanye nezimiso zeBatho Pele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lugxile ezimisweni zomthethosisekelo, emthethweni, nasezindinganisweni zomhlaba, ezibalulekile kumnyango uma kwethulwa izidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi lweMisebenzi Yokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi lukhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi emikhulu yomnyango, efana nokuqinisekisa inhlalakahle, izidingo zokuhlala zomphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lunikeza uhlaka lokuhlela imisebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo ezihlukene zomnyango. Nokho, izinkinga zomphakathi ziyinkimbinkimbi futhi zihlanganisiwe, zidinga ukuhlela nabanye abahlinzeki, ngaleyo ndlela kugcizelelwa
Yiziphi izitshalo ze-oyili nezitshalo zephrotheni? Ngokwekhasi le-SA Grains and Oilseeds, kuthiwa imikhiqizo engaphumeli emhlabeni ingukudla okungadliwa abantu. Izitshalo ze-oyili zingadliwa futhi abantu, ikakhulukazi ngoba ziqukethe amafutha adingekayo ekudleni. Izitshalo eziyi-oyili ezikhuliswa eNingizimu Afrika zifaka: amantongomane, ilanga, ikhanola, ubhontshisi, ikotoni, ummbila, kanye ne-sorghum. Izitshalo ze-oyili zikhuliswa ikakhulukazi ukuze kutholakale amafutha akhona. Okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo ezincane (njengekhanola) kufinyelela kuphela ku-1% - 2%; okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo zebhontshisi kufinyelela ku-20% futhi kudlula ku-40% ezitshalo zekotoni kanye nekhonola. Izitshalo ze-oyili ezingadliwa abantu zikhona kakhulu kubhontshisi, ikotoni, ikhanola, i-linseed, kanye namantongomane. Izitshalo ze-oyili ezifana ne-linseed kanye ne-castor oil zisetshenziswa ezinhlelweni zezimboni. Ukwakhiwa kwezitshalo ezinefutha elinothile ezingadliwa abantu kufana nezinye ezidliwayo. Amafutha aqinile akhiqizwa uma engashisi kakhulu, kodwa amafutha ayigazi. Ikotoni, amantongomane, kanye nobhontshisi konke kufezwa ehlobo - kufezwa ekuqaleni kohlobo lwehlobo ngemva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kweqhwa (kungase kudinge ukulimala kalula yiqhwa), futhi kukhula ezinyangeni zohlobo lwehlobo (ezindaweni lapho kunenhlangano yokuna ehlobo). Izitshalo zikhula ekwindla futhi ngokuvamile ziqoqa ngemva kokufika kweqhwa. Ikhanola ifezwa ebusika - iyona kuphela isitsha se-oyili esingalimaliwe yiqhwa. Izitshalo ezivunyiwe ziqhunyiswa, futhi amafutha akhishwa kuzo. Amafutha kanye namafutha abalulekile ekudleni, asetshenziswa njenge-oyili yokupheka, i-oyili ye-salad, kanye ne-oyili yokufry, noma angabunjwa ukuze kwenziwe i-margarine nezinye amafutha okCooking. Le mikhiqizo ingena emakethe yamafutha ivela ezinsizakusebenza ezingasasebenzi (njengebutter) ngoba la mafutha awanele ukudlisa bonke abantu emhlabeni ngenxa yokushisa okusheshayo. Impahla esele ngemva kokukhishwa kwamafutha ezitshalo ibalulekile ekulimaleni kwezilwane epulazini. I-meal ekhiqizwa kule mpahla esele ngemva kokukhishwa kwamafutha kubhontshisi, amantongomane, nezinye izitshalo ze-oyili ixubene nezinye izinhlobo zezimila ukuze kutholakale ukudla kwezilwane okuhle. I-Grafu 1: Inani lokukhiqiza kwamantongomane eNingizimu Afrika. I-Grafu 3: Inani lokukhiqiza kwekotoni eNingizimu Afrika.
Le ndatshana ibhalwe ngu-A.P.N. du Toit (ARC-Grain Crops Institute), S.J. Terrblanche (University of Pretoria), no-J. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, isikhathi sokuthi abalimi abasha bavele - kumele bavuke futhi babe nesibindi, kumele babe neqhaza ekufuneni usizo kuhulumeni nakwezinye izinhlangano, kumele bathathe izintambo ukuze baqinise ikusasa labo. Indlela yokuvusa ikhono lokuba nesibindi ilandelayo: abalimi kumele bahlangane futhi basebenzisane - lokhu kuzobavumela ukuba baqhubeke phambili. Abalimi kumele basebenze ngqo ukuze benze amaqembu abalimi aqinile, futhi ubunikazi bama qembu lawo kumele bube ezandleni zezakhamizi. Amaqembu abalimi avula indlela enhle yokuxhumana nokubambisana ukuze kufezwe uguquko emapulazini nasemkhakheni wezolimo jikelele. Kubonakala, nokho, ukuthi ukuhlanganisa abalimi ukuze benze amaqembu kuzothatha isikhathi. Le nhloso ihlose ukuvusa nokukhombisa abaholi emkhakheni wezolimo ukuba bazame ukwenza umsebenzi wokubambisana kwabalamuli kube yinto ezoba nemiphumela emihle. Kungani kufanele sakhe inhlangano yabalamuli emiphakathini yethu? Abalimi bangafunda komunye nomunye. Ngale ndlela, bathola ulwazi namakhono okusebenza. Ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, abalimi bazokwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezingcono. Uma kukhula ulwazi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, kuzobasiza abalimi ukuba bagweme ukwenza amaphutha: "Kuhle ukuhlanganisa izwi." Ezinhlakeni, abalimi bafunda ukucabanga ngezindlela ezintsha nokufuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhamba phambili. Amalungu eqembu akhuthazwa ukuba abheke futhi athole izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza. Inhlangano inika abalimi amathuba okuhlangana nokufunda izindlela ezintsha ezingakhulisa ibhizinisi labo, izindlela zokuthola izinto zokulima, nezinhlelo zokumaketha. Inhlangano isiza abalimi ukukhulisa imbuyiselo emapulazini. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba ulwazi, amakhono, nokuxhumana kuhlanganiswe phakathi kwamalungu. Amaqembu anika abalimi amandla okuxoxisana ngamanani angcono. Abalimi abasha badinga ukukhuluma ngezwi eliqinile. Iqembu lokufunda elisebenzayo lizokhuthaza amalungu alo. Yiziphi izici zeqembu lokufunda elisebenzayo? Ukuhola okuqinile - "Abaholi kumele basebenze ngamalungu, hhayi amalungu ukuze abaholi." Iqembu aliholwa ngumholi noma ilungu elithile ngendlela yokubusa. Iqembu elihle linezibuko ezicacile zekusasa, linomgomo ocacile, futhi linendlela eqondile ekhombisa indlela yokusebenza ezoletha izinzuzo zezimali. Bonke amalungu balingana ngezinga lolwazi lwezolimo futhi badinga izinsiza ezifanayo. Uma wonke amalungu elingana, ukuxhumana kwabo nokubambisana kuhamba kahle. Ilungu kumele liqonde kahle indima yalo ngaphakathi kweqembu lokufunda. Iqembu kumele libe nefa nempumelelo yalo. Izindaba zezimali zivame ukuvela kumalungu futhi ziqhutshelwa ngabo. Amalungu anesibopho sokubheka imiphumela yezindlela zabo zokusebenza; banesibopho sokusebenza eqenjini futhi bazwe injabulo yokubambisana. Bonke amalungu banomfutho wokufunda nokwabelana ngolwazi lwabo namanye amalungu. Amalungu kumele azinikele uma ehlanganisa izindlela zabo zokuhamba phambili, aphathe imisebenzi yabo, futhi afune izindlela zokuthola usizo olufanele. Amalungu akumele abambe ngokuqinile ezindleleni zendabuko zokuphatha imisebenzi yabo uma efuna ukufezekisa umphumela othile. Kumele basebenzise amakhono ahlukahlukene amalungu ahlukene ngendlela efanele. Kumele kube nokuhlangana uma kukhuluma. Amalungu kumele akwazi ukuveza kalula ukuthi isimo sabo sikhona kanjani mayelana nomsebenzi nokuthi bacabangani ngendlela iqembu elisebenza ngayo. Amalungu kumele azihlolisise njalo. Ngokufanayo, ithimba kumele lihlolisise njalo ukuthi lisasebenza kahle futhi lize lizele ezinye izindlela ezingcono zokusebenza. Iqembu kumele likwazi ukuxhumana kalula nabaphathi bezolimo. Iqembu elinjalo livame ukuxhumana nezinye izinhlangano futhi lizokwazi temsilwa amalungu ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Iqembu kumele lihlole ngokucophelela ukuthi lisebenza kanjani, lingesabi ukusho nokuvuma ukuthi lenze amaphutha. Bese likwazi ukusebenza kangcono ngoba lizokwazi ukushintsha indlela yokusebenza edingekayo. Amaqembu anika amalungu amandla okuqhubeka. Ilungu ngalinye linomsebenzi wokusebenza eqenjini kodwa liyazi ukuthi ekugcineni lizothola inzuzo ngoba iqembu liqinile kunomuntu oyedwa. Ukwakha iqembu lokufunda. Amaqembu kumele akhiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona futhi mayelana nomphakathi wonke. Uma kudingeka, ukuxhumana nekhansela lendawo kubalulekile. Kumele kube nokwamukelwa kukhansela lendawo nezinye izinhlangano ukuthi kudingeka kwakhiwe iqembu labalimi. Abalimi kumele bakhethe amalungu amaqembu amasha. Iqembu lingaqala ngesakhiwo esingaqondile. Ngemuva kwalokhu, lingakhula libe ngesakhiwo esisemthethweni, kodwa ngesivinini saso. (Bheka umgomo obizwa ngokuthi: "Sebenza kuqala bese uhlela kamuva"). Lo mgomo ungcono ngoba awuqinile kakhulu, uvumela abalimi ukuba bakhule ngenqubo yokwakha inhlangano. Amaqembu akhona angaphinde abhekwe ukuze asebenze kangcono noma angavuselelwa. Nokho, kungcono ukuhoxisa amaqembu angasebenzi kahle. Uma kubonakala ukuthi abantu abamukelwa eqenjini ngendlela efanele, kuzodingeka ukuthi kutholakale abanye abangakwazi ukusiza emsebenzini wokuhlanganisa amalungu ukuze kwakhiwe iqembu eliphilayo. Uma abaphakeli/abaholi bengaveli kulolo mphakathi, zama ukuthola abantu abathembekile kulomphakathi wonke abangakwazi ukuhlanganisa futhi baxhumanise abalimi emsebenzini wezolimo. Kumele kube nokucaciswa njalo mayelana nomsebenzi wabaholi nalabo abasiza ekuhlanganiseni abalimi ngoba kubalulekile uma kwakhiwa iqembu elihle. Kumele kucaciswe ukuthi yiziphi izidingo nezinkinga zamalungu eqembu elithile ngoba lokhu kuqhubeka uma kulungiselelwa umsebenzi wesikhathi esizayo nokusetha izinhloso zeqembu. Lo mgomo (indlela yokusebenza) usiza abalimi ukuba baqale ukusebenza ngokushesha ukuze isikhathi singachithwa. Iqembu elincane elingaqondile lingaqala ngokubhekana nenkinga ethile bese amalungu engasizana omunye nomunye ekuxazululeni le nkinga. Ngokufanayo, amalungu aleli qembu azothola umfutho wokusebenza ukuze kuzuze umgomo weqembu. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ukuharmony phakathi kwamalungu kudala umoya oqinile phakathi kwabo, basondele njengoba besebenzisana. Kufana nezinto zemvelo eziphila ngogesi wangaphakathi. Izinhlangano zikhula zodwa, azivinjwa yizinto zangaphandle. Lokhu kudala umoya oqinile wokuhola ngoba abaholi bakhethwa phakathi kwamalungu eqembu. (ukulwa kwamandla) kwabaphathi noma ezinye izinhlangano zangaphandle. Ukwakha iqembu lokufunda elisebenzayo kudinga lokhu: kumele kube nomfutho phakathi kwabalamuli kule ndawo ukuba bahlangane ukuze basebenze ngenhloso yabo yokuxazulula izinkinga zabo nokukhiqiza imikhiqizo edingekayo. Akukho iqembu lokufunda labalimi elingaphoqwa abantu ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle ukuba lihlangane - kumele kube nomfutho phakathi kwamalungu. Kodwa asifanele sikhohlwe ukuthi izimo zezinto azifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Uma umfutho wokuba ne iqembu lokufunda labalimi uvuka emphakathini, abaholi bang
Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo Isingeniso Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, onobumbano, nolwazi. Umthethosisekelo, njengesisekelo somthetho, udinga ukuhunyushwa nokubuyekezwa ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuchibiyelweni kwalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izindlela ezivumela abantu abaningi ukuba babambe iqhaza, baphendule, futhi baveze imibono yabo. Ukubaluleka kokubamba iqhaza komphakathi Ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo kudala ithuba lokuthi izwi labantu lizwe. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba umthethosisekelo kufanele ubonise izifiso, izidingo, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuveza imibono yabo, lokhu kudala umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu banomthelela ezinqubweni ezithinta impilo yabo, okwandisa ukuzibophezela kwabo ekuphathweni komphakathi. Izindlela zokubamba iqhaza Kunezindlela eziningi zokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo. Lezi zindlela zingahlanganisa: 1. Izinkulumo zomphakathi: Ukuhlela izinkulumo ezivulekile, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo, kubalulekile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imihlangano, izinkulumo, noma izinkundla zokuxhumana. Izinkulumo zomphakathi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule futhi babelane ngemicabango yabo. 2. Uphenyo: Ukuqhuba uphenyo olujulile ukuze kuqondwe izidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqoqa imininingwane ethile mayelana nezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ukuze kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okungcono ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo. 3. Izinhlelo zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokufundisa umphakathi mayelana nezici zomthethosisekelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinqubo ezithinta umthethosisekelo, futhi bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo ngendlela efanele. 4. Ukubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi: Ukubambisana nezikhungo ezahlukene zomphakathi, ezifana nezikole, izinkampani, nezinhlangano ezizimele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bayakwazi ukufinyelela ezinqubweni zokubamba iqhaza. Izithiyo zokubamba iqhaza Noma kunjalo, kunezithiyo eziningi ezivimbela ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo. Lezi zithiyo zingahlanganisa: 1. Ukungabi nolwazi: Abantu abaningi bangase bangabi nolwazi olwaneleyo mayelana nezinqubo zomthethosisekelo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuba babambe iqhaza. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokufundisa eziphumelelayo. 2. Ukungabikhona kwezinsiza: Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude noma ezinzima bangase bangabi nezinsiza ezanele zokubamba iqhaza, njengokufinyelela ezinkulumweni noma ezinhlelweni zokubambisana. 3. Ukungaboni kahle kwezinhlelo: Uma izinhlelo zokubamba iqhaza zingacacile, abantu bangase bangabi nentshisekelo yokubamba iqhaza. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinqubo zibe sobala futhi ziqondakale. 4. Ukungabikhona kokuxhumana: Ukuxhumana okunganele phakathi kwezikhungo eziphethe umthetho nomphakathi kungavimbela abantu ekubambeni iqhaza. Ukuze lokhu kuxazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana. Isiphetho Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuguquleni umthethosisekelo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthethosisekelo ubonisa izidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezindlela ezivumela abantu abaningi ukuba babambe iqhaza, baphendule, futhi baveze imibono yabo. Noma kunjalo, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, futhi kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokubamba iqhaza. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe inqubo yokubamba iqhaza ethuthukile, eqinile, futhi efinyeleleka kubo bonke. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umthethosisekelo onobulungiswa, obumbene, nolwazi, okuzokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile Ekuqaleni kuka-2007, kwaqala ukuhlela iphrojekthi enkulu yokwakha isiteshi samandla eKusile, esiseMpumalanga, eNingizimu Afrika. Lesi siteshi, esiklanyelwe ukukhipha amandla angama-4800 MW, sibe yinsiza enkulu yokwandisa umthamo wamandla kuleli. Nokho, phakathi nezinyathelo zokwakha, kwabakhona izinselelo eziningi ezaholela ekubambezelekeni kokuphothulwa kwesistimu ye-flue gas, okuyinsiza ebalulekile yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa komoya. Umsebenzi wokuqala wawuqala ngokuqinile, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokuqala zaba sobala. Izinkampani ezingaphansi kokwakhiwa kwalesi siteshi zathola ukuthi izinsiza ezidingekayo azitholakali kalula. Ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengemishini ethile, kwadlala indima enkulu ekuvimbeleni inqubekelaphambili. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kuqashelwe ukuthi isikhumbuzo seLanga, okuyi-mozambique, nesikhumbuzo seGoli, sibe sezindaweni ezikude nezokwakha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwempahla zikhula, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezimali ezichithwa ngokweqile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi ibhekelelwa ngendlela efanele, kwadingeka ukuthi kube nezivumelwano eziningi phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa uhulumeni, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nezinkampani eziphakathi kokwakha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuxhumana, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinto. Ukwengeza, ukusimama kwezimo zezulu kwaba yinkinga enkulu. Ngemuva kokuphakanyiswa kwezinhlelo zokwakha, izikhukhula nezimvula ezinzima zaba yindlela yokuphazamisa, okwenza kube nzima ukuhambisa izinsiza nezisebenzi endaweni yokwakha. Lokhu kwaholela ekubambezelekeni okukhulu, njengoba izisebenzi zazingeke zikwazi ukugcina umjikelezo wokwakha. Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zezulu, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bendawo nabakhi baphinde baba yinkinga. Abantu bendawo babekhuluma ngezidingo zabo, ezazihlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, kodwa babephinde baphikise izinhlelo zokunciphisa ukungcoliswa kwemvelo. Lokhu kwaholele ekubambezelekeni kokuvunyelwa kwezinhlelo ezithinta imvelo, ngoba abanye babebona ibhizinisi lephrojekthi njengokuphazamisayo emiphakathini yabo. Uhlaka lokuphatha lwephrojekthi, olwakhiwe ngenhloso yokulawula izinselelo, lwathola ukuthi izinqubo zokusebenza azihambisani nezidingo ezishiwo. Lokhu kwaholela ekubambezelekeni okukhulu, njengokungafinyeleli ezingeni elilindelekile lokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abahlinzeki bezinsiza babephinde babe nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha. Kuyenzeka ukuthi ngenxa yalesi simo, izimali eziningi zashoda. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinkinga ezazikhona, izinkampani eziphathelene neKusile zathola ukuthi kudingeka izinhlelo ezikhethekile zokwakha ubudlelwano obuphilayo phakathi kwabo nabahlinzeki. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuba nezinhlelo zokuhlanganyela, okwakuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ezisemqoka zokuhlola nokuphathwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili kwephrojekthi zathuthuka. Izinguquko ezibucayi zafakwa ekuphathweni kwezakhiwo, okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuhlola izimpahla nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nokwenza kahle, futhi kwathuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani ezihilelekile. Ukwengeza, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukufaka isandla emphakathini kwandisa ukuzethemba kwabantu bendawo. Ngokwenza imizamo ethile yokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubambisana, abahlinzeki bezinsiza bakwazi ukuhlanganisa izifiso zomphakathi nezidingo zempumelelo yephrojekthi. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuxhumana okungcono, okwakhulisa ukufinyelela kweziphakamiso ezithile. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingana yokubambisana nokuthuthukiswa, iphrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile yawela esigabeni sokuphothulwa. Njengoba izinkampani ziqhubeka nokwakha, izinzuzo zokuqala ziqala ukukhanya, futhi umphakathi uqala ukubona imiphumela yokusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iphrojekthi igunyazwe njengemodeli yokwakha ezindaweni ezinkulu, ibonisa ukuthi nakuba izinselelo zikhona, khona-ke ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nokusebenza ngokubambisana kungaholela empumelelweni. Ukwakhiwa kwesistimu ye-flue gas eKusile kube yinto ebalulekile ekunciphiseni ukungcoliswa komoya, futhi kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo. Lesi simo siphinde sibe ngumfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuthi, noma izinselelo zikhona, umphakathi ungenza uma kubhekwa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlanganyela. Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile kube yisibonelo sokuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yomphakathi kudinga ubudlelwano obunempumelelo phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Lesi sihloko sikhombisa ukuthi nakuba isikhathi sokubambezeleka sikhona ezinkampanini eziningi, izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela kwephrojekthi kungaba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu. Uhlelo lokuhlanganyela, ubudlelwano obunempumelelo, kanye nezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuphatha kwaholela ekwakheni umsebenzi ophumelelayo, okwagcina sekubangela impumelelo yephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile. Le miphumela ibonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, imiphakathi ingaqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Incazelo yomcimbi: iYouTube Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, sizobe sibhala umlando omusha emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, lapho sizobamba umcimbi omkhulu we-YouTube. Lo mcimbi, ozobanjelwa eThekwini, uzohlanganisa abantu abanothando lokwabelana ngezindaba, imicabango, nobuciko, bonke bephumelele ekwakheni izikhala ezisemqoka ezivuleka emhlabeni we-digital. Umcimbi uzovula ngempelasonto ekuseni, lapho abantu abavela kuzo zonke izindawo zomzansi bezongena, bejabulela imihlangano ehlukene. Uzokwakha ithuba lokuthi abathandi be-YouTube bahlangane, baxoxe, futhi babelane ngolwazi oluwusizo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umqondo wobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okuhambisana nemigomo ye-YouTube yokuxhumana, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana. Izinhlelo zomcimbi zifaka izingxoxo ezibucayi, lapho ochwepheshe bazoqinisekisa ukuthi abazobamba iqhaza bazokwazi ukufunda kahle ngempumelelo ye-YouTube, izindlela zokwakha okuqukethwe, kanye nezindlela zokukhulisa izithameli. Kukhona futhi izifundo ezihlukene ezizokwenza abantu baziqonde kahle izidingo zabo nezifiso zabo kumhlaba wezokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nemicimbi ethokozisayo efana nama-workshop, lapho abazokwazi khona ukufunda izindlela ezintsha zokuphucula ikhwalithi yokuthumela izithombe, ividiyo, nemiyalezo ebhalwe phansi. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zizoqinisekisa ukuba abaklami bethu bathola amathuba amaningi okukhula, bephucula amakhono abo ukuze babe neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni we-YouTube. Ezinsukwini zokuqala zomcimbi, sizobamba neqhaza lezinhlaka ezihloniphekile ezivela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa abezindaba, abaculi, nabaculi bempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umcimbi ube yindawo yokuhlangana, lapho abantu bejabulela ukufunda, ukuhlekisa, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo. Ngenxa yokuxhumana okuhamba phambili, sizobe sithokozisa uhambo lwethu ngezinhlobonhlobo zezimpendulo, iziphakamiso, nezixazululo ezivela kubantu abanamakhono ahlukahlukene. Umcimbi uzolandela izinyathelo ezilula zokubamba izethameli, ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kuma-video, izithombe, nemiyalezo ethokozisayo. Abangane bethu bazoba nethuba lokuxhumana ngokuqondile nabantu abahlukene, behlanganyela imicabango nezimvo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuze nabantu baziqonde kahle izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuholela ezindleleni ezintsha zokwenza ibhizinisi. Ngemva kwemihlangano nemicimbi, sizobamba umcimbi ophakathi, lapho sizobamba indawo yokubambisana phakathi kwabathandi bama-YouTube. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula abantu bathole amakhasimende amaningi, besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze bakhe izixhumanisi eziphumelelayo. Izinkampani ezizobamba iqhaza zifuna ukuzama imikhankaso emisha ye-YouTube, futhi sizobafaka phakathi kulo mcimbi. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi we-YouTube uzoba yithuba elihle lokukhuluma, ukufunda, nokuhlangana. Uzoqhakambisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ubuciko, nezindlela zokudala. Ngakho-ke, sicela uqhubeke ulandele iziqondiso nezimemo zethu, uqinisekise ukuthi ungakuvumeli ukuthola lokhu kuhlanganyela okumangalisayo. Hamba nathi kulolu hambo, futhi silindele ukukubona phansi komcimbi, lapho sizokwakha khona ikusasa eliqhakazile le-YouTube. Sibheke ngabomvu ukuhlangana nani nonke, sabelane ngalezi zindaba ezithokozisayo. Hamba nathi emhlabeni we-YouTube!
Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwabavoti Nentando Yeningi: Iphrofayela KaMandla Mthethwa UMandla Mthethwa ungumuntu ohamba phambili emkhakheni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Uzalwe emzini onemithwalo eminingi, uMandla waqala uhambo lwakhe lokubamba iqhaza esebenza njengomfundi ophokophelelayo emiphakathini yakhe. Ukukhula kwakhe eMkhambathini kwaholela ekutheni aqonde kahle indlela ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kusebenza ngayo, futhi wazi kahle ukuthi intando yeningi iyisihluthulelo sokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMandla wathatha isinqumo sokuba yingxenye yomsebenzi wezombusazwe. Wayefuna ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, okhululekile, futhi owawubhekelele izidingo zabantu. Wazimisela ukufundisa abantu baphendule, baphakamise izwi labo, futhi bazi ukuthi impilo yabo ithonywa kanjani yizinqumo ezenziwa ezingeni likamasipala, isifunda, nakwazulu. Ngemva kokuba sebenza nabantu bendawo, uMandla waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuthaza abavoti, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Wayebona ukuthi abavoti abasha bahlale bephuthumisa izwi labo, futhi lokho akukwaziwa kahle. Ngaleso sikhathi, waqala ukuxhumana namakhosikazi nabafana, edlulisa umyalezo wokuthi ukubamba iqhaza kwezombusazwe akukhona kuphela emavotweni, kodwa kubandakanya nokuhlanganyela phakathi komphakathi. Ubufakazi bokusebenza kukaMandla buvele ngesikhathi ezama ukwakha izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze abavoti bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. Waqala amaphrojekthi ahlanganisa abantu ukuze badlale indima ebalulekile ezinqumweni ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umqondo wokuthi abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi banezwi, futhi lokho kwenza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabavoti nabaholi bube namandla. Eminyakeni edlule, uMandla washintsha indlela abavoti abacabanga ngayo. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abakhe izinkqubo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuvota. Ubuye wavula izinkundla zokuxoxa ezingama-workshops, lapho abantu bekhuthazwa ukuba baqonde izinqubo zokuvota, izizathu zokubaluleka kokuvota, kanye nemithetho eqondile yokuvota. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangazivota kanjani, futhi kudingekile ukuthi benze njalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMandla wabonakala njengomholi obonisa izifiso zabantu. Uhlale elindele, ethokozisa abantu bathole izindlela zokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umbono owawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, benza ukuba babe nokuqonda okujule ngentando yeningi. Uhlale edinga ukwazi uma abantu bakhe bezizwa kanjani, ukuze akwazi ukubanikeza izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMandla waba ngumshayi, ehlonishwa ngempela emiphakathini yakhe. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza ukusondelana phakathi kwabavoti nabaholi, eqinisa imiphakathi ukuze ifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumele phambili, baveze izinkinga ezithinta impilo yabo, bese bezama ukuzenza zixazululwe ngempela. Ubuciko bakhe bokuxhumana nabantu bukhombisa ukuthi ungumholi onomoya ophilayo. Uhlale ethokozisa, efuna izixazululo, futhi ezama ukusiza abavoti bakhe ukuze bazi ukuthi banezwi, futhi lokho kubalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi emihle. Uhlale efundisa ukuthi ukubamba iqhaza kuhilela ukuxhumana, ukuxoxa, nokwenza izinqumo ezinhle. Namuhla, uMandla Mthethwa usenqabeni yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, okhululekile, nobumbene. Uqhubeka nokuhola abantu emsebenzini wokubamba iqhaza, eqinisekisa ukuthi intando yeningi iyahlala ibalulekile. Ngokuhambisana nemigomo yakhe, ukhuluma kahle ngemiphakathi, futhi ubamba iqhaza ezindabeni ezithinta abantu. Uhlale ethokozisa abavoti, efundisa, futhi evuselela umqondo wokuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma wonke umuntu ezwa ubuhlakani. Ngalendlela, uMandla ubonisa ukuthi ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti akukhona nje kuphela emavotweni, kodwa kuhilela ukuphila kwansuku zonke, ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bahlukumeza izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ubuye afakazele ukuthi intando yeningi iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile nelizwakalayo. Ubuye abe yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umuntu oyedwa angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabanye. Ngakho, uMandla Mthethwa uyisibonelo esihle sokubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi, ebonisa ukuthi indlela esibamba ngayo iqhaza empilweni yethu ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sihlale sigxile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezizoletha ushintsho oluhle emiphakathini yethu.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sokuqashwa (GEMS Employment Status Verification) Isingeniso Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kubalulekile emkhakheni wezokusebenza, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngempumelelo yebhizinisi, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Le nqubo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi be-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) bayaziwa futhi bahambisana nezidingo ezimisiwe. Kulokhu, sizobheka le nqubo, sikhuluma ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile, izidingo, kanye nezindlela zokuthola ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izidingo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise isimo sokuqashwa. Abafuna ukuqinisekisa isimo sokuqashwa kufanele babe nezinto ezithile, ezifaka phakathi: 1. Ubufakazi Bokusebenza: Lokhu kungaba yincwadi yokusebenza, isivumelwano sokuqashwa, noma ezinye izincwadi ezikhombisa imiholo. 2. Idokhumenti Yokuhlonza: Izincwadi ezinjengemvume yokuhlala, ipasipoti, noma ikhadi lesazisi. 3. Izincwadi Zokuxhumana: Izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezivela kumqashi zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umuntu uyiqembu elisemthethweni. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuxhumana Ne-GEMS Ngemuva kokuhlangabezana nezidingo, isinyathelo esilandelayo wukuxhumana ne-GEMS. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezindlela ezahlukene: 1. Ucingo: Fona inombolo ye-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela izinyathelo ezichazwe ngumsizi. 2. I-imeyili: Thumela i-imeyili echaza isicelo sakho sokuqinisekisa isimo sokuqashwa, uqinisekise ukufaka izincazelo ezidingekayo. 3. I-Website: Vakashela ku-website ye-GEMS ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe mayelana nezicelo. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlinzeka Ngemininingwane Edingekayo Lapho uxhumana ne-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ephelele: 1. Igama eliphelele: Sebenzisa igama eliphelele, njengoba kubhalwe ezincwadini zomsebenzi. 2. Inombolo ye-ID: Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba i-GEMS ikuthole. 3. Ulwazi Lokuqashwa: Nikeza imininingwane ethile ngendawo yakho yokusebenza, isikhundla, nosuku lokuqala kokusebenza. Isinyathelo 4: Ukulinda Impendulo Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kulindeleke impendulo ku-GEMS. Lokhu kungathatha isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba nesineke. Ungalindela impendulo nge-imeyili noma ngefoni. Uma ungatholi impendulo ngesikhathi, ungaphinda uxhumane nabo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqinisekisa Ukusebenza Kwenqubo Uma uthola ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle: 1. Ukuhlola Imininingwane: Qiniseka ukuthi imininingwane oyitholile iyahambisana naleyo owahlinzeke ngayo. 2. Ukugcina Amarekhodi: Gcina zonke izincwadi ezihambisanayo, kuhlanganise nezincwadi ezithunyelwe ne-GEMS nempendulo oyitholile. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa ku-GEMS kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokusebenza. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo sakho sokuqashwa sihamba kahle, uthole izinsizakalo ezinhle ze-GEMS. Qhubeka uqinisekise ukuthi uyaziqonda izidingo nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze ube nesikhathi esihle sokusebenza. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS luhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila Umbuzo 1: Yini eyenza zikhule izindleko zokuphila? Izindleko zokuphila zikhuphuka ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, ukwanda kwentengo yezinto eziyisisekelo, njengezokudla, izindlu, nezinsiza, kuyinto enkulu ephakamisa lezi zindleko. Ukukhuphuka kwentengo kwamafutha, imikhiqizo yokwakha, kanye nezindleko zokuhamba nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umnotho jikelele, izinqubomgomo zezimali zikamasipala, kanye nezinguquko zemakethe yomsebenzi ziwumphumela. Umbuzo 2: Lokhu kukhuphuka kuzothinta kanjani abantu abakhenkethile? Abantu abakhenkethile bazoba nemiphumela emibi ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi imindeni ibhekane nokushoda kwemali yokuphila, okuholela ekudleni okungabizi, ukuhamba okuncane, noma ukungakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu. Lokhu kubangela ingcindezi enkulu, ikakhulukazi emindenini enezindleko eziningi. Ukuze ukwazi ukuphila, abantu bangase badinge ukukhipha izindleko ezibalulekile empilweni yabo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izindlela ezithile zomphakathi zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga? Umphakathi ungasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokubhekana nokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusungula izinhlelo zokusekela imindeni ezikhathazekile, njengezinhlelo zokudla eziphansi, izinhlelo zokuhlala ezishibhile, noma ukwenza imikhankaso yokweluleka abantu ngezindlela zokuphila ezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlela imicimbi yokwabelana ngemibono nokuxhumana ukuze kuqondiswe izindleko zokuphila kungaba usizo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa uhulumeni ukuze alungise le nkinga? Uhulumeni ungathatha izinyathelo ezithile ukuze alungise lesi simo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo kwezinsiza, ukunciphisa izintela eziphakeme ezithinta izimpahla ezibalulekile, noma ukusungula izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni enezidingo ezikhethekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni angavula izinkampani ezincane, aphinde athuthukise imisebenzi yokuhweba ukuze kube nezinketho eziningi zabathengi. Umbuzo 5: Kukhona yini izixazululo ezithile ezingase zicatshangelwe? Yebo, kunezixazululo eziningi ezingase zicatshangelwe. Umphakathi ungakhuthaza izinhlelo zokulima ezincane, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukutshala ukudla kwabo, okuvumela ukunciphisa izindleko. Futhi, ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila ezisebenzayo, njengezokugcinwa kwemali, ukusebenzisa kahle izinsiza, nokuhweba phakathi kwabo, kungasiza ekuqedeni ukwanda kwezindleko zokuphila. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele abantu bayazi ngabantu abathintekayo? Abantu abathintekayo kumele baqonde ukuthi abazizwa bematasa futhi besabekayo ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. Kubalulekile ukuthi bahlanganyele, bazwakalise izinkinga zabo, futhi baphinde balwe ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo. Ukuze ubambisane, ungaba neqhaza emiphakathini, ube yingxenye yomsebenzi wokwakha umphakathi, noma uxhumane nabanye ukuze uqhubeke nokucela usizo. Umbuzo 7: Kukhona yini imiphumela emihle engavela ekukhuleni kwezindleko zokuphila? Ngaphandle kwemiphumela emibi, kukhona imiphumela emihle engavela. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo ezintsha zokuphila, ukuqhamuka kwezinkampani ezintsha, nokukhula kwemakethe yokuhweba. Lokhu kungenza abantu bancintisane, futhi kube nezinketho eziningi ezitholakalayo kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwanda kwezindleko kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo eziphusile, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zomphakathi. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngezizathu ezithile zokukhathazeka? Kunokukhathazeka okuningi okudingekayo ngalesi sikhathi. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kungakhanyisa izinkinga ezinkulu, ezinjengokungalingani komnotho, ukungabikhona kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila ezibucayi. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhamba phambili, futhi kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi babone lezi zinkinga futhi benze izinqumo ezinhle. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola kulokhu? Izifundo ezitholakala kulokhu kubalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nokuqonda okujulile kwezindleko zokuphila nokuthi ziqondanisa kanjani nezimo zomphakathi. Okwesibili, abantu kumele babe nekhono lokuphila phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ekugcineni, imiphakathi kumele ibambisane futhi ihlanganyele ukuze ithole izixazululo ezinzima. Umbuzo 10: Yini okubalulekile ekupheleni? Ekupheleni, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuyinselele enkulu, kodwa ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, kukhona nethuba lokuthi izinto zingathuthuka. Ukubambisana, ukusiza, nokuhlinzeka ngesisekelo kulabo abadinga usizo kungenza kube nokwenzeka. Kumele siqhubeke sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, sithumele izwi lethu, futhi sithole izixazululo ezithinta wonke umuntu. Isiphetho: Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuphakamisa izinkinga eziningi, kodwa ngokubambisana singathola izixazululo. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi umphakathi unamandla. Ngakho, kumele sihlanganyele, sibambisane, futhi sikhuthaze ukuhamba phambili ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene.
Zonke izikole zikhishwe ngekhophi efanele, ifomu lokubala le-CD, kanye nediski. Izikole kulindeleke ukuthi zibuyise ifomu elisayiniwe, ukuhlolwa okubhalwe ngesandla okuphelele noma ifomu eliprintiwe, ikhophi yalo, kanye nediski (enolwazi olufakiwe). Izikole ezingakwazi ukufinyelela kumakhompyutha kufanele zibuyise ifomu lokuhlola elisayiniwe eligcwaliswe ngesandla kanye nekhophi yalo. Iphasi 1 isebenza kuzo zombili izikole ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile. Iphasi 2 isebenza kuphela ezikoleni ezijwayelekile. Iphasi 3 isebenza ezikoleni ezikhethekile (LSEN). QAPHELA: Lezi ziqondiso zisebenza ezikoleni ezigcwalisa ifomu ngesandla. Lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo kufanele zilandelwe lapho kugcwaliswa amafomu. Sicela usebenzise IZINHLOKO ZEZINHLOKO lapho ugcwalisa amafomu. Sicela ubhale ngendlela ecacile ngangokunokwenzeka. Signa kuphela endaweni enikeziwe yokusayina. Sicela ugcwalise enye ikhasi uma wenza amaphutha ekhasini. Sicela ufake inombolo ye-EMIS ekhasini ngalinye. Amakhasi efomu kufanele abuyiswe ngendlela efanele. Lonke ulwazi kufanele lunikezwe. Ikhasi le-"fomu yokuvuma" - ikhasi lesibili lefomu - kufanele ligcwaliswe ngesandla. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo owavumile akhona efomini yokuvuma ahlelwe kahle. Gcwalisa imininingwane yesikole sakho noma ngabe akushintshanga. Iyunithi ye-EMIS izohlinzeka ngolwazi olusha uma kuqhathaniswa nolwazi olushintshile ngaphandle kwegama lesikole. Ikheli leposi: 1. Ikhodi yeposi Ikheli lendawo: 1. Khombisa inani labafundi kuGrade 1 noGrade 2 esikoleni sakho ngokwezinsuku zabo zokuzalwa. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi inani eliphelele labafundi kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi ezigabeni ezifanayo kuTebula 3. Le tebula isetshenziselwa ukulandelela iminyaka yabafundi abangena ohlelweni. Khombisa inani labafundi kuzo zonke izigaba, inani lezigaba ekilasini (amaqembu abafundi ngokwezigaba), kanye nenani labaphindayo, okungukuthi, abaphindayo okokuqala, abaphindayo kwesibili, njll. Amakilasi okulungisa/ukwesekwa abhekisela kumakilasi abafundi abathola ukufundiswa okwakhe isikhathi esithile. Inani labafundi selivele lafakwa ezigabeni zezifundo. Khombisa inani abafundi okulindeleke ukuthi bakhokhe njengesikole kule nyaka. Ezimweni zezikhungo ezingenayo izinsizakalo ze-hostel, lokhu akuhlanganisi nezimali ze-hostel. Khombisa inani labafundi abakhululelwe ekukhokheni imali yokufunda ngonyaka ka-2008. Khombisa inani labafundi abathutheleka kwezinye izifunda noma amazwe ukuya eGauteng. Bala kuphela labo bafundi abajoyine isikole ngonyaka ka-2009. Khombisa inani labafundi ngokwezigaba abakhona esikoleni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abafundi ab placed in hostels. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 3 no-8. Le tebula isebenza kubazali/ab guardians abahlala nomfundi. Ungabala kabili uma abazali/ab guardians behlala futhi besebenza endaweni. Umfundi ngamunye kufanele uchazwe ngawe nakulet tebula. Tebula 9: Ulwazi Lokusebenza Tebula 9. Khombisa inani labasebenzi abaqashwe nguhulumeni esikoleni ngokobulili, izinga, nohlobo lomsebenzi. Izinga lesikhundla somphakathi kufanele likhombiswe. Khombisa inani labasebenzi abaqashwe ngababusi esikoleni ngokobulili, izinga, nohlobo lomsebenzi. Bheka isigaba 2 seTebula 1 ezikoleni ezijwayelekile ngenhla. Khombisa inani labafundi kuzo zonke izigaba/iphasi, ubulili, inani eliphelele lezigaba, kanye nenani labo ngokwezigaba/iphasi kwiqembu ngalinye labafundi ngokwezigaba/iphasi. Tebula 3: Umnikelo wezezimali ngummfundi (Bheka isigaba 2 seTebula 4 ezikoleni ezijwayelekile ngenhla). Tebula 4: Inani labafundi abakhululelwe ekukhokheni imali yokufunda ngonyaka ka-2008. (Bheka isigaba 2 seTebula 5 ezikoleni ezijwayelekile ngenhla). Khombisa inani labafundi abanezingqinamba. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi uma kunezingqinamba eziningi, abafundi kufanele babalwe ngezinga labo eliyinhloko. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 2, 7, no-8. Tebula 6: Inani labafundi abahambe baya eGauteng ngonyaka ka-2009 (Bheka isigaba 2 seTebula 6 ezikoleni ezijwayelekile ngenhla). Khombisa inani labafundi ngokwezigaba abakhona esikoleni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abafundi ab placed in hostels. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 2, 5, no-8. Tebula 8: Inani labafundi Iphrofayela Yomzali/Umphathiswa engena ngale ndlela. Khombisa inani labafundi mayelana nesimo abazali/ab guardians njengoba kuhlelwe kwiMithetho Yokwamukela. Le tebula isebenza kubazali/ab guardians babafundi abahlala nabo. Ungabala kabili uma umzali ehlala futhi esebenza endaweni. Umfundi ngamunye kufanele ubalwe ngawe nakulet tebula. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 2, 5, no-7. Khombisa inani labasebenzi abaqashwe nguhulumeni esikoleni ngokobulili, isikhundla, nohlobo lomsebenzi. Izinga lesikhundla somphakathi kufanele likhombiswe.
