Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye (GEMS spouse/partner beneficiary status) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza yokwelashwa eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. I-GEMS inikeza amalungu ayo izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwelashwa, kuhlanganise nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezibalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okudingekayo. Umbuzo 2: Yini umhlomuli? Umhlomuli ungumuntu okhethwe ngumuntu obhaliswe kwi-GEMS ukuze athole izinzuzo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya umshado, umlingani, noma umntwana, kuye ngohlobo lwesimo somhlomuli esikhethwe. Umbuzo 3: Yini isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye? Isimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye sisho ukuthi umpartner noma umyeni/womkakho ungumhlomuli kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umyeni noma umkakho bangathola izinzuzo zokwelashwa ezitholakala kwi-GEMS, uma umyeni noma umkakho ebhaliswe njengomhlomuli. Umbuzo 4: Ungabhalisa kanjani umhlomuli wakho? Ukuze ubhalise umhlomuli wakho, udinga ukufaka ifomu lokubhalisela umhlomuli. Lokhu kungafaka imininingwane efana negama, usuku lokuzalwa, kanye nezinye izincazelo zomhlomuli. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izincazelo ziqondile futhi ziqedile ukuze kube lula ukuhlela izinzuzo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakalayo kumhlomuli? Umhlomuli onguye umyeni noma umkakho ungathola izinzuzo ezahlukene ezifana nezindleko zokwelashwa, izindleko zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezidingo zomhlomuli, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe umhlomuli angase abe nezinye izinzuzo? Yebo, umhlomuli angase abe nezinye izinzuzo ezitholakala kwi-GEMS, ezifana nezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo, ukwelashwa kwezifo ezithile, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlomuli uthola ukunakekelwa okuphelele. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe umhlomuli kufanele ahlangabezane nezimfuneko ezithile? Yebo, umhlomuli kufanele ahlangabezane nezimfuneko ezithile ukuze abhaliswe. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufakazela ubudlelwano, njengemishado, noma ukufakazela ukuthi ubuhlobo busemthethweni uma ungashadile. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele uyenze uma umhlomuli wakho eshintshe? Uma umhlomuli wakho eshintshe, njengokushada kabusha noma ukuhlukanisa, kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi ushintsho lwenziwa kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kuzodinga ukufaka ifomu lokushintsha umhlomuli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinzuzo zihlala zikhona kumuntu ofanele. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izinzuzo zihlala zikhona uma umhlomuli eshiywe? Uma umhlomuli eshiywe, izinzuzo zingase zishintshe. Kubalulekile ukuthi uxhumane ne-GEMS ukuze uthole ulwazi oluqondile mayelana nezinguquko ezizokwenzeka ngenxa yokushiywa komhlomuli. Umbuzo 10: Ungathola kuphi olunye ulwazi? Olunye ulwazi lungatholakala kwi-GEMS website, noma ungaxhumana nethimba le-GEMS ngocingo noma nge-imeyili. Bazosiza ngazo zonke izidingo zakho ezihlobene nomhlomuli wakho. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zihloko, sithola ukuqonda okujulile ngesimo somhlomuli somlingani noma oshade naye kwi-GEMS. Kubalulekile ukuba amalungu aqonde izinqubo, izinzuzo, nezimfuneko ukuze bakwazi ukujabulela izinsiza ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kumalungu ayo, futhi ukuqonda kahle isimo somhlomuli kubalulekile ekufezeni le njongo.
UMkhandlu weMthonjaneni, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 156 seMthethosisekelo, 1996 (Umthetho 108 ka-1996, ofundwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 11 nesigaba 98 soMthetho Wamasistimu Omkhandlu, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000), ofundwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 6A(1) soMthetho Wamabhizinisi, 1991 (Umthetho No. 71 ka-1991), wenze lezi zinhlinzeko ezilandelayo. "Uhlelo lokukhokha" lisho umyalelo wecala wokuthatha imali ethile emholweni wekhasimende. Imigomo esetshenziswe kulokhu izohlanganisa abantu, izinkampani, nezinhlelo, kanti ubulili buzohlanganisa bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa, futhi ubumbano buzobhekisela kokubili okukodwa nokubili. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, amanzi, nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa kumakhasimende, wonke amakhasimende kufanele angene esivumelwaneni noMkhandlu lapho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ikhasimende livuma ukuthi uhlelo lokukhokha kukagesi namanzi lungasetshenziswa ukuqoqa izimali ezikhokhwayo mayelana nezinsiza. Uma ikhasimende lingangeni esivumelwaneni noMkhandlu, amanzi nogesi angaphazanyiswa noma apheliswe ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile, njengoba kudingeka, kuze kube isivumelwano sokuhlinzekwa kwensiza singangenwa futhi imali efanele ikhokhwe. Lokhu ikhasimende kuzodingeka kukhokhe imali ethile. UMkhandlu uzokhokhisa abantu abahlala kule ndawo, kanye nabanikazi bezindawo nabahlala kulezi zindawo, imithwalo kanye nezinsizakalo zomkhandlu ezihlinzekwa nguMkhandlu ngezikhathi ezithile noma njengoba kunqunywa umthetho. Umenzi wezindawo kufanele akhokhe ukukhipha udoti nezinsizakalo zezingqimba. Ikhasimende ngalinye kufanele libe nokufinyelela kumakhasimende ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina olukhulunywe kwi-akhawunti. Noma yisiphi ushintsho lwesikhala luzothatha umthelela kuphela ngemva kokuthi isaziso sokushintsha samukelwe nguMkhandlu. Amakhasimende kufanele akhokhe, ngokuphelele, imali ebiliwe ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nalolu hlaka kuzoholela ekutheni kube nokuhlawuliswa okukhokhwayo kumakhasimende, futhi inzalo njengoba kunqunywa nguMkhandlu izokhokhwa ngemuva kosuku lokukhokha noma lapho kungekho imali ethile, njengoba kunqunywa umthetho, kusukela ngosuku okwakufanele ikhokhwe. Izimali zokubolekwa zizokwenziwa nguMphathi Wezezimali, ezizokwenziwa kokubili njengengxenye nangokuphelele kwi-akhawunti yenyanga yezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa endaweni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi iyimali ethile noma inani elibaliwe. Ekutheni imali yokubolekwa echazwe esigabeni 4(1), uMphathi Wezezimali uzohlukanisa phakathi kwezindawo ezizokhokhwa ngezinga lezinsiza ezihlukene nezinga lokusetshenziswa. UMsizi Wezezimali angaphinde abuyekeze izimali zokubolekwa zamakhasimende ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemuva kosuku lokubolekwa kokuqala, futhi angacela ngenxa yokubuyekezwa inani elengeziwe ngaphezu kwemali yokubolekwa kumakhasimende. UMsizi Wezezimali kufanele abuyekeze zonke izimali zokubolekwa njalo eminyakeni emibili noma uma izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa kumakhasimende ziphelisiwe noma zaphazanyiswa ngenxa yokungakhokhi. Umphumela walolu buyekezo uzokhulumelwa ikhasimende uma kukhona ushintsho emalini yokubolekwa futhi ezinye izivumelwano ezidingekayo zenziwa. Uma imali yokubolekwa ethintwa esigabeni 4(2) noma 4(3) itholakala inganele, ikhasimende linelungelo lokungena esivumelwaneni sokukhokha le mali eyengeziwe noMsizi Wezezimali. Izimali zokubolekwa zamakhasimende zezo zonke izinsizakalo ezibiliwe kufanele zikhokhwe. Izimali zokubolekwa kufanele zikhokhwe mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kukagesi namanzi kuphela. Izimali zokubolekwa kufanele zikhokhwe ngempahla noma ngekhadi. UMkhandlu uzokwamukela iziqinisekiso zebhange lapho imali yokubolekwa idlula izinkulungwane ezimbili rand (R2000.00). Iziqinisekiso zebhange kufanele zithunyelwe mathupha phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ehhovisi likaMsizi Wezezimali eCivic Centre. Zonke izimali zokubolekwa kufanele zikhokhwe okungenani ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi kokuhlala endaweni noma ngosuku lapho izinsizakalo zidingeka, uma zingadingeki ngosuku lokuqala lokuhlala. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nalolu hlelo lungaphazamisa ukuxhumana kwezinsizakalo, futhi uMkhandlu ngeke abe nesibopho nganoma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zenzeke. Akukho mali yokubolekwa edingekayo uma imitha ikhokhwa ngaphambi kokuhlinzekwa kwensiza ethile. Lapho izinhlobo ezintsha zemithombo kagesi namanzi zifakwa kumakhasimende akhona, la makhasimende kufanele angene esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe noMkhandlu sokukhokha izimali zokubolekwa phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha. Imali yokuxhumana izokhokhwa uma amakhasimende ahlinzekwa ngeminye imisebenzi yomkhandlu nganoma iyiphi indlela futhi labo abakhona ohlwini lwabakhokhi bezikweletu mayelana nalezi zinsizakalo futhi baphazanyiswa kukagesi namanzi. UMkhandlu, ngokuthanda kwawo, uzothumela izaziso nezinye izikhumbuzo kumakhasimende athola izikweletu ngaphambi kokuphazanyiswa kwezinsizakalo. UMkhandlu uzokhipha isicelo sokukhokha izimali ezikhokhwayo mayelana nazo zonke izikhwama ezikhombisa izimali ezikhokhwayo ezedlule ezinsukwini ezingama-30 (30), emva kwalokho i-akhawunti izothunyelwa kumakhompiyutha wezikhwama, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 10, ngaphezu kokuphazanyiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwensiza. UMkhandlu uzophazanyiswa kwezinsizakalo kumakhasimende anemithombo kagesi emisha mayelana neziqeshana ezikhokhwayo ezedlule ngemuva kosuku lokugcina lokukhokha. Uma la makhasimende efuna ukuxhumana kukagesi, azokhokhwa imali efanele yokuxhumana futhi insiza ngeke ibuyiselwe kuze kube i-akhawunti ikhokhwe ngokuphelele noma isivumelwano esanelisayo senziwa noMsizi Wezezimali ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7. UMkhandlu kufanele uphazamise ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi ngaphambi kwaleso sikhathi sokuqala (13:00) ngosuku lokuphazanyiswa. Ukuxhumana kuzokwenziwa ngokushesha, kodwa kuzokwenziwa kuphela phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Lapho izinsizakalo ziphazanyiswa ezindaweni eziningi, uMkhandlu akabopheleka ukuqala ukuxhumana ngesikhathi esifanayo. UMkhandlu akabopheleka ukuthengisa ugesi kumakhasimende anemitha ezikhokhwayo ngaphambi kokuthi basebenzise ngaphandle kokuthi i-akhawunti yomkhandlu yezinye izinsizakalo nemithwalo yendawo, uma kusebenza, ikhokhwe ngokuphelele noma isivumelwano esanelisayo senziwe noMsizi Wezezimali ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7 salolu hlelo, futhi sigcinwa. Zonke izinsiza zamamitha kagesi eziphazanyisiwe kufanele zibe nezimpawu ezicacile uma insiza iphazanyiswa ngenxa yokungakhokhi, ukuze kugwenywe ukuthi lezi zinsiza eziphazanyisiwe zibikwe njengokungasebenzi. IFIFA World Cup: Iphrofayela Yomhlaba Wokuncintisana IFIFA World Cup, eyaziwa nangokuthi iMidlalo Yomhlaba, iyisiganeko esikhulu emhlabeni wonke sokuncintisana kwezemidlalo, esihlanganisa amaqembu aphesheya kwezilwandle. Le midlalo ibanjwa njalo eminyakeni emine, futhi ibonisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhle, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana phakathi kwamazwe. Iqala ngonyaka we-1930, lapho i-Uruguay yaba yisizinda sokuqala sokubamba le midlalo, futhi kusukela lapho, iFIFA World Cup ibalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo. Ukwakhiwa kweFIFA World Cup kuhlobene kakhulu nomlando weFIFA, inhlangano ebhekelele umhlaba wonke wezemidlalo. Ngonyaka we-1904, iFIFA yasungulwa eParis, futhi umgomo wayo wukukhuthaza umdlalo wombhoxo emhlabeni jikelele. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokukhula, kwavela umqondo wokubamba umncintiswano omkhulu, okwaholela ekubeni neFIFA World Cup. I-FIFA World Cup ibalulekile hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokuncintisana, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Le midlalo ibonisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwamazwe, futhi ibonisa ukuthi umdlalo ungahlanganisa abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Njengoba amaqembu ahlukaniswe ngamasiko, izilimi, nezinkolelo, umoya wokubambisana ubonakala kakhulu ngesikhathi semidlalo. Ngonyaka we-1930, i-Uruguay yathola ithuba lokubamba umqhudelwano wokuqala, futhi yaphumelela, yaziwa njengomqedazwe wokuqala. Lokhu kwakuyisikhathi esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula umnyango wokuncintisana okukhulu emhlabeni. Kusukela lapho, iFIFA World Cup ibanjwa ezindaweni ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi iBrazil, iJalimane, i-Italy, ne-England, phakathi kwezinye. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umdlalo wombhoxo ungabamba abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha izwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup yathuthukiswa, yathola ubuchwepheshe obusha, futhi yakhula yaba yinsakavukela. Izinkanyezi zomhlaba, ezifana noPelé, Diego Maradona, Zinedine Zidane, noLionel Messi, zaba yizithonjana zomhlaba, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu emidlalweni. Lezi zinkanyezi zikhuthaza abanye abadlali, futhi zenza umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo. Ngaphezu kokuncintisana, iFIFA World Cup ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezindawo ezibamba umqhudelwano. Izindawo eziningi zikhulisa izinsiza zazo, zenza izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo zokuhlala, izokuthutha, nezokwakha. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kuqinisa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umqhudelwano udala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izigidi zabantu ziqhuba izinkanyezi zazo, zikhumbula izikhathi ezinhle. I-FIFA World Cup ibuye ibe yinsakavukela yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zomhlaba. Njengoba amaqembu edlala, izinkanyezi zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, futhi zenza umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, njengoba abantu behlangana ukuze baphokophele izinjongo ezifanayo. Umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela umdlalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup ibonisa ukuthi umdlalo wombhoxo ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha izwe, futhi ungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Le midlalo ibalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo, futhi ibonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungabambisana ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo ezifanayo. I-FIFA World Cup iyisibonelo sokuthi umdlalo ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha, futhi ungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFIFA World Cup izoqhubeka nokukhula, ibonise ubuchwepheshe obusha, futhi ihlale ibalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo. Umoya wokuncintisana, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomuzwa wokuhlanganyela kuzohlala kuhlonishwa, futhi iFIFA World Cup izoba yinsakavukela yokuhlonipha umhlaba wonke. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu, futhi kuhlale kukhumbuza ukuthi umdlalo ungaba yindlela yokuhlonipha, futhi ungahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene.
Izinsizakalo Zokwesekwa Kwabantu Abakhubazekile: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Namuhla, abantu abakhubazekile babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa izinsizakalo zokwesekwa zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Lezi zinsizakalo zenzelwe ukusiza lezi zinsizwa ukuba ziphile impilo egculisayo, zenza izinqumo ezibalulekile, futhi zithole amathuba afanele. Kulesi sihloko, sizoxoxa ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izinzuzo zazo, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona. Izinsizakalo Ezitholakalayo Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zihlukaniswe ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, sinezinsizakalo zokwelashwa, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Lezi zinsizakalo zisiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ukuze bakwazi ukuzimela. Okwesibili, sinezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Lezi zinsizakalo zifaka ukuqeqeshwa kwemisebenzi, ukusiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuthola imisebenzi, kanye nokubasiza ukuba bahlale emsebenzini. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba imisebenzi inika abantu abakhubazekile ithuba lokuzimela, ukwakha ukuzethemba, nokuthola imali yokuphila. Okwesithathu, kunezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, ezihlanganisa izinsizakalo zokuhumusha, ezisiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba baxhumane nabanye. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuveza imicabango yabo, izidingo, nezifiso zabo. Izinzuzo Zezinsizakalo Zokwesekwa Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zinezici eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zikhuthaza ukuzimela. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, abantu abakhubazekile bangathola amathuba okuphila impilo egculisayo, okwakha ukuzethemba nokuzimela. Okwesibili, lezi zinsizakalo zikhuthaza ukufakwa emphakathini. Ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezithuthukisa amakhono, abantu abakhubazekile bangakwazi ukujoyina imiphakathi yabo, benze ubungane, futhi bathuthukise izimpilo zabo, okwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Okwesithathu, izinsizakalo zokwesekwa zikhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo zokwelashwa, abantu abakhubazekile bangathola ukwelashwa okudingekayo, okusiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zempilo ezivamile. Izinkinga Ezikhona Noma izinsizakalo zokwesekwa zinezinzuzo eziningi, zikhona nezinselelo. Okokuqala, zikhona izindleko eziphezulu. Abantu abakhubazekile bavame ukubhekana nezindleko eziphezulu zokwelashwa, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, okungaholela ekutheni abanye bangakwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinsizakalo. Okwesibili, kunezinkinga zokufinyelela. Ezinye izinsizakalo zingase zingatholakali ezindaweni ezithile, okuvimbela abantu abakhubazekile ukuthi bathole usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kalula. Okwesithathu, kunezinkinga zokwazi. Abantu abaningi basazithola bephazamisekile mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okudinga izinhlelo zokukhuthaza ulwazi ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo. Isiphetho Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Zihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana, okwenza kube lula kubantu abakhubazekile ukuba baphile impilo egculisayo. Nokho, izinkinga ezikhona, ezifana nezindleko eziphezulu, ukufinyelela, kanye nezinkinga zokwazi, zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kwalesi sizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsizakalo zokwesekwa, ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, enothando, futhi egculisayo.
Isahluko 1: Ukuvuka Komhlaba Ekuqaleni, kwathi uma usuku luphuma, izulu ladlula kuphiko lwendabuko. Ezindaweni ezihlahleni ezinkulu, abalimisi babezama ukuhlomula emhlabeni, bezama ukuthola umvuzo ophusile. Kodwa-ke, phakathi kwabo kwakukhona ukuguquka. Ama-drone amancane athumele umoya opholile ezindaweni ezikude, akhuluma ngezinto eziningi ezimangalisayo. UThandi, umnumnzane wendawo, wayengakaze abone lokhu. Wayezwa izindaba ezikhuluma ngalezi zinto ezindizayo, kodwa wakhulelwa emhlabeni ophakathi kwembiza yesintu. Waqhubeka nokucabanga: “Kwamanje, amadrone angabe akhuluma ngezinsiza ezilungile?” Isahluko 2: Ubuciko Be-Drone Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wahamba phansi enyameni yakhe, nomoya unothe nogu eliphakeme. Wabhekisa phezulu, lapho ama-drone amaningi ehamba emazulwini, efana nezinyoni ezilukhuni. Ngisho nenkanyezi enkulu, uMbhobho, wayehamba nayo; eqeda ukuhamba okukhulu, ngahamba izinsuku eziningi. Kanye phakathi kwjava, umngani kaThandi, uJabulani, wavula izinyembezi nezincwadi zabantu abahamba phambili kulo mkhakha. "UThandi, umhlaba ushintsha! Lawa ma-drone asinika ithuba lokumbonisa izinto ezinhle zokuqhamuka!" uJabulani akhomba. Wayenokuzimisela, ethanda ukuba ngumqondisi wesikhathi esizayo. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlangabezana Nezinselele Thandi waffle noJabulani bezamile ukufaka ama-drone ezosombulula izinselele zomphakathi. Kwakuyaqhuma izikhala zomhlaba, kodwa uthando lwabo lokufunda lwabe lungapheli. Kodwa izinto zaba nzima. Abanye abantu bendawo babenokungabi nankinga. “Ama-drone azoletha ukuchitha izinsiza. Ngabe sizopholisa imvelo?” babebala izinkinga zabo. UThandi wayefuna ukwazisa ukuthi angaziwa, umoya omusha ubhalwa ngama-drone, eyaqoka ubuchwepheshe bokuhlola nemifino. Isahluko 4: Uhambo Lokuzakhela Ngemuva kwesikhathi, unogada wezinsiza zendawo, uNokuthula, wahlela umkhosi wokwazisa abathandi bendawo mayelana namathuba ama-drone. UThandi noJabulani babebambe iqhaza, benasa ukuthi bangakha ukuthula emphakathini. Uhlelo lwabo lwase lwenziwa yitze ukudala lo mkhosi, kungezwe abathengisi abavela kude. Kwakuwumcimbi omkhulu, kudliswa izinkanyezi, ama-drones edlula phezulu. Kwavulwa iziphepho zenkanyezi, abazali bebafundisa izingane ngezinto zomhlaba ezingezona ezemali. Isahluko 5: Uhambo Lokukhanya Ngesikhathi umkhosi uqala, uThandi wabona ama-drone engaphansi kwansuku zonke, esephiphiza zonke izindawo. “Ngabe lokhu kuhlangene nathi, sivelile?” uJabulani wabuza. UThandi wayezithokozisa, eqonda umbono omusha. Kwaphela ubumnyama emathanjeni, uMbhobho wakhanya, uqhakazile emzini, ekhombisa isibhakabhaka esisha. Ngapha, emakhaya, abantu babebona impela ukuthi ama-drone ayengaphansi okwelakani, ewela phezulu. Isahluko 6: Ukuphila Ngobuchwepheshe UThandi noJabulani, ngemva kokubona izibani zikaMbhobho, bakhumbula ukuthi konke lokhu kuwukuhamba kwesikhathi. Indoda ethokozisayo yokuthuthukisa umhlaba yayigqoke isiqophi. Ama-drone ayenikela ngezinhlanhla ezinhle, futhi umphakathi wahamba phambili. Phakathi kwezinkanyezi, babefuna ukukhipha iziyaluyalu, oJabulani wathi, “Ama-drone akusisiza kanjani, saholeka? Babangazathusi.” “Ukwazisa kuphela!” uThandi wavele wamthanda, “Uhlonze ukwenza ukufunda okukulethe phakade.” Isahluko 7: Umhlaba Omusha Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokusebenza, umphakathi wabona izinzuzo, ugqozi lwawuthatha. UThandi noJabulani bahamba phambili, basondela ezindabeni. Izihloko zikaThandi zakhombisa ikamva elihle, lapho ama-drone ahlinzeka khona ngempumelelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNokuthula waphakamisa igama elisha, "UbuMphakathi beTue Technology!" Ngemuva kokukhuluma, izinyoni zabuya nezinja, zihambela phezulu. Umoya wagcwala yize bekufana nezinyoni, umqhudelana waze wabhakabhaka. UThandi waphumula udonga lwakhe, elindele ukusho into ethakazelisayo. "Kuthiwani uma singawuvula umhlaba, sihlangane nezinga lethu?" Ngamafuphi, ama-drone awathathwa nje, kodwa waba yithuba lokuphila, ukuzakha umphakathi, kanye nokukhula ezingeni elisha. Umhlaba ugcwele ithemba, umoya opholile, okuyilokho eyikhumbulayo uThandi.
Umbiko Ngemountain Everest Isingeniso IMount Everest, eyaziwa ngokuthi iSagarmatha eNepal kanye neChomolungma eTibet, iyinsika eyinhloko yokuphila kwemvelo, iyona ntaba ephakeme kunazo zonke emhlabeni. Le ntaba ibhalwe emlandweni njengento ephakeme kakhulu, inezinga elingu-8,848.86 m ngaphezulu kwezinga lolwandle. Itholakala eningizimu yeHimalaya, iMount Everest iyindawo yokuthokozisa, yokuhlola, kanye nokuhlola, futhi ibamba izinkumbulo eziningi zabantu abavela kuwo wonke umhlaba. Umlando weMount Everest IGama leMount Everest livela kuSir George Everest, umphakathi waseBrithani owawuphatha iNepal ngasekuqaleni kwekhulu le-19. Ukuze kuhlonishwe lo mphakathi, igama lakhe lathathwa ngo-1865. Nokho, izithakazelo zentaba ziqala ngaphambi kokuba ibizwe ngalesi sikhathi, njengoba le ntaba ibiyingxenye yeHimalaya iminyaka eyizinkulungwane. Abantu bamaSherpa, abahlala eduze kwayo, babephila ngaphansi kwale ntaba isikhathi eside, bazi kahle ngendawo futhi benza izindlela zokuhamba ezihamba phezulu. Izimo Zemvelo IMount Everest ibonakala ngezimo eziyingozi, ezihlanganisa umoya opholile, izinga lokushisa eliphansi, nezimo zomhlaba ezinzima. Lezi zimo zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi abavakashi bahlala bephokophele phezulu ukuze bafinyelele phezulu. Ukuze bakwazi ukukhuphuka, abavakashi kufanele bazi kahle izimo zomoya, izimo zokwakheka, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nokukhuphuka. Izinsiza Zokukhuphuka Kunezindlela eziningi zokukhuphuka iMount Everest, kodwa izindlela ezivame kakhulu zifaka iSouth Col Route kanye neNorth Ridge Route. Lezi zindlela zidinga ukulungiselela kahle, futhi abaqeqeshi abavela ezinkampanini ezihloniphekile banikeza usizo oludingekayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabakhuphukayo, abaqeqeshi, kanye nezinye izinsiza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabo bonke abahamba. Izingozi Nezithiyo Noma iMount Everest ibonakala iyindawo ephakeme, inezingozi eziningi ezihambisana nokukhuphuka. Izimo zomoya ezinzima, izikhukhula, kanye nezimo zokushisa eziphansi zingaba yingozi. Abakhuphukayo bahlala bephakathi kwezingozi ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa ukushoda komoya, ukushisa okukhulu, nokuhlaselwa yizimo zeqhwa. Ukuze baphumelele, kudingeka ukuthi bazi kahle izingozi futhi baqonde izinqumo ezibalulekile. Izinsiza Zokuhlola Izinsiza zokuhlola iMount Everest zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabakhuphukayo. Abahamba badinga izinsiza ezifanele, njengezicathulo ezikhethekile, izingubo zokuvikela, nemishini yokuhlola. Uhlanga lwezobuchwepheshe lukhula njalo, futhi izinsiza zokuhlola ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthuka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhuphukayo bahlala bephila. Umthelela Kwezokuthengisa Nokuvakasha IMount Everest ibalulekile emnothweni wezokuvakasha eNepal. Ukuvakashelwa kwale ntaba kuholela ekukhuleni komnotho, futhi abantu abaningi bathola amathuba emisebenzi ngenxa yokuvakasha. Nokho, lokhu kuholela nakwezinkinga ezithile, njengezinkinga zokungcoliswa kwemvelo, ukwehla kwezimali zemvelo, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu bendabuko. Isiphetho IMount Everest iyinsika yokuphila, ibhadi lezemvelo elihamba phambili emhlabeni. Noma izimo zayo zingaba nzima, abavakashi bahlala bephokophele phezulu ukuze bafinyelele phezulu. Ukukhuphuka iMount Everest kudinga ukulungiselela, ulwazi, kanye nesineke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela wezokuvakasha ungathinta izimpilo zabantu bendabuko, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukugcina le ntaba ibalulekile, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bayo. IMount Everest iyinsika yokuphila, ibhadi elikhumbulekayo, futhi kufanele sibe nomthwalo wokuyigcina iphilile.
Umlando Wezisebenzi Zasezimayini Umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini ungumfanekiso obalulekile wezomnotho, wezokusebenza, kanye nezokuthula ezindaweni eziningi emhlabeni. Izimayini zaba yinsiza enkulu ekwakheni umnotho, kanti izisebenzi ezisebenza kulezi zindawo zaba yisisekelo sokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho. Le ngxoxo ibheka umqondo wezisebenzi zasezimayini kuzo zonke izigaba zayo, kusukela ekuqaleni kokwakhiwa kwezimayini kuze kube yisikhathi samanje. Ekuqaleni, izimayini zazivame ukuba yizindawo zokumba amafutha, insimbi, namagugu emvelo, kuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izisebenzi zazivame ukuba yizinkampani ezincane, zisebenza ngezandla, futhi zenza imisebenzi enzima ngokwenyama. Ngaleso sikhathi, imisebenzi yasezimayini yayihambisana nezimo ezinzima, ezifana nokuphila emakhaya aphansi, imithetho yokusebenza, kanye nezimo ezinzima. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe yokuqala, kwavela ukwanda kokwakhiwa kwezinkampani ezinkulu, ezahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Izisebenzi zathola amathuba okufunda nemfundo, okwakwandisa amathuba okukhula komsebenzi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni imisebenzi ibe nezinjongo eziphakeme, lapho bezikhuthaza ukuba zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze zithole imiphumela engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izisebenzi zasezimayini zathola izinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezinsiza zokuphepha nezempilo, okwakukhuthaza ukukhula komphakathi. Nokho, umphakathi wezisebenzi zasezimayini ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa izimo zokuphepha, izimo zempilo, nezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kwaholela ekuguqulweni kwemithetho nemigomo yokusebenza. Izinkampani zaba nezinhlelo zokuphepha nezokwelashwa ukuze ziqinisekise impilo yezisebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izisebenzi zathola ukufaneleka emkhakheni wezokusebenza, okwakha ubudlelwano obuhlukahlukene phakathi kwazo nezinkampani. Izisebenzi zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umnotho, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza nezokugqugquzela. Ukuze kube nezinguquko eziphumelelayo, izinkampani zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ezihlinzeka ngempilo nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Ngokuphetha, umlando wezisebenzi zasezimayini ugcizelela ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nomphakathi, futhi izisebenzi ziphatha indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho. Ukusebenza kwemigomo nezindlela zokuphepha zidinga ukuqhubeka zikhula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili komphakathi, kanti izingxoxo eziphumelelayo phakathi kwezinkampani, izisebenzi, nemiphakathi zibalulekile ekuqhubekeni kokwakhiwa komphakathi ophumelelayo.
Izivakashi ezikwiwadi ye-maternity zizovunyelwa ukungena kusukela ngo-09H00 - 10H00, emva kwalokho zizongena ngesikhathi esithile sokuvakasha. Izivakashi ezikwiwadi ezibuhlungu kakhulu zizovunyelwa ukungena kusukela ngo-09H00 kuze kube ngu-08H00 ebusuku, kodwa isikhathi abazokwazi ukusihlala sizokwenziwa ngabasebenzi bewadi. Izivakashi ezikwiwadi ye-tuberculosis kanye nalabo abanezingqondo eziphukile zizongena ngesikhathi esishiwo phambilini sokuvakasha. Abathengisi abavunyelwe emhlabeni wesibhedlela. Zonke izikhungo zik government zikhulunywe njengendawo lapho izivakashi zingavakashela khona, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bendawo bahloniphe le mthetho. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha azivunyelwe ukuvakashela esibhedlela. IMISEBENZI YEBHIZINISI. Isibhedlela sinezinqubomgomo nemigomo elawula ukumaketha nokuqasha abasebenzi. Izikhala ezitholakalayo zikhangiswa ezincwadini zendawo nezasezweni, kuye ngendawo yomsebenzi evulekile. Bonke abathanda umsebenzi kumele bathumele izicelo zabo endaweni eyinhloko. NB. Zonke izicelo kumele zithunyelwe ngeposi njengoba kuchaziwe kokukhangiswa. Izicelo ezithunyelwe ngesandla azizokwenziwa. Labo abahlongozwayo bazomenywa ezivivinyweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abahlangabezana nezidingo ezidingekayo bayaqashwa. IBHODI YESIBHEDLA. Laba ngamalungu omphakathi abekwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Baphatha njengoxhumana phakathi kwesibhedlela nomphakathi. Bacebisa ukuphathwa kwesibhedlela ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi kanye nezidingo ezingase zibe usizo emphakathini njengoba bephethe isibhedlela. Baphinde balethe ulwazi mayelana nesibhedlela, besebenzisa izakhiwo zomphakathi, futhi bejolise kulwazi abaluqoqayo kuziphathimandla zesibhedlela; njengoba ibhodi iyisakhiwo esisemthethweni esixhumana nokuphathwa kwesibhedlela. Uma umphakathi udinga ukucaciselwa ngezindaba ezithile ezithinta isibhedlela, leli yisakhiwo esiqondile esizokwenza izincazelo njengoba sithola iningi lolwazi lwethu emihlanganweni eyenziwa njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu nabaphathi besibhedlela... Baphinde bahlangabezane nezidingo zempilo ngaphansi kwemigomo yephalamende neyesifunda, beqhakambisa ukubambisana kwezempilo nomphakathi. Qeqesha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi. Thuthukisa, uthuthukise izinga lethu, futhi uhlaziye njalo. Qinisekisa indawo ephephile kubo bonke. Igumbi lokuhlola nokweluleka kulabo abahamba ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV. Igumbi labanye amadoda. Igumbi lokugcina igazi. Omunye wemigomo nezinhlelo zomnyango wezempilo ukubring izinsiza zempilo zibe seduze nemiphakathi. Lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi uhulumeni aqeqeshe odokotela abenza emakhlinikini, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha nokuxazulula izinkinga zempilo ezilethwa abantu emakhlinikini; ikakhulukazi njengoba inqubo yamanje ibalula ukuthi umuntu kumele aqale aye emkhlinikini ngaphambi kokuthi aye esibhedlela. Umdokotela emkhlinikini nguye ozothumela umuntu esibhedlela uma ebona ukuthi udinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Ikhasimende likhumbuza ukuthi lidinga ukuhambisa incwadi yokuthunyelwa evela emkhlinikini ethumele ukuba iye esibhedlela. Izimo eziphuthumayo azifakiwe kulolu hlelo; ngaphandle kwalokho, umphakathi kumele usebenzise emakhlinikini njengoba eduze futhi insizakalo iyamahhala. Izincwadi zokuthunyelwa uma uya esibhedlela 2..1. Abathola umhlalaphansi. Labo abangenamsebenzi kodwa baye basebenza ngaphambili kumele baphathe iphasipoti kanye nebhukwana eliluhlaza. Labo abangenamsebenzi futhi bengenayo ibhukwana eliluhlaza kumele baphathe amaphasi bese besayina i-affidavit ehhovisi lababhalisi noma emaphoyiseni ukuze bathole usizo. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha kumele ziphathe amakhadi ezinqubomgomo. Uma usufika esibhedlela.
Umbikweni Ngobuhlakani Bokwenziwa EZwe lanamuhla, sithokozisa umcimbi okhethekile obuhlanganisa izinkanyezi zothando nezobuchwepheshe, okungukuthi, umbono wethu ngozimele bokwenziwa. Lo mcimbi, owenzelwe ukwakha ukuhlakanipha kokukhula, ubhekiswe kokubili kulabo abathanda ubuchwepheshe nezifundo ezithinta umhlaba wokwenziwa, kanye nabantu abajabulela ukuziphilisa emhlabeni wokwakheka kwemvelo. Sihlangene lapha namuhla, ezikhungweni ezihloniphekayo, ezilawulwayo ngothando nofaka ukucabanga okujule ngezinto eziqhamukayo emhlabeni wethu. Ukudla ubuhlakani bokwenziwa kuzakha izindlela eziningi zokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono, kudala amathuba amasha, futhi kwandise indlela esiphila ngayo. Umcimbi wethu usetshenziselwa ukwazisa, ukufundisa, nokukholisa kulabo abanamakhono ahluke kodwa bakhathazekile ngalokhu kuguquguquka. Uhlanga lwethu lwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa lukhula ngesivinini esikhulu, lube yinsika ekubeni izingxenye ezahlukene zempilo yomuntu zisebenze kahle. Uhlanga luthinta ing ngemigudu emisha yokukhiqiza, ukuthuthukisa ezoktransportation, ukufundisa, kanye nezokuxhumana. Kulolu hambo, iziphakamiso zethu kanye noshintsho lwezobuchwepheshe luhamba phambili ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo eziyisebenzi kahle. Umcimbi wethu uqukethe abakhiqizi, ochwepheshe, kanye nabathandi bebhizinisi ababelokhu becabanga ngezindlela ezihlukene zokuveza ubuhlakani bokwenziwa emikhakheni ephephile. Ngesikhathi sithokozisa le ndaba, sizoba nezingxoxo ezinobuchule ezizocacisa izinzuzo nezingozi zalesi sikhala. Izingxoxo zizoparticipant ngalendlela yokufundisa, ukuqonda ubuhlakani bokwenziwa, kanye nokuhlola izinzuzo ezithile ezilotshwe kumaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene. Singacabanga ngalokhu kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezithile zokwandisa ulwazi lwethu. Abakhuluma kuzodingeka ukuba baxhumane nezifundo zakamuva ezigciniwe, bahlolisise izinhlelo ezihambisana nesimo, #okukhona, nezinhlelo ezisebenza ngempumelelo. Lo mcimbi uzobhekelela izinhlelo ezingezenzo zocwaningo, okufaka phakathi namafomu ezikhalazo. Umhlaba ube nezigigaba zalesi sikhala, kodwa izindlela zethu zokuxhumana ngemva kokukhuluma ngebhubesi lethu, kuncane kakhulu kwabanye. Izifundo zethu zikhumbuza abantu bonke ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa yinkomfa evulekile, nemigudu evulekile yokufunda, lokho kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla oboshelwa ngumoya wokuxazulula. Siyazi bona ukwakheka kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kumele kuthathwe ngesineke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, singenza kahle uma sithokozisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ngokulandela izimiso zokuhlonipha. Ukubaluleka kokuhlukana kwezinkambo emhlabeni wethu ofisayo ukuqhubeka ngokuveza izinyathelo eziphezulu kakhulu. Nokho, siyaphinda sibheke ukuthi kudinga uhlinzeko oluqhamukayo, okukhona, kanye nemihla yonke yokushintshela. Ngemva kokuphothula izingxoxo, sizoba nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezihambisanayo. Uhlanga lwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa luhlupheka uma izinkanyezi zekhono zizama ukuhamba nomgudu, lokhu kuyindida engafaneleka. Sifuna ukuhlola amandla obuhlakani bokwenziwa, sinesaba sokuthi singenza impilo yethu ibe mhle nangaphezulu, kepha kumele sihlale sinobuhlakani bokwazi ngaphandle kokuphinda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobamba inhlangano yokubambelela ezinhliziyweni zethu, sigqugquzela kakhudlwana ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ngokuhlanganyela. Lo mcimbi uzoyiHlala kube yimpumelelo, wagcoba amatshe! Imininingwane yokuqhubeka nalesi sikhala izojabula, futhi ibhande retngqe umphakathi jikelele. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa akuyona kuphela into ethokozisayo, kodwa ukudinga uhlelo, ukucabanga, nokuhlakanipha okuhlanganisiwe. Siqonda ukuthi umcimbi wethu uyaphumelela, kuhle ukwenziwa okubalulekile. Ngakho-ke, sizokwenza okufanele ukhumbule izinkanyezi zabo bonke abahlanganyeli nabathandi bokuhamba, salindele umfenyana nobuhlakani bokwenziwa esikhathini esizayo!
Enhlanganweni enkulu, kungenzeka ukuthi abasebenzi bahlangabezane nezinkinga zomuntu siqu ngezikhathi ezithile, okungathinta kabi ukusebenza kwabo nokuphila kwabo kahle. Le ngqikithi yokubuza ihloselwe ukuhlaziya izidingo zabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezamanzi (DWAF) nokuthola izindlela zokubhekana nalezi zidingo. Le ngqikithi yokubuza iyimfihlo. Ikhethwe ngendlela evulekile futhi engakhethi njengengxenye ye-10% yabasebenzi bonke beMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, ePhondweni Elisenyakatho. Awudingi ukufaka igama lakho kule ngqikithi yokubuza. Inhloso yethu ukuqoqa imibono nemicabango evela esampulini yabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, mayelana nezidingo zabo, hhayi ukukhomba izinkinga zomuntu siqu. Ucelwa ukuthi ufunde imibuzo ngokucophelela bese uphonsa ibhokisi elingezansi komphumela ocabanga ukuthi ufanele kakhulu kuwe. Ukhuthazwa ukuba uzame ukuphendula yonke imibuzo. Ngiyabonga ngokubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Sithemba ukuthi imiphumela nemiphumela izoba usizo kuwe nakwabanye ozakwethu emsebenzini. Uneminyaka emingaki? Ungumfana noma ungumfazi? Yini isimo sakho somshado? Qaphela: "Ushadile" kufaka phakathi umshado wesintu, wesonto, kanye nomshado wombuso. Yini ulimi lwakho lwasekhaya? Yini izinga lakho lokusebenza? Sicela uphonsa okukodwa. Ususebenze isikhathi esingakanani eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF? Yini izinga eliphezulu lemfundo olitholile? Uma kunjalo, sicela ubhale igama le-fund yokusiza kwezempilo. Okwamanje, uma wena noma ilunga lomndeni ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, kukhona yini umuntu noma usizo phakathi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungakufaka lezi zinkinga? Akekho; ngizixazulula mina. Uthanda ukuya emhlanganweni wokufunda mayelana nanoma yiziphi zalezi zihloko? Ungaphonsa ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali noma ukubhajethi, izikweletu, njll. Ukudlulisela emnyangweni omunye, ukulahleka komsebenzi, noma ukuhamba emsebenzini. I-HIV/AIDS, ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, njll. Angifuni ukuya kunoma yiziphi zalezi zifundo. Ucabanga ukuthi kungaba ngcono ukuba uthole izeluleko ezivela kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe beMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, noma kulabo abaqashwe okwamanje, abazimele, futhi basendaweni eziseduze nalapho usebenza khona? Abasebenzi be-DWAF noma beMnyangweni Wezamanzi. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kungathuthukisa kanjani impilo yabantu eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, uma bethola izeluleko ngezinkinga zabo ezizokhokhelwa yi-DWAF? (Lokhu kubhekisela kuhlobo lwezeluleko olukhethwe kuMbuzo 12 ngenhla). Yisiphi ulimi noma izilimi ozikhethayo ukuthi zisetshenziswe uma uthola izeluleko (Ungaphonsa ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo)? Uma iMnyango Wezamanzi, DWAF, inganikeza izeluleko zomuntu siqu ezimfihlo (usebenzisa uhlobo lwezeluleko olwakhethile), ubani ozosisebenzisa le sevisi? Amalunga omndeni wakho. Angizukuyisebenzisa nhlobo. Uma iMnyango Wezamanzi, DWAF, inenombolo yocingo etholakala ngaso sonke isikhathi, engadingi umuntu ukuba aveze igama lakhe, ukuze isetshenziswe abantu uma bezizwa bengaphilile, ubani ozosisebenzisa le sevisi? Amalunga omndeni wakho. Angizukuyisebenzisa nhlobo. Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga yezempilo noma ukhathele (hhayi i-HIV/AIDS noma i-AIDS)? Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga nomkakho, umlingani, noma omunye obalulekile? Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga nezingane zakho? Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga nezinye izinkinga zomndeni? Uthola kangaki ukuthi uzwa umzimba wakho ungenamandla noma ukhathele? Uthola kangaki ukuthi uzwa ukhathazekile ngokuba ne-HIV noma i-AIDS uqobo? Uthanda ulwazi mayelana ne-HIV/AIDS ephathelene nanoma yiziphi zalezi zihloko? Ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okukhona kwabantu abane-HIV noma i-AIDS. Ukuphila impilo ephelele uma unayo i-HIV noma umphumela ophumelelayo. Ukuphila nolwazi lwemiphumela ephumelelayo ekhombisa ukuthi unayo i-HIV. I-stigma yemiphumela ephumelelayo kulabo abaseduze kwakho, abangane, nomndeni. Isithunzi sakho emsebenzini namalungelo akho njengomsebenzi one-HIV. Angidingi ulwazi nganoma yiziphi zalezi zihloko. Uthola ukhathazekile ngokuqedwa kwemisebenzi? Kungenzeka yini ukuba ukhathazeke ngokulahleka komsebenzi? Unenkinga ngotshwala noma ngezidakamizwa ezihlobene ngqo nawe noma nelunga lomndeni eliseduze? Unenkinga zomthetho? Unenkinga zezimali noma zezimali? Uke waba yisigameko sokuhlukumezeka? Kungenzeka yini ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi uzwe ungaphansi noma ukhathele ngenxa yomsebenzi ngenxa yezizathu ezilandelayo (Ungakhetha ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo)? Ukukhathazeka ngokuqokwa noma ukwesaba ukuphepha komsebenzi ngokulandela umthetho we-Employment Equity Act. Imali, ukuqokwa, noma izinkinga ezihlobene nohlelo oluphatha ukuhlolwa kwendawo yokusebenza. Uzwa kanjani uma udluliselwa kwenye indawo (Isibonelo, eMnyangweni, eBhodi Lezamanzi, noma eMnyangweni Wokuphathwa Kwamanzi)? Ingabe kukhona omunye umbono noma isiphakamiso ofuna ukusho mayelana nosizo olungadingeka ngabantu baseMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF? Ngiyabonga ngokuphothula le ngqikithi yokubuza. Ukubamba iqhaza kwakho kuyabongwa kakhulu! 290 1245 -Ngesikhathi sokusebenza.
Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV Licence ye-SABC Isingeniso Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC (South African Broadcasting Corporation) kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nhlangano iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthokozisa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, kunezimpikiswano eziningi ezibhekene nale ndaba. Lezi zimpikiswano zifaka phakathi izinzuzo, ubungozi, nemiphumela yokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Umqondo we-TV Licence Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-TV licence iyini. I-TV licence iyimali ekhokhwa yibo bonke abanikazi bama-TV ukuze bathole ukufinyelela kumabonakude we-SABC. Le mali isiza ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokubuka, izindaba, nezinhlelo zokufundisa. Isinyathelo 2: Izizathu Zokuxhasa I-TV Licence 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimali: I-TV licence iyisizinda esibalulekile sokwakha imali engenayo ye-SABC. Le mali isiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezikhona, ukwakha izinhlelo ezintsha, nokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumabonakude. 2. Ukwaneliseka Kwab viewers: Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluhle nolwanelisayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izilaleli zihlala zikhumbula i-SABC. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. 3. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni: I-SABC iyisikhungo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa izimboni zendawo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi, ukweseka abaculi bendawo, kanye nokukhuthaza ubuciko. Isinyathelo 3: Izinkinga Nezimpikiswano Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC. 1. Ukungaboni Ngasolinye: Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwe-TV licence akufanele kube umthetho. Bakholelwa ukuthi abantu kufanele bakhethe uma befuna ukukhokha noma cha, futhi abanye bakhuluma ngokuthi izinhlelo ze-SABC azihambisani nezifiso zabo. 2. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Kukhona ukukhathazeka mayelana nokuphathwa kwezimali ye-SABC. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi imali ethathwa nge-TV licence ayisetshenziswanga kahle, futhi kunezinkinga eziningi zokuphathwa kwezimali ezikhona. 3. Ukwanda Kwezinketho: Ngokuvamile, abantu bahlala benokukhetha okuningi kwezokuxhumana, okwenza kube nzima ukuba i-SABC igcine izilaleli zayo. Ukukhula kwezinkampani ezizimele nezokuxhumana kwenza kube nzima ukuba i-SABC ikwazi ukuheha izilaleli. Isinyathelo 4: Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuthuthukisa 1. Ukwenza Ngcono Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Kubalulekile ukuthi i-SABC ithuthukise ukuphathwa kwayo kwezimali. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusebenzisa imali ethola nge-TV licence, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi lisebenza kahle. 2. Ukukhuluma Nezithameli: I-SABC kufanele ibambisane nezithameli zayo ukuze iqonde izidingo zabo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwenziwa kwezifundo zocwaningo ukuze kuhlonishwe imicabango nezidingo zabantu. 3. Ukwanda Kwezinhlelo Zokuthokozisa: Ukuze i-SABC ikwazi ukuheha izilaleli, kufanele ikhulise imikhankaso yokuthokozisa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezithameli ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zentsha, ezokuthokozisa, nezokufundisa. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuxhumana Nezithameli Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nezithameli kubalulekile. I-SABC kufanele ikhulume ngokuqhubekayo nezithameli zayo, ibanike ithuba lokuphendula, nokubavumela ukuthi bazise ngemibono yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo futhi ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Isiphetho Izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC zikhombisa ukuthi le ndaba ibalulekile kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kunemiphumela eminingi, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi i-SABC ithuthukise izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi ihlinzeka ngohlelo oluhambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngokwenza lokhu, i-SABC izokwazi ukuheha izilaleli zayo, iqinise izinsizakalo zayo, futhi iqhubeke nokuba yinsika ebalulekile kwezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika.
Iphrofayela kaSipho Mthetho: Umphakathi Wezokuvakasha Ngesikhathi esihle eGoli, uSipho Mthetho ubonise ukuthi ungumuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuvakasha. Uhlanga lukaSipho lungumfanekiso wezinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela yakhe ehlanzekile ekwakhiweni kwesiko lethu. Wazalwa eThekwini, uSipho wakhulela endaweni enothile ngezothando, imisebenzi yezandla, nezimanga zemvelo. U-Sipho waqala ukuthanda umhlaba wezokuvakasha eneminyaka eminingi, lapho esencane evakashela izindawo ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika noMama wakhe, efunda ngamasiko ahlukahlukene. Wabeka amandla akhe ekuthandeni izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, amaphupho, nezifiso—konke lokhu kwaholela ekufundeni ngezakhamuzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uSipho waqala ukusebenza njengomholi wezihambi eDrakensberg, indawo ethokozisayo edumile phakathi kwabavakashi. U-Sipho waba umfundisi ophumelelayo, ebakhombisa izindawo ezinhle, imifula, nezindawo zomlando ezinomthelela. Kodwa uSipho akazange ayeke lapho; wahamba phambili ngokufunda ngezifundo ezengeziwe emkhakheni wezokuvakasha ukuze aqonde kangcono nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabavakashi nendawo abavakashela kuyo. Ngonyaka ka-2020, uSipho waqala ukuqasha abantu abancane ababehlela emhlabeni wezokuvakasha, wahlanganisa izinhlelo zokuvakasha eziphumelelayo ezihlanganisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi osebenzisanayo, futhi uSipho wanikela ngaphezu kuka-30% wemali engenayo emiphakathini yendawo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izinhlelo zezenhlalakahle zingakhula ngokuhlanganyela nezokuvakasha. U-Sipho uqhubekile nokukhuthaza umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabavakashi nabantu bendawo, ethuthukisa umqondo wesiko lokwamukela futhi efundisa abavakashi ukuze baqonde okukhona. Uthembisa ukuqhubeka nokukhanyisa izinkanyezi zabantu abaphumelelayo, eqhubeka nokwenza izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Njengoba esebenza emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, ubona ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onamandla. U-Sipho ungumholi wezimvo ezibukhali, unothile ngothando lwemvelo, njalo ethuthukisa umhlaba wakhe. U-Sipho Mthetho, osendaweni yokuphumula, usaqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe onobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, ugqugquzela abavakashi, ebavumela ukuba benze izinkumbulo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonakala enhliziyweni yeDrakensberg, uhlanganisa imizwa yephinde ahloniphe izinzuzo zomphakathi. U-Sipho usebenzela ukuphila okwenziwayo, okukhuthaza, futhi esekela abantu. Le ncazelo yezenzakalo zempilo ibonisa uSipho njengomfanekiso wempilo eshintshashintshayo, umthombo wezindaba ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, uSipho Mthetho ungumfana odume kakhulu emkhakheni wezokuvakasha, obalulekile, futhi onomusa, uhambo lwakhe luzogcina luhlaza, liphumelele, ngegama lakhe lizohamba phambili.
Umphumela walomthetho uzovivinywa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni wesifunda uzokwazi ukuqhubeka nenqubo yokulungisa eyayiqalwe ngonyaka ka-1994. Izinsizakalo ezibalulekile zikahulumeni azikafinyeleli ezingeni elilinganayo ekusetshenzisweni kwezinsiza, yingakho umgomo wonyaka wezezimali ka-1997/98 ukuqhubeka nokwethula izinhlelo ezizosusa le miphumela engalingani. Ukwamukelwa kwalomthetho kuzohlinzeka uhulumeni wesifunda ngovumelekile lokusebenzisa u-14 percent ngaphezulu kokwabiwa kwezezimali kuka-1996/97. Ukubaluleka kwemali eyengeziwe kuyabonakala ezindlekweni zezigaba ezintathu ezinkulu (Imfundo, Ezempilo, kanye Nezokwelashwa Komphakathi) ezithatha u-88.02 percent wokwabiwa okuphelele kwesifunda. Ibhajethi inama-voti angu-15 avela ku-16 wonyaka ka-1996/97 ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa kwavoti 1 (uMphathiswa) kanye nevoti 4 (Izinsizakalo Zenkampani) ukuze kwakhiwe ivoti elilodwa, Izinsizakalo Zenkampani. Ukwabiwa kwezokwelashwa komphakathi kukhuphukile ngama-R555 million (3.38%) kusuka ku-R1.788 billion kuya ku-R2.343 billion. Izinselelo ezibhekene naleli gumbi ngonyaka wezezimali ka-1997/98 zibalulekile. Le nkulu yokukhuphuka kwebhajethi ihloselwe ukwenza izinsizakalo zokwelashwa komphakathi zifinyeleleke kumiphakathi engakaze ifinyelele kuzo. Lokhu kuzoba ukuqala kwenqubo yokulungisa ezokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukungalingani kwezezimali kwemali kahulumeni ehlinzekwa emphakathini kulingana kuzo zonke izinhlanga. Akukho mali ethile eyabiwe kulolu gumbi. Zonke izimali zokuthuthukisa isimo ezisetshenziswa ngaphansi kwayo zabiwe kwezinye izivoti, futhi ezinye izimali ezizobekwa kulolu gumbi phakathi konyaka nazo zizobekwa kwezinye izivoti.
Ukufika kuk governo elikhethwe ngentando yabantu kuletha imithetho eminingi emphakathini wethu, imithetho efana nelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi, ukuba negunya, nokuba ngum citizen. Ukuze lokhu kube nencazelo futhi ukuze uhulumeni wethu omusha okhethwe ngentando yabantu ukhule, ukufinyelela ulwazi kubalulekile. Ukufinyelela ulwazi kuyilungelo eliyisisekelo elivumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile futhi kubavumela ukuba bafinyelele ezinsizeni ezihlinzekwa ngabeziHulumeni. I-Department of Social Development inezibopho zokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu. Yingakho sidale futhi siqhubeke nokugcina i-manifesto, esebenza njengethuluzi lokukhuthaza ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yiDepartment. "Ukuthuthukisa ukuphela kobuphofu": kuyisihloko esibekwe nguMongameli Thabo Mbeki, kuyisithembiso sethu njenge-Department of Social Development futhi sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu akukwazi ukwenzeka ngaphandle kokuthi abantu babe nokufinyelela ulwazi esizimisele ukusihlinzeka ngakho ngokuqinile. Inhloso yethu ukuthi le manifesto ifinyeleleke kuzo zonke izigaba ezihlelwe ngohlanga, ubuzwe, nolimi ngokusebenzisa zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye kuhlanganise ne-braille nezinye izinhlobo zokuxhumana ukuze kubhekwe zonke izinhlobo zokukhubazeka. Nokho, le manifesto izoshicilelwa kuqala ngesiZulu, isiSetswana, isiTshivenda, nesiSepedi. Sithemba ukuthi ukushicilelwa kwesibili kuzohlanganisa nezinye izilimi kuze kube zonke izingxenye zomphakathi zimele kahle. Ngiyethemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula kini i-manifesto ka-2002/2003 ye-Department of Social Development, ezokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezinsizakalo esihlinzekayo. Ngiyethemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula le manifesto kini - abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yale manifesto ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekile ukufinyelela kalula kolwazi olugcinwe yi-Department of Social Development ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho emthethweni, ikakhulukazi isigaba 32, esithi "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguHulumeni." Le manifesto yakhiwe ngokuhambisana neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, (Umthetho No.-2 ka-2000). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele zivumela ukufinyelela okufanayo ezinsizeni, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinsizakalo zomphakathi okuyilungelo lenu lokuthola. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uzothola le manifesto iyasiza futhi iyazisa. I-National Department of Social Development - Umthetho No. 3 Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi. Imininingwane ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 seMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, No. I-Department of Social Development inezibopho zokuthuthukisa imigomo kazwelonke nemithetho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwazwelonke nezindinganiso, ukweseka umsebenzi oqhubekayo kwi-Provincial Departments of Social Development, ukuqaphela nokuhlola izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinqubo zokuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo ehambisana nesithembiso semiphakathi ehlukene ehlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emphakathini okuyisibopho esikhaleni seziHulumeni zendawo. Ukubuyisela ubuntu bokukhathalela nokuthuthukisa abantu kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha kabusha imindeni nemiphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa amasu aqondile ukuze kuphumelelwe ukunciphisa ubuphofu obuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithile kulabo abadinga usizo, ngokususelwa emandleni nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokuphepha komphakathi oluyinhloko oluhlanganisa imizamo yokuhlinzeka nokungahlinzeki ngoxhaso nokuphakamisa imindeni ethintwe kakhulu. Ukubhekana nemiphumela yezenzo zokuhlukumeza ezihlasela abesifazane nezingane, kanye namasu okuphatha abahlaseli. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuthanda nokukhathalela abantu abaphila ne-HIV/AIDS noma i-AIDS uqobo kanye nalabo abathintekayo, njengabantu abangenamakhaya be-AIDS. Ukuthuthukisa isu lesizwe lokunciphisa ubugebengu bezinsizwa nokungasebenzi ngaphansi kweNational Framework for Crime Prevention. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ufinyeleleke futhi utholakale kubantu abaphila ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ezindaweni ezikude nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulingana ekufinyeleleni usizo. Ukusekela umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ngokuzibophezela ekubambeni uhulumeni okuhlanganisa umsebenzi wezinhlelo ezahlukene zabeziHulumeni nemiphakathi. Ukuqeqesha, ukufundisa, ukuhlela kabusha, nokuhlinzeka ngabasebenzi abasha. I-Department of Social Development igcina imibhalo enezihloko ezahlukene. Wonke ulwazi oluhambelana nokwembulwa luhlelwa ngohlelo lwezinhlaka njengoba kuchaziwe etafuleni elingezansi. Imibhalo ihlelwa ngendlela yethebula. Ezinye imibhalo ithunyelwa ezinhlelweni ezithile, kanti ezinye zisezingeni eliphezulu, kanti ezinye ziseNhliziyweni. "Imibhalo" ithunyelwa ezinsizakalweni ezahlukene, ngokwesibonelo. Imibhalo egxile noma ethathwe kumarekhodi, imibhalo egcinwe ezinsizeni zezimali noma kumabhroshuru wokukhangisa kwamakhompyutha. Uhlelo: Njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla embhalweni, kube nezinguquko ohlelweni lwezinhlaka. Ucelwa ukuthi uxhumane noJaco Victor ukuze uthole incazelo mayelana nezinguquko zakamuva ezizokwenziwa ngokucacile nangokufanele ngezansi. Imibhalo yocwaningo eshicilelwe enezibalo zabantu nezindaba zokuthuthukiswa, ezikhiqizwe yi-HSRC, MRC, DBSA, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, njll. Le mibhalo egcinwe ihlelwa ngalezi zigaba ezilandelayo, ngokwesibonelo: ezomthetho, ezimali, ezokuphatha, izindaba zomsebenzi, nezinye. Imihlangano Imizuzu, njll. Imibhalo yokuphatha, imibhalo egcinwe ezindaweni, njll. Ukuze ucele ulwazi, gcwalisa ifomu elihlanganiswe neFomu-C bese ulithumela kumuntu ohambisana naye kwi-Department of Social Development. Umfanekiso wesicelo nenqubo yokulandela lapho uthumela khona ukukhala ulandela iFomu-C. Qaphela: Isifinyezo "S" kulesi sithombe sikhuluma ngesigaba esihlobene neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi. Umfakisicelo ofuna ukufinyelela kumibhalo egcinwe equkethe ulwazi lomuntu ngaye akadingeki ukukhokha leyo sicelo. Noma ubani omunye ofaka isicelo solwazi olungahlangene naye kufanele akhokhe imali yesicelo efanele ukuze kuhlolwe ukukhokha, bheka iGovernment Notice R. 187 kuGovernment Gazette etholakala ngomhla ka-15 kuMashi 2002. Ukuze unikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unegunya lokufaka isicelo, uma ufaka isicelo egameni lomunye umuntu. Uma umfakisicelo engazi indawo noma incazelo ethile yombhalo oceliwe, umemukelwa ukuthi axhumane noMphathi: Information Management, ozosiza ekutholeni umbhalo ofanele. B. Imininingwane yabantu abafaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumibhalo egcinwe a Imininingwane yomuntu ofaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumibhalo egcinwe kufanele ihlinzekwe ngezansi. b Ikheli nenombolo yocingo eNingizimu Afrika lapho ulwazi olunikeziwe kufanele luthunyelwe khona. c Uma kudingeka, faka ubufakazi bokug
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya: Isikhathi Sokuguqulwa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya sekube yinto ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ntambama, uma ubheka ezindlini ezisemaphethelweni edolobha nasemaphandleni, uzothola ukuthi ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezilungiswayo zisebenzisa ugesi okuwumkhiqizo osunguliwe okwandisa impilo yomphakathi. Kwakuyisikhathi sikaMnu. Nkosi, owayehola umphakathi wamakhosikazi nabantu abadala abahlala emakhaya eNingizimu Afrika. Waba umgibeli wenguquko, ephakamisela iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa ukutholakala kukagesi. Umcimbi ophawulekayo wawubanjelwe endaweni yokuqhumisa ugesi, kwahlanganiswa abantu abaningi bephakamisa izinkumbulo ezinesiphepho. Kowathokozisa abaningi, kwavulwa amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo evulekile. Ubuchwepheshe be-akhawunti yokukhanyisa baphenduka insiza ebalulekile. Ugesi waba yinkanyezi yokukhanyisa izindlu, ukugcina izinga lokushisa, nokwenza ukuba umndeni uphumelele emsebenzini. Lokhu kwavuselela ukujula kokufunda, kube yisipho sokuphila kwabafundi ngoba Befunde kahle emakhaya, ngenxa yokutholakala kukagesi. Kwakukhona okukhuluma ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zomphakathi, izinkampani zemvelo, kanye nohulumeni. Ukufaka izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zamandla avuselelekayo, kuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka kukagesi, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela kukagesi ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Lezi zinhlelo zathuthukisa impilo yabantu abaninzi, zabelana ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwenzeke izikhumbuzo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuqhakambisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza eziningi ezifanele zamandla, ezifana ne-solar panels. Lokhu kuthatha amanyathelo amasha empilo yokudala, kudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha, futhi kuqinisekisa impilo engcono yezizukulwane ezizayo. Abantu babekwazi ukuzitholela ugesi ngenkathi belandela izinyathelo ezilungile zokuphila kahle, befunda kabanzi ngalezi zinsiza, okwakungabavusi kuphela kodwa kuhleleka komphakathi bonke. Kwakukhona ithimba elahluleka ukufaka izakhamizi emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe nabadali bemisebenzi yokukhanyisa. Indlela ababephila ngayo yasebenzisa amathuba, balindele ukuthi ugesi uzokwakha izinsiza ezithuthukisayo kumakhaya abawahlupheke ngazo. Njengoba umbhali ophakathi kwezothando wobuchwepheshe ebesezimpilweni zabo, umcimbi wagcwala abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bethokozisa kahle isakhiwo semiphakathi. Fake ukufaka uhulumeni emkhakheni wezomnotho, waqala ukwazisa abantu abaningi ngebhizinisi elivuleleke ngokuphepha. Imicimbi yokwazisa isebenzela ukusiza abantu ukuthi bazi kahle izithiyo ezikhona mayelana nokutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kwakwenza abantu baphile kahle, kabona ukuthi nesikhathi sokukhuluma nokuqonda kungenziwa ngezinsiza eziku-inthanethi. Ngenxa yokufunda, izici ezithinta impilo zabantu zamukelekile, zashintsha ekukhulumeni ngempumelelo. Kwavela izincwadi zokuqondisa ezithinta izinhlelo zokuthola amandla, zashiya abantu benolwazi oluningi lokwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Ukuze impilo ende iqhubeke, abezindaba baqhamuka nezindaba ezilungile, behlikihla izixazululo ezidingekayo ukuze kutholakale ugesi endaweni. Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kuletha ushintsho olukhulu oluthinta zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Lokhu kuyavusaithemba, kwenze abantu bazi ukuthi khona uma bezithokozisa ngezinsiza ezihamba phambili. Nakuba izinkinga zingeke ziqedwe ngokushesha, umcimbi wanyathelwa umbono ophakeme. Lesi sikhathi sokutholakala kukagesi emakhaya siphakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu ezizayo, siphinde sibonise amandla okuhuqula impilo. Ngaphandle kwalesi sikhathi sokuqwashisa, abantu banikela ngokuhlanganyela ukufaka iziphakamiso ezithuthukisayo ezithinta izikhungo ezidinga lokuhlala ziphilile. Ngokuziqhenya, abantu bayavuma lokhu, bekhuluma ngezinselelo ezithinta abahlali emakhaya. Izigidi zabantu zicebile ngemithombo yokuphila enguqukayo, zibona ukuthi izinkanyezi zifika kanjani zikhangisa igcwele kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akuwona nje umcabango, kodwa kudinga ukuba fierce. Kungashintsha izigigaba zomphakathi, kulethe umcebo wemfundo nezinsiza ezizolubha uthando nomphakathi. Uma sizoya phambili, ngokuqinisekile imiphakathi izothokozisa eminyakeni ezayo, kupata amandla angokomlando, kube neziphakamiso zempilo ezunguza izithunzela ezintsha, sizofeza imiphumela emihle ekutholakaleni kukagesi emakhaya.
Abaholi bendabuko banamandla okwenza izinqumo zomthetho kanye nezinqumo zokuphatha. Kubalulekile ukuqonda umehluko phakathi kwalezi zisebenzi ngoba imithetho elawula lezi zisebenzi ihluke. Izinqumo zomthetho zenzeka lapho umholi wendabuko ebizwa ukuze axazulule ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi noma ukuze abhekane nezikhalazo ezenziwa yilungu lomphakathi elilodwa ngokumelene nelinye. Uma amalungu amabili omphakathi ecabanga ukuthi banelungelo lokuvumela izinkomo zabo ukuba zidle endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko ubizwa ukuze acacise ukuthi ubani phakathi kwabo onelungelo lokusebenzisa le ndawo. Lezi zinqumo zomthetho ngoba inhloso yazo ukuhlela ukungaboni ngaso linye. Uma ilungu lomphakathi likhalaza elinye ngokweba izinkukhu zalo futhi le ndaba ilethwa kumholi wendabuko, kusho ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe isinqumo somthetho. Uma ilungu lomphakathi lithumela isicelo kumholi wendabuko sokuthola indawo yokudla izinkomo zakhona noma ilungelo lokwakha indlu yakhona endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko uzokwenza isinqumo sokuphatha mayelana nokuthi leli lungu kufanele linikezwe imvume. Ukwenza izinqumo zokuphatha kulawulwa isigaba 33 seMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha, 2000. Ngokusho kwale mthetho, zonke izinqumo noma izenzo zokuphatha ezenziwa umholi wendabuko kumele zihambisane nomthetho, zibe neqiniso, futhi zilandele inqubo efanele. Umholi wendabuko owenza isinqumo sokuphatha noma othatha isenzo sokuphatha kufanele, uma eceliwe, anikeze izizathu zaleso sinqumo noma isenzo kubo bonke abathintekayo. Uma umholi wendabuko enqaba ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zizathu, umceli angafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze baphoqelelwe ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zizathu. Uma izizathu zinikezwa futhi iqembu elithintekayo likholelwa ukuthi azilungile futhi azilandeli inqubo efanele nephephile, leli qembu elithintekayo kufanele lifake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi leso sinqumo sibuye sibuyehlulelwe. Umthetho ophathelene nokwenza izinqumo zokuphatha uvela emthethweni ojwayelekile, kodwa manje usuphakanyiswa umthetho ophathelene Nokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha. Ikhophi ye- booklet ebizwa ngokuthi 'Umhlahlandlela Osebenzayo Wokuphatha Ubulungiswa' izonikezwa bonke abakhona kulolu cwaningo. Le booklet inikeza uhlaka lwezinyathelo ezihilelekile ekwenzeni izinqumo zokuphatha, kanti isinyathelo sokuqala siwukucabangela isizathu esenza umuntu anikezwe amandla okwenza isinqumo noma ukuthatha isenzo. Lapho abaholi bendabuko benza izinqumo zomthetho, kumele bahambisane neMthethosisekelo, imithetho ejwayelekile ephathelene nokwenza izinqumo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izimo zokuthuthukiswa komthetho. Iningi lezi zihloko ezizoxoxwa kulolu cwaningo zizohambisana nokwenza izinqumo zomthetho. Izinqumo zomthetho kumele zenziwe uma isicelo senziwe noma uma izinqumo zihlolwa.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi 1. Isingeniso Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo futhi ophephile. Le dokhumenti ibonisa indlela ezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi okufanele zisebenze ngayo, zifaka izinyathelo ezidingekayo nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze umphakathi uthole imiphumela emihle ezinkundleni zokuphepha, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo baqonde imithetho nezindlela ezisemthethweni ezithinta lezi zinkundla. 2. Uhlaka lomsebenzi wezinkundla zokuphepha Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zifaka amaphoyisa, izinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo, izikhungo zokwelashwa, kanye neminyango yokuphatha. Ukuze zikhulise imiphumela, kumele kube nohlu lwezicwangciso ezihlukene: - Ukuxhumana: Ukuze kube nokuhlangenwe nakho kolwazi phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi kudlulelwe imininingwane mayelana nezingozi, izigameko, nezimo eziphuthumayo. - Ukuhlolwa kwezingozi: Izinkundla zokuphepha kufanele ziqhube ukuhlolwa okuvamile kwezingozi ukuze kubonakale izindawo ezidinga ukugxilwa. - Ukuqeqeshwa: Abasebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, ukuvikela, kanye nezinye izindlela zokuphendula, ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi. 3. Ukuhlela Izinkundla Zokuphepha Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle kwezinkundla zokuphepha, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle imisebenzi: - Ukumisa izinqubo ezicacile: Kumele kube nokuhlela okuhambisanayo kwezinkundla zokuphepha, okuhlanganisa izinqubo ezicacile zokuthi okufanele kwenziwe ezingozini ezithile. - Ukufuna nokubamba izithangami: Izithangami zibalulekile ekwabeleni ulwazi emiphakathini, ukuze wonke umuntu azi ngemithetho nemigomo. 4. Ukusebenza Ngokubambisana Kubhalwe ukuthi izinkundla zokuphepha kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana nezinye izikhungo ezizimele ezifana nezikhungo zomphakathi, izifunda nezikole. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amazinga omphakathi abamba iqhaza ekwakheni indawo ephephile. - Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zomphakathi: Izinkundla zokuphepha kufanele zikhuthaze uxhumano nemiphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela imihlangano, imicimbi, nezinhlelo zokufundisa. - Izinhlelo Zokuthumela Ubufakazi Boukuphumelela: Kubalulekile ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphepha ukuze kunqandwe izinkinga. 5. Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Izinkundla Zokuphepha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, izinkundla zokuphepha kumele zihlolwe futhi zibuyekezwe ngezikhathi ezithile: - Izibalo Zokuphepha: Ukuqoqwa kwezibalo zokuphepha kusiza ekutholeni izindawo ezidinga ukunaka. - Ukuhlola Imiphumela: Uhlolojikelele lwemiphumela yezenzo kufanele lwenziwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha. 6. Izinsizakalo Zokuphuthumayo Izinsiza zokuphuthumayo zibalulekile ukuze ziphendule ezimeni eziphuthumayo: - Ithimba Lokuphendula Eziphuthumayo: Ithimba eliqeqeshiwe kumele liqondise izimo eziphuthumayo ngempumelelo. - Izinsiza Zokuphila Nezokwelapha: Kubalulekile ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zifakwe ezinkundleni zokuphepha ukuze zibhekele izingozi. 7. Ukuphetha Ngamafuphi, ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kudinga ukubambisana, ukuhlela kahle, nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Imiyalelo ethile kufanele ilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka komphakathi. Ukuze kuqhubeke kahle, izinkundla zokuphepha kumele zihlolwe futhi zibuyekezwe njalo, ukuze zihlale zikhathalela izidingo zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kwezinkundla zokuphepha kumphakathi kuncike enhlosweni yokudlulisela umphakathi osekela, ophumelelayo, nezinhlelo ezisunguliwe phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuqhubekela phambili, umphakathi uzokwazi ukuphuma ezinkingeni futhi ube yindawo ephephile, ezinokuthula nemibono emisha.
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho okungakwenziwa ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, kukhona nezifo ezivela endleleni esiphila ngayo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, singathola lezi zifo. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isandleni sakho. Ngakho-ke, nakekela wena. Kumele sithathe ukunakekela thina. Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lidla utshwala kakhulu kunabantu kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni. Abantu abaningi baphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye baphuza kakhulu kanti abanye baphuza njalo. Lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi. Abanye abantu bayakhishwa emsebenzini ngenxa yokuzinikela kwabo kutshwala. Abanye bathi bangaba nodlame uma bephuzile futhi balwe namalungu omndeni, abangane, nabangane. Kwabanye, utshwala bungaba yingozi, futhi ukuqhubeka kuphuzile kungaholela ekufeni. Kungcono ukungaphuzi utshwala nhlobo ngoba contains ama-toxins ayingozi angaphazamisa impilo yakho. Ukuphuza utshwala kungaba nemiphumela emibi emndenini wakho. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile uma ungumuntu ophuzayo, uphuze ngokucophelela. Funda le bhukwana ukuze ufunde ukuthi ungaphuza kanjani ngokucophelela. Bheka uDudu, lezi zinsizwa seziqalile ukufuna utshwala olusele emshadweni wansuku ezedlule. Pic. UBongi uthatha zonke izinsimbi anazo ukuze athenge utshwala ngenkathi umndeni wakhe uthola ubuhlungu ngoba lelo mali kufanele ibisetshenziswe ukuthenga ukudla nezimpahla nokukhokhela izikole zezingane. Uyazi sengilahlekelwe ukuhlonipha yena. Pic. Kungenzeka ukuthi udla utshwala kakhulu. Kulokhu engikubona, kungenzeka adinge usizo esikhundleni sokugxekwa. Pic. Inkinga yokuphuza kakhulu iyinkinga evamile eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sifunde futhi sifundise izingane zethu ukuthi utshwala buhlupha kanjani imizimba nemiqondo yethu. Kumele sikwazi ukujwayela ukuphuza kwethu futhi sifunde ukuphuzela ngokucophelela. Pic. Empeleni, uBongi ubukeka njengomuntu ogulayo futhi uvame ukuvela engaphansi. Uyazi abantu benza iphutha lokucabanga ukuthi utshwala benza umuntu ajabule, kodwa empeleni, kukwenza uzizwe ungakhululeki ngemuva kwesikhathi futhi kungaholela ekukhathazekeni okukhulu emqondweni wakho. (Pic. 5). Abantu abafana noBongi banenkinga yokuphuza kakhulu, inkinga abangayilawulwa futhi badinga ukufuna usizo ngokushesha, ngaphandle kwalokho utshwala luzobabulala. (Pic. 6). Ngiyabonga, kukhona izinhlangano ezisize abantu abaningi ngezinkinga zokuphuza, zibasiza ukuthi babuyele empilweni ejwayelekile. (Pic. 7). Ngakho umndeni nozakwabo kaBongi kumele bazame ukufuna usizo olufana nalolu ukuze basindise impilo yakhe futhi baphinde bamphinde abe uyise onesibopho. (Pic. 7). UBongi, woza, masikuthathe ekhaya. (Pic. 8). INingizimu Afrika kumele ibhekane ngokuphuthumayo nalesi simo sokuphuza utshwala, mhlawumbe ulwazi lokuphuza kufanele lungethulwa ezikoleni futhi. (Pic. 8). Igama lami nguDudu. Sizokhuluma ngokuphuza utshwala. Ukuze sikusize wenze isinqumo sokuthi utshwala luhle noma lubi, ake sixoxe ngemiphumela yalo kumuntu. Utshwala lungaphazamisa kakhulu impilo yakho. Ukuphuza kakhulu isikhathi eside kungalimaza umzimba wakho futhi kungenzeka ungabuyeli esimweni sokuqala. Ukudla okunganele: Kukhona ukudla okuncane okutholakala kutshwala. Ngakho, ukuphuza utshwala kakhulu kungakwenza ungadli. Lokhu kudala ukuthi ube negciwane futhi uzizwe ungenamandla. Ukuhluleka kwengqondo: Utshwala lwenza ubuchopho buphazamiseke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, utshwala lungaphazamisa ukusebenza kwengqondo yakho. Izifo zenhliziyo: Ukuphuza kungakwenza inhliziyo yakho isebenze kanzima futhi ungase ube nezifo zenhliziyo. Umhlola: Utshwala lungadala umhlola emlonyeni. Ukulimala kwezinso: Uma uphuza njalo, kungadala ukulimala kwezinso. Utshwala lungalimaza futhi i-pancreas uma unegciwane. Ukuhluleka kokwakha: I-organ yesilisa ayisebenzi kahle futhi ubunzima bokufinyelela ekwakheni. Izenzakalo eziningi zokuhlukumeza nokuhlukumeza zenzeka ngoba abantu baphuza kakhulu. Abantu abakwazi ukuzilawula uma bephuza. Ezimweni eziningi zokushayisana kwemoto eziholela ekufeni, kuvame ukutholakala ukuthi abashayeli abaningi baphuze ngaphezu komkhawulo onemvume wabashayeli. Iningi labagibeli abafa ezimeni zengozi baphuze. Ukufa nokugula okubangelwa utshwala kubiza uhulumeni imali eningi minyaka yonke. Le mali ingasetshenziselwa ukufundisa, impilo, nezindlu. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo ezihlukene zinezingxenye ezihlukene zoshukela. Ungakhetha ukuthi iyiphi ofuna ukuyiphuzela phakathi kwalokhu. Akufanele uphuze noma yini ungazi ukuthi ingakanani utshwala obukhona. Lokhu kungaba yingozi kakhulu! Ukuphuza nje ukuze ujabule nokweqa umkhawulo wezinyanga ezimbili zoshukela nsuku zonke, ngenye indlela, akufanele kube yindlela yakho yokuphila ukuphuza ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa iziphuzo zakho. Phuza uhlobo olulodwa lutshwala ngesikhathi esisodwa futhi ungaphuzi ngaphambi kokushayela noma ukuhamba emgwaqweni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyodwa kuya kwezimbili: Ukhuluma kakhulu futhi awumemezi, umphumela wenhliziyo yakho uyanda. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu: Ukushayela kwakho kuba kubi kakhulu, awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungazizwa udinwa. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu: Ungase ungaboni kahle; uma ukhuluma, uyabhalisa; awukwazi ukwenza izinto ngokushesha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili: Awukwazi ukuhamba ngqo futhi kubonakala sengathi uyawa; ubona izinto kabili. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-15 kuya kwezingu-20: Uyakhipha kakhulu futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase ube phansi. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi akufanele uphuze kakhulu ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili. Izinyanga ezintathu zenza ushintsho ekuziphatheni kwakho futhi awuphumelelanga ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo. Ungakaze uphuze utshwala uma... Ungavumeli abantu bagcwalise iglasi yakho ngaphambi kokuyiqeda. Uzophela ungazi ukuthi uphuze kangakanani. Ungahlanganisi utshwala obuphuza. Phuza kancane. Ngaphambi kokuphuza iglasi elandelayo yotshwala, phuza iglasi yamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwehlisa izinga lakho lokuphuza. Qiniseka ukuthi udle ngaphambi kokuphuza. Ungaphuzi utshwala uma ungakudlanga okuthile. Ungashayi noma uhamba. Zama ukuthola indlela yokubuyela ekhaya. Ungavumeli muntu ukuthi akuphoqe ukuphuza uma ungafuni. Impilo yentsha ingashintsha ibe nezinkinga ngenxa yokuphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye bangase bathole abazali abathanda utshwala. Intsha ingase ibone ukuthi abanye babo baphuza. Lokhu akwakhi
Ngomhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu 2023, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wethule uhlelo olusha lokuqinisekisa lwezinsiza zezeMali ezitholakala ku-Home Affairs online. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinsiza ezahlukene, njengokufaka izicelo zezimvume zokuhlala, ama-ID, kanye nezincwadi zokuzalwa. Lokhu kubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezimali zomphakathi, kanye nokuphucula ukuphathwa kwezinsiza. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlose ukunciphisa izikhathi zokulinda ezijwayelekile ezihambisana nezinsiza zomphakathi. U-Mnu. Sipho Mthembu, okhulumela uMnyango wezamaNhlangano, uveze ukuthi uhlelo luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, eziphusile, futhi ezitholakala kalula kubantu bonke. "Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bonke, noma bahlala kuphi, bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza zethu ngokushesha," kusho uMnu. Mthembu. Abantu bangabhalisela izinsiza ezithile ku-inthanethi, bekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, nokukhokha izindleko ezihambisana nezicelo zabo. Lokhu kukhulisa ukuhlela izikhathi zokuvakasha ezidingekayo, okunciphisa izixakaxaka ezivamile emnyangweni. Abantu abaningi baphendule kahle kulolu hlelo, bekhombisa ukwaneliseka. U-Phumzile Nkosi, umfundi ophothule izifundo zakhe, uthe: "Ngiyathokoza kakhulu ngalolu hlelo. Ngaphambilini, kwakunzima ukuthola izinsiza, kodwa manje ngikwazi ukuzenza ngikhululekile ekhaya." Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo luphendula izidingo zomphakathi, futhi lwenza ukuphila kwabantu kube lula. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezikhona. Abanye baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa komsebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. U-Mr. Themba Dlamini, ongumsebenzi wezokuxhumana, uthe: "Kukhona abantu abangenayo imishini yokuxhuma ku-inthanethi, futhi lokhu kubaphazamisa. Uhlelo lwenziwe kahle, kodwa kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela." Ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga, uMnyango wezamaNhlangano uhlela ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops ezindaweni ezikude ukuze abantu bathole ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngalesi sikhathi sokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana zizokwenza abantu bazi ngalezi zinhlelo, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani. Uhlelo luzobe luhlinzeka ngesevisi yokuxhumana, lapho abantu bengabiza khona ukuze bathole usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abanakho ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi bangathola usizo oludingekayo ukuze baqhubeke nezicelo zabo. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yomphakathi. U-Mnu. Mthembu uthe, "Siyazi ukuthi izinsiza zethu zibalulekile empilweni yabantu, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sithuthukise lezi zinsiza." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMnyango uzophinde ube nezinqumo ezithile zokwenza uhlelo lube ngcono, kuhlanganise nokwandisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kwabantu abaningi, futhi kuqinise ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani. Uhlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online luhlinzeka ngenkundla yokufinyelela, futhi lwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokwenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuphetha, uhlelo lwe-Home Affairs online luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, eziphusile, futhi ezitholakala kalula kubantu. Nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile, uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kukhombisa isithombe esihle sokusebenza kohlelo lokuqinisekisa lwe-Home Affairs online, futhi kubonisa ukuthi uhulumeni uyazama ukwenza impilo yabantu ibe ngcono.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa (GEMS employment status verification) Umkhiqizo wezinsizakalo ze-GEMS, okuyinsizakalo yokuhlola isimo sokuqashwa, uyithuluzi elibalulekile kubantu abaningi abahlinzekwa ngezinsiza zezempilo. Le nqubo iyasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banezikhungo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole imishanguzo nezinsiza, kwaziwa ngokuthi kuyindlela yokuxhasa ukuhlinzekwa kwezempilo komphakathi. Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kuhloswe ukusiza ukuvimbela izinkinga zokungalungile, lapho abantu bezama ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane engalungile ukuze bathole izinzuzo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lesi simo, kubalulekile ukuthi abaqashi bagcine izikhumbuzo eziphelele nezibuyekeziwe mayelana nabasebenzi babo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo ziqhubeka nezinqubo eziqinisekisiwe zokuhlonza nokuqinisekisa ubungcweti babasebenzi bazo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuvikela umphakathi, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bahlonishwa futhi beqonda izinqubo ezidingekayo. Naphezu komsebenzi omuhle owenzekayo, kube nezinselelo ezithile ezivela kubasebenzi abathola izinsizakalo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kokuqinisekiswa kwezimali nezinsiza. Abanye baphawula ukuthi kunzima ukuthola izimpendulo ezifanele ezivela ezinkampanini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinsiza zabo zezempilo. Lokhu kubangela ukukhathazeka nokuwa kokuqonda kokuthi imishanguzo nezinsiza zidinga ukufinyelelwa, ngakho-ke kube nomthelela ekubhekaneni nezimo eziphuthumayo. I-GEMS ibamba umqondo wokuthi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabathengi nezinkampani. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obukhona, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza ngokushesha, kungaba isixazululo esihle sokubhekana nezinkinga zokuqinisekisa isimo sokuqashwa. Ngokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni. Ngokuphathelene nezinkampani ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, kubalulekile ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinqubo ezithile ezikhethekile ezisiza ekubhekaneni nezikhalazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda izidingo zomsebenzisi, ukuxhumana kahle kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma izinkampani ziqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko ezithile, kuzoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwenzeni kube sobala le nqubo yokuhlola isimo sokuqashwa. Umqondo oyinhloko ukuhlinzeka ngesikhungo lapho abantu bengathola khona izinsizakalo ezingcono nezisebenzayo. Kumele kube nezinsizakalo zokwesekwa eziqhubekayo, ukuze abantu bazi uma kunenkinga, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela emithonjeni yokuthi khona izinsiza ezingawathola. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba phakathi kwabathengi kanye nezinkampani ezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana okujwayelekile phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi kuzokwakha isimo esinengqondo, esihlanganisayo. Abasebenzi bazoba neqiniso lokuthi badaxhumene nezinkampani ezijabulisayo nesezingeni eliphezulu, kanti abaqashi bazoba nokuqonda okungcono kwezidingo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kuzovula amathuba okuphumelela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizosiza ekwenzeni kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuvikeleka kwezinsizakalo zezempilo akugcini nje ngokungena kumafayela okusebenza, kodwa futhi kuhlobene kakhulu nokuzimisela kwenkampani ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele. Le nqubo yokuhlola isimo sokuqashwa ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ikusasa elinempilo nelinengqondo kubo bonke abathintekayo.
