U-GEMS kufanele aqhubeke nokukhuthaza izinqubo ezilungile ezizovumela ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa ukuze kube nokwakha nokuphila kahle komphakathi. Ngabe le ndlela yokuqinisekisa isimo sokuqashwa iyokhokhela indlela ezinzima emiphumeleni engcono? Ngaphezu kwalokho, ingabe izinkampani zizokwazi ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhlola ukuze kube nesimo esiqinile phakathi komphakathi? Kubalulekile ukubona ukuthi imizamo yokwakha ubuqotho nekhwalithi ezinsizweni zezempilo ingase iqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukwethembana phakathi kwabahlinzeki nezinsiza, kudonse isithunzi esihle ngokwezimo ezinhle zempilo. Ngokuhlola yonke lezi zinto, sizoba nokuqonda okukhulu kokuthi izinsizakalo ze-GEMS zinqoba kanjani izinselelo emhlabeni wokuhlinzeka ngezempilo, futhi zikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphile ukuphila okukhulu, kwezinjongo eziphakeme, nempilo enhle.
Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni Isingeniso Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni sekuyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi njengoba izinkinga zokudla, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila zikhula. Izingadi zokudla, ezaziwa nangokuthi "izingadi zokudla ezisemadolobheni," zikhula ezindaweni eziphakeme zokuhlala, zifaka phakathi izindawo ezincane, izikhala zomphakathi, kanye nezindawo ezithile ezikhethekile. Lezi zingadi zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okusha, ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, kanye nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ukubaluleka kwezingadi zokudla Izingadi zokudla zinezinzuzo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuphila kahle, kanye nokwakha umphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokudla okusha, lezi zingadi zinciphisa ukuncika ekuthengeni ukudla okuvela ezitolo, okungabiza kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukudla okukhuliswa ezindaweni zokudla kudla izinsiza ezincane, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo kubalulekile, njengoba izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, njengoba abantu bejabulela ukudla okukhuliswa ngokwemvelo. Izifundo ezivela emadolobheni ahlukene Ukwanda kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akukhona nje kuphela emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa futhi kusezingeni eliphezulu emazweni ahlukene. E-United States, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingadi zokudla zikhula kakhulu ezindaweni eziphakeme zokuhlala, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ekudleni okuphila kahle, okukhuliswa ezindaweni zabo. E-United Kingdom, izinhlelo zokwakha izingadi zokudla zikhuthazwa nguhulumeni, njengoba kuhloswe ukuvuselela izindawo ezithile eziphila kahle. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izikhala zomphakathi ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi zinciphisa izinkinga zokudla. E-Afrika, ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Izinhlelo ezihlukene zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izingadi zokudla, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinkinga zokudla zikhula kakhulu e-Afrika, futhi izingadi zokudla zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izithiyo ezibhekene nokukhula kwezingadi zokudla Noma kunjalo, ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla akukhululekile ezitheni ezithile. Izithiyo eziningi zikhona, okuhlanganisa uk缺乏 indawo, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakusebenza. Ezinye izindawo zinezinkinga zokufinyelela emanzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuphila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezikhona zokwakha izingadi zokudla zihlala zincipha, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuba bakhe izingadi zabo. Ukwenza kube lula ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele zisebenzisane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokwakha izingadi zokudla, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nokwakha izingadi zokudla zibalulekile, njengoba lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokudla okuphila kahle. Noma kunjalo, izithiyo ezithile zikhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele zisebenzisane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bangenza izingadi zokudla. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, futhi sithuthukise impilo yabantu emadolobheni. Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izikhala ezinhle, kodwa futhi kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, obuthuthukisa impilo yabantu.
Imali yokwesekwa komphakathi iyimali edluliselwa kuhulumeni kubantu abangakwazi ukuzisekela. Ikhokhwa kubantu abampofu ukusiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo eziyisisekelo nokuxazulula izinto ezincane kodwa ezibalulekile zokuphila. Imali yokwesekwa komphakathi inikezwa ukweseka imigomo eyinhloko yeMnyango, okuyi ukuvuselela abampofu nokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu abadinga usizo. Uma ufaka isicelo sokwesekwa, isimo sezimali somfaki-sicelo kanye nalabo abahlangene nabo noma abathintekayo sihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lowo muntu uyafaneleka ukuthola usizo kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlolwa kwezimali." Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sokwesekwa akufanele ithathe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili kusukela ngesikhathi isicelo sithunyelwe. Qaphela: Imali yokwesekwa ikhokhwa kubamukeli njalo ngenyanga. Usizo lwezingane ezikhuliswa ngabazali abangabazali bazo ikhokhwa kulabo bazali mayelana nengane efakwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo ngokweMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983 (Umthetho No. 74 ka-1983). Umfaki-sicelo/ingane kumele abehlala eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Umyalelo wenkantolo kumele uthunyelwe ubonisa isimo sokunakekelwa kwabazali ngaphansi kokuthi ingane ifakwe. Ingane ethathwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabazali abangabazali bayo kumele ihlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlolwa kwezimali, okuyi R 12,720 ngonyaka. Sithumela ehhovisi lezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi eliseduze lapho umfaki-sicelo ehlala khona. Uma abafaki-sicelo bekhulile kakhulu noma bephilile kakhulu ukuze bafake isicelo ngokwabo ehhovisi, ilunga lomndeni kumele lifake isicelo ngabo. Ifomu lesicelo lizogcwaliswa phambi komphakathi. Uma ifomu lesicelo ligcwaliswe, umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa i-receipt. Le receipt kumele igcinwe - iyasiza njengobufakazi bokufaka isicelo. Akufanele kukhokhwe imali ukuze kufakwe isicelo. Uma isicelo esithunyelwe singavunywa yiHhovisi LezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi, umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswe ngokubhala ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kwesicelo. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokuphikisa ngokubhala kuNgqongqoshe WezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi esifundazweni sabo, echaza ukuthi kungani bengavumelani nesinqumo. Le mpikiswano kumele ithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa ngemiphumela yesicelo esithunyelwe. Uma imali yokwesekwa ivunywa, umfaki-sicelo uzokhokhwa kusukela ngosuku isicelo sathunyelwa. Umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswe ngokubhala ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kanye nenani losizo, kanye nelungelo labo lokuphikisa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa. Qaphela: Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukuhoxisa imali, umuntu ophathiswe ngokomthetho angabekwa ukuze ahoxise imali egameni lomfaki-sicelo. Isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwemali yokwesekwa kumele sithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokumiswa. Umfaki-sicelo akumele abe seRiphabhulikhi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Umfaki-sicelo kumele akhombise noma iyiphi imali ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kuzoba yisisekelo esizosebenza nguMnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inani losizo kumele libuyekezwe. Umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa izinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyekezwa noma usuku lapho kudingeka khona isitifiketi sezempilo. Imali yokwesekwa kwezingane ikhokhwa kumuntu onakekela ingane engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umuntu onakekela angaba noma ubani ophatha izidingo zansuku zonke zengane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhambisana noma cha. Umfaki-sicelo kanye nomuntu abahlangene naye kumele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlolwa kwezimali, okuyi R9,600 ngonyaka ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kanye no R13,200 ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ingane kanye nomuntu onakekela kumele babe ngababambiqhaza baseNingizimu Afrika futhi bahlale lapho. Umfaki-sicelo kumele abe ngumuntu onakekela ophambili wengane leyo. Ingane kumele ibe ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umuntu onakekela angafaka isicelo sezingane ezingaphezu kwezingu-6 ezingazange zibe zabo. Umfaki-sicelo akumele abe ngumuntu onakekela ophambili wengane; noma isikhungo sikhokhelwa ukunakekela ingane. Le mali yokwesekwa ikhokhwa kubazali, abazali bomntwana ongaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo, kubantu onakekela izingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-1 no-18, ngenxa yokukhubazeka okukhulu kwengqondo nokuqhubekayo okudingayo ukunakekelwa okugcwele. Umfaki-sicelo kumele abe ngumuntu onobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwendaba yabazali abahlala nengane engayibo. Umfaki-sicelo nengane kumele bahlale eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo okuqinisekisa ukukhubazeka kumele kuthunyelwe. Umfaki-sicelo, umuntu abahlangene naye, nengane kumele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlolwa kwezimali, okuyi R48,000 ngonyaka kubazali no R17,760 nengane. Ingane ephila ngokuncika ekunakekelweni inganakekelwa ngokuqhubekayo yisikhungo sikahulumeni.
Isingeniso I-Bitcoin, eyasungulwa nguSatoshi Nakamoto ngonyaka ka-2009, iyimali edijithali eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni. Le mali iyingxenye ye-blockchain technology, okuyindlela yokugcina ulwazi ngendlela ephephile futhi engashintshi. I-Bitcoin ibonakala njengezinga elisha lokuhweba, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Ukukhula kwayo eminyakeni edlule kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimakethe zezimali, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nasempilweni yomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kwe-Bitcoin I-Bitcoin isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obubizwa nge-blockchain, okuyinethiwekhi yokugcina amarekhodi ezezimali. Le nethiwekhi ibhalwa ngama-node amaningi, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuhlela noma ukuguqula ulwazi olukhona. I-blockchain ibhalwa ngama-block, lapho i-block ngayinye iqukethe ulwazi lwezohwebo ezithile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ongena kule nethiwekhi unokufinyelela kulolu lwazi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Izici ze-Bitcoin I-Bitcoin inezici eziningi ezihlukile eziholela ekutheni ibe yimpumelelo. Okokuqala, i-Bitcoin iyimali engathathi hlangothi, okusho ukuthi ayilawulwa noma iphethwe yizikhungo ezinkulu ezifana namabhange. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba basebenzise i-Bitcoin njengendlela yokuhweba ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqondisa kwemali. Okwesibili, i-Bitcoin inezinga eliphansi lokuhlawula uma kuqhathaniswa nezindlela zokuhweba ezivamile, okwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kule mali. Izingozi nezinselelo Noma i-Bitcoin inezinzuzo eziningi, ibuye ibe nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Enye yezingozi ezinkulu ukuthi intengo ye-Bitcoin iyashintsha kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izimali. Lokhu kudala ukungaqiniseki kubatshalizimali, ikakhulukazi labo abangenayo ulwazi olunzulu ngalezi zinkampani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Bitcoin ibhekene nezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba izigebengu zisebenzisa le mali ukuze zisebenze ngaphandle kokuboshwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezinzima zokuvikela abasebenzisi. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-Bitcoin I-Bitcoin isetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuhweba, ukutshalwa kwezimali, kanye nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile. Abanye abantu bayisebenzisa njengendlela yokugcina imali, njengoba ibonwa njengendlela yokuvikela imali yabo ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Bitcoin isetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi zokuhweba, lapho abantu bengathenga khona imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlobene ne-Bitcoin, okuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuhweba ezikhethekile. Umthelela we-Bitcoin emnothweni I-Bitcoin ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile emnothweni. Iphinde ibe nomthelela omkhulu ezimakethe zezimali, njengoba izinkampani eziningi ziqala ukwamukela i-Bitcoin njengendlela yokukhokha. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Bitcoin ibonakala iyindlela yokuhweba evumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba ukuba baxhumane kalula, okukhuthaza ukuhweba phakathi kwamazwe. Isiphetho I-Bitcoin iyimali edijithali enezici eziningi ezihlukile, eziholela ekutheni ibe yimpumelelo emhlabeni. Noma ibhekene nezingozi ezithile, umthelela wayo emnothweni, ezobuchwepheshe, kanye nasempilweni yomphakathi ungabhekwa njengomkhulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle i-Bitcoin, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwale mali edijithali.
Kukhona isisho esivela kwezinye izilimi zomdabu esithi: "Ithambo alakhi indlu." Ulwazi lwethu embonini ye-taxi lukhombisile iqiniso lalo misho kaningi. Ngaphambi kukahulumeni wenkolo, abantu abaningi embonini ye-taxi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokufa nokulimala kwabashayeli nabagibeli. Lezi zinselelo nezimpi zazivela kakhulu ngenxa yokungavumelani phakathi kwabo bonke embonini ye-taxi mayelana nezindlela, imali ethathwa ngabagibeli, njalonjalo. Ukuze kususwe izingxabano ezingadingekile embonini ephethwe ikakhulu abantu abamnyama futhi ethola inzuzo enkulu kubasebenzi abaningi abangekho emsebenzini, uhulumeni, kanye ne-South African National Taxi Council (Santaco), bashicilela incwadi yokuvumelana (MOU) ehloswe ukudala ukuthula kule mboni. I-MOU yalandelwa yimithetho eminingi eshicilelwe yiphalamende ngenhloso yokuletha induduzo embonini ye-taxi. I-National Land Transport Transitional Act (NLTTA) ingenye yale mithetho. Uzokhombisa ulwazi lwakho nge-NLTTA. Uzokuqonda inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwemigudu ye-taxi kanye nezinzuzo zayo. Uzokwazi ukuthi inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwemigudu ye-taxi ifaka ini. Uzobe wazi izimiso ezilindelekile emotweni entsha ye-taxi. Uzokwazi inqubo elandelwayo ukuze kushintshwe imboni ye-taxi yamanje ibe imboni yokuhamba yomphakathi. Uzokuqonda izibopho zabaphathi be-taxi mayelana nezinkokhelo zentela nezinzuzo zakho. Isici esibalulekile sempilo ukuxhumana. Ungacabanga ukuthi umhlaba uzobukeka kanjani ngaphandle kokukhuluma? Kukhona amagama nezimpawu ezisetshenziswa kakhulu ngamaqembu athile abantu, futhi bavame ukuba yibo kuphela abaqonda incazelo yazo. Ukukhuluma ngaleyo ndlela kufana nokusebenzisa abantu embonini ye-taxi ngoba nabo banendlela ethile yokukhuluma. Singabala "ulimi" (izimpawu) ezisetshenziswa ngabashayeli nabagibeli lapho bechaza izindawo abazohamba kuzo, ezaziwa kuphela yilolu grupo, futhi okumele kuchazwe kwabanye abangazi lolu limi noma izimpawu. Lezi zimpawu zisetshenziswa ukuze kudluliselwe imiyalezo kalula. Abantu bavame ukufingqa amagama ukuze kudlule imiyalezo kalula. Empeleni, abanye bathi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathanda ukwenza izinto zibe lula kubo, yingakho bekhetha ukusebenzisa amagama afingqiwe (amagama afushane) akhuluma futhi abhalwe. Kwesinye isikhathi ifomu elifingqiwe legama liba lidume kakhulu kunegama eliphelele uqobo. Isibonelo yisisho esithi "HIV noma Anti Immune Deficiency Syndrome," esinamagama afushane aziwa kakhulu futhi aqondwa kalula uma abhalwe noma akhulunywa ngendlela efingqiwe. Uyazi ukuthi kusho ukuthini? Njengakwamanye amagatsha omsebenzi, labo abathintekayo embonini ye-taxi basebenzisa amagama afingqiwe ukuze baxhumane. Ezinye zinde kanti ezinye zihluleka ukukhumbula. Nokho, la magama kufanele aziwe futhi aqondwe ngabo bonke embonini ngoba athinta ibhizinisi labo ngandlela thile. Lawa magama afushane angatholakala emibikweni, kuma-MOU, nasemithethweni eshicilelwe yiphalamende. Ku-NLTTA (qaphela leli gama elifingqiwe), kukhona amagama afingqiwe okumele sazi. Lawa magama achazwa encwadini ye-NLTTA. Empeleni, kungani sidinga i-NLTTA? Uma sibheka umlando wethu, sithola ukuthi kube khona imithetho esunguliwe futhi eqiniswa ezindaweni ezithile zamakhosi nabaphathi. Emikhandlwini yabo, le mithetho yayihloselwe ukugcina umthetho nokulawula kulezi zindawo. Namuhla, kusekhona izindawo lapho amadoda (mhlawumbe nabesifazane, ukuze kube nokushintsha) behlangana ezindaweni zobukhosi njalo ngesonto ukuze baqinise imithetho. Baphinde basebenzise le platform ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zilandela umthetho njengoba uqinisekisiwe. Le ndlela enhle yokuphatha isetshenziswa ezakhiweni zikamasipala nasemaphakathini kahulumeni. Omdala bethu baqonda ukuthi indawo engaphathwa kahle izoletha ukudideka futhi ibhubhise imiphakathi yethu; babekubone lokhu isikhathi eside. Izwe ngalinye eliphila ngaphansi kwesistimu yokhetho efana neNingizimu Afrika linezomthetho ezisunguliwe yiphalamende ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu kanye namalungelo abo njengoba kubhalwe emthethweni wethu kazwelonke. Lezi ziqondiso zibizwa ngamalungelo. Iphakheji ngalinye linezimiso ezisiza ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihlukahlukene umphakathi obhekana nazo mayelana nezindaba ezithinta le phakheji. Isibonelo, umnyango wezempilo unamalungelo achaza ukuthi abezempilo kufanele bakhathalele kanjani abaguli babo. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezokuthutha unamalungelo aqondisa labo abathintekayo ebhizinisini lokuhamba mayelana nalokho okufanele bakwenze ukuze kulethwe ukuthula embonini. Omunye wabo ngu-NLTTA. Ukuguqula isimo samanje semboni yokuhamba sibe uhlelo oluphilayo olunomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthumeni komphakathi. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabagibeli. Abantu abaningi abazalwe ngaphambi kuka-1994 bayazi ngezinselelo ezabhekana nazo bonke abantu abamnyama ngenxa yokucindezelwa nguhulumeni ongafanele. Babengenayo imvo ngendlela izwe eliphethwe ngayo ngoba babengavunyelwe ukuvota kuhulumeni abawafunayo. Kwakungekho ndaba. Njengomphumela wokhetho eNingizimu Afrika, manje sekukhona ukhetho ezingeni lendawo nakwenkolo. Ngendlela yokhetho, izakhamuzi manje zingakhetha abantu abazifunayo ephalamende! Njengoba sazi ukuthi kuyini ukuphila ezweni elinokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izindawo ezithinta ukuphila kwethu zisebenze ngokuhambisana nezifiso zabantu. Cabanga ngohlelo lwezikole (okusebenza kumakhandla akhethwe abafundi), uhulumeni bendawo (ohlanganiswe ngababonisi), njalonjalo. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela efanayo embonini ye-taxi - sidinga ukusebenza ngokhetho nohulumeni bendawo, ezingeni lesifunda nasezingeni lesizwe kuyo yonke imikhakha yethu. Kubuhlungu, Bhuda, asikabi nenzuzo! Singakwenza kanjani? Enye yezinkulumo zeKomidi Especial kuMsebenzi Womphakathi ngoJuni 2002, uMongameli we-SANTACO, uMnu. Moufhe, wathi: "Ngaphambi kuka-1994, imboni ye-taxi yayiyibhizinisi elinzuzo. Kodwa uhulumeni we-apartheid wahlela ngokucophelela ukuhlinzeka ngemboni ngokukhishwa kwezincwadi eziningi kakhulu." Wathi bazi ukuthi ama-taxi aphethe abantu abangaphezu kwe-3.7 million njalo ekuseni. Laba babephmostly abantu abasebenzayo - lokhu kusho ukuthi imboni ye-taxi inika umnotho wezwe umthelela omkhulu nakuba ingakabhalwa njengemboni yokuhamba yomphakathi? Ukushintsha uhlobo lwezithuthi ezindala, ezintsha zifake lapha futhi zithwele abantu abaneminyaka engu-18 kuya ku-35. Ukuhlangabezana nezinga eliphezulu lokuphepha elidingekayo ezithuthwini zokuhamba zomphakathi (izithuthi kumele zifake izici ezifana nohlelo lokumisa izithuthi oluvimbela ukugcwala). Ukuthola inzuzo kubanikazi be-taxi nababambiqhaza ngokuxhaswa kanye nezimali zokuphuma ezithuthwini. Ukusungula izinhlangano ze-taxi ukuze zixhumane nabaxhasi ukuze zabelane ngezithuthi ezintsha. Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo
Umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini kwezohwebo Umbuzo 1: Uminyana uyini, futhi kungani ubalulekile eThekwini? Uminyana ubhekisela enanini labantu, izakhiwo, nezindawo zokusebenza eziseduzane. EThekwini, uminyana ubalulekile ngoba udala amathuba okukhula kwezohwebo. Ngokwanda kwabantu, imakethe iyakhula, okwenza ukuhweba kube lula, futhi kukhula nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Umbuzo 2: Uminyana uthinta kanjani izimboni eThekwini? Uminyana unethonya ezimbonini eziningi, kuhlanganise nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokuthengisa. Izimboni zokwakha zikhula ngenxa yokwanda kwezidingo zokuhlala, kanti ezokuthutha zidinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha abantu abaningi. Lokhu kukhula kuholela ekwandeni kokuhweba, njengoba izinkampani zidinga izinsiza eziningi ukuze zifeze izidingo zabantu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuminyana kwezohwebo? Izinzuzo zokuminyana kwezohwebo ziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhula kokuhweba njengoba abantu abaningi befika emadolobheni, okuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo ezinkampanini. Okwesibili, uminyana uvula amathuba emisebenzi, izikhungo zokufunda, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, okwakha umnotho ophumelelayo. Umbuzo 4: Kukhona izinselelo ezihambisana nokuminyana? Yebo, kunezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhula kwabantu kuholela ezinkingeni zokuhlala, njengokuntuleka kwezindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni. Uminyana ungathuthukisa imfucumfucu, okungaba nomthelela omubi emvelweni. Umbuzo 5: Umnyango wezohwebo ungabhekana kanjani nalezi zinkinga? Umnyango wezohwebo ungabhekana nalezi zinkinga ngokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, ezifaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu, ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala ezisemthethweni, nokuxhasa izinkampani ezincane. Futhi, umnyango ungasebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziqhubeka ziqhutshekela phambili. Umbuzo 6: Ubufakazi bukhona obukhombisa umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini? Yebo, izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi waseThekwini ukhule kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, okuholele ekwandeni kokuhweba. Izinkampani eziningi zikhulise imisebenzi yazo, futhi umnotho waseThekwini ukhule ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu. Umbuzo 7: Umphakathi ungazithuthukisa kanjani ukuze ube nezinzuzo ezinkulu zokuminyana? Umphakathi ungazithuthukisa ngokubambisana, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela imihlangano yokuxoxa ngezidingo zomphakathi, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsizakusebenza, nokuxhasa izinhlelo zokufunda. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uminyana uphumelela? Izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokwakha, ukwakha izikhungo zokuthutha eziphumelelayo, nokuxhasa izinkampani ezincane. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphatha imfucumfucu ukuze umphakathi ungabi nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhlala. Umbuzo 9: Ubufakazi bukhona obukhombisa umthelela wokuminyana emhlabeni jikelele? Yebo, emhlabeni jikelele, iminyana ibonakale inezinzuzo eziningi. Izifunda ezinaminyana emikhulu, njengeNew York neTokyo, zikhombisa ukukhula okukhulu kwezohwebo, okukhombisa ukuthi uminyana ungaba nomthelela omuhle uma uphathwa kahle. Umbuzo 10: Kutheni kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuhlola umthelela wokuminyana? Ukuqhubeka nokuhlola umthelela wokuminyana kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezithathwayo zisebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, nokwakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo, okuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi nokukhula komnotho. Ngamafuphi, uminyana eThekwini unomthelela omkhulu kwezohwebo. Noma kunezinselelo ezihambisana nalokhu, izinzuzo zikhona, futhi umphakathi ungazithuthukisa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uminyana ube yinzuzo. Ukubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile, nokuhlola umthelela kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuphumelela.
Uma izicwangciso zomsebenzi wesikhathi esizayo sezifakwe ngokuphelele, futhi izinsiza zabasebenzi nemishini zixubene, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukwenza imisebenzi nezicwangciso zisebenze kahle kusho ukufezekisa umgomo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, kungaba yiphutha ukuhlela izicwangciso nokuzihlanganisa kodwa bese forgeta ukuzisebenzisa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuvela komsebenzi ngqo kungavimbela uma ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso kungahambi kahle. Ake sibheke ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi, okuyimsebenzi wesithathu sokuphatha ibhizinisi. Lapho sifika ezindabeni ezisebenzisekayo, kufanele siqhubeke lapho sishiyile khona ngemibhalo yethu (Pula/Rain June) echaza ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso, bese kuba nguMeyi 9, 2011, lapho izicwangciso nokuhlanganiswa kusetshenziswa. Ukudla enkampanini 3 kugcwaliswe. Imisebenzi enama-lambs angu-100 iqediwe. Lungisa indlu 3 (susa ukulala okudala). Imisebenzi ejwayelekile yansuku zonke, izindlu 1 no-2. UJohanna, uMinah, uJohannes. USarah, uMonica, uDawid. Amathuluzi okuhlanganisa, amabhakede, ithreyi. Imisebenzi ejwayelekile yansuku zonke iqediwe. Amathuluzi amadala, njll. Umsebenzi uqhubeka ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi okufanele yenziwe iyaphothulwa, kufanele yenziwe ngabantu balo msebenzi; kumele bakwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi ngendlela efanele. Uma umsebenzi osebenzayo utholakala, kubalulekile kumphathi (umlimi) ukuba abe nomsebenzi omuhle kuzo zonke izici zebhizinisi lakhe, imisebenzi yakhe yokuphatha ifaka okulandelayo: ukuhola, ukubambisana nokuxhumana, ukuhlela abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi kahle, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela eqinile njalo. Ukuhola nokubamba izintambo ngaphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuthuthuke umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe, futhi kubalulekile ukuthola izindlela ezingcono zokuhlanganisa izicwangciso, njll. Abaphathi kufanele bahole lapho beqinisekisa ukuthi okumele kwenziwe; akufanele kube kuhle ukuthi benze lowo msebenzi bona; kufanele bakwazi ukuhlela abasebenzi babo ukuba bawenze kahle. Abaphathi kufanele bahlele abasebenzi ukuba baphathe umsebenzi. Kufanele bahlele abasebenzi ukuba benze umsebenzi abangawenza ngazo zonke izinsiza zabo. Ngesikhathi sokuphothulwa komsebenzi, abasebenzi kufanele bathole umlayezo kubaphathi ukuze bafunde; lokhu kusiza ekuhlinzekeni abantu. Ukuxhumana okuhlanzekile kubalulekile uma sifuna umphumela omuhle emsebenzini okufanele wenziwe ngezicwangciso ezibekiwe. Umlayezo kufanele ube sobala, ubonakale, futhi uqondile. Bonke abantu abasebenza emsebenzini okufanele wenziwe kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi ubani ozokwenza ini, nini, kanjani, futhi baqonde ukuthi lo msebenzi uhamba kuphi. Ngesikhathi sokuphothulwa komsebenzi, ukuhlela (ukwabelana ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi) umsebenzi othile kubalulekile. Umphathi akakwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yena. Lokhu kwabelana ngomsebenzi kubasebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi noma usayizi womsebenzi othile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphathi bafuna ukuzibandakanya kulowo msebenzi okufanele wenziwe ngazo zonke izinsiza zabo noma bafuna ukuba ngasohlangothini futhi babe nomthelela kuphela ekuphatheni komsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukunaka ukuhlanganiswa okuhle phakathi kwezigaba zebhizinisi. Imisebenzi yebhizinisi kufanele iqhubeke kahle uma umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe uzoba nomphumela omuhle. Uma ukuhlanganiswa kuvimbela, kuzophula isikhathi nemali futhi. Khumbula imali engenayo - izindleko = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa. Isibonelo sethu ngenhla sikhombisa ukuthi uma imithi yokuphatha ama-lambs ingatholakali ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, ukusebenzisa umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe kuzomisa, futhi isikhathi sizophuma. Ngesikhathi sokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bathathe isinyathelo esiphuthumayo ukuze umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe uhambe kahle. Uma itraktori inethayi eliphukile, kuzokwenzekani? Ingabe ithayi izolungiswa kuqala, noma kuzosebenza itraktori enye? Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngokuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi kubalulekile uma abaphathi befuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Kungase kwenzeke ukuthi umsebenzi ube khona kodwa ungawenzi kahle; abaphathi bazokwamukela lokho uma kungekho ukuphathwa okuqinile futhi abasebenzi bengahambisani nalokho ukuphathwa, kungase kube nomthelela omubi emsebenzini okufanele wenziwe. Umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe uvame ukufaka izinto eziningi ezihlukene; khumbula ukuthi imisebenzi engalindelekile ingavela - umlilo ezindaweni, ibhulu elihle elibanjwe emudini, njll. Ngokusebenza amahora amaningi, siyazi ukuthi awukwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngasikhathi sinye. Kufanele ukwazi ukukhetha umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe ngaleso sikhathi esithile - lokhu kuhlobene nokukhetha/ukuhlonza umsebenzi obalulekile. Umsebenzi ophatha kahle izinzuzo noma izindleko, noma ophatha abasebenzi bakho kahle njengokusebenza 'ngamahora angeziwe', kufanele ubhekwe ngokucophelela ngoba kubalulekile. Isisindo esiphansi/ukuphuthuma okuphansi. Umsebenzi onesisindo esikhulu ungumsebenzi ongenza kube nesidingo esikhulu. Ukuphuthuma okuphezulu kukhombisa ukuthi lezi zisebenzi zizothinta inzuzo - uma zenziwa ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa inzuzo - uma zingaqediwe ngokushesha, kuzokwehla inzuzo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezindleko - uma zingaqediwe ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa izindleko. Ukuphuthuma kuhlobene nesikhathi esitholakalayo sokwenza umsebenzi othile - kufanele kwenziwe manje/namuhla noma kwesinye isikhathi. Uma wenza umsebenzi wokuvuna futhi umshini uphuka, ukuwulungisa lowo mshini noma itraktori kuzoba yinto efanele ukwenza ngokuphuthuma okuphezulu - kubalulekile. Ngokufanayo, kuzoba njengekati elinokukhathazeka ekukhulelweni, ikakhulukazi uma kuyikati yakho 'yokuhlola'. Amafayela nomsebenzi we-ofisi azosetshenziswa ngoba akuwona umsebenzi ophuthumayo; ungakwenziwa kwesinye isikhathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda zonke izimo zebhizinisi lakho, futhi ukuba nesineke ekusebenziseni izicwangciso ukuze zihambisane nezindinganiso zebhizinisi.
Kulendawo, kunezinkulungwane eziyi-2152 zamahhactha angavunyelwa ukuba abahlali beqembu lokufunda bawasebenzise. Lezi zindawo zisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke kodwa ziqashwe ngokofficial kumuntu ngamunye, futhi zilawulwa nje yikhandidethi lendawo. Umfuyi ngamunye unesivumelwano sokuhlala (PTO) salo mhlaba, esifana kakhulu nesivumelwano sokuqasha. Umfuyi akakwazi ukuba ngumnikazi walomhlaba, kodwa futhi akakwazi ukuxoshwa kule ndawo. Ngonyaka ongu-2023, abapheki bahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngamahektare angama-857. Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi lokhu kwenzeke, ikakhulukazi izindleko eziphezulu zokuqala zokulima nezindleko eziphezulu zokuqasha abaqashi. Abapheki bahluleka ukuthenga imishini yabo ngoba intengo yemakethe yezitshalo zokudla iphansi futhi inzuzo incane. Abapheki abaningi abasasebenzisa lo mhlaba sebesidala futhi baphila kakhulu ngezikhwama. Ngaphezu kwalokho, laba baphangi abadala abakwazi ukuxhaswa ngamabhange ngezikhwama, futhi abakwazi ukwandisa izinkundla abazilima ngemali abanayo. Izinkundla eziningi ezingalimi azinabafakazisi, futhi manje abapheki babhekana nezingozi ngoba izinkomo zikhululeka. Uhlelo lwe-CASP lweMnyango Wezolimo luhamba kancane, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokufaka izivikelo ezinkundleni. Uhlelo olukhulu lokukhiqiza ukudla luyancipha ngoba abapheki abaningi abasesitholanga ukwesekwa kulolu hlelo ukuze batshale ekukhiqizeni ukudla. Abapheki basemaphandleni bacele usizo kuhlelo lwe-ASGISA ukuze balime izinkundla zomphakathi wonke, kodwa lokhu akusizi abanikazi bomhlaba. Lokhu akusiyona isixazululo esiqinile ngoba siyazi ukuthi lapho i-ASGISA ingenzi izinkundla, lezi zinkundla zizoshiywa zingalimi ngoba ngeke kube nokuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane futhi abapheki ngeke babe namandla okuqhubeka bodwa. Amalungu eqembu lokufunda ahlangana njalo ngenyanga. Kukhona inzuzo enkulu ekubeni ilungu leqembu lokufunda ngoba abapheki bangabelana ngemibono yabo, bahlonze izidingo zabo mayelana nokuthola ulwazi, futhi basebenzisane. Abapheki basemaphandleni bahluleka, ngakho abapheki bezomnotho abaninzi abakhona. Intuthuko kulezi zindawo ihamba kancane, kodwa ngiyajabula ukuthi intuthuko ibonakala. Abapheki basebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zembewu), izivandlakanyo ezifanele, futhi bazama ukususa izitshalo eziphikisanayo ezinkundleni lapho kukhula khona ufulawa.
Yiziphi izenzo zokulima ozama ukuzibandakanya kuzo? Kungase kube nezizathu eziningi ezikukhuthazayo ukuba ulime le ndawo ongayithola. Ukulima kuyindlela efanelekile. Ezolimo zithinta ukutholakala kokudla nokudla okunempilo. Ukuze umlimi aphumelele, kudingeka abe nolwazi ngezitshalo, izinkomo, izimbungulu, nokuphathwa. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezithombo zingakhula emasimini - okusanhlamvu (njenge maize), imifino (njenge spinach), izithelo (njenge peach), noma imbewu (njenge beans). Izitshalo zingakhuliswa abantu noma izinkomo ngendlela yazo yemvelo noma zingashintshwa ukuze ziveze izinhlobonhlobo ezahlukene. Izidingo eziyisisekelo zokuthi izitshalo zikhule zifaka umhlabathi, amanzi, izakhamzimba, ukukhanya kwelanga, nokunakekelwa. Lapho izitshalo zikhula, ziba nezinsalela, amahlamvu/izimpande, nemifino. Lezi zingxenye zingaqoqwa njengokuthi izithelo ezincane ezisiza ekukhiqizeni imbewu (ukuhlwanyela). Izinkomo (amahhashi, amadonkolo, nezinkunzi ezisiza ekulimaleni). Njengamanje, izinkomo zingaqoqwa njengokuthi izithelo ezincane eziguqulwa zibe izinhlobo ezahlukene (ezivame ukuqoqwa emasimini) ukuze kudalwe imikhiqizo ethengiswayo (inyama, ubisi, amaqanda, njll.). Ngakho-ke, iningi lezinto zokulima kufanele ligxile ekutholakaleni kokudla okuvela ezinkomoyeni (isibonelo, umlimi ophakamisa izinkomo ukuze athole inyama angabizwa ngokuthi umlimi wenyama, ngoba ngaphandle kwenyama abakwazi ukukhiqiza inyama abangayithengisa). Umlimi udinga ukukhetha izinkomo afuna ukuziphakamisa ngokusekelwe ezizathwini ezahlukene, njengohlobo lokulima, isimo sezulu, ukukhetha komlimi, nezimo zendawo, njll. Amahhashi namadonkolo - ikakhulukazi ngenhloso yokudonsa izinkomo. Ukuqedela zonke izabelo zokulima ngesandla kungathatha isikhathi futhi kungaba yinsiza enkulu. Inhloso yokulima izinkomo ukuhweba - ukuqedela imisebenzi kangcono nangokushesha. Umthombo wamandla odonsela izinkomo ungaba amahhashi, amadonkolo, noma ama-tractor. Izinto ezingasetshenziselwa ukudonsa izinkomo zifaka phakathi kokuhlwanyela, ukufaka izitshalo, ukususa izihlahla, ukuqoqa, nokuthutha. Indlela yokudonsa ekhethiwe izoncika ezinsizweni zomlimi futhi ingahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomhlaba abawulimalayo. Ukuphathwa kungachazwa njengokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke izici zokukhiqiza (umhlaba, izitshalo, izinkomo, imishini, nezimali) ukuze kufezwe izinjongo zokukhiqiza ukudla, ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo, noma ukusebenza kwezolimo. Ukuze ukusebenza kwezolimo kuphumelele, zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo kumele zisetshenziswe kahle - lokhu kufaka phakathi izimali, abantu, umhlaba, izitshalo, izinkomo, imishini, nemakethe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza nokubhaliswa kwemibhalo kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali futhi kufanele kwenziwe njalo nangokunakekela okukhulu. Uma ungenayo ifamu, awukwazi ukuzithemba ezizathwini zokungabi nengeniso ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezivela komunye umthombo ongasekela ukulima ngokwakho. Sicela ucabangele le mibuzo elandelayo - uzibuze imibuzo ngayinye futhi ucabange kahle ngempendulo yayo. Uma ungenalo ukuqonda kahle ngalokho ozama ukukufeza, kukhona ithuba elikhulu lokuthi ungaphumelelanga - uma ungeziqondi kahle lapho uya khona, kuzoba nzima ukufinyelela lapho uhlose khona! Le mibuzo elandelayo kufanele icatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuthi umlimi akhethe izitshalo afuna ukuzitshala, izinkomo afuna ukuziphakamisa, noma ukuhlanganisa okuthile. Kungani ngilima? Lo mthetho uhlanganisa umthethosisekelo. I-Centre isunguliwe njengomuntu ophakathi kwezomthetho ezobizwa ngeSouth African Science Centre. Iphakamisa ngokuphelele ubuhlakani babantu bonke; futhi inikeza izeluleko ezinhle futhi ikhulisa izenzo eziphathelene nezidingo zokubambisana, amathuba, nezinselelo ezibhekene nabo bonke abakha iNingizimu Afrika. Le Centre iyona kuphela i-centre yesayensi eqashelwa nguhulumeni. Umphathiswa angayala le Centre ukuba iqhube imisebenzi ethile ehambisana nezinhloso zayo. Kukho uhlobo olulodwa lokubhaliswa kule Centre, kodwa amalungu angaba amalungu ehloniphekile (labo abahambile emsebenzini kodwa basahlonishwa) kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka wabo wokusebenza okuthatha iminyaka engama-70. Ilungu leCentre kulindeleke ukuthi lisize leCentre ukufinyelela izinhloso zayo. Inqubo ezolandela uma kukhethwa amalungu eCentre izoba yimpumelelo enkulu ekuthuthukiseni noma ekusebenziseni isayensi. Abantu abaphakanyisiwe ukuba babe amalungu amasha eCentre bazophakanyiswa futhi banikezwe isitifiketi esinqunywe ngamalungu okungenani amane, okungenani amabili kufanele abe nolwazi lomuntu siqu ngomsebenzi wesayensi kanye nendima ebonakalayo edlalwe yilowo muntu esayensini. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sihlanganise isitatimende esichazayo esichaza ukuthi kanjani ukuhunyushwa kwalowo muntu njengelungu leCentre kuzothuthukisa izinhloso zeCentre. Isitifiketi kufanele sibe nesitatimende esiqinile kulowo muntu esikhombisa ukuzibophezela kwabo ukuba baqashwe njengelungu leCentre, futhi kufanele sibe nesibopho esichaza umlando wabo wezokufunda nezobuchwepheshe (curriculum vitae). IBhodi leCentre kufanele ibuyekeze unyaka nonyaka zonke izicelo ezintsha ezithunyelwe ngonyaka odlule, kulandela inqubo ethile yokuhlola. Zonke izilungu ezikhona zeCentre zizodingeka ukuba zivote, ngemuva kokuvota okuthuli, zikhombise ukuthi ziyamukela noma azamukeli umuntu othile ophakanyiswe yiBhodi noma zikhombise uma zisesimweni sokungavoti noma zikhona phakathi. Amalungu eCentre angavota noma angavoti kuzothathwa njengokungavoti. Umuntu othola okungenani amavoti amathathu uzobhekwa njengokhethwe njengelungu leCentre, uma okungenani ingxenye yamavoti emamukele. a "Mina, ngigcwele igama, ngiyafunga ukuthi ngizothuthukisa isimo eNingizimu Afrika ngemicabango yesayensi futhi ngikhuthaze izinhloso zeSouth African Science Centre ngokusemandleni ami; futhi b Ngizohlonipha umthethosisekelo osekelwe kanye nemiyalo esunguliwe yeCentre njengoba ngihlala ngilungu leCentre." Noma yiliphi ilungu leCentre kumele, ngaphandle kokubheka izinhlinzeko ze-subsection 9, libe nesibopho sokubamba iqhaza ekhethweni lamalungu amasha eCentre kanye namalungu eBhodi. ICentre izophathwa futhi ibusiswe yiBhodi ngokuhambisana nalomthetho. Ibhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinhloso zeCentre zifinyelelwa ngokucophelela futhi kufanele ibheke ukuqhuba yonke imisebenzi yeCentre. e kanye namalungu ayisikhombisa; futhi f ilungu elilodwa leBhodi yeZokweluleka Kazwelonke Ngobuchwepheshe ezokhethwa ngumphathiswa. Amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwalabo abakhulunywe ngabo ku-subsection 3 f, azokhethwa ngamalungu eCentre phakathi kwabo bese ekhethwa ngumphathiswa. Ibhodi izosebenzisa amandla anikezwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalomthetho futhi iqhube imisebenzi eyabelwe yona ngumlomo. a Ibhodi izobamba imihlangano yayo ngezikhathi nezindawo ezizokwenziwa umongameli. b Amalungu akhona emhlanganweni azokwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano nokwenza izinqumo uma iningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni. b umuntu ophukile ezinkingeni zezimali futhi engakabuyiselwa ngokomthetho. g ophume emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha okungalungile ngemuva kokulalelwa mayelana nesenzo esingangcolisa iCentre, kodwa leli lungu lingase lishiya emsebenzini kuze kube emhlanganweni wonyaka olandelayo lapho le miphumela kufanele ibhalwe emaminithini ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zaleli gumbi, umuntu ophakamisile isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokuhamba kufanele ayithumele kumongameli futhi iBhodi izokwamukela le miphumela uma zonke izikweletu zikhokhiwe. Noma yiliphi ilungu leBhodi elifuna ukuhamba emsebenzini kumele lithumele isaziso esibhaliwe sokuhamba esibhekiswe kumongameli, futhi iBhodi kumele yamukele lesi saziso uma zonke izikweletu ezidingekayo zikhokhiwe. Uma isikhala selungu leBhodi siba singenalutho ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi salo lungu, umphathiswa, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-subsection 1, kufanele aqashe umuntu ophakanyiswe yiBhodi ukuze agcwalise lesi sikhala ezinsukwini eziyi-60 zokungabi nalutho. Ibhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwamakomidi, ingasebenzisa amandla noma iqhube noma imisebenzi yeCentre eyabelwe yona yiBhodi. Ikhodi ethile eyaziwa ku-subsection 1 izoba nezinye izilungu zeCentre kanye nabasebenzi beCentre abathathwa njengabafanele yiBhodi, uma kukhona, iBhodi ingase iphume noma ibuyisele umqondo noma ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanele. Uma ikomidi linamalungu angaphezu kwelilodwa, iBhodi kufanele iqashe ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe ngumholi walelo komidi. Ibhodi ayinakubhekelela ukwenza noma iyiphi imisebenzi eyabelwe noma ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba. Ngaphezu kwemisebenzi eminye eyabelwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalomthetho, uzoba ngumhloli ophathiswe ukuqapha izimali ezitholakele kanye nokusetshenziswa kwazo futhi uzoba nesibopho sokubheka impahla yeCentre. i ingase ikhiphe kumunye ilungu leBhodi amandla anikezwe kumhloli ngaphansi kwalomthetho noma kulomthetho; noma ii ivumele lowo muntu ukuba aqhube imisebenzi eyabelwe kumhloli ngaphansi kwalomthetho. b Ukudluliswa kwamandla ngaphansi kwe-subsection a akuvimbeli ukusebenzisa la mandla noma ukuqhuba le misebenzi kumhloli. ICentre ingaqasha abasebenzi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile uma ibona kufanele ukuze iCentre iqhube imisebenzi yayo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-subsection (b). b ICentre kufanele ikhokhe amaholo, izinzuzo, neminye imisebenzi engase ibekwe yiBhodi ezimali zayo. c ICentre ingase, uma ibona kufanele ngemuva kokuvumelana ngemisebenzi, idlulise noma isekele le misebenzi ukuze iqhube imisebenzi ethile noma isikhathi esithile kwiMnyango, inhlangano, noma isikhungo eNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwezimo zokuthi amalungelo nezinsizakalo zaleyo misebenzi azingcoliswa ukusekelwa kwayo. b singase sithumele izimali zomsebenzi ukuze sisize le misebenzi ukuze sibe yilungu noma sibe nesibopho sokubamba umhlomulo wepension ophakanyiswe yiCentre noma singacela ukuba sithathe umhlalaphansi ngemvume yokuthola umhlomulo ophakanyiswe njengosizo lwepension. ICentre kufanele isebenzise izinkokhelo nezisekelo ezikhulunywe ku-subsection 1b ngenhla ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe yilabo abahlinzeke le mali. ICentre ingase ikhokhe imali yokusebenza nganoma iyiphi imisebenzi eyenzayo ngaphansi kwalomthetho, noma yenze ezinye izinhlelo zezimali ezithathwa njengokufanele. Isitatimende sezezimali kufanele sinikezwe amalungu phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha
iPlayStation Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eGoli, umoya uvunguza kancane, kanti izingane zazijabulela ukudlala ngaphandle. Kodwa uThabo, umfana oneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, wayenokukhathazeka okukhulu. Wayefisa kakhulu ukuba ne-PlayStation, umshini wokudlala imidlalo odume kakhulu emhlabeni. UThabo wayehlale ezibona nabangane bakhe bedlala imidlalo emisha, behleka futhi bejabula, kanti yena wayehamba phambili edinga izindlela zokuwathola. Ngelinye ilanga, uThabo wathola ithuba lokukhuluma nomama wakhe. "Mama, ngicela ungithengele iPlayStation. Ngiyakwazi ukudlala imidlalo eminingi, futhi ngizofunda kakhulu," esho ngentokozo. Mama wakhe, uNandi, wayemazi kahle amandla okudlala imidlalo, kodwa wayezwa ukuthi umshini wawubiza kakhulu. "Thabo, ngiyakuqonda, kodwa imali ayikho. Sizodinga ukulinda," kusho yena, enomusa. Noma kunjalo, uThabo akazange ayeke. Waqala ukuhamba emgwaqweni, ehlola imisebenzi engatholakala. Waqala ukusiza abavakashi, ethengisa izithelo, futhi nakuba imizamo yakhe yayinzima, wayeqhubeka nokusebenza. Ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile, wathola imali eyanele. Wazizwa ejabule kakhulu, kodwa akazange akwazi ukuthenga iPlayStation, ngoba wayefuna ukugcina imali ukuze akhokhe imfundo yakhe. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziningana, uThabo wathola ithuba lokuvakashela emakethe yedijithali. Kwakukhona izitolo eziningi ezidayisa imidlalo, futhi wayezwa umoya wokujabula. Waqonda ukuthi umshini wayefuna, iPlayStation, wayeseduze. Wafaka imali yakhe esandleni, wathenga umshini, wathi: "Ngiyaphumelela!" Wabuyela ekhaya, enomoya ophakeme, efuna ukwabelana nabangane bakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo waqala ukudlala imidlalo, wabelana ngezikhathi ezijabulisayo nabangane bakhe. Kodwa, phakathi kokudlala, wathola ukuthi imidlalo ayizange imsize kuphela ekuzijabuliseni, kodwa futhi yamfundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Wafunda ukubambisana, ukuhlela, nokuxhumana nabanye. UThabo waba yisibonelo esihle kubangane bakhe, futhi wayejabulela ukwabelana ngalesi sikhathi. Nokho, kwaba nezikhathi ezinzima. UThabo wathola ukuthi imidlalo ibingamjabulisi kuphela, kodwa ibingamphazamisa ekufundeni. Waqonda ukuthi kufanele abeke phambili imfundo yakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNandi, umama wakhe, wabona ukuthi umntwana wakhe ufinyelele esicongweni sokudlala, kodwa waba nesidingo sokumkhumbuza ngokuqonda. "Thabo, khumbula, imfundo iyasiza. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi udinga ukufunda," wathi. UThabo wathola ukuthi uMama wakhe wayenelungelo. Waqala ukuhlela isikhathi sakhe, edlala imidlalo kuphela ngemva kokufunda. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo, njengoba wathola imiphumela emihle esikoleni. Waqhubeka nokwabelana nabangane bakhe, kodwa manje wayenobuchule bokuhlanganisa imidlalo nezifundo. Waqonda ukuthi iPlayStation ingaba umngane, kodwa imfundo iyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Njengoba iminyaka yadlula, uThabo wakhula waba umfana ophumelelayo, wathola iziqu zakhe, futhi waba nekhono lokwakha imidlalo. Waqala ukwakha imidlalo yakhe, efaka izifundo ezithile ezazimfundisa. Wazisa abanye ngezifundo ezitholakala emidlalweni, futhi waba umholi emphakathini wakhe. Ekugcineni, uThabo wathola ithuba lokuhlanganisa imidlalo yePlayStation, enza ukuthi abanye bakwazi ukufunda futhi bajabule. Wazalelwa emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa akazange akhohlwe izifundo zempilo. Wazi ukuthi iPlayStation iyinsiza, kodwa imfundo iyisikhali esinamandla. Ngakho-ke, uThabo waba isibonelo sokuthi, noma imidlalo ingaba yindlela yokuphumula, imfundo iyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Wazisa umndeni wakhe, abahlobo, nomphakathi, futhi waphumelela empilweni, eqhubeka nokukhulisa izizukulwane ezizayo. I-PlayStation yaba umthombo wokukhuthaza, kodwa imfundo yabe iyinsika yokuphila kwakhe.
### Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngabazimele okhethweni Isazi sesiZulu sihlohlela izinqumo zenkantolo njengokuhlotshisiwe kwemigomo emisha, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sihlolisise izinqumo ezithathwa yile ntando yoMthethosisekelo, ukuze siqonde kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokukhethwa kwabazimele. Kulesi sihloko, sizobuyekeza isinqumo esithile esithathwe yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nezimo zokukhethwa kwabazimele kanye nempembelelo yalesi sinqumo emphakathini. ### Ukubuka Kwezakhamizi Zezwe Sizoluza esikhaleni sokhetho, lapho abazimele bephakathi kokudinga ukwethembeka kubahluli bemihlangano. Isinqumo seNkantolo sihamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni umqondo wokuthula nokulingana kwezokhetho. Ukuhlolisisa kwe-constitution kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha umphakathi olungile. Ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukwakha izinto ezintsha, izinqumo zokhetho kumele zibe nomoya ophawulekayo wezinto ezibhekile. Izizathu ezikhathele izinqumo zenkantolo zikhombisa ukuthi abazimele kufanele bathathe indawo ebalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kungenkani izinsolo zokungathembeki. Isinqumo sokuthi abazimele bangagqugquzeliwe ukuzimela kulezi zimo kuyinhloko yemigomo yokukhethwa ehambisana nezimfanelo zezwe. ### Isimo Sezokhetho Ngesikhathi Sezimo Izinyathelo ezithathwa yinkantolo ziyaqinisekisa ukungafakazelwa komthetho, njengoba abavoti kudingeka bazi ukuthi abanye bazimele bahlala benemfanelo yokukhulumela wonke umuntu. Izinqumo ezifanele zihlanganisa ukuhlola izinqubo zokukhetha, okungaholela ekubeni nezokhetho ezihlanzekile, ezizele ngemigomo ethile esebenzayo, ukuze umphakathi uvumele okwempilo ukubamba iqhaza. Kubalulekile ukuqonda, uma sizobuka ukuthi izinqumo ziyazikhipha kanjani, sinendlela ethile yokwenza, ukuhlola kamuva izinqumo ezithathwe ngaleso sikhathi. Umkhandlu ubonisa indlela yokuvumelana kwemibono phakathi kokubhekisela kumthetho (legal framework) nomqondo wokwakha abanye abadlali abazimele. ### Ukubuyiselwa Kwabazimele Isinqumo seNkantolo sokuthi abazimele kufanele banikezwe ithuba elingcono lokukhuluma kuveza ukuhluka okukhuluma ngezinselelo ezihlongozwayo, okuhamba phambili ekukhuleni komnotho ngenxa yakho yokwakha abathintekayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukufaneleka kokwakhiwa kwemikhakha yokukhetha, umthethosisekelo ubalulekile ekwakheni izokuqhubeka kulokhu. Izinyathelo ezithathwa ngenkantolo zikhombisa udaba oludingekayo lwemiphakathi eyahlukeneyo, olunokwehluka phakathi kokunyuka kobuqotho nezindlela zokubusa. Ukubuyiselwa kwabazimele kuhlobene nomnotho omuhle, ubuhlakani obukhulu, nokuthinteka kwabazimele ezinhlelweni zezenhlalakahle. ### Ukubaluleka Kwezinqumo Ngokwakha ezimweni ezinhle, umphakathi uphinde ukhuthazwe ukuba ubekezelele amavoti akhe, kanti nezintambo zenkululeko ziqashelwa njengokukhombisa okuhle. Lokhu kuveza ukuqhubeka kolwazi ukuze kube nesithakazelo ebudlelwaneni bomphakathi, okwandisa ithimba elikhethiwe. Izenzo ezihambisana nenqubomgomo yenkantolo ziphakamisa ukuba nobuchule ekwakheni isimo esingenaziphazamiso. ### Isiphetho Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngabazimele okhethweni sidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubulungiswa bukhona emkhakheni wezokhetho. Ngokusho kwezinqumo zenkantolo, kubalulekile ukuthi abazimele banikezwe ithuba lokubamba iqhaza ekuphakamiseni umqondo wokhetho oluhlanzekile, oluqinisekisiwe, noqondile. Umphakathi, kudinga ukuthi ube nokuqonda kwezohwebo, umthethonqubo, nokwakha abavoti abaqotho ukuze baphile ngokukhululeka nangobuqotho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umthetho ungakhonza njengegugu eliyisisekelo sokwakhiwa kwempilo yomphakathi olungile nohlanganyela. Ngamafuphi, isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo senza ukuba umuntu ngamunye abe nesibopho sokwakha izwe eliqinile, elinokuthula, nokwabelana ngempumelelo ezikhathini ezinzima. Njengoba siqhubeka nalezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuthi ukuzimisela kwemiphakathi, nodlame lwezinto eziphakanyisiwe, kulungiswe ukuze kuzuze zonke izinhlangothi zomphakathi.
Ubulungiswa obuqondiswe kubantu bezizwe bangaphandle buwumbango! Uhulumeni ngeke avumele noma iyiphi indlela yobudlova eqondiswe kwabanye abantu! Masisebenze ndawonye ukuze sakhe impilo engcono kubo bonke abantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika. Masibambisane ukuze sithuthukise amakhono ethu futhi sakhe amathuba emisebenzi. Uma unemininingwane mayelana nokuhlasela okuhleliwe kubantu bezizwe bangaphandle abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, sicela ubize isiteshi samaphoyisa esikufuphi noma uma kuyiphuthumayo, sicela ubize le nombolo ethi 10111. Ukuhlasela abantu bezizwe bangaphandle abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ngeke kube nezinzuzo kumuntu. Kuvame ukuba abantu abangenacala babe ngabantu abathintekayo kulokhu - abaphangi bayabalekela. Uma unemininingwane mayelana nemisebenzi yobugovu - yenza kube sobala kumaphoyisa. Ungawuthathi umthetho ezandleni zakho. Uhulumeni ukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuba ihlale ibheke phambili futhi ibike izigameko ezihlobene nobudlova nokuzonda okuqondiswe kubantu bezizwe bangaphandle. Ukuhlela ngempumelelo iFIFA World Cup 2010 kwenze iNingizimu Afrika kanye nekhontinenti ibukeke kahle emehlweni omhlaba. Kukhule kakhulu inani labavakashi abavakashela leli zwe, okuthuthukisile amathuba okutshala imali, futhi lokho kuzovula amathuba emisebenzi. Noma iyiphi indlela yobudlova ezweni lethu izophula konke esikutholile ngenkathi sibhakabhisa iNdebe yoMhlaba. Manje umhlaba usibheka ngenhlonipho enkulu kunakuqala.
Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) yisiphetho esenziwe ngabaholi base-Afrika, esisekelwe embonini yabo ehlangene kanye nokuqiniseka okuqinile ukuthi banomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphelisa ubumpofu nokubeka amazwe abo, ngazinye noma ndawonye, endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi bebamba iqhaza emnothweni nasemphakathini wezwe. Le nqubo isekelwe ekuzinikeleni kwabantu base-Afrika ukuze bazikhulule kanye nendawo yabo ezinkingeni zokungathuthuki nokuhlukumezeka ekubambeni kwenhlalo yomhlaba. Ubumpofu nokuhlukumezeka e-Afrika kuphikisa impumelelo yezizwe ezithuthukile. Ukuqhubeka kokuhlukumezeka kwe-Afrika ekubambeni kwenhlalo yomhlaba kanye nokuhlukumezeka kobudlelwano bayo bezomnotho kanye nezokuxhumana kuletha ukwesaba nokungazinzi emhlabeni. Ukukhula komphakathi womhlaba, ukwezimali, kanye nosizo phakathi kwamazwe amabili (okubili) kube yisisekelo somqondo wokuthuthukisa i-Afrika. Ukwezimali kuholele ekuqoqweni okukhulu kwesikweletu, okuphinde kuhlawulwe ngezikhawu noma kuxoshwe kwesinye isikhathi, futhi kuhlala kuyisithiyo esikhulu ekukhuleni kwamazwe ase-Afrika. Iphuzu lokuzimela selifinyelelwe. Mayelana nezinye izici zosizo lwamazwe amabili - sibona ukwehla kosizo lwabantu siqu kanye nokuncipha okukhulu kosizo lwesamba, okwehlele ngaphansi kwezinga elibekwe ngama-1970. E-Afrika, cishe abantu abangu-340 million noma ingxenye yokuhlala komhlaba baphila ngaphansi kwe-USD $1 ngosuku. Ukufa kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu kungalinganiswa ku-140 ngama-1,000 izingane, kanti ukuphila okuhlele emhlabeni kungama-54 kuphela. Kukhona kuphela u-58% wabantu abathola amanzi aphephile. Abantu abangafundile abangaphezulu kweminyaka engu-15 bangalinganiswa ku-41%. Kukhona kuphela imigqa yocingo engu-18 kubantu abangu-1,000 e-Afrika, uma kuqhathaniswa no-146 emhlabeni jikelele kanye no-567 ezweni elinengeniso ephezulu. Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) bucela umhlaba ukuba uphendule kulolu suku olukhathazayo ngokushintsha ubudlelwano obubalulekile kulokhu. Abantu base-Afrika abaceli ukuqhubeka nokuncika kosizo noma ukusiza kwezezimali. Banokwaneliseka ukuthi leli thuba lesikhathi eshistorical lizophela ubumpofu bokungathuthuki obujolile e-Afrika. Ubuqotho, okuhlanganisa imali, ubuchwepheshe, amakhono abantu, adingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe impi yokulwa nobumpofu nokungathuthuki, manje sekukhona kakhulu futhi kutholakale kalula. Okudingekayo manje ukuze kuqoqwe lezi zinsiza futhi zisetshenziswe kahle abaholi abanamandla nokuzinikela enhliziyweni ekuthuthukiseni abantu nasekupheliseni ubumpofu, kanye nokubambisana nomhlaba omusha osuselwa ekuzinikeleni kwabo bonke nasekuzuzeni okuphumelelayo. Kulo lonke izwekazi, abantu base-Afrika bayazibophezela ukuthi ngeke baphinde bavumele ukuba bahlukunyezwe yizimo. Sizokwakha ikusasa lethu futhi sicele umhlaba ukusiza emizamweni yethu. Sekukhona izimpawu zokuphumelela ngethemba. Inani leziphathimandla ezizimele ezizibophezele ekukhuseleni amalungelo abantu, ukuthuthukiswa okujolile kubantu, kanye nezomnotho ezinikeza amathuba okuthengiselana kuyanda. Abantu base-Afrika sebekhombisile ukuthi ngeke bavumele abaholi bezomnotho nabepolitiki ukuthi babaphose. Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) buhlose ukuqinisa nokusheshisa lezi zimpumelelo. Kuyisicelo sokubambisana okusha phakathi kwe-Afrika nomhlaba, ikakhulukazi lezi zizwe ezinomnotho, ukuze kudlulelwe emgqeni wokuthuthukiswa obuphumelele iminyaka eminingi ngenxa yobudlelwano obungalingani noma obuhlukumezayo. Indawo ye-Afrika emphakathini womhlaba ichazwa njengendawo lapho umhlaba unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukusiza wonke umuntu iminyaka eminingi. Izindawo zezilwane nezinsiza zakudala ezikhombisa ukuguqulwa komhlaba, impilo, nomndeni wabantu. Ingxenye I iyindawo eyaziwa kakhulu. Ingxenye II isanda kuvela, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwezindaba zemvelo. Ingxenye III iphinde ivele yodwa, ibonakala njengefanele ukunakwa hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wesayensi noma kulabo abathanda ukugcina heritage (iminyuziyamu) kanye nalabo abawubona. Lokhu kuyIngxenye IV, ebonisa amandla abantu base-Afrika, angasetshenziswa noma athuthukiswe ngokuphelele ngezindlela eziningi. Kucacile ukuthi, ngaphandle kokuthi imiphakathi eyakhiwe ezindaweni ezinomoya ophakeme ingaguqulwa, ezinye izindlela zokuphila zizobamba iqhaza ekubhujiseni izihlahla. Njengoba ukugcina imvelo kuzothokozisa bonke abantu, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Afrika ibekwe endleleni yokuthuthukiswa futhi ingabeki izinsiza zayo engcupheni. Isayensi yanamuhla iyavuma ukuthi i-Afrika iyisikhumbuzo somuntu. Njengengxenye yokwakha nokubuyisela isithunzi nokuzethemba kwabantu base-Afrika, kubalulekile ukuthi le nhloso yokuba ngumuntu iqondwe noma ibonwe futhi ithathwe njengengcebo yibo bonke abantu base-Afrika. Isikhundla se-Afrika njengezikhumbuzo zomuntu kufanele sibhakanyiswe umhlaba wonke njengomlando wabantu bayo bonke. Ngakho-ke, Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika kufanele lugcine leli thongo futhi lusetshenziswe ukuze kwakhiwe ukuqwashisa ngalesi sidingo esiphuthumayo sokuphelisa ukungathuthuki nokuhlukumezeka kuleli zwe. I-Afrika inendima ebalulekile yokudlulisela ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo emhlabeni. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe kugcizelela indima edlalwa ngabantu ekukhiqizeni, belwa nendawo yabo enqubweni yokukhiqiza besebenzisa amathuluzi abo ngaleso sikhathi noma esikhathini esizayo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane, izitshalo, nezilwane ezitholakala kuphela e-Afrika zinikeza abantu ithuba lokugcina ubudlelwano babo nemvelo. I-Afrika isivele idlale indima ebonakalayo emasikweni omhlaba, ezincwadini zelizwe, emculweni, emculweni, nakwezinye izindlela zamasiko, kodwa amandla ayo awakaze asetshenziswe ngokuphelele ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuhlanganiswa ngokuphelele emnothweni womhlaba. Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika luzovumela i-Afrika ukuthi wandise indima yayo esayensi, emasikweni, nasezobuchwepheshe. Kule millennium entsha, njengoba abantu befuna indlela entsha yokwakha umhlaba ongcono, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlanganise ukuhlukahluka kanye nenhloso yabantu ukuze sithumele leli zwe ezingeni elifanayo lokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni isivilizashoni yabantu. Ukuncipha kwalesi zwe lase-Afrika kugcizelelwe ukuphathwa kwalesi zwe ngabanye, impi engenemikhonto, ukuhlukumezeka kohlelo lwezomnotho lwezwe, kanye nokwehluleka noma ukungafaneleki kwemigomo elandelwa ezinye izizwe ngemuva kokuthola uzibuse. Iminyaka eminingi, i-Afrika ibambe iqhaza emnothweni womhlaba njengomthombo wezisebenzi ezishibhile nezinto ezingavuthiwe. Lokhu kuholele ekunciphiseni kwempahla ye-Afrika esikhundleni sokuthi isetshenziswe ukuze kuthuthukiswe leli zwe. Umfutho ngaleso sikhathi wokusebenzisa izinto ezingavuthiwe nezinto zokwakha ukuze kuthuthukiswe imboni yokukhiqiza kanye nezisebenzi ezinobuchwepheshe ukuze kufezwe ukukhula komnotho nok
Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni Ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika, kusekhona ukukhathazeka okukhulu mayelana nokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinkulu emithini yokwelapha, kuxhumene nezimo ezinzima zezempilo kubantu abaningi ababhekene nezinkinga zempilo ezidinga ukwelashwa. Kukhona izikhalazo eziningi ezivela kubantu abasebenzisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni, abathi imithi ayitholakali kalula, ikakhulukazi imithi ebalulekile yokwelapha izifo ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS, uDiabetes, nezinye izifo ezinzima. Lokhu kushoda kwemithi kungenxa yezinkinga eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemali, ukuphathwa kabi kwezinsiza, nokungabi khona kwezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuhambisa imithi. UProfesa Thandiwe Mkhize, ongumholi wezempilo, uthi: “Ukushoda kwemithi akubangeli kuphela ubuhlungu kubantu, kodwa futhi kudala umthwalo omkhulu ezibhedlela nasezinhlelweni zempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezibhedlela.” Izibhedlela eziningi zixwayisa abantu ukuthi uma besebenzisa izinsiza zempilo, kufanele baphinde baqinisekise ukuthi banemithi edingekayo ngaphambi kokufika ezibhedlela. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi kukaHulumeni, abenzi bezemithi, kanye nabantu abathintekayo. NgoMgqibelo, umphakathi wakwaZungu uhlelwe umhlangano ukuze baxoxe ngale nkinga. Umphakathi uvumile ukuthi kushoda kwemithi kudala izinkinga eziningi, futhi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezinqala ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo. UZanele Khumalo, ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokwelapha, uthe: “Sidinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izinsizakalo zabantu. Akukwazi ukuthi abantu baphile ngaphandle kwemithi.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, uphiko lwezempilo luhlongoza ukuthi kube nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezizokwazi ukuzitholela imithi, ukuze abantu bangabhekani nezinkinga zokuthola imithi ezibhedlela. Iziphakamiso zifaka phakathi ukwandisa imithombo yokuthola imithi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani zokwenziwa kwemithi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha izinsiza. Ngokwakha izikhungo ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngemithi, umphakathi ungase ufinyelele kalula emithini edingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufanisa izidingo zabantu nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kunciphise ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Abahlinzeki bezempilo baphinde baphawule ukuthi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kungaba yindlela yokwehlisa izinkinga ezihambisana nokushoda kwemithi. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha eziphumelelayo, ezinjengokuthola imithi ku-inthanethi, kungasiza ekutholeni imithi ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Umbiko wakamuva ubonisa ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhathazekile ngezinga lokukhula kwabantu abadinga imithi, kodwa zikhona izifundo ezitholakele ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Izingcweti zempilo zithi izimpumelelo zidinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, othisha, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi iyatholakala kalula. Naphezu kwezithiyo ezikhona, kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuncishiswe le nkinga. Uhulumeni usekhulume ngokuqinile ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokulethwa kwemithi, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa ntokazi. Lokhu kuzoba yinsiza enkulu kubantu abaningi abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziguli zikhumbuza ukuthi zikhona izinketho ezitholakalayo uma imithi engatholakali ezibhedlela. Izikhungo zempilo ezizimele ziyaqhubeka nokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuhlinzeka ngemithi, nakuba lokhu kungase kube phezulu kwamanani. Kumele kube nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha imithombo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zithola imithi efanele ngesikhathi. Ubuqotho bokuphathwa kwemali nokuhlinzekwa kwemithi kumele kube yinto eyinhloko ekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza. Ekugcineni, ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni akuyona nje inkinga yamanje, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezixazululo ezinzima. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabahlinzeki bezempilo kumele basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze bagcine impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu abaningi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, emhlabeni wethu, amanzi abengumthombo ophilayo. Kwakungamandla amakhulu, akhuthaza ukuphila, futhi abelokhu ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisibusiso esivela phezulu. Kodwa, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinkinga zokuqala ziqala ukuvela. Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi angcolile ayingozi empilweni. Izifo ezinjengecholera ne-typhoid zaba yizinkinga ezinkulu, zibhubhisa izigidi zabantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abaphathi bezempilo baphendule, baqale ukucwaninga ngezindlela zokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Kwakuyisikhathi sokuhlola, sokufuna izixazululo. Abantu baqala ukufunda ukuthi ukuhlanzwa kwamanzi kungasiza ekugwemeni izifo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izixazululo eziningi zathuthukiswa. Emazweni amaningi, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile zathuthukiswa. Kwakukhona imizamo yokwakha iziteshi zokuhlanza amanzi, lapho amanzi angcolile ayebekwa khona ukuze ahlanzwe. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavumela abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono. Abantu baphila kahle, izifo zancipha, futhi umphakathi waba namandla. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izwe lethu laqala ukubona izinguquko ezinkulu. Emazweni amaningi, izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka kwamanzi zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukufunda ukubaluleka kokugcina amanzi. Kwakukhona imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphuze amanzi ahlanzekile, baphinde baqonde ukuthi amanzi angcolile ayingozi. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awasizi kuphela empilweni yabo, kodwa futhi nasemvelweni. Kodwa, njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo zanda. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, kanye nezinguquko ezikhona emhlabeni jikelele kwaholela ekutheni amanzi ahlanzekile abe yinto engatholakali kalula. Izifunda eziningi zathola ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila, kodwa zikhona izithiyo eziningi ezivimbela ukufinyelela kwabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baqale ukucabanga ngezindlela zokugcina amanzi, nokuthi bangawasebenzisa kanjani ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka kwamanzi zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokugcina amanzi. Izikhungo zokuhlanzeka kwamanzi zakhula, futhi abantu baqala ukufunda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esibalulekile. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba kwavumela abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Namuhla, amanzi ahlanzekile awasiyona nje into esiyithola kalula. Kukhona imikhankaso eminingi emhlabeni wonke yokugcina amanzi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphuze amanzi ahlanzekile. Izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka kwamanzi ziqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esibalulekile empilweni yabo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, abantu baye bahlala bephokophele ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi izinselelo zanda. Kodwa, abantu baye baqonda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awasiyona nje into ethile, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile empilweni. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile atholakala kubo bonke. Ngakho-ke, indaba yamanzi ahlanzekile iyindaba yokuphila, yokuhlola, nokusebenza. Ibonisa ukuthi, nakuba izinselelo zikhona, abantu baye bahlala bephokophele ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile, ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, uma sikhumbula ukubaluleka kwamanzi, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa elihle, elinempilo, nelihlanzekile.
Impilo Yaselokishini: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Impilo yaselokishini ibonisa ukutholakala kwabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-township. Lezi zindawo, ezaziwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, zidalwe ngesikhathi sobandlululo ukuze kuhlukaniswe abantu ngokobuhlanga. Impilo yaselokishini ibonakala ngezinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinkinga, izinselelo, kanye namathuba. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo abantu abahlangabezana nazo? Abahlali bezindawo zasemakhaya bavame ukubhekana nezinkinga eziningi, ezinjengokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala. Izindawo zokuhlala zihlupheka, futhi abantu abaningi bahlala ezindlini ezincane, okwenza kube nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni yabo. Umbuzo 3: Kukhona yini amathuba empilo yaselokishini? Yebo, nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi, zikhona nezinto ezinhle empilweni yaselokishini. Abantu bavame ukuhlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze bakhe imiphakathi eqinile, futhi izinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinhlelo zokuziphilisa zikhona ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela abantu abazisebenzisayo ukuze baphile? Abantu basemalokishini bavame ukusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukuze baphile, okuhlanganisa ukuhweba, ukwenza imisebenzi yezandla, noma ukuhlela imicimbi yokuthengisa. Abanye baphinde basebenzise izinkampani ezincane ukuze bathole imali, kanti abanye bahlala bephokophele izifundo ukuze bathole amathuba angcono. Umbuzo 5: Impilo yaselokishini ibonakala kanjani ngezokuxhumana? Izokuxhumana zibalulekile empilweni yaselokishini. Abantu bavame ukuhlela imicimbi yokuxhumana, njengezinkulumo, imicimbi yokuzijabulisa, kanye nemikhosi, okwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onokuxhumana okuhle. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza impilo yaselokishini ibe yinhle? Impilo yaselokishini ibonakala ngothando, ubumbano, kanye nomoya wokusebenza ndawonye. Abantu bahlala bephokophele ukuphila okungcono, bephinde bakhe izinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yabo, okubukeka emisebenzini yokuzithandela. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yaselokishini? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yaselokishini, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezihlanganyela phakathi kukamasipala, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, ukufundisa amakhono, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu nabaholi bendawo kubalulekile ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Umbuzo 8: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze bathuthukise impilo yabo? Abantu bangathuthukisa impilo yabo ngokuzibandakanya emisebenzini yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ukufunda amakhono amasha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuzithandela, ukufunda, nokuhweba kungabasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umbuzo 9: Impilo yaselokishini izoba kanjani esikhathini esizayo? Esikhathini esizayo, impilo yaselokishini ingathuthuka uma abantu beqhubeka nokubambisana. Ukukhulisa imfundo, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile. Uma abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, impilo yaselokishini ingaba ngcono. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele siqonde ngempilo yaselokishini? Impilo yaselokishini iyinkimbinkimbi, igcwele izinselelo nezinto ezinhle. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abantu basemalokishini bahlala bephokophele ukuphila okungcono, besebenzisa ubumbano. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe nomoya wokubambisana ukuze sithuthukise impilo yasemalokishini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, impilo yaselokishini izoba yinhle uma abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, bephokophele izinjongo ezifanayo, futhi beqonda ukuthi ubumbano lungakha amandla amakhulu.
Imidlalo Yevidiyo: Izimpendulo Nezinkulumo Umbuzo 1: Yini imidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo iwumkhakha wezokudlala ophakathi kwamakhompyutha, ama-console, noma ama-smartphone. Le midlalo ikuvumela ukuba uphume emhlabeni wokuqhathanisa, uyiluleke, futhi ujabulele izimo ezahlukene. Izinhlobo eziningi zifaka phakathi imidlalo yezenzo, imidlalo yokwakha, imidlalo yokuhlola, nezokucabanga. Umbuzo 2: Zini izinzuzo zokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo inezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, ingathuthukisa amakhono okucabanga nokusebenza, njengoba kudinga umqondo ophusile ukuze uphumelele. Okwesibili, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana nabanye, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni we-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganyela nabangane noma nabantu abanentshisekelo efanayo. Futhi, kudinga ukuthi umdlali abe nesineke, okungasiza empilweni yansuku zonke. Umbuzo 3: Ziyini izingozi zokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo? Ngaphandle kwezinzuzo, imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba nezingcuphe. Umdlalo ongenamkhawulo ungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale isikhathi eside behluleka ukuphumula, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo ezifana nokukhathala noma ubuhlungu bezinhlangothi. Kubalulekile ukufaka isikhathi sokuphumula phakathi kokudlala ukuze ugweme lezi zingozi. Umbuzo 4: Imidlalo yevidiyo ithuthukiswe kanjani? Imidlalo yevidiyo ithuthukiswa ngabadlali abahlakaniphileyo ababelana ngemibono nezobuchwepheshe. Abathuthukisi bemidlalo benza ucwaningo olunzulu, behlola izidingo zabadlali, futhi basebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze benze imidlalo ethokozisayo. Imidlalo ibhalwa ngamagama, izithombe, nemisindo, konke kudinga ukuhlela okuhle ukuze kuthuthukiswe umuzwa wokudlala. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinhlobo ezidume kakhulu zemidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo ihlukaniswe ngezindlela eziningi, kodwa ezinye zezinhlobo ezidume kakhulu zifaka imidlalo yezenzo, imidlalo yokuhlola, imidlalo ye-strategy, ne-role-playing games (RPGs). Imidlalo yezenzo igxile kumkhankaso, imidlalo ye-strategy idinga ukucabanga ngokucophelela, kanti i-RPG ivumela abadlali ukuba baphile izindaba ezijulile. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe imidlalo yevidiyo iyavuma kubantu bonke? Yebo, imidlalo yevidiyo iyavuma kubantu bonke, kodwa kubalulekile ukukhetha imidlalo efanele. Imidlalo ibonakale ihluka ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene, njengezinga lobudala nezimpikiswano. Abazali kufanele bazi kahle imidlalo ezithokozisayo nezingafanele ezinganeni zabo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi badlala imidlalo efanelekile. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe imidlalo yevidiyo iyasiza ekufundeni? Ngempela, imidlalo yevidiyo ingasiza ekufundeni. Imidlalo ethile ikhulisa amakhono afana nokubala, ukufunda, nokucabanga. Kukhona nemidlalo eqondile yokufunda efundisa izifundo ezinjengezibalo, isayensi, nezinye izifundo, okuveza ukuthi imidlalo ingaba ithuluzi elihle lokufunda uma isetshenziselwa kahle. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ngiyicabangele lapho ngithenga umdlalo? Lapho uthenge umdlalo, kubalulekile ukuthi ucabangele izinto eziningi. Qiniseka ukuthi umdlalo uyahambisana nezidingo zakho kanye nezinga lobudala elihambisana nawo. Futhi, hlola izibuyekezo zabanye abadlali ukuze uqonde kahle umuzwa womdlalo. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izindlela zokudlala imidlalo yevidiyo? Imidlalo yevidiyo ingadlalwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ungadlala wedwa noma nabanye abantu, kungaba ngokuqondile noma nge-inthanethi. Imidlalo ye-multiplayer ivumela abadlali abaningi ukuba badlale ndawonye, okwenza kube lula ukujabulela umuzwa wokuxhumana. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo emhlabeni wezemidlalo yevidiyo? Emhlabeni wezemidlalo yevidiyo, ubuchwepheshe buyashintsha njalo. Izithombe eziphakeme, imidlalo ehambisanayo, kanye nemidlalo yezokuxhumana kuzoqhubeka nokwenza kahle. Futhi, i-virtual reality (VR) iyakhula, ivumela abadlali ukuba bahlale ngaphakathi kwemidlalo ngendlela engakaze ibonwe, okuthuthukisa umuzwa wokudlala. Isiphetho Imidlalo yevidiyo iyinto ehlangeneyo efaka ubugagu bezokudlala, ubuchwepheshe, nemizwa. Ngokudlala, umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila iziphetho ezihlukahlukene, uxhumane nabanye, futhi athuthuke kumakhono amaningi. Ukuqonda kahle imidlalo yevidiyo kubalulekile ukuze sithole ubuchwepheshe bezemidlalo obungasiza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yethu. Kuhle ukuhlola, ukudlala, nokubona ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ingakwenza kanjani kube mnandi.
Umlando Wokhetho Luka-1994 Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 eNingizimu Afrika ungomunye wemicimbi ebaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezwe. Lokhu kukhumbuza isikhathi esinzima sokuphila kwabantu abamnyama, lapho ubuhlanga bukhona njengomgogodla wezinkinga eziningi. Ngalesi sikhathi, iNingizimu Afrika yayisaphila ngaphansi kokubusa kwe-apartheid, uhlelo olwakha ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwabantu ngokobuhlanga. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abamnyama bahlupheke kakhulu, bephoqeleka ukuba baphile ezindaweni ezikhethekile, bengenayo imisebenzi eminingi, futhi bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi "ama-township." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bamaNgisi, abamaXhosa, nabanye abavela ezizweni ezahlukene baqala ukuhlanganisa imizamo yokulwa nalezi zimo. Uhlelo lwe-apartheid lwaba yingozi, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuka, bephakamisa izwi labo. U-Desmond Tutu, uNelson Mandela, noWalter Sisulu babengabanye bamaqhuzu abahola lezi zinguquko. UNelson Mandela, owayengumholi we-ANC (African National Congress), waba yisithonjana sokulwa nokucindezelwa. Ngonyaka ka-1990, uMandela wakhululwa ejele, lapho abehleli khona iminyaka engama-27. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuphila kabusha, lapho abantu baphakamisa ithemba lokuthi izinguquko zingase zenzeke. Ngemuva kokukhululwa, uMandela wahola imizamo yokwakha uxolo phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Kwakudingeka ukuthi kube nezinqumo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uzothola ithuba lokuvota. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlaka ezisemthethweni zokhetho kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile. Ngonyaka ka-1993, kwavulwa izingxoxo phakathi kwe-ANC nohulumeni, okuholele ekwakhiweni kweMithetho yeSivumelwano. Lokhu kwavumela ukuthi kube nokhetho lokuqala olukhululekile nolungakhethi, olwakhiwe ngempela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, angavota. Ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa ka-1994, kwaba nokhetho lokuqala olukhululekile eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esijabulisayo, lapho abantu abamnyama, abamhlophe, nabanye bonke bejabulile, bephuma bezovota. Izikhumbuzo zalesi sikhathi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi leli sonto lalisikhumbuza ukuthi umhlaba ungashintsha, futhi abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa labo. Izikhungo zokuvota zazigcwele abantu, futhi umoya wokujabula wawukhona. Abantu babebonisa izimpawu zokuthokozisa, bejabulile ngokuba neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa elisha. U-ANC, ngaphansi kokuholwa kukaMandela, wathola ukwesekwa okukhulu, futhi kwavela ukuthi abantu baphokophele ekwakheni izwe elisha, elinokuthula, nelokubambisana. Ngemuva kokhetho, uNelson Mandela waba nguMongameli wokuqala omnyama weNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, lapho uMandela eqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Uhlelo lwezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zaba yizinto ezibalulekile ezazithathwa ngokubaluleka. Umlando wokhetho luka-1994 awupheli lapho. Ubuye ubonise ukuthi izinguquko zidinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, nokubambisana. Nakuba izinkinga zihlala zikhona, abantu bahlala bethemba ukuthi ikusasa lingcono. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe luhamba phambili, futhi abantu bahlala bephokophela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNingizimu Afrika ibhekane nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa umoya wokhetho luka-1994 usaqhubeka nokukhanya. Lokhu kukhumbuza abantu ukuthi, nakuba izinguquko zingathatha isikhathi, umphakathi unamandla okwenza umehluko. U-1994 akukhona kuphela ukhetho; kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu bangabambisana ukuze bakhe ikusasa elingcono. Ngakho-ke, umlando wokhetho luka-1994 ungumfanekiso wokuthi umphakathi ungashintsha kanjani, ungakha kanjani izindlela ezintsha, futhi ungathola kanjani amandla okuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile esifanele ukusigcina engqondweni, ukuze siqhubeke nokwakha iNingizimu Afrika engcono, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila, ukusebenza, nokuphumelela.

I-Charter Yokumba yasungulwa ngokulandela ingxenye 100 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokumbiwa, Umthetho No. 28 ka-2002 (MPRDA). Umnyango Wezinsiza Zomhlaba usanda kubuyekeza le Charter Yokumba. Le buyekezo ibheke ezicini ezahlukene ze-charter kufaka phakathi ubunikazi, ukuthengwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezohwebo, okuthokozisa abantu abathile, ukuqashwa okufanele, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ngokulandela umgomo ophakeme wePhalamende wokukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, iKomidi leZwe leZinsiza Zomhlaba lizokwenza iNdaba Yokufaka Umphakathi mayelana nemiphumela yokubuyekezwa kwe-Charter Yokumba endala kanye nezinhlinzeko ze-Charter Yokumba entsha eKlerksdorp (i-Anglo Ashanti no1 Shaft hall), esifundazweni seNyakatho Nentshonalanga ngoLwesine, uMashi 31, 2011. Le komidi ifuna ukuhlangana ikakhulukazi neZinhlangano Zokumba, abasebenzi bezimayini, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, kanye nemiphakathi ezungezile ezimayini.
