Le nsizakalo itholakala kubalingani bangaphandle abangabantu bezwe laseNingizimu Afrika noma abanamalungelo okuphila njalo. Gcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Ubudlelwano obuqhubekayo phakathi kwabantu abashadile noma abaphakathi kobudlelwano bobulili obufanayo nabanye bezinhlobo ezahlukene zamadoda nabesifazane bwamukelwa, kodwa esikhundleni sesitifiketi sokushada, kumele banikeze ulwazi olunembile ngokuqhubeka kwabo, kanye nokwesekwa kwabo nokuxhaswa kwezimali ngokufaka isiqinisekiso esif sworn esivela kumphakathi wezomthetho. Ukuze uMnyango Wezangaphakathi unikeze amalungelo okuphila njalo kumlingani wangaphandle wesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma kumuntu onamalungelo okuphila njalo, kumele baneliseke ukuthi kukhona ubudlelwano obuqinile. Amalungelo okuphila njalo anikezwa ngaphansi kokuthi azophela uma kutholakala ukuthi ubudlelwano abukhona ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, ngaphandle uma omunye umphakathi eshonile. Kumele ushade nesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma nomuntu onamalungelo okuphila njalo ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezwe ongawumthetho wobugebengu noma umthetho wesiko, isikhathi esingama-5 iminyaka. Izicelo zingafakwa emahhovisi eMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le nsizakalo iyamahala.
Inhloso yokubuyekeza umthetho ophathelene nezinga lomoya ukuvikela, ukuvuselela, nokuthuthukisa izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika, kubhekwa isidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungapheli; ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sezwe nezindinganiso zokwamukelwa kwezinga lomoya, ukuphathwa, nokulawulwa kuwo wonke amasekela kahulumeni; isisekelo esithile sokuzama ukuthuthukisa izinga lomoya; nokucabangela zonke izindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. Izinyathelo zomthetho ezintsha nezizayo zidingeka ukuvikela, ukuvuselela, nokuthuthukisa izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika. Noma iyiphi inqubomgomo eyenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 46 noma 47; nezinye izinhlinzeko ezincane ezenziwe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Kulo mthetho, igama noma isigaba esithathwe egameni noma isigaba esichazwe esigabeni 1 sinezincazelo ezifanayo ngaphandle uma umongo ukhombisa incazelo ehlukile. Inhloso yalolu mthetho ukuvikela, ukuvuselela, nokuthuthukisa izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika, mayelana nesidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungapheli. Ngohulumeni osebenza ngalolu mthetho, uhulumeni kumele uvikele, uvuselele, futhi uthuthukise izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika; noma b uhulumeni kumele asebenzise lo mthetho ukuze afinyelele empumelelweni yalezo ziqu. b kuzo zonke izenzo ezithinta izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika. a emkhakheni kahulumeni kazwelonke nasezindaweni; futhi b emkhakheni kahulumeni wesifunda, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo. b kumele kuhumusheke futhi kusebenze ngokuhambisana nesisekelo esichazwe esigabeni 2 salolu mthetho. e ukuphathwa kolwazi lwezinga lomoya. d kungashintshwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isisekelo sezwe noma noma iyiphi inguquko esisekelweni, uNgqongqoshe kumele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukufakwa lapho kukhona inguquko encane esisekelweni. i mayelana nezinga lemoya lemvelo, lihlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalawo makhompiyutha noma inhlanganisela yawo atholakala emoyeni; noma ii njengento eyenziwe emoyeni lapho umthombo wayo waziwa noma esimweni lapho umthombo ungatholakali. mayelana nomsebenzi owenziwa ngamasipala mayelana nokuhambisana nalolu mthetho. v ngokuhambisana nezibopho zikaNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwezivumelwano zamazwe omhlaba. i kanye nezinga lemoya lemvelo, lihlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalawo makhompiyutha noma inhlanganisela yawo atholakala emoyeni; noma ii imikhakha eyenziwe emoyeni eqhamuka endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda noma noma iyiphi indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Uma amazinga kazwelonke esungulwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 sokwakha umkhakha othile noma inhlanganisela yemikhakha, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nalolu msebenzi akakwazi ukushintsha lowo mzila kazwelonke ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile kulelo sifunda noma endaweni ethile ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngokwalolu sigaba, isaziso singahlukanisa phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene ezisunguliwe ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, noma iyiphi inguquko eyenziwe esazisweni, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kumele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukufakwa ezinguqukweni ezincane esazisweni. b kungasungula amazinga endawo ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezinto ezivela endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda, kumkhakha ngamunye noma inhlanganisela yawo. Uma amazinga kazwelonke noma wesifunda esunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 noma 9 sokwakha umkhakha othile noma inhlanganisela yemikhakha, isifunda asikwazi ukushintsha lawo mazigaba kazwelonke noma wesifunda ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile esifundeni. Ngaphambi kokuthi isifunda sithathe umthetho wangaphakathi esifundeni esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 1, kumele silandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana neSahluko 4 seMthetho Wamasipala. a ezokwenziwa ngezinga lemoya elizungezile, b ezokwenziwa ngento eyenziwe yindawo ngayinye ebonakalayo noma engabonakali. Ngosaziso kuGazethi, uNgqongqoshe angasungula iKomidi Lezokweluleka Ngokuqhubeka Kwezinga Lomoya ukuze eluleka uNgqongqoshe mayelana nokuphathwa kwalolu mthetho. e noma iyiphi indaba ephathelene neKomidi. UNgqongqoshe kumele aqoke umphakathi eMnyangweni ozoba ngumqondisi wezinga lomoya kazwelonke lapho uzohlela khona izindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinga lomoya ezingeni likahulumeni kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezinga lomoya esifundeni kumele aqoke umphakathi kwiKhansela lesifunda elizophatha ukuphathwa kwezinga lomoya futhi uhlele izindaba ezihlobene nezinga lomoya esifundeni. Isifunda ngasinye kumele siqoke umphakathi wezinga lomoya ozophatha umsebenzi wokuhlela izindaba zokuphathwa kwezinga lomoya esifundeni. Umphakathi wezinga lomoya kumele wenze imisebenzi noma usebenzise amandla anikezwe wona ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Umphakathi wezinga lomoya ungadlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi ekhulumayo esigabeni 4 kumuntu osebenza ehhovisi lalo mphakathi, kuphela ngaphansi kwezimo nezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe, ngokulandela isigaba 46. Amaphoyisa ezinga lomoya kumele ahlele imisebenzi yawo ngendlela ethile ethunyelwe ngesisekelo sezwe noma nguNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 46. Isigaba ngasinye sokuphathwa kweMithetho Yezemvelo eNingizimu Afrika kumele sihlanganise njengengxenye yesu, uhlelo lokuphatha izinga lomoya. KuHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe olukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 25 seMthetho Wamasipala, isifunda ngasinye kumele sifake isu lokuphatha izinga lomoya. c ngokuhambisana nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo esingase sithathwe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi komthetho ophakanyisiwe esigabeni 46. d Imisebenzi yokuhlola izinga lomoya. b indawo idinga isenzo esithile sokuphatha izinga lomoya ukuze kulungiswe isimo esikhona. b indawo ibheke ngaphandle kwemingcele yesifunda esinye; noma c indawo ingaphansi kwesifunda lapho leso sifunda sicela uNgqongqoshe ukuba akhombise le ndawo njengendawo ebalulekile. Ngokwesigaba 1, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezinga lomoya esifundeni angakhombisa indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda njengendawo ebalulekile. UNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezinga lomoya ezifundeni ezimbili noma ngaphezulu angakhetha ngesikhathi esisodwa ukukhombisa indawo ngaphakathi kwalawo masifunda njengemisebenzi ebalulekile. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, uNgqongqoshe kazwelonke noma wesifunda kumele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isahluko 1: Izinsuku Zokuthula UMsizi wayephumile emsebenzini, ebheke ekhaya eHammanskraal. Umoya wawubukeka kahle, nezinyoni zibhakabhakela phezulu. Njengoba ilanga lishona, izinkanyezi ziqala ukukhanya. Ngokungazelelwe, uMsizi wahlangana nezehlakalo ezazingalindelekile. Ngaleso sikhathi, wathola isikhumbuzo sikaMnumzane Mthethwa, ophume imoto yakhe yokuqala ngosuku olufanayo. "Uthole zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo?" kubuza uDineo, othandana naye. Isahluko 2: Ukuqhamuka Kwehlazo Ngesikhathi bexoxa, kwavela ugwayi wezingozi ezivela kwenye indlela. Izimoto zabe zikhanya, futhi ummemezelo wokuqala washaya uphondo. Kwakukhona imoto eyodwa ethwele umphakathi wabasebenzi, edlula ngesivinini esikhulu. UMsizi, onokukhathazeka, waphuma esikhathini esincane. Wabona imoto eqhulwini yempilo, izinkanyezi zicacile phezu kwayo. "Ngabe kukhona okungahambi kahle?" kubuza uMsizi, ehlola izimo ezinzima. Isahluko 3: Ukuqondisa Impilo Njengoba ubuchwepheshe busiza, uMsizi waqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuphila. Izimoto zabe ziqhuba izinkulumo, umphakathi waqeqeshela ukushayela kahle. UMsizi wayaphakathi kwezimoto ezimangalisayo, eqhuba izinyathelo ezibukhali, uDineo enza izixazululo. "Yebo, sithole ukudaba," kusho uMnguni, umphakathi osebenza nezingane. "Hlanganani, asithathe imoto. Kuzodingeka sihlole nosuku lonke," kuphetha uMsizi. Isahluko 4: Ukujwayela Nezimo Eziphuthumayo UMsizi wathola umhlaba wokwakha isimo esisha. Uthando lo mndeni lwalubonakala, futhi wahlanganyela nezinsiza. "Ngingakwazi ukuvuma ukuphuma?" kubuza uDineo, efuna ukungena kulokho okwakudingeka. UMsizi wanikela, "Hamba, wenze imiphumela emihle." Isahluko 5: Ukuqopha Izinhliziyo Zomphakathi Uhlelo lwaqhamuka, bazonqoba iziphithiphithi. Izimoto zindizela, zikhanya ukuxhumana. UMsizi wathola impilo, ephindaphindeka ngendlela enhle. Umoya wawubukeka uphinde wethule, umndeni wawubamba. Ukuze izinhliziyo ziqhubeke, ubuchwepheshe bwakhiwe ukuze buhamba phambili. Isahluko 6: Ukuqalisa UMsizi wathola umsebenzi, uhlelo lwezimoto eziphuthumayo lwazinzile. Umphakathi uxhaswe, uMnumzane Mthethwa washona esikhumbuzweni. UMsizi wayezwa ebumnandini, impilo yayingenza, imoto eyodwa inikeza umphakathi izixazululo ezintsha. Isahluko 7: Ubulungiswa Budinga Isibindi UMsizi waphinda wangenela umphakathi, amakinhi zibazisa impilo. Izinyathelo zikhuluma phakathi kwesimo esisha, umphakathi ufana noMoya wendlela. UMsizi wanika izinyathelo ezinzima, isimo esiphuthumayo sihamba phambili. Njengoba izinkanyezi ziqhakaza, uthando nemicabango yokuphila yahlala. UMsizi washintsha ubuchwepheshe bemoto, ethola izinyathelo eziphezulu, uDineo wathokozisa umphakathi. Isiphetho: Ubufakazi Bempilo UMsizi wasuka phakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo, edlula indlela uMnumzane Mthethwa ngonembeza oluqinile. Njengoba izimoto zikhanya, umphakathi wafunda ukubaluleka kokuphendula. UMsizi, uDineo, nobuchwepheshe baphakanyiswa, izinqumo ezinqala zaziyilanga olusha. UMsizi wahamba nomoya omusha phambili, edlula izimo ezinzima.
Inkolo Nomoya Emkhathini owawugubungele idolobhana elincane elalibizwa ngokuthi uMfumalanga, kwakukhona abantu abahloniphekile ababesebenzisa inkolo njengesikhumbuzo sokuhle. Babezokhuluma ngezimfundiso zabo ngemibono ethokozisayo, baphinde beza nemikhosi emikhulu yokuhlanganyela. Kule ndawo, inkolo kwakungaphezu kokholo; kwakuwumoya owawuhambisana nabo enhliziyweni, ukwazi ukuqonda izimpilo zabo nokuqhubeka bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene. UMaMkhize, uMama omkhulu emkhaya, wayebonwa njengomholi wezenkolo. Wayeqonda kahle izinkolelo zabantu, futhi izingoma zikaMakhulu, zazingabhalwa ngendlela yokukhumbuza imihla yokuhlonipha abaphilayo nabangasekho. Ngemuva kokukhulelwa kwengane, uMaMkhize wayehlala esebenzisa isikhumbuzo seNkosi neMoya, ebonisa indlela yokuthokozisa nophoqelelwayo. Wayevezwa ngamakhono akhe okukhanyisa intshonalanga, ememezela izikhalazo ezazikhulunywa ngezinkanyezi zenkolelo. Ngemva kokuphuma kwelanga, uMaMkhize wayefunda kubantwana, ebaphethe ngezinsuku zempilo zesintu. Ikhaya lale nkolo laligcwele izimfundiso ezibhaliwe phansi. "Noma izinsuku zikhanya, kulandela isiko lethu," wayeqhubeka ethi. "Inkolo yisisekelo sokuhlanganisa umndeni, sithandazela isimo sengqondo esihle." Ngesikhathi sokwenziwa kwemikhosi, abantu bebenomoya ophakanyisiwe. Umoya wawuvulwe ngezingoma, izikhumbuzo zothando nokuhlonipha kwemithombo yabo. Isiko lokukhuleka laliyinsika eyayiqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Kwakufanele uhloniphe imiphakathi, eziyindilinga ezincane nokubaluleka kokuhlonipha umoya. “UbuMoya buhambisana nomoya wethu,” uMaMkhize wayephinda njalo, ethula izimfundiso ezisemqoka ezazincike ezindaweni eziphakeme. Esikhathini esiningi, umkhuleko wawungenisa abantu emoyeni. UMaMkhize wayebathumele ngokuphathelene nezikhathi zothando, uchwepheshe ekuhlinzekeni ngempilo ejabulisayo. Ngemva kwemikhuleko, abantu babelokhu bejabulela umoya ophakanyisiwe, bezwa uMoya kanti baphakathi centro bemifino nabo. Ukukunika umoya ophakeme kwakungakhumbuza ubuhle bezinto eziphilayo. Uhlanga lwesiko lwakhe, uMaMkhize wayequka izigaba. Wagenisa ishidi lokuhlanganisa abantwana, elalithinta umndeni nomoya. Izingane zazingathokozisi kuphela, zaziya ekukhulekeni, zibhalela ezandleni zabo. “Kufanele sikhumbule, uMoya udinga izinyathelo eziphakeme!” wayesho. Ngaleso sikhathi, indlela eya emoyeni yokuhlonipha yaphucuka, ibaluleka ngaphansi komoya ongenamkhawulo. Kwakunezikhathi lapho abantu babekhuluma ngezindaba ezinzima, ezazihlanganisa nempilo yabo. Kwakufanele baqonde ukuthi amalingo ayazenzakalela — izinyathelo ezinomoya, izizinde zokwethembeka, nezinye izinkinga. Ngenkathi bezincika emoyeni, uMaMkhize wabathokozisa, ebonisa indlela abangahlangabezana nezinkinga eziphathelene nemizwa. “Abohlanga bezinsuku, ngubani ongafakhile,” wayetshala izinkumbulo zezimpi ezazihlanganisiwe. Umoya, lapho usetshenziselwa ukuphakamisa izwi, waba isicinci esihambisana nezinsuku zempilo. Abesifazane abangamaNguni babengabakhumbuli besekela uMaMkhize. UMaMkhize wayebhalela izinkumbulo emizileni, ezikhumbuza ngemisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kwakungathi kudalwe umoya, uma wonke umuntu eyethembe. Kwathi lapho umoya uphakamisa njengebhande, Iziqhwaga zenzeka. UMaMkhize ngabomvu wathokoza ukuzigqaja. Phakathi komoya ohewuliwe, bathokozisa imizamo yabo, beka isigubhu esinothando tabanisa. Imikhuleko yaha ngezindlela ezimbili: … kwazulu, imanji. UMaMkhize wagubha ukusebenza phakathi kwezinye izinkanyezi. Ngaphezu kokuzithokozisa, imikhosi yafakazela isiko lesintu, iqiniso elithokozisayo elalisondela ezintweni ezisemqoka. Kwaziwa njalo ukuthi, uma umoya ungena, imisebenzi ikhuluma. Sekukhona izinsuku eziphindaphindiwe, abadala bayathokoziswa. Izesekeli zalolu hlobo kulandela abavela ezinhliziyweni zomthetho. Abantu abayikhipha onke amaphuzu, enza uthando lunamandla, behamba emkhathini unomoya wakhe omkulu. Umlando ube yinhlebo ejabulisayo, umoya uthokozisa, ingcwele, futhi ubumbene phakathi kwabo. UMaMkhize wayevuma lokhu, ukuthi nje umoya wokholo uthokozisa, ubuMoya buhamba ndawonye nomoya kanye namathuba. Ngomoya, umuntu wonke uzogubha umthandazo, uMoya usitu abavukayo, labeMoyeni, ephakamisa izingoma ezibhalwa ngobuqotho. Emkhathini uphinde uqhubeke, ludumo lwezinwele ezishubile, kwasuka umoya, kanti ibhodi yomoya yenzeka. Ukufuna, umoya umncane phansi, nokusebenza, kwenza kube nzima ukufunzwa. Noma uthando ludinga umoya ophakeme, umkhuleko uthengisa izinkumbulo. Bahlala bejabulile, indawo ehambelana nezimo zomuntu kanti uMaMkhize, wahamba phakathi kwamazinga ezinkanyezi, ebonisa okukhanyayo kumoya. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka, umoya uhlezi eduze nezinsuku, ubumbene, ikakhulukazi emkhathini. Umhlaba uqhubeka nomoya. UMaMkhize wayebona umgubho wempilo uqhubekayo, kanti umoya uhlezi uqhubeka, ungashintshi. Ngaleyo ndlela, abantwana bahlala bezithokozisa behamba ngemigqa yomoya, ubuhlobo obuhluke kancane, kodwa bobabili berekoding. Nakuba izinto zishintshile, umoya uhlala uphinde uphakamise. Umlando, umoya, unguMaMkhize, uthina, kuwumoya. Umoya wakho ukhanya namuhla, uqhubeka nokukhanya, uthokozisa umhlaba, uqhubeka busuku nobusuku.
Umfuyi Wonyaka ka-2010 - Free State uphumelele futhi! Isithombe: William Matasane, umfuyi wethu wonyaka ka-2010. Eminyakeni edlule, bekukhona umncintiswano omkhulu phakathi kwabafuyi baseFree State nabakuleNorth West. Kubonakala ukuthi bekukhona abafuyi abane bephila eNorth West kanye nabane bephila eFree State. Ngonyaka ka-2011 sizobona ukuthi iyiphi indawo ezophuma kuyo umkhiqizi ophakeme! UWilliam Matasane ungumfuyi ozinikele. Ukhethe ukufuywa njengomsebenzi futhi wenza kahle kakhulu. Sike sakhuluma kwamanye amadokhumenti ukuthi uWilliam ukhula ufulawa nezinkukhu, uphakamisa izinkomo eziningi nezimvu. Uthenge ifamu yakhe futhi uqasha emasimini angeziwe ukuze andise ukufuywa kwakhe. UWilliam unakekela kahle umndeni wakhe futhi uphatha kahle abasebenzi bakhe - simfisela: 'Siyavuma!'.
Lo mbhalo uveza uhlaka lwezombusazwe lokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokwahlulela zendabuko ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Ugwema umbono nezinhlelo zohlaka lwezombusazwe, kuhlanganisa ukukhuthazwa kwezindinganiso zamasiko ezikhuthaza ukuxhumana komphakathi, ukuthula, nokuphila ndawonye. Uxoxa ngendima yobuholi bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kanye nesidingo sokuba nomfanekiso ofanele wobuholi ngesikhathi esisha sokudemokhrasi. Lo mbhalo ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwezindinganiso zomthetho ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezomthetho lwendabuko kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezifanele zokwenza kube lula izindima nemisebenzi yobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kokwahlulela.
G. Izeluleko Ebalulekile Mayelana Nokuphatha Izimpawu Zezifo Nokwandisa Ukudla Okunempilo. Impilo yethu, indlela esizizwa ngayo, umsebenzi, nokudlala, indlela esikhula ngayo futhi sithuthuka ngayo - konke kuthonywa ukudla esikudlayo. Ukudla kunikeza umzimba izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze ube nempilo futhi uqine. Izakhi zifaka phakathi ama-protein, ama-carbohydrate, amafutha, ama-vithamini, imithombo, namanzi. Le phampu ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nendima ebalulekile ukudla okudlalayo ekuqineni uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba ukuze luphikise izifo futhi lusize ekubuyiseni. Inhloso iwukukhuthaza ukuthi unakekele isimo sokudla somguli ngamunye osesimweni sokugula okukhululekile futhi usebenzise ukudla okunempilo njengesisekelo esibalulekile ohlelweni lwakho lokwelapha. Kulolu documet, abantu abasemzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile bafaka bonke abaguli abaneziguli ezikhululekile abadinga ukwesekwa okwengeziwe kokudla ukuze bagweme ukulahlekelwa isisindo nokubola - ikakhulukazi abaguli abane-HIV, umdlavuza, i-tuberculosis, noma ezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza. Enye yezindlela zokuphula leli cyclus eliyingozi ukudla ukudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo kukhuphula amandla omzimba okuphikisa izifo nezifo, kukhuphula amandla, futhi kwenza umuntu azizwe eqinile futhi engcono. Lokhu kungasiza ukuhamba phambili kwesifo. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungasiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuzivikela lusezingeni eliphezulu ukuze sikwazi ukuphikisa izifo. Wonke umuntu udinga ukudla ukudla okufanele ukuze ahlale enempilo. Nokho, kubantu abasemzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi badle ukudla okunempilo, njengoba besengozini enkulu yokuntula izakhi. Ukungadli okwanele, ukulahleka kwezakhi okweqile, kanye nokuntula izakhi kubantu abagulayo kuholela ekulahlekelweni isisindo nasekuboleni, kunciphisa uhlelo lokuzivikela futhi kukhuphula ubungozi bezifo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasemzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile badla ngendlela efanele. Ukuvimbela ukulahleka kwesisindo nokukhuthaza ukwanda kwesisindo. Ukubuyisela zonke izakhi ezilahlekile ngesikhathi sokugula nokuhlanza. Ukukhuthaza ukudla izinhlobonhlobo zokudla okunempilo (ukudla okunomsoco nokudla okunamandla emithini ngayinye) kunezindlela eziningi zokugcina uhlelo lokuzivikela lukhona. Ukulungisa ukudla komguli ukuze kuhambisane nezimpawu zabo zokugula. Ukuncoma umguli ngendawo efanele yokudla okufanele bacabangele ukuthi umguli angakuthola yini. Hlola isisindo somguli futhi ugcine irekhodi lesisindo kukhadi lekliniki. Buza umguli ukuthi udla ini ngokuvamile ukuze uthole ukuthi yikuphi ukudla abakudlayo, izimo zabo zomnotho, nokuthi yikuphi ukudla abangakuthola. Thola ukuthi kukhona amanzi aphephile kanye negesi etholakalayo. Thola umlando wezimpawu zokugula zomguli. Siza umguli ukuhlela ukudla kwabo, ucabangele isimo sabo sezomnotho nezinye izimfanelo ukuze kuhambisane nesimo somguli. Uma umguli elahlekile isisindo, nikeza iziphakamiso zokwandisa isisindo somzimba. Nikeza umguli izeluleko zokuphatha ukudla ngokuphepha. Hlela ukuhamba phambili ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zicebiso ziyalandelwa. Kunezindlela eziningi zokudla okunempilo. Ngamunye wethu udla ngendlela ehlukile ngenxa yezimo zethu zomnotho, ukukhetha ukudla, inkolo, isiko, njll. Kubalulekile ukukhetha lokhu uma uncoma abaguli ngokuqhubekayo kokudla okunempilo. Ukuze ugweme izifo, ukuntula ukudla, nokulahleka kwesisindo okungafuneki, khuthaza abaguli ukuthi bangalibali, baqale ukunaka kakhulu udaba lokudla okunempilo manje. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukulungisa ukuntula izakhi emzimbeni uma sebesebenzile kakhulu futhi begula kakhulu! Akukho uhlobo olulodwa lokudla olungasinika konke esikudingayo! Khuthaza abantu ukuthi badle izinhlobonhlobo zokudla - ukudla abangakuthola futhi abakutholayo kalula. Kunconywa ukuthi umuntu adle izinhlobo ezintathu zokudla ezahlukene nsuku zonke. Khuthaza abantu ukuthi baphuze phakathi kokudla (okuphuzwayo) njengoba lokhu kusiza kakhulu uma othile enezinkinga zokudla okwanele ngesikhathi sokudla. Nansi isithombe ongasebenzisa ukukhombisa abaguli ukuthi kulula kanjani ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo ezinkundleni ezahlukene zokudla. Ukudla okune-starch njenge-bread, porridge, cereals, rice, potatoes, yam, maize, pasta kufanele kube yingxenye enkulu yokudla kwabo. Ngokuvamile, lezi zinto azibizi kakhulu futhi zinikeza izakhi eziningi ngemali. Khuthaza abaguli ukuthi bafake ukudla okwengeziwe ezindaweni ezine-starch ukuze prepari ukudla okuxubile. Imifino nezithelo zinikeza umthombo wama-vithamini nemithombo ukusiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuzivikela lukhona. Khuthaza abaguli obakhathalelayo ukuthi badle izinhlobo eziningi zezithelo nemifino ngangokunokwenzeka. Imifino nezithelo ezinemibala efana ne-yellow, orange, red, noma dark green kufanele zidle nsuku zonke, isibonelo, spinach, pumpkin, carrots, apricots, papaya, kanye ne-mango. Izithelo ezifana ne-oranges, lemons, ne-guavas, kanye ne-mango kanye ne-tomato zinikeza i-vitamin C esiza ekuphikisaneni nezifo. Abaguli kufanele bahlosise ukudla izithelo nemifino/izinkonzo eziyisishiyagalombili zemifino ngosuku. Inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, kanye namaqanda angadliwa nsuku zonke. Phakathi kwezinye izakhi ezitholakalayo, lezi zinto zinikeza umzimba ama-protein. Ngesikhathi sokugula, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba umuntu abe ne-protein eyanele. Inyama yenkukhu, inyama yengulube, inyama yenkukhu, inhlanzi, umgudu, ikhala, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, i-tripe, izinyawo zenkukhu, amaqanda, ubisi, ushizi, i-yogurt, ubisi oluphothiwe (hhayi i-coffee creamer), ushizi, kanye nezinye izinyoni ezithile. Lapho zithengwa esitolo, lezi zinto zivame ukuba zibhakabhaka - khuthaza labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuba baphile izinkukhu, izinkomo, izimvu, izinkunzi, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izilwane ekhaya ukuze bathole inyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho ngebisi. Lezi zinto zisebenza ezitshalweni, futhi zinikeza ama-protein nezinye izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze uqine uhlelo lokuzivikela nomzimba. Khuthaza abaguli ukuthi badle kakhulu amabhontshisi, amabele, ama-lentils, kanye nama-soybeans angasetshenziswa njengokufaka inyama ukuze prepari ukudla okungabizi. Kulabo abangakwazi ukudla inyama emzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile, lezi zinto kufanele zibe yingxenye ebalulekile yohlelo lwabo lokudla okunempilo. Abaguli bangafaka ushukela kanye namafutha ohlelweni lwabo lokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kudla kukhuphula inani lamandla atholakalayo kokudla futhi kusiza ukwenza ukudla kube mnandi, ngaphezu kokukhuphula ukudla okutholakalayo. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu uma umguli engakwazi ukudla ukudla okuningi. Abaguli kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi amafutha amaningi angadala ukuhamba. Usawoti omningi ungakhuphula umfutho wegazi. Icholera yisifo esitholwa umuntu ngokuphuza amanzi nokudla okungcolile nge-bacteria yecholera. I-bacteria ebangela icholera itholakala emfucumfucu yomuntu. Icholera spread kanjani? Ungasebenzisi umfula njengento yokuhlanza, kodwa sebenzisa indlu yangasese efanele. Geza izandla zakho ngamanzi aphekiwe noma insipho ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese nangaphambi kokuphatha ukudla. Ungamsiza kanjani umuntu ongocholera? Mnika amanzi amaningi ahlanganiswe noshukela/ukhala ukuze aphuze. Thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi aphekiwe, engeza ama-teaspoon ayisishiyagalombili noshukela kanye nohhafu we-teaspoon yokhala, bese uhlanganisa. Nika umuntu ogulayo le miphumela ukuze aphuze kancane futhi kaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Khumbula, qhubeka unikeza lo mshanelo noshukela/ukhala kumuntu ongocholera. Thutha lowo muntu ngokushesha uye esikhungweni sezempilo noma esibhedlela ngangokunokwenzeka. Uma udinga olunye ulwazi, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi ungase ube necholera, vakashela esikhungweni sezempilo, esibhedlela, kudokotela, noma kumsebenzi wezempilo oseduzane nawe.
Izikole Zikahulumeni: Ukuhlola Umsebenzi Wazo Emphakathini Izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi. Lezi zikole zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantwana, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali, bathola ukufinyelela emfundweni esezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba imfundo iyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane. Ukwakhiwa Kwezikole Zikahulumeni Izikole zikahulumeni ziqalwa nguhulumeni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi imfundo iyatholakala kubo bonke. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikole ezisemadolobheni, ezisemaphandleni, kanye nezikole ezikhethekile ezibhekene nezidingo ezithile. Uhlelo lwezikole zikahulumeni luhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene, kusukela ezikoleni zokuqala (primary schools) kuya ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu (high schools). Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola imfundo eqinile kusukela besencane, kuze kube sekupheleni kwemfundo yabo. Izinsiza Nezinhlelo Zokufunda Izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zihlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola imfundo efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezincwadini, izikhungo zokufunda, kanye nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe. Uhlelo lwezifundo luhlelwa ukuze luhambisane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi luhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuncintisana emakethe yomsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe nezinhloso eziphakeme, futhi zikhuthaza ukuzibophezela emfundweni. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Noma kunjalo, izikole zikahulumeni zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, izikhala eziningi, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokushoda kwezisebenzi zokufundisa, kubangela ukuthi abafundi bangatholi imfundo efanele. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinga eliphakeme lokuphuma kwezikole, okungaholela ekutheni abanye abafundi bangatholi amathuba afanele empilweni. Uhlelo lokuxhasa izikole zikahulumeni lufuna ukuba luthuthukiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izikole zithola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Umthelela Emphakathini Izikole zikahulumeni zineqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Zisiza ekwakheni ubuhlakani, ubumbano, kanye nokuhlonipha phakathi kwabafundi. Abafundi abavela ezikoleni zikahulumeni bahlala bephumelela emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ezemidlalo, ubuciko, kanye nezifundo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba kuthuthukisa umphakathi jikelele, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bethu bahlala bephokophele phambili. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni ziqhubeka nokusebenza kahle, uhulumeni udinga ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwandisa izinsiza, ukuqeqesha othisha, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nomphakathi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho Izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi. Noma zikhona izinselelo eziningi, umgomo wazo uwukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kubo bonke abantwana. Ukuze lezi zikole ziqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, othisha, nabazali basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola imfundo efanele. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuhlakani.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, sikhula nezinselelo ezithokozisayo eziphuthumayo. Izimo ezinjengokuhlaselwa kwezimo zokukhanya, izikhukhula, noma izigameko zezempi zifaka izingqinamba ezinzima ekuphathweni kwesikhathi sokuphendula. Ukuze sikwazi ukusiza ukusindisa izimpilo, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima zokuthuthukisa lezi zinsuku zobungozi. Ngokokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula singenza umphakathi wethu uqhamuke ngaphakathi. Uhlelo olungasebenzi kahle lungadala ukushoda kokuphendula kwezinhloso eziphuthumayo. Ukuze sithuthukise lokhu, kudingeka sithuthukise izinhlelo zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, amabhizinisi, nemiphakathi. Imithetho nezinhlelo zempilo kufanele kusebenze ngokuhlanganyela, ukuze amaqembu anokuphendula okusheshayo. Okulandelayo, ukukhulisa ukufundiswa kwamasu ayisisekelo ezimeni eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Ngabe sizokwazi ukuvikela umuntu ongazi lutholekile? Nansi indlela efanele. Ukuqhuba izifundo ezithinta ezokuphepha nezokuphendula ezinganeni nakubantu abadala kuyasiza ukwandisa ukuqonda kwabantu mayelana nezingozi abazibhekile. Ukufaka imfundiso ngalokhu ezikoleni, ezindaweni zomphakathi, nakuma-seminar kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bunika ithuba elikhulu lokukhulisa isikhathi sokuphendula. Ubuchwepheshe be-ICT, i-inthanethi, nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zinikeza amathuba okuxhumana nempumelelo. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza, kumele sikhuthaze i-automation ukuze sithuthukise izinqubo zokuphendula. Lokhu kuzoholela ekunciphiseni isikhathi esidingekayo sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlola izinto ezikhona, njengokuthuthuka kwezokuthutha, kubalulekile. Uhlelo olunembile lokuhamba nezinsiza ezifanele kuyasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izinsiza ziyasiza abantu abadingayo. Lokhu kungafaka izinto ezifana nezimoto zokuhlenga, imishini yokuthutha, nezinsiza zokwakha. Ukwenza izinhlelo ezihamba phambili, isibonelo, izikhungo zokuhlenga eziphuthumayo eziseduze zidinga ukucabANGwa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu báhamba nempumelelo. Kukhona futhi udaba lokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe. Izinxushunxushu ezishiwo ngezinye izikhathi zingathinta izindawo eziningi kakhulu. Ukuze sikwazi ukunciphisa izimo eziyingozi, amaphoyisa, iziphathimandla zezempilo, neminyango yokuhlengenzimeni kumele badlulisele izifundo zabo phakathi kwezinkinga. Kukhona umbono omuhle othi "ukuzinikezela kufanele kube ubuchwepheshe obuthokozisayo.” Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe ukuze kuphathwe izimo eziphuthumayo kuyasiza ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula ngokuhlanganyela. Okokugcina, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezikhala zokuphendula akukhona okukhanya kuphela. Kuqukethe umqondo wobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ukwenza amalungiselelo, nokuhlonipha izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa umphakathi ophilayo futhi olungele amaphrojekthi akhula. Umphakathi obambisene unedumela elihle, futhi ubuchwepheshe bokuphendula esikhathini esifushane buyelebazela ukukhuluma okukhulu. Ngokuhlanganisa zonke lezi zindlela, kufanele kube khona ukuzimisela okukhulu nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlanganyela, ukufunda, ubuchwepheshe, nokubambisana kuzokwenza sikwazi ukulawula izimo eziphuthumayo ngendlela ebhalwe ngaphansi. Uma sihlanganyela, sithuthukisa ikusasa lethu, sinesiqiniseko sokuthi sizokwazi ukuphendula ngendlela efanele, isikhathi esifushane nesesha zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sifeze lokhu. Ngakho-ke, okubalulekile wukwazi ukuqhubeka nohlu olunembile, nokwenza okusemandleni ethu ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, ukuze sikwazi ukusindisa izimpilo nokwakha umphakathi onobuchule. Lokhu akusisodwa kuphela kwethu, kodwa isikhumbuzo sokuthi lesi sikhathi sokuphendula sisonke, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi sithuthukisa umphakathi ophilayo.
Empeleni, "ukwakha" kubhekisela emshape nasekubonakaliseni kwesikhumbuzo esithokozisayo. Ezinye izakhiwo ziqhutshwa umsebenzi wesikhumbuzo kanti ezinye ziqhutshwa ukuhweba okuhle. Ukuklama okuhle ngokubheka ukubonakala kwayo kufanele kube nesizotha futhi kube nekhono, kube nobuhle emshape yayo, ukuhlela kahle izingxenye ezahlukene; noma ukuhweba; futhi kufanele kube sobala ukuthi kukhiqizwe ngezinqubo zezimboni. Kufanele kube nesimo noma ukuhlela kwezingxenye okuqhutshwa umsebenzi wazo; futhi kufanele kube sobala ukuthi kukhiqizwe ngezinqubo zezimboni. Nakuba kungadingeki ukwenza ucwaningo ukuze kuhlolwe ubungcweti nokwakhiwa okusha, noma ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho ukuklama okufanayo noma okuphakathi kokufana okubhalisiwe ngaphambili, kungcono ukwenza njalo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ucwaningo lokwakha lungaqhutshwa ehhovisi le-Design Registry ePitoli. Kufanele kwenziwe ngumuntu noma ummeli, ofana nommeli we-patent. Uma ukuklama kabulwa njengokusha kokubhaliswa, uzonikezwa isitifiketi sokwakha. Ukuklama kuhlaziywa njalo eminyakeni emithathu. Nikeza ikhophi yesitifiketi sakho sokubhaliswa esiqinisekisiwe. Ngemva kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka eyisithupha, kuqhutshelwa ukuhlolwa kwesiko, bese kukhishwa ukubhaliswa kokwakha enyangeni yesixhenxe.
Ngiyithola kanjani umhlaba? Kukho umbuzo ohlale ufika lapha kithi: "Ngifuna umhlaba (ifama). Ungangisiza?" Impendulo yethu njalo ithi "Cha, asikwazi." Sizama ukusiza abalimi ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development, kodwa asikwazi ukusiza abantu ukuthola umhlaba? Uma sizama ukwenza lokhu, ngeke kube nesikhathi sokuthuthukisa abalimi ngoba kukhona abantu abaningi abafuna ukuthola umhlaba nokuqala ukufama. Ohlelweni lwethu, sizama ukweseka labo abantu abanomhlaba nezinsiza. Ngemuva kuka-1994, kwasungulwa iMnyango omusha weZwe. Lo Mnyango waqala izinhlelo ezintsha zokushintsha ubunikazi bomhlaba. Lapha sizoxoxa kuphela ngokuqiniswa komhlaba, hhayi izimangalo zomhlaba nokushintsha kobunikazi. Khumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwethu luhlose ukuphakamisa abalimi bezomnotho, ngakho sizama ukusiza ukuthi basebenzise umhlaba wabo ngendlela efanele; asikwazi ukusiza abanye abafuna ukusungula amanye amabhizinisi. Uhlelo lokuqala lweMnyango weZwe kwakuyi-Settlement Land Acquisition Grant (SLAG). Lokhu kwakuhambisana kakhulu negranti enikezwa abantu ukuze bathenge indlu - R15,000. Nokho, akukho ifama engathengwa ngo-R15,000. Abantu baphinde bahlangana ukuze bathenge ifama. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani le nhlanganisela yokubamba umhlaba ingasebenzi kahle. Ngokuvamile, abaningi bacabanga ukuthi bangazuza ngokushesha ekufameni, kodwa babengenalo ulwazi lokufama futhi babengenakuphatha ibhizinisi. Kwakungekho mfuneko yokuthi labo abathola umhlaba bahlale efameni. IMnyango weZwe yashesha yaqaphela ukuthi 'SLAG' ayisebenzi kahle futhi yethula 'LRAD'. Kwakuyigranti enikezwa umuntu ngamunye (hhayi igalelo lomndeni). Umuntu onengcebo yakhe angathola igalelo elikhulu kunalesi (isibonelo: uma umuntu enama-R400,000, igalelo lakhe lingakhula laya ku-R100,000). Bawethula lokhu ukuze bakhange abantu abanokwazi abangaqinisekisa ibhizinisi. Kwakungekho mfuneko yokuthi labo abathola umhlaba bahlale efameni. IMnyango weZwe yabona ukuthi ngisho nalolu hlelo alusebenza kahle, ngakho baqala uhlelo olusha - iProactive Land Acquisition Scheme. Ekuqondeni kwabo, lokhu kuzokwenza labo abafuna ukufama bakwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi bangasebenzisa ifama ngaphambi kokuyinika. Uhlelo lwe-PLAS lusebenza kanje: Uhulumeni uthenga ifama ukuze anikeze abantu. Bese le ifama iyakhangiswa. Labo abafuna ukuyithola kufanele bakhombise (baveze) ngokucacile futhi banikeze izizathu ezichaza ukuthi bazofama kanjani. Isikhathi sokuphatha salo muntu ophatha ifama sithatha iminyaka emithathu, emva kwalokho bangathola ifama. Uma kuba sobala ukuthi bahluleka ukufama kahle, omunye "umphathi" ofuna ukufama uzobekwa endaweni yabo. Lolu hlelo lokushintsha ubunikazi bomhlaba lulethe nezinye izinkinga. Kwakungekho mfuneko yokuthi labo abathola umhlaba bahlale efameni. Lezi "zikhulu" zithola ifama esebenzayo ethola inzuzo, kodwa kaningi abazi lutho ngazo zonke izinto eziphathelene nokuphatha ifama. Kaningi izinsiza nezinsiza ezisemafamini zibhujiswa futhi azisebenzi kahle. Izindleko zokutshala ihektare eyodwa zingafinyelela ku-R5,000. Uma umlimi efuna ukutshala amahektare angu-200, okungesiyo indawo enkulu uma sikhuluma ngotshalo lwezomnotho, kusho ukuthi bazodinga ama-R1,000,000 kuphela ukuze babeke imbewu emhlabeni (lapho singakhulumi ngezindleko zokugcina nokulungisa ama-tractors nezinye izinsiza). Umlimi akasesona isikhulu sezinkambu futhi kaningi ubandakanyeka ulwazi oluhambisana nokufama. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi bazophoxa ukuza nemali edingekayo ukuze baqale ukukhiqiza. Ake sithi umlimi unayo imali edingekayo yokutshala nokulungisa izinsiza. Ucabanga ukuthi umuntu ohlakaniphile uzophonsa leyo mali yonke emapulazini kahulumeni nasezinsizeni ezingezakhe? Emafamini lapho kutholwa khona, kukhona imishini ehlukene - i-plough, i-disc, i-harrow, i-disc yokusika trasi, i-cultivator, i-rotovator, nezinye eziningi. Uma umlimi (ofuna ukufama) engakaze asebenze efamini, ngeke azi ukuthi iyiphi imishini enza umsebenzi muni - bazoyilungisa kanjani lezi zinto futhi bazisebenzise kahle? Umusho owodwa kule nkontileka phakathi komphathi kanye neMnyango weZwe uthi umphathi akavunyelwe ukuqasha lelo land noma ukubambisana nomlimi omunye ukuze afune lelo land. Ngaphandle kwezimali zokuqala zokutshala, ngaphandle kwemvume yokufama nomuntu onolwazi, umphathi uzofunda kanjani umsebenzi wokufama? Engxoxweni yethu lapha ngenhla, kubonakala ukuthi imizamo yethu yokushintsha ubunikazi bomhlaba ngendlela ezothokozisa wonke umhlaba wethu ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izinselelo eziningi esingazazi ukuthi zizovela, kodwa abasebenzi abakhonza iMnyango wezolimo bazame ukucacisa lezi zinkinga. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sibe nesikhathi esinzima. Kodwa kumele sibhekane neqiniso lamanje. Esikhathini esedlule, ukufama kwakusezandleni zabantu abamhlophe (amaAfrikaner), ngakho kufanele sisekele ukuhlanganiswa kwabafama bezomnotho nalabo abafuna ukukhula emkhakheni wokufama. Imizamo kahulumeni kufanele ihlolwe futhi lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngesikhathi esifanele. Kukhona amaphrojekthi amaningi aphumelele ngenxa yezinhlelo esizixoxile lapha ngenhla. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi lokhu kwenzeke (buka ngenhla). Kubonakala ukuthi iMnyango omusha we-Rural Development and Land Reform uhlose ukuvivinya lezi zinhlelo ukuze umhlaba uqale ukukhiqiza ukudla ngaphambi kokuthi amaphrojekthi amasha aqale. Uma sifuna ukuvivinya lezi zinhlelo kube nomphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle ukuthi kwenzekeni ukuze zihluleke - ngisho noma izizathu zokuhluleka kwalezi nezi zingafani. Kulula ukuthi uhlelo oluthile luhluleke ngoba bekungekho mali. Yebo, ukungabi namali bekungumsebenzi, kodwa ukukhetha uhlelo oluthile bese kufakwa imali kuphela akuzukuvusa - kaningi kuzodala nezinye izinkinga ngoba labo abalahlekelwe imali ekuqaleni bazobuyela ngethemba lokubuyisela imali kulolu hlelo olusha. Siphakamisa kuphela "abaphathi" abazophila efamini. Ukufama akukuhle uma ungakaze ube khona efamini ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kufanele singenise "abaphathi" ohlelweni oluzobafundisa ukufama futhi bathuthukise amakhono abo. Lolu hlelo kufanele luphathwe ngombutho wabakhiqizi kule ndawo ophatha izinsiza ukuze abalimi abasha bakwazi ukuhlanganiswa nabafama bezomnotho ekuqaleni. Uma sifuna ukushintsha kwezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika kusebenze kahle, sidinga ukuhlanganisa izandla, sifunde ukuzethemba, futhi sihlanganise imikhakha yezolimo ukuze ukufama kube yisisekelo lapha ezindaweni zasemakhaya ezweni lethu.
IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament libambe umhlangano walo wokuqala e-Addis Ababa ngoMashi 2004, futhi ngoJulayi walo nyaka, kwanqunywa ukuthi i-PAP izoba seNingizimu Afrika. IPhalamende selokhu libambe imihlangano yalo yesibili neyokuthathu ngokulandelana eMidrand, eNingizimu Afrika. Umhlangano wesibili wawugxile kakhulu ekwamukeleni imithetho nezindlela ze-PAP kanye nezikhalazo zayo, kanye nezinkulumo ngamasu, ingxoxo, kanye nezinhlelo ze-African Union. IPhalamende lePan-African okwamanje lisasezingeni lokushintsha noma lilawulwa okwamanje, lineminyaka emihlanu eGallagher Estate eMidrand. INingizimu Afrika, ngeMnyango Wezangaphandle, iPhalamende Lesifunda, idlale indima ebalulekile empumelelweni yemihlangano yesibili neyokuthathu yePhalamende. INingizimu Afrika igcine ukuzibophezela kwayo ngaphansi kweSivumelwano sokuba yizwe elamukela futhi iphinde yanikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe, njengokuhlinzeka ngabasebenzi, njengoba iPhalamende lePan-African lalingakasebenzi ngokuphelele, njengokuhola abasebenzi. IPhalamende lePan-African langena emahhovisi awo amasha nomhlangano wesithathu. IKomidi Lezomnotho, Lezenhlalo Nezamasiko (ECOSOCC) lamukelwe yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2004, kulandela inqubo yokubonisana ende namazwe amalungu nemiphakathi. Abamele imiphakathi yase-Afrika bahlangane ehhovisi le-African Union e-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia, kusukela ngoMashi 27 kuya kuMashi 30, 2005, ukuze baqale iKomidi Lezomnotho, Lezenhlalo Nezamasiko le-African Union (ECOSOCC). Le ngxenye yomlando ibonisa ukuqala kwesigaba esisha somsebenzi we-Union mayelana nokwakhiwa kwezindlela zokusebenza ze-ECOSOCC nokwakhiwa kwenqubo yokukhetha amalungu e-ECOSOCC General Assembly. Ikhompiyutha yesikhashana yeminyaka emibili yakhethwa ukuze iqhube le nqubo. Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezinhlelo zokwakha zezimali ze-African Union, i-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yanquma ukuthi iNkantolo yase-Afrika Yamalungelo Abantu Nezizinda kanye neNkantolo ye-African Union kufanele zihlanganiswe zibe yinkantolo eyodwa. Idokhumenti yesakhiwo sezomthetho ephathelene nokwakhiwa kwale nkantolo ehlanganisiwe kufanele iqedwe ukuze icatshangelwe yi-Assembly kanye ne-Executive Council ngoJanuwari 2006. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kuvimbe ukuqala ngokushesha kweNkantolo yase-Afrika Yamalungelo Abantu, esele ikhona kulandela ukusebenza kweSivumelwano se-African Charter on Human Rights ngokwakhiwa kweNkantolo yase-Afrika Yamalungelo Abantu eqala ukusebenza ngoJanuwari 25, 2004. IKomidi le-AU lenziwe umyalelo yiKomidi Eliphezulu ukuze lenze ucwaningo oluhlosiwe lokwenza kube lula ukusebenza kwe-STC. Ukungafuni kweKomidi le-AU ukukhulula umbiko walolu cwaningo kube sekuphoqelela oNgqongqoshe balolu siko ukuba babambe imihlangano ngokwabo. INingizimu Afrika ibibe yindawo yokwamukela imihlangano yoNgqongqoshe Bezemisebenzi, Ezokuhlaliswa, EzeMisebenzi Yomphakathi Nezokuphathwa, EzeMboni Nezokuthutha ngoJulayi. Nokho, iKomidi le-AU kulindeleke ukuthi likhombise umbiko ocwaningweni kwi-AU Assembly ngoJanuwari 2006. Izinhlelo ze-AU zamukele iVision and Policy Statement ye-African Union kanye nohlelo lwezenzo lweKomidi le-AU oluhlosiwe ukuhola ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Afrika nokusebenza kwe-NEPAD. Njengomphumela, uxhaso oluhlinzekwe ezinhlelweni eziphambili ze-AU luhlolwe emhlanganweni okhethekile weKomidi Eliphezulu, obambelekile ngoSepthemba 6-7, 2004. Lo mhlangano wamukela ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$158,384 konyaka wezezimali ka-2005/2006. Ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okuhlangene kuqukethe ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$63 million kwezemisebenzi kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$95,384 kwezinhlelo. INingizimu Afrika yathumela u-8.25% wezinsiza ezabelwe zemisebenzi ngokwehlukaniswa kokuhlola. INingizimu Afrika, njengekhanda leKomidi yoNgqongqoshe, idlale indima ebalulekile enhlanganweni yokubhaliswa kweSikali Sokuhlola esiphakanyisiwe. Lesi Sikali Sokuhlola esisha samukelwa yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2005, futhi kwavunyelwana ukuthi sizohlala ku-15% ngaphandle kokuthi kwenziwe okunye. Lesi sikhala esisha sizosebenza ngoJanuwari 2006. INingizimu Afrika, ngokuxhasa ngempahla ucwaningo olwenziwa ngu-Ernest & Young oluhlosiwe ukuqinisa izindlela zezimali nezimpendulo emsebenzini we-AU, ibone umbiko ocwaningweni ukhishwa, futhi INingizimu Afrika izosekela ukusebenza okuphelele nokuphumelelayo kweziphakamiso ezenziwe ngu-Ernest & Young ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iKomidi le-AU lisebenzisa izindlela ezinhle zezimali nezimpendulo zokusebenza nokuthi izakhiwo ze-Information and Communication Technology (ICT) zeKomidi zibe sezikhathini. Uma lezi ziphakamiso zamukelwa, kulindeleke ukuthi zisetshenziswe kancane kancane, kuqala ngalezo ezithinta ukusebenza kwezimali noma abasebenzi. Ukwenziwa kwesinqumo mayelana nezakhiwo ezathathwa ngo-2003 kwi-AU Assembly eMaputo, ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi kuqhubeka. INingizimu Afrika izosebenzisa futhi ingxenye yayo eyabelwe yabasebenzi. Kuze kube manje, abantu ababili kuphela baseNingizimu Afrika bayeqashwa yiKomidi, okungukuthi uDr. B Tema (ovela eMnyangweni Wezesayensi Nezobuchwepheshe) njengomqondisi: Izinsiza Zomuntu, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe, noMs. F Lortan (ovela emphakathini) njengomphathi wezinhlelo kwiSahluko Sezokuhlaliswa Nezokuphila - esaziwa ngaphambili njenge-CSSDCA. Isifungo sokuziphendulela sinikeza wonke amazwe amalungu ithuba lokuqinisekisa ibhalansi yezenhlalo ekubambeni iqhaza. Amazwe amalungu adingeka ukuthi aqoqe umbiko obonisa imizamo eyenziwe noma ukwehluleka ukukhuthaza ukulingana kwezobulili. Umbiko wezwe kufanele uthunyelwe kwi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yiKomidi le-AU. INingizimu Afrika iphethe futhi yathumela umbiko wayo ngo-2005 kwiKomidi ngaphambi kwe-AU Assembly ebibanjelwe eSirte, eLibya ngoJulayi 2005. Kwakukhona nezinguquko ezenziwe kumadokhumenti mayelana nezikweletu ezikhokhwayo amazwe ase-Afrika kumazwe athuthukile nezikhungo ezahlukene, kanye nezohwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe, uxhaso lokuthuthukisa, ulwazi, nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana (ICT) kanye ne-HIV/AIDS. I-NEPAD iphinde yahlela izingxoxo nezinkulumo ezinkulu nemiphakathi kanye nesigaba esingahlangani. Izinhloso eziphambili nemiyalezo ye-NEPAD: Afrika ithatha umnikelo nokuphathwa kokuthuthukiswa kwekontinenti; ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano, amalungelo abantu, ukuphathwa kahle, kanye nokuholwa okwenziwayo, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo ukuze kuncishiswe ukuncika ekuxhasweni; ukwakha amakhono ezikhungo zase-Afrika; ukukhuthaza ukuhweba nokutshalwa kwezimali phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika; ukusheshisa ukuhlanganiswa kom
Ezobunjiniyela: Uhlelo Oludala Uhlanga Oluphakeme Ezobunjiniyela, isiZulu sithi, yinsika yokwakha impilo eyiqhwa, ethinta wonke umhlaba. Njengoba sigubha impumelelo yezobunjiniyela, kulapho safunda khona ukuthi yisiphi isikhala esikhulu esinokwakhiwa ukuze sifeze imiphetho emisha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ezimakethe, ukulungisa izinkinga ezikhona, futhi kubangelwa ngempela ukujula okukhona emkhakheni wezobunjiniyela. Ngokwendlela evamile, ubunjiniyela buyingxenye enkulu yokuhlelwa kwezinto. Kubalwa ukwakhiwa kwemithombo emisha, ukufundiswa kwezinsiza, ukwakhiwa kwemifula, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Ibhizinisi lazo lihlala likhula, futhi lokhu kudala amathuba amaningi emisebenzi kithi sonke. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlela ngempela indlela lezi zinhlelo ezithuthukiswe ngayo, ukuze zibe nomthelela omuhle emakethe nakumphakathi. Ngenkathi sihamba phambili, kuthe uma sicabanga ngezakhiwo ezidala, sizibona zihamba phambili ngesinye isikhathi. Isibalo sabantu abawasebenzisayo sikhuphuka, kanti nendlela yokuphila ithuthuka kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abunjiniyela bakhe izixazululo ezintsha ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukukhula kwempilo kubaluleke kakhulu, futhi isidingo sokufundisa odabeni bezobunjiniyela kuyasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sibeka izifundo eziqinile emakhanda abantu abasanda kuvela. Ukukhuluma ngothando ngethuba, kudinga ukuthi sizibuze nathi: yini engaholela ekutheni ubunjiniyela busize ukukhulisa umnotho wethu? Ukuphendula le nkinga kudinga ukufakwa ezivivinyweni ezinzima. Uma abunjiniyela besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokwakha okuhlakaniphile, bangakha izakhiwo ezihlala isikhathi eside nezivumelana nemvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezisebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, okufaka phakathi i-solar energy ne-wind energy, okwamanje izinsiza ezishibhile futhi ezihamba phambili kwezobunjiniyela. Izinselelo zokuntuleka kwenhlanzeko emphakathini zikhona, ngaleyo ndlela kubalulekile ukuba abunjiniyela baxhumane nabo ohlangothini lwezinhlelo zokwakha izinhlelo ezikhuthaza ukusimama. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile nengqalasizinda yokuhlala, uhlu oluqhubekayo lokwakha izintambo nezinsiza zokuphila. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubalulekile ngoba kudala umphakathi osebenza kahle, okhulisa umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubunjiniyela bukhombisa indlela yokufundisa. Ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme bukhombisa izindlela zokukhuthaza ukufunda ngezenzakalo ezithinta umphakathi. Noma ngabe ezibhedlela, ezikoleni, noma emakhaya, abanjiniyela basebenzisa imikhankaso yokufundisa ukuze bacebise abantu ngethuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisa ezokuthutha, ukusiza ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhamba. Okokugcina uma sikhuluma ngezobunjiniyela, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi iphupha elidumile elithi "izinkanyezi zingenziwa" liyavuma. Lokhu kudinga ukufaka imizamo ehlukahlukene yokwakha ukuphila okungcono. Amathuba okuphila koMdabu akha izidingo eziningi. Ukuthuthukiswa complaisant kuncike ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihlukahlukene, futhi lokho kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ezobunjiniyela akugcini nje ekwakheni imithetho emisha kodwa kudinga uhlobo oluthile lwezibopho phakathi kwababezinhlelo. Ukuhweba nokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene kuqukethe inhlalo, ukubukela phansi uphiko lwezempilo, nokuwina izinkanyezi eziza nezehlakalo ezintsha ezikhombisa ubunjiniyela obukhulu. Ngokujuluka, ukuhamba phambili kwezobunjiniyela kuphinde kuhlelwe izinhloso eziphakeme, kungaba endaweni engokwenziwe ngezakhiwo ezenzakalayo, ezinezinhloso ezinhle nokukhathalela imvelo. Lesi yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubunjiniyela akukhona kuphela ukudala izinto, kodwa futhi kudinga ubuhlakani, ubuchwepheshe, nezinqumo ezikhalipha, ngakho sizophela ekubeni nekhono lokubeka umgomo olinhle emhlabeni. Lokhu kuhlobene nemigomo emisha, efana nokwakha isimo sokuphila kumuntu ngamunye, emkhakheni wezobunjiniyela ozosiza ukwakha ikusasa elihle. Izwi elihle, ubunjiniyela, libhekele iMbewu.
Kunemibandela eminingi echaza intshisekelo evukile yokuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika, njengokuthi: umhlaba ophumelelayo utholakala, amanani okudla akhuphukile kakhulu, futhi kukhona ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngavailability yokudla ezweni lethu nasemhlabeni jikelele. Udaba lokuntuleka kokudla luhlala lukhuluma emhlabeni jikelele, mayelana nokugcina ukudla emhlabeni jikelele, ilungelo lokuba nokudla nendawo yokuhlala, ekugcineni, lokhu kudla kukhiqizwa umuntu othile endaweni ethile - kukhona umuntu osebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lowo muntu. Kukhona isidingo sokuthuthukisa lowo muntu nokumnika amandla ukuba abe umkhiqizi wezomnotho ozohlinzeka ukudla kwethu ezweni lapho kudingeka khona. Kungani abantu befuna ukwazi ukuthi abalimi abavela kuphi benza ini? Umkhakha wezolimo udinga ukuba nenkulumo eyodwa evumelanayo ekhulumela bona. Imikhiqizo yezolimo iyimpahla ethile enikeza ukudla emhlabeni jikelele futhi iyisisekelo somnotho sezizwe emhlabeni wonke. Imikhiqizo yezolimo inikeza umsebenzi obalulekile kubantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukukhula komnotho wendawo kwenza ingcebo yasemadolobheni ingabi nzima. Lapho u-1-30% wombuso ungena ezandleni zabantu abangakaze bathole ithuba lokuba abanikazi bomhlaba, sizobheka ukuthi u-30% wokukhiqiza kwezolimo uzovela kulabo bantu. Ngakho-ke, sicabanga ukuthi u-30% wezinto ezidingekayo kwezolimo zizothengwa kulabo abalimi. Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabakhiqizi abavela kuphi? Imikhawulo yokwenzela inzuzo ephansi yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu uma ikhiqizwa kuphela ezimeni zokunisela, kanye nezinga lokwazisa elikhuphukayo. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo etholakala ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu ibihamba phansi. Izindleko zokuqala ziyaqhubeka nokukhuphuka, kodwa intengo yemakethe ayikhuphuki ngokufanele. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa abangakwazi ukuqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokuboleka imali. Lapho imikhawulo yokwenzela inzuzo ib tight futhi izinga lokwazisa lemali ebolekiwe liphansi, kuba nguyena umphumela omkhulu ukuboleka izimali ezinkulu ukuze ukwazi ukutshala imbewu emhlabeni. Abakhiqizi eNingizimu Afrika baphikisana emakethe yomhlaba, kodwa imithetho yokubambisana ayifani. Kukhona ukuntuleka kolwazi olufanele namakhono. Abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bangaba abafundi; badinga ukwesekwa, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nemfundo. Njalo, abantu abasebenza emaphandleni abaphathisa le misebenzi bangenalo ulwazi olufanele. Abaningi abake basebenze epulazini, abanye bayavuma ukusiza, kanti abanye bafundile kodwa abakwazi "ukufaka imbewu emhlabeni." Izinhlangano ezinikeza izinto zokulima zisebenza kahle, kodwa izindleko zazo ziphansi. Abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo uma befuna uxhaso lokukhiqiza. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhaso idinga ukuzibophezela epulazini ngaphambi kokunikeza uxhaso. Abalimi abaqasha amapulazi noma abakhiqiza emhlabeni womphakathi abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo zibopho, ngakho-ke bahluleka ukuqinisekisa uxhaso. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhaso ehlinzeka ngezimali zokukhiqiza idinga umshwalense ukuze uqinisekise lezo zimali. Nokho, umshwalense wokukhiqiza usebenza kuphela uma izitshalo ziqala ukukhula, lapho zonke izindleko seziqoqiwe. Ezinye izindawo zifuna ukuvumela uxhaso ngaphambi kokuthola ukuvunywa komshwalense, kushiya umbulali engakwazi ukuqinisekisa uxhaso lokukhiqiza lokuqala. Enye inkinga ukuthi: umshwalense uvikela kuphela u-65% wezindleko - u-35% osele usengcupheni. Ukulima kunzima; ngaphandle kolwazi, uzobhekana nezinkinga. Lapho imikhawulo yokwenzela inzuzo incane, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Abakhiqizi abavela kuphi basafunda, ngakho-ke ingozi yokubavulela uxhaso iphezulu kakhulu. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abanethuba lokuthola umhlaba noma izinkundla, kodwa abambalwa banezinto zokulima ezitholakalayo. Izinsiza ezintsha zikhokhiswa kakhulu, futhi abalimi abakwazi ukufinyelela kuzo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ibhizinisi elizohlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuthenga izinsiza ezindala. Lapho kukhona imishini yokulima, ivame ukungasebenzi kahle. Inzuzo ephansi yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu kusho ukuthi abalimi abanamali yokulungisa imishini yabo. Njalo, abalimi bangenalo ulwazi lokulungisa nokugcina imishini yabo. Njalo, ukudluliswa komhlaba kufaka zonke izinto ezikhona epulazini, futhi sithola ukuthi imishini ibikhubazekile futhi iphukile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umbulali omusha uqala endaweni ephansi kakhulu. Izigaba zinikezwa imishini esetshenziswa bonke ozakwethu, kodwa akekho ophatha kahle impilo yemishini. Uhlelo lokulungisa umhlaba lweMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube nenkinga kubantu abaningi. Ngokuvamile, ukusebenza kwalo kube kuhamba kancane; manje abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bahluleka amathuba okuqhubeka, kanti abalimi abamhlophe baqala ukujwayela futhi bathengise amapulazi abo kubangane abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango wehlulekile ukuqedela ukudluliswa. Futhi akukho zinkomba ezicacile ezikhombisa ukuthi ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu shintsho lomhlaba. Ukubuyisela ibhalansi ye-PH emhlabathini kungaba yindleko enkulu ngoba kunezindawo ezidinga kuze kube yizinsuku eziyi-14 ze-lime nge-hectare. Njalo, abalimi abakwazi ukukhokhela lezo zindleko, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zindlela zomthetho ezikhombisa ukuthi abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bangafuna usizo kuhulumeni. Kube nezinhlelo kwezinye izifunda, kodwa akukho hlelo olufana nalolo. Izindlela zokulima ezingafanele eminyakeni edlule zibe nomthelela emithonjeni ye-phosphate kwezinye izindawo zafika ezingeni lokuthi zinciphe ngokuphelele. Njengokufaka i-lime, ukubuyisela lokhu kudinga imali eningi, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zixhaso. Njalo, amapulazi lapho abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bephila awasebenzelwanga kahle ngoba awekho ama-contours nezinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unohlelo lokunakekela umhlaba, isabelomali sabo sincane, futhi bahluleka ukubhekana nale nkinga enkulu futhi bahlangabezane nale mfuneko enkulu. Njalo, ukonakaliswa komhlaba ngenxa yomoya namanzi kube sekuqhubekile kuze kube sezingeni lokuthi akukwazi ukulungiswa. Abakhiqizi badinga ithuba lokuba abanikazi bomhlaba futhi babe nemishini ukuze bakhule babe abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Kwezinye izifunda, kukhona ukuntuleka okukhulu kwezinsiza zezolimo ezifana nezindlela, ama-silos, izindawo zokomisa ukudla, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Abalimi badinga ukuqeqeshwa, ukwesekwa, kanye nezikhulu ezabelana ngolwazi. Abantu badinga ukwenziwa bakwazi ukuzimela. Kumele bafunde ukusebenza ngokwabo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni abangakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo baphumela abantu bahlale bephila ngaphansi (isibonelo, uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba wehlulekile ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo kanye noMnyango Wezolimo ongasekeli abantu kahle). Le bhukwana lenzelwe njengomhlahlandlela wokuthi amalunga omphakathi angafinyelela kanjani ulwazi olugcinwe yi-GCIS. Ichaza ukuthi yikuphi ulwazi olukhona kule ndawo futhi ikutshela ukuthi ungafinyelela kanjani kulolo lwazi. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi, 2000, uthi inhlangano ngayinye kumele ibize uMphakathi Wokulawula Ulwazi kanye noMphakathi/Abaphakeli boMphakathi Wokulawula Ulwazi abazobhekana nezicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi futhi basize abaceli ekuthumeleni izicelo zabo. Umbono we-GCIS usiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuxhumana nolwazi lukamasipala nomphakathi, uqinisekisa impilo engcono kubantu bonke. Inhloso ye-GCIS ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa ekuxhumaneni kukamasipala futhi iqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uyazi ngokuqhuba kwezimali zalesi sikhungo. Izinhloso ezisemqoka ze-GCIS ukuqinisa uhlelo lokuxhumana kukamasipala nemisebenzi yalo ngezindlela ezithuthukisa ukuhlanganiswa okuqhubekayo kokuphathwa kwethu ngokwemfanelo futhi kubeke izwe endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthuka okuphezulu. Ukwakha isikhala sokuxhumana sokubambisana esihlinzeka ngolwazi olunombono ophelele mayelana nezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa jikelele. Ukuxhumana kukamasipala nokuxhumana kwezindaba kukhuthaza (G&ML) ukuxhumana nokusebenzisana kokuxhumana kukamasipala kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi kuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zobungcweti ekubambisaneni kwezindaba. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi izigaba, amaqembu, nezifunda zithuthukisa izinhlelo zazo zokuxhumana ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sokuxhumana sokuhlanganyela, kanti izindaba zomphakathi nezamazwe zithola ulwazi lukamasipala ngendlela efanele. I-P&LL isekela ukuhlinzekwa kokuxhumana kokuthuthukiswa futhi yandisa izakhiwo zolwazi lukamasipala ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nezendawo. Iphinde isize ekwakheni amaKhaya Ezenzo Amaphakathi ukuze kwenziwe izinsizakalo nolwazi lufinyeleleke kabanzi emphakathini, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahluphekayo. I-CSA ihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile zokuxhumana ku-GCIS nakwezinye izigaba zikamasipala, ngaphakathi nangokucela izinkampani zangaphandle ukuba zenze umsebenzi. Ikhiqiza futhi ihlukanisa ulwazi isebenzisa amapulatifomu nezindlela ezifanele ukufinyelela emphakathini ophakanyisiwe. Inezigaba ezintathu zomnyango: Ukuthuthukiswa Komkhiqizo; Ukuthuthukiswa Kokuqukethwe; kanye Nokumaketha, Ukukhangisa, Nokuhanjiswa. Vuk'uzenzele igxile ekukhiqizeni iphephandaba likamasipala elikhululekile elikhombisa amathuba wezomnotho nezinye ezidalwe uhulumeni wethu wenhlangano futhi ukuthi la mathuba kufanele afinyelelwe kanjani. I-Information and Technology Management ibhekana nokusetshenziswa kolwazi nobuchwepheshe njengokubalulekile kwezidingo zamasu ekusebenzeni kwe-GCIS nasezinhlelweni zayo. Le ngxenye inezinhlelo ezincane ezilandelayo: Ukuxhaswa Kwenethiwekhi Neseva, Ukuxhaswa Kwesifunda Nokufundisa, Ukuthuthukiswa Kwephrojekthi, kanye Nezidingo Zolwazi Olwakhiwe. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, kanye Nokuxhaswa kudlula ekuphathweni kwezimali jikelele e-GCIS futhi kubheke ukuhambisana nomthetho wezezimali zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999). Umnyango unazo lezi zinhlelo ezincane: Izinsizakalo Zokuxhasa, Ukuphathwa Kwezimpahla, Ihhovisi Lezabelomali, kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezimali. Abahloli Bangaphakathi basiza i-GCIS ukufezekisa izinhloso zayo ngokuqhuba indlela ehlelekile nephathekayo yokuhlola nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokuphathwa kwemingcele, ukulawula, kanye nezinqubo zokuphatha. I-Project Desk ixhumanisa ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi ngobuchwepheshe futhi ixhumanisa izixazululo ukusiza i-GCIS ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zayo zokuxhumana nolwazi lukamasipala nomphakathi, iqinisekisa impilo engcono kubantu bonke. I-SAHR (ebizwa lapha njenge 'ikomidi') ngaphansi kweSahluko 10 se-PAIA, 2000, izokwenza umbiko wokusebenza kwalesi sikhungo. Lo mbiko uzotholakala kumkhandlu. Uhlu Lwabantu, Uhlu Lwezindaba, kanye Nezithombe zingxenye zohlu lokuxhumana lwabasebenzi bokuxhumana kukamasipala. Uhlelo lokufunda, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha, kanye nemibhalo yokuqeqesha ifaka phakathi izivumelwano nemibhalo yezomthetho. Amaphephandaba, imizuzu yemihlangano, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zezindaba, imibhalo yokuxhumanisa, izindatshana zezindaba, amarekhodi, kanye nezitatimende, kanye nohlu lwamagama ezindaba kanye nezikhumbuzo zokuxhumana. Izinhlelo zeThusong Service Centre, izinhlelo zokuxhumana zokuthuthukiswa nezinsiza, izinsiza zokukhangisa nokumaketha, imibiko, nemizuzu yemihlangano.
