Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ithuba lokukhuluma ngempilo yethu, ikakhulukazi ngezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Sihlangane noMnu. Sibusiso Mthethwa, umqondisi wezokuphepha kwezokuthutha eMnyangweni Wezempilo, ukuze sithole ukuqonda okwengeziwe. Ingxoxo Umbuzo 1: Mnu. Mthethwa, ungachaza kanjani ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi? Mnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuhamba lapha. Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo esheshayo uma abantu bedinga usizo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimoto zokwelapha, zokuphepha, nezokuthutha, okubalulekile ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezidinga usizo ngokushesha. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula okusheshayo? Mnu. Mthethwa: Sinezinqubo ezithile ezibekiwe. Sinezikhalazo zokulawula ezithola izaziso ngezimo eziphuthumayo, lapho sithola khona isaziso, sithumele izimoto ezidingekayo ngokushesha. Siphinde siqinisekise ukuthi abashayeli bethu baqeqeshwe kahle ukuze bazi izindlela ezihamba phambili zokufinyelela ezindaweni ezidinga usizo. Umbuzo 3: Kukhona yini izinselelo ezithile obhekana nazo? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, izinselelo zikhona. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ukungabi khona kwezindlela ezinhle noma izimo zezulu ezimbi, okungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokuphendula. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, njengemitholampilo, amaphoyisa, nezokuphepha, kudinga ukuba kube kuhle ukuze sikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Umbuzo 4: Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe le nqubo? Mnu. Mthethwa: Ngicabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba senze ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze siqonde izidingo zomphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubashayeli bethu nakwabanye abasebenzi bethu kubalulekile. Futhi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kuzothuthukisa ukusebenza kwethu. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe kukhona izibonelo ezithile zokuphendula okuphumelelayo? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, sinesibonelo esihle esivela eminyakeni embalwa edlule lapho kwenzeka ingozi enkulu emgwaqeni. Ngemva kokuthola isaziso, sathumela izimoto eziningi ezihlinzekayo, futhi abashayeli bethu baphendule ngokushesha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni sikwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi, futhi sathola impendulo enhle emphakathini. Umbuzo 6: Uthini umyalezo wakho kubantu uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo? Mnu. Mthethwa: Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo, kufanele bazame ukugcina ukuthula. Ukuxhumana kahle nabaphenduli, njengamaphoyisa noma izisebenzi zezokwelapha, kubalulekile. Futhi, uma ungakwazi, qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ngendlela efanele ukuze uvumele izimoto eziphuthumayo ukufinyelela lapho kudingeka khona. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kuhlose ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha komphakathi. Njengoba sikhuluma noMnu. Mthethwa, sithola ukuthi le nqubo ibalulekile, izinselelo zikhona, kodwa izixazululo nazo zikhona. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onakekela bonke abantu. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngalesi sithombe esibalulekile.
Idokhumenti lichaza uhlaka lwezinhlelo zokuphatha izinhlelo zokwahlulela zendabuko ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Umbono nenjongo yalolu hlaka lwezinhlelo zifaka phakathi izimiso zokuziphatha kwamasiko ezikhuthaza ukuxhumana komphakathi, ukuthula, nokuhlalisana. Kugcizelelwa ukufaneleka kobuholi bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika nasemkhathini omusha wezokhetho, kuqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwemithetho ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezomthetho bendabuko. Kuhlinzekwa ngezindlela ezifanele zokwenza kube lula imisebenzi nobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kokwahlulela. Umbiko ubhekisisa uguquko lwemithetho ezinkantolo zendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kanye nemisebenzi yobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Abaholi bendabuko kumele babe sobala emisebenzini yabo ephathelene nokuphathwa kwemithetho. Izinkantolo zendabuko zinegunya lokuzwa amacala ahlobene nezicelo ezisekelwe emthethweni wamasiko nakwezinye izimiso eziphathelene nezindaba zezinyama. Izinkantolo zendabuko ziqokwe ukubhekana nezindaba ezihlobene noguquko lwezokwahlulela. Ukukhishwa kwezaziso nezinhlelo zokusebenza kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuphathwa kwezinqumo ezenziwe ezinkantolo zendabuko nakho kugcizelelwa. Ukukhishwa kwabamele ezinkantolo zendabuko kuqokwe. Izinqumo ezenziwe ezinkantolo zendabuko kumele zibe nezinga, futhi ukudluliswa kwamacala ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile kuyavunyelwa. Ukuhlolwa kwezinqumo ezivela ezinkantolo zendabuko nakho kuyakhuluma. Izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ukuze amacala aqhamuka ezinkantolo zendabuko athathwe ezinkantolo zomphakathi zikhuluma. Indima yezinkantolo zendabuko ohlelweni lokwahlulela kwezindaba zezinyama igcizelelwa. Abaholi bendabuko nezinkantolo zendabuko kumele zikhuthaze izimiso nezinhlelo ezisemthethweni kuMthethosisekelo. Kukho isidingo somthetho kazwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukulingana. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho ezinkantolo zendabuko nakho kuyakhuluma. Ukubaluleka kwesikhungo ekugcineni ukuthula nokuxhumana emiphakathini yasemakhaya kugcizelelwa. Imiphakathi yasemakhaya idlala indima ebalulekile futhi enobunzima ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Ziyingxenye yefa lesiko labantu base-Afrika, futhi lokhu kuyavunywa nguMthethosisekelo. Umthetho ophathelene namasiko ubikhona kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo futhi uyavunywa uhlelo lwezomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi labantu abahlala emiphakathini yasemakhaya liphethwe yimithetho ephathelene namasiko kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokwahlulela zendabuko, besebenzisa le ndlela yomthetho. Abantu abalinganiselwa kumashumi amane emalini bazoba yingxenye yomphakathi wendabuko kuzo zonke izifunda zeNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kweWestern Cape. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko sidlala indima ebalulekile ekwandiseni izinga lokuhlalisana komphakathi, ukuthula, nokuxhumana emphakathini. Kulolu suku lokuphathwa kwemithetho, abaholi bendabuko baxazulula izingxabano ezinkantolo zendabuko (Inkundla). Ukubaluleka kwezinkantolo zendabuko kuvela eduze kwemiphakathi nasekusebenziseni ulimi nezindlela ezilula umphakathi ozazi kahle, nezinhlelo ezisetshenziswa ezinkantolo zomphakathi. Abaholi bendabuko nezixhumanisi zabo basebenza ngokubambisana, bephulaphula ubufakazi bababhalisi kanye "nabaphikisi" ukuze baxazulule izingxabano ngokwemithetho yamasiko yalowo mphakathi. Izinkantolo zendabuko azinayo uhlu olubhaliwe lwemithetho ezilandelwayo. Ziqondiswa ngezifiso nezindlela zomphakathi abaphila kuwo. Ngale ndlela, ukuhlinzekwa kokwahlulela kwenziwa kalula nangokushesha. Ngemva kokhetho lwezokhetho lweDemokhrasi lwango-1994, lezi zinhlelo zobuholi zamukelwa. Ithebula elilandelayo libonisa ukusabalala ezifundeni kwezinga ezintathu zobuholi bendabuko kuleli. Ihhovisi likazwelonke labaholi bendabuko lasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokwakhiwa KweHhovisi Labaholi Bendabuko ka-1997 futhi lisebenza kazwelonke; ithebula elilandelayo libonisa isimo samanje esithinta izindlu zesifunda nezasekhaya ezifundeni. Emphakathini ngamunye ngaphansi kobuholi bendabuko, kufanele kusungulwe futhi kuqashelwe ikomidi lendabuko. Umbono walolu hlaka lwezinhlelo ugcizelela ukubaluleka kwesikhungo sobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho, okungafaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kokufinyelela kokwahlulela nokufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bonke. Inhloso eyinhloko yalolu dokhumenti lwezinhlelo ukuhlela uhlelo lwezomthetho lwezinkantolo zendabuko noMthethosisekelo. UMthetho Wokuphathwa KweMblack, njengokuphuma komthetho wokuqala wokwehlukaniswa kwezizinda, wawususiwe ngoNovemba 1995. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sokwethula umthetho kazwelonke ukuze kuqondiswe indima nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Idokhumenti yezinhlelo iyinhlanganisela yemiphumela ethathwe ekuhloleni kwemibhalo, ukufunda okuqhathanisayo kwezinye izindawo lapho umthetho kufanele usebenze, izingxoxo nabaholi bendabuko, kanye nezinsiza zikahulumeni ezibhekelele ezokwenziwa kwendabuko nezinye izithakazelo emkhakheni wezomthetho wamasiko. UNgqongqoshe nabanye osomabhizinisi bavakashele ukuze bafunde ngokwabo ukuthi izinto ziqhutshelwa kanjani eNdiya naseBotswana. Eminye imininingwane itholwe ezithombeni emhlanganweni wezikhungo zendabuko owawubanjelwe eThekwini ngoJulayi 2007, kanye nomhlangano olandelayo wezinkantolo zomphakathi owawubanjelwe eMidrand ngoAgasti 2007. Kulezi zinkulumo, indima yalezi zikhungo ekuphathweni kwemithetho yakhuluma. Ukhetho lweDemokhrasi lwango-1994 lwaholela enqubweni entsha. Le nqubo entsha yaba isisekelo sokuhlola imithetho nezindlela ezazikhona ngaphambi konyaka ka-1994. Le dokhumenti yezinhlelo igxile endimeni nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko phakathi nalesi sikhathi sokhetho, ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko sidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yesiko labantu base-Afrika, emlandweni, nasekutheni kwezwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Kubandakanya ukugcina isiko, izindlela, izimiso, nezindinganiso zabantu base-Afrika, ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo temsilisa izigaba zomphakathi zangaphambili kanye nokuphathwa. Nokho, lapho iNingizimu Afrika yamukela uMthethosisekelo wesikhashana, kulandela uMthethosisekelo kazwelonke ka-1996, abantu bethu bachaza iNingizimu Afrika njengelizwe elizimele, eliphethwe yidemo, elisekelwe ezimisweni ezamukelwe ngabo bonke, lapho singafaka khona nokuvinjelwa kokwehlukaniswa kuMthethosisekelo. Lokhu kwakukhombisa ukuthi itshe lizokhuhla omunye ummbila. Ngemva kokhetho lwe-1994, uhulumeni omusha waqala isigaba sokwakha kabusha izwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izakhiwo zokuphatha ezazizohambisana nenqubo entsha yokhetho nezimiso zomthethosisekelo ezifana nokulingana
Ama-Social Media Influencer Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukufunda ngama-social media influencer, abantu abathokozisa izinkulungwane, noma ngabe ku-Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, noma Twitter. Lezi zinkanyezi zedijithali zidlala indima enkulu empilweni yethu, zishintsha indlela esibona ngayo imikhiqizo, izinsiza, nezindlela zokuphila. Ukuze siqonde kahle le mboni, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa noNandi, ongumthandi wezokuxhumana, kanye nomuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Ingxenye 1: Ukuzalwa Kwama-Influencer UMsizi: Nandi, ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla. Ngabe ungachaza ukuthi yini eyenza umuntu abe yi-influencer? UNandi: Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane. Ngempela, ukuba yi-influencer kusho ukuba nomthelela empilweni yabanye abantu. Lokhu kungenzeka uma uthola abalandeli abaningi, abakholelwa kulokho okukhuluma noma okwenziwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nekhono lokuxhumana, ukuze ukwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabalandeli. Ingxenye 2: Izindlela Zokwakha Umphakathi UMsizi: Ngabe ungabelana nathi ngezindlela ozisebenzisayo ukuze wakhe umphakathi wakho? UNandi: Yebo, ngiyajabula. Okokuqala, ngiyazama ukuba ngiqonde kahle izithakazelo zabalandeli bami. Ngithanda ukwabelana ngokuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuhlobene nezinto ezithinta impilo yansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyazama ukuhamba phambili ngezikhathi, ngithola izitayela ezintsha nezinto ezithakazelisayo. Ukuphendula imibuzo yabalandeli bami nokubandakanya imicabango yabo kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ingxenye 3: Izinkinga Nezinselelo UMsizi: Ngabe kukhona izinselelo obhekana nazo njengomthandi wezokuxhumana? UNandi: Yebo, izinselelo zikhona. Okokuqala, ukugcina ubungcweti nokwethembeka kubalulekile. Abantu bahlola izinkanyezi zedijithali, futhi uma uthola ukuthi awuhambisani nalokho okukhuluma, ungaphenduka ungathembeki. Futhi, kunezikhathi lapho abantu bephikisana nezinto ozishoyo, okungaholela ezinkulumweni ezinzima. Kodwa ngiyafunda kulokhu, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi akukhona konke okuthandwa ngabantu. Ingxenye 4: Umthelela Wama-Influencer UMsizi: Ucabanga ukuthi ama-influencer anomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu? UNandi: Impela, umthelela wama-influencer ungaphezulu kokucabanga. Siphila emhlabeni lapho abantu bejolise kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqumo zethu zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthengiseni nasekuthuthukiseni imikhiqizo. Ngakho, uma ngithanda umkhiqizo, ngiyazi ukuthi abalandeli bami bazokwazi ukukholwa futhi bazame lokho engikukhulumayo. Ingxenye 5: Ukubambisana Nezinkampani UMsizi: Ngabe ubambisene nezinkampani ezithile? Lokhu kukuthinta kanjani? UNandi: Yebo, ngiyabambisene nezinkampani eziningi. Lokhu kungenza ngithole ithuba lokwabelana ngempilo yami nabantu, ngiphinde ngithole imikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukuba ngikhethe izinkampani ezihambisana nezimiso zami. Ngiyazi ukuthi abalandeli bami bahlola kahle, ngakho ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngithumele imiyalezo efanele. Ingxenye 6: Ikhono Lokuphila UMsizi: Njengomthandi wezokuxhumana, ungakuthola kanjani ukulinganisa phakathi kokuphila kwakho siqu nomsebenzi wakho? UNandi: Lokhu kuyinselelo enkulu. Ngiyazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba nesikhathi sokuphumula, ngakho ngizama ukuhlela isikhathi sami kahle. Ngithanda ukuhamba, ukufunda, nokuchitha isikhathi nomndeni. Lokhu kusiza ukugcina ingqondo yami icacile, futhi ngiyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okungcono kubalandeli bami. Isiphetho UMsizi: Nandi, ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubantu abafuna ukuba ama-influencer? UNandi: Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi uma ufuna ukuba yi-influencer, qiniseka ukuthi uhlala uqotho. Thanda lokho okwenzayo, futhi ungazami ukukopisha abanye. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukugcina ubungcweti, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabalandeli kuzokwenza ube yimpumelelo. Ngokuphetha, ama-social media influencer ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu wanamuhla. Ngakho, uma unentshisekelo, phokophela phambili, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuhamba ngendlela yakho.
Ukuthatha isinqumo: Ingxenye 3 yoMthetho Osekela iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, 1995 Umthetho No. Ukuthatha isinqumo: Ingxenye 3 yoMthetho Osekela iNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, 1995 Umthetho No. Umbiko ophakanyisiwe uhlanganisa ukuvuma noma ukuveza njengoba kuchaziwe engxenyeni 7 yoMthetho Wokuthula kanye Neziqu Zomphakathi, 1963 Umthetho No. Iklinikhi yezomthetho' ichaza isikhungo sokufundisa izifundo zomthetho kubafundi emkhakheni wemfundo yezomthetho eNyuvesi Ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika, ehlanganisa nesikhungo somthetho esisebenza ngenhloso yokungatholi inzuzo esiza umphakathi mahhala ngemininingwane yezomthetho, lesi sikhungo sinikezwe igunya ngendlela echazwe engxenyeni 3(f) yoMthetho Wabameli, 1979 (Umthetho No. Ummeleli' uchaza uchwepheshe wezomthetho wenkantolo yezenzo owamukelwa ngaphansi kwengxenye 3 yoMthetho Wokwamukelwa Kwabameli, 1964 (Umthetho No. 73 ka-1964) noma ummeleli wenkantolo yezenzo owamukelwa ngaphansi kwengxenye 15 yoMthetho Wabameli, 1979 (Umthetho No. Umphakathi wenkantolo' uchaza umuntu oqokwa ngaphansi kwengxenye 2 yoMthetho Womphakathi Wenkanuko, 1986 Umthetho No. Imithetho yeNkantolo Ephakeme Yokudluliselwa Kwezimangalo' ichaza imithetho elawula ukuziphatha kwezinkantolo zeNkantolo Ephakeme zokudluliselwa kwezimangalo ezishicilelwe ngaphansi kweSaziso Sokuhulumeni No. R. No. R. 48 ka-12 January, njengoba kuguquliwe. Noma yiziphi amandla noma igunya likaNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa aqukethwe ngaphansi kwale mithetho angasetshenziswa ngumgibeli noma ngamagibeli aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa ngenhloso yokwenza lokhu. Noma yisiphi isikhumbuzo kule mithetho esiqondiswe eqenjini okufanele sigcine idokhumenti sizothathwa njengokuhlanganiswa kokumela kwalelo qembu kanye nemibhalo ethunyelwe kuNksz. kanye nokuhilela umsebenzi welinye iqembu nokuhambisa amakhophi angama-25 wezimali ezihambelanayo kuhlanganisa ngezindlela zedijithali ngendlela ehambisana nezinsiza zenkantolo kanye noNksz. Izaziso, ama-oda, nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana ngaphansi kwale mithetho zingakhishwa noma zithunyelwe ngeposi ebhalwe noma ngezindlela zedijithali noma nganoma iyiphi enye indlela esebenzayo ngezindlela zedijithali. Uma isaziso noma ukuxhumana kufakwe ngendlela yedijithali noma ngekhompyutha, iqembu elithumela leso saziso noma ukuxhumana kufanele likhiphe kuNksz. ikhophi yomzimba wesaziso noma ukuxhumana kanye necebo elisayinwe yilowo mqondisi elikhombisa usuku lwesaziso noma idokhumenti. UNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa angandisa noma yisiphi isikhathi esibekwe kule mithetho. Iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe, izimpendulo, nezinye izibalo ezithunyelwe enkantolo kufanele zicace futhi zihlukaniswe. Izicelo kufanele zibhale kahle zishiye izikhala ezimbili phakathi kwemigqa, zibhaliwe ephepheni le-A4. Ngokuhambisana nomthetho 5, izinhlinzeko zomthetho 4 weMithetho Ejwayelekile zizosebenza kanye nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo uma kwenziwa noma iyiphi inqubo yenkantolo. Lokhu kuza kuze kube uNovemba 30. Isicelo singaphakanyiswa ngaphandle kokulandela isikhathi sonyaka uma uNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa ethatha leso sinqumo. Uma usuku oluhlongozwayo lokuqala kwesikhathi lungelona usuku lwenkantolo, lesi sikhathi sizophakanyiswa ngosuku olulandelayo lwenkantolo, uma usuku oluhlongozwayo lokuphela kwesikhathi sonyaka lungelona usuku lwenkantolo, lesi sikhathi sonyaka sizophela ngosuku lwenkantolo olwandulela leso suku. Ihhovisi likaNksz. lizovulwa kusukela ngo-08:30 kuya ku-13:00 futhi lizovulwa futhi kusukela ngo-14:00 kuze kube ngu-15:30 ezinsukwini zenkantolo. Ezimo ezikhethekile, uNksz. angamukela imibhalo ngemuva kwezinsuku zokusebenza, ezokwenziwa uma eqondiswa nguMjudge. Isaziso sokudluliselwa kwezimangalo, isinqumo senkantolo sokudluliselwa noma noma yini enkantolo ivela kwenye idokhumenti eqale izingxoxo enkantolo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zale mithetho izonombolo nguNksz, ngokulandelana kusukela konyaka owagcinwa. Zonke imibhalo ethunyelwe kamuva kulowo msebenzi noma enye ingxenye eqhubekayo izobanjwa ngaleyo nombolo nguNksz. futhi uNksz. ngeke azamukele uma zingakabhalwanga ngaleyo msebenzi noma inombolo. Zonke imibhalo ezithunyelwe kuNksz. ukuze zigcinwe efayilini lesicelo zizogcinwa nguNksz. efayilini lesicelo, ngaphansi kwenombolo efanele yalowo msebenzi. Zonke imibhalo ezithathwe kusukela ku-schedule -1 zizohambisana nezimali zenkantolo ezingu-R75.00, le mali ikhokhwa ngephosta: Uma iqembu likwazisa uNksz. ngaphansi kwesheduli -5 ukuthi bahluphekile, imali yenkantolo ingakhanselwa nguNksz. ozobhala le simo ekhasini lokuqala ledokhumenti ethile. Iqembu elifuna ukuqala noma ukuphikisa udaba ku-schedule yenkantolo futhi elikholwa ukuthi bahluphekile noma umuntu osebenza egameni lelo qembu kufanele akwazise uNksz. ukuthi ngaphandle kwezimpahla zomndeni, izingubo, nezinsiza zokusebenza, lelo qembu alinayo impahla engaphezulu kwe-R20,000 futhi ngeke likwazi ukuthola le mali masinyane emholweni wabo. Lapho amakhophi enziwa, imali ethile eshiwo ku-schedule -6a izokhokhwa. Amakhophi edokhumenti egciniwe angakhiqizwa nganoma ubani, uma kwenziwa phambi kukaNksz. a Ngokwesicelo seqembu, uNksz. angakha ikhophi yedokhumenti yenkantolo uma imali yenkantolo ikhokhiwe ngokuthenga isithombe se-R0.50 ngekhophi ye-A4 ephelele noma ingxenye, uma enye i-R1.00 ikhokhwa le khophi ingaqinisekiswa njengokuthi iyi khophi yeqiniso yaleso sithombe esisemthethweni. b Imali yenkantolo ingakhanselwa nguNksz. uma umuntu ehluphekile njengoba kuchaziwe kumashadi 4 no-5. Uma inkantolo ithatha isinqumo esinika igunya noma siqinisekisa noma yimuphi umthetho noma ukuhlinzeka okuphikisana noMthethosisekelo ngaphansi kwengxenye 172 yoMthethosisekelo, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwesinqumo, uNksz. angathatha izinyathelo zokuthi leso sinqumo sishicilelwe kwi-gazette kazwelonke naku-province uma leso sinqumo sithinteka emthethweni wesifunda. UNksz. uzoshicilela uhlu lwezindaba ezizothathwa ezizothunyelwa ebhodini lesaziso esakhiweni senkantolo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15 ngaphambi kokuqala kwesikhathi sonyaka ngenhloso yokwazisa umphakathi nokuhlinzeka ithuba elanele kulabo abanentshisekelo kulolu daba ukuze bamele. Ama-oda ahlobene nomsebenzi oqhubekayo azothunyelwa nguNksz. ezindabeni ezithintekayo phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zokukhishwa kwalelo oda. a UNksz

ISIGABA 7: UKUQEDILELA AMAFAKSI WOKUBHALISWA INGQIKITHI 2 Ingxenye 2 yamafomu... Isigaba 2 Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi Inqubo yokubhaliswa: Kungani, ubani, kanjani, nini. Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi kuqondiswa nguSigaba 26 © noSigaba 34 weMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi abasebenzisi bamanzi badinga ukubhalisela ukusebenzisa amanzi kule Ndaba. Ukuze kulawulwe futhi kulungiswe izinsiza zamanzi ukuze kuhlelwe kahle nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kwamani kubasebenzisi bamanzi. Ukubhaliswa kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuthola izindleko ezifanele nezichanekile zokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Imali eqoqwe lapha izosetshenziswa ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukubhaliswa akusizi kuphela abasebenzisi bamanzi kodwa kuzophinde kusebenze kuzo zonke izwe. INingizimu Afrika ingelinye lamazwe anezinsiza zamanzi ezinganele. Siseduze kokubizwa emhlabeni jikelele njenge "izwe elinamanzi ambalwa." Ukuhlola kukhombisa ukuthi zonke izinsiza zamanzi ezintsha zizokhishwa phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 kuya kwengu-30 ezayo, kuye ngentuthuko yezezimali. Ukuhlukumezeka kwezinsiza zamanzi ezintsha ngenxa yokungcoliswa kunganciphisa inani lamanzi angasetshenziswa. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo nokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zamanzi nokuhlinzekwa kwesikhathi esizayo kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi sinesikhathi esingakanani samanzi, ubani osisebenzisayo, nokuthi kuphi. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kubhalwe kuSheduli 1 yeMthetho (bona Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungafakiwe ezidingweni zokubhaliswa njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi kweSaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kweNqubomgomo Yokubhaliswa noma ngaphansi kweZimvume Jikelele (bona Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungxenye yosizo olunikezwa labo abahlinzeka ngamanzi njengohulumeni bendawo (Izindawo) noma iBhodi Yamanzi. Isibonelo salokhu yamanzi nokulahla udoti ezindaweni zokuhlala ezilawulwa yiMuniisipali. Akudingeki ukuthi wonke umndeni ubhalise, kodwa iMuniisipali kufanele ibhalise ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Umuntu ngamunye - njengabalimi, abanikazi bezindawo, noma abaqashi. Imiphakathi - njengamabhizinisi omphakathi, izinhlangano zabafuyi bendabuko. Izinkampani Nezohwebo - kufaka phakathi ubudlelwano, izinkampani zomphakathi, izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinkampani zangaphandle, imishado, nezikole. Abahlinzeki bamanzi, kuhlanganise neBhodi Yamanzi kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Kusukela ngo-Okthoba 8, 1999, bonke abasebenzisi bamanzi abasha kufanele babhalise njengoba kuchaziwe kwiZimvume Jikelele (bona Isigaba 4). Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le Ndaba izokhipha Izaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni enemininingwane yezimo zokugeleza kwemifula nezinqolobane noma izindawo zokuhlola amanzi nezinsiza zamanzi, ibize abasebenzisi bamanzi ukuba babhalise ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okwamanje. Lezi Zaziso zizokwenza kube sobala isikhathi lapho abasebenzisi bamanzi kufanele babhaliswe. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sitholakala cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-60 kusukela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kweZaziso. Ngemuva kokukhishwa kweZaziso, abasebenzisi bamanzi bazophinde baziwe ngezinye izindlela ukuthi kufanele babhalise, njengokushicilela izaziso eziphephandabeni noma ukumemezela emsakazweni. Ungabaza emahhovisi amanzi endaweni yakho uma iZaziso yokubhaliswa yale ndawo ikhishwe. Amafomu okubhaliswa atholakala kunoma yisiphi ihhovisi leNdaba (bona Isigaba 8). Ukuze ubhalise ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi, thumela ifomu eliphelele kule Ndaba. Ukubhaliswa akukwazi ukuphikiswa noma ukuhoxiswa uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kuhambisana. Amafomu angaphelele angabuyiselwa kubasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukubhaliswa kuzophakanyiswa kuze kube ifomu libuyiselwa lonke ulwazi oludingekayo. Lapha unikezwa incazelo yezisho (nezisho) ezivame ukusetshenziswa kule nqubo yokubhaliswa ukusiza umsebenzisi wamanzi lapho egcwalisa ifomu. Uthola futhi amagama ezobuchwepheshe asetshenziswa Engxenyeni 2 yamafomu. noma ukungcoliswa kwemvelo njengensimbi noma udoti omkhulu ongahlakazeki. Ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwezinsiza zamanzi ngenxa yezinqubo zokumba. Noma iyiphi imayini enezinqubo zokukhishwa kwensimbi kuhlanganisa nokulahla udoti. Zonke ezinye izimayini, kuhlanganise nezimayini ezinkulu ezinezingcuphe ezincane ezinsizeni zamanzi, nezimayini ezinezingcuphe eziphansi nezinqubo zokumba ezingaphansi. IMIFULA EYINQABILE Ukugcina amanzi kuyindlela yokusebenzisa amanzi njengoba kuchazwe kuSigaba 21(b) ngezansi. Ukuvikeleka emifulaneni kulawulwa futhi kuyisahluko 12 seMthetho kanye neNqubomgomo Yokuphepha Kwamadamu (kuGazethi yoHulumeni No. R1560 edlule ngoJulayi 25, 1986). Ukubhaliswa kwemifula eyingozi kuqondiswa nguSigaba 120 seMthetho. Lezi yimifula enekhono lokugcina ngaphezu kwamamitha angu-50,000 amanzi enobude bezindonga obungaphezu kwamamitha angu-5 noma eyamukelwe nguNgqongqoshe njengehlobo lwemifula eyingozi. Umfula noma noma iyiphi isakhiwo esingagcina noma sithwale noma sibe ne-amanzi. Imifula yakhiwa emifulaneni noma ngabe ayakhiwe ukuze igcine amanzi (ama-weirs). Amanzi anokungcoliswa kwasekhaya avela emathunjini asekhaya okukhona lapho kuhlanzwa khona izingubo, kuhlanzwa imizimba, nasezindlini zokugezela. IMITHOMBO YOKUNGCOLISWA Ukulahla udoti ngendlela engaphazamisa insiza yamanzi kuyindlela yokusebenzisa amanzi njengoba kuchazwe kuSigaba 21(g) ngaphansi kwezincazelo zokusebenzisa amanzi ngezansi. Izindawo lapho udoti ulahlwa khona kufanele futhi zibhaliswe ngaphansi kweSigaba 20 seMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kwemvelo. Ezinye izinhlobo zokungcoliswa azidingi ukubhaliswa njengendawo yokulahla uthuli lwezimboni nezindawo lapho izimayini zalahla khona udoti. Lezi zinhlobo azidingi ukubhaliswa njengoba zilawulwa ngaphansi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelon
Imali yokweseka emphakathini iyizimali ezithunyelwa kuhulumeni kubantu abangakwazi ukuzisekela. Ikhokhwa kubantu abampofu ukusiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezibalulekile nokubhekana nezici ezincane kodwa ezibalulekile zempilo. Imali yokweseka iphakanyiswa ukuze kusekelwe imigomo eyinhloko yeSikhungo, okuyinto yokuphakamisa abampofu nokuthuthukisa ukuphila kwalabo abadinga usizo. Lapho ufaka isicelo sokwesekwa, isimo sezimali somfaki-sicelo kanye nalabo abahlanganyela nabo noma abathintekayo sihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umuntu uyafaneleka ukusizwa kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlola kwezomnotho." Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sokwesekwa akufanele ithathe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili kusukela ngesikhathi isicelo sithunyelwa. Qaphela: Izimali zokwesekwa zikhokhwa kubamukeli njalo ngenyanga. Usizo lwezingane ezikhuliswa ngabazali abangabazali bazo lukhokhwa kulabo abazali mayelana nengane ebekwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo ngokweMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983 (Umthetho No. 74 ka-1983). Umfaki-sicelo/ingane kumele ahlale eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. I-oda leNkantolo kumele lithunyelwe libonisa isimo sokunakekelwa kwabazali ngaphansi kokuthi ingane ibekwe. Ingane ethwele abazali abangabazali bayo kumele ihlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola kwezomnotho, okuyi-R 12,720 ngonyaka. Sithumela ehhovisi lezeMphakathi eliseduze lapho umfaki-sicelo ehlala khona. Uma abafaki-sicelo bephakathi kweminyaka eminingi kakhulu noma bephila kahle ukuze bafake isicelo sokwesekwa ngokwabo ehhovisi, ilunga lomndeni kufanele lifake isicelo ngabo. Ifomu lesicelo sizogcwaliswa phambi kwenhlangano yezeMphakathi. Uma ifomu lesicelo ligcwaliswe, umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa isiqinisekiso. Lesi siqinisekiso kumele sigcinwe - sikhombisa ubufakazi bokufakwa kwesicelo. Akufanele kukhokhwe imali yokufaka isicelo. Uma isicelo esithunyelwe singavunyelwa yiHhovisi lezeMphakathi, umfaki-sicelo kufanele aziswe ngokubhaliwe ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kwesicelo. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokuphikisa ngokubhala kwiNgqongqoshe yezeMphakathi esifundazweni sabo, echaza ukuthi kungani bengavumelani nesinqumo. Le mpikiswano kumele ithunyelwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa ngemiphumela yesicelo esithunyelwe. Uma imali yokwesekwa ivunywa, umfaki-sicelo uzokhokhwa kusukela ngosuku isicelo sithunyelwe. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele aziswe ngokubhaliwe ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kanye nenani losizo, kanye nelungelo labo lokuphikisa ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa. Qaphela: Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukuqoqa imali, umuntu ophathisiwe ngokomthetho angabekwa ukuqoqa imali egameni lomfaki-sicelo. Isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwemali yokwesekwa kumele sithunyelwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokuphakanyiswa. Umfaki-sicelo akufanele abe seRiphabhulikhi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhombise noma iyiphi imali engenayo ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kuzoba yisisekelo esizosebenzisa yiSikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inani losizo kufanele libuyekezwe. Umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa izinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyekezwa noma usuku lapho kudingeka khona isitifiketi sezempilo. Imali yokwesekwa kwezingane ikhokhwa kumgcinimafa ophakathi mayelana nengane engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umgcinimafa angaba yiluphi uhlobo lomuntu ophatheka ezidingweni zansuku zonke zengane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubandakanyeka noma cha. Umfaki-sicelo kanye nomuntu ophathelene naye kufanele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola kwezomnotho, okuyi-R9,600 ngonyaka ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kanye ne-R13,200 ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ingane nomgcinimafa wabo kufanele babe ngababumbi baseNingizimu Afrika futhi bahlale lapho. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele abe ngumgcinimafa ophakathi waleyo ngane. Ingane kufanele ibe ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umgcinimafa angafaka isicelo sezingane ezingaphezu kwezingu-6 ezingazange zibe zabo. Umfaki-sicelo akufanele abe ngumgcinimafa ophakathi kwengane; noma isikhungo sikhokhelwa ukunakekela ingane. Le mali yokwesekwa ikhokhwa kubazali, abazali bempela bengane ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo, kubagcinimafa bezingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-1 no-18, ngenxa yokukhubazeka okukhulu kwengqondo noma okwenyama okudingayo ukunakekelwa okugcwele. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele abe ngummeli waseNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwemibandela yabazali abahlala nengane engayibo. Umfaki-sicelo nengane kufanele bahlale eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha okuqinisekisa ukukhubazeka kumele kuthunyelwe. Umfaki-sicelo, umuntu ophathelene naye, nengane kufanele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola kwezomnotho, okuyi-R48,000 ngonyaka kubazali kanye ne-R17,760 nengane. Ingane ephila ngokuncika kokunakekelwa inganakekelwa ngokuphakade yisikhungo sikahulumeni.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwamalungelo Abantu: Umcimbi Wokukhumbula Nezinyathelo Zokuzivikela Ngomhla ka-10 kuNhlangulana, abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlangana eGoli emcimbini obalulekile, ukuze bakhumbule futhi baphakamise izwi labo ngokumelene nokuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu. Lo mcimbi, owenziwa ngamaqembu ahlukene ezokuhlalisana, ubandakanya izinkulumo ezivela kubaholi bendawo, abezindaba, kanye nezikhungo ezilwela amalungelo abantu, bonke bejolise ekuthuthukiseni isimo samalungelo abantu eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evula umcimbi, egcizelela ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayisisekelo sokuphila kahle futhi kufanele avikelwe ngokuqinile. Umgqugquzeli, uNksz. Thandiwe Mkhize, uthe: “Siyazi ukuthi kuningi okwenziwa ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, kodwa kusenezinto eziningi ezidinga ukulungiswa.” Lokhu kukhuthaze abantu ukuba baphendule futhi bathumele iziphakamiso zabo. Ngemuva kwalokho, izinkulumo ezivela kubaholi bamazwe ahlukene zaphakamisa izinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abahlukunyezwayo. Uthishanhloko, uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, uthe: “Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu akukhona kuphela okwenziwa ezindaweni ezikude, kodwa nakulezi zindawo esiphila kuzo.” Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano phakathi kwabantu abahlukahlukene, abakhuluma ngezinto abazibona zenzeka ezimpilweni zabo. Uhlelo lwemcimbi lwagcizelela izifundo ezivela ezincwadini ezibhalwe ngamalungelo abantu, lapho ababhali baphawula khona izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abahlukunyezwayo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba kunezinhlelo zokuvikela amalungelo abantu, ziningi izithiyo ezivela ezinhlelweni ezikhona, ezifana nokungabi bikho kokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ukungabikhona kwemali yokwenza izinhlelo zokuqwashisa, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uthathe ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa. Abantu baphakamisa iziphakamiso ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasemakhaya, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezilwela amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kwavusa umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bebonisa isifiso sokusebenza ndawonye ukuze bafeze izinjongo zabo. Umcimbi uphinde waphakanyiswa ngemicabango yokuthi ukufundiswa nokwaziswa kwabaqeqeshiwe kufanele kube yinsika yokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lubonisa ukuthi abantu abaningi abazi kahle amalungelo abo, okuholela ekutheni bahlukunyezwe kalula. Ukufundiswa kwalesi sihloko kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabavikela kanjani abanye. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele ekwakheni isikhala sokuxoxa, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Abantu baphuma bematasa, bejabule futhi bephakamisela izwi labo, beqonda ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu akukona okungathathwa kancane. Umphakathi ubonisa isifiso sokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, futhi umoya wokuzimisela ubonakala phakathi kwabo bonke ababe khona. Lo mcimbi ubonisa ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene namalungelo abantu, umphakathi unamandla okwenza ushintsho. Ukubambisana, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuzimisela kuyizinto ezisemqoka ekwakheni umhlaba ophumelelayo, lapho wonke umuntu ehlonishwa khona. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wawungesiyo nje indawo yokukhumbula, kodwa futhi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi sizokwenza kanjani ukuze siqhubeke siqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, futhi asavikelwe.
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqwa ngesikhathi ikwenza imisebenzi yayo yansuku zonke yokuhola imali yokuthola intela kuhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezintela zebhizinisi ezisiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zinhlelo. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, okubandakanya abakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, abakhuphukeli bezebhizinisi, abameli, kanye nabathengisi ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke inzuzo iboniswa kwi-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokuvikelwa kolwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi mayelana nabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi luyimfihlo futhi alunakukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphuthumayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kwalolu lwazi, uhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuba imfihlo ngaphansi kwemvume yomthetho, ngaphandle komuntu onelungelo lokuyithola noma kumuntu onemvume yokuthola lolu lwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekisela ekuvikelweni kokudluliswa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kube kubalulekile. Lezi zihloko ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti e-SARS, futhi uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS isungule umnyango owodwa wezicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandelela nokuphendula ngaphakathi kwezikhathi ezibekiwe umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nanoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingenzeka ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambelana nesiko eliphakanyiswa yi-SARS lokwenza izinto ngokusobala, njengoba umthetho uhlinzeka, kanye nokuhlonipha izimiso zokubopha, ubuqotho, kanye nokwethembeka kulabo i-SARS ihlanganyela nabo. Umphathiswa we-SARS nguMphathiswa weMali yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMnu. Pravin Gordhan. Phansi kwakhe kukhona abaphathiswa abane be-SARS, abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kolwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS njengoba umthetho ubhala njalo. Umpathiswa ngamunye unendawo ethile yomsebenzi ngokuya ngokuqonda kwabo nolwazi lomsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo ukuze basebenze ngayo ngokwazi kwabo kanye nesipiliyoni. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti agcinwe yi-SARS, kufanele uqedele ifomu eliku-Anexure 1 bese ulithumela kumphathiswa ofanele. Abaphathiswa basebenzisa ihhovisi elifanayo kanye neposi. Umphathiswa ofanele uzophendula ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (60 ezimweni ezithile) ukukwazisa ukuthi isicelo sakho sivunyelwe noma sikhishwe. Ezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma ufike kumarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukucubungula isicelo sakho kungadlula amahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungiselela ulwazi oluceliwe ngemuva kokuthi ukhokhe imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela oyicelile noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwe kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho indlela oyicelile. Lokhu kuyikhasi lokuqala lokushicilelwa kwedokhumenti mayelana nokusebenza komthetho we-SARS ngokomthetho. Kuzokhula futhi kukhule njengoba i-SARS nabaceli bolwazi behlola ukusebenza kahle kwalomthetho, kanye nokulinganisa ilungelo lokufinyelela kolwazi nezinye izimfanelo ezinikwe umthetho, njengokuphila, kanye nesidingo sokugcina uMbuso usebenza kahle. U- Ms. Jane uthi... Ezindabeni (eziphephandabeni, ithelevishini, umsakazo) zalesi sikhathi samanje, kukhuluma okuningi i-ANC Youth League mayelana nendaba yomhlaba (nokubhanga nemigodi), futhi kukhuthaza kakhulu ukubona ukuthi abantu abahlukene bakhuluma kanjani ngalesi sihloko somhlaba. Ngibona umhlaba njengomthombo okufanele siwusebenzisa ukukhiqiza ukudla nokuhlomula. Izinto eziningi lapha emhlabeni ziya zanda njalo unyaka nonyaka - abantu, izinkomo, izimoto, njll. Kodwa umhlaba awukwazi ukukhula - unemikhawulo. Uma ucabanga ngempilo eyanda njalo, kodwa umhlaba okhiqizayo uyancipha (masikhumbule ukuthi abantu badinga indawo yokwakha izindlu zabo - amadolobha akhula ngokusebenzisa umhlaba), kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba wonke usetshenziswa ngokukhiqiza. ENingizimu Afrika namuhla sinesimo esinzima ngoba iningi lomhlaba okhiqizayo liphethwe ngabantu abamhlophe. Manje kukhuluma ngokuthatha lowo mhlaba, hhayi ukuwuthenga, bese unikezwa abantu abamnyama. Kukho nezinye izinto okufanele zikhunjulwe, kukhona inani elikhulu lomhlaba eliphethwe nguhulumeni (ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke) kodwa izindawo eziningi zalo mhlaba azisetshenziswanga kahle. Kukhona futhi izinkulungwane zamahhektare ezabelwe uMnyango Wezomhlaba ngezinhlaka zawo. Lokhu kuhambisana nombala wesikhumba somuntu. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo, noma ungazimela, uphila endaweni encane, noma ungumkhiqizi wezohwebo akusho lutho ngalokho umbala wesikhumba somuntu. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uma ufuna ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo, udinga ulwazi namakhono, imishini, imakethe, kanye ne-capital yokuqala yokutshala. Ukunikeza umuntu umhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi - nje ngoba uphakathi kwegaraji akusho ukuthi ungimoto! Ngokufanayo, nje ngoba unomhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi. Uma ufuna ukukhonjiswa njengomkhiqizi, kumele usebenzise umhlaba wakho ngokuphelele - kumele ukhiqize ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza kulowo mhlaba. Ngifuna ukuphakamisa ukuthi sixhase ngamandla ethu bonke labo abanomhlaba ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa wonke umhlaba okhiqizayo ukukhiqiza ukudla kwethu. Umhlaba uyigugu elikhulu; uma unomhlaba, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuwusebenzisa. Masihlangane njengabantu abangakhiqizi ukuze sikhulise lokho esikwazi, sishiye izehlakalo ezikhuluma abapolitiki abakhonza kuphela bona.
U-Napoleon Bonaparte, lo mdundu owaziwayo emlandweni, uzwakala njengomuntu onemibono eminingi. Uthathwa njengomholi onamandla, kodwa futhi nokuthi ube nemiphumela emikhulu emlandweni waseYurophu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi uNapoleon wazalwa eCorsica, ngonyaka ka-1769? Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphila kwakhe okwandayo, lapho ahlale khona ezindaweni eziningi, eFrance, e-Itali, nakwezinye izindawo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngaye, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uNapoleon wayengumuntu ophumelelayo. Uqala njengomphakathi ojolayo, kodwa akazange ame ukuma nje; wayephusha phezulu, efuna ithuba lokuba ngumholi. Ngemuva kokuhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, waba iGeneral lezempi, futhi kamuva waba nguMongameli. Lokhu akuzange kube lula, kodwa ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokulwa, izinhlelo zempilo zakhe, nezifundo azifundile empilweni bamsiza kakhulu. Okwaziwa kakhulu ngaye yizimpi aziholela, ikakhulukazi iMpi Yezwe Yokuqala. U-Napoleon wayenobuchwepheshe bokuhlela impi, futhi wayaziwa ngethuba lokwakha izinhlelo ezinhle. Kodwa-ke, akazange abe nempi eyodwa kuphela. Kwakukhona izimpi eziningi, futhi ngenxa yabaphikisi bakhe, akazange akwazi ukusinda. Uhambo lwakhe lwezombusazwe lwaluyinselelo enkulu, futhi wayesebenzisa amasu ahluke kakhulu. Ngemuva kokuphuma esigodlweni, uNapoleon wafaka imiqondo emisha emlandweni, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abanye babe nokuqonda okukhulu ngempilo. Ubephinde abe nomthelela emfundweni, njengoba abefuna ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zefundiso eFrance. Ngisho nasemazingeni emhlabeni jikelele, wayebonwa njengomholi onenjongo, owakha izinhlelo zokuhlela izwe. Kodwa-ke, akuzange kube lula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yokuqala, uNapoleon wahlala enezinkinga eziningi. Wayezithola ebhekene nezithiyo eziningi, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abuyele eFrance. Lokhu kwaze kwaba nzima, njengoba izimpi zaphinde zakhula. Kwakukhona nezinkinga zempilo, futhi uNapoleon waba nesikhathi esinzima. Kodwa uNapoleon akazange akwenze konke kube nzima; wayengumuntu ophokophelelayo. Wazama ukubuyisela amandla, futhi kwaba nezinye izikhathi lapho abaphikisi bakhe bephikisana naye. Lokhu kwaba yinto enzima, kodwa uNapoleon wayezama ukuba neqhaza emlandweni. Ubephinde abe nesithakazelo emhlabeni nasemafundweni, futhi wayebona ukuthi izwe lakhe liyadinga izinguquko ezithile. Noma kunjalo, izinsuku zikaNapoleon zashabalala. Ngemuva kokuhlaselwa phezulu, wathola ukuthi umhlaba ubunzima kakhulu, futhi izinhlelo zakhe zaphuka. Uqedele isikhathi eside lapho abelokhu esebenza, kodwa ekugcineni, waba nesikhathi sokubuyisela emuva. Iziphumo zempilo zikaNapoleon zashintsha, futhi wathola ukuthi isikhathi sakhe siphelile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNapoleon ube usuku lwakhe lokugcina eSt. Helena, lapho abehlezi khona ezinsukwini zakhe zokugcina. Kwakungesikhathi sokuhlola konke okwakwenziwe, futhi ubephinde abheke emuva ngezinkumbulo zakhe. U-Napoleon wayengumuntu onemizwa eminingi, futhi ngempela, wayengumholi owawuthanda izwe lakhe. Ubuye waba nemisebenzi eminingi emhlabeni, futhi izifundo zakhe zingakuphakamisa. Ngombono wami, uNapoleon Bonaparte ungumuntu ongakhumbulekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokuhlela impi, izifundo emfundweni nasemazingeni emhlabeni jikelele ziwusizo. Kodwa ngasohlangothini, izinkinga azihlangabezane nazo zikhombisa ukuthi ngisho abaholi abanamandla bangabhekana nezinselelo ezinzima. U-Napoleon ufakazela ukuthi impilo iyinselele, futhi ngempela, imiphumela yempilo iyashintsha.
Bonke amafutha okwenziwa, athunyelwe, noma athengiswa eNingizimu Afrika kumele abhaliswe ngaphansi koMlawuli weMthetho 36 ka-1947. Umfakisicelo kumele abe ngumuntu ongena emthethweni, ngokwesibonelo, uJohn Peter Citizen T/A owenza ibhizinisi ngaphansi kwegama: Diepsloot Stud. Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhaliswe kuleli, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, noma isikhungo esisemthethweni esibhaliswe eNingizimu Afrika esingafaka isicelo samafutha. Amafutha eqembu 1 yilezo eziqukethe i-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, noma i-potassium njengengxenye eyinhloko, ezaziwa nangokuthi amafutha angaphandle. Usayizi bezikhwama noma iziqukathi abakwazi ukushintshwa ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela koMlawuli. Isicelo sokubhaliswa kokudla kwezilwane namafutha kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumfakisicelo noma kumuntu ophakanyisiwe ukuba umele umfakisicelo. Thumela ifomu lesicelo lemibhalo emisha kanye nezichibiyelo ezibhalwe phansi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ekwakhiweni. Thumela amafomu amabili, aphelele ngokuphelele, ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, izinombolo zamakhasi, noma emikhiqizweni eminye. Omunye ungaba ikhophi. Umuntu ophakanyisiwe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yilowo ofuna ukuxhumana nenkampani noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu wesicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele isetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, noma ngabe sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuchibiyela. Thumela amafomu wesicelo ehhovisi eliphethe. Ukuhlinzeka ngamaformu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzophazamisa isikhathi ngokubambezela inqubo. Bhala ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akukho sidingo sokuphrinta amalebula ngalezi zilimi zombili; kumele abhalwe kahle. Ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezixwayisweni zokuphepha. Lonke ulwazi kumalebula kumele luhambisane ngqo nalokho okunikezwa kufomu lesicelo. Thumela isicelo sakho kanye nezimali kuMlawuli weMthetho 36 ka-1947. Ukubhaliswa kwamafutha kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.
Noma ubani onenhlalakahle engapheli eNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukufaka isicelo sokuba ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-naturalisation ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngum resident ophakeme. Noma ubani oshadile nom citizen waseNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukuba ngum citizen wesinye isizwe ngemuva kweminyaka emibili kulandela ukuhanjiswa kwenhlalakahle engapheli etholelwe ngokushada. Izingane ezineminyaka engu-21 ezinokuhlala okuphakeme ziyafaneleka ukuba ngababusi besinye isizwe, uma ukuhlala kuphumelele ngokushesha ngemuva kokukhishwa. Qedela ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-63 kanye ne-BI-757 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma le-mission uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela imvume yokuhlala engapheli noma ukwehliswa. Qedela ifomu le-SAP kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe ukuze uthole isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka komphakathi. Thumela ifomu le-BI-9 eliqediwe kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe nezithombe ezimbili ezinomumo we-ID uma usukhulile kunezinyanga eziyi-15. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthola ub identification ngemuva kokwamukelwa kwesicelo sakho sokuba ngum citizen wesinye isizwe. Umzali onengane angafaka isicelo egameni lezingane ezincane nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho ingane incane ihlala ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Abafakizicelo abamukelwe bazodingeka ukuthi basayine i-Declaration of Allegiance futhi bazonikezwa isitifiketi se-naturalisation, kanye nenombolo ye-R. Ubuqotho buzokwenziwa futhi buthunyelwe kumfakizicelo. Abafakizicelo abamukelwe bazokwaziwa ngokufanele. Izicelo zingathatha ezinyangeni ezi-2 kuya kwezi-4. Le sevisi iyamahala. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezeMisebenzi eliseduze.
NgoMeyi 2010, ngesikhathi semvula, sahlinzeka ngohlu lwezinto okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi. Itraktori iyadingeka epulazini; uma ungakwenzi lokho, uzobanga izindleko eziningi. Bheka amanzi uma injini isashisa. Uma kungekho ibhodlela lamanzi, i-radiator kufanele ibe ne-25mm ukusuka phezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona i-antifreeze. Qinisa ama-pins alinganayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uxhumano lunamafutha futhi ukuthi kukhona ama-pins afanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-bolts aqinile. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi izinyathelo zokuphepha zaleyo traktori. Ezinye izinhlobo zidinga ukuthi ufinyelele kwi-clutch bese uyikhipha ngaphambi kokuphakamisa. Phakamisa kancane futhi uhlole zonke izinkomba nezibani. Uma kukhona inkinga, yenza kube lula ngokushesha ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili. Ungayiqhumi kakhulu injini. Sebenzisa ithuluzi elifanele futhi uqinisekise ukuthi injini ayikhathazeki. Vumela injini igijime kancane ukuze ivumele i-turbo ipholile ngaphambi kokuyivala. Gcwalisa ithangi nge-diesel ngemuva kokusebenza - lokhu kuzovimbela umoya ekubanjweni nasekuguqukeni kube amanzi.
Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi seKhisimusi, indawo kaMnumzane Bhengu yayihlotshiswe kahle kakhulu. Izihlahla ezinhle, imihlobiso eminingi, nezibani ezikhanyayo zazigcwalisa izindlu zakhe nabangane bakhe. Umoya weKhisimusi wawuqhakazile, ugcwele uthando nokuhlangana, okwakujabulisa bonke abahlali bendawo. UMnumzane Bhengu, indoda enobuhlakani, wayethokozela lezi zinsuku, ngoba zazingezokuphila okubalulekile. Ubhuti wakhe, uSizwe, wayevame ukufika ngesikhathi seKhisimusi, ezinsukwini ezikhethekile. Njengoba uSizwe efika, uMnumzane Bhengu wayejabula, ubuso bakhe bukhanya ngothando. "Ngabe ubuya ngempela ukuze uvuse umoya wokukhumbula, mngani?" kubuza uMnumzane Bhengu, efuna ukuqonda indlela uSizwe azokwenza ngayo lesi sikhathi. USizwe, owayeqaphelile, waphendula: “Yebo, umngani, ngizohlala ngikhumbula iminyaka edlule, lapho sazi ukuhamba sihlola izihlahla ezinhle. Ngifisa ukwabelana ngalokho.” Bebehamba ngezinyawo emzini, behleka bejabule. Ukitshimi omncane wawusemoyeni, uzungeza amakhaya, uphakamisa umoya wokudlala. Abazali babo baphuma behleli, bejabulile, behlobisa izingane ezicela imiqhingle. Umama uMahlobo, unina kaMnumzane Bhengu, wayeletha imifino, izithelo, kanye nezimbuzi zokupheka. Imvuselelo yokuphila yayikubuyisela eminyakeni edlule, lapho amakhosikazi ayebhalisela amaholo nsuku zonke ukuze baqhubeke. Ngesikhathi esinzima, uZinhle, umntwana omncane, wayehamba no-gogo wakhe, evula izindololwane ezazikhala emoyeni. UMhlobo wakhe, uThandi, wayehamba, enza izinhlelo zokuhlala noKhisimusi. Kulawa maholide, uMnumzane Bhengu wanikeza umntwana izipho. Uthando lwempilo lwalukhanya phezulu, futhi uThandi noZinhle bakhuluma ngothando lwabo. Njengoba besondela ezinjeni, uMnumzane Bhengu wavuma ukuthi baphume bonke. “Sizokwakha iviki eliphephile, sizohamba. Umhlanga ungahlala isikhathi eside, okukhuluma ngomoya.” UMama uMahlobo wathokozisa bonke ngemifino, zikhumbula izinkanyezi ezimnyama, ekubhekeni ebusuku. Ubhuti uSizwe wathokoziswa empilweni, ukufika kwasebucikweni, nokuqhubekela phambili kokukhumbuza izinkanyezi ezihamba ngale kwelanga. Ngesikhathi efika elangeni, uMnumzane Bhengu wathola ukuphendula okuhle. Abafowabo babekhonjiswa ukubekezela, bekhombisa umndeni ukuqhakambisa impilo yothando. “Phuma, sithakele khona,” bathi lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya. Kukhanya izinkanyezi ezifakazela uhlobo lwenhlonipho. Uthokozisa, uMnumzane Bhengu waphakamisa izinkanyezi ezinhle, ugqozi lokukhanya kwakhe lwalukhanya emoyeni. Impilo yokugcina yayigubha umndeni, lapho izilo zichuma emagumbini. Khumbula izinkanyezi ezihamba, uMnumzane Bhengu wafunda uthando, ubusuku obunobungane konke. Lapho behamba besuka, ukudla neqhwa kwavuma. Iziqholo zegolide zebhasi zanyathelisa ngenxa yokuthokozisa, futhi bahlala befika besebhasi. Phakathi nemihlangano, bahlala bezama ukuphumula, bekhuluma ngothando, benza izinkanyezi zikhanye emzimbeni. Kwahamba isikhathi, umnyango wawuvulekile, futhi njengoba uKhisimusi uphelile, uMnumzane Bhengu wahamba nethuba lokwakha umndeni. Gxila emphakathini, ubusuku ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi kuqhamuke, kuncibilika. UThandi noZinhle bahlala behamba, bekwenza izindlela ezilungile, baphumula izinkanyezi. UKhisimusi wawuphelile — kodwa uthando, ubudlelwano, nempilo yempilo bekukhanya, kuyavuma. Emvcwebe, idlozi lalingekho, uMnumzane Bhengu ugwema ukuthi umndeni uzokhula. Lokhu, isilinganiso sokugcina, kuxoxa njengoba izinkanyezi, umoya, uvuka kabusha, kucela ukuthula nemihlangano esewuzayo, kuhamba nomndeni, umyalezo omuhle wothando. I-Khisimusi ayipheli; ithokozisa, ibaluleka, ithokozise, iphile. Umndeni wachuma ngamunye, kwavuma ngenhliziyo. Ngaphansi kokukhanya, impilo yayimnandi, ijabule.
Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika: Uhlolo Olubanzi Kusukela emuva kweminyaka eyishumi nanhlanu edlule, uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika usungule isisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umphakathi ovulekile, onobulungiswa, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ukwakhiwa kwalokhu mthethosisekelo, owamukelwa ngempumelelo ngonyaka ka-1996, kuhambisana nezinguquko ezinkulu ezwenikazi, ezizwakala kumlando wezombusazwe, ezomnotho, nezokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo. Isizinda: Uhambo Olukhulu Lokushintsha Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuvuselelwa koMthethosisekelo, kubalulekile ukuhlola isizinda somlando. Ngaphambi kokuholwa kweMpi Yenkululeko, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babephila phansi kwemigomo yobufokeng, oxhaxha hlobo lobudlovandlela. Izinkombandlela zikhona ezingeni eliphakeme loshintsho, futhi kwangena isimo esisha lapho ubumbano lwezinkampani zamalungelo abantu, njenge-MK (uMkhonto weSizwe), lwavula umnyango wokuxoxisana. Lokhu kwafaka isandla ekwakheni isigaba esisha sokucabanga, sokuhlonipha izinhlaka ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo: Izinyathelo Eziyinhloko Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo kwahambisana nezifundiso eziphambili, ezazidala isikhala esisha somqondo. Izinyathelo ezibalulekile ziqala ngonyaka ka-1994, lapho kwenziwa khona ukhetho lwokuqala nolwakho lweminyaka, olwakuvumela bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ngabe banemibala ehlukene, ukuba bavote. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komkhandlu omkhulu, owawuhlanganisa izizathu eziningi, okubalwa kuzo amaqembu ahlukene ezehlukeneyo, okwakubuhlungu ukuba abavoti bephumelele. Umkhandlu wawuhlinzeke ngesisekelo esiqinile sokudidiyela imiqondo ehlukahlukene ukuze sakhe umthethosisekelo ophumelelayo. Umthethosisekelo uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unamalungelo alinganayo, okuhlanganisa nokuhlonishwa kweziphetho zamasiko nezinkolo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni indawo ephumelelayo yokuphila, efaka izidingo zomphakathi, amazinga obuhlakani, nezinto ezimbi ezazikhona emiphakathini. Ubuqotho bamabhuku bobuchwepheshe, imishado, kanye namalungelo okuzalwa akwenza umthethosisekelo ube yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha ubumbano nokuqhubeka. Ubuhle nezinselelo emthethweni Nakuba umthethosisekelo unikeza umbono omuhle mayelana nelungelo labantu, akuphuthelwa ukuthi kunezinselelo ezinqala ezibhekene nomphakathi. Ukuhlupheka, ukungabi namsebenzi, nemingcele yezomnotho kusekhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi abantu benze izinqumo ezintle ngesimo sabo. Ubufakazi obukhona bukhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezibangelwa ukuhleleka okungelungile kwezomnotho zenza kube nzima ukuhambisana nemigomo emisha yokuhlalisana. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kubekhona amasu ahlukene okuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bayavuma lesi simo. Ukufuduka kokuziphatha komthetho Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi umthethosisekelo uhlale ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokulungisa inhlalakahle. Ukuvuselela umthetho wokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kungumsebenzi othembisa ikusasa elikhanya. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo zokusebenza zedlula ezakhamuzini, izigaba zempilo, nezokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi qinisekisa ukuthi umthethosisekelo awusiyihlanga kuphela, kodwa ungaphumi lapha. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo akugcini nje ekubhalweni kokuqina kwezinyathelo, kodwa kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokulondoloza incwadi yomthetho. Ukuze sizuze eduzane, abantu kumele baqhubeke bexhumana, benza izinhlelo ezifaneleko, futhi bahloniphe izimiso zomthethosisekelo. Lokhu kuzodala isizinda esiqinile sokwakha ezinhlelweni, nezimiso zokwakha umphakathi. Isiphetho: Umthethosisekelo Njengesikhumbuzo Sempumelelo Ngesikhathi sihlola ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo, sithola ukuthi umthethosisekelo uvula iminyango emisha yokuhlala esidlangalaleni, ukwakha ubumbano nokuqhubeka. Iminyaka edlule ibonisa ukuthi yize kunezinkinga ezikhona, uMthethosisekelo uhlale unguMhlahlandlela ezizweni eziningi, uqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu awafudukeli phansi. Ngaleyo ndlela, umthethosisekelo ungohlobo olunsthyama ekwaziseni umphakathi wonke, uqinisekisa ukuba umphakathi ulondoloza isiko, ukhula ngokuhlanganyela, uvuma izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Emva kokubuyekezwa, sithola ukuthi uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika ungumqoka kagesi odidayo okhombisa umehluko emlandweni, onqamulelayo phakathi kokuhluka komphakathi. Iphupha lesizwe liqhubeka liphila, lizama ukufezekisa umoya wokuhlonipha, ubumba bokuqonda okwenze kube sobala. Lokhu kuzophinda kube yisifundo emiphakathini eminingi, okungathiwa umuntu oyedwa, lapho siphelela khona, izwe lethu lisebenza kanjani empilweni.
Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS (GEMS membership contributions and payments) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano yokuhlomula yezempilo, iyinsiza eyenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo ezinhle kubasebenzi bakamasipala eNingizimu Afrika. I-GEMS iyisixazululo esiyingqayizivele sokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo ezithuthukisiwe, okuyinto ethokozisa kakhulu amalungu ayo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu le-GEMS? Impendulo: Ukuze ube yilungu le-GEMS, ungathola izinzuzo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokwelashwa, nezinsiza zokuhlala eziphakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungu angathola izaphulelo ezithile ezinhlelweni ezithile, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Umbuzo 3: Uphi umthombo wemali weminikelo ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Iminikelo ye-GEMS itholakala kubasebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nohulumeni. Ngokuvamile, umkhiqizo wezezimali wokuhlinzeka nge-GEMS uhlinzekwa ngqo emholweni wabasebenzi, lapho uhlelo lwe-GEMS luhlinzeka khona ngeminikelo ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe iminikelo ye-GEMS iyahluka? Impendulo: Yebo, iminikelo ye-GEMS iyahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lwenhlangano, izinga lokuhlinzeka kwezempilo, kanye nezidingo zomuntu siqu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amalungu angase athole izinketho ezahlukene zamaholo, okubandakanya nezinkokhelo ezincane noma ezinkulu, kuye ngezinga labo lokusebenza. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani izinkokhelo zisebenza? Impendulo: Izinkokhelo ze-GEMS zenzeka njalo, ngokuvamile ngenyanga, bese zihlolwa futhi zikhokhwa ngempumelelo. Amalungu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinkokhelo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bangathola izinsiza eziphelele ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngikhumbula ukukhokha? Impendulo: Uma uthola ukuthi kukhona okukhumbulelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi uxhumane ne-GEMS ngokushesha. Ungabafonela noma uvakashele i-ofisi yabo ukuze uthole usizo lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukukhokha isikweletu sakho. Umbuzo 7: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo zokukhokha ngaphambi kwesikhathi? Impendulo: Yebo, ezinye izinhlelo ze-GEMS zikhuthaza amalungu ukuba akhokhe ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokho kungaholela ezinzuzweni ezikhethekile, ezifana nezaphulelo noma izinzuzo ezithuthukisiwe. Umbuzo 8: Kunjani ukufaka isicelo sokuhlinzwa? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo sokuhlinzwa, amalungu kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi baphatha zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo, kuhlanganise nezincomo zomtholampilo. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, isicelo sizophenywa, futhi uma kutholakale ukuthi kuhlinzekwa, kuzokwenziwa ukufinyelela. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe i-GEMS inezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezinhlelo eziningi ezihloselwe ukusiza amalungu akhona, kuhlanganise nezinyathelo zokukhuthaza impilo, izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezixazululo zengqondo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza amalungu abhekana nezinselelo zempilo. Umbuzo 10: Kanjani ngithola olunye ulwazi mayelana ne-GEMS? Impendulo: Ungathola olunye ulwazi oluvela ku-website esemthethweni ye-GEMS, noma uvakashele i-ofisi yabo. Futhi, ungaxhumana nezinye amalungu ukuze uthole izeluleko nezincazelo ezithile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ngokubambisana, i-GEMS inikela ithuba lokuhlomula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga khona usizo lwezempilo. Ukuthola izinsiza ezimnandi nezihloniphekile kuhloswe ukuhlinzeka amalungu ngenhlalakahle engcono. Njengamalungu, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zeminikelo nezinkokhelo ukuze sithole izinzuzo eziphelele ezitholakalayo.
Ezamandla: Ukubaluleka Kwezamandla Emhlabeni Wethu Ezinsukwini zethu zanamuhla, amandla (energy) abe yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngaphandle kwamandla, imisebenzi yethu yansuku zonke ingase ingaqhubeki. Kusukela ekukhanyiseni izindlu zethu, ekushiseni amakhaya, kuze kube ekusebenzeni kwemishini eminingi, amandla adlala indima enkulu empilweni yethu. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amandla awatholakali kalula, futhi ukusetshenziswa kwawo kudinga ukuba siqaphele. Ngokweqiniso, amandla ahlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, njengezinto eziphilayo, ezivela emithonjeni yemvelo, kanye namandla aphuma emithonjeni yokwenziwa. Amandla avamile, njengezinto eziphilayo, ahlanganisa amandla elanga, amanzi, nomoya. Lezi zinsiza zikhona emhlabeni, kodwa zidinga ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ukuze ziqhubeke zikhona. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umhlaba wethu ubhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu, ezifana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, ukungcoliswa, kanye nokuncipha kwemithombo yemvelo. Ngokubheka izimo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amandla asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izindlela zokukhiqiza amandla, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa amandla, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokusebenzisa amandla elanga zikhula ngokushesha. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukusiza ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngendlela enempilo. Amandla elanga akhombisa ukuthi singakha kanjani umphakathi ozimele, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa okuqinile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lwamandla. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amandla akhulu kakhulu, futhi kufanele siqaphele ukuthi asiwafuni kuphela, kodwa kufanele siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise imikhuba yokuphila, sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amandla awatholakali kalula. Ukukhiqiza amandla kudinga izinsiza, isikhathi, kanye nemali. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amandla asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise izindlela zokukhiqiza amandla, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa amandla, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ekugcineni, amandla ayinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukusebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele akusizi kuphela ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngendlela enempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa okuqinile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lwamandla. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeni sithuthukise izindlela zokukhiqiza amandla, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa amandla, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila ezisebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza umhlaba wethu ube ngcono, ube nekhono, futhi ube nekhono lokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi amandla awatholakali kalula, kodwa uma sithatha izinyathelo eziphusile, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ozimele, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza umhlaba wethu ube ngcono, ube nekhono, futhi ube nekhono lokuphila. Amandla ayinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele.
Ulwazi lokusebenzisa amathayi akho efemini ngendlela efanele luzokusiza ukuba usebenze ngokuphepha futhi unciphise izindleko kanye nokulimala kwezitshalo nasemhlabathini. Ukuhamba efemini kusho ukusebenza ezindaweni eziningi ezihlukene - ukulima emapulazini nasekudonseni ithreyi emgwaqweni ophukile. Lokhu kuyahluka, kodwa kukhona umyalezo obalulekile okufanele ulandelwe njalo. Lapho sikhuluma ngamahayi, kunezinto ezibalulekile: hlanganisa uhlobo lwethayi nohlobo lomsebenzi (ukusebenza emhlabathini, sands ethambile, njll.), landela imihlahlandlela yomkhiqizi mayelana nosayizi nohlobo lwamahayi, ikakhulukazi hlanganisa ingcindezi yomoya nesisindo somthwalo nendawo lapho kusetshenziswa khona. Umoya kuphela ngaphakathi kwethayi ophatha umthwalo othile, futhi abakhiqizi bamathayi afana neGoodyear bakhombisa umthwalo wethayi ethile, ingcindezi, kanye nezinga lesivinini. Uma uthwala okuthile okukhulu kakhulu kodwa ungakhuphuli ingcindezi yomoya, kuzokwenza amathayi akhathale futhi aphume ngokushesha, okuzokwenza imishini ingasebenzi kahle futhi amathayi azokhathala ngokushesha. Uma umthwalo unheavy futhi amathayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele, ithayi izogoba ohlangothini futhi imiphetho yethayi ingase ikhathele futhi ithayi izophuka njengoba ihamba. Amathayi e-bias noma e-crossply ajwayele ukuhamba ohlangothini uma umthwalo unheavy futhi ingcindezi iphansi uma amawheels edonswa kanzima, umzimba wonke wethayi uzonakala. Ithayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele ingase igxume emgqeni futhi i-bead ingase iphuke, nendawo lapho ithayi ibamba khona emgqeni izonakala. Ngakolunye uhlangothi: uma ithayi inengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu, iba qinile kakhulu, okwenza ithayi ibambe kuphela emgwaqweni ngaphakathi futhi ikhathele lapho. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi ithayi lonke alibambisani nomhlaba, futhi alikwazi ukubamba kahle, lizogxuma futhi limilise umhlabathi. Uma kudingeka ukusebenza ngamahayi ezimo lapho kudingeka khona, amathayi azohamba kalula. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukulungisa ingcindezi ngokwezimo zokusebenza, njengokudonsela ithreyi noma emshinini omunye, noma ukuhamba emgwaqweni ophukile. Ubuningi bengingcindezi yethayi busemqoka, kodwa ukusebenzisa ithayi enengcindezi ehlukile kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni kwamawheels kanye nengcindezi yayo emhlabathini. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona izitshalo nemithombo ngaphansi komhlaba, kungase kube ngcono ukusebenza ngethayi elibanzi elinengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzovumela imishini ukuthwala umthwalo ofanayo njengethayi elincane ngobubanzi kodwa eliqinile emoyeni - le thayi izojwayela ukuhamba kalula emhlabathini futhi iqinise umhlabathi. Ngokufanayo, emsandleni, ithayi elibanzi elingaqinile kakhulu lizobamba kahle ngoba linendawo enkulu yokubamba - lihamba phezu komsand, lingagxili. Kungcono ukusebenzisa i-4 wheel drive uma umhlaba uhlehlela, kodwa ungasebenzisa lokhu emgwaqweni ophukile noma emigwaqweni eqinile ngoba kuholela ekukhathaleni okungalingani kumathayi aphambili, okwenza ukuhamba kube nzima nokusebenzisa ezinye izingxenye ngendlela ephunyukayo.
Iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu be-GEMS Sanibonani nonke! Namuhla ngizokhuluma ngenhloso ethile, okuyi-GEMS, okuyinsiza ebalulekile kubantu abaningi. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS imele ini? I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, iyinsiza yokwelashwa eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kulabo abathanda ukwazi, i-GEMS inezinhlelo eziningi ezihlukahlukene ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa, kodwa okukhuluma kakhulu lapha yiminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu. Uma sikhuluma ngemali yokungena, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zihlala zikhona. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zidingeka ukuze kube nokwaneliseka kwezinsizakalo? Kulungile, ngizokuchazela. Umuntu obulunga kwi-GEMS udinga ukukhokha imali ethile njalo, ukuze abe nezinzuzo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ngaphandle kwemali yokungena, i-GEMS ingakwazi kanjani ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle? Ngicabanga ukuthi kulungile ukucacisa ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zihluke kakhulu kuye ngohlobo lobulungu. Kukhona lezi ezibizwa ngokuthi "izinkokhelo zenyanga" ezikhokhwa njalo ngenyanga, kanye nezinye ezibizwa ngokuthi "izinkokhelo zonyaka." Lezi zinkokhelo zikhokhwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umbulali uzothola ukwelashwa okudingayo. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi uma ungakhokhi, ungase ungabi nezinzuzo ezithile? Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukugcina umthetho. Ngokuphathelene nezinkokhelo, i-GEMS inezindlela ezahlukene zokukhokha. Ungakhetha ukukhokha nge-inthanethi, ngeposi, noma ngokuqhafaza emnyangweni. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavame ukuba nezinkinga zokuhamba. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS inezinhlelo ezithile ezikhethekile zokukhokha? Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungakakwazi ukukhokha yonke imali ngesikhathi, ungase ube nezinketho ezithile zokuhlela ukukhokha. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngokuba nezinzuzo eziningi? Ngaphezu kokwelashwa okujwayelekile, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo ezihlukahlukene ezifana nezinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinsizakalo zezempilo, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwezingane. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu abaningi badinga izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, futhi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezimo ezithile ezithinta iminikelo nezinkokhelo. Kukhona izimo lapho umbulali angase abe nezinselelo zokukhokha, futhi i-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngokuthi inezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abanjalo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungakwazi ukukhokha, ungathola usizo ukuze uqhubeke uthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS inezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhokhe? Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinzuzo ezengeziwe kubantu abakhokha ngokushesha, noma abakhokha izinkokhelo zonyaka. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle futhi bakhokhe ngesikhathi. Ngokuphathelene nezinkokhelo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi lezi zinkokhelo zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle izinqubo zokukhokha, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephila kahle. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi i-GEMS inezinsizakalo ezithokozisayo ezithinta iminikelo nezinkokhelo? Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakalo zokuhlola, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwezingane. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu abaningi badinga izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, futhi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Ngokuphetha, i-GEMS iyinsiza ebalulekile kubantu abaningi, futhi iminikelo nezinkokhelo zobulungu zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nsiza iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukubaluleka kokukhokha, ukuze siqhubeke sithola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinto ezikhuluma ngazo zizokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuqonda i-GEMS nokubaluleka kwemali yokungena.
UMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zasembusweni kanye namaMEC anegunya lezamasiko, ukhethe isihloko esithi "Ukugubha Ifa Eliphilayo ('Izinto Esiphila Nazo') Ngonyaka Wesishiyagalombili Wezokhetho Lwethu" ngesikhathi somhlangano wabo we-MINMEC ngoMgqibelo 2004. Lesi sihloko sizosetshenziswa eminyakeni emithathu ezayo, kuzoqedwa ngoSepthemba 2007. Umnyango uhlose ukusebenzisa inyanga ye-Heritage njengendlela yokukhuthaza umbono wesikhathi eside wokuhlanganisa, ukugcina, ukuvikela, ukuthuthukisa, nokusabalalisa ifa eliphilayo/ifa lesizwe elingathinteki. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba imibhalo yepholisi yaseNingizimu Afrika nemithetho ivame ukubhekisela efeni eliphilayo, emhlabeni jikelele (e-UNESCO) ibizwa ngokuthi ifa lesiko elingathinteki. Le ndlela entsha iyathandwa ngaphakathi komgomo osanda kusungulwa yi-International Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, lapho abaqeqeshi nabasebenza nefa lesiko sebegqoke ukufaka ifa eliphilayo nefa lesiko elingathinteki ngokufanayo. Lapho othile ekhuluma ngefa eliphilayo, kuqondwa ukuthi ingxoxo ibhekisela efeni lesiko elingathinteki kanye nokukhula kwalo. Incazelo, njengoba iboniswe kwi-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye ne-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ifaka inqubo ephelele yemvelo, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi seMemezelo, "Ifa Lesiko Elingathinteki" libhekisela ezindleleni, emifanekisweni, ezikhombisweni, ulwazi, amakhono - kanye nezinsiza, izinto, nezindawo ezihlobene nazo - ezihlonishwa yimiphakathi, amaqembu, nabantu njengengxenye yeifa labo lesiko, edluliselwa kusuka kwesizukulwane ukuya kwesizukulwane, eqhubeka ikhiqizwa yimiphakathi namaqembu mayelana nemvelo yabo, ukuxhumana kwabo nemvelo, kanye nomlando wabo, futhi ibanika umqondo wokuhlonipha nokuphila, ngaleyo ndlela ikhuthaza ukuhlonishwa kwehlukahluka kwezamasiko kanye nokudala kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi seMemezelo, ukuvuma kuzokwenziwa kuphela kwifa lesiko elingathinteki elihambisana nezimiso zeziqinisekiso zomuntu njengokufunwa kokuhlonipha phakathi kwemiphakathi, amaqembu, nabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuxhaswayo. Iziqondiso zomlomo nezikhombisi, ezihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwefa lesiko elingathinteki, nazo zifakiwe. Lezi zichazamazwi ezandulele (kokubili ngokomthetho waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nomthetho wamazwe omhlaba) zibhekisela kumqondo oxhumene kakhulu. Umkhuba ojwayelekile ufaka izinkolelo zomlomo, imiphumela, imikhuba yomphakathi, nolwazi lwemvelo, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Lapho othile ekwazi ukubona umehluko, akuwona umehluko ngokwakhiwa kodwa ngokuchazwa kwamagama. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenzisa lezi ziqondiso ngokufanayo, njengoba abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika benza, akuhambisani nokwephula noma iyiphi imithetho kodwa kunalokho kubonisa ukuhamba kokukhetha. Ifa eliphilayo lifana nanoma yimuphi umphumela womuntu ophathelene nesikhathi sokusungulwa kobukhosi bamazwe omhlaba kanye nabakhi benhlangano engeyabo. Kuyisakhiwo futhi kuhlala kuyisakhiwo solwazi oluphilayo lwemiphakathi ehlukene ezimweni zomlando ezithile. Kuyilokho ulwazi oluphilayo abanalo; indlela abaphatha ngayo ukuzalwa, ukukhula, ukuguga, umshado, nokufa; indlela abakhumbula ngayo lezi zinyathelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu, indlela abaphatha ngayo ubumpofu nokushoda, indlela abakha ngayo umnotho wabo, nokuthi bangakha kanjani ukuqhubeka, indlela abaphila ngayo nabanye imiphakathi kanye nemvelo yabo, indlela abakhuluma ngayo izindaba zabo, indlela abacule ngayo futhi badanse, njll. Uhlobo lwefa eliphilayo esinalo namuhla luyingxenye yeifa elivela ebantwini abahlanganyela kusukela ezikhathini ezingakhumbuleki. Ifa eliphilayo livela ezinkolelweni zomlomo, umlando owethulwayo ngomlomo, imikhuba yomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi ezivumelanayo ezikhule futhi zathathelwa indawo noma zengezwa ngezilinganiso ezintsha ngenxa yokuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene yomhlaba eyayihlukene ekuqaleni ngendawo nasemhlabeni. Lokhu kuxhumana kuqhutshekiswa kakhulu ngokuhlanganiswa kwezamasiko zomhlaba okuvele ngenxa yokuphuma kobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ukwanda kokuhamba nokuvakasha, kanye nokunciphisa ibanga phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. INingizimu Afrika imele isithombe esiphelele somphakathi esiyisithombe sezinhlanga ezakhiwe phezu kwefa elicebile nelihlukahlukene lesiko - ngakho-ke umqondo we-Rainbow Nation. Ngakho-ke, kufanelekile ukuthi uhulumeni wakhe indawo yokwethulwa nokuboniswa kwefa eliphilayo elihlukene lamaqembu abahlali. Lokhu kumele kwenzeke ngendlela esekela izimiso zomphakathi ongakhethi, ezisekelwe ebuhleni, ubulili, kanye nokukhubazeka, futhi ngendlela efaka bonke. Kumele futhi kwenzeke ngaphakathi komqondo wokuzama ukuthuthukisa ukwabelana kolwazi lwefa eliphilayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ngoba kungokwakho ukwabelana nokuhlonipha okufanayo nokuhlukile kwefa lesiko elingathinteki lapho sizothola khona ukuvumelana kwesizwe, ukwakha isizwe, kanye nokuhlangana komphakathi. Kuzofundisa zonke izindawo ukwabelana ngolwazi ngendlela eguquguqukayo, njengoba kuboniswe ngefa labo eliphilayo. Lokhu kungathatha ifomu lokuhlonipha kokubili umehluko nokufana. Kuzodingeka ukufunda ukuthi lezi zamasiko ezihlangene zidalela kanjani amasiko aphuma kumaqembu ahlukene anobuntu obuhlukile baseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyakhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi izinqubomgomo nemithetho esunguliwe kusukela ngo-1994 zikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa nokugcina ifa lesiko labantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezamasiko zamaqembu onke emphakathini wethu. UMthethosisekelo ophathelene nezobuciko, amasiko, kanye nefa kanye nezinhlinzeko zawo uthi i-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye ne-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999) ziqukethe ubufakazi bombono owakhiwe ukuze kufezwe le njongo. Iminyango kahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezisekelwa umphakathi, kanye nabantu bakhe izinhlelo zokwenza kube lula ukugcina nokukhuthaza ifa eliphilayo. Nakuba lezi zikhumbuleka futhi zigubha, inqubo efaka bonke eholelwa nguhulumeni kanye nezindlela eziholwa umphakathi iyadingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe uhlelo olubanzi oluhlanganisa imicabango yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo kumele luthinte ukuhlanganiswa kwezici zeifa eliphilayo futhi luqedele ekuthuthukisweni kwemigomo nemithetho edingekayo yokuvikela (njengesibonakaliso sokuhweba/ukufaneleka).
