Ukusetshenziswa kwe-e-learning ezikoleni Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yesikole namuhla, akusikho okwakukhona eminyakeni edlule. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zishintshile kanjani? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu sikhumbula izinsuku lapho sithola khona izincwadi ezinkulu, sibhala ngezandla zethu, futhi sithola izifundo ezinzima. Kodwa manje, sikhuluma nge-e-learning, okungukuthi ukufunda online. Lokhu kuza nezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo, kodwa futhi nezinkinga ezithile. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngalezi zinhlelo zokufunda eziku-inthanethi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi zenza kube lula ukufunda? Ngempela, uma umntwana efuna ukufunda ngendaba ethile, angavula i-laptop yakhe noma i-tablet, abheke ku-Google, bese ethola ulwazi oluningi. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, ngoba akusikho kuphela ukufunda okwenziwa esikoleni, kodwa futhi kukhona amathuba amaningi okuthola ulwazi. Ngabe uyavuma? Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Ngabe ubona ukuthi abanye abafundi bangase babe nezinselelo? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi akukhona wonke umuntu onokufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Abanye bethu sikhumbula izinsuku lapho sithola khona izincwadi ezinkulu, sibhala ngezandla zethu, futhi sithola izifundo ezinzima. Kodwa manje, sikhuluma nge-e-learning, okungukuthi ukufunda online. Lokhu kuza nezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo, kodwa futhi nezinkinga ezithile. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umntwana engakabi ne-laptop noma i-tablet, noma uma engakwazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi, uzoba nenkinga enkulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abafundi bahlale behluleka, kanti abanye baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikole zicabangele izixazululo, mhlawumbe ngokuhlinzeka ngama-computer ezikoleni noma ngama-lab e-inthanethi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngempilo yesikole, akusikho kuphela ukufunda. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezibalulekile ezifana nokuxhumana nabanye. Uma abafundi befunda online, kungenzeka ukuthi bahlale bodwa, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphatheke kabi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba nezingxoxo phakathi kwabafundi? Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, ngoba akusikho kuphela ukufunda okwenziwa esikoleni, kodwa futhi kukhona amathuba amaningi okuthola ulwazi. Ngabe uyavuma? Ngakho, izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bayakwazi ukuxhumana, kungaba ngezingxoxo eziku-inthanethi noma ngama-forums. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bakhulise ubudlelwano, futhi bazi ukuthi abakhulumi bodwa. Ngabe ubona ukuthi e-learning ingasiza kanjani othisha? Othisha bangasebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ukuze bathuthukise izifundo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, futhi kube lula ukuhlela izifundo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungaba usizo? Othisha bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, futhi bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo engcono kubafundi babo. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Othisha badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza kahle. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi nemali, futhi izikole kufanele zicabangele lokhu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyinselelo? Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma nge-e-learning, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona wonke umuntu onokufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikole zicabangele izixazululo, mhlawumbe ngokuhlinzeka ngama-computer ezikoleni noma ngama-lab e-inthanethi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi e-learning ingasiza kanjani othisha? Othisha bangasebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ukuze bathuthukise izifundo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, futhi kube lula ukuhlela izifundo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungaba usizo? Othisha bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, futhi bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo engcono kubafundi babo. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Othisha badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza kahle. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi nemali, futhi izikole kufanele zicabangele lokhu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyinselelo? Ngokuphetha, e-learning iyinsiza enkulu ezikoleni, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule izinselelo ezihambisana nayo. Kumele sithole izixazululo ukuze bonke abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lokufunda. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka? Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sisebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwenza ukufunda kube lula futhi kube mnandi kubo bonke. Ngabe unayo eminye imibono? Ngiyafisa ukukuzwa!
Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng Ngokubona kwami, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zibonisa ukuthi kunenkinga enkulu ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Njengomphakathi, sikhumbula kahle izikhathi ezinzima lapho kudingeka usizo oluphuthumayo, kodwa izikhathi zokuphendula zihlala zikhathaza kakhulu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi ama-ambulensi awafiki ngesikhathi, kodwa kukhona nezinkinga ezithinta izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okwenza abantu bahlupheke. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi eGauteng, isifunda esinabantu abaningi, izidingo zempilo zikhula njalo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi ama-ambulensi abe nekhono lokuphendula ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Kodwa, ngabe lokhu kuyenzeka? Ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwami, izikhathi zokuphendula zivame ukuba zinde kakhulu, futhi lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki emphakathini. Izizathu eziningi zikhona zokuthi ama-ambulensi awafiki ngesikhathi. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemithombo, njengemoto ezanele, abasebenzi abanele, kanye nezinsiza ezingasebenzi kahle, kubangela ukuthi ama-ambulensi ahlupheke. Lokhu kudala izimo lapho abantu badinga usizo, kodwa behluleka ukukuthola ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izithiyo zomgwaqo, ezifana nezimo zokukhwabanisa, izimo zezulu, kanye nezithiyo zomphakathi, zengeza ekubambezelweni kokuphendula. Ngokubona kwami, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuphakamisa lezi zinkinga. Abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi uma bephuthumayo, bangathola usizo olufanele. Ukuphuma kwama-ambulensi akufanele kube yinto yokukhathazeka. Abantu badinga ukuzizwa bephephile, futhi lokhu kuncike ekutheni izinsizakalo zempilo zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izixazululo eziphusile, okuhlanganisa ukwandisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuqasha abasebenzi abaningi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele kungaba yindlela yokuthola izinsiza ezengeziwe, ukuze ama-ambulensi akwazi ukufika ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela impilo yabantu, futhi kuphucule izinga lempilo emphakathini. Mayelana nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi banganikeza iziphakamiso ezithile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufundisa umphakathi mayelana nezindlela zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, kanye nokubakhuthaza ukuba baphendule ngezikhathi ezinzima. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu nomphakathi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izikhathi zokuphendula, futhi kulethe ushintsho oluhle. Ngokuphetha, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zidinga ukushintsha. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza, futhi uhulumeni kufanele abheke izixazululo eziphusile. Akufanele kube nezinselelo ezithinta impilo yabantu, futhi kufanele kube nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezitholakalayo, ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile. Ngalesi sikhathi, asikwazi ukubeka impilo yabantu engcupheni; kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza ngempela ukuthi ama-ambulensi akwazi ukuphendula ngesikhathi, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu eGauteng.
Inhloso yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiMininingwane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenzisa ilungelo labo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela imininingwane ephethwe uhulumeni, kanye nemininingwane ephethwe abanye abantu, edingekayo ukuze umuntu akwazi ukusebenzisa noma ukuvikela noma yiziphi izimfanelo. Umgomo ophambili wokwenza kube nokufinyelela imininingwane ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okucacisa nokubhekelela ohulumeni nasezinkampanini ezizimele, futhi ukuthuthukisa umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinyelela imininingwane ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa noma ukuvikela zonke izimfanelo zabo. Ingabe kukhona imininingwane equkethwe eMnyangweni Wezobulungiswa noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi engatholakala? Ungafinyelela wonke amadokhumenti kanye/noma amarekhodi avela eMnyangweni, kubasebenzi bawo, noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano kahulumeni. Akubalulekile ukuthi le mininingwane yafika nini. Amarekhodi omuntu siqu avela eMnyangweni noma enhlanganweni kahulumeni. Imininingwane mayelana nez parties ezithile noma amarekhodi kuphela ngevumelekile ye-party ethile, ikakhulukazi uma amadokhumenti aqukethe imininingwane eyimfihlo noma eyasendaweni. Imininingwane engavunyelwe ayitholakali ngokulandela iMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiMininingwane. Ukufinyelela imininingwane kuncike ezitheni ezithile, ngokwesibonelo, uma amarekhodi eceliwe asetshenziswa ezinqubweni zomthethosisekelo noma ezingezona ezomthethosisekelo noma uma izinqubo zomthethosisekelo noma ezingezona ezomthethosisekelo seziqale, lapho imininingwane ingase ingasetshenziswanga enkantolo, ikakhulukazi uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi kungalimaza ukuphathwa kwezobulungiswa. Amarekhodi ezikhwama noma amakomidi azo. Amarekhodi ahlobene nokusebenza kwezinkantolo nabaJaji. Imininingwane etholakala ezinkantolo ezikhethekile ezinquma izingxabano ezithile nezicelo, ezisungulwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Futhi imininingwane ephethwe ngumuntu oyilungu lephalamende noma lezakhamuzi zendawo. Qedela futhi uthumele Ifomu A: Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi kahulumeni. Ungakuthola ehhovisi leMnyango Wezobulungiswa. Uma imininingwane oyifunayo ingatholakali mahhala, kuzodingeka ukuthi uyikhokhele. Ungadinga ukukhokha imali yokucwaninga ukuze ufinyelele imininingwane. Umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane, ongumuntu ophakanyisiwe wokufinyelela imininingwane, kumele aphendule phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo sakho. Uma umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane enqaba isicelo sakho sokufinyelela imininingwane eceliwe, ungabhalela uNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo. Umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane noma umphathiswa ophakanyisiwe wokufinyelela imininingwane uzokweseka ngalolu hlelo. Uma imininingwane eceliwe ingekho emnyangweni kahulumeni kodwa ikwi-inhlangano kahulumeni, umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane uzodlulisela isicelo sakho kumphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane waleyo nhlangano kahulumeni phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14. Inhlangano kahulumeni efanele kumele iphendule isicelo sakho ngesikhathi. Uzokwaziswa uma lokhu kwenzeka. Imali ekhokhwayo kumarekhodi enhlangano kahulumeni ibhalwe njengokukhulunywa ezimfuneko zamanje zeMthetho.
Ukubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezibhedlela: Ukuhlola Ngaphandle Kweqhinga Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke yezokwelapha. Umsebenzi wokuqala ofaneleka kakhulu uma isiguli sifika esibhedlela, ukubhaliswa kwaso kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izidingo zayo ziqashelwa, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubhaliswa kuletha uthobekile, kulungele isiguli ukuxhumana nodokotela nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo. Iziguli zifanele zigcwaliswe izincwadi ezithile lapho zifika. Lokhu kubhaliswa akugcini nje ngokufaka igama, ubudala, noma isikhumbuzo somndeni; kudinga futhi imininingwane yokuhlola isimo sempilo yesiguli kanye nemigomo ethile yokwelashwa. Kuyisinyathelo esiqondisa iziguli zomzimba noshayela ezoshintsha ukuphila kwazo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izimo zikhona ngaphambi kokuqhubeka nokwelashwa. Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zokubhaliswa kweziguli eqhubekayo yimikhiqizo yezeMpilo. Njengoba iziguli zifaka izincwadi zazo, kufanele zihlola kakhudlwana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi bagcine imiyalelo ethile kanye nezitifiketi ezakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kungaholela ekujoleni izinsiza ezithile ezidingekayo neluleme iziguli ukuthi zithole ukunakekelwa okusezingeni eliphezulu. Ukuhlola imininingwane yokubhaliswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwabantu kubalulekile kumasevisi ezokwelapha. Kumathuba amaningi, iziguli zidinga ukwazi izinqubo ezibandakanya ukubhaliswa okufanele. Lokhu kuqondisa iziguli ngempela, zibuza imibuzo eqondile futhi zifinyelele emathubeni akhuthazayo. Ngesikhatsi sokubhaliswa, iziguli zingakhohlisa imicabango yazo, zibe neqhaza elibhekene nezinyathelo ezithinta impilo, futhi zizithokozise ngempela ukwamukela imiphumela ethile. Ukwazisa iziguli ngezinqubo ezithinta ukubhaliswa kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma abahlinzeki benza imihlangano neziguli. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane engcono yokubhaliswa nezidingo ezincane ezitholakalayo kudala isikhala sokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, okwandisa umuzwa wokudingeka kokuba iziguli zibhaliswe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi bezempilo banikeze ithuba lokukhuluma, banikeze imihlahlandlela, nokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphusile. Ngokuphindaphindiwe, ukubhaliswa kweziguli kuhambisana nezimiso ezithile ezisemqoka, ezinjengezinhloso ezinhle zokubhaliswa nokuxhumana. Umsebenzi walu okhethekile waziwa kakhulu phakathi kwenhlangano ethuthukayo, uhambisana nezinhloso ezicacile ezizosiza iziguli ezikhethekile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zazo. Lokhu kubhaliswa kusebenza njengesikhumbuzo esiqavile sempilo esiguquguqukayo. Uma kwenzeka iziguli zingezelela imikhuba yokubhaliswa, lokhu kubalulekile. Akubalulekile nje ukuba khona kwezinkolelo zenhlangano eyahlukene, kodwa nemithombo yesikhumbuzo iyahlala ibalulekile. Ukuthola imiphumela engase ibaluleke ekugcineni kubaluleke kakhulu, kusiza abahlinzeki bezempilo ukuthi bahlale beqaphile ngezindleko nezindlela eziqhamukayo zokuphatha iziguli. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela akukhawulelwa nje ezinsizeni zokwelapha. Kubalulekile ukuphakamisa ulwazi, ukuxhumana, nokuhlola iziphakamiso ezintsha ezivela phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka endaweni yokwelapha, sinemfanelo yokuhlonipha izimo zempilo ezithile nezidingo ezikhethekile zabantu. Lokhu kubhaliswa akuba umnyango kuphela; kuba yindlela yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi ngokwakha umhlaba ongcono. Sinokubambisana okuhle kuyo yonke imihlangano, sipela silandele lezi ezinjengokubhaliswa, siqhosha isimo sokuphila kwezokwelapha esizayo.
Umbiko: Imali Yokufunda Emanyuvesi Isingeniso Imali yokufunda emanyuvesi ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imfundo nesikhala sokusebenza kubafundi abasha. Ekuphileni kwethu kwansuku zonke, imfundo iyisisekelo esiyinhloko sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi imanyuvesi zidlala indima enkulu kulokhu. Nokho, izindleko eziphezulu zemali yokufunda zenza kube nzima kubafundi abaningi ukufinyelela kwi-akhademi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta imali yokufunda emanyuvesi, izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nemithelela emiphakathini. Izindleko Zemali Yokufunda Izindleko zemali yokufunda emanyuvesi zihluka kakhulu kuye ngezikhungo zemfundo, izifundo, kanye nezwe. Emhlabeni jikelele, izifundo ezithile, njengezokwelapha nezinjiniyela, ziningi kakhulu uma ziqhathaniswa nezinye ezifana nezifundo zezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi bakhethwe ngokuqhathanisa izindleko ezihambisana nezifundo abazikhethayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuphila, ezifana nokuqasha, ukudla, nezokuthutha, ziyanda kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuzitholela imali yokufunda. Izindlela Zokuxhasa Abafundi Ukuze baphumelele, abafundi banikezwa izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhasa, okuhlanganisa imalimboleko, izibonelelo, nezikhwama zokufunda. Imalimboleko ivame ukufunwa ukuze kufezwe izindleko zokufunda, kodwa izinzuzo zayo zifaka ingcindezi yokukhokha emuva ngemva kokuphothula. Izibonelelo, ngakolunye uhlangothi, zinikeza usizo kulabo abavela emindenini eziphila ngaphansi kwezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Lokhu kusiza ukunciphisa umthwalo wemali kumafunda. Ubuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokufundisa Ubuchwepheshe buye baphendula izindlela zokufunda, futhi emnyuvesi, izifundo eziku-inthanethi ziye zanda. Lokhu kuvumela abafundi ukuba benze izifundo zabo besebenzisa izinsiza ezikhona ku-inthanethi. Nokho, abanye abafundi bangase bahlupheke ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuxhuma nokungabi nekhono lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kubangela ukuba kube nokuhlukahluka ekufinyeleleni emfundweni, okungaba nomthelela ekubhekaneni nabafundi abavela emiphakathini ethile. Imithelela Emiphakathini Imali yokufunda emanyuvesi ingaba nemithelela eminingi emiphakathini. Ukungatholakali kwemali yokufunda kungaholela ekwehleni kwesibalo sabafundi abaphothula izifundo zabo, okuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kungadala umjikelezo wokuhlupheka, njengoba abafundi abangenayo imfundo ephezulu behluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele nehlonishwayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma abafundi bethola uxhaso lwezimali, lokhu kungakhuthaza ukukhula komnotho emiphakathini. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kwemfundo, kubalulekile ukuthi iminyango kahulumeni nezinhlangano ezizimele zisebenze ndawonye. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lwezibonelelo ezihlukahlukene, ukunciphisa izindleko zemali yokufunda, kanye nokwandisa amathuba okuthola imalimboleko ezinhle kungase kube yizixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi yokufundisa nokwakha amakhono angama-workshops kuzokwandisa ukuqonda nokwazisa abafundi ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokufunda. Isiphetho Imali yokufunda emanyuvesi iyinselelo enkulu kubafundi abaningi, kodwa kunendlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, iminyango ezizimele, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abafundi bafeze amaphupho abo, futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukusebenza ngobuchwepheshe, ukukhulisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni imfundo, okuzokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi nasemiphakathini, futhi kuqhakambisa izakhamuzi ezinamakhono. Iminyaka ezayo ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo, futhi ukufinyelela kwempumelelo emanyuvesi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile kulokhu.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana Ku-GEMS: Okubalulekile Ekuqinisekiseni Impilo Yamakhaya Ngokulandelana kwezinsuku, ukukhula kwemishini yokuxhumana nezokwelapha kuveza izinselelo ezintsha ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokwelapha emakhaya. Kulokhu, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibonakala iyinsika eqinile ekuhlinzekeni izinsizakalo zokwelapha ezinembile. Lokhu kungubufakazi bokuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana emkhakheni wezempilo kudinga ukuqondwa kahle ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomphakathi. I-GEMS ikhuluma ngokubaluleka kokugunyazwa kodokotela, okubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abahlali bangathola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethola ukwesekwa kwezokwelapha. Uhlelo lokugunyaza kudokotela lubalulekile ngoba lwenza kube nesimo esiphumelelayo sokwenza izinqumo eziphusile ezithinta impilo yabantu. Ngaphandle kokugunyazwa, abelaphi bangase benze izinqumo ezingase zibe nemiphumela emibi ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela, abahlinzeki bezempilo, kanye nabantu abathola usizo lwezempilo kudinga ukuba kuhlelwe nangokucophelela. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yini engatholakala kubo, nezinyathelo ezizothathwa ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukuxhumana akusikho kuphela ukukhulumisana, kodwa kudinga ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano obunempumelelo phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo. Kukhona imfundo ebalulekile edingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, imihlangano yokwazisa, izinsiza zokuxhumana ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa kudinga ukuba kube yizindlela ezibanzi zokwethula ulwazi kubantu. Ukuzwakala kolwazi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi izinqumo zokwelapha ezithathwa yizinkampani eziyinkimbinkimbi, nokuthi bazi indlela yokuxhumana nabodokotela uma beface nezinkinga ezithile. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalabo abakhiqiza izinsizakalo nezala izinsizakalo kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle se-GEMS. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kudinga ukubhekwa njengokuhlanganyela okwenziwe ngozakwethu ukuze sihlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lokuxhumana olwakhiwe ngendlela efanele luba yinsika eqinile yokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwabadokotela nabahlali. Ngokwezibalo, abahlali abanolwazi olunganele mayelana nezinhlelo zokwelapha kungase kudaleke izinkinga ezinzima ezimweni ezingathandeki. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi i-GEMS ibambelele ekwaziseni nasekuqwashiseni umphakathi. Izinhlobo ezithile zokuxhumana zingathuthukiswa ukuze zibe lula ezandleni zabantu. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kokwelashwa kwezifo nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze i-GEMS iqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa, ukudinga izinguquko kusemqoka. Ukukhuthaza abadokotela ukuba bahlale beyazi izimo zomphakathi kudinga ukuba kube neziqondiso ezicacile ezikhombisa izindlela zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela nababaleki, okuzoqinisekisa ukuthi amazinga okusebenza aphezulu akhonjiswa. Ekuqedeni, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana akungoshi nje umsebenzi, kodwa kufanele kube yinjongo yansuku zonke. U-GEMS, njengolawulo lwezempilo, kumele iqhubeke nokufundisa, ukuxhumana, nokugunyaza ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Izizathu ezilotshiwe ziwubufakazi bokuthi ukwakhiwa komphakathi ophilayo kudinga ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo, ukugunyazwa okunembile, nokuzibophezela kubo bonke abathintekayo. Ngaphezu kokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo, lokhu kuzodala umphakathi ophilayo, okhulile, nolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka ngomphakathi, nabantu baphile impilo enempilo nenokuthula. I-GEMS kufanele iqhubeke ibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umhlaba onempilo, oqinile, nolwazi olwakhiwe ngobudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezakhamuzi nabodokotela.
Lo mbhalo kufanele ufundwe njengengxenye yesitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke zamabanga R-9 (ezikoleni). UMbutho Wezemfundo uzithokozisa ngokwethula lesi sitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke zamabanga R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zeNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha lo msebenzi bekungelula neze. Izikhathi eziningi, abantu ababephatha lo msebenzi wokuhumusha bekudingeka ukuthi bakhe amagama amasha kwezinye izindawo. Le mibhalo ithunyelwe futhi kubachwepheshe kulezi zilimi ukuze bahlolisise. UMbutho Wezemfundo ubheka le mibhalo njengethuba lokuqala lokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufunda ukuthi asebenzise le mibhalo njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuhlola umfundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela wezinga lokuhlola imfundo elisekelwe emiphumeleni, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze nezibonelo zezindlela zokugcina amarekhodi. Okuqukethwe kwencwadi le kubhalwe ngezahluko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sikhuluma ngezinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo nokuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, izinga eliphakeme. Isahluko ngasinye kulezi zinga sihlanganisa ingxenye yokwethula emfushane, izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga. Izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga zethulwa ngendlela ezokwenza kube lula ukubona intuthuko yokufunda. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola ezifanayo zazo zonke izinga ziqhubeka ngendlela yokuthi uthisha angakwazi ukuqhathanisa intuthuko yokufunda eminyakeni. Lokhu kudala izikhala kwezinye izindawo, njengoba hhayi zonke izindlela zokuhlola zifana kuzo zonke izigaba. Ngokuqondile kubhekiswe ku-11 Ukuqala - Izigaba R-1 11 Amakhono okuyifunda nokubhala ayisisekelo 11 Intuthuko yabafundi - Izigaba 2 12 Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono 12 Ukuqinisa Intuthuko - Izigaba 3 13 Ukuthuthukisa Ulwazi LwesiZulu - Uhlelo, amagama, kanye nokwakhiwa kwamagama. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) unikeza isisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokufunda eNingizimu Afrika. Futhi wakha iNingizimu Afrika ephethwe ngedemokhrasi nokuhlanganyela futhi ekwazi ukudlala indima yayo efanele njengombuso ozimele phakathi kwezizwe ezihlukahlukene zomhlaba. Imfundo kanye nesifundo kudlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso. Isifundo sihlose ukuthuthukisa amandla okuthi umfundi ngamunye abe ngum citizen ophelele waseNingizimu Afrika ophathwa ngedemokhrasi. Imfundo esekelwe emiphumeleni. Imfundo esekelwe emiphumeleni iyisisekelo sesifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi bangathola ulwazi ngokwezinga labo lokwazi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlela imiphumela okufanele abafundi bayifinyelele kanye nomfundi ekupheleni kwazo zonke izinto ezenziwayo. Futhi amandla okukhombisa ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba wenziwe ngokuqhamuka kwezingxenye ezihlukahlukene ngokukwazi ukubona ukuthi umqondo wokuxazulula izinkinga awukwazi ukuhlukaniswa. Bangazama izindlela ezahlukene zokufunda ngempumelelo. Bangabamba iqhaza njengabantu abaphethe izibopho ekuxazululeni izimpilo zomphakathi abawakhayo ezindaweni zabo, ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bangaba nobuhlakani futhi bathinteke ngamasiko nobuhle obukhona ezimweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Futhi bakhe amathuba ezamabhizinisi. Izinkinga ezihlobene nobuphofu, ukungalingani, ukuhlukumeza ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, ukukhubazeka, nezinkinga ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS kanye ne-AIDS uqobo zonke zithinta izinga nendlela abafundi abafunda ngayo esikoleni. Isitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke zamabanga R-9 (ezikoleni) sikhombisa isu eliphelele eligcizelela izidingo ezincane zabafundi bonke. Zonke izitatimende zezifundo zizamile ukukhombisa ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kwendlela efanele yokuphila, amalungelo abantu, indawo ephephile nephilile ebazungezile, nokufaka wonke umuntu. Abafundi baphinde bakhuthazwe ukuba bazi futhi baqonde kabanzi ngohlukahluka kwezinto ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngamasiko, inkolo, kanye nezwe, okuyizici ezivelele zale nhlobo. Isitatimende ngasinye sezifundo sikhombisa imiphumela yokufunda elindelekile okufanele umfundi ayifinyelele ekupheleni kwesigaba sika-9. Isitatimende ngasinye sezifundo sichaza kahle izindlela zokuhlola ezingafinyelela imiphumela yokufunda elindelekile. Izindlela zokuhlola zichazwa kahle ngezigaba nezinga, kanye nobubanzi nob depth bolwazi okufanele abafundi bakhulelwe nokuthi kufanele bakwazi ukwenza ini. Izindlela zokuhlola zesitatimende salo msebenzi zikhombisa ukuthi ulwazi namakhono angathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zindlela zokuhlola zingahlanganiswa ezigabeni ezifanayo noma zixhunywe ezigabeni ezingafani. Amandla okwakha ubudlelwano ngokusebenzisa amandla okuhlanganisa izigaba kanye namandla okuthuthukisa ulwazi kusuka kwelinye izinga kuya kwelinye kuyisisekelo salo msebenzi omusha wesifundo. Isitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke sihlose ukukhulisa ukuzinikela nolwazi phakathi kwabafundisi, abazoba yibo abazobamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zabo zezifundo. Ukuze kusekelwe leli hlelo, uMbutho Wezemfundo uzokwethula umthetho oholayo osetshenziswe esitatimendeni ngasinye sezifundo. Izifunda nazo zizoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela yazo ukuze zixazulule ukuhlukahluka okukhona ukuze zicabangele ukuhlukahluka kwezifunda. Iziqondiso nezinto ezisemqoka ezitholakala esitatimendeni esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke nasemazingeni ezifundo ziyisisekelo sezinhlelo zokufunda. Njengoba izindawo zezifundo zigcizelela ukufinyelela kolwazi, amakhono, nezinto ezisemqoka emfundweni ngezigaba nezinga, izinhlelo zezifundo zigcizelela ukuklama lokho kuzofundwa nokuthi umsebenzi uzohlolwa kanjani ezingeni ngalinye lemfundo. Izinhlelo zezifundo ziqukethe uhlu lwemisebenzi okufanele iqedwe lapho isivinini sokuphothulwa kwazo kufanele sibe khona kanye nesigaba sokulandela unyaka nonyaka, kanye nezibonelo zehlelo lesifundo okufanele lisetshenziswe phakathi nesikhathi esinikeziwe. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, kunezinhlelo zezifundo ezintathu: Amakhono okuyifunda nokubhala ayisisekelo, ubuchwepheshe obuyisisekelo (ukusebenza ngezibalo), nolwazi lwezempilo. Ezingeni eliphakathi, Ulwazi LwesiZulu kanye nezibalo zihlala zihlukaniswe njengezinhlelo ezizimele zezifundo. Ezinye izinhlelo zezifundo kufanele zithuthukiswe ezikoleni ngemva kokuthi zithole imvume evela kuMbutho Wezemfundo wesifunda. Izifunda kufanele zenze izinqumo ngokuqhathaniswa kwezifundo ezingaqhathaniswa ezingeni eliphakathi. Ezingeni eliphakeme, kunezinhlelo eziyi-8 zezifundo ez
Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Ngenxa yokukhuluphala nokwanda kwezinkampani ezihamba phambili, kuvele kudingeke ukuba sithathe izinyathelo eziqinile zokubhekana nemithetho yokusebenzisa izinsiza kanye nemigomo yokuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Uhlelo lwe-GEMS (Government eMarketplace System) luhloselwe ukwakha indawo yokuhweba ethula izinkampani ezincane, kodwa kufanele kube nezikhawulo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza kuhambisana nemigomo yezezimali neyekhwalithi. Umsebenzisi ohambisana ne-GEMS kumele abheke ngokucophelela imikhawulo ethile yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi. Lokhu kuvumeleka ukuthi kuphela izinhlelo ezithile zokuhweba nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezinhlelweni ezifanele, okuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlanganyela kulezi zinhlelo bahlangabezana nezidingo ezisetshenziswa umphakathi. Kumqoka ukuthi, uma umsebenzisi ehlangabezana nokwephula imikhawulo, uzobhekana nezijeziso ezinzima, okungaholela ekudlaleni phansi kwesibopho sakhe sokuhweba. Ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo kwezebhizinisi ngaphansi kwe-GEMS akuvumelekile ngaphandle kokuhambisana nemigomo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthi kube nohlelo oluqinile lokuphepha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo ethile, efana nezinsiza zamabhizinisi amancane, ayisetshenziswa ngendlela engafaneleke. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izicelo zazo ziyahambisana nemigomo yezezimali, futhi zihlola amandla nezinsiza ze-GEMS ukuze zishintshe uma kudingeka. Ukwamukelwa kwe-GEMS kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zihlale ziqhuba izinhlelo zakho, zibhala phansi imisebenzi yabo, futhi zihlale zibheka imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi aziphuli iziqondiso. Lokhu kujolisa ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani nabanye osomabhizinisi, lapho umphakathi ungazuza olwazini oluwusizo kanye nokuqhuba kwezimali. Ukwaziwa kweziqu ze-GEMS kusho ukuthi izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zifinyeleleka kumuntu wonke, futhi azikho izimo lapho abantu abanye bengathola ukukhetha okukhethekile. Lokhu kuvuma ukuthi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezahlukahlukene zomsebenzisi kungaholela ekuphumeleleni kokusebenza kweziqondiso ze-GEMS, okudinga ukubhekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma umsebenzisi ethola ukuthi imishanguzo yokuhlola ibhalwe ngalolu hlobo olungavunyelwanga, khona-ke uhulumeni uzodinga ukufaka izinyathelo ezinzima zokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani ezinjalo azinamanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuba umsebenzisi aqonde kahle iziyalezo ezichaziwe ukuze angabhubhisi izinto, futhi ahloniphe ngokwanele imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwemithombo. Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwe-GEMS ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni indawo yokuhweba eqinile nehlala njalo. Umsebenzisi kufanele azise ngokuphumelelayo izinsiza kunye nezinsuku zokuhlola ukuze abavumelekile bahlanganyele ngempumelelo. Ukuqonda lokhu kulandelayo, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani ne-GEMS kuzoba yisinyathelo esiyinqaba empumelelweni yezebhizinisi, bese kubusiza umphakathi. Ngokuhlola imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa, singaqinisekisa ukuthi isisekelo sokuphila kwezebhizinisi sithokozisa zonke izinhlaka ezihilelekile. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzisi kufanele avule amehlo akhe kuzo zonke izifundo namathuba, agcine umkhuba ovulekile nokuqonda, bese eqinisekisa ukuthi uhwebo lwakhe luhambela phambili ngaphandle kwezingqinamba ezididayo. Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali kanye nemikhawulo yesikhashana uzothola izinzuzo ezinhle, ukuvumela umphakathi ukuba ugcine i-GEMS njengomthombo ochazwe kahle wempumelelo. Izikhumbuzo zokuhweba azikaze zikhumbulelwe ngaphandle kokuhlola imikhawulo ye-GEMS. Ngokuhlonipha nesinyathelo esiqinile sokusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqinile lempumelelo kwezamabhizinisi nasemphakathini, futhi sisebenze ukuze siqonde indlela yokugcina isithombe esihle sakwa-GEMS. Njengoba sibona ubuchwepheshe obuvela, kuzodingeka imikhawulo ethile ukuze iqinise imfundiso ezisizayo ngenkathi sithuthukisa ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ingabhekwa njengesihluthulelo sokubumbana phakathi kwezinkampani kanye nohulumeni, okuzokwakha izinto ezinhle emhlabeni wezebhizinisi.
Abaphathi baphathiswa (ngokweSigaba 66 sika-2008 mayelana nokubalwa kwezinhloko zonyaka ka-2009) ukuba banikeze ulwazi oluqondile noluhambisanayo njengoba luthinta ukuvalwa kanye nokuhlonza izidingo ezibalulekile zesikole. Ukungahlinzeki ngalo ulwazi oluqondile noluhambisanayo kuzoholela ekuhlukanisweni nasekuphathweni kabi kwemisebenzi yoMnyango futhi kuzobhekwa njengokungazange ulandele umyalo osesitifiketi. Mina, umphathi, ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe lapha, ngokwazi kwami nokukholwa, luyiqiniso futhi luyaphumelela. Mina, i-IDSO, ngiqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi kulolu fomu, ngokwazi kwami nokukholwa, luyaphumelela futhi luphelele. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa kuqinisekiswe nguMphathi Wesifunda: Mina, uMphathi Wesifunda, ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe kulolu fomu, ngokwazi kwami nokukholwa, luyaphumelela futhi luphelele. Le ngxenye kumele igcwaliswe ngokuphelele futhi iqinisekiswe ngumphathi noma umphathi ophakeme noma omunye umuntu ophakanyisiwe esikoleni. Umphathi kumele assinwe futhi uphumelele endaweni enikeziwe ngasezansi kwekhasi lokuqinisekisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi oluqoqiwe kwenziwe futhi wonke amaphutha alungisiwe kuluhlu ngalunye. Lolu hlu lokuqinisekisa kumele luthunyelwe emahhovisi esifunda/region futhi ikhophi igcinwe esikoleni ngezinjongo zokuhlola. Uma ifomu litholakala esikoleni emahhovisi esifunda noma esifundazweni, uMphathi Wezemfundo Oqokwe (UMphathi Wesifunda) kumele aqinisekise ulwazi oluqoqiwe ngento ngayinye kulolu hlu. Isithombe 1: Impumelelo yokucindezela umhlaba emapulazini. Isithombe 2: Imizi engakwesokunxele ibonisa indlela engaphazamiseki yokukhula, kuyilapho leyo engakwesokudla ibonisa ukukhula okuncane ngenxa yokucindezela umhlaba. Isithombe 1: Isithombe sikhombisa ukuthi indlela eyodwa yokuna ingadala umonakalo omkhulu emhlabeni. Isithombe 2: Lapho umhlaba uqala ukoma, kuvela isikhumba esivimba umoya ukuthi ungene noma uphume emhlabeni, futhi ivimba amanzi ukuthi angena noma aphume. Isithombe 3: Qinisekisa ukuthi amapulazi akho awanamanzi amaningi kakhulu futhi ususe izinkomo ukuze uzifake kwenye indawo. Lapho amapulazi eqala ukoma, ungabuyisela izinkomo. Ukucindezela umhlaba kwenzeka lapho amaqoqo omhlaba acindezelwa futhi izikhala ngaphakathi zivaliwe. Umhlaba ocindezelwe kakhulu unama pore amancane, avimbela ukungena kwamanzi, futhi uma kukhona amanzi amaningi, awakwazi ukuphuma kulolu cindezelo. Ukushintshana komoya okuqukethe i-oxygen, i-nitrogen, i-carbon dioxide, nezinye izinto ezibalulekile zokukhula kwemizi akwenzi kahle, futhi izitshalo azikhuli kahle. Yini edala ukucindezela komhlaba? Ukunyakaza kwezitrobhu nezinye izinto ezisebenza emhlabeni omanzi kungadala ukucindezela komhlaba. Ukuhlwanyela umhlaba kanye nokucindezela kwawo kuhambisana nazo zonke izenzo emapulazini: ukuhweba, ukujova, ukuvuna, njll. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bazame ukwakha izitrobhu ezinamandla kakhulu nezinsiza ezikwazi ukuphula leli cindezelo elakhiwe uma amaqoqo omhlaba ehlangana, evimba umoya namanzi ukuthi angena noma aphume. Ngeminyaka yama-1940, isisindo sezitrobhu sasivame ukuba amathani amathathu - namuhla, izimoto ezineziqhamo zidlula amathani angama-20. Ukucindezela okuvela ekunyakazeni kwezinsiza kunganciphisa ukuphakama komhlaba kube ngu-0.60 m. Ukuhlwanyela nokuhlanza kuvame ukuhlinzekwa uma umhlaba unamanzi, okungadala ingozi ngokushesha kumongo womhlaba. Umhlaba awukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngamakhemikhali anele ezitshalo. Ukuhlwanyela okuqhubekayo ngombhoxo ophula umhlaba kube ukuphakama okufanayo kungaholela ekucindezelweni okweqile phansi, okwenza kube nzima kumizi ukuba kungene. Emhlabeni lapho kukhona amanzi amaningi, umhlaba uthi uziphathe njengopulasitiki. Izinsiza ezinzima ezihamba lapho zingacindezela umhlaba ngaphezulu kwezinhlamvu ezihlanziwe. Lapho izizinda zezimoto zivele, kukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba umanzi kakhulu. Umhlaba omanzi uzokwakha futhi ugcine isakhiwo esihle. Isimo/sakhiwo somhlaba sizokutshela ukuthi umhlaba othile ungagcina futhi uthumele amanzi, amakhemikhali ezitshalo, nomoya odingekayo ukuze imizi ikhule kahle. Imizi ekhula kahle idinga ama pore amakhulu kune-0.1 mm ukuze iziphetho zomizi zingene futhi zibambe amaqoqo omhlaba ukuze iqhubeke ikhula. Uma umhlaba ucindezelwe kakhulu, imizi idinga amandla amaningi ukuze ingene. Umfarmu angakwenza kanjani ukuvimbela ukucindezela komhlaba? Ukuhlwanyela ngaphakathi kune-25 cm kuzosisiza ukuphula ama-pans anzima akhiwe uma izinsiza zinyakaza, kodwa lokhu akusebenza isikhathi eside uma ufuna umkhiqizo omuhle. Ezindaweni eziningi, ukuhlinzeka okujulile kudingeka kwenzeke unyaka nonyaka. Ukuphinda uhlinzeke leli pulazi elihlinzekiwe kungacindezela umhlaba ngama-80%. Ngakho-ke, ama-diesel amaningi nezinsiza zisetshenziswa. Indlela ophuma ngayo manje ingafana nendlela ejwayelekile: ukuhlinzeka ngemva kokuvuna, ukujova, ukuhlinzeka, njll., bese uhlwanyela, uhlinzeka, futhi ujova izihlahla nezifo. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi izinsiza zakho zisebenza kuleli pulazi mhlawumbe izikhathi eziyi-8 noma eziyi-9 phakathi nezikhathi zokuhlwanyela nokuvuna. Le ndlela yokulima inezindleko eziningi. Izindleko zezinsiza, isikhathi sokuphothula umsebenzi, umsebenzi, ama-diesel, nok maintenance kwezinsiza ziyaqhubeka zanda. Le ndlela yokulima yayihloselwe ikakhulukazi ukubulala izihlahla nokukhulula umhlaba ocindezelwe ngemuva kokuhlwanyela okweqile. Enye imvula ingagcinwa ukuze ikhulule ungqimba lomhlaba phezulu ukuvimbela ukulahleka kwamanzi emoyeni. Ukuhlinzeka okujulile kungaphula ungqimba lomhlaba ocindezelwe, okungadala enye ingozi kumongo womhlaba futhi ngeke kusebenze kahle uma umhlaba umanzi kakhulu. Ukulondolozwa komhlaba ngezinye izindlela ezifana nokunciphisa ukuhlinzeka nokungahlinzeki kungavimbela ukucindezela komhlaba futhi ekugcineni kunciphise izindleko. Izitshalo eziningi zihlala zicindezela kancane umhlaba ngaphezulu kwezinhlamvu ezihlanziwe. Lokhu kuvumela ukuxhumana okusheshayo phakathi komhlaba, amanzi, nezitshalo, okuholela ekukhuleni okusheshayo. Ukucindezela kancane kungavimbela ukulahleka kwamanzi, futhi umhlaba ophuma ezitshalweni awomisi ngokushesha. Lapho izitshalo zilinganiselwe, zivaliwe umhlaba omanzi, okhululekile. Lokhu kuzovimbela futhi ukulahleka kwamanzi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi kokubili ungqimba lomhlaba ophakeme nolwangaphansi lungacindezelwe kakhulu. Umhlaba ocindezelwe kakhulu onokucindezela okungafani kungavimbela ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kwemizi ngendlela efanele. Imizi ivame ukukhetha izindlela ezilula zokukhula, ngakho-ke ngeke izame ukungena ezindaweni ezicindezelwe lapho umhlaba unzima. Lapho ukucindezela kwenzeka, kunciphisa indawo lapho imizi ingakhula khona. Izitshalo zingakwazi ukukhipha amakhemikhali anele namanzi ukuze ziveze umkhiqizo omuhle. Eminyakeni lapho imvula inganele, izitshalo zihlupheka ngoba azitholi amakhemikhali kulomhlaba ocindezelwe. Eminyakeni lapho imvula ikahle, umhlaba ocindezelwe uvimbela umoya ukuthi ungene futhi uphume emhlabeni ngoba kukhona amanzi amaningi - futhi lezo zikhathi azikwazi ukuphuma. Lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwamakhemikhali nase-nitrogen emhlabeni. Isitshalo sidinga amandla ukuze sithole i-potassium emhlabeni. Njengoba kungekho moya, imizi ayinayo amandla anele ukuze ithole i-potassium ngokwanele. I-phosphorus ivamise ukungena ngokujulile emhlabeni; uma siphinda siyifake, imizi engenamoya iyahluleka ukuyithola leli khetho elibalulekile. Umhlaba onothuli unama-aggregates amancane futhi uvame ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha. Lezi zindawo zihlala zinezinsiza ezanele, kodwa uma kukhona ungqimba olucindezelwe, luzovimba imizi ukuthi ifinyelele kulawo manzi aphansi - ikakhulukazi uma imvula inganele. Sibonile ukuthi uma imizi ingena kulolu cindezelo (noma sivula indlela ngokuhlanza), ingakhula kahle ngoba uthuli ngaphansi kolungqimba olucindezelwe luthambile. Ngakho-ke, bathola amanzi anele namakhemikhali ukuze bahlale bephila kahle. Ukucindezela komhlaba kungavela ezindaweni ezimbili: ukucindezela komhlaba ophakeme nokucindezela okuphansi (hardpan). Imvula yehlobo ingadala umonakalo omkhulu emhlabeni ongavikelekile, njengokuguguleka okukhuhla umhlaba namakhemikhali. Iphakamisa iziphakamiso kuNgqongqoshe mayelana nanoma yiziphi izindaba ezingase zishiwo ngaphansi kwalesi sikhungo; futhi ngokujwayelekile, yenza konke okucabanga ukuthi kubalulekile noma okubalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zalesi sikhungo. (a) IMphakathi kufanele ibe namalungu angaphezu kwezingu-25, lapho okungenani u-14 kufanele babhaliswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 (a) no (b), okhethwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokubheka iziqu zabo emfundweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukunakekelwa, impilo yomphakathi, usizo lokuqala, impilo yomsebenzi, kanye nempilo yengqondo. Amalungu kufanele akhethwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuphakanyiswa kwamagama kulabo abathintekayo, nangemva kokushicilelwa kwesaziso kumagazini kahulumeni sokumema iziphakamiso zamagama amalungu amasha. (b) Uma uNgqongqoshe engatholi amagama noma amagama aphakanyisiwe enganele ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo sokumema iziphakamiso zamagama, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha inani elidingekayo lamalungu afanelekile ukuba akhethwe njengamalungu ngaphansi kwesigaba 1. Ilungu kufanele libambe le ndawo isikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni emihlanu kusukela ngosuku lokukhethwa. Amagama amalungu eMphakathi, usuku abekhethwa ngalo, kanye nesikhathi abazohlala emsebenzini kufanele ashicilelwe nguNgqongqoshe esazisweni kumagazini kahulumeni ngokushesha ngemuva kokukhethwa kwabo. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda akhethe ilungu eliphelelwe isikhathi, akhethwe kwesinye isikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni emihlanu. Le lungu kufanele, uma ingena emsebenzini, isaqhubeka nokulandela isithembiso sokulandela okukhuluma kulolu sikhungo kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha. (a) UNgqongqoshe angakwazi ukuhoxisa iMphakathi uma ingahambisani nanoma yiziphi izinhlinzeko zalesi sikhungo. (b) Zonke izisebenzi zeMphakathi zizobe zisebenza ngaphansi kwamandla kaNgqongqoshe kuze kube kukhethwa iMphakathi entsha. UNgqongqoshe angakhetha umuntu oyedwa noma abaningi ukuze bahlolisise iMphakathi futhi babike ngemuva kwalolo hlolo uma kukhona ukungabaza ukuthi iMphakathi yehluleka ukuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalesi sikhungo kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha. (i) ilungu leMphakathi, umthetho wesifunda, noma iPhalamende likazwelonke; noma (ii) umuntu ophatha isikhundla esifundeni noma ezwenikazi noma ungumsebenzi wenhlangano noma iqembu lezepolitiki. (d) ungena emsebenzini ngendlela yokuthi angakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe njengelungu leMphakathi; noma (e) akanazo iziqu ezidingekayo ukuze akhethwe njengelungu leMphakathi. (f) ilungu ivumela noma ingena ezindlekweni ezingavunyelwe noma ezingafanele noma ezindlekweni ezingabuyiselwa noma ezichithwa; noma (g) ukuvalwa kwalolo msebenzi kuzoba inzuzo noma kuzokwenza kube lula emphakathini. Noma iyiphi indawo evulekile eMphakathini kufanele igcwaliswe njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 7 noma esigabeni 8 noma indawo eyadalwa ngokufa kwelungu kufanele igcwaliswe nguNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 5, futhi ilungu elikhethwe kufanele liqedele isikhathi esingakaze siphelelwe yileli lungu abelisebenzisela. UNgqongqoshe, ngemuva kokuxoxisana neMphakathi, kufanele akhethe omunye wamalungu eMphakathi akhethwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 5 (a) njengomholi weMphakathi. (b) Emhlanganweni wokuqala weMphakathi, amalungu azokhetha umphakathi ophakanyisiwe ohlobene nesigaba 31 (1) (a) no (b). (c) UNgqongqoshe angakwazi ukuhoxisa ukukhethwa kwelungu njengomholi noma umphakathi ophakanyisiwe uma lokho kuzoba inzuzo emphakathini noma uma ilungu ingakwazi noma yehluleka ukwenza imisebenzi yayo njengomholi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu. Umholi nomphakathi ophakanyisiwe bazobamba le ndawo isikhathi esilinganayo nalokho abakhethwe ngaso njengamalungu eMphakathi ngaphandle kokuthi umholi noma umphakathi wabo ophakanyisiwe ahluleka noma engasasebenzi njengelungu leMphakathi ngaphambi kokuphelelwa isikhathi somsebenzi noma akhishwe emsebenzini nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi kwesigaba 8. Uma kungekho mholi noma nganoma yisiphi isizathu bengakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo njengomholi, umphakathi ophakanyisiwe, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhuluma esigabeni 1, unamandla okwenza zonke izisebenzi futhi asebenzise amandla omholi. Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal Sifo sofuba, noma i-tuberculosis (TB), sisabhekwa njengesithiyo esikhulu empilweni yethu, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal. Ukuze silwe nale ngxaki, kudingeka ukuba nezinhlelo eziqondile, ezibanzi, nezihlanganisayo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba kufanele zithuthukiswe, zibe nomthelela, futhi zifake wonke umuntu ukuze sithole impumelelo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lesi sifo asithinti abantu kuphela, kodwa siphazamisa umphakathi wonke. Abantu abathola lesi sifo bahlushwa ngezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nokuntuleka kokudla, ukungabi namsebenzi, kanye nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba zibe nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezibhekiswe ekuthuthukiseni izimo zempilo zomphakathi, hhayi kuphela ekwelapheni abagulayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka, izinhlelo zokuvikela zidinga ukuqiniswa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola abantu abathintekayo, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukusabalala kwesifo. Kubalulekile futhi ukufaka imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi ngalesi sifo, izimpawu zaso, nezindlela zokuvikela. Ngomkhankaso ophumelelayo, singakhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphumelele ekutholeni usizo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele ube nesandla esikhulu ekulweni nale ngxaki. Njengoba izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba ziqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi abahlali babambe iqhaza emisebenzini ethile, njengokuhlinzeka ngolwazi, ukusiza ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo, nokuthuthukisa ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umuzwa wobumbano nokuzimela phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile empumelelweni yokulwa nesifo sofuba. Ithimba lezempilo linendima ebalulekile, kodwa akufanele kube yilo kuphela ophakathi kokuthwala umthwalo. Uhlelo lokulwa nesifo sofuba kufanele luhlanganise iminyango ehlukene, njengemfundo, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nezokwelapha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, futhi zifinyeleleke kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zinsiza kuzosiza ukwakha indlela eyodwa yokusebenza, okuhlanganisa izixazululo ezisebenzayo nezindlela zokuphila ezithuthukisiwe. Sizodinga futhi ukugxila emiphumeleni yezinhlelo ezikhona. Izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba kumele zihlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona izinguquko ezithuthukile. Lokhu kusho ukuhlola izinga lokuphila kwabantu abathintekayo, kanye nokubona ukuthi izindlela ezisetshenziswayo zisebenza yini. Uma kunokungaphumeleli, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokwenza ngcono futhi ziqhutshekwe phambili ukuze sithole impumelelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi silungise izinkinga ezihlobene nezezimali. Ukuze sikwazi ukufeza izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhaswa kwezimali okukhulu, okungagqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezizimele, kanye nabaxhasi abavela emiphakathini. Ngokwami, uma singanqoba lezi zinkinga, sizoba nethuba elihle lokulwa nesifo sofuba. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal zidinga ukwakhiwa ngempumelelo, ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukugxila emiphumeleni, kanye nokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi, uma sithatha lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukukhipha isifo sofuba empilweni yabantu bethu, sithuthukise izimo zabo zokuphila, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wonke. Lokhu akusizi kuphela abantu abaphethwe yilesi sifo, kodwa kuzothuthukisa umnotho, ubudlelwano, nempilo yansuku zonke KwaZulu-Natal. Ngakho-ke, asiqhubekeleni phambili, sikhuthaze izinhlelo zokulwa nesifo sofuba, futhi sithuthukise impilo yethu sonke. Izenzo zethu namuhla zizosipha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Sifuna ukuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba, sihlanganyele ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobumbano, nolungisa izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sihlanganyela ngokuphelele, sibhudlaza, futhi sithumele izwi eliqinile lokulwa nesifo sofuba KwaZulu-Natal.

Umthetho - 3: Umlandeli noma abalandeli, kanye nezizukulwane.. Ngemuva kokungabi khona kwesivumelwano sokuhlomula eNingizimu Afrika, umthetho we-Intestate Succession Act No. 81, owawusebenza kusukela ngoMashi 18, 1988, ulawula ukusabalalisa kwempahla (ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye) ngalolo suku noma ngemuva kosuku olufanele. a Uma umufi engakakhombisi ukuthi impahla yakhe kufanele ihlukaniswe kanjani ngencwadi yokuhlomula noma ngesivumelwano esenziwe ngaphambi komshado; noma b Lapho kungenzeka ukufeza izifiso zomufi ngoba abalandeli, ngokwesibonelo, bahluleka ukufaka isicelo sokuhlomula noma abakhombisi isifiso sokuhlomula noma bafa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kungenzeka ukuthi umuntu afe ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye ngaphandle kwesivumelwano. Isibonelo salokhu yileso esikhombisa umtshali-mali unikeza ingxenye ethile yemali empahleni encwadini eqinisekisiwe kodwa engakhulumi ngempahla esele. Kulokhu, ingxenye enikezwe incwadi izohlukanisa impahla ngokuhambisana nezimo ezitholakala encwadini, kanti impahla esele izohlukaniswa ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Intestate Succession Act. Ngaphambi kwesinqumo se-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, Icala No. 49/03, elethwe kwiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngo-Okthoba 15, 2004, imithetho ye-Intestate Succession Act ayizange isetshenziswe kubantu abamnyama abafa ngaphandle kwesivumelwano futhi bashadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Isinqumo se-Bhe saguqula lokhu; manje impahla yabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma isiko, abafayo ngaphandle kwesivumelwano, izophathwa yi-Intestate Succession Act njengoba kubhalwe kwi-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma ngemigomo ye-Intestate Succession Act, kubalulekile ukuchaza ezinye izimiso ezisemqoka ukuze kuqondwe imithetho. Ngokuqondene nezincazelo ezilandelayo, "stirpes" kusho ingane ephilayo yomufi noma ingane eyafa ngaphambili emelelwa yizizukulwane. Ingane eyafa ngaphambili yomufi enezizukulwane eziphilayo eyakha kuphela i-stirpes eyodwa. Ukumeleka kwenzeka lapho umnqobi ofanele engakwazi noma engafuni ukuhlomula, kuthathwa ngabanye bezizukulwane. Esibonelweni esingenhla, u-D no-F bazomela ingane eyafa ngaphambili yomufi. Ngemuva kwesigaba (f) se-Intestate Succession Act ka-1987 njengoba kuguqulwe ngesinqumo se-Bhe, ingxenye yengane ibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani eliphelele lempahla ngenani le-stirpes zomufi (okukhuluma ngenani lezingane eziphilayo zomufi noma lezo ezafa ngaphambi kwakhe ezisaphila ezizukulwaneni) kanye nenani labashadile abaphilayo bomufi. Ake sithi inani eliphelele lempahla yomufi ngu-R500,000 futhi unezingane ezimbili eziphilayo kanye nezingane ezimbili ezisemthethweni. R100,000. Ngakho-ke, ingxenye yengane izoba ngu-R100,000. Ngokwesigaba 1(d) se-Intestate Succession Act, izinga lobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abahlobene ngegazi nomufi lungahlukaniswa laba ngamaphuzu amabili, okungukuthi izinga lobudlelwano ekuhlomuleni okuqondile kanye nezinga lobudlelwano ekuhlomuleni okuphambene. Ekuhlomuleni okuqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lingalingana nenani lezigaba phakathi kwezizukulwane kanye nomufi noma isizukulwane nomufi (njengoba kumile). Ekuhlomuleni okuphambene, izinga lobudlelwano lingalingana nenani lezigaba phakathi kobudlelwano begazi kanye nezizukulwane eziseduze ezihlobene nazo zonke, kanye nenani lezigaba phakathi kwezizukulwane zomufi. Ukusabalalisa kwempahla ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987 kungafingqwa kube yimithetho eyisishiyagalolunye. Uma umufi eshiya umlingani noma abalingani, kodwa enganazo izizukulwane - umlingani noma abalingani bangabalandeli kuphela. Endabeni lapho umufi engumkakhe emshadweni wesiko onabafazi abaningana, abalingani abaphilayo bazohlomula impahla ngokulingana. Umlingani ophilayo ungumlandeli kuphela ngaphansi kwe-Intestate Succession Act, kungakhathaliseki inani lempahla. Uma abalingani bashadile emiphakathini yezezimali, umlingani ophilayo uzothola ingxenye eyodwa ngokuhambisana nomshado wabo emiphakathini yezezimali nengenye ingxenye ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Uma abalingani bashadile ngaphandle kwemiphakathi yezezimali, umlingani ophilayo uzothola yonke impahla ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. A & B = abazali bomufi; E = umufi; C no-D = abalingani emshadweni wesiko bomufi. Ngokwesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987, njengoba kaguqulwa yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esinqumweni se-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, abalingani ababili bomufi (C no-D) bazohlomula impahla ngokulingana, ngaphandle kokubandakanya omunye umuntu emndenini. Uma umufi ehlonishwa ngaphezu kwabafazi ababili ngaphansi komthetho wesiko futhi engashiyi izizukulwane, khona-ke bonke abafazi bazohlomula impahla ngokulingana. Uma umufi engashiyi umlingani kodwa eshiya izizukulwane - izizukulwane zihlomula impahla njenge-stirpes futhi ukumeleka kuvunyelwe. Izingane zomufi, D, E, no-F zizohlomula impahla ngokulingana. Njengoba u-E efa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, izizukulwane zakhe, J no-K zizomela yena futhi zihlomule impahla yakhe ngokulingana. Zonke izingane zomufi zinegunya lokuhlomula. Akukhathaliseki ukuthi zabe zikhuluma emshadweni wezomthetho, wesiko, noma zabe zikhuluma ngaphandle komshado. Ngokwesigaba 1 se-Intestate Succession Act, abalandeli abangenayo imvume yokuhlomula empahleni yomufi ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esivela kubudlelwano begazi. Uma umufi eshiya umlingani noma abalingani kanye nezizukulwane - umlingani noma abalingani bazothola ingxenye enkulu engu-R125,000 ngayinye noma ingxenye yezingane, kanti izizukulwane zizothola impahla esele, uma kukhona noma yiziphi izizukulwane ezikhuluma. Uma inani eliphelele lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, umlingani ophilayo, esibonelweni esingenhla, (S) uzothola yonke impahla, kuhlanganise nezingane nezinye izihlobo. Uma umufi engumkakhe oshadile nabafazi abaningi futhi kunezintombi eziningi eziphilayo, futhi inani lempahla lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, khona-ke abalingani abaphilayo bazohlukanisa inani elisele ngokulingana phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezingane nezinye izihlobo. Uma inani elisele lempahla lidlula u-R125,000, umlingani uzothola u-R125,000 noma ingxenye yengane, noma yikuphi okukhulu, kanti inani elisele lizohlukaniswa phakathi kwezizukulwane zomufi nge-stirpes futhi ukumeleka kuvunyelwe.
