Ezokumbiwa Kwezinsiza: Ingxoxo Ngemiphumela Nezindlela Zokuphila Ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza, noma "resource extraction" ngesiNgisi, kubhekisela ekutholeni nasekuthengiseni kwezinsiza zemvelo, njengezinto eziyigugu, amalahle, uwoyela, nezinsimbi ezahlukene. Le nqubo ibalulekile emnothweni wezwe, kodwa ihambisana nezinselelo ezinkulu, futhi izimpendulo zihlale ziba nezinhlangothi ezahlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinzuzo ezilethwa yizokumbiwa kwezinsiza. Le nqubo ithuthukisa umnotho, ikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, futhi ithuthukisa izinga lempilo emiphakathini eminingi. Umsebenzi owakhiwe ezindaweni eziningi uthuthukisa umphakathi ngenhla kokuthola imali, ukudala ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, nokwandisa amathuba okubambisana kwezamabhizinisi. Izifundazwe ezithola umvuzo ophuma ezinsizeni zemvelo zikhula zibe nezinsiza ezinamandla, futhi lokhu kudlulisela umnotho ophilayo. Nokho, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza akukhulumi kuphela ngenzuzo. Imiphumela yabo ingaba nemiphumela emibi engatholwa uma ungaphathwa kahle. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuvuma ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ngaphandle kokunakwa kwemiphumela emibi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinjengokubola kwemvelo, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, nezinkinga zokungcoliseka komoya. Lokhu kuvamise ukufaka izakhamizi ezisemadolobheni amakhulu, nezingatholi izinzuzo ezinjalo zokuthuthuka. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zidalela ukungaboni ngaso linye. Ukusuka emuva, abanye abantu becabanga ukuthi lezi zinsiza zidinga ukuvikelwa ezinhliziyweni zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwezinsiza zethu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, osomabhizinisi bakubona njengobuchwepheshe bezenhlalo nezomnotho. Ubhadlana nohlanga oluhlukahlukene, lobu buciko bezamabhizinisi nezokumbiwa kwezinsiza bufaka ukungqubuzana phakathi kokuthola imali nokuvikelwa kwemvelo. Kulindeleke ukuthi, uma sikhuluma ngokubhalela izinsiza, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezicacile. Imithetho ehlangabezana nezidingo zemvelo ibaluleke kakhulu, kuyilapho ibhizinisi libhekisela ekuvinjweni kwezinto ezimbi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola nomthelela, okuhleliwe nezokuhlola, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihlanganyelwayo phakathi kwabantu, osonhlalakahle, nosomabhizinisi. Izifundo eziningi zikhombisa ukuthi ukuvikelwa kwemvelo akubangela ukuphikiswa komnotho. Ngempela, ukuthola imithombo engaphandle nezinsizakusebenza kungavumela izinsiza zokuqinisekisa ukuhamba nokudlondlobala. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nemithetho eqinile ebonisa indlela eyiyo yokusebenza, eqinisekisa ukuziphatha okuhle nokuba nesibopho. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, kudingeka indawo yokuxhumana ngempela phakathi kokuthola kuwo wonke umphakathi. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo eziyinsakavukela ezizoqinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bahlala benesikhala sokuqhubeka nezenzo ezinhle. Ukuze kube nezenzo eziphumelelayo, kufanele kuhlale kudingeka ukusabalalisa izinzuzo ezenzakalayo, kuze kufakwe umigomo esobala nezici zokuchitha izinsiza ngendlela eqhubekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlela izindawo zokumbiwa ukuze zigcine imiphumela emibi. Ukuze kube neqhaza elithe xaxa, kumelwe kuthathwe izinyathelo ezikhuthaza ukwakhiwa kokubuyisela emuva kukho konke okwandile. Lokhu kungenziwa ukuvikela indawo ebonakalayo futhi ukukhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Izindlela zokuvikelwa komhlaba zibonisa indlela yokusebenza enobuchwepheshe nephusile, ubungako nezinhlelo ezifanele ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umbono wezokumbiwa kwezinsiza kumele udlule kwezinsizakusebenza kube indlela yokuxhasa umphakathi. Imithombo esikhulu yalokhu yindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, evusa ubuchwepheshe nemibono ehloniphekile. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ibhizinisi eli sustainable, okuzokwenza kube neqhaza elithe xaxa empilweni yabantu. Ekugcineni, ezokumbiwa kwezinsiza zingaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi owahlukahlukene, kodwa lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo eziphusile nezihlanganisayo. Ukuthola izinsiza ngezindlela ezisemthethweni kuyasiza ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, kodwa ibalulekile nokuvikela imvelo. Ngokuhlanganisa ukumelana nemiphumela emibi ngokuphatha okuhle, singenza kube nohlanga olusha oluhlangabezana nezidingo zethu. Lokhu kugcizelela ukubaluleka kokukhuluma, ukusabalalisa, nokuxhumana phakathi kwezimali nemvelo, ukuze sithole impumelelo ehlala njalo.
U-Eskom: Umcimbi Wokubuyiselwa Kwamandla Eminyakeni edlule, i-Eskom, uMnyango wezokuhlinzekwa kwamandla eNingizimu Afrika, ibihlaselwa yizinkinga ezinzima zezimali, ukuntuleka kwamandla, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kuhambele phambili kunomthelela omkhulu ekuphileni kwabantu abaningi, ngokuvamile kwaphumela ekubeni nomoya ophakeme wezokuxhalaba ezweni. Nokho, umcimbi wamuva, obhalwe phansi njengephesenti lempumelelo, ubuyisela ithemba kulabo abaphila phansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngomkhosi ojabulisayo, i-Eskom iwavula amahlandla amahle, ithuthukisa izinhlelo zayo zokuhlinzeka ngamandla, okwenza kwazeke ngendlela esikhathini esizayo. Le nchazelo yomcimbi ibonisa indlela u-Eskom ehlela ngayo ukuphucula ukuzinza kokuhlinzekwa kwezimoto zakhe, ukwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza ziphumelele, futhi ukuphinde inikeze amandla ahlanzekile kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe. Umcimbi wokuqala ubungamkhankaso owawuhlosiwe ukujolisa ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokusebenza zomphakathi. Ngoviyo owenziwa emphakathini, i-Eskom yabamba umhlangano ophakathi kwezinkampani eziningi, iziphathimandla zomthetho, kanye nezikhungo zokuhlola. Ukuzikhandla kwalesi sikhangiso kwakuhlosiwe ukukhuthaza ukwakheka kwezixazululo ezihlinzekwayo, okwenza kube nokuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani ezihlobene. Izithameli zabeziqoqene ezikhungweni ezihlukahlukene, zibhakabhaka emcimbini Ngenxa yokukhuluma okwazisa, izazi kwizobuchwepheshe zenze izethulo ezithokozisayo, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bebambisene ukuze bafeze umgomo ophezulu. Uhlaka lwezithameli lushaywa izikhumbuzo eziphathelene namandla ahlanzekile, izindlela zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili nokuhamba phambili kwezokuhlinzeka. Lokhu kugqugquzela abantu kakhulu, kwenza umoya omuhle kuwo wonke amalungu omphakathi. Ukwethenjelwa kwezakhamuzi ku-Eskom kuhleliwe ngaphansi kwendawo yokubuyiselwa kancane kwezinsiza. I-Eskom ithole izinsizakalo eziyisisekelo ukuze iqhubeke nokunikeza amandla, ithuthukisa zonke izinkomba zokuhlaziywa kwensiza. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza kusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezakhamuzi kwamoto, zikhombisa ukwakha ukholo phakathi kwabantu, beshweleza izinsizakalo eziphakeme zokuhlinzeka. Ukwenziwa kwesikhumbuzo samandla ahlanzekile kuboniswa ngamaphrojekthi amasha, kuyilapho kuhlala kucacile ukuthi u-Eskom uyayiqonda imiphumela yokuwohloka kwemvelo. Izinhlelo zokuphuma emithonjeni yokugcina, nokuvuselelwa kwemithombo yokuhlinzeka, sebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukile ukuze kunqandwe umphumela omubi emvelweni. Umcimbi uqhubekile ngokudlulisela ezenzakalweni ezisemqoka zomsebenzi wokuhlanzeka, kukhombisa ukuthi indlela yokuhlinzeka kagesi ingashintsha ngokuvumelana nesilinganiso sezemvelo. Ngalolu suku, u-Eskom wakha ubudlelwano obuhlala bukhona phakathi kwesikhungo sokunakekela izinsiza ezihambisana nezinye izikhungo, ukuze kuhlonishwe izifiso zomsebenzi wokuhlola, nokuhlinzeka ngezolimo ezihlakaniphile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakheka kwezinhlelo zokhetho ezizojabulisa abantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaqonda futhi uvunyelwe ukuhamba phambili. Ekugcineni, u-Eskom uqhubekile nokukhuthaza ukuzimisela kokwakha isizwe esinamandla, esimele amandla amasha nezobuchwepheshe. Umcimbi walolu suku ubuhlanganisa imizamo emikhulu yokwenza u-Eskom ibe yinhlangano ezimele, enokholo, kanye nezinhlelo ezilula zanamuhla ezizosiza ukufezekisa imiphumela ehlelekile. Ngale ndlela, sithola uthuthuko olunamandla ku-Eskom, olukhombisa zikhanya ngempumelelo, lapho okukwazi abantu nabaholi bezezimali bekhuthazwa ukuba baphinde balungiselele izinsiza zabo ukuze kuphumelele ekuthuthukiseni ubuqotho. Umcimbi uphakamisa umoya wokubambisana, ukujolisa kumgomo wokunikeza amandla angcono, u-Eskom uyavuma, ubhalisela uhla olukhulu lokuthuthuka kwamandla eNingizimu Afrika.
Imincintiswano Yezemidlalo: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha Ubulungiswa Nobuchwepheshe Imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyisigcawu esibalulekile emiphakathini eminingi, ihlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, izizukulwane, nezizinda ezihlukene. Lezi zenzakalo zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuzikhandla, nokuhlonipha, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana, ubungani, kanye nokuhlanganyela. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka imincintiswano yezemidlalo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nomthelela wayo emphakathini. Ukuqala, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ivame ukuhlela ngezikhathi ezithile, ikakhulukazi emaphakathini amakhulu, ezikoleni, noma ezikhungweni zokuqeqesha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imidlalo efana nebhola, i-rugby, i-athletics, nezinye eziningi. Umcimbi uvame ukuhlela ukuze ubonise amakhono abathandi bezemidlalo, futhi uvame ukuheha izixuku ezinkulu zababukeli. Lokhu kudala umoya opholile, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bahloniphe abaqhudelana, baphinde baphakamise umoya wokuncintisana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlangana, bahlala ndawonye, futhi babelane ngemicabango nemizwa. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bejabulisa futhi bexhasana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano ibalulekile ekukhuthazeni intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezemidlalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ukuzivocavoca nokubamba iqhaza emidlalweni kuthuthukisa impilo yomzimba, kunciphisa izinga lokukhathala, futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nempilo engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zanamuhla, lapho abantu abaningi behlupheka ngezinkinga zokuphila eziphila kahle. Imincintiswano ibavumela abantu ukuba baphume emakhaya, bazivocavoca, futhi baphinde bathole ubungani obusha. Ngokubheka imiphumela yezenzakalo ezinjalo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo ayigcini nje ngokuba umcimbi wokuncintisana, kodwa iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Imincintiswano ibalulekile ekwakheni izinkumbulo ezinhle, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlakaniphana, futhi bezama ukufinyelela imigomo yabo. Lokhu kudala umoya opholile, lapho abantu bejabulisa futhi bephakamisa omunye nomunye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe. Abadlali bahlala befuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kahle, befundisa abanye, futhi bephinde bathuthukise amakhono abo. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezemidlalo, futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bahlala bejabulisa, bephakamisa umoya wokuncintisana, futhi bephinde bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Ekugcineni, imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyisigcawu esibalulekile sokuhlanganyela, ukuhweba, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Imincintiswano ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, futhi ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze imincintiswano yezemidlalo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphume, bazivocavoce, futhi bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi onobungani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imincintiswano yezemidlalo izohlala ibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi izoqhubeka nokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle, ubungani, nokuhlonipha phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokukhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana, ubungani, kanye nokuhlanganyela, okubalulekile empilweni yethu. Imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze bonke abantu ukuba bahlale bejabulisa, bephakamisa omunye nomunye, futhi baphinde bahloniphe ubuchwepheshe obukhona. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke nokukhuthaza imincintiswano yezemidlalo, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphume, bazivocavoce, futhi bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi onobungani. Imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyisigcawu esibalulekile sokuhlanganyela, ukuhweba, nokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze bonke abantu ukuba bahlale bejabulisa, bephakamisa omunye nomunye, futhi baphinde bahloniphe ubuchwepheshe obukhona.
Ukufunda Ngobuchwepheshe: Umpheki wempumelelo UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumfundisi wezobuchwepheshe odume kakhulu esifundazweni saseGauteng. Ukukhula kukaThandiwe kwahluka kakhulu kulokho okunembile ezimpilweni zabanye. Uhlanga lwakhe lwasekhaya lungamakhaya anemithetho elula, kodwa ngezimfanelo ezihlukile, uThandiwe uthole amandla okwenza ushintsho olukhulu empilweni yakhe. Ekhula emzini omncane, wathembeka esikhathini esinengqondo, lapho izifundo zobuchwepheshe zazifaka isandla sokujabulisa, ukubona ushintsho nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe esikoleni, uThandiwe wagxila ezinhlelweni zobuchwepheshe eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, lapho afundela ubunjiniyela bemishini. Ubulungiswa bukaThandiwe buvame ukusitshela ngempumelelo yakhe ethokozisayo yokuhlangana nezifundo ezinzima. Khona lapho, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhawulelwe nje kuhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe; ngaphakathi kokuhlaziya, wakwazi ukubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlose ukufezekisa okuningi kokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. UThandiwe ukholelwa ekutheni ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akukhona nje ukufunda ukuzenzela, kodwa nokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abe nomfaniswano ophakeme nabafundi, abamfakeli oxhasayo abathembela kuye emnothweni wobuchwepheshe. Ukukhuthaza, uthanda ukufundisa abafundi ngendawo yabo emphakathini nasebenziseni ubuchwepheshe kanye nezinsiza zendawo ukwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. Njengoba ethuthuka emsebenzini wakhe, uThandiwe waphendukela kumkhakha wezobuchwepheshe. Waqala ukwakha izinhlelo ezihambelana nezidingo zabafundi nezindawo eziphakanyiswa uMnyango wezeMfundo. Lokhu kusebenzelana kwakha isikhala sezakhamuzi ukusebenzisana. UThandiwe ubelokhu eqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo zokufunda ezihlanganisa imfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemikhakha ehlukene yezezimali. Lokhu kuthuthukisa indlela yokubuka imisebenzi eyenzekayo emphakathini. UThandiwe ungumfundisi ophumelelayo, okhuthaza abafundi abakhe umbono omuhle. Uqhuba imikhankaso yokubambisana ezitholakala emhlabeni wonke, equkethe amaphrojekthi akhe okuyisibonelo esihle sokuxhumanisa imiphakathi. UThandiwe unethuba lokuba nomthelela ohlelweni lomphakathi, eqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yabo. Kwazulu, umculi, imbongi, nomfundisi, uThandiwe ungaphezu komkhakha wezobuchwepheshe. Uqedela ubuchwepheshe nezindlela zokwakha abafundi ezitsheni zokuhlola, edala indlela yokuthi imfundo ibaluleke kakhulu emakethe yanamuhla. UThandiwe usebenzisa amakhono akhe akhe eziphathimandla ukuze kube nohlelo oluqinile lokufunda, lunikeza ithuba lokuthi abanye bakhule uze beqonde izidingo zomphakathi namanje kuzoyingxenye yempumelelo yabo esikhathini esizayo. Ubufakazi bokuphumelela kukaThandiwe ukukholwa ukuthi umphakathi ungathola uthando olukhona emfundweni, futhi ukwazi ukukhiqiza izithombe ezimbili ezibukekayo ukuze kuqondwe ukwehluka komkhakha. Ukubambisana nezikhungo ezincane, eziphakeme, kanye nezinhlelo zezezimali, uThandiwe wathola indlela yokunxenxa ubuchwepheshe, aphinde alwelwe imfundo eyakhayo. Emuva kwezinyanga eziningana zokwenza izinhlelo ezisemqoka, uThandiwe ugcizelela ukuthi umphakathi ungasiza ukufundisa kusebenze, ezikhathini ezinzima ziyashintsha. Umsebenzi wakhe uba isizathu sempumelelo, njengoba ubuchwepheshe buyinhloso ethokozisayo yokuthi ugcine imizwa emihle yangokwezifiso. Kuzoba nomphumela wokwakha izinhlelo ezizobasiza abafundi ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile nelimnandi ngemodi ethokozisayo. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, ulwela ukudlulisa izifundo zakhe kuzakwethu, echazela ukuthi izifundo zobuchwepheshe zingakhulisa injabulo nokuphila kwempilo okujabulisayo. Unomsebenzi omkhulu phambili, uvula amathuba amaningi, futhi uyacela kufanele ukwehlisa umkhankaso wakhe wokuthi ubuchwepheshe buphakwe kwaziwa esizukulwaneni esizayo. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumholi omeleke, ubonisa ukuthi ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka njalo emoyeni wokufunda nokuzitholela.
Ikomishini Yokuxazulula, Ukuhweba Nokuhlonza (CCMA) iyisakhiwo sokuxazulula izingxabano esisungulwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezobudlelwano bezabasebenzi, Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995. Le komishini iyazimela kwiSikhungo, emaqenjini ezombusazwe, ezinyunyana, abaqashi, izinhlangano zabakwaqashi, kanye nobuholi bezinyunyana noma izinhlangano zabakwaqashi. Umqondisi we-CCMA unomthwalo oqondile wokwakha izinqubo nemigomo kwi-CCMA. I-CCMA ihlose ukukhuthaza ubulungiswa bomphakathi nokuthuthukiswa komnotho, ngokubambisana nezithakazelo zomphakathi, ngokuguqula ubudlelwano endaweni yokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka uma kwethulwa uhlelo lokuxazulula nokuvimbela izingxabano olungakhethi. Kithi, ubuchwepheshe, ubuqotho, kanye nokwethulwa kwezinsiza nokwabelana ngobudlelwano obusekelwe ethembeni kubalulekile. Emphakathini, sizibophezele ekwenzeni izinguquko kubudlelwano bendawo yokusebenza ngokuxazulula izingxabano ngendlela efanele nokwabelana ngolwazi lwethu kabanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukucubungula izicelo zokwamukelwa nokwesekwa ezithunyelwe ngamaBargaining Councils nezinkampani ezizimele. Kuhlinzekwa ukuqeqeshwa nokuqondisa mayelana: ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zokuhweba ezihlanganyelwayo; izinguquko ezimweni zokusebenza; izinqubo zokubonisana; ukuvalwa kwemisebenzi; ukuhlolwa kwendawo yokusebenza nokuvimbela izingxabano. I-CCMA inehhovisi likazwelonke eliseGauteng, kanye nehhovisi leziphathamandla eziyi-9. Ihhovisi ngalinye leziphathamandla linomkomishana okhethekile ophatha imihlangano futhi aqondise le ndawo, kanye nomlobi ophatha imisebenzi yokuphatha. Iphakathi nendawo inamakomishana aphatha ukuhweba nokwahlulela lapho kukhona izingxabano. Umphakathi uvunyelwe ukusebenzisa ilabhulali kodwa awukwazi ukuboleka izinto. Umfaki-sicelo kumele akhombise uma efuna ikhophi yerekhodi noma efuna ukubona irekhodi mathupha ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Uma irekhodi ingabhalwanga ephepheni noma encwadini, ingabukwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziceliwe, njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 292. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela irekhodi ngaphansi kwezimo ezingajwayelekile, umfaki-sicelo kumele athole leyo rekodi ngaphansi kwezimo abacelwayo. Nokho, lokhu kungase kungabi khona uma kuphazamisa ukusebenza kwaleyo nhlangano, kuphazamisa irekhodi, noma kuphikisana nomthetho ovikela amarekhodi abhalwe angawomphakathi. Uma kungabi khona ithuba lokuthi umfaki-sicelo athole ikhophi ngaphansi kwezimo eziceliwe, ukukhokha kumele kubhekwane nokuthi kungadluli kulokho okudingekayo ukukhokhwa esicelweni sabo. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukuphendulwa ngokubhala noma ngefoni mayelana nesicelo sabo, kumele akhombise lokhu njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna olunye ulwazi, kumele achaze ukuthi iyiphi isicelo abathumele njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enezinkinga, angacela irekhodi ngokuqonda. I-Information Authority kumele iphelele ifomu lesicelo kubo futhi inikeze ikhophi yefomu njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 183. Umfaki-sicelo ofuna ukubona irekhodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwabo akakhokhiswa. I-Information Authority kumele ikwazise umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwalabo abafuna ulwazi ngabo) ngesenzo, icela ukukhokha okufanele ngaphambi kokuthi kuqhubeke nalesi simo. Imali yesicelo sezikhungo zikamasipala ingama-R35. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi, uma kudingeka futhi kufanelekile, noma ukufaka enkantolo ukuze acela ukuthi bangakhokhi imali edingekayo. Ngemuva kokuthi i-Information Authority yenze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswe ngalokho kwenziwe ngendlela abacelwayo. Uma isicelo samukelwa, umfaki-sicelo kumele akhokhe imali yokucubungula nokufuna ulwazi kwi rekodi, amalungiselelo, kanye nokwenza amakhophi, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze le rekodi ilungiswe ukuze ibonwe. Ukuze uthole imininingwane yokuxhumana, bheka Isigaba 14 1 b ukuze uthole amakheli emahhovisi e-CCMA ezindaweni. Uma amalunga omphakathi enezinkinga mayelana ne-CCMA futhi efuna ukuba nengxenye ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo zokuphatha, kufanele bafake isicelo kumqondisi noma baxhumane nanoma yiliphi ilunga lenhlangano yomphakathi esebenza ne-CCMA eduze. Ngokwesibonelo, uma ilunga lomphakathi lingowesinyunyana, kufanele lixhumane nehhovisi elimele abasebenzi. Inhlangano ingaphika ukuhlinzeka irekhodi ngendlela eceliwe. Uma umfaki-sicelo sekuqedile lelo fomu, kumele lilithumele kwi-Information Authority. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokucela ulwazi mayelana nemiphumela ngendlela engafani nokubhala, njengokufonela noma nge-imeyili. Umuntu ophakamisayo udinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuxhumana futhi angacelwa ukukhokha imali yokuhambisa udaba. I-Information Authority kumele iphendule ngesicelo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 zokusebenza, futhi uma isicelo sikhanseliwe, i-Information Authority kumele ihlinzeke ngezizathu zalokho njengoba kuchaziwe ngumthetho. Akukho okukhuluma ngendaba yeNgqongqoshe yezeMthetho nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo okukhulunywa lapha, njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 92. Isakhiwo sikamasipala kumele, uma kudingeka, sihlaziye futhi sishicilele incwadi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14, izikhathi ezingadluli unyaka owodwa. Amakhophi amathathu abhalwe ngolimi lwemiphakathi emithathu kumele atholakale ezikhungweni zokwazisa ulwazi ezichaziwe ngumthetho njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 6 soMthetho Wokufakwa Kwezimali ka-1997; iKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu yaseNingizimu Afrika; kanye nazo zonke izikhungo zayo. Le ncwadi kumele iphumelele ngolimi lwemiphakathi emithathu kwiGazethi yoMnyango. Uma imisebenzi yezakhiwo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zikamasipala ibonakala ingaxhunyiwe, iNgqongqoshe ingakhetha, ngokwakhe noma ngokwesicelo, ukuthi kube ne ncwadi eyodwa kuphela ezokhishwa. Lezi zakhiwo kumele zabelane ngezindleko zokubhala nokushicilela le ncwadi ngokuhambisana nesinqumo seNgqongqoshe. Ngenxa yezizathu zokuphepha, zezimali, noma ezihlobene nomsebenzi, iNgqongqoshe ingakhetha, ngokwakhe noma ngokwesicelo, ikhiphe isaziso kwiGazethi yoMnyango, ikhulula izakhiwo ezithile ezivela ezinhlinzekweni zale ngxenye yomthetho isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Imali ekhokhiswa ukuze uthole ikhophi yencwadi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ingama-R0.60 ngephepha ngalinye lesayizi ye-A-4 noma ingxenye yayo. Imali ekhokhiswa ngesicelo, ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu ucelwe ulwazi oluthile ngaye, ngokuhambisana nemithetho ingama-R35.00. Ukuze kufunwe nokulungiselelwa irekhodi ukuze ikhishwe, kungakhokhwa u-R15.00 ngehora noma ingxenye yayo, kanti ihora lokuqala liyadingeka
Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Ezinengi Ngomhlaka 15 kuMandulo 2023, kwenzeka umcimbi obalulekile emiphakathini yethu, lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zathinta kakhulu impilo yabantu. Kwakuphakathi kwezinsuku ezimnandi, umoya wawupholile, kodwa ngezikhathi ezithile ubukhulu bezingozi benza kube nesithukuthezi phakathi kwabantu. Kwakukhona umcimbi wezimoto eziningi owenziwa edolobheni, lapho uhulumeni, izikhungo zezokwelapha, kanye neziphathimandla zomphakathi behlanganyela ukuze baphendule ngendlela efanele ezimeni eziphathelene nezingozi eziphuthumayo. Umcimbi waqubuka ngenhloso yokuvuselela ulwazi lokuphendula ezintweni eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi ezimotweni eziningi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila kahle futhi baphumule. Ukuze siqonde kahle, izimo eziphuthumayo ngokuvamile ziqukethe izimo ezinjengezingozi zomgwaqo, izikhukhula, noma izimo ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kubangela ukumemezela okuphuthumayo, okudinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo. Umcimbi waphela uhlanganisa izigidi zabasebenzi bezokuphepha, abezokwelapha, kanye nababambiqhaza abahlukene, bonke bejolise ekwenzeni imizamo ephezulu yokuphendula. Ngemva kokuvula umcimbi, kwaba nezingxoxo ezibalulekile phakathi kwabaphathi bezokuphepha nezithunywa zezokwelapha mayelana nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kube nempumelelo ekuphenduleni ezimeni ezinjalo. Kukhona ukugxila okukhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuziqhenya emiphakathini, ukuze kube neziqu ezizwakalayo zokuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kumele benze kanjani ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Umhlangano wawuqhakambisa izindlela ezahlukene zokwenza ngcono ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi. Kukhona izinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa, okwakuhlanganisa izifundo zomphakathi, ezifundisa abantu ukuthi baphendule kanjani uma bethola izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ukuphendula okusheshayo nokuphumelelayo kudinga ukuqonda kahle izinyathelo ezilandelwayo. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zaphinde zakhuluma ngokuqhubekayo, zisiza abathintekayo bazi ukuthi bangawathola kanjani amalungelo abo, izinsizakalo, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka zokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nabantu abathintekayo ukuze bathole ukuhlinzekwa komsebenzi ophumelelayo, njengokuthola usizo lwezokwelapha, ukuzithokozisa, noma ukuxhumana nezinsiza zokukhuluma. Umcimbi uphinde wavula amathuba okukhuluma ngobuchwepheshe obuthuthukile bokuphendula. Abathuthukisi bezobuchwepheshe bamemezela izixazululo ezizosheshisa ukuphendula, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezitholakalayo ezisiza ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwezinsiza zomphakathi nabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpendulo eziphuthumayo, futhi kuthuthukise ukuhlinzekwa kwempilo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonise ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nezikhungo ezihlukene. Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo akuyona indaba yomuntu oyedwa, kodwa kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo, ulwazi, nezinsiza. Ukubambisana kwenza kube lula ukuphendula, kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyafinyelela usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi wokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi ubonise ukuthi, njengoba izimo zishintsha futhi zikhula, kufanele sibe neziqu eziphambili zokuphendula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi impilo yomphakathi iqhubeke nokuphila kahle, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi basendaweni ephephile, lapho usizo lungatholakala kalula. Umcimbi ubonise umdlandla phakathi kwabantu, ubufakazi bokuthi, uma sihlanganyela, singakha umphakathi onempumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sinesithakazelo esikhulu sokubona izinhlelo ezidingekayo zikhula, futhi sithi, kumele siqhubeke nokuxhumana, sifundisane, futhi sizame ukusiza omunye nomunye ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Khumbulani, impilo iyigugu, futhi ukuphendula kahle ngesikhathi esifanele singasiza ukusindisa izimpilo.
Ukuvulela 'ukufinyelela' kwelungelo lokwazi ukuze kuhlanganiswe ukufinyelela okubanzi emkhakheni wokukhiqiza nokwakha kwezokuxhumana. Ilungelo lokukhululeka kwezintatheli kanye nezinye izinto zokuxhumana, ukukhululeka kokufinyelela nokusabalalisa ulwazi nezindaba nemibono, ukukhululeka emculweni nasekudlaleni; ukukhululeka emkhakheni wemfundo ephakeme kanye nokukhululeka kokucwaninga. Kusukela ekuthuthukisweni komqondo, udaba lenqubo yokulingana lubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi zonke izinto zisebenza ngokulinganayo nangokufanele embonini yokuxhumana ngokukhuthaza ukufinyelela nokwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi amasha kulomakethe yokuxhumana. Ukukhulumela iziteshi zomsakazo ezinezinga eliphansi - ezisebenza ukusakaza ezitolo/ezikhungweni, ezinkundleni zemidlalo, ezindaweni zokubonisa, nasezindaweni zokubuka amafilimu noma ezinye izinsizakalo ezifanayo, iziphathimandla zingase zingakuboni njengokufanele. Izinsizakalo zomsakazo womphakathi ezinezinga eliphansi - ezisebenza ezindaweni zokuhlala zabadala, zixhumanisa izindawo zezinkonzo, zixhumanisa izindawo zokukhulekela nezindlu, noma ezinye izindawo ezifanayo, iziphathimandla zingase zingakuboni njengokufanele. Umsakazo womphakathi kanye nokukhulumela iziteshi ezinezinga eliphansi kuzosebenza iminyaka emithathu, kanti ilayisensi yokukhulumela iziteshi ezinezinga eliphansi izosebenza ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu. Ukuhlola ukuthi yiziphi izikhala ezifanele ukusetshenziswa okuphansi. Ukuhlola indawo yesiteshi sokukhulumela esizokwenza ukusakaza. Setha ithimba lokubambisana elizophatha inqubo yesicelo futhi libe ngumfakisicelo egameni labakhuthazi bezenzakalo. Qedela ifomu lesicelo ngokuphrinta, usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu. Thumela ifomu lokuqala lesicelo kanye nezincwadi eziyi-16 ezithunyelwe zefomu lesicelo kanye nezimali zesicelo. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfakisicelo futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Ukuvunywa kweleyisensi kungathatha ezinyangeni ezi-2 kuya kwezi-3. Ifomu lesicelo lizoba yingxenye yezinhlu kuGov Gazette.
IHIV/AIDS emiphakathini yasemakhaya Isingeniso IHIV/AIDS iyisifo esithinta kakhulu umphakathi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokubhekana nale nkinga, kubalulekile ukuqonda imbangela zayo, indlela esithinta ngayo abantu, nokuthi singasiza kanjani ukuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabantu abathintekayo. Umphakathi wethu udlala indima ebalulekile ekutholeni izixazululo eziphumelelayo zokukhuthaza impilo enempilo nokuvikela abantu abanale sifo. Ukwazi iHIV ne-AIDS IHIV, noma i-Human Immunodeficiency Virus, ithinta uhlelo lokuvikela lomzimba, inciphisa amandla omzimba ukuvikela izifo. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuphila kahle nale nkinga, sikhuluma nge-AIDS, noma i-Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome, okuyisimo esibucayi esivame ukuhamba nephutha. Izimpawu zalesi sifo ziveleka ngemva kokuba ne-HIV emzimbeni, futhi zingaba yingozi empilweni. Izimbangela zeHIV/AIDS Izimbangela zokwanda kweHIV/AIDS emiphakathini yasemakhaya zihluke kakhulu. Ezinye zezinto eziyinhloko zifaka phakathi ukuthola ulwazi olungelona, ukungcoliswa, nezindlela zokuphila ezingafanele. Ukungabi nokuxhumana okusebenzayo kubangela umphakathi ukuthi ungatholi ulwazi olufanele. Ukuze sifeze impumelelo ekwaziseni, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuvikela, njengokusebenzisa ama-condom nezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Izimpawu zikaHIV/AIDS Abantu abaningi abazi kahle izimpawu zikaHIV/AIDS, okwenza kube nzima ukubona lesi sifo. Izimpawu zokuqala zingabandakanya ukuzizwa ungaphilile, ukuvuvukala kwemilenze nezinyawo, ukuhamba gazi, nokunye okuningi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umphakathi ungathathi izinyathelo zokuhlola, ukuze bazi ngalesi gciwane eliyingozi. Umthelela emiphakathini yasemakhaya Umthelela weHIV/AIDS emiphakathini yasemakhaya ubalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekuthintweni kwezimilo zomndeni, nokunciphisa amathuba okukhulisa nokuthuthukisa abantu. Abantu bahlala besaba, bephikisana nalokho okukhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izixazululo ezithinta umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukusiza wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala emakhaya, ukuqonda ukuthi akusiyona icala, futhi akukhona okuthile okuphikisa. Izixazululo ezitholakalayo Kukhona izindlela eziningi zokunceda emiphakathini yasemakhaya ukuze iHIV/AIDS ingagcini ngokwaziswa kodwa futhi ilashwe. Ukuqwashisa abantu, ukufundisa ngezindlela zokuphila eziphusile, kubalulekile. Izikhungo zezempilo zingavulwa emaphandleni, ukukhuthaza ukuhlolwa, izifundo zeHIV/AIDS, kanye nezinsiza ezivela ezinhlelweni zomphakathi ezinkulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi ukwelashwa kuyatholakala, futhi kubalulekile empilweni yabo. Isiphetho I-HIV/AIDS iyinkinga enkulu emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Ngisho noma izinselelo zikhona, kufanele sithathe ithuba lokuba neqhaza lokuhlala sikhumbuza umphakathi. Njengomphakathi, sinesifiso sokuphila kahle, nokufinyelela ekuthuthukiseni impilo, sizame ukulwa nokwanda kwe-HIV/AIDS. Sifuna ukuthola izixazululo ezithembekile ezisiza umphakathi, sithuthukisa impilo, sibe neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizoqhubeka sithinta izindlela ezithokozisayo nemiphakathi yasemakhaya, ukuze abantu bazizwe benelungelo lokuphila nekusasa elihle.
Inqubo yokwakha izindlu abantu iyisinyathelo sokuhlinzekwa nguhulumeni ukusiza ngezindlu ezisekela imindeni efuna ukuthuthukisa ukufaka kwabo izimali zokuqashwa ngokwakha izindlu zabo noma ngokuzikhuthaza ukuba zakhe izindlu zabo. Le nqubo isiza labo abafuna ukujabulela ukusungula inhlangano yokweseka izindlu ezizobasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngenkxaso ekubumbeni, ezobuchwepheshe, nasekuphathweni. Usizo luhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa nokwelulekwa kwabathola izinzuzo ukuze bakhe izindlu zabo. Le ndlela itholakala njengomsebenzi wababhekiwe, ngokuhlanganiswa, ukudala izikhungo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, itholakala nasezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho abantu benelungelo lokusebenzisa nokuhlala emhlabeni abawuthathile. Le nqubo ikuvumela ukuba usebenzise usizo lwezikhwama ukuze wakhe indlu yakho. Njengoba usizo lobuchwepheshe lubalulekile kakhulu kule nqubo, wonke umuntu ophakathi kwenqubo kumele abe nenhlangano esekelayo. Le nhlangano isiza ngensiza yobuchwepheshe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indlu yakhiwa kahle. Abantu abakha izindlu zabo noma bakhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zabo bangakha izindlu ezinkulu ngezindleko ezincane, behlisa izindleko zomsebenzi ngokuba nabantu abakhe ezinye izinto bona noma ngokuthola usizo emindenini yabo, ozakwabo, abangane, nabanye abangabasiza ukuze bagweme ukukhokha izinzalo kumakhontileka okwakha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinqumo. Kumele ube shadile noma uhleli ndawonye, noma ube nezincwadi ezixhaswa ngokwezimali. Kumele ube ngumuntu omdala okwazi ukungena ekwenzeni isivumelwano. Kumele ube nemali engenayo yomndeni engaphansi kuka-R3,500. Akufanele ube uthole usizo lwezikhwama kuhulumeni ngaphambili ukuze uthenge indlu. Kumele ube ngumthengi wokuqala wezindlu. Qaphela ukuthi kumele ungene esivumelwaneni esisekelwa yinhlangano esemthethweni. Inhlangano esekelayo izohlinzeka ngemininingwane yobuchwepheshe kanye nolwazi lwezokuphatha. Izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe zifaka phakathi ukuxhumana neMnyango wezokwakha wesifunda, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho, yomkakho, nezingane zakho, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngekhophi ye payslip yakho njengobufakazi bemali engenayo. Izicelo zikhishwa yiMinyango yezokwakha zesifunda. Isikhathi esidingekayo sokuhambisa le nkonzo siyahluka kumacala. Le nkonzo iyamahhala futhi ayidingi ifomu.
Isahluko 1: Ukuvela Kwephupho Kwaze kwava emhlabeni, uSteve Jobs, indoda enezifiso ezinkulu, wayehamba ngezinyathelo zokwakha okuthile okwakuzoshintsha impilo yabantu. Ngemva kokuchitha izinyanga eziningi nocwaningo, kudalwe umkhiqizo owaziwa kakhulu — i-iPhone. Isizathu sokuba sithakazelise kangaka besingekho nje kuphela ukuthi sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi sisenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Isahluko 2: Ukuhlangana Kwezobuchwepheshe Ngesikhathi umkhiqizo uphume, abantu babeyithokozisa ngendlela eyahlukene. Ngaphambi kokuba i-iPhone ivele, abantu babejwayele ukusebenzisa amafoni ahlakaniphile, kodwa ayenokuthile okungahambisani nezinselelo zansuku zonke. I-iPhone yathi ithokozisa, ikhulisa umqondo wokuqhubeka nokuxhumana. Ngengxenye yayo enhle, umuntu wayengathola imiyalezo, izithombe, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezahlukene, konke okukhuluma ngale foni. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlola Izici Njengoba abantu bezama le foni, kweza nabantu abaninzi ababephikisa umbono wokuthi lokhu kuzoba umphumela omuhle empilweni yabo. Kodwa abanye babebona ukuthi le foni inikela ngezinto ezinhle — ukusakaza izithombe, ukuhambisa imiyalezo, nokuxhumanisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezikude. Kukhona owabevele esebenzisa i-iPhone yakhe njengephephandaba, abanye bebukele amafilimu, kanti abanye besebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze bazithuthukise. Isahluko 4: Uhlanga Lwenkululeko Ngonyaka wesibili, i-iPhone yathola izinguquko ezinkulu. Kwavela amafoni anemibala ehlukene, izinqubo ezithuthukisiwe, nezinhlobonhlobo zezici ezazenza kube lula kubantu. Kwaba nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezazizama ukuhlola umhlaba, ukusiza abantu ukuba babe nolwazi olukhululekile. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokusebenzisa le foni, baqala ukuthola ukuthi i-iPhone ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yabo, yaze yabavumela ukuba bahlale bexhumene nezinye izwe. Isahluko 5: Imiphumela Emihle Eminyakeni eyalandela, i-iPhone yahlanganisa abantu emhlabeni wonke. Ngaphakathi kwamashumi eminyaka, kwasungulwa amaqembu oxhumana nabo, izinkampani ezisebenzisa i-iPhone ukwenza umsebenzi wazo, nezinhlelo ezahlukene ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu. Kwavela umqondo ophusile wokuthi abantu bangenza izinto ezinkulu uma bexhumene, futhi i-iPhone yayingumgogodla walokho. Isahluko 6: Izinkinga Nezinselelo Nokho, njengoba konke kusebenza kahle, kwavela nezinselelo. Abanye abantu baqala ukujwayela ukusebenzisa i-iPhone ukuba kube yinto ebonakalayo, okwadala izinkinga zokuxhumana. Ukuphila kwaba sesimeni sokukhathazeka, abantu bephuma endleleni ngenxa yokugxila kakhulu kumafoni. Lokhu kwaveza imiphumela engafanele, futhi kwaba nesidingo sokubiza abantu ukuthi baphinde bacabangele umqondo wokubambisana. Isahluko 7: Ukubhekisela Esikhathini Esizayo Njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka, i-iPhone yahamba ngaphesheya kokulindelwe. Izinqumo eziningi zenzeka, kodwa i-iPhone iyahlala ibalulekile. Ubuza abantu abaningi, "Ucabanga ukuthi i-iPhone izokwenza ini esikhathini esizayo?" Impendulo ibonisa ukuthi abantu bakholwa ukuthi i-iPhone izoba nezici ezintsha ezizoshintsha impilo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, kanti ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Isahluko 8: Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-iPhone ithole izimfanelo eziningi, kodwa okwakubaluleke kakhulu wukuthi yenza abantu baxhumane. Yashintsha indlela yokuphila, futhi izothinta izizukulwane ezizayo. Yize izinselelo zikhona, abantu bahlala bejabule ngalokho i-iPhone abakutholile. Le foni ayisiyona nje into yokuxhumana, kodwa iyinsika yokuphila, ithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kwenza i-iPhone ibe yisimanga esibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ngalesi sikhathi, sinethemba lokuthi i-iPhone izoqhubeka nokukhula, ithuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi igcine ibalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Ngakho-ke, silindele ukuthola okuthile okusha, okwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho i-iPhone izoba khona, isiza abantu baphile impilo engcono.

Ukwakhiwa kweSikhungo seZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kanye neBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi; kulungiselelwe ukuphathwa kwezikhumulo ezithile nguMnyango wezikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke; kanye nezinye izinto ezihlobene. Isikebhe sisho noma iyiphi isakhiwo esiwela emanzini, kuhlanganise nezindiza. Ukuze kube lula ukudluliswa kwamakhono nokwazi, ulwazi, nokuphathwa ngokubambisana nomkhakha ozimele ongaphansi kokulawulwa kuk governo. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa nguNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi, kuzokwakhiwa inkampani yeSikhungo seZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ezoba nefa, imele, futhi iphathise izikhumulo egameni leHhovisi. Le Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke izophathwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA). UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokwakha nokubhalisa iBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke njengenkampani yomphakathi engathengisa amasheya noma izitokwe futhi ikhiphe isitifiketi sokubhaliswa futhi ilandele lokho okukhuluma nguMthetho Wamakampani. UHhovisi uzoba yilona kuphela ilungu nomnikazi kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke. Amalungelo eHhovisi ukuba ube ilungu onezabelo kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke azophathwa nguNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi. Uma kutholakala ukuthi lezi zimpapasho zokubhaliswa azihambisani nalokho okukhuluma ngomthetho, lowo mthetho uzothathwa njengowokuqala noma uzosetshenziswa; futhi lokho okukhuluma ngalezi zimpapasho zokubhaliswa kuzoba namandla kuphela uma lo mthetho ushintshwa ukuze ususe lokho okuphikisanayo. UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi, ngokusekelwe eziphakamisweni ezenziwe yiBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke, angacela uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuba akhombise ukuthi ezinye izinhlinzeko noma izingxenye zeMthetho Wamakampani azisebenziseki kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke. UMsizi Wamakampani kufanele akhombise leyo mininingwane mayelana nokusebenza kwayo nokwesekwa kwayo ngokuhambisana nalesi sahluko, ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi. Kuleso saziso, uMsizi Wamakampani kufanele abize abantu ukuba bathumele iziphikiso zabo neziphakamiso kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kuleso saziso ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esichaziwe kuleso saziso. Ngemuva kokucabanga ngalezi ziphikiso neziphakamiso uma kukhona ezitholakala ngokuhambisana nesahluko 2, uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni, ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi, angakhombisa le ngxenye yezenhloso ezithile noma zonke izinhlinzeko noma lezi zingxenye ezithintekayo nguMthetho Wamakampani, azisebenziseki kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kusukela ngosuku oluchaziwe kuleso saziso. Lokhu ngeke kunciphise noma kwehlise amandla eBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ukuveza njengobuholi bomphakathi noma kwehlise ukuvuleka kokusebenza nokusetshenziswa; futhi ngeke kuphule amalungelo, inzuzo, noma izicelo zalabo abathola imali yiBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke noma abasebenzi noma ilungelo lokuzuza komunye umuntu. Unyaka wezimali weBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke uzohamba kusukela kuMfumfu 1 kuya kuNdasa 31 wonyaka olandelayo, kokubili ezinsukwini zifakiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma nganoma yimuphi umthetho, iBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ngeke ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu ophakanyiswe yinkantolo noma ngaphansi kohlelo lokuphuma kwezimali olwehluleka ukukhokha izikweletu, ngaphandle uma kuvunyelwe ngemicimbi ethile ethile eyenzelwe le njongo. Zonke izikhumulo ngaphansi kweBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke yeTransnet ngaphambi kokuqala kwalomthetho zizobuyiselwa kuBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kusukela ngosuku oluchaziwe ngokuhambisana nesahluko 27. Ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi, uNgqongqoshe uzokhombisa ukuthi yiziphi ezinye izikhumulo ezizongena ngaphansi kweBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ngaphandle kwalabo okukhulunywa ngabo esahluko 1. UNgqongqoshe angaphinde abuyekeze, ashintshe noma enze ngaphezulu kwemikhawulo yezikhumulo futhi kufanele axhumane nezindawo ezihambelana nalokhu uma leyo mikhawulo, ukushintsha noma ukwandisa kuzothinta imikhawulo yezindawo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle, ukwethembeka, kanye nezindleko zabelungu abaneziqinisekiso, ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zomhlaba ezamukelekayo nezidingo zomphakathi. IBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kufanele yenze konke okudingekayo ukuze iphathise izikhumulo kahle nangempumelelo, ihlele futhi ithuthukise izikhumulo. Ukuze ilungiselele ukwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi ukuze kuncishiswe ukuphindaphinda kwalezi zisebenzi nezinqubo mayelana nokwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi. UNgqongqoshe kufanele azise umphakathi ngalesi sithangami sokubonisana esikhuluma ngaso esahluko 2, ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi. Ibhodi izoba nelungu elingaphansi kwezingu-7 futhi lingaphezu kwezingu-13, ezizokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi. UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi kufanele aqoke ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe nguMongameli weBhodi. IBhodi kufanele ikhethe uMongameli Osenhliziyweni phakathi kwamalungu ayo. Amalungu eBhodi akufanele amezele izithakazelo zeqembu elithile, kodwa kufanele aphakamise ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhumulo ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke abasebenzisi bezikhumulo. UNgqongqoshe kufanele akhiphe isaziso ngokwenza isimemezelo kwiGazethi yoMphakathi nangemidiya ngenzondo yakhe yokukhetha lowo muntu futhi abize umphakathi ukuba uthumele imibono yabo noma aphikise ukukhethwa kwalowo muntu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esichaziwe kuleso saziso; futhi abheke eziphakamisweni noma iziphikiso ezitholwe ngenxa yaleso saziso. UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi angakhetha amalungu okuqala eBhodi ngaphambi kokuba iBhodi ibhaliswe. Lezi zikhundla zizothatha umphumela ngosuku lokubhaliswa. IBhodi izomele iBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kuzo zonke izenzo ezizokwenziwa yiBhodi ngaphansi kwalomthetho futhi ezizovunyelwa zizobhekwa njengokwenziwa yiBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukuqashwa kwezinye izisebenzi ezisemthethweni zeBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke; futhi kulandele umgomo weHhovisi mayelana nezohwebo zezikhumulo kazwelonke. Nothile okukhuluma ngalesi sahluko 1 ngeke kuvinjeze iBhodi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yayo efanele kahle ukuphatha, ukuhlela, ukwenza nokulawula izikhumulo futhi lokho akuphikisi umthetho. IBhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo, umhlaba ophethwe yiBhodi awudayiswa. Umuntu
Umthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa, ukuvikela, nokuphatha izinsiza zomlando ezibonakalayo nezingenakubonwa ePhikweni leKwaZulu-Natal; ukusungulwa kweBhodi esemthethweni yokuphatha ukuvikelwa komlando ephikweni; ukunquma izinhloso, amandla, nemisebenzi yeBhodi; ukunquma ukuthi iBhodi izophathwa, ibuswe, futhi ixhaswe kanjani; ukusungulwa kwamakhomidi omlando ezingeni lendawo, isifunda, idolobha, kanye nephikweni ukusiza iBhodi ekuqinisekiseni ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuphathweni nasekuvikeleni komlando ephikweni; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngeminye imibandela ephathelene. Kulo mthetho, noma iyiphi igama noma ibinzana elinikezwe incazelo kuMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ibhodi yendabuko esunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 6 soMthetho Wokuhola Nokuqondisa Kwendabuko, 2005 (Umthetho No. 5 ka-2005) ibhekisela kumasipala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 155 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, futhi esunguliwe ngezizathu 11 no-12 kanye ngaphansi kwezizathu 11 no-12 zoMthetho Wokwakha Kwamamasipala, 1998 (Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998), kufundwa nezizathu 3, 4, no-5 zoMthetho Wezinhlelo Zamasipala, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000); "umfundaze wombuso wesifunda" ubonisa umfundaze osunguliwe kuPhikweni leKwaZulu-Natal ngesigaba 226 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996; "ibhange lesifunda" libonisa ibhange lesifunda elisunguliwe kuPhikweni leKwaZulu-Natal ngaphansi kwesigaba 17 soMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999); "imisebenzi yomphakathi" ibhekisela emisebenzini yomphakathi njengoba ichazwe esigabeni 8 soMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, 1994 (Isikhangiso No. 103 sika-1994); "umphakathi wendabuko" ubonisa umphakathi wendabuko oqashelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 2 soMthetho Wokuhola Nokuqondisa Kwendabuko, 2005 (Umthetho No. 5 ka-2005). (2)(1) Izinqumo zalo mthetho zisebenza ezindabeni zomlando, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zomlando ezibonakalayo nezingenakubonwa ephikweni. Uma lo mthetho ungawulawuli udaba oluhambelana nokuvikela noma ukuphatha umhlaba ephikweni, izinqumo zoMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), kanye noMthetho weBhodi Yezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999), zizosebenza ephikweni futhi noma iyiphi isho "kuhulumeni wombuso wesifunda" kuMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999, kufanele, ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okunye, kubhekwane njengokubhekisela kwiBhodi. UmMember weBhodi yePhakathi kanye neBhodi kufanele kusekele izimiso ezijwayelekile ezikhuluma esigabeni 1 seSahluko 1 soMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ezisebenza ezinyathelweni zohulumeni wesifunda kanye nohulumeni bendawo mayelana nokuphathwa komlando ephikweni. Indima yeMember yeBhodi yePhakathi ephathelene nomlando (4)(1) Mayelana nendima yoHulumeni Kazwelonke emlandweni, iMember yeBhodi yePhakathi kufanele, ukuze ikhuthaze umoya wokubambisana okukhuluma esigabeni 3 soMthethosisekelo, ikhulise ukuphathwa komlando nezinsiza ephikweni ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo zikaHulumeni Kazwelonke nezinhlelo ezihambelana nomlando nezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwamandla anikezwe kuMember yeBhodi yePhakathi ngalolu mthetho, iMember yeBhodi yePhakathi kufanele, ngemva kokuxoxisana neBhodi, futhi ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zomlando kazwelonke, ichaze izinqubomgomo zomlando nezinhlelo zephikweni. Ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yomlando yeKwaZulu-Natal (5)(1) IBhodi ezobizwa ngokuthi iBhodi Yomlando yeKwaZulu-Natal isunguliwe. IBhodi iyisikhungo esisemthethweni. IBhodi iphethwe nguMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999). Izinsiza zomlando ezibonakalayo nezingenakubonwa ephikweni, futhi, ngokujwayelekile, ngokuhambisana nomthetho womlando kazwelonke nowesifunda, ukukhuthaza nokuhlela ukuvikelwa komlando ukuze kuzuze izizukulwane zamanje nezizayo. Amandla, imisebenzi, nemisebenzi yeBhodi (7) ingenza noma iyiphi enye umsebenzi noma igcine noma iyiphi umsebenzi onikezwe kwiBhodi nganoma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Ngokujwayelekile, ingenza zonke izinto ezidingekayo noma ezilungile ukuze ifinyelele izinhloso zayo ezikhuluma esigabeni 6 futhi yenze imisebenzi ekhulumayo esigabeni (1). (3)(a) IBhodi, ngenhloso yoMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), iyisikhungo somlando wesifunda seKwaZulu-Natal futhi noma iyiphi isho "kuhulumeni wombuso wesifunda" kuMthetho kufanele, ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okunye, kubhekwane njengokubhekisela kwiBhodi. IBhodi kufanele, ngaphezu kwamandla, imisebenzi, nemisebenzi ekhulumayo esigabeni (1) no(2), yenze imisebenzi enikezwe esikhungweni somlando wesifunda ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999. Ukwakhiwa kweBhodi (8) kufanele ikhethe omunye wezithunywa zayo njengomholi noma njengomholi weBhodi ozophatha imihlangano yeBhodi futhi enze eminye imisebenzi ephathelene. Kufanele imele zonke izigaba ezihlobene futhi ifake abantu abavela ephikweni ngezizinda ezahlukene nezamasiko ahlukahlukene. Amalungu akhuluma esigabeni (1) kufanele abe abantu abafanele abangazimele, abangakhethiwe, futhi abafanelekile. Ukwehluleka ukuveza inzuzo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 11 noma ukubamba iqhaza noma ukuba yingxenye yezinkulumo zeBhodi ngenkathi uthola inzuzo njengoba kuchazwe kulolu sigaba. bangavakashela imihlangano yeBhodi futhi babambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni, kodwa abanalo ilungelo lokuvota lapho kuthathwa izinqumo kwiBhodi. Lolu sigaba luphansi kwezinhlinzeko zokudlulela ezikhuluma esigabeni 66. (9)(1) Ilunga leBhodi lingabamba isikhundla isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu, futhi lingabuyiselwa. Akekho ilunga ongabekwa ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezimbili ezilandelanayo. Lolu sigaba luphansi kwezinhlinzeko zokudlulela ezikhuluma esigabeni 66. Amanzi Ahlanzekile Kwakukhanya ilanga, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, futhi umoya wawuhamba kancane. Emzaneni omncane, uMfula uNhlanga wawuhamba ngokuthula, uthela amanzi akhe ahlanzekile. Abantu bendawo babewathokozela kakhulu, ngoba amanzi ayewasiza ekuphileni kwabo. UThandi, intombazane encane, wayejabule kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi, ngoba wayeziqhenya ngamanzi ahlanzekile akhukhulayo. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wahamba noMkhulu wakhe, uMnumzane Ndlovu, waya emfuleni. UThandi wayefuna ukubona ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awavela kanjani. UMnumzane Ndlovu, onolwazi oluningi, waqala ukuchaza. "Amanzi ahlanzekile, Thandi, avela ezintabeni. Zikhona izintaba eziphakeme ezithokozisa umoya, futhi lapho imvula ihlaba, amanzi ahlanzekile ayehla phansi, efika emifuleni yethu." UThandi wayemamatheka, ethokozisa uMkhulu wakhe. "Ngabe amanzi ahlanzekile angasiza kanjani abantu, Mkhulu?" ubuza. UMnumzane Ndlovu waphendula, "Amanzi ahlanzekile asiza ekuphileni. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphile, ukuze balime, futhi ukuze bathokozise imindeni yabo." Ngemuva kokuchaza, uMnumzane Ndlovu wathola ithuba lokufundisa uThandi ngendlela yokugcina amanzi ahlanzekile. "Kubalulekile, Thandi, ukuthi sigcine imvelo yethu ihlanzekile. Uma sishiya udoti emfuleni, amanzi azoba namagciwane, futhi lokho kuzokwenza abantu bahlupheke." UThandi wathola ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile, futhi wathi, "Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngigcine amanzi ahlanzekile." Ngemuva kokuhamba emfuleni, uThandi wanquma ukuhlela umcimbi wokuhlanza umfula. Waqala ukuhlela nabangani bakhe, wathi, "Sizohlanza umfula wethu, sizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono." Abangani bakhe bamamukela, bejabule ngokuhlanganyela. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, bahlangana emfuleni, behamba neziphuzo, izikhwama, nezinsiza zokuhlanza. UThandi wakhuthaza wonke umuntu, "Masihlanze umfula, ukuze amanzi ahlanzekile aqhubeke ehamba." Bonke bahlanganyela, bejabule, behlanza udoti, bephinde bejabulisa umfula. UThandi wayebona ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayebalulekile, futhi abantu badinga ukuhamba ndawonye ukuze bagcine imvelo yabo. Ngemuva kokuhlanza, umfula wawubukeka kahle, amanzi akhanya njengegolide. UThandi noMkhulu wakhe babebuka umfula, bejabulile. "Ngiyabonga, Mkhulu, ngokungifundisa. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngigcine amanzi ahlanzekile." UMnumzane Ndlovu wamamatheka, "Ngiyazi, Thandi. Uthando lwakho lwezinto ezinhle luzokwenza umehluko." Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awaveli kuphela emfuleni, kodwa adinga ukunakekelwa. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza umphakathi wakhe, ebakhumbuza ukuthi bahlale behlanza, baphinde baphinde bahloniphe imvelo. Umfula uNhlanga waba yisibonelo sokubambisana, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngemva kwesikhathi, umfula waba yindawo yokudlela, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behamba ngezinyawo, bejabule. UThandi waba yintokazi edumile emzaneni, futhi abantu bamthanda kakhulu. Waqhubeka nokufundisa abanye, wathi, "Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisibusiso. Masigcine, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono." Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle emvelweni. Uthando lwakhe lwezinto ezinhle lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi umfula uNhlanga waba yindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlala behlanzekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umfula waba yindawo yokuhlala, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisibusiso esikhulu. UThandi noMkhulu wakhe bahlala bejabulile, behlola umfula, bejabulisa amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi umphakathi waba yindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlanzekile. Ngakho-ke, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awaveli kuphela emfuleni, kodwa adinga ukunakekelwa. Uthando lwakhe lwezinto ezinhle lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi umfula uNhlanga waba yindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlanzekile. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle emvelweni, futhi umfula waba yindawo yokuhlala, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlanzekile.
iCheckers: Ukubaluleka Nokuthokozisa Umphakathi Ngokubuka kwami, iCheckers iyisizinda esiyisisekelo empilweni yomphakathi wethu. Lezi zindawo zokuthenga zihlala zikhangayo, zinikeza imikhiqizo ehlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Zivame ukuba yindawo yokuhlangana, lapho umphakathi uthola ukudla, izimpahla zansuku zonke, futhi ubonisana nabanye. Ijolise ekwenzeni impilo ibe lula, ikakhulukazi emakhaya, lapho umndeni uthola khona ukudla kwansuku zonke. Ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu emadolobheni, iCheckers ibonakala njengezikhala ezibalulekile ezinikeza izixazululo ezisheshayo nezilula. Uma uhamba edolobheni, uzobona abantu behamba ngezinyawo, bephatha izimpahla zabo ezinkulu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uyayithanda le ndawo futhi uthokozisa ukuthola izinto ezihamba phambili. Ngokuqhubekayo, iCheckers ibonisa indlela yokuphila enezinga eliphezulu, njengoba uhlelo lokuphatha izimpahla lwenziwe lula, abantu bengathola konke abakudingayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho ukufinyelela ezitolo ezinkulu kunzima. iCheckers ithuthukisa indlela yokuphila, ikhulisa umnotho, futhi inika abantu ithuba lokwazi izinto ezintsha, kanti futhi ifaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Iziphakamiso ezitholakala ezitolo zihlala zikhuthaza abantu ukuba basize omakhelwane babo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abadinga usizo. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, ngethemba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. ICheckers ithokozisa izingane nabantu abadala, kuba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokufunda, nokuxhumana. Nokho, njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zindawo, akukhona konke okukhanya. Ukuze iCheckers iqhubeke nokuphumelela, kudingeka ibhekane nezinkinga ezithinta izindleko zokuphila. Abantu abaningi basabhekene nezinkinga zezimali, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phezulu kwezindleko zokudla. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iCheckers ibheke izindlela zokwenza izinto zibe lula, njengezaphulelo ezikhethekile nezinhlinzeko ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi, njengoba iCheckers ibonisa umphakathi, ibuye ibe yindawo yokuphila kwabanye. Ukuze iqhubeke nokukhula, iCheckers kumele ibheke umoya wokugcina imvelo. Ukuphepha kwezimali, ukunciphisa ukusebenzisa izinto ezilimazayo, nokwakha izinhlelo ezintsha zokuphila, kuyadingeka ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iCheckers kufanele ibheke ukuthi ingakha kanjani ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabathengi nezitolo, ukugqugquzela ubuhlakani obusha, nokukhuthaza imicimbi eyahlukene, kungasiza iCheckers ukuba ibe yindawo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela umoya wokubambisana, futhi kube yindlela yokuthuthukisa umnotho. Ekugcineni, iCheckers ayisiyona nje indawo yokuthenga, kodwa iyindawo yokwakha umphakathi. Noma ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo, izidingo, noma imizwa, iCheckers ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Idinga ukwesekwa ukuze iqhubeke nokuba yinsika emnothweni nasezimpilweni zabantu. Ngakho, kumqoka ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokubambisana, siphekelele, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi iCheckers iqhubeka nokuba yindawo ethokozisayo, efundisayo, nenobuntu, ukuze kuhlangane wonke umuntu, futhi sikhulise umphakathi wethu.
Ukuze usebenzise kahle amasu akho esikhathini esizayo futhi ufeze imigomo yebhizinisi lakho, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa amasu akho kusenesikhathi. Imvula kaJuni 2011 ixoxe ngamasu okuphatha ibhizinisi. Sathi kungcono ukuba necebo eliphakathi kunokungabi necebo elijwayelekile, futhi sathi lokhu kuyisibopho esibalulekile sokuphatha ibhizinisi. Umsebenzi wesibili wokuphatha ibhizinisi esizowukhuluma ngawo ukuhlanganisa kahle amasu akho okusebenza. Uma uhambisa amasu, kusho ukuthi kudingeka ulungiselele ukusebenzisa amasu akho lapho wenza imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo. Nokho, kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi lapho sisebenza ekwakheni amasu nasekuhlanganiseni amasu, kwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. Ukuhlanganiswa kusho ukukhetha ukuthi ubani ozokwenza umsebenzi muni, ngesikhathi esithile, kuphi ngempela, nokuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezidingekayo ezifana nezinsiza, amathuluzi, izikhungo, nezimali ukuze ukwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile kumkhiqizi ukuthi azi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezinsiza anazo - kokubili ezimali nakwabanye abasebenzi. Kumele bazi amakhono, imfundo, ukuqeqeshwa, namakhono (amandla okwenza/ukusebenza, ikhono lokusebenza kwemishini, amandla enhliziyo) abasebenzi babo. Abasebenzi kumele basebenze lapho benolwazi lokwenza lowo msebenzi, futhi lokhu kungabasiza ukwenza umsebenzi abawuthokozelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlela ukuthutha, izinsiza, nezimali zokuqala zokutshala endaweni efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze ukwazi ukuhlanganisa amasu, kudingeka ubheke zonke izabelo ezikhona ngaphakathi kwalezi zamasu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo zokusebenzisa lezi zamasu ngesikhathi esifanele. Lapho sikhuluma ngokuhlanganisa amasu, singasebenzisa amasu okwakha nokuhlanganisa njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni 1. Lokhu kulandela isibonelo esisetshenziswe ngoJuni 2011. Hlola insimu 5. 3 - 10 hectares. Abasebenzi ababili (umsebenzi ophathekayo). Amathrekhtha amabili namathreila amabili. Hlola ukudla kwezinkomo nokuthi yini edliwayo. Susa esiswini, bhalela, phatha imishanguzo, ufinyelele izinga lokuphila leziqhamuka ezingu-100. Moloto, Abram, Kagiso, noHendrik. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Izinsiza zokuphatha izinkomo, izinsiza zokushisa (zokubhalela), amathuluzi okuphakela, izincwadi zokurekhoda. Yakha indlu 3 (susa izinto zokulala ezindala). Imisebenzi ejwayelekile yansuku zonke. Izindlu 1 no-2. Johanna, Minah, noJohannes. Sarah, Monica, noDawid. Ukuqoqwa kwezinto, amabhakede, namathreila. Amathuluzi akhe, njll. Sikholelwa ukuthi bonke abantu abasebenza kulesi sibonelo esiphakeme banolwazi futhi bakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi. Sikholelwa futhi ukuthi zonke ezinye izinsiza zikhona futhi zilungele ukusebenza. Uma lokhu kungenjalo, zonke amasu akho kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwamasu kuzodingeka kubekwe eceleni ngoba labo basebenzi kudingeka baqeqeshwe kuqala, futhi izinsiza kudingeka zibe khona futhi zilungiswe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umsebenzi ofana nokutshala noma ukufaka imishanguzo ezinkomeni. Lokhu kuyisibonelo nje sezindlela ezingasetshenziswa ukuhlanganisa amasu; konke kungashintsha ukuze kuhambisane nohlobo lokulima lwemfuyi kanye nezidingo zomfuyi othile. Sihlangabezane kaningi nokuthi kubalulekile ukubhala phansi lapho kwakhiwa amasu nokuhlanganiswa kwamasu emsebenzini onjengalona. Njengokwakha amasu, ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zamasu kungabhalwa encwadini, ebhodini, kukhompyutha, noma kwenye indawo. Njengokwakha amasu, ngaphakathi kokuhlanganiswa kwalezi zamasu, umfuyi kufanele azibophezele ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuphatha ibhizinisi efana nokuhamba phambili, ukubamba izintambo, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi, ukuthola ugqozi lokusebenzisa abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa. Usayizi webhizinisi uzokutshela ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani konke lokhu. Kufanele kube ngumfuyi oqala ngokuqhubeka, ozokwazisa abasebenzi ngalokho kuzohlanganiswa futhi athathe izinyathelo zokuhlanganisa umsebenzi othile (yikuphi ithrekhtha noma yimaphi imishini ezosetshenziswa nokuthi yibaphi abasebenzi abazosebenza). Kumele futhi baphathe umsebenzi ngokuqinile ekuhlanganiseni kwezinyathelo zebhizinisi. Kumele futhi bakwazi ukunikeza umsebenzi othile kumsebenzi othile uma kudingeka; abakwazi ukwenza wonke umsebenzi bodwa. Khumbula, uma ingxenye yemisebenzi yakho yokuphatha ingaqhubeki kahle okwamanje, ibhizinisi lakho lizokwenza inzuzo, kodwa ngemva kwesikhathi - mhlawumbe ngemva kweminyaka emi-5 noma emi-10 noma ngemva kwalokhu - ibhizinisi lakho lizoma, lizofa ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Ikusasa lethu libhekene nalolu shintsho (kufanele sibheke phambili kulokho esizokudla kusasa) - uma ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi lakho kungaqhubeki nokukhula unyaka nonyaka - ekugcineni ibhizinisi lizoma ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Asikwazi ukuqhubeka sisebenza ngendlela efanayo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka uthuthukisa umsebenzi ngokwandisa imali engenayo nokunciphisa nokuphatha izindleko. Ukuhlanganiswa kahle kwamasu kuzokusiza ufeze impumelelo ngendlela esichaze ngayo ngenhla.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Ukuphikisa Izimo Nokufuna Amalungelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziteleka zabasebenzi zibe yindlela ebalulekile yokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezimweni zokusebenza. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula, izisebenzi ziyaqhubeka nokubhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, ezifana nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, imiholo enganele, kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezinzima. Lokhu kudala isidingo sokuthi abasebenzi baphakamise izwi labo, baphakamise izicelo zabo, futhi bahlasele izinkampani nezikhungo ukuze bathole amalungelo abo. Izizathu Zokuhola Iziteleka Iziteleka zenzeka ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene. Ezinye zezizathu ezivame kakhulu zifaka phakathi ukunganeliseki kwemiholo, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezingeziwe, noma izinguquko ezithinta izinqubomgomo eziphathelene nezisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuphumelela, izisebenzi zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zikhokhelwa kahle, futhi zihlomula ngezinzuzo ezikhulayo, ukuze zikwazi ukuphila impilo enokuthula. Isibonelo, eminyakeni edlule, iziteleka ezinkulu zashaya umoya emkhakheni wezokwakha, lapho abasebenzi bephikisa izimo zokusebenzisa imishini engasebenzi kahle, kanye nezinsiza zokuphepha ezinganele. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izinkampani ziqhubeke nokucabanga ngamasu athile okwenza izimo zibe ngcono, kodwa akukaze kube nokushintsha okukhulu ngaphandle kokuthi abasebenzi baphakamise izwi labo. Umthelela Weziteleka Ezomnotho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zinezinhlobonhlobo zomthelela emnothweni. Ngokwesibonelo, iziteleka ezingapheli zibangela ukungasebenzi kwezinkampani, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu emnothweni jikelele. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanikazi bezinkampani bahlupheke uma kwenzeka izinkampani zihlala zivalekile isikhathi eside. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iziteleka eziphumelelayo zingaholela ekutheni izinkampani zibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithinta abasebenzi, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imisebenzi. Izinkampani eziphumelelayo ngokuvamile ziba nezinhloso zokubambisana nezisebenzi, futhi lokhu kuvame ukuholela ezinkampanini ezizimele ngokwazo. Ubulungiswa emisebenzini, ezokuphepha, kanye nezinzuzo ezithile, konke lokhu kuthathwa njengemiphumela ethile yeziteleka eziphumelelayo. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Iziqu Zabasebenzi Ukukhula kweziteleka zabasebenzi kuphakamisa izidingo zokubambisana phakathi kwenhlangano yezisebenzi kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi kube khona ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvulwa kwemihlangano phakathi kwezisebenzi, abaphathi, nezikhungo zomphakathi. Izinhlangano zabasebenzi zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nezinkampani ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izimfuno zabo ziyaqondwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani kufanele ziqonde ukuthi imiphumela yeziteleka ingaholela ekutheni kube noshintsho olukhulu ezinqubweni zazo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba izinkampani ezithola ukuthula nokuziqhenya ngemisebenzi yazo ziba nezinga eliphakeme lokukhula. Isiphetho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zihlala zibalulekile emhlabeni wonke, njengoba zikhombisa ukuzimisela kwabasebenzi ekufuneni amalungelo nezimo zokusebenza eziphusile. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokusekela labo abaphikisa, besebenzisa lezi ziteleka njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ongcono, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila impilo enokuthula nempumelelo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abambisane, ukuze izizathu zokuhola iziteleka zithole ukwesekwa okuhle, futhi umphakathi uphumelele.
Izinsolo zenkohlakalo ezikhuluma ngamakomidi omasipala zihlala ziba yinkinga enkulu emphakathini, zikhombisa ubuhlungu obukhulu obuhambisana nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi. Ukuze siqonde umthelela wezinsolo zenkohlakalo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kulungiswe lezi zinkinga. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde izinsolo ezivame ukuvela. Emasipala amaningi, izinsolo zenkohlakalo zifaka ukungathembeki emalini, ukufaka izinkampani ezingekho emthethweni ezinkonzweni zomphakathi, kanye nokuphathwa kabi kwemithombo yomphakathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokungabikhona kokuhlola okwakha ukungathembeki phakathi kwabaphathi bezinsiza zomphakathi. Uma umphakathi ungakuboni ukuthi imali yawo isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, lokho kudala ukungabaza nokungathembeki. Okwesibili, imiphumela yezinsolo zenkohlakalo ibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu baphule umthetho, baphule imithetho yokuphatha, futhi kube nomthelela omubi ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukungathembeki kuholela ekunciphiseni kwenhlalakahle yomphakathi, njengoba izinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezokuthutha zingatholakali kalula. Lokhu kudala ukungabi nankinga emphakathini, okuholela ekwandeni kweziphithiphithi, ukungaboni ngaso linye, kanye nokuphakama kwezinga lokuphila eliphansi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsolo zenkohlakalo zenza kube nzima ukufaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uma abantu benokungabaza ngezinhlelo ezithile, bazokwenza kube nzima ukuhlela nokuphumelelisa izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuthuthukiswa komnotho, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo azikaze zibe yisixazululo. Kunezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinsolo. Uhulumeni kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi kufanele zisebenzise izinhlelo zokuhlola eziphumelelayo, ziqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yokuphatha iyahlolwa njalo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ukwethembeka phakathi kwabantu, futhi kubenze bakhuthazeke ekutheni baphathe izinsiza zomphakathi ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele ubambe iqhaza ekulawuleni izinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi eqinile, enezinhlelo zokubika izinsolo zenkohlakalo, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela izinsolo zenkohlakalo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazithola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinsolo zenkohlakalo zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Uhulumeni, izinkampani zomphakathi, kanye nomphakathi kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi abantu baziqhenya ngemiphakathi yabo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukugxila ezinsolweni zenkohlakalo komasipala. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukulwa nokungathembeki, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, ohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umphakathi onempilo ubonisa ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa kahle, nokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Ngakho, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuphatha kahle izinsiza zomphakathi, ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu sonke.
Okukhuluma lapha akuhloselwe ukuba kube umhlahlandlela ophelele ngama-wills kanye nezifundo. I-will iyidokhumenti ekhethekile esiyincomayo ukuthi ibhalwe ngumuntu onolwazi njengommeli, inkampani esunguliwe yokuphatha izindlu, noma abanye. Le mininingwane ihloselwe ukwazisa umfundi ngezinto ezisemqoka ze-will. Bonke abantu abaneziminyaka ezingu-16 noma ngaphezulu, ngaphandle kokuthi ngaleso sikhathi sokwenza i-will babe nesimo sokungakwazi, bangakha i-will. (Umuntu owenza i-will ubizwa ngokuthi u-testator uma engumfana noma u-testatrix uma engumfazi). Bonke abantu abaneziminyaka ezingu-14 noma ngaphezulu, abaqapheli i-will, kumele bakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo. Kusukela ngomhla ziyi-1 kuJanuwari 1954, i-will kumele ibe ebhalwe phansi. Ingabhalwa ngesandla, ibhalwe ngekhompyutha, noma ikhiqizwe ngekhompyutha. U-testator kumele asayine i-will ekugcineni noma ekupheleni kwayo. Uma i-will inamakhasi amaningi, u-testator kumele asayine ikhasi ngalinye ngaphandle kwekhasi lokugcina (Noma u-testator kumele asayine wonke amakhasi abaqapheli, kumele futhi basayine ikhasi lokugcina bese besayina ekupheleni kwedokhumenti). Umphakathi wenkantolo kumele aqinisekise ukuthi uyaneliseka ngubani u-testator futhi ukuthi i-will isayinwe ngu-testator wabo. Umphakathi wenkantolo kumele asayine isitifiketi nakuwo wonke amakhasi e-will. Umphakathi wenkantolo kumele abe khona lapho i-will isayinwa futhi kumele anexhume isitifiketi sakhe ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi i-will isayinwe noma ngabe u-testator ufela masinyane ngemva kokusayina. I-addendum noma ukuxhumana ne-will esivele ikhona, eyenzelwe ukwengeza noma ukulungisa i-will, kumele ihambisane nazo zonke izidingo ze-will. I-addendum ayidingi ukusayinwa ngababukeli ababesayine i-will yokuqala. Izinguquko kwi-will zingaqhutshelwa ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwayo noma ngemuva kokuyenza. Izinguquko kwi-will kumele zihambisane nezidingo zokwenza i-will futhi uma ungakwazi ukusayina, kumele futhi zihambisane nezidingo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolo hlobo. Ngesikhathi sokulungisa i-will, akudingeki ukuthi abaqapheli abasayine i-will yakho yokuqala basayine izinguquko. Isipho noma umnikelo owenziwe kumkakho kwi-will yakho, owenziwe ngaphambi kokuphulwa komshado, sizophumelela njengesipho noma umnikelo ngisho nangemva kokuhlukana. Umthetho ophathelene nama-wills uthi ngaphandle kokuthi uchaze okunye ngokubhala, isipho esinikezwe kumkakho owahlukana naye sizobhekwa njengokukhanselwa uma ufela ezinyangeni ezintathu kusukela ngosuku lokuhlukana. Le mfuneko yomthetho inika umuntu ohlukanisile izinyanga ezintathu zokulungisa i-will yakhe ngemuva kokuhlukana. Nokho, uma ungakwenza lokhu, umkakho ohlukanisile uzothola leso sipho njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-will. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obhala i-will noma ingxenye yayo ubhala ngegama lika-testator. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obona i-will uyenze lokho egameni lika-testator noma njengomqapheli. Xhumana nommeli wakho ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi.
Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho No. weZakhiwo Zasemaphandleni, 1998 (Umthetho No. 117 we-1998) lapha uveza imithetho ehambisanayo yasezindaweni ngokuhambisana nesigaba 13(a) sikaHulumeni Wasekhaya; Umthetho Wezakhiwo Zasemaphandleni, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 we-2000) owawusungulwa ngosuku lokushicilelwa kwawo kwiGazethi Yezifundazwe.
