Ngenxa kokuhlinzekwa kwesigaba (b) lapha, akukho mithetho yasezindaweni ezosetshenziswa ukuze kuhlukaniswe abantu ngokobuhlanga, inkolo, ubulili, noma ukuze kuqinisekiswe leyo hlobo lokuhlukaniswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, njengoba kuhanjiswa esigabeni (a) lapha, ukuhlukaniswa ngokobulili kungase kuqinisekiswe nganoma yiziphi izinhlinzeko zalemithetho yasezindaweni ezichaza ubuciko obufanele ezindaweni zomphakathi noma baphumeze imikhawulo yokufinyelela ezindaweni zokuphumula zomphakathi, amathoyilethi, noma izindawo zokushintsha noma baphumeze izimo ezithile ezihlukile kulezo zindawo. Ngokwezimiso zalemithetho yasezindaweni, noma yimuphi umusho ochazwe kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe kanye Nezinhlinzeko Zokuhamba Kwamazwe njengoba kuchazwe lapha uzoba nalolo chazo kule mithetho yasezindaweni. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana ezichazweni, izichazamazwi ezihlinzekwa kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996) zizosebenza. "Umthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. Umthetho Wezakhwo Zasemaphandleni, 1998 Umthetho No. ithikithi noma ibhasi lingase lisebenze ithikithi ethile noma ibhasi. noma ibhasi kusho imoto ethutha umphakathi eyenzelwe kuphela noma ikakhulukazi ukuthutha abagibeli abangaphezu kuka-15 esetshenziswa ngokuhambisana nesheduli futhi evunyelwe ukusebenza ezindleleni zomphakathi ezikhishwe yiBhodi Yezokuhamba Kwamazwe endaweni ethile ephelele noma engaphelele ethintwa yiBhodi. Le mithetho yasezindaweni izosebenza kuzo zonke izikhala zamathikithi namabhasi nezikhala, ezibekwe eceleni noma ezizobekwa eceleni yiBhodi ukuze zisetshenziswe njengezikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi noma izikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi avunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ngephasiwedi yokusebenza ethunyelwe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho yasezindaweni. Izikhala zamathikithi namabhasi noma izikhala zizoba lezo ezisungulwe ohlelweni oluhlelwe ngokuqondile yiwo ophumelele lowo msebenzi njengoba kuguqulwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ukubekwa eceleni kwezikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi nezikhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ngama-taxi namabhasi kuphela kuzokwenziwa futhi kuboniswe ngokuqhakambisa, ngokudweba izimpawu, noma ukufaka kulezo zindawo (noma ngabe kuthiwa kusemgwaqweni womphakathi noma cha), njengoba kunqunywe yiBhodi, izimpawu zomgwaqo ezifanele zifakwe ngokuqondile ngezimiso ezenziwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho. Ibhodi ingachaza izindawo ezithile noma izindawo ezithile, kuzo zonke izikhala ngezizathu noma izizathu ezithile, njengokuthuthukisa noma ukunciphisa abagibeli, indawo yokuma, noma abathengisi abangekho ohlelweni olusemthethweni. Izikhala ezisungulwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 zizosebenza kuphela ngama-taxi noma amabhasi akhangisa ngephasiwedi yokusebenza esemthethweni yalezi zikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi (kuze kube yilapho le mikhawulo ingasebenzi kumathikithi noma amabhasi, kulokho okukhulwe noma okushintshaniswa futhi kuvunyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 14). Izikhala ezisungulwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 zizoba ezifana kuzo zonke izithuthi noma amabhasi asebenza kulowo mgwaqo noma abekwe kumphakathi othile, umphakathi, umgwaqo, noma indawo njengoba kuchazwe izimpawu zomgwaqo ezifakwe kulezo zikhala. Ibhodi, ngephasiwedi efakwe esikhala noma eduze kwayo ingabonisa isikhathi esiphezulu esivunyelwe kumathikithi namabhasi ukuhamba kulezi zikhala. Akukho thikithi noma ibhasi elizovunyelwa ukuhamba esikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi isikhathi eside kunesidingo sokulayisha abagibeli. Akukho thikithi noma ibhasi elizovunyelwa ukuhamba ngesikhathi sokusebenza, ngaphandle kokuba esikhala esinikeziwe noma esikhala. Umshayeli wethikithi noma ibhasi ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa isikhala noma isikhala ngaphansi kwale mithetho yasezindaweni ungumuntu kuphela ongakha noma avumele le moto ukuthi isebenzise lesi sikhala noma isikhala nganoma yisiphi isikhathi (kuze kube yilapho le mikhawulo ingasebenzi kumathikithi noma amabhasi, kulokho okukhulwe noma okushintshaniswa futhi kuvunyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 14). Uzoqhamuka leyo mthetho uma usebenza ithikithi noma ibhasi enikezwe iphasipoti yokusebenzisa isikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi ngaphansi kwale mithetho yasezindaweni, uma ukhona kunoma yisiphi isikhala noma isikhala ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulwe noma okukhulwe okukhethwe kuwe futhi kuchazwe kwi phasipoti yokusebenzisa isikhala esithile samathikithi noma amabhasi. Umshayeli wethikithi noma ibhasi uzoba yilo kuphela ozohlala eqhuba le moto ngenkathi ikulezi zikhala noma izikhala. Noma yisiphi ukulahleka noma umonakalo kunoma iyiphi moto, noma ingxenye yayo noma phakathi, eyayipakishwe noma ihlezi kunoma yisiphi isikhala noma eyayifaka, idlula, noma iphume kunoma yisiphi isikhala noma isikhala. Futhi ukufa, ukulimala, ukungasebenzi, noma ukulahleka (kuhlanganise nokulahleka okuzayo) kumuntu nganoma yisiphi isikhala noma isikhala. Ibhodi izoba nelungelo lokuvula noma ukuvala noma yisiphi isikhala esisunguliwe ngaphansi kwale mithetho futhi, uma kudingeka, inelungelo lokusungula esinye isikhala esiphuthumayo kwenye indawo esikhundleni salo. Ukuvalwa okuphuthumayo nokusungulwa kwenye indawo kuzothathwa njengokunjalo ngemuva kokufakwa kwezaziso lapho noma eduze kwalolo sikhala futhi futhi ngesikhathi sokuvulwa okuphuthumayo noma noma iyiphi iphasipoti yokusebenzisa isikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi eyakhishwa kulolo sikhala esivalwe izobhekwa njengemthethweni yokusebenzisa kulolo sikhala oluzoba esikhundleni sokunye. Akukho amalungelo omuntu onikezwe ukusebenzisa isikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi ngaphansi kwale mithetho azovimba ibhodi ekuthumeleni noma ekukhipheni noma yisiphi isikhala esisunguliwe lapha noma ngenkathi le mithetho iphumelelwe. Kuze kube yilapho uma kukhona isikhala
Ukwazisa ngezinguquko zobulungu be-GEMS Ubulungiswa kepha kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ku-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ezithinta bonke abathintekayo. Lezi zinguquko, ezaziswa kubasebenzi ngosizo lwemiyalezo ehlukene, zishiye abantu abaningi bezicabangela ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, izinguquko zobulungu be-GEMS ziqhutshwa ngebhizinisi lokunikeza imishwalense yezempilo, futhi zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abacela izinsizakalo bakhethwa ezifanele. Ekuqaleni, kumele siqonde ukuthi kungani lezi zinguquko zenzeka. Umnotho wezempilo uguquka njalo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abe nezinsizakalo zezempilo ezitholakala kalula kubasebenzi bakhe. Ukuze kube khona lokho, i-GEMS izame ukujwayela izidingo kanye nezimfuno zabasebenzi. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi inhlangano iphendule ngezindlela ezinjengokwandisa umkhawulo wezinsiza ezitholwayo, ukwandisa izinketho zobulungu, kanye nokunikeza izinsizakalo ezingeziwe eziwusizo. Kodwa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinguquko zingancintisana nezimo ezithize. Abanye abantu baveza ukukhathazeka ngalezi zinguquko, bethi kungaba nezinselelo eziningi uma imishwalense yokwelashwa ibhujiswa ngokungafanele. Lokhu kudala ukungabaza, njengoba abanye abasebenzi begcizelela ukuthi sezihamba kahle izimpilo zabo, kanti uma izinguquko ziqiniswa, kulindeleke ukuthi zifake umthwalo omkhulu kubasebenzi. Ngokucacile, izinguquko eziqokonyiswe yi-GEMS zifuna ukuphucula izinga lemisebenzi yemishwalense, kodwa kumele sikhumbule ukuthi lo mshini wezempilo uchaza ukuthandwa kokwelapha nokunakekelwa. Uma imishwalense ithinteka kakhulu ngezimali, lokhu kungadala ukuthi abangani bezempilo baphume engcupheni yokulala, okungenzeka kube nezinkinga ezikhulu ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona izinguquko ezinkulu, kubalulekile ukuba kukhuliswe udaba lokuthola ulwazi olunembile nokucatshangelwa kwabantu. Ngokunjalo, abanye baphokophele ukusebenza kahle nokulekelela umphakathi. Kwa-GEMS, izinguquko kumele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele, ukuze wonke umuntu azizwe eqondile futhi eqinisekisiwe. Izinguquko kufanele zibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu, hhayi ukulimaza. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukulayisha imithwalo emisha kubasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi bahloniphe izinqumo zohulumeni, babe nokuqonda, nokuqhubekela phambili ngokubambisana nabanye. Kodwa-ke, kumele sikhulume ngama-FAQs: abafundi, amalungu omphakathi, nabanye abathintekayo bakhulume ngezinkinga zabo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinguquko zithintwa ngokweqiniso. Lokhu kushukunyiswa kuzothuthukisa ukholo phakathi kwabantu ne-GEMS, okudingayo ukuze kusebenze imishwalense ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, zonke lezi zinguquko zingaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi uma kuhlanganiswa impendulo enhle, izixazululo ezibulala izinkinga, nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabathintekayo. Ubulungiswa bokwelapha kumele bujule emqondweni wabo bonke abasebenzi. Yilapho kuphela lapho sizomkhumbula umbono wokuthula, lapho impilo yembula intuthuko. Ekugcineni, izinguquko zobulungu be-GEMS ziwusizo kakhulu, kodwa kumele kube nezinyathelo ezithile eziqinisekisa ukuthi lonke uhlanga luhlangana kumgogodla omkhulu. Ukuhlala sizama njalo ukuqonda, ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo, noxolo okungawutholi, kuzokwandisa ukuzethemba kwethu. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, sizodinga ukuqhubeka sikhuluma ngalezi zinguquko, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinhlaka zihlangana ukuze zibe nezesekeli ezithuthukayo, kuzuzwe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngakho, kube sithokozisa ekuthandeni amanqampunipuni abavela ezinhlelweni ze-GEMS, ukufakazela uthando lwabo ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinhle ukuze babe yizinsiza ezikhaliphile. Ubulungiswa bempilo kumele budlule ezinyathelweni ezikuhle. Okwamanje, hamba sizolanda izinguquko zobulungu ukuze siphile impilo ejezile, silondoloze izinjongo zethu ezingokwelashwa kube nomthelela omuhle.
Yini isimo (mhlawumbe singathi)! Ngesikhathi sikhula njengabantwana, sifundiswe ukuthi akufanele sikhombe izinkukhu ngaphambi kokuba amaqanda aphume. Nokho, uma usuphumelele, uyabona ukuthi lokhu kuyinto oyitholile. Manje kufanele ucabange ukuthi uzokwenzenjani ngalokhu kuphumelelanga - uzokuthengisa ngokushesha noma uzokugcina ukuze ulinde intengo inyuke (noma yehlise uma ungathokozile). Lokhu kungenzeka uma ungenayo inkontileka yokumaketha - uma unayo, kufanele ulandele imigomo yayo. Yiziphi izinto okufanele ngicabangele uma ngifuna ukuqoqa ukuhweba kwami? Ngabe nginendawo efanele epulazini yokuphatha, ukuhlanza, nokugcina lezi z food? Ngabe kufanele ngithumele umkhiqizo ezindaweni zokulima ukuze ngiwuhlinzeke kumninimandla wesilo ongumuntu siqu, mhlawumbe kumfarmela omunye, noma emakethe noma kumunye umuntu osebenzisa ukudla ezindaweni zokulima? Uma ummbila kufanele ubekwe epulazini noma endaweni lapho kukhona isilo somuntu osebenza ngokwakhe, kuzobiza malini ithani elilodwa? Qonda ukuthi izindleko zokuhlanganisa ummbila endaweni ethile ngeke zedlule izindleko zezintela nezinye izindleko ezihlobene nokubeka ukuhweba kwakho. Funda kahle lokho okukhuluma kule nkontileka, ngesiNgisi baphawula "ukuphrinta okuncane" okuvame ukutholakala ekupheleni kwale nkontileka - qaphela ukuthi bangakukhokhisa? Yisiphi isithembiso esinakho mayelana nentengo yokudla ehla futhi enyuka? Njalo ngesonto kufanele ushintshe amasu akho okuthengisa ngokwezimo zezulu nezimakethe, kodwa kufanele ukhulume nomphathi wakho wezimali noma nesiphathimandla esabelana ngemininingwane endaweni yakho. Yini edala intengo yommbila eNingizimu Afrika yehlise futhi inyuke? Uma kukhona ukukhiqizwa okukhulu kakhulu kommbila eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2004 nango-2005), intengo yommbila ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo eduze kwentengo yommbila ethengiswa phesheya. Uma kubonakala ukuthi ummbila kuzodingeka ukuthi ulethelwe kwabanye lapha eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2006 nango-2007), intengo yommbila ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo eduze kwentengo ekhokhelwa ukuthenga ummbila phesheya. Intengo yommbila emhlabeni jikelele ithonywa yizinto ezinkulu lapho intengo yommbila ethengiswa phesheya noma ummbila othengwe phesheya ikalwa. Intengo yommbila emhlabeni jikelele iyahluka futhi iyashintsha nsuku zonke nangasikhathi. Ukushintsha kwentengo yomhlaba jikelele kuzoshintsha nentengo yommbila othengwe phesheya. Intengo yommbila ethengwe e-USA nase-Argentina ivame ukukhombisa ukuthi intengo yommbila eNingizimu Afrika izoba kuphi. Izindleko ezihlobene nentengo yokungenisa ukudla noma ukuyithumela phesheya (njengentengo yokuthenga ummbila emakethe yomhlaba - noma ezindaweni ezithile) ikalwa ngokumelene nezindleko zokuthutha ukudla ngomkhumbi kanye ne-inshurensi ehambisana nalokhu. Konke lokhu kuphinde kubizwe futhi kukhokhisiwe ngama-dollar aseMelika. Ukuhlela zonke lezi zindleko ne-Rand yaseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuhambisane nenani lokushintshanisa le-Rand/ama-dollar aseMelika. Ukushintsha nsuku zonke kwenani lokushintshanisa le-Rand/ama-dollar aseMelika kuzoshintsha nentengo yommbila ethengiswa kanye nommbila othengwe phesheya. Ummbila waseNingizimu Afrika uthengiswa nsuku zonke emakethe yokudla eyakhiqizwa ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika e-Safex, engxenye yeJohannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE). I-Safex ingachazwa njengohlelo lwe-elektroniki oluphatha futhi luhlola abathengi (njengoba abathengi abamila ummbila ukwenza ufulawa) kanye nalabo abathengisa (njengoba abakhiqizi bezolimo). Ngakho-ke, abathengi nabathengisi bangabeka intengo noma inani lemali yommbila nganoma yisiphi isikhathi (ngokuvamile njalo ngenyanga). Ukuhweba kwe-Safex (ukuthenga nokuthengisa imikhiqizo yezolimo) kuqhubeka kusukela ngo-09:00 kuya ku-12:00 ngosuku olusebenzayo. E-Randfontein (Gauteng), uzothola uphawu olukhombisa intengo yommbila. Lokhu kusho ukuthi intengo yommbila ye-Safex iyatholakala uma ummbila ufika e-Randfontein. Uma ummbila unikezwa kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwe-Randfontein, intengo kufanele ilungiswe ngokuya ngezindleko zokuthutha nezinye. Uma ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombila e-Randfontein, kufanele ucabangele izindleko ezizovela uma uhlinzeka ngombila wakho kwezinye izindawo (izicelo) ezibhaliswe ku-Safex. Kukho izimali ezizokhokhiswa. Okokuqala, kukhona izindleko zokuthutha (kusuka endaweni yakho kuya kule silo e-Randfontein). Lezi zindleko zibhaliwe kahle emqulwini we-Safex ophumelele unyaka nonyaka. Uma ummbila uhlinzekwa endaweni enesilo somnotho (umninimandla wesilo), kuzodingeka ukhokhe imali yokuphatha bese ubeka ummbila wakho. Ngokuvamile, kuzoba nezindleko ezizokhokhiswa yinkampani ethengisa ummbila wakho uma ungawuthengisi ukuhweba kwakho ngokushesha (isibonelo: ibhizinisi lezolimo lizokuthengisela ummbila wakho futhi uzokhokha ngalokhu). Uma ummbila ungathengiswa ngokushesha ngemva kokuhlinzekwa (mhlawumbe kufanele ugcinwe isikhathi esithile), kuzoba nezindleko ezengeziwe zokugcina lowo mbila. Kubalulekile kumfarmela ukuqonda ukuthi inani lemali abazokwazi ukuyithola kulowo silo othile lingase libe phansi kunezinga abangathola khona kwezinye izindawo. Ungazama futhi ukukhuluma ngqo nabaphathi bemifino, kanye nezinye izinkampani ezisebenza ngemikhiqizo yezolimo nabanye abathengi nabathengisi bezinhlamvu zokudla ukuze uthole intengo engcono. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ungumnikazi kuphela walokhu kuphumelelanga - kukhona okwakho ukukuthengisa ngokuthanda kwakho - uma ungathandi intengo yokuthengisa, zama ukuthola intengo engcono. Intengo ekhombiswa yi-Safex iyona okufanele uzame ukuyithola.
Isiphakamiso Sokwandiswa Kwe-Gautrain Isingeniso I-Gautrain iyinsiza ebalulekile yokuhamba eGauteng, ikhuluma ngezindawo ezibalulekile ezifana neJohannesburg, Pretoria, kanye ne-O.R. Tambo International Airport. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokwanda, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokwandisa le nsiza ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabantu. Le dokhumenti ibonisa isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain, ibheka izinzuzo, izindleko, nezindlela zokuphumelela. Izizathu Zokwandiswa 1. Ukukhula Kwabantu: Njengoba abantu abahlala eGauteng bekhula, kudingeka izindlela eziningi zokuhamba. Ukwandisa i-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, kunciphise umjikelezo wezithuthi zomgwaqo, futhi kunciphise ukungcoliswa komoya. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa Komnotho: Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokusebenza, okuzoholela ekwandeni komnotho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinkampani zikhule, zandise imisebenzi, futhi zikhuthaze ukutshalwa kwezimali. 3. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezokuthutha: Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzohlinzeka ngezindlela ezihamba phambili zokuthutha, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bahlale bejabulile futhi bephumule ngesikhathi sokuhamba. Izinhlelo Zokwandiswa 1. Ukwakhiwa Kweziteshi Ezisha: Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabahambi, kuzodingeka kwakhiwe iziteshi ezintsha ezindaweni ezidinga ukufinyelela. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa iziteshi eziseduzane nezikhungo zokuhweba, izikhungo zemfundo, nezindawo zokuhlala. 2. Ukwandisa Umugqa Wezitimela: Umugqa we-Gautrain kufanele wandiswe ukuze ufinyelele ezindaweni ezikude, njengeMidrand, Soweto, ne-Ekurhuleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, kunciphise isikhathi sokuhamba, futhi kulethe izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. 3. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezokuxhumana: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahambi bahlala bexhumekile, kuzodingeka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuxhumana ezihambisana ne-Gautrain. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphakeme, izikhangiso ezisebenzayo, nezinsiza zokuhamba ezihamba phambili. Izindleko Nezinsiza Ukwanda kwe-Gautrain kuzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, kodwa izinzuzo ezizotholakala kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka. Izindleko zokwakha iziteshi ezintsha, ukwandisa umugqa wezitimela, nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuxhumana kuzodingeka zihlolwe ngokucophelela. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi basebenzisane ukuze kutholakale izinsiza ezidingekayo. Izindlela Zokuphumelela 1. Ukubambisana Nezinkampani: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le phrojekthi iyaphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani ezizimele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswe kahle, futhi izinkampani zibe nesithakazelo ekwakheni iziteshi ezintsha. 2. Ukubandakanya Umphakathi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubambe iqhaza ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo ezinkulu kumphakathi. 3. Ukwenza Ucwaningo Olufanele: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngokucophelela, kubalulekile ukwenza ucwaningo olufanele mayelana nezidingo zabahambi, izindleko, nezinsiza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo ezinkulu. Isiphetho Isiphakamiso sokwandiswa kwe-Gautrain sikhombisa indlela yokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuhamba eGauteng. Ngokwandisa i-Gautrain, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezihamba phambili zokuthutha, sithuthukise umnotho, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisane ukuze le phrojekthi iphumelele, futhi izinzuzo zayo zifinyelele kubo bonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi i-Gautrain ibe yinsiza ebalulekile yokuhamba, ehambisana nezidingo zomphakathi.
Izikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Ukubaluleka Kokwazi Izikhungo Ezemthethweni Ukuze uthole ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okufanele, kubalulekile ukwazi izikhungo zezempilo ezisemthethweni. Kukhona izikhungo ezingama-72 ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, ezinikeza izinsiza ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kulolu hlu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uthole izikhungo ezihamba phambili nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Isigaba 1: Ukuhlola Izidingo Zempilo Zomphakathi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinkinga ezivame ukubangela iziguli, njengezifo, ukuswela kwezinsiza, noma izinkinga zokuthutha. Uma lokhu sekucacile, ungathola izikhungo ezikufanele. Isigaba 2: Ukucacisa Izinhlobo Zezikhungo Izikhungo zezempilo zihlukaniswe ngezinhlobo ezahlukene, ngokwezinga lemisebenzi yazo. Kukhona izibhedlela eziphambili nezikhungo ezincane zokunakekelwa. Ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha izikhungo ezifanele. Isigaba 3: Ukuthola Izikhungo Ezithile Uma izidingo seziqondile, ungavakashela ezikhungweni ezikufanele. Ungasebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi, njengezikhumba zezempilo, ukuze uthole izinketho ezitholakalayo. Isigaba 4: Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Kubhekwa amakheli ezikhungo, kubalulekile ukuxhumana nezinhlelo ezithintekayo. Lokhu kuzokuvumela ukuba uqonde izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo nezisebenzi. Isigaba 5: Ukuhlela Ukuhamba Lapho uthola izikhungo ezifanele, kubalulekile ukuhlela indlela yokuhamba. Qinisekisa ukuthi uqonda isikhathi sokuhlala nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze uthole ukunakekelwa okuphumelelayo. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlola Izinsiza Ezitholakalayo Ngemva kokuhamba, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda ngokuqonda izinqubo zokwelapha nemishanguzo ethile. Isigaba 7: Ukugqugquzela Ukubuyekezwa Kwemiphakathi Ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zilandela izidingo zomphakathi, ngokuvuma iziphakamiso ezivela kubantu abathintekayo. Isiphetho: Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezinsiza Ngemva kokuhlola izikhungo ezisemthethweni, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Izikhungo ezingama-72 zingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukuhlola, ukuhlola, nokukhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezikhungweni ezihamba phambili, futhi kubalulekile ukwenza izinqumo ezinempilo ezisebenzayo.
Isahluko 1: Ukwamukela Ukugoma Umbhali: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungihlangabeza namuhla. Ngicela ungazise, yini okukwenza ukhulume ngalezi zimiso zokugoma? Umlingisi: Sawubona! Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Imigomo yokugoma ibalulekile ngoba ivikela impilo yomphakathi. Ngokwazi lezi zimiso, abantu bangakhetha kahle ngezempilo zabo. Isahluko 2: Ukubaluleka Kokugoma Umbhali: Ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi kungani ukugoma kubalulekile kumphakathi? Umlingisi: Ngokuqinisekile. Ukugoma kubalulekile ngoba kuvikela abantu ezitheni ezifana nezifo ezinzima. Ngokugoma, sithuthukisa ukuphepha komphakathi, futhi sithuthukisa ukuvikelwa kwabanye. Imigomo yokugoma ihlinzeka ngezixhumo phakathi kwegazi lenhlanzeko, ukwandisa ukuvikeleka kanye nabafundi. Isahluko 3: Izimiso eziyisisekelo zokugoma Umbhali: Ungabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezimiso eziyisisekelo zokugoma? Umlingisi: Yebo, kunezimiso ezithile ezisemqoka. Okokuqala, zonke iziguli kufanele ziqonde izinzuzo zokugoma, okuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa ezingozini zomhlaba. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bakhethe ukuzibandakanya. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusiza emigomweni yokugoma, ukudala ukuqwashisa, nokukhuthaza abanye. Lokhu kugcina umphakathi unempilo futhi uphephile. Isahluko 4: Izithiyo ekugomeni Umbhali: Kukhona yini izithiyo ezithinta ukufakwa kwemigomo yokugoma? Umlingisi: Yebo, zikhona. Abantu abaningi banokukhathazeka ngenxa yokungazi; kunezinkolelo ezithile mayelana nezithako ezisetshenziswayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashiswa kwezakhamuzi. Okuhle, imithombo ethile inikeza izimpendulo ezibalulekile, ezisiza abantu baqonde kangcono. Isahluko 5: Izinqubomgomo nezinto ezithinta izenzo Umbhali: Kukhona yini izinqubomgomo ezenza kube lula ukufaka lezi zimiso? Umlingisi: Yebo, iHhovisi leZempilo lisebenza ngezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayagoma. Ukuze kube neziphakamiso ezifanele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye namalungu omphakathi. Lokhu kudala umkhankaso wokugoma ophumelelayo. Isahluko 6: Ukukhuthaza ukugoma Umbhali: Yini okufanele kwenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhuthazela kwabantu ekugomeni? Umlingisi: Kubalulekile ukudala imikhankaso efinyelela enhliziyweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imihlangano yokuxoxa, izifundo ezithinta imiphakathi, nezinsiza ezikhuthazayo ezikhombisa izinzuzo zokugoma. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlonipha imikhuba nemvelaphi yamasiko kungasiza ekwandiseni isimo sokugoma. Isahluko 7: Ukuqonda imiphumela Umbhali: Ngabe imiphumela yokugoma ingachazwa kanjani emiphakathini? Umlingisi: Imiphumela yokugoma ibonakala emiphakathini ngezindlela eziningi. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo, ukukhululeka kwezifo ezithathelwanayo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zezempilo komphakathi futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ukuze kube nemiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu asebenze ndawonye. Isahluko 8: Ukuqedela Umbhali: Ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa! Yini ofuna ukuyishiya kubafundi bethu? Umlingisi: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile. Ngifuna ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi ukugoma akukhona okwenziwa umuntu oyedwa kuphela, kodwa kukhomba umphakathi wonke. Ngakho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukugoma, sithuthukise imibono yethu nezifiso ukuze sibe nempilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uhulumeni, imithombo yezempilo, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisane. Umbhali: Ngiyabonga kakhulu! Lokhu kuyasiza kakhulu kumphakathi wethu. Umlingisi: Ngiyabonga. Ngithokozile ukuthola ithuba lokuxoxa.
Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Inhloso yokubamba umuntu ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi othweswe icala ubonakala enkantolo. Umuntu obanjwe ubhekwa njengomuntu ongaphikiswa kuze kube sekukhululiwe icala. Ngalesi sizathu, wonke umuntu obanjwe kufanele aphathwe kahle futhi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Kukhona amaposta akhombisa amalungelo abantu abanjwe. Iposi kufanele ibekwe odongeni ngaphambi kokuqala kwalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yalesi sabelo ukuhlinzeka ngamaqhinga alolu suku. Le ngxenye yeMthetho Wokuphatha Icalo ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-alternatives angcono kokubamba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba khona enkantolo. Lezi zinketho kufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokukhetha ukubamba ngoba ingxenye 36 (e) yeMthethosisekelo ibonisa ukuthi umuntu kufanele acabangele izindlela ezincane zokunciphisa ukuze afinyelele inhloso (kulesi simo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu ubonakala enkantolo). Ukubamba kufanele kube yindlela yokugcina. Ukubamba akuyona indlela yokukhipha umuntu emphakathini okwesikhashana ukuze kuhlanzeke le ndawo, futhi akuyona indlela yokujezisa. Umuntu angabanjwa ngewaranti noma ngaphandle kwayo. Khumbula ukuthi kuhle kakhulu ukuthola iwaranti. Into enhle ngayo ukuthi ivikela uphiko lwezepolitiki ekubanjweni icala futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi ukubamba nokuthola ubufakazi kuhlelekile. Iwaranti yokubamba ingatholwa kumagistrate noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukuvikela ukuthula, okungabandakanya uphiko lwezepolitiki olwenziwe umphakathi. Inhloso yalesi sabelo ukuhlela inhloso yokubamba umuntu nezinye izindlela zokwenza ukuthi ubonakale enkantolo. Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Yini okusho ukuthi umuntu ubhekwa njengomuntu ongaphikiswa? Yiziphi ezinye izindlela, ngaphandle kokubamba, ezingaqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu othweswe icala ubonakala enkantolo? Buza abafundi ukuba baphendule umbiko ngalokho abakukhulumile. Phatha ingxoxo bese uhlela. Izinto okufanele zisetshenziswe ngesikhathi sokuhlanganisa. Akudingekile ukuxhumana nomuntu ovuma ngesikhathi eboshwa. Uma umuntu ephikisa ukubamba, kungasetshenziswa amandla afanele (amandla amancane) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubamba. Umphakathi obamba kufanele, ngokushesha okukhulu, azise umuntu obanjwe ngesizathu sokubamba. Uma umuntu eboshwa ngaphansi kwewaranti, ikhophi kufanele inikezwe uma iceliwe. Umuntu obanjwe kufanele aziswe ngamalungelo akhe ngokushesha okukhulu (njengoba kungenzeka ngokwezimo) njengoba kuqinisekisiwe engxenyeni 35 yeMthethosisekelo. Uphiko lwezepolitiki kufanele lukhumbuze futhi luchaze la malungelo wonke kumuntu obanjwe futhi luqinisekise ukuthi uyawuqonda ngokuhambisana nengxenye 35 yeMthethosisekelo. Ukubhekwa njengomuntu ongaphikiswa kuhambisana nelungelo lokungaziphikisi nokulunga kokuhlala silent. Umuntu othweswe icala akaphoqwa ukusiza uhulumeni kuleli cala. Uma uhulumeni ebanjwa umuntu, kufanele athole ubufakazi obuqinile bokuthi lowo muntu unecala. Inhloso yalesi sabelo iwukuthi uphiko lwezepolitiki lucabangele amalungelo abantu abanjwe kanye nezibopho abahlangabezana nazo mayelana nalabo abanjwe. Yini indlela efanele yokubamba umuntu? Yiziphi amalungelo nezibopho zomuntu obanjwe? Yini indima yephiko lwezepolitiki lapho kubanjwa umuntu? Yini okufanele uphiko lwezepolitiki lukhumbuze umuntu obanjwe ngesikhathi sokubamba? Nini futhi kuphi umuntu obanjwe angafaka isicelo sokukhululwa? Yiziphi amalungelo omuntu obanjwe angaphulwa? Lezi z права zingaphulwa kanjani? Phatha ingxoxo ejwayelekile mayelana nezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba, uqala ngamandla amancane angasetshenziswa. Nini uphiko lwezepolitiki lungashaya umuntu ophunyukayo? Ingabe amandla angasetshenziswa uma kuseshwa umuntu obanjwe? Yiziphi izimiso ezisebenzayo uma kuseshwa nokutholwa kwezimpahla? Amalungelo omuntu ongena izimpahla ezithathwa ngenhloso yokuhlola, ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo; kanye nemikhawulo efanele yalezi zinkulumo, ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo nezikhombisi ezizothunyelwa kulesi sikhathi ngendlela ehambisana nezimiso zamalungelo; kanye nemiphumela yokusesha ngendlela engahambisani neMthethosisekelo. Ukusesha nokuthola izimpahla kuyisiphazamiso esikhulu samalungelo omuntu. I-Mthethosisekelo iqinisekisa ilungelo lokuba nemfihlo (ingxenye 14 yeMthethosisekelo) kanye nelungelo lokukhululeka nokuphepha (ingxenye 12 yeMthethosisekelo). Lezi zinkulumo zisho ukuthi uMbuso (uphiko lwezepolitiki) awukwazi nje ukusho ukuthi ubheka indlu yomuntu, indawo yabo, noma umzimba wabo futhi awukwazi ukuthatha impahla yakho, ukuvula imiyalezo yakho, noma ukufaka ucingo lwakho ngaphandle kokugunyazwa komthetho. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi la malungelo awagciniwe njengoba angancishiswa. Umthetho ka-1977 uvumela lokhu. Lokhu kungenzeka, ngokwesibonelo, lapho umuntu ehlolwa, lapho indlu yomuntu ihlolwa, noma lapho okuthile kuthathwa kumuntu ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Khumbula ukuthi uphiko lwezepolitiki lungasesha futhi luthathe izimpahla uma kugunyazwe umthetho ukwenza kanjalo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uphiko lwezepolitiki lusebenzisa lezi zikhwama ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo efanele yezenzo zomthetho futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo alowo muntu awaphulwa. Uma uphiko lwezepolitiki lwenza izibopho zawo ngokuhambisana nomthetho, le mpazamo yamalungelo omuntu izoba semthethweni (ngesizathu). Umuntu unamalungelo aqinisekisiwe yiMthethosisekelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yena noma impahla yakhe ibhekwa noma ithathwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi izenzo zephiko lwezepolitiki zihlale zisebenza ngokomthetho. Uma amalungelo omuntu ephulwa ngesikhathi sokusesha nokuthola, le mpazamo kufanele igcinwe ibe phansi. Inhloso yalesi sabelo iwukukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bacabangele imiphumela yokusesha nokuthola izimpahla engase ibe nomthelela kumalungelo omuntu. Buza abafundi ukuba benze amaqembu ukuze baxoxe ngezinto ezilandelayo. Hlinzeka ngezibonelo zamalungelo angaphulwa ngesikhathi sokusesha nokuthola. Bakhumbuze ukuthi babheke ingxenye yokuphulwa ekhasini 6 yamabhuku okusebenza futhi bahlolisise ukuthi ukusesha nokuthola izimpahla kungabhekwa njengokuphula amalungelo omuntu ngesizathu. Buza abafundi ukuba bahlinzeke ngezibonelo zomthetho (umthetho ojwayelekile) ophathelene nokusesha nokuthola izimpahla. Thola umbiko kumaqembu ngalokho abakukhulumile: iqembu ngalinye kufanele libhale amalungelo angaphulwa ku-flip chart noma ibhodi ngenkathi amaqembu ebika ngalokho abakukhulumile. Xoxa ngokusebenza kwengxenye yokuphulwa. Qeda ngezingxoxo ezijwayelekile. Uma kukhona amalungelo ngaphansi kweBill of Rights aphulwa, njengokusesha nokuthola izimpahla, ukuphulwa kufanele kuhlolwe ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zengxenye yokuphulwa. Amalungelo angaphulwa ukuze kube nokuqondanisa okukhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuphulwa kufanele kube nokuhambisana okukhona emkhakheni wokusesha. Amanothi kufanele asebenzise le ndlela. Izinhloso yilezo ezizokweseka ukusesha. Ngakho-ke, ukuphulwa kuzoba nokuhambisana. Uphiko lwezepolitiki al
Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Njengama-ATM Ngiyabingelela! Ngabe uzitholele ukuthi izikhungo zethu zisebenza kanjena, njengezikhungo zama-ATM? Kulungile, ake sikhulume ngale ndaba ethokozisayo. Njengoba sonke sithanda ukufinyelela kulwazi, izikhungo zethu zikhona ukuze zisinikeze izinsiza eziseduze, kalula, futhi ngezinye izikhathi, kunjalo nje, ngezikhathi ezinzima, zithi zibusise! Uhlelo lwezikhungo lungahlukaniswa ngezindlela ezithile, ngokufana kakhulu nezikhungo zama-ATM. Njengoba ulwazi lutholakala kalula ezikhungweni, like ATM, sizokwazi ukuthola futhi silondoloze izinto eziningi ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezinsizakalo zansuku zonke. Uye wacabanga ukuthi ungayithola kanjani imininingwane ethile, nokuthi izikhungo zingakwenza kanjani kube lula? Ngokwesibonelo, thina sibe namahora amathokozisayo, kanjalo nezinye izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ezinigela lezo zikhungo. Lokhu kusebenza njengokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabantu. Phakathi nezinsuku ezinzima, uma uhamba emgwaqweni ufinyelela kuzikhungo, uzoba nesithukuthezi sokucela usizo kwabanye. Kepha uma kukhona izikhungo ezithile ezilungiselelwe, njengama-ATM, ukuphendula okusheshayo kuyatholakala, futhi kulungile! Kanye nokuthola izincwadi, izikhungo zethu zingasivumela ukuthi sifinyelele kalula emithonjeni yethu edingekayo, sibe nemithombo ewusizo. Lokhu kubalulekile uma sikhuluma ngempilo, njengokufunda izincwadi ezithile zezemfundo, ukuthola izinsizakusebenza eziphathelene nezempilo, noma umkhakha wezokuthengisa. Njengoba sithanda ukufunda futhi sithole ulwazi olusha, izikhungo zethu zingakwenza kube lula lokhu, ngokubeka imithombo etholakalayo njengoba kudingeka. Ukwakha isithombe esicacile, ake sithi ungumfundi ofuna ukuqhubeka nokwenza okuhle. Kungase kube nezinsuku lapho ungazi qhubeka kanjani, kodwa uma unesikhungo eduze, ungakwazi ukufinyelela emithonjeni ethile, okufana nezincwadi, uhlu lwemibuzo, noma izikhungo ezithile zokusiza. Lokhu kukhumbuza, ngempela, ukuthi izikhungo zisetshenziselwa ukuxhumanisa abantu, similar to how ATM connects us to cash. Uzakwethu, asikhumbule ngezinsiza ezisemthethweni ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zenziwa ukuze zithuthukise umphakathi, njengama-ATM azisinika ukuthola imali. Filosofiya isebenza njengezikhungo zamakhasimende, nezinsizakalo ezahlukahlukene ezitholakalayo uma kudingeka. Ngabe ukhona umehluko phakathi kwezikhungo ezilungile nezicasuliwe? Ngaphezu kokusebenza kahle, ezinye izikhungo zinezinjongo ezenzakalayo, ukuze sithole usizo ngendlela ethokozisayo. Sizokhuluma kakhulu ngendlela izikhungo ezithinta ngayo umphakathi. Njengoba sikhangisa imizwelo ethile, lezo zikhungo zenza abantu bazizwe behambisana, nalokho okwakhiwa njengomphakathi. Lokhu kuhamba phambili kukhombisa ukuthi, uma sifunda ngendlela zokusebenza kwezikhungo, kungenzeka ukuyiqonda kahle. Isibonelo, uma unezidingo ezithile, ungabheka izikhungo endaweni ethile, futhi kungaba lula ukufinyelela kulokho okufunayo. Hamba phambili, thina sithokoziswe yizikhungo ezilungile. Njengoba sikhulumayo, yazi ukuthi abantu abavame ukujolisa emsebenzini bezikhungo ezingeqondile. Ngalesi sikhathi, ucingo olufushane lungavula umnyango, lilungiselele umphakathi ukuba ube yindawo efanele. Ukephazelisa, izikhungo zethu zingakwenza kube lula ukuyithola imihlangano noma izinto ezibalulekile. Amaphutha amancane kunye, akuphephile ukudlula ngaphambi kokuthi uvule umnyango wenhloso eyiyo. Ngokuya phambili, sizobona ukuthi izikhungo zisebenza njengolwazi olwenziwe lula. Njengoba u thene, uma ufinyelela ezikhungweni, kukhona ukuncika kokwenza izinto zenziwe ngendlela ethokozisayo. Umehluko ukhona phakathi kwezindawo ezidumile nezincane, kepha bonke banenhloso efanayo: ukusiza abantu. Lokhu kukhomba ukuthatha izinyathelo ezihle ukuze sonke sibe nendawo engcono. Ukugcina izikhungo zisebenza ngendlela efanele, kudinga ukubambisana. Njengoba uzwa, kuyinto ebalulekile ukuxhumana nabanye, ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi, uma sizama ukuphila kahle, zikhona izindlela eziningi zokubambisana. Kungaba ngezithombe, imihlangano, noma izinsiza ezithile, kudinga abasebenzi abazinikeleyo, abazimisele ukufaka izandla ekuphakamiseni izikhungo. Ngokuphetha, sithanda ukubona izikhungo ezingama-ATM, zihamba ngokufana nezinsizakalo ezithile ezidingekayo. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhungo zenzelwe ukusiza abantu, futhi uma sicabanga ukuthi singabathandi bezinto ezilungile, sikhumbula ukuzithiba. Kuhle ukukhumbula, uma sinezikhungo zethu, siphithizela izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuthola izinsiza, futhi kuzo zonke izimpilo zethu, ngokubambisana siyakwazi ukuba neqhaza. Njengoba sisenza, sizokwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi, izinsiza, nokusiza umphakathi wethu. Ngakho, sisekhaya, siphinde sinezikhungo, sizokwazi ukusiza abanye. Ngiyabonga!
UMphathiswa weZobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo usungule lezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ngemuva kokuxoxisana noMphathiswa wezeMali, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 30 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvikela Ukwehlukaniswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). Isicelo sokubekwa njengomlobi obhekiswe esigabeni 17 soMthetho kumele sibe sobala ngesimo esifanayo neFomu 1 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo futhi sithunyelwe kuMphathi-Jikelele. Ubufakazi bezincwadi zomsebenzi ezivela kubaphathi besicelo, uma zikhona; kanye namagama, amakheli, nezinombolo zocingo zabantu ababili abangaxhumana nabo mayelana nesimo somfaki-sicelo. Ukubekwa kwababhali kuhlobene nokuphothulwa kweziqu ezithile ezivunyelwe nguMphathi-Jikelele. UMphathi-Jikelele angabeka umuntu njengomlobi isikhathi esivunyelwene ngazo zombili uMphathi-Jikelele nomfaki-sicelo, futhi umfaki-sicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola inani eliphelele lemali efanelekile neyezokuphatha eyamukelwe ngababhali ezinhlelweni zeMnyango. Izimo zokubekwa komuntu njengomlobi njengoba kuqondiswe esigabeni 1 ngenhla zifana nezimo zomsebenzi ezisebenzayo kumuntu obekwe njengomlobi wenkantolo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezabasebenzi BezeMphakathi ka-1994, Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994. Xwayisa abafakizolo ukuthi banelungelo lokuthola imali yokufakaza futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umfakizolo uyasizwa ngalokhu, uma kudingeka; futhi baphathe izibopho zomlobi wenkantolo ezimweni zomphakathi uma kudingeka ukuze kufezwe lokho okukhulunywa ngumthetho. Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikomidi elikhuluma ngalesi sigaba 20 soMthetho, ofuna ukulethela udaba phambi kwenkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi, angakwenza lokhu ngokwazisa umlobi wenkantolo ngenhloso yabo yokwenza lokho besebenzisa ifomu elifanayo neFomu 2 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Wazise umphikisi usebenzisa ifomu elifanayo neFomu 3 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo, ukuthi baphikiswa; futhi ucele umphikisi ukuthi ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ebhaliwe ebhekiswe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo phakathi nezinsuku eziyishumi kusukela ngosuku athola ngalo lesi saziso. Umlobi kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola impendulo evela kumphikisi obhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma ikhophi yale mpendulo kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu olethe udaba. Umlobi kumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakeme, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nodaba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzolalelwa yinkantolo noma ludluliselwe kwenye inkantolo. Uma umphathi ophakeme ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kufanele lulalelwe enkantolo, kumele adlulisele udaba kumlobi, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuthola udaba, abeke usuku lokulalelwa kwalo. Umlobi kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokulalelwa kwalo, wazise umfaki-sicelo nomphikisi ngaleso sikhathi sokulalelwa besebenzisa ifomu elifanayo neFomu 4 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Kumele bathumele ikhophi yesinqumo senkantolo kubo bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba; futhi bazise/benze bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba ngezincwadi ezithunyelwe kule nkantolo ebhekiswe esigabeni a. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokhuluma ngodaba ithole amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isaziso esibhaliwe esazisa bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba kanye nomlobi wenkantolo ngokuthola kwabo udaba. I-inkantolo lapho udaba ludluliselwa khona kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8, ithumele umbiko kumlobi wenkantolo, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolo daba. Uma le nkantolo ibuyisela udaba emuva enkantolo, le mbuyiselo kumele ibe sobala ngesimo esifanayo neFomu 5 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo, ichaza izizathu zokuthi kungani udaba buyehliswa. I-inkantolo kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe kusukela ngosuku udaba luphindiselwe emuva enkantolo, iqondise indlela udaba luzoxoxwa ngayo. Umlobi kumele ngokushesha azise labo abathintekayo nodaba ngosuku lokulalelwa kwemigomo ngaphansi kwalezi ziqondiso ezibhekiswe esigabeni 6. Kuthunyelwa kumphikisi noma kufakwe enkantolo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela engaphathwa umphathi ophakeme. Isaziso esibhekiswe esigabeni 66 kumele sinikezwe kumuntu osebenza enkantolo noma kumlobi kubo bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba ngokuqondile. Umuntu ofuna ukuthumela isaziso kumfakizolo sokuthi avele phambi kwenkantolo kumele akwenze okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalelwa kwalo, ecela umlobi wenkantolo ukuba alungise futhi akhiphe leso saziso kumfakizolo ngokushesha. Isaziso kumfakizolo esikhiphwayo kumele sibe sesimo esifanayo neFomu 6 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Izindleko zokusebenza komuntu osebenza enkantolo; noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ongabekwa umphathi ophakeme. Umuntu othumela isaziso kumfakizolo kumele aqedele ingxenye B yesigaba sesibili seFomu 6 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Ukubakhona komfakizolo phambi kwenkantolo ngokuyalelwa kwenkantolo kwenziwa ngokuthumela leso saziso kumfakizolo, esikhiphwe ngumlobi, okumele sibe sesimo esifanayo neFomu 6 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Isaziso kumfakizolo esibhekiswe esigabeni a kumele sithunyelwe kumfakizolo ngumuntu osebenza enkantolo ngezimali zikamasipala. Umuntu obizwayo ukuba avele phambi kwenkantolo njengomfakizolo angacelwa ukuba akhiphe amadokhumenti athile noma amaphepha noma isitatimende noma noma yini enye ehlobene nalolo daba. Wonke umfakizolo, ngaphandle komsebenzi wombuso ophelele, obizwayo ukuba avele phambi kwenkantolo unelungelo lokukhokhelwa imali ebekwe esigabeni c ngezansi ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywa esigabeni b. Umphathi ophakeme angathatha isinqumo sokuthi umfakizolo kungenzeka angakhokhelwa noma angakhokhelwa inani elithile lemali. R100 ngosuku noma ingxenye yosuku lapho umfakizolo efanele ukuba enkantolo; nezindleko abangazichaza kahle zokufika enkantolo nezindleko zokuthenga ukudla ezitholwe ngumfakizolo ngenxa yokufika enkantolo. Umbuso ukhokhela uma umfakizolo ebizwayo enkantolo ngokuyalelwa kwenkantolo noma ebizwayo yinkantolo; noma umuntu ocela ukuthi umfakizolo abizwe noma akhokhelwe ngokuyalelwa komphathi ophakeme. Izitifiketi Zobungcweti Zabasebenzi Bakahulumeni: Umqondo Wokuthuthukisa Umsebenzi Nokusebenza Kwenhlalakahle Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuphatha. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni, abanjengabakhokheli bezinsiza zomphakathi, badinga iziqu eziphakeme nezitifiketi zobungcweti ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwakha umphakathi onempilo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwabo. Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni ziwumgogodla wokwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha. Zisiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu abaphatha izinsiza zomphakathi bazi kahle imisebenzi yabo, futhi banamakhono adingekayo ukuze baphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma abasebenzi benza kahle, umphakathi uzothola izinsiza ezinhle, ezisebenzayo, nezifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitifiketi zobungcweti zikhuthaza umoya wokufunda nokuthuthukiswa. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni badinga ukuhlala bephambili emikhakheni yabo, futhi lezi zitifiketi ziwusizo ekugqugquzeleni ukufunda okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izidingo zomphakathi zishintsha njalo, futhi izindlela zokuphatha zidinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze zihlale zisebenza. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti azikhona kuphela ezikhungweni zemfundo. Zidinga ukuba ziqinisekiswe futhi zihlolwe ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zifaneleka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalezi zitifiketi kufanele zibe nezindinganiso eziphakeme, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bazo bahlola kahle izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwethenjelwa ezitifiketini, futhi kuzokwandisa ukwaziswa komphakathi ngalezi ziqu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitifiketi zobungcweti zingaba nomthelela omuhle ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokuphatha. Uma abasebenzi bakahulumeni benemfundo efanele, umphakathi uzobona ukuthi izinsiza zabo ziphathwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukwethembela kuhulumeni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti azikona konke. Akukhona nje ukuthi umuntu unazo iziqu, kodwa kufanele futhi abe nekhono lokusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni badinga ukuba nekhono lokuxhumana, ukuhlela, nokuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Izitifiketi zobungcweti zingaba usizo, kodwa uma umuntu engakwazi ukusebenza kahle, iziqu zihluleka ukusiza. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokugqugquzela izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaziswa okukhulu ngempumelelo yokuphatha, futhi kuzokwandisa ukusebenza kahle kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni badinga ukuba neziqu eziphakeme ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi efanele, futhi baphendule izidingo zomphakathi ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni ziwumgogodla wokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Zisiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abasebenzi bazi kahle imisebenzi yabo, futhi banamakhono adingekayo ukuze baphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokuphatha, futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwabo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze izitifiketi zobungcweti ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zihlala zisebenza kahle.
Ukuhlola Ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan Ngonyaka ka-2012, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqalisa uhlelo olubalulekile olwaziwa njengeNational Development Plan (NDP). Lolu hlelo lwakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izwe, luhloswe ngokukhulisa umnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuqhubeka kweNDP, kubalulekile ukubheka izigameko ezithile ezihambisana nalesi sihloko. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kweNDP, uhulumeni wahlela izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziyaphumelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, ezemfundo, nezamabhizinisi. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkampani ezinkulu zathola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP, okuholele ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi komphakathi nezinkampani. Ngonyaka ka-2014, uhulumeni waphinde wakhuluma ngempumelelo yeNDP, lapho kwavulwa khona izikhungo zokufundisa, ezokwelapha, nezokuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abasha. Nokho, izinselelo zaba khona, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu besaba ukungabi namathuba afanele. Ngonyaka ka-2016, uhulumeni wahlola impumelelo yeNDP futhi wathola ukuthi izinhlelo ezithile zidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bayathola izinsiza, kwenziwa imizamo yokwakha izikhungo ezikahle zokufinyelela ezinsizeni. Ngonyaka ka-2019, uhulumeni waphinde waphakamisa izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP, lapho kwavulwa amathuba okuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ezemfundo, ezokwelapha, nezokuthengisa. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba abantu abaningi baqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze bathole amathuba emisebenzi. Nokho, izinselelo zihlala zikhona. Ukungalingani komnotho, ububha, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, kuqhubeka kube yizinkinga ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2021, uhulumeni wahlola izinhlelo zeNDP futhi wathola ukuthi kudingeka izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abampofu bayathola usizo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokudla, ezokwelapha, nezokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngonyaka ka-2022, uhulumeni waphinde waphakamisa izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP, lapho kwavulwa khona amathuba okuthuthukisa imisebenzi emisha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, nezikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bayathola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba izinga lokungasebenzi lehla kancane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zeNDP ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zifanele izidingo zabantu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziyaqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi bahlale bebambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa umnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ekupheleni, ukuhlola ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan kukhombisa ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nezinhlelo, uhulumeni uhlala ezama ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo ukuze zifanele izidingo zabantu. Ukuqhubeka kokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, ezemfundo, nezamabhizinisi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yeNDP. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhlelo ezihambisana neNDP ukuze sifeze umgomo wokwakha izwe elinobulungiswa, elithuthukile, nelinempilo.
Ukudla okuthengiswa ezimotweni zokudlela ezibekwe ezindaweni zomphakathi kumele kube nezaziso eziphambi kokuthengiswa emshinini ezikhombisa amagama ezinto zokudla, ngaphandle kwezimfanelo lapho ilebula (igama lokudla) livela emkhiqizweni wokudla uqobo. Uma umkhiqizo wokudla uthengiswa ngamasheya (okhululekile), umphakathi kumele ube nelebula (igama lokudla) ngokuhambisana nomkhiqizo wokudla othengiswa wedwa, futhi izinhlamvu zamagama kumele zibe nosayizi ofundekayo kumthengi. Izinto zokudla ezithile zikhululekile ngokuphelele ekubhalweni (igama lakho). Noma iyiphi i-beverage ekhankanywayo iphendukela kwiBeverage Products Act, 1989 (Act No. 60 of 1989). Kumele ifundeke futhi ibonakale futhi akufanele ibe ekushiseni okudlula u-500 C noma "Awukwazi ukuyiphula noma ukuyilimaza nganoma iyiphi indlela echazwe. I-Foodstuffs Hygiene Act, 1992 Act No. I-Agricultural Products Standards Act, 1990 Act No. I-Foodstuffs, Cosmetics and Disinfectants Act, 1972 Act No. I-Standards Act, 1993 Act No. I-Trade Marks Act, 1963 Act No. 1973 (Act No. 77 of 1973). Ulwazi lokudla luyadingeka kuphela ezimweni lapho izinhlamvu zembhalo zenziwa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ilebula lombhalo basekelwe kulokho. Ukudla okuqukethe ama-additives, preservatives, kanye nezinsiza zokuqhakambisa kumele kubonise igama le-additive, i-preservative, kanye negama le-colorant esetshenzisiwe. Uhlobo lwe-Monosodium Glutamate (oluwuhlobo lwezithako ezithuthukisa ukunambitheka kokudla) kumele futhi lubhaliswe njengokwakhiwa uma kutholakala kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo wokudla. Imikhiqizo yokudla equkethe ama-preservatives kanye nezinsiza zokuqhakambisa zohlobo lwe-Tartrazine kumele ibonise igama le-preservative noma i-colorant, futhi uma kuziwa kuma-preservatives, igama elisebenzayo "preservative" kumele libonakale kanye nezinye izithako zokudla ezibhalwe ngohlobo lwazo. Isixwayiso Uma umkhiqizo, nakuba uhlose ukusetshenziswa, ungase ube sengozini yokuphepha kwabantu, amalebula okuxwayisa afanele kumele avele kumkhiqizo, isibonelo, Izitatimende Ezivimbela Akukho zinsolo zezempilo ezingaqhamuka. Izigaba "impilo" kanye "nezemidlalo" akufanele zifakwe kumalebula (incazelo yomkhiqizo) njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uqukethe izithako ezithuthukisa impilo. Uma kuziwa kokupheka okujwayelekile okuvela ezitshalweni, amagama athi "akubangeli isifo senhliziyo" angathathwa njengokuphikisana. Isitatimende esifana "siphakanyiswa odokotela" akufanele sisetshenziswe njengoba kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uphakamisiwe ngochwepheshe bezempilo (udokotela). Imikhiqizo eqandisiwe Imikhiqizo elawulwa ngokushisa nokufriza kumele ichaze izimo zokugcina. Kumele ibonise izindlela zokusebenzisa, ezifana nokushisa, ukupheka ukuze kudleke ukudla futhi kugcinwe izinga elifanele. Ukudla okuphila ngokushesha kuboniswa ekukhanyeni kwelanga ngokukhululeka kokushisa okuphansi ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yakho yokuvikela ngokubulala noma yiziphi izinhlayiya eziphilayo ezikhona. Ilungelo lomthengi ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi imikhiqizo ebhekene nokukhanya kwelanga, ngakho-ke igama "exhunywe" noma "exhunywe ekukhanyeni kwelanga ukuze kubulawwe amagciwane" kumele kubonakale kumalebula, kodwa uma kungenamaphesenti angaphansi kuka-10 athola ukukhanya kwelanga, akudingeki ukusho ukuthi umkhiqizo utholakala ekukhanyeni kwelanga.
Ezokuvikeleka Kwezenhlalo: Ukubaluleka KwezeMisebenzi Zokuvikela Imininingwane Ngokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, izinkampani nezikhungo eziningi zikhula zisebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwemisebenzi. Nokho, lezi zinguquko zikhombisa ingozi enkulu yokuphulwa kwemithetho yokuvikela imininingwane. Ukweba imininingwane, ukuhlaselwa kwezinhlaka, kanye nezinsongo ezivela kumakhompyutha kubonisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukufaka izinyathelo eziqinile zokuvikela imininingwane. NgokweZikhungo Zokuvikeleka KweMisebenzi, ukuhlaselwa kwe-cyber kuyanda emhlabeni jikelele. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezincane, kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni ziya zihlushwa yizigebengu ze-cyber ezihlasela izinhlelo zazo ukuze zithole imininingwane ebalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, ukwehla kwesithunzi, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba necebo eliqinile lokuvikela imininingwane. Ukuze kuvinjwe lezi zinsongo, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinhlelo eziphambili zokuvikela. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokubethela, kanye nokuhlola izinhlelo zabo ngokuqhubekayo. Ukubeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuvikela imininingwane kubalulekile, futhi kubalulekile ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikelwa kwemithombo yolwazi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ukubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi mayelana nezinsongo ezikhona, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela imininingwane. Izinhlelo zokubambisana zingaba yinzuzo enkulu, njengoba zenza kube lula ukufunda ezinhlelweni eziphumelelayo zokuvikela. Naphezu kwemizamo eminingi yokuvikela imininingwane, izinsongo zihlala zikhona. Izinkampani kufanele zihlale zisesimweni sokulungela ukuhlaselwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele zihlale ziqapha izinhlelo zazo, zihlola izingozi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela eziphambili zokuvikela. Ukubuyekeza njalo izinqubomgomo zokuvikela imininingwane kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umphakathi uqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwemithombo yolwazi, abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amagama aphusile, ukugwema ukucindezela izixhumanisi ezingaziwa, kanye nokuhlola izinhlelo zabo zokuvikela. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kulindeleke ukuthi izinsongo ze-cyber zikhule. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izinkampani zifune izixazululo ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane. Izinkampani eziningi ziyaqonda ukuthi ukuvikela imininingwane akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinhlelo. Ekugcineni, ukuvikeleka kwemininingwane kuyinselele enkulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Noma izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela eziphambili zokuvikela, zihlala zidinga ukuqapha izinsongo ezikhona. Ukubambisana, ukuqeqesha, kanye nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kwemithombo yolwazi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zihlala ziphila ezinsukwini ezinzima ze-cyber. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imininingwane, kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabantu, kanye nokugcina isithunzi sezinkampani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza ekulweni nezinsongo ze-cyber. Noma ngabe ungumsebenzi, umphakathi, noma umsebenzisi, wonke umuntu unendima yokudlala ekuvikeleni imininingwane. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, sizoba sengozini enkulu yokulahlekelwa yimininingwane ebalulekile. Ukuthi sikwazi ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, kuyoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile nelinempilo.
U-Cassper Nyovest: Iphupho Elikhanyayo Nokusebenza Kwesimanje U-Cassper Nyovest, igama eliqhakazile emculweni weHip Hop waseNingizimu Afrika, ube nesandla esikhulu ekuguquleni umhlaba wezokungcebeleka. Ngonyaka we-2014, uCassper, ogama lakhe langempela linguRefiloe Maele Phoolo, wathola udumo olukhulu ngemva kokukhulula i-albhamu yakhe ethi "Tsholofelo". Le albhamu ikhuluma ngempilo yakhe, izifiso zakhe, kanye nezithiyo ahlangabezana nazo, ikakhulukazi njengoba efuna ukuphumelela emhlabeni obheke phansi. U-Cassper akavumanga ukuthi izimo zimpofu zizmbe indlela yakhe, kuphinde kachaze ubuhlakani nobungcweti bokuthola izixazululo. Kukhona phakathi kwamathuba amakhulu owakha wona emculweni. U-Cassper ugcizelele ukuthi umculo ungaphezu kokwenza imali; uwumthombo wokukhuluma, obambisela ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Umculo wakhe uhlangene nemizwa, uvusa izinkumbulo, futhi ukhuluma nabantu, ikakhulu abasha, ngezinselelo zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufaka umoya wokwakha, umphakathi, kanye Nezimpawu Zesimanjemanje, akuphinde kudalule umfutho othenjiswa kumphakathi konke. U-Cassper uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezobuciko, ephakamisa izinkanyezi ezisha. Ngamandla akhe, udlale indima enkulu ekuvuseleleni ubuciko beHip Hop eNingizimu Afrika, ekwakheni isimo sokuthi umculi angaphuma ngaphandle ehla ngenxa yokukhula kwezinkanyezi ezihamba phambili. U-Cassper uyazisa ukuthi umculo wakhe udinga ukuzwakala ezindaweni eziningi, ngakho-ke uhamba phambili ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abaculi abasha bayahlanganiswa, futhi bakhuthaza ezokungcebeleka. Ngaphandle kokuba umculi ophumelelayo, uCassper uphinde waba umphakathi. Unenhlonipho evelele emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini emisha efuna indlela yokuphila engcono. Ubuye abe nomthelela omkhulu ezinhlelweni zokuhlomulisa umphakathi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini elwela ukuthola amathuba okusebenza. Ubuye uqhubeke nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazibandakanye, baphumelele, futhi baphokophele amaphupho abo. U-Cassper Nyovest ubonakalisa intshiseko yokwenza umphakathi ungcono, usebenzisa izinkuni zakhe ezinhlobonhlobo ukusiza abanye. Usebenzisana nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuze aqinise ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza nezifundo kubantu abasha, ethuthukisa izizukulwane ezizayo. Ucwaningo lwakhe lokuzama ukuqhakambisa izinkanyezi ezincane luhlonishwa enhliziyweni yomphakathi futhi luphendula izinga eliphezulu lothando lokusiza. U-Cassper uqhubeke nokuhlonishwa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ethokozisa izithameli zakhe ngezinsuku ezimnandi. Ngemva konyaka wezivivinyo ezingapheli zempilo, ubesanda kuthola izindondo ezinkulu emcimbini we-South African Music Awards. Lezi zindondo zikhombisa umsebenzi oncomekayo, ubuciko, nemali eyakhayo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanye abaculi abakwenza okungaphezulu kokulindelwe. Okokugcina, uCassper Nyovest uphinde waba ngumkhiqizo wemikhiqizo emikhulu, ngezinhlelo ezijulile nezokuhlonza. Uhlele izinhlelo ezifana ne "Fill Up" uhlele emicimbini eminingi eNingizimu Afrika, ukuze abavakashi bazobona amaciko akhe phezu kwesigcawu. Hhumusha umqondo wokuhlanganyela, uCassper ukhuthaza abaculi abasha ukuba bangasebenzisa amandla abo ukuze bazathandwa. Umgomo wakhe omkhulu ukwakha ingqalasizinda yokwazisa nokuphathwa kwalabo abanamakhono. Ngakho, uCassper Nyovest ungubuhlakani obusha emculweni nasezinhlelweni zokusebenza. Njengomculi, umphakathi, umxhumanisi, necaba elijulile, uCassper ubonisa indlela yokwakha umphakathi, ukwazi nokukwazi ukuphumelela, kakhulukazi elwela ukuphila okugcwele umhlaba, izizukulwane ezintsha zikwazi ukukwazi ukusungula izinto ezinhle ezithinta izimpilo zabantu. Ngempela, uCassper Nyovest ubonisa indlela yokuphila engcono, kokubili emculweni nasekuhlinzekweni kwemiphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe ungumthwalo ongalibaleki, uvcimisela abanye ukwenza umqondo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi, ngendlela engokoqobo, imicabango emihle nezincazelo zokuphila zithuthuka ngokubambisana, kunoma yisiphi isikhathi esikhunjuzayo. U-Cassper ufana nedwa ngesithunzi sothando, ukuhlonipha, kanye nomsebenzi omuhle, okuhlonishwa okufanele futhi okungenakuphikwa.
Ukwakhiwa kweMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi; ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kubantu abathile abangasebenzi kule Mali, nokukhokhela labo abasebenzi abagulayo, abakhulelwe, noma abanabantu abaxhomekeke kubo, nezingane noma labo ababeqashwe ngaphambili uma bengasebenzi; ukulungiselela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi, imisebenzi yale Bhodi kanye nokunikezwa komphakathi weMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi; nokulungiselela ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umbiko wombhishobhi, ukudluliswa kwamandla okuzonikezwa, amandla, nemisebenzi. Umphakathi angabheka ukuthi umuntu ubengumfakisicelo kule Mali. Izingane zisho umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye esigabeni 30 ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 futhi zifaka umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-25 ongumfundi futhi oxhomekeke kuzo zonke izidingo zezezimali zomuntu obeqashwe. Umuntu oqashwe umndeni njengomshayeli; nomuntu ophatha noma ubani kule ndlu; kodwa akuhlanganisi umsebenzi wezolimo. Inhloso yalomthetho ukusungula iMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi lapho iminikelo izokwenziwa ngababusi nabasebenzi ukuze uma abasebenzi abathile behluleka emsebenzini noma labo abaxhomekeke kubo, bakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezomnotho nezokuhlalisana kwabantu. Abantu abangena eRiphabhulikhi ngenhloso yokwenza isivumelwano esithile, nalabo abasafunda ukuze basebenze, befunda lapha eRiphabhulikhi uma ekupheleni kwaleso sivumelwano umqashi enesibopho ngokomthetho noma ngokwenkontileka sokubuyisela lowo muntu ezweni lakubo, noma lowo muntu kufanele ahambe eRiphabhulikhi, kanye nabamqashi babo. Ngaphandle kwesigaba 1, lo mthetho ubhekelela abasebenzi bendlu, abasebenzi besizini, kanye nababusi babo iminyaka engu-12 kusukela ekuqaleni kwalomthetho. UNgqongqoshe kufanele, ngokushesha ngemva kokuqala kwalomthetho, aqashe noma abeke umphakathi ukuze ahlole futhi enze izincomo mayelana nokusebenza kwalomthetho kubasebenzi bendlu nalabo abasebenza ngesizini. UNgqongqoshe kufanele axhumane neBhodi mayelana nemiphumela yokuhlola. Noma yiziphi izimali ezisele kule Mali ezivela ekwabelweni kwempahla noma noma yiziphi izipho ezenziwe kule Mali noma ezinye izimali ezingatholakala kule Mali. Ukukhokha - kwemiholo nezinzuzo zamalungu eBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi kanye nekomidi layo; nezinye izindleko ezingase zenzeke ngokuhambisana nokusebenza kwalomthetho. Noma yimuphi umuntu, isikhungo, inkampani, noma ibhange lezezimali lingafaka imali kule Mali noma linikeze kule Mali njengempahla. UMsizi-Jikelele angamukela izimali noma impahla eyabelwe kule Mali esikhundleni seMali. Ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezimbili ngemva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, umphakathi kufanele abuyekeze isimo sezezimali sonke seMali salo nyaka wezezimali bese ethumela umbiko wesimo sezezimali kuMsizi-Jikelele. Noma yiziphi izinguquko ekusebenzeni kwemigomo nezindlela zokukala umbiko wezezimali wonyaka owedlule; kanye nezici ezithile noma izithiyo umphakathi angase abe nazo ngokusebenzisa umphakathi noma ezisetshenziswa umphakathi ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba sombiko ukuze kuvele izinkinga ezibalulekile ukuze kutholakale umfanekiso oqotho wesimo sezezimali seMali. Izincomo mayelana nokugcina noma ukuthuthukisa impilo yezezimali yeMali. Uma inani elidingekayo ukukhokhela izinzuzo likhulu noma lincane kunalokho okudingekayo ukukhokhela izinzuzo ezilindelekile. Noma yiziphi izimali ezibuyiselwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 588; kanye nanoma yiziphi izindaba ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezimali ezidingekayo; futhi kulandela inqubo echazwe esigabeni 55 yokwenza noma yiziphi izinguquko uma kudingeka. Uma umholo wehla kakhulu ngezikhathi ezithile, ukubalwa kufanele kusekelwe enanini ejwayelekile yalolo msebenzi olufake imali kule Mali. Usuku lapho umsebenzi ofake imali kule Mali waqala khona kuze kube usuku lapho lowo msebenzi uphelelwe; nanoma yisiphi isikhathi - umsebenzi wakhokhelwa umholo esikhundleni sokwaziswa. Izinsuku lapho umuntu ofake imali kule Mali kufanele athole izinzuzo njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 3 ngeke zinciphise ukukhokhelwa kwezinzuzo zokukhulelwa ngokuhambisana nengxenye D yale sahluko. Isinyathelo 3 - susa kule mali izinsuku lapho izinzuzo zitholiwe (ukuhlukanisa izinzuzo zokukhulelwa) eminyakeni emine elandela usuku lokufaka isicelo sezinzuzo ngokuhambisana naleli sahluko. Isinyathelo 4 - Inani elisele liyilona elihlinzeka ngezinsuku zokuthola izinzuzo umuntu ofake imali kule Mali okufanele athole. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nezimo zalomthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophathelene nokungasebenzi; noma ukungafaneleki ukuthola izinzuzo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 361. Ngaphandle kwesigaba 1, isikhathi sokungasebenzi kufanele sibilwe kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, noma usuku lokugcina lomsebenzi. Usuku okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 1 lunganda lube usuku olwandulela usuku lokufaka isicelo uma umphakathi ophatha izicelo eqinisekile ukuthi isizathu sokulibaziseka kokufaka sikhona ngaphandle kokulawula komuntu ofake imali kule Mali. Umuntu ofake imali kule Mali kufanele abhalise njengomfuna umsebenzi nezinsizakalo zokusebenza ezisunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998 Umthetho No. 97 ka-1998; futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 3, umuntu ofake imali kule Mali kufanele ulungele futhi akwazi ukusebenza. Umuntu ofake imali kule Mali wehluleka ukuveza phakathi nezinsuku nezikhathi ezibekwe umphakathi ophatha izicelo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 174d; noma umuntu ofake imali kule Mali uyakwenqaba noma uyakwenqaba ukuqeqeshwa noma ukwelashwa ngezizathu ezithathwa njengokungafaneleki ngaphansi kwanoma yisiphi uhlelo olwamukelwe nguMsizi-Jikelele ngokuhambisana nalomthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Ngaphezu kwesigaba 1d futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 201a, umuntu ofake imali kule Mali ophazamisekile yisifo esithole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi uzophinde athole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi inqobo nje uma umphakathi ophatha izicelo eqinisekile ukuthi leso sifo ngeke sithinte amathuba alowo muntu ofake imali kule Mali ukuthola umsebenzi. Isicelo sezinzuzo zokungasebenzi kufanele senziwe ngokugcwalisa ifomu elakhiwe ngalokhu. Isicelo kufanele senziwe phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, kodwa umphakathi angamukela izicelo ezithunyelwe ngemuva kwalolu suku inqobo nje uma kukhona izizathu ezisemthethweni. Umphakathi ophatha izicelo kufanele ahlole isicelo uma kudingeka futhi angacela olunye ulwazi mayelana nokuqhubeka kokungasebenzi komfaki-sicelo. UMsizi-Jikelele kufanele akhokhele umuntu ofake imali kule Mali izinzuzo zokungasebenzi ehhovisi lokusebenza lapho isicelo sithunyelwe noma ehhovisi elinye elinikezwe umfaki-sicelo ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Uma umfaki-sicelo ethola izinzuzo zokungasebenzi futhi enqaba noma enqaba ukuthatha umsebenzi ofanele ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele noma enqaba ukuhamba noma uk
Impilo Yengqondo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Nokuhlola Izindlela Zokuphila Impilo yengqondo iyisihloko esibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, esithinta wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki iminyaka, ubulili, noma isimo somnotho. Ngaphandle kokuphila kahle emzimbeni, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ukuze siqhubeke siphila impilo egcwele, enempilo. Lokhu kuhlola impilo yengqondo kuhilela ukuqonda izinkinga zengqondo, izimpawu zazo, kanye nezindlela zokuzilungisa. Izizathu Zokukhathazeka Ngempilo Yengqondo Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani impilo yengqondo ibalulekile. Okokuqala, izinkinga zengqondo zingaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu empilweni yomuntu, kubandakanya ukwehla kokusebenza, ubudlelwano obuphukile, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yomzimba. Ukukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, nokukhathazeka kwengqondo, uma kungalashwa, kungaholela ezimeni ezinzima, njengokuziphindisela, ukungazithandi, noma ngisho nokuziphilisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yengqondo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunempilo. Abantu abaphila kahle ngokwengqondo bavame ukuba nekhono lokuxhumana kahle nabanye, bakwazi ukuxazulula izingxabano, futhi babe nempilo engcono yokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile emndenini, emsebenzini, nakumiphakathi yethu. Izimpawu Zokuphazamiseka Kwengqondo Ukuze siqonde kahle impilo yengqondo, kubalulekile ukufunda ngezimpawu ezihlobene nezinkinga zengqondo. Izimpawu zihluka kumuntu nomuntu, kodwa ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi ukucindezeleka, ukungabi nandaba, ukungaphatheki kahle, ukucasuka kalula, kanye nokuhlukumezeka. Uma umuntu ezwa lezi zimpawu isikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuthi afune usizo, kungaba kudokotela, kumelaphi wezengqondo, noma kumuntu omtrust. Izindlela Zokuphila Zokuthuthukisa Impilo Yengqondo Kunezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo. Okokuqala, ukuzivocavoca kuyindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokukhulisa impilo yengqondo. Ukuhamba, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili, noma ukuhamba emanzini kungasiza ekwehliseni ukucindezeleka futhi kukhulise umoya. Ukudla kahle, okuhlanganisa ukudla okunezithelo, imifino, noshukela ophansi, nakho kunomthelela omuhle empilweni yengqondo. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana nabantu abaseduze, njengemindeni nabangane, kubalulekile. Ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zakho nabanye kungasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo wengqondo. Ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yomphakathi, efana nezinhlelo zokuzithandela, nakho kungakhulisa umuzwa wokuxhumana nabanye. Okwesithathu, ukuzithokozisa ngezinto ezithokozisayo, njengokufunda, ukudlala imidlalo, noma ukwenza ubuciko, kungasiza ekwakheni umoya ophilayo. Ukuhlola izindlela zokuphumula, njenge-yoga noma ukujula, nakho kunikeza ithuba lokuthola ukuthula kwengqondo. Ukubaluleka Kwezemfundo Nokuqwashisa Ngempilo Yengqondo Ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngempilo yengqondo kubalulekile. Imfundo mayelana nezinkinga zengqondo, izimpawu zazo, nezindlela zokuzilungisa kufanele kube yingxenye yezinhlelo zemfundo ezikoleni nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibalulekile futhi kufanele ihlonishwe njengempilo yomzimba. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abanezinkinga zengqondo, ezifana nezikhungo zokwelapha, zidinga ukuxhaswa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi ezidingekayo. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesithakazelo sokwakha izindawo eziphilayo, lapho abantu bezokwazi khona ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba. Isiphetho Impilo yengqondo iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuqonda, ukwelashwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwempilo yengqondo kufanele kube yinto esiyigxilile, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, egcwele, nenjabulo. Ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo, ukuxhasa abanye, nokuzithokozisa ngezinto ezithokozisayo, kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo. Ngakho-ke, masithathe izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphila impilo egcwele nempilo.
Umthetho 108 ka-1996 ngokweSigaba 152 ubopha uhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuluma ukuthi 'uhulumeni bendawo' kumele 'ukhuthaze ukubamba iqhaza kwemiphakathi nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezindabeni zohulumeni bendawo'. Lokhu kulandela umthetho owenziwe uhulumeni bendawo othi 'ukwakha uhulumeni obumbene endaweni kubalulekile kuhlelo lokuphatha bendawo futhi izindawo zidinga ukudala izindlela nezindlela zokugcina zixhumana nezakhamuzi, abantu bezebhizinisi, nezinhlelo zomphakathi'. Izinsiza zokufundisa ezamukelekayo zingasetshenziswa ukuqeqesha abamele izigaba nezithunywa zezigaba. Imihlangano yokufunda ephumelelayo futhi ebamba iqhaza. Abamele izigaba nezithunywa zezigaba bayakuqonda kahle ukuthi bayini emisebenzini yabo. Ukuhlinzeka abamele izigaba nezithunywa zezigaba ngamandla okuxhumana nomphakathi ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezifanele. Ukusungulwa kwezindlela zokukala ezamukelekayo ukuze kukhombise umnikelo wokufundisa. Lo mbhalo uhlelwe ngendlela efanayo naleyo indlela leli khasi lihlelwe ngayo. Le mifanekiso igqamisa okubaluleke kakhulu. Lapho ulwazi lokuxhumana lunikezwa, uzobona le mifanekiso. Uzobona le mifanekiso lapho kukhona izibonelo. Le mifanekiso isetshenziswa lapho unikezwa amanye amathiphu, amasu, noma imicabango. Imininingwane ngayinye imele uhlobo oluhlukile lolwazi. IPhalamende leZokuphatha Bendawo nezeMvelo. Yiziphi izisho esizisebenzisayo uma sikhuluma ngalo mthetho ophumile? Yiziphi izinqubomgomo ezikhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yiziphi izindawo ezibalulekile ezidinga ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza kanjani kuhulumeni bendawo? Lapho kuthuthukiswa ngendlela ethile, yiziphi izidingo zokuthuthukiswa, labo abathintekayo ukuze baqinisekise ukufakwa kwezindlela ezizokwenziwa baveza ukuthi banethuba lokufaka okubalulekile emphakathini. Kubalulekile kuhulumeni bendawo nabathintekayo ukwazi ukuthi badinga ini kubamele iPhalamende, nokuthi benza kanjani uma kufanele baveze. Kuhlinzeka uhulumeni bendawo ngolwazi ngezimo zaleyo ndawo, izidingo, izifiso, nezimo, futhi kusiza uhulumeni bendawo ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezinhle. Umthethosisekelo unikeza umqondo wezindlela ezahlukene zomthetho ezenza impilo ngendlela esiyazi ngayo ibe khona. Isiphakamiso esakhiwe ngesisekelo somthetho kanye nomthethosisekelo sikhombisa ezinye izidingo noma amalungelo. Umthetho onamandla noma ovunyelwe umthetho ususelwa esiphakamisweni. Lo mthetho uhlose ukuba namandla kulowo mthetho okhethiwe. Indlela ekhethiwe yokuxazulula izinkinga yamukelwa ngokomthetho ePhalamende. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwezixazululo ezivela kwiKhansela yesifunda nangemva kokuhlangana kweKhansela likamasipala, kwaphinde kwashicilelwa njengomgomo obizwa ngokuthi umthetho. Kukhona imithetho eminingi ekhuthaza isisekelo sokubamba iqhaza komphakathi kuhulumeni bendawo. Bangakhetha ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokwaziswa komphakathi ezingeni eliphezulu - lokhu kudinga ukuthi lezi zidingo zibe khona. Ukuthuthukiswa kufaka phakathi nokwakha ulwazi phakathi kwabantu nokubavumela ukuba basebenzise ubuhlakani babo. Yini ukuphepha kokuthuthukiswa? Kugxilwe emcabangweni kuhulumeni bendawo, ukuthi izindawo kufanele zakhe ubumbano obubambekayo futhi zikhuthaze ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwedemokhrasi kube yimpumelelo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi enqubo efanele yokuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha nezithiyo ezivele zenzeka. Ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kuncike ekuthuthukisweni kuhulumeni bendawo. Umthetho ophumelele uphinde wabona ukuvuselelwa kwamandla omphakathi njengempumelelo yokuthuthukiswa kuhulumeni bendawo. Umthetho ophumelele weBatho Pele ubeka izimiso zokuhola, ukuvela komsebenzi kubasebenzi bomphakathi. Phakathi kwezimpawu kukhona umqondo wokubonisana nomphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngesigaba esifanele somsebenzi namandla phakathi kwezinhlobo zamadolobha. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezifanele ezihlobene nokuvota. Izinhlobo A zamadolobha ezihlobene namadolobha amakhulu, zinezimfanelo ngaphandle kokuphatha nokwenza izinqubomgomo ezindaweni zazo. Izinqumo zezinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Umthetho wokuphatha ukhombisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo, ukwenziwa, nezinqubo azikwazi ukwethula incazelo entsha kuhulumeni bendawo. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwamadolobha kufanele kwakhiwe futhi kukhuthazwe ngesisekelo somthetho sokunikeza amandla kumadolobha, phakathi kwezinye izinto. Kwenzela kube lula ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela nokuxhumana phakathi kwezakhiwo zabo zezombusazwe, iziphathimandla zezombusazwe, nabaphathi nomphakathi wendawo. Umthetho wokusebenza kwamadolobha uqhubeka uvimbela amalungelo nemisebenzi yomphakathi nohulumeni bendawo obamba iqhaza. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba ngentando yabantu nokuzinikela kuhulumeni. Umthetho wamadolobha umthetho wentela yendawo. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokuphikisana nokudlulisela. Lezi yizinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezihlelwe ukuveza lokho okunikezwa. Izigaba zokubuyekeza noma izithakazelo zithinteka ekwenzeni imithetho. Lezi yizigaba zabantu abangabamele izigaba abahlangana ukuze baxoxe nganoma iyiphi indaba engavela kwiKhansela eyaziwa. Lokhu kuvame ukusetshenziswa ukusiza abamele izigaba ukwazisa umphakathi ngezizathu ezithathwe yiMasipala ezingase zithinte amalungelo nezinsiza zabo; futhi/noma ukubika ngesimo sezindaba zomphakathi. Ungacabanga ngezinye izindlela umphakathi ongabamba iqhaza ezindaweni zomphakathi? Bhala uhlu lwezindlela abantu abakwi ward yakho abangabamba iqhaza ezindabeni zohulumeni bendawo. Yini ikomidi lezigaba? Yiziphi izinqubomgomo ezibalulekile nezikhombisi ezikwi komidi lezigaba? Yini indima nemisebenzi yamakomidi ezigaba? Iziphi izikhathi abamele ikomidi lezigaba bakhethwa ngazo? Abamele ikomidi lezigaba bakhokhelwa kanjani? Umthethosisekelo uveza ukuthi kuphela amalungu eKhansela angavota. Abaholi bendabuko bangabamba iqhaza ezindabeni zohulumeni bendawo ngokuhlinzeka ngemibono, ukwenza izicelo, nokubuza imibuzo. Abaholi bendabuko noma labo abamele bona kumele bameleke kwi komidi lezigaba. IKhansela kumele inikeze isaziso esifanele sokuthi ifuna ukuhoxisa ikomidi. Nansi uhlu lwezindlela zomthetho nezikhombisi ezizodingeka ukuze wazi ukuthi wenzeni njengomunye wamalungu e komidi lezigaba. Zonke izindawo kumele zibe nohlelo lokuphatha izinhlekelele. Lo msebenzi manje uhlelwa ngamasipala esifunda.
