Abadlali Abasebasha: Ukuhlola Izinselelo Nezithuthukisi Zempilo Yabo Isingeniso Abadlali abasebasha bahlala bephakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu, njengoba bephakathi kokukhula nokuthuthukiswa emikhakheni ehlukene yezeMidlalo. Lokhu kuhlola kuzobheka izinselelo ezihambisana nokuba ngumdlali omncane, izinzuzo zokubandakanyeka emidlalweni, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo. Izinsiza Zokuthuthukiswa Kwabadlali Abasebasha Ukwanda kwemidlalo ehlukene, kusukela ku-rugby, ibhola, kuze kube ku-athletics, kubonisa ukuthi abadlali abasebasha bahlala benethuba elikhulu lokuthuthuka. Izikhungo zemfundo, izikole, nezinhlelo zomphakathi zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsiza zitholakala kalula kubadlali. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundiswa kwezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuzivocavoca, ukwakha amakhono, nokwakha umqondo ophumelelayo wokuncintisana. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nabantu Abancane Noma kunjalo, abadlali abasebasha babhekene nezinsiza eziningi ezinzima. Okokuqala, ukucindezeleka kwemfundo kanye nezifundo ezinzima kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza kwabo emidlalweni. Ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi abadlali abasha bavame ukuhamba phambili emidlalweni, kodwa uma bephazamiseka ezifundweni, lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi empumelelweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwehla kwezinga lokwesekwa emndenini nakubangani baphinde kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni kwabo. Izinzuzo Zokubandakanyeka Emidlalweni Kodwa-ke, ukubandakanyeka emidlalweni kunikeza abadlali abasebasha ithuba lokuthola izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, imidlalo iyathuthukisa impilo yomzimba, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekwakheni imisipha, ukuqina kwezitho zomzimba, kanye nokugcina isisindo esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo inikeza abadlali ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye, okwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabo nabanye abadlali. Lokhu kuthuthukisa amakhono okuxhumana, okubalulekile empilweni yabo yonke. Ukubaluleka Kokwesekwa Komphakathi Ukuze abadlali abasebasha baphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi bathole ukwesekwa okuqinile komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwesekwa okuvela kumazinga ahlukene, kusukela emndenini, kubangani, nakumfundisi. Ukuze umphakathi ube nomthelela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abadlali abasha, njengezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono, izifundo zokuphila, kanye nemicimbi yokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abadlali babe nesiqiniseko sokuthi bakhona abantu ababaxhasayo, okwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Impilo Yabadlali Abasebasha Kunezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa impilo yabadlali abasebasha. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abadlali ngezindlela zokuphila eziphusile, okuhlanganisa ukudla okunempilo, ukuhlela isikhathi sokuzivocavoca, nokuphumula okwanele. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emidlalweni yabo, futhi baphinde bazuze impilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa abadlali ngempilo yengqondo kubalulekile. Ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nokungabi nokuqina kwengqondo kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kokuphatha ingqondo, njengokufunda izindlela zokuphumula, kungasiza abadlali ukuba bakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zabo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, abadlali abasebasha banendima ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokweseka nokuthuthukisa lezi zinsizwa. Ukuqonda izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo, kungasiza ekwakheni abadlali abaphumelelayo, abakhula kahle, futhi abanezimpilo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi, imindeni, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kufanele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abadlali abasebasha banelungelo lokuphila impilo egculisayo, futhi baphumelele emikhakheni yabo.
Ukusebenza Ukude Ezinkampanini ZaseNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba wezokusebenza ushintshile kakhulu, futhi lokhu akukwazi ukungabazeka. Ukusebenza ukude, okwaziwa nangokuthi yi-remote work, sekuyinto ejwayelekile ezinkampanini eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuveza izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba siqaphele nezinselelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngezizathu eziholela ekutheni abantu bakhethe ukusebenza ukude. Enye yezizathu ezinkulu yikhono lokuphila impilo engcono. Ukusebenza ukude kuvumela abantu ukuba bahlale emakhaya, baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bagcine isikhathi esiningi sokuchitha nezingane zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezweni elinokuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezomnotho, lapho abantu abaningi behlupheka ngenxa yokungabi namathuba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenza ukude kudala amathuba okusebenza kubantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani zingathola abasebenzi abakhono kakhulu, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngendawo abahlala kuyo. Lokhu kuveza ithuba lokwakha ithimba elihlukahlukene, elinokuhlukahluka kwezizinda, izinkolelo, namakhono, okwenza izinkampani zibe nekhono lokuphendula kahle ezimfuno zomhlaba jikelele. Nokho, ukusebenza ukude akukhululi ezinkampanini ezithile ezibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Ngenkathi izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi baxhumana kahle, akusizi uma umoya wokubambisana ungatholakali. Ukusebenza ukude kungaholela ekutheni abasebenzi bazizwe behlukanisiwe, okunganciphisa umoya wokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenza ukude kudinga ukuthi izinkampani ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele zokuxhasa abasebenzi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngama-computer, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Uma izinkampani zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza, abasebenzi bangase babe nezinselelo ekwenzeni umsebenzi wabo, okungaholela ekunciphiseni ukukhiqiza. Kodwa, uma izinkampani ziqonda kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga zokusebenza ukude, zingakwazi ukuhlela izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza kube lula. Ukuze izinkampani zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela imihlangano evamile, noma ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikuvumela ukuthi uxhume nabanye abasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bazizwe bejabulile futhi bephumelela emsebenzini wabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, izifundo, noma amathuba okukhula emsebenzini kungasiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Kubhalwe futhi ukuthi ukusebenza ukude akusho ukuthi abasebenzi badinga ukusebenza isikhathi eside. Ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezikhathi zokuphumula. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abasebenzi bakwazi ukujabulisa imisebenzi yabo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza ukude ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika kuyithuba elikhulu, kodwa kudinga ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde kahle izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Uma izinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana, ukuthuthukisa abasebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, zingakwazi ukuhamba phambili futhi zibe neqhaza elikhulu emnothweni. Ukusebenza ukude akusiyo nje indlela yokusebenza, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila engcono, futhi kufanele sithathe leli thuba ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Isingeniso Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kubonakala njengombono onjengokuthakazelisayo, kodwa empeleni, kuyinto ehlukumezayo ehlupha imiphakathi eminingi. Ukukhuluma ngalesi sihloko kubalulekile ukuze siqonde ububi bayo, sithole izindlela zokuvikela izingane, futhi sizame ukusiza abahlukunyezwayo. Kulesi sihloko, sizoxoxa ngalezi zinyathelo ezisemqoka ukuze sikwazi ukuvikeleka nokwelashwa kwabantu abahlukunyezwayo. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kungaba ngohlobo lwezinto ezithile. Kungaba ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, noma ngempela ngokocansi. Kubalulekile ukuqonda lokhu ukuze sikwazi ukuklama izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kubonakala ngokushaywa, ukuphonsa, noma ukulimaza izingane. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokwengqondo kugxile ekudluliseni imiyalezo eyingozi, ukujabulisa izingane noma ukuzithiba ngokweqile. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi, lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi kungenzeka nezimo ezinzima kakhulu, lapho izingane zibekelwa engcupheni yokwanda kokuhlukunyezwa ukuphila kwazo. Isigaba 2: Izimpawu Zokuhlukunyezwa Ukuze siqonde ukuthi izingane zihlukunyezwa, kumele sazi izimpawu ezithile ezingabhekiselwa kuyo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungaphatheki kahle, ukulahleka kwezitho zomzimba, ukugula kaningi, ukugxila okuphambeneyo, nempilo engajwayelekile. Izingane zingaba nezingxoxo ezinjalo, ezikhulu noma ezincane, ezihambelana nokuhlukunyezwa, futhi lezi zimpawu kufanele ziqubule ubugovu bethu njengezizwe. Uma sithola izimpawu ezithandwayo, kubalulekile ukuba sithumele izidingo zomthetho ukuze kube nokuqonda okungenzeka kokuhlukunyezwa. Isigaba 3: Ukwazisa Abazali Nabantu Kulabo abaphethe izingane, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi izindlela zokuvikela izingane zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa izingane ngezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa, ukuhlola izimo eziphazamisayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuba nemisebenzi yokukhulumisana nezingane. Abazali kufanele babe neziqondiso ezicacile zokukhuluma nezingane zabo, ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ukuzethemba kwezengqondo. Ukwamukela imizwa ezinhliziyweni zabo kubalulekile, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi bazizwe bekhululekile ukuveza izifiso zabo. Isigaba 4: Izinhlelo Zokuvikela Kunemisebenzi yokuvikela ehlukahlukene engaqashwa emiphakathini ukuze kuncishiswe ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane. Lokhu kungafaka izinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi, imfundo kaMasipala, kanye nokuxhasa abahlukunyezwayo. Umphakathi ungashintsha ngenhloso yokuvikela izingane, kungase kudingeke ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuphila ezinhlobonhlobo ezihlanganisa ukuxhumana, ubudlelwane bezakhamuzi, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Imigomo yokuxhasa lezi zinhlelo kufanele ibonise ubuqiniso, ubumbano, nokuzinikela. Isigaba 5: Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zokwelapha Uma umntwana ethola ukuthi uhlukunyezwa, kubalulekile ukuba ahlole izikhungo zempilo ukuze afune usizo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhuluma nochwepheshe abafana nodokotela, abelaphi, noma abelaphi benganekwane. Izikhungo zempilo zendlela efanele yokuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele, futhi ikakhulukazi kubalulekile ukuba zihambisane nezidingo zomntwana. Ngezikhathi ezinjalo, amakhosikazi nezinsizwa ezixeshe umphakathi zingaba izikhumbuzo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezivela kwezinye izinkinga ezinzima. Isigaba 6: Ukubamba imithwalo Ekugcineni, kube nemithwalo eyinkimbinkimbi kulesi sici sokuqeqeshelwa, okuhloswe ngakho ukuvasha ukukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Lokhu kumele kubonakale ekufundeni nasekuqhamukeleni, futhi lokho kumele kubhalwe ezikhathini ezithile ukuze kuvezwe ubuchwepheshe. Ukuhlanganyela kwenhlalakahle kuyadingeka ukuze kuze kube khona impumelelo yokugcina. Kukho izinselele ezinzima ezihlanganisayo ubuchopho, kodwa ukuxhumana kufanele kube yimbangela yokuphumelela. Isiphetho Ukwazi ngezinselele azikhungathekile isimo sokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kudinga imizamo eminingi yokubamba imithwalo, ukufunda izimpawu, nokwakha umphakathi ovikelayo. Lokhu kusebenza ekuzuzeni indawo engcono yokuvikela izingane. Ngakho-ke, sekuyisikhathi sokuba balwa ngalolu hlobo lokuhlukunyezwa, besebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokuqhakambisa ubudlelwano, ukukhuluma ngezinkinga eziphambili, nokuhlinzeka ngosizo. Ubuqotho nokuzinikela kulolu hlelo lungaholela ezinzuzweni ezikhulu emikhakheni yokuhlukahluka, kodwana cabanga ukufaka kungaphakathi kwezingane ukuze ziphumelele empilweni.
ISIHLOKO: I-TikTok I-TikTok ikhulile ngokushesha eminyakeni edlule, yaba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. Le app, ethokoziswa kakhulu ngabasha, ishintshe indlela abantu ababelana ngayo ngemicabango, imizwa, nezithombe. I-TikTok ibonisa umhlaba wonke ngokuhlanganisa ukudlalwa, ukuveza ama-video amafushane, kanye nokwakha izinkanyezi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukwakhiwa kwe-TikTok I-TikTok yasungulwa ngo-2016 e-China ngaphansi kwegama le-Douyin, yabe isithola udumo emhlabeni wonke ngo-2018. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinguquko eziningi ezithuthukisa ulwazi lomsebenzisi, okusiza ekusakazeni imizwa nokuzijabulisa. Ukuhlanganyela kwabantu ku-TikTok kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene zokuzijabulisa, ezobuciko, nezamakhono. Ukusebenza Kwe-TikTok I-TikTok iyabavumela abantu ukuba benze ama-video kalula, ikakhulukazi ezimfushane ezithokozisayo. Izici zayo ezihlukahlukene, njengezinhlelo zokuhlela, imaski, nemisindo ehlukahlukene, zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi wonke umuntu akhe okuqukethwe okwakhe. Amathuba okwakha imiyalezo ahluke kakhulu, kusukela kumavidiyo amahlekisayo, amahora okudansa, kuya ezinhlelweni ezijulile zemicabango. Lokhu kuveza ukuhlukahluka komphakathi futhi kuholele ekwakhiweni kwenkulumo nezinkanyezi ezintsha. Uhlanga Lokukhuthaza Enye yezinto ezithokozisayo nge-TikTok ukuhamba kwayo ngokushesha. Abantu abaningi baqala ukufinyelela kuzithombe ezaziwayo, imisebenzi, nezixhumanisi ezitholakala kulolu hlelo. Ukuphumelela kwe-TikTok kuholele ezinkanyezini eziningi ezahlukahlukene, ezingama-‘influencers’ abakhuluma ngendlela yokwakha ubunikazi, baphuma emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Lokhu kuholela ekugcineni kokuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo, kulethe izinzuzo kubathengisi abancane nabakhulu. Ubuciko Bokuxhumana I-TikTok ivula izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukuhlanganyela abantu ezindabeni ezithile, njengokuhlola izinjongo zomphakathi, kudala umxholo ohlanganyela, ogxile ekuboneni umnotho wobuciko nezehlakalo zomhlaba. Lokhu kwenza ukuphepha komphakathi kube kuhle, futhi umphakathi uphila ngokubambisana, ubonisa ubuciko nolwazi lwesimanje. Ubungozi BokuToxicity Nokho, i-TikTok ayinakho konke okuhle. Kunezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu, okubandakanya ubuvila bokuphila, ukusakazwa kwemikhiqizo emibi, nocansi olubi. Izinselelo zokuphepha zabantu abasha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho omncane, zikhula. Ukukhathazeka ngokuphepha kuhambisana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubantu. Ukunakisisa Komphakathi Kweminye imiphakathi, abantu basebenzisa i-TikTok ukukhuthaza izindaba ezithinta umphakathi, ukulwela amalungelo, nezinkinga ezibucayi. Kwamanye amacala, kukhona ukungaboni ngasolinye okubangela umoya wokungabambisani. Ukuphendula okubalulekile kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela ubumbano phakathi kwabo, benza izinkinga zomphakathi zibe yizithako ezivuthayo. Isiphetho I-TikTok iyathakazelisa ekwenzeni izinto zesimanje, ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezihlukahlukene nezizwe. Ngabe ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe baluzenzo bungaba yinzuzo ekwakheni uthando nolwazi phakathi kwabantu? Lokhu kuncike kumuntu ngamunye. Kunezinto eziningi okufanele zihlolwe kulokhu, kanti impumelelo ye-TikTok ibonisa ukubaluleka kolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe emiphakathini yanamuhla. I-TikTok iyisixhumanisi esikhafulayo, esivulela iminyango emisha, futhi akungabazeki, kuzoholela ezintweni ezinhle. Ngokuhlanganisa ubuciko, izinkanyezi ezintsha, nezinto eziningi ezikhanga, i-TikTok ibonisa indlela ephilayo yokuzijabulisa, kodwa kubalulekile ukufundisa, ukuvikela, nokuhlonipha ubukhosi bomphakathi. Njengoba isikhathi siqhubekela phambili, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi sisebenzisa le ndawo yokubambisana ngendlela efanele, ukuze sibe nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomunye nomunye.
Ulwazi luthathwe encwadini ebizwa ngokuthi, Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ubhontshisi. Zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni lapho zingafaneleki khona zingabizwa ngokuthi "izihlahla eziphikisanayo." Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingumphikisi wabakhiqizi bokudla - ziqhathanisa nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, ukukhanya kwelanga, nezithako, zenze izinkinga ngesikhathi sokuvuna, zingangcolisa imbewu noma zishintshe umbala wembewu, imbewu yazo ingaba yingozi futhi ilethe ezinye izifo ezibeka ubungozi ezitshalweni ezikhulisiwe. Ngokujwayelekile, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zikhula ngokushesha futhi zikhulisa imbewu eningi, zikwazi ukusabalala kalula futhi zikhule ngokushesha. Njengomthetho, ziba nezimpande eziqinile futhi zingakhula ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ziyinkinga ukuyilawula, ziqhathanisa ngokuqinile nezinye izitshalo. Zivame ukuvuthwa ngokushesha, ngakho-ke zikhula ngokushesha. Izimpande zeziqholo eziphikisanayo zivame ukungena phansi emhlabathini, zivumela ukuthi zihlale zikhona ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ezikhula minyaka yonke zifaka ukudla kwazo phansi komhlabathi - ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukuhlala zikhona ngesikhathi esinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingama ngokushesha phakathi konyaka, noma zingakhula iminyaka emibili, noma zingakhula minyaka yonke futhi zikhulise imbewu minyaka yonke. Kungani kubalulekile ukuphatha (ukubulala) izihlahla eziphikisanayo? Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziqhathanisa nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, izithako, isikhala, nokukhanya kwelanga. Lokhu kudala ubungozi ezitshalo zokudla ngoba kuvimba ukukhula okufanele kwezitshalo futhi kunciphisa umkhiqizo. Lokhu kuqhathanisa kungangcolisa imbewu yokudla, kunciphise umkhiqizo, futhi kuthinte ikhwalithi yembewu yokudla. Ukuncintisana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhluka phakathi kwezitshalo ezahlukene - kungadala ubungozi obuphakathi kuka-10% kuya phezulu kuka-98%. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziqala ukuqhathanisa nezinye izitshalo uma izimpande zazo seziqhakazile. Ukuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhlose ukuvimbela le mqhudelwano ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke, futhi ukuvimbela izihlahla eziphikisanayo ekukhuleni nasekuphuleni imbewu yazo ezizovuthwa uma ezinye izitshalo zifakwe. Kukhona izindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo - ngokomshini (ukuvuna) nangokwenziwa kwezinto. Njengomthetho, ukuvuna kuphela, noma inhlanganisela yokuvuna nokufaka ama-herbicides kungaba yindlela eshibhile. Ukukhetha indlela kusezandleni zomlimi, ukukhetha kwabo, ulwazi, kanye namandla okuthola abasebenzi, imishini, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka nokuphuma. Ukuphathwa kwezihlahla eziphikisanayo kufanele kwenzeke njalo uma kuqala ukulima, uma prepariwa izinkambu zokufaka, ngesikhathi sokufaka, nangesikhathi izitshalo zikhula. Ngale ndlela, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zihlala zisetshenziswa ngokomshini ukuvimbela imbewu yazo ekufakweni. Lokhu kungenzeka ngaphambi kokufaka (inkambu kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile) futhi ekuqaleni kokukhula kwezitshalo. Kubalulekile ukubulala izitshalo eziphikisanayo uma zincane ukuze zingakwazi ukuqhathanisa nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi, futhi izimpande zezithako zokudla azizukulimala kalula uma nazo zincane. Uma izitshalo eziphikisanayo zinezimpande eziqinile, ukuvuna kuzokwazi futhi ukulimaza izimpande zezithako zokudla. Kukhona amakhemikhali ahlukaniseka ngamanzi, ama-granular, kanye nezinye izihlahla eziphikisanayo ezingekho emoyeni ezisetshenziselwa ukubulala izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi inani le-herbicide elisetshenzisiwe libe nekhwalithi futhi isikhathi sokufaka sibalulekile. Lezi zinto zingahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezimbili: ukukhetha nokungakhethi. Lezo ezingakhethi zibulala zonke izitshalo ezithintana nazo, kanti lezo ezikhethiweyo zibulala kuphela izihlahla ezithile, zishiya izitshalo zokudla zingalimali. Lezo ezingakhethi zingafakwa phakathi kwemigqa yezitshalo ukuze zibulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo lapho kodwa azithinti izitshalo zokudla. Ama-herbicides asebenza ngezindlela ezimbili - eyodwa isebenza ngokuxhumana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo, enye isebenza ngokungena ohlelweni lokukhula kwezitshalo. I-herbicide yokuxhumana ibulala amaqabunga, ngakho-ke izihlahla eziphikisanayo kufanele zibe namanzi amahle nge-herbicide. Le herbicide ivame ukusebenza kahle uma izitshalo zincane. I-systemic iyahamba ngaphakathi kwezitshalo, ingafakwa kumaqabunga kodwa izobulala nezimpande. Kukhona nezinye izinhlobo zama-herbicides - ama-herbicides aphambi kokuvuthwa (afakwa ngaphambi kokuthi isitshalo sikhule) kanye nama-herbicides emva kokuvuthwa (afakwa ngemva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule). Ama-herbicides aphambi kokuvuthwa ahlala emhlabathini futhi athathwa ngezimpande uma isitshalo siqala ukukhula; ama-herbicides emva kokuvuthwa athathwa ngamaqabunga nezitho zezithombo. Ukufaka ama-herbicides kuyashesha uma siwuhlanganisa nokuvuna. Ezinye izinhlobo zama-herbicides zisebenza isikhathi eside, ngakho akudingeki ukuthi ubuyele futhi ubulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Uma kunenhlama enkulu futhi izinkambu zimanzi kakhulu, kungaba nzima ukungena enkambini ngetraktori edonsela umshini wokuvuna, kodwa ungakwazi ukungena ngomshini ophonsa i-herbicide. Ukufaka ama-herbicides kuzosebenza kangcono ngaleso sikhathi.
Umuntu ongumzali waseNingizimu Afrika ngokokhokho ungumuntu owazalwa ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika kumzali okungenani oyedwa owayengumzali waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuzalwa kwezingane kumele kubhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwezokuzalwa Nezokufa, 1992. Qedela ifomu le-BI-24. Abazali abanguMazwe aseNingizimu Afrika kumele baqedele ifomu le-BI-529. Mayelana nokutholwa, kumele uhambisane nesinqumo sokutholwa. Thumela ikhophi yesitifiketi sokuzalwa sangaphandle. Thumela amakhophi ezitifiketi zomshado zomfakisicelo nabazali. Uma umfakisicelo ezalwa ngaphandle komshado, bobabili abazali kumele basayine ifomu lokubhaliswa kokuzalwa le-BI-24. Thumela ubufakazi uma umzali waseNingizimu Afrika ethole ubuzwe phesheya. Thumela ubufakazi bokuzalwa komzali waseNingizimu Afrika. Izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane leziphathimandla.
I-Kweekgrass - ingabe kukhona indlela yokususa le mithi engafunwa kalula? I-Cynodon dactylon (i-quickgrass, i-couch grass) icatshangwa ukuthi ivela emiphakathini e-Afrika noma e-Asia. Le grass itholakala ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika futhi ibeka ingozi ezitshalweni zokudla nasemathafeni. I-Kweekgrass iyigrasu ephansi ekhula ngokushesha futhi isakazeka ngezinhlayiya nezimpande. Le grass ingakhuliswa ngezinsiza zokulima nezilwane. I-Kweekgrass ngokuvamile ayikhuli phezulu, ivamise ukungadluli ku-40 cm. Ihlamvu lesitshalo linemibono efana nezandla enezikhala ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7, futhi ubude bayo buphakathi kuka-3 cm kuya ku-6 cm. Izimpande zayo zinemibala emnyama kuya emnyama, shine, futhi zilingana no-1.1 mm ubude kuya ku-0.7 mm ububanzi. Iqala ukukhula ngokushesha futhi izinza kahle. I-Kweekgrass iyisiphikisi esiqinile, idala ingozi ezindaweni ze-concrete ne-asphalt. Njengoba i-kweekgrass iqala ukukhula ngokushesha, isetshenziswa ezindaweni ezinomhlabathi ophukile. Izinhlobo eziningi ze-kweekgrass zisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezine-lawn, lapho kukhona amanzi agijimayo (NK 37), emagcekeni, ezinkundleni zomjaho, nasemaphandleni okuzijabulisa. I-Kweekgrass iyaphikisana kakhulu nezitshalo zokudla ukuze ithole isikhala, ukukhanya (ilanga), amanzi, nezithako emhlabathini. Iphinde ibambe ezinsizeni zokulima, okungadala ingozi ethinta izindleko. Bonke bayabuza: Ingabe singaphatha/susa i-kweekgrass? Yebo, singaphatha i-kweekgrass, kodwa akukho isixazululo esisheshayo. Ukulima kuphela akususi ngokuphelele. Ngokuvamile, izinsiza zokulima ziphula izinzwa, okwenza le mithi ikhule ngokushesha futhi isakazeke endaweni enkulu. Ekwindla (uFebhuwari noMashi), indlela yokukhupha izithako kule grass iyashintsha ngoba ikhipha izithako ezivela ezimpandeni ukuze iphumelele ezinyangeni ezibandayo. Le nkathi iyona ehamba phambili yokuphuza i-kweekgrass. Izi-6 liters ze-glyphosate (Roundup) nge-hectare zanele ukuphatha i-kweekgrass. I-Glyphosate ingena ezimpandeni futhi ibulale isitshalo sonke. Uma kukhona izindawo lapho ibuyela khona, ungaphuza lezo zindawo futhi. Kubalulekile ukubulala i-kweekgrass ezindaweni zemifula nasemgwaqweni ngoba lezi zindawo zingaholela ekukhuleni okusha kwe-kweekgrass. Enye indlela yokubulala i-kweekgrass ukuhlinza izinzwa nezimpande ebusika usebenzisa imishini. Ngemuva kwalolu work lwebusika, izinzwa nezimpande zizobuyela, linda zikhule kahle bese uphuzisa izi-6 liters ze-glyphosate nge-hectare - linda amasonto amathathu ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukulungisa umhlabathi ukuze uphande ngempelasonto. Ukubulala izitshalo ezine-leaf broad ezindaweni lapho izitshalo zokudla ezine-leaf broad zikhuliswa (njengama-soybeans) nokubulala izitshalo ezifanayo ezindaweni lapho izitshalo ezine-leaf elincane zikhuliswa kuyinkinga njalo kubalimi. Ngakho-ke, kunzima ukubulala i-kweekgrass emkhakheni we-maize. Uma kungenzeka, zama ukutshala isitshalo esine-leaf broad ngonyaka ozayo (njengama-soybeans, ama-nuts, noma ama-sunflowers) bese ubulala i-kweekgrass ngaleso sikhathi. Xhumana nomphakathi wezokwelapha wezokwelapha ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ngemuva kokuvuna isitshalo esine-leaf broad, ungahlinza izinzwa nezimpande ebusika bese uphuzisa izi-6 liters ze-glyphosate nge-hectare. Phinda zonke izinyathelo ezishiwo ngenhla. Uzobona ukuthi ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, i-kweekgrass izoba lula ukuyiphatha. Ngaphambi kokuphuza i-glyphosate, i-kweekgrass kufanele ibe isiqinile futhi ibe nezinhlamvu eziningi ukuze ikwazi ukuthola i-herbicide. Awufanele uphuzise i-glyphosate uma i-kweekgrass ibhujiswa (ifakwe, umswakama, noma uma kukhona amanzi amaningi) ngoba izinhlamvu ngeke zikwazi ukuthola i-herbicide kahle. Landela imiyalelo ebhukwini le-herbicide ngokucophelela. Qaphela ukuthi i-herbicide ingahamba iye kwezinye izitshalo. Qaphela ukuthi izinga lamanzi ahlanganiswe ne-glyphosate lingathinta ukusebenza kwe-herbicide - sebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngezinye izikhathi kungadingeka ukuhlanganisa i-ammonium sulfate ne-glyphosate. Khumbula ukuthi ukukhokha inani elincane ngesikhathi esifushane kungaholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu esikhathini eside - sebenzisa i-herbicide ngendlela efanele ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimo Zamanje Njengoba uhamba phambili, umphakathi ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta izindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kukhuphuka, okukhuluma ngakho, akukhona nje kuphela okuthinta abantu abajwayelekile, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda imiphumela yalo kumphakathi jikelele. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinguquko, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu eziholela ekukhuphukeni kwezindleko, imiphumela yazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Izizathu Zokukhuphuka Kwezindleko Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole izizathu eziyinqaba eziholela ekukhuphukeni kwezindleko zokuphila. Enye yezizathu ezinkulu ibangelwa ukwanda kwezindleko zokukhiqiza. Njengoba izindleko zokuthenga izinto zokwakha, izinsiza, nezinsiza zokusebenza zikhuphuka, abenzi bezimpahla baphinde baphakamise amanani. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bahlupheke kakhulu uma bephokophela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo eyisisekelo, njengokudla, izimpahla zokugqoka, nezinsiza zokuhlala. Okwesibili, ukwanda kokungasebenzi kahle emnothweni nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Njengoba abantu bengatholi imisebenzi, umnotho uyabola, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila. Abantu abangenamali yokwengeza, bahlala bejolise ekuthengeni izinto ezisemqoka kuphela, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Imiphumela Yokukhuphuka Kwezindleko Imiphumela yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila ibonakala ngokucacile. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zabo zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezifo zengqondo. Abantu bahlala bejolise ekunciphiseni izindleko, okwenza kube nzima ukujabulisa imindeni yabo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophukile, lapho abantu behluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kudala ukungalingani emnothweni. Abantu abathola imali encane bahlushwa kakhulu, kuyilapho abathola imali eningi beqhubeka nokuphila kahle. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onobandlululo, lapho abanye bejabulile kanti abanye behlupheka. Lokhu akuhambisani nemigomo yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Izixazululo Zokubhekana Nezindleko Zokuphila Ukuze siqonde lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele enze izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwandisa izinhlelo zokuphakela ukudla, ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhlala, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokusebenza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile kahle, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokungakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zabo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazitholele izindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda ngezindlela zokonga, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele, kanye nokuthenga izinto ezisemqoka kuphela. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle, kufanele bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Isiphetho Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuhlola izizathu eziholela ekukhuphukeni kwezindleko, imiphumela yazo, kanye nezixazululo ezithile, kubalulekile ukuze sithole indlela yokubhekana nale nkinga. Umphakathi kufanele ube nezinqumo eziphusile, futhi uhulumeni kufanele enze izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukuphila kahle.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Umbuzo 1: Yini eyaholela ekwenziweni kokulalelwa kwePhalamende ngale nkinga kagesi? Impendulo: Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kwenziwa ngenxa yokukhathazeka okukhulu kwabantu mayelana nezinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Izinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi zibhakane nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, izinkinga zokuphatha, kanye nezinguquko ezinkulu emnothweni. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kagesi, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuthi uhulumeni abheke le nkinga ngokujulile. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyayibhekwa ngesikhathi sokulalelwa? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi sokulalelwa, bekubhekwa izici eziningi, kuhlanganise nezizathu zokuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kagesi, izinqubo zokuphatha ezikhona, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ugesi ongenamaphutha. Abamele izinkampani zikagesi, izikhulu zikahulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele babenethuba lokwethula imibono yabo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinkinga eziphawulekayo ezavela ngesikhathi sokulalelwa? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinkinga eziphawulekayo ezavela zifaka phakathi ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokukhiqiza ugesi, izinkinga zokuphatha ezikhona, kanye nokuntuleka kokuxhumana phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi nohulumeni. Abanye baphinde bakhomba ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo ezintsha zokukhiqiza ugesi zidinga ukusheshiswa ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Umbuzo 4: Kuthiwani ngemuva kokulalelwa? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokulalelwa, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni athathe izinyathelo ezithile ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izikhungo ezintsha, ukwandisa imithombo yokukhiqiza ugesi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kubasebenzi ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo zomkhakha. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi iziphakamiso ezivela kulalelwa? Impendulo: Iziphakamiso eziningi zaphakanyiswa, kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo, ukwandiswa kwemithombo yokukhiqiza ugesi, nokuhlinzeka ngama-subsidies ezinkampanini ezincane ezikhiqiza ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola ugesi, kuze kube yilapho izinkampani zikagesi zikhulisa ukukhiqiza kwazo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa uhulumeni ukuze abhekane nale nkinga? Impendulo: Uhulumeni uthatha izinyathelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo ezintsha, ukuhlinzeka ngama-grants ezinkampanini ezikhiqiza ugesi, kanye nokwakha imithetho eqinile yokuphatha izinkampani zikagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ongenamaphutha kubantu. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngempumelelo yokulalelwa? Impendulo: Impumelelo yokulalelwa izobonakala kuphela uma izinyathelo eziphakanyisiwe zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani zikagesi, kanye nabantu. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kuzodingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nohulumeni ekuthatheni izinyathelo? Impendulo: Uhlelo lokuthatha izinyathelo luhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezimali, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izixazululo ezithile ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izindlela zokuxhumana ezitholakala phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi nohulumeni? Impendulo: Izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezinkampani zikagesi nohulumeni zifaka phakathi imihlangano, izinkomfa, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zikagesi ziyaqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 10: Kuthiwani ngekusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi eNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: Ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi eNingizimu Afrika lidinga ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuzodinga ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ukwandiswa kwemithombo yokukhiqiza ugesi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwezakhamuzi ukuze ziqonde kahle izidingo zomkhakha. Isiphetho: Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kubonisa ubukhulu bokukhathazeka kwabantu ngalesi simo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani zikagesi, kanye nabantu basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi kuzodinga ukubambisana okuqhubekayo.
Ukuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo (GEMS statistical data handling) Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile yokuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni weGEMS (Global Education Monitoring System). Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa nomnu. Mthethwa, ongumqondisi wezibalo eGEMS, ukuze sithole umbono wakhe ngale ndaba. Ingxoxo Umbuzo 1: Mthethwa, ungachaza kanjani umsebenzi wakho eGEMS? Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga ngokungibiza. Njengomqondisi wezibalo, umsebenzi wami uwukuphatha, ukuhlaziya, nokuhlinzeka ngedatha yezibalo ethinta imfundo emhlabeni jikelele. Sisebenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imfundo iyatholakala, iyasebenza, futhi iyathuthukiswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuqoqa idatha ethile, ukuyihlela, nokuyihlaziya ukuze sithole izindlela zokwenza ngcono imfundo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene neGEMS ekuphathweni kwedatha? Mthethwa: Kunezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuqoqa idatha ezindaweni ezahlukene kungaba nzima. Kunezimo ezihlukene zomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezamasiko ezithinta indlela idatha eqoqwa ngayo. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngedatha enembile kuyinselelo. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi idatha esiyitholayo iyakhombisa iqiniso lemfundo kulezo zindawo. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezinsiza ezanele. Umbuzo 3: Uthini umbono wakho ngokuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ekuphathweni kwedatha? Mthethwa: Ngiyavuma ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphendule indlela esiphatha ngayo idatha. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izinhlelo zokuhlaziya, kanye nezinsiza zokugcina idatha zenza kube lula ukuqoqa, ukuhlela, nokuhlaziya idatha. Lokhu kusinika ithuba lokuthola imiphumela esheshayo, okwenza kube lula ukusiza izinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta imfundo. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani iGEMS ibambisana nezinye izinhlangano ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa kwedatha? Mthethwa: Sisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlangano eziningi, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo. Lezi zixhumanisi zisiza ekutholeni idatha enembile, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yethu iyasetshenziswa. Ngokubambisana, sithola izinsiza eziningi, futhi sabelana ngolwazi oluwusizo. Umbuzo 5: Uthini umphumela wokuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo emfundweni? Mthethwa: Ukuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo kunomthelela omkhulu emfundweni. Lokhu kusinika ithuba lokuhlola ukuthi imfundo iyatholakala yini, iyasebenza, futhi iyathuthukiswa. Ngale ndlela, sikwazi ukubona izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, futhi sithole izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemfundo, okugcina kuholela ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iyavikeleka? Mthethwa: Ukuze siqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwedatha, sithatha izinyathelo eziningi. Sisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha eziphambili, futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi kuphela abantu abanegunya abakwazi ukufinyelela idatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi bethu ukuze baqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka kwedatha. Umbuzo 7: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo? Mthethwa: Ngibona ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha nokuhlaziya idatha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela esheshayo, futhi sizokwazi ukusiza izinqumo ezibalulekile ezithinta imfundo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobona ukwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene, okuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemfundo emhlabeni jikelele. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, ukuphathwa kwedatha yezibalo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Njengoba sithole imiqondo ehlukahlukene emqondweni kaMthethwa, sithola ukuthi izinselelo zikhona, kodwa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukayo kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha le datha. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemfundo, okubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Sifisa iGEMS nethimba layo konke okuhle emizamweni yabo yokuphatha idatha yezibalo.
Izinkinga Zamanzi: Ingxoxo Nenduna Yendawo Isingeniso Uthando lwamanzi luyimpilo, kodwa ezindaweni eziningi zethu, izinkinga zamanzi zikhula ngokushesha. Ukuze siqonde kangcono lezi zinkinga, sithintane nenduna yendawo, uMnumzane Dlamini, ukuze sithole umbono wakhe. Umbuzo 1: Uthini umbono wakho ngezinselele zamanzi esizweni sethu? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Izinkinga zamanzi zikhula kakhulu. Ngabe kukhona okukhuluma ngezinye izinsuku, kodwa ukudlula kwesikhathi, abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Izifunda eziningi zethu ziyaqhubeka nokubhekana nezinkinga zokuntula amanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinzima, njengokungaphumi kahle kwezinhlaka zomphakathi.” Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izimbangela ezikhona zokuntula amanzi? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Kunezinto eziningi ezithinta le nkinga. Okokuqala, imvula iyancipha, futhi le miphumela ibangelwa izinguquko zesimo sezulu. Okwesibili, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, ikakhulukazi emithonjeni yamanzi, kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga. Ngesikhathi sokuhlala, izinkampani ezinkulu zifaka imfucuza emithonjeni, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile.” Umbuzo 3: Uthini umbono wakho ngempilo yomphakathi ngenxa yezinkinga zamanzi? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Impilo yomphakathi ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola amanzi, futhi lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka. Ukuntula amanzi ahlanzekile kuholela ezinkingeni zempilo, njengezifo ezithathelwana emanzini. Abantu abakwazi ukuhamba kahle, futhi lokhu kubangela ukwehla komnotho. Umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo ezinjalo ezidinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo.” Umbuzo 4: Kukhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Yebo, zikhona izixazululo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngendlela yokugcina amanzi. Ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukungaphumeleli. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuhlanzwa kwamanzi kufanele ziqiniswa. Kukhona amaphrojekthi amaningi angasebenza ukusiza abantu bakithi, kepha kudinga ubambiswano phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni.” Umbuzo 5: Yini umphakathi angayenza ukuze uthuthukise isimo samanzi? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Umphakathi unendima enkulu. Abantu kufanele babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuhlanzwa kwamanzi, futhi baziswe ngezindlela zokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Ukubambisana namanye amaqembu, njengezikhungo zomphakathi, kungasiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizosebenza. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi lapho umphakathi uhlanganisa imizamo, izinto ziba ngcono.” Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ubonisa umbono omuhle ngekusasa? UMnumzane Dlamini: “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi singathola izixazululo uma sisebenza ndawonye. Iziphakamiso ezithile zingahlala zifinyelelwa uma sikhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale benolwazi ngalezi zinkinga. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, nohulumeni kungaholela ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke siphikelela ekutholeni izixazululo.” Isiphetho Izinkinga zamanzi zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Njengoba sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizoba nenhlalakahle engcono. Njengoba uMnumzane Dlamini esho, ubambiswano nomphakathi, kanye nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo, kungasiza ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. Ngakho-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi sikwenze, kodwa kufanele sibe nomdlandla ekutholeni izixazululo. Njengoba sithuthukisa ulwazi, sithuthukisa umphakathi, futhi siphephisa ikusasa lethu.
Amabhizinisi Amancane (Small Businesses) Umbuzo 1: Yini amabhizinisi amancane? Impendulo: Amabhizinisi amancane angamabhizinisi asebenza ngezimali ezincane, futhi avamise ukuba nezisebenzi ezingu-1 kuye ku-50. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinto eziningi ezifana nezitolo, izimboni ezincane, izinsizakalo zokuthutha, kanye nezinsizakalo eziningi ezikhiqizwayo. Amabhizinisi amancane adlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, lapho edala amathuba emisebenzi futhi eqinisa umnotho wendawo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani amabhizinisi amancane ebalulekile? Impendulo: Amabhizinisi amancane abalulekile ngoba anciphisa ukwehla komnotho nokungasebenzi. Ngenxa yokuthi avame ukuba yizinkampani ezihloniphekile emiphakathini, akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi eminingi esiza abantu abaningi. Futhi, amabhizinisi amancane avame ukusebenza ngempumelelo, kube nemiphumela emihle ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselele ezithinta amabhizinisi amancane? Impendulo: Kuneziningi izinselele ezibhekene namabhizinisi amancane. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu kube yizinsiza ezikhudlwana ezingatholakali kalula, njengezimali, amakhono, nezinsiza zokuphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko emthethweni nasemigomeni yokuhweba zingabathinta ngokunjalo. Ukwenziwa kwezindleko eziphezulu, okungaholela ekutheni kube nzima ukuqhubeka, nakho kuyiqiniso. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokwakha ibhizinisi elincane? Impendulo: Ukwakha amabhizinisi amancane kuza nezinzuzo eziningi. Ukuze uqale, ungazithola udizayina futhi uhambise imikhiqizo eyakhelwe abantu bendawo, okwenza kube lula ukuheha amakhasimende. Futhi, amabhizinisi amancane avame ukuba nokuthuthukiswa okulula, kuthuthukiswe futhi kube nezinqubo ezizwakalayo. Lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi uhlale unolwazi olusheshayo lwezinguquko emakethe. Umbuzo 5: Umsebenzi wokuqonda nezinkinga zamabhizinisi amancane kufanele ubenjani? Impendulo: Ukuqonda nezinkinga zamabhizinisi amancane kufanele kube ngumsebenzi ohlanganisa ukucwaninga nokuhlola ukuphila kwamabhizinisi. Izikhulu zamabhizinisi kufanele zihlale ziqaphe izinguquko emakethe, zifunde izinkanyezi zamabhizinisi eziphumelele, futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obufanele ukuze zinze izinqumo ezizosiza ibhizinisi lezo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinqubo ezinhle zokuqalisa ibhizinisi elincane? Impendulo: Ukuqala ibhizinisi elincane, kubalulekile ukuba uhlose kahle, uhlole imakethe, futhi uqedele isu lokusebenza. Okokuqala, kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izidingo zabathengi bendawo. Lokhu kuzovumela ukuqonda ngokujulile ukuthi iziphi izindlela ezizosebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali lwezindleko zokuqala nokwenza abantu bakhulume ngendaba yakho kuyisici esibalulekile. Umbuzo 7: Uxhaso olusemthethweni lungatholakala kanjani? Impendulo: Uxhaso olusemthethweni lungatholakala ezihlotsheni eziningi. Izinhlelo zikamasipala nemifundaze yombuso zihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali kulabo abayaziyo, abakubhekisisa emiphakathini yabo. Izikhungo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, zibusisa ngolwazi, izinsizakalo, futhi zikhuthaza ukuphumeza izinhlelo zokuhlola. Umbuzo 8: Kufanele kwenziwe kanjani ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende? Impendulo: Ukuze wakhe ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende, kufanele kube nezindlela ezithile zokuxhumana. Ukulungiselela ukubonisana nokuqonda, njengamaworkshop noma izinkulumo, kuzosiza ekwakheni ukuxhumana okungcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, uqinisekise ukuthi izinkinga zixazululwa ngokushesha, kulindeleke ukuthi uthuthukise ubudlelwano. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe amabhizinisi amancane angazithola kanjani izinsiza ezithembekile? Impendulo: Amabhizinisi amancane angazithola izinsiza ezithembekile ngokubambisana nezinsiza zakwamanye amabhizinisi, noma imikhankaso yokukhangisa. Ukuhlola izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngempumelelo, ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile kuzokwenyusa izinga lokwaneliseka. Ukubamba iqhaza emikhankasweni yokuthola izinkampani ezisiza amabhizinisi amancane kungaba usizo olukhulu. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezilindelekile zomphakathi wezamabhizinisi amancane? Impendulo: Umphakathi wezamabhizinisi amancane ulindele ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuxhaswa, ukusimama, nokwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Izinhlelo ezifana nokuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu zehlisa imithombo yokusebenza engahlala impilo ebuyayo. Kulindeleke ukuthi imiphakathi ibuye ijabulele ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe okungabavulela amathuba amasha. Isiphetho Amabhizinisi amancane anendima ebalulekile emnothweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Noma kunjalo, bahlala bejabha nezinselele ezihlukahlukene. Ukuqonda izindawo ababambisene kuzobavulela amathuba amaningi, futhi kuzokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngethuba lokukhulisa izinzuzo zomphakathi ngendlela efanele. Ngenhloso yokwakha amabhizinisi amancane, nakanjani kudingeka umbono, ubuhlakani, nezinqubo ezisebenzayo ezinganikeza indlela yokuphumeza amaphupho emiphakathini yethu.
Kuyadingeka ukuthola nokusebenzisa izindlela ezizokwenziwa ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka kwemvelo yasolwandle. Izenzo zomnyango zokweseka ekukhishweni kwamalungelo. Izenzo noma ukuziphatha komfaki-sicelo: Umthetho nezinyathelo zomuntu onencwadi yokucela zizobuyekezwa. Ndawonye nalabo abazama ukwenza kahle bazobuyekezwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzobhalwa ukuthi izikhalazo zithunyelwa nge-imeyili. Ukukhishwa kwamafomu okucela kanye nezindlela zokukhokha. Umnyango awunankinga nokusebenzisa abameli, abeluleki, ngakho umnyango uzosebenzisa amafomu akhe okucela neminye imibhalo ukuze kugwenywe ukuhileleka kwabantu besithathu. Izimemo zokucela zizoshicilelwa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni. Umnyango uzokhetha ukuyibeka kwiwebhusayithi, ezincwadini, nasemaphandleni okudoba. Izimemo ngeke zifakwe kuMthetho Jikelele. Abafaki-sicelo bazonikezwa amakhophi uma becela. Nakuba umnyango ungenankinga nokusebenzisa abeluleki noma abameli, umnyango uzokwakha amafomu, imigomo, nemibhalo yakhe ukuze kuncishiswe ukuthembela kubantu besithathu. Umnyango uthanda ukuthi usizo lwabo lusetshenziswe ngaphambi kokuthi umuntu aqale ukusebenzisa abeluleki. Uhlu lwabathathi bezinqumo. Umnyango ulindele ukuthi kube nezicelo eziningi zokucela amalungelo. Ezinye zizophikiswa. Inqubo yokukhetha izobheka labo abanamaphuzu aphezulu. Lokhu akusho ukuthi labo abaphikisiwe abaqeqeshiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babe namaphuzu aphezulu. Okokuqala, isicelo sizobuyekezwa ngokuya ngokuthi sithunyelwe kanjani. Uma kutholakala ukuthi sithunyelwe sekwedlule isikhathi, uma umuntu engakhokhi izimali ezidingekayo, noma uma sithunyelwe ngendlela engalungile, njengokufakiswa ngefeksi noma usebenzisa ifomu elingalungile. Umthathi-zinqumo ngeke avume lokho ngenxa yokuthunyelwa okungafanele. Izicelo zabantu asebekhulile sezingaqhathaniswa nalabo abafuna ukujoyina. Abafaki-sicelo abakhona bazokwenziwa amaphuzu ngendlela efanayo kodwa izimfuneko ezifanayo zingasetshenziswa njengalabo abafaka izicelo ezintsha. Ukuphikiswa kuzobhekwa ngendlela ehlukile kubafaki-sicelo abasha. Bonke abanamaphuzu aphezulu bazophumelela. Kwamanye amalungelo okuthengisa, amalungelo azonikezwa isikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni engu-15, okukhona eziningi, izinga lokuguqulwa kwezinsiza zasolwandle, ulwazi lwezinto eziphilayo; nokuthuthukiswa kokudoba nokukhuthaza utshalomali nokuthuthukiswa komnotho; nokuziphatha kokudoba ikakhulukazi ezindabeni zomthetho. Kwamanye amasekthini, abanye bangadinga ukuthi izicelo zabo zibuyehlolwe nezindlela abazokhethwa ngazo ngemva kokukhishwa kwamalungelo. Labo abangenakuphumelela bazophumelela. Ukuqhubeka kwesikhathi samalungelo kulawulwa yimithetho yokudoba. Abathathi bezinqumo bazobuyekeza idatha yenkampani. Ulwazi ngeke luhlolwe. Ubunikazi obuyinzuzo bomfaki-sicelo bezinhlobo ezishiwo kuzobuyehlolwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphuzu engeziwe azobhekwa kulabo abafuna ukuphakamisa abantu abasebenza kulabo bahlala ngaphandle kwezinhlelo, kubonisa ukuthi abasebenzi bathola imivuzo ngendlela yokwabelana kulezi zinhlelo. Akukho izingcezu eziphethwe noma izingcezu ezinezimali ezizokwenziwa. Labo abanezingcezu, izinhlobo zizobuyekezwa. Isibonelo, uma inkampani inama-20% enkampanini B kanti inkampani A inama-10% ephethwe yizinhlobo ezithile, izingcezu zayo ziletha ama-2% ekuphathweni kwenkampani B. Abantu abaningi bezinhlobo ezithile nabesifazane abaqashwe ngumfaki-sicelo bangasetshenziswa njengokulinganisa. Amaphuzu amaningi azonikezwa kulabo abaqasha izinhlobo ezithile nabesifazane ezikhundleni eziphakeme kanye nemiholo yabo ephezulu. Isibonelo, abafaki-sicelo kumele bachaze abesifazane abangu-10% kulabo abaphakathi kokuhola, phakathi kuka-10% no-30% nakanjani, labo abaphansi kuka-50% naphakathi kuka-50%. Amaphuzu amaningi azonikezwa uma abantu bezinhlobo nabesifazane bethola imali ephezulu kunalokho okwenzeka ngaphambili. Umehluko emalini phakathi kwalabo abathola kakhulu nalabo abathola kancane nawo uzoba nomthelela. Phakathi kuka-1994 no-2004, abantu bempela baphumelele. Ukwanda kuvumele lezi zinto ukuba zifake le ndawo ukuze ziguquke. Umnyango ubona futhi ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi amalungelo anikeza izinsiza zokuzimela. Isizathu sokukhishwa kwamalungelo wesikhathi eside ukuthi kube nokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi futhi umnyango uthanda ukusebenza ngokubambisana ezindaweni eziningi. Abantu abasha bangasusa abakhulile abangasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka kubantu abadala abangaphumelelanga ekuguqulweni. Kwamanye amasekthini, labo abafaka izicelo bazokhawulelwa ngokungavumeli amalungelo kulabo abathola amaphuzu aphansi, ngokuba nezindawo ezincane, inani elikhulu lokuhlinzeka ngamalungelo. Abafaki-sicelo kumele bakhombise ukuthi bakhokha izimali ngendlela efanele zezinhlobo ezitholiwe (ngakho kufanele bakhombise lokho abakutholile uma benza kahle) phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi. Uma izimali zingakhokhiwe ngaphezulu kwezinsuku eziyi-60, umfaki-sicelo uzobanjwa. Uma amalungelo engakhiswanga, umnyango ngeke anikeze amalungelo aphelele kuze kube lezi zimali zikhokhiwe. Umnyango unama-rekhodi okwephula umthetho we-MLRA ozobuyekezwa ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwamalungelo. Bobabili abafaki-sicelo abasha nabakhona bacelwa ukuba baziveze ngendlela umnyango owazi ngayo, ophatha ngayo, futhi uthumele izicelo nokuthi amabhizinisi kufanele asebenze kanjani. Labo ozakwabo abangadobi izinkanyezi ngesikhathi sabo noma abangenayo imvume bazosuswa. Ukudoba okungaphansi kungase kusetshenziswe ngendlela engafanele. Umnyango uzokhipha izinombolo zokuthi zingaki ezitholakele ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwemvume. Umnyango uzokhipha futhi abantu ababa "phambili" ukuze benze kahle kwezinye izinto. Ukuba phambili kwenziwa uma umfaki-sicelo wokuguqulwa kwenzeka kwezinye izindawo noma uma beyi-HDP. Umthetho obizwa ngokuthi umthetho jikelele, umnyango ngeke uvumele abantu abanezimali zokudoba ukuthi bathengise noma bashiye ukudoba ukuze banikwe amalungelo futhi. Kwamasekthini C no-D, imihlangano eminingi noma efana naleyo eyenziwe ngababeluleki nezinkampani zokudoba izokhishwa eziphepheni zezimali. Akukho ngaphezu kokuthi amalungelo amanye azonikezwa kulowo mndeni. Labo abafaka izicelo kumele bakhombise ukuthi bahlobene kanjani nezinye izindawo. Uma umuntu oyedwa emndenini efuna ilungelo, bonke abanye emndenini ngeke bakwazi ukuhileleka, ngaphandle uma othile echaza ngokusobala ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni ezincane zokudoba. Abafaki-sicelo kumele bakhombise ukuthi baphinde bazimisele ukuphakamisa ibhizinisi. Isizathu esibaluleke kakhulu sokukhishwa kwamalungelo wesikhathi eside ukuvula imisebenzi. Imisebenzi kumele yenziwe ngokuhamba ukuze kudalwe imisebenzi eminingi. Labo abanezimali bazodinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa nezitatimende zezezimali. Labo abafuna ukungena k
Ukudala Okuqukethwe: Uhambo Lokwakha Nokuqonda Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ethokozisayo, eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla — ukudala okuqukethwe. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukudala izithombe ezinhle noma ukubhala izindatshana? Cha, mngani! Lokhu kuhlanganisa yonke into esiyibona ku-inthanethi, kusukela ezithombeni ezithokozisayo kuze kube kumavidiyo ahlekisayo, izinkulumo, nezincwadi. Ngakho, ake siqale! Isinyathelo sokuqala: Ukuqonda Umqondo Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi yini lezi "okuqukethwe" okukhuluma ngayo. Uma sikhuluma ngokuqonda, sikhuluma ngempela ngokuqonda izithameli zethu. Yebo, kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona ukuthi abantu badinga ini, yini eyenza bahlale bejabule, futhi yini engabathokozisa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola, sithole izimpendulo ezivela kubantu, futhi sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokuxhumana. Isinyathelo sesibili: Ukucabanga Ngokuqukethwe Ngemuva kokuba siqonde izithameli zethu, kudingeka siqale ukucabanga ngokuqukethwe esizokwakha. Lokhu kungaba yizindaba, izifundo, noma ngisho nemicabango yethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubona izinto ezithokozisayo, ezithinta abantu, futhi ezihambisana nezifiso zabo. Uma sithanda ukudala okuqukethwe, kufanele sibe nekhono lokucabanga ngaphandle kwebhokisi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe izingozi, sizame izinto ezintsha, futhi singesabi ukuphumelela noma ukuphumelela. Isinyathelo sesithathu: Ukudala Okuqukethwe Manje, sesifikile esigabeni sokudala. Lokhu kungaba yisikhathi esijabulisayo, kodwa futhi esinzima. Uma sibhala, kufanele sibe nekhono lokubhala kahle, sithumele imiyalezo ecacile, futhi sibe nekhono lokuxhumana kahle. Uma sithatha izithombe, kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona ubuhle ezindaweni ezilula. Futhi uma sikhuluma, kufanele sibe nekhono lokukhuluma ngendlela ethokozisayo, ethinta abantu. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, ukuzikhandla, nokuzimisela. Isinyathelo sesine: Ukuhlola Nokuthuthukisa Ngemuva kokudala, kudingeka sihlolisise lokho esikudalile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithole impendulo ezivela kubantu. Ngabe abantu bayakuthokozela? Ngabe bakuthola kulula? Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokwamukela impendulo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi iyinhle noma embi. Futhi, uma sithola izinkinga, kufanele sibe nekhono lokuzithuthukisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza ngcono, sithuthukise izindlela zethu, futhi siqhubeke nokufunda. Isinyathelo sesihlanu: Ukuxhumana Ngezokuxhumana Ngemuva kokudala okuqukethwe, kudingeka sithumele lokho esikudalile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuxhumana ngezokuxhumana. Lokhu kungaba ngezimali, izinkundla zokuxhumana, noma ngisho nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nekhono lokufinyelela izithameli zethu, sithumele imiyalezo yethu, futhi sibe nekhono lokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuxhumana, sibe nekhono lokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi sibe nekhono lokuphendula. Isinyathelo sesithupha: Ukuphila Ngokuqukethwe Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukudala okuqukethwe akupheli. Lokhu kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Njengoba sithuthukisa, kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola, sithole izindlela ezintsha, futhi sibe nekhono lokuhlala sithuthukisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuphila ngokuqukethwe, sithokozise, futhi sibe nekhono lokuhlala sithokozisa abanye. Ngakho, mngani, ukudala okuqukethwe akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubona, sithokozise, futhi sibe nekhono lokwakha umphakathi. Ngakho, yiba nesibindi, thola izindlela ezintsha, futhi uqhubeke nokudala! Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela nami kulolu hambo. Ngiyafisa ukukuzwa ngempumelelo yakho!
UXolile Dasheka wazalwa efemini endaweni yasePetrusburg. Ubaba wakhe wayesebenza efemini kanti umama wakhe wayengumsebenzi wezindlu. UXolile unedigri kuMphakathi kanye neHhotela kanye neDiploma kuMphakathi Wobudlelwano. Wathenga ifemini yakhe, iLemoenkloof, endaweni yaseJagersfontein ngo-2006 ngezikweletu ezivela kuLand Bank. Ifemini yakhe inobukhulu obuyi-1,134 hectares, lapho u-145 hectares kuyindawo yokulima kanti u-989 hectares isetshenziselwa ukugaya izinkomo. UXolile ukhula ikakhulu ufulawa, uphakamisa izinkomo zenyama, amaphiko, izinkukhu, futhi uphinde akhulise nemifino. Uthola kanjani imali yokuphatha izitshalo zakho? Emuva kweminyaka emibili edlule, angikathengisi izitshalo. Ngizisebenzise ukudla izinkomo zami. Ngisebenzise ezinye zezinzuzo engizitholile ukuphatha umkhiqizo wonyaka ozayo. Ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko, ngizozama ukuthola isikweletu ukusiza kuLand Bank. Ucabanga ukuthini ngezimo zezimali kwezolimo? Umkhiqizi kumele abe yizinto eziningi; ngokwesibonelo, kumele abe uchwepheshe kwezezimali, umnotho, umthengisi, nokunye okuningi. Izinzuzo ezitholakala ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zincane kakhulu. Sidinga umphakathi ukusiza abakhiqizi baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuthenga imikhiqizo yasendaweni. Sidinga ukuba kube nokuthengiswa kwemali ethile ezitshalweni ezingenayo ezweni. Izinzuzo zokufaka njenge-diesel nezokwenziwa ziyasiphuca. Ezolimo akuyona insimu ethokozisa intsha yabantu abamnyama; ababona ikusasa kuyo. Uma izindleko nezimpahla ezingenayo zingalawulwa, ukuncintisana okukhona ezimpahleni ezixhaswayo kuzophula umkhiqizi waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthola kuphi izinto zakho zokufaka? Ngithenga kulabo abamele abahlinzeki bezinkampani ezihlinzeka lezo zinto, ngemuva kokuthola nokuhlanganisa amanani aphakanyisiwe futhi ngicabangele ukusiza abakuhlinzekayo ngezinkinga ezivela ngemuva kokuthenga kubo. Yini indima kahulumeni kwezolimo futhi uyayifeza kanjani? Uhulumeni kumele anakekele abakhiqizi. Abakhiqizi bakha amathuba emisebenzi nokuzinza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Kumele babheke umhlaba onikezwa kubakhiqizi abasha kanye nosizo olunikezwa ukuze babasize baphumelele kwezezimali nasezinsizeni zokusebenza. Kumele kube nokukhuthazwa kulabo abakhiqizi abasebenzela ukwenza imali. Kumele kukhokhelwe amanani afanele, futhi ukusiza kumele kufunwe lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni uyazama, kodwa okwamanje akaphumelelanga. Ucabanga ukuthini okuthinta impumelelo yakho? Ikhono lami lokuphatha izinto eziningi lingenzele kahle. Izinkomo zikunikeza ukuzinza futhi zikusize ngemali oyidingayo. Ukuphakamisa amaphiko nezinkukhu kungisizile ukuhlangabezana nezindleko zami zenyanga. Nginephezi elincane lokulima elingu-3 hectares engazi ukuthi ngingalisebenzisa. Ngikhula imifino ukuze ngithole imali ngokushesha. Futhi, iqiniso lokuthi angigxilile ngokuphelele kwezolimo, nginokunye umsebenzi ongenakuphila, liyasiza. Uma ezolimo zingaba nemali eningi, ngizoba umkhiqizi wesikhathi esigcwele. Ucabanga ukuthini njengengozi empumelelweni yakho? Ngikhathazekile ukuthi ukungabi nobumbano kwezombusazwe, ukukhohlisana, nokukhuluma okukhanga izindaba kungaphazamisa amathuba ami empumelelo. Ukutholakala kwemali futhi kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Yiziphi izingxenye zokuhweba kwezolimo ofuna ukuzithuthukisa? Ngifuna ukuba nolwazi oluningi lobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuphathwa komhlaba, ukongiwa kwamanzi, nokunakekelwa kwezinkomo. Ngifuna futhi ukuthi abasebenzi bami bathole ukuqeqeshwa. Yisiphi isu ozophila ngaso kulo nyaka? Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwami lokusekela lukhona. I-Grain SA neqembu lami locwaningo kubalulekile ekunikezeni usizo. Ngifuna futhi ukukhulisa ukulima kwami kwezinkomo, okuyizinkomo zami zenyama. Uma ukukhohlisana kungasuswa, ngifuna ukuqala ukuphakamisa izimvu.
iNyuvesi yasePitoli: Ukwakhiwa Kwezemfundo Ezinomthelela Emphakathini INyuvesi yasePitoli, eyaziwa nangokuthi iUP, iyisikhungo semfundo ephakeme esikhipha izifundo eziningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kokuba indawo yokufunda, ibamba nendima yokwakha imiphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, nezifundo ezithuthukisa umqondo. Ngikholwa ukuthi lesi sikhungo sinomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa labafundi bethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo engcono nenqubekela phambili yomphakathi. Okokuqala, sizoqhubeka sihlole izinzuzo ezihlobene neNyuvesi yasePitoli. Le nyuvesi inikeza ukufinyelela kumakhono ahlukahlukene nezifundo ezahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izifundo zobunjiniyela, ezomnotho, ezokwelapha, nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala amathuba okwakha amaqembu anobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, ahlinzeka ngamasu okuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNyuvesi iseNingizimu Afrika ibonisa ukuthi ukwakha isikhala sokufunda nemisebenzi kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezimfanelweni eziphezulu. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zayo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibonakala ibeka phambili izifundo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinhlaka zayo zokufunda ziwuhlelo olwakhelwe phezu kokuhlangenwe nakho kwezemfundo, okwenza abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi bazokwenza kanjani ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Isibonelo, abafundi baphumelele ekwakheni izixazululo ezithile ezithinta imiphakathi yabo, njengokuhlinzeka ngezifundo zasekhaya, ukufundisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abampofu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNyuvesi yasePitoli inezinhlelo ezizimele ezihlanganisa ukubamba iqhaza emisebenzini ethile ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlinzeka abafundi ngamahora okusebenza, okwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo nezinhlangano eziphumelelayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwenza abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi imisebenzi ibukeka kanjani, kodwa futhi kubavulela amathuba okuthola izikhala emsebenzini. Izinhlelo zokuhlanganyela nabafundi abavela emiphakathini ehlukene zikhuthaza ukubambisana nokuqonda okungcono phakathi kwabafundi. Isimo sokufunda eNyuvesi yasePitoli sikhombisa ukuthi abafundi banesibopho sokwenza izinguquko. Abafundi bahlala bephushwa ukuba babe necebo eliphusile lokuxhumana nezinkinga zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa ububha, ukungalingani, nokungabi nendawo yokuhlala. Abanye baphumelela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusiza, njengezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu abasha ngokuqonda ubuchwepheshe, ezokuphepha, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Lokhu kukhuthaza umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza imiphakathi imatasa ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngaphezu kokuba yisikhungo semfundo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli iyindawo yokwakha izinjongo eziphumelelayo. Abafundi baye baveza umbono omusha ngempilo, ngempilo engcono, kanye nentuthuko ethinta izimpilo zabantu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwama-lecturers nabafundi kudala indawo yokuxoxa, okwenza kube lula ukufaka iziphakamiso ezithile ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, okwenza abafundi bazizwe bephakanyiswa. Ngokuphetha, iNyuvesi yasePitoli iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi izikhungo zemfundo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ngokuvumela abafundi bakwazi ukuqonda, ukufunda, nokwakha, le nyuvesi iyakwazi ukwakha isizukulwane esisha sabafundi abaqeqeshiwe futhi abalulekile emphakathini. Ngiphakamisa ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo kumele ziqhubeke zifuna izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwabafundi nophiko lwezokufunda, njengoba lokhu kuzoqinisa umphakathi wonke. Ngokugxila ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo, iNyuvesi yasePitoli ibonisa indlela yokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhule, bahlale bephokophele empumelelweni, neNyuvesi iyophumelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kanjalo, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ukuqonda, ukuxhumana, nobuhlakani bomphakathi ukuze sakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Iphasiwedi yokusebenza yeqembu elithile inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle uma lowo muntu efall under isigaba esithile esibekwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle ngonyaka, ngenothi kuGovement Gazette ngemva kokubonisana noNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuqashwa. Inani lezi zikhwama kuleli qembu alizokweqi inani elithile elibekwe enothini. Qedela ifomu le-BI-1738 ehhovisi le-embassy noma emnyangweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Umqashi kufanele azibophezele ekukhokheni amaphesenti amabili ezindleko zokuqeqesha. Qaphela: Ubufakazi bokukhokha kufanele buthunyelwe ezinsukwini ezintathu ngemuva kokwamukela iphasiwedi. Cela umqashi ofuna ukukuhola ukuthi aqedele ingxenye 13 yefomu le-BI-1738. Nikeza ubufakazi bokubhaliswa kanye nenhlangano yobungcweti noma ibhodi uma kusebenza. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.

Amahathi - Ukubaluleka Kwabo Empilweni Yethu Umhumushi: Sanibonani, nonke. Namuhla sikhuluma ngamaHlathi, indawo ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Nansi ingxoxo esiyihlelile noMnu. Dlamini, ongumsebenzi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuhlala, ukuze sihlolisise kabanzi ngalezi zindawo ezinkulu. Mnu. Dlamini, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngihlanganyele nawe namuhla. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, ngiyakujabulela ukukhuluma ngalolu daba. Amahathi ayindawo ebalulekile, futhi kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi awafaneleki kuphela njengendawo yokuphumula, kodwa anenhloso enkulu empilweni yethu. Umhumushi: Kulungile, ngiyacela uchaze kabanzi mayelana nokubaluleka kwamaHlathi. Mnu. Dlamini: Amahathi ayisitshalo esiyingqayizivele. Avikela umoya esiwuphefumulayo, angamakhaya ezilwane nezitshalo eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaHlathi adlala indima enkulu ekugcinweni kwamanzi. Amathafa ahlanzekile futhi anomoya opholile, athuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Umhumushi: Lokhu kuphinde kudinge ukuvikelwa. Iziphi izinselelo obhekana nazo kumahathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ziningi izinselelo.
