Okunye, izinguquko zezulu, ezihlanganisa ukushisa okwandayo kanye nokushoda kwemvula, kukhathaza kakhulu amaHlathi. Umhumushi: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela amaHlathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, ziningi izinyathelo. Imizi ethile isungule imikhankaso yokuvikela amaHlathi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini esebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo. Kunemizamo yokulima ngendlela ehlanzekile ezama ukunciphisa umthelela omubi kumahathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuvikela kwabantu zikhuthazwa, kufanele simise ukungcoliswa kwamaHlathi. Umhumushi: Ngabe ubona kanjani ikusasa lamaHlathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngicabanga ukuthi sinesikhathi sokulungisa izinto. Uma sithokozisa umphakathi mayelana nokubaluleka kwamaHlathi, sizoba nokuthi ngabe sikhulisa imizamo yethu yokuvikela. Ukwazisa abantu ngamalungelo nemisebenzi yabo, kuzobasiza ukuba bahlanganyele ekulondolozeni lezi zindawo ezibalulekile. Umhumushi: Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa izingane nokuqala lapho? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngempela. Izifundo ezitholakala ezikoleni mayelana nemvelo, amaHlathi, nezilwane ezifuywayo zibalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwakha umqondo wokuhlonipha izinsiza zemvelo phakathi kwezingane. Uthando nemfundo kudlula emaphakathini, eso kuzogcina sekuwumgomo ophumelelayo. Umhumushi: Lokhu kukhomba ukuthi sinesibopho sokuqinisekisa umhlaba osuhlukahlukene nesinjalo? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, wonke umuntu ubalulekile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezifundazwe, amabhizinisi, nemiphakathi kungaba nomthelela omuhle ekulondolozeni amaHlathi. Imizamo yethu akufanele ibhalwe emithonjeni ephambili kuphela; kufanele ikwenze ifinyelele kumphakathi ngokuphelele. Umhumushi: Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukwabelana nakho mayelana namahathi? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga ngokunginika ithuba lokukhuluma ngalokhu. Nginesifiso sokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi amaHlathi awasizi thina kuphela, kodwa anomthelela emhlabeni wonke. Omoya, amanzi, nezinto eziphilayo, konke kuhlangene. Futhi ukuzinda kwethu phakathi kwazo, kufanele sikuphinde sikwazi ukwenza lokho, okubekwe phezulu. Umhumushi: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Dlamini, ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile nalesi sihloko esibucayi. Ngithemba lokuthi sizobona umnotho kulobu bukhona bamaHlathi. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngijabule kakhulu. Ngiyaphinda ngiyavuma – amaHlathi awawusizo, kanti umsebenzi wethu udinga ukubambisana. Ngiyabonga! Umhumushi: Ngiyabonga, futhi sikhumbule ukuhlonipha nokuveza izinsiza ezisemhlabeni. Kuhle kudlula konke. Le ngxoxo ibonisa ukubaluleka kokugcina amaHlathi. Akukhona ukudla noma kuphela ukulondoloza izinkuni, kodwa kunokuhilonza impilo yethu. Ake sethule izinyathelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amaHlathi azothela emaphethelweni ethu nabazokhulisa lezi zinyathelo. Ngiyabonga nonke ngokuhlala seduze.
iTikTok - Uhlanga Lwezokuxhumana Olwakha Noma Oluphula? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTikTok iye yaba yinsika enkulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Le nsizakalo yokwabelana ngama-video, eyasungulwa ngo-2016, ibonakala iyinsiza ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ihlale ibhekwa ngamehlo anganeno. Kukhona abavuma ukuthi iTikTok iyinsiza ewusizo, ikhulisa ubuciko, futhi ibeka abantu phambili, kanti abanye baphikisa, bephakamisa izinkinga ezihlobene nokuphepha, umphakathi, kanye nemiphumela ethile yokusebenzisa le nsizakalo. Uhlanga Lwenjabulo Okokuqala, iTikTok iyinsiza edlalwa yizigidi zabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ikuvumela ukuba uveze ubuciko bakho, ubonise amakhono, futhi ufinyelele abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu bengaxhumana khona, bejabulisa, futhi befundisana. Abantu abaningi bathola ukuthi iTikTok iyindlela yokukhuluma ngezindaba ezibalulekile, izinkinga zomphakathi, noma izenzakalo zansuku zonke. Ukubeka izindaba ezithile ematheni, okungaba izindaba zomphakathi, izinkinga zokuhlukumeza, noma imikhuba emisha, kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ukwakha Umsebenzi Nokuqwashisa Ngaphezu kokujabulisa, iTikTok ibonakala iyinsiza ewusizo kulabo abafuna ukudala imisebenzi emisha. Abantu abaningi bathola amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi abaculi, ababhali, nabadansi. I-TikTok inikeza abantu ithuba lokuthola udumo, futhi lokhu kungaholela emathubeni amakhulu emisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTikTok iyinsiza yokwazisa abantu ngezinto ezibalulekile, njengezempilo, imvelo, kanye nezokuphepha. Amavidiyo afundisayo angaba nethonya elihle emphakathini, akhuthaze abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Izinkinga Zokuphepha Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle ngale nsizakalo. Abaphikisi baveza izinkinga ezinkulu ezihambisana neTikTok, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuphepha kolwazi. Izinkampani eziningi zikhathazekile ngendaba yokuthi idatha yomsebenzisi ingase ingavikeleki kahle. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka mayelana nokuthi ubani ongalufinyelela ulwazi lwethu, futhi lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zomphakathi. Abantu baphikisana ngokuthi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela ulwazi lomsebenzisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luphathwa kanjani. Imiphumela Emphakathini Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTikTok ibonakala ithinta imikhuba yomphakathi. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi iTikTok ikhuthaza imikhuba engafanele, efana nokucasulwa, ukweqisa, noma ukwakha izithombe ezingalungile. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke bahlale bephila impilo engalungile, begxila emibonweni engafanele. Ukuphila ngaphakathi kwezithombe ezinhle kakhulu kungadala ukucindezeleka, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebasha, abavame ukuqhathanisa impilo yabo nabanye. Ukuphila Ngemva KweTikTok Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iTikTok iyinsiza, futhi njengazo zonke izinsiza, inezinzuzo nezinkinga zayo. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe neziqondiso ezicacile zokusebenzisa le nsizakalo, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise iTikTok ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa konke lokhu, iTikTok iyinsiza enamathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi inezinkinga ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe neziqondiso ezicacile, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba basebenzise iTikTok ngendlela efanele, futhi sigcine izinga lokuphepha kolwazi lwethu. Njengoba sithola izinzuzo ezivela kule nsiza, kufanele futhi siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ngale ndlela, singakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe obuhle.
Ukwenza umshado wendabuko kungabhaliswa ngokweMthetho Womshado Wendabuko ka-1998. Akukhathalekile ukuthi washada nini. Ezimweni lapho omunye wababambiqhaza eseshonile, omunye ophumelelayo angakstillabhalisa umshado. Ukubhaliswa kumele kwenziwe ehhovisi elihambelana neZindaba Zasekhaya. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube khona abafakazisi ababili. Qinisekisa isimo somshado wakho ku-inthanethi. Gcwalisa amafomu okusebenza i-BI-1699 ne-BI-130. Ababandakanyekayo emshadweni nabafakazisi kumele baveze imibhalo yokuzazisa esebenzayo. Nikeza ubufakazi bezinkulumo zomshado. Umphathi obhalisayo uzogcwalisa ifomu lokusebenza le-BI-1699 futhi aqinisekise ukuthi umshado wendabuko ukhona. Ezimweni lapho omunye wabashadile, onguyise emshadweni wendabuko efuna ukungena emshadweni wendabuko omusha, kumele aye eNkantolo Ephakeme ukuze athole umyalo ozophatha umshado wakhe omusha wendabuko. Isetifiketi somshado obhalisiwe sikhishwa ngokushesha. Isetifiketi somshado ongekho ebhalisweni sithatha amasonto ayisithupha ukuze sikhishwe. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lakho eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Amalayisense okushayela angaphandle akhishwe kwamanye amazwe avunywa eNingizimu Afrika azoguqulwa abe amakhadi eNingizimu Afrika uma abanikazi bebuza amalayisense eNingizimu Afrika ngokuhambisana nomthetho weZokuhamba Emgwaqweni ka-1996. Isicelo sokuguqula ilayisense yangaphandle kumele sibe neleyisense yokushayela ekhishwe yilowo mhlaba. Ilayisense yangaphandle noma imvume ingaguqulwa ibe yelayisense yaseNingizimu Afrika uma umbuzi engum citizen waleli zwe noma unomvume yokuhlala unomphela. Ilayisense yangaphandle kumele ibe semthethweni ngosuku lokuguqulwa futhi kumele ibhalwe ngolimi olukhuluma ngokusemthethweni kuleli. Uma kungenjalo, isicelo kumele sibe nehumusho ovela kumhumushi oqinisekisiwe. Ukukhomba okwamukelekayo eNingizimu Afrika kufaka phakathi idokhumenti ye-ID, i-ID yesikhashana, iphasi leNingizimu Afrika, noma iphasi langaphandle elihambisana nemvume yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, kanye neleta evela kumphakathi owamukelayo eqinisekisa ukuthi ilayisense yangaphandle iyasebenza; le leta kumele ichaze uhlobo lweleyisense yangaphandle, ifake nezithombe ezingemibala zedokhumenti ye-ID, futhi ikhokhe imali efanele. Uzodlula ukuhlolwa kwamehlo ngaphambi kokuthi ilayisense yakho iguqulwe. Qaphela: awudingi ukuthatha ukuhlolwa kwelayisense yokushayela. Uzothola ilayisense yokushayela yesikhashana ezophelelwa isikhathi ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha ngaphandle kokukhokha.
Isimemezelo Sokunemba Kwefomu Lelungu (GEMS Member Form Accuracy Declaration) Ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inhlangano ye-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni nasempilweni yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS inikeza uhlelo lwezempilo oluhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezidingekayo kubasebenzi, okuhlanganisa neqhaza labo emindenini yabo. Ukuze lolu hlelo lusebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke ababhalisile bahlinzeke ngemininingwane eqondile futhi enembile ku-fomu lelungu. ### Ukwazi Ukubaluleka Kokunemba Isimemezelo sokunemba kwefomu lelungu singumkhiqizo obalulekile ohlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwaziwa komkhiqizo wezinsizakalo zempilo ohlangene no-GEMS. Lokhu kusiza ekugcineni izinga eliphezulu lokuphatha, kanti kuphinde kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yabasebenzi. Ngakho-ke, ukuhlonishwa kwalesi simemezelo kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile kunoma ubani ofaka le fomu. ### Izizathu Zokuhlonipha Isimemezelo Noma ubani ofaka ifomu le-GEMS kufanele aqonde ukuthi ukungena kwemininingwane enembile kudlala indima enkulu ekuphathweni kwesiguli. Uma umuntu enza iphutha, kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinjengokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelashwa okungakuhle, ukungafuneki kokuhlolwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinkinga ezicashile ezithinta ukukhokhwa kwemali. Kanjalo, ukungabi neqiniso kwemininingwane kungaholela ezinkingeni zomthetho nezokuphatha. ### Ubulungisa Nokuphathwa Kwamafomu Abasebenzi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukufaka amafomu aphelele, afinyelela ezingeni lobulungiswa, kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi igama, idayari, idokhumenti efana ne-ID, nezinye izincazelo ezifanele zifakwe ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Umphakathi wesikhungo wezempilo, abaphathi, nabaphathiswa bempilo balindele lezi zinkcukacha ukuze kukhululeke ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo. ### Ukuqinisekisa Ukunemba Kwefomu Kumele kubonakale ukuthi ukuqinisekisa ukunemba kwefomu lelungu akuwona umkhawulo, kodwa kunjalo, kuyinqubomgomo efanele. Umuntu ofaka lesi simemezelo kufanele ahlole kahle imininingwane ayifakile, abuyekeze noma iyiphi ingxenye engalungile, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi konke kulungile ngaphambi kokuphawula. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthuthukisa ukwethembeka kkomkhankaso wokwelashwa. ### Ukusekelwa Noma Izimo Zokungahlangabezani Ngokufaka isimemezelo sokunemba kwefomu, umthengi uvuma ukuba neqhaza elithile emisebenzini ye-GEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kwenzeka kungekho ukugadwa noma izimo ezinjalo, umthengi angase abhekane nemiphumela ethile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi ukuthi yini okufanele bayenze uma bahluleka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile, njengokufaka izikhalazo noma ukubika izinto eziphuthelwe. ### Emva Kokufaka Ifomu Uma ifomu selifakiwe, abamukeli bempela be-GEMS bazokwenza umnyaba wokuhlola ukunemba kolwazi olufakiwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, abasebenzi bazokwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezinikezwayo, kodwa kumelwe bazi ukuthi bangakwazi ukuthola izikhalazo uma kuvela izinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi uqhubeke nokubuyekeza imininingwane yakho njengoba kudingeka. ### Isiphetho Ngokuvamile, isimemezelo sokunemba kwefomu lelungu sikhumbuza bonke ababhalisile be-GEMS ngobuhle bokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelashwa uma kunemininingwane efanele efakiwe. Ngokuhlonipha isimemezelo, sizothuthukisa inhlonipho kubo bonke abathintekayo kulolu hlelo lwezempilo olukhulu. Lokhu akugwemezi nje ezinkingeni, kodwa futhi kuphinde kuthuthukise impilo yabaningi. Ukwazi lezi zinto kuzoholela ekutheni kube nokukhula okuhle emikhakheni ye-GEMS, okuhlasela umphakathi wakithi ngokuphelele. Uma sonke sithatha umthwalo wokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile, sizobe sikulethe emiphumeleni eyakhayo. Cishe njengoba ukhula, kwenza kube lula nabanye, kanti ekugcineni, sizobaqondise kahle empilweni yabo.
Ezokwakhiwa Kwengqalasizinda: Umgomo Wokuthuthukisa Izwe Ezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda ziwumgomo obalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Zihlanganisa zonke izinhlelo zokwakha, ukuphucula, nokugcina izinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezindlela, izibhedlela, izikole, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Ukuze izwe lithuthuke, kubalulekile ukuba nezingqalasizinda ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, okukhula komnotho, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu. Ngokokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izinga lokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda lincike kakhulu ekubeni khona kwemithombo yezimali. Izwe elinokuphila kahle, elinokuthuthukiswa kwezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda, kudinga ukuxhaswa kwezimali okuhlelekile. Lokhu kuxhaswa kungavela kuhulumeni, izinkampani ezizimele, noma ngisho nezikhungo zamazwe ngamazwe. Ukuze sithuthukise izinsiza, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha lezi zimali, ukuze zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Okwesibili, ezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Izindlela ezinhle, izikhungo zemfundo, nezibhedlela zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwabantu, kuholele ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uma abantu bekhululekile ukuhamba, benza izinkampani zibe nezinselelo ezincane, okukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zemfundo ezithuthukisiwe zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, zifundisa abantu amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Okwesithathu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda kufanele zibe nezinhloso eziphusile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akufanele kube khona ukwakhiwa okungahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinhlelo zokwakha kufanele ziqhutshekwe ngemibono yokuthuthukisa izindawo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda kufanele zibe nezindlela eziphusile zokuphatha imvelo. Njengoba sithuthukisa izinsiza, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi imvelo yethu iyagcinwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela izinsiza zethu zemvelo, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, izinhlelo zokwakhiwa kumele zibe nezindlela zokuhlola umthelela wazo emvelweni, ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka. Ekugcineni, ezokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukuze sithuthukise izwe, kufanele sigxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu, zikhuthaze ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi ziqinisekise ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha ziqhutshekwe ngendlela ehloniphekile, ngokuhlonipha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi zibe nezinhloso eziphusile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni wezwe. Ngakho, asiqhubekeni nokwakha ingqalasizinda ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo, ukuze sibe nezwe eliqhakazile nelinempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokuthi sonke sithole impilo engcono, futhi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokwakha ingqalasizinda alupheli nje emsebenzini, kodwa luhlanganisa izifiso, amaphupho, nezidingo zethu njengabantu. Ngakho-ke, asibambeni ndawonye, sithuthukise izwe lethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukuphendula Ezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi I. Isingeniso Namuhla, izimo eziphuthumayo ezihlobene nezimoto eziningi zikhula ngenxa yokwanda kokuhamba kwezimoto emigwaqweni. Ukuphendula ngendlela efanele kulezi zimo kubalulekile ukuze kuvinjwe ukulahleka kwabantu nokwenza kube sengozini. Kubalulekile ukuba nolwazi olucacile lokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe lapho ubhekene nalezi zimo. II. Ukuqonda Isimo Ngaphambi kokuphendula, kubalulekile ukuqonda isimo: 1. Ukubona isimo: Qaphela izimpawu ezikhona. Ingabe kukhona imoto ethintwe kabi? Ingabe abanye abantu balimele? 2. Ukucela usizo: Uma ungakwazi ukusiza, cela usizo lwezikhulu. Fona emaphoyiseni, ezempilo, noma abaphuthumayo. III. Ukuphepha Kwakho Nokuphepha Kwezinye Ngaphambi kokwenza noma yini, qiniseka ukuthi kuphephile: 1. Phuma endaweni engcupheni: Uma ungasebenzisi imoto, hamba kude nendawo engcupheni ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngosizo. 2. Gqoka umkhono ophathekayo: Uma kudingeka, sebenzisa imikhono yokuphepha ukuze uvikeleke. IV. Ukuxhumana Nabanye Uma uxhumana nabantu abanolwazi, khuluma kahle, ngokucacile, futhi unikeze imininingwane edingekayo: 1. Chaza kahle isimo: Bika kahle okwenzekile futhi funisisa izingxenye ezibalulekile. 2. Lalela: Phendula imibuzo, futhi uma kudingeka, nikeza olunye ulwazi. V. Umsebenzi Wokuphuthumayo Uma usaphenya isimo, sebenzisa lezi zinyathelo: 1. Hlinzeka ngokusiza: Uma unolwazi, ungalungisa izimo ezilula, njenge ukulungisa imoto encane noma ukusiza umuntu ophukile. 2. Phendula kumalungiselelo: Thobela imiyalelo yeziphathimandla noma abaphathi. VI. Ukubika Izingozi Uma ubika isimo, qiniseka: 1. Thola imininingwane ethile: Lokhu kubandakanya izindawo, isikhathi, nabantu abathintekayo. 2. Sebenzisa izinombolo ezithile: Bhala phansi izinombolo zezimoto ezibandakanyekayo, amagama, nezincwadi zazo. VII. Ukubamba Ukusebenzisana Ukubambisana kubalulekile: 1. Sebenza nabanye: Noma ubani okhona angasiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi iyatholakala. 2. Phendula ngempumelelo: Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela iyavunywa ukuze wonke umuntu abanjwe. VIII. Isiphetho Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kudinga ukuzimisela, ukuqonda, nokuxhumana okuhle. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakhulisa amathuba okuthi ukusiza kube yimpumelelo. Khumbula ukuthi kufanele uqinisekise ukuphepha ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Ubulungiswa, ukusiza, nokuqonda kufanele kube yinto eyinhloko ezimweni ezinjalo. Ukubambisana nabanye, ngokuhlonipha, kubalulekile ekusizeni. Noma isimo sikhathazekile, izinyathelo ezifanele zingasiza ukunciphisa umthelela wezingozi. Qhubeka ube nesineke, uzinikele, futhi ube nesibindi. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ungaba yisixazululo esiqinile ezimweni eziyingozi ezihlobene nezimoto eziningi.
Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Ekhaya elikhulu leMisebenzi, kwaya kwavela izinkanyezi zempumelelo. Le nkampani yayiqhuba kahle, kodwa wayekhona umoya wokufuna okungcono. UMnumzane Khanyile, umphathi omkhulu, wayekholwa ukuthi abasebenzi bangenza ngcono uma beqeqeshwa futhi bethuthukiswa. Ngakho, wanquma ukwakha uhlelo olusha lokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Ngemva kokuhlangana nezisebenzi, uKhanyile wathola ukuthi abasebenzi babenokukhathazeka ngezinto ezithile. Abanye babebona ukuthi badinga amakhono athile ukuze bakhule emsebenzini, kanti abanye babecabanga ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa ngokuqeqeshwa kuzobasiza ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuleni kwenkampani. Ngakho, wathola ukuthi uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwaludingeka ngempela. Uhlelo lwezokuqeqeshwa lwaqala ngezilimi ezahlukene, lapho abasebenzi befundiswa khona ukuxhumana kahle. Umqeqeshi, uNkk. Ndlovu, wayenolwazi olunzulu lokuxhumana, futhi wayethokozisa abasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokuba baqale, uNkk. Ndlovu wathi: "Bafowethu nodadewethu, ukuxhumana kuyisisekelo seziqu zethu. Uma singakwazi ukukhuluma kahle, sizokwazi ukufinyelela phezulu." Emva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uKhanyile wathola ukuthi abasebenzi baphenduke kancane kancane, bezikhuluma ngempumelelo. Uhlanga lwemibono lwalwandiswa, futhi ukuhlangana kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni baphinde benze izinhlelo zokuzibandakanya, futhi kwavela imibono emisha emsebenzini. Uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lwalwakhiwe ukuze luhambisane nezidingo zemboni. Abasebenzi babefundiswa izinhlelo eziningi zesoftware, okwakuhlanganisa ukuhlela amabhizinisi nezinye izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza. Uhlelo lwakha ubuchwepheshe obusiza abasebenzi ukuze babe nokuqonda okujulile kwezinqubo zomsebenzi. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuhlonza amakhono abawadingayo ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngesikhathi sokubamba izifundo, uKhanyile wathola ukuthi abanye abasebenzi babenokuthakazelisa okukhudlwana. UThandi, omunye wabasebenzi, waba nesifiso sokuba umphathi wezobuchwepheshe. Waqala ukuzithokozisa ngezobuchwepheshe, wakhuthaza abanye ukuba bakhuthazeke. Ukufunda kwabo kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi uKhanyile wabona ukuthi uhlelo lwalusiza abasebenzi ukuba bahlale bejabulile. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwaluhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzivocavoca, ukuze kusekelwe impilo enhle yabantu. Abasebenzi bakhuthazwa ukuba baphume emsebenzini bayovama, bahlale bephila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kwavuselelwa umoya wokubambisana, njengoba kwaba nezinsuku ezikhethekile lapho bonke basebenzi bejolise kokuzivocavoca. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezingu-6, uhlelo lwezokuqeqeshwa lwavuma ukuhamba phambili. Abasebenzi baseMisebenzi babonisa izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Ukuxhumana kwabo kwaba namandla, ubuchwepheshe bukhuphukile, futhi impilo yabo ibivele kahle. UKhanyile wabona ukuthi ukuthembela ebantwini kubalulekile. Wazi kahle ukuthi uma umphakathi uthuthukiswa, khona-ke izinkampani nazo ziyaphumelela. Ekugcineni, uKhanyile waba nomhlangano nezinye izinkampani, ezibhalwe njengemikhiqizo efana neMisebenzi. Wabelana ngempumelelo yabo, futhi uhlelo lwezokuqeqeshwa lwakhe lwaba yisibonelo sokukhuthaza ezinye izinkampani. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi ophumelelayo, onemibono emisha, futhi owaziyo ukuthi ukuze uphumelele, kufanele kube nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, uKhanyile waba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabasebenzi bakhe. Abasebenzi baphuma bejabule, benokholo lokuthi bazokwazi ukuphumelela emsebenzini nasempilweni. Uhlelo lwezokuqeqeshwa lwalungamaphupho asebenzelayo, futhi lwaba yinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kwavula izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, kwaholela ekwakhiweni komoya wobumbano phakathi kwabasebenzi. Umphakathi waseMisebenzi waba isibonelo sokuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zokuthuthukisa amakhono zingakhuthaza impumelelo, zikhulise ubudlelwane, futhi zakhe izisekelo eziqinile zomsebenzi ophumelelayo. UKhanyile, njengesikhumbuzo sokuba ubumbano luthuthukiswe, waphinde wathi: “Siyakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu uma sisebenzisana.” Futhi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMsebenzi wabamba izinkanyezi eziningi zempumelelo, ngenxa yokuthi uKhanyile wakhuthaza abasebenzi bokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile E-Kusile, isiteshi esisha sokukhiqiza ugesi esiseMpumalanga Kapa, sekukhulunywa kakhulu ngokuqhubeka kokubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas. Lokhu kubambezeleka, okuthinta izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya, kubonisa izinselele ezinkulu ezikhona emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, okukhathaza kakhulu abathintekayo. Iphrojekthi ye-flue gas, eyakhiwa ngenhloso yokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi eyingozi emoyeni, iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kweKusile, okuyisiteshi esikhulu sokukhiqiza ugesi esizothuthukisa ukutholakala kukagesi kuleli. Nokho, izinkinga ezahlukene, kubalwa nezinkinga zokwakha, ukungahambisani nezinhlelo zokuhamba kwezimali, kanye nezinkinga zokusebenza, ziye zenza ukuthi le phrojekthi ibambezeleke. Okwamanje, abaphathi bephrojekthi bathi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqubo zihamba kahle ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale ukusebenza. Lokhu kubambezeleka kuthinteka kabi ezinhlelweni zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengoba izimakethe zithwele kanzima ngenxa yokwehla kokutholakala kukagesi. Izinselele ezikhona ziphinde ziveze izinkinga ezinkulu ezimbonini ezincane, okuyinto ethinta umnotho wendawo. Kodwa-ke, ubuchwepheshe obusha obusetshenziswa ekwakhiweni kwephrojekthi ye-flue gas bukhombisa ithemba lokuthi lezi zinkinga zingaxazululwa. Abachwepheshe bahlola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanza umoya, ezizoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza ugesi. Uhlanga olwakhiwe kule phrojekthi luzophinde luthuthukise izinga lokuphila kwabantu bendawo, njengoba kusebenza izinhlelo zokuhlanza umoya. Ummeli wenkampani ephakathi kokwakhiwa kweKusile, uThabo Mthembu, uthe: "Siyaziqonda kahle izinselele ezikhona, kodwa sinesifiso sokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje ukuze siphumelele. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa umoya esiphila kuwo, futhi kuzokhulisa amandla ethu okukhanyisa." Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abahlali bendawo baveza ukukhathazeka kwabo ngezinkinga eziqhubekayo. UNaomi Dlamini, umphakathi wezindawo eziseduze neKusile, uthe: "Sicela ukuba lesi sikhungo sithathe izinyathelo ezisheshayo. Imindeni yethu iyathinteka kakhulu, futhi sithandazela ukuthi kube nezixazululo ezisheshayo." Uhlelo lwephrojekthi ye-flue gas lungathuthukiswa ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezakhamuzi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezithintekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi kube nokubambisana okuhle, kuthuthukise izinga lemisebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emnothweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwakha kanye nokuhlanza umoya zikhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi iKusile ingaba yisibonelo esihle sokuphila kahle kwabantu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zethu zemvelo zihlala ziphila. Abanye abachwepheshe bathi, ukuhlinzekwa ngogesi okwanele kubalulekile emnothweni. Uma iKusile ingaphumeleli, lokho kuzothinta kakhulu izimboni ezahlukene, okuholela ekwehleni kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abancane abakhaliphile abakhangayo umsebenzi. Ngaphandle kokubambezeleka, izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umoya zidinga ukuba ziqhubeke. Abasebenzi baphinde bakhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwedlanzana lezi zinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umoya ophumayo uhlala uhlanzekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo. Ikhono lokuhlanza umoya lingenza umehluko omkhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi umphakathi awukwazi ukuzifihla. Njengoba izinhlelo zeKusile ziqhubeka, umphakathi ubheke phambili ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga ukuze kuzuzwe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokubheka phambili, ubuchwepheshe obusha obutholakala ekwakhiweni kweKusile buhlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umoya ungena ezindlini zabantu ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Lokhu kuzophinde kuthuthukise umnotho wendawo, kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uphakamisa izwi lokubambisana ukuze kuxazululwe izinselele ezikhona. Iphrojekthi ye-flue gas eKusile ibalulekile, futhi kubalulekile ukuba wonke umuntu abe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa elihamba phambili. I-Kusile ingaba yinsika yempilo engcono, uma wonke umuntu edlalela indima yakhe. Isikhathi sizobonisa ukuthi le phrojekthi izophumelela yini, kodwa ithemba lidlulela phambili njengoba umphakathi unikezela usizo, ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka, futhi izinkampani zikhuthaza ukukhiqiza ugesi ngendlela ehambisana nemvelo. I-Kusile ingaba yisibonelo esihle, uma zonke izithako zisebenza kahle, nazo zikhona emhlabeni.
Izinsiza eziningi zisebenzisa ama-gear. Isibonelo esihle ngu-bhayisikili enama-gear okwenza kube lula ukuhamba, ikakhulukazi uma uhamba phezulu. Ngokuvamile, ibhayisikili inama-gear amakhulu lapho kukhona i-pedal, futhi kunezinga elihlukahlukene lama-gear emuva. Uma i-gear yangaphambili iphumelelwe, i-chains idonsa ama-gear emuva e-wheela, futhi ibhayisikili ihamba phambili. Bheka usayizi we-gear lapho i-pedal isetshenziswa futhi uqhathanise nosayizi lama-gear emuva. Yini oyibonayo? Abantu abaningi bahamba ngamabhayisikili uma kukhona ukuphakama. Uma ukuphakama kuphakamisa, ukuhamba kwe-pedal kuba nzima - ngokuvamile, umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili uzoshintsha ama-gear. Uma umgibeli eshintsha ama-gear, i-chain ihamba ivela ku-gear encane iye ku-gear enkulu enezinyo eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Uma kunezinyo eziningi ku-gear, kube lula ukuhamba, kodwa ibhayisikili ayihambi ngokushesha. Sifuna ukubuza lokhu: kwenzekani uma umgibeli ehamba phezulu futhi eshintsha ku-gear enkulu iye ku-gear encane? Kuzoba nzima noma kube lula ukuhamba ibhayisikili? Isizathu sokuthi kube lula ukukhuphuka intaba ukuthi ama-gear ashintshwa - ubudlelwano be-gear buyashintsha. Ubudlelwano be-gear bungatholakala ngokubala inani lezinyo ku-gear ethile - isakhiwo se-chain asibaliwe. Ngezansi, kuzachazwa ngesiNgisi ukuthi lelo nani lingatholakala kanjani. Uma i-gear enikeza amandla (i-pedal) ijika kanye, zingaki izikhathi i-sprocket gear izojika? Isibonelo esedlule sikhombisa ukuthi njalo uma i-pedal gear ijika kanye, i-sprocket gear emuva ijika kabili - lokhu kwenza kube lula ukukhuphuka intaba. Uma i-pedal gear ijika kanye, zingaki izikhathi i-sprocket izojika? Uma i-pedal gear ijika kanye, zingaki izikhathi i-sprocket izojika? Yini umphumela obudlelwano be-gear onokushesha kwemishini? Ubudlelwano be-gear busitshela ukuthi kanjani isivinini se-gear eyodwa siqhathaniswa nesivinini se-gear enye. Uma i-gear yethu yamandla (enama-10 teeth) ijika ngama-5 rpm, futhi ixhunywe ku-gear yamandla (enama-50 teeth), i-gear yamandla izojika ngama-1 rpm. Uma i-gear yethu encane ijika 1x, i-gear yethu enkulu ijika 1/5. Kuthatha ama-5 ajika e-gear encane ukuze kufane ne-1 ajika ye-gear yethu enkulu. Ngakho-ke, i-gear yethu enkulu ihamba ngesivinini se-1/5 sesivinini esilinganayo no-1 rpm. Kuzokwenzekani uma ubudlelwano bethu be-gear bungu-1:3? Lapha, usayizi we-gear yamandla ungama-3x mkhulu kunosayizi we-gear yamandla. Uma i-gear yamandla ijika ngama-20 rpm, i-1 ijika izokwenza i-gear yamandla ijike kathathu (3x). Amandla anikeziwe angama-60 rpm. Amandla okuhamba yile gear noma i-sprocket enezinhloso ezithile. Njengesibonelo se-bhayisikili, umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili uphakamisa i-pedal. I-sprocket enkulu lapho ama-pedals axhunywe khona iyisikhumbuzo, kuyilapho i-sprocket encane emuva ibizwa ngokuthi iyashintshwa. Akukhona njalo ukuthi i-gear enkulu ihambisa i-gear encane - usayizi awubalulekile. Okubalulekile lokhu: iyiphi ethola amandla kuqala? Uma sibheka ukuhlelwa kwama-gear lapho kuxhunywe khona nge-chain, kubalulekile ukuhlela usayizi walawa ma-gear. Ama-gear azokhombisa ukuthi mangaki ama-axle abhalwe kuwo ajika. Isivinini salo axle sizokhombisa ukuthi mangaki ama-seed-producing mechanism ahamba, okuphinde kushintshe inani leziqhamuka ezitshalwa. Uma i-axle ihamba ngokushesha, ama-seed amaningi azotshalwa. Uma ulinganisa umtshali bese uthola ukuthi ama-seed amaningi atshalwa, uzokwazi ukuthi i-axle ehambisa umshini wokutshala izitshalo ihamba ngokushesha kakhulu futhi isivinini salo axle kufanele sincishiswe. Enye indlela yokulungisa lokhu ukushintsha usayizi wama-gear noma ama-sprockets ahambisa le axle.
I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi (PSC) iyisikhungo somphakathi esizimele esisungulwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. I-PSC inemithwalo yemfanelo namandla, phakathi kwezinye izinto, yokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi kahulumeni. Le mmandla ifaka phakathi ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle noma okungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni. Ehlotshaniswa nalemithwalo, i-PSC inemithwalo yokukhuthaza izindlela zokwenza kube nokusebenza kahle nokusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni nokukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kubhalwe emthethosisekelweni kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. I-Commission ithola amandla ayo kwiSigaba 195 no-196 soMthethosisekelo, 1996. ISigaba 195 sichaza izindinganiso nezimiso ezilawula ukuphathwa komphakathi okufanele i-Commission ikhuthaze. Izinga eliphezulu le-ethics yobungcweti. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kusekelwe ekuthuthukiseni. Izinsizakalo kufanele zibe nezinga eliphezulu, zifanelekile, zibe nezehlakalo, futhi zingabi nenkohlakalo. Kumele ziphendule ezidingweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi kufanele ukhuthazwe ukuba ube nengxenye ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube nekhono. Ukuveza kufanele kukhuthazwe. Ukusungulwa kokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube yindawo ethokozisa wonke umuntu ngokusekelwe kumakhono abo, ukucabanga ngokuzimela, ubuqotho, nokulungisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili. Ukukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe kwiSigaba 195 soMthethosisekelo, 1996 kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ukuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela, ukuphathwa, nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni, ikakhulukazi ukuhambisana nezindinganiso nezimiso ezishiwo kwiSigaba 195, kanye nezinqubo zokuqashwa kukahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni lesizwe nasezindaweni mayelana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuveza imiphumela nezincomo okungenani minyaka yonke kwiZikhulu Zesizwe noma kwiZikhulu zendawo njengoba zenzeka. Ukuveza izindaba eziphuthumayo ezihlobene nomsebenzi ezikhungweni ezifanele. Ukuhlola izikhalazo zabasebenzi nokwenza izincomo ezifanele zokulungisa. Ukuthuthukisa ukuphathwa nokusebenza komsebenzi. I-Commission isunguliwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. Umthetho ufuneka i-Commission eyodwa yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enamalungu alishumi nane, amahlanu awo aqokwa nguMongameli ngokuphakanyiswa kweZikhulu Zesizwe, kanti elinye ilungu lisuka esifundazweni ngalinye liqokwa nguMongameli wesifunda. I-Commission ibophezelekile kwiZikhulu Zesizwe okufanele ibike okungenani minyaka yonke. Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo kwiZikhulu zendawo. Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amalungu amahlanu asendaweni yasePretoria kanye nelinye esifundeni ngasinye. I-PSC ixhaswa yiHhovisi le-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, eliholwa nguMphathi-Jikelele (ongumphathi ophakeme), enehhovisi elikhulu ePretoria kanye nehhovisi lesifunda esisodwa esifundeni ngasinye. Lezi zikhungo zisebenza njengesisekelo samalungu eCommission ezifundazweni futhi ziphathwa ngabaqondisi bamasifunda, ngosizo lwamalungu ambalwa abasebenzi. Imisebenzi ethile nezisebenzi ezibalulekile zikhuluma ngazo ehhovisi lesifunda. Amalungu eCommission aqokwa nguMongameli, aqala ukusebenza kusukela ngoJanuwari 1, 1999. Nokho, ukuqala ngokusemthethweni kwemisebenzi yeCommission kwabambezela kuze kube nguJulayi 1999 ngenxa yezinkinga zomthetho phakathi kwezinye izindaba zeMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997. NgoJulayi 1, 1999, uMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997 kanye nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho weCommission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997, kanye nokuphulwa kweCommission yeZokuphathwa Komphakathi, 1984, kwaba nomthelela, kuvumela i-Commission ukuthi isebenze ngokuphelele. Umkomishana uMgijima waphumelela uKomishana uVusi Mavuso owashiya esikhundleni sakhe. Ukwakhiwa kwenhlangano ye-PSC kwasungulwa ukuze kulandele imigomo yayo yecebo bese kuthi kamuva izigaba zayo zokusebenza. Umsebenzi weCommission uhlelwe ube yizigaba zayo eziyisithupha zokusebenza kanye nezindawo ezimbili ezikhuluma ngazo njengoba kushiwo endaweni 1 ngenhla. Ukuphathwa - kubhekisela ekuphathweni okuphelele nasezimali; ukuphatha abasebenzi nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza kubasebenzi; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomthetho nezinye izinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa inqubomgomo. Ibhange: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu Nezobudlelwano Bomsebenzi - Le bhange ivumela i-Commission ukuba iqhube imisebenzi yayo mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; ukuqapha ubudlelwano bomsebenzi; kanye nemithetho yomsebenzi ngempumelelo. Ibhange: Ukuphathwa Okuhle Nokulethwa Kwezinsizakalo - Le bhange isebenzisa amandla eCommission ngokubhekelela nokuhlola; ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo; ukuziphatha okuhle kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni nezicwangciso zokubhekana nezingozi emsebenzini kahulumeni. I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi: Amadokhumenti ahanjiswe ngamalungu eCommission kanye nemibhalo yemihlangano nezinkundla abebekhona. Imizuzu yemihlangano yokuphatha yonke. Amadokhumenti wokunikezwa kwemali evela kubahlinzeki. Izivumelwano nabahlinzeki. nokuhlola izikhalazo nezikhalazo ezibekwe ngabasebenzi bakahulumeni kanye nezincazelo ezifanele zokulungisa. nokuhlola izikhalazo ezihlobene nezicelo ezibekwe ngabasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa komphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola izinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. ukuqapha nokuhlola izimo zomsebenzi nokuphathwa kokusebenza ngabaphathi bezigaba. kanye nokuhlola nokubika ngezinkinga zokuthanda kumaphathi nokugcina uhlaka lokwembula kwezimali; nokukhuthaza nokuhlola ukusebenza kahle ekubhekaneni nezingozi. nokulwa nokukhwabanisa emsebenzini kahulumeni ngokuhlola okuqondile; nokufaka isandla ekulweleni ukukhwabanisa ezwenikazi. Ukuthuthukisa Ukuphathwa Nokulethwa Kwezinsizakalo: izindaba ezihlobene nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola imisebenzi yokuphatha nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo emsebenzini kahulumeni. ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kahle, okusebenzayo, nokonga kwezinsiza; nokuhambisana nezinqubo ezifanele emsebenzini weZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Akukho sikhumbuzo esikhishwe mayelana nezigaba zezimali ze-PSC/OPSC, ezitholakalayo ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu ucele
Iphasi yezingane iyidokhumenti ebalulekile ukuze ingane ikwazi ukuhamba iye kwelinye izwe. Iphasi yezingane inikezwa ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-16. Ivalidi ukuhamba kuyo yonke imikhakha ngaphandle uma kudingeka imibhalo ethile ekhombisa ukungavunyelwa. Ivalidi iminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku olukhishwa ngalo. Qedela amafomu B1-73 bese uwafaka ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle eliseduze. Faka ezikhungweni noma emishinini yaseNingizimu Afrika uma uhamba phesheya. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuzalwa sengane. Faka izithombe ezimbili ezincane zephasi zengane. Imvume yomzali noma yomgibeli iyadingeka ngaphambi kokuthi ingane ithole iphasi. Nikeza ubufakazi besitifiketi sokufa uma omunye umzali eshonile. Uma imvume inikezwa ngumgibeli, kufanele kuchazwe ukuthi umgibeli uthole kanjani ilungelo lokuba ngumgibeli. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezikhethekile, uma kungenakwenzeka ukuthi lowo mzali anikeze imvume kumafomu okucela, imvume ebhaliwe kufanele itholwe encwadini ethunyelwe kumzali ongakabi khona. Endabeni lapho umzali engafuni ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, inkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele yenze isinqumo ngalesi sihloko. Ikhophi ye-oda lenkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele ihambisane nefomu lokucela iphasi. Uma abazali behlukanisiwe, bobabili abazali badingeka ukuba banikeze imvume ngaphandle uma i-oda lenkantolo ibonisa okunye. Iphasi ingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili ukuba ikhishwe.
Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Kwakusasa, umoya wawupholile, ugibisela izihlahla ezazimile eduze komgwaqo omkhulu. UThandi, owayehamba esuka emsebenzini, wayefuna ukufika ekhaya ngesikhathi. Njengoba efika eduze komgwaqo omkhulu, waqaphela ukuthi isimo sasingesihle. Izinkinga zemigwaqo zaziphakeme kakhulu. Izimbobo ezinkulu zazithokozisa emgwaqweni, zenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Abanye abantu babesebenzisa izimoto zabo, bejolisa phezulu, benza konke okusemandleni ukuze bagweme izimbobo. UThandi wacabanga, "Kanjani umuntu angaphila kahle uma imigwaqo ingalungisiwe?" Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umgwaqo waba yindawo yokuxoxa phakathi kwabantu. Abantu babebhulula izikhalazo zabo, besho ukuthi imoto yabo yaphuka ngenxa yezimbobo. UThandi, owazi kahle ukuthi ukungabi nemigwaqo elungile kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, waqonda ukuthi kufanele sikhulume ngale nkinga. Ngemuva kokuhamba, wathola uMnumzane Mthembu, umuntu ophakathi komphakathi. UMnumzane Mthembu wayenokuhlakanipha, futhi wayeqonda izinkinga ezikhona. "Thandi," esho, "sidinga ukuhlanganisa abantu ukuze sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga. Uma singazikhulumeli, sizohlala sithwele kanzima." Lokho kwenza uThandi wanquma ukuthi kudingeka bahlangane nabanye abahlali. Bahlela umhlangano, bembula izinkinga ezikhona, futhi bahlola izixazululo. Umhlangano waba yimpumelelo; abantu babebonisa izithakazelo zabo, bephakamisa iziphakamiso ezahlukene. Ngemva kokuhlangana, uThandi noMnumzane Mthembu bahamba emigwaqweni, bejolisa izimbobo ezinkulu. "Kumele sithumele izincwadi kumasipala," kusho uThandi. "Kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi kumele siqinisekise ukuthi imigwaqo yethu iyalungiswa." UMnumzane Mthembu wavuma, "Yebo, kumele sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, futhi sibe neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi wethu." Ngemva kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukuvumelana, benza izincwadi ezizokhishwa kumasipala. Umoya wawuphakeme, abantu bezwa ukuthi bazokwazi ukwenza umehluko. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, uThandi wathola ukuthi akukhona kuphela izinkinga zemigwaqo, kodwa nezinkinga zempilo, izinsiza, nezokuthutha. Umphakathi wawudinga ukwakha ubudlelwano ukuze bakwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, abantu baphinde bahlangana, bejabulile. UThandi noMnumzane Mthembu babonisa iziphakamiso ezitholakele, baphinde baphinde babonisa ukuthi imisebenzi yokuqala yokulungisa imigwaqo yayiqalile. Izimbobo ezinkulu zazisuswa, futhi imigwaqo yabe ibukeka kahle. UThandi waphuma emnyango, wabona abantwana bedlala emgwaqweni, behamba kalula. "Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane Mthembu," kusho uThandi, "siphumelele." UMnumzane Mthembu wavuma, "Siphumelele ngenxa yokubambisana. Uma sikhuluma, sithola izixazululo." Ngale ndlela, uThandi wathola ukuthi izinkinga zemigwaqo zaziyingxenye yempilo, kodwa ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuzenza zibe ngcono. Umoya wokusebenza ndawonye wawukhanya, futhi uThandi waba nethemba lokuthi imiphakathi eminingi izofunda ukufunda futhi ibambisane ukuze ikwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga zayo. Ngakho-ke, uThandi waphuma, ejabulela impilo, ebona ukuthi imizamo yabo yayikhona. Imigwaqo yayiyingxenye yempilo yabo, futhi bazokwazi ukuhamba kalula, bejabulile, futhi bephila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba yisibonelo sokubambisana, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu oyedwa angaba nomthelela omkhulu uma esebenza nabanye. Izinkinga zemigwaqo zaba yindaba yokuphila, kodwa zafundisa abantu ukuthi ubudlelwano, ukukhulumisana, nokubambisana kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Futhi, emgwaqweni omkhulu, uThandi wathola ukuthi izinkinga zempilo zingaxazululwa uma abantu bephumelela ndawonye, behlanganyela ukuze bakhe umphakathi ongcono.
Umphakathi ungaxhumana nalesi sikhungo ukuze uthole usizo ngokushaya inombolo engakhokhiwe: 0800 005 133. Lesi sikhungo sokuxhumana nobuchwepheshe obuphezulu sinezisebenzi ezinganikeza umphakathi izeluleko nolwazi mayelana nempilo nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi nemininingwane edingwa umshayi. Zizwe ungathola usizo uma kukhulunywa ngempilo. Lesi sikhungo, esitholakala ebhizinisini iNatalia, okuyihhovisi elikhulu leMnyango Wezempilo e-uMgungundlovu, sinezisebenzi eziqeqeshiwe ezilungele ukusiza noma ubani oxhumana nabo. Inhloso yokwakha lesi sikhungo ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wonke ngosizo lwezempilo ngaso sonke isikhathi ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zokuxhumana ezifana neradiyo, ithelevishini, i-imeyili, i-SMS, nezinsiza zokushaya ucingo. Uqhubekile wathi, "Lesi sikhungo sisiza kakhulu kithi ekusizeni ngezimo eziphuthumayo ngoba uma umphakathi uphakamisa isixwayiso, singafika ngokushesha lapho kudingeka khona njengoba lesi sikhungo sinezixhumanisi ezisiza abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuba baqondiswe lapho usizo ludingeka khona ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi befuna le ndawo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sikhungo singathumela imiyalezo yokwazisa uma kunezimo zokuphanga, kuchaza uNtsobi. Ingxenye enkulu yezingcingo ezitholakala kuleli sikhungo ivela kubantu abafuna ulwazi nosizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, kanti abanye bafuna ulwazi ngamadawa. "Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi lesi sikhungo singasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubantu abafuna usizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, okusho ukuthi siphinde sibe nesandla ekufundiseni umphakathi. Okubukwayo ukuthi abantu abaningi bafuna ukwazi ngesimo sempilo kule ndawo ngoba befisa ukuvakashela futhi bathi sinesandla kwezokuvakasha," kuchaza uNtsobi. Izinhlobo zezingcingo ezitholakala kuleli sikhungo zifaka phakathi lezo ezivela kubantu abafuna ukubika izinkinga ezifana nokukhwabanisa, amacala okuhlukumeza, udlame lwasekhaya, abantu abalahlekile, imibiko yezingozi, izikhalazo ngezisebenzi, nokuthi abanye baphinde babeke izikhalazo. Zonke izikhalazo zilandelwa futhi zihlolwe. Njengoba sisondele isikhathi seholide, kubonakala ukuthi lesi sikhungo sizoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuhlinzekeni ngosizo lwezempilo emphakathini nasekuletheni usizo lokuxhumana uma kunezimo zokuphanga ngesikhathi lesi. Xhumana nathi. Lalela thina. Amahora angama-24 ngosuku. UKhuzwayo akazange abambezele njengoba athatha ithuba lokuba phakathi kwababokuqala kuleli sikhungo ukuthola imishanguzo ye-antiretroviral ye-HIV. Nakuba impilo kaKhuzwayo kanye naleyo yabanye abavakashi abangu-506 kuleli sikhungo ibonisa umehluko omkhulu ezimpilweni zabo kusukela baqala ukuthola imishanguzo, ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu ekhaya njengoba umyeni wakhe engafuni ukuzwa lutho ngempilo ye-HIV. Uzakwabo uzame ukukhuluma ngakho ngemva kokuthola ukuthi unomphumela oph positif, kodwa umyeni wakhe wenqaba ukulalela le ndaba. Indlela amadoda abheka ngayo amadoda. Ingabe lokhu kuyinkinga? Ngokusho kukaNzuza, lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuthi amadoda azibona kanjani emphakathini. UNzuza uthi kukhona izikhathi lapho amaqembu, ikakhulukazi amadoda, engafuni ukubonakala ethola imishanguzo kuze kube phezulu kokuthi benqume ukufihla imishanguzo enikezwa ozakwabo. Omunye weziguli zethu waze wathi usikhumbuza ukuthi imishanguzo yakhe iyaphuma. Ngesikhathi sokuqhuba ucwaningo lwethu, sathola ukuthi umyeni wakhe ubebamba amaphilisi akhe. Sabe sesichaza kuye ukuthi kuyingozi kanjani ukungalandeli imiyalelo uma usebenzisa imishanguzo njengoba kungase kuphumelele kube nokungasebenzi kahle, kuchaza uNksz. Nzuza. IMnyango Wezempilo ukhuthaze amadoda ukuthi nawo asebenzise uhlelo lukamasipala lokuthola imishanguzo mahhala. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezikhona ohlelweni lwemishanguzo mayelana nokulandela imiyalelo efanele yokusebenzisa imishanguzo, uhlelo lusebenza kahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zitholakala kuzo zonke izifunda eziyi-11 zaleli phondo. Lezi zikhungo zineziqinisekiso ezihlinzeka kubantu abadala, izingane, nabesifazane abakhululiwe. UNzuza uthi abantu abathola imishanguzo bangabantu abanokubala kwe-CD4 ngaphansi kuka-200. Inani le-HIV virus emzimbeni womuntu libizwa ngokuthi i-viral load. Odokotela bahlola i-viral load emzimbeni ngesikhathi besebenzisa isiguli ngoba ukuncipha kwayo kusho ukuthi imishanguzo iyasebenza. Ukwanda kwe-viral load kumuntu osebenzisa imishanguzo kungase kube uphawu lokuthi isiguli sinezinkinga lapho imishanguzo ingasebenzi kahle noma ukuthi imishanguzo ayithathwa kahle. Imishanguzo iyasebenza kahle uma ithathwa njengoba kuqondiswe udokotela noma um nurse. Ukushiya isikhathi sokuthatha imishanguzo kungadala ukuthi i-virus ikhululeke futhi ingase ingasebenzi kahle emzimbeni. Amalungelo abathuthukisi bezitshalo anikezwa kuphela ezitshalweni ezithile, ezimemezelwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wamalungelo Abathuthukisi Bezitshalo ka-1976. Kukhona cishe izitshalo eziyi-290 ezihlanganiswe ohlwini, bheka iwebhusayithi: lapho amalungelo abathuthukisi bezitshalo anganikezwa khona. Izingxenye zezitshalo ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka ezingenziwa zathengiswa eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Kumele zibe ngezinhlobo zezihlahla, noma izintambo, izingxenye ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka, ezingatholakali kwezinye izindawo, ngokuhweba noma emiphakathini isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha, noma uma kukhulunywa ngohlobo lwezitshalo, iminyaka emine. Kumele zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo, okusho ukuthi zonke izitshalo ezitshalwe ngesikhathi esifanayo kumele zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo. Kumele zibe zizinzile, izitshalo ezithile, emva kokuphindaphinda ukutshala, kumele zihlale zifana nezitshalo zakudala. Kumele zibe ngezinhlobo ezamukelekayo. Bheka itafula 1 loMthetho Wamalungelo Abathuthukisi Bezitshalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhlobo lwezitshalo oludinga ukuvikelwa lukhulunywe. Uma uhlobo lwezitshalo lungekho etafuleni, thumela isicelo sokumemezela nencwadi echaza isizathu esivumelekile kuMlawuli Wamalungelo Abathuthukisi Bezitshalo. Imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kumnikazi, uma ungumthuthukisi ophindaphindayo, wuhlobo olukhethiwe noma olwakhiwe. Sicela uchaze embuzweni ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ezaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika lezi zihlobo kufanele ziqhathaniswe nazo, izinhlobo ezintsha kumele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kubonakale umehluko wazo. Ungafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa okwesikhashana kwalezi zihlobo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi lezi zihlobo zivikela ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa. Kumele unikeze ukuzibophezela okubhalwe phansi kokungathengisi noma yimaphi amamathiriyali okuhlinzeka ngohlobo lwezitshalo oluhlolwayo kuze kube sekupheleni kokuhlolwa konke futhi amalungelo okuhlinzeka ngalezi zitshalo anikezwa. Kuhle ukuba nokuvikelwa okwesikhashana kwezitshalo lapho izinhlobo zihlolwa ezithatha isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Kukhona izinsuku ezibekiwe lapho imibhalo namathiriyali ezingxenye ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka kufanele athunyelwe kuMlawuli. Lezi zinsuku, inani lamathiriyali okwakha amamathiriyali okuhlinzeka ngama plants, nokuthi kufanele athunyelwe kuphi, zingatholakala uma ziceliwe kuMlawuli. Uma uhlu lwezinhlobo lukhona lwezihlobo lwezitshalo olwenziwa isicelo samalungelo okuhlinzeka, thumela izicelo ndawonye zonke izikhathi nezindleko. Inqubo yokuhlola amalungelo okuhlinzeka ngezithombo zezitshalo ithatha cishe isikhathi sokutshala esisodwa.
iBMW - Umfanekiso Wokuhamba Okuphakeme I-BMW, okuyisithombe esihloniphekile emhlabeni wezimoto, ibonakala njengenkanyezi emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Le mboni, eyasungulwa eJalimane, inhloso yayo enkulu iwukuhlinzeka ngempilo yokuhamba engcono. Ngaphezu kokuba imoto, iBMW ibonakala njengophawu lwezinga, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nesitayela. Ukuhlonishwa kwayo akugcini nje ngempahla yayo ebonakalayo, kodwa futhi kusekelwe emsebenzini wayo ophakeme. Ngokwethu sikhuluma nge-BMW, imoto ngayinye iyinsiza yokuhamba enezici ezihlukahlukene. I-BMW ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, obuhlanganisa izici zokuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokunethezeka. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezimotweni zayo ezidumile, njenge-BMW 3 Series ne-BMW X5, ezikhombisa ukuthi iBMW ayinikezi kuphela imoto, kodwa inikeza umuzwa ophakeme wokuhamba, okwenza umsebenzisi azizwe ehloniphekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iBMW ibonakale ibhekana nezinselelo, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni oshintsha ngokushesha. Ukukhula kwemakethe yemoto ye-electronic kanye nezidingo zokunciphisa umthelela emvelweni, kudinga ukuthi le mboni ibheke phambili. Ngakho-ke, iBMW ithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokwakha izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, njenge-BMW i3 ne-iX, okukhombisa ukuthi ibona ukubaluleka kokuzivumelanisa nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba iBMW ibhekana nezinguquko, kukhona abanye abakhathazekile ngentengo yezimoto zayo. I-BMW ibonakala iyimfashini, okwenza izimoto zayo zibe phezulu kakhulu, nokwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kuzo. Futhi, izindleko zokugcina lezi zimoto ziphinde zibe phezulu, okuvimbela abanikazi bazo. Ukuze ibheke phambili, iBMW kufanele iqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokwenza izimoto zayo zibe zishibhile, ngaphandle kokunciphisa izinga. Lokhu kuzodinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza. I-BMW kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi zibe zithengekayo, ukuze ikwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuba babe neBMW, futhi kuzokwenza umkhiqizo ube neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iBMW kufanele iqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi bayo. Ukuze ibambe iqhaza elikhulu emakethe, iBMW kufanele iqonde izidingo zabathengi bayo, ifune izindlela zokwenza imoto zibe nezici ezithokozisayo, ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzisi. Ekugcineni, iBMW iyinkampani ehloniphekile, enezinhloso eziphakeme zokuhlinzeka ngempilo yokuhamba engcono. Nokho, kufanele ibheke phambili, ibhekane nezinselelo ezikhona, futhi iqhubeke nokwakha imoto ezithokozisayo, ezithengekayo. Uma iBMW ikwazi ukwenza lokhu, izoba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezokuthutha, futhi izokwazi ukuheha abathengi abaningi. I-BMW ayigcini nje ngokuhamba, kodwa ibonisa indlela yokuhamba okuphakeme, okwenza umsebenzisi azizwe ehloniphekile. Lokhu kuyisifiso esikhulu, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi iBMW izokwazi ukufinyelela kulokhu.
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Ngisho noma sithatha ukunakekela umzimba wethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isandleni sakho. Ngakho-ke, qaphela. Uma ungashisi, ngeke ube nezinkinga zempilo. Abantu abaningi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bayazi lokho. Ngakho-ke, abashisi izigubhu noma amaphepha, futhi abakhwabanisi itshwala noma bashise isikhumba (itshwala esiphumayo). Le bhukwana contains amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana nokuphila impilo enempilo. Into engcono kakhulu umuntu angayenza ukuvuma ukuthi angakhethi ukuqalisa ukushisa noma ayeke uma eseshisa. Sithemba ukuthi uzokhetha ukuphila kahle ngokungasondeli ezigubhu noma ekushiseni. Funda indaba kaDudu... Um husband wakho uyakhwehlela kakhulu, Gugu. (Pic.1). Kuzoba ngcono uma engayeki ukushisa! (Pic.1). Uyazi ukuthi sengishise iminyaka eminingi futhi akukho okwakuhambile kimi! (Pic.2). Ubonile uDudu, le yimpilo yami ngakho nginela ukushisa ngendlela engifuna ngayo! (Pic.3). Kulungile, uyakhumbula ukuthi uDkt. Zondi, udokotela ophakanyisiwe, uthi abantu abaningi abafika esibhedlela ukuze bathole ukwelashwa banezifo ezidalwe ukushisa? (Pic.3). Umonakalo odalwe ukushisa itshwala ngaphakathi emzimbeni wakho usuku nosuku uyalimaza inhliziyo yakho, amathambo, imithambo yegazi, nezinye izingxenye zomzimba wakho. Ekugcineni, impilo yakho yonke iyahluleka. Ukushisa itshwala kubulala izigidi zabantu emhlabeni wonke unyaka nonyaka! (Pic.3). Lokhu akusho lutho ngoba sonke sizofela ekugcineni. Angiboni inkinga uma ngibulawa yinto engiyithokozelayo. (Pic.4). Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukushisa itshwala kuphinde kufakwe ngabantu abakuzungezile futhi kubenza babe sengozini efanayo nezifo ezithinta umshisi. (Pic.5). Futhi khumbula njalo uma ushisa isigubhu ukuthi ungase ungafi masisha ngenxa yokushisa, kodwa ungase ube nezifo eziholela ekuchithweni kweminyaka eminingi ubuhlungu, noma ungase ufe ubuhlungu ngenxa yesifo sezinhliziyo. Cabanga ngalokhu ngenkathi usenethuba lokuyeka ukushisa okwamanje! (Pic.6). Igama lami nguDudu. Ngifuna sikhulume ngokuqhuba itshwala. Ake siqale ngokubheka amaphuzu ahlobene nokushisa itshwala. Unyaka nonyaka, abantu abangu-12,000 eNingizimu Afrika bafa ngenxa yesifo senhliziyo, umdlavuza wezinyembezi, nezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza, kanye nesifo se-bronchitis esiqhubekayo. Ukushisa itshwala kufaka isandla ekutheni umuntu abe sengozini yalezi zifo. Emazweni athile, ukushisa kubulala abantu abaningi kunenani elihlanganisiwe labafayo ngenxa ye-HIV/AIDS, utshwala, nezidakamizwa ezifana ne-heroin ne-cocaine, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo. Umshisi angabuyela esimweni esijwayelekile sempilo uma eyeka ukushisa, kuye ngempilo yakhe, isisindo somzimba, ezinye izimo zempilo, nokuthi usushise isikhathi esingakanani. Ngonyaka olandelayo kokuyeka ukushisa, kunezikhathi ezincane zokuthola izifo ezifana ne-bronchitis. Ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi, bafeza umphakathi onjengomuntu ongakaze ashise. Izigubhu nezitshalo ziqukethe inhlanganisela yezinto eziyingozi ezifana ne-carbon monoxide, itshalo, kanye ne-nicotine. Lezi yizona ezenza abashisi bahlupheke. Ukushisa itshwala kuphinde kubangele abathintekayo. Uma usondelene nomshisi, qaphela ukuthi lowo muntu uyaphula impilo yakho ngendlela efanayo abaphula ngayo impilo yabo. Itshwala liyingozi empilweni yakho ngoba liqukethe izinto eziyingozi ezingaphezu kwama-200. Lezi zinto zilimaza amathambo. Uma uqhubeka nokushisa, umonakalo uyaqhubeka. Lezi zinto zingadala ukuhamba komoya okungasebenzi kahle kanye nomdlavuza. I-nicotine iyidroga. Ungase uthole ukuthi unokuxhomeka kwe-nicotine noma uthinteka yinto ethile egazini lakho. Uma uxhomeke kwi-nicotine, kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho nomqondo wakho kudinga i-nicotine njalo. Uzizwa sengathi uyayidinga nsuku zonke. Uma uthinteka yinto ethile egazini lakho, kuba nzima ukuyeka. Yingakho abantu abaningi bethola kunzima ukuyeka ukushisa. Kuthiwani ngesikhumba (itshwala esiphumayo)? Isikhumba siqukethe zonke izinto eziyingozi ezitholakala ezigubhu. Abantu abashisa isikhumba bangathinteka yizifo ezithile, ezifana nezifo zomlomo, zomlomo, nezifo zomgudu. Kuthiwani nge-marijuana? Odokotela bathole ukuthi i-marijuana ilimaza umzimba wakho ngendlela efanayo yokushisa itshwala. Uma uxhomeke ekushiseni i-marijuana, uzogcina ungakwazi ukusebenza, ukufunda, ukudlala, noma ukujabulela. Kukhona izinhlobo zetshezi ezingalimalanga? Cha, azikho. Izigubhu, ama-cigar, amaphepha, kanye nesikhumba zonke ziyingozi empilweni yakho. Uma umuntu eshisa izigubhu ezimbalwa ngosuku, lokho kungamphazamisa? Ngisho nokushisa isigubhu esisodwa ngosuku kungaba yingozi! Ungaqali ukushisa! Umonakalo emzimbeni wakho uqala lapho uqala ukushisa. Ungase ubukeke unempilo iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokuthi izimpawu zesifo ziqale ukuvela. Ingabe kuyingozi ukuhlinza itshwala elishiswa abanye? Yebo, ungathola izifo eziningi uma uphila noma usebenza nomshisi. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba uhlinza itshwala labo nsuku zonke. Izingane ezazalwe kubazali abashisayo zivame ukuhamba nezifo zokuphefumula ezifana ne-bronchitis ne-pneumonia, okungajwayelekile ezinganeni ezingenabo abazali abashisayo. Kuyilungelo lakho ukuphefumula umoya ohlanzekile! Abashisi kumele bahloniphe leli lungelo. Abashisi abaningi bayalwela ukuyeka ngoba abazi ukuthi ukushisa kuthinta kanjani impilo yabo. Ake sikhulume ngezinye zalezi zifo. Ukushisa kudala izifo eziningi ezahlukene. Eziyinhloko ezingozi yizifo zamathambo, umdlavuza, izifo zenhliziyo, nezifo zokuphefumula. Abantu abanezinye izifo zamathambo bangahlupheka iminyaka eminingi bekhwehlela nokushoda komoya. Izinhlobo eziningi zomdlavuza, ezifana nomdlavuza wezinyembezi, zidalwa ukushisa. Akukho ukwelashwa komdlavuza wezinyembezi. Ukushisa kungadala nomdlavuza kwezinye izingxenye zomzimba, ezifana nomlomo, ibhodlela, izitho zomzimba, ulimi, nezinye. Igazi emzimbeni wethu lihamba ngezitshalo ezincane esibiza ngemicabango yegazi. Ukushisa kudala ukuthi lezi zikhala zibe mncane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi igazi alikwazi ukuhamba, okungumngani omkhulu. Uma igazi lingafiki endaweni ethile yomzimba, leyo ndawo iyafa. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho umuntu ehlushwa yisifo se-stroke noma ukuhamba komoya. Abantu abaningi bafa kulezi zifo. Uma bephila
Ukwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni: Ucwaningo kuMbuso Wezinguquko Zamasiko Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni, ikakhulukazi endlini yezemfundo, kubalulekile ekwakheni isimo esihle sokusebenza nolwazi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Embonini yaseNingizimu Afrika, lapho isiZulu nesingisi kungenye yezilimi ezisemthethweni, kubalulekile ukufaka izilimi eziningi eziyisisekelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi, bahlale befunda ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezithiyo zemibono noma zolimi. Lesi sihloko sihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemibono ebalulekile mayelana nokubaluleka kokwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni, kuhlanganisa kusebenzelana kwezilimi, ukukhiqiza izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa, kanye neqhaza lezilimi ekuthuthukiseni imibono. Isizinda Sokwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kuhambisana nokwelulekwa ngokwezakhamuzi, lapho abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bezokwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakalayo. Umqondo wokuphila kwabasemhlabeni uhambisana nemihlangano yokufunda nabanye abantu. Uhlelo lwemfundo olusekela izilimi eziningi lukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, okukhuthaza umqondo wokuqonda okwengeziwe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zindlela ziziphumelelayo, izikhungo zidinga ukuhlela izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibandakanya izilimi ezahlukene, okuyokwenza kube nokusizana okukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Izindlela Zokweseka Izilimi Izikhungo zingasebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokweseka izilimi eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo zokufunda ezilimini ezahlukene ezinhlelweni zabo. Isibonelo, ukufundisa isiZulu njengomkhiqizo wokuqala kwazulu kudinga ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezinto eziphathekayo, njengokuphathwa ngendlela efanele kokuqukethwe. Lokhu kuheha ukufundwa kwesikhathi eside kunoma imuphi umgomo wezifundo, uyisibonelo esibalulekile sokukhuthaza ukwaluka kolimi. Ukuqiniseka ukuthi izinhlelo zokufunda zifaka izilimi eziningi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlola yonke imibono ngaphandle kokuhlukaniswa kwabantu. Izinkinga Ezibangelwa Ukungafaki Izilimi Eziningi Ukungafaki izilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kudala izinkinga ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuba abafundi baziqhenye ngamasiko abo, kanti futhi kubangela ukuntuleka kokubona ubumqoka bezilimi ezahlukene komunye nomunye. Ukungafaki izilimi eziningi kungaphinde kuholele ekunciphiseni amathuba okuphumelela kwabafundi, njengoba abanye bengahamba bephakathi kwezithiyo zomqondo eziphakeme ekufundeni. Izenzakalo zalesi sikhangiso zikhombisa ukuthi indlela yethu yokubhekelwa kwezilimi eziningi izodinga ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ukuze kufezwe umbono wokufunda ophumelelayo kanye nezigidi zemali eziphakanyisiwe. Izithelo Ezinomthelela Wokweseka Izilimi Eziningi Ukusebenzisa izilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kuhlelwe kahle, kudala izithelo ezibushelelezi kumfundi wonke. Ikhansela umqondo wokubusa ngendlela ehlinzeka ngokuhlonishwa nokuhlakanipha, okuyinto eyinhloko ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kwangathi kube nezinhlelo eziqhamukayo ezithokozisayo, ukufinyelela kuzobonakala kunciphisa izinkinga zokuqonda. Ukwesekwa kwezilimi ezahlukene kufana nohlanga oluhlaza, kuvula amathuba okuthuthukisa ubuhlakani bokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuselela imicabango yezezilimi eziningi kudinga iqhaza elikhulu lobuholi ezikhungweni, njengoba libalulekile ekuqoqeni imiphuma efanele. Imithetho emisha kanye nemihlahlandlela kufanele ibhalwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kwenzeka ukuthuthuka okubalulekile. Ukwakha ithuluzi le-intanethi elihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile kubafundi nesikole kuyisimiso esifanele, okunikeza imiphumela emihle. Isiphetho Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni akukhuthazi nje kuphela ukufunda, kodwa kudala indawo eqinile yokubambisana phakathi kwezizinda ezahlukene. Ukuqonda izilimi ezisemqoka njengesiZulu nesiNgisi kufaka ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokwazisa, okuhambisana ngokuphelele nokwakhiwa komhlaba wezemfundo ophumelelayo. Uhlelo olusekela izilimi eziningi lungathinta imiphakathi eningi, luthuthukise ukuxhumana nokuhlonipha izizinda ezahlukahlukene, futhi finalizes inqubo yokwakha impilo engcono kubafundi bonke. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izilimi zithathwa ngokweqophelo, zidlulisela imiyalezo ethile eyenza kube nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo ejulile emphakathini.
Sebenzisa ipeni emnyama noma eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lempahla futhi ugcine ukubhala kwakho ngaphakathi kwezikhala ezitholakalayo. Sicela usebenzise izinhlamvu ezinkulu uma ugcwalisa le phepha. UNGASHIYI izikhala ezingenalutho ongazidingi. Sicela ungasebenzisi umoya wokulungisa uma wenza iphutha. Siphinde sicele ukuthi ungayigubungeli ifomu lakho lempahla njengoba lokhu kuzodlula isikhathi sokucubungula. Kufanele uqedele zonke izingxenye ezihlobene nephepha lempahla. Noma yisiphi ifomu lempahla elingagcwaliswanga ngokuphelele lizobuyiselwa kuwe libhalwe "alingathunyelwanga" kuze kube ubuyisela ngokuphelele. Lokhu kungaholela ezijezweni zokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngokweqile. Ukusayina: ifomu lempahla liyisitatimende esisemthethweni esidinga ukuthi uveze yonke imali engenayo, intela, nezikhala unyaka wonke. Ngaphandle kokusayina kwakho, akusho lutho. Imali etholelwe uma ungazange uthole imali engenayo unyaka wonke kufanele igcwaliswe kule ngxenye ngokufaka zero (0). AZIKHO izingxenye okufanele uziqhamukele efomini lakho uma uthumela ku-SARS. Nokho, wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene kufanele agcinwe iminyaka emihlanu uma i-SARS icela. Ukuze kube lula, kulo nyaka i-SARS ithumele ifomu lempahla elisha elingu-IT12C kwabantu. Uma uthole ifomu le-IT12C kodwa uzwa ukuthi ungaphansi kwesigaba se-IT12S, kufanele ugcwalise futhi uthumele lelo fomu le-IT12C; ungaceli ifomu le-IT12S. Ngesikhathi sokucubungula, i-SARS izoshintsha uhlobo lwefomu ngokusekelwe kulwazi olunikeziwe efomini lakho lamanje futhi izoshintsha uhlelo ngokufanele ukuze ikhiphe ifomu elilungile ngonyaka olandelayo. Qinisekisa ukunembile kolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze ufake imininingwane enembile. Isimo somshado njengoba sikhona ngoFebhuwari 28, 2007: Beka ibhlogo efanele nge "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) usebenzisa "X" futhi uma ushade, khombisa nge "X" ukuthi umshado usemphakathini wezimpahla noma cha. Qinisekisa ukunembile kolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze uhlinzeke imininingwane enembile. Sicela ugcwalise imininingwane yekheli lomqashi wakho wamanje. Uma usebenze endaweni engaphezu kweyodwa phakathi nesikhathi sikaMashi 1, 2006, kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2007, gcwalisa imininingwane yekheli lomqashi wakho omkhulu - lapho usebenze khona amahora amaningi. Uma ungasebenzi, shiya le ndawo ingenalutho. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimali ezibuyiswayo kwenziwa kusetshenziswa ikhodi yephoyisa, hhayi igama lebhange. Ngakho-ke, akudingeki ukuhlinzeka ngegama lebhange olisebenzisayo. Qaphela: i-SARS ikhipha ama-cheque kuphela ezimweni ezikhethekile, ngakho kufanele uhlinzeke ngemininingwane yebhange ukuze uthole ukubuyiselwa. Akukho ukubuyiselwa okuzobekwa kwi-akhawunti yebhange yomuntu wesithathu. Khombisa indlela yakho yokuxhumana oyithandayo ngokubeka ibhlogo efanele usebenzisa izinombolo 1 kuya ku-5. Inombolo 1 ibonisa ukukhetha okuthandwayo kanti 5 ibonisa ukukhetha okungathandwa. Uma usebenzisa umhlinzeki wentela ukuze ugcwalise iphepha lakho lempahla, lowo mhlinzeki uzogcwalisa ulwazi. Uma uthola imali eboniswe kumasertifiketi IRP5/IT3(a), kufanele uyilawule njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. Ikhodi kukholomu yokuqala ibonisa umthombo wemali yakho kanti ikholomu yokugcina ibonisa inani olitholile. Lezi yizinkanyezi kuphela ozodinga ukuzigcwalisa kule ngxenye yefomu. Uma uthola kuphela i-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, uzogcwalisa inani bese ufaka ikhodi yomthombo efanele kule ngxenye yefomu njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. Uma unezigaba ezingaphezu kwezishiyagalombili ezahlukene, kufanele uxhumane neCall Centre ku-0860 12 12 18 ukuze uthole usizo ekuqedeni ifomu lakho lempahla. Izimali zitholakala engxenyeni yeziqhamo eziphelele ze-IRP5. Sebenzisa inani eliboniswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 ukuze ugcwalise le ngxenye - uma uthole ama-IRP5/IT3(a) amaningi, zonke izimali eziboniswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 kufanele zengezwe ndawonye futhi inani eliphelele lifakwe efomini njengekhodi 2697. Ngemigomo yentela, imali yokutshalwa kwezimali ifakwa emalini engenayo njengenzalo yasendaweni, inzalo yangaphandle, kanye nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle. Inzalo yasendaweni iboniswa ekhasini lesibili lempahla yakho futhi amalungiselelo enziwa ekhasini lesithathu lempahla yakho yokukhombisa imali etholelwe ezinsalweni zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle kanye nanoma yimaphi amakhredithi entela yangaphandle, uma kudingeka. Hlanganisa izimali ezihlobene nezinsalo zasendaweni eziboniswe kumasertifiketi atholwe ngawe nomkakho. Gcwalisa izimali eziphelele zezinsalo ezitholwe nguwe nomkakho - ingxenye engathathi hlangothi izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezinsalo zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle. Khumbula futhi ukuhlanganisa noma yimaphi amakhredithi entela ahlobene ngawe nomkakho bese ugcwalisa inani eliphelele eduze kwekhodi efanele ekhasini lesithathu lempahla yakho. Amalungiselelo enziwe efomini ukuze akhombise ngokwehlukana amakhredithi entela ahlobene nezinsalo zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle. Hlanganisa izimali eziboniswe njengenzalo yasendaweni kumasertifiketi owatholile. Gcwalisa izimali zamakhredithi entela ezingathathi hlangothi - ingxenye engathathi hlangothi izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezinsalo zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle futhi ubonise izimali eziphelele ekhasini lesithathu lempahla yakho ezikhala ezifanele. Qaphela: Le yindawo kuphela yephapha lempahla lapho i-RAND NE CENTS isetshenziswa. Ukuze ugcwalise le ngxenye, usadinga ama-IRP5/IT3(a) akho. Ifomu lempahla livumela ama-sertifiketi amathathu futhi ngaleyo ndlela lihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Khombisa inani labantu abancike kulabo abahlinzekwa ngemali. Ulwazi oludingekayo lubhekisela kumali oyikhokhele emfundweni yezokwelapha kuze kube nguFebhuwari 28, 2007, mayelana nawe nabanye abantu abaregistered kulolo mfundo. Le mininingwane ivame ukuboniswa kumazwi owatholayo kumfundisi wakho wezokwelapha. Ingabe inani lehlukile phakathi nonyaka wokuhlola? Beka ibhlogo "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) nge "X". Uma impendulo ingeyebo, khombisa inani labantu abancike ngenyanga. Uma wena, umkakho, noma ingane unokukhubazeka, inani lezindleko ezihlobene nalokhu kufanele lifakwe lapha uma lingakafakwa emfundweni yezokwelapha. Khombisa iminikelo kuPension Fund yakho.
