Lo mthetho ophakanyisiwe umele izinkolelo zokudlala nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa kudlala indima ekuphumeleleni kwabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyindlela enhle yokubandakanya intsha emicimbini ezokwakha imiphakathi. Eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, umgomo wokuqala wezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa washicilelwa okokuqala emthethweni ophakanyisiwe lapho izinselelo, izinqubomgomo, nezinto ezibalulekile zavezwa ngokucacile. Kwenziwe okuningi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nalezi zinkinga nezinto ezibalulekile, kodwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwesikhathi esanele nezinsiza, indlela phambili isalinde isikhathi eside. Ngemva kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zikamasipala, kubalulekile ukuthi izinto ezibalulekile kwezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa zihlolwe futhi zishintshwe. Ukuze kufezwe umgomo wezinqubomgomo zikamasipala wokuphila kahle kwabantu bonke, futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi udlala, ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa laseNingizimu Afrika kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudlala kufinyelela zonke izingxenye zeNingizimu Afrika. Izinhlangano ezivela kubaxhasi abafana nePoverty Relief, Ukwakhiwa Kwezinsiza, izinkokhelo ezitholwe kwiJob Summit, nezezimali ezivela kwiNational Lottery zokuthuthukisa ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa ezindaweni ezazishiywe ngaphandle uhulumeni bangaphambili kuzoba yindlela efanele yokwenza ukudlala kufinyeleleke kubantu abaningi baleli. UMbutho Wezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) ubeke lezi zinto ezilandelayo, ezisemqoka kumgomo othi "siyenza umphakathi udlale." a) ukukhulisa ukubamba iqhaza emicimbini yokudlala nezokuzijabulisa b) ukukhuthaza umlando wezokudlala naphezu kwezinto eziphikisanayo c) ukwandisa amathuba okuphumelela emicimbini emikhulu d) ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezibalulekile emizamweni yokubhekana nezinto ezibalulekile zizwe. Zonke izinto ezibalulekile zithatha indlela yokuguqula futhi le ncwadi ibhekana kahle nalomsebenzi, njengoba singashintshi emsebenzini wethu ohlelweni lwezinqubomgomo zikamasipala. Ukwenza umphakathi udlale kuyisisekelo/sihloko salomthetho ophakanyisiwe. Ukufeza le njongo kudinga imizamo nokuzinikela kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni (NGOs), umkhakha ozimele, kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo ezibandakanyekayo ekwakheni isisekelo sesiko lokudlala nezokuzijabulisa. Umthwalo wokwakha izinsiza nezindawo zokudlala nezokuzijabulisa uphonsa ezikhwameni zoMnyango Wezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) kanye neKomidi Lezokudlala laseNingizimu Afrika (SASC). Ukungalingani phakathi kwemiphakathi ethola izinsiza kahle, evame ukuba emadolobheni, kanye nemiphakathi eshiywe ngaphandle, ikakhulukazi leyo emaphandleni, kubonakala. Intsha yaleli nalesi simo sokuthuthukiswa kwezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa kubalulekile. Kukhona isidingo sokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ithathe indawo yayo efanele emphakathini wezokudlala womhlaba. Izinhlangano (IFs). Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezepolitiki, ezokuxhumana, nezomnotho, njengendima nomthelela wokubambisana kwamazwe, kanye nokuhweba kwezokudlala nokukhula komkhakha wezindaba, akufanele kuphuthunyiswe. Kwenziwe imizamo eminingi yokuchaza kahle ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa. Nokho, ukusondelana kulokhu akukakafinyeleli. Ngokusho komgomo walomthetho ophakanyisiwe, incazelo elandelayo iyanele. UKUDLALA kungachazwa njengomsebenzi noma imisebenzi ethile edinga umzamo womzimba, futhi labo abathatha inxaxheba kufanele balandele indlela ethile noma engathathwa, ngenhloso yokufeza umnqobi noma umphumela ophumelelayo, noma ngenye indlela; noma ngenhloso yokuphumula, ukujabula, impilo yomzimba, ukukhula komoya, nokuthuthukiswa. Nokho, mhlawumbe okubaluleke kakhulu, indima yokudlala iwukuzama ukwakha ubunye bezwe. Umthelela wezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa awugcinanga kulabo abathatha inxaxheba noma abahilelekile. Uhlanga lwezokudlala lukhuluma emikhakheni eminingi yokuphila efana nempilo; imfundo; umnotho; ukuziphatha okungahambisani nokuphila kahle; ukwakha isizwe kanye nezokuxhumana kwamazwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi uMbutho Wezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika uzohlinzeka ngezidingo zabantu bonke, usebenzisa inani lezezimali elifanele elalingasetshenziswa ngaphambili ukuhlinzeka ngama-20% abantu ngesikhathi sokuphatha kukahulumeni wangaphambili. Nakuba indlela esibheka ngayo ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa kufanele kusekelwe ezimweni nasezinkolelweni zaseNingizimu Afrika, isimo sezwe, imiphakathi yalo, umlando walo, ifa lalo, kanye nezinqubomgomo zikamasipala zokudlala nezokuzijabulisa kufanele kuhlangane nezimo zomhlaba. Kutholakale ukuthi kunokuntuleka kokwazi indima edlalwa ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa kuleli. Abaholi beqembu leHulumeni leCommonwealth ababeHarare bathole okulandelayo mayelana nomthelela wezokudlala emphakathini: Isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi indima ebalulekile edlalwa ukudlala ekwakheni isizwe ibonakale ngokuphelele. Ukudlala kungagcina. Okokuqala, kungagcina impilo, ubude bokuphila, kanye nokukhiqiza kwabantu, noma kudale umsebenzi ophawulekayo kubantu. Okwesibili, kungagcina ikusasa. Izinzuzo ezitholakala ekuphathweni kahle zifaka phakathi impilo engcono yomzimba, engqondweni, kanye nokukhula komoya kubantu bonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abadlali abaphumelelayo baba izibonelo ezinhle zentsha yaleso sizwe, njengabantu abavelele, noma ngabe abanakho ukukhethwa nguhulumeni, futhi njengabantu abazinikela ekubambisaneni okulinganayo nokwamukelekayo. Izifo eziningi ezifana ne-hypertension zixhomeke ekwelashweni noma emisebenzini yomzimba okufanele ilandelwe. Emazweni athuthukayo, kukhona ukukholwa ukuthi wonke rand osetshenziswe ekudlaleni nasekuzijabuliseni kunciphisa izindleko zempilo ngama-rand ayikhulu. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ukudlala kuqeqesha ingane ngezindlela zokuphila ngendlela engadlula nganoma iyiphi enye imisebenzi. Kukhona futhi ubufakazi bokuthi imfundo yomzimba iholela ekusebenzeni kahle ezifundweni. Njengoba zinegqugquzela elihle empilweni, imisebenzi yomzimba inemiphumela emihle ezingeni lokukhiqiza. Ukwehla kwezinga lempazamo emsebenzini kuhambisana nempilo engcono yomzimba, eyingxenye ye-23% eholela ekulondolozeni izinsuku nezindawo zonyaka. Ngokuphikisana nalesi sisho sokuthi umdali uthola umsebenzi wezandla ezingenamsebenzi, lesi sisho sithi ingane edlalayo ingane engakathwali. Ukuziphatha njengokuhamba kancane kuhambisana nokuntuleka kokuzethemba, kanti impumelelo emidlalweni nezokuzijabulisa ithuthukisa ukuzethemba. Labo abakhombisa izibonelo ezinhle emidl
Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Ezinengi Izimo eziphuthumayo zenzeka ngezikhathi ezahlukene, zifaka phakathi izingozi zomgwaqo, imicimbi yemvelo, noma izimo zokuphuthumayo ezidinga ukusiza okusheshayo. Ukuphendula kulezi zimo kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekusebenziseni izimoto eziningi. Le ngxoxo izobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga zokuphendula ngezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi, kanye nezindlela zokwenza lokhu kube ngempumelelo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimoto eziningi zingaba usizo olukhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Uma kwenzeka ingozi enkulu, izimoto eziningi zingahlinzeka ngosizo olusheshayo, zifaka phakathi izimoto zokuhamba ezisheshayo, izimoto zokuhambisa abaphilayo, kanye nezimoto zokuthutha impahla. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezidingekayo zifika ngesikhathi, okungasiza ukusindisa izimpilo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma kwenzeka ingozi enkulu emgwaqweni, izimoto eziningi zingasebenza ndawonye ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abaphilayo baphuthunyiswa ezibhedlela ngokushesha. Nokho, ukuphendula ngezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi akukhona njalo okungahamba kahle. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezihambisana nalokhu wukuhamba kwezimoto eziningi emgwaqweni. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakhekeni kwemigwaqo, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma izimoto ziningi ziqhuba ndawonye, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuphendula. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphendula kuhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene, ukuze wonke umuntu aqonde kahle ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto eziningi zingase zibe nezindleko eziphezulu. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziningi ezidingekayo ukuze kuphendulwe ezimeni eziphuthumayo kungaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko, okungase kube yinkinga kumaphoyisa, ezokwelapha, noma emaphandleni. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha izinsiza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindleko zihlala ziphansi, kodwa ukusebenza kuhamba kahle. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimoto eziningi zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezicacile, ezihlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukuhlela izinsiza, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwamaqembu. Ngokubheka izinzuzo nezinkinga zokuphendula ngezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukuhlela izinsiza, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphendula kuhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana, ukuze wonke umuntu aqonde kahle ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zifika ngesikhathi. Ekugcineni, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kuyinselele, kodwa futhi kuyithuba lokwenza ngcono izinqubo zokuphendula. Ngokuhlela kahle, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwamaqembu, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo ziphendulwa kahle, futhi izimpilo ziyasindiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza ekuphenduleni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifika ngesikhathi, futhi izimo eziphuthumayo ziphendulwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izimpilo ziyasindiswa. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukuhlela, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zifika ngesikhathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusindisa izimpilo, futhi sithuthukise izinqubo zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo.

Ungathola umsebenzi wobuciko emnyuziyamu ofana nalezi zifanekiso ezimbili ozibukile? Uthole le nto ngezindlela EZINTATHU EZIHLOKILE? Yini umehluko phakathi kweSITHOMBE kumakhasi (amakhasi amabili aphuzi anama-cross) kanye NOMSEBENZI WOKWENZA okukhona phambi kwakho? Ake sibheke bobabili imisebenzi yobuciko futhi sikhulume ngendawo. Bheka iMercedes emnyama nephuzi emnyuziyamu! Uchwepheshe wezobuciko ubebheka izimoto ezingakanani? Ubonani ngezindlela EZINTATHU EZIHLOKILE eduze kwezimoto? Ake sizame ukudweba le nto NGOKUBONAKALA KWEZINYONI. Bheka lo msebenzi wobuciko. Lesi sithombe sikhombisa indawo yokuhlala ngokubukeka kwezinhlamvu. Ake sibhale uhlelo lwezitezi lwekilasi lakho olunezinto zonke ngaphakathi bese sisebenzisa ukubonakala kwezinhlamvu. Lesi sithombe senziwe nguZwelethu Mthethwa ophila eCape Town. Ukuze adale iphrojekthi yakhe yobuciko, uvakashela abantu futhi athathe izithombe ezindlini zabo. Chaza indlu oyibona. Ake sibhale ikhaya lakho ngezindlela ezintathu ezahlukene: lapho ulele phansi endlini, lapho ume esihlalweni, kusuka ngaphakathi kuya ngaphandle.
Ukuhlola okuqhubekayo (CASS) kumele kube yingxenye yokufundisa nokufunda futhi kumele kusetshenziswe ezindaweni zokufunda. Umfundi ngeke anikezwe umphumela uma uphawu lwakhe lwe-CASS lungekho. Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi ifomu lokumemezela (Appendix A) kumele liqedwe futhi lisayinwe yibo bobabili umfundi nomphathi wesikhungo. Umphathi wesikhungo kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi banephuzu le-CASS eduze kwamagama abo kumashidi ophawu, noma incwadi echaza uma kungekho uphawu olubhaliwe, ngaphambi kokuhambisa amaphothifoliyo ku-ABET District Support. Abaphathi be-ABET Centre bazohlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze basebenzisane futhi babelane ngemininingwane mayelana nohlelo lokufunda nokuhlola. Umphathi wesikhungo kuzo zonke izikhungo kulindeleke ukuthi aqoqe umbiko wokuthi i-ICASS ihamba kanjani ezindaweni zokufunda zonke futhi athumele lo mbiko ku-ABET District Support njalo ngenyanga. Abasebenzi be-ABET District Support kumele baqoqe umbiko we-CASS besebenzisa imibiko efingqiwe evela kubaphathi bezikhungo kanye nemibiko yokwesekwa nokuqapha ezindaweni zokufunda njengesisekelo. Umbiko we-CASS ohlanganisiwe kumele uthunyelwe ngu-ABET District Support njengoba kukhombisa kuphrojekthi yokuphatha. Abafundi abangakawuqedi wonke amafaneleko mayelana ne-CASS kumele banikezwe uphawu. Ukuhanjiswa kwamaphuzu kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imibhalo ibhalwe kahle. Umphathi wesikhungo kanye ne-ABET District Support kumele baqinisekise ukuthi ukucubungula ezingeni lesikhungo kwenzeka okungenani kanye ngeviki ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindinganiso zokucubungula zizwe nezifunda zigcinwa. Abaphathi bezikhungo kumele bathumele amakhophi wamashidi ophawu asebenzayo ukuze baveze inqubekela phambili eyenziwe ezindaweni zokufunda ezibanjwa ezikhungweni zabo ku-ABET District Support ngomhla kaJulayi 25, 2003. Uhlu lwamagama akhethiwe luzothunyelwa ezikhungweni ngomhla kaAgasti 14, 2003. Amashidi ophawu anophawu olushintshiwe azobuyiselwa ezikhungweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe. Izikhungo zingafaka izikhalazo uma zinganelisekile ngamaphuzu atholakele uma sekuqedile ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesikhalazo (Appendix D). Isikhalazo kumele sihunyushwe ku-ABET District Support phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-2 zokuthola amaphothifoliyo. Ukuhlola kuzohambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zesifunda. Umhloli omkhulu kanye nokwesekwa kwezindawo zokufunda kuzokwazisa abacwaningi ngezindinganiso zokuhlola ezivumelanisiwe emhlanganweni wokuhlola. Uma kukhona ukungafani kokuhumusha phakathi kwalesi sihumusho esihunyushwe kanye nesiginali, isiginali izosihola.
USuku lwaBasha: Umkhosi Wokuhlonipha Abasha Nokuqhakambisa Isiko Emphakathini wethu, usuku lwaBasha luvele lube usuku olukhulu nolugcwele ubusuku nezinsuku, lapho umphakathi uhlangana khona ukuze uhlabela abasha, ubavuselele, futhi ubahloniphe. Lolu suku, olugubha ubuhlakani, amandla, nokuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu abasha, luhlobene nokugqugquzela impumelelo futhi luthuthukise izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kusebenza ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa nakuba ubukhona bayo bukhona ezindaweni ezithile, umoya wayo usakazeke kakhulu. Uhlelo lweSuku lwaBasha luhlelwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi. Ngonyaka, lo mkhosi ubungama-29 kuMfumfu, ube nomoya opholile, ungena eminyakeni eminingi yokugubha leli suku. Izikhumbuzo ezihlukahlukene zafakwa ohlelweni, kufaka phakathi imicimbi yokukhuluma, imiqhudelwano, nemikhosi yokudansa, ukuze kuhlonishwe futhi kuvezwe ubuchwepheshe, ubuciko nemfundo. Kuleli sonto, umkhosi uqale ngephuzu lokukhuluma, okwakuholwa uMnumzane Thulani Zulu, umfundisi ophumelele kakhulu emkhakheni wemfundo. UThulani uvuselele abasha ngokukhuluma ngezifundo ezibalulekile empilweni, ezibandakanya ukubaluleka kokufunda, ukusebenza kanzima, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Izinkanyezi zomculo zabeziqhakambisa umoya wokujabula, zenza izingoma ezithandwayo ukuze kuzuzwe ukuvuselela umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani eziningi zanikela ngezikhumbuzo nokuxhaswa komphakathi. Khona-ke, izindawo zokuqeqesha zazikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi, zandisa ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhlangene nokuxhaswa kwezinhlelo zokufundisa, okuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze abasha baphumelele ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Ngokusho kwezifundo ezitholakele, uSuku lwaBasha ubonakaliswe njengomhlahlandlela wokuphumelela kwabasha. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokuxhumana, izinkulumo-mpikiswano, kanye nemicimbi yokugcina izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngempumelelo, zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Lokhu kuphinde kuthekelelwe ukuba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, kuqhakambisa isithunzi sentsha. Uphakathi lwezokuxhumana lube nesandla esikhulu ekukhuthazeni umkhosi. Amathuluzi wezokuxhumana, afana ne-Facebook, Twitter, kanye ne-Instagram, adlulisa ulwazi ngalesi sikhathi esikhethekile. Lokhu kuvumela abasha ukuthi babonise ubuciko babo, benze izithombe ezikhangayo, futhi baxhumane nabantu abavela kwezinye izindawo. Umoya wokukhuthaza abasha ubonakala ungapheli, njengoba izikhangiso ezahlukene zezinkampani nazo ziqhakambisa uSuku lwaBasha, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe khona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqhubekile nokuhlonipha abasha ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Izikhumbuzo zefilosofi, ezicacisa ngempumelelo, zakhishwa ezikoleni, zibe nomthelela ekukhuthazeni abasha ukuba bazibandakanye. Lokhu kuhlangene nemikhosi yezenzakalo, efana nemikhosi yokuhlukaniswa kwamaBasha, eyenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo nengxoxo ezwakalayo. Ukuphendula kwezakhamuzi kuSuku lwaBasha kubonisa ukuthi leli suku lihamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onamandla. Abantu abasha bazithola bekhululekile, bejabule, futhi bedlula ezivumelwaneni zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi isiko lethu linamandla okuphila, futhi ubuchwepheshe bethu buyasisiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obufanele phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuphetha, uSuku lwaBasha awusizi nje kuphela ekwakheni isithunzi somphakathi wethu, kodwa ubuye uveze impilo ebumbene yabasha. Uhlanga lwethu lufanele ukujabuliswa, futhi uSuku lwaBasha lufanekisela umoya ophilayo wothando, ubumbano, kanye nempumelelo. Njengoba sazi ukuthi abasha bethu bangamaqhawe, kulindeleke ukuthi umoya lo uhanjiswe ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. Lokhu kudinga ukugcinwa, ukuhlonishwa, nokuxhaswa, ukuze sikwazi ukubona isizwe esiqinile, esiyingqayizivele.
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni: Uhambo Olusha Lokuthuthukisa Izinsiza Uhlanga lukaMashi 2023, uHlastwa, eMakhaya - Ezikhungweni eziningi zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, kudlalwa indima ebalulekile ekuhlinzekeni izinsiza ezisemqoka kubantu. Kumaphakathi emphakathini, ukwazi nokufinyelela ngamasu noma izinsiza ezihlinzekwayo phezulu ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu, futhi ngenxa yalokho, kube nezinguquko ezibalulekile eziphakanyiswe ezikhungweni. Ngokwengxenye ebalulekile, uhulumeni wakwaNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele, baqale ukwakha imigomo ehlose ukuvuleka kwezinsiza kumiphakathi, okuhlanganisa izikhungo zemfundo, amathumba okubonisana, nemithombo yolwazi. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthi kulwe nezimo zokungafinyeleli ezimalini, ikakhulukazi kumphakathi osezingeni eliphakeme lokuhlupheka. Imisebenzi yokwenziwa yizikhungo ibonakala njengendlela yokubuyisela emphakathini ngokwandisa ukufinyelela kobuchwepheshe, ulwazi, nezinsiza eziphambili. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kahle, uhulumeni uhlinzeke ngezinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo ukuze aqinisekise ukufinyelela kwamahhala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa, phakathi kokunye, izifundo zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, izinkonzo zokweluleka, kanye nezinsiza eziphathelene nezempilo. Njengoba izikhungo zinikeza ukufinyelela kwamahhala, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokwandisa ulwazi lwawo nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Umphakathi zowaseKapa, uhla lwezinhlelo zikhombisa iqulu lesizathu sokufinyelela kobuchwepheshe bukhona. UJabu Ngema, umphakathi wendawo, ubesebenza nezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngosizo lokusebenzisa amakhompyutha. "Kodwa, siqhubeka sikhumba, ukubaluleka kokufinyelela kwebhodi lokusebenza," esho, emamela izisebenzi zikhuluma ngakho ebhizinisini labantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zezemfundo nazo ziwuphendula umgomo wokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Izikole eziningi zabalwa ukuze ziqinise ukufinyelela kwamahhala kumakhono empilo, ikakhulukazi kumafoni, amakhompyutha, nezinye izinsizakusebenza. Umfundisi Ongema Ndlovu, ophumelele ekwenzeni impumelelo ezinhlelweni ezinjalo, uthi: “Siyaziwuza izinhlelo ezikhiqizayo ezifundisa izingane ukujwayela ubuchwepheshe, ukuze sikhulise ikghono lokusebenza labantu.” Kodwa-ke, ukuqwashisa okuphelele kubalulekile. Imicimbi egqugquzelayo iyadlalwa ukwandisa ukukhuthaza nabantu ukuthi basebenzise lezi zinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi yokufundisa, amakhono okusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezihlukahlukene. Imicimbi ewuhlelo lokukhuthaza abantu, ikakhulukazi abasha, ukwenza okuningi ukuze baziqhenye ngempumelelo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lo hlelo lokufinyelela kwamahhala aze kumphakathi kuboniswa ngempumelelo eningizimu yeMqansa, lapho kwaqalwa khona imikhankaso ehlomulisa abahlali ezikhungweni zempilo. Izikhungo zempilo zishiye umphakathi uthakazelisa, zibeka ubuchwepheshe obunembile kwezokuxilongwa, kubaluleke kakhulu ekuphuculeni izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Lapho inisikelo lemikhiqizo nezinsizakusebenza kuhlangene, izinto ziqhubeka ziba lula. Umphakathi owakhathalelayo, uThuli Mthethwa, uthi: “Lena ithuba elihle lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze zikhuthaze impilo yabo, ngakho-ke kudingeka sibe nesibopho sokusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza.” Nakuba ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kuhlale kunezimpikiswano, kunezinzuzo eziningi ezithi zimotifike imbangi yokufinyelela ngendlela onke. Ukuthola ulwazi olusha, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, konke kuhlangene, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni uqinisekisa ukuthi abantu basezingeni eliphakeme bayatholakala ezinsizeni ezisemqoka ezidingekayo empilweni yabo. Lokhu akuwona umgomo kuphela, kodwa kuyisiphetho somphakathi esiqinile, esibhekene nezinselelo zesikhathi esizayo. Ekupheleni, kuleli zinga elisha lokufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lokhu akusiyona nje enye indlela yokuthuthukisa, kodwa iqalwe ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ezithombile ezingabizayo. Njengoba izikhungo ziqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, umgomo omkhulu uwukwakha umphakathi okhula, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe obuphucukile. Noma yini eyenzekayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke usebenzisana nezikhungo, ukuze kubonakale ubuchwepheshe obuqhamukayo bukhona, ukuzilungiselela ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Abalimi BaseNingizimu Afrika: Umbiko Isingeniso Ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika, abalimi babalulekile ekwakheni umnotho, ekuphakamiseni izinga lempilo, nakwazisa ubuciko nokwaziswa kwemvelo. Abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika banenhlobonhlobo yokukhiqiza, okuhlanganisa ukulima, ubulili bezinkomo, nemifino, okwenza izwe lethu likhanye emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kubalulekile ezingxoxweni zethu ngezinkinga ezithinta abalimi, izinselelo abazihlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imikhakha yabo. Ubuhle Bokulima Abalimi, ikakhulukazi abasemaphandleni, bayingxenye yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Bayabamba iqhaza ekwakheni imisebenzi, ngokukhiqiza ukudla okudingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukulima kudala amathuba emisebenzi, okukhuthaza ukusimama komnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abalimi banendima ebalulekile ekulondolozeni izinsiza zemvelo, njengamanzi, umhlaba, nezitshalo. Izinkinga Eziyinselelo Kodwa-ke, abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika babhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukushoda kwezinsiza, okungukuthi, ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza zokukhiqiza, kanye nezinsiza zemvelo ezithintekayo, kubangele ukuthi abanye abalimi babe sengozini yokungakwazi ukukhiqiza ngokwanele. Ukushoda kwamanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile, kube yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yezinguquko zesimo sezulu ezithinta kakhulu izinqubo zokulima. Ukwamukela Ubuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bube yinsiza ewusizo kubalimi. Ukusetshenziswa kwemishini ethuthukisiwe, izinhlelo zokulima ezihlakaniphile, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhweba ezikwi-inthanethi, kube nemiphumela emihle ekwandiseni ukukhiqiza. Abalimi abaningi baphumelela ekutholeni imithombo yezimali yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, okukhuthaza ukwanda kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimali Nezinhlelo Zokweseka Uhlaka lwezomnotho lwezokulima lwakha ithuba lokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokweseka abalimi. Izinhlelo zomshuwalense, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nezikhungo zokuthuthukisa ezokulima zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho. Lokhu kudinga ubambiswano phakathi kukahulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, nabalimi uqobo. Ukuxhaswa kwezimali kumkhakha wokulima kungenza umehluko omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Izinselelo Zokuphila Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokukhiqiza, abalimi baphinde babhekane nezinkinga zokuphila. Ukungabi namakhaya afanelekayo, ukuntuleka kwemfundo, nokuhamba kancane kwezinsizakalo zempilo, kubangela ukuthi abalimi babe nesikhathi esinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izindlela zokwakha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila zabalimi. Imiphumela Yezinguquko Zesimo Sezulu Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu kubalimi. Ukuze balungiselele lezi zinguquko, abalimi kufanele bathole izindlela zokwenza ngcono imikhuba yokulima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihlakaniphile zokulima, ezifana nokulima ngendlela yokugcina amanzi, nokusebenzisa izitshalo eziphumelelayo ezinamandla okukhula ezimweni ezinzima. Ukwakhiwa Kwezixazululo Zokubambisana Ukuze kuzuze abalimi, udinga kube khona ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa uhulumeni, abathengisi, izikhungo zocwaningo, nezikhungo zemfundo. Uhlelo lokuhweba olusebenzayo, oluhlanganisa izinkampani ezincane nabakhulayo, lungakhuthaza ukuqhubeka komnotho wokulima. Ukuhweba ngemikhiqizo yasendaweni, nokuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane, kuyindlela yokwakha umnotho okhula ngokushesha. Isiphetho Abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika banendima enkulu ekwakheni umnotho, ukuphakamiseni izinga lempilo, nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Noma bephakathi kwezinkinga eziningi, imizamo yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokweseka, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni imikhakha yabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke ubonge futhi usekele abalimi bethu, ukuze bakwazi ukuqhubekela phambili, bese beqhakambisa ikusasa lempilo nempumelelo yeNingizimu Afrika.
Uhlelo lwe-National Health Insurance (NHI) eNingizimu Afrika: Isingeniso Namuhla, sizoxoxa ngohlelo lwe-NHI eNingizimu Afrika, olukhuluma kakhulu emiphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle le phrojekthi, sithole ithuba lokukhuluma noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, umholi wezempilo kuleli. Mnu. Mthembu, ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi uvela kuphi kulolu hlelo lwe-NHI? Ingxenye 1: Umqondo we-NHI Mnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyabonga, ngijabule ukukhuluma lapha. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo eyanele kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kungakhathaliseki indawo abahlala kuyo noma izindlela zokukhokha. Umgomo uwukwenza ukuthi wonke umuntu akwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okungcono, ngaphandle kwezithiyo zezindleko.” Ingxenye 2: Izizathu zokwakhiwa kwe-NHI Interviewer: “Kungani le phrojekthi ibalulekile eNingizimu Afrika?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Siyabona ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo zihlukaniswe kakhulu. Abantu abaningi abakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo, okuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemiphumela yabo. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzama ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, luhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, futhi kuthuthukise izinga lempilo jikelele.” Ingxenye 3: Ukusebenza kwe-NHI Interviewer: “Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzosebenza kanjani?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Uhlelo luzoba nezinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, sizodinga ukudala imithombo ehlangene yokuxhasa uhlelo. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuxhasa ngemali, ukwakha izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Sizobambisana nohulumeni, ezinkampanini, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele.” Ingxenye 4: Izinselelo ezitholakalayo Interviewer: “Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nohlelo lwe-NHI?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Kukhona izinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngempilo yomnotho. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okukhulu. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngokuqonda kwabantu. Abanye bangase babe nokungabaza ngale phrojekthi, futhi kudinga imizamo yokubasiza baqonde ukuthi kubalulekile. Ekugcineni, kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo.” Ingxenye 5: Umthelela we-NHI emphakathini Interviewer: “Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nomthelela muni emphakathini?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Umthelela uzoba mkhulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu babe nempilo engcono, okuzoholela ekwenzeni kahle emisebenzini yabo. Uma abantu benempilo, bazokwazi ukusebenza kahle, lokhu kuzothuthukisa umnotho. Futhi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengokudla, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubambisana komphakathi Interviewer: “Umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza kulolu hlelo?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Umphakathi unendima ebalulekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi uhlelo lwe-NHI lungumsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele babambe iqhaza, balandele izinqubo, futhi banikeze impendulo ukuze sithuthukise uhlelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana nohulumeni ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa futhi zisetshenziswe.” Isiphetho Interviewer: “Ngabe unazo iziphetho noma iziphakamiso zokugcina?” Mnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyabonga. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi uhlelo lwe-NHI luhlobene kakhulu nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sisebenze ndawonye, sithuthukise izinsiza, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okudingayo. Ngiyabonga ngokunginika ithuba lokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile.” Ngokuphetha, uhlelo lwe-NHI luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba sithuthukisa lesi simiso, kubalulekile ukuba sihlanganyele, sikhulume, futhi sisebenze ndawonye ukuze sifeze lezi zifiso. Uhlelo lwe-NHI lungaba yisixazululo esihle, uma sithuthukisa izinsiza, sikhuthaza ubambiswano, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izwi zomphakathi ziyaqondwa.
Okuqukethwe kwalolu documet kufanele kuqaliswe manje. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi phakathi konyaka ka-2000, kuzoba nezingezo noma izinguquko okuqukethwe kwalolu documet, futhi lezi zinguquko zizothunyelwa kuwe. Umphathi weSigaba seMfundo (HOD) unomsebenzi wokuphatha inqubo yokwamukela abafundi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwale nqubo kuhlanganisa izinto ezifana nokukhishwa kwamakhadi okudlulisela abafundi abahamba ezikoleni ezahlukene, ukuthunyelwa kolwazi lwabafundi esikoleni esisha, nokugcina irekhodi eliqukethe ulwazi mayelana nokwamukelwa kwabafundi esikoleni. U-HOD, ngalezi zisho, unika le msebenzi namandla kumphathi wesikole. Umphathi unikezwa ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi uzolandela izinqubo ezichazwe kulolu documet futhi aqhubeke nomsebenzi wokwamukela abafundi esikoleni, kodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi abeke phambili ukuthi bahloniphe izinqubomgomo eziphathelene nalokhu kanye namadokhumenti azothunyelwa esikhathini esizayo. QAPHELA: Akukhona umsebenzi noma indima yomphathi wesikole yokunquma ukuthi umfundi wamukelwa esikoleni noma cha. U-HOD unelungelo lokubopha umphathi otholakale engahambisanga nezinye izinto ezishiwo kulezi zinqubomgomo. Lokhu kuhambisana nokusungulwa kwezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kube lula ukufakwa kwabafundi ezingeni labantwana abancane. Lokhu kuhambisana nokubhaliswa kwabafundi uma isikhathi sokubhaliswa sesidlulile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi laba bafundi bathola izindawo esikoleni ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nokwabiwa kwezindawo zabafundi abanezinselelo zokungena ezikoleni zomphakathi noma ezimweni lapho uhlobo lesikole umfundi angangena kulo lushintshile. Hlola ukuthi abafundi bangaki abangafiki esikoleni uma laba bafundi besengaphansi kweminyaka okufanele bangene ngayo esikoleni. Bheka irekhodi lokubhaliswa kwabafundi, kanye ne rekhodi yokutholakala kwezindawo. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zokwamukela abafundi ezikhokhelwa abaphathi bezikole. Izinqumo kufanele zenziwe mayelana nokuthi kukhona yini isidingo sokuthi umfundi abhale ukuhlolwa ukusiza ekutholeni indawo esikoleni. I-SGB kufanele idale inqubomgomo ezosetshenziswa ekwamukeleni abafundi ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zomkhandlu kanye nezizwe mayelana nalolu daba. Le nqubo yokwakha le nqubomgomo kufanele ihambisane nezimiso ezichazwe kuMthetho Wezokufunda. Umzimba ophakamisayo kufanele unikeze umqondisi wesigaba inqubomgomo ebhaliwe yokwamukela abafundi ngaphambi kokuphela kukaApril ngonyaka, ukuze umqondisi akwazi ukuyibuyekeza futhi avume. Khuthaza abazali ukuthi bathumele izicelo zabantwana babo ukuze baqinisekise izindawo esikoleni ngaphambi kokuphela konyaka wesikole. Umfundi ofunda kulolo sikole futhi ehlose ukubuyela ngonyaka olandelayo kufanele azise isikole ngalokhu ngaphambi kokuphela kuka-October kulo nyaka, uma kusebenza. Isidingo salokhu asikwenzi ukuze kutholakale ukuthi bazokwamukelwa, kodwa kubalulekile njengoba kuzosisiza isikole mayelana nokuhlela inani lezifundo ezidingekayo kanye nenani labafundisi elidingekayo. Akukuvunyelwe ukukhokhisa imali ngalolu hlelo kubazali. Umfundi ofuna ukungena esikoleni okokuqala ekuqaleni konyaka wesikole kufanele abhaliswe kusukela ekuqaleni kuka-August kuze kube sekupheleni kukaSeptemba konyaka odlule ngaphambi konyaka wakhe wokuqala esikoleni. Abafundi abahlala ezindaweni ezingekho eduze nendawo lapho isikole sakhiwe khona bangabhaliswa, kodwa amagama abo azogcinwa ku-irekhodi labafundi abalindele ukutholakala; futhi bazokwaziswa ngaphambi kokuphela kuka-October kulo nyaka ababhaliswe ngawo ukuthi bayothola yini indawo esikoleni abahlanganyele khona. Umfundi ozothola ukwenqatshelwa kokwamukelwa esikoleni abahlanganyele khona uma leso sikole sesigcwele. Abazali kufanele banikezwe ifomu lokubhaliswa lapho bezohambisa amagama abantwana babo ukuze babhaliswe. Zonke izimali ezikhokhiswayo zokubhaliswa noma zokwamukela esikoleni kufanele zikhishwe kumamount okhokhwa abazali esikhathini esizayo. Uma umfundi engathathi indawo eyamukelwe esikoleni, izimali abakhokhile kufanele zibuyiselwe esikoleni. Imali yokubhaliswa akufanele idlule inani elikhokhwa ngenyanga kumamount okhokhwa. Akufanele kube khona umfundi ophuthumayo wesikole ongenqatshelwa ukufunda kulolo sikole ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo abakwazi ukukhokha imali yokubhaliswa noma idiphozi. Akufanele kube khona umfundi onqatshelwa indawo esikoleni ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo abahambisani nesitatimende somsebenzi wesikole, noma abahambisani nezixhumanisi zezimiso ezibhalwe ngesikole ezichaza umthetho wokuziphatha kwabafundi; noma banqatshelwe ukungena ngenxa yesivumelwano esithi abazali ngeke bakhokhe izindleko zesikole uma umonakalo wenzeka ngenxa yemfundo enikezelwe kumntwana wabo. QAPHELA: Umnyango uyazi ukuthi kunezikole ezisanda kuqala inqubo yokwamukela abafundi ngonyaka ka-2000, futhi ezinye zalezi zikole sezithumele imibiko emphakathini yokuthi azinazo izindawo zabafundi abafuna ukwamukelwa ngonyaka ka-2000. Le nqubo yalezi zikole iphula umthetho obekwe yile nqubomgomo. Nokho, uMphathi Wezemfundo (HOD) kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi inqubo yokwamukela abafundi yenziwa ngendlela efanele, futhi laba abazali ababhale izingane zabo esikoleni bazonikezwa izindawo abathole zona futhi ngeke kudingeke ukuthi baqale kabusha ngokubhaliswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, u-HOD usenelungelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi abahlala eduzane nendawo lapho isikole sakhiwe khona bangaba yilabo abathola izindawo esikoleni ngaphambi kokuthi abafundi abavela ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwendawo lapho isikole sakhiwe khona bamukelwe. Kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi umfundi wamukelwa emhlanganweni wezinto eziphelele ohlelweni lwesikole, futhi akufanele anqatshelwe ukufinyelela kwezinye izifundo zesikole, ukufinyelela emisebenzini kazwelonke, ezemidlalo, noma imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa esikoleni, futhi akufanele anqatshelwe umbiko wesikole noma amakhadi okudlulisela esikoleni esisha; noma aphathwe ngendlela ehlukile kulokho okubhalwe esigabeni 4. Ikhadi lokudlulisela litholwa esikoleni lapho umfundi efunda khona. Le khadi kufanele ithunyelwe ngeposi noma inikezwe umphathi wesikole esisha ngumuntu onegunya futhi ayikwazi ukunikezwa abazali noma umgibeli womfundi. Umphathi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsiza ezisemthethweni zikhona ngempela. Uma ezinye zalezi zinsiza zingekho, kufanele kube nezingxoxo nomqondisi wesigaba; lapho-ke umfundi wamukelwa ngokwesikhashana izinyanga ezintathu ngesikhathi esikoleni. Ngesikhathi salokhu, isikole nomqondisi wesigaba kufanele babonise abazali indlela yokuthola lezi zinsiza ezidingekayo. Uma ekupheleni kwesikhathi sezinyanga ezintathu abazali bengakathumeli izinsiza ezidingekayo, umzimba ophakamisayo kufanele uxoxe nomqondisi wesigaba ukuze axazulule le nkinga. Akufanele kube khona umfundi oneminyaka yokufunda edingekayo onqatshelwa ukwamukelwa esikoleni ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo bengenakuk
Kwakukhona idolobha elikhulu elibizwa ngeMbali, elalicebile ngamasiko nezilimi. EMbali, abantu babezixhumanisa ngezindlela ezahlukene zokukhuluma, kodwa isiNgisi nesiZulu bekungamanye amalimi abawakhulumayo. Ukuze kusekelwe izilimi ezahlukene, kwasungulwa uhlelo lokuxhasa izilimi ezikhungweni ezifana nezikole, imiphakathi, nezikhungo zokucwaninga. Ngelinye ilanga, uMnu. Mthembu, uthisha wezifundo zamakhaya, wanquma ukuhamba emigwaqweni, enethemba lokwakha indawo ephephile yokuthi abafundi bakhe bakwazi ukwazisa izilimi zabo. "Ngifuna abantwana bami bakwazi ukukhuluma isiZulu ngaphandle kokwesaba," kusho yena ezithombeni zansuku zonke zabafundi. Waqala ukuhlela umcimbi ofana nowokweSonto, lapho abantwana bejabulile, bekhuluma isiZulu, behlaba umxhwele abazali babo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wathola ukunakwa okuhle. Amaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene aqhakambisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilimi aqala ukuvelela. Kwakukhona imicimbi efana nezinkulumo, ukudansa, nokubhalela izinkanyezi ezintsha. Abantu baphinde bakhumbuze ukuthi isiZulu nesiNgisi zingamaqabane amakhulu, futhi nakuba kungafaneleke ukwehlukaniswa, babenethuba lokuthuthukisa amakhono abo. Udadewethu uNandi, owayengumfundi omncane, wathola injabulo enkulu. Njengoba ebamba iqhaza emigqeni yomcimbi, wathola ukuthi akukhona nje ukukhuluma isiZulu, kodwa wathola izifundo eziningi ngesiNgisi. UsiMabaso, owayengumfundisi weziMfundiso, waphinde wakhuluma ngokubaluleka kokuhlanganisa ulwazi neziko lemindeni. "Uma singakwazi ukukhuluma ngezindlela ezahlukene, sizothola imiphumela emihle," kusho yena ezithombeni zamaholidi. Umoya wokwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi uqhubeka uvuthwa. Abafundi babebhala izincwadi ezithokozisayo ngesiZulu, futhi babelana ngama-essay amancane phakathi kwezifundo zabo, bekhuthaza abanye ukuba bavume isiZulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni bakheba abaninzi, bekwazi ukuvivinya imiqondo emisha. UMnu. Mthembu waba namathuba amaningi nabanye abafundi abavela eMbali, bobabili besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bezilimi ukuze banciphise imithwalo yemfundo. Kwafika isikhathi lapho isikole saqala ukufundisa izifundo ezihlanganisa isiZulu nesiNgisi. Abafundi babehamba phambili, bekhuluma ngalezi zilimi. Ustanisi olwakhe lwalubonisa indlela yokuhlala kwabelwa izilimi. Amakhono nokuheha amathuba avumela abantwana ukuba balwele imisebenzi ethokozisayo. Kodwa impilo yokufunda ibihamba kancane, kwathi obebhapathi bazi ukuze bahlale beqonda izilimi eziningi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni imifino eyisiyalo, ebaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni wezothando. Uthisha uMthembu waphinde walungisa izifundo eziphikisanayo nabafundi abavela eMbali. Umoya wezilimi ezimbili ubalwa, uMnu. Mthembu uqonda ukuthi ukuhlanganyela kuyindlela ebalulekile yokukhulisa imfundo. Abafundi baqhubeka behamba ngezinyathelo, besebenzisa ubuhlakani obuphakeme. Uhlanga lwempilo lwaluhamba phambili. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uNandi washaywa yimicabango. Waqonda ukuthi ukufunda kwakhe akukhona okusheshayo. Kwakukhona okuthile okwakukhuluma, kanti umbala wokwethembeka wawuhambisana nesiko lesizulu. Lezi zimpilo ezikhathaza umoya, zakhula, zashintsha Mathieu nokuthi benchaze izilimi eziningi. Ekugcineni, uMnu. Mthembu waba phakathi kokufunda okwakukhula lapho ekhokhela izilimi eziningi. Amalungiselelo abawathola angaphezulu kokwenziwa. Lokhu kufithwa yikuthi uzothola ukuthi izilimi eziningi zisebenza kakhulu ezikhungweni, futhi imvelo yokusebenza kunothile ngamabala amasha kakhulu. Lokhu kukholelwa kubo bonke abahlali beMbali, bemomotheka bezwa ukukhathaza okushelela ukwaziwa ngempumelelo. Isiphetho sikhulu sikhuluma ngama-oda wokuhlanganyela, abantwana bebekwazile ukufunda nokuhlala kanjani bephakamisa izilimi. Futhi njengeNhlangano, abahlali beMbali bakhumbula umoya ophakeme, ukuqhubekisela phambili, behlanza umhlaba ngezinto ezingafani. Njengoba bezohamba phambili, bahlala be mindful futhi bekulokhu behloma, besebenzisa isiZulu nesiNgisi ukuze bakhule bese beshaywa kahle emoyeni wezinsuku ezizayo.

Ngiyavuma, sizoxoxa ngalesi sihloko esithakazelisayo sokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi zimpikiswano zikhona ezindaweni eziningi? Abantu banezizathu ezahlukene zokuthi kungani bebona lokhu kungcono noma kungabi kuhle. Okokuqala, sithanda ukuveza ukuthi abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi i-TV licence iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle. Lokhu kuyiqiniso, ngoba uma ungakakhokhi, usuke ungatholi izinto ezinhle. Ngabe uyavuma? Kodwa-ke, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi lezi zinkampani kufanele zifune ezinye izindlela zokuxhasa, hhayi kuphela nge-TV licence. Kukhona abathi, “Kungani kufanele ngikhokhe uma ngingasebenzisi i-SABC? Ngabe kufanele ngikhokhe ukuze abanye babe nezinhlelo?” Lokhu kudala ingxabano, ngoba abanye abantu bahlala bejabule ngezinye iziteshi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kucace ukuthi abantu abaningi bazizwa sengathi i-SABC iyabakhokhisa imali engafanele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abantu abakhokhayo bathi, “Uma ungakhokhi, ubuhlungu bukhona! I-SABC iyadingeka ukuze kube nezinhlelo ezithokozisayo.” Lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa akukwazi ukusho ukuthi bonke abantu basebenzisa i-SABC. Kukhona abanye abantu abathanda ukubukela ezinye iziteshi, futhi lokho kudala ukungavumelani. Futhi, sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi lapha. I-SABC iyinkampani yomphakathi, futhi kufanele ibhekelele izidingo zabantu. Uma abantu bengakhokhi, kungenzeka ukuthi izinhlelo ezithile ziba phansi, futhi lokho akukhuthazi. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu? Uma kungenjalo, yini eyenza abantu bazizwe bengekho emkhakheni? Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona abathi lezi zinkampani kufanele zisebenzise izindlela zokukhangisa ukuze zikhulise imali. Lokhu kulungile, kodwa abanye baphikisa ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube nezinhlelo ezimbi. Bakhathazekile ngokuthi uma i-SABC ibeka izikhangiso eziningi, kuzokwenza kube nzima ukubukela izinhlelo. Lokhu kucacisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo ye-TV licence, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezindleko eziningi ezihambisana nayo. Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi uma i-SABC ikhokhisa, kufanele ibheke izindleko zayo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa abanye baphikisa ukuthi akufanele kube nezindleko eziphezulu. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu? Ngabe uyazi ukuthi uma ungakhokhi i-TV licence, ungabhekana nezijeziso? Lokhu kudala ukungavumelani. Abantu bahlala bephikisana ngokuthi lezi zijeziso zifanele yini. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezijeziso, ngoba lokho kuzokwenza abantu bakhumbule ukukhokha. Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa ukuthi lokhu kudala ukungakhululeki. Lokhu kudala ingxabano enkulu phakathi kwabantu. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zimpikiswano, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC iyinkampani ebalulekile. I-SABC inezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nayo, futhi uma abantu bengakhokhi, lokho kuzokwenza kube nzima. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela zokuxhasa i-SABC ngaphandle kokukhokha i-TV licence? Lokhu kucacisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC inezinhlelo ezithile ezithokozisayo, futhi uma abantu bengakhokhi, lokho kuzokwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle. Lokhu kudala ukungavumelani, ngoba abanye bahlala bejabule ngezinye iziteshi, kanti abanye bahlala bejabule nge-SABC. Lokhu kudala ingxabano enkulu phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuphetha, izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu? Lokhu kudala ingxabano, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinto ukuze sithole isixazululo esihle. Ngabe unayo eminye imibono?
Uma uhlela ukuthengisa izinkomo zakho emakethe, zibuze le mibuzo elandelayo: Kungani ngifuna ukuthengisa izinkomo zami kulobu sikhathi? Izilwane zikulungele ukuya emakethe futhi zikhulisiwe kahle ukuze zibe yizinkomo ezizokhishwa. Zineminyaka efanele yokuthengwa kulabo abafuna ukuzikhulisa ukuze zikhulise. Izilwane azikwazi ukukhiqiza inzuzo, ikakhulukazi uma zikhuluma ngezinkomo zokukhulisa ezindala ezingasakhiqizi. Akukho okukhulayo okukhona epulazini ukuze kudle izinkomo. Khetha umhlambi oneminyaka yokukhulisa bese uthengisa abanye ngaphambi kokuba babe bashaywe yizindleko eziphezulu zokugcina. Izinkomba zokuhlela zitholwa ngokulandela iminyaka, ukwanda kwesisindo, isimo, ukujolisa, kanye nobulili. Ungalindela kuphela intengo enhle yezilwane ezinempilo enhle, ikakhulukazi uma ziku-A nase-B, zingabi mncane kakhulu noma zibe zikhulu kakhulu futhi ziqondiswe kahle (zihlosiwe). I-AB inikeza inani lentengo eliphansi kanti i-C iyona ephansi kakhulu. Ukuze kulandelwe imithetho, isimo se-carcass yezilwane sihlolwe futhi sichaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwenyama nezinsika. Isimo sokuhlola senziwa ngokuhlola ukujolisa kwezinkomo. Ikhathalogi ibonwa ngokuhlola amazinyo. Ubulili bezilwane busemqoka kakhulu ezilwaneni zokukhulisa nasezicathulweni zezimvu ezikumaqembu eminyaka A, B, kanye ne-C. Ukuhlola: Ukuhlola iminyaka yezinkomo ngokuhlola amazinyo. Ikhathalogi B: Kusukela eminyakeni engu-2½ kuya kwengu-3 (kuhlonishwa ngokuba khona kwe-incisor nokuba namazinyo okwakha angu-3 kuya kwangu-6). Ikhathalogi C: Amazinyo abuhlungu futhi aphukile ezilwaneni ezindala.

Ukhetho Lukazwelonke - Ukubaluleka Kwezinqumo Zethu Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisikhathi esibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Lolu suku luhlanganisa izinketho eziningi, ezithinta ikusasa lethu, izwe lethu, kanye nezizukulwane ezizayo. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukhetho akukhona nje ukhetho lwabantu abathile, kodwa luhlanganisa izwi lezakhamuzi zonke. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinketho zethu, siqonde kahle ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuhola izwe, futhi sithathe izinqumo ezizokwenza umehluko. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlanganisa izifiso nezidingo zabantu. Abantu bahlala bephikisana ngezinto eziningi, kodwa ekugcineni, sonke sifuna ukuphila kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo kufanele zibe nezimpande ezijulile emphakathini. Uma sikhuluma ngama-akhawunti ezomnotho, izinhlelo zokunakekela impilo, noma izinhlelo zemfundo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinto zibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaholi bethu baqonde kahle izidingo zomphakathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhona nje ukhetho lokukhetha umholi, kodwa kuyithuba lokubeka izimiso ezizokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaholi bethu kufanele babe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Uma umholi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinto, kufanele sibuze ukuthi kungani simkhetha. Ukhetho lwethu kufanele lube nezinjongo ezicacile, ezihambisana nezifiso zethu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngempumelelo. Kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nezwe lethu, futhi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izinketho zethu, siqonde kahle ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuhola izwe, futhi sithathe izinqumo ezizokwenza umehluko. Ukhetho akukhona nje ukhetho lwabantu abathile, kodwa luhlanganisa izwi lezakhamuzi zonke.
