Ihhovisi leMibiko Yezobuchwepheshe, iMeta-information, ngaphansi koMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, iqala futhi ixhasa ngezomnotho ucwaningo lwezinhlelo zeMisebenzi Yezincwadi Nezokwazi (LIS) ezingeni likazwelonke. Zonke lezi zenzo ziqondiswe ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala ezingeni likazwelonke. Ihhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano yolwazi kazwelonke liyinhliziyo yoHulumeni kazwelonke ophatha imigomo ethile mayelana nemisebenzi yezincwadi nezokwazi (LIS) ezingeni likazwelonke. Ulwazi lukhuluma ngolwazi oluhlobene nolwazi. Umbono wehhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano kazwelonke uwukwakha nokugcina uhlelo lolwazi oluphumelelayo oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kolwazi, luqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo zibhakabhise kwiSizwe Solwazi, okuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni izwe. Umsebenzi walo uwukwazisa uNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlela, nokugcina isikhala semigomo nezinsiza zolwazi ezingeni likazwelonke. Lezi zikhungo zifaka isandla ekwakheni isikhungo sikazwelonke seMisebenzi Yezincwadi Nezokwazi, esiphinde sasisize nezinye izinhlobo zezincwadi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza yolwazi ezindaweni zazo. Ihhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano kazwelonke lisebenza njengeSikhumbuzo seKomidi esisemthethweni sokugcina amarekhodi nolwazi kanye neBhodi Yezemisebenzi Yezincwadi Nezokwazi esisemthethweni. Ihhovisi lolwazi liphinde lilawule ukuhlelwa kabusha kwekomidi nebhodi.
Izivumelwano Zokufinyelela Kosonkontileka Besithathu: Ukuthuthukisa Ukusebenza Kwezimali Zomphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi ziye zathuthuka kakhulu, ziveza izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinqubo zibe lula. Omunye wemigomo ebalulekile kulezi zinhlelo yi-GEMS, okuyisistimu yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zezempilo eNingizimu Afrika. I-GEMS, noma i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, isebenza ngokuqinile ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okufanele. Ukuze lokhu kuqhubeke, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zibalulekile. Lezi zivumelwano zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuthi osonkontileka abathile, abavela ezinkampanini ezizimele, bangafinyelela kalula ezinsizeni ze-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokubambisana phakathi kwe-GEMS nezinye izinkampani ezisebenza ezinsizeni zezempilo, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nabahlinzeki bezinsiza. Ngokwenza lokhu, i-GEMS ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze izivumelwano zokufinyelela zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela ezicacile zokuphatha, ezihlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola, izimfuneko zokuphepha, kanye nezibopho zomthetho. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi osonkontileka bahlala behlonipha izindinganiso eziphakeme zokusebenza, okubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabahlinzeki bezinsiza. Izivumelwano ziqukethe izinhlinzeko ezithile, njengensuku zokusebenza, izindleko, nezindlela zokuxhumana, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi ihamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zivumelwano ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zifanele izidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. I-GEMS ibheke phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile nabahlinzeki bezinsiza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinsizakalo zezempilo zikhula kakhulu, futhi kudinga ukuba nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izinsiza. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele, i-GEMS ithola ithuba lokwandisa izinsiza zayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga kakhulu ukunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, okwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Izivumelwano zokufinyelela zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi osonkontileka bahlale bejolise ekwenzeni izinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, okuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zivumelwano zihlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zifanele izidingo zomphakathi. I-GEMS ibeka phambili ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izivumelwano zihlala zisebenza kahle, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinsizakalo zezempilo zikhula njalo, futhi kudinga ukuba nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izinsiza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zezempilo. I-GEMS iqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okufanele. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokubambisana, okuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zezempilo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Ekugcineni, izivumelwano zokufinyelela kosonkontileka besithathu zikhombisa indlela yokwenza izinqubo zibe lula, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. I-GEMS ibheke phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile nabahlinzeki bezinsiza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezikhathini zokuqala, izimo eziphuthumayo zazibhekwa njengemisebenzi yokuphendula okusheshayo, kodwa ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa ukuthi lezi zimo zidinga ukuhlela okuhle nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinhlelo zokuphendula zazincane, futhi izinsiza zazikhawulelwe. Abantu babebhekana nezimo ezinzima, kodwa izinsiza zokuphendula zazivame ukuba nezinkinga ezinkulu, okuholela ekutheni isikhathi sokuphendula sibe sikhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani nezikhungo ziqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuphendula ngokushesha. Ngeminyaka yama-1960, izikhungo zokuqala zokuphendula eziphuthumayo zathuthukiswa, zisebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukile zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa abaphenduli, abezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngeminyaka yama-1980, ubuchwepheshe bukhula kakhulu. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana zathuthuka, futhi izikhungo zathola amathuluzi amasha afana nezinhlelo zokubika ezisheshayo. Lokhu kwavumela abaphenduli ukuba baphendule ngokushesha, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zixazululwe ngokushesha. Izikhungo ziqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlola izimo, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuphendula zathuthuka zaba nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ngeminyaka yama-1990, izikhungo zokuqala zokuqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi, okuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwabaphenduli nezikhungo. Lokhu kwavumela abaphenduli ukuba bathole ulwazi oludingekayo ngokushesha, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zixazululwe ngokushesha. Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo ziqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokufundisa abaphenduli, ukuze baqonde kahle izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kwavumela abaphenduli ukuba babe nolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe, okuholela ekutheni baphendule ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zathuthukiswa, zifaka izifundo ezihlukahlukene ezihlobene nezimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze abaphenduli bakwazi ukuphendula kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo ziqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlola ukusebenza kwazo. Lokhu kwavumela izikhungo ukuba zihlaziye izimo eziphuthumayo, ziqonde kahle ukuthi yini engasebenzi kahle, futhi zithuthukise izinhlelo zazo zokuphendula. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okuholela ekutheni isikhathi sokuphendula sibe sikhulu. Namuhla, izikhungo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisheshayo, izinhlelo zokuhlola, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa. Lokhu kwavumela abaphenduli ukuba baphendule ngokushesha nangempumelelo, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zixazululwe ngokushesha. Izikhungo ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zazo, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kube yindlela ebalulekile yokwenza izinhlelo zokuphendula zibe ngcono. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi kuveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe, ukuhlela, nokufundisa kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimeni ezinzima. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zethu, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula izifundo esizifundile emlandweni, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela kahle futhi siphendule ngokushesha ezimeni eziphuthumayo.
Uma iNhlangano Yezobuchwepheshe Bezesayensi Yezemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika inqaba ukubhalisela noma ikhubaze ukubhaliswa kwakho, ungabiza iNhlangano ngalolo shintsho ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30, kodwa ngokukhokha imali efanele okufanele ikhokhwe. Xhumana ne-SACNASP phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku olwenqabe, futhi uzonikezwa izeluleko mayelana nalokho okudingeka ukwenze. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ungathumela incwadi yokubiza kwiNhlangano phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30. Le ncwadi kumele ihambisane nemali okufanele ikhokhwe kwiNhlangano. Phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 zokwamukela isicelo sakho sokubiza, iNhlangano izokwenza isinqumo ngesicelo sakho sokubiza futhi ikunikeze izizathu zesinqumo. Uma isicelo sakho sokubiza sikhuluma ngokwenqaba kwekomidi yokuvuselela ukubhaliswa kwakho njengomuntu obhalisiwe, ukubhaliswa kwakho ngeke kukhanselwe kuze kube senziwe isinqumo ngesicelo sokubiza. Ukuze ukhokhe ngedijithali nangokukhokha ngqo: Sicela usebenzise iziqu zeminwe namagama akho ukuze uqinisekise ukukhokha kwethu emalini yethu yasebhange bese uthumela ubufakazi bokukhokha ngefeksi, kanye nekhasi lokuqala lefomu lokufaka isicelo enombolweni: 841 1057.
Umbiko Wokuphepha Ezikoleni Isingeniso Ukuphepha ezikoleni kuyisihloko esibalulekile esidinga ukunakwa okukhulu kumphakathi. Izikole, njengendawo yokufunda, zidinga ukuba ziphephile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda nokukhula ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezibambekayo, ezihlanganisa wonke umuntu odlala indima ekuphuhliseni umphakathi, kusukela kubafundi, abazali, othisha, kuze kube kubaphathi bezikole. Izigameko Zokuphepha Izikhungo zemfundo zihlala zibhekene nezinsongo ezihlukene, ezifana nezingozi zemvelo, ukungqubuzana phakathi kwabafundi, kanye nezinsongo zempilo yomphakathi njengesifo esithathelwana kalula. Ngokusho kwezibalo, izigameko ezihlobene nokuphepha ezikoleni ziye zanda, kube nezigameko ezithinta ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, ukungabikho kokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yezikole. Izinyathelo Zokuphepha Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinsongo, izikole kufanele zibe nezinyathelo ezicacile zokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Abafundisi, othisha, nabaphathi baziwa ngokuthi bahlale bekulungele ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile. 2. Izinhlelo Zokubika: Izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokubika izigameko zokuphepha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukulandela izigameko ezithile, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthola izixazululo eziphusile. 3. Izikhumbuzo Zokuphepha: Ukuhlinzeka ngezikhumbuzo ngezinsiza zokuphepha kubafundi nabazali, kuzosiza ekwenzeni abantu baziqonde kangcono izingozi ezingase zibe khona. 4. Ubudlelwano Nabazali: Ukuhlanganiswa kwabazali ezinhlelweni zokuphepha ezikoleni kubalulekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kufanele kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, nabaphathi bezikole. Izimo Zokuphepha Zangempela Izimo zangempela zokuphepha ezikoleni zikhombisa ukuthi izinga lokuphepha lidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngokuqhubekayo. Ngokwesibonelo, izikole ezithola izikhalazo ezivela kubafundi bangase zidinge ukwakha izinhlelo eziqinile zokuhlola izimo zokuphepha. Izinkinga Ezingaba Khona Nokho, izikole zikhona nezinkinga ezithile okufanele ziqashelwe. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinhlelo ezikhona zokuphepha kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ngezinsiza ezanele. Ukubaluleka Kokufunda Ngokuphepha Abafundi kumele baqonde ngokubaluleka kokuphepha ezikoleni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi banemibono ecacile ngezingozi, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa ukufundisa abafundi ngendlela yokuhlinzeka ngempilo, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela. Isiphetho Ekupheleni, ukuphepha ezikoleni akusona isici kuphela sokuphila kwabafundi, kodwa kuyisici esibalulekile sokuphila komphakathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zihlala ziphephile, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, nabaphathi. Ngale ndlela, izikole zingaba yizindawo lapho abafundi bakwazi ukuphila, ukufunda, nokukhula ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ukuphepha akusikho ukungabikho kwezingozi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, izinsiza, kanye nobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umphefumulo wokuphepha uzogcinwa kuphela uma wonke umuntu ezibophezela ekwenzeni izikole zibe indawo ephephile.
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokwakha imiphakathi engakhethi phakathi kwamahemuhemu luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, luwumsebenzi obalulekile ekusizeni ohulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinhlelo ezisekelayo ngokusebenzisa umthetho weZinhlelo Zikamasipala kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa komthetho omusha wezomthetho wezokuphatha izindawo zomphakathi ngokukhuthaza umthetho wezakhiwo zamakhaya kanye nomthetho wezinhlelo zamakhaya kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo olwenziwe ngomhla ka-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lokuphatha bendawo lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zokuphatha bendawo ukuze ibhekane nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokubhekelela indima yokuhlela eyakhelwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphatha emiphakathini futhi njengengxenye yesu lezinhlelo ezihlanganisiwe nezinsiza zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo mayelana nezabelomali zamakhaya, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamasipala kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamakhaya. Esikhathini esedlule, amakhaya avame ukuhamba kanzima ukuhlela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Amakhaya amaningi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Ashintshayo) ayenokuntuleka kwezinsiza kanye namandla okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe ngalesi sikhathi, futhi akukho zinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezakhelwe futhi ezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga zonke, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bathole inzuzo enkulu kulwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona amakhaya ambalwa athole intuthuko enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Imibhalo ye-IDP yokuhola, eyakhelwe ithimba elihlukile le-DPLG ngokwesekwa kwe-GTZ, iphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwesizwe lwabaphathi bamakhaya, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke abamele amakhaya. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokweseka izinhlelo zamakhaya (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zamakhaya. Iningi lamakhaya, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yokuphatha bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi yezimboni zikahulumeni ezweni lethu bangengxenye yalolu hlelo futhi baphumelelisile ekwakheni le miphumela emisha ye-IDP. Nginethemba elikhulu lokuthi le miphumela yedokhumenti eprintiwe izoba yinsiza ewusizo kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubweni ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ebheke phambili. Yini ebalulekile mayelana neziqondiso ze-Integrated Development Planning? Lezi ziqondiso ziphendula umbuzo OYINI? Uma ama-Integrated Development Plans (IDPs) enziwa umthetho wezomthetho wamakhaya ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Bendawo (LGTA), njengoba kuguqulwe, kusho ukuthi ngesikhathi salolu hlelo awuzona izithiyo ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe zibhekisela ezimweni zeZinjongo Zokuthuthukiswa Komhlaba (LDO) njengoba zisunguliwe kuMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa (DFA) ka-1995. I-DFA inikeza uhlaka lwezomthetho oluwusizo mayelana nezici zokuhlela nokuthuthukiswa komhlaba. Izimo ezibalulekile zezinqubomgomo, izinhlelo zomthetho, kanye nezindlela ze-IDP zasungulwa ngemuva kokuthi inqubo ye-IDP isiqalile. Uhlu lweziqondiso zezindlela lubandakanya ukuhlela, ukugxila ezindabeni ezibalulekile, isinyathelo esibheke phambili, uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo, kanye nokubambisana nezinye izigaba. Lo mthetho ubhekisela endimeni yokuhlela emiphakathini yokubambisana. Kukhona eminye imibhalo emibili eyavela kwi-WPLG ebalulekile ekuhlelweni kokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kokusebenzisa Umhlaba uqale inqubo eholele ekunciphiseni inani lamakhaya. Lezi zindawo zikhule futhi zinekhono lokushintsha izakhiwo zezikhungo. Idokhumenti ye-Integrated Development Plan izama ukwethula uhlaka lwezamasu kulabo ababandakanyekayo engejwayelekile yokuthuthukiswa. Inhloso wukubasiza ukuthi benze umsebenzi wabo ngempumelelo. Kukhona imiyalelo nezindlela ezichaza izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zilandelwe. Lezi ziqondiso azifani nemibhalo yezomthetho edingekayo kodwa zisebenza njengemihlahlandlela ewusizo. Lezi ziqondiso ziyisisekelo sokuqeqesha, ulwazi, kanye nezinsiza. Njengoba inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe iqale ngaphambi kokuphuma kwalesi sikhala esisha, izinga lenqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo kube nomthelela omkhulu kulolu hlelo. Kwamanye amakhaya, inqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo, imibhalo yokuhlela ibingaphansi kokuhlanganiswa kwezidingo ezilula zesisekelo sokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Le nqubo yadala ukudideka okukhulu nokudumazeka kulabo ababandakanyekayo. Esikhundleni sokuthi isetshenziswe njengethuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zangempela zabantu kanye nemiphakathi ngendlela ekhombisa imiphumela futhi ibheka ikusasa, amakhaya amaningi akhethe ukulandela kuphela izidingo zomthetho ezincane ngosizo lwabacebisi. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ibingekho ngempela ephumelelayo futhi ibingafani nomdlalo wokuthenga izinhlelo ezikhona. Ingxenye yalezi zinkinga yikhono elilinganiselwe lehulumeni bendawo, ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezinzima nezibucayi enqubo engcono nephumelelayo, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuzisekela. Lesi simo siholela ekuthembekeni okukhulu kubakhiqizi abangabacebisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inqubo nezinhlelo zokuphatha zamakhaya zazingakabi zintsha. Izinselelo eziningi zixhomeke ekuntulekeni kokuhlelwa okucacile kwezomthetho. Ezinye izinselelo ezichazwe ngezansi zisafuna ukuxazululwa. Inhloso yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ibingacacile ngokwanele kumakhaya ambalwa ngenxa yokusondela kwayo kuma-LDOs. Ngamanye amahora, ibibhekwa njengendlela yokubamba iqhaza ekutholeni uhlu lwezinhlelo zezakhiwo ezidinga uxhaso lwangaphandle. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ye-IDPs ivamise ukuba yizihloko ezilula zezimali ngaphandle kokuchaza kahle izimo zokwakhiwa kwazo nezindlela zokusebenza uma seziqalile. Bekunge
Ukufunda Ngobuchwepheshe: Umgomo Wokwakha Ikusasa Elinempumelelo Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomgibeli ophambili ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu. Ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akusikho kuphela ukufunda indlela yokusebenzisa amathuluzi nezinsiza, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wokucabanga, ukuhlela, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ngakho-ke, ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe kufanele kube ingxenye ebalulekile yemfundo yethu, kusukela ezingeni lezingane kuze kube sezikoleni eziphakeme. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlobene kakhulu nezidingo zethu zansuku zonke. Izinsiza ezitholakala ku-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zinsiza ukuze bathole ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe. Ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akugcini nje ngokufunda izinhlelo zokusebenza, kodwa kubandakanya nokufunda indlela yokucabanga ngendlela yokwakha, yokuhlola, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe kudinga ukuba kube nezinselelo ezithile. Abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga ezihlukahlukene, futhi lokhu kudinga umqondo ophusile. Ngokufunda ngobuchwepheshe, abafundi bayakwazi ukuthola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezinkingeni ezibhekene nabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umhlaba ushintsha njalo, futhi izinkinga ezintsha ziyaqhubeka nokuphuma. Umqondo wokucabanga ngokujulile, nokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokuxazulula izinkinga, kuyasiza ekwakheni abantu abaqeqeshiwe nabakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngokubheka izinhlelo zemfundo, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zifake ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe ezinhlelweni zazo. Lokhu akusho kuphela ukufaka izifundo zobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi nokwakha izikhala zokufunda ezikahle. Izikhala ezifana nezikhungo zokwakha, izikhungo zokucwaninga, nezikhungo zokuxhumana zingasiza abafundi ukuba bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezinkingeni zomphakathi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali. Othisha kufanele babe nekhono lokufundisa abafundi ngendlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi bazame ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda evulekile. Abazali nabo badinga ukuba bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe busebenza kanjani, ukuze bakwazi ukuxhasa izingane zabo ekufundeni. Lokhu kubambisana kuzokwakha umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo, obungakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngokuphetha, ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akusikho kuphela ukufunda indlela yokusebenzisa amathuluzi, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wokucabanga, ukuhlela, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zifake ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe ezinhlelweni zazo, futhi zikhuthaze abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokucabanga ngokujulile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali kuzokwakha umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokufunda ngobuchwepheshe ukuze sakhe ikusasa elinempumelelo. Ukufunda ngobuchwepheshe akusikho kuphela umgomo, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempumelelo.
Ubudlelwano: Ukuqonda Nokwakha Izixhumanisi Ezinempilo Ubudlelwano buwumgogodla empilweni yethu. Njengoba sikhula, sihlangana nabantu abaningi, futhi ubudlelwano bethu nabo buqala ukuvela. Lokhu kungaba ubudlelwano bomndeni, abangane, noma othandweni. Ukuze sikwazi ukuqonda kahle ubudlelwano, kubalulekile siqonde izici eziyisisekelo ezithinta lezi zixhumanisi. Izici Zobudlelwano Ubudlelwano buphakathi kwabantu ababili noma ngaphezulu, futhi buhlanganisa izici eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuxhumana kubalulekile. Ukuxhumana okuhle kusiza abantu baqonde imizwa nemicabango yomunye. Lokhu kungaba ngokukhuluma, ukubhala, noma ukusebenzisa izimpawu zomzimba. Ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kudala isizinda sokwethembana, okubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Okwesibili, ukuhlonipha kubalulekile. Ukuhlonipha omunye nomunye kusiza ubudlelwano bukhule. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele siqonde futhi sihlinzeke indawo yokuba nomunye umuntu, sithathe izinqumo ezithinta bobabili, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi wonke umuntu unamalungelo akhe. Ukuhlonipha kudala ubudlelwano obunempilo, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile ukuveza imizwa yabo. Okwesithathu, ubudlelwano bukhona emkhakheni wezifiso. Abantu bahlukile, futhi izifiso zabo zingahluka. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izifiso zomunye, futhi sibe nesineke uma kudingeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izingxabano ezivela phakathi kwabantu. Ukuxhumana ngezifiso zethu kuzokwakha ukuqonda okukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Ubudlelwano Bomndeni Ubudlelwano bomndeni buwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu. Umndeni ungaba yindawo yokuphepha, uthando, nokweseka. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali nezingane bukhulu, njengoba kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuhlonipha, nokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle. Abazali banelungelo lokufundisa izingane zabo izimiso zokuphila, kanti izingane zifunda ukuhamba phambili empilweni ngokulandela lezi zimiso. Ubudlelwano bomndeni buphinde buhlanganyele nezinkinga ezithile, ezifana nokungaboni ngaso linye, izinkinga zezimali, noma izimo zokuphila ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi umndeni ube nezinqubo zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ukuze ubudlelwano bukhule futhi bube namandla. Ubudlelwano Babangane Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abangane buwumsebenzi ohlukile. Abangane bahlala bejabulile, behlanganyela izikhathi ezinhle, futhi besekelana ngezikhathi ezinzima. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu abangane buhamba phambili uma kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuhlonipha, nokweseka. Abangane badinga ukuba nekhono lokuxazulula izingxabano, ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza ubudlelwano bube namandla. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abangane buphinde buhlanganyele nezinkinga ezithile, ezifana nokungaboni ngaso linye, ukungabi nesikhathi sokuhlangana, noma izimo zokuphila ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi abangane bahlale bexhumana futhi bazi ukuthi bangaxhumana kanjani uma kudingeka. Ubudlelwano Othandweni Ubudlelwano othandweni buwumsebenzi ophakeme kakhulu. Lokhu kubandakanya uthando, ukuzwana, nokuhlonipha. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu abathandanayo buhamba phambili uma kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuhlonipha, nokweseka. Uthando luhlala lukhula uma abantu bexhumana kahle, bephila izikhathi ezinhle ndawonye, futhi bekwazi ukuxazulula izingxabano. Ubudlelwano othandweni buphinde buhlanganyele nezinkinga ezithile, ezifana nokungaboni ngaso linye, ukungabi nesikhathi sokuhlangana, noma izimo zokuphila ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu abathandanayo bahlale bexhumana, futhi bazi ukuthi bangaxhumana kanjani uma kudingeka. Isiphetho Ubudlelwano buwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezihlukene ezithinta lezi zixhumanisi. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuhlonipha, nokwakha izifiso ezihlangene kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ubudlelwano bomndeni, abangane, kanye nothando buphinde buhlanganyele nezinkinga, kodwa uma abantu bexhumana kahle, bangakwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu buncike ekuxhumaneni, ekuhlonipheni, nasekuthandeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili empilweni, sithole ubudlelwano obunempilo, futhi sibe nekhono lokwakha izixhumanisi ezihlala ziqinile. Ubudlelwano bethu bukhulu, futhi kufanele sibe nesineke, sithokozise, futhi sithande omunye nomunye.
Iphrofayela kaThandiwe Mthembu: Umgibeli Ohloniphekile Kwezokusubatha UThandiwe Mthembu, umgibeli ophumelele emkhakheni wezokusubatha, ungomunye wabantu abavelele emhlabeni wezokugijima eNingizimu Afrika. Uthandiwe wazalwa ngoMfumfu 15, 1995, edolobheni elincane laseMkhondo, eMpumalanga. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yakhe, njengoba umndeni wakhe wawuhlanganisa izimfanelo zokusebenza kanzima, ukuzimisela, nokuhlonipha. UThandiwe waqala ukugijima esebancane, lapho abesebenzisa izikhathi zokudlala nabangane bakhe emaphandleni. Uthando lwakhe lokugijima lwavela ngesikhathi esebenza emakhaya, lapho abebona khona izinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu, ezimkhuthazayo ukuba aphumelele. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole samabanga aphansi, uThandiwe waqhubeka nezifundo zakhe eMkhondo High School, lapho athola khona ithuba lokubamba iqhaza emqhudelwaneni wezokugijima. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokungena kwiNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika, lapho aqhubeka khona nokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe. Uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo lwamkhuthaza ukuba abe neqhaza elikhulu emqhudelwaneni wezokugijima, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle kubafundi abasha. UThandiwe wathola iziqu zeBachelor of Arts, kodwa waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokugijima. UThandiwe waba neqhaza emqhudelwaneni omkhulu, lapho ahlola khona amakhono akhe. Ngonyaka ka-2018, wathola umklomelo wokuqala emqhudelwaneni we-10km eGauteng, okwakuyisinyathelo esikhulu empilweni yakhe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umsebenzi onzima uyakhokhela, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi emqhudelwaneni omkhulu. UThandiwe waba yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi, futhi waba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza emqhudelwaneni wamazwe omhlaba, lapho ahlangana khona nabagibeli abavela emazweni ahlukene. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokukhulisa amakhono akhe, futhi wathola izifundo eziningi ezimfundisayo. UThandiwe waba neqhaza emqhudelwaneni we-World Athletics Championships, lapho wathola khona umklomelo wesiliva, okwakuyisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokusebenza kanzima. UThandiwe akagijimi kuphela, kodwa futhi ungumfundisi. Uthanda ukusiza abanye, futhi ubamba izifundo zokugijima ezikoleni ezincane. Uthando lwakhe lokwabelana ngolwazi lwakhe lwenza ukuba abe yisibonelo esihle kubantu abasha, futhi ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ingafinyelelwa uma umuntu ezimisela. UThandiwe ubelokhu eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba balandele amaphupho abo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungathola izinzuzo ezinkulu uma abantu bephumelela. Ngaphandle kokugijima, uThandiwe ungumuntu ophumelelayo empilweni. Uthanda ukufunda, futhi ubamba izifundo ezihlukahlukene. UThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi impilo ayigcini nje ngokugijima, kodwa futhi ibandakanya ukufunda, ukukhula, nokuhlonipha. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila kahle lwenza ukuba abe yisibonelo esihle kubantu abaningi, futhi ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ingafinyelelwa uma umuntu ezimisela. UThandiwe Mthembu ungumgibeli ophumelelayo, umfundisi, nomphakathi ophumelelayo. Ubonisa ukuthi impilo ingaba yinhle uma umuntu ezimisela, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungathola izinzuzo ezinkulu uma abantu bephumelela. UThandiwe uhlala ekhuthaza abanye ukuba balandele amaphupho abo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi onzima uyakhokhela. UThandiwe Mthembu ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wezokugijima, futhi umhlaba uzokhumbula igama lakhe.
Ubudlelwano obuphephile kusho ukusebenzisa i-condom ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ubudlelwano obuphephile kusho ukuthi ithanga lendoda alikwazi ukungena emathangeni omfazi. Kubalulekile ukuba nobudlelwano obuphephile nomlingani oyedwa (ubudlelwano obuthembekile). Ubudlelwano obuphephile kusho ukuthi wena nomlingani wakho kufanele nihlolwe i-HIV ukuze nithole ukuthi anitholakali. Bobabili ningabamba iqhaza ebudlelwaneni. Lokhu kusabhekwa njengobudlelwano obuphephile. Umuntu one-HIV angaphila isikhathi eside uma ethatha ukunakekela. Phuza amanzi ahlanzekile. Faka ukudla ukuze izinyoni zingasabalalisi amagciwane. Geza izandla ngemva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Geza izandla ngaphambi kokudla. Phuma udoti ngendlela efanele. Gcina ikhaya lakho nendawo ophila kuyo ihlanzekile. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa kweziqhamo. Khuthaza ubudlelwano obuphephile. Futhi uthi cha ebudlelwaneni. Abantu abane-HIV nabo banamalungelo afana nawo wonke umuntu. Ilungelo lokuhlonishwa. Ilungelo lokuba nekhaya. Ilungelo lokuvikelwa kolwazi lwabo. I-HIV yisifo esinciphisa uhlelo lokuzivikela, sishiya umuntu engatholakali ezifo. I-HIV ibangela uhlelo lokuzivikela ukuba luphume. Umuntu angaphila ne-HIV iminyaka eminingi ngaphandle kokukhombisa izimpawu. I-HIV noma i-AIDS isiphakathi kwethu, iyinto eqinile, futhi isabalala ngokushesha. Lesi sifo singanqotshwa kuphela uma sihlangana sisebenzisana ukuze salvise isizwe sethu. Ngalesi sikhathi sonke siye savalela amehlo ethu sithemba ukuthi i-HIV ayiyona into eqinile. Ngokwenza lokhu, sivumela ukusabalala kwe-HIV ukuqhubeka yonke le minyaka. Izwe lethu liqhubeka nalesi sifo. Usuku nosuku, cishe abantu abangu-1500 batholakale nalesi sifo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwabantu abathathu million baphila nalesi sifo. Njengabathintekayo empini yokulwa ne-HIV noma i-AIDS, kufanele sihlanganyele zonke izinzwa zethu, kanye namandla ethu nemibono yethu. Akukho enye indlela yokuvikela ukusabalala kwe-HIV ngaphandle kokuziphatha kahle. Kufanele sisebenze ndawonye futhi sixhase izikhungo zezempilo ekucwaningeni isixazululo se-HIV nezinkinga ezihlobene. Kufanele sithumele yonke imithombo kazwelonke ukuze sithumele imiyalezo yokuvikela i-HIV, sinikeze ukwesekwa kulabo abaphila nalesi sifo nabathandekayo babo. Kufanele sihlanganyele njengabathintekayo, sazi ukuthi ubumbano lwethu lungaholela emiphumeleni emihle. Kufanele sazi ukuthi lokho esikwenza namuhla kuhloswe ngathi nempilo yethu nalesi sikhathi. Ndawonye njengabathintekayo empini yokulwa ne-HIV ne-AIDS, singawina. I-virus ye-HIV ingena emzimbeni ngezindlela ezilandelayo: Ngokwenza ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ukuvikela. Umama angadlulisa i-virus kumntwana wakhe ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ngokuxhumana negazi elitholakale. Ngokwesibonelo, igazi elihlangana nesikhumba esivulekile, noma isikhumba esiphukile, emlonyeni, ngaphansi kwenaili, noma ezilonda. Izilonda ezingapholi emlonyeni. Izimpawu ze-tuberculosis, ukukhwehlela, nokuphuma. Ukuphuma okungapheli okungase kuhlangane nokuphuma. Ukulahlekelwa yinkumbulo nokukhohlwa kalula. Kunezindlela eziningi zokuvikela i-HIV. Ngokuvamile, i-HIV idluliselwa ngokuxhumana ngokocansi. Kufanele ubambe iqhaza ebudlelwaneni obuphephile uma ufuna ukuphepha.

Kuzosetshenziswa ngendlela yokwakha oxhumana nabo phakathi kwabantu abanamava kulomsebenzi wokuhweba nalabo abangenamava. 2.1 Ezindaweni ezibekelwe ukuhweba, kuzobekwa usuku lokwamukelwa ngokofficial kwabathengisi bonke kule ndawo. Ngemuva kwalokho, noma ubani ophula umthetho uzosuswa, futhi umnyango uzobika kwiKhansela njalo ngenyanga mayelana nokwamukelwa kwabathengisi ukuze basebenze ngokomthetho. 2.2 Kuzovunyelwa kuphela labo abakwi-level yokuqala yokungena ebhizinisini. 2.3 IKhansela izokhuthaza ukuphakanyiswa kwabathengisi ezindaweni ezibekelwe ukuze kube nokungena emakethe esemthethweni, ngokwakha amathuba okuthuthukisa abantu kanye namabhizinisi abo isikhathi esithile emva kwalokho umthengisi angabuyela ukufaka isicelo uma efuna ukusebenzisa le ndawo efanayo. Umnyango kufanele wenze izivumelwano zokuhweba ezindaweni zokuhweba zomphakathi, ezizoba yisivumelwano phakathi kweKhansela nabathengisi abaqoshwe ngesikhathi benikezwa lezi zindawo abazohweba kuzo. 2.4 Isicelo sokudluliselwa kwendawo yokuhweba uma kwenzeka isimo esinzima, ukugula, ukufa, noma ukungasebenzi kahle komnikazi kufanele sithunyelwe kwiKhansela ukuze processing. (Lokhu kubhekwa ngesimo ngasinye). 2.5 Umlando wendawo uzobuyekezwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona yini izimo ezikhethekile okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphezu kwemigomo evunyelwene ngayo, noma ukuthi kufanele kusebenze imigomo ejwayelekile. Ngokuphathelene nezindawo zokusebenza, iMasipala we eThekwini izozama ukufinyelela lezi zinhlelo ezilandelayo. IKhansela izosebenzisa ukwabiwa kwezindawo zokusebenza ukuze ibhekane nokuntuleka kwamathuba ezomnotho emiphakathini eyayiphucukile amathuba. Ekubeni kwezakhamizi ezindaweni zokusebenza, kuzobekwa ukugxila okukhulu kwabesifazane, intsha, kanye nabantu abakhubazekile njengoba kuchazwe umthetho kazwelonke. Amaphuzu azonikezwa ngendlela ehambisana nezimfuneko ezibekiwe. Ukukhula kwezindawo zokuhweba ezingasetshenziswanga kuzobikwa kubalawuli ngenhloso yokubazisa ngezindawo ezitholakalayo. Noma iyiphi indawo yokuhweba engasetshenziswanga izokhankaselwa kubantu bendawo abakhe le ndawo. Izindawo zokuhweba ezingeni lemasipala ngokuvamile zizokhankaselwa kuyo yonke indawo yamasipala. Akuzukuba nohlaka lokulinda; labo asebekwiwo izikhundla ezinjalo bazokwaziswa ukuze bakwazi ukufaka izicelo kabusha uma izindawo zitholakala. Uma amaphuzu efana, indawo izonikezwa ngokudonswa. Abathengisi abakhona bangafaka izicelo zezindawo ezahlukene. Uma umuntu ethola indawo entsha, kuzodingeka aphume kuleyo ayesebenzisa ngaphambili. Umnyango uzohlinzeka ngombiko kubalawuli njalo ngenyanga mayelana nokwabiwa kwezindawo zokuhweba.
Ukubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezibhedlela Kwathi ngosuku olukhanyayo, uNandi, umama oneminyaka engama-30, wathola ukuthi umntwana wakhe, uSipho, uphakathi nodlame lokugula. USipho wayenokukhwehlela okukhulu, futhi uNandi, ethukuthele, wagijima emnyango weziguli zendawo. Wazi ukuthi kufanele abhalise uSipho ukuze athole usizo, kodwa kwangathi lokhu bekungeyona into elula. Lapha, emnyango weziguli, uNandi wathola abantu abaningi, bonke bejolisa emnyango, belindele ukuba bahlolwe. Ukukhathazeka kwakhe kwanda, kodwa wakhumbula ukuthi umntwana wakhe udinga usizo. Wavuma ukuthatha umoya, waphila amehlo akhe, wathinta isikhumbuzo sokuthi akakaze abhalise, ngakho kudingeka abone ukuthi okungukuthi ukufaka igama labantu abangu-1, 2, 3, nokunye. Ngaphambi kokungena, umphakathi owawuhlangene emnyango weziguli wawubukeka ungokwemvelo, umama ophakathi noNandi, umphakathi ohlangene, kodwa uNandi waphila isikhumbuzo sokufuna usizo. Wabe esephuma emnyango, uthola umphakathi umphakathi wenjabulo, abantu bejabulile, kepha yena udinga ukwazi ukuthi kufanele enze kanjani. Ukubhaliswa kwezinsiza ezinjengalezi kungenziwa kumasayizi ahlukahlukene, okuhamba kwahlanganiswa nezinsiza ezithile. U-Nandi wathola umnyango ovulekile, lapho abahlali bejabulile. Wabe esebonisa umbono omuhle, kepha futhi ethokozisa. Uhlale phansi, wathola abanye abantu bejabulile, bejabulile, kepha yena wayesebenzisa isikhathi sakhe esibalulekile. "Ngiyavuma," kusho uNandi, "ngizokwenza lokhu." U-Nandi wathola ibhodi elalikhombisa izigaba ezahlukene zokubhaliswa, ngakho wathola ukuthi kudingeka abhalise uSipho. Wazama ukufunda amagama, kodwa kwaba nzima. Ngakho, wacele usizo kumama owayesondelene naye. Umama walokhu ehlale emnyango, waphendula kahle, wathi: "Ngidinga ukudlula phambili." U-Nandi wathola umoya ohlanzekile, wathola okuthile okukhuthazayo, waphila ukukholwa ukuthi uSipho uzothola usizo. Ngemuva kokuthi ethole izinqumo ezidingekayo, uNandi wahamba emnyango, wathola ukuthi uSipho uzothola usizo oluthile. Waba nomoya opholile, kwavela umoya omusha. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, uNandi wathola isibopho sokuhlinzekwa. Wamukela umphakathi omusha, ubumnandi bakhe bukhanya, wathola ukuthi kukhona abanye abahlala emnyango, bekhuluma, bebuka izincwadi, bezama ukukhetha. U-Nandi waphila umoya omuhle, wathola ukuthi uSipho uzothola usizo olunembile. Kodwa, ngaphambi kokuba uNandi akhulume neziguli, wadinga ukuqonda kahle ukuthi umntwana wakhe uzothola kanjani usizo. Wathola umphakathi obhujiswa yizinto ezinzima, abafundi bezolungisa umphakathi, kepha uNandi wathola umphakathi ophakeme, wathola iziguli ezizokwenza kahle. U-Nandi wahamba phambili, wathola usizo, waphila umoya omuhle. U-Sipho, owayesebenzisa isikhathi eside, waba neqhaza ekutholeni isixazululo. U-Nandi wathola umoya opholile, walungisa umphakathi wabantu abahlala phansi, wathola ukuthi kufanele abe nesibopho sokuhlinzekwa. Ekugcineni, uSipho wathola usizo oluqondile, uNandi wathola umphakathi omuhle, umoya opholile. Waqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, wathola umphakathi ophakeme, ekugcineni waphila umoya omuhle. U-Nandi waphuma emnyango, wathola ukuthi umntwana wakhe uzothola usizo, wathola umphakathi ophakeme. U-Nandi wakhumbula, "Ngiyabonga, uSipho, ngiyavuma, sizokwenza kahle." Wathi, "Ngiyazi, umoya omuhle uyasiza, sizokwenza kahle." Lokhu kusiza, uSipho waba neqhaza, uNandi wathola umoya omuhle, ekugcineni waba nesibopho sokuhlinzekwa. Ngale ndlela, ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kwaba ukukholwa, umoya omuhle, futhi uNandi wathola umphakathi ophakeme. U-Sipho waba nesikhathi sokuba neqhaza, wathola umoya opholile, futhi umama wakhe, uNandi, wathokozisa umphakathi. Kwakukhanya, kwavela umoya omuhle.
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa Ekuqaleni, eNyakatho Kapa, kwakukhona umuzi ophithizelayo, ogcwele izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Abantu bahlala ezindlini ezincane, behlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kumandla. Kodwa, kwavela umoya omusha, umoya wokuguquka. Kwakuyisikhathi sokubuyisela emuva, isikhathi sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThandi, umphakathi ophakathi kweNyakatho Kapa, wayengumuntu ophokophelelayo. Wayenothando olukhulu lokusiza umphakathi wakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi ehamba emgwaqweni, wahlangana noMnu. Mthembu, umphakathi ophakathi kokwakha iphrojekthi yamandla avuselelekayo. UThandi wathola ukuthi le phrojekthi yayihlose ukunciphisa ukuncika kumandla avela ezinsizeni ezingavuselelekayo, futhi yayizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bathole amandla. UMnu. Mthembu wakhuluma ngale phrojekthi ngendlela ethokozisayo. "Sizokwakha iziteshi zamandla elanga, iziteshi zamandla omoya, kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina amanzi," kusho yena. "Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu bethu ukuba bathole amandla, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi wethu ube namandla." UThandi wathokozisa kakhulu. Wazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha impilo yabantu abaningi. Waqala ukuhlela umcimbi wokwazisa umphakathi ngale phrojekthi. Wabiza abantu bonke, wathi: "Sizoba nomhlangano omkhulu, sizokhuluma ngempilo yethu, nendlela esingayithuthukisa ngayo." Ngesikhathi umcimbi ufika, abantu bephuma bezokhuluma, bejabulile. UThandi wakhuluma ngale phrojekthi, wakhuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza. "Sizokwakha umphakathi onamandla, umphakathi ozimele," kusho yena. Abantu babebonisa intshisekelo, futhi baqala ukubuza imibuzo. UThandi waphendula, wathi: "Sizodinga bonke, sizodinga imisebenzi, sizodinga izandla ezisebenzayo." Ngemuva kwalolo mcimbi, abantu baqala ukuhlela. Kwakukhona abanye ababevele benza izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zamandla elanga ezindlini zabo. Kwakukhona abanye ababevele beqale ukufunda ngama-batteries avuselelekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukugcina amandla. UThandi waba yisibonelo, waqala ukwakha iziteshi zamandla elanga emakhaya akhe. Wafundisa abanye abantu, wabelana ngolwazi, futhi umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa. Njengoba izinyanga zedlula, iphrojekthi yamandla avuselelekayo yathuthuka. Iziteshi zamandla elanga zakhuliswa, iziteshi zamandla omoya zafakwa, futhi abantu baqala ukuthola amandla. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa izibani ezikhanyayo, bejabulisa imishini yabo. UThandi wabona ukuthi umphakathi wakhe ubuyela emuva, ubuyela empilweni. Kodwa, akukhona konke okwakuhamba kahle. Kwakukhona izinselelo. Abanye abantu babengakholwa ukuthi le phrojekthi izophumelela. Babebona izindleko, babebona ubunzima bokwakha. UThandi waba nesibindi, wathi: "Sizokwenza lokhu, sizokwenza kube khona ithemba. Sizokwenza kube khona amandla." Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu, waba yisibonelo sokuthi konke kungenzeka uma abantu benza ngokubambisana. Wabamba izifundo, wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. UThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi amandla avuselelekayo awanqotshwa. Abantu baqala ukwethemba, baqala ukwakha, futhi umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa. Ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, iphrojekthi yamandla avuselelekayo yaphumelela. Umphakathi wawunamandla, wawunokuthula. Abantu babenamandla, futhi babenokuthula. UThandi wabona ukuthi umphakathi wakhe ubuyela emuva, ubuyela empilweni. Wazi ukuthi lokhu bekungaphezu kwamandla avuselelekayo; bekungukwakha umphakathi onamandla. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bephokophelelayo, bangakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Wazi ukuthi amandla avuselelekayo awanqotshwa, futhi umphakathi wakhe wawukhanya njengokukhanya kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphila, indaba yokubambisana, indaba yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile eNyakatho Kapa. uUsain Bolt Emazweni aphakathi kwezinyembezi zempilo, lapho abantwana bejabulisa khona futhi abadlali begubha impumelelo, kwavela isibani esikhazimulayo. Leli phepha livela emlandweni wezemidlalo, elibhalwa ngothando, ngenhlonipho, futhi lufaka izindaba eziyinqaba zomzamo nomsebenzi. Kulolu hlelo, sikhuluma ngendoda eyaziwa ngegama eliyinhloko kwezokugijima — uUsain Bolt. UUsain Bolt wazalwa ngoNovemba 21, 1986, eTrelawny, eJamaica. Uyinsizwa enenkanyezi, owayenobuhlakani obuningi, obuphawulwe yizikhathi zokuqala. Ubukhulu bakhe, u-1.95m, bamsiza ukuba abe yisixazululo somjaho. Ngesikhathi abanye abantwana bejolise kwezinye izindlela zokuphila, uUsain wayethola ithuba lokukhanyisa izinyembezi zempilo, efuna imigudu yokuphila phambili. Njengomfana, uUsain wayejabula kakhulu ngezinto ezahlukene, futhi ukugijima kwaba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yakhe. Akazange aphuthelwe ithuba lokuhola emhlabeni wezokugijima. U-Usain waba yinkanyezi, esebenza ngezinhloso zokufinyelela impumelelo. Ngonyaka ka-2008, uUsain waba neqhaza elikhulu emidlalweni ye-Olympics eBeijing, eChina, lapho wavula umqondo omusha wokugijima. Wathola iziqu ezinkulu, waphonsela inselelo, futhi wagubha amakhono akhe ngempumelelo. Waphumelela ezigabeni zokuqhuba, kuyi-100m nase-200m, waba yinkanyezi enkulu emhlabeni. Uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo lwaba umthombo wokudlondlobala, okuholela ekubeni umholi. U-Usain uqhubekela phambili, futhi uhamba ezikhaleni ezimnandi, abanye bakhe besekela imizamo yakhe. Wachitha izinsuku eziningi efunda kumadoda abamele umhlaba, okuhlale kusesimweni esihle. U-Usain ungumuntu ophakeme, ogijima njengesiphepho sothando. Wakhiwa ubudlelwane obuqinile nabangani bakhe, futhi imiphumela yayikhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe. Ngonyaka ka-2012, imidlalo ye-Olympics yeLondon yathokozisa izinkanyezi, uUsain waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu. Waqhubeka nokwakha izikhumbuzo ezinhle, futhi wakhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uUsain waphumelela izinguquko eziningi emkhakheni wezokugijima. Ngenhla kwalokhu, wathola umuzwa omuhle wokuba ngumholi. U-Ethos wakhe wephula imikhawulo, waba umfanekiso omuhle kubabukeli. U-Usain ungumholi ophakeme, ubumbene nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Njengoba ebuyela emsebenzini, ubala imizuzu yokugcina. Wafunda ukuthi impumelelo ibalulekile, kodwa umoya wokuzidela, ubudlelwane, nokwakha imifanekiso efanele kubalulekile. U-Usain uvuma ukuzikhandla, akazisa imizamo yakhe, futhi uthola imiphumela emihle. Ngempela, uUsain Bolt ungomunye wezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emlandweni wezokugijima. Uhlonishwa ngenkanyezi yakhe ehlala ifudumele, ibonisa ukuthi uthando, umzamo, kanye nesibindi, bakha izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emlandweni. Njengoba ethi, "Kodwa amaphupho akhe awapheli..." akhombisa ukuthi impilo idinga umoya wokuphila, ukuze kuhlangane nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. U-Usain Bolt, umholi wezokugijima, uhlobo oluhlala phambili, luhlaza emathubhini zempilo.
Idolobha LaseGoli Umbuzo: Yini okuncomekayo ngedolobha laseGoli? Impendulo: Idolobha laseGoli, elaziwa njengeGoli, linomlando ocebile, lingelinye lamadolobha amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Lihamba phambili kwezomnotho, izokwakha, kanye nezokuthutha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, idolobha linomoya ophilayo, udumo lwezokungcebeleka, nemisebenzi yezandla ehlonishwayo. Umbuzo: Yini eyenza idolobha laseGoli likhethekile? Impendulo: Okwakha ubunikazi beGoli, kusetshenziswa ukuhweba impahla ehlukahlukene, ubuciko, kanye nezokuthutha. Izikole, izikhungo zomphakathi, nezindawo zokungcebeleka zithokozisa imindeni. Goli yidolobha elihlanganisa izindawo ezahlukene, ubukhazikhazi bemijibha, nezinhlelo zezokuthutha eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo: Yini efanele ukuvakashelwa eGoli? Impendulo: Ezinye zezindawo ezihehayo eGoli zifaka iApartheid Museum, lapho abantu befunda ngembali yeNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona futhi iMaboneng Precinct, lapho uthola khona ubuciko obuphilayo, izindawo zokudla, nezitolo ezithokozisayo. IGold Reef City, indawo yokuzijabulisa, iyathandwa ngazo zonke izigaba zezihloko. Umbuzo: Kuthiwani ngezokuthutha eGoli? Impendulo: E-Goli, izindlela zokuthutha ziyatholakala, kufaka phakathi izitimela, amabhasi, nezimoto. U-Guatrain uhlelelwe ukuhamba phakathi kweGoli nezindawo ezizungezile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba nokufinyelela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene zedolobha. Umbuzo: Kulukhuni kangakanani ukuhlala eGoli? Impendulo: Njengoba idolobha linobunzima bempilo, imishado nezidingo zomphakathi zibalulekile. Izindleko zokuhlala zingase zibe phezulu, kodwa kunezinhlobonhlobo zezindawo zokuhlala. Ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezintweni eziningi, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale behlakaniphile. Umbuzo: Yimiphi imicimbi ethokozisayo ebhizinisini eGoli? Impendulo: Goli isebenzisa imicimbi ethokozisayo, okuhlanganisa imikhosi, amarugby, nezinye izinto ezinomthelela. I-Afrika Cup, isibonelo, iwumcimbi oveza ubumqoka bempumelelo yethu kwezomnotho nakwezobuciko. Lokhu kudlulisela umqondo ophilayo kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo: Ucabangani ngempumelelo yedolobha laseGoli? Impendulo: Impumelelo yedolobha laseGoli ibonakala ezimbonini ezihlukahlukene, okukhulumayo ngeddiya yempilo, ezemidlalo, nezobuciko. Lokhu kukhuthaza abafundi, abasebenzi, nabakhiqizi, kubavumela ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo. Umbuzo: Yikuphi okungcono ukwenza ngempela eGoli? Impendulo: Ukuhamba, ukudla, nokwelashwa kwezimali eGoli kujabulela kwabantu abaningi. Ukudla ukubonakala kwezindawo ezimnandi zokudlela, kufaka phakathi izindawo zemvelo nemigwaqo ehlukahlukene. Umbuzo: Yini eyodwa phakathi kwezinto ozoyiqonda uma uvakashela eGoli? Impendulo: Abantu, inguquko yabo, kanye nesiko lokuhlala eGoli bangaholela emiphumeleni emihle kumavakashi. Ukubona ubuzwe nezithakazelo zomphakathi kuyakwenza ube nakho okukhulu. Umbuzo: Yisiphi isifundo esinembile osincomayo ngedolobha laseGoli? Impendulo: Ukuhlonipha izinkolelo, izimpilo, nemisebenzi yabanye kungaba isipho esithokozisayo. Idolobha laseGoli liphakamisa imicabango emisha yokubambisana, yenze kube khulu ukuthula nemiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Umbuzo: Ngabe umoya obhujisiwe ungakhipha imiphumela? Impendulo: Kuhle ukuba nomoya ophilayo, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba bandise ubuhlakani babo futhi bakhe amathuba. Idolobha lisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze lufeze ukuphila okunempilo. Umbuzo: Ngabe uthola umbono ongakwenza uhambe ngeviki elizayo? Impendulo: Yebo, uhambo lwezobuciko, ukudla, nemicimbi ebalulekile kungakha amandla amahle. Goli ijezi lempumelelo phakathi namadolobha amakhulu, okwakha uthando namuhla kulabo abavakashela. Umbuzo: Yini engcindezelayo uma uhlala eGoli? Impendulo: Ubudlelwane bomphakathi, inselelo zomphakathi, nezindleko zezimali kungase kube ezimweni ezinzima. Nokho, ukubambisana emphakathini kusebenza kahle ukuze kudaleke imiphumela emihle. Idolobha laseGoli, ngakho, liyindawo edlondlobala, enhle, nangenhlonipho, ezinzima – ethokozisa abavakashi nendawo. Lokhu kuhamba phambili kungenza kube kuthe xaxa ukwazi izimpilo ezithokozisayo zeGoli.
Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KweMibhalo, 2000 ("umthetho") wawusungulwa ngoMsombuluko 9, 2001, ufeza ilungelo lemthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe ngama- body omphakathi noma ezizimele uma kudingeka ukuze kuqhutshekwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, isikhungo esithunyelwe kuso lesi sicelo sinesibopho sokunika lokho kulwazi ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ngokusobala ukuthi lokho kulwazi kufanele kukhishwe noma cha. Umthetho uphinde uveze izinqubo ezizolandela uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sithunyelwa. Le ncwadi ihlose ukukhuthaza isiko lokucacisa nokubhekelela ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezohwebo Nezomnotho ("DTI") ngokufeza ilungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ukuze abantu noma izikhungo ezithile zikwazi ukukusebenzisa futhi zivikele amalungelo awo. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuxhumana kweqiniso nezikhungo zikamasipala, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ufundisiwe futhi unolwazi ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Ngendlela efaka leli lungelo eduze kwamanye amalungelo, ifaka amalungelo afana nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kuMthethosisekelo. Isigaba 14 somthetho sinikeza ama- body omphakathi ukuba abhale idokhumenti yokusebenza, ezosiza abantu abafuna ulwazi oluthile kulowo mnyango, futhi sichaza izidingo okufanele zifezekiswe yilezi zedokhumenti. I-DTI ibike ukuthi izoqhubeka nokuzama ukusebenza ngokucacile futhi izohlinzeka ngolwazi emphakathini nasemabhizinisini ngokuqhubekayo ngama-publishing e-DTI, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye ne-call center. Le ncwadi ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ummangali wolwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ngemininingwane yokuxhumana, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile ku-DTI. Le Manual iphinde ihlose ukuhlinzeka ummangali ngencazelo ecacile yesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye nenxusa yolwazi ye-DTI ukuze ummangali akwazi kalula ukuthola lapho ulwazi lukhona. Le ncwadi iphinde ifake amafomu adingekayo kanye nezinkokhelo ezihambisana nezicelo zolwazi. I-DTI inhloso yayo ukuhola nokweseka uhlelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ngendlela ekhuthaza ukusimama komnotho futhi ivule amathuba emisebenzi kubo bonke abakha lo mnotho, ngokwandisa amazinga okutshalwa kwezimali, ukuthuthukisa nokwandisa ukuthunyelwa kwemikhiqizo yaseNingizimu Afrika ezweni langaphandle, nokwakha imakethe efanele futhi eyinhlangano yokuncintisana kwemikhiqizo phakathi kwamabhizinisi endawo kanye namakhasimende. Ngale ndlela, i-DTI isebenza ukusiza umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ukuba ube nendlela esheshayo yokukhula nokuphumelela. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe umkhakha wokukhiqiza ophumelelayo nowokubambisana okukhuthaza ukwandiswa kwamathuba okukhula komnotho okusimeme kubo bonke abanye baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze wandise futhi uthuthukise isikali somkhakha wokukhiqiza nezinsizakalo zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze ukhuthaze amazinga aphezulu okutshalwa kwezimali kwasekhaya nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuze udale imakethe enezindlela, enezinga lokuncintisana lemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika kubo bonke abathengisi bendawo nakwamanye amazwe, kanye namakhasimende. Izikhungo zokweseka zinikeza usizo kumabhizinisi asebenza ukusiza izigaba ezahlukene zomnyango. Izikhungo zokwenza izinqumo zigxile ekwakheni izimo ezithokozisayo ngaphakathi komnotho. Izikhungo zokwethula izinsizakalo zixhumanisa ngqo amabhizinisi namakhasimende nemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Isikhungo sokumaketha siqapha ukumaketha kwemikhiqizo ye-DTI (ohlelo nezinsiza) futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi endawo namakhasimende aqonda amalungelo awo emnothweni. Ukuze wandise ukuqwashisa nokufinyelela kumikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ze-DTI. Ulwazi lwenkampani, isibonelo, umqondisi, abanikazi, ikheli lenkampani, njll. Umthetho Wokulawula Izikhali 87 ka-1993: Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula ukulawulwa kwezikhali zonke, nokusungula iBhodi ezolawula izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezikhali kuleRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokuchaza izinhloso nemisebenzi yalezi zikhali, nokuchaza izindlela ezizolawulwa ngazo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene.
