Umbiko: Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwamavoti Nentando Yeningi Isingeniso Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ezweni lethu. Lokhu kuhlobene nendlela abantu abathatha ngayo izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo, kanye nezinhlelo ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kubika kuzohlola ukubaluleka kokuvota, izindlela ezithinta ukunqoba kwezombusazwe, kanye nemiphumela yokungabambi iqhaza kwabavoti. Ukubaluleka Kokuvota Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kusho ukuthi abantu banesibopho sokuthatha izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nezikhundla eziphakanyiswa, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinhlelo ezithinta impilo yabo. Ukuvota akuyona nje indlela yokukhetha abaholi, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhuluma, yokubonisa umbono, nokubeka izidingo zomphakathi phambili. Ngakho-ke, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kuqinisekisa ukuthi izwi labantu liyavuma, futhi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izifiso zomphakathi. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukubamba Iqhaza Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezihlelwe kahle zokufundisa abantu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, izinqubo zokuvota, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola abakhankasayo. Izikhungo zemfundo, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni bangabamba iqhaza ekwakheni imikhankaso yokufundisa. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde ukuthi ukuvota akuyona nje into eyinqaba, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokubamba iqhaza ezinqubweni zomphakathi. Izithiyo Ekubambeni Iqhaza Kunezithiyo eziningi ezithinta ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukungabi nolwazi, ukungathembi izinhlelo zokhetho, kanye nezinkinga zokufinyelela ezikhungweni zokuvota. Abanye abantu bangase bazizwe bengakhethi, noma bahlale bephikisana nezinhlelo ezikhona. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabavoti, abaholi, kanye nezikhungo eziphathelene nezokhetho. Imiphumela Yokungabambi Iqhaza Uma abantu bengabambi iqhaza, imiphumela ingaba mibi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zingavumelani nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abaholi bangabi nesibopho sokubheka izidingo zabantu, futhi kungenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithinta izimfuno zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zikhombisa izifiso zomphakathi. Isiphetho Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ukuvota akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhuluma, yokubamba iqhaza, nokwakha ikusasa. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bavote, ukufundisa ngamalungelo nezibopho zabo, nokuxazulula izithiyo ezithinta ukuvota kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphatheke kahle ezinqubweni zomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onokuthula, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo.
Ukulalelwa Komphakathi Mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Enye yezinguquko eziphakanyisiwe, futhi ezibhekwa njengendlela yokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, nguMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI). Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho kuwukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubo bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi noma baphila kanjani. Nokho, le msebenzi ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukulalelwa komphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke uhlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokunikeza abantu ithuba lokuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba iningi labantu eNingizimu Afrika lingakwazi ukukhokhela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezizimele, okuholela ekutheni iziguli zihlale zisebenzisa izinsiza eziphansi noma ezingekho emthethweni. Ngakho, uNHI uzoba yindlela yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, engabizi kakhulu, futhi ethokozisayo. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke, bephakamisa izinkinga ezithile. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka mayelana nezinsiza ezikhona. Abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke uzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, izisebenzi zezempilo, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze ube yimpumelelo. Lokhu kubangela ukukhathazeka ukuthi izinsiza ezikhona eNingizimu Afrika zikhona yini ukuze zikwazi ukusekela le msebenzi. Uma izinsiza zingekho, uNHI ungase ungabi nempumelelo, futhi abantu bangase bahlupheke kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona ukungabaza ngempumelelo yokuphatha uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi uhulumeni ungenza kahle ekuphatheni izinhlelo zezempilo, kodwa baphikisa ukuthi uNHI uzodinga ukuphathwa okuhle ukuze ube yimpumelelo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekubhekeni nasekuphatheni uNHI. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukwethembeka komphakathi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke ungaba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezisemthethweni, bazoba nethuba elikhulu lokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa umnotho, ngoba abantu abanempilo bayakwazi ukusebenza kahle, futhi bangakha izimpilo ezinhle. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni komnotho, okuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi umphakathi ube nengxoxo evulekile mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uNHI ube yimpumelelo, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni nasekuphatheni le msebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uNHI ube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi zezempilo, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi zezempilo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokulalelwa mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uNHI ube yimpumelelo, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni nasekuphatheni le msebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ezisemthethweni. Ekuphetheni, uMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke ungaba yithuba elikhulu lokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, ukuze ube yimpumelelo, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni nasekuphatheni le msebenzi. Ukulalelwa komphakathi kubalulekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuxoxa ngale msebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uNHI ube yimpumelelo, futhi uhlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubo bonke abantu.
Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika isu lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kazwelonke. Lokhu kuyingxenye yemiphumela yokucwaninga okukhulu kanye nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezabasebenzi kanye neSikhungo Samakhono Kazwelonke. NgoNovemba 2000, kwakhulunywa kabanzi ngohlelo olwakhiwe. IBhodi Yezamakhono Kazwelonke isiqinisekisile iziphakamiso eziningi ezaziphakanyiswe kulokhu kukhuluma. NgoJanuwari 2001, le Bhodi yethule kimi iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqala zezwe lethu ezisekela isu elibanzi lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Lezi ziphakamiso nezincazelo zakhuphula umoya wami ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, leli su selivele laqaphela izindawo ezibalulekile ezihamba phambili ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono, futhi sihlinzeke ngezinkomba esizozilinganisa ngazo impumelelo nentuthuko esiyenzile. Ngakho-ke, leli su lihola umnyango wami, uMnyango Wezemfundo, nezinye izigaba zokuqeqesha. Okwesibili, leli su libonisa kahle ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuzothinta kanjani umkhankaso kazwelonke wokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekuthuthukiseni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izigaba zikahulumeni zisebenza ndawonye ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu bathola imfundo neziqu ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isibonelo, uMnyango Wezemfundo uzibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi kube nezinguquko emfundweni ejwayelekile nasezifundweni eziphakeme. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono afanele. Isu Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ligcizelela indima edlalwa umnyango wami enqubweni yokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi - ikakhulukazi ngezindlela ezizotholwa ngazo impumelelo yaleyo ndima. Iphinde ihlinzeke nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni ngohlaka lokusebenza njengoba zithuthukisa amakhono ezindaweni zazo. Okwesithathu, nginikezwe igunya lokusekela lokho esikutholile ngesikhathi sibhala futhi sihlela leli su. Nakuba kube nokuvumelana mayelana nezindlela zokuhlola ukusebenza kahle kwecebo nokukala izinhloso, impumelelo yalesi sihloko ixhaswe ngaphandle kokungabaza. Mayelana nendaba yokusetha izinkomba ezizokhombisa impumelelo nokuhlola indima esiyidlalayo ekufezeni leli su, kwavunyelwana, futhi le nhloso iyinkomba eyengeziwe yokuthi umnyango wami uzibophezele ekusebenzeni komphakathi nasekubikeni umphakathi ngakho konke okwenziwayo. Inselelo enkulu ukuwenza lo msebenzi ube yimpumelelo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uqhubeka nokusiza umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhuthaza abaqashi, izinyunyana, abasebenzi, izigaba zikahulumeni, nomphakathi ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Umnyango wami uzibophezele ekuqapheleni ukuthi leli su lisebenza kahle futhi liya phambili. Zonke izindlela ezifanele kumele zenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempumelelo futhi kube nezincwadi ezibhalwe ngokusemthethweni mayelana nentuthuko yalesi si. Ngithembela kakhulu kwiBhodi Yezamakhono Kazwelonke ukuze ibuyekeze imibiko ebhalwe umnyango wami, futhi uma kudingeka, iqale uphenyo lwayo, inginikeze izeluleko nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezidinga ukubuyekezwa kwezinhlelo nezinguquko ekwenzeni. Impumelelo nokwehluleka kumele kubhalwe ukuze sonke sikwazi ukufunda kulokhu futhi silungise amaphutha ethu. Isu kumele ngempela libe sezingeni eliphezulu. Ngizokwenza njalo ngilindele imibiko yentuthuko evela emnyangweni wami, nakwiBhodi ephethe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ngiphinde ngemukele iBhodi ukuba iqhubeke ibuyekeza izinhloso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziqhubeka zixazulula izidingo ezibalulekile zezwe lethu. Ngifuna ukuveza ukubonga kwami okujulile kubantu abangujajayo nabesilisa abangujajayo abake baba nesandla ekuthuthukiseni leli su elihloniphekile. Izinhloso engizibekile zisezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu, kodwa akukho okungenzeka uma sinesibindi. Ngokufanayo, umdlandla esinawo wokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ungafezwa. Inselelo kithi manje ukuwenza amaphupho ethu abe yiqiniso. Masivule izandla zethu futhi siqale ukusebenza! Kukhona okwaziwa kahle ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayikakabi namakhono adingekayo ukuze ithuthukise ngokwezimali, ngokwezokuxhumana, nangokwemisebenzi. Ukuze sifinyelele kulolo zinga, sineMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, kanye neMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, owamukelwa ngonyaka ka-1998 no-1999 ngokulandelana. Lezi zimiso zinika uNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi umthwalo wokwenza amalungiselelo eNational Skills Development Strategy, ngokubambisana neSkills Development Council. ISkills Development Council yasungulwa nguMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu ayo amele amabhizinisi, abasebenzi, uhulumeni, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngemva kokucwaninga okukhulu kanye nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezabasebenzi neBhodi ephethe Amakhono, kwenziwa amalungiselelo okuphila kwalesi su. NgoNovemba, kwahlinzekwa amakhophi aleli su kumabamba-ndaba wonke. Imihlangano yokukhuluma ngalesi su yabanjwa kuzo zonke izifunda. Ibhodi ithole iziphakamiso eziningi mayelana nale pilot. Kwabe sekwenziwa ukuhlola, futhi izinkomba zokuphumelela zashintshwa. Izinkomba zokuphumelela ezibekwe kulolu su zizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke futhi zishintshwe uma kudingeka. Ziyindlela esebenzayo yokuhlola izindaba ezibalulekile nokuphumelela, kodwa izindlela zokuhlanganisa ulwazi zingathuthukiswa, njengoba nezindlela zokuhlola umthelela walesi su. Ngasikhathi sinye, lezi zinkomba ziye zavezwa izenzo ezithile kunokukhombisa imiphumela yalezo zenzo. Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkomba zingashintshwa ukuze zikhombise kangcono imiphumela. Ngesikhathi esibekwe, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi uzophatha imibiko ngazinye izinkomba. IBhodi Yezamakhono izobuyekeza le mibiko. Lokhu kuzokwenza uNgqongqoshe abe nolwazi oluqhubekayo nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingavela. Uma kudingeka, uNgqongqoshe angakwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo zamakhono ezwe ngaleso sikhathi. UMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998, kanye noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezibhekisela kubasebenzi nentuthuko yabo. Lezi zimiso ezimbili zethula imibono emisha mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezihloselwe ukugcina nokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Kukhona izindaba ezimbili ezibalulekile ezibhekwa yilezi zimiso. Okokuqala, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho womhlaba kanye nokuncintisana kwemikhakha yethu nezinye izizwe. Okwesibili, ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nokususa ubuphofu. Imithetho yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono seiqalile ukusebenza. NgoAprili 1999, iSkills Development Council yasungulwa. Ngomhla kaM
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa I. Isingeniso Ezinye zezinselelo ezibalulekile zomhlaba wanamuhla zifaka phakathi ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, kanye nezinguquko zezulu. E-Nyakatho Kapa, lezi zinkinga zikhomba isidingo sokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa abheke ukusiza ukunciphisa ukuncikiswa kumamandla aphuma emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza impilo engcono kanye nezinsiza ezihlala isikhathi eside. II. Uhlolojikelele lwezinhlelo zamandla avuselelekayo Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa ahlanganisa izinhlelo ezahlukene ezifana namandla elanga, amandla omoya, nokusetshenziswa kwamandla avela emithonjeni ye-hydro. Amandla elanga, njengemithombo ewusizo yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ayathandwa kakhulu ngenxa yokutholakala kalula kwelanga, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphezulu lokukhanya kwelanga. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amandla omoya azitholela ukubaluleka, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezimvula ezinkulu. III. Amaphrojekthi amakhulu eNyakatho Kapa 1. Uhlelo lwamandla elanga eThekwini Uhlelo lwezokukhiqiza amandla elanga eThekwini luhlose ukwandisa ukuhlinzeka ngogesi wezimboni nezindawo zokuhlala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufakwa kwezinsiza zokukhiqiza amandla elanga ezindaweni ezinjengamasu amakhulu, izikole, nezikhungo zempilo. Izinzuzo zale nhlelo zifaka phakathi ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, ukuphakamisa ukwaziqabukela, kanye nokwehlisa umthelela wokungcoliswa kwemvelo. 2. Uhlelo lwamandla omoya eBokkeveld Uhlelo lwamandla omoya eBokkeveld luhlinzeka ngomthombo othembekile wamandla, futhi lunomthelela omuhle emnothweni wakule ndawo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izikhumbuzo zomoya ezakhiwe ngenqubo yokwakha eluhlaza, okukhuthaza ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungafani nokwendawo engavuselelekayo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kuyilapho kunciphisa ukungcoliswa. 3. Uhlelo lwamanzi avela emithonjeni ye-hydro eCeres Uhlelo lwe-hydro eCeres luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamandla avuselelekayo ngokusebenzisa amanzi afika emifuleni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha iziteshi zamandla ezisebenzisa amanzi ukuze kukhiqizwe ugesi. Le ndlela ingabhekwa njengokuhlinzeka ngogesi okuphakeme, okuyinsiza ehlanzekile, futhi ethokozisa ukuhweba. IV. Izinzuzo zamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa ahlinzeka ngezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, akunciphisi ukukhishwa kwegesi eluhlaza okukhuluma ekwakhiweni kwemvelo. Lokhu kudinga ukunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle emvelweni. Okwesibili, akhulisa umnotho wendawo ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emikhakheni emisha. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngengqalasizinda eqinile yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. V. Izinselelo Noma kunjalo, amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo ahlangabezana nezinselelo ezithile. Lezi zinkinga zihlanganisa ukungabi bikho kwemali eyanele, izinkinga zokufinyelela, kanye nezinkinga zokusungulwa kwezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezithiyo ezivamile ezisemthethweni lapho izikhungo eziningi zikhokhela ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithile, okuyinto engathumela izinkinga ezinkulu ekwenzeni ngempumelelo. VI. Isiphetho Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anendima ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elinempilo nelinokuthula. Ngokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, iNyakatho Kapa ingathuthukisa umnotho, inciphise ukungcoliswa, futhi ikhuthaze ukusimama kwemvelo. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezithile ezithinta impumelelo yalezi zinhlelo, ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izinzuzo zikhula kakhulu kunezingozi. Ukuze kuqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani, uhulumeni, nabantu baphakathi bakhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo engcono, enempilo, nezinsiza ezihlala isikhathi eside eNyakatho Kapa.
Umoya (amanzi) ubalulekile ngesikhathi sokutshala lapho izitshalo zikhula ezindaweni ezithola kuphela imvula. Ulwazi mayelana nenani lemvula elizokwanela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lungatholakala kuMnyango Wezolimo oseduzane nawe. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa njengemihlahlandlela lapho sihlela izindlela zethu zokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani kufanele sigcine amanzi emhlabathini? Ukutshala kudinga amanzi - izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zidinga izinga elihlukile lamahora, ngakho kufanele sicabangele lokhu ngaphambi kokukhetha isitshalo esithile sokulima. Imvula yemvelo ayivamile ukuvela ngesikhathi esifanele sesitshalo esithile. Ngokuvamile, izindawo eNingizimu Afrika lapho kukhula khona izitshalo zokudla ezomile zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunamanzi anele emhlabathini ngesikhathi esifanele sokutshala ukuze imbewu ikwazi ukuvuthwa kalula nemizi ikwazi ukukhula kahle ekuqaleni. Isikhathi esifanele sokutshala sizobhekelela nezinye izikhathi ezibalulekile lapho isitshalo sikhula (isibonelo: imvula ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwezinsika zembewu kanye naleso sikhathi lapho izimbali ze-pumpkin ziphuma). Ukuze izitshalo ezisele emathafeni zife ngokushesha futhi zandise inani le-'humus' emhlabathini, okwenza izitshalo zithole izakhamzimba. Ingabe zonke izinhlobo zomhlabathi zingagcina amanzi? Yebo, kodwa umhlabathi onoshukela nomhlabathi opholile uzokwenza amanzi amaningi alahleke. Umhlabathi onamathambo aqinile (njengekleyi) ezindaweni ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 m ugcina amanzi kahle uma usetshenziswa. Singasiza kanjani umhlabathi ukuthi wamukele imvula? Umhlabathi ophakeme uphumelelayo, awuqinile, noma kokubili. Kukhona izitshalo eziphuma phezulu komhlabathi. Amanzi agcinwa kanjani emhlabathini? Amanzi agcinwa ezikhala phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi. Izinhlobo zomhlabathi ziyahluka: kukhona usawoti, i-silt, ne-clay. Inani lamahora angagcinwa kulezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi lihluka futhi. Lezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi ngokuvamile zingagcina ama-25 mm wamazinga emanzini emhlabathini ongu-150 mm. (Emhlabathini lapho imizi ingafinyelela ku-1 m, ama-180 mm emvula angagcinwa). Yini edala ukuthi amanzi alahleke emhlabathini? Ukukhanya kwelanga. Umhlabathi uyashisa futhi amanzi ayaphuma. Ukukhuphuka kwe-capillary emhlabathini. Amanzi ahamba phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, akhuphuka, futhi aphume emoyeni. Izihlahla eziyizihlahla ezikhula nezinye izitshalo ezifana nograsi - amanzi alahleka ezithelweni (lokhu kuyimbangela enkulu yokulahleka kwamanzi). Yini esingayenza ukuze sigcine amanzi kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula ingangena emhlabathini. Uma kukhona ungqimba oluqinile phezulu, amanzi awakwazi ukungena, bese amanzi eqala ukuhamba kude futhi awakwazi ukungena phansi. Zama ukushiya izinsalela eziningi zezitshalo zonyaka odlule ukuze imvula ingagibeli emhlabathini kakhulu, ngaleyo ndlela ivimbela ukwakheka kwegatsha eliqinile. Khumbula njalo ukuthi ukuphuma kwezinsalela kudinga isikhathi, futhi umanyolo onothile ngenitrogen uzodingeka ngoba izinsalela eziphumayo azihlinzeki ngenitrogen ngokushesha. Uma imvula inezinga eliphezulu, phula ungqimba oluqinile phezulu komhlabathi. Ungqimba oluqinile luzovimba imvula eyengeziwe ukuthi ingangeni emhlabathini futhi lwenze amanzi aphume, okwenza umhlabathi ube namanzi ngokushesha. Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uhlanzekile futhi ungabi nezihlahla ngemva kokuvuna kuze kube sekufikeni kwesizini entsha yokutshala. Izinsalela zezitshalo phezulu komhlabathi zivimba ukuhamba kwamanzi futhi azikwazi ukuphuma. Ilanga lishisa izinsalela, kodwa ukuhamba kwamanzi akwenzi ngokushesha. Izinsalela zingaba izitshalo ezisele noma zingaba izinsalela ezivela lapho ukulima kwenziwa njalo ngama-mishini. Ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezomile, qinisekisa njalo ukuthi kukhona izinsalela ukuze amanzi agcinwe emhlabathini ophakeme.
Umphakathi uyaziswa ukuthi umongameli uvumile umthetho olandelayo ophumelele ukufakwa ukuze wazise umphakathi wonke ngawo:... Umthetho Wokwenziwa Kwezishado Zendabuko inombolo 120 ka-1998. Izisho eziphakanyisiwe zichaza izichibiyelo kumthetho osekhona. Umbhalo wesiNgisi usayinwe umongameli. Mayelana nokwamukelwa kwezishado zendabuko; Ukucacisa izidingo zokuba nesishado sendabuko esiphilayo; ukuphatha ukubhaliswa kwezishado zendabuko; ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana kwesimo namandla kwabafazi kulezi zishado; ukuphatha ukusulwa kwezishado zendabuko; ukubhekelela ukuhlinzekwa kwemithetho; ukususa ezinye izigaba zemithetho; nokubhekana nezindaba ezihlobene. Kulomthetho, ngaphandle kokuthi incazelo ebhaliwe ihluke... isishado sendabuko sisho isishado esenziwa ngokwezomthetho wesiko. Lobola kusho impahla noma imali eyaziwa ngokuthi lobola, nanoma iyiphi enye igama umlandeli noma umphakathi wekhaya ahlela ukuyinika umndeni wesifazane ngokwezifiso zendabuko. Umqoqi wama-akhawunti kusho noma ubani ophakanyiswe nguNgqongqoshe ukuze abhalise ngenhloso yalomthetho kanye nanoma yimuphi osomabhizinisi osebenza ngaphansi kokuphathwa nguNgqongqoshe. Isishado sendabuko esingenele ngemva kokuqala kwalomthetho ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalo umthetho sikhonjwa njengokuthi isishado sonke. Uma umuntu engumshado emishadweni eminingi yendabuko, zonke izishado ezingenile ngaphambi kokuqala kwalomthetho, futhi ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalo umthetho, zikhonjwa njengokuthi izishado sonke. Ngokusho kwesishado sendabuko esingenele ngaphambi kokuqala kwalomthetho, kubhekwa njengokuphila... Njengokuchazwe esigabeni 10I. Akukho mpahla esishadweni sendabuko ezokwazi ukungena esishadweni ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushada inombolo 25 ka-1961, ngenkathi leso sishado sendabuko sisasebenza. a Uma omunye wabantu engena esishadweni ngenkathi esencane kakhulu, bobabili abazali babo noma uma bengekhona abazali, umgadi wabo wezomthetho kumele avume leso sishado. b Uma ukuvuma kwabazali noma ukuvuma komgadi kungatholakala, isigaba 25 soMthetho Wokushada ka-1961 siyasebenza. Ngaphandle kwesigaba (a), uNgqongqoshe noma noma yimuphi osomabhizinisi ophakathi kwezinsizakalo zoHulumeni ogunyaziwe nguye anganika imvume kumuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ukuba angene esishadweni sendabuko uma uNgqongqoshe noma lowo osomabhizinisi ogunyaziwe ebona ukuthi kubalulekile kulabo abathintekayo. d uma leso sishado sikhona, futhi futhi uthola ukuthi zonke ezinye izindaba ezihlobene naleso sishado ziqhutshelwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalo mthetho, kufanele abhalise ngokofficial njengokuthi isishado sendabuko. Ngemuva kwesigaba, isigaba 24 soMthetho Wokushada ka-1961, sisebenza esishadweni sendabuko somuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ongenele ngaphandle kokuvuma kwabazali noma umgadi. Ukuvinjelwa kwesishado sendabuko phakathi kwabantu ngenxa yokuhlobana kwabo kwegazi kulawulwa ngumthetho wesiko. Ukubhaliswa kwezishado zendabuko. Izingxenye ezingenela isishado sendabuko zinesibopho sokubhalisa isishado sabo. Noma ubani wabashadile angafaka isicelo kumqoqi wama-akhawunti ngendlela esemthethweni ukuze abhalise isishado sabo sendabuko futhi kumele anikeze umqoqi wama-akhawunti ulwazi oludingekayo kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi olungase lufunwe umqoqi wama-akhawunti ukuze akwazi ukuqhubeka nokubhaliswa kwesishado ukuze kube semthethweni. a esingenile ngaphambi kokuthi lo mthetho uqale, futhi engakabhaliswa ngaphansi komunye umthetho, kumele ibhaliswe phakathi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili ngemva kokuthi iqale, noma phakathi nesikhathi eside njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhipha umyalo ngezikhathi ezithile ngokwaziswa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni. (a) Umqoqi wama-akhawunti, uma eqiniseka ukuthi abashadile balandele indlela esemthethweni esishadweni sabo sendabuko, kumele abhalise isishado ngokurekhoda izinombolo zokuhlonza zabashadile, usuku abashade ngalo, lobola ovumelanayo, nezinye imininingwane esemthethweni. b Umqoqi wama-akhawunti kumele anikeze abashadile isitifiketi sokubhaliswa esikhombisa imininingwane esemthethweni. (a) Uma isishado sendabuko singabhaliswa nganoma yisiphi isizathu, noma ubani ongakwazi ukujabulisa umqoqi wama-akhawunti ukuthi unelungelo lokungena kwalesi simo angafaka isicelo ngokubhala kumqoqi wama-akhawunti ngendlela esemthethweni yokuhlola ukuhlala kwesishado. b Uma umqoqi wama-akhawunti eqiniseka ukuthi kukhona noma bekukhona isishado sendabuko phakathi kwalabo bashadile, kufanele abhalise leso sishado futhi anikeze isitifiketi sokubhaliswa njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 4. Uma umqoqi wama-akhawunti engakwenzi kahle ukuthi labo bashadile bangene esishadweni sendabuko esiphilayo, kufanele aphikelele ukubhaliswa kwalolo sishado. Ijezi lingase, uma lithola isicelo esithunyelwe kulo futhi ngemuva kokuhlola, likhiphe umyalo wokuthi... a noma yisiphi isishado sendabuko sibhaliswe; noma b sikhanselwe noma sishintshwe noma iyiphi ukubhaliswa kwesishado sendabuko okwenziwe ngumqoqi wama-akhawunti. Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kwesishado sendabuko esikhishwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba nanoma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophathelene nokubhaliswa kwezishado zendabuko sikhombisa ngokuphelele ukuhlala kwesishado sendabuko kanye nemininingwane equkethwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ukwehluleka ukubhalisa isishado sendabuko akuphazamisi ubuqiniso nobulungiswa balolo sishado. Umqoqi wama-akhawunti angamukela isitifiketi somuntu okukhuluma ngaye ukuthi usencane kakhulu futhi ubunikazi bakhe, isitatimende esifungwayo sokuvuma komzali noma komndeni, nanoma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi umqoqi wama-akhawunti angacela njengobufakazi bokuthi lelo qiniso. Uma ubudala bomuntu okukhuluma ngaye ukuthi usencane kakhulu bungacacile noma buphikiswa, noma ubudala balo muntu buhambisana nezidingo zomthetho, umqoqi wama-akhawunti angadlulisa lesi simo kwiNkantolo yeMagistrate esunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkantolo zeMagistrate inombolo 32 ka-1944, okumele ibone ubudala balo muntu futhi ikhiphe isitifiketi mayelana nalokhu esizoba ubufakazi bobudala balo muntu. Mayelana nokufana esishadweni sendabuko, kuye ngokuthi izinhlelo eziphathelene nempahla zimi kanjani kulolo sishado, umkakhe unendawo efanayo namalungelo nomyeni wakhe kuhlanganisa nelungelo lokwamukela nokuphatha impahla, ukungena ezivumelwaneni, nanoma yimiphi eminye amalungelo akhona esishadweni sendabuko. Amaholide AseNingizimu Afrika: Ukubaluleka Nokuphikisana Emazweni amaningi, amaholide ayisikhathi sokuphumula, sokuzijabulisa, nokuhlanganyela nezothando. E-Ningizimu Afrika, amaholide ahluke kakhulu, ahlanganisa izinsuku ezibalulekile zomlando, amasiko, nezinkolelo. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngama-holide aseNingizimu Afrika, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi akuwona wonke amaholide ahlangabezana nezidingo nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela engxoxweni ethokozisayo mayelana nokubaluleka kwama-holide, izinzuzo zawo, kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nawo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amaholide ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezahlukene: amaholide omphakathi, amaholide ezinkolo, kanye nama-holide omhlaba. Amaholide omphakathi afana ne-Youth Day, i-Human Rights Day, kanye ne-Freedom Day. Lezi zinsuku zikhumbuza abantu ngempilo yabo, izifiso zabo, kanye nezifundo ezithathwe emlandweni. Ukukhumbula lezi zinsuku kubalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle izimpilo zethu namuhla, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile kwezinto ezakha isizwe sethu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amaholide ezinkolo, njenge-Christmas ne-Ramadan, anika abantu ithuba lokuhlanganyela ezinkolelweni zabo, futhi ahlale eqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni nabangani. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhloniphana, uthando, nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, lapho kube khona ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinkolo, futhi amaholide anikeza ithuba lokuhlangana nokwabelana ngezinkolelo ezahlukene. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amaholide awanikezi kuphela ithuba lokuphumula, kodwa futhi angaholela ezinkingeni ezithile. Isibonelo, amaholide amaningi awavumelani nezidingo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngama-holide akhokhelwayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke ngenxa yokuphuma kwemali, njengoba abantu bahlala bephoqeleka ukuba baye ezindaweni zokungcebeleka, izindawo zokudla, noma emikhosini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezindleko zokuhamba, ezokudla, nezokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abampofu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaholide angaholela ekwandeni kokungcola. Izindawo ezivakashelwa kakhulu, njengezindawo zokungcebeleka, ziba nempilo engcono, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokungcola nemfucumfucu. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukugcina izindawo zihlanzekile, futhi kungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlupheke ezinkingeni zezempilo ngenxa yokungcola. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukuthi amaholide awavumelani nezidingo zokugcina imvelo, futhi kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile ukuze sikwazi ukujabulela amaholide ngaphandle kokubangela umonakalo emvelweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaholide aseNingizimu Afrika akhombisa izici ezithile ezidinga ukucubungula. Uhlanga lwesiko, njengemikhosi yamasiko, luhlangana nezinye izinkolelo ezahlukene, okwenza kube nzima ukujwayela amaholide. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale bephokophele ekwakheni umoya wokuhloniphana phakathi kwezinkolo nezamasiko. Uma sikhuluma ngama-holide, kufanele siqonde ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukuhlonipha izinkolelo zabanye, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile futhi ukukhumbula ukuthi amaholide angaba nethonya elihle emiphakathini. Amasiko ahlukahlukene, lapho abantu behlangana khona, akha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, othando, nokuhloniphana. Amaholide angaba yithuba lokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona, behlanganyela, futhi bekwazisa imvelaphi yabo. Ekugcineni, amaholide aseNingizimu Afrika ayisikhathi esibalulekile sokuphumula, sokuhlanganyela, nokukhumbula. Nokho, kudinga ukuba siqonde izinkinga ezihambisana nawo, ukuze sikwazi ukujabulela amaholide ngendlela efanele. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube nesibopho sokuhlonipha izinkolelo nezamasiko ahlukene, kodwa futhi uqaphele izinkinga ezihambisana nama-holide. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi amaholide ahlala ebhekelela izidingo zomphakathi, futhi aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu.
Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi (GEMS business use restrictions) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS, noma i-General Enterprise Management System, iyinsiza ebhekene nokuphathwa kwezinsiza, ukulawula izinqubo, kanye nokwenza kahle kwezohwebo. Isebenza njengepulatifomu yokwenza lula izinqubo zebhizinisi, iqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ye-GEMS ibandakanya izinqubo ezithile ezithinta indlela imikhiqizo nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungavunyelwa kokusebenzisa i-GEMS ngezinto ezingekho emthethweni, ukulawula ukusebenzisa amakhono anjalo emisebenzini eyingozi, kanye nokugwema izinqubo ezingahambisani nemigomo yokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Umbuzo 3: Kungani imikhawulo ibalulekile? Impendulo: Imikhawulo ibalulekile ngoba iqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lisebenza ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ebekiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuphatha izinsiza, ukunciphisa ubungozi, nokugcina ukuqina kwezimali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi liyakwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinkinga ezingavela uma imikhawulo ingalandelwa? Impendulo: Uma imikhawulo ingalandelwa, ibhizinisi lingabhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu, okubandakanya ukujula kwemali, ukulahlekelwa yizinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni ibhizinisi liphumele ekutheni likhuphuke kancane, futhi kungashintsha isithombe salo emakethe. Umbuzo 5: Uphi umthombo wokwazi ngezikhawulelo? Impendulo: Umthombo wokwazi ngezikhawulelo ungatholakala kwi-website esemthethweni ye-GEMS, ezincwadini zokuphatha, noma ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha. Ukuze uqonde kahle imikhawulo, kubalulekile ukufunda nokuhlola lezi zinsiza. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona izinzuzo zokulandela imikhawulo? Impendulo: Impela! Ukulandela imikhawulo kuza nezinhlelo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunciphisa ubungozi, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokusebenza, nokwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwezakhamuzi, abathengi, kanye nabanye ozakwethu. Lokhu kuthuthukisa isithombe sebhizinisi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi liyakwazi ukufinyelela izinjongo zalo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyicabangele uma uhlela ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle izidingo zomthetho kanye nezimfuneko ze-GEMS. Qiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu osebenza ebhizinisini uyazi ngemikhawulo futhi unokuqonda okuhle kwezingozi ezihambisana nokungahambisani nemikhawulo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuvamile nokuhlinzweni kwezinsiza zidinga ukufakwa ezinhlelweni zansuku zonke. Umbuzo 8: Kungani kunzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo? Impendulo: Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuhlelwa kahle, kanye nokugqugquzela izinguquko. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezinzima zokusebenza kungaba inselele, kodwa uma ibhizinisi linokuhleleka okuhle, kuzoba lula ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo. Umbuzo 9: Yini engaholela ekutheni izinkampani zingalandeli imikhawulo? Impendulo: Izinkampani zingase zingalandeli imikhawulo ngenxa yokungazi kahle, ukungabi nesineke, noma izinkinga zokuphatha. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokuncintisana kungaholela ekwehlulekeni ukuhamba kahle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuhlola nokulawula izinqubo zansuku zonke. Umbuzo 10: Kukhona yini iziphakamiso zokwandisa ukuqonda ngemikhawulo ye-GEMS? Impendulo: Yebo, iziphakamiso zokwandisa ukuqonda zifaka phakathi ukuhlela izifundo, ukwenza izivivinyo zokusebenza, kanye nokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni ye-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zingaxhumana nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ukuze bathole izeluleko ezithile nezixazululo ezihambisana nemikhawulo. Ekugcineni, ukuqonda nokulandela imikhawulo ye-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze ibhizinisi likwazi ukusebenza ngempumelelo, ukunciphisa izingozi, nokwakha isithombe esihle emakethe. Kubalulekile ukufunda, ukuqonda, nokwakha inhlangano ekhuthaza ukusungulwa kwemikhawulo ethile ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi ezihambisana nokungalandelwa kwemigomo. Futhi, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu osebenza ebhizinisini abambe iqhaza ekwenzeni ukuthi imikhawulo ihlale ibhekwa futhi iyahlolwa njalo.
Indoda eneminyaka engama-86 evela eLimpopo, eyayithole i-grant yokuguga eyayimisiwe eminyakeni emithathu edlule ngoba yayisebenzisa inombolo ye-ID efanayo nomunye umuntu eFree State, manje ibukeka ijabule yodwa njengoba ibheka ehhovisi, ngenxa yokungenelela kweMphakathi Ovikela. I-grant yanyanga zikaNkk. Nyasedza Sophia Mphephu ophuma emzaneni waseThononda eVenda yayimisiwe yi-South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) ngoMfumfu 2005 ngaphandle kokunikeza incazelo. Ubephuma ehhovisi cishe eminyakeni emithathu, njalo ebuyela ekhaya engenalutho. Nokho, isimo sathuthuka ngemuva kokungenelela kukaMphakathi Ovikela njengoba i-grant yokuphila kaNkk. Mphephu yabuyiselwa. Uthole izinkokhelo zeminyaka emithathu edlule, futhi uMphakathi Ovikela waqhubeka nokumelulela ukuba akhokhelwe inzalo ezinkokhelweni ezisemva. UNkk. Mphephu uphinde wathola i-grant eyayiqhubeka izinyanga ezintathu ngenkathi i-SASSA ixazulula udaba lwakhe. Isimo sakhe sathola ukunakwa kweHhovisi leMphakathi Ovikela (OPP) ngoMeyi 2009 ngemuva kokuthi iphephandaba lendawo eLimpopo, iCapricorn Voice, lishicilele indaba yakhe. I-OPP yashesha yangenelela futhi yaqala uphenyo ngalolu daba. Uphenyo lwathola ukuthi ukuziphatha kwe-SASSA akuhambisani nezidingo njengoba bekungekho sizathu sokumiswa kwe-grant yakhe njengomamukeli. Kuphinde kwatholakala ukuthi akuphumelelanga ukunikwa ezinye izindlela zokuziphilisa yena nomndeni wakhe ngenkathi i-grant yakhe imisiwe. Ngemuva kokutholakala kwephenyo, uMphakathi Ovikela wabhala kumphathi ophezulu we-SASSA, ephakamisa ukuthi i-grant yokuphila kaNkk. Mphephu ibuyiselwe futhi akhokhelwe izinkokhelo zeminyaka emithathu ezisemva kanye nezinsalo. "Umphathi wesifunda we-SASSA eLimpopo kufanele aqashe ithimba lokusebenza, njengoba kuthethiswa, ukuze lihlolisise ukumiswa kwezi-grant ngenxa yokusetshenziswa kwezibalo ze-ID ezifanayo ngabantu abaningi ngokushesha," kusho uMphakathi Ovikela. Uphinde waphakamisa ukuthi i-SASSA inikeze abamukeli abanezi-grant ezimisiwe amaphakheji okudla ngenkathi uphenyo lwenziwa ukuze ibasize baphile ngenkathi iSocial Security Agency ixazulula udaba oluholele ekumweni kwe-grant. U-Mphakathi Ovikela uphinde waphakamisa ukuthi i-SASSA ithole izindlela zokuphothula uphenyo lwayo phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu ngemuva kokumiswa kwe-grant.
Kubhalwe kahle ukukhokha izindleko zakho zikagesi. Ukwenza njalo kuqinisekisa ukuthi awuphuthumi. Njengoba kuvamile, amakhasimende akhokha ingxenye yebhili elibhalwe ukuthi kufanele likhokhe ngoba acabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzovimbela ugesi wabo ekusikeni. Uma ingxenye oyiphuthumayo ingakhokhwa ngenyanga ezayo, umthwalo wakho uzokhula kakhulu futhi ungase ungakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Qaphela ukuthi ukukhokha njalo kuphela izingxenye zenani okufanele ukhokhe kungaholela ekusikeni kukagesi wakho. Uma ubona ukuthi uphuthumile kakhulu emthwalweni wakho, xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuze uxoxe ngendlela yokulungisa isimo. Kuzokwenziwa izintshisakalo kulokho okukhokhwayo uma umthengi engakhokhi ngokuphelele noma ekhokha ngezindleko ezincane noma ekhokha ngemva kosuku lokugcina. Lesi simo sokungakhokhi kahle kuholela ekwandeni kwenani elikhokhwayo njalo ngenyanga. Uma usayine isivumelwano sokukhokha nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi, gcina leso sivumelwano. Uma wehluleka, ugesi wakho uzosikwe. Kodwa uma isimo sakho siba sibi kakhulu ngemuva kokusayina isivumelwano, kufanele uqinisekise umhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ngokushesha. Ungase udinge ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi besimo sakho esishintshile. Uma unemitha yokukhokha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, qaphela ngenani likagesi olisebenzisayo. Kuwo wonke umbhalo, kufanele kube nenani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga kanye nenani lokuvala ekupheleni kwenyanga. Lokhu kukunika ithuba lokwazi inani eliphelele olisebenzisile le nyanga. Kufanele uhlole ukuthi inani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga lihambisana nenani lokuvala elivela enyangeni edlule. Uma lezi zilinganiso zingahambisani, funa ukucaciselwa kumhlinzeki wakho kukagesi. Ngezinye izikhathi, labo abafunda imitha kagesi benza amaphutha. Qaphela ngenani lenyanga ngayinye. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umhlinzeki wakho kukagesi kufanele akukhokhise malini ngeyunithi (Kwh) yegesi oyisebenzisayo. Uma ungazi, kufanele ubuze umhlinzeki wakho kukagesi noma iNational Energy Regulator. Ukuze uqonde ukuthi ubhajwe kanjani le nyanga, udinga ukuthatha inani eliphelele okufanele ukhokhe (ngemali) bese ulibala ngenani likagesi olisebenzisile le nyanga. Umphumela uzoba yintengo ngeyunithi (I-unit). Uma unenketho yokukhetha, ungashintsha uhlelo olusebenzisa ikhadi lapho uthenga khona inani elithile likagesi. Khumbula ukuthi uzokhokhwa imali yokusetha leli hlelo. Intengo yalezi zinguquko iyahluka ngenani likagesi elisetshenzisiwe. Ulwazi lokulawula inani likagesi elisetshenzisiwe. Uma umthwalo wakho uphuthumile, ungase udinge ukukhokha le ngxenye ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokushintsha kuhlelo lwekhadi. Izinzuzo zalesi sitembu esichazwe ngenhla zikhuluma kakhulu kunobunzima bokuqala obumele ubhekane nabo ngaphambi kokushintsha (njengemali yokuqala okufanele uyikhokhe). Thola kumhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuthi yiziphi izimo nemigomo abahamba ngayo. Ngokuvamile, abanye abahlinzeki bakagesi badinga amakhasimende ukuthi asayine isivumelwano sokukhokha umthwalo wabo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngokucophelela kuzokusiza unciphise ukusetshenziswa kwakho nezindleko zanyanga. Ungakwenza kanjani lokhu? Izitofu, izifudumezi zamanzi (gizmos), kanye nezifudumezi (radiators) yizona ezisebenzisa ugesi kakhulu futhi zandisa ibhili lakho likagesi. Uma unesi fudumezi samanzi, qiniseka ukuthi i-thermostat ayibekwe phezulu. Ungabeka i-thermostat cishe kuma-60 degrees. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuze uthole izeluleko ngalokhu. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi esifudumezini samanzi: uma unamandla, unganciphisa izinga likagesi eliya esifudumezini samanzi, futhi lokhu kungaphinde kwenziwe emaphuzini aphatha amanzi. Le ndlela inciphisa kakhulu izindleko zikagesi kodwa ifika nemali ethile uma ufuna ukuyisebenzisa. Isitofu: qiniseka ukuthi awuvuli zonke izitofu ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izeluleko zithi unciphise ukushisa ephepheni uma ipani lakho liqala ukuvutha. Ungasebenzisi i-oveni njengendlela yokufudumeza ngoba i-oveni isebenzisa ugesi omningi. Izifudumezi: izifudumezi zikagesi zisebenzisa ugesi omningi. Uma unesi fudumezi sikagesi, kunconywa ukuthi uvule kuphela isifudumezi esisodwa. Kodwa uzokuqonda ukuthi lokhu kuzokwandisa isikhathi ngaphambi kokuthi indlu yakho ifudumale. Ukuvala amawindi: enye indlela yokunciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa ukuvala amawindi endlini yakho. Ukukhanyisa: ilambu elivaliwe elinengilazi linikeza ukukhanya okuningi ngenkathi lisebenzisa ugesi omncane. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi. Yini umthetho okukhuluma ngayo mayelana nokusikwe kukagesi? Umthetho ohlaziywe weMithetho Yezokukhanyisa ka-1987 unikeza umhlinzeki kukagesi igunya lokusika uma ibhili ingakhokhiwe noma uma umthengi engahambisani nezimo zokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Nokho, umthetho ufuneka ukuthi umhlinzeki kukagesi unikeze umthengi isaziso sezinsuku eziyi-14 ngaphambi kokusika ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Le nkathi iqala ngosuku olubhalwe encwadini. Isaziso embhalweni wanyanga nanyanga siphinde samukelwe. Amakhasimende acelwa ukuba ahlole umbhalo embhalweni. Khumbula ukuthi umuntu wokuqala okufanele ukhalaze kuye umhlinzeki wakho wendawo. Umthengi unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo mayelana nezinga lenkonzo elinikezwa umhlinzeki wendawo. Umhlinzeki wendawo unecala lokulalela nokubhekana nesikhalazo. Uma wena njengomthengi unganelisekile ngemiphumela noma ngendlela isikhalazo sakho esiphathwe ngayo, udaba lungathunyelwa kwiNational Energy Regulator (NER) ukuze lutholakale isixazululo.
Izibuyekezo ze-Integrated Resource Plan kanye nemiphumela yazo Isingeniso Uhlelo lwe-Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) luyisisekelo esibalulekile sokuphatha izinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuhlela, ukuphatha, nokuphucula izinsiza zamandla ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi, kuncishiswe umthelela emvelweni, futhi kuthuthukiswe umnotho. Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zenzeka njalo ukuze kuhlolwe izidingo ezishintshashintshayo nezinguquko ezidingekayo. Izizathu zokubuyekeza i-IRP Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zidingeka ngenxa yezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinguquko kwezobuchwepheshe, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Isibonelo, ukukhula kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, njengamandla elanga namandla omoya, kudinga ukuba i-IRP ibuyekezwe ukuze ibheke lezi zinguquko. Izinqubomgomo ezihlose ukunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngohlelo oluhambisana nalezi zifiso. Ukuze i-IRP ibe yimpumelelo, kufanele ibhekelele izinguquko ezimnandi zomnotho, kuhlanganise nezindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Izibuyekezo ezinkulu ze-IRP Ezinyangeni ezedlule, izibuyekezo ezinkulu ze-IRP zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezivuselelekayo, ukunciphisa ukuthembela emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, nokwandisa amandla okugcina. Ukukhula kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokwakha, kuveze izidingo ezintsha zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kuholela ekubuyekezweni kwemigomo ye-IRP ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, njengamandla elanga namandla omoya, kunikeza izinzuzo ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni i-IRP. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza amandla avuselelekayo, okunciphisa ukuthembela emithonjeni engavuselelekayo, futhi kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa abahlinzeki bamandla avuselelekayo. Ukunciphisa umthelela emvelweni Ukukhathazeka ngokuphila komphakathi kanye nomthelela emvelweni kuholele ekubuyekezweni kwemigomo ye-IRP ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon. Lokhu kubandakanya ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha angavuselelekayo, okukhuthaza ukwandiswa kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo. Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokunciphisa umthelela emvelweni. Izimo zomnotho Izimo zomnotho eNingizimu Afrika zidinga ukuba i-IRP ibuyekezwe njalo ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta umnotho. Lokhu kubandakanya izinguquko ezithinta izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, izinga lokukhula komnotho, nezimo zezokuthutha. Imithelela yezibuyekezo ze-IRP Izibuyekezo ze-IRP zinezinto eziningi ezithinta umphakathi, umnotho, kanye nemvelo. Ukukhuliswa kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okuthuthukisa umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukunciphisa umthelela emvelweni kuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Isiphetho Izibuyekezo ze-Integrated Resource Plan zibalulekile ekwakheni nasekuqondiseni izinsiza zamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, impilo yomphakathi, kanye nemvelo. Ukuze i-IRP ibe yimpumelelo, kufanele ibhekelele izinguquko ezidingekayo, okuhlanganisa ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, ukunciphisa umthelela emvelweni, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Ukubuyekezwa kwe-IRP kufanele kube yinqubo eqhubekayo, eqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zamandla zihlala zikhona, zisebenza kahle, futhi zisebenza ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi.
Uma uthola imali yokusiza kuhulumeni engafanele ukuba uyithole, uzobhekana nesibopho sokuyibuyisela kuhulumeni ngaphandle kokuthi uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ube satisfied ukuthi awuzange wazi ukuthi bekungekho emthethweni ukuyithola. Kulokhu, imali yokusiza kuhulumeni kufanele ibhujiswe noma iphazanyiswe, njengoba izobhekwa njengohlelo lokukhwabanisa ukuze uthole inzuzo yomuntu siqu. Le nsizakalo ibhekelelwe abantu abathola izinxephezelo ezingafanele. Abantu abathola izinxephezelo ezingafanele bazothola sebephakathi kwalesi simo. Uma imali yokusiza ingafunwa ezinyangeni ezintathu ezilandelanayo. Uma umuntu engasekho eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Uma uthola ukuthi uthole imali yokusiza kuhulumeni engafanele ukuba uyithole, kufanele wazise ihhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Lo mnyango uzokhansela inani owedlula lona uma bejabulile ukuthi awuzange wazi ukuthi bekungekho emthethweni ukuyithola le mali. UMsunguli-Jikelele woMnyango angase, ngokuthanda kwakhe, afune ukubuyiselwa kwemali ngokusebenzisa izinqubo zomthetho kulowo muntu. UMsunguli-Jikelele woMnyango angavuma ukuqhubeka kokukhokhwa kwemali isikhathi esithile, kulandela izimo ezithile ezibekwe ngumuntu ofuna ukuqhubeka ethola le mali yokusiza. Isicelo kufanele senziwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 ngemuva kokuphazanyiswa kwemali yokusiza kuhulumeni. Uma umuntu efuna ukubuyekeza udaba lokuphazanyiswa kwemali yokusiza kuhulumeni, kufanele aveze imali yakhe ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kuzoba yisisekelo esizosebenza uMnyango uma enza isinqumo sokuthi ubuyekeze isimo sakho noma cha. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngemiphumela yesicelo phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyekezwa noma ngosuku lapho kukhishwa khona isitifiketi. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhelwa futhi ayihlawulwanga. Amafomu atholakala ehhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika.
Amabhizinisi Amancane: Umqondo, Izimfanelo Nezindlela Zokuphumelela Amabhizinisi amancane ayingxenye ebalulekile yomnotho wanamuhla. Amaqhinga abo, izimfanelo, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela zihlala zikhuluma ngempumelelo emiphakathini ehlukene. Ukuze siqonde kahle amabhizinisi amancane, kubalulekile ukuba siqale ngokuqonda umqondo wabo. Umqondo Wamabhizinisi Amancane Amabhizinisi amancane, ngokuvamile, abhekisela ezinkampanini ezincane ezisebenza ngezinsiza ezilinganiselwe, imithombo, kanye nezisebenzi. Lokhu kubandakanya izitolo ezincane, izinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanye nezimboni ezincane. Ngokuvamile, amabhizinisi amancane ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo noma imikhiqizo ethile, enza kube lula kubantu bendawo ukufinyelela kulokhu abakudingayo. Izimfanelo Zamabhizinisi Amancane Okokuqala, amabhizinisi amancane ahlukaniswa ngezici ezithile. Zivame ukuba nezinga eliphansi lokuphathwa, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinqumo ngokushesha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi angakwazi ukusabela ngokushesha ezimfudlaneni zemakethe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhizinisi amancane avame ukuba nekhono lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile namakhasimende, njengoba umphakathi uvame ukuxhumana nabaphathi bawo. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi amancane avame ukuba nezindleko eziphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkampani ezinkulu. Lokhu kunciphisa ingozi yokulahlekelwa kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkampani ezinkulu, ezivame ukuba nezinselelo ezinzima uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bahlale bephila, futhi bahlale bephendula izidingo zemakethe. Izindlela Zokuphumelela Ukuze amabhizinisi amancane aphumelele, kudingeka izindlela ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo ocacile. Lokhu kusho ukuba necebo eliqinile lokuthi umkhiqizo noma insizakalo izokwenziwa kanjani, kanye nezithiyo ezihlukene ezibhekene nalo msebenzi. Umqondo ocacile usiza abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuthi bahlale begxile futhi benze izinqumo eziphusile. Okwesibili, amabhizinisi amancane adinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nokwakha umuzwa omuhle kumakhasimende. Ubudlelwano obuqinile namakhasimende bungaholela ekutheni abantu babuyele futhi baphinde bathenge, okwandisa inzuzo yebhizinisi. Okwesithathu, ubuchwepheshe bukhona njengomngani omkhulu kumabhizinisi amancane. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokumaketha ku-inthanethi, kungasiza amabhizinisi ukuthi afinyelele emakethe enkulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele bahlale befundisa futhi bejwayela izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Izithiyo Ezingase Zibhekane Nezinhlelo Zokuphumelela Noma kunjalo, amabhizinisi amancane abhekene nezithiyo eziningi. Enye yezithiyo ezinkulu ukuhweba nezinkampani ezinkulu. Lezi zinkampani zinezinsiza eziningi, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi amancane ukuba ancintisane ngempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nalwazi noma izinsiza ezanele zokuphatha ibhizinisi kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali. Kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi bazi izithiyo ezikhona futhi bazame ukuhlela izindlela zokuzigwema. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda ngezindlela zokuphatha ibhizinisi, ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokuqeqesha, noma ukuthola izeluleko kochwepheshe. Isiphetho Amabhizinisi amancane ayingxenye ebalulekile yomnotho, anikeza amathuba amaningi emisebenzi, ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, futhi akha umphakathi oqinile. Ukuze aphumelele, kudingeka ukuba abanikazi bawo babe nomqondo ocacile, bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende, futhi basebenzise ubuchwepheshe. Noma izithiyo zingase zibe khona, ubuchwepheshe, ulwazi, nokuzimisela kungasiza amabhizinisi amancane ukuba aphumelele, aqhubeke nokukhula, futhi akhuthaze umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze sikhulise amabhizinisi amancane, ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu.
Izilimi Nezinguqulo: Ukuhlola Zokuhumusha Nokuqonda Ezizindeni zomhlaba, izilimi zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Zisiza ukuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokuhumusha imicabango nemizwa yethu. Ubukhona bezilimi ezingaphezu kwekhulu emhlabeni kuchaza ububanzi bemicabango ehlukahlukene, izinkolelo, namasiko. Kodwa, kulapho-ke izinto ziqala khona ukuba inzima, njengoba ukuguqula ulwimi kube ingxenye ebalulekile yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezehlukene. Uhlelo lwezinguqulo luhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokuhumusha—kusuka kokulula njengokuhumusha amagama noma izisho, kuya kokusebenzisanayo okufana nezincwadi, izinkulumo, noma evenini. Noma ngabe umhumushi ngumuntu noma uhlelo, ukuphumelela kokuhumusha kuncike ekwakheni ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezilimi ezihilelekile. Ukungaqondi kahle intokozo yomhumushi kungaholela ekuqondeni okungalungile, okuyingozi emiphumeleni. Ukuhumusha kusemqoka emikhakheni eminingi, njengemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezomthetho. Ezikhathini ezinzima, ukuhumusha okuhle kungenza umehluko phakathi kokuphumelela nokwehluleka. Ukuhumusha engxenyeni yezempilo, isibonelo, kudinga ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiyalo iyafundwa kahle futhi iqondakalayo. Umphumela wokuhumusha ongenalwazi ungaholela ekuphumelelweni okuhle, okuphathelene nezimpilo zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula indlela esihumusha ngayo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, ezinjenge-Google Translate, ziye zaba lula ukuthola izinguqulo ezisheshayo. Nokho, akumele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinhlelo azikabi nemiphumela efanele ngesikhathi somqondo. Ukuthola ukuqonda okujulile kwezimiso zomdabu kungavela kuphela komuntu onolwazi nolwazi lwamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba ubuchwepheshe bungathuthukisa ukuphepha kokuhumusha, umuntu usengumgibeli omkhulu kulokhu. Izilimi zihlala zishintsha njalo. Amaphutha, izinto ezintsha ezitholakala kumphefumulo womuntu, nezinguquko eziphakathi kwemiphakathi zinomthelela omkhulu kulokho okukhulunywa. Lokhu kukwenza kusemqoka ukuthi sihlale silungisa izinguqulo zethu ukuze zihlale zifanele izimo. Ukuze uhlu lwezifiso lungalungi, ukuhumusha akumele kube nje ukukhiqiza umphumela osebenzayo, kodwa futhi kufanele kuhloniphe ubukhulu obukhulu bemvelaphi yesizinda, imishwana, nemibono. Ubhubhane, iziyaluyalu zezinhlanga zezilimi nezinguqulo zibhaliwe ezithakazelo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Zihlala ziqhubeka nezihloko ezinzima futhi eziyinqaba, okwenza kudingeke ukuthi sibe namakhono amasha kokuhumusha. Ukuqonda izilimi akusikhumbuzi nje ngenqubo yokuhumusha, kodwa futhi kubonisa ukuthi imibono eyisisekelo iphetha kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukucwaningwa okujulile kuzo zombili izingxenye—lemikhakha yesayensi yokuhumusha nezehfuzo—ukuze uhlale uyazisa lokhu kukhula. Izinxushunxushu zezilimi ezisemanzini zikhombisa ubukhona bethu njengoMhlaba. Ukuhumusha akusiyi nje ukuhamba ukusuka kolunye ulwimi kuye kolunye; kuwumsebenzi owenza imbangi yezizwe, uhlu lwezizwe, nolwabiwo lwezincwadi. Akupheli, kumiselwe ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlanga, ubuwangelanga udaba lwangempela, kuphinde kesha uhambisane nemigomo eyisibonelo yokuxhumana kwangempela. Lokhu kudala umhlaba lapho imiqondo eyinqaba ibonakala, kanti izilimi zenzeka njengomlilo phakathi kwezimo. Ngokuphetha, uma sibheka izilimi nezinguqulo, sizithola sigcinwe emsebenzini omkhulu wokukhanya kwemibono ehlukene. Lezi zinto zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukuhlalisana kwabantu, okuhlangene endaweni yokufunda, kwazulu ezempilo, nakweminye imikhakha. Ukuhumusha akuyona nje umphumela, kodwa impilo yezilimi ezifunayo ukusizana, ukuze sikwazi ukukhuluma, sihuthumise ubudlelwano, sikwazi ukufeza izinhloso ezivamile phakathi kwezizwe ezithokozisayo. Kanjalo, ukuhumusha akufuni ukubhekisisa nje ulwimi; kuwukubamba izinsuku, izithombe, nemicabango ezihlukahlukene, ehlukanisa ‘thina’ nathi.
Awukwazi ukuvuka ekuseni uthi, 'Namuhla ngifuna ukuqala ukutshala ukudla.' Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngokwezimali kudinga ucwaningo oluningi ngaphambi kokwenza lokho. Yimuphi umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwutshala kulo nyaka? Kukhona izinto ezithile okufanele uzicabangele ngaphambi kokuphendula le mibuzo. Isikhathi esifanele singafika. Inani lokuna okungatholakala. Izinga le-pH nokushisa komhlabathi. Ukutholakala kwemali yokuqala yokukhiqiza. Uzothola kuphi le mali? Khumbula ukuthi lokhu kuyibhizinisi labantu abanikela ngemali; bafuna ukwenza inzuzo. Benza inzuzo kulokho okutholayo. Akekho ofuna ukulahlekelwa yimali, ngakho umbolekisi ufisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola imali yakhe. Uzothola nini imali? Lokhu kungase kubonakale njengento encane, kodwa khumbula ukuthi lapho utshala, izinkambu zidinga ukulungiswa isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokutshala. Uma imali ifika sekwedlule isikhathi, izinkambu azikwazi ukulungiswa kahle futhi umthuthukisi angase abhekane nezingozi ekulimaleni? Uzokwenza kanjani ukumaketha umkhiqizo wakho? Uma uthengisa ukudla kuphela kuwe, ukumaketha akuyona inkinga. Kodwa uma uqala ukutshala ukudla okuzothengiswa, kudingeka ucabangele ukumaketha. Ubani ozothenga ukudla kwakho? Uzakuthola kanjani ukudla emakethe? Ubani ozohambisa ukudla? Ubani ozophatha izinhlelo? Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kufanele kwenzeke ngesikhathi esifanele. Yini le msebenzi yokulima efuna ukuyifeza? Uzokwenza nini? Yiziphi izinsiza ozosebenzisa? Uzolima kangakanani? Ingabe ithrekhtha yakho inamandla anele? Ingabe izinsiza zakho zisebenza kahle futhi zikwazi ukwenza le msebenzi? Yini le msebenzi yokulima efuna ukuyifeza? Uzokwenza nini? Yiziphi izinsiza ozosebenzisa? Ingabe izinsiza zakho zisebenza kahle futhi zikwazi ukwenza le msebenzi? Uzothenga kuphi imbewu yakho? Ubani ozokweluleka ngokuqhuba imbewu efanele? Ucabangele isikhathi esithathwa umkhiqizo othile ukuze ukhule ufinyelele ekupheleni? Zingaki izitshalo ezitshaliwe ngehektare? Uthathe amasampula omhlabathi? Uthole imiphumela yokuhlola umhlabathi? Uthole iziphakamiso mayelana ne-fertilizer efanele endaweni ethile nomkhiqizo? Ingabe isiphakamiso se-fertilizer sikhona ngokuhambisana nosayizi womkhiqizo ofuna ukuwuvuna? Yisiphi isithako se-fertilizer ozosisebenzisa? Zingaki amakhilogram ozowafaka ngehektare? Inqubo yokutshala ibaluleke kakhulu kunazo zonke uma ulima. Isitshalo singalinganiswa ukuze sisebenze kahle. Unama-plates, ama-gears, kanye nezinsiza zokuphalaza ezifanele? Yisiphi ububanzi bezigaba ozikhethayo? Kungani ukhethe le banga? Uma uzolima ngemva kokukhula kwezitshalo, uyazi yini ukuthi umphakeli wakho angasebenza kulowo banga? Zingaki izitshalo ozidingayo? Uyaqonda ukuthi zingaki izithako okufanele uzifake? Ungalinganisa isitshalo noma udinga usizo? Uyaqonda kanjani ukuphatha izihlahla ezisemqoka? Ingabe umphakeli ufanele ububanzi bezigaba? Ingabe ama-tines omphakeli alinganisiwe kahle? Unemishini yokuphalaza? Ingabe zonke izingxenye zemishini zisasebenza kahle? Ubani ozokwenza ukulinganisa kwemishini yokuphalaza? Yiziphi amakhemikhali ozowasebenzisa? Uyaqonda ukuthi mangaki amakhemikhali athile azofakwa? Kwenziwa kuphi esigabeni sokukhula kwesitshalo ukufaka amakhemikhali? Ingabe umhlabathi umanzi ngokwanele ukuze imbewu ikhulule? Uzolima kangakanani imbewu? Ucabangele inani elifanele lemibewu ngomjikelezo? Ufaka yini i-fertilizer kumakhilogram afanele ngehektare? Ufakile yini amakhemikhali abulala izilokazane nezihlahla? Ngemva kokuphothula ukutshala, ingabe isitshalo sihlanzekile futhi sikhona kahle? Ngemva kokuphalaza amakhemikhali, ingabe imishini ihlanzekile futhi ibekwe kahle? Yisiphi uhlobo lwe-fertilizer yokuphezulu ozoyifaka? Nini kufanele ifakwe? Uzofaka malini i-fertilizer? Uma ufuna ukuba umthuthukisi wezomnotho, kufanele usebenze ngokuzikhandla nangokuhlakanipha! Udinga ukuthuthukisa amasu ngokuqhubekayo futhi wenze le msebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele.
Izinqubo zokuphatha idatha yocwaningo (GEMS research data protocols) Zidingeka izinqubo ezicacile ukuze kutholwe imiphumela ethile. Lezi zinqubo ziqukethe izinyathelo ezisemqoka okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idatha iqoqwa, igcinwe, futhi ihlaziywa ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo sokuqala: Ukuhlela Uhlelo Locwaningo Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuqoqa idatha, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle uhlelo locwaningo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusungula izinjongo, imikhakha yocwaningo, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola. Kubalulekile ukucacisa izinkinga ozama ukuzixazulula, futhi uqonde kahle ukuthi ubani ozoba neqhaza ocwaningweni. Isinyathelo sesibili: Ukuqoqa Idatha Qinisekisa ukuthi idatha iqoqwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhilela ukusungula izinqubo ezicacile zokuthi idatha izotholakala kanjani. Uma usebenzisa imibuzo, qinisekisa ukuthi ibhalwe kahle ukuze ivumelane nezilaleli zakho. Futhi, uma kusebenza, sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhlola ezisemthethweni ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi idatha iyatholakala futhi isetshenziswe. Isinyathelo sesithathu: Ukugcina Idatha Ngemuva kokuba idatha iqoqwe, kufanele igcinwe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idatha iphephile futhi iyatholakala. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokugcina idatha ezithembekile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izipele ezivela emhlabeni. Qinisekisa ukuthi idatha iyahlolwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuze ubone ukuthi isasebenza. Isinyathelo sesine: Ukuhlaziya Idatha Uma idatha igcinwe kahle, sekuyisikhathi sokuyihlaziya. Sebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlaziya, njengezibalo noma izindlela zokuhlaziywa ezithuthukile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhlale uhambisana nezinhlelo zakho zocwaningo. Noma imiphi imiphumela etholeka kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi ihlaziywe ngendlela efanele ukuze kubonakale kahle izixazululo. Isinyathelo sesihlanu: Ukubika Imiphumela Ngemuva kokuhlaziya, kulandela ukubika imiphumela. Lokhu kuhilela ukubhala imibiko enezincazelo ezicacile nezifundwayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ibhalwe kahle futhi ibonisa izixazululo ezitholakele. Uma kungenzeka, hlanganyela nemiphumela yakho nabanye abantu ukuze uthole impendulo ethokozisayo. Isinyathelo sesithupha: Ukuvuselela Idatha Izinqubo zedatha zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubuyekeza izinqubo zokuhlela, ukuqoqwa, nokuhlaziya. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela izitayela ezintsha nezindlela zokucwaninga. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ucwaningo lwakho luhlale luhamba phambili. Isinyathelo sesixhenxe: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Kwedata Qinisekisa ukuthi idatha yakho iphephile. Lokhu kuhilela izinyathelo zokuvikela idatha, njengokusebenzisa ukufihla, izinhlelo zokuvikela, nezinsiza zokuphathwa kwedatha. Qinisekisa ukuthi abanye abantu abangenayo imvume yokufinyelela kudatha yakho. Isinyathelo sesishiyagalolunye: Ukuhlonza Amaphutha Ngaphezu kokuhlola idatha, kubalulekile ukuhlonza amaphutha. Ungavumeli amaphutha aphumele emiphumeleni yokugcina. Beka isikhumbuzo sokuhlola kabusha idatha yakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uphinde uhlole izindlela ezisetshenziswayo. Isinyathelo seshumi: Ukugcina Ubudlelwano Nomphakathi Kubalulekile ukugcina ubudlelwano nomphakathi. Hlanganisa nemiphakathi yakho, futhi ubonise imiphumela oyitholile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ucwaningo lwakho luthokoziswe, futhi nabanye bazokwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uqonde izidingo zomphakathi, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lwakho luhambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngokulandela lezi zinqubo, ungathola imiphumela ethile futhi uqinisekise ukuthi idatha yakho yocwaningo ibhekwa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza ucwaningo lwakho lube namandla, luhambisane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi luthole imiphumela enembile.
Kunoma ngabe inhlangano enkulu, kungenzeka ukuthi abasebenzi bahlangabezane nezinkinga zomuntu siqu ngezikhathi ezithile, ezingase zibe nomthelela omubi ekusebenzeni kwabo nasekuphumeleleni kwabo jikelele. Le mibuzo ehlelekile ihloselwe ukuhlaziya izidingo zabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezamanzi (DWAF) nokuthola izindlela zokubhekana nalezi zidingo. Le mibuzo ehlelekile iyimfihlo. Ikhethwe ngendlela evulekile futhi engakhethi, njengengxenye yeziqu eziyishumi noma amaphesenti ayishumi wabasebenzi bonke beMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, ePhondweni Elisenyaweni. Awudingi ukufaka igama lakho kulolu hlu lwemibuzo ehlelekile. Inhloso yethu ukuqoqa imibono nemicabango evela esampula yabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, mayelana nezidingo zabo, hhayi ukuthola izinkinga zomuntu siqu. Ucelwa ukuthi ufunde imibuzo ngokucophelela futhi uphinde uphinde umaka ibhokisi elingaphansi kokuphendula okucabanga ukuthi kulungile kuwe. Uxhaswe ukuba uzame ukuphendula zonke imibuzo. Ngiyabonga ngokubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Sithemba ukuthi imiphumela nemiphumela izoba usizo kuwe nakubangani bakho emsebenzini. Uneminyaka emingaki? Ungumfana noma ungowesifazane? Yini isimo sakho somshado? Qaphela: "Ushadile" kufaka phakathi umshado wendabuko, wesonto, kanye nomshado wombuso. Yini ulimi lwakho lwasekhaya? Yini izinga noma ibanga lakho lokusebenza? Sicela umake okukodwa. Ususebenze isikhathi esingakanani eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF? Yini izinga eliphezulu lemfundo olitholile? Uma kunjalo, sicela ubhale igama le nhlangano yokusiza kwezempilo. Okwamanje, uma wena noma ilunga lomndeni ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, ingabe kukhona othile noma usizo phakathi kwalokhu okulandelayo ongakukhombisa lezi zinkinga? Akekho; ngiyaxazulula izinkinga zami. Uthanda ukuya emhlanganweni wokufunda ngezihloko ezilandelayo? Ungamaka ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali noma ukubhajethi, izikweletu, njll. Ukudlulisela emnyangweni omunye, ukulahleka komsebenzi, noma ukuhamba emsebenzini. HIV/AIDS, ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa, njll. Angifuni ukuya kunoma yimuphi walemihlangano. Ucabanga ukuthi kungcono ukuba uthole izeluleko kubasebenzi abangochwepheshe beMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, noma kulabo abaqashwe okwesikhashana, abazimele, futhi basezikhungweni eziseduze nendawo okusebenza kuyo? Abachwepheshe be-DWAF noma beMnyangweni Wezamanzi. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kungathuthukisa impilo yabantu eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, uma bethola izeluleko ngezinkinga zabo ezizoxhaswa yi-DWAF? (Lokhu kubhekisela kuhlobo lwezeluleko olwakhethwe kuMbuzo 12 ngenhla). Yisiphi ulimi noma izilimi ozithanda ukuba zisetshenziswe uma uthola izeluleko (Ungamaka ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo)? Uma uMnyango Wezamanzi, DWAF, ungahlinzeka ngempumelelo ngempumelelo yokuqonda (usebenzisa uhlobo lwezeluleko olwakhethwe), ubani ofuna ukuyisebenzisa le nsizakalo? Amalunga omndeni wakho. Angizukuyisebenzisa nhlobo. Uma uMnyango Wezamanzi, DWAF, unikeza inombolo yocingo etholakala njalo, engafuni umuntu ukuthi akhombise igama lakhe, ukuze isetshenziswe abantu uma bezizwa bengaphilile, ubani ofuna ukuyisebenzisa le nsizakalo? Amalunga omndeni wakho. Angizukuyisebenzisa nhlobo. Uthola kangakanani ukuthi unezinkinga zempilo noma ukhathele (hhayi i-HIV/AIDS noma i-AIDS)? Uthola kangakanani ukuthi unezinkinga nomkakho, umlingani, noma omunye obalulekile? Uthola kangakanani ukuthi unezinkinga nezingane zakho? Uthola kangakanani ukuthi unezinkinga zomndeni omkhulu? Uthola kangakanani ukuthi uzizwa umzimba wakho uphansi noma ukhathele? Uthola kangakanani ukuthi uzizwa ukhathazekile ngokuba ne-HIV noma i-AIDS uqobo? Uthanda ulwazi nge-HIV/AIDS oluhambisana nezihloko ezilandelayo? Ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okukhona kwabantu abane-HIV noma i-AIDS. Ukuphila impilo ephelele uma unayo i-HIV noma umphumela ophumelelayo. Ukuphila nolwazi lomphumela ophumelelayo okukhombisa ukuthi unayo i-HIV. Ukuhlukunyezwa komphumela ophumelelayo kulabo abakuzungezile, abangane, nomndeni. Isithunzi sakho emsebenzini kanye namalungelo akho njengomsebenzi one-HIV. Angidingi ulwazi ngalokhu. Uthola ukukhathazeka ngokuqashwa? Kungenzeka yini ukukhathazeka ngokulahleka komsebenzi? Unazo yini izinkinga ngotshwala noma izidakamizwa ezihlobene ngqo nawe noma nelunga lomndeni eliseduze? Unazo yini izinkinga zomthetho? Unazo yini izinkinga zezimali noma zezezimali? Uke waba yisigameko sokuhlukunyezwa? Kungenzeka yini ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi uzizwa uphansi noma ukhathele ngenxa yomsebenzi ngenxa yezizathu ezilandelayo (Ungakhetha ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo)? Ukukhathazeka ngokuqashelwa noma ukwesaba ukuhamba emsebenzini ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokulingana Kwezemisebenzi. Imali, ukuqashelwa, noma izinkinga ezihlobene nohlelo oluphatha ukuhlolwa emsebenzini. Uzwa kanjani uma udluliselwa kwenye indawo (Isibonelo, eMnyangweni, kwiBhodi Yezamanzi, noma eMnyangweni Wokuphathwa Kwamanzi)? Ingabe kukhona eminye imibono noma iziphakamiso ofuna ukuziveza mayelana nosizo olungadingwa ngabasebenzi beMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF? Ngiyabonga ngokuphothula le mibuzo ehlelekile.
