Amalungelo Abasebenzi Amalungelo abasebenzi ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi, okukhuluma ngalezo ziqinisekiso ezivumela abantu ukuba basebenze ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle, ziphumelele, futhi zigcine ukuhweba ngempumelelo. Ukuqonda amalungelo abasebenzi kubalulekile, hhayi kuphela ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela izimfanelo zethu, kodwa futhi ukuze siqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle nemisebenzi eqinile. Ukubaluleka Kwamalungelo Abasebenzi Amasiko ahluke kakhulu emhlabeni, kodwa amalungelo abasebenzi abomiswa emizamweni yokwakha umphakathi ofanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwelashwa ngokulinganayo, ukuvikelwa kokusebenza okungekuhle, kanye nezimo zomsebenzi eziphephile. Amalungelo abasebenzi avame ukufakwa emthethweni - kuhlanganisa nezivumelwano zabasebenzi, izimiso zokuvikela, nemithetho yokuphatha. Amalungelo abafundi akhuluma ngamalungelo omsebenzi kubasebenzi bezimboni, izinkampani, nezikhungo. Lawa malungelo kuhlanganisa izinzuzo ezinhle, okufana nezikhwama zempilo, ukuphepha emsebenzini, nokusebenza ezindaweni ezihambisanayo. Lokhu kunciphisa ukubandlululwa, kungakhathalekile ukuthi ugama, ubulili, noma isimo somnotho. Izindlela Zokwenza Izenzo Eziwusizo Ukuze umsebenzi awazi amalungelo akhe, kubalulekile ukuba neziqondiso ezicacile. Abasebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi bangasebenzisa kanjani amalungelo abo, futhi bazi izinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela lezo zimo zabo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma kutholakale ukuhlukunyezwa emsebenzini, umsebenzi angafaka isikhalazo emnyangweni ofanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza umsebenzi abe nesibindi sokuphikisa imikhuba emibi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyathelo zokwenza amalungelo asebenze kahle zifaka phakathi ukufundisa abasebenzi ukuthi babe nezinhlangano ezahlukene, njengezinyunyana zomsebenzi. Lezi zinhlangano ziphakathi kokubamba amalungelo abasebenzi, ukuvikela umsebenzi, futhi zisebenza ukuze zikhulise izimo ezinhle zokusebenza. Amalungelo Iqhaza Nawo Emphakathini Amalungelo abasebenzi ahlinzeka ithuba lokuthola ukwaziswa nolwazi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi uhlanganyele ekufundiseni amalungelo abasebenzi emphakathini. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa komphakathi nokuqonda lezi zinto kudinga izinhlelo zokufunda emiphakathini, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezikhungo ezilwela amalungelo abantu. Umphakathi osebenzelana kahle, lapho wonke umuntu ekhuthazekile futhi enza isiqiniseko sokuthi amalungelo awasebenzi ayahlonishwa, ubamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umhlaba wonke. Lokhu kuholela emiphakathini lapho abantu benikwazi ukukhula, ukuvuma, nokubambisana. Izinselele Ezibhekene Namalungelo Abasebenzi Nokho, amalungelo abasebenzi abavumelekile aziphenduki kalula. Kwezinye izindawo emhlabeni, abasebenzi bahlangabezana nezinselelo ezehlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukushoda kwezinsiza, ukuphathwa okuhlukunyezwayo, kanye nokungabi namathuba okulungisa obubhalwe ngaphambilini. Ukuze sifeze amalungelo abasebenzi, kudingeka imizamo eqhubekayo yokuthuthukisa imibono, imithetho, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Abasebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi imithombo eyahlukene ikhona ukuze ibavikele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi amakhomishini aphatha amalungelo abasebenzi, izikhungo ezisebenzela ukuvikela abantshontsho, nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezenzakalayo. Phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza ezinjalo, abasebenzi bangakwazi ukusebenzela izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze banqobe izinselele. Isiphetho Ngokuhlonipha amalungelo abasebenzi, sibe nemiphakathi emihle, eqinile. Amalungelo abasebenzi akha umfundiso yokukhuluma, ukwakha abehlukanisiwe, nokulwisana ukuze kuhlonishwe izimiso ezisemthethweni. Ukufundiswa ngendlela efanele, ukuvikelwa, nokubambisana, izimo zethu zokusebenza zingathuthuka, futhi sikwazi ukuba neqhaza eliyingqayizivele empilweni yabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaleyondlela, amalungelo abasebenzi awubona umhlangano, kodwa ube yisitho esiyinhloko sokwakha umphakathi ophelele, onobulungisa.
Yini ekhuthaza abanikeli ukuba banikele? Ukukhuthaza izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali ukuba zamukele izibopho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakwa okufanele nokugcinwa kwamazinga aphezulu ezinqubweni: ukwenza umsebenzi ngenhlonipho; ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele; ukuhweba kahle; ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nohulumeni, imiphakathi ethintekayo, abanikeli, abaxhasi, kanye nomphakathi; ukuphatha ihhovisi lenhlangano ngokuzikhandla; nokuziphatha ngenhlonipho. Iphondo Lezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi lisebenze umthetho ohambisana nezidingo zeMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti ka-1997, ngokuxoxisana nezinhlangano eziningi kanye namalungu azo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinqubomgomo ziwumphumela wombono ophumelelayo wokuthi yini ebhekwa njengokwenza kahle ekuphatheni nasekuphatheni izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali, kungakhathaliseki usayizi wenhlangano. Ukugxila kugxile kakhulu ezicini ezifana nokusebenza ngokufanele, ukugcina izindaba zokuphatha, ukuhweba, nokucabangela umphakathi othintekayo. Kukholelwa ukuthi ngalezi ziqondiso, zonke izinhlangano ezibhaliswe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti zizokwamukela lezi ziqondiso, zisebenzisa lokhu ukuze zithuthukise futhi zikhuthaze umkhakha lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Kunemikhakha emithathu ecacile neqhondile kule mthetho yokuziphatha, ehlanganiswe ngaphansi kwedokhumenti eyodwa. Kubonakala ukuthi inhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali ephumelelayo izuza ezisebenzisanayo phakathi kwabantu abanikela, abahlinzeki bezimali, nalabo abaphatha izinsiza nezisebenzi zenhlangano. Umthetho wokuziphatha ubalulekile, kodwa awukhiphi kahle izindinganiso ezibekiwe zokuziphatha. Ababhekele i-ofisi yezenhlangano ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali banemithwalo yokubheka nokuphatha inhlangano ngendlela efanele futhi esebenzayo ngenkathi behlonipha imithetho ephethwe umthethosisekelo wenhlangano. Njengoba le mthetho izosetshenziswa yizinhlangano ezahlukene ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, le dokhumenti ivulekile futhi ibhalwe ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda nokuyisebenzisa. Umphakathi - umuntu ophethe ukulandelela isimo sezezimali senhlangano nsuku zonke. Lokhu kungaba umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele noma wesikhathi esithile, unikezwa umuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle, noma kwenziwa ngokuzithandela, kuye ngusuku nosayizi nezinga lezinsiza zenhlangano, inani lemali eliqoqiwe, noma lokho okukhokhiwe. Umphathi we-ofisi - umuntu ophethe ukuhlela i-ofisi nsuku zonke ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Le ndima ingaba isikhathi esigcwele noma esithile, noma kwenziwa ngokuzithandela, kuye ngusuku nosayizi nezinga lezinsiza zenhlangano. Umphathi - umuntu ophethe ukuba umphathi wenhlangano ngokuphelele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. Lo muntu uqashwa yinkampani ephethe ye-NPO futhi ubika kule nkampani konke okwenzekayo enhlangano nsuku zonke. Umeluleki - izinhlangano eziningi ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali azinazo izinsiza nezimali zokuhola bonke abantu abadingekayo kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuphatha izinhlelo, ukwenza umsebenzi, nokuhweba. Ezinye zalezi zinto zinganikezwa kubacebisi bangaphandle abaziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngalobo buchwepheshe. Lezi zinqumo zingase zihlobane ngqo nalezi zinto, kungakhathaliseki uma zifushane noma zisezingeni eliphakathi. Abanikeli - umuntu noma isikhungo noma inhlangano ethanda ukunikela ngezinsiza kaningi, okungaba kwezimali, ngemuva kokucela okukhulunywe yinhla, ukuze kusekelwe izinhlelo nezindleko zansuku zonke. Umhlinzeki wezinsiza - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, enhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali ukuze athole izinsiza noma imali ukuze ahlangabezane nezinhlelo, imisebenzi ehleliwe, nezindleko zokusebenza. Le ndima inganikezwa kubantu noma kumuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle elizophatha ukuhweba. Umzimba ophathelekile - iqoqo lamalungu enhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali akhethwe noma aqokwe ukuba abe ngabaholi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Umzimba ophathelekile ungabizwa ngokuthi iBhodi, iBhodi Labaphathi, iSishayamthetho, noma iKomidi Lokuphatha. Isitatimende somsebenzi - isitatimende esifushane esichaza inhloso nezinto ezihlosiwe zenhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali, sichaza isizathu sokuba khona kwenhlangano. Isitatimende somsebenzi kufanele sihlolwe njalo. Umphathi we-ofisi - umuntu ogunyaziwe ukuba abambe isikhundla futhi abe namandla okuphatha nokubhekela ngaphakathi kwenhlangano noma i-NPO. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke ngokusebenza ngenhloso yokuhola inhlangano nokuphatha ngendlela efanele noma nje ukuphatha; njengomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. I-NPO yamukela izimiso zokuzilawula ezimweni ezibalulekile ezidinga ukucaciswa. Izinqumo zikhomba ezindabeni ezibalulekile zenhlangano futhi zisebenza njengokubhalwa okuyisisekelo kwesitatimende somsebenzi wenhlangano. Lezi zimiso ziphendula imibuzo mayelana nokuthi inhlangano isebenza kanjani ezingeni elihlukene futhi zikhombisa ukuthi izosetshenziswa kanjani esikhathini esizayo. Umphathi wehlelo - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, kwi-NPO njengomphathi noma uhlelo olwakhiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso. Akuvamile ukuthi le mithwalo inikezwe kumuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle. Umhlinzeki wezinsiza - umuntu noma isikhungo esisekela i-NPO ngokuqondile, noma imisebenzi yayo noma imicimbi, kuvame ukukhuthaza abaxhasi noma imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zabaxhasi. Izimali noma ezinye izinsiza zinikezwa kwi-NPO ngenhloso yokuthola okuthile empeleni. Le miphumela ibonakala ngokukhuthaza okwenziwe ngenhloso. Umuntu ozithandela - umuntu osiza i-NPO emisebenzini yayo, ezinhlelweni ze-ofisi, noma ekuhwebeni, ngaphandle kokufuna ukukhokhelwa noma ukukhokhwa. Izindleko ezibangelwa yilowo muntu ozithandela zivame ukukhokhelwa yi-NPO, futhi kungenzeka ukuthola izipho ezincane zokubonga. Izigaba ezintathu ezihlukene zinefuthe elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika nasemdemokhrasini. Iqembu lokuqala nguhulumeni, lapho wonke umuntu angaveza imibono yabo mayelana nezombusazwe nokuphathwa kwezempilo komphakathi. Uhulumeni ukhethwa ngokuqhuba ukhetho, kuletha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi lezi zenzakalo nezidingo zixhaswa ngababhalisile ngabanye kanye nezikhungo ezahlukene. Lezi zixhaso zengezwa ngosizo oluvela kwamanye amazwe, ngendlela yokubolekwa kwemali noma uxhaso lwezimali. Iqembu lesibili nguhlelo lwabantu abathengisa noma amabhizinisi. Umthelela emphakathini uyabonakala uma izidingo nezifiso zomuntu zihlangatshezwa ngokuhlinzekwa kwemikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ngentengo ethile. Impendulo kulezi zimo ukukhokha ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo okwenziwa ngenhloso, futhi le nsiza ivela emphakathini ivumela amabhizinisi ukuthi aqhubeke ahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ngaleyo ndlela evumela ukuthi akhiqize inzuzo. Imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni (Life Esidimeni arbitration) Q: Yini i-Life Esidimeni arbitration? A: I-Life Esidimeni arbitration iyinqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano eziphathelene nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo ezihlinzekwa yi-Life Esidimeni, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokudlula kweziguli eziningi ezazitholakala ezikhungweni zabo. Le nqubo yenzelwe ukuvumela abathintekayo ukuthi bathole ukulungiswa nokubuyiselwa kwezindleko. Q: Yiziphi izizathu eziholele ekubeni kube ne-arbitration? A: Izizathu eziholele ekubeni kube ne-arbitration zifaka phakathi ukunganeliseki kwabazali nezihlobo zeziguli, izikhalazo ezivela ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo, kanye nezinkinga ezinkulu ezihlobene nezinsizakalo ezazihlinzekwa yi-Life Esidimeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinsolo zokungabi nekhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Q: Yiziphi imiphumela eyavela kule nqubo yokulamula? A: Imiphumela yokulamula ibonakale ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, abathintekayo bathole izinxephezelo ezithile, okukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ukuthatha umthwalo wezinto ezenzakalayo. Okwesibili, le nqubo yaphinde yakhuthaza izinguquko ezinkulu ezinhlelweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Q: Yiziphi izinguquko ezenziwe emkhakheni wezempilo ngenxa yokulamula? A: Ngemuva kokulamula, kube nezinguquko eziningi emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwemigomo emisha yokunakekelwa, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi izikhungo zokunakekelwa zihlola izinga lekhwalithi, kanye nokwandiswa kwemithombo yokuxhasa iziguli. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola izinsizakalo eziphezulu. Q: Ubufakazi obuphumelele kanjani kule nqubo? A: Ubufakazi buphumelele kakhulu kule nqubo, njengoba abathintekayo bakwazi ukuveza izinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nezikhungo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ubufakazi beziguli ezithole ubuhlungu, izikhalazo ezivela kubazali, kanye nezincwadi ezivela kubachwepheshe bezempilo. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthathweni kwezinyathelo ezidingekayo. Q: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakele kule nqubo? A: Izifundo ezitholakele zifaka phakathi ukubaluleka kokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zokunakekelwa neziguli, ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kungasiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu. Q: Ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zinguquko zisebenza kanjani? A: Ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zinguquko zisebenza kahle bukhona ezibuyekezeni ezitholwe ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi iziguli zikhuluma kahle ngempilo yazo, futhi zikhona izinhlelo zokuhlola ezithuthukisiwe ezisiza ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa. Q: Yini okumele yenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziqhubeka? A: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuhlola, ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zokunakekelwa neziguli. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Q: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwempilo? A: Izikhungo zokunakekelwa kwempilo zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemithombo, ukungabi nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lezi zinto zingathinta ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa okukhuluma ngakho. Q: Ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani? A: Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izikhungo ezithuthukisiwe zikhuluma kahle ngempilo yeziguli. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezenziwe zikhuthaza iziguli ukuba zibe nekhwalithi yokuphila engcono. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze umphakathi ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo? A: Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuhlola, ukuhlinzeka ngeminikelo, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze uhulumeni ukuze aqinisekise izinsizakalo ezinhle? A: Uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi kunezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola izikhungo zokunakekelwa, aqinise imithetho yokunakekelwa, futhi ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze i-Life Esidimeni ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo? A: I-Life Esidimeni kufanele iqhubeke nokuhlola izinqubomgomo zayo, iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bayo baqeqeshwe kahle, futhi ibambisane nezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo zayo. Q: Yini okumele ikwenze umphakathi ukuze uqhubeke nokuxhasa iziguli? A: Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa iziguli, ukuhlinzeka ngeminikelo, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule uma behlangabezana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngamafuphi, imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni ibonisa ukuthi izinguquko ezinkulu zingatholakala uma abantu bephendula ezinkingeni ezibhekene nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo, uhulumeni, nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha Isingeniso Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga ethinta izwe lonke, kanti kuthinta imiphakathi eminingi ngempela. Lokhu akukhulumi nje kuphela ngezibalo, kodwa futhi kuhlanganisa imizwa, izinkolelo, nezimo ezihlukahlukene ezenzeka emindenini nasemiphakathini. Ukukhulelwa okungalindelekile kwezinye izinsuku kungenza kube nzima empilweni yentsha, njengoba izinqumo ezinzima zidingeka. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlole le ndaba ngeso lesibili, sibheke izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokukhulelwa kwentsha. Izinzuzo Zokukhulelwa Kwentsha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuthiwa ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungaba nezinzuzo ezintathu eziyinhloko. Okokuqala, kuyasiza ekwakheni umndeni. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi uma intsha ikwazi ukukhulelwa, izothuthukisa umndeni wabo, ikakhulukazi uma isebenza ngayo. Lokhu kusebenza uma kukhona uhlelo oluhle lokuthuthukiswa kwezingane, oluqinisekisa ukuthi umntwana uthola uthando oludingekayo, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze akhule abe umuntu ophumelelayo. Okwesibili, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungaholela ekutheni intsha ikwazi ukuzithuthukisa. Futhi, uma kucabanga ngalesi sikhathi, intsha ingakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, ibonise amandla okukhula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bakholelwa ukuthi ukugcina umndeni kuyisibopho esinzima, okuholela ekukhuleni komqondo, kuyilapho kuthuthukiswa izindlela zokuziphatha nezokuxhumana. Okokugcina, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungakhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle emndenini. Lokhu kubalulekile uma kukhulunywa ngempumelelo yokwakha ubuhlobo obunempilo phakathi kwabantu. Ukukhulelwa kudala ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, kuholele ekwakheni umphakathi onamandla. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezizukulwane, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkolelo nezifundo zidluliselwa phambili. Izinkinga Zokukhulelwa Kwentsha Nakuba kunokuthakazelelwa okukodwa, izinkinga ezihambisana nokukhulelwa kwentsha zikhona futhi zidinga ukuba sikhulume ngazo. Okokuqala, ukukhulelwa okungalindelekile kungaholela ezinkingeni zezezimali. Intsha ivame ukuba nemithwalo eminingi, futhi uma kwenzeka ukukhulelwa, kungenzeka kube nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuphila. Abantu abaningi bahluleka ukubhekana nemithwalo yezezimali, ikakhulukazi uma bengenakukwazi ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Okwesibili, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkinga zempilo zomama, izinkinga zempilo zezingane, kanye nezifo ezithathelwanayo. Intsha ivame ukuba nezinkinga zokuqonda nezokuphila, okwenza kubaluleke kakhulu ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhasa abakhulelwayo. Okokugcina, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kungabhekana nezinkinga zendawo yokuhlala. Uma intsha ikhuliswa emindenini engaphili kahle, lokhu kungaholela ekukhuleni kwezinkinga ezinkulu. Izimo ezinzima zendawo yokuhlala zikhulisa izinselelo ezinobungozi, okungaholela ekwenzeni kube nzima ukusebenzisa amathuba empilo. Lokhu kudinga indlela yokubheka izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhasa intsha. Isixazululo Nezinyathelo Ezizothathwa Ukuze sithuthukise imiphumela yokukhulelwa kwentsha, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubalulekile. Abantwana abathola imfundo ephusile mayelana nezinselelo zokukhulelwa, izindlela zempilo, nezinsiza ezikhona, bazoba nethuba elingcono lokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezithuthukile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphila ezithuthukile, ezibandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, izifundo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhethekile zabantu abakhulelwe. Okokugcina, umphakathi kumele ube nempilo. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuxhaswa kwemindeni, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana kungase kuthuthukise impilo yentsha. Lokhu kuzokwenza intsha ikwazi ukukhula kahle, ithole izinselelo ezincane, futhi ibhekelele ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga ebalulekile edinga ukuxoxwa ngokuqinile. Kukhona izinzuzo ezithile, kodwa futhi zikhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nakho. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokuxhasa intsha, siqinisekise ukuthi abantwana bethu bathola uthando, imfundo, nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze bakhule kahle. Umphakathi wethu udinga ukuxhumana, ukwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukile, ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lethu. Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akukona nje umthwalo, kodwa kuyithuba lokwakha izimpilo ezintsha.
Ezokudoba: Umcimbi Wokukhulisa Imiphakathi Nokuqinisa Ubudlelwano Ezokudoba zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, futhi ziqinisa umnotho wendawo. Umcimbi wezokudoba, owawubanjelwe emfuleni uMgungundlovu, wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngengxoxo, ukufundisana, nokuhlonipha izindlela zendabuko zokudoba. Lokhu kwenzeka ngempela, njengoba abathandi bezokudoba, abathengisi, nabahlali bendawo behlangana ukuze babelane ngolwazi, izindlela, nemiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. Umcimbi waqala ngempelasonto, lapho abantu beqoqana emfuleni, behamba ngezinyawo, behamba ngezikebhe, futhi bekhuluma ngezinto ezihlukahlukene ezihlobene nezokudoba. Izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo obungapheli. Abadala bahlala phansi, bexoxa ngezindlela ezihamba phambili zokudoba, besebenzisa izindlela zendabuko ezivela ezizukulwaneni ezedlule. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo, njengezinkuni nezinye izinto ezitholakala emvelweni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi udobo lwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nemisebenzi yokufundisa, lapho abanye bezokudoba befundisa abasha izindlela ezahlukene zokudoba. Kwakukhona izifundo ezithokozisayo, ezifana nokusebenzisa amakhono okudoba, ukuqonda izilimi zezilwane zasemanzini, nokuhlonipha imithetho yokudoba. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yezilwane zasemanzini, nokubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yemvelo. Abafundi babebonisa intshiseko enkulu, bephakamisa imibuzo, futhi bejabulela ukufunda ngalezi zindlela ezithokozisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waba nethuba lokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu babezokwazi ukwabelana ngezinto abazitholile emanzini. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezinhle, izimfishane ezinkulu, nezitsha eziningi ezazigcwele ukudla okuhle. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuhlonipha imiphumela yokudoba, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yabo. Abaningi babebonisa ubuhlakani bokuphila, bejabulisa abanye ngempilo yabo yansuku zonke, futhi bebonisa ukuthi ukudoba akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba emanzini, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nezinye izinhlelo, ezazihlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa, njengemidlalo yokudoba, lapho abathandi bezokudoba bekhombisa amakhono abo. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa nemikhosi yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi ezinkulu, lapho abathandi bezokudoba bejabulisa abantu ngokukhetha okuthile. Kwakukhona umjaho wokudoba, lapho abathandi bezokudoba bejabulisa umphakathi, bejabulisa nabangane babo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nemisebenzi yokukhuthaza, lapho abathandi bezokudoba befundisa abantu ngezindlela zokugcina imithombo emihle. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokukhuluma ngempilo yezilwane zasemanzini, nokubaluleka kokugcina imithombo yemvelo. Abaningi babebonisa intshiseko enkulu, bephakamisa imibuzo, futhi bejabulela ukufunda ngalezi zindlela ezithokozisayo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wezokudoba wawuwumcimbi ophumelelayo, owavula amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yemvelo, nokubaluleka kokuhlonipha izindlela zendabuko. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephinde behlanganyela, futhi bejabulisa umphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokuhlonipha imithombo yemvelo, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe izindlela zendabuko zokudoba. Umcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, nokukhuthaza ukuthi imiphakathi ihlale ibambisene, ikhulise umnotho, futhi iqinise izindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wezokudoba uzoba yinkumbulo emnandi, futhi abantu bazohlala bekhumbula izifundo abazitholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nemiphumela emihle yokuhlangana. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithombo yabo, futhi bazithokozise ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Umcimbi wawuwumcimbi ophumelelayo, owavula amathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yemvelo, nokubaluleka kokuhlonipha izindlela zendabuko.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwamalungelo Abantu: Inselelo Ebalulekile Emhlabeni Wethu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu kube yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuhilela izenzo eziningi eziphula amalungelo abantu, okuhlanganisa ukucindezelwa, ukuhlukunyezwa, nokungabi nendawo yokukhuluma. Izwe lethu, elibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, akukwazi ukuphunyuka kulezi zinkinga ezinzima. Eminyakeni edlule, izigameko eziningi zokuqhubeka kokuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu zivele zaba sobala. Izifundo ezitholakele zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, izingane, nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezithile, bahlukunyezwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhilela ukungabi nendawo yokuphila, ukungabi namathuba alinganayo, kanye nokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo. Uhlanga lwezombusazwe luhlobene kakhulu nokuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu. Emazweni amaningi, abantu bahlukunyezwa ngenxa yokukholelwa kwabo, ubuzwe, noma imikhuba yabo. Lokhu kubangela ukungabikhona kokuthula, futhi kudala umoya wokwesaba phakathi kwabantu. Izikhungo ezahlukene, ezifana nezinhlangano ezizimele, zisebenza ukuze ziqinise amalungelo abantu, kodwa zihlala zibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu akukhawulelwanga ezindaweni ezithile. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezibhalwe phansi ezikhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlukunyezwa ezindaweni eziningi, kuhlanganisa ezikoleni, emsebenzini, nasemphakathini. Lokhu kubangela umphakathi ophukile, lapho abantu bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze silwe nale nkinga. Izinhlelo zokuvikela amalungelo abantu zidinga ukwakhiwa ngokuqinile. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, ukufundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, kanye nokwakha izikhungo ezizokwazi ukuvikela abantu abahlukunyezwayo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezakhamuzi zisebenzisane ukuze kudaleke umphakathi ophilayo, onobulungiswa. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi onamalungelo abantu avikelwe. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibindi sokukhuluma, sikhulume ngezinkinga ezikhona, futhi sithumele izwi lethu kulabo abahlukunyezwayo. Ukukhuluma ngalezi zindaba akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi wezombusazwe, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokuvikela amalungelo abantu zidinga ukugxila ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukuvikela abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokwakha izikhungo ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abahlukunyezwayo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nesibindi sokukhuluma, sikhulume ngezinkinga ezikhona, futhi sithumele izwi lethu kulabo abahlukunyezwayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amalungelo abantu awawona amakhono okukhuluma kuphela, kodwa aphinde abe yizinto ezisemqoka empilweni yethu. Ukuphila ngokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kusho ukuphila ngendlela efanele, lapho wonke umuntu enelungelo lokuphila, lokukhuluma, nokuba neqhaza emphakathini. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibindi sokukhuluma, sikhulume ngezinkinga ezikhona, futhi sithumele izwi lethu kulabo abahlukunyezwayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu akukhona nje kuphela inkinga yomphakathi, kodwa kuyinselelo esidinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nesibindi sokukhuluma, sikhulume ngezinkinga ezikhona, futhi sithumele izwi lethu kulabo abahlukunyezwayo. Umphakathi ophilayo, onobulungiswa, uyisifiso sonke, futhi sizokwazi ukusifeza uma sisebenzisana. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukunyezwa kwamalungelo abantu kudinga ukuba sibe nesibindi sokukhuluma, sikhulume ngezinkinga ezikhona, futhi sithumele izwi lethu kulabo abahlukunyezwayo. Umphakathi ophilayo, onobulungiswa, uyisifiso sonke, futhi sizokwazi ukusifeza uma sisebenzisana. Ngakho-ke, asithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu avikelwe, futhi sikhulume ngezinkinga ezikhona, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, onobulungiswa.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ngenxa yokwanda kwezimo eziphuthumayo emhlabeni, kubalulekile ukuthi izinsiza zokuphendula zithuthuke ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abantu ngesikhathi esifanele. Izimo ezifana nezinhlekelele zemvelo, izingozi zomgwaqo, kanye nezimo zokuphila zidinga ukuphendulwa ngokushesha ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo kanye nezingozi zokuphila kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula kubalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Izinsizakalo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, ngokwesiko, zisebenzisa izindlela ezithile ezifana nezimoto zokucima umlilo, izimoto zempilo, kanye nezinsizakalo zamaphoyisa. Nokho, lezi zinsiza zihlala zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nezimo zomgwaqo, izimo zezulu, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe isikhathi sokuphendula, kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlela ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwezimoto eziphuthumayo. Okwamanje, izifunda eziningi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuphendula zifinyelela ezindaweni ezidinga usizo ngokushesha. Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo, izikhumbuzo ezithunyelwa kumasistimu, kanye ne-GPS zisetshenziswa ukuze kutholakale indlela efanele yokufinyelela ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi izinsizakalo zokuphendula zikwazi ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula, okubalulekile ekulweni nezimo ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kubalulekile ukuze kube nesikhathi sokuphendula esiphumelelayo. Abasebenzi bezinsizakalo zokuphendula badinga ukuqeqeshwa okujulelekile ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngendlela efanele. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olwakamuva nolunembile lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okubalulekile ikakhulukazi ekuphatheni izimo ezinzima. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo nazo zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Ukuze izinsizakalo zokuphendula zisebenze kahle, kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene, ezifana nezokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezokucima umlilo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo zidingeka ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi yonke imithombo iyatholakala futhi iyasebenza ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthuka. Izifunda eziningi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokubika eziphuthumayo ezitholakala ku-inthanethi, ezivumela abantu ukuba babike izimo eziphuthumayo ngqo kumasistimu wezinsizakalo. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula, njengoba izinsizakalo zingathola ulwazi oludingekayo ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Ukwengeza, ukuhlanganiswa kobuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo ze-drone, kukhombisa ukuthi zingasetshenziswa ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lezi zinsiza zingasetshenziswa ukuze zihlola izindawo eziphuthumayo, ziqoqa ulwazi, futhi zifake izinsiza ezidingekayo, okudala ithuba lokuphendula okusheshayo. Nokho, nakuba kunokuthuthuka, kusekhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nezinsizakalo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Ukuntuleka kwemithombo, izinsiza ezindala, kanye nezimo zomgwaqo ezinzima zihlala zikhona, okudingeka ukuthi izinsizakalo ziqhubeke zisebenza kanzima ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinto eziningi, okukhuluma ngobuchwepheshe, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuxhumana. Ukusebenza kahle kwalezi zinto kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okuzokwehlisa umonakalo nokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba izimo eziphuthumayo ziqhubeka nokwanda, kubalulekile ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuphendula ziqhubeke nokuthuthuka ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo esheshayo nephumelelayo.
Izikhukhula: Umcimbi Ohlangabezana Nezimo Zokuphila Izikhukhula, okungukuthi izikhukhula zamanzi, ziwumcimbi ongenakugwenywa ophazamisa impilo yansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni nasemadolobheni. Lezi zimo zenzeka uma umswakama omningi, imvula eqhubekayo, noma ukuhamba kwamanzi emifuleni kudlula umkhawulo, kuholele ekwandeni kwamanzi. Lokhu kuholela ekungena kwamanzi ezindaweni ezivamile, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu ezihambisana nezikhukhula. Eminyakeni edlule, izikhukhula ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, zishiya izimpawu ezinzima emiphakathini. Izindawo ezithintekile kakhulu zifaka phakathi iKZN, iMpumalanga, neGauteng, lapho imvula eqhubekayo ibangele ukwanda kwamanzi emifuleni. Lokhu kubangela ukuphazamiseka kwabantu, imizi yabo ibhujiswa, futhi izimpilo zikhathazeke. Ngokwesimo sezulu esishintshashintshayo, izikhukhula ziba yinkinga ebonakalayo. Ukushintsha kwemvelo, okubangelwa ukwanda kokungcoliswa komoya, ukuncipha kwemithi, kanye nezimo zokwakha eziphazamisayo, kudlala indima enkulu ekwandeni kwezikhukhula. Izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi umhlaba wethu udinga ukunakekelwa, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo yethu. Izikhukhula zinezinhlobonhlobo zezimpawu ezithinta abantu. Okokuqala, kubangelwa ukulahleka kwemali kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile. Imizi ibhujiswa, izimpahla zibhujiswa, abantu bahlala bephila ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezisemqoka, okwenza kube nezinga elikhulu lokuhlupheka, njengoba abantu behluleka ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baphile. Okwesibili, izikhukhula zishiya izinkinga ezempilo. Ukungena kwamanzi angcolile emiphakathini kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izifo ezifana necholera, i-typhoid, kanye nezinye ezithathelwana emanzini ziba yingozi enkulu, kudinga ukuthi iziphathimandla zisebenze ngokushesha ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zishiya umonakalo emithonjeni yokudla. Izitshalo ezivunyiwe zibhujiswa, izinkomo zibhujiswa, futhi abantu bahlala bephila ngaphandle kokudla, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imiphakathi yethu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu mayelana nezimo zezulu, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphuma ezindaweni ezithintekile, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuvikela izindawo ezisemaphandleni, konke lokhu kudinga ukunakwa. Izikhukhula zifundisa ukuthi umhlaba wethu udinga ukunakekelwa, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo yethu. Ekupheleni, izikhukhula ziwumcimbi ohlangabezana nezimo zokuphila, ophazamisa impilo yansuku zonke. Zishiya izimpawu ezinzima emiphakathini, zishiya abantu bephila ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela imiphakathi yethu, kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo, siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphuma ezindaweni ezithintekile. Izikhukhula zifundisa ukuthi umhlaba wethu udinga ukunakekelwa ukuze sikwazi ukuphila kahle.
Umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane Ngokwanda kokwenziwa kwezinto eziningi, umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane ubonakala ungena ezindaweni eziningi zokuphila. Kulezi zinsuku, lapho umnotho wezwe ubhekene nezinselelo ezahlukene, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinguquko zinezimpempe ezikhaliphile emabhizinisini amancane. Ezimakethe, izinkampani ezincane zikhula zikhula ngokushesha, zifuna ukujabulisa amakhasimende futhi zikhuthaze ukuthengiswa. Nokho, uma kucishwa kukagesi, lokhu kuthinteka kakhulu. Lokhu kucishwa kukagesi kuholela ekutheni amabhizinisi ahluleke ukugcina imfanelo yemikhiqizo yabo, okuholela ekutheni kube nokuncipha kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. UJohn Mthethwa, onemakethe yokudla eGoli, uthi: "Ngesikhathi senkinga yokucishwa kukagesi, sithola ukuthi izinsiza zethu ziyasuka. Ukuphila kwethu kuncike kumshini, futhi uma kukhona ukungasebenzi kahle kukagesi, kuza nezinselelo ezinkulu." UJohn uqhubeka nokukhuluma ngokuthi, "Sizama ukuhlela kahle, kodwa ukungabi nakagesi kuphazamisela wonke umsebenzi." Umphakathi wezobuchwepheshe ubona ukuthi izinkampani ezincane zidinga izixazululo ezisheshayo. Izinkampani eziningi ziqala ukusebenzisa ama-generator ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi uyaqhubeka. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kubiza kakhulu, futhi akulungele wonke amabhizinisi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi kumele kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuxhaswa kwamabhizinisi amancane ngesikhathi sokucishwa kukagesi. UProfesa Thandeka Nkosi, udokotela wezomnotho, uthe umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane ubonakala emnothweni jikelele. "Uma amabhizinisi amancane ehluleka, imiphumela izoba mibi kumuntu wonke. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba emisebenzi, nokuncipha kwemali engenayo," kusho uProfesa Nkosi. Ezinye izinkampani, ezifana nezezimali, nazo ziba nezinselelo. USipho Dlamini, umphathi wenkampani yezezimali, uthe: "Siyakwazi ukuqhubeka nokusebenza, kodwa izindleko zokugcina isondlo siphila zikhuphuka. Lokhu kukhuthaza umthengi ukuthi asebenzise izinsiza eziningi, okuyinto engavumi." Umkhakha wezokuthengisa ubona izinguquko ezinkulu. Abathengisi baphinde bazame ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, kodwa uma kukhona ukucishwa kukagesi, lokhu kuthinta ubukhona babo emakethe. UZandile Khumalo, umthengisi wezimpahla, uthe: "Siyazama ukusindisa, kodwa uma kukhona ukucishwa kukagesi, kunzima ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende." Izinselelo ezihamba phambili zifaka phakathi ukwehluleka kokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo ezinqala, okubandakanya ukuxhaswa okuqondile kumabhizinisi amancane. UThandiwe Mthembu, ummeli wezohwebo, uthi: "Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni axhase amabhizinisi amancane ngezinsizakusebenza ezikahle ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela." Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bakhuthaza ukwenziwa kwezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ama-solar panels, ngokwesibonelo, asebenzisa amandla elanga ukuze ahlinzeke ugesi. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuncika kumasevisi kagesi, futhi kungasiza amabhizinisi amancane ukuthi agcine ukusebenza kahle. UBarbara Ngcobo, umnikazi wenkampani yokwakha, uthe: "Senza izinhlelo zokuqasha ama-solar panels ukuze sizuze amandla elanga. Lokhu kusinikeza ukuqhubeka, futhi siba nekhono lokwenza umsebenzi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngocingo lokucishwa." Kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezihlangene phakathi komphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabathintekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthuthukiswa okuphelele emabhizinisini amancane. UProfesa Nkosi uphetha ngokuthi: "Uma singahlanganyela, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumabhizinisi amancane, futhi kuzothuthukisa umnotho jikelele." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubheka izixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze kuqedwe umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokukhula emnothweni, futhi kuzokwenza amabhizinisi amancane akwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngenxa yalokho, umphakathi ungabona ukubuyiselwa okuhle kokusebenza kanye nempumelelo yezezimali.
Iphrofayela kaThandiwe Mthembu: Umzamo Wokuphila Ngempilo UThandiwe Mthembu, umama oneminyaka engama-35, uhlala edolobheni laseThekwini. Uhlale ebhujiswa yizifiso zokuphila impilo enempilo, okwenze wathola indlela yokuzivocavoca eyamvumela ukuba akwazi ukuphila kahle. UThandiwe akazange aqale ukuzivocavoca ngenxa yokuthanda kuphela, kodwa ngenxa yokuthi wayefuna ukuphila impilo enempilo, engathinteki kalula yizifo ezihlobene nokungasebenzi kahle komzimba. Uthando lukaThandiwe lokuzivocavoca lwaqala ngemuva kokuba umngani wakhe emshiyile emcabangela izinzuzo zokuphila impilo enempilo. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayezizwa engakhululekile emzimbeni wakhe, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhuthazo sokuthi aqale ukuzivocavoca. Waqala ngokuhamba ngezinyawo, ematasa ekhanda, ethola umoya opholile, futhi ethokozisa umqondo wakhe. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuhamba kwakhe, futhi kwaba yindlela yokuphuma emhlabeni wakhe wansuku zonke. Ngemva kokuhamba ngezinyawo, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukugijima kwaba yinto emjabulisayo. Waqala ukugijima emaphandleni, lapho ethola khona umoya omusha nezinsizwa ezimnandi. Uthando lwakhe lokugijima lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqhubeke nokuzivocavoca, futhi wathola ukuthi lokhu kumenza azizwe engcono, kanti futhi kumphucula amandla akhe. UThandiwe ubona ukugijima njengendlela yokukhulula ingcindezi, futhi lokhu kumenza azizwe ekhululekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuzivocavoca akupheli ekugijimeni kuphela. Waqala ukufunda ngokuqina, futhi wathola izindlela ezahlukene zokuzivocavoca. Wafunda ukudlala ibhola, ukugibela ibhayisikili, kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokuzivocavoca emakhaya. Lokhu kumenze waba nezinhlobonhlobo zokuzivocavoca, futhi wathola ukuthi umhlaba wezokuzivocavoca unikeza amathuba amaningi okuzithuthukisa. UThandiwe akazange akwenze lokhu kuphela ngenxa yokuzithokozisa, kodwa wathola ukuthi ukuzivocavoca kuyasiza ekuphuculeni impilo yakhe. Waqala ukufunda ngempilo, ukudla okunempilo, nokubaluleka kokuphumula. Wafunda ukuthi ukudla okuphumelelayo kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlobonhlobo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emiphumeleni emihle. UThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukudla okukhululekile, okuqukethe izithelo, imifino, nemifino, kuyasiza ekwakheni umzimba onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukuzivocavoca akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa umzimba, kodwa futhi kuyasiza ekwakheni umqondo ophilayo. Waqala ukuhamba nezinye izintokazi ezithanda ukuzivocavoca, kwaba yithuba lokuhlangana nabantu abasha, nokwakha ubungane obusha. Lokhu kwaba yisikhala esihle sokuxoxa, ukufunda, nokukhuthazana. UThandiwe uthanda ukuhamba ezikhathini ezithile, lapho abanye abantu behlangana ukuze bazivocavoce. UThandiwe akathandanga kuphela ukuzivocavoca, kodwa wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili empilweni yakhe kuyadingeka. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi eziphathelene nezokwelapha, ezimfundisayo, nezokuphila. Lokhu kumenze waba nolwazi oluningi, futhi wathola ukuthi ukujula kwempilo kuyadingeka ukuze akwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo. Waqhubeka nokufunda, futhi uThandiwe wathola ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi lokhu kumenze abe nesithakazelo esikhulu empilweni. Namuhla, uThandiwe ungumama ophilayo, onempilo, futhi othokozisayo. Uhlale ebhujiswa yizifiso zokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi ukwazi ukusiza abanye abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. UThandiwe uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuzivocavoca akukhona kuphela ukuzithokozisa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Uthando lwakhe lokuzivocavoca lukhombisa ukuthi impilo enempilo iyindlela yokuphila engcono, futhi uyakuthokozisa ukusiza abanye abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. UThandiwe, ngempela, ungumama ophilayo, onemibono emihle, futhi oqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba babe nemiphumela emihle empilweni yabo. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuzivocavoca akuyona nje into, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi lokhu kumenza abe ngumuntu ophilayo. Lokhu kwenza uThandiwe abe yisibonelo esihle sokuthi impilo enempilo iyindlela yokuphila engcono, futhi umhlaba wezokuzivocavoca unikeza amathuba amaningi okuzithuthukisa.
Lo mhlahlandlela uzokusiza ukuthi udle ukudla okunempilo, usebenzisa ukudla okutholakalayo. Uma unesifo esingapheli (njengesifo senhliziyo, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), kubalulekile kakhulu ukudla okunempilo. Ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuthi ulwe nezifo futhi kukusize uphumelele ekubhekaneni nesifo. Ukudla okunempilo akusho ukuthenga ukudla okukhethekile okudayiswa ngentengo ephezulu! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukukhetha ngokuhlakanipha ukudla okuzohlinzeka umzimba wakho ngazo zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo. Le pamphlet izokusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okutholakalayo. Zama ukudla izinhlobonhlobo zokudla ngangokunokwenzeka. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuthi uthole zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Izakhamzimba yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezakhamzimba ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi amaprotheni, amakarbohayidrethi, amafutha, ama-vithamini, nezinsimbi. Zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho azitholakali kuphela kulolu hlobo lokudla, ngakho kufanele udle izinhlobonhlobo zokudla. Kubalulekile ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile. Zama ukudla okungenani kathathu ngosuku. Uma kungenzeka, zama futhi ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile, ikakhulukazi uma ungumuntu odla kancane. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kuphakwe kakhulu kunezinye izithako zokudla. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kungaba yiphuthu, ubhontshisi, irayisi, amaphuphu, noma noma iyiphi enye ukudla okune-starch okutholakalayo. Iningi kwalokhu kudla kulula ukukuthola. Ukuze wenze ukudla okunempilo, engeza ukudla okune-starch noma noma iyiphi enye ukudla okutholakalayo, njengezithelo, amabhontshisi, amaqanda, noma izithelo. Izitshalo nezithelo zinikeza ama-vithamini nezinye izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni ukuze kugcinwe isistimu yokuzivikela iqinile. Zama ukudla izinhlobo eziningi zezithako nezithelo nsuku zonke. Izitshalo ezijulile ezinemibala ephuzi, oranje, noma eluhlaza njenge-spinach, beetroot, ufulawa, amakaroti, kanye nepapa zine-vithamini A eningi. I-vithamini A isiza ukugcina isistimu yokuzivikela iqinile. Zama ukudla okungenani uhlobo olulodwa lwezitshalo noma izithelo ezine-vithamini A nsuku zonke. Ezinye izitshalo nezithelo zikhulisa i-vithamini C eningi, esiza ukulwa nezifo. Izibonelo zalokhu zifaka izithelo ezifana namagilebhisi, amatanjile, ipapa, namalimu, kanye nezitolo, ama-mango, ama-guava, ikhabhishi, namaphuphu. Zama ukudla izitshalo nezithelo ezine-vithamini C nsuku zonke. Zama ukudla okungenani izinhlobo ezinhlanu ezahlukene zezithako noma izithelo nsuku zonke. Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zakho zamandla, qala manje ngokutshala imbewu yezitshalo nezihlahla ezimbili zezithelo. Awudingi isikhala esikhulu ukuze wenze lokhu, futhi ungasebenzisa nezitsha zokutshala ukuze ukhule izitshalo eziluhlaza ezinemiphumela emihle. Uma kungekho sikhala ekhaya, kungani ungahlanganyeli emkhankasweni wezolimo emphakathini, noma usize ukuqala umkhankaso wezolimo esikhungweni sakho? Ungaqala futhi ingadi yakho encane nabangani bakho. Uma izithelo zikhokha kakhulu, thenga izitshalo eziningi esikhundleni. I-pumpkin, amaphuphu, amaphuphu amsweet, amakaroti, i-spinach, nezitolo zinhle ngoba zinikeza ama-vithamini amaningi nezinsimbi ngaphandle kokuba zibe nezindleko eziphezulu. Phaka izitshalo ngamanzi ambalwa. Ngemuva kwalokho, lawa manzi angasetshenziswa ukwenza isobho noma isitshulu - noma uwaphuze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izakhamzimba emanzini azichithwa. Izitshalo ezivundlile ezifana ne-amaranth noma i-spinach yasendle nazo zindlela ezinhle zokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi udla izitshalo ezanele. Abantu abaningi bathenga izitshalo nezithelo kubathengisi bezitaladi. Ngezinye izikhathi ziba nezindleko eziphansi kunezindawo zokuthenga futhi zitholakala kalula. Thenga izitshalo nezithelo ezigcinwa emthunzini ngoba ilanga lihlupha izakhamzimba eziningi ezibalulekile. Thenga izitshalo nezithelo ezikhona ngesikhathi, njengoba ziba nezindleko eziphansi. Ukudla okutholakala ezilwaneni njengezinkukhu, inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, noma amaqanda kungadliwa nsuku zonke. Nokho, ezinye zalezi zinto, ikakhulukazi izinkukhu, inhlanzi, kanye nenyama, zivame ukuba nezindleko eziphezulu. Ukuze uthole izinkukhu, izimbuzi, izinkomo, noma ezinye izilwane ekhaya kungakunika inyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho nobisi. Ungajabulela futhi ezinye izidlo ezine-protein eningi njengezitho, amaphaphu, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, izitho zomzimba, ama-tripe, kanye namaqanda. Thenga ubisi obusha esikhundleni sokuthenga izikhumbuzo zobisi, ama-creamer, kanye nobisi oluqinile. Lezi zindleko ziphezulu ngoba ziqukethe izakhamzimba ezincane kakhulu. Uma ungekho kahle futhi uzwa ubuthakathaka, engeza amafutha noma ushukela ekudleni kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukudla kube mnandi futhi kukusize uthole amandla ngaphandle kokudla kakhulu. Jabulela ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile futhi aphephile - akubizi futhi unempilo kuneti nekhofi. Uma ungazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile noma aphephile, phaka kuphela bese uvumela ukuba kuphole ngaphambi kokuphuza. Uthuli uphuca imali futhi uphuca umzimba wakho izakhamzimba. Esikhundleni salokho, sebenzisa imali yakho ukuthenga ukudla okunempilo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukugwema ukuphuza utshwala ngenkathi uthatha imithi. Hlala usemsebenzini ngangokunokwenzeka uma uzwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuthi ugcine imisipha yakho iqinile. Ukunyakaza komzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukusebenza engadini, noma ukuhlanza indlu, kuzokugcina uqine kodwa futhi kuthuthukise umoya wakho. Cabanga ngokunikeza isikhathi sakho noma ukwenza eminye imisebenzi ukuze uthole ukudla. Ungasiza esikoleni, esontweni, ekhitshini, noma ekhitshini lesobho ukuze uthole ukudla okunempilo noma ibhagi yokudla. Khetha ukudla okujabulisayo nokutholakalayo endaweni yakho. Lezi zibonelo ezilandelayo zingakusiza ngezinsiza zokupheka ukudla okulula, okunempilo okutholakala ngamanani aphansi. Phaka isitshulu samabhontshisi futhi uhlanganise ne-tomato kanye ne-onion stew. Ungangeza nezinsipho kule dish ukuze uyiqedele. Uma uzwa ungathandi ukudla kahle, phaka iphuthu elanelisayo. Ungakwenza lokhu kanje: Phaka ikomishi eyodwa ye-cornmeal. Engeza izipuni ezintathu ezincane ezigcwele ubisi oluphakeme, isipuni esisodwa se-oyela noma ibhotela, nezipuni ezimbili ezincane zoshukela kuphuthu bese uhlanganisa. Ukuze wenze isidlo esinempilo sonke umndeni, ungapheka ithini elikhulu le-sardines (khumbula ukusebenzisa amathambo) bese uhlanganisa nehhafu yekhasi lefulawa noma ama-breadcrumbs. Engeza amaqanda amathathu aphukile bese uhlanganisa kahle. Yenza ama-patties amancane bese uwafrya ngama-oyela ambalwa. Phaka ne-salad entsha, amaphuphu ap
Umbhalo: Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Umbuzo 1: Yini ukhetho lukazwelonke? Ukhetho lukazwelonke luwumcimbi obalulekile emhlabeni wezepolitiki, lapho kubanjwa khona ukhetho lwamalungu ePhalamende, iziphathamandla, kanye nezinye izikhundla ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuvota izakhamizi ukuze zikhethwe labo abazophatha ezweni. Lokhu kukhombisa ubukhona bemibono ehlukene, kanye namaphuzu okukhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ukhetho lukazwelonke luyabaluleka? Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izakhamizi zinamandla okwenza izinqumo ezithinta impilo yazo. Kubalulekile ngoba kuholela ekwakheni uhulumeni, ophakathi kokuphatha izinsiza, ukuhlela izinhlelo, nokuphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga zomphakathi zihlala zikhuluma, futhi iziphakamiso ziye phambili. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinqubo ezihambisana nokhetho lukazwelonke? Izinyathelo zokulungiselela ukhetho ziqala ngesikhathi esifanele sokukhetha, lapho iziphathimandla ziqala ukuhlela izinsiza zokuvota, izikhungo zokuvota, kanye nezinsiza zokuthumela izikhumbuzo zokuvota. Kubalulekile futhi ukuziqhenya ngokuqwashisa izakhamuzi mayelana nezinsuku zokuvota, imithetho yokuvota, kanye nezifiso zokuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uhlanganyela. Umbuzo 4: Yisiphi isimo sezepolitiki esikhona ngaphambi kokhetho? Isimo sezepolitiki singahluka kakhulu, sisuselwa ezindleleni ezahlukene zokuphatha, izinkinga zomnotho, kanye nezenzakalo zomphakathi. Ngezinye izikhathi, izinkinga ezinjengobuphofu, ukungalingani, nokuhlukumezeka kwezombusazwe kungase kube izinto ezibalulekile ezithinta indlela abantu abavota ngayo. Lokhu kusebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi izakhamuzi kumele zihlale zikhumbula izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze zifeze izidingo zazo. Umbuzo 5: Kuthiwani ngezinhlangano ezihlangene ekhetho? Izinhlangano ezihlangene, njengezinhlelo zokuvota, ezokuphepha, kanye nezikhungo zokubhalisela ukuvota, zidlala indima enkulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle. Lezi zinhlelo ziqinisekisa ukuthi akukho ukuphazamiseka okuthinta ukuvota kwabantu, futhi zikhuthaza izakhamuzi ukuba zibe nentshisekelo yokuzibandakanya. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe ukhetho lukazwelonke luhluke kwamanye ukhetho? Yebo, ukhetho lukazwelonke luhluka kumakhosi, izifunda, noma izindawo ezithile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuvota, imithetho ehlukene, kanye nezinsuku zokuvota ezihlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izifunda ziyavota futhi zikhuluma ngalezi zindaba ezithinta izindawo zabo. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinsiza ezitholakalayo kubavoti? Abavoti bangathola izinsiza eziningi, kuhlanganise nomhlahlandlela wokuvota, izikhumbuzo zokuthi baphumele ukuze bavote, kanye nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa amalungelo abo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile ezitholakala kumphakathi, njengokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi bangavota kanjani, izikhungo zokuvota eziseduze nendawo zabo, kanye nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nokhetho lukazwelonke? Izinkinga ezithinta ukhetho lukazwelonke zifaka phakathi ukungaboni ngaso linye, ukungakhokhi kahle, kanye nezinkinga zezenhlalo ezithinta ukuvota. Nokho, kunendlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, kuhlanganisa nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nohulumeni. Umbuzo 9: Kuthiwani ngemiphumela yokhetho? Imiphumela yokhetho ibaluleke kakhulu, njengoba iphakamisa ukuthi iziphi izinkampani ezizothatha izikhundla eziphezulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zikhuluma ngezinto ezisemqoka ezithinta izakhamuzi. Imiphumela yokhetho ibuye ibonise indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, nokuthi izinqumo zithinta kanjani impilo yabo. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele kwenziwe ngemuva kokhetho? Ngemuva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi izakhamuzi zihlale ziqhubeka nokubheka izinqumo ezithathiwe, ziqhubeke zikhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, futhi zigqugquzele ukuvota okukhulayo. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezizinda ezahlukene, amabhizinisi, nezakhamuzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uhamba phambili. Ukhetho lukazwelonke luwumcimbi obalulekile, owuholela ekubumbeni ikusasa lezwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe icala, sibe neqhaza, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi izwi lethu linamandla.
Umthelela Wama-Social Media Entsheni Emzaneni kaMkhize, intsha yayiphila ngaphansi komoya opholile wezokuxhumana. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lwalwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene, luhamba ngesivinini esikhulu. Kwakuwumhlaba ogcwele amathuba, kodwa kwaba nezinkinga eziningi. UMina, intombazane encane, wayejabulela ukudlala nezingane ezindalini, kodwa njengoba ama-social media ethuthuka, wathola ithuba lokuhamba ngebhasi ukuze azame izinto ezintsha. Ngemva kokwakha i-akhawunti ku-Facebook, waqala ukuthola ubungane obusha, ukwabelana ngezithombe nezindaba. Nokho, akazange aqaphele ukuthi umhlaba ovulekile ku-inthanethi wawufaka umthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe yangempela. UMina akazange akhumbule ukuthi nakuba ama-social media emnika amandla, abuye amphathe kabi. Ngemva kokuhlangana nabanye abesifazane emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, waqala ukusola ukuthi ubuhle baphakathi kwabanye bukhona kakhulu. Isithombe sikaMina sakhula, kodwa impilo yakhe yangempela yathinteka. Waqala ukuzizwa enganelisekile, njengoba edlula isikhathi esiningi efuna ukujabulisa abanye. Lokhu kwaholela ekucindezelekeni lapho ebona isithombe sikaThandi, omunye wabangani, esebenza kahle empilweni. UThandi wayenobuhle obuhlukile, okwakwenza uMina azizwe engafaneleki. Lokhu kwamphuza umoya, wacabanga ukuthi akathandi impilo yakhe. Ngemuva kwalokho, umngani wakhe, uSipho, wamsiza wathi: “Mina, kungani ungafuni ukuzithokozisa? Uhlale uthokozisa abanye, kodwa uhlezi ugwaza okukhona ngaphakathi.” Lokhu kwamnika umuzwa omuhle, kodwa wacabanga ukuthi akekho umuntu ozokwazi ukuphila ngaphandle kwama-social media. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi, nakuba umphakathi ufisa ubufakazi bokuphila okuhle, umqondo ophilayo uyathinteka. Ngemuva kokuchitha isikhathi esiningi ebukhoma, uMina wathola ithuba lokuphila ngaphandle kwama-social media. Waqala ukuhamba phesheya, ehlanganyela nezifundo, futhi wathola ukuthi kukhona okukhulu okungaphezu kokuthola injabulo kubangani bakhe. Waqaphela ukuthi umhlaba uyahluka; i-intanethi ibonisa umphakathi, kodwa empeleni, ukujabula kungatholakala empilweni yangempela. Ekugcineni, uMina waqonda ukuthi ama-social media angaba usizo, kodwa akufanele aphendule impilo yakhe. Waqala ukufuna izindlela zokuphila ezikhona ngaphandle kwalesi sithombe esikhanyayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uqhubeke nokuhlala empilweni yangempela, ekwazi ukuthokozisa abanye, kodwa ehlezi eqinisa amandla akhe. Ngale ndlela, uMina waba isibonelo sabanye abasha emzaneni, edlulisela umyalezo othi: "Kubalulekile ukuba nemicabango yakho, nempilo yakho, ngaphandle kokubheka izithombe ezihlukahlukene." Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umthelela wama-social media kwentsha ube yindaba yokuphila, okwakukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile ngempela, behlukanisa ubuhle obungokwenyama nobuhle obungokwenkolo. U-Mina wathola ukuthi ubuhle bukhona emhlabeni, futhi akudingeki kube ngokufana nezithombe ezikhanyayo. Lokhu kube ukufundisa okukhulu, kwenze umphakathi wakhe ube nomoya opholile, uhambisana nomoya wokuxhumana ongokoqobo.
Iphasi leziqinisekiso ibhizinisi iyisiqinisekiso esinikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula noma ukufaka imali ebhizinisini eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo kumabhange aseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini noma ehhovisi eliseduze lezeMisebenzi lapho ibhizinisi lizokwakhiwa khona. Isicelo sephasi lebhizinisi kumele sibe necebo elikhishwe ngengcweti yezezimali, ebhaliswe neNhlangano Yezingcweti Zama-Accounting eNingizimu Afrika. Imali encane yokutshalwa kwezimali ingama-R2.5 million ngempesheni noma okungenani ama-R2 million ngempesheni kanye nama-R500,000 ngempahla. I-deposit yokubuyiselwa, efana nekhadi lokubuyela elilodwa ezweni lokwakheka noma lapho umuntu enamalungelo okuhlala unomphela: Le deposit izobuyiselwa ngemva kokuhamba kwakho noma ngemva kokuthola iphasi. Izibalo zezempilo nemiphumela ye-x-ray ziyadingeka kumfakisicelo ngamunye. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 nabesifazane abakhulelwe akudingeki ukuba babe nemiphumela ye-x-ray. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezempilo eliseduze.
Unikezwa ukwamukela, ukukhipha, nokuhlelwa kabusha kwezinhlelo, ukuhlinzeka ngokuhlukaniswa komhlaba nokuhlanganiswa komhlaba; ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko yomhlaba engafakiwe ezinhlelweni; ukuhlinzeka ngokuhlukaniswa ngezigaba noma ukuhlela kabusha uhlelo olwamukelwe lokuhlukaniswa komhlaba noma intuthuko yomhlaba; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqalwa, ukugcinwa, nokususa kwemikhawulo ethintana nomhlaba; ukusungula imigomo yokuphothulwa okuphakade kwemigwaqo yomphakathi noma izindawo zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngokwamukela nokwazisa ngezinhlelo, ukuhlinzeka ngokukhokha okuhlobene nezindaba ezilawulwa umthetho; ukusungula iKwaZulu-Natal Planning and Development Appeals Board; ukuhlinzeka ngezinga nezindinganiso zokuhlela nokuthuthukisa esifundazweni; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. Umsebenzi wokuthola izilinganiso nezincazelo zobungcweti. Izinqubomgomo ezijwayelekile mayelana nokuphothulwa kwemigwaqo yomphakathi noma izindawo zomphakathi ziyadingeka ukuze kutholwe izilinganiso nezincazelo zobungcweti ezihlobene! Imali yokubuyiselwa ethintwa ukuphulwa kwemithetho kanye nezinyathelo ezizenzakalelayo noma ezingenabungozi zokuphatha iziqondiso zokuphuthumayo ukuvimbela inani lokubuyiselwa! Isicelo sokufaka isikhalazo sesidlulile. Amacala ahlobene nokuphuma phambi kweBhodi Yokufaka Izikhalazo! Umgibeli weBhodi Yokufaka Izikhalazo! Ukufaka izicelo zokuhlelwa kabusha kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, ukuhlukaniswa komhlaba noma ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba kanye nentuthuko yomhlaba ngaphandle kwendawo yohlelo, kanye nokuhlelwa kabusha, ukusungulwa, noma ukususwa kwemvume ethintana nomhlaba. Ilungelo lesicelo lokuphendula ku-O. Umthetho Wokuhlela Intuthuko ubonisa umthetho wokuhlela intuthuko, uMthetho No. 1995. UMdabuli Mhiaba ubonisa umuntu obhaliswe njengomhloli womhlaba ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wabahloli Bomhlaba ka-1984 uMthetho No. umnikazi ubonisa umnikazi obhalisiwe bomhlaba njengoba kuphakanyiswa esigabeni 102 soMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwezincwadi futhi kubandakanya umnikazi ongumqashi, idokhumenti yeshadi lesikhumbuzo noma umuntu onelungelo elifanayo kumgibeli wezincwadi zeshadi lesikhumbuzo, kodwa akuhlanganisi ilungelo noma inzuzo yomqashi, ukuqasha abasebenzi noma ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkontileka; noma ukusungula imigomo ejwayelekile yokulalela! Inhloso yohlelo ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa komhlaba nokukhuthaza izinhlelo zentuthuko ezihambisana nohlelo lwemunicipality oluhlobene nentuthuko. I-municipality kufanele, ngaphakathi kweminyaka emihlanu kusukela ekuqaleni kwalolu mthetho, yamukele uhlelo noma izinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezisebenzayo endaweni yonke, ngaphandle kokuthi ilungu lekhansela elibhekelela ukwandiswa kwesikhathi. I-municipality ingafaka isicelo kulowo mlungu wekhansela ophatha isikhathi sokwandisa ukuze yamukele uhlelo noma izinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezisebenzayo endaweni yonke. kanye neleta ephakamisa ukwandiswa kwesikhathi; futhi sizokhombisa isikhathi esidingekayo sokwandiswa. I-municipality ayikwazi ukwandisa isikhathi sokwamukela uhlelo noma izinhlelo ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kuGazethi. izokhombisa izindawo lapho ukuvunyelwa kwemunicipality kungadingeki ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho ukuze kuhlukaniswe umhlaba noma kuhlanganiswe umhlaba. Abafundi Basemanyuvesi: Izinkinga Nezithombe Zokuphila Kwabo Ngonyaka wezi-2023, abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bephakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta imfundo, ezomnotho, kanye nezokuxhumana. Njengoba izikhungo zemfundo ziqhubeka nokukhula, abafundi bahlola izinselelo ezihlukahlukene ezibhekene nabo, okuhlanganisa izindleko zokuphila, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, kanye nezinkinga zokwelashwa kwengqondo. Izindleko Zokuphila Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nabafundi basemanyuvesi yizindleko zokuphila. Ngokwezinhlolovo ezithile, izindleko zokuhlala, ukudla, nezokuthutha zikhuphuka ngonyaka. Lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu kubafundi, ikakhulukazi labo abavela emindenini eziphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Abafundi abaningi baphinde bahlola izindlela zokuthola imali eyengeziwe, njengokusebenza ngezikhathi ezithile, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ukufinyelela Ezinsizeni Ngaphezu kwezindleko, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo emanyuvesi kuyinselelo enkulu. Abafundi badinga izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nezincwadi, izikhungo zokufunda, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Nokho, ezinye izikhungo zihlala zinganikezi izinsiza ezanele, okwenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuba bafeze izifundo zabo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka, njengoba abafundi benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze baphumelele. Izinkinga Zokwelashwa Kwengqondo Ngokukhula kwezinkinga zokwelashwa kwengqondo phakathi kwabafundi, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqhubele phambili izinhlelo zokuxhasa. Abafundi bahlushwa ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, kanye nokudangala, okuvame ukuvela ngenxa yokucindezeleka kwezifundo, izinkinga zemali, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Izikhungo eziningi ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwengqondo, kodwa kusemqoka ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zikhona futhi zifinyeleleka. Ubuchwepheshe Nezokuxhumana Ubuchwepheshe buye baba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabafundi basemanyuvesi. Ngemva kokuhlaselwa kwe-COVID-19, izikhungo zemfundo zishintshe indlela yokufundisa, zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikwi-inthanethi. Lokhu kulethe izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudalile izinselelo ezintsha. Abafundi badinga ukufunda ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, futhi abanye bahlushwa ukungabi nekhono lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi bukhulu kakhulu empumelelweni yabo. Abafundi badinga ukuxhumana nabafundisi ukuze bathole usizo, izeluleko, kanye nokukhuthazwa. Izikhungo eziningi ziqhuba izinhlelo zokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi, okuhlanganisa imihlangano, izifundo ezikhethekile, kanye nemicimbi yokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza abafundi bazizwe bephakathi komphakathi. Izinhlelo Zokuxhasa Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokubolekisa imali, izikhuthazo zokufunda, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Abafundi badinga ukwazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma behlangabezana nezinkinga, futhi izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zifinyeleleka kalula. Isiphetho Abafundi basemanyuvesi bahlala bephakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu, futhi izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo zidinga ukunakwa. Ngokuqhubeka kokukhula kwezindleko zokuphila, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, nezinkinga zokwelashwa kwengqondo, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqhubeke nokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza abafundi bazizwe bephakathi komphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele, izikhungo zingasiza abafundi ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
