Umbiko: Ukufuna Umsebenzi Isingeniso Ukufuna umsebenzi kube yisiko elijulile emphakathini wethu. Kunobufakazi obuqinile bokuthi ukuthola umsebenzi kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi nezinyathelo okufanele zithathwe ukuze kuphumelele ekufuneni umsebenzi. Lo mbiko uzohlola izindlela zokufuna umsebenzi, izinselelo ezibhekene nabafuna umsebenzi, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe kulesi sikhathi sokufuna. Izindlela Zokufuna Umsebenzi I-Intanethi ibonakala iyinsiza enkulu ekufuneni umsebenzi namuhla. Amathuba okusebenza angatholakala kalula kumasayithi emisebenzi, njenge-LinkedIn, Indeed, naww.mzansimjobs.com. Ukuze uphumelele, abafuna umsebenzi bangakha amaphrofayili aqinile kulezi zinkundla, kuhlanganiswe nemibhalo efanele efana nezincwadi zokuqoka nezitifiketi. Ukwakha inethiwekhi yokuxhumana, ngokuhlanganyela emicimbini yokusebenza, kuyinzuzo enkulu; abantu bavame ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi kusetshenziswa ubudlelwano obukhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufaka izicelo ezivumelaniswe kahle nezidingo zomsebenzi kubalulekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafuna umsebenzi kufanele bahlaziye kahle imisebenzi ethile, bazi ngempela ukuthi abaqashi badinga ini, bese bephendula ngale ndlela. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abazimisele ngokuphelele ukufaka isandla emsebenzini. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nabafuna Umsebenzi Noma kunjalo, ukuzama ukuthola umsebenzi akuhlali kulula. Abafuna umsebenzi bangase babhekane nezinselelo eziningana, kuhlanganisa ukuncintisana okuqine phakathi kwabafuna umsebenzi. Lokhu kuncintisana kwenza kube nzima ukuthola amathuba, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasha emsebenzini. Futhi, imfundo engaphansi nokuqeqeshwa okungafanele kungathinta amathuba omsebenzi kwabanye. Kunoma yisiphi isikhathi sezomnotho, abaqashi bangase bacabangele ukunciphisa izindleko, lokho kungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko ezinzima emhlabeni wezamabhizinisi, njengezinguquko zezezimali kanye nokuncishiswa kwemali yokusebenza, kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisebenzi ekhaya. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuqhubekisela Phambili Ngokuqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi abafuna umsebenzi bahlele kahle indlela yabo yokufuna. Ukuze bakwazi ukuhlola izinsiza zemfundo nezokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi, bangase bakhulise amakhono abo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhethekile nezinhlelo zokuxhasa zikhona, eziza ukusiza ukulungiselela abagibeli ezintweni ezidingekayo emhlabeni woqobo. Ukwenza izifundo eziqondile lapho uthola ukubhunga nabantu abanethalente emkhakheni ofuna ukuhamba kuwo, kuyasiza ukufundisa. Ukusiza ohulumeni, izikhungo zokuqeqesha, nezikhungo zomphakathi ukuze bathole izinsiza ezingasiza kulolu hlelo lokufuna umsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwenza amandla okukhuleka, ukuqhubekela phambili kulabo abahamba phambili, kubalulekile. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukufuna umsebenzi kubambisana nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa kunamathuba amaningi akhona uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Ukukhulisa ulwazi, ukufunda futhi simbandakanye ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo, kuyindlela yethu yokukuqinisekisa impumelelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukusungula umqondo othile, njengoba sifuna umsebenzi. Iziqu ezitholakele, izixhumanisi ezakhiwe, nokubeka phambili amakhono ethu kuyakwenza kube lula ukuthola imisebenzi efanele. Njengoba sisebenza sonke, kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi vui ube nemugqa wokuphila ocacile, okuhloswe ukuhamba nempumelelo empilweni.
Izinkinga Zokuhamba Ngamatekisi: Umqondo Wami Ukuthutha abantu emigwaqweni ziningi izindlela ezahlukene, kodwa ukusebenzisa amatekisi kungokwesikhathi esiningi okuthandwa kakhulu. Amatekisi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuhamba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamaphuzu amaningi abantu, izindawo zokuhlala, nezindawo zokusebenza. Nokho, le ndlela yokuhamba akuyona engaphazamiseki, futhi izinkinga ezithile zikhona, okuyizinto esizodinga ukuzihlonza ukuze sithuthukise lesi sikhala. Okokuqala, sizobhekana nenkinga yokuphepha. Kulula kakhulu ukuba abashayeli bamatekisi babe nezimo ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungaziphathi kahle. Izingozi zenzeka njalo emgwaqeni, futhi abanye abashayeli bangase baqhubeke bephula imithetho yokuhamba, bephulaphula imiyalelo yabezimo. Lokhu kudala ukungathembeki phakathi kwabakhweli, nabanye bethu balapho beziphatha ngendlela enobungozi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi iziphathimandla ziqinise izinqubo zokuhlola abashayeli bamatekisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabakhweli. Okwesibili, sikhuluma ngezindleko. Amatekisi angabiza kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma uhamba ibanga elide. Lokhu kudala ukuthi abanye abantu bacabangele ezinye izindlela zokuhamba, njengokuhamba ngezinyawo noma ukuhamba ngama-bus. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okukhathaza abakhweli, kodwa futhi kudala umbandela omubi phakathi kwabantu nabezokuthutha. Ukungabi nezindleko ezikhangayo kungaholela ekutheni abantu bangazethembi imoto ye-taxi, baphinde baphinde bacabangele izinketho eziphakeme. Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokuphepha nezindleko, kudingeka kuphathwe kahle udlame lwezinkampani ezithengisa amatekisi. Abanye abashayeli bamatekisi basebenzisa izindlela ezingezinhle ukuze bathole amakhasimende, okuhlanganisa ukwehlisa izindleko noma ukusebenzisa izikhangiso ezididayo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho abashayeli bethola inzuzo encane, futhi abakhweli bahlushwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile neziphumelelayo zokuphatha amatekisi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bathola okungcono. Ngokweqile, sizobona izinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwabakhweli nabashayeli. Abashayeli abaningi bahlala belahlekile emigwaqweni ezingaziwa, noma behamba imizila engalungile. Lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu, okwenza abakhweli bahlupheke. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ezizolekelela abashayeli ukuthi bathole indlela engcono yokuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba, kanti abakhweli bazoba nekhono lokufinyelela izindawo zabo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, udaba lokungabi nezinhlaka ezithuthukayo emadolobheni nasemadolobheni kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Emiphakathini eminingi, imigwaqo ayihambisani nezidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kudala ubunzima ekuthuthweni kwabantu. Ngaphandle kokuthuthukiswa kwemigwaqo, izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi zizoqhubeka. Umphakathi udinga ukubambisana neziphathimandla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zokuthutha zikhona futhi zisebenza ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi zidinga ukwelashwa okuphumelelayo. Ukuphepha, izindleko, ubudlelwano, nezinhlelo zokusebenza zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhweli bazithokozela izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Umphakathi, abashayeli, nezinkampani kumele basebenzisane ukuze uthuthukiswe isimo sokuhamba. Ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, kudingeka sizame ukuzithuthukisa, sibe nemigomo eqondile, futhi sihlale sithembekile ezinkampanini zethu. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela isimo sokuhamba ngamatekisi, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuhamba kalula, ngokuphepha, nangemali engafaneleki.
Umshado wesiko kumele uqashelwe njengomshado ongokomthetho, futhi lo mshado wesiko kumele ube sewenziwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaNovemba 15, 2000. Umshado kumele wamukelwe noma ungene ngokwezomthetho wesiko. Abazali bomntwana kumele bavume umshado. Uma kungabazali, umgibeli wezomthetho kumele avume. Uma abazali noma umgibeli wezomthetho bengavumi, umkomishana wezokuphila kwezingane angaxhumana ukuze athole ukuvuma. Uma kungabavumi abazali, umgibeli wezomthetho, noma umkomishana wezokuphila kwezingane, nguMphakathi ophezulu ozoqinisekisa isicelo sokuvuma. Ngisho noma kungabikho inani elithile lomshado wesiko, umyeni angangena kuwo, kodwa ngeke kuvunyelwe ukuthi kube nomshado wesiko omunye ngaphandle kokuba kube nesinqumo senkantolo esilawula ikusasa lenqubo yezezimali yomshado wakhe. Qinisekisa isimo somshado wakho ngokuhlola ku-inthanethi. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-32 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Isethaphu yomshado ephelele noma ukubhaliswa kanye nemibhalo ethintwayo ikhishwa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi oluvela kuluhlu lomshado. Isitifiketi somshado esifingqiwe sikhishwa, kodwa imali kumele ikhokhwe ukuze kukhishwe isitifiketi uma ukubhaliswa komshado kwenziwa. Isitifiketi somshado esifingqiwe sikhishwa ngaleso sikhathi. Isitifiketi somshado esiphelele sithatha amasonto angu-6 kuya kwangu-8 ukuze sikhishwe. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Ngiyavuma, asiqale! Ngicabanga ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom kuyinto ethokozisayo kakhulu. Njengoba sonke sazi, i-Eskom ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Manje, uma sikhuluma nge-smart meters, kusho ukuthi sikhuluma ngama-meters akwazi ukuxhumana ngokuqondile, akwazi ukusakaza idatha, futhi akwazi ukusiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini ugesi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zisebenza kanjani? Ziyakwazi ukukala ugesi osukumiwe, futhi zikhumbula izikhathi lapho umsebenzisi ethola ugesi kakhulu. Lokhu kuhle ngoba kuzosiza abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bahlala kanjani. Futhi, uma kukhona ukusetshenziswa okungajwayelekile, lezi zinto zikhumbula lokho, futhi zingabika. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma kukhona okungajwayelekile, i-Eskom ingakwenza kube lula ukuthola izinkinga. Ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzoba usizo olukhulu, ikakhulukazi emakhaya. Ngabe kukhona owake waba nezinkinga zokukhokha ugesi? Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala benecala lokuthi bahlala bekhokha kakhulu, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngalezi smart meters, lokho kuzoshintsha. Uzokwazi ukubona kahle ukuthi ugesi owusebenzisa ubani, futhi uzokwazi ukwenza izinguquko uma kudingeka. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Abanye abantu bakhathazekile ngalezi smart meters. Bakholelwa ukuthi kungenzeka kube nezinkinga zokuphepha, noma ukuthi i-Eskom izoba nekhono lokubona konke okwenzayo. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yinkinga, ngoba abantu bahlala befuna ubumfihlo. Nokho, i-Eskom ithi izokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi idatha yakho iphephile. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngalezi smart meters, kufanele sikhulume nangezindleko. Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi lezi zinto zingabiza kakhulu. Nokho, uma ucabanga ngempela, uma zikhona izinzuzo eziningi, kungenzeka kube kuhle ukukhokha kancane ukuze uthole lezi zinsizakalo. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi lezi zindleko zifanele? Kukhona futhi abanye abantu abakhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokufaka lezi smart meters. Kukhona abathi lokhu kuzoba yinkinga, ngoba kungenzeka kube nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Kodwa, uma i-Eskom iqinisekisa ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, lokho kuzokwenza kube lula. Ngabe uyavuma? Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zikhona ezindaweni eziningi? Ngiyazi ukuthi zifakwe ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa abantu bazi kahle ukuthi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma uqala ukusebenzisa i-smart meter, uzoba nekhono lokubona ukuthi ugesi wakho usebenza kanjani, futhi uzokwazi ukulawula kangcono. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngalezi smart meters, kufanele sikhulume nangezinhlelo ezihambisana nazo. I-Eskom inezinhlelo eziningi zokufundisa abantu ukuthi bangasebenzisa kanjani lezi zinto. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu bengazi ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani, kuzoba nzima ukuzithola. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokufundisa zibalulekile? Ngabe uthanda ukwazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zisebenza kanjani emakhaya? Ngicabanga ukuthi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izabelomali, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela ugesi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile? Ngokuphathelene nezimo zomhlaba, i-smart meter ingasiza ekunciphiseni ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma abantu beqonda kahle ukuthi bahlala kanjani, bangakwazi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa komhlaba. Lokhu kuyasiza, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomhlaba. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi lezi smart meters zingasiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle? Uma abantu benokwazi kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini ugesi, bangakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle zokusebenzisa ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izabelomali. Ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo, i-Eskom ikhuluma ngama-smart meters njengendlela yokwenza izinto zibe lula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma i-Eskom ifaka lezi zinto, kuzoba lula ukuphatha ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lezi smart meters zizoba yinzuzo? Ngicabanga ukuthi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi basebenzisa malini, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izabelomali. Lokhu kuyasiza, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomhlaba. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi smart meters zinezinto eziningi ezinhle, kodwa kufanele siqaphele nezinkinga ezingase zibe khona. Ngabe ukhona omunye umbono noma imibuzo onayo? Ngiyajabula ukusizwa ngalezi zindaba!
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokukhula kwazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinyathelo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle futhi ziphila impilo enempilo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinqubo ezihlukahlukene zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa, kusukela emzini wezibhedlela kuze kube sekupheleni kokunakekelwa kwazo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlolwa Kwezingane Ngokufika kwengane emhlabeni, kubalulekile ukuthi ihlolwe ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhlola kuhlanganisa ukuhlola isimo sezingane, izinga lokuphefumula, kanye nezimpawu zokuphila. Abahlengikazi nabodokotela bazobheka izimpawu ezibalulekile ezifana nokukhanya kwamehlo, izinga lokushisa, nokuphendula ezitheni. Lokhu kuhlola kuqinisekisa ukuthi ingane iphephile futhi ayinazo izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlanzwa Nokunakekelwa Ngemva kokuhlolwa, ingane kufanele ihlanzwe kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukususa amanzi amnandi nokuhlanza isikhumba sayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho okungcolile okungase kube yingozi. Abahlengikazi bazogcina izinga lokuhlanzeka eliphezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane iphephile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nokugqoka izingubo ezihlanzekile nezithambile, ukuze ingane ikwazi ukuzizwa ikhululekile. Isinyathelo 3: Ukudla Nokunikeza Imithi Ukudla kwengane ezisanda kuzalwa kubalulekile kakhulu. Uma ingane iyinsikazi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iyathola ubisi lwezinyanga. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba ubisi lwezinyanga lunikeza izingane zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze zikhule. Uma ingane idinga imithi, abahlengikazi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imithi iyinembile futhi iyatholakala. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuqapha Impilo YezeMidlalo Ngemva kokunakekelwa kwezidingo ezisemqoka, kubalulekile ukuqapha impilo yezeMidlalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuzivocavoca ehambisana nezidingo zengane. Abahlengikazi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle futhi zinemisebenzi efanele yokuzivocavoca. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba ingane ikwazi ukujabulisa futhi ibonakale ikhululekile. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuxhumana Nabazali Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akupheli kuphela ezibhedlela. Kubalulekile ukuthi abahlengikazi baxhumane nabazali ukuze babanikeze ulwazi olunembile mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezingane zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ingane kufanele ikwazi kanjani ukugcina impilo enempilo, izidingo zokudla, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imidlalo. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi bangabathinta kanjani abahlengikazi uma bephawula izinkinga ezingase zivele. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kuhlanganisa futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwazo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane azitholi izingozi. Abahlengikazi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi zonke izindawo zokudlala zihlanzekile, ziphephile, futhi zihlala zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azikho izingozi ezithinta impilo yezeMidlalo. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuhlinzeka Ngothando Nokunakekelwa Ukwengeza, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga uthando nokunakekelwa. Abahlengikazi kufanele babe nesineke, bakhulume kahle, futhi banikeze uthando oludingekayo ukuze izingane zikhule zikhululekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uthando lungasiza izingane zibe nesimo esihle sokukhula, futhi zikwazi ukujabulisa. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuhlola Ngokujulile Ekugcineni, abahlengikazi kufanele baqhubeke nokuhlola impilo yezeMidlalo ngemuva kokukhululwa ezibhedlela. Lokhu kuhlola kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokukhula, impilo, nokuhlola izidingo ezithile. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi imitholampilo iyatholakala ukuze ibasize uma kudingeka. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kudinga ukucophelela, uthando, nokuhlangenwe nakho. Abahlengikazi nabazali kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle futhi ziphila impilo enempilo. Ngalezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantwana bethu, sithuthukise isizukulwane esisha esiqinile, esinempilo, nesinothile.
Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika: Indaba Yomlando Ningizimu Afrika, izwe elinothile ngempilo yalo, linomlando omude nowenhle, owakha isimo somnotho esihlukahlukene. Ukuze siqonde isimo samanje somnotho, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezahlukene zomlando, ezabeka isisekelo sokwakheka kwalesi simo. Umlando wezimali waseNingizimu Afrika uqala ngenkathi yeMibuso, lapho izwe laziwa khona ngempela. Ngalesi sikhathi, umnotho wawususelwa kakhulu emasimini nasekukhuleni kwezolimo. Abantu bendawo, ikakhulukazi amaXhosa, amaZulu, nabanye, babephila ngokubamba izinkomo, ukulima, nokuhweba. Lezi zindlela zokuphila zabeziqinisekisa ukuthi imindeni ibhekelele izidingo zayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi phakathi nekhulu le-19, izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka. Ukuvela kwezimboni, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokumbiwa phansi, kwashintsha kakhulu isimo somnotho. Abathengisi bamaNgisi nabaJalimane baqala ukufika, belethe ubuchwepheshe obusha nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezimayini, ikakhulukazi ezimayini zegolide nezinsimbi, ezase zaba yizinsiza ezibalulekile emnothweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhweba kwangaphandle kwanda, kwenza ukuthi izwe liqhamuke njengomholi emkhakheni wezinsiza. Kodwa-ke, lokhu akuzange kube ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezenhlalo, okubangelwa uhlelo lwe-apartheid, kwashiya abanye abantu bengakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kokungalingani okukhulu, okwakha izithiyo ezinzima emnothweni. Ngemva kokuphela kwe-apartheid ngo-1994, izwe labhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ukubuyiselwa kwezinsiza ezithile, kanye nokwakha umnotho onobulungiswa, kwaba yinjongo enkulu. Uhlelo lwezokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho lwakha izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi engaphansi, kodwa izinselelo zazingapheli. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukwanda kwezimali ezibolekiwe, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemithombo, zaba yizinkinga ezinkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izwe laqala ukuhamba phambili. Ukukhula komnotho kwanda, nakuba kuncane, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi zathuthukiswa. Izimboni ezinjengokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokukhiqiza zathuthuka, futhi izwe laqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namanye amazwe. Ibhizinisi elincane naphakathi laqala ukuvela, okwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Kodwa-ke, izinselelo zazingapheli. Ukungalingani kwezomnotho, ukwehla kwemali yokutshala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, zaba yizithiyo ezinkulu. Ukukhula kokuphila, okukhula okukhulu, kwaba yinkinga enkulu, njengoba abantu abaningi bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuphila engaphansi. Namuhla, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sithinteka kakhulu izinguquko zomhlaba. Ukuvuselelwa kwemithombo, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha umnotho onobulungiswa, zikhona. Abantu bahlala bephokophele ekwakheni umnotho onobulungiswa, kodwa izinselelo zikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika uzobe usendleleni yokuvuselela, kodwa izinselelo eziningi zidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bathola ithuba lokukhula nokuphila kahle. Umnotho ungathuthuka kuphela uma wonke umuntu ebamba iqhaza, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela nokubambisana. Ngakho-ke, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sikhombisa indaba yokubambisana, izinguquko, nezinselelo. Ngaphandle kokubheka emuva, kufanele siqonde ukuthi umnotho ungaba yinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukubambisana, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo ezinhle zingasiza ekwakheni umnotho onobulungiswa, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bonke. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umnotho awuwona umgomo, kodwa yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Amanani Okudla: Izinguquko Nezinkinga Ezingaqhamukayo Ngonyaka ka-2023 Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezimeni zamakhosikazi okudla. Ukuze sithole umbono ocacile, sithumele abaphenyi bethu ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze siqoqe imibiko evela kubathengisi, abathengi, kanye nochwepheshe bezomnotho. Izizathu Zokwenyuka Kwamamanani Ukukhula kwamamanani okudla kuxhomeke ezintweni eziningi, njengokusebenza kwezimo zezulu, izindleko zokuhamba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka. Izimo zezulu ezinzima, njengezikhukhula nezomiso, ziye zabangela ukuncipha kokukhiqizwa kwezinto ezisemqoka, okukhokelela ekwenyukeni kwam prices. UProfesa Thandi Nkosi, umcwaningi wezomnotho, uthe: “Izimo zezulu zidlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinkinga zokudla. Uma umkhiqizo uncipha, amanani akhuphuka.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuhamba ziye zanda ngenxa yokunyuka kwamanani wamafutha, okuholela ekuphakamiseni kwamamanani ngababathengisi. UJohn Mthembu, umthengisi wezokudla eGoli, uthe: “Sibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu. Amanani okudla akhuphuka njalo, futhi lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka kubathengi bethu.” Imiphumela Kubathengi Abathengi bahlushwa kakhulu yizinguquko kumanani okudla. Ukuze bahlale bephila, abaningi badinga ukwenza izinguquko ezinkulu ezindlekweni zabo. UThandi Dlamini, umama onabantwana abane, uthe: “Ngiyazama ukusindisa, kodwa amanani okudla awavumeli. Ngithenga okuncane, ngidinga ukukhetha phakathi kokudla nezidingo ezisemqoka.” Ukukhuphuka kwamamanani okudla akuthinti kuphela abantu abavamile, kodwa futhi kubangela ukwanda kwezinga lokungabi nalutho. UProfesa Nkosi uthe: “Ukukhuphuka kwamamanani okudla kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungabi nalutho, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethinteka kakhulu.” Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Uhulumeni kanye nezikhungo ezizimele seziqalile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. Izinqubomgomo zokuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kokudla, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abalimi, zibe nezixazululo ezibalulekile. UNgqongqoshe wezokuThuthukiswa kweZolimo, uMnu. Sipho Mkhize, uthe: “Sizama ukwandisa ukukhiqizwa kokudla ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza sikwazi ukuhlinzeka abathengi ngamanani aphansi.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, imizamo yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa kwezinsiza zokudla, njengokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhambisa, ibalulekile. UProfesa Nkosi uthe: “Ukuthuthukiswa kwezokuthutha kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kokudla, okuzokwehlisa izindleko.” Isiphetho Amanani okudla aseNingizimu Afrika abhekene nezinguquko ezinzima, futhi lezi zinguquko zinemiphumela eminingi kubathengi. Ukukhuphuka kwamamanani kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungabi nalutho, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Nokho, izinyathelo ezithathwayo, ezifana nokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kokudla kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezokuthutha, zikhombisa ithemba lokuthi umphakathi ungathola izixazululo ezidingekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola ukudla okuphumelelayo, okungabizi kakhulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abalimi, nabathengi kuzodingeka ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile. Njengoba sikhangisa phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokwenza umnotho wethu ube namandla, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke.
Amanzi Angcolile Nemiphumela Yawo Empilweni Isingeniso Amanzi, njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuphila komuntu, anomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Nokho, amanzi angcolile abe yinkinga enkulu emphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu ukukhula kwezimboni, ukusizakala kwezolimo, kanye nokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Le mibiko ibheka izimbangela zokungcoliswa kwamanzi, imiphumela yawo empilweni yomuntu, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo zokulwa nale nkinga. Izimbangela Zokungcoliswa Kwamani Ukwanda kokungcoliswa kwamanzi kuxhumene kakhulu nezinto eziningi. Okokuqala, izimboni zikhulisa umthamo wokungcolisa amanzi ngokukhipha imfucumfucu, izinhlayiya, nezinto eziyingozi ezincane emanzini. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni amanzi ahlale engavikeleki. Okwesibili, ukusetshenziswa kwemithi yokulima, okuhlanganisa amafutha nezibulala-zinambuzane, kubangela ukungcoliswa okuvinjwe emanzini avulekile. Lokhu kukhulu kakhulu ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, lapho ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo kudinga amanzi. Imiphumela Yamanzi Angcolile Empilweni Yomuntu Amanzi angcolile abe nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomuntu. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Izifo Zokudla: Amanzi angcolile angaholela ezifo ezinzima, njenge-cholera, typhoid, kanye ne-hepatitis A. Lezi zifo zikhula lapho abantu behlupheka futhi bengenayo imithombo efanele yamanzi ahlanzekile. 2. Imiphumela Ezinganeni: Izingane zihlushwa kakhulu ngenxa yokungena emanzini angcolile. Lokhu kubangela ukukhula okungafanele, ubuthakathaka, kanye nezifo ezivamile. Izingane eziyisishiyagalombili ezithola amanzi angcolile zithinta impilo yazo yokukhula. 3. Imiphumela Kwezempilo Yomphakathi: Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kudala izinkinga ezinjengokungabi nokwaneliseka kwezidingo emiphakathini, okuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zezempilo. Izikhungo zezempilo zikhawulelwa ekuphepheni uma abantu bephila ezindaweni ezingenamathuba okuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nokungcoliswa Kwamani Imiphakathi, izinhlelo zikamasipala, kanye nohulumeni kudinga ukuthatha izinyathelo ezivelele ukuze baphonse emanzini ahlanzekile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokuhlunga Amanzi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile atholakala kalula, izinhlelo zokuhlunga amanzi zidingeka ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Lokhu kumayelana nokwakhiwa kwemifula yokuhlunga, ezokuthutha, nezikhungo zokuhlanza amanzi. 2. Ukukhuthaza Ukusetshenziswa Kwamantombazane: Uhlelo lokufundisa abantu ngendaba yokuhlanzeka kwamanzi luyadingeka. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi amanzi angcolile angaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. 3. Ukwandisa Ukuvikelwa Kwendawo Yezokukhiqiza: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimboni nezolimo zidla amanzi ahlanzekile, izinhlelo zokulawula nokuhlola imiphumela yokukhiqiza kufanele zibe semthethweni. Lokhu kuzovikela imithombo yamanzi ekungcolisweni. Isiphetho Amanzi angcolile awazange abe yinkinga kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa abawumthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izimbangela zokungcoliswa kwamanzi kanye nemiphumela yazo. Ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile zokulwa nale nkinga. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, sizobhekana nezinkinga ezinzima ezizofaka impilo yabantu engcupheni. Ukwazi ukuvikela amanzi ahlanzekile kuyisinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqinile futhi elinempilo.
Abalandeli Bebhola: Umcimbi Wezothando Nezobuciko Ngaphakathi kwempilo yezenhlalo, abalandeli bebholayo badlala indima ebalulekile, behlanganisa abantu abaningi ngezikhathi ezahlukene. Njengoba umhlaba ubona ukuhamba kwemidlalo yezeMidlalo, ikakhulukazi ibhola, abalandeli bembula umoya ongenamkhawulo, uthando olujulile nolokuxhumana. Lo mcimbi ubonisa ukwakheka kwempilo yabantu, lapho umphakathi ubumbene, ubambisene, futhi ujabulela umphakathi owodwa. Umcimbi wethu ubuhlanganisi abalandeli bokuqala bebhola, okwakuyinsakavukela eminyakeni edlule. Izinsuku zokuqala zokuqala zazigcwele umoya omuhle, lapho izinkanyezi zibhakabhaka phezulu, zigubha imidlalo ephakeme. Abadlali abahlonishwa kakhulu bavele kulezi zinsuku, kuthi abalandeli babephakamisa izinsika zabo eziphezulu, bejabulisa yonke imiphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ibhola akukhona nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, izinkumbulo, nezithombe ezithokozisayo. Izinkanyezi zibhakabhaka, kanye nezinkanyezi ezincane zazivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Abalandeli behlabelela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukwakha umoya opholile, opholile. Iphakade, umoya wokukhumbula kudlalwa ibhola udinga ukuqinisekiswa. Noma ngabe ubani, noma yiliphi iqembu, ubudlelwano buyafaneleka; lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe neqhaza ekwakheni umoya opholile. Umcimbi wenza umehluko emiphakathini, njengoba abalandeli bephakanyiswa ngezikhathi ezimnandi. Abanye babebhalisela ukubamba iqhaza, bezama ukuthola izinsiza ezithokozisayo, abanye bezama ukwakha impumelelo. Lezi zinsuku zaziwa ngaphezu kokuba umcimbi wamakilasi, kodwa bekungokwakha ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Eminyakeni edlule, uhlu lwabalandeli lukhule, lwakha izinkanyezi ezahlukene. Abanye babalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bekhumbula izikhathi ezithokozisayo zabadlali, bejabulisa umphakathi. Izinsuku zikhumbula, abalandeli bephakanyiswa futhi besiza abanye, bonke behlanganyela ekukhumbuleni. Lokhu kukhumbula akusiwo umoya odinga ukuphakanyiswa, kodwa kuveza ukholo olujulile olwenzeka ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ubonisa ukuba khona kwamasiko ezehlakalo ezihlukahlukene. Abalandeli bebholayo bejabulisa umphakathi, bephakela izinkanyezi zabo, bezama ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi ibhola akuhlangani nezokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuba nokuqonda okukhulu komphakathi. Kuzwakala ukuthi abalandeli bebholayo bahlonipha imvunulo yabo, bejabulisa umphakathi, bephakela izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umuntu ungubani, ibhola liyisikhumbuzo sokuhlangana, ukuhlonipha, nobudlelwano. Umcimbi udinga ukukhiqiza ubudlelwano obuqinile, ubudlelwano obuqondile phakathi kwabantu, ukuze umphakathi ube nomoya opholile. Ekugcineni, umcimbi wokuhlanganyela wabalandeli bebholayo ubonisa ubuhlakani, uthando, nomoya omuhle. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ibhola akukhona nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuwumoya ophilayo, umoya wokwakha ubudlelwano, nemiphakathi eqinile. Abalandeli bembula indlela yokubambisana, bejabulisa umphakathi, bephakela izinkanyezi zabo, bese behlabelela umoya opholile. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wethu awugcini nje ngokubona ibhola, kodwa kuwumcimbi wezothando, ubudlelwano, nokuhlanganiswa kwamalungu omphakathi. Abalandeli bebholayo bakhombisa indlela yokwakha umhlaba ophumelelayo, umhlaba ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi omuhle. Njengoba umcimbi uphumelela, abalandeli bembula ubuhlakani babo, bejabulisa umphakathi, behlanganyela njalo, ukuze ibhola libe yinsika yokwakha izimpilo eziyingqayizivele.
Ama-Drone: Ikhanya Elisha Esibhakabhakeni Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kungani ama-drone athandwa kangaka? Hhayi, akusikho nje ngoba amaningi abantu bayakuthanda ukukhangisa ama-drone, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuthi anomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ngabe singaqala ngempela kulezi zinto ezithokozisayo? Ama-drone, noma abafundi baqala ukuwazi, ayizinto eziphakanyiswa emoyeni ngengcindezi, futhi eziningi zazo zenza imisebenzi emangalisayo. Ukuthola ukuthi ama-drone aqala njani, kudingeka uhlole emuva eholweni lesayensi. Kuze kube sekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, ama-drone ayekwaziwa kakhulu njengamathuluzi ezempi. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, abantu baqala ukufuna ukusebenzisa ama-drone ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kukhona abanye asebevele sebephendule ama-drone abe yizithombe zamakhamera, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izithombe ezinhle nezibukwayo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi lapho ukuthola impahla kunzima khona. Ukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, ama-drone asebekhula ngokushesha. Manje, ungathola ama-drone angakwazi ukufunda, akwazi ukuzihlanganisa nemithwalo eminingi, futhi ahamba phambili nawe. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuziqalela imikhakha emisha, njengokuthula, ukufothela izenzakalo, noma ukwenza ucwaningo lwezindawo. Ngabe ubungakuboni lokhu? Ngokwenyani, abanye abantu bathola ama-drone angama-robotic, futhi lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu emsebenzini wabo. Kulabo abathanda ukuvivinya amathuba, ama-drone angumngani omuhle. Ukusuka kwezemidlalo zokusho, njengezincwadi zemidiya, ziqhubekile ukusabalalisa amathuba okuthola imiphumela emihle. Kuzwakala kahle!. Cabanga nje uma ungaba nesibonakaliso ngezinyoni, ungathola amahlathi angama-4000, uqaphela izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu. Lokhu kudala umbono wokuthi ama-drone angaphezu kwempahla; bangama-ambasada eqiniso bezokuxhumana nemvelo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule nezinkinga eziyisipesheli ezivela kule mikhakha. Ukukhiqizwa kwama-drone okulungile kufanele kube namathuluzi amasha, amalungelo, nemigomo emisha. Uxhaso lwezomthetho luhlala lukhona. Lokhu kuhlobene nocwaningo lwemithetho, njengokuhlalisana nezindawo eziningi. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekwenzeni kube lula ukuzwa, kodwa futhi kusemqoka ukugcina ubunikazi balo mkhakha wokucwaninga. Mhlawumbe, sizogxila emiphumeleni yamadrone ezindaweni ezahlukeneyo. Njengoba ama-drone eza Nokuvikela, ezokulima, nezokuthuthukisa izidingo zabantu, baphinde babhekane nokunciphisa ubungozi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukusiza izifundazwe ezinozothando. kulezo zinto eziphathekayo. Kodwa-ke, akusikho konke okukhanya kakhulu, njengoba ama-drone ahlangabezana nezingozi ezilandelayo. Ngokwandisa umehluko, ama-drone khona lapho akwazi ukudala izingozi, ikakhulukazi uma ezinganeni, ezindaweni zokuhambela, zikhona. Lokhu kululekile, abanye abathandi be-drone baye bayothola imiphumela yokugcina. Njengoba abantu beqala ukusebenzisa ama-drone ngeminjanjalo emikhulu, bangase bafake izinhlelo ezithile zokuqapha nokwazisa ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle. Okokugcina, singakucacisa ukuthi ama-drone, njengomshini esematheni, aletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini. Kubalulekile siqaphele iziNgxenye zawo ezithokozisayo nezezi. Njengoba sithandazela ukuba kanye kakhulu ngeyikhumbuzo, kufanele sazi izimpilo zethu ezizothuthukiswa. Ngakho, uma usakhumbula ama-drone — hayi, akusiwe umcabango kuphela — ungabazi, ukuba neqhaza, ungabhalelwa ukuthuthukiswa nokuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona. Uhlanganyela kumongameli, kulungile!
Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Q: Yini eyenza kube nesidingo sokugunyazwa kokwelashwa ebhodini le-GEMS? A: Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa ku-GEMS kuyinqubo ebalulekile ehlinzekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okufanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zeziguli ezingama- medical aid, kuqinisekiswe ukuxhaswa kwemali, nokubheka ukuthi ukwelashwa kuhambisana nezindinganiso ezivumelekile. Q: Kanjani umuntu angaqala khona inqubo yokugunyazwa? A: Ukuze uqale inqubo yokugunyazwa, kufanele ube nekhadi le-GEMS lakho. Ungaqala ngokuxhumana nodokotela wakho noma umhlinzeki wezempilo, abazokwenza isicelo sokugunyazwa. Phinde, ungathumela isicelo ngokuqondile kwi-GEMS. Q: Yiziphi izigaba ezithintekayo ezingakwandisa amathuba okuthola ukugunyazwa? A: Amathuba okuthola ukugunyazwa ahluka ngokwezigaba ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuba nolwazi oluthile lwezempilo, izimo eziphuthumayo, noma izinsizakalo ezithile ezidingekayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubhalwe kahle emkhakheni wezempilo, izincwadi ezisekelayo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umhlinzeki wakho ubhalisiwe ku-GEMS kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphumelela. Q: Ingabe kudingeka incwadi ethile ukuze kutholakale ukugunyazwa? A: Yebo, incwadi ethile ibalulekile ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo sokugunyazwa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi isimemezelo esivela kudokotela, okuyindlela yokushayela umsebenzi wezempilo ukuthi kudingeka ukwelashwa okuthile. Le ncwadi izoba nemininingwane ecacile ngempela yokuthi kungani ukwelashwa kukhethwe. Q: Kuhluka kanjani ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa phakathi kweziguli ezahlukene? A: Yebo, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kuncike ezintweni eziningi ezifana nomkhakha wezempilo, izimo zomuntu siqu, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Iziguli ezinemishanguzo ethile noma ezibhekwa njengedlula esikhathini esiningi zidinga ukugunyazwa okukhona. Ukuhlola ukuthi umhlinzeki wombiko ungowakakholwa ku-GEMS kuzoqinisekisa udaba olunembile. Q: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuthola impendulo yokugunyazwa kokwelashwa? A: Isikhathi sokuphendula sithinta ubunzima besicelo. Ngokuvamile, izicelo ezilula zingaphendulwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-5 kuya kwezingu-14. Nokho, uma isicelo siqukethe izimo ezinzima, kungathatha isikhathi eside. Kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano no-GEMS ukuze uthole izibuyekezo. Q: Kukhona yini okungase kwenzeke uma ukugunyazwa kukwenqatshelwa? A: Uma ukugunyazwa kukwenqatshelwa, uzothola incwadi echaza izizathu zokwenqaba. Ungakhetha ukufaka isicelo sokubuyekeza, lapho ungabhalela incwadi ethi ‘appeal’ ebanzi ezifakazelo ezikukhombisayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungathola usizo oludingekayo. Ukukhuluma nodokotela wakho kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni isicelo sokubuyekeza. Q: Ingabe zonke izinsizakalo zempilo zidinga ukugunyazwa? A: Kwamanye amacala, akudingekile ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zempilo zidinge ukugunyazwa. Izinsizakalo eziphathelene nezimo eziphuthumayo noma ezivamile, njengokuhlinzwa kwempilo ephuthumayo, zingathola ukugunyazwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Nokho, izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene ezidinga izinsizakalo ezithile zidinga ukuyobhaliswa. Q: Kungenzeka yini ikheli lazo ezimeni ezithile ku-GEMS? A: Yebo, ikheli le-GEMS lingaba nezindaba ezahlukene, kufaka phakathi izimo zomkhiqizo oceliwe, imishanguzo etholakalayo, nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo. Ngesikhathi sokuxhumana, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka imibhede etholakalayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ufaka izicelo ezithile. Q: Yini okufanele uyenze uma uthethiswa ukuhlaba umxhwele yilezi zinqumo? A: Uma ucabanga ukuthi izinqumo ze-GEMS azihambisani nezidingo zakho, ungavula icala lokubizela udaba ukwazisa ezokuphepha kulolu hlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuxhumana okunembile nokutholakale okuvumelekile ukuze kwenziwe isiqiniseko sokuqonda izinqumo. Umgomo Wokugcina: Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa ku-GEMS kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo lwezempilo ezifanele. Kubalulekile ukuqoqa yonke imininingwane edingekayo, ukugcinana kwezokuxhumana no-GEMS, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola konke okudingayo ukuze ubhekane nezidingo zakho. Ukuba necebo elihle lokufaka izicelo kuzokhulisa amathuba okuthola usizo lomsebenzi wezempilo.
Ukugcwaliswa kwamafomu e-GEMS kanye nemibhalo edingekayo Kwakuyilanga elimnandi, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, umoya wawupholile futhi uthokozisa njengomoya opholile olwandle. UNandi, umama oneminyaka engu-35, wayephumule endlini yakhe, ehlezi ethokozisa izingane zakhe. Nokho, namhlanje wayezokwenza umsebenzi obalulekile: ukugcwaliswa kwamafomu e-GEMS, okwakuzomnika ithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono emndenini wakhe. Kusukela ekuseni, uNandi wakhumbula ukuthi ukuhamba kwayezokwenza kube nezinselelo. Wayazi kahle ukuthi amafomu e-GEMS ayadingeka ukuze athole usizo lwezempilo, izimali zokufunda, nomsebenzi ongalindelekile. Nokho, wayesebenzisa izinsuku eziningi efunda ukuthi angawugcwalisa kanjani kahle lo mfuno. “Inhloso yami iwukuthi ngithole konke okudingekayo,” kuphakamisa uNandi. Uhlanga lwakhe lwalugcwele amaphuzu angama-12 wezinto ezidingekayo, anjengemibhalo yokuhlonza, izithombe, kanye nemibhalo ekhombisa imithombo engenayo. UZodwa, umngani wakhe omkhulu, wamsiza ngezinyathelo zokwakha lezi zinsiza. "Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi wonke umthetho kufanele ulandelwe ukuze sithole usizo," kusho uZodwa, ethokozisa ukudlulisa ulwazi lwakhe. UNandi wahamba eceleni kwekhompyutha, ethinta izinkinobho ngokucophelela. Njengoba egcwalisa amafomu, kwaba nezinye izinkumbulo ezimnandi. Ukugcwaliswa kwamafomu bekuyinqubo efana nokudweba. Waqala ngokubhala igama lakhe, uNandi Ndlovu, wabe esehamba phambili nezinye izinketho. Uxolo lwakhe lwalukhanya, futhi isikhathi sasingajabula. Kwathi lapho efika emaphethelweni amafomu, wathola ukuthi ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ubulili balo msebenzi babunobunzima bokuhlonza. “Ngabe ngifaka isigaba esifanele?” kubuza yena. UZodwa, owayekshedlile, wamsiza. "Thina sesingabantu abavela ezigabeni ezahlukene, kodwa kufanele siqondiswe kahle." Izinsuku zedlule, uNandi wayebhekelele imiphumela yokuhlonza. Ufumene ukuthi kufanele enze izinto ezithile ukuze akwazi ukufaka izithombe ezidingekayo. “Ngabe kukhona owaziyo ukuthi izithombe zidingeka zifakwe kanjani?” kubuza uNandi. UZodwa waphakamisa umbono: "Bheka, lesi sikhumbuzo sokuhlonza kudinga ukuba sihlonishwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi uqonde kahle." Ngemva kwesikhashana, uNandi wafaka izithombe zakhe, ethokozisa ukuqonda kokuhlonza. "Ngiyabonga, Zodwa, ngempela ungenze ngaziswa," kusho uNandi, edlulisela izwi elithokozisayo. UZodwa wayekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele, futhi lokhu kwaba isipho esihle. Ngemuva kokuhlanganyela, uNandi uqedile ukugcwalisa amafomu. Ukubhalwa kwezincwadi, izithombe, kanye nemibhalo eyengeziwe kwahamba kahle. “Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoletha izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yethu,” kusho yena, ethokozisa umoya opholile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wabhalela i-GEMS incwadi yokufaka isicelo, enza amakholi, futhi wagcwalisa amafomu ahlanzekile. UZodwa waphakamisa umbono: “Manje kufanele sithumele lezi zinto, bese silindele impendulo.” Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo sokugcina sokuphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uNandi wayenecebo lokugcina, lapho ahlola izinsuku ezithile ukuze alindele impendulo. "Ngiyazi ukuthi impendulo izothatha isikhathi, kodwa ngizohamba phambili,” kusho yena. Leli sonto, uNandi wagcina efunde ukuncika emizweni yakhe, ezwa ijoyi kuyo yonke inqubo. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili, uNandi wathola i-imeyili ethokozisayo. U-GEMS wamamukela amafomu akhe, futhi bamsiza ngemibhalo eyengeziwe. "Ngiyabonga, uZodwa, lokhu kuyiqhamuka kuphela kokuqala," kusho uNandi, edlulisela umoya wezinhlonipho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wanqoba uhlelo lwe-GEMS, wathola izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi wathola ukwazi ukuxhasa umndeni wakhe. Uthando lwakhe lokuzinikela, nokuxhumana noZodwa, lwenza izinguquko ezinempilo zenzeka, kube umfaniswano omuhle wokuthi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani, noma yikuphi, nathi sikhona. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphumelela, ukuxhumana, kanye nokubambisana. U-Nandi wayeboniswa ukuthi ukufaka izicelo ezinembile nokuhlonza kokulungisa, kuzosiza ekwenzeni impilo engcono. Lokhu akukwazanga kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa kwaba yinsizakalo ethokozisayo emndenini wakhe. Uthando lwakhe, ubudlelwano noZodwa, kwaba yinsizakalo enkulu empilweni yakhe. Futhi, njengoba umoya wezimanga uphakamisa, uNandi wabona ukuthi imizamo yakhe yokugcwaliswa kwamafomu e-GEMS yayihamba phambili, izinsiza zikhula, futhi izinsiza zempilo ziqhubeka. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngokubambisana, bangakwenza konke.
Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi Isingeniso Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kubalulekile ezikhungweni zomsebenzi, ngoba kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi nokuphathwa kwezinhloso zezinhlangano. Ukuqashelwa kwabasebenzi akusizi kuphela ukugcina abasebenzi benelisekile, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni isimo somsebenzi kanye nokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene. Kulokhu, sizohlola izinzuzo zemiklomelo, izindlela zokwenza, nezindlela ezithile zokuhlonipha abasebenzi. Izinzuzo Zemiklomelo Imiklomelo inezinzuzo eziningi ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, iholela ekuthuthukiseni umoya wezisebenzi. Lapho abasebenzi beqashelwa ngempumelelo, bakhuthazwa ukuba benze kahle, baphathe kahle imisebenzi yabo, futhi basebenzise amandla abo aphelele. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemiphumela emihle kwezinhlangano. Okwesibili, imiklomelo iyindlela yokwakha isithunzi esihle senhlangano. Uma ibhizinisi likwazi ukuqashelwa kahle abasebenzi bayo, lokho kusiza ekuthuthukiseni igama layo emphakathini, okwenza kube lula ukuheha abasebenzi abanamakhono. Izindlela Zokuqashelwa Abasebenzi Ukuze imiklomelo ikwazi ukusebenza kahle, izindlela ezithile kufanele zisetshenziswe. Enye yezindlela ezivame kakhulu yimiklomelo yezeMidlalo, lapho abasebenzi beqashelwa ngeqhaza labo emisebenzini ethile. Lokhu kungaba ngokunikezwa izitifiketi, ama-trophy, noma emiklomelweni emikhulu efana nezinsuku zokuhlonipha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezifana nezinkomfa zokuhlonipha, ezibandakanya bonke abasebenzi, ukuze bakwazi ukubona futhi baziswe ngempumelelo yabo. Enye indlela ebalulekile yokuqashelwa abasebenzi ukufaka izinhlelo zokubuyekezwa komsebenzi, lapho abasebenzi behlulelwa ngokuhambisana nezinkomba ezicacile. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba babone kahle ukuthi yiziphi izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthuka, futhi basize ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlonishwa kwabasebenzi kufanele kube okuqhubekayo, hhayi okwenziwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhumbuzo, njengemikhosi yokuhlonipha, kufanele zenzeke njalo, ukuze kube nomoya wokuhlonipha okuqhubekayo. Izinto Ezingase Zibe Nezithiyo Naphezu kwezinzuzo eziningi, kunezithiyo ezithile ezingavimbela imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Okokuqala, uma izinqubo zokuhlonipha zingacacile noma zingatholakali kalula, abasebenzi bangase bazizwe bephuthelwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekudumazekeni, okungase kube nomthelela omubi emsebenzini. Okwesibili, kunezimo eziningi ezidinga ukuba zicaciswe kahle, njengokuthi imiklomelo ibhekelelwa ikakhulu kokuqashelwa komkhiqizo, kunokuba ibheke emisebenzini ethile yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ukwenza Ngcono Imiklomelo Ukuze imiklomelo ibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuphendukela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezikhona. Lokhu kungafaka ukufuna impendulo kubasebenzi ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi yini abayifisayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngenkundla yokukhuluma, lapho abasebenzi bengabelana khona ngemibono yabo nezifiso zabo, kungasiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenyusa umoya wokuhlonipha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuhlonipha kufanele zibe nezici eziningi, ukuze zihlanganise izinkinga ezihlukahlukene, njengokusebenza kahle, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuhola. Isiphetho Ngokubona, imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kubalulekile ukuphumelela kwezinhlangano. Lokhu kudinga ukucwaninga okujulile nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Kufanele kubhekwe izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlonipha, izinzuzo, kanye nezithiyo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uhlonishwa. Ngokwenza lokhu, izinhlelo ezikahle zokuhlonipha zingasiza ekwakheni umoya omuhle emsebenzini, okwenza kube lula ukuheha nokuqinisa abasebenzi abakhuthele nabaneziqu. Ukugcina abasebenzi benelisekile futhi beqashelwa, kuyasiza ukuqinisa isimiso somsebenzi esiqinile, esiphumelelisa izinjongo zezinhlangano.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane: Ingxoxo Nothisha Osezingeni Eliphezulu Isingeniso Ngiyakwemukela kulolu hlelo lwezingxoxo, lapho sizogxila khona ekunakekelweni kwezingane. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane kubalulekile, njengoba kuthinta ikusasa lethu. Namuhla, sithumele imizwa yothisha onolwazi olukhulu kulesi sikhala, uNkk. Zodwa Mthethwa, ongumqondisi wesikhungo sokunakekela izingane esiseGoli. Ngizokhuluma naye ukuze sithole imibono emisha nokuhlangenwe nakho okuthakazelisayo. Umbuzo 1: Uthini umqondo wakho wokunakekela izingane? Nkk. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga. Ubudlelwane phakathi kokunakekelwa kwezingane nemiphakathi bukhulu. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane akukhona nje ukugcina izingane ziphilile, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukufundisa, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokwakha ukuzethemba. Izingane zidinga indawo ephephile, ethokozisayo, lapho zingakhula khona zibe abantu abakwazi ukuzimela. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ezivame ukuvela lapho unakekela izingane? Nkk. Mthethwa: Izinsiza zihlala zikhona, kodwa inkinga enkulu ukuthola izinsiza ezanele. Abazali bethu bahlala bebenemisebenzi, ngakho isikhathi sokuba nezingane sikhula. Lokhu kudala inkinga yokuthi abanye abathuthukisi bahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo efanelekayo. Futhi, kunezingane eziningi ezibhekene nezinkinga zempilo, ezizithinta kakhulu ekunakekeleni. Umbuzo 3: Ungawuthola kanjani umphumela ophumelelayo ekuhloleni izingane ezihlukahlukene? Nkk. Mthethwa: Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokuhlola olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izici ezifana nokukhula komqondo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemizwa. Ukuhlola akufanele kube yinto eyodwa kuphela; kudinga ukuba kube nenhlonipho nengxoxo phakathi kwezingane, abazali, nothisha. Lokhu kudala umbono ophelele. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela ozisebenzisayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle? Nkk. Mthethwa: Sisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa, okuhlanganisa ukudlala, ukufunda, nokudala. Ukudlala kubalulekile ngoba kuhlangene nomqondo wengane, kuyakwazi ukuvusa imizwa, nokwakha ubungane. Ukwengeza, sizama ukugcina ukuxhumana phakathi kwethu nothisha nabazali, ukuze sizwe izidingo zezikhathi ezithile. Umbuzo 5: Ucabanga ukuthi izinsiza zamasiko nabantu zibaluleke kangakanani ekunakekelweni kwezingane? Nkk. Mthethwa: Ukwazisa izinsiza zamasiko kubalulekile. Izingane zikhula zidinga ukuzihlanganisa nezingxenye ezahlukene zamasiko. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubuhlobo, ukwaziwa kwamasiko ahlukahlukene, nokuthuthukisa umqondo wobuntu. Ukuhweba ngokuhlanganyela kulabo abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene kuyakhuthaza futhi kuyavuselela. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kunezifundo ezithile ozitholile ezithinta ukuphila kwakho njengothisha? Nkk. Mthethwa: Yebo, ngifunde kakhulu emsebenzini wami. Ngithole ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kuletha imiphumela emihle. Futhi, ngiyaziqhenya ngokusebenza nezingane, ngoba zikhombisa eziningi ezinhle. Ngithokozisa impilo yami futhi ngithanda ukubona izinguquko ezinhle ezivela ezicini ezahlukene. Umbuzo 7: Ukubona izinguquko kwi-society yethu, kukhona okuthile okukhathaza? Nkk. Mthethwa: Yebo, kukhona. Ngibona ukuthi iningi labantu alikakhulumi ngokubaluleka kokunakekela izingane. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle. Izingane zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, futhi uma sikhula umphakathi ophumelelayo, kudinga ukusondelana kwabantu bonke. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Nkk. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nezimvo ezibalulekile. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane kuyinselelo enkulu, kodwa kuhlobene nethuba lokwakha umphakathi oqinile. Ngithanda ukufakazela ukuthi kulabo abavula iminyango sokunakekela izingane, bahlala bekwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Ngiyabonga nonke abalandeli bethu, ngethemba lokuthi le ngxoxo izokwenza ubuhlakani bokunakekelwa kwezingane bube obukhulu. Ukuphetha Ukunakekelwa kwezingane akusikho kuphela ukugcina izingane ziphilile, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngiyabonga ngokulalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizokhuthaza abakha ikusasa lethu.
Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ngokufana Nama-ATM: Umqondo Wami Namuhla, sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe obusisiza ezimpilweni zethu zowonke, kodwa ngabe kucacile ukuthi izikhungo, ezingama-ATM emkhakheni wezikhwama, zidinga ukufaka izinguquko ezibalulekile ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi? Njengomuntu ohlala edolobheni elikhulu, ngivame ukubona ukuthi kuthiwani lapho izikhungo zisebenza njengama-ATM, ezikhokhela imali kuphela, kodwa ezinganiki umphakathi sfundo esanele. Ngikholwa ukuthi, uma izikhungo zisebenza ngendlela efana nama-ATM, zidinga ukwenziwa ngendlela ethile yokuthi zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ekuqaleni, kufanele sigcizelele ukuthi ama-ATM awagcini ngokukhiqiza imali kuphela, kodwa apha izinsiza ezahlukahlukene ezifana nezimemezelo, uhlu lwezinsizakalo, nezithombe ezenzakalelayo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle, kubonisa ukuthi ayengalindeleki ukuthi izikhungo ziqhubeke nokukhuluma kuphela ngemali. Sidinga izikhungo eziphila, ezihlanganisa ukuxhumana nabantu, nezinsiza ezengeziwe. Uma izikhungo zingabamba indima efanayo, kungani zingabi nezinsiza ezifana neqembu lezinsiza zempilo, izifundo zokwakha amakhono, nezinsizakusebenza ezinamathuba amaningi ukuze ziqinise umuntu ngamunye emphakathini? Njengoba sithola lonke ulwazi emhlabeni, sizikhumbuze ngalokho okwandisayo. Izikhungo kufanele zisetshenziselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emisha, ukubamba izifundo, futhi zibe nezikhala zokusebenza. lokhu kuzokhulisa umnotho wendawo, kuqhakambisa amakhono abantu, futhi kusheshise ukucabanga komphakathi ngendlela ebumbene. Njengoba kuthiwa, “Umlando ubhalwa ngezinyawo,” futhi uma izikhungo ziqhuba izifundo zomphakathi, ziza ukuze zifunde ukuqonda izidingo ezahlukene zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zidinga ukwazi ukufaka izinqubo ezihloniphekile, kepha ezithokozisayo, ukuze zisebenze. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo nezikhungo kakhulukazi ezisebenzela umphakathi. Ukuze izikhungo zibe eziphumelelayo, kudingeka ukufaka izinhlelo zokubambisana ezizofaka izinhlelo zokuxhumana, okufana nezicukuthwane, izinkampani ezimbonini zendawo, ezibambisidla nezikhungo. Lokhu kuzobuyisa umoya ohlanganyelayo emphakathini, okungcono kakhulu kuzo zonke izici zomsebenzi. Ubuqotho bakha eqinisweni kuso sonke isikhathi, lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bahlanganyele ukudala imizamo ephusile ephethe ukubumbana. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempumelelo yezikhungo, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuphendula izidingo zabantu, nokubambelela emhlabeni. Izikhungo zidinga ukusebenza ngendlela yokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nokubandakanyeka. Umuzi unethuba lokuhlorya phezu kolwazi olwakhiwe, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha. Kuyavuma ukuthi izikhungo zidinga ukwenziwa zibe yindawo ethandwa abantu, lapho bengakha khona izifuno zabo futhi banikele njengoba imiphakathi yendawo idinga khona. Ekuhlakatheleni, indlela izikhungo ezisebenza ngayo kufanele ibuye icacise ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, sithanda ukwakha umoya wokubambisana nangokukhuluma okukhululekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inhloso yezenzakalo kanye nezinsiza kufanele ithinte imiphumela ehleliwe futhi kwazulu. Kuphakathi kokuxhumana okuhamba phambili, izikhungo zingakhuthaza ubuhlakani obujulile, kanye nomvuzo ophawulekayo wokuthola abakhasimende abasha. Ngokubambisana, izikhungo zingaguquka zibe אותישת. Uma zenza lokhu, sithola ukuxhumana okwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelela. Ngikholwa ukuthi izikhungo, uma zisebenza ngendlela efana nama-ATM, zidinga ukuphatha izinto ngokuhlakanipha, okwenza kube lula ukugqama komphakathi. Ukuba yizikhungo ezithokozisayo, ezizo hlinzeka ngemikhakha edlulele yokukhula, kungenza kube khona isithombe esipholile senkampani ngesikhathi esithile. Ngaphambi kokuphetha, kuyacaca ukuthi izikhungo zingenza umehluko omkhulu uma zicingwa ngendlela efana nama-ATM. Noma ngabe zikhona izinhlelo ezichitha isikhathi, imizamo yokuqhubeka ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi, Izingaphambili, imiphakathi izoba nemiphumela emihle. Kuzodingeka kucabangele indlela yokufaka izinhlelo ezingakha umnotho, ziqhubekise abantu, futhi zakhele izikhungo ezifanele. Ukusebenza kwezikhungo okufana nama-ATM kudinga wonke umuntu ukuba athinteke. Ngikholelwa ukuthi uma sithatha isinyathelo sokuqhuba izinguquko ezinqala, sithole imiphakathi eqinile, eyakha isisemkhathini esinemvelo. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lwezikhungo lungasiza ekusizeni umphakathi, ukuphakamisa amandla abantu, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kumphakathi kuyakuma. Izikhungo ezifana nama-ATM zesikhathi esizayo zidinga ukuba zikhulume ngendlela efanele, ukuze zihlale zinquma indaba ezizithathela yona. Sihamba phambili, silungele ukwenza umehluko.
Imithetho ngeke isebenze kumkhumbi othile kanye nezinye. Isahluko sokuqala - Ababambiqhaza embonini yezokuthutha olwandle badinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Imikhumbi esebenza eNingizimu Afrika akufanele ivimbele noma ibambelele ekuphumezeni izinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. UMsunguli-Jikelele angayala ababambiqhaza ukuba baphinde bahlaziye izinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Ukususwa kwezinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle kuyadingeka. Abasebenzi bemikhumbi bangahlaziya izinhlelo zokuphepha zemikhumbi. Ibhodi ingayala abasebenzi bemikhumbi ukuba bahlaziye izinhlelo zokuphepha zemikhumbi. Le mithetho izobizwa ngokuthi Imithetho Yokuhweba Ngomkhumbi (Ubumfihlo Bezokuthutha Olwandle) ka-2004. Lezi ezinye zezimiso ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kwiGovinda Gazette. Ukuze kufezwe le njongo, le mithetho isungula uhlaka oluhlosiwe lokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha zemikhumbi nezinye izinyathelo zokuphepha zokuthutha olwandle. Ukusetshenziswa kwalolu hlaka kuzovumela iRiphabhulikhi ukuba ihlangabezane nezibopho zayo ngaphansi kweSahluko IX - 2 seSivumelwano Sokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Olwandle kanye ne-ISPS Code. Umkhumbi wezimpahla ubhekisela kunoma yimuphi umkhumbi ongumkhumbi wezivakashi, futhi ufaka... umphakathi wokuphatha impahla ubhekisela kumuntu osebenza nempahla esetshenziswa emkhumbini... I-ISSC esemthethweni uma ibhekisela kumikhumbi ngesikhathi esithile ibhekisela ku-ISSC yomkhumbi osebenza ngaleso sikhathi. Ngemigomo yale mithetho, umkhumbi uhlobo olukhuluma ngalo emthethweni-10 1 uthathwa njengokuthi usetshenziswa ukuze uthuthwe olwandle uma usetshenziswa njengomkhumbi walolo hlobo. Iphothi ephethwe ukuze iphephe, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi noma nanoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho le phothi, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi iphethwe noma iphethwe kuphela nguMnyango Wezokuphepha Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha komkhumbi osengozini ngokudlulisela ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Iphothi iyindawo yamanzi, umhlaba namanzi (kuhlanganisa nezakhiwo, imishini exhunywe futhi esebenzayo etholakala kulawo manzi noma umhlaba) ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kuyo yonke noma ingxenye yayo ephathelene nokuhamba, ukulayisha, ukuhambisa, ukugcinwa noma ukuhlinzekwa kwemikhumbi. UMsunguli-Jikelele ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGovinda Gazette, angakhetha umuntu ukuze asebenze ephothini ephethwe ukuze iphephe. c imibono yomuntu, abantu abahilelekile ekuphathweni kokusebenza kwephothi. b umkhumbi ophathwe kwelinye izwe. c indawo yokuwela ehlala noma ekuthuthweni emanzini aseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kugwenywe ukudideka, indawo yokuwela ehlala ebhekiswe emthethweni-1 c ithathwa njengomkhumbi ngemigomo yale mithetho. Imiyalelo yokuphepha inikezwa mayelana nephothi, umkhumbi, indawo, ababambiqhaza noma ukusebenza, amazinga okuphepha akhona aqhubeka nokusebenza. Izimo zezulu zango-2007/2008 - yini ababelana ngemininingwane abayishoyo? Inani lemvula elibhalwe ngonyaka owedlule, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi esibalulekile kusukela ngoJanuwari 2007 kuya kuMashi 2007, belingaphansi kwezinga elibi lika-1992. Kube nezindawo ezifana neGauteng nezingxenye zeMpumalanga ezisentshonalanga ezihlangabezane nezomiso ezifana nalena ka-1912. NgokukaMnu. Johan van den Berg ophuma ku-ARS, kukhona izimpawu ezikhombisa umphumela omkhulu weLa Nina. Kungenzeka ukuthi lo mphumela weLa Nina uzoph持续 kuze kube kwenkanyezi ka-2008. Umphumela walokhu kungaba ukuwa kwemvula okukhulu kusukela ngoDisemba 2007 kuya kuMashi 2008. Izithombe 1 - 3 zikhombisa ithuba lokuthola izinga lemvula ejwayelekile. Izindawo eziphuzi zikhombisa izinga lemvula ejwayelekile, izindawo eziluhlaza zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphezulu kunejwayelekile, kanti izindawo ezinsomi zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphansi kunejwayelekile. Izibikezelo zikhombisa inani elijwayelekile (eliphuzi) elikhuphuka ngaphezu kwejwayelekile (eliluhlaza) ezinyangeni ezizayo. Amathuba okuthola imvula enkulu awamukelekile kahle ngoDisemba 2007 naseJanuwari 2008. Izithombe 1 - 3: Ithuba lokuthola izinga elijwayelekile (%). Ezithombeni 4 - 7, amathuba okuthola ngaphansi kuka-20 mm yemvula ezinsukwini ezithile akhombiswa. Izilinganiso zesikhathi eside zikhonjiswa ngombala obomvu, kanti amathuba wamanje (2007/2008) akhombiswa ngombala oluhlaza. Oluhlaza ukhombisa izikhathi ezinomsebenzi omuhle wokuthola imvula engaphezulu kwejwayelekile. Ngokubheka ukuqhubeka kweLa Nina, imvula enhle ilindeleke ngoDisemba, ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari, nasekuqaleni kukaFebhuwari 2008 naseMashi 2008. Ulwazi oluningi luqoqwe nguMnu. Johan van den Berg ophuma ku-ARS. Ulwazi olungeziwe lungatholakala ku-website yeGrain SA (www.graansa.co.za).
Iphrofayela kaSipho: Uhambo Olukhanyisayo Lokulwa Nokusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa USipho, umfana oneminyaka engu-28, uhlala nomndeni wakhe eThekwini. Wakhulela emndenini ophakathi, lapho ubaba wakhe engumfundisi kanti umama wakhe engumsebenzi wezokwelapha. Lokhu kumenze waba nolwazi olunzulu ngezempilo nokubaluleka kokuphila kahle. Nokho, njengoba edlula ezinsukwini zakhe zokuqala, izinto zashintsha. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezifundo eziphakeme, uSipho wathola umsebenzi omuhle emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Kodwa ke, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, waqala ukuhamba nezingane ezithanda ukuphuma nokujabulela impilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aqale ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa, okwakungakaze kube yinto ayicabangele. Uqala ngeziphuzo ezinamandla, kodwa ngemva kwesikhathi, waqala ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ezinzima. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kwaholela ekutheni uSipho ahlupheke kakhulu. Waqala ukulahlekelwa umsebenzi wakhe, futhi ubudlelwano bakhe nomndeni nabangane baphenduka bubi. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho waba yisithombe esingezwakali kahle, esikhombisa ubuhlungu obukhulu. Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yokuphila kwempilo enobuhlungu, uSipho wathola usizo. Wavakashela emtholampilo wezokwelapha, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abanesimo esifanayo. Uthando lokuphila, kanye nomoya wokulwa, kwamsiza ukuba aqale uhambo lokuphila kabusha. Uthole ukwesekwa okuhle, futhi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo, izinzuzo zokuphila ngendlela enempilo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ngaphandle kwezidakamizwa. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho wathola ukuthi ukulwa nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa akuyona into elula, kodwa kuyinto edinga ukuzimisela. Waqala ukufunda izincwadi eziningi, wahlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokwelapha, futhi wathola umphakathi owamukelayo. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila lukhula, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabangane abasha, abamkhuthazayo. Ngemva kweminyaka emithathu yokulwa, uSipho waphumelela. Waphinde wathola umsebenzi, futhi waba ngumfundisi wezokwelapha, lapho efundisa abanye ngempilo enempilo nokubaluleka kokuphila ngaphandle kwezidakamizwa. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi, noma ngabe ubuhlungu bukhulu kangakanani, kunendlela yokuphila kabusha. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila lukhula, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obusha nabangane abasha, abamkhuthazayo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi, noma ngabe ubuhlungu bukhulu kangakanani, kunendlela yokuphila kabusha.
Izimpi ZamaZulu: Ukuhlola Ulimi Nokuhlonipha Izinhlanga Zethu Izimpi zamaZulu, ezaziwa kakhulu emlandweni, ziwumlando obalulekile, ophinde ubonise ukuzidela, ubuhlakani, nobuqhawe. Lezi zimpi zenzeka phakathi nekhulu le-19, ngesikhathi sokuphikisana phakathi kweZizwe, izimpi zomhlaba, kanye nezinguquko ezazihambisana nezepolitiki. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zimpi zazikhona ngenxa yokulwa; zaziyingxenye yomlando obanzi wezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwaziswa Kwezimpi ZamaZulu Izimpi zamaZulu ziqalile ngonyaka we-1830, lapho uShaka Zulu, umholi ophakeme, eqala ukuhlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo esisodwa. UShaka, owaziwa ngokuqinisa ubuholi bakhe, wakhulisa umphakathi wakwaZulu ngokwakha izikhali ezinamandla, izindlela zokulwa, kanye nokuhlela izimpi. UShaka waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isizwe esiqinile, esaziwa ngokuba nezinhloso ezicacile. Ngemuva kokubulawa kukaShaka ngo-1828, umfowabo uDingane wathatha ubuholi. U-Dingane waba neziqu ezinkulu, kodwa impi eyaziwa kakhulu yenzeka ngonyaka we-1838, ngesikhathi seMpi yaseNcome. Le mpi yahlasela izixuku zamaNgisi, ikakhulukazi iVoortrekkers, ababephuma eKapa. Ngaleso sikhathi, uDingane wayefuna ukuvikela umhlaba wakwaZulu, kodwa impi yaphenduka yaba yinhlekelele. IVoortrekkers, bejabulile ngezinqumo zabo, bahlasela iNcome, kwaholela ekubulaweni kwamaZulu abaningi. Izimbangela Zokulwa Izimpi zamaZulu zazihambisana nezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi nempumelelo kwezomnotho, ukungaboni ngaso linye kwezombusazwe, kanye nezifiso ezihlukene zezinhlanga. Ukuphikisana phakathi kweZizwe kwakhuthaza izimpi, njengoba amaZulu ezama ukuvikela umhlaba wabo, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zokuphila. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izimpi zibe yindlela yokuphikisa, yokuzama ukuphila, nokulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. Iziphumo Nezimpilo ZamaZulu Izimpi zashiya umphakathi wakwaZulu unokuhlukumezeka okukhulu. Ngemva kweMpi yaseNcome, amaZulu abhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, kuhlanganisa ukulahlekelwa kwemithombo yokuphila, izinsiza, kanye nezwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni zabo ukuze baphile. Nokho, izimpi zakhuthaza umoya wokuzidela, ubumbano, nokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Ukwamukela Umqondo Wokuhlonipha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimpi zamaZulu zaba yinkumbulo yokuhlonipha. Izinsuku zokuqhubeka kwempi zaba yizinsuku zokuhlonipha, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bakhumbule abaholi babo, izimpi zabo, kanye nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umoya wokuhlonipha, ukuqonda, nokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwezinhlanga. Ukubaluleka Komlando Umqondo wezimpilo zamaZulu ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungakha kanjani, ukulwa, nokwakha izindlela zokuphila. Izimpi zifundisa abantu ukuthi ubuholi, ukuhlela, nokuhlalisana kwezizwe kudinga ukuqonda nokubambisana. Umhlaba wamaZulu ungumlando wezinto eziningi, futhi izimpi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale bephila ngokuhlonipha, benza izinqumo ezihloniphekile, futhi bahlale bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Isiphetho Izimpi zamaZulu ziwumlando ophawulekayo, ogcwele izifundo ezibalulekile. Zifundisa abantu ukuthi impi ingaphezu kokulwa; iyindlela yokwakha, yokuhlonipha, nokugcina isiko. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lezi zifundo, sihlole indlela esingakha ngayo umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Umlandweni wamaZulu kufanele uhlale uhlonishwa, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbule izimpilo zabantu bethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukusebenza Ukude Ezinkampanini ZaseNingizimu Afrika Ukusebenza ukude, okuyinto evame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-remote work, sekuyinto ejwayelekile emhlabeni wonke. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, le mikhuba ibonakala ihambisana nezimo ezithile ezivela emlandweni, uhlanga, nemigomo yezezimali. Ukuze siqonde kahle izimpande zokusebenza ukude kuleli, kubalulekile ukucabangela izigameko zomlando ezithintekayo ezilethe lezi zinguquko ezinkampanini zethu. Ngemuva kokuphela kwezimpi zenkululeko, eNingizimu Afrika, leli zwe lathola izindlela zokwakha emikhakheni ehlukene. Nokho, abantu abaningi babebhekene nezinkinga zokufuna umsebenzi. Umsebenzi wanamuhla waqala ukuvela kubantu abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imisebenzi esemthethweni. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, izinkampani zikhula, kodwa zikhona nezinselelo ezithinta abantu kanye nezikhungo ezithola ukuqashwa. Ngesikhathi sokulungiswa kwezimali, izimboni ezinjenge-IT zathuthuka, zenza ukuthi izinkampani zifune izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto ukuze zikhule. Kwakukhona ukwakhiwa kwezinkampani eziningi ezibhaliswe kwi-inthanethi, okuhlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi kumakhasimende ahlukahlukene. Ukuze zisebenze kahle, izinkampani zathi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuba abantu basebenze ezindaweni ezikude, kubandakanya izindawo zasemakhaya nasemadolobheni. Ngokukhula kwamathuba okusebenza ukude, izinkampani ezinkulu eNingizimu Afrika zathola izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamathuba okuvana umsebenzi kumuntu okude. Uhlelo lwezimpahla, ezamalungelo, nolwempilo lwenza kube nesithakazelo ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza ezinkampanini ezikude. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni abantu, nabanye ababephila ezimweni ezinzima, bathole amathuba amaningana emisebenzi. Ngemuva kokuphuma kwemicimbi ye-COVID-19, izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukusebenza ukude kwakuyisixazululo esiphumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni amalungu ezinkampani aqale ukuqonda ukuthi ukude kusebenza kahle, futhi kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali, ukunciphisa izindleko, nemisebenzi yokuxhumana. Izinhlangano zathola izindlela zokusebenza ukude, okuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwezinkampani ukuze kubonakale ukufaneleka kwabantu emsebenzini. Noma kunjalo, ibhizinisi eliseNingizimu Afrika lenza kube nzima ukufakazela ukuthi izinkampani zingakwazi ukwenza ukundirhiza okwenziwe. Ukuze ziqinisekise ukusebenza kahle, izinkampani zinezinhlelo ezithile ezinesithunzi. Lokhu kube nomthelela ekuxhumaneni, nokwakhiwa kwemibono yokusebenza okude kochwepheshe. Ngokuqhubeka, izingozi eziphathelene nemisebenzi ecindezelayo ziqhamuka, zikhuthaza izinkampani ukuba zifeze imisebenzi ethile ukuze zithuthukise ukuqonda kokusebenza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukufunda kule modeli ye-remote work kuvulelwe izinkampani ezinkulu nezincane ukufaka inzuzo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene, kubonisa ukuthi izinkampani eNingizimu Afrika ziqala ukwenza ushintsho oluhamba phambili emisebenzini yazo. Namuhla, ukuqhubeka kwenhlanhla yokusebenza ukude kunomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini ezimbonini ezahlukene. Abantu bahlola amakhono nezinto ezithintekayo, okuvulela amathuba okuthi baqonde indlela yokusebenza eNingizimu Afrika, basheshe baphinde bashintshe imicabango yabo. Ekugcineni, ukwakha isithombe esicacile ngesimo sokusebenza ukude ezinkampanini nasezindaweni zethu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana okuhle, nesimo esikhona. Lezi zinto zibalulekile ukuze kudaleke umphakathi ohlanganyela, onobuchwepheshe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaqhinga ahambelana namazinga okusungula. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuholela ezinkampanini ezinkulu nezincane eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenza ukude ezinkampanini eNingizimu Afrika akukabi ngamathuba kuphela, kodwa kusemkhakheni ophumelelayo, ophelele, nowezinzile. Ibhizinisi, umphakathi, kanye nabantu kufanele baqhubeke nokusebenzisa lokhu ukuze kuncitshiswe izinkinga, futhi ukufinyelele ezindaweni ezimbi emhlabeni wezinkampani. Ukusebenza ukude kudinga ubuchwepheshe nemikhuba esebenzayo, ukuqinisekisa umphakathi owodwa, kuyabaluleka emzuzwini ohlangene.
Imicimbi Yomphakathi: Ukuhlonipha, Ukuxhumana Nokwakha Ubudlelwano Imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba iyindlela yokuhlanganyela, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Le micimbi ingaba yinhlekelele, imicimbi yokugubha, izinkonzo, noma imicimbi yokufundisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha isithombe esihle somphakathi. Ukwakhiwa Komphakathi Imicimbi yomphakathi ivame ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bakha izixhumanisi ezinamandla, okwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nokuxazulula izinkinga ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi efana nezinsuku zokugubha, imikhosi, nemihlangano yokuxoxa ngezindaba zomphakathi. Ukwabelana Ngolwazi Imicimbi yomphakathi iyindawo efanele yokwabelana ngolwazi. Lokhu kungaba ukufundisa abantu ngezinto ezahlukene, njengezempilo, imfundo, noma izindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangafunda izinto ezintsha, bathole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, futhi bakhulise ulwazi lwabo. Imicimbi efana nezinkulumo, izifundo, noma imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukwakha Umoya Wokubambisana Umoya wokubambisana uyisisekelo somphakathi ophumelelayo. Imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni lo moya, njengoba abantu behlangana ukuze basebenzisane, baphinde baxhumane. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, obungaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle. Imicimbi efana nemikhosi yokuzijabulisa, imidlalo, noma imicimbi yokuzithandela ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana. Ukwenza Umehluko Imicimbi yomphakathi ingaba nethonya elikhulu empilweni yabantu. Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangakwazi ukwenza umehluko ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kungaba ukufaka isandla ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ukusiza abanye, noma ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Imicimbi efana nezinsuku zokuzithandela, imicimbi yokusiza, noma imihlangano yokuxoxa ngezinkinga zomphakathi ibalulekile ekwenzeni umehluko. Ukukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Nobulungiswa Imicimbi yomphakathi ingaba yindlela yokukhuthaza ubulungiswa nobulungiswa. Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, baphinde baphakamise izwi labo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokukhuthaza izinguquko ezinhle, eziholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Imicimbi efana nemihlangano yokuxoxa ngezindaba zomphakathi, izinkulumo, noma imicimbi yokukhuthaza ubulungiswa ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ukwamukela Izinhlanga Nezamasiko Ezingafani Imicimbi yomphakathi iyindlela yokwamukela izinhlanga nezamasiko ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokufunda nokuhlonipha amasiko ahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi. Imicimbi efana nemikhosi yokugubha amasiko, izinkulumo, noma imihlangano yokwabelana ngamasiko ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukugcina Ubudlelwano Obuqinile Ngemuva kwemicimbi yomphakathi, kubalulekile ukugcina ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kungaba ngokuxhumana njalo, ukwabelana ngolwazi, noma ukuhlela eminye imicimbi. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buvumela abantu ukuthi bahlale bexhumene, baphinde bakhuthazane. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Isiphetho Imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba ihlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlanganyela, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangakwazi ukwabelana ngolwazi, bakhe umoya wokubambisana, benze umehluko, futhi bakhuthaze ubulungiswa. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale bejabulela imicimbi yomphakathi, njengoba lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuhle.
### Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nokukhula okuhle kwezingane. Le nqubo ibandakanya izinyathelo ezahlukene ezithinta ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukuvikelwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezingane ezincane. Kulokhu, sizoqhubeka sithinta izigaba ezibalulekile zokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa, kusukela ekufikeni kwazo ezibhedlela, kuya ekunakekelweni kwazo. #### Ukufika Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Lapho ingane ifika ezibhedlela, ibhekwa ngochwepheshe bezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abezokwelapha, abahlengikazi, kanye nochwepheshe bezempilo abaneziqu. Ukuqala, ingane ibhekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphilile futhi ayinazo izinkinga eziphuthumayo. Abahlengikazi bahlola isisindo, ukuphila, nezimpawu zempilo zengane. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane iyakwazi ukujabulisa impilo yayo. #### Ukuhlola Nokunakekela Ngemuva kokuhlola, abahlengikazi baphinde baqinisekise ukuthi ingane iyathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina ingane ifudumele, iyakwazi ukuphefumula kahle, nokuyinika ukudla okufanele. Uma ingane idinga ukudla, abahlengikazi bahlola ukuthi ingane iyakwazi ukuncela kahle. Uma kudingeka, bangasebenzisa izindlela ezihlukile zokudla, njengokusebenzisa ifomula yokudla uma ingane ingakwazi ukuncela kahle. #### Ukuxhumana Nezingane Ukuxhumana nezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kubalulekile. Abazali bencike kakhulu ekuxhumaneni nezingane zabo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba abahlengikazi bahlale beqaphele. Uxhumano oluhle phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabazali lwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezithile. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi bangabakhulumela kanjani abahlengikazi uma benemibuzo noma bekhathazekile ngezimpilo zezingane zabo. #### Ukuvikelwa Kwezingane Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akugcini nje ngokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuvikelwa kwezingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvikela izingane ezinsongweni ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nezifo, ukuvuvukala, noma izimo zokuphila ezingezinhle. Abahlengikazi bahlola izimpawu zokugula futhi benza izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane ivikelekile. #### Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Ngaphezu kokunakekelwa kwezempilo, abahlengikazi banomsebenzi wokuthuthukisa izinga lokukhula kwezingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina izingane zikhula kahle, zikhula ngokomzimba, nangokwengqondo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abahlengikazi bahlola izindlela zokukhula, izidingo zokudla, kanye nezimo zokuphila. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezingane luhlanganisa izindlela zokukhuthaza ukukhula okuhle, ezifana nokubamba izingane, ukuhlinzeka ngezinto zokudlala, nokuxhumana. #### Ukunakekelwa Kwabazali Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akupheli kuphela ezingeni lezingane, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukunakekela abazali. Abazali badinga ukwesekwa ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi bangabakhulumela kanjani abahlengikazi, bazi ukuthi yini okufanele bayilindele, futhi baqonde izinqubo ezihambisanayo. Abahlengikazi bangenza izinkulumo ezibalulekile nabazali ukuze baqondise izinqubo zokunakekela izingane zabo. #### Ukuqhubeka Nokunakekela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akupheli lapho ingane isitholele impilo. Ukuqhubeka nokunakekela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane iyakhula kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlolwa okuvamile, ukufundiswa kwabazali, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi bangabakhulumela kanjani abahlengikazi uma bekhathazekile. Ukuze ingane ikwazi ukujabulisa impilo yayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abahlengikazi baqhubeke nokunakekela. #### Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nokukhula okuhle. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabazali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zethu zikhula zibe nekhono, ziqinile, futhi zihlala ziphilile. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane akuyona nje umsebenzi wezempilo, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke.
Amalungelo Abantu Besifazane Ngokuhlanganyela, umphakathi wonke uzokwakha umcimbi obalulekile, ogcizelela amalungelo abantu besifazane. Lo mcimbi uzobanjelwa endaweni edumile, ezungezwe imvelo enhle, ngempelasonto ezayo, umhla ziyi-25 kuMfumfu ngo-2023. Ngomoya opholile, lo mcimbi uzohlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene nabazinhlekelele, ukuze baxoxe ngamalungelo abantu besifazane, futhi babonise ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi. Umcimbi uzovula iminyango ngengxenye yokuqala, efana nesithangami sokuqala. Lapha, sizoba nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu abacha umqondo, abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Umdlaliso wezinkulumo uzokhombisa izifundo ezahlukene ezikhuluma ngamalungelo, uthando, kanye nokuphumelela kwabantu besifazane. Izinkulumo zazo zizonikeza imibono ehlukahlukene, kugxilwe ekuthuthukiseni amalungelo abantu besifazane, nasekugqugquzeleni imiphakathi ukuba ibambisene ukuze ihlukanise izithiyo ezikhona. Ngemva kokukhuluma, sizobe sihamba siye engxenyeni yesibili yomcimbi, lapho sizophothula imibono ngemicabango ethile yokwenza impilo yabesifazane ibe ngcono. Kulendawo, izethameli zizoba nethuba lokubandakanya, ukuthola izixazululo ezivela ezindaweni zabo. Izifundiswa, abezindaba, kanye nomphakathi uzobhekelela ukuba asebenze eduze ukuphakamisa izimfuno zabo. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba lokuhlola izinhlelo, izinhlelo, kanye nezindlela zokwakha amandla abesifazane emiphakathini yabo. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma, sizoba nezinhlelo ezihlekisayo ukuze kugqugquzelwe umoya. Umculi odumile uzokwenza umculo ophilayo, udweba izinxenye zomphakathi, ubesho nezindaba eziphathelene namalungelo abantu besifazane.
