Lokhu kuzobandakanya nezokuxhumana, ukuqinisekiswa kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abangaphakathi komcimbi, ukuze umoya wezokuxhumana ukhule. Umgomo wethu ngeqophelomphakathi lokuvakasha ukuthi wonke umuntu azizwe evulekile, ekhululekile, futhi ebambisene. Umcimbi uzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumanisa abantu, ukukhuthaza uhlu lwezinhlelo ezinzima ezenzakalayo eduze kwempilo yabantu besifazane. Ngaphandle kwalokho, lokhu kuzobangela ukuzimisela okukhulu kokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kokugqoka izigqi ezintsha nokwakha amaqembu athuthukayo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uzobamba umsebenzi wokuvivinya izinhlelo ezenzakalayo eziphathelene nezinhlelo zokwakha amandla abesifazane. Sizofaka umkhankaso ophakathi komphakathi, lapho wonke umuntu angabamba iqhaza, ekutholeni izizathu ezithile zokuphakamisa amalungelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ithuluzi lokwazisa, elizokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela emihle kwabantu besifazane. Ngaleso sikhathi, sobala lokho kwehluka, sizoba nedlanzana lezintokazi ezizokhuluma ngendlela abezwe ngayo emhlabeni. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba lokuba uphakamise izwi lakho, unikeze ezinye izixazululo zokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu besifazane. Ukuhamba phambili, sihlanganyela izisiphetho ezimaphakathi, sibe neqhaza elicatshangelwayo emuva kwempi yezinhlupho. Umgomo omkhulu walo mcimbi ungukwakha isimo esihle sokuphila, lapho amalungelo abantu besifazane eh重. Umcebo walesi sikhathi, amathuba makhulu kulezi zinkulumo azoba umphumela omkhulu wokuthola ukufinyelela ezinqolobaneni zabo. Ngakho-ke, nansi indlela esizothokozisa ngayo imiphakathi, sibe neqhaza elisha lokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu besifazane. Njengomphakathi, sizokhuthaza ukuhwebelana, isimo esihlangene, ukuze sibe nesibopho sokuphakamisa abesifazane. Siyakwemukela wonke umuntu, yiba nathi ezinsukwini ezithokozisayo, lapho sizokwakha khona umoya ohloniphekile, nosuku lokwazisa amalungelo abantu besifazane. Kwesokudla, sizokwenza umphakathi uzwe ubaluleki bakhe, nakanjani uzoba nomthelela. Chelacela!
Izitifiketi Zobungcweti Zabasebenzi Bakahulumeni Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elaziwa ngokuthi uThukela, elalikhula kancane kancane, futhi lalinabantu abanothando emsebenzini kahulumeni. Kulokhu, abanye babantu babenobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, kodwa babengazi ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti zingabavulela amathuba amaningi. Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi uMnumzane Dlamini, umphakathi onothando, ethola ithuba lokuvakashela ezikhungweni ezahlukene ukuze aqonde kabanzi ngalezi zitifiketi. U-Dlamini wayengumfundisi ophumelelayo, futhi wayenothando lokufundisa. Wazi kahle ukuthi ukufundisa akupheli ekilasini kuphela, kodwa kudinga izitifiketi ezikhombisa ukuthi uyakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe ngendlela efanele. Ngakho, wathola ithuba lokuhambela umhlangano owawuhlelwe yihhovisi likamasipala, lapho kwakukhulunywa khona ngalezi zitifiketi. Ngesikhathi umhlangano uqala, uDlamini wathola ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zibalulekile kakhulu. Zikhombisa ukuthi umuntu unolwazi olufanele, kanye nezifundo ezithile ezithathwe ukuze abe nokuqonda okujulile emsebenzini wakhe. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuba bathole imisebenzi, futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lemisebenzi kahulumeni. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uDlamini waphuma emhlanganweni ethokozile. Waqonda ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi wathola umuzwa wokuthi kufanele aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe. Wazi ukuthi izitifiketi zingamvulela amathuba amasha, futhi wakhumbula izinkumbulo ezinhle zokufunda. Waqala ukuhlela indlela yokuthola lezi zitifiketi. Uhlanga lwakhe lwaluhambela phambili, wathola izifundo ezahlukene ezitholakala ezikhungweni zokufunda. Waqala ngezifundo ezimayelana nezokuphathwa kwemali, ngoba wayekwazi ukuthi ukuphathwa kwemali kahle kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni komsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, wathola izifundo eziphathelene nezokuxhumana, ukuze akwazi ukuhlela kahle imihlangano nokuxhumana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, uDlamini waqala ukubona izinguquko empilweni yakhe. Wathola izitifiketi eziningi, futhi lokhu kwakhuthaza abanye abantu bendawo. Abantu baqala ukuza kuye befuna izeluleko, bejabulile ngempumelelo yakhe. Waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ukufunda nokuthola izitifiketi kungakhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke phambili. Ngesikhathi sokuhamba phambili, uDlamini wathola ithuba lokusebenza ehhovisi likamasipala. Lokhu kwaba yiphupho eliphilayo, futhi wathola ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi alutholile. Waqonda ukuthi izitifiketi azizange zibe yinsiza kuphela, kodwa zaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye. Waqala ukusebenza nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi lokho kwaba yithuba lokufunda okuningi. Naphezu kokuthi uDlamini wayenempumelelo, wayengakaze forget abantu ababephila nezimo ezinzima. Waqonda ukuthi abanye abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zokufunda, futhi wathola umqondo wokubasiza. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokufundisa ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezindaweni eziphansi ukuba bathole izitifiketi zobungcweti. Ngemva kokuhlela izinhlelo, uDlamini wahlangana nabantu abaningi, wabaqondisa ngendlela yokufunda. Wabafundisa ukuthi izitifiketi zikhona ukuze zibavulele amathuba, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bangayeki ukufunda. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokwakha umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi abanye abantu baqala ukuthola imisebenzi emihle. Ngemuva kweminyaka, uDlamini waba ngumholi ophumelelayo emiphakathini yakhe. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bafunde, futhi wathola izitifiketi eziningi ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene. Wazi kahle ukuthi izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni azikhombisi kuphela ulwazi, kodwa zikhombisa ukuzinikela nokusebenza kanzima. Ekugcineni, uDlamini waba nesithakazelo esikhulu sokuba nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Wazi ukuthi izitifiketi zazingamvulela amathuba, kodwa zaziwa nangokuhlonipha. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enobuchwepheshe, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ukufunda akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni. Ngale ndlela, izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zaba umphumela omuhle, futhi zashintsha impilo kaDlamini nabanye abantu bendawo. Uthando lokufunda, kanye nezifundo ezitholakele, kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo sokuthi izitifiketi zikhona ukuze zithuthukise impilo yabantu, zikhulise amathuba, futhi ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu.
Abaholi Bezepolitiki: Indlela Yokuhola Nokuqondisa Izwe Abaholi bezepolitiki bangabantu ababalulekile emphakathini, njengoba benza izinqumo ezithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abaholi bezepolitiki bahlala bephakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta umnotho, ezemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezokuphepha. Ukuze siqonde kahle indima yabo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezihlobene nabo, izimfanelo ezidingekayo, kanye nemithelela abaholi bezepolitiki abayenza emphakathini. Izici Zabaholi Bezepolitiki Abaholi bezepolitiki bahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abaholi bezwe, abaholi bendawo, kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano ezizimele. Abaholi bezwe, njengobongameli noma abaphathiswa, banomthwalo omkhulu wokuhola izwe. Baphethe izinqumo ezinkulu ezithinta izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, ezemfundo, nezempilo. Abaholi bendawo, njengababheki bezifunda, bahlala beqondisa izinhlelo ezithinta izindawo ezithile, kanti abaholi bezinhlangano ezizimele, njengezinhlangano zomphakathi, bahlala bephakamisa izwi labantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Izimfanelo Eziyinhloko Zabaholi Bezepolitiki Ukuze abaholi bezepolitiki baphumelele, kudingeka babe nezimfanelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ubuholi obuqinile buhamba phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaholi kufanele babe nekhono lokuhola abantu, benze izinqumo ezinzima, futhi bakwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizokwenza izwe libe ngcono. Okwesibili, abaholi kufanele babe nekhono lokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuxhumana kahle nabantu, bezwakalisa izinjongo zabo, futhi bathole impendulo evela kubantu. Okwesithathu, abaholi bezepolitiki kufanele babe nekhono lokuhlola izimo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, bahlaziye izizathu zazo, futhi bathole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Umthelela Wabaholi Bezepolitiki Emphakathini Umthelela wabaholi bezepolitiki empilweni yabantu ungakhula noma uncishiswe, kuye ngokuthi bahola kanjani. Uma abaholi benza izinqumo ezinhle, lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokwenza izinhlelo ezithinta ezemfundo zibe ngcono. Ngokuphambene, uma abaholi benza izinqumo ezingalungile, lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga, njengokukhula kwezinga lokungasebenzi, ukwehla kwezinga lemfundo, kanye nokwanda kwezinkinga zempilo. Izinkinga Abaholi Bezepolitiki Ababhekana Nazo Abaholi bezepolitiki bahlala bebhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu abaholi abahlangabezana nazo yizinkinga zezimali. Ukuze benze izinhlelo ezithinta abantu, kudingeka kube nezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kungaba nzima uma izwe libhekene nezinkinga zezimali. Okwesibili, abaholi bahlala bebhekene nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Abantu bahlala benemibono ehlukene, futhi abaholi kufanele bakwazi ukuphendula kulokhu ukuze bagcine ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Okwesithathu, abaholi bezepolitiki bahlala bebhekene nezinkinga zokuphikiswa. Abaholi abavumelani nabo bangase baphikise izinqumo zabo, okungaholela ekudidekeni nasekuphazamiseni izinhlelo. Isiphetho Abaholi bezepolitiki banendima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Baphethe izinqumo ezinkulu ezithinta izimpilo zabantu, futhi umthelela wabo ungaba mkhulu. Ukuze baphumelele, kudingeka babe nezimfanelo ezifanele, bakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo, futhi bahlale bexhumana kahle nomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde indima yabaholi bezepolitiki, ukuze bakwazi ukuxhasa, ukuphikisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo ezinqumweni zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu nabaholi, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izwe.
Ifilimu - Ihlanganyela Emhlabeni Wethu Okwamanje, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, akufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ifilimu yindawo ethokozisayo lapho imicabango, imizwa, nemibono ihlangana khona. Ngiyakhumbula ngesikhathi ngibona ifilimu yami yokuqala, ngabe sengizizwa ngizungezwe yizwe elisha, imisebenzi, nemigudu ethokozisayo. Lokhu kunika umuntu ithuba lokuphuma empilweni yabo yansuku zonke, kube ukufaka incwadi embhalweni ebhalwe ngefoni. Kukhona okuthile ngefilimu eyenza kube lula ukuyithanda. Kukhona labo abahamba beyiseka, benza izibopho nemicabango mayelana nezindaba ezahlukene. Ukukwazi ukufaka izinga lesimo sokukhuluma, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ifilimu ayigcini nje ngokuba yinto yokubhiyozela, kodwa iyinqwaba yezimvo ezenzakalayo. Kungaba ukuthi ibonisa imizwelo, izinselelo, noma izifundo ezibalulekile empilweni yethu. Kunezikhathi lapho ifilimu ibamba izimpilo zethu, ikakhulukazi uma ifilimu ithinta izihloko esizijabulele. Njengomuntu ofisa ukufunda ngemikhiqizo emihle yokubhala, ngizwa ukuthi ifilimu iyindlela enhle yokucubungula izindaba. Ithokozisa futhi imnandi, ifaka umqondo wokwazisa ngobumu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ifilimu ivumela abaculi ukuthi babelane namakhono abo, eqondise emphakathini, lapho kwenziwa khona ukuxoxa izindaba ezithinta njengezothando, ubudlelwano, nobudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Akukaze kube nzima ukuxoxa ngezinto ezibuhlungu kodwa zibalulekile empilweni. Ubadlali bethu, noma amaqhawe ethu, baveza izimfundiso ezinkulu, kanti lokho kuhlobene nangendlela abahamba ngayo kulezi zinsuku. Abadlalayo banika ubuchwepheshe obujulile kwazulu ukuze sikwazi ukuzwisisa imizwa, izinselelo nezincwadi ezihlobene. Umdlalo ungase ube nzima, kodwa ukuhamba phakathi kwenhlekelele kuyasithokozisa, kusikhumbuza ukusinda. Ngokuqinisekile, uma senza umqondo wokuhlaziya ifilimu, sizobona izindima ezihlukene zokuphila. Okwanda kwandi, izindawo ezisobala, nezimo zomphakathi – konke kuveza uhlobo oluthile lokuphila, okuyinto edingekayo ukuze sikhulume. Abalandi bembula izimo, kanti ifilimu iyakwazi ukuveza umbono othokozisayo, umnco, nomcabango ophosisiwe. Kodwa, asikhumbuli ukuthi ifilimu akukhona kuphela okwenzeka esikrinini; kusukela kuqhamuka ucingo oludingekayo kokuthile okufanayo, kuveza ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi komphakathi. Ngenhliziyo, imizwa ixhumana, nobudlelwano bukhazimulisa. Abadingi bethu bangavela ezimweni ezahlukene, kodwa nabaphi emhlabeni bahlala behlaselwa yizimo zempilo. Kubantu abakhumbulayo, ifilimu iyindlela yokuzihlanganisa. Ngaphandle kokukhumbula, sikhumbula ukuthinta kwethu. Imininingwane ibonakala, izinhlelo zingavela uma abanye bephila. Njengoba sikhuluma ngabo, sizoba nabantu abanokukhumbula, abahlangene empilweni ezinzima. Lokhu kugcizelela umbono wokuhlobisa umkhawulo, sidinga ukuqonda lokhu. Ngaphambi kokuba sihambe, khona-ke, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi uma ifilimu iboniswa, impilo iphenduka, icacile futhi ibonisa umbono. Uma sizama ukudlula, sizobona ukuthi uma sikhuluma, sizoba nokudlula kumimbo. Ngaphandle kwezinsuku eziminabili ukuze ungayibonisi ifilimu, somlomo, ibalulekile, iyafundwa, ikhuthaza futhi ibalulekile ukuze sifeze umphakathi. Ngakho, ngizokhuluma kuphela ngendlela ifilimu ibonisa ngayo. Njengoba sisiba nefula, sithola izibonelo ezilula ezidingekayo ukuze sakhe izinyathelo ezinzima. Ngisho, ukuhambahamba kubalulekile, okwenza ifilimu iyinqaba yokwazi. Iqala ngezinyathelo eziphakeme, ikhathele, ithule, kodwa ayifuni ukukhumbuza. Ngemali, zingaba ukushaya izinyathelo, nakuhtse, sizokwazi ukuqonda nezinto ezilungile. Ngalokhu, ngiyabonga, futhi umhlaba wethu unendlela ehluke ngendlela ifilimu iba khona. Ngempela, ifilimu iyisikhumbuzo esiwusizo sokuhamba phambili, ngemibono, izimoto, nemicabango ehambelanayo. Ngakho, abantu, bazi ukuthi uma ufisa ukusizakala, ukuqonda ifilimu kuyaphumelela, sidlule lapho ukwazi ukuhlola. Lokhu kuzokwenza ezinye izinyathelo, ukuze sikhumbule kabusha, sithathe imikhiqizo emisha yokukhumbula. Kuzocacisa kwesikhashana, ifilimu ibalulekile ukudlulisa umlayezo, ikhethiwe phakathi kwalesi sikhathi eside. Hamba uyodlula, uphinde ube ngumuntu ophumelelayo. Futhi kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi ifilimu ingathokozisa noma ikhulume ngemizwa eyahluka phakathi kwezikhathi. Ibhizinisi lidinga izinyathelo, kuningi okuthokozisayo okubhalwe – ifilimu isiyindawo yokwakha, okwenza kube nomuzwa endabeni yokukhuluma. Ngakho-ke, baphila, amakhono kufuneka ahanjiswe phambili, nefilimu ibonise umncintiswano ophumile. Kukhona ukuvusa emhlabeni wakho. Ngithanda ifilimu. Wena?
Isingeniso Ukungondleki ezinganeni kuyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi emazweni ase-Afrika, lapho impilo yezingane ibhekwa njengento ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi nokudla okwanele, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni zempilo, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Ukungondleki akuhlanganisi nje ukungabi nokudla, kodwa kubandakanya nezimo eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezihambisana nokungondleki ezinganeni. Izimbangela zokungondleki Izimbangela zokungondleki ezinganeni zingahlukaniswa zibe yizigaba ezahlukene. Okokuqala, izimo zomnotho zidlala indima ebalulekile. Emazweni amaningi ase-Afrika, izinga lokuhlupheka liphezulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuze abazali bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono ezinganeni zabo. Ukuntula amathuba emisebenzi, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kahle, konke lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni amandla okuthola ukudla nokunakekela izingane. Okwesibili, izinkinga zempilo zomphakathi nazo zifaka isandla ekungondleki. Izifo ezinjengokukhulelwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle, konke lokhu kuthinta impilo yengane. Ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kuholela ekunciphiseni izinga lempilo lemindeni, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni ezincane. Imiphumela yokungondleki Imiphumela yokungondleki ezinganeni ibaluleke kakhulu. Izingane ezithola ukudla okunganele ziba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuleni kwazo nasekuthuthukiseni impilo yazo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okuphumelela ezimpilweni zabo. Izingane ezikhula zingakhula zibe nezinkinga zempilo, ezifana nezinkinga zokuthuthuka kwezingqondo, izifo eziyingozi, kanye nezinkinga zokucindezeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungondleki kukhulu kakhulu emiphakathini, njengoba izingane ezikhula zingakwazi ukuhamba phambili ukuze zifunde, ziqhubele phambili ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungondleki kungenza kube nzima ukuthi izingane zifinyelele emfundweni. Uma izingane zinganakiwe, ziba nezinkinga zokugxila, okwenza kube nzima ukufunda kahle. Lokhu kubangela ukwehla kwezinga lemfundo, okukhokelela ekungatholakali kwamathuba emisebenzi ezikhathini ezizayo. Izixazululo zokulwisana nokungondleki Ukuze kulwisane nokungondleki ezinganeni, izixazululo ezihambisanayo kumele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele anakekele izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni ezihluphekayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuyisisekelo, ukuxhasa imindeni ngezinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqinisa umnotho. Ukuhlelwa kwezinhlelo ezibhekiswe ekwenzeni umnotho ube namandla kuyasiza ekunciphiseni izinga lokuhlupheka, okukhuthaza impilo engcono yezingane. Okwesibili, izinkampani ezizimele nezinhlelo zomphakathi zingadlala indima enkulu ekulwisaneni nokungondleki. Ngokuqinisa imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukudla okunempilo, ukulethwa kwezinsiza zokunakekela impilo, kanye nokufundisa abazali ngokuqwashisa ngemfundo yokudla, izinkampani zingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ukungondleki ezinganeni kuyinkinga eqhubekayo, edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuze sikhiphe izingane emiphumeleni emibi yokungondleki, kumele kuqashelwe izimbangela eziyisisekelo, kucutshungulwe imiphumela, futhi kube nezinqubomgomo ezihamba phambili. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphelele. Njengoba sithuthukisa izimo zokuphila ezinganeni, sithuthukisa futhi ikusasa lempilo yomphakathi jikelele.
Umbuzo: Yini iPitoli? Impendulo: IPitoli, okuyinhloko-dolobha yaseNingizimu Afrika, iyidolobha elinemininingwane eminingi, ngokwezimfanelo zembali, amasiko, nezinsiza. Le dolobha, engaziwa nangokuthi "iPitoli," itholakala emlandweni njengeyindawo yokuhweba, izimboni, kanye nemfundo. Isebenzelana nezintaba zeMagaliesberg eningizimu ye-Afrika, futhi iyisikhungo sezokuphila, ezokuthutha, nezamasiko. --- Umbuzo: Yini eyenza iPitoli ibe yindawo ebalulekile? Impendulo: IPitoli ibalulekile ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, iyinhloko-dolobha, kusho ukuthi inezikhungo eziningi zikaHulumeni. Okwesibili, iPitoli iyindawo yokuhweba enezimakethe ezinkulu nezinkampani eziningi. Okwesithathu, inezikhungo zemfundo eziphakeme, njenge-University of Pretoria, ezikhuthaza ukufunda nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. --- Umbuzo: Yiziphi izindawo ezithandwayo ePitoli? Impendulo: Ezinye zezindawo ezithandwayo ePitoli zifaka iUnion Buildings, okuyindawo yokuhlala kaMongameli, kanye nePretoria Botanical Gardens, lapho abantu bengathokozela khona ubuhle bemvelo. IVoortrekker Monument ibalulekile, ibonisa umlando wama-Afrikaans. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindawo zokudla, izitolo, nezimakethe zenza iPitoli ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuvakasha. --- Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinkinga ezibhekene nePitoli? Impendulo: Njengoba kwenzeka ezindaweni ezinkulu, iPitoli ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Ukungasebenzi, ubumpofu, nezinkinga zokuhlala kuyatholakala. Ukwengeza, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo nokuhamba kwemoto kungaba nomthelela empilweni yabantu. Nokho, uhulumeni nabanye abahlanganyeli basebenza ndawonye ukuthuthukisa lezi zinkinga. --- Umbuzo: IPitoli ibonisa kanjani amasiko? Impendulo: IPitoli ibonisa ukuhlukahluka kwamasiko. Ihlangene nezizwe eziningi, okwenza kube nempucuko ecebile. Izinkonzo zamasiko, imicimbi, nemikhosi yamasiko zenzeka njalo, zikhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi efana neHeritage Day, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze babonise amasiko abo. --- Umbuzo: Yini ethokozisayo ngempilo yokuhlala ePitoli? Impendulo: Impilo yokuhlala ePitoli inezinzuzo eziningi. Izinsiza zempilo ezitholakalayo, izikole ezinhle, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa zenza kube lula ukuhlala kuleli dolobha. Abantu bangathokozela izindawo zokuphumula, izinkanyezi ezinhle, nezindawo zokudlela ezihlukahlukene. Ukuze kucaciswe, iPitoli inezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzivocavoca nemicimbi yokuhlanganyela. --- Umbuzo: Uphi umbono wesikhathi esizayo sePitoli? Impendulo: Uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo sePitoli lubonisa ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Uhulumeni ubeka imigomo yokwakha izinsiza ezinhle, ukuthuthukisa izokuthutha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izindawo zokuhlala. Lokhu kuzokwenza iPitoli ibe yindawo engcono yokuhlala, ukusebenza, nokuvakasha. Abantu basePitoli bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, onobungane, nolwazi. --- Umbuzo: Ngabe iPitoli iyindawo efanele ukuvakashelwa? Impendulo: Yebo, iPitoli iyindawo efanele ukuvakashelwa. Noma ungumuntu ofuna ukufunda ngempilo yamasiko, noma umvakashi ofuna ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo, iPitoli inakho konke. Izindawo zayo ezinhle, izinsiza ezithokozisayo, kanye nomoya ophilayo kwenza kube yindawo ethokozisayo yokuhlala. Ngakho-ke, uma ucabanga ngendawo yokuvakasha, iPitoli iyisinqumo esihle. --- Ngakho, iPitoli iyinhloko-dolobha enothile ngamasiko, izinsiza, nezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo. Ngaphezu kokuba yindawo yokuhlala, ibalulekile emlandweni nasekuthuthukiseni ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika. Abantu bayo bahlala bejolisa ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, okwenza iPitoli ibe yindawo enothile futhi ethokozisayo.
Ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika Ngenkathi uNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, iphrojekthi ye-digital migration ibonakala ibambezeleka, okudala ukukhathazeka kubantu abaningi. Le phrojekthi, ehlose ukuguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ibingumgomo obalulekile kuhulumeni, kodwa izinkinga ezahlukene zivele zaphazamisa inqubekela phambili. Ukudlula ku-analogue kuya ku-digital kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola izinsiza ezintsha nezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokubuka eziphezulu nezokuxhumana. Kodwa-ke, izithiyo ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinkinga zokuxhumana, izinsiza ezindala, kanye nezinguquko eziphuthumayo emthethweni, zibe nomthelela omubi ekwenzeni lokhu kube yimpumelelo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana luhamba phambili, kodwa ukuhluleka kokuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo kwezinsiza kudale ukuthi izigidi zabantu zihlale zingatholi ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kubangele ukunganeliseki kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho izinsiza zokuxhumana zihlala zikhawulelwe. Uhlelo lwe-digital migration luhloselwe ukuqeda ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezindala, okuyinto ethinta kakhulu izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuhluleka kuholele ekubambezelekeni kokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola ulwazi olufanele nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngokwezibalo, cishe u-80% wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika basathola izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezindala, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuxhumana zidinga ukusheshiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Uhlelo lwe-digital migration lwenziwa ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu, kodwa izithiyo ezikhona zibonisa ukuthi kudinga ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nabantu abathintekayo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana lukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana ukuze kube nokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuxhaswa okuqinile kuhulumeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala befinyelela ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisiwe. Umlando we-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika ubuhlungu, njengoba izinhlelo zokuqala zabeziqale eminyakeni edlule, kodwa ziye zabambezeleka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Lokhu kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi iyaphumelela. Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nabahlinzeki bezinsiza ukuze kwandiswe ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzodinga izinhlelo ezicacile, ezisebenzayo, nezisebenziseka kalula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Iziphakamiso ezithile zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ukuze baqonde kahle izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezithuthukisiwe, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi i-digital migration iyaphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuxhumana zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhona ezindaweni zonke, kuhlanganise nezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuzodinga izinsiza ezinkulu, kodwa kuzoba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ekugcineni, ukubambezeleka kwephrojekthi ye-digital migration eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa izinselele ezinkulu ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Nokho, ngokubambisana, kungaba nokwenzeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, futhi kube nokuhamba phambili emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, kanye nabantu abathintekayo kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yephrojekthi ye-digital migration.
Ukwanda Kwezindawo Ezingekho Emthethweni Kwakukwaziwa edolobheni elincane elibizwa ngokuthi uMthatha, elalikhanya ngempumelelo yokukhula kwalo. Nokho, phakathi kwalezi zinsuku, umoya wephithizela wawuhamba edolobheni, ulethe izindaba ezinzima zokwanda kwezindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Abantu babekhuluma ngalesi sifo esishisayo, njengoba izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zavesa zikhula njengemithi emhlabathini. Ekuqaleni, izinsuku zaziphephile, abantu besebenzisa izindawo ezisemthethweni, kodwa njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izidingo zabantu zakhula, umnotho wendawo waphazamiseka, kwavela izinselelo ezintsha. Abahlala emakhaya, bedinga izindawo zokuhlala, baqala ukwakha izindlu ezincane ezingenamthetho. Ngenxa yokuntuleka komthetho, lokhu kwadala umndeni omkhulu wabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, baphuma ezindaweni ezisemthethweni befuna ukuphila okuhle. Kwakukhona uThandi, intombazane encane eyayikhula edolobheni, eyaziwa ngothando lwezithombe. UThandi wayehlala noMama wakhe, uNandi, owayesebenza njengefektri ye-‘sewing’ ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo. Njengoba uThandi eseyinkosikazi, wayevame ukuhamba nabangani bakhe endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi iMshayazafe, lapho kwakhiwa khona izindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Lezi zindawo zazihlanganisa amakhaya ashukumisayo, izitolo ezincane, nezindawo zokudlela ezinhle, kodwa kwakukhona nemiphumela engalungile. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola izindlela zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabo. UThandi wayezisola, ebona ukuthi umoya ubuhlungu, kodwa imiphefumulo yabo yayiqhubeka nokukhula. Uxhosa, umngani kaThandi, wayenombono othi, “Siyashoda, kwaziwa ukuthi akusikho konke okungoka, kodwa izimpilo zethu zidinga ukwakhiwa.” Lokhu kwakubeka umoya wengcindezi kubo, njengoba bephokophele ekutholeni izindlela zokuphila. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, izigameko zanda. Iziphathimandla zathola ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zikhula ngokushesha, ziqinisa imithetho yazo, kodwa izinyathelo ezazithathwa azizange zisebenze. Abantu abavela ezindaweni ezisemthethweni baqala ukucasuka, besaba ukuthi izindawo ezinjalo zizobenza baphule imithetho yabo. Ubaba kaThandi, uMnumzana Nkosi, wayephakathi kwezikhulu zomphakathi. Wayefuna ukusiza, kodwa wayezwa umuzwa wokuthi ukungena ezinkingeni ezinjengalezi kungaba yingozi. Wayengathanda ukusiza abanye, kodwa ukucabanga ukumisa lezi zindawo ezisemthethweni kwenza abe nokungabaza. Ngenkathi uThandi ebona ubaba esebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuthola izixazululo, wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nokuba nomusa kubalulekile. Ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zaziqala ukuba nezinselelo ezihlukahlukene. Izinyathelo zeziphathimandla zazinamandla, kodwa kubantu abahlala kulezi zindawo, kwaba nenkinga enkulu. UThandi waphakama, wathola ukuthi izinsizakusebenza nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezisemthethweni kufanele baqaphele futhi benzise amandla abo ukuze bakhe uxolo. Wakhumbula umyalezo kaMama wakhe, owawukhumbuza ukuthi umphakathi ubalulekile, nokuthi uma benza izinqumo, kufanele babheke phambili. Ngesikhathi uThandi esaqhubeka nokusebenza nabangani bakhe, bahlangana nabanye abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu behlanganyela izinsiza, bejolisa ekwakheni amathuba. Kancane kancane, uThandi waqala ukubona izinguquko. Izindawo ezazingekho emthethweni zashintsha zaba izindawo eziphephile, abantu baqala ukubambisana ukuze bakhe umphakathi ongcono. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola indlela yokuhlanganyela imicabango, ecabanga ukuthi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zingaba neqhaza elihle. Ngalesi sikhathi, iziphathimandla zathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nabantu abahlala kulezi zindawo kwaba yisinyathelo esihle. Umphakathi wathola izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano, kwaba nesivumelwano sokudala izindawo ezisemthethweni ezinhle. Ekugcineni, uThandi wabona ukuthi izinselelo ezazikhona zingashintsha uma abantu benza isinyathelo sokubambisana. Izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zaba yizikhala zokukhula, zaba izindawo zokuhlangana, futhi umoya wengcindezi waphumela emoyeni. UThandi wayejabule, ebona ukukhanya empilweni, futhi umphakathi waqala ukuvuka. Kwakukhona umuzwa ophumile, umphakathi wathola ukuthi ukuphila kwabo kwakungekho ngaphansi komoya wokukhungathekisa, kodwa kwakuphephile. Umoya wephithizela wajabula, abantu behlangana, futhi uThandi wayekwazi ukujabulisa, eqhubeka nokuthatha izithombe zamazwi abo, ezithokozisa izinsuku ezilandelayo. Ngenxa yokubambisana, uMthatha waba yidolobha elihambisana nezinto ezinhle, futhi izindawo ezingekho emthethweni zaba yizikhala zokukhula, zashintsha izimpilo zabantu abaningi.
Izehlakalo ze-cybersecurity kumasipala: Ukukhula kwezingozi ezikhathazayo Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi esishintshashintshayo se-cybersecurity, kumasipala kukhona izinsongo ezikhulayo eziyingozi. Izehlakalo ezifana nokuhlaselwa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuvulwa kwezinhlelo, kanye nokwephulwa kwedatha, zibonisa ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuvikela imininingwane yawo. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekuvikeleni imininingwane yomuntu, kodwa futhi kudala ukwethembana phakathi kwabantu nomasipala. Njengoba i-inthanethi ikhula, izinkampani ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zomphakathi zikhula futhi, lokhu kusiza ukuhlinzeka ngezinsongo ezinkulu. Umasipala unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina imininingwane ebalulekile, efana nezokwelapha, ezemfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Uma le datha ingaphathwa kahle, ingaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, njengokwephulwa kwedatha okungase kubangele ukulimala kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umasipala ube necebo eliqinile lokuphatha izingozi ze-cyber. Izehlakalo ze-cybersecurity ziveza izinselelo ezithile, kodwa zihlola ubuthakathaka obukhulu ezinsizweni ezitholakalayo kumasipala. Ngokwesibonelo, umsipha waseBaltimore, e-United States, ubhekane nezinhlekelele ezinkulu eziholele ekulimaleni kwemali, izinsizakalo, nezinsiza. Ukuhlasela kwe-cyber okuvela kubahlaseli, kwenze kwaba neziphumo ezinkulu emsebenzini wamasipala, kwaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwemisebenzi ethile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukwakha amasu aqinile okuvikela amakhompiyutha nezinhlelo zawo. Ngokwenyanga, imizamo yokuvikela i-cybersecurity kufanele ibandakanye ukufundisa abasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuqwashisa ngezingozi ze-cyber kanye nezindlela zokuvikela kubalulekile. Abasebenzi kufanele babe nolwazi oluqinile lokuvikela umphakathi wabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezifanele nezindlela zokuphatha izingozi. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kumasipala nezinkampani ezikhethekile ku-cybersecurity kuyinselelo enkulu. Umasipala ungasebenza nabantu abanolwazi, okungasiza ekuqedeni izinqubomgomo ezifanele. Umasipala kufanele futhi ube nezinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela imininingwane. Lezi zinqubomgomo kufanele ziqinise izinyathelo zokuphatha, njengokubhaliswa kwemiyalezo, ukuvikelwa kwamaphasiwedi, kanye nokuhlanzeka kwemishini ye-cyber. Umasipala kufanele unakekele izinhlelo zokuphatha izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zivikelekile. Njengoba izingozi ze-cyber ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, umphakathi kufanele ulungiselele kahle. Ukushoda kokwaziswa noma ukunakekela izinsiza zokuvikela kungabangela imiphumela emibi, hhayi kumasipala kuphela, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabantu. Ukuze umphakathi uhlale uvikelekile, kudingeka ukuba kube necebo eliqinile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izingozi ezikhona. Ngakho, umasipala kufanele uqhubeke nokwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezibhekelela i-cybersecurity. Kubhalwe phansi ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nomqondo wokuvikela imisebenzi yabo, kanti umasipala kufanele ube nezehlakalo ezizokwazi ukuvikela abantu, ugcine imininingwane yabo iphephile. Njengoba sithuthuka emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, umphakathi kufanele uthuthukise izindlela zokuvikela i-cybersecurity ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwawo. Ekugcineni, i-cybersecurity kumasipala akuyona nje indaba yezenzakalo ezithile, kodwa iyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ophephile. Umasipala kumele uqhubeke nokwenza izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezikhulayo, ukuvikela abantu, nokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nemiphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi othembele futhi ophephile, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni nasekukhuleni komphakathi.
Ezokuxhumana: Umthelela Wazo Emphakathini Wethu Ezokuxhumana, noma i-media, zinemisebenzi ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi wanamuhla. Lezi zindlela zokuxhumana zifaka amaphephandaba, izincwadi, imithombo yezokuxhumana, kanye neziteshi zethelevishini. Zixhumene ngokuqondile nezimo zansuku zonke, zishintsha indlela abantu abacabanga, behlaziya, futhi bephila. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wezokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukene ezihambisana nazo, okuhlanganisa izinzuzo, izingozi, kanye nemithelela emisha ezimpilweni zabantu. Izinzuzo Zezokuxhumana Ezokuxhumana zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, imicabango, nezinhlelo. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, abantu bangathola ulwazi olusha, bahlale bexhumene nabangani, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bekwazi ukusizana, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokuxazulula izinkinga ezibhekene nabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuxhumana zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni imiqondo yomphakathi. Ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluthile, ezokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi, njengokukhuthaza imikhankaso yokuvota, ukulwa nezinkinga zokuhlukumeza, noma ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezempilo. Izingcuphe Nezingozi Noma kunjalo, ezokuxhumana azinakho konke okuhle. Ziphinde zibe nezingcuphe eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukusabalala kolwazi olungelona iqiniso, ukucwasa, kanye nokuhlukumeza. Ukusabalala kolwazi olungelona iqiniso kungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingalungile, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta impilo yomphakathi, lapho abantu bephendukela kulwazi olungelona iqiniso ukuze benze izinqumo ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana zikhuthaza ukucwasa, okungaholela ekwakheni imiphakathi ehlukanisayo, lapho abantu behlukaniswa khona ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, noma izinkolelo. Lokhu kubangela ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomphakathi. Umthelela Wokuxhumana Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Ezokuxhumana zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi olukhuluma ngezimo ezithile ezibhekene namazwe ahlukene. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okukhuthaza ukuqonda nokuhloniphana phakathi kwezizwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhlela imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa umphakathi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta izinkinga zomhlaba, njengokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukulwa nobuphofu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ezempilo. Ngokuxhumana, abantu bangakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango, izixazululo, kanye nezinsiza, okukhuthaza ukuhlela imikhankaso emisha yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kucacile ukuthi ezokuxhumana zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zihlinzeka ngendlela yokuxhumana, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nazo, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela umphakathi ekutholeni ulwazi olungelona iqiniso, ukucwasa, kanye nokuhlukumeza. Ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi, kufanele sisebenzise ezokuxhumana ngendlela efanele, sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, futhi sithuthukise ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, ukuvumelana, nokuhloniphana phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ukufuduka Kwezimboni Zangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika: Imiphumela Nezindlela Zokubhekana Nazo Eminyakeni edlule, iNingizimu Afrika ibhekane nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle. Lezi zinguquko zikhombisa izinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi ziveza amathuba amasha. Njengomuntu ophila kuleli, ngikholelwa ukuthi le ndaba iyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa kufanele sixoxe ngayo ngokuqondile, ngendlela ehloniphekile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abavela kwamanye amazwe bayeza eNingizimu Afrika ngezizathu ezahlukene. Abanye baphuma ezimeni ezinzima, befuna ithuba lokuphila kangcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi nendawo yokuhlala, izimpi, kanye nezinkinga zomnotho ezibuhlungu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bangena kuleli ukuze bazuze amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abaneziqu ezithile noma amakhono akhethekile. Lokhu kuveza ubudlelwano obubucayi phakathi kokufuduka nokuphila kwezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Kodwa-ke, ukwanda kwabantu bangaphandle kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinkinga ezithile. Abanye abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bakholelwa ukuthi ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle kubangela ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, ukwanda kwezindleko zokuhlala, kanye nokuncipha kwezinye izinsiza zomphakathi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokungabaza phakathi kwabantu, kube nemibono eyeqisayo nokuxabana phakathi kwendawo nezihambeli. Kubuhlungu ukuthi izinkinga ezinjalo zikhuthaza imikhankaso yokwehliswa kwamahemuhemu, ebandakanya izinsolo zokuthi abantu bangaphandle baphula umthetho noma bahlala ngokungekho emthethweni. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umfanekiso omubi ngabo, okwenza kube nzima ukuba sihlangane kahle. Kumele siqonde ukuthi abantu bangaphandle abaveli eNingizimu Afrika baphila njengezimpilo eziphilayo, futhi kufanele sibabheke ngeso lokhozi, sikhumbule izizathu ezingemuva kokufuduka kwabo. Ngokuqhubeka, ukwamukela abantu bangaphandle kungaba nenzuzo enkulu. Lokhu akukhulumi nje ngokwakha umnotho, kodwa futhi kubalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Abantu abavela kwamanye amazwe banikeza amakhono amasha, baphinde baveze izimfashini ezahlukene, izindlela zokuphila, nezinkolelo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi ehlangene, lapho abantu bangafunda khona futhi benze ubudlelwano obusha. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, njengamazwe, kudingeka sibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubhekana nale mikhankaso. Ukuze sikwazi ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaNingizimu Afrika nabantu bangaphandle, kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okuhle, imihlangano yomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga, futhi kukhuthaze ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi uhulumeni anikele ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuvikela amalungelo abantu bangaphandle, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlinzekwa ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufuduka okukhulu, futhi kuvikela izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ekukhathazekeni okukhona. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinezinhlobonhlobo. Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle akukhona okubalulekile kuphela; kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ogcwele ubuhlakani, namathuba. Njengabantu, kufanele sihlanganyele ukuze siqonde izizathu zokufuduka, sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle, futhi sakhe iNingizimu Afrika engcono kulabo bonke. Ngakho, ngalolu hlelo lokubheka izinzuzo nezinkinga zokufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle, ngikholelwa ukuthi kumele sihlanganyele ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele ukunakekelana, nokuhlonipha izimpilo zomunye nomunye. Ekuvuleni ithuba lokufuduka, singenza iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngcono—hhayi kuphela kubantu bangaphandle, kodwa naphakathi kwethu sonke.
Umbiko Ngokwakha: Izinkolelo Nezinto Eziphambili Kwezokwakha Isingeniso Ezokwakha zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zibhekelele ukwakhiwa kwezindawo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Lezi zindawo zifaka izakhiwo ezahlukahlukene, kusukela ezindlini zomphakathi, izikole, izibhedlela, kuze kube nezindawo zokuhlala. Umbiko lo uzobheka izinkolelo, izinqubo, kanye nezinto ezithinta ezokwakha, ngenkathi sigxila ezintweni ezibalulekile ezithinta umphakathi. Izinkolelo Nezithembiso Kwezokwakha Ezokwakha akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kodwa kudinga ukuthi kube nezinkolelo ezinamandla ezimayelana nekhwalithi, ukuphepha, nokuhlonipha imvelo. Ukuze izakhiwo zibe nekhono lokusebenza kahle, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthobela izinkambiso zomsebenzi, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo, nokwakha izakhiwo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinyathelo Zokwakha Ukuze ukuqala iphrojekthi yokwakha, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle. Ukuhlela kuhlanganisa ukuthola imvume yokwakha, ukwakha isikhumbuzo sezezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga uxhumano phakathi kwabahlali, abaklami, nabakhiqizi. Ngaphambi kokuqala, kubalulekile ukwenza ucwaningo lokuhlola indawo, ukuqonda izimo zemvelo, nezidingo zomphakathi. Izinsiza Zokwakha Izinsiza ezisetshenziswa kwezakhiwo zithinta kakhulu umphumela wokugcina. Izinsiza ezifanele zifaka phakathi amatshe, isihlabathi, nezinsiza zokwakha ezivuselelekayo ezifana namapaneli elanga. Ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezingaphezulu kokuqonda, kuzokwenza kube nokonga, futhi kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ezindleleni zethu zokukhulisa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo zibalulekile ekwakheni izakhiwo eziphumelelayo nezihlala isikhathi eside. Izingozi Nezindlela Zokuphepha Ezokwakha zinezingozi eziningi ezihambisana nazo, futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemikhuba yokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqapha abakwaqashwa, ukuhlinzeka ngamasu wokuvikela, nokwenza izivivinyo ezithile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, izisebenzi kumele zifundiswe ngamasu aphumelelayo okusebenza kanye nezingozi ezingase zibe khona. Izihlahla Nezindlela Zokwakha Ezihambisana Nemvelo Ngokwanda kokukhathazeka ngempilo yomhlaba, kubalulekile ukwenza izinqumo zokwakha ezihambisana nemvelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izakhiwo ezisebenzisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo, njengesoloko, umoya, nesichumiso. Izindlela zokwakha ezihambisana nemvelo zikhuthaza ukonga amanzi, ukusebenza kahle, nokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. Izinselele Zamanje Kwezokwakha Kwezakhiwo, kuningi okuhambisanayo nezinselele zamanje. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungabi namathuba okusebenza, ukwehla kwezimali, kanye nezinguquko emthethweni. Ukubhekana nalezi zinselele, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uthole izixazululo eziphusile, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha nokuqonda okujulile kwezokwakha. Isiphetho Ezokwakha zihlala zibaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokwakha, sizame ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi sinakekele imvelo. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakwazi ukudala izakhiwo ezingcono, ezihlala isikhathi eside, futhi ezithuthukisa izinga lempilo lomphakathi. Ukusebenza ngamandla, ukuqonda izinkolelo, nokuhlonipha umhlaba kuzoba isiqalo esihle sokwakha ikusasa eliyingqayizivele.
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemazweni abo. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kuphathwa kakhulu ngamaKhothama noma Abaholi Bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaNkosi nabakhulumeli, futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulu ngokuqhuba imikhuba yokwenziwa kwemithetho. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 211 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wesiko uyavunywa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho ezihambisana nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wesiko njengokwakunjalo ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwemithethosisekelo emisha, kodwa lo mthetho kumele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona kanye nemthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhiwe ngaphansi kwento 16 yeSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo, ethula ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neKhothama eyayikhona ngesikhathi sokwethulwa kwemthethosisekelo ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza futhi zisebenzise amandla azo omthetho njengoba kunikezwe. Ukusebenza kwalezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ixhumene nezinye ezaziphumelele ngaphambi kwemthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezazizimele. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yomlando eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngomlayezo wezomthetho, uMongameli wezwe udlulisele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuhambisana nento 14 yeSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko obizwa ngokuthi "Umbiko NgamaKhothama & Imisebenzi Yezobulungiswa Yabakhulumeli Bendabuko" odwetshwe ngomhla kaJanuwari 21, 2003: IKomidi Lezomthetho laseNingizimu Afrika ekhasini 1. Ukuncipha kwamandla kungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwenkantolo yokulalela icala nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinsizwa ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho-ke, ukuncipha kwamandla kusitshela ngamandla nemikhawulo enikezwe enkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe kwicala lapho inkantolo ingenamandla sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Uma sihlola umthetho okhona, imiqondo yokuncipha kwamandla ivela kokubili emikhubeni yesiko nasemithethweni eminingi. Le mithetho ivela kumthetho ojwayelekile kodwa ingase yenziwe njengomthetho. Isibonelo sokwenziwa kwale mithetho nguMthetho WamaKhothama Wasekhaya. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ephathelene nokuncipha kwamandla. Ngokuvumelana nalomthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe namandla, kumele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kumele ibe namandla phezu komuntu odefendwa kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wokuncipha ubandakanya umgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanelekile. Ukuncipha kwamandla kuhambisana nomngcele wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Ukuncipha kwamandla enkantolo kuhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echaziwe. Le misho ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphakeli ulandela indawo lapho umphikisi ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphakeli kumele alivule enkantolo enegunya phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Kuvamile ukuba inkantolo yasendaweni lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphakeli ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezihlukene ngaphansi kwalomthetho: isibonelo; inkantolo inegunya ngoba umthombo wenkinga uvele endaweni elawulwa leyo nkantolo. Mayelana nesigaba 28(d) soMthetho WamaKhothama Wasekhaya No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sithi ukuze le nkantolo ibe namandla okusebenza, umthombo wenkinga kumele uvele ngokuphelele endaweni elawulwa le nkantolo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana kwamandla, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe namandla phezu kwendaba efanayo. Njengoba umphakeli enelungelo lokulawula icala, angakhetha inkantolo ezolalela udaba lwakhe. Ngokuvamile, umphakeli ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana naye ngaphandle kokucabangela ukuthi isimo sikhona yini esifanele umphikisi. Amandla okulawula enziwa ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha imiyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula amandla ayo, ingase iphumelele icala ngokuphelele. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ekhasini 819. Uma inkantolo yayinokuncipha kwamandla ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho ezimweni ngeke luguqule ukuncipha kwamandla enkantolo. Isibonelo: inkantolo inegunya lokulawula ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, wayehlala ngaphakathi kwendawo yayo yokulawula, iyaqhubeka nokuba namandla phezu kwendaba noma ngabe emva kokukhipha imiyalo, umphikisi akasekho endaweni yenkantolo. Indawo ephathelene nokuncipha kwamandla. Inkantolo inegunya lokulalela udaba olukhulunywa phambi kwayo. Lokhu kuqondene kakhulu nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwenkinga kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kumele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezimali zendabuko, akukabi khona umgomo othile ophatha inani lemali. Noma ngabe akekho umgomo ophathelene nenani lemali, iKomidi Lezomthetho mayelana Nezomthetho Zendabuko lenza iziphakamiso zokuqala zemigomo ezizosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo seMithetho Yendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo ngaphandle kwamandla okukhuluma udaba lwakhe futhi engakwenzi ukungafuni ukuba abhekane phambi kwenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okulalela udaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuba alawulwe yimigomo yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) soMthetho WamaKhothama Wasekhaya No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kulungisiwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenalo ummeli, umphakathi ophakeme unomsebenzi wokubuza ngokwakhe (mero mutu) mayelana namandla okukhuluma udaba kule nkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli womphikisi, umphakathi ophakeme wenkantolo ngeke ubuze ngokwakhe mayelana namandla enkantolo okukhuluma icala. Uma kwenzeka udaba lokuthi inkantolo ingenamandla okukhuluma icala, umuntu owafakile kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ifanele ukukhuluma icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weKomidi Lezomthetho ngamaKhothama, ekhasini 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokukhuluma ukuthi inkantolo ayinamalungelo okukhuluma icala ingabaphoqa ukuba banikeze ubufakazi mayelana nokuthi kungani besho kanjalo. Umqondo wokuncipha kwamandla uphinde ubandakanye ukuhlela kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa ngamandla nemithetho yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lamandla okulawula nokuncipha, inkantolo yomthetho
Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izigameko Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zihlala zikhona, futhi zidinga ukuphathwa ngokushesha nangendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphepha kwabagulayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izigameko eziphuthumayo zingaba nemiphumela emibi uma zingaphathwa kahle. Nokho, kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha lezi zimo, futhi lezi zindlela zidinga ukuxoxwa ukuze kuqondwe kahle ukuthi yiziphi ezisebenza kahle kakhulu. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zihlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, njengokulimala, izifo ezinzima, noma izimo zokuphuthuma ezidinga ukwelashwa okusheshayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izibhedlela zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha lezi zimo. Izinhlelo ezinjalo zifaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla efanele, kanye nokwakha izinqubo ezilula zokuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi. Ngokuphathelene nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bezibhedlela, kuhlanganise nodokotela, abahlengikazi, nabanye, bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kufanele kube yinhlelo eqhubekayo, ukuze abasebenzi bahlale bephapheme futhi bezilungiselele ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphuthumayo. Uma abasebenzi bengaqeqeshwanga kahle, lokhu kungaholela ekutheni iziguli zingatholi usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele, okungaholela ekufeni noma ekulimazeni okukhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla efanele kubalulekile. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinsiza ezanele, ezifana nemishini yokuhlola, imithi, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Uma izibhedlela zinganikezi lezi zinsiza, iziguli zingase zibe sengozini yokungatholi usizo olufanele. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izibhedlela kufanele zihlale ziqinisekisa ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngendlela efanele. Kodwa-ke, akukhona kuphela ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempahla efanele okubalulekile. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi ezibhedlela nakho kubalulekile. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo zingasiza ekusheshiseni ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izinqubo ezilula zokuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okusheshayo nokuphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu abahlinzeka ngosizo. Uma izisebenzi zingakwazi ukuxhumana kahle, lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelweni kokwelashwa, okungaba nemiphumela emibi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlola nokuhlaziya izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo ezisetshenziswayo zisebenza kahle. Ukuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo kungasiza ekutholeni izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izibhedlela zikwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngendlela engcono. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izibhedlela kufanele zihlale ziqhubeka nokuhlola izinqubo zazo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo azilindelekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izibhedlela kufanele zihlale zilungile, ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izibhedlela zibe nezinsiza ezanele, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. Uma izibhedlela zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinto, iziguli zingase zibe sengozini yokungatholi usizo olufanele. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla efanele, nokwakha izinqubo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphepha kwabagulayo, futhi izibhedlela kufanele zihlale ziqhubeka nokuhlola nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zazo ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngendlela engcono. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze izibhedlela ukuba ziqhubeke nokwenza ngcono izinqubo zazo, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abadinga usizo.
Ezabantu Abadala: Ukuhlinzeka Ngempilo Enhle Nokuqonda Isingeniso Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, abantu abadala bahlala bebalulekile emphakathini. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enhle kubantu abadala kudinga ukuqonda, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Lezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo zizosiza ekuphatheni abantu abadala ngendlela efanele, ukuze baphile impilo egculisayo futhi enempilo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izidingo Zabo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zomuntu omdala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Izidingo Zempilo: Bheka izimo zabo zempilo, izidakamizwa abazithathayo, kanye nezidingo zokwelashwa. Qiniseka ukuthi uthola ulwazi olugcwele kumphakathi wezokwelapha. - Izidingo Zomzwelo: Abantu abadala badinga uthando nokuxhumana. Hlanganyela nabo, ubakhumbuze ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi badinga ukuba khona kwabanye. - Izidingo Zokuphila: Qinisekisa ukuthi banendawo yokuhlala efanele, ukudla okunempilo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baphile kahle. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuxhumana Ngempumelelo Ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Qiniseka ukuthi: - Uphendula Ngothando: Bheka izidingo zabo, futhi uphendule ngothando. Lokhu kuzobasiza bazizwe beqondwa. - Sebenzisa Izindlela Zokuxhumana Ezingcono: Uma umuntu omdala enezinkinga zokuzwa, sebenzisa izwi eliphakeme, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubakhumbuza ukuthi ubani. - Bavumele Bakhulume: Nika abantu abadala ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto abazithandayo, izinkumbulo zabo, noma izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kuzobasiza bakhululeke. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlinzeka Ngempilo Enhle Ukuze abantu abadala baphile kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enhle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukudla Okunempilo: Hlinzeka ngokudla okunempilo, okuhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, nezinye izithako ezidingekayo. Qiniseka ukuthi ukudla kuhambisana nezidingo zabo zempilo. - Ukuzivocavoca: Khuthaza abantu abadala ukuba bazivocavoce, noma ngabe kuyimidlalo elula noma ukuhamba. Lokhu kuzobasiza bagcine imisipha yabo iqinile. - Ukuhlola Impilo: Qinisekisa ukuthi bahlangana nodokotela njalo ukuze kuhlolwe impilo yabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza bahlale bephila kahle. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlinzeka Ngothando Nokuxhaswa Abantu abadala badinga uthando nokuxhaswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuba Nabo: Hamba nabo, ubavakashele, noma ubathumele imiyalezo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza bazizwe bebalulekile. - Ukweseka Emizweni: Uma bephila ngezikhathi ezinzima, bahloniphe futhi ubakhuthaze. Lokhu kuzobasiza bakhumbule ukuthi bahlala beqondwa. - Ukwenza Imisebenzi Ndawonye: Hlela imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa, njengokubukela amafilimu, ukudlala imidlalo, noma ukuhamba emaphandleni. Lokhu kuzokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuphepha Ukuphepha kwabantu abadala kubalulekile. Qiniseka ukuthi: - Uhlola Indawo Yokuhlala: Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokuhlala iphephile, ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezithinta ukuphepha kwabo. - Bafundise Ngokuphepha: Bafundise ngezindlela zokuphepha, njengokugwema ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezinzima noma ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele. - Bahlale Bephakathi Kwezinye: Qinisekisa ukuthi bahlala bephakathi kwabanye abantu, ukuze bazi ukuthi bahlala beqondwa. Isiphetho Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enhle kubantu abadala kudinga uthando, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Khumbula, abantu abadala bahlala bebalulekile, futhi kufanele sibe nesineke, sithande, futhi sihlinzeke ngempilo enhle ukuze baphile kahle. Uthando lwethu nolwazi lwethu lungaba yinsika eqinile empilweni yabo.
Izimpawu ezintsha zomphakathi ziwuhlonzo oluphakeme, olunikezwa nguMongameli kubantu, kanye nakwabanye abantu abahloniphekile kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe. UMongameli ungumthombo (umgibeli, itheku, kanye nomthombo omkhulu) wokuhlonipha ezweni, yingakho uMongameli engumuntu ophakamisayo izihlonzo futhi enikeza izimpawu zokuhlonipha. INingizimu Afrika idlule endleleni ende yokuhlukanisa nesikhumbuzo sokukoloni esisekelwe ebudlelwaneni, umbala, kanye nokukholwa. Izwe lethu liqhubeka nokuqhubeka endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu nobukhulu kubantu bonke. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu babantu bonke, kukhona isiko elisha lamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonipha ubukhulu bomoya womuntu, okukhombisa ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Imithombo yezimpawu zokuhlukanisa nezikhathi ezedlule ibonakaliswa ngokuphakanyiswa kwefulegi elisha ngo-1994. Leso sikhathi saqinisa ukuzigqaja kwethu nobukhulu bezwe elijabulela ukuhlonishwa kwabantu bonke. Enye into ebalulekile kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwe-emblem yezenhlalakahle entsha, ehlanganisa umlando wabantu bonke bezwe, ngoMsombuluko 27, 2000. Ngokwenza kanjalo, lokhu kuhlinzeka ngakho konke ubuhle be-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuvuka nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Le emblem entsha yezenhlalakahle isekelwe emoyeni walolo vuselelo lwezizwe. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanamakhono aphezulu kwezobuciko nokwakha, futhi abafeze amazinga aphezulu empumelelo ngendlela engajwayelekile. IMapungubwe - Ubukhosi beMapungubwe babusemhlabeni ophakathi kwezwe lethu eminyakeni eyinkulungwane edlule. Lolu bukhosi lwalunohlelo oluhle lokuphatha, futhi lwaluphambili kakhulu kwezolimo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lolu bukhosi lwalunemigodi kanye nezimboni zensimbi. Lolu bukhosi lwathengiselana namazwe akude njengeChina. Ngesikhathi salolu bukhosi, babe nenhlonipho enkulu emkhakheni wokucabanga okujulile nokwakha. I-mapungubwe artifact - Sisiqalo nendawo, i-artifact iyingxenye yomhlaba enedwala efakwe ngothuli, endaweni eyomile nephakeme, engatholi imvula eningi yesikhathi sasehlobo, njengoba kuboniswe ngesikhathi sokuhlola okukhombisa ubuciko obukhulu obutholakele endaweni yemvelo kodwa ngezimo ezinzima. Iroyal staff yeMapungubwe - itholakele futhi emathuneni egolide kokubili - okuyinto eyodwa eyakhelwe futhi yatholakala ethuneni elahlwa ngababhalisi bendawo (indawo yokuhlola). I-vessel ehloniphekile yokungcwaba igolide - ifomu le-vessel elivela ku-vessel yokungcwaba igolide libonisa ubuciko obunothile, isayensi, kanye nekhono lokwakha, okukhombisa impumelelo yasendulo ekukhiqizeni insimbi. Ilanga eliphakamisayo - libonisa ukukhanya okusha e-Afrika. Isikhungo sokungcwaba insimbi - sihlambulula futhi sithuthukise impilo ngokuqhume, okusetshenziswe kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, kanye nempumelelo eqhubekayo nobuciko kuzo zonke izindawo. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo ophakeme. Le misebenzi akufanele ibe imisebenzi ejwayelekile kuphela kodwa idlule emkhakheni ojwayelekile, futhi futhi yenziwe ngabantu hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokukhokhwa kodwa ukuze baphumelele kulokho okujwayelekile nokulindelekile. Ukukhuthazwa kubuchwepheshe, nokukhonza imiphakathi. Sisiqhamuka esihlahleni esibalulekile kwezolimo. Sihlinzeka ngama-fibers ezindwangu nezintambo, izithelo, nomlilo, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi ezisiza. I-Baobab (Baobab noma i-Adansonia Digitata) - iyaziwa ngamagatsha ayo nezimpande zayo zempilo ende. Sihlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala kanye nendawo yokwabelana, futhi sibuye sibe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekusekeleni imiphakathi lapho sitholakala khona. Ifomu leziqongo eziyisishiyagalolunye - ifomu eliyisishiyagalolunye leziqongo limele imikhakha eminingi ehlukene lapho imisebenzi ehlukene ingaqhutshelwa ukuze kwakhiwe izwe elizinzile nelithuthukayo. Le symbol ibuye imele izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zezwe lethu. Le emblem inikezwa kubahlonishwa abakwamanye amazwe (Abaholi bezwe kanye nohulumeni, nabanye abantu abahloniphekile abakwamanye amazwe) ukuze kubonakale ubudlelwano neNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho siba yisithonjana sokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesibonakaliso sokuhlanganyela nokusekela. Le emblem iyisithonjana esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Imiklomelo emibili yokuqala ihlanganisa izigaba ezine: iphendenti, ibhajethi yephimbo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel rosette. I-emblem yokugcina inezigaba ezintathu: ibhajethi yephimbo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel pin. Umjola (inyoka etholakala emathafeni) - Inyoka evakashela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Ayilimazi ingane noma amalunga omndeni, futhi indlela yokukhipha le nyoka iwukuthi umama wengane adle. Le nyoka ivakashela ingane ukuze iyilungiselele ikusasa elikhanyayo neliphephile ebuncaneni bayo. Iza njengomngane nomvikeli. Ubudlelwano obumele, obusekelwe ekubekezeleni okuhle, bukhona emoyeni wokukhombisa ukweseka nokufuna ukuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yesikhathi esizayo yezenhlalakahle ezincane kanye namalunga omphakathi akhulayo. Le nyoka bekuwumlando wethu ngenxa yesikhathi esidumile esabhala kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba iphikisa umqondo wokuthi le nyoka iyisidalwa esiyingozi nesilimazayo, kodwa ikhombisa umbono ocebile we-Afrika, iqonda le nyoka njengomngane kanye nelungu lemvelo okufanele liphila ndawonye. Umjola - indwangu eyakhelwe, eyenziwe ngama-fibers amnyama, isuka esihlahleni sase-Afrika, iyisithonjana sobungane ekusekeleni nasekubambisaneni okukhonjiswa ngabangane, futhi ibonisa nokuzibophezela ekusekeleni nasekuma nabantu abasisekelayo.
Ulwazi lweziboshwa, uma lukhona: Inombolo yesiboshwa: Usuku oluseduze ongathola ngalo ithuba lokukhululwa: Usuku lokukhululwa okujwayelekile:... Ingabe kukhona umuntu owazuza ngawe nganoma iyiphi indlela ngokwenza icala? Uma kunjalo, chaza isimo kanye nezinga lokuzuza kwakho. Ingabe bekukhona izizathu zezepolitiki, uma zikhona, ozama ukuzithola ngokwenza icala? Ingabe inhlangano yakho, isikhungo, iqembu, noma impi yezenkolo yazuza ekwenzeni amacala? I-soybean - isitshalo esiyisimangaliso kanye nokudla okungavamile! Kukhona ingxoxo enkulu mayelana ne-soybeans kanye nokubaluleka kwazo ekushintshaneni kwezolimo kanye ne-maize. Njengamanye amahlamvu adlalwa isikhathi eside ekhaya, ubudlelwano be-soybeans besimanjemanje nezinye izinhlobo ezikhula ngokungajwayelekile abunakulandwa nganoma iyiphi indlela eqinile. Njengengxenye ye-Grain SA Farmer Development Program, sithemba ukusungula uhlelo ne-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust ukuze sikhuthaze abalimi abasafufusa ukuba bakhulise i-soybeans - njengokudla okuthengiswayo, futhi njengomthombo walesi sizwe sezinhlobo ezisemqoka ze-protein. I-soybeans ihluka ekukhuleni nasekuziphatheni. Ukuphakama kwesitshalo kungahluka kusuka ngaphansi kuka-20cm kuya ku-2 meters. Amabhodlela, izimpande zesitshalo, kanye namahlamvu covered with fine brown or gray hairs. Amathambo anama-leaflets amathathu kuya kwane per leaf, futhi lawo ma-leaflets angaba ngu-6 kuya ku-15 centimeters ubude, enobubanzi obungu-2 kuya ku-7 centimeters. Amathambo awawa ngaphambi kokuthi izithelo zikhule. Izimbali ezingabonakali, ezizithokozisayo, zikhula ezindaweni zamathambo futhi zingaba mhlophe, pinki, noma purple. Imikhiqizo yayo iyibhodlela elihlotshiswe ngempahla ethile elikhula ezixubeni ezingu-3 kuya ku-5, ngalinye ibhodlela lingama-centimeters angu-3 kuya ku-8 ubude futhi ngokuvamile liqukethe izithelo ezi-2 kuya ku-4 (ngokwejwayelekile kuncane), nezithelo zilinganiselwa ku-5 kuya ku-11 millimeters ububanzi. I-soybeans iza ngezinhlobo ezahlukene nosayizi bamabhodlela, kuhlanganisa omnyama, ompunga, oluhlaza-oluhlaza, ophuzi, oluhlaza, kanye nomhlophe. Ibhodlela le-soybean elikhulile linzima, alithathi amanzi, futhi livikela izithelo ezivela ekulimazeni okungenzeka. Uma ibhodlela elihlotshiswe ngezithelo lihluka, izithelo ngeke zikwazi ukuvuthwa. Okuqukethwe kwe-oyela kanye ne-protein kubalelwa cishe ku-60% wesisindo se-soybeans ezomile uma kuhlanganiswe, ne-proteins zenze u-40% kanti i-oyela i-20%. I-35% esele iyisitashi (ama-carbohydrates) kanti i-5% iyinhlama. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-soybeans kuqukethe cishe u-8% ibhodlela elihlotshiswe ngezithelo, u-90% izindawo zamathambo, kanye no-2% izimpande zamathambo. Ukuze kudliwe ngabantu, i-soybeans kumele iphekwe emlilweni "omisiwe" ukuze kuqedwe ama-trypsin inhibitors (okuyizithiyo ze-serine protease). I-soybeans ezingashisayo, kuhlanganisa nezo ezingakakhuli ngokuphelele, ziyingozi kubantu, izinkomo, izinkukhu, futhi ngempela kuzo zonke izilwane ezine-stomach eyodwa. Abathengisi abaningi bacabanga ukuthi i-soybeans iyinsiza ye-protein ephelele. I-proteins ephelele yilezo eziqukethe ama-amino acids abalulekile okumele atholwe emkhakheni wokudla kwabantu ngoba umzimba womuntu awukwazi ukuhlanganisa lawa ma-amino acids. Njengoba kunjalo, i-soy iyinsiza enhle ye-protein, phakathi kwezindlela zokudla eziningi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangadli inyama kodwa badla kuphela imifino noma labo abafuna ukunciphisa ukudla kwabo kwenyama. Ama-proteins e-soy empeleni afana nezithelo zezinye izilimo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-soybeans ingakhiqiza okungenani kabili kwe-protein nge-hectare uma kuqhathaniswa nanoma yisiphi isitshalo sombila noma esolimo. Nge-hectare, lezi proteins zingaba phezulu kwama-5 kuya kwama-10 izikhathi eziphezulu emhlabeni okukhuliswa izilwane, futhi i-protein nge-hectare ingaba phezulu kwama-15 izikhathi eziphezulu emhlabeni okukhuliswa inyama. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-soy kunganciphisa nengozi ye-cancer ye-colon. I-soybeans iyisitshalo esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, inikeza i-oyela kanye ne-protein. E-United States, ivolumu yalezi zitshalo iphumelelwa ngesisombululo esisebenzisa i-hexane, kanti i-soybean meal (i-50% protein) inikeza ithuba lokusetshenziswa ekukhuliseni izilwane (isb., izinkukhu, izinkomo, kanye nezinkomo) ezingeni lokuhweba elingakaze libonwe. Ingxenye encane yalezi zitshalo idliwa ngabantu. Imikhiqizo ye-soybeans itholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene zokudla eziphekiwe. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, i-soybeans yayibalulekile eNyakatho Melika naseYurophu, ikakhulukazi njengomthombo wokudla ongashintsha ezinye izinsiza ze-protein kanye njengomthombo we-oyela odliwayo. I-soybeans yaziwa njengomkhiqizo wezolimo ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili yiMnyango Wezolimo wase-United States. Iphumelela ezindaweni ezishisayo futhi ikhula kahle ezishisayo phakathi kuka-20 kuya ku-30 °C; izinga lokushisa elingaphansi kuka-20 °C noma elingaphezu kuka-40 °C linciphisa kakhulu ukukhula kwayo. Ingakhula ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlabathi, kodwa iphumelela emhlabathini onama-sandy loam anothile ngempahla ye-organic. I-soybeans, njengamanye ama-legumes, sebenzisa i-nitrogen ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ne-bacterium Bradyrhizobium japonicum. Nokho, ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, kufanele kuhlanganiswe i-strain efanele ye-bacteria nezithelo ze-soybeans (noma yisiphi isilimo) ngaphambi kokutshala. Izinhlobo zesitshalo zesimanjemanje ngokuvamile zifinyelela ukuphakama okungama-1 meter futhi zithatha izinsuku ezingu-80 kuya ku-120 ukuze zikhule zisuka ekutshalisweni kuze kube sekutholeni. I-soybeans iyindawo yaseMpumalanga Asia, kodwa kuphela u-45% wemikhiqizo ye-soybeans ivela lapho. I-U.S. ikhiqize ama-ton angama-75 million e-soybeans ngonyaka ka-2000, lapho u-1/3 wathunyelwa phesheya. Abakhiqizi abahamba phambili baphinde baphakanyiswa eBrazil, e-Argentina, e-Paraguay, e-China, nase-India. Izitshalo ze-soybeans zihlala zithinteka kalula yizifo ezithile ze-fungal, izifo ezibulalayo, izifo ze-viral, kanye nezinsongo ezidla izicubu zesitshalo. I-soybeans yayiyisitshalo esibalulekile eMpumalanga Asia isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba abantu bakwazi ukubhala. Ihlala iyisitshalo esihamba phambili eChina, eJapane, naseKorea. Ngaphambi kokuphuma kwemikhiqizo ephumelele njenge-soy sauce, tempeh, natto, kanye ne-miso, i-soy yayibhekwa njengomuthi ongcwele ekushintshaneni kwayo nezinye izitshalo njengendlela yokubuyisela i-nitrogen. Izitshalo zazikhuliswa ngezansi ukuze kuvuleke isikhala sezitshalo ezinikeza ukudla kwabantu. I-soy yethulwe eYurophu ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-18 futhi e-United States ngo-1765, lapho yaqala khona ukukhuliswa njengezithako zezinkomo. I-soybeans azizange zibe zibalulekile e-Asia kuze kube ngu-1910. E-America, i-soy ibhekwa njengomkhiqizo wezohwebo kuphela kodwa yaqala ukusetshenziswa njengokudla ngawo-1920. I-soy yafika e-Afrika ivela e-China cishe ekupheleni kwekhulu le-19 futhi

Umbiko Ngomlando KaDesmond Tutu Isingeniso UDokotela uDesmond Mpilo Tutu, owazalwa ngomhla ka-7 kuNhlangulana 1931 eKlerksdorp, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe, ezokuhlalisana, kanye nezokholo eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Njengomfundisi, umholi wezokholo, kanye nomlwi wezemfundo, uTutu waba nesandla esikhulu ekulweni nobandlululo, futhi waba yisithombe esiqhakazile sokuthula nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Imfundo Nokukhula UTutu wakhulela emndenini ophila impilo ejwayelekile, kodwa waphumelela kakhulu ezifundweni zakhe. Wafunda eSt. Peter's Theological College, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBhayibheli. Ngemuva kwalokho, wathola iziqu zeBachelor of Arts e-Universiteit van Natal. Lezi zifundo zamsiza ukuba aqonde kangcono izinkinga zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nobandlululo. Umsebenzi Wokuhola Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uTutu waba umfundisi, waphinde waba umphakathi wezokholo. Waqala ukusebenza njengomfundisi eSoweto, lapho aqala khona ukugxila ezinkingeni zomphakathi. Ubuye waba umphakathi wezokholo eKapa, lapho akha khona izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantu abampofu. Ubuye waba umphakathi wezokholo eNingizimu Afrika, lapho waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula. Ukwelulwa Kwezemfundo UDesmond Tutu waba yisithombe esiqhakazile sokulwa nobandlululo, futhi waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantu abampofu. Waqala ukusebenzisa izinkulumo zakhe ukuze akhuthaze abantu ukuba baphumelele ezikoleni. Wabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abampofu ukuba bathole imfundo efanele. Ukwamukela Umsebenzi Wokuthula Ngemva kokuba uNelson Mandela ekhishwe ejele, uTutu waba ngumholi ophambili emizamweni yokwakha ukuthula eNingizimu Afrika. Waba umholi weKomidi Lokuthula, lapho abamba khona iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokubuyisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abampofu. Ukwamukelwa Kwamazwe Ngamazwe UDesmond Tutu waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula emhlabeni jikelele. Waba umholi weKomidi Lokuthula eNingizimu Afrika, futhi waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula emazweni amaningi. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula emazweni afana neZimbabwe, eRwanda, naseBosnia. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula ezazihlose ukusiza abantu abampofu. Ukwamukelwa Kweziphakamiso UDesmond Tutu wathola izindondo eziningi ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe. Wathola iNobel Peace Prize ngonyaka ka-1984, ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe ekulweni nobandlululo. Ubuye wathola izindondo eziningi ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthula. Isiphetho UDokotela uDesmond Tutu ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe, ezokuhlalisana, kanye nezokholo. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Uhlale esikhumbuzo sokuthi ukuthula, ubumbano, nokuhloniphana kubalulekile ukuze sakhe umphakathi ongcono. UDesmond Tutu usashiya ifa elikhulu, elizohlala likhumbuleka eminyakeni ezayo.
