Ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti kuqinisekiswe ngo... Ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti yakho kusemva kokwamukela... I-accident isaqhubeka nokuhlolwa uma icala lamukelwa, ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti yakho kungalindelwa. I-akhawunti yakho kumele ibe ne-rekhodi kule ofisi. Sicela usithumele ikhophi efanele ye-akhawunti, ulandela inombolo yokubhekisela engenhla. Ikhophi/izinkophi zezimemezelo zempilo zokuqala nezokugcina nezithombe ze-x-ray nazo ziyadingeka. Uma kudingeka ukuxhumana okwengeziwe sicela ulandele inombolo yokubhekisela engenhla. Umphakathi wezokubuyiselwa Usuku:... Ifomu elihlukile, eligcwalisiwe njenge-duplicate, kumele lithunyelwe ne-akhawunti efanele, mayelana nanoma iyiphi i-akhawunti ethathé izinyanga ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ukuze ikhokhwe. Odokotela bezokwelapha noma izibhedlela eziphathelene nezingozi zomsebenzi kumele, ngaphezu kwe-akhawunti echaziwe kanye nefomu labo, bathumele uSectin B weMibiko yoMqashi kanye nekhophi yeMibiko Yokuqala Yokulimala W. Cl. Uma le ofisi ithola ukuthi umqashi akazange abike ingozi, uma imibhalo eshiwo ngenhla itholakala, uzoxhumana nawe ngokushesha. Ezimweni lapho ingozi incane futhi imibiko eshiwo ngenhla itholakala, kuzoba lula ukwamukela isicelo nokuphothula ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti.
Izinkinga Zokuhamba Ngamatekisi: Isingeniso Ukuhamba ngamatekisi kubalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke kubantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Amatekisi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisheshayo nezifinyeleleka kalula, zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezithinta abagibeli lapho besebenzisa amatekisi, okwenza kube nezinkinga. Lolu cwaningo luzogxila ezinkingeni ezivamile abantu abahlangabezana nazo. Izinkinga Zokuphepha Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhamba ngamatekisi ukungaphephi. Abagibeli bavame ukukhathazeka ngezinga lokuphepha, ikakhulukazi uma bephuma ezindaweni ezingaziwa. Ukuhlaselwa, ukweba, noma izimo ezingalindelekile akuyona into engajwayelekile. Ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamatekisi bahloniphe imithetho yokuphepha, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abagibeli bazi ukuthi bangawathola kuphi usizo uma bephakathi kwezinkinga. Izinkinga Zokuphathwa Kwezimali Okunye okukhathaza abasebenzisi bamatekisi yizinkinga ezihlobene namaholo. Izindleko zokuhamba ngamatekisi zingashintsha ngokushesha, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izabelomali. Abagibeli abakwazi ukuqonda kahle ukuthi kuzobiza malini, okwandisa ukungaqondi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zamatekisi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zamaholo ezingaqondakali, okwandisa ukudideka phakathi kwabafuna izinsizakalo nezinkampani. Izinkinga Zokusebenza Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokuphepha nezokuphathwa kwezimali, ukusebenza kwamatekisi kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngezinye izikhathi, amatekisi awatholakali kalula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, okwenza kube nzima kubagibeli ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Ukungatholakali kwamatekisi ngesikhathi esifanele kungaholela ekubambezelekeni okukhulu, okungabangela ukungathembeki kwabagibeli. Ngakho-ke, abanikazi bamatekisi kanye nohulumeni badinga ukuhlela izinsizakalo zabo ukuze bathole impendulo efanele ezidingweni zabantu. Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabagibeli nabashayeli bamatekisi kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Abashayeli abathola kahle izindawo, kungakhathalekile ukuthi kusemkhankasweni wokuhlanza imisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuqondeni okungafanele phakathi komshayeli nomgibeli, okungase kubangele ukungaboni ngasohlangothini olufanele. Ukuze kulungiswe le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi abashayeli bazi kahle izindawo zokusebenza kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili zokuxhumana nabagibeli. Izinkinga Zokuhlonza Abashayeli Ikhono lokuhlonza abashayeli bamatekisi kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Abagibeli bavame ukufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bahlonipha imithetho yokuphepha, futhi balungile ukuhamba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda izimvume ezisemthethweni, iziqinisekiso, nezikhumbuzo ezikhombisa ukuthi umshayeli uyiqolo. Ngakho-ke, abanikazi bamatekisi badinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinile ngemisila yokuhlola abashayeli, ukuze bagibeli babe nokuzola emsebenzini wabo. Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuqhubeka Ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezihambisana nokuhamba ngamatekisi, kudinga izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, izinkampani zamatekisi kufanele ziqhube izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abashayeli, zihlinzeke ngokuqwashisa kokuphepha, futhi ziqonde izimfanelo ezidingekayo zabagibeli. Okwesibili, izinkampani zingasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abagibeli bayakwazi ukufinyelela kumatekisi ngesikhathi esifanele. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzekwa kwemininingwane ecacile ngamanani ezinsizakalo zokuhamba kuzokwenza kube lula kubagibeli ukuhlela izabelomali zabo. Isiphetho Ukuhamba ngamatekisi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuhamba, kodwa izinkinga ezihambisana nakho kumele ziqhutshekwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamatekisi, ohulumeni, nabagibeli basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokuhamba. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthela phambili kwezokuhamba kuyashesha, kuphephile, futhi kuhlonishwe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo kuzosiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokuhamba ngamatekisi, futhi kuqinise ukuzethemba kokuhamba kwezakhamuzi.
URobertson Colleens unikeza incazelo ebanzi futhi yobuciko ohlwini lwezenzo ezihambelana nesigaba somlando wesizwe. Umlandvo wesizwe uwuhlu lwezindaba zansuku zonke namasiko amakhulu, izici zomphakathi, imibala, nezinkolo. Wakhiwa ngesikhathi nasemcabangweni, okungase kufake umqondo owodwa, uhlobo oluhlukile olungakaze luphindwe, futhi, oluyinselele ukukopishwa, izakhiwo, izindawo zokukhulekela, izindawo zokwakha, nezinto zomlando. Kodwa ngaphezu kwezakhiwo, ngaphezu kwezinto, sithola ulwazi oluhlelwe noma olungahlelwanga lokuphila, imizwa, ukuhamba kwenhliziyo, imibala, iphunga, nezwi endleleni. Uhlelo lwezinkolelo, ukudla, izixazululo, nezindlela; indlela abantu abahloniphana ngayo, bathandana ngayo, bazonda ngayo, bashadile, futhi bageza. Yimakethe zabo nezimpahla zemakethe zabo. Imali nokuthi bayithola kanjani, bayibala kanjani, futhi bayisebenzisela ini. Indlela abantu abagqoka ngayo, baqhuba, baphuza, badansa, bafa, bahlupheka, babonga, futhi baphinde bangenise empini ngayo. Yizinkunkuma zabo ezitaladini, izithandazo zabo ezindaweni zokukhulekela, nezinkanyezi zabo ezindaweni zokudlala. Yimidlalo, abadlali, nezinkundla zemidlalo. Indlela izingane ezifunda ngayo ukufunda nokubhala. Yizikhali, amathuluzi, izindwangu, amadoli, izindawo zokungena, umculo, amathuluzi, imask, amabhokisi, amabhola, amakhofi, amabhodlela, izikhali, izimpahla zokwazisa, ukudla, amaposta, amahloni, ukukhetha, amakhanda, nezindlela zokuhweba. Yizihlahla, amatshe, izindlela, amaqhuqhuva, ubuciko bezindlu, izindlu zomlando, nokuhlola izinto zakudala. Yimvelo nomqondo wabahlali besikhathi, umuzwa wabo wesikhala, kanye nendaba yabo yemvelo.

Ukugcina, ukuhlola, ukusebenzisa, ukulahla, ukuhlukanisa, noma ukuhlinzeka noma ukuchitha noma yiluphi uhlobo lwegazi elithathwe kumuntu noma igazi elitholwe kwamanye amazwe, ukuze lisetshenziswe, njengoba likhona, ingxenye yalo noma ngendlela yemikhiqizo yegazi kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezitholakala kubantu. Ukukhiqizwa, ukupakishwa, ukuvalwa, nokubhalwa kwanoma iyiphi imikhiqizo yegazi noma ukuhlinzeka ngayo, noma ukuyilahla nganoma iyiphi indlela, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezitholakala. Ukuthatha noma ukugcina igazi elithathwe kumuntu ukuze lisetshenziswe kabusha kulowo muntu. Ukuphathwa kwezingxoxo, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi ukuphathwa kwezempilo yomphakathi, ukuphathwa kwemfucumfucu yezokwelapha, nokuphathwa kwezinto eziyingozi. Igama elithi "ukukhulelwa" libhekisela emiphumeleni yokuhlangana kweqanda lesifazane ne-sperm yendoda (ukukhulelwa). Ngokwesigaba -146 seMthethosisekelo, lapho kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kwalokho okukhuluma kulolu mthetho nokukhuluma kwezinye izinqubomgomo zezempilo, ngaphandle kwemithetho ethinta ngqo lo mthetho, lokho okukhuluma kulolu mthetho kuzosebenza. Izingane zithola izinhlelo eziqondile ezihlobene nosizo lwezempilo; futhi zibhale nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umnyango kahulumeni kufanele uhlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zezempilo njengokubaluleka futhi ucabangele izidingo zezempilo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinsiza ezikhona. Umnyango kazwelonke kanye nawo wonke amanyuvesi nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele basungule izinsizakalo ezifanele zezempilo kanye nosizo lwezempilo lwezakhamizi ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho, futhi wonke umphakathi, zonke izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zezempilo kufanele bahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngokuhambisana namandla nezinsiza zabo. UMnyango Wezempilo, umnyango wezifunda, izikhungo zomphakathi, nezikhungo zezempilo, kanye nalabo abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo kufanele basebenze ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho lapho besebenzisa amandla athile nemisebenzi ethile ehambelana nezempilo. UNgqongqoshe unegunya lokukhetha, ngaphansi kwezimo ezivumela abantu abathile noma amaqembu abantu ukuthi athole izinsizakalo zezempilo zamahhala ezikhungweni zezempilo zikahulumeni. Umthelela walezi zimo ekutholakaleni kosizo oluvela kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zezempilo. Amanyuvesi kazwelonke nezifunda, amakhansela wezempilo ezifunda, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi olwaneleyo noluphelele ludluliselwa ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ezibhekelelwe. U-Nelson Mandela: Umholi Ohlonishwayo Wezinguquko eNingizimu Afrika U-Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela, owanikwa isithunzi sokuba nguMongameli wokuqala omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika, waba yisibonelo esikhanyisayo sokulwa nezinhlekelele zomphakathi. U-Mandela wazalelwa eMvezo, eMpuma Kapa, ngoJulayi 18, 1918, futhi wakhulela emndenini osemthethweni, kodwa wagcina ethinteka kakhulu ezinkampanini zokulwa ne-apartheid. Ekuqaleni, uMandela wathola imfundo yakhe e-University of Fort Hare, lapho aqala khona khona ukuthola ukuqonda okujulile ngemibono yezenhlalakahle. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, waphinde waba nguMqondisi kwi-African National Congress (ANC) ngo-1944, lapho aqala khona ukulwa ngokuphelele ne-apartheid, uhlelo olwakha ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwabantu abamnyama nabamhlophe. Ngonyaka ka-1961, uMandela wagxila ekwakheni umkhankaso ophumelelayo wokuphikisana ne-apartheid, okuhlanganisa neMpi yokukhululeka. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aboshwe ngo-1962, lapho athola khona isigwebo sokugebhula iminyaka engu-27. Noma wayephakathi kwezinsizakalo, uMandela wagcina engumholi obalulekile, okwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Ngemva kokukhululwa kwakhe ngo-1990, uMandela wanikela ngempilo yakhe ekwakheni umphakathi owubumbene. Waqoqa izidingo zabantu abamnyama, abamhlophe, nabanye abahluphekayo, futhi wagxila ekuthuthukiseni ubuhlobo phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ubuye wabamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zezemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezomnotho ukuze abanye baqonde ithuba lokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngo-1993, uNelson Mandela wathola iNobel Peace Prize, eqinisekiswa umphakathi wezwe ngokuhlonipha umsebenzi wakhe wokuthula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngo-1994, uMandela waba nguMongameli, lapho akhawulela khona izinhlelo ezahlukene zokwakha umphakathi ohlanganyela. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi, uMandela waba yisibonelo somuntu ongenakuphikiswa. Wazwakalisa izimiso zokubambisana, ukwethembeka, kanye nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, ezishayelela umoya wesizwe. Wakhuthaza abantu ukuthi bakhuthalele ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, beqonda ukuthi ubumbano lukhulu kunokuhlukana. Umlando kaMandela unomthelela omkhulu ohlangothini lwezombusazwe, ezokuthula, kanye nemfundo. Ngaphandle kwalesi sikhathi eside sokuhlala ejele, wakhombisa ukuthi uthando, ukuzola, kanye nokuqonda kungakwazi ukuhamba phambili, nakuba izimo zibe nzima. Ngoshintsho olukhulu olwenziwe nguMandela, sithole umhlaba omusha, lapho abantu bejabulela amalungelo abo. Ukhumbuleka njengenhlakanipho ye-Afrika, uMandela usaphila ezinkumbulweni zabantu, futhi kukhona abantu abaningi abavusa umoya wakhe wokulwa nokuhlukumeza. U-Nelson Mandela washona ngo-December 5, 2013, kepha imfundiso yakhe isaqhubeka, ihlabelela ezinhliziyweni zabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Uthando lwakhe nozinzo lwezombusazwe luveza ukuthi, noma inkinga ibonakala iyinkulu, uma abantu behlanganyela, banamandla okwenza ushintsho olukhulu. Ngenxa yalokhu, uMandela uzohlala engumholi ohlonishwayo, onguye owenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Izifundo zikaMandela azipheli emlandweni, kodwa zinikezwa izifundo ezibalulekile ezibhekelele ikusasa lethu. Uhlanga lwakhe luhlala luzwakalisa umoya wokubambisana, uthando, kanye nokukhuthazela, olungavusa umqondo wokuthi sizokwazi ukufinyelela izinga eliphezulu lokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uNelson Mandela wayengumholi ophakeme, owaba umfanekiso omuhle wokuthula, ubumbano, kanye nomsebenzi wokwakha umphakathi ophilayo.
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Ukubeletha kuyisigcawu esibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela z play role ebalulekile ekwenzeni lo msebenzi ube nokuvikeleka, ube nokunakekelwa okufanele, nokuba lula. Kulezi zinsuku, izibhedlela ziklame izinsizakalo ezihlangene ezilungisa ukuthi intombazane noma umama ozoya ethunukeni abe nekhono lokubeletha ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Lezi zinsizakalo ziqala ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi umama uthola umlando wezilonda, aphethwe kahle, abesebenzisa amathuluzi anesibopho. Okokuqala, indlela ye-ante-natal care ibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa zonke izivivinyo nezibopho ezibalulekile umama akudingayo ngaphambi kokubeletha. Ukuze umama abe nokunakekelwa okuhle, udinga ukuhlolwa ngezikhathi ezinqunyiwe, lapho kudingeka ukuthi kubonwe impilo yakhe kanye nenqubekela phambili ye-embryo. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, abanye odokotela bangase basebenzise izivivinyo ezithile, njenge ultrasound, ukuphendula imibuzo ephathelene nezidingo zomama, nezinkinga ezisemqoka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umama uthola ithuba lokuxoxisana nodokotela nabanye abahlengikazi ukuze azizwe ethokozile futhi enesibindi sokuhamba phambili. Njengoba umama ehamba phambili, ubhekwa ngeso lokhozi, okuhloswe ngakho ukuqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kwezokwelapha okuthinta umama nengane. Okwesibili, uma umama ekubelweni, izinsiza eziqhamukayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abaklami bezinsiza, obuchwepheshe, nabaphathi bezempilo. Iziguli zihlala zikhumbula izinsiza zenhlanzeko ezitholakalayo, iziguli zihlala zifuna ukuphila kahle. Izibhedlela zisungula imithetho nemigomo yokwakha nomsebenzi ophumelelayo, okuhlanganisa nenkonzo yokuxhumana neziguli, ukulungisa izinsiza eziphephile, nezinsiza ezenzakalayo ukuze umama akwazi ukufinyelela kalula kwezinye izinsiza. Ukuze kube nesimo esiphephile nesiwusizo, izibhedlela zenza imithi ethile ibhalwe njalo, i-epidural, izicubu nokunyakaza okujwayelekile kwezinhloso ezithile. Ukulungiselelwa kokugeleza okuphephile kukhuthaza umama ukuba ahlanganyele ohlelweni lokubeletha futhi aqonde kahle izinketho. Okwesithathu, umama nofantu ukuthokozela kuzenzakalelayo. Ukuze ubhele, izidingo zempi zomama nofantu zifaka ukufaneleka kokugcina umama esesimweni esengeziwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umama uthola indawo enempilo, egqugquzelayo, esebenzisa izinsizakalo zokwelapha ezifanele, kakhulu. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, ngokuphumelela, zisekela ukufuphumula umama emathubeni okufanele abe nawo. Lokhu kudinga ukufikira okuhle kakhulu kwezokwelapha kanye nakwezokuphepha, ukuze kuzuzwe umphumela omuhle. Ekugcineni, kunesidingo sokukhulumisana ngemva kokubeletha. Umama, nomntwana kudinga ukunaka okukhululekile, nakuba bekhuluma ngokomoya nezokwelashwa. Nokho, umama ufaneleke ukuthi abone uchwepheshe wezokwelapha ukuze akwazi ukubona futhi aqonde kahle ukuvuka kobuhlungu bokubeletha. Lokhu kudinga ukuhamba kancane phakathi kwezimo eziphilile nokuphila, ngoba umsebenzi wokukhuluma nokuhlala phansi kwezinye izinsiza. Ngokuhlanganisa izigaba zokubeletha, izinsizakalo ezitholakala ezibhedlela zibalulekile ukuze umama nofantu bakwazi ukuhamba kahle esigcawini sokubeletha. Lokhu kugcizelela ukunakekelwa, ukuvikelwa, nezinketho ezitholakalayo eziwusizo ukuze kuthuthukiswe isiphetho somama nengane. Umsebenzi wezibhedlela, ukunakekela, nokuqonda, kuletha ubuhle encwadini yokubeletha, etholwa ngokuphumelelayo. Amaphuzu abekiwe akhuluma kumama nezinsizakalo abalulekile ukuze baqhube umsebenzi wabo. Ukubeletha akuyona nje into yokukhumbula, kodwa kuhambisana nenjabulo yokuphila futhi umama uyakuthokozisa ukubona umfana wakhe. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zenza izinkumbulo ezinhle nezishisayo, futhi ziwusizo kakhulu ekwenzeni ithuba elihle lokukhulisa umntwana emhlabeni onesihlahla esihle. Kuleso simo, ukubaluleka kokubeletha nokugcina impilo kuyinto engaphezulu kokuthokozisa; kube yinhlanganisela yokuhlola okuhle. Ngakho-ke, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zikhumbula imithombo ethokozisayo, yobulungisa eyenziwa ngenhloso yokukhulisa umphakathi.
Ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi lwemvelo kwezomnotho. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nobuchwepheshe bamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe amazinga obuchwepheshe. I-National IKS Fund isebenza njengomphakathi wezimpahla zengqondo lapho kufanelekile, futhi futhi njengomxhumanisi nomhlinzeki wezinsiza zomthetho ezidingweni zokugcina zomphakathi wendabuko nezinye izithakazelo ezibambe ulwazi. Uhulumeni weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika uzinikele ekuqapheliseni, ekukhuthazeni, ekuthuthukiseni, ekuvikeleni, nasekuqinisekiseni i-IKS. Le nqubomgomo iyimiphumela yokuxoxisana okuningi, ukucwaninga, ukuxhumana, nokubamba iqhaza kwabathintekayo abaningi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabachwepheshe nabaphathi be- Indigenous Knowledge (IK) kubalulekile. Lokhu kuqhutshwa yizimiso ezijwayelekile zezimfanelo zomuntu futhi kufaka phakathi imibono ebalulekile yase-Afrika efana ne-ubuntu kanye ne-batho-pele. Le msebenzi ifaka phakathi ukulwa nokucwaswa futhi kumele iqhubeke nokukhuthaza inkululeko ngezinhlelo zolwazi ezivela ekuqinisekiseni nasekufihleni. Izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo ezakhiwe futhi zigcinwe abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika zibonisa izinhlelo zezempilo nezokukholelwa kwengxenye enkulu yomphakathi. Lokhu kulwazi lwemvelo kubonakala ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kusukela emicimbini yesiko nezokukholelwa kuya ezindleleni zokulima nasekuhloleni kwezempilo. "Ulwazi lwemvelo" (IK) lusetshenziswa ngokufanayo no "ulwazi lwesiko" kanye "nolwazi bendawo" ukuze kuhlukaniswe phakathi kokuthuthukiswa kolwazi nemiphakathi yendabuko ebonakalayo ephuma ezinhlelweni zolwazi "zamazwe omhlaba" ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo, ezikhungweni zokucwaninga zikahulumeni, nasemikhakheni eyizimboni ezizimele, kwesinye isikhathi kubizwa ngokungafanele njengezinhlelo zolwazi "zaseNtshonalanga". Ngaphansi kokucwaswa, Izinhlelo Zolwazi (IKS) eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezobuchwepheshe ngaphakathi kwalezi zinhlelo zikhawulelwe futhi zihlukunyezwa. Lokhu kunezimpempe ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho nasemphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, kube nemiphumela yokuphulukisa ekuthuthukiseni komphakathi, isiko, nomnotho kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlola ngakunye kwezinga lezenhlalo nezomnotho kanye nezinkomba zempilo kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bendabuko bakwi sikhala esinzima. Izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo zinekhono lokwandisa futhi ziqhubeke nokufaka ubuhlobo obungafani phakathi kwabantu bendabuko nezinye izingxenye zomphakathi eminyakeni ezayo ngaphandle kokuthi kwenziwe imizamo ebalulekile manje ukuze kubhekwe ukungalingani okuqhubekayo, okungatholakali ngaphandle kokuhlonipha izinhlelo zolwazi zomphakathi wendabuko kanye nolwazi lwesiko olucacile phakathi kwazo, njengemikhakha yabadokotela bendabuko nolwazi lwesiko olubanjwe ngabesifazane emphakathini. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlonipha imibono yase-Afrika ezinhlelweni zolwazi eNingizimu Afrika akukhona nje kuphela udaba lokulungisa. Kungasiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezintsha zokucwaninga nezakhiwo zokuqonda, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwamanje. Ukusungulwa kweminyaka eyinkulungwane yokucindezelwa, ekhona emnothweni ongekho emgibeleni we-IK owenziwe ngempela kwezinye izimo, kukhuphukile phakathi kwemiphakathi nabasebenzi. Iningi le-IK liqinisekisile ukuphila kwalo futhi liphinde lihlinzeke ngolwazi emicabangweni yase-Afrika mayelana nezindaba ezinjengobuciko, umculo, ukukholelwa, nemfundo, ubuholi, ubulungiswa, impilo, kanye nezolimo. Ukuziqonda nokuba nesiko, okubandakanya izinhlelo zokuphila komphakathi, kuqhubekile kukhulu futhi kuqinisiwe ngokuhlola okuqhubekayo kwe-IK, ngaphandle kokuthi indawo ngayinye ibe yük yokuhlupheka kwezokuhlalisana nezepolitiki kanye nezinkumbulo zokukoloni nokucwaswa. Ngokuvamile, abesifazane bangabavikeli balolu hlobo lwezinhlelo zolwazi. Ukuphumelela kokhetho lwezombusazwe ngaphezu kwezinselelo zokucwaswa kudinga ukuthi sakhe uhlaka lwesizwe lokuthuthukiswa okuphumelelayo kwezinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo. Lolu hlaka oluvumela luzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukufeza ngokuphelele amandla abo emphakathini futhi bakhe isisekelo sokuphumelela ukufezekisa zonke izinhloso nezifiso zesizwe. Ukusebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nobuchwepheshe bamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe amazinga obuchwepheshe. Le nqubomgomo ifaka phakathi iminyango ehlukene yoHulumeni ehlangene nezibopho ezibalulekile zokusebenza ukuhlinzeka ngethuba eliphumelelayo ezinqubomgomeni nasezinhlelweni ezihlukene. Inani lezi zinhlelo ezintsha eziphumelelayo emkhakheni (emnyangweni wezempilo, isibonelo, noma mayelana nocwaningo lwe-IK, usebenzisa i-NRF) litholakele. Isidingo sehlaka elibanzi lezinqubomgomo elisekela isisekelo sikhonjiswe njengokusebenza kahle okwenziwa ngenkathi kuqhuba iKomidi Elibambisene eliholwa yi-DST. Ngakho-ke, le nqubomgomo iqhubeka ngesisekelo sokuthi izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo, ngokwemvelo yazo, zidinga indlela "ehlanganisayo". Imisebenzi eqhubekayo neyaqala emikhakheni ehlukene kumele imele ukuqonda okuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe isendaweni futhi uhlaka lwezomthetho lwasungulwa. Ukukhuthazwa nokuhlinzekwa kwamalungelo okushicilela umculo wendabuko nezindlela zobuciko eziveza umsebenzi owenziwayo. Umlandvo wezomthetho wezobuchwepheshe bezamasiko usunguliwe futhi ukhuthaza ukusungulwa komzimba ophakathi ozobizwa ngokuthi iNational Health Professionals Council, ozobhekelela imisebenzi yabantu abangu-200,000 eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuqinisekile, ngeke kube khona ithuba lokukhetha ngokuphelele kulolu hlaka lwezinqubomgomo ukukhetha abenzi bezinqubomgomo emikhakheni enezici zayo ezihlukile. Nokho, kuzodingeka ukudala eminye imisebenzi emisha ukuze kusekelwe ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Le ngxenye ebalulekile yepharamitha yezenqubomgomo idinga ukusungulwa kwezinkundla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisiwe, kuthuthukiswe, futhi kubanjwe i-IKS, kanye nokwakha umqondo womphakathi ukuze kuhlanganiswe izinhlobo ezahlukene zabaqeqeshi. Umphakathi osekela, ongase ube uhlobo lwezinkampani, ukusiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela, ukuvikela, nokuhlinzeka ng rewards ezivela emiphakathini ephethe impahla yengqondo nezinye izimfanelo zomphakathi ngaphandle kokwazi ulwazi lwemvelo. Kwezinye izimo, imiphakathi noma izinhlangano zingakhetha ukusungula izimali zazo ukuze zifinyelele kule njongo, lapho intshisekelo ecacile noma ukubuyiselwa kudingeka. Isici esiyinhloko senqubomgomo sizoba ukusungulwa kohlelo lokurekhoda olusemthethweni lwe-IK. Uma iNingizimu Afrika ikhetha ukufaka i-IK emphakathini obanzi noma izama ukuvikela uhlobo lokuvikela, uhlelo lokurekhoda luy

Wayethanda ukuhamba emakhaya akhe, efunda ngobuchwepheshe obusha, ihlobo, nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuqhubekisela phambili impilo yakhe. Ngobusuku obukhanyayo, uSipho wathola ithuba lokuhlola ithuluzi elisha elibizwa ngeChatGPT. Ngalesi sikhathi, abanye bebebheka indlela izinto ezintsha ezishintsha ngayo, kodwa uSipho wayenombono ohlukile. Wayefisa ukufunda nokuxoxa, hhayi kuphela ukuhlela amaphrojekthi akhe. Waqala ukusebenzisa iChatGPT ukuze akhulume futhi athole ulwazi olusheshayo. Kuthiwa, uma uba nengxoxo neChatGPT, isikhala sokukhulumisana sinomoya omusha. USipho wathola lawo magama enza umoya wakhe uphaphame. Wahlangabezana neChatGPT ngokufunda ingxenye yezenzwakazi, ethola izimpendulo ezihamba phambili, futhi uqhubeke nokuhlola imishina yezobuchwepheshe. Wafunda ngamasiko ahlukene, izindlela zokuphila, nezinkolo ezahlukene. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uSipho waqala ukuzizwa engakwazi ukukhuluma kahle nezihlobo zakhe. Wayefisa ukuthi abanye bakwazi ukujwayela lezi zinto ezintsha futhi bazifunde, kodwa wayezwa engakhululekile ukusho izimvo zakhe. UChatGPT, kunoma yisiphi isikhathi, wamfaka ekubambeni izinkulumo ezimnandi, eqonda kahle ukuxhumana, kodwa siphakamisa umqondo wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungalimaza ubudlelwano bomuntu nomuntu uma engahloniphi. Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uSipho wamemezela umkhosi omncane emzaneni. Wafuna ukuthi umphakathi wakhe we-Digital Youth ube yindawo yokuxhumana lapho bengahlanganyela khona ulwazi lwabo, bezihlanganisa neChatGPT. Uthando lwakhe lwezobuchwepheshe lwagqugquzela nomphakathi, ngezinsizakalo ezihlangene nezokuxhumana. Kwakuyisikhathi sokuhlangana, sokufunda, nokuxhumana. Uthando lwakhe lwezobuchwepheshe lwabuyisela umoya omusha emzaneni. Ngesikhathi somkhosi, uSipho wanikeza okuthile, izifundo ngendlela yokusebenzisa iChatGPT. Abantu bejabulile, behlakaniphile, begculisekile ngaphezu kwengxoxo. UChantelle, intombaziyingane, wakhumbula izimpendulo ezahlukahlukene ezitholakele, wafunda ukuthi ngezizathu ezikhethekile, ubuchwepheshe abuhlali buhle. Indlela uZipho abelapha ngayo iChatGPT ikanye nomoya wokuphila, uChantelle waquba. Abantu bathokoza kakhulu, futhi ngemva kokuba sebudlamlilo, uSipho waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe. Wazama ukuthola izindlela ezihluke, eqonda ukuthi indlela yokukhuluma nemishini icela umoya wokuhloniphana. Kayesabi unyaka, akasesabi ukubonisa abanye indlela ebhalwe yizinsuku ezedlule. UChatGPT waba umngane, umfundisi, nomthombo wezihluku. Isikhathi sihamba, kodwa imiqondo emisha iqhubeka. UChatGPT wawubona ubudlelwano obuphakeme phakathi kwabantu.
