Wayezwa ukwaneliseka kokuhlanganyela izimpendulo ezithokozisayo futhi efuna ukuba nxazonke ezimweni ezahlukahlukene. Ngemuva kokuhlola uhambo lweminyaka eyishumi, uSipho wagcina ekwazi kahle lokhu, wathi, “Ubuchwepheshe buyehlisa umqondo wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa kumele sikhumbule ukuhamba phambili, sizwakalise izwi lethu.” Uhlanga lwakhe lwade lwaba yinsiza yokufunda. Ukuhlekisa, ukufunda, nokuhlanganisa kwavuma ngokuzenzakalelayo emoyeni, kanti umphakathi wathuthuka ngemibono emisha. Ekugcineni, uSipho waphinta unyaka, ephinde abayeke abantu bejabulile. Wayezazi ukuthi imiqondo yakhe yempilo yayiyinsiza ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ngakho, umphakathi uBumbene waba yindawo yokuhlanganyela izimpumelelo, engashintsha izindlela zokuphila. Uthando lwenhlonipho, ubugagu, izinsizakalo, kanye neChatGPT kwaba yinsiza yokwehlisa ubuhlobo. Uthando lwezobuchwepheshe hlangana neChatGPT, kwaba umqondo ohlangene, ohlanganisa ubuchwepheshe nezikhala zokuhlanganyela, okwakungazange kwandiswa koSipho. Waba yindawo yokuxhumana, nokuhlobisa izimpumelelo ezithokozisayo. Umsakazo ohloniphekile waba umholi, owavula amehlo omphakathi kuzo zonke ezithile. Lokhu kwaba yokuqala kwesizukulwane esisha esaziwa ngoSipho, nesizolalelana eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane ezizayo. Phakade uSipho noChatGPT bahlala bobabili, bahlala bezama ukuthola izimpendulo ezimnandi.
Ngokulandela lokhu, kubizwa ngokuthi isivumelwano somphakathi ngapha, emva kwalokhu babizwa ngamaqembu. I-SAPS ingena esivumelwaneni ne-CONTRACTOR ngokuhambisana nezimo nemigomo ebekiwe esivumelwaneni, futhi i-CONTRACTOR ivuma ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwakhe ngqo kwi-SAPS ngokuhambisana nezimo nemigomo ebekiwe kulesi SIVUMELWANO, esizobizwa ngokuthi WORK: Kwaphela uma i-CONTRACTOR ingaziswa yi-SAPS ukuthi asebenze kwi-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma iyiphi indawo eyi-SAPS engaphansi kwe-WORK, kuzoba isikhathi esilinganiselwe. I-CONTRACTOR, ngenxa yesi sivumelwano, ngeke ibe noma ibe ngaphansi kokulindela ukuthi lesi sivumelwano sizovuselelwa, futhi ngeke ibekwe emsebenzini njengesisebenzi se-SAPS. Kuvunyelwene phakathi kweZIGABA ukuthi isivumelwano se-CONTRACTOR esenziwe naye njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kukhona ubudlelwano bokusebenza phakathi kwe-CONTRACTOR ne-SAPS. I-CONTRACTOR kumele, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-clause 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo ye-clause 5 no-9 ngezansi, ihlinzeke i-SAPS ngezinsizakalo njengoba kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe yi-SAPS, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lokuqala kulesi SIVUMELWANO, bheka i-clause 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene ne-CONTRACTOR izofaka noma iyiphi imisebenzi yezandla eyingxenye, futhi ehambisana, nomsebenzi we-CONTRACTOR. I-CONTRACTOR izokwenza umsebenzi wakhe (bheka i-clause 3.1 - 3.2 ngenhla) kwi-SAPS ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngesonto: Kwaphela uma i-CONTRACTOR ingasebenzi kwi-SAPS ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto, noma ezinsukwini zomkhosi. I-CONTRACTOR izokwenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokuhambisana nohlelo oluhlanganiswe lapha njengeSheduli A. I-CONTRACTOR ngeke ibe nelungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma ezinsukwini ayengakabi khona ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-CONTRACTOR ngeke ibe nelungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izoba nesibopho sokuhlinzeka i-CONTRACTOR ngezokuthutha ukuya nokubuya kwi-WORK ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe, bheka i-clause 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izokhokhela i-CONTRACTOR ngokuba khona kwakhe nomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yesivumelwano ye-R - ...rand ngehora kuhlanganiswe ne-VAT: Kwaphela uma i-SAPS ingakhulisa le mali yesivumelwano yehora ngokuthanda kwayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Le mali izokhokhwa ngenyanga ngemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yesivumelwano (bheka i-clause 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo ophelele kanye nezinsizakalo zonke ezihambisana nomsebenzi we-CONTRACTOR, kwaphela uma le mali ikhokhwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho othile, izofakwa emholweni we-CONTRACTOR. I-CONTRACTOR ivikela i-SAPS kukho konke ukulimala noma ukulahleka okubangelwa ukulimala komzimba, ukulahleka kokuphila, ukulahleka noma ukulimala kwempahla kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kubangelwa yi-SAPS noma omunye umuntu noma kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kubangelwa noma ngenxa yokungakhathali okukhona ngesikhathi engumsebenzi we-SAPS ogcina ukuhleleka, futhi ivikela i-SAPS kukho konke ukulahleka, ukulimala, izindleko noma imali ekhokhelwayo mayelana nezinqubo zomthetho ezikhona eziphathelene ne-CONTRACTOR futhi ezingase zibe nezicelo zemali noma ukuboshwa nganoma iyiphi indlela. Lesi SIVUMELWANO sizoqala futhi sibe nesibopho kusukela ngosuku olusayinwe yizigaba zombili kulesi SIVUMELWANO: Kwaphela uma lesi SIVUMELWANO singasayinwa ngesikhathi esifanayo yiZIGABA, usuku lokugcina lokusayinwa kwelinye lamaqembu luzothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kulesi SIVUMELWANO. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-clause 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizoqhubeka isikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi), esizoqala ngosuku lokuqala lapho lesi SIVUMELWANO siqala (bheka i-clause 12.1 ngezansi). Lesi SIVUMELWANO singavuselelwa ngokuthanda kwe-SAPS ngokubhalwa phansi ngokuvuma kwe-CONTRACTOR isikhathi esichaziwe: Kwaphela uma i-SAPS ifuna ukwazisa i-CONTRACTOR ukuthi ifuna ukuvuselela lesi SIVUMELWANO, kumele inikeze isaziso esibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe ku-clause 13.2 ngenhla, ngaphambi kokuphela kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla). Okuqukethwe kwalesi SIVUMELWANO kuzoba yisisekelo sesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokuhambisana ne-clause 13.2 ngenhla. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-clause 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizophela ngokuzenzakalelayo ekupheleni kwesikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi). Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sosuku olulodwa. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kodwa ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sezinsuku ezimbili zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela ngemuva kwenyanga zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso senyanga. Kwaphela uma i-SAPS ingakwamukela, ngezimo ezithile ezamukelekayo, isaziso esifushane. Noma iyiphi iqembu kulesi SIVUMELWANO ingaqeda lesi SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula noma iyiphi ingxenye yalesi SIVUMELWANO: Kwaphela uma iqembu lokuqala elishiwo linikeze elinye iqembu isaziso esibhaliwe mayelana nale mpahla futhi le mpahla ayilungiswanga phakathi kwezinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela ngosuku ayitholile leso saziso. Izihloko zemigomo kulesi SIVUMELWANO zikhona kuphela ukuze zisetshenziswe njengokubhekisela, ngakho-ke azikho ingxenye futhi azihlobene nokuchazwa kwemigomo nganoma iyiphi indlela. Ngaphandle kokuthi kubonakale ukuthi kukhona ukungqubuzana noma ukungahambisani nokuhlangenwe nakho, okwakodwa kuzofaka okwakubili futhi ubulili besilisa kuzofaka ubulili besifazane, futhi kuphinde kube njalo. Lesi SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelele phakathi kweZIGABA futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esingase sibe khona phakathi kweZIGABA mayelana nokuhlangenwe nakho lapha. I-ZIGABA ivuma ukuthi ngeke kube nezinguquko, ukwengeza, noma izivumelwano zokukhansela noma noma yini edala kab
Mnumzane ohloniphekile, uMphakathi wePhondo, uDkt. Sibusiso Ndebele, ohloniphekile, amalungu eKhansela, amalungu ePhalamende lePhondo, uMnumzane ohloniphekile nozakwethu beKomidi Lezempilo, uMeya ohloniphekile kanye namakholwa, oBaNtu bendabuko, uMphakathi weMnyango, uDkt. Yolisa Mbele, abasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo, izivakashi zethu ezahlukene, izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, abafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Mnumzane ohloniphekile, ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukuhlala phambi kwenu nalesi sikhungo namuhla njengomuntu onenhlonipho futhi ozinikele kwiAfrican National Congress, lapho sibhiyozela iminyaka emihlanu yokuzinikela kwalesi sikhungo ekusebenzeleni abantu, njengoba kuchaziwe nguMongameli wethu, uMnumzane ohloniphekile uThabo Mbeki, ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngenkonzo yokusebenza kwabantu ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobuphofu. Siqhubeka nalesi sizathu, futhi ngikholelwa ukuthi senze okungcono kakhulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi nasekulweleni ubuphofu. Lokhu kuboniswa yisisho sethu eMnyangweni wezempilo, "Ukulwa Nezifo, Ukulwa Nobuphofu, Ukunikeza Ithemba" kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi eziyishumi ePhondweni lethu elihle eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Siphinde safika kude ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinhloso ze-Black Economic Empowerment. Izikhathi eziningi, izinselelo esihlangabezana nazo njengombuso nasemhlabeni wethu, kanye nomsebenzi esizibekele wona, zidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu, sibahlanganise bonke ukwenza okudingekayo, futhi siqonde ukuthi ikusasa lomuntu ngamunye sikhona ezandleni zethu! Mnumzane ohloniphekile, uMongameli uthi kufanele sikhumbule lapho siphumelele noma siphumelele. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukuthi sibheke izinselelo esihlangabezana nazo kule minyaka emihlanu yokuzinikela kwabantu, njengoba uMongameli esebenzisa ukuzinikela kwabantu baleli zwe nalesi sikhungo. Okokuqala, phakathi kwezinkinga ezinkulu esihlangabezana nazo mayelana nezinkulumo ngemiholo yabasebenzi bakamasipala. Lapho lezi zinkulumo zifika endaweni engatholakali, kubangele ukuthi abasebenzi baphume emsebenzini ngoJuni 1, 2007. Lokhu akukhange kulahlekelwe abasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo. Ukungenelela okuhle kweMnyango kwakwazi ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zempilo ngesikhathi lesi sikhathi esinzima. Nakuba bekukhona lezi zifiso, izikhungo zethu zezempilo zazithinteka kakhulu futhi izimali ezinkulu zatholakala zikhokhela abasebenzi bangaphandle, ikakhulukazi abantu bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze basize umphakathi odinga usizo. Siphinde sathola ukuthi kufanele sithenge amabhentshisi ezibhedlela ezizimele futhi sathola izindleko ezinkulu. Enye inselelo esihlangabezana nayo yisifo seKlebsiella ephondweni. Amalungu azokhumbula icala elibi ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital lapho izingane zafa ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa ngenxa yeKlebsiella virus. Ucwaningo lwethu lukhombisile ukuthi le nkinga ivamise ukuvela ngenxa; (i) indlela izibhedlela zethu ezakhiwe ngayo, ikakhulukazi amakamelo; (ii) izimo zomnotho zabesifazane abasha abapheka abadinga ukuthembela kubodadewabo futhi bengakwazi ukulawula izindaba eziphathelene nokusebenza kwezocansi; (iii) ukudluliswa kwezifo ngenxa yokuthi izindlu zenzelwe kanjani, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni; kanye (iv) indlela imindeni ehlelwe ngayo engasizi empilweni yentsha. IPrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital iyisibonelo esihle sokuhlangabezana nalezi zinkinga engizichaze. Okokuqala, idolobha laseUmlazi linabantu abaningi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amadolobha ephondweni, kodwa alinalo usizo lwezempilo olufanele, okwenza iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital ibeke umthwalo omkhulu wokuletha abesifazane abaningi. Le nqubo ikhipha cishe abesifazane abangu-1,000 ngenyanga, futhi kulezi zingane, cishe abangu-525 bagcinwa kwiyunithi ye-neonatal besesimweni esibucayi. Isikhala esitholakalayo sincane kakhulu sokwamukela izingane eziningi, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi zidlulisele izifo ezahlukene. Okwesibili, ukungabi nezinsiza kuleli dolobha kwenza kube nzima kumphakathi ukuhlela imindeni, ikakhulukazi kubesifazane abasha abavame ukutholakala bephakathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuxhumana okuqondile nokudluliswa kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, kuhlanganise ne-HIV nezinye izifo ezifana ne-tuberculosis ne-Gonorrhea. Lokhu futhi kukhombisa kahle ukuthi intsha yethu ayifuni ukuzibandakanya ocansini oluphephile noluvikelekile! Ngalesi sizathu, ngihlala ngikhuthaza ukuthi kufanele siqale ukusebenza kanzima futhi sibe nendima ehamba phambili ekulweleni ukusabalala kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi (kuhlanganise ne-HIV) nokushintsha imicabango uma kuziwa empilweni yocansi. Ngenkathi iMnyango izosebenzisa konke okusemandleni ukuvimbela ukufa kwezingane ezizalwayo; sidinga futhi wonke umuntu ukusiza ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanzeka ekhaya, nokuqeqesha bobabili amantombazane namadoda ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi akukhona okungafunwa kokukhulelwa nokuphazamiseka kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Sonke sinesibopho esibalulekile sokufundisa izingane zethu ukuba babe yibo abazothatha ukunakekela amalungelo abo ocansi. Sizodinga futhi ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba ukuze sinciphise ukusabalala kwezifo ngenxa yezimo zomphakathi. Isibonelo esihle nguMnyango Wezokwakha emizamweni yawo yokuhlukanisa izindawo ezingekho emthethweni ngo-2014, isenzo esifanele ukuhalaliswa. Njengomnyango, emalini edlule, senze imikhankaso engu-45 yezempilo, okuyimizamo yokufundisa imiphakathi ngempilo engcono, sikholwa ukuthi lokhu kuzonciphisa umthwalo ezikhungweni zethu ezithola abathintekayo bezifo ezingavimbekile. Mnumzane ohloniphekile, kube nezikhathi eziningi lapho sithinteka kakhulu ukulahlekelwa ngabasebenzi abanekhono nokwehluleka kwethu ukuheha ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lokhu kungenxa yokuntuleka kwezindlu nezimali ezanele zokwakha izindlu, futhi lokhu kusemiphakathini njengoba silwa nokwakha izikhungo zezempilo. Sisesekude kakhulu ukuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kwabasebenzi besikhashana eMnyangweni wethu. Kunezikhungo eziningi eziqhubeka nokuhola abasebenzi besikhashana ukuze ziqinise izibhedlela nezinye izingxenye zeMnyango. Sihlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke lokhu kuvalwa masinyane nokuthi bonke labo basebenzi baqashwa ngokuphelele nguMnyango. Siqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikhala ezibalulekile zizogcwaliswa ngoJuni futhi sisesimweni sokwenza lokhu kwenzeke. UMongameli wezwe ngesikhathi esikhuluma wathi "Ngizokwenza izinto ngendlela engajwayelekile" futhi sihlela ukwenza noma yini edingekayo ukuze sifinyelele leli phupho - noma ngabe kanjani okungajwayelekile. Mnumzane
Amabhizinisi Amancane - Ingxoxo noMnu. Mthembu Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnu. Mthembu, ongum sahibi wamabhizinisi amancane eThekwini. UMr. Mthembu uthole impumelelo enkulu emkhakheni wezohwebo, futhi ubona amabhizinisi amancane njengesisekelo somnotho. Ake siqale le ngxoxo ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile ngezinkinga, amathuba, kanye nenhloso yokwakha amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwakha Amabhizinisi Amancane U-Mnu. Mthembu, ungakuchaza kanjani indlela owakha ngayo ibhizinisi lakho? “Ngiyabonga. Ngithole imfundo enkulu emndenini wami, njengoba babenamabhizinisi amancane. Ngathola ithuba lokuzama ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yami. Ngathanda ukwenza izinto ngezandla zami, ngakho ngafaka umqondo wokukhiqiza imikhiqizo yokudla. Ngafaka imali encane, ngaqala ngithengisa emakhaya nakumakhelwane. Lokhu kwaba isinyathelo sokuqala.” Izinselelo Zokusebenza “Yiziphi izinselelo obhekane nazo ekuqaleni?” “Ziningi, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu kwakungukuthola amakhasimende. Ngazama ukwakha igama elihle, kodwa ngathola ukuthi abanye abantu babejolise emikhiqizweni emikhulu. Kwangathi bengiwazi kahle umkhakha, ngabe ngithola ukwesekwa okwengeziwe. Okwesibili, kwakunzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka ukuze ngithuthukise ibhizinisi. Nokho, ngiyazama njalo.” Amathuba Nempumelelo “Ucabanga ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane anjani amathuba?” “Nakanjani! Amabhizinisi amancane ayisisekelo somnotho wethu. Anikeza abantu ithuba lokuzimela, futhi akha imisebenzi. Ngiyabona ukuthi abantu abaningi banikela kumabhizinisi amancane, futhi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Iphinde ibavumele abantu ukuthi bahloniphe imikhiqizo yendawo, futhi kube nethuba lokwazisa izitsha zethu zendabuko.” Ukwesekwa Nokuqhubekisela Phambili “Ucabanga ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele enze ini ukuze awasekele amabhizinisi amancane?” “Ngicabanga ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele unikeze izinsiza ezithile, njengokufundisa abantu indlela yokuphatha amabhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kube nezinhlangano ezixhasa amabhizinisi amancane ngokwabelana ngolwazi. Umfundisi wami abantu, bellengikhumbuza ukuthi ibhizinisi alikaze lihlale lilula, kodwa uthola ukwesekwa kuzokwenza umehluko.” Izifundo Ezifundwayo “Utholeziphi izifundo ezibalulekile empilweni yakho yokuhweba?” “Ngifunde ukubaluleka kokuxhumana. Ukuxhumana nabanye osomabhizinisi kuyasiza. Ngiyazi ukuthi akekho ongakwenza konke wedwa. Ngifunde futhi ukuthi ukulalela amakhasimende kubalulekile. Uma umakhasimende enza iziphakamiso, kufanele uzame ukuyisebenzisa. Lokhu kuhlelwe kahle, kuyothuthukisa ibhizinisi.” Ikhono Lokuphila “Ucabanga ukuthi abantu kufanele bazame ukwakha amabhizinisi amancane?” “Yebo, uma unenkani nokuzimisela, kufanele uzame. Amabhizinisi amancane awavuleli nje ithuba lokwenza imali, kodwa avula amathuba okukhula, okuthuthukisa izimpilo. Abantu kufanele babe nesibindi, baphathe izinsiza zabo kahle, futhi bahlale bethembekile kumakhasimende. Umuntu kufanele azi ukuthi akekho umphakathi ophumelelayo ngaphandle kokubambisana.” Isiphetho U-Mnu. Mthembu ubonisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba yinsika ebalulekile emiphakathini, asiza ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa umnotho. Ngokuqhubeka nesifiso sokuphumelela, ukuphatha kahle, nokuxhumana nabanye, amabhizinisi amancane angaletha ushintsho olukhulu. Le ngxoxo ibonisa ukuthi, ngaphezu kwezinsiza, umoya wokusebenza kanzima nokuhlonipha umphakathi yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni impumelelo. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esikhulu sokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho.
Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS Major Member Classification) Uhlanga lweGEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-"Government Employee Medical Scheme," lungumsebenzi obalulekile emzamweni wokuthuthukisa impilo nempilo yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu kuhloswe ukusiza ukuhlela ngendlela efanele abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, bese bekwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo okunembile nokuqhubekayo. Ukwakheka kwelungu le-GEMS kukhombisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza, ubuchwepheshe, nezinsizwa ezithuthukisa imfundo, umsebenzi, kanye nezimo zokuphila zakhona. Ukuhlukaniswa kwakha izigaba ezahlukene, zisekelwe ezidingweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu, kuhloswe nabo, bathola ukusiza okufanele. Ukwakhiwa kwezigaba ezahlukeneyo kudinga ukusungulwa komgomo ophusile. Lokhu kusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abanye abalondiwe bathola ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezihlinzeka ngempilo efanele, kakhulu kulabo abaphila nezimo ezikhethekile. Ngakho, ngale ndlela, kugxilwe kakhulu ezidingweni zezigaba ezithile ezithintekayo, njengezinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezikhokhelwa nguMnyango wezabeMpilo, ukuze kubhekwane nezidingo ezenzakalayo zabantu abavela ezimeni ezinzima. Ngokubhekwa lezi zici, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezemfundo, kwezempilo, kanye nezimo eziphilayo zabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezinamandla ezibhekelela lezi zinhlelo, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okunembile phakathi kwezinhlelo zezemfundo, ezokwelapha, kanye nezokusebenza. Lokhu kuhlela kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha nezinhlelo ezintsha ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngamafuphi, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izidingo zabantu zikhuluma ngombono obumbene, okubhekisisa kakhulu ukuze kuphumelele ukusizakala okuhle kwezempilo. Izifundo ezifanele, ikakhulukazi kumphakathi, zisho ukuthi ukuhlakanipha kokuhlela udaba lwezempilo kudlula ukukhethelwa kwabantu kwezinhlaka, kuhlanganisa ukungenelela kwezobunhloli, ukufunda kanye nekhwalithi yokunakekelwa. I-GEMS iyinsika esemqoka futhi ibalulekile emphakathini, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahluphekayo, ukuze bonke bathole ithuba elilinganayo lokuthola izinsiza ezifanele. Lokhu kuhloswe ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngaphandle kokubandlulula nokusebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile ye-corporate governance. Ngaphezu kokuhlela nokuhlukanisa, kubalulekile ukuxhumana nomphakathi obhekelele ukwakhiwa kwelobugebengu benhlalo. Lokhu kudinga ukwenziwa ngesizotha, okukhuthaza ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baye bayangena ezinhlelweni ezikhona. Kungaba yinjengoba umphakathi uvulelekile, udinga ukwazi nokuzwa izidingo zabantu abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngempela, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu akukhuseli kuphela ukuhlela, kodwa kwenza nokuqonda okwengeziwe kwezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zikalwezera zikhona, kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kanye nomphakathi. I-GEMS izakhamuzi zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuthi uthole ukuholela okuhle nokuqonda, ukuze kube nokuhlonipha nomqondo ohloniphekayo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu kwesikhumbuzo kokuhlupheka kwabantu abaphila nezimo eziyinqaba. Umsebenzi wethu wokuqala, ukuze tipholise izidingo zabo, njengoba siyichela udinga ukuhleleka nokuhlakanipha. Ngalesi sizathu, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinhlaka ezinamandla ezihlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, ukuze sikwazi ukuhola uhlelo olukhulu futhi oluqhubekayo. Ngakho-ke, izinyathelo esizithathayo zibhekelela ukwakhiwa komphakathi ohloniphekayo, onokuphila okuphephile ngokuphumelelayo nezidingo zabantu ezihambisana nezinhlelo ezithuthelelayo. Kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu kuyiqedisayo emzamweni wethu wokwakha impilo ezinzile kubantu bonke. Uhlanga lweGEMS lungukukhanya kothando, ukuveza isibindi sokukhuluma, kanye nomoya wokuthakulisa - konke kuhambisana ukukhiqiza imiphumela emihle ezimpilweni zethu.
Inhlangano yethu ifuna ukuthi ulandele indlela efanele yokuziphatha endaweni yokusebenza! Ngokwenqaba ukukopela, ukweba, ukukhalipha noma ukuveza amaqiniso ngendlela engafanele. Ngokwenza uqiniseke ukuthi ungumuntu onemigomo eqinile yokuziphatha enezinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka nokuthembeka. Ngokukuqonda ukuthi unomthwalo wemfanelo wezinqumo zakho zonke nezenzo zakho futhi uzobe ulindelwe ukuthi uchaze izenzo zakho uma ucelwa. Ngokwenza uqiniseke ukuthi izinqumo ezenziwayo zicacile futhi zivulekile. I-Tip-offs Anonymous iyinsizakalo ye-hotline ezimele evumela ukuthi ubike noma yiziphi izenzakalo zokungalungile endaweni yokusebenza ngendlela engaziwa. Akekho ozokwazi ubunikazi bakho uma kwenzeka uphakamisa isixwayiso, uhlala ungaziwa. Awuzukubhekana nanoma iyiphi ingozi emsebenzini ngenxa yokwenza into efanele ngokubika ukuziphatha okungafanele. Ilanga lethu. INingizimu Afrika yethu. Masizame sonke ukufuna ikusasa elikhanyayo ngokuba nomthwalo wemfanelo nokuthatha umthwalo wezinto esizenzayo. Yenza into efanele! Bheka wena emkhatsini futhi uzizwe ujabule ngawe nangeminyango yakho. Uma ungabaza ukuziphatha okungafanele, bika!
uCyril Ramaphosa Umbuzo 1: Ubani uCyril Ramaphosa? UCyril Ramaphosa ungumholi wezwe laseNingizimu Afrika, owaziwa kakhulu njengomongameli wezwe. Wazalelwa eSoweto, eGoli, ngomhla ka-17 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1952. Ngaphambi kokuba abe ngumongameli, uRamaphosa wayengumsebenzi wezomnotho, umphakathi, kanye nomholi wezombusazwe. Ubuye abe neqhaza elikhulu ekulweni nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abamnyama ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyamkhombisa njengomholi? URamaphosa wathola ukuqashelwa kakhulu ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Ube ngumholi weSACP (iSouth African Communist Party) kanye neCosatu (iCongress of South African Trade Unions). Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni iANC (iAfrican National Congress) eyaqhubeka nokulwa nezenzo zokuqalwa kokubandlululwa. Lokhu kwenze waba yisithonjana sokulwela amalungelo abantu, futhi waba neqhaza elibalulekile ekwakheni umthetho ohlonipha amalungelo abantu. Umbuzo 3: URamaphosa wathola kanjani isikhundla somongameli? Ngemva kokuphumelela kweziqu zeqembu le-ANC, uRamaphosa waba ngumongameli wezwe ngonyaka ka-2018, kulandela ukuhamba kukaJacob Zuma. Uthole ukwesekwa okukhulu emiphakathini ehlukene, njengoba abantu bebefuna ushintsho emkhakheni wezomnotho, ezokuphepha, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo uRamaphosa abhekene nazo? Njengomongameli, uRamaphosa ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhula komnotho, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha zikhona ezweni. Ubuye abhekane nezinkinga zokuphatha kahle izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nezinkinga ezibangelwa yizigameko zokukhwabanisa. URamaphosa udinga ukujola phakathi kwezidingo zabantu kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Umbuzo 5: URamaphosa ubheka kanjani ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika? URamaphosa ubona ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika njengelihle, uma abantu behlanganyela ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uthembisa ukulwela ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ubuye ugqugquzele ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe, ukuze abantu baziqhenye ngezwe labo. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyakhayo uRamaphosa emkhakheni wezempilo? Ngaphansi kokuhola kukaRamaphosa, izinhlelo zempilo zathuthukiswa, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seCovid-19. Ubuye wabeka phambili izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu banokufinyelela kwezempilo. URamaphosa uqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zikhona, futhi zisebenza kahle. Umbuzo 7: URamaphosa ubamba kanjani izinkulumo zomhlaba? URamaphosa ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ezinkulumweni zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ezomnotho, kanye nezokuhlalisana. Uhlanganyela nezinye izizwe emihlanganweni emikhulu, lapho abamba khona izinkulumo ezibalulekile zokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika namanye amazwe. Ubuye ugqugquzele izinhlelo zokubambisana kwezomnotho phakathi kwamazwe. Umbuzo 8: URamaphosa ubona kanjani indima yabesifazane? URamaphosa ubona indima yabesifazane njengengxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthuthukisa izinhlelo zokweseka abesifazane emikhakheni ehlukene, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuphepha. Ubuye ugqugquzele ukulingana phakathi kwabantu, ukuze abesifazane bakwazi ukuthola amathuba alinganayo. Umbuzo 9: Yini uRamaphosa ayikhuthaza emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa? URamaphosa ukholelwa ekutheni ukuthuthukiswa kwezwe kudinga izinhlelo ezihlangene. Uthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhweba, ukwakha izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ubuye uqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zifinyelela kubantu bonke, hhayi kuphela ezindaweni ezithile. Umbuzo 10: Yini abantu abangayilindela kuRamaphosa esikhathini esizayo? Abantu balindele ukuthi uRamaphosa aqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima ekubhekaneni nezinselelo ezikhona. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuthuthukisa umnotho, ukunciphisa ububha, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu baphinde balindele ukuthi uRamaphosa aqhubeke nokukhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe, ukuze kube neNingizimu Afrika engcono. Isiphetho: UCyril Ramaphosa ungumholi onemibono ecacile, othembisa ukwakha ikusasa elihle leNingizimu Afrika. Noma ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ubona ithuba lokuthuthukisa izwe, futhi abantu baphinde baneliseke ngalesi sikhathi sokuhola. Ukubambisana kwabantu, izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, kanye nokuzinikela kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
iPitoli: Isixazululo Sokwakha Ikusasa Elingcono I-Pitoli, inhlokodolobha yeNingizimu Afrika, iyindawo enothile ngamasiko, izinkolelo, nezimo zokuphila. Njengoba sihamba phambili emhlabeni obushelelezi, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sizibuze ukuthi iPitoli iyini empeleni kithi, futhi ibaluleke kanjani ekwakheni ikusasa lethu. Le ndaba ingeyokubona kwami, futhi ngifuna ukwabelana ngemicabango yami ngalolu daba. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iPitoli ayiyona nje inhlokodolobha yeNingizimu Afrika, kodwa iyisithombe esikhulu sokuhlangana kwamasiko ahlukene. Uhlanga lwethu lwenziwa ngezinkanyezi eziningi, futhi lokho kwenza iPitoli ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuhlala. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinkanyezi zidinga ukuhamba phambili, ukuze ziqhubeke nokukhanya. Kumele sikhuthaze ubumbano phakathi kwethu, ukuze sibe namandla okuvuselela leli dolobha. Ngokubuka kwami, iPitoli ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, nezinkinga zokuhlala zikhona. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile neziqhubekayo. Kumele sithuthukise imfundo, siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokufunda, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umphakathi onamakhono. Imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa elihle, futhi kufanele kube yinto esiyigxilile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iPitoli idinga ukuvuselelwa kwezinsiza. Izindawo zokuhlala zidinga ukwakhiwa kabusha, izikhungo zomphakathi zidinga ukuthuthukiswa, futhi izinsiza zokuhamba zidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo. I-Pitoli kufanele ibe yindawo ethokozisayo, lapho abantu bejabulayo futhi bephila kahle. Lokhu kuzodinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kukamasipala, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. Ukwengeza, iPitoli inezinsiza eziningi ezikhona, kodwa zidinga ukusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Imithombo yemvelo, njengezihlahla nezindawo eziluhlaza, kufanele zifakwe emaphakathini. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwenza indawo ibe muhle, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Izindawo eziluhlaza zikhuthaza impilo enempilo, futhi zinciphisa ingcindezi yengqondo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, ukuze sikwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo zayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhulume ngamasiko ethu. I-Pitoli iyindawo enothile ngamasiko ahlukahlukene, futhi lokhu kufanele kube yisikhumbuzo sokuhlangana kwethu. Sidinga ukugubha imicimbi yamasiko, sithuthukise ubuciko, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba babonise iziphiwo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa abantu, futhi kuzokwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela. Ngokubuka kwami, iPitoli iyindawo enezinto eziningi ezinhle, kodwa zidinga ukwenziwa kahle. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile, sikhuthaze ubumbano, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. I-Pitoli ingaba yindawo yokukhanya, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, iPitoli iyindawo enenhliziyo, kodwa kumele sibe nomoya wokusebenza ndawonye. Njengabantu basePitoli, kufanele sibe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi sihlanganyele ukuze sakhe ikusasa elingcono. Ngizwakalisa umbono wokuthi uma sithanda iPitoli, sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sithuthukise leli dolobha. Ngakho, ngicela wonke umuntu, akhuthazwe ukuba abe yingxenye yokwakha iPitoli engcono. I-Pitoli iyathanda, futhi kufanele sithande futhi.
Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Ngenkathi sikhuluma ngesimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lesi simo sithinta zonke izici zokuphila kwabantu. Uma uzama ukuhamba phambili ekutheni uqonde kahle le ndaba, qhubeka ufunde ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile nolwandile. Umkhakha Wezomnotho Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole umkhakha wezomnotho. Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika unama-sector amathathu ayinhloko: umhlaba, imboni, kanye nezinsizakalo. Umhlaba ubandakanya ukukhiqiza ukudla nezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Umkhakha wemboni ubhekele ukukhiqizwa kwamathuluzi nezimpahla, kanti umkhakha wezinsizakalo ubandakanya izimakethe ezinjengezempilo, ezemfundo, nezokuthutha. Izinkinga Eziyinselelo Noma kunjalo, isimo somnotho sinobunzima obuningi. Ukungasebenzi kubalulekile, njengoba izinga lokungasebenzi liphakeme, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha amathuba emisebenzi kumele ziqhutshekwe ngokuqinile. Okunye okukhathazayo yizindleko zokuphila ezikhulayo. Izinga lempilo liyanda, kodwa imiholo iyahluleka ukuhamba ngokulinganayo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwesilinganiso sokuphila kwabantu abaningi. Ukukhula Komnotho Naphezu kwezithiyo, kunamathuba amasha okukhula komnotho. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane nezingaphakathi ziyaqhubeka, futhi lokhu kunikeza ithuba lokwakha imisebenzi emisha. Izinhlelo zokuhweba nezikhuthazwayo zikhuthaza abathengisi, ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthazwa umnotho. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Isimo Somnotho Uma sikhuluma ngezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo somnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngama-policies aqinile okuthuthukisa umnotho, okuhlanganisa ukwehlisa izinqubo eziyinkimbinkimbi zokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundiswa kwentsha kubalulekile. Imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha umnotho osebenzayo, ngakho-ke ukukhulisa ukufinyelela kwemfundo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onamakhono. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe nakho kudlala indima enkulu. Ukuze umnotho uqhubeke ukhula, kufanele kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuxhasa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakhiweni kwamathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni ezihlukene, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kwezindawo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezakhamuzi Ezizimele Ukwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi amancane kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Lokhu kucela ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo kuwo wonke amazinga, kuhlanganise nezinsizakalo zokuhweba, izinsiza zezimali, nokufundiswa kwezokuphatha. Ukwakhiwa kwalezi zakhamizi ezizimele kuzokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi futhi kuthuthukise izinga lokuphila. Isiphetho Ekupheleni, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sinesithombe esijulile esidinga ukuhunyushwa ngokucophelela. Ukukhula, izinselelo, kanye namathuba akhona kudinga ukuba siqhubeke sibhekisisa ukuze siphumelele. Ngokuhlanganyela, uhulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nomphakathi bangahamba phambili ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, nolungele wonke umuntu. Umsebenzi wethu uqhubeka, futhi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle uma sithola izixazululo eziphusile nezisebenzayo.
Umgwaqo ohlanganisa indlu onezicabha ezivaliwe ungcono kunodonga oluphakeme ngoba umgwaqo uyabonakala. Uthango lokusika, uthango olunemibambo, amaqanda amancane noma ama-bell angaxhunywa emgwaqweni ukuze akhumbuze ngokushesha uma kukhona umphangi. Khumbula ukuthi izicabha kufanele zihlale zivaliwe. Iziphuzo zokuphepha ezingeni ngalinye kufanele zibe nezivalo eziqinile phambi kwesicabha ngasinye kanye nasezindongeni, nezinsiza zokuvikela ukuhlinzekwa. Iziphuzo zokuphepha kufanele zihlale zivaliwe. Isiphuzo sokuphepha ngaphakathi kwendlu esihlukanisa indawo yokulala nezinye izingxenye zendlu singasiza kakhulu uma kukhona abahlaseli endlini. Kungcono futhi uma indlela yokuxhumana yokuphuthumayo ingafakwa kule ngxenye yendlu. Izikhali kufanele zihlale zifinyeleleka kalula futhi, uma kungenzeka, zigcinwe kumuntu. Qiniseka ukuthi izikhali zihlale zigcinwa kahle futhi ukuthi umuntu ozisebenzisayo uqeqeshiwe. Umsindo wesixwayiso ophakanyiswe phezu kwendlu onendawo lapho ungafakwa khona ngaphakathi kwendlu ungatholakala kude uma ezinye izindlela zokuxhumana zifanele ziphume. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinto zihlale zihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zingatholakala noma ngabe umuntu ukude nendlu. Izinja nezinkunzi ziyasiza kakhulu ekwaziseni uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Lezi zinyoni kufanele zigcinwe eduze kwendlu ukuze izivakashi ezingaziwa zingakwazi ukufinyelela kalula. Abantu abangaziwa endaweni, bephuma nokungena, bangase bangabonakali kulokho abakwenza. Izimoto ezingaziwa ezihamba emgwaqweni wepulazi kwesinye isikhathi zihlala endaweni. Qaphela ngezinyawo ongazazi. Izinguquko endleleni umqashi enza ngayo izinto. Ukuthenga noma ukusebenzisa ukudla ngokweqile ngasohlangothini lwemisebenzi. Izinguquko emikhubeni yabasebenzi abadala ngemva kokuqashwa emsebenzini omusha. Ukufa kwenja yokuvikela ngendlela engacacile. Hlale uqaphele ngezimpawu zabantu abangaziwa entering endaweni, njengezimbiza noma amaqanda amancane, izikhwama zezigareti, amaphepha, izingubo eziphukile, izinyathelo noma izicathulo, indawo esanda kuphazamiseka, izikhwama zokudla, nezinye izinto ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlukunyezwa kokudla, uphethiloli, izinkomo, nezilwane. Abantu abangaziwa befika endaweni yakho bephakamisa izizathu ezizwakalayo kodwa bangase babe nezinhlelo ezimbi. Sebenzisa amalungelo akho njengomnikazi wepulazi. Abantu abangaziwa entering epulazini noma uvakashela abasebenzi kufanele kuqala bathole imvume yakho. Xhumana namaphoyisa endawo ukuze uthole ukuthi yini oyivunyelwe ukwenza ngokomthetho nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani lokho epulazini lakho. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bakho. Gcina amakhophi wezikhwama zabasebenzi bonke. Khuthaza bonke abasebenzi ukuba bahlale beqaphele ngezokuphepha futhi babike noma yisiphi isenzo esingajwayelekile. Khokha abasebenzi bakho ngazo zonke izifiso zabo futhi ubazise. Ungavumeli muntu ukuthi engena emapulazini akho noma epulazini ngaphandle kokubona kahle ukuthi bangobani, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. Zonke amathuluzi angasetshenziswa njengezikhali kufanele zihlale zivaliwe uma engasetshenziswa. Uma uhambe endlini, yenza kube umkhuba ukwazisa umndeni wakho ukuthi uyaphi, indlela ozoyithatha, nokuthi uzobuyela nini. Hlale uhlole njalo ukuthi ifoni yakho iyasebenza. Beka ifoni endaweni elula ukufinyelela kuyo endlini, futhi kude nezindawo ezingabhekwa kalula noma amawindi. Qaphela ngezikhwama ukuze zingasikhiwe. Hlale ugcina umoya eduze futhi uma uyisebenzisa, ungavezi ukuthi uphi noma ukuthi utholakala kuphi. Qaphela ukuthi uphethiloli nezimpahla zingaba yizigebengu. Ungahlali wenza izinto ngendlela efanayo nsuku zonke. Thuthukisa umkhuba wokungaphumuli endaweni ebonakalayo kumuntu ophumayo. Ungavumi ukuhlala eduze kwamawindi uma uvula noma uvala amajazi. Hambisa neja ukuze ungabonakali kalula ngaphandle. Thatha izithombe nezinyathelo zabasebenzi bonke. Noma ungakwazi ukwenza noma yini, kungaba yingozi. Ukujolisa okwenziwayo kwezokuphepha epulazini (endaweni ephephile) futhi kusiza ukuvusa nokuvikela izinsongo ezingase zibe khona. Fundisa izingane zakho indlela efanele yokuphendula uma kudingeka usizo nokugwema ukukhuluma nabantu abangaziwa noma ukuthola izipho kubantu abangaziwa. Cabanga - ungaphuthelwa. Ukungabonakali kahle kuyindlela yakho yokuqala yokuvikela. Bheka isimo - ingabe kukhona umuntu oseduze? Khala kakhulu? Uyalelwa ukuthi ungabhekani nomhlaseli ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi ungaphuma kulolo suku. Uma ubhekana ngaphandle kokucabanga, ungase uboshwe. Phula umhlaseli. Sebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela kuze kube yilapho ungathola usizo noma uphume. Uma ungakwazi ukubhekana, qaphela izimpawu zokukhomba. Qaphela iminyaka yabo, ukuphakama, umbala wezinwele, izibazi, izingubo, ukukhuluma, nezindlela. Zama ukushiya ubufakazi obuningi ngangokunokwenzeka mayelana nendawo okwenzeka kuyo. Izinyathelo, izinyathelo, nezinto ezithile ezingasiza ukukukhomba kamuva. Abantu abahlukunyezwe baphume ngempumelelo ngokuxhumana kahle nabahlaseli babo (ukukhuluma).
uHuawei Umbuzo: Yini uHuawei? Impendulo: UHuawei iyinkampani enkulu yezobuchwepheshe esungulwe ngo-1987 eShenzhen, eChina. Ibandakanya ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhiqiza, nokuhlinzeka ngamalaptop, amaphones, nezixazululo zokuxhumana. UHuawei uyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngempumelelo yawo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa nguHuawei? Impendulo: UHuawei uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezixazululo ze-inthanethi zensiza, imishini yokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza zezifundo, kanye nezixazululo zezemidlalo. Ikakhulukazi, ibhizinisi layo le-ICT (Information and Communications Technology) lihlala libalulekile ekuxhumaneni kwezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo: UHuawei unamaphuzu anjani emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe? Impendulo: UHuawei ungomunye wabaholi emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Iphinde ibe ngumkhiqizi omkhulu wamafoni esikhathini esiningi, ikakhulukazi ama-smartphones, futhi ibambe iqhaza elibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kwe-5G, okuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zedijithali. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo uHuawei abhekene nazo? Impendulo: UHuawei ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokuphikiswa kwezinye izizwe, ikakhulukazi i-United States. Lokhu kube nemiphumela emikhulu emhlabeni wonke, okuhlanganisa nezithiyo ekuthengiseni nasekutholeni izinsiza ezibalulekile. UHuawei uhlose ukuvuselela ubudlelwano bawo ezimakethe ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeka kokukhula. Umbuzo: UHuawei uyasebenzisana kanjani nezinye izinkampani? Impendulo: UHuawei usebenza ngokubambisana nezinye izinkampani ezinkulu emhlabeni, okuhlanganisa izinkampani zokuxhumana, izikhungo zocwaningo, nezikhungo zemfundo. Lezi zixhumanisi zandise amathuba okuthola izixazululo ezintsha nezobuchwepheshe, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemikhiqizo emisha. Umbuzo: UHuawei ungena kanjani ebhizinisini labantu abaningi? Impendulo: UHuawei ungene ebhizinisini labantu abaningi ngokuhlinzeka ngama-smartphones anenani elifanele, izixazululo ze-inthanethi, kanye nemikhiqizo ye-ICT. Uthandwa kakhulu phakathi kwabantu abasha, njengoba unikeza ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ngezindleko ezincane. Umbuzo: UHuawei uyakuthanda kanjani ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe? Impendulo: UHuawei ikhetha ukutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu ocwaningweni nasekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kokwakha imikhiqizo emisha, ibamba izifundo eziningi zokuthuthukisa amakhono abathengi nabasebenzisi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izixazululo zayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Umbuzo: Kungani uHuawei ebhekwa njengomholi wezobuchwepheshe? Impendulo: UHuawei ibhekwa njengomholi wezobuchwepheshe ngenxa yokukhiqiza imikhiqizo ethuthukisiwe, isivinini sokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezixazululo ezihamba phambili ezitholakala emhlabeni. Ukuze iqhubeke nokukhula, uHuawei uziqhenya ngokuqeqesha abasebenzi bayo, ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo, nokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Umbuzo: Yini esinokuyilindela kuHuawei esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Esikhathini esizayo, singenza okulindelekile ukuthi uHuawei uzoqhubeka nokwandisa imakethe yawo, uthuthukise ubuchwepheshe bayo obunobuchwepheshe, futhi uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile namanye amazwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulindeleke ukuthi uHuawei uqhubeke nokuhlola izinketho ezintsha zokusebenza ezizokwandisa imikhiqizo nemakethe. Umbuzo: Ngabe uHuawei unethonya elihle emphakathini? Impendulo: UHuawei ubonakala enethonya elihle emphakathini, njengoba uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezemfundo nasekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuxhumana. Uthanda ukusiza abantu ukuze banikezwe amathuba angcono, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuzibophezela kwawo ekukhuleni komphakathi. Umbuzo: UHuawei ungaba kanjani isibonelo kwabanye? Impendulo: UHuawei ungaba isibonelo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe ngokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukufaka imali ocwaningweni, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabanye. Imigomo yayo yokukhula, ukuhamba phambili, nokuba nomthelela omuhle emphakathini iyafundwa ngabanye abathuthukisi bebhizinisi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uHuawei ubonakala esebenzisa amaqhinga amasha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nemigomo ezokwenza le nkampani iqhubeke nokukhula, iphinde ibe yisibonelo esihle emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe.
Izikole Zikahulumeni Ingxoxo noMnu. Mthembu, Umphakathi Wabazali Uhlanga: Ngiyakwemukela, Mnu. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngendaba ebalulekile — izikole zikahulumeni. Ngabe ungathanda ukusho okuthile ngalesi sihloko? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Izikole zikahulumeni zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, ngoba ziwusizo ekufundiseni izingane zethu. Zihlinzeka ngokuqonda okujwayelekile, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela emfundweni kubantu abaningi. Uhlanga: Ngabe ungachaza ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zisebenza kanjani? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, izikole zikahulumeni zisebenza ngaphansi kukahulumeni, futhi zikhokhelwa nguhulumeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi abakhokhi imali yokufunda, okwenza kube lula kubazali abanemali encane. Izikole zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi zihlala zifuna ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono yokufunda. Uhlanga: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Kodwa-ke, kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nezikole zikahulumeni, akunjalo? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, impela. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yizinsiza. Izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zibhekene nokushoda kwezinsiza ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi okufunda, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kungathinta ikhwalithi yemfundo ethola abafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole ezithile zihlala zikhungathekile ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali yokuphatha. Uhlanga: Ngabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikole zikahulumeni? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, uhulumeni uhamba phambili ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuthuthukisa izikole. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa imali ethunyelwa ezikoleni, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabafundisi, kanye nokwakha izikole ezintsha ezindaweni ezidinga kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezikole, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izifundo. Uhlanga: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyasiza. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zisebenzisana kanjani nomphakathi? Mnu. Mthembu: Izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zisebenzisana nomphakathi ngezindlela eziningi. Abazali bavame ukubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izikole, futhi lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabazali, abafundi, nabafundisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zenza imicimbi yokubandakanya umphakathi, efana nemikhosi yokufunda, ukuze abantu baziqhenye ngempumelelo yezikole zabo. Uhlanga: Lokhu kubalulekile. Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile ezitholakala kubafundi abahamba ezikoleni zikahulumeni? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, izinzuzo ziningi. Abafundi bathola imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu, futhi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Futhi, izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza ukufunda okujabulisayo, okwenza abafundi babe nentshisekelo yokufunda. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlanga: Ngabe ungakukhumbuza ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zifaneleka kanjani kumphakathi? Mnu. Mthembu: Izikole zikahulumeni zifaneleka kakhulu kumphakathi, ngoba zenza kube lula ukufinyelela emfundweni. Zihlinzeka ngempilo engcono yokufunda, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, abazali, nabafundisi. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuhle. Uhlanga: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubazali nabafundi? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi abazali badinga ukuba bahlale bexhumana nezikole, futhi baphathe izikole zabo njengendawo yokukhula. Abafundi kufanele baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bazi ukuthi imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga. Uhlanga: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu. Lokhu kube ingxoxo ewusizo kakhulu. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho. Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukusiza. Isiphetho Izikole zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi zidinga ukwesekwa okuqhubekayo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali, abafundi, nabafundisi busekelwe ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuzinikela komphakathi wonke.
Ibhola lekhanda yikhanda elitholakala kuyo yonke indawo lapho kukhuliswayo ummbila e-Afrika - leli bhola litholakala kuphela e-Afrika kanti ezinye izinhlobo zalo zihlala ezindaweni lapho ummbila ukhula khona. Ngokuvamile, singasho ukuthi leli bhola libangela ingozi efana no-10% wokukhiqizwa kommbila minyaka yonke - kodwa lingalimaza ukukhiqizwa okuphelele. Amagciwane adla ezithelweni, emithini, nasezimbali zommbila. Ulwazi mayelana ne-biological neendlela zokuphila kwalesi sikhala kubalulekile uma sizama ukuqonda indlela yokulawula nokulawula. Amagciwane agcwele aphila ezithelweni zommbila ezihlala ezindaweni ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngemuva kwalokhu, isizukulwane sokuqala sezinambuzane sikhuphuka ukuze sibe neziqhamo emva kwezinsuku eziyi-7 kuya kweziyi-10. Amagciwane akhuphukayo azodla amasonto ayisithupha ngaphambi kokuba aguquke abe yizigaxa ngaphakathi kwemithini yommbila. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu, ezinye izinambuzane zikhuphuka futhi zingasabalalisa leli bhola kuyo yonke indawo lapho zihlala khona. Ekuhlaleni, kunezindlela eziningi zokuphatha leli bhola. Lokhu kungafaka ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali, izinhlobo zezitshalo, izindlela zemvelo, kanye nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izikhala. Lokhu ngeke kuqinisekise ukusulwa ngokuphelele kodwa kuzosisiza ukuphatha lesi sifo ngaphandle kokusabalala futhi sithole ukukhiqizwa okuhle. Amakhemikhali okuphatha ibhola lekhanda abhaliswe njengezibulala-zinambuzane zokuxhumana noma izibulala-zinambuzane ezidliwayo yileli bhola. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi amakhemikhali abiza kakhulu angcono, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezibiza kancane ezisebenza kahle. Kuthiwa ukuphatha leli bhola ngensipho engabulali phezu kwesikhathi esingama-6 weeks kungaba nezinkinga. Ngenxa kwezindleko zamakhemikhali, abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi basebenzisa ukwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuphalaza amakhemikhali masinyane kuboniswe ukuthi akusebenzi. Ukuphatha leli bhola ngamakhemikhali kufanele kwenzeke kuphela uma kubonakala ukuthi u-10% wezithombo zikhombisa izimpawu zengozi ngoba amagciwane aqala ukudla ezithelweni. Ukuhlola ingozi ye-10% kungaba uphawu lokufaka amakhemikhali ngesikhathi esifanele. Mhlawumbe ukuphalaza kuphela kungase kungabi yanele ngoba leli bhola lingavela futhi. Ngonyaka onjengalo, kungase kudingeke ukuhlola kahle ukuba khona kwamagciwane lapho ummbila uqala ukuvuthwa. Lapho amagciwane amancane engabulawa ngokushesha ngaphambi kokulimaza kakhulu ukuvuthwa kwesivuno. Uhlosile ukubulala lawa magciwane ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuthwa kufike cishe ku-50%. Ukufakwa kwezinhlobo ze-Bt-maize kwehlisile ingozi yokuhlaselwa yizikhala ngoba ngokuvamile azidliwa ibhola lekhanda. Lokhu kwenze amakhemikhali angabi namfuneko kakhulu ngoba kunejini elibulala amagciwane aleli bhola. Nokho, hhayi zonke izinhlobo ze-Bt-maize zisebenza kahle ngokumelene nebhola lekhanda - ngakho abalimi kufanele bakhethe kahle ukuthi yisiphi isivuno okufanele bakhule ngaso ngonyaka ozayo nangemva kwalokho. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) kufanele bazi ukuthi kukhona ezinsukwini eziyi-10 lapho amagciwane angase adle isivuno. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba amakhemikhali axhumana nomswakama okukhona ezithelweni zesivuno, avumela amagciwane ukuba aphile. Ingozi ethintwa yilezi zikhala izovela ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa ngeke ibe yingozi enkulu. Lawa magciwane akhiqiza izinambuzane ezizoya emoyeni ngonyaka omusha. Lapho ukhetha ukufaka amakhemikhali noma uk planting Bt-maize, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi yikuphi okukhetha okunezindleko eziphezulu ngoba i-Bt-maize ibiza kakhulu. Ukukhulisa ebusika kungasiza ngoba izikhala ezihlala ezithelweni zommbila ezisemathafeni zizobulawa futhi azizoveli ngonyaka olandelayo. Futhi, ubusika obubandayo buzobulala ezinye. Lapho ukhulisa ebusika, kungase kube nomthelela wokuthi amagciwane afakwe emhlabathini, futhi izinambuzane azizukwazi ukuphuma nokundiza ngonyaka omusha. Kukhona abanye abahlaseli abavame ukudla amaqanda namagciwane ezikhala, kodwa abanciphisi kakhulu ingozi ethintwa. Abanye abalimi abangakhulisi ezindaweni ezinkulu bangazama uk planting utshani obubizwa ngokuthi i-Napier - izikhala zifaka emathafeni bese zishiya ummbila. Kodwa ngisho nabanye abalimi abakhulu bangazama uk planting lobu busika ngoba buhle ukudla kwezilwane. Izindlela zemvelo nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izikhala azisebenzi kahle - kungcono ukuzama amakhemikhali noma uk planting i-Bt-maize. Bonke abalimi bommbila bayazi ukuthi ibhola lekhanda libangela ingozi enkulu. Kufanele liphathwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele.
Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi Ngokubheka izinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezokwakha, kagesi, kanye nezinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngendaba yokulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi. Le nkinga ibonakala iyinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu behlupheka khona ngenxa yokungabi khona kokukhanya, amandla, nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende akukhona nje ukuxoxa, kodwa kuyithuba lokwakha izixazululo ezinzima ezizokwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu. Ngokweqiniso, izinkinga zagesi zikhula ngokushesha, futhi zidinga ukugxilwa okukhulu. Izinsiza ezikhona zidinga ukuvuselelwa, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza kagesi kufanele zibe sezingeni eliphezulu ukuze zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwePhalamende, abaholi bendawo, kanye nabantu abathintekayo. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokubeka phambili izinkinga ezithinta abantu, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi izwi labantu libe khona. Ngokubona kwami, ukulalelwa kwePhalamende akufanele kube yisikhathi sokukhuluma kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube yisikhathi sokuthola izixazululo. Abaholi bethu kufanele bazi ukuthi abantu badinga izixazululo eziphusile, hhayi izithembiso ezingenamsebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthi izinkinga zagesi zizoxazululwa kanjani, futhi kube nezinsiza ezanele ukuze lokhu kwenziwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zagesi azithinti abantu kuphela, kodwa zinezimpempe ezinkulu emnothweni. Ukungabi khona kokukhanya kagesi kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqiza, okukhathaza abanikazi bamabhizinisi, futhi kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iPhalamende ibheke lezi zinkinga ngokujulile, futhi ibone ukuthi izixazululo zidinga ukwenziwa ngokushesha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zagesi zikhombisa ukuthi kudingeka kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokuphatha izinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokwakha, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokuxhumana nabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi abantu baveze imibono yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zagesi zihlala zikhona, futhi zidinga ukugxilwa okungapheli. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele ibeke izinhlelo eziphusile zokuhlola izinkinga zagesi njalo, futhi ibheke ukuthi izixazululo ezitholakele zisebenza kahle. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokuhlola izindlela zokwenza ngcono izinsiza, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi abantu baveze izinkinga zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zagesi zidinga ukuxhaswa okukhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuxhasa abantu abathintekayo, futhi ibone ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ukuze zixazulule izinkinga. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokuhlola izindlela zokuxhasa abantu, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi abantu baveze izinkinga zabo. Ngokubona kwami, ukulalelwa kwePhalamende ngenkinga kagesi kufanele kube yithuba lokwakha izixazululo eziphusile. Abaholi bethu kufanele bazi ukuthi abantu badinga izixazululo eziphusile, hhayi izithembiso ezingenamsebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthi izinkinga zagesi zizoxazululwa kanjani, futhi kube nezinsiza ezanele ukuze lokhu kwenziwe. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukulalelwa kwePhalamende akukhona nje ukuxoxa, kodwa kuyithuba lokwakha izixazululo ezinzima ezizokwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu. Izinkinga zagesi zidinga ukugxilwa okukhulu, futhi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza ngcono izinsiza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokukhanya okukhanyayo empilweni yabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini yethu. Ukulalelwa kwePhalamende kufanele kube yindawo yokuhlola izindlela zokwenza ngcono izinsiza, futhi kube nethuba lokuthi abantu baveze izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokukhanya okukhanyayo empilweni yabantu, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini yethu.
Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kwezohwebo EThekwini, umuzi ogcwele impilo, ubuhle bemvelo, nezinsiza eziningi, umthelela wokuminyana ungumqondo obalulekile okufanele siwucabangele. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufika kuleli dolobha, umnotho wethu uyakhula, kodwa lokhu kuza nezinkinga ezithile. Ngiyavuma ukuthi umminyano unamathuba amaningi, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nawo. Okokuqala, umminyano ulethela izinkampani ezincane ithuba lokukhula. Njengoba abantu abaningi befika eThekwini, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi, okuholela ekwandeni kokuthengwa kwemikhiqizo. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izitolo ezincane, izindawo zokudlela, nezinsizakalo zempilo ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, zikhulisa umnotho wendawo. Ngakho-ke, umminyano ungumthombo omuhle wokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela zokuhweba. Nokho, umthelela omubi wokuminyana awukwazi ukwenqatshelwa. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufika, izinsiza zomphakathi ziyaqala ukuba nzima. Izikole, izibhedlela, nezindawo zokuhlala ziba nomthwalo omkhulu. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaphakathi nendawo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi umnotho uyakhula, kodwa uma abantu bengakwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, umphakathi ungase ube sengozini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umminyano ungaholela ekwandeni kokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwakha izakhiwo ezintsha, izindawo eziluhlaza ziyaqhubeka nokuncipha. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezindawo zokuphumula, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola indawo yokuphumula. IThekwini, enezindawo eziningi ezinhle, kufanele igcine lezi zindawo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umminyano ungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufika, izinga lobugebengu lingakhula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu bendawo basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila endaweni ephephile. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, ngiyavuma ukuthi umminyano eThekwini unamathuba amaningi, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nawo. Umnotho wethu uyakhula, kodwa kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuphetha, umthelela wokuminyana eThekwini ungumqondo obalulekile okufanele siwucabangele. Njengoba umuzi wethu uqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi wethu ubalulekile. Ukubambisana, ukwakha izinsiza, nokugcina imvelo kuyizinto ezibalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umnotho wethu uyakhula ngaphandle kokulimaza abantu bethu. EThekwini, sinesibopho sokwakha ikusasa elihle, elinempilo, nelinokuthula.
Ukuqinisekisa Izinkokhelo Zempilo Ngolunye usuku oluhle, uMnumzane Mthembu, owayengumfundisi esikoleni samabanga aphansi, wathola incwadi ethokozisayo evela kuGEMS, uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo. Wayefisa ukuziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zakhe zempilo zikhona ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono emndenini wakhe. Ngesikhathi ehlole izincwadi zakhe, uthole le ncwadi ebalulekile. Wawazi ukuthi kufanele athathe izinyathelo ukuze aqinisekise izinkokhelo zakhe, ngoba lokhu kuzomvumela ukuthola ukwelashwa uma kudingeka. Ngemuva kokufunda incwadi, uMnumzane Mthembu wathola ukuthi kufanele aphenye ku-inthanethi. Wavula ikhompyutha yakhe, wahamba kwiwebhusayithi yeGEMS, futhi waqala ukufaka imininingwane yakhe, efaka igama lakhe, inombolo ye-ID, neminye imininingwane edingekayo. Ngemva kokufaka konke, wacindezela inkinobho ethi "Qinisekisa." Ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile, uthola impendulo emnandi—izinkokhelo zakhe zempilo zikhona futhi ziqinisekisiwe. Wazizwa ethokozile, ngoba wayazi ukuthi manje uzokwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula, njengoba wayefuna ukuvikela impilo yakhe nomndeni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuphothula le nqubo, uMnumzane Mthembu waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo akukhona nje ukubaluleka, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphila kahle. Wazi ukuthi uma abantu beqinisekisa izinkokhelo zabo, bazokwazi ukwakha impilo engcono ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ngemuva kokuphothula konke, uMnumzane Mthembu waphuma waya emzini wakhe, lapho abantwana bakhe babedlala. Wawathokozisa, wathi: "Ngithole ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo zethu, okusho ukuthi sizoba nempilo engcono." Abantwana bakhe bamjabulisa, baphendula bethi: "Yay! Baba, sizokwazi ukuya esibhedlela uma kudingeka!" Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula, futhi uMnumzane Mthembu waba nesithakazelo sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuyisinyathelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngesikhathi edlula, uMnumzane Mthembu waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kudinga ukuba kube yinto ejwayelekile. Waqala ukufundisa abafundi bakhe esikoleni ngalolu daba, ukuze nabo baqonde ukubaluleka kokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Wabakhuthaza ukuba baqinisekise izinkokhelo zabo, ukuze bazi ukuthi baphila kahle. Umphakathi waqala ukwakha umqondo omusha, abantu baqala ukuqinisekisa izinkokhelo zabo, okuholele ekuthuthukisweni kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Uhlelo lweGEMS lwaba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kungashintsha impilo yabantu. Ekugcineni, waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Wazi ukuthi uma abantu beqinisekisa izinkokhelo zabo, bazokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi baphile impilo enempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile, futhi uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni.
Osomabhizinisi: Ukuhlola Indima Nobuhlakani Babo Emnothweni Osomabhizinisi, abanjengokwaziwa ngokuthi "entrepreneurs," banendima ebalulekile emnothweni wanamuhla. Lezi zinkanyezi zomnotho zikhula zisuka ezicini eziningi, ziqhuba ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe, futhi zenza izinguquko ezinkulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle indima yabo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nosomabhizinisi, okuhlanganisa izimfanelo zabo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nomthelela abawuwenzayo emiphakathini yabo. Izimfanelo Zosomabhizinisi Osomabhizinisi bahlala bephakeme ngezici ezithile ezibenza bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezohwebo. Ubuhlakani, ukuzimisela, kanye nokubona amathuba lapho abanye bengakuboni, yizici ezibalulekile ezithinta impumelelo yabo. Osomabhizinisi abanothando lokuxazulula izinkinga bahlala bephumelela, njengoba bejolise ekwakheni imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha izinsiza, ukuphatha izingozi, kanye nokwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo, kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwabo. Izinsiza Nezinselelo Naphezu kwezici ezinhle ezihambisana nosomabhizinisi, baphinde babhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethuthukayo, kuyinselelo enkulu. Osomabhizinisi badinga imali, ulwazi, kanye nezinsiza zokusebenza ukuze bakhe amabhizinisi abo. Ukuze baphumelele, kudingeka bahlale bephokophele ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo, njengokuxhaswa ngemali, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza zokuhweba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko ezisheshayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe zenza kube nzima kubanye osomabhizinisi ukuhlala bephambili. Ukuze bahlale bephumelela, kudingeka bahlale befundisa futhi beqonda izitayela ezintsha, izidingo zabathengi, kanye nezinguquko emthethweni. Lokhu kudinga ukuzimisela okukhulu, njengoba osomabhizinisi kufanele bahlale bephokophele ukufunda nokukhula. Umthelela Osomabhizinisi Emiphakathini Umthelela osomabhizinisi emiphakathini yabo ungaphezu kokwakha imisebenzi. Osomabhizinisi baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuthazeni umnotho wendawo. Ngokwakha amabhizinisi, bahlomula umphakathi ngokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, okwandisa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, osomabhizinisi bahlala bephakamisa umoya wokuzimela, okukhuthaza abanye ukuba bazame ukufinyelela amaphupho abo. Osomabhizinisi baphinde babe nomthelela omuhle ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ngokuxhasa imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi yabo iyakhula. Lokhu kungaba ngokuxhasa izinhlelo zemfundo, imikhankaso yokunakekela impilo, noma izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imvelo. Umthelela wabo ungafinyelela ezingeni elikhulu, uqhamuka ezinhlelweni ezincane ezithinta izimpilo zabantu. Isiphetho Osomabhizinisi bahlala bephakathi kokwakhiwa komnotho wanamuhla, behlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhula kanye nokuqhubeka. Noma baphinde babhekane nezinselelo eziningi, izimfanelo zabo ezikhethekile nezindlela zokusebenza zenza kube lula kubo ukufinyelela impumelelo. Umthelela wabo emiphakathini ungaphezu kokwakha imisebenzi; bahlala bephakamisa umoya wokwakha, beqhakambisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi beqinisekisa ukuthi umnotho wendawo uyakhula. Ukukhuthazwa kwabo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomdlandla wokwenza umehluko, kudinga ukuhlonishwa nokuxhaswa, ukuze kuqhubeke ukuthuthukiswa komnotho. Osomabhizinisi bangaba izikhumbuzo ezinhle zokuthi, uma abantu bephokophele ukufinyelela amaphupho abo, bangakha umhlaba ongcono kubo bonke.
Izincwadi Zabasebenzi Abasha: Ukubaluleka Kwezincwadi Zokuqala Zabasebenzi eGEMS Uma sihlangabezana nezinguquko eziningi emsebenzini, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi ezikhiqizwa yinkampani njengeGEMS, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lezi zincwadi azikhiphi nje kuphela izincazelo zezinqubomgomo zenkampani, kodwa futhi zikhombisa umoya wokwamukela, oxhumene nemigomo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezakhamuzi zomsebenzi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi incwadi yokuqala yabasebenzi ibaluleke kanjani ekwakheni umuzwa wokwamukelwa. Lapho umnewa eqala emsebenzini, incwadi ethile iyasebenza njengophawu lokuqala lokuxhumana phakathi kwakhe nemisebenzi yenkampani. Iqukethe iziyalezo ezibalulekile ezihlobene nezibopho, amalungelo, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi inkampani ikholelwa ekubeni yindawo enobungane, lapho abasha bezothola ukwesekwa neziqondiso ezidingekayo ukuze baqale kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezici ezithuthukisiwe, okuhlanganisa ukufaka izithombe, izithombe zenkampani, nemininingwane ethokozisayo ngaGEMS. Lokhu akukhulisi nje kuphela umoya wokubambisana, kodwa futhi kudala umbono omuhle ngesiko lenkampani. Ukubona izithombe zabasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zenkampani kuxhumanisa umnewa nomphakathi wendawo, kube sengathi uyangena emhlabeni omusha, ogcwele amathuba nokuphumelela. Ezinye izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha ziqinisekisa ukuthi umnewa unolwazi olunembile nolwakha isithombe esihle ngenhloso, izinqubomgomo zomsebenzi, nezimiso zokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuhlinzeka abasha ngokuqonda okujulile ngesimo sokusebenza, okubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba kahle emisebenzini yabo. Ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezilula nezicacile kulezi zincwadi kuhloswe ukusiza wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani owenza isiqalo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zidinga ukuba zibe nezici ezithuthukisayo, njengezikhumbuzo ezibhalwe phansi nezincwadi zokuqonda ezitholakala ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kuzosiza umnewa ukuba akwazi ukubuyekeza imininingwane uma edinga. Ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakusebenza kuhlonipha isikhathi somsebenzi, futhi kubonisa ukuthi inkampani ibheka phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Noma kunjalo, akukhona kuphela ukujwayela izinqubomgomo nezinhlinzeko. Izincwadi zabasebenzi zidinga ukufaka umoya wokukhuthaza. Ukufaka izigaba ezikhethekile ezikhuthaza umnewa ukuba aziveze, ahlanganyele, futhi adlale indima ebalulekile emsebenzini kungenza umehluko omkhulu. Umsebenzi uwukwakha umphakathi, futhi lokho kudinga abantu abawaziyo ukudlala izindima zabo ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zingase zibe nezixhumanisi ezihlobene nezinqubo eziningi zomsebenzi, njengezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinhlelo zokubuyiselwa komsebenzi. Lokhu kuhlelwe kahle kuzokwenza kube lula kumnewa ukufinyelela kulawa maphrojekthi, kuveza ukuthi inkampani ikhulisa ubuchwepheshe bayo ekuvuseleleni amandla abasebenzi bayo. Ngokuphetha, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha eGEMS zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Zihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, izinsiza, kanye nomoya wokwamukela, okuholela ekwakheni isiko elihle. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zincwadi ziqhubeke zithuthukiswa, zikhombise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi zihambisane nezidingo zabasebenzi abasha. Njengoba uhamba phambili emsebenzini, lezi zincwadi zingaba yinsika yokuxhasa, zikhuthaze, futhi zigqugquzele, ukuze umnewa akwazi ukuthola impumelelo. Isikhathi sokwaziswa, ukwamukelwa, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle kuqala ngezincwadi ezilungile. Lezi zincwadi zifaneleke kakhulu, futhi kufanele zihlale ziqhubeka zithuthukiswa ukuze zibe yinsika eqinile yokukhula kwabantu nabantu.
Ithelevishini Ngaphakathi kwendawo ethokomele, uMnumzane Mthembu wayehlezi phansi, ebuka ithelevishini yakhe entsha. Uthanda kakhulu ukubukela izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, kodwa okwakumjabulisa kakhulu yizinhlelo zomculo. Ngenkathi ebuka, izigigaba zempilo zazingena emhlabeni wakhe, zimenza azizwe engakude nezinye izindawo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinhlelo lwaluhambisana nokuhlaziya izimo zempilo zabantu abahlukene. Ngelinye ilanga, uMthembu wabona isikhangiso sehlelo olusha olwakhiwe ngamahlaya. Wayezwa abantu besho ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa impilo yansuku zonke, zibhakabhaka phakathi kwezinkinga ezijwayelekile, kodwa zikhombisa futhi indlela yokuhlekisa ngazo. Waqala ukubuka, futhi wathola ukuthi uhlelo lwaluhlukile. Abalingisi babebonisa izimo ezijabulisayo, futhi uMthembu wathola ukuthi uhleka kakhulu, okwenza abe nesikhathi esihle. Ngemva kokubuka lezi zinhlelo, uMthembu waphupha ngokwakha uhlelo lwakhe. Wayefisa ukwabelana ngempilo yakhe nabanye, nokuthi abanye bakwazi ukujabulisa abantu ngendlela efanayo. Waqala ukuthola izindlela zokwakha uhlelo olwakhe. Wafuna abalingisi abavela emiphakathini ehlukene, ababe nemicabango ehlukene, ukuze baveze izimo ezihlukile zempilo. Ngesikhathi esebenza ngalesi sikhathi, uMthembu waqala ukucabangela ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yinsiza enkulu yokuxhumana. Wayefisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lungasiza abantu baziqonde kangcono izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Wayefisa ukuthi abantu babone ukuthi noma ngabe izimo zempilo zingaba nzima, ukuxhumana, ukuhlekisa, nokwabelana ngezindaba kungasiza. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaqala ukuvela, futhi uMthembu wathola ukuthi abantu baphokophele ukufaka izimvo zabo. Kwakukhona abalingisi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, ababe nezinganekwane ezihlukene ezazihambisana nezimo ezijwayelekile. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi abantu baqala ukuza phambili ukuze babuke. Uthando lwakhe lokuxhumana nabantu lwakha umphakathi omuhle, futhi abantu baqala ukwabelana ngezindaba zabo. Ngenxa yokuphumelela kwalolu hlelo, uMthembu wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abaculi nabadidiyeli. Uthole ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yinsiza yokwakha imiphakathi, yokuhlanganyela izinkumbulo, nokuhlonipha izinkolelo zempilo. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezazivela emhlabeni, zikhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lwaluhamba phambili, futhi uMthembu waphokophela ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi ezizokwenza abantu bajabule. Noma kunjalo, uMthembu wazi ukuthi ithelevishini nayo inezinkinga zayo. Wabona ukuthi abanye abantu bangenza izinto ezingalungile, bebhala izindaba ezimbi noma bephula imithetho. Waqonda ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ithelevishini isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwamenza wacabanga ngokwakha uhlelo lokuphakamisa izimiso zokuziphatha, ukuze abanye bazi ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yinsiza, kodwa futhi ingaba yingozi uma ingasetshenziswa kahle. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uMthembu wathola ukuthi ithelevishini iyinsiza enkulu yokuxhumana, kodwa kufanele kube nokuhlakanipha ekuyisebenziseni. Waqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo ezihlekisayo, ezithokozisayo, nezifundisayo. Uthando lwakhe lwezinhlelo lwakhula, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu angashintsha impilo yakhe nabanye ngempela. Ekugcineni, uMthembu waphumelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, nolwazi. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yinsiza yokuhlanganisa abantu, futhi ithelevishini yaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngempilo, nokuhlekisa. Uthando lwakhe lwezinhlelo lwaba yimpumelelo, futhi wathola ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yindlela yokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, uma kuphela abantu bephila ngokuhlonipha, ngokubambisana, nangokwakha izixazululo ezilungile. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMthembu waqonda ukuthi ithelevishini, nakuba ingaba yinsiza enkulu, idinga abantu abaqondayo, abahamba phambili, nabafuna ukwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Wafisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe luhlale lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi impilo iyinhle, futhi izinkinga zingaxazululwa uma abantu bebonisana, behlekisa, futhi bexhumana. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile empilweni kaMnumzane Mthembu, futhi ithelevishini yaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, nolwazi.
Noma ngabe umphakathi uyabandakanyeka emcimbini ophathelene nomsebenzi wabo ongenakuhlonishwa, lowo mcimbi ungaholela ekulimazweni noma ekufeni. Noma ngabe umphakathi ubika ukulimala kwabo kumqashi wabo, uma ngesikhathi sokubika bephawula ukuthi umcimbi ubangelwe umsebenzi ongenakuhlonishwa. Uma umcimbi uholela ekufeni, ekulahlekelweni kokwazi, noma ekusikeni ingxenye ethile yomzimba futhi lapho umuntu okhuniwe ethathwa njengokungakwazi ukusebenza okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14, umphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza kufanele futhi aziswe ngokuphuthumayo ngefeksi noma ngefoni. Qedela "Ingxenye A" yekhasi lokuqala lefomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele, udayise, futhi ufake usuku lapho kuboniswe khona. Susa "Ingxenye B" efana kakhulu ne "Ingxenye A" ekhasini 1 ngokuyikhipha lapho inebhokisi, nikeza umphakathi "Ingxenye B" bese ubacela ukuthi bayinikeze kudokotela noma esibhedlela lapho belashwa khona. Ezimeni ezinzima, "Ingxenye B" kufanele ithunyelwe kudokotela noma esibhedlela ngokushesha. Qedela "Ingxenye A" ekhasini lesibili lefomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele lapho. Thumela umbiko ophelele wemcimbi kanye neMbiko Yezokwelapha Yokuqala W.CI. Qedela ifomu elisha mayelana nomphakathi okhuniwe. Le fomu akufanele ibambezeleke ngoba kulindeleke ukuthi umphakathi uqale ukusebenza noma imibiko evela kudokotela ilindelwe. Umqashi ongeke abike umcimbi kwiKomidi Lokukhokha usebenzisa le fomu phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 uzoba nesibopho ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokukhokha Izingozi Zomsebenzi Nezifo zika-1933, futhi angase abhekane nezindleko eziphelele zokukhokha ezihlobene nalowo mcimbi. Umqashi ongeke abike kumphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza ngefoni noma ngefeksi umcimbi obangele ukufa, ukulahlekelwa kokwazi, noma ukusika ingxenye ethile yomzimba noma isimo lapho umphakathi engakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo ezinsukwini eziyi-14 uzotholwa enesibopho ngaphansi kweMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha ka-1993. Kufanele usebenzise ifomu efanele ukubika izifo ezitholakele ngenxa yomsebenzi owenziwayo W.CL.1. Uma umphakathi okhuniwe eba nezehlakalo zokungasebenzi, gcina irekhodi le-adresi lapho bengatholakala khona ukuze kusizwe ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izimali ezivela kwiFundi Lokukhokha okufanele zikhokhelwe ziya kubo. Qedela ifomu elibhalwe ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu bese uphakamisa (X) ezindaweni ezifanele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lo mbiko wokulimala okukhuluma ngawo ukuthi kwenzeka emsebenzini, ngokwazi kwami, uqotho.
