INingizimu Afrika ithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokukhuthaza ukuqwashisa. Nazi izizathu eziyishumi zokuthi MANJE yisikhathi sokuhlolwa... I-HIV iyaphathwa futhi iyagwenywa. Kufanele uthathe isinyathelo esifanele sokuhlolwa kwe-HIV namuhla. Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV nokwelashwa kuyatholakala mahhala KUZOZONKE izikhungo zikamasipala. Uma imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwakho ikhombisa ukuthi ungena, uzokwazi ukuzinakekela kahle ukuze uphile impilo enempilo. Uma imiphumela yokuhlolwa ikhombisa ukuthi ungena, uzokwazi ukuzivikela kahle ukuze ugweme ukuthola lesi sifo. Ungazivikela wena nabanye ekutholeni i-HIV - sebenzisa ama-condom ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi unciphise inani labalingani bezocansi onabo. Ukuhlolwa kwe-virus kanye nomlingani wakho kukhuthaza ukwethenjwa nokuhlonipha. Yiba isibonelo emndenini wakho nakubangani. Hamba uhlolwa namuhla futhi ukhuthaze abanye ukuba bahlolwe. Akekho umntwana okufanele azalwe ne-HIV. Kukhona izinyathelo zokuvikela ezitholakalayo kulokhu, KODWA kufanele wazi isimo sakho se-HIV ngokushesha okukhulu ngemuva kokukhulelwa. Uma unokhubazeka, kungenzeka futhi ukuthi unayo i-HIV. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlolwa nge-HIV. Uma unayo i-HIV, qiniseka ukuthi uhlolwa ngeTuberculosis. INingizimu Afrika ithatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokunakekela impilo yakho. Uzothatha nini isinyathelo esifanele sokuhlolwa? Uma ungena, zivikele futhi uvimbele ukuhanjiswa - futhi ugcine lesi simo.
Ukwehla Kwamandla: I-Load Shedding Nezinkinga Zayo Isingeniso I-load shedding, noma ukwehla kwamandla, isimo esibalulekile esithinta impilo yabantu eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukwehla kokusebenza, izinga lokuphila, kanye nezimpikiswano ezinzima phakathi kukahulumeni nezinkampani zamandla. Abahlali bahlushwa yizinkinga ezivela ngenxa yokungabi namandla okuqhubekayo, okwenza kube nokungabaza nokuqonda okuphansi phakathi kwabantu. Ukuxhumana Kwezimoto Zesikhumba Ngokwezibalo ezitholakala emithonjeni ehlukene, i-Eskom, okuyinkampani eyinhloko yokukhiqiza amandla eNingizimu Afrika, ibonisa ukuthi imithombo yamandla iyancipha. Lokhu kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, njengezinkinga zokusebenza kwemishini, ukuntuleka kokutshalwa kwezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ezingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuhlukahluka kwamandla, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi aphezulu. Abantu basemakhaya, ikakhulukazi, bahlushwa kakhulu, njengoba ukwehla kwamandla kwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemqoka ezifana namanzi, ukukhanya, nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokungathokozisi emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bejwayela ukuphila ngezinga eliphezulu, bese bekhathazeka ngenxa yokwehla kwamandla. Imiphumela Ebalulekile Imiphumela ye-load shedding ibonakala ezindaweni eziningi zomphakathi. Ukwehla kwamandla kuholela ekuphazamisekeni emisebenzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi izinkampani ziqhube kahle. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo, okuphazamisa umnotho. Abantu bahlushwa kakhulu ngezindleko eziphakeme njengoba izinkampani zikhathazekile zifuna izixazululo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwehla kwamandla kube nomthelela omkhulu kwezemfundo. Izikole zihlala zikhathazekile, futhi izingane zihlushwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwamandla, okuthinta ukufunda kwazo. Izinyathelo Zokuxazulula Izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqedwe le nkinga zifaka phakathi ukutshalwa kwezimali emithonjeni yokukhiqiza amandla. Uhulumeni nezinhlangano ezizimele ziqhuba izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi ezintsha zokukhiqiza amandla, kufaka phakathi amandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa umthombo ongenamkhawulo wokukhiqiza amandla, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngadinga ezahlukene. Uhulumeni uthuthukisa futhi izinhlelo zokugcina amandla, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zidingo. Isiphetho Noma kungekho ukususa okucacile kwezinkinga ezibangelwa i-load shedding, kubalulekile ukuthi abahlali bahlale bephapheme futhi basebenze ndawonye. Ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani zamandla kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe izixazululo ezizinzile. Abasebenzi bamasipala, ohulumeni, kanye nabanye abathintekayo kumele basebenzisane ukuze kuqedwe le nkinga ngokushesha. Ukubambisana kunomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izixazululo ezizinzile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngadinga ezahlukene. Ngakho-ke, abahlali bangathola izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabo, begxila ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo yonke. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu nezinkampani kuyindlela ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa elihle, lapho i-load shedding ingasaveli njengokuphazamiseka okungapheli.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwenkinga Kwake kwaba khona idolobha elincane elaluziwa ngeNyanga. Leli dolobha laligcwele abantu abanothando, imindeni, nezingane ezijabula. Nokho, ngaphakathi kwalezi zinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, kwakukhona inkinga eyayiqhubeka ikhula, eyayithinta impilo yansuku zonke, kodwa abantu babengeyazi kahle. Le nkinga yayihambisana nemfucuza. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, abantu bephila impilo yabo, behlisa izindlu zabo, kodwa imfucuza yayiqhubeka ibhujiswa ezitaladini, emapaki, nasemifuleni. Abantu bebengazi kahle ukuthi kufanele bayenze kanjani le mfucuza, futhi imiphumela yalesi sithiyo ibingakaze ibonwe. INyanga, yayingakaze ibone umoya opholile, njengoba imfucuza yayigcwele emigwaqweni, yenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Isahluko 2: Ukuhlangana Kwabantu Ngelinye ilanga, uMnumzane Ndlovu, umphakathi wendawo, wanquma ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuxoxa. Wabiza umhlangano wezakhamuzi emzini wakhe. Umhlangano wawuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejolise ekutholeni isixazululo. Kukhona uMama Zanele, owayengumama wengane, uBaba Thabo, owayengumlimi, kanye noSibongile, owayengumfundi ophokophelelayo. Bonke babekhathazekile ngalesi simo. UMnumzane Ndlovu wavula umhlangano ngokuthi, "Siyabona ukuthi imfucuza yethu isiyinkinga enkulu. Akukhona okukhuluma kahle ngalesi simo, kodwa kufanele sithathe isinyathelo." Abantu bavuma, futhi umoya wabo wawugcwele umoya wokubambisana. UMama Zanele waphakamisa ukuthi kufanele kube nemikhankaso yokufundisa abantu, ukuze baqonde ukuthi imfucuza kufanele ilahlwe kanjani. Isahluko 3: Imikhankaso Yokufundisa Ngemva komhlangano, uNdlovu noZanele baqala umkhankaso wokufundisa. Bahlela izifundo ezincane ezindaweni ezahlukene zedolobha, befundisa abantu ngendlela yokuhlukanisa imfucuza. Basungula izikhangiso ezikhanyayo, bahlola izindawo ezimnyama, behlola ukuthi imfucuza ingalahlwa kanjani ngendlela efanele. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSibongile, owayengumfundi ophokophelelayo, wanikeza umqondo omuhle. "Kungani singakhe izikhungo zokulahlwa kwemfucuza?" wabuza. Lokhu kwavusa umqondo omusha kubo bonke. UZanele wancoma lo mbono, futhi umphakathi waqala ukwakha izikhungo ezincane ezindaweni ezahlukene, lapho abantu bangalahlwa khona imfucuza yabo. Isahluko 4: Ukubambisana Nabezindaba Njengoba umkhankaso uqhubeka, uNdlovu waphawula ukuthi kufanele baxhumane nabazimele bendawo ukuze bathole usizo. Bahlangana nezinkampani ezithengisa izinto zokwakha, behlola ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza zokwakha lezi zikhungo. Abazimele baphendula ngokubambisana, futhi bahlinzeka ngempahla yokwakha. Ngaleso sikhathi, izindaba zalesi sithombe zafika ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zabhalwa ezincwadini zendawo. Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla kubantu, futhi abanye baphendula ngokuhlanganyela, beqhamuka nezindlela zabo zokuziphatha kahle. UZanele waphinde waphakamisa ukuthi kufanele kube nemikhosi yokuhlanza, ukuze abantu bakhumbule ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. Isahluko 5: Umphumela Wokubambisana Ngemva kwezinyanga eziningana zokusebenza kanzima, iNyanga yaguquka. Izikhungo zokulahlwa kwemfucuza zazikhona, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi imfucuza yabo ibalulekile. Izingane zazijabula, zidlala emapaki ahlanzekile, futhi umoya wawugcwele ukuthokoza. UZanele noNdlovu babebona ukuthi imiphumela yokubambisana ibalulekile. Abantu baqala ukubona imfucuza njengento engafanele ibhujiswe, kodwa njengento engafanele ilahlwe ngendlela engafanele. UMama Zanele waphakamisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokubuyisela imfucuza, ukuze kuncishiswe okungasetshenziswanga. UZanele waphinde wancoma ukuthi bahlale befundisa abasha, ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi imfucuza ibaluleke kangakanani. Isahluko 6: Ukugubha Umphefumulo Wokuhlanzeka Ekugcineni, iNyanga yahlala ibe yindawo ehlanzekile, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi ukuphila kwabo kuncike ekulahlweni kwemfucuza. Umphakathi wawugubha impumelelo yabo, behlanganyela emcimbini wokuhlanza. UZanele noNdlovu babebona ukuthi umoya wokubambisana ubalulekile ekwakheni indawo engcono. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSibongile waphakamisa ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola imiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. Lokhu kwavusa umqondo omusha, futhi abantu baqala ukucabanga ngezindlela zokuphila ezihlanzekile. INyanga yabe seyiba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bebandakanya, bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Isiphetho: Isifundo Esibalulekile Ngaphezu kwakho konke, le ndaba ibonisa ukuthi ukulahlwa kwemfucuza akuyona nje inkinga, kodwa kuyithuba lokubambisana. INyanga yathola ukuthi imfucuza ibalulekile, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi kufanele baphathe kahle imvelo. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawugubha impumelelo, ubonisa ukuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono.
Kuyiqiniso ukusho ukuthi ekuqaleni kwesikhathi lapho umhlaba wokuqala, umhlaba ongavunwa okhona kule planethi unomkhawulo - akukho mhlaba omusha odalwa lapho izitshalo zingakhula khona. Kukhona izindlela zokukhiqiza ukudla ngaphandle kokusebenzisa umhlabathi (ukukhiqizwa kwe-hydroponic) lapho izitshalo zikhula, kodwa ngokuvamile umhlabathi uyasetshenziswa, futhi kumele siqonde ukuthi inani lomhlabathi linomkhawulo; kukhona kuphela inani elithile lomhlabathi, alikhuli. Ngokuvamile, ukuvuna kuhambisana nokukhiqizwa kokudla nokuphila. Indlela yokuvuna endaweni ethile noma ezweni ihlobene nezinto ezifana nesimo sezulu, uhlobo lomhlabathi, nezindlela ezijwayelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwacaca ukuthi amazwe aphumelelayo ezimweni ezinzima yilezo akhiqiza ukudla okwanele. Izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukudla zikwazile ukuvumela amazwe amaningi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuningi kakhulu kunokuthi kudliwe ngabantu balowo mzansi. Amazwe amaningi athuthukile kwezomnotho akhiqiza ukudla okuningi kunokudingeka yizakhamuzi zawo. Lapho sikhuluma ngezimo zomnotho, lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kudlula isidingo. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi intengo yemakethe yalezo zimpahla kufanele yehlise, futhi abalimi abaningi bazokhawulela ukutshala izitshalo ezithile ezingakhiqizi inzuzo. Nokho, ezwenikazi eliningi, abalimi bathola izinxephezelo ukuze baqhubeke nokutshala lezo zitshalo ngoba uhulumeni walowo mzansi ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe labo alidingi ukuncika ekudleni kwezinye izindawo noma kwamanye amazwe. Amazwe akhiqiza ukudla ngaphezu kwezidingo zawo athumela lokhu kudla kwamanye amazwe. Njalo lokhu kudla kuthengiswa ngentengo ephansi kunezindleko zokukhiqizwa kokudla kulowo mzansi. Njengoba sishilo, inani lomhlabathi elitholakalayo lokukhiqiza ukudla linomkhawulo. Ukuze izwe elithile liqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazoba nokudla esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umhlabathi okhona uqhubeke usetshenziswa ukukhiqiza ukudla. Kodwa umhlabathi ungasebenzisa kuphela ukukhiqiza ukudla uma abanemhlaba benza inzuzo. Njengamanje, sikhona ezinkingeni ngoba izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla njenge-maize, amabele, okusanhlamvu, kanye ne-soybeans zikhuphukile kakhulu kangangokuthi akukho inzuzo etholakalayo. Inkinga yosuku olwaziwa nge-Day Zero eKapa ichaziwe Ekhaya elilindelekile, uKapa yidolobha elikhangayo, elinamagquma ahlanzekile nemifula ehlanzekile. Kodwa, eminyakeni edlule, leli dolobha lidlule engozini enkulu yokushoda kwamanzi - ukukhalipha kwe-Day Zero. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho amanzi, abephumelele, efika ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, kwaze kwaba yilapho abaphathi bephuma bathi uma izinga lempilo lingaphansi, kuzofanele umphakathi uthole amanzi kuphela ezindaweni ezithile. UThandi, umama oneminyaka engama-35, wayekade ehlanganyela nemindeni eminingi eyakha izimpilo zabo ezinkulu eKapa. Wayebona izinkanyezi zempilo ezikhanya ezindleleni, kodwa kwavela umoya wobuhlungu. "Ngempela, ngabe sizowela kwazulu, sithole amanzi amancane?" kubuza uThandi, ehlabelelayo ekukhathazekeni. Abantu beqala ukududuzela, bekhuluma ngempilo yabo, izindleko, nemfundo. Kodwa ukuthula akusiyo indlela yokuphila. Njengoba izinsuku zidlula, ubuhlungu buphawula kakhudlwana. Izinsizwa ziphakamisa izinkanyezi, zikhumbula izikhathi lapho bezijabulisa emanzini aluhlaza. "Uthando lwami, akubona abaninimabhuku," kusho uMshengu, umngane kaThandi, "ndiyazi ukuthi sithanda ukuhamba emanzini, kodwa manje amahle ayebonakala engasekho." UThandi wajabula ngokuhlukumezeka, kodwa wayefuna ukuthola indlela yokuphila. Ukuze akhe umndeni wakhe, udinga amanzi. Waqala ukuxhumana nabangane, wabafundisa ngezindlela zokulondoloza amanzi. "Thina, asiwavumele amanzi asiphume," akhaliphe, "singathanda ukuba noguquko. Kukhona amathuba amaningi." Kwathi uma sekuhamba isikhathi, uThandi wathola umphakathi udinga umhlahlandlela. Waqala ukuhlela izifundo ezincane zokulondoloza amanzi. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, abantu baqala ukufika, bezama ukufunda. Bahlangana ngokuhlanganyela, behlanganyela ngemibono, bephakamisa izixazululo. "Asibuyiseni umoya," kusho omunye, "sidinga ukuhlela inhloso ebambene." Izinyanga zedlule, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe uthole impumelelo. Abantu baqala ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi, beqala ukufaka izindlela ezifana nezigubungela umsebenzi wokuhlanzeka, ukugwema ukuchitha amanzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, kwathuthukisa umoya omuhle phakathi kwabantu. "UThandi, ubungaguqula kanjani impilo yethu?" kubuza umama odabukile. "Ngokubambisana, sizokwenziwa," kuphendula. Kodwa izinsuku zashintsha, futhi uDay Zero wawusondela. Abantu baqala ukukhathazeka, bephosa izinsolo ezikhaliphile. UThandi wayesezandleni ezinzima, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kumele aqhubeke. Waqhubeka efundisa, eqinisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. "Thina sonke, sikhona emanzini. Asithini, asihambisani," kusho uMshengu ngesikhathi ebona umoya ophakamayo. Ngempela, uThandi wabona abantu bebandakanya imizamo, bephokophela endaweni ethile. Lokhu kwavumela umphakathi ukuba ube nobumbano, nempilo yahluka. UDay Zero waba yisifundo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba ndawonye, ngisho nasemanzini, uma besebenza ndawonye. Uyazi ukuthi yize izinsuku zihlala zikhona, umoya wokubambisana uzohlala uqhubeka. UThandi, umama onothando, uphumelelisile. Uday Zero wawungaphenduli nje, kodwa waba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi. UThandi wayazi ukuthi ngothando, ukuxhumana, nokuqonda, abantu bangaqhubeka. "Ngiyakhumbula izinkanyezi, kodwa manje sinothando neziqu," kusho uThandi. "Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili." Ngaleso sikhathi, uKapa kwaba yidolobha elikhanye kahle, elithokozisayo, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. UThandi wabona abantu bejabulile, besebenzisa amanzi kakhudlwana, ngoba bazi ukuthi ubudlelwano nabanye bukhulu kunazo zonke. Ngakho, umoya wokubambisana waqhubeka, uKapa waba yinkanyezi enkulu echaza umhlaba. Lena indaba kaThandi, umama onjengempela, ophumelela ekulondolozeni umphakathi, uday Zero waba yisifundo sokuthi izimo ezinzima zingakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. UThandi wathola umoya ophilayo phakathi kwabantu, bejabulile, bezama ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
U-Aunt Jane uthi... Okwamanje, ezindaba (i-TV, iradiyo, kanye nezincwadi) zikhuluma kakhulu ngamacala nobugebengu. Kwenzekani kubantu bethu, umthetho wokukala ukuphila kwethu kanye nomgwaqo ofanele? Mhlawumbe kufanele sikhulume ngomgwaqo ofanele? Emgwaqweni ofanele emsebenzini, kukhona umoya wakho, indlela ophila ngayo, ukuxhumana, nokuhlanganyela - indlela esihlanganyela ngayo nabanye. Umbuzo omkhulu lapho sikhuluma ubandakanya lokho okufanele (ngqo) nokuthi yini efanele, sibuze ukuthi lokho kumelana kanjani nalokho okungalungile nokukhwabanisa. Esikhathini esedlule, kwakukhona izinkampani nabantu abangenamgwaqo omuhle, basebenza emnyama futhi babe nomthelela omubi kwabanye abantu. Labo bantu babengenakukuqonda le nkinga, ngenkathi abanye benza izinto ezinhle. Umgwaqo ofanele emsebenzini, njengokwethembeka, ukusebenza kahle, ukubaluleka komsebenzi wakho, ukwazi ukuthi ubani osebenza naye, konke lokhu kubalulekile. Kufanele sifune ukwenza izinto ezilungile. Imigudu emihle ivela enhliziyweni, ivela ngaphakathi. Ekwenzeni okungalungile, kukhona amathuba amaningi okukhuluma amanga nokwenza izinto ezimbi. Cabanga ngababolekayo imali kodwa bengenayo emuva kokuvuna; abanye batshala, bathengise umkhiqizo bese bephawula ukuthi abatholanga inzuzo; noma labo abathenga imali ukuze batshale inani elithile le-hectares, bese betshala kwezinye i-hectares (besebenzisa ezokuqala ukuhweba ngokuhlanganyela). Abantu abangakhokhi imali ngokuhlanganyela, abakhuluma amanga ngokungasebenzi kanzima, abantu abathengisa izinto ezingabapheki, abantu abathenga izinto ezibi, nokunye. Uma sifuna ukwakha nokukhulisa umkhakha wezolimo ezweni lethu, kufanele sihamba emuva, kufanele samukele futhi sigcine imithetho eqondile, izimo zokusebenza ngokukhuthaza nokuhlonipha. Bonke abantu, kuhlanganise nalabo abasebenza ezikhungweni zikamasipala, kufanele benze umsebenzi ofanele nsuku zonke. Lokhu kuyindlela eyodwa ezosiza siphumelele. Uma ufuna ukushintsha indlela izinto ezenziwa ngayo - kufanele ushintshe wena kuqala. Hambisa phambili, ube nethemba. Masibuyele endaweni lapho sizokwazi khona ukuthi ngokwokuqonda: amazwi ami aqondile, ngikhuluma iqiniso.

Izingxoxo zamaholo Izingxoxo zamaholo ziwumsebenzi obalulekile phakathi kwezisebenzi nabaphathi. Lezi zingxoxo zihlala ziqhutshelwa ngaphambi kokugunyazwa kwamaholo, uma kungena izinguquko emiholweni, noma uma kudingeka ukufaka izici ezintsha. Kubalulekile ukuthi izingxoxo zibe nobulungisa, ziqhutshelwe ngendlela efanele, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokukhuluma. Ubulungiswa ezinkampanini buncike ekwakheni isimo sokuxhumana esivulekile, lapho abasebenzi bezwa khona ukuthi izwi labo libalulekile. Izinkinga ezithinta izingxoxo zamaholo Naphezu kokubaluleka kwezinguquko zamaholo, kunezinkinga eziningi ezithinta lezi zingxoxo. Okokuqala, kunezinto ezithinta izimo zomsebenzi, ezibandakanya ukungaqondi kahle phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi. Lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni nasekugculiseni izidingo zomsebenzi. Okwesibili, izinkampani ezithile zingase zibe nemikhuba yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwabasebenzi, okwenza kube nzima ukuvuma izinguquko zamaholo. Lokhu kubangela ukungazweli phakathi kwabantu, okungaholela ekudlulelweni kuxhumana. Ukubaluleka kohlaka lwezomthetho Uhlaka lwezomthetho lwenza kube lula ukuhlela izingxoxo zamaholo. Imigomo ethile iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi banamalungelo afanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zithobele izinqubo ezimisiwe, kuhlanganiswe nemigomo yokusebenza evumela izisebenzi ukuba zikhulume ngokuqondile uma kukhulunywa ngamaholo. Ukuntuleka kokuthobela imithetho kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, kanti izinkampani ezithobela imithetho ziba nekhono lokuphatha kahle abangasebenzi bazo. Izindlela zokuphucula izingxoxo zamaholo Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izingxoxo zamaholo, izinkampani kufanele zifake izinhlelo eziphusile. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuqeqesha abaphathi ukuze bazi ukuthi bangawuphatha kanjani kahle umqondo wezisebenzi zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zingase zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izingxoxo zenzeka ngendlela efanele, futhi kubhekelelwa zonke izidingo zezimali nezokuxhumana. Imiphumela yesimo sezimali kumaholo Isimo sezimali embonini yezimayini sineqhaza elikhulu kumaholo abasebenzi. Uma imboni ibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, njengokuncipha kwemali engenayo, lokhu kungaholela ekwehliseni amaholo. Lokhu kungaba nemiphumela emibi, okuhloswe ngayo ukubangela ukunganeliseki phakathi kwezisebenzi, okungaholela ekudlulelweni kokusebenza kahle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma imboni ikwazi ukuhamba kahle, lokhu kungaholela ekwenyukeni kwamaholo, okwandisa umoya wokusebenza phakathi kwezisebenzi. Uma ushiyela okhiye bakho bebukeka, qaphela okhiye be-ofisi obagcina endaweni ephephile. Nikeza okhiye kuphela kubantu abavunyelwe futhi uqinisekise ukuthi bayabuyisa. Ingabe ushiyela ibhange lakho noma ipuleti etafuleni? Gcina ibhange lakho noma ipuleti kanye nezinto ezibalulekile nawe ngaso sonke isikhathi noma zivalwe kudrowa noma ikhabhinethi. Ingabe ushiyela ifoni yakho engaphathwa etafuleni? Ingabe ushiyela imali etafuleni noma kudrowa? Ungakaze ushiyele imali noma ushintsho etafuleni noma kudrowa. Kunalokho, faka imali ephepheni bese uyibeka kudrowa evaliwe. Ingabe ushiyela umnyango we-ofisi uvulekile uma uhamba, noma ungowezinsuku ezimbalwa? Ingabe ushiyela ibhande lakho lingaphathwa? Uma ungowokuqala ukufika e-ofisini, hlola izimpawu zokungena. Uma ubona izimpawu zokungena, ungangenisi, shayela amaphoyisa, futhi wazise bonke abasebenzi abafika e-ofisini. Ingabe ubika ezokuphepha uma uqaphela abantu noma izimoto eziphazamisayo—ikakhulukazi ngemuva kwezinsuku zokusebenza—noma uthemba nje ukuthi othile uzokwenza lokhu? Kufanele ube nekhono elikhethekile emahhovisi atholakala ezakhiweni ezinkulu futhi ikakhulukazi uma sekuphelile isikhathi sokusebenza. Ingabe uhlale uqaphele kakhulu ezitebhisini, ezindaweni ezivulekile, noma ezindaweni ezikhanyisiwe kahle? Uma usebenzisa umshini wokuphakamisa, ingabe ume eduze lapho izinkinobho zicindezelwa, ubheke inkinobho yokuphuthumayo, futhi ungene uma kukhona umuntu ophazamisayo? Ingabe ubika kum maintenance yezakhiwo nasezokuphepha uma kukhona ukukhanya okuphukile noma okukhanyayo, iminyango engavuli noma evaliwe kahle, amafasitela aphukile, noma amafoni omphakathi angasebenzi? Uma usebenza e-ofisini noma esitolo ngemuva kwezinsuku zokusebenza, qiniseka ukuthi iminyango yangaphandle nezifundo zivalwe. Uma unohlelo lokwakha, ungawuphuli ukuze uthole ukuphepha okwengeziwe. Uma usebenza ngezikhathi ezingajwayelekile (njengokubizwa noma ukusebenza ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene), hamba nabanye noma cela omunye umsebenzi ukuba akuhambise emotweni yakho. Okhiye bakho bemoto kufanele kube lula ukufinyelela, futhi hlola izihlalo zangemuva kuqala ngaphambi kokungena. Ingabe ushiyela izinto ezibalulekile emotweni yakho uma use-ofisini? Vala izinto ezibalulekile emgqonyeni ngaso sonke isikhathi, noma ingabe ushiyela ekhaya? Hamba njalo uqaphele. Ukutshela othile ocingweni ukuthi umngane uphakathi kokugeza kufana nokutshela umgibeli ukuthi leli yithuba elihle lokungena ezindlini zabo. Zama ukwazisa abashayela ukuthi umuntu abawufuna akatholakali ngaphandle kokukhuluma ngemininingwane eyengeziwe. Qiniseka ukuthi labo abafika emsebenzini e-ofisini yakho noma esakhiweni ukuze balungise okuthile baziveza futhi bahlale beqaphele kakhulu ngobukhona babo ngaleso sikhathi. Izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal Ekhaya, eNingizimu Afrika, KwaZulu-Natal iyindawo enezimanga eziningi, izintaba eziphezulu, nezilwandle ezinhle. Nokho, ngezikhathi ezithile, le ndawo ibhekana nezinkinga ezinzima. Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezikhathi Zamaholide Emzaneni omncane owaziwa nangokuthokozisa abantu ngezikhathi zamaholide, kwathi kwamemeza umoya omusha njengoba kufika isikhathi sokubungaza. Ukukhumbula uSipho, nempilo yokuphuphela abazimele, nakhu kahle kakhulu, khumbula indaba, ngezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezavumbelekayo, ezazizontelela ngokuhlukile ngenxa nezinsuku ezijabulisayo zalewu zinyanga. Labo abaye bahlala phansi, banomoya wokuhlola, umoya wokubonga, bahlala ngaphansi kwempilo, bethokozisa izinsiza. Ubhubesi lwezimo ezinzima nezinselele zihambela phambili, kodwa ezinsukwini ezijabulisayo, umphakathi ubonisa ubudlelwano obusondele, nobubekezelo. Izinsuku zamenywa ngothando, zashintsha, zathi zanezele. Lokhu kusekelwa amandla, kwabe sekukhona emaphandleni ubhayisikili, behamba amamile emiphakathini edale ekhumbula izinsizakalo zempilo, eziphosiwe zapephula, ngenxa yezenzakalo ezinjalo. Umphakathi wawulungiswa, waqondiswa, nasemakhaya, uThandi wagcina ehamba phambili. Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zaba yinto edlula ukujabulisa, zabonakaliswa ngokuthi kunje kube busuku boMkhumbuli. Inhliziyo yothando yahamba phambili, izinsizwa zadala umoya ophumayo wothando. Futhi ngeshwa, lokhu kuphumelela. Ngalesi sikhathi sokugcina, uThandi, noSipho, noMmaMkhize, bahamba phambi kukhomo, bahlala ngokuhlonipha umoya omuhle, bekhumbula izinsizakalo ezithokoza imiphakathi. Njengoba umphakathi uphila, uThandi waqonda kahle ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zingahlala zibalulekile ngezikhathi zamanje, zikhefu othandweni, kodwa zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi akuhlali kuhle phansi, kepha kukhona okukhulu okungaba khona, uma besebenza ndawonye. Kwaqhamuka uMoya omusha, njengoba umphakathi, uma ucele, unamathuba amaningi nelungelo elihle lokuphila. Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zaziyinsika, noma zaziqhubeka ziba eceleni kwendlela, khumbula umkhiqizo walolu hambo lobuqhawe. Futhi yonke imiphakathi yabi phupha, idinga ukusebenza, ukuthuthukiswa kokuhlala phansi, ezindaweni zabo, zothando nasezikhumbuzweni. Nobuhlungu buphume esiphethweni sodwa, lapho umhlaba ungahle, kokubili.
uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 Ngesinye seziqalo ezingaphezu kwamashumi amathathu, umhlaba wawuhamba phambili uzama ukufinyelela impumelelo ethile, kodwa eNingizimu Afrika, inhlangano iphumelele ngokuphelele ekutholeni ubumbano. Lokhu kwenzeka ngaleso sikhathi, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976, lwazala izigameko ezashintsha umfanekiso waleli zwe. Iminyaka eyi-16 encane, abantwana, izinyane ezazikwiSizini, bangena emigwaqweni bebambelela ezithombeni zabantu abakhuluma isiNgisi, benza impi enkulu ngendlela yabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi waseMidi, izindawo eziphakamisayo, zikhonkotha emuva kokuba nezinhlelo zokufunda zalesi sikhathi ezazisekelwe kwiNgxoxo. Kwakukhona ubuqhawe obukhulu phakathi kwezingane, bephakamisa izwi lazo, yimuphi umoya ovusa umqondo wokuphikisana noHulumeni ophusile. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwabuye kwaba nezenzo ezinjengokubhalela izikole eziphakeme, okuyinto eyayibathokozisa kakhulu. NgoMsombuluko, umoya wawuphilile, umhlaba wobukhazikhazi wawusondele, ubhajwa kancane kancane ngabantu abangawazi ukuthi ukuhamba kwabo kuzoshintsha izinto zempilo kakhulu. Izinyanga ezine zizele ubuhlungu bezinhlungu zabantu, kodwa ngokukhumbula, ugqozi lwabasha lwakhuthaza ukufundisa nokwakha ikusasa. Bafuna ukufunda, behlala sidlula ezindlini, ukuze bazokwazi ukulwa, benza umehluko. Kulokhu, uMnyango wezokuFunda, owakhelwe ukusiza izingane, wathola ukuthi abantwana bayalaywa ukuthi bafunde isiNgisi, ngenkathi isiZulu sishiywa engqondweni. Lokhu, kube yiphupho lababi, hayi kokuphucukisa umphakathi, kodwa kuholela ekubhujisweni kobumbano. Akukanye noThando, umntwana ovulekile nomoya onothile, wavuna umphakathi. Wayingeqondi kahle lokho okwakwenziwa ngabo. Kwafika uhlu lwezikole, iNkolobane yeNkosi yamukele imihlangano, bekulokhu kudlalwa izigigaba ezinhle. Ngonyaka ophakathi, abantwana baqonda ukuthi yize bezama ukuhlangabezana nemfundo, imfundo yekhono ayitholakali. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni iSizini yaseMain, indawo eqhamuka kakhulu, ukuze ibhukhasi ibonakale kancane. Izinsuku zaba mduduzi ezishaywa ngaphandle komhlaba, kufanele kube nochwepheshe. Ngaleyondlela, kwaba losuku olwandulelayo, umkhuhlane ungase usuku lwezimo zokubusa. Izenzakalo zikaJuni zikhumbula isiZwe; uThando wabephakamisile umoya, edlalisa abanye ngoba wayenethemba lokungena kulolu suku olukhulu. Wabanye abantwana abamnyama, abathola ithuba lokukhuluma okuhle. Babesaba da! Okwakukhona, bathola izwi lazo. Uhlanga lwezokuphepha lwaqala ukufika, abakwa-Voortrekker bathi: "Hamba, hlala!" Ukudlala kube ukungena emuva kwemisebenzi yokuhamba. UMnyango wezokuNgena uzama ukubamba ekuboshweni kwemizuzu eminingana emalini. UThando, othokozayo, wayehlamukela reqinsela lansuku; "Akukhona ukuhamba, lee siングa, niyazikhumbula izinyane!" Kusobala ukuthi, isimo sishintsha, abantwana bafa. Odumo kwenzeka! Izinyanga zakhe zashintsha kabuhlungu. Ukuthi, uSuku lwaBasha, odinga ukukhunjulwa, abanye benza izimpikiswano. Bakhetha yonke imihlangano, imisenzi yempilo eyayingaqondakali. UThando. UJuni 16, isimo sashintsha ngokushesha. Abantwana bejolisa phambili, behamba lapho bekhanyisile; baphikisa, baphikisa. Njengoba ukungabi xolo kuvumela ukushayisana, izenzakalo zabe zishiwo. Bahlasela uHulumeni. UThando uthola ithuba lokuphakamisa usuku lwabasha luka-1976, imva izwi lakhe liphakamisa phezulu! Kwaba isenzo esixakekile, umoya wenza sonke. Ukushisela izinsalela eziphakeme ezibhalwe ngaphezu kwenkosi. Izigameko zazinyuka, imicabango yezehlakalo, imbono yomphefumulo. Ngaleso sikhathi,iyayike yaze isuka ngeyimpumelelo. Basha, sishayela umoya, imikhumbi yethu, izinyanga eziphakama. UThando, uqhubeke nezinsuku, athintwa ukwazi ngamabhandi, abathola ubufakazi obunengqondo. Ubuqamama, uphakamisa phambili, iqhaza elibhalwe ngaphezulu komhlaba. Lokho kube yinsango yokufunda, ukujabulisa emkhumbini. Ababulali bavuma ukuthi bawa! Imihlangano yokukhuluma yayizishaye njengethuba. UThando, ubufakazi abukhululiwe, uhola abasha! Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSuku lwaBasha lukhipha izinyanga eziningi, izigameko ezimbalwa, sambanga yena uThando. Kuze kube yilapho eyokhukhliswa engadlali kahle, ngenxa yokhala kwazulu, kuza ukuncwasa kwabantu ababili. Iwezwomenqa, ukuhlakanipha, umoya, ukufunda – uSuku lwaBasha lufanekisa ukukhanya, ubunkulunkulu bemithetho yethu. UThando noMnyango bezamantla. UThando uvele endaweni; iphimbo liye lafaka, izinyosi zathi: "Khumbulani UThando, sisize!" Ngemva kokuba uSuku lwaBasha, izinyoni zithungathungela izicathulo, ibolekisa imicabango, amayıqe aphelele. Kuzophenduka, bamba uThando – umuzi ophukhile – umoya wethu; sizokwenza umhlaba udlule ngezinto ezintsha. Baba besho: “UThando uyakha impilo!”. Ngemuva kokudlula kwalesi sikhathi, imfundo yokuqala, umoya, uSuku lwaBasha waba usuku olwalukhumbuleka emhlabeni wonke; izikole zikhanga kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ukuthi abasha benza izinkanyezi. Lolu suku lwazisa abantu, lwaholela ekwandeni kokuzidla impumelelo, kwavula amathuba ezintsha. Uthando lwethu ngeSizini lwakha umhlaba wethu, kwashintsha imiqondo, ubukhazikhazi, ubumbano, ubuhlakani. Lokhu kwaholela kulwazi oluwusizo olwakha ububha nosizi. Kuqhamukile umoya, ngakho uThando ufundisa, uphakamisa izwi futhi uthanda? UThando uqhubeka nempilo, eqhubekela phambili, ezandleni zethu. Ngakho, uSuku lwaBasha luka-1976 lukhumbuleka njengomcimbi obalulekile emlandweni wezwe, uThando ubamba izwi elihle, kodwa emakhaya ethu, sibamba umoya obukhazikhazi, umoya weBasha. Iyanetha ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, imifula yenziwa, yazi umuntu wonke; kwaziswa uThando nosuku lwakhe! Yilokho, umhlaba ufana noThando abasha!
I-Assembly Yezwe inezinhlaka eziningi zangaphakathi ezibhekene nokusebenza kwePhalamende. Izinhlelo ngokuvamile zinezakhamizi ezivele zikhona ePhalamende isikhathi eside. IKomidi Lezibopho kanye nezinhlelo zakhona zixoxa ngezinhlinzeko zokusebenza zeNdlu, isabelomali seNdlu, ukwesekwa kwamalungu, ukuhlela kwangaphakathi, kanye namandla nezivikelo zamalungu. Ezinye izinhlelo zangaphakathi zifaka iKomidi Lokuhlela, elihlela umsebenzi we-Assembly Yezwe, iKomidi Lokubhekelela, kanye neKomidi Lezikhungo. I-National Council of Provinces nayo inezinhlelo zayo zangaphakathi. IKomidi Lezibopho kanye nezinhlelo zakhona zixoxa ngezinhlinzeko zokusebenza ze-NCOP, isabelomali se-NCOP, ukuvikelwa kwamalungu ePhalamende, ukuhlela kwangaphakathi, ezomhlaba jikelele, kanye nemithetho ethunyelwe. IKomidi Lokuhlela lihlela umsebenzi we-NCOP, kanti iKomidi Lezikhungo lenza izincomo mayelana nokusebenza kweZinhlelo kanye nezinye izinkundla ze-NCOP. Uma kukhona umsebenzi ophuthumayo okudingeka wenziwe yiPhalamende noma enye yeNdlu zayo, zingakhetha ikomidi lesikhashana. Izinhlelo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ukuvumelana nasekufakeni umphakathi ezinhlelweni nasezenzweni zePhalamende. I-National Council of Provinces iyaphumelela emsebenzini wayo emihlanganweni ebanjwe yiNdlu kanye neNdlu lapho amalungu eNdlu ehlangana khona ukuze abambe umhlangano owodwa weNdlu, lapho zombili izindlu zePhalamende zihlangana (lapho amalungu ezindlu zombili ehlangana ukuze abambe umhlangano owodwa weNdlu), nasezinhlelweni ezincane ezihlanganisa amalungu. Zihlinzeka ngePhalamende indawo yokuzwa ubufakazi nokuqoqa ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi wekomidi ethile. Ngokuvamile, izinhlelo zakhiwa ngokwezinga lokwakhiwa kwezikhala zamaphathi ePhalamende. Imihlangano yeKomidi ivulelekile emphakathini, kodwa ingavalwa uma kudingeka. Ziqapha futhi zihlola umsebenzi nezabelomali zezikhungo zikamasipala futhi ziphendule kukho konke abakwenza. Zibuyekeza imithetho esheshayo yamalungu azo kanye nemithetho ephakanyisiwe yizifunda neziphakamiso ezikhethekile. Izinhlelo zinegunya lokubiza noma ubani ukuba uvele phambi kwazo, ukuze alethe ubufakazi noma athumele imibhalo. Bangacela umuntu noma isikhungo ukuthi sibikelele kubo. Izinhlelo zingathola uhlu lwezikhalazo, izincazelo zokubhekelela, noma izethulo ezivela emphakathini. Ikomidi ngalinye liholwa nguMongameli. I-Assembly Yezwe (NA) ikhetha ezivela kumalungu ayo izinhlelo ezahlukene ukuze zihlola umsebenzi wezikhungo zikamasipala ezahlukene. Ukuze zihlola umsebenzi wesikhungo esiphakanyisiwe, zibuza imibuzo futhi zenze izincomo mayelana nezindaba ezithile esikhungweni, kuhlanganise nesakhiwo, ukusebenza, kanye nenqubomgomo. Umsebenzi wezinhlelo awupheli kuhulumeni kuphela. Zingahlola noma iyiphi indaba ethinta umphakathi ethinta umgomo wazo. Kukhona iKomidi Lezindlu Zikamasipala kuzo zonke izikhungo zikamasipala kanye nezikhungo zikamasipala ezihlanganyela nazo. I-National Council of Provinces (NCOP) ikhetha izinhlelo ezikhethekile kumalungu ayo ukuze iphelele ukuhlola umsebenzi wezikhungo zikamasipala ezahlukene futhi ixoxe ngeMithetho Ephakanyisiwe. Njengoba amalungu angu-90 e-NCOP enamalungu aphelele angu-45 kuphela uma kuqhathaniswa namalungu angu-400 e-NA, izinhlelo ezikhethekile zihlola umsebenzi wezikhungo zikamasipala eziningi. IKomidi Lokubhekelela Izimali Zomphakathi le-Assembly Yezwe isebenza njengomgibeli wokuthi abaphathiswa basebenzisa kanjani imali yabakhokhi bentela. Ngonyaka, uMphakathi Ohlola Izimali uthumela imibiko ngezimali kanye nokuphathwa kwemali yezikhungo zikamasipala ezahlukene kanye nezikhungo zikamasipala. Abaphathi bezikhungo nezikhungo zikamasipala bavame ukubizwa kuleli komidi ukuze babike futhi bachaze ukuthi imali isetshenziswe kanjani. Ikomidi lingancoma ukuthi i-Assembly Yezwe ithathe isinyathelo uma kudingeka. Imithetho Ephakanyisiwe ibhekwa yikomidi elibhekene neMithetho Ephakanyisiwe yamalungu kanye neziphakamiso ezikhethekile. Uma ikomidi ivuma ngenhloso yeMithetho ephakanyisiwe, imithetho ephakanyisiwe ilungiselelwa ukuba ibhekwane nePhalamende. Iziphakamiso zemithetho zingangeniswa ePhalamende bese zidluliselwa ekomidini elibhekene nalezo zindaba eziphakanyisiwe.
Ukuzalwa kwedemokhrasi engahlukanisi futhi engabandakanyi ubulili eNingizimu Afrika kudinge ukuhlolwa okuphelele kwezimpawu zikazwelonke. Uhlelo lwangaphambili lwaluhlanganisa ukuqashelwa okukodwa nezindondo ezine, ezazimelela isikhathi esedlule. Sifuna ukuphuma esikhathini esedlule; ngoMeyi 1998, iPhalamende elisha leZeluleko leMphakathi mayelana Nezimpawu Zikazwelonke lenziwa ukuba lilawule umsebenzi wokuhlola izimpawu zikazwelonke nezindondo. Njengengxenye yohlelo, uMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe, ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezokuxhumana kanye Nezokuphepha Kolwazi, wenza ucwaningo olunzulu ngezimpawu nokuthi zimelela ini ngenhloso yokuthola ubuhle obusha obubonisa umoya weNingizimu Afrika entsha. Kwacelwa ithimba labafundisi nabachwepheshe abanokwazi okujulile ngezimpawu zomdabu kanye nezincazelo zazo ukuba bacabangele izinto ezimelela ubunye, umlando wonke, kanye nolwazi lwase-Afrika, ngokukhethekile begxile eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela jikelele walolu hlelo waholela ekwakhiweni nasekudizayineni kwezimpawu zikazwelonke ezintsha. INingizimu Afrika iqale uhambo olude lokuzihlukanisa nomlando wokucwasa ngokobulili, umbala, kanye nokukholwa. Izwe lethu liqhubeka kahle endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu kanye nobuqotho bonke abantu. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu bonke abantu, kukhona isiko elisha lamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonipha ubuqotho bomoya womuntu, okuyinto echaza ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Omunye wemizuzu engasoze yalibaleka yokuhlukanisa nesikhathi sethu esedlule kwaba ukuphakanyiswa kwefulegi elisha ngo-1994. Le mizwa yaqina ukuzigqaja kwethu kanye nobuqotho benhlangano ehlabela ubuqotho bonke abantu. Okwesibili kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwezindondo zikazwelonke ezintsha, ezikhumbula umlando wabo bonke abantu benhlangano, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 2000. Ngokwenza kanjalo, lokhu kuveza ubuhle base-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuphinda kuvuswe nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Izindondo zikazwelonke ezintsha ziqinile emoyeni walolo vuselelo lukazwelonke.
Isithombe 1: Izimpawu zezitshalo ezithintekayo zikhombisa ukuhamba kwalesi sifo. Bheka i-sclerotia emnyama kanye ne-mycelium emhlophe. Isitshalo esinempilo singase sibe eceleni. Isithombe 2: I-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ethishelwe esitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 3: I-sclerotia ngaphakathi kwesikhumba sesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 4: Ukuhlakazeka ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Isithombe 5: Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda - lokhu kubonakala ngaphambi kokuthi ikhanda lehlise. Isithombe 6: Ukuhamba kwesifo - ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kanye naphakathi kwesigaba. I-sclerotia ibuyiselwa emhlabathini ngesikhathi sokuvuna nasekulimeni. Kulesi sithombe, sizogxila kakhulu esifweni esibalulekile esithinta i-canola - Izifo ze-Sclerotinia. Kukhona izifo ezintathu, ukuwa (ukuwohloka) okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia, ukuwohloka ngaphakathi kwesigaba, nokuhlakazeka kwekhanda. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kubangelwa i-fungus eqhubeka emhlabathini ebizwa nge-sclerotia, engena ezimpandeni ze-canola. Lokhu kuwa kuhlukile ngoba kuqala ezimpandeni. I-Sclerotinia ewohlokayo ikhanda nesigaba ihamba emoyeni ngezimpande. Lezi zifo zikhombisa ingozi phezulu komhlaba kodwa zonke zifana engozini ezidalayo. Zonke ezintathu zibangelwa yisitho esisodwa esibizwa nge-Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, i-fungus eyingozi kakhulu edume ngokuthi "i-mold emhlophe." Le fungus ifana naleyo edala i-mold emhlophe kuma-soybeans, ama-beans omisiwe, i-canola, nezinye izinhlobo zezithombo ezivame ukuthinteka. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kwenzeka lapho i-canola ifakwe emhlabathini one-Sclerotinia, okuholela engozini enkulu yokulimala. Kungenzeka ukuthi insimu yonke ithinteke yilesi sifo. Ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuhlobene nenani lezitshalo ezithintekayo kanye nesikhathi sokufika kwesifo; uma inani lezitshalo ezithintekayo liphakathi, futhi isifo singena ngokushesha, ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuzokhuphuka. Ngokuvamile, isitshalo esithintekayo sinikeza kuphela u-50% wokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okuqukethwe kwe-oyela kuyancipha uma isitshalo sinesifo. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi ukuvela kwalesi sifo kukhuphula inani le-Sclerotinia emhlabathini. Lokhu kungakwenza kube nzima ukufaka i-canola emasimini analesi sifo iminyaka eminingi. I-Sclerotinia yehlisa ukukhiqiza futhi ingavimbela i-canola ekukhiqizeni esikhathini esizayo, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwezinzuzo okujwayelekile okuhlotshaniswa ne-canola. Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kanye naphakathi kwesigaba akuvamile ukwenzeka; kuvame ukuvela ngemuva kwemvula enkulu. Lezi zifo azivamile ukwenzeka ezikhathini ezomile. Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kwehlisa ukuvuthwa kwezimpande, inani lezimpande, kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-oyela. Uma kune-sclerotia ezimpandeni, kwehla isikhala kanye nemakethe yokukhiqiza. Amakhanda athintekayo avame ukuwa ensimini, futhi izimpande zilahleka emhlabathini. Futhi, uma imishini yokuvuna ithinta ikhanda, izimpande zihlakazeka futhi azingeni emshinini. Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kuyinkinga lapho kukhiqizwa izimpande ezintsha ezizothengwa abalimi ukuze zifakwe ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba azivuthi kahle futhi spread the sclerotia disease, creating new work to clean the seeds before obtaining a certificate stating that the seeds are healthy. Azikho izinto eziyingozi ezikhiqizwa yi-Sclerotinia ezimpandeni ze-canola, kodwa uma kune-sclerotia eziningi, akufanele zisetshenziswe abantu noma izilwane. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi lesi sifo singangena ezimweni eziphilile futhi sidale ingozi esikhathini esizayo. Ngokuvamile, izimpawu ezivela ngokushesha ziyi-wilting kwezithombo, ukuwohloka kwezimpande, kanye nesikhumba sesigaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuwa kwezithombo kuqala kubonakala ezimeni ngaphambi kokuthi izithombo ziqhakaze, kodwa izithombo ezine-sifo zingase zibonakale lapho ziqala ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, isitshalo ngasinye sibonakala ngokwehlukana, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ziyaqhamuka. Lesi sifo sivame ukuvela ezindaweni ezithile zensimu. Ngoba izitshalo zingawa ngokushesha ngemuva kwezinyanga zesifo, izimpawu zingase zibonakale ngokushesha. I-lesion ethwele amanzi ikhula esikhumbeni (ngaphansi) sesitshalo. I-lesion inombala oluhlaza-ompunga bese iba mnyama ifana nesigaba esijikeleza isigaba. Uma ukuwohloka kuqhubeka, isigaba siba mncane futhi singase sibe sengathi sihlakazekile. Ukuwa kungabonakala endaweni ejolile engaphezu kwezandla ezimbili ubude. Kukhona ukuwohloka ngaphansi kwesigaba futhi izakhi eziqinile ezibizwa nge-sclerotia (ezinobukhulu obuphakathi kuka-1/8 kuya ku-1/4 inch) zitholakala. I-sclerotia ikhiqizwa yisitho futhi ibonisa leli sifo. Uma kuneziningi, i-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ikhula esikhumbeni sesigaba, ngakho ibizwa ngokuthi: "i-mold emhlophe." Ukuwohloka kwezimpande kubonakala ngokushesha ngoba imvamisa isitshalo siphuma emhlabathini kalula uma pulled. Isikhumba sezimpande siphuma kalula, sikhombisa i-pith yangaphakathi. Ukuwohloka kuvame ukwenzeka ezigabeni futhi i-sclerotia ibonakala kuzo zonke izimpande. Ekugcineni, isitshalo esithintekayo sifa. Isitshalo singakhiqiza kuphela ukudla, okuhlobene nesikhathi lapho isifo singena esitshalweni. Amakhanda ezitshalo ezithintekayo ancane kunezempilo. Ukuwa kwehlisa inani lezimpande, ikakhulukazi ngoba izimpande zikh light. Izitshalo ezithintekayo ziwela kalula uma kunomoya omkhulu. Lokhu kuvame ukubonakala lapho izimbali ziqhamuka noma ngemuva kwalokho, kubonakala ngaphakathi noma eduze kwesigaba. Kuqala kubonakala njengombala omnyama noma ophuzi obonakalisayo. Bese isigaba sithokozisa ikhanda, izindawo ezithintekayo nazo ziba namanzi futhi ziba buthaka. Isigaba sivame ukuphuka uma kukhona ukuwohloka, futhi konke okuphakeme kwesigaba kufa. Imvamisa i-mycelium emhlophe ne-sclerotia izovela ngaphandle nangaphakathi kwesigaba, ikakhulukazi uma kune mvula. Ekugcineni, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba mhlophe futhi ziqhume. Ukuwohloka kwesigaba kungaqhubeka phansi esikhumbeni noma kungakhuphuka phezulu kwekhanda. Ngezinye izikhathi, leaf ingathola i-Sclerotinia futhi i-fungus izoqhubeka nokungena nokuhlakazeka kwesigaba. Izimpawu zokuqala ezibonakalayo ziyi: i-fungus emhlophe (mycelium) ivela ezithombeni noma izindawo ezithwele amanzi ngaphansi kwekhanda. I-fungus ikhula ngokushesha kulowo mhlaba, ihlukanisa ikhanda bese i-mycelium emhlophe ne-sclerotia eziningi zivele. Ikhanda livame ukuvela mhlophe, libonakala ngokushesha. Ikhanda lonke lingahlakazeka futhi indawo lapho kukhona izimpande iyawa, ishiyela ikhanda elihlala mhlophe eline-scler
Iyini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye neMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? Ubani onesibopho ngezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke? Le mhlahlandlela ihlobene neMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Njengomthetho, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibhalwe ngolimi olusemthethweni olungaqondakali kalula. Le mhlahlandlela ichaza ukuthi umthetho uthi ini nokuthi kusho ukuthini. Isimiso esiyisisekelo seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kwamanzi. Inhloso yale mhlahlandlela ukusiza abasebenzisi bezinsiza zamanzi (izifunda, imifula, amanzi edamu, amanzi aphansi, njll.) baqonde umthetho ukuze bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ngendlela enenzuzo ezinqumweni ezihlobene nezindaba zamanzi ezithinta bona. Ubani okufanele afunde le mhlahlandlela? Noma ubani ofuna ukuba yingxenye yokuphathwa kwamanzi. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunembile ngezihloko ezithile, kufanele uxhumane neHhovisi Lesifunda eliseduzane leMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni. Imininingwane yokuxhumana ibhalwe ekhasini lokugcina. Ikhophi yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ingatholakala ku-inthanethi ku-www.dwaf.gov. Le mhlahlandlela iqukethe ini? Le mhlahlandlela ayifaki lutho ngaphakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Ilinikeza ukubuka okujwayelekile komthetho nokuhlaziya okucacile mayelana nezindawo ezibalulekile zomthetho, eziklanyelwe ukusiza abasebenzisi bamanzi babambe iqhaza ezindabeni zezinsiza zamanzi. Izikhungo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi ziyasungulwa. Kungani iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ubalulekile? I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba ibeka izindaba ezihlobene namanzi emcontext efanele ngaphakathi komthethosisekelo. Amanzi abalulekile empilweni yonke. Ngaphandle kwamanzi, akukho muntu, isilwane, noma into ephilayo engaphila. Ihlwanyela amasimu abelusi, inikeza izinkomo nezindawo zasemakhaya; inikeza ukuhamba, isekela izindawo zokuhlala; isekela amadolobha namadolobhana amakhulu, imayini, imboni, futhi ikhiqiza ugesi. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphuze, bahlabe, bakhe ukudla, bathandaze, futhi baphile. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinomkhuhlane omncane. Iminyakazo eminingi yeziqu zamanzi zethu isetshenziswa kakhulu. Njalo ngosuku, abantu namabhizinisi baphuma kakhulu emifuleni nasezizindeni zethu, emanzini aphansi, nakumazinga amanzi. Izindawo eziningi ezweni zibhekene nokushoda kwamanzi, lapho sidinga khona amanzi amaningi kunalokho esinakho. Kulokhu, izindawo esihlala kuzo zingase zibe ngaphansi kwengcindezi futhi abanye abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile (okuphuza) noma abatholi ingxenye yabo efanele yamanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba inikeza uhlaka lokuvikela izinsiza zamanzi ekusetshenzisweni ngokweqile futhi iqinisekisa amanzi ukuze kuthuthukiswe kwezomnotho nasemiphakathini ezayo. Kubalulekile futhi ngoba uthi amanzi awokubantu bonke ezweni ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke. Yiziphi izinsiza zamanzi? Izinsiza zamanzi ziwumzimba wamanzi njengezifunda, imifula, amanzi, izindawo ezinamahlathi, kanye namanzi aphansi. 'Amanzi aphakeme' abhekisela emanzini aphezulu. 'Amanzi aphansi' abhekisela emanzini aphansi (isibonelo, ama-aquifer). Iyini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye neMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? 'Kazwelonke' kusho ukuthi umthetho uhlose wonke amazwe. 'Umthetho' ubhekisela kumthetho owamukelwa yiPhalamende. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibonisa ukuthi kuyimthetho ophathelene namanzi, okwenziwe kuzo zonke iNingizimu Afrika. Yamukelwa yiPhalamende ngo-1998. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo eth belong to all South Africans. Ithi amanzi kumele ahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo nangokufanele. Ithi amanzi adingeka njengokudingeka kwabantu (njengamanzi okuphuza, ukulungisa ukudla, nezidingo ezihlobene nempilo) futhi ukuthi amanzi endaweni kumele ahlukaniswe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye izicelo zabelwe. Njengoba amanzi ebalulekile kubantu, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi abantu kumele babambe iqhaza ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Iphromotha ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi. Ithuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngokukwenza kube seduze kwabantu ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusungula izikhungo ezisha zesifunda nezendawo, njengezikhungo zokuphathwa kweziqu. Lezi zikhungo ezintsha zizoba nezikhulumi zomphakathi futhi zizosisiza umphakathi ukuba ubambe iqhaza ezinqumweni ezihlobene namanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ikhipha zonke izimiso zokucwasa mayelana nokufinyelela kwabanye abantu. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Iwandisa ukutholakala kwamanzi ukuze kuthuthukiswe okuqhubekayo. Iyini inhloso yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke? Iqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi avikelwe, asetshenziswe, athuthukiswe, agcinwe, aphathwe, futhi aqashelwe ngendlela eqhubekayo futhi efanele (ngokufanele) ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke. Ubani onesibopho ngezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke? Uhulumeni kazwelonke (iMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni) osebenza ngaphansi komphakathi wezamanzi nezinkuni ungumgibeli wezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke. Umphakathi wezamanzi nezinkuni unesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi uMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke uhlelwe. Le nqubo kumele iboniswe kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Inqubo yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke ibophela zonke izikhungo zamanzi kanye nabasebenzisi bamanzi. Umphakathi kumele abuyekeze futhi abuyisele inqubo yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke njalo eminyakeni emihlanu. Iyini inhloso yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke? Inhloso yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke ziphathwa ngendlela efanele kulo lonke izwe. Iphinde ihlinzeke ngemigomo yokuthi amanzi kumele aphathwe kanjani ezindaweni zokuphathwa kwamanzi ezibekwe. Ithi mangaki amanzi kumele 'agcinwe' ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo eziyisisekelo zabantu kanye nezindawo zokuhlala. Inqubo yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke kumele iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona amanzi esikhathini esizayo nasemsebenzini okhethekile njengezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke. Isetha amazinga okuhlukaniswa kwamanzi. Iphinde ithi izikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi (njengezikhungo zokuphathwa kweziqu) kumele zisungulwe. Uhulumeni kazwelonke uhlukanisile izwe lonke laba izindawo eziyi-19 zokuphathwa kwamanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi le nqubo ithuthukiswe kuyo yonke indawo yokuphathwa kwamanzi. Umnyango Wezokulungiswa Uthumele umthetho ozovumela umphakathi nabanye ababambiqhaza njengomnyango wezobulungiswa kanye neSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwezempi eNingizimu Afrika ukuba babe nezwi ezinqumweni eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwabanjwe ngaphambi kokuphothulwa kwezinsuku zabo. Esikhathini esizayo, izisulu zobugebengu zizovunyelwa ukuba zenze iziphakamiso kumaBhodi Okukhululwa okuhlola izinsizakalo zokulungiswa futhi zibe khona emihlanganweni yeBhodi mayelana nezimo ezinzima. Kungani kudingeka ushintsho? Uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi luhlale lukhala kakhulu ngenxa yokubona ukuthi abaphathi bezokulungiswa baphazamisa izinqumo ezenziwe yizinkantolo. Nakuba uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi lukhona emhlabeni jikelele futhi luhlose ukuhlela ukuziphatha kwabaphula umthetho ngokukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle nokubambisana, kanye nokunciphisa umehluko phakathi kokuphila ejele nokuphila okujwayelekile emphakathini. ENingizimu Afrika, lolu hlelo lukhala ngenxa yokungabi sobala nokuzimela ngesikhathi sokwenza izinqumo. Lezi zimo kanye namathuba okuthatha ingxenye yomphakathi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuholele ekushintsheni komthetho nasekuthumeleni umthetho ngo-1998 owavumela ukusungulwa kohlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi olucacile nolungakhethi, oluhilela ababambiqhaza bangaphandle ekwenzeni izinqumo. Kunobunzima obukhulu obuphazamisayo ukwamukelwa kwalesi sigaba (isigaba 74) seMthetho Wezokulungiswa, Umthetho 11 ka-1998. Umthetho waguqulwa ngo-2001 ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinkinga. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuphothulwa kohlelo ukuze kuphumelele masinyane engxenyeni yesibili ka-2004. Yini indima yeBhodi Yokukhululwa? AmaBhodi Okukhululwa abhekelele ukucubungula izindaba eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kwabanjwe kanye nokubhekwa kwabo. Kuze kube manje, lawa mabhodi awanawo amandla okwenza izinqumo eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Okwamanje, amaBhodi enza kuphela iziphakamiso ezihambisana nenqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi izinqumo zenziwa ngababhekelele ngqo, isibonelo; abaphathi bezikhungo zokulungiswa, abaphathiswa bendawo, abaphathiswa bezifunda, kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokulungiswa, kuye ngokuthi ubukhulu balesi simo nokuthi ubukhulu balesi sijeziso. Umthetho omusha unika iBhodi amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhileleka kwabanjwe abathathwa njengobungozi nalabo abathathwa njengokubeka engcupheni uma amaBhodi enza iziphakamiso ezithunyelwa enkantolo eyafaka isijeziso, engase iyiphikise futhi iyiphule. Okokuqala, umthetho omusha unika amaBhodi Okukhululwa amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhileleka kwabanjwe abathathwa njengobungozi ngokwesigaba 286A seMthetho Wokuphatha Kwezigwegwe futhi ukuguqula izijeziso ezibekwe ngesigaba 276(A) seMthetho Wokuphatha Kwezigwegwe mayelana nabantu abakhululiwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ezimeni ezishiwo ngenhla, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezafaka isijeziso ekuqaleni bese kwenziwa isinqumo. Omunye umehluko uwukuthi isinqumo sokunikeza ukukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kumuntu ongosuku noma ezikhungweni ezithathwa njengokubeka engcupheni. Kulezi zimo, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezafaka isijeziso bese kwenziwa isinqumo. AmaBhodi angama-52 azosungulwa ezweni lonke azoba namalungu akhishwe emiphakathini. Amalungu azoba ngabantu abahloniphekile nabathembekile ngaphakathi kwemiphakathi yabo abaphuma kuyo, okuzokwenza amaBhodi aqinise. Kumele babe ngabantu abadala abaqonda ukuphila futhi balungele ukuveza izintshisekelo zomphakathi ngenhlonipho nangokungakhethi. Abaphathi kufanele babe ngabantu abanemfundo efanele ehlanganiswe nesipiliyoni sokuphatha. Ngaphezu komphathi, amalungu amabili angeziwe azothunyelwa kwiBhodi. Izikhala zePhini leMphathi kanye noSekela zigcinwe kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe boMnyango Wezokulungiswa. Ibhodi izophinde ifake abamele abavela kuSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwezempi kanye noMnyango Wezobulungiswa. Le nhlanganisela nokumelwa akuyona imfuneko njengoba lezi zinsizakalo zingakhetha isikhathi sokuba zikhona noma cha. Ezimeni eziphathelene nezono ezinzima, ummeleli ovela kuMnyango Wezobulungiswa udingeka ukuthi ulethe umbiko kwiBhodi. Ibhodi ngalinye izosizwa ngamalungu amabili avela emnyangweni wezokulungiswa ukuze kube nokuphathwa kahle nokwesekwa. Kwezinye izinguquko ezivela enqubweni ejwayelekile kanye nomzamo wokwandisa amandla ezisulu zobugebengu, izisulu zezinye izono zizoba nelungelo lokwenza iziphakamiso kwiBhodi futhi zibe khona emihlanganweni yeBhodi kuphela uma bezobhekana nezindaba eziphathelene nabantu abashushisiwe. Lokhu kubhekwa njengenyathelo elibalulekile ekwakheni nasekukhuthazeni ubulungiswa obubuyiswayo njengomsebenzi owamukelekayo, ukwakha nokuhlanganisa. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba amaBhodi amasha okukhululwa azocubungula izicelo ezivela ezihlotsheni ezahlukene zabantu abanjwe ezethulwe kubo, izimo ezintsha ezithinta isikhathi umuntu okufanele akhululwe ngaphambi kokubhekwa kokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi zizosebenza kuphela kulabo abajeziswe ngemuva kokuthi izinhlinzeko ezithile zomthetho ziqalile ukusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bonke abantu abajeziswe ngaphambi kokuphathwa komthetho omusha bazobhekwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho okhona (Umthetho 8 ka-1959). Ngamanye amazwi, abantu abajeziswe esikhathini esedlule ngaphambi kokuphathwa komthetho omusha akufanele balindele ukuthi umthetho omusha uzoba nomthelela omubi esikhathini okufanele bakhululwe ngaphambi kokubhekwa kokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Abantu abachazwa njengabaphula umthetho abavame ukuphindaphinda: Ngemuva kokusebenza okungenani eminyakeni eyisixhenxe. Umthetho omusha uvumela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokubhekelela Ukukhululwa ezobheka izimo ezithunyelwe kuyo ukuze ibuyekezwe nguMphathiswa noma uNgqongqoshe Wezokulungiswa uma bekholelwa ukuthi isinqumo sokuqala seBhodi Yokubhekelela Ukukhululwa siphikisana noma siphula inqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa. Ibhodi yokubuyekeza izoba nezimfanelo ezizimele futhi ibanjwe ngamalungu avela kwiNational Council of Correctional Services, uMphathi noma uPhini loMphathi Wokushushiswa Kwezimali, kanye nabamele ababili bomphakathi. Umphathi weBhodi yokubuyekeza uzoba nguJaji weNkantolo Ephakeme, futhi isinqumo seBhodi sizothathwa njengenqubomgomo eqinile kumaBhodi Yokubhekelela Ukukhululwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aqonde izinguquko ezilethwe umthetho omusha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu, uMnyango uqale umkhankaso wokwazisa ophumelelayo ophathelene nokuhlinzeka ngemin
Kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi inhloso yokulima ukuhweba ekugcineni. Kudinga imali eningi ukuze uqale uk planting ummbila. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla zibalulekile kakhulu uma uphatha ibhizinisi lokulima. Sidinga ukuhlukanisa izindleko ngezindlela ezimbili - izindleko eziqondile nezindleko eziguqukayo. Lokhu kuhambisana nezindleko eziphelele zokuphatha ibhizinisi lokulima epulazini - lezi yizindleko ezingabangelwa uk planting kwesivuno esithile. Lokhu kungabandakanya izindleko zokuhlola amarekhodi ezimali, imali yasebhange, amaholo, ugesi, amalayisense, ukuphathwa nokulungiswa, inzalo emalini ebolekiwe, ukuphathwa kwemoto, izinto zokubhala, njll. Lezi zindleko zingahluka kumlimi nomlimi ngoba usayizi wezinkambu awufani, inani lesikweletu lihlukile, futhi abanye abalimi abaphathi ukulima ngendlela efanayo. Lezi zindleko zihambisana nohlobo lwesivuno esithile esikhuluma ngaso. Lokhu kubandakanya izindleko ezifana ne-diesel, umanyolo, imbewu (uk planting), amakhemikhali, ukuvuna, ukumaketha, kanye namaholo çalışan. Ngokuvamile lezi zindleko endaweni eyodwa zingahluka kakhulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ulima ngendlela ethile noma u planting isivuno esithile, zifana kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukucabangela kahle ngezimali ngaphambi kokuba uqale uk planting noma iyiphi imbewu. Kungcono kakhulu ukuhlela uk planting indawo enkulu kahle ukuze uqinisekise umkhiqizo omuhle.
Fika ekhaya ngokuphepha. Le bhukwana iyisikhumbuzo sokukusiza ukuthi ugcine impilo enhle ngesikhathi uhamba. Bafuna ukuphendula noma yimiphi imibuzo onayo mayelana nempilo yakho. Uma uqasha abashayeli bezinqola, ubhekene nabo. Ingabe ugcina umthetho wezempilo kubo bonke abasebenzi? Ingabe unikeza ulwazi lwezempilo nezikhwama zokuvikela? Ingabe uvumela abashayeli ukuthi bathathe ukuphumula ukuze bazikhulule uma behamba ibanga elide? Ingabe unikeza abashayeli bakho izigqoko zokugqoka uma besiza abalimele? Thatha isikhashana ukuphendula imibuzo elandelayo. Ingabe nginama- sores noma amanxeba ezindaweni zami ezizimele? Kuthiwani ngothandekayo wami? Ingabe kukhona okukhishwayo, ukuvuvukala, noma ukuhamba kahle? Ingabe othandekayo wami unokukhishwayo? Uma uphendula ngempela, yisiphi isinyathelo osithathayo? Uma uphendula ngempela, wena nothandekayo wakho (noma abanye) kufanele baphenduke izeluleko zezempilo esibhedlela, esikhungweni, noma endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngoba kulula ukuphatha izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi/IZifo Zokuthathelana. Ngoba uma unayo isifo esithathelwana ngocansi, amathuba okuthola nokudlulisa igciwane le-HIV aphezulu kakhulu. Ingabe uyazi ngezikhungo zezempilo nezinsizakalo zolwazi ezisogwini? Abashayeli bezinqola bayamukelwa! Ngabe ngingaya kuphi uma ngigula endleleni? Emgibeni ophumayo, ungaya kunoma yisiphi isibhedlela sikamasipala, isikhungo, noma udokotela. Kodwa kunzima ukuhamba emgibeni wakho oqondile. Kuhlale kunzima futhi ukuhamba nokuqasha isithuthuthu phakathi nosuku uma uhamba isikhathi eside. Kukhona enye indlela! Zama enye yalezi zikhungo ezihlinzeka ngolwazi endleleni. Kukhona abahlengikazi abaqeqeshiwe nabangane, futhi ungathola izeluleko nolwazi oluvela kubachwepheshe bezempilo abazi kahle ngazo zonke izinkinga zempilo ongahlangabezana nazo. Ungapaka isithuthuthu sakho esikhungweni futhi uthole usizo ngobusuku. Yisiphi usizo oluhlinzekwa izikhungo ezisogwini? Ulwazi lokuthi ungaya kuphi uma ufuna ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV/AIDS. Zonke izindlela ezitholakala kulezi zikhungo ezisogwini zihlala zifihliwe futhi azidalulwanga kumuntu. Umqashi wakho noma umphathi wakho ngeke akwazi ukuthi uvakashele enye yalezi zikhungo. Zonke lezi zikhungo ezisogwini zivulekile ntambama kuze kube phakathi kobusuku, phakathi kwesonto. Lezi zikhathi zifanele kakhulu kubashayeli bezinqola ngoba kunzima kubo ukuhamba phakathi nosuku njengoba bevame ukusebenza ngesikhathi behamba. Izikhungo ezisogwini zisebenza futhi njengamakhaya olwazi atholakala emigibeni ekhonjiswe kule mappa. Zama enye yalezi zikhungo ezihlinzeka ngolwazi endleleni. Kukhona abahlengikazi abaqeqeshiwe nabangane, futhi ungathola izeluleko nolwazi oluvela kubachwepheshe bezempilo abazi kahle ngazo zonke izinkinga zempilo ongahlangabezana nazo. Ungapaka isithuthuthu sakho esikhungweni futhi uthole usizo ngobusuku. Kufanele uhlole amehlo akho. Uma kusemidlalweni, hlala endaweni ekhanyayo bese ubeka le khadi phambi kwakho efasiteleni elikhulu elivimbela umoya. Phumula esihlalweni sakho cishe imitha eyodwa kude nekadi. Ungakwenza kanjani lokho? Uma ungakwazi ukufunda wonke amahlebezi, kufanele ubone udokotela wamazwi ukuze uhlole. Uma uzwa ukungabi nekhaya, khumbula ikhaya nabathandekayo bakho... Uchitha isikhathi eside kude nekhaya futhi kukhona izikhathi lapho uphupha ngokuthula nokufudumala kwekhaya nabathandekayo bakho. Izithelo ezintsha nemifino zisiza ukuqinisa uhlelo lwakho lokuzivikela futhi zikunike amandla. Zama ukugwema ukudla ukudla okunamafutha amaningi. Ukulala esithuthuthwini kungaba mnandi kakhulu; NOKHO, ukuthola ukulala okwanele kusiza ukuba wenze kahle. Ukuphakamisa imilenze yakho nokulandela uhlelo lokuzivocavoca nokusebenza kokuqina kugcina uqaphele. Ukuphuma esithuthuthwini futhi kugcina ingqondo yakho icacile futhi kukunikeze ukuphumula. Ukuhlanzeka - kusukela ekuphileni kuya ekuphileni! Nakuba izindawo eziningi zokumisa izinqola zineziqandisi, zama ukugeza nsuku zonke. Ukuze ube nekhono lokuhlanzeka akukhona nje okuhle empilweni yakho; kukwenza uzizwe uqhakazile futhi uqinisekile. Emgwaqweni, ubhekene nezingozi eziningi. Abashayeli bavame ukuphazamiseka futhi baphanga, njengoba wazi. Ngakho qaphela futhi uhlale uvula amehlo akho ukuze ugweme izingozi. I-HIV ingenye yezingozi ezinkulu kubashayeli. I-HIV yigciwane elibangela i-AIDS. Le ndlala ibi kakhulu ngoba uma uyithola, awukwazi ukuphola, futhi impilo yakho iyahluleka. Akulona iqiniso lokuthi awukwazi ukuthola igciwane le-HIV ngoba uhamba nomuntu onalo emzimbeni wakhe. Ungathola i-AIDS kuphela uma unocansi olungavikelekile nomuntu onale gciwane noma uma igazi lakho lithinta igazi elithintekile. Ngalesi sizathu, kufanele uhlale usebenzisa isikhwama sokuvikela uma unocansi. Ngalesi sizathu, kufanele futhi ugqoke izigqoko uma usiza umuntu olimele. Akulona iqiniso lokuthi i-AIDS iyapholisa. Odokotela abakwazi ukuyiphola. Ngisho nom miracle ngeke ikuphole. Empeleni, akekho ongalungisa uma igciwane selingene emzimbeni wakho. Uma unalo, kufanele ufune ukwelashwa futhi uthole izeluleko kubachwepheshe bezempilo. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi owesifazane ophakathi kokukhulelwa ongu-HIV/AIDS angadlulisa igciwane kumntwana wakhe, noma ngesikhathi sokubeletha noma ngesikhathi sokuncelisa. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlole igciwane ukuze bazi ukuthi banalo emzimbeni wabo noma cha. Bangathola izeluleko esikhungweni abavakashela kuso ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa. Le nsizakalo ibeka ingane engozini yokuphila. Akulona iqiniso lokuthi awukwazi ukubona ubuso bomuntu onegciwane le-HIV. Abantu bangabukeka bephilile futhi behlanzekile njengezithombe, kodwa bangase babe negciwane ngaleso sikhathi. Futhi ngakolunye uhlangothi, akekho onobuso obuphilile futhi obufanele ongasithola lesi sifo. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa kwegazi kuphela inganikeza ubufakazi bokuthi umuntu uthwele igciwane noma cha. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi uma uhloleka kahle nge-HIV, akusho ukuthi uphume emgwaqeni. Ungaphila impilo ende futhi uqhubeke nokushayela. Udinga nje ukuvakashela udokotela ukuze uthole izeluleko. Kufanele futhi ujwayele ukudla kahle nokuzivocavoca njalo, futhi kufanele uyeke ukuphuza nokukhahlela. Uma uthole igciwane, ubhekene nokungadlulisi kumkakho noma kumunye umngane wakho. Khumbula ukuthi noma nini uma unocansi, kufanele usebenzise isikhwama sokuvikela. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi abantu abaneziqu ezithathelwana ngocansi (IZifo Zokuthathelana) banamathuba aphezulu okuthola igciwane le-HIV uma benocansi nomuntu onalo igciwane. Amalungelo Abasebenzi: Ukubaluleka Nokuvikela Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amalungelo abasebenzi abe yinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithuthukayo. Abasebenzi, njengengxenye ebalulekile yomnotho, badinga ukuvikelwa ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bathola izinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi baphila kahle, benza imisebenzi yabo ngokuzikhandla, futhi bahlala bejabulile emsebenzini. Emazweni amaningi, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlanganisa izici eziningi, njengokuhola kahle, izinsuku zokuphumula, nezinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, futhi bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlanganisa nokuvikelwa ekuxhashazweni, okungukuthi, abasebenzi kufanele bavikelwe ezimeni zokusebenza ezinzima, ezingenza kube nzima kubo ukuzenzela impilo engcono. NgokweMithetho Yezabasebenzi, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlukaniswe ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amalungelo okuba nezinhlaka zokwakha, amalungelo okukhuluma, kanye namalungelo okukhuluma ngezinkinga ezithinta abasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, baphinde baphakamise izinkinga ezithinta imisebenzi yabo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezivulekile zokuxhumana phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungelo abasebenzi ahlanganisa nokuvikelwa kwezisebenzi ezincane, ezinjengokuthi abantwana badinga ukuvikelwa ekusebenzeni. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bahlala besesikoleni, befundiswa kahle, futhi baphila impilo engcono. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, izwe kufanele libe nemithetho eqinile evikela abantwana ekusebenzeni ngaphansi kweminyaka ethile. Ezinye izinkinga ezithinta amalungelo abasebenzi zifaka phakathi ukungalingani emiholweni, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama nabamhlophe, kanye nabesifazane nabesilisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi kudingeka kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba elifanele emsebenzini. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinqubo ezivulekile nezifanele zokuhola abasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bathola imiholo efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe amalungelo abasebenzi ziye zanda. Izinyathelo ezifana nokwakhiwa kwezinyunyana zabasebenzi, ezihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi, ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu. Lezi zinyunyana zenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuveza izinkinga zabo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani ziyaqonda ukuthi zidinga ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izinyathelo ezithile zikhona, kusekhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene namalungelo abasebenzi. Ezinye izinkampani ziyaqhubeka nokwephula amalungelo abasebenzi, zenza kube nzima kubo ukuveza izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezinqala ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi avikelwa ngempela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izwe kufanele libe nezinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa abasebenzi ngamalungelo abo. Lokhu kuzosiza abasebenzi ukuba baqonde ukuthi banelungelo lokuvikela amalungelo abo, futhi bazokwazi ukuveza izinkinga zabo uma kudingeka. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izinhlelo zokufundisa kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezithile ezihambisana nezidingo zabasebenzi. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abasebenzi ayisici esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi avikelwa, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo, futhi izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izinqubo ezivulekile nezifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukuveza izinkinga zabo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi baphila impilo engcono. Amalungelo abasebenzi awavikela kuphela abasebenzi, kodwa futhi avikela umphakathi wonke, uqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono.
Umbiko NgezImidlalo Yevidiyo Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imidlalo yevidiyo iye yaba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu abaningi. Iziphakamiso ezihlukahlukene zezimali, izindawo zokudlala, nezinkampani ezidumile zikhombisa ukuthi lo mkhakha yinsiza enkulu ekwakheni izenzo zentengiselwano. Ukuze siqonde kahle imidlalo yevidiyo, kubalulekile ukuba sihlolisise imvelaphi yayo, ukuthuthukiswa, umthelela emphakathini, nezinkinga ezihambisana nayo. Ukwakhiwa Nokuqamba Imidlalo yevidiyo iqale ukuthuthukiswa ezinkulungwaneni ezedlule, lapho umqondo wokuqala wama-computer games uqhamuka. Lezi zinkosi zokuqala zamakhompiyutha zazingaphansi kwezikhungo zokucwaninga, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo ihambe yaba yinto ejwayelekile emakhaya. Uhlelo olwandayo lokwengeza ubuchwepheshe, indawo yokusebenza enokuthuthuka, nezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi kube yizici ezibalulekile. Imidlalo yokuqala, efana no-'Pong' ne-'Space Invaders,' maphakathi neminyaka yama-1970 kuya kuma-1980, iye yakhombisa indlela yokujabulisa abantu. Kodwa-ke, ngesikhathi se-2000, imidlalo yevidiyo ikhombisa intuthuko enkulu, ikakhulukazi emshadweni wayo nama-graphics, umphakathi, nezici zokusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu. Lezi zinto zibonakala kakhulu kumadivayisi afana ne-PlayStation, Xbox, ne-PC. Uhlanga Lwemidlalo Uhlanga lwemidlalo yevidiyo lubanzi kakhulu, luhlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene. Noma ngabe imidlalo ye-action, adventure, role-playing (RPG), noma sports, bonke banezinjongo ezithile. Ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokwenziwa kochwepheshe buncedile ekwandiseni imidlalo emisha, kufaka phakathi imidlalo egijimayo (virtual reality) ethokozisa abadlali ngendlela ehluke ngokuphelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakhiwa kwemidlalo yevidiyo kuncike ezidingweni zabantu ezahlukeneyo. Abadlalayo babesebenzisa umqondo wezinselelo ezibucayi ezithinta umqondo, ukuhweba, kanye nemithetho ethe xaxa yokuphila. Lokhu kudala imidlalo ehambisana nezinhloso zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni zezemidlalo zanamuhla ezithokozisa abantu abaningi. Umthelela Emphakathini Imidlalo yevidiyo ayinakuphikiswa: ibalulekile emiphakathini yamanje. Kuwo wonke umhlaba, abantu bahlanganyela emidlalweni, bebhalisela imicimbi yezemidlalo, nezifundo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubumbana emiphakathini, lapho abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene behlangana khona ukuze bajabulele imidlalo ndawonye. Naphezu kwezinto ezinhle, imidlalo yevidiyo ithinta nezinkinga ezithile. Ukuhlala isikhathi eside kumadivayisi kudala izinkinga zezempilo, futhi kumqoka ukuba abadlali baqaphele izimpilo zabo. Izinkampani zidinga ukuncika emikhankasweni yokukhuthaza bonke abadlali ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Izinkinga Nezitaladi Kukhona izingozi eziphathelene nemidlalo yevidiyo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukumeza, ukudlwengulwa, nokwehlukana okungatheni. Lokhu kuzale imiphumela emibi, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni. Ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga, kudingeka ukuqhuba imikhankaso yokwakha ukuqonda kwezemidlalo, ukuhlola ukuphila ngababili, nokukhuthaza imikhuba emihle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yokuvikela amalungelo akakhululeka kudinga ukuba ibekwe kakhudlwana. Lokhu kuzovikela abadlali ezintweni ezingezinhle ezihlobene nomjikelezo wezobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Imidlalo yevidiyo iyinsiza ebambekayo ebalulekile, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi idinga ukugxila kuzo zonke izimpikiswano ezithinta imiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuvela kwemidlalo ethokozisayo kubonisa ukuthi ibalulekile komphakathi, njengoba ibambelela kumkhankaso wokuhlalisana. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sikuthathe ngokuqinile ukuzwai izinkinga, nokuqhuba imikhankaso ehambisana nemikhwa yokujabulela imali yevidiyo. Ngokufunde ngempela, lo mkhakha ungasiza ukufaka uhlelo nokuziphatha okuhle, kanti kubalulekile ukuthola indlela efanele yokujabulela lo mdlalo ogqamile. Imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuxhumana, yokufunda, nokuzithokozisa, futhi kumele sihlole kahle ukuze sizuze kahle.
Imibhalo Yesimo Sempesheni Kwathi ngelinye ilanga, uMnumzane Mthembu, owayengumsebenzi wezempilo emnyangweni wezokwelapha, wathola incwadi ethokozisayo. Le ncwadi yayivela kwi-GEMS, okuyinhlangano ethokozisayo eyayiphatha izinsiza zempesheni zabantu abasebenza emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngokujabula, uMthembu wabona ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola isimo sempesheni yakhe. Uhlanga lwempesheni lwalubhalwe kahle, kodwa uMthembu wathola ukuthi kudingeka athumele imibhalo ethile ukuze aqinisekise isimo sakhe.
