Umphakathi UProtector Lawrence Mushwana ukhuthaze iSikhungo Sezokuphepha saseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS) ukuba ihlulele abanikazi bezindaba abasiza amaphoyisa kanye neNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) ekuxazululeni amacala okweba, ngempumelelo ye-R75,000. Ngemva kokuhlola le ndaba, uMphakathi UProtector Mushwana ukhuthaze iSAPS ukuba iqhubeke nokwenza izithembiso ezingazifezeki kubanikazi bezindaba, njengoba lokhu kudala umonakalo emlandweni wabo. "Le ndlela yokuziphatha idala umonakalo emfanekisweni wabo (SAPS)," kusho yena. Umfakazi uthintane ne-OPP ngo-2007, futhi ngemva kweminyaka emithathu le ndaba yavulwa, kuthiwa iSAPS eGauteng yehlulekile ukumkhokhela impumelelo. Amaphoyisa abeke impumelelo kumuntu ongamsiza i-NPA ekubambeni abasolwa nasekuqinisekiseni ukuvuma emcimbini ophathelene nokweba imoto, ukubulala, nokuzama ukubulala. Umfakazi uphinde waphenya enkantolo ukuze lokhu kwenzeke. Impumelelo, ethiwa yakhishwa yinkampani yokuphepha iKhulani Security, yanikezwa iSAPS, nakuba benze izithembiso zokuyikhokhela amaphoyisa ngokwenza umsebenzi wenkampani yokuphepha. Umfakazi wabekwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokuvikela abafakizolo. Ngesikhathi sokuhlola, i-OPP yathola ukuthi umfakazi ngempela wanikeza iSAPS ulwazi olwaholela ekubambeni nasekugwetshweni kwabasolwa emcimbini wokweba. Kwatholakala ukuthi iSAPS yehlulekile ukumkhokhela umfakazi impumelelo eyathembisiwe. U-Advocate Mushwana wethula imiphumela yakhe kanye nemibiko yokunconywa kuNgqongqoshe uNathi Mthethwa wezokuphepha nokuphepha (manje obizwa ngokuthi amaphoyisa) kanye noMphathiswa wezamaPhoyisa eGauteng uPerumal Naidoo.
Isingeniso Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala libalulekile emkhakheni wezok教育. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ngenxa yokuthi ukufunda kuyisisekelo sokuthola ulwazi, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono okucabanga, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka izici ezithinta izinga lokufunda kwabafundi, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa lezi zinga. Izici Ezithinta Izinga Lokufunda Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lincike ezintweni eziningi. Okokuqala, umqondo wokufunda uqala ekhaya. Abafundi abakhuliswa ezindaweni ezinomoya opholile, lapho imfundo ibalulekile, bavame ukuba neziqu eziphakeme. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umndeni unendima enkulu ekwakheni isisekelo sokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuphila, ezifana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, zidlala indima ebalulekile. Abafundi abathola izincwadi, izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisiwe, bahlala bephumelela kakhulu. Okwesibili, izinga lokufunda lincike kumfundisi. Umfundisi onolwazi, onothando, futhi ophumelelayo ungashintsha impilo yomfundi. Umfundisi kufanele akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda ekhuthazayo, enezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, izindlela zokufunda ezihlukahlukene, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda. Uma umfundisi engakwazi ukuheha abafundi, izinga lokufunda lizoba phansi. Izinselelo Ezinzima Nokho, kunezinselelo eziningi ezithinta izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yindlela yokufunda. Abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi nentshisekelo, okwenza kube nzima ukufunda. Lokhu kungavela ngenxa yokungabi nezinsiza ezanele, noma ngenxa yokuthi abafundi bahlala ezindaweni ezikude nezikole. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zempilo, ezifana nokukhathazeka noma ukungabi namandla, zingathinta kakhulu izinga lokufunda. Okwesibili, ukungabi nokuqonda kahle kwezifundo kungaba yinkinga. Abafundi abaqondi kahle izifundo, noma abathola usizo oluncane, bahlala behluleka. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho izifundo zikhuluma ngolimi olungajwayelekile kubafundi. Ukungabi nokuqonda kahle kungaholela ekutheni abafundi baphumelele kancane, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Izinga Lokufunda Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokufunda, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izincwadi, izikhala zokufunda, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda, kungasiza abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi ngendlela ethokozisayo. Okwesibili, umfundisi kufanele abe nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa, ezifana nezifundo ezisebenzisanayo, izifundo ezisebenzayo, kanye nezifundo ezikhethekile. Umfundisi kufanele akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, ukuze abafundi bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bejabule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kumfundisi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephuma phambili ngezindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, futhi bazi kahle izidingo zabafundi babo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kuzokwenza umfundisi akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, okuzothuthukisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Isiphetho Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala libalulekile empilweni yabo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta lezi zinga, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa izinga lokufunda. Ngokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokufunda, izinsiza ezanele, kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kumfundisi, singathuthukisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abafundi baphumelele, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempumelelo, nelizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.
ISahara Desert: Umlando Wempilo ISahara, okuyi-Desert enkulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni, inembali ethakazelisayo nolwazi olunzulu. Le ndawo, enezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu, izintaba eziphakeme, nemifula emincane, iyindawo evusa umqondo. Abavakashi bayathokoziswa ngezinto ezihlukahlukene ezitholakala kule ndawo, futhi yindawo yokuhlala kwabantu abaningi abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Uma sibheka emuva, sithola ukuthi iSahara ayiyona nje indawo eyomile, kodwa ibalulekile emlandweni wabantu. Izinkanyezi phezulu zikhumbuza ngezizukulwane zokuqala ezazihlala lapha, futhi zikhombisa indlela kubavakashi abavela kude. ISahara ibingakaze ibonakale njengendawo yokuhlala kuphela, kodwa futhi yayiyindawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwezakhamuzi ezihlukene. Izinkanyezi zaziqinisekisa ukuthi izindaba ezahlukene, ezinjengothando nobudlelwano, zihlala zikhanya. Ngesikhathi esithile, iSahara yaba yindawo yokugcina impahla ezivela ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abathengisi bephuma khona bezithutha ngezinyawo noma ngemikhumbi emincane, behamba ngezindlela ezazaziwa kuphela kubo. Lezi zindlela zaziqondiswa izinkanyezi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimpahla zifika ezindaweni ezahlukene. Nokho, impilo eSahara ayizange ibe lula; ukushisa okukhulu, izimvula ezingaphansi, nezimo ezinzima zokuphila kwenza kube nzima kubantu abahlala kule ndawo. Nokho, abantu baye bakwazi ukuhamba phambili, besebenzisa ulwazi lwabo lokuphila. Basungula izindlela zokugcina amanzi, izindawo zokuhlala eziphumelelayo, nezindlela zokuthola ukudla, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwemiphakathi ezindaweni ezithile. ISahara ibiyindawo ebalulekile yokuhweba, lapho izinsiza ezifana namatshe, izinsimbi, nezinsiza zokwakha zatholakala khona. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezakhamuzi ezahlukene, kuhlanganisa amaBerber, amaTuareg, nezinye izizwe. Izinkanyezi zabeziqhuba, zikhombisa indlela yokuhweba, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bexhumene. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinguquko zenzeka eSahara. Ukufika kwabantu abasha, izinkampani, nezinhlelo zokwakha, kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izindawo zokuhlala, izikole, nezikhungo zezempilo. Nokho, lezi zinguquko zanelisa izinkinga, njengokungqubuzana phakathi kwabantu bendabuko nabantu abasha, kodwa abantu baqhubeka bezama ukuthola izixazululo. Namuhla, iSahara iyindawo ebalulekile emhlabeni, futhi ibonisa indlela yokuphila. Izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza abantu bokuqala nabantu bamanje ukuthi le ndawo iyindawo enomlando ocebile, ethandwa yizizukulwane eziningi. Umsebenzi wethu ukuhlinzeka ngothando nemvelo, sikhumbule izinkanyezi, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi iSahara iyohlala ibalulekile emlandweni wethu. Le ndawo izothokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo, ikakhulukazi uma sikhumbula ukuthi iSahara iyingxenye yethu, umhlaba wethu. Ngakho-ke, uma uhamba eSahara, khumbula izinkanyezi, khumbula abantu abahlala lapha, futhi hlonipha le ndawo emangalisayo. I-Sahara iyindaba, iyisiko, futhi iyingxenye yempilo yethu.
I-Fund ye-Competitiveness (CF) iyisikhwama sokwabelana ngezindleko esinikeza usizo lwezezimali ukuze kusekelwe osomabhizinisi abasungula amabhizinisi ukuze bafinyelele ku-50% yezindleko zabo. Osomabhizinisi abafanelekayo kumele bakhiqize imikhiqizo noma banikeze izinsizakalo kumabhizinisi anezici noma iziqu ezithile. Ukukhuthaza ngokwezimali amabhizinisi ukuba athuthukise izinga lawo lokusebenza, kanye nokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokwazi zangaphandle kanye namakhono. Ukuthuthukisa izinkampani (ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphatha noma lokuphathwa, ukuthola amazinga ajwayelekile), ukuqeqesha ukuze kwakhiwe amazinga okuncintisana. Ukwandisa izinsizakalo ze-NGOs, izinhlangano zamabhizinisi, nezimboni ezizama ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zezigaba/izimboni ezithile. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-grant ukuze kufinyelelwe ezingeni eliphezulu le-R600,000 emkhakheni nasemkhakheni ofanele. Ukusiza izimboni ukufinyelela amazinga aphezulu okuncintisana emakethe yangaphandle emkhakheni wemakethe yasekhaya nasezimakethe zokuthumela.

Eminyakeni yethu yokuqala eyishumi njengohulumeni obusayo, siqondise amandla ethu nemizamo yethu ekushintsheni kusukela ekunakekeleni komphakathi kuya ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi ngokwenza kube lula ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza nezikhombisi-zinqumo. Njengombuso omusha, sithuthukise izinqubomgomo nezisekelo zomthetho eziholele ekutheni sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu abampofu nabasengozini njengoba bekulindelekile ngamalungelo abo. Umnyango eminyakeni eyishumi edlule ugxile ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ekubhekaneni nezidingo zezinye izinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuhlonishwa kwezimali zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuholele ekunciphiseni nasekwehliseni ezinye izinsizakalo. Lokhu kuphinde kwakhula ngenxa yokuthi izinsiza zokuvikela umphakathi zathuthukiswa ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, izinsiza ezinganele zokuhlinzeka ngeminye imisebenzi yomphakathi kubantu abadinga usizo, ukuphakanyiswa kwamakhono phakathi kwabachwepheshe ababalulekile, kanye nokubophezeleka kwezikhungo zomphakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuholele nasekuphuleni kwezikhungo ezinjalo nasekulahlweni kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni, okuthinte kabi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga, uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi weSizwe uqale inqubo yokuthuthukisa uMthetho Wokukhuthaza Izehlakalo Zezimali zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Izenzakalo zangempela zelizwe zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababephakanyiswe ngaphambili. Ukuze kuhanjiswe izikhombisi-zinqumo, izifanekiso zezindleko zathuthukiswa ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga ezibanzi zamasu ezizosebenzisa. I-PFA ingesinye sezinsiza ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqhutshwe ushintsho kokubili ekwethulweni kwezinsizakalo nasekusekeleni kwezimali zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Uhulumeni, ngomnyango wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, kufanele wethule le mvume, futhi siyazi ukuthi asikaze sikwazi ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso nezifiso sodwa. Ngakho-ke, savula amaphiko ethu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana, ukusebenzisana, nokuhlanganyela nezikhungo ezingekho kuhulumeni (NGOs), izikhungo ezisekelwe emkhulekweni (FBOs), izikhungo ezisekelwe emphakathini (CBOs), izikhungo ezihlobene nohulumeni, nezimboni. Kumele zixhaswe kahle futhi kufanele kube nezindinganiso ezibekwe ngendlela ezixhaswa ngayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe izifunda. Izifanekiso Zezindleko Zohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ziqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukusethwa kwezindinganiso nokulingana ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsiza. Iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhasa, njengoba kuchazwe ku-PFA, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ziqondiswe emphakathini nasezikhungweni ezidinga kakhulu, nokuthi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithengekayo. Ngemuva kwalokhu, uhulumeni uthuthukise futhi wavuma amathuluzi okuphatha nezikhombisi-zinqumo, ezihlanganisa ingxenye yesikhala esibanzi sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo okumele kuhlanganiswe noMthetho Wokukhuthaza Izehlakalo Zezimali kanye neSifanekiso Sokwethulwa Kwezinsiza. Njengomhla, asizokhumbula ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nemiphakathi ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsizakalo. Sibone amaphrojekthi afana noHlelo Lokwandisa Imisebenzi Yomphakathi (EPWP), Nezinhlelo Zokunciphisa Ubumpofu (ukubala ezimbalwa), ezihlanganisa umphakathi nohulumeni ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza. Le moya yokubambisana izosiza sibe nemiphumela engcono nokubamba iqhaza kwabantu bethu kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Izinsiza nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngabazithandayo, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ezizimele, kanye namalungu omphakathi zibalulekile kakhulu. Ngaphandle kwemizamo yeqembu, singakwenza ngokwengeziwe ukuthi isisekelo sehlelwe, nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi esibhekene nazo ekwenzeni iminikelo ebalulekile kumalunga ayizigidi zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abadinga usizo abalahlekelwa ithemba ezinsizeni zethu. Umnyango uphinde ufise ukuqaphela abantu nezikhungo ezisizile ekuthuthukiseni le mthetho, iminyango ezingeni lezifunda, amalungu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi ngeziphakamiso zabo nemibono. Ukubambisana komnyango nomphakathi kuhlala kuyisici esiyinhloko semizamo yokweseka ukusebenza kahle nokufeza umgomo wethu. Uhulumeni namuhla ubhekene nezinselelo ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza ezinhle kakhulu kubantu abaphansi kakhulu nabaphakanyisiwe emphakathini. Ngokomlando, izinsiza zokunakekelwa komphakathi zaziyimfanelo yokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni nezikhungo zomphakathi, lapho uhulumeni abe yisikhungo esiyinhloko sokuxhasa izikhungo ngokusekela kwawo. Izenzakalo zangempela zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababephakanyiswe ngaphambili. Imizamo yenziwa esikhathini esedlule yokuthuthukisa umthetho wokukhuthaza izimali ze-NPOs. Nokho, le mthetho ayikakafinyeleli ezidingweni zombili zikahulumeni kanye ne-NPO. Manje sekukhona isidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthuthukisa umthetho ozokuqinisekisa ukuthi umnyango ungahlinzeka ngezinsiza ukuze uthembise ukuphila okungcono kubantu bonke. Umthetho wokukhuthaza izimali uhlose ukuhlela ukuxhaswa kwezimali zezwe kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo emkhakheni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha ushintsho nokuhlela kabusha izinsiza nezimali, nokuqinisekisa izinsizakalo ezisebenzayo nezisebenzayo kubantu abampofu nabasengozini. Umthetho uzibophezela ekubhekaneni nokufinyelela ezinsizeni zabampofu nabaphakanyisiwe ngaphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila okungcono kubo, ngokubambisana nalabo abazimisele ukwakha umphakathi onakekelayo. Umthetho nezisekelo zomthetho zelizwe zinikeza indawo efanele umnyango ukuze ufeze izinhloso zawo, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokusatshalaliswa okufanele kwezinsiza. Igunya eliphethwe umkhakha we-NPO ekunikezeni izinsiza liyavunywa. Ezinye ze-NPO ziye zenza izinguquko ezibalulekile mayelana nezidingo zokunakekelwa komphakathi zelizwe. Nokho, ushintsho oludingekayo luhlala luyinselelo enkulu kuhulumeni. Ukufinyelela kulokhu nokwethulwa kwemvume yakho, umnyango udinga ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izinhloso okufanele zifezekiswe, ukuthi zizofezekiswa kanjani, nokuthi zingakhalipha kanjani ukusebenza kwehlelo. Umthetho ugxila ezinselelweni nasezinhlelweni zokushintsha, ezizokwenza kube sobala ukuthi izinsizakalo zizonikezwa kanjani, kuphi, futhi ngubani, nokuthi zixhaswa kanjani nguhulumeni. Uveza izinqubo zokukhetha zokuxhaswa. Izimfuneko zokufaneleka, kanye nezindlela zokukhokha nezidingo zokuxhaswa. UUber: Indaba Yezinsiza Zokuhamba Ngaphandle kwedolobha elikhulu, lapho abantu behamba khona ngezindlela ezahlukene, uUber waba yinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yabo. Le nsiza, eyasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2009, yahlala ibonakala njengokuphendula ezidingweni zabantu abafuna ukuhamba kalula, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuthi bangathola kanjani izithuthi. UUber, owaziwa ngokuba yinsiza yokuhamba ngendiza, washintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ukuhamba. Kwakukhona uThando, umphakathi ophila edolobheni elikhulu, oneminyaka engama-28. UThando wayehlala enezinkinga zokuhamba, ikakhulukazi uma efuna ukuya emsebenzini. Ngokuvamile, wayecabanga ngokusebenzisa izithuthi zomphakathi, kodwa wayehlale ethola ukuthi zikhona izinkinga eziningi, njengezikhathi zokulinda ezinde, noma izithuthi eziphelele. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, ngoba wayefuna ukusebenzisa isikhathi sakhe kahle. Ngelinye ilanga, uThando wezwa ngendaba ye-Uber kumngani wakhe. Uthe: "Kungani ungazami uUber? Uthola izithuthi kalula, futhi ungakhetha uhlelo olufanele." UThando, owakha isithakazelo, wanquma ukuzama le nsiza. Wathola uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Uber efoni yakhe, walubhalisela, wathola ukuthi kulula kakhulu ukuhamba. Kwakungelula nje, kodwa futhi kwaba yindlela yokuphila. Njengoba uThando eqala ukuyisebenzisa, wathola ukuthi uUber wayengaphezu kokuhamba kuphela. Kwakungumqondo omusha, omusha, owenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile. Uthando wathola izithuthi ezihamba kahle, ezihamba ngokushesha, futhi ezitholakala kalula. Lokhu kwaba yinto emnandi, ngoba wayengasaphuthelwa yizikhathi zokulinda ezinde, futhi wayephuma endlini yakhe ethokozile. Ngesikhathi esebenzisa uUber, uThando wahlangana nabashayeli abaningi abahlukahlukene. Omunye wabo, uSipho, wayengumshayeli onothando, owayekhuluma ngempilo, izifiso, nezinto azithandayo. UThando wathola ukuthi uSipho wayengumuntu ophumelelayo, owayengashintsha impilo yakhe. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuxhumana, futhi uThando wathola ukuthi uUber akukhona nje ukuhamba, kodwa futhi kuwumqondo wokuhlangana, wokuxhumana nabantu abasha. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uThando waqala ukujwayela uUber, wathola ukuthi ungathola izinsiza ezithile ezithakazelisayo. Waqala ukuthola izaphulelo, izinhlelo ezikhethekile, nemicimbi ethokozisayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila emnandi, ngoba wayengakwazi ukuhamba ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempilo yakhe yansuku zonke. Kodwa, uUber akukhona nje okuhle. Njengoba uThando eqhubeka nokusebenzisa le nsiza, waqala ukubona nezinselelo. Kwakukhona izinkinga ezithile, njengezikhathi lapho uUber engatholakali khona, noma lapho izithuthi zikhona, kodwa zikhona izinkinga zokuhamba. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga, ngoba uThando wayefuna ukuhamba kalula, kodwa kwaba nezikhathi lapho engakwazi ukufinyelela ezithuthwini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThando waqala ukuqaphela ukuthi abanye abashayeli be-Uber babenokungahambisani nezimiso. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho abashayeli babenokungabi nempilo, noma bephikisana nezivakashi. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enkulu, ngoba uThando wayefuna ukuhamba ngokukhululekile, kodwa kwaba nezikhathi lapho ezithuthi zazingahambi kahle. Noma kunjalo, uThando wayengakuvumeli lokhu kumphazamise. Waqhubeka nokusebenzisa uUber, wathola izindlela zokuhamba ezihlukahlukene. Wathola ukuthi uUber wayengumqondo omusha, owenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile, futhi wayengaphezu kokuhamba kuphela. UThando waqala ukubona uUber njengendlela yokuphila, eyenza kube lula ukuhamba, nokuhlangana nabantu abasha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uThando wathola ukuthi uUber washintsha impilo yakhe. Waqala ukuhamba ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, wahlangana nabantu abaningi, futhi wathola izinsiza eziningi ezithokozisayo. UUber waba yinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yakhe, eyenza kube lula ukuhamba, nokuhlangana nabantu abasha. Ekugcineni, uThando wathola ukuthi uUber akukhona nje ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumqondo wokuhlangana, wokuxhumana, nokwakha ubuhlobo. Uthando waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ku-Uber, futhi waqala ukuhamba ngendlela ehlukile. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, eyenza kube lula ukuhamba, nokuhlangana nabantu abasha. UUber waba yinsiza ebalulekile empilweni kaThando, eyashintsha indlela abacabanga ngayo ukuhamba. Uthando waba nesithakazelo esikhulu, futhi waqala ukubona uUber njengezindlela eziningi zokuphila, ezithokozisayo, nezinhle. UUber waba yinsiza eyashintsha impilo yakhe, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuhamba akukhona nje ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumqondo wokuhlangana nabantu, nokwakha ubuhlobo obusha. UUber, ngempela, waba yinsiza ebalulekile empilweni kaThando, eyashintsha indlela abacabanga ngayo ukuhamba.
Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhamuka, ukuveza, nokusebenzisa impahla yezenzakalo zezilwane ngaphezu kwabanye ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhiqizwa kanye nokulima izilwane ngenhliziyo yeRiphabhulikhi; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene kanye nezinto ezitholakele. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa imiyalelo; futhi igama elithi 'udokotela wezilwane' libhekisela kumuntu obhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezilwane kanye noMthetho Wempilo Yezilwane, 1982 (Umthetho 19 ka-1982), ukuze kulungiswe odokotela bezilwane njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 somthetho. Lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezilwane, noma izilwane ezihlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo zalolo hlobo njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhangela ngomyalezo kwiGazethi ukuthi lezilwane zenzelwe izinjongo zalo mthetho. Mayelana noluhlobo olusha lwezilwane noma uhlobo olusha lwezilwane oludingekayo ukuba lungene ezweni noma lwenziwe eRiphabhulikhi, uNgqongqoshe uzokwenza isimemezelo ngemuva kokucabangela isicelo, futhi ephinde acabangele umthetho wamazwe omhlaba, futhi ngemuva kokuthola imibono yokuphendula emyalezweni womphakathi okungenani ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ngaphambi kokwenza leso simemezelo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane noma imikhakha yalezi zilwane zingamenyezelwa njengokuhambisana nezimo zalo mthetho: Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isilwane noma impahla yezenzakalo njengoba kuthiwa esigabeni 17 izomenyezelwa kuphela ngemuva kwesicelo esibhaliwe sikaNgqongqoshe ngohlangothi lwezokulima ezilwaneni ezihlobene. a endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu eRiphabhulikhi; noma b ezweni elilodwa noma ngaphezulu elichaziwe. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha ofakazi eMnyangweni, onesifundo esifanele esiphakeme sokuthuthukiswa kwezilwane, njengomphakathi Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezilwane, ozokwenza amandla futhi enze imisebenzi enikezwe kubo noma edluliselwe kubo ngaphansi kwalomthetho. a Umsizi angadlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 ngokubhala kumfakazi onesifundo esifanele namakhono, noma anganikeza amandla noma adlulise umphakathi ngokuqhubeka nokubhalela ukuze enze lawo mandla noma enze le misebenzi. c Noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe noma umyalo onikezwe umphakathi ngaphansi kwesigaba a singakhanselwa noma sishintshwe nguMsizi, futhi njengoba kucacisiwe nguMsizi kuze kube kukhanselwa noma kushintshwe ngaphandle kokuhloswe ngalesi sigaba. Amandla okusebenzisa isinqumo sikaMsizi a Noma yiziphi amandla okwahlulela anikezwe uMsizi ngaphansi kwalomthetho, ngaphandle kwalawo anikezwe ngezinyathelo 16 noma 17, awavunyelwe ukuba asetshenziswe ukuze akhethe noma ubani ofaka isicelo noma omunye umuntu ophakanyiswa phambi kukaMsizi njengothando, ngaphandle kokunikeza lowo ofaka isicelo noma lowo muntu ithuba lokuzwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingasetshenziswanga, noma uma isikhathi singasetshenziswanga, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esifanele njengoba kuzoboniswa nguMsizi. b Umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu ophazamisekile ngaphansi kwesigaba a angawavuma lawo malungelo okuzwa. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uma kulandela lo mthetho isikhathi esichaziwe lapho noma yisiphi umthetho noma okuthile kufanele kwenziwe, uMsizi angathuthukisa leso sikhathi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuphela kwaso. UMsizi uzogcina uhlu lwezikhumbuzo, abahlinzeki, abaklami bezinhlamvu, abahlinzeki bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabazali, imiphakathi yabazali bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe noma ezivunyelwe ezilawulayo futhi ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe mayelana nalezi zikhumbuzo, abahlinzeki, abaklami bezinhlamvu, abahlinzeki bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabazali, imiphakathi yabazali bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezilawulayo kuzobhaliswa. Uhlaka luzovulwa, ngemuva kokukhokha imali ethile, ukuze luhlolwe ehhovisi likaMsizi phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza. UMsizi uzohlinzeka nganoma yimuphi umuntu, uma efuna futhi ngemuva kokukhokha imali ethile, ikhophi yanoma yiluphi ulwazi olubhaliswe kuhlu noma isitifiketi esihlobene nalokho. Uhlaka luzoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezinto zonke eziqondiswe noma ezinikezwe amandla ngalo mthetho ukuba zibhaliswe khona. Isitifiketi esithi sibhaliwe nguMsizi sizoba nomthelela wokuthi ubhaliso alwenziwanga noma noma yini enye enikezwe amandla ngalo mthetho ukuba yenziwe, yenziwe noma ingenziwa izoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezinto ezichazwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ikhophi yokungena kuhlu noma ukwehliswa kuhlu, okukhuluma ukuthi kuqinisekiswe nguMsizi, kuzothathwa njengobufakazi kunoma iyiphi inkantolo ngaphandle kokunye ukufakazela noma ukukhipha okwakukhona. b njengomzali obhaliswe ngenhloso ethile uqinisekisile ngendlela ethile ebekwe nguMsizi ukuthi umklami wezikhumbuzo, umhlinzeki, umklami wezihloko, kanye nomhlinzeki wezihloko, ngazo zonke izigameko, bangase, ngokubona kwabo, babe nolwazi olwaneleyo nolwazi mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezikhumbuzo, imbewu, noma mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezitho, izitho, noma imbewu yabesifazane eqoqiwe, ehlolwe, esetshenziswe, iphakanyiswe, noma igcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho, futhi ukuthi ezilwaneni, mayelana nomklami wezikhumbuzo, umhlinzeki wezitho, noma umklami wezihloko, kungase kube ukuthi bahlinzekwa ngokusebenzisa noma, mayelana nomklami wezitho noma umhlinzeki, bangangeniswa ngemibewu yabesifazane noma izitho; futhi c ukuhambisana nezinye izidingo ezingase zikhishwe. Umhlinzeki kufanele futhi abhaliswe uma ethatha isinqumo sokubhalisela uMsizi ukuthi uzosebenzisa ama-laboratories namalungelo okukhulula izinkokhelo ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezichaziwe zezimali zokuhlola zonke impahla yezenzakalo ezingenisiwe ngabo ezweni noma ezingenisiwe kwabanye. b abasebenzisi be-teknoloji kule ndawo, mayelana nokunakekela izilwane ezigcinwe lapho, bangase futhi baqoqe, bahlolwe, basebenzise, bapakishwe, bahlonze, futhi bagcine impahla yezenzakalo, kubhekwa njengokwenziwa ngumuntu olandela izidingo ezichaziwe; futhi c ukuthi le ndawo kufanele ilandele lezi zidingo ezithile ezingenziwa. b lezi zilwane zilandele ezinye izidingo ezichaziwe. i indawo ibhaliswe njengendawo; noma ii isilwane sivunyelwe njengomkhiqizo wezinto eziphilayo, kufanele sifake isicelo ngendlela ezokwenziwa nguMsizi nangendlela echaziwe, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezezimali ezichaziwe zokubhaliswa noma ukuvunywa okufunwayo. Iqembu labantu elifuna ukubhalisela ukuba imiphakathi yabazali bezilwane kufanele lifake isicelo kuMsizi ngendlela ezokwenziwa nguMsizi nangendlela echaziwe, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe neziqondiso zomphakathi wabazali bezilwane, kanye nezimali zokufaka isicelo. Imiphakathi yabazali bezilwane noma iqembu lemiphakathi yabazali bezilwane elifuna ukubhalisela ukuba isikhungo esibhalisiwe kufanele lifake isicelo kuMsizi ngendlela ebekwe nguMsizi ngendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe neziqondiso zom
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni Ngaphakathi kweminyaka edlule, umphakathi wethu ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi ezithinta ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo zemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuxhumana. Ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni kube yisihloko esibalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi bephikisana nezithiyo ezikhona, ezivimbela abantu abaningi ekutholeni lezi zinsiza. Ekuqaleni, izikhungo eziningi zazikhokhiswa imali ukuze zifinyelelwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abampofu bahlale bephoqeleka ukuba baphile ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. Izikhungo zemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuxhumana zazitholakala kuphela kubantu abathile, okwakwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kulokho abakudinga. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, njengoba izinsiza ezinjengemfundo nezempilo zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni akukhona nje kuphela okudingekayo, kodwa kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemizamo yokwenza izikhungo zibe sezingeni eliphezulu, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka kumphakathi wonke. Izinyathelo zokuqala zathathwa ngababambiqhaza abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ohulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi. Ngonyaka ka-1994, ngemva kokuphumelela kokhetho lokuqala olukhululekile eNingizimu Afrika, kwavulwa amathuba amaningi okukhuluma ngalezi zindaba. Uhulumeni waphakamisa izinhlelo eziningi zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka kumphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zemfundo nezempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo zathola ukugxila okukhulu, njengoba uhulumeni waqala ukwakha izikole eziningi ezitholakala kalula. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokufunda, njengoba izingane eziningi zathola ithuba lokufunda futhi zathola imfundo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zezempilo zathuthukiswa, zathola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuphila kwabantu, njengoba izinsiza zezempilo zatholakala kalula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni zathuthukiswa futhi zathuthukiswa. Izinhlelo eziningi zatholakala, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, izinhlelo zokwelapha, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokufinyelela ezinsizeni, njengoba abantu abaningi beqala ukuthola ithuba lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Nokho, nakuba izinyathelo eziningi zathathwa, kusekhona izithiyo ezithile ezivimbela abantu ekutholeni ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni. Izinkinga ezifana nezinsiza ezincane, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezithile, kanye nezithiyo zomnotho ziqhubeka zikhona. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba izinyathelo eziningi zathathwa, kusekhona umsebenzi omningi okufanele wenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni kuyatholakala kubo bonke. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imizamo yokwakha izikhungo ezitholakala kalula, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela. Umphakathi uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuphila impilo engcono, futhi lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Ekugcineni, ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni kube yisihloko esibalulekile emlandweni wethu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi ezithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi banelungelo lokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Nakuba kusekhona izithiyo ezithile, umphakathi uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kuhloswe ngempela, njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa elingcono kubo bonke.
Le nqubo yokufaka isicelo sokukhokha intela ithunyelwa kwiMnyango Wezemali weSewula Afrika, icela ukuthi imali ethile ebekwe eceleni engashintshiwe ikhawulwe emalini engenayo ethola umkhokhi wentela noma ethola ngonyaka. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zentela ziqondile ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo sokukhokha intela. IMnyango Wezemali ngeke ikhiphe isikhumbuzo sokukhokha intela uma kusekhona imibhalo yokukhokha intela engakafakwa kwiSARS noma uma kusekhona imali yentela engakakhokhwa umkhokhi wentela. Kudinga isitatimende esikhombisa imali engenayo nezindleko ngemininingwane. Indlela oyisebenzisile ukubala inani lentela okufanele ukhokhe. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwe, uzokwaziswa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa, kodwa isikhumbuzo esisemthethweni sokukhokha intela sizothatha amasonto amane ukufika kuwe. Indlela elula yokufaka isicelo sokukhokha intela ukwenza lokhu nge-eFiling. Uma wenza kanjalo, isicelo sakho sizokwamukelwa ezinsukwini ezingama-48, uma ihhovisi lingafuni ubufakazi bezindleko. Kuzothatha amasonto amane ukucubungula isicelo sakho. Gcwalisa futhi uthumele ifomu lakho ku-inthanethi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, download futhi uqedele ifomu le-IRP 3.
Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA Isingeniso Izinhlelo ze-SITA (State Information Technology Agency) zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi kahulumeni, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka kubantu nabezindaba. Nokho, lapho lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle, umphakathi, izisebenzi, kanye nohulumeni bahlupheka kakhulu. Le dokhumenti ibheka umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA, izimbangela zalesi simo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlaka. Umthelela Kwezinsizakalo Zikahulumeni Ukungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA kudala ukuhamba kancane kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni abantu bahlale belinde izinsizakalo ezinjengokubhaliswa kwemali, izicelo zezimali, kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo. Lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki kubantu, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokwethembeka kukahulumeni. Umphakathi uphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudala ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kukahulumeni nabantu. Izindleko Zokungasebenzi Izindleko zokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA azikhawulelwe kuphela emsebenzini ongaphumeleli, kodwa zifaka phakathi nezindleko ezinkulu zokuphinda kwenziwe imisebenzi. Lokhu kudala ukuchithwa kwemali kahulumeni, okungaholela ekwehleni kwesabelomali sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Izindleko eziphakeme zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni ezisemqoka, okukhathaza kakhulu izigidi zabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Izimbangela Zokungasebenzi Izimbangela zokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA zingahluka kakhulu. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezobuchwepheshe: Izinhlelo ezindala noma ezingenayo ubuchwepheshe obuphambili zingaholela ekungasebenzi kahle. Uhlanga lwezobuchwepheshe luhlala luthuthuka, futhi uma uhulumeni ungazivumelanisi nezinguquko, izinhlelo zingase zibe nezinkinga. 2. Ukuntuleka Kwezinsiza: Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokusebenza, njengemali, abantu, noma amathuluzi, kungaholela ekungasebenzi kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle. 3. Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlangano: Ukuhluleka kokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ze-SITA kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Ukungahambisani phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene kuholela ekungasebenzi kahle. 4. Ukungahambisani Nezidingo Zomphakathi: Uma izinhlelo zingahambisani nezidingo zomphakathi, umphakathi ungase ungathokoziswa, okukhathaza kakhulu. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo ezithile: 1. Ukwakhiwa Kwezobuchwepheshe Obuphambili: Ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuthi zibe nezobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. 2. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi: Ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi ezisebenzisana nezinhlelo ze-SITA kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. 3. Ukuphathwa Okunembile: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuba ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kube nokuhleleka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. 4. Ukubambisana Nomphakathi: Ukuze izinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izidingo zomphakathi. Isiphetho Umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ubalulekile kakhulu ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo ze-SITA kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha ukwethembeka phakathi kukahulumeni nomphakathi, okubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni.
A.1 Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo nezinhlinzeko zoMthethosisekelo zisebenza kahle, bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi baphatheke futhi balandele lo Mthetho Wokuziphatha. A.2 Lo Mthetho uzoba umhlahlandlela kubasebenzi mayelana nezilindelo zokuziphatha kwabo ngokwethembeka kanye nobudlelwano abanabo nabanye abasebenzi. Ukuhambisana nalo Mthetho kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise izinga lobuchwepheshe endaweni yokusebenza futhi kusize ekuqinisekiseni ukwethenjwa nokuzigqaja eMnyangweni Wezokuthutha. A.3 Umsebenzi ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuzilawula nokulandela imithetho ebekwe yilo Mthetho. Ngokufanayo, abaphathi nabaphathi banelungelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi lo Mthetho uyalandelwa, futhi lokhu kufanele kwenzeke ngaphandle kokukhetha. A.4 Lo Mthetho Wokuziphatha awuhloselwe ukuvimbela ukukhula komsebenzi kodwa ukuvikela amalungelo eMnyango kanye nomsebenzi. B.1 Lo Mthetho ungezelelwa kuMthetho Wokuziphatha okukhulunywa ngawo esigabeni 2 soMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-2001, okukhuluma ngabo bonke abasebenzi boHulumeni. Kuye kwengezwa ukuthi ubhekana ngqo nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuthutha. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi koMthetho Wokuziphatha WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni, njengokutholakala kuMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-2001, lo Mthetho uzolandelwa. B.2 Kukhona isidingo sokufundisa abasebenzi mayelana nobudlelwano babo nomthetho, kanye nababusi bamandla ezepolitiki, abanye abasebenzi, nomphakathi, futhi kufanele bafundiswe umoya lapho abasebenzi kufanele basebenze, nokuthi yini okufanele bayenze ukuze bagweme ukungqubuzana nezithakazelo, nokuthi yini elindelwe kubo mayelana nezindlela zabo zomphakathi, ezimpilweni zabo zangasese nasekusebenzeni. B.3 Nakuba lo Mthetho Wokuziphatha ubhalwe ukuze uhlanganise konke, awuyona yonke imithetho elawula izindinganiso zokuziphatha. Nokho, uMphakathi-Jikelele, ngokuya ngamalungelo esigaba 7 (b) soMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-1994, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle kweMnyango nokugcina umthetho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza kube nokuqondana kwezindlela zokuziphatha kwabantu bakhe nezindinganiso ezilawula amahhovisi kaHulumeni kanye nezinqubomgomo ezifanele nezindlela ezishiwo kulo Mthetho. B.4 Inhloso enkulu yalo Mthetho ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzisi angatholakala enecala lokuziphatha kabi futhi abhekane nenqubo yokuthola isijeziso ngokuhambisana nezindlela zohulumeni uma izenzo zabo ziphikisana noMthetho Wokuziphatha noma uma kutholakala ukuthi baphule ezinye zezidingo zalo Mthetho. C.1.7 akuphuli noma iyiphi ingxenye yoMthetho Wokuziphatha obekwe kubasebenzi boHulumeni. C.2.11 ingaxhumana namalungu omphakathi ngolimi olusemthethweni inqobo nje uma kukhethwe ngumphakathi. C.2.14 akungavumeli ukubeka impilo yabanye noma eyabo engcupheni ngokungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha noma ngokuyigxeka. C3.17 akungavumeli ukuba babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphikisana eziphikisana nezindinganiso zokusebenza futhi ezingekho emthethweni. C.4.6 ingacela ukuthi ingabambiqhaza ezinqumweni noma ezinyathelweni ezisemthethweni emsebenzini uma lokhu kungabakhokhela inzuzo engafanele ngendlela engalungile, engakhethi, futhi ehlukanisayo. C 4.16 ezimeni eziphuthumayo ingacelwa uMphakathi-Head ukuba enze imisebenzi ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi, noma uma kungesikhathi esijwayelekile sokusebenza kodwa kuyisimo esingaphansi kokulawulwa kukaMphakathi-Head futhi sinezimo eziphuthumayo ezidinga isenzo esisheshayo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni. C.4.31 akungavumeli ukuphula umthetho ezindaweni zokwakha zikaHulumeni. C.5.3 akungavumeli ukusebenzisa isikhundla sabo emsebenzini ukuze bathole izipho nokukhwabanisa umphakathi nezinye izinzuzo futhi akungavumeli ukuthola noma yini uma kubonakala kuyiphoyisa. Zonke izipho kufanele zikhulunywe futhi zibhale kwi-rejista yezipho. C.6.1 ngezizathu zokuxhumana ngaphakathi, kufanele usebenzise isiNgisi njengolimi lokuxhumana futhi lokhu kufanele kubonakale kuzo zonke izenzo zomsebenzi ngaphakathi (okungukuthi, imibhalo, imihlangano, njll.). C 6.5 kufanele ahambisane nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana ngekhompyutha njengoba kuchaziwe. C.7.11 kufanele ukhuthaze isiko lokwethembana ngokuhlala wazisa futhi usekela. D.1. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi kahle uMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-2001, Isahluko II, uMthetho 108 ka-1994, mayelana nezinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuthola isijeziso emahhovisi kaHulumeni. Umkhakha Wokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi uzosiza abaphathi nabasebenzi ngezinhlelo zokwazisa kanye nezinto ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa kubasebenzi. E.1 Abaphathi kufanele bahlale bezama ukuvimbela ukuvela kokunganeliseki nezikhalazo mayelana nezinhlelo zokuphatha nezokuhola ezilungile. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhona inkinga edinga ukuxazululwa. Iplatifomu Yokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi izodlala indima yokwesekwa ngokwazisa abaphathi nabasebenzi ngamalungelo nezibopho zabo. F.1 Zonke imibhalo ephathelene nezinyathelo zokuthola isijeziso kufanele ibekwe esigabeni esiphethe ukuphathwa kwabantu, esizokuqinisekisa ukugcina kahle. F.2 Iplatifomu Yokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi izobhekelela ukugcina amarekhodi wezibalo nokubhaliswa kwemibiko ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni. F.3 IMnyango, abasebenzi bawo, kanye nezinyunyana kufanele zobopheleke ekugcineni nasekuthobeleni okuqukethwe kwalolu Mthetho Wokuziphatha.
Umbiko: Ubugebengu Emiphakathini Isingeniso Ubugebengu emiphakathini buye baba yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinga lobugebengu lihlala liphezulu. Le nkinga ithinta wonke umuntu, kungakhathalekile ukuthi ungubani, futhi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ukuze siqonde le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuba sihlole izimbangela, izindlela zokuqeda ubugebengu, kanye nezinyathelo zokubuyisela umphakathi ophilayo. Izimbangela Zobugebengu Emiphakathini Ubugebengu buvame ukuba nemvelaphi ehlukahlukene. Okwokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele kubangela abantu abaningi ukuba baphenduke ezindleleni eziphikisana nomthetho ukuze bazuze. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, ezifana nokungabi nalutho, ukungathembeki kwabantu, kanye nokungabi nokuhlala kahle, kukhuthaza ubugebengu. Okwesibili, imiphakathi enokungabi nalwazi nokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezifanele yokuphila kahle ivamise ukuba nenkinga yokukhula kobugebengu. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokufundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, imithetho, kanye nemiphumela yokuphula umthetho. Ukwanda Kwezindlela Zobugebengu Ngokuphambene, ubugebengu emiphakathini buyanda. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ububi bukhula ngezinga elikhulayo, kanti izigameko ezifana nokweba, ukuhlasela, nezidakamizwa zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kuthinta imindeni, abantwana, nabantu abadala, futhi kuholela ekubeni kube nezinkinga ezengeziwe ezifana nokungabi nempilo, ukuhlukunyezwa, nokukhathazeka. Izindlela zokuphila eziholela ekwandeni kobugebengu ziqukethe nezindlela zokuphathwa kwemali, izinhlelo zokuphila, nokutholakala kwezinsiza. Izikhungo zokuhlala eziphucuzekile, izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokuxhasa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi zidingeka ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobugebengu. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Umphakathi Ukuze kuphumelele ekulweni nobugebengu, kubalulekile ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlobene nezimfuno zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nabahlali. Izinhlelo ezifana nezifundo zokuphepha, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela izingane zingasiza kakhulu. Imiphakathi kufanele ibambisane neziphathimandla ukuze kwakhiwe izinhlelo zokuphepha ezihlukile ezifanele izidingo zabo. Imithetho kufanele ibekwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayazi kahle imithetho nemiphumela yokuphula le mithetho. Ukubuyisela Umphakathi Ophilayo Ukubuyisela umphakathi ophilayo kudinga ukuzimisela kwabantu bonke. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukwakha isithunzi somphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abangelwe ubugebengu. Izikhungo zokuxhaswa, ezokwelashwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlala kahle kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kuphumelelwe ekubuyiseni impilo emiphakathini ethintekayo. Abantu kufanele baziqhenye ngendawo abahlala kuyo, futhi kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizinda zomphakathi nezikhungo zomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukulwa nobugebengu. Isiphetho Ubugebengu emiphakathini buye baba yinkinga enkulu, kodwa ngezinqumo eziphusile nezinqubo ezinhle, singenza umehluko. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu, kusukela kubahlali kuya eziphathimandleni, abambisane ukuze kube nezinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokulwa nobugebengu. Ngokubambisana, singakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolondekile. Umphakathi onjalo ungaba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, ukuhlangana nokusebenza ndawonye kungaholela ezintweni ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siphakamise izwi lethu, siphakamise imiphakathi yethu, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlale bephila ngokuhambisana nemithetho yezwe. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sibe nomoya wokubambisana, uthando, nokwazisa omunye nomunye. Ngaleso sikhathi, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi obumbene, ophilayo futhi ophumelelayo.
Kunabantu abakhulayo abakhiqizayo kahle kwezolimo kodwa abangafundile - bathola ulwazi ngokubuka nokuhlangenwe nakho ngoba bathanda ezolimo. Ezolimo kuyimpilo yabo. Ezolimo kuyubuciko, kuyisayensi, kuyindlela yokuphila. Ezolimo, kufanele kube nethemba nokukholwa - izinto eziningi azikho ezandleni zakho ngoba ulima ngaphandle futhi isimo sezulu asiqinisekile. Isayensi yezolimo ithuthuke - kukhona ulwazi oluningi ngemininingwane emincane yezindlela zokulima. Kufanele ufune usizo nolwazi kulabo abafundile ngoba ungumkhiqizi emapulazini. Ngokwesibonelo, ukuhlola amasampula omhlabathi kudinga ulwazi lobuchwepheshe. Awudingi ukwenza lowo msebenzi wokuhlola uqobo - udinga nje ukuthatha amasampula njalo, uwahlola, futhi ulalele lokho okukhuluma lowo muntu ofundile onokwethenjelwa. Sebenzisa umanyolo ngokuya ngomyalezo owutholayo mayelana nezitshalo zakho. Sicela uqiniseke futhi uthole umyalezo omuhle futhi usebenzise lowo myalezo ngendlela efanele - kodwa khumbula, amehlo akho nolwazi oluthola ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kuzokwazi ukukusiza ufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle. Thatha wonke amathuba okufunda nokuzilolonga nalabo abafundile nabanolwazi. Awukwazi ukufunda ezolimo kuphela encwadini; thola umuntu onolwazi olugcwele. Kufanele uhlanganise ulwazi lwakho mayelana nokufunda ngenkathi usafuna ukuqhubeka nokufunda - sebenzisa amatafula alandelayo kodwa ungakhathazeki kakhulu uma ungahambanga esikoleni. Isifundo sesikole sodwa asizokwazi ukukusiza uphumelele kwezolimo.
Isahluko 1: Ukuzalwa KwamaQhawe Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-18, emzini omncane waseKorsika, kwavela umfana ogama lakhe linguNapoleon Buonaparte. Ngesikhathi ethokozisa imindeni, wayefana nomntwana ophumelelayo, kodwa izinkanyezi zazikhanya phezulu, zikhuluma ngezinto ezinkulu ezazimlindile. UNapoleon wayenothando lwezombusazwe nempi, okwaholela ekubhaliseni kwakhe esikoleni esiphakeme eFrance. Isahluko 2: Ukufunda Namasu Napoleon wayephumelela ezifundweni, ikakhulukazi ezempi. Wafunda izindlela zokuhlela, nokuhlela kahle, eqonda ukuthi izimpi zidinga amasu amakhulu. Njengoba edlulela phambili, waqala ukujula ezindleleni zokugcina izinkanyezi zishintsha. U-Joseph, umfowabo, wamsiza ukuba athole ithuba kumasosha, futhi uNapoleon waba ngumholi ophakeme ngenxa yokuhlonishwa kwakhe. Isahluko 3: Ubuqhawe Nempumelelo Ngemva kokubamba iqhaza empini, uNapoleon wathola ithuba lokuhola. Waba yisikhulu esiphakeme, ethola impumelelo enkulu ezimpini. Waziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe e-Italy, lapho wahlasela khona izitha zakhe wathola izinqola eziningi. Wenze imisebenzi emikhulu yokwenza ubuhlakani bezempi, futhi wathola udumo olukhulu. Isahluko 4: Ukuqhamuka Kwezwe Njengoba esanda ukukhula, uNapoleon wathola ukuthi akafuni ukuba ngumholi wezempi kuphela, kodwa wayefisa ukuba ngumholi wezombusazwe. Wavula izinhlelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa uMthetho weNapoleon, owawukhuluma ngamalungelo abantu. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba nemiphumela emihle, kodwa lwaluphinde lwaba nezinkinga njengoba abanye bezama ukumkhinyabeza. Isahluko 5: Ukuphumelela Nokuqedwa Ubusuku bukhanya ngezinkanyezi, kodwa uNapoleon wathola ukuba nezinqumo ezinzima. Waba umholi wesikhathi eside, kodwa ukuncintisana nezimbangi zakhe kwaba nzima. Kulapho uNjiniyela, umholi wezombusazwe, athola ithuba lokuphindisela. UNapoleon wahlaselwa kakhulu, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni akhishwe ezwenikazi. Isahluko 6: Ukuphila Ngemuva KweMpi Ngemuva kokuphelelwa kwezimfanelo, uNapoleon wathola ukuhlala kwiSikhumbuzo se-Exile, kodwa akazange ahlale phansi. Waphinda wahamba phambili, wakha izixhumanisi ezinzima, wabuyela kuFrance. Nokho, impi yakhe yokugcina, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Waterloo, yaphumelela. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni aphinde akhishwa, waze wafa eSt. Helena, lapho ahlala khona izinsuku zakhe zokugcina. Isahluko 7: Uhlanga Nemfundiso Ngemuva kokuhamba kukaNapoleon, kwasala imfundiso ebalulekile — ukuthi ubuholi bukhona, kodwa bukhona nemiphumela. UNapoleon Bonaparte akazange aphumule, kodwa izinyathelo zakhe zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni. Unomlando ophilayo, futhi izifundo zempilo yakhe ziqhubeka zifundiswa, zikhuluma ngezikhathi zethu namuhla. Ngakho, uNapoleon Bonaparte ungumholi okhumbulekayo, owafundisa umhlaba ngezindlela zokuphatha, ukulwa, nokuphila. Ubuqhawe bakhe bahlale bukhona, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo yakhe zihlala zikhanya, zikhumbuza bonke ukuthi ubuholi buveza amandla amakhulu, kodwa bukhombisa futhi izinselelo ezihambisana nempumelelo.
Intuthuko Ecaleni Lokushushiswa KukaJacob Zuma Ngasese Kuyajabulisa ukubona intuthuko ethile ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma, owake waba nguMengameli weNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kushushiswa, okungavumelekile, kubonisa ubuhlakani obuphakeme kanye neqhaza elikhulu elithathwe abezindaba, izinhlangano zamalungelo abantu, kanye nezakhamuzi ezijulile ezithintekayo. Kodwa-ke, kudinga ukuthi siqonde kahle izimpikiswano ezizungezile le ndaba. UJacob Zuma, owaziwa ngamaqhaza akhe afana nohlelo lwezokuhlaliswa okwakuhamba phambili, uphakathi kokucwaningwa ngesigameko esidlule. Abantu abaningi baye baba nemibono ephikisanayo ngalesi simo. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kushushiswa kuyingxenye yesikhumbuzo sokuthi uZuma, njengomholi, uphathiswe ngendlela engalungile, kanti abanye bathi lokhu kudinga ukuba kube sobala ukuze kuphumelele impilo yomphakathi. Ngokubheka emuva, kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi uZuma ubesebenza ezindabeni eziningi, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha, izinqumo ezinzima, kanye nokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi. Uhambo lwakhe olukhathazayo lwezobulungiswa lubonisa ukuthi akusikho ukusola kuphela, kodwa nokuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona zokulwa ne-corruption. Abantu bayathandazela ukuthi izinqumo ezenziwa ecaleni lakhe zibe nezinhloso ezinhle, futhi azisoze zaphuthelwa. Okunye okukhathazayo, wukuthi kulezi zinsuku zamuva, izinkantolo ziba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphathweni kwezobulungiswa. UZuma, ngoshintsho lwakhe, ungase abe nethonya elikhulu ekuphathweni komthetho. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo ezicacile futhi ezihlakaniphe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abezindaba, izikhungo zezemfundo, kanye nezakhamuzi zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ubulungiswa buza kuphela uma abantu bethi baphumelele. Ngakho-ke, intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaZuma ibalulekile, futhi kudinga ukuthi simemeze zonke izinyathelo ezenziwa. Kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu kuzoba yisibonelo sokuthi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungubani, noma ungumholi, kufanele uphathiswe ngendlela efanele. Noma ngabe uzama ukulwa nemigudu yokushushiswa, izinqumo ezithathwa kufanele zibe nemiphumela ecacile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezibekwe phambili kuzo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zithinta nempilo yomphakathi. Abantu bakhathazekile ngezinga lokungathembeki okuqhubekayo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nenqubo yokutakula. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubeka ingcindezi kumaphoyisa, ezinkantolo, kanye nasemphakathini, ukuze kubonakale ukuthi ubulungiswa bungenziwa ngezinga eliphakeme. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi uZuma uthole imikhuba eminingi ethinta izinqumo ezithathwa phambili. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abantu bahlala begcizelela ukuthi kungekudala bazothola ukuthi kunjani empilweni. UZuma, njengomholi, udinga ukuba abe neqhaza lokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokuthi usemthethweni, kodwa ngoba abantu banethemba kuye. Ngaphandle kokuphikisana, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo ezenziwa ecaleni lakhe zikhumbula izidingo zomphakathi. Ekupheleni kosuku, abezindaba, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezakhamuzi zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubulungiswa busebenze ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ayigcini nje ngokuba yindaba ethokozisayo, kodwa iyisifundo esibalulekile sokuthi ubulungiswa obuphelele buphethwe ngezinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqumo ezicacile, ezihlakaniphile, futhi eziphefumulayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bethu bayakwazi ukuphila impilo enobulungiswa, futhi baphile ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, kufanele siqhubeke sikhalela, sithumele imiyalezo yokuthi ubulungiswa buqhubeke, futhi sithumele umyalezo wokuthi akekho ophunyukayo. Ukushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma kufanele kube yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umthetho uyiNhloko yempilo yethu, futhi kufanele sibe neqiniso eliqinile lokuthi ubulungiswa buyaphumelela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqumo eziphusile, ezihloniphekile, futhi ezilungile, ukuze sonke sihlale sithokozile ngezimpilo zethu.
Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwabavoti Nentando Yeningi Ezweni lethu, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni intando yeningi. Lokhu kusebenza njengesisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho izwi lalabo abavota lihlala libalulekile. Ngaphandle kokubamba iqhaza, intando yeningi ingaba yiphupho elingenakufeza izinjongo zalo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze bonke abantu, ikakhulukazi abasebasha, ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezinqubweni zokhetho. Ngokwengqondo, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti akugcini nje ngokukhetha abameleli. Kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baqonde ukuthi izinqumo zabo zineqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabo nasemphakathini. Izinqumo ezithathwayo emaphandleni, ezindaweni zokusebenza, nasemiphakathini zikhombisa indlela esiphila ngayo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nomqondo ophusile. Uma abantu bebona ukuthi izinqumo zabo zibalulekile, bazoba nesifiso sokubamba iqhaza. Ikakhulukazi, uma sikhuluma ngentando yeningi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukukhetha phakathi kwabantu abaneziqu zokuhola, kodwa futhi nokuba neqhaza ezinqumweni ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuthaza, ukwenza izinkulumo, nokubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, abavoti bangaba nesandla ekwakheni izinqumo ezithinta izimpilo zabo. Ukwengeza, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngendima yezokuxhumana. Namuhla, izinkundla zokuxhumana zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umbono wabantu. Abavoti bangasebenzisa lezi zinkundla ukuze bathumele imicabango yabo, babuze imibuzo, futhi bakhulume ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi banganikeza impendulo, futhi lokhu kungakhuthaza ukuba babambe iqhaza ekukhetheni. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona konke okuhle. Ukuze sibe nentando yeningi eqinile, kudinga ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwabavoti, abameleli, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze lezi zinkundla zisebenze, kufanele kube nezindlela zokuxhumana ezivulekile, lapho abantu bezwa khona ukuthi izwi labo libalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abameleli baphendule futhi baphathe kahle izikhalazo zabavoti. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngobulungiswa bokhetho. Ukuze abantu bakhuthazwe ukuba bavote, kufanele kube nezimo ezilungile zokhetho. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuvota, ngaphandle kokuthola izithiyo. Ukuze sibe nentando yeningi eqinile, kufanele sikhuthaze izinqumo ezilungile ezithinta ukhetho, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphathe izinqumo zabo njengomsebenzi obalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngempumelelo yokubamba iqhaza kwabavoti. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ekukhetheni abameleli, kodwa futhi ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Uma abantu bebamba iqhaza, bazoba nesifiso sokwenza izinguquko ezinhle. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bezwa khona ukuthi banganikeza umbono, futhi lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabavoti nabameleli. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi intando yeningi iyinto ephilayo. Akukhona nje ukuthi abantu bavote, kodwa kufanele baphinde babe nesifiso sokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphathe izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezindlela ezilula zokubamba iqhaza. Uma sikwazi ukuhlanganisa abantu, sizokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho intando yeningi ibalulekile. Ekugcineni, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti nentando yeningi akuyona nje indaba yokhetho, kodwa kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Uma abantu bebamba iqhaza, bazoba nesandla ekwakheni ikusasa labo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bazi ukuthi izwi labo libalulekile, futhi kube nezindlela ezilula zokubamba iqhaza. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho intando yeningi ibalulekile, futhi abantu bezwa ukuthi banganikeza umbono. Lokhu kuyisifiso esibalulekile, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze bonke abantu ukuba babe nesandla ekwakheni ikusasa elihle.
UMangosuthu Buthelezi: Umlando Nomthelela Wakwakhe UMangosuthu Buthelezi ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Uzalwe ngomhla ziyi-27 kuNhlangulana ngo-1928 eBabanango, eKwaZulu-Natal. UButhelezi uphumelele kakhulu emkhakheni wezombusazwe, waba ngumholi weqembu le-Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP) futhi waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni isimo sezombusazwe esikhona namuhla. Umlando Nokukhula UButhelezi wakhulela emndenini wezobukhosi, njengoba uyindodana kaNkosi uMathole Buthelezi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wathola ithuba lokufunda e-United Kingdom, lapho aqhubeka khona nezifundo zezeMpi nezeZombusazwe. Ubuye waba ngumfundi ophumelelayo eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abaholi bezombusazwe abanjengoNelson Mandela noOliver Tambo. Ipolitiki Nezombusazwe UButhelezi waba umholi we-IFP ngonyaka ka-1975, futhi waqala ukulwa ngokumelene nezinhlelo zokubusa ezaziphakanyiswa nguMkhonto weSizwe, inhlangano ye-ANC. UButhelezi wagxila ekwakheni umphakathi ohlukanisayo, owawuhlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu baseZulwini. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni umthetho we-Black Consciousness Movement, owawuhlose ukwakha ukuzethemba phakathi kwabantu abamnyama. Ukwamukela Izinguquko Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-apartheid, uButhelezi wanikela ngempumelelo ekwakheni izivumelwano zokuthula phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC. Waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umthethosisekelo wezwe, futhi waba nguNgqongqoshe wokuqala wezasekhaya. UButhelezi waqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu baseZulu ayavikelwa, futhi waphinde waba nesandla ekwakheni uhulumeni wezwe. Umthelela Womphakathi UButhelezi ungumholi onemibono ehlukene, futhi ubonakale esebenza ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezahlukene, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ezinjengokwakha izikhungo zemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuthutha. UButhelezi ubelokhu eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazibandakanye ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma kunjalo, uButhelezi ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi emlandweni wakhe. Ubuye waba neqhaza ezinkingeni zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC, lapho kwavela khona ukungaboni ngaso linye. Lokhu kwaholela ezimpini ezinzima, ezashiya umphakathi unokuhlukana. Nokho, uButhelezi ubelokhu ezama ukuthola izixazululo, futhi ubelokhu esebenzisa izinkulumo zokuthula ukuze ahlukanise abantu. Isiphetho UMangosuthu Buthelezi ungumholi onemibono ehlukene, ohlonishwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezombusazwe, kanye nemizamo yakhe yokwakha umphakathi, kuhlonishwa ngababukeli abaningi. Noma kunezinkinga ezibhekene naye, uButhelezi ubonakala engumholi onomthelela omkhulu, futhi imisebenzi yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika iqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa, umbono kaButhelezi uzohlala unomthelela, futhi uzofundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngokuqhubeka kokubambisana nokwakha umphakathi onobumbano.
Umbiko Ngempi YaseSandlwana Isingeniso Impi yaseSandlwana, eyenzeka ngomhla zingu-22 kuNhlangulana ka-1879, ibalulekile emlandweni wezimpi zempucuko phakathi kwezakhamuzi zendabuko zaseNingizimu Afrika neBritish Empire. Le mpi yahlasela izwe laseZulu, lapho izimpi zenzeka phakathi kweZulus nezamasosha aseBrithani, futhi yaveza ubucayi besimo sezombusazwe nendawo ngesikhathi salo. Isizathu Senhlangano Ngonyaka ka-1879, iBrithani yayihlongoza ukuba ithathe ukulawula izwe laseZulu, eyayiyingxenye yeNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, iBritish Empire yayidinga ukuhlela imikhankaso yokuzama ukucisha izinsika zempucuko yaseZulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezimpi eziningi, phakathi kwazo iMpi yaseSandlwana. Iziphathamandla zaseBrithani zabulala izinsika zomphakathi waseZulu, zikhumbula ubuchwepheshe bezempi obuphucuziwe nezinsiza ezitholakale kalula, kodwa bezilokhu zingaziqondi kahle amandla nezinsiza zabo. Ukuhlangana Kwezempi Ngaleso sikhathi, izimpi zempucuko zazingasaphumuli, kanti abaholi beZulu, uShaka Zulu, noCetshwayo, babephakathi kokuvikela izwe labo. IZulu lwaluwina impi eziningi, kodwa izinsiza zempucuko zikaBrithani zaziqina. Ngemva kokuhlela, uMpande noCetshwayo bangaphambi kwezinsiza zezempi zeBrithani, okuyinto eyavumela izinsiza zabo ukuba zihleleke kahle kumasosha. Ukusebenza Kwamabutho KuSuku lweMpi, amabutho eBrithani anemikhankaso emikhulu, kodwa imibono yabo yokuhlasela yahluleka. Amathuba okuthi abanye baswele, kanti abalwela izwe labo babenokuthula. Ibhuloho lemidlalwano livumela izinkanyezi zeZulu ukuba zibambisane nezinsiza zempucuko zikaBrithani. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izinkanyezi zeZulu ziqhubele phambili, futhi kwagcina ukuthi iBrithani iyacasuka. Ukwenza Kwezombusazwe Impi yaseSandlwana yahlula umkhankaso wezombusazwe, njengoba izinsiza zeZulu zaphumelela, zaphinde zathola umphumela omuhle. Le mpi yaphenduka uphawu lomkhankaso weZulus wokuvikela izwe labo, lapho ukulwa kwabo kwaqinisekisa ukugcina isithunzi sabo. Ukuphela kweMpi yaseSandlwana kwavula umnyango wokubona izinsiza zomphakathi nezombangazwe. Ukuncipha Kwamandla eBrithani Ngemva kokuhluleka eSandlwana, ukuncipha kwamandla eBrithani kwavela. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni bakhumbule ukwehluleka kwabo. Imiphumela yale mpi yayiyinhloko, ikakhulukazi emlandweni wokulawula amabhande eZulus. Uhlelo lwezombusazwe lwaphinde lwazama ukuvuleka, kodwa izinsiza zempucuko zazingakabi nempumelelo. Isiphetho Ngaphezu kokuba impi yaseSandlwana ibalulekile emlandweni, ifundisa ngezifundo eziningi mayelana namandla, ukungabi naziphakamiso, nobucayi bezombusazwe. Iziphathamandla zeBrithani zifunde ukuthi ukungabazi nokungabi nezinhloso ezinhle kungaholela ekulahlekeni. Izifundo zempucuko zabalulekile ezinkampanini zanamuhla, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi amandla angavela kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa imikhankaso yokuhlola ibalulekile ukuze kuzuze umphakathi. Izinhloso zempucuko, izifundo, nemiphumela yeMpi yaseSandlwana zihlala zikhumbuleka, futhi zenza umphakathi uqonde ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwezakhamuzi nezinsiza zomhlaba kufanele buhlale buhlonipha izimpawu zomlando. Umphakathi waseZulu, nakuba ubuhlungu, uhlala ubalulekile emlandweni, futhi impi yaseSandlwana iyinsika yokukhumbula.
Izikhukhula ZaseKZN Ingxoxo noMnu. Nkosi Zulu, umphakathi wezokuhlaliswa kwezakhamuzi eThekwini Umbhali: Sanibonani, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuthatha isikhathi sokukhuluma nathi mayelana nezikhukhula ezikhathini zakamuva eKwaZulu-Natali. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithole umbono wakho njengoba uhlala kule ndawo. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukusiza. Izikhukhula ziningi kakhulu eKZN, futhi zishayisa kakhulu abantu bendawo. Umbhali: Ungangitshela ukuthi zenzeka kanjani lezi zikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, izikhukhula zenzeka kakhulu emakhazeni, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezikhathi zokuna kwemvula. Lokhu kubangelwa ukungakwazi kwezimvula eziningi ukwakha, futhi umhlaba awukwazi ukuwathwala amanzi. Lokhu kuholela emifuleni nasezindaweni ezimboze abantu. Umbhali: Kukhona yini imiphumela ethile esibonakalayo emphakathini? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, imiphumela iyahluka. Abantu bayalahlekelwa yizinto zabo, izindlu, nezimpahla. Abanye baphinde babe nezinkinga zezempilo, njengezifo ezithathelwanayo ngenxa yokuhlangana kwamanzi angcolile. Lokhu kudala umonakalo omkhulu emphakathini. Umbhali: Ngabe umphakathi uthola kanjani usizo emuva kwezikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Ngemuva kwezikhukhula, izinhlelo zokusiza ziqala. Uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nemiphakathi yemfundo, bayahlanganyela. Kukhona ukusiza ngezimali, ukudla, nemishini yokwakha. Nokho, izithiyo eziningi zikhona, ezinjengokungabi namathuba afanele. Umbhali: Ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zanele? Mnu. Zulu: Cha, ngicabanga ukuthi zidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Kudingeka izinhlelo zokwakha ezinhle, izindlela zokuphuma, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Uhlelo lokusiza abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezibuthakathaka luyadingeka. Umbhali: Uthini umbono wakho mayelana nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo wezikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kakhulu. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela kahle, singasebenzisa amamephu edijithali ukuze sithole izindawo ezibuthakathaka. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze sikwazi ukwazisa abantu ngezimo ezimbi. Lokhu kuzogcina abantu bephephile. Umbhali: Njengomphakathi, yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayavikeleka ezikhukhuleni? Mnu. Zulu: Umphakathi kufanele ube nekhono lokuzivikela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu indlela yokuphuma ezindaweni ezibuthakathaka, ukwakha izikhungo zokuphila eziphephile, nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile mayelana nezindawo ezibuthakathaka. Umbhali: Kungani kubaluleke kangaka ukuxhumana nezinye izindawo ukuze kudaleke izixazululo eziphumelelayo? Mnu. Zulu: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Uma sabelana ngolwazi nolwazi, singafunda kokunye okwenzekile kwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo ezizophumelela. Umbhali: Ngabe unayo imikhokhelo ethile kumphakathi mayelana nezikhukhula? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ngincoma abantu ukuba bahlanganyele ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuzivikela. Bafundise ukuthi bahlale beqaphele izimo zezulu, baqonde izinhlelo zokuphuma, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala behlola izindawo zabo. Umbhali: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ngikufisela inhlanhla emisebenzini yakho yokusiza umphakathi. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, futhi ngiyabonga ngokuhlinzeka ithuba lokukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esibucayi. Nakanjani sizobambisana ukuze siphumelele. Umbhali: Ngiyavuma, kumele sihlanganyele ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngiyabonga! Le ngxoxo ibonisa ubunzima obubhekene nomphakathi waseKZN ngenxa yezikhukhula, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuhlaliswa kahle kwezakhamuzi. Ukuhlonishwa kwezimvo zomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kudaleke izixazululo eziphumelelayo.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: UProf. Thandiwe Ntuli UProf. Thandiwe Ntuli ungumholi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezempilo nenhlalakahle, obonakalisa ubuholi bakhe obuqinile emiphakathini ehlukahlukene. Uthole ukuqashelwa kwezifundo zakhe ezikhethekile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokwelapha, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, ubuholi bakhe bokwenza imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Umlando Nokufunda UThandiwe wazalelwa eThekwini, lapho akhulela khona emndenini ophumelelayo. Wafunda ezikoleni eziphakeme, lapho akwazi khona ukubonisa amakhono akhe ezempilo kusenesikhathi. Ngemuva kokuphothula iBachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB) eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uqhubeke nezifundo zakhe ngokuqhubeka neMaster’s degree kwezempilo yomphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe olandelayo, owawuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezithile, wambona eqala ukuthola izinkanyezi emkhakheni wakhe. Umsebenzi Wokusebenza UProf. Ntuli uqale umsebenzi wakhe njengodokotela emtholampilo eThekwini, lapho abhekana khona nezinkinga ezinzima, njengezifo ezithathelwanayo kanye nezifo ezihlobene nokuphila kahle. Ubuye wagxila ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphila, ezagcina ziqinisa impilo yabantu ezindaweni ezisengozini. Ngaleso sikhathi, waqala ukubona uhlelo olukhulu lwenhlalakahle olubalulekile, olwakha izikhungo zempilo ezithuthukile. Ukwenziwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Impilo Ukwazisa umsebenzi wakhe, uThandiwe waqala ukuqala imicimbi ethinta impilo yomphakathi, efaka phakathi izinhlelo zokweluleka, izinsiza zokwakha imiphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ngempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zashintsha impilo yemindeni eminingi, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bazinakekele, futhi ziqinisa imiphakathi. Umsebenzi wakhe ungumfanekiso weqiniso wokuthi imicimbi yezempilo ayigcini nje ngezixazululo zokwelapha, kodwa iyahlanganisa futhi nezindlela zokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ukwamukelwa Nezikhumbuzo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uProf. Ntuli wathola izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise neNational Health Service Award, ezithokozisa kakhulu imizamo yakhe. Ubuye waba umxhumanisi omkhulu phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo nezinhlangano ezizimele, eqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zifinyelela kulabo abazidingayo. Imicimbi Yezempilo Nezokwelapha UProf. Ntuli ungasoloko athola imicimbi emisha, efaka phakathi izinsuku zokuhlonipha impilo, lapho abamba khona izifundo ezihlobene nemikhuba emihle yokuphila. Lezi zinsuku zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile kahle, zigqugquzela imiphakathi ukuba ibambisane ekwakheni izimo ezingcono zokuphila. Ubuye abambe imihlangano yokufundisa, lapho abaholi bendawo befundiswa ngempumelelo yokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zempilo. Imiphumela Nalokho Okuzayo Ngaphandle kwamazinga aphezulu okuphumelela, uProf. Ntuli uhlala ebheka phambili. Ubelokhu esebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi imiphakathi ithola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Uthi: “Umsebenzi wami awupheli lapha. Ngihlose ukuhamba phambili, ngithuthukise amakhono ezempilo, futhi ngisize abanye ukuba baphile impilo engcono.” Ubuye wanikela ngengxoxo ezinkulu ezithinta izinhlelo zomphakathi, eqinisekisa ukuthi imicimbi yakhe iqhubeka nokwenza umehluko. Isiphetho UProf. Thandiwe Ntuli ungumfanekiso ohloniphekile weqiniso lesimiso sokubaluleka kwempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi. Ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, nokwakha imiphakathi, uThandiwe uqhubeka nokwakha umhlaba ongcono. Igama lakhe libuye libe yinsika yokukhuthaza abanye abaholi ukuze baqhubeke nezinhlelo ezenzakalayo zokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, kuphumelele imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle. Njengoba eqhubeka, uProf. Ntuli uzoba yisibonelo sokuphila kahle, esikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile ngendlela efanele.
Ukuphila Emadolobheni Ukuphila emadolobheni kuyinto ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi kunobunzima obuthile. Amadolobha ayizikhungo ezinkulu zokuhlala, umsebenzi, nezokuxhumana, futhi zinezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa zibuye zibe nezinselelo. Kulokhu, sizobheka izici ezahlukene zokuphila emadolobheni, kuhlanganise nezinto ezinhle, izinkinga, nezindlela zokuphila ezithuthukile. Izici Ezinhle Zokuphila Emadolobheni Okokuqala, amadolobha anikeza amathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezinkampani ezinkulu, amadolobha avame ukuba nezimboni ezahlukene, ezihlinzeka ngokuqashwa kwabantu abanemikhakha ehlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abaningi bangathola imisebenzi efanele izifundo zabo, futhi lokhu kudala umnotho ophilayo. Okwesibili, amadolobha anikeza ukufinyelela okulula ezinsizeni. Izikhungo zezempilo, izikole, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa zikhona eduze, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhamba. Lokhu kukhulisa izinga lempilo, njengoba abantu bengadingi ukuhamba kude ukuze bathole lezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amadolobha avame ukuba nezindawo zokudla ezihlukahlukene, okuvumela abantu ukuba bazame ukudla okuvela ezizindeni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Okwesithathu, ukuphila emadolobheni kuvumela abantu ukuba bahlanganyele ezindabeni zomphakathi. Amadolobha avame ukuba nezinhlelo eziningi zokuhlanganyela, ezifana nemicimbi yokuzijabulisa, imicimbi yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, nezinhlelo zokufundisa. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Izinkinga Zokuphila Emadolobheni Nokho, ukuphila emadolobheni akukhululekile. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhala lokuhlala. Amadolobha amaningi abhekene nenkinga yokuntuleka kwezindlu, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuthola indawo yokuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuhlala, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaphakathi nendawo ukuhlela izimali zabo. Enye inkinga enkulu yizinkinga zokuhamba. Ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu, izindlela zokuhamba zihlala zigcwele, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuhamba, okungaholela ekudambiseni izinga lempilo. Abantu bahlushwa yizinkinga zokuhamba, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokucindezeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amadolobha avame ukuba nezinkinga zokuphepha. Ukukhula kwabantu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lobugebengu, okwenza abantu bezwe bengaphephile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphile, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka. Izindlela Zokuphila Ezithuthukile Ukuze abantu baphile kahle emadolobheni, kudingeka izindlela zokuphila ezithuthukile. Okokuqala, abantu kufanele bafunde ukuhlela kahle izimali zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bazi ukuthi bangakusebenzisa kanjani kahle imali yabo ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izindleko zokuhlala, zokuhamba, nezokudla. Ukuhlela kahle izimali kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuntuleka kwemali. Okwesibili, abantu kufanele baphile impilo enempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bephila kahle, baphuze amanzi anele, badle ukudla okunempilo, futhi benze ukuzivocavoca. Ukuphila impilo enempilo kuzobasiza ukuba baphile kahle, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuphila emadolobheni. Okwesithathu, abantu kufanele bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, baphinde baphathe kahle abanye. Ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo, futhi kuzokwenza abantu bazizwe bephila kahle. Isiphetho Ukuphila emadolobheni kunobuhle bayo, kodwa futhi kunezinselelo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde lezi zici ukuze bakwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngokuhlela kahle izimali, ukuphila impilo enempilo, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi, abantu bangakwazi ukujabulisa ukuphila kwabo emadolobheni. Ngakho, ukuphila emadolobheni kungaba yinto ethokozisayo uma abantu benza izinqumo ezifanele.
Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000 ("umthetho") wawusungulwa ngomhla kaMashi 9, 2001, ufeza ilungelo lesi simiso lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe ngamasimu omphakathi noma ezizimele uma kudingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, inhlangano ethunyelwe isicelo kuyo iphoqelekile ukuba inikeze lokho kulwazi ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ngokucacile ukuthi lokho kulwazi kufanele kukhishwe noma cha. Umthetho uphinde uhlele izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sithunyelwa. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukukhuthaza isiko lokucacisa nokubhekelela ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezohwebo Nezomnotho ("DTI") ngokufeza ilungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ukuze abantu noma izikhungo ezithile zingakusebenzisa futhi zivikela amalungelo azo. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana okungokoqobo nezikhungo zikamasipala, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ufundisiwe futhi unolwazi ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Ngendlela efaka leli lungelo eduze kwamanye amalungelo, ifaka amalungelo afana nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kwiSivumelwano. Ingxenye 14 yomthetho ibeka imfuneko yokuthi izikhungo zomphakathi zibhale idokhumenti yokusebenza, ezosiza abantu abafuna ulwazi oluthile kulowo mnyango, futhi ibeka izimfuneko okufanele zifezwe yilezi zedokhumenti. I-DTI ibike ukuthi izoqhubeka nokuzama ukusebenza ngokucacile futhi izohlinzeka ngolwazi emphakathini nasemabhizinisini ngokuqhubekayo ngeziphakamiso ze-DTI, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye nesikhungo sokubiza. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukuhlinzeka ummangali wolwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ngemininingwane yokuxhumana, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile kwi-DTI. Lo Mhlahlandlela uphinde uhlose ukuhlinzeka ummangali ngencazelo ecacile yesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye neziqondiso zolwazi lwe-DTI ukuze ummangali akwazi kalula ukuthola lapho ulwazi lutholakala khona. Lo mbhalo uphinde uhlanganise amafomu adingekayo kanye nezinkokhelo ezihambisana nezicelo zolwazi. Izinhloso ze-DTI ukuhola nokweseka uhlelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ngendlela ekhuthaza ukuhlala komnotho nokuvula amathuba emisebenzi kubo bonke abakha lo mnotho, ngokwandisa amazinga wokutshalwa kwezimali, kuthuthukiswa nokwandiswa kokuthunyelwa kwamikhiqizo yaseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe, nokwakha imakethe efanelekile nephikisanayo yemikhiqizo phakathi kwamabhizinisi endawo kanye namakhasimende aphesheya. Ngale ndlela, i-DTI isebenza ukuze ibeke umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika endaweni yokukhula nokuphumelela. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe umkhakha wokukhiqiza ohlanganisayo ophakamisa ukwandiswa kwamathuba okukhula komnotho okuzinzile kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze wandiswe futhi kuthuthukiswe isikali semakethe yokukhiqiza nezinsizakalo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kukhuthazwe amazinga aphezulu wokutshalwa kwezimali kwasekhaya nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuze kudaleke imakethe enezinketho, enezinga lokuncintisana lemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika kubo bonke abathengisi bendawo nakwamanye amazwe, kanye namakhasimende. Izikhungo zokweseka zinikeza usizo kumabhizinisi asebenzela ukusiza izigaba ezahlukene zomnyango. Izikhungo zokwenza imigomo zigxile ekwakheni izimo ezinhle ngaphansi komnotho. Izikhungo zokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zixhumanisa ngqo amabhizinisi namakhasimende ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Isikhungo sokumaketha siphatha ukumaketha kwemikhiqizo ye-DTI (izinhlelo nezinsiza) futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi endawo namakhasimende aqonda amalungelo awo omnotho. Ukuze kwandiswe ukuqwashisa nokufinyelela emikhiqizweni nasensizakalweni ye-DTI. Ulwazi lwezinkampani okungukuthi, umqondisi, abanikazi bezabelo, ikheli lenkampani, njll. Ukuphathwa Kwezezimali Nezinsiza Zomuntu okungukuthi Umthetho Wamabhizinisi 71 ka-1991: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuhoxisa nokulungisa ezinye izinqubo ezihlobene nokukhishwa kwemvume yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi, izikhathi zokuvula nezokuphela, nokwenza kube sobala ukuthi ukukhishwa kwemvume yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi kanye nokusebenza kwazo, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izindaba ezihlobene, zixazululwe. Umthetho Wokuncintisana 89 ka-1998: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula iKomidi Lokuncintisana elizophenya, lilawule, futhi lilungiselele inqubo yemigomo, izinqubo ezingafanele, kanye nezindlela zokuziphatha zamabhizinisi.
