Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lokuncintisana kuqondisiwe ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo ngalezi zindaba, kanye nokusungulwa kweNkantolo Yokubuyisela. Umthetho Wesibili Wokulungisa 39 ka-2000: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuhlela Umthetho Wokuncintisana ka-1998 ukuze kucaciswe amagama athile, kuguqulwe incazelo, futhi kususwe ezinye izincazelo. Umthetho Wokuvikela Abathengi 75 ka-1980: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuvikela abathengi abathenga imikhiqizo ngokuthengisa, ukuqashwa, noma ngezikweletu kanye nalabo abathola ezinye izinsizakalo ngezikweletu. Umthetho Wokutholakala Kwezimpahla Zasendaweni 89 ka-1970: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukunikeza amandla kuNgqongqoshe Wezomnotho ukuze akhiqize, athole, aqashe, noma athole izimpahla ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Umthetho Wokuhweba Nezinsizakalo 25 ka-1964: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula ukulawula ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo kanye nokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Zokuhlala Zokuthatha Umhlalaphansi 65 ka-1988: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuhlela ukudluliswa kwezindlu nezinye izindaba ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu zabathatha umhlalaphansi, kanye nokusungula ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokulawula Nezindinganiso Zokwakha Zikazwelonke 103 ka-1977: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuthuthukisa ukuvumelana nezinye izinqubo ezihlobene nokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezindaweni zomphakathi, kanye nokuchaza ukuthi yiziphi izindinganiso zokwakha okufanele zibe khona, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokugembula Kwamazwe 33 ka-1996: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula ukulawula nokulawulwa kwezindaba ezihlobene nezikhangiso zokugembula, futhi ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukiswe izindinganiso nezindlela ezivumelanayo ezilandelwa kuyo yonke iRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokusungula iBhodi Yokugembula Kwamazwe, nokubhekelela zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokugembula. Umthetho Wokulawula Izikhali 87 ka-1993: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula ukulawula zonke izikhali, nokusungula iBhodi ezolawula izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezikhali lezi eRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokuchaza izinhloso nemisebenzi yalezi zikhali, nokuchaza izindlela ezizolawulwa ngazo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokukhanda 9 ka-
Bangakwazi ukuqeqeshwa ukuze babe neqhaza lokweseka emaphoyiseni. Ukuze benze imisebenzi yokweseka emahhovisi kazwelonke, esifundazweni, endaweni, noma emahhovisi esiteshi, futhi ngeke benze imisebenzi ephelele yamaphoyisa, ngeke bagqoke ifomu lapho kudingeka khona, bangaqeqeshwa ezindaweni zomthetho, ezinqubomgomo, nezikhombisi ezisebenzayo emkhakheni abakhona noma ezihlobene nomsebenzi abawenzayo. Kumele babe nekhono elithile noma ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe olungasetshenziswa yinsizakalo yamaphoyisa, ngokwesibonelo, abaphayona, odokotela, abapholisa amanzi, abasebenzi bezokwelapha, noma abaphsychologists bazokwenza imisebenzi ethile endaweni yabo yolwazi lobuchwepheshe njengoba kuvunyelwe umphathi wabo, bagqoke ifomu lapho kudingeka khona, bangaqeqeshwa ezindaweni zomthetho, ezinqubomgomo, nezikhombisi ezisebenzayo emkhakheni abakhona noma ezihlobene nomsebenzi abawenzayo. Ukuze benze umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ophathelene nokupholisa ezindaweni zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni zasemakhaya emikhakheni ethile esiteshini, noma ukwenza imisebenzi echazwe emkhakheni wabo endaweni ethile njengoba kumisiwe umphathi, bangagqoka ifomu kuye ngokusetshenziswa kwabo, kumele baqeqeshwe emkhakheni ofanele wokupholisa noma/nomsebenzi wamaphoyisa ophathelene nemisebenzi yabo. Ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kungadingeka uma benza umsebenzi wamaphoyisa emikhakheni ehlukene yokupholisa. Umphakathi ophakathi nendawo uqokwa emkhakheni othile, futhi angadluliselwa kwenye emkhakheni ehambisanayo, ngokuhambisana nazo zonke izimfuneko zalowo mkhakha, futhi kumele adlule ekuqeqeshweni noma abe nesifiso sokuthola ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo kulowo mkhakha. Kumele benze ukuhlolwa noma ukuhlola, okwenziwe nguMphathi Wezizwe Wamaphoyisa, ukuze babe neziqu zesikole esiphakeme noma ezilinganayo, futhi banikeze ubufakazi bokuthi bakwazi ukukhuluma, ukubhala, nokufunda isiNgisi, njengolimi olwamukelwe ngokomthetho, kumele bavume ukuba kuthathwe izithupha zabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe futhi kumele bangabi ne-rekhodi yobugebengu noma babe ngabantu abanecala elisavivinywa, kumele babe nesifiso sokudlula ekuqeqeshweni futhi bathathe isifungo sokusebenza, kumele bangabi namathattoo abonakalayo; futhi kumele babe nelayisensi yokushayela, nakuba lokhu kungesiyo imfuneko eyinhloko yokuba umphakathi ophakathi nendawo. Nikeza ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yomsebenzi wakho wokuzazisa. Ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yelayisensi yakho yokushayela, uma unayo, amakhophi aqinisekisiwe wezifundo zakho. Umuntu owake waxoshwa emsebenzini ngenxa yokugula kwengqondo ungum member weNhlangano Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika ongeniswe isicelo sokubuyiselwa esiphumelele, umuntu ophakathi nendawo kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yezenkolo, umuntu ogcwele emsebenzini wezindaba noma omele izindaba, umfundi, umphakathi wezokuphepha, ummember wenhlangano yamaphoyisa omasipala. Uma utholakala ufanelekile, isicelo sakho sizovunywa nguMphathi Wendawo, futhi uzophinde uqinisekiswe. Awuvunyelwe ukwenza imisebenzi yamaphoyisa kuze kube sekupheleni kokuqeqeshwa kwakho. Ngemuva kwalokho, uzonikezwa isitifiketi esisemthethweni. Le nsizakalo iyamahala futhi ayikhokhelwa. Amafomu okucela awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lenkonzo eliseduze.
Isingeniso seCOVID-19 Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umhlaba uhlangabezana nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta impilo yabantu. Phakathi kwalezi zinguquko, iCOVID-19 ibe yisihloko esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele. Le nhlobo yeziqubu ibangele izinkinga eziningi, kubandakanya ukulahleka kwemindeni, izinkinga zezomnotho, kanye nemiphumela emibi empilweni yengqondo. Kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuthola ukuqonda okujulile ngezihloko ezihlobene neCOVID-19, okuhlanganisa ukubaluleka kokuvikeleka, ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nemiphumela yayo. Ukuhlukaniswa Kwezimvo Ukuze siqonde iCOVID-19 kahle, kufanele sihlole izindlela zokulawulwa kwayo. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukulawulwa kweCOVID-19 kudinga izinyathelo ezinzima, ezifana nokuhlukaniswa, ukuvalwa kwezindawo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthola umuthi. Lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa ukuzimisela, kodwa abanye abantu baphikisa, becabanga ukuthi zidalela ukucindezeleka nokuphazamiseka emisebenzini yabo. Nokho, abanye baphikisana nabo, beqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zibalulekile ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusabalala kweCOVID-19. Njengoba izibalo zikhombisa ukukhula kwezifo, abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukungazikhathaleli kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zempilo, futhi izinyathelo ezinzima zingasiza ekunciphiseni lezi zingozi. Izimpikiswano Zokulawulwa Enye yezimpikiswano ezisemqoka ngalesi sikhathi iwukuthi izinyathelo zokulawulwa kweCOVID-19 zixhasa impilo yomphakathi kangakanani. Abanye abantu baphikisa imithetho yokuhlukaniswa, ukuvalwa kwezindawo, kanye nezidingo zokuhlala ekhaya, ngokuthi lezi zinyathelo zibangela ukuwohloka emnothweni. Lokhu kudala ukungabaza phakathi kwababusi, abezindaba, kanye nezakhamizi. Umnotho unokuthuthuka uma abantu bejolise ekusebenzeni, kodwa ukuvalwa kwabo kungaholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuvimbela ukusabalala kweCOVID-19 kubalulekile, njengoba ukungabi nakunakekelwa kwezempilo kungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi. Ukwamukela Imithi Nezindlela Zokuvikela Ngokukhula kokuhlola, imithi ehlukene yeCOVID-19 ivelile. Lokhu kudala izinkulumo ezithokozisayo, njengoba imithi ethile ibonakala isebenza kahle. Nokho, lokho kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Ukuze abantu bathole imithi, kumele kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola, futhi abantu kumele bazi ukuthi le mithi ayiyona imithi yokwelapha, kodwa iyindlela yokuvikela. Kanjalo, ezinye izifundazwe zikhuthaza ukuphepha komphakathi, njengoba abantu beqala ukufunda ngalesi sifo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ukufundiswa kwabantu ngeCOVID-19 kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga ezihlobene nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Umthelela Wempilo Yengqondo I-COVID-19 ayithinti kuphela impilo yomzimba, kodwa futhi ithinta impilo yengqondo. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi abantu abaningi baphila nokucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nomqondo ophukile ngenxa yokuhlukana nezothando, ukungakwazi ukuhamba, nokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi iziphathimandla zifake izinhlelo zokusekela abantu abaphethwe yizinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Abantu kumele bakhumbule ukuthi akekho ophila ngaphansi kwemithetho engavunyelwe, futhi lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuba baphile kahle. Ukwakha izikhungo zokusekela nokuhlinzeka ngempilo yengqondo kwenza abantu bazizwe beqhamuka futhi bekhululekile, okubalulekile ukuze bathole imiphumela emihle. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iCOVID-19 ibonisa ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinyathelo ezicacile, ezihlanganisa izimvo ezihlukene. Abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukulawulwa kweCOVID-19 akuyona into elula, futhi izinqumo zidinga ukucabangela kahle. Ukuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi, kanye nokubona ukuthi impilo yomphakathi ibalulekile, kuyisihluthulelo sokubhekana nezinkinga ezithinta iCOVID-19. Ngokubambisana, singabhekana nezinkinga ezinzima, sisebenzisana ukuze sithole izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze impilo, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nokukhuluma ngalezi zindaba ukuze simise lesi sifo esinzima. I-COVID-19 ingathinta impilo yethu, kodwa ngokuhlanganyela, singaphumelela.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Entsheni Ingxoxo noMnu. Thabo Mthethwa, Ucwaningo Ngokusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Entsheni Umhleli: Sawubona, Mnu. Mthethwa. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuhamba nathi kule ngxoxo. Ngabe ungazichaza kancane izizathu ezibangela ukuthi intsha ibheke ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa? Mnu. Mthethwa: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Izizathu eziningi zikhona. Okokuqala, intsha ikhangwa kakhulu yempilo yokuphila, lapho izidakamizwa zibonakala njengezindlela zokuphila kahle, noma zokuthola injabulo. Abanye baphinde bazame ukuzithokozisa noma ukufihla izinkinga zabo, njengokucindezeleka noma ukunganeliseki empilweni. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izidakamizwa zikhona ezindaweni ezithile, noma zisetshenziswa kakhulu emiphakathini ethile? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, ngempela. Izidakamizwa zihlala zikhona ezindaweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba amancane. Intsha ethola ukungabi namsebenzi noma imfundo ibonakala ikhangwa kakhulu yizidakamizwa. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo omubi, lapho ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okuthola umsebenzi. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngabe ubona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwa ukuze kuphumelele ukulwa nale nkinga? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, izinyathelo zikhona. Izikhungo zokwelapha zikhona, futhi zisebenza kanzima ukuze ziqinise imikhankaso yokuvikela intsha. Imfundo ibalulekile, futhi izinhlelo zokwelapha ezihlanganisa ukuxhumana nabantu, ukuxhaswa, nokubuyiselwa emsebenzini ziyaqhubeka. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele. Umhleli: Ngabe ubona ukuthi imithombo yezokuxhumana idlala indima ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Mnu. Mthethwa: Impela, imithombo yezokuxhumana inendima enkulu. Intsha ibona izithombe zokuphila okukhazimulayo, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni bacabange ukuthi izidakamizwa zingaba yindlela yokuphila. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokufundisa intsha mayelana nemiphumela emibi yokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa. Umhleli: Ngabe kukhona izindlela ezithile zokufundisa intsha ngalezi zinkinga? Mnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, izindlela eziningi zikhona. Ukuhlela imicimbi yokufundisa, izifundo ezikhethekile ezikoleni, kanye nemikhankaso yokuxhumana nabantu kungasiza kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi intsha ibone ukuthi kunezindlela eziningi zokuphila ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izidakamizwa. Umhleli: Ngabe ubona ukuthi umphakathi ungawuthola kanjani umphumela omuhle kulolu hlelo? Mnu. Mthethwa: Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu. Ukuhlanganisa imizamo yokuxhasa intsha, ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi kungasiza kakhulu. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umhleli: Ngabe ungathanda ukwabelana ngeminye imibono yokugcina? Mnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa akuyona inkinga yomuntu oyedwa, kodwa kuyinkinga yomphakathi wonke. Sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Intsha iyigugu, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza lokuyivikela. Ngiyabonga. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokuxoxa. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngemicabango yakho. Mnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile.
Izimpi ZamaZulu Izimpi zamaZulu ziwumphakathi obalulekile emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, zibonisa ubuhlakani, ikhono lokuhlela, kanye nezindlela zokulwa ezazisetshenziswa nguShaka Zulu, umholi ophawulekayo. UShaka, owaqala ukuhamba phambili ngokuhlanganisa amaZulu aba yinqaba eqinile, wakha izimiso ezizoguqula isimo sangenxa yokulwa nezimpi eziningi. Izimpi zakho zabonisa ubuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, ezinjengokusebenzisa izikhali ezisemkhathini ezinjengezibhakela, amafa, nezinhlelo zokuhlola izindawo. Ngokwakhiwa kwenhlangano yamaZulu, uShaka washintsha imikhuba yokulwa, efaka phakathi ukuhlela izinqwaba zezinduna, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimpi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha okuvikelwa kwendawo yobukhosi, okugcina isithunzi somphakathi samaZulu sizinzile. Izimpi zathi ke, ziwela ezindaweni ezahlukene namazwe angomakhelwane, kuhlanganisa namasosha kaDingiswayo, umholi weNguni, kanye nezizwe ezikhalipha isikhathi samanje. Izimpi zamaZulu zikhombisa ukugcizelela esikhathini sekoloni, lapho izimpi ezinokusebenza khona zenzeka ngemva kwekhulu le-19. UShaka, ngokudlula, waya phambili nezempi ezinzima, ezihlanganisa neMpi Yezinsizwa ZamaNguni, eyenzeka phakathi kuka-1818 no-1828. Izinselelo ezahlukeneyo zempimpi zaveza ukubaluleka kokulawula izifunda ezivela ezinhlobonhlobo, okuholela ekutheni amaZulu abe nemithombo eyanele yokuphila. Emva kokuhamba kukaShaka, uDingane Zulu wathola impi yakhe, okuyimva yokulawula uMbuso wamaZulu. Lokhu kwaholela ezimpini ezenzeka phakathi kweZulu nabantu abahlala eduze, okwakuhambelana neMpi yeGubhuka ngonyaka ka-1838, lapho amaZulu ahluleka khona. Lokhu kwaqeda umkhankaso wenhlangano yamaZulu, futhi kwakha iziqhumane ezinzima zokuphazamiseka komphakathi. Umgwaqo wamaZulu washintsha kakhulu njengoba abanye abantu behamba phambili nemibono eyahlukahlukene yempi. UZulu, njengoba ungenela emezwe ahlukahlukene, waba nezenzo ezizwakalayo, ezagqugquzela amabhange amasha nezindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhlaziya izimpi zamaZulu kwenza kube sobala ukusebenza kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene nezithakazelo ezihlukahlukene emlandweni wempi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpi zamaZulu ziye zavela ekuthuthukiseni ulwazi lwezohwebo. Ukuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla zaphoqa ukuvuleka kwezindawo ezahlukene. Njengenhlangano, amaZulu avuleka emhlabeni wezohwebo, akha amacebo aphumelelayo okuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kwehlisa izikhala phakathi kwabantu, okwakukhuthaza ukuvela kokuxhumana okuhle emhlabeni. Ukwenza kube sobala, izimpi zamaZulu azizange zibe yinto eyodwa kuphela yokubuka emlandweni. Zihlanganisa izinselelo ezinzima, ubuchwepheshe bezenzo, nezinhlelo zempilo. Zigsilengisa ezinkathazweni zempilo ezikhona, njengoba abaholi beZulu behlongoza izinqumo ezahlukene mayelana nempilo, ubumfihlo, kanye neziqu ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, ukhuluma ngempilo kwamasiko namaZulu, izimpi zabonisa izinyathelo ezilondolozayo mayelana nomhlaba, ubuhlakani, namandla ezomkhuba. Ngakho, izimpi zamaZulu ziyisibonelo esihle somzabalazo, umoya wokuhlangana, kanye neqhaza lokuhlonipha abakhulu besizwe. Lezi zimpilo zempimpi, ezazithinta ngezindlela eziningi, zisafanele ukuthathwa njengokugqugquzela, imfundiso, nezifundo kumaphoyisa akhula nokuphuma phambili. Kungakhathalekile ukuthi imiphumela yaba mnyama noma emhlophe, ziye zashiya umphumela omkhulu emlandweni wokwakha isizwe, kokubili kube nsindiso nokuphila. Ngokuhlanganisa izifundo ezitholakala kulezi zimpimpi, umphakathi ungathuthukisa imiqondo emisha yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ezentsha: Ukubaluleka Kokubandakanya Intsha Ekuthuthukiseni Umphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intsha ibonakala iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Izingane zethu, abasha, nabantu abasha, bahlala bejolisa emiphakathini yabo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zindaba ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi intsha inezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inamathuba amaningi okwenza umehluko. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokubandakanya intsha ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi intsha ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukungasebenzi, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, zonke lezi zinto zenza kube nzima kubantu abasha ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi ube nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuxhasa intsha. Izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezokusebenza, nezokwelapha zidinga ukwakhiwa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi intsha iyakwazi ukuthola amathuba afanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha inezwi elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Izingxoxo ezivela kubantu abasha zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezinqubweni zokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinkundla ezivulekile zokuxoxa, lapho intsha ingakwazi ukwabelana ngemibono yabo. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kufanele sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza ezinqubweni zokuthuthukiswa. Ngokubandakanya intsha, sithola izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nezinkinga. Abantu abasha banamakhono amasha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nemibono emisha. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni ehlukene, njengezobuchwepheshe, ezemidlalo, nezokwakha. Uma sithatha isikhathi sokulalela intsha, sizokwazi ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ukubandakanya intsha ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokuzithandela. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwakha umphakathi, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza intsha ukuba ibonise ubuhlakani bayo. Ukuzibandakanya emisebenzini yokuzithandela kungasiza intsha ukuba ithole amakhono amasha, futhi ibenze babe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi intsha iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa. Uma sithatha isikhathi sokukhuluma nabantu abasha, sizokwazi ukuqonda izifiso zabo, izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezinto abazifunayo. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba sakhe izinhlelo ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zabo, futhi sithuthukise umphakathi wethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi intsha iyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Ukubandakanya intsha ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi akusizi kuphela intsha, kodwa futhi kusiza umphakathi wonke. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokubandakanya intsha, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Ekugcineni, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke intsha njengengxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Sidinga ukwakha izinkundla ezivulekile, sikhuthaze intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza, futhi sithathe izinyathelo zokuxhasa intsha. Uma sithatha lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolungele ikusasa. Intsha iyinsika yomphakathi, futhi kufanele siyihloniphe, siyixhase, futhi siyibandakanye. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono, futhi sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Izinsizakalo zokuhlenga zikhona ukuze zikusize abantu abakhubazekile bafinyelele ezingeni lapho bengasebenza khona ngendlela efinyelelekayo. Izinsizakalo zokuqala zokuhlela ziwusizo oluvimbela olwakha ikhono leklayenti lokuzimela. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokunakekela ekhaya, amaqembu okweseka, nokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuzimela, bakhuthaze, futhi babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuvikela nokukhuthaza. Ukuvuselelwa kwezinga lesibili kuyohlelo lokungenelela oluyisisekelo oluhlanganisa imikhankaso yokwenza imali nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukunciphisa ubuphofu, ukuthuthukisa izingane ezincane, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphumula ezikhathini zobunzima. Vakashela endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eduze noma esikhungweni sokuhlola, lapho uzothunyelwa khona endaweni yokuvuselela esibhedlela noma kwenye indawo yokuvuselela, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ikhethekile, yesibili, noma yesithathu. Kungathatha cishe izinyanga ezi-3 ukuxazulula isicelo sakho. Kwamanye amaphethelo, abantu baphakanyiswa ohlwini lokulinda okungafika ezinyangeni ezi-6. Kwamanye amacala, usizo luk 정부 lwabakhubazekile, olungafika ku-75%, luthathwa njengengxenye yezindleko. Ezinye izindleko zikhokhwa yizikhungo ngokwazo. Ezinye izikhungo zihlola izindleko ngokususelwa kulokho umndeni ongakukhokha. Zonke lezi zindleko zihluka ngephondo. Amafomu wesicelo adingeka ukuthi agcwaliswe ahlinzekwa yindawo yokuvuselela noma indawo yokunakekelwa kwezempilo yokuqala.
Uhlelo lokushintshanisa abafundi luyavunywa njengemvume enikezwa umfundi ongaphandle ofuna ukuthatha ingxenye kuphrojekthi ethile noma uhlelo. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lezakhamuzi noma emnyangweni waseNingizimu Afrika, oqinisekisa ukuthi le ndawo izobhekana nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nalowo mfundi ngenkathi ekhuluma eRiphabhulikhi futhi ukuthi umfundi uyamukelwa ukuze abhaliswe. Iqinisekisa usuku lapho uhlelo luzosungulwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isicelo singathatha izinsuku ezingu-30.
iMinecraft - Umcimbi Wokwakha Nokuqhamuka Ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, umphakathi we-Minecraft ubungcweti obukhulu emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Umcimbi omkhulu, owawubanjelwe emaphandleni asezintabeni, wathokozisa abathandi be-Minecraft abavela kuzo zonke izindawo. Umcimbi lo wawuhloselwe ukuhlanganisa abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, nokukhuthaza ubuhlakani bokudala. Kusukela ekuseni, izivakashi zafika zikhombisa injabulo, zibhakabhaka emhlabeni ogcwele izakhiwo ezihlukahlukene, ezakhiwe ngothando, ubuciko, kanye nesineke. Izindawo ezihlukene zazihlanganisa izindawo zokwakha, izinkundla zokudlala, nezindawo zokufundisa, lapho abanye befundisa abanye izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha. Umoya wokubambisana wawubhalwe emoyeni, njengoba abantu babelana ngemicabango, izindlela, nezinsiza zabo. Kwakukhona umncintiswano omkhulu wokwakha, lapho amaqembu ahlukene ahlukaniswe ngokwezinga lobuchwepheshe. Abadlali baphakanyiswa ukuthi bakhe izakhiwo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezindlini ezincane kuya ezakhiweni ezinkulu nezihlabahlosile. Umphakathi wawubukeka uzolile, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana wawukhanya kakhulu. Abadlali babekhuluma, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa abanye ngama-strategies abo, bejabulisa umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivakashi zazithola ithuba lokubona izinkanyezi eziphakeme, njengoba abanye bephusha imingcele yokwakha. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, izimanga ezidumile, nezithombe ezikhumbulekayo ezazithokozisa bonke. Umcimbi wawuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuzijabulisa, futhi abanye babebhalisela ukufunda izifundo ezithile zokwakha, ezazihlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kwezakhiwo. Izingqungquthela ezithile zaxoxwa ngempumelelo yokwakha, ezikhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uqhubeke nokwakha. Abafundi babenethuba lokuxhumana nabakhi abanolwazi, behlanganyela izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha, futhi benza ubuhlobo obusha. Umoya wokubambisana wawumangalisayo, njengoba abantu babelana ngemicabango, izindlela, nezinsiza zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wawuhamba kancane, kodwa umoya wokubambisana wawukhanya. Izivakashi zabe seziphakamisa izinkanyezi eziphezulu, zikhombisa ubuhlakani bokudala, nezindlela zokwakha ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi wawuhlangene, unomoya omuhle, futhi wawuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuzijabulisa, yokufunda, nokwakha. Ekugcineni, umcimbi we-Minecraft wawungaphezu kokwakha; wawuwumcimbi wokuhlanganyela, wokufunda, nokubambisana. Umphakathi wawuhlangene, umoya wokubambisana wawukhanya, futhi abathandi be-Minecraft baphumelele ekwakheni ubuhlobo obusha, bejabulisa umphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi umphakathi wawukhumbula izinsuku ezinhle ezazihlanganisa abantu abavela kuzo zonke izindawo, bejabulisa, befundisa, futhi bejabulela umhlaba we-Minecraft. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi we-Minecraft wawuhamba phambili, uhlanganisa abantu, uhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, futhi uhlanganisa izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Umoya wokwakha, wokubambisana, nokufunda wawukhanya, futhi umphakathi wawuhlangene, uzinikele ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono. Umcimbi wawungaphezu kokwakha izakhiwo; wawuwumcimbi wokwakha ubuhlobo, umoya, nokuhlanganyela. I-Minecraft, ngempela, iyindawo yokwakha, yokufunda, nokuhlanganyela, futhi umcimbi lo waba yisibonelo esihle salokho.
Imvelo yamanje ukuthi kune-28. Ngemva kokuhlangana kweMasingana ngo-2002, uMnyango weZobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi neTekhnoloji wakhuthazwa ukuba wethule isu leSizwe lokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa. Le nqubomgomo izoba yisihluthulelo ekukhuleni komnotho futhi ixhase ezinye izinqubomgomo ezifana neNqubomgomo Yokuthuthukiswa Kwabantu, iNqubomgomo Yezimboni Ezisebenzayo, kanye neNqubomgomo Yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika. Ukwehla okubonakalayo kokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe (isibonelo; ukugxila kakhulu ekuvikeleni nasekw independence kwezidingo zamandla) okwakuvamile kuhulumeni odlule phakathi kuka-1990 no-1994. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokuxhaswa kwehlelo lokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa kwazulu kusuka ku-1.1% ngo-1990 kuya ku-0.7% ngo-1994. Lokhu kwehla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uHlelo lweZinqubomgomo Ezintsha Zesizwe lwaludinga ukukhula ukuze lihlangabezane nezidingo zabantu abangu-40 million uma kuqhathaniswa nabantu abangu-6.5 million. Ukubhekana nezinkinga zesikhathi eside, ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu, ezomnotho nezokuphepha. Imibono efanele ephathelene nezifo ezintsha nezifo ezindala, noma lezi zifo zithinta abantu noma izilwane, kufanele iphathelwe ngezinhlelo zocwaningo zangakini. Uma sicabangela ukuphepha, ngisho nomthengi onolwazi ngotekhnoloji ekhona engakabi phezulu udinga abacwaningi abaningi abenza ucwaningo ezindaweni ezifanele. Izindaba zomsebenzi nabantu. Umkhakha wethu wabacwaningi nezobuchwepheshe awuphucukile kahle noma ngokwanele. Iningi labacwaningi abamhlophe, abesilisa, nabadala abahambeli phambili nabantu abasha ngendlela ebonisa isithombe esifanele sokuhlanganiswa kwabantu bezwe. Iziphakamiso ezilula zithonywa kakhulu yizinguquko ekubambisaneni kwamazwe omhlaba eziholela ekwehleni kwezinga lokutshalwa kwezimali nasemsebenzini wezimboni ezizimele zokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokulawula ngaphakathi kwesisekelo solwazi esibalulekile empumelelweni yezinkampani zethu ezincintisanayo. Imithetho efanele ephethe impahla yengqondo nezinsiza. Ukuthuthukiswa okusha kwezobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha kukhulise ingozi yokuhlukunyezwa kocwaningo emkhakheni wezokwelapha, kuyilapho izinqubomgomo zokucwaninga ezisekelwa uhulumeni zingavikelwe futhi zingaphathwa kahle. Izakhiwo zokwahlulela ezihlukanisiwe. Nakuba izikhungo zocwaningo zibuyekezwe futhi izinkomba eziyisisekelo zisetshenziswe, indima yezigaba ezithile zokwahlulela nokubeka izindinganiso ezilindelekile ezikhungweni zocwaningo zikahulumeni ayikacaci. Uma sibheka ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali, awekho umbono obanzi wokuchitha kukahulumeni kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe. Ukwakha uhlelo oluqinile lwezocwaningo nezobuchwepheshe lukahulumeni. Iphuzu lezi zinhlelo ezintsha liqukethe ukusungulwa nokutshalwa kwezimali ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zobuchwepheshe ezibalulekile ekukhuthazeni ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amapulatifomu amabili abalulekile ezobuchwepheshe esikhathini samanje, ahlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuthinta imithi nolwazi. Enye inisiative yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokukhiqiza nobuchwepheshe obwenza izinguquko ezinsizakalweni ezisuselwa emithonjeni noma ezisemvelweni. Ekugcineni, sizokwakha inisiative, ubuchwepheshe bokunciphisa ubuphofu obuzobhekana nezinselelo esihlangabezana nazo njengamanje. Le nqubomgomo izophathwa yisikhungo esisha esaziwa ngokuthi iSikhungo Seziqinisekiso Zobuchwepheshe Ezintsha (FTI) esizosebenza njengendawo yokutshalwa kwezimali egxile kulwazi, le ndawo izogxila kakhulu ezinhlelweni ezintsha ngaphakathi kwazo zonke izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. I-FTI izotshala imali ezinhlelweni ezintsha kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi nasemkhakheni wezizimele kanye nasezikhathini ezahlukene kusukela ekwakhiweni kwesu kuya ekwethulweni komkhiqizo emphakathini ngenkathi igxila kakhulu esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa kwesu esinezimali eziphezulu nokwamukelwa komkhiqizo emphakathini uma uthengiswa, ulethelwa, noma usatshalaliswa. Indlela esihamba ngayo yokuthuthukisa abantu ibekwe ngakolunye uhlangothi ngokudinga ukwanda okusheshayo kwenani labantu abakhululekile ezithombeni ezedlule, abesifazane abangena emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe ukuze bahlale kuwo, kuyilapho ngakolunye uhlangothi sihlose ukwakha isu lokuhlangabezana nezinselelo zokuhweba nokubambisana nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba. Ukuqonda okujulile komphakathi mayelana Nezinhlelo Zesayensi kungaba yimpumelelo ekwandiseni lezi zibalo kuphela uma intsha ingabona amathuba akhangayo futhi ajabulisayo emisebenzini elindelekile. Ngeminyaka yama-1970 kanye nama-1980, lezi zikhala zomsebenzi zaziningi ngenxa yezinselelo zendawo ezikhona ngaleso sikhathi - nakuba zazihloselwe kakhulu uhlangothi oluthile lomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, iphuzu labantu libalulekile kakhulu ukuba lihlangene nephuzu lobuchwepheshe. Emhlabeni jikelele, indlela yokukhiqiza abacwaningi abaphezulu abakwazi ukudlulela kwezinye izigaba ibandakanya ukugxila okuqinile emandleni okusebenza kahle emsebenzini. Enye indlela ephezulu ezingeni lesizwe iwukugxila kakhulu ezidingweni zezinga eliphansi lesayensi ezindaweni lapho sinesikhala esihle sokuphumelela ngenxa yokuba khona kwemithombo yemvelo nolwazi olukhona. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lezi zindawo zihlanganisa ulwazi lwezulu nolwazi lwezemvelo. Isikhungo esihamba phambili uma kukhulunywa ngalesi sikhathi, esikhuthaza isayensi, yiNational Research Organization esebenza ngokubambisana nomkhakha wezokufunda ophakeme ngeNational Higher Education Program. Nakuba umsebenzi kahulumeni wangaphakathi waphinde wahlelwa ngo-1994, izibopho ezinamandla zeNational New Strategies Program zaphazamiseka. Ukuqonda indima yezigaba ezithile ezibekwe emisebenzini efana neMnyango Wezolimo Nezempilo okukhombisa izinhlelo ezithile emikhakheni ethile kanye neMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe (DACST) kufanele idlale indima ethile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezilindelekile emhlabeni jikelele mayelana nokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe zilandelwa, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yokucwaninga ethuthukisiwe (ukukhiqiza ulwazi), izinqubomgomo ezintsha (amabhizinisi amasha, imikhiqizo, nemisebenzi) kanye nokwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi. Indima ye-DACST izoba ukuhlela uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka umnikelo wezokusebenza zezimboni ezibanjwe nguhulumeni futhi ibe nesibopho esiqondile ezikhungweni ezinhlanu ezigxile, ezifana neNational Research Center, iScience Promotion Center (eyayaziwa njengeFEST), iCenter for New Technological Strategies, iCouncil for Scientific Research and Industry, kanye neCouncil for Human Science. Izigaba ezihlobene zizoba nezibopho zokuhlonza izikali nezabelomali zezikhungo eziphansi kwazo. Ucwaningo lwesig
Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS kudlulelwe phambili eminyakeni edlule, sihamba phambili ekwakheni ezempilo eziphumelelayo, kodwa lokhu kuza nemiphumela eminingi, ikakhulu uma kuziwa ekuvikeleni kolwazi lwezempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukubheka i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kanye nendlela yokuphatha ulwazi lwezempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luyigugu elikhulu, oluhlanganisa nemininingwane eyimfihlo, efana nezimo zokuphila, izifo, nezokwelashwa. Ukuvikela lokhu kulwazi kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo ngaphandle kokwesaba izinkinga zokuphepha. Izinkampani ezisebenzisa i-GEMS kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinqubo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela ulwazi, okuhlanganisa ukulawula ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi, ukuze kuphela abantu abafanele banokufinyelela. Kumele kube nezinhlelo ezisheshayo ezizovikela iziguli emaphutheni, kuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kokwephulwa kolwazi. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwe-GEMS, izibhedlela, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo kudinga izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuvikela ulwazi, kubandakanya ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphepha, kanye nokuhlola njalo izinhlelo zokuvikela. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwa lihlanzekile futhi lwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sihlole umthelela wobuchwepheshe obuphambili ekuphathweni kolwazi lwezempilo. Ukwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuvikela ulwazi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile, ezifana nezokwelapha, kufanele zibe nezindlela ezivikelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala ngokuphepha, ukuze kungabi neziphakamiso ezingafanele. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke izimo zomphakathi ezisebenzayo, njengoba iziguli zidinga ukuqonda kahle ukuthi ulwazi lwazo lungavikelekile. Ukuqinisekisa lokhu, izikhangiso ezicacile nezihambisanayo kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kudaleke ukuqonda phakathi kweziguli, futhi kube nezindlela zokuxhumana ezichazayo. Ngakho, izinqubo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo akufanele zibe zinsuku nje kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube yinkqubo eqhubekayo. I-GEMS kumele ihlale ibuyekeza izinqubo zayo ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, imithetho, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala luphumelelisa izidingo zabantu, luhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphephile. Ekugcineni, ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS akukhona nje ukulandela imithetho, kodwa kuyisivumelwano esidinga ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani obuphambili, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nezinsizakalo ezisebenza kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lugcinwa luhlala luphephile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokholo, nolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukuzethemba kwabantu kwi-GEMS, okuvumela abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, engcono. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke ukuthi ikuphi lapho kudinga ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, iqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala luphila ngaphansi kwemigomo eqinile yokuvikela. Umphakathi wethu uyafuna lokho, futhi kufanele sizame konke okusemandleni ethu ukuvikela leli nani eliyigugu.
Ukudla okuthengiswa emashinini okuthengisa abekwe ezindaweni zomphakathi kumele kube nezaziso eziphambi kokuthi umshini ubonise amagama ezinto zokudla, ngaphandle kwezimfanelo lapho ilebula (igama lokudla) livela emkhiqizweni wokudla uqobo. Uma umkhiqizo wokudla uthengiswa ngempahla (ngokukhululeka), umphakathi kumele ube nelebula (igama lokudla) ngokuhambisana nomkhiqizo wokudla othengiswayo kuphela, futhi izinhlamvu zamagama kumele zibe nosayizi ofundekayo kumthengi. Izinto zokudla ezithile zikhululekile ngokuphelele ekubhaleni (igama lakho). Noma iyiphi i-beverage ekhankanywe ibhekwa nguMthetho Wemikhiqizo Yeziphuzo, 1989 (Umthetho No. 60 ka-1989). Ilebula (umbhalo) kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo linikeza ulwazi olubalulekile ngaleso sikhathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezifanele zilandelwa, kunezidingo ezahlukene zomthetho ezilawula Ukubhaliswa Kokudla njengalesi: Ulwazi lokudla lufanele kuphela ezimweni lapho izinhlamvu zombhalo ziqoqwe ndawonye futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ifomethi yombhalo isekelwe. Ilebula legama lomkhiqizo kumele libhalwe ngolimi olulodwa lwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Kumele ifundeke futhi ibonakale futhi akufanele ifihlwe nganoma yini eboniswa. Ukudla okuqukethe ama-additives, ama-preservatives, kanye nezithako ezinemibala kumele kubhale igama le-additive, i-preservative, kanye negama lesithako esisetshenzisiwe. Uhlobo lweMonosodium Glutamate (oluwuhlobo lwezithako ezithuthukisa iphunga lokudla) kumele lufakwe njengokwakhiwa uma lukhona kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo wokudla. Imikhiqizo yokudla equkethe ama-preservatives nezithako ezinemibala zohlobo lweTartrazine kumele ibhale igama le-preservative noma isithako futhi uma kuziwa kuma-preservatives, igama elisebenzayo "i-preservative" kumele libonakale kanye nezinye izithako zokudla ezibhalwe ngohlobo lwazo lwezithako. Uma umkhiqizo, nakuba uhlose ukusetshenziswa, ungase ube sengozini yokuphepha kwabantu, izimpawu zokuxwayisa ezifanele kumele zivele kumkhiqizo, isibonelo, emaphaketheni anengcindezi "umphakathi unengcindezi" kanye "gcinani ngaphansi kuka -50 degrees" noma "Ungaphuli noma uphule ngemva kokusetshenziswa." Akukho zikhala zempilo ezingaqhamukayo. Amazwi "impilo" kanye "nenhlanzeko" akufanele afakwe kumalebula (incazelo yemikhiqizo) njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uqukethe izithako ezithuthukisa impilo. Uma kuziwa ekuphekeni okujwayelekile okuvela ezitshalweni, amazwi "akudaleli isifo senhliziyo" angathathwa njengokukhala okungafanele kwezempilo. Isitatimende esifana "siphakanyiswe odokotela" akufanele sisetshenziswe njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo waphakanyiswa uchwepheshe wezempilo (udokotela). Imikhiqizo elawulwa ngokuqhathaniswa nezinga lokushisa nokubanda kumele ichaze izimo zokugcina. Kumele ibhale izindlela zokusebenzisa, ezifana nokuncibilika, ukufudumala, ukupheka ukuze ukudla kube usable futhi izinga elifanele ligcinwe. Ukudla okunezinga eliphezulu lokuphuka kukhombisa ilanga ngenkathi kukhishwa izinga lokushisa eliphansi ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yakho yokuvikela ngokubulala noma yiziphi izinhlayiya eziphilayo ezikhona.
## Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Emadolobheni Kwakuyisikhathi sasekuseni eThekwini, umoya wehlobo wawuhamba kancane, uphonsa amandla alula emoyeni. Abantu babehamba nezinyawo zabo, bethe ngelele emsebenzini nakweminye imisebenzi yabo. Nokho, njengomuntu owayehamba phansi emgwaqweni omkhulu, uThuli wabona okuthile okwakwenza enze umjikelezo emkhatsini wabo. "Ubuqotho bemigwaqo buphilile," kusho uThuli njengoba ebheka phezulu. Amaphuzu amabili ahluke kakhulu akwakha umhlabathini, kodwa akuzange kube njalo ngokuqhaqhazela; umgwaqo walokhu ubhujiswe umphakathi. Izithuthi zishaywa ngaphansi kweminyango yedolobha ebhokozela umphakathi ngezinsiza ezimnandi. Kodwa izinkinga zifihlekile ngaphansi kwalokho kuhlonipha. Ethekwini, indlela yokuhamba yaziwa ngokungabandakanyi. Umgwaqo omnandi, wonke umuntu udinga ukumangala. UThuli, enwene uMthakathi, uzwe udumo lokushisa. Lokhu kwakungaqinisekanga, unkezwa amawu ezithuthuthu. "Izinkanyezi ezinyakazayo, kwenzenjani nje? UThuli wayebona ukujaha kwabantu, kwaphinde kube nemithambo emikhulu ephuchisekayo. Izingalo zodwa ezibamba izithuthi zizokwenzenjani? Kumangaliswa kakhulu, umgwaqo wawubukeka ungena ekwakheni. Izimoto zazingathandi ukuhamba. Abagibeli, abasheshayo, behamba ngempumelelo. UThuli wayebona ukuthi lezi zinkinga emgwaqweni zazonke emadolobheni. Umgwaqo ubonakala kancane, kodwa lapha naseThekwini, umoya uthuthukile. Izilayidi zibhujisiwe; izithuthi abaziqinisekisile. Wafundisa uThuli ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezithuthi kudinga lokho. Noma iyiphi imoto engafiki khona, kufanele ihlale. Kwakuyinsakavukela efanelwe, ukuze kuhlangane nabaphila eTownship. Asho ngamaphoyisa weTraffic, abenelisa ukuhamba kwabo kwezinjini. Umlilo wawuphathe kahle, unayo indawo eyigugu. Yize kunjalo, umoya ubhalwe ngubani? UThuli wanesikhathi sokuhlola amaphoyswe, abamele ibona. Ngaphansi kwaze kwaphela isikhathi, bangaqiniseka ngezinhlelo ezihamba ngasese. Emakholweni, izinkinga zikhona. UThuli wacela izinyathelo ezisemthethweni ukuze kunqandwe ubunzima. Uyazi, ubufakazi buyiqiniso. Noma uhlobo lwemali lukhona, kuze kube yezinkanyezi. UThuli wacela umphakathi, "Ahlangane, abezwe lezi zidakamizwa, sizokhonjiswa ngengqondo." Ekugcineni, uThuli wathathwa entweni waphuma kwazulu. Phakathi ukudlula kwamaZulu, wayefisa ukuthi umphakathi uqhamuke. Ngokuqhamuka kwezinsizakusebenza, umoya ungenwa. Ukuphuculiswa kwezinhlelo zidingaka ukuba nezinga, umzamo, ungeniswa ngempumelelo. "Kwakufanele kube njalo," wathi uThuli, ebala emuva emakhaya. "Umgwaqo awumisa mina, ngizofika emizileni yokuqala." Izinyathelo ezikhulayo, umoya uphume emhlabeni. Abakwazi ukwenza izinto zibe ngokwamanje; umsebenzi wephasi ibhalwe esibayeni, alternativeness eyengayo. Ngokwenyama, uThuli wayezikhiphele ekwakhe. "Kungaba njani uma wonke umuntu efana nale ndlela?" wacabanga. Zoba yizinyathelo ezizovuleka. Ngokuvamile, umphakathi unamazinga aphansi. UThuli waqala ukufunda, ufunde ukuhamba. Njengoziphilayo, umgwaqo ubhaliswe ngesikhathi okuthokozisa. Uthokozisa imfundo ye-Institutions, izinsiza zothando ezikhombisayo. Noma uzothanda, izinga labanye lingakhula uma kuthekwani. UThuli wabona la: "Ukhuluma njengokuphila." Ngakho-ke, wayesebenzisa imithombo yokuphikisana nemigomo yezinto aphelelwa umoya. Umhlaba wokwakha emkhatsini wezibani, umphakathi uhlale ngokomoya. Ebuya umoya, uyashintsha engabe ungavuma kinina? Kulezi zinkinga zendlela, uThuli noHulumeni kufanele banelise ukuzwakala. Kuzwakala obala ukuthi umphakathi uyalokhu uzothola. Izimpungushe, umkhankaso, uzoceka njengezinyathelo. Lokhu kwaholela empilweni ethokozisa izinga lempilo. UThuli, njengoba enza uhambo, wayeqiniseka ukuthi lokhu kusebenza. Ukufika kwabantu emadolobheni, wahlinzekela luzolu. Uthando, umphakathi ukhumbulwe kahle, imizamo isebenzile, izinyathelo ezinjalo zingena. Kwakufanele, manje sekuyindlela yokuphila. UThuli waqala ukuhlangana nezinkanyezi. Inhloso, iphume phambili, eqhamukayo ngemithombo elingani. Ngaleyo ndlela, izinkinga zihlala zikhona. Kodwa uThuli, ngaphezulu ngaleso sikhathi, wahamba wayokwenza uguquko. Akuyona into engashintshi, kodwa izinyathelo ezinomoya, empini. Umphakathi, ungquzulwano lwalubamba. Lokhu kwavuleka umhlaba, izinhlamvu emnyangeni wezinsiza. Ngokuphathelene nezinyathelo, izinkanyezi zibonakalise ukuthi laFAUTHI amafoni aziyo, umphakathi ubhalwa. Okwedlulelayo, umgwaqo awudala, uThuli wawushintsha umgomo. Ngamakhansela alungilendatshana, umoya uphumo luthandwa njalonje. Ngakho-ke, ukuphinde sithole emakhaya. Umupa, ukhulekelwe!
Umthelela Wama-Social Media Entsheni Emndenini wanamuhla, abasha banomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wonke nge indlela abathumela ngayo izindaba zabo ngama-social media. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuliseni, ekuthuthukiseni, nasekushintsheni izindlela zokucabanga, ezempilo, kanye nezokuxhumana phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba singamaZulu sinesiko elihle lokuxhumana, kodwa sizidinga ukucabangela kahle izinzuzo nezinselelo ezivela kulolu hlobo lokuxhumana. Kuqala, ama-social media avumela abasha ukuba baqoqe, babelane futhi baphinde bahlanganyele ngezinto ezicacile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi olusha, izinkwazi, nezinhlelo ezithinta izimpilo zabo. Ngokwesibonelo, abasha bangase bazitholele imisebenzi emisha, bavule amabhizinisi, noma bathole izindlela zokukhuthaza umphakathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kokubambisana phakathi kwezizukulwane kuzala ubuhlakani obunamandla, obulungisa imiphumela emihle emphakathini. Kodwa, ngaphansi kwalezi zinzuzo, kukhona nezinselelo ezinkulu. Ama-social media abanga nobudlova besithombe sabo, lapho abasha bephoqwa ukuba baphile ngemiphumela ethile enhloko. Lokhu kudala izingcindezi zokuba baphumelele ngendlela ethile, okungaholela ekuhluphekeni. Ibhayisikobho lethu lithi "ukubona kubangela isifiso," futhi lokhu kwenza ukuba izinjongo zomphakathi zibe yikhanda lokwakha ubuhle obungokwenyama. Lokhu kungenza abasha bazizwe belahlekile, bephoqeka ukuhamba kwezinye izifiso ezivela kwabanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba kokuqukethwe kudinga isikhathi nomndeni. Kwezinye izimo, abasha basebenzisa ama-social media ukuze bazikhumbuze ngenjabulo, kodwa lokhu kungase kuholele ekudakeni nasekugculiseni. Abantu bahlala besebenzisa izinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi ukuze bathole ukukhuthazwa, kodwa kudinga abakhiqizi ukwazisa ukuba nemicabango emihle. Lokhu kungenza umqondo wokuphila uvuthwe. Uma sikhuluma ngama-social media, akukhona kuphela ukuhwebelana kwezindaba, kodwa futhi kuyithuba lokwakha ukuthi abantu bahlale bejolisa ezinkingeni zomhlaba. Abasha bangaba yizwi labo ebalulekile, bavezwa ezindabeni ezimqoka, imikhankaso, uye benza umehluko. Lokhu kudinga ulimi, umdlandla, kanye nenhloso. Kungakho i-Instagram, Twitter, kanye ne-Facebook zibalulekile ezimpilweni zabo. Kodwa, kungakuhle uma abasha bazi kahle imikhawulo yokuphepha. Ukusiza abasha ukuba babe nolwazi oluhle nokukhuthaza umphakathi kungavikela ekuvaleni emiphumeleni emibi. Izinselelo ezixhunywe ngokuxhumana kokuxhumana zibalulekile, futhi zidinga umuntu ngamunye ukuthi aqonde ukuthi izithombe ezibhalwe ku-social media akuthathi kalula. Umhlaba uthola ubuhle bayo kwabanye, futhi lokhu kudinga ukucabangela. Ngokubukeka, umthelela wama-social media entsheni ungaphendukela ezindleleni ezingenakubalwa. Kukhona izinzuzo ezicacile njengoba abasha bethola ithuba lokuxhumana, kodwa kumele baqaphele izinsongo ezivela enjongweni yokuphila. Ukudinga umbono owaziwa osukwini, abasha kufanele bahlale beqaphele ukuziphatha kwabo nokwenza izinqumo eziningi ezifanele. Umqondo wothando, ukuzithokozisa, nokubekezela kuvame ukuyisa embikweni omuhle. Ngokwezepolitiki, uhulumeni, izikole, nomphakathi, kumele baphathe ngempela lolu nhlangano, ukuze atinikeze abasha amathuba okukhula nekusasa elizayo eliqhakazile. Abasha abavunyelwe kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa bakwazi nokuqoqa izimvo ezithinta imiphakathi. Ukucacisa izindinganiso zokuziphatha, ukhetha umxhwele, kuzothuthukisa indlela abasha abaphila ngayo, beziphatha abanokholo nolwazi oluhle. Ngalokhu, ukuthuthukiswa kwesiko lokuxhumana nendlela yokuhlanganyela kuzovula amathuba amasha ezimpilweni zabantu. Ama-social media asanda kube yinsiza eyinqaba, futhi uma esephathwa kahle, akhe umphakathi owaziyo, ophilayo, nolwazi. Ukuze abasha baphumelelayo emhlabeni wama-social media, badinga ukuqonda amandla nezingozi ezihambisana nalokhu. Umhlaba ulindele ukuzwa nezwi labo, kufanele balisebenzise kahle. Ngakho, asivule inhliziyo nomqondo, ukuze sibe yisikhulu sendaba emhlabeni digital.
Inkinga yosuku olwaziwa nge-Day Zero eKapa ichaziwe (Day Zero water crisis) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-Day Zero? Impendulo: I-Day Zero ibhekisela ngosuku lapho amanzi ezokwehla kakhulu eKapa, okwenza kube nzima noma kungenzeki ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kwenzeka uma izinqolobane zamanzi zifika ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, okwenza kube khona ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Umbuzo 2: Yini edale i-Day Zero eKapa? Impendulo: I-Day Zero yadalwa yizimo ezihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwemvula, ukwanda kwabantu, kanye nokungaphumeleli kokuphathwa kwamanzi. Izinga lokushisa eliphezulu, ukungabi namvula okwenzeka eminyakeni edlule, kanye nokungabi nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo zokulondoloza amanzi, konke lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenzeka ngesikhathi se-Day Zero? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi se-Day Zero, izakhamuzi zaziphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Amabhokisi amanzi abekwe ezindaweni ezithile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola amanzi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, okwakuholela ekutheni abantu bahlale bezama ukulondoloza amanzi. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuvimbela i-Day Zero? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvinjelwe i-Day Zero, uhulumeni waseKapa uthathe izinyathelo eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amanzi. Izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi zaphinde zathuthukiswa. Umbuzo 5: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze basize? Impendulo: Abantu bangasiza ngokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi emakhaya abo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amanzi aphindaphindiwe, ukugwema ukugeza izimoto njalo, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokulondoloza amanzi ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izifundo ezitholakele kusukela ku-Day Zero? Impendulo: I-Day Zero ifundisile abantu abaningi ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokulondoloza amanzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi amanzi ayinsiza engatholakali kalula, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuwagcina. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokuphatha amanzi. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe i-Day Zero iyinkinga kuphela eKapa? Impendulo: Cha, i-Day Zero ayiyona inkinga kuphela eKapa. Izindawo eziningi emhlabeni jikelele zibhekene nezinkinga zokuntuleka kwamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi inkinga yokuphathwa kwamanzi iyinkinga yomhlaba wonke, futhi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezizwe. Umbuzo 8: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwamanzi? Impendulo: Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwamanzi, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokulondoloza amanzi, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokulondoloza, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza zamanzi. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokulondoloza amanzi? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi zokulondoloza amanzi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, izinhlelo zokugcina amanzi emithonjeni, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenzisa amanzi aphindaphindiwe. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezakhamuzi. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayifunda kwabanye abantu abaphumelele ekuphatheni amanzi? Impendulo: Singafunda ukuthi ukuphathwa kwamanzi kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezinkampani. Ukuhlonipha izinsiza, ukusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhlakanipha, nokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, konke lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole impumelelo ekuphatheni amanzi. Umbuzo 11: Ingabe izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zidinga ukushintshwa? Impendulo: Yebo, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo ukuze zihlale zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo ezintsha, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi. Umbuzo 12: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wokulondoloza amanzi? Impendulo: Singathuthukisa umqondo wokulondoloza amanzi ngokufundisa abantu, ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuthaza, nokwakha izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezindawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde ukubaluleka kokulondoloza amanzi. Umbuzo 13: Ingabe i-Day Zero izophinde ibonakale? Impendulo: Kungenzeka ukuthi i-Day Zero ibonakale uma izinyathelo ezithathwayo zingasebenzi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amanzi ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile. Umbuzo 14: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi? Impendulo: Singathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi ngokubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, nokwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza zamanzi. Umbuzo 15: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezilandelayo okufanele zithathwe? Impendulo: Izinyathelo ezilandelayo zifaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlola izinga lamanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, nokwakha izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela izinsiza zamanzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Day Zero ibonisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwamanzi kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe izinyathelo zokulondoloza amanzi ukuze sithole ikusasa elingcono.
Yini amafutha nezitshalo ezineprotheni? Ngokwewebhusayithi ye-SA Grains and Oilseeds, kuthiwa imikhiqizo engaphumeli emzimbeni ingokudla okungadliwa abantu. Amafutha angadliwa abantu, ikakhulukazi ngoba aqukethe amafutha abalulekile ekudleni. Izitshalo ezinefutha ezikhuliswa eNingizimu Afrika zifaka: amantongomane, ilanga, ikhonela, amabele, ikotoni, ummbila, kanye nesorghum. Amafutha akhuliswa ikakhulu ukuze akhishwe amafutha akhona. Okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo ezincane (njengekhonela) kungama-1% - 2%; okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo zamabele kufinyelela ku-20% futhi kudlula ku-40% ezitshalo zekotoni nasekhonelani. Amafutha angadliwa ngabantu atholakala kakhulu kumabele, ikotoni, ikhonela, i-linseed, kanye namantongomane. Amafutha afana ne-linseed kanye ne-castor oil asetshenziswa ezinhlelweni zezimboni. Uk formation of amafutha-aphakeme ezitshalo angadliwa ngabantu kufana nezinye ezidliwayo. Amafutha aqinile akhiqizwa uma engashisi kakhulu, kodwa amafutha ayisithako. Ikotoni, amantongomane, kanye namabele konke kufezwa ehlobo - kufezwa ekuqaleni kwehlobo ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kweqhwa (kungalimala kalula yiqhwa), futhi kukhula ezinyangeni zokuqala zonyaka (ezindaweni lapho kunenhlanhla yokuna ehlobo). Izitshalo ziba sezinhlotsheni ezithile ekwindla futhi ngokuvamile ziqoqwa ngemuva kokufika kweqhwa. Ikhonela ifezwa ebusika - iyona kuphela i-oilseed engalimalwa yiqhwa. Izitshalo ezivunyiwe ziqhutshelwa, futhi amafutha akhishwa kuzo. Amafutha nemafutha abalulekile ekudleni, asetshenziswa njengefutha lokupheka, ifutha lesaladi, kanye nefutha lokufry, noma angabekwa ukuze kube ne-margarine nezinye izinhlobo zamafutha okCooking. Le mikhiqizo ingena emakethe yamafutha ivela ezinsizakalweni (njengebutter) ngoba la mafutha awanele ukudlisa abantu bonke emhlabeni ngenxa yokupholisa okusheshayo. Izinsalela ezisele ngemuva kokukhishwa kwamafutha ezitshalo zibalulekile ekufuyweni kwezilwane epulazini. I-meal ekhiqizwa kulokhu kusala ngemuva kokukhishwa kwamafutha kumabele, amantongomane, nezinye amafutha ixutshwa nezinye izinhlobo zamagugu ukuze kutholakale ukudla kwezilwane okuhle. Ngiyacela/Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukhokhe inzuzo yami uma siphumelele ohlelweni lokufaka isicelo kule akhawunti yasebhange elandelayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukudluliswa kwemali okuvunyelwe lapha kwenziwa ngohlelo lwekhompyutha olwaziwa njenge-ACB, futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi akukho ulwazi lokukhokha olunikezwa ebhange lami kodwa ulwazi lokukhokha luzobhalwa esitatimendeni sebanga lami. (lokhu akusebenzi uma ibhange lingajwayele ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi noma izitatimende zebhange, njengokwesibonelo, i-akhawunti yokonga noma uhlobo olufanayo). Le mvume ingakhanselwa ngami ngokunika isaziso esibhalwe phansi sezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Qaphela: Ubufakazi obubhalwe phansi be-akhawunti yasebhange (njengokwesibonelo, isitatimende sebanga, iphepha elivela kwi-ATM, i-cheque ekhishiwe) kumele kuhlanganiswe. Igama lomnikazi we-akhawunti... Ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olukhululiwe ngenhla lungamanga kulolu suku futhi lugcwele ngazo zonke izindlela futhi uMphakathi Wokuhlinzeka Ngemali Yokungasebenzi akabandakanyeki kunoma yiziphi ukukhokha okungalungile okungavela ngenxa yolwazi olungaphelele noma olungalungile olunikezwe ngami.
