Kungani izitshalo ziba nombala ophuzi ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezimanzi zonyaka? Isithombe: Izimo zokuphuma kwamanzi zithinta inqubo yokukhula kwezitshalo eziningi. Umlando wesiNgisi u-H.G. Willis wathi umlando wabantu ungumbono phakathi kokufunda nokuphazamiseka. Mayelana nabakhiqizi bezitshalo ezindaweni ezithola imvula yasehlobo eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi lezo ezindaweni ezinomhlabathi owomile, le miphumela iyinto evamile nsuku zonke. Izindlela zokukhiqiza izitshalo ezindaweni ezingomile zishintshile ukuze kuvinjwe umonakalo ongenakubuyiselwa ngenxa yokushoda kwemvula. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokulungisa ubuningi bezitshalo, ukusebenzisa amafutha afanele ngokusekelwe emiphumeleni esunguliwe, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi ukuze kwandiswe kancane ukufakwa kwamanzi, ukusebenzisa izinsuku ezifanele zokuhlwanyela, nokukhetha ukuhlanganiswa kwezithombo ezingakwazi ukujwayela ukushoda kwemvula, njll. Lezi zinhlelo zezithombo zifaka phakathi iqembu lezitshalo elaziwa ngokuthi ama-mesophytes, aphumelela emhlabathini omanzi kodwa opholile. Imizi yazo ilungiswe kahle ukuze ifune amanzi nezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini; isibonelo, imizi ye-maize ingangena emhlabathini ngesivinini esingu-24 mm ngosuku, ifinyelela ubukhulu obungama-2 kuya kuma-2.4 metres, kuye ngalesi simo somhlabathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemizi kungavinjwa kakhulu noma kuphazamiseke ngenxa yemvula eningi, njengoba kwenzeka ngesikhathi salo nyaka lapho izitshalo zihlanyelwa ngoDisemba noJanuwari. Imvula eningi emhlabathini owomile izoholela ekutheni amanzi agcwalise izinga lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukuhamba komoya okukhona. Inqubo yokuqala ebalulekile yokuphila ezothinteka kabi ukungena komoya emizini; izitshalo zidinga amazinga athile omoya (okhiye) emizini yazo. Abacwaningi bakhombisile ezihlolweni zabo ukuthi ngaphansi kwezimo zokuphuma kwamanzi ngokuphelele, ukukhula kwemizi kungama kancane ngemizuzu. Nokho, izitshalo zihluka ekubekezeleni kwazo ukuhamba kwamanzi endaweni eyodwa. Isibonelo, izitshalo ezithanda amanzi ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-hydrophytes (njenge-rice) zikhululekile ukuphila ezimeni zomhlabathi ezimanzi. Nokho, lezi zitshalo zingafa emhlabathini onokuhamba komoya okwanele. Imizi yezitshalo ezingakwazi ukuhamba kwamanzi, njenge-legumes (ama-beans omile, ama-soybeans, njll.), izofa emva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuphuma kwamanzi. Izimpawu zokuqala zokulimala kokuphuma kwamanzi zingavela ngemva kwamahora amabili, kuyilapho umonakalo ongabuyiselwa ungavela ngemva kwamahora angama-24, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezishisayo nezinyakazayo. Uma ukungena komoya emizini kuphazamisekile, ezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile zezitshalo ezifana nokukhula, ukutholwa kwamanzi, nokumuncwa kwezinto eziphilayo nazo ziya kuphazamiseka. Naphezu kokuba namanzi amaningi, izitshalo azikwazi ukuwathola amanzi nezinto eziphilayo. Ezinye izimpawu zokukhathazeka kwezithombo ziba sobala, kuye ngokuthi zikhula kanjani. Isibonelo, uma ukungena komoya emizini kuncishisiwe ngesikhathi sokukhula kwe-maize, ukutholwa kwamanzi nakho kuyancipha ngokufanayo, okuzothinta ukumuncwa kwezinto eziphilayo. Isibonakaliso esibonakalayo yikhala lokuphuma kwezithombo (chlorosis) ngenxa yokuncipha kwamazinga e-chlorophyll. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwe-nitrogen ezitshalweni, nakuba i-phosphorus, i-potassium, nezinye izinto eziphilayo zingase zibe nokuntuleka. Kulesi sikhathi, isitshalo sithumele i-nitrogen ezitshalweni ezintsha ezivela ezindala ukuze siqhubeke sikhula. Ukuqhubeka kokuphuma kwamanzi kuzoholela ekunciphiseni ukukhula kwezithombo zezitshalo nokulahlekelwa kokukhiqiza.
Umbhalo Wendabuko Ngomhlaba Omkhulu: iSahara Desert Umbuzo: Yini iSahara Desert? Impendulo: ISahara Desert yinsimu enkulu yomhlabathi eyaziwa ngokuthi iyisihlabathi esisodwa esikhulu emhlabeni. Le ndawo ibhalwe ngenkanyezi ngokubanzi ikhuluma ngobushushuluzi, inhlabathi enempilo eyisisekelo, namazinga okushisa aphakeme kakhulu. I-Sahara ibonisa izici ezahlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezigodi, ezinza njalo, nezinyuka, okuyintshumayelo ethokozisayo kuzo zonke izilwane nezitshalo. Umbuzo: I-Sahara ibangeni elingakanani? Impendulo: I-Sahara icishe ibe nendawo engama-9.2 million square kilometers, okuyinto eyenza kube yisihlabathi sesine esikhulu emhlabeni. Le ndawo ibuka kanjalo emapanini. Ihlanganisa izindawo ezahlukahlukene, okwenza kube nokuhlukahluka okuphawulekayo emvelweni nasemanzini. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinto ezitholakala eSahara? Impendulo: E-Sahara, ungathola izinto ezahlukene kakhulu, okuhlanganisa izimphahla ezinjengokhuni, amapulazi, nezilwane ezahlukeneyo. Izilwane ezinjengama-jackals, izimvubu, nezelinye ezincane zivame ukuhlala kule ndawo, zikhombisa ukuzinza nokuhlakanipha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Sahara inezitho ezizodwa zemvelo, ezifana nezinyathi nezimbali ezitholakala kuphela kulendawo. Umbuzo: Yimiphi imvelo e-Sahara? Impendulo: I-Sahara inemvelo ethokozisayo ehlanganisa izihlahla, izihlahla ezihlaza, nezindawo ezinosawoti. I-photochemistry iyisici esibaluleke kakhulu, inequkethe imithombo yamanzi ebalulekile. Kule ndawo, ungathola izindawo eziphakeme, ukuhlangana kwemimoya, nokukhanya kwezinkanyezi, okuyinto evusa umoya emphakathini. Umbuzo: Kukhona izithombe ezithakazelisayo eSahara? Impendulo: Yebo, izithombe ezithakazelisayo zikhona eSahara. Izithombe zendawo ezibukekayo ziveza ubuhle bendawo, ukuya phezu kwezintaba eziphakeme, umjikelezo wezintaba, kanye nezihlahla ezihlala ziqhakaza. Abavakashi bayajabulela ukuzithumele izithombe, banganqoba unyaka wonke. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinkolelo nemigubho ebucayi yeSahara? Impendulo: I-Sahara iyindawo enemigubho ethandwa kakhulu, futhi izinkolelo zabo zinezimpawu ezithakazelisayo zamasiko zendawo. Abantu basendaweni benza imikhosi yokuhlonipha imvelo, izinkanyezi nezilwane, benza ukudlala ngendlela yokugcina ubuhlakani bamasiko. Imigubho nazo zikhombisa ubuhlobo bezinhlanga ezahlukene ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo: I-Sahara ihlanganisa kanjani nabantu? Impendulo: I-Sahara iyisikhungo sokuhlanganyela kwabantu. Ihlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene, konke kuhlobene nezokuhamba, ukuxhumana, nezokuhweba. Lokhu kudala umoya ophethe impumelelo, ubumbano, kanye nomusa phakathi kwabantu abasuke bejolise kulolu hlobo. Umbuzo: Yini okubalulekile ukuyazi ngempilo e-Sahara? Impendulo: Impilo eSahara ibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele. Ithinta izimo zomnotho neziphakamiso. Izitshalo namahlathi aphezulu ahlukanisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu bendawo. Ukubhekelela impilo kwabantu kuyasiza ukugcina ibhalansi phakathi komhlaba nemvelo, okuyinto ejwayelekile emiphakathini ethokozayo. Umbuzo: Awuyithola kanjani i-Sahara? Impendulo: Ukuze ufike eSahara, ungathola izindlela eziningi zokuhamba. Izindiza ezivela ezindaweni eziningi, ezifana neAlgeria, Tunisia, neMorocco, zingaveza okuhlangenwe nakho okuhle okuphathekayo. Ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuhamba ngebhasi, noma ukuphakanyiswa ezindaweni ezithile kusenawo amandla okuphawula ubuhle beSahara. Umbuzo: Ikuphi okuthakazelisayo kwabavakashi eSahara? Impendulo: Abavakashi bangaqhubeka bazifake emhlabeni wendawo ehlukile. Bangaqaphela izkhiphokhitho ezihlaza, imifula, namadwala amakhulu adinga ukufinyelela. Uhlelo lokuvakashela izindawo ezithokozisayo, ukufunda ngezimpisi, ukuthola amadizi nezilwane, kuyathokozisa ukwenza izinjongo zokusizakala kweSahara. Izivakashi ziba nezinhlobonhlobo zempilo kule ndawo, zivula amathuba okukhulisa izifiso zabo. Umbuzo: Kuthiwani nempilo kaSahara esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Njengoba izimo zomhlaba zishintsha, i-Sahara izoba nezinselelo ezibalulekile. Ukuchithwa kwemvelo, izinguquko zamawela, nezimo zokwakha zinezinga lale mhlaba. Kubalulekile ukuqonda nokugqugquzela izinhlelo eziqondile zokugcinwa kwayo, ukuze imvelo nezilwane zikwazi ukuphila kahle. I-Sahara ikhuluma ngesifiso sokuzinza nokuqhubeka kwesikhathi esizayo. Umbuzo: Kungani iSahara ibalulekile kumhlaba? Impendulo: I-Sahara ibaluleke kakhulu kumhlaba ngenxa yemvelo yayo, izinsiza, nezimpawu zamukela izivakashi. Ibhalansi phakathi kokuphila, isiko, nezinsiza zokuqinisa ubulili benhlalakahle kubalulekile. Futhi, izifundo zempilo yeSahara zisiza ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo eziningi eziphumayo ezweni jikelele. Ngokuphetha, iSahara Desert iyiqoqo eliyingqayizivele lendawo, elihlanganisa izimo ezahlukahlukene, ezikhombisa ubuhle bezemvelo, ubuhlakani bendoda, nezinsiza eziphilayo. Ubulungisa bempilo kanye nemvelo kudinga ukuqashelwa nokuhlonishwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhalansi iyagcinwa phakathi kwezinsiza nezosizo.
Umkhakha Wezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) ukhuthaza futhi uhlanganisa ukuxhumana ngezilimi ezahlukene. Njengomzamo wokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, i-NLS iphethe ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emphakathini wethu futhi inesibopho sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilimi zonke zabantu baleli zwe ngokusebenzisa lokho okukhulunywe kumgomo ophakanyisiwe wokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi lezi, kanye nazo zonke izilimi ezakhelwe emuva emlandweni waleli zwe. Umsebenzi ophambili we-NLS ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthethosisekelo ngokwenza kube lula, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlinzeka ngensiza yokuhumusha nokuhlela kuzo zonke izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho nokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngokuhlela izilimi nemigomo ezinhlelweni ezithile. I-NLS isebenza njengengxenye yoHulumeni wezazi zezizimi ngokuhumusha imibhalo ebhalwe ngolimi oluthile olwamukelwa ngokomthetho iye kwezinye izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho. Iqembu layo lemigomo linikeza usizo ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphuculeni izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho ngezisho zobuchwepheshe. Umsebenzi wabo wokuhlela izilimi uhilela ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuhulumeni ekuthuthukiseni umgomo wezilimi nasekutholeni izindlela zokuwusebenzisa. Umsebenzi omkhulu weMkhakha Wezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) mayelana Nokuhlelwa Kwezilimi ukuhlinzeka ngolimi oluningi nokuhlonipha zonke izilimi ezikhona lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba ukuhlela izilimi eNingizimu Afrika kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa komphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezakhelwe emuva kuzobekwa phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa komgomo wezilimi ngokwakha amasu, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kufezwe lo msebenzi. Ukuqaliswa komgomo wezilimi kuhilela ukuhlinzeka (i) ukufinyelela nokuphathwa (ii) nokukhuthaza ukuhlinzekwa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlola ukusetshenziswa komgomo ukuze kutholakale ukusebenza kwawo kubalulekile. Lo mkhakha wokuhlela izilimi wasungulwa ngo-1993 ukuze unikeze uHulumeni ngeluleko ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphumeleliseni umgomo wezilimi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo. Ukuvuleka nokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke izigaba kule nqubo kugcizelelwe. Umsebenzi ophambili nokuqala walomkhakha kwakuwukuphatha inqubo ende yokusungula iBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South African. Le nqubo yaqala ngo-1994 ngephakheji yokubonisana kazwelonke ebizwa ngeSithangami Sezilimi Sabantu Bonke, kwalandelwa yizingxoxo eziningi nemiphakathi ezweni, okuholele ekubhalweni kweBill yeBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South African ngo-1995. Ibhodi yezilimi yasePan South African yasungulwa ngo-1996. Umgomo wezilimi kanye nezisekelo zeNingizimu Afrika zathuthukiswa ngokuhambisana neziphakamiso ezenziwe yiLangtag nezinye izingxoxo nezifundo ezenziwe. NgoDisemba 1999, uNgqongqoshe wathumela ithimba lokweluleka ukuze liphothule umgomo wezilimi nezisekelo zeNingizimu Afrika, owethulwe kubo bonke ababambiqhaza eSithangamini Sezilimi esabanjwa ngoMashi 2000. Ngemuva kweziphakamiso ezenziwe yilabo ababekhona eSithangamini, ithimba lokweluleka labuyekeza umgomo wezilimi nezisekelo zeNingizimu Afrika. Ngemuva kweziphakamiso lezi, kwenziwa ucwaningo olunzulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala nasemaphandleni ukuze kutholakale ubukhona bezinsiza zezizimi. Okwamanje, inani lemali elidingekayo ukuze kuqaliswe umgomo ophakanyisiwe liyacatshangelwa, ngokubambisana neMali Yezwe. Le nqubo iyingxenye yokuphumelelisa izinqubo ezisunguliwe emgomweni wezilimi ophakanyisiwe. Izithiyo zolimi zisasebenza njengokuphazamisayo kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu, ukuze bakwazi ukuxhumana nohulumeni. Usizo lokuhumusha eNingizimu Afrika lungakwenza kube lula kubo bonke ukuxhumana neziphathimandla ngolimi lwabo, njengasemathuneni, eziteshini zamaphoyisa, nasezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Lokhu kusizo kulindeleke ukuthi kuhlolwe ngonyaka ka-2000/2001 ezindaweni ezikhethiwe amahora angama-12 ngosuku, kusukela ngo-07:00 ekuseni kuya ku-19:00, ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngesonto. Lo msebenzi wenziwa ngokubambisana nePANSLAB ukuze kube lula ukuthuthukiswa nokuphumelelisa izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Isisekelo esihle sokwakha emkhakheni wezilimi zomdabu zobuchwepheshe sidingeka ukuze kuhlelwe kahle imizamo yocwaningo ezwenikazi lonke futhi kwakhiwe amandla noma izinsiza zezilimi zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ikhompiyutha yokuphatha yasungulwa ukuze ibhale idokhumenti ezophakamisa inqubo engasetshenziswa ukuze kusungulwe imboni ye-HLT ezothuthuka futhi ikhuthaze izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bonke abantu bayazi ngamalungelo abo njengoba ebhalwe emthethweni mayelana nezilimi; futhi ukuthi ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi kuyakhuthazwa ukuze abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babone ukuthi ukwazi izilimi eziningi kuyinzuzo. Umkhakha wokuqala walolu shintsho wagxila ekusebenzeni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanti umkhakha wesibili wagxila emphakathini wonke. Umphumela walolu shintsho uhlanganisa amakhalenda ezilimi, amaposta, amabhrosha ezilimi (anezibingelelo ngolimi eziyi-11), namavidiyo, kanye nokuphumeleliswa kolimi lwakho lokukhuluma ezikhungweni. I-UNESCO okwamanje ilungiselela umbiko wezIzilimi Zomhlaba ophakanyiswe ukuze uchaze ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emhlabeni jikelele, ukufunda ngempande zezizimi nendawo yazo yamanje, nokuhlonza izinkinga ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni. Ngalesi sithangami, i-UNESCO ihlose ukukhombisa isidingo sokuphatha noma ukuhlela ubukhona bezilimi emhlabeni jikelele. Umkhakha Wezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) wacelwa yi-UNESCO ukuba ibambe iqhaza ocwaningweni lokuqoqa ulwazi lombiko ngazo zonke izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezilimi zeKhoisan neNama. Njengoba ulwazi olunzulu ngalezi zilimi lwaludingeka kulolu cwaningo, imibuzo yathunyelwa ezazi zezizimi ezidumile ukuze zinikeze ulwazi. Ulwazi olunothile luqoqwe ezimkhakheni ezahlukene mayelana nezilimi eNingizimu Afrika, njengolwazi ngendawo, ukuhlukahluka, inani labantu abakhuluma ulwimi oluthile, ulwazi lokuhamba, umnotho wephakathi ngalinye elikhuluma ulwimi oluthile, indlela okuthathwa ngayo noma okwamukelwa ngayo, imizimba ephethe umgomo wezilimi, nezinhlelo ezihlobene nalolu limi nezindlela zokufunda nokubhala. Umbiko wezIzilimi Zomhlaba we-UNESCO uzokhishwa ngo-2001 futhi uzophakamisa uchungechunge lweziphakamiso mayelana nokuvikela nokukhuthaza ubukhona bezilimi zomphakathi.
Inhloso yale nsizakalo ukusiza amalungu omphakathi ekubikeni izikhalazo kwiMnyango Wezokukhala Ozenzakalelayo. Uma uthumela isikhalazo ehhovisi likazwelonke le-ICD, udaba luzothunyelwa ehhovisi likamasipala ukuze luhlolwe. Isikhalazo seClass III yisikhumbuzo esithi uphiko lwezepolitiki noma amaphoyisa enze isenzo esiholele ekulimazeni okukhulu okudingayo umuntu ukuthi afune ukwelashwa esibhedlela. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke ngesikhathi umuntu esesandleni samaphoyisa noma uma ethunwa amaphoyisa. Ukusetshenziswa kabi kwamandla kunezimpempe emphakathini ngokulandela ukulimala okukhona; inani labantu abathintekayo; inani lemali elihilelekile; noma isikhathi lokhu kwenzeka. Izikhalazo ngezimo ezenzeka ngaphambi kokusungulwa kwe-ICD, ngokwesibonelo, yonke imicimbi eyenzeka ngaphambi kukaApril 1997. Futhi, izimo ezenzeka unyaka ngaphambi kokubikwa kwi-ICD, ngaphandle uma kukhona izimo ezikhethekile. Ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezokukhala Ozenzakalelayo. Thumela isikhalazo ngokwakho, ngefoni, ngeposi, noma nge-imeyili ehhovisi le-ICD eliseduze. Zonke izikhalazo kumele zithunyelwe phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza, phakathi kuka-8h00 no-16h30. I-ICD ingakucela ukuthi unikeze olunye ulwazi ngaphambi kokuhlola isikhalazo. Uma uvakashela mathupha, uzokhuluma nomphakathi wezokuhlola noma umhlaziyi. Ukuthola umvakashela kumakhasimende kungathatha cishe imizuzu emihlanu noma imizuzu emihlanu. Ukuthola isikhalazo esibhaliwe kungathatha cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-30. Le nsizakalo iyamahala.
Ukusebenza Ukude Ezinkampanini ZaseNingizimu Afrika Ngenxa yokwanda kokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi, izinkampani eziningi eNingizimu Afrika ziqhubele phambili ukuvuma ukusebenza ukude. Lokhu kungenxa yokufunwa ikakhulukazi kokuqasha abasebenzi abavela ezinhlakeni ezahlukene, kanye nomthelela weCOVID-19, othintekayo kuzo zonke izimboni. Ukusebenza ukude sekuvame kakhulu, futhi le ndlela yokusebenza iyathandwa ngabasebenzi nabaphathi. Ngokocwaningo olwenziwa yi-South African Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SACCI), kuboniswe ukuthi amaphesenti angu-62 abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banethemba lokuthi ukusebenza ukude kuzokwandiswa nakulesi sikhathi esizayo. Abasebenzi bayakujabulela ukuhlela isikhathi sabo, bezikhandla ekwakheni izimo ezinhle zokusebenza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngama-work-from-home (WFH) ziyaqhubeka nokukhulisa umkhiqizo wazo. UProf. Thabo Mhlongo, umphenyi kwezokuphatha, utshele iSowetan ukuthi "ukusebenza ukude kuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza njengoba abasebenzi bekwazi ukulawula izimo zabo zokusebenza." Ubuye wancoma izinkampani ezibenobuhlakani ekwakheni amasu awusizo ukuze zakhe izindlela zokuxhumana ezikahle nezinzile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benomzwangedwa ophusile futhi beqonda izinjongo zenkampani. Izinkampani eziningi, njengeFNB ne-Discovery, seziqale ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ngenxa yokuthi kungase kusize ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kweqembu nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kokusebenza okusezingeni eliphezulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kuholele ekuhluphekeni kwabanye abasebenzi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni lapho kukhona izinkinga zendawo yokuxhumana. U-Vusi Magagula, osebenza endaweni yokuncintisana, ushaye indiva wathi, “Kukhona abanye abantu abadinga imali engaphezulu ukuthenga izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze basebenze kahle.” Lokhu kufanekisa izinselelo ezahlukene ezihlangabezana nabo, okwenza kube nzima kubanye abasebenzi abathola izinsiza ezinembayo. Uchwepheshe wezobuchwepheshe, uNoluthando Jali, ukholelwa ukuthi izinkampani kufanele zikhulise izinqubomgomo ezizokweseka abakhiqizi. Uthi: "Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zifake izinhlelo ezihambelana nesidingo sabasebenzi. Izinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo kufanele zibe nzima, zifane nezindawo zokusebenza ezisemqoka." Lokhu kuzosiza eeqenjini ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, obambisene, futhi okhiqizayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani eziseNingizimu Afrika zidinga ukuthi zifake izinhlelo ezinhle zokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuqhubeka kokusebenza kahle kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwesimo sokusebenza esihambisana nezidingo zamanje nezizayo. IPC (Institute of People Management) ibonisa ukuthi izinkampani ezihamba phambili ziguqula imikhuba yokusebenza ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko ezichazwe yizimo zomhlaba. Izinhlangano ezinhlobonhlobo, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokweseka ukuphuma kwezimoto, zikhombisa ukuthi kusebenza kahle ukuba nezinqubo zokuxhumana ezijulile nezibambene. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu usazi ngemigomo nezinhlelo ezenzeka ezinkampanini zabo, futhi lezi zinyathelo zilanuswa ngempela umphakathi. Ngokuphawuleka, ukusakazwa kolwazi nokutholakala kijinhle kolwazi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zokusebenza ukude. Kungaba ngokwenza izinkundla zokusebenza ezihlangene, izinhlelo zokusebenzelana, noma uqobo ukwakha imikhiqizo ethuthukisayo. Abasebenzi badinga ukuphathwa kahle ukuze bazuze impumelelo, futhi lokhu kuzokwakha isizinda esiqinile sokusebenza. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele zikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe kuphela abukhona – impilo yomuntu ibalulekile. Ukuqhubeka kokusebenza ukude kufanele kuhlangane nezinyathelo ezinhle zokuphila komsebenzi, okubandakanya ukulwa nokudangala nokuqinisa umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokujabula phakathi kwabasebenzi, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhula kwenkampani. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza ukude sekuyindlela yokuphila ezinkampanini zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uma izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuvumelanisa nezidingo zamathuba ezobuchwepheshe, zithuthukisa izinqubomgomo ezenzakalayo futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi nezinkampani, sizobona impumelelo ephezulu nokuthuthuka emisebenzini. Lokhu kuzoba nempempe ebheke phambili ezinkampanini zethu, futhi kuzonika abantu ithuba lokukhula futhi bakhe izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana.
Kukhishwe nguMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo weZizwe Ezihlangene. Pheka ukudla okwemvelo noma okukhuliswe kahle emasimini. Ukudla kwemvelo njengokudla kwenhlanzi, izithelo, nezitshalo nakho kung carrying i-cholera virus, kodwa le virus ingafa uma ukudla kuphikwa, ngakho qiniseka ukuthi awudli ukudla okungaphekiwe, futhi kufanele uhlanze izandla zakho ngemva kokudla. Uma ukudla kuphakathi, i-virus iyakhula. Ngakho, dlani ukudla okushisayo noma kuphinde kuphikiswe ngemva kokudla. Gwema ukuxhumana phakathi kokudla kwemvelo nokudla okukhishiwe. Ukudla okuphekiwe okuphephile nakho kung carrying i-cholera virus ngenxa yokuxhumana okuncane nokudla kwemvelo. Lokhu kuxhumana kungenzeka uma usika inhlanzi engaphekiwe ngenkathi usika ukudla okukhishiwe ngaphandle kokuhlanzisa izandla zakho. Ezindaweni ezithintekile yi-cholera, ukudla okufana nezithelo nezitshalo akuphephile ngaphandle kokupheka, njalonjalo. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokuqala ukupheka ukudla nangaphambi kwanoma yiziphi iziphazamiso, njengokushintsha noma ukugeza ingane, ukusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Hlanza izandla zakho futhi ngemva kokuphothula ukupheka ukudla okufana nenhlanzi nezitshalo ngemva kokuthinta ezinye izidlo. Indawo lapho upheka khona kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile; cabanga ukudla okungeke kudliwe noma indawo engahlanzekile njengoba ikhipha i-virus. I-cloth yokuhlanza izitsha kufanele ishintshwe nsuku zonke noma iphume emanzini emva kokusetshenziswa. Hlukanisa i-cloth yokuphuza okufanele futhi ihlanziswe njalo. Ukusebenzisa amanzi aphephile ukupheka kubalulekile njengokuwasebenzisa ukuphuza. Phika amanzi ngemva kokupheka ukudla kwengane. I-bleach noma i-iodine ingasetshenziswa esikhundleni samanzi aphekiwe. Faka isipuni esisodwa se-bleach noma i-iodine kumalitha angama-25 wamanzi, bese ulinda amahora amabili noma ubusuku obuphelele ngemva kokuyisebenzisa. II. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe ukudla okuphakela kuphephile? Pheka kahle zonke izidlo ezifana nezinkukhu, inhlanzi, nezitshalo. Dla ukudla okukhishiwe ngenkathi kusemva. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokupheka ukudla. Hlanza izitsha ngamanzi nesepha. Hlanza indawo lapho usika khona inhlanzi nezitshalo, njalonjalo, ngamanzi nesepha. Dla izithelo ezisikiwe ezifana nezorhwe noma amabanana. Gcina ihlanzekile - pheka, hlanza, nezinye izinto ukuze umise! Pheka ukudla kwakho. Phika ukudla kwakho. Hlanza ukudla kwakho. Ingabe amanzi akho aphekiwe noma aphephile? Ingabe amanzi akho agcinwe endaweni ephephile? Amanzi ahlanzekile ang carrying i-virus uma engagcinwanga endaweni ephephile. Gcina amanzi endaweni ehlelekile enevulandi. Sebenzisa amanzi agciniwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-24. Thela amanzi ebhodweni noma sebenzisa ikomishi ukuyiphakela. Gcina ihlanzekile - gcina amanzi akho ephephile. VI. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe uhlanza izandla zakho? Ukungcola okuningi ezandleni zakho kungakwenza uthole i-cholera ngaphandle kokwazi? Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ukugeza ingane. Ngemva kokupheka ukudla. Ngemva kokudla. Ngemva kokunikeza ingane yakho ukudla. Yini indlela engcono yokuhlanzisa izandla zakho? Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa isipele. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Hlanza izandla zakho njalo ngemva nangaphambi, phakathi kwezitho zakho, nasemanzini aphansi. Gcina ihlanzekile - hlanzisa izandla zakho? VII. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe usebenzisa indlu yangasese? Umuntu ohlanzekile angathola i-cholera esikhathini. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa indlu yangasese? Phuma udoti lwezingane endaweni yangasese noma ulifake phansi. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nesepha ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina ihlanzekile - sebenzisa indlu yangasese. Phuza amanzi avela emthonjeni ophephile noma ovikelekile. Pheka ukudla noma kuphinde kuphikiswe, bese kudliwa ngenkathi kusemva. Hlanza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokuthinta udoti noma ukuhamba, ngemva kokupheka ukudla. I-cholera ngeke ikubulale uma iphathwa kahle. Phuthuma isiguli esigulayo esikhungweni sezempilo ukuze sithole ukwelashwa. Phuza isiguli ngamanzi.
Ngesikhathi esashona, sazi ukuthi uMama Adelaide Tambo usanda kukhishwa esibhedlela. Nokho, saphinda sagcizelela ukuthi wayenomphefumulo wokubekezela kanye nesifiso esiqinile sokuphila phakathi kwethu. Sihlose ukumamukela yena nomndeni wakhe njengabavakashi emcimbini ngenyanga kaFebhuwari, kodwa lokho akwenziwanga. Kusasa sizokwenza ukuhlonipha kokugcina njengoba simfaka phansi. Ngakho, uzobe ekhona nathi emoyeni ngenyanga kaOkthoba kulo nyaka njengoba sibhiyozela usuku lokuzalwa kukababa wakhe, owayezobe eshaya iminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye, ubaba wezingane zakhe, umngane wakhe, umlingani wakhe, kanye nezingane ezidumile zethu, uOliver Reginald Tambo. Sizophinde sikhulumele umndeni kaTambo. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukumukela uMama ophakanyisiwe uAlbertina Luthuli, okhona phakathi kwethu namuhla ekuseni. Ungdaughter kaChief Albert Luthuli, owayengowokuqala ukuthola iNobel Peace Prize emhlabeni. Ukufa okubuhlungu kukaChief Luthuli, eminyakeni engamashumi amane edlule, kukhunjulwa kulo nyaka, futhi usizi lwaleso sikhathi lwaziswa lapho sathola ukuthi ushaye isitimela emasimini eshukela eKwaDukuza. Ukufa kwakhe bekuyimfihlo futhi kwashaqisa nomzimba, kodwa impilo yakhe ibingumfanekiso omuhle osiholela enkululekweni esiyibhiyozelayo namuhla. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ezimele inombono ocacile wokubonga ngalokho uAlbert Luthuli noOliver Tambo abakwenze ezweni lethu ngokusungula izimiso ezimbili zomphakathi ukuze kuhlonishwe amaqhawe - isimiso sikaLuthuli kanye nesimiso sabangane bakaO. R. Tambo. Ngiyaziqhenya futhi ngalabo abamukelwe kulezi zimiso zomphakathi ezihloniphekile. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukumukela ezindlini zephalamende labo ababe nomsebenzi ngonyaka ka-1956 ngesikhathi omama bephikisa imithetho yokupasa, nalabo ababe khona ngesikhathi uhlelo lwe-apartheid luphikiswa ngonyaka ka-1976, behlezi endaweni elungiselelwe umongameli. Angikhohlwa izindaba ezibuhlungu ezivela ezweni lethu ezivela kuzo zonke izifunda, ezikhethwe ngabakhulumeli bezifunda ukuze zabelane nabavakashi ababalulekile phakathi kwethu. Uhulumeni wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika engikhuluma nabo lapha namuhla, njengoba ngibe nebhadi lokwenza kanjalo eminyakeni edlule, wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2004 ngemuva kokhetho olwenziwe ngalolo nyaka. Emhlanganweni wonyaka, ngenyanga kaJanuwari, umkhandlu wombuso kazwelonke, ophakeme kakhulu esifundazweni, wathola isikhathi sokucabangela ukuthi imihlangano yawo ibhalile ukuthi manje isesikhathini sokuphathwa kukahulumeni okhethwe ngonyaka ka-2004. Angikhulumi kini ukuthi sithola inhlanhla yokuhola lo mkhandlu. Ekuboniseni lokhu, kubonakala kufanelekile ukuthi sibuze lo mbuzo - ingabe kukhona intuthuko esiyenzile ekulimaleni ukuze sifinyelele imigomo esakhuluma ngayo emphakathini ukuthi sizoyifinyelela ngezithembiso esizenzile, ukuthi abantu bethu basinikeze igunya lokuphatha izwe lethu kusukela ngonyaka ka-2004 kuze kube sekukhethweni okulandelayo ngonyaka ka-2009? Ngemvume yenu, ngithanda ukubuyela emuva futhi ngikhumbuze lokho esikukhulumile ngonyaka ka-2004, njengabaholi benkolo, nangaphambi kwabodadewethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, sahlanganiswa endaweni yokuhlangana kukahulumeni e-Union Building eTshwane ngosuku lokukhululwa, usuku esikhumbula inkululeko yethu eminyakeni eyishumi, futhi saphinde sajoyina isizwe ekubekeni umongameli wokuqala wombuso wokhetho, owasungulwa nguphalamende lwethu, ukuze kuhlonishwe izinterest zomphakathi ezikhonjiswe ekhethweni langonyaka ka-2004. Sekuphele isikhathi eside iNingizimu Afrika yethu ibinayo, futhi iphinde yakhombisa ukuphathwa kabi nangokucindezelayo emphakathini. Iyindawo lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke impilo yakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uphatha ukwesaba nokuthukuthela okufihlekile... Iyindawo lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phambili futhi ifaka ubuhle kwenye indawo enezindlela eziphambene, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo omuhle nothando. Iyindawo lapho ukuhlala endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuba bakucindezele, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezocindezelwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi impilo yabo ngeke ibe yinhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuthukwa nempi ezingenangqondo phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Iyindawo lapho ibonisa ukuthi uma uhlala ezindaweni ezithile, kuyindlela yokuphila ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukuba nezingxenye eziphakeme, izithiyo zikagesi, izinja zokuvikela, amapolisa aqaphelayo, nezinsizwa ezilungele ukuvikela labo ababa bethu nezibhamu, nezibhamu ezifihliwe emathuneni, nezindiza ezizokwehla zifeze labo abaphazamisa abazali... Ikuvuselela ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenziwe ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule lunikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, kanye nohlobo lomuntu ukuze basebenzisane ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labantu bonke abafana. Izinkinga eziphuthumayo zokuphila kwabantu ngeke zixazululwe uma singakhethi amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokunciphisa noma ukususa ubuphofu phakathi kwethu. Lokhu kuhlangana nokuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zabantu, ukunciphisa izinga lobugebengu, ukufundisa abantu ukufunda nokubhala, kanye nokuvula iminyango yokufunda nezindlela zamasiko... sithi kuzo zonke ezinkulu zethu nezingane ezazinikela ekufinyeleleni inkululeko, kanye nabangane bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke sikhokhele ithemba elibekwe kithi ngenkathi nisekela ukusiguqula iNingizimu Afrika ibe yidemo, umhlaba wokuthula, lapho kungabikho ukuhlukumeza ngokobuhlanga, noma ngokobulili, umhlaba ophumelelayo, ohlangene nezinterest zomphakathi. "Umsebenzi wokwakha le Ningizimu Afrika uqale. Lo msebenzi uzophinde uqhubeke kulesi sikhathi sesibili sokukhululeka kwethu." Emashumini eminyaka angama-50 edlule, ngenkathi silungiselela umhlangano omkhulu wabantu owamukela umqulu wenkululeko, izindaba ezibuhlungu zalolo suku zathi Masikhulume sonke ndawonye, ama-Afrika, labo abavela eYurophu, amaNdiya nabamnyama, bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, masikhulume sonke ndawonye ukuze sikhulume ngenhlalakahle, masikhulume ngenjabulo evela kubantu abaphila ezweni elikhululekile. Namuhla kufanele sikhumbuze isithembiso sethu, kufanele sikhulume ndawonye ngenhlalakahle, kufanele sisebenze emishinini ukuze
U-Winston Churchill: Umholi Ohlonishwayo U-Winston Leonard Spencer Churchill, owazalwa ngoJanuwari 30, 1874, eBladen, eNgilandi, waba yisimo esaziwa kakhulu emlandweni, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba. Impilo yakhe ibiyinsakavukela kakhulu. U-Churchill wayengumuntu ophakeme, onobuhlakani, futhi onothando lwezombusazwe. Imfundo yakhe yaqeqeshwa eHarrow School naseRoyal Military Academy eSandhurst, lapho aqala khona ukuhlela impilo yakhe yokuba umholi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo, waba ngumsunguli wezomkhosi, ube neqhaza elikhulu ezindaweni eziningi zokulwa, kuhlanganisa eBhulogwa, eMpi yaseNdiya, naseMpi yaseBhulogwa. Lokhu kumfundeza kakhulu, kwaba yisisekelo sokuba abe umholi ophumelelayo. U-Churchill waqala ukungena emkhakheni wezombusazwe ngo-1900, lapho afaka isicelo sokuba uNgqongqoshe weSifunda saseOldham. Waba ngumsunguli weqembu le-Conservative Party, kodwa wathuthela kwezinye izigaba ezahlukene, okwenza waba umholi ohlonishwayo. Ngemuva kokuba esebenza ezikhundleni ezahlukene, ngo-1911 waba nguNgqongqoshe Wezempi, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokulwa ezasiza iNgilandi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe I. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe I, waba nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, lapho aphatha khona izinhlelo zokuthutha amasosha, nakuba waphikiswa ngempumelelo futhi wathola izinkinga eziningi. Ngemuva kwempi, u-Churchill waphinde waba nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, lapho ahola khona izinhlelo ezibalulekile zokwakha umnotho wezwe. Wazisa izinhlelo zokwakha, futhi wayenombono omuhle ngempilo yempucuko. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba, u-Churchill waba nguNdunankulu kaNgilandi ngo-1940, lapho waphakamisa umoya wokulwa, wathi: "Ngizokulwa emakhaya, ngizokulwa ezindlini, ngizokulwa ezilwandle, ngizokulwa ezindaweni eziphakeme." Lezi zisho zaba yizimpawu zomoya wakhe ophakeme, futhi zakhuthaza abantu baseNgilandi ukuba balwe. U-Churchill waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi iNgilandi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekunqobeni uHitler, wabambisana nezizwe eziningi, okuhlanganisa neMelika, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi iMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba iyaphumelela. Wayengumholi onobuhlakani, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokulwa. Ngemva kokunqoba kweMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba, u-Churchill waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umhlaba omusha, waphakamisa umbono wokuthi izizwe kufanele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze ziqinisekise ubumbano. U-Churchill wakhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokwakha umhlaba, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni iNhlangano Yezizwe. Waqhubeka nokubhala, wathola umklomelo weNobel Prize for Literature ngo-1953. U-Churchill waba nguNdunankulu kaNgilandi futhi wathola ithuba lokuba nguMongameli weqembu le-Conservative Party. Nokho, waphinde waphikiswa, kodwa wahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme zomphakathi. U-Churchill wafa ngoFebhuwari 24, 1965, kodwa imisebenzi yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni. Wayengumholi ophakeme, onobuhlakani, futhi onothando lwezombusazwe. U-Churchill waba yisibonelo sokuhola, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uWinston Churchill waba yisithonjana sokuhola, futhi imisebenzi yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni. U-Churchill ungumholi ohlonishwayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka emhlabeni wonke.
Lo mbhalo ochazayo ushintshwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("UMthetho"). Uqukethe ulwazi nge-SAMSA kanye nenqubo yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umthetho Wokuphepha Kwamanzini ka-1998 wasungula i-SAMSA ngoMsombuluko ka-1998. Sinomsebenzi wokubika kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, ophakamisa ibhodi yethu futhi uvuma uhlelo lwethu lonyaka lwezohwebo. Ibhodi iphakamisa uMphathi Omkhulu (CEO) wethu, onomthwalo wemfanelo wezokuphatha nezokuhlela. Inhloso yethu ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokuphila nezimpahla olwandle, ukuvikela nokuvimbela imvelo yasemanzini ukuba ingcoliswe yizikebhe, nokukhuthaza uthando lwemikhumbi eNingizimu Afrika. Imisebenzi yethu yokusebenza ihlanganisa: ukubhalisela nokukhishwa kwamalayisense ezikebhe; ukuhlola izikebhe nokukhishwa kwamacertificates; ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezokuthutha emanzini nokubakhishwa amacertificates; nokuvimbela ukungcoliswa kwemvelo yasemanzini. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga ukuthi iKomidi Lezokuphila Lwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika likhiphe imigomo equkethe ulwazi oludingekayo umuntu adinge ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiluphi ilungelo ngaphansi koMthetho. Uma ufuna ukubona irekhodi elihlobene nanoma yiziphi zalezi zigaba, kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo elihlanganiswe nalolu mbhalo ochazayo (kodwa bheka isigaba 7 salolu mbhalo ochazayo). Kufanele uthumele ifomu lakho eliqediwe, kanye nemali yesicelo kanye nanoma iyiphi idiphozi (uma kudingeka), ehhovisi lolwazi kule ndawo yeposi, ngefeksi, noma kule imeyili ekhishwe esigabeni 2 salolu mbhalo ochazayo. Futhi ikheli lakho leposi noma inombolo yefeksi. Uma isicelo osithumelayo siwukwakhiwa komunye umuntu, kufanele unikeze ubufakazi obanele nobufanele ukuze ubonise ukuthi unegunya lokufaka isicelo ngabo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufinyelela kumarekhodi akusikho okwenziwa ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi kubalulekile ukuhlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zoMthetho ezihlobene nesicelo sakho. Uzokwaziswa ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha ngendlela obukhombisile efomini lakho. Noma ubani angafaka isicelo mathupha uma engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma uma engakhubazekile ngendlela yokuthi angakwazi ukuqedela ifomu. Kulokhu, abasebenzi behhovisi bazoqedela ifomu futhi banikeze usizo oludingekayo. Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi ibalwa ngokususelwa ezindlekweni zokukhiqiza, ucwaningo, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zokuthumela. Lapho umphathi wehhovisi wethu ethola isicelo sakho sokufinyelela kumarekhodi, uzocela (uma ungumfaki-sicelo) ukuthi ukhokhe imali yesicelo efanele ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uzocelwa ukuthi ukhokhe imali yokuthola irekhodi: le mali ihlanganisa izindleko zokuhlola, ukukhiqiza, nezinhlelo, kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezibekwe zokucela nokulungiselela irekhodi ukuze likhishwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthi likhishwe ngendlela oyifunayo. Ungacelwa ukuthi ukhokhe idiphozi ngaphambi kokuthi uthole irekhodi: le diphozi iyingxenye yenani eliphelele lemali yokucela irekhodi futhi ibuyiselwa uma isicelo singaphumelelanga. Lezi zigaba zolwazi zitholakala kalula ukuze zihlolwe, zithengwe, noma zikhishwe, noma zitholakala mahhala. Asinazo izinhlelo ezibekwe ze-SAMSA zokubandakanya umphakathi ukuze umphakathi uthinteke lapho izinqubomgomo zisungulwa, noma lapho imisebenzi yenziwa. Nokho, isigaba 11 soMthetho Wokuphepha Kwamanzini waseNingizimu Afrika No. 5 ka-1998 sisho ukuthi i-SAMSA kufanele ixhumane nalabo abathintekayo uma kudingeka, lapho kwenziwa imisebenzi yayo. Senza lokhu ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, njengokulandela izaziso ezifanele nezimvo zomphakathi uma umthetho ophakanyisiwe wephalamende wethulwa. Uma kukhona imibuzo mayelana nesimo esithile, wamukelekile ukuxhumana nehhovisi elikhulu noma ehhovisi eliseduze. Asinayo inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo ngaphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umphathi wehhovisi wethu ehluleka isicelo sakho, futhi unekhalazo ngalolo shintsho, kuzodingeka ulandele inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo yangaphandle. Uma unekhalazo mayelana nokwenqaba kwesicelo sakho ngumphathi wehhovisi, unelungelo lokufaka isicelo enkantolo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30. Noma ubani othintekayo angakwenza lokho. Isicelo samukelwa ngu: (bhala isikhundla, igama, nesibongo somphathi wehhovisi/noma umphakathi wabo) ng... Imali yesicelo (uma kudingeka): R... Idiphozi (uma kudingeka): R... Imali yokuhlola: R... B. Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... Igunya lokufaka isicelo, uma kudingeka komunye umuntu:... Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... D. Imali ekhokhwayo a Isicelo sokufinyelela irekhodi ngaphandle kwalelo rekodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwakho sizobhekwa kuphela ngemva kokukhokha imali yesicelo. b Uzokwaziswa ngenani okufanele ukhokhe. c Inani elikhokhwayo lokuthola irekhodi lizoncika endleleni okudingeka ngayo nokuthi isikhathi esidingekayo sokucela nokulungiselela irekhodi. d Uma ukhululekile ekukhokheni noma yiziphi izimali, chaza izizathu zokukhululeka kwakho. Uma ungakwazi ukufunda ngenxa yokukhubazeka, sicela ukhombise noma uchaze ukuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi njengoba kunikezwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, ubonise ukukhubazeka kwakho nokuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo. a Ukugcina isicelo sakho sokufinyelela irekhodi ngendlela oyicelile kuzoncika ekutheni le rekodi iyatholakala ngale ndlela. b Ukuthola irekhodi ngendlela eceliwe kungase kube nezithiyo kwezinye izimo. Uma kunjalo, uzokwaziswa uma irekhodi izokhishwa kuwe ngenye indlela. c Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi, uma kudingeka, kanye nendlela okudingeka ngayo kuzoba nomthelela. Ukuguqulwa komthetho 13. okungase kuhlolisise futhi kuqinisekise isijeziso semali esichazwe nguMsebenzi 185.00. Ukuguqulwa komthetho 13.00. b Ukufaka lesi sigaba kulandela f yomthetho ngaphambi kokuthi isimo: okungase kuhlolisise futhi kuqinisekise isijeziso semali esichazwe nguMsebenzi 85.00.3 " kanye c ukufaka igama elithi "nokunye" ngemuva kwe-semicolon ekupheleni kwesigaba f somthetho. c izidingo zokuqeqeshwa zabasebenzi abathintekayo ekuphathweni kwezimpahla zezindiza; kanye d ezinye izindaba ezihlobene nokuphepha kwezimpahla zezindiza. Noma ubani ophakathi kokwamukela/ukugcina/ukudlulisela nokuphatha impahla ezothuthwa ngezindiza ngokwesekwa kwezokuthutha kwezindiza kumele ahambisane nezinhlinzeko zokuphepha ezibekwe kulesi Sigaba. Akekho umuntu ongase abe ngumsebenzi wezokuthutha kwezindiza ukuze athwale impahla engaziwa. Noma yimuphi umphakathi ophathwayo osebenza ukuze wamukele/ukugcina/ukudlulisela nokuphatha impahla ezothuthwa ngezindiza kumele abe necebo lokuvuma elikhishwe nguMphakathi. Kudingeka ukuthi noma ubani osebenza kumphakathi ophathwayo futhi ophakathi kokuphathwa kwezimpahla ezaziwayo kufanele aqedele ukuqeqeshwa okukhulunywa ngawo kumthetho 108.06.1 futhi abe necebo lokwazi elifanele ukuze athole lokho ukuqeqeshwa. Umphakathi ophathwayo uzokwakha umqulu wezokuphepha oqukethe yonke imininingwane nezimpahla ezithunyelwa ngezindiza equkethe yonke imininingwane okukhulunywa ngayo kuSichazamazwi I-SA-CATS-aCS nendawo okukhulunywa ngayo ukuthi izosebenza kanjani. Lo mqulu uzonikezwa kuMphakathi ukuze wamukelwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukuba umphakathi onemvume noma oqinisekisiwe njengomthumeli wezimpahla owaziwayo uzovumela umuntu onegunya, umhloli noma umphakathi onegunya okukhulunywa ngaye nguMphakathi ukuba enze uphenyo olufanele nolwazi ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuthi iziqondiso zokuphepha eziphathelene nokuphathwa, ukuthuthwa nokugcina kwezimpahla ezaziwayo zihambisana nezidingo zalesi Sigaba. Labo abanecwecwe lokuvuma noma incwadi yokuvuma bazovumela umphakathi onegunya, umhloli noma umuntu onegunya okukhulunywa ngaye nguMphakathi ukuba ahlole noma iyiphi impahla ethunyelwa ukusuka noma ngaphezu komphakathi ophathwayo noma umuntu onemvume ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuhambisana noma ukuthobela lesi Sigaba. Izifundo Zobuchwepheshe: Ukuqonda Nokusebenzisa Ubuchwepheshe Ekuhlaleni Isingeniso Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ezimpilweni zethu, buphinde bube namandla amakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuphila. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukufunda ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe, njengoba lokhu kusivulela amathuba okwazi kahle indlela ubuchwepheshe obusebenza ngayo kanye nezinto ezintsha ezivela njalo. Lezi zifundo zikhuluma ngenzuzo, izinselelo, nemithelela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela zokubusebenzisa ngokuhlakanipha. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Ubuchwepheshe Ukuze uqale ukufunda ngezifundo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ngezindlela eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi amakhompyutha, izinhlelo zokusebenza, i-inthanethi, namadivayisi ahlakaniphile. Ukuqonda izisekelo zobuchwepheshe kufanele kube isinyathelo sokuqala. Thola izincwadi, izifundo eziku-inthanethi, noma ubuke imibukiso ethinta ubuchwepheshe. Ukuqonda lezi zinto kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda ngezinhlelo ezithile. Isigaba 2: Ubuchwepheshe Emhlabeni Wamanje Ngemva kokuba uqonde izisekelo, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlobene kanjani nezindawo ezahlukene zempilo. Isibonelo, emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe buguqule indlela esixhumana ngayo. Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuthumela imiyalezo, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana kukhuthaza ukuxhumana okusheshayo. Funda ukukhetha izinkundla ezifanele ezizokwandisa ukuxhumana nabanye. Isigaba 3: Ukusetshenziswa Kwetekhnoloji Kubuchwepheshe Bokufunda Ubuchwepheshe buphinde buhlinzeke izindlela ezintsha zokufunda. Izifundo eziku-inthanethi, amavidiyo, nezifundo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe zikhona ukuze zikhuthaze abafundi. Ukuqhubeka uphumelela, kufanele uqonde izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda. Zama ukusebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ezifana namavidiyo, izincwadi zedijithali, nama-forums ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho. Isigaba 4: Ukuhlola Izinsizakusebenza Ezingama-Online Izinsiza eziku-inthanethi ziwumthombo omuhle wokwandisa ulwazi lwakho. Kunezinkundla eziningi ezinikeza izifundo eziphathelene nezobuchwepheshe, ezihlanganisa ezikhokhelwayo nezamahala. Qala ngokusesha izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zakho, usebenzisa amasevisi afana neCoursera, Udemy, noma i-Khan Academy ukuze uthole izifundo ezikhethekile. Isigaba 5: Ukuqonda Izinselelo Nezinzuzo Zobuchwepheshe Kubahlala kubalulekile ukujwayela izinselelo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe. Nokho, ubuchwepheshe buhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziningi, kunezingozi ezithile ezihambisana nakho. Ukukhuluma nge-cybersecurity, ubungani bokuxhumana, nezinkinga zokuphila, ungafunda ukuhlola kahle lezi zinkinga. Ukuhlola izinzuzo nemiphumela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kuzokwenza ukwazi ukuhlela kahle impilo yakho. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlela Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ngemva kokufunda ngalezi zihloko, ungase uzizwe uthakasela ukwenza izinguquko ezithile. Uma ubona izindlela zokuthuthukisa impilo yakho, ungakwazi ukuhlela ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kungase kube ukuhambisa ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezihlakaniphile, noma ukufunda izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, ukuze ube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yakho. Isigaba 7: Ukubambisana Nezithakazelo Zobuchwepheshe Ukuxhumana nabanye abantu abanothando lwezobuchwepheshe kubalulekile. Ungaxhumana nabafundi, ochwepheshe, noma abantu abaphumelelayo emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlanganisa imicabango nezinsiza kuphakamisa ulwazi lwakho. Hlanganyela ezinhlelweni, amabhodi emiyalezo, noma izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze uthole izeluleko nemibono. Isiphetho Izifundo zobuchwepheshe zikhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe busiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni impilo yethu. Ukuqonda, ukufunda, nokusebenzisa kahle ubuchwepheshe kuyisisekelo sokuphila okuhle. Qhubeka ufunde, uhlale uvulelekile ezintsha, futhi usebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho. Ngale ndlela, ungaba neqhaza elihle emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe. Uthando lobuchwepheshe luthuthukisa impilo yakho futhi lwenza kube lula ukuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Phila kahle, ufunde, futhi uthuthukise!
Isinqumo somnyango sikhombisa incwadi yokuvuma noma yokwenqaba. Imigomo yokuvuma itholakala kwi-rekhodi yesinqumo (ROD), ehlanganiswe encwadini yokuvuma. Ukuphikiswa kufanele kuhambisane nawo wonke amadokhumenti afanele noma amakhophi aqinisekisiwe wale midokhumenti athunyelwe kumkomishana ophakanyisiwe. Ukuphikiswa kufanele kuveze wonke amaqiniso nezizathu zokufaka ukuphikiswa. Ingabe ufaka leli phikiso njengomuntu siqu noma egameni lomphakathi/organisasi? Uma ufaka egameni lomphakathi noma organisasi, sicela unikeze ubufakazi obuvumela ukuthi wenze kanjalo. Ingabe ukuphikiswa kwakho kusekelwe ezindaweni ezihlobene nenqubo eyalandelwa umfaki-sicelo wokuvuma? Ingabe ukuphikiswa kwakho kusekelwe ezindaweni ezihlobene nemiphumela yemvelo engamukeleki eyangaphathwa umnyango ngesikhathi wenqaba noma evuma isicelo? Ingabe uyavuma ukuqhubeka nale misebenzi uma ukukhathazeka kwakho kungaxazululwa ngokushintsha uhlelo noma ngokucacisa noma ukususa okukhona ngenxa yomsebenzi? Ingabe uqinisekile ukuthi uyaphikisa ukuqhutshelwa kwalomsebenzi endaweni okwenziwa kuyo? Ingabe ukuphikiswa kwakho kuqukethe ulwazi olusha olungazange lunikezwe umeluleki wezokuphepha kwemvelo noma umnyango ngaphambi kokuthi umnyango ucabangele isicelo sakho? Uma impendulo yakho phezulu ingu-yi, sicela uchaze ukuthi kungani umphathiswa engafanele ukukucabangela nokuthi kungani lokhu kungazange kunikezwe umeluleki wezokuphepha kwemvelo noma umnyango ngesikhathi senqubo yesicelo. Angiphikisi ukuthi leli phikiso lifakwe yinoma iyiphi ithathu ethakazelisayo futhi ethintekayo noma/nomphakathi, njengoba ngiqonda ukuthi inqubo ye-EIA iyinzuzo yomphakathi.
Ithini inhloso yeqembu lokufunda? Umsebenzi obalulekile wohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabafama ukuheha nokuphatha amaqembu okufunda. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukukhuthaza abakhiqizi abasafufusa abangenasemaphandleni ukuba benze amaqembu okufunda ukuze bakwazi ukuhlangana njalo ukuze bahlaziye ukuqeqeshwa okukhona nolwazi oluhambisana nokukhiqizwa kweziphuzo. Izindlela zokuthola umhlaba, ukukala nokunquma usayizi wendawo yokulima noma insimu, ukurenta insimu, izinhlobo zomhlabathi, nezindlela zokuphatha izihlahla ezindaweni zakho. Ukuphatha izibungu emasimini nasekuphatheni izifo ezithinta izithelo. Izinhlobo zezihlahla, ukuphatha izihlahla ngezinto zokwakha nezimishini, ukuphatha izihlahla ezifana nogwayi, ukufaka ama-herbicides ngaphambi nangemva kokutshala, nokufafaza emigqeni noma ensimini yonke. Ubungozi bezibungu, umshwalense wezibungu, umshwalense ojwayelekile, nezidingo zokuthola umshwalense.
Inkululeko isitholile, manje sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babe nesandla ekuguquleni izwe lethu libe yilokho esilwe ngakho. Okokuqala emlandweni wethu nasezweni lethu, abantu bethu banikezwe ithuba lokuba nezwi ekubizeni izindawo. Ngale ndlela, kumele sikhombise ukuthi izinto zishintshile, ukuthi sesidlule esikhathini sokwahlukaniswa. Kumele sishintshe umfanekiso wezwe lethu ukuze ungaveli njengengxenye yeYurophu kodwa njengaseAfrika. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezizoholela ekushintsheni lezo ziqu ezaziyisikhumbuzo nezihlambalazayo, amagama ezizwe atholakala kwamanye amazwe kanye nalawo abhalwe ngendlela engalungile. Lokhu kuyimfanelo eqondiswe kuNgqongqoshe wethu Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye neTekhnoloji ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempela. Kuyimfanelo yethu njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka. Impumelelo yalesi sizathu izoba uphawu lokuguqulwa kweqiniso ezweni lethu elisebuhlungu bokushintsha. INingizimu Afrika inohulumeni obumbene futhi kufanele ibonise le shintsho kubantu abavotele yona nakwabanye abaseduze kwayo. Kumele isebenze ngokushesha njengamazwe asendaweni angakazisa le mizwa ngokususa konke okukhumbuza ngeminyaka yokucindezelwa nokwahlukaniswa. Kulezi zifomu, abantu banelungelo lokuphakamisa amagama amasha kanye nezinguquko kumagama akhona, uma iziphakamiso zilandela nezizathu. Le mibiko ilungiswe kusukela ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kweBhodi kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka wokuqala wokwabiwa kwemali. Ukuxhaswa kwemisebenzi ehhovisi leBhodi kuvela kuMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye neTekhnoloji (DACTS). Ekuqaleni, bekuphansi kweBhodi Yezilimi Yezwe yalolu Mnyango. Abantu nezinhlangano ezingahambisani nezinqumo ezenziwe yiBhodi bangase babhekane nezinyathelo zomthetho. Abanikezwayo bazosebenza kwiBhodi Yezwe Yezindawo Zokubiza. Ibhodi ithathe indawo yeKomidi Lezindawo Zokubiza elaleluleka uhulumeni ngokuqinisekiswa kwamanye amagama ezindawo kusukela ngo-1940. Omunye umehluko obalulekile phakathi kweBhodi kanye nomnyango owasebenza esikhathini esedlule ukuthi le Bhodi inikezwe amandla amaningi ukuze ibhekane nazo zonke izinhlobo zezindawo kuhlanganise; ukufuna lezo zindawo ezidinga ukubizwa kabusha noma ukubizwa okokuqala futhi ukuthi izinqumo zayo zizoba namandla, uma ziqashelwa nguNgqongqoshe. Ibhodi isungule umgomo nezindlela, kulandela izinqumo nezindlela zeZizwe Ezihlangene. Ibhodi inegunya phezu kwazo zonke izindawo zokubiza nezinto kanye nezakhiwo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeNingizimu Afrika nasezindaweni lapho leli zwe lilawula, noma lezo zindawo ezitholakala ngokuqhubekayo. Ezinye izizathu ezisemthethweni zingatholakala namagama abantu abaphilayo. Ukunquma igama noma amagama endaweni kudinga ukuqhathaniswa ngokucophelela phakathi komlando nesidingo solimi, ukuhamba kalula kokuxhumana, umphakathi kanye nenhloso kazwelonke. Ukukhuthaza ulwazi mayelana nezinzuzo zomnotho kanye nokuhlangana komphakathi ngenxa yokufana kwamagama ezindawo. Ukuze kuvezwe isu lokususa, ezinye izindawo ezabizwa ngaphansi kokucindezelwa kufanele zifakwe. Ukuze kube lula, ukusabalalisa ulwazi nokudlulisa ulwazi ngohlelo oluhlelwe kahle lapho amagama ezindawo akhiwa, angashicilelwa ezincwadini noma ngombiko wekhompyutha. Ukuze uthumele intlanzi usuka eNingizimu Afrika uye kwamanye amazwe noma ngaphandle kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika, kumele ufake isicelo sesikhwama sokuthumela esikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMnyango ophethe ezokuxhumana zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuthumela intlanzi ngaphandle kwalesi sikhwama. Faka isicelo sesikhwama esisha uma lesi onaso siphelelwe isikhathi ngemva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wesikhwama, lesi sikhwama sakho singase sithathwe noma sikhanselwe. Faka isicelo sesikhwama sokuthumela. Funda ifomu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uqedela zonke izidingo zenqubo yesicelo. Nikeza ubufakazi bokuthunyelwa kanye nekheli labo abazokunikeza intlanzi ofuna ukuyithumela, kuhlanganise namagama ajwayelekile nezesayensi zentlanzi kanye nenani lentlanzi ozoyithumela.
