Umbhalo: Kubhalwe ngumkhiqizi ophumile emsebenzini. Ngesikhathi salo nyaka, imvula ihluka phakathi kuka-600 no-2,000 mm ezindaweni lapho kukhuliswe khona uhlobo lwezithombo, kanti kwezinye izindawo kube khona u-50 mm kuya ku-75 mm ngosuku. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umhlabathi uthole amanzi futhi ube nzima futhi ugcwele amanzi. Okwesibili okwenzeka lokhu: ukujula kwemishini yokuvuna, ama-traktor, nokuhamba kwezinsimbi ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nezinqola ezithutha uhlobo lwezithombo ngesikhathi sokuvuna kuzokwenza umhlabathi ube nzima kunezinye izinyanga lapho kunganeni kakhulu imvula. Izinkomo ezibekwe ezindaweni zokukhulisa uhlobo lwezithombo ukuze zidle izinsalela zempande nazo zizokwenze umhlabathi ube nzima uma kukhona amanzi amaningi. Uma kukhona amanzi amaningi ezindaweni, ungazama ukuhlinzeka ngaphambi kokutshala noma ngesikhathi sokutshala, mhlawumbe lokhu kungakusiza ukuthi utshale ngesikhathi esifanele. Kulonyaka bekubanda kakhulu ebusika futhi kwezinye izindawo kube nemvula, ngakho umhlabathi awukwazi ukuwomisa kahle. Kungasiza ukuhlola isimo sephansi lomhlabathi uma ufuna ukutshala uhlobo lwezithombo, bese ungasebenzisa umshini wokuhlinzeka ukuze uthole izindawo ezinzima ngaphansi komhlabathi ophakeme. Lo msebenzi uzosiza futhi ukuvuselela umhlabathi (lokhu kubalulekile). 'Amabhaktheriya' nom 'microbes' aphila kuphela ephepheni eliphezulu lomhlabathi, efika phezulu kuka-150 mm - 180 mm. Igama elithi 'aerobic' lisho ukuthi kukhona umoya ne-oyili, i-nitrogen, nomoya ongu 'carbon dioxide' uma umhlabathi uhlinzekwa. Inqubo yokuhlinzeka ibalulekile ngoba isiza amabhaktheriya ukuba aphule izinsalela zezitshalo zonyaka odlule ngaphambi kokutshala izitshalo ezintsha. Umsebenzi wamabhaktheriya uzokwenziwa uma izinga lokushisa lomhlabathi liqala ukukhuphuka kusukela ekupheleni kuka-Agasti kuya kuSepthemba kuze kube u-Okthoba. Siphinda sithi kubalulekile ukuthi ukuhlinzeka kwenziwe ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi umhlabathi ugcwele amanzi. Uma ukuhlinzeka kwenziwa ngesikhathi esifanele, kuzokwandisa ubukhali bomhlabathi, ngeke kunciphe. Umkhiqizi kufanele aguqule imishini yabo ukuze bayise ngendlela ezokhipha imiphumela emihle. Ukuphathwa nokulungiswa (mhlawumbe nokushintsha) kwezinsiza ezingakaze zenziwe kufanele kuqedwe ekuqaleni kuka-Okthoba.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, izimo eziphuthumayo ziba yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphendula zibe nezinga eliphezulu lokusebenza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bathola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze sithole impendulo efanele, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngokuqhubekayo ngentuthuko yesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zifaka phakathi izimo zemvelo, izigameko zokuhlukumeza, nezimo zokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphendula kufanele zibe nezinqubo ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezimo ezithile. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, kudingeka ukuthi sibe nezinsiza ezanele, abantu abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuphendula, okuzokwenza kube nokuphendula okusheshayo. Ngokwesibili, ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomgibeli omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphuthumayo, zingasiza ekutholeni ulwazi oludingekayo ngokushesha. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma izikhungo zokuphendula zingakwazi ukuthola ulwazi oluqondile, isikhathi sokuphendula siba sisheshile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bokuhlola izimo, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa, zingasiza ekutholeni izimo eziphuthumayo ngokushesha, ngaleyo ndlela zinciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula. Okwesithathu, ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu abaphendulayo kubalulekile. Abantu abaqeqeshiwe bangakwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngempumelelo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, izikhungo zokuphendula kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bazo bahlala beqeqeshwa ngezindlela ezintsha zokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazi kahle izinyathelo okufanele bazithathe, futhi bazithathe ngokushesha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene zokuphendula kubalulekile. Uma izikhungo zokuphendula zikwazi ukuxhumana kahle, isikhathi sokuphendula siba sisheshile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezikhungo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo ezixhumanisa lezi zikhungo, ukuze zikwazi ukusebenza ngokubambisana. Ngokuphetha, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinto eziningi. Ubuchwepheshe, ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo kuyizici ezibalulekile ezizothuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula. Uma sithatha lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngosizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele, okuzokwenza kube nokuphila okungcono kubantu abathintekayo. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula, kodwa futhi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo.
Isingeniso se-OpenAI Ngokukhula okukhulu kobuchwepheshe, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezishintsha izindlela esisebenza, sikhuluma, futhi sithokozisa ngazo. Phakathi kwalokhu, i-OpenAI ibonakala njengomholi ophambili ekuhlinzekeni ngesisombululo esisebenzayo sokufunda komshini, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile. Le mbiko izogxila ekuchazeni i-OpenAI, imisebenzi yayo, kanye nomthelela wayo emhlabeni wonke. Ukwakhiwa kwe-OpenAI I-OpenAI yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2015 ngenhloso yokwakha ubuhlakani bokwenziwa obukwazi ukusebenza ngokubambisana nabantu, ukuze izinzuzo zalesi sikhungo zifinyelele kubo bonke. Abasunguli bayo, kubandakanya u-Elon Musk no-Sam Altman, babona isidingo sokuhlonza izingozi ezikhona ngenxa yokukhula kwe-AI, baqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Imisebenzi ye-OpenAI I-OpenAI ibonisa imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezimodeli zokufunda komshini ezithuthukile. Isibonelo, i-ChatGPT iyisibonelo esiyingqayizivele sokuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bungenza kanjani ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Le modeli iyakwazi ukuphendula imibuzo, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, nokuxoxa ngezihloko eziningi, konke lokhu ngendlela ehlekisayo nephumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-OpenAI ibamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene ezithuthukisa imikhakha ehlukene, njengezempilo, ezemfundo, nezezimali, ziqinisekisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Umthelela we-OpenAI emhlabeni Umthelela we-OpenAI emhlabeni ubonakala ezindaweni eziningi. Ngokwakha izixazululo ezithuthukile, i-OpenAI isize ukunciphisa izindleko, ithuthukise ukusebenza kahle, futhi ikhulise izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Ezempilo, izinhlelo ze-AI zisetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngocwaningo oluphuthumayo, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izindlela zokwelapha eziphumelelayo. Ezemfundo nazo zithole izinzuzo ezinkulu, njengoba abafundi bengasebenzisa izinhlelo ze-AI ukuze bathole ulwazi olujulile, okukhulisa imiqondo yabo. Izinselelo ezibhekene ne-OpenAI Naphezu kwemisebenzi emihle, i-OpenAI ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu iwukuhlola umthelela omubi we-AI. Njengoba ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buqhubeka nokukhula, kunezinkinga ezithinta ubuqotho, ubumfihlo, kanye nezingozi zokusebenzisa kabi lezi zinsiza. I-OpenAI ibalulekile ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, iqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala benolwazi olufanele. Ukwenza Ngcono Izenzo Zokuhlola I-OpenAI ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zayo zokuhlola, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yayo iyahambisana nezindinganiso eziphakeme. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokubuyekeza ezibandakanya abaphenyi, abacwaningi, kanye nomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, i-OpenAI iqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zayo zihlala zicacile, ziqinile, futhi zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho I-OpenAI iyisikhungo esibalulekile emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe, esihlinzeka ngesisombululo esiphumelelayo sokufunda komshini kanye nobuhlakani bokwenziwa. Nakuba izinzuzo zayo zikhula, izinselelo azipheli, kubalulekile ukuthi i-OpenAI iqhubeke nokwenza ngcono izinqubomgomo zayo, iqinisekise ubuqotho, kanye nokuhlola umthelela wayo emhlabeni. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhamba phambili ngendlela efanele, buhlinzeka ngothando, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu.
Inkinga Yokubhalisa Emanyuvesi: Izithiyo Ezingabhekana Nabafundi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inkinga yokubhalisa emanyuvesi iyinhloso ebalulekile, ibhidliza amaphupho nezifiso zabafundi abaningi. Lokhu kubangelwa izinselelo ezihlobene nokuhlinzekwa kwezindawo zokubhalisela izifundo, izinqubo eziyinkimbinkimbi, kanye nezimo ezinzima zezimali. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuze kucace ukuthi kungani le nkinga ibalulekile kubafundi nabazali, nakuba ivame ukuvela njalo ngonyaka. Ngaphambi kokuqala konyaka wesifundo, abafundi abasha banikezwa ithuba lokubhalisela izifundo, kodwa lokhu kuvame ukuhamba kancane ezinsukwini zokugcina zokubhalisa. Lokhu kudala ubunzima kubafundi abasha nabathuthela emanyuvesi, njengoba imfuneko yokubhaliswa iba nzima kakhulu. Abafundi bahlola izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokubhalisa, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuqedela lezi zinqubo. Izinkinga ezitholakala emakhosombeni emanyuvesi zikhuluma ngokuqinile ngokuvela kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezithile ezihlinzekwa yizikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. Ngokwesibonelo, ezinye izikhungo zikhombisa izinkinga zokungabi nakho ukuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezivela ezinhlelweni zokubhalisa, okuhlanganisa amawebhusayithi angasebenzi kahle, izinsizakalo ezitholakala zikhawulelwe, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikole neminyango yokubhalisa. Ukungqubuzana phakathi kwemali, isikhathi, nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kudala umoya wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabafundi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abaningi bahluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo ukuze baqedele izinqubo zabo zokubhalisa. Abafundi abavela emakhaya anothile bangathola izinsiza ezihlukahlukene, kodwa labo abavela emakhaya aphansi bahlala behluleka, njengoba izinsizakalo zokubhalisa zingase zibe zikhawulelwe, noma nezimali zokubhalisa zingabizi kakhulu. Ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu zokubhalisa, abanye abafundi baphinde babhekane nezinselelo zokuhamba. Izinhlangano ezithile zikhuluma ngokuthi kukhona izinkampani ezizimele ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza zokubhalisa, kodwa lezi zinsizakalo zihlala zikhokhiswa kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima kwabafundi abaningi. Lokhu kufakazela ukuthi inkinga yokubhalisa ayikhona nje emkhakheni wezokubhalisa, kodwa ibanjwe ezindlekweni eziphezulu ezihambisana nezifundo. Uhlaka lwezombusazwe luphinde lunikeze isithombe sokuthi izinkinga zokubhalisa zingahluka uma kubhekwa izikole ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlobene nezimboni zokufundisa ezihlukene, ezithinta izikole ezincane kanye nezikole ezinkulu. Izikole ezinkulu zihlala zikhona ezikhaleni ezikhangayo, kodwa lokhu kwenza kube nzima kwabafundi abasha abafuna ukufinyelela ezikoleni ezidumile. Abafundi abasha basebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukukhangisa izinkinga ezibhekene nabo, njengezinkinga zokungabi nakho kokubhaliswa, ukuze baziwe. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwamagama ezinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubhalisa ezisheshayo, kodwa akukwazi ukuqeda zonke izinkinga ezikhungethe abafundi. Uhlaka lwezombangazwe lunenhloso yokunciphisa lezi zinkinga zokubhalisa, futhi abaholi bazo balungisa izinqubo ezahlukene ukuze kuzuzwe ukuxhaswa kwempilo yabafundi. Ucwaningo olwenziwa ezikhungweni zemfundo luhloswe ukuthola izixazululo eziphelele ezizophumelela ekubhaliseni, njengoba kudingeka izinguquko ezinkulu emikhakheni yokuheha nokuqinisekisa ukwesekwa kwezimali. Ngokuphetha, inkinga yokubhalisa emanyuvesi ibalulekile, futhi izidingo zabafundi zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngempumelelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathweswe iziqu bangaphumelela, bahloniphe izifundo zabo. Ubulunga bezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa yizikhungo zemfundo ephakeme bukhomba ukuthi kwenziwa umsebenzi omkhulu, kodwa izivumelwano ezikhethekile zidingekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinkinga zokubhalisa zixazululwa. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, ukwandisa izinsiza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsizakalo zokubhalisa ngendlela elula.
Usain Bolt: Umgibeli Ohlonishwayo Emhlabeni Wokugijima UUsain Bolt, owazalwa ngomhlaka 21 kuNhlangulana 1986 eTrelawny, eJamaica, uyisibonelo esihle sokuphumelela emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Ubulili bakhe, ubuhlakani bakhe, kanye nesifiso sokuphumelela, konke kumenze waba yisithonjana esihamba phambili emhlabeni wokugijima. Usain, owaziwa kakhulu ngophawu lwezikhala, uqale ukujolisa abantu emhlabeni ngempumelelo yakhe emqhudelwaneni wezokugijima, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinzima ezifana ne-100m ne-200m. Ubulunga bukaBolt buqala eminyakeni eminingi edlule, lapho aqala khona ukuzikhandla futhi efuna ithuba lokukhombisa amakhono akhe. Ngonyaka we-2008, uBolt waphakanyiswa washiye umhlaba udana ngempumelelo yakhe emqhudelwaneni weziMidlalo zeMidlalo yaseThunazi, lapho akhiphe khona irekhodi elisha le-100m elingu-9.69 seconds. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuqala sokuthi uBolt ungumgibeli oyingqayizivele. Ngemva kwalokho, wahamba wahola kumqhudelwano omkhulu, ethola izindondo eziningi zeGold Olympic, izindondo eziphakeme kakhulu emhlabeni wokugijima. Ngaphezu kokuba umgibeli ophumelele, uUsain Bolt ungumholi omkhulu emkhakheni wezokugijima. Ubuye waba nokuzimela okukhulu ekwenzeni izinqumo zakhe, ethola izikhangiso eziningi kanye nezivumelwano zokuqashwa nezinkampani ezinkulu. Ubuye waba nguMphakathi, ehlanganisa imikhankaso yokusiza abantwana kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imidlalo ezikoleni. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uBolt akagibeli nje kuphela kodwa uphinde abhekelele izidingo zomphakathi. UUsain Bolt uzinze emhlabeni wezemidlalo, futhi ukwazi kwakhe ukujabulisa izigidi zabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni ubuhlobo phakathi kweJamaica nezinye izizwe, ikakhulukazi ezemidlalo. Ubuye wagqugquzela amalungu amasha emhlabeni wokugijima ukuba aphile impilo enempilo futhi azikhandle ukuze afinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ubulungiswa bakhe nokuzinikela akubonisi kuphela ekugijimeni, kodwa futhi nakwezinye izici zokuphila. UUsain Bolt uveze ukuthi umphakathi ungawuthokozisa kanjani emithonjeni emisha. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu kulabo abathanda ukuzijabulisa ngemidlalo, ikakhulukazi abantwana. Ngempela, uBolt uyinkanyezi enkulu eqhubekayo nokukhanya emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Ubulungiswa bakhe emqhudelwaneni, umoya wakhe ophila, nokuzimisela kwakhe, konke kumenza waba yisigaba esihlonishwayo, futhi akukhona nje kuphela emhlabeni wezemidlalo kodwa nasekuphileni kwansuku zonke. UUsain Bolt uqhubekile nokuba yisibonelo esihle sokuphumelela, nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele phambili. Ukuba khona kwakhe emhlabeni wezemidlalo kuzokhunjulwa njalo. Usuku lokugcina lokugijima kwakhe, owawuqedwa ngoMgqibelo, ungobunye bezinsuku ezikhumbulekayo, lapho abalandeli bethu behamba phambili bephakamisa izithombe zikaBolt, bezibonisa imizwa yokuhlonipha. Ngokuphetha, uUsain Bolt ungumgibeli onguye owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni, onomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezokugijima, owahlinzeka ngothando, umoya, nokuzinikela. Uyenze umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi lapho umhlaba ubona izinhlonipho ezinjalo, uUsain Bolt uzohlala engumgibeli ophumelele, onobuntu, ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo ayikhona nje kuphela ngemijaho, kodwa futhi kuyi-journey yokuphila lapho ubumqoka bukhona, nokuthi wonke umuntu angafinyelela izinjongo zawo uma enza kahle, efuna ukufinyelela empumelelweni.
Ibhokisi: Indaba Yomphakathi Ekuqaleni, emzaneni omncane ogama lakhe linguMkhumbane, kwakukhona umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele abantu abanesithakazelo esikhulu emidlalweni. Phakathi kwabo, kwakukhona uSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyi-16, owayenothando olukhulu lokubhokisa. U-Sipho wayehlala ebuka ama-video abhokisi abavela emhlabeni jikelele, efisa ukuba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. U-Sipho wayengakaze abhokise, kodwa wayenokholo olukhulu. Ngosuku oluthile, uSipho wahlangana noMnumzane Mthembu, owayengumqeqeshi odumile emzaneni. UMnumzane Mthembu wayenolwazi olunzulu ngalesi sikhathi, futhi wayephokophele ukufundisa abantwana abasha. U-Sipho wathola ithuba lokuhlangana naye, wakhuluma ngothando lwakhe lokubhokisa. “Ngicela ungifundise, Mnumzane,” kusho uSipho, enesibindi. “Ngifuna ukuba ngcono, ngifuna ukuba umbhokisi ophumelelayo.” UMnumzane Mthembu wamomotheka, wathi: “Kulungile, Sipho. Kodwa kufanele uqonde ukuthi ibhokisi akukhona kuphela ukuhamba phambili. Kufanele ufunde ukuzithiba, ukuzinikezela, nokusebenza kanzima.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waqala ukuqeqeshwa. Waqala ukufunda izisekelo, izikhumbuzo, nezindlela zokubhokisa. Ngemva kwezinyanga eziningana zokuzikhandla, uSipho wathola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza emncintiswaneni wendawo. Kwakuyinsuku enkulu, futhi wonke umphakathi wawubheke phansi. U-Sipho wayezizwa ethokozile, kodwa futhi ethukile. Wazi ukuthi umphakathi wawulindele kuye, futhi wayefuna ukwenza kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuncintisana, uSipho waphuma emkhakheni, waphuma phambili, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu. Waqala ukulwa nomphikisi wakhe, uThabo, owayedume kakhulu. UThabo wayenamandla, kodwa uSipho wayenothando olukhulu lokuwina. U-Sipho wakhumbula izifundo zikaMnumzane Mthembu, wathola amandla okuphumelela. Waqhubeka nokulwa, waphumelela, futhi ekugcineni, wathola umqhele. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yinkanyezi emzaneni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuwina, uSipho waphinde wahlangana noMnumzane Mthembu. “Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane. Ngaphandle kwakho, ngingase ngingaphumelelanga,” kusho uSipho, enomusa. UMnumzane Mthembu wamomotheka, wathi: “Uphumelele ngenxa yokusebenza kwakho kanzima, Sipho. Khumbula, ibhokisi akukhona kuphela ukuhamba phambili, kodwa futhi ukufunda nokukhula.” U-Sipho waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, futhi waba umqeqeshi wezizukulwane ezilandelayo. Wafundisa abanye abantwana emzaneni wakhe, wabelana ngothando lwakhe lokubhokisa. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma uzikhandla, ungafeza amaphupho akho. Ngaleso sikhathi, ibhokisi lathola ukubaluleka okukhulu emzaneni. Kwakungesikhathi sokuhlangana, sokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano. U-Sipho, njengomqeqeshi, wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele, futhi umphakathi waba namandla. U-Sipho waphinde wathola ithuba lokuncintisana emhlabeni jikelele. Wazithokozisa, waphumelela, futhi waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Kodwa akazange akhohlwe umphakathi wakhe, futhi njalo wabuya emzaneni, efundisa abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi ibhokisi akukhona kuphela umjaho, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Wafundisa abanye ukuthi ibhokisi lidinga uthando, ukuzithiba, nokusebenza kanzima. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yinkanyezi engapheli. Ngakho-ke, ibhokisi lathola ukubaluleka okukhulu emzaneni, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma uzikhandla, ungafeza amaphupho akho. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uSipho waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezemidlalo, ethokozisa abanye ngothando lwakhe lokubhokisa.
Lo mbhalo awuhloselwe ukuba ube yidokhumenti ebanzi engathathwa njengomthombo wolwazi kodwa usebenza njengesinsiza sokuhola ochwepheshe abasebenza emshadweni nasekuhlukaniseni ifa emthethweni wamasiko. Ngenxa yemithetho ehlukumezayo, emishadweni ethile yabantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika, ayizange ibonwe noma yaphuma emhlabeni ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo ulethe izinguquko ezibalulekile kumasiko njengoba sizobona ebhalweni. Ngokufanayo, indlela yokuphathwa kwezimpahla zabantu abamnyama abashonile ngaphandle kokukhetha abathathi-ndaba yayiphikisana kakhulu nemthethosisekelo, ngakho-ke izigameko ezedlule zaphusha uMnyango Wezobulungiswa ukuba aguqule imithetho ukuze ihambisane neMthethosisekelo. Kungasho futhi ukuthi umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo awuhambisani namasiko abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kodwa asihlosile ukuhlela lokhu kulokhu kuxoxwa. Uzoba yijaji. Ngaphambi kokugxila kakhulu ekuxoxweni kweMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko (owaziwa lapha njengomthetho), kubalulekile ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wesimo somthetho esithinta imishado yamasiko "nemaqembu endabuko" aqediwe ngaphambi kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000, (lolu suku lapho lo mthetho uqala khona). Nokho, ukufakwa kwezimpahla kwaphumelela kuphela lapho indoda ishada omunye ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sendabuko, ehlukile emshadweni wezempi. Ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, umthetho wokushada uMthetho 88 ka-1984 washicilelwa, phakathi kwezinye izinto, wakhansela amandla okushada anikezwa indoda phezu kwenkosikazi lapho beshadile ngaphansi komthetho wezempi. Lesi sinqumo saholela ekutheni kusukela ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, amandla okushada anikezwa indoda mayelana nenkosikazi yakhe akhishwe esigabeni esikhanselwe 22. Ngoba labo abashadwe ngaphansi kwemishado yamasiko bangenakubhekwa njengabashadile ngokomthetho, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi omunye wabo ngaphansi kwalolo shado angabopha umshado wezempi nomunye umuntu. Umthelela walomshado wezempi waholela ekupheleni kwemishado yamasiko ekhona. bheka uNkambula v Linda 1951 1 SA 377 A noMalaza v Mndaweni 1975 BAC C 45. Inkosikazi ngaphansi kwalomshado wamasiko yayibhekwa njengenkosikazi enganakiwe. Inkosikazi yalolo shado lwamasiko ingashada nomunye umuntu ngaphansi komshado wezempi, ngaleyo ndlela umshado wamasiko ekhona waba sephumile. Umbuzo wokuthi "lo mqondo" uvuselelwa yini uMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 isigaba 2, lo mbuzo kumele unqunywe yizinkantolo. Nokho, isigaba 22 seMthetho Wokuphatha kwabantu abamnyama 38 ka-1927 sinikeza imizamo yokuvikela umndeni onganakiwe uma indoda ifa. Ngokwenzela ukuphawula ngababheki, isimo sokuba yindodakazi kanye nezingane zomshado wezempi kusebenza ngokufana nalabo bomshado wamasiko. Kucacile ukuthi isimo esingcono esinikezwa enkosikazi eshadwe ngaphansi komthetho wezempi nezingane zayo sesiphumelele futhi zibhukwa ngokufana nenkosikazi nezingane ezinganakiwe. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushintsha Umshado 3 ka-1988 owawuqala ngomhla ka-2 kuZibandlela 1988, uMthetho Wokuphatha kwabantu abamnyama ka-1927 waguqulwa. Umthetho weshintsho ulethe lezi zinguquko ezilandelayo. Umthelela wokukhansela lesi sigaba wawuholela ekutheni yonke imishado eNingizimu Afrika ibe nefana futhi uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwempahla Yabantu Abashadile 88 ka-1984 wawusebenza emishadweni yabantu abamnyama aqediwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988. Imishado eyenzeka ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988 ixuba izimpahla ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesivumelwano sokuhlukanisa izimpahla futhi ibhaliswe ehhovisi lemidlalelo ezinyangeni ezintathu ngaphambi komshado. Isici esisha nesibalulekile ukuthi "umshado wamasiko" awukwazi ukuxoshwa ngomyalo wezempi. Isigaba 221 sivimbela indoda eshadwe ngaphansi komthetho wamasiko ukuthi izibophezele emshadweni wezempi nenkosikazi ngesikhathi isashadile ngaphansi komthetho wamasiko. bheka uThembisile v Thembisile 2002 2 SA 209 T noKwitshane v Magalela 1999 4 SA 610 TK. Ngeshwa, akukho ukulungiswa okunikezwa kwesimo lapho umshado wezempi uvela ngemuva komshado wamasiko. Kwamukelwa ukuthi umshado wezempi onjalo awunamsebenzi. Isigaba 3 seMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 sivimbela omunye wababheki abakhona emshadweni wamasiko obonwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ashade ngokomthetho ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushada 25 ka-1961. Umqondo ofanayo njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni 2.3.2, futhi lapha akukho ukulungiswa okunikezwa kokwephula lo mthetho. UMthetho Wokushada eTranskei 21 ka-1978 uvumela indoda eshadwe ngaphansi komshado wezempi ukuthi ithathe futhi ngaphansi komshado wamasiko, inqobo nje uma umshado wamasiko ungafaki izimpahla. Ngokufanayo, indoda eshadwe ngaphansi komshado wamasiko ingashada futhi ngaphansi komshado wezempi, ngaphandle kokuxosha umshado wamasiko, inqobo nje uma umshado wezempi ungafaki izimpahla. Lo mthetho uqale ukusebenza ngomhla ka-15 kuNovemba 2000 futhi uthathile isinyathelo esibalulekile sokwamukela yonke imishado yamasiko ebhekwa ngokomthetho. Lo mthetho unomthelela wokubuyisela emuva futhi uzoxoxwa isigaba ngesigaba. Lo mthetho usebenza kuzo zonke imishado yamasiko eqediwe ngaphansi kohlelo lomthetho wamasiko, amasiko, nezindlela zendabuko ezihloniphekile ngabantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika futhi uyiqembu elingxenye yesiko labo. Ngakho-ke, kucacile ukuthi lo mthetho usebenza kubantu abathile, usebenza kuphela kubantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika, inqobo nje uma umshado wenziwa ngendlela ebekiwe ngamasiko noma ngezinhlelo zabantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika. Imishado yabantu ababili noma imishado yepholigami eyenziwa ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000. Imishado eqediwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000 kumele ihambisane nezidingo zomthetho. Izidingo ezibekiwe kulo mthetho ziqinile futhi ukungahambisani kuholela emshadweni ongenamsebenzi. Bobabili ababheki kumele babe nesifiso sokushada ngaphansi komthetho wamasiko. Akekho phakathi kwabashadile okufanele abe yingxenye yomshado wamasiko omunye. Kumele kube nezinkulumo ngomshado futhi zenziwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wamasiko. Ukuze umshado wamasiko ube semthethweni, ngaphandle kwezidingo ezichazwe ngenhla, kumele kube nesivumelwano esinikezwa esigabeni 7 (ukuxoxwa okuphelele, bheka isigaba 5.2.2). Isigaba 4 seMthetho sikhombisa
Ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni (GEMS self-employed/pensioner income verification) kubalulekile kakhulu kulezi zinsuku. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezimpilo zabo, kudingeka ukuba babe nemininingwane ethile ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Uma kuziwa ekufakeni izicelo zokuxhaswa ngemali noma izinsizakalo, ulwazi oluqinile nolwakheke kahle mayelana nemali engenayo luyadingeka. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kubalulekile, futhi kuyingxenye ebalulekile ye-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kubo bobabili abazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nemali engenayo kudinga izinqubo ezithile. Abazisebenzayo, abangasebenza emikhakheni ehlukene, kufanele bathumele ubufakazi bemali abahola ngayo, okubandakanya izinkokhelo ezitholwa emisebenzini yabo, ama-invoice, noma amabhuku ezimali. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe imali engenayo, ukuhlinzeka ngencwadi yezezimali evela kumeluleki wezomnotho kungaba usizo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathatha impesheni badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ehlobene nezinsizakalo abazitholayo, okuhlanganisa amakhadi empesheni, izitatimende zezimali, kanye nemibhalo ethile evela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakala eminyakeni edlule. I-GEMS ibheka lezi zidingo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abagibeli bayo bahlonipha izimfuneko zomthetho. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu abazisebenzayo baqhubeke behlola izimo zabo zezimali, njengoba imali ingenayo ingashintsha ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi bahlale benolwazi olwakheke kahle ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo zokuphila. Futhi, abathatha impesheni badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala behlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze bazi ukuthi bahlala bejolise emiphumeleni ethile. Ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, i-GEMS ibalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Uthando lokuthola umbono ophusile kulokho okudingayo kubalulekile, futhi i-GEMS ibonisa indlela yokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kube lula. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abatholi bezinsizakalo bahlala bejolise emiphumeleni ethile. Ekuphetheni, ukuqinisekiswa kwemali engenayo kwabazisebenzayo nabathatha impesheni kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukuze kube nezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, abantu badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala behlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa isimo sokukhula komnotho kuwo wonke umuntu, futhi umphakathi ungalindela izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uhlonishwa. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba banemithombo ethe xaxa yokusiza abantu bafeze izidingo zabo zezimali.
Ukuntuleka Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Emiphakathini Yasemakhaya Emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuyinkinga enkulu ethinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Le nkinga ibangelwa izizathu ezihlukahlukene, futhi ibonakala ngokucacile emiphumeleni yokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Izizathu Zokuntuleka Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Esikhathini esiningi, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya kuhlobene nezimo ezithile. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zikhawulelwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhono abantu abawatholile, izinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngaphandle kokufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokufunda ezisezingeni eliphezulu, abantu basemakhaya bahlala bephoqeleka ukuba baphile ngezindlela ezincane. Okwesibili, izimakethe zomsebenzi zihlala zikhula kuphela ezindaweni ezinkulu. Emiphakathini yasemakhaya, izinkampani ezinkulu nezimboni azitholakali kalula, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlale bezama ukufuna umsebenzi emadolobheni, okwandisa izinga lokuhamba kwabantu. Imiphumela Yokuntuleka Kwamathuba Emisebenzi Imiphumela yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi ibonakala ezimpilweni zabantu. Okokuqala, abantu abangenamathuba emisebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukudla, izindlu, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka, futhi abantu abaningi bahlala bephila phansi kwezinga lokuphila elidingekayo. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuholela ekutheni abantu baphume emiphakathini yabo, baye emadolobheni, okwandisa izinga lokuhlala abantu emadolobheni. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezinsiza emiphakathini yasemakhaya, futhi kwandisa umthwalo wezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izixazululo Zokuthuthukisa Imisebenzi Emiphakathini Yasemakhaya Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi benze izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono abantu. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezihlinzeka ngamasu okuphila. Ngokwenza lokhu, abantu bazokwazi ukuthola amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele ezimakethe zomsebenzi. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza izinkampani ukuthi zisebenzise abantu basemakhaya. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo zokwakha izinkampani ezincane, okungasiza ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Izinkampani ezincane zingaba yinsika ekwakheni umnotho emiphakathini yasemakhaya. Isiphetho Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi emiphakathini yasemakhaya kuyinkinga ebalulekile edinga ukunakwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izizathu ezibangela le nkinga, imiphumela yayo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakha izindlela zokuthuthukisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu basemakhaya. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile, enempilo, futhi enezinhloso eziphakeme. Ukusebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa el better kwabantu basemakhaya.
Isingeniso Ukubhukuda kuyinto emnandi futhi ewusizo, engasiza ekuphuculeni impilo yethu. Ngaphandle kokuba umthombo wokuzithokozisa, ukubhukuda kuthuthukisa amandla omzimba, kuthuthukisa ukujikeleza kwegazi, futhi kunciphisa ingozi yokugula. Kulabo abaqala, lezi zinyathelo ezilula zizokwenza kube lula ukufunda ukubhukuda ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukubhukuda, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi unendawo efanele yokubhukuda, njengemfula, ichibi, noma ichibi elikhulu. Bheka izimo zomoya nezamanzi, uqiniseke ukuthi akukhona okungase kube yingozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, qiniseka ukuthi unempahla efanele yokubhukuda. Izimpahla zokubhukuda ezifanele zifaka i-swimsuit, izicathulo zokubhukuda, kanye nekhanda elivikelayo uma kudingeka. Ungakhohlwa futhi ukuthola umoya omuhle, ungathola izibuko zokubhukuda uma uthanda ukubona kahle ngaphakathi kwamanzi. Isinyathelo 2: Ukufunda Izinyathelo Zokuqala Uma usulungile, qala ngokufunda izinyathelo ezilula. Thola indawo enamanzi angashintshi kakhulu, bese uqala ukufaka izinyawo zakho emanzini. Qala ngokuhamba kancane, uzame ukujwayela umswakama. Lokhu kuzokwenza uzizwe ukhululekile emanzini. Ngemva kwalokho, zama ukugxila ekuphumuleni. Beka izandla zakho phansi, bese uzama ukuphakamisa umzimba wakho ngaphezulu kwamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi ungaphila kanjani emanzini. Qhubeka uzama ukugcina umoya wakho, ungavumeli ukungezwa kwephunga ukuba kukuthinte. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubhukuda Ngendlela Eyisisekelo Uma usuzizwa ukhululekile, qala ukufunda indlela yokubhukuda eyisisekelo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokubhukuda zikhona, kodwa sizogxila ku-front crawl, okuyindlela elula futhi esheshayo. Qala ngokubeka isikhumba sakho emanzini. Phakamisa izandla zakho phezulu, bese uzama ukuhamba phambili. Phakamisa isandla esisodwa, bese usithumela phambili, kanti omunye usendaweni yalo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umzimba wakho uhamba phambili. Khumbula, uma uvula umlomo wakho ukuze uphume umoya, qiniseka ukuthi uvalile kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza ungatholi amanzi emlonyeni. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuthuthukisa Amandla Nokusebenza Njengoba uqhubeka, zama ukwandisa isikhathi sokubhukuda. Zama ukuthola umoya omuhle, ungavumeli umzimba wakho uphume emanzini. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthole amandla amakhulu. Ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukene ukuze uthuthukise ukusebenza kwakho. Izinsiza ezifana nezikhwama zokubhukuda zingasiza ekwakheni amandla emzimbeni. Zama ukwenza imisebenzi ethile, njengokubhukuda ngamamitha angu-25, bese uphumula. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthole umoya omuhle. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphepha Emanzini Ukuphepha emanzini kubalulekile. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlale unakekela, ungakwenzi okuthile okungase kube yingozi. Hamba nabangani, ungakwazi futhi ukufunda ukubhukuda ndawonye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube mnandi futhi kuphephe. Uma ungakaze ubhukude, cabanga ukufunda nezifundo zokubhukuda. Abafundisi bezokubhukuda bangakusiza uqonde kahle izinyathelo ezithile nokuthi ungazithuthukisa kanjani. Isiphetho Ukubhukuda kuwumsebenzi omuhle ongakwenza ungathokozisa impilo yakho. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo ezilula, ungafunda ukubhukuda ngendlela efanele. Khumbula, ukubhukuda akukhona nje ukuhamba emanzini, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila enempilo. Qhubeka uzijwayeze, uzithokozise, futhi uphile impilo enempilo. Qhubeka ufunde, futhi ungakuthola ukufunda okungcono kakhulu, ukuze uthole injabulo emanzini.
Umhlaba unamanzi athile, futhi lawa manzi ahamba - akhuphuka abe phezulu bese ebuyela phansi. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi umjikelezo wamanzi (umjikelezo wezamanzi). Ukuhlangana kwenzeka lapho ilanga likhanyisa amanzi emifuleni nasemachibini, futhi amanzi aguquka abe yiphunga noma umusi. Lawa manzi manje akhuphuka emifuleni nasemachibini aye emoyeni. Lokhu kuyimisebenzi yezitshalo ezikhipha amanzi ngeziphumo zazo. Iphunga nokuhlangana yizinqubo ezivumela amanzi ukuba abuyele emoyeni. Lapha, iphunga (ukukhanya) emoyeni kupholisa futhi kuhluka kube yizigaxa, kudala amafu. Lokhu kwenzeka uma amaningi amanzi emoyeni eqoqana futhi engasakwazi ukuhlala emoyeni. Bese amafu eqala ukuba nzima, futhi amanzi aqala ukuwa phansi - imvula, umoya, umswakama. Uma amanzi ewa phansi ngenxa yokuthi agcwele, ahamba aye olwandle, emifuleni, emachibini, noma emhlabathini. Uma amanzi ehlangana nomhlabathi, ayawathola futhi sithi yamanzi aphansi azosetshenziswa izitshalo, izilwane, nabantu. Okusele kuzohamba emifuleni, emachibini, nolwandle - bese umjikelezo uqala futhi. Kungani izitshalo zidinga amanzi? Amanzi asekelwa kahle isakhiwo sezitshalo. Amangqamuzana ezitshalo aqukethe kuze kufike ku-90% amanzi. Lawa mangqamuzana aqukethe amanzi asekelwa isitshalo. Uma amangqamuzana ezitshalo ephelelwa ngamanzi, isitshalo siba mncane futhi sithambekele. Uma amanzi ephelelwa ngokuphelele, sonke sizofa. Amanzi asiza isitshalo ukuba sipholile uma sishisa (ukuhlangana). Amanzi asiza futhi ekwakheni isitshalo, ehlanganisa ne-carbon dioxide ukuze kudaleke ama-carbohydrates. Amanzi ayawuhlanza amaminerali futhi athumele le miphako emhlabathini aye ezimpandeni bese efika esitshalo.
Ezokuphepha: Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Impilo Nempahla Yakho Ezokuphepha zibalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Zihlanganisa izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu, impahla, nemininingwane yethu ivikelekile. Ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zinyathelo, sizobheka izigaba ezahlukene zokuphepha, izinqubo ezilula zokuzilungiselela, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Izingozi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izingozi ezihlukene ezingase zibe khona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izingozi zomzimba, ezifana nezingozi zokweba, kanye nezingozi zedijithali, ezifana nokuhlaselwa kwe-cyber. Ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zingozi, cela ukuthi ubheke izimo ezijwayelekile ezithinta indawo ophila kuyo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo zokuvikela. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlela Uhlelo Lokuphepha Ngemuva kokuba uqonde izingozi, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuhlela uhlelo lokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubeka Izikhumbuzo: Beka izikhumbuzo ezikhumbuza abantu abahlala nawe mayelana nezinyathelo zokuphepha. Lokhu kungaba yizikhumbuzo ezibhaliwe noma izithombe ezikhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphele. 2. Ukubeka Izinsiza Zokuphepha: Qinisekisa ukuthi unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengokwakha izithiyo, ukufaka amakhodi okungena, noma ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha zedijithali. 3. Ukuhlela Ukuhlola: Hlela ukuhlola izinhlelo zakho zokuphepha njalo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zisebenza kahle futhi zihlala zisesikhathini. Isigaba 3: Ukuqeqesha Abantu Uhlelo lokuphepha alusebenzi uma abantu abazi ukuthi kumele benzeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqeqesha abantu abahlala nawe. Lokhu kungafaka: - Izifundo Zokuphepha: Hlela izifundo ezimfushane ezichaza izinyathelo zokuphepha, izingozi ezivamile, kanye nezindlela zokuzivikela. - Ukuhlela Imicimbi Yokwazisa: Hlela imicimbi yokwazisa lapho abantu bengakwazi ukufunda ngempela ngezokuphepha. Lokhu kungaba yizinkulumo, izifundo ezibukhoma, noma imidlalo yokufunda. Isigaba 4: Ukuphatha Izimo Eziphuthumayo Noma ngabe uhlela kahle, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela. Kubalulekile ukuba necebo lokuphatha lezi zimo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubeka Izinhlelo Zokuphuma: Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi angaphuma kanjani endaweni uma kwenzeka ingozi. Lokhu kufanele kube lula futhi kube nesikhumbuzo esicacile. 2. Ukuxhumana: Hlela indlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Lokhu kungaba yifoni, i-SMS, noma izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. 3. Ukuhlola Izimo: Ngemuva kokuphuma, hlola ukuthi bonke abantu baphumile ngokuphepha. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi akekho oshiywe emuva. Isigaba 5: Ukuvuselela Uhlelo Lokuphepha Uhlelo lokuphepha akufanele luhlale lungashintshi. Njengoba izimo zishintsha, kufanele uvuselele uhlelo lwakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubuyekeza Izinhlelo: Hlala ubuyekeza izinhlelo zakho zokuphepha ukuze zihlale zisesikhathini. Lokhu kungafaka izinguquko ezidingekayo ngenxa yezinguquko ezimakethe noma izingozi ezintsha. - Ukubuyekeza Ukuqeqeshwa: Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu kuhlale kuqhubeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bahlale beqaphele futhi bazi ukuthi kumele benzeni. Isiphetho Ezokuphepha zibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuvikela impilo yakho, impahla yakho, kanye nemininingwane yakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi uqonda izingozi, uhlela uhlelo lokuphepha, uqeqesha abantu, uphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, futhi uvuselela uhlelo lwakho njalo. Ngale ndlela, uzokwazi ukuvikela wena nabathandekayo bakho. Khumbula, ukuphepha akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila.
Ukuhlanganisa inani - ingabe lokhu kungakhuphula inzuzo? Ukuhlanganisa inani kungaba yindlela esetshenziswa abalimi ukuze bakhuphule inzuzo abathola yona futhi bathuthukise imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Ngamafuphi, ukufaka inani, noma ukuthuthukisa inani kusho ukusebenza ngomkhiqizo wakho ngendlela ezokwandisa inani (imali) yalowo mkhiqizo. Yini ukufakwa kwenani? Ukwandisa inani lomkhiqizo kusho ukuthi umalimi kufanele aqale ukusebenzisa (ukuguqula) umkhiqizo wezolimo ngendlela ezokwenza kube nokwenzeka imali kulowo owenza ukufaka inani, nokunye. Lokhu kuzodinga utshalomali olungeziwe ngoba kuzodingeka ukuthi kube nomsebenzi owengeziwe, njengokuhola abasebenzi abasha noma ukuthenga imishini emisha, ngakho kufanele kubalwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kutshalwa kwezimali okungeziwe phezu kwezinye izindleko zokuguqula umkhiqizo kuzokhiqiza inzuzo ephezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubala izindleko ezintsha nokuthuthukisa amasu okucabangela izimakethe nezintengo kufanele kwenziwe njalo - izimakethe zomkhiqizo zihlala zishintsha futhi izimakethe zishintsha njalo - kwesinye isikhathi ukufaka inani kuzokbringela inzuzo, kwesinye isikhathi kungaba nje izindleko. Kungani kubalulekile kubalimi ukuba babambe iqhaza, basebenze ndawonye, futhi banakekele le misebenzi yokufaka inani? Njalo abakhangisi bavame ukuvumelana nenani lezimakethe abathola lona, abakwazi ukuhlela inani lezimakethe, lelo nani limiswa ngabathengi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abathengi bazokwenza isinqumo sokuthi bazokhokha malini ukuze bathenge into ethile, abalimi abanamandla okucela inani eliphakeme. Ngakho, abalimi kufanele bacabangele izindlela ezizobasiza ukuthi bathole inzuzo ephezulu uma umkhiqizo wabo uphume emasimini ngoba umsebenzi omkhulu wenziwa ukuze ulungiselele lezi zinto zokudla ukuze kufezwe inzuzo engcono esikhathini esizayo. Ukwengeza inani kumakhenikhazi. Inani lezimakethe kumakhenikhazi ngo-2010 laliphansi kakhulu, abalimi badinga ukuhlela ezinye izindlela zokukhuphula inzuzo yomkhiqizo wabo. Isibonelo: kungabalwa kalula ukuthi kuzoba nenzo engakanani uma amakhenikhazi ehlatshwe futhi athengiswe njengomgubo. Ake siqale ngokuthi singathengisa ithani lamakhenikhazi ngo-R1,000.00 kwi-cooperative. Kodwa umalimi angakwazi futhi ukuhluza amakhenikhazi akhe amhlophe futhi athengise umgubo ozodliwa abantu nasezinkampanini. Futhi angakwenza lokhu yena (ngomshini wakhe) noma angathatha amakhenikhazi akhe emshinini bese ehlatshwa khona bese ethengisa ezipakisheni. UMr. Farmer angase acabangele ukuhluza amakhenikhazi namuhla nangesonto elizayo nokuthi uzothola malini uma eba umhluzi futhi. Ingabe unendawo eyanele emasimini akhe ukuze enze lo msebenzi noma uzodinga ukuqasha enye indawo? Ingabe kukhona imithetho yezempilo okufanele ayilandele nokuthi lokhu kuzobiza malini? Yimuphi uhlobo lwemishini oludingekayo nokuthi kuzoba yini impumelelo yesikhathi eside? Lapha sikhuluma ngezinto ezifana nemishini yokuhluza, izikali, imishini yokupakisha, nezinye ezipakisha amabhakede/amaphakheji, njll.? Yimuphi uhlobo lwamaphakheji oludingekayo nokuthi uzowathola kuphi? Kuzobiza malini ukufaka amalebula, ama-logo (amagama ezimpahla), nezinye izinto? Uzodinga abasebenzi abengeziwe? Uzokhangisa kanjani lo mgubo? Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi lokhu kuyisibopho sesikhathi eside futhi uMr. Farmer uzobopha yena kulomsebenzi wokuhluza isikhathi eside. Enye inketho kaMr. Farmer ingu: Angathatha amakhenikhazi akhe amhlophe emshinini oseduze ukuze ahluzwe abe ngumgubo. Le yinketho ephumelelayo ngoba uzokhetha isikhathi lapho inani lezimakethe lamakhenikhazi liphansi kakhulu ukuze athengise ezimakethe, bese ehluzela emshinini ukuze athengise umgubo ukuze akwazi ukukhuphula inzuzo yomkhiqizo wakhe. Lokhu kumnika ithuba lokukhetha lapho ethengisa noma lapho ehluza. Akukwazeki ukutshalwa kwezimali okwengeziwe ukuze wandise ibhizinisi lakhe kodwa kuzoba nokwanda kwempahla. Umqali ngamunye kufanele acabangele zonke izindlela ezizosebenza kahle kuye endaweni ahlala kuyo. Kuzoba nokulahleka okungu-20% ngoba umhluzi uthatha izikhumba nezinsalela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ngizothola ama-800 kg omgubo kumakhenikhazi ami angu-1,000 kg. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umhluzi uthatha u-R320 ukuze ahluze amakhenikhazi. Amakhenikhazi: 1,000 kg - 20% yokulahleka (200 kg izikhumba) = 800 kg yomgubo kuphela. Kodwa: ama-800 kg omgubo adinga ukupakishwa ngumhluzi ezipakisheni ezifanele. Okwamanje, lowo mgubo ungathengiswa ngo-R2.20 ngekilogramu. Imisebenzi emisha iyadalwa. Kukhona izindlela eziningi zokuhlola uma ubheka ukuhlanganisa inani nokukhuphula inzuzo. Mhlawumbe kungakhiqiza inzuzo eningi uma uMr. Farmer esebenzisa amakhenikhazi akhe ukukhulisa izinkukhu, izinkomo, izimvu, noma izinkomo. Mhlawumbe inzuzo izokhula uma i-ethanol ikhiqizwa kumakhenikhazi. UMr. Farmer angase athole ukukhula kwenzuzo ngendlela akhetha ngayo ukusebenzisa amakhenikhazi akhe. Konke lokhu sizobuyela kukho futhi esikhathini esizayo.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi lunikeza abalimi imibhalo enembile mayelana nokulima njalo ngenyanga ngephephandaba lethu - iPula/Imvula. Amakhophi angama-18,000 e-iPula/Imvula distributes to farmers in 7 languages every month - isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiNorthern Sotho, isiZulu, nesiXhosa. Njalo ngenyanga, iPula/Imvula iqukethe amakhasi ayi-8 asekelwe yiMaize Trust. Kukhona namakhasi amane aphelile ngesiSesotho ngoMashi, ngoJuni, ngoSepthemba, nangoDisemba asekelwe yiWinter Cereals Trust. IIOPOT nayo inamakhasi amane aphelile kuzo zonke izilimi (ngaphandle kwesiXhosa) ngoJanuwari, ngoAprili, ngoJulayi, nangoOkthoba. Sihlala sizama ukufaka imibhalo ezosiza abalimi ngalolo suku. Le mibhalo ixoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene nezwe, ukulima, izindlela zokukhiqiza, ukumaketha, imishini, nokuphathwa kwezindawo zokulima. Sifuna futhi ukubonga abaxhasi bohlelo lwethu ngokusinika ithuba lokufaka isandla emsebenzini wethu wokuthuthukisa nokuguqula ukulima ezweni lethu.
Ezentsha: Ukubaluleka Kwezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Abantu Abasha Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, abantu abasha bahlala bejolise emathubeni amaningi okukhula, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuzimela. Izinhlelo ezihlobene nezentsha zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho abantu abasha benza ingxenye enkulu yabantu. Ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngezinto ezithinta abantu abasha, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abasha. Ezinye zalezi zinkinga zihlanganisa ukungasebenzi, ukufinyelela emfundweni, kanye nezinkinga zempilo. Ukungasebenzi kubonakala njengomsebenzi omkhulu, njengoba abantu abasha behluleka ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuzimela. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphoxeka, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufinyelela emfundweni kuyinselelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho izinsiza zihluleka ukufinyelela abantu abasha. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye bahlale benqaba amathuba okuthola imfundo ephakeme, okuthinta ikusasa labo. Ngokubhekisisa lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi bahlanganyele ukuze bathuthukise izinhlelo ezithinta abantu abasha. Izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezokusebenza, kanye nezokweluleka zingasiza ekwakheni amathuba okukhula. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlanganisa imikhakha ehlukene, njengezobuchwepheshe, ezokwakha, nezokuxhumana, zingasiza abantu abasha ukuba bathole amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuthola imisebenzi, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokweluleka zingasiza abantu abasha ukuba baziqonde kahle izinketho zabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele mayelana nezifundo, imisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abasha bahlala bejolise ekutholeni amathuba angcono, futhi izinhlelo zokweluleka zingasiza ekwakheni umqondo wokuzimela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukwakha izikhungo zokuxhumana ezihlanganisa abantu abasha. Lezi zikhungo zingaba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, kanye nezinsiza. Ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu abasha kuzokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oludingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukubhekana nezinselelo ezihambisana nezimpilo zabo. Ngokubheka izinhlelo ezithinta abantu abasha, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinkampani. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokuthuthukisa abantu abasha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okukhula. Ekugcineni, abantu abasha bahlala bejolise emathubeni okukhula, kodwa izinselelo ezibhekene nabo zidinga ukunakwa. Ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngezinto ezithinta abantu abasha, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantu abasha zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu ahlanganyele ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa labantu abasha, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela emathubeni angcono, futhi bakhe impilo engcono. Ngokuhlanganisa izinsiza, ukwakha izikhungo zokuxhumana, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluqinile lokweluleka, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abasha ukuba baphumelele, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okukhula. Ngakho-ke, sithumele izwi lokuthi abantu abasha badinga ukuxhaswa, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ezithinta abantu abasha ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Ezabesifazane: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha iZinduna Zabesifazane Ngomhlaka 15 kuJuni 2023, kwaba nempumelelo eMnyangweni KaMasipala weTheku, lapho abesifazane bahlonishwa khona ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo ekwenzeni izwi labo libonakale emphakathini. Lo mcimbi wawuhloswe ukukhumbuza nokuqhakambisa umthelela obalulekile wabesifazane ezimpilweni zabantu. Uhlelo lwawuholwa nguNkk. Thandiwe Nkosi, lwathi luhlanganyela abesifazane abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze babelane ngamava, bavule izingxoxo ezimnandi, futhi banikeze izeluleko. Umcimbi uqale ngamazwi akhuthazayo avela kumongameli weqembu lesifazane, uNkk. Mbali Dube, owathi, "Amakhosikazi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kumele sithuthukise izindlela zokukhuthaza abesifazane ukuze babe namathuba alinganayo, sishaye indiva izithiyo ezibhekene nabo." Lokhu kwathokozisa abathandekayo, banika ugqozi lokulandela izinyathelo ezihlosiwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, umphakathi wahlangana ngendlela ejabulisayo, lapho abesifazane abanikazi bamasiko nemisebenzi behlanganyela. Phakathi kokuxoxa, abesifazane banikeza izifundo ngezindlela ezintsha zokuphila, behlola izindlela zokuzijabulisa. Omunye wemicimbi ebalulekile wawuhlanganisa abafundi, abathandi bezobuchwepheshe, kanye nabaphathi, okwakuholela ekuxhumaneni nokwabelana ngolwazi ngezifundo ezahlukene, ezempilo, ezokukhangisa, nezobuchwepheshe. Kwakuphawulekayo ukuzwa abesifazane bethuthukisa amakhono abo, benika amacebo okwakha imisebenzi yabo. Kwakukhona nendaba ethokozisayo, lapho osaziwayo bephendula izinkinga ezithinta abesifazane, bephendula izimpendulo ezibalulekile. USolwazi Nandi Midiya, owaziwa kakhulu ngocwaningo lwakhe emkhakheni wezempilo, uthe, “Ukuphila kwabesifazane kubalulekile, futhi kudinga ukugxilwa. Abesifazane kufanele bazi ukuthi banamandla okuthinga izikhala ezibalulekile.” Lokhu kudala ukwamukela, kukhombisa umbono wobuholi obuvulekile. Umcimbi uphinde wavula amathuba okwakha izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa, okwenza abesifazane abampofu bakwazi ukwenza izaziso ezithinta umkhiqizo, nokuvuselela umoya wokukhula ezimbonini. Umcimbi wagcina ngenkulumo ebandakanya bonke, ukunikeza ithuba lokuhlonipha abesifazane abasinikeza amandla. Uthando, umoya wokubambisana, nomgomo wokuhlonipha umusa wabesifazane kwaba izici ezibalulekile. Kwaba nomoya opholile phakathi kwezingxoxo, bavelisa izimvo ezintsha zokuhamba phambili. Umcimbi waphothulwa ngodumo nolwazi olusha, olwakha isibopho esijulile phakathi kwabesifazane. Lokhu kuveza umuzwa wokuhloniphana, umoya wokukhuthazela kokubumbana, nokwakha umphakathi onobuhle. Umcimbi, obubhalwe ezincwadini, uvale ukufudumala nokuhlomula kobudlelwano phakathi kwamakhosikazi. Ekugcineni, umcimbi waholela esimisweni sokuthuthukisa inhlalakahle yabesifazane, uqhubeka ngempumelelo, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nezinhlelo ezijulile ezizokwenziwa ukuze abesifazane bahlonyiswe futhi bakhuthazwe. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikhulise izwi labo, sithuthukise izifundo, futhi sibe nomnotho owaziyo. Umcimbi ubonisa amandla amakhulu abesifazane, kumele bahlonishwe ukuze bakhule ngezifundo ezikhethekile. Abesifazane bahlonipha izilimi zabo, bahlonipha imikhuba yabo, futhi bathola amandla okwenza uma behlangana. Umcimbi uzwakalisa lokhu, ulethe izikhumbuzo ezithinta ubunjalo babo futhi nokuqhubela phambili kokwakhiwa komphakathi onokuthula nobumbano.
Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo Isingeniso Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo bayawulandela umthetho, futhi baphinde bagcine izindlela zokuxhumana ziphephile. Le ndaba ihlola impumelelo yalesi simiso, izinguquko ezitholakele ezikhathini ezedlule, kanye nemithetho ehambisanayo. Izizathu Zokuhlinzeka Ngemvume Imininingwane elula kodwa ebalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo ibalulekile, njengoba umuntu kumele anikeze imvume ukuze abahlinzeki bezempilo bakwazi ukuphatha idatha yakhe. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eGEMS nabahlinzeki bempilo kuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Ukungahlinzeki imvume kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuxhumana, nokudlula kwemiyalo ethinta imininingwane eyimfihlo. Ukubaluleka Kwezimvume Ukugcina isithunzi somuntu kubalulekile ukuze kwakhiwe ukuzethemba phakathi kwabahluleli kanye nezinsizakalo zezeMpilo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo phakathi kweGEMS nabahlinzeki bezempilo kudinga imvume efanele. Abantu bazizwa bephumule uma beqinisekiswa ukuthi imininingwane yabo izophathwa ngendlela efanele, futhi bazogcinwa benelungelo lokugcina ubulungu bempilo bungalokothi buphazanyiswe. Izinselelo Ezinzima Nakuba imvume ibalulekile, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokuhlinzeka kwayo. Izinkampani eziningi ziye zaba nezithiyo ezimayelana nezinsizakusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukutholakala kwemvume, kanti abelungu bangase babe nezizathu ezahlukene zokungathumeli imvume. Lokhu kungadala ukukhathazeka komphakathi uma abathintekayo bengaqondi kahle izinzuzo ezikwi-vidiyo nemithombo emisha yokuxhumana. Izinyathelo Zokuthola Imvume Ukuthola imvume kudinga ukufundisa amalungu ngendlela efanele ukuze baqonde ubungozi obuhambisana nemvume yabo kanye nezindlela zokuzuzisa. Izinyathelo ezichazwe kuhlu lokucacisa, ezisiza ekwakheni umkhankaso wokufundiswa, kufanele ziqashelwe. Lokhu kungabandakanya imihlangano ebukhoma, izinhlelo zevidiyo, noma izincwadi zobuchwepheshe ezibhaliwe ngendlela elula ukuze abahlulele baqonde kahle. Ubuchwepheshe Obukhulu Ubuchwepheshe busiza ekwenzeni lula ukuthola imvume, futhi buvumela ukukhiqizwa nokuhambisa imininingwane. Izinhlelo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ezifana nosoftware yokuphatha imvume, ziwusizo ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwamalungu eGEMS nabahlinzeki bempilo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuphatha imvume, okuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ibalulekile empilweni nasekuphathweni kwemininingwane. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuqonda lezi zinkinga ukuze ukuxhumana kube kuphephile. Ukuqonda imvume kubalulekile ekuvuseleleni ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS nabahlinzeki. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kuqhubeke nokugxila emvume ukuze imiphumela ibe yinhle, ihloniphe abahluleli, futhi igcine izinga lemisebenzi emisha.
Idolobha LaseGoli: Ngaphakathi Kwezingxoxo Zokuphila Kwesimanje Idolobha laseGoli, elaziwa nangokuthi iJohannesburg, liyinqaba yokuthuthukiswa komnotho eNingizimu Afrika. Le ndawo ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ngenxa yobungcweti bayo bezomnotho, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuhlukahluka kwempilo kanye nezinselelo ezifanele ukucatshangelwa. Kulokhu, sizophawula ngokubaluleka kwaleli dolobha, izinzuzo zalo, kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Okokuqala, kudingeka sikhulume ngempilo yansuku zonke eGoli. Idolobha linabantu bamaSuthu, amaHosa, amaZulu, kanye nabanye abantu abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iGoli iyindawo yokunethezeka nolwazi, lapho iz cultures ezahlukene zenza ubuhlobo, zifundisana futhi zabelana ngezindlela zokuphila. Kubalulekile ukufaka isigqi sokuhlukahluka kwamasiko, njengoba lokhu kuhlelwe kahle ekwakhekeni komphakathi onobungani. Nokho, leli dolobha liphinde libe nezinselelo ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezinga lokuphila nokuhlaliswa kwabantu. Ngokwezemisebenzi, iGoli iyikhaya lemisebenzi eminingi. Iqukethe izinkampani ezinkulu, abahwebi, nabathuthukisi, okwenza kube lula ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lezi zinkampani zithuthukisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, ngaleyondlela zidlalayo indima ebalulekile ekwakheni amathuba kubantu abaningi. Nokho, kufanele sicabangele ukuthi indlela yokuphila eGoli ibuye ibize, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezindlekweni zokuhlala. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abahlala ezindaweni eziphoqelelwe, bayathola kunzima ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele ukuzinakekela. Ezinye zezinkinga ezikhona eGoli zifaka phakathi ubuphofu obukhulu, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lobugebengu. Lezi zinkinga zifanele ukubhekelwa ngeso elibukhali, njengoba zikhomba ukufaneleka kokuphila kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga eliphakeme lokuhlala livame ukuveza ukungabi bikho kokusizakala kwiSocial Welfare, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ophumelelayo wokuxazulula, uma sikhuluma ngophetho oluzodingeka ukuthi lwenziwe ukuze kwandiswe izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona umbono ongapheli mayelana neGoli njengendawo yokuhweba. Abanye bathi iGoli iyindawo ehloniphekile yokwakha amabhizinisi, njengoba izinzuzo ezitholakele zikhulisa umnotho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo eziningi zamaholo, izitolo ezinkulu, kanye nezinsizakalo ezisemqoka ezifana nezokwelapha namathuluzi obuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuhweba, okulindeleke ukuthi kuzuze umphakathi jikelele. Kodwa-ke, umbono ophikisanayo uthi lezi zinzuzo ziyashubisa uma siqhathanisa nezindleko zokuphila ezikhula kakhulu. Kukhona izikhalazo eziningi ezikhuluma ngokuswabela kwemisebenzi, ukungabikho kwemali, nokuhamba phakathi kwezindawo ezihlukile. Lokhu kucacisa ukuntuleka kokufinyelela emisebenzini ethile, okuholela ekuzimiseleni kwezingqinamba ezikhona eGoli. Enye indlela yokubhekana nalokhu kube ukusiza izikhungo zentuthuko ngokwandisa amathuba ezemisebenzi nemisebenzi yokujabulela. Ngonyaka ka-2023, iGoli ibonakala ithuthukisa izindlela ezintsha zokwenza ngokufanisa izinselelo ezikhona. Izinhlelo zokusebenza kwezemfundo, izikhungo zokuhweba, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphepha ziyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zazo, zigxile ekwenzeni impilo ibaluleke kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukuthi, naphezu kwezinkinga ezikhona, izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza ekwakheni umphumela omuhle. Umphakathi obonisa ukufaka imali ezindaweni ezinokuthula kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile. Ngaphandle kokuxhasa abaqashi, kubalulekile futhi ukukhuthaza uchwepheshe abasha. Lokhu kuzonciphisa izinkinga eziphathelene nobuphofu, kuvule amathuba okwandisa izinga lempilo. I-Goli, njengezikhungo zomnotho, kufanele iconywe ukuqonda abafuni bait ebandakanya abahola izinxephezelo. Ngokugcinwa kwamaqhinga athile, iGoli ingaba yindawo yokuhweba ewusizo kubantu bonke. Ukuphendula izinkinga ezikhona, kubalulekile ukwakha ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi komphakathi, uhulumeni, nezinkampani. Lezi zinyathelo zizoqinisekisa ukuthi iGoli isasebenza njengenhloko-dolobha yeNingizimu Afrika, futhi iyindawo yokubaluleka emhlabeni wonke. Umphakathi unemisebenzi eminingi, izinkinga eziningi, kodwa lonke leli theku ligxilile ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kudingeka ukuthi iGoli ibhekane nezinkinga zayo, iqhubeke nokukhula, futhi iqhakambisa izindlela ezinhle zokuphila. Njengoba sizama ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, umbono wamathuba aqina uboniswa ikakhulukazi lapho sikhuluma ngokuhlonipha, ukuxhumana, kanye nezimanga zempilo ezihamba phambili. Idolobha laseGoli linethuba elihle lokushintsha, uma kuphela sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ufinyelela izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze ahlale kahle.
Umnyango Wezabasebenzi usungule umthetho omusha, ikakhulukazi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle. Ikhophi yeSikhungo Sokuhlola itholakala kubathengisi bephepha eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi futhi iyatholakala ku-inthanethi: www.labour.gov. Yini inhloso yale Ndlela Yokuhlola? Le Ndlela Yokuhlola iqukethe izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle ezifana nezinsuku zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane, kanye nokupheliswa kwezinkontileka zomsebenzi. Iphinde iphakamise ngemiholo elindelekile nokuthi kufanele ikhokhwe ngababambiqhaza. Ubani othintekayo kule Ndlela Yokuhlola? Noma iyiphi imisebenzi ethinta lowo msebenzi, hhayi kuphela ukuthengisa, ukugcina impahla, noma ukusabalalisa, noma imisebenzi ethuthukisa ibhizinisi lommeli noma imisebenzi eyenziwa ezindaweni zalolo bhizinisi ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi ez covered by this Sectoral Determination. Ubani ongathinteki kule Ndlela Yokuhlola? Abasebenzi abenza amahora angama-24 noma ngaphansi ngenyanga abathinteki. Uma kukhona udaba olungakhulunywanga kule Ndlela Yokuhlola, izinhlinzeko zeMthethosisekelo Wokusebenza Okuyisisekelo (BCEA) zizosebenza kubabambiqhaza nabasebenzi kule Ndawo. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nemiholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi kufanele bathole okungenani imiholo ekhombisa kumaThebula 1 kuya ku-3. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle bazothola imiholo efanayo? Abasebenzi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle kufanele bathole okungenani izimali ezikhonjiswe kumaThebula akhuluma ngazo ngenhla. Nokho, abasebenzi abathola imiholo ephezulu kunezikhombisiwe bazoqhubeka bethola lezozikhombisi ngoba imigomo yokusebenza ayinakushintshwa nganoma iyiphi indlela. Noma okungenani inani ngehora njengoba kuchazwe kumaThebula 1 kuya ku-3 ngehora noma ingxenye yohora eyenziwe ngabasebenzi. Uma lowo msebenzi ekhiqiza noma ethengisa ngaphansi kwemiholo encane ebekwe ngenxa yezizathu ezibangelwa umqashi, kufanele athole imiholo ekhombisiwe. Ibalwa usebenzisa amahora enziwe aphelele ngosuku/ama hora = imiholo ngehora aphelele evikini/ama hora evikini = imiholo ngehora aphelele evikini/izinsuku ezisebenze = imiholo ngosuku aphelele ngenyanga/4. Imiholo yabasebenzi evikini lapho ukukhokha kungabalwa ngokubheka isikhathi noma lapho bethola imiholo eguquguqukayo ibalwa ngokususelwa enanini eliphelele elilinganisiwe ezinyangeni eziyi-13 uma uhlukanisa ngama-13. I-slip yemiholo iyimpahla yabasebenzi. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-index yokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa ezinyangeni zokuqala eziyishumi. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-index yokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa eminyakeni yesibili ngemuva kokuqala kwale Ndlela Yokuhlola. Uma i-CPIX ingama-10% noma ngaphezulu, imiholo ekhombisiwe izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-CPIX. Ukuhlinzekwa kokuhambisana nezindinganiso zempilo nokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nezikweletu ezivela emiholweni? Ukweba ugesi kubhekisela kunoma yisiphi isenzo esingagunyaziwe sokuphazamisa amathuluzi, izinto, noma izinsiza ukuze uxhumane ngendlela ekhombisa noma engaholela emandleni kagesi angafundeki noma awedwa, noma ukuze uthole inzuzo engafanele kagesi. Ukweba ugesi kuyinselele edinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kugcinwe umkhakha wokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Kungani kubalulekile? Kuphikisana nomthetho: ukuhweba kubhekwa njengesenzo sobugebengu esingaphathwa ngumlomo. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngaphandle kwemvume yokuxhuma noma ukubhalisela njengomthengi endaweni yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kanye nokuphazamisa umgibeli kagesi, kuyisenzo sobugebengu. Ukuze ugweme lesi simo, kufanele uxhumane nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi bendawo bese ufaka isicelo. Kuzodingeka ukhokhe imali yokuxhuma ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Akukho justice kulabo abathengi abangakhokhi ugesi. Ukuhluleka kagesi: ukuxhumana okungekho emthethweni kuvame ukuholela ekwehlulekeni kwemigudu kagesi, okungase kuwe. Ukwehluleka kungase kuthinte nezindawo eziseduze. Lezi zinkinga zagesi azibangelwa umhlinzeki kagesi. Ukuhluleka kagesi kungaholela nasezingeni zamandla kagesi angalawulwa, okungase kubangele ukulimala kwezinsiza kagesi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abathengi abangakhokhi ugesi. Ingxenye enzima ukuthi abathengi abangenacala ngeke babe nendlela yokuphikisa kumhlinzeki kagesi, njengoba inkinga ingase ingabangelwa umhlinzeki noma ingase ibe ngenxa yokungakhathaleli kwabo. Abahlinzeki bagesi badinga ukuhweba ngenprofit efanelekile ukuze bakhokhe izindleko zagesi abathenga kubakhiqizi bagesi. Inzuzo evela ekuthengiseni ugesi isiza ukugcina ibhizinisi lokuhlinzeka ngogesi futhi ivumela umhlinzeki ukuthi aqhubeke nemisebenzi yabo. Ngakho-ke, ukuhweba ugesi kubeka engcupheni ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ukwehla kwemali engenayo kusho ukuthi imali encane iyahamba ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abangakatholi ugesi kuzodingeka balinde isikhathi eside. Ezimweni eziningi zokuxhumana okungekho emthethweni kagesi, ubungozi buvela ngoba ama-cables awavikelekile, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo zabantu. Ukulahlekelwa kwenzuzo ngenxa yokwehla kokuthengiswa kusho ukuthi kufanele kutholakale indawo ethile ukuze kugcwaliswe leli gabadi. Le simo sichaza ukwanda kwentengo kagesi. Ubani othintekayo kulokhu? Kuthinta labo abathengi abangakhokhi ugesi ngoba inzuzo elahlekile ibuyiselwa ngokukhuphula intengo? Xhumana nomakhelwane wakho mayelana nomthelela walokhu. Nika umakhelwane wakho iseluleko ngendlela efanele yokufaka isicelo sokuxhumana kagesi. Xhumana namakhelwane akho; bangase babe nesixazululo kulokhu. Phakamisa le ndaba emhlanganweni womphakathi noma nezinhlangano zendawo. Thumela le ndaba emnyangweni wezokuxhumana nabathengi. Xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi uma unemininingwane ngothile ophanga ugesi. Njengomthengi osebenzisa ugesi, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhokha insizakalo ethunyelwe kuwe. Uma unenkinga yokukhokha ibhili yakho ngesikhathi, mhlawumbe isixazululo singaba ukusetha uhlelo lokukhokha ugesi olwenziwe ngaphambi. Ngale ndlela, ungakwazi ukuphatha kangcono ugesi owusebenzisa. Ukweba ugesi kuphazamisa bonke abathengi, hhayi kuphela endaweni yakho kodwa kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu kwezinye izindawo. Njengokugcina, ungathumela ukul complaint kumlawuli wegesi. Abathengi bakhuthazwa ukuba baxhumane nomhlinzeki wogesi ngqo lapho bengakwazi ukufaka izikhalazo. Uma unganelisekile, ungaphakamisa le ndaba kumlawuli wegesi kazwelonke, ozophenya le ndaba ngokujulile. Ukulawula umkhakha wokuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokulandela izinqubomgomo nemithetho kuhlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamanje nezangomuso zababambiqhaza emkhakheni kagesi ngokusebenzisa amasu afanele aholela ekusimameni kwesikhathi eside. Umphakathi wegesi, ngokubambisana nomnyango wezinsizakalo zabathengi, uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni izinga lenkonzo emkhakheni wokuhlinzeka ngogesi futhi ugcine abathengi bekwaziswa ngezinkinga ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa kagesi.
Izinsalo Zempilo Umbuzo ubheke phezulu, ezinkanyezini ezikhanyayo, ubona ukudideka okukhulayo empilweni yakhe. U-Jabulani, owayekhuluma nezinkanyezi, uzizwe engcono. Nokho, umuzi wakhe ubuphithizela. U-Phumzile, umkami, wayenokukhathazeka ngenxa yokuthi umsebenzi wakhe ubuphazamisekile. Ukudlula kwi-khubezelo lwezimpilo zabo, ububhekwa yizinselelo ezinzima ezifuna amasu ukuze zilawulwe. Isisindo sokuphila sakhula emakhaya amabili — kuphela ezinsukwini eziningana ezedlule. U-Jabulani wayengazi ukuthi izinsolo ezazisondela, njengezinyosi, bezizofika zibulale umzila wonke. Kwakukhona izikhalazo ezikhuluma ngokungafinyeleli emsebenzini, ukuzikhandla emigudwini, and ubuhlungu bokulahlekelwa umndeni. Lezi zinsolo zikhulise umoya wokukhathazeka, kwaba nzima ukuze ababe nekhono lokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. U-Jabulani uthokozisa inhlonipho. Ngaphezu kwezimvo zakhe, wayekwazi ukuthi izinselelo zempilo zidinga uthando nokuqonda. Waqala ukukhuluma ngezinselelo ezinjalo, wabelana ngalesi simo no-Phumzile. Kwi- banga lokuqonda, u-Phumzile, yena owaziyo, ngamunye uphenya iziphumo ezifanayo kokubili. Amanxeba ayesevk mechamo akhe. Babengabambisene ngezinhloso ezikhanyayo embulungeni yokuhlala phansi. Kwathi ngoMgqibelo, u-Jabulani naye waveza adlula inqondo yakhe. Wathi: “Noma imina ingasinika amakhono amahle, kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona izinkinga ezikhona.” U-Phumzile wavuma. “Impela, umzabalazo wempilo ungakhuthaza na. Asi kudlule ngaphandle kokubona ithuba.” Ngaleso sikhathi, bakhumbulile umholi wabo, umkhulu uSipho, owaziyo ukuhlinzeka abantu abahluphekayo ngezinsiza. U-Jabulani wathi: “Sizophokophela kumkhulu uSipho. Iziqu eziphakeme nezithokozisayo kungasiza ekuphuculeni izinkundla zempilo.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bahamba bephonsela uthando kumkhulu. Umholi wabo uSipho wasebenzela abanye, waze wafika ezindabeni. Wavuma ukwenza izinkampani ezincane, ezivuleleke kubantu abaningana. “Sidinga ukuhlanganyela, ngizothanda ukukha ezinye izindlela ezithile zokubhekana nezinkinga zempilo,” esho. Ngokuphumelelayo, uSipho wanikela ngezinsiza, waphinde wona omunye udaba, olokhu uvula amakhono okuhlaziya isimo. U-Jabulani no-Phumzile babephansi, baphumelelisa ukuthula phakathi kwezinkinga ezikhona. U-Jabulani wenza umkhono. “Ake siqale i-projekthi ye-mkhiqizo, ezogqugquzela ukwakha ezokuthengisa. Ngiyazi ukuthi sizodinga ukukhuthazwa.” U-Phumzile wathokoza, “Ngiyavuma! Sizomema bonke abangani bethu beze. Ubulungiswa kuvundulula izinsiza zethu.” Nguphuma phambili, u-Jabulani noPhumzile bahuni ama-hrati ukuze baqale i-projekthi yabo. Baqala ukufaka izingubo ezivuna umoya, izithelo ezihlukahlukene zomhlaba, ubuciko dibanisa. Umsebenzi wabo wagqugquzela abanye, uSipho wasebenzisa izinsiza zakhe ukuze bNews. Ngalolu suku, ubuhlobo babu phezu kwezinkanyezi—ubuhlungu nomusa bekhahlamezekile. Sekupheleni kuka-2023, u-Jabulani noPhumzile babephuma ngezinto zempilo ezihamba phambili. Bathole ukuzuza, bezama ukufunda amakhono amasha. “Sisoloko beletha umoya omuhle,” kusho uPhumzile. Ngamasasasa aphelele, uJabulani wathola ukuyeka izinselelo ezinzima. Kodwa ngaphambi kwempilo engasoze ukuya epheleni, safuna ukwazi okwakuzonakele. U-Phumzile, umphefumulo wezinsuku, akakaze aphelelwe umfutho; umoya wokukhanya wabelana ubungani babo. Ngaphezu kweminyaka, isifiso sokuhamba phambili sakhula. Bathola ukuzivocavoca komoya, okuphilayo. Njengoba bobonke behamba phambili, baziduduza izinselelo zempilo, bazi ukuthi umoya ophilayo uthela umthombo wokuphila. Izinto zontanga zaba yizifiso zempilo, nomoya omuhle waqhubeka. U-Jabulani no-Phumzile bakwazi ukuqonda ukuthi izinselelo zempilo zikhona, kodwa zinemithelela emihle, uma besebenza ndawonye. Imigudu yabo iphucukile, umhlaba wabo washintsha ngokukhanya. Futhi kufanele wazi, kujabula ukugcina umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezinsuku ezinzima. U-Yena, umoya omuhle.
Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni Isingeniso Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthuthukisa impilo, ukunciphisa izindleko zokudla, nokwakha umphakathi. Lezi zingadi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, zinciphise ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, futhi zandise ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile zokwakha nokuphatha izingadi zokudla emadolobheni. Isinyathelo 1: Ukukhetha Indawo 1. Thola Indawo Efanele: Khetha indawo enelanga elanele, enomhlabathi onempilo, futhi engaphansi kokungcoliswa. Izindawo ezinjengemakhaya, izinkundla, noma izindawo ezingenamahlathi zifaneleka kahle. 2. Hlola Umhlabathi: Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlabathi unempilo. Ungasebenzisa ithuluzi lokuhlola umhlabathi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unama-nutrients adingekayo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Izinhlobo Zezithelo Nezimbali 1. Khetha Izinhlobo Ezifanele: Khetha izithelo nezimbali ezivumelana nezimo zendawo yakho. Izithelo ezifana namakhowe, amakhabe, nezimbali ezifana nezimbali zothando zifaneleka kahle emadolobheni. 2. Bheka Isikhathi Sokukhula: Qonda isikhathi sokukhula kwezinhlobo ozikhethayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela isikhathi sokuhlwanyela. Isinyathelo 3: Ukulungiselela Umhlabathi 1. Susa Izitshalo Ezindala: Uma kukhona izitshalo ezindala, qiniseka ukuthi uzisusa ukuze uvule indawo yokukhula. 2. Phakamisa Umhlabathi: Faka umhlabathi omusha noma uthuthukise umhlabathi okhona ngama-organic fertilizers ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unama-nutrients adingekayo. 3. Hlanza Umhlabathi: Susa izinsalela, izinsalela zezitshalo, nezinsalela eziphilayo ukuze uvikele izitshalo zakho ekuguleni. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlwanyela 1. Hlanza Izikhala: Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhala phakathi kwezithombo zanele ukuze zikhule kahle. Lokhu kuzovumela umoya nokukhanya ukuba kufinyelele ezitshalweni. 2. Hlwanyela Ngendlela Efanele: Landela imiyalelo yokuhlwanyela yeziqubulo ezikhethiwe. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlwanyela ngezinga elifanele, ungawufaki umhlabathi kakhulu. Isinyathelo 5: Ukunakekela Izingadi 1. Phuza Ngendlela Efanele: Qinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zithola amanzi anele. Ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphuzisa ezizenzekelayo ukuze unciphise isikhathi sokunakekela. 2. Susa Izihlahla Nezihlahla: Qinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zakho azinazo izihlahla eziphilayo. Lokhu kuzovikela izitshalo zakho ekuguleni. 3. Faka Ama-Fertilizers: Faka ama-fertilizers ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izitshalo zikhula kahle. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuvuna 1. Bheka Isikhathi Sokuvuna: Qonda isikhathi sokuvuna kwezinhlobo ozikhethayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuna ngesikhathi esifanele. 2. Vuna Ngendlela Efanele: Qinisekisa ukuthi uvuna izithelo nezimbali ngendlela efanele ukuze ungaphazamisi izitshalo ezisele. Isinyathelo 7: Ukwabelana Ngezithelo Nezimbali 1. Yabelana Nomphakathi: Uma uvuna, yabelana ngezithelo nezimbali nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi ophilayo futhi ukhuthaze abanye ukuba bakhe izingadi zabo. 2. Hlela Imicimbi: Hlela imicimbi yokwabelana ngezithelo nezimbali ukuze uthuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akugcini nje ngokuthuthukisa impilo, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza umphakathi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha ingadi yokudla ephumelelayo, ethuthukisa impilo yakho, futhi ibandakanye abanye emphakathini. Qhubeka nokukhula, ube nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni wakho.
Bika ochwepheshe bezilwane mayelana nezilwane eziphatha ngendlela engajwayelekile, futhi kuthathwa ukuthi kunokhukhula. Abantu abathintekayo ekutholeni ukhukhula kufanele bavaccine ngaphambi kokungena kulezi zimo. Izikhungo zezempilo, odokotela, amaZikhungo Okulawulwa Kweziguli Nokuvikelwa (CDC), kanye nabahloli bezempilo kufanele baziwe ngokushesha. Abahloli bezempilo bahlola isimo, baphenya, futhi banikeze izeluleko (bacele). Abahloli bezempilo bahlanganyela nochwepheshe bezilwane emikhankasweni yokuvikela izilwane (eziphilayo) futhi bakhuthaze ukuqwashisa. Iqembu elibhekele ukhukhula liqinise ukufinyelela emphakathini. Isilwane esigulayo sithathwa sibe yisidumbu, bese sithathwa. Kumuntu ogulayo, umswakama uthathwa ukuze uhlole. Isilwane esithathwa ukuthi sinokhukhula siba ngaphakathi kokuhlala imihla eyishumi ukuze kubonakale ukuthi sishintsha yini. Uma sikhombisa izimpawu zokukhukhula, sithathwa sibe yisidumbu ukuze ubuchopho buphathwe. Uma umuntu owashwe uphathwa ngokushesha, ngeke agule noma afe. Umuntu owashwe akufanele washise indawo ewashwe ngamanzi kanye nomuthi opholisayo imizuzu emihlanu ngaphambi kokuhamba esibhedlela. Hamba esibhedlela esiseduzane. Udokotela noma um nurse uzosungula uhlelo lokuvikela ukhukhula, oluhilela ukubulala i-virus yokukhukhula emzimbeni. Kubalulekile ukulandela zonke izilinganiso kuze kube sekupheleni. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana nez authorities zezempilo noma isikhungo sezempilo. Uhlobo lokukhukhula luyisifo esithathelwana esibangelwa yi-virus (germ) esinazo izilwane. Lesi sifo sithathelwana kusuka esilwaneni esinombono ne-gazi elishisayo siye kwenye. Uhlobo lokukhukhula luvela ezilwaneni ezifana nezinja, amahlosi, amakati, izinyoni, kanye nezinyoka. I-virus itholakala emswakamswakama lapho lesi sifo siqala. Umswakama onale virus ungene kumuntu ngokuqhanyelwa noma ngokuqhumisa, inqobo nje uma isikhumba sishabalele. Le germ ihamba ngezinzwa kuze kufike ebuchosheni. Izilwane eziphukile ezinekhukhula zingaba yingozi uma ziphathwa, zithinte ubuchopho, umswakama, noma uma zicutshwa ngensimbi. Qaphela ukuthi ukhukhula uthinta izinhliziyo nezimo zengqondo, kubonakala njengokuphatha izilwane ngendlela engajwayelekile. Izinguquko zokuziphatha (ukuhlukumeza), ukuwasha noma yini, ukungaphumuli, ukwesaba, umswakama omningi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuzilimaza, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela, amehlo avulekile, ukudideka, ukwenza sounds ezihlukile, ukungawuqondi umnikazi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela izinto ezingaphili kanye nabantu, ukuhlala ezikhaleni, umswakama, ukuwasha, umswakama omningi, kanye namahlo avulekile kungase kwenzeke. Umsebenzi omningi, ukukhala okukhulu, ukuhlasela, ukuhamba okungadingekile, nokugaya amazinyo kungase kwenzeke. Baphenduka bangesabi abantu, bengena ezindlini nasemafamu, behlasela abantu nezilwane ngaphandle kwesixwayiso, futhi befa ngokuzumayo. Kuthatha amasonto amabili kuya kumasonto ayishumi noma ngaphezulu ukuze umuntu owashwe yisilwane esinekhukhula akhombise izimpawu zokukhukhula ezibangelwa yiso. Izimpawu zokuqala: umkhuhlane, ikhanda, ukukhathazeka, ukuqunjelwa, ukwesaba amanzi, ubuhlungu bempumulo, ukulahlekelwa yisifiso, ukuphazamiseka, ukungaphumuli, ukuqubuka, bese kuba nokufa. Imigomo iphephile; ayenzi izilwane zakho zibe nogu. Ungathinti noma ungasondeli esilwaneni ongasisazi, noma esibonakala singenamuntu, futhi ungakwenzi ukudlwengula.
Izindlela Zokuphatha Izimo Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela: Umqondo Wami Izimo eziphuthumayo ziwumqondo okhathaza kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yethu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bethu bayazi kahle ukuthi izimo ezinjalo zingavela nganoma isiphi isikhathi, zishayise phansi izinhlelo zethu, kanye nemicabango yethu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokho kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubo eziphusile zokuphatha lezi zimo, ikakhulukazi ezibhedlela. Ngiyavuma ukuthi izinqubo eziphuthumayo, uma zisetshenziswa kahle, zingasiza ekwenzeni umphakathi ube safer, futhi ziqinise ukwethembana phakathi kwabantu nabodokotela. Ukuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zifaka phakathi izinjongo eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izingozi zomgwaqo, izifo ezinzima ezivela ngokuzumayo, noma izimo ezinjengokushayisana noma ukuhlaselwa. Ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zokuphatha lezi zimo kufanele zibe nezinyathelo ezicacile, ezizwakalayo, nezisebenzayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abezimo eziphuthumayo bazi kahle ukuthi kumele benze kanjani ukuze bagcine impilo yabo nabanye. Enye yezinto engizithakaselayo ngokuqondene nezinhlelo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela ukuthi kufanele kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba.
