Lokhu kuhlanganisa odokotela, ab nurse, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo. Ukuze umsebenzi uhambe kahle, kufanele kube nenqubo ecacile yokukhulumisana phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kuzogcina kuphumelele kahle, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukusiza abantu abadinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Futhi, izinhlelo ezifanele zidinga ukuba nezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu. Uma kudingeka ukusiza umuntu ophuthumayo, kuyadingeka ukuba izibhedlela zibe nezinsiza ezifanele, njengezithuthi ezisheshayo, imishini yokwelapha, kanye nezidakamizwa ezithile. Ngokwenza lokhu, izibhedlela zingakwazi ukunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda nokwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu. Ngokuphathelene nezinkinga ezibhekene nezibhedlela zethu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ezinye izibhedlela azinazo izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokulinda ngesikhathi esibalulekile. Ngaleso sikhathi, ungazibuza ukuthi kuthiwani uma owesifazane omdala edinga usizo lokuphuthumayo, kodwa kufanele alinde amahora ngaphambi kokuthi athole usizo? Lokhu akumele kube yinto evumelekile. Ngiphinde ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi futhi izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo kufanele zihlale zisebenza ngendlela eqhubekayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa okuphindaphindiwe kwabasebenzi, ukuze bahlale bephapheme ezindabeni ezishintshashintsha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abezimo eziphuthumayo badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezintsha nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokusebenza, ukuze bagcine begxile kumsebenzi wabo. Ngokubheka ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zenzeka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile ezibhedlela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukusiza abantu abadinga usizo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi impilo yabo iyasindiswa. Ngakho-ke, ukwakha izinqubo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela akukhona nje ukwakha uhlelo olusebenzayo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezihambisana nezibhedlela, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma siza ndawonye, singakha izinqubo eziphuthumayo ezizothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ngikhuthaza osomabhizinisi, izikhulu, kanye nosomabhizinisi bezempilo ukuba basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izindlela ezenzakalayo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze kube nokuthula nokuphepha ezibhedlela zethu. Ngokuphetha, izinqubo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile, futhi kufanele zihlale ziguqulwa ukuze zihlale zihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kumele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezisiza abezimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu. Ngibona ukuthi ukwakha izinqubo eziphuthumayo eziphumelelayo kuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, futhi kuyasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwane obukhululekile phakathi kwezibhedlela nabantu. Ngalokhu, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, siphumelele, futhi sakhe umphakathi onempilo.
Uhlaka lokuguqula ubuciko, isiko, kanye nezinsiza zomlando wezwe luboniswe kuMthetho Wokwenziwa KwezeMisebenzi, Isiko Nezinsiza Zomlando Wonyaka ka-1996. Umthwalo wokuphumeza lezi zinqubomgomo unikezwa uMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, owawuqala ukuwuphumeza ngoMgqibelo 1, 2002. Inhloso enkulu ukuhlela nokwandisa ibhajethi yobuciko nezamasiko ukuze kusizakale ngezidingo zobuciko nezamasiko kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwenhlangano nakho kubalulekile, futhi ekuqaleni, kubhekiswe ngqo ezikhungweni zokwenza ubuciko ezazincike kakhulu ekuxhasweni ngaphambili. Ubuciko nezamasiko kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuqedeni, ubunye, kanye nokubuyisana. Iqembu leMiphakathi Yezobuciko Nezamasiko lilungiselela ukweseka amasu ezikhungo zobuciko nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Zihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kobuciko kodwa futhi zidlala indima ebalulekile mayelana nezinselelo zomphakathi. Zifuna ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihlobene nokufakwa nokuhlanganiswa nokukhipha ukungalingani emkhakheni wobuciko nezamasiko ekunikezeni izinsiza. Inqubo edingekayo ifaka phakathi ukufaka amaqembu aphansi njengabakhubazekile, intsha, abesifazane, nezingane. Baphinde banikeze ukunakwa okukhethekile ezinkingeni zokuguqulwa kwemigomo ukuze kulethe ubulungiswa ekunikezeni izinsiza nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni. Izikhungo zobuciko nezamasiko, izikhungo zokuxhasa, nezikhungo zobuciko zomphakathi zithola izibonelelo zonyaka ukuze zifeze izinhlelo futhi zithuthukise ubuciko nezamasiko. Uhlanga lwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika lusekelwa ngokomthetho ukuze kuvikelwe amalungelo ezilimi nokukhuthaza izilimi zomdabu. Ngo-2003, ikhabhinethi yamukela uHlahlo-lwabiwo lwezilimi, oluhlanganisa isitatimende sezinqubomgomo, uhlelo lokuphumeza, kanye nenqubo yokuziphatha yezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 futhi luqinisekisa ukulungiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphansi ngaphambili. Le nqubomgomo isebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zikamasipala, futhi iqhubeka nokukhuthaza inani lezilimi emibhalweni esemthethweni eyenziwe, okuzothuthukisa futhi kuqondise izinsizakalo zomphakathi kahle ngokusebenzisa imibhalo efanele yezilimi. Izifunda zizothuthukisa izinqubomgomo ngokusekelwe ezimweni zendawo. Izinqubomgomo zizokwethulwa kancane kancane. Ukusungulwa kweSouth African National Heritage Resources Centre njengomuntu ophakathi kwemithetho ngo-2002 kanye neNational Heritage Council ngo-2003 kwenze ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomlando wezwe kanye nokuguqulwa komkhakha kube yimpumelelo. Iphrojekthi eyinhloko kule ndawo yiMnyuziyamu kaAlbert Luthuli eKwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal. Ngo-1998, ikhabhinethi yamukela amaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalolunye okuqala okwakuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezithile zendaba yomlando wezwe, ukukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwesizwe, nokufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni ezokuvakasha. Kuze kube manje, amaphrojekthi ayisithupha aqalile, kuhlanganise neMnyuziyamu Yokukhumbula Abesifazane kanye neMnyuziyamu Yokukhumbula Ibhola LaseNgilandi eNingizimu Afrika. Umnyango uzobambisana nePhalamende ukuze ufune imvume yamaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalombili ezomlando wezwe. Ukuxhaswa okuvela ebhajethini ekhethekile elinikezwe izikhungo kuhlose ukuthuthukisa amathuba okuguqulwa ngokwandisa ububanzi bokuxhaswa kwezezimali ezikhungweni. Umnyango uqale uhlelo lwezinyathelo zokuqala ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2002/03 ukuze wandise ukufinyelela ezikhungweni ngokuthuthukisa izakhiwo zeminyuziyamu kanye nezinsiza. Ukugxila okukhulu kuzobekwa nasekuphathweni kwezinto eziqoqiwe kanye nokwenza ucwaningo ngempahla yomlando wezwe kuzo zonke izikhungo zomlando wezwe (iminyuziyamu nezinye izikhungo) ukuze kuzame ukunciphisa imisebenzi yokwephula umthetho, kuhlanganise nokuhweba kwamanye amazwe kanye nokukhwabanisa. I-National Archives and Records Services of South Africa ithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni imigomo yayo yokuphathwa kahle, ukuguqulwa, ukufinyelela ezidingweni zolwazi lomphakathi, nokukhuthaza ukubuyisana kwesizwe ngokuguqulwa kwezimpawu zomlando nezinye. Intuthuko yenziwe nohlelo lwezifunda lokuthatha izinsiza njengokugcina amarekhodi nezindawo zomlando. IWestern Cape okwamanje ikwi ndlela yokudlulisa lezi zindawo esifundazweni. Usizo ekuvikeleni impahla yeNepad nakho kubalulekile ohlwini lwezindaba ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho emithathu emisha yezwe isunguliwe. Omininistru basayine iSitatimende Sokugcina Amarekhodi Omhlaba, Ukuhlelwa Kwezimali, kanye Namalungelo Abantu avela emazweni ayishumi ase-Afrika abethulwe ukuze wamukelwe njengomsebenzi weNepad. NgoNovemba 2003, iNational Council for Library and Information Services (NCLIS) yasungulwa, nomhlangano wokuqala ubuhlelwe ngoMsombuluko 2004. Ochwepheshe bokwakha nokuklama banikezwe imisebenzi yokubheka ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo esisha sePretoria branch yeNational Library of South Africa ngoJanuwari 2004. I-Cultural Industries Growth Strategy ihlose ukuhweba amandla omnotho wobuciko, imisebenzi yezandla, umculo, ifilimu, ukuphrinta, kanye nezimboni zokuklama. Ukuxhaswa komnyango kuhilela ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano nokwakha izinto ezintsha nemiphakathi/abazimele, besebenzisa isiko njengensiza yokuvuselela idolobha kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlanganisa lezi zimboni. Kukhona ukugxila okukhulayo kumandla embonini ye-filimu. Ingxenye ekhethekile yokunciphisa ubuphofu ihlose ukufinyelela kubabazi bezandla kanye nabathengisi njengensiza yokuvuselela idolobha, ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemakhaya, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Amaphrojekthi enziwa ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nezindawo, kanye nohulumeni nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi. Imizamo yokuthuthukisa iWild Coast, Lebombo, kanye neMaputo Corridor izindawo ezibhekelele ukukhuthaza ezokuvakasha kwezamasiko okuhlobene nokwabiwa kwalokhu. Le mizamo izoqhubeka ngokunikeza imali kumaphrojekthi abizwa ngokuthi "Investing in Culture." "Investing in Culture" izozama ukuqhakambisa zonke izici ezihlobene nesiko ukuze kufezwe lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni "izindawo eziphilayo." Umnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko uxhasa ukuthi imiphakathi eminingi engekho emthethweni ngaphakathi kwemingcele yethu ingaba ngabaphathi bezinsiza, kuhlanganise nezidingo zemvelo nezabantu, impahla yamasiko, amakhono, nolwazi lwesiko, izinto zokwenziwa, nezamasiko angasiza ekuqedeni ukuguqulwa komphakathi kanye nomnotho. Imiphakathi yethu igcwele ulwazi lwesiko, amakhono, kanye nemiphumela yobuciko evela kubantu abanamakhono aphezulu abawathathile baphumelele emfundweni esemthethweni nasebucikweni. Umnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko
Ingabe icala lizobuyiselwa kubakhiqizi? Kuwo wonke ama-ndaba, kukhona abahle nabangafaneleki - kodwa kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi wokudla ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ukudla kubantu ungowokugcina ongafaneleki. Bahlukunyezwa lapho kungekho ukudla, bahlukunyezwa lapho ukudla kuncishisiwe noma ikhwalithi yokudla ingahlangabezani nezinga labo. Uma sibheka indlela, umsebenzi noma uhlelo lokubeka ukudla etafuleni labantu besizwe, sizobona ukuthi kukhona abantu abaningi benza lo msebenzi futhi sizobona ukuthi kuwumsebenzi odinga isikhathi esiningi. Ingxenye yezinto kufanele ilandele. Kumele bakwazi ukufakwa kahle futhi bathuthwe ngendlela efanele. Kufanele kudalwe umanyolo ukusiza izitshalo zikhule kahle. Kufanele kutholakale i-herbicide, ama-pesticides, kanye nokulawulwa kwezifo ngendlela evikela izitshalo ukuze zime kahle. Futhi konke lokhu kunikezelwa kumabhizinisi ezolimo. Futhi bathenga izinkanyezi zokudla. Futhi bathutha umkhiqizo baye ezinkampanini zokugcina. Futhi bathengisa umkhiqizo kubakhiqizi (noma ezimakethe zangaphandle). Futhi bapakisha ukudla ngaphambi kokukuletha kubathengisi abakhulu. Bathengisa ukudla okupakishwe kubathengisi abancane. Bathengisa ukudla kubathengi. Le ncazelo ayichazi kahle zonke izinyathelo ezenzakalayo ngoba izinhlobo zokudla zihluka. Isibonelo: ngemuva kokuphosa ummbila, kufanele uphise (upheke) ngaphambi kokuthengiswa, uma ukudla kuyisithako esisetshenziselwa ukuhluza utshwala, kufanele kukhishwe kuqala ngaphambi kokuthengiswa. Kulomsebenzi wonke, kukhona abantu abaningi nemisebenzi eminingi eyakha uhlelo lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ngumuntu ngamunye wabo ofanele ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nemisebenzi yabo. Manje singabuza futhi - ingabe icala lokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla lingabekwa kuphela kumfuyi (umkhiqizi)? Yini intengo yotshwala (ibhiya) ingaphansi kuka-3% wentengo yemakethe yommbila? Ukusebenzisa ibhizinisi kuhambisana nokungena engozini - wonke amabhizinisi abhekana nezingozi ezithile. Abakhiqizi bahlushwa ukuba bamukele intengo yemakethe - abakwazi ukuhlela ukuthi bafuna malini ngethani lommbila ngoba yonke imikhiqizo yokudla ithengiswa emakethe - banikezwa intengo yosuku. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi uphonswe ukuba wamukele intengo yomkhiqizo engaphansi kwezindleko zokukhiqiza lowo mkhiqizo. Isibonelo: unyaka owedlule eFree State wawubi kakhulu futhi imvula yayingelungile. Ezindaweni eziningi, abafuyi bahluleka ukuvuna ngisho nethani elilodwa lommbila ngehektare. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ummbila zishintsha zibe ngu-R4,200 ngehektare, kanti intengo yemakethe ngaleso sikhathi yayingu-R3,000 ngethani. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umfuyi evuna ithani elilodwa ngehektare, ulahlekelwa (udliwa) ngu-R1,200 ngehektare. Uma ungumthosi, uzothenga umgubo bese unquma ukuthi uzokhokha malini ngezinto ozibakele. Uma umthengi enqaba ukukhokha lelo nani, uzokwehlisa intengo yomgubo nokuqhuba kuze kube intengo yomgubo yehlile. Kodwa uma umfuyi ethatha izinyathelo zokuqala zokutshala ukudla, abakwazi ukususa ngaphakathi komsebenzi wabo futhi balinde intengo inyuke - sebesuke benze izindleko manje kumele baqhubeke nokuvuna nokuthengisa lowo mkhiqizo. Abakhiqizi bethu bayinsiza enkulu kithi - basebenza kanzima, bathatha amathuba ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ng ukudla nemisebenzi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi singathenga kuphela ngaphandle uma lezo zizwe zinezakhamuzi eziningi zokudla, futhi uma izwe lethu linemali yokuthenga lokho. Lapho izimo zezinye izizwe zibi, zizogcina ukudla kwazo, ngakho sizophumelela ukuthenga ngaphandle. Futhi uma umphumela wokushintsha kwemali ubangela ukuthi inani le-rand lehle, izwe lethu ngeke likwazi ukuthenga ukudla futhi abantu bazolamba, sibona lokhu ezindaweni eziningi e-Afrika. Ngaphambi kokubeka icala kulezo zizwe ngokukhokha izindleko eziphezulu, masibheke le ndaba ukuze sithole ukuthi yini imbangela yokwenyuka kwentengo. Uma singasekeli abakhiqizi bethu ukuze baqhubeke nokutshala ukudla ngendlela enenzuzo, ngisho lapha abantu bazohlupheka ngendlala.
Ulwazi Ngokufinyelela Kwamarekhodi. Ulwazi Ngokufinyelela Kwamarekhodi. Ulwazi Ngokufinyelela Kwamarekhodi. Ulwazi Ngokufinyelela Kwamarekhodi. Ulwazi Ngokufinyelela Kwamarekhodi. Isigaba 32 seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) ("imthethosisekelo") sinikeza amalungelo omphakathi okuthola ulwazi olugcinwe yinoma iyiphi inhlangano yangasese noma yomphakathi. Lo mthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kolwazi. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuqinisekisa isiko lokucacisa nokubambisana ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezasekhaya ("DHA") ngokusebenzisa ilungelo lolwazi okungenzeka abantu noma izinhlangano zidinge ukukwenza nokuvikela noma yiziphi zezimali zabo. Ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwa umthetho kufanele lusetshenziswe ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo evunyelwe umthetho njengoba kunikezwa esigabeni 9 soMthetho (kubandakanya, kodwa kungagcini lapho, imikhawulo eqondiswe ekuvikeleni ubumfihlo, ubuchwepheshe bokuhweba, kanye nokuphathwa kahle, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokuphathwa kahle) nangendlela elinganisa lelo lungelo namanye amalungelo, kubandakanya lawo akwiBill of Rights emthethosisekelo. Ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho, izikhungo zomphakathi ezifana neDHA kufanele ziqoqe ibhukwana ukusiza abantu ukuthola ulwazi oluvela kule nhlangano. Isigaba 14 sichaza kahle izidingo ezincane zaleli bhukwana. Ngokuhambisana nemthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho, iDHA iletha le bhukwana ngenhloso yokuqinisa isiko lokucacisa nokuphathwa kahle. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhlinzeka abafuna ulwazi ngezindlela nezindlela zokuxhumana ezidingekayo ukuze bathole ulwazi ngqo kwiDHA. Le bhukwana iphinde ihlinzeke incazelo ecacile yokwakheka, amandla, nemisebenzi yeDHA, kanye nokuhlelwa kolwazi lwabo ngezigaba, ukuze abafuna ulwazi bakwazi ukubona kalula ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo lutholakala kuphi. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga iKomidi Lezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ("SAHRC") ukuba iqoqe umhlahlandlela wokuthi kusebenza kanjani lo Mthetho, ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni nangendlela elula ukuyifunda, ngaphambi kukaJulayi 2003. Ngesikhathi le bhukwana ibhalwa, umhlahlandlela weSAHRC wawungakatholakali. Ulwazi lokuxhumana lwabo bonke ofisa ulwazi kanye nezikhonzi zabo kuzo zonke izikhungo zomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuthi ungafaka kanjani izicelo zamarekhodi ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezangasese. Usizo olutholakalayo oluvela kumfundi wolwazi wesikhungo somphakathi ngokomthetho. Izixazululo zomthetho ezitholakalayo uma inhlangano yomphakathi noma eyangasese ingahambisani noMthetho, kubandakanya indlela yokufaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi nokufaka isicelo enkantolo (okuyindlela yokugcina uma uzama ukusebenzisa noma yiziphi izimfanelo ezishiwo kuMthetho). Ulwazi lokuthi izikhungo zomphakathi nezangasese ziqoqe kanjani amarekhodi, nokuthi abafuna ulwazi bangawathola kanjani amarekhodi, kanye nokukhulula ezinye izinhlobo zamarekhodi ngokuzithandela. Incazelo yezimiso zomthetho ezisunguliwe. Le bhukwana yokuhola izobuyekezwa ngolwazi olusha futhi iphinde iphumeze eminyakeni emibili. Izincwadi ezikhethiwe kuzo zonke izifunda, ezibizwa ngokuthi "izindawo zokugcina ezisemthethweni," ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokugcina Osemthethweni (Umthetho No. 54 ka-1997). Zonke izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezisunguliwe ngokusemthethweni. Zonke ofisi zezikhungo zomphakathi, kubandakanya zonke izikhungo zomkhandlu kanye nazo zonke izikhungo zeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kutholakale emahhovisi eSAHRC nasemakhasini ewebhu eSAHRC ku-http://www.sahrc.org.za. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izophrintwa kwiGazethi Yomphakathi. Ingafinyelelwa mahhala ezikhungweni ezishiwo ngenhla, nakuba kungase kube nezindleko zokukopisha. Izicelo zokufinyelela kumarekhodi eDHA kumele zenziwe kufomu esemthethweni ephezulu kuMthetho Wokubika No. R. 187 owashicilelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002. Lo Mthetho ubonisa kabanzi ofisa ulwazi njengomuntu okufanele wamukele futhi aphehle izicelo, kodwa kufanele kucatshangelwe ukuthi isigaba 17 sivumela abantu abaningi ukuba bahlonishwe ukuze basize ofisa ulwazi. Lezi zikhonzi ezichaziwe zibizwa ngokuthi abasisekeli bofisa ulwazi. Le fomu kulula ukuyigcwalisa, kodwa uma kudingeka, ungabiza umphakathi ofisa ulwazi ukuze akusize. Uma umfuna ulwazi engakwazi ukwenza isicelo esibhaliwe, umphakathi ofisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu futhi unikeze umfuna ulwazi ikhophi. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bazi ukuthi yimaphi amarekhodi abafuna. Uma umfuna ulwazi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana namarekhodi adingekayo ukuze kube lula ukuwafaka, iDHA izokwazi ukusiza umfuna ulwazi ngokushesha. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bathole ukuthi ubani ophethe amarekhodi. Kumele basebenzise uhlu lwezihloko nezigaba zolwazi olugcinwe ngofisa ulwazi ukuze bathole ukuthi ubani ofisa ulwazi onamarekhodi, bese bethumela izicelo zabo kulowo ofisa ulwazi. Umfisa ulwazi ngamunye unomthwalo wokuthola ukuthi kufanele anikeze imvume yokufinyelela kumarekhodi ngaphansi kokulawula kwabo. Amafomu okucela atholakala kunoma iyiphi ofisa ulwazi. Angasetshenziswa futhi ngekopya yefomu. Ifomu lokucela eligcwaliswe lingaba nolwazi oluningi kangangokuthi umfuna ulwazi angase angakwazi ukulithumela. Kuzokwenywa kuphela imali, ama-oda eposi, kanye nezinkokhelo ezivunyelwe yibhange. Ukukhokha kungakwenziwa ehhovisi leDHA eliseduze (uma le ofisi ingenayo imali, izothumela umfuna ulwazi ehhovisi leDHA elinayo) futhi ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-receipt kufanele ixhunywe kufomu lokucela. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukukhokha kwakho kungahambisana nefomu lokucela kanye ne-receipt oyitholile. Ngemuva kokuthi ifomu igcwaliswe, kufanele ithunyelwe kumphakathi ofisa ulwazi ofanele. Akudingeki ukuthi ithunyelwe ngokuqondile; empeleni, lokhu kungase kwenzeke kuphela uma izivumelwano zenzekile ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Idokhumenti egcwalisiwe ingafakswa, ithunyelwe nge-imeyili, ithunyelwe, noma ithunyelwe nge-courier kumphakathi ofisa ulwazi ofanele. Uma umfuna ulwazi engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma ukuphazamiseka kumvimbela ekwenzeni isicelo, umfuna ulwazi angacela usizo kumphakathi ofisa ulwazi. Kuvame ukuba ngcono ukuhlela kusenesikhathi ukuze wenze isicelo somlomo futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani lokhu kubalulekile. Ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana ngezinkinga, umphakathi ofisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu lokucela kumfuna ulwazi futhi unikeze ikhophi yefomu eligcwaliswe. Abafisa ulwazi eDHA bazokwazi ukusiza abafuna amarekhodi eDHA. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasisekeli bofisa ulwazi balo mnyango bazosiza abafuna ulwazi abafuna ukufaka isicelo kumunye umnyango noma inhlangano ezimele. Nokho, izicelo zingase z
Umnyango wezobulungiswa ungowesigaba sokupholisa lapho indawo yokusebenza kwamaphoyisa ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane, ezilawulwayo ezaziwa ngokuthi izigaba. I-SAPS izokhetha uphoyisa, owaziwa ngokuthi umphathi wesigaba, kuyo yonke isigaba. Imiphakathi kanye nabaphathi bezigaba bazoba ababambiqhaza abenza okuthile ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha nokuvikeleka endaweni abahlala kuyo. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela umphakathi esigabeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ngokumelene nobugebengu bendawo njengokubambisana. Ukuze kube nesixhumanisi phakathi komphakathi wesigaba kanye nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo. Ukuze kusebenze njengomphakathi wokuvikela ubugebengu, ophatha zonke izinhlelo nezinhlelo ezibhekana nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze kuxoxwe ngezinhlelo zokwenza nezomphakathi wesigaba ukuze kubhekwane nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze kusungulwe futhi kubambe iqhaza emicimbini yasendaweni ukuze kugcinwe indawo abahlala kuyo iphephile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane neziphakamiso zokuvikela ubugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze kusekelwe ngempela umnyango wezobulungiswa wezivakashi ezindaweni. Ukuze uxhumane nomphathi wakho wesigaba ukuze wenze indawo ophila kuyo iphephile. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, amaqembu omphakathi, izinhlangano zabahlali, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi bamenywa ukuba babambe iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezinkinga eziholela kubugebengu esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inengxenye yokweseka umphakathi, ehlinzeka bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo ababuya emiphakathini eyayithintekile ngodlame, ngemininingwane nezidingo. Ngokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo ezikhiqiza amafilimu, le ndawo ihlose ukufinyelela kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. I-archive kazwelonke egcina amafilimu, ividiyo, kanye nolwazi olurekhodiwe lwezwi ibamba iqhaza emikhankasweni ehlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo zimenyiwe ukuba zibheke amafilimu futhi zixoxe ngezihloko ezithile ezidinga ukubhekwa. Lokhu kwenziwe ngokuxhumana nabafundisi nabafundisi. Inhloso enkulu yale ngxenye yokweseka umphakathi ukulethela "izindawo zokubuka amafilimu abantu," ezizothokozisa imiphakathi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinye izikhungo ezifana nezikole, imboni efanele, amaqembu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukufinyelela emiphakathini yasemaphandleni engazi ukuthi le archive ingakwenza kanjani njengoba nayo inamalungelo okufinyelela ulwazi. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukusebenzisa Izikhungo Zezobuciko Zomphakathi, ezisunguliwe nguMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, ukuze kufezwe le njongo. Izindawo zezakhamuzi, izikole, nezindawo zomphakathi nazo zizosebenza. Siphakamisa umphakathi kanye nanoma ubani ofisa ukuxhumana nomlando nempilo yaleli zwe ukuthi axhumane nathi uma efuna ukufaka isicelo sokusebenzisa izinsizakalo ze-archive kazwelonke, i-NAFVSA. I-NAFVSA inengxenye egxile ekuvikelweni komlando orekhodwe ogcwalise izikhala endabeni yethu yomlando. Kuxoxiswane nabantu abanolwazi ngezihloko ezihlukahlukene ezihlobene namasiko, ubuciko, umlando, kanye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuqoqwa, ukuvikelwa, nokusatshalaliswa komculo wendabuko kukhuthazwa ngohlelo lwethu olubizwa ngokuthi i-Traditional Musical Instrument Exhibition. Ukuqoqwa kwezinto ezirekhodiwe ze-audio nezomfanekiso (kokubili komphakathi kanye nokungakhethi) nezinye izenzo ezihlobene ezikhiqizwe noma ezihlobene neNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bangafinyelela kulezi ziqophi futhi bakhuthazwe ukuthi zisetshenziswe ngabo bonke. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezigcina lezi ziqophi. I-NAFVSA inendawo yokucwaninga lapho abacwaningi bengathola usizo lwezinhlobo zonke uma befuna ulwazi, futhi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe kumakhompyutha mahhala. Ukubuka nokulalela izinto ezishicilelwe kufanele kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi. Udinga ukwazisa isikhungo okungenani ezinsukwini ezintathu ngaphambi kokulungiselela okuthandayo nokukufaka kumishini efanele. Lezi zinto zingasetshenziswa kuphela ezindaweni ze-NAFVSA futhi kuzokwenziwa imali ethile ethathwe nguMnyango Wezezimali. Abafundi nabafundi bangasebenzisa lezi zinto mahhala, kodwa badinga futhi ukuhlela ngaphambi kokulalela nokubuka. Imvume ebhaliwe evela kubadali iyadingeka uma othile efuna amakhophi ento ethile. Ibhuku lethu linezincwadi eziyi-3000 ezikhethekile ezihlobene nomkhakha wefilimu, oqale kudala ngesikhathi seBhodi LezamaFilimu, futhi izinto ezingahlangene azikahlinzekwa nhlobo ngenxa yokubaluleka kwazo. Nokho, zonke izincwadi zebhuku zingabukwa ku-Archive Yezomlando Kazwelonke, futhi amakhophi angakhiqizwa ngentengo ephansi. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo leziqeshana zamafilimu ezikhethekile ezilinganiselwa ku-1000, ezibuyela emuva ngesikhathi seDe Voortrekkers, okuyifilimu endala kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi leziqeshana lingempela lihluke kakhulu futhi lihlobene nazo zonke izinhlobo zamafilimu ezikhiqizwe ezweni lethu. Inhloso ye-archive ngalezi ziqeshana ukuzenza zirekhodiwe ngokuqondile futhi zigcinwe eqoqweni lapho zingasetshenziswa ngaphandle kokuphuma. Njengokuqoqwa kweziqeshana, i-Archive ineqoqo lezithombe ezihlobene namafilimu kuleli. Izithombe zamafilimu cishe zonke ezikhiqizwe kuleli kusukela ngonyaka ka-1916 zingatholakala lapha. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo leziqeshana zamafilimu ezilinganiselwa ku-1200 ezikhiqizwe kuleli. Iningi leziqeshana lisesigabeni sokulungiselela, ngakho-ke lihlukile kakhulu kumkhiqizo ophelile olungiselelwe ukubukwa. I-NAFVSA iphinde ibe umgcinimafa wezincwadi zezindaba, ezihlanganisa imibhalo, iziqeshana ezikhethiwe zezindaba ezivela ezincwadini, izithombe, izinhlelo, kanye nezikhangiso ezihlobene nezindawo zokusebenza, umculo, ubuciko, kanye nezandla. Iningi lezi zinto kulesi sigaba laqala ngeminikelo evela kubantu kanye nezikhungo ezizimele ezinomdlandla kwezobuciko nezandla. I-NAFVSA ikhethekile ngoba iyingxenye yezinqolobane ezimbalwa emhlabeni ezigcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nezinto ezirekhodiwe ezingenziwa zaba yizinto ezilalelwayo ngaphansi komoya owodwa. Ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lolwazi olukhombisa umlando wezwe lethu eNingizimu Afrika ngemicabango kube usizo futhi kuzokwenza kube umthombo omkhulu wezizukulwane ezizayo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Bangakwazi futhi ukubheka kalula okwenzekile esikhathini esedlule, futhi lokhu kungabeka abantu endaweni yokucabanga ukuthi umkhakha wefilimu nezinsiza zokurekhoda zizobukeka kanjani esikhathini esizayo. Ngenxa yokushintsha kwezobuchwepheshe okusheshayo, imishini esetshenziswe eminyakeni engama-20 edlule manje isiphukile, kodwa ingasetshenziswa ukuze ihlinzeke ngolwazi lomlando, kanye nokubon
I-borer ye-corn iyisiphukuphuku esitholakala kuzo zonke izindawo lapho kukhuliswayo khona u-mazeyu e-Afrika - lesi siphukuphuku sitholakala kuphela e-Afrika kanti ezinye izinhlobo zaso zihlala ezindaweni lapho u-mazeyu ukhula khona. Ngokuvamile, singathi lesi siphukuphuku sikhona ingozi efana no-10% yokukhiqizwa kwe-mazeyu unyaka nonyaka - kodwa singalimaza yonke imiphumela. Ama-larvae adla ezihlahleni, ezitheni, nasezithombeni ze-mazeyu. Ulwazi mayelana ne-bioloji nokuthi lesi siphukuphuku siphila kanjani kubalulekile uma sizama ukuqonda indlela yokulawula nokulawula. Ama-larvae akhulelwe aphila ezitsheni ze-mazeyu ezisele ezindaweni ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngemuva kwalokhu, isizukulwane sokuqala sama-moths sikhululeka ukuze sibhale amaqanda ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyi-7 kuya kweziyi-10. Ama-larvae akhula azodla izinyanga eziyisithupha ngaphambi kokuba aguquke abe ama-pupae ngaphakathi kwezitho ze-mazeyu. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu, ama-moths amanye akhululeka futhi angasabalalisa lesi siphukuphuku yonke indawo abakhona. Ekuhlakuleleni, kunezindlela eziningi zokulawula lesi siphukuphuku. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwemichiza, izinhlobo zezitshalo, izindlela zemvelo, nokulawulwa kwe-biological ngezinye iziphukuphuku. Lokhu ngeke kuqinisekise ukusulwa okuphelele kodwa kuzosisiza ukuphatha lesi sifo ngaphandle kokusabalala futhi kufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle. Imichiza yokulawula i-corn borer ibhaliswe njengezithako zokuxhumana noma izithako ezidliwayo yilesi siphukuphuku. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi imichiza ebizayo ingcono, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezibiza kancane ezisebenza kahle. Kuthiwa ukuphatha lesi siphukuphuku ngemichiza engabulali ngenkathi ethile yamasonto ayisithupha kungaba yinkinga. Ngenxa kwezindleko zemichiza, abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi basebenzisa ukwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuhlanza imichiza kusenesikhathi kubonakale kungasebenzi. Ukuphatha lesi siphukuphuku ngemichiza kufanele kwenzeke kuphela uma kubonakala ukuthi u-10% wezitshalo ukhombisa izimpawu zengozi ngoba ama-larvae aqala ukudla ezihlahleni. Ukuhlola ingozi ye-10% kungaba uphawu lokufaneleka kokusetshenziswa kwemichiza ngesikhathi. Mhlawumbe ukuhluza kuphela kungase kungabi kuhle ngoba lesi siphukuphuku singavela futhi. Ngonyaka onjengalona, kungase kube nesidingo sokuhlola kahle ukutholakala kwama-larvae uma u-mazeyu uqala ukuvuthwa. Lapho ama-larvae amancane engabulawa ngokushesha ngaphambi kokulimaza kakhulu ukuvuthwa kwesivuno. Uhlosile ukubulala lawa ma-larvae ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuthwa kufinyelele cishe ku-50%. Ukungeniswa kwezinhlobo ze-Bt-maize kwehlisile ingozi yokuhlaselwa yiziphukuphuku ngoba azivamile ukudliwa yi-corn borer. Lokhu kukwenze kwadingeka imichiza kancane ngoba kukhona igene elibulala ama-larvae aleli siphukuphuku. Nokho, hhayi zonke izinhlobo ze-Bt-maize zisebenza kahle ngokumelene ne-corn borer - ngakho abalimi kufanele bakhethe kahle ukuthi yisiphi isivuno okufanele basitshale ngonyaka ozayo naphakade. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) kufanele bazi ukuthi kunezinsuku eziyi-10 lapho ama-larvae eziphukuphuku angadla khona isivuno. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba imichiza ixhumana nomswakama okukhona ezihlahleni, kuvumela ama-larvae eziphukuphuku ukuba aphile. Ingozi ehlinzekwa yilezi zimpukane izovela ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa ngeke ibe yingozi enkulu. Lawa ma-larvae akhiqiza ama-moths azovunguza ngonyaka omusha. Uma ukhetha ukufaka imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi iyiphi inketho enezindleko eziphezulu ngoba i-Bt-maize ibiza. Ukuhlakulela ebusika kungasiza ngoba iziphukuphuku ezihlala ezitsheni ze-mazeyu ezindaweni zizobulawa futhi ngeke ziphinde zivele ngonyaka olandelayo. Futhi, ubusika obubandayo buzobulala ezinye. Uma utshala ebusika, kungase kuholele ekutheni ama-larvae angene emhlabathini, futhi ama-moths azophumelela ukuvela nokuvunguza ngonyaka omusha. Kukhona ezinye izibungu ezivame ukudla amaqanda nama-larvae eziphukuphuku, kodwa azinciphisi kakhulu ingozi. Abanye abalimi abangatshali izinkambu ezinkulu bangazama ukutshala utshani obubizwa ngokuthi u-Napier - iziphukuphuku zingena enkambini futhi zishiya u-mazeyu. Kodwa noma abanye abalimi abakhulu bangazama ukutshala lobu butshani ngoba bungokudla okuhle kwezinkomo. Izindlela zemvelo nokulawulwa kwe-biological ngezinye iziphukuphuku azisebenzi kahle - kungcono ukuzama imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize. Bonke abalimi be-mazeyu bayazi ukuthi i-corn borer ibeka ingozi enkulu. Kufanele ilawulwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Umbuzo 1: Yini eyenzeka ngesikhathi sokubeletha? Impendulo: Ngesikhathi sokubeletha, umama udinga ukunakekelwa kahle. Izibhedlela zisebenzisa izinyathelo ezithile, ezifaka phakathi odokotela abanolwazi, abahlengikazi, kanye nezinsiza ezikhaliphile. Umama kufanele agcinwe ethokomele, kanti izingane zidinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhula kahle. Umbuzo 2: Yini okufanele ikwenze umama ngemuva kokubeletha? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokubeletha, umama kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukuphumula okwanele. Kubalulekile ukudla ukudla okunempilo ukuze akhuthaze ukukhiqizwa kwegazi, futhi afune usizo uma kudingeka. Ukuhlola impilo yakhe, kanye nokubona ukuthi ingane iyaphila, kubalulekile. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo zokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa? Impendulo: Izinyathelo zokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa zifaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukugcina ingane ibanda, kanye nokunikeza ukudla okufanele. Izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zidinga ukunakwa okukhethekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azikho izinkinga zempilo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngengane ngezakhamzimba ezifanele. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinkinga ezivame ukwenzeka ezinganeni ezisanda kuzalwa? Impendulo: Ezinye zezinkinga ezivame ukwenzeka zifaka phakathi ukungaphatheki kahle, ukushisa okukhulu, noma izinkinga zokuphefumula. Ukuhlolwa kwempilo okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale lezi zinkinga ngesikhathi. Abahlengikazi bahlola izingane njalo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi zikhula kahle. Umbuzo 5: Yini eyenziwa uma ingane ingaphatheki kahle? Impendulo: Uma ingane ingaphatheki kahle, abahlengikazi bazoqala ngezinqubo zokuhlola. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlola amazinga okushisa, ukuphendula kwezingane, kanye nezimpawu zempilo. Uma kudingeka, umntwana angathola ukwelashwa okusheshayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uphila kahle. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe umama unelungelo lokukhuluma noDokotela? Impendulo: Yebo, umama unelungelo lokukhuluma noDokotela noma abahlengikazi. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bazi ukuthi bangabeka imibuzo ngezinkinga zabo, futhi baziqinisekise ukuthi bayawuqonda umthelela wokunakekelwa kwezingane zabo. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komama nabasebenzi bezempilo kubalulekile. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ikwenze umama ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ingane yakhe ikhulile kahle? Impendulo: Umama kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ingane yakhe ithola ukudla okufanele, izinsiza zokunakekelwa, futhi iboniswa uthando. Ukuthola usizo lwezokwelapha njalo, kanye nokulandela izeluleko zodokotela, kubalulekile ukuze ingane ikhulise impilo yayo. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ikwenze umama ukuze azinakekele? Impendulo: Umama kufanele azinakekele ngokuphila kahle, ukuhamba, futhi abheke impilo yakhe. Ukuthola usizo kumngane noma emndenini, ukuze akwazi ukuphumula, kubalulekile. Ukuze akwazi ukunakekela ingane, umama kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi naye uyaphila. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izibhedlela zikhona ezikhethekile zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezibhedlela ezikhethekile ezihlinzeka ngempilo yezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lezi zibhedlela zihlala zinezinqubo ezithile ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela izingane, ezihlanganisa izinsiza ezikhethekile, abahlengikazi abanolwazi, kanye nodokotela abaqeqeshiwe. Umbuzo 10: Yini umphakathi angayenza ukuze usize umama nezingane? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa umama, ezifana nezinsiza zokunakekela izingane, izifundo zokunakekela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphila kahle. Ukuxhasa umama ngemali, izinsiza, noma ngempilo yengqondo kubalulekile ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ingane yakhe ikhulile kahle. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo yabo. Ukuqonda lezi zinyathelo, kanye nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi komama nabasebenzi bezempilo, kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Umama, umphakathi, kanye nezibhedlela kumele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula ziphilile, zithokozile, futhi zikhululekile.
Amaqhaza okudoba ahilela ukusebenzisa ilungelo lakho lokudoba. Le ngelosi kumele iceliwe ngumuntu oyinikezelwe ukuyisebenzisa, ukuze athole izinkanyezi olwandle noma azibandakanye emisebenzini ephathelene nokudoba ukuze athengise. Kubandakanya ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene nokudoba kodwa kuvinjelwe ukudla izinkanyezi ezitholiwe. Ukuze usebenzise amalungelo akho okudoba, thumela isicelo sephermithi yokudoba esheshayo esinikezwa nguNgqongqoshe wezigaba eziphathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiweyo. Amalungelo aphelele noma alinganiselwe anikezwa ngezinyoni ezithile zezinhlanzi yi-department ye-DEA&T ngokususelwa kumkhawulo wokudoba ovunyelwe okwenziwa minyaka yonke nguNgqongqoshe wezigaba eziphathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha. Kumele ufake isicelo se-right yokudoba ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo se-permit yokudoba. Ngaphezu kwe-permit yokudoba, uzodinga iphepha lokuthutha izinkanyezi ukuze ukwazi ukuzithutha. Faka isicelo samalungelo akho okudoba uma umgovernment ikumema ukuthi wenze kanjalo, okuzobhalwa ezikhangisweni zikamasipala. Thola ifomu lesicelo emnyangweni ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma uye lapho kuzokutshelwa khona ukuthi ukhulume ne-DEA&T. Funda ifomu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyahlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zesicelo. Qedela, sign, futhi uthumele ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo nezitifiketi, kanye nezimali ezidingekayo endaweni ethile noma ehhovisi le-DEA&T eliseduze. Ukuprocessing kwezicelo kuzokwenziwa ngemva kwesikhathi sokugcina sokufaka izicelo, futhi imiphumela izokhulumwa ngocingo ne-DEA&T. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinyanga eziyi-1 kuya kweziyi-3 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngempahla yokusebenza noma ukutholakala kwezinhlanzi. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngenani labafakizicelo.
Unyaka unaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha. Bafaka imithi emzimbeni wonke kusukela emathangeni kuze kube ezindlebeni. Linda imithi yomile. Shiya imithi emzimbeni usuku oluphelele (24 hrs) bese uyihlanza emva kwalolo suku. Phinda ngosuku olulandelayo. Kubantwana abangaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha, landela inqubo efanayo njengabantu abadala. Kungase kudingeke ukuphinda ngemuva kwesonto, qhubeka usebenzisa imithi. Gqoka izingubo ezihlanzekile ngemuva kokusebenzisa imithi. Bonke amalungu omndeni kumele ahlolwe. Gcoba izipikili futhi ugcine zihlanzekile. Hlanza zonke izindwangu zokulala nezembatho ngamanzi ashisa. Omile elangeni. Hlanza umzimba ngamanzi warms ne sabuni, uhlole izindawo ezithintekile ngombhoxo noma ithawula lokuhlamba. Sula indawo ethintekile ngendwangu bese uyomisa ngethawula elihlanzekile. Indlu yonke kumele ihlanzwe ngempahla yokuhlambulula. Ukutheleleka kusabalala kakhulu ngenxa yokungabi nehlanzeko, ukugcina umuntu ehlanzekile kuzovikela ezimeni zokugula, ngakho hlanza umzimba njalo, futhi ugcine izingubo nezindwangu zokulala zihlanzekile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Abantu abanezikhalazo kumele basheshe baye esibhedlela ngokushesha futhi balandele konke abakutshelwa ngababheki. Abazali kumele bakhuthaze izingane ukuba zihlale zihlanzekile. Ukuhlanza kuvela ezindaweni ezifudumele zomzimba (emathangeni nasemgudwini), ukungakhululeki kubi kakhulu ebusuku. Isikhumba singase sibe nezinhlungu. Inhliziyo nezitho zomzimba zingase zingasebenzi kahle. Isinyathelo esilandelayo wukufa uma kungaphathwa. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, izilonda ezingapholi zingase zivele. Ukutheleleka kusabalala kanjani? Kwenziwa kanjani ukuvimbela? Ukutheleleka kungathinta izinyoni ezincane. 1. Ukuhlanzeka komuntu: - kulabo abathintekile (kufana nezinyoni kodwa zincane kakhulu). Uma lezi zinyoni zikhona, zingadala ukungakhululeki esikhumbeni futhi ziholele ekuhlanzeni nasekufakeni izingubo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi zibeka amaqanda. Ngokuxhumana nomuntu onakho, umuntu angase ahlanze izingubo noma izindwangu zokulala, beqaphela elangeni ukuze bafe amaqanda. Kubantu abake babe nokutheleleka, izimpawu zingavela ezinsukwini eziyodwa kuya kwezine kamuva. Izingane akufanele zidlale nezilwane uma zixhumana nomuntu noma isilwane (njengamakhaya) esinokutheleleka. 6. Abantu abakha amanzi ezindaweni kufanele baqaphele. Ubani ongathinteka ekuthelekeni? Ukutheleleka kungathinta abantu bezizukulwane zonke, kungakhathalekile iminyaka, ubulili, ubuhlanga, noma izinga lokuhlanzeka. Kusabalala ngegciwane. Izigameko eziningi noma ukuqubuka kokutheleleka kuvame ukubonwa ezindlini zabapheki, kanye nasezikhungweni zokunakekela izingane. 1. Bonke amalungu omndeni kumele aphathwe ngesikhathi esisodwa nangendlela efanayo ukuze ukutheleleka kungathinti abanye.
Umbiko: uMfula iNile Isingeniso UMfula iNile ungomunye wemifula emikhulu kakhulu emhlabeni. Uqhamuka eNyakatho ye-Afrika, udlula ezindaweni eziningi, ubamba kakhulu emlandweni, emnandi, nasekuthuthukiseni izindawo ezihlangene naso. Uthathwa njengenye yezimpophoma ezibaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni, ngenxa yezenzo zawo ezifaka izivinini, izilwane, kanye nezinhlobo ezahlukene zezomnotho. Uhlanga lokuhlala Nangona iNile ingakafiki kuzo zonke izindawo, ibalulekile kumiphakathi eminingi. Izihlahla ezizungezile zithokozisa kakhulu abantu abaningi abahlala eduze kwalolu mfula. Uvame ukwenziwa umlando nezinkolelo zamakholwa ahlukene, futhi imiphakathi ethokozisayo iyazinikela ekulondolozeni imvelo yayo. Abantu bakulezi zindawo bahlala ngezindlela ezahlukene, bezama ukuhlanganisa izimfanelo zabo zomdabu nezakuwe zalesi sikhala esibanzi. Ukwakhiwa kwemvelo UMfula iNile uqhamuka ezintabeni zikaBhar (Uganda) bese uhamba unqamula izwe laseSudan, ngaphambi kokufika eGibhithe. U kuyinde, unomlilo omkhulu okhanyisayo ngamalanga amaningi, futhi uhambela emanzini amnyama agqamile. Lokhu okwaziyo ukuvusa imizwa ye-soul esimi ngaphakathi kwabantu abavakasha kule ndawo. Ubudlelwano bempilo phakathi kwabantu, izilwane, nezitshalo buhamba kahle, kube kuhle konke. Ukukhula kwezinto eziphilayo kule ndawo kuhlobene kakhulu nokubumbene kwalezi zinto. Izinsizakalo ezibangelwa uMfula iNile UMfula iNile unendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezindawo ezidlangile, ikakhulukazi eGibhithe. Uthela kakhulu kubalimi, obavumela ukuba bakhe imikhiqizo yezinhlamvu ezifana nohlu lobhuku, imbuzi, nezithelo ezahlukene. Lokhu kuholela ekukhuleni kwemisebenzi, futhi kudala amathuba okuphila. Abalimi benza izivumelwano ezinhle nezinkampani, bezama ukwandisa umphakathi kanye nezinsizakalo zabo. Imiphumela yokuhlala nesimo sezulu Kodwa-ke, ubukhona bomfula abukhona ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Izinguquko zesimo sezulu ziyaqhubeka zithinta indawo, zenza kube nzima kubalimi ukuthola umkhiqizo ophumela kuNile. Izinselelo ezifana nezimo zokuchitheka kwemithombo yamanzi kanye nokuphuma ngenxa kwezikhukhula kuyathinta ukuyeka kwabo ekuphileni. Yilokhu okwenza kubalulekile ukuba abahlali bahlanganyele ngezobuchwepheshe ukuze bathole izixazululo. Izinkolelo zabantu Imisebenzi yomuntu iyahlala ihlukaniswa ngezinkolelo ezizungezile uMfula iNile. Abantu abaninzi bakholelwa ukuthi umfula udlalisa indima ethile empilweni yabo. Izinhlangano zamasiko avame ukuphakanyiswa, zithuthukisa umlando namasiko edlule, kudala isithakazelo sokugcina izinkolelo ezibhalwe phansi. Abaningi bancamela ukwazisa umfula njengomthombo wemisebenzi, ukuphila, nokufunda. Ukubaluleka komfula UMfula iNile uphinde ube nendima enkulu emithonjeni yesayensi. Izinhlangano eziningi zitshala imali ocwaningweni lokuqonda izimfanelo zegciwane elitholakala emanzini, okusiza ekudaleni imishado phakathi kobunjiniyela bemvelo. Umoya osesimweni sezolimo kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola zikhuthaza abacwaningi bokugcina izinto ezilimazayo ngemizwa ethinta izizukulwane ezizayo. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganyela kwazo zonke lezi zinto, uMfula iNile awuyena kuphela umfula, kodwa uyithuluzi lokwenza izinqumo ezithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Uthinta izinhlaka zomphakathi, umnotho, nokuthuthukiswa kwesayensi. Kubalulekile ukuthi abahlali, ochwepheshe, nabaholi baphakamise izanda zokugcina leli thuli eliwusizo elingokoqobo. Lokhu kuzobaphilisa nesikhumbuzo, ukuze iNile ibaluleke njengomfula ohlukile, okhanyayo, nohlezi uvela, umiselekile phakathi kwabantu nezimfanelo zempilo.
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Ikhono Lokukhulisa Impilo Yezingane Nez母 Ngonyaka wezi-2023, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibe neqhaza elibalulekile ekuphuculeni impilo yabesifazane nabantwana eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinsizakalo, ezihlinzekwa emabhulohweni nasemazibukweni ahlukene, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele ngesikhathi sokubeletha, okubalulekile empilweni yabo nasemiphumeleni yokukhula kwezingane zabo. Ubuciko Bokubeletha Amabhulogi, izindawo zokubeletha, kanye nezibhedlela zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane bangathola usizo lwezempilo oluphumelelayo ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukuze kube nokwenziwa kahle, izinsizakalo zokubeletha zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene, kufaka phakathi ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili, iziguli zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe nezeluleko ezithile eziphumelele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwangaphambi kokubeletha, ukukhethwa kwezindlela zokubeletha, kanye nokulandela izinqubo eziphephile. Ukwaneliseka Kwemindeni Njengoba izinsizakalo zokubeletha zanda, abesifazane bahlala bejabulile ngokuthi banethuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ababaziyo nezifiso zabo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kithi ukufinyelela izidingo zabo, kulula nakakhulu uma kuziwa ezinqubweni zokubeletha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikhuthaza imindeni ukuba ibambe iqhaza ekuthatheni izinqumo ezithinta impilo yazo, okuhlanganisa nokukhetha izindlela zokubeletha ezihambisana nezintandokazi zabo. Izifundo Ezivela Eziqhingini Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubeletha zihlala ziqhuba izifundo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane bazi kahle izinqubo ezithinta impilo yabo. Lezi zifundo zifaka phakathi ukuxhumana, ukwelashwa kwezempilo, kanye nemikhuba yokuphila enempilo. Ngale ndlela, abesifazane bangathola ulwazi olunembile nolwakha amandla, okuhloswe ngalo ukuthuthukisa impilo yabo nezingane zabo. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma izinsizakalo zokubeletha ziqhubeka nokukhula, zikhona izinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nazo. Ukuntuleka kwemithombo yezezimali, ukuqashwa kwezisebenzi ezinemfundo efanele, kanye nezinsiza ezinganele zishiya abesifazane bezwa sekuthinteka. Izibhedlela zisebenza ngokuqhubekayo ukuze zibone izixazululo, zifaka phakathi ukusungula izinhlelo zokuxhasa abesifazane abakwiqembu elingathokozwa. Umqondo Wokubambisana Ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano phakathi kwezibhedlela nomphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni isikhala esikhuthazayo sokubeletha. Izibhedlela ziyaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezempilo kumphakathi, futhi lokhu kusezingeni eliphezulu, okwenza kube lula ukubandakanya imindeni. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemigudu yokuxhumana phakathi kwezibhedlela nezindawo zomphakathi kuba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokubeletha. Ukubhekana Nezinguquko Zesikhathi Esizayo Kukhona umuzwa omuhle wokuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zizoqhubeka nokwenza kahle, njengezibhedlela ezithuthukisa izinsiza zazo. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezizwe lujolise ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokubeletha, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuxhasa abesifazane abakhulelwe. Lokhu kuzofaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, nokwandisa ukufinyelela kokunakekelwa kwemvelo. Isiphetho Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zibe nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabesifazane nabantwana eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuqhubekayo, zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwezibhedlela nomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. Njengoba izinsizakalo ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kutholakala izinsiza ezanele, ukuze abesifazane bakwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele ngesikhathi sokubeletha, lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhulisa izingane eziphilayo nezinempilo.
Ithenisi: Umhlahlandlela Wokudlala Nokuthuthukisa Amakhono Ithenisi, umdlalo odlalwa emhlabeni wonke, ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ukugcina impilo, nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ukudlala ithenisi kudinga ubuchule, umqondo ophusile, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokuzikhandla. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka zokudlala ithenisi, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni. Isigaba 1: Ukulungiselela Ukudlala Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukudlala, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nezingubo ezifanele. Ukugqoka izingubo ezikhululekile, ezikhethekile zokudlala ithenisi, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Qiniseka ukuthi unama-sneakers anekhono lokubamba kahle emhlabeni, ukuze ugweme ukuwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele ube nebhola letennis elihle, kanye nezinsiza ezifanele, njengezintambo ezinhle. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyazithokozela izikhathi zakho zokuqeqesha, hlela isikhathi esithile sokudlala. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujolisa emgqeni wakho. Isigaba 2: Ukuqonda Umgomo Womdlalo Umdlalo we-tennis udlalwa phakathi kwabantu ababili (singles) noma amaqembu amabili (doubles). Umgomo uwukuphosa ibhola phezu komgqomo, uqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lishaya emkhakheni womphetho. Umdlalo uqala ngokuphosa ibhola, bese umphosa ophendulayo kufanele abuyisele ibhola emuva. Ngokujwayelekile, umphosa ophumelela ukugcina ibhola emkhakheni womphetho uthola amaphuzu. Iphuzu linikezwa kumphosa ophumelele uma umphosa ophendulayo engakwazi ukubuyisela ibhola. Umphosa ophumelela amaphuzu angu-4, uthola umjaho, uma efika ku-6 amaphuzu, udlula emjaho. Isigaba 3: Amakhono Okudlala Ukudlala ithenisi, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho. Okokuqala, qiniseka ukuthi uyazi ukuthi ungakha kanjani i-forehand ne-backhand. I-forehand iwumphosa owenziwa ngendlebe yakho ethanda, kanti i-backhand iwumphosa owenziwa ngendlebe yakho engathandi. Zama ukwenza lezi zindlela zibe lula, uqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lishaya kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, qonda ukuthi ungayithola kanjani i-serve. I-serve iyisinyathelo sokuqala somjaho, ngakho-ke qiniseka ukuthi uyayithuthukisa. Thola indawo efanele emkhakheni, uthathe ibhola, bese uphonsa phezulu, uqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lishaya kahle emkhakheni. Ukusebenza kanzima ekuthuthukiseni i-serve kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu emidlalweni yakho. Isigaba 4: Ukuhlonipha Umphikisi Ngokudlala ithenisi, kubalulekile ukuhlonipha umphikisi wakho. Zama ukugwema ukukhuluma noma ukwenza izenzo ezincane eziphikisana nomphikisi. Lokhu akukhombisi kuphela ukuhlonipha, kodwa futhi kukhombisa umoya ophakeme. Ukusebenza ndawonye, noma ngabe ungaphikisana, kudala umoya ophilayo emidlalweni. Isigaba 5: Ukuqeqesha Nokuthuthukisa Ukudlala ithenisi kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Hlela isikhathi sokuzilolonga, ungazami kuphela ukudlala imidlalo. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlala uphila, uthanda ukudlala, futhi uthuthukise amakhono akho. Umsebenzi oqhubekayo uzokwenza ube ngcono, futhi uzokwenza uzizwe ujabule emidlalweni. Isigaba 6: Ukubuyekeza Imidlalo Ngemuva kokudlala, kubalulekile ukubuyekeza imidlalo yakho. Bheka ukuthi yiziphi izindawo okudingeka uzithuthukise. Ungasebenzisa amavidiyo ukuze ubuke imidlalo yakho, noma ucele umngane ukuthi akubheke. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle izindawo okudingeka uzithuthukise. Isigaba 7: Ukuzijabulisa Ekugcineni, khumbula ukuthi ithenisi kufanele ibe yinto yokuzijabulisa. Ngakho, qiniseka ukuthi uyayithokozela imidlalo. Yiba nomoya ophakeme, futhi ungavumeli ukwehluleka kukudikibalise. Ukudlala ithenisi akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi ukujabulela isikhathi esihle nabangani. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho, ujabulele ithenisi, futhi ube nomphumela omuhle emidlalweni. Qhubeka uqeqesha, uzithokozise, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuhlonipha umphikisi wakho — lezi zinto zibalulekile emhlabeni we-tennis. Umdlalo unikeza ithuba lokuhlangana, ukufunda, nokukhula. Hamba phambili, ujabulele, futhi ube yinkanyezi emkhakheni we-tennis!
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwezimayini Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyikhulu edlule, iNingizimu Afrika yahlangabezana nezinguquko ezinkulu ngenxa yokutholakala kwezinsiza zemvelo. Izimayini zaba umgogodla wokukhula komnotho, zikhanga abantu abaningi abafuna imisebenzi. Izinsiza ezifana negolide, platinum, kanye namadijithi zaba yizinto ezazithokozisa izinkampani ezinkulu, kodwa zafika nezinkinga ezinzima. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezikhiqiza lezi zinsiza, kodwa bahlushwa izinselelo eziningi. Izimayini zazivame ukuhamba phambili, zishiya izindawo eziningi zibhujiswe, futhi umhlaba wethu waba nezinselelo ezinkulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abantu bahlupheke, izilwane zishiywe zingekho, futhi imvelo yahlupheka. Isahluko 2: Ukubhubhisa Imvelo Njengoba isikhathi sithuthuka, izimayini zathola ukukhula okukhulu. Izinkampani zashintsha izindawo eziningi zibe izindawo zokumba, zibhubhisa izihlahla, izifunda, nezilwandle. Lokhu kubhubhisa kwenza kube nzima ukuthi izilwane zihlale, futhi izitshalo ezazikhula zashabalala. Umhlaba waba mnyama, nezindawo ezazigcwele impilo zashintsha zaba izindawo eziyize. Izinkampani zazisebenzisa izindlela ezinzima zokumba, okwaholela ekukhuleni kwezinkinga zokungcoliswa. Amathafa ayegcwele udaka, amanzi ahlanzekile abhubhiswa, futhi izindawo ezazithokozisa abantu zashabalala. Abantu abahlala eduze kwezindawo zokumba bahlushwa yizinkinga ezifana nokungcoliswa komoya, izifo, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwemithombo yamanzi. Isahluko 3: Ukuphikiswa Nokuzwakala Kwezwi Njengoba izinkinga zikhula, abantu baqala ukuphikisa izimayini. Abantu bendawo, izinkampani ezizimele, kanye nezikhungo ezivuna imvelo zathola izwi eliqinile. Kwakukhona imibhikisho emikhulu, abantu bephakamisa izandla zabo, befuna ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Lokhu kwavusa umqondo wokuthi imvelo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele ivikelwe. Izinkampani zathola ukuthi zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu bendawo. Kwakukhona izinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva, lapho izinkampani zazizama ukwenza kahle, zikhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvuselela imvelo. Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zazivame ukuba yizinkulumo kuphela, futhi abantu babengakholwa ukuthi izinkampani zikhathalela imvelo. Isahluko 4: Ukubuyiselwa Kwezemvelo Ngemuva kweminyaka yokuphikiswa, izinkampani zathola ukuthi kufanele zisebenze ngokubambisana nabantu bendawo. Kwakukhona izinhlelo eziningi zokubuyisela emuva, lapho izinkampani zazithatha izinyathelo zokuvuselela imvelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokulima, ezokuvikela izilwane, kanye nezokuhlala kahle. Izinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko. Izindawo ezazibhujiswe zathola ithuba lokuvuselelwa, izihlahla zakhula, futhi izilwane zabuya. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, imvelo ingabuyiselwa. Isahluko 5: Ukufunda Ekuhluphekeni Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izifundo ezitholakele zafundisa abantu ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi izimayini zingaba nemiphumela emibi, kodwa uma zisebenza kahle, zingasiza ekwakheni umnotho. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela imvelo, ezazihlanganisa izimayini, abantu bendawo, kanye nezikhungo ezivuna imvelo. Izinkampani zathola ukuthi ukuvikelwa kwemvelo akusikho kuphela ukunciphisa umthelela, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu bendawo. Isahluko 6: Isiphetho Namuhla, izimayini zisebenza ngendlela ehloniphekile, ziqinisekisa ukuthi imvelo ivikelwe. Abantu bahlala bebandakanyeka, futhi izinkampani ziyaqhubeka nokwenza izinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, imvelo ingabuyiselwa, futhi izimayini zingaba yinsika yokukhula komnotho ngaphandle kokubhubhisa imvelo. Le ndaba ibalulekile, ngoba ifundisa ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele siyivikele. Izimayini zingaba yinsika yokukhula, kodwa kufanele zisebenze ngendlela ehloniphekile, ukuze sikwazi ukuvikelwa kwemvelo yethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokukhula okuqhubekayo, futhi sizokwazi ukujabulela izinsiza zethu zemvelo isikhathi eside.
Izitifiketi Zobungcweti Zabasebenzi Bakahulumeni: Ukuqinisekisa Ikhwalithi Nokuqinisa Umsebenzi Ngokwanda kwezidingo zokusebenza kahle emiphakathini, uhulumeni uthathe isinyathelo esibalulekile sokwethula izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakhe. Lezi zitifiketi zenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni banamakhono adingekayo ukuze bahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Uhlaka lweZitifiketi Zobungcweti Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zifaka phakathi izifundo ezisemqoka, ezihlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okusemthethweni, ukuhlolwa kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuhlolwa kokusebenza. Ukuze uthole lesi sitifiketi, abasebenzi badinga ukuhamba ezinhlelweni zokufunda ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni, ezikhokhelwa ngempumelelo, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephakeme ezingeni lokusebenza. Uhlelo lwezitifiketi luhlose ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yezinsizakalo ezitholakala kubantu, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaphathi, othisha, abahloli, kanye nabanye abasebenzi bakahulumeni banamakhono afanele. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Izizathu Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezobungcweti Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobungcweti kubalulekile ngoba kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuphucula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe baqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zisebenza kahle, okwakha ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izitifiketi zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babe nekhono lokuphendula ezimweni ezishintshashintshayo, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo. Uhlaka lwezitifiketi luhlinzeka ngethuba lokuqeqesha abasebenzi ngendlela efanele, ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula izidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, ezemfundo, nezokuphatha, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni zabo zomsebenzi. Ukwamukelwa Kwezitifiketi Ukwamukelwa kwezitifiketi kubonakala njengento ebalulekile kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezibanzi zokwazisa, ukuze bonke abasebenzi baqonde kahle izinzuzo ezihambisana nezitifiketi. Uhulumeni usebenza ngokubambisana nezikhungo zemfundo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Izinkampani ezahlukene, ezihlanganisa izikhungo zemfundo, ziqhuba izifundo ezikhethekile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola ulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezisemqoka, izifundo zokuqeqesha, kanye nezifundo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ngale ndlela, uhulumeni uqinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bahlala bephakeme emkhakheni wabo. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Naphezu kwezinhlelo ezinhle zokwethula izitifiketi, kukhona nezinselelo ezithile. Abasebenzi abaningi baveza ukukhathazeka mayelana nezindleko ezihambisana nezifundo, kanye nezikhathi ezidingekayo ukuze baqedele izinhlelo. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, uhulumeni ubheke izindlela zokwenza izifundo zibe lula, kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngama-scholarships, izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, kanye nezifundo ezikwi-inthanethi. Ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokufunda, uhulumeni uqinisekise ukuthi izifundo zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abasebenzi baphumelele futhi bathole izitifiketi zobungcweti. Isiphetho Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni ziwumgogodla wokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yezinsizakalo ezitholakala kubantu. Ngenxa yokusebenza okunembile, uhulumeni uyawuqonda umqondo wokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokuthuthukiswa kwezobungcweti, uhulumeni uqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bephakeme, benza umsebenzi wabo ngempumelelo, futhi behlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nelikhiqizayo.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma abantu abahlala njalo abafuna ukushintsha amakheli abo okuhlala noma amakheli abo eposi bangafaka isicelo eMnyangweni Wezangaphandle kuNombolo Yabantu Kazwelonke. Izicelo zingafakwa nasezikhungweni zezwe laseNingizimu Afrika noma emaphandleni uma ufaka isicelo usuka ngaphandle kwelizwe. Bhala incwadi, uyithumele ngefeksi noma nge-imeyili, bese uyithumela kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ungagcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-4 futhi ufake kopi yokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho. Nikeza i-ID yakho yaseNingizimu Afrika enebhakhodi noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa uma ufaka isicelo. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Isaziso sokushintsha ikheli, BI-4. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
iSamsung Galaxy Umbuzo 1: Iyini iSamsung Galaxy? IMikhiqizo yeSamsung Galaxy iwuhlobo lwezinto eziphilayo, izinsiza kusebenza zedijithali kanye nezikhala ezifana nama-smartphones, ama-tablets, nemishini yokuxhumana. I-Samsung, engomunye wabakhiqizi abaphezulu emhlabeni, yethule le mhlangano ngomqondo wokwenza izinsiza ezithakazelisayo, ezisemqoka, nezisebenziseka kalula kubantu abaningi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi ezithakazelisayo ze-Samsung Galaxy? I-Samsung Galaxy yaziwa ngama-design ayo ahluke kakhulu, izici ezinzima, nomphumela wokusebenza ophakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-smartphones e-Galaxy avame ukuhlinzeka ngezithombe ezinhle kakhulu, izinketho zokukhipha, nezinye izici ezifana ne-5G connectivity, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba naku-inthanethi fast. Umbuzo 3: Kufanele ngikhethe i-Samsung Galaxy noma enye? Ukukhetha i-Samsung Galaxy kuzoba kuhle uma uthanda ukujabulela umkhiqizo osezingeni eliphezulu onemisebenzi eminingi. I-Samsung Galaxy inezici ezithakazelisayo ezifana nokuvikeleka kwedatha, ukhiye wefoni, kanye nezinye izinsiza zobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Uma uhlola izidingo zakho, qhathanisa izici nezindleko, bese uthola okuthandayo. Umbuzo 4: Uma ngithenga i-Samsung Galaxy, yini engiyilindele? Uma uthenga i-Samsung Galaxy, uzothola umkhiqizo onohlelo oluhle, okukhuluma izilimi eziningi, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene, nezithombe eziphezulu. Futhi, uzoba ne-interface yokusebenzisa eyakhayo, ethakazelisa, nehlangabezana nezidingo zabo bonke abasebenzisi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza kuzoba ukulula nokusebenza kahle. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iSamsung Galaxy iyatholakala kuzo zonke izimakethe? Yebo, i-Samsung Galaxy iyatholakala ezimakethe eziphezulu eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezitholakala ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ezitolo ezikhethekile, nakumakethe eziku-inthanethi. I-Samsung isebenzisa inethiwekhi enkulu yethengisa ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu abaningi bangayithola le mikhiqizo. Umbuzo 6: I-Samsung Galaxy iyavuselelwa? Yebo, ama-smartphones e-Samsung Galaxy avame ukuhlinzekwa ngezibuyekezo ezithuthukisayo ezijwayelekile. Lokhu kubalwa nezibuyekezo zesoftware, ukulungiswa kweziphumuzi, nezici ezintsha. Ukuze uthole i-Galaxy yakho isesikhathini, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngezibuyekezo ezifanele. Umbuzo 7: Ngingayithola kanjani usizo uma nginproblema neSamsung Galaxy? Uma uthola ubunzima nge-Samsung Galaxy yakho, ungaxhumana ne-Samsung Customer Service. Bakhona abanikazi bezinsiza abakhethekile ukuze bakusize ngezinkinga ezihlukahlukene. Futhi, ungavakashela kwiwebhusayithi yabo ukuze uthole eminye imininingwane nokwesekwa. Umbuzo 8: I-Samsung Galaxy ingasetshenziswa kangakanani? I-Samsung Galaxy inikeza imisebenzi ebanzi, kufaka phakathi ukufunda, ukubhala, ukudlala imidlalo, kanye nokuxhumana nabanye. Ngendlela yokwakheka, ungayisebenzisa ukuhlela izinkumbulo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba njalo nobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe i-Samsung Galaxy ifanelekile kubo bonke abasebenzisi? I-Samsung Galaxy ifaneleka kakhulu kubantu abaningi ngenxa yokuthokoza kwayo, ukusebenza kahle, nezinzuzo eziningi. Nokho, kuye ngokuthi izidingo zomuntu ngamunye, abanye bangakhetha ezinye izinketho. Kubalulekile ukuhlola izidingo zakho ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi kuthokozisa kahle. Umbuzo 10: Yini engiyidingayo ukuze ngisebenzise iSamsung Galaxy? Ukuze uqale ukusebenzisa i-Samsung Galaxy, uzodinga i-smartphone noma i-tablet, umkhiqizo we-Sim, kanye nekhono lokuxhumana naku-inthanethi. Futhi, udinga umjikelezo wokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuze uthole okuningi kumphakathi wakho. Isiphetho: I-Samsung Galaxy iyinqubo yokudala izinsiza ezimnandi, ezinokuthokozisa, ezisebenziseka kalula, nezisebenza kahle. Ukuze uqonde kahle imikhiqizo ye-Samsung, yiba nogqozi lokuhlola izici ezintsha, ubungcweti, nezindleko. Noma ungathengwa i-Galaxy eyisipesheli, ukukhetha okuhle kuzokwandisa ukuzizwisiswa kwakho kwezobuchwepheshe. Uhlelo lweSamsung Galaxy luhlala luzwakala emhlabeni wonke, luhlinzeka ngolwazi olunamandla lwesimanje. Uyaqhubeka ukhuluma ngendlela obamba ngayo imisebenzi yakho nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe.
Ukufinyelela Kwamahhala Komphakathi Ezikhungweni: Ukubuyekezwa Umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezimo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekufinyeleleni ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Enkathini yamanje, lapho amathuba okuqeqeshwa, imfundo, nezinsizakalo ezihlukene zidingeka ukuze sikhule futhi sithuthuke, ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni kuba yisihloko esibalulekile. Le mibono idinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi izikhungo zethu ziwusizo kangakanani ekwakheni umphakathi osebenzayo. Isimo Samanje Ubukhona bezikhungo zomphakathi, ezifana nezincwadi, izikhungo zokufunda, nezikhungo zamasiko, kudinga ukuvuselelwa. Kuningi okungafezwa uma abantu bezithola bezithola kulezi zinsiza. Kodwa-ke, sidinga ukucacisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamahhala akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngemali. Kuhlobene kakhulu nokwakha indawo evulekile futhi enobungane, lapho wonke umuntu ezwakalisa khona imicabango yakhe. Kulesi sikhathi, izikhungo eziphathelene nemfundo, ezokwelapha, nezemisebenzi zingavula iminyango emisha. Abantu badinga ukufinyelela kulezi zinsizakalo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bayakwazi ukuhlala bephila kahle. Ukubukela phansi isidingo sokuphila kahle okufanele uhlinzeke izinsiza ezithile, kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi. Izithiyo Zokufinyelela Kodwa-ke, kufanele siqonde ukuthi kunezithiyo eziningi ezivimba abantu ekufinyeleleni kulezi zinsiza. Ezinye zalezi zithiyo zingaba yizindleko, izimo zokuhlala, nezimo zomnotho. Lokhu kudinga ukuba ubuhlakani bethu busetshenziswe ngendlela yokuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bangenela kulezi zikhungo kudinga ukuba ziqinise. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezanele kuzoba yisithiyo esikhulu. Izikhungo eziningi zidinga ukuthola izinsiza ezengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi emihle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bangase bangatholi amakhono nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze bakhulise amathuba abo. Imiphumela Yokufinyelela Kwamahhala Uma sizama ukukhulisa ukufinyelela kwamahhala ezikhungweni, imiphumela ingaba yinhle kakhulu. Izikhungo ezivulekile nezithakazelisayo zingaholela ekukhuleni komphakathi. Lokhu kuzodala umphakathi onamandla, onokukhula okunempilo, futhi okwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphusile. Ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwamahhala kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola amathuba okusebenza, imfundo, nokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onesizotha, othembekile, futhi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzoba yinsiza yokwakha izizukulwane ezizayo ezizophumelela. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukufinyelela Kubalulekile ukuthi kukhuthazwe imizamo yokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela. Ukwandisa imithombo yezimali, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, nokwakha amakhono kuzothuthukisa izikhungo. Izinhlelo zokwesekwa, njengokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezikhethekile, zidingeka ukuze abantu bangasebenzisi izithiyo ezikhona. Izikhungo zidinga ukuba ziqhubeke zibambisana nohulumeni, izinkampani, nezikhungo zomphakathi ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo engcono, lapho wonke umuntu ezothola ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono. Isiphetho Ukufinyelela kwamahhala komphakathi ezikhungweni akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza; kuhlobene nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi eqinile, enokuthula. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sizama ukwenza izikhungo zethu zibe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze abantu bethu bakwazi ukuphumelela. Umzamo wokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwamahhala kufanele uqhubeke, ukuze sakhe umphakathi onamandla, ofanele, nolungile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakhekeni kwesizukulwane esizayo esizokwazi ukuphila kahle, sikhule, futhi sithuthuke.
Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi Lwezempilo lwe-GEMS Isingeniso Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla, njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka futhi izinsiza zokwelapha zikhula. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyisikhungo esibalulekile sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lwamalungu lukhululekile futhi luvikelekile, i-GEMS ibeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuvikela le datha. Ukwaziswa Kwenqubo Yokuvikela Ulwazi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, i-GEMS iyasebenzisa izinqubo ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa izindlela zobuchwepheshe, ezokuphatha, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphephile, ezihlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwezinhlaka zedatha, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola ezisiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala lukhululekile. Izinhlelo zokuphepha zifaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amakhodi, izigxivizo, kanye nezinye izindlela zokuvikela ezithuthukisiwe. Izinsiza Zokuvikela Ulwazi I-GEMS inikeza izinsiza ezihlukahlukene zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa amalungu mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela ulwazi lwabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze amalungu aqonde ukuthi kufanele aqaphele kanjani lapho ethola izinsizakalo zezempilo. I-GEMS iphinde inikeze amathuluzi okuphatha ulwazi lwezempilo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezivumela amalungu ukuthi baphathe ulwazi lwabo kalula futhi ngokuphepha. Izingozi Zokwephulwa Kolwazi Noma kunjalo, ukwephulwa kolwazi lwezempilo kungaba nemiphumela emibi. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka, ukwehluleka kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezifanele, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. I-GEMS ibona lezi zingozi futhi ibeka izinqubomgomo ezinzima zokuvikela ulwazi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwabo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphepha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokuvikela ulwazi zisebenza kahle, i-GEMS ibambisana nezikhungo zokuphepha ezahlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenza nezinkampani ezikhethekile ekuphepheni, ezihlinzeka ngolwazi nolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kolwazi. Lokhu kubambisana kusiza i-GEMS ukuthi ihlale ibuyekeza izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze ihambisane nezinguquko emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukwaziswa Nokufundiswa Kwamalungu Ukwaziswa kwamalungu kubalulekile ekwakheni ukuqonda okuphelele kokuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo. I-GEMS inikeza izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlanganisa izifundo ezithinta ukuvikelwa kolwazi, ukuze amalungu akwazi ukuqonda izinqubomgomo ezikhona. Lokhu kufundiswa kuhloswe ngokuqinisa ukuqonda kwamalungu, ukuze bakwazi ukuvikela ulwazi lwabo ngokwabo. Isiphetho Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwabo. Ngezinqubomgomo ezicacile, izinsiza zokuvikela ulwazi, kanye nokubambisana nezikhungo zokuphepha, i-GEMS ibonisa ukuzibophezela kwayo ekuvikeleni ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuqwashisa nokufundiswa kwamalungu kuqhubeka nokuba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo nolwazi. Ngakho-ke, i-GEMS iqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zamanje, iqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala lukhululekile.
Ukufakwa Nokucutshungulwa Kwezicelo Zezimangalo Ze-GEMS Emhlabeni wezempilo, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zibalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ibalulekile ekunikezeni izinsiza zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Nokho, ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kudinga ukuba sikhulume ngokuqonda, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithuthukisayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufakwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ku-GEMS akuyona into elula. Abasebenzisi badinga ukuqonda izinqubo ezithile ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukuze umsebenzisi akwazi ukufaka isicelo, kudingeka ukuthi aqonde kahle izidingo ezithile, njengokuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane efanele, izincwadi ezisemthethweni, kanye nezikhumbuzo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezibekwe yi-GEMS. Ngokuphathelene nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinqubo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Abasebenzisi bahlala bekhathazekile ngalesi sikhathi sokulinda, njengoba izicelo zingathatha isikhathi eside ukuze zicutshungulwe. Lokhu kudala ukunganeliseki, futhi kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke ezinkampanini ezizimele ukuze bathole usizo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibheke indlela yokwenza lezi zinqubo zibe lula, ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabasebenzisi kubalulekile. Abasebenzisi badinga ukwazi ukuthi izicelo zabo zikhona, zicutshungulwa, noma zidinga okuthile ukuze ziqhubeke. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, i-GEMS kufanele ibe nezindlela ezithile zokuxhumana, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ezokuxhumana, noma izikhungo zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Kodwa-ke, akukhona kuphela ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo ezidinga ukwenziwa. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke futhi izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zayo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ukuze kube nokusebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, i-GEMS kufanele ibambisane nezikhungo ezahlukene, ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezithuthukisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibheke izidingo zabantu. Abasebenzisi badinga izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, futhi i-GEMS kufanele ibheke ukuthi izinsiza zayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo zezimangalo. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubo ezicacile, ezisebenzayo, futhi ezithuthukisayo. I-GEMS kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza lezi zinqubo zibe lula, ukuze abasebenzisi bakwazi ukuthola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabasebenzisi kubalulekile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza ezinhle, futhi izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS ibheke lezi zinto, ukuze iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngensiza ezinhle, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo baneliseka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo zezimangalo. I-GEMS kufanele ibe yisibonelo sokusebenza kahle, ukuze ibonise ukuthi izinsiza zezempilo zingathuthukiswa, futhi abantu bangathola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
Inqubekela phambili yokuqedwa kwezindlu zangasese zemigodi ezikoleni Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikole ezisemigodini ziye zathola ukwesekwa okukhulu ekwakhiweni nasekuthuthukisweni kwezindlu zangasese. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi baphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezindlini zangasese ezihlanzekile nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lokuqeda izindlu zangasese ezindala ezikoleni luhamba phambili, futhi iziphathimandla zikhombisa ukuzimisela okukhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokufunda. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo ziye zanda, futhi izinhlelo zokwakha ziqhutshelwa phambili. Uhlelo lwezindlu zangasese ezikoleni luhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zangasese ezintsha, ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezihambisana nezidingo zabafundi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephila kahle, futhi bakwazi ukufunda ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezimo ezingezinhle. Uhlelo lokwakha luhlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuhlola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwakha, kanye nokuhlela izinsiza zokwakha. Izikhungo zemfundo zisebenzisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza izinto zokwakha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlu zangasese ezakhiwayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezindlini zangasese ezihlanzekile nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lokwakha luhamba phambili ezikoleni ezisemigodini, futhi iziphathimandla zikhombisa ukuzimisela okukhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokufunda. Izikole eziningi ziye zathola izinsiza ezithile ezivela kuhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Umlando weSoweto Uprising Ngomhlaka 16 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1976, umphakathi waseSoweto, ophakathi kweGauteng, waba yisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuphikiswa kwemigomo yobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika. Le ndaba yenzeka ngesikhathi sokuphila okunzima, lapho abantu abamnyama bephila ngaphansi kwemithetho eqinile yokuhlukaniswa, eyayibizwa ngokuthi uBandlululo. Izinyathelo ezithathwe nguhulumeni zashiya umphakathi ubuhlungu, futhi izifundo ezazifundiswa ezikoleni zashintshwa zaba ngesiBhunu, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa isiZulu nezilimi zabantu abamnyama. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantwana baseSoweto, ikakhulukazi abaphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi neshumi nanye, baqala ukucela izinguquko. Bafuna ukufunda ngolimi lwabo, isiZulu, isiXhosa, nezinye izilimi zomdabu. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni kube nezinhlelo zokuhlangana, lapho abantwana bephakamisa izwi labo, bephikisa izinqubomgomo ezazibabeka phansi. Umoya wokuphikiswa wawukhula, futhi izifundo zaba yisikhumbuzo sokungavumelani nokuhlukumezeka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukuhlela imibhikisho, futhi kwavela izinsuku zokuhlangana ukuze kubonakale ukungavumelani. Ngaleso sikhathi, umholi weSoweto, uHector Pieterson, waba yisithonjana sokuphikiswa. U-Hector, owayeneminyaka eyishumi nanye, wabulawa ngesikhathi sokuphikiswa, futhi lesi senzo saphenduka isikhumbuzo sokuhlupheka kwabantu abamnyama. Ngomhlaka 16 kuNhlangulana, abantwana bahlangana emgwaqweni, bephakamisela izikhumbuzo zabo. Umphakathi wawubhalela izimpawu ezikhumbuza abantu ukuthi baphike izinqubomgomo ezazibabazisayo. Kodwa-ke, uhulumeni, owawungavumi ukwamukela izikhalazo, wathumela amaphoyisa ukuze abavimbe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezimpikiswano ezinzima, lapho amaphoyisa aphosa izibhamu, kwavela udlame olukhulu. Abantwana baphendula, bephikisana nempilo yabo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulungwane zabantu abathintekayo. Umlando weSoweto Uprising akukhona nje kuphela ngempilo yalesi sikhathi, kodwa ubonisa amandla abantu abamnyama. U-Hector Pieterson, owayengumfana ophumelele, waba yisithonjana sokuphikiswa, futhi izithombe zakhe zashintsha umqondo wabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Uhlanga lwabantu abamnyama lwaphakamisa izwi labo, lwazisa umhlaba ngezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo. Ngemuva kokuphikiswa, uhulumeni wathola ukuthi akasakwazi ukugcina izinqubomgomo zakhe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezweni. Izifundo zashintshwa, futhi abantu abamnyama baqala ukuthola ithuba lokufunda ngolimi lwabo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, owawuhlangene. Umlando weSoweto Uprising ungumfanekiso wezinselelo abantu abamnyama abahlangabezana nazo, kodwa futhi uyafundisa ukuthi amandla okuhlangana nokuphikisa angaguqula umhlaba. U-Hector Pieterson nozakwabo bahlala bephila ezinkumbulweni zabantu, futhi lesi sikhathi sikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ukulwa namalungelo akho akumele kube yinto engapheli. Umphakathi uhlala ukhumbula lezi zinsuku, futhi izifundo zalesi sikhathi ziqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi baphike izinhlelo ezimbi. Ngakho, umlando weSoweto Uprising awuwona nje umcimbi ophakathi kokuphila kwabantu, kodwa ubonisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenza ndawonye ukuze bafeze izinguquko ezibalulekile. Izinsuku zikaJuni zihlala zikhumbuleka, futhi umphakathi uhlala uqhubeka nokukhumbula izifundo ezitholakele. U-Soweto waba yisibonelo sokuthi amandla abantu abamnyama angashintsha umhlaba, futhi lokhu kuhlala kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi akufanele silahlekelwe ithemba.
Ngokuhambisana nezinto ezintsha zobuchwepheshe, iMnyango Wezokumaketha weMnyango Wezolimo, Uhlanga Nezokudla (DAFF) wethule i-Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) yokuthola ulwazi lwemakethe ngonyaka odlule ngoSepthemba. Le program ihlose ukusiza abalimi nabanye abangenayo ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi ukuze bathole ulwazi lwemakethe. Phambilini, iAgricultural Market Information System (AMIS) etholakala ku-inthanethi yayiyinsiza kuphela yokuthola ulwazi lwemakethe eyayifinyelelwa abalimi abane-inthanethi. Manje, ulwazi olusetshenziswa abalimi olwalutholakala kuphela ku-inthanethi lungafinyelelwa ngefoni ephathekayo.
