Ngalesi siza, ngisho nabelimi basemaphandleni abangena-inthanethi bangakwazi ukuthola ukuthi imikhiqizo yabo ibiza malini uma kuqhathaniswa nezintengo ezifanayo emakethe. Ngezitshalo ezingu-157 nezintengo zezilwane ezimakethe eziyi-16, abalimi banokukhetha okuningi lapho benquma izintengo zemikhiqizo yabo. "Le nsizakalo ivumela abalimi ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile zokuthengisa ngaphambi kokuthi baye emakethe futhi ayidingi ukuba bahlale endaweni ethile noma babe ne-inthanethi," kusho uBilly Morokolo, umphathi wesigaba sokumaketha, ekhuthaza abalimi ukuthi basebenzise le nsizakalo. Uqhubekile ekhuthaza ukuthi bangazizwa behlulekile ngenxa yezindleko eziphezulu ngoba ulwazi luyabiza ngempela. Le nsizakalo ibiza ama-senti angama-60 ngomzuzu, futhi ithatha ngaphansi kwemizuzu emibili ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ezwakalayo. Le nsizakalo iyatholakala kunoma iyiphi ifoni ephathekayo futhi iyatholakala kunoma yimuphi umhlinzeki wesevisi yefoni ephathekayo njenge-MTN, CellC, kanye neVodacom. Isebenza ngokuphelele ngezingcingo futhi ayifani ne-SMS. Le program iphendula ngesikhathi sangempela. Zonke iziqondiso zeprogram zizovela efoni yakho ephathekayo, futhi ilindele umsebenzisi ukuthi aphendule, okufana nemishini yokubhanga ye-ATM. Lezi zinyathelo ezilula zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi noma ubani ofuna ulwazi lwakamuva emakethe angaluthola ngokushesha. Umsebenzisi angakhetha inketho 1 yokukhiqiza bese ethumela, nezintengo ezahlukahlukene zemakethe zizovela. Ukuze ubone umkhiqizo, khetha inombolo edingekayo, njengokuthi ukuze uthole intengo yamapulangwe emakethe yaseBloemfontein, iBloemfontein (Bfn) inombolo 2. Cindezela impendulo 2 bese uthumela. Ngaphezu kwe-USSD, kukhona enye insiza ebizwa nge-SMS bulk ethulwe ngoApril futhi okwamanje iyahlolwa nabelimi abayi-10 abakhethiwe kuzo zonke izifunda. Ngokwehlukana kwe-USSD, i-SMS bulk ithumela ulwazi lwezintengo zemakethe zemikhiqizo yezolimo nge-SMS kubalimi abaqashile nabasebenzisi bedatha. U-Tlou Kabe ophuma esigabeni sokumaketha uthe abalimi kufanele babhalise ezindaweni zabo nasemiphakathini ukuze benze kahle kulolu sizo olunikeziwe. Umbono weNational Land Care Program (NLP) uwukuba nemiphakathi nabantu bezwe babe nobudlelwane obusimeme nemvelo yabo nezinsiza zemvelo eNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi bethuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu basebenzisa umhlaba, amanzi, nezinsiza zezitshalo ngendlela ethuthukisa izinga lempilo yabo futhi ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zingazisebenzisa ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukutshala, ukuhamba, nokuvuna izinsiza zemvelo kufanele kuphathwe ngendlela evimbela ukonakala (njengokuhlanza umhlabathi, ukuncipha kwezinto eziphilayo, ukushabalala kwezinhlobo zezimbali, izinguquko emanzini, njll). Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, iMnyango Wezolimo uhlose ukweseka ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zemvelo ngeNational Land Care Program. Ngale program, amaqembu omphakathi akhuthazwa ukuba aphathe ngokresponsibly futhi agcine umhlabathi, izitshalo, amanzi, kanye ne-biodiversity ezindaweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMnyango Wezolimo ifuna ukuthuthukisa umgomo wayo wokuphatha umhlaba nezinsiza zezolimo kuzo zonke izigaba zohulumeni kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza ngale program. Inhloso yeNational Land Care Program (NLP) ukusungula nokusebenzisa izindlela ezihlanganisayo zokuphatha kahle izinsiza zemvelo eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuzimela, ngokulinganayo, nangokuhambisana nezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa okusimeme. Lokhu kuhilela ukusungulwa kwezikhungo zokuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa imithetho, izinhlelo, nezinqubo ezizokhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okusimeme kwezinsiza zemvelo. Ihloswe ukudala amathuba okuthuthukisa izinhlangano zebhizinisi ezigxile ekuphathweni okusimeme kwezinsiza. Ihloswe ukuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwezinsiza zemvelo isikhathi eside. Lezi zikhwama, ezilingana no-R100,000, zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngensiza ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kwezinhloso ze-NLP. Kunokugxila okuqinile ekukhuthazeni izindlela ezinhle zokuphatha umhlaba. Imiphumela izokhulumelwa abanye ababambiqhaza nezikhungo ezithintekayo. Lezi zikhwama azihloselwe ukushintsha ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, kuhlanganise nemisebenzi yocwaningo, ezinye izigaba zohulumeni, noma abantu, kodwa zihloselwe ukusheshisa isenzo nokuzibophezela ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Ukusekelwa kwesikhathi eside kwemisebenzi yokuphatha izinsiza akuhlanganiswe kuhlelo lweSmall Grants Program yeNational Land Care Program. Ukuxhaswa kwephrojekthi ngokuvamile akuhlinzekwa isikhathi eside esingaphezu kweminyaka emithathu (izinyanga eziyi-36). Lokhu kuvumela ukuthi imali ithunyelwe kumathuba amasha njengoba evele. Ukuxhaswa akuphakanyiswa lapho amaphrojekthi ephinda imisebenzi ethile eyenziwa kwenye indawo, noma lapho engasekela kahle ngezinye izinhlelo. Omunye wemigomo ebalulekile yesigaba sezolimo emlandweni bekungukuhlinzeka nokuqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ukudla okwanele emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wombuso weMnyango Wezolimo, Uhlanga Nezokudla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imindeni nezwe lithola ukudla kufanele kuphathwe ngokuqinile. Ukwanda kwezindleko zokudla nezindleko eziphakeme zokufaka kunomthelela omubi esigabeni futhi kubeka engcupheni ukutholakala kokudla ezweni. Ukutholakala kokudla kuholela ekulaleleni futhi kungaba nemiphumela emibi emphakathini. Ngenxa yokuthi izimakethe ezinkulu zomhlaba zihlupheka ngenxa yokwehla komnotho kusukela ekwehleni komnotho kwamuva (kuhlanganisa neNingizimu Afrika), inani elikhulu lemisebenzi losthwe ezimbonini ezinkulu zomnotho. Le simo nezinye zifaka ingcindezi esigabeni sezolimo ukuze kudalwe amathuba emisebenzi futhi kudlale indima ekwehliseni ubuphofu. Ukwazi ukuthuthukiswa kwasemaphandleni njengokwakhiwa okubalulekile ekulweni nezinga lokungasebenzi, ubuphofu, kanye nokungalingani, imizamo kufanele igxile ekuthuthukiseni ukunikezwa kwezinsiza emiphakathini yasemaphandleni. Ama-cooperatives ezolimo njengendlela yokuhweba ingasetshenziswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izintshisekelo zikahulumeni ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi esigabeni semiphakathi yasemaphandleni. Ama-cooperatives ezolimo abe phakathi kwama-first okwakhiwa ngaphansi komthetho we-cooperative waseNingizimu Afrika futhi kusukela lapho aguquke waba inhlangano ebhalisiwe futhi ephumele
Imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza nomnotho wasekhaya Ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2023, umphakathi waseMahlabathini uzobamba umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nemithetho yezitolo zama-spaza kanye nomnotho wasekhaya. Lo mcimbi uzoba yithuba elihle lokuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokuxoxa ngezindlela ezithinta izitolo zama-spaza, ezibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, kanye nendlela umnotho wasekhaya ongathuthuka ngayo. Umcimbi uzovulwa ngenkulumo ethokozisayo evela kumalunga eKomidi leZitolo Zama-Spaza, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, abazoqhubeka nokuchaza imithetho emisha ethinta izitolo. Le mithetho izohlanganisa iziqondiso ezisemthethweni ezithinta ukuvulwa kwezitolo, izidingo zokusebenza, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha ezizokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bezitolo ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza ngokusemthethweni. Ngemuva kwalokho, kuzoba nezingxoxo ezivulekile phakathi kwabavakashi, abanikazi bezitolo, kanye nochwepheshe bezomnotho. Lezi zingxoxo zizogxila ezindleleni ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa umnotho wasekhaya, okuhlanganisa nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezitolo zama-spaza nezimakethe ezinkulu. Abanikazi bezitolo bazokwazi ukwabelana ngamasu abo, izinselele abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo abazitholile ukuze baqhubeke nokuphumelela. Umcimbi uzobandakanya nezifundo ezithile ezizokwakha ulwazi lwabavakashi. Izifundo zizoqondiswa ochwepheshe abanolwazi olunzulu emkhakheni wezohwebo, futhi zizohlanganisa izihloko ezifana nezindlela zokuphatha izitolo, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezindlela zokuthola amakhasimende. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubanikazi bezitolo ukuba baqonde izidingo zamakhasimende abo, nokuthi baphendule kahle ezimfuno zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzoba nezinkampani ezithile ezizobamba iqhaza, ezifana nezinkampani zokuhweba, izikhungo zokuxhaswa, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo. Lezi zinkampani zizohlinzeka ngeminikelo ebalulekile, njengokufundisa abanikazi bezitolo ngezindlela zokuphatha imali, ukwakha izinhlelo zokumaketha, kanye nezindlela zokuphucula izinga lempilo emiphakathini. Umcimbi uzophinde ube nethuba lokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwakha umoya wokubambisana, lapho abanikazi bezitolo nabanye abathintekayo bezokwazi ukuxhumana, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza umnotho wasekhaya ube namandla. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uzophothulwa ngenkulumo yokugcina enezifundo ezitholakele, lapho kuzokwenziwa iziphakamiso ezithile zokuthuthukisa umnotho wasekhaya ngokusebenzisa izitolo zama-spaza. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba lokuhlanganisa yonke imiqondo ethathwe phakathi komcimbi, nokwakha isikhumbuzo esiqinile sokuthi umnotho wasekhaya ungathuthuka uma wonke umuntu ebambisene. Umcimbi uzoba yithuba elibalulekile lokufunda, ukufundisana, nokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Sihalalisela bonke abathintekayo, futhi sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza kulolu suku olujabulisayo nolwakha. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, umcimbi uzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho osebenzayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ozinikele ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu emiphakathini yethu. Sicela uhambisane nathi ukuze sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile!
Ezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Umbuzo 1: Yini ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya? Impendulo: Ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zikhuluma ngenqubo yokuqinisa izindawo ezisemaphandleni ukuze zibe nempilo engcono, zithuthukise umnotho, nemfundo, futhi zifinyelele ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuthutha, ukuze abantu basendaweni ezisemaphandleni bakwazi ukuphila kahle. Umbuzo 2: Yini edinga ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni zasemakhaya? Impendulo: Kunezinto eziningi ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Okokuqala, izinsiza zokuhamba zidinga ukuqhubekela phambili. Izindlela eziphukile noma ezingekho kahle zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Okwesibili, izikole ezindaweni zasemakhaya zidinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngengqikithi yokufunda efanele. Okwesithathu, izikhungo zempilo zidinga ukwakhiwa kahle, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola ukwelashwa ngesikhathi. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya? Impendulo: Ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zinikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, futhi zikhuthaza intuthuko yomnotho. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni izimpilo zabantu zibe ngcono, kunciphise ububha, futhi kugqugquzele ukwakha imiphakathi eqinile. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani abantu bangasiza ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zabo? Impendulo: Abantu bangasiza ngezindlela ezihlukene. Bangabamba iqhaza emihlanganweni yomphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngezidingo zabo nezindlela zokuthuthukisa izindawo zabo. Futhi, bangakwazi ukufunda amakhono amasha, ukuze bakwazi ukusiza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, njengezokwakha, ezokulima, noma ezokuphatha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nabaxhasi bangaphandle kubalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza umehluko. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindawo zasemakhaya? Impendulo: Kunezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona, ezihlanganisa ezihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali, izinhlelo zokufundisa, nezinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo. Uhulumeni, kanye nezinsizakalo ezizimele, bahlala benza imizamo yokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kube yimpumelelo. Lokhu kubandakanya izinhlelo zokulima ezithuthukisa ukukhiqiza, izinhlelo zokwakha izikole eziphakeme, nezinqubo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zempilo. Umbuzo 6: Kukhona yini izithiyo ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezithiyo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo ezicacile kungaba yizithiyo ezinkulu. Futhi, abanye abantu bangase babe nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezinhlelo ezithile, noma bangase bangathandi ukubamba iqhaza. Ukungabi nezinqubomgomo ezicacile kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani umphakathi ungakha ubudlelwano obuhle ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindawo? Impendulo: Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu buvumela ukuxhumana okuhle kanye nokubambisana. Ukuhlelwa kwemihlangano evulekile, lapho abantu bengase baxoxe khona ngezinkinga zabo, kubalulekile. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ubuqotho, futhi abantu bakhuluma ngezidingo zabo, basize kumaphrojekthi athile. Ubuqotho nokukhuthazela kumphakathi kuyasiza ukuba kudaleke izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngekusasa lezindawo zasemakhaya? Impendulo: Ikusasa lezindawo zasemakhaya lidinga ukuba libe nokuqhubekayo. Uma abantu beqhubeka nokubambisana, besebenzisa amathuba amasha, futhi behlola izinkinga ezikhona, izindawo zasemakhaya zingaba nempumelelo enkulu. Lokhu kuzodinga ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukufunda okuqhubekayo, kanye nokuhlonipha imvelo. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ubuchwepheshe bungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya? Impendulo: Ubuchwepheshe bungaba nendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zasemakhaya. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana kungavulela abantu amathuba amasha, ukubamba imihlangano ye-inthanethi, noma ukufunda ngezindlela zokulima ezithuthukile. Ukufinyelela kwe-inthanethi kungasiza ekwabeleni ulwazi, futhi kubenze bazi ngamasu amasha okuthuthukisa izindawo zabo. Umbuzo 10: Ngabe kukhona umbono wokuthi abantu basemakhaya bangafunda kanjani? Impendulo: Yebo, ukufunda kubalulekile. Abantu bangafunda ngezinhlelo ezihlinzekwa ohulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, noma ngezifundo eziku-inthanethi. Ukwakha izikhungo zemfundo ezisemaphandleni kubalulekile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufunda kumakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zabo. Ukufunda okuqhubekayo kuzoba nesandla ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho: Ezokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya zidinga ukubambisana kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, amalungu omphakathi, kanye nohulumeni. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezikahle, sikwazi ukwakha izindawo ezigcwele amathuba, lapho abantu bahlala khona benempilo, benokuthula, futhi bekwazi ukufeza amaphupho abo. Lokhu kuzoba yisibusiso, hhayi kuphela kubantu basemakhaya, kodwa nakumphakathi wonke.
UJacob Zuma: Iphrofayela Yomuntu UJacob Gedleyihlekisa Zuma, owazalwa ngomhla ziyi-12 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1942, ungomunye wezizinda ezibalulekile emlandweni wepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika. UZuma, ovela esizweni samaXhosa, wazalelwa eNkandla, edolobheni elincane eliseMpumalanga. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nzima, njengoba ababephila ezimweni ezinzima, kodwa lokho akuzange kumlimaze; esikhundleni salokho, kwaba yimpilo eyamfundisa izifundo eziningi. UZuma uqale ukufunda ezikoleni zamabanga aphansi, kodwa ngenxa yezimo zomndeni, akazange aqhubeke nezifundo zakhe. Ngemuva kokuphuma esikoleni, wathola umsebenzi, kodwa waba nesithakazelo kwezombusazwe. Ngonyaka ka-1959, waba yilungu le-ANC (African National Congress), lapho aqala khona ukukhiqiza izifundo ezibalulekile ngempilo yezombusazwe. Ngemva kokubona uZuma njengomholi oqavile, wathuthela eBotswana, lapho ahlangana nabanye abaholi be-ANC, futhi waba yingxenye yeqembu elalilwa neziphathimandla zenkohlakalo. Waba yiNhloko yeMpi ye-ANC, eqinisekisa ukuvikela amalungelo abantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Ngalesi sikhathi, waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo eziningi zokulwa nobandlululo, okwaholela ekubuyeni kwakhe eNingizimu Afrika ngonyaka ka-1990, lapho uNelson Mandela ephuma ejele. Ngemva kokuphuma kukaMandela, uZuma waba neqhaza elibalulekile ekwakheni uhulumeni wephalamende, eba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali, futhi ngemva kwalokho, nguNgqongqoshe wezangaphakathi. UZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezazihlose ukwakha umnotho wezwe, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni kubantu abamnyama. Ngonyaka ka-2005, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekutholeni ukunqoba esikhundleni sokuba nguMongameli we-ANC, kwathi ngo-2009, wathatha isikhundla sokuba nguMongameli wezwe. Njengomongameli, uZuma waphokophela ekwakheni umnotho, kodwa wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa, ukungathembeki, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukwahluleka kwakhe ukuvikela isithunzi sakhe kwaholela ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqubomgomo zakhe. Ngesikhathi sokuphatha kwakhe, waqhamuka nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kodwa izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa zaphinde zaqhamuka, okuholele emiphumeleni emibi. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokulwela amalungelo abantu, kodwa izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zashiya umthelela omubi esithunzini sakhe. Ngonyaka ka-2018, uZuma wathatha isinqumo sokuhoxa esikhundleni sokuba nguMongameli, ngenxa yezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abanye baphakamise izwi labo, bephikisa izinqubomgomo zakhe. Nakuba ebebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, uZuma wahlala eqinile ezinkolelweni zakhe, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. UJacob Zuma ungumholi okhumbuleka kakhulu, onobuhlakani obukhulu, lapho eveza khona ukuthi, nakuba ebhekene nezinkinga, akazange alahlekelwe yithemba. UZuma ubonisa ukuthi ukuphila akukhona nje ukuzithokozisa, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba nesithakazelo kumphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uJacob Zuma uzohlala engomunye wezikhumbuzo ezibalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi izifundo azifundisile zizohlala zikhumbuleka ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Umbiko ngamaCheckers Isingeniso AmaCheckers, umdlalo odumile emhlabeni jikelele, udlalwa kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika nasezindaweni ezithile eYurophu. Umdlalo lo udinga amakhono aphakeme okucabanga, ukuhlela, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile ukuze uqhubeke emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Kule mibiko, sizohlola umlando, imithetho, izindlela zokudlala, nezici ezithokozisayo ezihambisana naleli thuba lomphakathi. Umlando WamaCheckers Umdlalo wamaCheckers uqala eminyakeni edlule, kanti abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ungemuva kwezinhlobo eziningi zedlanzana ezazidlalwa emhlabeni. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi lo mdlalo unokuxhumana okuqinile nemidlalo efana ne-Draughts, eyasungulwa eYurophu ngo-12th century. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdlalo uthandwa kakhulu e-Afrika, lapho izinguqulo ezihlukene zithathwa njengemisebenzi yamasiko nezinkolelo zomphakathi. Imithetho Yokudlala Imithetho yamaCheckers ilula kodwa igcwele ubuchwepheshe. Umdlalo udlalwa ku-dlanzana enezikhala eziyi-64, okuyizikhala eziphakathi nendawo. Abadlali bakhetha izimpahla ezimnyama nezimhlophe, lapho umphakathi omnyama uqala ukudlula izikhala, uhamba phambili, futhi uma kudingeka, ungazama ukudlula impahla yomphakathi ophikisayo. Ukudlula kwempahla kungenza kube khona "ukuphana," lapho umphakathi uthola ithuba lokuthola izimpahla zomphakathi ophikisayo. Izindlela Zokudlala Isu lokudlala amaCheckers linokuhluka okuningi, okuhlanganisa izindlela ezithokozisayo nezobuchwepheshe. Abadlali abahlakaniphile bahlola izinyathelo eziningi ngaphambi kokwenza isinqumo, behlaziya izinketho ezitholakalayo. Umbono wokuhlanganisa izinyathelo nokuhlonza izingozi kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi ungaphumi emdlalweni. Umdlalo unikeza amathuba okukhula, njengoba abadlali bejolisa ekukhuleni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo. Izici Ezithokozisayo ZamaCheckers AmaCheckers akhombisa izici ezithokozisayo, njengokwakha ukudlalwa okujabulisayo. Lokhu kudlalwa akugcini nje ngokuhlola amakhono, kodwa kubuye kukhuthaze ubungani phakathi kwabantu, njengoba umphakathi uvame ukudlala ndawonye. Umdlalo ungaba yisixhumanisi sokuxhumana, uvulele abantu ithuba lokuhlangana nokubambisana. Izinselelo Nezinto Eziqhamukayo Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, futhi nothando oluvela emidlalweni, amaCheckers abhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Izinhlelo zokudlala eziphakeme, ezifana nezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ziqhume kakhulu. Lokhu kubangela abaninimasheya ukuba bakhathazeke ngokuthi umdlalo ungaphuma kanjani emakhaya, uma uhamba phambili ezindaweni ezithile. Nokho, izinkampani ezithile ziqhubekile ziqinisekisa ukuthi amaCheckers ahlala engaphakathi kwamasiko, futhi ziqhubeka zidalela izinhlelo ezithokozisayo kubadlali abaneminyaka ehlukene. Isiphetho AmaCheckers ahlale engumdlalo ongenakuphikiswa, uhleli unikeza ithuba lokukhula, ukuxhumana, kanye nokujabula. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, umdlalo unela izifundo ezinzulu ezihlobene nezindlela zokuphila zansuku zonke. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi amaCheckers azogcina esekela izizukulwane eziningi, ahlale engumdlalo ohamba phambili emhlabeni, nokunikeza ithuba lokuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi ungalindela ukuphila okukhulu okulindelekile kulolu mdlalo oluqhubekayo, oluhlelekile, nolwakhiwe ezimpilweni zethu.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha - Ingxoxo Ngesikhathi Samanje Isingeniso Namuhla, sijabule ukuba nezingxoxo ezibalulekile mayelana nokukhulelwa kwentsha. Le ndaba ithinta imindeni, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nemiphakathi eminingi. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka izizathu, izinselelo, nezixazululo ezihambisana nalokhu. Sizokhuluma noNksz. Thandiwe Mthethwa, ongumeluleki wezempilo, ukuze sithole umbono wakhe. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqonda Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha Umbuzo: UThandiwe, ungakuchaza kanjani ukukhulelwa kwentsha? Impendulo: Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kubhekisela ekukhuleni kwentsha, ikakhulukazi phakathi kweminyaka yokufunda, ngemuva kokukhulelwa. Lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi olwaneleyo mayelana nezokwelashwa, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nemiphumela yokukhulelwa. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izizathu ezivame ukuholela ekukhulelweni kwentsha? Impendulo: Izizathu ziningi. Okokuqala, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele ngezokwelapha. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ngemithombo yokuvikela. Okwesibili, umphakathi ungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Uma intsha ibona abanye bejabulisa ukukhulelwa, bangase bazame futhi. Futhi, izimo zomndeni nezomnotho nazo zidlala indima enkulu. Ingxenye 2: Izinselelo Eziphumelelayo Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha ekhulelwe? Impendulo: Izinselelo ziningi futhi zihluke kumuntu nomuntu. Okokuqala, intsha ekhulelwe ingase ibhekane nezinkinga zezezimali. Ukukhulelwa kudinga izinsiza eziningi, futhi uma umndeni ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka, kubalulekile. Okwesibili, kunokuthola ukuqonda nokwesekwa. Abanye abezwa kahle, bayazithola bephazamisekile, okuholela ekutheni bahlale bodwa, okwenza kube nzima. Umbuzo: Ingabe zikhona izingozi ezithile ezihambisana nokukhulelwa kwentsha? Impendulo: Yebo, zikhona izingozi eziningi. Okokuqala, intsha ingase ibhekane nezinkinga zempilo, njengezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Okwesibili, ukukhulelwa okungalindelekile kungaholela ezinkingeni zokukhula kwezingane, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengane kanye nezinkinga zokuphila komama. Ingxenye 3: Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokweseka Umbuzo: Yiziphi izixazululo ezikhona ukuze kusizakale intsha ekhulelwe? Impendulo: Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zidingeka ukuze intsha iqonde izindlela zokuvikela. Okwesibili, umphakathi kufanele ube nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ezifana nezikhungo zezempilo, ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuthola usizo. Ukubambisana komndeni kubalulekile; uma umndeni ungasiza, intsha izoba namathuba angcono. Umbuzo: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha ithola usizo oludingayo? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zempilo zibe sezingeni eliphezulu, okuhlanganisa abeluleki abaqeqeshiwe, izikhungo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezinsiza ezithile. Umphakathi kufanele uthuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze intsha ikwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi. Ingxenye 4: Umphakathi Nokubambisana Umbuzo: Umphakathi ungaluthola kanjani usizo lwawo ekuxazululeni le nkinga? Impendulo: Umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza elikhulu. Ukuhlela imicimbi yokufundisa, ukuxhumana nezikhungo zezempilo, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu kungasiza. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imithombo yezindaba ibambe iqhaza ekwaziseni umphakathi ngalezi zinkinga. Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lentsha ekhulelwe lingenziwa kanjani libe ngcono? Impendulo: Ikusasa lentsha lingathuthukiswa uma sikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, umphakathi, nezikhungo zezempilo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile kuzokwenza intsha ikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga ebalulekile esidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngokwazi izizathu, izinselelo, nezixazululo, singasiza intsha yethu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, umphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Masisebenze ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lentsha yethu.
UToyota: Indaba Yokuphumelela Nobuchwepheshe Kwazulu, kade kukhona inhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni wonke, ebizwa ngegama elithi uToyota. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1937 eJapane, nguKiichiro Toyoda, owawaziwa ngokuqonda okujulile kwezobuchwepheshe. Kwakuwumqondo wakhe ukwakha izimoto ezinhle, eziphephile, futhi ezithengeka kalula kumuntu wonke. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komkhiqizo owayezobamba izinhliziyo zabantu abaninzi, kwazise izimoto zabo zazingezokukhanya, kodwa futhi zaziwa ngokusebenza kahle. Ngemva kokuhamba kweminyaka, uToyota wathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. Izimoto zayo zazihamba kakhulu, zishesha, futhi zaziqinisekiswa ngokuqinile. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawubukeka unomoya ophilayo, bonke befuna ukuzama lezi zimoto ezinkulu. Kwakukhona umndeni owawuhlala edolobheni elikude, okwakuyinto eyaziwa njengeNokogiri. UJohn, indodana yalesi sikhumbuzo, wayenombono omuhle wokukhuluma nabangane bakhe ngezithombe ezinhle zeToyota. UJohn wayehlala echitha isikhathi esiningi edlalela izimoto zabo zikaToyota, eqonda ukuthi ziwusizo kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kwakungelula ukufinyelela ezimotweni ezikhethekile, kodwa wayezithanda kakhulu, ngoba zazingazwakali, futhi zazingasenzi lutho ngaphandle kokusebenza. Waqhubeka nokufunda ngale nkampani, waqonda ukuthi uToyota wayengumholi ekwakheni izimoto ezivumelana nesimo sezulu. UJohn wayezimisele ukuba ngumagama omphakathi, eqhubeka efundisa nabangane bakhe ngezindlela zokwenza izimoto zibe ngcono. Ngemva kokuhamba kweminyaka, uToyota waqala ukuhamba phambili ezinhlelweni zayo, wabelana ngezinto ezintsha, efuna ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezihlakaniphile. UJohn, njengomfundi, waqonda kahle ukuthi ukuze kube nezinjongo eziphumelelayo, kufanele kube nezindlela ezintsha zokuhamba. Umndeni wakhe wawujabule, ngoba umoya wokwakha izimoto eziphephile wawuhamba phambili, kanti abanye abantu babefuna ukufunda ngokuqonda okuphelele kwezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba ihamba phambili, uToyota waqala ukugxila kakhulu ekunciphiseni umthelela wemvelo. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba izimoto zabo zenza kube lula ukuba abantu baphile kahle ngaphandle komthelela omkhulu. UJohn, owayezithokozela izimoto eziphephile, wanikeza iziphakamiso ezinhle, ezazenza zibe ngcono. Waqhubeka nokushicilela imicabango yakhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ezaholela ekuphawuleni kwezinye izinkampani ezinkulu. Ngonyaka ka-2000, uToyota waphakamisa umkhiqizo wakhe ophumelelayo, iPrius, okuyimoto yokuqala yokuhamba ngamafutha ahlanzekile. Lezi zindaba zashintsha umqondo wabantu ngabanye, njengoba bekhuthazeka ukufunda nokusebenzisa lezi zimoto ezivumelana nemvelo. UJohn waba nenhlanhla yokuba nelungelo lokuhlola iPrius, futhi wathola ubuchwepheshe obuhlukile obenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Le moto yaphawula isikhathi esisha kubo bonke abathandi bezimoto, kanti uToyota waba umholi ekwakheni izimoto ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. UJohn wayenothando olukhulu lwezinkanyezi, futhi wathola ukuthi uToyota ungumholi emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Njengoba izimoto zabo zazithuthuka zibe nezinye izici, nokubukeka kwazikhumbulo, uToyota waqala ukwakha imoto esebenzisa amandla elanga. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba abantu baqala ukufuna izindlela zokuphila eziqondile, ezihambelana nemvelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uToyota waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe obuhlakaniphile, futhi waqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukile ezimotweni zawo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubantu, njengoba izimoto zabo zazizokwazi ukuphatha izicelo, zixhumane nezinye izimoto, futhi zisebenze njengemishini ezinzima. UJohn, owayenethemba lokuba umphakathi uqhubeke ufunda, wathokozisa abanye ngalezi zinhlelo ezithokozisayo, futhi abanye abantu baqala ukusho ukuthi uToyota ungumholi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukwaziswa kukaToyota kumhlaba kwaholela ekubeni abanye abenzi bezimoto bazame ukufaka izimiso ezifanayo. Kodwa uToyota wayehlala engumholi, edinga ukuba ngcono, futhi uqhubeke nokwakha izimoto ezihamba phambili. UJohn wayejabule, ngoba wayebona ukuthi izinto ezintsha zikhona, futhi umndeni wakhe wawuncintisana nawo ukuthola izimoto ezinhle. Ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi, uToyota wenza izinkampani eziningi zikwazi ukufunda izifundo ezithokozisayo. Kwakukhona umoya ohlangene phakathi kwabantu, nabanye besebenzisa lezi zimoto ezinhle, bahlanganyela nezifundo, futhi baqonda ukuthi uToyota ungumholi ongagqibeki. Njengoba ezimoto ziqhubeka ziba yizinsiza eziphilayo, uJohn waba nokuqonda okujulile kokuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi umphakathi uqhubeka uvuselela izimiso eziphile. Ekugcineni, uToyota waphumelela ngalesi sikhathi, wahlinzeka ngezindlela ezinkulu zokuhamba, ezazizokwenza umhlaba ube indawo engcono. UJohn, indodana yalesi sikhumbuzo, wagcina ebhalela incwadi, efuna ukwabelana ngale ndaba yokuphumelela, efisa ukuthi abanye abantu bazi uToyota, umholi kwezobuchwepheshe, onezindlela zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile, ezithokozisayo, futhi ezithuthukayo. Le ndaba kaToyota iyinkanyezi eqhakaza emhlabeni wezokuthutha, igcizelela ukuthi ubuchwepheshe, umoya wokwakha, nokuzithoba kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. UJohn, njengenhlangano, wokuqhubeka nokufunda, uyazi ukuthi lesi sikhumbuzo sizoqhubeka sikhanya, sikhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi izinguquko ezinhle ziqala ngamathuba amakhulu. UToyota akuyona nje imoto, kodwa ikusasa elikhanyayo lemoto nezindlela zokuphila emhlabeni.
Inhloso yeKomidi ukuhlanganisa nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kweMthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi ka-1997. Umsebenzi oyinhloko weKomidi ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuNgqongqoshe ngezindaba ezihlobene nalesi Mthetho, ukwenza izincomo kuNgqongqoshe mayelana nanoma yiziphi iziqondiso uNgqongqoshe angazikhupha ngaphansi kwaleli Mthetho, ukuhlela imisebenzi eyenziwa izikhungo zokufaka izincwadi, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ezikhungweni zokufaka izincwadi ngezindaba ezihlobene nalesi Mthetho, nokwakha amaqembu amancane noma amaqembu okusebenza uma kudingeka ukuze kuhlolwe noma yiziphi imisebenzi ehambelana nokuphumeleliswa kwaleli Mthetho. Ababhalisile kumele temsilise abathintekayo abaneziqu emkhakheni wezincwadi futhi benze izinzuzo kulwazi; umkhakha wezokushicilela; ukuphathwa, ezemali, nezindaba zomnotho; kanye/noma ulwazi kanye/noma uthando lwezincwadi ezishicilelwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukunikela ngomuntu ozokhonza kwiKomidi Lezincwadi kumele aqedele futhi athumele ifomu elisemthethweni lokunikeza iziphakamiso eMnyangweni Wezobuciko neZamasiko. A: Incwadi enikeza amagama aphelele nemininingwane yokuxhumana yomuntu ophakanyisiwe, echaza iziqu zabo zokubekwa ngokusekelwe ezicini ezishiwo ngenhla, kanye namagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabantu abathathu abaqinisekisa lowo ophakanyisiwe. B: Incwadi yokwamukela isiphakamiso ebhalwe lowo ophakanyisiwe. a Isihloko namagama aphelele g Ulwazi lwezempilo oluhambelana b Inombolo yokukhomba h Izigaba zamakhono c Ubuzwe i Ukubhaliswa ezinhlanganweni, d Imininingwane yokuxhumana ephelele amabhodi njll. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi lokhu akusikhangiso somsebenzi. Imiholo yamalungu eKomidi Lezincwadi izobe ikhawulelwe ekubuyiseleni izindleko zokuhamba nezokuhlala uma behlangana kabili ngonyaka (ePitoli noma kwezinye izindawo).
Esihlokweni mayelana nokulahla okuphephile kwe-residue ye-pesticide ku-Pula-Imvula kaFebhuwari 2008, enye yezihloko ezingaxoxwa ngayo yisimo se-boom sprayer. Kungase kubonakale ukuthi lokhu kuyinkinga evamile - ngakho-ke lesi sihloko sikhona. Ukugcinwa kahle nokugcina akukwanele ukulandela njengokulungiselela ngaphambi kwesizini yonyaka ozayo kuphela, kodwa kuqinisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer njengoba kungeza iminyaka empilweni yayo yokukhiqiza. Ukuba khona kwezinto ezilimazayo ezitsheni isikhathi eside kungalimaza ezinye izindawo ze-sprayer, uphahla, kanye nezixhumi zikagesi. I-residue yalezi zinto ingaba yingozi kunoma ubani osebenza nemishini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inani elincane kakhulu lezinto ezilimazayo ezitsheni ezisele ku-sprayer lingalimaza izitshalo njengoba zidluliselwa kwesizini yokufafaza elandelayo. Ukuvikela ukuphepha kwakho siqu kanye nalabo bakho, abasebenzi, nezitshalo kubalulekile ukuhlanza kahle nokukhipha noma yikuphi ukungcoliswa ku-sprayer yakho phakathi nesizini, phakathi kwezitshalo futhi ngaphambi kokuyigcina ebusika. Khumbula ukuthi i-residue yemichiza esetshenziswe kwezolimo iyingozi ezitshalweni nakuma-nyama, ngakho-ke zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqondwe ubungozi obuhambisana nalokhu ukuze lesi simo sikwazi ukuphathwa ngendlela efanele. Inqubo yokugcina nokuhlanza igcwele izinyathelo ezinhlanu. Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuhlanza i-sprayer yakho, qiniseka ukuthi uyabheka ilebula lezinto ezilimazayo ozisebenzisile. Iphakamisa indlela efanele yokulahla umkhiqizo osalayo. Iphinde inikeze imiyalelo ethile yokuhlanza engase ibaluleke. Iphakamisa ngemikhiqizo yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. Iphinde ikunikeze amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana ne-Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) okufanele uyigqoke ukuze uhlanze kahle i-sprayer yakho. Inhloso yokuhlanza ngamanzi ukuhoxisa noma yikuphi umkhiqizo osele noma izinqwaba ezinkulu ezingase zibe ku-sprayer. Imishini yokuhlanza ye-sprayer ifaka ukujikeleza kwamanzi ngaphakathi kohlelo ngemuva kokugcwaliswa ngamanzi njengoba kukhonjisiwe ku-lebula lezinto ezilimazayo ozisebenzisile (ngamanye amazwi, ukuhlanza ngamanzi/ukuxuba kwemichiza encishisiwe, manje ebizwa ngokuthi yi-rinsate, endaweni ephephile). Ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi uhlanza ngethanki kanye nezintambo nezikhala, gcwalisa amanzi ahlanzekile uze ufinyelele uhhafu wethanki ukuze ugijime i-tractor kancane emzileni wepulazi - ukujikeleza kuzodlulisela amanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kufafaza umphakathi wethanki wonke. Ukuphinda izinyathelo zokuhlanza ngezinqwaba ezincane zamahhala (ukuze kuze kube ngu-10% wamandla wethanki le-sprayer) kungcono kunokugcwalisa nje ithanki le-sprayer ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Kunconywa ukuphinda inqubo yokuhlanza kathathu okungenani. Khetha indawo lapho i-rinsate ingakwazi khona ukungcolisa imithombo yamanzi, ukuchitheka, izitshalo, noma ezinye izitshalo futhi lapho izingcezu ezincane zingakwazi ukuhlanganiswa, njengoba lokhu kungaba yingozi kubantu, ezilwaneni, nasezindaweni eziphilayo. Ungafafaza emasimini noma emzileni wepulazi. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha amanzi ethankini ye-sprayer ngokuhambisana nelebula le-pesticide. Ungavuli nje ama-valve njengoba lokhu kuzokhipha emhlabeni. Faka izikhala ezengeziwe ezingenza ngaphezulu ukuze udale indlela esheshayo futhi evumelekile yokulahla i-rinsate ye-sprayer. Iph外e ye-sprayer nayo kufanele ihlanzeke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lapho uhamba i-sprayer ngamanzi, ungakwenzi amanzi angakha amanzi angavunyelwe ukufinyelelwa yizingane, izilwane, izinkomo, noma izilwane zasendle. Lahla i-rinsate ye-pesticide ngokuhambisana nemihlahlandlela ku-lebula, ubeka i-rinsate endaweni lapho imikhiqizo izosetshenziswa khona ngokuhambisana nenhloso yayo (futhi, emasimini lapho imichiza ifafazwe khona kubhekwa njengendawo efanele). Phinda inqubo yokukhipha ngaphakathi ngemuva kokukhipha ukungcoliswa nokuhlanza kabusha i-sprayer. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha noma yiziphi izithanki zamanzi ezisetshenziswe ekuhlanzeni ngaphambi kokugcinwa ukuze uvikele ukulimala okubangelwa ukuhamba kwamanzi ngaphakathi. Ngemuva kokuhlanza kokugcina ngamanzi, ungahlola i-sprayer yakho futhi wenze izilungiselelo noma ukulungisa okudingekayo. Nakuba i-sprayer ihlanzekile, qhubeka ugqoke imishini yakho yokuvikela. Kukhona okungase kusale ku-sprayer. Isakhiwo se-boom, esibonisa noma yiziphi izinkinga, kufanele silungiswe. Njengoba i-sprayer manje ihlanzekile, ungase ufise ukususa izingxenye zayo ezilimele ngesikhathi sokugcina. Susa ama-filters futhi uwahlanze ngesandla ngamanzi anesipuni (khumbula ukugqoka izigqoko ezivikelayo eziphikisa imichiza), hlanzisa ngamanzi futhi mhlawumbe ugcine noma ubuyisele kumasiphu. Hlola ngazinye izikhala, izikhala ze-nozzle, kanye nama-valve. I-residue yemichiza ingaqinisa kulezi zindawo futhi ibe nzima ebusika, ngaleyo ndlela yehlisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer esizini elandelayo. Susa iziphetho ze-nozzle, ama-skrini, hlola ama-valve, izikhala, kanye nemizimba ye-nozzle ukuze ubone noma yiziphi izimpawu zokugqokwa. Qaphela ukufaka kabusha ama-plugs. Hlanza futhi uhlola izikhala, izikhala ze-nozzle, futhi uhlola ama-valve. Gcina ezikhwama ezibhalwe phansi. Gcina ama-valve ezingeni lokushisa endlini ebusika ukuze uvikele ukulimala okungase kubangele izinga lokushisa eliphansi. Susa wonke ama-pressure gauges futhi ufake izikhala ezindaweni ezivulekile ze-sprayer. Gcina ama-gauges lapho engakwazi khona ukuvulwa kokushisa noma ukulimala. Ekugcineni, jikeleza i-antifreeze ku-sprayer, kufaka phakathi i-boom, ama-valve, imiphetho, ama-pressure gauges, kanye nezintambo zokubuyisela. Vumela i-antifreeze ijikeleze phakathi kwezintambo ze-boom. Lokhu kuzofaka ngaphakathi kwezintambo ukuvimbela ukoma nokuphuka. Ukufaka izikhala kuzo zonke izikhala ze-boom kuzosisiza ukuvimbela i-antifreeze ohlelweni, kodwa kungase kudingeke ukuvula enye noma ngaphezulu kwezikhala ukuze uvumele i-antifreeze ijikeleze ngokuphelele phakathi kwe-boom. Vala lezi zikhala uma i-antifreeze igcwele ngokuphelele ohlelweni. Lapho ugxile esigabeni sokugcina, i-antifreeze kufanele ikhiphe noma yikuphi amanzi asale engase abe kuhlelo futhi ifake zonke izingxenye ze-sprayer. Vumela i-antifreeze ihlale kupompo nasezivalvini ukuvimbela ukugqwala nokulimala okungase kubangelwe ukuhamba kwamanzi okungaphakathi ohlelweni. Njengoba ezinye zisuswa ngaphambi kokugcina, ukufaka ama-valve okukhansela ngakolunye uhlangothi lwepompo kungasiza kule nqubo. I-antifreeze eyenzelwe izimoto zokuzijabulisa (RVs) ifanele ukusetshenziswa kumasiphu wezolimo. Akuyona efanayo ne-antifreeze yezimoto ezisebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo, ayinayo imiphumela emibi ezilwaneni. Nakuba imikhiqizo eminingi ye-antifreeze ibonakala ifana ne-gel ngaphansi
Noma ubani oseke waba ngum citizen ngokuzalwa noma ngokuhlala, osevele waphuma emhlabeni wokuba ngum citizen noma osephumelele, angafaka isicelo sokubuyela futhi abe ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika. Qedela amafomu wesicelo BI-175 no-BI-529 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-9 futhi unikeze izithombe ezimbili ezincane ezifanele ipasipoti. Faka incwadi eqinisekisa ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Faka ikhophi yesitifiketi sokuhlangana, uma sitholakala. Izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezeMisebenzi eliseduze.
Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Uhlanga Lokuphila Noma Uhlanga Lokuhlupheka? Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wezempilo ezweni lethu. Zihlinzeka ngempilo kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenamali yokukhokhela izindleko zokwelashwa ezibhedlela ezizimele. Nokho, uma sihlola izibhedlela zikahulumeni, kubalulekile ukuba sikhulume ngezinto ezinhle nezimbi ezihambisana nazo. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuba siqonde kahle ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziwusizo noma zikhona ezithinta impilo yabantu ngendlela engafanele. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngalezi zinto ezinhle ezihambisana nezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki isimo sabo sezimali, uthola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba impilo iyigugu elikhulu. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, bahlala bezithola besebenzisa izibhedlela zikahulumeni, njengoba lezi zindawo zikhona eduze kwabo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bathole usizo lwezempilo, okungaba yisixazululo esibalulekile ekunciphiseni izifo ezithathelwana kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zihlala zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zabelwa kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, uma kukhona izifo ezithile ezibhekelelwa, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayathola imithi nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ekulweni nezifo ezinjengemalaria, i-HIV/AIDS, nezinye izifo ezithathelwana kalula. Ngakho-ke, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zenza umsebenzi omuhle ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibhujiswa izinkinga eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nezibhedlela zikahulumeni yisixazululo esincane sezinsiza. Izibhedlela eziningi zihlala zihlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bahlupheke kakhulu uma befika ezibhedlela, njengoba kungenzeka ukuthi badinge ukulinda isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi bathole usizo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izimo zabo zempilo zibe zimbi kakhulu, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi bafe ngenxa yokungabi khona kokunakekelwa okufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga zokuphatha. Abasebenzi bezempilo, ikakhulukazi odokotela nabezempilo, bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izibhedlela zihlala zihlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, futhi abanye abasebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye bahlale bephuma emsebenzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubantu. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola abanikazi bezempilo abaqeqeshiwe, okukhona emiphakathini ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zihlala zikhathazekile ngezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemali. Imali ethathwa kuhulumeni ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindleko zezibhedlela ikakhulukazi ibhujiswa ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izibhedlela zingabi namali eyanele yokuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthola imithi, izinsiza, nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo omubi, lapho izibhedlela zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele, futhi abantu bahlupheka ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsiza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izibhedlela zikahulumeni ngendlela ehlakaniphile. Kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubantu. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwandisa izinsiza, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, nokuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zingahlala zihlupheka, futhi abantu bazohlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ekugcineni, izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wezempilo ezweni lethu. Zihlinzeka ngempilo kubantu abaningi, kodwa zibhujiswa izinkinga eziningi. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abheke lezi zinkinga ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele kubantu. Uma lokhu kungenziwa, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zingaba yisixazululo esihle sokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, futhi abantu bazoba nethuba elingcono lokuphila impilo enempilo.
Iphrofayela kaSipho Mthembu: Umholi Wezobuchwepheshe be-Cryptocurrency USipho Mthembu ungumholi ophawulekayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe be-cryptocurrency. Uthole iziqu zakhe zezeMali eNyuvesi yaseKwaZulu-Natal, lapho aqala khona ukufunda ngalezi zinhlelo ezintsha. Njengomuntu onobuchwepheshe, uSipho waba ngudokotela wezobuchwepheshe, ethola ulwazi olunzulu ngama-systems we-blockchain kanye nezindlela zokukhokha ezisebenza nge-inthanethi. Waqala ukufunda ngama-bitcoin nokwakhiwa kwalezi zimali ezishintshashintshayo, futhi uthole umbono wokuthi lezi zimali zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika. U-Sipho uye waba nesithakazelo esijulile ekwakheni umphakathi ozinikele ekufundiseni abantu ngama-cryptocurrency. Waqala izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini, ezihloselwe ukufundisa abafundi indlela yokufaka imali, ukusebenzisa ama-wallet, nokuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency. Njengomfundisi ophumelelayo, uSipho ubonisa ubuhlakani obukhethekile, eqonda izinkinga ezibhekene nabathengi, futhi uthemba ekuthandeni kwabo ukufunda. Uphinde waba ngumsunguli weqembu elisha elibizwa nge-‘CryptoForAll’, elihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze abantu bazi kahle ngama-cryptocurrency. Le nhlangano isebenza ukusiza abantu baphumelele emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ukufundisa umphakathi wonke, kungakhathaliseki imvelaphi noma isimo sabo sezimali. U-Sipho ube nokubambisana nezinkampani ezihamba phambili emhlabeni, ezithuthukisa izixazululo kumkhakha we-blockchain. Ubuye wagxila ekwakheni izixazululo ezizokwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, uSipho ungumuntu onothando, oxhaswa umndeni wakhe, futhi uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe. Ujolise ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, usebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayazuza. U-Sipho ubhalela izindaba kumaphephandaba nezinkundla zokuxhumana, ethokozisa ukufundisa abantu mayelana nezinkinga ezibhekene nabathengi. Uhlonipha ukuthi abantu badinga amathuba okukhuluma ngama-cryptocurrency, futhi uyakuthokozela ukufundisa indlela yokugcina imali iphephile. Ngokubambisana namanye amaqembu, uSipho uhlinzeka ngokuqonda okubalulekile kokuthi kuyini okufanele kuqashelwe lapho uhweba noma ufaka imali ema-cryptocurrency. USipho Mthembu ungumholi wezemali, onobuchwepheshe obuhlukile nezixazululo ezintsha emkhakheni we-cryptocurrency. Ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zokufundisa, uhlomisa umphakathi, udala amathuba amasha, futhi ugqugquzela ubuchwepheshe obusha. Uthokozisa abanye ngothando nolwazi aluhlinzekayo, ethuthukisa izimpilo zabantu nabanye. Ngempela, uSipho ungumholi ophusile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe.
Enye yezinkinga ezibalulekile eNingizimu Afrika ukuthola isixazululo sezimo eziningi zokuhlaselwa kwezimboni ezithinta kabi umphakathi wezolimo. Senza konke okusemandleni ethu ukwenza umehluko obonakalayo mayelana nokuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ngokwenza kube nokuphepha kwabafuyi, amathuba angavela ukuze bagxile ekukhiqizeni imikhiqizo yezolimo ekhangayo. Umnikelo wezezimali owenziwe nguMfundisi we-Agri Securitas kulencwadi ubufakazi bokuzinikela kwethu ekwakheni amandla komphakathi wezolimo ukuba uphathe ukuphepha kwawo. Kuyajabulisa iZinyunyana Zolimo eNingizimu Afrika ukubambisana neNhlangano Yezokuphepha yaseNingizimu Afrika kulolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuletha ulwazi kumphakathi wezolimo wonke. Khumbula: impilo yakho ibalulekile kithi; ndawonye singakwenza umehluko. Le ncwadi ihloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ikakhulukazi ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Lwezifunda leMpumalanga neNtshonalanga (POCOC) lithathe lesi sinyathelo sokwakha umhlahlandlela wokuphepha nokuhlanganisa lokhu kulencwadi. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Kazwelonke (NOCOC) linqume ukusabalalisa le ncwadi ezweni lonke futhi lisekele lokhu ngeminikelo evela kwabanye abathintekayo. Le ncwadi iqukethe ulwazi mayelana neSikhungo Sezokuphepha saseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS), iMpi Yezwe yaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF), kanye nezinyunyana zabafuyi. Ichaza ukuthi lezi zinhlangano zimi kanjani futhi zihlelwe kanjani ukuze zilwe nohlu lokuhlaselwa kwezimboni. Iphinde ixoxe ngePhuzu Lokuvikela Izindawo Zasemaphandleni (RPP) nokuthi leli phuzu lixhumene kanjani neMisebenzi ye-Akantus II, umkhankaso wokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezinsizakalo zokuphepha ohlose ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Enye into ebalulekile kule ncwadi yizindlela zokuphepha ezikuyona. Izindlela zokuphepha zidingeka ngoba izinhlangano zokuphepha (SAPS neSANDF) zibheka ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini yezolimo njengenye yezinkinga ezishiywe ngaphandle ohlelweni lokuphepha kwezindawo zasemaphandleni (RPP). Uma zisetshenziswa kahle, izindlela zokuphepha zizothinta ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. Uhlelo lweMpi uhlelo olwenziwa ngokuzithandela oluhlanganyela neNhlangano Yezempi yaseNingizimu Afrika olusebenza ngasikhathi sinye. Umphathi ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza kube nokuphepha nokuvikela umphakathi othile (ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezidolobheni). Usizo abahlinzekayo ngokuvamile lubizwa ngokuthi usizo lendawo. Usizo lendawo luhlanganisa umphakathi wonke, ngakho-ke noma ilungu lomphakathi elingelona ilungu loHlelo lweMpi lungathola ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, nakuba kungenzeka bangatholi zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba ilungu lohlelo. Labo abahlanganyela kulolu Hlelo lweMpi abanakho umthwalo wemfanelo wokuvikela ngaphandle kwemingcele yezindawo abasebenza kuzo; banomthwalo wemfanelo kuphela wokuvikela nokwenza kube nokuphepha kwemiphakathi yabo. Lolu hlelo lungachazwa ngokufushane njengokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zibe yizicucu ezincane, ezilawulekayo. Ngamunye walezi zindawo ezincane inani elithile lezindawo zokulima noma izindlu, kuye ngesisindo sendawo kanye nokwabiwa kwezindawo lapho abantu behlala khona. Amalungu endawo axhumana ngefoni noma ngomsakazo njengohlelo lokuxhumana uma imigqa yehluleka. Ezinye izinhlelo zokuxhumana zibalulekile ohlelweni lokuphepha ezindaweni. Amalungu endawo axhumana nomholi wabo (okhethwe ngamalungu) onendlela yokuxhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuphendula ngokushesha kwamaphoyisa uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Umholi wohlelo angazisa umphathi waleso sithangami uma kudingeka amandla amakhulu. Inqubo yokuxhumana ingathatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke amalungu endawo kumele akwazi ukuvikela futhi athembe ozakwabo nabanye amalungu endawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula ngokushesha esimweni esiphuthumayo. Ngalesi sizathu, indawo kumele ilungiselele ukubhekana nezimo ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Umphathi Wendawo uzosiza lolu hlelo lendawo uma lwakha uhlelo lokuphendula ezimeni. Ukubaluleka kokusebenza kahle kwalolu hlelo kukhona ekubambisaneni okufanayo kwamalungu endawo. Bamba iqhaza - kuzokusiza! Kukhona ama-foramu amaphoyisa (CPF) nemiphakathi esiteshini, endaweni, nasezifundazweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi wezolimo ukhuthazwa ukuba ujoyine iNhlangano Yezokuphepha Yezolimo yaseNingizimu Afrika (SARPF) lapho bengafunda khona izindlela zokuzivikela nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuxhumana uma kunezingozi. Uma ujoyina i-CPF noma i-SARPF, umphakathi wezolimo uyaziswa ngamalungelo awo, njengelungelo leli lungu lomphakathi lokuthwala nokusebenzisa isibhamu. I-South African Rural Police Federation (SARPF) iyinhlangano yokuzithandela esebenza ngasikhathi sinye. Amalungu ale nhlangano ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine, okuyiziphathimandla zamaphoyisa, amaphoyisa asekelayo, amaphoyisa akhethekile, kanye namaphoyisa ezolimo nasezidolobheni. Labo abaphakathi kwesigaba samaphoyisa ezolimo nasezidolobheni bangama phoyisa asondelene kakhulu nokuvikela izimboni. Labo abafuna ukuzinikela bangafaka isicelo esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze ukuze bafakwe ohlwini lwezizinda. Abazinikeli bakhethwa ngendlela efanayo nalabo abafaka izicelo zomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, kodwa akudingeki ukuba ne-licence yokushayela. Izidingo ezivamile ezifana neziqu zokushayela, izitifiketi zemfundo, kanye nezilinganiso zempilo yengqondo azisebenzi kulabo abafaka izicelo zokufakwa ohlwini lwezizinda emkhakheni walezo ezibhekene nezindawo zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni. Ngokwenkambo 5 yemithetho esungulwe nguMphathi Kazwelonke noma uMphathi Wezifunda, bangabizwa ukuba basebenze kunoma iyiphi indawo ngosuku nesikhathi esinqunywe nguMphathi Kazwelonke noma uMphathi Wezifunda futhi benze imisebenzi ephathelene namaphoyisa edolobheni noma endaweni yasemaphandleni ngesikhathi noma endaweni eyinikezwe nguMphathi Kazwelonke noma uMphathi Wezifunda ophathelene. Bangadluliselwa kwenye imikhakha uma behlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zalo mkhakha futhi baqeqeshwe noma befuna ukungena eqeqesheni lelo khakha; futhi ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe kaMphathi Kazwelonke, abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yenhlangano ekhethiwe, iSikhungo Sokuphepha, ezweni lonke, esikhumulweni sezindiza, noma kunoma iyiphi enye ingxenye. Umphathi ngamunye kumele enze isinqumo sokuthumela amaphoyisa ezolimo esiteshini sabo, emnyangweni, noma kwezinye izikhungo zeNhlangano ngokuya ngezidingo nezinto ezibalulekile zaleso sithangami, umnyango, noma kwezinye izikhungo. Ochwepheshe bezolimo kulo lonke izwe babamba iqhaza kulolu hlelo lokuvikela izindawo zasemaphandleni (RPP). Lezi zinsizakalo zixhumene nezinyunyana zezolimo zezifunda. Izinyunyana zezolimo zezif
Ukukhulisa Izingane - Ingxoxo NoMama NgesiZulu Isingeniso Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukhula nomndeni, kube nokwanda kwemibono nezinqumo ezithinta ukukhuliswa kwezingane. Ukukhulisa izingane akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka, kodwa futhi kube yindlela yokwakha izimiso, uthando, nobudlelwano. Kulokhu, sithathe isikhathi sikhulume noMama, uNobuhle, oneminyaka engama-40, ophumelele ekukhuliseni izingane ezintathu. Ngiyavuma ukuthi sizoba nencazelo ejulile ngale ndaba. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqala Kokukhulisa Izingane Umbuzo: Mama Nobuhle, ungachaza kanjani isimo sokuqala sokuba ngumama? Impendulo: Ngempela, kwakunzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, ngangikhipha izingane zami zokuqala, ngaba nomuzwa wokuthi kufanele ngihloniphe izinkolelo zomndeni. Kwakubalulekile ukufundisa izingane zami ngothando, kodwa ngangiphinde ngifundise izimiso ezisemqoka. Ngaphinde ngafunda ukuthi ubuhlobo obuqinile nomntwana busekelwe ekwakheni ukwethembana. Ingxenye 2: Ukubaluleka Kwezemfundo Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi ukufundisa izingane kuyisisekelo sokukhulisa? Impendulo: Impela! Ezemfundo ziyisihluthulelo sokukhulisa izingane eziphumelelayo. Ngithanda ukufundisa izingane zami izifundo ezijulile, hhayi kuphela ezincwadini. Ngikholwa ekutheni ukufunda kufanele kube ngumsebenzi ojabulisayo. Ngiyazama ukuxhumana nomntwana wami, ngikhuluma ngempilo, izincwadi, nezinto ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba babe nekhono lokucabanga. Ingxenye 3: Ukubeka Izimiso Umbuzo: Yiziphi izimiso ezibalulekile ezibalulekile ekukhuliseni izingane? Impendulo: Ngibona izimiso eziningana eziyisisekelo. Kuqala, ukukhombisa uthando olungapheli. Uthando lukhuthaza ukwethembana. Okwesibili, ukugcina umthetho. Izingane zidinga umkhawulo, ukuze zazi ukuthi zenza kahle noma kungenjalo. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana. Kufanele sikhulume, siphendulane. Lokhu kuqinisa ubudlelwano bethu. Ingxenye 4: Ukubhekana Nezinselelo Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinselelo obhekana nazo uma ukhulisela izingane? Impendulo: Ziningi izinselelo. Ngicabanga ngezikhathi lapho izingane zami zithola izinkinga ezithile, noma uma ziphikisana. Ngaphinde ngaba nezinselelo zokuthola isikhathi sokuphumula, njengoba ngizama ukulawula ubudlelwano nomsebenzi. Ngiyakwazi ukuthi akekho umama ovumayo, kodwa ngifunda ukuthi kubalulekile ukuxhumana nomyeni wami ukuze sihlanganyele izinselelo. Ingxenye 5: Indlela Yokukhulisa Umoya Wokuzimela Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi ukubakhuthaza ukuba bazimele kubalulekile? Impendulo: Yebo, kakhulu! Ukuzimela kubalulekile. Ngizama ukufundisa izingane zami ukuba zibe nezinqumo futhi zikhulume ngezifiso nezinkinga zabo. Ngiyakhuluma nabo ngezinto eziningi, ngibavumela ukuthi bazame izinto ezintsha, futhi ngibaxhase lapho behluleka. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bayakwazi ukuzimela ngokwabo. Ingxenye 6: Isehlakalo Esikhethekile Umbuzo: Ngabe kukhona isehlakalo esikhethekile esikhumbulekayo esithinta ukukhulisa izingane? Impendulo: Yebo, kukhona. Ngesikhathi sokugubha umkhosi wezinsuku zokuzalwa, ngiyakhumbula ukuhlela umcimbi ophumelelayo. Ngibavumele ukuba bakhule benza izinqumo, kusukela ekukhetheni izitsha kuya ekukhetheni abadlali. Lokhu kwaba yindlela enhle yokubavumela ukuba bazive bekhululekile futhi benza izinto ngokuzimela. Ingxenye 7: Ukubaluleka Kokuxhumana Nezingane Umbuzo: Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi ukufunda ukukhuluma nezingane zakho kubalulekile? Impendulo: Ngempela! Kungumgogodla wokukhulisa izingane. Ukuxoxa nabantwana bethu kusiza ukuba baqonde umhlaba obabazungezile. Ngiyazama ukuba nomkhuba wokuhlangana nabo nsuku zonke, sikhuluma ngempilo yabo, izifiso, nezinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kunciphisa umqondo wokuba bahluleka futhi kwandisa ukuzethemba kwabo. Isiphetho Ukukhulisa izingane akuwona umsebenzi olula, kodwa kuyajabulisa. Uthando, izimiso, nemfundo kuhlanganisa ukwenzeka kokukhula kwengane. Ngiyabonga Mama Nobuhle ngokwabelana ngalezi zihloko ezibalulekile. Ukukhulisa izingane kuyindlela ethokozisayo, futhi kudinga ukubekezela, uthando, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngiyethemba ukuthi abanye bazothola le ngxoxo ibalulekile ekukhuliseni izingane zabo.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo (GEMS Payment Verification) Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwemali ezinsizeni zezempilo. Uhlelo lweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) luhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphathwa kwalezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo ezenziwa kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo zifaneleke, ziqondile, futhi zihambisana nemigomo nezimo zeGEMS. Okokuqala, ukuqonda izinqubo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubalulekile. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni banelungelo lokuthola izinsizakalo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezivivinyo, ukwelashwa, nemithi. Njengoba lezi zinsizakalo ziqhutshelwa, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo ezenziwa kumahlinzeki ziqondile. Ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuhilela ukuhlola imininingwane ethile, efana nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekiwe, izindleko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nemigomo yeGEMS. Okwesibili, le nqubo yokuqinisekisa ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo bathola izinkokhelo zabo ngesikhathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kweGEMS, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kanye nabathengi. Ukuze le nqubo iqhutshekwe kahle, kudingeka ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, obuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ezivumela abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ukuthi baphawule izinkokhelo zabo, futhi ziqinisekiswe ngokushesha. Lokhu kusiza ekunciphiseni isikhathi sokulinda, kunciphisa amaphutha, futhi kuthuthukise ukwaneliseka kwabathengi. Okwesithathu, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuhilela ukuhlola izinkinga ezithile ezingase zivele ngesikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Lokhu kungaba izinkinga ezihlobene nezindleko ezingalungile, izinsizakalo ezingahambelani nezivumelwano, noma izinkinga zokuhlinzeka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinkinga zixazululwa ngokushesha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo ngesikhathi nangendlela efanele. Lokhu kusiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha izinsizakalo zempilo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemali ziyaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, lapho izinkokhelo zingaqinisekiswa ngokushesha, futhi izinkinga zixazululwa ngaphandle kokubambezela. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuhilela ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kanye nabathengi. Ukuze le nqubo ibe yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi zisebenze ngokubambisana, ziqondise izinqubo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni uhlelo oluqinile nolusebenzayo lwezempilo, oluzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngokuhlanganisa konke lokhu, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuGEMS akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isizinda esiqinile sokuphatha izinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu, kunciphise izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zempilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekiswa kwezinkokhelo kuGEMS kudinga ukugxila, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yohlelo lwezempilo.
Ezokuxhumana: Uhlanga Olubucayi Ekuxhumaneni Kwabantu Ezokuxhumana, ngokwemvelo yazo, ziwumgogodla wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Zibandakanya izindlela eziningi zokudlulisa ulwazi, imiyalezo, nemicabango phakathi kwabantu, izigaba, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukuze siqonde kahle izokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukumukela ukuthi lezi zindlela zihlukaniswa ngokwehlukana kwazo, esitayela, nendawo yokusebenza. Okokuqala, izokuxhumana ziqala ngezindlela zombili ezikhona emhlabeni, okungukuthi, ezibhalwe phansi kanye nezikhuluma. Izokuxhumana ezibhalwe phansi, ezifana nezincwadi, amaphephandaba, nezincwadi zocwaningo, zidlala indima enkulu ekuhlinzekeni ngolwazi oluqinile noluchwepheshe. Lezi zindlela zifaneleka kakhulu ezimweni lapho kudingekayo khona ukufaka izizathu ezimiswe ngempumelelo, noma lapho kudinga ukunakekela izincazelo ezicacile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izokuxhumana ezikhuluma, ezifana nezinkulumo, imihlangano, nezingxoxo, ziqhubekela phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lezi zindlela zikhuthaza ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okuqhamuka emoyeni, nakwethuthukiseni ubudlelwano obunobudlelwano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuxhumana zithinta izimo zempilo zansuku zonke, zisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene ezifana nezemfundo, kwezokuxhumana, kanye nobuchwepheshe. Emfundweni, izokuxhumana zidlala indima enkulu ekufundiseni nasekufundeni. Abafundi kudingeka bakwazi ukudlulisa imicabango yabo, baphinde bathole ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kuxhumana kusho ukuthi abaphathi, othisha, nabafundi kumele babe nekhono lokukhuluma kahle nangaphezulu, ukuze kube khona ukuqonda okuphelele phakathi kwabo. Ezweni lezemfundo, izokuxhumana zikhona ezindleleni ezahlukahlukene; njengokufundisa, ukuxoxa ngezihloko, nokwenza izifundo ezihlanganyelwe. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ukuxhumana akugcini nje ngokudlulisa ulwazi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuba ube nezindlela ezinhle zokubamba iqhaza, lokho okuholela ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda kwempilo. Ukuze abantu babe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabo, badinga ukufunda ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana obubumbene nezinhloso zabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezokuxhumana zibuye zibe nomthelela obalulekile kwezokuxhumana. Ukuxhumana kwezokuxhumana kuhilela iziteshi ezifana namasayithi wezokuxhumana, izithombe, nezinsizakusebenza ezisheshayo. Lolu hlobo lokuxhumana lunokuthuthukiswa okukhulu, njengoba lungavumela abantu abaninzi ukuthi baxhumane ngaphandle kwemikhawulo. Nokho, lokhu kuza nemiphumela emibi, njengoba kuveza izinselelo ezifana nokuntuleka kokuxhumana okungokwenyama, ukungaqondi kahle imiyalezo, kanye nezingozi zokuphepha komuntu siqu. Eminyakeni edlule, ubuchwepheshe buguqule kakhulu indlela esixhumana ngayo. Ukuze sikhulume ngempumelelo, kubalulekile ukufaka izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi. Lezi zindlela zenza kube lula ukudlulisa imiyalezo, ukunikeza izimpendulo ezisheshayo, nokwenza kube nokuxhumana okuhlanganyelwe. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo akuphathelene nje nezinsiza zobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokuhlonishwa kwabanye. Ngesikhathi sokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuthola izindlela zokuxhumana ezihloniphekile, ezithokozisayo, nezisebenzayo. Ukuxhumana akupheli kuphela kumyalezo odlulisiwe, kodwa kudinga ukuthi umamukeli aqonde futhi azisebenzise ngempumelelo lokho akutholile. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni ukuxhumana okuvuselelayo, okuhlanganyela, futhi okuhle. Ekugcineni, ezokuxhumana ziwumkhakha obalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Zidlala indima enkulu ekuhlakanipheni nasekukhulumeni, zisebenza njengesixhumanisi phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ukuze sibe nekhono lokuxhumana kahle, kudingeka siqhubele phambili, sifunde izindlela ezinzima, futhi sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu nabanye. Ngalesi sikhathi sokuguquka kwezobuchwepheshe, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi sithuthukisa izindlela zethu zokuxhumana, ukuze sizuze impumelelo empilweni yethu. Ngakho-ke, ezokuxhumana zihlala zibalulekile, futhi kufanele sibe nesithakazelo sokuthuthukisa lezi zindlela ukuze sibe nekhono lokuxhumana okuhle, okuhloniphekile, nokuphumelelayo.
Ikhophi yeSicelo seMikhakha iyatholakala kubakhiqizi bak gouvernement noma uMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Iyini injongo yeSicelo seMikhakha? Isicelo seMikhakha sibhala izimo zokusebenza zabantu abasebenza emithini kanye nabanye abasebenza emithini, kuhlanganise nezinto ezifana nezinsuku zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane yokemployment, kanye nokuphela kwemisebenzi. Siphinde sithathe izinga elincane lemiholo okufanele ikhokhwe ngabaphathi. Bonke abahlwanyela izihlahla; abakhiqizi abavamile; abakhiqizi abachitha isikhathi esiningi emsebenzini wemithi; bonke abathutha embonini yemithi; umsebenzi wasekhaya oqashwe endaweni lapho izihlahla zihlwanyelwa; umgibeli oqashwe emithini kodwa engaphansi kwenkampani yokuphepha yangasese. Ubani ongeyena ohlangene nalokhu? Abaphathi abangahlanganisi imikhakha yokuhlwanyela; imithi yomphakathi; imithi yokuvikela imvelo; noma umuntu ongena noma obamba iqhaza emsebenzini wemithi ngaphansi kwesicelo seMikhakha noma ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esihlangene nebhodi labasebenzi njengoba kuchaziwe eMthethweni Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi ka-1995, njengomthetho ophatha ngaphansi kweBhodi Labasebenzi Bezokuthutha kanye nomsebenzi wokusika nokuguqula izihlahla zibe omunye umkhiqizo, ngokuhlanganyela nemboni ye timber kanye nephepha, njalonjalo. Umthetho uthi ini ngamaholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi bemithi kufanele bakhokhelwe okungenani iholo elifana nokuchazwa kwetafula elingezansi. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi bemithi bathola iholo elifanayo? Bonke abasebenzi bemithi kufanele bathole okungenani iholo elichazwe etafuleni 1. Nokho, abasebenzi bemithi abathola ngaphezulu kwentengo ebekiwe bazoqhubeka bethola amaholo aphezulu. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umsebenzi ongezansi kweminyaka engu-15 noma phezulu kodwa engakafiki eminyakeni engu-18 osebenza amahora angama-35 ngesonto okungenani intengo yehora echazwe etafuleni 1. Ngemuva konyaka owodwa lokusebenza kwesicelo seMikhakha, amaholo azonyuka ngentengo engu-2% ye-CPI (Consumer Price Index). Umphathi nomsebenzi wemithi bangavuma ngokubhala ukuthi umsebenzi wemithi uqedele umsebenzi wezimpahla ngezikhathi ezichaziwe. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umsebenzi wemithi oqashwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, ukukhokha akufanele kube ngaphansi kweholo elincane kanye nenani elisebenzayo ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo. Noma yini ebalulekile ukuqinisekisa izinga lokuphepha nempilo. Umphathi angakhipha imali kuphela ngezizathu ezihlinzekwe yiSicelo seMikhakha. Abasebenzi bemithi kufanele bavume ngokubhala ekukhipheni. Akufanele kukhishwe imali yokuhlala engaphezu kwamaphesenti ayishumi eholo lomsebenzi wemithi. Ukukhishwa kokudla akufanele kudlule amaphesenti ayishumi eholo lomsebenzi wemithi. Uma kukhona abasebenzi bemithi abaphezulu kwemibili abahlala endaweni yokusebenza, inani eliphelele lemali elingakhishwa kubo bonke abasebenzi bemithi abahlala kufanele lingadluli amaphesenti angama-25 athathwe ezingeni eliphansi leholo lomuntu ophila emithini. Ngamanye amazwi, uma kukhona abasebenzi bemithi abahlanu abahlala ngaphakathi kwenkampani, inani eliphezulu elingakhishwa kumuntu ngamunye lingaba amaphesenti amahlanu. Indlu kufanele ibe nekhono elikhulu elingama-30 square meters okungenani. Abasebenzi bemithi banesibopho sokubheka impahla yomphathi wabo. Impahla yomphathi ifaka imishini noma ezinye izinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngabo ngesikhathi beqashwe. Uma umphakathi wemithi engaphatheki kahle ekuhloleni impahla yabo, umphathi angakhipha imali ngenxa yokulahleka noma ukulimala. Kumele banikeze umsebenzi wemithi ithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi kungani imali kumele ingakhishwa eholo labo. Qinisekisa ukuthi inani elikhishwayo alidluli ingxenye eyodwa ye-quarters eholo lomsebenzi wemithi. Amalungelo nezibopho zabaphathi nabantu abasebenza emithini emkhakheni wemithi akhishwa ngendlela efuna ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zombili izinhlangothi. Uhlelo olungakanani umphakathi wemithi angasebenza ngesonto? Amahora ayisishiyagalolunye ngosuku, uma umphakathi wemithi usebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu noma ngaphansi kwesonto; noma amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku, uma umphakathi wemithi usebenza ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezinhlanu ngesonto. Umsebenzi akufanele asebenze isikhathi esengeziwe esidlula amahora angama-12 ngosuku. Ngenxa yokuthi umphakathi wemithi akufanele asebenze isikhathi esengeziwe esidlula amahora angama-45 ngesonto, umphakathi wemithi osebenza amahora ayishumi ezinsukwini ezine akufanele asebenze amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku lwesihlanu. Isikhathi esengeziwe kufanele sikhokhelwe ngentengo ejwayelekile yansuku zonke ehambisana nengxenye yeholo ejwayelekile yomsebenzi. Isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo kufanele sinikezelwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kusukela ngosuku oluthola ilungelo lokuphumula. Nokho, isivumelwano esibhaliwe singakhulisa lesi sikhathi sibe yizinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe singadinga noma sivumele umphakathi wemithi ukuthi asebenze amahora ayishumi ngosuku ngokuhlanganyela nezikhathi zokuphuma kokudla ngaphandle kokukhokhwa kwesikhathi esengeziwe. Ngaphezulu kwezinsuku ezinhlanu ngesonto. Uma iholidi liphakathi nosuku olujwayele ukujwayelekile lwabantu abasebenza emithini, umphathi kufanele akhokhele labo abangasebenzi okungenani iholo elijwayelekile elilinganayo nosuku. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umphakathi wemithi noma yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakele ngokusebenza ngosuku lweholidi ngosuku lokukhokha olujwayelekile. Abaphathi kufanele baziqhenye ngabasebenzi bemithi abajwayele ukuhamba ebusuku mayelana nezimo ezibucayi ezihambisana nomsebenzi kanye nelungelo labantu ukuba bahlolwe uma bebuza njalo lapho izindleko zikhokhwa umphathi. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umphakathi wemithi elindile ubenefit yokulinda. Le benefit kufanele ibe okungenani elingana namaphesenti ayishumi eholo lomsebenzi. Isivumelwano singasusa isikhathi sokuphuma kokudla kumphakathi wemithi osebenza ngaphansi kwamahora ayisithupha ngosuku. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe singahlinzeka okungenani amahora angama-60 wesikhathi sokuphumula njalo ngesonto lesibili noma sinciphise izikhathi zokuphumula ngesonto ukufinyelela amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngesonto, uma isikhathi sokuphumula sikhuliswa ngokufanele ngesonto elilandelayo. Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuhamba umphakathi wemithi angazithatha? Uphi umphakathi wemithi ongathatha ezinsukwini ezingu-365? Umphakathi wemithi unelungelo lokuthatha izinsuku ezintathu ezinyangeni. Kwenzekani uma iholidi lihambisana nezinsuku zokuhamba? Iyini ebalulekile mayelana nezinsuku zokugula? Ukusekelwa noma isikhathi esibaliwe ngokusekelwe kulungelo lokuhamba sikhokhelwa izinyanga eziyi-36 ezithathwe kusukela ekubhaleni kwezinsuku ezisebenze phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha. Umphakathi wemithi usebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngesonto. Izinsuku zokuhamba ngaphakathi kulungelo lokuhamba zilinganiselwa ku-5 x 6 (inani lezinsuku) = 30 izinsuku phakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-36. Umphathi angacela isitifiketi sezokwelapha uma umphakathi wemithi engasebenzi ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili noma
Ngo-2010, kwaba unyaka odinga ukubekezela lapho kufezwa ukutshala ibhali kwiSikhungo Sokunisela eTaung. Kwakunezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nokutshala kokuqala uhlobo olubizwa ngokuthi 'cocktail', umoya opholile nokubanda okwahlala kuze kube nguSepthemba, imvula enamandla, ukuhlaselwa yizilokazane, nokusebenza okuncane. Ukuqala kokutshala uhlobo olusha lwezibhalibhalu olubizwa ngokuthi 'cocktail' kwiSikhungo Sokunisela eTaung kwalethe indaba enzima. Uhlobo lwe-'cocktail' lwabonisa ukuthi lungakwazi ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle ngehektare. Ngokubheka umlando wokutshala ibhali, sibona ukuthi u-'cocktail' uwuhlobo lokuqala ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ehambisanayo eminyakeni emibili elandelanayo. Kwakunezinye izinkundla ezikhiqize ama-toni angu-7.9 ngehektare. Uma bekungekho zinkinga ezishiwo, u-'cocktail' ubengakubonisa ukuthi ungakhiqiza nakakhulu. Inkinga kwaba ukuthi amazinga e-nitrogen awahlangabezani namazinga abekwe yi-SABM. Nokho, lokhu sekuthuthuke, futhi imikhiqizo ngehektare ikhulile ngemuva kokutshala kokuqala le bhali ngo-1981 kwiSikhungo Sokunisela eTaung. Unyaka ka-2010 wawathinteka kakhulu ubanda nokufriza. Lokhu kwaqhubeka kuze kube ngu-Okthoba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukufriza kwaba nomthelela ebhalini phakathi nesikhathi sokukhula, kusukela ngesikhathi kuqala ukuvuthwa, kuze kube ngesikhathi kuqala ukuvuna, futhi kuze kube ngesikhathi okwakukhona khona okwakukhuluma kuze kube sekupheleni kokuvuthwa. Izimo zezulu zibalulekile kakhulu lapho kutshalwa ibhali. Ngonyaka odlule, ama-toni angu-1,129 akhishwe, kodwa ama-toni angu-1.35 abengaphansi kwestandadi ye-SABM, kanti amanye ama-toni angu-33 athengiswe ngemuva kokuhlolwa. Imvula eningi yadala izinkinga zekhwalithi ye-bhali. Ngesikhathi sokuvuna ngo-2010, imvula yasehlobo yayisanda kuqala. Ukuvuna kwaqala ngomhla kaNovemba 8, kodwa ngoNovemba 12, kwaqala ukuwa imvula. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavunwa kuphela inani elincane le-bhali. Izinkundla ezazingeziwunwanga zathinteka yilomvula, zakhokelela kulokhu okubizwa ngokuthi "ukuvuthwa kwangaphambi." Nokho, i-SABM yaqhubeka nokuhlola le nkinga futhi yasebenza nabakhiqizi (abalimi) ukuze bathole izindlela zokweseka nokusebenzisa le bhali ngendlela ezothokozisa bonke. Ukuhlaselwa izilokazane nakho kwanciphisa umkhiqizo. Ama-hektare angu-140 athinteka yizilokazane ngaleso sikhathi. Izilokazane zavele kathathu kulandela phakathi naleso sikhathi. Izinkampani ze-inshurensi zabalula ukuthi imikhiqizo yehlile ukusuka ku-45% kuya ku-47% ngaleso sikhathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kwakukhona ingozi enkulu ekukhiqizeni. Izinkundla ezivame ukukhiqiza phakathi kuka-6 no-7 ama-toni zathola kuphela ama-toni angu-4.9 ngehektare. Kwakubalulekile futhi ukuthola izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko zemishini. Ngakho-ke, kwakungcono ukusebenzisa ukusebenza okuncane. Le ndlela inciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwemishini eminingi - ukwenza imisebenzi ehlukene ngokuhambisa imshini kanye kuphela. Ngokufanayo, ungakha, utshale, futhi ufake umanyolo ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ngokusebenzisa le ndlela yokulima, umkhiqizo reached ama-toni angu-6.8 ngehektare lapho ama-hektare angu-120 atshalwe. Kulo nyaka, abakhiqizi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa bakhuthazekile futhi bafunda ezinye izindlela zokulima. Umkhiqizo ophumeleleka wama-toni angu-3,688 wasetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane kulo nyaka.
Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka kwazo ezindaweni ezahlukene ezisebenzisa amanzi. Uhlelo oluphelele lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha (NCMP), oluphathwa yiMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla eNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezithile ezijwayelekile eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlolwe emalabhorethri omnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo kokubili eziphilayo nezingenamandla emvelweni. Ulwazi oluqoqwe kulolu hlelo lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha lusetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda ngesimo sekhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha ezweni esisebenzisa amanzi, kubaphathi bezinsiza zamanzi, ososayensi, abathathi bezinqumo, kanye nomphakathi ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda. Ikhwalithi yamanzi ihlolwa ukuze ibonakale ifaneleka ukusetshenziswa kwasekhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo, kanti izingxenye eziphakeme zekhwalithi yamanzi ezihlanganiswe kulesi sifundo zazigxile kulokho okucatshangwa ukuthi kufanelekile kulezi zindawo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Izinkinga ezinkulu zekhwalithi yamanzi kubasebenzisi bamanzi abakhaya zihlanganisa amazinga aphezulu e-Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) futhi, kwezinye izindawo, amazinga aphezulu e-fluoride. Ukuhlola kokumuncwa kwe-sodium, ukuxhumana kukagesi, pH, kanye namazinga e-chloride kuyizinkinga ezingaba khona ezolimo ezinomoya. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinamanzi ambalwa ngoba likhona ezindaweni ezikahle kakhulu ezinomoya opholile nezomoya, ezinomoya ohlukahlukene ukusuka emathafeni kuya kumathafa apholile engxenyeni esentshonalanga yelizwe kuya ezindaweni eziseduze nekhasi elisha. Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo ezweni kungama-500 mm (Joubert, 2003), okuphansi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga lokwehla kwemvula emhlabeni elingu-860 mm (DWF, 2002). Nakuba amanzi aphansi ebalulekile ekunikezeni izindawo zasemaphandleni ezingxenyeni zelizwe, ngenxa yesimo sejeoloji esiphakeme eNingizimu Afrika, kunezinto ezinkulu zezitini ezingasetshenziselwa ukuhambisa inani elikhulu lamanzi ngezindawo ezinkulu (DWAF, 2002). Imvula namanzi aphansi ahlukaniswe ngokungafani nangokwenziwa, ngokwezimvula ezinzima ezenzeka ezindaweni ezinkulu zelizwe. Ngakho-ke, ukuhamba kwamanzi okuqukethe ukuhamba okukhulu kuvame ukwenzeka, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezimvula ezindaweni eziphansi, ukuthuthukiswa kwedolobha, kanye nemisebenzi yezimboni eyenzeka ezindaweni ezikude nezifundeni ezinkulu - ngenxa yezinsiza ezisemhlabeni kanye nezinye izizathu - kuholele ekudingekeni kokwandiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhamba kwamanzi ezinkulu kakhulu kakhulu (DWAF, 2002). Imifula emine emikhulu eNingizimu Afrika ihlukaniswe nezinye izizwe, okwenza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi kube umsebenzi onzima futhi obalulekile. Ukuze kuphathwe izinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, izwe lehlukaniswe ngeziqu eziyi-19 zokuphathwa kwamanzi (WMA) (DWAF, 2002). Inhloso yalokhu, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuvumela abasebenzisi bamanzi nezinye izithakazelo ukuba babambe iqhaza kahle ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Ezinye zalezi zikhungo kuzodingeka ziqalwe kanti ezinye (kuhlanganiswe noMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla) kuzodingeka ziguqulwe ukuze zibonise imisebenzi emisha noma eshintshile njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wamanzi (Umthetho 36 ka-1998) (DWAF, 2002). Ngenxa yezidingo ezibekwe ezinsizeni zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, imithombo yemvelo yamanzi ithintekile kakhulu ngalezi zinhlelo zokulawula ezifana nezinqaba nezindonga zokugcina amanzi ezakhiwe emifuleni, kanye nemisebenzi yabantu efana nokukhipha amanzi, amanzi abuyela emifuleni, kanye nemithelela yokusetshenziswa komhlaba (DWAF, 2002). Ngokuvamile, lokhu kuholele ekwehliseni ikhwalithi yamanzi aphezulu futhi kube nemiphumela emibi ezinhlelweni zokuphila kwezitshalo nezilwane ezisemanzini. Ikhwalithi yamanzi ingase ibe yimbi kwezinye izindawo ngenxa zezizathu zemvelo. Izinto ezingaphili ezakha lapho izendlalelo zezitini zakhiwa, izinto ezisele zokusetshenziswa komhlabathi, nezinto eziphilayo ezithululwa emvelweni, njengokhula nezinsalela zezilwane. Izinhlayiya ezincane kakhulu eziphilayo ezifana namagciwane, ama-virus, nezilwane ezidla igazi, ezivela emhlabathini nasemvelweni, zingase zifake nezinsalela zezilwane nabantu. Izinto ezikhipha ukukhanya okuqinile ngokuvamile zenzeka kuphela ngamaphesenti amancane ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo. Ukutholakala kokulinganiselwa kwamanzi, okusho, ibhalansi ekutholeni izinsiza zamanzi, ekusetshenzisweni kwemithombo yamanzi nezinsiza zokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukusebenzisa amanzi okuqhubekayo, ngokwenza izinguquko ezincane ekusetshenzisweni kwamanzi ukuze kufezwe ibhalansi phakathi kokutholakala kwamanzi nezidingo zomthetho zamanzi, nokuqalisa ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokugcina amanzi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle ukuze kufezwe izinzuzo ezinkulu zomphakathi nezomnotho. Ukuze lezi zinjongo zifezeke, umthetho weMvelo Wamanzi (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998) waphakanyiswa. Lona ngumthetho obalulekile ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika.
