Umthetho uthi "amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo ephethwe bonke abantu." Ukuhluka okukhulu okwenziwa yilo mthetho uma kuqhathaniswa nemithetho yamanzi yangaphambili ukuthi ilungelo lokufinyelela emanzini alisekelwe ekubeni nomhlaba, ukuthi bonke abantu banelungelo elilinganayo lokufinyelela emanzini afanele izidingo eziyisisekelo zomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okokuqala, imvelo iyavuma njengokuthi inelungelo lezomthetho lokufinyelela emanzini. Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinjongo ze-NWA nezinye izidingo zokuhlola ikhwalithi yamanzi. Uhlelo oluphelele lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi, oluphathwa yiMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla eNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile ezimfushane eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlolwe emalabhorethri omnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo nezinto ezingaphili neziphilayo. Inhloso yocwaningo olwakhiwe kule ndatshana kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezinto ezinkulu ezingaphili zekhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha emanzini asetshenziswa eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngencazelo emfushane ngesimo sekhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha asetshenziswa ngokuhambisana nezidingo zekhwalithi yamanzi zabasebenzisi bamanzi abakhulu, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi abakhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo. Ulwazi luphinde luhlinzekwe ezingeni elihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile lapho kukhona idatha eqoqwe eyanele ezindaweni ezifanele. Lolu lwazi luyathakazelisa ikakhulukazi kulabo abaphatha ikhwalithi yamanzi esifundazweni kunokwenziwa kwenhlangano. Iglossary yezisho ibonakala ekuphe
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: Ukuhlola Izinto Eziyinhloko Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, futhi abantu behlale bejolise ezintweni ezithinta impilo yabo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka imicimbi ebalulekile ezempilo nenhlalakahle, sithintane nemicimbi ethile, izinhlelo, nezindlela ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo ayigcini ngokubhekana nezifo noma izinkinga zempilo, kodwa ibandakanya nezindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Izinhlelo zokuvikela impilo, njengokuhlola impilo, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nempilo engcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imicimbi yokuhlola izinga lempilo, izifundo zokudla okunempilo, kanye nemikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukuzivocavoca. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile, zinezithelo ezinhle emiphakathini. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zokuhlala zempilo, imicimbi eminingi ibonakala ihlanganisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo emphakathini. Izikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha zenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kuhlangene nemicimbi yokukhuthaza imikhuba emihle, efana nezinsuku zokuhlola impilo, izifundo zokudla okunempilo, kanye nemikhankaso yokuvikela izifo. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqonde izidingo zabo zezempilo, futhi zikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imicimbi yezempilo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umphakathi onempilo uyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, futhi unikeza ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imicimbi efana nemikhosi yokuphila, izinkundla zokuxoxisana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi, zonke zikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlanganyela, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu babelane ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle ibalulekile ekwakheni ukuqwashisa. Imikhankaso yokukhuthaza impilo, njengezinhlelo zokuvikela izifo, zifundisa abantu ngezingozi ezihlobene nezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela impilo yabo, futhi baqonde ukuthi izinqumo zabo zingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi. Ukuqwashisa ngempilo kuholela ekutheni abantu benze izinqumo eziphusile, okukhuthaza impilo engcono. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle ayisebenzi ngaphandle kokubambisana. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze, kudingeka ukuthi abantu babambisane, kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nabantu. Imicimbi yokuxhumana, efana nezinsuku zokuvikela impilo, izifundo, kanye nemikhosi, ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu babelane ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ukwakha imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle kudinga izinsiza eziningi, kuhlanganise nezimali, abantu, kanye nezinsiza. Izikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nohulumeni kudinga ukuba babe nesandla ekwakheni lezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imicimbi iyaphumelela. Imicimbi yokuvikela impilo, izifundo, kanye nemikhankaso yokukhuthaza impilo, zonke zidinga ukuxhaswa ukuze zibe nempumelelo. Ekugcineni, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqwashisa, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imicimbi ehloswe ngokuqinile iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, futhi ikhuthaza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nempilo yabo. Njengomphakathi, kumele siqhubeke nokukhuthaza le micimbi, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Ukubambisana, ukuqwashisa, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, konke kudinga ukuba kube khona ukuze imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle ibe nempumelelo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo.
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungathí sina esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Singadla ukudla okunempilo, futhi noma kunjalo, uma singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa indlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho-ke, nakekela wena. Ukunakekela thina kuyisibopho sethu. Ukudla kuyisidingo esibalulekile empilweni. Ukudla kusenza sijabulele ukuphila. Cabanga nje ukuthi sithokozisa kangakanani ukudla okunambitheka kahle nemindeni yethu nokuthi kubi kangakanani emihlanganweni uma kungekho ukudla okunambitheka kahle. Ngesikhathi sijabulela ukudla okunambitheka kahle, kubalulekile ukudla ngokuhlakanipha. Funda le bhukwana ukuze uthole ukuthi kungani ukudla kubalulekile nokuthi kufanele sidle kangakanani. Funda indaba kaDudu... Qedela i-milkshake yakho, bantwana, sekuyisikhathi sokuthi niye esikoleni. Ukudla okunempilo kusiza ukufunda kahle. Imizimba nemiqondo yezingane ezikhulayo idinga inani elifanele lokudla nsuku zonke ukuze ikhululeke kahle. UDudu uthi, umphakathi omkhulu njengemvubu uthola kanjani zonke izidingo zawo emathafeni? Umzimba womuntu usebenza ngendlela ehlukile. Sidinga ukudla okunempilo okuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ukuze sihlale sikhona futhi siqinile. Woza uphuze itiye, Dudu, kukhona nekhukhi elimnandi esilethe kwi sisi sethu edolobheni lapho esebenza khona. Ngizokucela nje ungiphe ingxenye yekhukhi, ngiyabonga. Kodwa ukuba nolwazi lokuthi kufanele sidle ini kungasiza ukuvikela ingozi yokukhuluphala, kugcine isisindo esinempilo ngokudla okulungile nokwanele. Lezi yizithombe zomjaho wezemidlalo wendodana yami. Ungumlandeli omkhulu weBafana Bafana. Lapha ungabona umehluko wokuthi lezi zinto zidinga ukudla okuhlukile ngoba ukudlala kubenza bahlale bephila, ngokungafani nosisi wakho osebenza ehhovisi. Kule bhukwana, sikhuluma ngokuqondile ngokudla. Ukudla yikho esikudlayo noma esikuphuza ukuze siqhubeke siphila. Kufanele udle ukudla okufanele ukuze uhlale unempilo, usebenze kahle, futhi uphile isikhathi eside. Konke ukudla kunezinto ezimbili eziqinisekisa ukuphila kwethu: amandla nezithako. Imoto kumele ibe nefuels ukuze ikwazi ukuhamba. Ngendlela efanayo, ukudla kunikeza umzimba wakho amandla okunyakaza nokwenza izinto ofuna ukuzifeza. Izithako yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Lezi zithako zinegama elihlukile futhi zisebenza ngezindlela ezihlukene emizimbeni yethu. Izithako ezakhiweyo zomzimba wakho futhi zigcine uqine zibizwa ngokuthi ama-proteins. Izithako ezivikela ekuguleni zibizwa ngama-vitamins kanye nama-minerals. Lokhu kudla kuqukethe izithako eziningi ezivikela, ama-vitamins, kanye nama-minerals. Khumbula njalo ukuhlanza izithelo nemifino ngaphambi kokukudla. Lokhu kudla kunikeza amandla. Ezinye izidlo ezihambisana nalokhu zifaka ama-nuts nezithelo. Ukudla kusho ukudla okudlayo nsuku zonke. Ukuze uthole zonke izithako namandla owadingayo, kufanele udle ukudla okuhlukile nsuku zonke. Ukuze ukudla kwakho kube kuhle, kufanele ufake okukodwa noma ngaphezulu kokudla okunezithako nezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezivikela ekudleni ngakunye odlayo. Zama ukukhetha ukudla okuhlukile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle kabili noma kathathu ngosuku. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle ekuseni. Izingane kumele zithole iziphuzo ngaphambi kokuhamba esikoleni. Khumbula ukuthi izingane kufanele zibe neziphuzo phakathi kokudla ngoba izimbobo zazo zincane futhi azikwazi ukudla okuningi ngasikhathi sinye. Ukudla kwethu kuleli lizwe kufanelekile ekudleni okunempilo. Empeleni, ukudla kwendabuko kwabokhokho benu (okulandwa abantu abaningi) kudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo okudliwayo nsuku zonke njengokhukhamba, irayisi, ama-cereals, ubhontshisi, kanye nezitambu kubizwa ngokuthi ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu kudla kunikeza amandla, kwakha umzimba wakho, futhi kuvikele futhi. Lokhu kudla kuhlangene. Ngoba akuphathwanga, kunikeza izithako ezidingekayo umzimba wakho. Okubi ukuthi abanye abantu bayakhohlwa ukudla okuyisisekelo. Bathi bangakwazi ukuthenga ukudla okudlula. Abantu bavame ukufaka iziphuzo nezithako ekudleni (njenge-curry, usawoti, uphizi, noshukela) ukuze kudle kube mnandi. Iningi lezi zinto nezithako azinazo izithako zokunikeza umzimba. Nakuba umzimba wakho udinga usawoti, kufanele kube ngezinga elincane kakhulu nsuku zonke; ingxenye ye-teaspoon ngosuku. Ngokuvamile, gwema ukudla okunoshukela njengama-chips nezitambu ezifakwe uwoyela. Iziphuzo yizidlo ezilula ezidliwayo phakathi kokudla. Ukuphuzisa phakathi kokudla kusiza ukugcina umzimba wakho uhlelekile usuku lonke. Izingane zidinga ukuba neziphuzo phakathi kokudla. Ukuphuzisa kubalulekile kodwa kufanele uqaphele ngezinhlobo zokudla ozisebenzisayo kulokhu. Abantu abaningi baphuza ukudla njengama-potatoes afakwe uwoyela, ama-sweets, ama-chocolates, iziphuzo ezibandayo, ama-cakes, ama-biscuits, itiye, kanye nekhofi. Okubi ukuthi zonke lezi zinto azikona ukudla okunempilo. Futhi zibhakabhaka kakhulu. Khuthaza ingane yakho ukuthi ithenge izithelo kuphela kubathengisi. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo akufanele zifake ezinye izidlo eziphilayo. Cishe u-2/3 wombili womuntu wenziwe ngamanzi futhi zonke izicubu zomzimba ziqukethe amanzi. Amanzi awanazo izithako ezitholakala ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zokudla kodwa adingeka emzimbeni. Empeleni, zonke izinto eziphilayo kuhlanganise nezilwane nezitshalo zidinga amanzi ukusiza umzimba ukuthi ukhiphe udoti ngaphakathi kwawo. Umuntu udinga ukuphuza okungenani izinkomishi eziyisithupha zamanzi ngosuku ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umzimba unamanzi anele. Umzimba wakho ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi uma kushisa, ngokukhathazeka nangokuthi uma uphumeza. Uma kushisa, uzwa umunyu wamanzi, lokhu kungenxa yokuthi umzimba wakho udinga amanzi. Impilo yethu incike kulokho esikudlayo. Ukudla okunempilo kuzokunikeza amandla anele kanti lezi zinto eziphilayo zizokusiza ekukhuleni, zigcine umzimba wakho unempilo ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza, ukudlala, nokwenza ezinye izinto ofuna ukuzifeza. Lezi zinto zidinga amandla amaningi. Iyini inani elifanele lokudla elinikeza umuntu "amandla" okufanele adle? Ake sibheke inani lokudla okufanele udle. Uthola kangakanani (ikakhulukazi ukudla okunikeza amandla) kuzoncika kulokho okudingayo. Abantu abahlukene banezidingo zamandla ezihlukene. Izingane zidle inani elanele lokudla okunikeza amandla uma zikhula kahle. Khuluma nomhlengikazi wesikhungo ukuze uthole ukuthi ingane yakho ikhula kahle. Umuntu omdala udla inani elifanele lokudla okunikeza amandla uma egcine isisindo somzimba esinempilo. Khuluma nomhlengikazi wesikhungo ukuze akusize ngesisindo esifanele somzimba wakho. Uma umuntu edla ukudla
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo 1. Isingeniso Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo sekuyinkinga enkulu ethinta impilo yomphakathi. Izindawo zasemakhaya zihlala zinezidingo ezinkulu zezempilo, kodwa ukungabi khona kodokotela abanele kuholela ekutheni abantu bangatholi usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Le ndatshana izobheka izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. 2. Izimbangela zokushoda kodokotela Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kudalwa yizizathu eziningi: - Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza: Izindawo zasemakhaya zihlala zinezinsiza ezincane, okuhlanganisa izikhungo zezempilo eziphansi, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha odokotela. - Izimo zokusebenza: Odokotela abaningi bakhetha ukusebenza ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni ngenxa yezimo zokusebenza ezinhle, okuhlanganisa nezikhala ezinhle zokuhlala, izinsiza ezithuthukile, kanye namathuba okukhula emsebenzini. - Izinkinga zokuhamba: Izindawo zasemakhaya zihlala zinezinkinga zokuhamba, okwenza kube nzima kubodokotela ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. - Imiholo ephansi: Imiholo yodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya ivame ukuba phansi uma iqhathaniswa nezindawo ezisemadolobheni, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha abanolwazi. 3. Imiphumela yokushoda kodokotela Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya kunezimpempe ezinzima: - Ukungatholi usizo lwezempilo: Abantu basemakhaya bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi zempilo, kodwa ngenxa yokushoda kodokotela, abakwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo, okuholela ekwandeni kwezifo. - Ukwehla kwezinga lempilo: Ukungabi khona kodokotela kuholela ekwehleni kwezinga lempilo, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu basemakhaya baphila impilo engaphansi. - Ukukhula kwezindleko zezempilo: Abantu abangenayo imitholampilo ethile badinga ukuya emadolobheni ukuze bathole usizo, okukhuphula izindleko zokuhamba nokwelashwa. - Ukukhula kwezifo ezithathelwanayo: Ukungabi khona kodokotela kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezithathelwanayo, njengoba abantu behlangana bezama ukuthola usizo. 4. Izixazululo Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile: - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni anikeze izinsiza ezanele ezikhungweni zezempilo zasemakhaya, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zokuhlala ezinhle kubodokotela. - Ukukhuthaza odokotela ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemakhaya: Uhulumeni angasebenzisa izikhuthazo ezifana nemiholo eyengeziwe, izikhala zokuhlala ezinhle, kanye namathuba okuthuthukiswa kwemfundo. - Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuhamba: Ukuze kube lula kubodokotela ukufinyelela ezindaweni zasemakhaya, kudingeka izinhlelo zokuhamba ezithuthukile. - Ukwandisa imfundo ngezempilo: Ukukhuthaza imfundo ngezempilo kubantu basemakhaya kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde izidingo zabo zezempilo futhi bakwazi ukuzitholela usizo. 5. Isiphetho Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuyinkinga edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo kufanele zibe nezinhloso ezicacile zokuthuthukisa isimo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngokubambisana, uhulumeni, odokotela, kanye nomphakathi bangasebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu basemakhaya bathola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, impilo engcono, kanye nokukhula komphakathi.
Umthetho Wokuphatha Abantu Abamnyama 38 ka-1927, isigaba 11 (b): Wonke owesifazane oshade ngokwenkolo yesiko (ngaphandle kwabesifazane eKwaZulu-Natal) uzobhekwa njengengane. Isimo sowesifazane silingana nesengane ngaphandle kwamalungelo omuntu omdala (ongakafiki eminyakeni engu-21). Owesifazane akanaso isithunzi sokugcina ingane ngoba ubhekwa ngumuntu. Owesifazane akakwazi ukusaina isivumelwano somthetho ngaphandle kosizo lwem husband noma uyise. Owesifazane akakwazi ukufaka amalungelo kodwa ungumfanekiso okumele wenziwe yilowo onelungelo. Umthetho wesiko uthinta kanjani igunya lokugcina ingane? Ngaphansi komthetho wesiko, ukugcina ingane kuyilungelo elinikezwa umuntu nempilo yakhe ngokushada. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umuntu ekhokhele lobola/umshado, yena nomndeni wakhe bathola amalungelo aphelele okuba abazali ezinganeni ezazalwe kulowo mshado. Umthwalo wokugcina izingane emshadweni uphakathi komuntu, umkakhe, nomndeni wakhe. Umthwalo wokugcina izingane zowesifazane ongashadile uphakathi kukhulu wokhokho bezingane nomndeni wakhe. Uma intombazane ishada futhi ibe nengane ekhaya, igunya lokugcina le ntombazane nezingane zayo lidluliselwa kumuntu okhokhele lobola nomndeni wakhe omusha. Ngakho-ke, umthwalo wokugcina ingane ngokwenkolo yesiko ushintsha izandla kuphela emgibeni wesilisa (emshadweni), futhi izingane ziba yingxenye yomndeni wesilisa. Ukugcina ingane kwenziwa ngumuntu egameni lomndeni wakhe. Ingane noma izingane ezazalwe ekhaya azibhekwa ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngoba ingane yayihlala ekhaya, kwesinye isikhathi ihlala nabokhokho bayo besifazane (ngaphambi komshado) noma ihlala nomndeni omusha wombuso lapho umama wayo eshada, okuthathwe kokukhuluma okuthi "inkunzi ithengwa ngethanga layo." Kukhona isidingo sokucacisa uhlobo lomshado owesifazane angaba kuwo. Izingane ezazalwe ngaphakathi komshado: Lezi zingane zomuntu nomndeni wakhe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela uyise. Kulindeleke ukuthi ukhulu wokhokho bezingane wamukele lezi zingane njengokwakhe futhi agcwalise yonke imithwalo yokuba abazali nezinhloso ezihlobene nazo. Ukufa komuntu akusho ukuphela kobudlelwano bomshado. Izingane zomfelokazi zihlukaniswa kanje: (i) izingane zomuntu oshade nomfelokazi. Ngaphansi kwesiko lokushada komfelokazi, umshado okhona uqhubeka nomfelokazi nomuntu entering esikhundleni somufi futhi uqhubeka ngamalungelo akhe. Umfelokazi nezingane zakhe zikhuliswa ngumuntu entering empilweni yomfelokazi. Umuntu entering umfelokazi uvame ukuba omunye wabazali bomndeni womufi. Umndeni womufi unomthwalo wokunakekela umfelokazi impilo yakhe yonke nokuzibophezela ekuzaleni izingane ezizobanjwa ngumuntu entering futhi onikezwe yona. Izingane ezazalwe kumfelokazi nomuntu entering umfelokazi zizohlala zibhekwa njengokhulu bomufi. Ngisho nasezikhathini lapho umuntu engena kumkakhe, uma umfelokazi ezala izingane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela uyise noma abezayo, zizohlala zibhekwa njengokhulu bomufi nomndeni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuhlukana, izingane zivame kushiywa nomndeni womuntu. Imithetho eminingi yesiko ayivumeli owesifazane ukuthi aphinde ashade ngenkathi esaphila ngaphansi komndeni wendoda yakhe. Kumele abuyele emndenini wakhe uma efuna ukuphinda ashade. Uma ephinda ashade, ingane ezalwe kumfazi ohlukanisiwe emshadweni wakhe wesibili ibhekwa njengengane yomshado, ngakho-ke belonging kumndeni womuntu wesibili. Umuntu womshado wesibili ungumgibeli noma umgibeli walezi zingane. Emshadweni wesibili, umfazi ohlukanisiwe akamukelwa ngumuntu womshado wesibili ukuba alethe izingane zakhe emshadweni wabo. (okukhuluma ukuthi izingane zikhula zikhuliswa uyise emva kokubuyela kubo ngemuva kokuhlukana), ngaphansi kwalesi simo, umuntu womshado omusha uletha izingane zakhe emshadweni. Imigomo yesigaba 11 (b) yeMthetho Wokuphatha Abantu Abamnyama yayihloselwe ukuphatha isimo lapho owesifazane ezohlala engane ngenkathi umuntu ezoba umgibeli wakhe. Umphumela walesi sigaba uthi: abesifazane abangashadile babhekwa njengabantu abadala (baphezulu kweminyaka engu-21) ngenkathi abesifazane abamnyama abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abashadile ngokwenkolo yesiko bebhekwa njengengane. Owesifazane omnyama oshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko unamalungelo akhe omdala aphansi ngenxa yomshado noma uma engaphansi kweminyaka engu-21, ngokwemigomo yeMthetho Wokufika Kwezimali Nezikhala. Isimo sabo sinciphisa ikhono labo lokungena ezivumelwaneni zomthetho, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bodwa noma uma befuna temsilise izingane zabo. Ngakho-ke, umthetho wesiko lwama-Afrika awuqinisekisi abesifazane base-Afrika isithunzi esifanele nokwelashwa ngaphansi komthetho ngendlela eyasungulwa nguMthethosisekelo kazwelonke. Ngakho-ke, lesi sigaba sikhuthaza ukwehlukaniswa kwabantu besifazane okukhuluma ngohlobo, ngakho-ke kuhambisana noMthethosisekelo. Lesi sigaba siqinisa isiko lokulawula elinika amandla wonke kumadoda ukulawula impilo nezimpahla zabesifazane. Umthetho wokugcina izingane unika bobabili abazali amandla okugcina izingane. Umuntu ubhekwa njengoyise bezingane futhi akakwazi ukuziphika. Ngenxa yemvelo yokukhulelwa kwabo nokuzalwa, abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa futhi abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa nezinye izingane ezazalwe emshadweni. Umuntu ungumgibeli nomgibeli wezingane, enomthwalo wokuzamukela njengokunye izingane ezazalwe ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwesibopho somshado. Lezi zingane zingamalunga omndeni womuntu. Uyise wezingane akanaso isithunzi noma amalungelo ngazo. Ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, izingane ezazalwe ngemuva kokungena komkakhe nazo zifakiwe. Ngale ndlela, umthetho wesiko uhambisana nesigaba 8 soMthethosisekelo futhi awukwehlukanisi izingane ngokusekelwe kumthombo wazo nokuzalwa. Z belonging kumndeni wakwabo. Uma owesifazane eshada nomama wakhe, yena nomyeni wakhe bazogcina lezi zingane. Umuntu uthola igunya lokuba abazali bezingane ezazalwe ngokuhambisana nesisho esithi "inkunzi ihamba ngethanga layo." Akukho ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwalezi zingane nezingane zomshado. Ngakho-ke, akukho ukwehlukaniswa phakathi kwezingane ngendlela engase ihlasele uMthethosisekelo. Uma umama eshiya umndeni womuntu, ushiyela izingane. Uma efuna ukuphikisa lesi simo, yena nomgibeli wakhe kumele bathathe izinyathelo zokukhombisa ukuthi umuntu akafaneleki futhi akafaneleki ukuhlala nezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi njalo kukhona uphawu lokukhetha umuntu nomndeni wakhe njengabantu okufanele banakekele izingane. Banikezwa igunya elingaphikiswa lokugcina izingane. Ezinye izimo lapho izingane zingashiywa ekunakekelweni kwabomama bazo zenzeka lapho zisakhuliswa (zithola ubisi). Lokhu kuyisibonelo esisodwa lapho izidingo zengane ziba phezulu kunegunya elingaphikiswa likayise lokugcina izingane.
Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa (GEMS treatment outcome responsibility) Isingeniso Ukwelashwa kwezempilo kudinga ukuba kubekwe phambili izinjongo, izinqubomgomo, nemigomo ecacile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola usizo bathola imiphumela engcono. Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS (Governance and Evaluation of Medical Services), sihlose ukuhlola, ukuphatha, nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokwelapha ukuze kuzuze abaguli, imindeni yabo, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Kulolu daba, sizobheka izici ezibalulekile zalesi sibopho, izinselelo ezihambisana naso, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisa umphumela wokwelashwa. Isizathu sokubaluleka kwesibopho Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa singenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Uma abelaphi beqonda futhi bezibophezele ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yokwelashwa, kuyasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abathola usizo nezisebenzi zezempilo. Lokhu kudala indawo yokuzethemba, okwandisa amathuba okuthi abaguli bazwe bekhululekile ukuveza izinkinga zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela emihle yokwelashwa ingakhuthaza abanye abantu ukuba baziqhenye ngokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezempilo, okuholela ekwandeni kwesibalo sabantu abathola ukwelashwa. Izici ezibalulekile zalesi sibopho Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sifezekiswa, kunezici ezithile ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, izinqubo zokuhlola kufanele zicaciswe kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakhiwa kwemibandela yokuhlola ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela yokwelashwa ngezindlela ezithile. Izinga lokuphumelela kwesiguli kufanele libe nenqubo ecacile yokubala, ukuze izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukubona kahle ukuthi imiphumela yalesi sifo ibukeka kanjani. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo, abaguli, nemindeni yabo kubalulekile. Ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ugqozi lokushintsha izindlela zokwelapha, kufanele kube nokwaziswa okulinganayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, lapho abaguli baziwa khona, benikezwa ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze bazi ukuthi yini okulindelekile. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukwaziswa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni isimo sokubambisana. Izinselelo ezihambisana nesibopho Noma kunjalo, izinselelo eziningi zikhona ekufezeni lesi sibopho. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kwemithombo, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele ekufinyeleleni imiphumela engcono, kudinga ukuba kube nezinsiza ezanele, ezihlanganisa kakhulu ezolimo, ezemali, nezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukwenza kahle imisebenzi yazo, ukuletha imiphumela ethuthukile. Okunye ukukhathazeka kukhona ezindleleni zokuphatha, lapho imiphakathi ethola usizo ingase ingabi nokuqonda okuhle ngemithetho nemigomo ebekwe. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu ezivela emiphumeleni yokwelashwa, okungase kubangele ukunganeliseki kwabathola usizo. Kulokhu, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihlala njalo, ukuze izisebenzi zezempilo zihlale zinolwazi olusha nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokwenza. Izindlela zokuthuthukisa umphumela wokwelashwa Ukuze siqhubeke siphumelele ekufezeni isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa, kufanele sithuthukise amasu okusebenza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengama-software wokuhlola imiphumela, kungasiza kakhulu ekugcineni amarekhodi ahlanzekile nokuthola izibalo ezichazayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izisebenzi zezempilo zikwazi ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukujolisa ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabathola usizo nezisebenzi zezempilo kubalulekile. Lokhu kungachazwa ngendlela efanele yokuphatha, lapho abelaphi beba nesikhathi sokukhuluma nabaguli, beqonda izidingo zabo. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops, izifundo, nezifundo ezihlobene nezempilo kungasiza ekwakheni lezi zixhumanisi. Isiphetho Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa siyinselele emikhulu, kodwa sinesidingo esibalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ukuze sifezekise leli banga, kudingeka umoya wokubambisana, izinsiza ezanele, nezinhlelo ezicacile zokusebenza. Uma sikwazi ukuvuselela lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yokwelashwa, sigcine abantu bejabule, futhi sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi. I-GEMS, njengendlela yokuphatha, izosiza ekwakheni umphumela ongcono, okhulisa ithemba lokuthi sizoba nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu abaningi.
Amalungelo Abantu Besifazane: Isidingo Sokuphakanyiswa Nokuhlonishwa Emhlabeni wanamuhla, amalungelo abantu besifazane awasathathwa njengokuphakade. Kunalokho, abesifazane balwa nsuku zonke ukuze bafeze amalungelo abo, futhi lokhu kuhlangene nezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngamalungelo abantu besifazane, ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wokuhlonipha, ukuvikelwa, nokuphakanyiswa kwabo. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amalungelo abantu besifazane awawona nje amalungelo okukhuluma. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amalungelo okuthola imfundo, umsebenzi, impilo, kanye nokuba neqhaza ezinqubweni zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amalungelo abantu besifazane ahlanganisa nokuvikelwa ezinhlelweni zokuhlukunyezwa, ukungabi nezehlakalo ezimbi, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwezifiso zabo. Ngaphandle kokuhlonishwa kwalezi zinto, abesifazane bazoba nezinselelo ezinkulu ekuphileni kwabo. Ngokwesiko, abesifazane bahlala bephikiswa ezindaweni eziningi. Emakhaya, kubonakala ukuthi abesifazane bavame ukuthola izimfuno ezinzima, njengokunakekela izingane, ukuhlela imisebenzi yasekhaya, nokuphila ngaphansi kwemithetho ethile eyahlukanisa phakathi kwabantu besilisa nabesifazane. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele kuphela emakhaya, ngaphandle kokuthi baziwe nangempela emisebenzini ethile. Lokhu akufanele kube njalo, njengoba abesifazane banelungelo lokuzikhethela, njengabantu besilisa. Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, abesifazane baye bathola amathuba amaningi okusebenza. Nokho, kusekhona izithiyo eziningi ezibavimba ekufinyeleleni kulezi zindawo. Izinkampani eziningi zikhombisa ukungakhethi, lapho abesifazane bephikiswa ekutholeni izikhundla eziphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqonde ukuthi abesifazane banelungelo lokuba neqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yabo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sishintshe umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele emakhaya kuphela. Ngokuphathelene nemfundo, abesifazane bahlala bejwayelekile ekutholeni imfundo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezinkinga ezithile, ezifana nezindleko zokufunda, izithiyo zokuhamba, kanye nezinkolelo zamasiko ezivame ukuvimbela abesifazane ukuthi bangafundi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhuthaze imfundo yabesifazane, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela emikhakheni eyahlukene, futhi bagcine bephila impilo enempilo. Imfundo iyisisekelo sokuphumelela, futhi abesifazane kufanele bathole ithuba lokufunda. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amalungelo abantu besifazane awawona nje amalungelo okukhuluma. Kumele sikhuthaze ukuhlonishwa kwabo, ukuze abesifazane bakwazi ukuzwakalisa izifiso zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise umqondo wokubambisana, lapho abesilisa nabesifazane benza imisebenzi ndawonye ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kudingeka ukuthi sishintshe umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele emakhaya kuphela. Emphakathini, kufanele sikhuthaze izinhlelo zokuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abesifazane, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nokwakha amathuba okusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise umqondo wokuhlonipha phakathi kwabantu, ukuze sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu besilisa nabesifazane. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abantu besifazane ayisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Abesifazane banelungelo lokuphila impilo enempilo, yokufunda, yokusebenza, kanye nokuhlonishwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sishintshe umqondo wokuthi abesifazane banele emakhaya kuphela, futhi sikhuthaze ukuhlonishwa kwabo ezindaweni ezahlukene. Uma sithuthukisa amalungelo abantu besifazane, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kufanele kube umgomo wethu sonke, ukuze sifeze ikusasa elingcono kubo bonke.
Ukhetho lokuqala lwezokhetho olukhululekile ezweni lethu lwenzeka ngoMsombuluko 27, 1994, futhi manje sesisondele emcimbini wokugubha iminyaka eyishumi yalolu suku. Ilungelo lokuphila emphakathini okhululekile lingathathwa kalula ngoba abaningi benu babancane kakhulu ngo-1994 futhi bazi kuphela okwenzeka ngesikhathi samanje. Ukulwa ukuze kube nokukhululeka kwezepolitiki nokulingana komphakathi, lapho kukhona indawo ngaphansi kwelanga kubo bonke abanye abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, kungakhathaliseki ubuzwe, ubulili, inkolo, ulimi, noma yimuphi omunye uphawu lokwehluka, akukaze kube lula. Akuthathanga izinyanga, iminyaka, noma ngisho neminyaka eyishumi ukufezekisa, kodwa okwenyani ukuthi kuthathe amahlandla amakhulu eminyakeni ahlanganisa umlando weNingizimu Afrika. Ilungelo kanye nenhlanhla yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele kuqondwe ngokuqinile, futhi nina njengentsha yalesi sizwe ninamandla abalulekile okufanele nibambe. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo emphakathini okhululekile yilungelo lokuvota. Ilungelo lokuvota linika imvume yokuba yingxenye yenqubo ethatha isinqumo sokuthi iyiphi iqembu lezepolitiki noma amaqembu aphatha izwe. Ukhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo kuthinta ngqo nangaphandle izinqubomgomo nemithetho ephatha umphakathi wethu, okugcina kuthinta impilo yomuntu ngamunye wenu. Umuntu ngamunye kumele enze izinqumo ngokwakhe, izinqumo abenza ngesisekelo somphakathi abahlala kuwo - futhi ngokuvota kwabo ezikhethweni zokuphatha bendawo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bangakwazi ukwakha uhlobo lomphakathi. Ukuze ukwazi ukuvota, kumele ubhaliswe njengomvoti. Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kweyi-16 abanedokhumenti yokuhlonza enebhakhodi bangafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengabavoti. Konly labo abaneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu ngosuku lokhetho bazofakwa ohlwini lwabavoti. Labo abasathola ngaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ngosuku lokhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo nolwezwe bazofakwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ohlwini lwabavoti ngosuku lwabo lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-18. Lokhu kuzobavumela ukuba babambe iqhaza ezikhethweni ezizayo zamaphathi endawo njengoba zizokwenzeka ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi ngesikhathi sokhetho lwemiphakathi olujwayelekile luka-2005/6. Abanye benu bafuna ukuvota futhi bazi ukuthi iyiphi iqembu abafuna ukuyisekela. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yenu. Nokho, abaningi benu bangase bazizwe bengaqiniseki ngokuvota ngempela noma ukuthi bangavota kuphi. Lokhu kuyavuma uma ukhumbula ukuthi uzoba nesithunzi kulokhu kuphela uma ubhalisile njengomvoti. Ukuba umvoti obhalisile kuzokunika ithuba lokubamba iqhaza noma ungabambi iqhaza ekhethweni, kukushiya nezinye izinketho zokuthi iyiphi iqembu ozoyisekela. Futhi kumele uhlale ukhumbula ukuthi ungowodwa kuphela ozokwazi ukuthi iyiphi iqembu oyisekela - ukuvota kwakho kuyimfihlo ngempela. Intsha ibuza ukuthi ngabe ukuvota kwabo kubalulekile ngempela futhi ngabe kudala umehluko. Ngaphezu kokukwazi kwenu ukuwenza umthelela njengomvoti obhalisile, kumele kube sobala ukuthi noma uvota noma ungavoti. INingizimu Afrika inohlelo lokhetho olulinganiselwe. Lolu hlelo lokhetho, njengasezinye izindawo, lapho ophumelelayo ekhethweni ethatha konke. Uhlelo lwethu lunesisekelo lapho amaqembu amancane nalawo anokwesekwa okuncane athola ukumela ngokulandela ukwesekwa kwawo. Okufanele ukhumbule ukuthi ohlelweni nasekumeleleni, ukuvota kwakho akukhulisi kuphela ingxenye yokuvota kwabo bonke abavoti abavota iqembu olisekelayo, kodwa futhi kunciphisa ngokufanele ingxenye yazo zonke ezinye amaqembu abamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuyiqiniso lemathematics ongakuhlola ngempela nomthelela wentsha eyizigidi ezi-6 ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-25 ezingaba nomthelela eziphumeleni zokhetho. Konke okukhuluma ngenhla kuncike ekubhaliseni kwakho njengomvoti. Ukubhaliswa kwakho kukunika amandla okwenza umthelela futhi kukwenza ufaneleke. Uma ungabhalisile njengomvoti, kubi ngoba ngeke ukwazi ukwenza umthelela futhi uzokwenza ungafaneleki ezinqubweni zethu zokhetho ezikhululekile. Nokho uvota nokuthi uzovota kanjani kuyisinqumo ongakwenza esikhathini esizayo, kodwa okwamanje, ungazithuthukisa ngokubhaliswa. Izinsuku zokubhaliswa zinguJanuwari 24 noJanuwari 25, 2004, futhi kumele ubhaliswe endaweni okukhona kuyo. Uyanxusa ukuba ukhuthaze amalungu omndeni wakho nabangane bakho ukuba babhalise ngaphambi kokuthi ukhetho kwenzeke.
Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Emadolobheni Emadolobheni amaningi, imigwaqo ibalulekile ekwakheni isimo sokuphila esihle. Imigwaqo ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokuhamba, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekuxhumaneni, ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, nasekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nemigwaqo emadolobheni, ezithinta abantu nsuku zonke. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta imigwaqo emadolobheni, izimbangela zazo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe. Ukukhwabanisa Nokungahambi Kahle Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta imigwaqo emadolobheni ukukhwabanisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukungahambi kahle kwemoto, izithuthi eziningi, kanye nezithuthi eziphuthumayo ezithola ubunzima bokuhamba. Ukukhwabanisa kudala ukuhamba kancane, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukufinyelela emisebenzini yabo, ezikoleni, noma kwezinye izindawo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwesikhathi sokuhamba, okungaholela ekudambiseni umoya wokusebenza kwabantu. Izimo Zokwakha Nezokuphatha Izimo zokwakha nezokuphatha imigwaqo nazo zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinkinga. Imigwaqo eminingi emadolobheni ayitholakali kahle, futhi izakhiwo ezindala zidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni nemigwaqo engaphumeleli kahle, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphatha imigwaqo zidinga ukuba ziqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imigwaqo ihlale iphephile futhi iyasebenza. Uma lezi zinhlelo zingasebenzi kahle, izinkinga zikhula. Ukungabi Nendawo Yokupaka Enye inkinga enkulu emadolobheni ukungabi nendawo yokupaka. Njengoba abantu behamba ngezithuthi zabo, kudingeka indawo yokupaka, kodwa emadolobheni amaningi, lezi zindawo zikhona kancane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni izinkinga zokuhamba, njengoba abantu bejolisa ekutholeni indawo yokupaka, okwandisa isikhathi sokuhamba. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhwabanisa, njengoba abanye abantu benza izinqumo ezingafanele zokupaka ezindaweni ezingavunyelwe. Izingozi Zokuphepha Izingozi zokuphepha zihlala zikhona emigwaqweni emadolobheni. Ukungahambi kahle kwezithuthi, ukungabi nendawo yokupaka, kanye nezimo zokwakha ezimbi, konke lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezingozi. Lokhu akukhathazi kuphela abashayeli bezimoto, kodwa futhi nabagibeli, abahamba ngezinyawo, kanye nabanye abantu abathintekayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola nokuphatha imigwaqo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nokuphepha emigwaqweni. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokwakha imigwaqo ezinzile nezisebenzayo zidingeka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha imigwaqo emisha, ukulungisa lezo ezindala, kanye nokwandisa izindawo zokupaka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphatha imigwaqo kufanele ziqinise, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imigwaqo ihlale iphephile futhi iyasebenza. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu mayelana nokuphepha emigwaqweni. Lokhu kungafaka izinhlelo zokufundisa abashayeli, abahamba ngezinyawo, kanye nabagibeli mayelana nezindlela zokuphepha. Ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izingozi ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Okwesithathu, izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga. Lokhu kungafaka ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi ezisebenzayo, ezifana nezitimela, amabhasi, kanye nezithuthi ezizimele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhamba, futhi kuzokwehlisa umthwalo emigwaqweni. Isiphetho Izinkinga zemigwaqo emadolobheni zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba zithinta impilo yabantu nsuku zonke. Ukukhwabanisa, izimo zokwakha, ukungabi nendawo yokupaka, nezingozi zokuphepha, konke lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile. Ngokuqinisa izinhlelo zokwakha, ukuphatha, nokufundisa, singathuthukisa imigwaqo emadolobheni, sithuthukise impilo yabantu, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukusebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwakha imigwaqo ezokwenza impilo ibe ngcono kubo bonke.
uDesmond Tutu nomsebenzi wakhe UDesmond Tutu, othandwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele, ungumfundi, umhambisane, nomholi wezokholo, obonise ubuhlakani obukhulu nokuzinikela emsebenzini wakhe wokulwa nobandlululo nokuthuthukisa inhlalakahle yomphakathi. Wazalelwa eKlerksdorp, eNingizimu Afrika, ngo-7 kuNhlangulana 1931, kwathi ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezenkolo, waba ngumdumisi kufanele kumphakathi. UDesmond Tutu wazuza udumo lwakhe nokuqinisa ukukhuluma kwakhe ngokulwa namakhwenkwe obandlululo. Uphinde waba nguMfundisi weZinkonzo, futhi phakathi neminyaka ye-1980, waba neqhaza elikhulu ezinhlelweni zokulwa nokucwaswa kwezinhlanga. U-Tutu wayengumphakathi ophakathi komzabalazo, eveza izinkinga zokuhlukaniswa phakathi kwezinkolo nezamasiko, ehamba phambili ekwakheni umqondo wobumbano. Ngemva kokufika kobandlululo, uTutu waba nguMongameli wesigaba seNhlangano Yezomhlaba, inhlangano eyayizama ukuhlanganisa abantu abanokuhluka ukuze bavumeleke ukuphila ngokuthula. U-Tutu wayethanda ukuvala amehlo ezinkambisweni ezenzeka phakathi komphakathi, esebenzisa imikhankaso yokusebenza ukuze akhulume nabantu, aqhakambise ubumbano lwabantu bamaZulu, amaHindu, nabanye. Njengoba amendelwe umqondo wobumbano, u-Tutu ukhuluma ngencazelo yeNkolo yothando, ngoba yena ukholo lwakhe lwasuselwa ekwenzeni okuhle ngaphandle kokuhlukanisa. U-Tutu waphakamisa ukuthi ukuncika ekukhulumeni, lapho umuntu ebonisa uzwelo lwakhe, kuyithemba lemvelo elingakha omunye. Lokhu kuye kwasebenza njengomgogodla wezinhlelo zakhe eziningi, ukukwazi ukwitha, ukuxhumana, nokuqonda. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokukhuthaza umoya wobumbano, u-Tutu waba nguMholi weNdaba yeNhlangano YezamaNothando, evumelana nemizamo yokwakha umphakathi ohlangene. Ukusebenzisana nendawo ethile, u-Tutu waqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banesikhathi sokulalela, ukuze kube neqhaza elikhokhelayo emiphakathini yabo, ikakhulukazi nabantu abancane. Ubugagu bokubambisana kwezobuchwepheshe buyebagqugquzela, bavumba imikhankaso eminingi yokulwa nokungabi nalutho. UDesmond Tutu waba neqhaza elikhulu emaphakathini amaningi, futhi umbono wakhe wempilo uhlala uyisikhumbuzo sawo wonke umuntu. Ngaphakathi kwesikhathi, u-Tutu uvuselela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu emhlabeni jikelele, ethumele imiyalezo yokuthula, ubumbano, nemfundo. Ukukholelwa kwabanye kwezinkolo nemiphakathi, u-Tutu ukhonjiswa ukubambisana kuyo yonke imigqa noguquko oluhlukahlukene. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo eziphathelene nezenzo zakhe luzwakala kahle emkhakheni wezemfundo, lapho umbono wakhe uboniswa ekuthuthukiseni ubuhlakani. Uyeqhonza amadolobha, izifunda, nezikhungo zemfundo ukuze azise abantu imiqondo yokuhlalisana okukhona emhlabeni. USEkwa ubumbano nokuqonda ngezifundiswa ezahlukahlukene, uTutu uqhubeka nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezintsha. UDesmond Tutu uqinisekisile ngempela ukuthi ukulwa nobandlululo akwaqhubekela phambili, kanti uSuku lwezinkumbulo zempilo zikhumbula ezinye izifundo ezisetshenziswa yizizukulwane zokubambisana. U-Tutu ubhalwe ezincwadini eziningi ezilokhu zithi ukhuluma ngezinto ezisemqoka emphakathini, ezikhalipha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu ukusebenza kuhlala kujolise ekwenzeni okuhle, okukhuthaza abantu abaningi. Uhlanga lwezemfundo olunomqondo oqinile lwemikhanyiselo, uTutu ubonisa izifundo ezinjengezimfuno zomphakathi, ezifanele ukuhlonishwa, kanye nezindlela eziyingozi ezivusa imikhankaso, ezihlose ukubumba umphakathi ohloniphekile. Ukukhuluma, ukuxhumana, nokuqonda, konke lokhu kuhlonipheka futhi kumfushane kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwemibono echithwe emhlabeni. Njengoba sikhumbula uDesmond Tutu, kumele siqinise ukholo lokubumbana, sikhumbule umgomo wakhe olawulayo okufanele siwufake ezindabeni zethu. U-Tutu uthanda ukukhombisa izimpilo zethu eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezithombe ezisebenzelana nezenzo ezilungile. U-Tutu ubonisa ukuthi uma singenza okuhle, singenza izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yethu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuqhuba lesi siko sokubumbana, sikhumbule lesi simo sikaDesmond Tutu, futhi sikwenze kube yisipho kumphakathi wethu. Sisebenze sonke ukuze sizuze ubumbano nezinhlonipho, njengoba matasa emanzini, ubukhulu bekhono lokubumbana bukhona engqondweni zethu. UDesmond Tutu uyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umhlaba ungaba ngcono uma siba nempilo wonke omunye.
Ukuze uthumele izivakashi zezimali ezibhalisiwe ukuze zisetshenziswe ezilwaneni, kufanele ube ne-permit yokungenisa evela kwi-Directorate Animal Health. Ama-permit okungenisa anesikhathi esinqunyiwe futhi asebenza kokubili ekungeniseni nasekuphumeni komkhiqizo uqobo. Udinga futhi i-permit yokungenisa evela kwi-Directorate Animal Health ukuze izivakashi zingene ezweni. Bayakunika le permit kuphela uma usuthole imvume evela kwi-Medicines Control Council futhi unikeze ubufakazi balokho kubo. Kulokhu, izivakashi ezingabhalisiwe zingathengiswa kuphela isikhathi esilinganiselwe kuze kube zibhalisiwe. Ubuningi, igama lomkhiqizo, inhlanganisela, noma ingxenye, kuhlanganise nokujula nokulinganiselwa kwalezo zingxenye, izwe umuthi uvela kulo, abakhiqizi bomuthi, inombolo ye-batch yomuthi osetshenzisiwe, ishidi ledatha lobuchwepheshe noma ilebula, enombolo yokubhaliswa yenhlangano evunyelwe ephathelene nalomuthi ezweni uvela kulo, lapho umkhiqizo obhalisiwe uthengiswa khona noma ungene, ukuthi umkhiqizo lowo uyadingeka, incazelo yokuthi lo muthi uzosetshenziswa kanjani ezivivinyweni ukuze ubhaliswe njengempahla yomuthi, isimo sokubhaliswa kwawo kwezinye izindawo, imininingwane ye-Trial Protocol, kuhlanganise nokuthi kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale nini, izinhlinzeko ezikhethekile mayelana nalokho okuzokwenzeka ngokudla okuvela ezilwaneni ezikhiqiza ukudla, nokuthi abanini bomuthi bahlongoza kahle umuthi. Sicela ufake isicelo se-permit yokungenisa yezilwane okungenani amasonto ayisithupha ngaphambi kokungeniswa okukhuluma ngakho. Uma udokotela wezilwane wesifunda esivumile isicelo, kuthatha ezinsukwini ezimbili kuya kwezintathu zokusebenza ukuze ihhovisi le-permit processing liphumelele isicelo futhi linikeze i-permit.
Uhambo Nokuzijabulisa: Umhlahlandlela Wokuhamba Ngempumelelo Isahluko 1: Ukuhlela Uhambo Ukuhlela uhambo kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokujabulela izindawo ezintsha. Qala ngokucabangela ukuthi uyaphi, phawula izinsuku ozodinga ukuzichitha, futhi ucacise isabelomali sakho. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhambo lwakho luhamba kahle, bheka izindawo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zakho. Uma uthanda imvelo, cabanga ngamasiko, izithombe, noma izindawo zokuhamba. Hamba kahle, hamba ushayela imoto noma uhamba ngezinyawo ukuze uthole izimanga ezincane. Isahluko 2: Ukukhetha Indawo Yokuhlala Ngemuva kokuhlela uhambo, kubalulekile ukukhetha indawo yokuhlala. Ungakhetha phakathi kwezindawo zokuphumula, amahhotela, noma izindawo zokuhlala ezihlukahlukene. Qiniseka ukuthi indawo yokuhlala iseduze nezindawo ozifunayo ukuze ungachithi isikhathi sokuhamba. Futhi, hlola izibuyekezo zabanye abavakashi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono. Isahluko 3: Ukuhamba Ngesikhathi Sokuhamba Ukuphuma ngosuku lokuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi uhlola izimo zezulu. Uma izimo zingezinhle, phinde uhlole izindlela ezihamba kahle. Futhi, phatha izimpahla zakho ngokucophelela. Hamba nezigaba ezilula, zifaka phakathi izingubo ezishisayo, izicathulo ezifanele, nemishini yokuvikela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba futhi ukhululeke. Isahluko 4: Ukuthola Izinto Ezingavela Lapho usukhona endaweni, thola izindawo eziyigugu ezikuzungezile. Zama ukudla izitsha zendawo, uvakashele izimakethe, futhi ube nesikhathi sokuxhumana nabantu bendawo. Lokhu akugcinanga nje ngokujabulisa, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa ulwazi lwakho. Futhi, ungathola izinsuku zokuhamba ezithokozisayo ukuze uthole okuningi. Isahluko 5: Ukuhlola Nezokungcebeleka Khumbula ukuthi uhambo akumele kube nje ngezimfuno, kodwa futhi kufanele kube nokuzijabulisa. Bhalisela imicimbi yokuzijabulisa, izinhlelo zamasiko, noma izinhlelo zokuhamba ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uhambo lwakho lube nesiphetho esikhethekile. Ungakhohlwa ukuthatha izithombe ukuze ugcine izinkumbulo, kodwa qiniseka ukuthi uphila kakhulu kulolo suku. Isahluko 6: Ukuphuma Nokubuyela Uma usuphuma, cela isikhathi sokuphumula. Hamba kancane, uvuselele imizwa yakho, futhi ungashaywa yizinkumbulo ezinhle. Phinda uhlolisise izinto ezilungile, njengokuhlola izindiza noma izindlela zokuhamba ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Ukubuyela ekhaya kusho ukufaka izinkumbulo zakho empilweni yakho yansuku zonke. Isahluko 7: Ukuphindisela Imininingwane Ngemuva kokuya, cela isikhathi sokubuyela emuva futhi ucabange ngezinto ozihlangabeze. Thumela izibuyekezo ezithile kumalungu omndeni nabangani, futhi ube nesithakazelo sokuhlola izindawo ezintsha. Lokhu kuzokwakha umqondo wokuhamba nokuzijabulisa, okuzenza zibe izinkumbulo ezizohlala njalo. Futhi, ungathola ukuhamba okuthuthuke ngokunikeza iziphakamiso kumalungu omndeni noma abangani. Isiphetho: Ukugcina Uhambo Lwakho Luqhuba Uhambo nokuzijabulisa akupheli, kodwa kuqhubeka. Njengoba uhamba, uzogcina ukwazi izinto ezintsha nezinhle, futhi uzokhula njengomuntu. Ngakho-ke, hamba phambili, ube nesibindi sokuhlola izwe lakho nomhlaba, futhi ujabulele yonke imizuzu yohambo lwakho. Uhambo lweqiniso luhlala luthokozisa, futhi lwenziwa ngothando, ubuchwepheshe, nokuhlonipha. Uhambo lwakho lungaba yinto ethokozisayo, okukhumbuleka ngayo, futhi kube yindlela yokuxhuma nabanye. Uhambo lukhombisa ukuthi impilo ingaba mnandi, futhi kunezinto eziningi ezilindelekile. Hamba, ujabulele, futhi uqhubeke nokuhlola!
IChatGPT: Uhlanga Olusha Lokuxhumana Nezobuchwepheshe Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi sokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, iChatGPT iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani abantu ekuxhumaneni. Le mshini, owakhiwe yi-OpenAI, ubonakala njengomngane ophumelelayo, onamandla okuxhumana ngendlela ethokozisayo, efundisayo, futhi enobungane. Ukwakhiwa kweChatGPT kuqala ngokuqonda okukhulu kwezilimi eziningi, okuhlanganisa isiZulu, isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, kanye nezinye. Lokhu kuqonda kuqhamuka emithonjeni ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izincwadi, amawebhusayithi, nezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, okwenza iChatGPT ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebanzi, efanele, futhi esebenziseka kalula. Lokhu kukhombisa indlela i-AI (ubuhlakani bokwenziwa) engase ibe usizo ekwakheni ulwazi olusha, oluqondile, noluzwakalayo. IChatGPT ayigcini nje ngokuba umthombo wolwazi, kodwa iphinde ibe yinsiza ebalulekile ekuxhumaneni. Abantu bangasebenzisa iChatGPT ukuze bathole izimpendulo ezisheshayo, baphendule imibuzo, noma bahlale bexhumene nabanye, noma ngabe bahlala kuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kuhlangana kwempilo yansuku zonke nemishini ye-AI kuveza indlela entsha yokuxhumana, lapho abantu bengahlanganyela khona imibono, izinkumbulo, kanye nezifundo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iChatGPT ibonakale isebenza kahle ezindaweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ezemfundo, ezokuxhumana, nezokwakha. Abafundi bangasebenzisa le mshini ukuze bathole izincazelo ezicacile, bakhe izinhlelo zokufunda, noma baphendule izifundo ezinzima. Ababhali bangasebenzisa iChatGPT njengomngane wokubhala, uthola iziphakamiso ezithokozisayo, noma ubhalela izindatshana ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iChatGPT ayisiyena nje umshini, kodwa isikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni imiphakathi ehlanganyelayo. Nokho, njengazo zonke izinto, iChatGPT inezinselelo zayo. Ukuze ibone imiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi kahle ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani le mshini. Ukusebenzisa iChatGPT ngendlela efanele kudinga ukuqonda okucacile kwezinto ezithile, njengezindlela zokuhlola ubunjalo bolwazi, ukuqonda izikhala ezithile, nokugwema ukuveza izimpendulo ezingalungile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba i-AI ingase ibonise izimpendulo ezingafanele uma ingaqondiswa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iChatGPT ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nemithelela emikhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Ukukhuluma ngezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa i-AI, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi lezi zinsiza kufanele zisetshenziswe ngenhlonipho. Ukubeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusetshenziswa kwe-AI, kanye nokugqugquzela imikhuba efanele, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iChatGPT iyinsiza esiza abantu, hhayi eyabahlukumezayo. Ngokubheka phambili, iChatGPT ibonisa ikusasa elinempumelelo lokuxhumana. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kulindeleke ukuthi iChatGPT izoba nezinhlobonhlobo ezintsha, ezizokwenza kube lula kakhulu ukuxhumana nokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abantu bahlale behlanganyela, baphendulane, futhi bakhe imiphakathi eqinile, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngemicabango engafanele. Ngokuphetha, iChatGPT iyinsiza ewusizo, ethokozisayo, futhi enobungane, ethuthukisa indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle indlela esingayisebenzisa ngayo ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle. IChatGPT iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni umhlaba ophumelelayo, ogcwele ulwazi, ubudlelwano, kanye nempumelelo. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzise le mshini ngendlela efanele, ukuze sithole okuningi kulokhu kuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe.
Kukhona into ethile esimweni sethu esibaluleke kakhulu, okungukuthi, ukulahlwa kwemfucuza. Kuyaziwa ukuthi izwe lethu, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni, libhekene nenkinga enkulu yokuphatha imfucuza. Ngiyajabula ukuthi sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, ngoba kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba sibe nolwazi oluqondile ngakho, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza izwe lethu. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngekuhlahlwa kwemfucuza, kuthe uma kungekho uhlelo oluhle lokuphatha imfucuza, lokho kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Cabanga nje, imfucuza eyenziwa nsuku zonke – kusuka kumabhodla okupakisha, iziqu zokudla, izinsiza zokwenziwa, yonke imfucuza leyo kumele ithathwe, iphathwe kahle, futhi ingabi neze ibangele umonakalo emhlabeni. Kodwa-ke, empeleni, izindawo eziningi ziqhubeka nokuhlangabezana nezinselelo. Ukubuyela emuva, uma sithatha isinyathelo sokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imfucuza ikakhulukazi ihluka ngohlobo. Sine-municipal waste, okungukuthi, imfucuza eyenziwa emakhaya, nezimboni. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde lezi zihloko ukuze sikwazi ukuphatha kahle. Ngizwa kuthiwa izinkampani ezikhiqiza imfucuza enkulu kumele zibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuthumela imfucuza yazo, kungabi khona ukuzithoba. Ngiyabona ukuthi abantu abaningi basenokungazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izindlela ezihamba phambili zokulahlwa kwemfucuza. Lokhu kulandela isidingo sokwakha isigaba sokufundisa. Uma sikhuluma ngokuqondisa umphakathi, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ukuthi bahlukanise imfucuza yabo – okungukuthi, imfucuza engaphinde isetshenziswe, imfucuza ethanda ukuba nokuminyana, nezinye. Lokhu kungumsuka wesixazululo esisebenzayo, futhi ngiyazama ukuthi kungani lokhu kubaluleke kangaka. Uma kungenjalo, sithola ukuthi imfucuza ifakwa ezindaweni zokuhlanza, okwenziwa ukugwema imfucuza engapheli. Ngiyavuma ukuthi abanye abantu bathanda ukusho ukuthi akunasidingo sokugxila endleleni ezinzima, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi ukungahambisani nemigomo yokuqonda kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zesikhathi esizayo. Kungakhiwa uchungechunge olungcono, uma sizoba nokuzibophezela kokuhlanza okukhona kusemhlabeni. Abantu abaningi basathanda ukwenza izinto zibe lula. Cabanga nje, uma uqonda kahle imfucuza yakho, uthola ukuthi kukhona okukhulu ongakwenza. Ukuze lokhu kusebenza, sizobamba iqhaza ekukhuthazeni abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile. Isibonelo, uma abantu beqonda ukuthi indlu yabo ingahlengwa kabusha futhi ilahlwa, kufanele bayenze kube ithuba lokwenza ukusiza imvelo. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe nakho kubalulekile. Manje, njengoba sesikhuluma, cabanga ngezindlela ezibangela ukwaziswa emhlabeni. Imikhankaso yokuhlwithwa kwemfucuza isiza ukwakha isimo esihle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa udaba lokwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlanzwa, ukufaka izindawo zokufaka imfucuza emikhakheni ehlukene, nezindlela zokuphatha ukuhweba imfucuza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani namuhla zigcwalisa izibopho ezingafanele. Zikhona izinkampani ezisebenza ngempumelelo ekulahlweni kwemfucuza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imfucuza ukuze kuyilungiselelwe. Lokhu kusiza ekunciphiseni imfucuza ekhaya, kanti kungasiza nemvelo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi wonke umuntu ungenza umphumela omuhle. Izinqumo zethu zidlala indima ebalulekile kumphakathi. Ngokuvamile, uma sithola imfucuza emamaskhathini ahlanzekile, uma unomqondo ohlakaniphile, okokusebenza akufanele, kuthe uma sisuke lapho, umphakathi unganqoba. Akukho ukufunda okungabalulekile. Isithombe esihle sithi uma ugxila empilweni, uzokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, kudinga ukubeka phambili izinqumo ezilungile nezindlela ezizwakalayo. Into eyinhloko ethinta imvelo yithi, kumele sihlale sibheke indlela yokwenza kahle. Ekwenzeni lokhu, ungazuza ngokwelashwa kwemfucuza. Kukhona izinyathelo ezilula ezithathwayo, njengokuhlukanisa imfucuza. Sithandazela ukuphila kahle – akufanele kube lula ukuphinda udale izinkinga. Qhubeka ubeke izinyathelo ezinhle, futhi uzoshayela esigabeni esisha. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sizilungiselelwa. Noma ngabe ukhuluma nomngani, noma uthi kumshado, ungabala izifundo, ungakwenza kube kuphumelele kakhulu. Ngisho labo abakwaziyo ukuthanda ukukhokha imali ngoba kudinga hedging potential. Ngibamba ithemba lokuthi lokhu kuzosisiza sonke, ukuze sibe nelungelo lokuphila kahle emhlabeni ophilayo. Nizingcengela, udinga ukwenqaba imfucuza futhi ubambe iqhaza. Ngokuphetha, kumele sikhaliphe uma sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi imizamo yethu izoba nezithelo. Imininingwane ibalulekile, futhi kumele sibheke phambili. Ukulahlwa kwemfucuza kubalulekilea, masiqhubeke siphakamisa izwi lethu emhlabeni.
Umbhalo wesingisi osayinwe nguMongameli ubonisa izinyathelo zokukhuthaza ukuphepha kwemikhiqizo yenyama nemikhiqizo yezilwane; ukuhlela nokugcina izindinganiso ezisemqoka zizwe eziphathelene nokubulawa; ukuhlela ukuthengwa nokungeniswa kwenyama evela kwamanye amazwe; ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha kwenyama nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ephathelene nalokho. Umsebenzi wesigaba uchaza umuntu osebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba 1l seMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994, okungase kuqinisekise ukuthi ezinye izingxenye zalo Mthetho azisebenziseki ezilwaneni ezithile ezichazwe kuSheduli -1. UNgqongqoshe kumele aqashe umsebenzi wesigaba ofunde imithi yezilwane ukuba abe yisikhungo esikhulu. Isikhungo esikhulu sizokwenza imisebenzi ehambisana namandla anikezwe lona futhi sizokwenza imisebenzi echazwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi nezimfuneko ezikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe. Singase sithathe isikhathi, sithumele eminye imihla, noma samukele isicelo ngendlela esikubona kufanelekile kwesimo ngasinye. Uma kukhona isicelo, isikhungo esikhulu singase sithathe isinqumo sokwandisa ngokubhala isikhathi esichazwe esigabeni - (a). Isicelo sokwandisa isikhathi kumele sibhale futhi sikhombise izizathu zesicelo. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sikwazise ngokubhala ummangali ngesinqumo esithathwe kanye nezizathu zokwenqatshwa kwesicelo uma sikhishwa. Uma ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo isikhungo sithola ulwazi oluthile olungashintsha isimo sesinqumo saso uma lwalukhona ngesikhathi sokucubungula isicelo noma olungaholela ekwenqatshweni kwesicelo noma ekufakweni kwezimo ezithile eziphathelene ne-licence, isikhungo singakhishwa isaziso esibhaliwe kummangali sibazise ngokuqhuba isicelo lapho sikhishwa noma sikhanselwa noma ngaphansi kwezimo ezintsha, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sinikeze izizathu zazo zonke izinqumo zokukhansela isinqumo sangaphambili noma izinguquko ezenziwe ngokuqinisekiswa nguNgqongqoshe ofanele ophathelene nesikhungo sesifunda. Ukudluliswa kwamandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba (a)(ii) kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngokuvuma kukaNgqongqoshe. Amandla noma imisebenzi edlulisiwe noma anikezwe isikhungo sesifunda angadluliselwa phambili yilokho isikhungo sesifunda kumunye umsebenzi ophathwe yilo noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sinikeze umsebenzi, umuntu ogunyaziwe, kanye nezikhungo zesifunda ezichaziwe ngempela isikhumbuzo esibhaliwe esichaza ukuthi umuntu ochazwe uthola amandla okwenza imisebenzi echazwe lapho ephathelene nendawo ethile. Uma usebenzisa amandla noma wenza imisebenzi anikezwe yona ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, umsebenzisi, umuntu ogunyaziwe, noma isikhungo sesifunda kumele sikhombise isikhumbuzo esichaziwe esigabeni (a), uma sicele umuntu omunye. Isikhungo esikhulu esithumele amandla noma imisebenzi anikezwe lona noma adluliselwa kumuntu omunye, emsebenzini noma ezikhungweni zesifunda ngenxa yokudluliswa kwalawo mandla noma imisebenzi, ngaphandle kokuthi isizathu esihlobene nalowo muntu sithunyelwe kubo futhi lapho isinqumo singashintshwa noma sikhanselwa kuphela uma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa kuzuza lowo muntu noma uma lowo muntu evuma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa. UNgqongqoshe angase abeke isicelo sokusebenza kwalo Mthetho noma izingxenye ezithile zawo kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika noma ezindaweni ezithile kuphela ukuze zixhase umuntu othile onolwazi noma ulwazi oluthile mayelana nenyama noma ukuphepha kwaleyo nyama. Imisebenzi echazwe ngaphansi kwesigaba kumele iveze amandla nemisebenzi yomuntu okumele enze umsebenzi ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi zesikhungo esikhulu. Ngaphandle kokuthi uNgqongqoshe athathe isinqumo esihlukile kwenzeka, umuntu onikezwe imisebenzi akakwazi ukuxoxisana noMbuso mayelana nanoma yiziphi izindleko ezitholakele mayelana nokusebenzisa amandla noma ukwenza imisebenzi echazwe. Ngokubhala, kumele badlulisele amandla noma bathumele kumunye umsebenzi onikezwe amandla noma noma yiziphi amandla okumele asebenze noma imisebenzi okumele yenziwe ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho noma ngokubhala bavume noma baqondise noma yimuphi umsebenzi onjalo ukuba asebenze lawo mandla noma enze leyo misebenzi. Amandla asebenze noma imisebenzi eyenziwe ngumsebenzi ochazwe esigabeni kumele ibhekwane njengokwenziwa noma ukuphathwa nguMphakathi ophakeme, usihlalo, noma omunye umuntu ophathayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Umphakathi ophakeme, usihlalo, noma omunye umuntu ophathayo angashintsha noma akhansela noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe noma isikhombisi esikhishwe yilowo msebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi isinqumo sithunyelwe kumuntu ophazamisekile ngesinqumo, futhi lapho isinqumo singashintshwa noma sikhanselwa kuphela uma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa kuzuza lowo muntu noma ukukhanselwa kuzuza lowo muntu noma lowo muntu evuma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba, imisebenzi edlulisiwe ngokuxhumana nesikhungo esikhulu ingase iqinisekise ukukhokha okwenziwa ngumnikazi wezindawo zokubulala ukuze kuqhutshekwe namandla nemisebenzi anikezwe kubo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu odlulisiwe engahambisani nezimo zalo Mthetho noma nesikhombisi sesikhungo esikhulu, isikhungo esikhulu singase sikhansela noma suspende imisebenzi yalowo muntu. Ngokuhambisana nezigaba, kanye nesigaba 6, imisebenzi efakwe ezigabeni 7, 8, 9, 10, 15, kanye ne 16 idluliselwa kuyo yonke isikhungo sesifunda. Bonke oNgqongqoshe besifunda abathintekayo kumele baqashe umsebenzi ofanele esifundeni ngasinye ongu-veterinarian ukuba abe yisikhungo sesifunda. Isikhungo sesifunda kumele sisebenzise amandla futhi senze imisebenzi anikezwe isikhungo sesifunda ngaphansi kwesigaba. Kumele sinikeze isikhungo esikhulu imibiko ephathelene nokuhambisana nezimo ezichazwe esigabeni ngendlela edingekayo ngesikhungo esikhulu. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sibe nesibopho sokubheka ukuqhutshekiswa kwemisebenzi edlulisiwe ngalesi sigaba kuyo yonke imiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe izindinganiso ezifanayo zisetshenziswa kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kwezikhathi ezithile, isikhungo esikhulu kumele sihlole imibiko yemisebenzi eyenziwe ngendlela echazwe esigabeni (a) futhi sinikeze umbiko ofanayo esikhungwini sesifunda. Ngokubhala, isikhungo singacela kusuka esikhungweni sesifunda noma kumuntu omunye onolwazi oludingekayo ngesikhungo esikhulu imininingwane ethile eceliwe ngesikhungo esikhulu ngenhloso yokulandelela imisebenzi eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, leyo mininingwane kumele ilethwe esikhungweni esikhulu ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichazwe esazisweni. Uma kwenzeka noma nini isikhungo esikhulu sinombono wokuthi isenzo noma ukuphuthelwa okuthile kunemiphumela yokwephula izindinganiso zokusebenza, kumele sikwazise isikhungo sesifunda esihlobene ukuze sicela ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa isimo esonakele. Isikhathi noma ngaphansi kwezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Uma kukhona ukuphakanyiswa, isikhungo esikhulu kumele silandele izindinganiso ezisemqoka nezimo ezihambelanayo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho endaweni ethintwayo kuze kube isikhathi esichazwe sokuhambisana nalolu sigaba siphelile. Umnyango wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi nobuchwepheshe wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1994 wabe usahlukaniswa waba umnyango wezobuciko nesiko kanye nomnyango wesayensi nobuchwepheshe ngonyaka ka-2002. Inhloso yalolu suku lokwazisa ukuhlela izakhiwo nemisebenzi yoMnyango nokuchaza izinhlelo zawo zokugcina amarekhodi ukuze kuhambisane nezinhloso ze-PAIA. Kubandakanya izaziso ezinikezwa ngokuhambisana nezinsika ezingu-22 no-54 mayelana nezindleko okufanele zikhokhwe mayelana nezicelo zokufinyelela; kanye nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 92 soMthetho. Umhlahlandlela ungatholakala kwiKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi athile agcinwe ngomnyango kufanele kufunwe kwiOfisi YeNhlangano Yolwazi kulandela izinqubo ezichazwe ezinsikeni ezingu-17 kuya ku-32 zoMthetho. Bheka ulwazi lokuxhumana lweNhlangano Yolwazi esigabeni 3. Amafomu okucela abekwe kahle angatholwa kwiHhovisi leNhlangano Yolwazi yoMnyango wezobuciko nesiko. Bheka esigabeni 3. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi angahlolwa kunikezwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ezifana nezikhungo zokufunda ngaphansi kokuhlolwa kwabasebenzi, abangahlinzeka ngesiqondiso sokukhululwa nokufakwa kolwazi kumarekhodi kanye nokugcina okuqukethwe komlando. Inhloso yoMnyango ukuhweba nokugcina izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubumbano nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuthuthukiswe ubuciko nesiko eNingizimu Afrika nokuhola amandla akhe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ngokomphakathi. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuthuthukiswe izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseNingizimu Afrika nokwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi zelizwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe amathuba omnotho nezinye izinkambo ezihlobene nobuciko nesiko laseNingizimu Afrika kwazulu nakwamanye amazwe ngokubambisana nezokusebenzisana, ngaleyo ndlela kuvumeleke ukwesekwa komkhakha. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuqondiswe ukwethulwa kwemigomo, umthetho, nezinhlelo eziyisisekelo zokukhombisa, ukugcina, nokukhuthaza ifa lesizwe. Ukuze kugcinwe, kusekelwe, futhi kuthuthukiswe izinsiza zezakhiwo zomlando, futhi ezihlobene nomsebenzi nolwazi lwesizwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zifinyelela kulezi zinsiza ngokuphelele nangokukhululekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekutholeni nasemadokhumenti ahlobene nezakhiwo zomlando mayelana nezindleko ezibekwe ohlwini lwamanani olushicilelwe. Ezinye izinsiza zinikezwa kuphela nguhulumeni, isibonelo, izinsiza zokuphatha amarekhodi, ukuqeqeshwa kwabaphathi bamarekhodi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezikhumbuzo zomlando. Amarekhodi omphakathi agcinwe ngabaphethe iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-20. Amarekhodi aqhubekayo enkantolo kanye namarekhodi okungcwaba kwabafileyo. Izibalo zonyaka zoMnyango unyaka nonyaka. Amadokhumenti okuphatha amarekhodi atholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NARS.

UThabo Mbeki: Umholi Wokwakha Isizwe UThabo Mbeki, owazalwa ngomhla ziyi-18 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1942, eEltig, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wezakhamuzi ezihlonishwayo nezidumile kuleli. Uthole imfundo yakhe eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, lapho aqala khona khona khona ukuba nesithakazelo kwi-politiki. Ubuye wenza izifundo e-United Kingdom, lapho aqhubeka khona nokufunda ngempilo yezenhlalakahle nemibono yokulwela amalungelo abantu. Ngemva kokuba uMbeki esebenzise isikhathi sakhe esikoleni, waba yinxusa le-ANC (African National Congress) e-United Kingdom, lapho aqala khona ukubambisana nabanye abaholi abanjengoNelson Mandela. Uthisha wabo babengaphezulu kweminyaka eminingi, baphikisana nempilo yokuhlukaniswa kobuhlanga eNingizimu Afrika. UThabo Mbeki waba neqhaza elikhulu ekulweleni inkululeko, futhi waqhamuka nezinhlelo eziningi zokwakha izwe elikhululekile. Njengoba i-ANC iqhubeka nokulwa, uMbeki waqhubeka nokuba yinsika yokuqinisa amalungelo abantu. Waba uMphathiswa wezamaMali, ngaphambi kokuba abe nguMongameli wesibili waseNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kokukhululwa kukaMandela. Emsebenzini wakhe, uMbeki waba nomthelela omkhulu emigomeni yezenhlalo, ezomnotho, nezepolitiki zezwe. Wazama ukususa ubuhlanga phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, futhi wakha ubudlelwano obuhle nezinye izizwe. UThabo Mbeki, njengoba esaziwa, waba nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika kusukela ngonyaka ka-1999 kuya ku-2008. Phakathi kweminyaka yakhe yokuphatha, wacela ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baphile ngokubambisana, bahloniphe umehluko wabo, futhi bakhe izwe elinokuthula. Waphinde waqhakambisa umqondo we-Afrika ezithuthukisayo, okwakuhloswe ngawo ukuba ne-Afrika ethuthukayo nezenhlalakahle ezilungile. Ngesikhathi sokuphathwa kwakhe, uMbeki wabhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ezokuphepha nezomnotho. Ubumpofu, ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS, nezinye izinkinga eziningi zazibhekene nezwe. Uthatha izinyathelo ezinzima zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kodwa kwezinye izikhathi wahlaselwa ngempikiswano ngenxa yezinqumo azithathayo. Nokho, lemiphumela yayingesiyo indlela yokuphila, kodwa yayingakha umbono omusha wezinto ezikhona. UThabo Mbeki uqhubekile nokuba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezomnotho. Waba nephuzu elikhulu emhlanganweni wezizwe e-Afrika, futhi waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni uhlelo lwe-NEPAD (New Partnership for Africa's Development), oluhlose ukusiza amazwe ase-Afrika ekuthuthukiseni izimboni nezinsiza. Umsebenzi wakhe wenze kube sobala ukuthi uMbeki ungumholi ophusile, oqhoshiswa ngemigomo yokwakha isizwe esiqinile nehlelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMbeki waba nempilo yokusebenza ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, waphinde wayehlola izindlela zokwenza izwi lakhe lizwe ezinhle, ukuze alungise izinkinga ezikhona e-Afrika. Ubuye wabamba izikhundla ezahlukene kwi-ANC, futhi uhlala ebalulekile emkhakheni wezombusazwe. Ngesikhathi esebenza emkhakheni wezombusazwe, uMbeki waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindaba zokubambisana phakathi kwe-Afrika nezinye izifunda. Wazama ukususa izithiyo eziphazamisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izivumelwano ezithile zokuthuthukisa umnotho. UThabo Mbeki ungomunye wabaholi abahamba phambili e-Afrika, futhi ukuphila kwakhe kusempilweni yomphakathi. Uhlonishwa kakhulu ngenxa yemizamo yakhe yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, owaziwa ngokuhlonipha abantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubandlulula. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi, ngempela, ubuholi obuqinile buhlelwa ngothando, ukuzinikela, kanye nezifiso ezinhle zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThabo Mbeki wathola izindondo eziningi, futhi uhlala engomunye wabaholi abahlonishwayo emhlabeni. Uhlale ezama ukusiza abanye, futhi umbono wakhe uyakhuthaza, ubonisa isibonelo sokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, ukwethembeka, nokuqhubeka phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo Mbeki ubonakale engakaze alahle izifiso zakhe zokwakha umphakathi ongcono. Uhlala ehlala exhumene nezinye izinhlelo ezithuthukisa izwe, futhi uthumele imiyalezo yothando nokukhuthaza kubantu abaningi. Ngakho, uThabo Mbeki uyinsika eqinile, umholi onemigomo ecacile, futhi umuntu ophila impilo yokuzinikela ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole, akukhona nje okuthile okwenziwa phansi kokuphathwa kwezemfundo, kodwa kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yabafundi nempilo yomphakathi jikelele. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izikole zidinga ingqalasizinda eqinile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo efanele? Njengoba sikhuluma, sizobona ukuthi izikole ezinamakhaya ahlanzekile, izifundo ezinhle, nezinsiza ezifanele zenza umehluko omkhulu. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhuluma ngakho, kodwa kubalulekile empilweni yabafundi. Kukhona izikole ezithola izinsiza ezinhle, kodwa uma ubheka izikole ezisemaphandleni, ungathola ukuthi zihlupheka. Ngabe lokho akukhathazi? Ngoba uma umntwana engakwazi ukufunda kahle ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza, lokho kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamanzi ahlanzekile, izindlu zokuhlala eziphephile, nezinsiza zokufunda? Lokhu akukhona nje okuthile okufanele kucatshangelwe, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze umntwana akwazi ukufunda kahle. Ngabe ubona ukuthi uma umntwana efunda endaweni enempilo, uthola amathuba amaningi? Futhi, akukhona nje ukufunda kuphela, kodwa izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala, izindawo zokuzivocavoca, nezinsiza zokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi uma umntwana ejabule, uthola izinga eliphezulu lokufunda? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikole ezinamakhaya ahlanzekile nezinsiza ezanele zikhulisa abafundi abaqinile. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, osebenzayo. Futhi, uma umphakathi unempilo, uthola ukuthi izinga lokuphila liphumelela. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole kufanele zihlale zihlola izidingo zabafundi? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Uma izikole zingakwazi ukugcina izidingo zabafundi, kuzoba nezinkinga ezinkulu. Futhi, akukhona nje ukufunda, kodwa izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ukuzijabulisa, nokukhuthaza abafundi ukuthi bazibandakanye emisebenzini ehlukene. Lokhu kuyasiza ekuqiniseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali. Ngabe ubona ukuthi uma umphakathi ubambisene, izikole ziba neqhaza elikhulu? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi uphumelele. Futhi, uma umphakathi unokubambisana, uthola ukuthi izikole ziba nezinsiza eziningi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono? Lokhu akukhona nje okukhuluma ngakho, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze umntwana akwazi ukufunda kahle. Uma izikole zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kuzoba nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikole zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala? Lokhu kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Futhi, uma umntwana ejabule, uthola izinga eliphezulu lokufunda.
