Iyini ibhajethi? Ibhajethi uhlelo lokukhombisa ukuthi malini imali engena njengemali engenayo nokuthi izosetshenziswa kanjani phakathi nesikhathi esithile. Thina njengabantu senza izinhlelo eziningi ezihlobene nemali engenayo nendlela esizoyisebenzisa. Ukwakha ibhajethi kubalulekile ngoba noma singafuna ukuthenga izinto eziningi, kakhulu kwesikhathi asinalo imali eyanele yokwenza kanjalo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sinezidingo ezinkulu kanti sinezinsiza ezilinganiselwe zokuthola lokho esikufunayo. Ukwakha ibhajethi kuyindlela ehlakaniphile yokukhetha indlela esisebenzisa ngayo imali yethu. Uma sithenga imali kwenye into, kungenzeka sibe nezinkinga zokuphila ngaphandle kokuthile. Uhulumeni uhlela kanjani ibhajethi yawo? Ngokufanayo, uhulumeni kufanele akhethe. Iminyango kahulumeni kufanele ihlaziye izinsiza ezitholakalayo nezidingo zabantu. Ibhajethi ikhishwa ngokusekelwe ezidingweni ezichaziwe ngonyaka lowo. Ibhajethi yesizwe ibonisa imali elindelwe kuhulumeni kanye nokusetshenziswa kwayo kulonyaka wezezimali, kusukela kuMfumfu 1 kuya kuNdasa 31 konyaka olandelayo. Ibhajethi yesizwe iyingqayizivele ngoba ikhombisa ukuthi imali izosetshenziswa kanjani futhi iphinde inikeze imininingwane yokuthi lezi zinsiza zizotholwa kanjani ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindleko zezwe. Uhulumeni udala kanjani umpoolo wakhe wezezimali? Umthombo omkhulu wemali kahulumeni uvela emalini yokuthola intela. Intela yimali okufanele ikhokhwe ngababambiqhaza, amabhizinisi, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izikhungo ezithintekayo, ethathwa nguMphakathi Wokuthola Imali. Isevisi Yentela yaseNingizimu Afrika (SARS) iphethe ukuqoqwa kwentela. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zentela. Uhulumeni uthola ingxenye enkulu yentela emalini engenayo yomuntu. Wonke umuntu ophuma ngenhla kwenani elithile kufanele akhokhe intela kuhulumeni. Le ntela ibizwa ngokuthi intela yemali engenayo. Ezinye izinhlobo zentela zifaka intela yokwengeza inani (VAT) kanye nezintela zokusetshenziswa ezimpahleni ezisetshenziswa ngaphakathi. Abantu abaningi bazi nge-VAT, futhi ukuthi ezinye izinto eziyisisekelo zikhululiwe kwi-VAT. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kwesinye isikhathi izintela zengezwa ezintweni ezithile zokunethezeka. Le ntela yokusetshenziswa kwezwe ibizwa ngokuthi "intela yokonakalisa." Umthethosisekelo uchaza ukuthi uMongameli kufanele aphathe kanjani imali. Noma iyiphi imali eyamukelwa yizwe ifakwa kwi-akhawunti esetshenziswa kuhulumeni ebizwa ngokuthi i-akhawunti ye-Exchequer. Umthetho wePhalamende usebenza lapho imali ikhishwa kule akhawunti. Noma iyiphi ibhajethi kufanele ibe nezindleko nezimali. Ibhajethi isebenza kanjani? Ibhajethi kahulumeni ihlukaniswe ibe yiMali Engenayo kanye Nezindleko, lapho kube khona ukungabikhona ngaphambi kokuthola izikweletu kanye neMali Yomphakathi. Imali engenayo nezindleko zaziwa nangokuthi i-Akhawunti Yezimali Zombuso. Ibhajethi kahulumeni iqala ngezindleko kanti ezinye ziqala ngemali engenayo. Umehluko phakathi kwemali engenayo nezindleko ubizwa ngokuthi ukungabikhona noma ukusinda. Ukungabikhona kwenzeka uma uhulumeni ehlela ukusho imali engaphezulu kwalokho angakuthola emalini yokuthola intela ejwayelekile. Imali yomphakathi yenzeka uma uhulumeni eboleka imali ngaphakathi noma evela kwamanye amazwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindleko zawo. Uma imali engenayo idlula izindleko, isibonelo, uma imali yokuthola intela eqoqiwe ingaphezu kwalokho okulindelekile, kukhona ukusinda. Kuthatha izinyanga eziyi-14 ukulungiselela ibhajethi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ibhajethi yonyaka wamanje ithunyelwa ePhalamende, ibhajethi yonyaka olandelayo isivele ikhulunywa izinyanga ezimbili. Kunezindawo ezahlukene ezithintekayo ekwakheni ibhajethi. Lezi zindawo zithumela iziphakamiso zabo ezihlobene nezidingo zazo emahhovisi aphakeme afanele. Ihhovisi eliphezulu lihlanganisa umbiko wesifinyezo ngalokhu futhi lilithumele kwiMnyango Wezezimali. IMnyango Wezezimali izokwakha umbiko wesifinyezo obonisa izindleko zeminyango ehlukene. Ihhovisi leMenenja yeMali Yezangaphakathi kanye neHhovisi leMali Yezokuhweba nokuThengiswa nazo zakha izinhlelo zabo zezimali futhi zithumele kwiMnyango Wezezimali. UMphathiswa Wezezimali kanye noMphathiswa Wezokuphatha bahlangana ukuze baxoxe ngeziphakamiso zezimali. Lezi zinkulumo zizothonywa yisimo sezombusazwe, sezezimali, kanye nezomnotho. UDirector-General Wezezimali ulungisa ibhajethi. Ngokuvamile, unyaka nonyaka ngoFebhuwari, uMphathiswa Wezezimali uthumela iBajethi Speech ePhalamende. Ngemuva kwalokho, ibhajethi ixoxwa ePhalamende. Abaphathiswa beMnyango ophakeme badingeka ukuhlinzeka ngezizathu zezimali zeminyango yabo. I-Budget Speech ngokuvamile ilandela ifomethi eyodwa. Iqala ngokubuyekeza imiphumela yezezimali yonyaka odlule, bese ibuyekeza isimo somnotho wezwe, futhi ihlola unyaka wezezimali ozayo. Ikhomba ukuthi imali engenayo nezindleko ezishiwo zizobonwa kanjani. Kuyisiko lomthethosisekelo ukuthi uhulumeni angasebenzisa imali kuphela uma kuvunyelwe yiPhalamende. Ibhajethi ibhekwa njengazo zonke izinqumo okufanele ziqinisekiswe yiPhalamende kuqala ngaphambi kokuba zibe nemiphumela. Ngemuva kokukhuluma komphathiswa, amalungu ePhalamende axoxa ibhajethi bese evota ngayo. Ngemuva kokuba ibhajethi ngayinye ixoxiwe, zombili izindlu zePhalamende kufanele zivote ngayo. Uma ibhajethi ivunywa, leyo Mnyango inganikezwa imvume yokuhamba phambili nohlelo lwayo lwezezimali. Ukuqoqwa kwentela nezindleko kufanele kuphathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imali isetshenziswa ngokuhambisana nenhloso ebekwe yiPhalamende. U-Auditor-General ubika ePhalamende ukuthi ngabe iziqondiso zokuchitha imali zilandelwa yini. Ibhajethi iyithuluzi elibalulekile lempumelelo kanye nesikhali esibalulekile sokubheka, kulandela umgomo wokuphendula kahulumeni mayelana nokuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kanjani.
Okokuqala, umthengi kufanele athumele ukukhala uma enikezwa usizo. Uma enganeliseki ngendlela ukukhala kwakhe kukhishwe ngayo noma umphumela, angakhuphula ukukhala kwakhe kumphathi weposi. Thumela ukukhala kwakho ehhovisi lempathi yeposi kanye nawo wonke amadokhumenti. Abathengi/abasebenzisi bezinsizakalo zezimali bangathumela ukukhala kwabo ngefoni, ngefeksi, ngeposi, noma ngokukuthumela ngogesi. Iyiphi iposi noma inkampani ethutha amaphakheji? Ubani owakhuluma naye ephepheni? Uma kukhuluma ngokukhala okuhambisana nezicelo zokulandela nokutholakala kwephakheji noma into ebhalisiwe, nikeza inombolo yephakheji noma into ebhalisiwe. Umphathi weposi uhlose ukuthuthukisa usizo nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngenkxaso ethembekile ebonakalayo kubo bonke abathengi. Umphathi weposi uyinxenye yoMnyango Wezokuxhumana. Umphathi weposi wasungulwa ngaphansi kweSigaba 3 soMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zeposi No. 124 ka-1998. Inhloso yokulawula umkhakha wezeposi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola izinsizakalo zezimali ezithembekile nezisezingeni. Umphathi weposi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezisemqoka zezimali zikhona kubo bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Phendula ukukhala kwabathengi mayelana nezokusebenza kweposi. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bezeposi bayahambisana noma bayavuma umthetho, kanye nemigomo nemibandela ye-licence kanye ne-sertifikat yesikhumbuzo. Faka isandla ekufezeni ngempumelelo nasekuzikhandleni ekufezeni imigomo yokusebenza yokusiza ngenkxaso ngenkathi ubhekana nezidingo zabantu kuzo zonke izigaba. Lungisa kokubili usizo lweposi olwalulawulwa nolungelulawulwa. Bheka futhi ugcine ukuhambisana nemigomo ye-licence kanye ne-sertifikat yokubhaliswa. Khuthaza intshisekelo yokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezimali mayelana nezimali, inqubekela phambili, nezinga lenkonzo. Khuthaza usizo olujwayelekile oluqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanayo kubo bonke abantu. Inkonzo embi. Ngokwakha amazinga enkonzo okukhuluma ngezikhala. Ukuhamba nokuphothula iposi. Ngokubuyekeza nokwakha kabusha izinsiza zezimali ngokususwa kwezinye izikhungo zezimali ezindaweni eziningi ezineposi ezithunyelwe ezindaweni ezingenayo noma ezincane. Ukulethwa kweziphakamiso ezindlini. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izindlu emkhandlwini zinikezwa izinombolo zokuthola iziphakamiso. Ukukhokha ngezikhwama zezimali. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izikhwama zezimali zithathwa njenge ndawo eyinhloko yokuthola iziphakamiso - azikhokhiwe. Indlela yokuthumela ukukhala. Ukulethwa kwesikhathi. Ukulibazisa ukuthumela, ngokwakha ivolumu yeziphakamiso okufanele iqoqwe ngosuku olwandulela lokuthi zithunyelwe kulabo okufanele bazithathe. Amaphakheji anesisindo esingaphezu kuka-30 kg. Ukuthumela iposi kuyisibopho somuntu othumelayo. Iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe umuntu ongasebenzi enkonzweni yokuthumela iziphakamiso. Yiziphi izimfanelo zomthengi? Ukuthola usizo oluyisisekelo lokuthumela iziphakamiso. Ilungelo lokuthola usizo olwakhiwe kahle nolufinyeleleka ngesikhathi. Ukuthembeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezimali ngesikhathi. Ukutholakala kosizo nezinsiza ezifanele abantu abakhubazekile. Ilungelo lokuthumela ukukhala.
Inyama Yenkomo: Umkhiqizo Wendabuko Nezindlela Zokupheka Sawubona, mngani! Ngifuna ukukhuluma nawe ngento ethokozisayo, inyama yenkomo. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi le nyama ibaluleke kangakanani ezimpilweni zethu, ikakhulukazi emakhaya? Kuhle! Ngizokutshela okuningi. Okokuqala, inyama yenkomo iyinsiza yokudla ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Isetshenziswa kakhulu ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi emakhaya. Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi inyama yenkomo iyingxenye ebalulekile yemishado, imicimbi, kanye nezinsuku ezikhethekile. Akukaze kube nesikhathi esihle sokuhlangana nomndeni nabangani, sithokozisa inyama yenkomo emlilweni. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile uma bephuza inyama yenkomo? Ngikhumbula ngesikhathi sikaKhisimusi, lapho umndeni uhamba phambili, bejabulile, bephuza inyama emnandi. Lokhu akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyisiko elihlanganisa abantu. Ngokwenkolo, abantu bakhuluma ngezinhlobonhlobo zokupheka inyama yenkomo. Uthanda ukwazi ukuthi yini engiyithandayo? Ngiyathanda ukuyigaya, bese ngiyifaka emlilweni. Lokhu kuhambisa izithako ezikhethekile, futhi inyama iba mnandi kakhulu. Abanye abantu bathanda ukuyipheka ngezithako ezihlukene, njengama-sauces e-soya noma ama-chilli. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kahle nezinongo ezithile, okwenza kube nempilo enempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukufaka izindlela ezahlukene zokupheka. Uke uzame i-braai? Uhlanga oluhle lwezikhathi ezijabulisayo! Uthanda ukungena emlilweni, uphonsa inyama, bese ubona ukuthi ikhuluma kanjani. Lokhu kuyajabulisa, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bethu sithanda ukuhamba phambili sithokozisa izivakashi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi inyama yenkomo inezinzuzo eziningi empilweni? Iqukethe amaprotheni amaningi, okwenza kube kuhle emzimbeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma sidla inyama, sithola amandla, futhi sikhula kahle. Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala bejolisa emithini yokudla, kodwa inyama yenkomo iyinsiza enkulu yokuthola amandla. Ngaphakathi kwamasiko ethu, sikwazi ukubona ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile uma bephuza inyama yenkomo. Akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyisiko elihlanganisa abantu. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi ezinye izindawo zinezigaba ezihlukene zokupheka? Kukhona i-bobotie, i-braai, nezinye izindlela ezithokozisayo. Ngabe uzama ukujabulisa umndeni wakho? Ngokuphathelene nezindlela zokupheka, ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bethu sithanda ukuhamba phambili nendlela yokupheka. I-sosati, i-braai, noma i-stew, konke kuyajabulisa. Ngabe uzama ukugcina izithako zakho zihlanzekile? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba sithanda ukudla okuhlanzekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ukugcina inyama yenkomo ibalulekile? Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyayigcina kahle, ukuze igcine ubumnandi bayo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ungayigcina kanjani? Ngabe uphila kahle? Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye bethu sithanda ukuyigcina emanzini, ukuze igcine ubumnandi bayo. Ngokuphathelene nezithako, ngiyazi ukuthi ezinye izimo zidinga izithako ezikhethekile. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi ungathola izithako ezithile ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene? Lokhu kuyajabulisa, ngoba sithola ithuba lokuhlola izithako ezahlukene. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi inyama yenkomo ingasetshenziswa kanjani ezitsheni ezahlukene? Lokhu kuyajabulisa, ngoba sithola ithuba lokuhlola izitsha ezahlukene. Ngabe uzama ukwakha izitsha ezithokozisayo? Ngokugcina, ngiyazi ukuthi inyama yenkomo iyinsiza enkulu empilweni yethu. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi izindlela zokupheka zihluke kakhulu? Lokhu kuyajabulisa, ngoba sithola ithuba lokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela kulolu hambo lokukhuluma ngenyama yenkomo. Ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza sibe nesikhathi esijabulisayo emakhayeni ethu. Hamba kahle, mngani!

Ulwazi Oluqondiswa Nggezwi Ezikhungweni: Ukubuyekezwa Ezikhungweni eziningi zokuqonda, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi luthola indawo ebalulekile, lokho okufana nempumelelo yezenzo zazo. Uhlelo lwezwi oluphathwayo, olunikeza abafundi ithuba lokuthola ulwazi oluqondile futhi oluphuthumayo, luthuthuka kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzobheka izindlela zokusebenza, izinzuzo nezithiyo ezingahlangabezana nomsebenzisi, kanye nemiphumela engokwemvelo ezikhungweni. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi luhlanganisa izinsizakalo ezifana nezinhlelo zokuqonda ngezwi (speech recognition systems) nezinhlelo zokuphendula ngezwi (voice response systems). Lokhu kuhlangene kuveza umqondo wesimanje, lapho abahlanganyeli bengafuni kuphela ukusebenzisa izinkinobho, kodwa baphinde bafune futhi izixazululo ezenzakalayo ezithuthukisiwe. Lezi zinhlelo zisiza abantu ngokudlulisela imiyalezo yabo ngolimi olukhuluma, okwandisa ukuxhumana kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi. Ngokuphathelene nezikhungo zemfundo, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lungaba yinsiza yokufunda ebalulekile. Abafundi bangezelela ukufunda kwabo ngendlela ekhuthazayo, ikakhulukazi uma uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezivumela ukuxhumana okungenalwazi. Isibonelo, abafundi abanezimfuno ezikhethekile bangakusebenzisa lokhu ukuze bathole usizo, okwenza kube lula ukufunda futhi kuzuzwe imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kuveza ithuba lokuthi abafundi bakhule, bakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olukhulu ngaphandle kokuvinjelwa izithiyo ezisemqoka. Ngokubona njengokwasemhlabeni, izinhlelo ezikwi-inthanethi zokuqonda ulwazi ngezwi ziye zandisa indlela esibonelela ngayo ubuchwepheshe. Izikhungo zifanele zihloniphe ukwakheka kobuhlakani bezwi, nje uma zibheka ukuthi izinhlelo zazo zikhona ezinhlelweni eziningi. Lokhu kuyavumelana nezidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundi nabanye abasebenzisi bangakhetha ukuzitshala ekukhetheni izilimi ezahlukene, okwandisa ububanzi besixazululo. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona nezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nezikhungo. Enye yezi zinkinga ezinkulu yi-accuracy (ukunembile) yohlelo lwezwi. Izinhlelo ezithile zingase zingathathi kahle ukukhulumisana, okuholela ekutheni abasebenzisi bakhungathekise. Lokhu kungazwakalisa ukungathokozisi, ikakhulukazi uma kuqhathaniswa nezindlela ezingezelelwe kahle. Njengoba izinhlelo ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqhathaniswe namazinga aphezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi luhlinzekwa kahle. Kodwa-ke, uma uthatha zonke izinzuzo, lokhu kunciphisa ubuhlungu obukhona kwi-interface yomsebenzisi. Abasebenzisi bangathola ngendlela ethulelayo ekuxhumaneni nabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo zithuthuke ngaphakathi ukuze zifeze lesi sihlakalo senhlakanipho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzekwa kokufundisa nezinsiza mayelana nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhumana kwezwi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani futhi bakwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele. Lokhu kudinga ukugxila desde kokuqala balungiselela izinhlelo zesikhathi esizayo. Ukwaziswa ngaphambi kokusebenza komsebenzisi kunciphisa iziphazamiso ezinkulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izikhungo, ezidinga ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezinhle zokwakhiwa kwemiphumela, zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezi zinhlelo. Ekugcineni, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni luveza izikhala zokwenza ngcono, nezintsiza ezinamandla. Lokhu kuthuthukisa indlela esiqonda ngayo ulwazi, siyivumele abantu ukuba bakhule. Ngemva kokuhlaziya izinzuzo nezi zinkinga, kubonakala ukuthi ikusasa likhuluma ngekhono lokuhlanganisa ulwazi lwezwi ukuze sifezekise ukufinyelela okukhulu. Njengoba izikhungo ziqhubeka nokulungelelanisa imisebenzi yazo ukuze zenze kube lula, thina sonke kufanele simethe izwi ekuthuthukiseni. Ngakho-ke, leli thuba lokubuyekezwa lilandelela umqondo wokuthi ukufunda nokuphathwa kolwazi akusikho nje ukuphendula, kodwa ukuhamba phambili kulokho esikufunayo — ulwazi olukhuluma, luhweba, futhi, ngempela, luqhuba imiphumela emihle empilweni.
Uma uhamba ukuyobona udadewenu noma udokotela wakho, chaza ukuthi uhlela ukuba nengane, ikakhulukazi uma unesimo esithinta wena njenge-diabetes, epilepsy, noma isifo senhliziyo. Uma wena nomlingani wakho nindodana, gwema ukuthatha noma iyiphi imithi ngaphandle kokuphakanyiswa udadewenu noma udokotela. Yenza kube yijwayelelo ukuvakashela iklinikhi yabesifazane abakhulelwe noma udokotela wakho. Uma kukhona othile emndenini wakho noma emndenini womlingani wakho owazalwa enesimo esithile sokukhubazeka noma onokukhubazeka kwengqondo, kokubona, noma kokuzwa, cela udadewenu noma udokotela ukuthi akudlulisela iklinikhi yokwelulekwa kwezakhi zofuzo eduze kwakho. Thola ukuphumula okwanele futhi unakekele umzimba wakho ngokucophelela. Thola ulwazi mayelana nokuncelisa. Xhumana neklinikhi noma nodokotela wakho ngokushesha uma uhlangabezana nokopha ezindlini zakho zangasese noma unezimpawu ezilandelayo: ukushisa kwenhliziyo okuqhubekayo, ukuhlinzwa, izinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuvukala kwezinyawo noma imilenze, ukwanda kwesisindo ngokushesha, izinhlungu zesisu, ukuncipha kokukhipha umchamo, noma ukuhamba kwamanzi amaningi ezindlini zakho zangasese. Vakashela iklinikhi noma udokotela wakho cishe ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngemuva kokuba ingane yakho izalwe ukuze uhlole kahle ngemva kokubeletha. Yenza kube yijwayelelo ukuthatha ingane yakho uye eklinikhi yezingane ukuze uhlole njalo futhi uthole ukuvaccine okudingekayo. Xhumana neklinikhi yokuhlela umndeni ukuze uthole ukuthi yini okufanele uyisebenzise ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa.
Ukudla okudayiswa ezikhwameni zokudla ezibekwe ezindaweni zomphakathi kumele kube nenothi ngaphambi kokuthi kudayiswe, okukhombisa amagama ezinto zokudla, ngaphandle kwezimo lapho ilebula (igama lokudla) likhona emkhiqizweni wokudla uqobo. Uma umkhiqizo wokudla uthengiswa ngobuningi (ungabhalwanga), umphakeli kumele ube nelebula (igama lokudla) ngokuhambisana nomkhiqizo wokudla odayiswayo, futhi izinhlamvu zamagama kumele zibe nosayizi ofundekayo kumthengi. Izinhlobo ezithile zokudla zikhululekile ngokuphelele ekubhalweni (igama lakho). Noma iyiphi into yokuphuza ekhulumayo iphethwe nguMthetho Womkhiqizo Wokuphuza, 1989 (Umthetho No. 60 ka-1989). Ilebula (umbhalo) kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo linikeza ulwazi olubalulekile ngaleso sikhathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo ezifanele zilandelwa, kukhona izidingo ezahlukene zomthetho eziphathelene nokubhalwa kokudla njengalezi: Ulwazi lokudla luyadingeka kuphela ezimweni lapho izinhlamvu zembhalo ziqoqa ndawonye futhi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ifomethi yombhalo ibhalwe kahle. Ilebula legama lomkhiqizo kumele libhalwe ngolimi olunye lwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Kumele ifundeke futhi ibonakale futhi akufanele ifihlwe nganoma yini eboniswe. Ukudla okuqukethe ama-additives, ama-preservatives, kanye nezinhlobo zokufaka imibala kumele kubhale igama le-additive, i-preservative, kanye negama le-colorant esetshenzisiwe. Uhlobo lweMonosodium Glutamate (oluyinhlobo yokwakhiwa ethuthukisa ukunambitheka kokudla) kumele lufakwe njengengxenye uma lukhona kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo wokudla. Imikhiqizo yokudla equkethe ama-preservatives kanye nezinhlobo zokufaka imibala zeTartrazine kumele ibhale igama le-preservative noma i-colorant futhi uma kuziwa kuma-preservatives, igama elisebenzayo "i-preservative" kumele libonakale kanye nezinye izithako zokudla ezibhalwe ngohlobo lwazo. Uma umkhiqizo, nakuba uhlose ukusetshenziswa, ungase ube sengozini empilweni yomuntu, izimpawu ezifanele zokuxwayisa kumele zivele kumkhiqizo, isibonelo, emkhakheni one-pressure "umkhakha unengcindezi" kanye "gcinani phansi -50 degrees" noma "Ungawugobi noma uwushise ngemva kokusetshenziswa." Akukho okukhuluma ngempilo okungaqinisekiswa. Amagama "impilo" kanye "nenhlanzeko" akufanele afakwe kumalebula (incazelo yomkhiqizo) njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uqukethe izithako ezinikeza impilo. Uma kuziwa ekuphekeni okujwayelekile okuvela ezitshalweni, amagama "akwenzi umkhuhlane wezinhliziyo" azothathwa njengokukhuluma ngempilo okungafanele. Isitatimende esifana "siphakanyiswa odokotela" akufanele sisetshenziswe njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo waphakanyiswa nguchwepheshe wezempilo (udokotela). Imikhiqizo ephethwe ngokuqinile ngezinga lokushisa nokupholisa kumele ichaze izimo zokugcina. Kumele ibhale izindlela zokusetshenziswa, njengokuncibilikisa, ukufudumeza, ukupheka ukuze ukudla kube usable futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinga elifanele ligcinwa. Ukudla okunezinga eliphezulu lokuphuka kuboniswa elangeni elinokukhululwa kwezinga lokushisa eliphansi ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yakho yokuvikela ngokubulala noma yiziphi izidalwa eziphilayo ezikhona.

IZINHLOKO ZOKUKHOKHA Izindleko zesibhedlela zingakhokhwa ngempahla noma ngekhadi lezokwelapha. Uma isiguli singanemali, kukhona indlela enikezwa uMnyango Wezempilo. Yiba neqiniso uma uhlinzeka ngemininingwane yezempilo. Buza uma kukhona okungaqondi. Buza uma kukhona ofuna ukukwazi okwengeziwe. Gwema izenzo ezingamukeleki nezingeziwe. Zama ukuqonda inkinga yakho. Yazi abasebenzi abakwelapha. Hlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli. Landela imithetho, imithetho, nemigomo yesibhedlela. Khokha izindleko zesibhedlela. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Isingeniso Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021, ezazihlanganisa izigameko zokuphikisana, ukugqugquzela, nokuphikisana nezinsiza, zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zigameko zikhombisa ubunzima obukhona emkhakheni wezomnotho, ezokuphepha, kanye nezokuphatha. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kuzogxila emtheleleni wezibhelu emnothweni, izizathu eziyisisekelo, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqedwe imiphumela emibi. Izizathu zezibhelu Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zenzeka ngenxa yokuhlangana kwezinto eziningi. Ukukhula kwezinga lokungasebenzi, ukungabi nabulungisa kwezomnotho, kanye nezinkinga zempilo yomphakathi ngenxa ye-COVID-19 kwaba nemithelela emibi. Ukudlondlobala kwemali yokuphila nokungabi nezinsiza ezanele, kuhlanganiswe nezinsolo zokuphathwa kabi kwempahla yomphakathi, kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphume emigwaqweni, bephikisa izinqubomgomo zohulumeni. Umthelela emnothweni Izibhelu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuphazamiseka kwezohwebo, ukwehla kokutshalwa kwezimali, kanye nokwanda kokungabikhona kwezinsiza zikhombisa isimo esinzima. Izindawo ezithintekile kakhulu zifaka phakathi izimboni ezincane, ezokuthutha, kanye nezokwakha. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa izinga lokungasebenzi, futhi kwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuthola imali yokuphila. Izinyathelo zokubuyisela emuva Ukuze kuqedwe imiphumela emibi yezibhelu, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zicatshangwe zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukubuyiselwa komnotho: Uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngezinhlelo zokubuyisela emuva ezizothuthukisa umnotho, njengezinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. 2. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni aqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zikhona ukuze kuqedwe izinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo, ezemfundo, nezokuphepha. 3. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi: Ukuze kuqedwe ukungaboni ngaso linye, uhulumeni kufanele ahlale exhumana nomphakathi, abelane ngemininingwane, futhi athathe izinyathelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. 4. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuphepha: Ukuze kuvinjelwe izigameko ezinjengalezi esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo, ezizobandakanya zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Isiphetho Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 ziveze izinkinga ezinkulu ezikhona emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Umthelela wazo ubalulekile, futhi udinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo nezisebenzayo ukuze kuqedwe imiphumela emibi. Ukuze umnotho ubuyiselwe emuva, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, ezinkampanini, kanye nomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umnotho oqinile, onobulungiswa, nolungele ikusasa.
Izinqubo Zokuthunyelwa Kwama-Ambulensi Umuntu: UThando Mthembu Umxhumanisi: UZanele Nkosi UZanele Nkosi: Sawubona, Thando. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukwabelana nami namuhla. Ngifuna sikhulume ngama-ambulensi, ikakhulukazi izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwawo. Kungani lezi zinqubo zibalulekile? UThando Mthembu: Sawubona, Zanele. Ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zibalulekile ngoba ziphatha impilo. Uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo, ukufika kwe-ambulensi ngesikhathi kungasindisa umuntu. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinqubo kumele ziqondwe kahle ukuze zisebenze ngempumelelo. UZanele Nkosi: Ungachaza kanjani kahle ukuthi lezi zinqubo zisebenza? UThando Mthembu: Yebo, izinhlobo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zihlanganisa izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, uma kwenzeka ingozi noma isimo esiphuthumayo, umuntu kufanele afake isicelo sokuthunyelwa kwe-ambulensi. Lokhu kungenziwa ngocingo, ngocingo lwezimo, noma ngezinye izindlela ezitholakalayo. I-call center ibhizinisela kahle futhi inezinhlelo ezilungile zokuhlola isimo somuntu ophuthumayo. UZanele Nkosi: Kukhona yini okukhuluma ngezinhlobo zama-ambulensi? UThando Mthembu: Yebo, kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-ambulensi. Kukhona ama-ambulensi ajwayelekile, ama-ambulensi okubhekelela izimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nama-ambulensi akhethekile adinga ukunakekelwa okukhethekile. Lokhu kusebenza ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomuntu ophuthumayo. UZanele Nkosi: Ngakho, imishini esesimeni se-ambulensi ibalulekile? UThando Mthembu: Impela, imishini ibalulekile. Ama-ambulensi kufanele abe nezinsiza ezifanele, njengezokwelapha eziphuthumayo, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nemishini yokuhlola isimo sempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu ubhekwa kahle ngaphambi kokufika esibhedlela. UZanele Nkosi: Ungakuchaza kahle ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo uma i-ambulensi ifika? UThando Mthembu: Yebo, uma i-ambulensi ifika, abezimo eziphuthumayo bahlola isimo somuntu ngokushesha. Bafaka imishini yokuhlola, bahlinzeka ngosizo lokuqala, futhi bahlola izimfuno zomuntu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baqonde kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze basindise impilo. UZanele Nkosi: Kukhona yini izinselele ezivamile ezibhekene nama-ambulensi? UThando Mthembu: Yebo, kunezinselele ezithile. Ezinye zazo zihlanganisa ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, izinkinga zokuxhumana, noma izinsizakalo ezingahambi kahle. Futhi, izimo zezokuthutha ezifana nezithuthi ezimaphakathi noma izimo ezimbi zomgwaqo zingaphazamisa ukusabela kwe-ambulensi. UZanele Nkosi: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abaqeqeshiwe kwi-ambulensi? UThando Mthembu: Ukuqeqeshwa kubalulekile ngoba abezimo eziphuthumayo kumele babe nolwazi olunembile nokuqonda izindlela zokuphatha izimo ezinzima. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo ukuze baqhubeke nokufunda izindlela ezintsha nezinqubo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bakwazi ukusiza abantu ngendlela efanele. UZanele Nkosi: Njengomphakathi, singasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi? UThando Mthembu: Umphakathi ungafaka isandla ngokwakha ukuqwashisa, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nokuxhasa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ama-ambulensi. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukuqonda kwezingxenye zomphakathi nohlelo lwezokwelapha. UZanele Nkosi: Ngiyabonga, Thando, ngale ngxoxo ewusizo. Ngithokozile ukuthola ulwazi oluningi ngalezi zinqubo ezibalulekile. UThando Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, Zanele. Ngithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda umsebenzi wama-ambulensi nokubaluleka kwawo empilweni yethu. UZanele Nkosi: Ngiyabonga futhi. Lokhu kungenze ngiqonde kahle ukuthi izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ngiyabonga ngomzamo wakho wokwabelana ngolwazi. UThando Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, Zanele. Ngithokozile ukwabelana ngalokhu. - Uqedile -
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini: Ingxoxo Ehlakaniphile Ngaphakathi kwempilo yansuku zonke, amanzi abhekwa njengomthombo obalulekile, futhi ukuhlinzekwa kwawo kusebenza njengesisekelo sokuphila kwabantu. Nokho, emiphakathini ethile, izinkinga zamanzi zikhathaza kakhulu, zidalula izinselelo ezinzima ezithinta impilo, ezemvelo, kanye nezomnotho. Ukungabi khona kwamanzi acacile, ukungahlinzeki kahle, kanye nezimo zokungcoliswa kwamanzi, konke lokhu kumele kubhekwane ngeso elibucayi ukuze kuqondiswe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkinga zamanzi ziba nemiphumela emibi emiphakathini. Lokhu kubangelwa yizinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko zendawo, ukwanda kwabantu, kanye nokuphathwa kabi kwezinsiza. Ngokwesibonelo, emadolobheni amakhulu, ukwanda kwabantu kuholela ekwandeni kwesidingo samanzi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi aneziqu eziphezulu. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni abantu baphuze amanzi angahlanzekile, okwandisa izinga lokutheleleka ngezifo ezihlobene namanzi, njenge-diarrhea ne-cholera. Ngakho-ke, kumele kwenziwe izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Ngokubhekelela izimo zokungcoliswa kwamanzi, kuphinde kube khona izinselelo ezinkulu. Izimboni, ezokuthutha, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi zikhuthaza ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, lapho imfucuza, izikhalazo, nezinsalela zezimboni kuphumelele kulo mkhathi. Lokhu kungcola amanzi, okwenze kube nzima ukuwasebenzisa, futhi kuholele ezinkingeni zempilo ezinzima. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi akukhona nje kuphela ekuphazamiseni impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuphazamisa izitshalo nezilwane eziphathelene nomjikelezo wemvelo. Uma sikhuluma ngezinselelo, kubalulekile futhi ukuhlola izindlela zokuphatha amanzi. Ukuphathwa kahle kwamanzi kwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi anele, futhi kubalulekile kumaphrojekthi okwakha. Izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zifanele ziqinisekise ukuthi amanzi afinyelelwa kalula, ahlanzekile, futhi akhuphuka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kungachaphazela izidingo zomphakathi, kubaluleka ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo zokuphathwa kwamanzi ukuze babambe iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqonda izindlela zokugcina amanzi kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga. Ukuvuselela imikhuba yokulondoloza amanzi, njengokusebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile kuphela lapho kudingeka, nokunciphisa ukusebenzisa amanzi emisebenzini engadingeki, kungavula umnyango wezixazululo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ezisekelwe emiphakathini zingakhuthaza abantu ukuba babe nomqondo ophumelelayo mayelana nokuphila kwamanzi, okuholela empumelelweni yokugcina izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zinkinga zidinga ukubhekwa ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe bokuhlanza amanzi, njengezinhlelo zokuhlanza eziphakeme, kungasiza ekuphatheni izinkinga zokungcola. Uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lungahlanganisa izindlela zokuhlanza amanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuholela ekutheni amanzi abe sezingeni elihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude noma ezinzima ukufinyelela. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zifaka izinselelo ezihlukahlukene ezidinga ukunakwa. Ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, nokuphathwa okungafanele, konke lokhu kubangela umphumela omubi empilweni nasemphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe nomqondo ophumelelayo, silandele izinqubo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha amanzi, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ukuze sigweme izinkinga ezinzima. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezizokhulisa impilo, ukuvikeleka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezizinzile emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sikhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi enezinsiza zamanzi eziyinqaba, eziphumelelayo, nezihlanzekile, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Izinhlelo zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ukufundisa umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi ezithuthukisiwe zizoba yisisekelo sokwenza lokhu kungenzeke. Siphila emhlabeni onamathuba amaningi, kodwa uma singaphatheki kahle, sithola izinkinga ezinkulu. Sihamba phambili siphokophelele ekuzitholeni izixazululo ezinzima ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ayikho impilo yethu, hhayi nje umphakathi.
Kufanele ugweme izenzo ezingaphazamisa isithombe noma igama lemakethe. Sebenzisa ulimi olufanele futhi ugweme ukusebenzisa izinsolo. Kufanele ugweme ukusebenzisa amagama abantu abanye ngaphandle kwemvume yabo. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokucwasa. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokukhwabanisa futhi ugweme ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi, impi, nokuhlukumeza ngokwengqondo. Khuthaza ubumbano futhi ugweme ukusabalalisa ukungezwani. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezidingekayo zithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabanye. Gwema ukuzithokozisa, ukuphatha, noma ukuhlukumeza izidakamizwa ezithokozisayo. Khuthaza indawo ehlelekile yokusebenza. Gxila emsebenzini wakho. Hlonipha isikhathi sokusebenza uma wenza imisebenzi yakho. Landela iziteshi ezifanele uma uphakamisa izikhalazo. Ziphatha ngendlela ethuthukisa noma ikhulisa isithombe/sigama esihle emakethe. Khuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende/izivakashi ngokuba nobungane, ukuthobeka, nokusiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezithengiswa kumakhasimende zisezingeni eliphezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezithengiwe zifinyelelwa ngesikhathi. Phendula izikhalazo zamakhasimende ngokushesha futhi wamukele impendulo. Yamukela ukubaluleka kwamakhasimende ngokuvulekile nangokwethembeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi intengo yezinto zakho ilungile futhi iyamukeleka. Khuthaza ukuphathwa okufanayo kwabo bonke osomabhizinisi. Ukuze kube nokwaziswa, ubambisene nebhodi ngendlela engcono kakhulu oyikwazi. Hlonipha izibopho zenkontileka yakho. Hlonipha izinqumo zebhodi. Landela umthetho wokuziphatha kanye nenqubo yokuhola izikhalazo ezibekwe yibhodi. Kuzoba nezindlela ezimbili zokuphatha izikhalazo, ezisemthethweni nezingenamthetho/ezingalawulwa. Iphathwa ngamalungu amane osomabhizinisi. Iphatha ukuphulwa okukhulu komthetho wokuziphatha. Iphathwa ngamalungu amahlanu, amathathu awo ebaqhamuka ebhodini kanti amabili abekwa osomabhizinisi. Iphatha ukuphulwa okukhulu kakhulu komthetho wokuziphatha. Iqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa uphenyo uma kukhona izinsolo zokuphulwa komthetho wokuziphatha. Ikhetha amalungu amabili ukuze aphenyi izinsolo. Iqhuba ukuhlolela izikhalazo. Iyiwona ophakamisa ukuthi izinsolo zokuphulwa komthetho wokuziphatha kufanele zilandele inqubo esemthethweni noma eyingxenye engalawulwa ngumthetho. Noma ubani onenkinga angafaka isikhalazo mayelana nokuphulwa komthetho, futhi kunconywa ukuba kube okubhaliwe. Abantu ababili bazokhethwa ukuze baphenyi ukuphulwa komthetho. Ithimba lokuphenya lizohlanganisa ubufakazi obufanele mayelana nezinsolo. Osomabhizinisi abasolwayo ngokuphula umthetho kufanele banikezwe ithuba lokuphendula kulolo sikhathi. Uma ikomidi lezikhalazo lithola ukuthi kukhona ubufakazi obucacile, lizokhipha izijeziso ezibhekiswe kosomabhizinisi abasolwayo ngokuphula umthetho.
IKapa: Amadolobha, Imikhakha, Nezindaba Zansuku Zonke IKapa, okuyinhloko-dolobha yeMpumalanga Kapa, itholakala ngaphansi kwesigubhu seTable Mountain, ibonakala iyindawo enezindawo ezinhle nezithakazelisayo. Le dolobha iyikhaya kubantu abaningi abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi ibalulekile emnothweni nasenkululekweni yamasiko eNingizimu Afrika. Isimo Sezulu Nezindawo Zokuhlala Isimo sezulu eKapa siphawuleka ngezinsuku eziningi zokukhanya kwelanga, okuhleleka kahle nezinyanga zokubanda. Lokhu kukhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zibe khona, zigubhe ubuhle bemvelo obungapheli. Izindawo zokuhlala zihluke-hluke, kusukela ezindlini ezincane ezisemadolobheni kuya ezindlini ezinkulu ezikwiindawo eziphakeme, okwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene ukuthi bathole indawo yokuhlala efanelana nezidingo zabo. Isiko Nezamasiko IKapa iyikhaya lesiko elicebile, elihlanganisa izinkolo eziningi, izilimi, nezamasiko. Izinkanyezi zomculo, njenge-Jazz ne-Gospel, zikhanya kakhulu eKapa, futhi imicimbi yezamasiko ibanjwa njalo, okubandakanya imikhosi yezinkanyezi, imikhosi yamasiko, nemicimbi yokudla. Abantu bendawo bahlala bevuselela izithakazelo zamasiko, benza kube lula ukuba izivakashi zifunde nokuhlanganyela kulokho okujabulisayo. Umnotho Nezokuthengisa IKapa iyindawo ebalulekile kwezomnotho, inomnotho ophilayo ohlanganisa ezokuthengisa, ubuciko, nezokuvakasha. Izimakethe ezinkulu, ezinjengeGreenmarket Square, ziphakamisa izimpahla ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kumasiko endabuko kuya ezicathulweni ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nethuba lokuhweba nokuqinisekisa ukuzinza komnotho wendawo. Izivakashi Nezokuvakasha Izivakashi zifika eKapa ngonyaka wonke, zifuna ukujabulisa amehlo azo ngezinto ezithokozisayo. I-Table Mountain, iCape of Good Hope, kanye neRobben Island ziyiwo amaphuzu abalulekile okwenza izivakashi zifake izithombe ezinhle. Abavakashi bangathokozela imisebenzi efana nezikebhe, ukuhamba ngezinyawo, nokuhambela izindawo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza umnotho wendawo, kwenza kube nesidingo sokuthuthuka kwezinsiza zendawo. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, iKapa ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezindlu, ukungalingani komnotho, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha. Uhulumeni kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi basebenza ndawonye ukuze bathole izixazululo ezithile, njengezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu ezihambisanayo nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuphepha. Ikusasa leKapa Ikusasa leKapa libukeka linethemba, njengoba izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho ziqhubeka. Izinhlelo zokukhulisa imisebenzi emisha, ukwakha izikhungo zemfundo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisemadolobheni ziqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. I-Kapa iyaqhubeka nokuba yindawo lapho abantu bengahlangana, bejabulisa, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Ngokubona konke lokhu, iKapa iyindawo ehlala iyinhle, igcwele izinsuku ezijabulisayo nezifundo ezithembisayo. Izingxoxo ezimnandi, imicimbi eyahlukene, namathuba okuhweba esikhathini esizayo, konke kulungiselela iKapa ukuba ibe yindawo ethokozisayo nehlonishwayo eNingizimu Afrika.
Usain Bolt: Umgibeli Oqavile Isingeniso UUsain Bolt ungomunye wabagibeli abaphambili emlandweni wezokugijima, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emqhudelwaneni. Uhlonishwa njengomgibeli ophumelele kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi ubukhazikhazi bakhe buyabonakala ezindaweni zokugijima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqwaba zezilokotho eziphakeme, izindondo eziningi, kanye nesithunzi esikhulu emphakathini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinyathelo ezahlukene eziholele empumelelweni kaBolt, izifundo esingazithola kuye, kanye nendlela angathinta ngayo abanye. Ukwakha Isizinda Ukuze uqonde impumelelo kaUsain Bolt, kubalulekile ukuqala ngesisekelo somlando wakhe. Uzalwe ngo-1986 eSherwood Content, eJamayka. Uqala ukuzijayeza ngokugijima esemncane, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha amakhono akhe. Ngalesi sikhathi, ukwesekwa komndeni kwakubalulekile, njengoba uBolt ethola ukwesekwa okukhulu kubazali bakhe. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni aqhubeke nokusebenza kanzima. Ukuqala Ukujwayela Umjaho Ngemva kokuthola izifundo ezinhle, uBolt waqala ukujwayela umjaho. Ukuze ufinyelele impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqala kancane. UBolt waqala ngemijaho emincane, efaka phakathi imijaho yezikole. Lokhu kumjabulisa futhi kumfundisa izifundo ezibalulekile zokusebenza ngokuzikhandla. Kubalulekile ukuthi umgibeli aqhubeke nokuzijwayeza, aqonde izindlela zokuphumelela, futhi akhulise amakhono akhe. Ukusebenza Kaningi Nokuzikhandla Njengoba uBolt eqhubeka nokukhula, wathola ithuba lokusebenza nabathuthukisi bezemidlalo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile empumelelweni yakhe. Ukuze ufinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, kubalulekile ukuba nomqeqeshi onolwazi, ongasiza ekwakheni uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluhambisana nezifiso zomgibeli. UUsain Bolt wagcina ebamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezinzima zokuqeqesha, ezihlanganisa ukujwayela imijaho emide, ukwakha amandla, nokusebenza emathubeni okuphumelela. Izifundo Zokuphumelela UUsain Bolt ubonisa izifundo eziningi kubagibeli abasha. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhloso ezicacile. UBolt wayenhloso yokuba ngumgibeli ophumelele emhlabeni, futhi lokhu kwamsiza ukuba agxile. Okwesibili, ukuzikhandla akukwazi ukungabazeki. Umgibeli kufanele azimisele ukuphumelela, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuzikhandla nokusebenza kanzima. Okwesithathu, ukusekelwa komndeni nabangani kubalulekile. UUsain Bolt wathola ukwesekwa okuhle, okwakwenza kube lula kuye ukuhamba phambili. Ukuphumelela Emqhudelwaneni UUsain Bolt waba yisithonjana emqhudelwaneni. Waqala ukuhamba phambili emqhudelwaneni wezemidlalo, waphumelela izindondo eziningi, okuhlanganisa neziqinisekiso ze-Olympics. Ukuze ufinyelele lezi zimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nomoya ophakeme, ukwazi ukuphatha ingcindezi, nokuba nesineke. UBolt waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuphumelela akufanele kube lula; kudinga umsebenzi, ukuzikhandla, nokuzimisela. Ukwamukela Imiphumela Ngemuva kokuphumelela, uBolt waba neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni. Waqala ukuhamba phambili ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle, ezihlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abanye. Ubulungiswa bakhe bukhombisa ukuthi impumelelo akuyona kuphela yokwakha igama, kodwa futhi nokuphila impilo enobuntu. UUsain Bolt waphinde waba ngumfundisi, efundisa abanye ngezifundo azifundile empilweni. Isiphetho UUsain Bolt ungomunye wabagibeli abavelele kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi izifundo azihambisani nazo zibalulekile. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzikhandla, nokuba nesineke kuyizinto ezibalulekile empumelelweni. Ubulungiswa bakhe bukhombisa ukuthi impumelelo akuyona kuphela yokwakha igama, kodwa futhi nokuphila impilo enobuntu. UUsain Bolt ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi uma uzimisela, ungafinyelela noma yini. Lokhu kungenza abanye bazame ukufezekisa amaphupho abo, bazi ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza umsebenzi onzima.
Ukungenisa izinsizakalo zomphakathi ezweni kuzohlale kuyisithwathwa esinzima. Uhlaka lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ludinga uhlelo lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi ezihlobene, oluhlanganisa imikhakha futhi luhlukanise iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni nemikhakha yazo. Le nhlanganisela nokubambisana kungenzeka kuphela uma kwakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo semikhuba nemigomo yokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke, zendawo, nezifundazwe. Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, ingxoxo ngezinto ezakha umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ibibe phambili ezinkulumweni, ngokuvamile ingacacile futhi ingaqondakali kahle. Kusukela ngo-1994, sibe nengxoxo ezingeni elihlukene ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zethu zifinyelela ezingeni elifanele ukuze sikhuthaze imikhakha ethukile futhi ehluphekayo yomphakathi. Indlela entsha emlandweni wezwe ibonisa ushintsho emsebenzini wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi obheke emcabangweni ophumelelayo wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi okukhomba abantu abayizigidi abahlala ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka, ukuntuleka, kanye nokungabi nokufinyelela kwezinsiza. Lo shintsho wakhiwe embonweni yokuthi abantu kufanele bakhuthazwe ukuba baqonde lokho abakufunayo ezimpilweni zabo. Lo mbono, ohlukile endleleni yesiko yokupha kwabampofu, uhlose ukuthuthukisa nokuhlinzeka ngamathuba abantu, amaqembu, nemiphakathi ukuze ibe nokuzimela, okuzosiza umnyango futhi kubambisane nawo ekubhekaneni nezinselelo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezibhekene nomnyango nezwe lethu. Sizokwenza lokhu ngoba sikholwa ukuthi lezi zifiso zizokwenza kube namandla uhlelo lapho izidingo zethulwa khona futhi inhlalakahle jikelele ithuthukiswe, kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu bethu. Uhlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi luveza kahle imizamo yethu eqhubekayo yokwethula isimo sezidingo zomphakathi kubantu abahluphekayo kakhulu nemiphakathi ethukile. Ngasikhathi sinye, siqoqa idatha nezinkomba zezidingo zezinsiza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka ngendlela efanele. Sithemba ukuthi lolu hlelo luzosiza wonke umuntu ekubhekaneni nezinselelo esihlangabezane nazo eminyakeni eyishumi edlule mayelana nokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, sithemba ukuthi uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi luzokwenza kube namandla futhi luqinisekise ukubambisana nazo zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ekuthuthukiseni ubulungiswa bomphakathi nokubambisana okuhloswe ukufezekisa umgomo owodwa "Impilo Engcono Kubo Bonke." Umnyango ufisa ukuveza ukubonga okujulile kwiThimba Lezabelo elizinikele ekuShintsheni elithumele kakhulu ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi. Leli thimba liqukethe amalungu avela ezingeni likazwelonke nezifundazwe, kanti uMongameli walo nguNksz. N. Kela, uMphakathi-Jikelele Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zokuphila (ezingeni likazwelonke). Kungenxa yokuhlanganyela kwaleli thimba ukuthi singakujabulela ukusho ukuthi sakhe isisekelo esedlula ezinselelweni ezikhona ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indima edlalwa iyasiza izigidi zabantu abahluphekayo eNingizimu Afrika abakulindele umsebenzi wethu. Umnyango uphinde ufise ukuqaphela iminikelo eyenziwe abanye ababambiqhaza kuyo yonke imiphakathi eyisishiyagalolunye, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, iSikhungo Sobungcweti Bokusebenza Komphakathi, izinyunyana, ama-NGO, ama-FBO, ama-CBO, nezinye izikhungo ezathatha ingxenye ngesikhathi senqubo yokubonisana futhi zabelane ngemibono yazo kulolu documeti. Ukubambisana nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi kuzohlale kuyinto ebalulekile emizamweni kahulumeni nasemsebenzini wawo wokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo nokwenza lokho okuzinikele. Umqondo woHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi... Inhloso yoHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi... Umbiko wezithelo ezilindelekile... Imikhuba nezindinganiso ezilindelekile zoHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izinqumo zezinqubomgomo nemiyalo yeMthethosisekelo... Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi olukhombisa izidingo ezigxile ekuthuthukisweni... Uhlobo nobuningi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi... Abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo/Izindlela zezikhungo... Ukusekela uHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokuphatha izinguquko... Umnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ubonisa izidingo ezihlukene ezintathu ezibanzi: inhlalakahle yomphakathi, izidingo zokuphila komphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo kufanele ziqhutshelwe phambili futhi zisize imiphakathi eqondile ekubhekaneni nazo zonke izinkinga zomphakathi nezimo ezifana nempilo yengqondo, ubumpofu obukhulu, ukungabi nokudla, nezimo zomphakathi ezinzima. Lezi zimo zidalile isidingo sokugcizelela indlela yokuthuthukiswa egxile ekukhuthazeni abantu, amaqembu, noma imiphakathi futhi ibonise amandla abo okukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuqaphela isidingo sokukhuthaza imigomo yokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi kubhekwa ukungalingani komlando, umkhakha wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi uthathile indlela yokuthuthukiswa njengendlela yokwethula izidingo ezihlosiwe zokuhlanganisa izinhlelo zomphakathi kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Eminyakeni yamuva, abathuthukisi bomphakathi baphoqelekile ukuba bamukele izinyathelo zesikhashana ezibekwe yizinkinga zezinsiza ezikhona, noma lezi zidingo eziphuthumayo, izidingo zomthetho, noma izibopho ezichazwe ezingeni lomhlaba. Ngakho-ke, umgomo oyinhloko woHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi kuMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uwukwethula uhlaka olukhulu lukazwelonke oluchaza kahle uhlobo, ububanzi, ubuningi, nezinga lomsebenzi olwakha uhlelo lokwethulwa kwezidingo zomphakathi emnyangweni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi futhi luzosebenza njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa imikhuba ejwayelekile nezinga elifanele lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi. Umphumela olindelekile woHlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi uwukwethula nokwenza uhlelo olukhulu, olusebenza kahle ngendlela eqondile nenhle eluthuthukisa umphakathi ozimela, oluhambisana nemikhuba esunguliwe kwiWhite Paper yoMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi kanye nezimiso zeBatho Pele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lugxile ezimisweni zomthethosisekelo, emthethweni, nasezindinganisweni zamazwe omhlaba, ezibalulekile kumnyango lapho kwethulwa khona izidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi emsebenzini wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi lukhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi emikhulu yomnyango, efana nezokuphepha komphakathi, izidingo zokuphila komphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lunikeza uhlaka lokuhlanganisa imisebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo ezahlukene zomnyango. Nokho, izinkinga zomphakathi zixakile futhi zixhumene, zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba, ngaleyo ndlela kugc
Nakwezinga zonke zokukhulelwa kwakho, kusukela ekwamukelweni esibhedlela kuze kube sekuzalweni kwengane yakho, kuhlanganise nesikhathi sokuphuma esibhedlela. Inhloso ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsiza nezincazelo ngesikhathi uthola ukuba ngumzali omusha. Incwadi ye-GEMS yokukhulelwa, yokuzala, kanye nezinsiza mayelana nezinzuzo ezizokhokhwa yi-GEMS ngesikhathi uthola ukuba ngumzali omusha uma ubhalisela uhlelo lokuzala kanye nezinye izinsiza ongase ube nazo. Ukufinyelela mahhala kuzo zonke izinsiza ezihlinzekwa uHlelo Lokukhulelwa. Izeluleko ezihlinzekwa yi-GEMS ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kwakho nangemva kokuzalwa uma ubhekana nezinkinga zokulethwa kwengane yakho. Ekwenyukeni kokuqala kokuba ngumzali omusha. Uhlelo Lokunakekela luhloselwe ukuphatha udokotela wakho mayelana nemithi edingekayo ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kwakho. QAPHELA: Ukuze ujabulele izinzuzo, kubalulekile ukubhalisela uhlelo. Izeluleko ngezindaba ezifana nokudla, ukuzivocavoca, ukungakhululeki okuncane ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ukuzalwa ekhaya, ukuziphatha ngemithi, kanye nokwesekwa kokudla kwengane. Ukukwazi ukuzinakekela ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ukuzalwa, nasekuphumuleni. Umphathi uzobe ekhona ukukusiza wena nengane yakho kuze kube uthola ukuhlolwa kokuphuma esibhedlela.
Cape Town, Februwari 6, 2009. Nkosikazi uMholi weSishayamthetho Sezwe; uMholi ohloniphekile weBhunga Lezifundazwe; Nkosikazi uMphathiswa oPhakathi; Nkosikazi uMholi oPhakathi noNkosikazi uMholi weBhunga Lezifundazwe; uMphakathi omkhulu, uJaji Langa; uMphathiswa oPhakathi weNingizimu Afrika owayengaphambili kanye noMongameli wamanje we-ANC; oMongameli bezifundazwe; amalungu eKabineti kanye nabakhulumi bezifundazwe; uJaji owayengumholi kanye nalabo ababephakathi kwezikhala eziphezulu ePhalamende; abavakashi abahloniphekile, abameli abahloniphekile, kanye nabamele kwamanye amazwe kanye nezinhlelo zomhlaba jikelele; abaholi abahloniphekile bezepolitiki kanye namalungu ePhalamende, abaholi bomphakathi; uMholi oHloniphekile weCape Town; abaholi bezinkolo nabamele umphakathi; ozakwethu nabangane; abavakashi abakhethekile, ngiyajabula ukuthola leli thuba lokukhuluma phambi kwalezi zindlu zombili zePhalamende leRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ekuvuleni kweseshini yokugcina yePhalamende lesithathu leRiphabhulikhi. Ngimi lapha phambi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngenkululeko ngesikhathi engithole khona ithuba lokubamba isikhundla esiphezulu kuleli; ngenxa yokuthi kwenzeka umcimbi ongajwayelekile lapho iphathi ebusayo yanquma ukuhoxisa kumongameli owayedlule. Umsebenzi wami ezinyangeni ezizayo uwukuhola iKabineti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiyalelo eyanikezwa i-ANC ezivotweni zika-2004 iyafezwa, futhi ngibeke isisekelo sokuthi umsebenzi olandelayo emva kokhetho uqhubeke kahle. Lokhu esikwazile ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni nokudlulela esikhathini esisha ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezivela ezinyangeni ezedlule, kufanele sibonge ukuzinikela ekusebenzeni kwezakhiwo zomthethosisekelo, okubonakaliswe ngokubambisana kwamalungu eKabineti, kokubili okudala nokusha, kanye nokuphathwa kahle kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ngibheka emuva eminyakeni eyi-15 edlule, ngifuna ukuqaphela ukuzinikela nokusebenza kanzima kukaMongameli uNelson Mandela noThabo Mbeki kanye nabantu abaningi abesifazane nabesilisa ababe nendima ebonakalayo ekuhlinzekeni ngalesi sihambi sikahulumeni ngaphansi kokuthula: eKabineti nasezikhungweni, eziphakanyisweni zokuhola ezihlanganisa izigaba ezintathu zikahulumeni kanye nezenzo zomthetho, okuhamba phambili ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ngimi lapha phambi kwenu ngokuqhakazile nangokuzethemba ngazi ukuthi le Ningizimu Afrika esiyijabulelayo namuhla - ehlukile kakhulu ekwahlukanisweni, empini, nasekucwasweni okwakukhona eminyakeni eyi-15 edlule - iyisithelo somsebenzi nezifungo zabesifazane nabesilisa baseNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Laba bantu baseNingizimu Afrika babonisa ithemba nezifiso zabantu baleli. Emhlanganweni wabantu abavelele baseNingizimu Afrika kukhona amalungu ePhalamende lethu angasekho nathi kusukela ngoFebruwari wonyaka odlule. Phakathi kwabo, singabala uBrian Bunting, uBilly Nair, uNcumisa Kondlo, uJohn Gomomo, uJoe Nhlanhla, uCas Saloojee, uJohn Schippers, noJan van Eck. Phakathi kwabo, ngithanda ukukhumbula uNkk. Helen Suzman, umuntu ophawulekayo waseNingizimu Afrika, owamele izimiso zePhalamende lethu elisha ePhalamende elidala. Laba bangamaqhawe abafanele ukuhlonishwa lapho isikhathi sokwenza lokho sifika, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kube ngohlobo lwezikhukhula zezimali ezithinte uNingizimu Afrika, noma ngohlobo lwezinkinga zezombusazwe ezingase ziphazamise umsebenzi wethu wokubambisana kulolu hulumeni olusha, kodwa izwe lethu likhona esimweni esihle. Nokho, akufanele siwuhlulele phansi ubunzima esibhekene nabo. Isimo sezomnotho emhlabeni jikelele esibucayi sithinta umnotho wethu ngokulahlekelwa amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokwehla kwezinga lempilo yabantu bethu. Ngokufanayo, izinkinga zezombusazwe zingavusa imibuzo eminingi kakhulu kunempendulo ezikhona njengamanje. Ngakho-ke, abanye bethu bangase baphumelele em waves zesimo sezomnotho esibucayi okwenza kubonakale sengathi asazi ukuthi kwenzekani kulezi zikhathi ezinzima zokuhlupheka kwezomnotho nezimo zezombusazwe ezingazinzile. Nokho, sigxile ethembeni nasezifisweni. Singasho futhi ukuthi, ngendlela engajwayelekile, izakhiwo zomthethosisekelo zihlolwe ezikhathini ezedlule ezingekho kude, kodwa zonke zaphumelela kulokho ukuhlola, okukhombisa isifiso sangempela sabantu. Isifiso sabantu lapha sikhona esimweni esihle kakhulu. Siba namandla, sisekelwa umthethosisekelo onzima ukuwufanisa nanoma yimuphi omunye emhlabeni. Impela, sonke siyavuma ukuthi ukujula kwemikhankaso yokhetho yamanje, esivuma ukuthi kufanele iqhutshelwe phansi ngebhadi nangokuthula, kuyisithembiso esibonakalayo sokukhula nokujula kokuthula kwethu. Ngivumele, Nkosikazi uMholi kanye nawe Mholi, ukuba ngikhuthaze bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanephuzu lokuvota ukuba babhalise kulokhu kukhetho okuzayo kwaseNingizimu Afrika nasezifundazweni ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa lethu. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe nsuku zonke emahhovisi omasipala, ngaphambi kokuthi uhlu lwabavoti luvalwe. Kufanele futhi sithathe ithuba elinikezwe yiKomidi Lokhetho laseNingizimu Afrika, i-IEC, ngokuhlela impelasonto ekhethekile yokubhalisela ukuvota, kusasa nangeSonto, 7 no-8 kuFebruwari ngokwehlukana. Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukumemezela ukuthi ezinsukwini ezizayo, ngizophothula umhlangano wokubonisana neKomidi Lokhetho kanye noMongameli bezifundazwe futhi ngimemezele usuku lokhetho. Amalungu ahloniphekile, sibonga abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuba isifiso sabantu, futhi ukuthi okokuqala, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 1994, bathatha ikusasa labo ezandleni zabo. Ngalesi senzo esilula kodwa esinempembelelo, isenzo sokuvota kuhulumeni wabantu bonke baleli, sikwazile ukufaka umkhondo emuva obekuphikisana nobuntu bethu. Ngakho-ke, kufanelekile ukuthi kulolu suku sibhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yokwamukelwa kweCharta ye- African Union ezindabeni zezifundazwe zaseNingizimu Afrika nezamazwe ase-Afrika mayelana nendaba eyakhuluma eNingizimu Afrika futhi yavumelana ngayo ngoMgqibelo ka-1989 - eyaziwa ngokuthi iHarare Declaration. Lokhu kubekwe isisekelo sokuthi umhlaba uvumelane ukuba uholelwe yiZizwe Ezihlangene ngezingxoxo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngisho naseNingizimu Afrika, le Charta yalandelwa ngesikhathi seNgqungquthela yeDemocratic Future ka-1989 eyakwazi ukuhlanganisa cishe wonke umuntu owawuthanda leli zwe ngaleso sikhathi. Konke lokhu kuholele ezingxoxweni ezahole
Umphakathi uyaziswa ukuthi uMongameli uvumile umthetho olandelayo owashicilelwa lapha ukuze wazise umphakathi wonke. Amagama akhanyiswe ngokuqinile abonisa izinguquko emthethweni osekhona. Lokhu kuhlobene nokukhishwa kwemiyalo mayelana nokuvikelwa kwabantu ezimweni zokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya nezindaba ezihlobene. Mayelana nalokho okuphathwa yile mthetho, kubikwa ukuthi isimo sizimisele ukuvimbela ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya. Amalunga omndeni angabandakanya ubudlelwano ngokwenkolo, umshado, noma ukuthola, kodwa akukhona ubudlelwano uma bengakabambisani, bengahambelani, bengahlangani noma bengashadile, futhi bengahlangani ngokocansi; noma bangahlala ndawonye noma bahlale ndawonye. "Ukuhlukunyezwa" kusho ukulimala okuqhubekayo; "lo mthetho" uhlanganisa imithetho. Uma kudingeka, kumele kuhanjiswe isaziso esiqukethe ulwazi mayelana nomlamli ngolimi olusemthethweni olukhethwe ngumlamli; futhi uma kudingeka, umlamli kumele aziswe ngokuqondile okuqukethwe kulesi saziso, kuhlanganise nezixazululo ezingamsiza ngaphansi kwalomthetho kanye nelungelo lokufaka icala uma kusebenza. Amaphoyisa angabamba ngaphandle kweziqinisekiso noma imvume noma yimuphi ophendulayo endaweni lapho ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kwenzekile noma lapho ophendulayo kuthiwa wenze isenzo noma icala elihlobene nokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya ngokumelene nomlamli. Noma yimuphi umlamli angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuvikelwa ngendlela efanele. a ngosizo olutholakalayo ngaphansi kwalomthetho; futhi b nelungelo lokukhala uma icala lenziwa ngumlamli. Naphezu kwemigomo yomthetho, noma yimuphi umuntu ongakwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela, noma yimuphi umuntu omele umuntu ongakwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela, angafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa enkantolo ngaphandle kosizo lwezihlobo, umgibeli, noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ogunyaziwe ukusiza lowo muntu ongakwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela. Isicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-1 singafakwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngosuku olungahambelani nezinsuku zokusebenza zenkantolo, inqobo nje uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi umlamli angalimala uma lesi sicelo singabhekwa ngokuphuthumayo. Ama-affidavit enziwe abantu abanolwazi ngalesi sihloko angafakwa kulesi sicelo. Isicelo nama-affidavit angathunyelwa kumlobi wenkantolo, ozothumela konke lokhu enkantolo. I-inkantolo kumele ibheke isicelo esithunyelwe kuyo ngokuphuthumayo uma ingakwenza lokho ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-4 futhi ingase icabangele ubufakazi obungeziwe balesi sihloko uma ibona ukuthi kuhle ukwenza kanjalo, kuhlanganise ubufakazi obukhuluma noma ama-affidavit, azoba yingxenye yobufakazi ezosetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa enkantolo. a ophendulayo wenze icala noma ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya; futhi b kungaba khona ukulimala kumlamli ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka kwale ndlela uma umyalo wokuvikela ungakhishwanga ngokuphuthumayo, inkantolo kumele, naphezu kokuthi ophendulayo akazange aziswe ngemigomo echazwe esigabeni-1, ikhiphe umyalo wesikhashana wokuvikela ophendulayo ngendlela efanele. a umyalo wesikhashana ophume enkantolo kumele unikezwe ophendulayo ngendlela efanele futhi ophendulayo kumele abuzwe ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezingavimbela inkantolo ekukhishweni kwalowo myalo. b Ikhophi yesicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-4 1 kanye nobufakazi obubhalwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- kumele inikezwe ophendulayo ngokuhambisana nomyalo wesikhashana ophume enkantolo. Uma inkantolo ingakhishi umyalo wesikhashana ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- inkantolo kumele iyale umlobi wenkantolo ukuthi athumele ophendulayo ikhophi egunyaziwe yalesi sicelo kanye nanoma yisiphi ubufakazi bama-affidavit asekelayo lesi sicelo, kuhlanganise nesaziso esiphakamisayo ophendulayo ukuthi anikeze izizathu zokuthi kungani engafaneleki ukuba anikezwe umyalo wokuvikela wenkantolo ngokumelene nomlamli. Izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a no-4 akumele zibe ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokuthi ophendulayo ethole umyalo wenkantolo; ngaphandle uma izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a zingalindelwa ku ophendulayo ngaphansi kwezinsuku ezingaphansi kwamashumi amabili nane amahora esaziso esibhaliwe yinkantolo ku ophendulayo. a kumele icabangele noma yisiphi ubufakazi obutholwe ngaphambili ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-5 1; futhi b kumele futhi icabangele ama-affidavit noma ubufakazi obukhuluma obuzoba yingxenye yokuhlolwa. a akumele abuze ngqo noma yimuphi umuntu obandakanyeka nabo ngempela; futhi b kuzobuzwa abafakazeli balesi sihloko ngokubhekisela imibuzo yabo enkantolo, futhi inkantolo izobuyisela umbuzo kubo. I-inkantolo kumele, ngemuva kokulalela icala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni-2, ikhiphe umyalo wokuvikela ngendlela efanele uma ithola ukuthi ophendulayo wenze icala futhi ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya. a qinisekisa ukuthi umyalo onjalo unikezwa ophendulayo; futhi b wenze ikhophi egunyaziwe yalowo myalo, kanye nomyalelo wokubamba okukhuluma ngawo esigabeni -8 1 a, okumele unikezwe umlamli. Umlobi wenkantolo kumele athumele ikhophi egunyaziwe yomyalelo wokuvikela nanomyalelo wokubamba okukhuluma ngawo esigabeni -8 1 a kumaphoyisa. Ngokwemigomo yesigaba-7 7, umyalo wokuvikela ophume ngaphansi kwemigomo yalesi sigaba uhlala usemthethweni kuze kube ususwa, futhi ukuhlinzekwa kwalowo myalo ngeke kuqedwe kuphela ngenxa yesicelo sokukhuluma sokudluliselwa kwecala. g ukuvimbela umlamli ophila noma owayephezu kwabo endaweni efanayo njengokuchazwe esigabeni -c ekungeni noma ekuhlala endaweni abahlala kuyo; noma h ukwenza noma iyiphi enye into njengokuchazwe kumyalo wokuvikela. a ukuthatha ku ophendulayo noma iyiphi impahla noma impahla eyingozi njengokuchazwe esigabeni 9; futhi b amaphoyisa kumele ahambisane nomlamli endaweni ethile ukuze asize ngezinhlelo zokubuyisa impahla yabo. I-inkantolo ingalalela ukuthi ophendulayo akhokhe izidingo, kodwa ikwenza lokhu ngokucabangela izidingo nezinsiza zezimali zomlamli kanye nophendulayo nokuthi umyalo onjalo ungenela ekwenzeni isinqumo secala lesi sivilayezwe enkantolo ye-magistrate. a ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona kumele likhishwe kumyalo wokuvikela, ngaphandle uma okukhuluma ngawo kumyalo kudinga ukuthi ikheli lomlamli lifakwe. b inkantolo ingakhipha noma yisiphi isinqumo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona alikhululwa nganoma iyiphi indlela engase ibangele ingozi empilweni yomlamli. a ingavimbela ophendulayo ukuba ahlangane nalowo mngane; noma b ilungise ukuhweba nophenyo nomntwana ukuze kube ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. i ukukhipha um
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Ngiyanemukela, nonke, namuhla ngizokhuluma ngezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, okungokwakho noma okungokwakho. Njengoba sikhuluma, kusho ukuthi sonke simqoka, futhi sihlala sithanda ukwazi ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakala ezibhedlela zizele ngekhwalithi. Okokuqala, sizothi, kubeletha akukhona okuncane. Kuqala, sizocabanga ngaleso sikhathi esiyigugu. Uthola umhlangano nesisebenzi sebhodi, isiye sihamba kahle na? Bayathanda ukusiza umama, noma umama obamba izinsiza ezithile, abesebenzisa umoya omuhle. Izibhedlela zethu ziqinisekisa ukuthi umama uthola ukunakekelwa okuhle phakathi nalolu suku olubalulekile. Lokhu kusemqoka, ngalesi sikhathi umama udinga isikhala sokuthola, isikhathi sokuphumula, nokunakekelwa okufanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuzodingeka uhlu lwezinto. Ngabe umama uthola isipho sokubeletha? Yebo, izibhedlela eziningi zinikeza amasheya, lapho umama angathola khona amakhadi, imithi, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ngaleso sikhathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umama azizwe ekhululekile, azijabulele, futhi azisolokhu ebonisa izidingo zayo. Ngoba akukhona okuncane, lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuthanda. Ngemuva kokubeletha, kubalulekile ukuthi umama nabantwana bazi ukuthi banelungelo lokuhlala ezindaweni ezikhethekile. Izibhedlela zinezigaba ezahlukahlukene, ezithanda ukudala umphakathi omuhle. I-ward yesiguli, ikakhulukazi izinsizakalo zokukhululeka zenhliziyo, zidinga ukuthi kube khona uxolo nothando phakathi kwabo bonke abaku-wards. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi neziguli. Ukuze lezi zinsizakalo zifezeke, izibhedlela zithola izinsizakalo ezithile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga ukuba bazi ukuhlola impilo yengane ngemva kokubeletha, futhi bangashiya imfuneko yokuthi iziguli zihlale ziqaphele. Abantu abakha izibhedlela bahlale bebheke izinsizakalo ezithile, okufana nezithombe ezithokozisayo nokukhalipha okusiza umama nabantwana abasha. Ukwazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona kuyeza nezidingo ezikhulayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umama akwazi ukudinga usizo lwempilo emshadweni wakhe wemindeni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona okwenza kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukufaka umuntu ngempela noma umphakathi omkhulu. Ngale ndlela, umama angazinika isikhathi sokuhlola amathuba ahlukile atholakala ezibhedlela. Ngokujulukile, iSikhumbuzo, okungokwakho, ikhuluma nendaba yokubeletha ukuthi zikhona izinsizakalo, azikhona nje izinqubo. Umama kufanele ahlale eqonda ngalokho abakuward bayokwenza, ukuze ahlale ethola usizo olufanele. Noma ngabe kukhulunywa ngokuqolile, umama uxhumana abasebenzi besibhedlela ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo olufanele. Ngemuva kwalokho, umama kumele aqonde ukuthi imithi nohambo lwezokwelapha, okubuye kuqinisekise ukwelashwa okubhekelelwe. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi uma kukhona ukufudumala komama, abaqhubeka nokwelashwa kungapheleli lapho. Ukuhamba phambili, bayakwazi ukufunda indlela yokudala umphakathi omusha phakathi kwabo. Ngakho, njengokwala kufika isikhathi sokubeletha, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukuba zikhumbule abantwana. Umoya omuhle kumele udluliselwe futhi udluliselwa. Ngaleso sikhathi, umama uzothanda ukukholwa, futhi kuzolandelwa ngempumelelo eqhubeka uqhubeka nezeluleko ezithile ezitholakalayo. Ngokuqhulisayo, iSikhumbuzo iyisinyathelo, isikhumbuzo sobuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili. Uma ukhumbula njalo ulwazi lwezimpilo, kuyisikhathi sokubona ukuthi uqhubeka nokuthola izinsizakalo ezifanele. Empilweni, izinqubo zidinga ukufundwa ukuze sithole ubuhlakani obulungile. Ekugcineni, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zithinta wonke umuntu. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuba nomama, kodwa kuhlobene nomsebenzi wezakhamizi. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kumele uhlale uthokozisa ukuze umama akwazi kodwa alwele izinsiza. Okubhalwe kuzo zonke izigaba zokwelashwa kubalulekile, futhi konke nokungavumeli umphakathi, kuzo zonke izinsizakalo, kuzofuneka kube nezinyanga ezithile ukuze umama nabantwana baphume kahle. Bengifuna ukufingqa nezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, sikugcizelela ukunakekelwa okuhambelana nokusebenza. Ungafuni nje ukubeletha, kodwa ukwenza umbuzo wokuthi uthola usizo olufanele. Umama, phambili, unganqikazi, ugcine uqhubeka, futhi ungaphuthelwa lezi zinsizakalo ezikwenze wathola. Ngiyabonga.
UMartin Luther King Jr. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1920, emhlabeni omkhulu, kwavela umntwana ophakathi kwezinkanyezi zenkululeko, uMartin Luther King Jr. Wazalwa ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana, ngonyaka we-1929, eAtlanta, eGeorgia. UMartin wayengumfana ophilayo, onothando, futhi enothando lokufunda. Wakhulela emndenini owayenobuhlakani, umphakathi owawukhuluma ngenkululeko, ubulungiswa, kanye nezinqumo ezinzima. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu emfundweni yakhe, lapho afunda khona izincwadi eziningi ezikhuthaza impilo yakhe. Njengoba uMartin ekhula, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi umphakathi wakhe ubhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Abantu abamnyama babebhekana nokucwaswa, ukungabi nabulungiswa, nokuhlukunyezwa. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, futhi kwavusa umoya wakhe wokulwa. Wayefuna ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, engaba nethuba lokuphila kahle. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMartin wahamba eBoston, lapho aqhubeka khona nezifundo zakhe. Wafunda ngezinkolo ezahlukene, futhi wathola ukuthi uNkulunkulu ubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Waqonda ukuthi indlela yokulwa nokucwaswa akufanele ibe yodwa, kodwa kufanele kube nendlela ethule, ethokozisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aqale ukwakha izinhlelo zokulwa nokucwaswa, ezazigcwele umoya wokuthula. Ngonyaka we-1955, kwenzeka umcimbi omkhulu. U-Rosa Parks, owesifazane omnyama, waphika ukuma emuva kwendiza ye-bus ukuze umnumzane omhlophe akwazi ukuhamba. Lokhu kwavusa umphakathi, futhi uMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokukhuthazela. Waqala ukuhlela imibhikisho, izinkulumo, nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. UMartin wayekholwa ukuthi amandla abantu abamnyama angavuselelwa uma behlanganyela, benza imisebenzi ethokozisayo. Ngonyaka we-1963, uMartin Luther King Jr. waba nesikhumbuzo esikhulu eWashington, D.C. Lapha, wakhuluma khona izwi lakhe elidumile, "Ngiyaphupha." Wakhuluma ngothando, ukulingana, nokuhlanganyela. Wayefuna umphakathi lapho abantu bonke bengaphila ngokuthula, ngaphandle kokucwaswa. Izwi lakhe lavusa umoya, futhi abantu babephendula ngothando, benza izinqumo ezinkulu zokuba neqhaza emzamweni wokulwa nokucwaswa. UMartin akazange ayeke. Noma ubani owawazi uMartin, wayebona ukuthi ungumholi onobuhlakani, onokholo, futhi onothando. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba balwe, baphumelele, futhi bahlale bephila ngokuthula. Kodwa, njengokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsizi zakhula, futhi izitha zikaMartin zanda. Kwakukhona abanye ababenobudlova, ababenomqondo ophikisana nezifiso zakhe. Ngonyaka we-1968, uMartin Luther King Jr. wabulawa. Lokhu kwashiya umhlaba uphahlazekile, abantu bephendula ngezinyembezi, ubuhlungu, nokukhala. Kodwa, izifiso zakhe azizange zife. Umoya wakhe wahlala uphila, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokulandela izifundo zakhe. UMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi umhlaba ungashintsha, uma abantu bephikelela ezinhlelweni ezinhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMartin Luther King Jr. waba yisibonelo esikhulu sokuthi uthando lungahlula ubudlova. Umsebenzi wakhe wathinta abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele, futhi izifundo zakhe zakhuthaza izizukulwane eziningi. UMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, uthando, ukulingana, nokuhlanganyela kuzoholela empumelelweni. Namuhla, uMartin Luther King Jr. uyahlonishwa, futhi izifiso zakhe zihlala zikhona. Umhlaba usaqhubeka nokufunda emsebenzini wakhe, futhi abantu bayazi ukuthi uma behlanganyela, bangakha umphakathi ongcono. UMartin waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, "Uthando lungcono kunezinkinga," futhi lokhu kuqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu emhlabeni wonke. UMartin Luther King Jr. akazange abe ngumholi kuphela, kodwa waba yisibonelo sokuthi umhlaba ungashintsha uma abantu benza okuthile.
U-Eskom Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, okungukuthi, u-Eskom. U-Eskom ungumhlinzeki omkhulu kagesi kuleli, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wezwe. Ukuze siqonde kahle izinselelo ezibhekene no-Eskom, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa nomphakathi, abahlinzeki, kanye nochwepheshe abanolwazi olunzulu ngalesi sihloko. Ingxenye 2: Umlando ka-Eskom U-Eskom waqalwa ngonyaka ka-1923, futhi wathola umthwalo omkhulu wokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Ngaphandle kokukhula okukhulu, u-Eskom ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezinsiza ezindala, ukungabi bikho kokutshala imali, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekwehleni kokukhiqizwa kagesi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokwanele. Ingxenye 3: Izinkinga Zamanje Namuhla, u-Eskom ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwaziwa ngokuthi "load shedding," sekuphenduke isimo esijwayelekile empilweni yabantu. Lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka emisebenzini, ezikoleni, nakwezinye izindawo. Siphinde sithole imibono evela kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile, bechaza ukuthi lezi zinkinga ziba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Ingxenye 4: Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa U-Eskom uzama ukuthola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinkinga. Abaphathi bakhe baveze ukuthi kukhona izinhlelo zokutshala imali ezintsha, ukwakha iziteshi ezintsha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokulawula amandla. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi u-Eskom uzama ukuvuselela izinsiza zawo ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Ingxenye 5: Ukubambisana Nezinkampani Zangaphandle Ukuze u-Eskom uphumelele, kubalulekile ukubambisana nezinkampani zangaphandle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo ezintsha, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha. Abanye ochwepheshe baveza ukuthi ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza amandla avuselelekayo kungasiza u-Eskom ukuba uthole izixazululo ezibanzi. Ingxenye 6: Umthelela Emphakathini U-Eskom akawona umhlinzeki kuphela kagesi; unomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Izinkinga ezibhekene no-Eskom ziba nomthelela ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi, ezemfundo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzeka ngogesi kuhlobene nezinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Ingxenye 7: Ukubheka Phambili Njengoba sikhuluma ngendaba ka-Eskom, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi izixazululo azizukutholakala ngokushesha. Kubalulekile ukuthi u-Eskom, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye ukuze bathole izindlela zokuthuthukisa isimo. Ukubambisana, ukwethembeka, kanye nokuhlonipha izinqumo ezithathwayo kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni u-Eskom. Ingxenye 8: Isiphetho U-Eskom ungumgogodla wezokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wezwe. Nakuba ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo zingasiza ukuvuselela le nhlangano. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho u-Eskom engaba umhlinzeki okhaliphile, ophumelelayo, futhi othembekile. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi u-Eskom ungathuthukiswa ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi.
Izinselelo zokuxhasa imisakazo yomphakathi 1. Ukuqonda Imisakazo Yomphakathi Imisakazo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, unomoya ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano. Lezi ziteshi zihlala ziqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene. Nokho, ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oluqinile nolwakhiwe kulolu hlobo lwemisakazo kubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. 2. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko 2.1 Uk缺乏 Imali Yokuxhasa Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nemisakazo yomphakathi uk缺乏 imali yokuxhasa. Imithombo yokuxhaswa, efana nezibonelelo zikahulumeni, izinkampani, nabantu ngabanye, ibalulekile ukuze imisakazo ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngeso lengqondo eliqinile. Ukuze imisakazo iqhubeke, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthola uxhaso olunzulu. 2.2 Ukwehluka Kwezithameli Imisakazo yomphakathi ivame ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze ifinyelele ezithamelini ezahlukene. Nokho, ukuhlelwa kwemibhalo yohlelo kuhlale kube inselelo. Ukuze imisakazo ifinyelele impumelelo, kufanele iqonde izidingo nezifiso zezakhamuzi ezihlukene. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza eziningi nezazi ezinezifundo ezithile. 2.3 Izinkinga Zobuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengesikhumbuzo esibalulekile ekwakheni imisakazo yokuphila. Nokho, izinkinga ezinjengokwehla kwezinga lokuxhumana, ukungena kwenethiwekhi, kanye nezinsiza ezindala kwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukile. Ukuze imisakazo ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kudingeka izinsiza ezithuthukile nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. 2.4 Ukuncintisana Nokuhlonza Umkhiqizo Imisakazo yomphakathi ibhekene nokuncintisana okuqinile emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Iziteshi ezizimele, iziteshi zikamasipala, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele zifuna ukuheha izithameli. Lokhu kudinga imisakazo yomphakathi ukuba ibekezelele ukuziphendulela, ithuthukise izinhlelo zayo, futhi ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango ehlukile. 3. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa 3.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimali Ukukhulisa uxhaso lwezimali kudinga ukuhlela kahle imikhankaso yokuthola uxhaso. Imisakazo kufanele ibambisane nezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, ezinkampanini, nasemiphakathini, ukuze ihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemiphakathi nezikhungo ezixhasayo kuzosisiza ekwenzeni imisakazo iqhubeke. 3.2 Ukuhlola Nezinhlelo Zokuthola Ababukeli Ukuze imisakazo ithuthuke, kufanele iqonde izidingo zababukeli bayo. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokuhlola izifiso zabo, ukubamba izinkulumo, noma ukwenza ucwaningo ngemibono yokubuka. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe izinhlelo ezihambisanayo nezidingo zomphakathi. 3.3 Ukuvuselela Ubuchwepheshe Ukuze imisakazo iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuthi ivuselele ubuchwepheshe bayo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemishini, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ezithuthukile ukuze kube nokuxhumana okungcono. Ukuze kubonakale, imisakazo kufanele ibambisane nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe ukuze ihlinzeke ngezixazululo eziphumelelayo. 3.4 Ukukhuthaza Umkhiqizo Imisakazo yomphakathi kufanele ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango ehlukile ukuze ikwazi ukuheha izithameli. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ukunika izikhala zokuxhumana, nokwakha izikhangiso ezithakazelisayo. Ukuze umfutho uqhubeke, kudingeka ukuthi imisakazo ibonise izinzuzo eziningi kumphakathi. 4. Isiphetho Imisakazo yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, futhi izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nayo zidinga ukuthi zenziwe izinyathelo eziphusile. Ukuze imisakazo ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthola uxhaso, ukuhlola izidingo zababukeli, ukuvuselela ubuchwepheshe, nokukhuthaza umkhiqizo. Ngokubambisana, imisakazo yomphakathi ingaqhubeka nokukhula, ihlinzeke ngemininingwane edingekayo, futhi ibe yinsika ebalulekile emphakathini. Ngakho-ke, kwamukelekile ukuba kubhekwane nezinselelo ezikhona, kwenziwe imizamo yokwenza imisakazo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni nasemphakathini jikelele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni kwezimali, ekwandeni kwezithameli, nasekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo.
UMphathiswa Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, ngaphansi kwamandla anikezwe yizigaba 26 (a) no (g), kanye nesigaba 116 esifundwa ndawonye nesigaba 21(k) seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke, 1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998), uhlose ukwenza imithetho kuSheduli. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kuhambisana nesu elivunyelwe lokusebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa, okuyisu lokwenza imisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo 5 lapho kufanelekile; futhi futhi kuhambisana nezidingo zanyanyathiselwe noma yisiphi isizathu esamukelekayo sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, lapho kudingeka. Futhi izindlela ezifanele zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; kanye nendawo lapho kukhona izindawo ezibucayi noma ezivikelwe uma kungekho isu elivunyelwe lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngendlela enomthelela omkhulu noma ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa eziholela enprofit kufanele afake isicelo sokuvunyelwa kwesu lokwenza imisebenzi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi enomthelela omkhulu noma ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 zokuthola isaziso ngendlela efanele ukuze enze kanjalo. Ngokuhambisana nanoma yiziphi iziqondiso ezilawula udoti nezindawo noma izinqubo; futhi ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa amanani namasiko mayelana nomthombo wamanzi. Lokhu kuhambisana nezidingo zezinqubomgomo 2; futhi noma yimuphi umfaki-sicelo ovezile ukuthi angakwazi, noma uzokwazi ukuphatha nokulawula imithelela emibi kumthombo wamanzi njengoba kuboniswe kuzinqubomgomo 2g.
