Izinqubomgomo zokulawula zingase zicela olunye ulwazi kumuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa, njengokuthi umyalezo wezinhlinzeko zezinqubomgomo 2 futhi zingase zisho ukuthi isu eliphakanyisiwe lokwenza imisebenzi lishintshiwe njengoba kudingekile yizinqubomgomo zokulawula. Uma izinqubomgomo zokulawula zikhululekile isizathu sokwenza imisebenzi, umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa kufanele ahambisane nezinhlinzeko zesu elivunyelwe lokwenza imisebenzi. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi kufanele lithuthukiswe yizinhlinzeko ezifanele futhi liboniswe yizinqubomgomo zokulawula ukuze kuvunyelwe ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kulowo mthombo wamanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa, kuhlanganise namanzi angaphezulu emisebenzi kahulumeni, ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-180 kusukela ngosuku lapho izinhlinzeko ezifanele zaziswa yizinqubomgomo zokulawula ukuze zenze kanjalo. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, njengoba kuchazwe kuzinqubomgomo 1, kufanele libhalwe ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zeMnyango mayelana ne-Integrated Water Resource Management Strategy, mayelana Nokusetshenziswa Kwamazwe Ngezizathu Zokuzijabulisa, ephepheni ngoMsombuluko 2005. Kufanele kusungulwe isikhala sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi kufanele kuvumeleke imibono ebhaliwe ukuba ithunyelwe ngesizathu esiphakanyisiwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokushicilelwa kwesaziso; futhi kufanele kubhekwane nazo zonke imibono eyamukelekayo. Kungashintshwa isikhala sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zezinqubomgomo 3, kushicilelwe isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi ezincwadini nasemithonjeni ethile ephathelene nomthombo wamanzi ophazamisekile. Noma yimuphi umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa kufanele akhuthazwe ukugcina amarekhodi okusetshenziswa kwamanzi afanele futhi anikeze izinhlinzeko zokulawula ngalolo lwazi. Akekho omunye umuntu, ngaphandle kokuba nenhloso ebhaliwe kaMphathiswa, ongafinyelela noma iyiphi ingxenye yemisebenzi kahulumeni yamanzi, lapho kungekho indawo yokufinyelela esemthethweni. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa akuvunyelwe kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yemisebenzi kahulumeni yamanzi ngaphandle kokuthi uMphathiswa uyivumele ebhaliwe. Akukho imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa ezindaweni zokuphepha zomjovo wezimpahla kanye nomlomo wemisebenzi noma ekukhishweni kwayo ngaphandle kokuthi uMphathiswa akhiphe imvume ebhaliwe; futhi kuphela izimoto ezihamba ngesivinini esingaphazamisi kuphela ezivunyelwe ezindaweni ezibekiwe ezingezona zokuzijabulisa. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophula noma ongahambisani nezinhlinzeko zalezi Ziqondiso ubhekwa njengomsolwa, futhi, uma ebanjwa, ubhekene nehlawulo noma ukujolwa isikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni emihlanu. Lezi Ziqondiso zingabizwa ngokuthi Iziqondiso Zokusebenzisa Amanzi Ngezizathu Zokuzijabulisa. Ingxenye yokuqala ibeka izimo nezinqubo ezizolandela ngesikhathi sokuqala sokwenza umsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process ngaphakathi kweminyango yamasipala. Ingxenye yesibili ibeka izimo ezizokwenziwa ekupheleni kwesigaba sokuhlola ukuze kugcinwe le nqubo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokhu kunikeza abasebenzi amandla okwenza isicelo sokubuyekezwa kokusebenza kwabo ngenkathi ngakolunye uhlangothi, kuqinisekisa ukuphathwa nokubuyekezwa kwezinqubo ezibekwe kanye nokwethembeka kwazo. Inqubo yokuhlola iyinhloso yokuvumelana kweSouth African Local Government Bargaining Council (SALGBC) ukuthi kunesidingo sokuba nendlela efanayo yokuhlola ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweminyango yohulumeni bendawo. Kunombono wonke amaqembu ukuthi le uniformity ibalulekile ezicini ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nezinkulumo zokuhola, ukuqonda okufanele kwezikhala zabasebenzi kanye nezimo zenhlangano, ukuhlela kwezobuchwepheshe kweminyango, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa nokuthuthukisa. Lo mbhalo wezinyathelo kufanele ufundwe ngokuhlanganyela nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process, ama-Job Evaluation Training Manuals, kanye nezincwadi zeMnyango Wamasipala mayelana nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process. Uhloswe ukuhola inqubo ukuze kugwenywe ukubambezeleka ekwenzeni ukuhlola ngenxa yokungavumelani okungadingekile nezinkinga. Kuqondene nokuphothula isigaba sokuqala senqubo yokuhlola ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingafinyelela ezinyangeni eziyi-18. Kubalulekile ukuthi le nqubo ibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo ngangokunokwenzeka futhi yamukelekile kubasebenzi. Akukho umsebenzi ozosala esimweni sokusebenza esiphansi kunalokho okwamanje okwenelisayo ngenxa yokuhlolwa kokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasebenzi akufanele balindele ukuthi isigaba sokuhlola sizohlinzeka nganeliseko kubo bonke. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukuxoxisana ngokwenyusa amaholo nezihlolo ezintsha akusho nje ukuthi kukhona ukwenyusa amaholo kubo bonke abasebenzi kodwa kuyashintsha inqubo yokuhlola esivele ikhona ibe yindlela eyodwa. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le ndlela iyasetshenziswa. Ngemuva kwalokho, wonke umuntu uzoba nethuba lokwenza isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwesikhundla sabo uma bezwa ukuthi isigaba sabo asikhombisi kahle ubunjalo bomsebenzi wabo noma uma bezwa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ushintshile ngemuva kokuhlolwa kokuqala kwezikhundla. Izindawo zokuhlola zisezindaweni ezisemthethweni ezibekwe ukuze kusungulwe amaKomidi Wokuhlola Imisebenzi (PJECs) kuze kube yilapho inqubo yokuhlola iphelile. Zonke izigungu zamasipala zizoba Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi. Ezinye Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi zizokwenziwa yiKomidi Eliphezulu le-SALGBC ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiMnyango Wamasipala we-SALGBC. Lezi ziph
Iphrofayela Yomuntu: UThandiwe Mthethwa - Umphakathi Wokuxhumana UThandiwe Mthethwa, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, ungumuntu ophumelelayo, onobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi onothando lokuxhumana nabanye. Uthandiwe wazalwa eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika, lapho akhulela khona emndenini ophilayo, ogcwele uthando nolwazi. Uthandiwe ufunde eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona iziqu zeBachelor of Arts, ezihlanganisa izifundo ze-Communication and Media Studies. Lokhu kwamsiza ukuba aqonde kahle izindlela zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni we-digital. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThandiwe waqala umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, lapho aqala khona ukusebenza njengomxhumanisi wezokuxhumana enkampanini enkulu yokumaketha. Lapha, wathola ithuba lokusebenzisa amakhono akhe, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. UThandiwe ubelokhu ethanda ukuxhumana nabantu, futhi lokhu kumenze waba yinsika emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe waqala ukwakha ibhizinisi lakhe, elibizwa ngokuthi "Thandiwe Connect." Le nkampani igxile ekwakheni izixhumanisi eziphumelelayo phakathi kwezinkampani nabantu, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. UThandiwe uqonda ukuthi ama-social media awusizo kuphela uma abantu besebenzisa kahle lezi zinkundla ukuze baxhumane, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngalesi sizathu, uThandiwe uhlele izifundo ezikhethekile zokufundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela efanele. UThandiwe ungumuntu onomoya ophakeme, futhi uthanda ukusiza abanye. Uthanda ukuhamba emicimbini ehlukene, lapho ahlangana khona nabantu abasha, ababelana ngemicabango nemibono. Uthanda futhi ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, futhi ubona ama-social media njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. UThandiwe ubelokhu ethanda ukufunda, futhi njalo uzama ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe. Ngaphandle komsebenzi wakhe, uThandiwe ungumuntu onothando lwezobuciko. Uthanda ukufunda izincwadi, ikakhulukazi ezikhuluma ngempumelelo, ubudlelwano, kanye nezindlela zokuphila. UThandiwe ubelokhu ethanda ukuhamba, futhi uthokozela ukuvakashela izindawo ezintsha, lapho ahlangana khona nabantu abasha. Uthanda futhi ukudla, futhi uthokozela ukuhamba emakhaya, lapho athola khona ithuba lokuhlola izindlela zokuphila ezahlukene. UThandiwe ungumuntu onokholo oluqinile, futhi ubelokhu ethanda ukusiza abanye. Uthanda ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi ubelokhu ethanda ukwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. UThandiwe ubelokhu ethanda ukuxhumana nabantu, futhi ubona ama-social media njengendlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. UThandiwe ungumuntu onothando, onobuchwepheshe, futhi onokholo oluqinile, futhi ubona ukuthi ama-social media angaba yinsika enkulu empilweni yabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe uqhubeka nokwakha ibhizinisi lakhe, futhi ubelokhu ethola impumelelo enkulu. UThandiwe ungumuntu onomoya ophakeme, futhi ubelokhu ethanda ukusiza abanye. Uthanda ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi ubelokhu ethanda ukwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. UThandiwe ungumuntu onothando, onobuchwepheshe, futhi onokholo oluqinile, futhi ubona ukuthi ama-social media angaba yinsika enkulu empilweni yabantu. UThandiwe Mthethwa, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, ungumuntu ophumelelayo, onobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi onothando lokuxhumana nabanye. Uthandiwe ubelokhu ethanda ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi ubelokhu ethanda ukwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. UThandiwe ungumuntu onothando, onobuchwepheshe, futhi onokholo oluqinile, futhi ubona ukuthi ama-social media angaba yinsika enkulu empilweni yabantu. UThandiwe uhlala efuna izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa amakhono akhe, futhi ubelokhu ethanda ukusiza abanye, ukuze bonke bakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezinkulu ezivela ekuxhumaneni.
Kwakhanya ilanga elishisayo eNingizimu Afrika, umoya uthokozisa izihlahla eziphakeme. Emzaneni omncane, uMafikizolo, kwakuhlala umndeni ophilayo owaziwa ngothando lwabo lokupheka. UMaMkhize, umama wendlu, wayengumculi ophumelelayo, kodwa wayenothando olukhulu lokwenza uphuthu, isidlo esidumile esivela ezimpandeni zethu. Ngolunye usuku, wanquma ukwenza uphuthu olwakudala, olwakhiwe ngothando nemfundo ayitholile emndenini. UMaMkhize waqala ngokuhlanza izithako: ufulawa, ushukela, ubisi, kanye nezinye ezidingekayo. Wayazi ukuthi uphuthu luthanda ukunakekelwa, futhi wayezimisele ukwenza kahle. Uphuthu lwaluhamba phambili, umoya omuhle wawuhamba emzini, ubhiyozela izithako ezihlangene. Wabhalela izingane zakhe, uThandi noSipho, izinyathelo zokupheka. "Ningakhohlwa, izingane," esho, "ukupheka uphuthu kudinga uthando, futhi uthando lukhona lapho sabelana khona." UThandi noSipho babebonakala bejabule, bejabulisa umama wabo ngenkathi bephendula izinyathelo. UThandi, oneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, wayenothando lokuphendula izithako, kanti uSipho, oneminyaka eyisithupha, wayezama ukusiza ngokuhlanza izitsha. UMaMkhize wathokozisa izingane zakhe, wathi: "Niyizinkanyezi zami." Ngemuva kokupheka, uphuthu lwakhe lwalubukeka luhle, lukhanya ngombala ophuzi opholile. Wathatha isikhwama sokuphakela, waphaka uphuthu emathinini amancane, wathi: "Sizokwenza umkhosi, sizobamba umcimbi omkhulu." Umndeni wahlangana nabangani babo, umoya wawugcwele injabulo. UMaMkhize wabelana ngophuthu, wathi: "Nansi isidlo esikhethekile, esikhiqizwe ngothando." Abangani baphendula ngothando, bejabule ngalesi sidlo esisha. Uphuthu lwakhe lwathokozisa wonke umuntu, futhi umndeni wabo waba neqhaza elikhulu emzaneni. Wathola ukuthi uphuthu akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganyela, yokubumbana, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngaleso sikhathi, umoya wothando wawuhamba emzini, uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokuxhumanisa abantu. Ngemuva kokuphela komcimbi, wathola ukuthi uphuthu lwakhe lwalungaphezu kokudla. Wazi ukuthi uthando, ubudlelwano, nokuhlanganyela kwenza impilo ibe mnandi. UThandi noSipho babebonisa umama wabo ukuthi bazi kahle ukuthi uthando lukhona lapho kudliwa khona, futhi lokho kwaba yisifundo esibalulekile empilweni yabo. Umndeni wabo waba neqhaza elikhulu emzaneni, futhi uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi uphuthu akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Uthando lwabo lokupheka lwaluhamba phambili, umoya wothando wawuhamba emzini, uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokuxhumanisa abantu. Ngakho-ke, uphuthu lwakhe lwalungaphezu kokudla, lwalukhombisa ukuthi uthando lukhona lapho kudliwa khona. UMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi umndeni wabo waba neqhaza elikhulu emzaneni. Uthando lwabo lokupheka lwaluhamba phambili, umoya wothando wawuhamba emzini, futhi uMaMkhize waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukudla kungaba yindlela yokuxhumanisa abantu.
Amalungelo Abasebenzi Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elibizwa ngeKhaya Labasebenzi, lapho abathakathi benza imisebenzi yabo ngendlela ethile. Abantu bahlala behlupheka, benza imisebenzi enzima ngaphandle kokukwazi ukuncintisana ngemali eholeka kahle. Abasebenzi bebekhumbula ihlaya elithi, "Umsebenzi awupheli, kodwa amalungelo awanqamuki." Lezi zinkulumo zazithokozisa, kodwa zaziqhubele izinkumbulo ezinzima. UThandi, umphakathi ophuma ezindaweni ezinzima zokwakha, ungena emkhakheni wezokwakha ngemuva kokuphothula isikole. Ubaba wakhe wayengumakhi, futhi wayefisa ukuba nezehlo ezimnandi kwezokwakha. Kodwa, njengoba edlula ezindleleni ezicindezelayo zomsebenzi, wathola ukuthi izinto zenzeka ngandlela thize. Kanjalo, nakanjani, akazange azizwe ephephile. Kwakukhona uMgijimi, obengumholi weqembu abawusebenza neThandi. UMgijimi wayehamba phambili, efundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokulwela amalungelo abo. Wavuleka, wathi, "Abasebenzi, asiyiva imisebenzi yethu just ukuze kube nzima. Sinesikhala sokukhalipha, kufanele sazi ngalokho esikufanele khona." Kwakuyisikhathi sokuphakanyiswa, futhi uThandi waba nesifiso sokufunda. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uThandi wathola izinkampani zinezinyathelo eziphusile ukuxhashazela abasebenzi. Kwakukhona izinsuku ezinzima lapho bebebhapathizwa izikhwama ezinzima ngokuyisimanga, abanye beqhelelaniswa nezinye izinsiza. UThandi uthole ukuthi akukho sicelo sokuqashwa esihlala phezulu. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezenziwayo kodwa izici eziyinkimbinkimbi zikhona. Umgijimi wacela ukuthi uThandi ahlangane nabo bonke abasebenzi, ukuze baxoxe ngalesi simo. Bahlala bephahlazekile, behlakanipha, bezama ukuqonda ukuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngenhloso yokulwa. Babekhuluma ngamalungelo abashadile, ukuhamba phambili, nemali abangaka. Okwamukeleka uThandi, wayengafuni ukuphikelela ekutheni akwaphephi. Wenzele abanye abangane ababili, uSbusiso noNobuhle, abamtshela izindaba zabo. USbusiso washaywa ihlaya elingalindelekile: "Ngabe abafana banakwe loan? Bafaka amakhulelo emanzini." Ngenkathi njengoba bebe sephula amahlathi, uNobuhle wathi: "Ngabe sinendawo yokusizakala okufanele sibuyele kuyo?" Abangane baqinisekisa ukuthi baqonde ukuthi badinga ukukhanya ekubeni negalelo. Ngokukhuthazeka, uThandi wahamba naye uMgijimi, ebheka imigoqo ethile yamalungelo abasebenzi. Bafuna ukufaka izicathulo zomphakathi, begubha amalungelo okukhula. Umoya wabe usushisa, kanti baphila izivakashi zikhumbuzo zesiko lokulwa. Emva kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi imizamo yabo yenza umehluko. Izinkampani zaphuma zifuna izivumelwano ezinhle. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabulile, futhi babesebenzisa izinhlelo zomphakathi ukuxhumana nezinkampani. Iqhaza labangabezi kwezamabhizinisi lathola ukukhethwa ngezinga eliphezulu. UThandi wabona ukuhlangabezana nemigomo ethokozisayo. Umphakathi wakha imiphakathi. Ngenkathi uThandi efuna ukujoyina imisebenzi yezezimali, wabona umuntu omusha owayefuna ukwakha abadlali abahlukunyezwayo. USharon, uMphathi wezeMali, wasiza ekuhwebeni okuhle. Wathi, "Ningathanda ukuba nikhumbule, amalungelo abashadile akukhathazi? Qhubekani." Ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa unjalo, indlela yokwenza amalungelo. Ngokukhuthazeka, uThandi noMgijimi bahlola izimiso zendawo zokuhlala zabantu. Lokhu kwadlalela indima enkulu ekwakhiweni kokuhweba. Amakhono abefike ezandleni ezizimele, okwenza abavakashi bahlale bezisa bonke. Baphakanyiswa izinxenye njengomphakathi, behamba phambili ekukhuliseni abantu. Ngemva kokuhamba phambili, ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ubuhlakani bokuthi, ukushaywa kwezimali akuyona indlela yokuhlola ukusebenza okuhle. Waqonda ukuthi imizamo yokudlula kumalungelo eqiniso kuncike kubakaki bakhe. Umoya waba mncane, waphefumula enhliziyweni. UMgijimi, noSbusiso noNobuhle, banyathela emkhakheni wezokwakha, besincoma abanye basebenzi, besebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi ezinakekelwayo. UThandi wathola ukuthi amalungelo avalela lokho ababhakanayo, wenza umphakathi wonke umangalise. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abasebenzi akhunjuzwa, njengoba esehlisayo kubantu abazahlala isikhathi eside. Lokhu kwavuleka emandleni okwakha imiphakathi eshisayo, efuna ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho, ngokukhanya okukhanyayo, uThandi noMgijimi nesiqephu sabo babezongena ezintweni ezintsha ababewenza ukuze amalungelo abashadile akwazi ukuphakanyiswa. IKhaya Labasebenzi laqala ukuba nomqondo omuhle, futhi izinyathelo zaba phakathi kwezicathulo zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokukhumbula, isikhathi sokuhamba phambili - isikhathi sokubhekana nalolu hlangano.
Ukusekela Izilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni Uhlanga 1: Isingeniso Ngaphambi kokuthi siqale, ngithanda ukubonga ithuba lokuxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile yokwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni. Kulesi sikhathi sokuhlangana, sizobheka indlela ezilimi ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi isiNgisi nesiZulu, ezithinta ngayo izikhungo zethu, zifaka phakathi izikole, izikhungo zempilo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Ngabe izilimi eziningi zingasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano? Lokhu kuzoba yisisekelo sokuxoxa kwethu. Uhlanga 2: Ukubaluleka Kwezilimi Eziningi Ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi akusizi kuphela ekuxhumaneni, kodwa futhi kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emithonjeni yolwazi. Uma sikhuluma ngesiZulu, sikhumbula ukuthi leli zinga lezilimi lihlala linomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, ngicela ungithumele imibuzo mayelana nokubaluleka kokwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni. Uhlanga 3: Ukuxhumana Kwenhlalo Ngabe ungakuchaza kanjani ukuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi ezahlukene? Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukuxhumana okukhona phakathi kwezinye izilimi, ikakhulukazi isiNgisi nesiZulu, kudinga ukuba kube nezindlela ezihlukene zokuvula iminyango yokuxhumana. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngabe ubona kanjani umthelela wokwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni ezinjengezikole? Uhlanga 4: Izikhungo Zokufunda Ngokubheka izikole, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kubalulekile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Uma abafundi bekwazi ukufunda isiZulu, kungenzeka ukuthi bazinikele kakhulu ekufundeni isiNgisi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi izikole zethu zisebenzisa kahle le ndlela yokwesekwa kwezilimi? Uhlanga 5: Izikhungo Zempilo Ezikhungweni zempilo, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo olufanele. Uma umtholampilo ethola umuntu okhuluma isiZulu, kubalulekile ukuthi abe nezingcweti ezikwazi ukuxhumana naye kahle. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli ziqonda kahle izinqubo zempilo. Ngabe ubona izinselelo ezithile ezikhona kulokhu? Uhlanga 6: Umphakathi Nokubambisana Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi akukhona kuphela ezikhungweni, kodwa futhi nakumphakathi. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi izilimi zabo zihlala zibalulekile. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuhlonipha phakathi kwabantu, okwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi izikhungo zomphakathi zisebenzisa kahle lezi zindlela zokuxhumana? Uhlanga 7: Izinselelo Zokwesekwa Kwezilimi Noma kunjalo, kunezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nezikhungo lapho kuxoxwa ngalesi sihloko. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengabafundisi abakhuluma izilimi eziningi, kungaba yinkinga. Ngabe unayo imibono yokuthi singakwenza kanjani lokhu kube ngcono? Uhlanga 8: Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zethu ziqhubeke zisebenza ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokukhuluma izilimi zabo. Ngiyabonga ngokungihlanganisa kulolu daba olubalulekile, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle ezikhathini ezizayo.
Isithombe: U-Hlangabeza kanye neqembu elivela eBothaville nehlelo le-Grain SA lokuthuthukisa abalimi: Kusukela kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla ngu-Jane McPherson (umphathi wohlelo), u-Willie Kotzé (umqondisi wezokufundisa nolwazi), u-Debbie Nel (ukwesekwa kwehhovisi), u-Jenny Mathews (ikomidi eliphathisa: Grain SA), no-Nico Vermaak (umphathi: Isevisi Zenkampani, Grain SA). Sifinyelele ekupheleni konyaka omunye wokuxhaswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho kohlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi. Njengoba kwenzeka kwezinye izindawo ezithuthukayo, intuthuko kwesinye isikhathi ibonakala ihamba kancane - abanye abantu bafunda ngokushesha kodwa abanye bathatha isikhathi ukuze baphenduke ezindleleni ezintsha zokusebenza ukuze sifinyelele endaweni lapho singasho khona ukuthi sithuthuka. Kulo hlelo, sisebenza kanzima ukuthatha abalimi abakhona manje esimweni (okungafani nakwabanye) bese sibabeka esimweni esidingekayo lapho bengasho khona ngiyabalimi bezomnotho, ngimi ngiqinile futhi ngizophinda ngiqhubeke nomsebenzi wami wokulima. Imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwalolu hlelo ihlose ukubhekana nezidingo zabahlali abahlukene. Lolu hlelo lusaqhutshwa eBothaville. Ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somsebenzi se-Grain SA, uhlelo luhlelwa ngaphansi kwesigaba seSevisi Zenkampani esiphathiswa nguMnu. Nico Vermaak. Ihlobo elidlule belinzima kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwamanzi ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi sehlobo - kukhona abalimi abangenakutshala, abanye batshala kodwa abangenakuthola umkhiqizo, kanti ezinye izindawo zithole imvula ejwayelekile. Ngokuvamile abalimi batshala ngemali ebolekiwe - baboleka ezibankini noma ezinkampanini ezibolekayo imali yokulima (noma ama-Co-op amadala) - futhi abambalwa bathatha umshwalense ukuze bavikele inani lemali abawutshala ukuze baqale ngoba inzuzo iphansi futhi abafuni ukungena ezindlekweni ezengeziwe. Ngonyaka onjengalona, kukhona abalimi abathile abangenakukhokha izindleko zabo zokukhiqiza, ngakho-ke bahlupheka ukuthola imali yokutshala kabusha. Lapho sisebenza nabalimi abasafufusa abangenamali ethile, unyaka odlule ubeka ingozi enkulu engavimbela intuthuko yesikhathi esizayo ekwakheni abalimi bezomnotho. Uhlelo lwethu lwezinga eliphezulu lwabalimi luhamba kahle futhi sesethule abalimi abakhethiwe kuhlu lwethu lweMfundo yeAgribusiness. Sibona ukwethulwa kwalolu suku kanye nomsebenzi olandelayo njengokuphela kohlelo oluzosiza umulimisi ukuba abe umulimisi ongenayo. Lolu suku luhlanganisa lonke ulwazi olukhona oluvela kwezinye izifundo futhi luhlose ukukhombisa umulimisi izindawo okufanele agxile ekuthuthukiseni, izinto ezibalulekile uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla ngempumelelo ngesikhathi esifanele nangendlela efanele. Uhlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abalimi belugcwele eminyakeni eminingana - ngaphezu kwezifundo ezingama-80 kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2006 kuya kuSepthemba 30, 2007. Lezi zifundo zamukelwa kahle, abalimi babuyela futhi bacela ezinye izifundo. Lezi zifundo ziqhutshelwa kusukela kuFebhuwari kuya kuNovemba ngonyaka - kwesinye isikhathi abalimi baphithizela ezindaweni zabo zokulima futhi abanakho isikhathi sokuhambele izifundo. Ngesikhathi sehlobo, sizama ukubring abalimi iziboniso lapho bezama futhi ukwenza umsebenzi wokulima, futhi simema amalungu ezigaba zokufunda ukuba bahlangane, futhi sizama ukusiza umulimisi ngamunye ngokwehlukana. Siphinde sathola impendulo enhle evela kumagunya ababelana ngolwazi besebenza nezikhungo zezolimo futhi silindele ukusiza bona emnyakeni emisha yezezimali lapho kuzoba nezifundo ezengeziwe ezifundisa umsebenzi ophathekayo - ukusebenza emhlabeni ngezandla kube inselelo enkulu kulawa magunya, engakaze ibonise abalimi ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kahle. Siyaqhubeka nokusabalalisa ulwazi ku-Radio ezindaweni ezine: Lesedi, Motsweding, Ligwalagwala, kanye ne-Umhlobo Wenene - lokhu kuyindlela enhle yokuxhumana nabalimi - hhayi nje ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi mayelana nobuchwepheshe kodwa futhi ukwazisa abalimi ngemicimbi yalolu hlelo. I-Pula-Imvula iyaqhubeka - sekuwumsebenzi obalulekile walolu hlelo - ngakho-ke sithokozisa le miphumela uma siyibona iphrintiwe. Kukhona abantu abaningi abasebenza ukuze baqedele lo msebenzi - abanye basebenza ku-GSA, abanye bavela ku-ARC-GCI ePotchefstroom, abahleli bahlala bejolise ekuphothuleni umsebenzi wabo ngesikhathi, abanye basebenza ku-Infoworks (labo abahlola ukubhala kwethu nalabo abakhiqiza incwadi yezindaba oyifundayo), abahleli baqhubeka nokusebenza kulokho esikubhalayo nalabo abakhulisa izincwadi zezindaba - bonke basebenza ukuze bakhiqize incwadi yethu yezindaba nyanga zonke! I-Pula-Imvula iyamukelwa kahle kakhulu futhi labo abafunda ngayo bayanda - sesifinyelele ezinkopweni eziyi-16,500 ngenyanga, futhi lokhu kuyaqhubeka kukhula. Siphinde sibonge iMaize Trust ngokuxhasa uhlelo lwethu.
Isondlo se-sunflower siyinsimu ebaluleke kakhulu yokukhiqiza uwoyela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, ngokwesiko ikhiqiza cishe amathani angama-650,000 ngonyaka. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe uwoyela okuphezulu - 44% - iyingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza kwethu. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe uwoyela okuphansi - 25% kuya ku-38% - isetshenziswa ekubhakeni amakhekhe nasekudleni kwezinyoni. Ama-sunflower angakhula ezindaweni eziningi zelizwe lethu lapho imvula iphakathi kuka-475 mm no-675 mm ngonyaka. Nokho, kunoma iyiphi indawo, ukukhiqiza kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela ezokwenza inzuzo. Intengo ye-sunflower ikhule kakhulu muva nje, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi izohlala iphezulu unyaka wonke. Imbewu yekhwalithi ephezulu, efanayo ngaphandle kwembewu yezinambuzane kufanele icatshangelwe lapho kukhethwa izinhlobo zembewu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isivuno sakho asibanga engozini. Imbewu yokukhiqiza ephezulu yalo nyaka ayikwazi ukutshala futhi ngonyaka ozayo. Le mibewu izokhiqiza amakhanda amaningi, okwenza ukuvuna ngemishini kube nzima futhi kuholele ekukhiqizeni imbewu encane. Ukuqala kokushoda ezindaweni eziningi kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuya ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari kufanele kucatshangelwe ngokucophelela njengoba kubalulekile uma kukhethwa isikhathi sokutshala. Isikhathi sokuphuma kwe-sunflower sibalulekile ngoba ngalesi sikhathi izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi, futhi zingathinteka uma kwenzeka ukushoda. Ngakho-ke, isikhathi sokutshala kufanele sikhethwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuvinjwe ukuthi isikhathi sokushoda sihambisane nesikhathi sokuphuma kwezitshalo. Ingozi yokwehluleka kwesivuno iyanda uma ama-sunflower etshalwa emhlabathini owomile. Uma imvula ikahle ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokutshala, futhi umhlabathi unomswakama, ama-sunflower atshalwe kusenesikhathi anethuba elihle lokuphumelela. Isinqumo sokutshala kusenesikhathi noma ngemuva kuhambisana nenani lokunisela elitholakalayo emhlabathini. Umlando wokwenzeka kokushoda ngesikhathi sasehlobo kufanele futhi ucabangele. Nokho, awukwazi ukulinda isikhathi eside kakhulu ngoba ukwanda kokudla emibewwini kungase kwenzeke uma isimo sezulu sishisa, bese isivuno sincipha. Ngokuvamile, izikhathi zokutshala zingalandela le mikhombandlela: ezindaweni ezibandayo empumalanga, ungatshala kusukela ekuqaleni kukaNovemba kuya kwiveki yokuqala kaDisemba; ezindaweni ezisemaphakathi nezwe lethu, ungath开始 ukutshala evikini yokugcina kaNovemba kuze kube sekupheleni kukaDisemba; ezindaweni ezomile empumalanga, ungatshala kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuya ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari. Khumbula ukuthi uma utshala kakhulu ngemuva, kunganciphisa isivuno. Ama-sunflower angatshalwa ezindaweni ezijulile ezivela ku-2.5 cm kuya ku-5 cm, kuye ngohlobo lomhlabathi nesikhathi sokutshala. Ubude kufanele bube phezulu emhlabathini onzima (njengokhonkolo) kodwa bungaba buphansi emhlabathini ongenamahluko. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi imbewu itshalwe emhlabathini onomswakama owanele ukuze isize ekukhuleni. Kubalulekile ukuthi umhlabathi ube nokuxhumana okuhle nembewu. Sebenzisa indlela ethembekile yokutshala. Imbewu kufanele ibekwe ngezikhala ezifanayo nobude. Isikhala phakathi kwezitshalo sibalulekile ngoba izitshalo kufanele ziqhudelane ngendlela efanayo; akufanele kube khona ezinye ezisondele kakhulu ukuze ziqhudelane ngokudla nokukhanya. Inani lezitshalo ezingaphumelela endaweni ethile lihambisana nenani lokunisela elitholakalayo emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke kakhulu kunesikhala phakathi kwemigqa. Isikhala phakathi kwemigqa emapulazini athola imvula kuphela singaba phakathi kuka-0.91 m no-2.1 m noma 2.3 m. Lokhu kuzohambisana nohlobo lwemishini esetshenzisiwe kanye nendlela yokulima. Inani eliphansi kakhulu lezitshalo lizonciphisa ithuba lokukhiqiza, kodwa inani eliphezulu kakhulu lizokwenza izitshalo ziqhudelane, kuholele ekwehleni kwesivuno. Izitshalo ezisondele kakhulu zikhona amathuba amaningi okuthinteka yizifo (njengokubola kwemizi) futhi zikhona amathuba amaningi okwehla. Inani elinconyiwe lezitshalo (akufanele lingabi ngaphansi kwama-20,000 ezitshalo ngehektare kuzo zonke izindawo). (I-hektare ingama-100 amamitha ngo-100 amamitha). Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi ubungako bokutshala bulungiswe ukuze utshale ama-10% amaningi embewu kunenani elinconyiwe ngoba ezinye zizophumelela ukuvuna ngenxa yokushoda, umonakalo wezinsongo, nokucindezelwa komhlabathi ngemuva kwemvula enkulu ngesikhathi sokuqala sokuvuna. Ngempela, uma uthola ukuthi kunezitshalo ezingaphansi kwama-20,000 ngehektare, kufanele ucabangele ukutshala kabusha ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi esanele sokuvuna kahle.
Ezokuthengisa: Ukuhlola Izinguquko Nokwakha Ubudlelwano Obuqinile Ezokuthengisa, noma i-marketing, ziwumgogodla ophawulekayo emhlabeni wezohwebo. Njengoba izimakethe zishintsha, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi bahlale bephenya izindlela ezintsha zokufinyelela kubathengi. Lokhu kuhilela ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukuqonda izidingo zabathengi, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo namakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwesikhathi, izindlela zokuthengisa ziye zashintsha kakhulu. Kukhona izikhathi lapho abathengisi besebenzisa kuphela izikhangiso ezibhalwe phansi, kodwa namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhlinzeka ngezindlela eziningi zokuxhumana nabathengi. Izinkundla zokuxhumana, izikhangiso eziku-inthanethi, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza seziwumthombo obalulekile ekuthengiseni. Lokhu kudinga abathengisi ukuba babe nekhono lokuhlela izinhlelo zabo ngendlela efanele ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela izithameli ezibanzi. Okwamanje, abathengisi bahlola izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze baqonde izidingo zabathengi. Ukuhlola izimpendulo zabo, ukuqonda izitayela zabo, kanye nokubona ukuthi yini ethokozisa abathengi kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhiqizo iyahambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kudinga ucwaningo olujulile, futhi abathengisi kumele banake amandla okuhlaziya idatha ukuze benze izinqumo ezifanele. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo nabathengi busekelwe ekutheni umkhiqizo uyawuthokozisa yini umthengi. Abathengisi kumele bazi ukuthi akusikho kuphela ukuhweba, kodwa futhi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokwakha ukwethembana. Uma umthengi ezwa ukuthi umkhiqizo noma insizakalo iyamjabulisa, kungenzeka azobuyela, okwenza kube lula ukwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezihambisanayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala phambili emncintiswaneni. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha imikhiqizo emisha, ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Abathengisi kufanele bahlale befunda futhi bejolise ezintsha ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngento ethokozisayo kubathengi. Esikhathini esizayo, ubuchwepheshe buzoqhubeka nokuba nomthelela omkhulu ezokuthengisa. Imishini yokuhlaziya idatha, i-AI, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nabathengi. Lokhu kuzokwenza abathengisi bakwazi ukufinyelela kubathengi ngendlela engcono, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi eyingqayizivele. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengisi baqonde ukuthi, nakuba ubuchwepheshe buhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziningi, ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komthengi nomkhiqizo akukwazi ukufakwa endaweni yokusebenza. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buhamba phambili ekwakheni ukwethembana, futhi lokhu kudinga isikhathi, ukuzinikela, kanye nomqondo wokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, ezokuthengisa zidinga ukuba zihlale zishintsha, zifunde, futhi zikhule. Abathengisi kumele bazi ukuthi, ukuze baphumelele, kumele bahlale begxila kubathengi, baqonde izidingo zabo, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ibhizinisi eliqinile, elizokwazi ukumelana nezinguquko emhlabeni wezohwebo. Ekugcineni, ezokuthengisa akusikho kuphela ukuhweba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemikhiqizo nabathengi. Ngakho, abathengisi badinga ukuba bahlale bejolise ekwakheni izixazululo ezithokozisayo, ukuze baphumelele emncintiswaneni. Ubudlelwano obuqinile, ubuchwepheshe obusha, kanye nokuqonda izidingo zabathengi kuzoba yizinsika ezibalulekile zokuphumelela kwezokuthengisa.
Usibongile Victor Michael Mahlinza wazalwa e-Estcourt ngomhla ziyi-14 kuJulayi 1961, futhi wakhulela endaweni yaseNtabamhlophe (White Mountain). Uqale ukuya esikoleni samabanga aphansi ngo-1968 eCornfield Primary School. Ngonyaka ka-1976, waqala ukuya eMtshezi High School futhi waphothula ibanga leshumi nanye ngo-1982. Ngonyaka ka-1983, wathuthela eJohannesburg futhi wasebenza kumuntu ophakathi njengomphakathi. Wasebenza lapho unyaka owodwa. Ngemuva kwalokho, uVictor wasebenza enkampanini ye-chemicals eJohannesburg, lapho ayengumgibeli wezimpahla. Waphuma lapho ngo-1986. Kusukela ngo-1987 kuya ku-1988, uVictor wayengumshayeli wezimoto eM & L Distributors. Kusukela ngo-1989 kuya ku-1995, wathumela izimpahla ze-AMCA Construction. Ngonyaka ka-1996, uVictor wayefuna ukuba umproduci futhi wabuyela ekhaya. Uqale ukulima futhi wakhulisa izinkomo. Wathenga ithrekhtha ngo-2003. UVictor ushade noLinah, futhi banezingane ezinhlanu: amantombazane amathathu namadodana amabili. UFikile (26) unezingane ezimbili. USizwe (19) uphothule ibanga leshumi nambili ePietermaritzburg eZakhe Agricultural College, uphothulile nenkambo yokutshala imifino eBuhle College eDelmas, futhi okwamanje usebenza noVictor epulazini labo. UZandile (15) ukwiBanga lesi-9 eAbantungwa High School, kanti uMpumelelo (11) ukwiBanga lesi-4 eMathamo Primary School. UVictor uphinde ashade noNorah, futhi banezingane ezintathu: indodana eyodwa namantombazane amabili. U-Ayanda (24) uphothule ibanga leshumi nambili eMtshezi High School futhi uthole neziqu ze-N3 kuCivil Engineering eBerea Technical College eThekwini. U-Ayanda uphinde usebenze noBaba wakhe epulazini. Amantombazane, uThakasile (20) okwamanje ukwiBanga leshumi nanye eAbantungwa High School, kanti uBongeka (12) ukwiBanga lesi-6 eMathamo Primary School. UVictor unamathrekhtha amabili: iMassey Ferguson 440 4 x 4 kanye neMassey Ferguson 5465, futhi unemoto, iColt 2.8. Uzoqhubeka nokulima ngoba ukhulele ezindaweni zokulima. Unombono wesikhathi esizayo nenkani yokubhekana nezinselelo ezingase zivele kumuntu ofuna ukuba umproduci wokudla. Uthola kanjani imali yokutshala ezitshalweni zakhe? UVictor akaboleki imali kumuntu noma kuphi; usebenzisa imali yakhe. Lokhu okwamanje kuyinkinga ngoba usebenzisa kakhulu wonke amapulazi omndeni futhi uqasha amahektare angama-15 kumlimi ophakathi. Uthola kuphi izinto zokutshala? Uthenga zonke izinto ezidingekayo zokutshala e-TWK eWinterton futhi uthenga amakhemikhali e-Farmers Agri-Care eWinterton. UVictor uthenga imbewu kuPannar noma kuMonsanto, futhi bammukela kahle. Yisiphi isisebenzi esenzwa uhulumeni ekulimaleni, futhi benza kanjani lelo sisebenzi? UVictor ubona ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo endaweni ayilima uyawenza umsebenzi wawo futhi umsupporta ngezindlela eziningi. UMnyango Wezolimo kuleyo ndawo usize abalimi bakwazi ukutshala uSAB red maize. Impumelelo yakhe ekulimaleni ivela ekuhlelweni okuhle nasekusebenzeni kanzima. Yini engaba yingozi engavimbela intuthuko yakhe nempumelelo? Ubonile ukuthi inkinga enkulu evimbela intuthuko yakhe ukuthola imali eyanele yokuphatha kahle ukuvuna kwakhe kuze kufike emakethe. Izindleko zomsebenzi nazo zikhathaza kakhulu. Yiziphi izithuthukisi afuna ukuzifaka ekulimaleni? UVictor angathanda ukuthuthukisa ukulima kwezinkomo nezinkukhu ngoba ubona ukuthi kuzomsupporta ukutshala kwakhe. Izinqumo zakhe zokuphumelela kulo nyaka zifaka ukulima ngezithako ezihlukahlukene; okwamanje unenkontileka neNestle yokutshala u- maize, ama-beans omisiwe, kanye nemifino ye-chicory.
Uhlelo lweGrain SA Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhlala luzama ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano nawe - umkhiqizi wezithako zokudla. Izindlela ezahlukene zisetshenziswa ukufinyelela kubakhiqizi, njengephephabhuku lePula Imvula, imisakazo ye-radio, ama-DVD, amabhroshya, amaposta, kanye namaphampu wolwazi. Sihlanganisa, sithumele amakhophi, futhi sabelane ngalesi sithangami kubalimi njalo ngenyanga (sinamakhasi angu-8 futhi siqukethe izithombe ezinemibala) ngalezi zilimi: isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiNorther Sotho, isiXhosa, nesiZulu. Ukushicilelwa kwePula Imvula kwenzeka njalo ngenyanga - okuqukethwe okubhalwe phansi kulungiswa ngesiNgisi, bese kuthunyelwa ku-Infoworks lapho kulungiswa khona isampula yalokho ozokubona nokufunda ngesiNgisi. Okuqukethwe okubhalwe phansi kulungiswa ngendlela efanele ukuze kuhlolwe kahle, bese kuthunyelwa kubahumushi abaninzi. Lokhu kubuyiselwa ku-Infoworks ukuze kufakwe imibhalo ehunyushiwe ezindaweni ezifanele. Uma kutholakala ukuvunywa kokuthi konke kulungile, kuthunyelwa ukuphrinta bese kuthunyelwa kuwe. Konke lokhu kungathatha cishe izinyanga ezimbili. Kule nyanga sikhulise iPula Imvula, futhi manje sekukhona nezinye izigaba esikhuluma ngazo - kukhona amakhasi amane ngaphezulu kokujwayelekile ngoDisemba, uMashi, uJuni, noSepthemba okukhuluma Ngokukhiqizwa Kwe-Maize eFree State Province. Ukuxhaswa kwezimali kwalezi zikhasi kusekelwa yiWinter Cereals Trust. Amakhasi amane engeziwe ahlanganiswe noJanuwari, u- April, uJulayi, no-October okukhuluma ngokukhiqizwa kweSoybeans, kusekelwa yi-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane kubo bonke abafuna ukuthola ulwazi ngama-programs nalabo abasebenza kuma-programs - kunabalimi abaningi nezikhulu ababelana ngemininingwane okufanele bathole ulwazi ngama-programs, izinhlobo zama-programs, nokuthi ubani okukhulumayo uma befuna ulwazi oluningi (lamaphampu kufanele atholakale kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11). Lamaphampu wezaziso alungiswa futhi amakhophi enziwa ngolimi lwezingu-7 (isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiXhosa, isiZulu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, nesiNorther Sotho). Lamaphampu ayatholakala eNAMPO futhi azosetshenziswa njalo ngoJanuwari. I-DVD yemizuzu engu-8 ehlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nohlelo isetshenziswe kahle kule nyanga. Phakathi kweNAMPO, samema "abangane bohlelo" ukuze sibonise i-DVD, futhi bayithokozile. Sathumela amakhophi e-DVD kubaphathi bohlelo bezifunda kanye nabafundisi, abawasebenzisa njalo. Eqenjini lokufunda eFree State, uJohan Kriel wakhombisa i-DVD, futhi abalimi bacela ukuyibona kathathu - bajabule ukubona ukuthi uhlelo luhamba kanjani. Amabhroshya avulekile ayathuthukiswa futhi azosetshenziswa ngabaphathi bezifunda emihlanganweni yeqembu lokufunda nasezinsukwini zabakhiqizi. Siphinde sithumele imisakazo njalo ngesonto eziteshini ezine ze-radio ukuze sithumele ulwazi lokukhiqiza kubabukeli abaningi.
Isahluko 1: Uhlanga Lwezimoto Kwazulu-ngaphakathi, lapho umoya ubhalela izinkanyezi phezulu, kwaphuma imoto eyayihlekisa futhi ibhanga okukhulu embusweni wezimoto. Ngaleso sikhathi, izimoto zazingawubuyeli emuva, kodwa iMercedes-Benz, le mpumelelo yokwazisa, yayiyinyoni ebhalela izinkanyezi zayo emkhathini wezobuchwepheshe. Isigaba sokuqala saqala ngo-1926, lapho uKarl Benz, umphakathi wesikhumbuzo, ahlanganyela noGottlieb Daimler. Lezi zimbangi zashintsha umhlaba wezokuthutha, zenza izimpumelelo eziyingqayizivele ezahluka kakhulu. Isahluko 2: Imoto Yokuqala Kwavela imoto yokuqala yeMercedes-Benz, iModel O, ebelokhu ivusa ukudideka phakathi kwabantu. Imoto ethokozisayo, eguquguqukayo, yanyatheliswa nothengisa, yahamba ngendlela eyahlukahlukene. Abantu babenokubona kahle ukuthi le moto yayihamba phambili. Abantu babephupha ngokuyisebenzisa, kuyiwa emkhakheni wezokuthokozisa - okwakungekho phambili. Amazwi athokozisayo aphuma emlonyeni wabo, asho ukuthi le mhlaba izoshintsha imikhakha ethe xaxa. Isahluko 3: Ukuvusa Umcabango Njengathi abantu bebebonisa uthando lwezimoto, iMercedes-Benz yaphuma nezinye izimodeli ezahlukene. I-S-Class, i-E-Class, kanye ne-C-Class zashintsha umqondo wokuthi imoto kumele ibe kanjani. Lezi zimodeli ziye zafaka izinhlelo ezihamba phambili, izithuthi ezikhethekile, nezinhlelo zokuphepha. Bangujwayelani abahamba ezimotweni ezizimele, abakwazi ukuhamba bethembele kumafaneleka nezifiso. Imoto yabe iyisikhumbuzo sokuphila kwabantu, kwaphoqeleka ukuba bonke babe nethuba lokubona umhlaba ngamehlo amasha. Isahluko 4: Ukuhlola Umhlaba Njengoba iminyaka yehla emhlabeni, iMercedes-Benz yahlola izimakethe eziphuma phezulu. Iza nezimoto zayo eziningi emhlabeni wonke, zishiya umthelela omkhulu ezimweni zempilo zabantu. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo kulezi zimoto ezinhle. Umoya wendabuko wawududuzile, njengoba abathandi beMercedes-Benz behamba emigwaqweni, behamba bezama ukukhipha umoya omusha. Izithombe ezinhle zikhala izithombe ezithokozisayo, zenza abantu babonakale ikakhulukazi, begqoka kahle, bejabulile. Isahluko 5: Ukuhlanganyela Empowerment Emkhakheni wezokuthutha, iMercedes-Benz ibiyilokhu isebenza ngamandla, ikhipha imikhiqizo eyinde phakathi kwezithuthi. Umhlaba ubonisa ukuguquguquka, futhi iMercedes-Benz yenza kube lula ukuze izimvume ziqhubeke. Ubuchwepheshe bezimoto buphuthumile, izimakethe zinokuhamba phezulu, futhi imoto I-GLE ibonisa ukushesha nezimo ezinhle. Izithuthi ezithuthukisiwe zihlala ziphakamisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuhlinzeka abathusi ngezimfanelo ezinhle ngaphambi kokuthi baphume. Isahluko 6: Isixuku Safika Nansi-ke, ekugcineni, umcimbi omkhulu weMercedes-Benz uhamba phambili, umcimbi ohlonishwayo ohlanganisa abalandeli bayo abavela kuzo zonke izinkanyezi. Umoya uhlele umhlaba ukuze bahlale benomsebenzi kanye nezimoto ezinzima. Abantu balathwa izinhlaka, babamba izithombe, beshintsha imicabango, bejabulela ukuhamba phambili. Umbukiso ubaholela bekhuluma ngezifiso zabo, kubonakale ukuthi imoto iyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabo. Kwavela umfutho onamandla, imicabango ibanjwe, izinkanyezi zikhanya. Isahluko 7: Ukuqhubeka Phambili Ngemva kwalokho, iMercedes-Benz iyakwazi ukuqalisa ikusasa elisha, ithatha izinyathelo ezinhle nezicacile, ebonisa imizwa yezenzo ezithile. Imoto isazophela kancane kancane ibonisa umdlandla, ikhipha izihlahla, ibalema, ibhalisela izinkanyezi. Abantu babephakamisela izikhali, belindele ukufinyelela esikhathini senkululeko, bejabulile emizweni yabo. Le mikhakha ifakazela ukuthi iMercedes-Benz izaphephisa isizukulwane esizayo, iqoqa udumo kanye nethuba lokuhlala kuzo zonke izikhalazo, njengoba ikhuluma ngalobu buhle obuphelele bempilo. Isahluko 8: Umoya Wokugcina Ngaphakathi kwemoto zeMercedes-Benz, abantu bakwazi ukuthola umoya ophumayo. Umoya opheleleyo, omkhulu, uhlelekile. Emahlathini, eqhuba, izinyoni zishaya izibhakabhaka; zebhange ziya phezulu, ziveza ukuthi lokho kuhjuma kudinga ukufiphalisa iminwe. Isithombe sakhanya, saguqulwe kwaze kwaba khona umoya olawulwa ababhikishi. IMercedes-Benz illokhu ingumqondisi, uze ufike kuzo zonke izinkanyezi, ubukisisa umhlaba wonke, njengoba iba yinsika ebalulekile yokuthinta impilo yabantu. Imoto ayisiyona nje isithuthi; but ona, ibhalela izinkanyezi emkhathini wezobuchwepheshe, ikhuluma ngothando lokholo, ihamba phambili kuzo zonke izinsuku. IMercedes-Benz ithokozisa umhlaba wonke, ibhalela izindaba zayo emoyeni, izinkanyezi ezikhanya ngobunono. Kwakuthoma konke, kanti isigqi siba sesiqhubeka, sikhumbula zonke lezi zinkanyezi ezithokozisayo.
Ukubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezibhedlela Ngaphakathi kwezwe lethu, ubunjalo bezempilo buhlobene kakhulu nokubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela. Le nqubo ibaluleke kakhulu, ngoba ihlola ukuthi iziguli zithola kanjani usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Ukubhaliswa kweziguli akusiyona nje indlela yokugcina imininingwane, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile ethinta impilo yomuntu ngamunye, umndeni, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ukuqala Kwenqubo Lapho isiguli sifika esibhedlela, sithola ukwamukela okukhulu. Umsebenzi wokuqala wokuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo sokwelashwa sithathwa ngok serious, kubalulekile ukuthi iziguli ziqonde kahle le nqubo. Ukubhaliswa kuqala ngokuthola imininingwane eyisisekelo, efaka phakathi igama, ubudala, ikheli, nenombolo yokuxhumana. Lezi zinto zibalulekile ukuze kubhalwe umlando wezempilo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Umlando Wezempilo Ngemuva kokubhaliswa kwemininingwane eyisisekelo, isiguli sicele ukuchaza umlando wezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze odokotela bazi kahle ukuthi iziguli ziye zaba nezinkinga ezithile ngaphambili, noma zinezifo ezithile ezidinga ukunakwa. Umsebenzi walesi sigaba uwukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwesiguli nodokotela. Ukuvuma ukuxoxa ngempilo yakho akulula, kodwa kuyadingeka ukuze kube nezixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuhlolwa Nokunakekelwa Ngemva kokubhaliswa, isiguli sithola ukuhlolwa. Lokhu kuhilela izinyathelo ezithile zokuhlola impilo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola izimpawu, ukucacisa izinkinga, kanye nokwenza izivivinyo ezidingekayo. Abahlengikazi nabodokotela bahlola iziguli ngeso lokhozi, bezama ukuqonda kahle isimo sabo. Lokhu kuhlola akusiyona nje indlela yokunquma ukuthi yini edingekayo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwezokwelapha neziguli. Ukwaziswa Nokuxhumana Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, iziguli zithola ulwazi olunembile mayelana nezinyathelo ezilandelayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze ziqonde kahle ukuthi yini ezilindele. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezokwelapha neziguli kudinga ukuba kube sobala, ukuze iziguli zikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile mayelana nezempilo yazo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abahlengikazi nabodokotela badinga ukuxhumana kahle, beqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli ziyaqonda. Ukubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezingasebenzi Kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezikude, ukubhaliswa kweziguli kungaba yinkinga. Abanye bangase babe nezithiyo ezithile, ezifana nokungabi nekhadi lokuqinisekisa, noma ukungabi nolwazi olukhona. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokubhalisa, ukuze bonke abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Izibhedlela kumele zibe nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokubhalisa, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi akekho ohlushwa yizithiyo zokungena. Izimo Ezithile Zokubhaliswa Kukhona izimo ezithile lapho iziguli zingabhaliswa ngokuqondile. Lokhu kungenzeka uma isiguli sithola usizo lwezempilo ngokushesha, noma uma kudingeka ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Kulokhu, abahlengikazi badinga ukuba bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi isiguli sithola usizo oludingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nokwaziswa okuhle kwezokwelapha. Ukwenza Izinqumo Zokwelashwa Ngemva kokubhaliswa, iziguli zidinga ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nokwelashwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze ziqonde kahle ukuthi yini ezilindele. Uhlelo lokwelashwa kumele lube nolwazi olunembile, ukuze iziguli zikwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Abodokotela badinga ukuba baphendule imibuzo, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli ziyaqonda izinketho ezitholakalayo. Ukwelashwa Nokubuyiselwa Ngemva kokwenza izinqumo, iziguli ziyaqhubeka nokwelashwa. Le nqubo ibalulekile ekubuyiselweni kwempilo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, iziguli zidinga ukulandela iziqondiso ezithile, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zibuya empilweni. Abodokotela nabahlengikazi badinga ukuba babe khona ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli ziyaqhubeka nokuthola usizo oludingekayo. Isiphetho Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela akusiyona nje inqubo yokugcina imininingwane, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile ethinta impilo yomuntu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezokwelapha neziguli. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi impilo yethu iyathuthuka. Kumele sihloniphe le nqubo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu bazi ukuthi bangafinyelela kanjani ezinsizeni zezempilo.
Le nsizakalo inikeza ulwazi lokuthi ungabhalisela ukuba ngumthumeli ngaphandle kwelizwe neMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ifomu lokufaka isicelo kumele liqedwe ngumfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke samukelwe. Sicela ubheke imihlahlandlela yokufaka isicelo ukuze ukwazi ukusiza inqubo yokuthola ilayisensi. Bheka ibhokisi le-Importer ngaphansi kokubhaliswa bese ubonisa ukuthi uzobe uthumela izimpahla e-United States of America ngaphansi kwesivumelwano se-AGOA. Ingxenye yeMvume yokufaka isicelo kumele igcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo uma efaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengomsebenzisi we-rebate. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ethengisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube yilowo ophakathi kwalesi sigaba. Lapho kukhona lesi sikhombisi (), susa lokho okungafanele. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Gcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika eliseduzane. Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi esikhishwe nguMlawuli Wezinkampani noma uMphakathi Wenkantolo uma kunguMtrust. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento ye-rebate 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye no-607.04. Ibhizinisi - bonke abaphathi, kuhlanganise noMphathi Omkhulu noMphathi Wezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salensizakalo. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala. Uhlobo Lwabathengi Bokubhaliswa 4A2 - Umthumeli, DA 185.
Imiphumela yokubambisana kwe-Life Esidimeni Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imicimbi ebalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo ibenze umthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Okwenzeka e-Life Esidimeni kwaqala njengohlelo lokuhlala, kodwa kwagcina sekuba yinkinga enkulu ngenxa yokungahambisani nemigomo ethile yokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekuhlukanisweni kwabantu abaninzi ezikhungweni zokuphumula, okuvuselela ukucaciswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zempilo. Ngemuva kokuphikisana nokuhlukumezeka, kwavulwa ithuba lokuxazulula izinkinga ngendlela engemthethweni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komcimbi wokulamula ogxile ekutholeni izixazululo ezizuzisayo kubantu abathintekayo. Umcimbi obalulekile kule nqubo kube yisigameko sokuqala sokubhekelela izinkinga ezitholakala ezikhungweni zezeMpilo, lapho iziguli zophila zaziwa ngokuqhathwa. Ekuqaleni, imisebenzi yokulamula ibihlose ukuphucula izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bathola induduzo. Lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Abamele umphakathi, izikhungo zempilo, neminyango ezinzima bekwazi ukuhweba ngempumelelo ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zamalungelo abantu abathintekayo. Ukuqala kwezinkulumo kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwecala elihle lokuxoxa ngemicabango ehlukeneyo. Uhlelo lokwamukela izikhalazo lwaluhlose ukugqugquzela umbono wokuthi imiphumela efanele kuncike emgomeni ohlangene. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezinzima ezithinta iziguli, kufaka phakathi ukungabi namathuba okulawulwa kwezempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nomdlandla wokwabelana ng experiences zabo, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethuthukisayo eyasiza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yeziguli ezikwi-Life Esidimeni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqhakambisa amalungelo abantu, kanye nezinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela iziguli ezibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Umphakathi wahlanganyela ekwenzeni izicwangciso ezithile ezibheke phambili. Uhlelo lokuhlola izimpilo, ukuhweba ngempumelelo, kanye nokuhlangabezana kokufundisa abathintekayo kwavela njengezici ezibalulekile zokuzama ukuphendula lesi simo. Izidingo zempilo zabantu zafakwa eziphethweni ezithakazelisayo, kwaholela ekutheni imiphumela yokulamula ku-Life Esidimeni ingene ngempela emiphakathini ejabulayo. Ngokuphumelela kokuzenzakalelayo, umcimbi wokulamula ubeke isibonelo sokuthi empeleni kwenzeka kanjani ukuhweba ngempumelelo ezindabeni ezinzima. Ukufundisa kanye nezifundo ezatholakalayo zabe ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezidingekayo zisunguliwe ukuze kubhekwe izimpilo ezifuna ukwenziwa, okuhlinzeka nogqozi lwempilo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izikhungo ezithuthukisiwe zempilo, ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okuthola amalungelo abantu, nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi bonke abathintekayo bathola ukwelashwa okufanele. Izingozi neziphukhuphuku ezibandakanyekayo kule miphumela ziqhuba umcabango odinga ukwenziwa. Lokhu kuvumele ukugxila ekubuyiseni kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela iziguli ezihloniphekile. Umphakathi ube senkambisweni yokubuyiseka, kwazulu kumele kube nefuthe elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu. Ngokuphetha, imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni isivele ijwayele ukubaluleka okukhulu emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zezempilo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bahlala bemthokozisa, futhi bakwazi ukuthola impilo enempilo, kulindeleke ukwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, kudinga ukuba nezinye izinyathelo ezijulile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kuhlola kwempilo akupheli kuphela, kepha kuhlale kuqhuba phambili imiphakathi ukuze ibhekane nezinkinga ezithinta abantu. Umlando uzohlala ukhuluma ngalezi zinyathelo ezibalulekile ezithintekayo, njengoba kuyinto ebalulekile ephezu kwezincwadi ezikhuluma ngempilo. Ngamafuphi, ukubhalwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthuka kwempilo nokukhuthazwa kwemigomo ethuthukisayo kumele kube sezingeni eliphezulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela yokulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni ayisizi kuphela, kepha iphinde ibeke isizinda esiqinile sokuphila kwemiphakathi emisha.
Isibopho Selungu Ngolwazi Olungamanga Ngiyanibingelela, futhi ngifuna ukwazisa ngendaba ebalulekile ethinta wonke amalungu eGEMS. Njengoba sazi, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile yokunakekela impilo, kodwa kunezibopho ezithile ezihambisana nokuba yilungu. Kulokhu, sizobe sikhuluma ngolwazi olungamanga, nokuthi lokhu kungaba nemiphumela emibi kumalungu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yini eyaziwa ngokuthi "ulwazi olungamanga." Lokhu kungaba yizinto eziningi, njengokufaka izinsiza ezingekho, ukungazisi kahle ngezimo zempilo, noma ukusebenzisa amafomu angalungile. Lokhu akukhona nje ukungathembeki, kodwa kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezindlekweni zokwelashwa. Ngabe ubuwazi ukuthi uma ungafaki ulwazi oluchanile, ungase ube nesibopho sokukhokha izindleko eziphakeme? I-GEMS iyadinga ulwazi oluqondile ukuze ikwazi ukuhlela izinsiza zayo ngendlela efanele. Uma ulwazi lungalungile, kungaholela ekutheni uthole ukwelashwa okungafanele, noma ngisho nokungatholi ukwelashwa uma kudingeka. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umalungu efaka isicelo sokwelashwa kodwa engakaze akhulume ngempilo yakhe yangaphambilini, lokhu kungaba yinkinga. Uma uthola ukwelashwa okuthile, kodwa iGEMS ithola ukuthi bekukhona okuthile okungafanele, ungase ube nesibopho sokukhokha lezo zindleko. Lokhu akukhona nje okukhathazayo, kodwa kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iGEMS inezinqubomgomo ezithile ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayawazi umthwalo wawo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyifake, ungase ube nesibopho sokukhokha izindleko eziphakeme. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukufunda kahle izinqubomgomo zeGEMS, ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi yini elindelekile kuwe njengelungu. Kukhona nezinye izindlela zokuvikela wena njengelungu. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luyiqiniso, ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokuxhumana neGEMS ngqo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uthole izeluleko ezichanile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luhambisana nezidingo zakho. Uma ungazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele uyifake, ungase ucabangele ukufuna usizo kumeluleki wezempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqonde kahle izinqubo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luyiqiniso. Akukho okungcono kunokuxhumana nabantu abanolwazi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo olufanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iGEMS izokwenza izinguquko ezithile ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi amalungu ayazi kahle izibopho zawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi wonke umuntu aqonde kahle ukuthi yini elindelekile, futhi kuzovikela amalungu ekubeni nesibopho sokukhokha izindleko eziphakeme ngenxa yolwazi olungamanga. Ngokuphetha, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke amalungu eGEMS aqonde kahle izibopho zawo. Ulwazi olungamanga lungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, futhi kubalulekile ukufunda kahle izinqubomgomo zeGEMS. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukuxhumana neGEMS ngqo noma ukufuna usizo kumeluleki wezempilo kungasiza kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe luyiqiniso. Qhubeka uqaphele, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphakeme. Ngiyabonga ngokulalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqonde kahle izibopho zakho njengelungu leGEMS. Hamba kahle!
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuwumcimbi obuhlungu, obuholela emiphumeleni emibi ezimpilweni zabantu abancane. Lokhu kuhlukunyezwa kungaba ngezindlela ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, nangokocansi. Izizathu zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane zihluke kakhulu, zifaka phakathi izimo zomndeni, izinkinga zomnotho, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Ukuze siqonde kangcono le ndaba, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, imiphumela yakhona, kanye nezindlela zokuvikela izingane kulokhu kuhlukunyezwa. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kubonakala njengokubopha, ukuhlinzwa, noma ukuhlinzwa okungafanele. Lezi zenzo zihlala zenzeka emakhaya, lapho izingane zihlala khona nabazali noma abakhulisa. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba kuvame ukuhamba ndawonye nokuhlukunyezwa ngokwengqondo, lapho izingane zihlukunyezwa ngemicabango emibi, ukwehliswa, noma ukungabaziswa. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izingane zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu empilweni, okuhlanganisa ukungathembi, ukwesaba, nokuba nobudlelwano obunzima nabanye. Ngokwengeziwe, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ngokocansi kubonakala njengomsebenzi ophikisana nemigomo yokuziphatha, okuholela ekutheni izingane zibe nezinselelo ezinzima zokuphila. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi akuhlanganisi kuphela izenzo eziphikisana nomthetho, kodwa futhi kuhlanganisa nokungabi nendaba nokuphathwa kabi kwengane. Lezi zenzo zibhubhisa imizwa, ziphazamise ukukhula komqondo, futhi zishiya izingane zinesizungu esinzima. Imiphumela yokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane ibonakala emiphumeleni eminingi ehlukene. Izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zihlala zikhathazekile, zinezinselelo zokukhula, futhi ziba nezinselelo zokuphila ezinzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, njengokukhathazeka, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuphazamiseka emiphakathini, okubangela izinkinga ezinkulu ezithinta umphakathi wonke. Ukuze siqedele le miphumela emibi, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uthathe izinyathelo ezinqala zokuvikela izingane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abazali nabasebenzi bezempilo mayelana nezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa komphakathi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa izingane ezihlukunyezwayo. Izikhungo zokuxhasa zingaba nesandla esikhulu ekusizeni izingane, zinikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukubhekana nemiphumela yokuhlukunyezwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikelwa kwezingane kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele. Ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezibambisene zokuvikela izingane, eziqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukuhlukunyezwa, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izingane zikhula zikhululekile, zikhululekile, futhi ziphila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyinkinga enkulu edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akukhona nje kuphela ukwephula umthetho, kodwa kuyaphula amalungelo abantu abancane. Umphakathi kufanele ube nesibopho sokuvikela izingane, ukuze zikwazi ukukhula zikhululekile futhi ziphile impilo enempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile, ukuze siqedele le nkinga engathandeki, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izingane zethu zikhula zikhululekile, ziphilile, futhi zinekusasa eliqhakazile.
Izimpi Zomlando: Ukuhlola Izikhathi Zokulwa Nezinguquko Emhlabeni Izimpi zomlando zibalulekile ekuchazeni indlela yokuphila kwabantu, izinqumo abazithathayo, kanye nezinguquko eziphakathi kwezimpilo zabo. Lezi zimpi, ezivame ukugqama emlandweni, zikhombisa izizathu ezahlukene ezingaholela ekulweleni, kuhlanganisa nezombusazwe, ezomnotho, nezamasiko. Izimpikiswano Nezizathu Zokulwa Izimpi ziqala kaningi ngenxa yezimpikiswano ezinzima phakathi kwamazwe noma izizwe. Ngokwesibonelo, iMpi Yezwe I, eyenzeka phakathi kuka-1914 no-1918, yaqala ngenxa yokungaboni ngeso linye phakathi kwamazwe amakhulu aseYurophu. Izizathu zalesi simo zifaka izinkinga zezimali, ubudlelwano bezepolitiki, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha izindawo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibuso emikhulu, okwakuholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu emhlabeni. Ngokuphambene, iMpi Yezwe II, eyenzeka phakathi kuka-1939 no-1945, yathinta izwe lonke, lapho izizathu zayo zihlanganisa ukunganeliseki kwabantu ngemiphumela yeMpi Yezwe I, nezinhlelo zokwakha ubumbano lwemibuso. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izikhali ezinzima, okwaholela ekulahlekelweni impilweni kwabantu abaningi. Imiphumela Yokulwa Imiphumela yezimpi ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi kumiphakathi eyahlaselwa. Ngemuva kwempi, izwe libhekana nezinguquko ezinkulu, ezihlanganisa ukuphuculwa kwemithetho, izinguquko kwezombusazwe, kanye nokwakhiwa kabusha kwezomnotho. Ngokwesibonelo, emva kweMpi Yezwe II, umhlaba waphenduka waba nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo zokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwamazwe, okuholele ekwakhiweni kwe-United Nations. Nokho, izimpi zikhumbuza abantu ngezindleko ezinzima zokulwa. Abantu abaningi baphila ngezinkathazo, futhi izimpilo zishintsha kakhulu. Izindawo eziningi ezathintekile zadinga isikhathi eside ukuze zibuyiselwe emuva, futhi izizukulwane eziningi zikhumbula ubuhlungu bezimpi. Izifundo Ezinzima Izimpi zomlando zifundisa abantu ngezifundo ezinzima, ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ukubheka emuva, abantu bazi ukuthi ukuxhumana, ukuvumelana, nokubambisana kubalulekile ukuze kugwenywe izimpi. Imiphumela emibi yezimpi ibonisa ukuthi ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokuxoxisana kungaba yindlela engcono yokuthola izixazululo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo ukuze balwe, kodwa futhi zikhumbuza ukuthi lezi zinsiza zingasetshenziswa ekwakheni izinto ezinhle. Umhlaba udinga abantu abakhumbula lezi zifundo ukuze baphile ngokuhlonipha, ubumbano, nokuthula. Isiphetho Izimpi zomlando zihlala zibalulekile ekuqondeni indlela umhlaba osebenza ngayo. Zifundisa abantu ngezinto eziningi, kusukela ezizathwini zokulwa, imiphumela yokulwa, kanye nezifundo ezitholakala kulokhu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlola lezi zikhathi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimpi azikhethi, futhi umphakathi kufanele usebenze ngamandla ukuze ugweme izimpi ezizayo. Ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuhlonipha izinkolelo nezamasiko abanye, kuzosisiza ekwakheni umhlaba onokuthula. Ngakho, izimpi zomlando akukhona kuphela ukulwa, kodwa zikhumbuza abantu ngempilo, uthando, kanye nezifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala ezikhathini ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokufunda, ukukhumbula, nokuhlose ukuphila ngokuthula.
Umdanso: Iziqu zokuDansa Ngendlela Ekhanyayo Isingeniso Umdanso, okungukuthi, umkhuba wokuhamba nokuziphatha ngempela, unomlando omude eNingizimu Afrika. Umdanso awuwona nje umkhuba wezokungcebeleka, kodwa uhilela imizwa, isiko, namasiko ahlukene. Kulokhu, sizobheka indlela zokudansa ezihlukene, izinyathelo ezivamile, kanye nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze udansise kahle. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Umdanso Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuhamba, kubalulekile ukuzilungiselela. Qala ngokukhetha indawo efanele—indawo enokuthula, enendawo enkulu yokuhamba. Qiniseka ukuthi ungena endaweni enokukhanya kahle, ukuze ungaboni kahle izinyathelo zakho. Ngemuva kwalokho, bheka ukuthi worethayisha izingubo ezifanele zokudansa. Izingubo zakho kufanele zibe lula futhi zithambe ukuze ungalahlekelwa yikhono lakho lokuhamba. Nikeza umoya wakho isikhathi sokuphumula, futhi uvule umoya wakho ngokuqhuba izifundo zezemidlalo noma zokuzivocavoca, ukuze uthole amandla. Isinyathelo 2: Ukufunda Izinyathelo Zokuqala Uma usulungile, qala ukufunda izinyathelo ezilula. Umdanso ungahluka kakhulu, kodwa izinyathelo ezilula zingakwenza uqale kahle. Bheka izinyathelo ezilula ezinjengezinyathelo ze “two-step” noma “box step.” Lokhu kuyizinyathelo ezilula eziyisisekelo ezikhuluma ngokuhamba phambili, emuva, nasemaceleni. 1. Two-step: Hamba phambili nenyawo elilodwa, bese uphinde ulandele nenyawo lesibili. 2. Box step: Qala ngenyawo elilodwa, hamba phambili, phenduka, bese uphinda uhamba emuva. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nekhono lokuhamba kahle, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhuluma nezinye izinyathelo. Isinyathelo 3: Ukufaka Emoyeni Umculo Umdanso awuphumelelanga ngaphandle komculo. Khetha umculo onomoya ofanele, okhuluma ngezinto ezifanele. Ungakhetha umculo wamasiko, imizwelo, noma ngisho nepop—lokhu kuzokwenza umdanso wakho uthokozise. Uma umculo usuqalile, zama ukuhamba ngokuhambisana nemigqa yawo. Shintsha izinyathelo zakho ukuze zifanele umculo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umdanso wakho ube namandla futhi uthakazelise. Ungazama ukuhamba ngokuhlanganyela nabanye, uma kudingekile, ukuze umdanso wakho uthokozise ngempela. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuzijwayeza Nokuthuthukisa Amandla Njengoba usujwayele ukufunda izinyathelo, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza. Lokhu kuzokwenza ulungise izinyathelo zakho, futhi uthuthukise ubuchwepheshe bakho. Thola isikhathi sokuphindaphinda izinyathelo, uye uzenze zibe ngokwakho. Zama ukufaka ezinye izinyathelo ezinzima, noma ukhethe isitayela somdanso ofuna ukusithuthukisa. Kungaba umdanso wezothando, umdanso wesimanje, noma umdanso wamasiko. Lokhu kuzokwenza umdanso wakho ube nemibala, futhi kukhuthaze abanye ukuthi bajoyine. Isinyathelo 5: Ukusebenza Ndawonye Umdanso ungaba umkhuba ohlanganisayo. Zama ukucela abanye ukuba bajoyine. Hamba nabangani bakho, umndeni noma abokuqala ukuze nibe nomdanso ofanayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda nokwabelana ngemicabango, futhi kuzokhulisa umoya omuhle phakathi kwenu. Umdanso wokusebenza ndawonye ungahlanganisa izinyathelo ezahlukahlukene, futhi lokho kuzokwenza kube mnandi. Futhi, ungakha imicimbi yokudansa emakhaya, okungaba yindlela enhle yokukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Isiphetho Umdanso ungumsebenzi ophilayo, odinga ukuzimisela, umoya, kanye nezifiso. Noma ngabe uhamba wedwa noma nabanye, umdanso unikeza ithuba lokuziveza. Qhubeka uzijwayeze, futhi ungalokothi uyeke ukufuna ukufunda izinyathelo ezintsha. Ngale ndlela, umdanso wakho uzoba yinto ethokozisayo futhi ejabulisayo, ebonisa ubuciko bakho nokuhlakanipha. Khumbula, umdanso ungaphezu kokuhamba; ukuwuhlonipha, ukuwuthokozisa, nokuwabelana nabanye yikhona okwenza kube ngempela umdanso. Hamba, udanse, futhi ube nomoya omuhle.
Ukwakhiwa Kwezindlu ze-RDP: Ukwazisa Ngomcimbi Obalulekile Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi weNingizimu Afrika ubungazisa umcimbi obalulekile, okuwukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP (Reconstruction and Development Programme). Lezi zindlu zidalwe ngenhloso yokubhekana nezinkinga zokungabi nezindlu ezigculisayo, futhi ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba angcono empilweni kubantu abahluphekayo. Umcimbi waqala ngempelasonto eMphakathini waseMahlabathini, lapho izinkulungwane zabantu ziqoqana ukuze zihlomule emcimbini. Umkhosi uvulelwe ngokukhuluma komholi wesifunda, uMnu. Mthethwa, owasiza ukufakazela isidingo esikhulu sokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezithuthukisiwe. Wakhuluma ngokuqinile ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe, ephawula ukuthi “ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP akusikho kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha amathuba, ukuzimela, kanye nokuhlinzekela umndeni.” Ngemva kokwethulwa kwephrojekthi, abahumushi bahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezindlu ezizokwakhiwa. Kwakukhulunywa ngendawo ezokwakhiwa khona, iziqondiso zokwakhiwa, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo ezizohlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubahlali. Izindlu ze-RDP, ezakhiwa ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezithile, ziyamukeleka kakhulu emiphakathini, futhi zinikeza isitifiketi sokuba semthethweni kumphakathi. Umcimbi wawubhalwe phansi ngendlela yokubamba umoya womphakathi, lapho abantu bezama ukuxhumana nabanye, bejabulile futhi bephakamisa imicabango yabo. Abantu bahlabelela, begijima, futhi bejabulisa impilo yabo, bekhuthazela ukuthi ubumbano lwasemphakathini lungasebenza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ubanjwa ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, abahlali babekhuluma ngezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kodwa futhi bathokozisa izithembiso ezivela kulolu hlelo lwakha umphakathi. Izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza, njengezinkampani zokwakha, zabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinto ezidingekayo zokwakha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakusebenza ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlu zikhona, ziphephile, futhi zihlala isikhathi eside. Abasebenzi bezinkampani bahloniphe umphakathi, bacacisa ngendlela yokusebenzisa imithombo ethile ukuze kube nokwakheka okuhle kwezindlu. Ngemva kokuphela komcimbi, abaholi bendawo balungiselela imininingwane yokuhamba phambili, beqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyayiqonda indlela yokufaka izicelo zezindlu ze-RDP. Lokhu kwakubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi kakhulu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zathuthukiswa, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinqubo nezidingo ezihambisana nokufaka izicelo. Umcimbi wawuwukubonisa ubumbano phakathi kwemiphakathi, izinkampani, nohulumeni. Abantu baphuma benomoya ophakeme, bejabulile futhi bejabule ngokwesehlakalo esithokozisayo. Lokhu kuhambisana nomgomo wezwe wokwakha umphakathi onokuthula, onokuhlangenwe nakho kwezemfundo, nezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Umcimbi wokwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP ubonisa ukuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha izinto ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kuhlelwe ngendlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Sekunesikhathi eside umphakathi ufaka izicelo, abanye bahlala begcwele ithemba lokuthi bazothola izindlu ezizohlinzekela izidingo zabo. Umcimbi obalulekile njenganoma yimuphi omunye, ubonisa ithuba lokuthi abantu baphinde baphile impilo engcono, futhi bakhe impilo ethokozisayo. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP akukhona nje ukwakha izindlu, kodwa kuwukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo kumphakathi. Umphakathi wakhumbula umcimbi, uhamba phambili ngokuthola izixazululo ezithuthukisayo, futhi ububanzi bokuveza izidingo zabo. Ngakho, uma ucabanga ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile, khumbula ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP kuyindlela yokuhlomula, ukwakha, nokuphilisa umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala ukuthi umphakathi udlule ezindleleni ezinzima, ufinyelele izimpumelelo ezinkulu, futhi uqhubeke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Amahlaya (Comedy) Isingeniso Amahala yisigaba esihlekisayo sokucabanga, besebenza njengesithombe sobuhlakani bezinto ezahlukene. Kulo mbhalo, sizokhuluma ngama hlaya, sihlaziye imbali yawo, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, kanye nemithelela yawo emphakathini. Amahla ayindlela yokuzijabulisa futhi adlulisela umyalezo, evame ukuhlekisa abantu, ukuvusa imicabango, nokukhipha imizwa yokujabula. Imbali YamaHlaya Ukwazi imbali yama hlaya kubalulekile ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wazo. Amahla aqala ezikhathini zakudala, lapho abaculi babebhala izingoma nezincwadi ezihlekisayo ezazibhalwa njengezinkanyezi eziphathelene nemicabango yempilo, uthando, nezinselele. Emazweni amaningi, kuvela ababhali abanjengo-Aristophanes eGreece, owadlala indima enkulu ekwakheni amahlaya ashibhile. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, amahlaya aqhubeka eguquka; abaculi bayengeza imizwa, izimo, nezimo zempilo zansuku zonke, okwenza ahlale ehambisana nezimo zenhlalo ezikhona. E-England, abantu abaningi bahlonipha uWilliam Shakespeare, owasungula amahlaya afaka ubuhlakani nokuhlekisa okungaphezu kwemingcele yendawo. Izinhlobo ZamaHlaya Amahla ahlukahlukene anemishado yangempela, amaphikisho, nezinhlelo zokuhlekisa. Ezinye zezinhlobo ezidumile zamahlaya zifaka: 1. I-Comedy Stand-Up: Quizwa ngomshayi ohlonishwayo, odlalayo phambi kwabantu. Umshayi uhlola izimo zenhlalo, ukuhamba komphakathi, nezifundo zempilo ngendlela ehlekisayo. 2. I-Sitcoms: Lezi yizinhlelo zethelevishini ezahlukaniswe ngama-hlaya. Zihlaba ezindaweni ezijwayelekile, fokussinga abantu nokusebenza kwabo nsuku zonke. 3. I-Physical Comedy: Lezi amahlaya adinga ukusetshenziswa kwemizimba, ezifana nezinkanyezi ezihlekisayo eziqoshwa ngezinga eliphezulu ngenxa yokudumisa izisebenzi zomphakathi. Imithelela YamaHlaya Emphakathini Amahla ayindlela ebalulekile yokukhipha imizwa nokuhlaziya izinkinga. Kwabaningi, amahlaya anikela ithuba lokuhlekisa ngezinto ezinzima. Ukuhlekisa kuqala kube nzima, kodwa kuthandwa ngenxa yokuthi kuputha ibhasi lezinkinga zansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlaya avame ukuvusa ingxoxo. Njengoba ababhali behlekisa, kungenzeka kube nemibuzo ethinta izindaba ezinzima, ezifana nezinkinga zempilo, ubuzwe, nasekuchazeni ubulungiswa. Lokhu kuvula amathuba okukhuluma ngalezi zindaba ngaphakathi komphakathi, kungaba kwezokuxhumana, ezemidlalo, noma ezobuciko. Ubuciko Bokuhlekisa Ukuphumelela kokuhlekisa kudinga ubuciko, ubuhlakani, nomqondo weqiniso. Ababhali bama hlaya bavame ukudala izimo ezihlekisayo ngenhloso yokuhlekisa okuyiqiniso. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba amahlaya angafaka abantu ebuhleni nasekukhulumeni. Ukuba ubuhlakani beqondise izinhlelo zamanje zama hlaya, kudinga ukubheka izinqaba zezinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amahlaya ahlukahlukene, akhombisa ukunambitheka kwezinhlanga, izindawo, nemicabango eyakhayo. Lokhu kudala ukujula okuyingqayizivele, okwenza kubaluleke kakhulu. Isiphetho Amahla akha isiko emazweni amaningi, ikakhulukazi uma sibheka umhlaba wezenhlalakahle nezobuciko. Kukhona ezinye izindlela ezithakazelisayo zokuhlekisa, ukusuka kumabhukwana, ezinkanyezi, nezinhlelo zethelevishini. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izindlela zifana kangakanani, umgomo omkhulu ungukubamba abantu behlekisa, baphinde bahlolisise izinkinga ezikhiqizayo emhlabeni. Ngakho-ke, amahlaya awekho nje ukuze ahlekise; akuyona kuphela indawo yokuzijabulisa, kodwa nendlela yokuxhumana, yokufundisa, nokwenziwako. Amahla ahlekisayo angaba yindlela yokukhaya, ukusiza abantu baphinde bancome ukuze baphile impilo ejabulisayo. Ngakho-ke, sihlezi sicela ukuthi sihlekise, sifunde, futhi sithokozise. Amahla aphilayo aqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, ehola izizukulwane eziningi endaweni yokuhlekisa.
Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Ezinengi Ngaphakathi kweminyaka edlule, umhlaba ubhekane nezinguquko ezinkulu kwezokuthutha, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Izimoto eziningi, ezaziwa nangokuthi "izimoto zokuphuthumayo," zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekuphenduleni ezimweni eziphuthumayo, njengokuhlaselwa kwezifo, izingozi zomgwaqo, noma izimo zemvelo eziphuthumayo. Le ndaba izogxila emlandweni wokwakheka nokuthuthukiswa kwezimoto eziningi, kanye nomthelela wazo ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, kubalulekile ukubheka imvelaphi yezimoto eziningi. Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, izimoto zokuqala zatholakala, kodwa zazikhiqizwa ngamasistimu amancane futhi zazingatholakali kalula. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, izimoto zashintsha zaba yizinto ezitholakala kalula, futhi zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezinjini ezinamandla, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwezimoto eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimo eziphuthumayo zanda, futhi izinhlelo zokuphendula zidinga ukwakhiwa. Ngonyaka we-1950, izikhungo zokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo zathuthukiswa, futhi izimoto eziningi zatholwa ukuze zisetshenziswe ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezihlanganisa izimoto eziningi, ezazihlanganisa izimoto zokwelapha, izimoto zomlilo, nezimoto zepolitiki. Lezi zimoto zaba yizinsiza ezibalulekile ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangeniswa ezikhungweni zokwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimoto eziningi zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezici ezithuthukisiwe. Izimoto zokuphuthumayo zathola izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphakeme, ezazivumela abaphenduli ukuba baxhumane kalula nezikhungo zokuphendula. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni, njengoba abaphenduli bekwazi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto zathola izici zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe, ezazisiza ukuvikela abaphenduli ngesikhathi sokuphendula. Ngonyaka we-1980, izimoto eziningi zathola izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezinhlelo zokulandelela izimoto, ezazivumela abaphenduli ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi izimoto zabo zisebenza kanjani. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni, njengoba abaphenduli bekwazi ukuhamba ngezindlela eziphusile, bephuma ezimeni eziphuthumayo ngokushesha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha okuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimoto eziningi zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezinjini ezinamandla, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba ezindaweni ezinzima. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo, njengoba abaphenduli bekwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezinzima, lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zenzeka khona. Izimoto eziningi zathola izici ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezinhlelo zokulawula izimo, ezazisiza abaphenduli ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi izimo zikhona kanjani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimoto eziningi zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphakeme, ezazivumela abaphenduli ukuba baxhumane kalula nezikhungo zokuphendula. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni, njengoba abaphenduli bekwazi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto zathola izici zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe, ezazisiza ukuvikela abaphenduli ngesikhathi sokuphendula. Namuhla, izimoto eziningi zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ezivumela abaphenduli ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi izimo zikhona kanjani. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni, njengoba abaphenduli bekwazi ukuhamba ngezindlela eziphusile, bephuma ezimeni eziphuthumayo ngokushesha. Izimoto eziningi zathola izici ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezinhlelo zokulawula izimo, ezazisiza abaphenduli ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi izimo zikhona kanjani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimoto eziningi zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphakeme, ezazivumela abaphenduli ukuba baxhumane kalula nezikhungo zokuphendula. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni, njengoba abaphenduli bekwazi ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto zathola izici zokuphepha ezithuthukisiwe, ezazisiza ukuvikela abaphenduli ngesikhathi sokuphendula. Ekugcineni, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kube yinsika ebalulekile ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Izimoto eziningi zibe nezici ezithuthukisiwe, ezazisiza abaphenduli ukuba bazi kahle ukuthi izimo zikhona kanjani. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuphendula, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha okuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, sizobona izinguquko ezenzakalayo ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo, futhi sizokwazi ukuvikela impilo yabantu ngendlela engcono.
