Ngexesha lokuqala leMisebenzi yoMphakathi (1994-1999), iSebe leMisebenzi yeSifunda neYezeMidlalo (dplg) lwalubalulekile ekuphumezeni isivumelwano esisha somthethosisekelo sokudlula. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo emisha kanye nezinsiza zomthetho zokuphatha ezindaweni zendawo eNingizimu Afrika. Lo msebenzi obenhla uveze iMithetho YezeMidlalo, iMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi, iMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomphakathi, iMthetho Wezindleko Zempahla Zomphakathi, kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi ngesikhathi salo. Ukuqapha okuqondile ngesikhathi sokuqala somsebenzi kwakuwukwakha isikhungo esisha sezepolitiki esibalulekile kuhulumeni obusayo ezimweni zendawo nezifunda. Ukuqala kwesikhathi sesibili soMphakathi ngo-1999 kwethule ushintsho egameni lesi sebhizinisi, okuholele emisebenzini yayo emisha. Umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa umthethosisekelo wathunyelwa kuSebe lezeMthetho, elashintshwa igama laba yiSebe leMisebenzi yeSifunda neYezeMidlalo (dplg). Igunya elisha le-dplg laba yisisekelo sokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa, ukwandisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, nokwenza ukuthuthukiswa. Njengomphumela, igunya le-dplg lashintsha lisuka ekubeni umgibeli wombuso wempilo yabe lukhuni ukuphucula izikhungo zokuphatha nokwandisa ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa izigaba nokwakha uhlelo olusha lokuphatha ezindaweni. Ngokwakhiwa komgomo wezeMidlalo, ukuqapha kwayo okuqondile kwaba ukusungulwa kwezindawo zokuhlala nezinhlelo zazo njengesisekelo nokusekela isimo sokusebenzisa igunya layo lezeMidlalo. Izinhlelo Zokuphatha Ezibanzi: Lezi ziqinisekiso zifaka phakathi ukukala ukusetshenziswa kweHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezentengiselwano Okubambisene (isrdp), uHlelo Lokuvuselela Izindawo (urp), Izinsizakalo Eziyisisekelo Ezikhululekile (fbs), ukuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka, nokwakha umgomo wokuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka kanye nezinsiza zomthetho, kanye nokushintsha imithetho ngempela yamaqabane ezokuphatha ezindaweni. Uhulumeni Wezifunda: Ukuqapha okuqondile ngesikhathi esiningi somsebenzi kusekela izifunda ukuze zikwazi ukusebenzisa ukwesekwa kwazo nemisebenzi ekhombisa mayelana nezindawo zokuhlala. Uhulumeni Wendawo: Omunye umqondo wokuphenya okuqondile ngesigaba sokuphatha izindawo kwakuwukuphumeza imigomo emisha kanye nemithetho yokuphatha, kusekela ukusungulwa kokuphathwa kwezimali zezakhamuzi kuzo zonke izingxenye zayo nokuphothula yonke imithetho yayo yokuphatha efana neMthetho Wezindleko Zomphakathi (Mthetho Wezintela Zomphakathi). NgoDisemba 2000, amajaji okuhweba akhethwe aqala ukusebenza ngaphansi komgomo omusha wezomthetho. Okufakiwe kule ndawo yemisebenzi kwakuwukuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka, ukusungulwa komgomo wezomthetho wokuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka, nokwethulwa kwezinyathelo zokuvikela ze-Y2K. Ingxenye yesibili yale misebenzi yayiqondiswe ngqo ekulethweni kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza kanye nezinsiza ezilinganiselwe ezindaweni. Lezi zinsiza zemali zakhula unyaka nonyaka, zakhokelela ekwabeleni izinsiza zokuqala ezindaweni zokuhlala kanye nokwandisa izimo zokuhlinzeka ukuze kuxazululwe lokho okwakuhamba kancane ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Kusukela ngo-1994, isimo esisebenza njengemishini yokubandlulula saguqulwa sithathe izikhungo ezingu-1200 ezisekelwe ebuzweni, izifunda ezine zokuphatha, kanye nezindawo eziyi-10 zokuhlala zaba izindawo ezingu-284 ezikhethwe, izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye, kanye nohulumeni wezwe onamandla. Ukhetho olunokuthula kanye nedemokhrasi ephelele kwabanjwa ngo-1994, 1999, no-2004 kuhulumeni wezwe, wezifunda, kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Uhulumeni kuzo zonke lezi zindawo uphumeze izinhlelo ezahlukene zokubhubhisa ubuphofu nokungathuthuki ngokuphelele. Izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zaphumelelwa ezindaweni ezifana nokudla nokudla okuyisisekelo, amanzi nezinsiza, ugesi nokuhlinzekwa kwamandla, izindlu nezindawo zokuhlala, ukulungiswa komhlaba, ukuthutha, imfundo, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ama-SMME, kanye nokuhlangana kwezenhlalo. Ukuthi izifunda ziqhubeke nokuthola izinsiza ezikhululiwe ezivela kwi-fiscus zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nakho kwaba yimpumelelo yangempela. Ukuhlola okujulile kwezifunda kukhombisile ukuthi zikwazi ukusebenzisa izabelomali eziguquliwe kahle futhi zakhombisa imiphumela ebonakalayo ekuphatheni ukusetshenziswa kwezimali. Izinhlelo zokuphatha njengesisekelo ziqalile futhi zakhuliswa ukuze ziqondise ngqo ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, ukuhlela ukuhlanganiswa kokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, nokuphathwa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwesekwa kwezimali kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi kuqedile ukuhamba kancane komlando wokuhlinzekwa kukagesi ezindaweni ezikade zingekho ugesi. I-MIG iyindlela entsha yokudlulisa izinsiza ezihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ukudluliswa kwezimali ezindaweni zokuhlala ngendlela ecacile neqoqa. Izimo zayo zishintsha kakhulu, zenzelwe ukweseka izabelomali zezakhamuzi, nokulungiselela uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. I-MIG ngeke ikhokhele eminye imisebenzi, kodwa ihloselwe ukuvumelanisa nezabelomali zezakhamuzi (efana ne-grant ye-infrastructure yesifunda). Ukuveza ukusetshenziswa kwezimali kuzoba kuyo yonke ibhajethi yezindawo, okumele kuqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izabelomali ezisebenzayo esikhathini esizayo ukuze kusekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ezabelwe. Izigaba zomnyango kazwelonke zizoqhubeka nokuhola nokweseka ukusetshenziswa kwezimali emisebenzini futhi ziqhube izinjongo ezicacile. I-isrdp iyisiphakamiso somphakathi, esihlinzekwa yiSebe leMisebenzi yeSifunda neYezeMidlalo. Iqala ukusebenza ngo-Okthoba 2000, ngemuva kokuvunywa nguMkhuzi. Le nhlelo ihlose ukulwa nobuphofu, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, intsha, kanye nabantu abakhubazekile. Inhloso enkulu yohlelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisana ngokubambisana nemiphakathi nabanye abathintekayo ukuze kubhujiswe ubuphofu nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuphila ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. I-isrdp ihloselwe ukufezekisa ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi kanye nomphakathi onempilo oqhubekayo onomnotho osebenzayo futhi ophucukile ongagcina udumo lwezindawo zasemaphandleni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwasemaphandleni kuhlose okungenani ukususa ukwehlukaniswa kwabantu basemaphandleni eminyakeni eminingi ngokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo nokufinyelela okuphelele ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi ezifana nemidlalo nezokuzijabulisa, izikole, ama-clinic, njll. Ukuhlinzeka ngesesekeli kumaphrojekthi nezinto ezisemaphandleni kuyinselelo enkulu kuhulumeni, ngakho-ke kudingeka ukusebenza kahle nabanye abathintekayo ukuze ku

Yebo, ngempela, izinsuku zempilo yakhe zishintshile kakhulu. Ngempela, abantu abaningi bahlala bekhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sokushushiswa. UZuma ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, futhi kufanele kube nesizathu sokuthi abanye bahlale bemkhumbula. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi uZuma uzokwazi ukufaka isandla emiphakathini? Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisikhathi sokuhlola izimo ezinzima. Abantu bahlala bekhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, futhi uZuma ungumuntu ophakathi kwazo zonke lezi zindaba. Kukhona abanye abathi kufanele kube nezinqumo ezinzima, kodwa abanye bathi akukhona. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkantolo zihlala zikhona? Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisikhathi sokuhlola ukuthi uZuma uzokwazi kanjani ukuphuma kulolu shintsho. Ngabe uzokwazi ukuthola ithuba lokuziphendulela? Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Ngonyaka ka-2020, umhlaba wabhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu ngesikhathi i-COVID-19 iqala ukusabalala. Iziqubulo eziningi zashintsha, imisebenzi yahlala, futhi abantu abaningi bahlupheka. Ezinye izinhlelo zakuqala zabeziqukethe izindlela eziphuthumayo zokubhekana nalesi simo. Omunye walabo babambelela kuzo, kwakungumbono wokwethula isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant, esihlose ukusiza labo abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. UThandi, ungumama oneminyaka engu-32, wabhekana nenkinga enkulu ngesikhathi sokuvinjelwa. Wayengumsebenzi osemthethweni osebenza ezindaweni zokudayiswa, kodwa ngenxa yokwakhiwa okukhula kancane kwezinhlelo zokuvikela, isitimela samabhizinisi saziwa, futhi imisebenzi yakhe yahamba phansi. Lokhu kwashiya umndeni wakhe, onabantu abane, behlupheka kakhulu. Ngesikhathi uThandi ebona izikhangiso ngalesi sibonelelo somphakathi, wathola ithemba. UThandi wanquma ukuthi uzobhalisela leli thuba. Ngasikhathi sinye, wayezwa umuzwa wokuhlupheka kwabanye, njengoba ezwa izindaba zabangani nomndeni ababehlangabezana nezinkinga ezifanayo. Waqala uhambo lwakhe lokubhalisela isibonelelo. Ngenxa yokuthi kwakuyinkathi yokuhlupheka, izinsiza eziningi zabeziphansi, kodwa uThandi wathola ithuba lokuzama. Ngemuva kokubhalisela, wathola imilayezo eminingi yokuxhumana, okuhlanganisa nemiyalelo yokuthi angawathola kanjani amaphuzu azodingeka ukuze athole isibonelelo. Waqhubeka nokuqonda ngokucophelela lezi zinyathelo, wathola ukuthi ubhaliso kumele lwenziwe ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kwaba inselelo enkulu, ngoba uThandi wayengakaze asebenzise i-inthanethi kakhulu. Nokho, akazange ayeke; wayekhathele, wayezazi izinselelo ezinzima ezibhekene nomndeni wakhe. Ngemva kwezinsuku eziningana zokuhamba phambili, ekugcineni uThandi wathola isikhumbuzo sokuthi isicelo sakhe samukelwe. Ukuhamba kwesikhathi, umndeni wakhe waba nezinye izinzuzo, okuhlanganisa nesibonelelo esingama-randi angama-3500. Lokhu kwaguqula impilo yakhe nempilo yomndeni wakhe. Njengoba ethola le mali, uThandi wathola ithuba lokuthenga ukudla, ezidingweni ezingokwemvelo, kanye nokukhokhela ezinye izikweletu ezincane. Noma kunjalo, uThandi akazange akwazi ukwehlisa ingcindezi. Wayazi ukuthi le mali ibalulekile, kodwa wayevuma ukuthi ibhajwe kalula. Waqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi wahlangana nabanye abantu ababejolise emsebenzini wabo. UThandi waqonda ukuthi kumele aguqule umqondo wakhe, akhuthazwe ukukhuluma nabanye abantu ababephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza, wahlangana noNokuthula, ongumngani wakhe. UNokuthula naye wathola isibonelelo, kodwa wayenokukhathazeka ngendlela abathola ngayo izinsiza ezithile. UThandi wathola ukuthi abanye abantu bahamba phambili, benza imisebenzi eyahlukene ukuze bathole imali eyengeziwe. Lokhu kwavusa umqondo wezimali phakathi kwabo, futhi waqala ukucabanga ngendlela yokwakha ibhizinisi elincane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi wahlela umcimbi wokuhlangana nomphakathi, ukuze baxoxe ngezindlela zokuziphilisa. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokwabelana ngolwazi nokuhlanganyela amasu. UThandi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo nabanye, kwazise babezokwazi ukusizana. Uthando lwabo lokuba nezezimali lwakha umoya opholile, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okukhula. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uThandi waqala umsebenzi omusha wokuthengisa izithelo nezitshalo ezinkulu ezithengiswa emakethe. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okukhulisa umndeni wakhe, futhi wathola ukuthi isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza ukwakha amathuba amasha. Nakuba leli thuba liyeza ngenxa yezikhathi ezinzima, uThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona, futhi abantu bayakwazi ukuphumelela kakhulu uma bexhunywe. Njengoba usuku luhamba, uThandi waphakamisa izwi lakhe, efuna ukusiza abanye ababephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Waqhubeka nokuhlanganyela nezinye izinhlelo ezithuthukile, futhi waqala ukufundisa abanye abantu indlela yokufaka izicelo ngezinhlelo ezithile zempilo. Waqonda ukuthi isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza kuphela uma abantu besebenzisa kahle amathuba akhona, futhi bekwazi ukuzama ngendlela ehlukile. Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukuhlela umphakathi omncane wokuxhumana, lapho abantu bezokwazi ukufunda, ukukhuthazela, nokwabelana ngempumelelo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, futhi umoya wokwabelana wabonakala. UThandi wanquma ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi uma abantu besebenzisa ithuba, bangakwazi ukusiza abanye. Uhlanga lwezimo ezinzima luhamba, kodwa uThandi uthokozisa impilo yakhe nemali eyengeziwe eyayihamba nezindleko zomndeni. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza ukwenza izinguquko, futhi uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuphila kahle, ngaphandle kokwehla phansi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wenza ubudlelwano obunempilo nomphakathi futhi wakhulisa umndeni wakhe. Njengoba ethola izifundo ezintsha, uThandi waqhubeka nokuhlola izinsiza, futhi waqonda ukuthi ukufunda akupheli. Isibonelelo sasiwumthombo wokuphila, kodwa umoya wokusebenza kanye nokukhuthaza uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, indaba kaThandi yaba yindaba yokukhuthaza, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuthi baphile ezimeni ezinzima. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza, kodwa ibhizinisi lakhe elincane lasiza ukuvuselela umhlaba wakhe. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma kudingeka, abantu bangakha amathuba amasha, futhi baphile kahle ngezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaba yincwadi yokuphila, futhi uThandi wanqoba empilweni yakhe. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sasisiza ngezindlela eziningi, futhi umphakathi udinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze ube namandla. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokusebenza ndawonye, izinzuzo zalesi sibonelelo zikhula, futhi ikusasa liyaphila.
Intsha YaseNingizimu Afrika Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile kakhulu empilweni yalesi sizwe. Lezi zinsizwa nezintombi, ezikhula ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, zidlala indima enkulu ekuguqulweni komphakathi. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, intsha nayo ibonisa ukuqonda okujulile kwezinto ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kubonakala ezimpilweni zabo, ezinqumweni abazithathayo, kanye nezifiso zabo zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Nokho, intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Ukungasebenzi, ububha, kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokukhubazeka kwezemfundo kuyizinto ezithinta kakhulu impilo yomphakathi. Kodwa intsha ayikhaleli, ibonisa amandla okukhula. Ngaphakathi komhlaba wezobuchwepheshe, lapho imithombo yolwazi ifinyeleleka kalula, intsha ikwazi ukusabalalisa imicabango nemibono yabo. Izinkampani ezincane ezisungulwa ngentsha zikhombisa ukuzimisela kwabo ukuhamba phambili. Umkhankaso wezokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, udlala indima enkulu ekuboniseni izwi lentsha. Abantu abasha baveza imicabango yabo ngokukhululeka, baphakamisa izinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi, bese bexhumana nabanye abavela ezimweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, okukhombisa ukuthi intsha ingashintsha ikusasa uma ibamba iqhaza elibonakalayo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhanya. Intsha ibhekene nemiphumela emibi yokuxhumana okungapheli, okubandakanya ukukhathazeka, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinye izinkinga zokuphila. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuze intsha ithole usizo oludingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibonisa ubuciko obuhlukahlukene. Emculweni, emdlandlweni, nakwezobuciko, intsha ibonisa amandla ayo okudala. Umculo we-hip-hop, i-kwaito, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zikhombisa izimpilo zabo, izifiso, nokukhathazeka kwabo. Umculo, njengomkhiqizo wobuciko, uhlinzeka ngemibono yamasiko, udala umuzwa wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abasha, kubavumela ukuba babelane ngezinto abazithandayo. Ukuba khona kwezemfundo ezithuthukisiwe kucatshangelwa njengomnyango onguqobo wokwakha intsha enamandla. Izingane zisebenzisa amathuba afinyeleleka kalula okufunda, zikhulisa izinga lempumelelo. Nokho, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokufundisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha ithola amakhono adingekayo ukuze ibhekane nezimfuno zomnotho wanamuhla. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi, kuhlanganise nabazali, othisha, nabaphathi, kubalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngesoftware edingekayo ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuvuleka kumathuba amaningi. Njengoba intsha iqhubeka nokuthuthukisa amakhono ayo, izokwazi ukugxila ezindabeni ezisemqoka, kuhlanganise nezindaba zentando yeningi. Ekupheleni, intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ibonisa amandla, ubukhona, nezifiso ezinzima. Njengoba ibhekene nezinselelo zansuku zonke, ibonisa amandla okuphila, okudala, nokufunda. Umphakathi kumele usebenzisane ukuze uthuthukise amathuba okukhula, uqinisekise ukuthi intsha ithola ukuvuselela imicabango, futhi ibhekele phambili. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwentsha, umphakathi, nezikhungo zemfundo kuzokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okuyinto esiyidingayo ukuze sikhule sizimele. Intsha iyinhloko yeNingizimu Afrika, futhi ikusasa lethu lincike ekutheni sikhuluma futhi silalela izwi labo.
Ukufakwa kwengane kusho ukwamukela ukuba umgadi wezomthetho wengane, kulandela inqubo yesiko neyomthetho yengane engengayakho ngokwenyama. Ingane engengayakho ngokwenyama oyithathayo ukuze uyinakekele ithathwa kubazali bayo bese ibekwa ngokomthetho kubazali abangabazali noma endaweni yokunakekelwa. Ingane ingafakwa uma ingengayakho ngokwenyama. Umuntu oshadile, umkakhe ongumzali wengane; noma ubaba ongowenyama wengane eyazalwa ngaphandle komshado. Kufanele ube nezinsiza zokunakekela nokukhokhela imfundo yengane. Kufanele ube negama elihle, ube umuntu omuhle, futhi ube nethemba lokunakekela ingane. Uma ungumuntu ongakaze abe yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele ube neziqu zokuba yisakhamuzi noma ube ufake isicelo sokuba yisakhamuzi. Ukufaka ingane ngokufihlekile, lapho abazali bayo bengavunyelwe ukwazi ukuthi ubani abantu abathatha ingane ukuze bayinakekele, noma lapho abanikeli bezinsizakalo bezoshiyeka ngemva kokuthatha ingane, kulawulwa ngengxenye 18 yeMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983, futhi kungenzeka uma inkantolo yezingane ikwazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothuthukisa ingane futhi kuhlangabezane kakhulu nezidingo zengane. Uma inkantolo yezingane ithola ukuthi ingane noma izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa, umgibeli wenkantolo yezingane uzobeka lezi zingane ekunakekelweni, endaweni yokuhlala yezingane, esikoleni sezimboni, noma endaweni ephephile. Nokho, ingane noma izingane zingabekwa ngaphansi kokunakekelwa komzali, umnikeli wezinsizakalo, noma umgadi, lapho zizoba ngaphansi kokubhekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Kulokhu, uMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uzohlinzeka umnikeli wezinsizakalo ngoxhaso lwezimali kubazali abanakekela ingane. Isiphakamiso sokufakwa kwengane kufanele sibe kusekelwe ezidingweni zengane futhi kube usizo empilweni yengane. Hamba kumlobi wenkantolo yezingane endaweni lapho ingane ihlala khona. Ingane uqobo, uma idlula eminyakeni eyishumi; futhi inkantolo kufanele ikwazi ukuthi ingane iyayiqonda imvelo nokubaluleka kokuvuma. Umzali owamukela ingane ukuze ayinakekele, enakekela leyo ngane, uma umzali engakafaki isicelo sokufakwa kwale ngane ukuze ayinakekele. Uma umzali owamukela ingane ukuze ayinakekele ehluleka ukuvuma ukufaka ingane phakathi kwenyanga ngemva kokucelwa ukuthi enze njalo ngumsebenzi wenkantolo, inqubo yokufaka ingane ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kokuvuma kwabo okudingekayo. Akukho mvume ebhaliwe edingekayo ngaphansi kwezimo ezilandelayo: uma umzali wengane, kulandela ingxenye 16, efakwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa komzali osemthethweni, noma uma ingane ifuna indawo esikoleni sezingane noma esikoleni sezimboni; noma uma bephika ukuhlinzeka ngemvume yabo ngenxa yesizathu esingafanele. Ukuvumela ukufakwa kwengane ngumuntu ongumzali kuvame ukuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kungathatha isikhathi eside uma udaba lukhona oluyinkimbinkimbi. Mayelana nezindleko zokuhlola, xhumana nezikhungo ezifanele zokuvumela ukufakwa kwezingane, izinkantolo zezingane, kanye namahhovisi eMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi.
Izimo Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Ngelanga elikhanyayo, uNandi wayehamba emgwaqweni, emva kokufika emsebenzini. Uhlanga lwemithi lwalucwebezela, amakhaza abizwa umoya. Nokho, uNandi wayengekho emoyeni. Wayephuthuma esibhedlela, efuna ukubheka iziguli ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Njengomsebenzi wezempilo, wayejwayele ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima, kodwa namuhla wayezimisele ukuhamba phambili. Umnyango wesiguli ubukhanya kakhulu, futhi uNandi wabona abanye abasebenzi besebenza ngokuzikhandla, bebonisa uthando lwabo lomsebenzi. Ngaleso sikhathi, iziguli zazingekho ezikhathazekile. Ngenkathi ebhekwa yiziguli, wahlangana noDkt. Mthembu, udokotela ophendula imibuzo yeziguli. “U-Nandi, ngicela ungisize! Kukhona isiguli esidinga usizo oluphuthumayo,” kusho uDkt. Mthembu, ebheke phansi kwesikhumba esibomvu. U-Nandi wamamatheka, wayazi kahle ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukugxila. “Ngithumele lapho, ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni,” kuphendula. Bahamba ndawonye, beya esigulini esisenhliziyweni ye-ICU. U-Nandi wayezwa inhliziyo yakhe ikhathele, kodwa wayazi ukuthi akumele akhathazeke. Lapho befika, baphawula ukuthi uMr. Khumalo, indoda ethwele imfundo ephezulu, sikhathazekile. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi uMr. Khumalo uvele waba nesimo sokuphefumula okungajwayelekile. “Ngicela ungisize, ngihamba kahle,” kusho uMr. Khumalo, kodwa ubuso bakhe babubonisa ukukhathazeka. U-Nandi wasondela, wamphathisa isandla. “Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni, Mr. Khumalo. Ngizokhuluma nodokotela,” kusho yena. Ngemva kokuphendula, uNandi wathola ukuthi kufanele benze izivivinyo eziphuthumayo ukuze babone ukuthi yini eyenza uMr. Khumalo abe nesimo esinjalo. Ngemva kwezinyathelo ezinzima, kwavela ukuthi wayenokuphazamiseka kwepulmunari — udaba oludinga ukwelashwa ngokushesha. “Bheka, uNandi, kufanele sithumele uMr. Khumalo esigulini se-ICU,” kusho uDkt. Mthembu, egcizelela ubukhulu bokuphuthuma kwesimo. U-Nandi wathi, “Ngibona, sizokwenza lokhu ngokushesha.” Ngemva kokuhambisa uMr. Khumalo esigulini, uNandi wathola iziguli eziningi ezidinga usizo. Kwakukhona uMfundisi Zulu, owayenophefumulo oluphumelelayo, kanye noMama Ndlovu, owazalayo obonakala eqinile, kodwa ewumngani olukhuni. U-Nandi wayazi ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo azikhethi. Njengoba elwa nezimo ezinzima, uNandi wahamba phakathi kwezindlu, efuna usizo lwezokwelapha, ephendula emhlabeni wonke. Uhlanga lwezinyathelo lungagcwalisa izinkanyezi, kanti umoya wakhe wawunokuthula. Uhlanga lwabantu belubukeka lukhazimula, kanti iziguli zazingekho phansi, zikhuluma, zikhuluma, zikhuluma, kanti konke lokhu kwaba yinkanyezi. Ngemva kokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, uNandi wathola ukuthi uMr. Khumalo uthola usizo oluphuthumayo, futhi waphumelela. U-Dkt. Mthembu wamjabulisa, “U-Nandi, umsebenzi wakho ubonisa uthando nobungcweti. Uthando lwakho lwenza umehluko.” U-Nandi wathokozisa, eshaya izandla. “Ngiyabonga, Dokotela. Ngiyazi ukuthi sinamandla uma sisebenza ndawonye.” Ngale ndlela, izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zaba yizifundo ezinzima. U-Nandi, uDkt. Mthembu, nabanye abasebenzi bazi ukuthi kumele bahlanganyele ukuze benze umhlaba ube ngcono. Izinyathelo zabo zazisebenza, zabasiza iziguli, futhi zakhombisa ukuthi ubudlelwano, uthando, nokubambisana kwenza umehluko omkhulu. U-Nandi waphuma esibhedlela, ethokozile. Wayazi ukuthi, nakuba izimo eziphuthumayo ziningi, uthando nokuzinikela kwabo bonke abahlinzeki bezempilo kuzokwenza kube lula. Kwathi lapho ehamba, wabona isibhakabhaka sikaMsunduzi, futhi wathi, “Ngiyavuma, ngiyakuthokozisa, ngizophinde ngibuye.” Le ndaba kaNandi iyakhumbuza abanye ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zidinga isibindi, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iziguli zithola ithemba, futhi umhlaba ubakhumbuza ukuthi bahlale bephila, bejabule, bephila.
Othisha (Teachers) Umbuzo 1: Yini indima ebalulekile othisha abayidlala ezikoleni? Impendulo: Othisha baphetha indima ebalulekile kakhulu ezikoleni. Bangaphezu kwabafundisi — bayabakhuthaza, bayabakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bafinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi banikeza iziqondiso ezibalulekile empilweni. Ngaphandle kwalokho, othisha banikeza abafundi ulwazi oluyisisekelo ezimfundisweni zangempela, ezithinta impilo yansuku zonke. Umbuzo 2: Ngabe othisha banamakhono afanele okwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle? Impendulo: Yebo, othisha kufanele babe namakhono amaningana. Kubalulekile ukuba babe nolwazi olunembile ngezifundo abazifundisayo, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu nje, kufanele bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zifundo ngendlela ethokozisayo. Lokhu kudinga amakhono okukhulumisana, ukuzwelana, kanye nekhono lokuphatha izifundo ngendlela ehlelelekile. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenza uthisha abe muhle kakhulu emsebenzini wakhe? Impendulo: Uthisha omuhle ushayela abafundi abakhe, ubalalela futhi ubakhuthaza, ungabasi ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokufundisa. Abanawo ubuciko kuphela, kodwa futhi bayazwela futhi baliyithokozisa imfundo. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni isimo esinokuthula nesokubambisana esigabeni sokufunda. Umbuzo 4: Othisha badinga ukusizakala ngani ukuze bakwazi ukwenza kahle emsebenzini wabo? Impendulo: Othisha badinga ukuxhaswa kahle nothalamali, izinsiza ezifanele, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola ikhwalithi yemfundo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka abafundi ngempumelelo futhi bagcine besebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, badinga ukuhamba phambili kuhlelo lokufunda ukuze bahlale bephile kwezobuchwepheshe besimanje. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo othisha abahlangabezana nazo? Impendulo: Othisha bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinsiza ezibuthakathaka, izikhalazo ezivela kubafundi, kanye nezimo zempilo ezingezinhle. Izinselelo ezithinta umsebenzi wabo zidinga ukusizwa emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, kanye nophenyo olujulile lokukwazi ukuphuma kumatasa. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ukujwayela kwezinkolelo zomphakathi kudinga ukufundwa ngothisha? Impendulo: Yebo, othisha badinga ukuqonda izinkolelo zomphakathi ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuhloniphekile phakathi kwabo nabafundi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze babhale izinhlelo zokufundisa ezimfanele nezihambisana nezimo zomphakathi. Ukujanji okukhulekile nokuhloniphayo ukuze kubunjwe umphakathi ovumelanayo. Umbuzo 7: Yini iyunivesithi edinga ukuyihlonipha ukuze ifundise othisha? Impendulo: Iyunivesithi kumele iphathe izifundo ezinhle, imfundo ecacile, futhi ibenze bekhuthazwe ukuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa. Ngokufanayo, izinhlelo ezifanele zokuxhaswa kothisha kumele zigcinwe, kanti ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili kufanele buphothulwe ngamafunda. Lokhu kuzokwakha uthisha onekhono futhi olandelwayo emsebenzini wakhe. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe othisha badinga ukuphathwa isikhathi sabo ngendlela ethile? Impendulo: Impela, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi kubalulekile. Othisha kumele balungiselele izifundo zabo kahle; lokho kuholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufunda eziphumelelayo. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi kuyasiza ukwenza ukuthi uthisha abeke imigomo ethile futhi ahlelwe kakhudlwana ezinsukwini ezenzakalayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthisha akwazi ukuphatha izifundo nabafundi ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 9: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba othisha babe nokuqonda okujulile kwezithombe zomphakathi? Impendulo: Ukuqonda izithombe zomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze othisha bakwazi ukuphatha izifundo ngendlela ehlangabezana nezidingo zebhodi abahlanganyela nazo. Lokhu kubafundisa ukuthi ukuthi imfundo ingabantu bonke, hhayi abagcina phansi kuphela. Othisha, uma bejwayele imvelaphi nabantu, kungcono kuhlinzeke izifundo ezithokozisayo nabafundi bazo ongalokothi bahlupheke. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izindlela othisha abangazisebenzisa ukuze bathuthukise imisebenzi yabo? Impendulo: Othisha bangakuthuthukisa umsebenzi wabo ngokuqhubeka befundisa ngezinqubo ezintsha nezisusa enhliziyweni, ukufunda ezintweni ezintsha ezifana nezinhlelo ze-inthanethi, futhi ukuzama ukufaka izinyathelo zokufunda ezikhethekile ngabafundi. ukuphila komphakathi kuyakha ubudlelwano obwanele phakathi kothisha nabafundi, okuwukuphepha kwengqondo kokudlula kwezemfundo. Ngapaqontshi, othisha bakhulu ngosizo abaluthola ezikoleni nakweminye imikhakha yokuphila muyani eqinile emiphakathini njengabafundisi nabalimi bemihla. Othisha bayinsika enkulu yokwakha isizukulwane esisha esiqinisekile, esinobuchwepheshe, nendawo yokusesha imfundo engapheli, okwenza imiphakathi ifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu.
Umbuzo 1: Yini ama-social media? Ama-social media yizinkundla zokuxhumana ezivumela abantu ukuthi baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, izithombe, namavidiyo. Zihlanganisa izinhlelo ezifana ne-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, ne-WhatsApp. Lezi zinkundla zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngempilo, izenzakalo, nezindaba phakathi kwabantu emhlabeni wonke. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza ama-social media abe nesisindo emphakathini wanamuhla? Ama-social media abe yinsika enkulu ekuxhumaneni. Zisetshenziswa ngabantu ukuze baxhumane nabangane, umndeni, kanye nabantu abasha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-business nawo asebenzisa lezi zinkundla ukuze afinyelele emakethe, akhe ubudlelwano namakhasimende, futhi akhuthaze imikhiqizo yabo, okukhuthaza ukuthengisa nokuqwashisa ngezempilo ezimbonini ezahlukene. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezihambisana nama-social media? Izinzuzo zama-social media ziningi. Okokuqala, zenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi nolwazi olusha. Abantu bangafunda, bakhuthaze imicabango yabo, futhi bahlale bexhumene. Okwesibili, ama-social media anikeza amathuba amaningi okwakha ubudlelwano, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha abanesithakazelo esifanayo. Umbuzo 4: Ngabe ama-social media anenkinga? Yebo, ama-social media anenkinga eziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kolwazi, lapho abantu bavame ukwabelana ngemininingwane engalungile noma eyingozi. Okwesibili, kukhona udlame lwemizwa, njengoba abantu abaningi bahlushwa ukucwaswa nokugxekwa, okwakha izinkinga zempilo yengqondo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani abantu bangavikela izinkinga ezihambisana nama-social media? Ukuze bavikele izinkinga ezihambisana nama-social media, abantu kufanele benze ngokucophelela lapho babelana ngemininingwane. Kubalulekile ukusebenzisa izilungiselelo zokuphepha ezitholakala ezinkundleni ukuze kugcinwe ubumfihlo. Futhi, abantu kufanele bahlale beqaphele uma behlanganyela nezinye izinkampani, futhi baqonde kahle izinqubomgomo zokusebenzisa. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe ama-social media azoba nempilo ehlukile emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe? Yebo, ama-social media azoba nempilo ehlukile. Ngokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe, kulindeleke ukuba kube nezinkundla ezintsha ezizothokozisa futhi ziqinise ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuxhumana kanye namathuba amaningi. Umbuzo 7: Kuthiwani ngemiphakathi ethile ezama-social media? Imiphakathi ethile ikhuluma ngezindaba ezithile ezithinta izithakazelo zabo, okuholela ekwakheni izinkundla zamasiko lapho abantu babelana ngempilo yabo, iziphiwo, nezinkumbulo, kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe ama-social media angaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini? Yebo, ama-social media angaba nomthelela omuhle. Zivumela abantu ukuthi babe nezwi eliqinile, bahlanganyele ezindabeni ezibalulekile, futhi bakhe umphakathi olungile. Izinhlangano ezizimele zingasebenzisa ama-social media ukuze zikhuthaze izizathu ezifanele, zikhuthaze impilo yomphakathi, futhi ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani umphakathi ungathuthukisa ukuhamba phambili kwezokuxhumana nge-social media? Umphakathi ungathuthukisa ukuhamba phambili kwezokuxhumana nge-social media ngokwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngezindlela ezinhle zokusebenzisa lezi zinkundla. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukufundisa abantu ngemiphumela emihle nemibi yokusebenzisa ama-social media ukuze benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayifunda ku-social media? Sifunda ukuthi ukuxhumana, ukwabelana, nobudlelwano bubaluleke kakhulu empilweni. Ama-social media asisiza ukuba sibe nolwazi oluningi ngempilo yabanye, nokuqonda izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Ngokubambisana, singakha umphakathi onokuqonda, ohloniphekile, nolwazi. Ekugcineni, ama-social media ayingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu yanamuhla, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele ukuze sithole izinzuzo eziningi futhi siqonde izingozi ezihambisana nawo. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzise ama-social media ukuze sikhulume, sihlanganyele, futhi sakhe umphakathi omuhle.
Ukubamba Iqhaza Kwabavoti Nentando Yeningi Ezinsukwini zakamuva, ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kuhamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungisa, kanye nenqubekelaphambili kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuziwe nemihlangano ehlukahlukene emaphethelweni ezinkundleni zokuvota, lapho abavoti bahlala bephakamisa izingqinamba nezidingo zabo. Ngale ndlela, kukhulu ukubaluleka kokwazi ukuthi ubani onguMphakathi, futhi nalo msebenzi ubaluleke kakhulu emphakathini. Umshuwalense wezombusazwe ubonisa ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwezimpempe zempilo nabadlali bezombusazwe ungalokhu ubaluleke, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izakhiwo ezisemthethweni ezinika abavoti ithuba lokubonisa imicabango yabo. Kulokhu, isikhathi sokuvota sihamba phambili ekubambeni iqhaza kwabavoti, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke uqonda izinqubo ezibandakanya ukuthuthukiswa komthetho kanye nokuthola okudingekayo ukuze kuphumelele. Ukwaziswa kwezinhloso zeqembu lezemidlalo akugwema kuphela abavoti, kodwa nakho kusebenza njengezikhali ekuthuthukiseni umbono wabantu. Benza ngezidingo zomphakathi, abavoti badala amandla okwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abantu ababamba iqhaza emphakathini. Ngaphandle kokubambisana, umphakathi ungenza izinqumo ezingalungile, ezithinta ikakhulukazi izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo. Ngokwejwayelekile, ababhekele izinkundla zezombusazwe kumele bahloniphe amalungelo abavoti nendima abawudlalayo. Ukuze kube nokuthula kwentando yeningi, kubalulekile ukuvikela izimiso eziphezulu zokuphatha, nyangazonke ezithinta abantu. Lokhu kuza nokulawulwa kwezinkantolo, okukhuthaza ukuthi abavoti bagcine ukwaziswa okuphelele ngayo yonke imikhankaso, okukhona edolobheni, ezindaweni, nasemiphakathini emikhulu. Ekuhlola izindaba ezithinta abavoti, kube nempumelelo enkulu eziteshini zokusakaza, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nakwezinye izinsizakalo. Lokhu kumgqugquzela ukuba abavoti bazi ngezindaba zokuqhuba umphakathi, izinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho ethinta ukubaluleka kwentando yeningi. Ukwaziswa okusheshayo kwezenzakalo kwenza kube lula kwabavoti ukuthi benze izinqumo eziphusile uma bejolisa ezicini ezithinta izimfuno zabo, izifiso, nezifundo zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi abavoti bahlale bejabulile ngezinguquko zezombusazwe. Umphakathi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi bahlonipha izinqumo ezithathwa ezikhungweni ezisemthethweni, njalo kuncike ekubambeni iqhaza. Uma abavoti bephold kukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta izinqumo zomphakathi, baphendula kakhulu onke amafundo abafanele ukwenza ezifundazweni, izifunda, kanye nemiphakathi emikhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda nokubaluleka kokuhlala ngokuqhubekayo kubavoti. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanelekile ukuthi osomqulu bakhulume ngempumelelo yokubambisana phakathi kwezindabuko zomphakathi. Izinsizakalo zokuvota zidinga ukusiza abavoti ukuze baqhubeke bephileka, banothise ulwazi lwabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuvikeleni ukukhululeka kwezombusazwe kulabo abazimele, okuwukuphila eNingizimu Afrika. Ngenxa yokuthi abavoti bahlale benza izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo yonke, ukubamba iqhaza kwabo kufanele kube ukuphela komnotho. Imithetho nemigomo enembile izogcina izivumelwano ezisemthethweni, ezizoholela ekuqedeni ubuhlungu nokwehliswa kwezinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinselelo ezizalisekayo ezihlukahlukene. Ekugcineni, abavoti bazogcina bekhuthazekile futhi bejabulile ngaphandle kokuphikisana. Ubuhlakani bokwenqabela kunoma isiphi isikhumba sodlame kubalulekile, njengoba kuwenza abantu bakhululeke ukuxoxa ngemiphakathi yabo. Ukuba neqhaza elivulekile, ukunikela ukusiza abavoti kubalulekile ekuphatheni, ukuze intando yeningi iqhubeke phambili. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka nezinto ezithinta abavoti, ikakhulu uma bezama ukuthola izizathu ezizobenza baphile ngezimiso ezilandelayo. Amandla abavoti abe nezinguquko ezithinta umphakathi uzokwandisa ukukhalipha, izimo zokuphila, kanye necebo eliguquguqukayo kuzonke izinsuku ezizayo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabavoti kumele kube inhloso, ukuze imiphakathi ihlale ithuthuka futhi ibambe iqhaza elihle kwindalo. Njengoba izinsuku zenza zibe nezimo, kubalulekile ukuba abavoti baphinde baphike phansi ukuze balwe nemibono ephusile efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana nezinkampani zomphakathi nezinkampani ezisiza abavoti ukuze babambe iqhaza. Ukubambisana kwenze umphakathi ube ngcono, futhi umkhankaso walolu hlobo kufanele uqhubeke ushayelwa phambili.
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya: Izinguquko Nezinselelo Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya sekubalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhula komnotho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezidingo zokuphila kahle zikhuthaze uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo ukuba benze izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ugesi. Nokho, lezi zinguquko ziza nezinselelo eziningi. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukutholakala Kukagesi Uhulumeni, ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi, usungule izinhlelo eziningi zokwandisa ukufinyelela kukagesi emakhaya. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka phakathi ukwakhiwa kweziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi ezincane, ezitholakala kalula, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumakhaya angakatholi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa umehluko phakathi kwemiphakathi ethola ugesi kanye neyangaphandle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abangenamali zikhona, lapho uhulumeni enikeza izinsiza zokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza kukagesi, njengezikhungo zokufundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela enempilo, futhi baphile kahle. Izinkinga Ezingaphazamisa Ukutholakala Kukagesi Noma kunjalo, kunezinkinga eziningi ezithinta ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezikhona zihlala zinganele. Izindawo ezisemaphandleni zihlupheka kakhulu, futhi abanye abantu basathola ugesi kuphela ngezikhathi ezithile. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekuphatheni izidingo zansuku zonke, njengoba ugesi usetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi, ezifana nezikole, ezibhedlela, nakumakhaya. Okwesibili, izindleko zokufaka ugesi emakhaya zihlala ziphakeme. Abantu abaningi abakwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokufaka ugesi, ikakhulukazi uma behlupheka. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye bahlale bephila ngaphandle kukagesi, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila impilo efanele. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokubambisana Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani ezikhiqiza ugesi, kanye nemiphakathi. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezibandakanya imiphakathi zingasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezizwakalayo. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi ezincane, ezisebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, zingasiza ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kukagesi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi bangawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi ukuze baphile kahle, futhi baphumelele emikhakheni ehlukene. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Kokutholakala Kukagesi Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akusikho kuphela isidingo sokuphila, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokufinyelela kukagesi okungaguquki. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ugesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo. Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya akuyona nje into ethinta izindlu, kodwa kuyisici esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi Ngiyanibingelela! Ngithanda ukuxoxa ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile - imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Ucabanga kanjani ngalokhu? Ngikholelwa ukuthi kubalulekile kakhulu emsebenzini wethu. Futhi, uma kuhle, kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokukhulisa abathintekayo emsebenzini. Masizibuze: kungani imiklomelo ibalulekile? Siphila emhlabeni ophakathi kokuncintisana. Ukuze uphumelele, kufanele ubonakale. Lokhu kwenza imiklomelo ibaluleke kakhulu. Uma abasebenzi beqashwe, kufanele bazi ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma. Ngakho, uma umuntu engakhiphi umphumela omuhle, kufanele anikezwe umvuzo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuqonda nokuhloniphana phakathi kwabantu nabaqashi babo. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi imiklomelo ayikhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngiphongu. Kukhona ulwazi oluningi olunokuthokozisa. Umsebenzi omuhle ungawina imiklomelo efana nezipho, izinhlelo zamasonto, noma nemiklomelo yezezimali. Ukuphakanyiswa empumelelweni kwayisiyondlela yokukhulisa umoya wokusebenza. Lokhu kuvumela abantu ukuba bazethembe futhi babe nomdlandla emsebenzini wabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izici ezibalulekile ezihambelana nemiklomelo zihlanganisa ukuthi imiklomelo ibhekelele izinjongo zomuntu. Lokhu kudinga abaphathi bazi kahle izidingo zabantu abaqashwe, ukuze imiklomelo ingabi nzima. Izinhlelo eziphathelene nemiklomelo zidinga ukwakha ibhuloho elihle phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi, ukuze kube nelungelo elilodwa elithokozisayo lokuphumelela. Kubantu abahola izinkampani, ukuqashelwa kubalulekile. Ubulili, iminyaka, noma iminyaka yokusebenza akufanele kushaywe indiva. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abasebenzi abaqashelwayo banokukhula kwempumelelo. Lokhu kuthokozisa ngoba uma udlulisela imiphumela, uthuthuka. Lokhu kusiza ekwenzeni okuhle, nokuhamba phambili. Kukhona nezinye izindlela ezithakazelisayo zokwenza imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kubaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudala umkhankaso wobuhlakani obuthakazelisayo. Ungacela iziphakamiso ezivumela abasebenzi ukuba bazikhombise. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abadlali beqembu bamele imiphumela, hhayi abazimele. Ngemuva kokuncintisana nokuqhamuka nezinhlelo ezinobuchule, imiklomelo ingahunyushwa ngezindlela eziningi. Abantu abathola ukujabuliswa nokuqashelwa bazokwenza okungcono nekhono labo. Lokhu kusiza ekuqwashiseni ngethempeli lokukhula, ubuchule, nezinhlelo. Khumbula, imiklomelo akufanele ibe indawo yokuphela. Kukho nezinye izindlela eziningi zokuxhumana. Umsebenzi omuhle akuyona kuphela umphumela wezinto ezenzakalayo, kodwa kuyakwazi ukubheka izifiso, ukuhamba phambili, nokufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukwenza kube njani imiklomelo nokuqashelwa. Ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izinkampani ezithobekile kubalulekile. Singenza kube munye omunye ngaphandle kokuxabana phakathi kwamaqembu emisebenzini. Kulezi zinhlelo, kufanele sihlele izinselelo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga izinqubomgomo ezizimisele zokubambisana. Lokhu kuzokwenza imiklomelo ibe yindlela efanelekile yokugcina abantu bejabule. Ezinye izinhlelo zasendaweni zivumela abavakashi ukwenza imiklomelo yabo. Izinkampani ezinkulu ziphumelele, kepha kulungile sikhumbule nezintsha. Ngokuqhubekayo, imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kumele kube ngaphezu kokunikezwa kwemali. Kufanele kube yindlela yokubhalisa umphakathi. Ngokuqhubeka, imiklomelo kufanele ibheke emithanjeni ethakazelisayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube ngempumelelo kangcono futhi kube nempilo engcono. Ngakho, ucabanga kanjani ngalokhu? Ngokuqinisekile, imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kubalulekile. Akufanele kube umaqondana kuphela phakathi kobufakazi nokugcina, kodwa futhi imiklomelo ibalulekile kumathuba, ukwakha, nokuqhuba umoya omuhle phakathi. Ngiyabonga ngokuba nawe kulesi sikhuthazo, ngifisa konke okuhle!
Izimoto: Ukukhula Nokuthuthuka Kwezokuthutha Ezweni Lethu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimoto zibe yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu, zishintsha indlela esihamba ngayo, sithutha izimpahla, futhi zithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ezweni lethu, izimoto zikhula ngokushesha, zibonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimoto Izimoto zokuqala zatholakala emakhulwini eminyaka edlule, kodwa zathandwa kakhulu phakathi nekhulu le-20. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakhiweni nasekuthuthukisweni kwezimoto, okuhlanganisa nezimoto ezizimele. Namuhla, imboni yezimoto ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, njengokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi, ukwandisa ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokwenza izimoto ezihlala isikhathi eside. Izimoto Zokuhamba Ngezinsizakalo Izimoto zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokuhamba. Ezweni lethu, izinkampani ziqala ukusebenzisa izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, okwenza kube nokunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle emvelweni. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokuhamba eziphumelelayo, ezifana nezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisheshayo, ezitholakala kalula kubantu abaningi. Izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi zikhombisa ukuthi imboni iyazama ukunciphisa umthelela wayo emvelweni. Izimoto Nezokuphepha Ngokukhula kwezimoto, kuphinde kwavela izinselelo ezihlobene nokuphepha. Izingozi zomgwaqo zihlala zikhathaza umphakathi, futhi imboni yezimoto ibhekene nezidingo zokwenza izimoto eziphephile. Izinhlelo zokuphepha, ezifana nezinhlelo zokubona izingozi, izikhumbuzo zokuhlola, kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula ukushayela, zathuthukiswa ukuze zinciphise izingozi, okuveza umzamo wokuvikela abashayeli nabagibeli. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhula, futhi izimoto zikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu. Izimoto ezizimele, ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokufunda komshini, zikhombisa ikusasa elikhangayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhamba ezizimele, ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kokuthutha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimoto ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi zenza kube lula ukuhamba, zikhombisa izindlela ezihamba phambili, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi abashayeli bahlala bexhumekile. Imithetho Nezinhlelo Zokulawula Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimoto zisebenza kahle, imithetho nezinhlelo zokulawula zibalulekile. Ezweni lethu, uhulumeni ubeka imithetho eqinile yokuphepha, efaka phakathi izidingo zokuhlola izimoto, izikhumbuzo zokushayela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izingozi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto ezisemgwaqweni zihlala ziphephile futhi zisebenza kahle. Umthelela Emnothweni Imboni yezimoto inemithelela eminingi emnothweni. Isebenza njengomthombo omkhulu wemisebenzi, ikhiqiza amathuba emisebenzi emikhakheni ehlukene, kusukela ekwakhiweni kwezimoto kuya ezinsizakalweni zokuhamba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkampani ezikhiqiza izingxenye, izinkampani zokuhamba, kanye nezinsizakalo zokulungisa. Umnotho wezokuthutha ubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yabantu. Isiphetho Izimoto zibe yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu, zishintsha indlela esihamba ngayo, sithutha izimpahla, futhi sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba imboni yezimoto iqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo ezihlobene nezokuphepha, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomthelela emvelweni zidinga ukunakwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sithuthukisa izimoto zethu ukuze zibe nezinga eliphezulu lokuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nomthelela omuhle emvelweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, kube nokuphepha, futhi kube nempilo engcono kubantu bonke.
Wamkelekile ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, ePhalamende leminyaka eyikhulu nesishiyagalombili! Le Phalamende iyabantu! Umbono wethu uwukwakha iPhalamende eliphendulayo elihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu futhi eliqhutshwa umbono wokwakha izinga elingcono lokuphila kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Siqinisekisa ngezinhlelo zethu ukuthi imiphakathi eshaywayo ihlale ifakiwe. Indima edlalwa yiPhalamende kanye nemiphumela elindelekile ukuveza abantu futhi kuqinisekiswe uhulumeni wabantu osebenza ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokudlulisela kwemithetho, ukuqapha umsebenzi owenziwa uhulumeni, nokuhlanganisa abantu emisebenzini yephalamende. UMthethosisekelo uyimthetho ophezulu weRiphabhulikhi futhi ubeka isisekelo somphakathi ovulekile nowedemokhrasi lapho uhulumeni ephethe khona abantu futhi lapho umthetho uvikela bonke abantu ngokulinganayo. Uveza ukubaluleka nezindlela zokuphatha ngendlela yedemokhrasi enakekela abantu. IPhalamende lenziwe ngababonisi abangama-400 abakhethwe ngabantu ngokhetho olukhululekile nolufanele, kwakha iSishayamthetho SaseNingizimu Afrika. Izifundazwe zimelelwa yiNational Council of Provinces ePhalamende, eyakhiwe ngababonisi abayishumi besuka esifundazweni ngasinye. IPhalamende lethu ledemokhrasi linomlando omuhle mayelana nokumelwa kwabesifazane. Okwamanje, abesifazane benza u-43 percent wamalungu ePhalamende. Kusukela ngo-2009, sibe sesibekwe endaweni yesithathu emhlabeni mayelana nokumelwa kwabesifazane. Inhloso yokumelwa kwabesifazane ePhalamende ingu-50%. Futhi sinePhalamende elisebenzayo kakhulu! Into yokuqala eyenziwe yiPhalamende lethu lokuqala ledemokhrasi ngo-1994 wukukhetha uMongameli uNelson Mandela njengomholi wesifunda. Ngomhla kaMeyi 24, 1994, uMongameli uMandela wakhuluma iSimo Sezwe sokuqala ezindlini ezimbili zePhalamende ezikhethwe ngabantu. Kusukela lapho, iPhalamende lamukela uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996 futhi ladlulisa imithetho engaphezu kwenkulungwane! Uyalungela ukuhlola izimanga zale Phalamende emangalisayo? Masiqhubeke nohambo lwethu lokubona iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika! Lolu hambo ngezithombe zekhompyutha lugxile ezintweni ezintathu zePhalamende, okungukuthi i-Old Assembly, i-National Assembly, kanye ne-NCOP. Thatha isikhathi sakho ukuze ubheke!... Le yisiqondiso sePhalamende. Izindlu, okuyiNational Assembly, iNational Council of Provinces, kanye neTuynhuys zisebenzisa le sikhiye lapho ofisi zohulumeni kanye neofisi zamaphathi ePhalamende zitholakala khona. UMongameli uhamba ePhalamende Street lapho ehamba ukuya eMnyango weNational Assembly ukuze akhulume iSimo Sezwe sonyaka ezindlini ezimbili zePhalamende. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma iSimo Sezwe, esivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "Ukuvulwa kwePhalamende," zombili izinhlangothi zePhalamende Street zigcwele amaCivil Guards of Honour. ISlave Lodge iyindawo yokukhumbula nokuhlonipha. Yakhiwe yinkampani yaseDutch East India Company ngo-1679. Yayisetshenziswa yiCouncil of Advice njenge ndawo yokuhlangana ngaphambi kokuthi iPhalamende leCape lisungulwe, futhi yayisetshenziswa futhi njengehhovisi likahulumeni, iHigh Court, iPost Office, futhi ekugcineni yaba yiMnyuziyamu Yomlando Wamasiko. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma iSimo Sezwe, uMongameli kanye neqembu lakhe bahamba ezikhumbuzweni ezibomvu ukusuka eSlave Lodge baya kwiNational Assembly ngesikhathi sokuhlangana okukhona phakathi kwezindlu ezimbili zePhalamende. Isakhiwo seMarks sitholakala ngaphesheya kwesakhiwo seNational Council of Provinces ePhalamende Street. Sakhiwe ngo-1904, Isakhiwo seMarks sikhona njengamanje kusetshenziswa amaqembu aphikisanayo kanye nabasebenzi bawo. Phambilini, sasisetshenziswa ngamalungu eHouse of Delegates kwi-tri-cameral Parliament ngaphambi kuka-1987. I-tri-cameral Parliament ka-1985 yayinezigaba zamaBhulu, amaColoured, kanye namaNdiya, kanti abantu abamnyama bahlala bengekho. I-Afrika House itholakala endaweni ebalulekile endaweni yePhalamende ngaphesheya kweNational Assembly. Yayiyihhovisi leBritish High Commissioner, futhi manje isetshenziswa yiJoint Committee on Intelligence kanye nezinye ofisi zephalamende. Ngaphakathi kwe-Afrika House kukhona enye yezinto ezindala kakhulu zobuciko bephalamende ezenziwe lapha ekhaya: ibhokisi elakhiwe ng wood yeMimosa elineminyaka engaphezu kwengu-350 futhi washaywa ngamavuthondaba aqinile asuka empumalanga ngo-1892. Isethaphu yeSpeaker yayigcinwe kulesi bhokisi iminyaka eminingi. "Stal" ngesiNgisi kusho isikhala. Ekuqaleni, umnyango omkhulu weStalplein, owawuhlinzekwe ngezindawo zokuhlala zeCape Governor, wawuseCompany Gardens ngakolunye uhlangothi lweTuynhuys, owawuhlinzekwe njengendawo yokugcina amathuluzi e-VOC, eyaziwa nangokuthi iDutch East India Company, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi yayisetshenziswa futhi yizo zonke iziphathamandla zeCape. Izakhiwo zephalamende ezalandelayo zakhiwa kancane kancane ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwezindawo ezintsha, futhi ngo-1988 isakhiwo esaziwa njengeNew Wing, lapho iNational Assembly itholakala khona, sakhonkolo neTuynhuys. Ngesikhathi seseshini yephalamende, uMongameli usebenzisa iTuynhuys njengehhovisi likamongameli. ITuynhuys iphethwe ngokuzimela futhi ayabelani ukuphathwa nePhalamende. Kwesikhathi eside, iPhalamende imele izinto ezahlukene kubantu abahlukene. Lapho ungena ePhalamende ngeRoeland Street, isithombe sikaJan Louis Botha ophakanyisiwe sivame ukuveza umbuzo: Umbuzo uthi: Yini eyenziwa ngamaqhawe amasha omhlaba? Nokho, lesi sithombe siyimpahla yomkhandlu weDolobha laseKapa. Imingcele yePhalamende yenziwe ngogodo oluhamba ePleins Street, kanye neCompany Gardens eNtshonalanga. Umnyango ngeRoeland Street usetshenziswa ngamalungu ePhalamende kanye nokupaka kubo kanye nabasebenzi bephalamende. Ngesikhathi sokuvulwa kwePhalamende nezinye izenzakalo zeSimo, iMemorial Flame ivulwa ukuze ihloniphe bonke abashonile emabhubhane ahilela iNingizimu Afrika. UMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika ungumholi ophakeme wezikhali zalesi sizwe. Isikhungo sokuvakasha sitholakala esakhiweni esidala sePost Office, esingesinye sePhalamende. IPhalamende wamukela izivakashi ezivela kude nasezindaweni eziseduze, futhi abafundi bakwamukela ikakhulukazi. Ngaphezu kuka-25,000 izivakashi ziyavakashela iPhalamende minyaka yonke. Izivakashi zidinga ukuveza ubunikazi obusemthethweni ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa ukungena ePhalamende. Kuvame ukuba nokuhamba, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokukhuluma iSimo Sezwe (okubizwa nangokuthi ukuvulwa konyaka kwePhalamende) nakuba uNgqongqoshe wezeMali ekhuluma. IPoorthuis iyaziwa nangokuthi iGate House, umnyango wesakhiwo se-Old Assembly. Kumele uhlelwe ukuze uqinisekiswe ukuphepha uma ungene lapha. Uma ungene ngalendlela, kukhona amamitha angama-30 eKeiskamma Tapestry (buka iHotspot).
Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha Isingeniso Lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa indlela yokuhlela izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha. Uhlelo lwethu luzogxila ezicini ezihlukahlukene ezithinta intsha, izizathu zokungasebenzi kwabo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Kulolu hlelo, sizobheka izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingxoxo zikhuluma ngempumelelo futhi zikhuthaza izinqumo eziphumelelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Izingxoxo 1. Ukubamba Izingxoxo Zokuqala Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abamele ikomidi bazi kahle izihloko ezizoxoxwa. Lokhu kungafaka izifundo ezitholwe ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngaphambili mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha. 2. Ukuhlela Izinsuku Nezindawo Beka izinsuku ezithile zokuhlangana. Qinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsuku zikhona kubo bonke abamele ikomidi, futhi uhlinzeke ngezindawo ezikahle nezidingekayo ukuze kube nokuxhumana kahle. 3. Ukubiza Izikhulumi Biza izikhulumi ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezithunywa zezinhlangano zentsha, abezindaba, kanye nochwepheshe bezokusebenza ukuze bahlale bephendula imibuzo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlola Izizathu Zokungasebenzi Kwentsha 1. Ukwenza Ucwaningo Qinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo lwakhelwe kahle ukuze kutholakale izizathu ezivela kubantu abasha. Lokhu kungafaka izifundo ezibhalwe phansi, izifundo zocwaningo, kanye nemibuzo ethunyelwe kubantu abasha. 2. Ukuxoxa Nezithunywa Zokwakha Thola izinkulumo ezivela ezithunyweni ezihlukene ezikhuluma ngempumelelo yokusebenza kwentsha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izizathu ezihambisana nokungasebenzi kwentsha. 3. Ukuhlanganisa Imibono Hlanganisa imibono ehlukahlukene evela ezithunyweni, ukuze uthole umbono ophelele mayelana nezizathu zokungasebenzi kwentsha. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuxoxa Ngezixazululo 1. Ukubheka Izixazululo Ezingaba Khona Ngemuva kokuhlola izizathu, qhubeka nokubheka izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokusebenza, imikhankaso yokukhuthaza, noma izinhlelo zokufundisa. 2. Ukwakha Uhlelo Lokusebenza Dala uhlelo lokusebenza olucacile oluzobandakanya izinyathelo ezithile ezizothathwa ukuze kuqedwe ukungasebenzi kwentsha. Lokhu kuzofaka izinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo, izinsuku ezithile, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo. 3. Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zokusebenza Xhumana nezikhungo zendawo ezifana nezikole, izikhungo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhungo zentuthuko ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izixazululo zikhona. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Imiphumela 1. Ukubeka Izinkomba Zempumelelo Dala izinkomba ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlola impumelelo yezixazululo ezithathwayo. Lokhu kungafaka izibalo zokusebenza kwentsha, izibalo zokuphuma emsebenzini, kanye nezilinganiso zokwaneliseka. 2. Ukwenza Ucwaningo Lokubuyekeza Hlela ucwaningo lokubuyekeza ukuze uthole umbono wokuthi izixazululo zisebenza kanjani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. 3. Ukuphendula Izimpendulo Phendula izimpendulo ezitholakele ukuze uthuthukise izinhlelo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphucula izixazululo ezitholakalayo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuxhumana Nentsha 1. Ukwakha Izinhlelo Zokuxhumana Dala izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela intsha. Lokhu kungafaka izinkundla zokuxhumana, imihlangano, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. 2. Ukwenza Imikhankaso Yokukhuthaza Hlela imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukuze uthumele imiyalezo ethile ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela abantu abaningi. 3. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Qinisekisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwePhalamende nentsha buye bukhula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izixazululo ezithile. Isiphetho Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha zidinga ukuhlela kahle, ukuqonda izizathu, nokubheka izixazululo ezithile. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukwakha uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuxazulula le nkinga ebalulekile. Ukuxhumana nentsha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izixazululo zethu zisebenza futhi zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa imiphumela emihle ezimpilweni zabantu abasha.
