Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall, ophakamiswe ngabangani bezeMpilo nezokufunda eminyakeni edlule, ube nesizathu esijulile emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zimpikiswano, ezazifaka impilo nezindleko zamaholo ezikoleni ephakeme, zaphinde zavula ithuba lokuxoxa ngababukeli bomphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni. Ngalesi sihloko, sizobuyekezwa umthelela wesikhathi eside walomkhankaso, wokuqonda ukuthi usithinte kanjani umphakathi, izinqubomgomo zezemfundo, kanye nokuqhubeka kwempilo yabafundi. Ukuphakanyiswa kwe-Fees Must Fall kwakuwuphawu lokuphikisana kokufuna uguquko olukhulu ezindlekweni zemfundo. Lokhu kwaholela ezimfudlaniswaneni phakathi kwabafundi, abanikazi bezikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni. Umkhankaso, ophakanyiswe ngezinga elikhulu ngo-2015, waphawula ukufana kwezinkinga ezithinta abafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi amafundi avela emiphakathini ethukile. Lokhu kubonisa isidingo sokwehlisa izindleko zemfundo ukuze ivule izindlela zokufunda komphakathi wonke. Naphezu kwamathuba amaningi afunwa amalungelo abantu, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ushayele ubuhlungu ezikhungweni zemfundo. Uhlale ubonisa ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezifundiswa, okuyinto edalule izifundo ezibalulekile ezithinta ubunjalo bezikhozi zomphakathi. Njengoba abadlali abahlukene behambisana nezimpikiswano, umphakathi uqhubekile ngokwethula izinhlelo ezintsha, ezifana neMali yokufunda, ezihlosiwe ukusiza abafundi abangasekho kuzo zonke izigaba. Kodwa, umthelela walomkhankaso akugcinanga nje ngokwenyuka kwezindleko. Uhisile ubuchwepheshe bokuqonda kwempilo yempilo zabafundi. Abafundi abangama-Fees Must Fall baveze izinselele ezenzeka emiphakathini ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlaba umkhosi wezothando nolwazi lwemfundo. Lokho kuholele ekubeni abafundi bazame ukuhlanganisa amalungelo nezidingo zabo, besebenzisa izikhungo zokuxhumana ukuze babelane ngezinto ezihlukene ezibahambayo. Umkhankaso ubenomthelela ekugqugquzeleni izinqubomgomo ezilungisiwe. Uhlangothi lwezombusazwe, oluhlangene nalezi zicelo, luzange lube nemiphumela emihle. Izikhungo zemfundo ziphinde zenze izinyathelo ezinzima ekushintsheni izinqubomgomo, okubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele nama-bursaries kwabafundi abavela emiphakathini ethukile. Lokhu kuveza ukusebenzisa kahle izinsiza, kuphinde kudlule kudinga izikhungo ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi abakhiqizi bazo babhekelela umphakathi wonke. Kodwa-ke, kunokukhathazeka okuningi kuphakathi. Noma sezikhona izinyathelo ezithathwe, ubudlelwane phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nabafundi buphatheke kabi. Amabhande asezulwini ashiywe emhlabeni, ngemishumo ezishukumisayo ezifunwa ukusombululwa. Lokhu kubangela ukuhlanganyela phakathi kwabafundi, okuyinto eyangaqondakali, bese kudala imikhankaso engalindelekile. Ngaphezu kwezinqubomgomo, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uvuselele ingxoxo emikhulu ngenhlonipho yokufunda. Kuphinde kwaba nempumelelo ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe bemfundo, okuhlinzeka ngaphezulu kwethuba lokufunda ngemithombo ehlukene. Abafundi bayaziqhenya ngokuveza ubuciko bomphakathi, besebenzisa indlela yokuphila ehloswe ngophiko lokwazisa nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ukuze siqonde umthelela wesikhathi eside, kufanele sihlole nokuphambana phakathi kokuphakanyiswa kwesimo esihamba nalesi sikhumbuzo. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ukhuthaze ukuxhumana okukhanyayo phakathi kwabafundi, abaholi bezifundo, nohulumeni, kodwa unganqoba ukukhathazeka kwezifundiswa. Ukusho lokhu, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke ukuyenza imizamo emisha yokutakula izithiyo, Ukwazi kamba izidingo ezifanele izigaba futhi sibe nezingxoxo ezikuleso sikhumbuzo. Njengoba sihamba phambili, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube yinto eyisikhumbuzo sokuguquka kwemiphakathi kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngokuhlanganyela, umphakathi ungakha izindawo eziphathekayo zomphakathi ezinhloboni. Ngokufingqa, umthelela wesikhathi eside walomkhankaso kuveza ithuba lokwazisa kwabafundi, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zemfundo, nezinqubomgomo ezithinta yonke imiphakathi. Lokhu kungase kube yisifundo esimaqhubu, esiqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane, abesilisa, nosomabhizinisi banokufunda futhi baphumelele, baphinde bakhulise ithemba lobuchwepheshe obusha. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ungomunye wezinto eziba namandla okufundisa umphakathi nezifundo eziphakeme, zikhumbuza imbali yokuphila nezimpilo zabafundi. Ukukhipha izimpendulo eziphumelelayo ezaziyingxenye yeziqu, ukwazisa ngemfundo, kubalulekile ukuze umphakathi ube belungile. Lokhu akusona nje isifiso, kodwa ibhadi eliqinileyo lokuphuma, ukuhamba phambili, nokubuyisela ithemba kulabo abake bahlula izindlela. Ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, kuzodingeka ukuthi siguquke, sibe nezindlela eziqhubekayo, thina sonke. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ukufunda akukona ukuhlola, kodwa ukuhamba phambili ndawonye, ukunxenxa uthando nesifiso sokuphila, sifuna izimpendulo ezingaphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba izifundiswa zobuchwepheshe bukhulise izinqola ezilungile, uhlelo lwezizinda nemfundo, ukuze izizukulwane zethu zibe nesizathu sokukhula. Lokhu kuzoshukumisela ubuchwepheshe, umbono wezemfundo, nezimpilo zethu zonke, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall.
Izikhukhula Kwakukhona idolobha elincane, elalibizwa ngeMhlangamvula, elaliphila ngokuthula ezwenikazi elikahle. Abantu balo babeyazisa kakhulu imvula, ngoba imvula yayiletha ukuphila. Kodwa, kwaba nezinsuku lapho imvula yaguquka yaba umoya, yaphenduka ingozi. Kwakungumjolo ohlukeneyo, njengoba kwakukhona ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emkhathini. Ngolunye usuku, kwavela izinkanyezi ezinhle phezulu, kodwa abantu baseMhlangamvula bazi ukuthi lokho kusho ukuthi imvula izofika. UMaNandi, umama odabuka emndenini omkhulu, wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayezokwazi ukujabulisa umndeni wakhe ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Ngemuva kokuthi imvula iqale, uMaNandi waphakamisa izikhumbuzo zendabuko, ezifana namasiko okuphakamisa izihlahla ukuze athole izibusiso. Kodwa imvula yanda kakhulu. Izinsuku zashintsha zaba izinyanga, imvula yaphenduka ingamaphuzu amakhulu okukhala. Izinkanyezi zashabalala, imvula yenza umhlaba waba nzima, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezinzima. Abantwana babehamba bezama ukuvikela imiphako yabo, kanti omama benza imizamo yokuhlanza imizi yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imvula yanda kakhulu, yenza amanzi ahlume. Amaphuzu okukhala aqala ukufika ezindaweni eziphakeme, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi kudinga ukuhamba ngokushesha. UMaNandi, naye, wagxila ekutheni angawuqeda kanjani umndeni wakhe. Wafaka zonke izinto ezibalulekile emathangeni, efuna indawo ephephile. Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthembu, umphakathi wezinsuku, owayehamba enanela izimo zomhlaba. Waqonda ukuthi lezi zikhukhula zazingaphezu kwalokho okwakukhulunywa ngakho. Wavuma ukuhamba nendoda yakhe, uBheki, naba lezozisebenzi ukuze bazame ukwakha izivivinyo ezincane ukuze bavikele umphakathi. Ubenamasu azama ukukhipha abantu ezindlini zabo, kodwa izikhukhula zashaya kalula. Abantu bahlala phansi, beziqhenya ngezimali zabo, kodwa umoya wawuhlasele, ubafaka emoyeni. UMaNandi wanika abantwana bakhe izinqumo zokuhlala phansi, balinde ukuzwakalisa izwi labo. Ukuphila kwabo kwakukanye, futhi bahlala benethemba lokuthi kuzofika usuku lapho imvula izoba nomusa. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, izikhukhula zafika phezulu, zaphenduka umfula omkhulu. Izinto zashabalala emanzini, izindlu zashiywa zinefulegi, izimpahla zashabalala. Umphakathi wabona ukuthi kudinga ukuhamba, kanti uMaNandi noBheki bazi ukuthi kufanele basebenze ndawonye. Ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwelanga, uMaNandi wabona umhlaba ubukeka unguzi omkhulu. Kwakuwumfula omkhulu, umoya uthelelekile. Abantu baqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo, bezama ukufinyelela endaweni ephephile. Kukhona abanye abavela emiphakathini ethile, bekhumbula izinsuku ezinhle, imvula enezibusiso. UMaNandi noBheki bahamba naphakathi kwabantu, benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuvikela umphakathi. Umoya wezinsuku ezinzima wabuya, izikhukhula zathinta ithafa, kodwa abantu bazi ukuthi bazohlala bephila, bejabulisa imindeni yabo. Ngemuva kwezinsuku, izikhukhula zancipha kancane, ukuze umhlaba uphinde uthole umoya omusha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukuvuka, bahlola ukuthi kukhona okukhona. UMaNandi wabona ukuthi imiphakathini ibonakala ibusisiwe, futhi abantu bazi ukuthi umphakathi ungasebenza ndawonye. Izindlela zaba ngaphezulu, iziqephu zatholakala, futhi abantu basaqhubeka nokulima, behlola izindlela ezithokozisayo. Uhlanga lwaluphilile, izikhukhula zashabalala, izinhlelo zashintsha. Abantu babefunda ukuthi uma behlangene, bangenza konke. UMaNandi, noBheki, nabanye bakwaMhlangamvula bazi ukuthi izikhukhula zazifana nezivunguvungu, zishintsha izinto, kodwa umoya wokubambisana wawunamandla. Ngemuva kwezinyanga, kwavela izimbali ezintsha, izihlahla zakhula futhi umhlaba wabukeka kahle. Abantu bahlala behlangene, behamba phambili, benza izinhlelo zokwakha kabusha. UMaNandi waba yisibonelo sokuhlanganyela, ethi: "Sihamba ndawonye, sikhuluma ngothando, sibhekene nanoma yini." Ngaleso sikhathi, izikhukhula zenzeka, kodwa umoya wokuqina wawuhlala unamandla.
Izakhamuzi zomphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele zimenywa ukuba zifake iziphakamiso zabantu ukuze kube neBhodi leMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Ibhodi izoba namalungu ayisixhenxe, azokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe wezobuDlelwano neMisebenzi. Okungenani ilungu elilodwa kumele libe nolwazi ngezindaba zezimali. Ngesikhathi sokukhetha abantu, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi abakhethiweyo kumele babe nolwazi olunzulu ngezakhamuzi kazwelonke, ubuchwepheshe obubanzi bezimali nokuphathwa, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokubambisana nezithakazelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe uxhaso lwezocwaningo lwezesayensi, kanye nokuzibophezela ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza zomphakathi kanye nobuchwepheshe obukhethekile emkhakheni wokusebenza kweMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Iphaneli yokuhlola izokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze idale uhlu lwabaphakanyisi abafanele/abakhethiweyo ukuze kucatshangelwe. Indima yephaneli yokuhlola izoba ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhamba kokugcina kuhlanganisa abantu abanobuchwepheshe obuphakeme noma ulwazi oluhlukile noma uthando emkhakheni ofanele, futhi ukuthi bamele abantu abahlukene, kahle, emiphakathini nakubantu bobulili, futhi ukuthi ukukhethwa okuphelele kutholakala kungokwephezulu kakhulu. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe, siqinisekisa ukwamukela isiphakamiso; kanye d Amagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabantu abathathu abakwazi ukuqinisekisa umuntu ophakanyisiwe. Iziphakamiso ngeke zicatshangelwe uma konke okukhulunywe ngenhla kungafakiwe.
ULawrence Luthango, umphakathi wezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi eGrain SA kule ndawo. UMonica Mathamba uhlala endaweni yaseMthatha Mbozisa lapho engum member weMbozisa Farmers' Association. UMonica uphumelele ekulimaleni izinkulungwane eziyi-6 futhi uphumelele ekulimaleni izinkundla zakhe lapho efaka khona amanzi. UMonica uhambele izifundo zokuqeqeshwa kweGrain SA zabafuyi, kuhlanganise nokwethulwa ekukhiqizeni ufulawa kanye nesifundo esiphakeme sokukhiqiza ufulawa. UMonica ukhuphule umkhiqizo wakhe usebenzisa ulwazi alutholile kwiGrain SA. Uvame ukukhiqiza amatonnes angu-3.5 ngehektare kodwa manje ukhiqiza amatonnes angu-4.5 ngehektare. UMonica uthola kanjani uxhaso lokutshala? Ukuze athole uxhaso lokuqala, UMonica usebenzisa imali engakhe ngoba umphathi wezezimali uvame ukuthola imali ebolekiwe ngemva kokuvuna. UMonica uthola kuphi izinto zokutshala? UMonica uthi uthenga izinto zokutshala zakhe zokuqala kwiMthiza Farmers Co-op nase-East Cape Co-op. Intengo ivame ukuba phezulu (zibiza kakhulu) futhi abafuyi banikezwa izeluleko mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezinto lezo. Yiziphi izinselelo abhekana nazo ekulimaleni nokuthi uphumelele kanjani kulolo work? UMonica ubhekana nezinkinga ezidinga ukuthi abakhiqizi banikeze imibiko (izeluleko) nezakhono ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe, futhi kufanele banikeze izindlela namathuba okuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo (izakhiwo). UMonica uthi akabhekani nalezi zinkinga ngoba sebekhulume ngazo izinqubomgomo zabo lapho kudingeka. UMonica uthi uthini ngempumelelo yakhe eqhubekayo ekulimaleni? UMonica uthi impumelelo yakhe ivela othandweni lwakhe olukhulu lokulima kanye nomsebenzi wakhe oqhubekayo onzima. Ukholelwa ukuthi ukusebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zembewu), umanyolo ofanele, nokuzama ukulawula izihlahla ezimbi ezinkundleni ngezinto zokwakha kuye kwamsiza ukukhuphula umkhiqizo wakhe. Ngonyaka ongenhla, UMonica ufuna ukuthenga imishini eminingi, ikakhulukazi imishini yokuphalaza.
### ITable Mountain: Intaba Ethokozisayo Ekhaya Ekhazimulayo LaseKapa Ekhaya elihle laseKapa, lapho imifula ibhalela izinkanyezi phezulu, kukhona intaba eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi iTable Mountain. Le ntaba, enezinhlangothi eziphakeme nezimfushane, ibonakala njengendawo ethokozisayo ebhalwe ngothando lwemvelo. ITable Mountain iyinsika yalesi siqhingi, ibhalela izinkanyezi zayo ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le ntaba yahlala ibalulekile kubantu bendawo. Abantu ababehlala eduze bavele bejabulela ukuhamba ngezinyawo, bephokophela phezulu, behlola ubuhle bayo. Umoya ohlanzekile, izihlahla ezimibalabala, nezinyoni ezithokozisayo zakhanga abaningi. Babekwazi ukuhamba phezulu, behlangana nemvelo, behlola izimangaliso zayo. Nokho, le ntaba ayigcini nje ngokuba yindawo yokuhlala; iyindawo yokucabanga, yokuphila, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezindaba zothando, ubuhlungu, nokuphumelela. Abantu babebhalela izinkanyezi zabo emoyeni, behamba phansi, befaka izinkumbulo zabo ezithokozisayo. ITable Mountain yayiyisikhumbuzo sothando, ubuhlungu, nezifiso eziphakeme. Ngesikhathi sokuphila kwamaXhosa, iTable Mountain yabe iyindawo ebalulekile. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngamaNdebele, amaKhoisan, nabanye abantu ababehlala kule ndawo. Le ntaba yayiyingxenye yempilo yabo, ibabamba ngezandla, ibanika amandla. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinzima, kodwa futhi zikhuluma ngezikhathi zokujabula, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlola izimangaliso zayo. Nokho, njengoba izinkanyezi zikhuluma, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyashintsha. Umhlaba uthola izinguquko, futhi iTable Mountain ayiphunyukanga kulokhu. Izikhathi zashintsha, abantu baphila ngezindlela ezahlukene, kodwa le ntaba yayihlala ikhona, ibhalela izinkanyezi zayo ezikhanyayo. ITable Mountain iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma yini eyenzekayo, imvelo izohlala ikhona, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi, izizukulwane zashintsha, kodwa iTable Mountain yahlala ibalulekile. Abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa imicabango yabo, behamba ngezinyawo, behlola izimangaliso zayo. ITable Mountain yabe iyindawo yokuhlangana, yokuxoxa, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, le ntaba yahlala ibalulekile. Abantu baphila ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, kodwa iTable Mountain yahlala ibalulekile. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. ITable Mountain iyinsika yempilo, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngakho-ke, uma uhamba eKapa, ungaphuthelwa ithuba lokuhlola le ntaba. ITable Mountain iyindawo yokuhlangana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nokuhamba ngezinyawo. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. ITable Mountain iyinsika yempilo, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu baphila ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, kodwa iTable Mountain iyinsika yempilo. Izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezinhle, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imvelo iyindlela yokuphila. ITable Mountain iyinsika yempilo, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli. Ngakho-ke, hamba uye eKapa, ubone iTable Mountain, uzwe izinkanyezi zayo, futhi uhlanganyele nalesi sikhathi esikhethekile. ITable Mountain izohlala ikhona, ibhalela izinkanyezi zethu ezikhanyayo, futhi ibonisa ubuhle obungapheli.
Intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese UJacob Zuma, owayenguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezinkulu ezihlobene nokushushiswa kwakhe. Lokhu kushushiswa kungenxa yokuhlukumezeka kwezomnotho, izinqubo zokuphatha kanye nezinye izigameko ezazihambisana nobugebengu obuhlobene nepolitiki. Isimo sokushushiswa kukaZuma sithokozisa futhi sidala ukungabaza phakathi kwabantu abaningi. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kwakhe, sigxile ezicini ezahlukene, okubandakanya izizathu, izinqubo zomthetho, kanye nemiphumela. Izizathu Zokushushiswa UZuma ubhekene nezinsolo eziningi, phakathi kwazo izinsolo zokukhwabanisa, ukuhlonipha imithetho, kanye nokuphula izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Izinsolo ezivamile zifaka phakathi kokusebenzisa amandla akhe kabi, ukungakhokhi intela, nokuba nezehlakalo ezixakile ezihlobene nezimali. Lezi zinselelo zikhombisa ukuthi uZuma wayephula imithetho esebenzayo, engahloniphi izinqubo ezifanele. Izinyathelo Zomthetho Ngemuva kokuba izinsolo zethulwe, izinyathelo zomthetho zathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uZuma ubhekana nezinsolo. Uhlelo lokushushiswa lutholakala ngaphakathi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho, lapho izinsolo zethulwa ezinkantolo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlolwa kwezinsolo, Ukuhlola ubufakazi, kanye nenqubomgomo yokuhlonza ubufakazi obuqinile. Ukushushiswa kwenzeka emiphakathini ethile, lapho abaculi bezomthetho beqhubeka nokucubungula izinsolo ezithile. Imiphumela Yokushushiswa Imiphumela yokushushiswa kukaZuma ibalulekile, futhi inezimpikiswano ezinzima. Okokuqala, lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezithombe ezimbi ngokuphatha kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Umphakathi uba nomuzwa wokukhathazeka mayelana nokwethenjwa kwezikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlinzeko ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kubangela ukungabaza emiphakathini, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuba abantu bakholwe ezinkantolo nasezinhlelweni zomthetho. Okwesibili, imiphumela yokushushiswa ingathinta umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Uma uZuma engashushiswa, lokhu kungaholela ekuqhamukeni kokungathembeki nokuhlukumezeka kwemali. Imali eyengeziwe yokuhlawula izindleko zomthetho, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsolo, ingathinta izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izindlela Zokuhlonza Nokuqonda Ukuze kuqondwe kahle intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaZuma, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izinqubo zomthetho, izinhlinzeko ezisemthethweni, kanye nezindlela zokuhlola izinsolo. Abantu kufanele bahlale bekwaziswa ngezenzakalo ezithinta uZuma, bazi kahle izinsolo, nezinyathelo zomthetho ezithathwayo. Ukwazi kahle lezi zici kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlonipha izinqubo zomthetho, nokuphendula ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho Ngokubheka intuthuko ecaleni lokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsolo zihlukaniswe ngaphezulu kwegazi. Izinyathelo zomthetho ziqondisa indlela yokuthi uZuma ubhekane nezinsolo, kuyilapho imiphumela yokushushiswa ibonisa umthelela kumphakathi nasezinhlelweni zomthetho. Ukwaziswa kwedlanzana kwezokuphatha nezinhlinzeko zomthetho kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ozinzile. Nokho, kudinga ukuba sihlale siqaphile, siqonde, futhi sibe nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile ezithinta lezi zinsolo ezinzima. Ngalokhu, sizokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele ngekamva lethu, futhi sibone ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele.
Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, kwaba nomcimbi obalulekile eMpumalanga Kapa, lapho abahlanganyeli behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngempilo yengqalasizinda yezibhedlela kulesi sifunda. Lo mcimbi waba nezinhlaka ezahlukene zabantu, kuhlanganisa ohulumeni, izodokotela, abaphathi bezibhedlela, kanye nemiphakathi, bonke bejolisa ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezikhungethe imitholampilo. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle izinkinga ezikhona, kube nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo ezikhombisa izinselelo ezihambisana nezibhedlela, njengezinkinga zezimali, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, nezinsiza zokwelapha. Kukhona umbono ovamile wokuthi izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zihlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima ezenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka ezidingekayo ngempela. Esigabeni sokuqala somcimbi, kudalwe inkulumo-mpikiswano phakathi kwabamele izibhedlela ezahlukene, lapho bakhombisa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokubhekana nezinkinga zengqalasizinda. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi lezi zibhedlela zidinga ukusekelwa okuningi ukuze zikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ukuhluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, njengokwelashwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kwaba yinkinga enkulu eboniswe ngababambe iqhaza. Okwengeziwe, umcimbi ubeke emphasis ekubhekaneni nezidingo zamakhasimende. Abantu abahlala eMpumalanga Kapa baveze ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngempilo yabo ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziphuthumayo zokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yezibhedlela, ukuze abantu bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, ngesikhathi esifanele. Abaholi bezinhlaka ezahlukene baphinde basebenzise leli thuba ukukhipha iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda. Kwakukhuluma ngentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe, okuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuphatha iziguli, kanye nokwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo. Abaholi baphinde bagcizelela isidingo sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezibhedlela nemiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zabantu ziyaziwa futhi ziyaqondiswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi waba nezingxoxo ezinzulu mayelana nezinto ezithinta izibhedlela, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo phakathi kwezibhedlela namakhasimende. Kunomqondo ophakanyisiwe wokuthi izibhedlela kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola ulwazi olufanele nolwakha ithemba, kusukela ekufikeni kwazo ezibhedlweni kuze kube sekuphathweni kwazo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nezingxoxo ezithinta izixazululo ezitholakalayo, ezinjengezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela. Lezi zinhlelo zingasiza ekwabeleni izinsiza, ukuze izibhedlela ezincane zikwazi ukuthola ukwesekwa ezindaweni ezithile, ngaleyo ndlela zithuthukise izinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Umcimbi ugcine ngokuba nomhlangano wokubuyekeza, lapho abahlanganyeli benza isifinyezo sezinkinga ezikhuluma ngazo. Ngemuva kokuthi bekwazile ukuxoxa, kwavela iziphakamiso ezithile ezisheshayo nezizokwaziwa, ukuze kuncishiswe izinkinga ezintsha ezithinta ingqalasizinda yezibhedlela. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, ngokuqhubekayo, umphakathi uyalwela ukuthuthukisa impilo yezakhamizi, futhi abaholi bayazimisela ukusebenzela izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Kwazise, lo mcimbi ubonise ubunzima bokuphathwa kwezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa, kodwa futhi wagcizelela ithuba lokubambisana kwezinhlelo ezahlukene. Umphakathi ubonakale uzimisele ukuxhasa izinyathelo ezizothuthukisa ingqalasizinda, okuqinisa ithemba lokuthi iziguli zizothola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngemva kokuba lo mcimbi usuphelile, abahlanganyeli bathole umuzwa oqinile wokuthi kunezinyathelo ezahlukahlukene ezifunekayo ukuze kuzuzwe umgomo wezempilo ophumelelayo eMpumalanga Kapa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi uphumelele ekubambiseni izandla, ukuze uqhubeke uthuthukisa isimo sezibhedlela, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lokunakekelwa kwezempilo eMpumalanga Kapa.
Ikhodi yokuziphatha yamaphoyisa ifuna ukuthi, njengamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, sithande abantu ngokuhlonipha nokubahlonipha ngenxa yokwehluka kwabo kanye nomthetho, ngaleyo ndlela sithuthukise futhi sithuthukise umsebenzi wethu ngendlela evunyelwe umphakathi. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa athatha iqiniso njengokubaluleke kakhulu kunakho konke. Ukuchaza: Thina, njengamaphoyisa, sizohlale sizama ukugcina inhloso, sibe nolwazi ngezindinganiso ze khodi yokuziphatha yamaphoyisa. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohambisana nalezi zindinganiso. Sizoziphatha ngenhlonipho nangokuzinikela noma ngempumelelo kuzo zonke izimo. Sizohlale sikhuluma iqiniso, senza imisebenzi yethu ngedumela, futhi sibe isibonelo emiphakathini esiyisebenzela. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa avuma ukuhlukahluka kwabantu ezweni lethu futhi abahloniphe bonke abantu ngokulinganayo. Ukuchaza: Ekwenzeni umsebenzi wethu, sizohlale sikhombisa ukuhlonipha sazi ukuthi imiphakathi ihlukahlukene, ezinkolweni nasemkhakheni. Sizobahlonipha bonke abantu futhi sihloniphe amalungelo abo njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Asizokwenza ukucwasa okungemthethweni kunoma ubani. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa azohlale ehlonipha futhi agcine umthetho. Ukuchaza: Umsebenzi wethu uhambisana kakhulu nokuphathwa komthetho, ngakho-ke sithi sizohlale sibe ngaphansi komthetho naseMthethweni wezwe lethu. Sizohlale sigwema ukuziphatha ngendlela ezosiholela ekwephuleni umthetho. Sizohlale sivikela abantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ezinyathelweni ezingemthethweni. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa azama njalo ukwenza imisebenzi yabo kahle. Ukuchaza: Sizohlale, kuzo zonke izinzwa zethu, senza umsebenzi wethu ngamandla onke esinawo. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohlale kukhombisa ubuchwepheshe bomsebenzi wethu. Ukuziphatha kwethu nokubukeka kuzokwandisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekwenzeni kahle. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa asebenza ndawonye nomphakathi ngoba afuna ukuvunyelwa nokwesekwa umphakathi. Ukuchaza: Sizosebenza ngenhloso enkulu yomphakathi, futhi ngazo zonke izinzwa ukuze sixhase umthetho, futhi sifuna ukuvunyelwa umphakathi wonke.
Ezokukhiqiza: Ukubheka Umongo, Izinto Ezibalulekile, Nezinto Eziwusizo Ezokukhiqiza, noma ukukhiqiza, kubaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla, futhi kudlale indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ukwakha imisebenzi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Lolu hlelo lwezokukhiqiza ludinga ukucwaningwa ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi lungathuthukiswa kanjani, luqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethinta izimpilo zethu ngosuku nosuku. Umongo weZokukhiqiza Ezokukhiqiza zingabheka izinto ezahlukene lapho, kunoma yiluphi umkhakha, kudingeka khona imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa, kodwa akuphelelwe, emikhiqizweni yezimoto, imikhiqizo yokwakha, ezokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zemidlalo. Izinqubo zokukhiqiza ziqinisekisa ukuthi le mikhiqizo itholakala ngentengo efanele, isezingeni eliphezulu, futhi ifinyeleleka kalula. Ukuze lezi zinto zikwazi ukuhlanganiswa, kudinga imishini ethuthukile, ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, kanye nezinga eliphezulu lokuphatha. Izinyathelo Zokukhiqiza Inqubo yokukhiqiza ivame ukuhlanganiswa nezinyathelo ezithile ezisemqoka. Lezi zinyathelo ziqukethe ukuhlolwa kwemakethe, ukuklama, ukumisa, ukukhiqiza, kanye nokuhanjiswa kwemikhiqizo. Ukuze umkhiqizo uphumelele emakethe, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuhlola okuhle ngaphambi kokukhiqizwa. Lokhu kuhlola kugqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo ezohambisana nezidingo zabathengi, ngempela kube nezixazululo ezithuthukisiwe. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ubuchwepheshe bokuqala buye baletha ushintsho olukhulu emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza. Ubuchwepheshe be-Industry 4.0, obuhlanganisa i-Internet of Things (IoT), ubuchwepheshe bokufakelwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa komshini, buyanda ekwandiseni ukusebenza kahle nasekunciphiseni izindleko. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe, izinkampani zingakwazi ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo enezinga eliphakeme lokuchuma, ngasikhathi sinye zinciphise izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kuphela, kodwa futhi kuyasiza ekuvikeleni imvelo. Umthelela Emnothweni Umthelela wezokukhiqiza kumnotho awukho kuphela ekuhlinzekeni ngemikhiqizo, kodwa futhi ubandakanya ukudala amathuba emisebenzi. Izinkampani ezikhiqizayo zidinga abasebenzi abanobuchule, abakhono, nokuqonda okuphakeme kwi-automation kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, okwandisa ukuhweba phakathi kwezizwe. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, imboni yokukhiqiza ibamba iqhaza elibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile lapho abantu behlupheka khona. Izifundo Ezivela Kwezinye Izindawo Ukubheka izinto ezenzekayo kwezinye izindawo emhlabeni kungaba usizo ekutholeni izixazululo ezithuthukisayo. Izinkampani ezinkulu zejwayelekile, ezifana neToyota neGeneral Electric, zitholakala zisebenzisa izinqubo zokukhiqiza eziqhuba kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza okwenziwe kwazulu (Lean Manufacturing) kanye nemodeli yeSix Sigma, edinga ukunciphisa amaphutha ezinqubweni zokukhiqiza. Ukufunda kulezi zinhlelo kungasiza izinkampani zethu ukuthi ziqhube imisebenzi yazo ngendlela ephumelelayo. Izichasiso Nezinselelo Noma imboni yezokukhiqiza ingabika impumelelo enkulu, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindleko zokukhiqiza ezikhulayo, izinqubo zokuphatha ezinzima, kanye nezinselelo zokuqashwa. Izinqubo zokuqashwa kumele zikhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi efanelekile, futhi imiphakathi kumele ibonise ukwesekwa nokuqonda izindima ezithile zabashayeli bemikhiqizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kumele zikhuthale ekwandiseni izinqubo ezivumelana nemithetho yokuvikela imvelo, ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezemvelo oholela ezingeni eliphakeme lokukhulisa umkhiqizo. Ikhono Lokulungisa Nenjongo Yekusasa Okokugcina, imboni yezokukhiqiza idinga amakhono okusebenza aphakeme nabantu abanomqondo ochwepheshe. Ukuze imboni iqhubeke nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthuthukisa izisebenzi, ukufundisa izinto ezintsha, nokukhuthaza ukusungula. Lokhu kudala umoya wokusebenza onempilo, lapho abasebenzi bezizwa bexhaswe, futhi beqonda izinjongo ezinkulu zemisebenzi. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise imboni yethu yezokukhiqiza, ukuze ifinyelele izinjongo ezinhle zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nemiphumela emihle ezimpilweni zabantu, empilweni yezezimali, nasemhlabeni jikelele. Imboni yokukhiqiza, uma ibhekelela izindlela ezintsha futhi ithuthukisa izinqubo zayo, izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi eminyaka ezayo.
Ukusebenza kwePhalamende Ngiyavuma, ukusebenza kwePhalamende kuyinto eyisithokozisayo. Ukuphila kwethu kwansuku zonke kuningi okuxhomeke kokuqukethwe kwalo msebenzi. Phalamende, njengoba sazi, iyinhlangano yesithathu efana nezinye, kodwa ibaluleke kakhulu njengoba iyingxenye yohulumeni. Ngizokhuluma kancane ngalesi sikhungo, okwenza umsebenzi wayo ube neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabantu. Kwaqala ngokuqonda ukuthi iPhalamende inezigaba ezimbili: iNdlu Yabantu neNdlu Yezinduna. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kubalulekile ngoba kunceda ukuhlela izinto. INdlu Yabantu iyinhlangano lapho abantu bekhulumela izindaba ezithinta umphakathi, kanti iNdlu Yezinduna igcwele abantu abanolwazi olujulile kwezepolitiki, abahlala beqondisa izinqumo. Lokhu kwenza kube nokusebenza okuhamba phambili, njengoba izindleko nezidingo zomphakathi zihlala zibonwa. Uma ubheka kuqala, khona khona izinsuku ezithile, iPhalamende ihlangana ukuze ibhekele izindaba ezisemqoka. Kumane kuyinkulumo, kodwa ngokuyisisekelo, kungamaphuzu ayisithupha aqhubekayo. Lokhu kuvumela ukuxoxisana ngezindaba ezithinta izwe, izimiso, nezinhlelo ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ungathola ithuba lokuhlola nokuphendula lapho izinqumo zithathwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu badinga ukuba nezwi, futhi iPhalamende iyindawo lapho izwi lethu litholakala khona. Ngokubambisana, iPhalamende ibuye ibe nethuba lokubona izifiso zabantu. Ukuhamba phambili kulezi zinsuku, kunemihlangano eminingi, okukhona kuyo izinkulumo ezibucayi mayelana nezindaba ezithinta umnotho, ezempilo, nemfundo. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izinqumo zibe nesisekelo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhangela izidingo zomphakathi, hhayi kuphela okuthandwa ngababusi. Kukhona futhi izinqubo ezithile ezihambisana nokusebenza kwePhalamende. Izinhlelo zokuqhuba izinqumo zisebenza ngokuhlanganyela, futhi izinkokheli zidinga ukuba ziqonde kahle ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa kanjani. Lokhu kusiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho osomqulu abaphumelele kakhulu, nokuthi izinqumo eziyinkimbinkimbi zixoxwa ngendlela efanele nesekela umphakathi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Njengoba sikhuluma, kukhona izikhathi zokungaboni ngaso linye. Abantu bavame ukungaboni kahle ngezinto ezithinta izinqumo ezithathwa ePhalamende. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani, futhi kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abanesizotha ukuze basebenze ngokuqinile. Ukuqonda izinqumo ezithathwayo, abantu badinga ukuhamba phambili, baziqhenye ngalesi sikhungo, futhi benze kube sobala ukuthi izinqumo zenzelwa ukuthuthukisa umphakathi. Olunye uhlelo lokusebenza lwePhalamende lubandakanya ukuxhumana. Noma ngabe abantu bangase babe namahloni, iPhalamende ibalulekile ukuze izwi labo litholakale. Ngalokhu, izithangami neziqondiso zidinga ukuba zibe neqhaza elikhulu. Kufanele kube nezinkulumo ezibucayi, futhi abantu badinga ukuveza imicabango yabo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinkinga ezikhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukufaka isandla kwabaningi. Umphakathi kufanele uthole ithuba lokuba nomthelela. Njengoba sikhuluma, izinhlelo zokubambisana zidinga ukuba zihlale zikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo ezithinta abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuhle kakhulu ukuba nabantu abavela ezimbonini ezahlukene ukuze babe nesithakazelo esifanele. Ngokuphetha, iPhalamende iyisithangami esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ukusebenza kwayo kudinga ukuba kube nokukhulumisana okuhle, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Abantu badinga ukuzizwa bebandakanyekile, futhi iPhalamende kufanele ibheke imicabango, izicelo, nezidingo zabantu. Ngaleyo ndlela, singakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, noyinsakavukela. IPhalamende kumele iqhubekele phambili ngale ndlela, ukuze ihlale ibheke ikusasa eliqhakazile kubo bonke abantu.
Ushintsho kuMthetho 1. Ukuqonda kahle i-GNSS kusho ukuthi izinga lokuhambisana phakathi kokulinganiswa okulinganisiwe, kokutholakele, noma isimo esidingekayo noma ikhono lesistimu ngaleso sikhathi kanye nesimo sangempela noma amandla, kuvame ukuvezwa ezilinganisweni zephutha ezitholakala ohlelweni futhi kuchazwa njengento engalindelekile, ephindaphindekayo ngokusebenzisa umaqhuzu. Umgwaqo wesigaba se-C4 kanye namandla okulawula indiza akhona kuphela uma umshini udinga uhlelo lokulawula indiza oluqondile ukuze lunikeze izinga lobuchwepheshe be-GPS elilingana nalolo olukhona ku-RAIM. Qaphela: Uhlelo lwe-GNSS lwesigaba se-C luzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezinkulu ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nasezindizeni zomhlaba. Inqubo yokuhamba kwefu ichaza izindlela ezahlukene ezithinta ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokundiza ezihlobene nokuvikelwa okukhomba ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ngesikhathi sokusebenza kuze kube yilapho indiza ixhumana ngempela nomhlaba lapho wonke uhlelo lokugcina umhlaba noma ukuqala kwenqubo yokundiza kuphothuliwe ngenxa yokwehluleka ukugcina iphethini ejwayelekile; uma indiza yehluleka ukugcina ngendlela ejwayelekile, ibuyela esimweni lapho ingakhokha khona emoyeni noma ilinde isimo sokugcina esifanele. I-GNSS ichaza uhlelo lwe-Global Navigation Satellite System olusetshenziselwa ukubeka izindiza endaweni. Uhlelo nesikhathi esichazwe endaweni kufaka phakathi ubuchwepheshe noma ukuqeqeshwa kwabo okuhamba phakathi nendawo, izithuthukisi zokundiza, kanye namandla okuhamba okwenza kube lula ukweseka ukuhlola nokubona izimoto ezihamba phakathi nendawo. Umcimbi we-GNSS uchaza umcimbi onjengalowo kanye nezimo ezifanayo nokuphazamiseka komshini, izinkomba, noma iphutha labantu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Uhlelo lokuhola indiza lwesigaba sokuqala luchaza uhlelo lokuhola umoya oluvunyiwe yiKhomishini yokusebenza ethile noma isikhathi sokundiza esithembekile nesiqondile kodwa akusho ukuthi lihlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala nokusebenza ngendlela engaphazamiseki. Ukwamukela, Ukuqapha, kanye Nokwethembeka KweMiyalezo Etholakele Ngobuchwepheshe Bezinkanyezi (RAIM) kuchaza isu lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS lunquma khona ukwethembeka kwezimpawu zokulawula indiza nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakale ngokukhalipha. "I-RVSM" ichaza umehluko okhona phakathi kwezinga lokundiza elingaphezu kuka-290 kuya ku-1000 feet uma kubhekwa ohlangothini lokuphuma kule ndlela kanye no-1000 feet ubheke lapho indiza iqonde khona." "I-RVSM airspace" ichaza indawo yomoya phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 kanye ne-410." "I-RVSM authorization certificate" ichaza isitifiketi esibonisa ukuhambisana kwendiza kanye nekhono leqembu lokundiza lokusebenzisa i-RVSM airspace." Ukuhola indiza okukhombisa phezulu kuchaza isu lokulawula indiza elivumela indiza ukuthi ibheke phezulu isebenzisa izinsiza zokulinganisa ezisemhlabeni, ibheka imigwaqo ngaphandle kwendiza noma inhlanganisela yalezi. Ukusebenzisa amehlo kuchaza isu lokundiza le-IFR lapho ingxenye ethile noma inqubo yesixhobo ephelele ingaphothulwa futhi ukugcina kwenziwa ngokubheka indlela yokundiza. Ushintsho kuMthetho 1.00. Ushintsho kuMthetho 12.02. b Iqembu labantu bezindiza; noma c Isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduze, uma kwenzeka icala elithintekayo. Isigaba 8 seSigaba 6 njengoba sichazwe sinikeza noma yisiphi ushintsho noma ukuguqulwa okulandela isimo sokuqala lapho i-RVSM Authorization ikhishwe. Noma yisiphi isicelo sokuvunywa kwe-RVSM certificate sizothunyelwa kwiKhomishini njengoba kuchazwe nguMthetho 91.07. Ushintsho kuMthetho 43.02. Umthetho olandelayo uzoshintshwa emva koMthetho 43.02. Qaphela: Izinga lokubekezelela ingozi yokuphazamiseka endaweni yomoya ngeke lidlule uma abasebenzi beqhubeka behlangabezana neziphuthumayo. Umnikazi wesitifiketi sokulungisa indiza esikhishwe ngaphansi kwalesi Sigaba uzobeka futhi agcine uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluhambelana nabasebenzi bokugcina izindiza abaqashwe
uBill Gates - Umphakathi Nokuphila Kwakhe UBill Gates ungumuntu odume kakhulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, njengomtshali-zimali kanye nomphilanthropist. Uthathwa njengomunye wezinsika ezinkulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ngenxa ye-Microsoft, inkampani ayasungula ngo-1975. Nokho, ngaphezu kokuba nomthelela omkhulu, uGates ubhekana nezinkinga ezithile ezihlala zikhona. Kule ngxoxo, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana noBill Gates, sikhulume ngempumelelo yakhe, izinselelo abhekana nazo, kanye nezinhlelo zakhe zomphakathi. Okokuqala, uBill Gates uhlonishwa kakhulu ngenxa yezimpumelelo zakhe kwezobuchwepheshe. I-Microsoft, inkampani ayisungulile, yenza ushintsho olukhulu emkhakheni wekhompyutha, ivumela abantu abaningi ukufinyelela ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe. Ngaphambi kokusungulwa kwe-Microsoft, ubuchwepheshe be-computer babufinyeleleka kuphela kubantu abambalwa, okwenza uGates abe ngumuntu obalulekile emlandweni wezobuchwepheshe. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba inkampani yakhe ikhula, uGates ubhekane nezinkinga zokuncintisana, okuhlanganisa ukusizakala ngamandla akhe ukuze agcine isikhala esikhulu emakethe. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni abanye baphikise indlela imisebenzi ye-Microsoft ethinta ngayo umphakathi, bethi lokhu kungenza kube nzima kwezinye izinkampani ezincane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBill Gates udlale indima ebalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngemva kokuthi i-Microsoft isiphumelele, wagxila ekusizeni abantu ngezindlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi nge-Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, enikezela usizo ezinhlelweni zokulwa nezifo, ukuthuthukisa imfundo, nokuphucula izimo zokuphila kwabampofu. Lokhu kukhombisa ubuhlakani obuhle nokukhathalela umphakathi. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi uGates usebenzisa izinsiza zakhe ukuze enze izinqumo ezithile ezithinta umphakathi, okuholela ekutheni kube nezindaba zokuhlukumeza. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinkampani ezinkulu, njenge-Microsoft, zinezinzuzo ezihambisana nemiphumela emibi. UBill Gates uphinde abhekane nezinkinga ezithinta izwe, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Uthatha isinyathelo sokukhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, kodwa abanye baphikisa ukuthi akakwenzi kahle lokho. Ekugcineni, uBill Gates ungumuntu onomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kepha impumelelo yakhe kumele ihlolwe ngokuqhubekayo. Izinsiza zakhe zidinga ukubhekelwa ukuze zibe nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. UBill Gates, ngempela, ungumuntu ophendulayo, kodwa izinqumo zakhe kufanele zihlolwe ukuze kuzuze umphakathi wonke.
Siyizwe lesibili elikhulu emhlabeni elibamba imidlalo ye-cricket, rugby, kanye neFIFA World Cup. Izinkundla ezisha zemidlalo zikhangayo kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi zizokwazi ukufaka abantu abangaphezu kuka-570,000. I-Moses Mabhida Stadium e-Durban inemikhono ephakeme engu-105 meters phezulu enkundleni. Ngokusebenzisa imoto ye-cable car, ababukeli bazokwazi ukujabulela umbono omuhle we-Indian Ocean e-Durban. I-Soccer City e-Johannesburg ithathe ifomu lesikhwama sokuphuza esidala sase-Afrika. Imigwaqo yethu, izitimela, nezindlela zebhasi zizohlinzeka ngohlelo lokuthutha oluhlangene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinguquko ezifana neRapid Rail kanye neBus Rapid Transit Systems, ezizohlinzeka ngezindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi ezikhethekile nezindawo zokudlulisela zabagibeli abashintsha besuka kwelinye uhlobo lokuthutha kuya kwelinye. I-FIFA World Cup 2010 izoholela ekusetshenzisweni kokuthengiswa kwemathikithi okuhlanganisiwe okuzovumela abagibeli ukuthi basebenzise ithikithi elilodwa ukuze bafinyelele kumabhasi, izithuthuthu, izitimela, kanye nezitaxi. I-International Broadcasting Centre e-Johannesburg izoba yindawo yokuxhumana ezokwenza ukuthi kuhlelwe ukuhanjiswa kwezikhathi ezivela ezinkundleni zemidlalo ziye ezweni lonke.
