Kubhalwe kahle ukuthi kubalulekile kunoma iyiphi INKONTILEKA YOKUSEKELWA KWEMIBHIKISHO/INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO ukuthi le nkontileka kumele ibe ngaphansi kwenkampani ye-insurance ebhaliswe isikhathi eside. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ilungu linikezwa izimali zokusekela uma ziceliwe uma kwenzeka okuthile okudingayo i-insurance (ukufa). UMNIKAZI WENKONTILEKA/ILUNGU kumele anikezwe ISITIFIKETHE SOKUBA ILUNGU. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise kahle igama lenkampani enikeza le nkontileka; inani elizokhokhwa; izinzuzo ezizokhokhwa; izinqubo zokufaka izicelo zezimali nezinye izinto ezibalulekile mayelana ne-INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO. I-INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO kumele icacise ukuthi abaphathi bemibhikisho noma abasebenzi abaqashwe yinkampani ye-inkontileka abawukhokhi le nkontileka. Kubalulekile kumanikazi benkontileka ukuba bazi ukuthi bangakhetha ukuthola izinzuzo zen kontileka njengenzuzo yokusebenza kwemibhikisho noma ukuthola imali. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo ezidingekayo kumnikazi wenkontileka/ilungu ezifana nezikhathi lapho ukukhokha kuqala futhi kwenziwa; okukhokhwayo nokungakhokhwayo; izikhathi zokulinda, njll. Idokhumenti esemthethweni ekhishwe yinkampani kumele ibe nezinhlaka zezinzuzo, izimali, imithetho, nezimo futhi ibe nenombolo ye-insurance, okumele ibonakale esitifiketini sokuba ilungu. I-Friendly Society iyisikhungo sezimali esakhiwe ngamaqembu abantu abanezidingo ezithile, abahlanganisa imali futhi bagcine ndawonye ukuze basizane ngokwezimali ezidingweni ezithile, njengemibhikisho. Izinzuzo eziyinhloko ngu-R5000. I-Friendly Society ayiyona ibhizinisi elenzayo inzuzo, kodwa inzuzo eyenziwa ngemali egcinwe ngamalungu iyabelwana phakathi kwabo. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthola lesi sitifiketi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungumuntu oyi ilungu. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo zen kontileka yakho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi inkampani evunyelwe yinkampani ye-insurance ithengisa i-insurance ngegama layo. Inkampani ye-insurance ebhaliswe neBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ithola imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga futhi ibhekelele ukukhokha izinzuzo uma kwenzeka ukufa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi wena njengelungu ufaka imali ekhokhwa kubantu abakhethile ku-inkontileka. Imali oyikhokhayo uma uthola i-insurance ngenyanga. Lokhu kuyindoda ezimele ongayithinta uma ungajabuli ngempendulo evela lapho uthole khona i-insurance. Imininingwane yokuxhumana iboniswa esikhangisweni esisemthethweni nasemuva kwaleli phephandaba. Inkampani ye-insurance izohlola izimo noma izifo eziku-inkontileka ezingaholela ekufeni komuntu okukhanyisiwe ku-inkontileka, futhi akukho zinzuzo ezizokhokhwa. Qaphela: Ubufakazi kumele bunikezwe kumuntu othengisa i-insurance futhi kumele bube kufomu lesicelo nasestifiketini sokuba ilungu esikhishwe. Qaphela: Le mali ozoyikhokha ifaka zonke izindleko ezizokhokhwa kuwe nezimali. Lezi zimali ozokhokhwa kumele zicaciswe kahle. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngenyanga, ngenyanga ephindwe kabili, noma ngonyaka? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi uzodinga ukukhokha nini. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngaphambi noma ngiyaboleka? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi kudingeka ukukhokha ekuqaleni kwenyanga noma ekupheleni kwenyanga. Umbuzo: Uma ngikhokha ngempahla, ngizothola isitifiketi? Impendulo: Yebo, kufanele kube isitifiketi esisemthethweni. Umbuzo: Ingabe le mali ezokhokhwa ngenyanga izokhula esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Inani elizokhokhwa lingakhula uma kukhona izicelo eziningi kule nkontileka. Umbuzo: Le mali ezokhokhwa iqinisekisiwe isikhathi esingakanani? Umbuzo: Nini i-insurance yami iqala? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ukufa kudalwe yengozi? Impendulo: Ezimweni eziningi, isikhathi sokulinda asisebenzi uma umuntu efela engozini. Umbuzo: Ingabe kukhona okukhishwayo? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ngiphuthelwa ukukhokha noma ngiyeka ukukhokha? Impendulo: Awusoze ube ngaphansi kwe-insurance futhi uma uqala ukukhokha futhi, isikhathi sokulinda singase sibe khona futhi. Umbuzo: Ingabe ukuba ngaphansi kwe-insurance kusebenza kumuntu ngamunye kuphela? Umbuzo: Ngizothola ubufakazi bokuba ilungu? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole Isitifiketi Sokuba Ilungu, isifinyezo sokuthi ubani okukhanyisiwe ngaleyo insurance, inani elizokhokhwa, zonke izikhathi zokulinda, nokuthi yini ekhanyisiwe ku-inkontileka. Impendulo: Yebo, ungakhulisa inzuzo ku-inkontileka yakho uma i-INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO ivumela, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, lokhu kuzokhuphula nenani okhokhayo ngenyanga. Izinzuzo nezikhathi zokulinda zingase zisebenze ezinuzweni ezikhulisiwe. Umbuzo: Ngizofaka kanjani isicelo sezimali uma othile efile? Impendulo: Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sezimali kufanele iphakelwe ngokuphelele kuwe emithethweni nasezimweni zen kontileka. Impendulo: Ungakhansela i-inkontileka yakho phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokukhokha ukukhokha kwakho kokuqala futhi uthole yonke imali yakho ngaphandle kokuthi usuwafake isicelo sezimali zemibhikisho. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-inkontileka ingakhanselwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kodwa imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga ngeke ibuyiswe. Impendulo: Lokhu kungaqhutshwa, kodwa kufanele uqinisekiswe futhi wazi ukuthi kuthinta kanjani abantu ababe ku-inkontileka leyo esikhathini esedlule, mayelana nazo zonke lezi zinto. Inkampani entsha kumele ikunikeze isitifiketi sokuba ilungu. Uma uzwa ukuthi awukho esimweni esifana noma esingcono, kufanele uxhumane nenkampani ekhona ngokushesha. Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma unok complaint noma umbuzo? QAPHELA: Imininingwane ye-Ombudsman kanye ne-FSB kumele ibe ku- Membership Certificate nasemuva kwephephandaba lolwazi.
uMark Zuckerberg Ngasekuqaleni kwenkulungwane ye-21, emakhaya ase-United States, kwavela umntwana obizwa ngoMark Zuckerberg. UMark wazalwa ngonyaka ka-1984 eWhite Plains, eNew York. Ubephila nomndeni oshukumisayo, unina noBaba bembamba njengezikhungo zempilo, bekhuthaza uMark ukuba azifundele kahle. Esemncane, uMark waba nesiphiwo esikhethekile ekubhaleni izinhlelo. Wazifundela ukubhala ama-computer programs, ethandwa kakhulu ukuqonda ngokujulile indlela i-Intanethi esebenza ngayo. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole samabanga aphansi, uMark wajoyina i-Harvard University, eyaziwa njengenye yeziqu eziphezulu emhlabeni. EHarvard, uthole ubungcweti ngemfundo yezobuchwepheshe, kodwa akakaze athathe kuqala ukuzinza nesikole, ngoba iphupho lakhe kwakuwukwakha into ethile ezojabulisa abantu ezehlukeneyo. Ngenxa yalesi siphiwo, uMark wawujabulela kakhulu umoya wezobuchwepheshe nokuqhamuka nezinselele ezintsha. Ngonyaka ka-2004, uMark pawina umcabango owawujulile; yaqhamuka ipulatifomu yokuxhumana ebizwa ngeFacebook. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu babengakatholi kahle umqondo wezokuxhumana ngempela, kungekho okwakufana neFacebook. UMark wahlanganisa izinqubo ezithile nezindlela zokwakha ukuthi abantu baxhumane kalula, bekhuluma, futhi babelane ngempilo yabo. Ngamaphepha avuma, iFacebook yathandwa ngokushesha, yakhula yaba yinsiza enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. I-Facebook yayingenakuchazwa nje ngaphezulu kokuxhumana okwenziwa phakathi kwabantu; yayivumela ukuqanjwa kwesiko yokuxhumana. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani, abantu baanjengomama, abantu abasha, nabantu abadala babebamba iqhaza ekuhlanganyeleni. UMark wayengeyena uMongameli kuphela weFacebook, kodwa waba ngumholi ozinikele ekuqhubekeni kwezobuchwepheshe. Njengoba uFacebook usuthola impumelelo, uMark waze wahamba phambili emkhakheni wezindaba zenjini yokusesha, ekwazi ukwakha ibhizinisi elikhulayo. Ngenxa yokwandiswa kweFacebook, uMark waba nempumelelo ethokozisayo. Kodwa, ngemuva kokuba sephumelele, waqala ukuqhamuka nezinkinga. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale bephikisa izinto ezithile ezenzakalayo, okuhlanganisa nokuhlasela ebudlelwaneni bomuntu siqu. UMark waba nesihloko esinzima sokuthi uqhubeke nokwakha iFacebook, abhekane nezinkinga ezinzima zokuvikela ubumfihlo babantu. Lezi zinkinga zaba yizimpikiswano ezimnyama phakathi kokukhula kweFacebook kubantu. Kodwa uMark akazange ayeke. Uhlale ebheke phambili, enganqikazi, athi "Sizofunda futhi sithuthukise." Noma izinkinga ezazivukile, uMark wabonisa ukuzimisela okuqinile nokulangazelela ukuxhumana nomphakathi. Wathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ubumfihlo, futhi wagedla isikhathi esiningi efunda indlela yokuphatha umphakathi ukuze uFacebook uhlale uthokozisa abantu. Njengoba izindlela zoxhumano zithuthuka, uMark waphinde waqala ukuzama izinto ezintsha. Waqhubeka ehamba phambili, ehamba phambili nezobuchwepheshe, futhi wahamba phambili ngokuqhubekayo nezinhlelo ezithinta umphakathi. Wazibandakanya nezinye izinto ezinzima ezifana nezokuhlola imvelo, ukuhlola izixazululo zokwakha umphakathi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhulisa ubudlelwano bokuqala. UMark Zuckerberg akakaze abekezelele impumelelo yakhe, kodwa esikhundleni salokho, wagxila emiphumeleni engena kuFacebook. Ngalesi sikhathi, wavula umnyango wezinhlelo ezinkulu zokuthuthukisa imiphakathi embalwa ngemali ethile eyayiphuma emithonjeni emazwe, ezama ukusiza abantu abangaphandle kukaFacebook. UMark wayekholwa kakhulu ekuboleni kwansuku zonke, futhi wathambisa ukucabanga ukuthi ubumfihlo, ubulungiswa, nokuxhumana kufanele kubaluleke kakhulu. Ngemuva konyaka ka-2020, lapho umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, uMark wenza isiqiniseko sokuthi iFacebook ifaka umoya omusha wokwakha ubudlelwano. Lokhu kwadlalwa kuze kube yimali yenzuzo ewusizo kubantu. UMark wakwazi ukugqugquzela umoya wokuhlala phansi, enza abavakashi abanezimpendulo ezizwakalayo, befunda nezinkinga ezinkude. Lokhu waholela ekwakheni imoya yokuxhumana kwangempela phakathi kwabantu, evumelana nokuxhumana okwenziwe nge-intanethi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMark Zuckerberg waba isithombe esiphilayo sokuhola okuzinzile nobuchwepheshe, wenza ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu, imiphakathi, nezinkampani. Kube sengathi uMark usubeke isibonelo somuntu ophumelelayo, okhuthaza abanye ukuba bakhe imiphakathi emisha, bamemezele izinqubo ezintsha nenzuzo ngenjongo yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Njengoba uMark eqhubeka nokusebenza, sikubona kahle ukuthi, semncane okhalela wakhe, kuhlezi kumina kahle. Ngeke simphule umoya, kodwa ukuqhubeka kokusebenza kwakhe kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungashintsha uma sizaqhubeka sizicabangela, sihlanganise izindaba ezithokozisayo nezinsiza zokwakha. Ngakho-ke, lokhu akukhona kuphela okunomthelela emaqinisweni omphakathi, kodwa futhi kukhombisa ubunkulunkulu bokuxhumana kwabantu. UMark Zuckerberg, umholi ongaguquki, ungakaze akholwe ukuthi ukuphumelela kwakhe kuzokhanya empilweni yabantu. Ufundisa imihla ngemihla ukuthi uma sithanda ukuxhumana, kufanele sibe nokuqonda kokuhlanganyela. Yikho okuhloswe ngakho ekuphileni, ukwakha ubuhlobo, nokuhlanganisa umhlaba. Njengoba uhamba phambili, uMark usenalo umqondo owenza abanye baphokophele ukukhula, baneliseke ngezinga lokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi, enkulu kangakanani imbangi, uma izinto zenziwa ngezinhloso ezihle, umphakathi ungashintsha futhi uphumelele. UMark Zuckerberg, empeleni, umbono wokwakha umhlaba onobuchule obuhlukahlukene.
iNdlovukazi u-Elizabeth II: Uhlanga Lwenkululeko neNhlonipho Ubulungiswa, ubumbano, kanye nezinga lempilo yangempela — lezi yizinto ezibalulekile ezithinta isithombe seNdlovukazi u-Elizabeth II, owesifazane ophumelele kakhulu emlandweni wobukhosi baseBrithani. Lokhu akukhona kuphela emithonjeni yezindaba nasezincwadini, kodwa futhi kuvezwa ezimpilweni zabantu abasha, abamnyama nabesilisa, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. Njengoba sithuthukisa izinga lempilo, u-Elizabeth II ube yisibonelo esihle sokwakha isizukulwane esisha esinokubambisana. Ngesikhathi u-Elizabeth II ebhalwa emlandweni, akubanga lula ukuthi wayengowokuqala ukuthola izimfaneli zenkolo, umdlandla, nokuqonda komphakathi. Ukuphila kwakhe kwakungokubuyekezwa njengoba ebhekana nezimo ezinzima, ezithinta izwe lonke. Njengomholi, wabhekelela izinguquko ezinkulu ezazikhula eBrithani nasemhlabeni jikelele, ezihambisana nezifiso zabantu. Isikhathi sika-Elizabeth II sashintsha indlela umphakathi ubhekwa ngayo, kanti lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuhlonipha nobumbano. U-Elizabeth, njengoba sazi kahle, wakhethwa ukuphatha ngemuva kokudlula kwabazali bakhe, u-George VI no-Elizabeth I. Lokhu kubonisa indlela imvelaphi yenkosi ebheka imizamo yokwakha imindeni, izinkumbulo, nezifiso ezizwakalayo. Ukuphuma kwakhe emndenini odumile kubonisa indlela eyasiza ukuba u-Elizabeth abambe isikhala esisabekayo embhalweni. Lokhu kufanele kube isifundo kubantu bethu, njengoba siba nolwazi lokuthi ubukhazikhazi buhle kodwa kudinga umthwalo wemfanelo. Ngenxa yobukhazikhazi bayo nobungcweti bakhe, u-Elizabeth II waphetha izigigaba eziningi, ezazihambisana nezinto ezinkulu ezinjengokuhlukana kokwenziwa ukuze kube nezizwe ezizimele. Ukuhlanganyela kwakhe emaqhulwini ezehlakalweni, okumangalisa kakhulu, kwenze ukuthi abantu bamthande kakhulu. Lokhu kubonisa indlela abebekwazi ngayo ukujabulisa izinhliziyo zabantu, abakhomba isithombe esihle sokuhlonipha nokuqonda lapho kwenzeka izinqumo ezinzima. Uphila kancane ngosuku olujwayelekile, ephila ebhizinisini, kodwa futhi engapheli ize. Ubufakazi bokukhula kwayo buncike ekubeni yinkosana enkulu, evame ukudlula kumabhuku ezincwadi zomlando. Kukhona abawakwazi ukuphenduka, ngenxa yezinsiza eziphakeme, umoya nemigudu yesimanje. U-Elizabeth II ushintshe izidingo zomphakathi, eqhubeka nokwakha ulwazi lomphakathi obumbene. Lokhu kuhlobisa kwakhe nesimo sakhe, ukwazi ukuhoxa izinkumbulo ezinhle, lapho kudlalwa idlalwana. Ngalesi sikhathi sokuphila, u-Elizabeth II, ubungcweti bakhe babucishe bobu, bekhombisa ukuba nemigudu elula yokuphathwa, okusho ukuthi ngempela ungusomqulu wezinto ezisemqoka. Ubhala izigaba zempilo yakhe, okuyinto eyahlukaniswa phakathi komphakathi nokuhlonipha izimilo namasiko. Lokhu kuqonda kuvumelana kakhulu nezinto ezithinta abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ukuthi u-Elizabeth II wahola kulo mphakathi ngothando nempumelelo. Ngobungcweti bokuphila, u-Elizabeth II wahola imikhankaso eminingi, eqhubekisela phambili izinhlelo ezithinta imindeni eminingi nobumbano olunamandla. Ukukhuthaza izizukulwane ezintsha ukuthi zikhombise ukuzimisela, ubuhlakani, nokuqina, kuzakha isimo esihle sokubambisana. Lokhu kuhlangene ngezikhathi ezinzima, lapho enza khona izinto ezibalulekile ukuze abameli abahlukene baziqhubeke noshisayo. U-Elizabeth uyasikhumbuza ukuthi imikhankaso ethinta abantu ayigcini nje ngokuhweba ngezifiso, kodwa ibuye isikhumbule nabantu abakubo abaqhubekayo. Ekugcineni, u-Elizabeth II uzoba isibonelo esiyingqayizivele emlandweni wobukhosi, nempela njengomholi obonisa ubuqotho. Uhlanga lwenkululeko lwakhululwa, kubonisa ukuthi ngezinga elikhethekile elawulwa ngenkosi, ingozi ingaphezulu kwezindleko zempilo. Lokhu kwahluka hlukene, kwaba nomthelela omningi ekuchazeni isithombe seNdlovukazi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bazobongela u-Elizabeth II, ezingqondweni nakuphila kwabo. Njengoba sithokozisa u-Elizabeth II, sifunde izifundo ezibalulekile ezithinta abantu bethu, ukuhola, nephupho elingabheki emithonjeni yezenhlalo. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, kufanele sihloniphe, size sihlole imidlalo eyakhiwayo, ukuze izwe lethu lihlume ngempumelelo. U-Elizabeth II usishiye ephephile, ehlanganisa izindawo ezahlukene zomhlaba, ngakho thina, masizuze kulezo zifundo ukuze siqhubekele phambili!
Emsebenzini wayo wokubhekelela, iPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ethathwe iyasetshenziswa, kuhlanganise nezo eziklanyelwe intsha yaleli zwe. Ukuze iPhalamende ibe lula ukufinyelela, kwasungulwa uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi "Interface yeNgxenye" lapho intsha ingahlangana khona neNgxenye yePhalamende ukuze ixoxe ngezindaba ezithinta bona. Bangaphinde bakhombise imibono yabo ngokukhuluma noma ngokwenza izethulo ezibhaliwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha ibamba iqhaza ezithangamini zeMihlangano yeKomidi lapho imisebenzi eminingi yePhalamende yenzeka khona, futhi bangavakashela ezihlanganisweni zephalamende ukuze babone lokho okwenzekayo ukuze bathole ulwazi futhi bazikhulise. IPhalamende inezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihloselwe imikhakha ehlukene, isibonelo: iPhalamende leNtsha (elenzeka ngenyanga yeNtsha) lapho izindaba eziphathelene nentsha zixoxwa khona futhi lapho kuphela bona bavunyelwe ukuba babambe iqhaza, futhi okwenziwayo lapho kuhlose ukuhlonipha bona. Umthethosisekelo uyalalela iPhalamende ukuba ibandakanye abantu emisebenzini yayo nasemikhubeni yokwenza ibhizinisi, ngakho-ke intsha njengengxenye yomphakathi ivame ukumema ukuba ibe yingxenye yezinhlelo zephalamende, njengeZwi Lomphakathi, Ukwethulwa Kwendaba Yezwe, ezinye izinhlelo zokubambisana zomphakathi, nezinye izinhlelo zokubamba iqhaza komphakathi.
Ukuze ufinyelele kulolu hlelo, kumele ube yilungu lemidlalo ethole ukwehluleka ngaphambili, ube neminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu, ube nenhloso yokusebenzisa umhlaba kuphela ngezizathu zokulima, ube nesibopho esiphelele ekulimaleni, ungabi esikhundleni sokuphatha, ube nesifiso sokubamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokuqeqeshwa ngemuva kokuthola umhlaba, ube sesimweni sokwengeza emsebenzini, futhi ube nezinhlaka ezinhle, ikakhulukazi uma ufaka isicelo njengeqembu futhi unebhange. Abalimi abaphumelelayo abafisa ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima bangafaka izicelo zezimali, kodwa inani eliphelele losizo ngeke lidlule ku-R100,000. Ezinye izimali zokuqala noma zokwandisa imisebenzi yokulima kumele ziceliwe ezibankini. Ukusekelwa kwehlelo lwe-LRAD akukhokhiswa njengemalimboleko. I-formula isetshenziselwa ukubala ukuthi umuntu uthola malini. Ukuze ufinyelele ku-grant ye-R20,000, kumele ube nesabelo se-R5,000. Lesi sabelo akudingi ukuba kube yimali; kungaba izinto zokulima, izinkomo, noma ezinye izimpahla zokulima. Ngisho nomsebenzi ungafakwa emsebenzini njengengxenye yesabelo sakho ohlelweni lokusekela ukulima. Thola umhlaba ofuna ukuwuthenga. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ungase ube nomhlaba, njengomhlaba owabelwana ngawo emphakathini. Xhumana neMnyango Wezolimo noma nomphakathi wezolimo wendawo ukuze ufake isicelo sosizo. Uhlelo lokuthi umhlaba uzosetshenziswa kanjani noma uhlelo lokulima luyadingeka, kanye nesivumelwano sokuthenga nokuxoxisana ngentengo, uma uqasha ngenhloso yokuthenga uhla lwamalungu omndeni noma eqenjini, uma uhlose ukuthola umhlaba njengamaqembu, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi udokhumenti lwesikhumbuzo sikhona, akekho ofake isicelo sokuphikisa ukubuyiselwa kwalowo mhlaba, umhlaba ubhaliswe egameni lomthengisi, nokuthi intengo yomhlaba ayidluli inani lemakethe, ubufakazi bokuthi ibhalansi yemali edingekayo iyatholakala, kanye ne-report yokuhlola intengo. Le nqubo izothatha cishe ezinyangeni ezine, kodwa uma iphrojekthi yakho iyinkimbinkimbi, ingathatha isikhathi eside kunaleso. I-grant ye-R20,000 izodinga ukuthi ube nesabelo se-R5,000. Nokho, i-grant ephezulu ye-R100,000 izodinga ukuthi isabelo sakho sibe ngu-R400,000. Phakathi kwezinga elincane nelikhulu, kukhona nezinye izimali ezikhona, kuye ngokuthi yini efakwe ngabahlanganyeli. Uzohlinzekwa ngesimo okufanele ugcwalise, esivela ehhovisi lesifunda leMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba noma umphakathi wezolimo wendawo yakho.
Ukuhlinzekwa kokwakhiwa kweMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ukuze kusekelwe isifiso sabantu, ukufundisa nokukhulisa ukuqwashisa kwezombusazwe phakathi kwabantu baseKwaZulu-Natal ngokusebenzisa imali efanele nephumelelayo kumaphathi ezombusazwe; ukuhlinzeka ngamaqhinga nemisebenzi yemali; ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali kumali; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala kwemali kumaphathi ezombusazwe abhalisiwe kanye nokusetshenziswa kwaleyo mali; ukuhlinzeka ngencwadi yokukhishwa kwemali eyenziwe kumali; ukuhlinzeka ngembiko yokubhekelela yonke imiphakathi ngezokuphathwa kwemali etholelwe kumali; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuhoxiswa kwemali esetshenziswe kabi kumaphathi ezombusazwe; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala kwemali engasetshenziswanga; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba nokulawula imali; ukuhlinzeka ukuthi uMphakathi ubike kwiPhalamende lePhondo ngezindaba ezihlobene nemali kanye nembiko yayo yezezimali; ukuhlinzeka ngempahla engasetshenziswanga uma iPhalamende lePhondo liphume; ukuhlinzeka ngokwakhiwa kwemithetho; nokuhlinzeka ngeminye imibandela ehlobene. "Umthetho Wokhetho" ubonisa umthetho weKomishini Yokhetho, 1996 Umthetho No. "Iphathi" ibonisa noma iyiphi iphathi yezombusazwe ebhaliswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 15 somthetho weKomishini Yokhetho, 1996 Umthetho No. "lo Mthetho" uhlanganisa nemithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 15. ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba nokulawula kweMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. IMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe isunguliwe ngenjongo yokuxhasa ngemali amaphathi abamba iqhaza kwiPhalamende lePhondo. nokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olungeziwe kumaphathi ezombusazwe ngendlela efanele nephumelelayo. nemali etholelwe noma eqoqwe yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kusukela kwenye imithombo. Zonke izimali ezitholakele noma eziphathelene neMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kumele zifakwe kwi-akhawunti yasebhange ehlukile evulwe nguMsecretary enhlanganweni ebhaliswe njengebhange ngokwemithetho yeBhange, 1990 (Umthetho No. 94 ka-1990). Izimali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ezingadingeki ngokuphuthumayo ukuze zabelwe amaphathi ngaphansi kwesigaba 6 zingatshalwa neKomishini Yokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi okukhuthazwa kuMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1984 (Umthetho No. 45 ka-1984). Izimali zokonga nezokutshalwa zizovulwa ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba futhi noma yikuphi inzalo kulezo zikhwama kufanele kube ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa iMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe, futhi akufanele kuhlanganiswe noma kubekwe ngaphandle kwezinye izimali zePhalamende lePhondo. 6.(1) Zonke amaphathi anesibopho sokuthola izimali ezivela kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ngonyaka wezezimali owamukelwe yiPhalamende lePhondo. Ngokusekelwe esigabeni (7), izimali ezabelwe iPhathi kufanele zisetshenziswe ngezinjongo ezihlobene nokusebenza kwayo njengephathi yezombusazwe emoyeni wamanje wabantu. nokuqinisekisa ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwabantu nezakhiwo zikamasipala, futhi ikakhulukazi, phakathi kwabantu nePhalamende lePhondo. Ukubekwa kwemali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kufanele kube ngokulinganayo futhi kwenziwe ngezikhathi ezithile, ngokuhleleka kokukhokha okukhulunywe ngakho, nangendlela ethile. futhi ngokwengxenye, ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo yokulingana, engase ibhekelwe, phakathi kokunye, inani eliqinile elitholwe yiPhathi ngayinye emelelwe kwiPhalamende noma isilinganiso noma ukumelwa okuzobekwa kwiPhathi ngayinye ebamba iqhaza kwiPhalamende lePhondo. Ulwazi nemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe uhlelo oluhleliwe kwiPhathi kufanele kuvezwe emphakathini kanye nezinye izimo nezimo ngesikhathi sokubekwa. noma iyiphi enye injongo engahambisani nokusebenza kwephathi yezombusazwe emoyeni wamanje wabantu, njengoba kungase kuhlongozwe. Ukubekwa kwemali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kufanele kuphele uma iPhathi ingafanelekile ngaphansi kwesigaba (1), futhi ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-21 ngemuva kosuku lapho iPhathi ingafanelekile, kufanele ibuyise zonke izimali ezingasetshenziswanga zezimali ezabelwe yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. 7.(1) Ngokushesha okukhulu ngemva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, uMsecretary kufanele akhiphe isaziso kwiGazette esikhombisa ukubekwa kwemali okuhlelwe kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ngesikhathi salo msebenzi. kanye nezimali ezisele kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ekupheleni kwalonyaka wezezimali. vula futhi usebenze i-akhawunti yasebhange ehlukile egameni lePhathi enhlanganweni ebhaliswe njengebhange ngokwemithetho yeBhange, 1990 Umthetho No. qoka umuntu ophumelelayo kule Phathi njengomphathi wezezimali mayelana nezimali ezabelwe le Phathi yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. ikakhulukazi, umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezabelwe azisetshenziswanga ngezinjongo ezingavunyelwe yalo Mthetho. Umphathi wezezimali kufanele agcine izincwadi ezihlukene nezibalo ze-akhawunti, ngendlela ethile, mayelana nezimali ezabelwe yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe, kanye nazo zonke izindleko ezithinta lezi zimali. echaza izinhloso zokusetshenziswa ngokuhlukile kulezo zilinganiso ezisetshenzisiwe. Izincwadi nezibalo ze-akhawunti eziphakanyisiwe esigabeni (3) kanye nembiko ephakanyisiwe esigabeni (4) kufanele zihlolwe nguMhloli-Jikelele kanye nabahloli abhalisiwe abasebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo yeMthetho Wokuhlola Umphakathi kanye neMthetho Wabahloli Bomphakathi, 1991 (Umthetho No. 80 ka-1991). Umhloli ophenya izincwadi njengoba kukhombisiwe esigabeni (5) kufanele, embikweni womhloli, akhulume ngombono wokuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi izimali ezabelwe zisetshenziswe ngezinjongo ezingavunyelwe yalo Mthetho. Ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu emva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, umphathi wezezimali kufanele athumele izincwadi, umbiko, nezitatimende ezihlolwe ngummeli, kuMsecretary. Ngaphandle kwesigaba (4) uMhloli-Jikelele, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, angahlola izincwadi nezibalo ze-akhawunti nezitatimende zezezimali eziphathelene nezimali ezabelwe kwiPhathi yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. angase aphelelwe yilelo hlolo uma ethokozile, ekucaciseni kokuziphatha okungcono kwePhathi, ukuthi lelo hlolo alisadingeki. biza iPhathi ukuze icacise izizathu, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile esikhunjulwe, kungani ukubekwa kwemali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kungafanele kuphume. Isikhathi okukhulunywa ngaso esigabeni 10 akufanele sibe ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa kwesaziso. 9.(1) Uma izimali ezabelwe kwiPhathi ngaphansi kwesigaba 6 zingasetshenziswanga ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalesi Mthetho, umphathi wezezimali wale Phathi uzobhekana nokubuyiselwa
Inqubekela Phambili Yokuqedwa Kwezindlu Zangasese Zemigodi Ezikoleni Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukungatholakali kwezindlu zangasese ezisemigodini ezikoleni kube yinkinga enkulu eSouth Africa, ethinta impilo yabafundi nempilo yomphakathi jikelele. Kukhona abantu abaninzi abake baba nesandla ekuxazululeni le nkinga, kodwa uMnu. Thabo Mthembu ungumuntu ophawulekayo kakhulu kulolu hlelo. UThabo, oneminyaka engama-35 ubudala, ungumfundisi ophumelele eMphumalanga, futhi ungumholi ophakathi kokusebenza ukwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. UThabo wakhulela endaweni enobunzima obukhulu, lapho amaholo aphansi nabantu abangenamathuba amaningi bephila khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zendawo zazihlala zinezinkinga ezinkulu, ikakhulukazimayelana nezindlu zangasese. Njengomfundi, uThabo wayebona ubuhlungu obuphuma kulokhu, futhi lapho efika esikhathini sokuba umfundisi, waqala ukucabanga ngezinqumo ezizokwenziwa. Ngemva kokuqala ukusebenza, uThabo wahlangana noMphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izikole, inhlangano enobuchwepheshe, enezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini. Lezi zindlu zazingekho kuphela, kodwa zaziphinde zihlale zihlanzekile, zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokuphila kahle. UThabo waba yilungu eliyisisekelo kulolu hlelo, ebamba izithangami, efundisa abanye, futhi edala ukuxhumana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, kanye nabafundi. Ngendlela yokuhlela, uThabo wenza izinhlelo zokuqwashisa umphakathi mayelana nokubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi ukuthi izindlu zangasese ezinhle zingasiza ekukhuleni kwabafundi. Waqala imikhankaso yokuhamba, nokwenza imicimbi yokuhlanza, evusa umdlandla emiphakathini. Ubuye wahlela izinkulumo ezithokozisayo ezindlini zabo bonke abesifazane, ekhuthaza abesifazane ukuba babe nomthelela ekwakheni izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini. Ngemva kokusebenza kanzima, impumelelo yokuqala yatholakala. Izikole eziningi zathola izindlu zangasese ezisha, futhi abafundi baqala ukubonisa izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Lokhu kwaholela ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi impilo yabo iyathuthuka. UThabo, onobuhlakani bokuhola, waqhubeka nokwandisa imizamo yakhe, esebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukwandisa lezi zinhlelo. Ubuye waxhumana namabhizinisi endawo, edla amakhono namathuba okuthola uxhaso ukuze kunwetshwe umkhankaso. Ngemuva kokusebenza ngokubambisana, abakhokhi bezinsizakalo baphendula kahle, baziqhenya ngokuphilisa izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube neziqu ezinhle, njengoba imiphakathi yaziqhenya ngempumelelo yazo. UThabo akagcini lapho; ufunwa ukuba umeluleki kwezokwakha, ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe ezidingekayo ekwakheni izindlu zangasese. Uthole imivuzo eminingi yokwazisa, okwandisa umuzwa wakhe wokuthi ungumholi oqinile. Ubuye washintsha izinhlelo ukuze abanye abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngezindlu zangasese, beqonda izindleko ezibandakanyekayo nezidingo. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi eziphakame, uThabo uqhubeka nokusebenza ekugcineni umphumela omuhle. Uthi, "Kufanele sibe nendaba yokugcina abantu bethu bephila kahle, futhi lokho kuqala ezindlini zangasese." Le misho ikhuluma ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe, okuhamba phambili ekutholeni izixazululo ezihlala zikhona. Ukubuka phambili, uThabo ufisa ukuvuselela izinhlelo zakhe, adale imikhankaso emisha ukuze abanye abaholi bahlale bephumelele. Ubonisa ukuthi akekho owaziyo konke, kodwa abantu kufanele bahlanganyele ukuze bakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uThabo uyakholwa ukuthi imizamo yokwakha izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini ingazisa kakhulu uma wonke umuntu edlala indima yakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo Mthembu ungumholi obalulekile, owakha izimpilo zabafundi, abavuselela umphakathi, futhi abathuthukisa izikole. Njengomuntu ongenamkhawulo, uhamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini, enza umehluko ongakhethi phakathi kwabantu. UThabo ungumfuziselo wokuthi uma sithanda, singakha izinguquko ezinkulu ezimpilweni zabantu.
Mphakathi weGu District Municipality, uMphakathi S.B. Kuyajabula kakhulu ukuba sithintane nomphakathi wethu lapha eSimahla, ngesikhathi lesi senzakalo esibalulekile esihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu ngokwakha izindlu. NgokweZulu, sithi akukho mthunzi wesihlahla, okukhombisa kahle ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kokuba nekhaya. Ungaya noma kuphi, kodwa ekugcineni kufanele ubuyele ekhaya. Ikhaya liyisisekelo sempilo yomuntu. Namuhla sikhona ukuze sithathe umsebenzi obalulekile wokuhlinzeka umphakathi wethu ngezindlu ezizoba yisisekelo sezindlu zabantu bethu lapha. Lapho umuntu esekhaya, kufanele azizwe ephephile futhi ekhululekile, hhayi esaba. Inkinga emiphakathini yethu ekhaya yisimo sezindlu lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona. Ngenxa yokunganaki kukahulumeni we-apartheid, abantu bethu ekhaya baye bazama ukwakha izindlu zabo, eziningi zazo zingezingeni eliphansi. Inselelo ebhekene nemiphakathi yethu ekhaya ukuthi ngesikhathi sezimo ezimbi, izindlu ezikhona zihluleka ukumelana nezimo ezinzima. Njengoba kunjalo, imiphakathi yethu ishiywe ibuthakathaka, isaba ukuphila kwabo. Ikhaya liyikhaya uma kukhona indlu ephephile; asifuni abantu bethu bahlale besaba ngalokho okungase kwenzeke noma nini uma izimo zishintsha ngoba bahlala ezindlini ezinganele. Umphakathi wephrojekthi, umnyango wethu uqale umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekile kakhulu nguhulumeni we-apartheid ngokubahlinzeka ngezindlu. Namuhla sijabule kakhulu ukuthi umkhankaso wethu wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi wethu ekhaya ufike kule ndawo lapha eSimahla. Sisebenza kanzima ukuze sisheshise ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlu zabantu bethu ekhaya ngoba sifuna ukubuyisela isithunzi sabo esathathwa nguhulumeni we-apartheid. Ukubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele abe nendlu esimweni efanele. Akekho okufanele aphile esaba ngesikhathi esekhaya. Ngaphambi kokuthi uhulumeni wethu wamanje we-democratic ufinyelele emandleni, bekungathi kuyiphupho kubantu ukuba bakhiwe izindlu ekhaya. Umbono wethu njengohulumeni uwukubona yonke imiphakathi iphila izimpilo ezingcono ngendlela efanele. Sigcizelela ezinhlelweni zethu ukuthi abantu bethu kufanele bakhiwe izindlu ezindaweni eziseduze namadolobha, kanye nasezindaweni zasemaphandleni; sifuna abantu bethu baphile izimpilo ezifanayo nezabanye abantu, ngezindlu ezinhle, ugesi, nezindlela. Njengohulumeni wabantu, asikholelwa ukuthi ukuze abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele baphume emadolobheni; sifuna abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni abahlala kuzo ngaphandle kokuphazamisa indlela yabo yokuphila. Ukuhamba kancane kokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kule municipality kusemthethweni ngenxa yokuthi izindawo eziningi lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona lapha zashiywa ngaphandle kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa. Inselelo yethu njengomnyango wukushintsha lesi simo. Isivinini esihlinzekwa imiphakathi yethu ekhaya ngezindlu senze uhulumeni kumazinga omhlaba wonke nendawo uqaphele ukuthi imali esetshenziswa umnyango wethu ekwakheni izindlu zabantu bethu kufanele wandiswe. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukufinyelela ngokushesha kwezinye izindawo esingakazifinyeleli. Manje sizokwazi ukusheshisa uhlelo lwethu ukuze sithinte ngqo ukususa izindawo eziphithizelayo nokwakha izindlu zabantu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ezifana nalezi, sibuye sithuthukise isithunzi sabantu bethu ezindlini zokuhlala. Umnyango wezokwakha uyazi ukuthi umsebenzi obhekene ne-municipality ukuze usheshise ukuthuthukiswa ubunzima. Nokho, sikhuthaza ama-municipalities ukuthi afake izicelo kumnyango ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo kwezinye izindawo. Abantu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni bangabantu abahlala kancane ekuthuthukisweni. Sifuna abantu bethu eThoyana, eMaphumulo, nakwezinye izindawo nabo benze izinzuzo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu; ngiyazi ukuthi kunezinye izinhlelo umnyango owenza ukuze uqhakambise umphakathi kulezi zindawo. Njengomnyango, sihamba yonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukuze sikhombise amaphrojekthi ezindaweni ezifana nalezi. Lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi uhulumeni wamanje uzibophezele ekuthinteni ngqo izidingo zabantu. Izindlu esizethulayo namuhla zizohlangabezana nesivumelwano phakathi kukahulumeni nabantu sokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, futhi sizibophezele kulokhu. Njengohulumeni wabantu, sizigqaja ngokuba uhulumeni wokuqala kuleli elingakwazi ukwakha izindlu emiphakathini eyakhelwe oMnumzane. Izinhlanga ezahlukene ngaleso sikhathi zazisebenzisa umthetho ukuze zakhe izindlu zomphakathi wazo. Kwakungekho msebenzi wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi eyakhelwe oMnumzane. Abaningi baye bavuma ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa ngeke kufike kulezi zindawo. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi abantu basemaphandleni babone izindlu ezinhle zihlala ezinye izinhlanga abahlala nazo. Umlando ukhombisa kahle ukuthi ngisho nabathuthukisi abakhulu ababephakathi kukahulumeni bangaphambilini bavuma ukuthi izindlu zasemaphandleni azikwazi ukwenza lutho. Kubalulekile ukuthi sazi lo mlando ngoba ukuze siqonde lapho siya khona, kufanele sazi lapho sihamba khona futhi siqonde izinselelo esibhekene nazo njengohulumeni wabantu. Ngenxa yokunganaki izidingo zabantu bethu, kudingeka siqale kabusha ngokwakha imithetho emisha nemigomo emisha ukuze sikwazi ukwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabantu bethu. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi esihlela ukuhlinzeka imiphakathi ngentuthuko yezindlu kule ndawo. Kubalulekile kimi ukuchaza emphakathini izinyathelo esizithathayo uma sithumele uhlelo olukhulu kangaka njengalolu lwamuhla. Siyazi ukuthi izinkinga esinazo ekuthuthukisweni ziwumphumela wemithetho ye-apartheid. Ngamanye amazwi, umphakathi wonke lapha awunalo ilungelo lokuba ezindaweni ezithuthukisiwe. Imigomo nemithetho emisha esiyenzile njengohulumeni wabantu iphelisile lokho. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu akuphindi kwenzeke, sisebenza nama-municipalities ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe ngaphansi kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwe-municipal. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sifuna ukubona yonke intuthuko ehleliwe. Ngamanye amazwi, sifuna ukubona izindlu kanye nohlu lonke lokuthuthukiswa oludingekayo ngabantu abazokwakha lezi zindlu, kuhlanganise nezinye izidingo zomphakathi. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazothola ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuphila. Uma izindlu zakhiwe ngaphandle kokucabangela ezinye izigaba nezinye izindawo zokuthuthukiswa, lezi zindlu ngeke zibe yizindlu ezifudumele. Ikhaya liyikhaya uma izidingo zabantu abahlala kuyo zicatshangelwa. Umuntu ongakaze azwe ubuhlungu bokungabi nekhaya angase athathe kalula ukubaluleka kosuku olunjengalolu. Kodwa thina esazi usizi nobuhlungu bokungabi nezindlu sizokwazi ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwalesi sikhathi ezimpilweni zabantu bethu lapha eSimahla namuhla. Umphakathi wephrojekthi, izindawo zasemaphandleni ziseduze kakhulu enhliziyweni yami. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ngiyaphikisa kakhulu ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokushintsha okujwayelekile ukuze kuqaliswe imiphakathi engakhethi, okuhloswe ngalo ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, kuyinto ebalulekile ekusizeni ohulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo ngokwethula iMthethosisekelo Wokuphatha Kwamakhaya. Ukuveza uhlaka olusha lwezomthetho lokuphathwa kwamakhaya ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wamasipala kanye neMthetho Wamasistimu Wamasipala. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngoDisemba 5, 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zokuphatha kwamakhaya ezihloselwe ukubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba nesikhundla sokuhlela esasunguliwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengensiza yokuphatha yamamasipala futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nezindaba ezinjengokwabiwa kwezimali zamamasipala, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokubonisana, ehlelekile, futhi ehambisana nekusasa. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamamasipala kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqhube ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze kukahulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe kukahulumeni, ukwesekwa kwemboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamasipala. Esikhathini esedlule, amamasipala wayevame ukuba nezinhlelo ze-IDP ezihlelwe kahle. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Amanye amamasipala (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okuguqula) ayenqaba izinsiza namandla okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe ngalesi sikhathi, futhi kwakungekho izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinkinga, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bahlomule kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kunamamasipala ambalwa athole intuthuko enkulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ekuphathweni kokusebenza nezinhlelo ezivele zikhona. I-IDP Reference Books, esungulwe yiqembu elihlukile le-DPLG ngosizo lwe-GTZ, iphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwezizwe lwabaphathi bamamasipala, abasebenzi bezobuchwepheshe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababamba iqhaza abavela kumamasipala. Uhlelo lwezizwe lokweseka izinhlelo zikamasipala (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Inani elikhulu lamamasipala, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yokuphatha kwamakhaya, kanye neminyango eminingi yokuhweba kukahulumeni ezweni, iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kulolu hlelo olusha lwe-IDP Reference Book. Nginezithemba ezinkulu zokuthi le ndaba yokuhlanganisa izincwadi ezishicilelwe izokwenza kube lula futhi kube umthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubweni ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ibe ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ekhombisa ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kukhona ukuvumelana ngesidingo sokuba nezikhombisi ezicacile, ezisobala, nezilula ukusebenzisa kanye nesidingo sesu lokuhlela elinika indawo yokuxoxisana ngezindaba ezibalulekile, ezingenziwa kuphela ngochwepheshe bokuhlela abaphatha imibhalo nomsebenzi ofisi. Inselelo yesu elilula ayilula neze. Inqubo yokubonisana idinga ukubamba iqhaza okubonakalayo emikhakheni ehlukene yomphakathi ngokuya ngezinhlu ezahlukene zokuhlaziya nendawo lapho izinqumo zenziwa khona. Ukubandakanya wonke umuntu kusho ithuba lokubamba iqhaza kulokho okukhuluma ngakho nezinkulumo ngesikhathi esifanele ebhodini, futhi akulula nokwenza lo msebenzi. Inqubo yokuqala yesu idinga umcabango ocacile, ukuhlaziywa okuhlelekile ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezifanele, kubhekwa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi kucatshangelwe imigomo nezinqubomgomo ezisunguliwe. Lokhu kudlula nje ekudwebeni uhlu lwezinto ezibekwe phambili nokuhumusha lezi zinto zibe iziphakamiso zezimali. Inqubo ehlanganisiwe idinga ukucabanga nokubuka izinto ngokubanzi futhi isakaze emakhawulweni ezezimboni. Uhlelo oluhlanganisiwe oluqinile oluqhuba umsebenzi futhi luzama ukusho kahle izindleko, isikhathi, inani, izibopho, indawo, izinga lomsebenzi, kanye nendawo lapho umsebenzi uzolethwa khona. Lokhu kudlula nje uhlu lwezikhundla zomsebenzi ezizokwenziwa. Inselelo yokuhlela i-IDP ukuhlanganisa lezi zidingo ezintathu ngenhloso yokufinyelela inqubo yokwenza izinqumo ngendlela yokubonisana, ucabange kahle ngalesi sihloko, futhi uqhubeke ngempumelelo yomsebenzi uma usuqale. Kubandakanya inqubo ekhombisa umcimbi lapho i-IDP ihlelwa, hhayi ukukhombisa ithuluzi noma isu. Ukucabanga ngohlelo njengemicimbi eyisixhumanisi kulula kunokucabanga ngochungechunge lwezithuluzi zokuhlela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhuthaza inqubo yokubonisana nokucabanga phambili ngezinto ezibekwe phambili. Lokhu kuhlukanisa ngokucacile phakathi kweGeneral IDP Process (Guideline III) esebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamamasipala kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlela ezithile nezithuluzi (Guideline IV) ezingase zihluke kakhulu kumasipala owodwa kuya kumasipala omunye. Ihloswe ukusebenzisa ulimi oluhlelekile ngokugwema amagama ayinkimbinkimbi nezinsizwa ezinzima ezisetshenziswa abaklami. Imicimbi yokuhlela ivame ukuba yizinkulumo noma ama-workshops ezakhiwo zokuphatha ezilawula inqubo ye-IDP (Community Representative Council, IDP Steering Committee, Working Group) futhi kwezinye izimo, kungabandakanya imisebenzi eyenziwa ngabantu (njengokuhlanganiswa kolwazi, ucwaningo, njll.). Umcimbi ngamunye kumele ube nemiphumela ethile. Le miphumela ingaba uhlobo oluthile lolwazi noma isinqumo. Eminye imiphumela incike ezimfuneko zomthetho, ezinye zikhona ngenxa yokuhlakanipha okujwayelekile futhi zisiza ekulandeleni inqubo enephetho. Kuwo wonke umcimbi wokuhlela, kunikezwa izincomo mayelana nohlobo lwezinhlelo kanye nabantu okufanele babambe iqhaza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lubandakanya zonke izingxenye ezithintekayo futhi lukhuluma. Indlela yokuhlela ayisho okuningi ngezithuluzi zokuhlela ezithile okufanele zisetshenziswe kuwo wonke umcimbi. Lezi zinsiza zihluka kumasipala kuya kumasipala. AmaKhansela amakhulu angasebenzisa izindlela zokuhlela ezithuthukisiwe ezinekhompyutha. Amamasipala kuCategory B angase enze inqubo yokuhlela efanayo kodwa asebenzise indlela ebonakalayo. Ngomhla kaSepthemba 25, 2008, uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa KweFarmers lwe-Grain SA luzokhunjulwa njengoba bekungusuku olukhethekile, usuku lokukhumbula. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwefarmers luhlose ukusiza abalimi abamnyama. Iphathi eyayenzeka eNAMPO ngomhla kaSepthemba 25, 2008, yayihloselwe ukubonga labo abalimi abazokwazi ukufaka esikhundleni sabalimi bezomnotho ekulimaleni okujwayelekile. Indlela yokufaka esikhundleni sabalimi bezomnotho iyinselele; izinto azihambi kalula. Ukulima kuyinselele; kufana 'nokufaka umkhonto phansi,' futhi inzuzo ivame ukuba phansi. Laba balimi basizwe ngabasebenzi bohlelo lwe-GSA Farmer Development Programme kanye nabanye abaningi emkhakheni wezolimo - amabhange, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezithengisa izinto zokutshala, nabanye abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi sokweseka abalimi ngezigaba zokufunda, ngezinhlolovo ezinemfundiso, ezinsukwini zabalimi, ngeqhaza lempumelelo yabalimi yonyaka, ngezikole zokuqeqesha, ngokukhuluma nani emsakazweni, ngokushicilela i-"Pula/Imvula" isikhumbuzo njalo ngenyanga, sicabanga ukuqala okuthile okubizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo Lwabalimi Abathuthukile" ukuze sinikeze isisekelo esikhethekile sabalimi abanobuchwepheshe abathanda ukulima futhi baveze ukuthi bafuna ukuthuthuka. Iningi labalimi abaqashelwe kule phathi bangamalungu e-"Advanced Farmer Programme." Nokho, kukhona abanye abake basebenza nathi kulolu hlelo isikhathi eside; asikwazi ukubasiza ngentuthuko eyengeziwe ngoba sebesefikile kulolo phuzu: bangabakhiqizi bezomnotho. Sicabanga ukuthi kungaba kuhle ukuvuselela okuthile okubizwa nge-250 Ton Club ukuze sikhumbuze labo abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-250 tons wezinkwa ngonyaka, futhi babizwa ngokuthi "abalimi bezomnotho." Iningi labalimi abanjalo lizoba amalungu ohlelweni lwethu unyaka owodwa kuphela, kodwa sifuna ukuqaphela intuthuko yabo. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwefarmers lusebenze eminyakeni eminingi, futhi amaGrain Trusts, ikakhulukazi iMaize Trust, afake imali eningi ukuze asize ukuthuthukiswa kwalaba balimi. Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi manje sekukhona abalimi abangu-8 abaphumelele ekubeni abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, bekukhona abanye abalimi abangu-28 abaveze ukuthi bahlose ukufinyelela kulolo phuzu. Sibabize ukuba babe amalungu e-250 Ton Club. Kukhona izigaba ezihlukene kwi-250 Ton Club, kodwa manje sekukhona abalimi abane abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-1,000 tons, abane abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-500 tons, nabanye abangu-21 abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-250 tons. Sihlela ukugcina le phathi njalo ngonyaka futhi silindele ukusho 'Hooray!' kwabanye abalimi ngonyaka ka-2009.
