Uyayiqonda futhi uyayiqonda imiyalezo yale nkulumo ebhalwe phansi? Uyakuphikisa ukuthatha isifungo/njengoba kubhalwe? Uthatha isifungo njengokubophezeleka enhliziyweni yakho? Ngiyavuma ukuthi umuntu othatha isifungo uvumile ukuthi angakwazi futhi uyayiqonda imiyalezo yale nkulumo ebhalwe phansi. Umuntu othatha isifungo uthi lezi zisho ezilandelayo: "Ngiyafunga ukuthi imiyalezo yale nkulumo ebhalwe phansi iyiqiniso, uNkulunkulu angisize"/ Ngiyavuma ukuthi imiyalezo yale nkulumo ebhalwe phansi iyiqiniso". Umuntu othatha isifungo usayine/wenze uphawu phambi kwami ngenkathi ngikhona. Igama eliphelele nesibongo.
Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubamba iqhaza kwakho kanye nehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-influenza A (H1N1) 2009 pandemic ezindaweni zakho zokukhulekela nasemiphakathini. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni leli gciwane nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walonyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa ngokuthi yi-swine flu ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kuvela ezinkukhu. Manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi umthombo walo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, le flu ayinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje ibizwa nje ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngalesi sikhathi esisemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walonyaka, le gciwane isishayele phambili ezweni elingu-166. e-Afrika, kuze kube manje, le gciwane isishayele phambili ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, le gciwane sekuhlasele abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. ENingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 kanye nezinyanga eziyisithupha. Ngemuva kwemhlanganweni wesine weKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo owawubanjwe ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lezempilo Lomhlaba (WHO) lathola ukuthi izimfuneko zokubiza le flu njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke zifeziwe, futhi uMphathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, umemezele ngokusemthethweni le simo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho nje ukuthi le flu isishayele phambili ezweni lonke lezi zifunda ze-WHO futhi yenzeke ngesivinini esikhulu. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumenyezelwa kwe-pandemic akusho ukuthi le flu inamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iyaqhubeka nokusabalala yonke indawo. NgoJulayi 6, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwaleli pandemic ezweni elithintekile nakwezinye ezweni ezintsha njengokungamukeleki futhi okungabambezeli. Ngiyabonga, naphezu kwalokhu, iphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abahlaselwe le gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nakwazulu, sikhathazekile ngempilo yokufa okwenzeke kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye no-0.2% wabantu abahlaselwe eNingizimu Afrika). Le gciwane ithinta kakhulu abantu abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-29 - iningi labo bangabafundi noma basemanyuvesi. I-WHO inikeze iseluleko ezweni ezithintekayo ukuthi zigxile ekwehliseni umthelela wale flu emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Le flu idluliswa ngama-droplet okuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu ohlaselwe ekhwehlela noma ehlanza, uyawuphefumula ama-droplet abawakhwehlelayo noma abawakhwehlelayo. Noma uma bekhwehlela endaweni evaliwe, ungakuphefumula umoya lapho ungahlaselwa khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onama-symptoms alula noma abukhali kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokunconywa udokotela. Abaguli abadinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kwi-laboratory yocwaningo. Siyazi lokhu okwenzeka njengamanje emkhakheni wezempilo yangasese, kodwa akukona okudingwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe amacala abekwe engcupheni ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliswa kolwazi (protocol) ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Izinketho zokwelashwa zifaka iTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela ekubuyiseni kahle uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungasiza ukusindisa izimpilo. Ulwazi lomhlaba jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwesikole nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwe-flu. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kukhona iseluleko sokuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi onama-symptoms alula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi kanye/noma othisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenzisana nezinsiza zezempilo ukuhlinzeka ngesiqondiso esifanele. Uma unama-symptoms alula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sesixazululo futhi ukukhiqizwa okukhulu akukhona okwanele - isikali sikhona e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukukubonga ngalesi sikhathi osithathe ukufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubekayo kokubamba iqhaza kwakho ekusakazeni ulwazi nasekwehliseni imiphumela yale flu.
Ukuqinisekiswa KweSimo Sokusebenza (GEMS Employment Status Verification) Emakhaya amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika, kwavela izindaba ezidumile phakathi kwabantu, iyona yabezindaba ezithinta izimo sokuqashwa. Phakathi kwazo, indaba yeGEMS, iGoverning Employees Medical Scheme, yakhona ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi kwababambiqhaza emkhakheni wezempilo. Izikhathi zakudala, abantu bezishayisa izifuba ezinkulu, behlola izimo zokuqashwa ukuze baqonde ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza zeGEMS. Kwathi ngeSonto, uMnumzane Mthembu, osebenza njengomhlengikazi esibhedlela esikhulu, wacabanga ukuthi kumele aqinisekise isimo sakhe sokuqashwa. Kwakuhalaliswa isimo esijabulisayo, imindeni yekakhulu iphawula kanjena: “Ngabe uyazi, iGEMS iyalawula? Uma ungakatholi nje, ungaba nobunzima.” Lokhu kwaholela ekubonweni kokuthi isimo sokuqashwa, singenzeka kube yinkinga enkulu uma kungenzeka ungatholi lokho okufanele. UMnumzane Mthembu, nokho, wayengowesilisa ophumelelayo. Wazi kahle ukuthi izinsizakalo zeGEMS zibalulekile empilweni yakhe nasekwheni lokuhlinzeka usizo kubantu. Njengoba enza uhlu lwezinto ezidingekayo, wathola ukuthi kumele ahahe izincwadi ezisemthethweni ezivela ebhizinisini lakhe lokuqashwa, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyasebenza empilweni. Waqala ngokuthinta umphathi wakhe, uNkk. Khumalo, ukuze athole olunye ulwazi. UNkk. Khumalo, owayazi kahle imithetho yeGEMS, wamtshela ukuthi kudingeka agcwalise ifomu elithile ukuze aqinisekise isimo sakhe sokuqashwa. “Mnumzane Mthembu, kuzodingeka ubonise ukuhamba kwemali, izinsiza zezimali, nengxenye eyengeziwe yebhizinisi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubhalisile neGEMS,” kusho yena. Lokhu kwenza uMnumzane Mthembu aqonde ukuthi akufanele kube lula, kodwa kuyadingeka ukuba enze kahle. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, wahlola izincwadi zezimali zakhe, ezazisakeleki futhi ezalelwe usizo lwezempilo. Uthembise ukulandelela futhi wathumela yonke imininingwane efanele kuGEMS njengokufanele. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuhlakani bakhe bukhona, kanti khumbula imishwana yamaZulu esithi "ukufunda kumaphutha kuyingxenye yokuphila". Waqhubeka nokuphuma esibhedlela ngezinsuku ezilandelayo, njalo ethunyelwe ukuze alandele. Ngesonto elandelayo, uMnumzane Mthembu wathola impendulo evela kuGEMS. I-imeyili yeGEMS, echaza ngokuqinisekiswa kwesimo sakhe sokuqashwa, yamenza wakhanya. “Ngempela, umsebenzisi wezinsiza, uMthembu, unokuqinisekiswa!” Lolu suku lwaba yinsuku yokujabula ngoba wayezobona izinsiza ezazifanele ukuthi ziqhubeke. Waqonda ukuthi wayedlulelela inqubo yokuphila, eyayingadingeki ukuphuthelwa noma ukungabaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsiza zale nhlangano yeGEMS zavuma futhi zabamba uqhakambisa emhlabeni wezempilo. Uhlanga lwakhe lokusebenza lwaba nempumelelo, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kwase kuza nezithelo. Izinsizakusebenza zakhe zathuthukiswa, uMnumzane Mthembu ngahamba phambili ngebhizinisi lakhe elinjalo, elikhona kude nekhaya lakhe, kodwa linethemba. Ukusebenza ngeGEMS, kwavula amathuba amasha kubantu abanye abanikezwa izinsiza ezifanayo. N clássico, indaba kaMnumzane Mthembu ibonisa indlela impilo, izikhali, namathuba adinga ukuqinisekiswa ukuze aqukethwe kahle emangalisweni. Njengoba indaba yeGEMS iqhubeka, abantu basenhliziyweni zeNingizimu Afrika bahlala bejabulile futhi bematasa, ngokujoyina umhlaba wezinsizakusebenza zabo. Lokhu kukhombisa ubuqotho bokuphila nokuqhuba impumelelo ngaphandle kokungabaza, bonke behamba phambili emva kokuphumelelwa kwesimo sokuqashwa. Njengoba sizama ukuhamba nezindlela zokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele, sikhumbula ukuthi konke kuqala ngokuhlola ukuthi “ngabe ulungile, unelungelo?” Futhi lokho kuzoholela endleleni efanele yokwenza impilo enye eyengeziwe – okunenseku — ngenhloso nemibono ephusile. Ukusebenza noGEMS kuyafana nokwakha umuzi ophumelelayo, udinga izinkanyezi zokuqinisekisa, imibono ehlakaniphile, nezinyathelo ezisemthethweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa konyaka omusha, owenzelwe umphakathi wonke. Ngale ndlela, sihlanganyela sonke emicabangweni yokuphila, siqinisekise ukuthi sithola konke okwanele ukuze siqhubeke, kuze kuba yimpumelelo. Lokhu kunomthelela omkhulu, kwehlukanise izidingo zempilo zethu, kube yinsika yokusiza, uncedisiye emibhalweni yokwenza lula imizamo yethu. Ukubuyekezwa kwenzeke, nabantu bawaqhuba ukuyokwenza okukhulu, uma besimemeza inhloso nesimo sokuqashwa kuphela, kuze kube kunjalo. Ngale ndlela, uMnumzane Mthembu, uyazithokozisa ngempumelelo yakhe, iqiniso elikubona kakhulu: Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa akusikho kuphela ukwenziwa kukaMnumzane, kodwa kwaba yimpumelelo yempilo. Ubudlelwano phakathi kokuqinisekiswa kwempilo nezinsiza zeGEMS bukaMthembu bahlala bejabulile, baphuma emshadweni omkhulu wezempilo, behamba phambili bephumelele. Futhi lezi zitshalo, zibhalwe phansi ngalendlela eyingqayizivele, ezifuna ukuthi umhlaba wonke ubone izinyathelo ezibomvu ezingenziwa — kuZoom, kuGoogle Meet, noma kwelinye iphrojekthi. Kanjalo, le ndaba kaMnumzane Mthembu nokuphatha kwayo iGEMS, isifundo esiyinhle esiyaqonda okukhulu, esithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi, siphakamisela uqhakambisa izinsizakusebenza eziphathelene kokufanele. Ngakho-ke, ukuba ngumuntu ophumelelayo akudingi indlela ethile, kodwa kuyingxenye yokwaziswa kokuqinisekisa — ngisho nangaphandle, ikakhulukazi, uma uMnumzane Mthembu esebenzisa kahle iGEMS.
Yini efinyelelwa yi-NEMA? Ubani ongafaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ingabe isenzo noma isinyathelo esikhala ngaso singaphula amalungelo akho ezemvelo aphathelene ne-NEMA? Ingabe kukhona indlela yokulungisa izikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Kwenzekani ngemuva kokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amalungelo akho ezemvelo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Funda lapha kuqala. Ukusebenzisa iNational Environmental Management Act (NEMA) kungaba lula. Awudingi ukuba nommeli ukuze ufake isikhalazo kumuntu okwamanje odinga umonakalo emvelweni noma kumuntu okucatshangwa ukuthi angase enze umonakalo esikhathini esizayo. Awudingi nommeli uma ufuna ukujoyina njengomuntu wesigceme ezinqumweni eziphathelene nemvelo. Kuyasiza ukuhlela ukuhlangana nomuntu onolwazi nge-NEMA ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Umthetho ungaba nzima futhi ungadidanisa. Inkinga yakho ingase ibe nezimpande ezijulile. Kungase kube nezindlela ezingaphezu kweyodwa zokuyixazulula. Ungase udinge futhi ukubuza umuntu onolwazi ngalezi zindaba noma izinkinga ezingafakwanga kulolu hlelo. Ungase ufune ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi lokho okwenzayo kusemkhakheni ofanele. Uhlu lwamawebhusayithi kahulumeni nezinsiza zomthetho nolwazi olunomthelela lutholakala ekugcineni kwalolu hlelo. Bangakunika usizo mahhala ekuvikeleni imvelo yakho. Uma inkinga yakho ihilela ezinye izindaba, bangakudlulisela endaweni efanele yokusiza. Yini amalungelo ezemvelo? Ngonyaka ka-1994, umthethosisekelo omusha wasungula ilungelo lokuphila endaweni enempilo njengelungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Uma umthetho uthi into ethile iyilungelo eliyisisekelo, kusho ukuthi konke okwenziwa uhulumeni kufanele kuhambisane nalokho okukhulunywe ngalolo lungelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imithetho, izinqubo, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Abantu, kanye nemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezinhlelo kufanele zenze ngokuhambisana nelungelo. INkantolo yeMithetho ingase ibeke eceleni imithetho ephikisana nalolu lungelo, futhi izinkantolo zingase ziqedele izenzo zikahulumeni noma zomphakathi eziphula lo mthetho. Ukubeka eceleni kusho ukungafaki emsebenzini noma ukushintsha. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo lemvelo lithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila endaweni engalimeleli empilweni yabo noma ekuphileni kwabo. Kukhona futhi ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezilungile nezilindelekile ukuvikela imvelo, njengokuvikela ukungcoliswa komoya, ukukhuthaza ukulondolozwa, nokuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli kwemiphakathi kanye nokukhula komnotho. Ngaphandle komthethosisekelo, kukhona eminye imithetho eminingi evikela imvelo, njengomthetho wokulondoloza, umthetho wamanzi, nomthetho wokungcoliswa komoya. Le mithetho ivikela eziningi izinto ezingalimaza imvelo. Ngisho noma kungabi nomthetho ovikela ingxenye ethile yemvelo, kukhona njalo ilungelo lemithetho ongakusebenzisa ukuvikela impilo yakho nokuphila kahle nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu benza ngendlela efanele ukuvikela imvelo. I-NEMA iyimthetho omusha osiza ukuvikela amalungelo akho ezemvelo kangcono. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokusungulwa kwemigomo yemvelo ekhombisa uhulumeni lokho okufanele akwenze. Ngokwesibonelo, ukwazisa uhulumeni ngalokho okubizwa ngokuthi "ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli," okusho ukuthi wena njengomphakathi noma njengomuntu wempahla kufanele ube nengxenye ezinqumweni ezithinta imvelo. Usiza ukuvikela imvelo ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni ucabangela zonke izimpawu (umthelela wemvelo) ezingase zivele ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa ngaphambi kokuvuma ukuthi kuqhubeke. Ukuvikela labo abasebenza abavuma ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezilimazayo emvelweni, kanye nababikeli (labantu abahlinzeka ngemininingwane) ngabaningi abalimaza imvelo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kithi ukusiza izinkinga nezinkinga (ukuxazulula ukungavumelani kwemibono nokuxazulula). Ekugcineni, kunciphisa ingozi yokuthi uzothola uzama ukuvikela amalungelo akho uma ezinye izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga zihluleka. I-NEMA ichaza imvelo njengendawo yemvelo nezemvelo, izici zamasiko, nezinto ezithile ezithinta impilo yomuntu noma ukuphila kahle. Le mikhombandlela isetshenziswa kanjani? Ibonisa ukuthi ungafaka kanjani isikhalazo, ufune indlela yokulungisa, noma uthathe isinyathelo somthetho mayelana nokuthile okungase kwenzeke noma okukhona okwenzekile futhi kulimaza imvelo. Ichaza ukuthi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emizamweni yokuthinta izinqumo ezizothinta imvelo nezindlela zokuvikela imvelo ngokuvumelana nohulumeni. Uma ufuna ukufunda kabanzi nge-NEMA, funda lezi ziqondiso. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalazo mayelana nomonakalo wemvelo okwenzekile noma ongase wenze esikhathini esizayo, kunezinyathelo ezinhlanu kulolu hlelo. Lezi zinyathelo zizokukhombisa ukuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani i-NEMA. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma udinga olunye ulwazi, bheka isigaba kulolu hlelo lapho kukhona inombolo efanayo nalowo mbuzo bese ufunda. Buyela futhi ubheke lombuzo. Uma ungakwazi ukuphendula yebo kulombuzo, qhubeka komunye. Uma uqhubeka ungakuqondi kahle impendulo yombuzo, noma ufunde le ndatshana, noma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha, bheka Isigaba 10 lapho uzothola khona ikheli. Uma uphendule ngempela kuyo yonke imibuzo, funda Izigaba 8 no-9 ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nokwenzekayo uma uthatha isinyathelo. Ukuthatha isinyathelo somthetho. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma ucabanga ukuthi impendulo ingeyiyo, ungawulahli ithemba. Funda lesi sigaba seziqondiso futhi uxhumane neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha wesifunda sakho noma kazwelonke. Umbuzo 1: Ingabe isikhalazo sikhuluma ngento ezokwenzeka noma ngento esivele yenzeka noma yenziwe ngemuva kosuku lukaJanuwari 29, 1999? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 2. Umbuzo 2: Ungafaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 3. Umbuzo 3: Ingabe isikhalazo sithinta ukuphulwa kwamalungelo ezemvelo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 4. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe ucabangele ezinye izindlela ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 5. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe unolwazi olwaneleyo lokwenza izinqumo? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 6. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona indlela yokulungisa isikhalazo sakho ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 7. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe wenze isinqumo sokuthatha isinyathelo? Yebo, bheka Isigaba 8. Umbuzo 8: Kwenzekani uma uthatha isinyathelo? ISIGABA 1: Yini efinyelelwa yi-NEMA? I-NEMA yasungulwa ngomhla kaJanuwari 29, 1999. Ingase isetshenziswe ezindabeni ezizovela noma ezitholakele ngemuva kosuku lukaJanuwari 29, 1999. Ayisizi ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezenzeka ngaphambi kwalolu suku ngaphandle kwezinkinga eziqhubekayo. I-NEMA iyenza kube lula ukuvikela amalungelo akho ez
Abakhiqizi abaningi bathole ukuthi izinkinga zenzeka lapho bezama ukuvula i-akhawunti yasebhange entsha. Lokhu kungenxa yomthetho ka-2001 owaziwa ngokuthi i-Financial Intelligence Centre Act of 2001 (FICA), odinga ukuthi amabhange nezinkampani ezithintekayo zithole ulwazi oluthile mayelana nesimo samakhasimende ukuze zikwazi ukuhlola kahle nokudlulisela ulwazi oluhlobene nezinkampani nezivumelwano ezingase zibe semthethweni noma inzuzo engase ivela kwi-ububi. Umhlaba kanye nokuphila kushintshile. Ukwanda kobugebengu nokukhwabanisa kube nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni izwi eliningi ukuze kulwiswe leli banga. Ngenxa yalomthetho kanye nokubambisana kwamanye amazwe, iziphathimandla ziqinisa izinyathelo kubantu abenza ubugebengu lapho kubuhlungu kakhulu: emalini. Abantu abenza ubugebengu nabakhwabanisi badinga imali ukuze baphile. Baguqula imali "engcolile" etholelwe ngokwenza ubugebengu nokuhweba ngodlame, ukukhwabanisa, nokweba, bese "bahlanzisa" le mali besebenzisa i-ID yakho noma igama labantu abangenacala njenge wena. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlanza imali," okukhokhisa izigidigidi ezindleleni kumazwe emhlabeni wonke futhi kusiza ukukhula kobugebengu emhlabeni jikelele. Ngemizamo yokulwa nalolu hlobo lwezingozi, uhulumeni wethule umthetho obizwa ngokuthi i-Financial Intelligence Centre Act 38 ka-2001. Mayelana nalomthetho omusha, amabhange kumele enze izinyathelo eziqinile lapho evula ama-akhawunti amasha. Ukuze uhambisane nalomthetho, kumele unikeze ubufakazi obengeziwe ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungumuntu ophilayo. Lo mthetho uphinde ufunge ukuthi ibhange lithole ulwazi olusha njalo mayelana nesimo sakho. Lezi zinyathelo kufanele zisetshenziswe yizo zonke amabhange. Inombolo yakho ye-ID nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Incwadi yakho ye-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi, noma, uma ilahlekile, idokhumenti ekhombisa ukuthi ufake isicelo se-ID entsha eMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi noma isitatimende se-affidavit noma isitatimende samaphoyisa siqinisekisa ukuthi i-ID ilahlekile. Ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-licence yakho yokushayela. Ukuze ibhange noma ibhizinisi elithintekayo liqinisekise indawo yokuhlala, kumele ubahlinzeke ngencwadi evunyelwe equkethe igama lakho kanye nekheli - lapho uhlala khona (izibalo ze-P.O. Box azamukelwa), noma inombolo yakho yomgwaqo kanye nedolobha okukhona.
I-Charta Yokumba yasungulwa ngokulandela isigaba 100 somthetho wezinsiza zemaminerali nezamafutha, Umthetho No. 28 ka-2002 (MPRDA). IPhiko Lezinsiza Zemaminerali lisanda kubuyekeza le Charta Yokumba. Le buyekezo ibheke ezicini ezihlukahlukene zecharta kuhlanganise nokuba nefa, ukuthengwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezohwebo, amandla abantu abathile, ukuqashwa okufanele, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi. Ngemuva kokuba inhloso eyinhloko yePhalamende ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, iKomidi leNhlangano Yezinsiza Zemaminerali lizokwenza Ukuhlolwa Komphakathi ngemiphumela yokubuyekezwa kweCharta Yokumba endala kanye neziphakamiso zeCharta Yokumba entsha eCarltonville (indawo izoqinisekiswa), esifundazweni saseGauteng ngoMsombuluko, Mashi 30, 2011. Le komidi ifuna ukuxhumana ikakhulukazi nezinhlangano zokumba, abasebenzi bezimayini, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, kanye nemiphakathi ezungezile ezimayini. Ulwazi lokuxhumana: Ucingo (021) 403-3751, umakhalekhukhwini 083 709 8520 noma 083 966 7720, ikheli le-imeyili (nskaka@parliament.gov.za) noma (vmfuniselwa@parliament.gov.za); Ifeksi: 086 619 9194.
Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule NgoMsombuluko, uZola, umfundi ophothule eNyuvesi yaseNatal, ubhale imigqa ethokozisayo mayelana nezinselelo abahlangabezane nazo ekutholeni ama-internship. Njengoba izikhala zama-internship zikhula ngokuqhamuka kweminyaka, abafundi abaphothule badinga izindlela ezisheshayo nezisebenza kahle ukuze bathole amathuba okuqeqeshwa. Ukuthola internship kuyinselelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenawo amakhono okukhangisa. UZola uveza ukuthi, "Ngenkathi ngiphetha, benginenkinga enkulu yokuthola ama-internship. Ukuhlanganisa i-CV yami ngendlela efanele kube yinto ebalulekile." Iziphakamiso ezivela kubafundi bokuqala ziveza ukuthi ukuthuthukisa amakhono okubhalela imibhalo, ukufunda nokuphendula izincwadi kanye nokukhuluma phambi kwabantu kungaba usizo enkulu. UZola uthe: "Ngifunde ukuthi ukuhlela ama-CV nokubhala izincwadi ezicacile kungakhuphula amathuba ami." Ukwazi ukuthi ungakhalisa kanjani izinhlelo ze-internship, abanye bafundi baphumelelayo basebenzise izinhlelo zezikhumbuzo. UThandi, owenza izifundo zezezimali, uthe: "Ngithole internship yami ngokuqhafaza izikhumbuzo ezithunyelwa kubangane. Kukhona abadlali abavela ezinkampanini ezahlukene, ngakho ngathumele i-CV yami kwazulu." Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithe xaxa, abaphothuli badinga ukulandela ngemva kokuqashwa. Imithombo emininingwane efana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, izinsiza ze-intanethi, kanye nezingosi ze-internship, ziba wusizo olukhulu. Kwakhamusango, okuvame ukuhlola okuhle, nokukhangisa izinkampani ezenza izaziso. Izikhala eziningi zenzelwa ukufaneleka kwamafilimu, tsimingana, noma ezokusebenza kwezokuxhumana, okusho ukuthi abafundi badinga ukukhethwa ngokucophelela ukuze baphumelele. UThandi usho ukuthi, "Kubalulekile ukusetha izinhloso ezithile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola i-internship elungile." Abafundi abaphothule baveza ukuthi kudingeka banikeze izinkampani imiphumela emihle emphakathini. Ngokuphinde, abaphothuli badinga ukuthola izindlela zokuxhumana nabantu abahlala emkhakheni abafuna ukuwufunda. Ukuba nomphakathi onobungane ezinkampanini noma ezikhaleni ezintsha, kuzokwenza kube lula ukufuna izikhala eziyinqaba. UZola uveza indlela yokukhuluma, "Ngithole izeluleko ezivela kubantu abathakazelisayo emkhakheni wami." Ngaphansi kokuqonda okukhulu, uhlelo lwesikole lunikeza amathuba amaningi okukhulisa amakhono. Njengoba abaphothuli bephokophele imisebenzi, kubalulekile ukuba banikeze izikhulu ezihloniphekile, izifundo, nezinkumbulo. Noma kunjalo, abaphothuli bahlala bezibuza ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani kube lula ukuqasha. Izikhala zama-internship akuhlukahlukene, kodwa umphakathi ubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngothando lwezinto ezintsha. Umphakathi we-internship uphumelele uma uhambisana nezinto ezenzakalayo. UThandi uqhubekela phambili ngokuqhuba izifundo ezithokozisayo. "Ngibona ukuthi ukusebenza kwe-internship kubalulekile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuphumelela, kuthiwa kuyinselela, kufuneka njalo ube nekhono lokuhlola izinzuzo zakho." Ukubika kudinga ukuchazela lezi zindlela, ukuze abaphothuli bakwazi ukudala izikhala eziphumelelako. Nansi eminye imikhuba esizothola ezinkampanini eziphezulu, ezibavumela ukuba bebenze ithonya. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inhloso yokuthola i-internship igxila ekubhekaneni nezinto ezinjalo. Uthando lokusebenza nabantu nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekuhlonipheni izinkampani. Hamba hamba, qala ukukhuthazwa, qhubeka ufunde, futhi ungashiyi i-CV yakho ilunga elilodwa. Kukhona imfihlo yokuphumelela. Ngokulungiselela okuncane, uzobe usubhekelele kuwo umhlaba wobuchwepheshe, enze izinyathelo ezibalulekile ukuze uthole amandla okuqhubeka. Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule, zichaza leso sikhathi esifanele sokuba ufunde, umshiye, noma huza izinkundla zenhlangano. Kulabo abaphothule, lezi zindlela zingazosa izinzuzo, kuzokwenziwa ngenkuthalo, umsebenzi, nezifiso. Kuphumelela ukubamba amathuba akhulayo, ukuthi sizokhethiwe phakathi kwezinselelo eziqhubekayo, siphenyele ngalokhu kube nezinselelo ezinkulu. Abafundi abaphothule badinga ukuxeledisa, bahlanganyele, futhi basebenzisane ukuze baphumelelaye. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutholeni ulwazi olukhulayo, nezindlela ezithokozisayo ezivela ezinkampanini eziphezu. Emaphandleni, kubalulekile Ukuqonda ukuthi ezimakethe zethu, ubuchwepheshe bunzwa izifiso zamanje. UZola uyavuma ukuthi izingqinamba ezisemqoka zikhona, "Sidlula esikhaleni esinenkinga, kodwa kudinga ibhizinisi olindele." Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule, kulindeleke ezinsukwini ezizayo ukuthi zibe ngaphezu kokwenza umphakathi ube strongze. Ngeke uphushe amazwi ethu, umgomo ukufinyelela okuthokozisayo. Ngokuba khona, sithanda ukuqonda izivumelwano ezivelele. Abafundi abaphothule baphumelela uthando lwezinto zabo, ngokuhamba phambili ezitholakele, kuhlelwe ukuze bazizwe benamandla. Lezi zindlela ziyashintsha, zibonisa indlela evusa izifiso nabazali, uthando lomsebenzi, ezwehlinzi. Ngendlela, ukulwa nezinkinga kubalulekile, kuzosiza ukuba namaphuzu empathelwe, uthando lwamasiko namaqhawe. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni izikhala eziphusile, sizologique. Njengoba thina thina sizoba nephupho lesidumile, zonke izinyathelo eziphumelelayo ziyokwenza imizamo yenze namathuba amasha alindele futhi ahlole umhlaba wobuchwepheshe. Kulindeleke ukuthi uma amashumi eminyaka eshaya, inhloso ozoba nayo izogcwalisa izifiso eziphezulu zomphakathi, izikhala ezibanzi zezempilo, zithi sizobhalwa kuzo. Umgomo ungubani? Hamba phambili, uphendule, ruralize, be processers. Zombili zendawo, namathuba, qhafaza ukuba uqhawule osukwini lwakho. Ngakho, kulindeleke ukuthi izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule kube yinzuzo enkulu emphakathini, uthando lokusebenza, nezifiso eziphumelelayo. Noma yisiphi isizathu, kufanele sithole izinkolo eziphakemeamsung, esikhathini esizayo. Izindleko zokufunda zizele kakhulu, ngakho uma ubona izinyathelo, yiba nesibindi, uvulele izinto ezintsha. Zama ogama amasha! Ngakho, ukusebenza, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokubamba ngezandla, kwenza kube lula ukuhlonza ikusasa. Ukube sithola lezi zindlela, sizowina ubuchwepheshe, ngesikhathi esithile. Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zikhula, zama ukufaka isandla namathuba abhekiwe nezinyathelo okwenza kube yikhulu esikhathini. Yazi ukuthi uhlale unegqugquzela, uzobe uhamba phambili ekujabuliseni izwe.
Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kwezohwebo Kusukela eminyakeni yokuqala ye-1800, idolobha laseThekwini, elaziwa nangokuthi iThekwini, liye laba yindawo ebalulekile kwezohwebo eNingizimu Afrika. Umthelela wokuminyana kuleli dolobha ubalulekile, njengoba ungenise izinguquko ezinkulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ezomnotho, nakwezokuthutha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iThekwini yathola umphakathi omkhulu wabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuholele ekwakhekeni kwemiphakathi emisha. Lokhu kuminyana kwaba nemiphumela eminingi, kuhlanganisa nokwanda kwezohwebo. Abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bangenisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhweba, okuhlanganisa imikhiqizo emisha, izinsiza, nezindlela zokuphila. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwemakethe, okwakwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo ehlukahlukene. Ngaphakathi kweminyaka yama-1900, iThekwini yaba yindawo ebalulekile yokuhweba emhlabeni jikelele. Ibhizinisi lempahla, ikakhulukazi ezokuthutha, lenza umthelela omkhulu emnothweni wendawo. Izikhumulo zezindiza nezamabhasi zathuthukiswa, kwaholela ekwandeni kokuhamba kwabantu nemikhiqizo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kweThekwini nezinye izindawo eNingizimu Afrika, nakwamanye amazwe. Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini akukhawulelwe kuphela ezohwebo. Ubuye ube nomthelela ekwakheni izikhungo zokufunda nezokucwaninga. Izikole nezikhungo zemfundo zakhula, zathuthukiswa ukuze zifundise abantu abaningi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abaningi. Abantu abasha bathola amathuba okusebenza, okwakwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lemfundo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini wakhula kakhulu, kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Lokhu kwaba nemiphumela emihle, njengoba abantu baphila ndawonye, behlanganyela izimfuno zabo, futhi besiza omunye nomunye. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ungenise izinguquko ezinkulu kwezokuthutha. IThekwini yaba yindawo eyinhloko yokuhweba, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izindlela eziningi zokuhamba. Izitimela, izikhumulo zezindiza, nezindlela zomgwaqo zathuthukiswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu nemikhiqizo bangahamba kalula. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa ezohwebo, njengoba abantu bengenisa imikhiqizo yabo kalula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini waphinde wakhula emikhakheni eminingi. Izimboni zathuthukiswa, zakhula, futhi zaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni wendawo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, futhi abantu baphila kahle. IThekwini yaba yindawo yokuhweba enezimboni eziningi, okuholele ekwandeni komnotho. Naphezu kwezinselelo ezithile, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izindawo zokuhweba ezinkulu, ezinjengezikhungo zokuthenga, izimakethe, nezindawo zokudlela. Abahwebi bahlala bejabulile, njengoba imakethe ikhula, futhi abantu bengenisa imikhiqizo yabo kalula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala nakwezinye izindawo eNingizimu Afrika. IThekwini yaba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi omkhulu ungaba nomthelela omuhle kwezohwebo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhweba ezihlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokuthengisa. Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala futhi ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho zathuthukiswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphile kahle, futhi bahlale bejabulile. IThekwini yaba yindawo lapho abantu baphila khona ngokubambisana, behlanganyela izimfuno zabo, futhi besiza omunye nomunye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala nakwezinye izindawo eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba abantu baphila ndawonye, behlanganyela izimfuno zabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhweba. IThekwini yaba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi omkhulu ungaba nomthelela omuhle kwezohwebo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhweba ezihlukene. Ngokubheka emuva, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala njengomlando obalulekile. Ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi omkhulu ungaba nomthelela omuhle, futhi ungakhuthaza ukuhweba, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi. IThekwini iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, ezokuthutha, nasempilweni yabantu. Lokhu kuhlobene nokwakhiwa komphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Ngakho-ke, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini ubonakala njengomlando obalulekile, futhi ubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezohwebo eNingizimu Afrika.
Bheka amakhasi ahlukene (kusukela kumakhasi 5 kuya ku-10)! Khetha umbala owuthandayo bese ubhala igama lakho kuwo uma uthanda! Hamba ph round kule mboniso bese UTHOLA umfanekiso ophawulwe obonisa kumakhasi 12! Uthole imibala emingaki? Yini ifomu lalesi sithombe? Lo msebenzi wenziwe ngengxenye ezahlukene. Ubalela izingcezu ezingaki? Thatha ama-sticker bese UHLANGANISA wona kumakhasi 22 ngendlela oyithandayo! Dala umsebenzi wakho? Ingabe kukhona amafomu owaziyo obonayo empilweni yansuku zonke owawubona kulesi sithombe? Ungawadweba? Ingabe ubone ama-squares enziwe NGE-PAPER? Uthole izingcezu? Ingabe yindiza? Cha, iyifu? Iphupho? Kungenzeka kube nezinto eziningi. Ucabanga ukuthini? Uma lo msebenzi ungakha ISIZWE, iyiphi uhlobo lwezwi olungaba khona? Kungaba phezulu noma phansi noma kungase kungabi nezwi nhlobo. Ungazama ukwenza lelo zwi? Lesi sithombe, ungakucabanga ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lomculo esingadansa kuwo manje lapha? Lokhu nguMbongeni. Akasebenzisi upende, amaphepha, indwangu, noma iphepha. Uqoqe amabhokisi epulasitiki futhi awafaka esitudiyo. Lapha wenza umfanekiso ohlanganisa izinto, i-collage, namabhokisi epulasitiki. Ungachaza lo msebenzi? Ubonani? Ungacabanga ngezinto ongazithola ekhaya, emigwaqweni, noma esikoleni? Ingabe kukhona okutholayo kulezi zinto kulesi sithombe? Bhala phansi konke okutholayo? Bheka yonke imisebenzi yobuciko. Khetha ingxenye oyithandayo yale mboniso! Yenza UMDWEBO ukuze ukwazi ukukhombisa umndeni wakho nabangani bakho ekhaya! Umsebenzi obubhalile unombala nofomu, futhi wenziwe ngezinto ezihlobene ngqo nakho. Ungabhalela ukuthi uhlobo luni lombala lo msebenzi onalo, yisiphi isimo onaso, nezinto ezisetshenzisiwe? Hambisa ubheke umfanekiso ophawulwe kule mboniso! Ubonani? Ingabe kukhona umehluko uma ubheka umfanekiso odweba kude noma uma ubheka eduze? Bheka lo msebenzi kodwa ungafundi isihloko! Ungacabanga ngesihloko esingakha lo msebenzi? Manje bheka isihloko. Ingabe lesi sihloko sishintsha okuthile kuwe? Ingabe kukhona okubonayo noma okucabangayo okuhlukile kulokho okwakucabangile ekuqaleni? Ungathola umsebenzi wobuciko emnyuziyamu ofana nalezi zithombe ezimbili ozibheke? Uthole le nto ngeZINTO EZIHLOKILE ezintathu? Yini umehluko phakathi kweSITHOMBE kumakhasi (amakhasi amabili aluhlaza anama-cross) nomsebenzi WOKWENZA wokuqala phambi kwakho? Ake sibheke bobabili imisebenzi yobuciko futhi sikhulume ngendawo. Bheka iMercedes emnyama ne-white emnyuziyamu! Uchwepheshe bezobuciko ubebheka yimaphi amakhaya? Ubonani okuthile ngezindlela ezintathu EZIHLUKILE eduze kwamakhaya? Ake sizame ukudweba le nto NGOKUBONWA KWENKAZIMULO. Bheka lo msebenzi. Le mifanekiso ibonisa indawo yokuhlala ngokubona kwenkazimulo. Ake sithathe uhlelo lwezindlu lwekilasi lakho olunezinto zonke zokuhlala bese sisebenzisa ukubona kwenkazimulo. Lesi sithombe senziwe nguZwelethu Mthethwa ophila eKapa. Ukuze akhe iphrojekthi yakhe yobuciko, uvakashela abantu futhi athathe izithombe ezindlini zabo. Chaza indlu obonayo. Ake sithathe indlu yakho ngezindlela ezintathu ezihlukile: lapho ulele phansi endlini, lapho ume esihlalweni, kusuka ngaphakathi kuya ngaphandle.
Eminyakeni edlule, kubonakala ukuthi ukuhweba kwezolimo akusona isikhundla esikhethwe abantu abasha lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi awekho abalimi abamnyama abaphumelelayo emnothweni. Ngenxa yalolu thintelo, sifuna ukukhombisa ukuthi kukhona abalimi abamnyama abaphumelelayo, futhi sikhombisa ukuthi abantu abaqhuba kanzima bangaphumelela. Samuel Moloi waseFouriesburg, uMnu. Isak Khuto waseFicksburg, noMnu. Labious Manoto waseMooifontein. Umphumela wokugcina waba nguMnu. Kwakukhona abaphakanyisi abahlanu kulezi zindawo futhi bahlolwa ngaleyo viki ngenkathi omunye umncintiswano uhloleke. Sesivele sabona ukuthi kukhona abalimi abaningi abahlala ezindaweni ezincane abafanele ukunikwa ukwesekwa nokwaziswa. Ngale ndlela, sizama ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale ukuhweba ngezolimo ngokukhuthaza ezindaweni ezincane, bese bebona ukuthi umsebenzi wabo uzokhula.
Izinsizakalo zomphakathi yizinsizakalo eziyisisekelo ezikhululekile ezinikezwa uhulumeni ezindaweni ezihluphekayo ngaphandle kwentela. Lezi zinsizakalo zihlanganisa amanzi, ugesi, ukuhlinzekwa kwezokuhlanzeka, nokulahla udoti. Lezi zinsizakalo zinikezwa yizifunda futhi zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa okuyisisekelo kogesi, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo eziyisisekelo zezindlu ezihluphekayo. Nokho, imithetho elawula ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlanzeka nokulahla udoti ayikakagcwalisiwe yizigaba ezifanele zikahulumeni, okungukuthi uMnyango Wamanzi Nezinkuni, uMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha. Ukuhlinzekwa kwamahhala kwamanzi okuyisisekelo kuyi-volumu ye-6kl yamanzi ngenyanga ngendlu. Le volumu ingahluka ukusuka kwisifunda ukuya kwesifunda, futhi kufanele uxhumane nesifunda sakho ngqo ukuze uthole ukuthi yisiphi isikhungo samanzi samahhala esitholakalayo esifundeni sakho. Kufanele ukhokhe nganoma yisiphi amanzi owasebenzisayo ngaphezu kwe-volumu eyabelwe mahhala. Abasebenzisi bezikhala zogesi ezikhokhelwayo abangakasebenzisi ugesi wabo bazokwazi ukubona lapho ugesi usuphela, futhi kuzodingeka baxhumane nomunye umuntu. Abasebenzisi begesi abakhipha imali ekupheleni kwenyanga noma labo abasebenzisa okuthiwa ama-meter e-credits ngeke bakwazi ukubona lapho sebesebenzisile wonke amayunithi abo. Bakhokhelwa ngokusebenzisa okuningi ekupheleni kwenyanga ngayinye. Abasebenzisi begesi abangenayo amandla agridi bangahlinzekwa ngamandla angaphandle kwegridi yisifunda sabo. Kufanele uxhumane nesifunda sakho ukuze uthole ukuthi yisiphi ugesi osebenzisa. Ukuze uthole ukuhlinzekwa kogesi namanzi ekhaya lakho noma ebhizinisini, xhumana nesifunda sakho, lapho ikhaya lakho noma ibhizinisi lakho likhona. Ezindaweni ezithile, umhlinzeki wegesi kazwelonke, i-ESKOM, uhlinzeka ngogesi ngqo. Uhulumeni akak started ukuqaliswa kohlelo lokuhlanzeka mahhala. UMnyango Wamanzi usungule uhlaka lokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlanzeka zamahhala. Uma inqubomgomo igcwaliswa, ohulumeni bendawo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhlanzeka bazokwazi ukuqaliswa kwalolu hlelo. Uhulumeni akak started ukuqaliswa kohlelo lokulahla udoti mahhala. UMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha usungule uhlaka lokulahla udoti mahhala. Uma inqubomgomo igcwaliswa, ohulumeni bendawo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokulahla udoti bazokwazi ukuqaliswa kwalolu hlelo. Ukukhokha ama-akhawunti ngaphambi kokusebenzisa ugesi ukuthenga amayunithi ngemali yakho kusho ukuthi uzosebenzisa kuphela amayunithi owakhokhile noma owathengile. Uma ususebenzisile wonke amayunithi akho futhi usafuna amanye, kuzodingeka uthenge amanye. Ama-akhawunti athola izitatimende ngemuva kokusetshenziswa kusho ukuthi ungasebenzisa noma yiliphi inani legesi namanzi. Isifunda sakho sizokuthumelela isitatimende senyanga yonke esikhombisa inani legesi noma amanzi owasebenzisile kanye nenani okufanele ukhokhe. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo. Khokha imali yesicelo ebekiwe. Isicelo sakho sokwesekwa kwabantu abahluphekayo sizophathwa kusukela ngosuku olufaka isicelo sakho. Isicelo sakho sizohlolwa, futhi kuzokwenziwa isinqumo sokuthi uyafaneleka yini ngezinsizakalo eziyisisekelo zamahhala noma cha. Ngokusho kwemigomo yesifunda sakho, uzobhaliswa ukuze ufaneleke ngezinsizakalo zamahhala ngaphansi kohlelo olubizwa ngokuthi Izinsizakalo Eziyisisekelo Zamahhala, bese uthola ukwesekwa okufanele. Amanzi: Ama-6,000 amalitha wamanzi okuqala ngenyanga ngendlu ahlinzekwa mahhala, kanti noma yiziphi amalitha angeziwe ngaphezulu kwalokho akhokhelwa ngentengo ebekiwe yisifunda. Amafomu okweseka abantu abahluphekayo. Izifunda eziningi zinefomu lesicelo. Buza isifunda sakho ngohlelo lokwesekwa kwabantu abahluphekayo.
Ukubhujiswa Kwenziwa Ngenxa YeZimayini Umbuzo 1: Yini edala ukubhujiswa kwemvelo ngenxa yezimayini? Ukubhujiswa kwemvelo okubangelwa izimayini kuqala ngenxa yezinqubo zokumba nokuhlaziya umhlaba ukuze kutholakale izinto ezinjengogesi, uwoyela, namaminerali. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuhamba kwemithombo yemvelo, okukhuphula amathuba okukhukhuleka kwemithambo, ukonakala kwemifula, nokushintsha kwemvelo jikelele. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokumba izimayini? Izimayini ziqhuba phambili umnotho wezindawo ezitholakala kuzo. Zenza kube lula ukuthola amaminerali adingekayo embonini, futhi zandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Lezi zinzuzo, nakuba zidinga ukwenziwa ngendlela efanele, kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi azilimazi imvelo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinkinga ezihlobene nokubhujiswa kwemvelo? Ukukhula kwezindawo ezitholakalayo kuholela ekuphileni okuncishisiwe kwemvelo. Izimayini zishiya emhlabathini izinsalela ezinzima, ukuchithwa kwezinsiza, kanye nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni zokudla nezinye izinsiza, okwenza kube nzima kubantu nabanye abathile ukuthola izinto eziphilayo. Umbuzo 4: Umthelela wezokungcebeleka ungakanani? Umthelela wezokungcebeleka ubalulekile. Uma izimayini zisebenza kahle, zingakhuphula umoya ophathekayo, okwandisa izinga lokushisa emhlabeni. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, okwenza kube nomthelela ongemuhle empilweni yabantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala eduze. Umbuzo 5: Kungani kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalokhu? Ukukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga kusisiza siqonde indlela izinto ezihamba ngayo emhlabeni. Kudingeka izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuvikela imvelo, ukuze izinqubo zokumba izimayini zibe nezinzuzo ngaphandle kokulimaza indawo. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi sikhulisa umnotho ngaphandle kokuchitha umhlaba. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izixazululo ezikhona ukuze kugwenywe lokhu? Kunoma yisiphi isimo, kufanele siqale ngokuqinisa izinqubomgomo zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimayini zisebenza kuphela emigqeni ethile, futhi zithole izitifiketi ezihambisana nemigomo yokuvikela imvelo. Ukuze sithuthukise ubuhlakani bemvelo, kufanele sihloniphe izinqubo ezikhona. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe kunezinyathelo ezenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe imvelo? Yebo, kunezinyathelo eziningi ezenzakalayo ezweni elithile. Izinyathelo ezifana nezifundo zabantu ngezinqubo zemvelo nokubamba izinkulumo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yendawo kunciphisa umthelela wezizimayini. Ukuqinisekisa imithetho ethile yokuhlola imiphumela yemigwaqo yezezimali emhlabeni, kungenza kube lula ukuveza izinyathelo eziphuma ezindabeni zomphakathi. Umbuzo 8: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba abantu bazi kahle ngalesi sihloko? Abantu badinga ulwazi ukuze baqonde imiphumela emihle nehlupha yokumba izimayini. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi benza izinqumo eziphusile, ezivikelekile, nezinomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe abantu bangaqhamuka kanjani nezinqumo ezifanele? Ngokuhlanganyela, abantu bangafunda ngokubambisana nezikhungo ezithinta izimayini nezemvelo. Ukuhamba emihlanganweni, ukuhlola izikhungo, nokuqhubekisela phambili izikhumbuzo, kungenza abantu babe nomthelela omuhle esizweni futhi basize ukugcina imvelo ilawulwa kahle. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayilungisa ukuze sithole ibhalansi phakathi kokuthuthukiswa nezokuvikela imvelo? Ukuze sithole ibhalansi, kubalulekile ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabathintekayo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekuqoqeni imizamo yokuphila enempilo, kugxile ekusebenzeni komphakathi, nasezindaweni zokuhlala nezothando lwemvelo. Umphakathi ungathuthukiswa ngokuhambisana nokwakha izinqubo ezilungile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimayini zisebenza ngendlela ehlelekile. Isiphetho: Ukukhuluma ngalokhu kusho ukuvula umnyango wezinkinga ezinzima ezithinta imvelo. Kubalulekile ukuhamba kancane, silandela izinyathelo eziphephile ukuze sivikele umhlaba nempilo yethu. Uma sithatha izinqumo ezicacile, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza eziphilayo.
Izinkinga Zemfundo: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinto Ezithinta Ukufunda Nezokufundisa Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imfundo ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Nokho, izinkinga eziningi zikhona ezithinta imfundo, ezithinta abafundi, othisha, kanye nemiphakathi. Lezi zinkinga zidinga ukucutshungulwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lemfundo, futhi kube nokufunda okuphumelelayo. Ukungafinyeleli Emathubeni Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu zemfundo yikungafinyeleli emathubeni. Abafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, bahlushwa ukungabi namathuba afanele okufunda. Lokhu kubangelwa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengemithombo yokufunda, izikole ezinhle, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhasa abafundi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abafundi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni lemfundo elidingekayo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuqhubeka nezifundo zabo. Izinga Lemfundo Eliphansi Izinga lemfundo eliphansi lihlala lukhathaza. Abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukungaqondi kahle izifundo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kungenxa yokuntuleka kokuxhaswa okuhle, izinhlelo zokufundisa ezingasebenzi kahle, kanye nokungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezanele. Othisha, abanye bahlushwa ukungabi namakhono afanele, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukufundisa kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa amakhono othisha, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emfundweni. Ubunzima Bokufunda Ngolimi Lwakubo Enye inkinga enkulu yikufunda ngolimi olungelona olwakubo. Abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukufunda ngolimi olungelona lwabo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuqonda izifundo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufunda ngolimi lwabo, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ukufunda ngolimi lwabo kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuveza imicabango yabo, futhi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Izinkinga Zokuxhumana Nezobuchwepheshe Ngokwanda kobuchwepheshe, izinkinga zokuxhumana zikhula. Abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi nezinsiza zokuxhumana, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukufinyelela emithonjeni yolwazi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela kobuchwepheshe, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuveza imicabango yabo, futhi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ukungabi Nezinhlelo Zokuxhasa Abafundi Izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yabo. Nokho, izinkinga zokungabi nezinhlelo ezanele zikhona. Abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukungabi nezinsiza zokuxhasa, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukuxhaswa kwabafundi, ukuze bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ukuxhaswa kwabafundi kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuveza imicabango yabo, futhi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ukubambisana Kwezemfundo Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, othisha, nabafundi kubalulekile ukuze kuthuthukiswe imfundo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukubambisana, ukuze bonke abathintekayo bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye. Ukubambisana kuzosiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa imfundo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baphumelele. Isiphetho Izinkinga zemfundo zidinga ukucutshungulwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lemfundo. Ukungafinyeleli emathubeni, izinga lemfundo eliphansi, ubunzima bokufunda ngolimi lwabo, izinkinga zokuxhumana, ukungabi nezinhlelo zokuxhasa, kanye nokubambisana, zonke lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukuze sithuthukise imfundo, kudinga ukuba sibe nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufunda, futhi sibe nokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, othisha, nabafundi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abafundi bezokwazi ukufinyelela emathubeni afanele, futhi bakwazi ukufunda kahle.
UMphakathi Wezokuthutha, ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 soMthetho Wokusebenza Kwamakhwenkwe, 1962 (Umthetho 74 ka-1962), usungule izinqubomgomo ngokwehlelo lwayo. Kuleli hlelo, ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okunye, "izinqubomgomo" ibhekisela ezinqubomgomeni zokusebenza kwamakhwenkwe omphakathi, 1997, ezikhishwe nguHulumeni ngaphansi kwenombolo yesaziso R.1219 edlulelwa ngoSepthemba 26, 1997, kanye ne-R.1255 edlulelwa ngo-Okthoba 17, 1997, njengoba kuguqulwe yisaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.1735 edlulelwa ngoDisemba 24, 1997, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.1041 edlulelwa ngoMgqibelo 14, 1998, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.1148 edlulelwa ngoSepthemba 18, 1998, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.1664 edlulelwa ngoDisemba 14, 1998, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.1701 edlulelwa ngoDisemba 31, 1998, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.639 edlulelwa ngoMeyi 21, 1999, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.170 edlulelwa ngoFebhuwari 17, 2000, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.171 edlulelwa ngoFebhuwari 18, 2000, isaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.558 edlulelwa ngoJuni 22, 2001, kanye nesaziso sikaHulumeni esinombolo R.559 edlulelwa ngoJuni 22, 2001.
