G. Iziphakamiso Eziwusizo Zokuphatha Izimpawu Zokugula Nokwandisa Ukudla Okunempilo. Impilo yethu, indlela esizizwa ngayo, umsebenzi wethu, nokudlala, indlela esikhula ngayo futhi sithuthuka - konke kuthonywa yiz food esizidlayo. Ukudla kunikeza umzimba izithako ezidingekayo ukuze ube nempilo futhi uqine. Izithako zifaka phakathi amaprotheni, amakarbohayidrethi, amafutha, ama-vithamini, imithombo, namanzi. Le pamphlet yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nendima ebalulekile yokudla ekwandiseni uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba ukuze luphikise izifo futhi lukusize ekubuyiseni. Inhloso ukuheha ukuthi unake kakhulu isimo sokudla somguli ngamunye osesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo futhi usebenzise ukudla okunempilo njengendlela ebalulekile ohlelweni lwakho lokwelashwa. Kulolu doc, abantu abasesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo bafaka bonke abaguli abanezifo ezinzima abafuna ukwesekwa okungeziwe kokudla ukuze bagweme ukulahlekelwa isisindo nokuphazamiseka - ikakhulukazi abaguli abanokhulumeni, umdlavuza, i-tuberculosis, noma eminye imikhuhlane. Enye yezindlela zokuphula leli cycebe elibuhlungu ukusebenzisa ukudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo kwandisa amandla omzimba okuphikisa izifo nezifo, kukhuphule amandla, futhi kwenza umuntu azizwe eqinile futhi engcono. Lokhu kungasiza ukuhamba phambili kwezifo. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungasiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba lukhona ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze sikwazi ukuphikisa izifo. Wonke umuntu udinga ukudla ukudla okufanele ukuze ahlale enempilo. Nokho, kubantu abasesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi badle ukudla okunempilo, njengoba bephakeme kakhulu emiphumeleni yokuntuleka kwezithako. Ukungadli okwanele, ukulahlekelwa kwezithako okweqile, kanye nokuntuleka kwezithako kubantu abagulayo kuholela ekulahlekelweni isisindo nasekuphazamisekeni, kwehlisa uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba futhi kwandisa ubungozi bezifo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo badla ngendlela efanele. Ukuvimbela ukulahlekelwa isisindo nokukhuthaza ukukhula kwesisindo. Ukubuyisela zonke izithako ezilahlekile ngesikhathi sokugula nokuhlanza. Ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kokudla okunempilo okuhlukahlukene (ukudla okunothile ngezithako kanye nokudla okunamandla emathunjini) kunamacebo amaningi okugcina uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba lukhona. Ukulungisa ukudla komguli ukuze kuhambisane nezimpawu zabo zokugula. Ukuncoma umguli ngokudla okufanele acabangele ukuthi umguli angakufinyelela. Hlola isisindo somguli futhi ugcine irekhodi lesisindo kukhadi leklinikhi. Buza umguli ukuthi udla ini ngokuvamile ukuze uthole ukuthi uthola yisiphi isidlo, izimo zabo zomnotho, nokuthi yikuphi ukudla abangakufinyelela. Thola ukuthi kukhona amanzi aphephile kanye negesi atholakalayo. Thola umlando wezimpawu zokugula zomguli. Siza umguli ukuhlela ukudla kwabo, ucabangele isimo sabo somnotho nolunye ulwazi ukuze kuhlangabezane nesimo somguli. Uma umguli elahlekile isisindo, nikeza iziphakamiso zokwandisa isisindo somzimba. Nikeza umguli izeluleko zokuphatha ukudla ngokuphepha. Hlela ukuhamba phambili ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi lezi ziphakamiso zilandelwa. Kunezindlela eziningi zokudla okunempilo. Ngamunye wethu udla ngendlela ehlukile ngenxa yezimo zethu zomnotho, ukukhetha ukudla, inkolo, isiko, njll. Kubalulekile ukukhetha lokhu uma uncoma abaguli ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuze ugweme izifo, ukuntuleka kokudla, nokulahlekelwa isisindo okungafunwa, khuthaza abaguli ukuthi bangalibali, baqale ukunaka kakhulu udaba lokudla okunempilo manje. Kunzima kakhulu ukulungisa ukuntuleka kwezithako emzimbeni uma sebekhulile kakhulu futhi begula kakhulu! Akukho uhlobo olulodwa lokudla olungasinika konke esikudingayo! Khuthaza abantu ukuba badle ukudla okuhlukahlukene - ukudla abangakukwazi ukukhokhela futhi abakutholayo kalula. Kunconywa ukuthi umuntu adle izinhlobo ezintathu ezahlukene zokudla nsuku zonke. Khuthaza abantu ukuba baphuze phakathi kokudla (iziphuzo) njengoba lokhu kusiza kakhulu uma othile enezinkinga zokudla okwanele ngesikhathi sokudla. Nansi isithombe ongayisebenzisa ukukhombisa abaguli ukuthi kulula kanjani ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zokudla. Ukudla okune-starch njengobhontshisi, iphalishi, amakhabe, irayisi, amazambane, yam, ummbila, ipasta kufanele kube ingxenye enkulu yokudla kwabo. Ngokuvamile, lezi zinto azibizi kakhulu futhi zikh提供a izithako eziningi ngemali. Khuthaza abaguli ukuba bafake ukudla okwengeziwe kokudla okune-starch ukuze balungise izidlo ezihlanganisiwe. Imifino nezithelo zikh提供a umthombo wama-vithamini nemithombo ukusiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba lukhona. Khuthaza abaguli obakhathalelayo ukuba badle izithelo nemifino eminingi ngangokunokwenzeka. Imifino nezithelo ezinemibala efana nepinki, ophuzi, obomvu, noma oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kufanele zidle nsuku zonke, isibonelo, i-spinach, i-pumpkin, ama-carrots, ama-apricots, i-papaya, kanye ne-mango. Izithelo ezifana namawolintshi, amalimu, ne-guavas, kanye ne-mango kanye namatamatisi zikh提供a i-vitamin C esiza ekuphikisaneni nezifo. Abaguli kufanele baphokophele ukudla izithelo nemifino/izinkonzo ezinhlanu zemifino ngosuku. Inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, namathanga angadliwa nsuku zonke. Phakathi kwezinye izithako ezitholakalayo, lezi zinto zikh提供a umzimba ngamaprotheni. Ngalesi sikhathi sokugula, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba umuntu abe namaprotheni anele. Inyama yenkukhu, i-nyama yebhuku, i-nyama ye-pork, inhlanzi, umthondo, ikhala, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, imbuzi, izinyawo zenkukhu, amaqanda, ubisi, ushizi, i-yogurt, ubisi lwe-buttermilk, ubisi oluphakanyisiwe (hhayi i-coffee creamer), ushizi, kanye nezinyoni ezithile. Lapho kuthengwa esitolo, lezi zinto zivame ukuba zibhujiswe kakhulu - khuthaza labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuba baphile izinkukhu, amahlosi, izinkomo, izinkukhu, nezilwane ezithile ekhaya ukuze bathole inyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho nobisi. Lezi zinto zikh提供a imikhiqizo esekelwe ezitshalweni, ezikh提供a futhi amaprotheni nezinye izithako ezidingekayo ukuze uqine uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba nezicubu. Khuthaza abaguli ukuba badle ama-beans, ama-peas, ama-lentils, kanye nama-soybeans angasetshenziswa njengezikhumbuzo zenhlanzi ukuze kulungiswe izidlo ezishibhile. Kubantu abangakwazi ukudla inyama esesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo, lezi zinto kufanele zibe yingxenye ebalulekile yecebo labo lokudla okunempilo. Abaguli bangafaka ushukela namafutha ohlelweni lwabo lokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kudla kwandisa inani lamandla atholakalayo kokudla futhi kusiza ukwenza izidlo zibe mn
ITheku: Indaba Yomlando ITheku, idolobha elikhulu eliseNingizimu Afrika, linomlando ocebile ogcwele izigigaba eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Le ndawo, eyaziwa nangokuthi yiPort Natal, yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1824, lapho abaphangi bokuqala bevela eNgilandi befuna izindawo zokuhweba. Ngaphandle kokuba nebhishi elihle, le ndawo yathandwa kakhulu kubathengisi bezimpahla. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, iTheku yaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Abantu baseZulu, abavela ezindaweni eziseduzane, baqala ukuza kule ndawo, behlangana nabantu baseNgilandi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kobudlelwano obuhlukahlukene, kodwa futhi kwaba nemiphumela emibi, njengoba izimpi zokuqala zenzeka phakathi kwabantu bendawo nabaphangi. Ngonyaka ka-1835, iTheku yaba yindawo yokuhlala abantu abaningi, futhi kwavulwa izikhungo zokuhweba. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuhweba, ikakhulukazi kwezimpahla ezifana nezinkuni, izinkomo, nezinsiza zokwakha. Ngalesi sikhathi, iTheku yathola udumo, futhi abantu abaningi baqala ukuza kule ndawo ukuze bathole amathuba emisebenzi. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, iTheku yaba nesimo esibalulekile. Izikhali nezinsiza zathunyelwa kule ndawo, futhi yaba yindawo yokugcina izinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zokuhlala, izikole, nezibhedlela. ITheku yakhula ngokushesha, futhi abantu abaningi baphuma ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze baphile kule ndawo. Ngemuva kwempi, iTheku yathola ithuba lokwakha kabusha. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo zokuhlala, izikhungo zokuhweba, nezokuthutha zathuthukiswa. ITheku yaba indawo ebalulekile yokuhweba, futhi izikhungo zokuhweba zakhula. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuhamba kwabantu, kwenza iTheku yaba yindawo yokuhlangana kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ngesikhathi sokuhlupheka kwezezimali, iTheku yathola izinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukwanda kwezinga lokuhlupheka, nokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezanele kwaba yizinkinga ezinkulu. Kodwa, abantu baseThekwini baqhubeka bephikelela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokwakha imiphakathi eqinile. Namuhla, iTheku iyindawo ehlangene, ecebile ngamasiko nezilimi ezahlukene. Ibhishi leTheku, elaziwa kakhulu, lihlala linabantu abaningi, futhi izimakethe zikhangisa izivakashi ezivela emhlabeni wonke. ITheku iyikhaya labantu abaningi, futhi ibonisa ubuhle bokuhlangana kwezamasiko. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTheku ibonisa ukuthi nakuba izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Umoya wokubambisana, wokuhlanganyela, nokwakha umphakathi oqinile uhlala uqhakazile. ITheku, njengendawo, ibonisa ukuthi umhlaba ungaba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokuhweba, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngakho-ke, iTheku ayiyona nje idolobha, kodwa iyisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphile ngokuhlanganyela, futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Indaba yeTheku iyindaba yokuphila, yokubambisana, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. ITheku iyikhaya labantu, futhi izothokozisa izizukulwane ezizayo.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-Smart Meter kwa-Eskom Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elikhulu, lapho izinto zishintsha njalo, uSipho wayehlala emzini weMbali. Njengoba abahlali bezama ukuphila impilo engcono, uSipho ubona ukuthi ubunzima bokukhokha ugesi buyaqhubeka. EziNdlini zaku-Eskom, izinga lokusebenzisa ugesi lishintsha nsuku zonke, futhi lokho kudala ukuthi abantu babe nekhathazeka. Kodwa-ke, kwavela into ethokozisayo – i-smart meter. Njengoba uSipho ehamba ngebhasi eya emsebenzini, wathola izimemezelo ezivela ku-Eskom. "Sizoba nezinguquko ezinkulu!" kwakukhuluma khona. Ugesi othengiswa kumanje uyoba nezinga elisha, elizokwenza kube lula ukulawula nokukhokha. USipho wacabanga, “Kodwa lokhu kuzoba nesithunzi kanjani empilweni yami?” Ngemva kwesonto, uSipho wanikela ithuba lokufaka i-smart meter. Kulungile, wacabanga, “Noma yini eyenza impilo ingcono, ngiyavuma.” Wathola ithuba lokuhlangana ne-ekspert ka-Eskom, uNandi. “Lezi zinsiza zikhuluma nathi,” kusho uNandi, eyimfihlo ethokozisayo. “I-smart meter iyazazi izidingo zakho, iyakwazi ukukala ugesi osawusebenzisayo, futhi izokuthumela izaziso eziphathelene nezindleko.” U-Sipho waba nemibuzo eminingi. “Kanjani lokhu kuzokwenza ngithole ugesi ongcono?” U-Nandi wamchazela. “Ubani owaziyo, kungenzeka ukuthi uthole izaphulelo uma ungasebenzisi ugesi kakhulu ngezikhathi ezithile. Futhi uzokwazi ukulawula izindleko zakho ngokuqapha.” Njengoba uSipho efaka i-smart meter, wayezizwa efana nesisebenzi esisha esisebenzayo. Kwakuyindlela entsha yokuphila, futhi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuboniseni izinguquko ezizayo. Ngemva kwesonto, kamuva, uSipho waqala ukubona izinguquko. Kwakungenxa yokuthi i-smart meter yamthumela izaziso ezithile eziphathelene nokusetshenziswa kwakhe. Ngonyaka, wathola izaziso ezazimnceda ukuthi ahlale eqaphile. “Ngiyakwazi ukugcina ukusetshenziswa kwami phansi!” washaya izandla, ecabanga ngezindleko ezizokhula. Ngenkathi edlula ezinsukwini ezithile, uSipho waqala ukwakha imikhuba emisha. Wathola ukuthi ugesi obhujiswe ezinsukwini ezithile wawukhona kuphela uma efaka izinto ezithile. Waze wathola isikhathi esithile sokuhlola izinsiza zomndeni, okwenza abanye abahlali bakhe balandele isibonelo sakhe. “Ngabe lezi zinsiza zisebenza kangcono? Ngabe kungenzeka sithole izaphulelo?” babuza, begcizelela imiphumela emihle. Ngesikhathi umoya uthokozisa abantu, uSipho waba necebo. Waqala ukuthuthukisa imikhuba yokuphila, esebenzisa ugesi ngempumelelo. Kwakukhona izinsuku lapho umndeni wakhe ubona ukwehla kwezindleko. “Siyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko zethu,” kusho unina, ekhuluma ngokujabula. U-Sipho wayejabule kakhulu, njengoba i-smart meter yenza kube lula kubo bonke. Kodwa-ke, kwavela izinselelo. Abanye abantu baphikisa ukuthi i-smart meter ibiza kakhulu. “Siyidinga yini le teknoloji? Kukhona okufanele sikwenze,” kusho uMnumzane Ndlovu, owabe engumakhelwane kaSipho. “Kodwa ubani owaziyo? U-Sipho uveza impumelelo,” waphendula uNandi, eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye. Ngemva kwesikhashana, uSipho waphinde wathola ithuba lokuba nezingxoxo eziningi ne-Eskom. Wabona ukuthi i-smart meter yayihamba phambili, yenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi i-smart meter ibalulekile empilweni yabo. U-Sipho waba nesithakazelo sokuphakamisa umqondo wokwakha imikhuba emisha, futhi abanye baqala ukwamukela lokho. Ngaphakathi kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi ugesi ungcono kakhulu. “Ngifuna ukuba nesigaba esiphakeme,” wathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, uNandi wanikela ithuba lokubona ukuthuthukiswa. “Uyazi, umphakathi uthuthuka uma sisesha izixazululo,” echaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-smart meter yayiyinsiza enkulu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, futhi abantu baqala ukuya phambili. Kwaphela isikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi i-smart meter yayiyinsiza yokugcina ugesi, futhi izindleko zaphinde zancipha. U-Sipho wathola impumelelo, futhi umndeni wakhe waba nenhlalakahle. Njengoba kade kwenzeka, uSipho waqonda ukuthi i-smart meter yayiyindlela yokuphila engcono. Kwakuwukubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke, futhi abahlali baphakathi kwendawo yanamuhla bazitholele izinzuzo. “Ngempela, sizoqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela zokuphila,” wathi. Ekugcineni, uSipho waba yisibonelo somphakathi. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ukufaka i-smart meter kwa-Eskom kwakuwukwazisa impilo yakhe nezikhalazo zomphakathi. Kwasiza abantu baqonde ukuthi ugesi ungasebenza kahle uma besebenzisa izinsiza zethu kahle. “Siyakwazi ukwenza kahle,” wathi, ngesikhathi umphakathi waphuma phambili, ubukhumbula izinsuku zokuqala, lapho bekwazi ukukhipha izinsiza zokuphila. Kwakuyinsuku ejabulisayo, futhi uSipho waqonda ukuthi izinguquko zikhona, zikhulisa ikusasa. “Ngiyabonga, Eskom!” wathi, ephakamisa umoya ophakeme. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwakuwumsebenzi omuhle, futhi uSipho wagubha impumelelo yabo bonke.
Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi ziwumgogodla obalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi ophephile. Lezi zinkundla zifaka phakathi izinhlelo, imithetho, nezinsizakalo ezihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezihlanganisiwe. 1. Ukuqonda Izinkundla Zokuphepha Komphakathi Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zifaka phakathi izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene ezifana nezokuphepha, ezokwelapha, ezemfundo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lezi zinsizakalo zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baphila ezindaweni eziphephile, futhi banokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga ukuvikeleka, ukwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, nokuba neqhaza elihle emphakathini. 2. Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha Izinsizakalo zokuphepha, ezifana namaphoyisa, zibalulekile ekulawuleni ubugebengu nokuvikela abantu. Amaphoyisa ahlinzeka ngokuqapha, uphiko lokuhlola, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo uma kwenzeka izimo eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa asebenza ngokubambisana nemiphakathi ukuze akhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu. 3. Ukuvikelwa Kwezimali Ukuze izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenze kahle, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimali ezivela kuhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi uqobo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zikhona, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abeke izabelomali ezanele ezinkundleni zokuphepha. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela umphakathi. 4. Ukuqwashisa Nokuqeqesha Umphakathi Ukuqwashisa komphakathi kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani. Izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezokuphepha, izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zidingeka ukuze umphakathi uqonde kahle izinkundla zokuphepha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abantu ukuthi bangabika kanjani ubugebengu, izindlela zokuzivikela, kanye nokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani ezinsizakalweni uma kudingeka. 5. Ubudlelwano Phakathi Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha Nezokwelapha Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izimo eziphuthumayo, ezifana nezingozi noma izigameko, zidinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo, izinkundla zokuphepha kufanele zibe neqhaza eliqinile ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo. 6. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi Izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zidinga ukubambisana nezikhungo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu banokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa, ezokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulezi zinsizakalo. 7. Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziywa Kwezinkundla Zokuphepha Ukuze izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlole nokuhlaziya ukusebenza kwazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinga lokuphepha, ukubika ubugebengu, kanye nokuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlola lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuvikela umphakathi. 8. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi zisebenza kahle, zikhona izinkinga ezithile ezibhekene nazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabantu, kanye nezimo zomnotho ezinzima. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo, kanye nomphakathi baphendule ngokubambisana. 9. Ukubheka Ikusasa Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokubheka ikusasa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuvikela umphakathi. Ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke uphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkundla zokuphepha zihlale zikhona, zisebenza kahle, futhi zihlale ziqhubeka zithuthukiswa. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwezinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukuze lezi zinkundla zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele. Ngokuqonda izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuqwashisa komphakathi, nokuhlola ukusebenza, umphakathi ungakwazi ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ubugebengu, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila ezindaweni eziphephile.
Ukusabela kwenqubomgomo enhlekeleleni yomlilo yaseMarshalltown Isingeniso Kunoma yisiphi isimo esiphuthumayo, okufana nenhlekelele yomlilo, kubalulekile ukuba nenqubomgomo esebenza kahle yokusabela. Lesi sicelo sihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemiyalelo ecacile yokusabela kule nhlekelele, kuhlonishwa izinqubo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu, ukuvikela impahla, kanye nokugcina imiphakathi iphephile. Isinyathelo 1: Ukusungula Ithimba Lokuphendula 1.1. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungeze uhlu lwamalungu eHhovisi Lokuphendula Ngezimo Eziphuthumayo (EMT) olubandakanya: - Abaphathi bezokuphepha - Izikhulu zendawo - Umenzi wezinhlelo zokuphatha izinhlekelele 1.2. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amalungu ethu azi izindima zabo nezikimu ezifanele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuqonda Izimpawu Zomlilo 2.1. Bheka izimpawu ezitholakala emlilweni: - Umoya opholile ngcono - Ukushisa okuphakeme - Ukukhanya okubomvu noma okubhalayo 2.2. Cela imiphakathi ukuba ibike noma yiziphi izimpawu zomlilo ezitholakala. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlonza Izingosi Zokuphuma 3.1. Nquma izindlela zokuphuma ezivamile nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banokuqonda kahle lezi zingosi. 3.2. Bophela izingosi zokuphuma ngezimpawu ezicacile nezibukwayo ukuze zivumelekalwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukunyakaza Nobuhlakani Benhlangano 4.1. Thumela umlayezo ngemiphumela emnene kumphakathi, kutheknoloji yokuxhumana njenge: - Izikhangiso zomsakazo - Izinkundla zokuxhumana - Imiyalezo ye-SMS 4.2. Nxusa abantu ukuthi balandele izixwayiso zamaphoyisa nezokuphepha. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphuma Kokuthola Usizo 5.1. Khumbula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokucela usizo: - Ukuphanda izinsiza zomlilo - Uhlelo lokucela usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo 5.2. Ukugcina aphephile izinsiza zomlilo nezokusebenza. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuhlola Ukuphendula 6.1. Phindelela nokuqhuba izivivinyo eziphuthumayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle izinqubo. 6.2. Thola imiphumela nezibuyekezo ngokuphuma komlilo ukuze uthuthukise ukuthuthukiswa. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuqeqesha Umphakathi 7.1. Qhuba izifundo zokuphendula mazenze zibe lula kubantu: - Uhlaka lokuqeqesha oluhlelwe kahle - Imivuzo yokubamba iqhaza 7.2. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ithola isikhathi esanele sokuzilungiselela. Isinyathelo 8: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinqubomgomo 8.1. Bheka izinqubomgomo ezihleliwe ngesikhathi, nokuthi zisebenza kangakanani empilweni yangempela. 8.2. Thola iziphakamiso nezinguquko ezingase zidingeke. Isiphetho Ukusabela kahle enhlalweni yomlilo yaseMarshalltown kudinga ukuxhumana, ukuqeqesha, nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Izinyathelo ezilandelwayo zizokwenza umehluko omkhulu ekuphenduleni okufanele ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana nomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zokuhlola kuzokwenza sikwazi ukulawula nokuphepha kahle. Sifuna ukuqhubeka nokuhlola nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zethu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi siyaphumelela ukuze sikhulule abantu bethu ezinsizakalweni eziphuthumayo.
Izinsizakalo Zokusekela Abantu Abakhubazekile Izinsizakalo zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile zithinta zonke izici zokuphila kwabantu, kusukela ezimfundisweni kuya ezempilo, emsebenzini, nasemiphakathini. Ukunikeza lezi zinsizakalo kubalulekile ukusiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuthi baphile impilo eqhakazile, baze bazitholele amathuba afana nalawo abanye abantu abanawo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izindlela zokuqonda, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza eziziyo neziphephile. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphazamiseka kungenzeka kubonakale ngezinhlobo eziningi, ezinjengokukhubazeka komzimba, ukukhubazeka kwengqondo, noma ukungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yezimo ezithile. Ukuze imiphakathi ibeyisikhala esikhuthazayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinsizakalo ezisekela nezichazayo ezisiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba bazuze amandla abo aphelele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezintweni ezisemqoka ezifana nezokuthutha, izindlu, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo. Ngokwengxenye, izinsizakalo ezikhona zifaka phakathi izifundo ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza zezempilo. Izifundo ezikhethekile zenzelwe ukusiza abafundi abakhubazekile ukuba bathole imfundo efanele, okuhloswe ngayo ukuqinisa amakhono abo futhi kubavumele ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo. Uhlelo lokusebenza luhlinzeka ngendaba yokusebenza, lapho abantu abakhubazekile bangathola khona ithuba lokusebenza, bese bethola izinkokhelo ezivumelana nezinga lakho lokusebenza. Lokhu kuwenza abantu abakhubazekile bazizwe bebalulekile emphakathini futhi kubavumela ukuba babe ngabaholi emikhakheni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza zezempilo zibalulekile ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuhlala bephilile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufinyelela kokwelashwa, imitholampilo ethile, kanye nezinsizakalo zamakhaya ezinquma izidingo zabo. Izinsizakalo zokwelapha zifaka phakathi ukwelashwa komzimba, ukwelashwa kwengqondo, kanye nezinsiza zokuqeqesha ukuze abantu abakhubazekile babe namakhono athile. Ukuvikeleka kwempilo kuhambisana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokukhuthaza impilo, okukhuthaza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ukwenzenjani, imiphakathi kufanele ibambisane ukuze kube nokwakha izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile. Lokhu kuhilela abaholi bendawo, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinkampani ezizimele, ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, imiphakathi ingaqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile zicutshwa, zihlala zikhuthazwa, futhi zisebenza kulezi zinsuku. Phakathi kwemizamo yokwakha umhlaba ophilayo, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibe nokuzimisela ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo ezikhona. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubafundi, ukuphakamisa izinhlelo ezisekela abantu abakhubazekile, kanye nokugcina izikhungo zemfundo zithokozisa okubameleke. Ukulawulwa kwezimali nokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe kumele kube yinto evamile ukuze izinsizakalo ziqinisekiswe ukuthi ziyavuma futhi zikhuthazekile. Ngenkathi imiphakathi iphila uhambo lokwakha izinsizakalo ezinhle zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile, isu elihlakaniphile kumele lifakwe ekwenzeni abantu baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Ukuhlola izidingo zomphakathi, ukubona izindlela zokwenza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bubalulekile ukuze imiphakathi iqhubeke ibhekisela ukuphila kwabantu abakhubazekile. Abantu abakhubazekile bafanelwe ithuba lokuvuma ngezimpilo zabo, futhi kuphela uma sithumela izinsizakalo ezikahle, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi owahloniphekile, ophumelelayo, nolungisa lezi zifiso. Ngokwenhlonipho, izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, ezikhona, nezicacile kumele ziqhubekezelwe phambili. Iqoqo lezi zinsizakalo kuncike ekubeni abakhubazekile yabo balandele kahle izifiso zabo, bezama ukwaba isizotha, iqhubeke ukuze bazuze izinzuzo ezinzulu, bagqugquzele imiphakathi enesithunzi, namatshanelo okuphilayo. Ekugcineni, izinsizakalo zokusekela abantu abakhubazekile ziyisibusiso esibanzi esithinta bonke. Abantu baphila phansi kwezimo ezahlukene, kanti imiphakathi isebenza emandleni ukuze ibabhekelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa lezi zinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala benempilo, bethola izinzuzo ezivamile, futhi baphinde bazitholele ithuba lokuphila impilo ezigcwele izimfanelo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukubona umphakathi obumbene, ophumelelayo, nolungisa zonke izimpilo, kanti kuzokwandisa ithemba, ukholo, kanye nemfundo.
Ukuhlola Ukuqhubeka KweNational Development Plan I-National Development Plan (NDP) iyisicwangciso esibhekene nokuthuthukiswa kwezwe eNingizimu Afrika. Le mhlahlandlela ibalulekile ngoba iqukethe izinyathelo ezidingekayo nezinsiza ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimpilo, izinto zokwakha, kanye nomnotho. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuqhubeka kwe-NDP, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinyathelo ezithathwayo, ukubaluleka kwazo, kanye nemiphumela ethintekayo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. 1. Umongo weNational Development Plan I-NDP yasungulwa ngo-2012 ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuhlola, ukunciphisa ububha, kanye nokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Iqukethe izinhloso eziphakeme ezizoba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, ihlanganiswe nezinhlelo ezithile ezikhula ngonyaka, ukuze abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lempilo, imfundo, nezinye izinsiza ezibalulekile. 2. Ukuqhubeka kweNDP Ukuhlola ukuhamba kwe-NDP kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhloso zifanele izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubhekisela ekutholeni ukuthi izinhlelo ziwuvuma kanjani umoya wokuphila kwabantu, zifinyelela izifiso zabo. Nokho, kunezihibe nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusebenza kwayo, okubandakanya: - Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabaholi: I-NDP idinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kombuso, uhulumeni bezifunda, nezimboni. Ukuxhumana okuhle kwenza kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. - Ukwesekwa kwezimali: Izinsizakusebenza ezidingekayo ukuze izinhlelo ziqhube kahle zidinga ukuxhaswa ngemali. Uma uhulumeni engahlinzeka ngoxhaso oluthile, amaphrojekthi angase angaphumeleli. - Izikhala emsebenzini: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uyakhula, abantu kufanele babe namathuba okusebenza. 3. Izinselelo Nezinye Izingozi Isikhathi sokuphumelela kwe-NDP siphinde sibe nezinselelo ezinkulu ezihlobene nezimo zomnotho, izinkinga zezenhlalo, nezinguquko zomhlaba. Lezi zinkinga zifaka phakathi: - Ubulungisa bendawo: Kunezindawo ezithile lapho ukuqhubeka kwe-NDP ungase kubonise izinkinga ngokungalingani, okwenza kube nzima ukusungula izinhlelo ezifanayo. - Ukwenyuka kokungasebenzi: Inkinga yokungasebenzi ihlala iholela ekuhluphekeni kwabantu, futhi umnotho odinge ukuncintisana uvame ukukhokhelwa kakhulu laba abangenamsebenzi. - Izinguquko zezimo zezulu: Izimo zezulu ziba nomthelela omkhulu emashumini eminyaka ekufezekiseni izinhlelo zokuthuthuka. 4. Ubufakazi Bokuphumelela Kuhlolwe ukuthi i-NDP isithinta kanjani izimpilo zabantu. Bakhona ubufakazi bokuthi imiphumela ethile iyakhula, njengokwanda kwemfundo, ukuthuthukiswa kwamathuba emisebenzi, nemikhankaso yokunciphisa ububha. Lokhu kuvezwe kumaphuzu athile: - Izinga Lemfundo: I-NDP ithuthukisa izinga lemfundo, abantu baphakanyiswa ukuba bafunde, futhi inhlangano yezemfundo ikhulisa ukubhekelwa kwengqondo. - Izinsiza Zokwelapha: Ukuphuculwa kwezinsiza zomtholampilo nezokwelapha kungenye yezinto ezithonya kakhulu abantu, uhlelo lwe-NDP lwenza kube lula ukuthola imithombo yokwelapha. - Ukwanda kwezinsiza zezimali: Uhlelo lwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza zezimali ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuxhasa amabhizinisi abo, lokho kuholela ekwakheni amathuba okusebenza. 5. Iqhinga Elizayo Kubhalwe ukuthi ukuqhubeka kwe-NDP kumele kuhlale kuhambisana nezidingo zabantu abahluphekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zibe nengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo. Abantu kufanele baveze imibono yabo ukuze kuhlonishwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izithiyo ziyazizwa. Ukukhuthazwa kokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, nezinhlangano nongoti kuyinselelo eqhubekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukulinganiselwa, ukugxila ekuphuculeni imiphumela kuyoba ngesinye sezindlela ezihamba phambili. Ngokufingqa, ukuhlola ukuqhubeka kweNational Development Plan kudinga ukucabangela izinzuzo, izinselelo, nokusebenza kwesikhumbuzo kulabo abathintwayo kanye nezenzakalo zomnotho. Ukuze kufezwe izinjongo zezeNhlangano, sinesibopho sokulandelela izinto ezenzekayo futhi sihlole izindlela ezitholakala ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.
Kwakhiwa umhlahlandlela ukuze kuthuthukiswe amandla omnotho abantu abamnyama; ukuze kuqinisekiswe uNgqongqoshe ukuthi akhiphe imithetho futhi ahlukanise uhlaka lokuguqulwa; ukuze kwakhiwe ikomidi leNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama; nokulungiselela izindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. UKUZE kuthuthukiswe ukwenzeka kwesithakazelo somthethosisekelo sokulingana, ukuze kukhuphuke ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abamnyama emnothweni futhi kukhuthazwe ukukhula okukhulu komnotho, ukuze kwandiswe amathuba emisebenzi nokwabiwa okufanelekile kwemiholo. "ukukhuluma" kubhekisela kulokho okukhulunywa umthetho ophakanyisiwe; futhi lo Mthetho uhlanganisa imithetho noma izinhlinzeko zomthetho ezikhishwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uxhasa izinhlelo ezizoholela ekwandeni kokubamba iqhaza komnotho kwabantu abamnyama ukuze kufezwe ukuthuthukiswa nentuthuko; futhi ukuthi imiphakathi yasemaphandleni ithuthukiswe futhi imiphakathi yasendaweni ikwazi ukufinyelela emisebenzini yezomnotho, umhlaba, izinsiza, ubunikazi, nezakhono. a ngendlela ehambisana nezinhloso zayo eziyisisekelo; futhi b ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo. Ikomidi leNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama liyakhiwa. Ikomidi kumele linikeze uNgqongqoshe izeluleko mayelana namandla omnotho abantu abamnyama. Ikomidi lizoba neMongameli namalungu amanye ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo leKomidi. IMongameli izoba ngumholi weKomidi. Ikomidi ngokwalo lingakha emthethweni walo izimo zokubekwa kwezikhala zamalungu alo, inani lamalungu emhlanganweni, izinqubo, nezinye izindaba ezithinta umyalo walo wokusebenza. UNgqongqoshe, ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali, angakwazi ukuhlela izimali zokuhlawula izindleko ezithathwe amalungu eKomidi. e iziqondiso zezakhamuzi zonke nezindawo ezithintekayo ukuze zibhale izinhlelo zokuguqulwa zalolo suku. a isungula inqubo yokukhetha lapho izimvume zikhishwa, noma yisiphi esinye isikhungo esenziwe ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umthetho; futhi b ithuthukisa futhi iqhube izinqumo zokukhetha lapho kuqashwa. IPhalamende lezeMali nezeMisebenzi kumele linikeze iKomidi usizo oludingekayo nokuxhaswa kwezimali okwenziwe nguPhalamende ngenhloso le. a ukusungula nokusebenza kweKomidi; futhi b ukuthuthukisa nokuphumeza uhlelo lokwazisa umphakathi. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe imithetho ethile mayelana nanoma yini okufanele ayinqume ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwenziwa kahle kwalolu Mthetho. Lo Mthetho uzobizwa ngokuthi iBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act ka-2003, futhi uzongena esikhathini ngosuku oluzokwenziwa nguMongameli ngokuqhamuka kokukhishwa kweGazethi. Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika awukwazi ukusebenza ngokuphelele ngoba iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lithola imiholo ephansi futhi lisabhekwa ngaphandle kokuba ngabanikazi bezimpahla ezinzima nezakhono. Lokhu kubangela umonakalo kuwo wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika emnothweni. Umthetho ophakanyisiwe weNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama (okubizwa ngokuthi "umthetho ophakanyisiwe" lapha) ungomunye wemisebenzi ethathwe nguHulumeni ukuze ubhekane nalolu daba. IKomidi Lezeluleko leNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama (okubizwa ngokuthi "ikomi" lapha) iyisiphakamiso somzamo wokweluleka. Usizo nokuxhaswa kuzohlinzekwa yiMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (okubizwa ngokuthi "DTI" lapha) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugcina amabhizinisi abamnyama futhi aphathwe abantu abamnyama. ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphakathi yasemaphandleni nezasekhaya. Kulindeleke ukuthi amalungu eKomidi awatholi ukukhokhelwa izindleko zawo futhi ukuthi ukusungulwa nokusebenza kweKomidi kuzoxhaswa ngombono owenziwe kwiMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (DTI). Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi i-GCIS (Uhlelo Lokuxhumana Nokwazisa KweHulumeni) kanye ne-DTI kuthuthukiswe uhlelo oluphelele mayelana namandla omnotho abantu abamnyama jikelele nalolu mthetho ophakanyisiwe ikakhulukazi.
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Ukuphila kahle komuntu kusekelwa ngempela ezimpilweni zokwelashwa ezitholakala ezikhungweni zezempilo. Lezi zikhungo, ezilungiselelwe ukuletha izinsizakalo ezisemthethweni zezempilo, zinikeza izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuphila, zokwelashwa, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhasa imiphakathi. Ukuze kuqondwe kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda izindawo ezingama-72 zezikhungo zezempilo zentela eNingizimu Afrika. Isigaba sokuqala: Ukuhamba kwezimali nezichasiso Ezikhungweni zezempilo, izikhungo ezasolwandle nezisemkhatsini kwazulu, kukhona indawo yomphakathi ehambisana namathuba okwelapha. Lokhu akukhona nje ukufaka izinga eliphakeme lokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kodwa futhi kubangela uhla lwezikhungo ezithuthukayo ezikhethwe ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho, ukusungulwa kwezakhamuzi nezenzo ezigxile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele kucatshangelwa njengomqondisi. Isigaba sesibili: Izindawo nezinsiza Kunezikhungo eziningi, ezihlukahlukene zokwelapha, ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, ezinezinsiza ezihlukene. Lezi zikhungo zifaka phakathi izibhedlela, ama-clinic, nezikhungo zokuxhumana. Izibhedlela zihlala zihamba phambili ekunikezeni usizo lwezokwelapha oluphuthumayo, kuyilapho ama-clinic ewumgcinimafa kabusha ukusebenza okuncane, okuvame ukugxila ekunikezeni imiphumela emihle. Izikhungo zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukusondela ezinsizakalweni kubantu abaningana, zigcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana komphakathi. Isigaba sesithathu: Ukuphathwa kwezempilo Ukuphathwa kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika kudinga ukuba kudlule izigaba ezithile. Ukuze lezi zikhungo ukuze zisebenze kangcono, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nezizinda zomphakathi. Lesi sigaba senza ukuthi izikhungo zilethe izinsizakalo ezithile eziphumelelayo, zezehlise izindleko eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo. Isigaba sesine: Izinhlelo eziqhubekayo Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zolwazi nezokuthuthukisa zidingeka ukuze kulungiswe amalungelo ezempilo kubantu bonke. Izikhungo ezingama-72 zidinga ukugcina ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo nabantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bazi ngempela izinsiza ezitholakala kubo. Ukuxhumana okuthile, nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa, kulethe izibopho eziningi phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo nemiphakathi. Isigaba sesihlanu: Ubuchwepheshe obusha Ubuchwepheshe bukhula kashukela emkhakheni wezempilo, kubalulekile ukufaka izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezahlukene ezikhungweni. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ezokuxilongwa, kanye nezinsiza ze-inthanethi zidingeka ukuba zithuthukiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zingakwazi ukusiza abantu ngendlela ephumelelayo. Lezi zinhlelo zengeza ngendlela yokuthola ukwaziswa kusebenza kwempilo, okuholela ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokwelapha. Isigaba sesixhenxe: Ukuhlonishwa nokuphila kwabantu Ukuhlonishwa kwabantu kufanele kube okuyinhloko empilweni yezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele abe nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Ukuphila kwabantu kuncike ebubhalweni obuhle nezinhlelo zempilo ezikhethiwe. Izikhungo ezizwana nazo ziza nezinhlelo ezithile ezithuthukayo, ezihlosiwe ukuheha abantu ukuphila kahle, balandela izinqubo ezilungile. Isigaba sesishiyagalombili: Ukubheka phambili Uma sibheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ezikhethiwe zezeMpilo ezingama-72 ziqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa, zenzeka ngezindlela ezintsha. Imiphakathi kumele ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisha, lapho izimpumelelo ezifanele kufanele zibhale unyaka. Lokhu kuzothelela ukuhamba phambili kwezempilo ezindawo ezahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izifunda ezivuthayo, ngendlela yokwenza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kube khona nokuqhubekayo. Isiphetho Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zinemisebenzi ebalulekile yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo emiphakathini. Lezi zikhungo ziphikisana nenhloso yokuhlinganisa ukusebenza kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizokwazi ukuvikelwa ezindaweni ezikhethekile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nabantu, kuzobamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni imiphakathi enempilo. Kuhle ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi onzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okwemvelo, okuhloniphekile, nolungile.
Ingxenye -14 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ibeka ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, ilungu lomphakathi kumele libhale incwadi ethile enhlangano yomphakathi abakhona kuyo ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi. Le mfuneko ihlale iphansi kwemvume yokwandiswa kwesikhathi evela kuNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa nokushicilela le ncwadi kwiGazethi yoHulumeni. Ukushicilelwa kwale ncwadi kwiGazethi esemthethweni kunika amandla iziphakamiso ezitholakala kuNgxenye -14 kanye nokunika umuntu ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe yinhla yomphakathi efanele ukuze kufezwe noma kuvikelwe noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zabo. I-ICD iyingxenye yenhlangano ngaphansi komkhakha kaHulumeni. I-ICD iyisigaba sikaHulumeni sesifunda futhi ihlelwe ezingeni lesizwe nasezindaweni. Ezingeni lesizwe, umphakathi wayo nguMphathi Osebenzayo bese kuba noMphathi Wesifunda ezingeni lesifunda. Abaphathi bezifunda ze-ICD bathumela imibiko futhi baphathwa nguMphathi Osebenzayo. UMphathi Osebenzayo uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kulandela inqubo ethile eyenziwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokuxhumana neKomidi Lezomthetho. Ingxenye ethile yabasebenzi be-ICD yakhiwe ngamalungu aqokwe nguMphathi Osebenzayo ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho. Lokhu kwenzeka kulandela imithetho ephethe isevisi yomphakathi kanye nabantu abathile abathunyelwa kwezinye izigaba ngenhloso yokusiza noma ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwi-ICD. Umsebenzi oqala ngalokho okuchazwe umthetho (ngokwezimfuneko zeMthetho Wesevisi Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho No. 68 ka-1965) we-ICD ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokuziphatha okungafanele nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe amalungu eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) kanye neMuni Police Service (MPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangokprofessional. Lapha umthetho ubona kahle ukuthi uhlose ukunikeza i-ICD umthwalo nomsebenzi wokubheka umphakathi mayelana ne-SAPS njengoba kuchaziwe kuNgxenye -222 yeMthethosisekelo Wokushintsha ka-1993. Le ngxenye ibeka ukuthi "Kuzoba khona indlela ezimele, eyakhelwe futhi ephethwe ngokuqondile nguMthetho Wezomthetho ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokuziphatha okungafanele nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okukhuluma ngamalungu eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangokprofessional." a ngokuthanda kwabo noma ngemva kokuthola isikhalazo, bahlola noma yisiphi isenzo esingafanele noma ukuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe yilungu leNingizimu Afrika Police Service noma i-MPS. c bangahlola noma iyiphi indaba eyayiqondiswe kubo nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho noma ngaphakathi komkhandlu wesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma ngenhla, imisebenzi nemithwalo ye-ICD yanda kakhulu ngokuqhubeka kweMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwezakhamizi (DVA), ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 112 ka-1998). Lo mthetho uveza ukuthi uma ilungu leNingizimu Afrika Police Service lingahambisani nemithwalo echazwe kuMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwezakhamizi (DVA) noma iMiyalo Yezwe ekhishwe ngokomthetho (DVA), le nqubo ibhekwa njengokuziphatha okungafanele ngokokuchazwa kweMthetho we-SAPS. Ngakho-ke, i-ICD kumele ibhiyozwe ngalokhu okungahambi kahle okubikwe kwi-SAPS. Ukuqonda okuqondile kwalokhu kuhlelwe ukuthi i-ICD kumele isebenzise amandla nemisebenzi yayo ukuze ibheke umphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangokprofessional yi-SAPS. I-DVA iphinde ibeke ukuthi i-SAPS kumele ithathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene naliphi ilungu le-SAPS elisoliswa ngokungahambisani nemithwalo ephethwe yi-DVA, ngaphandle uma i-ICD inquma okuphambene ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuchaza kwalokhu kuhlelwe ukuthi i-ICD kumele ithathe umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze iphumeze izikhalazo ezicela ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene namalungu e-SAPS. Ngokwenza lokhu, i-ICD iqhuba umsebenzi wokwenza ukuthi izinyathelo zokulungisa zingagwenywa yi-SAPS ezimweni lapho kubalulekile ukuthatha lezo zinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa. a I-ICD ayingxenye futhi ayihlangene noMnyango WezeMthetho, ihlale izimele, icacile ingxenye yenhlangano yesikhungo somphakathi nakuba ixhunyiwe kumNgqongqoshe oyedwa - uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho - kanye ne-SAPS. b I-ICD inendawo yayo yokubalwa kwezimali evela kuMphathi Osebenzayo kanye nebajethi yonyaka ehambisana nayo. Le bajethi inefund ehlukile ehlukaniswe nguMthetho. Abasebenzi be-ICD bachaza futhi bahlanganisa bonke abaphethe isikhundla esichazwe ngenhla. Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi agcinwe yi-ICD kumele senziwe ngokubhalwe phansi lapho umfaki-sicelo egcwalisa Ifomu A, eyaziwa ngokuthi: "Isicelo Sokufinyelela Kumarekhodi Ezinhlangano Zomphakathi." a ehhovisi leMenenja Yolwazi enemininingwane yokuxhumana echazwe kuNgxenye 2.2 ngenhla; noma b ehhovisi le-ICD lesifunda elichazwe kuNgxenye 1.1 yale ncwadi. f Uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye, ubufakazi bokuthunyelwa komfaki-sicelo kumele bukhishwe ngendlela ejabulisa iMenenja Yolwazi. a Thumela noma udlulisele isicelo esibhaliwe kwiMenenja Yolwazi njengoba kuchaziwe kuNgxenye -2.2 yale ncwadi. Isicelo kumele sithunyelwe kule ndawo yeMenenja Yolwazi noma kunombolo ye-fax, noma ngabe ngqo kwi-imeyili; noma b Thumela isicelo ngqo ehhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze nemininingwane echazwe kuNgxenye -1.1 yale ncwadi. Kulokhu, ihhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze lizohlinzeka umfaki-sicelo ngerekhodi eqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sitholiwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD njengoba kuchaziwe kuNgxenye -4.1.2 kanye -4.1.2 yale ncwadi kodwa engakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yokungafundi noma ukungasebenzi, unelungelo lokwenza isicelo somlomo. a KuMenenja Yolwazi okhethwe; noma b KuMphathi Wesifunda noma ehhovisi lesifunda elikhethiwe lapho isicelo somlomo senziwa. I-Menenja Yolwazi izobhala isicelo somlomo futhi inikeze umfaki-sicelo kopi yalolo suku. Uma umfaki-sicelo efika kuMphathi Wesifunda okukhulunywe ngaye kuNgxenye -4.1.4(b) yale ncwadi, uMphathi Wesifunda ofanele uzobhala isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze umfaki-sicelo kopi yalolo suku. Uma umfaki-sicelo ezisa iMenenja Yolwazi noma uMphathi Wesifunda/umsebenzi okhethiwe ngenhloso yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD, le Menenja Yolwazi izohlinzeka ngaleyo
Isingeniso Iphalamende laseNingizimu Afrika libalulekile kwezombusazwe, elawula izinqubomgomo ezithinta bonke abahlali baleli. Ukuze siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi zalo msebenzi, kubalulekile ukuhlola indlela eliphatha ngayo izindaba zomphakathi, ukuhlanganiswa kwezwi labantu, nokuthi izinqubomgomo zikhula kanjani ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi. Umsebenzi wePhalamende Iphalamende linenhloso enkulu yokwazisa imithetho, ukuhlola izinqubomgomo zamasiko, kanye nokulawula uhulumeni. Lokhu kukhulisa ukuhamba phambili kwezinhlelo ezibhekene nezinkinga ezibalulekile ezifana nokungasebenzi, ubumpofu, nokwehla kwezinga lemfundo. Nakuba kunengxoxo ezindaweni eziningi, umphakathi ungenza ngezindlela ezahlukene ukuze ucele izinguquko abazifunayo. Izimvo Ezihlukahlukene KwaZulu, abanye baveza ukuthi iphalamende linomthelela omuhle ekwenzeni izinqubomgomo, kanti abanye bakhathazekile ngokuthi kudinga ukuphathwa kangcono. Ukuhlolwa kwezithangami zePhalamende kukhombisa ukuthi imithetho ethile iyathuthuka, kodwa abanye baveza ukukhathazeka ngokungabi nezibopho ezinqubweni ezithile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kumele kube neqhaza elikhulu lokusebenzisa izwi labantu ukuze bazwakalise izinkinga zabo. Ukubheka Izinhlelo Zokwakha Nezimpumelelo Iphalamende inendima yokwakha imiphakathi. Izinqubomgomo ezithile, njengokwakha izikhungo zemfundo, izibhedlela, nemigwaqo, ziye zakhula, kodwa zibhekene nezithiyo ezinjengokuphatha okungafanele. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha kuhlobene ngqo nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizokhilimuza, okuqinisekisa imiphakathi eqinile. Ukubambisana Kwamazinga Ahlukene Umsebenzi wePhalamende awupheli emnyangweni wombuso kuphela. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zikwazi ukuhamba phakathi kweQuantum nemiphakathi yendawo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuhwebelana kwabantu, okwenza kube nokuthola izinsiza ezingcono ezivela kubakhokheli. Ukushoda Kokuzwakala Kwezingxoxo Nakuba iPhalamende ibonakala iyisikhungo sokuphendula izinkinga zomphakathi, kukhona abanye abantu abangalutholi ithuba lokukhulumela izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekudumazekeni, okwenza umphakathi ungabi namandla okudlulisa imizwa yabo. Kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi izwi labo linomthelela kumaphuzu abucayi. Isimo Sezinqe Nokwesekwa Kwamalungu Amasha Ukuze iPhalamende ithuthukiswe, kubalulekile ukubandakanya amalungu amasha avela emiphakathini ehlukene. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abantu zidingeka ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi bangaba kanjani yingxenye yephalamende, okuhlanganisa ukusiza abantu ukuthi bazi ngezindlela zokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi. Ukuvuselelwa KweZinqubomgomo Kubhalwe ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezikhona zihlolwe njalo ukuze ziqhubeke zisesha izixazululo. Ukuvuselelwa kwezinqubomgomo kungaholela ekukhuleni kokuqonda ngempela kwezinkinga ezikhona, kudingeka ukuthi iPhalamende ibambisane namanye amalungu omphakathi. Isiphetho Ngaphandle kwezinto eziphikisanayo, iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika linendima ebalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Kubalulekile ukuqonda le ndima nokukhuthaza ubumbano phakathi kwemizamo yePhalamende nabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi sokushintsha, kubalulekile ukuqhubekisela phambili izwi lomphakathi ukuze bonke bazwe ukuthi isithombe sikhuluma ngempela. Iphalamende lingaba yindlela eqinile yokukhulisa iNingizimu Afrika ukuze ibhekane nezinkinga zomphakathi ezinzima.
Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ngokufana Nama-ATM Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle emzaneni omncane, uThulani, umphakathi ophilayo. Izikhungo zikhanya njengezinkanyezi, zithokozisa abantu abavakashela. UThulani wayeziqhenya ngalezi zikhungo, ngoba zazinikeza amandla okuphila, zenza kube lula ukuthola usizo. Ngempela, zifana nama-ATM, kodwa hhayi ezimali – zikhokha isidingo somphakathi. Ngomumo wempilo, uThulani wayehlale eduze kwalesi sikhungo esisha esavulwa. Kwakuwumsebenzi omkhulu owaqhamuka emphakathini, umphakathi wawudlula ngokuthokoza. Abantu behamba ngezinyawo, behamba besitshela izindaba zempilo zabo, bephuma ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene ukuze bavakashele lezi zikhungo. Izikhungo zaziphethe izinsiza eziningi, kusukela ezidingweni zansuku zonke kuze kube yizinsiza zokuzijabulisa. Ngenkathi uThulani efika esikhungweni, wathola abanye abantu bekhuluma. Kwakukhona uMmaNandi, uMnumzane Zola, noNokuthula, bonke bejabulile. “Ngabe ubuyaphi, Thulani?” kubuza uMmaNandi, ehleka. UThulani waphendula, “Ngihamba nje, ngifuna ukuthola ulwazi olusha. Ngabe niyazi ukuthi lokhu kuyi-ATM yokwazisa?” UZola wagcizelela, “Yebo, lesi sikhungo sinesikhumbuzo esihle. Sengivele ngithola usizo lokuqonda kahle izimfuno zempilo.” Lokhu kwavusa inhliziyo kaThulani, wabona ukuthi lokhu akukhona nje ukuhamba-hamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhulisa ukuqonda kwezakhamizi. Njengoba baphuma emnyango wesikhungo, uThulani wabona uMfundisi uDlamini engena. UMfundisi uDlamini wayeyisikhumbuzo esivela eminyakeni edlule, ethokozisa umphakathi ngezifundo eziphusile. “Sanibonani, bantwana!” esho. “Ngiyafuna ukusungula isifundo sokuhlobisa umphakathi, okufanele kube yinsiza yokukhulisa ukuqonda kwabantu ngezinsiza zethu.” Abantu baphendula bebona uthando olukhulu emfundisweni kaMfundisi uDlamini. “Ngabe sizofunda kanjani?” kubuza uNokuthula. “Sizokwenza izifundo ezimfishane, sonke sibe yingxenye yokuhamba phambili,” kuphendula uDlamini. UThulani, obonisa ukujabulisa, waphawula, “Kuhle, sizokwazi ukudlula imikhawulo yokufunda, sizothola indlela yokukwazi ukuzithuthukisa.” Imibono yabo yayiqhakaza, futhi kuzwakale umoya ophusile ophuma ezikhungweni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imihlangano yokuqala yaqala. UThulani, uMmaNandi, noMnumzane Zola babeqhamuka nezinselele ezithile. Babendleleni yokwenza izinto zibe namandla. Izifundo zabavakashi zazihamba kahle, futhi imiphumela yazo ibonakala. Abantu baqala ukuzizwa bephila kahle, bejabulile. Lokhu kwakukhombisa ukuba izikhungo zifana nama-ATM, njengoba zithola imiphumela emihle. Kwathi kwashona ilanga, abantu babeyingxenye yephunga elijabulisayo. UThulani waphuma nabangane bakhe, behamba ngentshiseko. “Ngabe uyazi ukuthi sithola kanjani imiphumela emihle ebuhleni?” kubuza uZola. “Yebo, ngiyazi. Ukusebenza ndawonye kuyinsika yethu,” kuphendula uThulani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waqala ukukhula. Abantu babenokuthula, bejabule, bezwa ukuthi izikhungo zineqhaza elikhulu empilweni yabo. UThulani noNokuthula baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo ezinkulu zokwenza izikhungo zibe ngcono. “Sizokwenza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo,” kusho uThulani. Ngemva kokuhlangana nemiphakathi, kwaba nezinhlelo ezinkulu zokuqinisa izikhungo. Kwakukhona imihlangano yamasiko, izifundo zamasiko, nezinye izinhlelo ezikhuthazayo. UThulani noMmaNandi babengabaphathi abakhulu, bephumelela ekuphuculeni izikhungo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zakhula zaba yizikhumbuzo ezikhangayo, zidingeka emiphakathini. Zazikhanga abantu abaningi, futhi zonke izinsiza zathola izinhlonipho ezinkulu. UThulani wagcizelela: “Izikhungo zethu zifana nama-ATM, zidalula amandla okuphila.” Njengoba umphakathi uhlala uqhuba, izikhungo zaba yizikhumbuzo zamandla, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. UThulani noNokuthula baqhubeka nokubambisana, bejabulile ngezinguquko ezithokozisayo. Kwakungelula, kodwa imizamo yabo yayikhombisa ukusebenza okuhle. Izikhungo zaba yindawo yokuphila, okuqhakazile, futhi zaba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ngale ndlela, uThulani wathola ukuthi ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngendlela efana nama-ATM akukhona nje kuphela ukuphila, kodwa kusho ukuhamba phambili, ukuqhubeka, nokuba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Uthando, umoya wokubambisana, neqhaza lokuthuthukisa umphakathi kwenze lezi zikhungo zibe yindawo yokwazisa, yokwakha, nokuphila. Kwalokhu, uThulani waba ngumbhali wezindaba ezinhle, umholi wabantu, kanye nesibonelo sokusebenza ngempumelelo.
Inhloso yalolu cwaningo ukuqoqa imicabango nemibono evela kubalaleli nabasebenzi beMnyango Wezokuvikela (DOD) mayelana nezinguquko, ukwesekwa kokuthula, ukuhlukahluka, amandla, kanye nekhono lokuzilawula kweSikhungo Sezokuvikela SaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF)/DOD kanye nesidingo sokufunda ngesiNgisi. Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo izosisiza ukuhlaziya ukusebenza kahle kwezinguquko ezenzakalayo kuDOD futhi ilandele umthelela wezindlela zokusebenza ezibekwe ngemuva kocwaningo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uphendule ngokuqotho emibuzweni nasezimpahleni ezikwi-questionnaire. Lokhu akusikho ukuhlolwa, ngakho akukho mpendulo efanele noma engafanele. Umbono wakho uwumphendulo ofanele. I-Center for Impact Analysis izogcina ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe luyimfihlo. Uzohlala ungaziwa ngoba i-Center for Impact Analysis izohlaziya ulwazi oluqoqiwe ngokuhlanganyela okuhlobene neqembu ngalinye, isibonelo, abesifazane nabesilisa ngokwehlukana. Kulula ukugcwalisa le questionnaire ngoba imibuzo eminingi iphendulwa kalula ngokubeka inombolo efanele yempendulo ehambelana nawe noma ebonisa kahle umbono wakho. Uma uhlangabezana nanoma yiziphi izinkinga ekuqedeni le questionnaire, unganqikazi ukucela usizo kubasebenzi abanikwe amandla/ocwaningweni noma ubize inombolo yokuxhaswa e-Center for Impact Analysis ku-312 4788/8164788. Ingcebo/ifundo yesizwe iyingxenye ebalulekile noma umqondo owenza ubunikazi bayo. Ihlanganisa umlando wesizwe nendlela okukhuluma ngayo noma okulandela ngayo abanikazi bayo, amasiko, ubuciko, [ubuningi] nolimi, izinhlobo zokudla abazithokozisayo, umculo abawuthandayo, nokuthi bakha kanjani futhi bahlobisa izakhiwo zabo. Ukuhlanganiswa okunRich kwezingcebo ezahlukene kweNingizimu Afrika kwenza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahluke kwabanye abantu emhlabeni. Ingcebo yethu isihlukile kwabanye izizwe futhi isenza sibe nezimfanelo ezihlukile njengokufana nesikhumbuzo seprincess. Akukho ndawo enye lapho ubunikazi balo mzansi buhlangene kahle futhi bukhanyiswe kahle njengasemibhalweni yalesi sizwe - iflegi yesizwe, i-anthem yesizwe, kanye ne-emblem yesizwe. Wonke umuntu oseNingizimu Afrika, izingane, abadala, izikole, abasebenzi, abaqashi, izikhungo ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (NGOs), izikhungo zomphakathi (CBOs), kanye nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni bangakwazi ukwazi, ukuqonda, futhi bazigcine ngokwethula lezi zimpawu kanye nalokho okuqukethwe. UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi, kanye Nobuchwepheshe. Izimpawu zesizwe sethu yilezi zibonakalayo nezizwakalayo ezichaza ubunikazi besizwe. Izimpawu zesizwe zichazwe nguMthethosisekelo futhi ziqondwa njengokukhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kanye nokwakha isizwe. Ilungelo lokuvota linikezwa wonke umuntu omdala, uhlu lwabavoti lwesizwe olulodwa, ukhetho okuvamile, kanye nohulumeni owenziwe ngezikhungo ezahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa phambili, ukuphendula, nokucacisa. I-anthem yesizwe esiyilalelayo idlalwa noma iculetshwa emicimbini ebalulekile yesizwe futhi ifundiswa ezikoleni noma emicimbini yezemidlalo. I-emblem yesizwe ibonakala ezakhiweni zikahulumeni, emadokhumenti, nasezimotweni zikahulumeni, phakathi kokunye. Iflegi entsha yesizwe yaseNingizimu Afrika yaqala ukusetshenziswa ngoMgqibelo 27, 1994. Yamukelwa masinyane ngemuva kokuphuma kwemini/nokuphuma kokuhlwa njengoba isizwe esisha sikhula. Ukuklama nemibala ye-flag kuyisithombe semibala ebalulekile emlandweni weflegi yaseNingizimu Afrika, kusukela ezikhathini zakudala kuze kube manje. Imibala ebomvu, emhlophe, kanye ne-blue yavulwa kusenesikhathi emlandweni weflegi yaseNingizimu Afrika; kuyilapho imibala emnyama, eluhlaza, kanye negolide yaqala ukuvela eflegi yethu yesizwe ngekhulu le-19. Imibala emithathu yonke isanda kuba yinhle kakhulu eflejeni yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuphathelene nalokho le mibala imela, kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi umbala ngamunye ungaba nencazelo noma uchaze izinto ezahlukene kubantu abahlukene. Ngalesi sizathu, asizokhiphi umbala onguye owodwa incazelo ethile. Noma ubani ukhululekile ukuba ne-interpretation yabo yokuthi umbala othile umela noma umele ini. Lokhu kwavunyelwene ngesikhathi kuxoxwa ngovoti lwezikhulu ngonyaka ka-1994. Ukwakhiwa kwengxenye ephakathi kweflegi, eboniswe njenge "V," kuhlanganisa phakathi kweflegi, kuqhubeka njengomugqa oqondile ukuya emaphethelweni, kukhombisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene yaseNingizimu Afrika, ibamba indlela phambili ndawonye njengento eyodwa. Le mbono ixhumene nomqondo we-emblem yesizwe, ebizwa nge-!ke e:/xarra//ke, okuyilimi leKhoisan (/Xam San people), okusho "abantu abahlukahlukene bahlangana." Lokhu kuklama kweflegi kuhlukile kodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye iflegi. Iflegi yesizwe izoba nezingxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo ububanzi nezindandatho ezintathu; ingxenye ephakanyisiwe, umugqa obomvu phezulu, kanye nomugqa oluhlaza phansi, kanye ne-triangle emnyama lapho izokwenyuswa, kanye nemigqa ehlukanisa umugqa oluhlaza ozoba ingxenye eyodwa yesihlanu yobubanzi, nomhlanga oseduze nobomvu noluhlaza; kanye ne-triangle yegolide endaweni emnyama lapho izokwenyuswa; kanti ububanzi nokuphakama kuzoba ingxenye eyodwa yesithathu yobubanzi beflag. Iflegi kufanele ithathwe ngokuhlonipha. Akufanele idonswe emhlabathini noma kube nezinto ezifakwe kuyo. Iflegi iyafana nencwadi - ukusuka phezulu iye phansi nangakwesokunxele ukuya kwesokudla. Uma iboniswa ngokuhlanganyela, ukuhamba kufanele kube ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti umugqa obomvu uphakathi. Uma iflegi iboniswa ngokuvundlile, lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi isizwe sisesimweni esinzima noma sithwele kanzima. Uma iboniswa kahle, kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile nomugqa obomvu ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti ukuhamba kwayo kusemkhakheni. Uma iboniswa eduze noma ngemuva komkhulumeli, kufanele ibekwe ngakwesokudla kwalowo mkhulumeli. Ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli, uma iboniswa kumkhankaso, umkhankaso wayo kufanele ube phambi kwemikhankaso yezinye iflegi. Uma ibhujiswa eduze kwezinye iflegi noma nezinye iflegi, kufanele ibe ngakwesokudla. Kufanele futhi ibe ngakwesokudla uma iboniswa nezinye iflegi zezinye izizwe noma kwamanye amazwe (zonke kufanele zibe zilinganayo ngosayizi nokuphakama). I-Emblem Yesizwe noma i-Emblem Yombuso iyisithombe esiphakeme esibonakalayo. Thatha isikhashana ucabange ngezikhathi ezibalulekile empilweni yakho - ukuzalwa, umshado, ukufa, nezitifiketi zesikole, ipasipoti yakho, zonke lezi ziqashelwa ngokomthetho yi-Emblem Yombuso. I-denomination encane yemali inemfanekiso wale emblem ngakolunye uhlangothi. Uma ukude kwelinye izwe, ukubona le emblem ezakhiweni zezikhungo zokumisa kuyisithombe sasekhaya noma ungakabi ekhaya. I-Emblem Yombuso iyingxenye ebalulekile yeSeal Elikhulu, ngokwesiko ibhekwa njengophawu oluyinhloko lweMphakathi. Noma iyiphi idokhumenti enesiginesha ye-Emblem Yombuso inikezwa amandla aphelele, njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ivunyelwe nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika. Umqondo - oyingxenye yesigubhu esiluhlaza ngu: !ke e:/xarra //ke. ubhalwe ngolimi lweKhoisan futhi ukuhumusha okuqondile kusho: "abantu abahlukahlukene bahlangana." Kubiza isizwe ukuba sihlangane ngokubambisana nokuzithokozisa - Ukuhlangana ebuningini. I-tusk yephondo - iyisithombe sobuhlakani, amandla, nokuphila okungapheli. Ukuklama okungaphezulu - kuyisithombe esakhiwe ngama-tusks e-phondo - kuyisithombe sokwaneliseka, ukukhula, nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, kukhuthaza abantu nezici zokulima zomhlaba. Ukumelwa/umfanekiso wabantu - kuthathwe kumakhono eKhoisan - kuthathwe ezithombeni ezidumile ezifana neLinton stone - lokhu kuyisibonelo esiyinhloko samakhono ezitini zaseNingizimu Afrika, manje baphakanyiswa eMnyangweni WaseNingizimu Afrika - kuyisithombe sesiko sokubingelela nokuhlangana, kukhombisa: ukuhlanganiswa ebuningini. I-spear ne-shield - ziyizimpawu ezimbili ezimele ukuvikeleka nokuphatha - futhi zikhombisa imilenze eqinile yomkhosi. I-spear ne-shield ezibekwe phansi z
Ngokuvamile nangokwemvelo, intengo yezwe ihambisana namandla ale ndawo okukhulisa ukudla kwezolimo. Ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, abalimi basalandela umqondo wokuthi uma umhlabathi unomkhiqizo futhi ukh produce ukudla okuningi, sizokhokha intengo ethile. Ukukhuphuka nokwehla kwezinga lenzalo nakho kuneqhaza ngoba abalimi abaningi balima ngemali ebolekiwe. Ukungena kwemali yokwakha izindlu nezinye izinto epulazini nakho kubangela intengo yamapulazi ukuthi ishintshe. Ungangena ezivumelwaneni nabanye abalimi ukuze wabelane ngempahla. Inzuzo izotholakala ngemva kwesikhathi eside ngoba ihambisana nokukhuphuka kwentengo yezwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Inzuzo ezotholakala ngemva kwesikhathi eside ixhumene nenani lemikhiqizo engatholwa epulazini ethile, kodwa lokhu nakho kube nokuguquguquka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokuvamile, intengo yamapulazi ikhuphukile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi manje sekucacile ukuthi umhlaba onomkhiqizo ophumelelayo usezandleni zabantu abambalwa. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubalimi abasha abafuna ukungena kwezolimo ukuthola umhlaba wokulima masinyane futhi bakhokhe ngenzuzo engatholwa. Nokho, lokhu kuyahluka uma umhlaba ungatholwa ngephakheji (LRAD), noma uwedwa, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngenzalo ephansi (njengoba kwenzeka njengamanje ngohlelo olusha olwethulwe yiMnyango Wezokuphathwa Komhlaba olubizwa ngokuthi iProactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS)). Ukuqashwa komhlaba sekushintshile; kwakuwumkhuba wabalimi abasafufusa ukungena kwezolimo, kodwa manje sekuwumkhuba wabalimi bezomnotho ukuthola umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze bathuthukise ukulima kwabo. Sidinga ukucabanga kahle ngalokhu ngoba kukhona umhlaba omningi ezandleni zomphakathi wonke ongasebenzisa, futhi kukhona abalimi abanekhono abadinga umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze balime ngendlela ezokhipha inzuzo. Ukuqashwa kunika abalimi ithuba lokwandisa umsebenzi wabo kodwa akudingi imali eningi ehambisana nokuthenga nokuba nomhlaba. Khumbula: Kukhona izindlela zokungena kwezolimo ngaphandle kokuba umnikazi womhlaba; ungakwazi ukuqasha ipulazi, usebenzise umhlaba womphakathi, noma wabelane ngalowo mhlaba nabanye abalimi.
I-VAT, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-Value Added Tax - kufanele ubhalise? Eminyakeni emine edlule, sibhale kaningi ngalesi sihloko se-VAT. Kodwa manje sibona ukuthi abanye abalimi abambalwa baye babhalisela. Kuzosiza kanjani uma ngibhalisela? Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakathi, ngakho abalimi kufanele bazame zonke izindlela zokunciphisa lezo zindleko. Ukubhalisela i-VAT kuyindlela eyodwa yokunciphisa izindleko. I-VAT isetshenziswa ezintweni ezidingekayo zokulima - imbewu, amafutha, amakhemikhali, ukulungiswa kwemishini, nokugcinwa, njll. Lokhu kufinyelela ku-14% wezindleko. Uma ukhokha u-R4,000 ngehektare oyilima, kusho ukuthi ukhokha u-R560 kwi-VAT. Uma ubhalisiwe, uzokwazi ukukhipha le mali emuva ku-SARS. Okwamanje, le mali ingaphezu kokuthola abalimi abakwenza ngehektare. Uma ungabhaliswanga, ngeke ukwazi ukukhipha le profiti yokulima kwakho. Kungani abalimi bengafuni ukubhalisela? Isidingo sokuphatha amarekhodi wemali engenayo nezindleko singesinye sezizathu zokuthi abalimi ababhali ngoba besaba ukuthi i-SARS izokwazi ukuthi bangakanani abathola futhi izokwazi ukuhlola amarekhodi abo. Uma ungena kokubhaliswa njengebalimi bezomnotho, kubalulekile ukugcina amarekhodi amahle. Kufanele wazi ukuthi izindleko zakho ziyi ziphi, ukuthi iphrofiti yakho iyini, nokuthi le mali iya kuphi. Njalo, abalimi baphuma emtaxini, bephika ukuthi abatholi okuningi. Basebenza ngempesheni futhi akukho bufakazi obubhaliwe. Lokhu akuyona indlela efanele yokusebenza. Kukhona izizathu ezimbili. Okokuqala, kuphikisana nomthetho ukungahlinzeki i-SARS ngemininingwane yakho yezezimali. Okwesibili, ngeke ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana neb business yakho yokulima uma ungenayo amarekhodi akhombisa imininingwane yakho yezezimali. Khumbula ukuthi sihlala sisebenzisa izinsiza ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni, ngakho-ke kuwumthwalo wethu ukuhlinzeka ngezimali ezidingekayo. Asikwazi ukuphuma kulomtaxi kodwa siphinde sithole inzuzo kulokhu. Khumbula ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisa le mali yokuthola izimali zokwakha imigwaqo, izikole, izibhedlela, amaphoyisa, njll. Uma ungena kokubhaliswa njengebalimi bezomnotho, bhalisela i-VAT ne-Income Tax.
Isingeniso ku-YouTube I-YouTube iyinsiza yokwabelana ngemicabango, imifanekiso, nemisakazo yevidiyo emhlabeni jikelele. Le nsiza inikeza abantu ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yabo, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka indlela yokusebenzisa i-YouTube, kusukela ekuvuleni i-akhawunti kuze kube sekuthumeleni ividiyo yakho. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuvula i-Akhawunti Ukuze uqale, udinga ukuvula i-akhawunti ye-YouTube. Lokhu kungenziwa kalula uma unayo i-akhawunti ye-Google. Uma ungakayivuli, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Vakashela ku-www.google.com. 2. Chofoza ku “Bhalisela” bese ulandela imiyalelo yokwakha i-akhawunti. 3. Uma usuwakhe i-akhawunti, vakashela ku-www.youtube.com. 4. Chofoza ku “Ngena” bese ufaka imininingwane yakho ye-Google. Ngemuva kokungena, uzobona isikhangiso se-YouTube esikuvumela ukuba uqale ukuhlela, ukubuka, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubuka Ividiyo Ukubuka ividiyo ku-YouTube kulula. Ungakhetha ividiyo ethokozisayo ngokuyifaka esikhaleni sokusesha phezulu. Ungasebenzisa amagama angukhiye, noma ungakhetha kumavidiyo aphezulu noma kumachaneli owathandayo. Uma usuthole ividiyo, chofoza kuyo ukuze uqale ukuyibuka. Ungase futhi ulandele umkhondo wezithameli, ubuke izibuyekezo, noma ubonise imicabango yakho ngemuva kokubuka. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubhalisela Amachaneli Uma uthanda ividiyo ethile, ungabhalisela leyo chaneli ukuze uthole izibuyekezo ezivela kuyo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukwazi ukuhamba phambili nezinto ezintsha ezitholakala kumachaneli owathandayo. Ukuze ubhalisele, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Buka ividiyo ethokozisayo. 2. Chofoza ku “Bhalisela” phezulu kwesokudla. 3. Uma usubhalisile, uzothola izaziso uma kukhona okusha okukhishwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuthumela Ividiyo Uma unentshisekelo yokwabelana ngemicabango yakho, ungathumela ividiyo yakho. Ukuze uthumele ividiyo, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Qinisekisa ukuthi unayo ividiyo efanele. Lokhu kungaba yividiyo oyitholile, noma eyenziwe nguwe. 2. Vakashela ku-www.youtube.com bese ungene ngemvume. 3. Chofoza ku “Thumela” (Upload) phezulu kwesokudla. 4. Khetha ividiyo ofuna ukuyithumela. 5. Faka isihloko, incazelo, nezithombe ezihlobene nevidiyo yakho. 6. Khetha izilungiselelo zokubuka (umphakathi, ozimele, noma ozimele). 7. Chofoza ku “Thumela” ukuze uqedele inqubo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuphendula Nokuxhumana I-YouTube iyinsiza yokuxhumana. Ungaphendula kumavidiyo, ubonise imicabango yakho, noma uxhumane nabanye abantu. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokubhalela izimpendulo ezithile kumavidiyo, noma ngokuthumela imiyalezo kumachaneli. Ukuze uphendule: 1. Buka ividiyo. 2. Phakathi kokubuka, skrolela phansi ukuze uthole indawo yokubhala izimpendulo. 3. Faka imicabango yakho bese uchofoza ku “Thumela”. Isinyathelo 6: Ukusebenzisa Izici Zokuhlola I-YouTube inezici eziningi ezithokozisayo, ezifana nezibalo zokubuka, izibuyekezo, nezithombe ezihlobene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imisebenzi yakho. Ukuze ubone izibalo zakho: 1. Ngena ku-akhawunti yakho. 2. Chofoza ku “Studio” ukuze uvule i-YouTube Studio. 3. Bheka izibalo ezitholakalayo, ezifana nezibalo zokubuka, izimpendulo, nezithombe ezithokozisayo. Isiphetho I-YouTube iyinsiza enamandla yokwabelana ngemicabango, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuvula i-akhawunti, ukubuka, ukuthumela, nokuxhumana nabanye. Qhubeka uhlola, ufunde, futhi wabelane ngemicabango yakho. I-YouTube iyinsiza ethokozisayo, futhi ungaba yingxenye yayo. Hamba phambili, ube nesikhathi esihle!
Imiphumela Yezivivinyo: Ukukhanya Nokuqhubeka Kwezemfundo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izivivinyo zibe yisigaba esibalulekile empilweni yabafundi, zikhombisa imizamo yabo, ubuhlakani, kanye nezinselelo abahlangabezana nazo. Ngalesi sikhathi, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibikade ibhekwa ngamehlo abukhali, njengoba abafundi, abazali, kanye nothisha bekulindele ukwazi ukuthi imizamo yabo ibiyimpumelelo noma cha. Ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe uMnyango Wezemfundo, imiphumela yezivivinyo zonyaka ibonisa ukuthuthuka okukhulu emiphumeleni yabafundi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngempumelelo yokuthuthukisa izinga lemfundo ezikoleni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izifundo, olwakhiwe ngonyaka odlule, luthole impendulo enhle, njengoba abafundi abaningi bephumelele kakhulu. UJohn Mthembu, umphakathi wesikole esiphakeme eMgungundlovu, uthe: “Siyajabula kakhulu ngale miphumela. Abafundi bethu benze kahle, futhi lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imizamo yethu yokuthuthukisa izifundo ibiyimpumelelo.” UJohn uthe, izifundo ezithuthukisiwe, ezihlanganisa izifundo ezikhethekile, zibe nomthelela omkhulu ekwandiseni ulwazi lwabafundi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi kunezindawo ezidinga ukunakwa. Ezinye izikole zikhombisa izinga eliphansi lokuphumelela, okukhombisa ukuthi kusekhona izinselelo ezithile. UProf. Thandiwe Nkosi, umeluleki wezokufunda, uthe: “Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze sithuthukise izikole ezikhombisa izinga eliphansi. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, kanye nohulumeni.” Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izikole eziphansi luhloswe ukusiza abafundi abaneziqhamo eziphansi, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa othisha ngezindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa ukuthi abafundi abaningi baphumelele emathubeni okuthola izifundo eziphakeme. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imfundo iyindlela ebalulekile yokuphumelela empilweni. UThandiwe, umfundi ophumelele, uthe: “Ngiyajabula kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngiqhubeke nokufunda, ngifuna ukufinyelela emaphusheni ami.” Uhlanga lwezivivinyo luhlinzeka ngenkundla yokuhlola imiphumela, kodwa futhi luhlinzeka ngethuba lokubheka izindlela zokuthuthukisa imfundo. Uhlelo lokubuyekeza imiphumela luzosiza ekutholeni izifundo ezitholakala ezivivinyweni, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokufunda. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphumela yezivivinyo izoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi imfundo iyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Abafundi, abazali, nothisha badinga ukuhlanganisa imizamo yabo ukuze bakhe umphakathi onempumelelo. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa imfundo luhloswe ukusiza bonke abafundi, ukuze baphumelele futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ekugcineni, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa ukuthi imfundo iyisikhali esinamandla. Abafundi badinga ukwazi ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma, futhi imiphumela iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi konke kungenzeka uma benza kahle. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa imfundo luhloswe ukusiza bonke abafundi, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, sikhumbule ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlola, kodwa futhi kuyithuba lokubheka indlela esihamba ngayo, nokuthi singakwenza kanjani kube ngcono. Imfundo iyindlela yokukhulisa amathuba, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokuyisebenzisa ukuze sithole impumelelo.
