Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa: Ukuhlola Uhlobo lwe-GEMS Ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yokwelashwa kwezempilo, kudingeka ukuthi sikhulume ngalesi simo esibucayi esibizwa nge-GEMS (Guided Outcome Measures for Specialized treatment). Lezi zindlela zokwelapha ziwusizo olukhulu kubantu abanenkinga zempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekulawuleni izimo ezinzima. Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sikhuluma ngenhloso yokuhlola nokukhuluma ngempumelelo ethathwa ebuhlotsheni phakathi kwabahlali nabaphathi bezempilo. Uhlolojikelele lwe-GEMS lungaqala nje ngesibhakabhaka esifanele, sihamba siphuma ezinsukwini ezidanile zezemidlalo zasendaweni. I-GEMS iyinsika yokuxhaphaza imiphumela yokwelashwa, ibhekelela zonke izinqubo nokusebenza okwenziwa ukuze kuqashelwe ukuthi ngabe ukwelashwa okutholakele kusebenza kahle yini. Lokhu kugqugquzela umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, nabanye abahlinzeki bezempilo. Isibopho sokwenza kahle semiphumela yokwelashwa siwusizo olukhulu, njengoba sikhuthaza abahlinzeki bezempilo ukuthi bahlale bephikelela emiphumeleni engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ukusiza abatotombikhwe kulezi zinsuku kudinga ukuthi sihlale silandelayo, sahlulele imiphumela ngenxa yokuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ihluke kumuntu nomuntu. Ngakho-ke, ukubona ukuthi uhlelo lwe-GEMS lusebenza kanjani kumuntu ngamunye kumayelana nokuhlonipha izidingo zabo. Uma senza isigaba sokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa, kudingeka siqonde izici ezihlanganisa uhlelo lwe-GEMS. Lezi zici zihlanganisa indlela yokuhlola okwenziwa ngedatha eth gathered, nezindlela ezihlukene zokufaka iziguli esimisweni sokwelapha. Abahlinzeki bezempilo badinga ukujabulela ubuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo, bokuhlola ukuba imiphumela izophumelela kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yokwelashwa ingathuthukiswa ngokubamba izingxoxo ezicacile namaklayenti. Lokhu kunikeza ithuba lokuthola impendulo ngqo, okungabhekelwa njengesikhumbuzo sokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kokwelashwa neziguli, ukukhuthaza ukuthi zigulise izichazamazwi zendlela ezichazwa ngayo imiphumela. Ngokubambisana ne-GEMS, umqondo wokuhlola imiphumela uyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphumelela. I-GEMS inika ithuba lokuthola impendulo ethile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okufanele. Isibopho sokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa kubalulekile emiphumeleni ye-GEMS, ukuze kwenziwe ngempumelelo. Kuwo wonke umkhakha wezempilo, isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sithinta iziguli, abahlinzeki, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Njengoba silwela ukuphucula ukutholakala kwemiphumela yokwelashwa, kuhle ukuthi sibe nenqubomgomo eqinile kulokhu. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa imikhuba yokwelapha, kuholele ekutheni kuhlanganyelwe imiphumela engcono, kunciphise izindleko, futhi kugqugquzele ukusimama kwemiphumela yokwelashwa. Ukuze u-GEMS uphumelele, kuthinta abahlinzeki bezempilo futhi kumele baphendule ebuhlotsheni obukhona namaklayenti abo. Lokhu kutusa iziguli ukuba zithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo, kubasiza ukuthi bahlale benempilo, futhi bahloniphe imiphumela yokwelashwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudinga ubuhle bomqondo obukhulu, kanye nemikhuba ethuthukisiwe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela kwe-GEMS. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi imiphumela engcono yokwelashwa ingatholwa kuphela uma senza izinga elifanele lokuhlola. I-GEMS iyinhloso eqhubekayo yokuthuthukisa imiphumela, nokukhuthaza umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwezidingo zomuntu siqu kanye nemigomo yezenhlalakahle. Lokhu, ngempela, kwenza kube nomthelela omuhle ekwenzeni imibono nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukayo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlola isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa nge-GEMS kudinga ubuhlakani nokuxhumana okuhle. Njengoba sithuthukisa izindlela zempilo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ibalulekile ohlwini lwezempilo. Ukubambisana kwabathintekayo, ukuphumelela kwempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukayo kuzokwenziwa ngempela kuphela uma sithobela lesi sibopho, ukuze iziguli zisebenze ngokubambisene nathi. Ngendlela ethile, lezi zinsizakalo zikhombisa ukuthi u-GEMS ungaba isikhumbuzo sokuthi ukwelashwa kuyinqubo yokuphila, hhayi nje okwenziwayo.
Ukudla Kwesintu Ngaphakathi kwenhliziyo yeNingizimu Afrika, ukudla kwesintu kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Phakathi kwezihlahla ezinkulu, phezulu ezindaweni eziphakeme, kutholakala umuzi omncane ophila ngokuhlanganyela, khona lapho imindeni ibambisana ukuze iqhube izinkumbulo ezinhle, ikakhulukazi lapho kudliwa khona. Kwakukhona umndeni owawuphethe lezi zinkumbulo, uMkhulu uJabulani, owayengumholi wabo. UJabulani wayenothando lwezinkanyezi, kepha okwakumjabulisa kakhulu kwakungukudla. Njalo ngempelasonto, umndeni wabuthana eduze komlilo, kanti uJabulani wayefaka phambili izimbiza ezinkulu ezazigcwele ukutya okuhamba phambili, okwakubizwa ngokuthi “isitsha sikaMkhulu”. Enye yezinganekwane zakhe zakuqala yayihamba ngale ndlela: “Bafana, sizokwenza isitshulu segusha namuhla. Ukudla okwakumfaka empilweni yami yokuqala kwaba yisitshulu esikhulu, futhi lokho kuzokwenza sizwe umoya omusha kulesi sikhala.” Wasuka esiphuzwini futhi waqale ngokuhlanza ingulube. Umndeni wawudlala izigubhu, ubhimba izinkanyezi, kanti umoya wawuthinta ubuso babo. Kusukela ekwenzeni isitshulu, uJabulani wayevame ukuxoxa ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokukhipha amazinga amasha. "Uphondo lwesitsha sikaMkhulu luhluka, futhi umoya wokuhlanganyela, umoya wokudla, ukungabikhona kothile, yikhona okwenza kube muhle," wayephawula njalo. Ukudla kwakhe akukhona nje ukudla; kwaba amandla, ubuhlobo, nempilo. Ngemuva kokupheka, imindeni yayithokozisa umoya. UZandile, indodakazi kaJabulani, wayezokwenza isinkwa esibizwa ngokuthi "isiqhingi". Isondo lesiqhingi, eliphephile, lalisetshenziswa njengokudla okuvamise ukwenzeka. UZandile wayethanda ukukhipha izithako ezivela emaphandleni, efaka ubhontshisi, izaqathe, nemifino eyahlukene, ukuze athole ubumnandi obuhlukahlukene. UJabulani wayejabule ngokubona indodakazi yakhe ikhuluma ngokudla kwesintu, ikhuluma ngempilo, ikhuluma ngothando. Isidlo sasinomoya wokubambisana, kahle. Kwakukhona abantwana abebhucunga, begijima bejabulile, bephakamisa izingxenye zomzimba zabo, bekhumbula ukuthanda ukudla. UJabulani wayephindela emqondweni, ehlola ukuthi ukuhlanganyela okuletha injabulo, kunjalo? “Yebo, ukuthokozisa, okukhona,” wathi. Ngesikhathi umndeni uvula izitsha, umoya uzungeza, ukhumbuza abantu ukuthi ukudla akuwona umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa kukhona umoya wosuku, umoya wokuhlanganyela, umoya wokubuyisana. “Bona, thina asifuni ukugcina, sifuna ukwabelana,” kwasho uJabulani. Ngemva kokudla, umndeni waqhamuka ukuze uzithokozise, wahamba ehamba. UJabulani, eveza umsebenzi wabo, wathi: “Ukudla kwesintu akugcini nje ngokwabelana, kodwa kuhamba phambili, kubamba izinkumbulo. Umoya wethu, izinkumbulo, ubuhlobo bethu, lokho kudinga ukuba sikuphathe kahle.” Kuleso sikhathi, uZandile waphakamisa isiphakamiso: “Mkhulu, kungani singakwenzi lokhu njalonje minyaka yonke?” UJabulani wayejabule, esuka ezinkumbulweni zodlule, waphendula: “Bafana, kudinga umzamo, kudinga uthando. Thina sisemzabalazweni okhanyayo.” Ngakho, ukuqhubeka kwabo, umndeni waqhubeka nokuthokozisa, waphila ngezinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngisho noma izikhathi zaqhubeka, umoya wokuhlanganyela, ukudla kwesintu, wayezohlala njalo, uJabulani wayazi ukuthi lokho kuyobakhumbuza, kube umoya wabo. Kwakungakhathaleki ukuthi iminyaka izophuma, kodwa umoya wezimvo, umoya wokuhlanganyela, umoya wezakhamuzi, ubuhlobo, lokho kuzohlala kuhlangene nezinkanyezi. Lokhu kwakuyisiko, lezi zinkumbulo ezaziyigugu, ezintsha nezidala, ekugcineni, indaba yokudla kwesintu, yayihlanganisa imindeni, izinkanyezi, neminyaka. Ngakho, njalonje, umndeni wakwaJabulani usaqhubeka nokugcina lesi simo, njalo ngempelasonto, ukuze baphinde baphinde bahlale behlanganisa izinkumbulo, behlala bejabulile, bephila ngothando. Kwakungumoya omuhle, umoya wezinkumbulo, umoya wokudla kwesintu.
Umbiko Ngemidlalo Yesikole Isingeniso Imidlalo yesikole ibalulekile empilweni yothisha nabafundi. Uhlelo lwezemidlalo lushintsha izindlela zokufunda, lubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, futhi luthuthukisa impilo yomzimba nengqondo. Lo mbiko uzobheka ukwakheka kwemidlalo yesikole, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezithiyo ezibhekene nabafundi. Ukwakhiwa Kwezemidlalo Yesikole Imidlalo yesikole ihlanganisa imikhakha ehlukahlukene efana nebhola, i-athletics, ibhodi, nezinye eziningi. Izikole zisebenzisa le midlalo ukuze zikhuthaze abafundi ukuba bakhuthalele ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza. Imidlalo yesikole ivame ukuhlelwa ngonyaka, kanti izinhlelo ziqala ngokuqeqesha abafundi ukuze bazilungiselele imincintiswano. Izinhlelo ezijwayelekile zifaka phakathi imijaho, imidlalo yeqembu, nemincintiswano yokudansa. Izigaba ezahlukene zifaka abafundi abavela ezikhathini ezahlukene, okukhuthaza ukuncintisana okuphumelelayo, konke lokho kwenziwa ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwabafundisi abanolwazi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bayathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela, bakhe ubudlelwano, futhi bathuthukise amakhono abo. Izinzuzo Zokubamba Izigaba Zemidlalo Imidlalo yesikole inezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, ikhuthaza impilo enhle phakathi kwabafundi. Ukuhamba, ukujaha, nokudlalela izivumelwano kudala ukwehlisa ingozi yokukhulisa isisindo kanye nezifo ezihlobene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo iyasiza ekwakheni ukuzethemba. Abafundi abawina imiqhudelwano nabathola ukujabulisa bazithola bekhululekile futhi bebanjwe yimpumelelo. Okwesibili, imidlalo yesikole ikhulisa amakhono okusebenza ngempumelelo. Abafundi bafunda ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokuqonda ukuthi impumelelo ivela ekusebenzelaneni. Lokhu kubalulekile hhayi kuphela emidlalweni, kodwa nasezifundweni zangempela lapho kudingeka khona ukuhlela kahle. Okwesithathu, imidlalo yesikole ithuthukisa ikhono lokulawula ingcindezi. Abafundi bahlala behlangabezana nezimo ezinzima, njengokuncintisana. Lokhu kubafundisa ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nengcindezi empilweni yabo, okubasiza ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Izithiyo Eziqukethwe Imidlalo Yesikole Naphezu kwezinhlelo ezinhle nezinhlelo eziqinile, imidlalo yesikole ibhekene nezithiyo ezithile. Okokuqala, kunezindleko. Izikole eziningi azinayo imali eyanele yokuhlinzeka ngempilo ezidingekayo, njengokuthenga izinsiza, ukwakha izindawo zokudlala, nokubandakanya abaqeqeshi abanolwazi. Lokhu kudala izithiyo ezinkulu kubafundi abaningi abavela emindenini ezingekho kwi-standards zemali. Okwesibili, ukungabikhona kwemithombo yokuxhasa emiphakathini kunomthelela omkhulu kumfundi. Imiphakathi eminingi ayikwenzi ngempela ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabadlali abasha, okwenza kube nzima kubafundi ukuthi bakhule emidlalweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhathazeka ngempumelelo emiphakathini kungaholela ekutheni abafundi baphikeleleke ezingxenyeni ezizothinta impumelelo yabo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokucindezeleka phakathi kwabafundi, okungaholela ekusebenzeni kokuphumelela okukhanyayo. Ukubhekisela Ekuqedeni Ukugcina, imidlalo yesikole iyisici esibalulekile empilweni yabafundi. Izinzuzo zayo zikhona emakhonweni, empilweni, nasekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano. Kodwa-ke, izithiyo ezithinta izimali, izinsiza, kanye nemiphakathi kufanele zixazululwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi uthola ithuba lokuhlanganyela. Kunoma yikuphi, imidlalo yesikole kufanele iqhubeke nokuba yinsika eqinile yokukhuthaza abafundi ukuba babe ngcono, babe nempilo, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, imidlalo yesikole isiza ukuvuselela umoya wokuncintisana, uthando lwemidlalo, kanye nokwakha isizukulwane esiqinile. Imiphakathi, izikole, nabafundi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi imidlalo yesikole iyanda, ithuthukiswe, futhi ihlale ibalulekile empilweni yabafundi. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, imidlalo yesikole ayigcini nje ngokwakha amakhono omzimba, kodwa inikeza ithuba lokuthuthukisa umqondo, ukwakha ukuzethemba, nokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abafundi baphumelele hhayi kuphela esikhathini sesikole, kodwa futhi nasemphakathini jikelele. Ukusebenzisana, ukusekela, kanye nokukhuthaza kumele kube yisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lemidlalo yesikole.
Ukukhulelwa Kwentsha Kwazulu, lapho umoya wehlobo ubushelelezi, kwenkwazi uThando, intombazane eneminyaka engama-16. UThando wayengumfundi ophumelele esikoleni, emthanda uNkulunkulu, futhi engumntwana ophakeme emndenini. Kodwa impilo yakhe yaguquka ngelinye ilanga, uma owakhe umngani, uLwazi, ehamba naye ukuzokhuphula isixhumanisi somngani. U-Lwazi wayenezimfuno ezinhle, engumfundi omuhle, kodwa ezinsukwini ezithile, uThando waqala ukujula enhliziyweni yakhe. U-Lwazi wakhanga intshisakalo yakhe, kwezwa ukuthi ungenza izinto ngendlela eyejwayelekile. UThando, ongekho ndlela yokuphikisana, wagcina esebenzisa izinsizwa, ezichaza kahle ukuhambisana nabanye. Ngemuva kwalokho, uThando wabona ukuthi uthandana noLwazi, kodwa akazange abone izinkinga ezinzima ezivela kulokhu. Bahlala bejabule, bechitha isikhathi ndawonye, bedlala imidlalo, bezoxoxa ngezinhlelo zabo zempilo. UThando wayenesithakazelo sangempela kuhulumeni, efuna ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kodwa ngesikhathi sehlobo, izinhlelo zayo zashintsha ngemuva kokuhlangabezana neqhaza lentombazane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile, uThando waqala ukuzwa ushintsho emzimbeni wakhe. Waqala ukwethuka, ngoba kusebenza kancane kancane njengoba imizwa yehluka. Waqonda ukuthi impilo yakhe isiyashintsha, kepha akazange akhulume noLwazi. Ubuhlungu bokuqala, nokuhluntshiswa, kwashiya uThando engazi ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nalokhu. Izinsuku zedlule, uThando wavuka elinde umzamo wokuxhumana noLwazi. Wabuka usuku lungapheli lapho ethola khona ukuthi uzithola ekhaya, umama ekhuluma ngezisombululo ezinzima. Wabulawa umuzwa wokungabaza, wahamba ebhakhweni, wezwa umoya emoyeni, wakuthola kucacile ukuthi uzoba nonkosikazi. Lokhu kwenza umama wathokoza, ngoba ubaqothwa ezitokisini ezinkulu nomusa. Zonke izinsiza zaziphuma, ubuhlungu bukhuni, kepha uThando wayembonile umama wakhe evuma. Kwaqoqwa amandla, ukufunelela, nokuhlale iqiniso. Umama wakhe wamkhumbuza ukuthi ungumuntu ophilayo, futhi konke kuzoba lula. Ngemuva kokuthola ukuthi uzoba nonkosikazi, kwachithwa i-akhawunti yezehlakalo, kumkhumbuza iqiniso lokuthanda. UThando wayeqonda ukuthi udinga ukukwenza. Wakhumbula izifundo ezazitholakala esikoleni, ezayephephile phakathi kwamavalela ezincwadi. Ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi, waqala ukubona izinto eziningi ngendlela entsha. U-Lwazi, owabe esephendule indlela eya kumazinga ahlukeneyo, wavuma ukudlula. Wavuma ukuthi uthando bangasafuneki futhi kezinsiza zisenziwa. Uma besondela, uThando wathokozisa ukudlula. Wamnika uLwazi ithuba lokuthi abuke maphakathi nalokhu. U-Lwazi wamkhumbuza ukuba asondelane, abheke emissisiwe. Okwakukhona, uThando wayengawonile umndeni. Imakhileyo yaphumelela, umama wahamba ngemuva kokubongela, ekhumbula izinsuku ezazithembisa, okwakukholisa ukuthi uThando uzolahlekile. Kwaba nesifiso sokuthi uThando akhule, ahlangane, awasebenzise imvelaphi, aqhubeke. Kumele aqhubeke, akholise ukuthi uzoba nonkosikazi. Kwakukhona uthando olugqumayo, uma ebona esikhathini somzali. Ngesikhathi sokuthola umndeni, uThando wanxusa abanye abantwana. Wafuna ukuyiqaphela imizamo, athola izinqondo ezithokozisayo. U-Lwazi waba nempumelelo phakathi kwezibopho, futhi uthando lwabo lwakhuliswa. UThando wafunda ukuba ukhulelwe akulula, kodwa uyazithola amandla nemijondolo. Inhliziyo kaThando yathemba, ingqungquthela izindonga ezinhle. Wafuna uLwazi noMama akhimba izinhlelo ezinzima ezizovula umoya onokuthula, eqinisekisa ukuthi ubudlelwano bukhula. Umnotho wabe utholeka emndeni, bahlanganisa umoya wezinkanyezi. Ekugcineni, uThando waqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wayo uzohlala. UThando wabamba iqhaza ekukhuleni, waphuma kumazinga azinzima. Ngakho ubuhle beqiniso bahlala lapho, bothembisa izinhlelo eziphakeme. Umama wakhumbuza uThando ukuthi uthando aluvumi ukuthi uzifanele ikhululi, menqaba ukucasula obala. Kwakukhona isithakazelo esithembisa ukuthi impilo izobathuthuka. UThando wakhumbula ukuthi yonke imizamo akuyona indlela kuphela, kepha izinyathelo ezithathiwe kumama futhi kulondolozwa ubukhosi. Uma nobani, kuzodingeka okuningi ukuze ibhalwe, kukhumbule uthando oluyinhloko. Usuku, izinyathelo, maturi. Kwakubonisa ukuthi imizamo emisha, izinsiza eziphezulu, kwaba nomlando omusha. UThando waphila ngokucacile, ngabantu abaninzi abahamba naye, ababaqotho phakathi kwabo, babuyele esikoleni, balethe umoya ophumuzile. Kwakungelula, kodwa uThando wayemazisa ukuthi umoya kube mingaki imizwa. Le ndaba nokukhulelwa kwentsha kuveza okufunwa, ubunzima, ubuhlungu, nokuxazulula. Kukhona injabulo, izinsizakalo ezinhle, nezifiso ezithokozisayo. UThando waba ngumama onokuthula, wahamba hiswayiza, nakuba izinhlelo zibeze zibhizinisa, kumphendula. Kwakukhona izinsiza ezinhle, ebuhlungu benhliziyo, waqaphela lokho enye imoto, ibaluleke. Uthando, imithreddi yathwala, waba isigubhu esikhulu, futhi imikhakha yanamuhla, udinga akubaleki. Kwaba nobungcweti, umrungwana wabona, owabika endleleni. Lapho umoya ukhula, udla izimolo ezaziyingqayizivele. UThando waba nomthelela, ngokuhamba kancane, phakathimena udinga uthando. Umndeni khumbulumqondisi kodwa abana ngenkani, ubuthakathaka phakathimena ibandakanya ukuthi beyazi. Barkhanye, bayakuzwa iziqhaza zempilo, ukudlula ukuthi udinga uLwazi, ngoba uthando aluhlaza phakathimena. Bayahlukana nezimanga.
Namuhla kuyinsuku ebalulekile njengoba sibhiyozela usuku lwababekezeli bethu ngaphansi kwesiqu, "Sibhiyozela iminyaka eyishumi yabantu abadala ezweni elihlanganisa zonke izigaba." Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nathi njengeMnyango ekusizeni abadala, njengokuthi kwezinye izindawo basaboshwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Siyazi ukuthi ngenxa yokucindezelwa komsebenzi, omama nababamkhulu bagcina bethathwa ezikhungweni ezihlinzeka ngensizakalo kubadala ukuze baphathwe kulezi zindawo. Sithola imibiko yokuthi abanye bagcina bengavakashelwa noma bethathwa ukuze bavakashele emakhaya abo. Siphika lokho ngoba kuyinto embi kakhulu. Ngifuna futhi ukusho ukuthi asikhuthazi le ndlela yokubathatha ezikhungweni; kodwa uma kungekho okungcono okungaqhubeka, kungcono ukuthi bathathwe lapho kunokuthi baphathwe kabi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uMnyango wami ukhathazekile kakhulu ngenhlalakahle yabadala. Yingakho lo Mnyango usungule izikhungo eziyi-461 ezihlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abadala abangu-25,215, kanti abangu-6,309 babamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzivocavoca ezitholakala kulezi zikhungo. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi ukuzivocavoca kubalulekile ukuze ungaguli kalula. Ukuze kukhombise ukuthi uMnyango, ngisho nasezingeni lesizwe, ufuna ukukubona uphila kahle ngenxa yokuzivocavoca, imidlalo ihlelwe ukuthi ibanjwe ePort Elizabeth lapho omama nababamkhulu bazoqhudelana khona bezivela kuzo zonke izifundazwe, futhi imidlalo ehlukahlukene izodlalwa, ngikhuthaza ukuba ubambe iqhaza, mhlawumbe ungabuya neziqu. Angikholwa ukuthi uzonqotshwa ngabantu abadala abavela kwezinye izifundazwe. Lezi zimbangi zizobanjwa kusukela ngomhla ka-27 ku-Okthoba kuya ku-29 ku-Okthoba, 2009. Ngiyacela ungithethelele ukuthi uzofika futhi uwine. Ngaphandle kwezikhungo eziphansi kwethu, kunezikhungo eziyi-53 esizixhasa ngezimali ezihlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abadala abangu-3,534. Siphinde sikhokhele abasebenzi bezokuxhumana abangu-64 abasebenza kulezi zikhungo. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi kusekhona izinkinga esibhekene nazo ekunikezeni usizo oluphelele kubadala, njengokuthi ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kunzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zeLuncheon Clubs ngoba awekho amakhaya okwenza lo msebenzi njengama-hall, amakholwa, futhi uthola ukuthi abantu abadala bakude kakhulu ukuze bahambe ngoba babona ibanga abadinga ukuhamba. Ngokufingqa, uma ngingafingqa lokho esikwenza kubadala kule ndawo kuphela, sinezindawo eziyi-50 ezihlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abadala abangu-2,292.
Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Isingeniso Umlando wezombusazwe nezomnotho eNingizimu Afrika ubonisa ukuthi izigameko ezinkulu, ezifana nezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021, ziwumthombo wokuhlola imiphumela eminingi, ikakhulukazi emnothweni. Lezi zibhelu, ezavela ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene ezifana nokukhathazeka ngezenzo zezombusazwe, ukungabi nokwaneliseka ngezinga lokuphila, kanye nezinkinga zokuqashwa, zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasemiphakathini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka imithelela ebalulekile yezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni, sithathela ingqikithi ezibhekelela izinzuzo nemiphumela emibi. Umongo wezibhelu Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zenzeka njengomphumela wokuphikisana okwakukhona phakathi kwabantu nezinhlelo zomphakathi, njengoba abantu bebebonisa ukunganeliseki ngezinga lokuphila eliphakeme, ukuphathwa kwempilo, kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha. Ukuhlaselwa kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izitolo nezimboni kube yisibonakaliso sokuphikisana okukhulu nokudumazeka okukhona phakathi komphakathi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, lezi zibhelu zaveza ubuhlungu obukhona ezingeni lempilo kunye nemiphumela yokungabi namathuba emisebenzi, okwaholela ekutheni abantu baphendule ngale ndlela. Umthelela emnothweni 1. Ukwanda kwezindleko Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umthelela omkhulu ezindlekweni zomnotho. Ukuhlaselwa kwezindawo zokuhweba, izimboni, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi kuholele ekulahlekelweni okukhulu kwemali, okwandisa izindleko zokubuyisela izinto emuveni. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amaningi aphumile emsebenzini noma enze ukunciphisa, okukhuphule izinga lokungasebenzi. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni wendawo, njengoba ukukhiqiza kuncipha, okukhulisa ukuntuleka kwemali. 2. Ukwehla kwezinhlaka zomnotho Izibhelu zashiya umthelela omubi ezinkampanini ezincane, ezikhiqiza imisebenzi eminingi. Ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwezindawo zokuhweba, abanikazi bamabhizinisi abancane bathola ukuhlupheka okukhulu, okwaholela ekwandeni kokuhamba kwemali. Lokhu kuhlupheka kuhlobene nokwehla kokwaneliseka kwabantu, okukhombisa izinkinga ezinhlekelele zomnotho. 3. Ukugxila kwezimali Abatshalizimali bakhombisa ukungabaza ngokuqhubekayo ezimakethe ngenxa yezibhelu, okuyinto ethinta ukutshalwa kwezimali. Ukungabikhona kokuthula, nomoya wokuphikisana, kuholele ekutheni abatshalizimali baphendule ngokuqaphela, bahlale kude nezinhlelo ezithile zokutshala imali. Lokhu kuholela ekwehleni kokutshalwa kwezimali, okwakha isithombe esibi semigomo yokukhula komnotho. 4. Ukwanda kokungabi namathuba emisebenzi Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zaphinde zakhombisa umthelela oqhubekayo ekungabi namathuba emisebenzi. Ukuthula okungapheli kuholele ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba amabhizinisi amaningi ehluleka ukuqhubeka nokukhiqiza. Lokhu kube nomthelela omubi ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila, njengoba abantu besaba ukufinyela emsebenzini, okwandisa udlame phakathi kwabantu. 5. Imiphumela yokuhlala kwabantu Izibhelu zashiya umthelela emiphakathini ethile, ikakhulukazi kumiphakathi ethile ehluphekayo, lapho abantu babebonisa ukunganeliseki ngezinga lokuphila. Imiphakathi ethile, ikakhulukazi leyo engaphansi, ibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima, futhi izibhelu zabe zihlola lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kuhamba phambili nemizamo yokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila, okwenza kube nobudlelwano obunzima phakathi kwabantu nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Isiphetho Ukwaziswa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni kungenzeka kube umthombo wemfundo kubaphathi bezomnotho kanye nabakhiqizi bezinqubomgomo. Ukubhekana nezizathu eziholela kulokhu kuhlaselwa, kuhlelelwa izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa izinga lokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo ezizayo zibe nemininingwane eqinile yokuhlola izindlela ezizokwazi ukusiza ekuqedeni lezi zinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuvikela umnotho ezimeni ezinjengalezi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindawo ezinjalo aziphindaphindiwe, futhi imiphakathi iqhubeke nokuthuthuka. Uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lungaboni kuphela izinselelo, kodwa futhi luhlinzeke ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umnotho onempilo.
Mhlonishwa uMphathiswa; uMkhulumeli kanye noMkhulumeli oPhakeme boMphakathi; Amalungu anhloniphekile ePhalamende leSifunda; uSihlalo kanye nawo wonke amalungu anhloniphekile weKomidi Lezempilo. Abaphathiswa kanye Nezikhulu; Abaholi bendabuko phakathi kwethu; uMphathi weSigaba, uDkt. Busi Nyembezi; Abaphathi bezigaba kuzo zonke izigaba kuhlanganise nabaphathi bezempilo bezifunda, abaphathi bezibhedlela, amalungu ebhodi lezibhedlela, amalungu eBhodi Yokuhlola Ngengqondo, Amakomidi Ezempilo, Abaphilayo bendabuko, kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo kuMnyango Wezempilo. Abanye abahloniphekile abakhona lapha engingabakhumbuzi; Bafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Izinselelo ezimangalisayo esibhekene nazo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, sizama ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo obekwe ezikhwameni zethu ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lobubha elenza umsebenzi wethu ube nzima kakhulu. Masihlangane njengabantu baleli sifunda elimangalisayo emkhankasweni wokulwa nobubha, ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, izifo, nokukhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekunakekeleni amalungelo abantu kanye nobuhlakani bomuntu ngamunye. Izindaba zezempilo kanye namalungu anhloniphekile yizihloko eziyisisekelo ezixoxwa ezinkundleni ezibhekana nokuthuthukiswa kokuphila komphakathi kanye nomnotho. I-International Rural Women's Conference ibanjwa eThekwini njengoba sikhuluma. Siyazi ukuthi eSifundeni sethu, abesifazane benza u-53% wabantu bonke futhi iningi labo lihlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, izifo, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo, nokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Kukhona amazwe athuthukayo asebenze kakhulu kulezi zinselelo esibhekene nazo. Sithemba ukuthi le ngqungquthela izonikeza ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yokuthi singabhekana kanjani nalezi zindaba ezibhekene nabesifazane ngesikhathi esithile. Umsebenzi wethu njengomnyango wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngokulandela umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kusukela ezingeni eliphansi, sigxile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kumuntu ngamunye ngokulinganayo, sithinte umphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo futhi sisebenzisane nazo zonke izigaba ezikhona esifundeni. Isikhungo sokuqala sokunakekelwa kwezempilo sakhiwe endaweni yePholela lapha eKwaZulu-Natal ngo-1948, eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwe-Alma Ata Declaration mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuqala ngo-1978, njengendlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphakeme. Umndeni wezempilo emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithuthukayo, uyavuma ukuthi kumele siqinise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuqala uma sifuna ukubhekana kahle nomthwalo wokulwa nezifo. Sibe nezikhathi eziningi ngonyaka odlule lapho sakhuluma ngezaziso ezihlukahlukene zezempilo emiphakathini. Kulonyaka sizokwakha kulokho njengesisekelo sigxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunomthelela ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi sisebenze ndawonye ekuxoxeni ngezihloko noma izindaba ezihlobene nezempilo, futhi ngaleyo ndlela sizokhula ndawonye. Ngithemba ukuthi ngalokhu sizobona intuthuko nezinkomba zokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo. Sibhekene nezinga lobubha elingu-54.3% kulesi sifunda, kanti kwezinye izindawo zasemakhaya izinga lobubha likhulu kakhulu elilinganiselwa ku-80%. Sake sathi izinga lokungabi nokudla liphakeme kakhulu ku-70%. Kulesi sifunda, kuphela u-32% wabantu abanokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile (kwezizwe kubalwa ku-79% kanti u-24% wezindlu unazo izinsiza zokuhlanza ezanele kulesi sifunda kanti kwezizwe kubalwa ku-62%). Lezi yizinselelo ezifanayo ezithinta izindawo zasemakhaya ezizungeze amadolobha lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo ezanele, kanye nechungechunge lezifo. Izifunda ze-Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Umzinyathi, Zululand, nezinye izingxenye zendawo ye-Ilembe zinezinga eliphezulu lobubha elikhonjiswa yizinkomba zomnotho. Izifunda ze-Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Umzinyathi, ingxenye esentshonalanga ye-Uthukela, ne-Zululand, ingxenye eningizimu ye-Umkhanyakude zinezinkomba ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobubha kanye nokuntuleka kokuphila komphakathi (kuhlanganisa nezinga eliphansi lemfundo, ubukhulu bezakhamuzi, iningi labantu libantu abasha, abantu abadala, nabantu abakhubazekile). Izindawo zasemakhaya e-Umzinyathi, Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Zululand, Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Isisonke zinezinkomba ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokungahlinzekwa kwezidingo ezibalulekile kuhlanganisa amanzi, ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo, nokuntuleka kohlelo lokuphatha udoti okudala inkinga enkulu kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ngenhlonipho ye-Alma Ata, kumele sisebenze ndawonye nezinye izigaba ezikwi zinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukuze sibhekane nezinkinga eziphazamisa impilo yomphakathi futhi zinciphise ukuzinza komnotho. Njengengxenye yale mizamoyethu, sifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo zomphakathi eduze komphakathi futhi siphinde sikhuthaze imikhankaso yokuphila kahle nezinhlelo zemfundo yezempilo ezihloselwe ukwazisa, ukufundisa, nokukhuthaza imiphakathi mayelana nezempilo. Abasebenzi bezempilo bazoqinisekisa ukuthi leli hlelo liphumelele. Iyunithi egxile emabhizinisini amancane, i-Targeted Enterprises Unit, yasungulwa kulo mnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi owned by black abantu adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthengiseni kukahulumeni ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobubha kulesi sifunda futhi kuthuthukiswe izimo zezempilo futhi kwakhiwe ikusasa eliphephile neliphumelelayo. Okwamanje, ugxile kuma-cooperatives, amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, namakhulu (SMMEs) ikakhulukazi lawo asevele ehlukunyezwa. Kukhona izinhlelo ezihloselwe ngqo abesifazane, intsha, kanye nezinkampani eziphethwe abantu abakhubazekile. Imali engama-R81 million ihlinzekwe ngaphansi kohlelo ukuze inikeze amabhizinisi ithuba lokuncintisana esikhundleni sokuthumela izimemo kumabhizinisi athile ukuze ancintisane ngezintengo ezibekwe emsebenzini odingekayo. Le msebenzi ibonise intuthuko ekwazini ukuphatha umkhankaso wezokusebenza emkhakheni wamabhizinisi ama-cooperative. Lokhu kubonisa ngokucacile ukuzinikela komnyango ekulweni nezifo, ekulweni nobubha, nasekunikeni ithemba kubantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Kukhona ubufakazi obucacile bokuthi uma ubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni impilo nemfundo yabesifazane, uthuthukisa isimo sempilo yezingane zabo okuyisisekelo senhlangano enempilo enekhono elikhanyayo. Umkhakha ophathelene nesimo sabesifazane ngesikhathi
Ukumaketha ukuze kube nomphumela omuhle kudinga ukuba nomkhiqizo ofanele ukuthengiswa, endaweni efanele, ngentengo efanele, nangaleso sikhathi esifanele. Akukho okukhishwa ukuze kugcinwe uma kungenziwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amandla okuthile awanani; lokho kufanele kuhambisane nezidingo zomuntu ofuna noma odinga ukukusebenzisa. Isibonelo: ubisi abukhiqizwa ukuze kugcinwe kuze kube sezingalweni zomuntu ophuza. Amaphunga awakhiqizwa ukuze agcinwe kuze kufike ekhishini lapho ephekwa khona. Ngokufanayo, ummbila awukhiqizwa ukuze ugcinwe kuze kube sezingalweni zomuntu ozowusebenzisa noma odlayo. Kuze kube khona, umkhiqizi ngeke athole inzuzo ngemali abethelelayo, ngakho ukumaketha kubalulekile okufanele kucatshangelwe kahle ngisho ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukutshalwa. Kunabantu abacabanga ukuthi ukukhiqiza nokumaketha izinto ezahlukene; kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo ehambisanayo, ethatha ukudla kwemvelo futhi ikuguqule ukuze kusebenze abantu. Kubonakala ukuthi akukho okufanele kukhiqizwe okungadingeki ngabantu. Hlanganisa umcabango wakho nemakethe! Umkhiqizo okhiqiziwe kufanele ube yinto abantu abayidingayo futhi kufanele uthengiswe ngentengo ezokwamukelwa yilabo abayidingayo. Ikhono lokuphatha izimo zebhizinisi mayelana nezindleko ezifanele umkhiqizi kufanele aphathe ibhizinisi lakhe ngokuhambisana nezimiso zezimali ezizompreparela ukuze umsebenzi uqhubeke unenzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Impela, zonke izinyathelo zokuthuthuka komkhiqizi zihambisana nalezi zinyathelo umkhiqizi azithathayo lapho eqala ukuhlela amasu okuthengisa ukudla kwakhe ekugcineni. Kukhona izinto eziningi umkhiqizi okufanele azicabangele uma efuna ukuthengisa ukudla kwakhe. Yini engifuna ukukhiqiza? Ngizokhiqiza ukudla okukhona ukufunwa? Ngizokuthengisela bani lokhu kudla? Ngizokhiqiza nini futhi ngizokuthengisa nini? Zingaki izindleko ezizoba kule bhizinisi lami futhi yisiphi isilinganiso engizokwamukela lapho ngifuna ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami? Yikuphi ikhwalithi yalokho engizokhiqiza? Ngizokwazi ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami kwi-cooperative eduze? Ngizokwazi ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami ngenkontileka esheshayo? Ngizokwazi ukuvikelwa komkhiqizo wami futhi ngiwuthengise kamuva uma intengo ikhuphukile noma uma imakethe inezinhlobonhlobo zokudla? Ingabe kubalulekile ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami ngokushesha noma kufanele ngiqale ngicabangele izindleko ezingaba khona? Imibuzo leyo izotholakala ezimisweni zezimali esizixoxile ngenhla: ukuhlinzeka nokufuna. Sifuna ukukhuthaza abalimi ukuthi bagxile ekumaketheni kahle lapho behlela amasu abo okukhiqiza ngonyaka omusha. Abakhiqizi abaningi manje bayazi ukuthi kufanele kuqala kucatshangelwe izimiso zezimali zokumaketha. Kodwa abaningi basakholelwa ukuthi ukumaketha kuza ngemuva kokutshala, bekholelwa ukuthi kufanele baqale bagxile ekulimaleni, futhi ukumaketha kuzolandela emva kwalokho, ngemuva kokuvuna. Yebo, ukukhiqiza ngendlela efanele kubalulekile futhi, kodwa umkhiqizi kufanele aqhubeke efunda ngakho okwenziwa emakethe emhlabeni jikelele, amathuba atholakalayo okuthenga nokuthengisa eSouth African Futures Exchange (SAFEX) kwiJohannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE), kubalulekile futhi kumkhiqizi ukuthola ulwazi ngama-opportunities wokumaketha nezimo zezimali ezikhona. I-SAFEX iyinsiza ethathwa njengendawo lapho abakhiqizi bengaphatha khona amathuba akhona emakethe kanye nezingozi ezikhona emakethe yezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Abalimi manje bangabeka umkhiqizo wabo kwi-SAFEX ukuze bathole intengo efanele ngesikhathi esifanele esizayo. Lokhu kungasiza abalimi ngoba kuzobavikela uma amanani ehla ngesikhathi sokuvuna noma uma kukhona ukudla okuningi emakethe. Ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kubhekene nengcindezi lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Izindleko zokuqala zokutshala zikhuphuka, kunezingozi eziningi ezingaba khona, ukuhlinzeka kudlula ukufuna, lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuhlinzekwa okweqile kokudla futhi amanani ehla, ngakho umkhiqizi akasatholi inzuzo ezokhokhela izindleko zakhe nezingozi ezingaba khona. Ekugcineni, singathi abalimi okwamanje abakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo. Umkhiqizi ngamunye kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezicabangela isimo sabo ukuze ahlele amasu abalulekile ngesikhathi esifanele ukusiza ibhizinisi labo. Abanye bangakhetha ukungatshali ukudla okuningi okwamanje, mhlawumbe bafuna ukulinda kuze kube imakethe ikhuphuka. Abanye abalimi bakhethe ukubheka izindlela zokulima ezihlukile ezifana "nokungatshali" ezizokwehlisa izindleko zokulima. Ngokushiya umkhiqizi wokudla okuyisisekelo njengengxenye yomshini emakethe yomhlaba ophoqayo emakethe, ngakho umkhiqizi oyedwa ngeke akwazi ukushintsha imakethe yomkhiqizo wabo. Lokhu kubenza babonakale njengabathengi benani, hhayi abakhiqizi benani, ngakho isu lokumaketha elikhethwe umkhiqizi libalulekile, kufanele licatshangelwe kahle, lwenziwe ngolwazi, ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukutshala.
Kusukela kumphathi wesibhedlela... Iziphakamiso 4 - Siyayithola, ziyasiphunyuka... Imibono, iziphakamiso, imicimbi, izimemo, imishado, izikhumbuzo, nokunye okuningi. Sidinga ukwazi zonke lezi zindaba. Sitshele! Abaphathi bavumile ukuthi kuzoba negumbi lelibhary. Omunye wabasebenzi uzovakashela wonke amagumbi eziguli ebuzwa ukuthi bayawathanda yini lezi zinto zokufunda, futhi bazothatha uma beqeda. Nks. Sibona, sibona ukuthi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu uma abasebenzi besisiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lo mzamo uphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasebenzi bangasebenzisa ilebhu ngesikhathi sokuphumula kwabo. Umsebenzi wezempilo uvakashela emakhaya amahlanu ngosuku futhi uba ngama-100 ngenyanga. Baphatha izifo ezilula ukuphatha futhi baqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli abazivakashelayo zithola ukwelashwa. "Sisebenza namasimu ezinkosi, inkosi ngayinye inikezwa umsebenzi wezempilo ukuze asebenze emzaneni wale nkosi," kusho uNeli Khuzwayo, umsebenzi wezempilo. Abasebenzi bezempilo bbaluleke kakhulu kuzo zonke izikhungo zezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ngoba lezi zikhungo zivame ukuba kude nomphakathi, futhi ukuhamba akukhona kahle. Siyi-sikhungo esincane kakhulu, sinezhope eziphezulu, amaphupho amahle, nokusebenza kanzima. Okwamanje, abantu beza ukuhlola igazi labo, kodwa sithumela igazi ukuze lihlolwe esibhedlela saseStanger bese besithumela emuva, kanye nemiphumela. Sicebisa iziguli zethu ngakho konke okudingeka zicebise ngalesi sifo bese sizithumela esibhedlela saseStanger kulabo abazothola imithi. Siqale ikliniki lapho, siqeqesha iziguli zethu izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze sibone ukuthi zingakwazi yini ukuthatha imithi ngesikhathi esifanele. Futhi, ukuthi zingavula ngempela ngezimo zazo ukuze zithole ukwesekwa emindenini yazo nasemiphakathini, futhi zizisize. Siyajabula ukuthi noma izinto zokudlala zimbalwa, izingane seziqalile ukudlala nazo. Sinezingane nezincwadi abangazidweba kuzo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso kusijabulisa futhi kusikhuthaza ukuba siqhubeke nezinhlelo ezifana nalezi. Siseduze kakhulu nokuphumelela. Siphakamisa bonke abasebenzi ukuba basisize. Sithemba ukuthi abanye abasebenzi bazosiza futhi ngokusisiza, besiza izingane ezigulayo. Ilebhu yethu. Uma uhlanza indlu yakho, uthola izincwadi ezindala kodwa ezifundekayo, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuthi sidinga neBhayibheli ezinhle. Isandla esisizayo sizobusiswa.
