Nkandla Umphumulo 0 -4 Udlale kahle impela, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wombhoxo, amantombazane awanqotshwa, bekungumaphutha nje ngalolo suku, ngiyazi ngeke kwenzeke futhi! Sizovakashelwa esibhedlela saseItshelejuba ngomhla ka-6 kuNdasa 2004. Bonke abadlali balungiselela kusukela evikini lokuqala kaNdasa. Siyajabula lapho abasebenzi abasha befika emndenini wethu, kodwa lapho befika, abanye bayahamba. Abanye baye ezindaweni eziluhlaza, abanye bashintsha izikhungo, abanye bathola ukukhushulwa ezikhundleni eziphezulu, kanti abanye bahluleka ukusishiya emhlabeni. Mnu. D. Sosibo Kulolu hlobo lokunyakaza, umuntu unemibono eminingi, sifuna abantu baphumelelayo futhi babe nezimpilo ezingcono, kodwa kunzima ukubavumela ukuba bahambe ngoba labo abazinikele ngempela bayahamba. Kodwa ngithi indlela enhle yokukhuthaza izinto ezinhle!!! Sithi kuye, qina, futhi ubonge uNkulunkulu ngokukusiza emthunzini wendawo yokufa, ngoba uma ungakabi kulolo suku oluhlelwe yingozi, enye indaba bekuzokhulunywa namuhla. Umthandazo ke uPhumzile unamandla. Ngiyazi ukuthi ubize uMdali ukuba lokhu kwenzeke, futhi umbala weza kuwe wakusindisa njengoba usaqhubeka nokudla uphuthu. Ube ngcono ngaleso sikhathi, sikhumbula! Unyaka ka-2004 usondela ekupheleni. Sonke siyazibuza ukuthi izinsuku, amasonto, nezinyanga zonyaka ziyephi! Isikhathi sishesha impela! Isizathu sokuthi sibuze konke lokhu kungenzeka ukuthi asizange senze konke esikufisayo ekuqaleni konyaka. Kube nezinhliziyo eziningi ezibuhlungu kubaningi bethu ngenxa yokungatholi izinga lokwenza umsebenzi wethu futhi labo abahlala ngaphakathi kungenzeka bangajabuli ngezinga lezimo zokuphila ababezinazo. Konke lokhu kunezimpempe ezinhle ngoba sikwazile ukuhlela nokuphuma nezinyathelo esingazithatha ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Konke lokhu kusiphakamisile kakhulu. Sibe nezindaba ezinhle zokushiya ozakwethu ngosuku lwalesi sikhathi, nalabo abashiya imindeni yabo, ngifisela nonke ukuthula. Ngakho ngalokhu, ngithi kuwo wonke amaqembu esibhedlela, umsebenzi wenu uyamangalisa, qhubekani njalo. Ngabe unyaka uphela sonke siphephile. Banikezwa izitifiketi zokwesekwa kwabo ngenyanga edlule. Bakhushuliwe ezikhundleni eziphezulu njengoba sishicilele ngenyanga edlule. Udokotela (ekhoneni lekhishi elingaphansi) umele bonke ab nurses nodokotela abaphezulu esinabo nalabo esithemba ukuthi sizoba nabo esikhathini esizayo. Ukhozi (ekhoneni lendawo yokulinda elingaphansi) umele amandla esibhedlela - lapho esibhedlela sifisa ukufinyelela khona - esibhedlela esincane nesithobekile esiya ezingeni elisha neliphezulu kakhulu. Okusele ukuthi le ndawo iyabantu baseZulu futhi sithokozisa ngamasiko ethu nezinkolelo zethu. Ukuqala kokholo olukhulu. Abantu abakha bangabakholelwa. Yingakho sibona kufanelekile ukuthi lokhu kufanele kube yingxenye yomlando wesibhedlela. Lapho siqhathanisa ukuthi sasiqhamuka kuphi ngaphambi nangalesi sikhathi, kube nehlukano olukhulu. Sikhule kakhulu futhi siqinisekile ukuthi sizophinde sikhule kuze kube yilapho siba yisibhedlela esikhulu ezweni. Lokhu kuyifiso yethu esiyifisayo. Lona umgomo wethu nezinhloso zethu zesikhathi esizayo. Imibala esiyisebenzisayo imele ukuphila, imithi, kanye nekusasa elikhanyayo. Abantu bethu, igumbi elikhiphayo yilona eliwina. Umqondo wabo unikeze isibhedlela ukukhanya okukhulu. Izinto ezifana nalezi zibaluleke kakhulu ngoba lapho sithola khona lokho abasebenzi abakukhuluma nokuthi bazizwa kanjani, futhi ngisho nokusebenza ndawonye. Ukufunda ukuhlela njengethimu kuyakhuthazwa kakhulu. Lapha sabelana ngolwazi nezifiso mayelana nesikhungo sethu. Bheka thina, manje sesinophawu lwethu olwakha. Le thokozi iyiyona! Udokotela noma um nurse ngaphansi kwesibhedlela sizothumela uUmphumulo, ngaleyo ndlela iziguli esibhedlela uma zingasetshenziswa. Sidinga ukubona ukuthi umuntu okhuthaza umphakathi kufanele abe phakathi kwethu ngosizo angakwenza. Ikliniki ngayinye ivakashelwa udokotela njalo ngesonto. Ab nurses nodokotela eziklinikini kufanele bahlale bebhalela kahle, ngakho sidinga ukwazi ukuthi umphathi ucabangani. Kukho phakathi lapho wazi khona. Sibone isidingo sokuhlela imihlangano enjengale ukuze abaphathi bazi ukuthi abasebenzi bakhuluma kanjani futhi bazwe imibuzo abasebenzi abanayo bese bephendula.
Izinkampani Zobuchwepheshe: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini imisebenzi eyinhloko yezinkampani zobuchwepheshe? Imisebenzi eyinhloko yezinkampani zobuchwepheshe ibandakanya ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhiqizwa, nokuhlinzekwa kwezixazululo zobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhilela izinto eziningi, njengesoftware, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ze-inthanethi. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Google ne-Microsoft zisebenza ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kwezokuxhumana kuya kwezobuciko bokufunda (artificial intelligence). Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe emhlabeni wamanje? Ubuchwepheshe bulethe izinzuzo eziningi, ezifana nokwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ukwenza imisebenzi ibe lula, nokusheshisa inqubo yokuthola ulwazi. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze abantu benze imisebenzi ethile, futhi kukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyehlukile ezinkampanini zobuchwepheshe ezinkulu? Izinkampani ezinkulu, njenge-Apple ne-Amazon, zihluke ngokuthi zinezimali ezinkulu, izinsiza, kanye nezikhala zocwaningo olukhulu. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhe imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, benze ucwaningo olunzulu, futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimfuno zemakethe. Izinselelo zabo zifaka phakathi ukuncintisana nezinkampani ezincane ezithuthuka ngokushesha. Umbuzo 4: Ukubuyekezwa kwemikhiqizo yokuthengisa kuyini, futhi kungani kubalulekile? Ukubuyekezwa kwemikhiqizo yokuthengisa kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ihlangabezana nezidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ukwethembeka kwabathengi futhi kuhambisana nemithetho nemigomo yokusebenza. Izinkampani eziphumelelayo zihlala zihlola impendulo yabathengi ukuze zithuthukise imikhiqizo yazo. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zinezibopho zomphakathi? Yebo, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zinezibopho zomphakathi. Zidingeka ukuba zisebenze ngendlela ethinta kahle umphakathi, ziqinise imithetho yokuziphatha, futhi zisebenzise izinsiza zazo ukwenza izinguquko ezinhle. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukweseka imfundo, ukunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle emvelweni, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufinyelela kulabo abangenayo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinkinga ezibhekene nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe? Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa nokuphepha kwedatha, ukugcina imithetho yokusebenza, nokuncintisana okuqinile. Ukuphepha kwedatha kubalulekile, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukuvikela ulwazi lwabathengi bazo. Ukwenza lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuvikela. Umbuzo 7: Kungani izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibalulekile emnothweni? Izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibalulekile emnothweni ngoba zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha, zandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zithuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Ukuvuselelwa kwezobuchwepheshe kudala amathuba amasha, kuthuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo, okwandisa umnotho jikelele. Umbuzo 8: Yini okuthandwa kakhulu kubathengi emikhiqizweni yezobuchwepheshe? Abathengi bathanda imikhiqizo ethuthukisiwe, elula ukuyisebenzisa, futhi enezici ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Umsebenzi wokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe bokufunda, kanye nezinqubo eziguquguqukayo zenze imikhiqizo ibe neqhaza elikhulu kubathengi. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Samsung ne-Apple zikhokhela imakethe ngenxa yokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Umbuzo 9: Ukuzibandakanya kwezinkampani zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini kubaluleke kangakanani? Ukuzibandakanya kwezinkampani zobuchwepheshe emiphakathini kubalulekile ngoba kuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani nabathengi. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana, kwenza izinkampani zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, futhi kukhuthaza ukukhula okuthuthukisiwe. Izinkampani ezikhuthaza umphakathi zikhulisa ukwethembeka kwabathengi. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe? Emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, sizobona ukuthuthuka okukhulu ezindabeni ezifana ne-artificial intelligence, i-blockchain, nezixazululo ezihlakaniphile. Lezi zinto zizothuthukisa indlela esiphila ngayo, sikhuluma, futhi sikhokha. Ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwezobuchwepheshe kuzokwandisa amathuba, nokwenza kube lula ukuphila kwabantu. Ngamafuphi, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe zibalulekile emhlabeni wethu, zikhuthaza ukwakheka kobuchwepheshe obusha, futhi ziba nethonya elikhulu emnothweni nasemiphakathini. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani nabathengi kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa eliyinqaba.
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Kwazulu, emhlabeni ogcwele izimanga, kukhona izindawo eziningi ezisemqoka ezikhona ukuze ziqinisekise impilo nokuphila kahle kwabantu. Kukhona izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72, ezihlanganisa izindawo ezahlukene, ezibhekelela izidingo zomphakathi. Lezi zikhungo zikhona ezindaweni ezikude neziseduzane, ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, sithola izikhungo ezinkulu ezisemadolobheni, lapho kubonakala khona izinsiza ezithuthukile, odokotela abanolwazi, nezinsiza zokwelapha ezisebenzayo. Lezi zikhungo zihlala ziqhuba imisebenzi yokuvikela impilo, njengezinhlelo zokuhlola izifo ezithathelwana, kanye nezifundo zokuphila kahle. Umphakathi uthola ithuba lokuthola imishanguzo, izeluleko zokudla, kanye nezifundo zokuzivocavoca. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, sithola izikhungo ezincane ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bathole usizo lwezempilo. Lezi zikhungo zihlala zisebenza ngezindlela ezithile, zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala benza imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zisebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Njengoba abantu behlangana ezikhungweni, kuba nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo, lapho abantu babelana ngemicabango nezinto abahlangabezane nazo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zihlala ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imihlangano yokwazisa, lapho abantu beziswa ngezifo ezithile, izindlela zokuzivimbela, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyazi kahle izindlela zokuphila kahle, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa izinga lezifo. Ngenxa yokusebenza kwalezi zikhungo, umphakathi uthola ithuba lokuthola imishanguzo, izeluleko zokudla, kanye nezifundo zokuzivocavoca. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba impilo ibaluleke kakhulu. Izikhungo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zisebenza ngokuqinile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukile. Lokhu kubandakanya izinhlelo zokwelapha ezithinta izifo ezinzima, njengokwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo, izifo zempilo yengqondo, kanye nezifo ezithathelwana. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala beqeqeshwe ukuze banikeze usizo olufanele, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Ekugcineni, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Njengoba umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, lezi zikhungo ziza nezixazululo ezithuthukisa impilo. Umhlaba unothando, futhi izikhungo zezempilo zikhombisa ukuthi impilo iyigugu elikhulu, elidinga ukunakekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Ngakho-ke, uma uhamba ezikhungweni zezempilo, khumbula ukuthi lezi zindawo azikhona nje kuphela zokwelapha, kodwa zikhona ukuze ziqinise umphakathi. Zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi impilo iyinto engaphezulu kokuphila—iyinto yokuphila kahle, yokubambisana, nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba impilo ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi izikhungo zezempilo ziyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sidinga ukusizana ukuze siphile kahle.
Ibhakabhaka lekhanda lekhanda liyisithiyo esitholakala ezindaweni zonke lapho kukhula khona ummbila e-Afrika - lesi sithiyo sitholakala kuphela e-Afrika kanti nezinye izinhlobo zalo zihlala ezindaweni lapho ummbila ukhula khona. Ngokuvamile, singasho ukuthi lesi sithiyo sikhombisa ingozi efana no-10% yokukhiqizwa kommbila ngonyaka - kodwa singalimaza yonke imiphumela. Ama-larvae adla ezithelweni, ezitheni, nasezimbali zommbila. Ulwazi mayelana ne-biology nokuthi lesi sithiyo siphila kanjani kubalulekile uma sizama ukuqonda indlela yokulawula nokukhipha lesi sithiyo. Ama-larvae asemdala aphila ezitshalweni zommbila ezihlala ezindaweni ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngemuva kwalokho, isizukulwane sokuqala sezinambuzane sivele ukuze sibe neziqhamo ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-7 kuya kwezi-10. Ama-larvae aphumayo azodla amasonto ayisithupha bese eguquka abe ama-pupae ngaphakathi ezitheni zommbila. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu, ezinye izinambuzane zivele futhi ziqhube ingozi kuyo yonke indawo lapho zihlala khona. Ekuhlwanyeleni, kunezindlela eziningi zokulawula lesi sithiyo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwemichiza, izinhlobo zezithombo, izindlela zemvelo, kanye nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izithiyo. Lokhu ngeke kuqinisekise ukususa ngokuphelele kodwa kuzokusiza ukuphatha lesi sifo ngaphandle kokusabalala nokuthola umkhiqizo omuhle. Imichiza yokulawula ibhakabhaka lekhanda ibhaliswe njengezithiyo ezithinta noma izithiyo ezibulalayo uma zidliwa yilesi sithiyo. Kukhona abantu abacabanga ukuthi imichiza ebizayo ingcono, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezishibhile ezisebenza kahle. Kuthiwa ukuphatha lesi sithiyo ngemithi engabulali phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-6 kungase kube nokungabaza. Ngenxa kwezindleko zemichiza, abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayisebenzisa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuphalaza imichiza kusenesikhathi kubonakale kungasebenzi. Ukuphatha lesi sithiyo ngemichiza kufanele kwenzeke kuphela uma kubonwa ukuthi u-10% wezithombo ukhombisa izimpawu zengozi ngoba ama-larvae aqala ukudla ezithelweni. Ukuhlola ingozi ye-10% kungaba uphawu lokufaka imichiza ngesikhathi esifanele. Mhlawumbe ukuphalaza kuphela kungase kungabi yanele ngoba lesi sithiyo singavela futhi. Ngonyaka onjengalona, kungase kudingeke ukuhlola ngokucophelela ama-larvae uma ummbila uqala ukukhula. Uma ama-larvae amancane engabulawa ngokushesha ngaphambi kokulimaza okukhulu emasimini. Kufanele uzame ukususa lawa ma-larvae ngaphambi kokuthi ummbila ufinyelele cishe u-50% wokukhula. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlobo ze-Bt-maize kwehlelile ingozi yokungena kwezithiyo ngoba ngokuvamile azidliwa ibhakabhaka lekhanda. Lokhu kwenze imichiza ingadingeki kakhulu ngoba kukhona igene elibulalayo ama-larvae aleli sithiyo. Nokho, hhayi zonke izinhlobo ze-Bt-maize zisebenza kahle ngokufanayo nebhakabhaka lekhanda - ngakho-ke, abalimi kufanele bakhethe kahle ukuthi yisiphi isivuno okufanele bakhulise unyaka ozayo naphakade. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) kufanele bazi ukuthi kunezinsuku eziyishumi lapho ama-larvae ebhakabhaka lekhanda angadla ummbila. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba imichiza ixhumana nemvula etholakala esitsheni sommbila, ivumela ama-larvae ukuba aphile. Igozi elibangelwa yalesi sithiyo lizovela ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa ngeke kube yingozi enkulu. Lawa ma-larvae azokhiqiza izinambuzane ezizovunguza unyaka omusha. Uma ukhetha ukufaka imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi iyiphi inketho enezindleko eziphakeme ngoba i-Bt-maize ibiza kakhulu. Ukuhlwanyela ebusika kungasiza ngoba izithiyo ezihlala ezitshalweni zommbila emasimini zizobulawa futhi ngeke zibuye zivele unyaka olandelayo. Futhi, ubusika obubandayo buzobulala ezinye. Uma kutshalwa ebusika, kungaholela ekutheni ama-larvae aletheke emhlabathini, futhi izinambuzane azizukwazi ukuphuma futhi zibhakabhake unyaka omusha. Kukhona ezinye izibungu ezivamile ukudla amaqanda nama-larvae ezithiyo, kodwa azinciphisi kakhulu ingozi edalwayo. Abanye abalimi abangatshali izindawo ezinkulu bangazama ukutshala utshani obubizwa ngokuthi i-Napier - izithiyo zangenela emasimini futhi zishiya ummbila. Kodwa noma abanye abalimi abakhulu bangazama ukutshala lobu butshani ngoba buhle ukudla kwezinkomo. Izindlela zemvelo nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izithiyo azisebenzi kahle - kungcono ukuzama imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize. Bonke abalimi bommbila bayazi kahle ukuthi ibhakabhaka lekhanda libeka ingozi enkulu. Kufanele kulawulwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Kwenzeka ngaleso sikhathi esinzima, ngesikhathi lapho umhlaba ubhekene ne-COVID-19. Izingane zazivame ukujabulisa, kodwa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezithile babezizwa belahlekile, besala ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. Kulokhu, uhulumeni weNingizimu Afrika wenza isinqumo esibalulekile sokwethula isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant. UThandi, umama oneminyaka engama-42, wayenobunzima bokuphila. Uhlala emzaneni omncane, eSoweto, lapho imisebenzi ibingekho njalo. Umkhaya wakhe wawudinga ukudla, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngemva kokufunda ngalesi sibonelelo, uThandi wanquma ukuba azame ukuthola ukwesekwa. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uThandi wathola izaziso zokuthi uzothola lesi sibonelelo. Wathola u-R350 ngenyanga, okwakuyisithako esincane sokuthuthukisa impilo yakhe nemindeni yakhe. Lokhu kwaba wumsebenzi omkhulu, njengoba wabona ukuthi angathenga ukudla okwakudingeka kakhulu. UThandi wathenga izithelo, imifino, nemikhiqizo yokudla eyayidlayo. Waqala nokufundisa izingane zakhe ukuthi zabelane ngalokho abakutholayo. Ukubambisana nomndeni wakubo, baqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke bayaphila, bahlala bexhumene. Lokhu kube yindlela yokwakha umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabo, nakuba babezizwa benomthwalo. Kodwa-ke, akuzange kube lula. Ubunzima bokuqala bukhona lapho uThandi ehlangana nezinkinga zokusebenzisa lesi sibonelelo. Kwakudingeka ukuthi abhalise ku-inthanethi, futhi lokho kwaba nzima ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza. UThandi waphinde wabhekana nezinkinga zokufinyelela kwi-inthanethi, okwakuphazamisa ukuqhubeka kwakhe. Ngemva kwamasonto ambalwa, uThandi waqinisekisa ukuthi ubhalisile. Wathola isikhumbuzo sokuthi uzothola imali yakhe, futhi lokho kwamlethela ithemba. UThandi waba nesizotha, futhi wayenombono omuhle wokuthi izinsuku ezizayo zizoba ngcono. Ekuhambeni kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukuhlela kahle ukusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo. Wazama ukugcina ingxenye encane yokubhalela imfundo yezingane zakhe, eqinisekisa ukuthi bazoba nekhono lokuphila elingcono esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi uThandi wayejabule ngokwazi ukuthi ubakhathalela. Nokho, abanye emzaneni babebona uThandi edlula. Kwavela imibuzo, nokungabaza, nokukhuluma okungathandeki. Abanye babecabanga ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sasingekho, futhi sathathwa kalula. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi, kodwa uThandi wachaza ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawuwusizo. Wayengazama ukuzama ukuze abone ukuthi abanye baphila kanjani. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, uThandi waqala ukufuna izindlela zokwenza imali engaphezulu. Waqala ukuthengisa izithelo nemifino emakhaya, ebamba imfashini yendlu. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha, futhi uThandi waphumelela ekwakheni umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Izinsiza ezitholakalayo zazisiza ekuhlinzekeni ngemfundo ezizayo. UThandi uphumelele ukukhokhela abantwana bakhe imfundo, futhi umndeni wakhe waqala ukuhlala kahle. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sathinta impilo yakhe, samnika ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono. UThandi wabona ukuthi imizamo yakhe, nokuhlanganyela nomndeni, bekuyinto ebalulekile ekuphumeleleni. Noma kunjalo, uThandi akazange akhohlwe abanye abangenamathuba. Waqhubeka nokusekela abanye, ebakhuthaza ukuthi bafune izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kwavula umoya wokubambisana emzaneni, futhi abantu baqonda ukuthi badinga ukusebenzisana ukuze baphumelele. UThandi wayephila ngezinsuku ezinzima, kodwa isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant samnika ithuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Waqonda ukuthi, nakuba ubunzima buhlala bukhona, uNkulunkulu wayekanye nabo, futhi izinsuku ezinhle zazizofika. Ngaleyondlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabambisana kanjani ukuze uphumelele, futhi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zingaba yindlela yokuphila. Ubuye wathola ukuthi umphakathi ungabambisana ukuze ufinyelele empumelelweni. Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sathuthukisa impilo yakhe, futhi uThandi waba ngumama okhuthazayo, ebakhuthaza abanye ukuthi baphumelele. Ngempela, izinto ezinzima zingaholela kwezinye, futhi ngezifiso ezinhle, ukuphila kungaba ngcono. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi imizamo, uthando, nokubambisana kungaguqula impilo.
Ukufuduka Kwezakhamuzi Zangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika kubalulekile emlandweni wezwe, kuhlobene nezigigaba ezahlukene ezithinta impilo, umnotho, nezokuhlaliswa. Lokhu kufuduka kuhambisana nezimo zomnotho, izimpilo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nobudlelwano phakathi kwezakhamuzi zendawo nezangaphandle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu zokufuduka, izinselelo, kanye nemiphumela ethinta umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Izizathu Zokufuduka Izizathu zokufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle zihlukaniswa ngezici ezahlukene, njengezomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezokuhlaliswa. Abantu abaningi bafuduka befuna amathuba angcono emsebenzini, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela emazweni anobunzima bezomnotho noma ezepolitiki. Ngokwesibonelo, abantu abavela eZimbabwe, eMozambique, naseMalawi bahlala begxile eNingizimu Afrika ngenxa yokukhula komnotho kanye namathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Lokhu kudala ukwanda kwezisebenzi, okwenza kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimbonini ezifana nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezinsiza. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo ezinzima emazweni afana neSyria ne-Afghanistan zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphume ezweni labo, befuna ukuphepha nokuthula. Ukuqhuma kwezinsongo ezibangelwa yizimpi, izinhlekelele zemvelo, kanye nezimo ezinzima zokuphila kuholela emiphumeleni ethile yokufuduka. KwaNingizimu Afrika, abantu abaningi befuna ukuphila kahle, umphakathi ophumelelayo, kanye namathuba afana nemfundo engcono. Izinsiza Nezinselelo Zokuhlaliswa Nakuba ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle kunikeza amathuba, kuza nezinsiza ezinzima. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zikhulu zihlala kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinselelo ezihlobene nezokuhlaliswa. Njengoba abantu bangaphandle befika, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsiza zezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni evikelekile, futhi banelungelo lokuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo, kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Izinselelo zizophinde zikhule uma kukhona umbandela omubi phakathi kwezindawo zabantu bendabuko nezangaphandle, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi eyahlukanisiwe. Lokhu kungadala umqondo wokuphikisana okungase kubangele izinkinga zokuqonda, ubuhlobo obubi, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Imiphumela Yomphakathi Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika kunezimpande ezijulile emiphumeleni eminingi yomphakathi. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi emisha, ethinta imikhuba yokuphila, izinkolelo, nezilimi. Ukuxuba kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi eyingqayizivele, enezinhlobonhlobo zezemfundo, izinkolelo, nezinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kungaba yinzuzo enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, okhuthazayo, kanye nokuthuthukisa izindlela ezintsha zokucabanga. Kodwa-ke, imiphumela ingase ibe nemiphumela emibi njengoba abantu bangaphandle bahlupheka ngezinkinga zomnotho, ubuhlanga, nezokuphila. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi ethile ebhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu, njengezinga eliphezulu lokuphila, ukungasebenzi, nokungabi nandaba komphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zezakhamuzi zendawo, okwenza kube baluleke kakhulu ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onezinto ezahlukene ezithinta izimo zomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezokuhlaliswa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu, izinsiza, nezinselelo ezihlobene nalolu hlobo lokufuduka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi oseNingizimu Afrika uhlala ubumbene, kudingeka ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwezizinda zempilo, izinhlelo zempilo, kanye nezinsiza. Ngakho-ke, ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle kufanele kubhekwane ngeso elibanzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unokuthula, ubumbene, futhi ufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphila.
Impi yaseSandlwana Impi yaseSandlwana yabakhona ngomhla wesithathu kuJanuwari ngonyaka ka-1879, ngesikhathi seMpi enkulu phakathi kwamaNgisi namaZulu. Le mpi yenzeka edolobheni laseSandlwana eliseNingizimu Afrika, ngenhloso yokuthola ubukhosi nokulawula izwe lamaZulu. Iziphathimandla zaseBrithani zazibuye zenze uhlelo lokukhulisa ububanzi bomhlaba ezinhlakeni ezisemngceleni, okwaholela ekwakheni impi phakathi kwalezi zizwe ezimbili ezahlukahlukene. Ibandla laseBrithani lenza uhlu lwezinhlelo zokuthumba umhlaba wamaZulu, okwakuholwa nguGenerali Lord Chelmsford. Ukungezelela, uLord Chelmsford wayephethe amabutho amakhulu, efuna ukuhlela ukufika kwawo eMashonaland. Kodwa, lokhu kwaholela ekwehlukaneni kwemibono phakathi kwamaZulu kanye neNhlangano yeNgilandi. Phambi kokuthi impi iqale, amaZulu ahleleke kahle, ahlela isu lokuvukela izitha. Umholi wamaZulu, uCetshwayo, wahlela izinhlelo zokulwa ezifanele ukuvikela izwe lakubo. Abangani, ubudlelwano phakathi kwezigaba zezenhlalo zamazwe bobabili bubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu zezimpi. AmaZulu akubona ubudlelwano obunzima, okwakuholela ekuphikisaneni phakathi kwezizwe. Ngonyaka ka-1877, uLord Chelmsford weza nezinhlelo eziphathelene nezombangazwe, ethubela iMpi yaseSandlwana. Yize kwaba nezinhlelo ezihlukene, abanye abantu bakubona njengezithiyo ezinkulu phakathi kweNgilandi namaZulu. Ubuqili, ubuhlakani, kanye nohlaka lwezinhlelo zamabutho kwaba yizinto ezibalulekile ezadonsela phansi isizwe samaZulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sekuvele kudingeka ukuba amaZulu ahlakaniphe, abhekane nempi nokusungula isu lokuvikela. Noma kungekho imishini ephakeme, amaZulu abephethe izikhali ezilula, kodwa kuphinde kwaba nesimo esinzima samaNgisi, abephethe izikhali zokugcina, izibhamu ezinzima, nokunye. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kumaNgisi ukuthola amandla asemhlabeni. Ngenxa yokuhamba kwesikhathi, impi yaqala. AmaZulu, animazi kahle ukuthatha izikhali, asebenzisa ukukhombisa ukuvukela izitha zawo. Impi yaseSandlwana yahlaba umxhwele ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo avela ezaze zihlukanisiwe. Kwakukhona abafana abanjengo- uNokuthula ongumholi wezempilo, obehola impi yokuhlobisa. Ngesehlo esikhethekile, impi yathatha umjikelezo ofanele; qhubeka inhlonipho yamaZulu yaba yimpumelelo enkulu engaziwa. Klunga, izinyathelo zikaNokuthula naseziphathimendeni zaba nzima ngesikhathi sokulwa. Kwakukhona izinzwa ezinzima ezingafanelekile phakathi kwamaNgisi, kuze kube sekupheleni, uma uLord Chelmsford ebona umgibeli wempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kokulawulwa, amaZulu akhuthaza okubili, ukumelana kwamadlozi. Ukuqeqeshwa bekwaziwa ngenkani zaba umphumela omuhle. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenziweni okukhulu, iMpi yaseSandlwana yabonakala futhi yahlaba umxhwele ezinkundleni. Ngokuhamba isikhathi, impi yaphinde yathinta umoya wabantu. Uhlelo lwezombangazwe lwashintsha, futhi le mpi yabonakala iyisibonelo esicacile sokuphikisana phakathi kwesiyingi esiyalwayo. Kwakukhona ubuhlakani obusha phakathi kweNgilandi namaZulu, futhi lokho kuzozibambezela umoya wezimpi. Lokhu kwazisa ukuthi isizwe samaZulu sasingathanda ukukhiqiza izinsizakalo ezinkulu ukukwazi ukuphoqelela izinqumo. Ngemuva kokulwa, izimpilo zabantu zashintsha ngokuphawulekayo. Ekugcineni, abantu baseSandlwana bahlala bebanjwa ukukhalipha ngempilo yabo. Noma injabulo yayiqhubekela phambili, impi yaseSandlwana yahloniphekayo emlandweni wamaZulu. Lokhu kwaholela emlandweni wamaZulu neNgilandi, nakuba bobabili bephikisana. Ubuqili bamaZulu bukhombisa uthando lwabo lwezwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kusemkhathini omusha owawusarandi imiphumela ebalulekile emakhaya. Iziphathimandla zaseBrithani zaba nemisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi yokulawula izwe lamaZulu, kwazungezile izinsuku ezinzima zokwenza. Ubusuku bube nzima, bevarasimanga ekuphikisaneni kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokuncintisana kodwa, izinkulungwane zabantu zafunda kulesi sidvwa esiyimpumelelo. Ekupheleni, impi yaseSandlwana ingomunye wempi ezithandwayo emlandweni wabantu base-Afrika. Ihlonishwa emlandweni wamaZulu, futhi iyisibonelo sokukhumbula igama lempi, lokho kuholela ekwakheni ukukhumbula ngobuhle bamasiko. Ngesikhathi esifanele, le mpi iyinkumbudzo yokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukahlukene, nokuqonda isimo sobuhlanga. Kumele sikhumbule impi yaseSandlwana njengemfundo enkulu emlandweni, ukuze sihloniphe imvelaphi yethu.
Ezokukhiqiza: Umgomo Wokwakha Ikusasa Elinempilo Ezokukhiqiza, noma i-manufacturing, ziwumgogodla wezomnotho emhlabeni. Le mboni ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ekwakheni imikhiqizo, kodwa futhi ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ukwenyusa izinga lempilo, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le mboni ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yethu nasemphakathini. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ezokukhiqiza akuhambisani nje nokukhiqiza izinto, kodwa kuyinqubo ehlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, izinsiza, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlelwa kahle, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele, kanye nokuba nezinqubo ezisebenzayo. Uma lokhu kungafinyeleli, umkhiqizo ungase ungahlangabezani nezidingo zabathengi, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali nasekunciphiseni ukwaneliseka kwabathengi. Ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula kakhulu indlela esikhiqiza ngayo. Izimboni ziye zathuthukiswa ngezindlela eziningi, kusukela ekusetshenzisweni kwemishini ethuthukisiwe kuya ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenza kahle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ezokukhiqiza kumele zihlale zikhona futhi ziqhubeke zithuthuka ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu, ikakhulukazi ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo. Ezokukhiqiza zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezindaweni ezithola amathuba amancane. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banethuba lokuphila kahle, baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Imisebenzi ethuthukisiwe, efana nezobuchwepheshe, ibonisa ukuthi abantu bangathola amathuba angcono, okwandisa izinga lempilo. Nokho, imboni yokukhiqiza ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhulu, izindleko zokukhiqiza ezikhulayo, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo emakethe zenza kube nzima kubakhiqizi ukuba bahlale bephambili. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi imboni ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokukhiqiza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokufaka i-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-automation, kungasiza ekwenzeni izinqubo zibe lula, zisheshise ukukhiqiza, futhi zinciphise izindleko. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo, okukhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezisebenzi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinqubomgomo ezizokwenza imboni ikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ukuze sikwazi ukwakha imboni eqinile, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abakhiqizi, ikakhulukazi abancane nabaphakathi, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili futhi bakhe imikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza imboni yokukhiqiza ukuba ibheke phambili, okuhlanganisa ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo emisha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni yabo. Ekugcineni, ezokukhiqiza ziwumgogodla wezomnotho, futhi zidinga ukuba ziqhubeke zikhula, zithuthuke, futhi zibe nezinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo esezingeni eliphezulu, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Njengabantu, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuxhasa le mboni ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono futhi sakhe ikusasa elinempilo. Ngakho, asithathe ithuba lokwakha imboni yokukhiqiza eqinile, ethuthukile, futhi enobuchwepheshe, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery I-Mthombo Oil Refinery iyiphrojekthi ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika, eyaziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngamafutha aphezulu, futhi ibalulekile ekukhuleni komnotho kanye nasekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zokuhamba. Le phrojekthi yadalwa ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zamafutha ezweni, ikakhulukazi njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo zokuncika kumafutha avela kwamanye amazwe. ### Ukusungulwa kwePhrojekthi Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery uqala eminyakeni yama-2000, lapho uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uqala ukucabangela izindlela zokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithinta umnotho, njengoba izindleko zokuthenga amafutha avela phesheya zikhuphuka. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, uhulumeni wahlela ukwakha imboni yokucubungula amafutha, okwakuzoba yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. ### Ukuhlola Izindawo Ngemuva kokuhlola izindawo ezahlukene, kwatholakala ukuthi indawo efanele yokwakha i-refinery ibikwiMthombo, eduze kwedolobha lasePort Elizabeth. Le ndawo yathathwa njengendawo efanelekile ngenxa yokwakheka kwayo, okuyenza kube lula ukuhamba nokuhambisa amafutha. Ukuhlola le ndawo kwahlanganisa izifundo eziningi ezazihlosiwe, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola izimo zezulu, imithombo yemvelo, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. ### Ukuxhaswa Kwezimali Ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery kudinga uxhaso lwezimali olukhulu. Uhulumeni wahlanganisa izinsiza ezivela ezinkampanini ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa abaxhasi bamazwe aphesheya. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezinkampani ezinkulu, okuhlanganisa nezinhlangano ezizimele, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iphrojekthi izoba yimpumelelo. ### Ukwakha Nokuhlinzeka Ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery kwaqala ngonyaka ka-2010, futhi kwathatha iminyaka eminingana ukuze kuqedwe. Le nqubo yokwakha yahluka kakhulu, ihlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi zokwakha, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi. Ukusebenza kwale phrojekthi kudinga abasebenzi abanekhono, futhi kwavula amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini yasendaweni. ### Ukusebenza Kwe-Refinery Ngokuphothulwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery, imboni yokuqala yama-refinery eNingizimu Afrika yatholakala, futhi yathuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha. Le refinery inezinga eliphezulu lokucubungula, ikwazi ukukhiqiza amafutha ahlukeneyo, okuhlanganisa amafutha enjini, amafutha okudla, kanye nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa emikhakheni ehlukene. ### Umthelela Emnothweni Ukwakhiwa kweMthombo Oil Refinery kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwandise ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha, kwavula amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kwathuthukisa imisebenzi yezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le refinery yathuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu bendawo, njengoba izinkampani ezincane zathola amathuba okukhula. ### Izingozi Nezinkinga Noma kunjalo, iMthombo Oil Refinery ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Izingozi zokungcola kwemvelo zikhona, njengoba imboni yokucubungula amafutha ingaba nemiphumela emibi emvelweni. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, uhulumeni kanye nezinkampani ezihlanganyela kule phrojekthi bahlongoza izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela imvelo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa izindlela zokucubungula ezihlanzekile, kanye nokuhlola izinga lokungcoliswa kwemvelo. ### Ikusasa leMthombo Oil Refinery I-Mthombo Oil Refinery ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezimboni zokucubungula amafutha kuzoba nomthelela omuhle ekukhuleni komnotho, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngama-fuel ahlanzekile. Ukuze le phrojekthi iqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi. ### Isiphetho Umlando weMthombo Oil Refinery ubonisa ukuthi imiphumela emihle ingatholakala uma uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisana ukuze bakhe izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Le phrojekthi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile, futhi ibonisa indlela yokuthuthukisa izinsiza zamafutha eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, iMthombo Oil Refinery iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi imizamo yokwakha imboni yokucubungula amafutha ingaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu.
Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngaphakathi Kwezikhathi Zamaholide Ezikhathini zamaholide, lapho abantu bezithokozisa, behlangana nemindeni, futhi bejabulisa, kuningi okukhathazayo okungase kwenzeke. Izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi ngaphansi kwezimo ezinjalo, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ziba nendima ebalulekile. Nokho, kufanele sihlole ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zikhona yini ngempela ngezikhathi zamaholide, futhi uma zikhona, ngabe zikhona yini izinselelo ezithile ezihambisana nazo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo, ezifana nezokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezokuthutha, zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ngezikhathi zamaholide. Njengoba abantu behamba, bezijabulisa, noma behlangana, kunokwanda kokuba nemicimbi engalindelekile. Isibonelo, umuntu angase adingeke ukuthi ahunyushwe esibhedlela ngenxa yokulimala noma ukugula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo zezimo eziphuthumayo kumele ziqiniseke ukuthi zikhona ukuze zikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha. Kodwa-ke, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zihlala zinezinkinga zazo. Ngesikhathi samaholide, iziguli ziba ziningi, futhi izikhungo ezinjengezibhedlela zingabhekana nengcindezi enkulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezikhathi ezide zokulinda, okungathinta impilo yabantu abadinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Ngakho-ke, kuyacaca ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo akufanele zihlale zinciphisa ukusebenza kwazo ngezikhathi zamaholide. Ngakho, kungani kufanele kube nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezithuthuke ngezikhathi zamaholide? Omkhulu umbono ukuthi, uma abantu bejabule, kumele bazi futhi bakhumbule ukuthi izinsizakalo kufanele zibe khona ukuze babagcine bephephile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi bezibhedlela, izikhungo zokuphepha, nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo baphakathi kokuhlela okukhulu ngaphambi kwesikhathi samaholide. Ukuhlelwa kwesikhathi esifanele kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona, futhi izinsiza zanele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abaphathi bezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi izinsizakalo zabo zikhona ngempela. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi nezikhungo, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kusebenza ngezikhathi zamaholide kulula uma kuqinisekiswa ukuthi abantu banolwazi olufanele lwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kulokhu, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kube nezinsizakalo ezithile ezithuthukisa izimo eziphuthumayo ngezikhathi zamaholide. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana zikhona ukuze kube ne-ambulance ehamba phambili, izithuthi eziphuthumayo ezitholakalayo, nezikhungo zempilo ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zingase zibe nethuba lokwenza kahle, uma ziqondiswa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili njengama-drone namakhompyutha ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuhlolwa. Lezi zinsizakalo zingaba nezindleko ezinzima, kodwa uma zisebenza kahle, zingavumela ukuphendula ngokushesha okukhulu kumalungelo abantu. Ngakho, kudingeka ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukwakhiwa nokuqiniswa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo esemthethweni nezidingo eziphuthumayo. Noma kunjalo, izinkinga ezilandelayo zibhalwe phansi. Abantu abavame ukuhamba ngezikhathi zamaholide, abanye bahamba nabezinto ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikhungo ziqinise ukuqapha. Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo kumele kube nokuqonda okukhulu ngemvelo yezinto ezinjalo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube neziqu eziphumelelayo phakathi kweziguli, abezokuphepha, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo. Ngokuphetha, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ngezikhathi zamaholide zibalulekile. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kudingeka ukuba ziqondiswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kube nezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Abaphathi, ososayensi, nabalawuli kumele baphokophele ukwakha izinsizakalo ezizokwazi ukuphendula izidingo zomphakathi. Uma sihamba phambili, kufanele siqhubeke sikhumbula ukuthi impilo ibaluleke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi eziyimfihlo zomphakathi. Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo kumele zibe khona, futhi zisebenze kahle ngezikhathi zamaholide ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuthokozisa kwethu.
Ezokuthengisa: Uhlanga Oludlula Izingqinamba Ezokuthengisa, noma i-marketing, zibalulekile ukuze amabhizinisi aphumelele. Uma imikhiqizo ingenakufinyelelwa, izokwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi ukuthola inzuzo. Nokho, kunezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nezindlela ezahlukene zokuthengisa, izimiso zayo, kanye nomthelela wayo emphakathini. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo nezingozi ezihlobene nezokuthengisa ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi zisebenza kanjani ezimpilweni zethu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ezokuthengisa ziwusizo olukhulu kwezomnotho wanamuhla. Izinhlangano eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuthengisa ukuze zifinyelele emakethe, kuhilela ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokumaketha ku-inthanethi, izikhangiso ezikwi-social media, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Lezi zindlela zenza kube lula ukufinyelela izithameli eziningi, zikhuthaza ukuthengwa kwemikhiqizo, futhi zandisa ubukhona bebhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuthengisa zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile kumakhasimende, okuthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabo emikhiqizweni. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nezokuthengisa. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuqhubekayo kokukhwabanisa. Abathengisi abanobuqili bangase basebenzise izindlela ezingezinhle, ezinjengokukhanga abantu ngemikhiqizo engaqinisekisiwe. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni amakhasimende azizwe edukile. Izikhangiso eziningi zikhombisa izithombe eziphakeme kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima kumakhasimende ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Lokhu kubangela ukungaqondi kahle, okungaholela ekutheni abantu benze izinqumo ezingalungile zokuthenga. Ukusebenzisa izindlela ezinzima zokuthengisa kungaholela ekuncipheni kokuhlangenwe nakho kwabathengi. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abathengi bazizwe bephushwa ukuba bathenge imikhiqizo engasekho emandleni abo, okungaholela ezinselelweni zezezimali. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ezokuthengisa zingathuthukisa umnotho. Uma amabhizinisi ethola inzuzo, akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqashwa, okukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho. Lokhu kubalulekile ezinkampanini ezincane, ezidinga ukusekelwa ukuze zikhule. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuthengisa zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo ethuthukile, ethokozisayo, nokwenza kube nokuncintisana okuhle emakethe, okwandisa izinga lokuphila. Nokho, akufanele sikhohlwe ngemithetho nemigomo ethile ezokuthengisa. Ukuze zisebenze kahle, kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubomgomo ezivikelekile ukuze kuvinjwe izindlela ezimbi, okuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwamakhasimende, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo iyatholakala, nokuthi izikhangiso zikhombisa iqiniso. Ukuze sithole umphumela ophumelelayo, kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, ezihloniphekile, nezibambisene phakathi kwabathengisi, abathengi, kanye nohulumeni. Ekugcineni, ezokuthengisa zibalulekile empilweni yethu, kodwa kudinga ukusetyenziswa ngokuqonda. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, nokuhlonipha imithetho, kuzokwenza kube nokuthula phakathi kwezokuthengisa. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele, ezokuthengisa zingaba yinsiza enkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okuqinisekisa ukuthi ezokuthengisa zihlala zisebenza ngendlela efanele.
Umbiko Ngemva KweNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo Isingeniso I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo iyisikhungo esibalulekile emhlabeni wezomthetho, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkantolo ibhekelela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthethosisekelo wezwe uyagcinwa, futhi izinqumo zayo zihlala ziqinisa amalungelo abantu. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizobheka imisebenzi, izinjongo, kanye nemiphumela yeNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo, ukuze siqonde indima yayo ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Umsebenzi Wenkantolo Yomthethosisekelo I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo inezinhloso eziningi, kodwa eyinhloko wukuhlola nokuhlukanisa izinqumo ezithathwe ngabezinye izinkantolo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zihambisana nomthethosisekelo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba umthethosisekelo ungumgogodla wezomthetho eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kufanele ube yisisekelo sokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi. I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibuye ibhekelele izicelo zokuhlola izinqumo ezithile ezithathwe ngabezinye iziphathimandla, ikakhulukazi uma lezi zinqumo zingahambisani nemigomo ethile yomthethosisekelo. Izinhlelo Zokusebenza I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo isebenza ngezindlela ezahlukene ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi umthethosisekelo uyagcinwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izicelo ezivela kubantu, izinkampani, noma iziphathimandla, ezicela ukuthi le nkantolo ibheke izinqumo ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNkantolo ibamba imihlangano yokuxoxisana, lapho abameli bezinhlangano ezahlukene bephakamisa izinkinga ezithinta amalungelo abantu. Lezi zinhlelo zenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bathole ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo zihlala ziqinisa amalungelo abantu. Izinkinga Ezibhekene NeNkantolo Noma iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yisidingo sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngesikhathi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kwezicelo, okungaholela ekutheni abantu bahlupheke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqumo ezithathwe yiNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo zingase zibe nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinqumo zithathwe ngokucophelela. Umthelela Wenkantolo Yomthethosisekelo Umthelela weNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ungaphezu kokuhlola izinqumo. Le nkantolo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho amalungelo abantu ehlonishwa. Izinqumo zayo zihlala ziqinisa umthethosisekelo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bazi amalungelo abo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umphakathi onolwazi ngamalungelo awo ungaba namandla okuphikisa izinqumo ezingalungile. Izifundo Ezitholakele Ngokubheka imisebenzi yeNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo, sithola izifundo ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinsizakusebenza ezanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa ngesikhathi. Okwesibili, abantu kufanele bazi amalungelo abo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela le nkantolo uma kudingeka. Okwesithathu, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo kufanele iqhubeke nokusebenza ngokubambisana nezinye iziphathimandla, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthethosisekelo uyagcinwa. Isiphetho I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo iyisikhungo esibalulekile emhlabeni wezomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wayo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nomthelela wayo kumphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Noma ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo iqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi umthethosisekelo uyagcinwa, futhi amalungelo abantu ahlonishwa. Ukubheka imisebenzi yayo, sithola ukuthi le nkantolo iyinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinobulungiswa.
Ngokwezimiso zomthetho wesithupha sokukhuluma ngempela, isicelo salo mthetho sinikezwa kuNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukwethula uMthethosisekelo omusha weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nakho. Uhlu 6A, olwakhiwe ngaphambilini esigabeni 6 soMthethosisekelo, wakhanselwa ngesigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2008. Uhlu 6B, olwakhiwe ngaphambilini kuHlu 6A, lufakiwe esigabeni 2 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2002, futhi lwaphinde lwabekwa inombolo yesigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2003 futhi lwakhanselwa ngesigaba 5 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2008. Sikholelwa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyavuma kubo bonke abahlala kuyo, behlangene ekwehlukaneni kwethu. Sakha iNingizimu Afrika ehlangene ethuthukisa inqubo yokhetho futhi ithathe indawo yayo efanele njengombuso ozimele phakathi kwezizwe. UNkulunkulu abusise i-Afrika. UNkulunkulu abusise iNingizimu Afrika. Isithunzi somuntu, ukufinyelela ekuqondeni phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kanye nezikhala. Ukuhlukaniswa okungafanele ngokobuzwe nangobulili. Ukubusa komthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho. Ilungelo lokuvota kubo bonke obalulekile, uhlu lwabo bonke abavoti, ukhetho okujwayelekile ngezikhathi ezibekwe, kanye nohlelo lukamasipala olusekelwe emandleni abantu oluvumela ukubamba iqhaza kwezepolitiki ezihlukene, ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa kwempumelelo, ukunakwa kwezidingo, kanye nensiza yomphakathi. Lo mthethosisekelo ungumthetho ophakeme weRiphabhulikhi; noma yimuphi umthetho noma ukuziphatha okungahambisani nawo awusebenzi, futhi izibopho ezibekwe ngawo kumele zifezwe. Kukhona ubuzwe obuvamile babantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Banelungelo elilinganayo lokubophela nezibopho ezihlobene nobuzwe. Umthetho kazwelonke kumele uhlinzeke ngokutholwa, ukulahleka, kanye nokubuyiselwa kobuzwe. I-anthem kazwelonke yeRiphabhulikhi inqunywa nguMongameli ngokwenza isikhumbuzo. Iflegi kazwelonke inemibala emnyama, igolide, eluhlaza, emhlophe, ebomvu, noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, njengoba kuchazwe futhi kuboniswe kuHlu 1. Izilimi zeVenda, Tsonga, Afrikaans, English, Ndebele, Xhosa, kanye neZulu. Ngokubheka ukwehla kokusetshenziswa kanye nesimo sezilimi zendabuko zabantu bethu, emlandweni, isimo kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezisebenzayo nezithuthukayo zokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi. (a) Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda bangasebenzisa noma yiziphi izilimi ezisemthethweni ezithile emsebenzini kahulumeni, bacabangela ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi, ukuvuma kwazo, izindleko, izimo zezifunda, kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezidingo nalokho okukhethiwe ngumphakathi jikelele noma esifundeni esithintekayo; kodwa uhulumeni kazwelonke noma uHulumeni bezifunda kumele basebenzise okungenani izilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni. Izindawo zamasipala kumele zihlinzeke ngezilimi ezisetshenziswa futhi zikhethwe ngabantu abahlala kuzo. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda kumele baphathe futhi baphonsele inselelo ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye izinyathelo. Ngaphandle kokulimaza lokho okukhulunywe ngakho esigabeni (2), zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kumele zihlonishwe ngokulinganayo futhi ziphathwe ngendlela efanele. kanye ne-Arabic, Hebrew, Sanskrit, nezinye izilimi ezisetshenziselwa izinjongo zenkolo eNingizimu Afrika. Le mthetho yamalungelo iyisisekelo senqubo yokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Igcizelela amalungelo abantu bonke ezweni lethu futhi iqinisa ukholo enhlanganweni yokhetho eqonda isithunzi somuntu, ukufana, kanye nenkululeko. Isimo kumele sihloniphe, sivikele, sikhuthaze, futhi siqedele amalungelo atholakala kuMthetho Wamalungelo. Amalungelo akhuluma kuMthetho Wamalungelo aphakanyiswa ezithintweni ezithile ezitholakala noma ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 36, noma kwezinye izigaba zeMthetho. UMthetho Wamalungelo ubeka wonke umthetho futhi ubopha umthetho, umphakathi, umphakathi, kanye nazo zonke izikhungo zenkantolo. Umgomo kuMthetho Wamalungelo ubopha abantu abaphilayo kanye nalabo abaqashelwe ngumthetho njengabantu uma, futhi uma lokhu kungenzeka, kubhekwa ubunjalo balo mgomo kanye nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe ngalowo mgomo. bangathuthukisa amathuluzi omthetho asuselwa ezinqumweni nasezikhathini zokunciphisa ilungelo, kuze kube yilapho leyo mikhawulo ihambisana nesigaba 36(1). Labo abaqashelwe njengabantu ngumthetho banegunya lokuthola amalungelo kuMthetho Wamalungelo, ngendlela edingekayo ngohlobo lwamalungelo kanye nobunjalo balo msebenzi obhalwe ngumthetho. Wonke umuntu ufana phambi komthetho, futhi unelungelo lokuvikelwa okufanayo kanye nezinzuzo zomthetho. Ukulingana kufaka phakathi ukujabulela wonke amalungelo nezikhala ngokuphelele nangokulinganayo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulingana, izinyathelo zingathathwa ukuze kudlule imithetho nezinye izinyathelo ezihlosiwe ukuvikela noma ukukhuthaza abantu noma amaqembu abantu abathintekile ngenxa yokuhlukumeza okungafanele. Isimo asikwazi ukuhlukumeza noma ubani ngendlela engafanele, ngokuqondile noma ngokuqondile, ngezizathu ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu, kuhlanganise ubuzwe, ubulili, ukukhulelwa, isimo somshado, imvelaphi yokwenziwa kwezinto, umbala, ukuhamba kwezocansi, ubudala, ukungakwazi, inkolo, umqondo, ukholo, isiko, ulimi, kanye nokuzalwa. Akekho umuntu ongahlukumeza omunye ngendlela engafanele ngezizathu ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni (3). Umthetho kazwelonke kumele uphumelele ukuvimbela noma ukuvimbela ukuhlukumeza okungafanele. Ukuhlukumeza ngezizathu ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu ezishiwo esigabeni (3) akuvunyelwe ngaphandle kokukhombisa ukuthi leyo mikhawulo iyamukeleka. Wonke umuntu unokuhlukumezeka okujwayelekile nelungelo lokuthi isithunzi sabo sihlonishwe futhi sivikelwe. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila. futhi akufanele aphathwe noma aphunyuzwe ngendlela enobuhlungu, engabantu, noma ethusayo. futhi akufanele asetshenziswe ekwenzeni izivivinyo zezokwelapha noma zesayensi ngaphandle kwemvume yabo eyaziwayo. Akekho umuntu okufanele abhekwe njengomphakathi, aphathwe njengomphakathi, noma asetshenziswe ngokuphikisana nezifiso zabo. ukuphazamiseka kokuxhumana kwabo nabanye. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokukhululeka kwemizwa, inkolo, umcabango, ukholo, kanye nemibono. Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo (GEMS member consent for health provider communication) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi ubona ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlinzeka ngezempilo nabantu abathola lezi zinsizakalo kubalulekile kakhulu. Ngalesi sizathu, iGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ithuthukise indlela yokuphatha imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwalabo abahlinzeka ngezempilo nabathengi bempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye kuyaphumelela. Imvume yelungu yokuxhumana iyinqubo ebalulekile, ethinta zonke izigaba zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngaphambi kokuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo baqale ukuxhumana nolwazi olubalulekile ngaleli qembu, kubalulekile ukuthi imvume itholakale. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo alabo abathola usizo lwezempilo ayahlonishwa, futhi bazizwa bekhululekile uma bechaza izinkinga zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imvume ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwayo luhambisana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye, futhi luhlonipha izinqubo zomthetho ezikhona. Ngokubambisana nezinhlaka ezahlukene, iGEMS ibone ukuthi kubalulekile ukwakha indlela elula yokuthola le mvume. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana, njengokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, ama-imeyili, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibukhoma. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi unolwazi oluningi noma oluncane ngempilo, angakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi futhi aqonde kahle ukuthi imvume yakhe ibaluleke kangakanani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iGEMS ibeka phambili ukuqwashisa ngale nqubo. Izinhlelo zokufundisa nezokuxhumana zisetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu abazi kahle izinzuzo zokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi imvume ingasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokunakekelwa, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komhlinzeki kanye nelungu. Ukuqwashisa kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu abathola usizo, ukuze bonke baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokuxhumana. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iGEMS ibona ukuthi imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo akugcini nje ngokuba inqubo yokubhalisa, kodwa iyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo olufanele. Ukuze lokhu kufezwe, iGEMS ibambisene nabahlinzeki bezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imvume iyavuma, futhi ulwazi olunikezwayo luhambisana nezidingo zomuntu ngamunye. Ekugcineni, imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. I-GEMS ibona ukuthi le nqubo iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abahlinzeka ngezempilo nabathengi bempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde kahle imvume yabo, futhi bazi ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bathola usizo olufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo. Ngale ndlela, iGEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi imvume yelungu yokuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezempilo iyinqubo ehloniphekile, esebenzayo, futhi efinyeleleka kalula, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi okwazi ukuphila kahle.
Ngiyavuma, le ndaba yeMedupi iyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa sizama ukuyiqonda kahle. Ngabe ubazi ukuthi ama-boiler aseMedupi ayingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza ugesi? Yebo, kodwa kukhona okuthile okungahambi kahle. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngama-boiler, lawo ma-mashini amakhulu akha umusi ukuze akhiqize ugesi. Kodwa, kulokhu, ama-boiler aseMedupi abhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Lokhu kuhluleka kwama-boiler kubangelwa izinto eziningi, njengokwakhiwa okungafanele, izinkinga zokuphatha, kanye nezinto ezithile ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Ngabe ubazi ukuthi lezi zinkinga ziqale nini? Kukhona abantu abathi lezi zinkinga ziqale ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwama-boiler. Abanye bakholelwa ukuthi izinkinga ziqale ngesikhathi sokuhlola, lapho izinhlelo zokuqala ziqala. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ama-boiler akhiwe ngezinga eliphezulu, kodwa akazange ahlangabezane nezidingo ezithile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinkulu? Njengoba ama-boiler engasebenzi kahle, kukhona ukwehla kokukhiqiza ugesi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bahlupheka, ikakhulukazi uma kukhona ukushoda kukagesi. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abanye bephila kahle, kanti abanye bahlupheka ngenxa yokushoda kukagesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ezibhekelele lezi zinhlelo ziqale ukuhlela izixazululo. Kodwa, akulula. Ukulungisa ama-boiler akudingi nje imali, kodwa kudinga isikhathi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ukucabanga kahle ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ama-boiler asebenza kahle. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okukhulu? Abantu abavela ezinkampanini ezahlukene, abaphathi, kanye nochwepheshe badinga ukuhlela imihlangano ukuze baxoxe ngezixazululo. Lokhu kudinga isikhathi, futhi kungenzeka kube nezinkinga ezithile ezivela phakathi kwalezi zinhlelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona nezinkinga zokuphatha. Abantu abavela ezinkampanini ezahlukene badinga ukuxhumana ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi yini edinga ukwenziwa. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi uma abantu bengakwazi ukuhlela kahle, izinkinga ziyaqhubeka. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okukhulu?
