Imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko ethu, futhi ibonisa ubuhle bempilo yethu njengabantu. Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, izinkumbulo eziningi ziyaqhamuka. Ngabe ubani ongakuthandi ukujabulisa, ukuxhumana, nokuhlanganyela nabantu abathandekayo? Lokhu konke kuza nezinhlobonhlobo zemishado yesintu. Ukuze siqale, imishado yesintu ivamise ukuhlela kahle. Ngokuvamile, umndeni wesilisa uzobamba umhlangano nomndeni wesifazane ukuze baxoxe ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlangana." Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkulumo ziba ziningi, futhi imindeni ibonisa izinkolelo zayo, izifiso, nezifiso. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Lokhu kuhlangana akukhona nje ukuhlela imishado, kodwa futhi kuyisikhathi sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, umndeni wesilisa uzothumela izipho, ezivame ukuba yizinkanyezi, izinkanyezi ezincane, noma ezinye izinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuhlonipha umndeni wesifazane. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuhlonipha kubaluleke kangakanani? Lokhu kudala isizinda esihle sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemindeni. Uma sekukhulunywa ngempela ngemishado, akungabazeki ukuthi izinsuku ezilandelayo ziba zinhle. Umkhosi uqala ngokuhlanza, lapho umndeni wesifazane uhamba phambili. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlanza umuzi." Umndeni wesilisa ulandela, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umndeni wesilisa uzokwamukela umkhosi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuhlanzwa kuhlobene kanjani nezinkolelo zethu? Umuzi kufanele uhlanzeke ukuze umshado ube yimpumelelo. Ngemuva kokuhlanza, umkhosi uqala. Izinsuku zokugcina ziba nezinhlelo eziningi, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. Umkhosi uvame ukuba nezinsuku eziningi, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. Izinsuku zokuqala ziba nezinkanyezi, izinkanyezi ezincane, nezinsuku zokugcina ziba nezinsuku ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlobene nezinkolelo zethu, futhi kubonisa ukuthi umshado ungumcimbi omkhulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imishado yesintu ibaluleke kangakanani? Akukhona nje umcimbi, kodwa kuyisikhathi sokuhlanganyela, sokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umshado awuqedi nje, kodwa uqala ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwabashadile. Ngemuva kokuphothula umkhosi, abantu bahlala bejabulile. Umndeni wesifazane uthola izipho, futhi umndeni wesilisa uthola izipho. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umshado awuqedi nje, kodwa uqala ubudlelwano obusha. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kubalulekile? Lokhu kudala isizinda esihle sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imishado yesintu iyashintsha. Kukhona abanye abantu abathanda ukwenza imishado yesimanje, kodwa imishado yesintu ihlala ibalulekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko ethu? Lokhu kuhlobene nezinkolelo zethu, futhi kubonisa ukuthi umshado ungumcimbi omkhulu. Ngokuphetha, imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe imishado yesintu, ngoba ibonisa ubuhle bempilo yethu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi imishado yesintu iyingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko ethu? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umshado awuqedi nje, kodwa uqala ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwabashadile. Ngakho, masiqhubeke sihlonipha imishado yesintu, futhi siqhubeke sithokozisa ubudlelwano bethu.
Ezokudoba: Ukuhlaziywa Nokubaluleka Kwazo Emnothweni NakwiNhlalakahle Ezokudoba, njengezomnotho, zidlalela indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi nasemvelweni. Lezi zinhlelo, ezibandakanya ukutholwa nokulondolozwa kwezinto eziphilayo zasemanzini, ziwumgogodla wobuchwepheshe bokudla kanye nezinsiza ezihlala zikhona dazindala. Ukuze siqonde kahle izimpande nezimpempe ezihlobene nezokudoba, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta le mikhakha. Isizinda Sezokudoba Ezokudoba ziqala ngokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zokudoba, ezihlanganisa amanzi asolwandle, amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezindawo ezihlangene. Amathuba okufaka isandla emnothweni avuleka ezindaweni ezihlukene, kanti izigaba ezahlukene zokudoba zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola izinhlanzi ezahlukene, ezihlanganisa nezinye izilwane zasemanzini. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngempilo ehlukahlukene yokudla, esiza ekwenzeni uhlelo lokudla oluqinile kanye nokugcina impilo yomphakathi. Ukubaluleka Kwezokudoba Ezokudoba akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ukudla; zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni wezwe. Izimboni zokudoba zaphakanyiswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, kanti zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezikhiqizayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi, ukwandiswa kwezokuhweba, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokudoba zibonakala njengezinto ezibalulekile zokuxhumana phakathi kwamazwe, lapho ukuhweba kwezilwane zasemanzini kudlula imingcele yezenhlalo nezomnotho. Izingozi Nezinkinga Zokudoba Nakuba ezokudoba zikhuthaza umnotho, azikwenzi ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ukweqisa kwemithombo yemvelo, ukungcoliswa, kanye nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kubeka ingozi enkulu ezokudobeni. Ukweqisa, ikakhulukazi, kuholela ekutheni izinhlanzi ezithile ziphume emanzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kudinga izinqubomgomo ezithuthukisiwe zokuphatha imithombo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ziyagcinwa futhi zihlala zikhona kumakholwa ezizukulwane ezizayo. Ukwamukela Izifundo Zokwakha Ezinhlangothini Zokudoba Ngokukhuluma ngokweqile, izifundo zezemvelo nemiphumela yezenhlalo zibalulekile ekwakheni izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezinqubo ezihambelana nezokudoba, ukuze kubhekwane nezingozi ezihlobene. Kumele kube nezinhlangano ezisebenzisanayo, ezifaka uhulumeni, abahwebi, nabathengi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusimama kwezinsiza zasemanzini. Izifundo ezitholakala ezweni, ezihlanganisa nezinye izifunda, zingaba usizo olukhulu ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezithinta ezokudoba. Ukwelashwa Kwenkathazo Nasemathubeni Ukwelashwa kwezinkinga ezibangelwa ukuhweba okungafanele, ukungcoliswa, kanye nezinye izingozi, kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, njengezinhlelo zokulandelela izinsiza, kungasiza ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. Lokhu kudinga imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwezazi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezimboni. Isiphetho Ezokudoba zihlala zibe yinsika ebalulekile emnothweni nasemphakathini. Ukuze lezi zinsiza zihlale zikhona futhi zikhulise umnotho, kubalulekile ukwenziwa kwemigomo ethile, ehloswe ngokuqinile ukulondolozwa kwemithombo yemvelo. Ubufakazi bokusebenza ngokubambisana, kanye nokuhweba okungamukeleki, kuzoholela ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile ezokudobeni. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, kudinga ukuba sihlole njalo izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha ezokudoba, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwempilo yomphakathi nempilo yezilwane zasemanzini.
Umthetho we-apartheid nokucindezelwa wadala isimo lapho zonke izilimi ngaphandle kwezimbili zingazange kuphela ziqhutshekwe kodwa futhi zaphathwa ngendlela ephakeme kakhulu. IsiNgisi nesiAfrikaans banikezwa isimo esisemthethweni futhi bathuthukiswa ngendlela ehlelekile, kodwa lokhu kwalimaza izilimi zomdabu zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ka-1996, unikeza ukusetshenziswa okufanayo kwezilimi ezisemthethweni zonke ezweni futhi uthuthukisa futhi uthuthukisa izilimi ezaziphathwa njengokungafanele. Ngaphezu kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11, umthethosisekelo ubona ezinye izilimi ezifana neNama, Khoi, kanye neSan, kanye nolimi lwezimpawu, okumele futhi kuthuthukiswe. IGauteng iyidolobha elinokuhlanganiswa kwezizwe futhi iyisifundazwe lapho kuphela izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 zaseNingizimu Afrika (iSepedi, iSesotho, iSetswana, isiSwati, iVenda, iTsonga, isiAfrikaans, isiNgisi, iNdebele, iXhosa, kanye nesiZulu) ezingakhuluma, kodwa iyikhaya lezilimi eziningi. Odiplomate, abokufika, ababaleki, nabantu bezohwebo abavela emhlabeni jikelele abahlala eGauteng benze le ndawo yaba yikhaya lezilimi eziningi zangaphandle. I-Gauteng Language Policy Framework (GLPF), ehloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela ebanzi yokuphumeza uhlelo lokusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi, yasungulwa ngezizathu ezihlobene ngqo nezidingo zomthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-National Language Policy Framework (eyavunywa futhi yethulwa ngoMashi 2003) ethinta amalungelo omthethosisekelo ahlobene nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kolimi. I-National Language Policy Framework ifuna ukuthi zonke izifundazwe zisungule imithetho yazo ezidinga ukuhambisana nayo. I-GLPF iyumphumela wezinkulumo ezihlelwe nabathintekayo abahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifundazwe, kanye lesizwe. Lezi zinkulumo zifaka iNational Language Institute yeMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, iGauteng Provincial Government (GPG), iminyango enegxile enkulu kwiGauteng Department of Education, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izindawo zokwakha, iGauteng Legislature, kanye nochwepheshe bezilimi abaningana. Le nqubo yokuxoxisana yakhuthazwa yiMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, osizile ngochwepheshe bezilimi abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Imiphumela yokuqala yocwaningo lwezenhlalo nokusetshenziswa kolimi olwenziwa yiPanSALB ngo-2001 yahlaziywa. Lolu cwaningo lusebenzisa indlela yokuhlanganisa okuhloswe ngayo abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 naphezulu, abathathwe ezigabeni ezahlukene zokuphila, emiphakathini yasemakhaya nasemadolobheni. Izindawo ezigxilwe kuzo zazizilimi zasekhaya nezilimi ezisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezizimele, emphakathini, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, emfundweni, izilimi ezindaweni zokusebenza, kanye nokuqonda umthetho wezilimi, ukusetshenziswa kolimi komuntu siqu, kanye nenani lezilimi ezikhuluma ngabantu. Umthethosisekelo uphinde ubone imfundo njengendawo ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi. I-GLPF iphinde ibheke izidingo ze-South African Schools Act ka-1996 ngokuhlola ukuthi izilimi zisetshenziswa kanjani ezikoleni nokuthi kanjani ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luhambisana nesimo semfundo samanje. Ihloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezilimi okuhle okuthinta ukufaka abantu, kuphendula kahle izidingo zomphakathi; futhi igcizelela futhi ikhuthaza isizwe esikhulayo, ikhulisa ukuzigqaja kwesizwe kanye nokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zolimi namasiko eGauteng. Icala lesi-29 lithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ngolimi olusemthethweni alukhethayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi, lapho le mfundo itholakala. I-PanSALB Act ka-1995 iphinde inikeze ukuvunywa, ukukhuthazwa, nokusabalalisa isiko elinokuhlanganiswa kwezilimi eziningi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphathwa njengokungafanele. Iphinde iphakamise ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zolimi ezingeni lesifundazwe. I-Gauteng Provincial Government, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, isungule iGauteng Provincial Language Committee. Nakuba iSouth African Schools Act (SASA) isaqhuba ukuhlolwa, okwamanje inikeza uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, ngemuva kokuxoxisana neBhodi YabaNgqongqoshe, ukuba athathe izinga nezindinganiso zomthetho wezilimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Iphinde icacise ukuthi ibhodi yokuphatha yesikole somphakathi ingathatha umthetho wayo wezilimi ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, lo Mthetho (SASA), kanye neminye imithetho efanele yesifundazwe. Izinhloso zeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi kufanele ziholele ekuthobeleni umthethosisekelo ovumela ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olunikezwe uMbuso, ezikhungweni ezizimele, noma ngabantu, ngokuhambisana nezilinganiso ezithile ezamukelekayo. Lokhu kufinyelela akukhona kuphela mayelana nokuthola ulwazi olufanele kodwa kufanele kube ngolimi olukhethwe umfakisicelo, lapho kusebenza khona. Njengoba uhlu lwe-4 lomthethosisekelo lukhombisa ukuthi ulimi luwumkhakha wokubambisana phakathi kukamasipala kazwelonke kanye nesifundazwe, i-NLPF ibeka ukuthi zonke izikhungo zomphakathi (kazwelonke, zesifundazwe, nezendawo) kanye nezikhungo ezisebenzisayo amandla omphakathi noma imisebenzi zibophelelwe yilolu hlelo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlanganiswa kwezilimi, kulindeleke ukuthi izifundazwe zithuthukise imithetho yazo yezilimi ngokusekelwe ku-NLPF, lapho zizobhekana nezimo zendawo, izidingo, nezintandokazi zomphakathi. Ngemuva kwalokho, ohulumeni bendawo bazothuthukisa imithetho yabo yezilimi ngokuhambisana neProvincial Policy Framework. Uma kudingeka, ohulumeni bendawo bakhuthazwa ukuba basekele umkhakha ozimele ekusunguleni nasekuthuthukiseni umthetho wabo ngendlela ehambisana nale Policy Framework. Ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luwumthetho wezilimi kazwelonke osebenza ngaphakathi komkhakha wemfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko igcizelela ukuxhumana okungaphazamiseki phakathi kwemikhawulo yamasiko, ezilimini, kanye nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudala indawo ehlonipha izilimi ezikhuluma abanye. Indlela yokuxhumana ngomlomo izohlonishwa futhi ikhuthazwe kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Umthetho Wezilimi Zokufunda uthi bonke abafundi kufanele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi olulodwa lomdabu, zonke izigaba zolimi zizothola isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla zesifundazwe kufanele ziqinisekise imithetho mayelana nezidingo zokuthuthukisa amazinga ezilimi afanele kanye nezifundo, ngokuhambisana nekurikulum kazwelonke. Umkhakha wePolicy Framework uhlanganisa iminyango ye-GPG, iGauteng Legislature, izindawo zokwakha (ezibhekele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendawo nezintandokazi), kanye nezikhungo ngaphakathi
Ulwazi Oluqondiswa Nggezwi Ezikhungweni Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukwazisa ngendaba ethokozisayo mayelana nolwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni. Kukhona okuthile okujabulisayo ngalolu hlobo lolwazi, futhi ngicabanga ukuthi sizokwazi ukukuxoxa kahle. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngakho konke okuqala. Uhlanga lwezikhungo, noma ngabe yiziphi, luhlobene kakhulu nokuxhumana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu badinga ukwazi ukuthi yini ethokozisayo, yini edinga ukwenziwa, nokuthi izinqumo zithathwa kanjani. Lapha, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi luba yinsika ebalulekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umuntu ethola ulwazi, kumele luthunyelwe ngendlela ecacile, engathokozisi kuphela kodwa futhi ethinta abantu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ezikhungweni eziningi, izwi labaphathi libalulekile? Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umphakathi uthola ulwazi, kumele lube nolwazi olucacile nolwakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi bazi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma abantu benolwazi olucacile, bazokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izwi eliqondisayo lingaba yinsika yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Uma abantu bekhuluma, bakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango, iziphakamiso, nezixazululo. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okubalulekile ezikhungweni. Ngakho-ke, uma izwi lishaya phansi, abantu bazizwa bejabulile futhi bekhululekile ukwabelana ngemicabango yabo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngempumelelo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu. Isibonelo, uma ulwazi lungathunyelwa kahle, kungase kube nemiphumela emibi. Lokhu kungaholela ekudidekeni, okungadala ukungaqondi kahle phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ziqinisekise ukuthi izwi elithunyelwa liyanakekelwa. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izikhungo ezithile zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi luthunyelwa ngendlela efanele? Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezikhungo ezinkulu. Izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezinkundla zokuxhumana zisebenza njengesikhungo sokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu bathole ulwazi kalula. Uma sikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi sobuchwepheshe, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izwi eliqondisayo alikupheli. Kukhona izindlela eziningi zokuthola ulwazi, futhi abantu badinga ukufunda ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlonza izidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izwi eliqondisayo alihlangene kuphela nezikhungo. Lolu hlobo lolwazi luthinta umphakathi wonke. Uma abantu bebona ukuthi izwi labo liyalalelwa, bazokhuthazeka futhi bazokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophumelelayo, okhuluma, okuxhumana, futhi okwakha. Ngakho-ke, uma sikhuluma ngolwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuxhumana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano, ukuqonda izidingo zabantu, nokwenza izinqumo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi kudinga imizamo yokwakha umoya wokubambisana. Ekugcineni, ngifuna ukusho ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi luyinsika ebalulekile ezikhungweni. Akukhona nje kuphela ukuthi luthinta izinqumo, kodwa futhi luthinta umoya wabantu. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izwi labo liyalalelwa, bazokwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sifunda, sikhulume, futhi sabelane ngolwazi ukuze sakhe izikhungo eziphumelelayo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngiyabonga ngokuba nathi kulolu hambo lokuxoxa ngolwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni. Ngithemba ukuthi sizoqhubeka sizama ukwenza izikhungo zethu zibe ngcono, futhi sikhulume ngalezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Hamba kahle!
Izokuphepha: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Emphakathini Wethu Ezokuphepha, njengengxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu yansuku zonke, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kulesi sikhathi lapho ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo ezihambisana nezokuphepha zikhula ngokushesha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala ukuze siqinisekise ukuphepha kwethu, kokubili emakhaya nasemphakathini. Isimo Samanje Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe buvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane kalula, kodwa lokhu kuza nezingozi eziningi. Ukweba imininingwane, ukuhlasela kwe-cyber, kanye nezindleko zokuphepha zikhula njalo. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimo ezithile ezithinta ukuphepha kwethu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvikelwa kwemali, ukuvikelwa kwabantu, kanye nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Izindlela Zokuvikela Ukuze siqinisekise ukuphepha, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo zokuphepha kumakhompyutha, ukusebenzisa amagama okungena aqinile, kanye nokuhlola njalo izinhlelo zokusebenza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuvikela ezisebenzayo, kungasiza ukuvikela imininingwane yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa umphakathi ngokuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nezokuphepha kubalulekile. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bazi izindlela zokuvikela, njengezindlela zokuphepha emakhaya, izindlela zokuphatha imali, nezindlela zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukubona izingozi ngaphambi kokuba zibe yingozi enkulu. Ukubaluleka Kwezinhlangano Zokuphepha Izinkampani ezikhethekile kwezokuphepha zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lezi zinkampani zisebenza ngokubambisana nohulumeni, emiphakathini, nasemiphakathini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Ukuze lezi zinkampani zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuthi zibe nezinsiza ezanele, abantu abanolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani ezikhethekile nezakhamuzi kudinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemininingwane ebalulekile, izixazululo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu ezindabeni zokuphepha kuzokwandisa ulwazi kanye nolwazi lwemiphakathi. Izingozi Zokuphepha Ezihlangabezana Nathi Njengoba sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kwezokuphepha, kubalulekile ukuqonda izingozi ezithile ezihlangabezana nathi. Ukuhlasela kwe-cyber, ukweba imininingwane, kanye nezingozi zomzimba zikhula njalo. Ukuze sikwazi ukubhekana nalezi zingozi, kudingeka sihlale siqaphile, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu zokuphepha, futhi sibe nolwazi oluqinile lwezingozi ezikhona. Isiphetho Ezokuphepha zibalulekile empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezinqala, siqinisekise ukuthi sinesizinda esiqinile sokuvikela, futhi sifundise umphakathi ngokuqonda izingozi. Ngalesi sikhathi esikhulayo sobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuphepha kwethu, kokubili emakhaya nasemphakathini. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo, nonobungozi.
Izinsizakalo Zokwesekwa Kwabantu Abakhubazekile: Umsebenzi Osafanele Ukwenziwa Ngokuhlola impilo yomphakathi wethu, singabona ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala behlupheka ngezindlela eziningi. Lokhu akukhona nje ukusho ukuba nemikhawulo emzimbeni, kodwa kube nemiphumela ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabo, kokubili ngokomzwelo nangokwenhlalakahle. Izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile zibalulekile ukuze siphumelele ekwakheni umphakathi ofanele wonke umuntu, kodwa sizobona ukuthi kunzima ukuya phambili. Abantu abakhubazekile, ngokuvamile, bahlushwa ukungabikhona kwezinsizakalo ezanele ezibhekelelayo. Ukungabikhona kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengokuhamba kalula, imfundo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa, kuhlanganisa nezinye izinkinga zokuxhumana, kube yisithiyo esikhulu ekufinyeleleni kokuphila okujabulisayo. Lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho wonke umuntu efisa ukuba neqhaza eliqhakazile emphakathini. Ngokweqiniso, izinsizakalo zokweseka abantu abakhubazekile zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Izinhlelo zamanje azihlangabezani nezidingo ezithile zabantu abakhubazekile, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda okukhulu kwemvelo yokukhubazeka, kanye nokuhlonipha izidingo nemicabango yabantu abakhubazekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukukhiqiza izinhlelo ezivula amathuba, hhayi kuphela okuphepha, kodwa nemfundo, ukulungela emsebenzini, kanye nezinsizakalo zokufuna usizo. Ukuze sifezekise lokhu, kufanele sibe nokubambisana okunesisekelo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila impilo egculisayo. Umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphezulu kufanele ube nezinqubomgomo ezibhekelelayo, ezibandakanya abantu abakhubazekile ezinqumweni ezithinta izinsizakalo zabo. Ngokwakha umphakathi lapho abantu abakhubazekile bengakhubazeki khona, kufanele sikhuthaze umqondo wokubumbana. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqonde izifiso zabo, sihloniphe izinkolelo zabo, futhi sibe nezinselele ezibhekelelayo ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi mayelana nokukhubazeka nokwenza kube lula ukukhuluma ngalezi zihloko. Ngakhoke, ukwakha indawo evulekile yokuxoxa ngalezi zindaba, ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinto abazidingayo, kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba izinsizakalo zibe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi zifezeke izinjongo ezithile. Umphakathi unethuba lokufunda nokukhula, kodwa kumele kube nezinqubomgomo eziqinile ezivuma ubulungiswa. Izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abakhubazekile akusikho ukuphikisana, kodwa yithuba lokwakha umphakathi ogcwele uthando, ukwamukela, nokubambisana. Umphakathi lapho umuntu angakhubazeki khona, lapho wonke umuntu enethuba lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, uyohamba phambili. Konke lokhu kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo ezinqunyiwe, siqwashise nabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abakhubazekile bayakhethelwa izinsizakalo ezizwakalayo. Lokhu kuzovula amathuba amaningi, kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephila impilo ecebile. Ukuphila kulezi zimo, kufanele sibe nesibindi sokuthatha izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi ofaka wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani, noma yisiphi isimo. Ukwamukela abantu abakhubazekile, ukufunda kumathuba, nokwakha izinsizakalo ezizungezile kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuyisidingo esikhulu, futhi kumele kube nomsebenzi oqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi sithola impumelelo ezinsizakalweni zokweseka abantu abakhubazekile. Kumele sithole indlela yokubambisana, yokufundisa, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu abakhubazekile bejabulile, bephila impilo egculisayo, futhi bezizwa beyingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, akusiyo nje indaba yokuphepha, kodwa kuyinjongo yokwakha umphakathi obumbene, onenhlonipho, nesibindi, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukujabulela zonke izinzuzo, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Lokhu kumele kube yinjongo yempilo yethu sonke. Ubufakazi bokuthi umphakathi omuhle ususwa emizameni yokwakha izinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukusebenza okuqhubekayo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemicabango emihle. Sihlale sihlangene, sicela ukuthi sithuthukise izinsizakalo zokweseka abantu abakhubazekile, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, onobumbano, nolwazi.
Izidingo zamaphepha omholo zamalungu aqashiwe eGEMS Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izidingo zokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile kumalungu aqashiwe eGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) zibe yinto ebalulekile. Lokhu kungenxa yokubaluleka kwamaphepha omholo ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutholeni izinzuzo. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle lezi zidingo. Okokuqala, amaphepha omholo kumele akhombise imininingwane yomsebenzi ngokucacile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi igama eliphelele, inombolo ye-ID, kanye nezinhlobo zomsebenzi. Lezi zinto zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe umholo wakho uhambisana nezidingo zeGEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphepha kufanele akhombise umholo wamanje, kuhlanganise nezithako ezifana nezikhwama zokuthola izinsiza nezinsizakalo. Okwesibili, amaphepha omholo kufanele abe nezinombolo ezithile ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zifaneleka kumalungu aqashiwe. Izinsizakalo ezifana nokwelashwa kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha kufanele zibe nezinombolo ezikhombisa ukuthi zikhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi amaphepha omholo akhombise izinsuku ezithile zokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe umholo uhambisana nezinsuku ozisebenzelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumalungu aqashiwe ukufaka izicelo zokuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Okwesithathu, amaphepha omholo kufanele abe nezinombolo zokuxhumana ezithile, ukuze uma kukhona izinkinga, ungathola usizo olufanele. Ukuze uthole izinsiza ezidingekayo, qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezikhonjisiwe kumaphepha ziqinile. Ekugcineni, amaphepha omholo kumele abe nezinqumo ezithile ezihlobene nezinsiza zempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zifaneleka kumalungu aqashiwe. Ukuze uthole izinsiza ezithile, qinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinqumo ziqinile. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zidingo, amalungu aqashiwe eGEMS angakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uphumelele empilweni. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle lezi zidingo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo zokuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zifaneleka. Ngakho-ke, uma ungumsebenzi oqashiwe eGEMS, qiniseka ukuthi uhambisana nalezi zidingo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza zempilo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi uthola usizo olufanele uma kudingeka, okuzokwenza ukuphila impilo enempilo.
Ukubhikisha Kwabafundi Ngokwejwayelekile, ukubhikisha kwabafundi kube yindlela yokuzwakalisa imizwa, izinkinga, nezifiso zabo. Njengomfundi, ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zenzakalo zikhombisa ubuhlakani, ubuholi, kanye nokuqonda okujulile kwezimfuno zethu. Uma ngibheka izikhathi ezithile lapho abafundi benza khona ukubhikisha, ngiyabona ukuthi lezi zenzakalo zikhona ngenxa yokunganeliseki ngezimo ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezikoleni nasemanyuvesi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abakha umphakathi wethu. Abafundi bangama-akhawunti amakhulu emiphakathini, futhi izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo zikhombisa izinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinkinga zezimali, izinga lemfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala zikhona. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abafundi kufanele baveze imizwa yabo, bahlangane, futhi bazwakalise izikhalazo zabo. Ukubhikisha, ngakho, kuba yindlela yokukhuluma, yokubeka izinkinga phambi kwabaphathi, futhi yokufuna ukulungiswa. Ngokwesibonelo, ngiyakhumbula isenzakalo esenzeka emnyuvesi yami lapho abafundi bahlala phansi ukuze baphikise ukwenyuka kwemali yokufunda. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, kodwa kwaveza ubuhlakani obukhulu. Abafundi babebonisa ukuthi akukhona nje ukuthi bahlupheka, kodwa baphinde bakhombise ukuthi banomqondo ophusile wokuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zinezimpempe ezinzima emiphumeleni yabo. Lokhu kwavula izinkulumo ezinzima phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabaphathi, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukubhikisha akuhambisani nje nokuphikisana. Kunalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezihambisanayo. Abafundi kufanele bakhuthazwe ukuba baphathe izinkulumo ezivulekile, bazame ukuxhumana nabaphathi ukuze bathole izixazululo. Lokhu kudinga ubuholi obuqinile, futhi abafundi kufanele bakhe amabhandezi ukuze basebenzisane, bephumelele ekufezekiseni izinhloso zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukubhikisha akukhona nje ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Abafundi, othisha, nabaphathi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bathole izixazululo ezinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano obuhle, okungaba yinzuzo kubo bonke. Ngokubheka phambili, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukubhikisha kwabafundi kudinga ukuqhubeka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kufanele baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ezindabeni ezithinta imfundo, futhi bahlale bephakamisa izinkinga ezibucayi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imiphakathi yethu ibe namandla, futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi abafundi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Ekugcineni, ngiyavuma ukuthi ukubhikisha kwabafundi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokukhuluma. Kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi baqhubeke nokuphikisa, kodwa kufanele baphinde bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze bathole izixazululo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imfundo yethu ibe ngcono, futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi sibe nomphakathi onempilo. Ukubhikisha akukhona nje ukulwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha, yokuxhumana, nokufuna izixazululo. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza bonke abafundi ukuthi baqhubeke nokukhuluma, baphikise, futhi bakhe umphakathi onempilo.
Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni Emadolobheni amaningi, lapho izikhala zikhula khona, izigidi zabantu zihlala zikhathazekile ngempilo yazo. UThandi, umama oneminyaka engama-35, wayehlala edolobheni elikhulu, elinokuphila okusheshayo, kodwa wayehlushwa ukungabi nandaba nokudla okunempilo. UThandi wayefuna ukugcina umndeni wakhe unempilo, kodwa ukungabi khona kwezinsiza zokudla eziphilile kwaba yinkinga. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahamba emgwaqweni, lapho abona khona umphakathi wendawo ubamba umcimbi wokwakha izingadi zokudla. Kwakukhona abantu abaningi, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo, bebonisa izithombe zezingadi zabo. UThandi wathola umuzwa omuhle, wacabanga ukuthi lokhu kungaba yithuba elihle lokuthola ukudla okuphilile. Wathola ukuthi lezi zingadi zokudla zazihlelwe ngababambiqhaza bendawo, ababejolise ekwakheni izindawo ezincane zokulima ezindaweni eziphithizelayo. UThandi wathola ukuthi lezi zingadi zazihlinzeka ngembewu, izinsiza, nemiyalo yokulima. Wazizwa ejabule, wathi: “Ngizokwenza lokhu!” Ngemuva kokubhalisela ukujoyina, uThandi waqala ukulima ingadi yakhe encane. Wafunda ukuthi ukudla okukhuliswa emakhaya kunempilo engcono, futhi akudingi izithako eziningi ezibizayo. Waqala ngembewu ye-tomato, u-anyanisi, nezinye izitshalo ezilula. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, waqala ukubona izimpande zikhula, futhi izitshalo zikhula kahle. UThandi wathola ukuthi akukhona nje kuphela ukudla okuphilile, kodwa futhi wathola umphakathi omusha. Abanye abahlali baphinde baphenduka abangane, bexoxa ngezindlela zokulima, bejabulela imiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. UThandi waba nesikhathi esihle sokufunda, futhi wathola ukuthi ukulima akukhona nje ukwakha ukudla, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, ingadi kaThandi yakhula yaba yindawo yokuhlangana. Abantu bendawo beza ukuzobona, bejabulile, bephakamisa izithombe zezitshalo ezinhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayiyindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho abantu bejabulayo, bexoxa, futhi bejabulela imiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayihlinzeka ngaphezu kokudla. Yaba yindawo yokufundisa izingane zakhe, lapho bezifundisa khona ukuthi ukudla okuphilile kudinga ukunakekelwa. UThandi wathola ukuthi izingadi zokudla zikhulisa umqondo wokubambisana, zifundisa abantu ukuthi bangakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezinkingeni zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wendawo waqala ukwakha ezinye izingadi zokudla. Abantu baqala ukwakha izindawo zokulima ezincane ezindaweni eziphithizelayo, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle, futhi izinyathelo ezincane zingaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha ukudla, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo, benza izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayiyindawo yokukhula, hhayi kuphela kwezitshalo, kodwa nasebudlelwaneni phakathi kwabantu. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba nesithakazelo sokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi nabanye. Waqala ukufundisa abanye abantu bendawo ukuthi bangakha kanjani izingadi zabo, futhi lokhu kwaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. UThandi wathola ukuthi izinyathelo ezincane zingaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu, futhi umphakathi wendawo waqala ukujabulisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle, futhi izinyathelo ezincane zingaholela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha ukudla, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo, benza izinguquko ezinkulu empilweni yabo. Ngakho, emadolobheni, lapho izikhala zikhula khona, izigidi zabantu zihlala zikhathazekile ngempilo yazo. Kodwa uThandi, nomphakathi wakhe, bakhombisa ukuthi ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla kungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omuhle. UThandi wathola ukuthi ingadi yakhe yayiyindawo yokukhula, hhayi kuphela kwezitshalo, kodwa nasebudlelwaneni phakathi kwabantu.
Ukukhula Kwezingadi Zokudla Emadolobheni 1. Isingeniso Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, njengoba kunciphisa ubungozi bokudla okungekuhle, kukhuthaza ukulima okuqinile, futhi kwandisa ukufinyelela kokudla okuvumelanayo. Le dokhumenti ihlola izinyathelo ezisemqoka zokukhulisa izingadi zokudla, izinzuzo zazo, nezindlela zokubhekana nezinselelo ezibhekene nezindawo ezisemadolobheni. 2. Izizathu Zokukhula Kwezingadi Zokudla Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla kuhlobene nezizathu ezithile: - Ukuphila Okunempilo: Ukudla okukhiqizwa ezindlini kuvame ukuba nezinzuzo eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukusiza ekudleni okunempilo. - Ukunciphisa Izindleko: Ukulima okuncane emakhaya kunciphisa izindleko zokuthenga ukudla. - Ukuthuthukisa Umphakathi: Lokhu kuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuqalisa umqondo wokubambisana. 3. Izinyathelo Zokukhula Kwezingadi Zokudla 3.1 Ukucabangela Indawo - Khetha indawo enelanga elanele, okungaphezu kwezinsuku eziyi-6 ngeviki. - Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlabathi unokuthula okungcono ukuze kube ne-drainage efanele. 3.2 Ukwenza Umhlabathi Ube Ngcono - Thola umhlabathi onempilo: Ungasebenzisa imikhiqizo yokunisela, ukudla okusakazwayo, noma imfucumfucu. - Khipha imifino, izimpande, nezinto ezingafuneki. 3.3 Ukukhetha Ukudla - Khetha imifino nezithelo ezifanele imvelo yangakini. - Qinisekisa ukuthi unolwazi lokukhula kwezinto ezikhethiweyo. 3.4 Ukwakha Izicabha - Faka izicabha zokuphepha ezithokozisayo. - Zama ukwakha izimo ezilula ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela. 3.5 Ukulima - Faka imbewu noma izitshalo emhlabathini. - Qiniseka ukuthi uthola amanzi anele, ikakhulukazi ezinyangeni ezomile. 3.6 Ukuphathwa Kwezihlahla - Naka ukuncipha kwezinyoni nezilwanyana, qhathanisa nezisebenzi. - Gcina umhlabathi unempilo ngokusebenzisa ama-organic fertilizers. 4. Izinsiza Zokuxhasa 4.1 Izinhlangano Zokulima - Xhumana nezinhlangano zasendaweni ezikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezingadi zokudla. - Bamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokufundisana. 4.2 Izifundo Zokuqeqesha - Phenya ngemifundaze eqhutshwa endaweni. - Bhala imishwana ewusizo yokuthuthukisa amakhono akho. 4.3 Amathuba - Hlanganyela emisebenzini yokukhuthaza izinhlelo zezigaba ezithile. - Cwaninga ngama-webinars nezinye izindlela zokuqhubeka ufunda. 5. Izinto Ezingahambisani 5.1 Ukwakha Umphakathi - Hlanganyela nabanye abakha izingadi zokudla ezindaweni ezizungezile. - Dala ukuxhumana phakathi kwezokuxhumana ukuze ukhulise umphakathi. 5.2 Izinhlelo Zokukhangisa - Khombisa imiphumela ezinhumeni uma sekukhuliswa izitolo ezikhangayo. - Hlela imicimbi yokwabelana abantu ngezinto ezitholakalayo. 5.3 Ukuphathwa Kwezokwenza - Qhuba izifundo ezivusa ukuze uthole izindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo nezindlela zokulima ezihamba phambili. - Lungisa izinhlelo ngendlela efanele ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza okuthuthukayo. 6. Izinselelo Ezibhekelele 6.1 Isimo Sezulu - Cabanga ngezinye izindlela uma kukhona ukwehla kwezulu okungalindelekile. - Phendula ngezindlela ezahlukahlukene zokulima ezifanele izimo. 6.2 Ukufinyelela Kwezinsiza - Ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezifanele kungaba yinkinga; hlanganyela nemiphakathi ukuze uthole izinsiza ezidingekayo. - Qhubekela phambili nokuxhumana nabakhiqizi bezinto ezisetshenziswayo. 7. Isiphetho Ukukhula kwezingadi zokudla emadolobheni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, okuthuthukisa izindawo zokukhula eziphilile, kanye nemfihlo zokulima. Ukulandela lezi zinyathelo ezisemqoka kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abantu, futhi kuphumelele ekwandiseni izitshalo zokudla, kuthuthukiswe ukujula komphakathi. Lokhu kuzoletha izinzuzo eziningi, kunikeze uthando, uthando, nempilo enhle ezinhliziyweni zabakhokhisi bezomnotho. Hlahlela phambili futhi uphathe izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise impumelelo yokwakha izingadi zokudla.
Impi yaseSandlwana, eyenzeka ngonyaka we-1879, yenzeka ngesikhathi sokungqubuzana eNingizimu Afrika. KwaZulu, uSuthu noMfecane kwaba nezimpi eziningi, kodwa okwakuzoba yimbangela yokungqubuzana enkulu, kwakuwuhlaselo lweNgilandi. UCetshwayo, inkosi yamaZulu, wayephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokuhlaselwa, elwela ukuvikela isizwe sakhe. Ngaphambi kokuqala kwempi, amaNgisi ayesezandleni, ehlela ukuhlasela amaZulu ukuze athole izinsiza. UGeneral Lord Chelmsford, owayengumholi wezempi, wathumela amabutho akhe eNingizimu Afrika, efisa ukuwaphula amaZulu. Nakuba kwakukhona ukungabaza, uChelmsford wayeqiniseka ngephumelelo yakhe. Amabutho akhe, aphakanyiswa ngamaNgisi, ayebonakala eqinile, kodwa wayengazi ukuthi ubuhlakani bamaZulu babezokwenza kube nzima. Ngenkathi izinsuku zedlula, impi yaseSandlwana yabe isiseduze. Ngempelasonto, uGeneral Chelmsford wathumela ingxenye yebutho lakhe, elibizwa nge-1st Battalion 24th Regiment of Foot, ukuze lihlole indawo. UZulu, besebenzisa ubuhlakani babo, baqonda ukuthi amaNgisi azosondela. UCetshwayo, enesibindi, wasebenzisa izindlela eziphusile zokuhlasela amaNgisi. Ngokushesha, impi yamaZulu yahlasela, yathola ithuba lokwenza impi enkulu. Ngemva kokuhlola, uGeneral Chelmsford wathola ukuthi amaZulu abambelele endaweni ethile, wacabanga ukuthi uzokwazisa kalula. Lokhu kwakuyiphutha elikhulu. Ngomhla ka-22 kuJanuwari, impi yaseSandlwana yaqala. Amabutho amaZulu, eziningi, akhombisa ubuhlakani obukhulu. UZulu babebonakala benza izinto ngendlela ehlukile, bephikisa izindlela ezazijwayelekile. Ngaleso sikhathi, amaNgisi abebonakala edidekile, engazi kahle ukuthi uzokwenzenjani. UZulu bahlasela ngamandla, bejabulisa imiphefumulo yabo. Impi yabe isiyaziwa njengomlando, njengoba amaNgisi akhombisa ukungakwazi ukulwa. UZulu bahlula, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokunqoba esikhulu. UGeneral Chelmsford, ebona ukuthi izinto azihambi kahle, uzame ukuhlela kabusha, kodwa kwakusele kancane. UZulu bahlasela, bahlasela, bahlasela, futhi ekugcineni, amaNgisi abebonakala engakaze abone ukwehluleka okunjalo. Umphumela walolu suku wawungakaze ubonwe. UZulu bahlula amaNgisi, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokunqoba esikhulu. UZulu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa umoya wabo, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo zakhanya ezulwini. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, okokuqala ukuthi amaZulu aphumelele impi enkulu, futhi lokhu kwashiya umhlaba ubheke phansi. Umlando wempimpi yaseSandlwana wawungaphezu kokuhlasela; wawungumfanekiso wokubambisana, ubuhlakani, nokuzimisela. UZulu babenamandla, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, noma izimo zishintsha, umoya wesintu awupheli. UGeneral Chelmsford waphinde wathola ukuthi ubuhlakani bamaZulu abukhona kuphela emhlabeni, kodwa bukhona nasemoyeni. Ngemuva kwempumelelo, uCetshwayo wathola ukuthi impi ayizange iphele. Kwakukhona izinselelo eziningi ezazilindele. Kodwa, impi yaseSandlwana yabe isikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma ubuhlakani bukhona, akukho okungatholakali. UZulu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa umoya wabo, futhi bahlala bephila impilo yabo, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zempilo zabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, impi yaseSandlwana yaba yisikhumbuzo esibalulekile emlandweni wamaZulu, futhi izifundo zayo zaphinde zaba yizifundo ezibalulekile emlandweni wempucuko. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esingasoze sakhishwa emlandweni, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo zakhanya ngaphezu kwezinkanyezi ezivamile. Ngakho-ke, impi yaseSandlwana yabe iyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando, futhi ibonisa ukuthi, uma ubuhlakani bukhona, akukho okungatholakali. UZulu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa umoya wabo, futhi bahlala bephila impilo yabo, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zempilo zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esingasoze sakhishwa emlandweni, futhi izinkanyezi zempilo zakhanya ngaphezu kwezinkanyezi ezivamile.
Ukufezwa Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula Semizuzu Eyi-15: Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Bukhombisa Impumelelo Ngokwandiswa kokusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, izinkampani eziningi ziye zathola indlela yokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, okuholele ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo. Iphrojekthi eyaziwa ngokuthi "Ukufezwa Kwezikhathi Zokuphendula Semizuzu Eyi-15" ibonisa indlela abaphathi bezinsizakalo abangasebenzisa ngayo ubuchwepheshe ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izimpendulo zifinyelela kumakhasimende ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukwethula le phrojekthi kuhloswe ngokuqinisa izinga lokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga usizo lwezokwelapha, izimo zokuphepha, noma izimo zokuphuthumayo ezithinta abantu. Uhlelo lwasungulwa ngenhloso yokunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda, okuholela ekutheni abantu bathole usizo oludingekayo ngokushesha. Ubufakazi bokusebenza kwalesi simo bubonakala emiphumeleni ethokozisayo. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo eziphambili, izinkampani zikwazile ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo zibe ngaphansi kwemizuzu eyi-15. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisheshayo, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha izinsizakalo eziklama izinqubo ezisebenzayo. Ngokwezibalo ezitholakele, izinkampani ezisebenzisa lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende, okukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bekhululekile uma bezwa ukuthi usizo lungafika ngokushesha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni, lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uhlelo lokuphendula oluphumelelayo luhlobene kakhulu nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Ukuze kutholakale usizo oluphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuthi izinsizakalo zisebenze ngokubambisana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsizakalo zezokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezinsizakalo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zinsizakalo kuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwazo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zisebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezithuthukisiwe ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zazo zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izinga lokuphendula, ukuhlola izinkinga ezivela, kanye nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula zihlala ziphansi. Izinhlelo zokuhlola zikhombisa ukuthi izinkampani ezithuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuphendula zikhula kakhulu, zikhombisa ukwanda kokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ukwengeza, ubuchwepheshe obusha bukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo zenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baxhumane nezinsizakalo ezidingekayo, bahlale bezwa ukuthi usizo lungafika ngasikhathi sinye. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphepha, okubalulekile ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. Kodwa-ke, le phrojekthi ayinakho konke okulungile. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezidinga ukubhekwa. Okokuqala, izinkampani zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bazo banolwazi olufanele lokusebenzisa lezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha ngendlela efanele. Okwesibili, izinkampani zidinga ukugcina izinsiza ezanele ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zazo zokuphendula zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele kube khona ukutshalwa kwezimali ezinkulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zihlala zisebenza kahle, futhi izinsiza zihlala zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphendula okusheshayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le phrojekthi ibonakala iyimpumelelo enkulu. Izinkampani ezithuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuphendula zikhombisa ukuthuthukiswa okuhle, futhi lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisa izinga lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukufezwa kwesikhathi sokuphendula semizuzu eyi-15 sekuyinto ebonakalayo, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungathuthukisa izinsizakalo eziningi. Ekugcineni, ukwenziwa kwale phrojekthi kubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bathole usizo oludingekayo ngokushesha, okwenza kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu kumakhasimende. Njengoba izinkampani ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zazo, kulindeleke ukuthi lezi zikhathi zokuphendula zihlale zincipha, okuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwabantu.
Umbiko Ngama-Cryptocurrency Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izimali zedijithali, ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-cryptocurrency, seziye zaba yinsakavukela. Izimali ezinjengokuthi i-Bitcoin, i-Ethereum, nezinye, zisiza ekwenzeni izinkokhelo ezisheshayo, zisebenza ngaphandle kokulawulwa nguhulumeni noma izikhungo zezimali. Kulesi siphetho, sizobheka ukuthi ama-cryptocurrency ayini, indlela asebenza ngayo, kanye nezinselelo nezinsiza ezihambisana nalokhu. Incazelo Yama-Cryptocurrency Ama-cryptocurrency azimele ngokwawo, atholakala kuphela emhlabeni wedijithali. I-Bitcoin, eyasungulwa ngu-Satoshi Nakamoto ngo-2009, ibhekwa njengesisekelo semali yedijithali. Lezi zimali zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obubizwa nge-blockchain, lapho ulwazi lwemininingwane luhlala kuxhumene ngamaqoqo (blocks) ahlukanisiwe. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke ama-transaction avikeleke futhi awalungiswa kalula. Indlela Ama-Cryptocurrency Asebenza Ngayo Ama-cryptocurrency asebenza ngokusebenzisa i-blockchain, okuyisizinda esiyisisekelo esiqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo zenzeka ngendlela efanele. Uma umuntu ethenga noma ethengisa i-cryptocurrency, lezi zinkokhelo zifakwa kwi-blockchain, ziqinisekiswa ngama-computer amaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuhoxisa noma ukukhohlisa, njengoba kudinga imvume enkulu yokwenza lokhu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-cryptocurrency awahlukanisiwe kuphela, kodwa angasetshenziswa ngendlela ebanzi. Abantu bangawathenga, bawagcine, noma bawasebenzise ezinkokhelweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-cryptocurrency atholakala kalula ezimakethe zedijithali, lapho abantu bangasebenzisa khona izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile zokuhweba. Izinsiza Zama-Cryptocurrency Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwama-cryptocurrency. Okokuqala, ukunciphisa izindleko zokuhweba. Ngokungafani nezinhlelo zezimali ezivamile ezibiza izindleko eziphezulu, ama-cryptocurrency avame ukuba nezindleko eziphansi zokuhweba. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukwenza izinkokhelo. Okwesibili, ama-cryptocurrency anikeza izinga eliphezulu lokuvikeleka. Njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, i-blockchain ivikela ulwazi, iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi akekho ongakwazi ukwephula imithetho. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuthi basebenzise ama-cryptocurrency. Izinselelo Zama-Cryptocurrency Noma kunjalo, ukuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency akuhambisani nezingozi ezithile. Okokuqala, intengo yama-cryptocurrency iyashintsha kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umuntu ongathenga i-Bitcoin namuhla angathola ukuthi inani layo liphansi kakhulu esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kudala ukungaqiniseki kwabathengi. Okwesibili, ubungozi bokuphula ubumfihlo bukhona. Nakuba i-blockchain ivikeleka, kukhona abantu abahlala befuna izindlela zokuphula izinhlelo zokuphepha. Lokhu kuholela emaphutheni, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimali. Umthelela Kwezomnotho Ama-cryptocurrency awavumeli kuphela ukushintshwa kwemali, kodwa futhi alokhu ethinta umnotho jikelele. Izinkampani eziningi ziyaqhubeka nokuwamukela njengendlela yokukhokha, okukhuthaza ukwamukelwa kwama-cryptocurrency emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kusebenza kahle emikhakheni efana nezokuthutha, ezokukhiqiza, nezokuxhumana, okwakha amathuba amasha emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-cryptocurrency akhulisa umqondo wokuthukuthaza ukuthengisa kwemikhiqizo nokuhlala kwi-inthanethi. Abanyeni abasha nabazimele, bahlala bezama ukuhweba ngama-cryptocurrency, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinkampani ezintsha. Isiphetho Ukuze sibe nezezimali ezisebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ama-cryptocurrency. Lezi zimali zedijithali, ezimnandi futhi ezikhuthazayo, zishintsha umqondo wethu wezokuhweba, umnotho, nokukhokha. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezihambisana nalokhu, izinzuzo zihlala zikhanga. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokushintsha, ama-cryptocurrency azoba nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa lezezimali. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi futhi baqonde lezi zimali, ukuze bakwazi ukufaka izinqumo ezinhle futhi ziqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ama-cryptocurrency azoba yinsika yomnotho wethu, kanye nezindlela zokuhweba eziphendukela phambili, futhi lezi zinkampani zedijithali zizokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Umqondo wokuhlala sisemhlabeni wedijithali uzokwenza kube lula ukumisa izinkanyezi zamanje nezangomuso.
uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean Ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean lwalukhanya, luveza imimoya ethokozisayo. Kwakukhona abesifazane nabesilisa ababehamba emkhunjini, behamba baphumule kahle, behlola leli lwandle elikhulu. UThandi, intombazane encane enothando lwezindaba, wathokozisa abanye ngendaba zayo. "Nikhumbula, lapho sidlula emhlabeni, kwafika umkhumbi omkhulu? Bantu baphuma phambili, bejabulela uLwandle," kubhala uThandi. I-Indian Ocean ibivame ukuba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu abanhlobonhlobo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwaludlalisa kubo izinsuku eziningi, uThandi efunda ngezinkanyezi ezichaza izindawo ezahlukene. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwaluhamba nezinhlanga, lukhumbuza abantu ngamaqondo ahlukahlukene nolwazi olwandisayo. Ngesikhathi behamba, uThandi uthembise ababheki, "Ngizokhuluma ngothando lwezulu, nezilwandle, nezigameko ezithokozisayo," kwathi abanye bamphendula, "Yebo, Thandi, sithanda izindaba zakho!" Ngaleso sikhathi, umoya wawuvusa umoya omusha, kwathi uThandi uqala indaba yakhe. "Ngesikhathi sokugcina engikukhumbulayo," uqala, "ngabe sikhona lesi sizwe sendlela esiphuma zasemanzini. Kwakukhona umfula omkhulu, umfula owawuhamba uhlezi ngaphansi kwelanga. Ngaphandle kweziqhingi zasolwandle, uMoya weLwandle wawuvuthwa, wethula izimanga. Ngasekupheleni kwalesi sikhathi, kwavela umkhumbi omkhulu, egcwele abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Bafika, bejabulela ubuhle balo lonke uLwandle." Njengoba abesifazane nabesilisa behamba emkhunjini, uThandi waqhubeka nokuxoxa, "Ngabe nikubona lokho? Amahlathi amakhulu angamaNdebele awavela eduze kwelwandle, athokozisa izinyoni ezihambahambayo. Abantu baqala ukuvakashela, behamba ngezinyawo, bejabulisa ezindaweni ezijulile zebhishi." Abantu bamamatheka, bejabulile, besebenzisa amathuba okuhlola leli lwandle elikhulu. UThandi waqhubeka, "Kwathi lapho bezulazula, baqaphela ukuthi i-Indian Ocean iyindawo eyingqayizivele. Kukhona izilwane eziningi eziphila emanzini, ezihambelana nezinkanyezi. Izinyoni ezibhakabhakayo ziza nezinkanyezi, zibhakabhaka phezulu, zithokozisa abanye. Kukhona nezinhlanzi ezimibalabala, ezihamba phansi, zigcwele izimanga." Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bezwa izindaba zikaThandi. Ngesikhathi sokuhamba, uThandi wagxila ekuboniseni uthando lwabo nolwazi lwabo, ubuchwepheshe obubaziwayo, nezinto eziphilayo ezihambisana ne-Indian Ocean. "Ngabe nitshala kancane? Ngabe sikhona isikhala ezweni elikhulu?" Abantu bejabulela lezi zimo ezinhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi uye waqaphela ukuthi i-Indian Ocean iyigugu elikhulu. Kwakukhona izifundo ezinzima, izinkumbulo ezinhle, nezinselele ezithokozisayo. "Ngabe sicabanga ukuthi singakwazi ukubona ubuhle bethu, ukuba khona kwethu, nokuba nesizathu sokuphila?" abesifazane nabesilisa bakhuluma ngendlela ezikwenze kahle. UThandi, ethokoza, waqhubeka, "Ngabe sikhona umoya ovunguza emakhaya ethu? Ngabe sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, sikhumbula izinyanga ezinhle, sikhumbula ubuhlobo bethu neLwandle?" UThandi, ethokozisa abanye, wakhumbula izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezazizovela. Ekugcineni, uThandi washaya isithupha, "Ngabe sikhuluma ngezinkanyezi, imimoya, nezinto ezithokozisayo? I-Indian Ocean iyisikhumbuzo sokuhlangana, sokubambisana, nokuthokozisa. Noma yisiphi isikhathi, uma siphuma, sizoba sesimeni esihle." Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baqonda kahle ukuthi iLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ayilona nje kuphela uLwandle, kodwa kuyindawo ethokozayo, imemori, nezinkumbulo ezihlala zikhanya. Ngaleyo ndlela, uThandi ube nomsebenzi omkhulu. Uhlelo lokuhamba lwaluphenduka indaba, luhamba phambili, lwenza ukuba abantu bakhumbule ubuhle be-Indian Ocean. Abantu baphuma bebebhiyoza, bezwa izindaba zikaThandi, kanti uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean lwalukhanya, luhlangene nezinkanyezi, futhi lihlasela abantu ngezinkumbulo ezihlala zikhanya. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean alunakuphikiswa, kwaba yindawo ethokozisayo, eyaziwa ngothando, imimoya, nezinkanyezi. Kwakukhona ubuhle obungapheli, nesikhathi esihlala sizwakala. UThandi waba nezinye izindaba eziningi ezazizolungiselelwa, njalo, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean lwalukhanya phansi, luthokozisa bonke abahamba kulo. Futhi, lapho behamba, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean lwalukhanya, luhlanga, luphila, futhi luhamba phambili. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi waqonda ukuthi izinkanyezi, umoya, neLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean zonke zazihlangene, ziphila kanye, zikhumbula izikhathi eziluhlaza. UThandi waqhubeka, "Ngiyabonga, mngani, ngalolu hambo olunothando!"
Imidlalo Yeshashalazi: Isiko Nobuciko Bokuziveza Imidlalo yeshashalazi iyingxenye ebalulekile yobuciko bendabuko nezamasiko emhlabeni wonke. Ziningi izizathu ezenza imidlalo yeshashalazi ibaluleke kakhulu, zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa izindaba, ukusiza abantu ukuthi bakhulume ngokuqonda izinkinga zempilo, kanye nokwakha umphakathi. Nokho, lokhu kudala ingxabano phakathi kwabafundi, abaculi, nababukeli mayelana neqhaza leshashalazi emphakathini. Okokuqala, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsika ebalulekile yokuxhumana mezi zikaNkulunkulu, umphakathi, nesiko. Ngokusebenzisa ukubonisa, abalingisi bayakwazi ukuveza izimo ezinzima zokuphila, izinkinga zomphakathi, nezinselelo obhekana nazo abantu. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi yize zikhona izithiyo ezihlukene, imidlalo iyithuluzi lokwenza abantu baziqonde kahle izimo ezithile. Ngokubona izinkinga ezihlangabezana nabanye, abalandeli beqala ukubona umhlaba ngamehlo ahlukile, banikezwa kanjani ubufakazi bokuthi bahlala endaweni eyodwa nabanye. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imidlalo yeshashalazi ingakha izingxoxo ezinzima nezihlabahlosile mayelana nezinkinga zempilo. Ngokusebenzisa izimo eziguquguqukayo, abalimisi bangakwazi ukuphakamisa imicabango mayelana nezifiso nemicabango yokuphila. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obukhulu phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuholela ekwakhekeni komphakathi onobuhlakani. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuhlala ohlangothini oluphakeme lobuciko, lokho kudala ukuphikisana okwenziwa ngezifiso zomphakathi ngempela. Ukwakha umphakathi okhululekile nokwazi ukufunda kudinga imidlalo yeshashalazi. Ukubukeka kwemidlalo yeshashalazi kuhlanganisa umoya wokubambisana, lapho abantu behlangana ukuze bahlanganyele izimvo zabo. Lokhu kugqugquzela ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo nabantu, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlanga noma izizinda zobuzwe zikhuluma ngokuma kwazo kumphakathi. Imidlalo iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuhlanganyela, ukudala ukuvumelana nokufuna ukuzimela, okukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abe nendima ekufundeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibalulekile ekugcineni amasiko. Izinkolo, izinkolelo, nezimpumelelo zamasiko zihlala zikhanya kulo mkhakha. Ngaphezu kokunikeza ividiyo yokuhlola, imidlalo igcina izixhumanisi zamasiko, iqinisekisa ukuthi izigameko ezisemqoka nezimo zihlala zivezwa. Lokhu kudala ukuxhumana komphakathi futhi kugqugquzela isiZulu, nabanye ubuchwepheshe bezikole. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sihlale sinokubuyekezwa kuphela ngezinto ezinhle mayelana nezinsiza. Ubulungiswa, izicathulo, noma izinkinga zempilo zomphakathi zingaba yingxenye yemibuzo ekubukeni okwenziwayo. Ngalesi sizathu, abantu kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi ingaba nemiphumela emibi uma ingalungiswa kahle noma uma ibonisa izinkinga ezithile ngendlela engalungile. Ukuphrinta okuphelele kobuqotho nokuhlanzeka kwesiko kufanele kube yingxenye yephuzu ebalulekile. Ngeshwa, ezindaweni eziningi, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibhekana nemikhawulo yokuqhuba ezimeni ezinzima, okuthinta ubuchwepheshe nezinsiza. ukukhethwa kwemidlalo kuxhomeke kakhulu ezimakethe zomphakathi, kusukela ezindaweni ezilula kuya kwizikhungo ezinkulu zobuciko. Lokhu kudala ukubungebu okubukeka njengezithiyo emikhakheni eyahlukene, okungase kwenze ukuthi izinganekwane zibe nesithiyo ekudlaleni. Ngakho-ke, kuyadingeka ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi kube umthombo wobuchwepheshe, ukuze bonke abahlali bakwazi ukufinyelela izinhlelo ezihlukene, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Ngokusebenzisa izinkulumo eziqhubekayo nezenzakalo, imidlalo yaphakade ihlinzeka ngamathuba okuyiqonda, ithinta izinkalo ezahlukahlukene zomphakathi, ibalule izinkinga, futhi ikhulise amakhono abalingisi. Sifanele ukuhlonipha nokuvula izindlela ezintsha zokucabanga ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi iyindlela yokukhanyisa umphakathi wethu, igqugquzela umoya wokubambisana, kanye namakhono okubambisana uzokhula ezwenikazi lethu.
Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Abadali Bokuqukethwe Ezinkundleni Zokuxhumana Nemisebenzi Yedijithali Isingeniso Le dokhumenti yenqubomgomo ibhekisela kubadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali, ibalulekile ekwakheni umqondo ophusile, ophumelelayo, nolondekile. Abadali bokuqukethwe banendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobuchwepheshe, futhi le nqubomgomo ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa, izinqubo, nemigomo yokusebenza. Umqondo Wokwakha Okuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde ukuthi okuqukethwe abakudalayo kudinga ukuba kube nekhwalithi ephezulu, kube nezinjongo ezicacile, futhi kuhlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abanolwazi, abaqeqeshiwe, nabathanda ubuciko. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kuyathandwa, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale bejolisa ezidingweni zabalandeli babo. Izimiso Zokwakha Okuqukethwe 1. Ikhwalithi: Okuqukethwe kufanele kube nekhwalithi ephezulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemfanekisweni, ividiyo, noma umbhalo. Ukusebenza ngempumelelo kudinga ubuchwepheshe obufanele, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. 2. Ukwazisa: Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bahlola izindaba ezithinta umphakathi, bahloniphe izinkolelo, nezinkambiso zomphakathi. Ukuze bafeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukuba baqonde izithameli zabo. 3. Ukwethembeka: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwethembeka, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahloniphe amalungelo abantu, baphathe kahle izinsiza, futhi bagweme ukusebenzisa okuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni. 4. Ukwabelana: Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale bexhumana nabalandeli babo, bephendula imibuzo, futhi bephendula izikhalazo. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabalandeli. Izindlela Zokuxhumana Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele basebenzise izinkundla zokuxhumana ezahlukene ukuze bafinyelele izithameli eziningi. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Izinkundla Zokuxhumana: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, nezinye izinkundla ezidumile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abadali bazi ukuthi izithameli zabo zikhona kuphi, futhi basebenzise lezi zinkundla ukuze bakhe umphakathi. - Iwebhusayithi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kufinyeleleka kalula, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele babe newebhusayithi enezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izixhumanisi, izinkanyezi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. - I-imeyili: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abalandeli bahlala bekwaziswa, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele basebenzise izinhlelo zokuthumela i-imeyili ukuze bathumele izibuyekezo, izikhumbuzo, nezinhlelo ezizayo. Ukuphathwa Kokuqukethwe Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuphathwa kokuqukethwe kubalulekile ekwakheni umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Ukwenza Ucwaningo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kuyahambisana nezidingo zabalandeli, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele benze ucwaningo olujulile ukuze baqonde izitayela, izifiso, nezidingo zabantu. 2. Ukwenza Uhlelo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kudalwa ngendlela efanele, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele benze uhlelo lokwakha okuqukethwe, oluhlanganisa izinsuku, izihloko, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. 3. Ukubuyekeza Nokuhlola: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okuqukethwe kuhamba phambili, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale bebuyekeza futhi behlola imiphumela yokusebenza kwabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi yini esebenza kahle nokuthi yini edinga ukuthuthukiswa. Imithetho Nezikhumbuzo Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde imithetho nemigomo ethinta ukuhweba kwabo. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Imithetho Yokuvikela Amalungelo: Abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele baqonde imithetho yokuvikela amalungelo, kuhlanganise nezimiso zokuphatha okuqukethwe, amalungelo obunikazi, nezimiso zokuvikela idatha. - Izikhumbuzo Zokuphepha: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabalandeli, abadali bokuqukethwe kufanele bahlale beqaphela izingozi ezihambisana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, futhi baphathe kahle izinsiza zabo. Isiphetho Le dokhumenti yenqubomgomo ibalulekile kubadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali. Ukuze bafeze impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba baqonde izimiso, izindlela, nezindlela zokuphatha okuqukethwe. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakha umphakathi onobuchwepheshe, ophumelelayo, nolondekile. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lokuxhumana nedijithali.
Kucacile ukuthi le mpilo ye-HIV/AIDS izothinta zonke izindawo zokusebenza, lapho abasebenzi behlupheka ngezifo zesikhathi eside, behluleka ukuya emsebenzini, abanye befa, ukukhiqiza kwehla, nezinsiza zabasebenzi zithinteka, kanye nempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini, izindleko zokukhiqiza, kanye nokukhuthazeka emsebenzini. I-HIV ayinazikhala; ibhujiswa kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi, kungakhathaliseki ubulili, iminyaka, noma ubuzwe; kodwa manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi isimo somnotho sabantu sinomthelela ekusabalaleni nasekuqhamukeni kwalesi sifo. I-HIV iba yinhlekelele kakhulu ezindaweni nasemiphakathini ezungezwe ubuphofu, lapho kushintsha okusheshayo kwenzeka, njengokwethulwa kwezindlela zokuphila zasemadolobheni nezindlela, kanye nokwanda kokuhlukumezeka nokungazinzi. Ukusabalala kwalesi sifo kuphuthumisa ukuhamba kwabantu besuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya baye ezikhungweni zasemadolobheni. Abesifazane, ikakhulukazi, bahlala besengozini enkulu yokuthola leli gciwane ngenxa yezindlela zamasiko nezincithakalo zomnotho ezivimbela ukuba bathathe ukulawula izimpilo zabo. Enye yezindlela ezisebenza kahle zokunciphisa nokuphatha umthelela we-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza wukusebenzisa umthetho kanye nohlelo lwe-HIV/AIDS. Ukubhekana nezindaba ezithile ze-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza kuzokwenza abasebenzi, amaqembu, kanye nohulumeni babe nethuba lokwenza umnikelo ophawulekayo emizamweni yasendaweni, kazwelonke, nasemhlabeni jikelele yokuvimbela nokulawula i-HIV/AIDS. Ngakho, umthetho uhlose ukuhlela abaqashi, amaqembu, kanye nabasebenzi ngendlela yokulinganisa amalungelo nezibopho zazo zonke izithakazelo; kanye nokuphumelelisa izibopho zeRiphabhulikhi ezindaweni, njengoba iyilungu leNhlangano Yentuthuko YaseNingizimu Afrika (SADC). Inhloso eyinhloko yomthetho ukuhlinzeka abaqashi namaqembu ngemihlahlandlela yokuyisebenzisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abane-HIV bayahlulelwa ngokungafanele endaweni yokusebenza futhi kubhekwe ukuhoxiswa kwabasebenzi; kanye nokuphatha izinqubo zokukhala. Inhloso elandelayo yomthetho ukuhlinzeka abaqashi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu ngemihlahlandlela yokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza. Njengoba i-HIV/AIDS ithinta izindawo zokusebenza kanye nabantu ezingeni elihlukene, kudingeka ibhekwe ngendlela ethatha lezi zinto zonke zicabangele. Ngakho-ke, umthetho uhlanganisa izimiso ezikhuluma kabanzi ngaphansi kwemithetho ebhalwe esigabeni 5. ukuthuthukisa amasu omthetho ukuze kuhlolwe isimo nokunciphisa umnikelo walolu sifo endaweni yokusebenza; kanye nokusekela labo abaphila ne-HIV/AIDS nalabo abathintekayo ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngokukhiqiza isikhathi eside. phakathi kwabaphathi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu endaweni yokusebenza; kanye phakathi kwendawo yokusebenza nabanye abathintekayo ezingeni lezigaba, emphakathini, ezifundazweni, nakazwelonke. Ukwakhiwa kwendawo yokusebenza esekela abasebenzi abaphila ne-HIV ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile kubalulekile lapho bezizwa bekulungele ukuphatha isimo sabo sezempilo. I-HIV/AIDS ithinta abesifazane ngendlela ehlukile kunabesilisa, ngakho lokhu kumele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa izinqubo zomthetho nezinhlelo zendawo yokusebenza. Ukubonisana, okuhlanganisa wonke umuntu, nokukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okuphelele kwazo zonke izithakazelo kuyisisekelo sezinqubo zomthetho zonke nezinhlelo ze-HIV/AIDS. Bonke abaqashi nabasebenzi, kanye nezikhungo zabo, bayakhuthazwa ukuthi basebenzise lo mthetho, ukuthuthukisa, ukuwusebenzisa, nokuhlanza izinqubo zabo ze-HIV/AIDS ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zabo endaweni yokusebenza. Ngokwezinhlelo zalesi simiso, igama elithi 'indawo yokusebenza' kufanele liqondwe kabanzi kunencazelo enikezwe kwiMithetho Yezokuhweba, Umthetho 66 ka-1995, isigaba 213, ukufaka noma yisiphi isikhala lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, hhayi kuphela kulabo abaphansi kokuhlangana komsebenzi kodwa futhi kulabo abasebenza ezindaweni ezingalandeli uhlelo nalabo abazimele. Nokho, lo mthetho awubeki izibopho zomthetho ezingaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma ngakho kwiMithetho Yezokuhweba kanye neMithetho Yezokuhweba, noma yimuphi omunye umthetho okukhulunywa ngawo emthethweni. Ukwehluleka ukuhamba kahle akubeki abaqashi endaweni yokuhlangabezana nezinqubo zomthetho ezithile ngaphandle uma umthetho uqondisa izibopho ezibekwe ngumthetho. Umthetho kufanele ufundwe ndawonye nezinye izikhombisi ezinhle zokuziphatha ezingenziwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi. Okuqukethwe kwalesi simiso kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa, kuqhutshwa, noma kubuyekezwa noma yiziphi izinqubo zomthetho nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo lwezomthetho olukhuluma ngenhla. Okulandelayo yizigaba ezikhethiwe, ezihlobene nezinye zezimiso ezikhulunywe ngenhla. Lezi kufanele zifundwe ndawonye nezinye izimiso. Umthetho unikezwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 54(a) seMithetho Yezokuhweba, No 55 ka-1998, futhi isisekelo saso siwumgomo wokuthi akukho muntu okufanele ahlulelwe ngokungafanele ngoba ungena kwi-HIV. Ukuze kusizakale abaqashi nabasebenzi ekusebenziseni lo mgomo ngokuqhubekayo endaweni yokusebenza, umthetho uthole ezinye izinqubo ezihlobene. Isigaba 6 seMithetho Yezokuhweba sithi kunoma iyiphi inqubo yomthetho kanye nenqubo, akukho muntu, ophumelele, noma ofaka isicelo somsebenzi, okufanele ahlulelwe ngoba ungena kwi-HIV. Uma kukhona izinqubo zomthetho mayelana nezinsolo zokuhlulelwa ngokungafanele ngummeli, umqashi kufanele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zihlulelo noma ukwelashwa okuhlukile kwaba khona. Akukho msebenzi noma ofaka isicelo somsebenzi okufanele aphoqelelwe ukuba ahlole i-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi unayo noma cha. Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV kungaqhutshwa ngumqashi noma egameni lakhe, kuphela uma iNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ivumele ukuhlole lokhu njengokufanele nangokufanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7 seMithetho Yezokuhweba. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24(e) seMithetho Yezokwelapha, No 131 ka-1998, uhlelo lwezokwelapha akufanele luhlulele ngqo noma ngokuqondile amalungu alo ngokusekelwe "esimweni sabo sezempilo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67, izinhlelo zokulawula zingasungulwa ezidinga zonke izinhlelo zezokwelapha ukuba ziqinisekise izinga elincane lezinsiza okufanele zibe khona kuwo wonke amalungu okungenani. Akukho mqashi ovunyelwe ukusho ukuthi umqashi, noma ofaka isicelo somsebenzi, kufanele ahlole i-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi unayo noma cha. NgokweMithetho Yezokuhweba, abaqashi bangathintana neNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ukuze bafune imvume yokuhlola umqashi. Nokho, uma isigaba 7 seMithetho Yezokuhweba sivimbela abahlinzeki bezempilo abaqashwe ngumqashi ekuhloleni umqashi, uma umqashi efuna ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV, kuncike ek
Umdlavuza Kwabesifazane: Iphrofayela KaNandi Umdlavuza, igama elithokozisayo nelidumazayo, ubonakala njengomphumela wezinto eziningi ezithinta impilo yabesifazane. U-Nandi, owesifazane oneminyaka engama-35, ungomunye wabantu abahlushwa yalesi sifo. U-Nandi ungumama, umngani, nomsebenzi onothando, kodwa impilo yakhe ibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima ngenxa yomdlavuza. U-Nandi wazalwa edolobheni elincane, lapho ababephila khona impilo ejwayelekile. Uthando lwakhe lokufunda lwenza waba nesifiso sokuba udokotela, kodwa izimo zempilo zomndeni wakhe zashintsha lezi zifiso. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wathola umsebenzi emnyangweni wezempilo, lapho aqala khona ukwazi kabanzi ngempilo yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi mayelana nomdlavuza. Ngonyaka ka-2020, u-Nandi wathola ukuthi unomdlavuza wesifuba. Lokhu kwashintsha impilo yakhe ngokuphelele. U-Nandi wakhumbula kahle usuku lapho udokotela emtshela khona. "Ngazizwa ngiphukile," kusho yena. "Ngangingazi ukuthi ngizokwazi kanjani ukubhekana nalokhu." Kodwa, u-Nandi akazange avumele lesi sifo simphoqe. Waqala ukucwaninga, efunda ngazo zonke izindlela zokwelapha, izindlela zokuphila eziphilile, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa abanye abanesifo esifanayo. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye abesifazane abanezi zinkinga ezifanayo kungaba usizo olukhulu. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokuxhumana, lapho abesifazane bekwabelana ngezindaba zabo, bezama ukuxhasa omunye nomunye. Lokhu kwaba yinsiza enkulu, njengoba u-Nandi ebona ukuthi akayedwa kulolu hambo. Uthando lwakhe lokuxhasa abanye lwamnika amandla okuphila, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Nandi wathola ukuthi ukwelashwa akukhona kuphela ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kodwa futhi kudinga ukwelashwa kwengqondo. Waqala ukuhamba emitholampilo yokwelapha, lapho athola khona izindlela zokuphila eziphilile, ezimfanele. Wafunda ukuthi ukudla okunempilo, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphumula kubalulekile empilweni yakhe. Lokhu kwashintsha indlela abheka ngayo impilo, futhi wathola ukuthi angakwazi ukuphila impilo egcwele, naphezu kokuba nesifo. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi umndeni wakhe, abangani, nabanye abesifazane ababehlanganyela nabo, bamsiza kakhulu. Uthando lwabo lwenza waba namandla, futhi wathola ukuthi akayedwa kulolu hambo. U-Nandi uqhubekile nokuxhasa abanye, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi impilo ingashintsha, kodwa amandla okuphila akhona. Waqala umkhankaso wokukhuthaza abesifazane ukuba bahlale beqaphele impilo yabo, futhi baphumelele ekubhekaneni nomdlavuza. Umdlavuza kwabesifazane akuyona indaba elula, kodwa u-Nandi ubonisa ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi, amandla angavela lapho ungakuboni. Uthando, ukuxhumana, nokuzimisela kwenza kube nokwenzeka. U-Nandi ungumfanekiso ophilayo wokuthi impilo ingashintsha, kodwa amandla okuphila akhona. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila, nokuxhasa abanye, kuveza ukuthi umdlavuza awuyona impilo ephelile, kodwa kungaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Nandi uqhubekile nokusebenza emnyangweni wezempilo, lapho esebenza khona ukuze aqhubeke nokukhuthaza abesifazane. Uthando lwakhe lokuphila, kanye nomsebenzi wakhe, kuveza ukuthi umdlavuza ungaba yindlela yokwakha amandla, hhayi ukuwaphula. U-Nandi ungumama, umngani, nomsebenzi, kodwa ngaphezu kwakho konke, ungumfazi onamandla, ophila impilo egcwele, naphezu kwezithiyo. Umdlavuza kwabesifazane ungumkhakha obucayi, kodwa u-Nandi ubonisa ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi, amandla angavela lapho ungakuboni. Uthando, ukuxhumana, nokuzimisela kwenza kube nokwenzeka. Izincwadi Zabasebenzi Abasha: Umqondo Wokwakha Isiko Elisha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ziye zathola ukuthi ukwamukela abasebenzi abasha akukhona nje ukugcwalisa izikhala, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha isiko elisha. Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi ezikhishwe yiGEMS, zikhombisa indlela yokuhlonipha, yokwakha ubudlelwano, kanye nokwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izincwadi zikhombisa ukuthi umqashi uyabahlonipha futhi ubabheka njengengxenye ebalulekile yempumelelo yenkampani. Ukuqala, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zifanele zibe nezinto ezithile ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, kufanele zibe nezinhloso ezicacile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kufanele achaze kahle ukuthi yini okulindeleke kubasebenzi abasha, izinjongo zenkampani, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqonde kahle indawo yabo ngaphakathi kwenkampani, futhi bazizwe bekhululekile ukuveza imibono yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi kufanele zibe nesithakazelo sokwakha umoya wokubambisana, okungukuthi, umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi ukuba basebenzisane, baphinde bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Okwesibili, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zibe nesithakazelo sokwakha isiko elisha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi abasha ukuba baphatheke kahle, baphinde bahloniphe isiko lenkampani. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokubafundisa ngamasiko, izinqubo, kanye nezimiso ezisemqoka zenkampani. Uma abasebenzi beqonda kahle isiko lenkampani, bazoba nesifiso sokuligcina, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zibe nezinto ezithokozisayo. Umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi abasha ukuba baveze izifiso zabo, izinjongo zabo, kanye nezinto abazithandayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bazizwe bekhululekile, futhi bazokwazi ukujabulisa izifiso zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izifiso zabasebenzi zikhombisa ukuthi banelungelo lokuba neqhaza elikhulu empumelelweni yenkampani. Okwesithathu, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zibe nezindlela zokuxhumana. Umqashi kufanele akhuthaze abasebenzi abasha ukuba baxhumane, baphinde bahloniphe omunye nomunye. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi bazokwazi ukusiza omunye nomunye uma kudingeka. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zenkampani. Ngokuphetha, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zibalulekile ekwakheni isiko elisha. Umqashi kufanele aqonde ukuthi lezi zincwadi azikhona nje ukuze ziqedele izinqubo, kodwa zibalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwesiko, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabasebenzi. Uma umqashi enza lokhu, uzokwazi ukwakha indawo yokusebenza enempumelelo, lapho abasebenzi bezizwa bejabulile futhi bephumelele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zenkampani, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zibe nezinto ezithile ezibalulekile, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi abasha bayaziswa, bahlonishwa, futhi baphumelele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinjongo zenkampani. Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha zikhombisa ukuthi umqashi uyabahlonipha, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni isiko elisha.
Kwakukhona edolobheni elincane, lapho abantu behlala khona ngokuthula futhi bejabula. Kule ndawo, uSipho, umculi ophumelelayo, wayenombono omkhulu. Wayefisa ukudala ifilimu ezodala umthelela empilweni yabantu, eqiniseka ukuthi ifilimu ingashintsha umhlaba, inikeze abantu ithemba, futhi ibakhuthaze ukuba balwe nezinkinga zabo. Ngelinye ilanga, uSipho wahlangana noNandi, umdwebi wezithombe, owawunobuchwepheshe obukhulu, kodwa engakaze abe nengxenye enkulu emhlabeni wefilimu. U-Sipho wamkhuthaza ukuba bahlanganyele, babaqale iphrojekthi yabo yokuqala. Baphenduka izinsuku eziningi bejolisa emcabangweni wabo, behlola izindaba ezithinta abantu bendawo. Bafuna indaba ethinta inhliziyo, ethinta izinkinga zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, bathola indaba kaThandi, intombazane enesibindi eyayiphila ezimweni ezinzima. UThandi wayephila emndenini onobunzima, kodwa wayenamaphupho amakhulu. Wayefisa ukufunda, nokuphuma endaweni yakhe, kodwa izithiyo zazingamjolisi. U-Sipho noNandi babona ukuthi le ndaba iyingqayizivele, futhi bangakha ifilimu ezodala umthelela. Ngemuva kokuhlela, baqala ukusebenza. U-Nandi wadweba izithombe ezinhle, ngesikhathi uSipho ebhala imibhalo. Bahlanganyela imicabango, behlola izimo ezahlukene. Kwakunzima, kodwa uSipho noNandi babengapheli amandla. Bafuna ukwakha ifilimu ezokhuthaza, ezojabulisa, futhi ethokozisa abantu. Ngesikhathi sokudalwa, bahlangana nezithiyo eziningi. Abanye abantu bendawo babengakuthandi ukubona ifilimu yabo, becabanga ukuthi ayizwakali kahle. Kodwa uSipho noNandi babengakuvumeli lokhu kubaphazamise. Bafuna ukwenza okuthile okukhumbulekayo. Bahamba phambili, beqinisekisa ukuthi ifilimu yabo izoba yinto eyingqayizivele. Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokusebenza kanzima, ifilimu yabo yaphela. U-Sipho noNandi babebonisa ifilimu yabo emiphakathini ehlukene. Umphakathi wathokozisa, abantu babebuka bejabule, bephendula ngemizwa emihle. UThandi, owayengumgibeli, waba yisibonelo sokuthi amaphupho angafezeka, noma ngabe izimo zikhathaza. U-Sipho noNandi bakwazile ukudala ifilimu eyashintsha impilo kaThandi, nezimpilo zabaningi. UThandi wathola ithuba lokufunda, futhi waba yisithombe sokuphumelela. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho noNandi bazi ukuthi umsebenzi wabo awuphelanga. Ifilimu yabo yayiyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungashintsha umhlaba, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukufezekisa amaphupho abo uma bebelana. Ngemuva kokuphumelela kwabo, uSipho noNandi baqhubeka bephusha imingcele yobuciko. Bafuna ukudala ezinye izindaba, behlola izimo ezithinta abantu.
