U-Sipho wakhumbula ukuthi ifilimu akukhona kuphela ukujabulisa, kodwa futhi ukuveza izinkinga zomphakathi. Bahamba phambili, bejolisa ekwakheni ifilimu ezothinta abantu, ezizokwenza baphinde bacabange. U-Sipho noNandi bazi ukuthi umhlaba ungashintsha, futhi ifilimu yabo yayiyisinyathelo sokuqala. Babengaqondi kahle ukuthi izinsuku ezizayo zizoze zibe zinhle, kodwa babeqinisekile ukuthi ubuciko bawo bukhona. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho noNandi bakwazi ukubona ukuthi ifilimu yabo yayiyingxenye yempilo yabo, futhi izosala njalo emqondweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ifilimu yabo yathola udumo emhlabeni wonke. UThandi waba yisithombe sokuphumelela, futhi abantu abaningi baqala ukulandela izinyathelo zakhe. U-Sipho noNandi bazi ukuthi benze okuthile okubalulekile, futhi ifilimu yabo izoba yinsika yokukhuthaza abanye. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphumelela, ethokozisa abantu, futhi ibakhumbuza ukuthi amaphupho angafezeka, uma kuphela bephikelela. Ekugcineni, uSipho noNandi bazi ukuthi ifilimu yabo yayiyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungashintsha umhlaba, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukufezekisa amaphupho abo. Baphinde bazitholele ukuthi ubuciko bungokwakho, futhi kufanele buphumelele, ukuze buhlanganyele nabanye. Ifilimu yabo yayiyinsika yokukhuthaza, futhi izokhumbuleka njengenye yezinto ezinhle ezenzeka empilweni yabo.
Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sikhombisa izinselelo ezinkulu, kodwa futhi sikhona nethuba lokukhula. Ngemuva kokubhekana nezinkinga eziningi, kuhlanganisa nezinguquko zezomnotho ezibangelwa yizimo zomhlaba, izinhlelo zokuphila ezinzima, kanye nezinselelo zokuphatha, uhulumeni kanye nezinkampani ezizimele baphinde baqala ukucabangela izindlela zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Ukukhula Komnotho NgokweMnyango Wezomnotho, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ukhule ngama-2.3% ngonyaka ka-2023. Lokhu kukhula kuza ngemva kokwehla okukhulu okwakubangelwa yizimo ezinzima ezihlanganisa ubhubhane lwe-COVID-19, okwakuholele ekwehleni kokukhiqiza, ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, kanye nokwanda kwezindleko zokuphila. Abahlaziyi bathi ukukhula okukhulayo kuveza ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwe uhulumeni, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, ziye zaba nomthelela omuhle. Izinkinga Zokusebenza Nokho, isimo sokusebenza sisaqhubeka siba nzima. Izinga lokungasebenzi lihlala liphezulu, likhuphuka laya ku-34% phakathi kwabantu abasha. Lokhu kubangelwa yizizathu eziningi, kuhlanganisa nezinga eliphansi lemfundo, ukungabi khona kwamathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo embonini. Uhulumeni ubeka phambili izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imfundo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abasha bayathola amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini. Izindleko Zokuphila Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuphila zikhuphukile kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo zansuku zonke. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokudla, ugesi, namanzi kubonisa ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze alungise lezi zinkinga. Abahlali baphinde baphakamisa izwi labo, befuna izixazululo eziphusile ezizokwazi ukusiza ekwehliseni lezi zindleko. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umnotho Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ubeka phambili izinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa umnotho, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izikhungo zokukhiqiza, ukuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, kanye nokwandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokukhiqiza zikhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, futhi zikhuthaza ukuncintisana emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisa umnotho wezindawo ezisemaphandleni, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale ezindaweni zabo, futhi baphile kahle. Ubambiswano Nezinkampani Zom private Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezizimele, uhulumeni ubheke ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali kumabhizinisi amancane, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi emisha. Lokhu kubambisana kuhloswe ngokuqinisa umnotho, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abaningi bathola amathuba okusebenza. Izinkampani ezizimele zikhuthazwa ukuba zisebenzisane nohulumeni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho zisebenza kahle. Ukubheka Phambili Ngokubheka phambili, abahlaziyi baphawula ukuthi isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sikhombisa izimpawu zokuphola, kodwa kudingeka izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zimpawu ziqhubeka. Ukuze umnotho uqhubeke ukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika basebenzisane ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhlanganisa izinsiza, izinhlelo, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi, umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ungathola indlela yokuphumelela. Lokhu kuzodinga ubuhlakani, ubumbano, kanye nokuzinikela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bayazuza ekukhuleni komnotho. Umnotho ophumelelayo ungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila, ukunciphisa ubumpofu, kanye nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika sikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba kunezinselelo eziningi, kukhona nethuba lokukhula. Ukuze leli thuba litholakale, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izigaba zomphakathi zisebenzisane, ziqinisekise ukuthi umnotho uyakhula, futhi abantu baphila kahle. Umnotho ophumelelayo ungaba yisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nelizimele.
Ngiyavuma ukuthi ngalesi sikhathi seseshini yesithathu ephelele yephalamende, okuyisikhathi esilandelayo kwesokugcina, ngifuna ukuveza izifiso zami zokuthi unyaka omusha ube nemfudumalo nempumelelo kubalulekile bephalamende. Ngiyethemba ukuthi unyaka ka-2008 uzoba ngempela unyaka wezimanga kuhulumeni wethu wenhlangano njengoba sisebenza ndawonye ukuze sifinyelele amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngiyasho lokhu ngoba, njengoba sibonile, akuvamile ukuthi isizwe sikhuthazwe ukuba sibe nomzamo omkhulu ukuze siqinisekise amaphupho abantu. Umlando usibeke kule ndawo. Ngikhuluma kini namuhla, Nkosikazi, umongameli wephalamende, phambi kwenina engangithanda, u-Epainette Mbeki, uMaMofokeng, oze lapha nomyalezo ocacile ovela kubantu bezindawo ezisemaphandleni zeTranskei lapho ehlala khona iminyaka eminingi. Uthi laba bantu bafuna ukuthi sibe nesibopho sokubatshela njengabaholi bethu ukuthi ngabe sizimisele yini ukwenza ikusasa libe ngcono kunanamuhla. Ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalombili ezedlule, ngomhla kaFebhuwari 16, umama uzogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lwe-92. Iphuzu elilodwa esingamnika lona ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa yilezi: iqiniso. Ngiyabonga kuye ngokunginika ithuba lokuba nani namuhla, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi ngeke simdumele. Bonke laba bamakhosikazi abahlonishwayo abamele imikhumbulo ngethemba, ngokuba khona kwabo basikhumbuza ukuthi umsebenzi wethu ufana nomjaho ohlanganyelwe ukuze sifinyelele amaphupho okuphila kahle kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngempela, laba bagibeli bamele ukuzimisela okungaguquki ezithakazelweni zabantu bethu futhi banikeza nenselelo yokuziphatha ngendlela engaphuli noma engaphazamiseli izifiso zabantu bethu. Sesisondele ekuqaleni konyaka wokugcina wezimali yephalamende lesithathu kuhulumeni wenhlangano, ngemuva kwalokho sizohamba siye kwi zinkanyezi zokhetho lwezizwe ezine. Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima engaphathwa kahle mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi sithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni izithembiso esazenzile kubantu ngo-2004. Nokho, kubonakala ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi osele. Njengoba sesisondele ekupheleni kwesikhathi esinikeziwe kithi, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokubeka phambili Imisebenzi Ebalulekile edingekayo ukuthi yenziwe, eyahlelwa ngokubaluleka, okuzoholelwa uhulumeni ukuze kufezwe izinhloso abantu abakulindele kuHulumeni. Ngiyabonga ngoba isitatimende sokuhlala kwesizwe sinikeze ithuba lokubika ephalamende nasemphakathini ngalezi zenzakalo eziyi-24 ezihlelwe ukuba ziphumelele ngaphambi kwezinye, okungatholakala kubalulekile bephalamende kuwebhusayithi kahulumeni ngesonto elizayo. Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile ezidinga ukuba zenziwe ngaphambi kwezinye kusho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezizweni, ezifundazweni, nasezindaweni, kukhabhinethi nasemphakathini zikhuthazwa ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Bonke ohulumeni bazoqinisekisa ukuthi esikhathini esizayo bazozama ukuhlinzeka kuzo zonke izindawo - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma ngeNqubo Engajwayelekile, asisho ukuthi izinqubomgomo zohulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sisho ngesivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, kanye namandla nempumelelo okuzophumeleliswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphila kwabantu ngokushesha. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka, sithatha izinyathelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umgomo oholayo wokuthi izimali zisetshenziswe minyaka yonke uzokhishwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali ngaphambi kokuphela kwale nyanga, okuvumela ukuba sifinyelele lezi zenzakalo ezidinga ukuba zenziwe ngaphambi kwezinye. Sizokhulisa ukuvumelanisa nezindawo ezibalulekile ngokubambisana namanye amazwe, sigxile ezindabeni zase-Afrika nasemibhalweni enezinhloso ezilungile. Isimo esibhekene naso nomsebenzi esizibophezele ukwenza sidinga ukusiza abantu ukuba bahlangane njengokuhlanganyela ukuze sifeze zonke izinto ezidinga ukuba zenziwe, singakhohlwa ukuthi sonke sithwala ikusasa lethu ezandleni zethu! Njengoba sonke sisebenza ndawonye lapha ezweni lethu, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene - neNqubo Engajwayelekile! Ngesikhathi ngilungiselela le nkulumo, omunye wethu wakhuluma kimi ngombono wokuthi izwe lethu lihlushwa umoya onamandla okwenza kube nzima ukubona ukuthi izwe lethu lizoba kuphi kusasa. Kube nezikhathi ezinhle nezimbi, izikhathi zokuhlakanipha nezikhathi zokuphoxeka, izikhathi zokukholwa okuqinile, izikhathi zokumangala okuqinile, izikhathi zokukhanya, izikhathi zobumnyama, izikhathi zethemba, izikhathi zokuphoxeka; sasinakho konke phambi kwethu, sasinganakho konke phambi kwethu, sonke sasingaya ezulwini, sonke sasingaya kwenye indlela - ngokufingqa, isikhathi sasiwufana nalesi esikuso manje, kangangokuthi abaholi abakhuluma kakhulu bathi akufanele samukele lesi sikhathi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuzoba kuhle noma kubi uma sikala ngokuphambene nakho konke. Impendulo yami ithi: Yebo! Njengohulumeni, ngikholelwa ukuthi isisekelo esakhe eminyakeni engu-14 edlule siqinile. Kumele siqhubeke nokusebenza kulolu sizo ukuze siqhubeke phambili futhi siqedele amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngakho-ke, kumele sonke sikhuthaze ukuthi sisendleleni yokuphumelela njengomphakathi. Nokho, njengokubona bonke abahlonishwayo, kubonakala kimi ukuthi abaningi emphakathini bayakhathazeka, bengenathemba lokuthi izwe lizoba kuphi kusasa. Bakhathazekile ngalokho okwenzeka emnothweni wethu, ikakhulukazi ukukhula kokwenyuka kwezindleko, ukudla, nezindleko zokuthenga uphethiloli, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abampofu ukuba baphile. Abanye bethu bakhathazekile ngalokho okuzokwenzeka emnothweni wethu uma ukwenyuka kwezindleko kuqhubeka (lesi yisikhathi lapho amandla omnotho ehla kakhulu, futhi umnotho ungase ungakhuli). Bakhathazekile ukuthi ngabe sinesikhala sokuvikela amalungelo obumbano, nomthetho wesichibiyelo osunguliwe ngokuzibophezela kwabantu abaningi ngezimpilo zabo. Lokhu kukhuthazwa ngezinkinga ezifana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabaphathi bamaphoyisa, ukuvalelwa komqondisi-jikelele ehhovisi lokuphikisa, ukwesaba ukuthi abahluleli abanaso isikhala sokwenza izinqumo ngokuzimela nokuphula umthetho, nokuthi abantu basebenzisa amandla omphakathi ukuze balwe nezimpi zabo zezombusazwe. Bayazi futhi bahlonipha ilungelo leqembu elibusayo lokwenza izinto ngendlela yabo, kodwa bafuna leli qembu liqhubeke nokudlala indima yalo njengelakhe elasungulwa nguNingizimu Afrika ophumelele ophathiswe ngenhloso yabantu, engahlukanisi ngohlanga noma ngobufazi. Kubonakala ukuthi asifanele sithathe lezi zinkinga kalula noma sizithathe njengabaprofethi abashumayela ukuwaph
Ubufakazi Bokukhanselwa Kobulungu Besikhwama Sangaphambilini (GEMS Previous Scheme Membership Cancellation Proof) Umbuzo 1: Yini ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini? Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama sangaphambilini, obukwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS cancellation proof, kuyidokhumenti ebonisa ukuthi ummember (ilungu) usukhanseli ubulungu bawo esikhwameni se-GEMS. Le dokhumenti ibalulekile ngoba ifakazela ukuthi ilungu alisasebenzisi izinsizakalo ze-GEMS futhi ingasetshenziswa uma kudingeka ukufakazela isimo salo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukuba ne-GEMS cancellation proof? Ukuba ne-GEMS cancellation proof kubalulekile ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, le dokhumenti isiza ukuvikela ilungu ekukhathazekeni ngezinsizakalo ezithile ezivela esikhwameni se-GEMS. Okwesibili, uma ilungu ifuna ukujoyina esinye isikhwama sokwelashwa, le dokhumenti ingaba usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi alikho ubuhlobo obukhona phakathi kwemishanguzo emibili. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okuthi kube nezinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Umbuzo 3: Ngabe ngingayithola kanjani le dokhumenti? Ukuze uthole ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama se-GEMS, kufanele uqale uxhumane ne-ofisi ye-GEMS. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokushayela inombolo yabo yocingo, noma uvakashele iwebhusayithi yabo ukuze uthole imininingwane ethile yokuxhumana. Kuye ngohlobo lokukhansela, ungase udinge ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile efana nenombolo yakho yokubhaliswa, igama, nomndeni wakho. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinyathelo okufanele ngizithathe ukuze ngikhanseli ubulungu bami? Izinyathelo zokukhansela ubulungu bethu zihluke kancane kuye ngesikhwama, kodwa ngokujwayelekile, kufanele ulandele lezi zinyathelo: 1. Xhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole ulwazi olucacile. 2. Bhala incwadi yokukhansela, ubonise isizathu sokukhansela. 3. Thumela le ncwadi kwikhompyutha ethile noma ngeposi, ngokwezidingo ze-GEMS. 4. Linda ukuqinisekiswa kokukhansela, okuzokwenziwa nge-imeyili noma ngeposi. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe kukhona izindleko ezihambisana nokukhansela? Ngokuvamile, ukukhansela ubulungu akuhlanganisi nezindleko ezinkulu, kodwa kungenzeka kube nezindleko ezithile ezihlobene nezinsizakalo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukufunda imigomo nemibandela ye-GEMS ukuze uqonde kahle izindleko ezingase zibe khona. Uma ungazi kahle, ungababuza ngokuqondile ngesikhathi uxhumana ne-GEMS. Umbuzo 6: Ngabe ngithola ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ngesikhathi esifanele? Yebo, uma usuhambisile zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo, i-GEMS izokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze ikuthumele ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuvame ukuthatha izinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa kungase kube nezimo ezithile ezithinta isikhathi sokuphendula. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlinzeka ngemininingwane ephelele ukuze kube lula kubo ukuhlela. Umbuzo 7: Yini engiyenzayo uma ngingatholanga ubufakazi bokukhanselwa? Uma ungatholanga ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ngemva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo, kufanele uxhumane ne-GEMS ukuze ubheke isimo sokuphendula. Ungase udinge ukuhambisa izincwadi zakho noma ukucacisa izinyathelo ozithathile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubufakazi buyatholakala. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe ngingabuyela esikhwameni se-GEMS uma ngikhansile? Yebo, uma usukhansile ubulungu bakho, ungabuyela esikhwameni se-GEMS uma uthanda. Kodwa, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyahlangabezana nezidingo zokubuyela, ezihlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile futhi uhlole izimo ezithile ezihambisana nokubuyela. Kubalulekile ukufunda izinqubomgomo ze-GEMS ukuze uqonde kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo zokukhansela ubulungu? Yebo, ukukhansela ubulungu kungaba nezinzuzo ezithile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukunciphisa izindleko zokwelashwa uma ungasebenzisi izinsizakalo ze-GEMS, noma ukubeka isikhala sokuthi uthole ezinye izinsizakalo ezihambelana nezidingo zakho. Kodwa, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlole kahle izinzuzo nezingozi ngaphambi kokwenza isinqumo. Umbuzo 10: Yini engiyifunda kulolu chungechunge? Kulolu chungechunge, ufunde ukuthi ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama se-GEMS buwusizo kakhulu ekuphatheni izinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Ukwazi izinyathelo ezidingekayo, izindleko, nezimo ezihambisana nokukhansela kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba uthathe izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinsizakalo zakho zezempilo. Ngakho-ke, uma ucabanga ngokukhansela ubulungu bakho, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo futhi uthole ubufakazi bokukhanselwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungena ezinkingeni ezizayo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa buwumgogodla wokuphatha kahle izinsizakalo zakho zezempilo.
Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa (GEMS Treatment Outcome Responsibility) Umbuzo 1: Yini iGEMS? IGEMS, noma iGlobal Evaluation and Management of Services, iyinqubo yokuhlola nokuphatha imiphumela yokwelashwa emithini. Le nqubo ibhekene nokuhlonza imiphumela ehlobene nokwelashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olungcono. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukufaka isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa? Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa siqukethe umthwalo wokuhlola ukuthi inqubo yokwelapha ikhiqiza imiphumela efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwelashwa kuhamba kahle noma cha, futhi kusiza odokotela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinhle kumakhosikazi abo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinto ezibhekwa uma kuhlolwa imiphumela yokwelashwa? Uma kuhlolwa imiphumela yokwelashwa, kubalulekile ukubheka: - Izinga lokuphila leziguli - Ukuncipha kwezimpawu - Izindleko zokwelashwa - Imiphumela emibi ethinta iziguli - Ukusebenza kwezinsiza zempilo Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenziwa uma imiphumela yokwelashwa ingahambisani nezilindelo? Uma imiphumela yokwelashwa ingahambisani nezilindelo, kudinga ukuba kube nezinqumo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukubuyekeza indlela yokwelapha, ukusungula izindlela ezintsha, noma ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezikhulu zezempilo neziguli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izidingo zicacisiwe. Umbuzo 5: Kuthiwani ngezingozi ezihambisana neGEMS? Njengokuhlola noma iyiphi enye inqubo, iGEMS nayo inezingozi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa: - Ukungabi nalo ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela ngendlela efanele - Ukuhamba phambili nezikhathi zokubuyekeza ezinzima - Ukungaqondi kahle izidingo zeziguli Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuqinisekisa isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa? Izinzuzo zokuqinisekiswa kweGEMS zifaka: - Ukwanda kokuzethemba phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo neziguli - Ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yokunakekelwa - Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi odokotela banolwazi olucacile ngesimo sokwelapha Umbuzo 7: Ubani ofanele ukuthatha umthwalo wesibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa? Umthwalo wesibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa uthwalwa yizikhungo zokwelapha, odokotela, kanye nezisebenzi zezempilo. Bonke kumele bahlale behlanganyela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa igcinwa iphawuleka kahle. Umbuzo 8: Kumphumela uma ukuphathwa kwemiphumela yokwelashwa ingenela? Uma ukuphathwa kwemiphumela yokwelashwa kungenela, iziguli zingabhekana nemiphumela emibi, ezinjengokuthola ukwelashwa okungafanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekuncipheni kokwethemba emithini nasabezempilo, nokwandisa izinkinga zezempilo ezithinta umphakathi. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe kunezinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakalayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe iGEMS? Yebo, kunezinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakalayo ezizama ukusiza osomabhizinisi, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo ukuthi baqonde ngemiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlola izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene nezifundo ezimayelana nezimfanelo zokuphatha nokuhlola imiphumela. Umbuzo 10: Yini ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iGEMS iyaphumelela? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iGEMS iyaphumelela, kufanele kube ne: - Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo - Ukuqonda izidingo zeziguli - Ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezisezingeni lomhlaba Isiphetho Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa (GEMS) siyisici esibalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke iziguli, odokotela, kanye nezikhungo zisebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukwelashwa kuhamba kahle. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphumela yokwelashwa akugcini nje ngokuthuthukisa izinga lokunakekelwa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ukwethemba phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zempilo. Ngakho-ke, qhubekani nokuqonda isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa ukuze sithuthukise ikusasa lempilo yethu.
Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule Izinhlelo zama-internship zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono nolwazi lwabafundi abaphothule. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza ukufunda okwenziwa emsebenzini, okuvumela abafundi ukuba baqonde izidingo zemboni, baphinde bathole ithuba lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwabo olutholakele ezikhungweni zemfundo. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zama-internship ezitholakalayo kubafundi abaphothule, izinzuzo zazo, nezindlela zokuphumelela emkhakheni wezokusebenza. Izindlela zama-internship 1. Izinhlelo zokuqashwa ezihlelwe yizikhungo zemfundo Izikhungo zemfundo ziningi ezihlinzeka ngezinhlelo zama-internship ezikhethekile ukuze ziqhube abafundi emsebenzini. Lezi zinhlelo zivame ukuhlanganisa izifundo ezithile ezihlobene nomkhakha, okuvumela abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olujulile. Ukuze abafundi baphumelele kulezi zinhlelo, kudingeka bahlale beqedile izifundo ezithile, futhi bahlale bephumelela ezivivinyweni ezithile. 2. Izinhlelo zama-internship ezizimele Abafundi bangasebenzisa izinhlelo zama-internship ezizimele, lapho behlola amathuba emisebenzi bezodwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufaka izicelo ezikhungweni ezahlukene, ukuthola ama-referensi, noma ukwenza ucwaningo ukuze bathole izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngama-internship. Le ndlela ivumela abafundi ukuba babe nekhono lokuphatha izinqumo zabo, futhi ibavumela ukuba bakhe amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. 3. Izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezinkampani Izikhungo zemfundo ziningi ezisebenzisana nezinkampani ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola ithuba lokusebenza. Lezi zinhlelo zihlala ziqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala befinyelela ezinhlelweni ezihlinzekwa yizinkampani ezihamba phambili emikhakheni yabo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezemfundo nezomnotho, okwenza abafundi bakwazi ukuthola amathuba angcono. 4. Ama-internship ahlinzekwa ngabezindaba Abafundi abaphothule bangasebenzisa ama-internship ahlinzekwa ngabezindaba, lapho bethola ithuba lokusebenza ezinkampanini ezinkulu, ezikhiqiza izindaba, noma ezokuxhumana. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe amakhono okukhuluma, ukubhala, kanye nokuxhumana, okuvumela ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Izinzuzo zama-internship Ama-internship ahlinzeka ngezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa abafundi abaphothule. Ezinye zezinzuzo zifaka: 1. Ukwanda kwamakhono Abafundi bathola ithuba lokuthuthukisa amakhono abo emsebenzini, okuhlanganisa amakhono okuxhumana, ukuphatha isikhathi, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ikhono labo lokusebenza ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. 2. Ukwazi imisebenzi Ama-internship avumela abafundi ukuba baqonde kangcono izimfuno zemisebenzi emikhakheni yabo. Lokhu kubasiza ukuba bahlale beqonda izinguquko ezisemkhakheni, nezidingo ezithile ezihambisana nezifundo zabo. 3. Ukuxhumana nabantu Abafundi bathola ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obubalulekile nabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudala amathuba okuxhumana, okungaholela emathubeni emisebenzi esikhathini esizayo. 4. Ukuthola izitifiketi Abafundi abanama-internship bangathola izitifiketi ezikhombisa ulwazi lwabo, okungasiza ekwandiseni amathuba abo emisebenzi. Lezi zitifiketi zikhombisa ukuthi abafundi benza kahle emkhakheni wabo, futhi zikhuthaza abaqashi ukuba bacabangele abafundi abanezi zitifiketi. Izindlela zokuphumelela emkhakheni wezokusebenza Ukuze abafundi baphumelele emkhakheni wezokusebenza, kudingeka balandele izinyathelo ezithile: 1. Ukuzimisela Abafundi kumele babe nezifiso ezicacile zokuphumelela. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuzimisela ukufunda, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokusebenza kanzima ukuze bafeze izinjongo zabo. 2. Ukuxhumana Abafundi kumele bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu abavela emikhakheni yabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bathole amathuba emisebenzi, futhi bahlale befinyelela ezinsizakazini ezihlukene. 3. Ukuzibandakanya Abafundi kumele bazibandakanye ezinhlelweni ezihlukene, njengokuhlanganyela emisebenzini, izifundo ezengeziwe, noma imihlangano. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi bahlale beqonda izinguquko emkhakheni wabo. 4. Ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela Abafundi kumele bakwazi ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela nabanye, ukuze bathole amava ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile, futhi bahlale beqonda izidingo zomsebenzi. Isiphetho Izindlela zama-internship zabafundi abaphothule zibalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphumelela emsebenzini. Lezi zindlela zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo, baqonde kangcono izimfuno zemisebenzi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obubalulekile emikhakheni yabo. Ngokulandela izinyathelo ezithile, abafundi bangathola amathuba angcono, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi baphumelela emsebenzini. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzimisela, nokuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze abafundi baphumelele emkhakheni wezokusebenza.
Ezokuxhumana Nomphakathi: Indlela Yokwakha Ubudlelwano Obuhle Ezokuxhumana nomphakathi, noma public relations (PR), zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani, izikhungo, nezinhlaka zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudinga ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uyiphethwe yinkampani enkulu noma umphakathi omncane, akwazi ukuveza izimvo, imizwa, nezidingo zabo. Ukuze ukwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuba nesu elihle lokuxhumana. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani nezakhamuzi badinga ukwakhiwa ngamathuluzi kufanele. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nokuba nomqondo ohlangene phakathi kwabantu. Uma izinkampani zikhuluma ngqo nabathengi, zikhuthaza ukwethembana, ziveza ukuzimisela kokubheka izidingo zabantu. Ngokwesibonelo, uma inkampani ibona ukuthi imikhiqizo yayo ayihlangabezani nezimfuno zemakethe, kufanele ikwazi ukulalela izinkomba ezivela emphakathini ukuze ithuthukise imikhiqizo yayo ngezinye izikhathi. Ngaphezu kwaleso sikhathi, ezokuxhumana nomphakathi zibalulekile ekubambeni isithunzi esihle senkampani. Ukuphuma phambili nokubamba imicimbi ebamba umphakathi kungakhuthaza ukubonwa okukhulu kwezinkampani. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana ngokwakha izinhlelo ezithile, ukweseka imicimbi yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, noma ukwenza imisebenzi yokuzithandela ezokuthuthukisa isithunzi senkampani. Lapho abantu bebona imizamo ethile yokuthola ubuhlobo, bazi ukuthi inkampani izimisele ukusiza nokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Isici esibalulekile ezokuxhumana nomphakathi y ukufaka abesifazane, abesilisa, izingane, nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umfanekiso owahlukahlukene phakathi kwezinhlaka ezithile zomphakathi. Izinkampani ezibamba iqhaza ekwahleni imikhankaso ethinta abantu bempilo, ezemvelo, nezokuthutha zikhombisa ukuthi ziyaqonda ukubaluleka kokuhluka. Lokhu kudala ukwakheka kokuxhumana obuhlukile, okuletha imiphumela engcono kumaphrojekthi ezokuxhumana ezikhona. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuze kube nokwenza kahle ezokuxhumana nomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo ohlangene, osiza ukuveza ukwakhiwa kokuqonda phakathi kwezinkampani nomphakathi. Lokhu kudinga isiqiniseko sokuba zonke izingxenye zomphakathi zikhulume nokulalela, futhi kucaciswe kahle ngezindlela ezahlukene. Njengoba sithola izixhumanisi ezintsha, kufanele sihlale sihamba phambili, sithuthukisa imikhankaso yethu, futhi sigcine izixhumanisi ezikahle. Ngaphandle kokubeka obala ezokuxhumana nomphakathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kubalulekile ukuqonda izinkampani kwabanye umphakathi. Kukhona izidingo ezithile zemboni, ezikhiqiza umphumela ohluke ngokuphelele kumphakathi. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuhlonipha izimiso, ubuhlakani, kanye nokuqonda okuphezulu okuthinta abantu emiphakathini. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola, siqonde izifiso zabantu, futhi senze izinhlelo ezithinta imiphakathi ukuze sizuze umphumela omuhle. Naphezu kwalokhu konke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokwakha izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana, zihlale zisebenza emakhaya ethu nasemiphakathini. Ukuze sithuthukise kakhulu, kumele sifake izinyathelo ezazisa abantu, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ezihloniphekile. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubekele phambili, ngothando kanye nokusebenzisana, ukuze sakhe umphakathi onempilo, onesithembiso. Ngokwesigaba sokugcina, ezokuxhumana nomphakathi azigcini nje ngokuxhumanisa izinkampani nabantu, kodwa futhi ke zibuye zibe yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ozwakalayo, ogcwele ukubambisana. Ukuzimisela kwabantu, izinkampani, nemiphakathi ukuthola izixazululo eziwusizo kuyisisekelo sokwakha ubuhlobo obuhlaza emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Kulolu hlelo, uma sikhuluma ngezokuxhumana, siyaqinisekisa ukuthi sizobe sigcina umoya obuhle, kuvele kubonakale izinzuzo ezinkulu kumphakathi wonke. Lokhu kuzokweqa umphakathi wethu phambili, sibe kukhulu, sibe namandla.
Umlando WaseNingizimu Afrika Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ungumfanekiso wobuhlakani, ubukhosi, nezinkumbulo ezinzima. Izigameko eziningi ezibalulekile zenzeka kuleli, okuhlanganisa izinguquko zomphakathi, izimpi, nemibono emisha. Ukuze siqonde kahle leli lizwe, kubalulekile ukuthi sibheke izigameko ezahlukene ezakha umlando wethu. Umlando uqala lapho izizwe zokuqala, njengezamaKhoisan, zihlala kuleli. Lezi zizwe zazinomlando ocebile, zikhuluma izilimi ezahlukene, futhi zabeziqhenya ngamasiko nezinkolelo zabo. Izizwe zamaBantu, ezifana namaXhosa namaZulu, zafika kuleli maphakathi nekhulu le-1, okuholele ekwakhekeni kwezinkolo, izindlela zokuphila, nemiphakathi ehlangene. Ngesikhathi sokufika kwabantu baseYurophu, ikakhulukazi abangamaDutch ngo-1652, kwavela ushintsho olukhulu. Lezi zizwe zafika nezinhlelo zokuhweba, kodwa zabamba umhlaba, zabhidliza izimpilo zabantu bendabuko. Lokhu kwaholela ekuphuleni kwamalungelo abantu, ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zamasiko, kanye nezimpi ezandulela ubukhomanisi, okubizwa ngokuthi yimpi yokuqala phakathi kweDutch neZulu ngo-1836. Umgwaqo omkhulu wempilo yama-Afrika wenzeka phakathi nekhulu le-20, lapho umqondo wobandlululo waqala ukubonakala. Uhlelo lobandlululo lwezombusazwe lwavuma ngo-1948, lwathinta kakhulu izimpilo zabantu abamnyama. Lokhu kwaholela ekuphikisaneni okuqhubekayo, okuhlanganisa nezimpikiswano ezaziholela ekwakheni amaqembu afana ne-African National Congress (ANC). Ukwenzeka kweMpi yeMpi eGhana ngo-1957 kwaba nomthelela omkhulu, kuholela ekwandeni kokucaciswa kwempilo yokuphila kwabantu abamnyama. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphila ngaphansi kobandlululo, uNelson Mandela, obengumholi we-ANC, wakhululwa ejele ngo-1990, okuveza umphumela omuhle ebuhlotsheni phakathi kwamazwe. Izinyathelo eziyinqaba, ezinjengezivumelwano zikaCODESA, zakhulisa ithemba lokuthula nokuhlangana. Ukwamukelwa kwenhlalo enobulungiswa, umthetho wesibili wamaNgqongqoshe, kwaphumelela ngo-1994, lapho kwaba nezinqumo ezibalulekile zokuvota. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuba uMandela abe nguMengameli wokuqala omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika, okwakuyisikhathi esisha sokwakha isizwe esisha. Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibheka emuva kumlando wayo, ibalulekile ukufunda nokuhlola izifundo ezitholakala emlandweni. Izinselele zakhona zifaka ukukhathazeka ngezinga lokuhlukumezeka, ububha, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlupheka. Nokho, izinto zisabukeka zikhanya kwezokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, osuka ekubeni umphakathi owahlukanisiwe waya empilweni efanele yokuhlalisana. Sikhumbula ukuthi umlando awupheli, kodwa uhlala uhlobene nezikhathi eziphilayo. Ukubheka emuva kumlando weNingizimu Afrika, sikhumbula izifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala ezingqondweni zethu. Ukubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha izinkolelo nezamasiko ahlukene kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Sinaso isibopho sokwakha isizwe esinobumbano, esihlonipha izimpilo zawo bonke abahlali bayo. Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ungumthombo wokukhumbula, ukufunda, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kungokwenza kube khona umoya wokubambisana, ukwakha isizwe esibumbene, futhi kuqhubekisele phambili izifiso zokuphila kwesizukulwane esizayo. Ngakho-ke, sithi: "Siyakhumbula, siyafunda, futhi sizokwakha."
Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Inhloso yokubamba umuntu ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsolwa ubonakala enkantolo. Umuntu obanjwe ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenacala kuze kube kufakazelwa ukuthi unecala. Ngalesi sizathu, wonke umuntu obanjwe kufanele aphathwe kahle futhi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Kukhona amaposta azisa ngamalungelo abantu ababanjwe. Iposi kufanele ibekwe odongeni ngaphambi kokuqala kwalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezihlosiwe zalesi sikhathi. Lesi sigaba 38 seMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezigwegwe siphinde sinikeze ezinye izindlela ezingcono zokubamba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvela enkantolo. Lezi zindlela kufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokukhetha ukubamba ngoba isigaba 36 (e) seMthethosisekelo sikhombisa ukuthi umuntu kumele acabangele izindlela ezingaphazamisi kakhulu ukuze afinyelele inhloso (kulokhu, ukuqinisekisa ukuvela komuntu enkantolo). Ukubamba kufanele kube yindlela yokugcina. Ukubamba akusiyo indlela yokukhipha umuntu emphakathini okwethula isikhala, futhi akusiyo indlela yokujezisa. Umuntu angabanjwa ngokwephephandaba noma ngaphandle kwephephandaba. Khumbula ukuthi kuhle kakhulu ukuthola iphepha lokubamba. Okuhle ngakho ukuthi kuvikela amapolisa ekubanjweni icala futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukubamba nokuthola ubufakazi kusemthethweni. Iphepha lokubamba lingatholwa kumgibeli noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukugcina ukuthula, okungabandakanya uphiko lwezokuphepha oluphakeme. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhamba phambili ngenkulumo mayelana nenhloso yokubamba umuntu nezinye izindlela zokwenza ukuthi bavele enkantolo. Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Yini okusho ukuthi umuntu ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenacala? Yiziphi ezinye izindlela, ngaphandle kokubamba, ezingaqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu obhekene necala ubonakala enkantolo? Cela abafundi ukuthi baphendule umbiko ngalokho abaxoxile. Phatha ingxoxo bese uqedela. Izinto ezidingekayo ngesikhathi sokuphetha. Akukho mfuneko yokuxhumana nomuntu ovuma ngesikhathi ebambwa. Uma umuntu ephikisa ukubamba, kungasetshenziswa amandla afanele (amandla amancane) ukuze kwenziwe ukubamba. Umphakathi obamba kufanele, ngokushesha okukhulu, azise umuntu obanjwe ngesizathu sokubamba. Uma umuntu ebambwa ngaphansi kwephephandaba, ikhophi kufanele inikezwe uma iceliwe. Umuntu obanjwe kufanele aziswe ngamalungelo akhe ngokushesha okukhulu (njengoba kungenzeka kahle kulolu simo) njengoba kuqinisekiswe esigabeni 35 seMthethosisekelo. Amapolisa kumele azise futhi achaze la malungelo wonke kumuntu obanjwe futhi aqinisekise ukuthi uyawuqonda ngokuhambisana nesigaba 35 seMthethosisekelo. Ukubhekwa njengomuntu ongenacala kuhambisana nelungelo lokungazibandakanyi futhi nelungelo lokuhlala silent. Umuntu obhekene necala akaphoqwa ukusiza isimo kulolu daba. Uma isimo sishaya umuntu, kufanele sithole ubufakazi obuqinile bokuthi umuntu unecala. Inhloso yalolu suku iwukuthi amapolisa acabangele amalungelo abantu abanjwe kanye nezibopho abahlangabezana nazo mayelana nalabo abanjwe. Yini indlela efanele yokubamba umuntu? Yiziphi amalungelo nezibopho zomuntu obanjwe? Yini indima yamapolisa lapho bebamba umuntu? Yini okufanele amapolisa azise umuntu obanjwe ngesikhathi sokubamba? Nini futhi kuphi umuntu obanjwe angafaka isicelo sokukhululwa? Yiziphi amalungelo omuntu obanjwe angaphulwa? Lezi z права zingaphulwa kanjani? Phatha ingxoxo ejwayelekile mayelana nezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba, uqale ngamandla amancane angasetshenziswa. Nini amapolisa angashaya umuntu ophumayo? Ingabe amandla angasetshenziswa uma kuseshwa umuntu obanjwe? Uma umuntu engavumi, amapolisa kufanele kuqala ashaye phezulu ukuze abambelele, kodwa lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokubeka muntu engcupheni. Uma umuntu eqhubeka nokuphuma, khona-ke bangashaywa. Kufanele uzame ukuhlela ngendlela engakubulali, njengokushaya emlenzeni. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhamba phambili ngenkulumo mayelana nezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba. Cela abafundi ukuthi baxoxe ngezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa lapho bebamba umuntu, uqale ngamandla amancane. Sebenzisa amandla afanele. Sebenzisa leyo mandla kuphela edingekayo ukuvikela wena kanye nabantu ongenacala abakuzungezile futhi ukuze uthole impumelelo yokubamba umuntu. Kufanele usebenzise amandla kuphela adingekayo ukuze ugweme ingozi, ukuphikisana, nokuvikela wena. Izinga lamandla lihluka ngokwezigameko zengozi, ukuphikisana, nokuhlasela. Uma umuntu ephikisa ukubamba, izinga lokungabaza lingaba nendima enkulu ekunqumeni ukuthi yikuphi izinga lamandla okusetshenziswa. Kukhona izinhlobo zamandla ezingafanele ukusetshenziswa uma kuwukwephula okuncane. Sebenzisa kuphela amandla amancane. Uma umuntu engaphikisi ukubamba, ngisho namandla amancane akufanele asetshenziswe. Lezi zindlela ezilandelayo zichaza umgomo wesidingo futhi zikhombisa izinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba. Uma umuntu echaza ukuthi ungumgibeli ngokubona noma ngokukhuluma, noma ngokuhola noma ngokukhuthaza. Uma amapolisa eyala noma etshela umuntu ukuthi enze okuthile. (Isibonelo: uma umsolwa ebaleka futhi amapolisa eqhwaga ukuthi umume). Izindlela ezinezingcuphe ezincane zokulimala. Isibonelo: Uma amapolisa efaka isandla esifubeni somuntu futhi emtshela ukuthi angahambi. Izindlela ezingase zibe nomthelela. Ukusebenzisa amandla, ubuhlungu ukuze umuntu avume, ukuhudula nezindlela zokucindezela, nezindlela zokuphatha ezinzima lapho kuxoxwa ngezitho zomzimba. Ukubamba umuntu ngemuva kwekhanda uma ungumgibeli oqeqeshiwe, noma enye ingxenye/ukwehla/ukuphuma kwempilo okwenziwa ngendlela edinga ingcindezi ezindaweni ezibucayi ukuze kuvinjelwe leyo ngxenye yesikhathi esithile ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo kuthinta ingqondo okwesikhashana. Ezinye izindlela zikhubaza ukuhamba okwesikhashana noma zilawule ukusebenza. Amabhola e-rubber/izikhali ezithinta njengokugunyazwa ngalesi sikhathi asetshenziswa ngababheki abaqeqeshiwe. Ukucindezela ngamandla/izikhali noma izindlela zokuphila ezingase ziphelelwe "ekufeni noma ekulimazeni okukhulu". Sebenzisa kuphela amandla adingekayo ukuvikela wena kanye nalabo ongenacala abakuzungezile ngesikhathi sokubamba. Ngesikhathi sokubamba, kungase kwenzeke ukuthi amapolisa azithole edinga ukuvikela. Khumbula ukuthi usebenzisa kuphela amandla adingekayo ukuvikela wena nabantu ongenacala abakuzungezile. Ingabe ukusetshenziswa kwamandla bekufanele kulolu simo? Ingabe bekukhona ukuvumelana phakathi kwesidingo samandla nenani lamandla asetshenziswe? Umphikisi wathola kanjani? Ingabe amandla asetshenziswe ngendlela efanele futhi enengqondo noma kwasetshenziswa ngokweqile, ngaphandle kwesidingo, noma ngenkani? Lokhu kuyindaba ebucayi. Isigaba 49 se-CPA sisaphenywa. Okuqukethwe kwalokhu kuphendula kungashintsha. UMthethosisekelo (isigaba 11) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila. Ngakho-ke, amapolisa angashaya umphikisi kuphela ezimweni ezikhethekile kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umthetho uvumela ini mayelana nokushaya umuntu ophum
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezithombe Nemidwebo Ezikhungweni Ekuqaleni kwesikhathi, izikhungo zibe yizindawo ezibalulekile zokuhlangana kwabantu, zokufundisa, nokukhuthaza ubuciko. Emazweni amaningi, izithombe nemidwebo zibe neqhaza elibalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wezikhungo. Lokhu kuqala ngaphezu kweminyaka eyinkulungwane edlule, ngesikhathi lapho ubuciko bokuqala buvela khona emiphakathini eminingi. Izithombe nemidwebo zikhombisa izimo zokuphila zaleso sikhathi. Kulokhu, izikhungo zakuqala, njengezinkanyezi zemifino ezakhiwe ngempahla yemvelo, zazinamathele kakhulu ezithombeni zezimfanelo zabantu, izilwane, nezimo zemvelo. Ubufakazi bokuqala bokusebenzisa izithombe buvela ezikhungweni zemfundo, lapho izithombe zisetshenziswa khona ukufundisa abafundi ngezinto ezahlukene. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ukuqonda kwabantu, nokubenza baqonde imvelaphi yabantu babo. Kwabesifazane, izithombe zabe zibalulekile ekwakheni isithombe somphakathi. Izithombe ezithathwe ngesikhathi sokuqala zibe ngabesifazane abaphethe izikhungo, bezokwenza izinqumo ezibalulekile emiphakathini yabo. Ubuciko babezama ukuveza imizwa yabo nokukhombisa izifiso zabo. Lezi zithombe zaba yizixhumanisi zempilo yabo, futhi zaba yinkomba yokwakha izinto ezintsha ezikhungweni. Ngemva kwesikhathi sobukhosi, ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo kwaqhubeka kubalulekile ezikhungweni, futhi kwanda ukusakazeka kwazo emiphakathini. Emakhaya, izikhungo zemiphakathi zaba nendawo ekhethekile yokugcina imidwebo, futhi lokhu kwavuleka eminyakeni eyishumi, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bakhulume ngendalo yethu, ezilwaneni, nasemdlalweni. Ngaleso sikhathi, izikhungo zafakwa imidwebo ezihlasela imininingwane nemicabango eyahlukene. Lezi zikhumbuzo zamaphupho, izifiso, nezimvo zabantu zakhombisa izigigaba ezinomlando, okwakusho ukuthi abantu babengathokoziswa yizithombe ezihlobene nezikhathi ezithile zomlando. Ubuye baphinde baveze ukwakheka kwemvelo, izifundazwe, nabantu abafudumele abalwa nosuku. Njengoba izikhungo zakhula, nakhu kusuka ezinsukwini zokuqala kwehluka nezinye izikhungo ukuze zikhuthaze ubuciko, ukufundiswa, kanye nokuxhumana. Uhlu lwemisebenzi olwamukelwa kulabo abavakashela izikhungo luye lwaqhamuka, kufaka phakathi imiqhudelwano yokudweba, imihlangano yokwakha, nezinkulumo ezihlaba umxhwele. Izithombe nemidwebo zakhula, zifika ezindaweni ezimqoka zansuku zonke, kube njengezikhumbuzo zabantu. Izithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni zaba yizinkumbulo ezivusa imizwa, zikhipha izindawo zokufunda, futhi zisiza abantu ukuba baqonde izifundo zabantu baphakathi. Lokhu kuwubufakazi bokuthi ubuciko buvuselela izinkumbulo ezinhle, kuveza imizwa eyatholakala emuva kweminyaka. Ukuba nezinye izithombe nemidwebo ezakha isithombe sokwakheka komphakathi kwabqamuka ekuboniseni izimo ezinzima, kwaba yindlela yokwakha isithombe esihle. Namuhla, izithombe nemidwebo azikapheli lapho, ziyaqhubeka zisetshenziswa ezikhungweni ezahlukene, zibhalela izinkumbulo zethu. Eziqhingini nasemakhaya, zisaziswa ngabantu, njengoba zikhombisa izinsuku ezishiwo phambili. Ukusakazwa kwezithombe kwenze kube khona umuzwa ngokwakha umphakathi oguquguqukayo, obonisa imizwa namahlaya abavakashi. Ngale ndlela, ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni kuhlala kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha isithombe somphakathi. Iziqingo zomlando zihlanganisa ubuciko, imizwa, nokuqonda okuyindida. I-legacy kwezithombe nemidwebo iqhubeka ikhuluma, ibakhumbuza abantu baleso sikhathi, nezinselele abakade behlangabezana nazo. Bayavuselela, bayadumaza, futhi banikeza ithemba elisha lokwakha imiphakathi ezinzima. Njengoba siqhubeka phambili, izithombe nemidwebo zibuye zigcine zilinganiselwa ezinhlelweni zokufundisa, zokuhlola, nokwakha ubuciko obusha. Phela, zibe yizinto ezingcono zamasiko, futhi zikhumbuza ukuthi ubuciko abupheli, bukhuluma ngemizwa yethu nokuqonda okukhona phakathi kwethu. Futhi, izikhungo zethu ziyaqhubeka zihlomula kule nqubo yokwakha, zithole ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezisekelwe emiphakathini yethu.
Umbhalo uxoxa ngemicimbi yokungenisa inhlanzi evela kwamanye amazwe eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuhweba. Ukuze ungenise inhlanzi, kumele ufake isicelo sephermithi esinikezwe umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma igunya elikhethiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungenisa inhlanzi zangaphandle ngaphandle kwalesi sithupha. Kumele kufakwe isicelo esisha sephermithi uma lesi sikhona sesiphelelwe yisikhathi. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nemithetho yephermithi kungaholela ekuphumisweni noma ekukhanselweni kwephermithi. Ukuthunyelwa okuphelele kwenhlanzi okukhuluma kuze kube ngama-600g ngasikhathi sinye noma umthwalo ophelele ongadluli ku-25 tons ngonyaka kuvunyelwe. Ukungeniswa kwenhlanzi eziphilayo akuvunyelwe. Ifomu lesicelo kumele liqedwe kahle, kuhlanganiswe nekheli lomthengisi ezweni lokwakheka, amagama ajwayelekile kanye nezobuchwepheshe zenhlanzi, kanye nenani elizongeniswa. Ikhophi ethunyelwe emaphoyiseni yokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho kanye nenombolo yokubhaliswa kwenkampani yakho, kanye nekhophi ethunyelwe emaphoyiseni yephermithi yokungenisa evela emnyangweni wezohwebo nezimboni noma isaziso sephermithi, kudingeka. Gcwalisa, sign, bese uthumela ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo ezikhungweni ezibhekelele amanzi nezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Thumela imibhalo yokuqala; kungenjalo, ipheshithi ngeke likhishwe. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma yonke imibhalo igcwele. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kucacisiwe ngumenzi wezokuphatha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma igunya elikhethiwe ngokuxoxisana nomphakathi wezomnotho.
Izindaba Ezintsha: Ukukhuthazwa Kwentsha Emphakathini Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intsha ibonakala iyingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Ezweni lethu, intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inethuba elikhulu lokwenza umehluko. Kuleli sonto, sizobheka izinhlelo ezahlukene ezikhuthaza intsha, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa ubuhlakani nobuchwepheshe bayo. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Intsha Izinhlelo ezikhona zokuqinisa intsha zifaka phakathi imifundaze, ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Izikhungo zemfundo zisebenza ngokubambisana nohulumeni ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi intsha ithola amathuba afanele. Ngokwesibonelo, uHulumeni weSizwe uqalile uhlelo olusha lokuxhasa abafundi abasha abahamba phambili ezikhungweni zemfundo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imifundaze ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zokusebenza zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ibambe iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezobuchwepheshe, ezokwakha, nezokuthengisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha ithola amakhono adingekayo ukuze ibe neqhaza elihle emnothweni. Ubuhlakani Nobuchwepheshe Intsha yamanje ibonakala iphenduka ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kobuchwepheshe. I-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi, okuvumela intsha ukuba ibonise ubuhlakani bayo. Izinhlelo zokufunda eziku-inthanethi zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ifunde ngezifundo ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphezulu zokufunda. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-‘Code.org’ ne-‘Khan Academy’ zikhuthaza intsha ukuba ifunde izifundo zobuchwepheshe, okuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, ogcwele abantu abanamakhono ahlukahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa umnotho. Izinkinga Ezibhekene Nentsha Nokho, intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukungasebenzi, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima zenza kube nzima kubantu abasha ukuba baphumelele. Ubulungiswa bezimali, ukungabi namathuba okusebenza, kanye nezinkinga zempilo zikhathaza intsha, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuba bafeze amaphupho abo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana lukhombisa ukuthi intsha ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi zokuphila, okuhlanganisa nokucindezeleka, ukwehla kwemizwa, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi ube nezinqubomgomo eziphusile zokuxhasa intsha, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle, nokwakha izinhlelo zokwelashwa. Ukubambisana Emphakathini Ukuze intsha iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubambisane. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizokwenza intsha ibonakale. Izinhlelo ezihlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzithandela, imicimbi yokwazisa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi yokuxhasa intsha, njengemiphakathi yokufunda, imiphakathi yokusebenza, kanye nemiphakathi yokuxhumana, kungasiza intsha ukuba ibone ukuthi ayiyedwa kulolu hambo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emathubeni, futhi kubavumele ukuba baphumelele. Isiphetho Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukusiza intsha ukuba ibonakale, ibonise ubuhlakani bayo, futhi ibambe iqhaza empilweni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ezikhuthaza intsha, kanye nokuxhasa ubuhlakani bayo, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba intsha ibonakale njengengxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelinothile, ukuze intsha yethu ikwazi ukuthola amathuba afanele. Ukwakha umphakathi onempilo kudinga imizamo eqhubekayo, kodwa uma sibambisana, singakwazi ukufezekisa lokho. Intsha iyisizukulwane esizayo, futhi umphakathi ungakha izisekelo eziqinile ukuze ibonakale futhi ibambe iqhaza emhlabeni.
Izinga Lemfundo Ezikoleni Zikahulumeni: Umqondo Wami Ezweni lethu, imfundo ibaluleke kakhulu. Izingane zethu zikhula zifuna ukufunda, zifuna ukwazi, futhi zifuna amathuba okuphila kangcono. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngempela, izinga lemfundo ezikoleni zikahulumeni lihlala liphansi, futhi lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka okukhulu. Ngiyavuma, imizamo yokuthuthukisa imfundo iyenzeka, kodwa izinselelo eziningi zihlala zikhona. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wemfundo ezweni lethu. Ziningi izikole ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, kodwa izinga lemfundo elitholakala kulezi zikole alihambisani nezidingo zamanje. Abafundi bethu bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezinsiza ezincane, izifundo ezingaphelele, kanye nezifundiswa ezinganaki kahle abafundi. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi, njengoba abafundi bengenzi kahle ezivivinyweni nasemakhono abawadingayo ukuze baphumelele empilweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezikhona ezikoleni zikahulumeni zihlala zinganele. Izincwadi, amathuluzi okufunda, nezikhungo zokufundisa zihlala zikhona, kodwa ziningi izikole ezithola ukungabi nakho. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abafundi bahlale behluleka ukufunda kahle, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni bahlale bephuma emkhakheni wemfundo. Abafundi abangenayo imfundo efanele bahlala benokungabi nempumelelo ezimpilweni zabo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Ngokubheka izinga lemfundo ezikoleni zikahulumeni, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngothando lokufunda. Abafundi badinga ukugqugquzelwa ukuze bathande ukufunda, kodwa uma izimo ezikhona zingezinhle, lokhu kuba nzima. Izifundiswa ezithanda ukufundisa, ezikhuthazayo, zidingeka ukuze ziqinise uthando lokufunda. Uma abafundi bebona ukuthi izifundiswa zabo zikhathalela impilo yabo, bazoba nesifiso sokufunda nokukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikhona ezikoleni zikahulumeni zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza izifundo zibe zikhuthazayo, zibe nezifundo ezihambisana nezidingo zamanje. Izifundo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, nezokuphila zibalulekile ukuze abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi bazobhekana nani emhlabeni. Uma izikole zikahulumeni zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zifundo, sizobona abafundi bethu behluleka ukuhamba phambili. Kodwa-ke, akusikho konke okubi. Kukhona izinhlelo ezithile ezikhona ezizama ukuthuthukisa izinga lemfundo ezikoleni zikahulumeni. Uhlelo lwezikhungo zokufunda, izinhlelo zokuxhumana nabafundi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izifundiswa zikhona. Lokhu kuhle, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nokuhlanganyela okuningi phakathi kukahulumeni, izikole, nabazali. Uma bonke bebandakanyeka, sizokwazi ukwakha isisekelo esiqinile semfundo ezikoleni zikahulumeni. Ngokuphetha, izinga lemfundo ezikoleni zikahulumeni lidinga ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu. Abafundi bethu badinga izinsiza ezanele, izifundiswa ezikhuthazayo, nezinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisana nezidingo zamanje. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi bethu. Imfundo iyisisekelo sokuphila, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi bethu bathola ithuba lokufunda kahle. Lokhu kuzoba yisinyathelo esikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi onothando lokufunda.
Ukwamukela Imigomo Yenqubomgomo (GEMS Member Policy Acceptance) Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, inani labantu abavuma ukujoyina uMnyango wezempilo weGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) liqhubeke nokukhula nsuku zonke. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthandwa kwenqubomgomo yezempilo ekhokhelwa nguhulumeni, ehlanganisa izinzuzo eziningi kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze abathanda ukuthola lezi zinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi bamukele imigomo nenqubomgomo yeGEMS, ukuze baqhubeke bezithola izinsizakusebenza okufanele zikhokhwe. Izinsuku ezimbalwa ezedlule, abaphathi beGEMS bahlela umcimbi omkhulu wokwamukela abasha emkhakheni wezempilo. Lo mcimbi, obanjwe edolobheni elikhulu, wabamba izinkulungwane zabantu, kufaka phakathi abasebenzi, odokotela, kanye nezinhlangano ezihamba phambili emkhakheni wezempilo. Umholi weGEMS, uMnu. Khwezi Mlamli, uvule lesi sithangami ngokwazisa kubantu abasha ukuthi imithetho nemigomo yeGEMS iwusizo olukhulu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abafuna ukunakekelwa kwabempilo okuhamba phambili. U-Mnu. Mlamli wagcizelela ukuthi ukuqonda kahle le migomo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. “Sifuna abantu bazi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zenzelwe ukunikeza ukwesekwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi kini abesifazane, abantwana, nabantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile,” kusho uMlamli. Ubulimungu bezempilo bukhula emhlabeni wonke, ngobunye ubusuku kwezobuchwepheshe, kumele kube namathuba angaphezulu okubona ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abavoti bahlala behlangabezana nezinkinga ezithile, njengezindleko eziphezulu zokwelashwa, isikhangiso seziguli eziningi, kanye nezizathu ezahlukahlukene zokungaphumi kahle. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nalezi zinkinga, uGEMS usungule izinhlelo eziningi zokulwela abantu abavela ezindleleni eziphansi zomphakathi. Lesi sikhumbuzo sokubamba iqhaza sinikela eli thuba elihle lokuthi abathintekayo baqonde izinqubomgomo ezisemthethweni futhi baneture engakhathalelwa. Ngokwengxenye yombukiso, abathintekayo banikwe ithuba lokuthola ukuxhumana ngqo nodokotela nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Lokhu kwavuleka ithuba lokucacisela umbuzo ongalungile nokusiza abantu abakazalwa ukuba baqonde izinzuzo ezenza umphakathi wazi ukuthi cishe ungakuthola kuphi. Umphakathi uyaqhubeka nokukhuluma ngendlela yokuxhumana nemigomo yamapholisi, okuyinto ethokozisayo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abheleleka kunoma yisiphi isikhangiso. Uhlanga lwemali luhlala lungokubhekwa futhi abahlomuli bangacela izilirho ngosuku lokubhaliswa ukuze iqhaza ngqo. Lokhu kunciphisa isidingo sokuthi abathintekayo baye emiphakathini yokwelashwa, nabo banika ithuba lokwamukela imithetho yesikhathi esikwazi ukuba kulabo abavame ukudlula emafutheni aphakeme. "Kuyasiza ukuba siqondise imigomo eqondile, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufaka izicelo zokwelashwa kalula," kusho uMnumzane Thabo Khumalo, ongumholi wezokuxhumana eGEMS. “Ngokukhipha lolu hlaka, sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akekho umuntu ozodlula emnyango weGEMS ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle.“ Ukuze abatungamizwi bezempilo baqinisekise ukwakhiwa kwezinklanyiso ezintsha, uGEMS uhlinzeka ngocwaningo lokumalunga nemigomo eyomile, ngalesi sikhathi kumele uthole izithombe ezinhle kakhulu ezingakuholela ekusebenzeni okuhlejj! Ngale ndlela, uGEMS uphinde wenze iziqinisekiso zokwelashwa ezihambisana neziqu zomphakathi, kuhlanganiswe nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubaqhamukayo ukuthi bafoo umphakathi njengabazulelayo, futhi banikezwe iesemwayeni uma befika. Ngokuphumula, uMnu. Mlamli wagcizelela ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enakekelwayo kubalulekile, bese bukhona abavuma ukufaka ukuphenya, okuhlobene nezifundo ezithile ezinzima zeGEMS, okuyinto ewusizo. Lokhu kuzojabulisa futhi kuzokwenza kucace ukuthi uGEMS ungumkhiqizo odumile emkhakheni wezempilo. Ngokuqhubekayo, abavuma abangewona abavumelekile, kodwa baqhubeka nokugqugquzela abantu ukuba bavele baphakamise izinqubomgomo zentuthuko, njengoba imizamo yeGEMS isiza ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. Izinhlelo zokwamukela imithetho ziyavuma, zikhumbuze bonke abantu ukuthi empilweni, onke amagalelo abaluleke kakhulu!
Iqembu libizwa nge-Uphuzane. Le ndawo yePhuzane ingatholakala enyakatho KwaZulu-Natal uma uhamba amakhilomitha angama-25 usuka ePaulpietersburg, eduze komfula obizwa ngeBivane River. Lapha ngempela kusemaphandleni futhi akukho okukhuluma ngakho ngesiNgisi njengemikhiqizo yokwakha (izinsiza zokulima nezokutshala, ukuthuthwa, ukuthenga nokuthengisa, noma okuthile). Abalimi nabo abanamakhono nolwazi lokulima bodwa. Kuleli qembu lokufunda, kukhona abakhiqizi besilisa nabesifazane abakhuthazekile ukufunda nokwandisa inzuzo yabo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabo futhi kusebenze kangcono ngezinsiza zemvelo ezikhona. Okwamanje, abakhiqizi basebenzisa amahektare angama-70 angalimiwa, kodwa kusekhona izindawo eziningi ezingalimiwe ezingakhiqiza. Kungani kunezindawo ezingalimiwe? Izizathu zokungalimwa kulezo zindawo ikakhulukazi zisezingeni lezimali, ngoba izindawo eziningi ziyizinkambu zomhlaba jikelele, futhi amabhange nabanye abanikazi bezikweletu bayazithiba ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo mali ngoba abanalo uqinisekiso lokuthi bazothola le mali emuva. Enye inkinga imishini; abalimi abanamatractor nezinye izinto. Iqembu lihlangana nini? Iqembu lihlangana kanye ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngezinkinga zamalungu nezindlela zokusebenzisa izinsiza zabo ezincane. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leli qembu lokufunda? Ngithole isimanga esikhulu lapho ngiya ukubona lokho abakwenza; ngathola ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima zesimanje ukuze bakhiqize (ukulima ngaphandle kokulima) ngempumelelo ngo-2009/2010. Lo nyaka baqale ukutshala ngaphandle kokulima besebenzisa indlela yokulima ngaphandle kokulima futhi bathola umkhiqizo ophakeme kunowonyaka odlule. Ukuzimisela kwabo nokufisa ukushintsha, ukushiya izindlela zokutshala zendabuko, nokuzama izindlela ezintsha kukhombisa ukuthi abashiyi emuva ekushintsheni futhi babona ukuthi ukufunda kwabo nentuthuko kubanika impumelelo enkulu. Bayazi lokho okukhuluma abadala: 'Ulala futhi uhlale emuva' - labo abangahambi phambili bazoshiywa emuva. Abakhiqizi bathola ukuthi bathola ulwazi oluningi uma beyiye amalungu eqembu lokufunda futhi behambele ezinsukwini zabalimi lapho kukhona izifundo. Enye indlela yokuthola ulwazi ukusebenzisa izindawo zokubonisa, ezikhombisa abalimi indlela entsha eqondile yokutshala ummbila. Ingabe kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwale qembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Kukho ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eqembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho abaseduzane, kodwa abanye bahlala kude futhi abakwazi ukuhlangana nabo kalula - lokhu kuyinkinga. Iqembu lihlangana kahle neMnyango Wezolimo kaHulumeni nabanye abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo.
Thola ulwazi kumagunya afanele mayelana nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezivela phesheya noma kumamele umphakathi walowo mzansi ophatha izimpahla mayelana nezimo zokuhlolwa kwezifo zezilwane kulowo mzansi ophathwayo. I-NPPO yaseNingizimu Afrika ingakunika nolwazi. Ngokubambisana ne-NPPO yaseNingizimu Afrika, thola ukuthi ungakwazi yini noma ungakwazi yini ukuhambisana nezimo zokungenisa izimpahla ezivela ezweni ofuna ukungenisa kulo. I-NPPO yaseNingizimu Afrika ikhipha isitifiketi esivumela ukuthi izimpahla azinazo izifo uma izimpahla zihlangabezana nezidingo zokungenisa zezwe eziya kulo. Izimpahla kumele zithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokuhlolwa kokugcina. Isitifiketi sokuqala esivumela ukuthi izimpahla azinazo izifo kumele sihambe nezimpahla. Uma izitshalo noma imikhiqizo yezitshalo ethunyelwa ifika endaweni yokungena yezwe eziya kulo, abahloli bezempilo yezitshalo be-NPPO yalowo mzansi bazobamba lezo zimpahla ukuze zihlolwe. Ummeleli noma umthumeli kumele abe nayo yonke imibhalo yokungenisa ukuze ayethule kubaphathi bezokuthunyelwa ezindaweni zokungena kwezimpahla kulowo mzansi. Isikhathi sokukhipha isitifiketi sokuvunywa sokuthi izimpahla azinazo izifo sincike kumkhiqizo othile kulowo mzansi; bheka ku-inthanethi: iphrothokholi yokuthumela.
Ama-Social Media: Umthelela Wawo Empilweni Yethu Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ama-social media asebenza njengomnyango omkhulu ohlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Njengoba sikhuluma ngama-social media, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi awawona nje ama-platforms okuxhumana, kodwa futhi ayizinkundla ezinamandla ezithinta izimpilo zethu, izinqumo zethu, kanye nemibono yethu. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukwabelana ngembono yami ngalezi zinkundla ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, ama-social media anikeza ithuba elikhulu lokuxhumana. Ngaphambi kokuba kube khona lezi zinkundla, abantu babebhekene nezithiyo eziningi zokuxhumana, ikakhulukazi uma bephila kude. Namuhla, umuntu angaxhumana nomngani osemazweni angama-10 kanyekanye, okwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemicabango, izenzakalo, nezithombe. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba seduze, nakuba sikhona kude. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media akhuthaza abantu ukuba babelane ngemicabango yabo, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-social media awanazo zonke izinzuzo. Njengoba sithola ulwazi olukhulu, sithola nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhathazeka ngempilo yengqondo sekuyinto ejwayelekile phakathi kwabantu abathola ulwazi olungapheli. Ukuphazamiseka okukhulu, ukucwaswa, kanye nokucindezelwa kungenzeka uma abantu bephendula ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kudala umoya wokungazethembi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha abathola ukuthi izinga labo lokuphila lilinganiswa ngempela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media akhuthaza umqondo wokuphila okungokoqobo. Abantu bahlala bejolise ezintweni ezinhle, okwenza kube nzima ukuba bakhumbule ukuthi impilo ayilula. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bephoxekile uma impilo yabo ingahambisani nalokho abakubona ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Umphakathi uthola umbono ongafanele wokuthi impilo kufanele ibe yinhle njalo, okwenza kube nzima ukwamukela izinselelo ezijwayelekile. Ngokubheka lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuphila kahle phakathi kwama-social media. Okokuqala, kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlukanisa phakathi kokuxhumana okuhle nokubi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana ziwusizo kanjani empilweni yethu. Uma sithola ukuthi izinkundla zenza sibe nezinselelo, kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuzihoxisa noma ukunciphisa isikhathi esichithwa kuzo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu, ikakhulukazi abasha, ngezingozi ezihambisana nama-social media. Ukuqonda ukuthi izithombe ezithunyelwe noma imibono engafanele ingaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile futhi bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, ama-social media angaba yinsiza enkulu uma sisebenzisa kahle. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi, njengabantu, sinesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola, ukufunda, nokuxhumana ngendlela efanele. Uma sikwazi ukwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukujabulisa impilo yethu, sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke ama-social media ngendlela ehlakaniphile. Akukhona nje ukuthi sithumele izithombe ezinhle noma sabelane ngemicabango, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, ophilayo, nolungile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukujabulisa impilo yethu, sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sibe nomthelela omuhle emhlabeni jikelele.
Imfashini: Umcimbi Wokukhanya Kwezemfashini eGoli Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi omkhulu wezokugqoka, owaziwa ngokuthi "I-Gauteng Fashion Week," wabanjwa eGoli, edolobheni elidume ngempumelelo yalo emkhakheni wezokwakha imfashini. Lo mcimbi, obuhlanganisa abaqambi, abathandi bemfashini, kanye nezinkampani ezihamba phambili, wawuhloselwe ukukhombisa ubuciko, ubuhle, kanye nezitayela ezihamba phambili emhlabeni wezokugqoka. Umcimbi uqale ngengxoxo ethokozisayo phakathi kwabaculi bemfashini abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bechaza izitayela zabo, izinsiza abazisebenzisayo, kanye nezinto ezithinta imfashini namuhla. Ababukeli babenethuba lokuzwa izindaba ezithokozisayo ezivela kubadali bemfashini, okuhlanganisa nezifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala emkhakheni. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuxhumana phakathi kwabathandi bemfashini nabadali, okwakuhlosiwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile ngale mikhakha. Ngemuva kwengxoxo, umcimbi uqhubekile nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezazihamba phambili emkhakheni wezokugqoka. Abamodeli baphuma bejabulile, begqoke izingubo ezihlukahlukene ezikhiqizwe ngabadali abavela eNingizimu Afrika. Izingubo zikhombisa ubuciko obuhlukahlukene, kusukela ezindaweni ezijulile zamasiko zethu, kuze kube sezitayeleni eziphakeme ezivela emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokuziveza, yokukhuluma, nokuhlonipha izimpande zethu. Izinkanyezi ezazihamba phambili zifaka phakathi uThando Thabethe, uBonang Matheba, kanye noMaps Maponyane, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. UThando, owaziwa ngempela ngempumelelo yakhe emkhakheni wezokwakha imfashini, wabelane ngolwazi lwakhe lokuthi imfashini ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yomuntu. UBonang, onobuchwepheshe obukhulu bokuphatha, wakhombisa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokwakha ibhizinisi eliphumelelayo. UMaps, owaziwa ngokuqhubeka nokwakha umkhiqizo wakhe, wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bejabulile, futhi bejabulisa abanye ngezimpahla abazigqokayo. Ngemuva kokukhombisa izitayela ezihlukahlukene, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi ababukeli baphenduka bezithokozisa ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezibukwayo. Abathandi bemfashini baphinde banikwe ithuba lokuthenga izingubo ezithile ezitholakala emcimbini, okuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuxhumana phakathi kwabathandi bemfashini nabadali. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha ubuciko bethu. Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ukuthi imfashini iyindlela yokukhuluma, yokuziveza, kanye nokuhlonipha izimpande zethu. Ababukeli baphuma bejabulile, bephinde bejabulisa abanye ngempilo yabo, futhi bejabulisa abanye ngezimpahla abazigqokayo. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha ubuciko bethu. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi we-Gauteng Fashion Week ubonise ukuthi imfashini ayiyona nje into yokugqoka, kodwa iyindlela yokukhuluma, yokuziveza, nokuhlonipha izimpande zethu. Ubuqotho, ubuciko, kanye nezitayela ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ukuthi imfashini iyindlela yokuphila, futhi ibalulekile empilweni yethu. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha ubuciko bethu. Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili zikhombisa ukuthi imfashini iyindlela yokukhuluma, yokuziveza, kanye nokuhlonipha izimpande zethu.
Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula isu lokusebenza leMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke eyethulwe nguNgqongqoshe. IMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke iwumphumela wezixoxiswano ezibanzi ezathatha ukuqala ngonyaka ka-1995 lapho kwabekwa khona iQembu Lezabelo Zolimi (LANGTAG). Isu lokusebenza linikeza imihlahlandlela ezosetshenziswa ukuze kufezwe kahle iMithetho Yezilimi, kukhuthazwe izakhiwo ezizodingeka ekusebenzeni kwayo nasekuzameni ukuthuthukisa nokukhuthaza izilimi zethu zomdabu zase-Afrika. Uhulumeni uyawazi umthelela wokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungakho isu lokusebenza ligcizelela inqubo ethokozisa ushintsho futhi ibheke phambili. Njengoba ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu kubhekwa njengesisekelo seMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza lihlose ukusungula izakhiwo zolimi kanye nezinhlelo ezifanele zokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi kwiMisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukubambisana esikwenza ezingeni likazwelonke, ezindaweni, kanye nohulumeni bendawo kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi iMithetho Yezilimi isebenza kahle. Uma sicabanga ngenselelo ehambisana nohulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zithola izinsizakalo ngokushesha futhi ukuthi ulimi luwumsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi, kubonakala ukuthi iMithetho Yezilimi kufanele iqale ukusebenza ngokuphuthumayo. Ngale ndlela, ngifisa ukucela bonke abahlanganyeli esibambisene nabo, kuhlanganise nezakhiwo nohulumeni kanye nezinsizakalo kanye neBhodi Yezilimi Zomdabu yaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi le Nqubomgomo Yokusebenza iguqula ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene kube yinto eqinile kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Le Nqubomgomo Yokusebenza ingxenye yeMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke (NLPF) evumela amandla ezinhlinzeko zolimi njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 6 seMthethosisekelo ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996). Uma sekuqediwe, yonke le mikhakha izohlanganisa iMibiko yeMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza, umthetho wezilimi ophakanyisiwe nezinhlinzeko zawo, kanye nomthetho ophakanyisiwe weBhodi Yezilimi Zochwepheshe baseNingizimu Afrika. Isu lokusebenza lenziwa njengokuphakanyiswa okujolise ekushintsheni futhi kungashintshwa ngezakhiwo ezithile nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza izilimi ezahlukene. Umbiko weNqubomgomo ye-NLPF wamenyezelwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko namasiko, Isayensi nobuchwepheshe ngomhla ka-3 kuZibandlela 2002. IBhodi yePhalamende ithole lo mbiko ngomhla ka-12 kuNdasa 2003. Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni ukuze kukhuthazwe ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni, ulwazi, nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Lezi zinjongo zixhomeke empumelelweni yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu eziphucukile. Njengoba ulimi luwumsebenzi wokuxhumana ezimpilweni nasezindaweni zabantu, kubalulekile ukusungula izinhlelo zokubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona. Isu lokusebenza lichaza izakhiwo ezidingekayo nezinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iMithetho Yezilimi kanye nezinsizakalo zezimali ezihlinzekwa ezikhungweni zikazwelonke nezasezifundazweni zisebenza kahle. Le nqubomgomo icacile mayelana nomkhakha walolu suku olwenziwe. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni (kazwelonke, ezifundazweni, nezasekhaya) zibophelelekile ezinhlinzekweni zenqubomgomo kanye nanoma yiziphi izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla noma ezihlinzeka ngensizakalo yomphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho. Iphakheji ngayinye noma isifunda ingakhetha ulimi lwayo lokusebenza. Nokho, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi akekho ophoqelelwe ekusebenziseni ulimi lwakhe. Uma kudingeka ukuhumusha noma ukuhunyushwa kwedokhumenti ethile ngolimi oluthile, lokhu kuzokwenziwa. Mayelana nokuxhumana okubhalwe phansi, kufanele kulandelwe uhlelo lokushicilela oluqaphela ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene (kuqondwa izithameli, umyalezo, kanye nomongo) kulokhu okungadingi ukuhunyushwa kuzo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye. Uma isikhungo esithile sikahulumeni sifuna ukuveza ulwazi ngokujulile, kufanele shicilele ulwazi kuzo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni. Ngaphansi kwezimo lapho imibhalo kahulumeni ingatholakali kuzo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni, izikhungo zikahulumeni kazwelonke kufanele zishicilele idokhumenti ngesikhathi esifanayo, okungenani ezilimini eziyisithupha. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba kufanele usebenze lapho kukhethwa izilimi ezisemqoka zeNguni neSotho. Isimo esithile okufanele silandelwe ukuthi okungenani izikhungo zikahulumeni kazwelonke zikhawulelwe ekushicileleni imibhalo esemthethweni ezilimini eziyisithupha noma ngaphezulu. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba awusebenzi ezifundazweni ngoba zinegunya lokusebenzisa izilimi ezikhethiweyo. Izikhungo zikahulumeni bendawo zizokwenza isinqumo sokusebenzisa ulimi njengoba kuceliwe umphakathi kulandela isikhumbuzo senqubomgomo yolimi esisunguliwe esifundazweni. Ngemuva kokunquma ulimi oluzosetshenziswa futhi oluceliwe umphakathi, ohulumeni bendawo kufanele bathuthukise, bashicilele, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi inqubomgomo yezilimi ezahlukene iyasebenza, okumele kwenziwe ngokubambisana eduze nomphakathi. Emibhalweni esemthethweni, ulimi olwakhethwe yisakhamuzi kufanele lusetshenziswe. Zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana kufanele zenziwe ngolimi olusemthethweni olwakhethwe yilabo bantu noma indawo. Uma kudingeka, zonke izindlela kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kusebenze izinsizakalo zolimi ezifana nokuhumusha (ukulandela ukukhuluma, ukuhumusha ngesikhathi esifanayo, ukuhumusha ngocingo, noma ukuhumusha ngokuthula) uma kukhona indlela. Lokhu kusebenza ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni lesifunda nasezwenikazi. Inqubo yokusebenza komsebenzi ophakanyisiwe iqondiswa yizinhloso nezinhlelo ezibekwe enqubomgomeni. Lezi zindawo ezilandelayo zizogxilwa kuzo: a Ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu kuhambisana nokusungulwa kwezinsiza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo efana nezikhangiso nezincazelo zolimi. b Ukuqinisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinzuzo zezinqubomgomo zomphakathi zabelwa ngendlela efanele ngokunika zonke izakhamuzi ithuba lokufinyelela kuzo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yisiphi ulimi abawusebenzisayo, inqobo nje uma kukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwabo nezwi ematfubeni kaHulumeni. c Ukuphathwa kwezilimi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni zine ithuba lokusebenza futhi ziqinisa isithunzi soHulumeni. d Ukukhuthaza ukufunda izilimi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezidingo zeMisebenzi Yomphakathi, ukuthuthukisa amandla okwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi nokukhombisa kahle izinzuzo zok
Hheyi, unjani? Ngizokhuluma ngalezi zinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezithinta indlela izitimela ezisebenza ngayo, futhi kumele sikhulume ngazo. Okokuqala, sobala ukuthi izitimela zika-Transnet zibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ziyindlela enkulu yokuhambisa impahla, kodwa zikhona izinkinga eziningi. Ukugcina izitimela zisesimweni esihle akulula. Ukuxhumana kwezitimela, izikhala zokuhamba, nezinsiza zikhona ezimeni ezithile ezidala izinkinga. Isibonelo, uma sithatha izitimela ezithutha amalahle, kudingeka ukuthi kulungiswe izinsiza ezithile. Kodwa uma lezi zinsiza zingekho, lokho kuphazamiseka kuholela ekutheni izitimela zingahambi ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuhluka kwezinsiza, njengama-locomotive, akuvamile ukuba kulungiswe kalula, futhi uma kudingeka ukulungisa, kubiza kakhulu. Futhi, kufanele sikhulume ngezenzakalo ezimbi. Uma izitimela zisebenza ezindaweni ezingaphephile, kuba khona izehlakalo ezinzima. Ukungabi nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphepha kudala izingozi ezingabangelwa abantu abangenamakhono. Lokhu kungenza kube nezingozi ezimbi, futhi lokho kuzochitha izinsiza eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbule ukuthi izitimela zidinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Uma umgibeli engakwazi ukuxhumana kahle nezinye izikhungo, lokho kungadala izinkinga. Uhlelo lokuxhumana lungase lungabi nekhono lokuhlinzeka ngemiyalezo ngesikhathi esifanele, okubangela ukuthi izitimela zingahambi ngesikhathi. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhamba. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngezinsizakusebenza, akufanele singakhohlwa ukuba izitimela zidinga abasebenzi abaningi. Ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi abakahle kungaba yinkinga enkulu. Uma umphakathi ungabona izinkinga ezithile, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zisebenze ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi ibanjwa kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukwandiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwempilo, ukuqeqeshwa kwabantu, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbule ukuthi izimoto ezisemgwaqweni zikhona ezithinta izitimela. Ukukhuphuka kokuthuthwa kwemoto kubangela ukunciphisa umthwalo wezitimela. Lokhu kungenza izitimela zingabi namathuba amaningi. Futhi, uma izimoto zithatha indawo enkulu, izitimela zingase zihlupheke ngokwezimali. Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo zokubhekana nalokhu. Ngokubheka ezemvelo, kuyacaca ukuthi izitimela zidinga ukuba zisebenze ngendlela ehlanzekile. Uma izitimela zikhumbula ukuhamba ngaphandle kokwenza umonakalo emvelweni, lokho kuzonikeza isithombe esihle. Kodwa uma izitimela zikhona ezikhipha imikhuba emibi, lokho kungaba yinkinga enkulu. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zemvelo, kubalulekile ukuthi izitimela ziqhubele phambili. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngonyaka, sithola ukuthi izitimela zidinga ukuhlela okuhle. Ukungabi nezinhlelo ezinhle kubangela ukungahambi kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuhlela, kodwa uma lezi zinhlelo zingekho, izitimela zikhona ezithinteka kabi. Ngokuphetha, izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail ziningi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume, sabelane ngezinhlelo, futhi sisebenze ndawonye. Ngithanda ukukukhumbuza ukuthi izitimela zikhona ezibalulekile, futhi umphakathi kumele uqhubeke nokuxhasa lezi zinsiza. Hamba kahle!
Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Kwake kwaba nesikhathi esikhethekile emsebenzini kaMnumzane Dlamini, umphathi omkhulu wezokuthengisa enkampanini edume kakhulu eGoli. Uhlanga lwakhe lwaluhlala lukhanya, futhi ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokuphatha abukhumbuleki. Kodwa, uMnumzane Dlamini wayazi ukuthi imisebenzi emihle ayizwakali kuphela ngezinga lokusebenza, kodwa futhi nangezindlela zokuhlonipha abasebenzi bakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi sokuphela konyaka, uMnumzane Dlamini wanquma ukuthi kufanele kube nesigcawu sokuhlonipha abasebenzi abaphumelele. Wazi kahle ukuthi abasebenzi bencike kakhulu ekwenzeni kahle kwenkampani, futhi lokho bekufanele kudunyiswe. Wabiza umhlangano nabaphathi bakhe ukuze baphakamise iziphakamiso zokuthi bangabazisa kanjani abasebenzi. “Ngiyacabanga ukuthi kufanele sibe nemiklomelo,” kusho uMnumzane Dlamini, ethokozisa ababekhona. “Sizokwenza umcimbi omkhulu, lapho sizokwazi khona ukuhlabela abasebenzi bethu abahamba phambili. Lokhu kuzobakhuthaza futhi kubenze bazizwe bebalulekile.” Abaphathi bamukele le mbono ngenjabulo, futhi baqala ukuhlela umcimbi. Bafuna ukuhlela indawo ethokomele, ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza imiklomelo, nezinsiza zokuhlela umcimbi. Kwakuyisikhathi sokubambisana, futhi bonke babebonisa umoya ophakeme. Njengoba umcimbi usondela, uMnumzane Dlamini wathola ukuthi abasebenzi babezithokozisa, bejabulela ukwazi ukuthi bazobonwa. Kwakukhona abanye abasebenzi ababevele bephumelele izindondo ezinkulu eminyakeni edlule, kodwa abanye babephupha nje kuphela. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokuthi bonke bazizwe beqhakazile. Umcimbi wenzeka ngosuku olukhanyayo, lapho umoya wawuhlabelela izinkanyezi. Abasebenzi baphuma bezimnandi, behlabelela izigubhu zothando nemfudumalo. UZanele, umphathi wezokusebenza, wayehlezi phambili, elungiselela izinkanyezi ezizoboniswa. “Ngiyazi ukuthi sonke sizobonisa uthando lwethu,” kusho yena, ecela wonke umuntu ukuba azizwe ethokozile. Lapho umcimbi uqala, uMnumzane Dlamini wanikeza isingeniso esifushane, echaza ukuthi imiklomelo ibalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bazizwe bebalulekile. “Siyazi ukuthi umsebenzi oncomekayo awuqhamuki kuphela emsebenzini, kodwa nakuwo wonke umuntu. Ngakho, namuhla sizokhonza abaphumelele, abakhombisa ukuzinikela, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokubambisana.” Kwathi lapho izinkanyezi ziqala ukuhamba phambili, abanye abasebenzi baphakanyiswa. UThabo, owawaziwa ngempela ngokuqhuba kahle imikhankaso yokuthengisa, wathola umklomelo omkhulu. Wazizwa ejabule, kodwa akazange akhohlwe abanye. “Ngiyabonga, kodwa lokhu akukaze kube yimi kuphela. Ngiyabonga kubo bonke abanguwe, ngoba sabelana ngempumelelo,” kusho yena, ethokozisa bonke ababe khona. UThandi, owayengumqondisi wezokuthengisa, naye wathola umklomelo. Wabanjwa umoya wokujabula, wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi le mikhankaso ibalulekile, kodwa akukaze kube yimi kuphela. Ngiyabonga kubo bonke abahlanganyela, ngoba sabelana ngempumelelo.” Umcimbi wawuhamba kahle, futhi wonke umuntu waba nesikhathi esihle. Uhlanga lokuhlonipha abanye lwalukhanya, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini wayejabule kakhulu. Wayazi ukuthi imiklomelo ayigcini nje ngokuhlonipha, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya ophilayo emsebenzini. Ngemuva komcimbi, uMnumzane Dlamini wabona izinguquko ezinkulu. Abasebenzi babebonisa umdlandla, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawukhula. Kwakukhona ukuvuselelwa emsebenzini, futhi bonke babefuna ukuba ngcono.
