Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini wayezazi ukuthi imiklomelo ibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono emsebenzini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zenzakalo zaba yisifundo esikhulu. Uhlanga lokuhlonipha abanye lwalukhula, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini waba yisibonelo sokuthi imiklomelo ayigcini nje ngokuhlonipha, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya ophilayo. Abasebenzi babebonisa uthando, futhi lokho kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu enkampanini. Ngakho, umcimbi wokuhlonipha abaphumelele waba yinkanyezi, futhi wakhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi umoya wokubambisana, uthando, nokuhlonipha ungakwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Uhlanga lwemiklomelo lwalukhanya, futhi bonke babebonisa ukuthi umphakathi ophilayo ungabamba izinkanyezi. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esikhulu, futhi uMnumzane Dlamini wayazi ukuthi imiklomelo izohlala ibalulekile emsebenzini.
Lo mthetho uqala ukusebenza ngosuku lokuqala lwezinhlinzeko zokuhlola umthelela wokuhamba kwemvelo, ka-2006 owakhelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 24 seMthetho, ophrintiwe kuMbiko Wezombusazwe No R. 385 ka-2006. Indawo yokumbiwa ithathwa njengendawo echazwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, ka-2002 Umthetho No. Ukuhamba kokumbiwa kusho ukuhamba njengokuchazwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, ka-2002 Umthetho No. Ilungelo lokwenza ukuhamba kokumbiwa lisho ilungelo njengokuchazwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, ka-2002 Umthetho No. Lo Mthetho ubonisa uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezokuhlala Kwamazwe, ka-1998 Umthetho No. Lezi zinhlinzeko zisho Izinhlinzeko Zokuhlola Umthelela Wokuhamba Kwamazwe, ka-2006. Noma iyiphi uhlelo noma umsebenzi odinga imvume noma igunyazo ngaphansi komthetho ophatha ukukhululwa kokukhishwa, ukungcoliswa, odoti, noma ukulahla futhi ongakhulumiwe kuMbiko Wezombusazwe No. R. Ibhodi efanele yezimisebenzi ezibalwe kule ngxenye yesheduli iyinhlangano yemvelo endaweni lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa khona ngaphandle kokuthi kube isicelo sephrojekthi njengoba kuboniswe esigabeni 24C seMthetho, lapho ibhodi iyinhloko noma ilungu likamasipala elithunywe njengokunjalo ngokwesigaba 42 seMthetho njengoba kushintshiwe.
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho okungakwenziwa ukuze sigweme lezi zifo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena ezimpilweni zethu. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuze ugweme lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho-ke, qaphela wena. Le bhukwana ebizwa ngokuthi "Ukuba Active ukuze Ube Nezempilo" iyinhlangano yezi bhukwana. Uma sinakekela thina, sizohlala siphilile emqondweni nasemzimbeni. Ukuze sigcine umzimba wethu nomqondo wethu uphilile, sidinga ukuhlala sikhona. Abaningi bethu baphila impilo esheshayo futhi enezinkinga, okushiya isikhathi esincane sokuphumula. Le ndlela yokuphila isenza sibe nokukhathala nokukhathazeka, okwenza imizimba yethu ibhekane nezinkinga. Kule bhukwana: "Ukuba Active ukuze Ube Nezempilo," sibheka ukuthi ukuzivocavoca nokuba active kungasisiza kanjani ukuba sibe abantu abaphilile. Le ndwangu ikufanele kahle, Fezile, futhi ikwenza ubonakale unamandla. Ngempela, angizizwa nginamandla nhlobo kulezi zinsuku; ngisebenza kanzima. Ngifisa ukuthi ngangingafiki kule mpikiswano namuhla. Kodwa uma uqala ukuzivocavoca, uzoba nomuzwa ohlukile. Ungathola indoda ezokuthanda futhi ozoyiphupha njalo. Yebo, Fezile, unethuba lokungabi nenkinga enkulu yomzimba njengami, njengoba ngisebenza ehhovisi futhi ngihlezi usuku lonke, ngiyazibona ngikhuluphala. Yebo, kunjalo, wonke umuntu angazigcina ephilile futhi ebukeka kahle. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuzivocavoca, ngizizwa ngcono futhi ngizizwa nginamandla. Nina bobabili anifuni ukuthi sifike sehluleka emcimbini. Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalokho okwenzekayo futhi kuyindlela yokuzivocavoca; ngizizwa ngcono kakhulu! Ukuzivocavoca kusiza abantu ukukhulula lezo zinto ezibakhathazayo ngempilo. Ngithathe isinqumo sokuthi impilo yami iyisibopho sami. Ngihamba amakhilomitha amahlanu nsuku zonke, kwesinye isikhathi ngihamba ngokushesha ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi umzimba wami uthola ukuhamba kahle. Ukudansa kuyindlela enhle yokuzivocavoca, futhi ngivame ukuzizwa umzimba wami uthola ukukhanya ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa. Kumele ngiqhubeke ngenza lokhu. Ngake ngiya kudokotela owangihlola wathi ukuzivocavoca kusiza umuntu ukuvimbela izifo eziningi. Yingakho kufanele sonke sizivocavoce ndawonye. Singakhetha ukuzivocavoca ngezindlela ezahlukene ngeviki, njengokuhamba, ukuhamba ngamanzi, ukuhamba, nokudansa. Uma sizivocavoca ndawonye, kuzosisiza sikhuthazane. Ngizokwenza ngokuchaza okwenzeka emzimbeni wakho uma uzivocavoca nokuthi ukuzivocavoca kungakusiza kanjani. Uma uzivocavoca njalo, uzoba nehlukile emzimbeni wakho ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa. Umzimba womuntu uhlelwe ngendlela engalula ukuyiqonda. Uqukethe amathambo, izicubu, ubuchopho, uhlelo lwezitho, uhlelo lokugaya, nokunye okuningi. Ukuze imizimba yethu isebenze kahle, sidinga ukuyinakekela. Ukuzivocavoca kuyindlela eyodwa yokunakekela umzimba. Uma sizivocavoca imizuzu engamashumi amathathu nsuku zonke, ngeke sibe noshukela futhi sizohlala sibukeka futhi sizizwe siphilile. Ake sithole ukuthi kungani lokho. Igazi iletha umoya-mpilo namandla ezicubwini zomzimba. Izicubu zidinga umoya-mpilo namandla ukuze zisebenze kahle. Kukhona izinto ezahlukene ezenzeka emizimbeni yethu uma sizivocavoca. Igazi liphonsa ngokushesha, livumela umoya-mpilo namandla ukufinyelela ezicubwini ngokushesha. Izinga lokusebenza kwezinhliziyo nezitho zokuphefumula liphinde lenyuke, lithumele umoya-mpilo ngokushesha. Umzimba wakho udinga umoya-mpilo ukuze usebenze kahle. Ukuzivocavoca kuqinisa izicubu, kwenza kube lula ukuthi zifeze ezinye izinyathelo. Izicubu ezinamandla zisebenzisa umoya-mpilo kahle. Uma sizivocavoca, ubuchopho bukhulula amahormone akhulula ubuhlungu futhi anciphisa ingcindezi okuthiwa ama-endorphins. Lezi hormone zisebenza njengezinto zemvelo ezithulula ingcindezi. Zikwenza uzizwe unempilo futhi unamandla. Umzimba onempilo uphinde wenze umqondo onempilo! Zivocavoce ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho! Ukuzivocavoca nokuba active kuzokwenza impilo yakho ibe ngcono. Ukukhathala nokukhathazeka kungaholela kalula ekucindezelweni kwengqondo nasekuntulekeni kokuzethemba, ukucindezeleka kwegazi, isifo sikashukela, izifo zezinhliziyo, kanye nokukhuluphala okweqile okuthinta ukusebenza kwakho kwengqondo nokuphila kahle. Ngizizwa ngihle ngoba ngibe ngumuntu active impilo yami yonke. Abantu abadala bavame ukuthola kunzima ukuhamba izindawo ezinde nokuphakamisa izinto ezincane. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi imizimba yabo isibe buthaka (kunzima kubo ukujolisa). Ukuhlala active kungasiza ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abadala. Labo ababe active ngesikhathi sokukhula bavame ukuphila kahle njengoba bephila. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kukhona izinto eziningi abangazenza. Futhi kulabo abashiyile ukuzivocavoca ngesikhathi besencane, akusho ukuthi baphuthelwe ithuba; banganqoba futhi baqale ukuzivocavoca ngokuhamba, ukuphakama ezitebhisini, njll. I-Osteoporosis ("isifo sokuncipha kwamathambo") yenzeka uma amathambo emzimbeni wakho eba buthaka, ephuka kalula, futhi athatha isikhathi eside ukuwaphola. Kwenza kube nzima ukuhamba uma uthinteka yile nkinga. Ukuhlala active nokudla ukudla okunempilo yizindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokukusiza ugweme i-osteoporosis. Ukucindezeleka kwegazi kuyisimo esivamile kakhulu esithinta abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Uma inhliziyo yakho iphilile, iphonsa igazi nge-arteries ngesivinini esifanele nangengcindezi efanele emzimbeni. Uma ama-arteries akho eqinisa noma evimba, kuba nzima ukuphonsa igazi kuwo. Lokhu okubizwa ngokuthi ukucindezeleka kwegazi. Ukuzivocavoca, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, ukuphatha isisindo somzimba wakho, nokuthatha imishanguzo njengoba kudokotela kungakusiza ukuphatha ukucindezeleka kwegazi. Ukezwile isisho esithi: "Umzimba onempilo uhamba ndawonye nomqondo onempilo"? Udinga ukudla ukudla okunempilo, ukuhlala active, ukuxoxa nabantu, nokuzinika isikhathi esanele sokuphumula uma ufuna ukuba nomqondo onempilo? Abantu abambalwa bakhuluma ngempilo yengqondo ngoba kuyinto enzima ukuyiqonda. Akekho ofuna ukubizwa ngokuthi "uyaphazamiseka," "uphazamisekile," noma "uphazamisekile." Ungase ube nezingcindezi uqobo. Ungase ube nezingcindezi uma uzithola usemkhakheni okwenza ube nezingcindezi. Lokhu kungase kube ngenxa yomsebenzi noma izimo zasemakhaya. Ungase ube nezinkinga zokwenza umsebenzi wakho kahle noma mhlawumbe awunayo imali eyanele yokudla izingane zakho.
Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukwazisa ngendaba ebalulekile yokugunyazwa kokwelashwa, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS. Njengoba sonke sazi, impilo yethu ibalulekile, futhi uma kudingeka ukuthi sithole ukwelashwa, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nalokho. Okokuqala, uma uhamba emtholampilo noma udinga ukwelashwa, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi unayo i-GEMS medical aid. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba i-GEMS inezinqubo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze uthole ukwelashwa. Ngakho, uma ungakabi ne-GEMS, kungase kube kuhle ukuthi ucabangele ukufaka isicelo sokuba yilungu. Uma usunayo i-GEMS, okokuqala, kufanele uqonde ukuthi kudingeka ukuthi uthole ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi udinga ukuthola imvume ngaphambi kokuthi uqale noma yisiphi isinyathelo sokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuvikela izindleko ezingalindelekile, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ngokujwayelekile, uma udinga ukwelashwa, kufanele uvakashele udokotela wakho. Udokotela uzokwenza ukuhlola, bese ethumela isicelo sokugunyazwa kokwelashwa. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisicelo sokuhlinzwa, ukwelashwa okuthile, noma imithi ethile. Udocotela uzokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi isicelo sakhe sihamba kahle, futhi sizokwenziwa ngokushesha. Ngemuva kokuthumela isicelo, i-GEMS izobheka imininingwane ethile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi ukwelashwa okuceliwe kuyadingeka yini, futhi ukuthi kudinga ukugunyazwa yini. Uma i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukwelashwa kuyadingeka, izokunikeza imvume. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqhubeke nokwelashwa ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Kodwa-ke, uma i-GEMS ingavumi isicelo sokugunyazwa, ungathola ithuba lokuphikisa le miphumela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungabhalela i-GEMS, ubonise izizathu zokuthi kungani ucabanga ukuthi ukwelashwa kufanele kugunyazwe. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yisinyathelo esinzima, kodwa kubalulekile ukulwela impilo yakho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uqaphele izinsuku zokuphendula. I-GEMS inezinsuku ezithile ezibekwe ukuze iphendule izicelo. Uma ungatholi impendulo, ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi isicelo sakho sikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awuphuthelwa yithuba lokuthola ukwelashwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uma uthola imvume, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uqonda kahle izinqubo ezilandelayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izindleko ezizokhokhwa yi-GEMS, nokuthi yini okufanele uyikhokhe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi awubhekani nezindleko ezingalindelekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma uthola ukwelashwa, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka izinga lokunakekelwa. I-GEMS inezinqubo ezithile zokuhlola izinga lokunakekelwa, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okuhle. Uma unganelisekile, ungathintana ne-GEMS ukuze ubike izinkinga zakho. Ekugcineni, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uqonda izinqubo, futhi ungathintana ne-GEMS uma unemibuzo. Impilo yakho ibalulekile, futhi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyayithola imvume yokwelashwa okufanele. Ngiyabonga ngokulalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizokwenza kube lula kuwe uma udinga ukwelashwa. Khumbula, impilo yakho ibalulekile, futhi kufanele uyilwele. Hamba kahle!

Yisiphi isikhathi esifanele sokuqalisa ukusebenza? Lapho inzuzo ihlale iphansi - kuphi abalimi abangatshala khona ezitshalweni ezisemqoka? Njalo ngosuku sikhubazeka umhlaba ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu, umhlaba ovame ukukhiqiza ukudla. Amanzi - ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela umhlabathi ngendlela egcina amanzi emhlabathini, amanzi atholakala ezulwini, noma uma unethuba, nge- irrigation. Ukudla - udinga umanyolo ukuze ukhule kahle. Impilo Yabantu Abasebenzayo: Umqondo Wami Impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onobumbano. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le mpilo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa futhi inezinzuzo ezithile ezithokozisayo. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo, ngithanda ukwabelana ngombono wami ngalolu hlobo lwezimpilo, ukuze sithole ukuqonda okungcono ngalesi sikhathi esinzima. Ekuqaleni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo bahlala bephila phakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila zihlala zikhona. Ngicabanga ukuthi lezi zinto zenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuba baphile impilo efanele. Abantu abaningi bahlala emakhaya amancane, lapho imithombo yokuphila ingatholakali kalula. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka, njengoba abantu bephoqeleka ukuba basebenze kakhulu ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibonisa amandla okuphila. Ngiyabazi abantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kodwa bonke banomoya ophakeme. Noma ngabe bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kubonakala ekusebenzeni kwabo, lapho bephokophela phambili ukuze bathole amathuba angcono. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukuzikhandla okukhulu, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abasebenzayo bahlala bephila phakathi kwezinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngikhumbula izinsuku engangihamba ngazo emsebenzini, lapho sabelana khona ngezindaba, sikhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi sikhumbula izikhathi ezinzima esihlangabezane nazo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, futhi lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yethu. Ubudlelwano obuhle bukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila, bahlale bejabule, futhi bahlale bephokophela phambili. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ayigcini nje ngokusebenza. Iphinde ibandakanye izinkinga eziningi, ezifana nezinkinga zempilo, izinkinga zokufunda, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala. Abantu abaningi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu akulula, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiyabona ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo bahlala bephokophela phambili. Noma ngabe bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, bahlala bephila impilo enenjongo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi abantu banganqoba izinselelo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukuzikhandla, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ngokuphetha, impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Noma bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, bahlala bephokophela phambili. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu bukhuthaza impilo enempilo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole impilo engcono. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le mpilo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa ngikholelwa ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, baphile impilo enenjongo. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile kithi sonke, njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yabantu abasebenzayo.
Imvume yokwelashwa inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ngenhloso yokuthola ukwelashwa eNingizimu Afrika. Le mvume yokwelashwa iyasebenza isikhathi esingama-6 months ngasikhathi. Qedela ifomu lesicelo i-BI-1738. Thumela ipasipoti yakho okumele ibe valid okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 emva kokuphela kokuvakasha okuhlose. Nikeza ubufakazi bezimali ezanele zokukhokhela izindleko zansuku zonke zabantu bonke abahambisana nomnikazi wemvume ngokuthumela isitatimende sebhange, iphephandaba, noma ama-checks abavakashi. Thumela incwadi evela kudokotela noma endaweni yokwelapha ekhombisa izizathu noma isidingo sokwelashwa, isikhathi esilindelekile sokwelashwa, kanye nemininingwane yecebo lokwelashwa eNingizimu Afrika. Nikeza imininingwane yomuntu noma indawo ephathekayo yokukhokhela izindleko zokwelashwa nezindleko zehospitali zomnikazi wemvume uma kudingeka. Thumela ubufakazi bezimali zokukhokhela ukwelashwa noma umshwalense wakho wezempilo noma umqashi wakho ngeke akhokhe. Isetifiketi sokugomela, uma kudingeka. Isicelo sithatha izinsuku eziyi-30 ukuze processing.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-E-Learning Ezikoleni: Umcimbi Wokuthuthukisa Imfundo Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, izikole eziningi zenzeka umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nokusetshenziswa kwe-e-learning, okuwuhlelo olusha lokufunda oluhloselwe ukuthuthukisa imfundo ezikoleni. Umcimbi, owawubanjelwe eMnyangweni Wezemfundo, wawuhlanganisa othisha, abafundi, abaphathi bezikole, kanye nabazali, bonke bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokufunda ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Uhlelo lwe-e-learning luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda enobuchwepheshe, lapho abafundi bengakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha, izifundo, nezinsiza ezahlukene nge-inthanethi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhambisana nezidingo zempilo yansuku zonke. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evula uMnu. Mthethwa, umphakathi wezokufunda, owakhuluma ngokuqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokufunda okukhululekile nokufinyeleleka kalula. Ngemuva kwalokho, abanye ozakwethu baphinde bakhombise izinhlelo ezahlukene ze-e-learning ezisetshenziswa ezikoleni zabo. Uthisha uNkk. Ndlela, othisha besayensi, wabelane ngempumelelo ye-e-learning esikoleni sakhe. Wakhombisa ukuthi abafundi baye baba nekhono lokufunda ngezifundo ezinzima, njengoba bekwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza eziningi ezitholakalayo ku-inthanethi. Uthisha uNkk. Ndlela waphinde waphawula ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kwe-e-learning kukhuthaze abafundi ukuba babe nezifiso eziphakeme, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphumeleni yabo yokufunda. Ngokuhamba phambili komcimbi, kwaba nezingxoxo eziphusile phakathi kwabazali nabafundi. Abazali baveze ukukhathazeka kwabo ngempela ukuthi ukubandakanywa kwe-e-learning kungaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabafundi, kodwa futhi bakhathazeka ngezinkinga ezihambisana nokufinyelela ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekuxoxeni ngamasu okwenza ukuthi bonke abafundi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo ukuze baphumelele. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokuhlola izinhlelo eziphumelelayo ze-e-learning ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Uhlelo lwe-e-learning olwenziwe eNyakatho Melika lwakhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi kudala ithuba lokufunda elingcono, njengoba abafundi bengakwazi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi e-learning akusikho kuphela ukufunda okwenziwa emakhaya, kodwa futhi kudala ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ekugcineni, umcimbi waphetha ngengxoxo enkulu phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba ezithintekayo. Ababambe iqhaza baphakamisa iziphakamiso ezahlukene zokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwe-e-learning ezikoleni, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokufundisa othisha, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokufunda, nokwenza izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwabazali nabafundi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umbono ophusile wokuthi i-e-learning ingaba yinsiza enkulu ekuthuthukiseni imfundo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Umcimbi wokusetshenziswa kwe-e-learning ezikoleni ungumcimbi obalulekile, owakhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Ngale ndlela, izikole zikhuthazwa ukuba ziqhubeke nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi bathola ithuba lokufunda ngendlela efanele, banethuba lokuphumelela, futhi bakhulise amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele empilweni. Umcimbi unikeze umbono omuhle wokuthi imfundo ingathuthuka kanjani uma ubuchwepheshe buhlanganiswa kahle nezidingo zabafundi.
Ukuqala Ibhizinisi: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Uma siqala ukucabanga ngokuqalwa kwebhizinisi, singaqala ngokubheka izizathu ezithile ezenza abantu bafune ukuvula ibhizinisi labo. Kungakanani lokhu okudingekayo ukuba ubheke ekwakheni ithonya elihle empilweni yomphakathi? Ngabe leli thuba ukusiza abantu abasha, ukulethela umphakathi imisebenzi, noma kungenzeka kube indlela yokuzitholela imali? Lezi zindaba ziningi, futhi zidinga ukucutshungulwa ngokucophelela. Okokuqala, sifuna ukugxila ekutheni kube yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba nebhizinisi. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqala ibhizinisi akukhona kuphela ukuvula isitolo; kungaba ngomkhakha wezobuchwepheshe, ukwakha, noma emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka. Ibhizinisi lethu lingadala amathuba emisebenzi, okuthuthukisa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma ibhizinisi liqhubeka kahle, kungase kuphumelele ukwandisa izinsiza, kubandakanye amabhizinisi amancane, okunika ithuba lokwakha umphakathi ohlanganyelayo. Nokho, akususi emakhanda ethu ukuthi ukukhula kwebhizinisi kudinga izinsizakusebenza eziningi. Ukuze ube nebhizinisi eliphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali, ukukhethwa kahle kwezisebenzi, nokwakhiwa kwamasu aqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaqalayo kumele babe nolwazi oludingekayo, futhi balungiselele ukuhamba nezinselelo ezenzakalayo. Umkhakha wezebhizinisi ubukhulu obukhulu, futhi umsebenzi onzima uhlala uzoba khona. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona labo abathi ukusungula ibhizinisi akukhona okuhle. Kukhona ababhalela izinkampani ezintsha okukhathazayo iqhaza elincane kumphakathi. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lethu liphumelela, kodwa kube nobunzima obuphezulu bokuthi izikhala ezingaphezu komzamo zikasizini. Lokhu kuthehlisa umqondo wokwakha ibhizinisi phakathi kwemiphakathi ethile. Abanye baphinde bagcizelele ukuthi libhizinisi elisha liphinde lithinteke negciwane elivela kumakhompiyutha, elijwayelekile kwedolobha elisemnothweni. Isizathu esikwenza ibhizinisi libe yingozi kakhulu, njengoba ingase idale ukuklwebha nabanye abaphakathi ngentengo, imiphumela engalindelekile, noma uhlu lokuxhumana oluphukile. Ngokubuka konke, ukuqala ibhizinisi akuyona indlela elula. Kodwa uma sizokwenza lokhu, kudingeka sibe nesithakazelo esijulile, siqonde izinjongo zethu, futhi silingane nezinselelo ezihambisanayo. Umphakathi uhlala ufana nempela, futhi ibhizinisi eliqinile kufanele lithuthukise wonke umuntu ofuna ukusizakala. Lesi simo sibiqino, asivumeli ukuthi sithumele izinga elisha, kodwa sikhuthaza abantu ukuthi bazibandakanye ekwakheni umnotho omuhle nekhwalithi. Uma ubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi abantu abaningi bakha ibhizinisi ngalokho abakuthandayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuzama izindlela ezizozisa abantu. Singenza uqobo umkhakha okwazi ukubekezelela, futhi sithuthukise amakhono ahambisanayo, incwadi kaNkulunkulu. Kulungile, kumele siqaphele nezingozi ezihambisanayo, kodwa akukho lutho olungafaneleka. Kuzomele sithathe isikhathi, sithuthukise indaba yethu yokuphatha ibhizinisi, nesikubuke njengokubuyiselwe enhliziyweni. Umphakathi wethu ungase uthuthuke, sithole izinjongo ezizwakalayo. Hamba phambili, sikhulume imininingwane, sithembise umphakathi, sizimele ngonomkhankaso. Mbusa, thina sithamele emnothweni omkhulu, futhi sikholwa ukuthi ibhizinisi kufanele indlela yokuhlalisa izwe. Ngokuhlanganiswa, ukudala ibhizinisi akuhambisana nezinselelo ezithile, kepha kuyindlela ebalulekile yokukhulisa umnotho wethu, uthuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi kanye nokwakha imiphakathi ehlala ihlanga. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukwakha ibhizinisi akuyona into ejwayelekile, kodwa yinyathelo elikhulu lokuphila nabantu. Ngakho, siphokophele ukuvula ibhizinisi, sithuthukise, futhi silandele imithetho nezinsika ezithile zokuphumelela. Lezi yizinkanyezi ezitshisayo ezikhombisa indlela. Futhi uma sikhombisa izimpumelelo, sizokwenza kube nomthelela omuhle, sikhulise ithalente phakathi kwethu, futhi sithumele umqondisi omuhle.
Ukubhukuda: Umsebenzi Wokuzijabulisa Nempilo Ukubhukuda, njengomsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, ungomunye wemisebenzi ethokozisayo kakhulu emhlabeni. Ngaphezu kokuba yindlela enhle yokuzivocavoca, kuyindlela yokugcina impilo kanye nokuthola injabulo emanzini. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo zokubhukuda, izindlela ezahlukene zokubhukuda, kanye nezinto ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe uma uhamba emanzini. Izinzuzo Zokubhukuda Ukubhukuda kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi empilweni. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomzimba. Ukubhukuda kusebenzelana nawo wonke amathambo nemisipha, okwenza kube umthombo omuhle wokuzivocavoca. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni amandla, kuthuthukise ukuhamba, futhi kunciphise ubungozi bezifo ezihlobene nomzimba, njengezinkinga zokukhuluphala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubhukuda kuyindlela ethokozisa yokwehlisa ingcindezi. Ukubhukuda emanzini kukhuthaza umuzwa wokukhululeka, njengoba amanzi enza kube lula ukuhamba. Lokhu kunciphisa ingcindezi engokwengqondo, kukhulisa imizwa yokujabula, futhi kunceda ekuthuthukiseni isimo sengqondo. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezwa ukuthi ukubhukuda kubasiza ukuba baphumule futhi bakhumbule izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izindlela Zokubhukuda Kunezindlela eziningi zokubhukuda, futhi ngayinye inezinzuzo zayo. Isitayela sokuqala esidumile yisigubhu (freestyle), esivame ukusetshenziswa emiqhudelwaneni. Lesi sitayela sithathwa njengokubhukuda okusheshayo, futhi sithuthukisa amandla okukhuphuka. Ababukeli baziwa ngokuthi balungiselela izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. Okwesibili, sinesigubhu se-backstroke, lapho umgibeli ebhukuda ngemuva. Lokhu kuvumela umgibeli ukuba abheke phezulu, okwenza kube lula ukuphefumula. Lesi sitayela sithuthukisa amandla emuva, futhi sithokozisa kakhulu abathandi bokubhukuda. Isigubhu se-breaststroke, esithathwa njengokubhukuda okuphakathi, sithokozisa kakhulu abaqalayo. Lesi sitayela sikhuthaza ukugxila ekuphefumleni nasekugcineni umgibeli eqinile. Okokugcina, sinesigubhu se-butterfly, esiyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Lesi sitayela sidinga amandla amakhulu, futhi sithuthukisa ukuhamba komzimba. Ababukeli abavame ukukhetha lesi sitayela uma befuna ukwakha amandla nokuphumelela emiqhudelwaneni. Izinto Eziyinhloko Zokucabangela Noma ngabe ubhukuda emanzini, kunezinto ezibalulekile okufanele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufunda izisekelo zokubhukuda ngaphambi kokungena emanzini. Ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda izindlela ezahlukene zokubhukuda. Abafundisi bebhukuda bahlala bekhona ukuze banikeze usizo, futhi kubalulekile ukulandela imiyalelo yabo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukwazi izimo zamanzi. Ukuze ubhukude ngokuphepha, kufanele uqonde izimo zamanzi, njengezikhukhula, izigameko ezimbi, noma izindawo ezinzima. Ukubhukuda endaweni ephephile kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokugcina impilo yakho. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa impahla efanele. Ukugqoka izingubo zokubhukuda ezifanele kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba emanzini. Futhi, ukusebenzisa izibuko zokubhukuda kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona, ikakhulukazi uma ubhukuda emanzini anokukhanya okukhulu. Isiphetho Ukubhukuda akuwona nje umsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila enempilo. Izinzuzo zokubhukuda zikhuluma ngokwakha impilo engcono, ukunciphisa ingcindezi, nokuthuthukisa isimo sengqondo. Ngendlela ezahlukene zokubhukuda, wonke umuntu angathola isitayela esihambelana nezidingo zabo. Ngakho-ke, uma ungakaze uzame ukubhukuda, thola isikhathi sokwenza lokho. Hamba emanzini, ujabulele, futhi uthole izinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukubhukuda akuyona nje indlela yokuzivocavoca, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila enempilo, ethokozisayo, futhi egcwele injabulo.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal Isingeniso Izikhukhula zihlala ziba yinkinga enkulu ezindaweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezimo zezulu ezinzima. KwaZulu-Natal, isifunda esiseNingizimu Afrika, izikhukhula ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, emnothweni nasemvelweni. Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula kule ndawo kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezithathwa ukuze kuncishiswe umonakalo. Izizathu zezikhukhula Izikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal zenzeka ngenxa yezimo eziningi. Okokuqala, izikhukhula ezivela emanzini aphakeme, ikakhulukazi emithonjeni yamanzi, zenzeka kakhulu ngesikhathi sezimvula ezinzima. Izimo zezulu ezinjengokwanda kwezinga lokushisa, ukushintsha kwemikhawulo yemvula, kanye nezimo zokuhlala kwabantu zikhuthaza lezi zikhukhula. Okwesibili, ukungcoliswa kwemithombo yamanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha ezingalungile, kuholela ekwandeni kwezikhukhula. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amanzi ahlale engaphumeleli, okwenza kube lula ukuthi izikhukhula zenzeke. Imiphumela yezikhukhula Imiphumela yezikhukhula ibalulekile futhi ibanzi. Ngokomnotho, izikhukhula zibhubhisa izakhiwo, zishiye abantu bengenamakhaya, futhi zinciphisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemithombo yokuphila kwabantu, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukudla, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezisemqoka, okuholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuhamba nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka. Ngokwengqondo, izikhukhula zishiya abantu bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima. Ukulahlekelwa kwemindeni, izimpahla, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala kudala ukucindezeleka, ukwesaba, nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abathintekayo. Izindlela zokuphendula Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokwakha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zikhona ezindaweni eziphephile, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izingozi ezihambisana nezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukufundisa umphakathi ngezingozi, izindlela zokuzivikela, kanye nezindlela zokuphuma ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukudla, nezinsiza zokwelapha kubantu abathintekayo. Ukuze kube nokuphendula okuphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zikamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal kubalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula. Izikhukhula zinezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nomphakathi, umnotho, kanye nezimo zempilo. Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphendula, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwezinsiza, kanye nokufundisa umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukunciphisa umonakalo owenziwa izikhukhula, sithuthukise impilo yabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izindawo zethu ziphephile. Izinsiza Zokufunda 1. Department of Water and Sanitation. (2022). Flood Management in South Africa: A Guide for Local Authorities. 2. South African Weather Service. (2021). Climate Change and Its Impact on Flooding in KwaZulu-Natal. 3. National Disaster Management Centre. (2020). Disaster Management Framework for South Africa. Lezi zinsiza zingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqondwe kahle izimo ezithinta izikhukhula, kanye nezindlela zokuphendula ezithathwa ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wazo.
I-NPI iyisisekelo somphakathi, ebhekwa njengokweseka uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, ngenhloso yokuphatha kwezezimali kwazulu. Ihloselwe ukuba yisikhungo esihamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindinganiso zomkhiqizo eziphelele, ngamasu amasha futhi aqhubekayo "okwenza kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke ngendlela efanele emphakathini." I-National Product Foundation iyinhlangano ye-triangle ezinikele ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhuthazeni izindinganiso zemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika ngokuchaza umoya we-triangle ngokucwaninga, ukusabalalisa ulwazi, ukuqeqesha, ukuvuselela, ukuxhumana, ukuhlola izincwadi, nokuphatha kuyo yonke imisebenzi yomkhiqizo kanye nezinselelo zokwandisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Vakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi ye-NPI, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezinhlelo zayo. I-NPI ithuthukisile izinhlelo ezinhlanu zokubhekana nezinkinga ezibalulekile, amasu, nezinyathelo. Umphathi wehlelo ubheka yonke uhlelo. Umthetho Wokuphromotha Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, Umthetho 2 ka-2000 (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umthetho") uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwesithakazelo somthethosisekelo sokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso nanoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo, nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. IKomidi Lezokuhlaliswa Kwamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika kudingeka, ngokwesigaba 10 somthetho, ukuthi likhiphe umhlahlandlela oqukethe ulwazi olungacelwa nganoma ubani (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umceli") ukuze umceli athole ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso futhi/noma omunye umuntu, lapho ulwazi lolu ludingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo omceli. I-NPI, uma kudingeka, izobuyekeza futhi ikhiphe izichibiyelo kulolu documeti oluchazayo uma noma uma kufanelekile, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli unyaka owodwa. Akukho sichazamazwi salabo i-NPI inawo ulwazi ngabo noma amarekhodi wezincwadi ezitholakalayo mayelana nabo ukuze zisetshenziswe. Ngokwalolu mthetho, umceli kufanele anikezwe ukufinyelela kudokhumenti eqoshiwe yomzimba womphakathi uma umceli ehambisana nazo zonke izidingo zokusebenza zomthetho ezihlobene nokucela ukufinyelela kulowo dokhumenti eqoshiwe, inqobo nje uma le dokhumenti eqoshiwe ingakhululeki nganoma yiziphi zezinkinga ezikhulunywa kulomthetho. Isicelo sokufinyelela kudokhumenti eqoshiwe njengoba kuchaziwe kumthetho kufanele sibe nobudlelwano obubalulekile neFomu A yePolisi -187 edluleka ngomhla kaFebhuwari 15, 2002, ukushicilelwa kwayo kutholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi le-NPI kanye nanoma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala, noma enokukhubazeka okwenza kube nzima ukuqhuba amalungelo akhe njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, isicelo sokufinyelela kudokhumenti eqoshiwe singacelwa ngenkulumo kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma nanoma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Idivayisi Yokuxhumana ye-NPI ibamba indima ebalulekile ekuhloleni izenzo zomkhiqizo emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza, ezentengiselwano, nezomphakathi kanye nezinhlelo ezisekelwe emphakathini, futhi inikeza izeluleko zokuthi lokhu kungasetshenziswa kanjani. Iqembu lokuxhumana le-NPI linikeza ulwazi olunzulu kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zobuchwepheshe ezilungiselelwe ngokwenza imisebenzi eminingi yomkhiqizo ezimakethe zasekhaya nezamazwe ngamazwe minyaka yonke. Uhlelo luthumele izinsizakalo zalo ezindaweni ezine, okungukuthi, iNkantolo Yokuhlola, Izinqubo Zokufunda, Ukuphathwa Kwezimakethe, kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezemisebenzi. Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nalezi zinsizakalo lungatholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma nanoma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Ngokwezinye izikhungo zomphakathi, i-NPI ayinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokufaka izikhalazo. Lapho umceli ekholelwa ukuthi i-NPI ayihambisanga noma yehlulekile ukulandela izibopho zayo ngaphansi komthetho, le ndaba izobhekwa ngababambiqhaza abafanele, uma kuvunyelwene, noma noma iyiphi iphathi ingathintana nanoma iyiphi inkantolo enegunya kulolu daba.
Kunzima ukukholwa ukuthi intengo ye-maize ku-Safex ngoFebhuwari 2007 yayiphansi kuka-R1880 ngentoni uma sicabanga ukuthi yafinyelela ku-R3,460 ngentoni ngoSepthemba 18. Ukukhuphuka kwamanani kwalethe ukukhanya kubakhiqizi be-maize, kodwa iqiniso ukuthi labo abathole inzuzo babebanemali ethile yokugcina umkhiqizo wabo ophume ku-2006/2007, noma labo abangenile ezivumelwaneni zesikhathi eside ne-Safex. Ngaphandle kokuthi, akukho abakhiqizi abangagcina futhi babambe imikhiqizo yabo isikhathi eside ngemuva kokuvuna, ngakho-ke kukhona ingozi yokungatholi intengo enhle. Abakhiqizi bangazibuza ukuthi kuphi ochwepheshe abafanele ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nale ndaba. Kungani abalimi (abakhiqizi) bengatholi imiyalezo eqondile? Lokhu kuyalimaza, kodwa ulwazi olukhona ngesikhathi esithile akusona isici esingakusiza ukwenza isinqumo esiqondile mayelana nokumaketha umkhiqizo wakho. Kukho nezinye izici ezingaba nomthelela, mhlawumbe isimo sezulu singaba yinto enkulu, esingabangela ukukhuphuka kwamanani. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukusho ngokwethembeka ukuthi kuzokwenzekani esikhathini esizayo. Ithebula 1 likhombisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele kusukela ngo-2005, futhi kukhona umbono ongajwayelekile ngamanani e-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 owawuncishiswe ngokusekelwe ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari, konke kuhambisana nezibalo ezivela esikhathini esifushane edlule. Ukuhlola okuhamba phambili kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 kukhombisa inani elingafinyelela ku-623.7 million tons, njengoba bekukholelwa ukuthi kunezindawo eziningi ezintsha ezilinywe. Uma lezi zibalo ziqinile, kuzoba khona ama-ton angu-33.5 million (6.7%) e-maize athengiswa ngo-2006. Emhlabeni jikelele, ukusetshenziswa kwe-maize kungaba cishe ku-620 million tons, okusho ukuthi kuzoba ne-maize eyanele kuzo zonke izindawo ezidingayo. Ithebula 1: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni (million tons). Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezingalindelekile, amazwe ahlukene akhiqiza i-maize anciphise izibalo zawo zokukhiqiza phakathi kuka-2007 kaningi, futhi ekupheleni kukaSepthemba 07, isibalo sokukhiqiza safinyelela ku-601.4 million tons. Lokhu kwaba ukuncipha kwama-ton angu-22.3 million kusukela ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari 2007 - lokhu kwabangela ukukhuphuka okungajwayelekile kwamanani e-maize emhlabeni. Umthombo (lapho sithole khona: International Grain Board, Safex kanye nedatha ye-Grain SA). Intengo ye-maize e-Argentina yayingu-$177/ton ngoFebhuwari 07 yabe isinyuka yaya ku-$355/ton (I-Graph 1). Lokhu kusho ukuthi yanda ngo-$158/ton noma ngo-89%. Lokhu kwenzeka ngaphandle kokukhuphuka kokukhiqizwa okwakudlula ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari. Intengo ethi "free-on-board" ye-USA Hard Red evela eGulf nayo yenza okufanayo ngaphandle kokukhuphuka kokukhiqizwa kwe-maize okungama-1.5 tons eMelika kusukela ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari (Ithebula 1). Ngenxa yesimo sezulu esibi e-Australia, eCanada, nase-European Union, ukukhiqizwa kwehla kakhulu - lokhu kwabangela ukuthi intengo ye-maize emhlabeni yehlise ngo-2007 - futhi lokhu kwacindezela amanani e-maize emhlabeni ukuba akhuphuke. I-Graph 1 ikhombisa intengo ye-Safex (ngenyanga esondelene), ku-$ /ton kulandela intengo yomhlaba ngo-2007. Kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007, intengo ye-Safex ikhulile ngo-$200/ton, uma kuqhathaniswa nokukhuphuka kwentengo ka-$158/ton e-Argentina, nokukhuphuka kwentengo ka-$143/ton ye-USA Hard Red. Ukukhuphuka okukhulu kwamanani e-maize lapha uma kuqhathaniswa nemakethe yomhlaba kwenzeka kakhulu ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhambisa i-maize lapha ngempahla. NgoFebhuwari 2007, kwakhokhwa $43/ton ukuhambisa i-maize evela e-Argentina, kanye no-$48/ton ukuhambisa evela eGulf. Kwakukhona futhi isidingo esikhulu semikhumbi ehambisa i-maize, okwakwenza izindleko zokuhamba zibe kabili. Njengamanje, kwakhokhwa $73/ton ukuhambisa i-maize evela e-Argentina, kanye no-$88/ton ukuhambisa i-maize evela ezikhumulweni zeGulf kuya lapha (I-Graph 2). Ngentengo yokushintshaniswa ka-R6.85/$, lokhu kusho ukuthi ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhambisa kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007 sekuhamba ku-R219/ton. Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni kulindeleke ukuthi kwehle, okwenze amanani e-maize emhlabeni akhuphuke, futhi ngenxa yesidingo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sidinga ukungenisa ingxenye yesithathu ye-maize edliwayo/eyidingekayo, ukukhuphuka kwamanani emhlabeni kuphinde kwabangela ukuthi amanani lapha akhuphuke. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhambisa i-maize ezivela phesheya nakho kuhlanganise ukucindezela amanani endawo. Ukukhuphuka kwamanani e-maize emhlabeni kuphinde kukhombise ukuthi izimo zezulu zinegalelo elikhulu uma sibheka imakethe yokudla evela kwezolimo. Siyazi kahle ukuthi asikwazi ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo noma isimo sezulu sizokwenza ukuthini.
Ungabika ezinye izikhalazo eziphathelene nokuhlolwa kwezimpande noma izingxabano ezihlobene nokwaziswa kwezimpande, kodwa kufanele uqale uxhumane ne-OSTS ukuze ubone ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obudingekayo bukhona yini ukuze uhlobo lokuhlolwa nolwabiwo lwezimpande. Le nsizakalo itholakala kumuntu, inhlangano, isikhungo, inkampani, noma umbulali. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalazo noma ingxabano mayelana nokwaziswa kwezimpande, thumela incwadi kanye nesampula yezimpande bese uchaza kahle lonke ulwazi oluphakathi kwesikhalazo noma ingxabano. Faka imininingwane yokuhlolwa okwenziwe ezinye izikhungo zokuhlola izimpande. Uma isikhalazo sikhombisa ukuba semthethweni, isibonelo, uma ukwaziwa kwezimpande kungahambisani nemigomo yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwez植物, 1976, akukho zindleko. Uma isikhalazo singekho emthethweni futhi singafaneleki, kuzodingeka ukukhokha imali yokuhlola izimpande eyabekwa yiMali Kazwelonke, futhi kuzokwenziwa i-invoyisi. Ukukhokha kungenziwa ngocingo noma ngokudlulisela emabhange, kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenombolo ye-invoyisi ukuze bakwazi ukuhambisa ukukhokha ne-invoyisi ekhishwe. I-OSTS ihlinzeka ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kokuqala kwezampula zezimpande lapho kukhona ingxabano noma izimo zomthetho zingalandelwanga. Ubukhulu bengxabano noma isikhalazo, isibonelo, inani lezampula, uhlobo lwezimbali, kanye nohlobo lokuhlolwa oludingekayo, kuthinta isikhathi esizothatha ukuhlola. Ulwazi mayelana nezindinganiso zokuhlola ngeke lunikezwe. Buza ngqo kule ndawo. Le nsizakalo iyamahala uma isikhalazo singekho emthethweni. Nokho, uma isikhalazo sithathwa njengesingafaneleki, kuzodingeka ukukhokha imali yokuhlola ezimpande efanele, ngokuhambisana nesimo nezimo.
Isikhumbuzo: Izikole Zikahulumeni Ezweni lethu, izikole zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Nokho, lezi zikole zihlala zikhuluma ngempikiswano phakathi kwabantu abaningi. Kukhona abakholelwa ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zidinga ukuxhaswa ngokwengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi lezi zikhungo zidinga ukwenziwa zibe ngcono ukuze zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu lemfundo. Okokuqala, sithola ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubafundi abaningi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izikole zikahulumeni zifinyelela ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane ezivela emindenini engatholi kahle, ziba nethuba lokufunda futhi zibe nekhono lokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zikhuthaza ukulingana, njengoba zikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi wonke, ngaphandle kokubheka izimo zomndeni. Nokho, abanye abantu baphikisa ngokuthi izikole zikahulumeni zihlala zihlupheka ngezinsiza. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izikole eziningi zikahulumeni zihlupheka ngempela, zidinga ukuxhaswa ngokwengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsiza ezifanele, othisha abaqeqeshiwe, nezinhlelo zokufunda ezithuthukile. Uma izikole zingatholi lezi zinsiza, zikhona izingozi zokuthi abafundi bazoqhubeka bephuma ezikoleni ngaphandle kokuthola imfundo efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, kodwa zidinga ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zazo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izikole, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufunda ezisebenzayo, izifundo ezihambisana nezidingo zempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abafundi. Uma izikole zikahulumeni zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinhlelo, kuzoba nzima ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lemfundo. Ngokubheka lokhu, sithola ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zidinga ukuxhaswa ngokwengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwandisa izinsiza, ukuqeqesha othisha, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezithuthukile. Abantu abaningi baphikisa ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zingakha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuze zikhuthaze abafundi ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, nabazali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bathola imfundo efanele. Ekugcineni, izikole zikahulumeni zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni imfundo, kodwa zidinga ukuxhaswa nokuthuthukiswa ukuze zifinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Abantu badinga ukuba neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni lezi zikole, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kubafundi. Umphakathi wonke kufanele ube nesithakazelo ekuthuthukiseni izikole zikahulumeni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izingane zithola ithuba lokufunda nokuphila kahle. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi jikelele, njengoba imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Kungenzeka ukuthi izinhlayiya ezincane eziphilayo zingadala izifo, futhi izinhlayiya ezincane ezilimazayo zitholakala kabanzi emhlabathini, emanzini, ezilwaneni, nasezimpilweni zabantu. Lezi zinhlayiya ezincane zidluliselwa ngezandla, ezindwangu zokuhlanza, nezinsiza zokudla, ikakhulukazi eziphethwe ezikhaleni zokusika, futhi ukuxhumana okuncane kungazidlulisela kokudla, kuholele ezimweni zokudla ezitholakala emathunjini. Ukudla okungaphekiwe, ikakhulukazi inyama, izinkukhu, nezilwane zasemanzini, kanye nemijimba yazo, kungaba nezinhlayiya ezincane ezilimazayo ezingangcolisa ezinye izidlo ngesikhathi sokulungisa nokugcina. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukudla okufana nezitsha zokuphuza nezitsha zokupheka kuphume kahle ukuze kufinyelele ku-700C. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho amanzi enyama nezinkukhu, futhi akufanele kube nombala ompunga. Ngokuyinhloko, sebenzisa i-thermometer. Ukupheka kahle kubulala cishe zonke izinhlayiya ezincane ezilimazayo. Izifundo zocwaningo zikhombisile ukuthi ukupheka ukudla ku-700C kungasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile ukudla. Ukudla okudingayo ukunakwa okukhethekile kufaka phakathi inyama eqoshiwe, inyama efakwe emanzini, izingcezu ezinkulu zenyama, kanye nezinkukhu eziphelele. Izinhlayiya ezincane zingakhula ngokushesha uma ukudla kugcinwa ezingeni lokushisa lendawo. Ngokugcina izinga lokushisa ngaphansi kuka-50C noma ngaphezulu kuka-600C, ukukhula kwezinhlayiya ezincane kuyancipha noma kuyama. Ezinye izinhlayiya ezincane ziyaqhubeka nokukhula ngaphansi kuka-50C. Izinto zokwakha, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqukethe amanzi neqhwa, zingangcoliswa ngama-organisms amancane alimazayo kanye nezinto ezikhemikhali. Izinto ezingenakubangela umonakalo zingakha ezindaweni ezonakele nezibola. Ukunakekela ekukhetheni izinto zokwakha kanye nezindlela ezilula zokuhlola ezifana nokuhlanza nokuhlanza kunganciphisa izinga lesingo.
Imininingwane yomuntu ofuna ukufinyelela kwi-rekhodi kumele ibhalwe ngezansi. Nikeza ikheli kanye/noma inombolo ye-fax eNingizimu Afrika lapho ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe khona. Ubufakazi besikhundla esivela kuso isicelo, uma kunesidingo, kumele kufakwe. Le ngxenye kufanele igcwaliswe kuphela uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Nikeza imininingwane ephelele ye-rekhodi ofuna ukufinyelela kuyo, kuhlanganise nenombolo yokubhekisela uma uyazi, ukuze irekhodi itholakale lapho ikhona. Uma kukhona isikhala esanele, sicela uqhubeke kwelinye iphepha elilandelayo futhi ufake lelo phepha kufomu. Umuntu owenza isicelo kumele assinwe kuyo yonke imiqulu eyengeziwe. Isicelo sokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi, ngaphandle kwe-rekhodi equkethe ulwazi ngawe, sizophathwa kuphela ngemva kokukhokha imali yesicelo. Uzokwaziswa ngemali edingekayo ukukhokhwa njengezimali zesicelo. Imali ekhokhelwayo yokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi incike ezimweni zokufinyelela ezidingekayo kanye nesikhathi esifanele sokucwaninga nokulungiselela irekhodi. Uma ungafaneleki ukuba ne-waiver yezimali, sicela uchaze isizathu. Uma uvimbekile ekufundeni, ukubona, noma ukuzwa irekhodi ezimweni zokufinyelela ezihlinzekwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, khombisa ukungabi namandla kwakho futhi uchaze ngaphansi kwezimo ziphi irekhodi idingeka. Beka uphawu ebhokisini elifanele nge-X. IZAZISO: (a) Ukukhombisa kwakho izimo ezidingekayo zokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi kuncike ezimweni lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. (b) Ukufinyelela ezimweni eziceliwe kungavinjwa kwezinye izimo. Kulokhu, uzokwaziswa uma ukufinyelela kuzovunywa ngaphansi kwezimo ezihlukile. (c) Imali ekhokhwayo yokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi, uma ikhona, izokhombiswa ngokwezimo zokufinyelela eziceliwe. Uma irekhodi liqukethe izithombe ezibonakalayo, lokhu kufaka phakathi izithombe, ama-slide, ukuqoshwa kwevidiyo, izithombe ezenziwe ngekhompyutha, imidwebo, njll. Uma ucela ikhophi noma idokhumenti ye-rekhodi (ngaphezulu), ingabe ufuna ikhophi noma idokhumenti ithunyelwe kuwe? Ingabe kukhona imali yokuthumela? Qaphela ukuthi uma irekhodi ingatholakali ngolimi oluthandayo, ukufinyelela kungahlinzekwa ngolimi lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. Uphi ulimi ofuna ukufinyelela ngalo kwi-rekhodi? Uzokwaziswa ngombhalo ukuthi isicelo sakho sivunyelwe/siwenqabile noma cha. Uma ungathanda ukwaziswa ngenye indlela, sicela uchaze ukuthi kanjani futhi unikeze noma yiziphi imininingwane edingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukuhambisana nesicelo sakho. Ungathanda ukwaziswa kanjani ngesinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho sokufinyelela kulwazi?
NgokweMthetho Wokukhokhela Abasebenzi Abalimala noma Isifo Somsebenzi sika-1993, abaqashi badingeka ukuthi babike zonke izifo noma izifo ezibangela umsebenzi emalini yokukhokhela. Abasebenzi kumele baqedele umbiko wesifo esihlobene nomsebenzi wabo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemva kokuba bazi ngalesi sifo. Umbiko wokuqala wesifo esihlobene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi uyisicelo sokukhokhela isifo esihlobene nomsebenzi, ifomu elibhalela ukusebenza endaweni ethile edale lesi sifo, libika ngesimo sesifo, futhi uma lesi sifo sithuthuke, umbiko wokugcina ngesimo sesifo esihlobene nomsebenzi. Uma lesi sifo sithuthuke, incwadi yokuhlolwa kwezindlebe ingase idingeke, ikakhulukazi uma umqashi ehlangabezana nokulahlekelwa ukuzwa ngenxa yokusebenza endaweni enomsindo omkhulu, okuyi mbiko okufanele ihambisane nencwadi yokuhlolwa kwezindlebe uma kudingeka, umbiko wokusebenza kwemiphunga uma lesi sifo sihlobene nemiphunga, umbiko wesikhumba uma lesi sifo sihlobene nesikhumba, umbiko wezinyembezi, umbiko wesitho somlomo, kanye nemibiko ethile ehlobene. Le nqubo ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-60.
Noma ubani ofuna ukugcina ibhufalo kufanele aqale abhalise umhlaba neMnyango Wezolimo. Thola ifomu lesicelo ku-inthanethi, bese uligcwalisa ngokuliprinta. Lingatholakala nasehhovisi lezemfuyo likamasipala. Buza udokotela wezilwane wakamasipala oseduze ukuze ahlole umhlaba kanye nezingxenye, kanye nokwazisa ngesimo sempilo sebhufalo. Umphakathi wezinsizakalo zezilwane esifundazweni kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinsiza ezifanele zokubheka isimo semfuyo njalo, nokuthi ukuhamba kwezinye ibhufalo emhlabeni nasemaphandleni kungaphathwa kahle nokuthi noma yiziphi izigameko ezingajwayelekile zingaxazululwa ngokushesha. Ubufakazi obugunyaziwe bokugcina kahle, obukhishwe yiziphathimandla zok conserving environmental, kanye nemephu ekhombisa imingcele yomhlaba wonke ofuna ukuwubhalisela. Isikhathi esithathwa ukuze processing isicelo kanye nokwamukelwa kwaso siyahluka ukusuka esifundazweni ukuya esifundazweni. Uma isicelo samukelwa, sithunyelwa kwiMnyango Wezolimo kazwelonke. Abasebenzi emnyangweni kazwelonke banikeza inombolo yokubhaliswa, bangeze ulwazi ku-register ye-bhufalo kazwelonke, futhi baprinta isitifiketi sokubhaliswa esikhishwe kumphakathi womhlaba. Le nqubo ingathatha izinsuku eziyishumi zokusebenza. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Lo mthetho ufaka phakathi umthetho wesakhiwo. Uthuthukisa ulwazi nokuqonda kwezindaba zase-Afrika ngokusebenzisa ososayensi bezokuxhumana abaziwayo ngokuvumelana nabo bonke abalandela lezi zindaba nangokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuqondisa ngezindaba zase-Afrika; kanye nokuhlanganisa, ukuqhuba, nokusabalalisa ulwazi mayelana nezindaba zase-Afrika, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko elifanele nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana nezidingo zabantu bonke, amathuba, nezinselelo ezibhekene nazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ibhodi isungulwa ukuze ibheke, iphathe, futhi iqondise izindaba zeMnyango. Amalungu akufanele adlule kwababili futhi azokhethwa yiBhodi ngokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe; kanti noMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi, ozoba yilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla sabo, akasoze abe namandla okvotelela. Ekusungulweni kweBhodi, kumele kube nokwakhiwa okufanele kobulili, ulimi, nokuhlukahluka kwemiphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ilungu leBhodi elikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi kumele likhethwe ngokuhambisana nezimiso zokucacisa nokwakhiwa. Okungenani elinye lamalungu akhethwe yiBhodi kumele libe nolwazi lokuphatha kwezimali. Bazokwenza noma babe yilungu iminyaka emithathu, ngaphandle uma isikhathi esifushane sithathwa; futhi ilungu eliphelelwe isikhathi singenziwa kabusha. Uma ilungu leBhodi lifa noma lishiya isikhundla sakhona ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esikhethwe, elinye ilungu linganikezwa ukuba lithathe leso sikhundla esisele. Ilungu leBhodi elingakhethwanga ngokuphelele nguMbuso lingakhokhelwa yiBhodi ngemisebenzi abayenzayo njengamalungu, naleyo nkokhelo izonqunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Akukho ilungu leBhodi elingagcini isikhundla kwi-political party noma inhlangano yezepolitiki. Umuntu ongakhokhiwe, ophumelele icala eNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwezono ezenziwe ngaphambi kosuku luka-27 kuMbasa 1994, ezihlobene nezinhloso zezombusazwe futhi ohlawulwe ukujola ngaphandle kokukhetha imali, noma uma bekungumsebenzi wobuqhophololo, uma behlawulwe ukuba bakhokhe imali noma bahlawulwe noma bobabili; noma ngaphandle kokuba yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma abe ne-permit yokuhlala okungapheli eNingizimu Afrika. Umuntu ophuthelwe imihlangano emibili noma ngaphezulu yeBhodi ngokuqhubekayo ngaphandle kokuthola imvume kwiBhodi. Kumele athumele incwadi yokuhoxa kuNgqongqoshe. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zeMnyango, iBhodi ingaba... noma ithole noma yiziphi izimfanelo namandla abona kufanele noma adingekayo. Bangaqasha, banqume amaholo, noma baphumeze abasebenzi beMnyango; futhi benze noma yini eholela ekufezeni izinhloso, futhi kumele bahlola njalo isakhiwo, inhlangano, nezinhlelo zeMnyango. Bangakwazi ukwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi onikezwe nguNgqongqoshe; futhi baqhube uphenyo noma ucwaningo mayelana nezinhloso zeBhodi uma kunikezwe nguNgqongqoshe. Ibhodi ayikwazi ukusungula, ukuthola, noma ukusebenzisa inhlangano noma umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zase-Afrika, kodwa ingaqala noma iphakamise izinhlelo ezibona kufanele ukuze kuqedwe izinhloso zeMnyango: Kuze kube yilapho lezi zinhlelo zenziwa ngokubambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona noma iminyango ekwazi ukwenza lezi zinhlelo. Ukuze kuqedwe izinhloso zeMnyango, iBhodi inganikeza usizo kunoma yisiphi isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika esihlala kwezinye izindawo ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi. Ibhodi kumele ihlangane noma ibambe imihlangano okungenani kathathu ngonyaka, futhi imihlangano izobanjwa ngesikhathi nendawo ezinqunywe nguMongameli ngokwazisa abanye amalungu. UMongameli angabiza umhlangano okhethekile weBhodi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, okumele bube ngesikhathi nendawo ezinqunywe nguMongameli. Inani lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni angakwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano nokwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu eBhodi. Noma yiziphi izinqumo zeBhodi zizokwenziwa ngokusekelwa kwenani elikhulu lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni weBhodi, futhi uma kukhona ukuhamba phambili kwendaba ethile, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote yokugcina ngaphezu kokuvota kwabo njengelungu leBhodi. Ilungu leBhodi lingavota noma lithathe ingxenye ekuphathweni komhlangano weBhodi noma libe khona endaweni lapho umhlangano ubanjwa khona uma linomsebenzi ophathelene nendaba engaphambi noma ekhuluma ngayo iBhodi evimbela ukuba lenze imisebenzi yabo njengelungu leBhodi ngokwethembeka, futhi ngaphandle kokubandlulula nangendlela efanele. UPhakathi; kanye namanye amalungu eBhodi, angadluli kwabahlanu, njengoba kuhlelwe yiBhodi. Ikomidi eliphakanyisiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuqala kumele lenze imisebenzi enikezwe yona yiBhodi. UMongameli weBhodi kumele abe nguMongameli wekomidi eliphakanyisiwe. Ikomidi eliphakanyisiwe kumele lihlangane ngezikhathi nendawo ezinqunywe nguMongameli walelo komidi, futhi inani labantu abakhona abakwazi ukwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu ekomidi eliphakanyisiwe. Ibhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwamakomidi, lapho inganikeza khona amandla noma imisebenzi ethile enikezwe noma enikwe iBhodi ngalo Mthetho. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi kumele libe nezinye amalungu eBhodi nabasebenzi beBhodi, uma bekhona, abona iBhodi ibona kufanele, futhi iBhodi ingase iyeke noma ibuyisele noma yikuphi ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanelekile. Uma ikomidi linezithombe zeBhodi eziningi kunelungu elilodwa, iBhodi kumele ikhethe elinye lalawo malungu ukuba kube nguMongameli wale komidi. Ibhodi ngeke ibhekane nokwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi onikezwe noma yikuphi ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba. Le mfuneko yokunikezwa kwamandla noma imisebenzi kumele ixhunyaniswe ngokubhalwe phansi kumamukeli. Ibhodi ingasungula ithimba labeluleki kunoma yisiphi isimo soxhumano uma ibona kufanele. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele libe nezingane ezingenakuphuma kwabahlanu abaphumelelayo abaneziqu noma ulwazi olukhethekile noma okuhlangenwe nakho emkhakheni wezindaba zase-Afrika okukhuluma ngawo, futhi abangamalungu eBhodi. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele ibeluleke iBhodi nganoma iyiphi indaba ephathelene nezindaba zase-Afrika ezakhayo. Ilungu lethimba labeluleki kumele likhethwe ngaphansi kwezimo, kuhlanganise nezimo zokukhokhela, ukuthola imihlangano, nokuhlinzekwa kosizo, okuzonqunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Ibhodi ingasusa noma iphelelise ubulungu bayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma kukhona izizathu ezanele zokwenza kanjalo. Amalungu ethimba labeluleki ngeke athole ukwesekwa kwezimali kwiBhodi ngenkathi ebamba lezi zikhundla. Ibhodi kumele, ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe, ikhethe uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi. Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezikhathi Zamaholide Ngaphakathi kwempilo yomphakathi, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibe yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwansuku zonke, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi zamaholide. Izikhathi zamaholide, ezihlanganisa imikhosi yamasiko, izinsuku zokuphumula, kanye nezinsuku ezilandelayo, zikhombisa ukuhamba kwabantu, izivakashi, nemicimbi eminingi ethokozisayo. Lokhu kukhuphula izinga labantu ebantwini, ngakho, nokuthi inhloso yobuciko bempilo noma yokuphumula ingase iphazamiseke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsizakalo eziqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kwezakhamuzi. Ngokubheka emuva emlandweni, sithola ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zathuthuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, zanda ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuhuma kwezinsuku zokuqala zezwe, lapho abantu bejabulela imisebenzi yezemidlalo, imicimbi yamasiko, nezinye izinsuku eziyinqaba, izimo eziphuthumayo zathi, zenze isidingo somphakathi. Ngokusho kwezifundo zomlando, ngesikhathi sabantu basendulo, izimo eziphuthumayo zazihileleka kakhulu emnothweni wezokwelapha, okwakuhlanganisa abelaphi bendabuko, abamaqhugwane namaqonga okwelapha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sasithola lokho okwakumaphakathi kwezinsuku, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zavela ziqinisa imithombo yazo. Ngemva kokuthi umhlaba uphume kwizinhlobo ezihlukahlukene, izikhungo ezinkulu zezokwelapha zafika ziqhuba imisebenzi eminingi, ziqinisekisa nokuthi akukho muntu ophuthelwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, sahlangabezana nezici ezithokozisayo zokusebenza kwezimo eziphuthumayo, okuyizinto ezazingaphansi kumagugu obuhlanga, ezakhiwe ngenhloso yokuvikela izakhamuzi ngesikhathi seziqephu ezinzima. Ngemva kweminyaka ethile, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zathatha ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu. Ukuqala kwezimoto ezisheshayo kwakuwumlando omusha, futhi kwaba umphumela omuhle ezikhathini zamaholide, lapho izigameko ezinzima zazitholakala njalo. Ukusebenza kwamabhasi, izimoto zokuqapha, nokuqwashisa komphakathi, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo. Umphakathi uhlanganisa izifundo eziyisisekelo nezesayensi ukuze kwendawo kukhuthazwe ukudlondlobala kwezimoto eziphuthumayo ezivela kuzo zonke izindawo zokuhlala. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uma izinhlelo ezingenamkhawulo zingakwenziwa, izimo eziphuthumayo zizona ezithinta kakhulu umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokuphela kwezinsuku ezikhethekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka ukufunda ukusekela izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo, ngenkathi uhlanganisa amakhono ahlukene. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kwaba wukwakhiwa komkhakha wezokuphepha, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi lokuphuthumayo, noma ukudala imikhankaso yokuvikana, lonke lezi zinyathelo zenziwa ngenjongo yokucacisa nokwandisa ukuqwashisa komphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, amakhono okusebenza yizinto ezingagwemeki njengoba abantu bezama ukukhulisa izinsizakalo ukuze zihlale zikhona ngezikhathi ezinzima. Kubuhlungu ukuthi, ngaphakathi kwezikhathi zamaholide, izigameko ezinzima zenzeka ngendlela engalindelekile. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abaphathi bezimo eziphuthumayo bahlale belungile, begcizelela umqondo wokuthi uphephile, ubalulekile futhi ungasiza. Ukuhlinzekwa kwempilo, isikhumbuzo nemininingwane yokuphuthuma, kwenza kabusha ubuhlobo phakathi kwezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo nemiphakathi, njengoba kudinga ukuqapha okungaqondakali. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imizamo yokusebenza kwezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ihlolwe ukuze kubhekwane nezigameko ezilindelekile, iqukethe abathandekayo abavela kwikhanda labantu. Lokhu kuhlanzwa ekwakheni indlela yesikhathi esizayo, lapho umuntu ngamunye eqonda indima yakhe emphakathini, futhi abaqondisi bemaphiko aphuthumayo benza ngcono ngokuphelele izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kube nezinsuku ezinzima ezide, lapho imikhankaso yokuvikela ikhula khona, umphakathi uqhubeka ufunda ngokubaluleka kokubambisana. Ngamunye unebhodi lokusebenza futhi ukhululekile ukufaka imiphumela ezinhle, uvumelanisa imizamo eminingi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, njengoba ubuchwepheshe bwezokuphepha buhamba phambili. Kwakuvuselela umoya wokubambisana, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zakhula zaba yinxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ngalesi sikhathi, sithi izinsizakalo zikhona, zinesibindi, futhi zihlala zikhona ngezikhathi ezinzima. Lokhu kukhuthaza umoya ophilayo nomthwalo wokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke uthuthuka, unakekela ubuhlobo bakhe nokwazi ukuthi ubani ungavula izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo. Ekugcineni, ngalesi sikhathi samaholide, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zisebenza njengosizo, ukuqhubeka komphakathi, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kubandakanya kubalulekile emphakathini, nomoya obumbene kube umgomo ohehayo wokuhlonipha wonke umuntu. Uhlelo lwezimo eziphuthumayo luphumelela kakhulu, futhi umoya wokubambisana ulindelekile kuwo wonke umuntu. Uthando nokukhathalela uhambela phambili, ukucacisa izifundo esizifunayo ukuze wonke umuntu abenakekelwe lapho kudingeka khona.
Uhlobo lokudla, kanye nohlobo lokuhlanganiswa ndawonye, kufanele kubhekwane uma ufuna ukwandisa i-calcium ne-phosphorus ukuze ufinyelele isilinganiso esifanele emalini ephelele. Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sempilo yengane. Lokhu kuqala ngemva kokubeletha, lapho umama nomntwana behlangana emhlabeni omusha. Izibhedlela zenza umsebenzi obalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi lezi zingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele ukuze zikhule zibe nekhono lokuphila. Ngemva kokubeletha, umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu, okuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo efanele, kanye nokunakekelwa komzimba. Abahlengikazi nabodokotela bahlola umntwana ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi uphila kahle futhi uthola ukudla okufanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze umntwana akwazi ukukhula kahle, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yakhe yesikhathi esizayo. Izibhedlela zinezinqubo ezithile ezilandelwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane ezisanda kuzalwa zithola ukunakekelwa okuhle. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo yokudla efanele, okukhulisa amandla omzimba, kanye nezithako ezidingekayo ukuze umntwana akwazi ukukhula. Abodokotela bahlola izinga lokukhula komntwana, ubukhulu, isisindo, kanye nezinga lokuthola ukudla, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi uthola konke okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akugcini nje ngokunakekela umzimba, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngothando nokunakekelwa kwengqondo. Umama nomntwana badinga isikhathi sokuhlangana ukuze umama akwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nomntwana wakhe, okwenza umntwana azizwe ephephile futhi ethokozile. Izibhedlela zikhuthaza umama ukuba abe seduze nomntwana ukuze baxhumane kahle. Futhi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi umama uthola usizo oludingekayo ukuze akwazi ukunakekela umntwana, okuhlanganisa ukufundiswa ngezindlela zokunakekela, imfundo yokuphila, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izinkinga ezingase zivele. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje emaphakathini ezibhedlela, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, imindeni, kanye nomphakathi. Umphakathi unendima ebalulekile ekwakheni indawo ephephile nekhululekile yokukhula kwezingane. Ukuhlinzeka ngothando, ukweseka, nokunakekela umntwana kudinga ukuba wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze umntwana akhule kahle. Ekugcineni, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umntwana uthola konke okudingekayo ukuze akhule abe nempilo enhle. Ukuze umntwana akhule kahle, kube nekhono lokuphila, futhi abe nempilo engcono esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, imindeni, kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umntwana uthola uthando, ukwesekwa, nokunakekelwa okudingekayo ukuze akhule abe nempilo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yakhe yesikhathi esizayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza ekunakekeleni lezi zingane, ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
uChristopher, ophakathi kwekhasi langaphandle, wazalwa enenhliziyo nepalate ehlukanisiwe. Ipalate yakhe yavuselelwa ngesikhathi enezinyanga ezinhlanu, futhi uphumelele kahle kulokho. Ihlombe lakhe lizovuselelwa cishe eminyakeni eyodwa. Izingane ezazalwa nepalate ehlukanisiwe ngokuvamile ziba nezinkinga lapho zifaka emathunjini ngoba umlomo awuhlukanisiwe nezindebe. Ngakho-ke, ingane ayikwazi ukusutha kahle, okuholela ezinkingeni zokufaka emathunjini kusuka emathunjini noma ebhodleni. Ukungenelela kanye nohlobo lwephutha, oluhlukahluka phakathi kwezingane, kuyizinkomba zokuthi ingane ingadliwa kanjani. Uma ingane inepalate ehlukanisiwe kuphela, ngokuvamile akukhona ukuhamba okukhulu kokufaka emathunjini. Ukuba khona kwehlombe ehlukanisiwe kubalulekile enhlanganisweni yokusutha. Inqubo yokufaka emathunjini ihilela ubisi obukhishwe emathunjini (kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusebhodleni noma emathunjini), inhliziyo edala amakhasi obisi (amakhasi amancane ajikelezayo), kanye nokunyakaza kwalezi zikhasi kusuka phambili komlomo kuya emuva, lapho zingadliwa khona. Ngokomlando, ingane kufanele ikwazi ukuphefumula ngenhliziyo ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini. Lapho inhliziyo ibekwe emlonyeni, izindebe ziyivala, futhi ulwimi luphakanyiswa ukuze luthathe inhliziyo ngokumelene nepalate eqinile. Ulwimi luphinde luphume, kudalwa isikhala esikhulu phakathi kwezindebe, futhi ulwimi/ipalate ivala umoya ukuze ungene esikhathini. Ngale ndlela, kudalwa umoya, futhi ubisi bukhishwa emlonyeni. Umoya uvimbela inhliziyo ukuba ingaphumi emlonyeni futhi uphinde usize ingane igcine ukubamba inhliziyo. Izindebe, ulwimi, izindebe, nezinsini zithola ubisi emathunjini. Inqubo yokufaka emathunjini ifana kungakhathaliseki ukuthi indlela yokudla (emathunjini noma ebhodleni). Nokho, isenzo esihilelekile ekutholeni ubisi emathunjini sihluke kulokho kokuthola ubisi ebhodleni. Inhliziyo yebhodlela ayisebenzisi izindebe, imisipha yobuso, ulwimi, izinsini, nezindebe zengane ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, ukuhamba kobisi kusuka ebhodleni kuyashesha kunokukhishwa kusuka emathunjini; kodwa, lokhu kuthonywa yizinto eziningi zomzimba, njengehlobo lebhodlela nenhliziyo kanye nosayizi wenhliziyo. Ukuhamba kobisi ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini kusuka emathunjini kulawulwa amandla omlomo okukhulisa ubisi, kuyilapho ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzekwa kobisi kukamama kukhula njengoba ingane isutha kakhulu. Ubisi lwamathunjini luwumzimba olungasoze lwakha ukuphazamiseka emzimbeni njengokudla kwezinye izingane. I-oral mucosa yengane enenhliziyo ehlukanisiwe ivulekile, futhi ubisi lwamathunjini ngeke lube yiphazamiseko kuyo. Ukufaka emathunjini kubonakala kungakha izinga elifanayo lok pressure emathunjini njengokudla ebhodleni, njengoba izingane ezinepalate ehlukanisiwe zisesimweni esikhulu sokuba nezinhlungu zomlomo. Ukufaka emathunjini kudala isimo esihle emathunjini, okunciphisa amathuba okuthola izifo zomlomo. Ubisi lwamathunjini lunamandla okuvikela kuma-bacteria. Luhlanganisa i-lactoferrin kanye ne-immunoglobulins ezisiza ukuvimbela izifo. Izingane ezinepalate ehlukanisiwe ezifakwayo ziba nezimo ezimbalwa ezibikiwe zokuthola izifo. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingane ifakwe emathunjini noma ebhodleni, kufanele inikezwe ukudla okunempilo okunene. Ukusutha kusiza njengoba kukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemisipha edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhuluma okujwayelekile (ukuthuthukiswa kwezwi). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindlela zokudla ingane encane zibalulekile kakhulu. Ingane enempilo ithatha cishe imizuzu engama-20-30 ukuze ifake emathunjini ngendlela efanele, okuvumela ukukhula nokudla okufanele. Izingane ezinepalate ehlukanisiwe ngokuvamile ziba nezinkinga zokufaka emathunjini ngenxa yokusutha okungasebenzi kahle kanye nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho bezama ukuhlanganisa inhliziyo. Izingane ezinehlombe ehlukanisiwe kuphela ngokuvamile azinazo izinkinga zokufaka emathunjini. Nokho, i-palate ehlukanisiwe iphazamisa ukwakheka kwe-seal evikela inhliziyo. Lokhu kubi kakhulu uma ingane isebenzisa ingxenye yangemuva yolwimi kanye nengxenye yezinsini (ingxenye ephezulu yezinsini ezibamba amazinyo) ukuze kwakhe i-seal ezungeze inhliziyo. Ukungabi khona kwaleyo seal kungaholela ekutheni ubisi luphume ku-cleft. Ukubamba ohlangothini lwehlombe lezingane ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini kusiza ukuvimbela ubisi ekuphumeni. Nokho, ingane enepalate ehlukanisiwe ayikwazi ukwenza i-seal emuva komlomo ngoba umlomo nezindebe azihlukanisiwe. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba i-seal edingekayo yokuphuma ayikwazi ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sokusutha. Ukuze kudaleke i-seal emuva, umoya kufanele wakhe emlonyeni ukuze kudaleke umoya. Kubantwana abane-palate ehlukanisiwe, ukuzama ukudala umoya kufana nokuzama ukuvuselela ibhaluni eliphukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngaphandle kokusutha, ingane ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ubisi emathunjini. Nakuba kungaphumeleli ukudala umoya odingekayo, uma inhliziyo ibekwe emlonyeni wengane, ukusutha ngokudonsa emuva kuzokwenza ingane iphakamise ulwimi lwayo ukuze ilungise inhliziyo ngokumelene nepalate ukuze ithole ubisi. Ukungabi khona kwepalate eqinile kusho ukuthi inhliziyo izopushwa ku-cleft. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezimbili. Okokuqala, inhliziyo ayicindezelwa ngokuphelele ngokumelene nepalate, uma ikhona, futhi ulwimi luphuma, futhi okwesibili, uma inhliziyo ikwi-cleft, uma ubisi kudonswa, kuzodliwa ngqo emlonyeni kunokudlula emlonyeni nasezindebeni. Ukuhamba kobisi emlonyeni kuholela ekutheni ubisi obunganele budliwe, ngakho-ke inqubo yokufaka emathunjini ingathatha isikhathi eside. Ukusutha kungaba yinkinga engane enenhliziyo ehlukanisiwe, engase ibe nokukhathala ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini futhi ingase ingadli yonke ubisi bayo. Uma ingane ingadli ubisi obuningi ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini, ngeke ikhulise isisindo esanele. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma ingane ithatha isikhathi eside ukufaka emathunjini, ibhujiswa amakhilojoule ngesikhathi sokusutha kunokuthola amakhilojoule okufanele ithole. Ngemuva kokufaka emathunjini, kuvamile ukuthi ingane iphumule. Ngesikhathi sokuphumula, ukudliwa kokudla kwengane ngokuvamile kwehla, okuholela ekukhuleni kwesisindo. Ngakho-ke, uma ingane enenhliziyo ehlukanisiwe ivuka kaningi ngoba kuthatha isikhathi eside ukufaka emathunjini, lokhu kungaba enye yezizathu ezivimbela ingane ekukhuleni isisindo ngendlela efanele. Imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa isiza ekukhululeni umhlaba. Umphakathi wezindlela noma umphathi osethwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezindlela WaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996) njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 soMthetho Wesevisi Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1995 (Umthetho No. 68 ka-1995) ungumlawuli wezokuthula njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 34 soMthetho Wenkohlakalo, 1977 (Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977). "UMkhandlu" ubonisa iMuniBuhlebizwe noma abalandeli bayo besikhwama, futhi uhlanganisa umkhandlu waleyo muni noma iKomidi Eliphezulu noma noma iyiphi enye inhlangano esunguliwe ngumlomo nomuntu onikezwe amandla emisebenzi yeKomidi Eliphezulu mayelana nalezi ziqondiso zomkhandlu. Umuntu ungumnikazi walezi zindawo ezibhalwe egameni labo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwezinkontileka, 1937 (Umthetho No. 47 ka-1937) futhi umuntu obhaliswe egameni labo ungumqondisi wesitifiketi salo mhlaba ngaphansi koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwamathikithi, 1986 (Umthetho No. 95 ka-1986) futhi futhi uhlanganisa umnikazi (njengoba kuchazwe kule mthetho), abaphathi bezindawo, kanye nabathuthukisi balo mhlaba. Uma umnikazi ochazwe lapha engasekho eRiphabhulikhi noma engaziwa, igama "umnikazi" lihlanganisa ummeleli walowo mnikazi noma noma iyiphi "iqembu" njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwamathikithi, 1986 (Umthetho No. 95 ka-1986). "Izindawo" zihlanganisa noma iyiphi indawo yomphakathi kanye nomhlaba womnikazi, zonke izakhiwo, amagumbi, izindlu zokuhlala, izikhala, izindlu zokhuni noma ezinye izakhiwo kanye nezindawo noma umhlaba oxhumene nazo futhi kuzohlanganisa noma iyiphi "ingxenye" njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwamathikithi, 1986 (Umthetho No. 95 ka-1986). "Imoto" ibonisa noma iyiphi indlela yokuhamba engakwazi ukuthwala umuntu oyedwa noma abaningi, ngaphandle kokuhamba ngekhanda noma ikhithi efana naleyo esetshenziselwa ukuhamba umuntu onokukhubazeka. noma ukuhlekisa omunye umuntu ukuba enze isono esinjalo. udakiwe noma ngaphansi komthelela wewayini ngendlela yokuthi ngokombono weMlawuli Othunyelwe lowo muntu angase aphelelwe yisithukuthuku noma kuphi lapho lezi ziqondiso zomkhandlu zisebenza khona. udakiwe noma usebenzisa izidakamizwa njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokusebenzisa Izidakamizwa Nokuhweba Ngazo, 1992 (Umthetho No. 140 ka-1992) wenza noma iyiphi into yokuhlukumeza noma ukuziphatha okungamukeleki noma aziphatha ngendlela engafanele. Umuntu wenza isono uma esendleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi futhi ezwakala ngomunye umuntu esebenzisa ulimi oluphikisana noma amagama angcolile noma eculayo ingoma ethile engcolile noma equkethe imibhalo engcolile. Umuntu wenza isono uma esendleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi ephatha ngendlela engafanele ngenhloso yokuthengisa umzimba wakhe noma ukuhlekisa omunye umuntu ukuba enze kanjalo. ngaphandle kokuthi unikezwe amandla noma uvumelekile ngumlomo ukwenza kanjalo noma enze kanjalo ngokuvuma okubhaliwe kweMlawuli Othunyelwe futhi ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe ngabo. ukususa emathangeni anikezwe ukuhamba kwemfucumfucu noma noma iyiphi enye ibhagi yokuphuma kwemfucumfucu nokwenza kube khona ukususwa kwalokho. Umuntu ophikisa noma uhlekisa omunye umuntu ukuba enze noma iyiphi imisebenzi echazwe esigabeni (1) uzotholakala enecala. Noma iyiphi impahla eyashiywa ngumuntu noma evunyelwe ukuba yehliswe izothathwa njengokuthi iphume kulowo muntu ngokuhambisana nesigaba (1)(a). Noma iyiphi impahla noma into etholakale endleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi evusa ukungabaza kokuthi isono senziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba (1)(a) futhi inegama lomuntu noma inezinkomba eziqinile zokuthi iyakhe noma iphethwe ngabo ngaphansi kwesigaba (1)(a) izothathwa njengokuthi iphume kuze kube kubeqinisekiswa okuphambene. Umuntu ophosa imfucumfucu noma ephuma kwemfucumfucu nganoma iyiphi indlela endleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi uzothathwa njengokuthi uphosa imfucumfucu ngokuhambisana nesigaba (1)(a). Umuntu obonwa nguMlawuli Othunyelwe ephula izinhlinzeko zesigaba (1)(a) noma (b) uzothunyelwa ukuba asuse le mfucumfucu, le mpahla noma le nto noma ukuyibeka emathangeni anikezwe uMkhandlu futhi uma engakwenzi lokho uzoboshwa. Abahlali bezindawo ezichazwe esigabeni (3) noma izindawo lapho noma iyiphi ibhizinisi, umsebenzi noma ukuhweba kwenziwa kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi imisebenzi eyenziwa lapho ingaba ibhizinisi noma lezi zindawo zivuliwe ukuze zibhiziniswe noma zibe nebhizinisi ngesikhathi sokusebenza, kungakhathalekile noma yini ethintana nakho, bagcine indlela eduze kwendlela noma indlela exhumene nalezi zindawo, kuhlanganise nezindawo zokulima ngaphandle kwemfucumfucu futhi bagcine lokhu kukhanya futhi kulungile okusho ukususa yonke imfucumfucu lapho. Umhlali okukhulunywa ngaye esigabeni (1) kufanele aqinisekise ukususwa kwemfucumfucu yonke ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba ukuze ibekwe emathangeni anikezwe uMkhandlu noma ngomyalo obhaliwe weMlawuli Othunyelwe, iphume ngendlela evunyelwe ngabo ukuze imfucumfucu yonke isuswe ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba ibekwe emathangeni anikezwe uMkhandlu noma ngovuma okubhaliwe kweMlawuli Othunyelwe, iphume ngendlela evunyelwe ngabo. Ngokwalesi sigaba igama "ibhizinisi" linencazelo enikezwe nguMthetho Wokuphepha Nokuphila, 1993 kanye nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngaphansi kwawo. ukushiya noma yini engabhekiwe, kufanele kube lowo obeke khona bese kuba yisithiyo kubantu noma ezimotweni njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezindlela WaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996) noma kukhinyabeza uphawu lwendlela njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezindlela WaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996).
