Ukutholakala kolwazi eState kuyisihluthulelo sokwenza ukuthi umphakathi wenze izinqumo ezicacile, okuholela kuhulumeni ophendulayo futhi ojabulisayo. IPhakathi leMisebenzi, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000 (Umthetho 2 ka-2000) ("umthetho"), kudalwe le bhukwana echazayo ukusiza amalungu omphakathi athintekayo ukufinyelela ulwazi oluvela kwiPhakathi leMisebenzi olungase lube usizo. IPhakathi leMisebenzi iholwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi oqokwe nguMongameli ngokuhambisana nesigaba 912 seMthethosisekelo saseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 Umthetho -108 ka-1996. Ngokuvamile, uMongameli uqoka ngokuhambisana nesigaba 12 seMthetho Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, 1994 kanye neMthethosisekelo. UMsunguli Jikelele unabasebenzi abane abaxhasi abaphatha uMthetho Wezabasebenzi kanye nohlelo lweMakethe Yezabasebenzi, Ukuhlinzekwa Kwezinsizakalo, Izinsizakalo Zokuhlanganisa, kanye Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Nokuqashwa ngokulandelana. Ngokuvamile, ungumHead weHhovisi Lezokwazi elisunguliwe. Imininingwane esekela lo Mphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi itholakala esigabeni C ngezansi. Futhi isakhiwo sikazwelonke sokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo. UMsunguli Jikelele uqokwe njengomphathi wehhovisi lolwazi, njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 1(a)(ii) somthetho. Abaphathi Abasiza uMsunguli Jikelele bangabasebenzi abaxhasi bomphathi wehhovisi lolwazi olusunguliwe, njengoba kukhombisiwe esigabeni 17 somthetho. Abasebenzi abaphezulu basungulwa ukuze babe abasebenzi abaxhasi bomphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi njengoba kukhombisiwe esigabeni 17 somthetho. Futhi iMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kazwelonke kanye Nezokusebenza, 1994 (Umthetho 35 ka-1994). Ukugxila kumalungelo emthethweni ukuze kube nokuphathwa kahle emsebenzini njengoba kutholakala esigabeni 23 seMthethosisekelo, nemithetho elawula amazinga amancane emsebenzini, ukuvimbela nokuxazulula izingxabano. Kusungulwa isakhiwo sokutshalwa kwezimali ezindaweni zikazwelonke kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa nokuqinisa amakhono abasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika. Iphatha zonke izinguquko ezibalulekile ezenzeka emnothweni nasemthethweni wezokuhlalisana ngaphambi kokutshalwa kwezimali noma ukwethulwa kwiPhalamende; futhi ikhuthaza futhi iphakamisa ukusungulwa kwesakhiwo sezinqubomgomo esihlanganisiwe ezindabeni zokuhlalisana komphakathi nasekonomini. IKomidi Lezokuhlukunyezwa Kwamalungelo Okwaziwa Kwamalungelo Abantu laseNingizimu Afrika kudingeka ukuthi linikeze umhlahlandlela ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika ukusiza bonke abantu abafuna ukusebenzisa amalungelo abo okufinyelela kolwazi, labo abangase badinge lokho ekusebenziseni amalungelo abo. Noma ubani ofuna ukufinyelela ulwazi olutholakala kwiPhakathi angaxhumana noMphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi noma noMphathi Osenkingeni weHhovisi Lezokwazi. Ulwazi ngababhalisile. Imibiko yokuhlola izingozi ezindaweni zokusebenza. Futhi uhlelo lokuxhaswa oluvela kwiNational Skills Fund. Ulwazi ngohlelo lweNational Skills Development Strategy. Futhi nezivumelwano zikazwelonke ezibanjwe yiNingizimu Afrika nezinye izizwe kanye/noma izinhlangano. Futhi ama-brochure, ama-pamphlet, kanye namabhukwana akhishwe yiPhakathi. Iziqinisekiso zebhajethi, izindleko, kanye nezicabangela zePhakathi. Ukufinyelela, ukuthenga; kanye nezenzo zemakethe yezabasebenzi. Imibiko ngamaMakethe Ezemisebenzi. Lezi zinsizakalo zitholakala kuzo zonke Ofisi ZePhakathi ezikazwelonke, ezikhona kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye. Futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwamazinga amancane emsebenzini, impilo, nemithetho yokuphepha. Lezi zinsizakalo zinikezwa ehhovisi elikhulu lePhakathi ePitoli nasezikhungweni zikazwelonke. Futhi ukuqapha ukusebenza kweMnyango Wezemfundo Nokuthuthukiswa. Izinkantolo zabasebenzi zinikeza izinsizakalo zokukhishwa kwezinqumo. Ulwazi ngama-ofisi e-CCMA nezinkantolo zabasebenzi lutholakala kunoma iyiphi yeOfisi zePhakathi ezikazwelonke noma ehhovisi elikhulu. Ulwazi oluvela kwiPhakathi lungatholwa ngokwenza isicelo ngendlela echazwe, etholakala kuzo zonke Ofisi zePhakathi ezikazwelonke, futhi kufanele kuthunyelwe kumphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi noma kumphathi osenkingeni weHhovisi Lezokwazi kule ndawo ekhombisiwe esigabeni C ngenhla. Umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele yonke imininingwane efomini ukuze umphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi akwazi ukubona ukuthi yikuphi ulwazi oluceliwe. Iziqinisekiso ezihlobene nempilo yomfaki-sicelo nokuthi umfaki-sicelo uyasizwa noma ucela usizo komunye umuntu. Futhi ukucacisa umbono ngomyalo ophakanyisiwe, ukulethela ukubhaliswa kwezinyunyana nezinhlelo zabaqashi. Ngokuhambisana nemininingwane yokuxhumana enikeziwe, thumela ukukhala kuMvikeli Womphakathi. Noma ubani ongachazwanga kahle nganoma yisiphi isiqubulo lapha angaxhumana nomphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi noma osiza wakhe kunoma iyiphi yeOfisi zePhakathi ezikazwelonke ukuze athole usizo.
ISIHLOKO: iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand – Ukuvuselela Ezemfundo Nokuqonda Komphakathi iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, eyaziwa kakhulu ngenxa yokukhula kwayo okuhle emkhakheni wezokufunda eNingizimu Afrika, ibonakala njengendawo efanele abafundi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Le nyuvesi, esungulwe ngonyaka ka-1922, inezinhlelo eziqinile kanye nezinga eliphakeme lokusungula ezobuchwepheshe, futhi ihlale ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izifundo ezihambelana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuvuselelwa kwezemfundo ku-Nyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand kubhekwa njengesisekelo esibalulekile sokukhulisa umnotho wezwe. Abafundi bangakhetha eziningi ezahlukene kwezifundo, okuhlanganisa ezemfundo, ezobuchwepheshe, ezempilo, kanye nezenhlalakahle. Ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomhlaba, le nyuvesi ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo ezikhiqizayo, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini lapho ubuchwepheshe buhlale buguquka. Izinsiza zeNyuvesi zisebenza kahle, zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokucwaninga ezisezingeni eliphakeme, izinkundla zokuzijabulisa, nemishini yesimanje. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola amathuba amaningi okuhlola, ukucwaninga, nokuzifundela. Ukwaziswa kokwenza ucwaningo kukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bangabi abatholi kuphela imfundo, kodwa babe ngababalulekile emiphakathini yabo. Ngaphezu kwemfundo, iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand ibheka izinga lempilo yabafundi, ikwakha izinhlelo zokwesekwa ezihlanganisa izifundo zokugcina ukhululekile, amaphrojekthi okuhlanganyela emiphakathini, kanye noqeqesho olwakha amakhono omsebenzi. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, iphinde ibambisane nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezihlose ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa nokuxhaswa okubhaliwe, okuqinisekisa imiphumela emihle yokuhlala kabusha kwabafundi. Imikhosi eyahlukene, efana neNyuvesi Yezakhamuzi, ibonisa indlela iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand esebenza ngayo ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziphezulu nezinhlelo ezikhiqizayo. Ngenxa yemikhosi eyenzeka njalo, abafundi bukhuthazwa ukuba babonise ubuqotho, uthando, kanye nezinto zokuzibandakanya, okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi namanye amakholwa. I-Nyuvesi isevele ibhekelele izinhlelo zayo zokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabafundi abaningi, isebenzisa imithombo yamaphrojekthi nezinhlelo zezimali ukuze ithole izifundo ezithile zokweseka abafundi abavela ezimweni ezinzima. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuthuthuka kwezinga lokufundiswa, okwenyusa amathuba abafundi abathola izifundo. Ngokubambisana nezinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nezikhungo zezimali, iNyuvesi ithuthukisa imisebenzi yabantu abasebenzelana nemfundo, ibheke phambili ekunciphiseni izikhalazo nezinkinga ezihlobene nezinga lezemfundo. I-Nyuvesi ibambisana nezinye izikhungo zamazwe ngamazwe, ukudala amathuba okusungula nokugcina imikhakha eminingi ihlanzekile, futhi izinhlelo ezikhuthaza iNyuvesi ukuba ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izifundo ezinhle. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, iNyuvesi ibhekelela izidingo zomphakathi, ibona ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwayo nabafundi, idizayina izinhlelo ezithuthukisa imizamo yempilo emphakathini. Izifundo zokuhlola ezibanjwa ngesikhathi esifanele ziye zatholakala kalula, uqhubekela phambili ekwakheni impumelelo yezenhlalakahle kanye nemfundo. Ekugcineni, iNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand, ngezifundo ezihloniphekile nezindlela zokwakha umphakathi, ibonakala ingeze izinguquko ezinhle emhlabeni wezokufundisa, ivumela abafundi bayo ukuba babe nesimo esihle sokwenza imisebenzi emisha. Izifundo eziqinile, amakhono aqinile, nezinhlelo ezinconyiwe, zenza le nyuvesi ibe impumelelo enkulu ezemfundo eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi kubafundi abasha abafuna ukufunda nokuhola. I-Nyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand ibonakala iphila ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iqhubekela phambili ekuphenduleni izidingo zomphakathi nezokufunda, ibeka izinyathelo ezikhiqizayo zokuphucula izinga lempilo nezemfundo, okwenza kube amandla amasha emhlabeni omhlaba jikelele.
Sithole kahle, kodwa kusekhona okuningi okumele kwenziwe, njengokwandisa inani lezinkantolo nokuthuthukisa ezikhona ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhanjiswa kobulungiswa emiphakathini. Saqala ngezinkantolo ezincane futhi saziwandisa ukuze nalabo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma emadolobheni bakwazi ukufinyelela ubulungiswa ngokuphelele. Phambilini, abantu bekumele bahambe izikhawu ezinde ukuya emadolobheni noma ezindaweni ezinkulu ukuze bafinyelele izinsizakalo zikahulumeni ezifana nezinkokhelo zomphakathi nezinkantolo eziphathelene nodlame lwezindlu. Omunye wemisebenzi eqalwe kulo nyaka ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo kumkhankaso wezinkantolo, okuvumela ukuthi amacala azwakale ngolimi lwakubo. Ngokuvamile, amacala manje asethwa ngesiZulu, isiXhosa, isiTswana, nesiBhunu emiphakathini ekhuluma lawa malimi kuphela. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini eyayinzima ukuqonda kahle lapho amacala axoxwa. I-Justice Today ilandele lo hlelo, ichaza ukuthi kungani kubalulekile kanye nemiphumela ezokwenza. Lezi zinkantolo eziyi-24 zizohlinzeka ngazo zonke izinsizakalo ezidingekayo, okusho ukuthi izinsizakalo zobulungiswa manje sezisondelene nezindlu zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ezikwazi ukuzimela. NgokweNgqongqoshe yezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo, u-Enver Surty, lesi sinyathelo sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi indlela abantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, abafinyelela ngayo izinsizakalo zobulungiswa ithuthukiswa. Lokhu kuhlelwa kabusha kusho ukuthi lezi zinkantolo eziyi-24 zizoguqulwa zibe izinkantolo eziphelele; zizobhekana nezindaba ezifana nokuhlukaniswa, ukwesekwa kwezingane, kanye nezinkinga zodlame lwezindlu ezisaphambili. Ekukhulumeni eNkantolo Ephakeme eBloemfontein ngonyaka owedlule, uNgqongqoshe uSurty uthe lezi zinkantolo ezihlelwe kabusha zizokwenza kube lula kakhulu kwabantu besifazane ngoba manje bazokwazi ukufinyelela izinkokhelo zabo zokwesekwa kwezingane eduze kwendawo abahlala kuyo. Sebenzisa umphakathi wase-Alexandra njengomfanekiso, uNgqongqoshe uchaze ukuthi le mpucuko enkulu bekumele ihambe ibanga elide ukuya eRandburg ukuze ifinyelele izinsizakalo zezakhamuzi. Ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo olusha olwakhiwe, manje bazokwazi ukusebenzisa inkantolo yase-Alexandra ukuze bafinyelele lezi zinsizakalo. Akukaze kube sekuyimfihlo ukuthi kwezinye izindawo, ukuhamba ukusuka ezindaweni zokuhlala ukuya emadolobheni lapho lezi zinkantolo zikhona kuyinkinga enkulu, okusho ukuthi abantu abaningi babhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu ukuze bafinyelele lezi zinsizakalo zomphakathi. Isibonelo, abahlali baseDeben eningizimu naseKapa kufanele bahambe ibanga elingu-11 kilometers ukuze bafike ePostmasburg, kanti labo abavela eBolotwa bahamba ibanga elingu-65 kilometers ukuze bafike eLady Frere. Ngakho-ke, ngalolu suku olwenziwe, kulindeleke ukuthi izinkinga ezinjalo zibe yinto yedlule. Ingxenye yemiphumela yale nyathelo ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinsizakalo zezakhamuzi ngokwandisa zonke izinsizakalo ezinkantolo zendawo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsiza ezihlinzekwa emiphakathini. Umbono weMnyango uthi izinkantolo kufanele zisetshenziswe eduze nemiphakathi esanda kuvela. Izinkantolo zendawo zakhiwe ukuze zibhekane kuphela nezindaba zodlame lwezindlu. Ukusungulwa kwalezi zinkantolo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokuhlala, kwaveza umbono wokuthi udlame lwezindlu lukhona kuphela ezindaweni zokuhlala. Izinkantolo zesikhashana nazo zisebenze ngendlela efanayo. Njengoba lezi zinkantolo zazingakhelwanga ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zomphakathi ezinjengokwesekwa kwezingane nodlame lwezindlu, kwasho ukuthi usizo lokuqala alukhona kalula kulabo abaluqondile kakhulu. Abahlali bezindawo zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokuhlala bahamba ibanga elide ukuze bathole ukwesekwa kwezingane. Ngesikhathi senziwa amalungiselelo okudlulisela lezi zinsizakalo, kuzobhekwa ukuthi umsebenzi ezinkantolo zendawo ngayinye ungatholakala yini ngaphambi kokuthi lezi zinkantolo zisetshenziswe njengezinkantolo eziphelele. Ngo-2005, i-Twelfth Amendment to the Constitution yashicilelwa ukuze kuqedwe imingcele yokuhlangana, ikakhulukazi lapho imingcele ethile ihlangana nedolobha elithile. Kusukela lapho, imingcele yaqhubeka ihlukaniswa ukuze kusungulwe amamunicipality angu-187 akhona. Nokho, le Mthethosisekelo, eyapheliswa nguPhalamende, ayisekelwa yizivumelwano ezidingekayo mayelana nezwe nemithetho ephathelene nezingane ezisemthethweni iNingizimu Afrika eyasayinile. Sekudlule isikhathi sokukhathazeka ukuthi imithetho ebhekana nobugebengu ayivumeli uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngenye indlela yokuhlala ngaphandle kokuboshwa. Ukunakekelwa Kwamadoda Nabesifazane Abadala: Ubulungiswa Nempilo Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahamba phambili empilweni, kubalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Lolu hlelo lokunakekela ludinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba luhlanganisa izici ezahlukene ezithinta impilo, ubuchwepheshe, nezidingo zomuntu siqu. Abantu abadala, ngokwemvelo, bahlala bezithola bephila impilo ehlukile, futhi kudinga ukwenziwa ngendlela ethokozisayo, efanele, futhi eqhubekayo. Isimo Somphakathi Nendlela Yokunakekela Izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala zidinga ukwakhiwa kumasiko nemigomo yomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, umphakathi kumele unikeze amathuba okuthi abantu abadala bazizwe bebandakanyekile, bejabule, futhi bephila impilo ephelele. Ukunakekela, kungaba ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo, ezokwelapha, noma izinhlelo zokuphila, kufanele kube yinto eqhubekayo. Umsebenzi wokuqonda izidingo zomuntu ngamunye, njengoba abantu abadala behluka ngokuya ngempilo yabo, izifiso zabo, nezinkumbulo zabo, ubalulekile. Izinselele Ezinhlobonhlobo Kukhona izinselele eziningi ezibhekene nabo abaphatha ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, izinqubomgomo ezingasebenzi kahle, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Abantu abadala, abaningi babo, bahlala bephathwa njengabantu abangenamandla, okwenza kube nzima ukuba baziveze. Ukuze kukhule ukuzethemba kwabo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhuthaza abantu abadala, zifaka phakathi ukuxhumana nomphakathi, ukuxhumana kwezokwelapha, nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphila. Ubuchwepheshe Nokunakekelwa Ubuqotho bokunakekelwa kwabantu abadala buhlobene kakhulu nobuchwepheshe. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka phambili, kukhona amathuba amaningi okuthi kuzothuthukiswe izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala. Izinhlelo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana zingasiza abantu abadala ukuba bahlale bexhumene nomndeni nabangani, baphinde bathole usizo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze kube nezinqubo eziqhubekayo zokufundisa abantu abadala indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukwamukela Ubulungiswa Ubulungiswa bukhona ekunakekelweni kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, wonke umuntu kufanele athole ukunakekelwa okufanele, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Abantu abadala kufanele banikezwe ithuba lokukhuluma ngezidingo zabo, bezwakalisa imizwa yabo, futhi bezwe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhuluma ngempilo yabo. Lokhu kudinga ukugxila emkhakheni wezemfundo, ukuze abantu nabakhiqizi babone ukuthi abantu abadala bangaba nesandla ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwabo. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ngokubuka phambili, kunezindlela eziningi zokuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abadala bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele, kudingeka ukwakhiwa kwemikhankaso yokwandisa ulwazi emphakathini. Lokhu kuhilela ukufundisa umphakathi ngokubaluleka kokunakekela abantu abadala, ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezisemthethweni, kanye nokuxhasa izinhlelo zokwelapha ezithuthukisiwe. Ukwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zempilo, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele kungaba yindlela enhle yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akuyona nje into ethinta impilo yabo kuphela, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha izinhlelo zokunakekela abantu abadala, kufanele sigxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunobulungiswa, obuphumelelayo, kanye nezixazululo ezibhekana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba abantu abadala baphile impilo egculisayo, benza umphakathi ube yindawo engcono kubo bonke. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akufanele kube umthwalo, kodwa kumele kube ithuba lokuhlonipha, ukuxhasa, nokwakha impilo enempilo.

I-Bhili ihlose ukusungula uhlaka lokuphumeza imithetho nemigomo ezohambelana nomkhakha wezempilo kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze izinsizakalo zezempilo zixazululwe kahle, iBhili ifuna ukuba kube nokulingana ekunikezeni izinsizakalo ngokusungula izinqubo nezindinganiso, izinhlelo, nemigomo kazwelonke. Isahluko sokuqala siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezinhloso zeBhili, imithwalo yemfanelo yomnyango wezempilo, kanye nelungelo lokufinyelela ukwelashwa okukhululekile. Ikhuluma ngokusebenza nokuchazwa komqondo weBhili. I-Bhili ihloselwe ukusetshenziswa ezingeni likazwelonke futhi idlule emithethweni ethile ehambelana nezempilo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo, uma kwenzeka ukungqubuzana phakathi kweBhili neminye imithetho yezempilo. Izinhloso zangempela zeBhili ukuhlinzeka ngemithwalo kahulumeni ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo mayelana nelungelo elihambelana nezinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nokusungula uhlelo lwezempilo lwesizwe oluhlose ababambiqhaza bezinsizakalo zezempilo zomphakathi kanye nezizimele futhi oluzohlinzeka abahlali beRiphabhulikhi ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezingathengiswa ngemali etholakalayo. Lesi sahluko sizama ukusho imithwalo yemfanelo kaNgqongqoshe wezempilo (uNgqongqoshe) uma kuqhathaniswa neminyango ezingeni likazwelonke, esifundazweni, nasemaphandleni. Lesi sahluko siphinde sihlose ukuvuselela uNgqongqoshe ukuba aphumeze imithetho ehambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezempilo okukhululekile ezigabeni ezithile zabantu. Isahluko sesibili siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nelungelo nemithwalo yemfanelo yalabo abasebenzisa izinhlelo zezempilo. Amalungelo abasebenzisi mayelana nolwazi ngezinsizakalo zezempilo, izinsizakalo zokwelashwa eziphuthumayo, kanye nokubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni mayelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo ayavunywa, njengoba nelungelo lomsebenzisi lokuhlinzekwa ngolwazi oluhambelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekukhishweni kwemibiko yokuthi umuntu uphume ohlelweni lokwelashwa kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwemvume enolwazi. Kukhona imithetho ebhekisela ekulawuleni ukwelashwa ngenhloso yokucwaninga kanye nokugcina amarekhodi ezikhungo zezempilo. Lesi sahluko siphinde sibheke ukwethulwa kwezikhalazo ngabantu abasebenzisi nabanye mayelana nezikhungo zezempilo kanye nezilindelo zabantu abasebenzisi mayelana nezempilo zabo, ukusetshenziswa kwabo kwezikhungo zezempilo, kanye nobudlelwano babo nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Isahluko sesithathu siqukethe imithetho ehambelana noMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Kubhekiswe ekusunguleni iNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke lapho uNgqongqoshe azobambisana khona namalungu eNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke (okuhlanganisa oNgqongqoshe bezifundazwe), ikomidi lezakhamizi elimele uhulumeni bendawo, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha aseNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezinye iziphathimandla eminyangweni yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nasemazweni. Lesi sahluko sichaza imisebenzi namandla eNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke, okuyi-ukwazisa uNgqongqoshe. Lesi sahluko siphinde sisungule iKomidi Lokweluleka Lezempilo Kazwelonke. Amalungu ale komidi angabaphathi beminyango yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nasemazweni, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha aseNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezimele zikamasipala. Lesi sahluko siphinde sikhuthaze uMphakathi Jikelele woMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke ukuba athuthukise izinqubomgomo zezempilo kazwelonke. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekusunguleni iKomidi Lokubonisana Ngempilo Kazwelonke ezosebenza ukuze kuhlanganiswe imikhakha ehlukene yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke. Isahluko sesine siqukethe imithetho ehambelana neMinyango YezeMpilo Yezifundazwe. Lesi sahluko s placing an obligation on these departments to operate in accordance with the national health policy under specific conditions. It addresses the establishment of health councils in provinces whose operations will mirror those of the National Council, but will be conducted at the provincial level. Provincial Health Advisory Committees will be established, which will perform similar functions to those of the National Council, but will be conducted at the provincial level. This chapter also authorizes the development of health strategies in provinces to be presented to the Director-General. It also addresses the requirement for provincial ministers to establish Provincial Health Consultation Forums to share information and connect on health-related issues with various stakeholders. Isahluko sesihlanu sisungula uhlelo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezithile eRiphabhulikhi, okwenziwa ngokulandela izimiso ezithile. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekwakhiweni kwezindawo zezempilo, okwenziwa ngokubheka imingcele ebekwe ezindaweni zamamunicipal kanye nokuhlanganiswa nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Ikhuluma ngokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo zamamunicipal futhi ivumela ukwethulwa nokuhlelwa kwezinhlelo zezempilo zezakhamuzi. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ezinhlelweni zesikhashana ezihambelana nezinsizakalo zezempilo zamamunicipal. Isahluko sesithupha siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezikhungo zezempilo. Le mithetho ilawula ukuhlukaniswa ngokuhlukana, ukusungulwa, nokusebenza kwezikhungo zezempilo futhi ifaka imithetho elawula izitifiketi zokudinga. Ngokusho kwalesi sahluko, akekho ongakha, akhe, aguqule, noma athole isikhungo sezempilo noma ihhovisi lezempilo ngaphandle kwesitifiketi sokudinga. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekufezeni izidingo, izimvume, nezixazululo mayelana nokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe ngezitifiketi zokudinga, kanye nezimo ezithile ezihambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezikhungweni zikahulumeni, okunika uNgqongqoshe amandla okwenza izinqumo ngalezo zimo. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekukhetheni kwamabhodi ezibhedlela nguNgqongqoshe kanye noNgqongqoshe bezifundazwe (amaMEC). Ukwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezikhungweni ezingezona ezempilo, njengemikhakha yezemfundo nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi, kuyakhuluma kulesi sahluko. UNgqongqoshe unikezwa amandla okwenza izinqumo mayelana nokwelashwa kwabathandazeli bamasiko nabanye abezinhloso zamasiko nokwenzeka ezindaweni zamasiko zokukhulisa abafana. Imithetho elawula ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni nezizimele ifakiwe kulesi sahluko. Izikhungo ezizimele zinesibopho sokuthola umshwalense ukuze zivikele abasebenzisi ekulimazeni okungenzeka. Isahluko sesixhenxe siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nokuhlelwa kwezinsiza zabantu kanye nezikhungo zezempilo ezihlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi zezempilo. Kukhona imithwalo eminingi ebekwe kwiNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke mayelana nokuhlinzeka nokuhlela izinsiza zabantu, futhi kukhona imithetho ebhekisela ekusunguleni izindlela ezifanele zokw
Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezikhathi Zamaholide Kwake kwaba nesikhathi lapho abantu bejabulile, behlangana emindenini yabo, bejabulela amaholide. Lezi zikhathi zazihambisana nokuhamba, ukudla okumnandi, nemicimbi yokuzijabulisa. Kodwa, njengoba kwenzeka ezimpilweni zethu, izimo eziphuthumayo zazingavela noma nini, zishiye abantu besaba futhi bedinga usizo. Ekuqaleni, uSipho, umphakathi ophakathi nendawo, wayehlala edolobheni elincane elinabantu abaningi. Ngelanga elihle, uSipho noMariam, umkakhe, bahlela ukuba neholide elikhethekile. Babefuna ukuhamba baye emaphandleni, lapho bekwazi khona ukujabulela imvelo, izihlahla eziphakeme, nezinyoni ezicwila emoyeni. Kodwa, kwasekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi sokujabula, kwavela ingozi. Ngenkathi bephuma emzini, uSipho wathola ukuthi umama wakhe, owayekhuluma naye, waphuthuma esibhedlela ngenxa yokuswela umoya. Uhlanga lwezimo eziphuthumayo lwalufaneleka kakhulu, kodwa uSipho wayezwa engazi ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani. Uthumele uMariam ukuba aqhubeke nohambo, kodwa yena wathola ukuthi akakwazi ukuhamba ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi umama wakhe uyaphila yini. U-Sipho wathinta insizakalo yezimo eziphuthumayo, ethintana ne-ambulensi. “Ngicela usizo, umama wami uhambe esibhedlela, kufanele ngiyobona ukuthi unjani,” esho ngenkani. Umqhubi we-ambulensi, uThabo, wamphendula ngokushesha. “Sizofika maduzane, ungakhathazeki,” kusho yena, futhi uSipho waba nethemba lokuthi umama wakhe uzophila. Ngesikhathi uSipho elindele, umoya wawuphakeme, kodwa inhliziyo yakhe yayigcwele ukwesaba. UThabo nozakwabo bafika ngokushesha, baphendukela emzini kaSipho. “Siyavuma, sizokuthatha umama wakho,” kusho uThabo, bejabulisa uSipho. U-Sipho wakhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile, futhi zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhashana, uSipho wathola izindaba ezinhle. Umama wakhe wayesebhadi, kodwa ubudlelwano babo babuhlale bukhona. UThabo nozakwabo bamsiza ukuba abheke umama wakhe esibhedlela, futhi uSipho wathola ithuba lokukhuluma naye. “Ngiyaphila, mntwanami,” kusho umama, “ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha.” U-Sipho wagcwala injabulo, waba neziqu zempilo. Ngemuva kokuphuma esibhedlela, uSipho waphinda wacabanga ngamaholide. Wayazi ukuthi akekho owayezokwazi ukuhamba ngaphandle kokukhathalela izimo eziphuthumayo. UThabo waphinde wathi, “Siyazi ukuthi amaholide awahambisani nezimo eziphuthumayo, kodwa kufanele sibe necebo.” U-Sipho wavuma, “Ngiyabonga, ngiyazi ukuthi sizokwazi ukubhekana nakho konke.” U-Sipho noMariam baphinde bahlela amaholide amasha, kodwa manje babenobuhlakani. Bahlela ukwakha uhlelo lokuphuma, behlola izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo. “Sizothatha inombolo yocingo ye-ambulensi, sizobe sithola usizo uma kudingeka,” kusho uMariam. U-Sipho wavuma, futhi bazama ukujabulisa izinsuku zabo. Ngesikhathi amaholide edlula, uSipho noMariam baba nezikhathi ezinhle, kodwa bahlala beqaphela izimo eziphuthumayo. Babefunda ukuthi ukuphila akuyona into elula, kodwa ukuhamba phambili kudinga ubuhlakani. Noma ngabe kwenzeka ini, bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zikhona ukuze zibe nesandla, ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila kahle. Ekugcineni, uSipho wathola ukuthi amaholide awawona kuphela isikhathi sokujabula, kodwa futhi isikhathi sokufunda. Izimo eziphuthumayo zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphela, bazi ukuthi banganqoba izinkinga uma behlanganyela. U-Sipho noMariam bahlala bejabule, bephila impilo enempilo, futhi bekwazi ukubhekana nanoma iyiphi ingozi ehamba phambili. Ngale ndlela, uSipho wafunda ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile, futhi zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila kahle, ngisho nangesikhathi sokujabula. Amaholide akhe aba yisikhathi sokukhumbula, sokuhlanganyela, nokubambisana, okwenza impilo ibe mnandi.
Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni Ngokwezibalo ezitholakala kuhulumeni, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhombisa ukushoda okukhulu kwemithi, okuvele kubangele ukungahambi kahle kwezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kushoda kwemithi kuhambisana nezinkinga eziningi, okuhlanganisa nokungabi khona kwemali eyanele, ukuphazamiseka kokuhlinzekwa kwemithi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali ezibhedlela. Izibhedlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezisezingeni eliphansi, zikhala ngokuthi azikwazi ukuthola imithi edingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukunakekela abafundi bazo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abaguli badinge ukuhamba imikhankaso emide ukuze bathole imithi ezindaweni ezingezona ezibhedlela, okwandisa ubuhlungu babaguli. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezwe luphinde lukhombise ukuthi izibhedlela eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela zokuphatha ezibucayi ukuze zikwazi ukugcina izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngenxa yokushoda kwemithi, abanye abaguli baphinde badinge ukulala ezibhedlela isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuthola imithi abayidingayo. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinkinga zokuphila, ngenxa yokuthi imithi ibalulekile ekwelapheni izifo ezihlukahlukene. Okwamanje, abezindaba bathole ukuthi izibhedlela ezisemaphandleni zikhathazekile kakhulu, ngoba akumele zithole imithi ngesikhathi, futhi lokhu kubangela ukungabikho kwesithunzi sokwelashwa. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lukhombisa ukuthi abanye abaguli baphendukela ezindaweni ezizimele ukuze bathole imithi, okukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezempilo lukhona ezinkingeni ezishubile. “Siye sahlala isikhathi eside silindile imithi esibhedlela,” kusho uMnu. Mthembu, ongomunye wababebonakala ezibhedlela. “Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu badinga imithi, kodwa uma ungatholi lutho, ungayithola kuphi? Lokhu kwenza kube nzima empilweni yami.” Uhlelo lokuphathwa kwemithi luthathwa kakhulu, futhi abezindaba bathole ukuthi sekudlulelwa indaba yokuthi imithi ethile ayitholakali, okukhombisa ubunzima bokuhlinzeka ngemithi eyanele. Uhlelo lwezempilo luhlala luthinteka yizinkinga zezimali, futhi lokhu kuhlangene noshintsho olungafanele olwenziwa kumaphrojekthi okutholakala kwemithi. Umnyango wezempilo uthe uqhubekile nokusebenza ukuze uthole izixazululo, nokho, inhloso yokukhulisa ukutholakala kwemithi iyinselele enkulu. UMsizi, umphakathi ophakathi kweNingizimu Afrika, uthe: “Kulokhu, sinesithakazelo sokuthi imithi kufanele ifinyeleleke kalula kubantu bethu. Njengoba umphakathi, kufanele sithumele izwi lethu ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo.” Uhlelo lwezempilo luhlala luhlaziywa, futhi umnyango uthe uzothathela phezulu iziphakamiso ezivela emphakathini ukuze kutholakale izindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlinzeka ngemithi ezibhedlela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaguli bahlala bephila impilo enempilo, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngemithi abayidingayo. Ngokwesikhathi esithile, umnyango wezempilo uqhakambisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngemithi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwemithi yokwelapha ngendlela efanele, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuhweba ezizokwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo emisha. Kubantu abaningi, ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kusemqoka, futhi sekukhona imizamo eminingi yokuthola izixazululo phakathi komphakathi kanye nohulumeni. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo kuyadingeka ukuze kutholakale izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuphatha imithi, ukuze abantu bahlale bephila kahle. Ekugcineni, ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kusemqoka, futhi udaba lufanele ukubhekwa ngeso lokho. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okuqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithi iyatholakala, futhi izimpilo zabantu ziqhubeka zikhula. Umphakathi kufanele ube nomthelela ekutholeni izixazululo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngensiza ezidingekayo kubantu.
Ikholera yisifo esitholwa umuntu ngokuphuza amanzi nokudla okuthintekile ngamagciwane eholera. Amagciwane adala ikholera atholakala emfucumfucu yomuntu. Ikholera isabalala kanjani? Ungasebenzisi umfula njengento yokuhlanza, kodwa sebenzisa indlu yangasese efanele. Geza izandla zakho ngamanzi ashisayo noma insipho ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese nangaphambi kokuphatha ukudla. Ungamsiza kanjani umuntu ongekholera? Mnike amanzi amaningi ahlanganiswe noshukela/usalty ukuze aphe. Thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi abilisiwe, ungeze izipuni eziyisishiyagalombili zoshukela nezinyanga eziyisithupha zosalty, bese uxuba. Nika umuntu ogulayo le ngxube ukuze aphuze kancane futhi kaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Khumbula, qhubeka unikeza le ngxube yoshlanga/usalty kumuntu ongekholera. Thutha lowo muntu ngokushesha uye emtholampilo noma endaweni yokwelashwa ngokushesha okukhulu. Uma udinga olunye ulwazi, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi ungase ube nekholela, vakashela emtholampilo, esibhedlela, kudokotela, noma kumsebenzi wezempilo oseduzane nawe.
UJacob Zuma: Uhlanga Oludlula Ividiyo UJacob Zuma, owayengumengameli wezwe lethu, ungumuntu ohlale ekhuthaza izingxoxo ezinzima phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga eziningi ezihambisana nezehlakalo zobuholi bakhe, akunakuphikwa ukuthi uZuma ungomunye wabadlali ababalulekile emlandweni waleli lizwe. Ubaba wakhe uqobo, osikhumbuza ukuthi uJohannesburg akukhona nje kuphela okuhlangenwe nakho okungenamkhawulo, kodwa kuyinhliziyo yendlela eqhuba ukuthuthukiswa kwezwe. Ngokubuka kwami, uJacob Zuma usezingeni eliphakeme kakhulu njengoba enza izinqumo ezinkulu, eziva izwe. Ukuphakama kwakhe kwezombusazwe akudluli nje ekubeni umengameli; kuholela ekutheni abe nezithakazelo eziningi emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Kodwa kumelwe sikhumbule ukuthi, njengomholi, uZuma ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Amaqiniso amahle nezimbi ezithinta impilo yakhe zihlanganisa izehlakalo ezithinta ubumbano lwezombusazwe, ubukhazikhazi, kanye nezehlakalo zenkantolo. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi uZuma wathola ukudumisa, kodwa futhi waphinde wabhekana nokuhluleka okukhulu. Munye wezinto ezijulile engizikhalela ngazo nguZuma wukuthi wayengomunye wabaholi abashayelwa phansi yizinkinga ezikhona kakhulu. Njengoba ebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, umphakathi wawukhula ngezindlela ezahlukene, ibhizinisi, kanye nezehlakalo ezenzeka emiphakathini. Ukuphuthuma kokuphatha izindaba zomphakathi, kuhlanganiswa neziqu zenkantolo, kwabonisa ukuthi abanye banikeza uZuma ividiyo futhi abanye bamhla ngenkani. Nokho, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi uZuma akazange alokhu engumholi omuhle, noma umbono omuhle, ngesikhathi sane ezifundazweni zakhe nomsebenzi wobuholi. Abanye babonakalisa imizwa yokukhathazeka mayelana nezinqumo zenkantolo azizange zixazululwe. Lokhu kwathi, ngemva kokusebenzisa izinkishwa eziyinqaba, uZuma wagcwalisa imicabango ethile futhi waba yisithombeni esibalulekile ezinkundleni. Ubuye ubone izikhangiso zomphakathi eziphethe izinkanyezi ezikhombisa ubukhazikhazi bakhe ngesikhathi esifanayo. Okwamanje, noma kungeke kuphumelele ukukhipha umphakathi ezinsukwini zekhulu leshumi nanye, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole indlela uZuma obuqhubeka ngayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuqonda ukuthi uZuma uyinqaba, uyinkanyezi, noma ungumholi osenkingeni. Lokhu kuzodlula ezindabeni kanye nezinqumo zakhe ezinkulu. UZuma ubonakala engumholi onamandla, owenze izinqubo ezinhle nokuhlasela okukhulu. Kodwa ngesimo esidlangile, uJacob Zuma uyinhlangano ebalulekile emlandweni wezwe. Ukumeleka kwakhe kudinga ukubhekwa njengezizathu ezahlukahlukene zempilo yomphakathi, ukunciphisa ububanzi benkohlakalo, kanye nezithombe ezifakazela izinqumo zenkantolo. UZuma kufanele ahlale esikhumbuzo seqiniso lokuthi impilo yakhe ingenye yezinto ezinkulu ezazingavela njengobuholi bovivinyo. Ekugcineni, uJacob Zuma umbono owenziwe ngamaphutha nezinto ezimfakazela izimpilo zabantu. Akukho futhi akaze kube khona ukuhamba kokuhlangana, okuwubufakazi bokuthi umbuso wezomthetho ubalulekile, futhi lezi zinjongo zidinga ukuqonda. Kwelokhu, kungenzeka dube ukunciphisa izinkinga, ngenkathi uthathwa njengomholi owayengowesithathu, kanye nesibonelo esinembile sokuqhubeka nohambo lwakhe lwezombusazwe. Uhlanga olukhula, lokho okukhumbuzayo uJacob Zuma, luhlala lunokhalakhanya nolwazi olunamandla, olukhumbuza ngezizathu zothando nosizo emsebenzini. Lezi zinto zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokusebenza, kodwa ziyaphinde zikhumbuze ukuthi ukuzibophezela kulandela izinqumo eziphusile nemiphako ezibanjwa umkhawulo ekwakheni izimanga ezizoletha impumelelo emiphakathini yethu. Ngendlela ethile, uJacob Zuma uyinsika yokuphila kwethu, futhi kanye nesigaba somphakathi, uyindodakazi yempumelelo ekhulayo.
Le nsizakalo ihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungabhalisela kanjani njengomthumeli wezimpahla ezivela phesheya neMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ifomu lesicelo kumele liqedwe ngumfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processing. Sicela ubheke iziqondiso zesicelo ukuze usize ekwenzeni izimvume. Bheka ibhokisi le-Importer ngaphansi kokubhaliswa nokuthi uzothumela imibhalo uqobo noma uqashe ummeli ukuze enze kanjalo. Ingxenye yeMvume Yokufaka isicelo kumele igcwaliswe ngumuntu ofaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengomthumeli wezimpahla ezivela phesheya. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ehlinzeka ngalo msebenzi, kumele kube igama elivela kule ngxenye. Uma kukhona uphawu (), susa noma yini engasebenzi. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama nesibongo somfaki-sicelo wesivumelwano. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyaziwe. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika eliseduzane. Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi esikhishwe nguMlawuli Wezinkampani, noma uMphakathi Wenkantolo uma kuyisikhwama. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwesigaba sokwehliswa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10 no-607.04. Inkampani - bonke abaphathi, kuhlanganise nomphathi ophakathi nendawo nomphathi wezomnotho. I-SARS isungule amazinga afanele okuphatha ibhizinisi azosungulwa eminyakeni emibili ezayo kusukela ngo-2004 kuya ku-2007. Uma ubhalisela noma ukhokha, i-SARS ihlose ukuphatha ukubhaliswa kwakho ngqo ezinsukwini eziyi-21 zokusebenza. Le nsizakalo iyatholakala mahhala. Uhlobo lweklayenti lokubhaliswa - Umthumeli, DA 185.
Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa (GEMS Treatment Outcome Responsibility) Ngaphakathi kwezinkulungwane, umhlaba kanye nezinkinga ezihambisana nokwelashwa zishintshile, kodwa into eyodwa ihlale ifana: isibopho sokunikeza imiphumela ethile phakathi kwezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Emiphakathini evamile, lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu neGEMS, okuyisifinyezo se-‘Generalized Outcome Measure for Standardized Treatments,’ esisiza ochwepheshe bezempilo ukuba bahlaziye imiphumela yokwelashwa ngendlela eqondile nefanele. Izinsuku eziphakathi kronjiwe zikhumbuza abantu abaningi ngezindawo ezenza imiphumela yokwelashwa ifinyeleleke. Kusukela ngesikhathi sokuzindla kwabantu, okwasekuhlaleni, izinqaba zokwelapha, iziguli zazifuna ukwazi ukuthi ziyobe ziphuma njani emkhakheni wezempilo. Kodwa ngaphambi kokuba kube khona izindlela ezicacile zokuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa, lezi zinsiza zazihlala zinezinkinga ezithile — ezokuhlola nezokubuyekeza. Emaphakathi nekhulu lama-20, kuba khona intuthuko enkulu emkhakheni wezokwelapha, lapho kuchazwa khona ngokucacile izindlela zokwelapha nezindlela zokuhlala zempilo. Kulezi zikhathi, kuchazwa ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa akukhona kuphela okufanele kube nemikhuba yokulwa nezifo, kodwa kufanele futhi kube nomthelela empilweni yesiguli. Ngalesi sikhathi, abacwaningi baveza ukuthi ukwelashwa kufanele kube nezinqubo ezisemqoka zokuhlola, ezizokwenza kube khona izinkomba ezichaziwe ukuze zihlolwe. Njengoba kusondela ekupheleni kwale nkathi, umphakathi wezempilo waqala ukubona izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izinkomba ezithile, okuyinto eyamenza lokhu kube ukwakha uhlaka olujulile lokuhlola imiphumela. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba phambili, uhlu lwemiphumela lokuhlola, okwakuhlanganisa izinkomba ezivumelana nezinga lesiguli, lwadalwa. Lokhu kwavuleka emaphethelweni okuzama ukujula ekuqondeni indlela yokuthi iziguli ziwuthola kanjani umphumela wokwelashwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iGEMS yavela njengomkhiqizo wokwakha i-model esebenzayo, evumela ukuthi izikhungo zezempilo ziqoqa, zihlaziye, futhi ziqhathanise imiphumela yokwelashwa. Iphrojekthi ibikade ibhekwa njengomphumela obalulekile emigqeni yokwelapha ukwazisa ngokwengeziwe ngezidingo zeziguli. Njengoba amakhono akhula ngemisebenzi ehlukene yokwelapha, imiphumela yokwelashwa yaba into eyenza ukucabanga okukhulu nemisebenzi emisha. Ukuqinisekiswa kwezibopho ezishiwo yiGEMS kwaba nomthelela ezinqubweni zokuphila zabantu. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela empilweni yabo, kodwa nasempilweni yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziguli zenzeka zokuqala ukuzimisela ukuba nomthelela ekuqondeni imiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu qallakaza indlela abaphila ngayo, kwabahlala bagcina bezibophezela ezimisweni ezithile, ukuze baqhubeke nokugqugquzela izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezinqala futhi ezinezinhloso. Abasabalalisi bemiphumela yokwelashwa behlole izinkinga nezinselelo ezihlobene neGEMS, futhi bazizwa bethokozisa ngokuhlanganyela imiphumela ethokozisayo. Le miphumela, okwakukhona izibalo ezithile nemiphumela ethile, yaholela ekubeni bathathe izinyathelo ezinkulu. Isizukulwana sokuqala sokusebenzisa iGEMS siphathe izithembiso zokwelapha ezithuthukile, ezaguqula indlela yokubhekisisa nezokwelashwa kahle. Phakathi nezinsuku ezithile, lezi zinto ziwubufakazi bokuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa iyashintsha. Ngenkathi amakhono eGEMS eqhubeka, umphakathi wabantu uthola ulwazi olunembile, oludingekayo ezindleleni zokuphila zokugcina imiphumela yokwelashwa ibalulekile. Ikakhulukazi, lokhu kubala okuhle akusayo kuphela ukwakheka kwemiphumela yokwelashwa kodwa kuhlobene nokwethula umkhankaso, ukuqonda okwandayo phakathi kwezempilo nezenhlalakahle. Isibopho sokusebenza sizinikele ekwakheni izixazululo ezivumelana nezidingo zabantu, nokwazisa ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukwazi impilo ildir jweji uma imiphumela yokwelashwa ibhekwa futhi ihlonishwa ngaphezu kokuhlola, lokhu ateka umphakathi ukuze balandele iziphakamiso ezithile ezilindelekayo. Ngamafuphi, isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa sineqalisa ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, kanye nemiphakathi, okuhamba phambili kumazinga aphezulu. I-GEMS isiqhubeka nokufuya ubuchwepheshe besimanje, ibalulekile emithini ewusizo yokuhlola imiphumela ekhulayo. Izinkampani zempilo zikhumbule, iziphakamiso zifinyelelwa ngenhloso yokubambisana, ngoba emaphayipini akhona, imiphumela yokwelashwa iqhubeka nokukhula nezindaba zomphakathi zezenzo zempilo. Ekupheleni kosuku, isibopho sokwelashwa sokuqala kulezi zinsiza zingenza isiguli sibe nesithakazelo esiqinile emkhakheni wokwelapha, okwenza kube lula kakhulu Ukuba neziguli ezijabule ngempela. Imiphumela yokwelashwa yaziwa, ibeka imiphakathi ibilingana, iGEMS izokwenza umphumela phambili, ehlonishwa futhi ethathwa njengento ebaluleke kakhulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu okubikiwe kudinga ukusungulwa kwezinyathelo ezithile, ezithuthukayo, ezinde ziza kubekezela ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile lokwelashwa. I-GEMS iyinsika ebalulekile yokwazisa abantu, umbono, neziphakamiso zokwelapha, okwenza kube kube yinsika yeqhaza ethe xaxa. Uhlelo olwakhiwa ngempumelelo lusebenza ukuze luthuthukise imiphumela yezempilo ngokuphathelene nezinto ezinqumayo zokubona. Njengoba siqhubeka, lesi sikhumbuzo sokuhlonipha, ukusebenza kahle, nesibopho senzelwa kahle ngokuchumisa imiphumela yokwelashwa, sizoqhubeka sithuthukisa izimfanelo zendalo, sithokozise iziguli, futhi sibe umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Sicela thatha umzuzu ukuze uqedele le survey elandelayo. Zonke ifomu ezigcwele zizohlanganiswa futhi kuzobanjwa umncintiswano kulabo abawina. Kuzoba nabawinile abayi-10, abazothola ibhaskithi yezitshalo - izitshalo ezanele zokutshala ihektha elilodwa. Uphi esifundazweni nasezindaweni ohlabayo? Iphakethe lakho linjani? Ukwakhiwa kweBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kanye neBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle; kulungiselelwe ukuphathwa kwezikhungo ezithile yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe; kanye nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umkhumbi ubhekisela kunoma iyiphi isakhiwo esivunguza emanzini, kuhlanganise nezindiza. Ukuze kube lula ukudluliswa kwamakhono nolwazi, ulwazi, nokuphathwa ngokubambisana nomkhakha ozimele ongaphansi kokulawulwa kuk gouvernement. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa nguNgqongqoshe onenhloso, kuzokwakhiwa inkampani yeBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ezoba nefa, izomela, futhi iphathe izikhungo egameni leHhovisi. Le Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe izophathwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA). UNgqongqoshe onenhloso kumele athathe izinyathelo zokwakha nokubhalisa iBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe njengenkampani yomphakathi engathengisa amasheya noma izitokwe futhi ikhishwe isitifiketi sokwakha futhi ilandele lokho okukhulunywa nguMthetho Wamakampani. IHhovisi izoba yilungu elilodwa kuphela kanye nomnikazi walesi sikhungo seBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe. Amalungelo eHhovisi ukuba ibe yilungu elinamasheya kule Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe azophathwa nguNgqongqoshe onenhloso. Uma kutholakala ukuthi lezi zifundo zokubhaliswa azihambisani nalokho okukhulunywa ngumthetho, lowo mthetho uzothathwa njengowokuqala noma uzosetshenziswa; futhi lokho okukhulunywa ngalezi zifundo zokubhaliswa kuzoba namandla kuphela uma lo mthetho ushintshwa ukuze ususe lokho okuphikisanayo. UNgqongqoshe onenhloso, ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe, angacela uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha ukuba akhumbuze ukuthi ezinye izinhlinzeko noma izingxenye zomthetho wamakampani azisebenziseki kule Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe. UMsizi Wamakampani kumele aveze leyo mininingwane mayelana nokusebenza kwayo nokwesekwa kwayo ngokuhambisana nengxenye, ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi. Kulokhu kwesaziso, uMsizi Wamakampani kumele ameme abantu ukuba bathumele izikhalazo zabo neziphakamiso kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kulokhu kwesaziso ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esikhulunywa kulokhu kwesaziso. Ngemuva kokubheka lezi zikhalazo neziphakamiso uma kukhona ezitholakele ngokuhambisana nengxenye 2, uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha, ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi, angakhipha isinqumo sokuthi le ngxenye yezinhlinzeko ezithile noma zonke izinhlinzeko noma lezi zingxenye ezithintekayo nguMthetho Wamakampani, azisebenziseki kule Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywa kulokhu kwesaziso. Lokhu ngeke kunciphise noma kwehlise amandla eBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ukuveza njengobuhlakani bomphakathi noma kwehlise ukuvuleka kokusebenza nokusetshenziswa; futhi ngeke kuphule amalungelo, inzuzo, noma izimangalo zalabo abakhokhelwa yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe noma abasebenzi noma ilungelo lokuzuza kwanoma ubani. Unyaka wezimali weBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe uzohamba kusukela kuMsombuluko 1 kuya kuMgqibelo 31 wonyaka olandelayo, kokubili izinsuku zifakiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywa nganoma yimuphi umthetho, iBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ngeke ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu ophakanyisiwe yinkantolo noma ngaphansi kohlelo lokwehliswa kwenkampani olwehluleka ukukhokha izikweletu, ngaphandle kokuthi kuvunyelwe nguMthetho ofanele okukhulunywa ngawo ngqo ngalokho. Zonke izikhungo eziphansi kweBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe yeTransnet ngaphambi kokuthi lo mthetho uqale uzobuyela kwiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywa ngokuhambisana nengxenye 27. Ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi, uNgqongqoshe uzokhipha isaziso sokuthi yiziphi ezinye izikhungo ezizongena ngaphansi kweBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulunywa nengxenye 1. UNgqongqoshe angaphinde abuyekeze, ashintshe noma andise imingcele yezikhungo futhi kumele axhumane nezindawo ezihlobene uma lokho kubuyekezwa, kushintshwa noma kwandiswe kuzothinta imingcele yezindawo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle, ukwethembeka, kanye nezindleko zalesi sikhungo, ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezamukelekayo zomhlaba nezidingo zomphakathi. IBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kumele yenze konke okudingekayo ukuphatha izikhungo ngempumelelo nangokuphumelelayo, ukuhlela nokuqhubekisela phambili izikhungo. Ukuze kulungiselelwe ukwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi ukuze kuncishiswe ukuphindaphinda kwezenzo nezinqubo eziphathelene nokwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi. UNgqongqoshe kumele azise umphakathi ngalesi sikhumbuzo sokuxhumana esikhulunywa ngengxenye 2, ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi. Ibhodi izoba nelungu elingaphansi kweyisi-7 futhi lingaphezulu kweyisi-13, elizokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe onenhloso. UNgqongqoshe onenhloso kumele aqoke ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe nguMongameli weBhodi. IBhodi kumele ikhethe uMongameli Osenhliziyweni phakathi kwamalungu ayo. Amalungu eBhodi kumele angamele izintshisekelo zeqembu elithile, kodwa kumele akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke abasebenzisi bezikhungo. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe isaziso ngokwenza isitatimende kwiGazethi Yomphakathi nakumaphephandaba ngenhloso yakhe yokukhetha lowo muntu futhi ameme umphakathi ukuba athumele imibono yabo noma aphikise ukukhethwa kwalowo muntu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esikhulunywa kulokhu kwesaziso; futhi abheke eziphakamiso noma izikhalazo ezitholakele ngenxa yalokho kwesaziso. UNgqongqoshe onenhloso angakhetha amalungu okuqala eBhodi ngaphambi kokubhaliswa kweBhodi. Lezi zinketho zizothatha umthelela ngosuku lokubhaliswa. IBhodi izomela iBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kuyo yonke imisebenzi ezokwenziwa yiBhodi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho futhi ezizovunyelwa zizothathwa njengokwenziwa yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi abanye abaphathiswa yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe; futhi kulandele inqubomgomo yeHhovisi mayelana nezohwebo zezikhungo zomphakathi. Akukho okukhulunywa nengxenye 1 kuzovimba iBhodi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yayo efanele ngempumelelo ukuphatha ngokwezimali, ukuhlela, ukwenza nokulawula izikhungo futhi lokho akuphikisi nomthetho. Izi-16 Zamahubo Zokulwa Nezokuhlukumeza Abesifazane Nezingane iyisikhangiso sezwe esenzeka minyaka yonke kusukela ngomhla ka-25 Novemba (Usuku Lomhlaba Lokulwa Nezokuhlukumeza Abesifazane) kuze kube ngomhla ka-10 December (Usuku Lwamalungelo Abantu). Phakathi nalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uqhuba umkhankaso wezama-16 wokulwa nezokuhlukumeza okukhomba ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngempempe ethinta abesifazane nezingane. Lo mkhankaso uhlose ukuhlanganisa zonke izigaba zomphakathi ukuze kulwe nokuhlukumeza. Uhulumeni uzinikele ekwakheni umphakathi onakekela futhi ophumulelayo ovikela abesifazane nezingane ezinhlotsheni zonke zokuhlukumeza. Nakuba umkhankaso wezama-16 wokulwa nezokuhlukumeza uqhubeka minyaka yonke kusukela ngomhla ka-25 Novemba kuze kube ngomhla ka-10 December, imigomo yawo ivuselelwa ngohlelo lweminyaka elodwa olwaziwa ngokuthi uHlelo lwe-365 Days kanye noHlelo LwaseNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka nonyaka, uhulumeni, ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi nezimboni, uqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe umthelela womkhankaso. Ngokweseka lo mkhankaso, izinkulungwane zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ziyasiza ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngokuqhuba nokwakha ukwesekwa kulabo abahlukunyezwayo nalabo abaphunyukile emiphumeleni yokuhlukumeza. Sekela umkhankaso ngokugqoka i-ribbon emhlophe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-16: I-ribbon emhlophe iyisikhumbuzo sokuthula esimele ukuzinikela komgibeli ekungayeki ukuhlukumeza okukhuluma ngakho abesifazane nezingane. Bamba iqhaza ezingxoxweni ezenzakalayo: Lezi zingxoxo ziqala ukuze kuqale izingxoxo phakathi kwabantu ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela: www.genderlinks.org.za noma uvakashele isikhungo seThusong sendawo yakho. Bamba iqhaza emicimbini ehlukahlukene phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-16 zokulwa nokuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane: Kukhona ikhalenda yemicimbi eyenzeka ezweni lonke kusukela ngomhla ka-25 Novemba kuze kube ngomhla ka-10 December. Ukuze ubone le micimbi, hlola le webhusayithi www.womensnet.org.za/calendar.shtml. Yiba umphakathi wokweseka izinhlelo ezizimele nemiphakathi esiza abesifazane nezingane abahlukunyezwayo: Izinhlelo eziningi ezisiza labo abahlukunyezwayo nabaphunyukile zidinga ukwesekwa komphakathi. Unganikeza isikhathi sakho ngokusiza ezikhungweni. Bheka isikhungo somphakathi eduze kwakho lapho ungakwazi khona ukusiza. Ungathola olunye ulwazi ngezinhlelo ongazisiza kule webhusayithi: www.csvr.org.za. Iminikelo: Unganikeza imali ezinhlelweni ezisebenzela ukuvimbela ukuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane ngokufaka imali kwiMali Yamalungelo Abantu. Akukhona okukhululekile okukhethiwe okumele kunikezwe - konke kuncike kuwe! Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, hlola le webhusayithi: www.fhr.org.za noma shayela le nombolo 012 440 1691. Khuluma ngokuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane: Khuthaza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo abathule ukuba bakhulume. Bika ukuhlukumeza izingane emaphoyiseni. Joyina ama-forum okuphepha komphakathi noma ama-forum okuphepha komphakathi: Umphakathi neziteshi zamaphoyisa zisebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nomphakathi. Ngokujoyina lezi zinsiza, ungasiza ekulweni nobugebengu endaweni yakho. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi lokuthi ungajoyina kanjani, xhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo yakho. Uma uhlukunyezwa nganoma iyiphi indlela noma uma wazi omunye umuntu ophoqelelwe, funa usizo - thola usizo.
Umculo: Isizinda, Uhlobo, Nezimpawu Zawo Umculo uyingxenye ebalulekile empilweni yabantu, udlulisela imizwa, ubuciko, nezinkumbulo. Ubonisa futhi ubumbene nezinkolelo, izinkolo, namasiko ahlukene. Ukuze siwuthole kahle umculo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izici zawo ezahlukene, izindlela zokwakha, kanye nemiphumela yawo empilweni yethu. Isizinda Somculo Umculo uqala emlandweni wethu, lapho abantu bokuqala besebenzisa izinsimbi ezilula ukuze bakhe imisindo. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakheka kwemikhakha eminingi yomculo. Izinsimbi zokuqala zazifana nezitho zomzimba, izinsimbi zokudlala, kanye nezinsimbi ezakhiwe ngamathe, izinkuni, noma amatshe. Umculo wendabuko, ophawulekayo ezindaweni eziningi, ubonisa izinkolelo namasiko abantu, futhi uhlanganisa izinkanyezi ezihlukene. Uhlobo Lwemculo Umculo ungahlukaniswa ngezinhlelo eziningi, okuhlanganisa umculo wendabuko, umculo wesimanje, umculo wejazz, umculo we-hip hop, kanye nomculo we-classical. Umculo wendabuko uvame ukuba nezimpawu ezithile ezihambisana namasiko athile, njengokusebenzisa izinsimbi ezithile noma izindlela zokucula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umculo wesimanje uvame ukuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene, futhi uvame ukufaka izinsimbi ezithuthukisiwe. Izimpawu Zomculo Izimpawu zomculo zifaka phakathi umoya, isivinini, umphumela, kanye nezinga. Umoya ubonisa umuzwa umculo owudlulisayo. Isivinini sisho ukuthi umculo ungashintsha phakathi kokushesha nokubambelela, okwenza kube nokuthakazelelwa. Umphumela ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungaba namazinga ahlukahlukene, kusukela kokuthule kakhulu kuya kokuphakeme. Izinga, noma i-pitch, libalulekile ekwakheni umculo, njengoba linika umculo ubuhle obuhlukahlukene. Umculo Nezinkumbulo Umculo unamandla okugcina izinkumbulo. Abantu bavame ukuhlela izinkumbulo zabo ngezikhathi ezithile, futhi umculo ungaba yindlela yokubuyisela lezi zinkumbulo. Ngokwesibonelo, umculo owawudlalwa emshadweni ungaba nezinkumbulo ezinhle, kanti umculo owawudlalwa ngesikhathi sokudabuka ungaba nezinkumbulo ezinzima. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umculo ungumkhiqizo wezimo zethu, futhi ungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Umculo Njengendlela Yokuxhumana Umculo ungumsebenzi wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abaculi baveza imizwa yabo, izinkolelo, nezifiso zabo ngomculo. Lokhu kuxhumana kungaba phakathi kwabaculi nabalaleli, noma phakathi kwabaculi abahlukene. Umculo ungaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba umculo ungaba yindlela yokugcina amasiko nezinkolelo zethu. Umculo Nezobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye buguqula indlela esikhiqiza ngayo umculo. Izinsimbi ezithuthukisiwe, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza zokurekhoda zishintshile indlela umculo okhiqizwa ngayo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokutholakala komculo, njengoba abantu bengakwazi ukufinyelela kumculo kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye bukhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwezindlela ezintsha zokucula, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezahlukene zomculo. Umculo Njengomsebenzi Umculo ungumsebenzi ophilayo, futhi abaculi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umculo omusha. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ubuciko, kanye nokuzinikela. Abaculi bahlala befuna izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana nabalaleli babo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bagcine umculo wabo uphila. Umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi abaculi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umculo ohlangabezana nezidingo zabantu. Isiphetho Umculo ungumhlaba ogcwele ubuciko, imizwa, nezinkumbulo. Uhlanga lwemizwa, ubuciko, kanye nezinkolelo zethu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda umculo, izimpawu zawo, nezindlela zokwakha. Umculo ungumkhiqizo wezinkolelo zethu, futhi ungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Ngakho, masiqhubeke nokuxhumana nomculo, siwuhloniphe, futhi siwuthokozise.

'Umuntu ogunyaziwe' uchaza umuntu ophilayo ogunyaziwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 66 yiKomishini noma inhlangano egunyaziwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 149, kuye ngokuthi kungenzeka yini ukuphatha indiza ngaphandle kwecebo lokundiza ngendlela ehambisana nale ndiza futhi ichaza umnikazi wendiza yokusetshenziswa komuntu siqu noma eyakhelwe yile ndoda ngokuhambisana nemigomo yeSigaba 24; 'umgibeli wendiza' uchaza indiza engasebenzi, ethuswa umoya futhi enezigubhu ezihambayo ezixhunywe ezinyaweni zayo; incwadi yokulawula yokugcinwa ichaza incwadi egcinwe ngumnikazi noma umphathi wendiza ngokuhambisana nezimo zalezi Ziqondiso ezamukelwe yiKomishini ngaphansi komgomo 43.02. 'Ukuhlolwa okuphindaphindiwe' kuchaza ukuhlolwa okwenziwe ngokwemigomo yomgomo 43.02. 'Izindiza ezilula' zichaza indiza enomkhawulo ngesivinini nesisindo sokuphuma. 'Izindiza zokuzijabulisa' zichaza indiza enesisindo esingaphansi kwama-850 kilograms, ethuswa ngogesi futhi enama-indikator okundiza asebenza ngaphandle kogesi uma kuvalwe; b Phakamisa umgomo ophakanyisiwe noma isitatimende somsebenzi, ushintsho noma ukususa ngendlela evunyelwe yikomidi kulandela imizamo yayo echazwe esigabeni 3 njengoba iphakamisa ukuhlela ngokwaziswa kwiGazethi uma kuhlobene nezilawuli noma ngokwaziswa kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA uma kuhlobene nezitatimende zomsebenzi. Ushintsho kumgomo 11.03. Ngakho-ke umgomo olandelayo ushintshiwe ngemuva komgomo 11.03. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe inqubo yokubonisana, iKomishini izokwakha iphothali yokubhalisela ulwazi ngemithetho esunguliwe kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA lapho abantu bengabhalisela futhi bakhansela mahhala futhi lapho bezokwazi ukwaziswa nge-imeyili ngale mthetho, ushintsho noma ukusula kwemithetho ephakanyisiwe noma udaba oluhlobene, kanye neziphakamiso ezihambisana nomgomo 11.03.2 (b) ngenhla. Noma yisiphi isitatimende somsebenzi esikhishwe sizoshicilelwa kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA ukuze sitholakale futhi singacelwa kwiCAA lapho sizotholakala khona ngephepha eliqinile noma ngendlela egcinwe ngetekhnoloji yekhompyutha, etholakala ngentengo ethile. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.06. b Ngaphandle kokugunyazwa yiKomishini, uzokwakha futhi agcine uhlelo lokuhlola imikhiqizo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ngemuva kosuku lapho incwadi yokugunyazwa ikhishwe ngenhloso yokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zimpahla zihambisana nohlobo olubhalisiwe nezimo zokusebenza eziphephile, umbiko kumele uthunyelwe kwiKomishini; futhi c Ngemuva kokuphothulwa kohlelo lokuhlola imikhiqizo echazwe esigabeni b ethunyelwe kwiKomishini, incwadi echaza uhlelo olunjalo nenqubo lapho izinqumo ezihambisana nomgomo 21.06.22 zathathwa. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.08. b Ngemuva kokusetshenziswa ngaphansi kweSigaba 137, kuncike ekudlulisweni komunye umsebenzi ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 43, noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma indiza iguqulwa ibe uhlobo oluvumela ukuhamba kwabantu ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 121, Sigaba 127, Sigaba 135 noma Sigaba 138, ngaphandle uma iKomishini ingatholi isizathu sokuphepha, esimweni ethile. Ukungondleki (Malnutrition) Umbuzo 1: Yini ukungondleki? Ukungondleki, noma i-malnutrition, kuchaza isimo lapho umzimba ungatholi ukudla okwanele noma okudingekayo ukuze usebenze ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukungadli kahle, ukuntuleka kokudla okunempilo, noma izimo zempilo ezithinta ukugaya. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokungondleki? Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zokungondleki: ukungondleki okungokwenani (undernutrition) nokungondleki okungokwakha (overnutrition). Ukungondleki okungokwenani kubonakala ngokulahlekelwa isisindo, ukuvuvukala, noma izinkinga zokukhula ezinganeni. Ngokuphambene, ukungondleki okungokwakha kubonakala ngokukhuluphala ngokweqile, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo ezifana nesifo sikashukela nezifo zenhliziyo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izimbangela zokungondleki? Izimbangela zokungondleki zingahluka. Ezinye zazo zifaka ukuntuleka kokudla okunempilo, izimo zomnotho, izifo ezithinta ukugaya, noma izinkinga zokuphila njengezokuhlupheka. Ezinye izindawo, ukuntuleka kokudla okwakhiwe kahle kungaba yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izimpawu zokungondleki? Izimpawu zokungondleki zihluke ngokuya ngohlobo. Kubantu abane-under-nutrition, izimpawu zingafaka ukuvuvukala, ukulahlekelwa isisindo, ukukhathala, noma ukungabi namandla. Kubantu abane-over-nutrition, izimpawu zingafaka ukukhuluphala ngokweqile, izinkinga zokuphefumula, noma izifo ezihlobene nezinga le-cholesterol eliphezulu. Umbuzo 5: Kungani kubalulekile ukwazi ngalesi simo? Ukungondleki kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, ezifana nezifo, ukungasebenzi kahle kwezitho zomzimba, noma ukufa. Ukuqonda ukungondleki kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokudla, siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukudla okunempilo, futhi sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela zokuvikela ukungondleki? Ukuze uvikele ukungondleki, kubalulekile ukuba nemikhuba yokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kufaka ukudla okunezithelo, imifino, amaprotheni, namafutha anempilo. Ukwazi ukuthi ungakuthola kuphi ukudla okunempilo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokudla ezitholakalayo, kubalulekile. Ukufundisa abantu ngezidingo zabo zokudla kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukungondleki. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele yenziwe uma umuntu ethola ukungondleki? Uma umuntu ethola ukungondleki, kubalulekile ukufuna usizo lwezokwelapha. Odokotela bangahlola isimo somuntu, benze izivivinyo, futhi banikeze izeluleko zokudla. Ukudla okunempilo, ukuhlinzeka ngama-supplements uma kudingeka, nokwenza izinguquko empilweni kungasiza ekubuyiseni impilo. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona zokulwa nokungondleki? Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi zokulwa nokungondleki. Izinhlelo zokudla ezitholakalayo, izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni ezindaweni eziphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lezi zinhlelo zisebenza ngokuhlanganyela ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ukudla okunempilo. Umbuzo 9: Yini umphakathi ongayenza ukuze unciphise ukungondleki? Umphakathi ungathatha izinyathelo eziningi ukuze unciphise ukungondleki. Lokhu kufaka ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokudla okunempilo, ukwakha izikhungo zokudla, nokuxhasa izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nohulumeni kungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini esiyifundayo ngalesi simo? Ukungondleki akuyona nje inkinga yomuntu ngamunye, kodwa iyinkinga yomphakathi. Ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izimbangela, izimpawu, nezindlela zokuvikela ukungondleki. Ngokuqhubeka nokufundisa, ukuxhasa, nokubambisana, singakwazi ukunciphisa le nkinga futhi sithuthukise impilo yabantu abaningi. Ukudla okunempilo akuyona nje into yokuphila, kodwa kuyisihluthulelo sempilo enhle.
Ngiyavuma, ingxoxo yethu ngalesi sihloko esithokozisayo sokuminyana ethekwini ibalulekile. Uminyano uhlanganisa abantu abaningi, izitolo eziningi, nezinkampani ezahlukene, okwenza kube yingxenye ebalulekile kwezohwebo. Ake siqale ngama-positives: uma abantu beqhamuka ethekwini bezama ukuthenga ezindaweni ezithile, izitolo ziba nomthamo omkhulu wokuthengisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungumthengisi, uthola ithuba elihle lokwandisa amathuba akho okuthengisa. Futhi, uma uhweba endaweni enabantu abaningi, uzothola amakhasimende amaningi. Ucabanga kanjani umthelela wezindawo eziminyanisiwe? Ngokwesibonelo, uma uhweba e-Durban CBD, izivakashi zihlala zikhangwe ukuhamba, okwandisa amathuba okuthi zibone izimpahla zakho. Ngabe ubona indlela abantu abahamba ngayo ethekwini? Kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukukhuluma ngama-businesses amakhulu. Izinkampani ezinkulu zikhona, futhi uma uhweba endaweni enabantu abaningi, ungase udinge ukuncintisana nazo. Lokhu kungaba nzima, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bazokwazi ukubona ukuthi ubani ophumelelayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngezinkinga ezihambisana nokuminyana. Imizamo yokuhweba eThekwini ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile, njengokukhula kokuhamba okungaholela ezinkingeni zokufinyelela ezitolo. Futhi uma izindawo zidalula ubude, kungase kube nezinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo, ukukhula komphakathi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezithinta impilo, okungase kubangele izinkinga kwezohwebo. Uma abantu bejolise kakhulu emnyangweni wezohwebo, kungenzeka kube nezinkinga zokuphila, ezibangela ukukhula kwezintela. Umnyango wezohwebo kumele uqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi iyavikeleka. Ucabanga ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaba muhle noma omubi? Kulolu hlobo lwengxoxo, izimpendulo zingahluka. Abanye bangase bakholelwe ukuthi umthelela omuhle uyavela, kanti abanye bangase baphakamise ukuthi umnyango wezohwebo uphumelelisile ekuphepheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi izinkampani eziminyanisiwe zingabhekelwa kanjani. Okokugcina, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu bahlala behamba, futhi umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini uzohlala uhlangene nezinto eziningi. Ngabe uthanda lezi zinkampani ezinkulu? Futhi, ungakwenza kanjani ukuze ujabulise abantu? Ngakho, umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini kwezohwebo ubonakala ngale ndlela. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani umnyango wezohwebo ungakha okuthile okukhangayo? Uma sikhuluma ngenzuzo, sizokwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngempilo, ngezindlela ezithakazelisayo. Ubuya kanjani? Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana uzoba ngcono noma kuzoba nezinkinga? Lokhu kuzokwenza kube mnandi ukuxoxa, futhi imiphumela izohlala ikhanya. Hamba kahle, futhi siqhubeke nokuxoxa ngale ndaba ethokozisayo!
Ukwamukela Imigomo Yenqubomgomo (GEMS Member Policy Acceptance) Ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kubalulekile abathintekayo. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile enikezela ngezinsizakalo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze ubambe iqhaza kule nhlangano, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu aqonde futhi avume imigomo nemibandela ethile. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuvikela amalungu, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okucacile, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu abathintekayo. Ekuqaleni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imigomo yenqubomgomo ibhalwe ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo. Le migomo ibonisa izimiso ezisemqoka, imikhawulo, kanye nezibopho ezihambisana nale nhlangano. Ngakho-ke, ukuvuma le migomo kusho ukuthi amalungu ayavuma ukulandela izinqubo nemithetho ebekwe yi-GEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo zisebenza kahle futhi ziqondile. Ngokwamukela le migomo, amalungu akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezahlukahlukene, ezifana nezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezinye izinsiza ezihlinzekwa yi-GEMS. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amalungu abhalise futhi avume izimo ezithile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, i-GEMS ihlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izindleko ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze amalungu akwazi ukukhetha kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujule, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayazi izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa lezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze amalungu akwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, eziphathelene nezempilo yabo. I-GEMS ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, futhi ukuvuma le migomo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibonile ukuthi ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubo ezilula nezicacile. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza ezikhethekile ezisiza amalungu ukuthi aqonde kahle le migomo. Izinsiza ezifana nezincwadi ezichazayo, amawebhusayithi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana zenzelwe ukusiza amalungu ukuthi aqonde kahle izinqubo ezithile, futhi aqonde izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuvuma le migomo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, futhi ukuvuma le migomo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu ayazi ngalezi zinsizakalo, i-GEMS ibeka phambili izinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuqeqesha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibandakanya amalungu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakalayo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ekugcineni, ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo ye-GEMS akukhona nje ukulandela imithetho, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu azithola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, futhi ahlale enolwazi oludingekayo ukuze akwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezempilo yabo. I-GEMS, ngokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, ibeka phambili impilo nempumelelo yamalungu ayo, ibavumela ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, enokuthula. Ngakho-ke, ukuvuma imigomo yenqubomgomo ye-GEMS akuyona nje isinyathelo esisemthethweni, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi onobudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu bayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bahlala bekwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezisemqoka, futhi bazi kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nokuphathwa kwezempilo. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayo ayakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, futhi ahlale enobudlelwano obuqinile nezinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo.
Ibhande Lesizwe liyisithombe esibonakalayo, esikhulu kunazo zonke ezinye izithombe ezisemhlabeni. Ibhande Lesizwe liyingxenye ebalulekile ye-emblem enkulu, evame ukubhekwa njengophawu oluphakeme kunezinye zonke ezweni. Ibhande elinophawu oluphakeme linikezwa amandla amakhulu ngoba libonisa ukuthi livunyelwe nguMongameli weNingizimu Afrika. Ibhande Lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika lanikelwa ezwenikazi ngosuku lweMphakathi, ngoMsombuluko 27, 2000. Lokhu kukhombisa umgomo lukamasipala wokugqamisa ushintsho lwezokhetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nothando olusha lwezwe lethu. Ibhande Lesizwe ingxenye yochungechunge lwezinto ezihlelwe ukuze zenze isimo se-oval esibekwe ngendlela yokuthi ingxenye eyodwa iphakama phezulu kwelinye. Isinqumo sokuqala siyi-motto eyingxenye ebalulekile ngaphakathi kwesigubhu esiluhlaza. Ibekwa ngendlela efanayo, enezinhlangothi ezimbili zezilwane ezibheke phezulu, ukuze igcwalise isigubhu. Emfanekisweni ongafani ne-egg eyakhiwe ngezinsingo zezilwane, kukhona izindlebe ezimbili ze-corn zakha umqhele wegolide ophakathi. Umfanekiso womqhele uhambisana nedrum futhi ubonisa abantu ababili abenziwe ngobuciko besikhumba bamele abantu baseKhoisan. Laba bantu baveza ubuso obubheke komunye nomunye, bejabulela ngokuhlanganyela. Phezulu komqhele, kukhona umkhonto nesihlangu ahlelwe ukuze akhe isiphambano. Lezi zinto zihlelwe ukuze zihambisane nomqhele ukuze kuqedwe umfanekiso wesisekelo esingaphansi esifana ne-egg. Inhlanzi enezinyawo ezinde ibekwe phezulu kwehlathi eliluhlaza, nezimbali zakha isifuba senhlanzi. Inhlanzi enezinyawo ezinde ibamba amaphiko ayo ngendlela yokuhlonipha. Izithombe ezibonakalayo zalenhlanzi zihloba ikhanda layo ngokuqinile njengokuthi iyinqaba. Ilanga eliphakamisayo phezulu kwesibhakabhaka libekwe phakathi kwamaphiko enhlanzi enezinyawo ezinde ukuze kuqedwe umfanekiso ofana ne-egg wokuphakama. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezithombe ezifana ne-egg phezulu naphansi kuhlanganisa ukudala indlela ende, engapheli, futhi ukuhlela kahle phakathi kwezinto kudala umklamo onamandla, omuhle ongafani nanoma iyiphi enye. Ngakho-ke, igcina ukuzinza, ubungcweti, namandla adingekayo ibhande lesizwe. Imoto - !ke e: /xarra //ke, ibhalwe ngolimi lwabantu baseKhoisan olubizwa nge-/Xam. Le motto ichaza: ubunye babantu abahlukene. Lokhu kuyizifiso zomuntu ngamunye zokuhlanganisa isenzo nemicabango kube munye. Kukhuthaza izwe ukuba lihlangane ukuze labelane ngokuqonda okujwayelekile kokuhlanganyela futhi lithokozise ngobuzwe bazo. - ubunye emiphakathini yethu ehlukahlukene. Uphawu lumele ukuvuthwa, ukukhula, nokuthuthukiswa okungenzeka, ukudla kwabantu, nezinye izinto ezihlobene nezolimo. Lumele ukuhlakanipha, amandla, ubumnene, nokuphila okungapheli. Inezinhloso ezimbili: ukukhombisa ubunikazi nokuvikela ngokomoya. Iphakamisa uphawu olukhulu lwezwe. Bobabili kumele baqinisekise ukuphepha namandla. Futhi kumele kube nezinyawo ezinamandla ezingafani nezinhlanzi. Umkhonto nesihlangu baphansi, okumele kukhombise ukuthula. Emaphuzwini - kukhumbuza ngokukhula nokushesha. Le yinhla enkulu enamandla ngezinyawo zayo - iboniswe nomkhonto nesihlangu - eyasiza kakhulu ekudlweni nasekuvikeleni. Iyi-messenger evela ezulwini futhi iletha ubumnene bayo phansi emhlabeni, ngakho ibonisa ubukhosi bezulu. Amaphiko ayo aphezulu amelela ukuphakama kwezwe lethu, elisinika ukuphepha. Uphawu lokuphakama nobukhazikhazi. Iphakamisa umfanekiso wesithembiso sokuzalwa kabusha, amandla okucabanga okujulile, ulwazi, ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, nokuzimisela okukhulu. Iphawu losuku lokuphila, ukukhanya, nokupheleliswa kobuntu bokwenyani. Isakhiwo esiphelele seBhande Lesizwe sihlanganisa izingxenye zaso eziphezulu nezisezansi zibe sesimweni se-oval esimele ukuphila okungapheli. Ukuhlanganiswa kombhalo ophansi, izinsingo zezilwane, kanye ne-horizon lapho ilanga liphakama kudala isimo esifana ne-egg esivela kulo izwe. Lo mfanekiso unencazelo ekhombisa ukuvuselelwa komoya kwezwe lethu elikhulu nelihle. Igama Batho Pele liyifreyimu yeSesotho elisho "Abantu kuqala," ekwenza kube ngumsebenzi wabasebenzi bakamasipala ukuba baphathe bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubaluleka nezimiso zeBatho Pele zisisekelo seBhande Lesizwe. Ngomhla ka-Okthoba 1, 1997, abasebenzi bakamasipala baqala umkhankaso weBatho Pele ogxile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo abazinikezayo emphakathini. Ukuze benze umsebenzi omuhle ngemali nezinsiza ezikhokhelwayo ukuze amakhasimende akwazi ukubona ukuthi imali yabo yokuthenga isetshenziswa kahle nangempumelelo. I-Batho Pele ihlobene nokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezisebenza kahle nezisebenzayo ezingabeki izidingo zabantu kuqala. Iphinde ihlobene nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imali zikamasipala zihambisana nezidingo zabantu nokuthi yini edingekayo ngokushesha. Iningi lokuthuthukiswa okufuna abantu aludingi imali ukuze lukhona, njengokuhlonipha abantu, ukuba neqiniso lapho uhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokuxolisa uma kwenziwa amaphutha. Lezi zinto azidingi imali - zidinga ukuguqula indlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zabantu kuhilela ukuhlela kabusha indlela ophatha ngayo abantu. Ukufeza uhlelo lweBatho Pele akusikho umsebenzi owodwa ophelayo, kodwa uhlelo oluqhubekayo, olunamandla oluzoqhubeka iminyaka eminingi, luthola umkhankaso njalo.
Isingeniso UNapoleon Bonaparte ungomunye wabaholi bezenkolo nabapolitiki abavelele emlandweni, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emazweni aseYurophu ngemuva kokuphumelela esikhathini seMpi Yenkululeko yaseFransi. Ubonisa ubuholi obuqinile, ubuchule bokuhlela, kanye nezimfundiso ezithinta umphakathi, ezakha isithombe esiqinile esihambisana nepolitikhi yaleso sikhathi. Le ndatshana izogxila emlandweni kaNapoleon, izifundo azifundile, kanye nomthelela wakhe emhlabeni. Ubuntwana Nokuqalwa Kwezemfundo UNapoleon Bonaparte wazalwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuMfumfu we-1769 eAjaccio, edolobheni eliseCorsica. Wakhulela emndenini ophakathi, futhi ubugagu bepolitiki bempucuko yamaFrentshi bamnikeza ithuba lokuhlola izifundo eziphakeme. U-Napoleon waba umfundi ophumelelayo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobudlova, lapho afunda khona izifundo ezinamandla zamasu nezombusazwe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wayesebenza njengomphakathi wezokuhlola emphakathini, okwakugqugquzela imicabango yakhe ngamasu okuphatha. Ukukhula Njengomholi Ngonyaka we-1785, uNapoleon waba yisikhulu esisemthethweni sezempi, lapho aqala khona khona ukuveza amakhono akhe okukhuluma, ahlaziye, futhi abhekelele izimo ezinzima. Ngaphambi kokuba abe umholi, uNapoleon wajabulela ukuphumelela emikhankasweni eyahlukene yezezimpi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yenkululeko yaseFransi. Kwakungaleso sikhathi lapho abe nesibopho sokubambisana nemibono yezenhlalo, kahle kakhulu emikhankasweni yokukhululwa nokuvuselela izwe. Ukwakha Umbuso Ngemuva kokuphumelela kweMpi Yenkululeko, uNapoleon waba yinjini yokushintsha kwezokuphatha eFransi. Ngo-1799, waguqula uhulumeni ngokuthi abe nguKhalipha, waphinde wethula uMthethosisomthetho kaNapoleon, owawuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngemithetho eqinile nebalulekile. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuphatha lwaluhlanganisa izimfundiso zamaNgisi, izichasiso zamasiko, kanye nezimiso zokuphathwa kwezenhlalakahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nesimo esisha sempucuko kanye nekhono lokuphathwa komphakathi. Impumelelo Nokuphumelela U-Napoleon wayaziwa njengehlakaniphile, futhi ukulawula kwakhe kwahlala kukhuthaza abanye abaholi bezenkolo nabapolitiki. Phakathi neminyaka yakhe yokuphatha, wayewuthuthukisa umnotho, ewina imikhankaso eminingi, futhi eba nomthelela omkhulu kwiGeopolitics. Uthola ukuhamba phambili kwiMpi yeNapoleonic, lapho wayehola khona amabutho amaningi, okwakuholela ekudlondlobeni kwezifundazwe eziningi. Isimo sakhe sokuphatha sathola ukunconywa ezindaweni eziningi, kepha kwazalwa nezinselelo ezithile. Ukwahlukaniswa Nokuphela Nokho, impumelelo kaNapoleon ayizange iphelelwe isikhathi. Ngemva kokuhluleka emkhankasweni wakhe eRussia ngo-1812, izinkinga zokuqala zempilo zenzeka. Ngemuva kwezimpi eziningi, wathola ukuhluleka eWaterloo ngo-1815, lapho kwaholela ekuthumeleni kwakhe eSt. Helena, isiqhingi esisemhlabeni ngaphansi kwelwandle. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokucabanga nokuhlanza, lapho uNapoleon wakhumbula ukuhluleka kwempilo yakhe, kodwa wakhombisa isithunzi esikhulu. Isiphetho UNapoleon Bonaparte ungumuntu omkhulu emlandweni, ongase asibonise izifundo eziningi kumphakathi waseYurophu nasemhlabeni jikelele. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuphatha, izinqumo azithathile, nezifundo azitholile, zenza kube sobala ukuthi ubuholi bezepolitiki buxhomeke emkhankasweni wokuzethemba, ubuchule, kanye nezifundo eziphuma ezimweni ezinzima. U-Napoleon ungumfanekiso ohlangene wezinto ezinhle nezimbi ekuphatheni, futhi umthelela wakhe kuzo zonke izinkanyezi zomhlaba uqhubeka nokuhlola izinkolelo zomphakathi nomlando.
Ezokwakhiwa Kwezindlu - Ingxoxo Nomhlinzeki Wezindlu Isingeniso Namuhla, sikhuluma noMnu. Sipho Mthethwa, ongumhlinzeki wezindlu odumile eNingizimu Afrika. U-Sipho unolwazi olunzulu kwezokwakhiwa kwezindlu, futhi uzokhuluma nathi ngalezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokuba lapha. Umbuzo 1: Uthini umbono wakho ngentuthuko yezokwakhiwa kwezindlu eNingizimu Afrika? UMnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Intuthuko yezokwakhiwa kwezindlu eNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile kakhulu. Njengoba abantu abaningi befuna izindawo zokuhlala, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izindlu ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izindlu ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezithengekayo, futhi ezihambisana nemvelo. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo obhekana nazo emkhakheni wezokwakhiwa kwezindlu? UMnu.
