Mthethwa: Kunezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, sinesidingo sokwakha izindlu eziningi, kodwa izinsiza zethu zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngaleso sikhathi. Okwesibili, izindleko zokwakha ziya zanda, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu ezithengekayo. Futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindawo eziningi zidinga ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezifana namanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zikamasipala ziwusizo kanjani ekwakhiweni kwezindlu? UMnu. Mthethwa: Yebo, izinhlelo zikamasipala zibalulekile. Zisiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezithile ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwakha, izinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uma umphakathi uthola ukwesekwa okuhle, izinhlelo zokwakha ziba lula. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenza izindlu zakho zihluke kwabanye? UMnu. Mthethwa: Sihlala sigxila ekwakheni izindlu ezihambisana nezidingo zethu zomphakathi. Sisebenzisa izinto eziphilayo nezihlala isikhathi eside, futhi sikhuthaza izindlela zokwakha ezivumelana nemvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sithanda ukufaka izici ezithokozisayo, ezifana nezindawo zokudlala neziphuzo, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi. Umbuzo 5: Ucabanga ukuthi izakhamuzi zingabamba kanjani iqhaza ekwakhiweni kwezindlu? UMnu. Mthethwa: Kubalulekile ukuthi izakhamuzi zibe neqhaza elikhulu. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemibono, ukusiza ekwakheni izinhlelo, nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Uma izakhamuzi zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezindlu ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela ezithuthukisiwe ozisebenzisayo ekwakhiweni kwezindlu? UMnu. Mthethwa: Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokwakha ezisebenzisa i-3D printing, kanye nezindlela zokwakha eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kusiza ekunciphiseni izindleko, futhi kusebenza kahle ekwakheni izindlu ezisheshayo. Futhi, sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokulima ezincane ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngokudla emiphakathini yethu. Umbuzo 7: Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lezokwakhiwa kwezindlu lizinzile? UMnu. Mthethwa: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ikusasa lezokwakhiwa kwezindlu lizinzile uma sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele. Kudingeka ukuthi sikhuthaze izindlela ezihlakaniphile zokwakha, futhi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi olujulile ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ukukhuluma nawe kuveza ukuthi ezokwakhiwa kwezindlu akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngiyabonga futhi, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle emkhakheni wezokwakhiwa kwezindlu eNingizimu Afrika.
AmaSotho: Isiko, Ubudlelwano, Nezindlela Zokuphila Isingeniso AmaSotho, abahlala ezindaweni ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, eLesotho, naseBotswana, banomlando ocebile kanye nezindlela zempilo ezihlukahlukene. Lesi sihloko sizogxila emlandweni wamaSotho, izimiso zabo, nemikhuba yabo yansuku zonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda ubudlelwano babo nemvelo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihambisana nezinkolelo zabo. Umlando WamaSotho Ukuze siqonde amaSotho, kubalulekile ukuqala ngomlando wabo. AmaSotho aqala ukuvela phakathi nekhulu le-18, lapho uMoshoeshoe I, umholi wabo, ehola abantu bakhe emhlabeni onzima. UMoshoeshoe wahlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene ukuze akhe ubumbano, okwakuholela ekwakhiweni kwezwe laseLesotho. Lokhu kudalwa kwezizwe kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni wamaSotho, njengoba kwavula indlela yokwakha isiko eliqinile nelihloniphekile. Isiko Nezinkolelo ZamaSotho Isiko lamaSotho lihlala ligxile ezinkolelweni zawo. Abantu bamaSotho banokholo oluqinile, futhi izinkolelo zabo zikhombisa indlela abaphila ngayo. Izenzo zabo zansuku zonke zikhombisa ukuhlonipha izinyanya, okukhombisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezedlule zibalulekile empilweni yabo. Izinkolelo zikaMoya, umoya ophilayo, zikhona emikhubeni yabo, njengokukhuleka, imikhosi, nemicimbi yokugubha impilo. Imikhuba Yansuku zonke Ubudlelwano bamaSotho nemvelo bukhombisa ukuthi bahlala bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Abantu bamaSotho bahlala benobudlelwano obuqinile nomndeni, futhi imisebenzi yabo ibonisa lokhu. Njengoba behlala emakhaya, imisebenzi yokulima ibalulekile. Abesifazane baphinde babambe iqhaza elikhulu ekulimaleni, kanti abesilisa bahlala beqondisa izinsiza. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane bamaSotho buhle kakhulu, futhi bonke bayawuhlonipha umkhiqizo wabo. Izinkanyezi Nezinkanyezi Zokuphila AmaSotho akha izinkanyezi ezithile ezihlobene nezinsuku zabo. Izinkanyezi zikhombisa izikhathi zokulima, izikhathi zokuvuna, kanye nezikhathi zokwakha. Lokhu kusiza abantu bamaSotho ukuba bahlale beqaphela izinguquko zemvelo, futhi baqonde kahle isikhathi sokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkanyezi zikhombisa izikhathi ezithile zokukhumbula izinyanya, okukhombisa ukuthi umqondo wokuhlonipha ubalulekile. Ukuxhumana Nezokuxhumana Ubudlelwano bamaSotho nabanye abantu buphinde bukhombise izindlela zokuxhumana ezihlukahlukene. Ubugebengu, imihlangano, nemicimbi yokugubha zenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi kwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi. AmaSotho aphinde abambe iqhaza emicimbini yokubungaza izinkanyezi, okukhombisa ukuthi ubuhlobo phakathi kwezizwe bukhula. Izifundo Zokuphila Kukhona izifundo eziningi ezingatholwa emiphakathini yamaSotho. Ukubambisana, ukuhlonipha, nokusebenza kanzima yizimiso ezibalulekile. Lokhu kusiza abantu bamaSotho ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bahlale beqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano bukhulu kakhulu. Ukufunda nokwabelana ngolwazi kubalulekile, futhi abantu bamaSotho bahlala bephokophelela ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabo. Isiphetho AmaSotho, njengabantu abanomlando ocebile, bahlala bephila ngokuhlanganyela, bejolisa emigomeni yokuhlonipha, ubudlelwano, nezinkolelo. Ubudlelwano babo nemvelo, izinkanyezi, nezokuxhumana kubalulekile ekwakheni impilo yabo. Ngokuhlonipha izinyanya, ukusebenza ndawonye, nokwabelana ngolwazi, amaSotho akha isiko eliqinile nelihloniphekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqhubeke sifunda nokuhlonipha lesi siko esicebile.
Ezolimi - Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha Ubulili Nezizwe Umcimbi wokuhlonipha ezolimi uhlelelwe ukuba ube yisikhumbuzo sokuhlobana kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zolimi, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona imicabango yabo ngezici ezihlukene zomhlaba wezilimi. Kulonyaka, umcimbi uzobanjelwa edolobheni elikhulu, lapho izilimi ezahlukene zingavinjezelwa, zikhulunywa, futhi zibe yinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Uhlelo lwezinkulumo, imidlalo, nezifundo ezinjalo luzosiza ukudala indawo yokuthula nokwabelana ngolwazi. Umcimbi uzovula ngempumelelo, lapho abaphathi bephakamisa izwi labo, bebonisa ukubaluleka kokukhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Izizwe ezahlukahlukene zizobamba iqhaza, zonke zikhombisa ubuqotho bazo ngezindlela zabo zokukhuluma. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahloniphe futhi bakhumbule izilimi ezingama-asethi ezingashintshi, ezihambisana namasiko nez traditions zabo. Uhlanga lwezizwe luhlobene nezinhlobonhlobo zamasiko, ngakho umcimbi uzobonisa ubuhle balesi simo. Izinkulumo ezilungiselelwe zizogcizelela ukuhweba kwezinkulumo, kusukela ezilimini zendabuko, ezijwayelekile, kuya ezilimini ezisemthethweni. Abazocula, ababhali, nabahlabeleli bazoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa umcimbi, bephakamisa izwi labantu abakhuluma izilimi ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza umoya wokubambisana, ukuxhumana, kanye nezifundo ezikhaliphile, lapho abantu bezobambisana ukuze baphakamise izilimi zabo. Izifundo ezizobanjwa phakathi nomcimbi zizobe zifaka izifundo eziphathelene nezilimi, lapho abantu bazokwazi ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzobavumela ukuba bahloniphe izilimi zomunye nomunye, futhi bakwazi ukudala izixhumanisi ezintsha. Abafundi bazoba nethuba lokuhlanganyela, bephumelela ekutheni baziqhenye ngamasiko abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzoba nezinhlobonhlobo zemidlalo ethokozisayo, efaka izivakashi ezahlukene ekuthandeni izilimi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bahlanganyele, baphile ngothando lwezilimi. Imidlalo izoba yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, kuhlanganisa nemidlalo yokukhuluma, lapho abantu bezoba nemizwelo emihle, bezama ukufunda izilimi ezintsha. Umcimbi uzovalwa ngeseshwa enkulu, lapho abantu bephakanyiswa nezinkumbulo ezinhle. Uhlelo lokugcina luzoba nendawo yokwabelana ngezinto ezintsha, lapho abantu bezokwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango yabo ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwezizukulwane, kuxhumane izilimi ezahlukahlukene. Umcimbi wokuhlonipha ezolimi uzokwandisa ulwazi, uthuthukise ubudlelwano, futhi ubonise ukubaluleka kokukhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukujabulisa abantu, sibavumele ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bejabulisa abanye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda, ukuthula, nokusebenza ndawonye emhlabeni onobuciko obuhlukahlukene bezehlakalo ezihlukahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wokuhlonipha ezolimi uyoba yisibonelo esihle sokubambisana, ukuhweba, nokuhlonipha izilimi ezahlukene. Izilimi zikhona ukuze zixhumane, ziqhube ubudlelwano, futhi zikhulume ngezinto ezibalulekile empilweni. Umcimbi uzoba yindlela yokukhombisa ukuthi izilimi zethu zibalulekile, futhi kufanele zihlale zikhulunywa. Ngokuhlanganisa abantu, izilimi ezahlukene, nezilimi zomdabu, umcimbi uzobonisa ubuhle bokubambisana nokuhlonipha, kube yinsika yokuxhumana ezweni lethu. Qhubekani nokuqhubekisela phambili umcimbi, futhi niqinisekise ukuthi izilimi zethu zivuma futhi zikhula.
Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela imithetho ephathelene nokubhekelela nokubhekelela izikhungo zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali, ukuhlela nokubhekelela abaphathi bezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali, ukugcina nokuphatha izinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali, nokuvimbela imikhuba yokuhweba ngaphakathi kwenkampani; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwedepartment ye-clearing house nokukhokha izimali zokuhweba nokwamukela abantu abanikeziwe; ukuhlinzeka ngenkambiso yokuziphatha kwabantu abavunyelwe nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalezi zenzakalo. Umphenyi-akhawunti uchaza umphenyi-akhawunti emkhakheni weMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi ka-1991 njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wokubhanga ka-1990 (Umthetho No. 94 ka-1990), kanye nebhange elingabi nalungelo lokwabelana ngenzuzo phakathi kwamalungu alo njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wokubhanga ongabi nalungelo lokwabelana ngenzuzo ekupheleni konyaka ka-1993 (Umthetho No. Ibhodi lichaza iMboni Yezinsizakalo Zezimali eyasungulwa ngengxenye 2 yoMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zezimali ka-1990. Imithetho ichaza imithetho eyenziwe ngumnikazi wezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali ngokulandela lo Mthetho. Umbiko ophumelelwe ngubani uhambisana nohlobo olusunguliwe, olurekhodiwe, oluthunyelwe, noma olugcinwe ngombhalo noma ngendlela engabonakali kodwa ebukekayo. Noma iyiphi inhlangano yephenshiyali ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinhlelo Zepenshiyali ka-1956 Umthetho No. noma noma iyiphi inhlangano yokubambisana ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezizinda Zokubambisana ka-1956 Umthetho No. noma noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlelo zokutshalwa kwezimali ezichazwe engxenyeni 1 yoMthetho Wokulawulwa Kwezinhlelo Zokutshalwa Kwezimali ka-2000 Umthetho No. noma noma ubani obhaliswe njengomthengisi we-inshurensi yesikhathi eside noma yesikhathi esifushane ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Eside ka-1998 Umthetho No. 52 ka-1998, noma uMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Esifushane ka-1998 Umthetho No. noma ubani ophakathi kokwenza imisebenzi echazwe engxenyeni 721d yoMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Eside ka-1998, noma engxenyeni 70e yoMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Esifushane ka-1998; kanye nebhange. Ama-shares, ubufakazi bokugcina imali enkampanini ebhaliswe ezimakethe zezimali nezinye izinhlobo zokuhweba ngemali ezimakethe zezimali ngaphandle kwehlobo otshala imali enkampanini ethengisa ama-shares ngama-bonds njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Olawulayo Wokuthengisa KweShares Ngama-Bonds ka-1980 Umthetho No. imali yokuhweba ichaza isivumelwano noma umcimbi wokuthenga nokuthengisa izinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa nokukhula kwemisebenzi yokuhweba ngezinsiza zezimali emakethe yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ezenzakalweni ezilawulwa noma ngaphansi koMthetho Wezokweluleka Nokuqondisa Izinsizakalo ka-2002 Umthetho No. Noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokugembula noma ukubheja awusebenzi ezimweni ezilawulwa noma ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu enegunya lokusebenza, emelela izinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali ngaphandle kokuthi lowo muntu ahambisane nemithetho yesikhungo elawula ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Abanalo ilungelo lokuba yisikhungo, njengomnikazi wezinsiza zokuhweba, umnyango wokukhokha izimali zokuhweba, ukubamba iqhaza noma ukuba neziqu zokwenza le msebenzi ngokuvumelana nesimo esivela, noma ukuziphatha ngendlela, sebenzisa igama noma incazelo ekhombisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo nesikhungo, njengomnikazi wezinsiza zokuhweba emakethe, umnyango wokukhokha izimali, ukubamba iqhaza noma ukuvunyelwa ukuba basebenze, ngokuhambisana nesimo njengoba sivelayo. Umthetho Wezokweluleka Kwezimali ka-1990 ngababhalisile nabaPhakanyiswa Bezimali Zezimakethe Zokuhweba Ngemali ngezinga labo. Igunya lokulawula kufanele lenze imisebenzi enikezwe igunya lokulawula noma liqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho uyahambisana. Bangafaka izimo ezihlobene nalolu Mthetho mayelana nevunyelwa, igunya, ukwamukela, noma amalungelo akhishwe ngogunyaziwe lokulawula, futhi lezo zimo zingakhanselwa noma zishintshwe. Ibhodi Lezokweluleka Kwezimali ezasungulwa ngengxenye 3 yoMthetho Wokuhweba Kwezimali ka-1989 (Umthetho No. 55 ka-1989) isasebenza nakuba lo Mthetho ukhubazekile ngengxenye 117. Abanye amalungu, kuhlanganise nezithunywa zomkhakha, amakhasimende anikezwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuxoxisana neBhodi. Igunya lokulawula liyilungu lebhodi yokweluleka ngenxa yomsebenzi walo kodwa alikwazi ukuvota ezindabeni lapho kudingeka khona ukuhlinzekwa ngeluleko lebhodi yokweluleka. Ilungu lebhodi yokweluleka lihlala emsebenzini isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngesikhathi sokunikezwa kwalo. Izindleko zemali ezisetshenziswa ilungu ekwenzeni imisebenzi enikezwe lona. Umholi weBhodi Yokweluleka kufanele abize umhlangano wokuqala weBhodi Yokweluleka ngemuva kokuqala kwalolu Mthetho, kulandela, ibhodi yokweluleka izohlangana ngesikhathi nendawo eyinqunywe yibhodi yokweluleka. Umholi ubiza umhlangano olandelayo ngemuva kwalowo odlule lapho inani elidingekayo lamalungu ebhodi lingaphumelelanga ukuhlangana. Inani elidingekayo lamalungu ukuze umhlangano uqhubeke kuzoba inani lamalungu ebhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi yokweluleka ingathatha isinyathelo noma iceliwe nguNgqongqoshe noma igunya lokulawula ukuze ihlole futhi ilethe umbiko noma eluleko ezindabeni zokuphathwa noma ubuchwepheshe ngabantu abasebenza embonini noma mayelana nokwethulwa kwezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Singacela usizo kunoma ubani noma sihlole izindaba eziphathelene nabantu abasebenza kule mboni noma imisebenzi yokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Igunya lokulawula lingahlinzeka ebhodini nganoma yiluphi ulwazi oluhambelana nendaba ehlolelwayo yibhodi yokweluleka. Igunya lokulawula linomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha umsebenzi ohlobene kakhulu nemisebenzi yebhodi yokweluleka kanye nekomidi elincane lebhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi kufanele ikhokhe izindleko ezihlobene nemisebenzi yebhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi yokweluleka kufanele ithole ukuvunywa kwebhodi ngaphambi kokuchitha lezo zindleko. Imithetho yeKomidi Yocwaningo ka-1947 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1947) ephathelene nokusungulwa kwekomidi, ukuhlolwa kwabantu, nokwenza imisebenzi yokuthatha izifungo, ukukhipha imibhalo, amarekhodi, nezinto ezithile nokwephulwa komthetho okwenziwa ngabafakazeli abahlanganyela nezinguquko ezidingekayo ocwaningweni olwenziwe yibhodi yokweluleka
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Komsebenzi Emakhaya aseGauteng, phakathi kwezinsuku ezimvula ezilungiselela uhlobo lwezokuphiliswa, kwavela indaba ethokozisayo mayelana nomculo. UKabza De Small, umculi owaziwa kakhulu, uqale ukuthola impumelelo emculweni wakhe. Igama lakhe langempela linguKabelo Motha, futhi wayefuna ukukhulisa umculo we-Amapiano, okusebenzisa izakhi zomculo we-house nezomdabu. Uthando lwakhe lomculo lwaqala ngesikhathi esencane, lapho ehlangabezana nomculo we-kwaito. Lokhu kuthandwa kwakhe kwakhula ngokushesha, njengoba yena nomngane wakhe uDj Maphorisa baqala ukudala izingoma ezidumile ezithokozisa abantu emaphakathini. Isahluko 2: Ukuhamba Kwezinyathelo Njengoba uKabza eqhubeka nomsebenzi wakhe, wabhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ekuqaleni, umculo wakhe wawubhekwa njengokwehlukile, kanti abathandi bomculo babenelisekile ngalesi siqhamo esisha. Umehluko emculweni kaKabza wawukhombisa uthando lwakhe lokukhiqiza. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, lezi zinyathelo zaguquka zaba yizinkanyezi zempumelelo. UKabza wayezimisele ukwenza umehluko, futhi umculo wakhe wakhula waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wonke. Izingoma zakhe zazithandwa kumaphathi, zishaywa kwi-radio, futhi ziheha abantu abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomphakathi. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlonishwa Njengoba umculo kaKabza uqhubeka nokwenza kahle, wathola izinkanyezi eziningi, futhi yonke imisebenzi yakhe ibhakedwe ngothando. Kodwa akagcinanga lapho; uKabza waqhubeka nokwakha izimpendulo zokuphupha zakhe, wacela abanye abaculi ukuba bamxhase ngezigqi zabo. Lokhu kwenza umculo wakhe uhluke, uhlale ubukhoma. U-Kabza waqhubeka nokufuna ukuhlonishwa, njengoba ebona umculo njengomsebenzi ongenamkhawulo. Njengoba edumile phakathi kwabantu abasha nabazali babo, wathokozisa abantu ngezenzo zakhe ezinhle, ezikhanga izithakazelo zabantu. Isahluko 4: Imiphumela Yokubambisana U-Kabza De Small wayengumgibeli ophumelelayo, ethanda izinkanyezi, i-harmonies, nomoya wokubambisana. Waqoqa imizamo yakhe nomngane wakhe uDj Maphorisa, futhi ngokubambisana kwabo, baqonda kahle izidingo zomphakathi wemculo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izingoma ezinhle, ezizwakala kahle. Umphakathi wawujabule, izigcawu zazigubha izinsuku ezimnandi. Lezi zicabha zomculo zafika eminyakeni edlule, zenza ubukhazikhazi emcimbini we-2023, lapho uKabza ethola umklomelo omkhulu wokuhlonishwa kumculi ovela. Ukuphumelela kwakhe kube nemiphumela emihle, kungenza izinkanyezi zempilo yakhe zikhanye. Isahluko 5: Isiphetho Ukuqonda uKabza De Small njengenhlekelele yomculo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo ungathi uthando. U-Kabza ungumqondisi wezinkanyezi, ehamba phambili, efaka umoya. Umsebenzi wakhe awuqondi kude; zonke izikhumbuzo zikhumbula umoya oncomekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uKabza De Small usakaze umculo wakhe emhlabeni jikelele, waba yindoda edumile, efakaza ukuthi uthando nemisebenzi kahle kungaholela ekukhanyeni kokufinyelela. Noma kuphumelele ngezithiyo, uKabza ubonisa ukuthi ukuphikelela, ukuthanda, nokubambisana kuyindlela yokufeza amaphupho. Indaba kaKabza ifundisa, isikhumbuzo somuzwa okhuluma ngothando, imizamo, kanye nohlanga lokuthandana. UKabza uqhubeka nokwenzela abantu injabulo ngombukiso wakhe, futhi uthando lomculo, nomoya wakhe wothando, kuqhubeka ukuthokozisa.
Awukwazi ukuvuka ekuseni uthi, 'Namuhla ngifuna ukuqala ukutshala ukudla.' Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngokwezimali kudinga ucwaningo oluningi ngaphambi kokwenza lokho. Yisiphi isivuno ofuna ukusitshala kulonyaka? Kunamanye amaphuzu okudingeka ucabangele ngaphambi kokuphendula lo mbuzo. Isikhathi esifanele singafika. Inani lemvula elingatholakala. Izinga le-pH kanye nokunamathisela komhlabathi. Ukutholakala kwemali yokuqala yokukhiqiza. Uzothola kuphi le mali? Ukukhiqiza ukudla sekubize kakhulu, izindleko zokutshala izinkambu ezithola imvula kuphela seziye zafinyelela ku-R 5,000 ngehektari. Uzoya kuphi ukufaka isicelo sesikweletu? Umalini uzothola izintshisakalo kulolo mali? Ubulula bokukhokha isikweletu bujwayelekile? Uma uthola isikweletu, ingabe umkhiqizo wakho uzokwanela ukukhokha leso sikweletu? Unazo yini izimpahla zokubolekwa? Khumbula ukuthi lokhu kuyibhizinisi labantu abahlinzeka ngezinsiza; bafuna ukwenza inzuzo. Benza inzuzo ezintshisakalini zalolo mali. Akekho ofuna ukuphuthelwa imali, ngakho umbolekisi ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola imali yabo. Uzothola nini le mali? Lokhu kungase kubonakale njengento encane, kodwa khumbula ukuthi lapho utshala, izinkambu zidinga ukulungiswa isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokutshala. Uma imali ifika sekwedlule isikhathi, izinkambu azikwazi ukulungiswa kahle futhi umnini wezolimo angase abhekane nezingozi ekulimaleni? Uzokwenza kanjani ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wakho? Uma uthengisa ukudla kuphela kuwe, ukuthengisa akusona isihloko. Kodwa uma uqala ukutshala ukudla okuzothengiswa, kudingeka ucabangele ukuthengisa. Ubani ozothenga ukudla kwakho? Uzakwenzani ukudla ukuze kufike emakethe? Ubani ozohambisa ukudla? Ubani ozobhekana nezokuthutha? Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kufanele kwenzeke ngesikhathi esifanele. Yini le msebenzi wezolimo ehlose ukuyifeza? Uzokwenza nini umsebenzi wezolimo? Yiziphi imishini ozoyisebenzisa? Uzolima kangakanani? Ingabe ithrekhtha yakho inamandla? Ingabe imishini yakho iyasebenza futhi iyakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi? Yini le msebenzi wezolimo ehlose ukuyifeza? Uzokwenza nini umsebenzi wezolimo? Yiziphi imishini ozoyisebenzisa? Ingabe imishini yakho iyasebenza futhi iyakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi? Uzothenga kuphi imbewu yakho? Ubani ozokweluleka mayelana nokuthenga imbewu efanele? Ucabangele isikhathi esithathayo ukuze isivuno esithile sikhule kuze kube sitholakala? Zingaki izitshalo ezitshaliwe ngehektari? Uthathe amasampuli omhlabathi? Uthole imiphumela yokuhlolwa komhlabathi? Uthole iziphakamiso mayelana ne-fertilizer efanele ye-akhawunti ethile nesivuno? Ingabe isiphakamiso se-fertilizer sithinta usayizi womkhiqizo ofuna ukuwuvuna? Yisiphi uhlobo lwe-fertilizer ozoyisebenzisa? Zingaki amakhilogremu ozowafaka ngehektari? Inqubo yokutshala ibaluleke kakhulu kunazo zonke lapho ulima. Isitshalo singalinganiswa ukuze sisebenze kahle. Unazo yini amaphepha afanele, imishini, nezinsiza zokuphalaza? Yisiphi ububanzi bezigaba ozikhethayo? Kungani ukhethe lelo bubanzi? Uma uzolima ngemva kokukhula kwezitshalo, uyazi yini ukuthi umkhululi wakho angasebenza kulolo bubanzi? Zingaki izitshalo ozidingayo? Uqonda kangakanani ukuthi ungafaka malini i-fertilizer? Ungalinganisa isitshalo noma udinga usizo? Uqonda kanjani ukuphatha izitshalo eziphikisanayo ezitsheni zakho? Ingabe umkhululi ufanele ububanzi bezigaba? Ingabe ama-tines omkhululi alinganisiwe kahle? Unayo yini imishini yokuphalaza? Ingabe zonke izingxenye zemishini zisasebenza kahle? Ubani ozokwenza ukulinganisa imishini yokuphalaza? Yiziphi amakhemikhali ozowasebenzisa? Uyiqonda kangakanani inani lekhomikhali ethile ezofakwa? Ngesikhathi sika ukukhula kwesitshalo kufanele ufake amakhemikhali? Ingabe umhlabathi unomswakama owanele ukuze imbewu ikhulule? Uzofaka imbewu kangakanani? Ucabangele inani elifanele lemibewu ngomitha? Ufaka i-fertilizer ngamakhilogremu afanele ngehektari? Ufakile amakhemikhali abulala izilokazane nezitshalo eziphikisanayo? Ngemva kokuphothula ukutshala, ingabe isitshalo sihlanzekile futhi sifakwe kahle? Ngemva kokuphalaza ikhemikhali, ingabe imishini ihlanzekile futhi ifakwe kahle? Yisiphi uhlobo lwe-fertilizer yokuphezulu ezofakwa? Nini kufanele ifakwe? Umalini uzofaka? Uma ufuna ukuba umnini wezolimo ophumelelayo, kufanele usebenze ngokuzikhandla nangokuhlakanipha! Udinga ukuthuthukisa amasu njalo futhi wenze lowo msebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele.
Izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS hospital notification protocol? Impendulo: I-GEMS hospital notification protocol iyinqubo ethile yokwazisa izibhedlela uma umtholampilo uthola ukuthi umtholampilo udinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqubo zilandela imithetho ethile yokuphatha. Umbuzo 2: Kungani kubalulekile ukwazisa ngesibhedlela ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48? Impendulo: Ukwazisa ngesibhedlela ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48 kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Lokhu kusiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo ezingase zivele uma ukwelashwa kunganikiwe ngesikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zesibhedlela zisetshenziswa kahle, futhi iziguli zihlala ziphila kahle. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kwaziswe ngesibhedlela? Impendulo: Ukuze kwaziswe ngesibhedlela, umtholampilo kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uthumele imininingwane ethile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi igama lesiguli, imininingwane yokuxhumana, isimo sempilo, kanye nezizathu zokwelashwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi le mininingwane ithunyelwe ngesikhathi ukuze iziguli zingalibali ukwelashwa. Umbuzo 4: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma umtholampilo engakwazi ukwazisa ngesibhedlela? Impendulo: Uma umtholampilo engakwazi ukwazisa ngesibhedlela, kufanele abike lokhu kumphakathi wezempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo abike lezi zinkinga ukuze iziguli zingatholi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokulandela lezi zinqubo? Impendulo: Ukulandela lezi zinqubo kunikeza izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo ngesikhathi. Okwesibili, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zesibhedlela zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Okwesithathu, lokhu kusiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo, okungaholela ekutheni iziguli zihlale ziphilile. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe lezi zinqubo zihlala zishintsha? Impendulo: Yebo, lezi zinqubo zingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izidingo zezempilo zihlala zishintsha, futhi izibhedlela zidinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo ahlale ebuyekeza lezi zinqubo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi kufanele enze kanjani. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa? Impendulo: Uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa, kufanele abike lokhu kumphakathi wezempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo abike lezi zinkinga ukuze iziguli zingatholi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze ziqondise umtholampilo? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinsiza eziningi ezitholakalayo ukuze ziqondise umtholampilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izincwadi zokuhlela, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsizakusebenza eziku-inthanethi. Lezi zinsiza zingasiza umtholampilo ukuba aqonde kahle izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela. Umbuzo 9: Yini okufanele ikwenze uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa? Impendulo: Uma umtholampilo ethola izinkinga zokwazisa, kufanele abike lokhu kumphakathi wezempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo abike lezi zinkinga ukuze iziguli zingatholi ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Umbuzo 10: Ingabe lezi zinqubo zihlala zishintsha? Impendulo: Yebo, lezi zinqubo zingashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izidingo zezempilo zihlala zishintsha, futhi izibhedlela zidinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi umtholampilo ahlale ebuyekeza lezi zinqubo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle ukuthi kufanele enze kanjani. Ngokulandela lezi zinqubo, umtholampilo angasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo ngesikhathi, futhi lokhu kuzosiza ekugwemeni izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphila kahle kweziguli.
Ukuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe (Digital Communication) Umbuzo 1: Yini ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuxhumana ezisetshenziswa abantu ukuze baxhumane, sebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, ama-imeyili, izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuthumela imiyalezo, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ngama-video. Ubuchwepheshe buvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane kalula, noma ngabe bakuphi emhlabeni. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Izinsiza ezitholakala ngobuchwepheshe zenza kube lula ukuxhumana. Abantu bangathumela imiyalezo ngokushesha, futhi bangaxhumana ngezikhathi ezithile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu, futhi kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuvumela ukuxhumana okuqondile, okungathuthukisa ubudlelwano. Umbuzo 3: Ziyini izinkinga ezihambisana nokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Noma kukhona izinzuzo, kukhona nezinkinga. Ukuze abantu baxhumane ngobuchwepheshe, kudinga ukufinyelela kumadivayisi afanele nezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi. Lokhu akusiyo njalo okulula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwamakhono okuxhumana, njengoba abanye abantu bengathandi ukuveza imizwa yabo ngokuqondile. Umbuzo 4: Kungani ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana bubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla? Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana bubalulekile ngoba bunikeza ithuba lokuxhumana ngezindlela ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela kolwazi, ukumelwa kwezwi kwabantu, nokuhlanganyela imicabango. Ubuchwepheshe buvumela abantu ukuba babe yingxenye yomphakathi omkhulu, futhi babezwa izindaba ezivela kwezinye izindawo, okwandisa umbono wabo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuguqula izindlela zokuxhumana? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuguqule izindlela zokuxhumana ngokwenza kube lula. Okwakudala, abantu babengakholwa ukuthi bangaxhumana nabanye abantu ngaleso sikhathi. Kodwa manje, imiyalezo ingathunyelwa kalula, nokuxhumana kumavidiyo kuyatholakala. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezixhumanisi ezijulile phakathi kwabantu, kanti abantu bangaba nokuhlangenwe nakho okusha. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngobuchwepheshe? Kunezindlela eziningi zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana noFacebook, Twitter, ne-Instagram; izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuthumela imiyalezo efana noWhatsApp noTelegram; kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhlanganyela ezinjengeZoom neSkype. Lezi zindlela zenza kube lula ukuxhumana, futhi zenza kube nokwaziswa okuncane. Umbuzo 7: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuhlobene nezobuchwepheshe? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuhlobene nezobuchwepheshe ngoba kudinga izinhlelo, ama-apps, kanye nezinsiza ze-inthanethi ukuze kwenziwe. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana buveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bunomthelela omkhulu ekuxhumaneni. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kuyasobala ukuthi nezindlela zokuxhumana zizoshintsha futhi zibe ngcono. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kubalulekile emsebenzini? Emsebenzini, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kubalulekile ngoba kuvumela abasebenzi ukuthi baxhumane kalula, bahlanganyele izimvo, futhi benze izinqumo ngokushesha. Izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokusebenza kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda, futhi zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenza ngempumelelo nangokubambisana. Umbuzo 9: Kanjani ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kunciphisa umkhawulo wezakhiwo? Ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kunciphisa umkhawulo wezakhiwo ngendlela yokuthi abantu bangaxhumana, noma bahlala ezindaweni ezihlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile emhlabeni wokusebenza, njengoba abantu bangasebenza ngokubambisana, noma ngabe bangaphakathi kwezitolo ezahlukene. Lokhu kudala imikhakha emisha yokusebenza futhi kuvala izikhala phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Umbuzo 10: Yini engase ibaluleke kakhulu kwabanye uma kukhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe? Uma kukhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kufanele siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nakho, njengezokuphepha nokuvikeleka kolwazi. Kubalulekile ukufunda ukusebenza kahle ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze ukuxhumana kube kuphephile futhi kube nezinzuzo. Ukubambisana nokuhlonipha izifundo ezivela kwabanye kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe kuzoba phakathi kwezinto ezizaqhubeka zikhula, futhi kufanele siqhubeke siyazisa izinzuzo zakhona, siphinde sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela.
Ubudlelwano: Ukuhlola Izici Zokuxhumana Kwezinhloso Zomphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu buye baba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ubudlelwano bukhombisa indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo, bahloniphana, futhi benza izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ehlukene, lapho izinkolelo, amasiko, nezindlela zokuphila zihlala zihluka. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlaka Zobudlelwano Ubudlelwano bukhona ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela ezindaweni zomndeni, emsebenzini, nakweminye imiphakathi. Ukuze ubudlelwano buphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu kufanele bakwazi ukuveza imizwa yabo, izifiso, nezinkinga ngendlela efanele. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle buholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka empilweni, okwenza abantu bazizwe bejabule futhi bephumelelayo. Izithiyo Ezinzima Noma kunjalo, ubudlelwano abuhlali buphumelelayo. Izithiyo eziningi zingavela, okuhlanganisa ukungaqondi kahle, ukungaboni ngaso linye, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezithinta abantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphulweni kobudlelwano, okungase kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yomuntu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bafunde ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bephokophele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, nokuthi bazi ukuthi izinkinga zingavela, kodwa zidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukwamukela Umehluko Ubudlelwano buphinde buhlobene nokwamukela umehluko phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile emiphakathini ehlukene, lapho abantu bahlukene ngezinkolelo, izinkambiso, nezindlela zokuphila. Ukwamukela umehluko kuholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi bahlonipha abanye. Lokhu kudala isimo sokuxhumana esivulekile, okwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ubuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokuxhumana Ngokuthuthuka kobuchwepheshe, izindlela zokuxhumana ziye zashintsha kakhulu. Namuhla, abantu bangaxhumana kalula ngezingcingo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubudlelwano, kodwa futhi kudinga abantu ukuba baqaphele ukuthi ukuxhumana okungokoqobo kubalulekile. Ubudlelwano obuhle bukhula lapho abantu behlangana, bexoxa, futhi behlanganyela izikhathi ezibalulekile. Ubudlelwano Emsebenzini Ubudlelwano emsebenzini buye baba yinto ebalulekile ekuphumeleleni kwezinhlangano. Ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi babe nobudlelwano obuhle nabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, okwenza izinkampani zibe nempumelelo. Izinkampani ezikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu zihlala zikhula, futhi zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babe nemisebenzi emihle. Ubudlelwano Nezempilo Yengqondo Ubudlelwano buye bahlobene kakhulu nezempilo yengqondo. Abantu abanobudlelwano obuhle bavame ukuba nezenzo ezinhle, futhi bahlala bejabulile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ubudlelwano obubi bungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, njengokukhathazeka nokudangala. Ukuze abantu baphile kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, bahloniphe abanye, futhi bazi ukuthi badinga ukuxhumana. Isiphetho Ubudlelwano buhlobene kakhulu nempilo yomuntu, futhi buye bahlobene nezici eziningi zomphakathi. Ukuze ubudlelwano buphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bakhe izindlela zokuxhumana ezinhle, bahloniphe umehluko, futhi bazi ukuthi izinkinga zingavela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale bephokophele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, ukuze baphile impilo enempilo, ejabulisayo, futhi ephumelelayo. Ubudlelwano, uma buhle, bungaba yinsika eqinile empilweni yomuntu, buholele ekwandeni kokwaneliseka, impumelelo, nokujabula.
Inqubekela phambili ekwakhiweni kwezindlu zangasese ezikoleni Ingxoxo noMnu. Zulu, Umphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izikole Uthando: Sawubona, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha ukuze sikhulume ngentuthuko ezindlini zangasese ezikoleni, ikakhulukazi lezo ezihlobene nemigodi. Uphi umbono wakho mayelana nokuxazulula lezi zinkinga? UMnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, Uthando. Ngiyajabula ukuba nezingxoxo ngalolu daba olubalulekile. Sinethemba lokuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezindlu zangasese ezisemthethweni ezikoleni kuzokwenza umehluko omuhle emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezinkinga. Uthando: Lokhu kuyavuma. Yini eyejabulisayo osukwini lapha emkhakheni wokuqeda izindlu zangasese ezingafanele? UMnu. Zulu: Okwamanje, sithole ukuvuselelwa kwemibono nezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zangasese ezingcono ezikoleni. Izikhungo eziningi ziyasathola izinsiza ezanele zokwakha, futhi izinhlelo zikhona zokusebenzisana nosomabhizinisi bendawo ukuze bathole izindawo ezisemthethweni nezinsiza. Uthando: Lokhu kuyakhanga, kodwa ngabe kukhona izithiyo ezishiwo emsebenzini wokwakha? UMnu. Zulu: Yebo, kunezithiyo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Ukuntuleka kwemali yokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithile, kanye nezinsiza ezincane, kubangela izinkinga. Nokho, sesiqhubekile kakhulu ukuze sithole izikhungo zokwakha ezisezingeni. Uthando: Ngabe lezi zinguquko zenza umehluko ekusebenzeni nasekuthuthukiseni izikole? UMnu. Zulu: Impela. Ngeziphakamiso ezinhle, lokhu kunciphisa izinga lokungatholi imfundo efanele kwezingane. Izindawo ezihlanzekile nezisezingeni eliphezulu zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bathole imfundo engcono, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi jikelele. Uthando: Kulungile, ngabe kukhona izinhlelo ezithile ezithakazelisayo ezikhona, njengokuxhumana nemiphakathi? UMnu. Zulu: Yebo, sithole ukuthi imiphakathi idlala indima enkulu. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi, ezifana nama-workshops ezokwakha, zifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni. Ukufunda ngezinto ezithinta imiphakathi zebhizinisi, sithola ukuxhaswa okuningi ophenyo nokuqinisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Uthando: Kuzwakala kahle. Ake sikhulume ngekusasa. Yini okukhona ngaphambi kokuthi sisezinhlelweni ezithile, kuzomele sithathe amanyathelo athile? UMnu. Zulu: Izinjongo zethu zibandakanya ukudala inethiwekhi yamaqembu ahlukene, ukufaka izinhlelo eziya phambili zokubambisana, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ihambisana noshintsho olunomthelela. Umfundi ohlanzekile uyehlela impilo engcono, igcwele izicelo eziphusile. Uthando: Ngabe ukhona umbhalo ocacile okhuthaza ukufaka isandla emizamweni yokwakha izindlu zangasese? UMnu. Zulu: Yebo, sinemithombo ethile ethumele izincwadi ezikhuthazayo nezicabangela othisha, abazali, nabanikezeli bezinsiza zamakhaya. Ithimba lethu libambisene nezikhungo ezihlose ukugcina umphakathi uthuthukiswa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kube neqhaza eliphelele ekwenzeni izinqumo. Uthando: Lokhu kuwumqondo omuhle. Ngingakuthanda ukuthi unikeze abadlali abawenza ngamunye umthelela wabo. UMnu. Zulu: Ngaphambi kokuphetha, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi wonke umuntu udinga ukuba neqhaza. Abafundi, abazali, othisha, nosomabhizinisi, bonke banendima ebalulekile. Ukubambisana nokuhlanganyela ngephakethe lemali kungaholela ekwenzeni umehluko omkhulu. Uthando: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngokusithokozisa ngalesi sikhathi. Ngithemba ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bazobe bazikhathalela izikole zethu ukuze sithuthukise imiphakathi. UMnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, Uthando. Ngiyabonga ngethuba lokukhuluma ngalo msebenzi obalulekile. Ngiyaphila. Uthando: Ngiyabonga. Lokhu kuhambisana neqiniso elijulile lokuthi imfundo iklanywa, futhi umphakathi uyoza ubhekene nezimo ezintsha ezikhuluma ngemigodi, konke kulandela ukuxhumana kwendlela ephumelelayo. Umsebenzi wokuqeda izindlu zangasese ezingafanele ezikoleni ulokhu uqhubekela phambili, futhi ngezimvo, izinqumo, nomsebenzi onomthelela, siphokophele ukuphendukela phambili ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umfundi ungena esikhathini esikahle.
Isigaba 1: Ukuqala Kwendaba Kwakukhona umhlaba ophumelelayo ogcwele ubuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, lapho abantu bezijabulisa ngezinhlelo ezithuthukile. Phakathi kwalokhu, i-Microsoft yaqala ukuba umholi emhlabeni, idume ngama-software ayo afana ne-Windows ne-Office. Lezi zinhlelo zazakhiwe ngothando, ubuhlakani, nobuchwepheshe, futhi abantu bezithanda kakhulu. UBill Gates, umsunguli we-Microsoft, wayengumuntu ophusile onomqondo ovulekile. Waqala le nkampani ngensimu encane yokuhweba, kodwa ngemizamo yakhe nokusebenza kanzima, wathola indlela yokwakha umphakathi wezemfundo onobuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba isixazululo ezinkingeni eziningi zomhlaba, futhi wayehlose ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Isigaba 2: Ukukhula Kwe-Microsoft Njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka, i-Microsoft yakhula kakhulu. Yaqala ukufaka izinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezazenza kube lula kubantu ukusebenza, ukufunda, nokuxhumana. UBill waba nemikhiqizo emisha, eqhubeka ehlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithuthukisiwe. Abantu baqala ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha emakhaya, benza izinto eziningi. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-Microsoft yaphenduka umphakathi omkhulu wokwakha izinhlelo ezikhethekile ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabantu. Ukukhula kwe-inthanethi kwavula amathuba amasha, i-Microsoft yaba umeluleki wezobuchwepheshe, inikeza izixazululo ezithuthukile ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba. Isigaba 3: Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe Kwenzeka izinguquko ezinkulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. I-Microsoft yahamba phambili ekwakhiweni kwemikhiqizo emisha, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni i-Cloud computing. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi bagcine idatha yabo endaweni ephephile, futhi bafinyelele kuyo noma kuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kwashintsha indlela abantu abakha ngayo, behlola amathuba amasha okusebenza. UBill Gates, nakuba esesondelene nokuthula, wayesathanda ukuhamba phambili. Wayebona ukuthuthukiswa kwezimali eziphakeme, futhi wayefuna ukuthi i-Microsoft ihlale ikhokhela. Ngalesi sikhathi, abanye abantu babekhuluma ngama-robotics, futhi i-Microsoft yaphendula ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokwenziwa. Isigaba 4: Izinselelo Nezimpumelelo Nokho, njengoba i-Microsoft ikhulile, yayiphinde yabhekana nezinselelo. Ukuncintisana okukhulayo kwabangakhiqizi abaningi, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, kwakudinga ukuba i-Microsoft ibe nezinqumo eziphusile. UBill waqala ukuthola ukuthi abanye abaqhamuki bakhuluma ngezinselelo eziphakeme, izinkampani zokuqala zifuna izixazululo eziphusile. Nokho, i-Microsoft yathola amasu amasha. Yaqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ukuze ithuthukise imikhiqizo yayo. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi i-Microsoft ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isigaba 5: Ikusasa le-Microsoft Namuhla, i-Microsoft isemhlabeni wonke, ithuthukisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Abantu balindele ukuthi i-Microsoft iqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, ibanikeze amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. UBill Gates, owayengumholi, usuke ethokozisa abantu ngezixazululo ezintsha ezithuthukisa izimpilo zomphakathi. Ukwakhiwa kwemikhiqizo emisha, ukuhlola amathuba amasha, nokusebenza kuzo zonke izinkalo zempilo, kuveza umbono ohlanzekile we-Microsoft. Ithemba likhona lokuthi lo mholi wobuchwepheshe uzophinde uthuthukise imikhiqizo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zomhlaba wonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu badinga kakhulu ubuchwepheshe. Isigaba 6: Isiphetho Ngale ndlela, i-Microsoft ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungamandla. Ukusebenza kanzima, ubuhlakani, nobuqotho kudinga ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho, i-Microsoft iyinkanyezi emkhathini wezobuchwepheshe, isikhumbuzo sokuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga izinqumo eziphusile, ukwakha, nokuthuthukisa. Lokhu kudinga ukusungulwa kwemibono emisha ukuze impilo ithuthuke, futhi wonke umuntu athole amathuba alingana. Uhlobo lwezixazululo ezithuthukile ezihlinzekwa yi-Microsoft luyinkanyezi, futhi lokhu kuveza indlela abantu abakhuluma ngayo, bakha ngayo, futhi baphila ngayo. UBill Gates, ngempela, washintsha umhlaba - futhi i-Microsoft iqhubeka ikhulisa izinzuzo zobuchwepheshe emhlabeni wonke.
IMIBUZO: Zonke imibuzo ephathelene nom contenido wale ndatshana kumele ithunyelwe ehhovisi lakho lesifunda. I-UGDE njengomqashi iyazi ukuthi ilungelo labasebenzi ukuhlinzekwa kahle njengoba kubhalwe kwiMthetho waseNingizimu Afrika nasemthethweni ophathelene nokwelashwa kwabasebenzi. Kungumthwalo womqashi nabasebenzi ukuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-LRA nokuhlonipha izibopho zabo kubaphathi babo ngalolu daba. Zonke lezi zikhwama zizoqala ngo-Okthoba 1, 1999. Amalungu ezinyunyana i-SAOU, i-NAPTOSA, i-PSA, i-PAWUSA, i-COSATU, nalabo beMnyango Wezemfundo ngaphansi kwe-COSATU, uma befisa ukuphikisa umqashi ngenxa yokuthi abathathanga ingxenye emhlanganweni, noma uma befisa ukusho ukuthi abahambelanga imibiko ethunyelwe ezinyunyeni zabo ngesikhathi beqondiswa ukwenza noma yini eyabavimbela ekwenzeni umsebenzi abaqashwe wona; kumele banikeze umqashi incwadi yokwazisa ethi abathathanga ingxenye emhlanganweni ngaphambi kosuku lukaSepthemba 15, 1999. Ehhovisi lesifunda, le ncwadi kumele inikezwe i-DEC, futhi kwezinye ehhovisi zendawo kanye nehhovisi elikhulu, kumele inikezwe abaphathi abaphezulu. [Funda okukhuluma kule ndatshana 30 no-130/1998 ukuze uthole amafomu adingekayo okugcwaliswa]. Izicelo zokuhamba ngezikweletu azizokwamukelwa umqashi ngesikhathi somhlanganweni, kuphela lezo ezenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi zamukelwe uma ziwukuhamba kwabantu abazoba nezingane, izicelo zokuhamba kokubeletha, nezicelo zabantu abagulayo uma umuntu egulile ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyi-14, futhi uma lezi zicelo zokugula zikh accompanied by a letter or certificate from a doctor or other health provider. Labo basebenzi abenza kabi ngesikhathi somhlanganweni bazobhekana nezinyathelo zokuphatha. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi otholakala ethathwa engalungile emhlanganweni uzobhekana nezinyathelo zokuphatha futhi angase aphume emsebenzini wakhe. Inombolo ekhethekile yokuxhumana yezenzakalo nezicelo eziphathelene nalolu daba ngu-0800600933.
Ngemva kweminyaka eyi-11 yokunqunywa eHhovisi leMphakathi (OPP) eMpumalanga Kapa, uMphakathi uNomsa Thomas usaqhubeka nokuthanda ukwenza okuthile ukuze aguqule izimpilo zomphakathi zibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, uthando lukaMphakathi owenze umthelela, owazalwa futhi wakhulela eQueenstown, lungaka ukuthi uzokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ngisho nangaphandle kwezinsuku zokusebenza kulabo abadinga usizo. "Ngithola ugqozi lwami lapho ngishintsha indaba yobumpofu nokungathembeki ibe yimihla yokhope. Lokhu kunginika isizathu sokubheka phambili ngosuku olungcono kumuntu ojwayelekile emgwaqweni," kusho yena. "Imiphakathi yasemaphandleni esiyisebenzela ibona thina njengabavikeli ekulethweni kwezinsizakalo." Kusukela ebuncaneni, uMphakathi uThomas ubehlale ethanda ukubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi lapho abantu, kungakhathaliseki ngombala noma umbono, baphila mahhala, benethuba elilinganayo endaweni ephephile. Empeleni, kube yinye yezinkinga ezingalingani kuhulumeni wobandlululo eyamkhuthaza ukuba acabangele umsebenzi kwezomthetho. Ubelieve ukuthi iHhovisi leMphakathi liyisikhungo esibalulekile esinikezwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isifiso sezingxenye eziningi sithathwa phambili futhi sifezwe. Nakuba uMphakathi uThomas ekholelwa ukuthi isu lehhovisi lokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni libalulekile, uyashesha ukuveza ukuthi ihhovisi kufanele, nokho, lihlale lizimele futhi lingavumi. "I-OPP kufanele ibe yisikhuthazi ekuphathweni komphakathi esinethonya elihle elenza isifiso sezingxenye eziningi sibe sobala kubantu abajwayelekile," kusho yena. Ngenkathi esendaweni enezinhlelo eziningi, uMphakathi uThomas akanasikhathi sokungasebenzi, nokho, uma ethola isikhathi sokuphumula, uvame ukufunda futhi "faka izandla emhlabathini." Unothando lokusebenza komphakathi futhi udlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni iqembu lokusekela i-HIV/AIDS, iVukume. Ezinye zezinto azithandayo zihlanganisa ukudlala i-squash, i-rugby, i-chess, nokuvakasha ejimini, lapho enza khona kahle emkhakheni wokuzivocavoca.
Amagama abhalwe ngaphezulu akhombisa lokho okukhishwe emthethweni osezingeni. Amagama aphakanyiswe ngentambo ephakeme akhombisa lokho okuhlanganiswe emthethweni osezingeni. Ukuze kusungulwe uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawula imboni kagesi, ukudala uMlawuli weZizwe zeNgesi, umgibeli nomgibeli wendlela yokulawula ugesi kazwelonke; ukuhlinzeka ngamalayisense nokubhaliswa njengendlela yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, ukusabalalisa, ukuhweba, nokwamukela nokuthumela ugesi ukuze kulawulwe; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. Ukudluliswa kusho ukuhanjiswa kukagesi ngohlelo lokudlulisa, kanye nokuhamba nokuhanjiswa kukagesi ngezincazelo ezihlobene. Futhi lo Mthetho uhlanganisa amagama noma imiyalo enziwa noma inikezwa mayelana nakho. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza nokusebenza kahle kukagesi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuncintisana nokukhetha kwamakhasimende; futhi ukuthuthukisa ukulinganisa okuhle phakathi kokuthandwa kwamakhasimende, abanikazi bamalayisense, abakhiqizi embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, nomphakathi. U-Mlawuli weZizwe zeNgesi osunguliwe ngengxenye 3 yeMthetho Wokulawulwa Kagesi ungumgibeli nomgibeli wendlela yokulawula ethile ethile. Ukuze uthole noma uqashe impahla ethile esuswe noma eyashiywa ukuze wenze imisebenzi yawo; futhi ukuthatha noma iyiphi isinyathelo esilimazayo emisebenzini yabo. U-Mlawuli angasungula amakomidi aqukethe amalungu amaningi kaMlawuli, abasebenzi kaMlawuli, nabanye abantu njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze uMlawuli izeluleko ngokujwayelekile noma ngezindaba ezithile. U-Mlawuli angasungula ama-foramu abathengi nabathengisi aqukethe amalungu amaningi kaMlawuli, abasebenzi kaMlawuli, kanye nezikhulumi zamakhasimende nabathengi njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze uMlawuli izeluleko ngezindaba ezihlobene namakhasimende noma abathengi ngokujwayelekile, noma ingxenye ethile yamakhasimende noma abathengi. U-Mlawuli kufanele afune ilayisense ukuze asungule futhi ahlinzeke ngempahla kumaforamu abathengi noma abathengi ngendlela echazwe ngelayisense ephethwe yilowo muntu. Ngaphandle kokubheka ingxenye 1, umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywe ngakho kuSheduli II okudingayo ukufaka isicelo noma ukuba nelayisense enikezwe uMlawuli akufanele abe nalutho kulomthetho olukhubazayo ekuxoxeni ngokuqaliswa nokusebenza kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka, ukungenisa nokukhipha ugesi, ukuhweba, noma yimuphi umsebenzi ophathelene, ngaphambi kokuphothula isicelo selayisense noMlawuli. U-Mlawuli kufanele ahlinzeke umceli wezicelo okukhulunywe ngaye engxenyeni a ngazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kube lula ukufakwa kwezicelo zamalayisense. Akukho sicelo sokuhlala kwemininingwane, izaziso, noma izingxoxo ezihlobene engxenyeni 3 ezingabhekwa njengokuthinta noma ilungelo noma okulindelwe komceli wezicelo. UNgqongqoshe angathola, ngemva kokuxhumana noMlawuli, ulwazi kuGazethi mayelana nanoma iyiphi imisebenzi engxenyeni 8 edinga ilayisense kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywe kulolu shicilelo. UNgqongqoshe angathola, ngemva kokuxhumana noMlawuli, izaziso kuGazethi mayelana nanoma yimuphi umuntu ophakathi kwalesi sikhathi sokuhweba noma sokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungadingi ilayisense ngaphansi kwengxenye 8 kufanele bhaliswe noMlawuli. Noma yimuphi umuntu odinga ukubhaliswa noMlawuli kufanele enze kanjalo ngendlela nasemigomeni echazwe, kanye nesicelo esidingekayo esidinga ukuhambisana nezimali zokubhaliswa ezichaziwe: uma umuntu onelayisense ngosuku olukhulunywe engxenyeni 9 kufanele anikezwe isitifiketi sokubhaliswa ngaphandle kokulandela izinqubo ezichaziwe. Ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo ngaphansi kwemigomo yeengxenye 2, uMlawuli kufanele abhalise umceli wezicelo ngemisebenzi echazwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa ezonikezwa kulowo muntu. Uma isicelo singafakiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe noma singaqhubeki nezimali zokubhaliswa ezichaziwe; noma uma isicelo siphikisana nenhloso yalomthetho. Ubufakazi bokulandela uhlelo olufanele lokuhlanganiswa kwamandla ngaleso sikhathi; kanye nolwazi olunye oluvela kuNgqongqoshe njengoba kuchaziwe. UNgqongqoshe kufanele achaze izidingo ezidingekayo ezidingeka ukuba zilandwe ngabaceli ngaphambi kokuba uMlawuli acabangele isicelo selayisense. Uma ilayisense iceliwe kuMlawuli, kufanele ifune umceli wezicelo ukuthi azise isicelo ezincwadini ezisemthethweni noma ezinkundleni ezihlobene nendawo yokusebenza ngolimi olusemthethweni okungenani ezimbili. Umceli wezicelo kufanele ahlinzeke umceli wezicelo ngazo zonke izinsiza ukuze avumele umceli wezicelo ukuphendula lokhu; futhi angafaka olunye ulwazi olungase lube luyadingeka ukuze uMlawuli acabangele isicelo kahle. Ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka; ukungenisa nokukhipha ugesi; noma ukuhweba. U-Mlawuli akafuneki ukuthi asebenzise ilayisense futhi kufanele anikeze kuphela ilayisense eyodwa yesicelo esisodwa semisebenzi echazwe engxenyeni 3. Isikhathi kufanele sihlanganise ukusebenza; kanye nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo esichaziwe. U-Mlawuli angavuma, njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense ezibekwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1, ukuvimbela umnikazi welayisense ekwenzeni noma ukuvusa umnikazi welayisense ukuba enze noma iyiphi isenzo esichazwe ngelayisense. Umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukukhokha noma iyiphi imali kumakhasimende futhi abeke izimo ezivunyelwe noma ezibekwe nguMlawuli njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense. UNgqongqoshe kufanele achaze inqubo ezolandwa ekukhanselweni, ekuphakamiseni okwesikhashana, ekususweni, noma ekubekweni kwanoma iyiphi isimo selayisense. Noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ofuna ukukhombisa ukuthi angathatha amalungelo namandla omnikazi waleyo layisense ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalo mthetho, futhi ilayisense entsha inikezwa kulowo muntu; noma isimo selayisense asihlonishwanga. Umnikazi welayisense kufanele, ezimeni ezichazwe ezingxenyeni 1a no-b, anikeze uMlawuli okungenani izinyanga eziyi-12 zokwazisa ngokubhalwe phansi ngenhloso yabo yokuyeka ukusebenza, ngaphandle kokuthi uMlawuli achaze okunye. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akazange alandele noma wehluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho, izimo, noma yimiphi imithetho yalomthetho, uMlawuli angahlala ebhodi ukwenza isinqumo ngalezi zinsolo. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akazange alandele izaziso mayelana nengxenye 2, uMlawuli angahlala ebhodi ukwenza isinqumo ngalezi zinsolo. Uma ibhodi ithola ukuthi izinsolo ngaphansi kwengxenye 3 ziqinile, bangabeka isijeziso esingadluli ku-R2,000,000.00 ngosuku uma lokhu kungahambisani kuqhubeka. U-Mlawuli kufanele acabangele ukungahambisani ukuze enze isinqumo ngezijeziso noma yimiphi. UNgqong
Noma ubani onenhlalakahle yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukufaka isicelo sokuba ngumCitizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-naturalisation ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngumhlali ongenamkhawulo. Noma ubani oshadile nomCitizen waseNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukuba ngumCitizen wendawo ethile ngemuva kweminyaka emibili kulandela ukuhlinzekwa ngenhlalakahle yokuhlala eyakhishwa ngesikhathi sokushada. Ingane enonyaka engu-21 enenhlalakahle yokuhlala iyafaneleka ukuba ngumCitizen wendawo ethile, uma kwenzeka lokhu kuza ngokushesha ngemuva kokuhlinzekwa ngenhlalakahle. Gcwalisa amafomu wesicelo BI-63 kanye ne-BI-757 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma lemission uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela imvume yokuhlala enenhlalakahle noma ukwehliswa. Gcwalisa ifomu le-SAP kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe ukuze uthole isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka komphakathi. Thumela ifomu eliphelele le-BI-9 kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe nezithombe ezimbili ezine-ID uma unaphezu kweminyaka engu-15 ubudala. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthola ubunikazi ngemuva kokuthi isicelo sakho sokuba ngumCitizen wendawo ethile samukelwe. Umzali onengane angafaka isicelo egameni lengane encane nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho ingane encane ihlala ngokomthetho futhi ngempela eNingizimu Afrika. Ubufakazi bokuhlonza buzokhishwa futhi buthunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo. Abafaki-sicelo abathola izicelo zabo zingamukelwa bazokwaziswa ngokufanele. Izicelo zingathatha izinyanga ezi-2 kuya kwezi-4. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lakho eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Impilo Yasemakhaya: Izinzuzo Nezinkinga Impilo yasemakhaya ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, kodwa ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle le mpilo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nayo. Kule ngxoxo, sizogxila ezicini ezithinta umphakathi, umnotho, nezimo zokuphila ezikhona emakhaya. Sizok开始 ngezinto ezinhle ezihambisana nempilo yasemakhaya. Abantu abahlala emaphandleni banethuba lokuphila eduze kwemvelo, okuholela ezindaweni eziluhlaza nezikhala zomoya opholile. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakwazi ukulima izitshalo ezahlukene, okwakha ukuzimela ekudleni, futhi kunciphisa izindleko zokuphila. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bujabulisa, njengoba abantu bethola ithuba lokubambisana ekulimaleni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, impilo yasemakhaya ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu wukuntuleka kwemithombo yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kubeka abantu engozini yokugula, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila impilo enempilo. Futhi, izinsiza ezifana nezibhedlela, izikole, nezithuthi zihlala zikhona kodwa zihlukumezekile, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Impilo yasemakhaya ithinta umnotho ngendlela ethile. Nakuba kunezinzuzo, umnotho emakhaya uvame ukuba phansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezindawo zomuzi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani ezinkulu zifuna ukwakha ezindaweni ezinezinselelo eziningi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu baphume emakhaya baye emadolobheni, okuphula ubudlelwano bomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yasemakhaya. Abahleli bezinqubomgomo kufanele basebenzise izinsizakusebenza ezinkulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izikole ezithuthukile, ukuqinisa ukufinyelela kwezinsiza zezempilo, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abadala. Ubulunga bezinsiza kufanele buphakanyiswe ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola amathuba angcono. Ubuchwepheshe bungaba yinsiza enkulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yasemakhaya, njengoba izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezinhle zingasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, zikhuthaze ukusakazwa kolwazi, futhi zikhuthaze ukuhweba. Ekugcineni, impilo yasemakhaya inezinzuzo nezinkinga ezithile. Nakuba kunezithiyo, kungenzeka ukuthuthukisa impilo yasemakhaya ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ukwakha izinsiza eziphusile, nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi uqhubeke phambili, ubhekane nezinselelo, futhi uthuthukise izimpilo zabantu abahlala emaphandleni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yasemakhaya kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula.
AmaMamelodi Sundowns: Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi Yebhola eNingizimu Afrika AmaMamelodi Sundowns, abizwa ngokuthi "Masandawana," angomunye wemikhosi ehamba phambili emhlabeni wobhola eNingizimu Afrika. Le nqola ibhola ithole udumo olukhulu eminyakeni edlule, ibonakaliswa ngempumelelo yayo emiqhudelwaneni yasekhaya nasezwenikazi. Kusukela lapho yasungulwa, amaSundowns akhule abe isikhumbuzo sebhola elihle, ehlanganisa abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwenza umphakathi uba nethuba lokubona ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu. Ukwakhiwa Kweqembu AmaMamelodi Sundowns asungulwa ngo-1970, eMamelodi, ePitoli. Iqembu laqala njengomphakathi, elihloselwe ukwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le nqola yathola ukwesekwa okuhle, kwaholela ekwandeni kwayo. Ngemva kokuthola umnikelo omkhulu, amaSundowns akwazi ukukhokhela abadlali abahamba phambili, okuvumela ukuhamba phambili emqhudelwaneni. Umpumelelo Emqhudelwaneni Umpumelelo wamaSundowns ubonakala emiqhudelwaneni ehlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi kwiDStv Premiership, okuyiqhaza elikhulu lemidlalwano yaseNingizimu Afrika. Iqembu liphumelele izicoco eziningi, kuhlanganise nePremier Soccer League (PSL) kanye neNingizimu Afrika Cup. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaSundowns abuye abe neqhaza elikhulu emqhudelwaneni weCAF Champions League, lapho athole khona izicoco eziningi, kukhombisa ubuchwepheshe bawo obuphezulu. Ubuchwepheshe Nokuqeqesha Ubuchwepheshe bamaSundowns buphakanyiswa kakhulu ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle. Umqeqeshi wabo, uRulani Mokwena, ungumuntu ophumelelayo futhi onolwazi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela amasu ahlukahlukene ukuze aqhubele phambili iqembu. Uhlelo lokuqeqesha luhlanganisa izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono abadlali, futhi luhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okujolise ekwandiseni amandla omzimba, ubuchwepheshe, nokucabanga ngesikhathi somdlalo. Umphakathi Nokuqhubeka AmaMamelodi Sundowns awawona nje amaqembu ebhola; ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi. Iqembu lihlala linikeza ithuba lokuhlanganyela komphakathi, ngokwenza imicimbi yokuzijabulisa, izifundo zokufundisa, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa abantwana. Lokhu kwenza amaSundowns abe isibonelo esihle sokuthi ibhola lingaphezu kokudlalwa; libalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi. Izinkanyezi ZamaSundowns Abadlali abaningi abaphumelelayo baye badlula amaSundowns, futhi benza igama elikhulu emhlabeni wobhola. Abadlali abafana noPercy Tau, uKhama Billiat, noTiyani Mabunda baye baba izinkanyezi, baphakamisa ibhande leqembu. Lezi zinkanyezi zikhombisa ukuthi amaSundowns awawona nje amaqembu aphumelelayo, kodwa futhi yindawo yokukhula kwabantu abasha abanezifiso ezinkulu. Isiphetho AmaMamelodi Sundowns ayinhlangano eyaziwayo emhlabeni wobhola, enobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, umphakathi onobudlelwano, kanye nempumelelo emiqhudelwaneni. Ukusuka ekuqaleni kwawo, le nqola ibhola ibonisa ukuthi ibhola lingaba yinsika yokuhlanganyela, uthando, nokuphumelela. Njengoba iqhubeka nokukhula, amaSundowns azosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthakazelelwa ngizigidi zabalandeli. Lokhu kwenza amaSundowns abe yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi ibhola akukhona nje ukuhamba kwegoli, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila.
Kunomehluko phakathi kokwahlulela uma kukhona impikiswano nokusiza amaqembu abandakanyekayo empikiswaneni ukuba ayixazulule. Ekwahluleleni, umuntu ongengowempikiswano uthatha isinqumo mayelana nempikiswano, futhi leso sinqumo kumele sibe sihlose amaqembu abandakanyekayo. Uma umuntu ongengowempikiswano esiza lawa maqembu ekuxazululeni impikiswano, sithi lokho kungukuhlanganyela noma ukuvuselela. Uma amaqembu abandakanyekayo exazulula izinkinga zawo ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu wesithathu, lokhu kuyimiphumela yenqubo yokuxoxisana phakathi kwamaqabunga amabili. Abaphathi bezomthetho ezinkantolo bathola amandla abo okwahlulela ngokuba baqokwe ngezinhlinzeko zomthetho. Futhi kungenzeka ukuthi amaqembu abandakanyekayo empikiswaneni azoletha impikiswano zawo ukuze zihlulelwe ngumuntu abavumelana naye ukuba abe yisikhulu sokwahlulela. Ezivumelwaneni eziningi, amaqembu afaka isigaba esivuma ukuthi noma iyiphi impikiswano ephuma phakathi kwabo ezivumelwaneni zabo izothunyelwa kumhlinzeki. Umhlinzeki angabizwa noma isigaba singachaza ukuthi umhlinzeki uzokhethwa kanjani, ngokwesibonelo, ummeli okhethwe yiBar Association. Isivumelwano sokuhlanganyela asidingi ukuba sibhale. Emiphakathini ethile noma emindenini, kungenzeka kube nesivumelwano sokuthi impikiswano izothunyelwa kumholi womphakathi noma kumholi wemindeni ngoba lokho kuyisiko elalandelwa isikhathi eside. Impikiswano ichazwa ngumuntu ophathiswe umthetho owenziwe nguhulumeni. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo awakwazi ukukhetha ukuthi ubani umuntu ophathiswe umthetho. Le nqubo ilawulwa yimithetho, izinqubomgomo, noma amasiko ezinkantolo. Kungaba nzima kumaqembu abandakanyekayo ukuqhubeka ngaphandle kokwethulwa komthetho. Isinqumo kumele sihlale sihambisana nesibonelo esifanele. Isinqumo siqinisekiswa ngenqubo esemthethweni noma engemthethweni. Isinqumo singavame ukuthathwa ngokufaka isicelo ezinkantolo eziphakeme. Izinqumo ezinkantolo eziphansi zingathathwa ngokuphathwa. Kuvamile ukuba kube nemiphumela yokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Umuntu otholwe enecala ukhokha izindleko ezitholakele zokusebenzisa abameli. Azikho izindleko zokwenziwa kwezinkantolo ezikhokhelwa kusenesikhathi ngaphandle kwamastamp. Qaphela: inkantolo ephansi ihluke ngokuthi inqubo iyinqubo yokuhlola futhi amaqembu abandakanyekayo awadingeki ukuba amelelwe ngababonisi. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo akhetha umhlinzeki (umhlinzeki). Umhlinzeki angaba ngumuntu onolwazi olunzulu kulolo mkhakha. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo anenkululeko yokukhetha inqubo yabo. Isidingo sokwethulwa komthetho sizoncika enhlanganweni ekhethiwe. Isinqumo kumele sithathwe njengomyalelo wenkantolo ukuze sisebenze kahle. Akukho isicelo esizofakwa ezinkantolo—kungavunyelwana ukuthi isicelo sithathwe ngababonisi abanye. Le nqubo ilawulwa ngamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Iqembu ngalinye elibandakanyekayo lingasebenzisa abeluleki bezomthetho, kodwa lokho akudingekile. Umphumela uncike kumandla nobuchule bamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Azikho izindleko zomthetho ngaphandle kwezindleko zabeluleki bezomthetho uma zisetshenzisiwe. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Umuntu wesithathu angasiza ekuxazululeni udaba. Le nqubo ilawulwa ngumhlinzeki ophatha izeluleko kumamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Abeluleki bezomthetho beqembu ngalinye abadingeki uma le nqubo ithathwa. Umphumela ungaba yifiso yomhlinzeki kodwa abenzi izinqumo. Umphumela uvame ukuba yisimo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo akhokha izindleko zomhlinzeki uma zikhona. Lokhu kuyindlela lapho umuntu wesithathu, umhlinzeki/umuntu olethe ukuthula, edingeka ukusiza amaqembu abandakanyekayo axazulule izinkinga zabo. Kungachazwa njengokuxoxisana okusekelayo. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi ukulethela udaba kumhlinzeki ngamaqembu abandakanyekayo kuyazithandela, kodwa ngokomthetho, isiko noma isivumelwano singadinga ukuthi amaqembu abandakanyekayo alethe udaba lwabo kumhlinzeki. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi umhlinzeki abe ngumuntu owamukelekayo kokubili amaqembu abandakanyekayo, umuntu ongaxhunyiwe nganoma iyiphi indlela kumqembu ongena noma kudaba. Umhlinzeki akufanele athathe izinhlangothi. Umhlinzeki akawenzi izinqumo zamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Indima yomhlinzeki ukusiza amaqembu abandakanyekayo axazulule izinkinga zabo. Umhlinzeki kumele azame ukuthi kokubili amaqembu abandakanyekayo awine ukuze kungabi khona iqembu elishiywe likwahlulelwe. Lokhu kubalulekile uma amaqembu abandakanyekayo enobudlelwano obuqhubekayo ngoba ubuhlungu obungazwakali kumqembu okwahlulelwe bungaholela ekuqhekekeni kobudlelwano obuhle. Uma kungekho umthetho othile ophatha lokhu, inqubo nokukhethwa komhlinzeki kusezandleni zamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Isivumelwano sokuhlinzekwa singakhethwa uma kukhona impikiswano, noma amaqembu abandakanyekayo uma bebona ukuthi kungenzeka kube nempikiswano phakathi kwabo esikhathini esizayo, bangavuma ukuthi le mpikiswano kufanele ibhekwane ngokufuna umhlinzeki. Isivumelwano sokuthumela udaba kumhlinzeki asidingi ukuba sibhale, kodwa isivumelwano esibhaliwe singasiza njengoba sisiza ukucacisa inqubo yonke elandelwayo ngababandakanyekayo. Umhlinzeki unomsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi ugcina ubumfihlo bamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Ngeshwa, umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika awunikezi abahlinzeki ilungelo lokwenqaba ukuveza ubufakazi ezinkantolo ngokusekelwe kulwazi olutholakele ngesikhathi sokuhlinzekwa. Uma izindaba zomphakathi ziphathwa, ilungelo elisebenzayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezisetshenziselwa ukuxazulula impikiswano lingasetshenziswa.
