Ukungezwani Phakathi KweMiphakathi: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Emazweni amaningi, ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi kuyinto ehamba phambili ezindabeni. Lokhu kuhlobene nemfundo, ubuhlanga, kanye nezinye izici ezithinta abantu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezindlela ezingasiza ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga. Izimbangela Zokungezwani Izimbangela zokungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi ziningi. Enye yezizathu ezinkulu iwukuntuleka kokuxhumana. Imiphakathi eminingi igcina izinkolelo namasiko ayo, ivimbe imizwa yokubambisana. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezinkinga phakathi kwabantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni. Okunye okungaholela ekuqhubekeni kokungezwani yisimo sezomnotho. Uma imiphakathi ingatholi amathuba afanayo, kube khona izinkinga ezikhaliphile nezokuphepha, okukhulisa ukungaboni ngasolinye. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle phakathi kwemiphakathi, njengoba abantu bejwayela ukugxila ezinkingeni zabo kuphela. Imiphumela Yokungezwani Ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi kungaholela ezimeni ezinzima. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukungaboni ngasolinye, okuthinta ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Imiphakathi idinga ukuvumelana ukuze kube nokuthula. Ukungezwani kudala imiphumela emibi, njengezikhali, ubudlova, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungezwani kungaholela ekuphuleni kwemithetho yokuhlala ndawonye. Uma imiphakathi ingabambisani, kube khona ukungabi nempumelelo kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izimo zempilo, imfundo, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka ingcindezi kumphakathi wonke. Izixazululo Ezingaba Nempumelelo Ukuze sithole izixazululo, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinhlelo zokubambisana, lapho abantu bejwayelana khona nemikhuba nemikhuba yabo. Imicimbi yokubambisana ingasiza ekuqedeni ukungezwani, njengoba abantu bezokwazi ukuqonda izinqumo zabo. Ukwenza izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngezamasiko ahlukene kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukungabi nempumelelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu beqonda izimbangela zempilo yabo, bazokwazi ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze bafeze imigomo efanayo. Ukubambisana Nezinhlaka Zikamasipala Izikhungo zikamasipala zingaba nendima enkulu ekuqedeni lezi zinkinga. Ngokuhlanganyela, bangase benze izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ezihlanganisa abantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi ehlanganyela, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukwabelana ngamasiko, imikhuba, nezinkolelo zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi iziphathimandla zisebenzise izindlela ezicacile zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ukwethenjelwa phakathi kwemiphakathi, okuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo ezihlukene. Isiphetho Ukungezwani phakathi kwemiphakathi akuyona into elula, kodwa kumele sibe neziqubulo zokukwazi ukuhlanganyela. Ukuze silwe nale nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngemiphakathi yabo, kodwa futhi baziqonde nokuhlonipha abanye. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, nokubambisana okukhulu. Ubuqotho, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha kuyizinto ezizothuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngokubambisana, singenza umehluko omkhulu, sithuthukise izimo zethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela emiphakathini yethu, kodwa nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sifuna izixazululo, sikhuthaze ubudlelwane obuhle, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izwi lizwe lizwa.
Umhlangano omusha obizwa ngokuthi iGrain Farmer Development Association (GFADA), umhlangano wokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi bokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, obambisene neGrain Value Chain Network (GVCN), ukhathazekile ngesimo sezolimo esingasakhiqizi inzuzo eyanele ekukhiqizeni ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukhathazekile ngempempe yokuthi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela kulabo abaqala embonini yokulima. Ukusungulwa kwalaba bafuyi abasha kubalulekile kuhulumeni, ngakho-ke iGFADA ifisa ukweseka zonke izinzame zabafuyi abasha. Nokho, ukuhlinzeka lezi zinsizwa ngempahla ngaphandle kokuzisekela ngendlela efanele kuyimanga ngoba babhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Amalungu eGVCN anolwazi nolwazi lokubathatha ngezandla nokubasekela, kodwa uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngemali edingekayo ukuze anikeze abafuyi imishini abayidingayo ukuze baqhubeke nezinsiza zabo zokuphumelela esikhathini esizayo. Ngempela, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sicabange kabusha ngesimo somsebenzi sokukhiqiza ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi. Isikhathi sishoda, futhi kungaba usuku olubi uma sivuka kusasa sithole ukuthi awekho ukudla. Manje sekuyisikhathi sethu sokubona ukuthi ngaphansi kwezimo zamanje, lokhu kungase kwenzeke kusasa. Amanani omkhiqizo ahlobene nezindleko zokuqala ezivela phesheya, kanti iNingizimu Afrika yaziwa ngokuba nezindleko eziphezulu kunezinye izinkanyezi emhlabeni. Ukwanda kwezindleko kukhula ngesivinini esiphakeme kunenani lomkhiqizo - lokhu kubeka ingcindezi enkulu kubafuyi ngoba kukhona ingozi phambili. Ukuvuna nokuba nekhono lokukhiqiza kungavimbela le nkinga. Ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kubalulekile uma sifuna ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokukhiqiza. Kodwa sinezinkinga ngoba uhulumeni akahlinzeki ngemali eyanele ukuze kwenziwe lezi zihlolo futhi kuxazululwe le nkinga ngempumelelo. Inani lokwanda kwam价格 lifuna ukuthi inzuzo ngohlangothi ihambisane nalokho okukhiqizwayo, noma ukuthi lokho okukhiqizwayo kufanele kwandiswe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindawo lapho kukhula khona izitshalo kumele zande ukuze zihambisane nezidingo zenzuzo. Ngamanye amazwi, uma abafuyi abasha abangenela ezolimo befuna ukuphumelela, kumele basebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha ngendlela efanele. Inhloso kufanele ihambisane nezimo zezimali. Abafuyi abasha bathembela kulabo abangahlinzeka ngolwazi nokwesekwa okuqhubekayo - lokhu kuyisisekelo seGFADA. Ukulima kuy umsebenzi onezinselelo nezingozi, ikakhulukazi uma sibhekene neminyaka emibi ezindaweni zethu. Uma sibheka imali engenayo, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imakethe ihlobene nemakethe zangaphandle kanye nezinguquko zezimali lapha nasemhlabeni. Lokhu akusibo ezandleni zabafuyi. Imakethe iyahluka futhi iyalinganiswa naleyo evela phesheya naleyo esuka lapha. Imakethe yokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi ihambisana nalokho okubizwa ngokuthi izindlela zemakethe ezikhululekile, ezikhombisa ukubaluleka kwalokho okudingekayo nokutholakalayo. Ukukhiqiza lapha eNingizimu Afrika kudlula lokho okudingekayo, ngakho-ke ukuthengisa phesheya akukhiqizi inzuzo enhle. Ukukhiqizwa emhlabeni jikelele futhi kuphakeme kudala imakethe yehlise. Futhi imithetho kahulumeni ivimbela ukuthuthukiswa kwemakethe emisha efana nezibani ze-biofuels. Abafuyi baseNingizimu Afrika abatholi ukwesekwa okukhulu kuhulumeni, futhi manje baphumelela ukuhweba nezizwe lapho uhulumeni esekela abafuyi. Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika kufanele acabangele ukushintsha ukulawulwa kwezimali ukuze ahlinzeke ngenkxaso engcono kubafuyi, bese abathengi bezokwazi ukuphila kangcono.
Ukushoda Kothisha Ezikoleni: Isifundo Esibalulekile Namuhla, ukuhamba phambili kwemfundo kuncike ekutholeni izinsiza ezanele, kuhlanganisa uthisha onekhono. Nokho, njengoba izikole zikhula, inkinga yokushoda kothisha iyavela. Le nkinga ibalulekile, njengoba ithinta umphakathi wonke, ikakhulukazi abafundi. Isizathu Sokushoda Kothisha Ukuze siqonde le nkinga kahle, kufanele sibuze imibuzo ethile. Kungani sithi kunoshoda kothisha? Okokuqala, ukuntula izinsiza ezanele kumasipala, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, kubangela ukuthi kube nzima ukuthola abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe. Izikhangiso zomsebenzi azitholakali kalula, futhi lapho zikhona, izizathu ezifana nokukhula kwemali yokuphila zenza kube nzima ukuheha uthisha onekhono. Umthelela Wokushoda Kothisha Umthelela wokushoda kothisha ubonakala ezindaweni eziningi. Okokuqala, abafundi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukuthola imfundo efanele, okukhokelela ekunciphiseni amathuba abo okuphumelela empilweni. Uthisha omncane ungenza kube nzima ukufundisa kahle, okubonakala kakhulu ezifundweni eziyinkimbinkimbi ezifana nezibalo nezesayensi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukushoda kothisha kudala ukucindezeleka kubo bonke abasebenzi bezikole, okukhuthaza ukungakhathaleli izifundo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekuncipheni kwesimilo sezikole. Imiphumela iyazwakala, njengoba izikole ziba nezinga eliphansi lokufunda, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi abafundi bathole amakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele empilweni. Izixazululo Ezingaba Yindlela Yokuphumelela Kucacile ukuthi kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kulwiswe le nkinga. Okokuqala, kudingeka ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlonza abafundi ukuze baphumelele emfundweni yokufundisa. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuhlinzekwa ngamasheya afanele, izifundo ezithokozisayo, kanye nemihlahlandlela eqinile yokufundisa. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo kumathisha kungaba yindlela enhle yokukhuthaza abasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezikude, okuhlanganisa izifundo ezikhokhelwayo, amathuba okuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezizobasiza ukuthi bakhulise amakhono abo. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambelele kumaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa izikole, kuhlanganise nokuxhumana nabazali nabezindaba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi injongo yokufundisa iyaphumelela. Ubulungiswa kumele busebenze ngezinga eliphezulu, ukuze bonke abafundi bathole imfundo efanele. Isiphetho Ukushoda kothisha ezikoleni akusiyona inkinga encane. Kubalulekile ukuqonda imithelela yayo, ukuba nezixazululo ezilungile, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, neziphathimandla. Uma singakwazi ukuxazulula le nkinga, sizobhekana nezinkinga ezimbi empilweni yabafundi, umphakathi, kanye nezwe. Ngakho, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze sithuthukise imfundo, siqinisekise ukuthi abantwana bethu bathola ithuba elihle lokufunda, futhi bakhulise amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele empilweni.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI emsebenzini Ngaphakathi komhlaba osezingeni eliphezulu lobuchwepheshe, ukukhiqizwa kwemisebenzi kwashintsha kakhulu. Lokhu kuqala kwaziswa uThando, owayengumqondisi wezobuchwepheshe enkampanini enkulu yokukhiqiza. UThando wayenamaphupho amakhulu ngomsebenzi wakhe, kodwa wayefuna ukuthola izindlela zokwenza izinto zibe lula futhi zisebenze kahle. Ngemva kokufunda ngempumelelo ye-AI emikhakheni ehlukene, wanquma ukuthi kufanele azame ukuyisebenzisa ukuze athuthukise ukusebenza kwenkampani yakhe. UThando wanxusa umhlangano nabaphathi abaphezulu enkampanini, lapho echaza khona izinzuzo ezinkulu ze-AI. “Uma sithatha leli thuba,” kusho yena, “singakwazi ukuhlela imisebenzi yethu ngezindlela ezingakaze zenzeke phambilini. I-AI ingasiza ekutholeni izinkinga ezingase zibe khona, ithuthukise ikhwalithi yokukhiqiza, futhi ikhulise imali engenayo.” Abaphathi bahlala behlola uThando, bejabulile ngenkathi ethokozisa isithakazelo sabo. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo sokusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-AI, uThando wanikela ngephrojekthi yokuhlola. Yena nabantu bakhe basebenzisana nezingcweti ze-AI ukuze bathole uhlelo olwakhelwe ukuba luthuthukise izinqubo zokukhiqiza. Uhlelo lwalufaneleka ngokukhethekile ezinqubweni zokuhlola, lapho ubuchwepheshe be-AI bengingaya khona ukususa imiphumela engalungile. Ngesikhathi uThando esebenzisa lezi zinhlelo, waqala ukubona izinguquko ezinkulu. Imishini yokuqala iboniswa iidatha ezinkulu ezazitholakala ngempela, futhi lokho kwavula ithuba lokuthola izixazululo eziphumelelayo. UThando wabona ukuthi izinkampani ezahlukahlukene seziqalile ukufaka izinhlelo ezifanayo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi badinga ukuhamba phambili ukuze bangashiywa ngemuva. Njengoba isikhathi sithuthuka, uThando waqala ukuhlela ama-workshop ukuze afundise abasebenzi bakhe ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani i-AI. Abasebenzi baye bakhombisa ukulangazelela, bekubona lokhu njengendlela yokuthola amakhono amasha. UThando wathola ukuthi abantu abavame ukudideka nge-AI, benza ukungaqondi kahle. Kwaqhubeka isikhathi, waqala ukubona izinguquko ezinhle emsebenzini. Uhlelo lwe-AI lwaluhamba phambili, futhi imiphumela yalo yayiqhakaza. UThando wathola ukuthi izinkampani ezincane ziyaqhakaza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi lokho kwazisa uThando. “Siyaphila!” wakhuluma uzithokozisa. “I-AI iyasiza, kodwa kudingeka sibe nezinselelo ezithile. Kumele sithole indlela yokusebenza ndawonye nezinkampani ezincane.” Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThando wanquma ukwakha ubudlelwano nezinkampani ezincane ezisebenzisa i-AI, ukuze bathuthukise imikhiqizo yabo. Lokhu kwathokozisa izinkampani, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuxhumana. UThando wathola ukuthi ngempela, i-AI iyithuluzi elihle, kodwa abantu badinga ukuqonda imiphumela yalo. UThando waqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi i-AI ingabathinta kanjani. Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThando waqala ukubona izinguquko ezinkulu. Ukusebenza kwenkampani kwakukhula, futhi izinto zaziqhubeka kahle. Abasebenzi babejabule, futhi ukwanda kwemali kwaba yinto ejabulisayo. UThando wabona ukuthi izinzuzo ze-AI zazingaphezu kokulindelekile. Yena nabanye abaphethe bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona njengokusebenzisana, kodwa kudinga abantu abaqondayo. Ngesikhathi uqhubeka nesikhathi, uThando wathola ukuthi i-AI iyakwazi ukwakha amathuba amasha emsebenzini. Kwadingeka ukucatshangelwa okuphezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bakhuliswa, futhi lokhu kwaba umgomo wakhe. UThando wathola ukuthi i-AI iyathinta wonke umuntu, inikeza amathuba awamukelwe kangcono. Ekugcineni, uThando wanquma ukuthi kufanele anakekele umphakathi, akhulume ngezinguquko ezenzakalayo. Waqala ukubamba izinkulumo eziningi ezikhuthaza abanye ukuba basebenzise i-AI, wabelana ngezinto ezinhle ezitholakele. Ukuze abanye bakwazi ukuphila kahle, uThando uvula iminyango yokufunda ezikhungweni zokufundisa. Kwakungasasekelwa uThando kuphela, kodwa izinkampani zabe seziqala ukwakha ubudlelwano. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokudala izinhlelo ezichwepheshile, ezazithuthukisa imisebenzi emisha. UThando wabona ukuthi izinzuzo ze-AI azizange zibe kuphela ezingxenyeni zomsebenzi, kodwa zafaka isandla ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo ezithinta umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, uThando wakhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisa i-AI emsebenzini akukhona nje ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kahle, kodwa kuhlanganisa abantu, ubuchwepheshe, nezixazululo ezilungile. Umhlaba kaThando waba umhlaba omusha, lapho zonke izidingo zifinyeleleka, futhi lokho kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Njengoba iminyaka ihamba, umhlaba waba neziqu, ezazihamba phambili, ezazibhekwa nguThando nozakwabo. UThando waba yisibonelo sokuthi i-AI ingaguqula kanjani izimpilo zethu, ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ubunyangamali bethu njengabantu.
Umgomo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho 8 ka-1996 uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguhulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zakhe, futhi umthetho kazwelonke kufanele udalwe ukuze unikeze amandla kulolu lungelo. UMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 (uMthetho 2 ka-2000), ophumelele kulolu lungelo, waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa 2001. Inhloso eyinhloko yalolu mthetho ukukhuthaza isiko lokukhanya nokubhekelela ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezizimele futhi ukhuthaze umphakathi ukufinyelela ulwazi oluwusizo ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa ngokuphelele amalungelo abo. Ngokusho kwalolu mthetho, uMphathiswa-Jikelele weMnyango Wezangaphandle ungumsebenzi wolwazi wale Mnyango. UMphathiswa-Jikelele uqoka oMsebenzi Ababambisene Nabo kulowo Mnyango. Ihhovisi leMphathiswa-Jikelele lizoba yisisekelo sokwamukela izicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale ndatshana ukujwayelisa amalungu omphakathi nezinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kutholakale amadokhumenti agcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle. Umbono weMnyango Wezangaphandle uwukwakha i-Afrika ehambisana, ethule, enedemokhrasi, engakhethi, ehlanganisiwe futhi ukubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umhlaba onobulungiswa nowenelisayo. UMnyango Wezangaphandle uzinikele ekukhuthazeni izintshisekelo nezimiso zaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuvuselela i-Afrika, nokwakha umhlaba ongcono kubantu bonke. Ukwakha nokuphatha ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba baseNingizimu Afrika nokukhuthaza izinhloso zezinqubomgomo zangaphandle. Ukuqapha intuthuko yamazwe omhlaba nokunikeza izeluleko kuhulumeni ngezinhlelo zangaphandle nezindaba zendawo ezihlobene nazo. Noma yiluphi ulwazi olubhaliwe olugcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle lungacelwa. Gcwalisa ifomu elibekiwe le-Fomu A elikhishwe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni inombolo R187 edlulelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002 (bona isheduli 2); futhi ukhokhe imali ebekiwe ekhombisa eshedulini 1 yale ndatshana. Nokho, umceli ofuna ukuboniswa amadokhumenti aqukethe ulwazi lwakhe siqu akadingeki ukukhokha imali yokucela. Lo mcela kufanele akhombise ukuthi isicelo sikhona ezithombeni zezincwadi ezigcinwe noma ukuthi ufuna ukubona amadokhumenti uqobo ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ukutholakala kwalolu lwazi kuzothunyelwa kumceli ngendlela abacelile ukuba kuboniswe, ngaphandle uma le ndlela eceliwe izophazamisa kakhulu ukusebenza nokusebenza kweMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ibangele umonakalo noma umonakalo kumadokhumenti noma iphule amalungelo edokhumenti. Uma, ngezizathu zokusebenza, amadokhumenti angatholakala ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngenye indlela, imali yokuthola amadokhumenti izobala ngokuya ngendlela umceli acelile ukuba aboniswe. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enokukhubazeka, angacela ngomlomo, lapho umphakathi wolwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu ngaye futhi umnike ifomu eliphelile. Uma efuna ukwaziswa ngempumelelo yesicelo ngefoni noma ngenye indlela. Isikhundla esisetshenziselwa ukufaka isicelo, uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Umceli kufanele athumele isicelo sakhe ehhovisi elibekiwe lokwamukela izicelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, elizobe likhuphula leso sicelo. Ngemuva kokuba umphakathi wolwazi wenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umceli kufanele waziswe ngalokho isinqumo ngendlela abathanda ngayo ukuba baziwe. Uma, ngemuva kokulandela zonke izidingo zokusebenza ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 4. Uma umceli efuna ukufaka isikhalazo, ifomu lesikhalazo elibekiwe elikhishwe ngokwaziswa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni inombolo R187 edlulelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002 kufanele igcwaliswe. Uma umceli enganelisekile ngesinqumo somphakathi wolwazi okukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 4.3.1 ngenhla, isikhalazo singathunyelwa kuNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Umceli angathatha le ndaba enkantolo uma enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Bona Isheduli 1. Ngokusho komthetho, amanye ama-rekhodi angatholwa ngaphandle kokwenza isicelo ngokomthetho. Lezi zinkampani zingafinyelelwa ku-inthanethi yeMnyango Wezangaphandle kule ndawo: www.dfa.gov. Ezocwaningo: Iqhaza Ebalulekile Empilweni Yansuku zonke Ezocwaningo ziningi kakhulu imithombo yokuqonda, ukucacisa, nokuxazulula izinkinga ezithinta abantu. Ngaphakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene ezifana nezemfundo, ezempilo, kanye nezobuchwepheshe, ezocwaningo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ulwazi, ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo enembile, nokwakha izixazululo ezintsha. Le mihlathi isihlola indlela ezocwaningo ezinikeza ngayo umbono ophusile ngempilo yethu, iqhubeka nokuqhakambisa ukufaneleka kokudala, nokuhlonipha izimiso zokucwaninga. Ukwazi Ngempela: Umqondo Wokucwaninga Ukucwaninga akuyona nje inqubo yokuhlola noma yokuhlola imizamo ethile, kodwa kunalokho kuwumqondo owakheke ngezinyawo ezine: ukuhlela, ukuqoqwa, ukuhlaziya, nokuxhumanisa idatha. Ukuze kube kokucwaninga okufanele, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezimiso eziqinile ezihlonipha ukuhambelana, ubuqiniso, kanye nokusebenza. Izinto ezisemqoka ekwakheni udaba lokucwaninga zifaka phakathi ukukhombisa ubufakazi, ukucacisa izinjongo, kanye nokugwema ukujolisa ngezizathu. Ubuchwepheshe Obuthuthukisiwe Nezindlela Zokucwaninga Ngokwenyuka kwezobuchwepheshe, izindlela zokucwaninga ziye zaguquleka. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, njengezinkundla zemidiya, ukuhlanganiswa kwedatha, nezinsiza zokuhlaziya, kukhulise imikhakha ehlukahlukene yokucwaninga. Izigidi eziningana zedatha ziqoqwa nsuku zonke, zenzela abacwaningi ithuba elikhulu lokuhlola izimo ezithile ngendlela engakaze ibonwe ngaphambili. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi nokukhathazeka, kudala ithuba lokuthola imiphumela esheshayo, futhi okuyinto ebalulekile ezindabeni ezinjengezempilo, ezemfundo, nezomnotho. Izicelo Zokucwaninga Eziyisisekelo Nezemvelo Izicelo zokucwaninga ziyakhula zidlula emkhakheni, zibhekisiswe ezimweni ezithinta ikakhulukazi impilo yomphakathi. Ekubhekeni izimo ezinjengokugula, ezocwaningo ziyaqhubeka zisebenza ukwakha izindlela ezintsha zokulawula izifo. Izinhlelo zokuhlola nezokuqonda izithintelo zomphakathi kudinga ubuqiniso, lapho abacwaningi begxila ezindleleni ezithinta abantu. Engxenyeni yezemfundo, izinhlelo zabo bokufunda ziguquguquka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuhlanganiswe nosuku nesikhathi bayanakuzwa ukuze kuqashelwe intuthuko nezinguquko. Ukubaluleka KweZifundo Zokucwaninga Okwamanje, ezocwaningo zikhuthaza ukufunda okuhlukeneyo. Abantu bangephumela emiphumeleni yokucwaninga ethula ukuqonda komhlaba jikelele. Izifundo ezitholakalayo zinezinsiza eziqinile ezivumela abantu ukuba baqonde izinkinga zomhlaba, ukuze badlule ezindaweni ezinzima. Kanjalo, abacwaningi bahlala bevuna abantwana nabathintekayo ukuze bashiye umhlaba ungcono. Lokhu kuhloswe ukufaka isandla esihle phakathi kwemiphakathi, ukwakha umqondo omnandi nemfundo ebanzi kumphakathi. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Ezingaphikiswa Kwezocwaningo Njengoba ezocwaningo zingahamba phambili, kufanele kuxazululwe izithiyo ezikhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuphazamiseka kwemali, ukungawenzi kahle umkhankaso, noma ukuntula indawo yokuhlala ethile yocwaningo. Zithinta kakhulu abantu abavuka emizweni yokwazi. Ukuhambisana nezimiso ezithile zokucwaninga, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okungekho emthethweni noma okuphindaphindiwe kuyinselelo enkulu. Ithuba Lokuhlola neMiphumela Yokucwaninga Ukubaluleka kokucwaninga akukwazi ukukhishwa phansi. Ukugcizelela lesi simo, abantu badinga ukwenza izinyathelo ezithile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi ezocwaningo azigcini endaweni engeziwe, kepha zisebenza ukusiza ukuhlola umhlaba, nezinkinga ezithinta abantu. Ucwaningo olusemthethweni lwenza kube lula ukufinyelela komphakathi, ludala imiphumela engcono nolwazi olunembile. Ukuphumelela Nokusebenziseka Kwezocwaningo Ekugcineni, umphakathi wesikhathi samanje udinga ukuxhumana namathuba ngendlela ezocwaningo ezithinta ngayo impilo yansuku zonke. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuzifaka ezibopheni ezingekho emthethweni, kufike effusively ukufinyelela kuthuthukisani elokhetho. Ukuphumelela kuzobalwa ezikhathini ezizayo, ukukhombisa ukuthi ezocwaningo azigcini nje ngokukhulisa ulwazi, kodwa futhi ukudlulisela umnqamulajuqu obalulekile kumphakathi. Ngakho, ezocwaningo zihlala ziyisifundo esiyinsakavukela, esizenzakalayo, nesihlanzekile. Ziyaguqula umqondo wethu, zisikhumbuza ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi okuhle kakhulu kuza kulabo abavuma ukuhamba nathi kulolu hambo lokucwaninga. Lokhu kusebenza kumuntu ngamunye, kuthinta umhlaba wonke. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ezocwaningo ziyisenzo sokuphefumula somphakathi, futhi ziyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Iphrofayela Yomuntu: UThandekile Mthembu - Umholi Kwezobuchwepheshe Beselula Ekuseni okukhanya ilanga, uThandekile Mthembu, umholi ohloniphekile kwezobuchwepheshe beselula, uqala usuku lwakhe. Wazalwa eThekwini, uThandekile uthanda ubuchwepheshe, okwakuholela ekutheni aqhubeke nendlela yakhe yokuphila. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezenhlalo, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi efunda eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona iziqu zeziMali nezeNkampani, kodwa wakhanga kakhulu ezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ezinhlelweni zokusebenza zefoni. Njengomuntu ophusile, waqala umsebenzi wakhe emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, eqonda izidingo zabathengi. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula buwumgibeli obalulekile emphakathini, waqala ukukhuthaza imiklamo ethuthukisa impilo. UThandekile ukholelwa ekutheni ubuchwepheshe kufanele busebenze njengensiza yokuxhumana, hhayi nje indawo yokudlala. Ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa, uThandekile wabona ithuba lokwakha inkampani yakhe yokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Lokhu kwaba umqondo ophumelelayo, futhi inkampani yakhe, i-Tech Innovations, yathola udumo olukhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. UThandekile nozakwabo badala izinhlelo zokusebenza ezidumile, ezifana ne-app yokuxhumana nemindeni, engeza kalula kubantu abangabakhulumayo. UThandekile uqhubeka nokukhuthaza impumelelo emiphakathini esezingeni eliphansi, eqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni ezibalulekile ukuze baphumelele. Uhlanga lwakhe lwezobuchwepheshe luhlanganisa imikhankaso yokufunda, uhlelo lokuxhumana oluthuthukile, nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhiqiza imisebenzi. Njengoba edlula eminyakeni, uThandekile waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula bungaba yindlela yokuphila engcono. Uqhuba imihlangano nemicimbi yokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe emiphakathini, elwela ukufaka izinhlelo ezisimeme nezithuthukayo ezithinta izwe lonke. Ubuye abhale izindatshana kwi-intanethi ezicacisa indlela uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe oluhlanganyela ngayo embonini. UThandekile ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula akusizi kuphela ezimeni ezinzima, kodwa futhi kungenza kube lula ukuphila kwansuku zonke. Ubuye abe nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni abesifazane emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ekhuthaza abesifazane ukuba baphumelele futhi balwe nezithiyo ezithinta umkhakha wezobuchwepheshe. UThandekile ukhombisa ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma bekhuthazekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThandekile waba neqhaza elibalulekile emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, kufaka phakathi ezemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuxhumana, futhi uthole imiklomelo eminingi, ehlanganisa neziqu zokuhlonipha ezivela emiphakathini ehlukahlukene. Ngokukhuluma ngempilo yakhe, uThandekile uthanda ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula, ikakhulukazi uma ehamba emizileni ye-KZN, lapho abuye abone khona ubuhle bemvelo. Ukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, baphumule emsebenzini, futhi bathole isikhathi sokuzithokozisa. Njengomholi ohlonishwayo, uThandekile Mthembu ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula bungaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ubuye waba yisibonelo sokuthi impumelelo ibalulekile, kodwa ukuhlonipha abantu, imvelo, nesiko kumele kubhekwane, ukuze sifeze ikusasa eliqhakazile. UThandekile usaqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu abaningi, ebakhombisa indlela yokuphumelela, hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa nempilo jikelele.
iTakealot: Ukuhlola Isipiliyoni Sokuthenga Ngedijithali Ngokukhula kokuxhumana kwedijithali, izinkampani eziningi zifaka izandla emkhakheni wezohwebo. Phakathi kwazo, iTakealot ikhethwa njengenye yezindawo ezihamba phambili zokuthenga online eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu njengoba iTakealot ihlinzeka abantu ithuba lokuthenga kalula ngaphandle kokuphuma emakhaya. Kulokhu, sizohlola izici ezihlukene zeTakealot, ukuhamba kwezinto, nezinsizakalo zayo. Ukubekwa Kwezimikhiqizo Nezithombe Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqhakambisa ukukhethwa kwezinto kweTakealot. Iwebhusayithi inezigaba eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinsiza, izinto zokudlala, izinto zokugqoka, nezokuhamba. Lokhu kuhlinzeka abakhasimende ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nezinto abakuthengayo. Izithombe ezicacile nezichazayo zenza kube lula kubathengi ukuhlole imikhiqizo ngaphambi kokwenza isinqumo. Uhlanga lwezithombe lwenziwe ngokuqapha ukuze luhambisane nomkhiqizo, futhi nezincazelo ezinemininingwane ziqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bazi kahle lokho abakuthengayo. Ukwenza Amakhasi Nokuhamba Kalula Uma kuziwa ekusebenzeni kwe-website, iTakealot ibonakala ikwazi kahle. Amakhasi ahamba kahle, futhi izigaba zihlukaniswe kahle, okuvumela abathengi ukuba bathole kalula lezi zinto abafuna ukuzithenga. Ukuze uthole umkhiqizo othile, kubalulekile ukuthi usebenzise ibhakhodi yokusesha, elula kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma uthanda ukuthola okuthile ngokuqondile. Izinsizakalo Zokukhokha Nezokuhambisa Enye yezinto eziphawulekayo ngama-ecommerce platforms yindlela zokukhokha ezikhona. ITakealot inikeza abakhasimende izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokukhokha, okuhlanganisa nekhadi lesikweletu, i-PayPal, kanye nezinketho zokukhokha ngqo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula futhi kuphephe ukukhokha, okubalulekile kumakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsizakalo zokuhambisa ziqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bathola izinto zabo ngesikhathi. ITakealot inikeza izinketho ezibalulekile zokuhambisa, kuhlanganiswa nezinsizakalo ezenzakalayo, okuvumela abathengi ukukhetha ukuthi bafeze order yabo emzini noma endaweni ethile. Ukuxhumana Kwezinkonzo Zamakhasimende Noma ngabe sithenga online, izinkinga nezimo zenzeka. Lokhu kubonisa ubuchule beTakealot ekuxhumaneni nezinsizakalo zamakhasimende. Idivayisi yenkonzo ikhululekile, ifaka ingxoxo ye-live, namakholi, okwenzeka kalula. Abakhi beTakealot bahlala belindele ukusizakala, okuwusizo kumakhasimende uma behlangabezana nezinkinga, okwenza abathengi bazizwe bejabule. Imibono neMbono Yabathengi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iTakealot ithole ukubuyekezwa okuhle kakhulu. Abathengi baveza ukwamukela okukhulu okuhlangenwe nakho kwabo, ikakhulukazi ekukhetheni nasekusebenzeni. Lokhu kudalile umqondo wokuthi iTakealot iyinkonzo ethembekile, okuyinto ebalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo. Abantu basendaweni yokwazisa, futhi uma umkhiqizo ungahlangabezani nezidingo zabo, kusebenza kahle ukuthola izinsizakalo zokubuyisela. Isiphetho Kucacile ukuthi iTakealot seyiphumelele emkhakheni wezohwebo online eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokugqamisa ukukhethwa kwezinto, ukusebenza kahle kwe-website, izinsizakalo eziphezulu zokuhambisa, kanye nezinsizakalo zamakhasimende ezithembekile, iTakealot ibonakala iyinkampani ehamba phambili enezeluleko ezinhle kumakhasimende. Njengoba izikhathi zishintsha, ukuthuthukiswa kweTakealot kuzoba nomthelela empilweni yabathengi, okuholela ekuthengeni online. Abathengi abajabule bazothola imikhiqizo ehamba phambili kalula nangempumelelo. Ngakho, uma udinga ukuthenga online, iTakealot ingaba yindlela efanele yokwenza lokhu.
Amabhange Amabhange, njengemikhiqizo ebalulekile emnothweni, ahlale edlala indima enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ukusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuhweba, lapho abantu babebhadalela izimpahla ngezinsiza ezahlukahlukene, amabhange abe yinsika yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, nemiphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, amabhange ahlinzeka ngesevisi ezahlukene ezinjengezimali, ukonga, nezinsizakalo zokuhweba, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amabhange athuthukile futhi ahlale ethuthukisa izinsizakalo zawo ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabantu. Namuhla, sinamabhange amaningi, kusukela kumabhange amakhulu ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibanzi, kuya kumabhange amancane ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amabhange akhula ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi ahlale ebheke phambili ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abathengi bathola okungcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange anendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho. Ngaphandle kokugcina izimali, amabhange anikeza imali yokubolekwa, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu nabezindaba baphumelele ezinhlelweni zabo zokutshala imali. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinkampani, ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, nokwandiswa kwemikhakha ehlukene yomnotho. Amabhange, ngakho-ke, akhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, futhi ahlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphila kwabantu. Ukwengeza, amabhange adlala indima ebalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi. Ngamabhange, abantu bangakwazi ukonga imali, baphathe izikweletu, futhi baqonde kahle izindleko zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Amabhange ahlinzeka ngolwazi, izeluleko, nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa ukuqonda kwabantu ngezindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye bahlala bukhula emabhange. Namuhla, amabhange anikeza izinsizakalo eziku-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuthokozisa, njengoba abantu bengakwazi ukuphatha izimali zabo kalula, noma ngabe bakhulumela emsebenzini noma emakhaya. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamabhange nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe kudalile izixazululo ezithuthukile, ezithuthukisa indlela esiphila ngayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amabhange abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhula kwezinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezimali, njengezimali eziku-inthanethi, kudinga amabhange ukuba aqhubeke ethuthukisa izinsizakalo zawo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni amabhange azame ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza, ukuze ahlale ethokozisa abathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko emthethweni nasezinhlelweni zomnotho zidinga ukuthi amabhange azivumelanise nezimo ezintsha, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ahlale evikelekile. Amabhange, ngaphezu kwalokho, abhekene nezinkinga zokuphepha. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, izingozi zokweba idatha zikhula. Amabhange kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zawo ziphephile, ukuze abathengi baziqinisekise ukuthi izimali zabo ziphephile. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu kanye nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuphepha. Ekugcineni, amabhange azinze emnothweni, futhi adlala indima enkulu empilweni yomuntu. Ukugcina, ukuphatha, nokuhlinzeka ngempilo yezimali, amabhange akha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphila kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle indima yawo, ukuze sikwazi ukuwasebenzisa kahle. Amabhange akhuluma ngempilo yethu, futhi kufanele sihlole ubudlelwano bethu nawo, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu nempilo yomphakathi. Ngamafuphi, amabhange awekho nje kuphela njengemiphakathi yokugcina izimali, kodwa futhi njengabalingani ababalulekile empilweni yethu. Ukuzigcina, ukugcina, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukile, amabhange akha umnotho, ahlale ethuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi aqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo eziphusile ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde kahle amabhange, imisebenzi yawo, nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuze sithole ithuba lokuphila kahle.
Isizinda sikahlobo lwehlobo sokukhiqiza sesisondele ekupheleni ezindaweni eziningi, futhi abaphathi basebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola umkhiqizo. Sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola lezi zinsiza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zizokwazi ukukusebenzela ngonyaka ozayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho amaphutha emaphaketheni nasezindaweni eziseduze nepompo. Hlola ukuthi amaphakethe amanzi asekhona futhi aqinile ngoba ajwayele ukujula uma uwoyela ewela kuwo. Hlola ukuthi ikhava ye-radiator isaqinile kahle. Uma ubona ukuthi amanzi aphansi kodwa ungatholi enye indawo evulekile, kungase kube ukuthi lekhava evulekile - shintsha ngayo entsha. Kubalulekile ukukhokha wonke amanzi ezinhlelweni zokupholisa minyaka yonke futhi uphumelele i-anti-freeze entsha. Khumbula ukuthi i-hlobo isondela, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba ne-anti-freeze entsha. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthenga i-anti-freeze efanele, futhi ungahlanganisi izinhlobo ezahlukene zemibala ngoba azifani. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafan belts asakhula kahle. Hlola futhi uqiniseke ibhande. Uma kukhona ama-belt amabili futhi elilodwa likhathazekile lokuphuka, kufanele ushintshe kokubili ngezintsha ukuze zisebenze kahle. Hlola ukuthi awekho amaphutha emathangeni kuze kube lapho i-diesel ingena khona ezinjini. Qinisekisa ukuthi ithangi likhanya, futhi hlola ukuthi i-filter yangaphakathi isasebenza. Faka ama-filter e-diesel amasha kuzo zonke izindawo. Hlanza umtrap we-manzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi ithangi le-diesel lihlale liphumelele ngoba uma kukhona umoya ethangini, iba amanzi. Lawa manzi angalimaza ipompo ye-injector. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi ukuthi isikhathi sokukh service abaphathi bakho - kungase kube isikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela nokufaka i-filter entsha. Uma sekuyisikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela we-differential kanye ne-gearbox, khumbula ukushintsha lezi zifilitha futhi (khumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwe-hydraulic lusebenzisa lo mwelo, ngakho hlola amaphutha). Uma ubuyekeza abaphathi, hlola ukuthi awekho uwoyela ow leaking lapho ufaka khona i-filter noma ku-sump cap. Hlola zonke izindawo lapho uwoyela ungavuleka khona - faka ama-seals amasha uma kudingeka. Faka i-grease kuzo zonke izindawo (ku-shaft yokuhamba nezinye izixhumi). Hlola ama-air filters - ingabe asasebenza futhi akhanya - faka amasha uma kudingeka. Hlola amaphakethe lapho umoya uphumelelwa khona, uqiniseke zonke izixhumi. Ibhethri - ibhethri kufanele ikhululeke ngokuphelele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele, uma ephansi, thela amanzi ebhethrini (ungawathola esitolo sebhathri). Khipha izintambo zebhethri futhi uhlanze. Buya izintambo kahle futhi faka i-grease encane lapho zixhunywe khona ukuvimbela ukugqwala kwe-asidi. Hlola ukuthi intambo exhunyiwe kumshini kanye nekhanda elixhunyiwe ku-starter iqinile. Qinisekisa ukuthi izintambo zikagesi azinayo i-grease noma uwoyela futhi ziqinile kahle kuzo zonke izindawo (lokhu kuvimbela ukushisa, ukuvibha, nokumanzisa). Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izibani zokuxwayisa nezilinganiso zisebenza kahle - uma uthinta ukhiye wokuvula, konke kufanele kukhanye. (Izibani zok pressure ye-oyela nezibani ze-alternator kufanele zikhanye uma uthinta ukhiye, kufanele zikhanye uma umshini uqala - ezinye izibani zizokhanya uma kukhona inkinga endaweni ethile). Hlola zonke ama-fuses njalo. Amathayi kufanele ahlale esesimweni esihle - akufanele kube nezikhala, izindawo ezilimazekile, noma ama-bulges. Hlola ukuthi ukujula kuhambisana kahle futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ibhalansi yamanzi nomoya kumathayi angemuva ilungile. Hlola izinyathelo zamathayi ahamba umshini - uma ziqinile, azikwazi ukubamba kahle. Hlola ukuthi izinyathelo zamathayi wonke ahlelekile ukuze ahambe phambili. Izinto ezihamba phambili zomphathi zineqhaza elibalulekile, ngakho kunezinto eziningi ezingaguga ngokushesha. Kubalulekile ukuthi ama-bushings, ama-bearings, kanye ne-gearbox konke kube sesimweni esihle. Uma kukhona izingxenye ezigugile, kungadala ukuthi umphathi ungaphatheki kahle endleleni - lokhu kungadala ingozi ngoba umshayeli akanawo amandla okulawula umphathi kahle, futhi kubangela ukuguga kwamathayi. Kukhona ama-plates akhethekile avikela umphathi (umbala wabo uvamise ukufana nalowo womphathi). Inhloso yalezi ziplate ukuvikela umshayeli nezinto ezihambayo. Njalo lezi ziplate ziya zikhula, futhi kwesinye isikhathi azikho. Kubalulekile ukuzigcina kumphathi, shintsha lezo ezingekho, futhi hlola ukuthi ama-bolts abamba aqinile kahle. Izingxenye lapho ezinye izinto zixhunywe futhi ziqinisiwe ngumphathi kufanele zihlale ziqinile. Sebenzisa ama-pins afanele usayizi uma udonsa ezinye izinto ngoba azinawo umthwalo ofanayo - ama-pins amancane athwala umthwalo wonke walokho okudonswayo, futhi yibo kuphela abamba ibhande lokudonsa. Iziphumo eziningi zenzeka uma lezi zingxenye zingahlolwanga kahle.
Ozakwethu bomphakathi bez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele bamukelekile ukukhetha abantu abazokhonzela njengoMphakathi weMnyuziyamu uLuthuli. Lo Mphakathi uzoba namalungu angaphezu kweziyi-7 aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi, kanye nobuchwepheshe. Omunye wamalungu kumele abe nolwazi oluthile lwezezimali. Ulwazi olujulile nge-heritage kazwelonke, ulwazi olujulile lokuphatha kanye nezimali, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokuxhumana, ulwazi lokuthola uxhaso, imfundo, kanye nocwaningo lwesayensi, kanye nomdlandla wokusebenza komphakathi nolwazi oluthile ngemicimbi yeMnyuziyamu uLuthuli kuyadingeka. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha ithimba elizokwakha uhlu lwabafanele abavela ezithakazelweni ezikhethiweyo. Imiyalelo yeqembu izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kuhlanganisa abantu abaneziqu ezifanele zemfundo noma ulwazi olukhethekile noma labo abanomdlandla ezindaweni ezithile ezihlobene, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi othile abe ngomunye wamalungu. Imiyalelo yeqembu izophinde iqinisekise ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kuhlanganisa abantu bazo zonke izindawo zomphakathi nobulili obubili, nokuthi ukukhethwa konke kuhamba kahle. Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumuntu okhethiweyo, lapho bevuma ukuthi igama labo likhethwe; kanye namagama abantu abathathu abangaxhumana nabo abazi lowo muntu okhethiweyo futhi banganikeza izinkomba ngabo. Awukho umkhawulo wamagama abantu abakhethiweyo, kodwa hhayi konke lokhu kubhalwe ngenhla.
Inkantolo Yomthethosisekelo Kwake kwaba nesikhathi lapho abantu baseMzansi benqaba ukuchitha isikhathi bephakathi kokuphila kwansuku zonke. Izinkinga zekhaya, zomsebenzi, nezombusazwe zazivama ukudla iminyaka yabo. Kodwa, emoyeni, bekukhona ithemba elincane, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo, ehlala ibhalwe emakhanda abantu. Le nkantolo, yayingumqondisi wamalungelo, yayingumlamuli wezwi labantu. Ngosuku olukhanyayo, uSibusiso, umuntu ojwayelekile ohlala eThekwini, wayehamba emgwaqweni edolobheni. Uhla lwezinkanyezi ngezinsuku ezinzima lwalubhalwe ebusweni bakhe. Wayencike kakhulu ekutheni inkantolo izobhekelela izinkinga zakhe. U-Sibusiso wayethola amakhadi ekhaya elungile, obhekiwe, engalindelekile, ezindaweni zempilo yakhe. Ngempela, uSibusiso wayegcwele umuzwa wokuthi impilo yakhe ayihambi kahle. Kwakukhona udaba lwemali, okuyinkinga yokuthola ukuhamba phambili empilweni. Wayefuna ukufaka isimangalo esikhaleni, kodwa wayehluleka. Ekugcineni, walandela umgqigqo wezopolitiki owaqhamuka emakhanda amaningi, umgqigqo owawufaka amagama anomthelela. Usuku lwezinkantolo lwehlele. U-Sibusiso, ehamba ngezinyawo, wanqamula umgwaqo, emnyama, uqonda endaweni yeNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo. Izithombe zezakhamuzi zithokozisa, zigcwele amahloni nemizwa. U-Sibusiso wayezisa umcabango, ethumele izwi lakhe phakathi kokuhlushwa. Uhlanga lwenkantolo lwalusebenza njengeziphakamiso ezilinganayo zamasiko, futhi kumnyama phansi kulokhu. Kwathi u-Sibusiso efika lapho, wabona umphakathi uvuleka. Ujolise kumadoda nabesifazane abaninzi, behambisa izinto eziphilayo, ezifanayo, bezomdabu. Inkanyezi yengqondo iphazamisekile, kwaba namacala okuhlola ngezinguquko ezibalulekile. U-Sibusiso wayezwa umoya wempumelelo uvuma phakathi kwezindonga. Ngesikhathi uSibusiso ehlangana neNkantolo, wathola ukuthi umphakathi wasendaweni udinga izwi lakhe. Umehluko wempilo wagcwala esandleni sabantu abaningi. Izinhloso zikhula, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo yathola ukuthokozisa ekuzameni ukufaka isikhumbuzo kulokho okwakubi. Njengoba abakhuluma, uSibusiso wavuka, waba nesibindi. Wathi, "Ngiyabonga, nansi ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onenhlonipho." Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izwi likaSibusiso lasizwa. Umphakathi wawuthinta. Izinkanyezi zeNkantolo zathokozisa, futhi kwakukhona izindlela ezihlukene ezibalulekile. U-Sibusiso wakhumbula umqondo wombono ophakeme. Uhlanga lwabantu lwakhula kakhulu, lwalubambisana namandla omlilo. Ngesikhathi inkantolo ifaka izinqumo, kwavela umoya wempumelelo. U-Sibusiso, nokho, wathola umqondisi ongakujabuleli kukhethwa ezinye izinguquko, izinqumo ezehlukene ezimgcekeni zomphakathi. Kwakuwumoya ophilayo owaba uqhamuka. Njengoba uSibusiso esho, "Imibono ithuthukisa izimpilo, yimi eyenzayo." Izinsuku zedlule, uSibusiso waba inkanyezi yokulawula. Wayezwa amaphupho akhe eza, ahamba phambili. Uhlanga lwabantu lwezandla lwenziwe. U-Sibusiso wabona iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ingashaywa phansi. Lena bekungumkhankaso, umphakathi ophilayo ophuma emoyeni. Ekugcineni, uSibusiso wafunda ukuthi inkantolo ayiyona kuphela indlela yokuphila. Wayezwa izWI zoyedwa, ukhumbula izinsuku ezinzima. Kuwo wonke amakhasi nezithombe, ukhona umbono ohlanzekile. Ekuhlanganyeleni, umphakathi uthola amandla. Ukuhlangene, izwi lathokozisa umhlaba, futhi uSibusiso waba yisibonelo esiphilayo. Ngaleyondlela, inkantolo yomthethosisekelo yaba yinkanyezi ehlangene, eya phambili. Kwakuwumbono owawubhalwe enhliziyweni, umphakathi ozigxile, inhlonipho yokuphila. U-Sibusiso futhi umphakathi, bembiza, behamba phambili. Ekuhlanganyeleni, baphila.
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokusungulwa kwemiphakathi engakhethi phakathi kwabantu luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa futhi luwumkhankaso obalulekile ukusiza uhulumeni bendawo ukuba benze umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukisweni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo ngokusebenzisa umthetho Wokuhulumeni Bendawo kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kwesigaba esisha somthetho wokuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza umthetho wezakhiwo zemiphakathi kanye nomthetho wezinhlelo zemiphakathi kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe (IDP) lungesinye sezinsiza zokuhulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela elasunguliwe, i-IDP ivela njengomsebenzi wokuphatha emiphakathini futhi njengengxenye yesu lezinhlelo ezihlanganisiwe kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo eziphathelene nezabelomali zomphakathi, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, kanye nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza kuphela ukuphathwa kwemiphakathi kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze nohulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho phansi, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomphakathi. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi ivame ukuba nezinselelo zokuhlela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Izinhlangano eziningi zomphakathi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okudlula) zazingenazo izinsiza kanye namandla okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izinqubomgomo zokuhlela ezihlolwe ngalokhu, futhi bekungekho izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezisunguliwe nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kule ndima bathole inzuzo enkulu kulwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona imiphakathi embalwa esithole intuthuko enkulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Imibhalo ye-IDP yokuhola, esunguliwe yiqembu le-DPLG elihlukile elisekelwa yi-GTZ, iphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha olwesizwe lwabaphathi bamaphakathi, abasebenzi abangochwepheshe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke abamele imiphakathi. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokusekela izinhlelo zamaphakathi endaweni (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zomphakathi. Iningi lempumalanga, i-SALGA, izigaba zikamasipala zendawo, kanye nezinkampani eziningi zikahulumeni ezweni ziyiingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi ziye zaba nomthelela kulolu hlelo olusha lwe-IDP. Nginehope enkulu yokuthi lezi ziqoqo zemibhalo ezishicilelwe zizoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubo ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ehlose ikusasa eliqhakazile. Yini ebalulekile ngamaGuidelines we-Integrated Development Planning? Lezi ziqondiso ziphendula umbuzo OJANI? Uma ama-Integrated Development Plans (IDPs) enziwa umthetho ophoqelelwe kumaphakathi ngaphansi komthetho Wokuhulumeni Bendawo (LGTA), njengoba kuguqulwe, kusho ukuthi ngesikhathi salolu hlelo awukwazi ukuvinjwa kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe zikhuluma ngezimo zezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa komhlaba (LDO) njengoba zisunguliwe kuMthetho Wokuphucula Ukuthuthukiswa (DFA) ka-1995. I-DFA inikeza uhlaka lwezinqubomgomo oluwusizo mayelana nezici zokuhlela nokuthuthukiswa komhlaba. Izimo ezibalulekile zezinqubomgomo, izakhiwo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlelo ze-IDP zasungulwa ngemuva kokuthi inqubo ye-IDP isiqalile. Uhlu lweziqondiso zezinhlelo lubandakanya ukuhlinzeka, ukugxila ezindabeni ezibalulekile, isinyathelo esibheke phambili, uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo, kanye nokubambisana nezinye izikhungo. Lo mthetho ukhomba indima yokuhlela kumasipala ahlanganyelayo. Kukhona eminye imibhalo emibili ephuma ku-WPLG ebalulekile ekuhlelweni kokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kokusebenzisa Umhlaba uqale inqubo eholele ekunciphiseni inani lemiphakathi. Le miphakathi ikhule futhi inamandla okuguqula izakhiwo zezinhlangano. Imibhalo ye-Integrated Development Plan izama ukwethula uhlaka lwecebo kulabo abahlanganyela enhlanganweni yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Injongo wukubasiza ukuthi benze umsebenzi wabo kahle. Kukhona imiyalo nezinhlelo ezichaza izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zilandelwe. Le miyalo ayifani nemibhalo esemthethweni ephoqelelwe kodwa isebenza njengeziqondiso ezisizayo. Lezi ziqondiso ziyisisekelo sokuqeqesha, ulwazi, kanye nezinsizakalo. Njengoba inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe yaqala ngaphambi kokuvela kwalolu hlelo olusha, izinga lenqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo ithonywe kakhulu yilolu hlelo. Kwamanye amaphakathi, inqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo, imibhalo yokuhlela yahluleka ukuba ibonakale ngempela ngenxa yezidingo ezilula zesu lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Le nqubo yadala ukudideka okukhulu nokudumazeka kulabo abahlanganyela. Esikhundleni sokuthi isetshenziswe njengethuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zangempela zabantu kanye nemiphakathi ngendlela ekhombisa imiphumela futhi icabangele ikusasa, imiphakathi eminingi ikhethe ukulandela kuphela izidingo zomthetho ezincane ngosizo lwabacwaningi. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ayizange ibe nomthelela oqinile futhi yafana nomdlalo wokuthenga izinhlelo ezikhona. Ingxenye yalezi zinkinga yikhono elilinganiselwe lamaphakathi, ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi nezibucayi enqubo engcono futhi eshesha, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuzisekela. Lesi simo siholela ekuthembeleni okukhulu kubakhiqizi abangekho abacwaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inqubo nezinhlelo zezinhlangano zomphakathi bezisanda kuvela. Izinselelo eziningi zixhomeke ekuntulekeni kokuhlelwa kwezomthetho okucacile. Ezinye izinselelo ezishiwo ngezansi zisafuna ukuxazululwa. Injongo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ayicacanga ngokwanele kumaphakathi athile ngenxa yokusondela kwayo kuma-LDOs. Ngezinye izikhathi, ibonwa njengendlela yokubamba iqhaza ekutholeni uhlu lwezinhlelo zokwakha ezidinga uxhaso lwangaphandle. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ye-IDPs ivame ukuba yizihloko ezilula zezimali ngaphandle kokuchaza kahle izimo zokwakhiwa kwazo nezinhlelo zokusebenza uma
Ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena futhi abanye abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Umphakathi ungumuntu oqokwe uM master weNkantolo noma iNkantolo ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Izingane zicatshangwa njengezizathu ezinamakhono ngenxa yokuthi umthetho uthathe ukuthi azikwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Uma lezi zinto zine impahla, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nomuntu oqokwe ukuphatha ifa. Ngokuvamile, umntwana unababheki abaphatha impahla yabo nezindaba eziphathelene nabo, ngakho-ke akudingeki ukuba baqokwe njengoba bengababheki babo. Nokho, kungase kwenzeke ukuthi izingane zingabi nababheki noma abazali, futhi kudingeka ukuqokwa komphakathi wengane ukuphatha ifa noma impahla. Nokho, uma umntwana enomgibeli wemvelo, iNkantolo inganquma ngenye indlela. Uma impahla yomntwana ifaka imali ebekwe ku-akhawunti yomgibeli, akudingeki ukuqokwa komphakathi wezimpahla, nakuba umphakathi angase aqokwe. Ukuqokwa komphakathi ezindabeni zezingane kudlala izindima ezimbili ngaphansi kwalesi simo. Ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Isimo eNingizimu Afrika siqonda ukuthi umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ungumuntu ongenaminyaka engama-21 ubudala ongakhululiwe yisimo sokushada noma umyalo wenkantolo. Ukukhala kufakwa eNkantolo. Ifomu J243 lichaza impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Ukuqokwa komuntu ofanele njengomphakathi, oqokwe ngumndeni womntwana (ngokuvamile abantu abaqokwe baveza emhlanganweni obizwa nguM master weNkantolo ngenhloso yokuxoxa ngale ndaba). Isicelo sokuba umphakathi sihlinzekwa ngefomu J197. Umzali ophilayo ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana. Umama womntwana owazalwa ekhaya ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela lowo mntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Umzali onikezwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Itestamente uma iqoka umphakathi kufanele ibhaliswe kahle futhi yamukelwe nguM master weNkantolo. Inani lesikhashana lempahla yomntwana kufanele liboniswe kufomu J243. Umbiko ochaza ukuthi umphakathi oqokiwe wakhethwa ngumuntu onegunya emqulwini oqukethwe ku-testamente futhi lowo muntu obhale i-testamente unelungelo lokwenza kanjalo. Umsebenzi nesiqinisekiso somphakathi oqokiwe esiqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokuthi umphakathi ukhululiwe yi-testamente ekwethuleni leso siqinisekiso. I-Nkantolo, njengomgibeli wezingane onamandla amaningi, ingaqoka umuntu njengomphakathi ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana futhi aphathe impahla yabo nefa. Kuvame ukuba ngumuntu onokukhathazeka ofaka isicelo kwiNkantolo. Ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo, iNkantolo iqoka umgibeli wefa ukuvikela amalungelo omntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ukuze ihlole isimo futhi inqume ukuthi isicelo sifaneleka kangakanani. Umgibeli wefa noM master weNkantolo kufanele babonise imibiko kwiNkantolo. Uma iNkantolo isiqedile ukucubungula isicelo, iqoka umphakathi, futhi uM master weNkantolo kufanele aqale isinqumo senkantolo ngokukhishwa kweMibhalo Yomphakathi nokuwagunyaza ukuba aqale njengomphakathi. Umbhalo ofanayo wesicelo senkantolo uhambisana nemibiko ekhishwe ngumgibeli wefa noM master weNkantolo. Isinqumo senkantolo sokuba umphakathi. Ifomu J242 liqukethe inani lempahla nefa lomntwana. Umsebenzi nesiqinisekiso somphakathi oqokiwe esiqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokukhululwa yinkantolo ekwethuleni leso siqinisekiso. Ukuphatha ifa labantu abashonile abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Abantu abachazwa yinkantolo njengokuphatha kabi impahla. Ukuphatha ifa labantu kanye nemali ethathwe ngokomthetho yiMnyango Wokuphathwa Kwezimali ngomyalo wenkantolo. Ukuphatha ifa lomuntu okhoyo (umuntu ongaziwa ukuthi uphi futhi ongenalo ummeli eNingizimu Afrika). Akusiyo indawo kaM master weNkantolo ukuqoka umuntu ukuba anakekele umntwana noma umuntu ophatha isimo nempilo yomntwana. INkantolo Ephakeme ingaqoka omunye umuntu ngaphandle komndeni womntwana njengomuntu ozosiza umntwana. Ngokufanayo, iNkantolo Ephakeme ingawathathela lowo muntu osiza umntwana ilungelo lokuba ngumsekeli walowo mntwana. Mayelana nokugcina umntwana ophazamisekile, iMthetho Wezingane No. 74 ka-1983 uveza ukuthi uMphakathi Wokunakekela Izingane endaweni lapho umntwana ehlala khona ungakwazi ukuqoka umuntu ukunakekela umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena, uma kutholakala ngemuva kokuhlola ukuthi umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa. Isigaba 14 seMthetho Wezingane sichaza izimo lapho umntwana ethathwa njengodinga ukunakekelwa, okubandakanya isimo somntwana ongenabazali noma ababezi, noma isimo lapho abazali babo bengatholakali. Umuntu oqokwe nguMphakathi Wokunakekela ungumuntu onakekela umntwana nsuku zonke. Nokho, umgibeli womntwana akanalo ilungelo lokuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakabi nakho amandla okuphatha yena.
Ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni Izithombe nemidwebo zihlala zinhle ukuze kusebenze kahle ezinhlakweni eziningi, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ezikhungweni. Leli phepha lizokuhola ngezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zisebenza kahle ukuze zifeze izinjongo ezithile. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlonza Umsebenzi Nezinhloso Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlonza umsebenzi ofanele nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezithombe nemidwebo. Lokhu kusho ukuhlela ukuthi yini ezomemezela, ukufundisa noma ukuphumelela. Isibonelo, uma ubeka izithombe emnyangweni wezemfundo, kufanele uqonde ukuthi izithombe zidinga ukweluleka noma zikhumbuze abafundi ngamalokhu. Izithombe ezithile zingadala imizwa ethile, zibe nomthelela omuhle kubantu. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhetha Izithombe Nemidwebo Ngemuva kokuthi umgomo sebubekiwe, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukukhetha izithombe nemidwebo ezithintana nomqondo. Izithombe kufanele zibe nekhwalithi ephezulu, ngaphandle kokungabaza, futhi kulula ukuziqonda. Ukuze ufinyelele lokhu, ungasebenzisa izithombe ezitholakala kuma-database anobuchwepheshe obuphezulu noma uqhakambise abaculi bendawo. Qiniseka ukuthi izithombe sizivezwa kahle ukuze zitshele indaba efanele. Isinyathelo 3: Ukumisa Nokubeka Izithombe Nemidwebo Ngemuva kokukhetha, izithombe nemidwebo kufanele zibekwe ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubeka izithombe ezindaweni ezithe xaxa nezithombeni, ukugwema ukuhlangana nemiyalezo engafanele. Ukubeka kahle kunciphisa ukuphazamiseka kwemiyalezo eqondiswe kubabukeli. Khumbula ukuhlola ukuthi isikhala sokubeka sikhona futhi sinikeza umbono ophusile nesicaci. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuqinisekisa Ukufundwa Kwezithombe Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abawubhalayo abezithombe nemidwebo bayakwazi ukuziqonda. Lokhu kungahilela ukufaka imishwana encane edlulisayo incazelo ezithombeni, noma ukusebenzisa ulwazi olwakha umqondo othi "ngalezi zithombe". Izithombe ezihlangene nemiyalezo egxile kulokho abantu abakwaziyo ukucabangela kuzokwazi ukukhulisa ukuqonda kakhulu. Isinyathelo 5: Ukumisa Izinqubo Zokuxhumana Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zimomotheka ngendlela elungile, kubalulekile ukusungula izinqubo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlola impendulo yababukeli, ukuqonda ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zifika kahle, futhi uma kudingeka, ukwenza izinguquko. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu osebenzisana nazo uyayazi imiyalo, ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphumelelisa izinjongo zokuxhumana. Isinyathelo 6: Uhlolo Lokugcina Ngaphambi kokuphuma nomsebenzi, kuhle ukuhlela ukuhlola lokho okukhona. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuba nezithombe nemidwebo zikalathisa, futhi abantu bazihloniphile. Hamba uhlole izithombe, uthembele kumphakathi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyawuqonda umthelela wazo. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuvuselela Ngemva kokusebenzisa izithombe nemidwebo, kubalulekile ukubuyekeza. Uvuselelo lwamathuba amasha lokuthola izithombe ezizobhalwa ngokusesha, nakukhombisa ukuthi izithombe zikhulisa kanjani amaphuzu abawubhalayo. Izinkinga ezithile ezifўся dapat ukufaka izithombe ezisemkhakheni wezemfundo, kangangokuthi izithombe zihlale zivethelekile. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni kudinga indlela eqondile, umqondo obucayi nokuzimisela ukuze kufezwe umgomo wethu. Ngokuhambisana nezinyathelo esizichaze, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo ziseza namaphuzu ahlukene, kungakhathaliseki umkhakha okhuluma nawo. Ngalesi sixazululo, sizovula ithuba lokuxhumana okuphumelelayo nabantu, futhi umcabango uzothokoziswa ngezithombe ezithintayo. Faka lezi zinyathelo ezisebenzayo endaweni yakho, futhi uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi wakho ngendlela emphezulwini.
Ukuhlinzeka ngama-rating wokusebenza ngonyaka: Ukuhlinzeka ngama-rating wokusebenza emsebenzini wonyaka njengengxenye yokuhlola umsebenzi wosebenzi kwenziwa ekupheleni kwesikhawu sokusebenza. Imiphumela yale rating yokusebenza ifaka zonke izilinganiso zomsebenzi owenziwe ngosebenzi phakathi kwesikhawu sokusebenza. Ithuluzi lokuhlola: Ithuluzi lokuhlola lisetshenziswa ukuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngamunye mayelana nokufeza izindawo ezibalulekile zomphumela kanye nomongo wezindlela zokuphatha ezihambisana nezinsiza zokuhlola ezifanele njengoba ziqukethwe esivumelwaneni sokusebenza. Ubuchwepheshe: Ubuchwepheshe (njengengxenye yokukwazi ukwenza) ngokuvamile bukhuluma ngokuba nezinhloso ezinhle, ubuntu, nokuzazi. Ukuba nekhono: kuhlobene nokukwazi kwabasebenzi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomsebenzi (ukuba nekhono lomsebenzi). Ikhono lokwenza: Ikhono lokwenza kuyinhlanganisela yolwazi, amakhono, nobuchwepheshe obudingekayo ukuze umuntu enze umsebenzi kahle. Ukuhlola okuqinisekisiwe: Ukuhlola okuphelele kwabasebenzi okuqinisekiswe yiKomidi Eliphezulu Lokuphatha (bona futhi ukuhlola okuqinisekisiwe nokuthi yini ehlinzekwayo). Amakhono Okuphatha Abalulekile (CMC): Ingxenye yolwazi, ikhono, noma amandla e-SMS PMDS aqondile ahlobene nokusebenza ngendlela efanele emsebenzini, efaneleka kubalaleli be-SMS. Abathengi: Abantu bobabili ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango abaxhumana nabasebenzi bomnyango lapho behlinzeka ngezidingo. Umnyango: Umnyango njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, 1994. Ukuthuthukiswa: Ukuqeqeshwa nezinto zokuthuthukiswa eziqondiswe ekwandiseni ikhono labasebenzi lokwenza nokuthuthukisa amazinga okusebenza. Igunya Eliphezulu: Mayelana noMnyango, imisebenzi kahulumeni noma izinhlangano, uMongameli, uNgqongqoshe, noma ilunga leKhansela Eliphezulu/Umphathiswa. Impendulo: Ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe olunikezwa nguMphathi/umqondisi mayelana nokusebenza kwabasebenzi mayelana nezilindelo nezindinganiso ezibekwe, eziqondwa ngabasebenzi, futhi ezihlosiwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ithuluzi lokuhlola ukufaneleka: Into esetshenziselwa ukuchaza nokuhlola izici zokusebenza, ukuhlola ulwazi, amakhono, nezinga lomsebenzi. Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo: Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzi kwiSevisi Yomphakathi, ezishicilelwe yiKomidi Lezisebenzi Zomphakathi kuMemezelo Kahulumeni R 1012 elandela 25 June 2003, uMqulu Wombuso No. 25209. Uhlaka lweMithetho Yokuphakanyiswa: Izinga lemali 1 kuya kwelama-12: Uhlaka lwe-DPSA 1/7/1/4/1, olwandulela 27 January 2003: "Ukwenziwa kohla lwezokuphakanyiswa oluhlobene nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukusebenza komnyango emisebenzini ezingeni lemali 1 kuya kwelama-12." Uhlelo Lokuphathwa Kokusebenza Nokuthuthukiswa (IPMDS): Uhlelo lokuphatha ukusebenza olwakhiwe yi-DPSA ngo-2003 ukuze lusetshenziswe ngenkuthalo kwiSevisi Yomphakathi. Izindawo Eziyinhloko Zomphumela (KRA): Ingxenye yomsebenzi lapho ukusebenza kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukufezwa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zomnyango, izinhloso, nezinhloso. Ukulawula: Ukuhlola ama-rating wokuhlola abasebenzi okwenziwa yiKomidi ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokungakhethi phakathi kwezingxenye zomnyango wonke ngokulandela indlela efanayo yokuqonda amazinga okusebenza adingekayo kuzo zonke izigaba zokulinganisa ukuze kusizakale ekuphumeleleni kokuthi izindleko ze-bonus zingadluli ku-1.5% yebhajethi yemali. Uhlelo Lokusebenza (noma uhlelo lwebhizinisi): Uhlelo lwesikhathi esiyonyaka olusekelwe futhi lwenza uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokusebenza luphile ngokucacisa izinhloso zohlelo lwezinhlelo zokusebenza olukhuluma ngezindawo ezibalulekile nezinto ezilinganisekayo, zonyaka othile woMnyango, Amagatsha, Ofisi zeSikhulu, kanye Nezikhungo. Umphumela: Isitatimende esibanzi mayelana nenjongo ethile, izinhloso, noma umphumela ohleliwe, odinga ukuthi kube khona okunye noma okunye okufanele kuphumelele. Impumelelo: Umphumela one-rating noma impumelelo (okungukuthi, umkhiqizo, izenzo, noma umsebenzi) ohlanganisa impumelelo yengxenye yezindawo ezibalulekile. Okudingekayo ukwenza. Izinga lokusebenza: Ukusebenza kwabantu kufaka (1) izenzo zabasebenzi kanye (2) umphumela noma umthelela waleyo zenzo. Ukusebenza kuyinqubo eqhubekayo lapho izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kahle, futhi eyinzuzo ukuze kukhiqizwe imiphumela ehambisana nezidingo zesikhathi, izinga, kanye nenani futhi umthelela noma umphumela waleso sikhathi uvela ezincwadini noma ezizindeni zomsebenzi. Isivumelwano sokusebenza: Idokhumenti evunyelwene futhi eyasayinwa ngosebenzi nomqondisi wabo, ehlanganisa incazelo yomsebenzi, izindawo ezikhethiwe ze-KRA nezama-GAF, uhlelo lokusebenza, kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Isiphakamiso/ukuhlola izinga lokusebenza: Ukulinganisa, ukuhlola, ama-rating, noma iziphakamiso mayelana nokusebenza kwabasebenzi. Inqubo yokuhlola yonyaka evamile ibizwa ngokuthi isiphakamiso noma ukuhlola ukusebenza, kuyilapho eyingxenye engafanele ibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlola ukusebenza. Uhlelo lwezinga lokusebenza: Isikhathi esiyimizuzu eyi-12 esihlelwe sokusebenza, ukuphatha, nokuhlola. Kumele kuhambisane nesikhathi esifanayo nesu lokusebenza lonyaka loMnyango, eliqala kusukela ku-1 Mashi kuya ku-31 February ngonyaka olandelayo. Izikhuthazo zokusebenza: Ukuqoqwa (a) kwemivuzo yezezimali ehambisana nemiphumela yeziphakamiso zokusebenza, kuhlanganisa ukwenyuka kwemali, ama-bonus okusebenza, kanye (b) ezinye izikhuthazo ezingezona ezemali ezingase zibe khona ohlelweni lokukhuthaza ukusebenza komnyango. Uhlelo lokukhuthaza ukusebenza: Uhlelo lomnyango oluhambisana nokuphakanyiswa kokusebenza okuhlobene nohlelo lwakhe lokuphatha ukusebenza, olwakhiwe ngokuhambisana ne-PSR 1/VIII F no-G. Isikhombisi sezinga lokusebenza: Isilinganiso esisetshenziselwa ukuhlola ukuthi impumelelo ingakanani efinyelelwe mayelana nokuthi okudingekayo ukwenza (ukusungulwa kwemigomo, ukuhlinzeka ngama-presentation, ukusungulwa kwemisebenzi). Ukuphathwa kokusebenza: Uhlelo oluqondile, oluqhubekayo olunhloso yokuphatha nokuthuthukisa ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zohlelo lokusebenza; ukuchaza imisebenzi efanele kanye nokuhlola nokuhlonipha ukuqala kwemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle nokufanele; futhi kuyindlela yokuthuthukisa imiphumela eMnyangweni, emaqenjini, nasemazingeni ngamanye ngokuphatha ukusebenza ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo, izinhloso, amazinga, nezikhuthazo ezivunyelwene. Uhlelo lokuphathwa kokusebenza: Uhlaka oluvunyelwe lokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, oluhlanganisa uhlaka lwezomthetho kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene nazo zonke izici zesikhawu sokusebenza, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukusebenza nezivumelwano, ukuqapha ukusebenza, ukubuyekeza, nokulawula; ukuphakamisa ukusebenza nokuphatha kanye nokuphatha imiphumela yeziphakamiso. Ibhola Lomnqakiswano: Umcimbi Wokuzijabulisa Nokuhlonipha Ngaphansi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, umcimbi omkhulu wezemidlalo, ibhola lomnqakiswano, ubungamukela izinkulungwane zababukeli abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Le midlalelo ibiyinsakavukela, igcwele umoya wokuncintisana, ukujabulisa, kanye nomoya wokuhlanganyela. Ibhola lomnqakiswano, elaziwa nangokuthi i-basketball, luhlobo lwezemidlalo oludumile emhlabeni wonke, futhi umcimbi walo uthokozisa abathandi bezemidlalo. Umcimbi uqale ngokuqhuma kwezinsimbi, lapho amaqembu amabili, elinye lithi "Izinkanyezi" nelinye "Amabhubesi", ehlanganyela emjahweni ophakeme. Izinkanyezi, ezimele idolobha elidumile, zifaka abadlali abanolwazi olukhulu, kanti Amabhubesi, abavela endaweni ethokozisayo, banelungelo lokubhalisela ukunqoba. Umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala ebusweni babadlali, njengoba bonke bejolise emgqeni ophakeme, befuna ukujabulisa abalandeli babo. Ngemva kokwakhiwa kweqembu, abadlali bahlala phansi ukuze baphumule, besebenzisa leli thuba ukuhlela isu labo lokudlala. Umphakathi ubukeka uzolile, kodwa ukucasuka kwabo kubonakala lapho umphakathi uqala ukuxhumana, ubhalela amaqembu akhe. Ababukeli banomsebenzi obalulekile, njengoba bejabulisa abadlali ngokuqhubeka nokuxhasa. Umoya wokuhlanganyela ubonakaliswa ngababukeli abavuma ukuvuma kancane, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lapho umcimbi uqala, isithombe sebhola siba sikhanya. Abadlali behluleka ukuhlala bezithokozisa, behamba ngezinyathelo ezisheshayo, bejolise emgqeni. Ukuphosa ibhola kwi-basket, okwakungumgomo wabo, kubonisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu. Abadlali baphosa, baphinde baphinde, bejabulisa ababukeli. Umoya wokuncintisana uphakamisa izinga lokudlala, njengoba amaqembu ebonisa amandla awo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi ubonakala ungena emoyeni, ubhalela amaqembu akhe. Izinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokuphosa ibhola, zikhuphuka emkhakheni wokuqhuba, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ufinyelela emaphuzwini aphezulu, lapho ibhola lisuka kancane kancane. Abadlali bahlala bezama, bejabulisa ababukeli, futhi umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala uqhubeka. Izinkanyezi zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, zenza izinyathelo ezithokozisayo, zifaka iziphumo ezinhle. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ufinyelela emaphuzwini aphezulu, lapho ibhola lisuka kancane kancane. Abadlali bahlala bezama, bejabulisa ababukeli, futhi umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala uqhubeka. Izinkanyezi zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obukhulu, zenza izinyathelo ezithokozisayo, zifaka iziphumo ezinhle. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi ufinyelela ekugcineni, lapho umphakathi ubhalela amaqembu akhe. Izinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokuphosa ibhola, zikhuphuka emkhakheni wokuqhuba, zikhombisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Amabhubesi, ngokuphindaphindiwe, azama ukuphendula, kodwa umoya wokuncintisana ubakhathaza. Umphakathi uvuma ukuvuma, ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele, izinkanyezi zithola ukunqoba, futhi umphakathi ujabulisa. Abadlali bahlala bezama, bejabulisa ababukeli, futhi umoya wokuncintisana ubonakala uqhubeka. Umcimbi we-basketball ubonisa ubuhle bezemidlalo, ubuchwepheshe, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kube yinsakavukela, futhi umphakathi ubhalela amaqembu akhe, ubakhuthaza ukuba baqhubeke nokudlala. Ibhola lomnqakiswano luhlobo lwezemidlalo oluhlala lukhanya, futhi umcimbi walo uhlale ukhumbuleka.
