Ukunikezwa yiBhodi 55 Isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwezindaba nguNgqongqoshe... x "Umkhakha" ubhekisela kunoma yikuphi okukhakha koMnyango Wezokuvikela noma iMpi eyasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi 103 ka-1994, Isikhangiso No. a Ukusungulwa nokusetshenziswa kwemigomo yokuvikela kuncike emthethweni weHulumeni nakuMkhandlu Kazwelonke ophatha. b Inhloso eyinhloko yeMpi ukuvikela iRiphabhulikhi, ukuhlonipha umhlaba wayo nabantu bayo. c IMpi kufanele iqhube imisebenzi yayo ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo nemithetho yezwe esiwamukela. d IMpi kufanele ikwazi ukuvikela yona uqobo futhi ibe sesimweni esifanele. e Akekho ilungu leMpi okufanele lenze noma yini engemthethweni. f IMpi kanye namalungu ayo awavunyelwe, ngesikhathi benza imisebenzi yabo, ukuhweba ngamalungelo eqembu lezombusazwe elivunywa uMthethosisekelo, noma nganoma iyiphi indlela ukukhuthaza izinhloso zeqembu lezombusazwe. g IMpi kufanele ihloniphe amalungelo ayisisekelo nobuntu bamalungu ayo nabantu bonke. a Bonke amalungu eMpi kanye nemisebenzi ehambisana nayo, kanye nazo zonke izisebenzi noma zisebenza ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi; futhi b Noma ubani, ngokuvuma kwezikhungo ezithintekayo, ongowesigaba seMpi ngenkathi engaphandle kwemingcele yeRiphabhulikhi. Uma kwenzeka ukungqubuzana phakathi kwalemthetho nezinye izinqumo ezisemthethweni ngaphandle koMthethosisekelo ezazisebenza ngesikhathi le mthetho waqala, le mthetho izobusa. Ngokwezinsika 202 no-204 zoMthethosisekelo, amandla anikezwe uNobhala Wezokuvikela kanye noMholi weMpi ngaphansi kwalemthetho kufanele asebenze ngokuhambisana nezinqumo zikaNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokwemithetho ephethe izisebenzi zomphakathi, anikeze inani elidingekayo labantu ukuze bagcwalise izikhala ezikhona koMnyango Wezokuvikela njengoba kudingeka. Nakuba kukhona isigaba 2, uma amalungu eMpi efisa, angabekwa ezandleni zikaNobhala Wezokuvikela ukuze angene ezikhundleni koMnyango Wezokuvikela. Amalungu eMpi ezikhundleni koMnyango Wezokuvikela kufanele ahlale ehambisana nazo zonke izinqumo ezisebenzayo kubo koMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezikhungo eziphezulu. UPresident kufanele, ngokuhambisana nemithetho ephethe izisebenzi zomphakathi, anikeze umuntu ukuze athathe isikhundla sikaNobhala. UNobhala Wezokuvikela uhlala kulesi sikhundla isikhathi esifanayo nalabo bonke abaphathi bezigaba kanye nemithetho abahamba ngayo, umholo wabo namalungelo afana nalabo baphathi bezigaba. UNobhala Wezokuvikela kufanele abe yisakhamuzi futhi akavunyelwe ukuba ilungu leMpi. a Kufanele abhekwane njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 1; futhi b Qhubeka nokusebenza kulesi sikhundla ngaphansi kwemithetho efanele, kuze kube isikhathi sokusebenza kulesi sikhundla siphele. Amakomidi ePhalamende aqapha ukuthi iminyango iyayilandela yini imithetho ebekwe. e Kufanele anikeze uMholi weMpi imiyalelo eningiliziwe edingekayo ukuze akwazi ukuhlela amalungu emisebenzi efanele nezikhungo zokwenza imisebenzi ethile enikezwe yena nguNobhala Wezokuvikela njengomholi nomphathi wezomnotho koMnyango Wezokuvikela. f Kufanele aqinisekise ukuhambisana nemithetho ethunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe edluliselwa kuMholi weMpi owenza umbiko ngalokho kuNgqongqoshe; futhi g Unesibopho sokuhola izinqubo zokuziphatha kanye nokuphathwa kwezisebenzi, kuhlanganisa nokusetshenziswa kwazo kahle nokuqeqeshwa. Leli thuba lokudlulisa noma ukudlulisa amandla njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 alivimbeli uNobhala Wezokuvikela ekuphatheni izindaba zakhe. Noma ukuphatha noma ukuhlela ngokuhambisana nomthetho; noma d Qhuba uphenyo olwamukelekayo futhi nemithetho engalandelwa. ekupheleni kwezivumelwano zokuqashwa kwabo; noma iii khululwa ezinye izindlela kwiMpi ngokuhambisana noMthetho; futhi b Akukho Msebenzi Wezinqola ongaba namalungu akhe asebenza okwamanje ngaphansi kwezivumelwano ngaphandle uma imisebenzi yabo iphelile ngemuva kwemithetho. i emsebenzini; futhi ii neMpi Esemthethweni noma iMpi yeZinqola noma zombili; futhi b UMholi weMpi angasungula umkhakha wesikhashana, iqembu, ingxenye noma iyunithi njengoba kudingwa yiMpi, futhi izisekelo zesikhashana zingasungulwa njengoba kudingeka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezikhona. UMholi weMpi kufanele abe yisakhamuzi futhi abe ilungu leMpi Esemthethweni. a kufanele abhekwane njengomsebenzi wesikhashana ngaphansi kwesigaba 1; futhi b qhubeka nokusebenza kulesi sikhundla ngaphansi kwemithetho yokusebenza ayisebenzayo kuze kube isikhathi sokusebenza kulesi sikhundla siphele. Noma ubani oqashwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi ka-1994, Isikhangiso No. 103 ka-1994, osebenza ngaphansi kweMpi; futhi c Noma emsebenzini uma kuvunyelwe nguNobhala Wezokuvikela. Ukudluliswa kwamandla okukhuluma esigabeni 1 akuvimbeli uMholi Wezokuvikela ekuphatheni izindaba zakhe. UNgqongqoshe angasungula umsebenzi ophathelene nokusebenza ukuze asekele iMpi uma kudingeka. Amalungu ale misebenzi asekelayo asiza kuphela ngesikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. c Ukuze kusekelwe noma iyiphi Imnyango Kahulumeni ngisho nokusekelwa okuhloswe ukuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho; futhi d Ukuvikela yonke imingcele ekhona kuleli. Uma iPhalamende lingahlangani ezinsukwini zokuqala eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokunikezwa kweMpi njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 2, uMongameli noma uNgqongqoshe bazohlinzeka ngazo zonke izimfuno ezidingekayo kulesi sigaba kumkhankaso ophathelene nezokuvikela ePhalamende. Uma iMpi inikezwa uMongameli nganoma yisiphi isizathu esishiwo esigabeni 2012 soMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele ahlangabezane nezidingo zesigaba 2e. c Kufanele kuvele futhi kube okusha endaweni yalokho okukhululiwe; noma d Kufanele kube nezizathu zokuphelisa ukwenziwa kweMpi;. b iqiniso lokuthi noma yini eyenziwe ngenxa yokukhululwa kuze kube isikhathi lapho ushintsho lwenziwa, ukuvela kokusha endaweni yokwakha noma ukuhoxiswa kokukhululwa; noma c noma yisiphi ilungelo, ithuba, umsebenzi noma umthwalo okumele wenziwe otholakele, okukhulile noma kube yindleko ngenxa yokukhululwa noma ukunikezwa kwe
Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Eziphansi Emazweni amaningi, ukudla kubalulekile empilweni, kodwa emindenini eshoda ngemali, izinkinga zokudla ziba yinkinga enkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile ukuze sikwazi ukusiza lezi miphakathi. Izinkinga zokudla zifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kokudla, ukungabi namali yokuthenga ukudla okunempilo, kanye nezimo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ukuntuleka Kokudla Okokuqala, emindenini eshoda ngemali, ukuntuleka kokudla kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya, bahlushwa yizithiyo zokufinyelela ezitolo zokudla. Lokhu kungenxa yezizathu eziningi, ezifana nokuntuleka kwemithombo yokuhamba, ukungabi namali, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ethile ibhekane nokudla okunganele, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu empilweni yabo. Ukungabi Namali Yokuthenga Ukudla Okunempilo Okwesibili, ukungabi namali yokuthenga ukudla okunempilo kuyinkinga enkulu. Imindeni eminingi eshoda ibhekene nezindleko eziphezulu zokudla okunempilo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla eziyisisekelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ikhethe ukudla okungasekho emthethweni, okubangela izinkinga zempilo ezifana nezifo zenhliziyo, izinkinga zesikhumba, kanye nezinye izifo ezihlobene nokudla. Izimo Zokuphila Ezinzima Okwesithathu, izimo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni ngokudla okunempilo. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi, ezifaka phakathi ukungabi namathuba emisebenzi, ukungabi nezinsiza zokufunda, kanye nezimo zokuhlala eziyinkimbinkimbi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga eziningi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enhle. Imiphumela Yokuntuleka Kokudla Imiphumela yokuntuleka kokudla emindenini eshoda ibalulekile. Ukudla okunganele kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, okubandakanya izifo ezahlukene, ukwehla kwemithwalo yemisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokufunda ezinganeni. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo enhle nezinselelo ezithinta impilo. Izixazululo Zokuthuthukisa Ukudla Ukuze sithuthukise izimo zokudla emindenini eshoda, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa ngemikhuba yokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa imindeni ngezindlela zokupheka ezilula, ukudla okunempilo, kanye nezindlela zokulima ezilula. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni ngezimali zingasiza kakhulu. Lokhu kungafaka ukuhlinzeka ngezikhwama zokudla ezithile, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisa imisebenzi. Ukuze sithuthukise izimo zokuphila, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, izinkinga zokudla emindenini eshoda zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ngokuqonda izizathu eziholela kulezi zinkinga, singakwazi ukuthuthukisa izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ukuze sithuthukise izimo zokudla, kudingeka sithuthukise izinhlelo zokufundisa, sithuthukise amathuba emisebenzi, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imindeni ithola ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo, kwandise amathuba, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesandla ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga ukuze sifeze umgomo wempilo engcono.
Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi Isingeniso Emhlabeni wesimanje, ukukhula komnotho kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe kudinga ukuthi izinkampani nabezindaba bazi kahle izidingo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abawasebenzisayo zibalulekile ekwakheni abasebenzi abakwazi ukuhambisana nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zemboni. Lezi zinhlelo azigcini nje ngokwandisa ulwazi lwabasebenzi, kodwa futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zizitholela izinzuzo ezinkulu emqhudelwaneni wokusebenza. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Ukuze izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zibe neqhaza elikhulu, kubalulekile ukuthi zikusungulwe ngesisekelo esiqinile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlonza izidingo zokuqeqeshwa, okungase kuhilele ukuhlinzekwa kwezimali, izinsiza, kanye neziqu. Ukuhlonza lezi zidingo kudinga ukubamba izinqubo zokuhlola amakhono abasebenzi, ukuhlaziywa kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuhlola izinkinga ezithinta ukusebenza. Ngemuva kokuhlola, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zingakhiwa ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo ezithile. Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zingahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile, ukuqeqeshwa okwenziwe ngendawo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile. Ukuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile kuvamise ukufaka izifundo ezivamile, ezihlanganisa amakhono afana nokuxhumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga, noma izinhlelo zokuphatha. Ukuqeqeshwa okwenziwe ngendawo, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kugxile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono athile aphathelene nomsebenzi, njengokuqeqeshwa kwezinjini, imishini, noma izinhlelo ezithile zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikhethekile zifaka ukufundiswa okudingekayo kumakhono angajwayelekile, njengokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe obusha, izinhlelo zokuphatha ubungozi, noma ukuthuthukiswa kwezimakethe ezintsha. Lezi zinhlelo zidinga ukuhlola okuqhubekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu, zithuthukiswe njalo ukuze zihambisane nezinguquko ezisemkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ubuchwepheshe Bezokufunda Ubuchwepheshe bukhuluma kakhulu empilweni yansuku zonke, futhi buphinde buhlobane ngothile nomkhakha wezokufunda. Ukuze izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zibe neqhaza, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukile, njengokufunda kwe-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezindawo zokuxhumana. Lezi zinsiza zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi, futhi zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba bafunde ngenkathi bedlala indima yokuhola. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buphinde bubhekelele ukufundisa ngendlela esebenzayo, njengoba izinhlelo zokufunda zingahlanganiswa nezinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bakwazi ukusebenzisa lokho abakufundile ezimeni zangempela. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana phakathi kweqembu, okuholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle. Ukucwaninga Nokuqhubekisela Phambili Ukuphumelela kwezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa akuphelelanga ekwakheni amakhono, kodwa kudinga nokucwaninga okuqhubekayo ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela yezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. Ukuhlaziya imiphumela kungenza izinkampani ziqonde ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle nokuthi yiziphi ezidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba imiphumela iyasiza ekwakheni izinqumo ezizwakalayo mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo nezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ezizayo. Izinsiza Zokuthuthukisa Amakhono Ukuze izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zibe nemiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zisetshenziswe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nezikhungo zokuqeqesha, izikole, kanye nezikhungo zokucwaninga. Ukubambisana nabaholi bemboni nakho kubalulekile, njengoba kubavumela ukuba bahlaze izidingo zomkhakha futhi baqhamuke nezixazululo ezithile. Isiphetho Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ukuze kube nokuphumelela kwezinkampani. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezihlanganisa izidingo zokuqeqeshwa, ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, nezinsiza ezifanele, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayakwazi ukufeza izinjongo zenkampani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokutshalwa kwezimali kulezi zinhlelo ukuze kuzuze bonke, kusukela kubasebenzi kuya ezinkampanini uqobo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kunceda ekwakheni umphakathi ophephelayo, ophumelelayo, futhi onamakhono, okugcina kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho jikelele.
Ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa (GEMS medical treatment authorization) Kuwo wonke umuntu, impilo iyigugu. Ukuze siqhubeke siphila kahle, kufanele sithole ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okwanelisayo, futhi kulokhu, kube nokukhululeka ekutholeni imishanguzo, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nakho. Enye yezinsiza ezibaluleke kakhulu ezitholakala ezinkampanini zokwelapha yikhono lokugunyazwa kokwelashwa, ikakhulukazi ukufaneleka kwesivumelwano sokunakekelwa kwezempilo kweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Kulokhu, ngicela ukuphakamisa umbono wami ngomthelela walolu hlelo ezinganeni, emindenini, nakubantu abaningi abavakashela ezikhungweni zokwelapha. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iGEMS iyinhlangano yokwelapha edqwaqla uHulumeni, eqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni nabasebenzi bezinhlangano zomphakathi banela ukuzitholela imishanguzo kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Ukuze lokhu kube ngempumelelo, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile; lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezempilo bazi kahle izinsizakalo eziphathelene nomphakathi, nokuthi izinsizakalo ezinikwa abantu zifanelana nezidingo zabo. Noma kunjalo, lo msebenzi awuhambanga ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Ngokwesibonelo, kubalulekile ukusho ukuthi kunobunzima obubonakalayo kulabo abadinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi uma kucacile ukuthi ukugunyazwa kweGEMS kuthatha isikhathi eside kunalokho abanye abantu abakulindele. Lokhu kungenza abanye abantu bazizwe bengasizi, futhi kuvame ukunciphisa ithemba labo ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo abazitholayo. Lokhu kunokuphazamiseka okungase kubangele izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Okwesibili, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa okwenziwa yiGEMS kudinga ukwenziwa futhi kube lula, ukuze kubize kuqede izithiyo ezikhona. Abantwana, abantu abadala, kanye nabantu abanesimo sezempilo esiphuthumayo, kufanele bathole ukwelashwa okudingekayo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Kulokhu, iGEMS kufanele ithuthukise izixhobo zayo zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezimbobo zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola imishanguzo, izinsizakalo ezifanele, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqhubeka nezinhlelo zokugunyazwa. Ngokubaluleka kokwenza lula lezi zinhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe izinhlelo zokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabezempilo, uhulumeni, nabantu bonke. Lokhu kuzophucula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokugunyazwa kokwelashwa lungasiza ukuphuma kwabantu bebhedlela, kanti lokho kunciphisa izindleko zokwelapha ezikhuphuka kubantu. Ngezinga elikahle, ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa akuyona into yokubhaliswa kuphela. Kuhle ukuqonda ukuthi le nqubo iyahamba phambili noma kusezingeni eliphezulu. I-GEMS kufanele ivumelane nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezizothuthukisa izinsizakalo zempilo... Zifundo ezikhona zikhombisa ukuthi lapho izinsizakalo zempilo ziqinile, abantu bangaphila impilo engcono, futhi lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sihlole nezinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba impilo ye-GEMS iyathuthuka futhi iqhubeke. Lokhu kudinga ubulungiswa phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi, kubandakanya ohulumeni, abezempilo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Kudingeka izinhlelo eziphathelene nokuphatha ukuhlanganyela nokuvuselela lezi zinhlelo. Uma izinhlelo zomphakathi zingaphumelelanga, kuzodingeka ukufaka imizamo eyengeziwe yokwakha isixazululo esiqhubekayo. Njengoba siphokophele emiphakathini yethu, kufanele sigcizelele ukubaluleka kokuxhaswa kokwelashwa okuhle. Ukuze ukusabela kwezinhlelo zempilo kube nakho, iGEMS kufanele inakekele ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona, zifanelane nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi kunciphise izithiyo ezibangelwa ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungabhekelelwa ngendlela efanele, nangokubambisana. Ekugcineni, sabona ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokwelashwa kunzima, kodwa kudinga ukusizakala ngenxa yezifiso zempilo zethu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi netheku kudlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni lezi zinhlelo zibe ukuma okungcono. Ngakho-ke, masenzeni konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze siphume phambili ekwakheni uGEMS obucayi, onenhlonipho, futhi osebenzelana kahle ngempilo emhlabeni wonke. Uthembiso olungaqhubeka luveza ukuthi impilo ingathengwa futhi ilungiswe, kodwa kuphela uma sonke sixhumene futhi silwela lokhu esikufunayo. Izimpilo zethu ziphumelele, singabantu bempilo, kudinga isimo esivumelana nganoma iyiphi indlela.
Izimfihlo Zokukhiqiza Kwakhanya ilanga elihle eMkhumbane, idolobha elincane elaziwa ngempumelelo yalo emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza. Abantu babejabulile, behlabelela izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezisemkhathini, kodwa empeleni babezama ukwakha impilo engcono. UJabulani, umkhiqizi ophumelelayo wezinto zokwakha, wayaziwa ngempahla yakhe ethi "Ithuba Lempilo," eyatholakala ezitolo eziningi. Nakuba uJabulani ephila impilo ejabulisayo, wayenobunzima obuthile. Ngesikhathi esebenza, wathola ukuthi izindleko zokukhiqiza zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina ibhizinisi lakhe liphila. Wazama ukuthola izixazululo, kodwa izinkinga zazimjolisa kakhulu. UNandi, umngani wakhe, wamsiza wathi: "UJabulani, kungani ungazami ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha? Kukhona izinto ezithuthukisiwe ezizokwenza umsebenzi wakho ube lula." Lokhu kwavula umqondo kaJabulani, kodwa wayengazi kahle ukuthi angazithola kuphi. UNandi, onobuchwepheshe, wathola ithuba lokumfundisa. Baphuma ndawonye, behamba ezitolo ezithengisa imishini yokukhiqiza. UJabulani wathola imishini ethuthukisiwe, njengezinsiza zokwakha ezisebenza ngogesi, ezamsiza ukukhiqiza kalula. Ngemuva kokuthola le mishini, uJabulani waqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Waqala ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ezamnika ithuba lokulawula ukukhiqiza kwakhe ngokuphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi lakhe laqala ukuhamba kahle; izindleko zokukhiqiza zancipha, futhi umkhiqizo wakhe wathandwa kakhulu. Abantu baseMkhumbane babebona izinguquko ezinkulu, kanti uJabulani waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani. Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, waqala ukufuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Waqala ukuhlela izifundo zokufundisa abanye abantu bendawo ngezindlela zokukhiqiza, efuna ukuthi bonke bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu baphendula kahle, futhi izifundo zakhe zaba yimpumelelo. U-Jabulani wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abakhiqizi emkhakheni, behlangana emhlanganweni wezokukhiqiza, lapho bekhuluma khona ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa imboni. UJabulani wabelana ngempumelelo yakhe, futhi abanye bakhiqizi bamthokozisa. Waqonda ukuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha amathuba amasha. Ngemuva kokuhlangana, uJabulani wathola ithuba lokwakha inhlangano yokukhiqiza eMkhumbane, eyayihlose ukusiza abakhiqizi abancane, ibanikeze amathuba okukhula. Waba ngumholi walesi sikhungo, waqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, futhi umphakathi waqala ukuhamba phambili. Ngemuva kweminyaka embalwa, uJabulani wathola umklomelo wezokukhiqiza, okwakuwumsebenzi omkhulu, futhi abantu baseMkhumbane babemjabulisa. Waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe, uma buhlanganiswa nomphakathi, bungakha izinguquko ezinkulu. Wazi ukuthi impumelelo yakhe yayingenxa yokubambisana, futhi wathanda ukusiza abanye. Ekugcineni, uJabulani waba yisithombe sokuphumelela eMkhumbane, efunda ukuthi ezokukhiqiza akukhona nje ukukhiqiza kuphela, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Wazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza, kodwa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bukhulu kakhulu. UJabulani waphila impilo ejabulisayo, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uJabulani wathola ithuba lokuhamba emhlabeni, efuna ukufunda okwengeziwe. Wafika ezindaweni ezahlukene, efunda ngezindlela ezahlukene zokukhiqiza, wabuyela eMkhumbane ethwele izifundo eziningi, waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano namanye amazwe. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula. UJabulani waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe, ubudlelwano, kanye nomphakathi kungenza kube nokwenzeka. Wazi ukuthi impumelelo ayizwakali kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. UJabulani waphila impilo ejabulisayo, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba yisithombe sokuphumelela. Izimfihlo zokukhiqiza zaba yimpumelelo, futhi uJabulani waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakha izinguquko ezinkulu.

Noma ubani othintekayo ekwamukeleni/ukugcina/ukudlulisela nokuphatha imithwalo ezothunyelwa ngomoya ngosizo lokuthutha komoya kumele ahambisane nezinhlinzeko zokuphepha ezibekwe kule ngxenye. Akekho umuntu ongase abe ngumsebenzi wokuthutha komoya ukuze athwale imithwalo engaziwa. Noma yimuphi umphakathi ophathwayo osebenza ukuze wamukele/gcine/dlulisela nokuphatha imithwalo ezothunyelwa ngomoya kumele abe necebo lokuvuma elikhishwe nguMphathiswa. Kudingeka ukuthi noma ubani osebenzela umphakathi ophathwayo futhi othintekayo ekuphathweni kwemithwalo eyaziwayo aqede ukuqeqeshwa okukhuluma ngakho kumthetho 108.06.1 futhi abe necebo lokwazi elifanele ukuze athole lokho ukuqeqeshwa. Umphakathi ophathwayo uzokwakha incwadi yokuphepha equkethe lonke ulwazi nemithwalo ethunyelwa ngomoya equkethe lonke ulwazi olukhuluma ngalo kuSaziso I-SA-CATS-aCS nokuthi ikhuluma kanjani ezokusebenza. Le ncwadi izonikezwa kuMphathiswa ukuze yamukelwe. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo sokuba umphakathi onemvume noma oqinisekisiwe njengomthumeli wemithwalo owaziwayo uzovumela umuntu onegunya, umhloli noma umphakathi onegunya obonakaliswe nguMphathiswa ukuba enze uphenyo olufanele nolwazi ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuthi iziqondiso zokuphepha eziphathelene nokuphathwa, ukuthuthwa nokugcina kwemithwalo eyaziwayo zihambisana nezidingo zalesi sikhathi. Labo abanecwecwe lokuvuma noma isiqinisekiso sokugunyazwa bazovumela umphakathi onegunya, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyaziwe nguMphathiswa ukuba ahlole noma iyiphi imithwalo ethunyelwa ukusuka noma ngaphezu komphakathi ophathwayo noma umuntu ogunyaziwe ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuhambisana noma ukungahambisani nale ngxenye. UMphathiswa angakhishwa iziqondiso zokuphepha eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwemithwalo ethunyelwa ngomoya lapho kudingeka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuphepha lokuthutha komoya. a ngokushesha enze izinguquko encwadini yokuphepha ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zokuphepha futhi athumele lezi zinguquko kuMphathiswa ukuze zamukelwe; futhi b Ngemuva kokwamukelwa kwezinguquko encwadini yokuphepha, enze lezi zinguquko zibe zatholakala kubo bonke abantu abenza umsebenzi wokwamukela, ukudlulisela noma ukuphatha imithwalo ethunyelwa ngomoya. b Qinisekisa ukuthi ngemuva kokwamukela imithwalo eyaziwayo futhi ngenkathi imithwalo isesandleni sabo igcinwa iphephile ekufinyeleleni okungagunyaziwe ngokuhambisana nezinyathelo zokuphepha ezib
Ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu bhukwana? Lolu bhukwana lunikeza uhlaka lokuthuthukisa amakhono abantu abathintekayo ohlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo (LED) emkhandlwini wase-AbaQulusi ngaphansi kweSifunda saseZululand ePhikweni laseKwaZulu-Natal (KZN). Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kubalulekile njengendlela yokuxhasa ukubambisana okuphumelelayo, ukuhlela, nokuphumelelisa uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo (LED) oluzoholela ekukhuleni komnotho okulinganiselwe nokusimeme e-AbaQulusi. Kulolu bhukwana, siphakamisa ukuthi kube nohlelo oluhleleka kahle lwezokusebenza olunemikhakha emine ukuze kuqinisekiswe umnotho wendawo e-AbaQulusi. Le ndlela ibandakanya ukusungulwa kwe-Provincial Project Management Unit (PMU), ehlanganisa ochwepheshe bokuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo isikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lukaNovemba 2011. I-PMU izosungula izinhlelo zesikhashana zokuxhasa i-LED, njengegatsha elibhekele ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa komnotho kwesikhathi eside okubandakanya ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, ukuthuthukiswa kwezimali, ucwaningo, ukuqapha, nokuhlola. Ngokudlulisela amakhono afanele nezinsiza kuMphakathi phakathi neminyaka emithathu yokwethulwa, umphakathi uzoba nekhono elanele lokuthuthukisa amasu okuthuthukiswa komnotho esikhathini esizayo. Kulindeleke ukuthi leli hlelo lihlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlala isikhathi eside kanye nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle okudingekayo ukuze kuphathwe ngempumelelo umnotho wendawo esikhathini esizayo. Lolu bhukwana lusekelwe embikweni oqoqwe ochwepheshe bokuthuthukiswa komnotho base-KZN, osekelwe yi-European Union egxile kumandla omnotho wendawo eVryheid (umkhandlu wase-AbaQulusi). Imiphumela yocwaningo ibisekelwe ekuhloleni izincwadi, ukufuna ku-inthanethi, ukuxhumana nabathintekayo ngocingo, izingxoxo zamehlo, izingxoxo ezihlelwe, ukudluliswa kwehlaka lemiphumela; kanye nokuphothulwa kwemibhalo equkethe imibono yabathintekayo. Abahlinzeki bolwazi ababalulekile esifundazweni baphinde babuzwa imibuzo ukuze kuthuthukiswe indlela efanele yesikhashana ye-PMU, okuyona ezothuthukisa amasu okusebenza kwesikhathi eside. Isinqumo esivumelekile sathathwa mayelana noHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe (IDP) lweMphakathi WaseVryheid kanye neSikhala Sokuthuthukiswa (SDF). Lolu bhukwana luhlaziya indlela yokuzinzisa umnotho wendawo e-AbaQulusi, ophoqelelwe. Uhlaka lwenziwa ngamasu akhombisa ukuthi i-LED ingaqalwa kanjani ngendlela ehlelekile nephumelelayo. Sikholelwa ukuthi kubalulekile kubo bonke abathintekayo be-LED ukuba babe nolwazi olunembile mayelana nokubaluleka kwezixhumanisi zokuxhumana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene zohlelo lwe-LED. Izimpilo zabantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya e-AbaQulusi zihlukaniswa yindlela yokuhamba kwabantu beshiya izindawo zasemakhaya ukuze basebenze emadolobheni, ukungabi khona kwezidingo eziyisisekelo nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanye nenani elikhulu labantu abangakaze bafundiswe. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nokuthuthukiswa kweMphakathi Wase-AbaQulusi, kubalulekile ukubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona ezidingweni zabahlali basemakhaya nabasemadolobheni ngokuqhamuka nezinhlelo ezizokhomba amathuba kubahlali basemakhaya. Isithombe sabahlali basemadolobheni sikhombisa ithemba kulandela amathuba akhona emkhakheni wezokumbiwa kwemalahle. Nokho, ukwehla kwemigodi yemalahle eminyakeni edlule kubeke umnotho engcupheni. Izinhlelo zokungenelela zisungulwa ukuze ziphinde ziqinise ezinye izinkalo zomnotho ukuze kudaleke amathuba emisebenzi nokukhuliswa kwemali. Le ngenelelo yokuguqula ilindeleke ukuthi ikhuthaze Ukuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo futhi idinga ubuholi obukhethekile obugxile ekwakheni isimo esizovumela umphakathi wendawo ukuba ube yisikhungo seZululand esifundeni saseKwaZulu-Natal. Izithombe zokuhlala kwabantu nezindawo zokusebenza endleleni ehlanganisa iMondlo-Vryheid-Hlobane-Coronation-Nyathi-Louwsberg ziveza bobabili ubunzima namathuba okukhomba izinhlelo zokungenelela eziguqulayo. Ukuqhamuka kombono wokuthi i-AbaQulusi ibe yisikhungo esiyinhloko sesifunda kuzodinga imiklamo eqinile nephumelelayo. Amasu akhethiweyo adinga okulandelayo: izinsiza zezezimali zokuthuthukisa konke okudingekayo kokwakhiwa nokwesekwa kwezobuchwepheshe; isikhathi esicacile nesithembekile sokuhlela nezinhlinzeko zokubhekwa; ukuziphendulela kokubika; nokuthi ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu bhukwana? Lolu bhukwana luhloselwe ukwabelana ngolwazi olufanele nabantu abaningi abasebenza ku-LED nabathintekayo abahileleke e-AbaQulusi. Lolu lwazi luwusizo kakhulu kubasebenzi abasebenzela uhulumeni wendawo eVryheid. Kuzoba usizo nakubani osebenza emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nezomnotho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abasebenzi bakamasipala, abezwe, nabasendaweni, abaxhasi bendawo nabangaphandle, abahlanganyeli bezamabhizinisi, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukamasipala (NGOs). Umphakathi wendawo (Vryheid) ungumkhandlu ohlanganisiwe wokuthuthukiswa obhekane nezinkinga zokuphatha, okuthinteke emandleni awo okwenza imisebenzi yawo yomthetho. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga zokuphatha, umphakathi ukwazi ukwenza ukuhlolwa okufanele koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe (IDP) kanye neSikhala Sokuthuthukiswa (SDF). Ubuye waphinde waqoka ukuthuthukiswa kwamasu okuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo. Ukwehla kwezinkalo zezimboni. Ukuntuleka kwamakhono ayisisekelo nezomnotho. Emkhakheni wesifunda, iZululand District Municipality (ZDM) isungule i-LED Unit ukuze ixhase amabhizinisi kuwo wonke amakhaya asezindaweni eziphansi ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwayo. Le ndawo isebenza ngokubambisana namakhaya asezindaweni eziphansi futhi inikeza uhlaka olubanzi lokuxhasa amabhizinisi emkhakheni wombuso. Ukuhlela kuhlanganyela nge-IDP phakathi kweZululand District Municipality kanye ne-AbaQulusi Municipality kusetshenziswa iPlanning Forum esunguliwe yiZululand District Municipality (ZDM). Le Forum ihlangana kabili ngenyanga futhi igxile ekuhleleni ngokuhola izindaba zamasu okusebenza, izinhlelo, nezinhlelo. Nokho, nakuba iForum isebenza, ukudluliswa kolwazi kuvame ukuphazamiseka ngenxa yezinkinga ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Kulindeleke ukuthi iProject Management Unit esanda kusungulwa, engaphansi kweSikhungo Sokuhlela Nokuxhumana se-AbaQulusi Municipality, iqale uhlelo lokuxhumana nokuphathwa okubhekana nezinkinga zokuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kweZululand District Municipality kanye nayo. Ngaphansi kwe-LED, kunezinhlangano ezahlukene ezisebenza ngaphansi kwe-AbaQulusi, nakuba zikhululekile futhi zihambisana nezinqubo zazo eziyisisekelo. Ayikho inhlangano yebhizinisi egcwele emkhakheni wombuso. Inselelo enkulu kumphakathi ukuthi awunawo amandla anele ngaphakathi
Ukusebenza komthetho weMali yoMphakathi. B. Uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng ubonisile ukuthi kukhona isidingo sokuba necebo lokusiza amabhizinisi amancane elidlula izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezikhona kanye nezikhungo zezimali ukuze kusekelwe amabhizinisi amancane ngezimali nangokunye. "Ibhodi" ibhekisela ebhodini le-GEP elisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sesikhombisa somthetho. "Umnyango" ubhekisela kumnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba esifundeni. "Inhloko yoMnyango" ibhekisela enhlokweni yomnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Umthetho" ubonisa umthetho wesifunda. "MEC" kusho ilungu lekhansela elibhekene nezindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Kwenziwe" kusho okwenziwe ngumlomo womthetho. "Isifunda" kusho isifunda saseGauteng. "Umthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi" ubhekisela kumthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi, Umthetho 1 ka-1999. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa uhlu nezinye izinqubo ezihlobene. Ukusebenza komthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi. Ezimali njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 492 a somthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi, b I-MEC iyinhlangano yeKhabhinethi njengoba kubhalwe esigabeni esiyimfihlo somthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi c Noma yini eyenziwe yiBhodi mayelana nomthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi kumele ihambisane nalokho okukhuluma ngakho esigabeni esiyimfihlo somthetho. Akukho lutho kulomthetho olunamandla okukhansela imithetho esunguliwe yi-GEP ngaphansi komthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi. d Ukuqaliswa nokuqhubeka komjikelezo wezinsizakalo zokukhulisa indima edlalwa amabhizinisi amancane emnothweni waseGauteng. e Ukuqhubeka nokukhula komnotho, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, nokulingana. f Ukuhlanganisa bonke abasebenzi abasukuma amabhizinisi amancane asekelwe nguhulumeni ngezimali eGauteng. g Ukuqinisa amandla alabo abahlinzeka ngosizo kumabhizinisi amancane. a Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokweseka osomabhizinisi ngezimali, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulokhu. Usizo lokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi, izindaba zezimali nezomthetho. Ukuqeqeshwa ngezakhono zekhompyutha nezinye izakhono. v Ikhono lokufinyelela ulwazi oluvela kuhulumeni nezikhuthazo. Izeluleko zokuhweba okungena nokuphuma. Izeluleko ngezobudlelwano bezithakazelo, ukumaketha, nocwaningo. b Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokweseka osomabhizinisi ngezimali, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulokhu. i Ngokwesigaba sesine, bahlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa. Futhi bahlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezikweletu. c Ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokweseka labo abahlinzeka ngosizo nezinye izithakazelo kulokhu. d Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo eyodwa yokusiza osomabhizinisi. Kuzosiza ukuqinisa ukusungulwa kwayo, ukuqhubeka, nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo zokweluleka amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuqaliswa kwezindlela ezizolandela ukuze kuthuthukiswe amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwenza izinhlelo ezingeni lesifunda, lezwe, kanye nezamazwe omhlaba ukuze kudonswe labo abafuna ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. Ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi nezinye izinhlobo zokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi nezinye izinhlangano kulesi sifunda, eRiphabhulikhi, nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuhlanganisa, ukusiza, nokubambisana nezithakazelo nezikhungo ezifuna ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezikhuthaza futhi zikhulisa amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. a Ukwakha amabhizinisi aqinile futhi akhangayo, b Ukukhuthaza osomabhizinisi. c Ukudala indawo efanele yokusebenza yamabhizinisi amancane. d Ukufinyelela kalula kumabhizinisi amancane ukuze bathole usizo lwezimali nezinye izinsiza, nokuthi basebenzise kanjani lokho. e Ukufinyelela kalula kumabhizinisi amancane kuleli nakwamanye amazwe. Ukukhuthaza, ukuhlanganisa, nokukhuthaza uhulumeni bendawo, izinhlangano ezizimele, nezinye izithakazelo ukuba zisebenzisane ukuze i-GEP ifinyelele imigomo yayo. Ukuhola nokuhlela ucwaningo oluhlobene nezinhlelo ezisiza amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwandisa ukuqwashisa komphakathi mayelana nendima yamabhizinisi amancane ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, nokuphila kahle. Ukuqaliswa kwezakhiwo zendawo nezifunda ukuze kuzuze imigomo yayo ngempumelelo. Ukwenza eminye imithetho ephathelene nalomthetho. Umthetho uyisisekelo seBhodi nokukhethwa kwamalungu. Ngaphambi kokukhetha amalungu eBhodi, i-MEC kumele ixhumane ngezaziso kwiGazethi yesifunda, iziphakamiso zamakhandidethi afanelekayo ukuze akhethwe. a Representa ingxenye ebalulekile yokuhlala kweGauteng, igxile kumasiko, ubulili, ukungakwazi, ukusabalalisa kwezindawo, nezikhungo ezikwiindawo zokuhweba. Umthetho osebenzayo kumabhizinisi amancane. I-MEC ingasungula noma yiziphi izinqubo ezizolandela ekukhetheni amalungu. I-CEO iyilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla asibamba. Bonke amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwe-CEO, bakhethwa ngasikhathi sinye. a Ilungu leBhodi njengomholi. b Elinye ilungu njengomphakathi ophakeme ukuze enze njengomholi weBhodi uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza le msebenzi. b Ilungu lezigungu, izigungu zesifunda, umkhandlu wesifunda, noma umholi wesiko osunguliwe ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke. c Umuntu ophoqelekile. d Umuntu onezinkinga zengqondo noma onedokhumenti esemthethweni ethi lowo muntu unengqondo engalungile noma ungenakho. f Umuntu osuswe emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi. g Umuntu osuswe eBhodi ngenxa yokwephula imithetho yayo. Ilungu leBhodi kumele likhishwe esikhundleni uma lelo lungu lenze noma yiziphi zezinto ezishiwo esigabeni sokuqala. a Ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi, ukungabi nolwazi, nokungafaneleki. b Ngenxa yokwehluleka ukuhambisana nesigaba 8 2 noma 151. c Uma ilungu ingahambeli emihlanganweni yeBhodi ngokulandelana ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele, d Noma ngenye imbangela efanelekile. IBhodi ingakhulula ilungu ngemuva kokunikeza ithuba lokuchaza izinkinga zayo. Isikhathi sokusebenza kwamalungu eBhodi. a Kungaba iminyaka emithathu, b Kungaba ngaphansi kwemithetho ebekwe yi-MEC kanye naleyo ebhalwe emqulwini wokukhetha ilungu. Uma ilungu likhishwa noma lishiya esikhundleni, i-MEC ingakhetha omunye umuntu esikhundleni salo lolu lungu kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi noma kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi esibekwe yi-MEC ngokwesigaba. Ngokwesigaba 8, umuntu angakhethwa futhi isikhathi sokusebenza kwabo singaqiniswa uma bengakhethwanga ezikhathini ezimbili ezilandelanayo. I-MEC kumele ihlukanise ukuthi malini amalungu
Umbiko: Ukunakekelwa Kwamadoda Nabesifazane Abadala Isingeniso Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kuyinsika ebalulekile emphakathini wethu. Njengoba abantu befinyelela ezinyangeni zabo ezithile, kubalulekile ukuthi bathole ukunakekelwa okulungile ukuze bagcine impilo enhle, umoya ophilayo, kanye nokwaneliseka empilweni. Lokhu akubalulekile kuphela kubantu abadala, kodwa futhi nakubantu abaseduze kwabo, njengezihlobo nabangane. Umbiko lo uzogxila ezindleleni ezahlukene zokunakekela abantu abadala, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona. Izidingo Zokunakekelwa Abantu abadala bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nezinkinga zempilo, ukungabi namandla, kanye nokwehla kokusebenza kwemizwa. Lokhu kudinga ukunakekelwa okuhle, okungahlanganisa izidingo zomzimba, ezokwelapha, kanye nezokuxhumana. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akugcini nje ngokubagcina bephila, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umuzwa wokuxhumana, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Izindlela Zokunakekelwa Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokunakekela abantu abadala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa ekhaya, ezikhungweni zokunakekela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ukunakekelwa ekhaya kuvumela abantu abadala ukuba bahlale endaweni abayithandayo, bejabulile, futhi bephila impilo ejwayelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi imindeni ibekezelele futhi ibanikeze usizo oludingekayo. Ezikhungweni zokunakekela, abantu abadala bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa, ukudla okunempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa. Lezi zikhungo zihlala ziqashwa ngochwepheshe abanolwazi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Izinselelo Zokunakekelwa Nokho, ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kuza nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, izinsiza zokunakekela zihlala zikhawulelwe, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo oludingekayo. Imindeni eminingi ibhekana nezindleko eziphezulu zokunakekela, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abadala bangase babe nezinselelo zokuxhumana, okungaholela ekuzizweni bephucukile. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze sithuthukise ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi baphathe izinhlelo zokuxhasa imindeni, ukuze kube lula ukuthola izinsiza zokunakekela. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukunciphisa izindleko zokunakekela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu abanakekela, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokunakekela ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphakathi ingadlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukuze abantu abadala bazizwe behloniphekile futhi bejabulile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imicimbi yokuxhumana, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuzijabulisa ezihloselwe abantu abadala. Isiphetho Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kuyisici esiyinhloko sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bahlala bejabulile, bephila impilo enempilo, futhi behloniphekile. Ngokuqhubeka nokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungele wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubudala bawo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni isizukulwane esizokwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbula ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akuyona nje imisebenzi, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke.
Masixoxe ngemuva kokuvuna imbewu yakho ye-maize yonyaka ka-2010, ukuhlela okujulile kwesizini yonyaka olandelayo kuqala. Le yisikhathi esihle sokuhlaziya okwenzekile esikhathini esedlule nokuhlola izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukuphathwa nokukhiqizwa kwemifino eyasiza esimweni nasekutholeni okukhishwe ekupheleni kwaleyo mifino. Uma imibiko yomlando ingagcinwanga emasimini ngamunye, manje yisikhathi esihle sokusebenzisa idatha yonyaka odlule ukuze uqale uhlelo lokugcina imibiko yomlando. Uma uhlelo lwebhizinisi lwakhiwe oluhlanganisa ukuhlela lokho kuzosebenza kumfino ngamunye unyaka olandelayo, izinga lokufaka kanye nezindleko ezitholakele kufanele ziqhathaniswe ngokucophelela nebhajethi eyayibekwe ekuqaleni. Izici ezithinta lezi zifaka kanye nezimo zomnotho kanye nezimo zezulu ezadlala indima empumelelweni noma ekwehlulekeni kwemifino ethile kufanele zicatshangelwe futhi zihlolwe ukuthi zishintshile noma zathuthuka. Imibiko eyisisekelo ngezimo zomhlabathi kufanele igcinwe futhi ivuselelwe minyaka yonke: igama lefamu, isifunda sefamu, indawo ephelele, izindawo ezilimiwe, izindawo zokulima, izindawo ezithuthukisiwe, ukuhlinzwa, ikhaya, izindlu zezimboni, nezakhiwo. Iphuzu ngalinye lendawo efamu ngalinye lingahlolwa mayelana nezinto ezisetshenziswe lapho: indawo yomhlaba, ukujula komhlabathi, uhlobo lomhlabathi, umanyolo, izinguquko zezulu eminyakeni eminingi. (Uma kutholakala emiphumeleni yokuhlola umhlabathi), ukujikeleza kwemifino nokuhlela ukujikeleza kwemifino kufanele kucatshangelwe, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokutshala, imifino ehlanganisiwe, izinga lokutshala imbewu, imvula ejwayelekile, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kokuthi imifino ithunyelwe, imvula etholelwe ngesikhathi sokukhula kwemifino, ukulawulwa kwezithombo ezisetshenzisiwe (kuhlanganise nezinto ezikhemikhali nezinga lokusebenzisa), ama-pesticides asetshenzisiwe nemiphumela yawo, imiphumela etholelwe kanye nesimo sayo. Izindleko zomanyolo ziyi-ndleko ezinkulu kakhulu zokufaka ezisetshenziswe ngqo ohlelweni lokulima imifino. Ukusebenzisa kahle uhlelo lokufaka umanyolo njalo ngesizini nasemnyakeni olandelayo kuzokhiqiza ukukhiqizwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Kubalulekile ukwazi isimo somhlabathi wakho ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokuthola imiphumela ephezulu yemifino nangemva kwemvula eningi etholelwe ezindaweni ezithile, okungase kube sekwenzele ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlaka eziningi ezibalulekile zemifino. Ukubukeka kokuphuma kwesikhumba ngenxa yokuntuleka kwe-nitrogen kanye ne-sulfur kubonwe ezindaweni eziningi ezithintekile kule nkathi yakamuva. Uma kukhona imifino ethile ethile, izakhi ezidingekayo ezikhiphwe kufanele zibuye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imifino elandelayo ingathola imiphumela elindelekile. Ngokukhumbula lokhu, amasampula omhlaba kufanele athathwe emasimini ngasinye se-maize ezokwenziwa futhi athunyelwe lapho azohlolwa khona. Izinyathelo eziningi kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inqubo yokufaka umanyolo nokuhlola izokwenza kahle emsebenzini wakho. Lezi zinyathelo zihlanganisa ukuqoqa nokuphatha kahle amasampula omhlaba, izinqubo ezifanele zokulandela, imihlahlandlela ehlelekile yokuhumusha imiphumela, ukulandela izincomo ezifanele zamazinga ezakhi ezidingekayo kumifino, nokuhlanganisa izidingo ezincomekayo zemifino ohlelweni oluphelele lokuphathwa kwezinto ezidingekayo kumifino. Inhloso yokuhlola umhlaba ukuhlole ikhono lomhlaba lokuhlinzeka ngezinto ezidingekayo ezidingekayo kumifino ezikhulayo nokuhlola noma yiziphi izinkinga zomhlaba ezingavimbela ukukhula nokuthuthuka kwemifino ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, imifino incike kakhulu ezitheni ezihlinzekwa njengomanyolo uma amazinga wokuhlola umhlaba enyuka. Ukuhlola umhlaba okuhlola ukujula kuvumela izinga elifanele le-herbicide ukuba lisetshenziswe ohlelweni lokulawulwa kwezithombo. Kubalulekile ukuthatha isampula emasimini ngasinye. Isampula yomhlaba ejulile engu-15 cm isisindo sithile sithi sithola cishe ama-kilogramu angu-2,400 kuye ngokuthi umhlaba ungakanani. Isampula yokugcina ethunyelwe kulabhorethri ingase isisindo sibe ama-kilogramu angu-0.5, ezokwenziwa ibe amagramu amancane. Ngenxa yalokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwemithombo enejula nezindawo ezahlukene zomhlaba ezisemasimini, ezingezona ingxenye yendawo ephelele elimiwe. Kusasebenza ukukhiqiza umanyolo ngokwezigaba ezibekwe kuzo zonke izindawo zomhlaba, ngaphandle uma kunezindawo ezitholakala nge-satellite (GPS) nezindlela ezilungiselelwe zokufaka umanyolo, ezingaphrintiwe endaweni esetshenziselwa ukutshala. Akusho ukuthi le ukuhlola kungcono kunesampula eqoqwe kulolo mhlaba. Khumbula ukuthi kukhona umehluko omkhulu emithonjeni emasimini. Esikhathini esedlule, isampula eqoqwe kumaholidi ayishumi emkhakheni ngamunye yayithathwa njengokwaneleyo. Nokho, kunconywa ukuthi uthenge noma uboleke ithuluzi lokubhoboza (auger) ukuze wenze imikhondo ukusuka phezulu phansi kulolo mhlaba nabantu ababili, omunye ephethe ibhagi ngayinye yesampula nethatha isampula yomhlaba efika ejulile phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm kodwa ingadluli ku-20 cm. Ibhokisi lesampula kufanele libe nelayisense ecacile enenombolo yefele, igama, ikheli lefamu, izinombolo zokuxhumana, nosuku lokuqoqwa kwesampula, ukuze kugwenywe noma yisiphi isiphithiphithi kulabhorethri. Kungcono ukwenza lo msebenzi wonke ngokucophelela emasimini ukuze kugwenywe ukungafani ezisampuleni eziqoqiwe. Amasampula omhlaba akufanele aqoqwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ezifana nezindawo ezingenela olwandle, imifula eyomile, izindawo ezigcina izitshalo ezindala emasimini, izintaba eziphansi, noma izindawo eziphukile. Manje sekuyenzeka ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokubeka (Global Positioning System) ohlelweni lwezikhala eziphakathi kwamamitha angu-0.5 kuya ku-4, noma ukucabangela ukuqoqa amasampula ohlelweni lwezikhala. Amasampula azobe eqhathaniswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nezinguquko ezenzeka kumazinga okukhula komhlaba zingatholakala kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Imiphumela yokuhlola ingatholwa ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lweGeographic Information System (GIS) ukuze kutholwe imephu enombala yefele ebonisa i-pH, i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-phosphate, i-sulfur, i-nitrogen, i-micronutrients, nezinye izinguquko zokuhlola umhlaba zingaboniswa ukuze kuboniswe ukubonakaliswa kwemfanelo noma ubukhulu benkinga ethile emasimini. Ezindaweni eziningi, izindawo eziphakathi zikhonjwa zisebenzisa indlela ye-grid ngokusekelwe kumaholidi efamu. Isikhathi esihle sokuthatha amasampula yileso lapho uzoba nethuba lokwenza kahle lo msebenzi, lapho ungathatha izinqumo ngokuhlukanisa ngamehlo efamu ibe izindawo ezifanayo zokuthola amasampula futhi ngesikhathi esifanayo minyaka yonke ngemuva kokuvuna noma ngesikhathi esifanayo lapho imifino ijikeleza. Kuye kwaba us
Amaphrojekthi ahlangabezana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu Njengoba siqhubeka nokuphila emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akuyona inkinga kuphela kubantu abathengisa noma ohulumeni, kodwa kubalulekile kithi sonke. Lokhu kuhlobene nempilo yethu yonke. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu sekuholele ekutheni sithole izixazululo ezihlukene ezizothinta kahle umphakathi, umnotho, kanye nemvelo yethu. Ngakho, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise izinga lethu lokuphila, futhi siqonde kahle impilo yethu yesikhathi esizayo. Omunye wemikhankaso emikhulu emhlabeni jikelele uhilela amaphrojekthi akhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwamandla avuselelekayo, okuhlanganisa imithombo efana nelanga, umoya, namanzi. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ukuvuselela amandla kuyisixazululo esiyinhloko ekunciphiseni umthelela wezokukhiqiza kwezimbiwa, okungakhuthaza ukuncipha kokungcola. Izinhlelo zokufaka amandla avuselelekayo emakhaya zikhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, zikhulula izabelomali ezinkulu, futhi zinciphisa ukungcola kwenhawunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphrojekthi okubhekana nokuguquka kwesimo sezulu angase aqhube imikhankaso yokungcwaba okuhlakaniphile, okukhuthaza ukungcwaba kwemfucumfucu ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukudla okuvela emakhaya, kube nomthelela omuhle ekulondolozeni imithombo yethu yemvelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlalisana kwezilwane nemvelo yazo kubalulekile ukuze kugcinwe ukulinganisela. Amaphrojekthi avikela izindawo zemvelo, njengezinkanyezi zomhlaba nezikhukhula, ahlinzeka ngombono omuhle wokuthi singabhekana kanjani nalezi zinkinga. Njengoba izindawo ezinjalo zigcinwa, zikhuthaza ukuhamba kwemvelo, okwenza sikhumbule ukubaluleka kwazo. Kodwa-ke, uhulumeni nabantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kudinga hhayi kuphela ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqwashisa emphakathini. Umqondo wokusebenzisa kahle izinsiza kufanele uqale ezindaweni ezincane, njengemindeni nezikole. Izifundo ezithinta imvelo ezikoleni zidinga ukufundiswa, ukuze izigaba ezahlukene zempilo ziqonde ngempilo yethu, impilo yomhlaba, nezinsiza esizisebenzisayo. Ngokwesibonelo, lapho sisebenzisa amandla ekuphileni kwethu, kudingeka siqinisekise ukuthi sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ukufaka izipho zokuphila eziphilayo, njengemithombo evela ezitshalweni, kugqugquzela umqondo wokulinganisa nempilo. Lokhu kungathuthukisa izindlela zethu zokuphila, futhi kuvikele imvelo yethu ekongoleni nasekugugulelweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amaphrojekthi okuphila ngendlela ehlanzekile kufanele ahlanganise izindawo ezichichimayo. Ngokuvamile, abantu basendaweni ezimnyama bahlala nemikhubulo yokungcola. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lesi simo sidinga izixazululo zendawo, uma singathatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizoba nempilo ehamba phambili. Amaphrojekthi ezokuthutha kufanele ahlanganise ukucacisa phakathi kokuthutha, izinyathelo ezincane zokuhlala ziqashwa njalo. Ngokufingqa, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kudinga umqondo ohlukile ophumelelayo kwi-ecosystem yethu. Amaphrojekthi akhuthaza izinsizakusebenza, izifundo ezithinta imvelo, kanye nokugcina izimo zenhlalakahle, zonke zikhombisa indlela esifuna ngayo. Ngokubambisana, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, onobuchwepheshe obuphathelene noshintsho lwezulu. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, eliphephile nezeluleki. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, singenza umehluko, sithuthukise impilo yethu, futhi sidlulisela umhlaba ophilayo kwabanye.
Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) Umxoxisana: UProf. Thandeka Mthethwa noMnu. Sipho Dlamini UProf. Mthethwa: Sawubona, Mnu. Dlamini. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namhlanje ukuze sikhulume ngokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni. Ngabe ungathanda ukusho kancane ngalesi sihloko? Mnu. Dlamini: Sawubona, UProf. Mthethwa. Ngiyabonga ngalesi sithakazelo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, ikakhulukazi yeGEMS (Government Employees Pension Fund), kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi umuntu ungowemali ethile yokupensiona. UProf. Mthethwa: Lokhu kuzwakala kuhle. Kukhona izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zilandwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe le nombolo? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, UProf. Mthethwa. Ngifuna kuphela ukugcizelela ukuthi ukwazi ukuhamba phambili kulolu hlelo kuncike ekwazini nasekusebenzisaneni. Mphakathi ophakeme, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngethule iSikhumbuzo seBhajethi somnyaka wezezimali ka-2009/2010 weMnyango Wezokwakha, okuwumnyango onikezwe umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ezinye izigaba zikamasipala ngezinsizakalo zezakhiwo nokugcinwa kwezakhiwo. Ukuguqulwa kwezimpahla zikamasipala kanye nokuba nefa kubandakanya ukuthengisa, ukuhoxisa, ukushintshisana, nokupha. UMnyango Wezokwakha udlala indima ebalulekile kulolu suku esikuso. Siphakathi kwesikhathi lapho imali iphela emhlabeni jikelele. Umhlaba uhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zomnotho ezisekelwe kumkhuba owaziwa njengezomnotho zikaKeynes ukuze uzikhulule kulokhu kuhlupheka, njengoba kwenzeka ngeminyaka yama-1930. Le nkinga yahlulwa kuphela ngempela ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili lapho ukukhiqizwa kwezikhali kuhlinzeka ngemicimbi yokusebenza kubo bonke abangenamsebenzi. Nokho, kulezi zinsuku, asikwazi ukuthembela ekukhiqizeni izikhali ukuze sixazulule le nkinga ngoba imiphumela yalokho iyesabekayo. Ngakho-ke, sidinga uhlelo olusha lokuhlanganisa bonke abafuna imisebenzi kanye nalabo abangenamsebenzi ngenxa yokungabi nemisebenzi. Lapha eKwaZulu-Natal, silahlekelwe yimisebenzi eminingi yokukhiqiza kunoma iyiphi enye indawo. Kufanele singene esikhathini sethemba nokuvuselelwa, noma uma silahlekelwa ithemba, kufanele sivumele konke kuphume. Ngikholwa ukuthi lesi yisikhathi sokuvuselelwa nethemba lesikhathi esingcono. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal, bafake ithemba labo nezifiso zabo kulolu hlelo lokuphatha lo mnyango. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, ngesikhathi sokuvuselelwa, uMnyango Wezokwakha uzibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi konke okwenziwe umnyango kuzobonwa ngokuqinile kokusebenza kanzima. Sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona indlela eyodwa yokubheka uhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezifundazwe mayelana nalokho uhulumeni omusha akubona kubalulekile. Okubalulekile kithi kuzoba ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezakhiwo kanye nokuphathwa kwezakhiwo njengamathuluzi okuheha utshalomali futhi ngaleyo ndlela sakhe amathuba emisebenzi nezinkampani. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, isiko lokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo ezithintekayo ekufezeni umsebenzi onikezwe lo mnyango kumele liqinisiwe. Nakuba kungelula, manje singasho ngokuzethemba ukuthi siqedile indima esinikezwe yona ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, futhi ngezinye izikhathi, kube nomuzwa wokungamukelwa. Naphezu kwalokhu, siqhubekile nokukhombisa ukuthuthuka ezingeni lomsebenzi wezinsizakalo zezakhiwo, isivinini sokuphothula umsebenzi, futhi kusenokuhlupheka ngalesi sikhathi. Umnyango ubheka ezinye izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi onikezwe wona nguhulumeni. Ezinye zazo zifaka ukulandela izinhlelo ezikhuthazwa abantu uqobo, zigxile kakhulu ekutholeni izinzuzo kubantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Siphakanyiswa ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zezigaba zethu zamakhasimende ngendlela ezohlangabezana nezinto ezibalulekile kuhulumeni. Ngakho-ke, sizosebenza ngendlela edala amathuba emisebenzi amaningi uma izinhlelo zikamasipala zisetshenziswa ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zamakhasimende ethu. Sizokwenza lokhu ngaphakathi kwebhajethi enikezwe kithi, ngokuya ngamanani adingekayo, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe nasemazingeni adingekayo omsebenzi. Umongameli weRiphabhulikhi, uMphakathi ophakeme uJacob Zuma, ukhulume ngohulumeni onakekela futhi osebenza kahle ophendula izidingo zabantu. Uthembise egameni lethu sonke njengesakhamuzi saleli zwe ukuthi "lo mnyango uzibophezele ekubekeni abantu phambili." Sizophumelela ekuxazululeni udaba lokuhamba kwabantu besuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya beya emadolobheni ngokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwasemakhaya kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abaningi bethu abalayishi. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kwasemakhaya kufanele kuhambisane nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza futhi ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukise izinga lempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, lapho kukhona ukuhlangana kokumbiwa nokukhiqizwa kwezinto, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kuyisiphiwo esihle sokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu ngokuvumela ukuba babambe iqhaza ngqo. Lapho kukhishwa izikhangiso, kugxilwa kulokho uhulumeni akubona kubalulekile. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa okujwayelekile nokweseka uMnyango. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusiza uMnyango ngokuphathwa kobudlelwano bezabasebenzi, izindaba zomthetho, nokuphathwa kwezimali. Le ngxenye iyinhloko yomsebenzi walomnyango futhi ifaka konke okukhona kokuthengwa nokuhlala kwezakhiwo. Ngaphezu kokugcina uhlu lwezimpahla zikamasipala, uMnyango unomthwalo wokwenza uqinisekise ukuhambisana nomthetho owaziwa nge-GIAMA - okuma ku-Government Immovable Asset Management Act ka-2007. Inhloso eyinhloko yalolu hlelo ukuhlinzeka ngezakhiwo ngokuhambisana nohlelo lwezokwakha lomnyango kanye nebajethi ekhona. Le ngxenye iphinde ibheke ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo zikamasipala. Izwe lethu ligcwele ukushoda kwamakhono, futhi uhulumeni ubeke phambili ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono nokufundiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi uxhaso lwenyuke ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono ngoba lokho kuzosisiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zemisebenzi. Ukushoda kwamakhono emkhakheni wokwakha nokuphathwa kwezimpahla kuphazamisa umsebenzi wethu. Lokhu kuphoqa uMnyango ukuthi uthembele kubasebenzi bangaphandle ukuze uqedele imisebenzi yawo, okwenziwa ngentengo ephezulu futhi akukwazi ukuqhubeka. Okwamanje, kunezithunywa eziyi-7 kulo Mnyango, kanti ababili babo abathole izifundo baphumelele ngokuphelele emisebenzini ngaphakathi koMnyango. Sizokuqhubeka nohlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abantu bethu emnyakeni wezezimali ozayo, lapho sizophinde singenise uhlelo lokufunda lokuphathwa kwephrojekthi lapho umsebenzi wokwakha wenziwa khona. Ngokomlando, uMnyango Wezokwakha unabasebenzi besilisa abaningi kunezabasebenzi besifazane. Nokho, manje ngiyakwazi ukuveza ukuthi kube nokuthuthuka ekwakhiweni kwabantu besifazane. Kusukela emnyakeni wezezimali ka-2007/08, kube nokushintsha kuMnyango lapho iphesenti labesifazane, elangaphambili lalingama-25%, lenyuke laba ngu-35%. Nokho, siqonda ukuthi sisadinga ukwenza okuningi ukuze sifinyelele ku-51% yokwakhiwa kwabantu besifazane. Sizokuqhubeka ngonyaka lo ukubhekana nokwakhiwa kobulili endaweni yokusebenza ngokuba nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibhekiswe ekulungiseleleni abesifazane ezingeni lokuphatha eliphakathi ukuze bathuthuke baye ezingeni eliphezulu. Asikafinyeleli umgomo we-2.6% wabantu abanokukhubazeka, kodwa kusekhona umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe ukuze kulungiswe lokhu. Ngifuna ukwenza kube sobala kulokhu okukhuluma okokuqala ukuthi ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngaphansi kokuhola kwami, umnyango uzosebenza ngaphandle kokwenza noma yiziphi izenzo zokungathembeki ezifana nokukhwabanisa nokukhwabanisa.
