UJacob Zuma: Indaba Yomlando UJacob Gedleyihlekisa Zuma, owazalwa ngomhla ziyi-12 kuNhlangulana ngonyaka ka-1942 eNkandla, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezwe. UZuma wakhulela emndenini ophila ezimeni ezinzima, lapho ubaba wakhe, uJulius Zuma, ayengumsebenzi wezolimo, kanti unina, uNongoma, wayengumama ophila impilo ejwayelekile. Lezi zimo zashiya umthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, zamsiza ukuba aqonde ubunzima obubhekene nabantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kokuphuma esikoleni, uZuma waba yilungu le-ANC (African National Congress) ngonyaka ka-1959. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu emzabalazweni wokulwa nobandlululo, lapho ahlanganyela khona nezinye izinkanyezi zomzabalazo ezifana noNelson Mandela noOliver Tambo. UZuma wathola ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe bokulwa, waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphathweni kwezempi ye-ANC, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili. Ngonyaka ka-1963, uZuma wabanjwa wabe esethunyelwa ejele, lapho ahlala khona iminyaka engu-10. Ngesikhathi esebhajwe, uZuma wathola ithuba lokucabanga ngempilo yakhe, izinjongo zakhe, kanye nezifiso zomzabalazo. Ngemva kokuphuma ejele, uZuma waqhubeka nokusebenza ngokuzikhandla, waba umholi ophakeme kwi-ANC, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-ANC nezinye izinhlangano zomhlaba. Ngonyaka ka-1994, uZuma waba nguMphakathi Wezokuphepha, lapho ahola khona izinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. UZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umthetho ophathelene nezokuphepha, okwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha. Ngalesi sikhathi, uZuma waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, futhi waqala ukwakha igama lakhe njengomholi onobuhlakani. Ngemuva kokuphumelela kwe-ANC, uZuma waba nguMongameli we-ANC ngonyaka ka-2005. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, njengoba uZuma wabhekana nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa, kodwa waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-ANC nezinye izinhlangano. UZuma waba nguMongameli wezwe ngonyaka ka-2009, lapho abhekana khona nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganisa nezinsolo zokuphula umthetho. Njengomongameli, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa waphinde waba nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu phakathi kwe-ANC, kanye nezinsolo zokuthi uZuma ubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano obungafanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZuma waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu. Nokho, izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zaphinde zaba yinkinga enkulu, futhi uZuma wathola ukugxekwa okukhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu phakathi kwe-ANC, kanye nezinsolo zokuthi uZuma ubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano obungafanele. Ngonyaka ka-2018, uZuma wathatha isinqumo sokuhoxa esikhundleni, kwathi uCyril Ramaphosa wathatha indawo yakhe. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola impumelelo kaZuma, kanye nezinsolo ezihlobene nezinto eziningi ezenzakalayo ngesikhathi sokuphatha kwakhe. UZuma waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ezindabeni zomphakathi, futhi waqhubeka nokusebenza ezindabeni ezihlobene nezokuphepha, kodwa izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zaphinde zaba yinkinga enkulu. UJacob Zuma ungumholi onobuhlakani, ophumelele emzabalazweni wokulwa nobandlululo, kodwa waphinde waba nezinselelo eziningi ezihlobene nezinsolo zokukhwabanisa. Indaba yakhe ibonisa ukuthi impilo yomholi ayilula, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. UZuma ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni wezwe, futhi indaba yakhe izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni weNingizimu Afrika.
Izinselelo Zempilo: Uhlanga Olubhalela Umzabalazo Wethu Empilweni, izinselelo zihlala zikhona, zifana nezikhukhula eziphakamisayo. Siphila emhlabeni ogcwele izithiyo, futhi lezi zithiyo zihlala zikhumbuza ukuthi impilo ayilula. Lezi zinselelo zingavela ngezindlela ezihlukene, kusuka ezimweni ezimfushane nezincane, kuya ezinkingeni ezinzima ezichitha amandla ethu. Kulokhu, ngizobe ngizama ukucacisa izinselelo zempilo, ngendlela engicabanga ngayo, futhi ngibone ukuthi zingafundisa kanjani. Okokuqala, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi izinselelo zingaba ngezemali. Ukuphila emhlabeni wamanje kubiza kakhulu, futhi abanye abantu bakhuthazeka kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemali. Lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu, ikakhulukazi uma ubheka umndeni. Imali ayinayo kuphela isidingo sokuphila, kodwa ibalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuthola imfundo, ukwelashwa, nezinsiza zempilo ezifanele. Umsebenzi ungaba nezinselelo zawo, futhi ukungenisa imali enganele kungaba umthwalo omkhulu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinselelo zezimali zikhona, futhi kumele sizilwele ukuze siphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zempilo zikwazi ukufaka isandla ekuphathweni kwempilo yethu. Abantu abaningi balwa nezinkinga zempilo, ezinjengokugula, ukugula kwengqondo, noma izimo ezithile eziphindaphindayo. Lezi zinkinga zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu, zishiya abantu bebheda nempilo yabo. Ukubhekana nemithi, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa, kudinga amandla amaningi. Ukukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo kokuqala kubalulekile, njengoba kuyinkinga ebonisa izinselelo ezinzima. Ukwenza izinqumo ezinzima kuyinselelo eyodwa eyaziwayo, okuyinto yansuku zonke. Ukuzikhethela phakathi kwezinketho, noma ukwenza izinqumo ezinkulu ezithinta ikusasa, kungaba yinkinga. Imiphumela yalezi zinqumo ibaluleke kakhulu, njengoba izimpilo zomuntu zingashintsha ngokuphelele. Njengoba sithola ulwazi, sithola izinketho eziningi, kodwa ukwaziswa kahle kuthinta umqondo wethu. Lokhu kudinga ukufunda okukhulu nokuhlola, ukuze sikwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziyinqaba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinselelo zempilo zikhona kwazulu. Kukhona abanye abantu abathola ubunzima ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ubudlelwano obuhle buxhumene nezinsiza zempilo yengqondo, kanti uma lezi zinsiza zingatholakali, abantu bangazizwa behluleka. Ukuthola izixazululo kulokhu kudinga ukuthi sithole abantu abathembekile, futhi sibe nesineke, kuphinde kwaziwe ukuthi uthando, ukuqonda, nokuxolelana kubalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo zempilo zifundisa okuningi. Zifundisa ukuthi ukuphila akukhona kuphela ukuphumelela, kodwa futhi ubunzima. Ubuqotho, amandla, nokuqonda kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila. Siphila edolobheni elikhulayo, futhi abantu bethu abavumi ukuhamba phambili. Ukufunda ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinzima, ukufunda ukuvuma izinkinga, kuyasiza ekwenzeni impilo ibe ngcono. Ekugcineni, izinselelo zempilo zidlala indima enkulu empilweni yethu. Ziyazama, zikhumbuza ukuthi impilo ayikabi lula, kodwa umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukufunda nokukhula. Siphila emhlabeni lapho kuhlangana khona ubunzima nemizamo yokuphila. Ngakho, kumele sihlale siphokophele impumelelo, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi emkhakheni wezinselelo, sikhona amandla okukhula, uhlobo oluphila, futhi lokho kuphila kuyakwazi ukunika umqondo ohlangene. Izifundo ezitholakala ezinselelweni zempilo ziwusizo ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Akukhona nje izigameko ezibuhlungu, kodwa izifundo ezitholakele zenza kube nokukhula. Ngakho-ke, kumele sibe nezinhliziyo ezivulekile, sibe nesineke, futhi sihloniphe zonke izinselelo eziphuma empilweni yethu. Lokhu kunikeza amandla olwethu emhlabeni ogcwele izithiyo. Njengoba sikhula, sithola amandla okujabulela impilo yethu, nokuvuma ukujula ebunzimeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizofunda ukuthi lezi zinto zifundisa ubuhlakani, futhi lezi zifundo zizokhumbuza ukuthi empilweni, konke kuyenzeka, uma sithatha izinyathelo zethu. Uhlanga oludlalayo, luhlaza, futhi lukhula ngezimo eziningi, njengempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengokuthi bonke abantu badinga izinsiza zokuphila, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlanganisa impilo yabo. Noma izinselelo zempilo zigcwele, kufanele sithokozise umhlaba, siphokophele ukufunda, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphila kuyinto enhle, ngisho noma kubonakala kunzima. Lezi zifundo zihlala zikhona, futhi ziwusizo empilweni yethu. Qhubeka nokukhula, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo ephelele, ezinzima, kodwa futhi ezijabulisayo.
Umthelela Wama-Social Media Entsheni Ezinyangeni ezedlule, umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yokukhula kwama-social media. Lezi zinkundla, njengeFacebook, Instagram, Twitter, kanye neTikTok, zihlala zinemiphumela emikhulu empilweni yentsha yanamuhla. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kudala ingxoxo ethakazelisayo, ethusayo, futhi evusa amadlingozi mayelana nemiphumela ethile ethinta intsha. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle umthelela wama-social media, kuhlanganise nezinzuzo nezingozi ezithintekayo. Okokuqala, masiqale ngokubheka izinzuzo zama-social media. Lezi zinkundla zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwentsha. Ngaphandle kwezithiyo zemikhakha, intsha iyakwazi ukwabelana ngezinto eziningi, njengezifundo, imicimbi, noma izinkinga ezibathintayo. Lokhu kukhuthaza umqondo we-communitiy, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona futhi besizana. Ngokwakha ubudlelwane obunempilo, intsha ingathola ukwesekwa, imihlahlandlela, nokuxhumana nezinye izizinda ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media anikeza ithuba elikhulu lokufunda. Ngaphandle kokuxhumana, lezi zinkundla ziqukethe ulwazi oluwusizo, olufanele, nolwakha. Abantu abavela kuzo zonke izizinda bangabelana ngemibono, izifundo, nemiphumela ehlukene. Lokhu kudala amathuba okukhula, ukucabanga, nokuhlola izinto ngendlela ebanzi. Intsha ingafunda ngezinhlelo zokusebenza, izifundo ezenzakalayo, nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene, okungaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Uma sikhuluma ngama-social media, kufanele sikhulume nangemiphumela emibi. Okokuqala, ukuxhumana okungapheli kungaholela ekutheni intsha ibe nezingcindezi zempilo ezinkulu. Izithombe ezinhle nokuphila okunempilo okukhombisa abanye kuzosiza ekwakheni izinga lokuphila eliphezulu, okungaholela emoyeni wokunganeliseki. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela kulokhu okubukwayo, okubangela ukuthi baqhubeke bezama ukuphila ngendlela ethile, okungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-social media angaba yindawo yokubandlulula. Amathuba okudlulisa imibono ahlukeneyo angaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwane obubi, lapho abantu behlukaniswa khona ngenxa yezinkolelo zabo, imakethe, noma imikhuba. Lokhu kudala umoya wokungaboni ngeso lengqondo, ophazamisa ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu. Abantu abavame ukuhlola nokuthola amaqiniso angokoqobo, futhi lokhu kungaba yingozi. Ukwengeza, kumele sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo yentsha. Ukuhlwithwa kwezinto ezikwi-inthanethi, ukushoda kokuxhumana okukhishwayo, nokushoda kwesikhathi esikhuluma nabanye abantu, kungaholela ekutheni abantu babe nezinselelo zempilo yengqondo. Ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, nokwehla kwemizwa kungenzeka kube yizimfanelo ezivame ukuvela ngenxa yokuxhumana okungapheli. Lokhu kudinga ukuphathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha iyakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbula ukuthi ama-social media akhuthaza ubucayi nokubukeka kahle. Intsha iphakathi kokuphila emhlabeni lapho ubucayi bukhuthazwa, futhi lezi zinkundla zenza kube lula ukuthola izithombe ezinhle, imiklamo, namathrendi. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni abantu baqonde ukuthi ubuhle bokuqala bukhona kuphela uma uthobela okukhombisa lokhu. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi ubuhle buhamba phambili, okuholela ekutheni intsha ibhekane nezinkinga eziningi. Kuwo wonke la maphuzu, kubalulekile ukuthola ibhalansi phakathi kokusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela enempilo nokugwema izingozi ezihambisana nawo. Abazali, othisha, nabanye abantu abadala badinga ukusiza intsha ukuze ithole ulwazi olufanele, ikwazi ukuqonda imiphumela ehlukahlukene, nokuhlonipha izinsiza ezikhona. Ukuze intsha ikwazi ukusebenza kahle nokuziqhenya, udinga ukuqonda nokuhlola indlela yokusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela efanele. Ngamafuphi, umthelela wama-social media entsheni ungaphakathi kokwaziswa, ukuzithokozisa, nokushintsha impilo. Noma kunezinzuzo eziningi, akumele sikhohlwe ngezingozi ezihambisana nawo. Ukuze intsha ibhekane nazo zonke lezi zinto, kubalulekile ukuba ibe nolwazi olufanele, izikhombisi, kanye neqhaza eliqinile. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelizwakalayo. Kuhlala kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu bethu, imizwa yethu, kanye nezimpilo zethu zibalulekile kakhulu kunoma yisiphi isithombe esingaphandle.
Yini ukuphathwa kolwazi? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyindlela yokusebenza kwezindawo ezahlukene ezisiza iminyango nezinhlelo ukuthuthukisa, ukwandisa, ukusabalalisa, ukubamba, ukuguqula, nokugcina ulwazi ukuze zifeze izinhloso zazo ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Yini inzuzo enkulu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Izinhlangano zithola inzuzo ngokugcwalisa ngokushesha izifiso nezinto ezihlosiwe, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kokukhiqiza, ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukusungulwa kwezindlela ezintsha, ukuncintisana, nokwandiswa kwezindlela zesayensi ezintsha; kuyilapho labo abasebenza nolwazi bethuthukisa umbono wabo nokuzimisela. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyisixazululo esisheshayo? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo hhayi isixazululo esisheshayo. Emhlabeni jikelele, imikhankaso nemihlangano yokuphathwa kolwazi iyasungulwa, futhi akukho ukuhamba emuva. Imikhankaso yokuphathwa kolwazi iyindlela eya ikusasa eliphumelelayo. Yini ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphathwa kolwazi nesikhathi solwazi? Ikhompyutha encane, i-Internet, kanye nezinto ezithuthukisiwe zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwe emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi eMelika, kuholele ekusungulweni kwelithi "Isikhathi Solwazi," kodwa kubonakala futhi ukuthi kuzobizwa kakhulu ngokuthi "Isikhathi Solwazi." Njengoba abantu bedlulela esikhathini seMboni besuka esikhathini solwazi, ezingeni eliphansi, ukuphathwa kolwazi sekuthuthuke kakhulu ukuze kubhekwe izinguquko. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinto entsha? Izinqubo nezimiso zokuphathwa kolwazi azikabi zintsha, njengoba kukhombisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kolwazi okwenziwe ngabantu kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo (izibonelo zifaka phakathi izindlela ezisetshenziswe emlilweni, insimbi, ngebhontshisi) ezadluliselwa ezizukulwaneni futhi zanda emhlabeni jikelele. Indlela ehlelekile yokuphatha ulwazi njengendawo yokugcina iyinsimu entsha futhi ethuthukayo, eyakhiwe yizinguquko ezisheshayo nezithuthukisi zobuchwepheshe nokuxhumana, nokubheka ulwazi njengemithombo ebalulekile yokusetshenziswa kwezicwangciso. Ulwazi luyindawo ebalulekile njengalezo zemithombo yemvelo, imithombo yabantu, kanye nezezimali. Indlela imboni nezinhlelo ezisebenzisa ngayo ulwazi nezindlela ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zolwazi, kanye nendlela lokho ulwazi lwasabalaliswa ngayo, kungafezwa ngempumelelo kusetshenziswa isikhali es secret sokuphumelela, okuyi ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuhlukile kwiTekhnoloji Yolwazi? Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyitekhnoloji noma isenzo? Ukuphathwa kolwazi akusiyo nje itekhnoloji noma isenzo esilula; kuyisistimu kanye neziqoqi zobuchwepheshe ezisekela ukwabelana kolwazi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano ethile ukuze kuqhutshwe izicwangciso nemikhankaso yokusungula. Ukuphathwa kolwazi (KM) kuhlobene kanjani nabantu? Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuphathwa kolwazi ngabantu abasebenza nolwazi, abathintekayo abasebenza enhlangano ethile, kanye nalabo abaziwa ngolwazi futhi kulindeleke ukuthi basize amakhasimende ale nhlangano. Ngakho-ke, ukuphathwa kolwazi kuphathelene nabantu kanye nokuphathwa kokuphila kwabo, hhayi uhlelo oluphatha ngendlela yokuphatha. Ukushintsha indlela yokwenza izinto kudinga ukushintsha kokuthi abantu bacabange kanjani kanye nenqubo endaweni yokusebenza eguqulwa ibe eyokwethembana nokwethembeka. Ukwabelana ngolwazi kuzosisiza abasebenzi benhlangano basebenzise ulwazi olukhona kunokuzama ukudala okuthile okusha. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ngokubonakalayo nangempumelelo ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi, okuholela ekusungulweni, okuyimiphumela yolwazi olusha. Yini umthelela wokuphathwa kolwazi ezicini zokusebenza zenhlangano? Enye into ebalulekile yokuphathwa kolwazi ukuxhumana kwayo nezinqubo nezicwangciso zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwaleyo nhlangano, okwenza inhlangano ibe sezingeni lokuncintisana nabanye. Yini umehluko phakathi kwedatha, ulwazi, nolwazi? Idatha imelela izinto ezibonakalayo noma eziyiqiniso ezingaqhathaniswa nalokho, ngakho-ke ayinani ngaphandle komongo. Ulwazi luwumphumela wokuhlela idatha ngendlela enencazelo futhi efanele, kuvame ukudlulisa umlayezo. Ulwazi yilokho esikholwa ukuthi sinakho sithole ukubaluleka okuthile ngemva kokuhlela nokwakha imiyalezo ngendlela eqondakalayo ngokuya ngezinto esizihlangabezane nazo, ukuhlangana, noma ukuxhumana okuqondisiwe. Ulwazi lungabhekwa njengento engagcinwa bese isetshenziswa njengoba kudingeka, kanye nenqubo eqhubekayo yokwazi ehlanganisa ukuqonda nokwenza - inqubo ekhombisa ubuchule. Ulwazi luwuqoqo lwezinkolelo ezithathwa njengezempela, futhi le nkolelo ingabekwa ngumuntu okungenani oyedwa, ngendlela yemiyalezo nolwazi olwaneleyo olungaqondwa futhi lusetshenziswe omunye umuntu. Kumele kube nezindawo ezithile ezibonakalayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwamukelwa njengolwazi. Ingabe kukhona indlela yokukala nokuhlola izinga kanye quality yolwazi? Yebo, ngokubona ukuthi kusiza inhlangano noma umuntu ukufinyelela kalula izinhloso zabo. Ingabe kukhona iwebhusayithi noma ipulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Iphulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi isunguliwe ukuhlinzeka ngesiteshi sokuxhumana sokubambisana ngaphakathi kweSahluko Sokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoba yindawo yokugcina yokuphathwa kolwazi, kuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuphathwa kolwazi futhi kusetshenziswe njengendawo yokuxoxa ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokuphathwa kolwazi eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukushoda Kukagesi: Izizathu, Imiphumela, Nezixazululo Ukushoda kukagesi sekuyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi ezithinta umphakathi, umnotho, kanye nezimboni. Le nkinga ibonakala ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho abantu bephila khona ezindaweni ezidinga ugesi ukuze kuqhubeke izimpilo zabo zansuku zonke. Kodwa-ke, ukushoda kukagesi akukhona nje kuphela ukungabi khona kukagesi; kudinga ukuba siqonde izizathu eziholela kulokhu, imiphumela ethinta abantu, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kulungiswe le nkinga. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu eziholela ekushodeni kukagesi. Enye yezizathu ezinkulu yizinkinga ezikhona emithonjeni yokukhiqiza ugesi. Iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi, ikakhulukazi lezo ezisebenzisa amalahle, zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga zokuguga, ukungasebenzi kahle, kanye nezindleko eziphezulu zokugcina. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni iziteshi zingakwazi ukukhiqiza ugesi owanele ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuncipha kwemithombo yemvelo, njengamalahle, kuyabeka ingcindezi ekukhiqizeni ugesi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngogesi owanele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zikhona. I-Eskom, okuyinkampani enkulu yokukhiqiza ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi zokuphatha, okuhlanganisa ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele, ukungabi nezinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha abantu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuphazamiseka ekukhiqizeni nasekulethweni kukagesi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubantu. Imiphumela yokushoda kukagesi ibonakala kakhulu emiphakathini. Okokuqala, abantu bahlushwa kakhulu ngenxa yokungabi khona kukagesi. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemisebenzi, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ugesi ukuze zisebenze. Lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemisebenzi, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukushoda kukagesi kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuphila, njengoba abantu bephoqwa ukuba bathenge izixazululo ezibizayo, njengezizinda zokugcina ugesi, ukuze baqhubeke nokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukushoda kukagesi kudala umthelela omubi emnothweni. Izinkampani ezincane, ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo ebalulekile, zihlushwa kakhulu ngenxa yokungabi khona kukagesi. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kokukhiqiza, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo emakethe. Lokhu, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kuholela ekwehleni komnotho, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka kubantu. Kodwa-ke, nakuba le nkinga ibonakala ibucayi, kunezixazululo ezithile ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kulungiswe ukushoda kukagesi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni ahlole izindlela zokuthuthukisa iziteshi zokukhiqiza ugesi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha iziteshi ezintsha ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengeziteshi ezisebenzisa amandla elanga noma amanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi owanele, futhi kuzokwehlisa ukuncika kumithombo yemvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngempilo yabo futhi baphathe kahle izinsiza. Ukuze sithole ugesi owanele, abantu kufanele baziqhenye ngokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi ezindaweni ezingadingi khona, njengokukhanyisa izindawo ezingenamsebenzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubantu abaningi. Ekugcineni, ukushoda kukagesi kuyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kulungiswe le nkinga. Izizathu eziholela kulokhu zidinga ukuba ziqondwe kahle, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngaphandle kokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nomphakathi, sizobhekana nezinkinga ezinzima ezithinta ugesi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola ugesi owanele, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila impilo engcono.
I-European Union: Uhlaka Lwayo I-European Union (EU) iyinhlangano yezepolitiki neyezomnotho eyakhelwe phezu kokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe aseYurophu. Isebenza njengomphakathi ophakathi kwezizwe ezihlukene, futhi inhloso yayo enkulu ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko, ukuthula, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu. I-EU yasungulwa ngemuva kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho izwe laseYurophu lathola ukuthi kudingeka ukuhlanganisa amandla ukuze kuvinjwe izimpi ezaziholela ebuhlungwini obukhulu. I-EU yathuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo, iqala ngezakhamuzi ezingu-6 ehlanganisa iBelgium, iFransi, iJalimane, iItali, iLuxembourg, neNetherlands. Lezi zizwe zazifuna ukuvuselela umnotho wazo ngemuva kwempi, futhi zathola ukuthi ukuhweba phakathi kwazo kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaleso sikhathi, i-EU yayaziwa njenge-European Economic Community (EEC), kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, yanda yaba nezinhlaka eziningi ezihlanganisa izici ezahlukene zempilo yomphakathi. Namuhla, i-EU ibandakanya amazwe angama-27, kuhlanganisa iSpain, iPoland, iSweden, neHungary, phakathi kwabanye. I-EU ibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni eziphathelene nezomnotho, ezepolitiki, nezokuhlalisana. Iphinde ibe nomthelela omkhulu ezinqubweni zomhlaba, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta ubulungiswa, amalungelo abantu, kanye nezindaba zokuvikela imvelo. I-EU inezinhlaka ezihlukene ezisebenzayo, ezifana neKomidi lezeMali, iKomidi lezeMisebenzi, kanye neKomidi lezeMithetho. Lezi zinhlaka zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zikhombisa izidingo nezifiso zamazwe angamalungu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-EU inezinhlelo eziningi ezihlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amazwe angamalungu athola ithuba lokukhula. I-EU ibeka izinqubomgomo ezihlosiwe zokuvikela imvelo, ezokuthuthukiswa komnotho, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi, ukugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo engRenewable, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezihlala abantu. I-EU ibhekelele izinkinga ezithinta ubulungiswa, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngamalungelo abantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ukubambisana kwe-EU kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe ahlukene, futhi ibamba iqhaza elikhulu ezinkulumweni zomhlaba ezithinta ukuthula, ukuvikelwa kwempilo, kanye nezindaba zokuhweba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-EU ibhekelele izinkinga ezithinta izikhala zokuhweba, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Noma i-EU ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezithinta izinkinga zezimali, ukungqubuzana kwezombusazwe, kanye nezinkinga zokufuduka, lezi zinkinga zidinga izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-EU iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili. I-EU iyisibonelo esihle sokubambisana, ibonisa ukuthi uma izizwe zisebenza ndawonye, zingakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuthula, intuthuko, kanye nokubambisana. Njengoba i-EU iqhubeka nokukhula, izifiso zayo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobulungiswa, kanye nokuthula zihlala zibalulekile. Lokhu kuhloswe ngempela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-EU iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, ibhekelele izidingo zamazwe angamalungu, futhi iqhubeke nokuba yisibonelo esihle sokubambisana emhlabeni jikelele.
Isibopho Semiphumela Yokwelashwa: Ukubaluleka KweGEMS Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo kuphumelelayo kudlula kakhulu iso lesiguli, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngempilo nokuqonda okungokoqobo. Isibopho semiphumela yokwelashwa, ikakhulukazi kuGEMS (Geographic and Emergency Medical Services), sikhula sibe yingxenye ebalulekile yesimo sokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuzindla okukhulu futhi kudinga ukuxhumanisa ubuchwepheshe bokwelashwa nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene. Yize imithi yokwelapha esebenzayo iyatholakala kakhulu, imiphumela engalindelekile yesiguli iyasehla, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba sizame ukuphenya imikhuba eyodwa ethinta umphakathi. Imiphumela yokwelashwa, engamaGEMS, ibalulekile ekukhuthazeni umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kweziguli, odokotela, nabeziqinisekiso zezempilo. Ubulungiswa kulokhu kunikezwa ekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza kanye nemiphumela emihle efaneleke kubantu. Uhlaka lweGEMS luhlose ukuzama ukusiza imiphakathi emisha ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokwelapha eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukushintsha kwendlela esibheka ngayo impilo nokwelashwa. Uma sikhuluma ngezibopho, kumele siqonde ukuthi udokotela, isiguli, nezinsizakalo ezithinta ukwelashwa zinengxenye ebalulekile emiphumeleni. Umphumela wokwelashwa akukhona nje kuphela ukuphulukiswa komzimba kodwa kube yisifiso sokwakha impilo engcono empilweni yomuntu. Ukwelashwa kufanele kube yinto ebambisana phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufundisa iziguli ngesimo sabazo, ukufundisa izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze zenze ukuqapha, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezithokozisayo nezisebenzayo. Ngalolu hlobo, umphumela wokwelashwa akuwona nje umsebenzi owenzelwa umphakathi, kodwa kwaziwa futhi njengezinga lokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. I-GEMS ingaholela emiphumeleni engcono uma iziguli zibona ubudlelwano obuhle nodokotela babo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuba nodokotela babe nesineke, baphathe iziguli njengabantu abavela emiphakathini ehlukene. Noma kunjalo, ukuphumelela kwemiphumela yokwelashwa akuphelele uma kungahambisani nezimo zabo bonke ababandakanyekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kudingeke ukuba kwehlonishwe izidingo zempilo zomphakathi, eyaziwa njengokuhlaziywa okuphathelene nemiphumela yempilo yolwazi. Abanye bangase bahluleka ukukhohlwa ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ayiphekiwe, kepha ibhekelelwe ngokuhlakanipha izidingo ezihlukahlukene, kanti lokho kuncika emiphakathini yolwazi, izinganekwane, namasiko. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo zezokwelapha zingaba nemiphumela eyingozi uma zingasetshenziswa kahle. Ukuze umphakathi uzuze kwenziwa, ulwazi oluqinile lokwelashwa lufanele luqinisekiswe. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sigcine ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemithombo yolwazi, abaphathi bezinsizakusebenza, kanye nesiguli. KuGEMS, ukwazisa iziguli mazinzima izindleko zabokhuphuka, kudinga ukuhlonishwa kokuphila kwazo. Ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwezinsizakalo zezempilo neziguli kudinga ukuba kube muse nophenyo olujulile. Njengoba sibheka emuva esikhathini eside, sokuqala sokuqala kweGEMS kubonisa ukuthi imiphumela yokwelashwa ingathola ukunqoba uma iziguli zifaka izinhlelo ezenzakalayo zokuphila. Lokhu akukhona kuphela ukuthuthukisa impilo yomuntu, kodwa futhi kuvuselela umphakathi jikelele. Isibopho sokuchaza imiphumela yokwelashwa sibusha, sisho ukuthi singakwazi ukufinyelela ebuhleni bemiphumela engcono, futhi sibonise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi kuthinta impilo yawo wonke umuntu. Noma kuwumkhosi obalulekile, lezi zinguquko zidinga ukuba abantu bahlale bephokophele ukuphumelela. Ngempela, imiphumela yokwelashwa yeGEMS iyisiqalo esihle, kepha kumele siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhlelo ukuze ibhershishe izifiso, izinyathelo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma sibambene, sithinta imibono yethu nokuqhuba phambili izindlela ezinhle zokuziphatha ezizothuthukisa imiphumela evumelaniswe nawomphakathi jikelele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizoxoxa ngalezi zimo ezibalulekile emiphumeleni yokwelashwa. Kulula ukuthola imiphumela emihle uma sibambisene, sithuthukise, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo ezinhle zokwelashwa. Ubulungiswa bokuGEMS bushintshe izimvo zokuhlala kube yindawo ephumelelayo, futhi ikakhulukazi oGEMS bodinga ukuba baphendule ngobuqotho, ukuze iziguli zihlale zikhululekile, zithole izinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo, futhi zibuye zibe neqhaza elihle ekuthuthukiseni imiphumela yokwelashwa yeGEMS.
Ezabantwana: Izindaba Zokukhathalela Abantwana Kwathi lapho umoya uvunguza kancane, izinyanga ziye phambili, indaba yethu iqala khona. Kukhona umuzi omncane, owawuthokozisa zonke izizukulwane, okwakukhona khona izingane eziningi. Lezi zingane zazimnandi, zishaya amahlaya, zidlala zikhululekile emikhakheni efana nezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Kwathi kube nesikhathi sokudayisa, uMama uSiphiwe, umama wengane encane yokuqala uThando, wayehlale ehlezi ezindlwini, elungiselela okuhle okwakuzobhalwa ezindleleni. "Abantwana bethu badinga izinto ezinhle, badinga umoya opholile namathuba amaningi," wayekhuluma esobala. UThando, owayenonophethwe emlonyeni, wayechitha imihla yakhe edlalela othandweni bakhe, kodwa uMama uSiphiwe wayenokholo olukhulu ukuthi uzomthola umoya omuhle empilweni. UThando, njenganoma ibani, wayephupha ngezinto eziningi. Wayefuna ukufunda, ukudlala, nokwazi izinto ezahlukahlukene. Kodwa, empilweni yakhe, kwakukhona izithiyo eziningi. Abazali bakhe bahlala bezama ukuphila, kodwa bezama futhi ukusiza uThando. UThando wayezwa imithwalo yobunzima kunoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uhlanga lwayo lwaludinga uthando, futhi uMama uSiphiwe wayefuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uThando uthola konke akudinga ukuze abe ngumuntu ophumelelayo. Ubusuku obukhulu, uMama uSiphiwe wenza isinqumo sokuhlanganisa abantu endaweni yokudlela, ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga ezikhona. "Kumele sikhulume ngezidingo zethu, kumele sikhulume ngezinto ezinjengokufunda nokuhamba phambili," kubekezela uMama uSiphiwe ngothando. Abanye abazali bahlangana, beshaya izandla, bezama ukwakha umoya wokulendawo eziphakeme. UThando, ehlanganyela nabangane bakhe, wayebamba izifundo ezibalulekile. Uthando noSiyabonga, ongumngane wakhe, babedlala emshallweni, bejabulisa kakhudlwana. Beyingane eziphathe kahle zabanjwa ngenkuthalo yokuba — ubuciko, umculo, nezifundo zomhlaba. Babedlula phezulu emhinini izizathu eziningi, kepha bazi ukuthi bonke babehlanganyela ezintweni ezinhle. Ngemva kokubheka izikhumbuzo, uMama uSiphiwe waxoxisana noMnumzane uPhungula, owayethanda ukuthanda ukusizakala kwabantwana. "Ngiyakwazi ukukhipha umoya opholile endaweni yethu. Abantwana bethu badinga izikhala zokudlala, ngemva kokudlala badinga lezozindawo zokucabanga," uxoxe kahle. Isikhathi senzekile, izinhlelo ziqala ukuthuthukiswa. Othisha babezama ukusiza, sibanika amathuba amahle abafanele ukuwasebenzisa. Umphakathi wabantu balokhu uphakamisa izinhlelo ezahlukene, ezingama-activities zokufundiswa ezithokozisayo. Abantwana babeziqhenya behlangene kuleso sikhathi, njengoba uThando ebamba kahle ubuciko obuhlukahlukene. Ngempela, labo abangabazali babengazii ngempela, kodwa babenothando olukhulu. Babezama ukusebenzisa izinsiza abazitholile, beyifaka kwiHholo YaseMphakathini ukuze bazise abantwana ngezindleko eziphansi. Kwenziwa imicimbi eminingi yokukhuthaza ukuhamba phambili ngokubuka izincwadi, ukuzihlanganisa nezinye izifundo, ibhuku lelagazi lobuciko bethu. Inhloso yaba abababonakalisayo ukuze kube nezindawo ezihlukahlukene zokuqhuba umculo, imidlalo yasendaweni, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Abantwana bezothatheka ukuze baqonde emakhaya abo, lapho bezothokoza besebenza ndawonye. Emakhaya, imidondoshiya yaqhubeka, imfundo yayizalwe ngothando. UThando wayelungela ukuhamba phambili, nazo zonke izifundo abezithola. Abazali bathokozisa umphakathi, ukuyisiza abantwana ukuba baphume phambili. Ekugcineni, le ndaba ibalulekile, yaphenduka yinhlekelele emiphakathini. UThando, nabangane bakhe, bamba izandla begubha lezi zinsuku ezimnandi. Kwaphela isikhathi, uMama uSiphiwe ubona ukuthi zonke izifiso zawo zifezekile; umoya obuhlungu manje uzolile. Uthando, ngokuziqhenya, waphakamisa izandla zakhona, enedumo ebukekayo. Ngale ndlela, impilo yokuqala kwabantu ifomethwe ngothando nebambiswano. UThando wayephupha futhi wayesebenzisa ithalente lakhe. Babengenazo kuphela indlela ezibalulekile, kepha benemoya opholile, futhi abafisilwe lokho. Kwathi ezinsukwini ezinhle, uThando washintsha, wazalwa esahlukweni sokuphila. "Abantwana bethu badinga imfundo, uthando, nesikhala sokukhula," wathi uMama uSiphiwe, wabe eshawula kahle, esho ngokusobala. Indlela yabe yisifundo sokuba neqhaza elikhulu. Njengoba uThando eqhubeka, njalo ubhiyoza, imiphakathi iyashanela kahle, izwi likhanya, izinto ezahlukene zenza uThando ajabule. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abantwana bayobalekela esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kusebenza izinkumbulo ezihlabelela amandla abantwana; bahlala bejabulela impilo yabo, benelisa ugqozi lwezinto ezinjengothando nobudlelwano. Ukukhula kwankosikazi, ukuhamba phambili. Abantwana badinga uthando, futhi umphakathi wazo uhlanganyela, kangangokuba, ufuna ukuba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yeqiniso. Le ndaba igcwele umoya wokuphila, uyavuma ukuthi abantwana, jikelele, kumele bakhuliswe ngothando. Indaba ibonisa indlela yokukhanyisa umoya, nokugqugquzela umphakathi, ukuze ukwenze kudlule phezulu. Ngale ndlela, abantwana bazoba nempilo engcono, imiphefumulo izothokozisa.
Uma inkampani noma inhlangano eduze ingakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zayo noma ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo, uMphakathi-Jikelele wezohwebo nezimboni angase aqale ukuhoxiswa nokuphulwa kwezimpahla zenkampani noma ukuvalwa kwebhizinisi kanye nokwabiwa nokuthengiswa kwezimpahla zayo. Inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana, noma yiliphi ilunga lenhlangano noma umuntu ophazamisekile, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuthi izimpahla zenkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana zikhishwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele noma zivalwe futhi izimpahla zayo zithengiswe. Uma inkantolo inquma ukuvala inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana, izonquma ukuthi izimpahla zenkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana zizophathwa kanjani ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Inkantolo izocabangela noma yiziphi iziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele mayelana nokwabiwa kwezimpahla. Uma uMphakathi-Jikelele noma inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana, noma yiliphi ilunga lenhlangano noma omunye umuntu ophazamisekile, efaka isicelo sokuthi inkampani ikhishelwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele noma ivalwe, uNgqongqoshe angabeka inqubo yokuthi inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana ikhishelwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele noma ivalwe. Inkampani ebhalisiwe, inhlangano, noma i-CC kumele ibhale incwadi yokufaka isicelo sokuhoxiswa ohlwini. Kumele ichaze isizathu sokuthi kungani inkampani noma i-CC ifaka isicelo sokuhoxiswa ohlwini. Uma kunesidingo, kufanele ibonise inombolo yentela yenkampani noma ye-CC. Bonke abaphathi namalunga enkampani noma i-CC kumele besayine incwadi uma kuyisicelo sokuhoxiswa ohlwini abakwenzayo ngokuvuma kwabo ukuze inkampani ikhishelwe ohlwini. Ukuhoxiswa ohlwini kuthatha cishe izinyanga eziyisithupha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi akukho fomu okufanele kugcwaliswe.

I-BMW - Uhlanga Olusha Lokuhamba Ngezimoto Isingeniso I-BMW, eyaziwa ngokuthi iBayerische Motoren Werke, iyinkampani edume kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele ekwakheni nasekuthengiseni izimoto ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isebenza ngempumelelo nezidingo zabathengi bayo, ikhiqiza izimoto ezihamba phambili, ezinesitayela, nezokuphepha. Lesi sihloko sizogxila ekuthuthukisweni kwe-BMW, izimoto zayo ezintsha, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nayo emhlabeni wezokuthutha. Ukwakhiwa Kwe-BMW I-BMW yasungulwa ngonyaka we-1916 eMunich, eJalimane. Yaqala njengomkhiqizi wemishini yokuphakela, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, yathuthela emkhakheni wezokuthutha. I-BMW idume kakhulu ngama-motorcycles ayo, kodwa ngemva kokufika kwayo ezimotweni, yathola udumo oluningi. Izimoto zayo zaziwa ngama-‘Ultimate Driving Machines’, okukhombisa umgomo wayo wokuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuhamba. Izimoto Ezintsha Nezobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-BMW izama ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Izimoto zayo ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, zifaka izici ezithuthukisiwe zokuphepha, ukulawula, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. I-BMW ixhaswa kakhulu ekwakheni izimoto ezisebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, njengama-hybrid namafutha kagesi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuzibophezela kwenkampani ekunciphiseni umthelela wayo emvelweni. I-BMW ibambelela emkhankasweni wokwakha izimoto ezisebenzisa amandla kagesi, okwakhiwe phansi komqondo we-BMW iX, ezihlinzeka ngempilo ende yokuhamba. Izinkinga Zokuncintisana Noma kunjalo, i-BMW ibhekene nezinkinga ezithile. Umncintiswano emkhakheni wezokuthutha uthuthuka ngokushesha, kanti izinkampani eziningi zikhuphuka ukuze zithole indawo emakethe. Izinkampani ezifana ne-Tesla zikhombisa ukwehluka okukhulu, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezimoto ezisebenzisa amandla kagesi. Lokhu kudinga i-BMW ukuba ihlale ibuyekeza izinqubo zayo futhi ithuthukise imikhiqizo yayo ukuze ihlale ibhekelele izidingo zabathengi. Ukukhula Kwezimakethe I-BMW ithuthukisa izimakethe zayo emhlabeni jikelele. Izinkampani zayo zikhula eYurophu, eNyakatho Melika, nase-Asia. Lokhu kukhula kuvula amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza izinkinga ezisha. Ukuze i-BMW iqhubeke nokukhula, kufanele ibhekane nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zabathengi, okuhlanganisa izidingo ezihlukene zezimali, izifiso zomkhiqizo, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Umthelela Wemvelo I-BMW ibuye ibheke umthelela wayo emvelweni. Ngokwanda kokukhathazeka ngempilo yomhlaba, izinkampani zikhuthazwa ukuba zisebenzise izindlela ezihlanzekile. I-BMW ibeka izinjongo eziphakeme zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni, futhi isebenzisa izindlela zokwakha ezihlanzekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinto eziphinda zisetshenziswe, kanye nezindlela zokukhiqiza ezinciphisa umthelela emvelweni. Ukwamukelwa Kwemikhiqizo Abathengi baveza ukuthokozisa okukhulu ngemikhiqizo ye-BMW, ikakhulukazi ezimotweni ezisebenzisa amandla kagesi. Imikhiqizo ye-BMW ibonakala njengenkanyezi ezinkundleni zokuthengisa, futhi ikhiqiza izinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi i-BMW iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezithokozisayo nezisezingeni eliphezulu, okwenza kube lula ukuyithanda. Isiphetho I-BMW ibonakala njengomholi emkhakheni wezokuthutha, kodwa kufanele iqhubeke ibhekana nezinselelo ezithile ukuze iqhubeke nokukhula. Ukubhekana nezidingo zabathengi, ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokunciphisa umthelela emvelweni kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa le-BMW. Njengoba izimoto zayo ziqhubeka nokuthandwa, i-BMW izoqhubeka nokuba yinkampani engakaze ibonwe emhlabeni wezokuthutha.
Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Empofu Ngaphakathi kwezindawo eziningi zethu, izinkinga zokudla zihlala zikhona, ikakhulukazi emindenini empofu. Lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ubunzima obukhulu obuhlangabezana nemindeni ethola inzuzo encane, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi empilweni yabo, kuholele ekuncipheni kwezempilo, ukungabi namandla, kanye nezinkinga zokukhula kwezingane. Ukuhlaziya Isimo Uhlanga lwezinkinga zokudla emindenini empofu luhlobene nezici eziningi. Okokuqala, umnotho wezwe ubalulekile. Izinga lokungasebenzi liphakamisa ubunzima bokuthola imali, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuthenga ukudla. Imindeni eminingi ibhekene nezimo ezinzima, lapho umphakathi ungatholi khona izinsiza ezanele, njengokudla okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi imindeni ibhekane nokudla okungaphelele, okuholela ezinkingeni ezinzima. Okwesibili, izimo zokuphila zidlala indima enkulu. Imindeni eminingi ibhekene nezindawo ezinamathuba amancane, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezitolo ezithengisa ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bathenge ukudla okungaphili kahle, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, njengokukhuluphala, izifo zenhliziyo, kanye nezinkinga zokugaya ukudla. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lubonisa ukuthi izingane ezikhuliswa emindenini ethola ukudla okungaphelele ziba nezinkinga zokukhula, okungathinta ikusasa lazo. Izixazululo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Uhlelo lokudla oluqinile lungasiza ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokudla emindenini empofu. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zokudla eziphumelelayo, njengokudla okuvela ezindaweni zokulima eziseduzane, okungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuthenga ukudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufundisa imindeni mayelana nokudla okunempilo zingasiza ekwakheni ukuqonda okukhulu ngezidingo zokudla. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo, okungaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Uhlelo lokuphakela ukudla ezikoleni lungasiza kakhulu, njengoba izingane zihlala zidinga ukudla okunempilo ukuze zikhule kahle. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Imiphakathi nayo idlala indima ebalulekile ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga. Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zomphakathi, njengokuhlinzeka ngezindawo zokulima, kungasiza emindenini ethola ukudla okungaphelele. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo yabo, okungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko zokudla. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemindeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani kungaholela ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokudla emindenini empofu zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuze sithuthukise isimo, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlanganise izinsiza, sikhuthaze imiphakathi, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokudla eziphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukusiza imindeni ethola ukudla okungaphelele, sithuthukise impilo yabo, futhi sakhe ikusasa elingcono. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolondolozekayo.

Pinda kanye noMphathiswa Wokuphatha Ulwazi uMnu. L. Ukusiza uhlelo lokuzinza nokuthuthukiswa kwezimboni zabalimi. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokubambisana zabalimi nokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ukwenza ngcono nokugcina ukuphepha kokudla ezingeni likazwelonke nokusiza ukwesekwa kokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yasemakhaya. Ukusiza ekuqapheleni izingozi nezimo zokuphazamiseka kwezolimo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokusiza ekwakhiweni, kubhaliswa, nasekuqinisekiseni izinhlelo zokulima ezibambisene (Lo msebenzi uzodluliselwa kuMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni). Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zebhizinisi lezolimo ezikhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okufanayo nokwabiwa okufanayo kwamalungelo nokukhula kwebhizinisi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezicwangciso zomnotho kanye nezinsiza mayelana nezimpahla zezolimo, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zomkhakha ophazanyisiwe. Ukusungula nokuphatha uhlelo lwezibalo lwezolimo lwezwe. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukutshala izitshalo, ukulima izilwane, kanye nokuphathwa kwezilwane. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo nokulawulwa kwezilwane. Ukusebenzisa kahle izinsiza. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokulima ezisimeme, nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo nezindinganiso zokusebenzisa kahle umhlabathi namanzi, kanye nokuvikela umhlaba. Ukunciphisa izinga lezingcuphe kwezolimo, ezimpahleni zezolimo, kanye nezinye izindawo ezilawulwa. Ukunciphisa izinga lezingcuphe ezibangelwa izilwane ezilimazayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho elawula umkhakha wezolimo nokubheka izimo zezingcuphe ezimpahleni zezolimo. Ukusiza, ukuhlela, nokweseka ubudlelwano bamazwe ngamazwe kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika obhekiswe ekuhwebeni, ukwabelana ngetekhnoloji/izeluleko, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezombusazwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-guidelines okuqeqesha nokufundisa kwezolimo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwezimali kwabantu okuphumelelayo emkhakheni. Ukusiza ekwakhiweni nasekuphumeleleni kohlelo lokuhlela, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukusebenza kwenhlangano nokuhlola ukuthi iyafeza yini imigomo yayo. Ukukhuthaza umkhakha wezolimo onamandla okwakha ingcebo ngokukhiqiza izinkomo nezinkunzi e-RSA. Ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; intuthuko yenhlangano kanye noqeqesho oluphumelelayo ngaphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngensiza yokusekela kwezomthetho. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluxhasa izinhlangothi kanye nohlelo oluphatha imibhalo. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphatha nokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Ukuhlinzeka nge-NGO yezezimali. Ukubuyisa izikweletu zezolimo, ukuphatha imali efakwe, nokukhokha izikweletu. Umhlahlandlela uzotholakala eKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika ngaphambi kuka-Agasti 2003. Imiyalelo ye-Debit Order neMimininingwane yaseBhange ye-GEMS Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokuphatha izimali ziye zashintsha kakhulu, futhi lokhu kuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo ezitholakala kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Enye yezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezitholakala kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, yi-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le mboni inikeza izinsizakalo eziningi ezihlanganisa ukwelashwa, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Nokho, ukuze lezi zinsizakalo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi baqonde kahle imiyalelo ye-debit order nemininingwane yasebhange. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-debit order iyindlela yokukhokha ethokozisayo, evumela abantu ukuthi bakhokhe izindleko zabo zempilo ngokuqhubekayo, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kokukhokha. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ikakhulukazi kulabo abavame ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo ze-GEMS, njengoba izindleko zempilo zingashintsha njalo. Ngakho, uma umsebenzisi efaka i-debit order, uyakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindleko zempilo zakhe zikhokhwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngaphandle kokuthi abuyele njalo ukuze akhokhe. Ukuze uqale, umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi unemininingwane efanele yasebhange. Lokhu kuhlanganisa inombolo ye-akhawunti, igama le-akhawunti, kanye nemininingwane ye-branch. Lezi zinto zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imali ifinyelela lapho kufanele ifinyelele khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi aqinisekise ukuthi unayo imali eyanele ku-akhawunti yakhe ukuze akwazi ukukhokha izindleko zempilo. Lokhu kuzovimbela izinkinga ezinjengokuthi i-debit order ingaphumelelanga, okungaholela ekutheni umsebenzisi angatholi izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baye baqonda ukuthi imiyalelo ye-debit order iyashintsha. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izinkampani zihlala zenza izinguquko ezithile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zazo zihlala zisebenza kahle. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi ahlale ebuyekeza imininingwane yakhe, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi uyayiqonda imiyalelo ethile yokukhokha. Lokhu kuzovumela umsebenzisi ukuthi aqhubeke nokuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle ze-GEMS ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi aqonde izinzuzo zokusebenzisa i-debit order. Njengoba sishilo, lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izindleko zempilo zikhokhwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, kodwa futhi kukhulula umsebenzisi ekukhathazekeni kokukhokha njalo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali, futhi umsebenzisi angagxila kwezinye izici zempilo yakhe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo ezithile kubantu abasebenzisa i-debit order, njengokunciphisa izindleko ezithile noma ukuthola izaphulelo. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi aqaphele ukuthi kunezimo lapho i-debit order ingase ingasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kungenzeka uma umsebenzisi enganaki kahle izimali zakhe, noma uma kunezinguquko ezinkulu ezimweni zakhe zezimali. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi ahlale eqaphela izimo zakhe zezimali, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko zempilo. Lokhu kuzovimbela izinkinga ezinjengokuthi i-GEMS ingase ingamukeli i-debit order, okungaholela ekutheni umsebenzisi angatholi izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ekugcineni, imiyalelo ye-debit order nemininingwane yasebhange ye-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zisebenza kahle. Umsebenzisi kufanele aqonde kahle lezi zinto, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi unemininingwane efanele ukuze akwazi ukujabulela izinsizakalo ezitholakala ku-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi ahlale eqaphela izimo zakhe zezimali, ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukukhokha izindleko zempilo. Ngokwenza lokhu, umsebenzisi uzokwazi ukujabulela izinsizakalo ezinhle ze-GEMS, futhi aqinisekise ukuthi impilo yakhe ihamba kahle. Ngakho, uma ungumsebenzisi we-GEMS, qiniseka ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle imiyalelo ye-debit order nemininingwane yasebhange. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izimali zakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze uphile impilo enempilo.
Noma ngabe ukudla kuphisiwe, izivakashi kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi kuphisiwe kahle futhi kusemisha. Ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka, izinhlanzi ezahlukene nezilwane zasemanzini zingaba ne-toxins eziyingozi ezingathinta impilo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziphisiwe kahle. Kubalulekile ukufuna iseluleko ezikhungweni zezempilo zendawo mayelana nalezi zilwane eziyingozi. Ng unfortunately, ukubukeka kokudla akukhombisi ukuphepha kwako, futhi ukudla okunobuthi kungaba nephunga elimnandi. Uma kukhona indlela yokugwema ukudla okungaphephile, izinga elincane lokudla linganciphisa ingozi yokuphathwa ubuthi. Izivakashi zingakhetha ukungadli ukudla. ENingizimu Afrika, amanzi aphuma emathubeni ngokuvamile aphephile ukuphuza. Nokho, uma othile evakashela ezindaweni zasemaphandleni isikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuthwala amanzi abotshiwe ezitsheni ezivalekile. Amathablethi okuhlunga amanzi atholakala ezitolo zezidakamizwa futhi kufanele asetshenziswe ngokuhambisana nezincazelo. Uma amanzi engase abe nezinye izinto, izivakashi kufanele zixwayiswe ukuthi noma amanzi abotshiwe kufanele athathwe njengokungaphephile futhi angasetshenziswa ukuphuza. Gwema ukuxhumana kwezocansi nabanye abangabalingani abajwayelekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. I-HIV iyinkinga enkulu okwamanje ngenxa yesikhathi esihlala egazini, okuholela ekudlulisweni okungathandeki nasezimpilweni zayo ezimbi. Izivakashi zicebiswa ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezimpahla zokuvikela ngaphambi kokuhamba uma kudingeka. Uma ukuvaccine kudingeka, izivakashi kufanele zizame ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-vaccine nemithi kuvela ezipakishweni ezivalekile zemithi ehlanzekile. Labo abane-diabetes kufanele bathwale izinsimbi ezihlanzekile (ezihlanziwe) ngesikhathi sokuhamba futhi babe ne-authorization kadokotela yokuzisebenzisa. Ukuhlukaniswa kwegazi kwenziwa ngokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika futhi akubeki ingozi ezivakashini. Akukho mfuneko yokugxila ezishintsheni zokuziphatha nasezinyathelweni zokuphepha. Ukusebenzisa ikhondomu kuyindlela enye yokuvikela. I-malaria ingenye yezifo ezivamile ezidalwa yiphilisi edluliselwa kumuntu ngomuntu ngempukane ye-Aedes Aegypti, ethwele isifo se-malaria. Nakuba kube nebufakazi bokuthi ukudluliswa kwe-malaria kwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika, impukane ethwele lesi sifo itholakala lapha. I-malaria ibonakala e-Afrika ezindaweni eziseningizimu, eziphakathi, naseMpumalanga naseNingizimu Melika. Ingozi yokuthola lesi sifo ingancishiswa ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezijwayelekile zokuvikela noma ukunciphisa ukuhlinzwa kwemikhono. Ukuvaccine: Ngokwezimiso zeMnyango Wezempilo Womhlaba, i-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyisithombe esisodwa esidingekayo sokuhamba emhlabeni jikelele. I-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyasebenza iminyaka eyishumi, iqala ezinsukwini eziyishumi ngemuva kokuvaccine. Ibalulekile kubo bonke abahambi abangaphezu kweminyaka eyodwa ubudala. Umuntu ophuma endaweni lapho lesi sifo sikhona ongakazivakali angavinjwa ekungeneni ezweni noma agcinwe ngaphansi kokubhekwa okungaphansi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha uma ethuthela khona kungaholela ekubhekaneni nezithiyo. Izikhungo zokuhamba zizohlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe ngalolu sifo nokuvaccine ngokulandelana. Lesi sifo esibulalayo esidalwa amagciwane esiswini. Ukutheleleka ngalesi sifo kudalwa ngokuphuza amanzi nokudla okungcolile. Ukulawulwa kwaso kusasele kuyinkinga yezempilo. Ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yokutheleleka ngalesi sifo, izivakashi kufanele zibe neqhaza elikhulu ngalokho abakudlayo nakokho abakuphuza. Izivakashi zikhuthazwa ukuba zigweme ukuphuza amanzi angahlanzwanga. Amanzi agcinwe ezitsha kuyas rekomendwa. I-blood flukes zenzeka emhlabeni jikelele futhi zidalwa ngamagciwane adla igazi lomuntu, impilo yazo iyinkimbinkimbi futhi ifaka ezinye izinhlobo zezilwane zasemanzini ezibamba. Lezi zikhungo ziyaqhamuka ngalesi sifo lapho uhlobo lwemithambo nemfucumfucu yabantu abathintekayo igcwalisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Lezi zikhungo ezithintekayo ngalolu bhubhane zikhulisa ama-larvae amancane ahamba kalula futhi angangena emzimbeni ongavikelekile (ovulekile) womuntu emanzini angashisayo. Ukubhukuda emanzini angcolile kufanele kugwenywe. Ukubhukuda emanzini ahlanzekile kuvame ukuba kuphephile ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Ngomhla ka-21 kuNtulikazi 2023, umphakathi ubhekene nesinqumo esikhulu esithathwe yinkantolo ephakeme mayelana nesigwebo sikaOscar Pistorius, umjaho ophumelelayo we-Olympic noMvikeli Womhlaba. Lesi sinqumo sithinte abantu abaningi, sihlangabezana nemibono eyahlukene ezindabeni, ikakhulukazi eziphathelene nezokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu, ubulungiswa, kanye nezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Pistorius, owaziwa kakhulu njengomjaho omncane onezinkanyezi, wathola udaba lwakhe lwezomthetho lwezizathu ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2013, washaywa yicala lokubulala uReeva Steenkamp, umkakhe, ngokungafanele. Le m事件 yaphazamisa kakhulu umphakathi, yakhuluma ngempilo kaPistorius, okwamanje ibonakala iyinselele enkulu kumphakathi ophakathi kokuhlukumeza. Inkatho yeNkantolo Ephezulu yathatha isikhathi eside ukuhlaziya izinkomba zobufakazi, izinsolo, nemiphumela yokuhlala kwePistorius ejele. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinto zaphenduka zaba zinkulu, kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokuhlola uPistorius, izinhlelo zokubuyisa, nezinqumo ezinzima ezimayelana nezomthetho. Abantu abaningi babekhaliphile ngalesi sikhathi, bephikisana ngokuqinile mayelana nenhloso yokuphendula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi weNingizimu Afrika, owayengaphansi kwezinkinga ezinzima zokuhlukunyezwa, uqhubeke nokuhlola indlela uPistorius abhekana ngayo nezinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kwavusa izingxoxo ezinzima ngempilo yomjaho, nokuthi abantu abanjengaye kumele babhekane nezimpilo zabo ngokuzithiba. Izinkanyezi ezahlukene zakhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, zibona uPistorius njengomfanekiso wezinkinga zomhlaba, okukhuluma ngokuphangisa ngaphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika. Isinqumo sokugcina sikaPistorius saphumelelisa ukwakhiwa komphakathi, kwavula indlela yokuxoxisana ezindleleni eziningi. Abantu basaba nesithakazelo esikhulu esivela ezindabeni, bephikisana ngokuqinile, benze izikhumbuzo ezinzima, bezama ukuthola ukuqonda okukhudlwana ngalesi simo. Izinhlobo zokuqonda zashintsha, zaphenduka emizweni eminingi yokuhlukunyezwa, ubulungiswa, nenqubekela phambili. Ngokubheka esikhathini esizayo, isinqumo sikaPistorius sikhombisa ukuhamba phambili komphakathi. Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda izindaba ezinjengalezi ukuze siqonde indlela ethinta abantu abaningi. Uhlanga lwezokuhlukunyezwa, izinkinga zomthetho, nezinqumo ezithathwa yinkantolo, zidinga ukuthi abantu babe nesithakazelo, bephikisana phakathi kwalolu hlobo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle, nokuqonda okujule. Kuyacaca ukuthi isinqumo sokugcina sikaPistorius sikhumbuza umphakathi ngempilo, ubulungiswa, nobudlelwane obunobungozi. Umphakathi udinga ukusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ufinyelele emiphumeleni emihle. Uhlanga lwezomthetho luhlose ukuthola ubulungiswa, ukuze izimpilo zabantu zinganqandwa, kanti izinkinga ezinjalo zingathathwa njengomthwalo ophakeme. Uhlanga lwezokuhlukunyezwa ludinga ukukhuluma ngezinto ezinjengalezi, ukuze sithole ukuqonda okukhulu. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi ungenza umehluko, ube nesithakazelo, uhlele kahle izinkinga ezinzima. Lokhu kumele kube yisifundo sokuhlola, sokubhala, nokuhlaziya izinkinga ezithinta ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, nezinkinga ezibucayi zomthetho. Ngemva kokuqeda ukuhamba kwalesi sinqumo, umphakathi uqhubeka nokuhlola izindlela ezinhle zokwakha ubudlelwane obunempilo, ube nempumelelo, ukuze uthole umphakathi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kuyisifundo esiqhubekayo, esidinga ukuba silandele, sifunde kakhulu, futhi sibe nesithakazelo. Izinqumo ezithathwayo kufanele zihlale ziqhubeka, zigqugquzele ukuhamba phambili, nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sikhumbuza abantu abaningi ukuthi ubulungiswa abukhona kuphela ezinhlelweni zomthetho, kodwa futhi nakuwo wonke umuntu. Kulula ukweqa izinkinga, kodwa kubalulekile ukuyibhekana nabantu, sifunde futhi sikhumbule izifundo ezitholakele. Ngalokhu, umphakathi ungenza umehluko, ube nesithakazelo, ube nezinqumo ezifanele ezithinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika.
Ithuba lokunakekela izingane liyindawo ebhalisiwe yokunakekela izingane. Izikhungo zokunakekela izingane zingafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali yenyanga evela kuhulumeni ukuze zisize ngezindleko zokusebenza ezikhungweni zokunakekela izingane. Inani lesikhwama sokwesekwa lihluka futhi lincike ezindlekweni zokusebenza zesikhungo, kanye nenani lezingane ezihlala lapho. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali? Izikhungo zokunakekela izingane ezibhalisiwe. Qedela ifomu ehhovisi lezinsizakalo zomphakathi eliseduze. Ifomu eliqediwe kumele lisayinwe nguMongameli weKomidi Lokuphatha kanye noMqondisi weSikhungo Sokunakekela Izingane esifakayo. Thumela isicelo kanye neziqinisekiso zokubhaliswa njenge-NPO nezitatimende zebhange kumnyango wezimali. Ukuxhaswa kwemali kutholakala endaweni yokunakekela izingane ezihlala lapho. Imali yokuxhaswa ikhokhwa endaweni, hhayi ezinganeni. Inqubo yokufaka isicelo izothatha ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma usuhambisile isicelo sakho, ubuqotho bayo buzohlolwa. Uma uMnyango ujabule ngesicelo, uzonikezwa imali. Isinqumo sisisekelo ekutholakaleni kwemali nasekudingeni kwalolu sevisi. Umnyango wezimali unikeza izimali zokuxhaswa ezinyangeni ezintathu, kuye ngokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yalolu sikhungo sokunakekela izingane. Le sevisi iyamahala futhi ayikhokhiswa. Amafomu okufaka isicelo atholakala ehhovisi lezinsizakalo zomphakathi eliseduze kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi.
Ukuphatha imibhalo ukuze ibe semthethweni noma ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuthi iyikho kuyinqubo yokuhlola ukuthi izimpawu ezikuyo ziyiqiniso. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imibhalo kahulumeni kumele iqinisekiswe, igcwaliswe, isayinwe, futhi ibe ne-Apostille certificate noma isitifiketi esiqinisekisa ubuqiniso bayo. Iphakela amakhasimende ngemininingwane ngefoni, incwadi, noma i-imeyili. Ama-embassy aseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe angakwenza imibhalo ibe semthethweni uma kuqala kwenziwa semthethweni ngabeziphathimandla zalelo zwe noma kwenziwa semthethweni ngumphakathi ofanele wezangaphandle. Ama-embassy aseNingizimu Afrika awanamalungelo okukhupha i-Apostille certificate kodwa anelungelo lokukhupha isitifiketi esiqinisekisa ubuqiniso. Qala ngokubona ukuthi iyiphi imibhalo ofuna ukuba yenzelwe ukuba semthethweni. Kumele wazise umnyango ofanele wezwe ofuna ukuba imibhalo yakho ibe semthethweni ukuze bakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isitifiketi sokuqinisekisa ubuqiniso noma i-Apostille certificate iyadingeka. Lokhu kwenziwa ngumbhali noma ummeleli wakhe noma inkantolo ephezulu eNingizimu Afrika. Uthumele - imibhalo ethunyelwe ngale ndlela ingaqoqwa uma unikeza ubufakazi bokuthi uyithumele. Uma uthumela imibhalo yakho ngesandla, uzothola i-receipt eqinisekisa ukuthi bathole imibhalo yakho. Nge-courier - kuzohlinzekwa nge-courier ukuze aqoqe imibhalo edingekayo ukuze ukwazi ukuyithola. I-courier ikhokhelwa nguwe. Nge-express mail - neziqu zakho, faka i-envelopu efanele usayizi wamagwebu ejwayelekile enezinombolo zakho ezikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokuthumela ukuze umnyango ofanele ubuyisele imibhalo yakho. Bhala incwadi echaza ukuthi zingaki imibhalo othumele yona ukuze iphathwe ngokusemthethweni, izwe ofuna ukuba khona, nolwazi lwakho lokuxhumana oluphelele. Thumela imibhalo yakho ku-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika kulolo zwe. Imibhalo kumele iqinisekiswe ngumgibeli othembekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubuqiniso bayo. Ummeleli ophathelene nezivumelwano zokucubungula ngu-owokufanele aqinisekise. Izitifiketi zokuzalwa, umshado, ukufa ezingaqinisekisiwe, kanye nencwadi eqinisekisa ubuzwe kumele zisayinwe futhi zifakwe uphawu ngommeli wezangaphakathi ogunyaziwe ukwenza njalo. Imibhalo yokwamukela kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngumbhali wehhovisi lokwamukela emnyangweni wezomthetho. Imibhalo yokuthengisa impahla kwamanye amazwe kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngommeli wezohwebo. Izitifiketi zemfundo kumele zisayinwe futhi zifakwe uphawu ngommeli wemfundo. Incwadi echaza ukuthi awekho amaphutha mayelana nomshado kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngommeli wezangaphakathi ogunyaziwe ukwenza njalo. Imibhalo yokuhlola impilo kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngommeli wecouncil ogunyaziwe ukwenza njalo. Izinsuku zokusebenza zomphakathi ziyiMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, 08:30 - 12:30. Umnyango ofanele uzokhipha isaziso sezinsuku eziyi-7 uma closed, okungafaki amaholide. Abantu abakhokhi lutho lapho imibhalo yabo icubungulwa. Ayikho ifomu okufanele igcwaliswe, kodwa qiniseka ukuthi uchaza izwe ofuna ukuba imibhalo yakho ibe semthethweni.
Le nsizakalo itholakala kuphela kubantu abanamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sifakwa ngaphandle kwelizwe. Akudingi ukubonisa ukuthi unikezwe umsebenzi kuleli. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Ukuze ubonise kwiMnyango ukuthi unamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile, kufanele uthumele incwadi evela kumnyango wombuso wangaphandle noma waseNingizimu Afrika, noma esikhungweni semfundo esiqinisekisiwe nesezintsha eNingizimu Afrika, isikhungo somculo, noma inhlangano yebhizinisi eqinisekisa ukuthi unamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile. Faka i-curriculum vitae nezinye iziqinisekiso zamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile. Ukuze uqinise isicelo sakho, ungafaka nezitifiketi ezivela kubaphathi bakho bangaphambili. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevice. Amandla okuphatha mayelana nesicelo/sokwandiswa kwesivumelwano sokuhamba noma sokuhlala okwesikhashana mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala okwesikhashana noma okuphakade.
Amanani Okudla: Isimo Esidinga Ukubhekelwa Ngokuqinile Emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla, amanani okudla abe yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba sithokozisa izinkanyezi zethu zokuphila, sithola ukuthi amanani okudla ayanda, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okukhathaza abathengi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphusile. Isizathu esikhulu sokwanda kwamaholo okudla sitholakala ezimakethe zomhlaba. Ukukhula kwabantu, izinguquko ezinkulu emnothweni, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima, konke lokhu kudlala indima enkulu ekwandeni kwamaholo. Ngokwesibonelo, izimo zezulu ezimbi, ezifana nezikhukhula noma umswakama, zenza kube nzima ukukhiqiza ukudla, okukhuphula amanani. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho ukufinyelela ezitolo ezinkulu kungelula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko zokuhamba, ezokuthutha, kanye nezindleko zokugcina ukudla nazo zikhuphuka. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abathengisi baphakamishe amanani, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongenamkhawulo, lapho abantu bephoqwa ukuba bahlale bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokukhuphuka kwamaholo. Ngokubheka lezi zimo, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo baphendule ngokushesha. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokulima ezinzile, ezibandakanya ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kungasiza ekwandiseni ukukhiqizwa kokudla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu, futhi kunciphise ukuncika ezimakethe zomhlaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ukulima okwakhiwe endaweni, okungokwendabuko, kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko.
