Izidingo Zemibhalo Yabasebenzi Abasha (GEMS New Employee Documentation Requirements) Ukuba ngumsebenzi omusha kwi-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) kuyinjabulo enkulu, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zemibhalo ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi inqubo yokwamukela isebenza kahle. Le mibhalo iyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuba ube yingxenye ye-GEMS, futhi ibalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi wakho. Isigaba 1: Ubuwena Bokusebenza Okokuqala, uma ujoyina i-GEMS, kudingeka ukuthi ube nemibhalo ebonisa ubuwena bakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa incwadi yokwamukela emsebenzini, eyakhelwe kwi-GEMS, ebonisa ukuthi usubhaliswe njengomsebenzi. Le ncwadi ibalulekile ngoba iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ube sebenza ngaphansi kwe-GEMS, futhi izokwazi ukusiza uma kudingeka ukuxhumana nezinye izikhungo. Isigaba 2: Imibhalo Yokukhomba Okwesibili, udinga ukuhlinzeka ngemibhalo yokukhomba. Lokhu kubandakanya ipasipoti yakho, noma ikhadi lakho le-ID, eliqinisekisa ubunikazi bakho. Kubalulekile ukuthi le mibhalo ibonise kahle igama lakho, usuku lokuzalwa, kanye nezinye izici ezibalulekile ezithinta ubuwena. Uma ungumuntu ophuma ngaphandle kwezwe, kuzodingeka ukuthi uhlinzeke ngombhalo owenziwe ngokusemthethweni ovela kuhulumeni wakho, oshowa ukuthi ungum resident. Isigaba 3: Imibhalo Yokufunda Ngaphezu kwalokho, izidingo zemibhalo zifaka phakathi iziqu zakho zemfundo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amakhophi ezitifiketi ezikufundisile, njengezidanga, izitifiketi, noma amakhono athile owatholile. Le mibhalo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi unamakhono adingekayo ukuze uphumelele emsebenzini wakho. I-GEMS ifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayo banemfundo efanele ukuze banikeze izinsizakalo ezinhle. Isigaba 4: Imibhalo YezeMali Ezinye izidingo zifaka imibhalo yezezimali. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ubufakazi bokuhola, njengezinkokhelo ezithunyelwe emaphaketheni, noma amakhophi we-akhawunti yakho yasebhange. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukukhokhela izinsiza zakho, futhi kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi wakho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma unayo, ungahlinzeka ngombhalo oshowa izinsizakalo ezithile ozithola ngaphansi kwe-GEMS, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubhaliswe kahle. Isigaba 5: Imibhalo Yezempilo Ngokuphathelene nezempilo, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlinzeke ngemibhalo ethile yokuhlola impilo yakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izitifiketi zokuhlola ezikhombisa ukuthi unempilo enhle, futhi ungaphinde uhlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinkinga zempilo obhekene nazo. I-GEMS ifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayo bahlala bephila kahle, futhi le mibhalo iyasiza ekuqinisekiseni lokhu. Isigaba 6: Ukuhlonishwa Kwezimfuneko Zomthetho Ngokuphathelene nezidingo zomthetho, kubalulekile ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke le mibhalo ihambisana nemithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubhaliswe ngokusemthethweni, futhi ukuthi uhlinzeke ngemininingwane efanele. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhambisana nemithetho, ungahlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo kwi-GEMS, noma uxhumane nomphakathi wakho ukuze uthole usizo. Isigaba 7: Ukuqinisekisa Ukuthola Izinsiza Ekugcineni, uma usuhlinzekile ngazo zonke le mibhalo, i-GEMS izobuyekeza futhi iqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uthole izinsiza ezihambisana nomsebenzi wakho. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, i-GEMS izokuthintana ukuze uxazulule izinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi ube nesineke, njengoba le nqubo ingathatha isikhathi esithile. Ngokuhlanganisa le mibhalo, uzokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ujoyina i-GEMS ngendlela efanele, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinzuzo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, futhi ube yingxenye ye-GEMS ngendlela efanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlola zonke izidingo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi awuphuthelwa lutho, futhi ube nesikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngazo zonke le mibhalo. Ngale ndlela, uzokwazi ukujoyina i-GEMS ngempumelelo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsiza ozidingayo ukuze uphumelele emsebenzini wakho.
Izindaba Zamanje: Ukubheka Emuva Nokuqonda Izenzakalo Zamanje Ngesikhathi sikaNovemba 2023, umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, eziphakamisa imizwa ehlukahlukene kubantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zindaba, kubalulekile ukubheka izenzakalo zomlando eziholele kulezi zimo esibhekene nazo namuhla. Izinto eziningi ezibuhlungu zenzeka eminyakeni edlule, kodwa zibhala indlela yokuphila kwethu namuhla. Izikhumbuzo Zezinguquko Zepolitiki Njengoba uhulumeni bezwe zingama-United States beqhuba izinqubo zeziqu zepolitiki, izinguquko ezenzeka emazweni amaningana ziqhubeka nezimpikiswano. Izinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuqhubeka nokuphila kwabantu zikhona, kodwa ziqhubeka nomthelela obalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngemva kokhetho lukamasipala oluphumelele, izinkulumo ziqhubeka, futhi abantu bathembela ekubeni khona kwezinguquko ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuyingxenye yesizinda esiqhubekayo sokubambisana kwezombusazwe emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqumo zamazwe ahlukene mayelana nezindaba zezemvelo ziveza isimo esinzima. Izenzakalo ezifana nokushisa komhlaba, imvula engajwayelekile, nokwanda kwezinhlekelele zemvelo zifaka ingcindezi ezinkampanini, emiphakathini, nasemalawulweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezinzima zokulawula ukungcoliswa kwemvelo kanye nokuphikiswa phakathi kwezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Izinkinga Zomnotho Nezempilo Esikhathini esifanayo, umnotho wezwe ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Ngemuva kokuphuma kobhubhane lwe-COVID-19, izwe liqhubeka nokubhekana nezinkinga zokubi kwezezimali. Abantu abaningi basahamba ebhange lempilo, ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemisebenzi nezinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imindeni ibhekene nezikhathi ezinzima, futhi izinsiza eziyisisekelo ezifana nezokudla, ezempilo, nezokuhlala ziya zishoda. Ngokwenhlalo, umnotho nezempilo zihlangana kakhulu. Ukuqonda ukuthi umnotho uthembela kanjani ezinhlelweni zempilo kubalulekile, njengoba ukungabi nandaba nezempilo kungaholela ekuwohlokeni komnotho. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala benempilo futhi benza kahle emsebenzini zidinga ukuhamba phambili. Izindaba Zezenhlalo Nezokuthula Ezinye izinkinga ezizwakalayo emhlabeni ziqhamuka ezindabeni zezenhlalo. Ukulwa nokukhwabanisa, ubuhlanga, nokuhlukumeza komphakathi kudinga ukugxila okukhulu. Imibiko ethile ibonisa ukuthi izigameko zokuhlukumeza zikhula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingaphansi kokuphathwa kahle. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokukhathazeka phakathi kwabantu. Izinhlelo zokwakha ukuthula zibuye zibe nzima, njengoba ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene kuholela ezinkingeni. Abantu badinga ukuthola izixazululo ezihlangene ukuze bakhe umphakathi onokuthula, nokho, lokhu kudinga isikhathi, ubuhlakani, kanye nomdlandla. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, izinkampani, kanye nabantu kuyadingeka ukuze kwakhiwe izixazululo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu nakwezinye izindawo ezithintekayo. Izenzakalo Zobuchwepheshe Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buyaqhubeka nokuthuthukisa impilo yethu. Izinguquko ezinkulu ezenzeka embonini yobuchwepheshe ziqinisa ukuxhumana, kodwa futhi zikhombisa izinselelo ezintsha. Ukuqwashisa ngemininingwane kanye nokuvikeleka kwemikhiqizo kubalulekile, njengoba abantu bephendula ezintweni ezinzima ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Izindaba ezithinta ubuchwepheshe zikhombisa indlela abantu abasha abathola ngayo ulwazi nolwazi. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala benolwazi lwakamuva, nokho, kudinga ukuthi kuqashwe izingozi ezihambisana nezinkampani eziphakela izinsiza zobuchwepheshe. Isiphetho Konke lokhu kuhlobene, futhi izindaba zamanje zidinga ukuqonda okujulile. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nekhanda elivulekile, sithathe izinyathelo zokusebenzisa ulwazi lwethu ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu. Izinkinga ezikhona zidinga ukuhamba phambili, nokuhlangana kwethu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokubheka emuva ezindabeni zomlando, sizothola ukuthi singenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Yilapho, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula, nenhlangano. Izindaba zamanje zikhombisa izifundo ezibalulekile, futhi ukuphila kwethu kuncike ekubeni sihlale siqaphele izimo ezenzakalayo.
Ubungako bokwazi kwakho ngemithombo yeplanter bujule kangakanani? Funda lokho okukhuluma lapha ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho ngemicimbi yeplanter. Zonke izingxenye zikhonjiswa futhi imisebenzi yazo ichazwa. Le yindawo lapho ingxenye yeplanter ixhunywa khona, futhi ihluke lapho i-planter izoxhunywa khona ku-traktor. Lezi yizinto eziphathelene nezitshalo nez fertiliser. Zenziwe ngeplastiki eqinile noma zakhiwe ngensimbi. Lezi zingaba yizinyawo ezihamba phezu kweplanter. Le nyawo ihanjiswa lapho ixhumana nomhlaba njengoba i-planter idonswa. Le nyawo ihamba ngendlela efanayo ne-traktor. Umsebenzi wale nyawo uwukusebenzisa zonke ezinye izingxenye ze-planter - izinto ezithumela inani lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Ukuze ukwazi ukukala ijubane lezingxenye ezithumela izitshalo nez fertiliser, kukhona uhlelo lwezigelekeqe nezinsimbi ezisebenzayo. Konke lokhu kungahlanganiswa ngendlela enikeza inani elifanele lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Kukho amabhodi ahlukene ahambelana nezinhlobo zezithombo kanye nosayizi bazo (asikhulumi lapha ngama-planters asebenzisa umoya ukufaka izitshalo). Lezi ngokuvamile zikhona phambi kweplanter futhi zihlala zikhona kulawa ma-planters asetshenziswa ezimweni zokungabikhona kokulima ngoba kunezinhlobo eziningi phezulu komhlaba. Lezi zifaka izitshalo nez fertiliser emhlabathini. Lokhu kungaba yizinyawo ezincane ngemuva kweplanter ezihamba emathafeni ukusiza ukuqinisa umhlaba emathafeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komhlaba nezitshalo. Lapha, ingcindezi ingaba phansi kakhulu noma phezulu kakhulu.
Kubukeka sengathi uyabona izinselelo ezikhona ngempahla yokwakha lapha esibhedlela. Sizama ngakho konke okusemandleni ethu ukugcina isibhedlela sibukeka kahle. Kunomnyango omusha owenziwe ngempela ngoMashi, futhi manje ususebenza. Igumbi lokusebenza liphinde lilungiswe, futhi sithemba ukuthi lizobe selilungele ukusetshenziswa masinyane. Sicela ukhumbule, bangani bethu, ukuthi emhlanganweni wezisebenzi sakhanyisa ukuthi thina, njengokuphathwa kwesibhedlela, asinaso isikhwama noma amandla okwakha impahla yesibhedlela. Umnyango Wokwakha unendaba nalokhu, hhayi thina siqu. Lo muntu kufanele aqhubeke efundisa abanye egumbini lakhe nasebantwini ezinyangeni ezizayo. Inhloso yethu ukuvuselela amazinga ethu okuphuma phezulu. Ukubambisana kwethu kuzobongwa kakhulu. Le mali iyasiza emphakathini ngalesi sikhathi esiphila kuso. Kumele sizame ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakholelwe kubo futhi ukuthi akukho okungafinyelelwa umuntu ngaphandle kokwenza. Abantu bangakwenza, kodwa uma bebhekene nezinkinga, bavame ukuphoxeka futhi bafune omunye umuntu ukuba enze izinto zabo. Njengoba ngibona ukuthi umncintiswano wekhorasi usondela, ngiye ngibavakashele eChapel bephakathi kokuzilolonga, futhi ngazizwa ngidinga ukubhala ngokucophelela ngomsindo wakho nowami njengomuntu ophathelene nezindaba ezihlobene nokukhuluma. Lokhu kuzosisiza hhayi kuphela abaculi kodwa wonke umuntu jikelele, ikakhulukazi labo abakhipha izwi emphakathini nsuku zonke njengezithunywa, abapristi, abezombusazwe, abameli, njll. KUTHENI KUKHONA EMPHUMENI NGENXA YOKUQHUMISA NOMA UKUKHULUMA Uma ujwayele ukuqhuba uma ukhuluma, lapha emaphumeleni kuzonakala; kuphi lapho umsindo wakho uvela khona? Uma uqhuma lapha lapho umsindo wakho uvela khona, imisipha nemithambo izobamba, futhi lapho kuqala khona inkinga. Uma ungakwazi ukukwenza lokhu, kungaba yingozi ethinta kakhulu umsindo wakho. KUNGANI NGINGAZIVIKELA Kukhona izindlela ongazisebenzisa uma ukhuluma endaweni enomsindo ngaphandle kokuphakamisa umsindo wakho? Sebenzisa izimpawu noma okuthile ukuze uthole ukunakwa. Othisha bangasebenzisa umphimbo ukuze babize izingane uma zidlala, noma bakhuphule izandla zabo ukuze babonise ukuthi baphinde babuyele ekilasini. Nciphisa umsindo ngemuva kwakho. Uma usekhaya, phakamisa ivolumu ye-radio noma ithelevishini uma ukhuluma nomuntu; zama ukusebenzisa into eyodwa ngesikhathi uma kunomsindo. Khuluma nomuntu osembonini efanayo nawe futhi ugcine ibanga elingama-3 kuya kwama-5 uma ukhuluma nomuntu. Funda ukulalela. Uma ubuza umuntu ukuthi aphinde akhulume okukhuluma, noma ukuthi lowo muntu uzophakamisa umsindo wakhe, ngaleyo ndlela bangase babangele umonakalo kumphimbo wabo. Asikwazi ukulindela abantu ukuthi benze izinto zethu ngoba thina siphinde sibe ngabantu, noma ngabe ngiyazi isimo engikuso noma cha. Imicabango yethu isebenza njengabantu abangenaso isifo, futhi kwesinye isikhathi sithanda ukucabanga ngcono kunabo. Abantu abane-virus bangakwazi ukuzinakekela ukuze bagcine impilo yabo. Abangasebenzi kuphela ekusekelweni kwabanye uma sebethole isimo sabo. Masisekele abangani bethu, sibathande, kanye nalabo emindenini yethu abangenayo i-virus futhi bakholelwe kubo. Khuluma ngothando. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukunciphisa umthwalo kumphimbo wakho futhi abanye bazolandela indlela okukhuluma ngayo. I-alcohol, ukuphuza, nezinto eziningi zingomisa umphimbo wakho, futhi sizisebenzisa emsebenzini nasemakhaya, futhi ezinye izidakamizwa zingase zibe nomthelela omubi kumphimbo wakho. KUFANELE NGIKWENZE NINI UMA NGINE-VOICE DISORDER Uma ubona ushintsho ekutheni abanye nabanye baziqonda kanjani umsindo wakho, mhlawumbe ushintsha ube nekhanda, ube nekhanda, noma ube thin uma ukhiqiza, xhumana nodokotela. Udokotela uzokuthumele kumuntu okhethekile ophathelene nokukhuluma kanye nomsindo kuphela. Uma lo shintsho uqhubeka ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili noma ezintathu noma umsindo wakho uphaphama ngokushesha, xhumana nalabo abaphathelene nalezi zindaba. Ngezinye izikhathi lokhu kungalungiswa kalula, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi kungaba into ebaluleke kakhulu? Isiko lethu njengabantu abamnyama lidlala indima enkulu emicabangweni yethu. Uma ingane ikhula ifundiswa lezi zinkolelo, izenzo, nemigomo yomphakathi ekhula nayo, lokhu kuyakha ukuziphatha komuntu nokucabanga ngempilo. Uma owesifazane ekhula efundiswa ukuthi owesifazane kufanele aziphathe ngendlela ethile, azithibe, futhi alalele lokho akukhuluma, noma angavumelani nakho, ngeke akwazi ukukhipha lokho; uzokugcina ngaphakathi kwakhe. Manje ubuze ukuthi yiziphi izinkantolo eziboshwa abesifazane abamnyama abathola izigwebo zeminyaka engamashumi amabili zokubulala abagibeli babo. Konke kuvela emvelweni yethu yamasiko, ukuthula nokuthula mayelana nezinto ezithinte abantu isikhathi eside, futhi lokhu okugcina kubenza babe ngababulali. Iningi labesifazane abaphakathi kwezinkantolo lidlulelwe isikhathi eside futhi ngezindlela eziningi, kuhlanganise nokweqisa, ngokomzimba, ngokomqondo, nangokwezimali ngabalingani babo. Umthetho uyazi lokhu. Bangakwazi ukuvikela lezi zehlakalo, kodwa hhayi isikhathi eside. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi baphenduke benze okuthile abangakwenzi, njengokubulala. Lokhu kubakhulula ukuthi ekugcineni ukuhlupheka kwabo sekuphelile. Baphika ukuba bashiye izingane zabo ukuze baphoswe. Kuyamangaza ukuthi lezi zihlukunyezwayo aziboni ukuthi zihlukunyezwa; zicabanga ukuthi amasiko asaqhubeka, kodwa ngakolunye uhlangothi, zithola amandla okukhuthazela. Ngesikhathi ubuholi bezwe bukhishwa ngo-1994 ngaphansi kukaCyril Ramaphosa, amalungelo abesifazane ayewabhekwa kakhulu. Sivumele ukuba bathathe amalungelo abo labo abangenamphimbo isikhathi eside. Manje kumele siphakame futhi sibonise, sakhe ikusasa elisha labesifazane, noma sihloniphe amasiko ethu, kodwa akukho okukhuthaza ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane. Ngicela imibono, izindaba ezinhlobonhlobo, ofuna ukuba zishicilelwe ephephandabeni lethu. Ungesabi, noma uma ungafuni ukukhombisa igama lakho, kulungile. Khumbula ukuthi sikhuluma kahle ngalokho esinakho.
Umthetho Wobudlelwano Bezimali ka-1995 uvuma ilungelo lokuphikisana emsebenzini phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ibhande elibhalisiwe lingavuma ukuphikisana kwamalungu alo nabaxhasi ngenhloso yokubonisa ngokuthula. Ukuphikisana kungabanjwa noma kuphi lapho abantu benelungelo lokungena, kodwa hhayi ezindlini zomqashi, noma ngaphakathi kwezindlini zomqashi ngaphandle kwemvume yomqashi. Imigomo yemithetho ivumela abasebenzi ukuba baphikise ezindlini zomqashi uma i-CCMA ithola ukuthi umqashi uphumelele ngendlela engafanele ngokuvimbela ukuphikisana ngaphakathi kwezindlini zabo. Ibhande elibhalisiwe noma umqashi bangagcwalisa ifomu le-LRA 4.1 ukucela i-CCMA ukuba ithole ukuvumelana ngemigomo yemithetho yokuphikisana ngesikhathi sokuhlasela noma sokuvinjelwa. Nikeza iqembu elithintekayo kopi yale fomu. Uma kunezinkampani eziningi ezithintekayo kule ngxabano, noma uma le ngxabano ibandakanya amaqembu amaningi, bhala amagama nezinhlaka ezengeziwe ephepheni elihlukile bese uxhuma le mininingwane kufomu. Lokhu kuzoncika ekutheni kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukusombulula le ngxabano.
Ukwamukela Imigomo Yenqubomgomo (GEMS Member Policy Acceptance) Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wenzeke eGoli, lapho abahlanganyeli beGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) bahlangana ukuze bamukele futhi baqonde imigomo yenqubomgomo yephrojekthi yabo. Lo mcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile mayelana nezinguquko ezisemqoka ezithinta amalungu, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo kubo. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evula umhlangano eyethulwe nguMnu. Sipho Mthembu, umphathi weGEMS. Uthe, “Siyavuma ukuthi izinguquko zidinga ukufundwa kahle ukuze amalungu ethu aqonde izinzuzo ezizovela. Ukuze sibe neGEMS eqinile, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke siqonde imigomo esiyamukelayo.” Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuxoxa, futhi abahlanganyeli baqala ukuxoxa ngemicabango yabo. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwemigomo, kwaba neseshini yokuxoxa, lapho amalungu abethula imibuzo eminingi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abahlanganyeli babejabulile ngokuba nesikhala sokwazisa, futhi lokhu kwavusa umoya wokubambisana. UMsizi Nkosi, omunye wamalungu, waphakamisa ukuthi, “Kubalulekile ukuthi sizwe izinzuzo ezithile ezizovela kulolu shintsho, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela kahle ikusasa lethu.” Ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo akukhona nje kuphela ukwamukela izinqumo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS namalungu ayo. UMsizi Thandiwe Ngubane, owayekhona emcimbini, uthe, “Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zinguquko zizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zempilo. Ngiyaziqhenya ngokuba yilungu leGEMS.” Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izifundo ezithile ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile. Kwaba nezinkulumo ezivela kochwepheshe bezempilo, abacwaningi, kanye nabamele iziguli, bonke bephakamisa indlela ezithinta ngayo izinqubomgomo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaveza ukuthi imiphumela yokwamukela le migomo izoba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawunikeza ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu, okwakuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okwakha ubudlelwano obusha, okwakuzoba usizo ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. UMsizi Siphesihle Dlamini, owayekhuluma ngesikhathi somcimbi, uthe, “Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwethu bungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezinzima ezithinta impilo yethu.” Ukugcina umoya wokubambisana, umcimbi uphumelele ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokuthi iGEMS iyakwenza kanjani ukuba amalungu ayo azizwe ebalulekile. UMsizi Zanele Khumalo, owayephethe iseshini yokugcina, uthe, “Siyabonga nonke ngokuba lapha. Ukubambisana kwethu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezithuthukile.” Ngemuva kokuphothulwa komcimbi, amalungu abawathokozela kakhulu, futhi kwavela izinhlelo eziningi zokuhlanganyela ukuze kuqhubeke nokukhuluma ngalezi zinguquko ezibalulekile. Umoya wokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha kwaba yizinto eziphawulekayo emcimbini. Ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo yeGEMS akukhona nje ukuvuma, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelithembekile. Umcimbi uphumelele ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokuthi iGEMS iyakwenza kanjani ukuba amalungu ayo azizwe ebalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zempilo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi ukwamukela imigomo yenqubomgomo akukhona nje ukwamukela izinqumo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS namalungu ayo, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, ubonisa ukuthi umoya wokubambisana, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha kuyisihluthulelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Amalungu abavuma ukuhamba phambili, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo kanye nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kwazisa iGEMS njengomholi kwezempilo, futhi kuzoqhubeka kugqugquzela amalungu ukuba abambe iqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo.
Ukufuna Umsebenzi: Ingxoxo Ngendlela Yokuphumelela Isingeniso Ukufuna umsebenzi kuyinto ebalulekile empilweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho abantu bejolisa khona emisebenzini ethile ukuze bakwazi ukuziphilisa. Kulesi sihloko, sizohlola izindlela ezahlukene zokufuna umsebenzi, sikhuluma ngezinto okufanele zicatshangwe, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ingxoxo yokusebenza ibe yimpumelelo. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Umsebenzi Ofunwayo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi olufunayo. Lokhu kusho ukuba necebo elicacile, lokho kusho ukuthola izimfuno ezithile zomsebenzi, izimboni, nezinkampani ozithanda. Ungasebenzisa izinsiza ezifana nezinkundla zokuxhumana, amaphephandaba, noma izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile nolwakha. Ngokuhlola imakethe yomsebenzi, ungakwazi ukuthola izikhala ezithokozisayo ezihambisana nezifiso zakho. Isigaba 2: Ukuhlela I-CV Nezincwadi Zokufaka Isicelo Ngemuva kokukhetha umsebenzi ofunayo, umnyango olandelayo ukuhlela i-CV yakho (i-curriculum vitae) nezincwadi zokufaka isicelo. I-CV yakho kufanele ibonise kahle amakhono akho, ulwazi lwakho, kanye nezifundo ozithathile. Kumele ube nokwethembeka, ugweme izimpazamo ezivamile, futhi ugxile kulokho okwenzile empilweni yakho, ikakhulukazi kokuhambelana nomsebenzi ofunwayo. Izincwadi zokufaka isicelo ziyisethulo esibalulekile, kufanele ubonise ukuthi kungani ungumuntu ofanele lo msebenzi, futhi unikeze izizathu ezikhuthazayo. Isigaba 3: Ukusebenzisa Izinkundla Zokuxhumana Izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yisikhali esinamandla ekufuneni umsebenzi. Ungasebenzisa uhlelo olufana ne-LinkedIn ukuze ukhulume nabantu abakwi ndawo ofuna ukusebenza kuyo. Lokhu kungaholela ekuboniseni izikhala zomsebenzi, ukuthola izixhumanisi ezibalulekile, noma nokwakha ubudlelwano obusiza ekufuneni umsebenzi. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uhlole iphrofayela yakho, uqinisekise ukuthi ibonisa kahle ubuchwepheshe bakho kanye namakhono akho. Isigaba 4: Ukulungiselela Ingxoxo Yokusebenza Uma usuthole ithuba lokuhlangana nendawo yokusebenza, kulapho ukuqala ukuhl准备. Lokhu kusho ukufunda ngenkampani, uqonde izinjongo zayo, nokwazi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zayo. Kulungiselela imibuzo ongayibuzwa, futhi ucabangele izimpendulo ezihlobene nemisebenzi yakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nokuzethemba ngesikhathi sengxoxo, futhi kukhombise izinga lakho lokuzimisela. Isigaba 5: Ukuphumelela Ngeke Kube Kalula Kubhalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphumelela ngokufuna umsebenzi akulona uhambo olulula. Kuzodingeka uthole izinkanyezi, uthole izinkinga, nokuthi ungaphazanyiswa. Uma ungaphumelelanga emsebenzini owuthandayo, ungaphinde uhlaziye izizathu, uhlolisise imvelo yakho yokusebenza, futhi uthole izindlela ezahlukene zokubhekana nemiphumela. Ukubekezelela nokuba nezinhloso ezicacile kuyasiza emizweni yobunzima. Isigaba 6: Ukukhuluma Ngempumelelo Uma usukwazile ukuthola umsebenzi, ungakhohlwa ukubonga abaqashi kanye nabantu abakusizile ohambweni lwakho. Lokhu kuzwakala njengokuhlonipha, futhi kungakha izixhumanisi ezinhle zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, qhubeka nokuthuthukisa amakhono akho nokufunda ukuze uqhubeke ube umholi emkhakheni wakho. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukufuna umsebenzi kuyinqubo eyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungaba nenhloso edidiyelwe yokuphumelela. Kubalulekile ukuba necebo, ukulungiselela kahle, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo. Khumbula ukuthi, ngokuba nesineke nokuqhubeka nokusebenza, uzothola ithuba ofuna lona. Ukuphumelela akuyona into ethokozisayo, kodwa kuyindlela eqhubekayo yokufunda, ukukhula, nokuthola ukuzethemba. Futhi, khumbula njalo, isinyathelo sokuqala sokuqala lapho umgibeli emhlabeni omusha.
Ukuqinisekisa Ukunakekelwa Kwezinga Eliphezulu (GEMS Quality Care Assurance) Ezimfundisweni zansuku zonke, umqondo wokunakekelwa kwesimo seGEMS ubonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokunikeza izinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izinkomba ezichaza uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Ngakho-ke, lezi zinhlelo, ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuchopho, kanye nomoya wokuhlonipha, zenza kube lula ukufezekisa izinjongo ezisemqoka zokunikeza ukunakekelwa okuhle. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhloselwe ukuqinisa ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okucatshangwa njengesinyathelo esibalulekile sokwandisa ukwethembeka nezinselelo ezivela emiphakathini emikhulu. Ngokuhlanganyela, inhlangano enza umgomo wokukhalipha ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bonke bathola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyiqiniso. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi, odokotela, nabanye abanakekeli, bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze babhekelele ukuhlonipha izidingo zabantu. Ngokunyuka kwebhizinisi lezempilo, izinsizakalo ziqhubeka nokukhula kakhulu. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezimo zokukhokha ezibucayi, okwenza kube nzima ukunikeza umkhiqizo uphumelele emqondweni wokunakekela. Kulokhu, uhlelo lweGEMS lubonisa ubuchwepheshe obuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza, kudalwa amathuba okukhuthaza, okwandisa ukuzinza nokumelana nezimo ezintsha. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhlinzeka ngaphezu kokunakekelwa. Luzama ukuhlanganisa izici ezahlukene zempilo - kumalungelo abantu, izicelo zempilo, kanye nezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe. Uhlelo luphinde lwenza kube lula ukufunda nokuhlola indlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ithuba lokuqonda ukuthi iziyalezo kanye nezinsiza zempilo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukufunda nokwenza izinto ngendlela efanele kuyahlobana. Uhlelo lweGEMS lwakha indlela esebenzayo yokwazisa isehlakalo sokunakekelwa, kulungiselelwa izindlela ezithile zokusebenza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubheka indlela yokubhalisela izingane, ukufaka umkhandlu wezinyathelo ezinhle, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola izinqubo zokunakekela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lweGEMS lwenziwa luhlale lujwayelekile ukunjalo, luhloselwe ukwakha isixazululo esiqhubekayo sokusebenza kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ukwenza izinto ngendlela efanele kuholela ekutheni uhlelo lutuze, olufanelwe ukwenziwa kahle, lwenze kube lula kubantu ukunikela ngesizakalo esikalwe kakhulu. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka ukwenza izifundo ezihlukile ukuze kuhlonishwe izidingo nemithetho yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuhlola izinqubo ezithile zokunakekela kuzokhulisa umoya wokuzimisela nokwazisa imikhuba emihle. Lokhu, ngesikhathi esifanayo, kwandise ithuba lokugeleza okuhle nokwandisa ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu abakhuluma ngempilo. Ngesikhathi inhlangano ibheka izindlela zokuthuthukisa, ubuchwepheshe bokuhumusha imithombo yezokuxhumana kudinga ukusebenzisa amakhosombe nezinhlelo zokuphatha. Lokhu kuzodala ithuba lokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abasha nabadala, okwenza kube nokuxhumana okuhamba phambili, okuhloswe kumqondo wokubambisana. Lawo maholoholo ezinsizakalo azokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinhlelo zokunakekela ezithuthukisiwe. Ngamafuphi, uhlelo lweGEMS luthinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Lokhu kutholakala kuphela ngenkathi izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa zithuthuka ziqinisekiswa. Abantu badinga ukuhlonishwa ngosuku nosuku ngokuphila kwabo, ukuze kube nekhwalithi ekahle yokunakekelwa. Lokhu kuyazisa, futhi kumele kube umgomo wazo zonke izinsizakalo ezihlangene, ukuze kufinyelelwe emiphumeleni ewusizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqonde ukuthi kuningi okufanele kucace. Umoya odingekayo wokuhlanganyela ungayifeza imisebenzi ethuthukayo. Lezi zinhlelo zokukhalipha zingakhuthaza, zijabule, futhi zisebenze ngokuqhubekayo. Lokhu kuhlola kudinga izikhalazo eziphakeme, ukuze kudaleke isithunzi sokuhlonipha esilondolozwayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhlelo lweGEMS luyoba yisibonelo esihle sokwakhiwa komphakathi, okwenza kube nekhwalithi yokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buyanda, kuhlale kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ikakhulukazi kunamathuba amaningi okufunda umphakathi ngezidingo ezithile. Lokhu kuncike ezindleleni ezihambisanayo, futhi umgomo wokuhlonipha abantwana eziphakamisweni zomphakathi onobuhle. Ngamanye amazwi, uhlelo lweGEMS lumele lihlale lwenza ukuboshelwe kakhulu ukuze kuhlonishwe izidingo zabantu. Njengoba siya phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule imiphumela engaba khona uma lezi zinhlelo zingaqinisekiswa. Lokhu kudinga ukukhuthazwa okuqhubekayo, ukuze kuxhunywe umoya wokusebenza okuphumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kuhle ukuthi uhlole uhla lwezinhlelo ezihambisanayo, kanye nezindlela zokugcina ukuhlonishwa kwezidingo. Uhlelo lweGEMS luveza ukuzimisela okungapheli ekwenzeni izifundo ezinhle. Lesi simemezelo silobolerho, ukudala isikhumba esisha sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sihamba phambili, sihlonipha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi sakha ikusasa elikhanyayo lokunakekelwa kwezitho nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi konke okwenzeka kubantu kwenziwa ngezinga eliphezulu, futhi ukunakekelwa kuyadedelwa ngendlela efanele. Uhlelo lweGEMS luzokhumbula каждый umnyango omusha.
Le mklomelo inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaveze ubuchwepheshe obukhulu emikhakheni yobuciko, isiko, izincwadi zemfundo, umculo, ezokubika, nezemidlalo. Ikhathagori yesithathu = Uhlanganiso lwezinsimbi. Uthuli lwe-pumpkin lumele ubuhle obukhulu bokuphumelela kwabantu abesilisa nabesifazane abaphakamisela iNingizimu Afrika emikhakheni yokwakha, ubuciko, isiko, umculo, ezokubika, nezemidlalo. Amakhanda eLydenburg - ubuciko - amakhanda e-teracotta amele ubuciko bokubona kanye nomsebenzi wokwakha ubuciko kanye nekhono lokwenza esiteji phambi kwabantu. Idrum yase-Afrika - ihambisana nazo zonke izinkolo nezifiso zobuciko. Imela isipho esikhulu ekuxoxeni izindaba nasekugubheni amasiko ethu. Iphakade / Ilanga - umqhele umele ikhanda elihlotshiswe ngama-feather agqokwe abaculi nobukhosi kanye nabantu abahlonishwa. Imisebe yelanga ichaza amandla amakhulu, udumo, nokukhanya, konke okumele kube yimpumelelo yabaculi emikhakheni ehlukene. Isisho sokuthi asifani neqanda ngaphakathi - (Udlame emidlalweni) simele ukuqashelwa kokuthi abantu baphumelele kakhulu emikhakheni yezemidlalo nezamasiko. Izindlela - (Impumelelo nentshisekelo) - zimele zonke izindlela eziya e-Afrika lapho abantu bevela khona, zimele indlela ende yokuphumelela nokubekezela.
Umthelela wokuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela Ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela, okungukuthi, ukungasebenzi kahle kwemishini ethile ethinta ukuhamba kwabantu, kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, emnothweni nasemphakathini jikelele. Le ngxoxo-mpikiswano izobheka izici ezahlukene zokuphuka kwalolu hlobo, izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezindlela zokubhekana nale nkinga. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umshini wamalayisense okushayela ubalulekile ekuphathweni kwemoto. Uma umshini uphuka, kungaholela ekutheni abashayeli bangakwazi ukuhamba ngendlela efanele, okungaholela ezimeni ezinzima zokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izingozi ezivela ekuphukeni kwemishini zingaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo, ukulimala kwabantu, kanye nezindleko ezinkulu zokulungisa izimoto. Ngakho-ke, ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona abanye abathi ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungaba nethuba lokwenza ngcono izinqubo zokuphatha izimoto. Lokhu kungenzeka uma abashayeli bephoqwa ukuba bahlale beqaphela futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abashayeli babe nekhono elingcono lokuphatha izimoto zabo, okungaba nomthelela omuhle ekuphepheni kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Uma izimoto zingasebenzi kahle, abashayeli bangase badinge ukulungisa izimoto zabo, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko. Lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo, ikakhulukazi uma abashayeli bephoqwa ukuba bahlale bezama ukulungisa izinkinga ezivela ekuphukeni kwemishini. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi emnothweni, njengoba abashayeli bengase badinge ukusebenzisa imali eningi ukuze balungise izimoto zabo. Kodwa-ke, abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela kungaba yithuba lokwenza izinguquko ezinhle. Lokhu kungenzeka uma abashayeli bephoqwa ukuba bahlale beqaphela futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abashayeli babe nekhono elingcono lokuphatha izimoto zabo, okungaba nomthelela omuhle ekuphepheni kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphuka komshini kungase kube yithuba lokwenza izinguquko ezinhle emkhakheni wezokuthutha, njengoba abashayeli bephoqwa ukuba bahlale beqaphela futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima. Ngokubheka izinzuzo nezingozi zokuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela, kubalulekile ukuthi abashayeli bahlale beqaphela futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abashayeli babe nekhono elingcono lokuphatha izimoto zabo, okungaba nomthelela omuhle ekuphepheni kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abashayeli bahlale beqaphela futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima, ukuze bagweme izingozi ezivela ekuphukeni kwemishini. Ngokuphetha, umthelela wokuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela ungaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, emnothweni nasemphakathini jikelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi abashayeli bahlale beqaphela futhi baphendule ngokushesha ezimeni ezinzima, ukuze bagweme izingozi ezivela ekuphukeni kwemishini. Lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni abashayeli babe nekhono elingcono lokuphatha izimoto zabo, okungaba nomthelela omuhle ekuphepheni kwabo. Ngakho-ke, ukuphuka komshini wamalayisense okushayela akukhona nje kuphela inkinga, kodwa futhi kungaba yithuba lokwenza izinguquko ezinhle emkhakheni wezokuthutha.
Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhola abakhandi bendabuko emsebenzini wabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphathwa kokwahlulelwa kwenziwa kahle kakhulu lapho bephatha njengababusi abaqinisekisiwe futhi basungula izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekuphathweni kwemishado noma ukuqinisekiswa, ukuthathwa kwemishado esemthethweni noma eqinisekisiwe, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo. a Amandla okubamba ngaphandle kwesimemezelo: umuntu ophula noma ozama ukuphula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi uzophuma ekubambeni okusemthethweni; umuntu otholakala enezinsiza zokweba noma/ kanye nezinsiza zokuphula imoto; umuntu otholakala enezinto okukholelwa ukuthi zibe zebiwe noma otholakala ezimeni eziphawulekayo; umuntu otholakala ebusuku ezimeni ezikhombisa ukuthi uphule noma uzophula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi ubevele waba nemfuyo, njll. kanye b Amandla okusebenzisa isiqinisekiso sokubamba. Bonke abakhandi bendabuko bangabaphathi bokuthula, ngakho-ke ngenxa yezikhundla zabo (ex officio) - bangababusi abaqinisekisiwe. Ngenxa yesikhundla sabo - umphathi oqinisekisiwe ungumuntu, ngenxa yesikhundla noma isikhundla sabo, okwenza kube umphathi oqinisekisiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Lapho abanye abantu kufanele bafake isicelo kuNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ukuze baphathwe njengababusi abaqinisekisiwe, lo muntu akafaki isicelo. Uma abaphathwa abaqinisekisiwe bethola izitifiketi zokuphathwa, ngenxa yesikhundla sabo umphathi oqinisekisiwe akadingi isitifiketi, njengoba benesitifiketi sesikhundla noma isikhundla. Umphathi oqinisekisiwe uphathwa endaweni ethile futhi usebenza kule ndawo abaphathwe kuyo. Indima yomphathi oqinisekisiwe ukusiza amalungu omphakathi wendawo ngokuphatha imishado noma ukuqinisekiswa noma ukwenza isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe kumuntu. Enye imisebenzi yomphathi oqinisekisiwe ukuqinisekisa amakhophi wemibhalo njengamakhophi aqinile wemibhalo yokuqala. Akukho imali ethathwa ekuphathweni kwemishado noma ukuqinisekiswa, ekuqinisekiseni isitatimende, noma ekuqinisekiseni imibhalo. Umphathi oqinisekisiwe akavunyelwe ukuphatha imishado noma ukuqinisekiswa okuhlobene nendaba enomsebenzi wabo. Isizathu sithi umuntu oqinisekisa i-affidavit kufanele abe ngumuntu ongahlobene futhi ongenalo uhlelo oluthile endabeni equkethwe kwi-affidavit ukuze umuntu oqinisekisa akhululeke kunoma iyiphi ingcindezi yendaba ethile kwi-affidavit. Lo msebenzi owenziwa umphathi oqinisekisiwe unciphisa isidingo sokuthi abantu bahambe izindawo ezide ukuya ezikhungweni zamaphoyisa eziseduzane noma emahhovisi kaMagistrate ukuze bafune usizo. Uma umholi bendabuko, ngenxa yemisebenzi okufanele bayenze noma ngezizathu ezahlukene, engakwazi ukusebenza njengomphathi oqinisekisiwe, umphathi noma noma yimuphi umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe ngumholi bendabuko angaba umphathi oqinisekisiwe kule ndawo, kuphela ngokuphathwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Amafomu esicelo (J5) atholakala emahhovisi kaMagistrate. Le fomu inamakhasi ayisithupha. Amakhasi amahlanu okuqala kufanele agcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo, kanti ikhasi lokugcina lidinga ukuthi uMagistrate agcwalisise iziphakamiso mayelana nesicelo. Ngokomthetho, lokhu kusho ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uzoba nezingxoxo zemibuzo noMagistrate, ezihlelwe nguMphathi weNkantolo yoMphakathi. Lapho kukhona umphathi womholi bendabuko noma omunye umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe ngumholi bendabuko, kubalulekile ukuba kube nephepha lokuphawula elibhaliwe ngumholi bendabuko ukuze lihambisane nesicelo. UMagistrate uzothumela ifomu lesicelo kanye nephepha lokuphawula kuMnyango wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Abasebenzi boMnyango wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo bazobheka isicelo kuze kube isikhathi sokuxoxisana sitholakala nguNgqongqoshe/Ngqongqoshe noma abamele babo, okujwayelekile okuqukethe amalungu omnyango ezikhundleni eziphezulu. Isitifiketi sizothunyelwa emuva kuMagistrate ozosithumela kumfaki-sicelo. Umuntu oqinisekisa (umuntu owenze i-affidavit) angaya kumphathi oqinisekisiwe ne-affidavit ukuze aqinisekise noma aqinisekise. Nokho, uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye mayelana nemishado njengoba kucacisiwe ngumlomo; kanye iii Uma imishado eqinisekisiwe ngumlomo ibonwa njengokubopheleka enhliziyweni yabo. Imishado eqinisekisiwe ngumlomo yenziwa ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe ethi: "Ngiyafunga ukuthi okuqukethwe kule affidavit kuyiqiniso, uNkulunkulu angisize." Umuntu ophakanyisiwe uzocelwa ukuthi uphakamise isandla sokunene ukuze afunge. Uma umuntu ophakanyisiwe evuma ukuthi uyazi okuqukethwe kwalokho afungayo futhi utshele umphathi oqinisekisiwe ukuthi baphikisa imishado noma ukuthi ababona imishado njengokubopheleka enhliziyweni yabo, umphathi oqinisekisiwe uzokwenza ukuqinisekiswa. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenziwa ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe ethi: "Ngiyiqiniso ukuthi okukhuluma kuyiqiniso." Umuntu ophakanyisiwe kufanele asayine lokho akufungayo phambi komphathi oqinisekisiwe. Uma umuntu ophakanyisiwe engakwazi ukubhala, kufanele abeke uphawu ekugcineni kwamagama aphakanyisiwe. Uma umphathi oqinisekisiwe engaboni ukuthi umuntu ophakanyisiwe akakwazi ukubhala, kuzodingeka ukuthi lokhu kuqinisekiswe ngaphansi kwamagama aphakanyisiwe ngabanye abantu abathembekile. Ngemuva kokuba umuntu ophakanyisiwe esayine noma ebeke uphawu, umphathi oqinisekisiwe uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu ophakanyisiwe uvumile ukuthi bangakwazi futhi bayazi okuqukethwe kwamagama aphakanyisiwe futhi bazokhuluma indawo, indawo, nosuku lokwenza imishado. Umphathi oqinisekisiwe uzosayina imishado futhi abhale igama lakhe eliphelele kanye nekheli lomsebenzi ngaphansi kokusayina kwakhe, futhi futhi akhulume ngesikhundla sabo kanye nendawo lapho babebonile noma ihhovisi abakhona. "Ikheli lomsebenzi" lisho ikheli langempela hhayi ikheli leposi. Izikhwama ezifanele zitholakala ukusiza abaphathi abaqinisekisiwe ekwenzeni umsebenzi wemishado noma ukuqinisekiswa ngaphandle kokulibaziseka. Ikhophi yemibhalo okufanele iqinisekiswe njengekhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala kufanele iqhathaniswe nemibhalo yokuqala futhi kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le mibhalo emibili iyefana. Uma umphathi oqinisekisiwe ejabulela ukuthi ikhophi iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi akukho shintsho olungagunyaziwe olwenziwayo, umphathi oqinisekisiwe kufanele abhale ukuthi uqinisekisa ukuthi le mibhalo iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi ukuthi akukho zinkomba zokuthi imibhalo yokuqala ishintshiwe ngabantu abangagunyaziwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, umphathi oqinisekisiwe kufanele asayine futhi abhale igama lakhe, isikhundla, imininingwane yokuxhumana, nosuku. Izikhwama ezifanele zitholakala ukuze kuqinisekiswe imibhalo. Uma imishado noma ukuqinisekiswa kungenziwa kahle njengoba kucacisiwe ngumlomo, khona-ke udaba luthunyelwa enkantolo, i-affidavit izobhekwa njengengamanga futhi ingaba nemiphumela emibi, njengokuholela ekukhululweni komsolwa ezimweni zezenzo ezimbi. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walonyaka, leli gciwane lisabalale ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalale ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane lihlasele abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo lwesayensi) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. ENingizimu Afrika, siqinisekisile izigameko ezingu-2,844 zokufa phakathi kwabantu abangu-6 kuze kube manje. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo okwenzeka ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lezempilo Lomhlaba (WHO) laphawula ukuthi izinqubo zokumemezela leli gciwane njengokuphakanyiswa komhlaba seziphumelele, futhi uMphathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni le ndawo njengePandemic (izinga lesi-6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi leli gciwane lisabalale ezwenikazi zonke zeWHO futhi lenzeke ngokushesha. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi leli gciwane linamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi liyaqhubeka lisabalala yonke indawo. Ngomhla kaJulayi 6, iWHO ichaze isimo esiqhubekayo saleli gciwane ezweni ezithintekile nakwezinye izwe njengokungamukeleki nokungavinjwa. Ngempela, naphezu kwalokhu, iphinde yaphawula ukuthi abantu abaningi abane-gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasendaweni, sikhathazekile ngama-efekthini abekade kwenzeka kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye no-0.2% wabantu abane-gciwane eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane liba nomthelela ikakhulukazi kubantu abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-29 - iningi labo ngababafundi noma labo abakwi-institutions eziphakeme. IWHO icele ukuthi amazwe athintekile agxile ekwehliseni umthelela waleli gciwane emiphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lidluliselwa ngezinsalela zomoya, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu ophukile ekhwehlela noma ehlanza, uphonsa umoya owonakele noma owakhiphayo. Noma uma behlaza endaweni encane, ungase ube nokungena emoyeni lapho ungase ufezeke. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onama-symptoms alula noma abukhali kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokunconywa udokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka esikhungweni socwaningo lwesayensi. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwenzeka okwamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukona okudinga iWHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe izimo eziphakeme ngokuya ngemininingwane yokusabalalisa (protocol) enikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela emiphumeleni engcono yokwelashwa uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangase baphile. Ulwazi lwemhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zokufunda nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwalesi sifo. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi onama-symptoms alula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi futhi/noma othisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezobulungiswa, ozobambisana nezikhulu zezempilo ukuze kunikezwe umhlahlandlela ofanele. Uma unama-symptoms alula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana neWHO ukuzama ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sokuxazulula kanye nokukhiqiza okukhulu okunganele - isikali esikhona e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukukubonga ngalesi sikhathi osithathile ukufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubekayo ngokubandakanyeka kwakho ekusabalaliseni ulwazi nasekwehliseni umthelela waleli gciwane.
Izindaba Zamanje: Ingxoxo NoMnu. Mthembu Ngempilo Yezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika Umhlangano wethu uqala ngenkulumo ejabulisayo, lapho uMnu. Mthembu, ongumholi wezepolitiki, ehamba phambili ekuphenduleni imibuzo ebalulekile mayelana nezindaba zamanje ezithinta iNingizimu Afrika. Umbuzo 1: Mnu. Mthembu, ungakuchaza kanjani isimo sezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika namuhla? UMnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Isimo sezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika sithokozisa, kodwa futhi sinesithiyo. Sihlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi, ezifana nokungabi namsebenzi, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nezinselelo zempilo. Nokho, kukhona nethuba lokuthuthukisa izinto. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo emkhakheni wezempilo, imfundo, kanye nezokuphepha zikhombisa ukuthi sikhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile.” Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathola izinsiza ezidingekayo? UMnu. Mthembu: “Sisebenza ngokubambisana nohulumeni bamazwe omhlaba, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphila. Umsebenzi wethu uwukwakha izinhlelo ezizofinyelela kubantu abavamile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa ukufinyelela emithonjeni yokufunda, izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abavela ezindaweni ezinzima.” Umbuzo 3: Kukhona izinkinga ezithinta ukhetho lwangaphakathi kwezepolitiki. Ungakuchaza lokhu? UMnu. Mthembu: “Yebo, izinkinga zokuqokwa kwabantu emikhakheni ethile zikhona. Lokhu kubangelwa ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwababonisi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukhetho lwenziwa ngendlela efanele, ukuze kube nesithunzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwabantu nabaholi, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo.” Umbuzo 4: Ucabanga ukuthi izinhlelo ezikhona zikhona yini ukuvikela amalungelo abantu? UMnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyavuma ukuthi kuningi okwenziwe, kodwa sinesidingo sokwenza okuningi. Amalungelo abantu kufanele abe yinto eyinhloko ezinqubweni zethu. Sisebenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa, futhi imithetho ivikela amalungelo abo. Lokhu kudinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nabantu.” Umbuzo 5: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa leNingizimu Afrika? UMnu. Mthembu: “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ikusasa leNingizimu Afrika linamathuba amaningi. Uma sikhuthaza ubumbano, sithuthukisa imfundo, futhi sithuthukisa umnotho, sizokwazi ukwakha izwe elinempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokukhula. Ngiyabonga!” Umhlangano wethu uphetha ngenkulumo evusa umoya, uMnu. Mthembu ebonisa ithemba lokuthi iNingizimu Afrika izokwazi ukuhamba phambili, uma abantu bebandakanyeka futhi besebenza ndawonye. Izindaba zamanje zikhombisa ukuthi, nakuba sinezinselelo, sinesikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi unamandla okwenza ushintsho oluhle.
Izinkundla Zokuxhumana: Uhlanga Lwempilo Yethu Yanamuhla Emhlabeni wanamuhla, izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu. Kuhlala sikhuluma ngalezi zinkundla ezisezingeni eliphezulu, njenge-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, kanye ne-WhatsApp, ezitholakala kalula emaplaystore nakumakhalekhukhwini. Lezi zinkundla azigcini nje ngokwenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi, kodwa zibuye zibe yindlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, kudala izixhumanisi ezisheshayo phakathi komphakathi. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana, ngesikhathi sokuqala, zazisa ngaphandle kokuhlonza okukhulu, okwakuhloswe ukufaka abantu abaninzi endaweni eyodwa ukuze baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bahlanganyele. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sidlula, kwavela izinhlelo ezihlukene ezazikhonjwa ekucindezelweni, emiphumeleni engalindelekile kuzo zonke izici zempilo. Ngonyaka ka-2020, ukuhlaselwa kokwanda kwezaziso zobudlova, amalungelo abantu, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi, kuveze umehluko phakathi kwezinkundla, zaba yizinkundla zokulwa, nezinsizakalo zokufundisa, okwakuthinta izigidi zabantu. Lokhu kwashiwo ngenhlonipho, njengoba izinkundla zokuxhumana zikhona njengezinkundla zokuxhumana, kodwa, ezithathwa njengenye yezinsiza ezisemqoka zokulwiswa kwezenhlalo, zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubunjweni kobuhlobo, futhi zihlale zinobungozi uma zingalawulwa kahle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinkundla zokuxhumana ziveze izinzuzo ezinkulu. Lokhu kuvula amathuba okuziphendulela kwemibono, okwandisa umphakathi wezokuxhumana, kakhulu ezindaweni ezikude kangaka. Ngaphandle kwezinhlelo ezisemqoka, njengoFacebook, izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana ne-LinkedIn zibamba abezindaba, ochwepheshe, nabafundi, ukuze babelane ngemicabango efana nesoftware, nezinkampani kanye nemisebenzi yangempela. Lokhu kusiza abantu ukuba baqonde izimfuno zemakethe. Ubulili, ubuzwe, nesikhathi sokuphila bukhombisa imiphumela emihle, kodwa futhi emiseleni ethile kuze kube nezinqumo ezibalulekile zokukhomba futhi kube nomthelela wokuthi abantu bazize benolwazi oluphusile olukhuluma ngezimvo orazinokwethenjelwa. Izinqumo zokukhetha izinkundla ziveza ukuthi abantu bahlukahluka, badinga ukugqugquzela ngokuhlukahluka kokucwaninga kwama-network, ruch project befo zevolvi. Umgwaqo oya phambili ungabalwa phakathi kwezinkundla zokuxhumana, ukukhuluma nohlelo olukhulayo dhigitha. Izinkundla ezizele ngemininingwane, izindaba, nezifiso, ngenxa yemikhankaso ethile, zikhombisa indlela ukuze sithole izimpendulo ezisheshayo ezizobalula izinkinga. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zidinga abaholi abanakancane, abangenza izinqumo ezilungile ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezinzima. Ngasikhathi sinye, imikhumbi ethile izoba yinkanyezi eshayisa endaweni eyodwa, nezehlayo, zigqugquzela ukuxhashazwa kwabantu. Imibono ibangakufika njengezinkinga, ukuhlinzeka ukukhulumela kwempilo, uma izinkundla zokuxhumana zingenzisiwa isotikisi. Nokho, ukugwema ubuxhakaxhaka ezehlakalweni, kubalulekile ukuba nokuqonda okuhle ngomhlaba wamanje wezokuxhumana. Akusiyo kuphela indawo yokubhalisela imicimbi, kodwa ibekela indawo yokudlula imibono, ukuphikiswa kwemigomo, nezimvo ezithokozisayo. Ngakusasa, izinkundla zokuxhumana zizoba yokukhuluma nokuveza ubuchopho, okuhlobene nokudlondlobala komphakathi, okuphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana zinezinqubo nezinselelo ezifanayo, kodwa futhi zindlela ezimnandi zokuba neqhaza empilweni yansuku zonke. Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, sikwazi ukufunda okufana nesizathu sokudlula emphakathini. Lokhu kuyakhombisa ukuthi ngezikhathi ezithile, ukuhamba kuloko kuyeza, ngesikhathi esithile, indlela esibona ngayo impilo. Kubalulekile ukuba siqhubeke siphakamisa imiyalezo ehloniphekile, siqhubeke sikhanyisa umphakathi, ukusiza othile, futhi sithumbe izinga lezigameko eziholwa yizinkundla zokuxhumana. Ngalesi sikhathi esimnandi, qhubekani nohlanga, nazindaba ezinhle zikhona ezindatsheni ezitholakala kulezi zinkundla, njengoba umphakathi uzama ukufunda nokwehliselwa phakathi kokuxhumana, eqhubeka nempilo ebumbene.
Ukufunda Nge-Inthanethi: Izinyathelo Zokwenza Ukufunda Kwakho Kube Ngcono Isingeniso Namuhla, ukufunda nge-inthanethi sekuyindlela ethokozisayo nethandwayo yokuthola ulwazi. Noma ngabe ufuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono akho, ukufunda izinto ezintsha, noma ukufinyelela emithonjeni eyahlukene, i-inthanethi ikunika amathuba amaningi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokufunda nge-inthanethi, ukuze ukwazi ukwenza kahle futhi uthole imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo 1: Ukukhetha Indawo Efanele Yokufunda Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukukhetha indawo ethokozisayo nekhululekile yokufunda. Indawo enokuthula izokwenza ukwazi ukuconsa kahle. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yakho ikhululekile, inegumbi elanele, futhi ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezizokuphazamisa. Ungakhetha ukufunda ekhaya, kwi-cafe, noma emtatsheni wezincwadi, kuye ngesithakazelo sakho. Isinyathelo 2: Thola Izinsiza Zokufunda Ezincomekayo Ngemva kokukhetha indawo, kufanele uthole izinsiza ozodinga. Izinsiza zokufunda zingaba izifundo eziku-inthanethi, amavidiyo, nezincwadi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. Thola ama-websites anjaniwedi angcono kakhulu, njengezikhungo zemfundo, izifundo zamahhala, kanye nemithombo efana ne-YouTube. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ozikhethayo zikhokhelwa noma zethembekile. Isinyathelo 3: Dala Uhlelo Lokufunda Njengoba uqala ukufunda, kubalulekile ukudala uhlelo lokufunda. Beka izinjongo ezicacile nezifanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela isikhathi sokufunda. Ungazama ukusetha izinsuku ezithile zokufunda, kanye nezikhathi ezithile zokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uyagcizelela ukufunda njalo. Faka izikhumbuzo kumakhalekhukhwini ukuze ungakhohliwe. Isinyathelo 4: Sebenzisa Amathuluzi E-Technology Ngokufunda nge-inthanethi, amathuluzi e-technology angaba usizo olukhulu. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikuvumela ukuthi ubhale amanothi, uhlele imisebenzi, futhi uqaphe ukuthuthuka kwakho. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-Notion, Evernote, noma i-Google Docs zingakusiza ukwenza lula ukufunda kwakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uyayazisa lezi zinhlelo ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono. Isinyathelo 5: Bamba Ingxoxo Nezinye Izifundi Ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi kungasiza kakhulu ekufundeni. Bamba ingxoxo nabanye, noma ku-inthanethi, ngezigameko ezithile. Ungasebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana noma ama-forum ukuze uxoxe ngemicabango, imibuzo, noma izinkinga ozithola ngesikhathi sokufunda. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umqondo ophusile, futhi uzofunda kakhulu uma uvuma izimvo zabanye. Isinyathelo 6: Thola Izibuyekezo Ngezifundo Zakho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthola izibuyekezo ngezifundo zakho. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufunda izindlela ezintsha, ukulungisa amaphutha, noma ukucabangela izindlela zokufunda ezihlukile. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazihlola lezi zinto, futhi ungazithathi kakhulu uma kunzima, ngoba ukufunda kuyinqubo ehlala njalo. Isinyathelo 7: Jabulela Ukufunda Ekugcineni, kufanele ujabulele ukufunda. Hlanganisa izifundo ezithokozisayo nezinto ozithandayo ukuze uvuselele isifiso sokufunda. Ungakwazi ukufunda izincwadi, ukujolisa kumavidiyo, noma ukujoyina amaqembu ahambisana nezifundo zakho. Ukufunda akufanele kube umsebenzi onzima, kodwa kufanele kube yinto ejabulisayo. Isiphetho Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyindlela enhle yokuthola ulwazi, kodwa kudinga ukuzinikela, uhlelo, kanye nokubekezela. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathuthukisa ukufunda kwakho futhi uthole imiphumela emihle. Khumbula, ukufunda akupheli, futhi kufanele uhlale uvulelekile ezintsha. Jabulela uhambo lwakho lokufunda, futhi ungaphumi emthanjeni wezokwazi!
Ithrekhi 1: Izikole esazivakashele esikhathini sokuqala sika-2010 no-2011. Ithrekhi 2: Abafundi esibabone esikhathini sokuqala sika-2011. Ithrekhi 3: Abafundi ababe khona ezifundweni esikhathini sokuqala. Ithrekhi 4: Izikole esazivakashele ezindaweni ezithile esikhathini sokuqala sika-2011. Ngonyaka ka-2010, iGrain SA yaqaliswa uhlelo ezikoleni olususelwa kuMaize Trust. Uhlelo lwalunomthelela omuhle. Ngesicelo sethu kuMaize Trust sokuxhaswa ngonyaka ka-2010/2011, saphinde sacela uxhaso ukuze kusekelwe impumelelo yalolu hlelo lwesikole. IMaize Trust ivumile ngokubekezela ukuhlinzeka ngama-R360,000 ukuze kudalwe lezi zinguqulo ezintathu ze-DVD. Samukela isithembiso sabo saqala ukukhetha abantu ukuze bakhiqize lezi zinguqulo ze-DVD. Ekugcineni, sakhetha uMartie Williamse ophuma kuNoline Productions ukwenza i-DVD yokuqala noPW van Wyk ophuma ku-AgriTV ukwenza i-DVD yesibili. Othisha bakhethwe ezindaweni eziyishumi: Free State, North West, North West/Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape, Northern Cape, kanye neMpumalanga. Esikhathini sokuqala, savakashela ezikoleni eziyi-180 futhi sakhombisa abafundi lezi zinguqulo ze-DVD. I-DVD yakhelwe ngendlela evumela uthisha ukuthi ayime ezindaweni ezintathu ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuxoxa ngalokho okukhonjiswe nabafundi. Ngemuva kokubuka i-DVD yokuqala, isikole sizothola iphosta yokukhumbuza abafundi lokho i-DVD abafundiswe khona - Ukudla, Ukudla Okunempilo, Impilo. Sabuza abanye abafundi kulezi zikole esahamba kuzo ukuthi lokho esizame ukukufundisa kubasizile yini. "Angazi ukuthi ngiqale kuphi, kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi ngifunde okuningi futhi ngisafuna ukufunda okwengeziwe. Ngikholelwa ukuthi kubalulekile ukutshala izitshalo futhi kakhulu ukuze sikwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngifundile futhi ukuthi ukuhweba akukhona nje umsebenzi wezolimo; thina abasha sidinga ukwazi okuningi okuhlobene nezolimo ukuze sikwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla kwabanye. Kusukela namuhla, ngizoqala ukutshala imifino ngoba ngifundile futhi ngingasiza futhi. Ngithumele izibusiso zami kuGrain SA. Ngabe uNkulunkulu ube nathi ukuze sibe nezinye izikhathi." "Sifunde izinto eziningi esazingazazi, ezifana: u-90% wezokudla emhlabeni ukhiqizwa abalimi. Sidinga abalimi abane ukwenza ibhaga elilodwa. Abanye lapha esikoleni sethu babengazi ukuthi izingubo zenziwa ngensimbi noma ngempahla yezilwane; babengazi ukuthi ukukhulisa izilwane (izinkomo) kuyindlela yokufunda. Sasicabanga ukuthi ukuhweba kuhlobene nje nokutshala, kodwa namuhla sikhumbule ukuthi asazi lutho. Ukuhweba kuhlobene nezimpilo zabalimi ngoba ngaphandle kwabalamile, ngeke kube nokudla." "Yebo! Siqonde kahle isifundo futhi safunda okuningi ngokuqhuba. Asikwazi ukuphila ngaphandle kwezolimo. Ukuboniswa kwakuqondile futhi safunda okwengeziwe ngokuqhuba. Asikwazi ukuphila ngaphandle kwezolimo. Kukho ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwabalamile abakhiqiza ukudla ngokukhulisa izilwane nokutshala izitshalo. Sifunde ukuthi lokho esikugqokayo kuvela ezolimo; sifunde futhi ukuthi ushukela utholakala kumoba futhi ikotini isetshenziselwa ukwenza amajeans. Sifunde futhi ukuthi 'i-photosynthesis' yenzeka ezitshalweni eziluhlaza futhi 'i-chlorophyll' itholakala ezitshalweni eziluhlaza. Ngiyabonga, Grain SA, bekumnandi ukuhlangana nani." "Yebo, ngifunde ukuthi singakwenza umehluko uma sisebenza ezindaweni zokulima ngemva kokuphothula isikole ukuze sikwazi ukusizana sonke ukuba nokudla. Ngibone futhi namuhla ukuthi konke ukudla nezinye izinto esizidlayo kuvela kuphi; akulula ukwenza lezo zinto, asizange sicele ngalokho. Angicabangi ukuthi ngizokwazi ukuqonda ukuthi lezo zinto zenziwa kanjani; kuyamangalisa. Ngiyabonga kakhulu!" "Yebo, ngoba kuhle ukuthola ulwazi oluhlobene nezolimo; ngifunde futhi ukuthi umhlaba ungumthombo wemvelo ophilisa umhlaba. Konke esikutholayo namuhla kuvela ezilwaneni nasemhlabeni. Ubaba uzobe ejabule. Lokho engikubonile namuhla kuyinto engingasoze ngiyikhohlwe. Ngiyabonga kakhulu." Ngiyazi ukuthi ngaphandle kwezolimo, sizokhathazeka futhi ngeke sibe nezingubo. Ngaphandle kwezolimo, ngeke kube nezimpahla, ukudla, noma izindlu. Ukuhweba kubalulekile ezimpilweni zethu; ngaphandle kwezolimo, ngeke kube nezinto eziningi emhlabeni. Ngiyabonga!" Ngiyacela ubuye futhi ubonise abanye abangakaze babone isifundo sakho. Bazothokoziswa futhi lapho bebona lokho engikubonile namuhla. Bekuyisithombe!" Abalimi baqinisekisa ukuthi izilwane zikhuliswa kahle futhi basikhombisa ukuthi umhlaba ubalulekile ezimpilweni zethu. Abantu kufanele banakekele imithombo yemvelo ngoba esikhathini esizayo, ukudla kungaphela - sisebenzisa amathani ayizigidi eziyizinkulungwane eziyi-1 zommbila njalo ngonyaka. Uma siqhubeka kanje, sizobhekana nezinkinga; lokhu kungikhumbuze lezi zinto futhi ngibonge ukuthi sisazitholile!"
