Ukuthuthuka komnotho ezweni kube nehle, futhi kukhona okungaqinisekile mayelana nezimakethe zomhlaba. Kulindeleke ukuthi izinga lokukhula komnotho lizokwehla kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka kusukela ngo-2001. Nakuba umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika uzothinteka ukwehla komnotho kwezwe, isisekelo saso sihlala siqinile futhi izimali zezwe zisesimweni esihle. Ukutshalwa kwezimali kuyakhula, futhi kubonakala ukuthi umnotho uzophinde ukhule. Konke lokhu kunikeza ithemba lokuthi sizophumelela. Ukukhula komnotho wethu akukaze kubonwe eminyakeni engama-50 edlule. Eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, kulindeleke ukuthi izinga lokukhula kube cishe ngu-5%. Kusukela ngo-2001, cishe imisebenzi eyodwa yezigidi idalwe. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezivumela uhulumeni ukuba athuthukise impilo yabantu ezweni lethu: ukukhula komnotho nokuphathwa kahle kwezimali zezwe. Lokhu kuvumele uhulumeni ukuba unikeze abantu izinsiza zokufunda, ezempilo, emalini, ezokwakha, ezokuphepha, ezokuhamba, izinkundla, imigwaqo, neziboshwa. Njengoba umnotho ukhula ngale ndlela, kube nezinkinga esibhekene nazo. Kubonakala ukuthi awekho abaqeqeshiwe abaningi, futhi ugesi ne-cement akanele ukuhlangabezana nezinga lokukhula. Enye inkinga ukuhlinzekwa kwemigwaqo. Ukuze umnotho ukhule ngaphezu kwalokhu, sidinga ukutshalwa kwezimali ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, ezakhiwo, ekuthengeni imishini, imigwaqo, nasemsebenzini. Ngenxa yalezi zinkinga nokwehla komnotho kwezwe, kubonakala ukuthi izinga lokukhula komnotho wethu lizokwehla libe phakathi kuka-4% no-4.5% eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Nakuba lokhu kukhulu uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka emihlanu edlule, kusengumsebenzi omuhle ezweni elinjengeNingizimu Afrika. Kubalulekile, sizophinde silungiselele ikusasa ngokutshalwa kwezimali. Ibhajethi ka-2008 izonikeza imali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bayazuza, ikakhulukazi amadoda athola emalini phakathi kweminyaka engu-60 no-64, ukuze kusekelwe uhlelo lokudla ezikoleni futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zezindawo zokufundela nezibhedlela zinhle. Enye inhloso yale bhajethi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abangena emkhakheni wezokuhamba bathola lezi zinsizakalo, kanye nokutshala imali ezokuhamba zomphakathi kubantu abaningi, ukwandisa amaholo othisha nabahlengikazi, ukwandisa inani labaphoyisa nabagwebi, ukuvuselela iziboshwa, ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bagcine ugesi, nokukhuthaza ukuhweba nokuthekelisa. Sifuna futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni unikeza abantu kahle futhi ukuthi yonke imali echithwa inethonya elihle. Inselelo esibhekene nayo ibalulekile, kodwa uma sisebenza ngokuzikhandla, singathola imiphumela emihle ngokusebenzisa imali kahle nokutshalwa kwezimali ngokucophelela ukuze sikhulise umnotho waleli zwe ngo-6%. Nakuba isisekelo somnotho siqinile, sizobhekana nezinselelo eminyakeni emibili ezayo. Wonke umuntu eNingizimu Afrika kuzodingeka asebenze ngokuzikhandla, futhi labo abenza izinqubomgomo kufanele bacabange kahle. Ngakho-ke, izwe lizophumelela. Sizophumelela. Yini iBhajethi Kazwelonke? Unyaka nonyaka ngoFebhuwari, uNgqongqoshe WezeMali uveza izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokukhiqiza imali, ukuqoqa intela, nezindlela zokubolekwa kwemali eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Lokhu kubizwa ngeBhajethi Kazwelonke. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi uhulumeni uhlela kanjani ukuqoqa imali yentela nokubolekwa kwemali. Ibhajethi kazwelonke ihlukanisa izimali kumaphakheji kahulumeni kazwelonke, ezifundazweni, nasemaphandleni. Ukulungiselela iFIFA World Cup ka-2010 sekuyasebenza. Sakha izinkundla zemidlalo, izikhungo zokuzijabulisa, nezindawo lapho ababukeli bazohlangana khona ukuze babuke imidlalo. Siphucula izinhlelo zokuhamba zabantu abaningi. Konke okukhona mayelana nale midlalo kuyacatshangwa - ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi, ukusakazwa nokuxhumana, indawo yokuhlala yezivakashi, ukuhamba ukuze kuheha izivakashi emadolobheni, nokwenza amadolobha abe muhle. Kukhona futhi ukulungiselela izinsizakalo zezempilo nezinye izinkinga ezingase zivele. Kuzophinde kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphepha nokuqeqeshwa kwababambiqhaza, ukugcinwa kwemvelo, nokuphathwa kwemfucumfucu, kanye nolwazi mayelana nemidlalo nakho konke okukhona ngo-2010, kuhlelwe. Izimali ezengeziwe kufanele zihlukaniswe ukuze zilungiselele ukuhamba kwabantu abaningi abahlangene nemidlalo yeWorld Cup. Ukwanda kwemali yokuxhasa umphakathi engaphezu kuka-12 billion rand kuhlukaniswe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu abadinga usizo emphakathini - abadala, izingane, abakhubazekile, nabangakwazi ukuzisekela. Izimali zihlukaniswa ukuze zisetshenziswe emalini yabadala, izimali zabakhubazekile, izimali zezingane zabazali, nezimali zabantu abadinga usizo. Imali yabadala ibalulekile kakhulu ohlelweni lokuxhasa umphakathi. Kubantu abaningi abathola le mali, rely kuphela kuyo ukuze bathenge ukudla nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Ngenxa yalokhu, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokwandisa le mali ngo-69 billion rand ukuze amadoda nawo akwazi ukuzuza kusukela eminyakeni engu-60, njengenjengabafazi. Ngo-2008/2009, izimali zezimali zabadala zizokhuphuka zibe ngu-9.6 billion rand, okuyi-10 percent yemali echithwa uhulumeni. Lokhu kwenza iNingizimu Afrika ibe enye yamazwe ahamba phambili ekubhekaneni nezidingo zabantu abadinga usizo. Kukhona nezinye izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisiza abadinga usizo. Izingane ezithola usizo lwezempilo azikhokhi imali yesikole. Izingane ezinezakwabo ezinzima nazo azikhokhi imali yesikole. Izingane zonke ezingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu azikhokhi ezikhungweni zokwelashwa noma ezibhedlela uma zikhuluma, futhi bonke abathola usizo lwezempilo basizwa ezibhedlela uma belimele futhi bengenayo inshurensi yezempilo.
Uphenyo Lokuvuza Kwamaphepha Kamatikuletsheni Isingeniso Uphenyo lokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni luhambisana nokwanda kokuhlangenwe nakho kwezindaba ezimbi emhlabeni. Ukuvuza, okungukuthi, ukusakazwa kwemininingwane engafanele, kuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu ezimbonini ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezokuphepha, ezemfundo, nezomnotho. Le ncwadi ihlose ukuhlola izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona zokuvikela amaphepha kamatikuletsheni, okungukuthi, imibhalo ebalulekile ethinta izinqubomgomo zomphakathi. Izimbangela Zokuvuza Ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni kungenzeka ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuhweba ngemininingwane engalungile, lapho abantu abavula izinkampani noma izikhungo bangase baphule imithetho yokuvikela imininingwane. Okwesibili, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele ngezindlela zokuvikela nokuphatha amaphepha kamatikuletsheni kungaholela ekuvuzweni. Ekugcineni, izinhlelo zokuphepha ezingasebenzi kahle noma ezindala zingaholela ezinhlekeleleni zokuvuza. Imiphumela Imiphumela yokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni ibalulekile futhi iyingozi. Ukuvuza kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka kwezinhlangano, okungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuthembela kwabantu. Imiphumela yokwephulwa kwemithetho yokuvikela imininingwane ingaholela ezijezweni ezinzima, okungaholela ekwehleni kwemali. Futhi, ukuvuza kungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu, ikakhulukazi uma imininingwane ethile ingaphathwa kahle. Izixazululo Zokuvikela Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zithathwe. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuphepha kufanele zihlale zisesikhathini futhi zisebenze kahle. Lokhu kusho ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokuvikela imininingwane. Okwesibili, izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha amaphepha kamatikuletsheni kufanele zisetshenziswe, futhi lezi zinqubomgomo kufanele zihlale zihlaziywa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisesikhathini. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi kuzokwandisa ithuba lokuvikela imininingwane. Ukubaluleka Kokuqwashisa Ukuqwashisa ngalesi sihloko kubalulekile. Izinkampani, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni kufanele baqonde ukuthi ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni akuyona inkinga kuphela yokuphepha, kodwa futhi kuyinkinga yokuthembeka. Ukuqwashisa kufanele kuhlanganise ukuxhumana okuhle nabantu ukuze baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokuvuza, okuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha isiko lokuvikela imininingwane. Isiphetho Uphenyo lokuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni luhlobene nezinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuvuza, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zithathwe, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo, izinqubomgomo ezicacile, kanye nokuqwashisa okuhle. Uma zingathathwa lezi zinyathelo, imiphumela yokuvuza ingaba yingozi, hhayi kuphela ezinkampanini kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokuhlola izindlela zokuvikela imininingwane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuvuza kwamaphepha kamatikuletsheni kuyinto eyaziwayo futhi engavunyelwe. Ukuvikela imininingwane kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile kubo bonke abantu.
Umculo We-Gospel: Umthombo Wokukhanya Nezinto Eziwusizo Umculo we-gospel unendima enkulu empilweni yamaKristu nabanye abantu abaningi emhlabeni. Lo mculo awugcini nje ngokuculwa ezikhathini ezikhethekile, kodwa unomoya ophilayo ophakathi kwabantu. Njengomuntu okhuluma ngezinto eziningi, ngithanda ukwabelana ngombono wami ngalolu hlobo lomculo, oluhlanganisa izimpilo zethu, uthando, nendlela esihlangana ngayo noMdali. Umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wesikhuthazo esivela kwiBhayibheli, ubonisa izinkolelo zethu nezindlela zokukhuluma, ugcizelela imigomo efana nothando nokubuyisana. Izihlabani ezikhanyayo zalesi siko, njengeMahalia Jackson noYolanda Adams, zaphendula kwiZwi likaNkulunkulu ngezindlela ezicacile. Zama ukuqonda lokho okuvela enhliziyweni, okwakha uxhumano phakathi kwabantu, lapho umculo uvela njengendlela yokukhuluma noMdali. Isiko le-gospel lihlala lisendlini yethu, libonisa ukukhula kokholo, futhi umculo unomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Uthandwa kakhulu emaphandleni nasemiphakathini, uthokozisa abantu abafuna ukuhamba phambili. Umculo we-gospel usiza abantu ukuba bahlale beqinile, naphezu kwezinkinga nempilo enzima, ubonisa indlela yokuphila engcono nezifundo ezivela ezimeni zempilo. Nokho, umculo we-gospel awuhanjiswa kuphela njengokukhuthaza; kukhona izigameko ezithile ezishiya umphumela omubi. Emhlabeni wanamuhla, umculo we-gospel ubhekana nezimo zomnotho, izinkonzo, nemibono ethile. Abaculi baphokophela ukuthola abalandeli abasha, kudinga imibono ethile, ukuze bahlale benguquko. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo we-gospel uthuthuka, uyashintsha, ufinyelela ezingeni elikhulu lokuhlanganiswa. Ukuxhumana kombhali nomzimba we-gospel kudinga ukuhlonishwa, kudinga ukudalwa kwezinkampani, nokwakha amathuba okukhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-gospel usiza abantu ukuba baziqhenye ngezenzo ezinhle, usisiza sithole umqondo omuhle phakathi kwezimo zansuku zonke. Ngalesi sithombe, ngincoma wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi abancane, ukuba baqhubeke becula umculo we-gospel obalulekile. Umculo we-gospel uyakhanya, ufinyelela ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi usikhumbuza ukuthi sikhona, ukhuluma ngothando, umndeni, nempilo. Ngakho-ke, ake sibe nesibindi, sithi 'yebo' kumculo we-gospel. Akufanele kube umculo kuphela; kufanele kube umoya wempilo. Phendukani nizwakalise, nikhumbule ukuhlanganyela umusa, uthando, nemizwa emihle, ukuze sizuze ubuhle bomculo we-gospel, udlule ezithombeni ezinobuhlobo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuhlanganisweni kokholo nobuhle, umoya ophilayo phakathi kwezimo, nokwabelana ngemizwa emqoka.
Umvikeli womphakathi usebenza ngokwenza uphenyo oluzimele nolungakhethi ngemva kokuthola ukukhala noma ngokuqhubeka kokuzikhandla. Ukukhala okuhlobene nokuziphatha emsebenzini (ukwehlukanisa nalokho okuhlobene nezinkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa) kumele kuthunyelwe kumphakathi ophakanyisiwe, njengoba umnyango kufanele ube nethuba lokuphendula ekukhala. Uma ungakathumeli ukukhala kumnyango ofanele, uyacelwa ukuthi wenze njalo. Zonke iziteshi zangaphakathi ezikhona kumele zibe khona. Ingabe ufuna ukugcina igama lakho lihlelekile? Yini ukukhala kwakho? Ingabe ubike le ndaba kumunye umnyango noma kumuntu osebenza kwiMasipala? Uma kunjalo, sicela unikeze imininingwane. 2.2 Ingabe ubike umnyango ngokungamukeli isinqumo, ngokukhuphula udaba noma ngokuthatha izinyathelo zokubuyekeza isinqumo? 2.3 Uma impendulo ingu-yes kumanyuvesi aphezulu, sicela unikeze imininingwane. 3.1 Usuku lwezehlakalo. 3. Ingabe umnyango noma umqashi ophathelene nalezehlakalo? Chaza lezehlakalo futhi ufake yonke imininingwane ongayihlinzeka. Ingabe ufuna le ofisi iphenye? Chaza umphumela ofisa ukuwuthola. Ingabe unama-documents noma ubufakazi bokweseka ukukhala noma lokho okukhuluma? Uma impendulo ingu-yes, sicela unikeze amakhophi.
Ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yeGEMS Ngiyavuma futhi ngiyaziqhenya ngokuba yilungu leGEMS, isikhwama esivelele esihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu abaningi. Njengomuntu ozinikele ekuthuthukiseni impilo yami, ngiyazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhambisana nemithetho yesikhwama ukuze ngithole zonke izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuzigcina, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokuhlonipha imithetho nemigomo yeGEMS. Ngihlangabezane nomqondo wokuthi imithetho yesikhwama ayigcini nje ngokuba iziqondiso, kodwa iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sinesibopho sokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukulandela izinqubo zokubhalisela izinsizakalo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthola imishwalense efanele, kanye nokubika izigameko ezithinta impilo yami. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ngihambisana nale mithetho, ngizokwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo eziningi zeGEMS futhi ngizokwazi ukusiza abanye ukuba benze okufanayo. Ngiyaziqhenya ngokuba nekhono lokuqonda imithetho yesikhwama, futhi ngiyazama njalo ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele lapho kudingeka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina amarekhodi ahlanzekile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngiyabika noma yiziphi izinguquko ezithinta impilo yami, kanye nokuxhumana ngokuqondile neGEMS uma ngihlangabezana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo uma kudingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyazi ukuthi ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yeGEMS akukhona nje okwenziwa ngami kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuba ngikhuthaze abanye. Ngikhuthaza abangani bami, umndeni, nabanye engihlangana nabo ukuba bazi imithetho yesikhwama, ukuze nabo bakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezitholakala ngaphansi kweGEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma sonke sithatha isinyathelo sokuhlonipha imithetho, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onobuchule. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngifunde ukuthi ukuzibophezela ekulandeleni imithetho yeGEMS akugcini nje ngokuthola izinzuzo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha isithombe esihle sokuhlonipha. Ngiyaziqhenya ngokuba yilungu leGEMS, futhi ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngihambisana nemithetho nemigomo ebekwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujabulela izinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo uma kudingeka. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ngihlonipha imithetho, ngizokwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezitholakala ngaphansi kweGEMS, futhi ngizokwazi ukusiza abanye ukuba benze okufanayo. Lokhu kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi onobuchule. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngihambisana nemithetho, ngithuthukise impilo yami, futhi ngisize abanye.
### Ukhetho Lukazwelonke: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini ukhetho lukazwelonke? Impendulo: Ukhetho lukazwelonke wumcimbi obalulekile lapho izakhamizi zensimu zikhuluma ngezithakazelo zazo. Kulolu suku, abantu bavota ukuze bakhethe abamele izindawo ezahlukahlukene, njengokhetho lwesikhathi eside lwezombusazwe, amalungu ePhalamende, kanye noMongameli. Lokhu kwenzeka njalo eminyakeni ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ithuba lokuzwakalisa imicabango yabo. --- Umbuzo 2: Kungani ukhetho lukazwelonke l важно? Impendulo: Ukhetho lukazwelonke lubalulekile ngoba luhlinzeka abantu ithuba lokuthatha izinqumo mayelana nokuhlelwa kwabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu bangakhetha abaholi abazobaphathisa imfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izifiso nezidingo zabantu zifakwa phambili, futhi abaholi benziwa balalele izidingo zabantu. --- Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle? Impendulo: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezicacile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezaziso ezanele ukuze abantu bazi isikhathi sokhetho. Okwesibili, kugcinwa ukulungiselela kahle emaphandleni, kuhlanganise nezindawo zokuvota ezikhangayo. Okwesithathu, izikhungo zokuvota kufanele zibe nezisebenzi eziqeqeshiwe ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu lapho kudingeka, futhi kube nezinsiza ezithile zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bavote. --- Umbuzo 4: Yini efanele ukuba ibhekwane ngayo ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho? Impendulo: Ngaphambi kosuku lokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi bangavota kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi bhaliswe kanjani, izindawo zokuvota, kanye nezidingo zokuvota. Abantu kufanele bahlale besondelene nezindaba ukuze bazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlelo ezikhona nezikhala ezithile ezishiwo ngabaholi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile. --- Umbuzo 5: Kuthiwani uma abantu behluleka ukuvota? Impendulo: Uma abantu behluleka ukuvota, lokho kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphumeleni yokhetho. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni uhulumeni ongawrepresenti kahle izidingo zabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhangiso zikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavote, futhi zifake izinyathelo ezizokwenza kube lula kubo ukuvota. --- Umbuzo 6: Kutheni kubalulekile ukuba nezikhangiso nezokuxhumana ngalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Izikhangiso nezokuxhumana zibalulekile ukuze zikhuthaze abantu ukuthi bavote. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinsiza ezingabavumela ukuthi bakhethe kahle. Izikhangiso ezihlelekile zidingeka ukuze zibe nezithombe ezicacile zabaholi, izinhlelo zabo, nezizathu zokuvota. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kuzobanjwa kanjani ukhetho. --- Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezokhetho? Impendulo: Izinselelo ezibhekene nezokhetho ziningi. Zingase zibe ukuvota okungaphelele, ukuthengisa kwezikhangiso ezingalungile, nokungabi nalwazi olufanele. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuba abantu benze izinqumo ezicacile. Ubufakazi bokukhetha obuphelele nezinqubomgomo ezinqala zidinga ukuba ziqinise ukuze kuhlangabezane nalezi zinselelo. --- Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngezinqumo zomphakathi ngemuva kokhetho? Impendulo: Ngemuva kokhetho, izinqumo zomphakathi zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezingxoxo ezithile, ukufundwa kwezinhlelo ezitholakele, nokuhlinzekwa kwamathuba okukhuluma. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bayakwazi ukuba bahlale bexhumene nezakhamizi zabo, futhi bakhulume ngalezi zinto. --- Umbuzo 9: Yini eyenzekayo uma umuntu ethola amavoti amaningi? Impendulo: Uma umuntu ethola amavoti amaningi, lokho kubonisa ukuthi abantu bameseka. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi abaholi basizakale ekukhuleni kwezinto ezithile ezifana nezemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha. Abaholi bazokwazi ukusiza izakhamizi zabo ngezinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuba abantu baphile kahle, futhi kube nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo. --- Umbuzo 10: Ngabe ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlaluka? Impendulo: Yebo, ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlala lusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqhubeke nokuvota ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukhetho oluqhubekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube khona ukuqhubeka komphakathi, futhi kuzokwenza kube nezinguquko ezizokwenza impilo ibe ngcono emiphakathini. --- Ukhetho lukazwelonke yisikhathi sokuhlola imiphumela yokuthandwa kwabantu. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe neqhaza, sikhuthaze abanye, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izifiso zethu zivele zikhona. Ukhetho alukona nje umcimbi; luyindlela yokwakha ikusasa lethu.
Ukuhlaziywa Kohlelo Lokondla Ezikoleni: Iphrofayela KaSipho Mthembu USipho Mthembu, oneminyaka engu-35 ubudala, ungumfundisi ophumelelayo osemkhakheni wezokudla nezokondla. Uthole iziqu zakhe kwiNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho afunda khona iBSc in Nutrition and Dietetics. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uSipho waqala umsebenzi wakhe ezikoleni, eholwa umgomo wokuthuthukisa impilo nezinhloso zokufunda zabafundi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waphawula ukuthi uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlukumezeka. Abafundi abaningi babebhekene nezinkinga zokudla, okuholela ekutheni bahlupheke ezifundweni zabo. Lokhu kwakhuthaza uSipho ukuba aqale ukuhlaziya uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni, ukuze abone ukuthi yini engathuthukiswa. Uhlolo lwakhe lwokuqala lwagxila ezindaweni ezithile, njengokwakheka kokudla, izinga lokudla okukhona, kanye nezidingo zezingane ezihlukene. USipho wathola ukuthi izikole eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile zokondla, ezingahlangabezani nezidingo ezithile zabafundi. Lokhu kubangele ukuthi abanye abafundi baphumelele kancane ezifundweni zabo, ngenxa yokuntuleka kokudla okunempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waqala ukubambisana nezikole ezahlukene, esebenzisa ulwazi lwakhe ukuze anikeze izeluleko eziphusile. Waqala uhlelo lokuqwashisa abafundi, abathintekayo, nabazali ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokudla okunempilo. Waphinde wathuthukisa uhlelo lokondla olwakhelwe abafundi, olwakhiwe ngokuqondile ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabo. Uhlelo lukaSipho lwakhelwe phezu kwemigomo emibili ebalulekile: ukudla okunempilo nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhuba yokudla. Lokhu kwavumela abafundi ukuba baqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izithako ezidingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Uhlelo lwakhe luhlanganisa ukudla okwenziwe ngezithako ezisemqoka, okukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bathande ukudla okunempilo. Uhlanga lwezinhlelo zikaSipho lwabandakanya izifundo ezihlukene, ezihlanganisa imikhuba yokudla, izifundo zokupheka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo. Uhlelo lwakhe lwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokudla okunempilo, futhi lukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali. U-Sipho uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhumana nabazali, ukuze babambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni imikhuba yokudla emakhaya. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abazali bayazi ukuthi ukondla kahle izingane zabo kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokukhula kwazo, futhi ukuthi imikhuba yokudla ibalulekile empilweni yazo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi imiphumela yohlelo lokondla ezikoleni ibonakala. Abafundi baqala ukukhula ngokomzimba, futhi izinga lokusebenza kwabo ezifundweni lenyuka. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi uSipho wathola izindondo eziningi ngenxa yemizamo yakhe. U-Sipho ungumholi othembekile, ohlala elwela impilo engcono yebanga labafundi. Uhlanga lwakhe lokondla lwenza kube lula ukufinyelela impumelelo, futhi uthanda ukwabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye. Ubuye abe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokondla ezikoleni, futhi ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi. U-Sipho uhlala eqhubeka nokusebenza ekuthuthukiseni uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni, futhi unethemba lokuthi izikole eziningi zizokwamukela izinhlelo zakhe. Ubonisa ukuthi ukondla kahle akukhona kuphela ukudla, kodwa futhi kuwumgomo wokwakha impilo enempilo, ethuthukisa imiphumela yokufunda, futhi igqugquzela ukwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngokubambisana nabanye othisha, abezindaba, nezikhungo zokondla, uSipho uqhubeka nokwakha umkhankaso ophumelelayo wokuthuthukisa uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni. Ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungalungisa izinkinga zokudla, futhi ubaluleka kokubambisana ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho uzoba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile labafundi, futhi uzohlala esebenzela impilo engcono yezehlakalo. Uhlelo lwakhe lokondla ezikoleni luhlobene kakhulu nezidingo zabafundi, futhi lukhombisa ukuthi ukondla kahle kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ozinikele, onobuhlakani, futhi onothando lokuthuthukisa impilo yabafundi, futhi uzohlala edlondlobala emkhakheni wezokondla.
Ngicela usizo lwakho kanye nokubandakanywa kwehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-influenza A (H1N1) 2009 pandemic emphakathini wethu. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni lalesi sifo nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa njenge-swine flu ngoba kwakholelwa ukuthi kuvela ezinkukhu. Manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi umthombo walo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, lesi sifo asinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sesibizwa nje ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngamagama ayo asemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka, leli gciwane lisabalalile ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalalile ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane lihlasele abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. ENingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile izimo ezingu-2,844 ezinezingozi eziyisithupha. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo okwenzeka ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi leMvelo Yezempilo (WHO) lathola ukuthi izimfuneko zokumemezela lesi sifo njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke sezihlangatshezwa, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni le ndaba njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi lesi sifo sesisabalalile ezweni lonke ezindaweni zikaWHO futhi senzeke ngokushesha. Nokho, ngithanda ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi lesi sifo sinezinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi siqhubeka nokusabalala kuyo yonke indawo. Ngomhla kaJulayi 6, iWHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwe-pandemic kulezi zizwe ezithintekile kanye nezizwe ezintsha njengokungamukeleki nokungabambeki. Ngaphandle kwalokho, yaphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abahlaselwe yileli gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasekhaya, sikhathazekile ngempilo yokufa okwenzekile kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abahlaselwe eNingizimu Afrika). I-virus ithinta ikakhulukazi abantu abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-10 no-29 - abaningi babo bangabafundi noma baphakathi kwezemfundo ephakeme. IWHO icele ukuthi amazwe athintekayo agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela waleli sifo emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Lesi sifo sithunyelwa ngeziphuzo zomoya, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu ophilayo ekhwehlela noma ethukile, uphuzisa lezi ziphuzo abezikhwethile noma abekwe ngaphandle. Noma uma bekhwehlela endaweni eqinile, ungase uphuzise umoya lapho ungahlaselwa khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banokuphazamiseka okuncane futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onezimpawu ezilula noma ezinzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokunconywa udokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka emlabasini ocwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwenzeka manje emkhakheni wezempilo yangasese, kodwa akukona okudingwa yiWHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe izimo ezithintekayo ngokwezimfuneko zokudlulisa ulwazi (ama-protocols) anikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela ekutholeni imiphumela engcono yokwelashwa uma lo muthi usebenza futhi kungavimbela labo abangakwazi ukusindisa izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi olukhona emhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwesifo. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kunconywa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umqashi onokuphazamiseka okuncane kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi kanye/noma othisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenza ndawonye nezikhungo zezempilo ukuze anikeze izeluleko ngezinyathelo ezifanele ezithathwayo. Uma unokuphazamiseka okuncane, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabantu. Ngithanda ukubonga isikhathi osithathile ukufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuhlanganyela kwakho okulindelekile ekusakazeni ulwazi nasekunciphiseni umthelela waleli sifo.
Izinqubo zamacala amakhulu enkohlakalo Izenzo zokukhwabanisa, noma enkohlakalweni, ziqukethe izenzo eziyingozi ezithinta impilo yomphakathi nezomnotho. Amacala amakhulu enkohlakalo avame ukwenzeka ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengezikhungo zikamasipala, ezinkampanini ezinkulu, kanye nasezikhungweni zikGovernment. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinqubo, kufanele sihlole ukuthi yiziphi lezi zinyathelo ezithathwa ekuhloleni nasekuphenduleni amacala enkohlakalo. 1. Ukuthola Ubufakazi Inqubo yokuqala yokubhekana namacala enkohlakalo iwukuthola ubufakazi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqoqa imininingwane ebalulekile efanele ukuphikisana noma ukusekela icala. Ubufakazi bungahlanganisa imibhalo, ubufakazi bokuqonda, nezinsizwa ezikhuluma ngemicimbi eyenzeka. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphenyisi baqoqe ubufakazi obuqinile ukuze bahlolisise ngokucophelela. 2. Ukuhlola Ubufakazi Ngemuva kokuthola ubufakazi, abaphenyisi bahlola le mibhalo ukuze bazi ukuthi iyasebenza yini. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izincwadi zomthetho, izinkampani ezithintekayo, kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukuhlola ubufakazi kudinga ubuchule obukhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bahlala benokuthula. 3. Ukuqhamuka Kwezinsolo Uma ubufakazi buphakanyisiwe, abaphenyisi baphawula izinsolo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kubhalwe phansi ukuthi yiziphi izenzo zokukhwabanisa ezenziwe. Izinsolo zingase zibe ezinzima, njengezokukhwabanisa imali, noma ezingase zibe lula, njengezokwephula imithetho ethile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinsolo zibhaliwe ngokucacile ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi. 4. Ukuhlola amaNhlangano Ngemuva kokuphakanyiswa kwezinsolo, abaphenyisi bahlola amaNhlangano ahilelekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinkampani, izikhungo zikamasipala, noma abantu abathintekayo. Ukuhlola lezi zindawo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuyaziwa kanjani ukuhamba kwemali nokuthi ngabe abathintekayo bahlala bephila ngokuhambisana nemithetho. 5. Ukuxhumana Nezinkantolo Uma ubufakazi buqinisekisiwe, abaphenyisi bangakhetha ukuhambisa icala ezinkantolo. Lokhu kusebenza njengesinyathelo sokugcina lapho abaphenyisi bebona ukuthi imiphumela yokuhlola iyafaneleka. Ezinkantolo, abezomthetho bazokwazi ukuveza izinsolo eziphakanyisiwe futhi bayephula izinkantolo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abathintekayo bayabuzwa. 6. Izigwebo Nezinqumo Njengoba icala lihamba phambili ezinkantolo, izigwebo zingakhishwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphenyisi, abavela ezinkampanini, nabameli bahlale beqaphele izinqumo ezithathwayo. Izinkantolo zingase zikhupha izigwebo ezinzima, njengezijeziso, noma zicacise ukuthi abathintekayo akufanele bahlawulwe. 7. Ukuqinisekisa Ukuthula Komphakathi Ngemva kokuphothulwa kwenqubo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola ukuthula. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana nezakhamuzi, ukuze kubonakale ukuthi amacala ayahlolwa futhi abathintekayo bayahlawulwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kumphakathi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela ubulungiswa. 8. Ukufunda Nokusungula Izinyathelo Eziphumelelayo Ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwemisebenzi, kubalulekile ukufunda eziphethweni ezitholakele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukucabanga ngezinyathelo ezithathwayo ekuphathweni kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwezinhlangano, nokubhekelela izinqubo zomthetho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zokulwa nekohlakalo zisebenza, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zisetshenziswe ekuphathweni kwezinhlangano ezithintekayo. 9. Ukuhlanganiswa Kwezinsiza Ukubhekana namacala enkohlakalo kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlangano ezihlanganyela, ezifana nohulumeni, ezokuphepha, nezinkampani zomthetho. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza kubalulekile ukuze kuzuzwe imiphumela emihle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amacala ahlolwa kahle. 10. Umphakathi Wokuphila Ngaphandle Kwenkohlakalo Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuba umphakathi uqonde kahle ukuthi ukulwa nekohlakalo akuwona umthwalo kuphela wababusi, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi wonke. Ukuqwashisa ngezinto ezimbi zokukhwabanisa, ukufundisa izakhamuzi ngamalungelo azo, nokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, kuzosiza ekunciphiseni izinga lenkohlakalo. Ngokuhlanganyela, lezi zinyathelo ezingama-10 zikhombisa indlela yokubhekana namacala amakhulu enkohlakalo. Kuhlala kubalulekile ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela iphakanyiswa, izinsolo ziphathwa ngendlela efanele, futhi umphakathi uthola ukuthula. Ngalolu hlelo, singaba nokwazi kahle ukuthi sihamba kanjani phambili ekulweni nalesi sifo sokukhwabanisa esibucayi.
Ukwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni: Ubuqotho Nobuhlobo Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe nemiphakathi eminingi ihlangana khona, ukukhuthazwa nokuqinisekiswa kokwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kuyinto ebalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka isiNgisi nesiZulu, okungukuthi, izilimi ezimbili ezibalulekile kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngalesi sikhathi, sifuna ukugqamisa ubuhle bokusebenzisa lezi zilimi ezimbili, nokuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma ethokozisayo nethokozisayo kubantu bonke. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi isiZulu nezinye izilimi zikhona ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwamasiko namasiko ahlukene. Ukuze sikwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni lokuxhumana elikahle, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuthi bakhulume ngolimi lwabo, nokuthi bakwazi ukubona izinzuzo zokwazi isiNgisi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezi zinto ezimbili kwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi kukhuthaza ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Sikhumbula ukuthi isiZulu sikhuluma ngaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-12 zabantu eNingizimu Afrika, kanti isiNgisi sithathwa njengolimi lwezohwebo, ezemfundo, nezokuxhumana. Ukusekela lezi zilimi ezimbili ezikhungweni kusho ukuthi sithuthukisa ukufinyelela emithonjeni eminingi yokufunda, ezokuxhumana, nezemisebenzi. Izinhlangano ezehlukene, ikakhulukazi ezimayelana nezifundo, zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezingabi sesimeni esithile, ukuze bonke abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula kulwazi nemisebenzi. Njengoba sikhuluma ngokuqinisekiswa kokwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi, kubalulekile futhi ukufaka izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlukahlukene ezikoleni nakwezokusebenza. Ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo ngebhodi lesikole, izincwadi, nezinsizakusebenza kuzo zonke izilimi ezimbili, kungasiza abafundi ukuthi baqonde kahle izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba abafundi baziqhenye ngamasiko abo, baphinde baziqonde kahle izilimi ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamaZulu nabantu abakhuluma isiNgisi, kubalulekile kakhulu. Lokhu kungafaka izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubuhlobo, njengezinkundla zokuxhumana, imicimbi yokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zamasiko. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bahlanganyele, bakhulume, futhi bakhulise ukuqonda okuhle phakathi kwezilimi ezahlukene. Ukusekela isiZulu nesiNgisi kuzokwenza abantu babone ukuthi bahlala bahlukene, kodwa kuyasiza ukuphathelene nokuqonda kwezinkinga ezithile, ezokusebenza, nezinye izimo ezibalulekile. Uma sikhuluma ngalesi simo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi akuhlanganisi kuphela ukufundisa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekuhlonipheni ubuhlobo namasiko. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izilimi zikhuluma ngempilo, ubuhlakani, kanye nezimvo zabantu. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma kulabo abakhuluma isiZulu kanti nabakhuluma isiNgisi, kuyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuvula amathuba okuthi abantu baziqhenye ngamasiko abo, futhi baphinde bazuze emhlabeni jikelele. Ekugcineni, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlonipha izilimi, kodwa futhi kuwumsebenzi onzima wokwakha umphakathi onobuhlakani. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi, ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu emiphakathini yethu. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza, izifundo, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisekelwa isiNgisi nesiZulu kuzoba yindlela eqinile yokwakha umphakathi obumbene, onobudlelwano obumangalisayo. Ngakho, njengoba sikhula emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe nobuchule, akukhona nje ukuba sikhulume ngesiNgisi, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukugqugquzela isiZulu, ukuze wonke umuntu azwe ukuthi uyingxenye yomphakathi obumbene. Ukusekela lezi zilimi eziningi akukhona nje ukuphila kwazo, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlonipha ubuhlobo, ubuhle, nezimvo ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza umhlaba ube indawo engcono yokuhlala, futhi kube nempilo engcono kubo bonke.
Imithetho Nemigomo Yesikhwama Se-GEMS Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku zethu, isikhwama se-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) sithathwa njengomunye wemithombo ebalulekile yokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi lesi sikhwama sakhula kanjani, kubalulekile ukubheka imithetho nemigomo yaso, okwakhiwa ngemuva kokuba kubonakale isidingo esikhulu sokunakekelwa kwezempilo kulabo abakhonza uhulumeni. Isikhwama se-GEMS saqala ukusebenza ngo-2006, sikhuluma ngempilo engcono nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhle kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze sithole lezi zinsiza, kwadingeka ukuthi kube nemithetho nemigomo ecacile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayazi kahle ukuthi angawathola kanjani amalungelo awo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethile, eyayihloselwe ukusiza amalungu akhulise ulwazi lwawo ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Imithetho yokuqala ye-GEMS yayihlanganisa izinqubo ezithile ezazisetshenziswa ukujolisa ekwenzeni kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kwahlanganisa izinqubo zokubhalisela ukujoyina isikhwama, izidingo zokuba yilungu, nezindlela zokukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho yayihlanganisa nezindlela zokuhlola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola izinsiza ezisemthethweni nezifanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa imithetho yayo ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinguquko ezithile, ezifana nokwandisa uhla lwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngama-claims, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe phakathi kwamalungu ne-GEMS. Lezi zinguquko zazihloselwe ukwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwenqubo yokuthola usizo lwezempilo, okwakubalulekile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezikhulayo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa imithetho yayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi amalungu athola izinsiza eziphumelelayo nezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo zihlola izindinganiso eziphakeme, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zihlala zisezingeni eliphezulu, futhi lokhu kwasiza ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi kwenhlangano neziguli. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemthethweni, i-GEMS ibuye yathuthukisa izinhlelo ezihloselwe ukufundisa amalungu mayelana nezempilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlanganisa izihloko ezahlukene, njengezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, ukuvikela izifo, kanye nokubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zazihloselwe ukukhuthaza amalungu ukuba abe nemikhuba emihle yokuphila, ukuze bahlale bephilile. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, i-GEMS yakhulisa izinhlelo zayo zokuxhumana, ukuze amalungu akwazi ukufinyelela kalula emalini yazo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinkundla ezikwi-inthanethi, ezivumela amalungu ukuthi athole ulwazi lwezempilo, abhalisele izinsizakalo, futhi axhumane ne-GEMS kalula. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ayakwazi ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza, i-GEMS yenza izinhlelo ezihloselwe abantu abanezidingo ezikhethekile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho muntu oshiywe ngaphandle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yaphinde yaphendula ezimweni ezithile ezibuhlungu, njengezinhlekelele ezithinta impilo yomphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemithetho emisha yokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola usizo lwezempilo ngokushesha. I-GEMS yaziqhenya ngokuba yisikhwama esiphendulayo, esithatha izinyathelo ezisheshayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, imithetho nemigomo ye-GEMS ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola izinsiza ezisemthethweni nezifanele. Le mithetho ibalulekile ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS namalungu ayo, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Njengoba i-GEMS iqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi imithetho nemigomo yayo ihlale ivuselelwa ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, isikhwama se-GEMS sithokozisa kakhulu, sikhombisa ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezempilo akusizi kuphela abantu, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, okukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Imithetho nemigomo yaso ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemthethweni, futhi lokhu kuhlangene nesifiso sokwakha ikusasa elingcono kubantu bonke.

Abadlali Abasebasha: Umthwalo Wokukhula Nempumelelo Ngaphakathi kwezwe lethu, abadlali abasebasha bahlala bejabulisa izinkundla zomjaho, bephakamisa izifiso zabo zokuba yizinkanyezi emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Lezi zinsizwa nezintombi, ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-12 no-18, zikhombisa ikhono elikhulu emikhakheni ehlukene, kusukela emijaho, ibhola, kuze kube kumidlalo yeqembu efana ne-rugby nebhola lezinyawo. Lokhu kukhula kwabadlali abasebasha akukhombisi kuphela amandla abo kodwa futhi kubonisa umoya wokuzinikela, uthando, kanye nomsebenzi owenziwa ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo. Izifundo Zokuphila Abadlali abasebasha bahlala befunda izifundo ezibalulekile, hhayi kuphela emidlalweni kodwa nasempilweni. Ukuzikhandla, ukuzimisela, kanye nokubekezela kuyizinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka. Umphakathi ubona lezi zinsizwa zisebenza kanzima ukuze zifinyelele izinjongo zazo, zifunda ukuthi ukuphumelela kudinga isikhathi, umzamo, kanye nezifundo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kunceda abadlali ukuba bakhe izimiso ezinhle empilweni yabo, okungaholela ekutheni babe neqhaza elihle emiphakathini yabo. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Noma kunjalo, abadlali abasebasha babhekana nezithiyo eziningi. Ukuncintisana okukhulu, ukucindezeleka, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nemidlalo kungaba yizinto ezinzima. Abanye abadlali bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokuphumelela, okungaholela ekutheni baphazamiseke emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokweseka abadlali, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha lezi zinkinga ngendlela efanele. Izinhlelo zokweluleka, ezihlanganisa abaqeqeshi, abazali, kanye nabanye abadlali, zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abadlali abasebasha bayakwazi ukuphila impilo enempilo, ngaphandle kokucindezeleka. Ukwesekwa Komphakathi Umphakathi udlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isisekelo sokuphumelela kwabadlali abasebasha. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokudlala, imitholampilo, kanye nezinsiza zokuqeqesha kubalulekile. Izikhungo zemidlalo, izikole, kanye nemiphakathi zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu ukuze abadlali bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nabantu ngabanye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abadlali abasebasha bakwazi ukusebenzisa amathuba abo ngokuphelele. Imiphumela Yokuphumelela Abadlali abasebasha abaphumelela emidlalweni baveza umphumela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ukuphumelela kwabo akugcini nje ngokuhlonishwa emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka, kodwa kuthuthukisa futhi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokuhlanganyela emiphakathini, okukhuthaza abanye ukuba basebenzise isikhathi sabo ngendlela efanele. Abadlali abanempumelelo bahlala bejabulisa, bephakamisa umoya wabantu, futhi bebonisa ukuthi imisebenzi emihle ingaholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Izinkanyezi Zesikhathi Esizayo Njengoba abadlali abasebasha beqhubeka nokukhula, umphakathi unethemba lokuthi bazoba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka. Abaningi babo bahlala bejolisa ezingeni eliphezulu, beqeqeshwa ukuze baphumelele ezingeni lempumelelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi babe nomoya wokuzimisela, futhi bazi ukuthi impumelelo idinga isikhathi, umsebenzi, kanye nokuzinikela. Umphakathi unethemba lokuthi lezi zinsizwa zizokwenza kahle, zikhulise izimpumelelo zazo, futhi zibe yisibonelo esihle kubanye. Isiphetho Abadlali abasebasha bahlala benza umehluko omkhulu emiphakathini yabo. Ngenxa yokusebenza kanzima, ukuzimisela, kanye nomoya wokubambisana, bahlala bejabulisa izinkundla zomjaho. Umphakathi udinga ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oluqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abadlali basebasha bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Njengoba besebenzisa amathuba abawatholayo, bahlala bejabulisa, bephakamisa umoya wabantu, futhi bebonisa ukuthi impumelelo iyatholakala uma uzinikele. Njengoba behamba phambili, umphakathi unethemba lokuthi abadlali abasebasha bazoba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wezokungcebeleka.
Njengoba siphakathi kwephondo leKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukubona intuthuko esiyenzile emizamweni yokubuyisela isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko kanye nokubamba kwabo iqhaza kuzo zonke izici zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lezakhamuzi. Umphathi wohlelo, ovela emphakathini waseMalangeni, ubonisa ukuthi ukuba lapha kusinika injabulo enkulu ngoba indawo yaseMalangeni inembali ejulile. Le ndawo iyindawo yokuzalwa kweNkosi uShaka ka Senzangakhona. Sazi futhi ukuthi amaqhawe amaningi aphumelele eEmalangeni. Futhi kule ndawo, emindenini eminingi, abantu baphunyukile ezweni labo elicebile. Nakuba kukhona izahluko ezingezinhle emlandweni wale ndawo, ilanga liqhubeka likhanya eEmalangeni. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa kwenkosi yethu lapha kwenzeka emuva kwesizinda esikhulu somlando ngesikhathi esibalulekile lapho ubuholi bendabuko buhamba phambili, buya phambili kunakuqala. Lezi zinguquko zifaka phakathi ukubuyiselwa kobuholi bendabuko kanye nokuphatha kwabo ezimpandeni zabo, ngokwemikhuba yendabuko. Siphakathi lapha namuhla sinesiqiniseko sokuthi nakuba ukuhlongozwa kwenkosi yethu kuwumcimbi obalulekile ohambisana nenjabulo nokuqhakambisa isiko, kuhlanganisa nomthetho, ukuphatha ngendlela efanele, kanye nokubaluleka kokugcina isiko. Isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sikhishwe kakhulu yizimiso ezahlukene zik government ezazikhona ngaphambili. Kodwa manje lesi simo siyashintsha. Uhulumeni wesizwe omusha uhlose ukuhlinzeka abaholi bendabuko ngamathuba okwakha uhlelo lokususa umthelela wezinhlelo eziphazamisa nezokucwasa esakhiweni sobuholi bendabuko. Ndawonye sisebenza kanzima ukufinyelela lapho sikhona namuhla. Okwamanje, siphakathi kwenqubo yokwakha umthetho ozotholwa ezingeni lephondo mayelana nabaholi bendabuko nokuphatha, futhi uzobhekana nezindaba ezithinta thina ngqo njengesifunda. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kube ukwephula umthethosisekelo kazwelonke. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume kahle izinto. Ngivumele ukuthatha leli thuba ukuqala ngokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile zamasiko mayelana nomcimbi wokuhlonishwa kwenkosi. Nakuba kuzobe kusekhona umthetho ophakanyisiwe ephondweni ozohlinzeka ngemininingwane ngalokhu. Kodwa ngifingqa, ngingasho lapha ukuthi umndeni wezakhamuzi uhlangabezane nomsebenzi wawo ngokukhetha uNkosi uNgcobo njengenkosi yesizwe saseMalangeni. Okwazozayo ukuthi indlela yendabuko izophelelwa uIsilo SamaBandla, lapho kuzoba khona nendlela yethu endala yokuhlanganyela amanzi. Le mikhuba ibalulekile kakhulu ngoba inkosi iyona ekhonzayo amakhosi, futhi amakhosi nawo akhonza inkosi. Le mikhuba sifisa ukuba ihlonishwe, futhi sikhuthaza wonke amakhosi ukuba ahloniphe le mikhuba. Angazi ukuthi bangaki bethu abazi noma basakhumbula lezi zinkolelo, njengoba ingxenye enkulu yesiko lethu lendabuko ilahlekile eminyakeni edlule. Ngiyakwazi ukusho ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile ekuvuselelweni kwesithunzi samakhosi. Ngiveze izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye esizithathile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sithola indawo yaso efanele. Le mizamoyihlanganisa ukuthi ekugcineni, indima yamakhosi ekuletheni intuthuko iyahlonishwa. Sazi ukuthi uNkosi uNgcobo kanye nekhansela lakhe, kanye namanye amakhosi, njengengxenye yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko, sebesebenzile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa, ngakho manje iOndabezitha iyamenywa ukuphatha ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukuze baxhumane futhi basebenzisane nezakhiwo zikamasipala ukuze kube nezinqumo ezisheshayo zokuletha intuthuko emiphakathini yamakhosi. Uhulumeni ukholelwa ukuthi intuthuko nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kungasheshiswa ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yamakhosi kanye nezikhulumeli ezikhethwe. Imizamo kaNkosi uNgcobo ekuletheni intuthuko kule ndawo, ngiyakholelwa nonke niyazi. Akukho shwa ngokuqinisekile ngokuqhubeka kwenkosi ekuletheni intuthuko. I-IDP, sibona izoba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu ngokusheshisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Sonke sibona ukuthi nakuba inkosi izama, isikhundla senkosi, njengezinye eziningi, sishayeke emsebenzini wokulethwa kwezinsiza zentuthuko. Lesi simo asivumelekile. Njengohulumeni, sikholelwa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uthuthuke ngokulinganayo; akufanele kube nezinsimu zecala phakathi kokuhlupheka nokungabi nalutho. Futhi akufanele kube nabantu abaphila kahle kakhulu kanti abanye bahlupheka kakhulu. Lesi simo umasipala kufanele asicwaninge futhi alungise ngokubambisana namakhosi kanye nekhansela zabo. Ngiveze indima yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko ekuletheni intuthuko; kufanele sibe nesithunzi semisebenzi yabo emicimbini yomlando esilethele lapho sikhona namuhla. Umlando usitshela ukuthi ekuvikeleni abantu babo, amasiko, nezwe, amakhosi amaningi, kuhlanganise nalabo abavela kulezi zintaba nezindunduma, bathatha izikhali ukuze balwe nokucwaswa. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, asikwazi ukukhohlwa ubuholi bukaBhambatha kaMancinza, owayenqotshwa yizikhali zesimanje zabahlaseli, kodwa waphonsa isisekelo sokukhululeka nentando yeningi esiyijabulelayo namuhla. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa kwenkosi uNgcobo namuhla kuqinisa ukuqhubeka kwesikhumbuzo sobuholi obuhlala buhamba nezinye izinkosi eziningi kule phondo kanye nezifiso zabo zokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Umphathi Wohlelo, uhulumeni wethu ubaluleka kakhulu kumakhosi, hhayi ngoba bangabaphethe bamasiko nemikhuba yendabuko kuphela, kodwa futhi ngoba bamele ingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kwentando yeningi esekelwe kumthethosisekelo. Kuye kwaba yinto ebalulekile kuhulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko ziqiniswa. Uhulumeni weKwaZulu-Natal ukholelwa ukuthi kudingeka ukuvikelwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuthuthukiswa kokuba khona kwabaphathi bendabuko kanye nezikhulumeli ezikhethwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu bethu. Iqiniso ukuthi njengelizwe kanye nephondo, sithola izinguquko ezinkulu kwezomnotho nasemphakathini. Siphila eNingizimu Afrika lapho intando yeningi nentuthuko manje seziqhulwini. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungumholi wendabuko, umphakathi, noma uMphakathi wePhalamende, unendima ebalulekile futhi edingekayo ekufezeni umgomo wethu wokukhulula abantu emsebenzini, endlaleni, nasekuphatheni. Ukuhlongozwa kweOndabezitha uMapholoba namuhla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni egxile kakhulu ekubuyiseleni ithemba kubantu bethu emiphakathini. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kweziteshi zokuxhumana phakathi kukamasipala nezakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko. Akukho shwa ukuthi ukusungulwa kwempumelelo kweziteshi zokubambisana phakathi kwezinga lempilo yomphakathi kuzoholela ekulethweni kwezidingo ezisemqoka futhi kuzosheshisa ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yokuphila kwabantu basemaphandleni. Ukushoda Kukagesi: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokushoda kukagesi zibe yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, zishiya izakhamuzi nezimboni zibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Lokhu kushoda kukagesi, okwaziwa ngokuthi "load shedding," kuhlobene nezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezanele, ukuguga kwemishini, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Isizathu Sokushoda Kukagesi Okwamanje, i-Eskom, okuyinkampani enkulu yokuhlinzeka ngogesi eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuphatha. Ukungabi khona kokutshalwa kwezimali okwakudingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhungo zokukhiqiza ugesi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwemithombo, kubangele ukuncipha kokukhiqizwa kukagesi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zezulu ezinjengemvula encane ziye zathinta kakhulu ukukhiqizwa kukagesi, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezisebenzisa amalahle. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kukagesi Imiphumela yokushoda kukagesi ibonakala ezimpilweni zabantu, emnothweni, nasezindaweni zokusebenza. Izakhamuzi zikhathazekile ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kokuphila kwansuku zonke, njengoba ukushoda kukagesi kuholela ekunciphiseni kokusebenza kwezinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana namakhaya, izikole, nezibhedlela. Izimboni nazo zikhathazekile, njengoba ukungabi khona kukagesi kuholela ekwehleni kokukhiqiza, okuthinta umnotho jikelele. Izixazululo Zokushoda Kukagesi Ukuze kuqedwe le nkinga, kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom ithuthukise izinhlelo zayo zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni izikhungo zokukhiqiza ugesi. Ukutshalwa kwezimali ezinsizeni ezintsha, ezifana nezinsiza ezisebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, kungasiza ekunciphiseni ukuncika kumalahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokonga ugesi zingasiza ekunciphiseni umthwalo. Izakhamuzi zingakhuthazwa ukuba zisebenzise izindlela zokonga ugesi, njengokusebenzisa izibani ezisebenza kahle, kanye nokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi ngezikhathi ezithile. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokonga ugesi. Ukubambisana Nezinkampani Zangaphandle Ukubambisana nezinkampani zangaphandle ezikhiqiza ugesi kungaba enye indlela yokuthola izixazululo. Izinkampani ezisebenza emhlabeni jikelele zinezindlela ezithuthukile zokukhiqiza ugesi, futhi ukusebenzisana nazo kungasiza i-Eskom ukuthola izixazululo eziphusile nezisebenzayo. Isiphetho Ukushoda kukagesi kuyinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa ngezinqumo eziphusile nezinhlelo ezinhle, le nkinga ingaxazululwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezakhamuzi basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuthuthukiswe izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinokuthula, lapho wonke umuntu engathola khona ugesi ngendlela efanele.
Ngiyajabula ukukhuluma ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, elihlangana sesikhulumi sokugcina sePhalamende lethu lesithathu, elibusa ngenhloso yabantu. Ngimi phambi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlonipha ngalesi sikhathi lapho ngithola ithuba lokuba ehhovisi eliphezulu elizweni ngenxa yesimo esikhethekile esavela esinqumweni seqembu elibusayo sokukhipha uMongameli owayekhona ehhovisi. Umsebenzi wami ezinyangeni ezedlule bekungukuhola iZikhulu zezwe ekufezeni umyalo onikezwe iAfrican National Congress ezivotelweni zika-2004 nokulungiselela izivoti ezizayo. Lokhu siqinisekisile ukuguqulwa okungaphazamiseki ezinyangeni eziyisihlanu ezedlule futhi siqhubeka nezinhlelo zikahulumeni, kubonga ukukhula kwendlela yethu yokwakha umthethonqubo, okubonakala ngokubambisana kwamalungu amasha namadala eZikhulu zezwe kanye nokwesekwa okuqinile kwabaphathiswa bethu. Ngokubheka emuva ezinyangeni eziyishumi nanhlanu ezedlule, ngifisa ukubonga ukuzinikela nomsebenzi onzima kaMongameli uNelson Mandela noThabo Mbeki, kanye nabesifazane nabantu abaningi ababe nendima ekuphatheni le ndiza kahulumeni ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu: ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha, emthethweni ezindaweni ezintathu zikahulumeni, nasezinkantolo; beqhuba ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abanye baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ngimi phambi kwenu ngokuqhakazile nangokholo lokuthi le Ningizimu Afrika esiyigubha namuhla, enezindawo ezihlukahlukene nezihlukaniso, izingxabano, nezikhalazo ezedlule ezinyangeni eziyishumi nanhlanu, kuyimiphumela yomsebenzi nokuzinikela kwabantu besifazane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Laba baseNingizimu Afrika bamele ithemba nokubekezela, bebonisa isizwe sethu. Phakathi kwabo kukhona abanye baseNingizimu Afrika abahloniphekile abangabe ngamalungu ePhalamende lethu ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu, esibahluleka kakhulu ngesikhathi sezivoti zonyaka odlule. Lokhu kufaka phakathi uBrian Bunting, uBilly Nair, uNcumisa Kondlo, uJohn Gomomo, uJoe Nhlanhla, uCas Saloojee, uJohn Schippers, noJan van Eck. Ngithanda futhi ukufaka uNkk. Helen Suzman, ongumuntu ophawulekayo waseNingizimu Afrika owamele izindinganiso zePhalamende lethu elisha ePhalamende elidala. Laba bantu nabanye abavela ezweni lethu bafanele ingxenye enkulu yomvuzo uma sikhuluma ukuthi, naphezu kwanoma yiziphi izikhukhula zezimali esibhekene nazo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinkinga zezimali ezingasithinta, sihlangene ekuguquleni isizwe sethu sibe sesimweni esingcono. Nokho, akufanele sikhulume kancane ngezinselelo esibhekene nazo. Ukuwohloka kwamandla omnotho emhlabeni kubeka umnotho wethu engcupheni enkulu ngenxa yokulahlekelwa kwemisebenzi nezinga lokuphila kwabantu bethu. Ngokuvamile, ukungaqiniseki mayelana nezinguquko zezombusazwe kungaphakamisa imibuzo eminingi kunalokho esinazo izimpendulo okwamanje. Ngenxa yalokhu, abanye bethu bahlushwa ukukhathazeka okwesikhashana kulolu shintsho lwezomnotho nokungaqondi kwezombusazwe. Kodwa thina sihamba ngendlela yethemba nokubekezela. Singasho nokuthi, ngethuba elikhethekile, izinto eziningi zohlelo lwethu lokwakha umthethonqubo zihlolwe phakathi nalesi sikhathi esedlule; futhi zonke zidlule ekuhlolweni ukuze zikhombise ubudlelwano obuphakeme bokhetho. Uhulumeni wethu weDemokhrasi uphila. Kancane kancane, ukhula uqine, uqinisekiswe yiMthethonqubo engafani nezinye emhlabeni. Ngempela, amandla okuzibandakanya kwezombusazwe kule nkathi yokhetho azodinga ukuba ahlonipheke futhi athule njengesiqinisekiso sokuphila okuqhubekayo nokujulile kukahulumeni wethu weDemokhrasi. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baqinisekise intuthuko yayo; bona futhi bangabavikeli ohulumeni bethu beDemokhrasi ezinsukwini ezizayo. Ngivumele, Mphakathi noMhlonishwa uSihlalo, kulokhu ngifuna ukugcizelela bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanelungelo lokubhalisela ukuvota ezivotweni zendawo nezasezifundazweni, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha isimo sethu lapho sifuna ukufinyelela khona. Kumele sikwenze lokhu ezinsukwini zokusebenza ezibhalwe emahhovisi omasipala, ngaphambi kokuthi uhlu lokubhaliswa kwabavoti luvalwe. Kumele futhi sisebenzise iWeekend ekhethekile yokubhaliswa ehlelwe yiKomidi Lezokhetho kusasa nangeSonto, 7 no-8 kuMfumfu. Kumele ngithathe leli thuba ukukwazisa ukuthi ezinsukwini ezizayo ngizophetha izingxoxo neKomidi Lezokhetho kanye nabaphathiswa bezifundazwe bese ngimemezela usuku lokhetho. Siphila ngokwakho njengohulumeni weDemokhrasi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 1994, okokuqala ngokubambisana ukuthatha ikusasa labo ezandleni zabo. Ngaleso senzo esilula kodwa esiphelele sokuvota kuhulumeni wabantu bonke bezwe lethu ngembobo, saguqa emuva esikhathini esabukeka sengathi sithukutheleyo njengabantu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele kube kuhle ukuthi kulesi senzakalo sibhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yokwamukelwa kwesitatimende seKomidi Lezomthetho se-OAU eNingizimu Afrika eMbuzweni, eNingizimu Afrika, esamukelwa ngoJuni 1989, esaziwa ngokuthi iHarare Declaration. Lokhu kuzama kwaba isisekelo sokuvumelana komhlaba, ngokusebenzisa iZizwe Ezihlangene, ohlelweni lwezingxoxo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, kwaba yinsika yokwakha iSivumelwano sika-1989 Sokwakha Isimo SeDemokhrasi, okuhlanganisa abantu bezwe bazo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Konke lokhu kuholele ohlelweni lwezingxoxo olwaholela ezivotweni zethu zokuqala zeDemokhrasi ngo-1994. Kulokhu, kumele sibonge uMongameli weAfrican National Congress, uOliver Reginald Tambo, ngokusungula nokuhlola ukuthi kuzosebenza kanjani kubantu bezwekazi kanye nomphakathi womhlaba njengesiqondiso sokuxazulula ngokuthula ukungqubuzana ezweni lethu. Leso sinyathelo esinobuqhawe sokwakha uhlaka oluzofuna ukuthula nokubumbana, esikhundleni sokulwa nokungqubuzana, sithathe isikhathi eside sithathe okwakungelona iqiniso eminyakeni eyikhulu: umphumela weSivumelwano seSizwe sika-1909 esaba uphawu lokwakhiwa kweSewula Afrika. Ngaleso sikhathi, leyo Ndaba yachaza isithombe seNingizimu Afrika njengoba siyazi namuhla, njengoba sasinokucindezelwa ngokobuhlanga nokuhlukaniswa. Ngakho-ke, ezinyangeni eziyishumi nanhlanu zokubusa kwethu kweDemokhrasi, singasho ukuthi ukwesaba, ukungaqiniseki, nokuzonda kwangeminyaka eyikhulu kwenze ukuthula kube nokuhlukana nokungabi nalutho kubaphathi bezwe ababe sebuhlotsheni; kwakungelona nje okungapheli kodwa kwaba ngempela endaweni engalungile. Ukwakhiwa Kwezindlu ze-RDP: Ukuhamba Phambili Kokuhlala Okuhle Ngaphakathi kwezemidlalo zenhlalakahle, ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP (RDP Homes) kube yinkinga ebalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba uhulumeni uqhubeka nezinhlelo zokwakha nezinsiza, abantu abaningi baphuma ezinkingeni zokuhlala eziphansi. Lezi zindlu, ezihloselwe ukusiza abantu abangenamali, zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kanye nokuqinisekisa izinga lokuhlala elingcono. Uhlelo lwe-RDP, olwamiswa ngonyaka ka-1994, luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ngokuphephile naphakathi kwezimali kubantu abahlwempu. Uhlelo lwalusungulwa njengengxenye yomgomo we-ANC wokwakha umphakathi obumbene, lapho abantu bethola ithuba lokuba nekhaya elinempilo. Kulokhu, uhulumeni ubeke izinhlelo eziningi zokwakha, kodwa izithiyo eziningi zisabhekane nalezi zinhlelo. Umphakathi waseThekwini ubonisile izinzuzo zokwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP. Ezindlini eziningi, abantu baveza ukwaneliseka, futhi imiphakathi iyakhula ngokuhlanganyela. UJohn Nkosi, ohlala endaweni ye-Durban North, uthi: "Ngithi ngiyabonga uhulumeni, ngoba umuzi wami wanikeza isithombe esisha sokuphila kahle. Ngiyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo engcono ezinganeni zami." Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izindlu ze-RDP akuzona kuphela izikhala zokuhlala, kodwa zikhombisa umqondo wokwakha umphakathi. Noma kunjalo, zikhona izinselelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nokwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP. Omunye walezi zinselelo ikakhulukazi, yindleko yezinsiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindlu zikhona, uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kusho ukwakha imithombo yokunakekelwa, ezinye izinsiza zomphakathi, nezinsiza zempilo ezisondelene. Ubuye bahlaziywe izinhlelo zokwakha, lapho abanye bezwa ukuthi izindlela zokuphatha izinhlelo azanele. Umphakathi udinga ukubambisana ukuze kuzuze wonke umuntu. Ngokubambisana, abantu bangabhekana nezinkinga ezinzima zokuqashwa nezokwakha. UMnu. Xolani Mthembu, okhulumela umphakathi, uthi: "Uma sisebenzisana namalungu omphakathi, singakwazi ukufinyelela ezilungiselelweni eziningi zabantu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izindlu zakhiwa ngobuqotho." Lokhu kuko kubalulekile emizameni yokwakha izindawo. Uhlelo lwe-RDP lwasungulwa ngenhlosongqangi yokwehlisa izinga lezokuhlala. Njengoba uhulumeni eqhubeka nezinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlangano yempilo iqhubekela phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudala amathuba okwakha ezindlini ezintsha nezokuhlala ezinhle. Ukubuyiselwa kwemali nokwakhiwa kabusha kusuka kumaphrojekthi aqukethe amakliele ezinkampani ezivela ezweni lonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha kufanele zikwamukele imibono yobuchwepheshe obusha, okungaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindlu eziphakeme nezongqondongqondo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe obukhokhelwayo kungakhulula izinsiza zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala endaweni enempilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izindlela ezintsha zokwakha ngabomvu zingabhekana nezinselelo zansuku zonke. Ukukhula komnotho kuholela ekutheni abantu babe nentshisekelo yokuba nezindlu ezithuthukisiwe, ezijabulisayo. Lokhu kwenza umphakathi uqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile. Abahlali bahlala njalo beqhudelana nempilo enempilo, bejolise ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo nesiko labo. Ngendlela efanele yokwakha, okuhloswe ngayo kuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, kuzosiza ekwakheni ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP kumele kuqhubeke nokugxila emiphakathini ukuze kuzuze bonke. UHulumeni, kanye nomphakathi, kumele baqhubeke nokubambisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yalezi zinhlelo. Ngokuqhubeka kwalokhu, sihlose ukufaka izandla ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono, lapho wonke umuntu angaba nendawo yokuhlala engcono. Njengoba uhulumeni eqhubeka nemizamo yakhe, kukhona ithemba lokuthi izindlu ze-RDP zizokwenza umthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Ngakho-ke, sihamba phambili, siphokophele izindinganiso eziphezulu zokuhlala, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza ezithuthukile ezizokwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuvumela abantu bahlala ezindlini ezingafaneleki. Lezi zinhlelo, lapho zisebenziswe kahle, zizoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomnotho kanye nezenhlalakahle, futhi kugcine kukhanya umthombo wokuphila okungcono kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Ukwamukela ingane emhlabeni kuyinto eyinhle, kodwa kukhombisa nezinselele eziningi emndenini nasemiphakathini. Ukuze lezi zingane zikhule kahle, ukunakekelwa kwazo ezibhedlela kubalulekile. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza, amakhono, kanye nezinhlelo zomsebenzi kubalulekile ekunakekeleni izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Izibhedlela kumele zibe nezinsiza eziphelele ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele, okuhlanganisa imishanguzo, izinsiza zokuhlola, kanye nochwepheshe abanolwazi. Ukuhlola izingane ezisanda kuzalwa kufanele kuhlanganise ukuhlola impilo, izimpawu zokukhula, kanye nezidingo ezithile ezifana nokudla, ukuphepha, nokunakekelwa kwempilo. Izibhedlela zidinga ukuba nezinqubo ezilungiselelwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izidingo zengane ziyahlangatshezwa. Ukwamukela ingane ezibhedlela kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabazali, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudingeka ukuze abazali baqonde izinyathelo ezidingekayo ekunakekeleni izingane zabo. Odokotela kumele baqonde ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluyisisekelo kubazali ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezifanele. Izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kufanele zihlale zihambisana nezimo zomphakathi, njengoba izimo zempilo nemvelo yendawo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni nasekuphathweni kwezingane. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa, izibhedlela kufanele zisebenzisane nezikhungo zomphakathi, ezifana nezikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zezemidlalo, nezikhungo zokufundisa, ukuze izingane zithole ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuze zikhule zibe nezempilo. Ngaphezu kwezemfundo, ukuhlonishwa kwezinkolelo zabantu kubalulekile ekunakekelweni kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Izibhedlela kufanele ziqonde izinkolelo zendawo kanye nezidingo zabazali ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela ukwethembana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubambisana nokuxhumana, okubalulekile ukuze kuzuzwe isimo esinempilo sokukhula kwengane. Ukwakhiwa kwemizamo yokuxhumana phakathi kwezingane, abazali, nabathintekayo emkhakheni wezempilo kudinga ukuba kube ngokubambisana. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezivulekile zokuthuthukisa imiphumela yezempilo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, izikhungo zokwelapha, nemiphakathi yendawo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula zibe zinhle, zinempilo, futhi ziqinile. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwalezi zikhungo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo efanele ekukhuleni kwezingane. Izinyathelo ezithathiwe ezibhedlela zidinga ukuqondwa kahle. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele, izibhedlela kufanele zisebenzise izinqubo ezisemthethweni nezisebenzayo, okukhombisa ukuhlola nokuhlaziya izinqubo ezikhona. Ukuhlola nokukhuluma ngempumelelo kwezindlela zokunakekela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa kufanele kube yimizamo eqhubekayo, okwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, abazali, nabanye abathintekayo. Ekugcineni, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezidingo zomsebenzi. Ukuhlola izinqubo, ukuxhumana, kanye nokubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, imiphakathi, kanye nabazali kuyindlela eqinile yokwakha isimo esinempilo sokukhula kwezingane, kuqinisekisa ukuthi zikhula zibe nezempilo, ziqinile, futhi ziqinisa izizukulwane ezizayo.
Impilo Yabafundi: Izinzuzo Nezinkinga Impilo yabafundi ibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, iyinsika ekwakheni ikusasa lethu. Nokho, le mpilo inezici ezingezinhle. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi izinkinga ezinzima ezihambisana nayo. Kulokhu, sizophendula imibuzo emibili ebalulekile: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezikhona empilweni yabafundi? Futhi, yiziphi izinkinga ezibhekene nabafundi? Izinzuzo Zempilo Yabafundi Okokuqala, impilo yabafundi inikeza amathuba amaningi okukhula. Abafundi bangaqonda izinto ezintsha, bakhe ubudlelwano, futhi bathole amakhono abalulekile. Isibonelo, imisebenzi yokuzithandela inika abafundi ithuba lokubambisana futhi iqinisa ukuqonda kwabo ngezinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abafundi bakhule babe ngabantu abakhuthazayo emiphakathini yabo. Okwesibili, impilo yabafundi iyindlela yokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izikhathi ezikhethekile, njengezinsuku zokugcina nemicimbi yokuhlonipha, zenza kube lula ukukhumbula izikhathi ezinhle zempilo. Lezi zinkumbulo zihlala zikhumbuleka, ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, futhi zenza kube lula ukuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabafundi inika abafundi ithuba lokuthuthukisa amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Abafundi bahlala bejuggling phakathi kwezifundo, imisebenzi, nezikhathi zokuphumula. Lokhu kubafundisa indlela yokuphatha isikhathi sabo, okubalulekile empilweni yabo yangemva kokuphothula izifundo. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi aqinisa ukuzimela, futhi akha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphumelela emsebenzini. Izinkinga Zempilo Yabafundi Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle empilweni yabafundi. Kukhona izinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukunakwa. Okokuqala, ingcindezi yokufunda iyinkinga enkulu. Abafundi bahlushwa umthwalo omkhulu wokufunda, okungaholela ekucindezelweni nasekukhathazekeni. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bahlupheke ngengqondo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziqonde lokhu ukuze zinikeze usizo olufanele. Okwesibili, izinkinga zezimali ziyaqhubeka zikhula. Abafundi abaningi baphila ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezanele zokufunda, okuhlanganisa imali yokufunda nezindleko zokuphila. Lokhu kudala umthwalo omkhulu, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zemfundo zicabangele izixazululo ezithile, njengezinhlelo zokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, impilo yabafundi ibhekene nezinkinga zokuhlala. Abafundi abaningi bahlala ezindlini zokuhlala ezibizayo, okuholela ezinselelweni zokuthola indawo yokuhlala efanelekile. Lokhu kudala izinselelo, njengoba abafundi bengenakugxila ezifundweni zabo ngenxa yezinkinga zokuhlala. Isiphetho Ngokuhlanganisa, impilo yabafundi inezinzuzo eziningi ezibalulekile, kodwa ibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bazi ukuthi bangenza kanjani ukuze balwe nezinselelo ezihambisana nalolu hlobo lwezimpilo. Izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi baphumelela. Impilo yabafundi iyinsakavukela, futhi uma ibhekwa kahle, ingaba yinsika eqinile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukufunda Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole: Uhlanga Olusha Lokufunda Namuhla, ukufunda ngengqondo ye-inthanethi sekuyindlela ejwayelekile yokuthola ulwazi, ethokozisayo futhi evumela abantu abaningi ukufinyelela emithonjeni ehlukene yolwazi. Lokhu kuxhumene nokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube lula kubafundi ukufunda ngezikhathi zabo, ezindaweni abazikhethayo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukufunda ngale ndlela, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nezindlela zokuphumelela. Izizathu Zokufunda Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole Okokuqala, ukufunda online kunikeza ukufinyelela okukhulu kumithombo ehlukahlukene. Abafundi bangathola izifundo ezivela ezikoleni ezahlukene, izifundo, nezinsiza ezivela emhlabeni jikelele ngaphandle kokuhamba. Lokhu kuvula amathuba amasha, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezingatholakali kalula izifundo ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda online kuvumela abafundi ukuba benze izifundo ngezikhathi zabo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa izifundo nemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Enye yezinzuzo ezibalulekile ukufunda online ukuthi abafundi bangazimela kakhulu. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhe izinhlelo zokufunda ezifanele izidingo zabo. Ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifana nezifundo zevidiyo, ama-podcast, kanye nezincwadi ze-inthanethi, abafundi bangakhetha indlela abathanda ngayo yokufunda. Izinselelo Zokufunda Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole Noma kunjalo, ukufunda online akuphelele ezinzuzweni. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile okufanele ziqondwe. Isibonelo, ukungabi khona kokuxhumana okuqondile nomfundisi kungaholela ekutheni abafundi bazizwe bedangele. Abafundi bahlala befuna ukusiza ngqo, futhi uma befunda online, lokhu kungaba nzima. Futhi, izinkinga zobuchwepheshe, njengokungasebenzi kwe-inthanethi, zingaphazamisa ukufunda. Enye inkinga enkulu ukuthola ukuzibophezela. Abafundi abaningana bahluleka ukuhlangabezana nezifundo zabo ngenxa yokungabi nokuqonda kahle kokubaluleka kokufunda. Ukuze ube nempumelelo ekufundeni online, kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo oqinile wokuzibophezela, ukuhlela isikhathi kahle, nokwakha isikhala esikahle sokufunda. Izindlela Zokuphumelela Ekufundeni Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole Ukuze ube nempumelelo ekufundeni online, kunezindlela ezithile okufanele zicatshangwe. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlela isikhathi sakho kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusetha izinsuku nezikhathi zokufunda, nokuphuma emisebenzini engadingekile ngesikhathi sokufunda. Uhlelo oluhle lokufunda lungasiza ukufaka umqondo wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo yakho. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukudala isikhala esikahle sokufunda. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi unendawo ethule nehlanzekile yokufunda, ngoba isikhala esihle singakhuthaza ukugxila nokwandisa umkhiqizo wakho. Futhi, sebenzisa amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokuphatha isikhathi, izinhlelo zokuhlela, kanye nezikhumbuzo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uphumelelisa izifundo zakho. Okokugcina, ungakhohlwa ukubambisana nabanye. Ukufunda online akumele kube yinto eyodwa. Ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi, ukuhlela amaqembu okuxoxa, noma ukufuna usizo kumfundisi kungasiza ukwandisa ulwazi lwakho. Ukubambisana kungakhuthaza izifundo ezinzima futhi kukusize uqonde kahle izifundo ezinzima. Isiphetho Ukufunda online kuyindlela enamathuba amaningi, kodwa futhi kunobunzima bayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi baqonde izinzuzo nezinselelo zabo ukuze bakwazi ukuzilungiselela kahle. Ngokuhlela kahle, ukusetha izinjongo ezicacile, nokubambisana nabanye, abafundi bangakha izindlela eziphumelelayo zokufunda. Ngale ndlela, abafundi bangazuza kakhulu kulolu hlobo lokufunda, bahlale bephambili emhlabeni ogcwele amathuba. Ukufunda online akukona nje kuphela ukufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Ukuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi (GEMS company name and code provision) Ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhulayo zomnotho, uhulumeni uthathe isinyathelo esibalulekile sokuhlinzeka ngamagama nezikhodi zenkampani ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukulawula, nokuphathwa kwezinkampani ezisebenza ngaphansi kweGEMS (Government Enterprise Management System). Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukusiza abanikazi bezinkampani, abathengisi, kanye nabanye abathintekayo ukuba bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula emisebenzini yabo. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhloswe ukusiza ukuhlela nokuphatha izinkampani ezisebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokukhiqiza. Ngalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni ubona ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinkampani zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele, futhi zikhona ezinhlelweni zokubhaliswa ezisemthethweni. Ukuze kube lula, uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngohlu lwamagama nezikhodi ezisemthethweni ezizokwenziwa zisetshenziswe ezinkampanini. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka okungase kube khona emisebenzini yansuku zonke, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kwezinkampani, njengoba kuzoba nezinqubo ezicacile zokubhalisela amagama nezikhodi. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhlinzeka ngama-akhawunti ahlukene, okwenza kube lula kubanikazi bezinkampani ukuba baqonde izidingo zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo zokubhaliswa, izidingo zokuhweba, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni. Abanikazi bezinkampani bazokwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlelo kalula, futhi bazothola usizo oludingekayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izinkampani zabo zisebenza kahle. Ngokuhlinzekwa kwegama lenkampani nekhodi, uhulumeni uhhlose ukwakha isimo esihle sokuhweba, esizokwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba phakathi kwezinkampani, njengoba kuzoba nezinqubo ezicacile zokubhalisela amagama nezikhodi. Uhlelo lweGEMS luhlinzeka ngama-akhawunti ahlukene, okwenza kube lula kubanikazi bezinkampani ukuba baqonde izidingo zabo.
