Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi lapho kuhlangene nezimoto eziningi, kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni nasemphakathini. Lezi zimo zihlanganisa izingozi zomgwaqo, lapho abantu abaningi bebandakanyeka khona, izimo zokuphuthuma ezidinga ukuxhasa okusheshayo, kanye nemicimbi yezenzakalo ezinqwabelanayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayasizwa, kumele kube nenqubo elungiselelwe kahle yokuphendula. ### Ukuqonda Izimo Eziphuthumayo Izimo eziphuthumayo zihlanganisa zonke izimo lapho udinga khona usizo ngokushesha. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuvela kwezingozi ezinkulu emgwaqweni, izilimi zomlilo, izikhukhula kanye nezimo eziyingozi zabantu. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi lokhu kusebenza nabantu abaninzi, ngakho-ke ukuhlanganiswa kwemisebenzi, izinsizakalo kanye nezinsiza kuyadingeka. Lezi zimo zidinga ukuphendula okusheshayo, okuhlanzekile, nemininingwane ecacile ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo ezifanele. ### Ukuphendula Ngokushesha Lapho kuvela isimo esiphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuthola izixazululo ngokushesha. Izithuthi ezinjengezimoto zomphakathi, izimoto ezikhethekile, nezithuthi zokuphuthuma zidingeka ukuze kutholakale usizo oluphuthumayo. Iqembu lokuphendula, elihlanganisa abashayela, iziphathimandla, abezokwelapha, nabanye ochwepheshe, kumele lisebenze ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bathola usizo olufanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle nokuxhumana kahle phakathi kweqembu. ### Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Eziphuthumayo Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzeka ngosizo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezibambisene nendawo. Iziphathimandla zomphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo, nezinhlangano ezizimele kufanele zibe nokuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphendula ezifanele zingasungulwa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izikhulu zazi ukuthi ziyazingcweti ekusheshiseni ukusebenza. ### Ukuhlela Ngaphambi Kwezimo Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo kuhamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nenqubo yokuhlela. Lokhu kuhlola izikhungo ezithinta izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokwakha uhlu lwezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Izinqubo zokuhlela zidinga ukufaka isikhumbuzo sokuthi izimpendulo eziphuthumayo azihlukaniswa nje ngezimo, kodwa zidinga ukuziqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bathola ukuvikeleka. ### Ukufunda Ngezimo Eziphuthumayo Naphezu kokuhlinzeka kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kuthakazelisa ukufunda ngalezi zimo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenza nezinhlangano ezifundisayo, ukufundisa umphakathi ngezingozi ezihamba phambili, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo. Izifundo zomphakathi zingahlanganiswa nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezithinta wonke umuntu, okuhlanganisa imindeni, izikole, nemiphakathi. ### Ukuphendula Kwezimoto Eziningi Lapho izimoto eziningi zikhona ngesikhathi esisodwa, kunezingozi ezinkulu ezihambisana nokuphendula. Kusho ukuthi abantu kumele baqonde izinqubo zokuhamba ukuze bahlale bephephile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma kwenzeka ingozi, kudingeka ukuba izimoto zibhalwe kahle futhi zihlolwe ukuze kukhishwe intengo emphakathini. Ukuxhumana nokuqonda izingozi zomgwaqo kunceda ekweqiseni izingozi nezinye izinkinga. ### Ukuqwashisa Ngokuqhubekayo Ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi akupheli kulezi zinyathelo. Kumele kube nokwazisa okuqhubekayo nokuxhumana nempilo yomphakathi. Ukuhlola izifundo ezitholakele, ukufundisa abantu abazimele, nezinhlelo zokuhlola zidinga ukuqhubeka ukuze umuntu ngamunye azizwe ephumelelayo futhi ephephile. Ukugcina imiphakathi iwazisa ngezimo eziphuthumayo kuzokwenza kube nomthelela omkhulu ekwehliseni izingozi. ### Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlaka ezahlukahlukene, ukuxhumana okucacile, kanye nokuhlela okuhle. Kubalulekile ukwenza umsebenzi ngokubambisana, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izigameko ziphendulwa kahle, futhi umphakathi uziqonda ukuthi ungabamba iqhaza kanjani ukuze kwenziwe ukubambisana. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo nokuvikela abantu, ukwenza izinqumo okufanele, kubalulekile ukukhiqiza umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Umbiko: Iziteleka Zabasebenzi Isingeniso Iziteleka zabasebenzi ziye zaba yinto edumile ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, zikhombisa amandla kanye neqhaza labantu emsebenzini. Njengoba izimo zomnotho zishintsha, izisebenzi ziba nemizwa ehlukahlukene mayelana nezimo zabo zokusebenza. Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izizathu, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezithinta iziteleka zabasebenzi ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zenzakalo. Izizathu Zokuhola Iziteleka Izizathu eziholela ezitelekeni ziningi, kodwa ezinye zazo zibalulekile. Okokuqala, izimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle, njengokucindezeleka, imiholo enganele, kanye nezinsiza ezinganiki ithuba lokuthuthuka, zenza ukuba abasebenzi bazizwe bephucwa amalungelo abo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphakamise izwi labo, befuna izinguquko ukuze baphile kahle. Okwesibili, izinkinga zemigomo yokusebenza, njengezinguquko emiholweni noma izindinganiso ezingalungile, zenza kube nomfutho phakathi kwabantu. Abasebenzi bahlala benethemba lokuthi izinkampani zabo zizobabhekelela, kodwa uma lokhu kungahambisani nezifiso zabo, iziteleka ziba yindlela yokuzwakalisa le mizwa. Imiphumela YeziTeleka Iziteleka zabasebenzi zingaholela emiphumeleni eminingi, ethinta hhayi kuphela abasebenzi, kodwa nomsebenzi wabo, izinkampani, kanye nomnotho jikelele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iziteleka zingaholela ekwakhiweni kwezixazululo ezinhle, lapho izinkampani ziqonda khona izidingo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza, ukwandisa imiholo, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza eziphumelelayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iziteleka zingaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezinsiza, uma izinkampani zivala amasango ngenxa yeziteleka. Lokhu kungashiya abasebenzi bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, futhi kungabangela ukungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabafundi nezinkampani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iziteleka azihlanganisi kuphela izinkinga, kodwa futhi zifaka izixazululo. Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuqedwe izizathu ezibangela iziteleka, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhuluma kahle nabantu bazo. Ukwenza kube lula ukuba nezithangami, lapho abasebenzi bengavula khona izinkulumo, kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwane obuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele ziqhube ucwaningo ukuze ziqonde kangcono izidingo nezifiso zabasebenzi. Kubantu, kubalulekile ukuba bahlale befunda futhi baziqhenye ngezinto ezithinta ubudlelwane babo nomsebenzi. Ukwamukela izinguquko, ukufunda amakhono amasha, nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa izimo zokusebenza, kungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi ozinzile. Isiphetho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zikhombisa amandla abantu, futhi zenza kube nokubaluleka kokukhuluma nokwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi nezinkampani. Njengoba sizama ukuqonda izizathu ezibangela lezi ziteleka, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuzwana nokubambisana kungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo ezizoletha impumelelo. Umsebenzi wethu, njengomphakathi, ukufunda kulokhu futhi sithuthukise izimo zokusebenza, ukuze sibe nempilo engcono, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yethu iyakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zifika nezifundo ezibalulekile, futhi umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukusiza abanye, ukuvuselela umphakathi, kanye nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kithi sonke.
Ezokwakha: Umlando Wokwakha Ezinsukwini zokuqala, abantu babenokuhlupheka ngenxa yezidingo ezibalulekile zokwakha izindawo zokuhlala, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezikhumbuzo zamasiko. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo babubucayi, futhi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zazisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindlu ezilula, ezakhiwe ngamathe, izinkuni, kanye nezinsiza zemvelo ezifana nezitini ezazitholakala emhlabeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ezokwakha. Emakhaya amakhulu, izindlu zakhangwa zibe nezakhiwo ezinzima, ezinjengezindonga eziphakeme nezimpahla ezithuthukisiwe. Izinkanyezi zokuqala, ezifana namaGrecian neRoma, zathuthukisa imikhuba yokwakha, zisebenzisa izinsiza ezifana ne-granit ne-marble, okwenza izakhiwo zihlale isikhathi eside. Lezi zinkanyezi zashintsha umqondo wokwakha, zifaka phakathi izinsiza ezithile ezathuthukisa ubuciko bokwakha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkanyezi ezahlukene zathuthukisa izitayela ezahlukene zokwakha. E-Afrika, izinkanyezi zokuqala zifaka phakathi amaZulu, amaXhosa, namaSotho, ababevele behlukanisa izakhiwo zabo ngezinkanyezi zabo. Izindlu zikaZulu, ezaziwa ngokuthi amaDonga, zaziqhakambisa ubuciko bokwakha, zineziqongo eziphakeme ezazivumela ukuhamba kalula emoyeni. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo esihle sokuhlanganiswa kwemvelo nezakhiwo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngesikhathi seMinyaka Ephakathi, izakhiwo zaba zikhulu kakhulu, zifaka phakathi izinqaba nezikhumbuzo. Lezi zinkanyezi zazihlanganisa ubuciko bokwakha obunobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi zazivame ukubonisa amandla nezikhumbuzo zomphakathi. Izinqaba zaziqinisekisa ukuvikeleka, kanti izikhumbuzo zazifaka isithombe esihle semiphakathi ethile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Industrial Revolution yaguqula ngokuphelele umkhakha wezokwakha. Ukutholakala kwezinsiza ezithuthukile, njengezinsimbi, kwavula amathuba amasha okwakha. Lezi zinsiza zashintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngokwakha, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezikhumbuzo ezinkulu, izakhiwo eziphakeme, nezindawo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha wokwakha, okwakwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zomphakathi. Ngesikhathi seMhlabeni Ohlangene, izakhiwo zanda, futhi ubuchwepheshe bokwakha bukhula ngokushesha. Izinsiza ezinjengezinto eziyinkimbinkimbi, izinhlelo zokwakha, nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi emikhulu zathuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindawo ezinkulu, ezinjengezikhungo zezemidlalo, izikhumbuzo, nezindawo zokuhlala ezibanzi. Uhlanga lwezokwakha lwalubukeka luhlukile, luhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Namuhla, ezokwakha ziba yinsika ebalulekile emiphakathini. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezimoto ezikhiqizayo, izinhlelo zokwakha ezisebenza kahle, nezinsiza ezihlala isikhathi eside, kuqhubeka kuholela ekwakhiweni kwezindawo ezinhle nezisebenzayo. Izinkampani eziningi zikhula, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izakhiwo zikhona, ziqhubeka zenza umthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani eziningi ziqhubeka nokwakha izakhiwo ezihloniphekile, ezihambisana nemigomo yokugcina imvelo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zihlala isikhathi eside, izinkampani ziqhubeka zifaka izindlela zokwakha ezilungile, ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, indaba yezokwakha ibonisa indlela abantu abahlangana ngayo nemvelo, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bokwakha buqhubeka buhamba phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ubuciko, nemvelo kuqhubeka kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhe izindawo ezinhle, eziphilayo, nezihloniphekile, okuholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. Ezokwakha, ngakho, akukhona nje ukwakha izindlu, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo, imiphakathi, nezinto ezizokhumbula izizukulwane ezizayo. Lokhu kuqhubeka kuveza ukuthi ezokwakha zihlala zibalulekile, futhi zihlala zikhula, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila kahle, behlanganyela, futhi bejabulela izinzuzo zokwakha.
Kukhona isisho esivela kwezinye izilimi zomdabu esithi: "Umkhonto awakhi indlu." Ulwazi lwethu embonini ye-taxi luveze iqiniso lalo misho kaningi. Ngaphambi kuk governo elikhethwe ngentando yeningi, abantu abaningi embonini ye-taxi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokufa nokulimala kwabashayeli nabagibeli. Lezi zinselelo nezimpi zazivela kakhulu ngenxa yokungavumelani phakathi kwabo bonke embonini ye-taxi mayelana nezindlela, imali ethathwa ngabagibeli, nokunye. Ukuze kususwe izingxabano ezingadingekile embonini ethathwa kakhulu ngababantu abamnyama futhi ethokozisa kakhulu abasebenzi abangemthetho, uhulumeni, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuthutha YaseNingizimu Afrika (Santaco), bakhiphe incwadi yokuvumelana (MOU) ehlose ukudala ukuthula kule mboni. I-MOU yalandelwa yimithetho eminingi ekhiphwe yiphalamende ngenhloso yokuletha induduzo embonini ye-taxi. Umthetho Wokuhamba Ngezinsiza Zomhlaba (NLTTA) ungomunye wale mithetho. Uzokhombisa ulwazi lwakho nge-NLTTA. Uzokuqonda inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwezokuthutha kanye nezinsiza zayo. Uzokwazi ukuthi inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwezokuthutha ihlanganisa ini. Uzobe wazi izimiso ezilindelwe emotweni entsha ye-taxi. Uzokwazi inqubo elandelwayo yokuguqula imboni ye-taxi yamanje ibe imboni yokuthutha yomphakathi. Uzokuqonda izibopho zabaphethe izimoto ze-taxi mayelana nezinkokhelo zentela nezinsiza zakho. Isici esibalulekile sempilo ukuxhumana. Ungacabanga ukuthi umhlaba ungaba kanjani ngaphandle kokukhuluma? Kukhona amagama nezimpawu ezivame ukusetshenziswa ngamaqembu athile abantu, futhi ngokuvamile bangabantu kuphela abaqonda incazelo yazo. Ukukhuluma ngale ndlela kufana nokusebenzisa abantu embonini ye-taxi ngoba nabo banendlela ethile yokukhuluma. Singabala "ulimi" (izimpawu) ezisetshenziswa ngabashayeli nabagibeli uma besichaza izindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo, ezaziwa kuphela kulolu grupo, futhi kufanele kuchazwe kwabanye abangazi lolu limi noma lezi zimpawu. Lezi zimpawu zisetshenziswa ukuze kudluliselwe imiyalezo kalula. Abantu bavame ukufushane amagama ukuze kudluliselwe umyalezo kalula. Empeleni, abanye bathi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathanda ukwenza izinto zibe lula kubo, yingakho bekhetha ukusebenzisa amagama afushane (amagama afushane) akhuluma futhi abhalwe. Ngamanye amahlandla, ifomu elifushane legama liba lidume kakhulu kunegama eliphelele uqobo. Isibonelo yisisho esithi "HIV noma i-Anti Immune Deficiency Syndrome," esinamagama afushane adumile futhi aqondwa kalula uma abhalwe noma akhulunywa ngalesi sikhathi esifushane. Uyiqonda ukuthi kusho ukuthini? Njengakwamanye amasekeli emisebenzi, labo abathintekayo embonini ye-taxi basebenzisa amagama afushane ukuze baxhumane. Amanye awade kanti amanye anzima ukukhumbula. Nokho, la magama kufanele akhunjulwe futhi aqondwe ngabo bonke embonini ngoba athinta ibhizinisi labo ngendlela ethile. La magama afushane angatholakala emibikweni, ku-MOUs, nasemithethweni ekhiphwe yiphalamende. Ku-NLTTA (qaphela leli gama elifushane), kukhona amagama afushane okumele sazi. La magama achazwe encwadini ye-NLTTA. Empeleni, kungani sidinga i-NLTTA? Lapho sibheka umlando wethu, sithola ukuthi kube nezimiso ezihlala zikhona ezibekwe futhi eziphathelene nezindawo ezithile zabakhosi nabaphathi. Emihlanganweni yabo, lezi zimiso zazihloselwe ukugcina umthetho nokuhleleka kulezi zindawo. Namuhla, kusekhona izindawo lapho amadoda (mhlawumbe nabesifazane, ukuze kube nokushintsha) behlangana ezindaweni zobukhosi njalo evikini ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izindawo zilandela umthetho njengoba uphumelelwe. Le ndlela enhle yokuphatha isetshenziswa ezakhiweni zikamasipala nasemaphandleni kahulumeni. Abadala bethu baqonda ukuthi indawo engaphathwanga izoletha ukudideka futhi ibhubhise imiphakathi yethu; babekubona lokhu isikhathi eside. Izwe ngalinye eliphila ngaphansi kwenkqubo yokhetho efana neNingizimu Afrika linemithetho ebekwe yiphalamende eqinisekisa amalungelo abantu kanye namalungelo abo njengoba abhalwe emthethweni wethu kazwelonke. Lezi ziqondiso zibizwa ngemithetho. Iphalamende ngalinye linemithetho esiza ukuxazulula izinkinga ezahlukene umphakathi obhekana nazo mayelana nezindaba ezithinta le phalamende. Isibonelo, umnyango wezempilo unemithetho echaza ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kufanele baphathe kanjani abaguli babo. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezokuthutha unemithetho eqondisa labo abathintekayo emsebenzini wezokuthutha mayelana nalokho okufanele bakwenze ukuze kulethwe ukuthula embonini. Omunye wabo ngu-NLTTA. Ukuhlela isimo samanje semboni yokuthutha kube yindlela ephilayo enezinga elikhulu lokuthuthukisa ukuthutha komphakathi. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabagibeli. Abantu abaningi abazalwe ngaphambi kuka-1994 bayazi ngezinkinga ezazibhekene nabo bonke abantu abamnyama ngenxa yokucindezelwa nguhulumeni ongekho emthethweni. Babengenayo imvo yokuthi izwe liphathwa kanjani ngoba bebengavunyelwe ukuvota kuhulumeni abafuna. Kwakungekho ntando yeningi. Njengomphumela wentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika, manje sekukhona ukhetho ezingeni lendawo nasemazweni. Ngokukhethwa, izakhamuzi manje zingakhetha abantu abafuna ukuba yiphalamende! Ngoba siyazi ukuthi kuwukuthi ukuphila ezweni elinotando yeningi, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izindawo ezithinta ukuphila kwethu zisebenze ngokuvumelana nenhloso yabantu. Cabanga ngohlelo lwezikole (okuhlanganisa amakhansela akhethwe abafundi), uhulumeni bendawo (ohlanganiswe namakhansela), nokunye. Lokhu kusebenze ngendlela efanayo embonini ye-taxi - kudingeka sisebenze ngentando yeningi nohulumeni bendawo, ezingeni lesifunda nasemazweni kuzo zonke izakhiwo zethu. Kubuhlungu, Bhuti, awukho umvuzo! Singakwenza kanjani? Enye yemihlangano yeKomidi Elikhethekile Lezokwakha Ezikhaleni Zomphakathi ngoJuni 2002, uMongameli we-SANTACO, uMnu. Moufhe, wathi: "Ngaphambi kuka-1994, imboni ye-taxi yayiyibhizinisi eliholela kahle. Kodwa uhulumeni wobandlululo waphula imboni ngokuqhubeka nokukhipha izimvume eziningi." Wathi bayazi ukuthi ama-taxi carry abantu abaphezulu kuka-3.7 million njalo ekuseni. Lezi zazikakhulukazi abantu abasebenza - lokhu kusho ukuthi imboni ye-taxi ifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezwe nakuba ingakakabhalwa njengemboni yokuthutha yomphakathi? Ukushintsha uhlobo lwe-taxi oludlulelwe, ezintsha zifike lapha futhi zikhokha abantu abaneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwe-35. Ukuhlangabezana nezindinganiso eziphakeme zokuphepha ezidingekayo zemoto zokuthutha zomphakathi (izimoto kufanele zibe nezici ezifana nohlelo lokumisa imoto oluvimbela ukugcwala). Ukuhweba kahle abanikazi be-taxi nababambiqhaza ngokwesekela nezimali zokuphuma ezimotweni. Ukwakha izinhlelo ze-taxi ukuze kuhlangany
Izakhamuzi zomphakathi ezihlobene namagugu kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele zimenywa ukuthi zikhethe abantu abazoba amalungu eBhodi leMnyuziyamu iLuthuli. Ibhodi lizoba namalungu alinganiselwa ezinsukwini eziyisixhenxe okungenani, athunywe nguNgqongqoshe wezobuciko, amasiko, isayensi, kanye nobuchwepheshe. Omunye wamalungu kumele abe nolwazi oluthile lwezezimali. Ulwazi olunzulu ngamagugu kazwelonke, ulwazi olunzulu lokuphatha nezimali, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokuxhumana, ulwazi lokuqoqa imali, imfundo, kanye nocwaningo lwesayensi, kanye nenhloso yokusebenza komphakathi nolwazi oluthile ngomsebenzi weMnyuziyamu iLuthuli kudingeka. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha ithimba elizokwakha uhlu lwabafanelekayo kusuka kumagama abanikela ngawo. Imiyalelo yeqembu izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kufaka abantu abaneziqu ezifanele zemfundo noma ulwazi olukhethekile noma labo abanothando ngezindawo ezithile ezihlobene, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi othile abe ngomunye wamalungu. Imiyalelo yeqembu izophinde iqinisekise ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kufaka abantu bazo zonke izindawo zomphakathi nobulili bobabili, nokuthi ukukhethwa konke kusezingeni eliphezulu. Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngowanikela, lapho bevuma ukuthi igama labo linikwe, kanye namagama abantu abathathu abangaxhumana nabo abazi owanikela futhi abangahlinzeka ngereferensi ngabo. Akuzukuba nokushoda kwamagama abantu abakhethiwe, kodwa hhayi konke lokhu kulotshiwe ngenhla.
Ukuzalwa kwengane eyazalwa ngaphandle komshado kubhalisela igama likababa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Qedela ifomu lokusebenza le-BI-193 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emisebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thola imvume ebhalwe phansi kukababa ukuze ingane ithathe igama lakhe. Imvume ebhalwe phansi kubazali bobabili iyadingeka kanye nezizathu ezanele ezibhaliwe zokushintsha. Imvume kukababa ngesikhathi sokuzalwa iyadingeka, ngaphandle uma lokhu kukhanseliwe yinkantolo. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha.
Izinkinga Zomthetho: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezifundo Nezimo Zamanje Ezomthetho zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, ovikelekile, nolondekile. Ukuqondisa izindaba zomthetho kuhlinzeka ngendlela yokulawula ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Kulesi sihloko, sizohlola izinkinga ezithinta ezomthetho, sihlole izifundo ezitholwe emlandweni, futhi siyabheka izimo zamanje ezithinta umthetho. Isizinda Somthetho Umlando wezomthetho ubonisa ukuthi izinkinga zomthetho azikhona kuphela emiphakathini ethile, kodwa ziwumongo wemiphakathi eminingi emhlabeni. Ukwakhiwa kwemithetho kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezimo zomphakathi nezidingo zawo. Izifundo zokuqala zomthetho zathinta izinhlelo zokuphatha, izinkantolo, kanye nezindleko ezihambisana nezinsiza zomthetho. Izifundo Zomlando Ukuqonda umlando wezomthetho kubalulekile ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile kwezinkinga zanamuhla. Izifundo zikaLutheran Luther, uJohn Locke, noThomas Hobbes ziye zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni izimiso zomthetho. Lokhu kuhlola kukhombisa ukuthi umthetho awuwona umphumela wezifiso zabaphathi kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube nomthelela kulokho okwenziwa ngabanikazi bobuchwepheshe bemiphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo zomlando ziye zaqondisa izinguquko ezinkulu, ezifana nezinguquko zomthetho wezobandlululo nobandlululo. Izimo Zamanje Namuhla, umhlaba ubhekene nezinselelo ezinzima ezithinta ezomthetho. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuhwebelana kwamazwe omhlaba, kanye nezinguquko ezimayelana namalungelo abantu kudinga ukuthi umthetho ube nezinqubomgomo ezisheshayo nezisebenzayo. Ukuze umthetho ube neqhaza elihle, iziphathimandla kumele ziqonde izidingo zenhlangano, zihlolisise izimo zomphakathi, futhi zifake imithetho ethuthukayo. Izinselelo ezikhona empilweni, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuphepha zikhombisa ukuthi umthetho kumele uqhubeke uhlanganisa izimpilo zabantu. Izinkinga Zokuhweba Izinkinga zokuhweba, ezifana nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezimali, imigomo yokuhweba, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho ezithinta ububanzi bezinkampani, zibuye zibe nesigaba esibalulekile. Ukuhweba kwezimpahla nezinsizakalo kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezomthetho ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukwakha izinqubo ezilungile, eziphathekayo, kanye nezinkantolo ezifanele kuyinsika yokuvikela ababambiqhaza. Ukwakhiwa Kwezichibiyelo Ukwakhiwa kwezichibiyelo ezisemthethweni kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezithakazelo ezahlukene. Njengoba umphakathi ushintsha, izichibiyelo zomthetho kufanele zihlale zihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ukuze kube nemithetho esebenza kahle, kumele kube nezinqubomgomo zokuhlola ezivumela ukuba imithetho ibhekelwe njalo. Isiphetho Ekuhlaziyeni izindaba ezithinta ezomthetho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lokhu akukhona okungapheli, kodwa kunokuhamba okujwayelekile. Umlando, izifundo, nezimo zamanje zikhombisa ukuthi umthetho unomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Ukuze kube nokwakhiwa komphakathi ophumelelayo, umthetho kumele uhlale uhambisana nezidingo nezimo ezishintshashintshayo. Njengoba singabantu, umthetho uyinsika esidingayo ukuze sifeze izinjongo zethu, siqinisekise ubulungiswa, nokugcina ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo emiphakathini yethu.
Ngempela kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukuba sithinte umphakathi waseHlabisa namuhla kulolu suku olubalulekile lokwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa lesi sikhala. Le ndawo ingesinye sezindawo ezithinteke kakhulu ukungabheki kahle kuk gouvernement ye-apartheid, enenjongo eyodwa yokucindezela abantu bethu njengobugqila nokubanqanda ekuthuthukiseni. Sihamba lapha namuhla njengohulumeni wabantu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indawo yaseHlabisa iyaphakanyiswa futhi ithathe indawo yayo efanele ngokudlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wethu wesifunda. Umnyango Wezokubambisana Kokuphathwa Nokuphila Kwamasiko umemezele izinhlelo ezibalulekile eziqondiswe ekubuyiseni nasekuqinisiseni ukusebenza kwemiphakathi esifundeni sethu, ukuze kusheshiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zomphakathi abakhonza zona. Senza lesi sithembiso ngoba njengohulumeni, siqonda kahle ukuthi ohulumeni bendawo basondelene kakhulu nabantu futhi kumele babe nesandla esibonakalayo ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bethu. Njengohulumeni, sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile empini yokulwa nobuphofu nasekuletheleni izinsizakalo ezibalulekile kubantu bethu. Naphezu kokuthuthuka esikwenze, siyazi kahle ukuthi kusekhona ukungaphumeleli kwezinsiza ezithile ezithinta izimpilo zabantu bethu nsuku zonke. Siyazi ukuthi kwezinye zezimiphakathi zethu, njenge lapha eHlabisa, abantu bethu basadinga ugesi, amathoyilethi ahlanzekile, namanzi anempilo. Emzamweni wethu wokwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, siwethule uhlelo olusha lokwesekwa kwemiphakathi olwaziwa ngokuthi iProject Consolidate, oluhloselwe ukusiza imiphakathi efana neHlabisa ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi ezibalulekile. Ngesikhathi senza ukuhlaziywa nocwaningo ngemiphakathi lapha, umphakathi waseHlabisa watholakala njengomunye wemiphakathi edinga ukwesekwa okukhulu kuhulumeni ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi. Sihamba lapha eHlabisa namuhla ukwethula izinhlelo eziqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu baleli sikhala. Ukuba lapha namuhla ukwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu kukhombisa ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kwalesi sikhala kuhulumeni wethu futhi kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kufinyelela kubo bonke amalungu omphakathi wethu. Sihamba lapha namuhla ukuze siqale ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lokwesekwa okuqondile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza komphakathi lapha, futhi sizovula futhi emahhovisi amasha omphakathi weHlabisa. Sikholelwa ukuthi ukuvulwa kwamahhovisi amasha omphakathi eHlabisa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuletha ushintsho kule ndawo ukuze ikwazi ukudlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni isifunda sethu. Sibone kulo lonke izwe ukuthi abantu abaningi baphakamisa izikhalazo mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ngokuvamile, imiphakathi yethu iyona ehluleka kakhulu kulokhu. Nokho, kufanele kuthiwe imiphakathi yethu iside isikhathi ingenazo izinsiza ezanele zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. Kungaphinde kuthiwe imiphakathi yethu ayinayo ngisho nezikhungo zokusebenza, futhi ngisho lapho zikhona, azinazo izinsiza ezisebenzayo ezifana namakhompyutha nezinye. Imiphakathi yethu ayikwazi ukusebenza kahle ukwenza lokho okukhona emandleni ayo ngoba ayinazo izinsiza ezanele nezakhiwo zokwenza imisebenzi yayo. Ngalesi sizathu, thina njengoMnyango wesifunda Wezokubambisana Kokuphathwa Nokuphila Kwamasiko, ngokuhambisana nendima yethu yokusiza, sithuthukisile futhi sizobheka ukusebenza kwemiphakathi yethu, futhi sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngemali ukuze kusizwe imiphakathi yakhe izikhungo ezinhle ezifana nalezo onazo lapha eHlabisa, ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisheshayo kubantu. Umbono wohulumeni wesifunda ophathiswa nguMholi ohloniphekile uDkt. S.J. Ndebele uwukubona le ndawo ithuthuka ibe idolobha eliphelele. Ngakho-ke, ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwamahhovisi omphakathi nokuqaliswa kwezinhlelo eziningi esizethulayo lapha namuhla kuyisinyathelo esihle sokufeza lo mbono. Ukuvulwa kwamahhovisi omphakathi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emphakathini walesi sikhala. Abantu bethu ngeke babe ngabantu abahluphekayo ngenxa yokuntuleka kwamahhovisi afanele ukuze basize ngezidingo zabo noma ngoba amahhovisi akude futhi anokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhlangabezana nezinkinga zabo. Lawa mahhovisi azoba izikhungo zokuthuthukiswa kwalomphakathi. Kumele abe njengomlilo ophakamisayo uthuthukise nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Lawa mahhovisi kumele asize bonke abantu baseHlabisa kungakhathalekile ukuthi bangobani ngokwenkolo noma ngokobuzwe. Kumele kube njalo ngoba ubuphofu, indlala, nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa akukhethwa futhi akubuzi ukuthi umuntu usemsebenzini muni. Ngesikhathi siqaliswa ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lweProject Consolidate, saphakamisa ukuthi sizovakashela imiphakathi ethokozisayo ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo ngenhloso yokwethula izinsizakalo zokweseka. Ngoba abantu lapha badinga usizo kakhulu, sathi nakuba kunesidingo kwezinye izindawo, sizoph开始 umnyaka omusha nokuqala okusha ezimpilweni zabantu bethu lapha eHlabisa. Sihlonze izinhlelo ezisheshayo ezizovumela le ndawo ukuba ibe nesandla esibalulekile emnothweni wesifunda nasezweni. Siyazi kahle ukuthi uma izwe lethu linquma ukukhulisa umnotho walo ngo-6% , indawo yaseHlabisa nayo kumele ibe nesandla. Indawo yaseHlabisa ikakhulukazi iyindawo yokuhlala. Ngakho-ke, akumangazi ukuthi sinesimo esiphezulu sobuphofu nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo ngenxa yesikhathi se-apartheid lapho ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yethu kwashiywa. Futhi akumangazi ukuthi isisekelo somnotho wale ndawo asikathuthukiswa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sonke kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuze sakhe idolobha elinokuphathwa kahle kwezokuphatha nezokuhweba. Njengamanye amaholo, indawo yaseHlabisa inezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ubuphofu, nokungathuthukiswa. Kule ndawo, iningi labantu bethu, okumele babe yizikhungo zomnotho, abanakho ukwenza lutho ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuthuthukiswa. Imisebenzi yokulima okwamanje ikhona kuphela ezingeni lokuphila. Kuningi okumele kwenziwe ukuze kudaleke amathuba kulolu hlobo lwezomnotho. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezidinga ukubhekelwa yikuntuleka kwamakhono ezemfundo nezobuchwepheshe phakathi kwabantu abasha kule ndawo. Lokhu kukhuphuka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezikhungo zemfundo nezokufundisa. Izindaba ezinhle ukuthi uhulumeni usemkhankasweni wokuqala wezinhlelo zemfundo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le ndawo iyathuthuka. Umphathi wePhrojekthi, ezokuvakasha, ungomunye wezinhlelo zethu ezibalulekile emkhankasweni wethu wokwandisa amathuba okutshala imali kulesi sifunda. Njengoba ngishilo, indawo yaseHlabisa ibusisiwe ngobuhle bemvelo obumangalisayo, obuhlotshiswe ngezintaba, izigodi, nemifula. Inokukhula kwemvelo okuhle kakhulu. Ukunakekela Abantu Abadala: Ingxoxo Nomhleli Wezempilo Isingeniso Namuhla, ukunakekela abantu abadala kubalulekile emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, sikhuluma noMnu. Zulu, umhleli wezempilo ophumelelayo emkhakheni wokunakekela abantu abadala. Ubuza ngezinto ezahlukene ezithinta lezi zinsizwa nezinsizwa, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ukuphila kwazo kube ngcono. Ingxenye 1: Ukubaluleka Kokunakekela Abantu Abadala Mnu. Zulu, ungachaza ukuthi kungani ukunakekela abantu abadala kubalulekile? “Ngempela, ukunakekela abantu abadala kubalulekile kakhulu. Lezi zinsizwa zinesipiliyoni esikhulu, futhi zifundisa izizukulwane ezincane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abadala bahlala bezidinga usizo ngezinto ezilula, njengezokuhamba, ukudla, nokuphila nsuku zonke. Ukunakekela kahle kubasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukugcina isithunzi sabo.” Ingxenye 2: Izinkinga Eziyinhloko Zokunakekela Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabantu abadala? “Yebo, izinselelo ziningi. Okokuqala, iminyaka yokukhula kwebhizinisi lokunakekela abantu abadala ibalulekile. Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi ukunakekela abantu abadala kuncike kuphela ekudleni nasekuphatheni. Nokho, lezi zinsizwa zidinga ukuxhumana, uthando, nokuhlonipha. Ubugebengu obukhulayo, izimo zokuhlala ezinzima, kanye nezinkinga zezezimali nazo zenza kube nzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase bahluleke ukuqonda izidingo zempilo zalesi sigaba.” Ingxenye 3: Izindlela Zokunakekela Kukhona izindlela ezithile zokunakekela abantu abadala? “Yebo, izindlela eziningi zikhona. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka abantu abadala ngemithi yabo ngesikhathi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba bahlale bexhumene nomndeni nabangane. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele, njengezinto zokuhamba, izinsiza zokudla, nezindawo zokuhlala ezikhululekile, kubalulekile. Ukubamba imicimbi yokuxhumana, njengokuhamba emaphakathini, kungasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Futhi, ukuxhumana nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bayaziswa.” Ingxenye 4: Umsebenzi Womndeni Umdlalo womndeni unendima enkulu ekunakekeleni abantu abadala. Ungakuchaza lokhu? “Ngempela, umndeni unendima enkulu. Umndeni kufanele ube yisikhungo sokwesekwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele babe khona, baphendule izidingo zomuntu omdala, futhi bahlale bexhumene. Uthando nomoya wokuhlanganyela kubalulekile. Umndeni kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bahlala bejabule, benempilo, futhi bezizwa beqondile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bexhumana, bephendula imibuzo, futhi bahloniphe izinqumo zomuntu omdala.” Ingxenye 5: Izinselelo Zokusebenza Yiziphi izinselelo ezithinta abasebenzi abakhathalela abantu abadala? “Abasebenzi abakhathalela abantu abadala bahlala bebhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, ukuntuleka kwemali, kanye nezinsiza ezingekho zokufundisa zenza kube nzima. Abasebenzi badinga ukuqeqeshwa okuhle ukuze baqonde izidingo zempilo zabantu abadala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucindezeleka okukhona emsebenzini kungabangela ukuthi kungabi nezinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokusekela abasebenzi, ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubheka Phambili Ngabe unayo imicabango yokuthi izinga lokunakekela abantu abadala lingathuthuka kanjani esikhathini esizayo? “Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi kumele kube nezinhlelo eziphusile zokuthuthukisa izinga lokunakekela abantu abadala. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa ukuqwashisa emphakathini, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okungcono kubasebenzi, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imiphakathi ikhulume ngalezi zindaba, ukuze abantu abadala baziwe futhi bahlonishwe. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zokunakekela kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni le mikhakha.” Isiphetho Ukunakekela abantu abadala akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisibopho somphakathi. Njengoba sithola izixazululo ezahlukene, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe, sithandazele, futhi sinakekele lezi zinsizwa ezibalulekile. Ubuza uMnu. Zulu, sithola ukuthi ukunakekela abantu abadala kudinga uthando, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi ophumelelayo.
Izindlela Zokuthunyelwa Kwama-Ambulensi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezinqubo Nezidingo Ukuhamba kwama-ambulensi emiphakathini bukhoma obalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Ukuze kube nempumelelo ekuthumeleni ama-ambulensi, kudingeka izinqubo ezihlelwe kahle, ezakha isisekelo esiqinile sokusiza abantu abadinga usizo lwezephethelo. Kulesi sahluko, sizobheka izinqubo ezahlukene zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi, sigxile ekutheni ziwathinta kanjani impilo yomphakathi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezephethelo akulula; kudinga ukuhlonipha, ukuhlela, nokuhlonza izindawo lapho ama-ambulensi kufanele atholakale khona. Ukuphendula emikhosini yokuphuthuma kufanele kwenziwe ngesikhathi, okufaka phakathi ukuthola imiyalezo ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhilela ukuvumelanisa nezinsizakalo ezahlukene, njengokuxhumana namaphoyisa, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezikhungo zokuphuthuma. Ukuhlelwa kwalesi sikhathi kusebenza njengesisekelo sokuthi ama-ambulensi alungiselelwe ukusiza ngokushesha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi sekuphenduke umkhakha owenziwa ngochwepheshe. Uhlelo lokuthunyelwa kwezinsizakalo luhilela imiphumela yezikhulu, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nababambiqhaza abavela emiphakathini, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-ambulensi angafinyelela ezindaweni ezidinga usizo ngempela. Ukuphathwa kwama-ambulensi kudinga abaqondisi abanesibopho. Abasizi bezokwelapha, abakhi bezakhiwo, nabasebenzi bezokuthutha kufanele bakhuthazwe ukuba baphakamise izinhlelo zokuthuthwa kwempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcina izinkambu ezisemqoka, ukugcinwa kwama-ambulensi esezingeni eliphezulu, kanye nezifundo zokuvuselela ukufunda kwabantu abasha. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengemishini yokuhlola nezinhlelo zokulandelela, kusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi. Ukuqonda ukuxhumana kahle phakathi kwama-ambulensi, izikhungo zezempilo, nomphakathi kudinga uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuxhumana. Ukulandelwa kwama-ambulensi kufanele kube nebanga elingafani, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukufinyelela kanye namathuluzi aphambili okuphuma kube lula. Lokhu kuzotholakala kuphela ngokusebenza okukhulayo phakathi kwezikhungo, njengoba ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezisebenzi neziguli kubalulekile ekutholeni usizo lwezephethelo. Izikhungo zezempilo nazo zidinga ukuthuthukisela izinhlelo zazo ukuze zifeze zonke izidingo zomsebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwama-ambulensi kudinga ukubhekelwa kwezimo ezahlukene, ezinjengokungavikeleki kwesimo sokwelapha, izimo zokungeniswa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokungena kwemithwalo eyahlukahlukene. Ukuhlela izidingo zempilo kubalulekile, ukuze ama-ambulensi akwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezidinga usizo ngezikhathi ezikhethiwe. Ngesikhathi sokuthunyelwa, kunemigomo ethile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhungo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-ambulensi awathunyelwa ngesikhathi, kudinga ukuvuselelwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka nezikhungo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abadingayo bafinyelela usizo lwezephethelo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zidinga ukufunda, ukuvuselela, kanye nezinqubomgomo eziphakathi kukahulumeni, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezisulu ezinenkinga. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa izinsizakalo zomphakathi, kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yomphakathi. Ngamafuphi, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zidinga ubuchwepheshe, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuhlanganyela kwezidingo. Uma kwenziwa ngendlela efanele, ama-ambulensi angaba insiza ewusizo empilweni yomphakathi, esiza ukuphila kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, ngempumelelo.
Ukuhlanganisa nokulungisa imithetho ephathelene nokubhekwa nokuphathwa kwezikhungo zokuhweba emakethe yezimali, ukuhlela nokubhekwa kwezikhungo ezigcina amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe yezimali, ukugcina nokuphatha amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe yezimali nokuvimbela izinqubo zokuhweba eziphuma ngaphakathi kwenkampani; ukuhlinzeka ngelayisensi yezindlu ezibhalisiwe zokuhweba ngamasheya nokwamukela abamele; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwabantu abavunyelwe nokuhlinzeka ngemicimbi ephathelene nalezi zenzo. Umcwaningi uchaza umcwaningi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi ka-1991, njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wamabhange ka-1990 (Umthetho No. 94 ka-1990), kanye nebhangi elingahlukanisi inzuzo phakathi kwamalungu alo njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wamabhange elingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo ekupheleni konyaka ka-1993 (Umthetho No. Ibhodi ichaza iBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezimali esunguliwe ngengxenye 2 yeMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zezimali ka-1990. Imithetho ichaza imithetho eyenziwe ngombuso ukuze igcine amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe yezimali ngokuhambisana nalo Mthetho. Umbiko ophuma kumuphi uhlela uhlobo olusunguliwe, olurekhodiwe, oludluliswe noma olugcinwe ngombhalo noma ngendlela engathinteki kodwa ebonakalayo. a noma iyiphi inhlangano yephenshini ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamafundisi ka-1956 Umthetho No. b noma iyiphi inhlangano yokubambisana ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezikhungo Zobungane ka-1956 Umthetho No. c noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlelo zokutshalwa kwezimali ezichazwe engxenyeni 1 yeMthetho Wokulawula Izinhlelo Zokutshalwa Kwezimali ka-2000 Umthetho No. d noma ubani obhaliswe njengomthengisi we-insurance wesikhathi eside noma wesikhathi esifushane obhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho WezeMali Wesikhathi Eside ka-1998 Umthetho No. 52 ka-1998, noma koMthetho WezeMali Wesikhathi Esifushane ka-1998 Umthetho No. e noma ubani ophakathi owenza imisebenzi echazwe engxenyeni 721d yoMthetho WezeMali Wesikhathi Eside ka-1998, noma engxenyeni 70e yoMthetho WezeMali Wesikhathi Esifushane ka-1998; kanye f ibhange. i amasheya, ubufakazi bokugcina imali enkampanini ebhaliswe emakethe yezimali nezinye izinhlobo zemali ezithengiswa emakethe yezimali ngaphandle kwelungelo lokutshalwa kwemali enkampanini ethengisa amasheya ngezindlela ezichazwe kuMthetho Olawula Ukuthengiswa Kwamashares Ngemigomo ka-1980 Umthetho No. ukwenziwa kokuhweba kuchaza zonke izivumelwano noma izenzakalo zokuthenga nokuthengisa amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe yezimali. d ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa nokukhula kwemisebenzi yokuhweba ngamathuluzi ezimali emakethe yaseNingizimu Afrika. a kwi-collective investment scheme elawulwa noma ngaphansi koMthetho Wokulawula Izinhlelo Zokutshalwa Kwezimali ka-2002; Umthetho No. b emicimbini elawulwa noma ngaphansi koMthetho Wezokweluleka Nezinsizakalo Zokuphakathi ka-2002 Umthetho No. Noma imithetho ephathelene nokugembula noma ukubheja ayisebenzi emicimbini elawulwa noma ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. h uma umuntu enegunya lokusebenza, ephatha amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe yezimali ngaphandle kokuthi lowo muntu ahambisane nemithetho yombuso elawula ukuphathwa kwamathuluzi okuhweba emakethe yezimali. Abanalo ilungelo lokuba yisikhungo, njengendawo yokugcina amathuluzi okuhweba, indlu ebhalisiwe yokuhweba ngamasheya, ababamba iqhaza noma abavunyelwe ukwenza le msebenzi ngokuya ngesimo esivele sikhona, noma ukuziphatha ngendlela, basebenzise igama noma incazelo ekhombisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo nesikhungo, indawo yokugcina amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe, indlu ebhalisiwe yokuhweba ngamasheya, ababamba iqhaza noma abavunyelwe ukusebenza, ngokuya ngesimo njengoba sikhona. Umphakathi omkhulu kanye nomphakathi wakhe ophakanyisiwe okukhulunywa ngawo engxenyeni 1 yoMthetho Wokweluleka Kwezimali ka-1990 nguMphathi kanye noMphathi wakhe wezAmathuluzi Okuhweba Kwezimali emakethe yezimali ngokulandelana kwabo. Umphathi kufanele enze imisebenzi enikezwe umphathi noma aqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho uyahambisana. d Bangafaka izimo eziphathelene nalolu Mthetho mayelana nelayisensi, igunya, ukwamukela noma amalungelo akhishwa umphathi futhi lezo zimo zingase zikhanselwe noma zishintshwe. Umthetho Olawula Imakethe Yezezimali ka-1989 (Umthetho No. 55 ka-1989) usaqhubeka nokusebenza nakuba lo Mthetho usususiwe ngengxenye 117. b nezinye ezihlanganisa abamele embonini kanye namakhasimende abekwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuxoxisana neBhodi. Umphathi ungum member weBhodi yokweluleka ngenxa yesikhundla sabo emsebenzini kodwa abakwazi ukuvota ngezindaba ezidinga iseluleko seBhodi yokweluleka. Umuntu oyi-member yeBhodi yokweluleka uhlala emsebenzini isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngesikhathi sokuhlonza kwabo. b izindleko zemali ezisetshenziswe ngumuntu oyi-member ekwenzeni imisebenzi enikezwe kubo. a Umphakathi weBhodi yokweluleka kufanele ubize umhlangano wokuqala weBhodi yokweluleka ngemuva kokuqala kwalolu Mthetho, emva kwalokho, iBhodi yokweluleka izohlangana ngesikhathi nendawo ethile eyinqunywe yiBhodi yokweluleka. Umphakathi ubiza umhlangano olandelayo ngemuva kwalowo odlule lapho inani elifunekayo labameli beBhodi lingahlangani. b Inani elifunekayo labangamalungu emhlanganweni ukuze uqhubeke lizoba iningi labangamalungu beBhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi yokweluleka ingathatha isinqumo noma icelwe nguNgqongqoshe noma umphathi ukuze ihlole futhi ilethe umbiko noma iseluleko ngezindaba zokuphatha noma ubuchwepheshe ngabantu abasebenza embonini noma ngokwethula amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe yezimali. a Singacela usizo kunoma ubani noma sihlole izindaba ezithinta abantu abasebenza embonini noma imisebenzi yokuhweba emakethe yezimali. Umphathi angathumela kuBhodi noma yiluphi ulwazi olufanele mayelana nendaba ethathwa yiBhodi yokweluleka. Umphathi unesibopho sokuphatha umsebenzi ophathelene nemisebenzi yeBhodi yokweluleka kanye nekomidi elincane leBhodi yokweluleka. a Ibhodi kufanele ikhokhe izindleko eziphathelene nemisebenzi yeBhodi yokweluleka. b Ibhodi yokweluleka kufanele ithole imvume yeBhodi ngaphambi kokuchitha izindleko. Izinqubomgomo zeMthetho Wokwakhiwa KweKomidi ka-1947 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1947) eziphathelene nokwakhiwa kwekomidi, ukuhlolwa kwabantu nokwenza izifungo, ukukhipha imibhalo, amarekhodi nezinto ezithile kanye nokwephula umthetho okwenziwe ngabafakazi abahlanganyela nezinguquko ezidingekayo ngaphakathi komqondo wokuhlola owakhiwe yiBhodi yokweluleka noma ikomidi elincane elibekwe. Izinqubomgomo zokubhaliswa zikhomba kulokho okudingekayo, njengoba kuhlelwe
Ezokusebenza Kukahulumeni: Umhlahlandlela Wokusebenza Isingeniso Ezokusebenza kukahulumeni, noma ezokuphatha, ziwumgogodla wabantu nempilo yomphakathi. Kuhlala kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zisebenza kanjani, ukuze kungabi khona ukudideka nezinkinga phakathi kwababambiqhaza. Umhlahlandlela unikeza izinyathelo eziyisisekelo ezidingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusiza umphakathi wabo, baqonde izinqubo, futhi balingise izidingo zomphakathi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izidingo Zomphakathi Ukuphatha kahle izokusebenza kukahulumeni kuqala ngokuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphathi kufanele baqhube ucwaningo oluqondile, bavule iziteshi zokuxhumana, futhi balalele izikhalazo nezicelo zabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezenzakalayo zitholakala kubantu ezindaweni ezidinga kakhulu. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zokuphatha Umsebenzi wophenyo kumele uhlanganise ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, ezibandakanya ohulumeni bendawonye, izikhungo ezizimele, nabavoti. Ukuze lezi zinhlelo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nomqondo ophakeme wobambiswano. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokuhlela imihlangano, ukufaka abantu emisebenzini, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izicelo zabantu ziyaziswa. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhulisa Izinsiza Ngemva kokuba izidingo zomphakathi seziqondwa, indlela elandelayo iwukukhulisa izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela izabelomali, ukuthola amalungelo, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziyimfuneko. Abaphathi kumele baqonde ukuba izinsiza kumele zenziwe zibe lula zokutholakala, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuzithola kalula. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlela Imisebenzi Ukuphathwa kwalokho okukhulisiwe kumele kuhlelwe kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela imisebenzi nezinqubo ezizosetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umnyango uyawuqonda umsebenzi othile. Kubalulekile ukusetha izinyathelo ezicacile, ukugcina amarekhodi afanele, nokuhlola ukusebenza kwazo ngokuvamile. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqeqesha Abasebenzi Abasebenzi bakahulumeni bangenye yeziqhamo ezisemqoka ezokusebenza kukahulumeni. Ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo, kudinga ukuthi baqeqeshwe ngezifundo ezisemqoka, izinhlelo zokufundisa, nezikhangiso eziphathelene nezimpoqo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzowandisa amakhono abasebenzi, kubenze bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezidingweni zomphakathi. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuhlola Nokuhlaziywa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba zonke izinhlelo eziphathelene nezokuphatha zisebenza kahle, kumele kuqashwe ukuhlola nezindlela ezithile zokuhlaziywa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubhalwa kwemiphumela, ukuqhuba izifundo, nokuhlola izinsiza. Ukuhlola kufanele kube njalo ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zikhona kuphi izinkinga ezikhona, futhi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ezifanele. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuxhumana Nezindaba Zesimanje Ezokusebenza kukahulumeni akumele zenziwe zibe sengxenyeni ethile kuphela. Ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nezindaba zesimanje, okubandakanya ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kuyisici esibalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola impendulo ngokushesha, ukuhlela izinhlelo, nokwenze kube nokubambisana okukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Isiphetho Ezokusebenza kukahulumeni zidinga ubuchwepheshe obunembile, ukuxhumana okuhle, nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Ukuze umphakathi uthole izinzuzo ezivela kulezi zinhlelo, kumele silandele lezi zinyathelo ngokunembile, siqhubeke sihlola futhi sihluze izinqubo, ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Ngokwakhiwa kwezokusebenza kukahulumeni okuyiqiniso, siqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uhlala unempilo, ubumbene, futhi unikezwa zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kwandiswe izinga lempilo yawo. Lokhu kuyimpumelelo yezenzo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha.
Umthetho ophathelene nezinkambiso usuthinteke kakhulu yisinqumo esithathiwe emcimbini kaBhe, owashintsha indlela yokwabiwa kokuhlala kwabafileyo. Ubuye washintsha indlela uMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo uphatha ngayo ukuphathwa kwezindlu zabafileyo. Kwakutheni esinqumweni sikaBhe? Indodakazi yabo yesibili yayihlala noyise umufi eBerlin, okuyindawo eseMpumalanga Kapa. Umufi washona ngaphandle kokubhala ifa, ngakho-ke impahla yakhe yabiwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nezinkambiso. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uyise umufi wayezothola yonke impahla, ngaphandle kukaNkk. Bhe nezingane zabo. Impahla yayiqukethe ishayela nomhlaba owawakhiwe phezu kwawo. Uyi sebenzisa umhlaba ukuze akhokhe umngcwabo wendodana yakhe. Uma eqhubeka kanje, uNkk. Bhe nezingane bazoshiywa bengenalutho. UNkk. Bhe ufake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi izingane zakhe ezimbili ziqashelwe njengezizokwazi kuphela ukufaka ifa likayise. INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yanquma ukuthi indlela yokwabiwa kwezakhamuzi ngaphansi komthetho wezinkambiso ibekwe emkhakheni 23 weMthetho Wokuphatha Wabantu Abamnyama, ngakho-ke ayihambisani nezinselelo zokushintsha kwezimo zomphakathi ezazisunguliwe kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngakho-ke, bekungasasebenzi kahle futhi bekungahambisani nezidingo zangempela zezindawo zasemadolobheni nezinguquko eziphakathi kwemindeni. Isimo samanje sikhombisa ukuthi asihambisani nendlela yeqembu elikhulu ngoba sikhubaza ngokobulili nasemzini. Zonke impahla yomuntu ofile izokwabiwa ngokomthetho womuntu ofile ongachazanga ukuthi ufuna ukwabiwa kanjani. Uma umufi eshiye kuphela omakoti nezingane, omakoti bazokwabelana ngempahla phakathi kwabo. Uma impahla ingafinyeleli ku-R125,000 kumakoti, omakoti bazothola isabelo esifanayo sempahla, kanti izingane azizotholi lutho. Ngemuva kwesinqumo sikaBhe, izindlu zabantu abafileyo manje ziphathwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwefa Elingabhalwanga ka-1965 (Umthetho 66 ka-1965, njengoba uguqulwe). Abameli bangeke baphathe ukuphathwa kwezindlu zabafileyo, kodwa lesi sabelo sishintshile sibe seMphakathini Wokuphatha Wokuphatha. Umphakathi Wokuphatha akudingeki ukuthi uzibandakanye ngokuqondile ekuphatheni izindaba zezakhamuzi zabafileyo. Umphakathi Wokuphatha uzokhetha umuntu ofanele kulolu daba lokuphatha impahla yomuntu ofile. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela impahla, umuntu angasafaka izinhlelo zokuthi impahla izokwabiwa kanjani ngaphansi komthetho wezinkambiso. Lokhu kufanele kubhalwe kuWills. Umphakathi Wokuphatha unomsebenzi wombuso ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho ophathelene nezinkambiso uthuthukiswa. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngokuvumela umndeni ophumile ukuvumelana ngendlela impahla yomufi kufanele iwabiwe. Nokho, umphakathi Wokuphatha akufanele uvumele amaqembu aphansi afana nezingane nabesifazane ukuba aphathwe kabi ngenxa yezivumelwano zomndeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baqonde lezi zinguquko ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izindlu zabo ngendlela efanele. Umphakathi Wokuphatha Omkhulu usungule umgudu wokuxhumana lapho usizo lungatholakala khona.
### Abadlali Abasebasha: Izifundo Eziqalayo Ezweni Lokuncintisana Emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla, abadlali abasebasha babe nemisebenzi ebalulekile eminyakeni edlule. Izenzo zabo, izinzuzo zabo, nezifundo abahamba kuzo, kudinga ukuba zibhekwane ngokuqonda okujulile. Lokhu kudinga izizathu eziningi, kodwa ngokuqinisekayo, abantu badinga ukujula kancane endleleni yokwenza amalungiselelo kulezi zinsuku. Abadlali abasebasha bahlala benesifiso sokuphumelela, kanti lokho kubaholela ekunqobeni emakhono abawathola ezivivinyweni zabo. Nokho, lapho sikhuluma ngabadlali abasebasha, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yabo ayikhulumi kuphela ngokuxabana noma ngezimali, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni ubuhlobo, ukufunda, kanye nokukhula njengabantu. Ubuhlakani besikole, izifundo ezimnandi zokuhlonipha, nezifundo zokubambisana nazo zikhona. Abadlali abakha izinselele, begxile ekugcineni amaphupho abo, bathola ithuba lokufunda izifundo eziphusile. Baphinde baqaphele amaphutha abo, badlule ezindaweni ezinzima, bese bephumelela, okwenza kube sobala ukuthi ukuzinikela nobuhlakani bakho kumele kube yizinto ezibalulekile. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngezithiyo ezibhekene nabadlali abasebasha. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi umjaho wokuncintisana ubandakanya ingcindezi enkulu. Abazali, othisha, nababukeli baphakamisa amazinga aphezulu. Lokhu kudala ukucindezeleka okukhulu, okuvame ukuhambisana nokuhluleka ukujabulisa abantu abaseduze. Lokhu kwenza kubalulekile ukuthi nabazali baziqonde izidingo nezinselele zezingane zabo, behlale bexhasa ngothando, hhayi ukwenza isikhumbuzo somjaho wokuncintisana kuphela. Imikhuba yokugcina ukudla, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphila impilo ethile, lokho kudinga ukuqashelwa. Izinselelo zokudla okulungile nezokuphila impilo enempilo zihlala zikhona. Abadlali badinga ukuphepha kwangempela, ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kuchaze kahle ukuthi ukukhula kwemizimba yabo kudinga izindlela zokusebenzisa njengezokuzivocavoca. Futhi uma kungenzeka, ukubukela izinhlelo ezinhle ezivela kumadlalisi abavela ezinkundleni zomhlaba, kubalulekile kwabakhethu. Kukhona namaphuzu amakhulu okufanele abadlali abasebasha bakwazi ukuwaphendula. Izifundo zempilo ezikhuluma ngezifundo ezitholakala emijikeni yokuncintisana. Manje sekuyisikhathi sokuthi sikhumbule ukuthi isimiso sokuphila kufanele sikhulume ngempilo nokwakheka komuntu, hhayi nje ngezimali neziqu. Izinkampani zezemidlalo, ukuhweba, kanye nezinsizakalo ezahlukene ziyabingelela abadlali abasebasha. Lokhu kuyindlela yokuthi baqhubeke beyizinkanyezi ezikhanya ezinkundleni zomhlaba. Noma kunjalo, kudingeka ukuthi bahlale bekhumbula izimpawu ezinhle zomphakathi, njengokuthokozisa umphakathi, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, kanye nokukhuthaza omunye nomunye. Ekugcineni, ngiyakhuthazi abadlali abasebasha, ukuthi baqhubeke benezimpumelelo ezinkulu. Noma zikhona izinselelo, kubalulekile ukuba bakhumbule ukuthi lezi zifundo azinakho ukufundwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Futhi uma sebezifundile, bazokwazi ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuchaziwe empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, asibambeni. Abadlali abasebasha, niyizinkanyezi eziphakeme, futhi ngeke niphumelele kuphela emjahweni, kodwa nasempilweni yenu yonke.
Ukuba nomntwana kuzoba enye yezinto ezizwakalayo kodwa futhi ezinzima empilweni yakho. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ulindele ukwamukela injabulo yakho oyilindele isikhathi eside ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye. Nokho, ngakolunye uhlangothi, uzobe ucabanga ngendlela yokwenza ukuthi umntwana wakho angene kulo mhlaba ngokuphepha ngaphandle kokukhathazeka okukhulu. Ngokwazi izinketho zakho nokuxhumana nomhlinzeki wezempilo, ungakwenza isinqumo esihle kuwe nomntwana wakho. Impilo yakho jikelele kanye nezindlela zokuphila, kanye naleyo yomntwana ongakazalwa, kuzoba yizici ezibalulekile ezinqumweni zakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda okuzokwenzeka kanye nezinzuzo nezinkinga zezinketho zakho. Wena nomntwana wakho bazobhekwa kuyo yonke inqubo yokubeletha, futhi abasebenzi bezokwelapha abaqeqeshiwe bazotholakala uma ubhekana nanoma yiziphi izinkinga. Ukuhlola okweqile kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinyathelo zokwelapha ezingadingekile. Ungase udinge ukuthokoziswa izinto ezijwayelekile ngesikhathi lesi, futhi isibhedlela akusona njalo isikhala esishisayo nesithokozisayo. Ukubeletha ekhaya kuyinketho ephephile uma ukukhulelwa kwakho kujwayelekile, futhi umuntu obelethayo unokufinyelela ezinsizeni nasekusekeleni okufanele. Ukubeletha ekhaya kukwenza uzizwe ukhululekile endaweni ejwayelekile ngesikhathi ubeletha umntwana wakho. Uma ubhekana nezinkinga, usizo olutholayo luzoncika ekutheni umphakathi noma umuntu obelethayo unolwazi olufanele nokuthi bangakudlulisela kalula esibhedlela uma kudingeka. Lokhu kuwukubeletha emanzini okujwayelekile okungasetshenziswa njengendlela yokunciphisa ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ungahamba kalula emanzini. Kukhona ubungozi bokutheleleka kokubili wena nomntwana. Umntwana uzalwa ngokusika isisu nomphimbo. Lokhu kungathinta impilo yomntwana nomama, kodwa imiphumela yokuhlinzwa okukhulu kanye nokukhathazeka kungaholela ezinkingeni kumama. Ukulethwa kwe-cesarean okwenziwe ngokukhetha kuhlelwe ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa ngenxa yezinkinga zezempilo noma zokubeletha, lapho ukulethwa kubhekwa njengokungaphephile kumntwana noma kumama. Ukulethwa kwe-cesarean okuphuthumayo kwenziwa uma kwenzeka izinkinga ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ngezinye izikhathi, isidingo sokulethwa kwe-cesarean asicacile kuze kube sekuthathweni kokubeletha, futhi omama abahlose ukubeletha ngokujwayelekile bangase badinge ukulethwa kwe-cesarean. Ukulethwa kwakho kungahamba kabi. Izitho zakho zomzimba zingase zibe zincane kakhulu. Izinga lenhliziyo yomntwana, elizobhekwa ngedivayisi kagesi ngesikhathi sokulethwa kwakho, lingase libonise ukuthi umntwana uthola ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukuthwala izingane eziningi, ngokwesibonelo, kungase kudinge ukulethwa kwe-cesarean kwezinye izimo. Lokhu kuyisimo esingase sibe khona ezinsukwini ezine kuya kwezisixhenxe ngemuva kokuhlinzwa. Kunjalo ukuhlinzwa ngemedikwe elawula ukuthi umphimbo uvale futhi umise ukuvuza. Ukudluliswa kwegazi, ukuhlinzwa, kanye nasezikhathini ezithile, i-hysterectomy (ukuhlinzwa kokususa umphimbo) kungase kudingeke. Ukulimala kwe-bladder noma i-bowel kungase kwenzeke. Udinga ukubhalisela uHlelo lweMali Yezokubeletha ukuze ufinyelele ezinzuzweni zakho njengom member wezinye zezinketho ze-GEMS. Ukubeletha ekhaya kubiza u-R6,610 kumuntu ngamunye ngaphansi komuntu omkhulu.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekelela umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika; noma onenhlawulo yebhizinisi yokusebenza ebhizinisini kuleli; noma ofuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini esivele ikhona kuleli. Izicelo zingafakwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle ephakathi kwendawo lapho ibhizinisi lihlelelwe khona. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Umphakathi wezincwadi ozimele okhulumela wena kumele unikeze ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi inani elithunyelwe lilingana ngempela nenani elibekwe emibhalweni yebhizinisi. Inani elizothunyelwa libekwe ku-R2.5 million futhi le mali ingabekwa eceleni noma ikhululwe uma ihlangabezana nezidingo zelizwe, noma uma iceliwe nguMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Uma ukuhlala okungapheli kunikezwa, kumele uvuselele ukuqinisekiswa komphakathi wezincwadi njalo eminyakeni emibili ngemuva kosuku lokukhishwa kwephepha lokuhlala okungapheli, futhi kwezinye izinyanga ezintathu ngemuva kwalokho. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nale mfuneko kuzoholela ekutheni iphepha lakho lokuhlala okungapheli lihlukaniswe. Akukho sikhathi esibekwe kulolu sevisi. Amandla okuphatha mayelana nesicelo/sokwandisa iphepha lokufuduka noma ukuhlala okwesikhashana, i-BI-29.
Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS: Umqondo Womuntu Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho izinsiza zempilo zibalulekile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi banele yini ekutholeni izinzuzo zeGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le mikhakha ibalulekile emalini esiwela ukuyokhishwa ezinsizeni, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezempilo, futhi iphinde ibaluleke emiphumeleni yethu yokuphila. Ngaphambi kokuba sithathe ithuba lokuhlola izinzuzo nokufaneleka kwama-GEMS, kufanele siqonde ukuthi le mnyango wawakhiwe ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenziGovernment. Ukufaneleka kwe-GEMS kuncike ezintweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ubudala, kanye nezidingo ezithile zezokwelapha. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi akuyona yonke umuntu ongena kuhlu lwe-GEMS ofanele ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Okwamanje, kunemivuzo eminingi nezinzuzo ezitholakala kwi-GEMS, futhi lezi zinsiza zibalulekile ekunakekeleni impilo yempilo yabantu. Nokho, ukuthola lezi zinsiza akuhambanga kalula. Ukuthola izinzuzo ezithile kungadinga ukuhamba ngezinyathelo eziningi, ukuhlolwa okungake kwabangele izinkinga, nokuthi kube nezinsizakalo ezithile ezilungile nezikahle ezifanele ukuthola ukufinyelela nezinsiza ezihlinzekwa yiGEMS. Ngokuphathelene nezindlela zokuhlola ukufaneleka, kudingeka ukuba kube neziqu eziphakeme ezithinta ubunjalo besicelo sokuthola izinzuzo. Abazali badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala bazi ukuba ngubani ofanele ukujula, futhi lokhu kubaluleke ukuze kube nokusungulwa okufanele kokufaneleka kwe-GEMS. I-GEMS ibalulekile, kodwa ibhulogu yayo ihambisana nezinqubomgomo ezithile, okwenza kube importantes ukwazi izinzuzo ezithathwayo. Kodwa-ke, inkinga enkulu esibona kulezi zinsiza zempilo yikhono local ebhizinisini lendalo. Ikakhulukazi, ezindaweni eziningi, abanye abantu bashoda ngempela emalini yokuhlola izimfuno zabo. Lokhu kukhombisa umusa obalulekile, lapho izinsiza ezithile zempilo kufanele ziqinisekiswe abantu abaningi, kanti abanye abaphakathi nezocwaningo badinga izinsizakalo ezikhona. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukwazi ukuthi uGEMS unikeza izinzuzo ezinjengokhulumela wabanye abasebenzi baseGovernment kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokuziphatha ngendlela efanele. Abantu abanesizotha, kudingeka bahlole ukuqonda izimo abazitholayo, kanti lokho kudinga okubona okuningi esikhaleni se-GEMS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubiza amakhono aphesheya kwasekhaya. Abantu abaningi bangazihlola izinsizakalo ze-GEMS ngezinhloso ezithile, kanti kuyinto ebalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izindlela ezithile zempilo zinganikeza imikhakha ethile. Lokhu kungaba yinsiza enkulu emndeni, nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo. Alukho uhlelo oluhamba phambili, futhi lokho kuthinta izinqumo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlola okunembile nokunembile kokufaneleka kwe-GEMS kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuzuze izwe lonke. Lokhu kudinga izinto ezibucayi ezithinta izinsizasazi zempilo, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezitholakele. Ubulungiswa nokufaneleka kumele kube nemisebenzi ethile, futhi lokho kuzoholela kumuntu izinzuzo eziyinqaba. Abantu badinga ukuqonda izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngempilo ezithinta izinzuzo zemali, kuma-GEMS. Lokho kuhlelwe kahle kuyokwenza umthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo, ikakhulukazi uma buka imiphumela engabhalwa. Njengoba nesizotha kwenzeke, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izinzwa ezikhaleni ezithile zinganikeza ukuqonda okujule kokubili kwe-GEMS. Ukucacisa ngezinga elinomthelela yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekukhulumeni ngalezi zinsiza. Njengoba siqhubeka sikhuluma ngendawo ezithinta abafayo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okuhlosiwe kuqondwa ngendlela efanele. I-GEMS iwusizo kakhulu uma isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kodwa uma kutholakala ukungabi nalwazi, lokhu kungase kube nabantu abampofu. Ukugcina ngenxa ebalulekile nokuhlinzeka ngeziqondiso ezicacile kuyabhekwa, kufanele kubhalwe phansi imiyalo neziqondiso ezindawo ezithile, futhi umuntu ngamunye udinga ukuqonda izidingo zokuphila kwansuku zonke. Lokhu kufaka izinyathelo ezinzima kanti akusizi ukwenziwa ngezwi elijulile. Ukunciphisa lezi zinkinga, kudinga ukuthi sibe nokuqonda okuhle kwezeMali yempilo eqonde eqondile ukwenza umthelela ophakeme. Ngokuphetha, ukwazi ukufaneleka kweGEMS kuzokwenza umthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Khona lapho singayithola imiphumela emihle, ukuze uthole izinzuzo ezinqunyiweyo, kufanele sibe nesithunzi esihle, sithobela izinqubomgomo namazinga okukhuthaza. Umqondo wobuntu, ukuthola ngamandla kanye nezinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi zempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. U-GEMS, wonke umuntu ofanele ukusebenza, kulabo abawazi, izinyathelo zalolu hlelo zizoba yizibonelo eziqhubekayo zokuphila kwethu. Ngakho, kumele sihlosise izindlela zokuqonda okufanele, sigxile kulabo abasebenzi, sikhumbule izingxoxo ezinjengalezi. U-GEMS ungagcina ungumakhalekhukhwini ezimfanelweni zempilo. Kuqakathekile ukuba siqonde kahle ukuzikhandla kwansuku zonke, ukuze siphumelele ezimvumelwaneni nezinzuzo ezintsha ezikhaleni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nethuba lokuqondisa ikusasa.

Izinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Abasebenzi: Umqondo Wokuthuthukisa Umsebenzi Nezinga Lokuphila Ezikhathini zanamuhla, sazi kahle ukuthi umnotho wezwe uncike kakhulu kumakhono abasebenzi. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokukhula, kumele sibe nesithakazelo sokuthuthukisa amakhono abantu ukuze bagcine bephumelela emsebenzini, kodwa futhi baphile ngempumelelo. Izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwezakhamuzi, kodwa futhi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani ziyakwazi ukuhamba phambili emncintiswaneni. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqesha azikhona nje ukuze ziqedise imfundo ethile, kodwa zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze baqonde izinguquko ezisheshayo emikhakheni yabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwezobuchwepheshe, izifundo eziphathelene nezinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye neziqu ezifanele ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuzethemba kwabo. Uma sicabanga ngalezi zinto, singabona ukuthi ukufunda akupheli nje esikhathini esifushane, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, izinguquko zenzeka ngokushesha. Umuntu oneminyaka eminingi esebenza njengomsebenzisi wekhompyutha angase azithole esebenzisa izinhlelo ezidala, kodwa uma engatholi imfundo ethile yokuthi angalithuthukisa kanjani ulwazi lwakhe, kungenzeka aphume emsebenzini. Kulokhu, izinhlelo ezihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kumele zibe yizinhlelo ezivumelanayo nezidingo zemboni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abasebenzi bahlale bekwazi ukuhamba phambili, futhi benze umsebenzi wabo ngokuphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa kufanele zifake nesici sokuthuthukisa amakhono okuphatha. Abasebenzi abanamakhono okuphatha kahle bangenza umehluko omkhulu ezinkampanini. Umphakathi unemibono eminingi mayelana nezifundo zokuphatha, futhi kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphatha kahle akukhona nje ukunika imiyalo, kodwa kuhlanganisa nokuhola, ukuxhumanisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabasebenzi. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enempilo, lapho wonke umuntu ezizwa efaneleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zidinga ukuba zisetshenziswe ngendlela eqotho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokufunda. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zazo zifinyelela kubo bonke, futhi zingabi nezithiyo ezivela ezinkampanini ezithile. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho bonke abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, bafezwa, futhi bahlonishwa ngempela. Esikhathini esizayo, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhlanganyela kwezinkampani nabantu kungaba yisixazululo esihle. Izinkampani zingase zisebenzisane nezikhungo zemfundo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abasebenzi bahlale bephumelele, futhi baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkampani nezikhungo zemfundo kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izifundo ezidingekayo kumakhono anele. Ngokuphetha, izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abasebenzi zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlangano ezihlukene, futhi zihlinzeke ngokuqeqeshwa okusezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Uma zonke lezi zinto zikhona, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, makube yisibopho sethu sonke, kubandakanywa izinkampani, izikhungo zemfundo, nabantu uqobo, ukwenza kube lula ukufunda nokuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, ophumelelayo.

Ngokukhethekile mayelana ne-GNSS, ibhekisela ezingeni lokuhambisana kokulinganiswa, noma indawo ethile noma isivinini salo msebenzi ngesikhathi esithile noma endaweni ethile, kanye nesivinini sangempela esivame ukuvezwa njengokulinganiswa kwezibalo kwephutha lemishini, futhi kuboniswa njengokulinganiswa okujwayelekile nokuhambisanayo. a Uhlobo A1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, endaweni yokundiza, emgwaqweni ongawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. a Uhlobo B1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, endaweni yokundiza, emgwaqweni ongawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. b Uhlobo B2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezindaweni zokundiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. "Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C" uveza umshini we-GNSS onama-sensors okulandela i-GNSS ahlinzeka ngemininingwane ngomgwaqo ohlanganisiwe wokuhamba kwezindiza futhi uphinde usize ngokukhombisa indlela yokuhamba lapho iqhutshwa ngumshayeli noma umphathi wezokuhamba emoyeni ukuze kuncishiswe amaphutha ezobuchwepheshe emaphutheni e-FTE. a Uhlobo C1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, endaweni yokundiza, emgwaqweni ongawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. b Uhlobo C2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezindaweni zokundiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. Qaphela: Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C uzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nasemakhaleni okuthutha abantu emoyeni. Inqubo yokundiza efwini ibhekisela ezicwangcweni ezihlelwe zokusebenzisa amathuluzi okundiza athile ukuvikela ukuhamba kokundiza ezitheni ezingase zibe khona emgudwini wayo wokuqala kuze kube yilapho ifika endaweni lapho izinhlelo zokuxhumana zomhlaba zingasungulwa khona futhi zisize ekubambeni noma ekuzungezeleni kokundiza, bese, ngemuva kwalokho, ingabamba endaweni lapho uhlelo lokuphatha izithiyo zendawo noma izithiyo zomgwaqo zisebenza. I-GNSS ibhekisela kuHlelo Lokuhamba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe lwezindiza. Uhlelo lokuhlonza indawo nezikhathi emhlabeni wonke oluhilela ubuchwepheshe bokubona obukude noma ukuhlanganiswa kwabo, ama-receiver ezindiza, kanye nohlelo lokulandela olusekela ukuqapha nokuhlola izindiza emoyeni. Umcimbi we-GNSS ubhekisela ezimweni nasezimo ezifanayo neziphazamiseko zemishini, izinkomba, noma iphutha lomuntu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Ukuqina mayelana ne-GNSS kubhekisela ekwazini kwemishini ukukhipha izaziso kulabo abawasebenzisayo uma ukusebenza kwayo kudlula imikhawulo yokuphepha esunguliwe futhi akufanele kusetshenziswe ekulandeleni. Ukuhamba kwe-Edge/Side kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuhola ukuhamba ngaphandle kwezinkomba ezijulile ezihlobene nezindlela zokulandela ukuhamba ngendlela engawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli noma yokufuna uma idlula. Uhlelo lokuhamba lwezindiza oluyinhloko lubhekisela ohlelweni lokuhamba emoyeni olwamukelwe nguMphathi wezokuhamba noma ngesikhathi esithile sokuhamba, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuhlonza ezijulile nezokuqina, kodwa akusho ukuthi luhlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala noma ukuqhubeka. Ukuqina kolwazi olutholakalayo (RAIM) kubhekisela kuhlelo lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS luhlola ukuqina kwezimpawu zokulawula ukuhamba nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakala ngokukhalipha. "RVSM" kusho umehluko okhona phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 kuya ku-1000 feet uma kubhekwa ohlangothini olulodwa futhi ama-2000 feet uma kubhekwa ngokuqondile kokundiza. "RVSM airspace" kusho indawo yomoya phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 no-410 feet. "I-RVSM authorization certificate" ibhekisela esiqinisekisweni esikhombisa ukuthi ukuhamba kanye neqembu lezakhamizi kuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza ze-RVSM.
