Umphakathi uyaziswa ukuthi uMongameli uvumile umthetho olandelayo owashicilelwa lapha ukuze wazise umphakathi wonke. Amagama akhanyisiwe ngokuqinile akhombisa izichibiyelo kumthetho osekhona. Lokhu kuhlobene nokukhishwa kwemiyalo mayelana nokuvikelwa kwabantu ezimeni zokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya nezindaba ezihlobene. Ngokuhambisana nalokho okuphathwa yile mthetho, kubikwe ukuthi isimo sihlose ukugcina ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kuphumelele. Amalungu omndeni angabandakanya ubudlelwano bokhokho, umshado, noma ukujola, kodwa akukho budlelwano uma bengakaze babe nobudlelwano obuqinile, bengahambisani, bengahlangani noma bengashadile, futhi bengahlangani ngokocansi; noma bangahlala ndawonye noma babe sebekhulile ndawonye. "Ukuhlukunyezwa" kusho ukulimala okuphindaphindiwe; "lo mthetho" ufaka phakathi imithetho. Uma kudingeka, kufanele kube nesaziso esiqukethe ulwazi mayelana nomlamli ngolimi olusemthethweni olukhethwe ngumlamli; futhi uma kudingeka, umlamli kufanele aziswe ngalezi zinhlinzeko, kuhlanganise nezixazululo ezingamsiza ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho kanye nelungelo lokufaka icala uma kudingeka. Amaphoyisa angabamba ngaphandle kwecala noma yimuphi ophendulayo endaweni lapho ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kwenzeka khona noma lapho ophendulayo kuthiwa wenze isenzo noma icala elihlobene nokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kumlamli. Noma yimuphi umlamli angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuthola i-oda lokuvikela ngendlela efanele. a ngosizo olukhona ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho; futhi b nelungelo lokukhala uma icala elibhalwe nguMlamli lenziwa. Naphezu kwemigomo yomthetho, noma ubani ongakwazi ukwenza ngokuzimela, noma ubani omele omunye ongakwazi ukwenza ngokuzimela, angafaka isicelo sokuthola i-oda lokuvikela enkantolo ngaphandle kosizo lwabazali, umgadi, noma omunye umuntu ogunyaziwe ukusiza lowo ongakwazi ukwenza ngokuzimela. Isicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-1 singafakwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngosuku olungahlangani nezinsuku zokusebenza zenkantolo, inqobo nje uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi umlamli angalimala uma lesi sicelo singaphathwa ngokuphuthumayo. Amafidi avunyelwe abantu abanolwazi ngalesi sihloko angangezwa kulolu sicelo. Isicelo namafidi angathunyelwa kumlobi wenkantolo, ozothumela konke lokhu enkantolo. Inkantolo kumele iphathe isicelo esithunyelwe kuyo ngokuphuthumayo uma ingakwenza lokho ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-4 futhi ingase icabangele ubufakazi obengeziwe balesi simo uma ibona kufanelekile, kuhlanganise nobufakazi bukhuluma noma amafidi, azoba yingxenye yobufakazi ezosetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa enkantolo. a ophendulayo wenze icala noma ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya; futhi b kungase kube nokulimala kumlamli ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka kwale ndlela uma i-oda lokuvikela lingakhishwa ngokuphuthumayo, inkantolo kufanele, naphezu kokuthi ophendulayo akazange aziswe ngezindlela ezichazwe esigabeni-1, ikhiphe i-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana eliqondiswe ophendulayo ngendlela efanele. a i-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana elikhiphwe yinkantolo kufanele lathunyelwa ophendulayo ngendlela efanele futhi ophendulayo kufanele abuzwe ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezingavimbela inkantolo ekukhisheni lelo oda. b Ikhophi yesicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-4 1 kanye nobufakazi obubhalwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- kufanele kunikezwe ophendulayo ngokuhambisana ne-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana elikhiphe yinkantolo. Uma inkantolo ingakhishi i-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- inkantolo kufanele iyale umlobi wenkantolo ukuthi athumele ophendulayo ikhophi egunyaziwe yalolu sicelo nanoma yisiphi ubufakazi bama-affidavit asekelayo lolu sicelo, kuhlanganise nesaziso esiphakamisayo ophendulayo ukuthi anikeze izizathu zokuthi kungani engafanele athole i-oda lokuvikela lenkantolo eliqondiswe kumlamli. Izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a no-4 akufanele zibe ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokuthi ophendulayo ethole i-oda lenkantolo; ngaphandle uma izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a zingalindelwa ophendulayo ngaphansi kwezinsuku ezingaphansi kwamashumi amabili nesine. a kufanele icabangele noma yisiphi ubufakazi obutholwe ngaphambilini ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-5 1; futhi b kufanele futhi icabangele amafidi noma ubufakazi bukhuluma obuzoba yingxenye yenkqubo yokuhlolwa. a akumele abuze ngqo noma yimuphi umuntu obandakanyeka naye ngempela; futhi b uzobuza abafakazeli balesi simo ngokuhambisa imibuzo yabo enkantolo, futhi inkantolo izobuyisela umbuzo kubo. Inkantolo kufanele, ngemuva kokulalela icala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni-2, ikhiphe i-oda lokuvikela ngendlela efanele uma ithola ukuthi ophendulayo wenze icala futhi ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya. a qinisekisa ukuthi i-oda yale ndlela ithunyelwa ophendulayo; futhi b yenze ikhophi egunyaziwe yale oda, kanye necebo lokubamba elikhuluma ngaso esigabeni -8 1 a, okufanele ithunyelwe kumlamli. Umlobi wenkantolo kufanele athumele ikhophi egunyaziwe ye-oda lokuvikela nanoma yisiphi isikhumbuzo sokubamba esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni -8 1 a emaphoyiseni athunyelwe nguMlamli. Ngokusho kwemigomo yesigaba-7 7, i-oda lokuvikela elikhiphwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yalesi sigaba lihlala lisebenza kuze kube sikhanselwa, futhi ukuhlinzekwa kwalesi sikhumbuzo ngeke kukhanselwe kuphela ngenxa yesicelo sokukhuluma. g ukuvimbela umlamli ophila noma owayephezu kwabo endaweni efanayo njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni -c ukuthi angangeni noma ahlale endlini abahlala kuyo noma kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yendlu abahlala kuyo; noma h ukwenza noma iyiphi enye into njengoba kuchazwe ku-oda lokuvikela. a ukuthatha kumphenduli noma iyiphi impahla noma impahla engcuphe njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 9; futhi b amaphoyisa kufanele ahambisane nomlamli endaweni ethile ukusiza ngezinhlelo zokubuyisa izinto zabo. Inkantolo ingalayisha ukuthi ophendulayo akhokhe izidingo, kodwa yenze lokhu ngokucabangela izidingo nezinsiza zezimali zomlamli kanye nophendulayo nokuthi leli oda linomthelela ekwenzeni isinqumo se-civil case enkantolo ye-magistrate. a ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona kufanele likhishwe ku-oda lokuvikela, ngaphandle uma okukhuluma ngakho ku-oda kudinga ukuthi ikheli lomlamli lifakwe. b inkantolo ingakhipha noma iyiphi i-oda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona alikwazi ukuvezwa ngendlela engase ibangele impilo yomlamli. a ingavimbela ophendulayo ukuthi ahlangane nalowo mngane; noma b ilawule ukuxhumana ophendulayo nengane ukuze kube ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. i ukukhipha i-oda lokuvikela; noma ii ukuqinisekisa
Izinkinga Zemigwaqo Emadolobheni: Ukubuyekezwa Emadolobheni amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika, izinkinga zemigwaqo ziba yinkinga enkulu, ethinta izimpilo zabantu nsuku zonke. Imigwaqo emibi, ukungabikhona kwemigudu efanele, kanye nezithuthi eziningi zenza kube nzima ukuhamba kahle. Lokhu kudala izimo ezinzima, ezithinta umnotho, impilo, kanye nezinga lokuphila kwabantu. Ukungabikhona Kwezimali Zokwakha Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokungabikhona kwezimali ezanele zokwakha nokugcina imigwaqo. Izikhungo eziphezulu zihlala zikhuluma ngokuqinisa umnotho, kodwa uma izimali zingekho, imigwaqo iyahluleka. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izindawo eziningi zibe nezinkinga ezinkulu, njengokuphuka kwemigwaqo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba. Abantu bahlala bephazamiseka, futhi lokhu kudala ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabantu nabaholi. Ukukhula Kwezithuthi Okwesibili, ukukhula kwezithuthi emadolobheni kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokuthuthela emadolobheni, izimoto zanda, kodwa imigwaqo ayikhulumi. Lokhu kudala izimo zokuhamba ezinzima, lapho abantu behamba isikhathi eside ukuze bafike ezindaweni zabo. Izithuthi eziningi zikhuphula izinga lokungcoliswa komoya, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zempilo. Abantu bahlushwa yizifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abheke izixazululo eziphusile. Ukungabi Nezinhlelo Zokuhamba Ngempumelelo Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nezinhlelo zokuhamba eziphumelelayo kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Imigwaqo eminingi ayinazo izimpawu ezicacile, okwenza kube nzima kubashayeli nabahamba ngezinyawo. Lokhu kuholela ezimweni ezimbi, lapho abantu behluleka ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezibalulekile, njengezikhungo zezempilo, izikole, nezindawo zokusebenza. Ukuze sithuthukise izimo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhamba, ezihlanganisa izithuthi zomphakathi, ukuhamba ngezinyawo, kanye nezithuthi ezincane. Izixazululo Zokuthuthukisa Imigwaqo Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okubi. Kukhona izixazululo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze sithuthukise imigwaqo, kudingeka ukuthi uhulumeni abeke izinhlelo eziphusile zokwakha. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha imigwaqo emisha, ukulungisa leyo esivele ikhona, kanye nokwakha izindawo zokupaka ezanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngezithuthi zomphakathi ezisebenzayo kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezithuthi ezisemigwaqweni. Ukubambisana Komphakathi Kubantu, kubalulekile ukuba babe nesandla ekuthuthukiseni izimo. Ukuze sithuthukise imigwaqo, abantu kufanele babambisane nohulumeni. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezinkinga ezikhona, kanye nokubamba imihlangano yokuxoxa ngezixazululo. Umphakathi unamandla, futhi uma abantu behlanganyela, izinguquko zingenzeka. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, izinkinga zemigwaqo emadolobheni zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni, umphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Ukuthuthukisa imigwaqo akusizi kuphela abantu, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa umnotho, impilo, kanye nezinga lokuphila. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imigwaqo yethu iyasebenza, iphephile, futhi iyathandeka. Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, sizokwazi ukwakha amadolobha angcono, ahlanzekile, futhi anempilo.
UNelson Mandela: Impilo Nokusebenza Kwakhe UNelson Rolihlahla Mandela, owazalwa ngoMfumfu 18, 1918, eMvezo, eMpumalanga Kapa, wayengomunye wabantu abavelele emlandweni yeNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe. Njengomholi ophakanyisiwe, umthetho, nothisha, uMandela waphokophela ekufezekiseni ubulungiswa nentokozo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lapho eseyingane, wakhula ezimeni zokuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, okwamvusa ukuba abe nemicabango emisha yokulwa nobandlululo. Uthisha wakhe, uAlbert Luthuli, owayehola i-African National Congress (ANC), waba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, wamgqugquzela ukuba abe ngumholi. Waqala ukufunda ezikoleni ezinkulu, wathola iziqu kwi-Universitiy of Fort Hare. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo, uMandela waya eJozi, lapho ahlangana khona nezinhlangano eziphikisa ubuhlanga. Waqala ukusebenza ne-ANC, futhi ngonyaka ka-1952, waba ngusomabhizinisi ophakeme, waba nelungelo lokugcinwa kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweMasekhasi, umkhankaso wokumelana nobandlululo. UNelson Mandela waba ngaphansi kobufakazi obuningi, futhi ngemva kokudlula ezindaweni eziningi nezinto zempilo, waba yisithwathwa esibalulekile kwizinhlelo zempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Ekuqaleni kwawo-1960s, i-ANC yashaywa nhlangothi zombili, kanti uMandela wayesebenzisa imizamo yabo yokulwa. Ngo-1962, waqanjwa icala lokubamba abantu, kwathi ngo-1964, wathola isijeziso sokubeletha iminyaka engu-27. Lokhu kwakubuhlungu, kodwa waphendula ngothando, ethula imicabango yakhe ezikhaleni ezahlukene. Ngesikhathi esefuze uzithibe, waqhubeka nokuthola ukujabulisayo ezinhlelweni zomphakathi, uye wahamba nabafo emkhankasweni. Ngemuva kokukhululwa ngo-1990, waba nomuzwa omkhulu wokuvuselela abantu, futhi waphakamisa umholi wezinhlelo zentuthuko. Wavula umnyango wobumbano, kulethe imiqondo emisha yokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. UMandela wathola umklomelo we-Nobel Peace Prize ngonyaka we-1993. Ngomsebenzi wakhe omkhulu, wakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha, egxile emandleni abantu, kulungiswa ubudlova nobandlululo. Waphuma njengomongameli wesibili weNingizimu Afrika, wazuza impumelelo eningi ekuvuseleleni umphakathi nezwe. Ukuze aqedele ukwahlukaniswa, washintsha isimiso, uMandela wasebenzisa izinsiza ukuze aqinisekise ukuvota kwabantu bonke, ngokuhlukana kuphela kwezikhumbuzo zezakhamuzi. Eminyakeni yamuva, wabe esebenza njengomxhumanisi, enza isiqiniseko sokuthi abanye bahlala bekhumbula, ngenkathi kuvela izinkinga ezintsha. Uknownwa njengomuntu ophakeme, uMandela wabamba izinkulumo emhlabeni wonke, ethula khona indlela yokuphila ngothando, uxolo, nokukhuthaza. Ngesikhathi sika-2021, uMandela waphuma emhlabeni, kodwa izinsalela zempilo yakhe zisakhula. Umoya wakhe uhlala unjengomoya wokuphila esikhathini samanje, umfundisayo, umholi, nothisha. Nakuba kube nezinkinga ezithile, kuyaziwa ukuthi uNelson Mandela waphila engumuntu omuhle, owafundisa ubuntu nezimiso zempilo, ezalayo kuzo zonke izizukulwane ezilandelayo. Izifundo zikaMandela zisabhalwe emithonjeni yempilo, zikhuluma ngoThando, uBumbano, nokuthula. UMandela ubonisa ukuthi umuntu ungakhuluma ngesikhathi esinzima, futhi emsebenzini wakhe, abenzi banikeza amandla kubantu, ubukhona bokuqala. Ngale ndlela, impilo kaMandela iyimpumelelo yokuholela impilo eyanelisayo, eyengeza obala kumzuzu wezomphakathi nezwe. Ngakho, ungamubheka uNelson Mandela njengezimpawu, futhi ube yisibonelo sokuba ubenze bonke abanye, kuhlelo lokuqhuba izinguquko ezinhle ezimpilweni zethu. Uhambo lwakhe lwakha isizinda esiqinile sephephandaba lempilo, okuyinto eyasiza ukwakha indawo okukhona khona abantu abangaphezu kwalabo abanye; konke kuyi halfves, ukufana nesikhumbuzo. Ngakho-ke, uMandela asishiya nokubheka phambili ngaphakathi kwezinga lethu, sishiye imbali ethokozisayo.
ISIHLOKO: iCOVID-19 Isingeniso I-COVID-19, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-coronavirus disease 2019, iyisifo esibangelwa yi-coronavirus ebizwa nge-SARS-CoV-2. Le ndaba yokuqala yabelana ngempilo yomphakathi emhlabeni wonke, yaqala ngonyaka ka-2019 eWuhan, eChina. Kusukela lapho, iCOVID-19 yaguqula izimpilo zabantu, yaholela ekubeni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezimweni zokuphila, ezomnotho, nezokuhlalisana kwabantu. Ukuze siqonde kahle ubungozi obuhambisana neCOVID-19, kubalulekile ukuhlola imvelaphi, izimpawu, indlela yokudluliselwa, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwe ukuvikela abantu. Imvelaphi yeCOVID-19 I-COVID-19 yokuqala yahlasela abantu ngonyaka ka-2019, lapho kutholakala khona iziguli eziningi ezinemigudu yokuphefumula ephukile. Ucwaningo lwakamuva luveza ukuthi leli gciwane luhambisana nezinye izinhlobo ze-coronavirus, ezinjenge-SARS-CoV, eyabangelwa yisifo se-SARS ngo-2002, kanye ne-MERS-CoV, eyabangelwa yisifo se-MERS ngo-2012. I-COVID-19 ibonakale ikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo, ikhulisa izinga lokutheleleka phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba okuphila eduze. Izimpawu Nezindlela Zokudluliselwa Izimpawu zeCOVID-19 zifaka phakathi ukukhwehlela, umkhuhlane, ubuhlungu bekhanda, ukulahlekelwa ukunambitheka, nokuphefumula okunzima. Lezi zimpawu zingahluka phakathi kwabantu, kanti abanye bangaba nezinye izimpawu ezinzima. I-COVID-19 idluliselwa ikakhulu ngezinhlayiya ezikhishwa ngesikhathi sokukhwehlela noma ukukhuluma, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwayo phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-coronavirus ingaphinde idluliselwe ngokuqondile uma umuntu ethinta indawo ethintwe yisiguli esineCOVID-19, kube khona ukungena emzimbeni. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusabalala kweCOVID-19, izinyathelo eziningi zaphakanyiswa. Lezi zinyathelo zihlanganisa ukugqoka amakhanda, ukuhlala kude nabanye, ukuhlanzwa kwezandla njalo, kanye nokugwema ukuhamba ezindaweni ezinamathuba aphezulu okuthola abantu abaningi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka komphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo zaphinde zaphakamisa ukuhlinzekwa kwemithi yokuvikela, njengemithi yokuvikela ye-COVID-19, eyasungulwa ngokushesha ukuze ibhekelele ukusabalala kwesifo. Umthelela Emphakathini Umthelela weCOVID-19 emiphakathini ubonakala ngokucacile. Izinhlelo zokuphila zashintsha, izimboni eziningi zathola ukuncipha, kanti izinga lokungasebenzi lenyuka. Abantu babhekana nezinkinga ezinzima, njengezinkinga zezezimali, ukungabi namsebenzi, kanye nokukhathazeka ngempilo yabo neyezihlobo zabo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, njengoba abantu bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokubuyisela Ukuze kuqedwe umthelela weCOVID-19, izixazululo ezihlukahlukene zaphakanyiswa. Uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele, bahlanganisa izinsiza ukuze baphumelele ekuvikeleni abantu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokuxhasa abathintekayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke nokuhlonipha izinyathelo zokuphepha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezifunda, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuvikeleka. Isiphetho I-COVID-19 ibonisa ukuthi impilo yomphakathi ibalulekile, futhi izinyathelo zokuqapha zidingeka ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusabalala kwezifo. Ukuqonda imvelaphi, izimpawu, nezindlela zokudluliselwa kweCOVID-19 kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela weCOVID-19 emiphakathini ubonisa ukuthi kudingeka izixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze kuqedwe izinkinga ezibangelwa yalesi sifo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele kuzoba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, futhi ovikelekile.
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokwakha imiphakathi engakhethi abantu luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, kuyinsiza ebalulekile ukusiza uhulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukisweni. Ukwethulwa kwesakhiwo esicacile sokukhuthaza inqubomgomo ngokuqhuba iMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kwesakhiwo esisha somthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wokwakhiwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi kanye neMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zomphakathi kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lwabaholi bendawo olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zohulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokusebenza kokuhlela kwangaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengensiza yokuphatha imiphakathi futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo ngezindaba ezifana nokwabiwa kwezimali zomphakathi, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, kanye nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxoxisana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwemiphakathi kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi isakhiwo sokusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomphakathi. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi kwesinye isikhathi yahluleka ukuhlela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho sikhungo somthetho. Izinhlangano eziningi zomphakathi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Wokushintsha) zazinganazo izinsiza kanye namakhono okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho zinhlelo zokuhlela ezihlolwe kulezi zimo, futhi kwakungekho nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezisunguliwe nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kule ndima benze kahle kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona imiphakathi embalwa esebenze kahle ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ekuphatheni ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Iziqondiso ze-IDP, ezasungulwa yiqembu elihlukile le-DPLG ngoxhaso lwe-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha olwakhelwe abaphathi bezemiphakathi, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababambiqhaza abavela emiphakathini. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zomphakathi (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zokuphatha zomphakathi. Inani elikhulu lemiphakathi, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yohulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango ehlukene kahulumeni embonini ezweni iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele ekwakhiweni kwalezi ziqondiso ezintsha ze-IDP. Ngibheke phambili kakhulu ukuthi lezi ziqondiso ezishicilelwe zizoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubweni ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi zethu ngendlela ehlanganisa ikusasa elikhanyayo. Iziqondiso zesibili zisiza ekwakheni amandla emiphakathini ukuze iphumelele ezinhlelweni zayo ze-IDP. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuhlobene nezinto ezenzeka lapho kulungiselelwa isigaba sokuhlela. Ngamafuphi, umqondo wenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela, incazelo yokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe, kanye nomqondo wakho (1.1) Ukwethula nokuchaza izidingo ezibekwe emthethweni ngokuqhuba (1. Izincwadi ezihlanganisiwe (nokuhlangenwe nakho) okufanele zibe nezakhiwo ngenxa yesigaba sokulungiselela ukuhlela (1.3) ekugcineni, ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wokuqukethwe kwalezi ziqondiso (iziqondiso zesibili ziqukethe izinkomba kuzo zonke lezi zinyathelo zenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela kanye nemisebenzi edingekayo). Yini okufanele ilungiswe? Ukuhlela i-Integrated Development Plan kuthatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye, kuhilela abantu abahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle komphakathi. Le nqubo idinga ukuhlela ngokucophelela nokucabangela. Idinga uhlelo lwezebhizinisi. Izinhlelo zangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano kufanele nazo ziqalwe kanye nezinqumo mayelana namalungu eqembu, amakomidi, nezakhiwo ezizobe zikhona. Uhlelo olwakhiwe kufanele lwenziwe luveze imisebenzi ehleliwe, isikhathi sokuphothulwa, nezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwenza amalungiselelo. Le nqubo yokuhlela ibalulekile ekulandeleni nasekuxhumaneni nabanye ababambiqhaza (ikakhulukazi phakathi kwemiphakathi yendawo kanye nezikhulu zesifunda). Kubalulekile ukuqaphela lapho kuthathwa izinqumo mayelana nezindima nezimo zokubambisana ezizobanjwa umphakathi nabanye ababambiqhaza ngesikhathi sokulungiselela. Obani okufanele babandakanyeke kule nqubo, obani abazothinteka, futhi bazokwaziswa kanjani ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwenqubo? Lezi zonke yizindaba ezidinga ukuphendulwa ukuze kuboniswe abantu ngesikhathi esifanele futhi ukuphatha izinsiza ezidingekayo kahle. Izinhlelo ezifanayo zingahlelwa ngezindima nezimo ezizobekwa kulabo abavela ngaphandle komphakathi, njengemiphakathi eminye, izifunda, kanye nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni. Lo msebenzi wokubambisana kufanele unqunywe ngendlela ebindayo umphakathi usebenzisa isakhiwo sokuhlela esabelwe esidinga ukulungiswa kusenesikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izincwadi ezidinga ukucatshangelwa ngaphambi kokuthi uhlelo luqale zaziwa futhi zifinyeleleka. Umsebenzi wokulungiselela i-IDP akuwona umthwalo wezikhulu zamakhansela. Inqubo yokulungiselela kufanele ibe nesandla ekulungiseleleni umphakathi ngokusebenzisa inqubo ye-IDP. Ngakho-ke, akekho ozokwenza isinqumo somphakathi ngaphandle komphakathi uqobo. Iziqondiso zesibili zenzelwe ukusiza umphathi wombuso ekuphatheni umsebenzi wokulungiselela ngendlela elula futhi eqondile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nezidingo ezibalulekile ezilindelekile ezingeni lomphakathi lapho kuhlelwa inqubo ye-IDP nokuxhumana okufanele nezakhiwo zikahulumeni, izinhlelo zenqubo kufanele ziphathwe nguMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zomphakathi ka-2000. Lo Mthetho awuchazi lutho oluhlukile mayelana nezimo ezijwayelekile zokwenza amalungiselelo. a Ukwamukela uhlelo olwenziwe ngunoma yimuphi umphakathi wendawo noma wesifunda futhi oluphakanyiswe ukuze kuhlolwe inqubo yokuhlela, ukuhlela, ukwamukelwa, nokubuyekezwa kwe-IDP. Le ncwadi ebhaliwe ngenqubo ye-IDP izobizwa ngokufushane ngokuthi "Isakhiwo Senqubo" seziqondiso. Izimo, izindima, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana nokubambisana okufanele kwenziwe nomphakathi wendawo, izakhiwo zikahulumeni, ama
Ithelevishini: Umkhiqizo Wokuxhumana Nokuzijabulisa Ithelevishini, noma i-TV, ingenye yezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yanamuhla. Ihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuxhumana, obuvumela abantu ukuba babone, bazwe, futhi baphile izindaba, imidlalo, nezinhlelo ezahlukahlukene. Le mboni ithuthuke kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, futhi ibalulekile emiphakathini eminingi. Ukwakhiwa Kwe-Thelevishini Ithelevishini yokuqala yadalwa ngonyaka we-1927, kodwa yathuthukiswa kakhulu ngemva kweminyaka eminingi. Ukuze i-TV ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngomsakazo wevidiyo, kwakudingeka ubuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlobo ezahlukene zezinjini, ama-antennas, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Namuhla, ithelevishini isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili obufana ne-HD (High Definition) ne-4K, okuhlinzeka ngombukiso ophakeme kakhulu. Izinhlelo Eziyinhloko Nezithakazelisayo Ithelevishini inezinhlelo eziningi ezihlukahlukene, ezihlanganisa izindaba, imidlalo, amafilimu, nezinhlelo zempilo. Izinhlelo zezindaba zibalulekile ngoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi okwenzekayo emhlabeni. Abantu bahlala bekhuluma ngezindaba ezithinta izwe labo, izinkinga zomphakathi, kanye nezindaba zomhlaba wonke. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuba abantu baqonde izimo ezinzima, futhi baphendule ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Ngaphezu kwezindaba, ithelevishini inikeza nemidlalo ehlukeneyo, okuhlanganisa ama-soap operas, ama-reality shows, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Lezi zinhlelo zihlala zikhangayo, zenza abantu bajabule, futhi zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwemindeni nabangani. Abantu bahlala behlola izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze bathole ukuzijabulisa, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlanganyela. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe be-thelevishini buye buguquka kakhulu. Namuhla, abantu bangabuka ithelevishini nge-inthanethi, nge-smartphones, kanye nezikhumbuzo ezikwi-inthanethi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi abantu bangabuka izinhlelo zabo abazithandayo noma nini, noma kuphi, ngaphandle kokuba bahlale phambi kwe-TV. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ithelevishini ayisiyona nje into yokubuka, kodwa iyindlela yokuxhumana esheshayo. Izinkampani ezikhiqiza ithelevishini zikhuthaza njalo ubuchwepheshe obusha, okuhlanganisa ne-augmented reality (AR) ne-virtual reality (VR). Lezi zindlela ezintsha zenza kube lula ukujabulisa abantu ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, futhi zikhuthaza ubuhlakani bokudala. Imiphumela Emphakathini Ithelevishini inethonya elikhulu empilweni yabantu. Iphinde ibe yinsiza yokufundisa, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta imikhakha efana nemfundo, impilo, kanye nezokuphepha. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ithelevishini ingaba nemiphumela emibi. Abantu bangase babe nezinye izinkinga, njengezinkinga zokuhlukumeza, ngenxa yokubuka izinhlelo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuhlola okuqhubekayo kwezinhlelo ezikhona, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhuthaza izimiso ezinhle. Ikusasa Le-Thelevishini Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ithelevishini izoqhubeka ithuthuka. Ubuchwepheshe obusha, izindlela zokuxhumana, kanye nezidingo zababukeli zizoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni ithelevishini. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zabantu, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihambisana nezifiso zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ithelevishini ingaba yinsiza enkulu uma isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhetha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezimiso ezinhle, nokukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwemindeni nabangani. Isiphetho Ithelevishini iyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yanamuhla, enikeza abantu ithuba lokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ithonya imikhuba, izinkolelo, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle ithelevishini, ukuze bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele, futhi baqhubeke nokuthola izinzuzo ezinkulu ezivela kuyo. I-thelevishini, njengoba ibonakala, iyinsiza engapheli, futhi izoqhubeka ibalulekile emhlabeni wethu.
Yini ukuphathwa kolwazi? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuwumkhuba wezindawo ezahlukene osiza iminyango nezinhlelo ukuthuthukisa, ukwandisa, ukusabalalisa, ukuthola, ukuguqula, nokugcina ulwazi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zazo ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Yini inzuzo enkulu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Izinhlangano zizuza ngokushesha ukufezekisa izifiso nezinhlelo zazo, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza, ukusungula, ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha, ukuncintisana, nokwandiswa kwezindlela ezintsha zesayensi; kanti labo abasebenza nolwazi bathuthukisa umbono wabo nokukhuthazeka. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyisixazululo esisheshayo kuphela? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo hhayi isixazululo esisheshayo. Emhlabeni wonke, imikhankaso nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi ziqalisiwe, futhi akukho ukuhamba emuva. Imikhankaso yokuphathwa kolwazi iyindlela eya ikusasa eliphumelelayo. Yini ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphathwa kolwazi neSikhathi Solwazi? Ikhompyutha encane, i-Internet, kanye nezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwe emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi eMelika, kuholele ekwakhiweni kwegama elithi "Isikhathi Solwazi," kodwa kubonakala futhi ukuthi kuzobizwa ngokwengeziwe ngokuthi "Isikhathi Solwazi." Njengoba abantu bedlulela esikhathini seMboni ukuya esikhathini Solwazi, ezingeni eliphansi, ukuphathwa kolwazi kuvele kwathuthuka kakhulu ukuze kubhekwe izinguquko. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinto entsha? Izinqubo nezimiso zokuphathwa kolwazi azizintsha, njengoba kuboniswa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kolwazi okwenziwe ngabantu kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo (izibonelo zifaka phakathi izindlela ezisetshenziswe emlilweni, insimbi, ngebhontshisi) ezadluliselwa ezizukulwaneni futhi zakhula emhlabeni jikelele. Indlela ehlelekile yokuphatha ulwazi njengendawo yokugcina iyinsimu entsha futhi ethuthukayo, eyakhiwe yizinguquko ezisheshayo nezithuthuke kakhulu zobuchwepheshe nokuxhumana, kanye nokubheka ulwazi njengomthombo obalulekile wokusetshenziswa kwesu. Ulwazi luyindawo yokugcina ebalulekile njengezinsiza zemvelo, izinsiza zabantu, kanye nezezimali. Indlela imboni nezinhlelo ezisebenzisa ngayo ulwazi nezindlela ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zolwazi, kanye nokuthi ulwazi lwenziwa kanjani, konke kungafezwa ngempumelelo ngokusebenzisa isikhali esiyimfihlo sempumelelo, okuyiPhathwa Kolwazi. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuhlukile kwiTekhnoloji Yolwazi? Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyitekhnoloji noma isenzo? Ukuphathwa kolwazi akusiyona nje itekhnoloji noma isenzo esilula; kuyisistimu kanye neziqoqo zezitshalo ezisekela ukwabelana ngolwazi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano ethile ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhlelo nemikhankaso yokusungula. Ukuphathwa kolwazi (KM) kuhlobene kanjani nabantu? Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuphathwa kolwazi yizisebenzi ezibhekene nolwazi, abathintekayo abasebenza enhlangano ethile, kanye nalabo abaziwa ngolwazi futhi kulindeleke ukuthi basize amaklayenti ale nhlangano. Ngakho-ke, ukuphathwa kolwazi kuhlobene nabantu nokuphatha ukuphila kwabo, hhayi uhlelo oluphatha ngendlela yokulawula. Ukushintsha indlela yokwenza izinto kudinga ukushintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo kanye nenqubo endaweni yokusebenza eguqulwa ibe eyokwethembana nokwethembeka. Ukwabelana ngolwazi kuzosisiza abasebenzi benhlangano basebenzise ulwazi olukhona esikhundleni sokuzama ukudala okuthile okusha. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ngokucacile nangempumelelo ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi, okuholela ekusunguleni, okuyimiphumela yolwazi olusha. Yini umthelela wokuphathwa kolwazi ezicini zokusebenza zenhlangano? Enye iphuzu elibalulekile lokuphathwa kolwazi ukuxhumana kwalo nezinqubo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, okubeka inhlangano kanye nesikhungo ezingeni lokuncintisana nezinye. Yini umehluko phakathi kwedatha, ulwazi, nolwazi? Idatha imelela izinto ezibonakalayo noma eziqinile ezingaqhathaniswa nokuthile, ngakho-ke ayinani ngaphandle komongo. Ulwazi luwumphumela wokuhlela idatha ngendlela enengqondo nephathelene, imvamisa ethumela umlayezo. Ulwazi yilokho esikholwa ukuthi sinesikhathi esithile sokubaluleka ngemva kokuhlela nokwakha imiyalezo ngendlela eqondakalayo ngokusekelwe kumava ethu, ukuhlangana, noma ukuxhumana okuqondisiwe. Ulwazi lungabhekwa njengento engagcinwa bese isetshenziswa njengoba kudingeka, kanye nenqubo eqhubekayo yokwazi ehlanganisa ukuqonda nokwenza - inqubo evula ubuchule. Ulwazi luwuqoqo lwezinkolelo ezithathwa njengangempela, futhi le nkolelo ingabekwa ngumuntu okungenani oyedwa, ngendlela yemiyalezo nolwazi olwaneleyo olungaqondwa futhi lusetshenziswe omunye umuntu. Kumele kube nezindawo ezithile ezibonakalayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwamukelwa njengolwazi. Ingabe kukhona indlela yokukala nokuhlola izinga kanye quality yolwazi? Yebo, ngokubona ukuthi kusiza inhlangano noma umuntu ukufinyelela kalula izinhloso zabo. Ingabe kukhona iwebhusayithi noma ipulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Ipulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi isunguliwe ukuze inikeze umgudu wokuxhumana ukuze kube nokubambisana ngaphakathi kweSikhungo Sokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoba yindawo yokugcina yokuphathwa kolwazi, inikeza ulwazi mayelana nokuphathwa kolwazi futhi isetshenziswe njengendawo yokuxoxa ngokuqhubekayo ngePhathwa Kolwazi eNingizimu Afrika.
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhalisiwe kuleli, abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano esemthethweni ebhalisiwe eNingizimu Afrika ezingafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ukuhlanganiswa kokubhaliswa okukhulunywe ngakho ngeke kuhluke kulwazi lokuhlanganiswa okubhalisiwe kanye namagama avunyelwe kumakhasimende noma ephaketheni futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe yeMenenja. Imigomo ebekwe ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa kumele ilandelwe; ukubhaliswa okukhulunywe ngakho ngeke kudluliselwe kwezinye izilinganiso zamaphakheji noma iziqukathi futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe yeMenenja. Isicelo sokudla kwezilwane kanye nokubhaliswa kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumabhalisi noma kumuntu okhethwe temsilise umabhalisi. Igama lomkhiqizo, inombolo yokubhaliswa uma umkhiqizo ubhalisiwe, isizathu sokufaka isicelo, incwadi yokuvuma uma kudingeka evela kumabhalisi, inani elizokhokhwa, ama-check athunyelwa ngokwehlukana angahambisani nesicelo kumele ahambisane nencwadi yokuchaza kanye nephepha lokwakhiwa. Umuntu ophathiswe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ozokhuluma nenkampani kanye neMenenja, kumele assinwe amafomu wesicelo. Igama kanye nenombolo yokubhaliswa yomkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-sertifika yokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, noma ngabe sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuhlelwa kabusha. Thumela amafomu wesicelo ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuthumela amafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzophazamisa isikhathi sokuhamba kwenqubo. Kumele kubhalwe ngokucacile. Ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezixwayisweni zokuphepha. Lonke ulwazi kumakhasimende kumele luhambisane ngokexactly nalokho okunikezwa kufomu lesicelo. Ukubhaliswa kwesicelo kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.
Ukwakha Umlando Wokhetho Lukazwelonke eNingizimu Afrika Ukwenzeka kokhetho lukazwelonke eNingizimu Afrika kuyisixhumanisi esihlanganisa uthando, ubuhlungu, kanye nokuphikelela. Lokhu kuqala emlandweni wezombusazwe, lapho izigaba ezahlukene zashintsha impilo yamaNingizimu Afrika, kusukela ekubuseni komphakathi oyedwa kuze kube sekubeni umphakathi kadeni. Umnyaka ka-1994 waba yisikhathi esiyingqayizivele, njengoba ubandlululo belukhona, kanti abantu abamnyama babephikisana nezinhlelo ezazibahlasela. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zimo, kubalulekile ukukhumbula imikhankaso yokhetho, okuhlanganisa nemihlangano yokulwa nobandlululo, njengama-ANC, SACP, nezinye izinhlangano ezagqugquzela ukunyakaza. Ngo-1994, ukhetho lokuqala lweminyaka eminingi lwaba khona, lwavula amathuba amasha, lwavumela abantu abamnyama ukuba bakhulume. Lokhu kwaba yithemba elikhulu, njengoba ukhetho lwaluphinde lwavula indlela yokwazi kwabaningi. Abantu babephuma ezitaladini, bebamba amaphephandaba nemithombo eyahlukene, besekela i-ANC, begcizelela ikusasa eliqhakazile. Nokho, le minyaka yokhetho yayihambisana nezinselelo eziningi, njengoba iziphathamandla ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene zazizama ukuheha abantu. Abanye, ngenxa yokwesaba, babengafuni ukuveza izinkulumo zabo. Isimo sezombusazwe sasingesihle; abantu babejolise ezikhangisweni, besondela ezindaweni zomphakathi. Ngo-1999, ukhetho lwesibili lwaba yithuba lokwakha amathuba amasha, kwavula indlela yokuhola imiphakathi eminingi ezinguqukweni. Izinhlelo zokusebenza kwezinsiza, imfundo, nezokwelapha zathuthuka, kodwa izinkinga zokungathembeki nokuqoqwa kwemithombo zaba yinqaba. Njengoba uhulumeni waqala ukwakha izinhlelo, amalunga e-ANC azama ukuhambisana nokuhamba kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kwagcizelela ukubaluleka kwezinhlangano ezisemqoka emnothweni, nokuxhumana phakathi kwamakhaya. Ubufakazi bokukhula nokuhlanganiswa kwabantu bukhona kulolu hlobo lwezombusazwe. Ekupheleni konyaka ka-2000, abathintekayo bahlangabezana nezimo ezinzima, bahlola izinkinga ezibhekene nezinkulungwane zabantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekuphakamiseni umoya ophikisayo. Nokho, izixazululo zaphuma, zaphinde zavuselela izinhlelo. Ukhetho luka-2004 lwaba ithuba lokuhlola okwenzekayo ezindaweni zomphakathi, kwavumela abameli bezombusazwe ukuqonda ukuphila kwabantu. Noma izinkinga zikhula, abantu baqhubeka besebenzisa ilungelo labo lokukhetha. Izinyanga zaphuma, kuze kube yilapho ukhetho luka-2009 lukhumbuza abantu ngentshisekelo yokuvota, kodwa imiphumela ibonise ukungaboni ngaso linye. Abakhethiweyo bejolisa ekwakheni umphakathi, futhi lokhu kwavusa impikiswano. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, ukhetho luka-2014 lwavusa ukuzinza. Nokho, izinguquko zaphinde zaba nomthelela emigomweni. Ukhetho lwakha isimo sokukhula, kodwa izimo zaphinde zaba nzima. U-2019 wadala umoya wokukhumbula izimo eziyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa abanye baqhubeka bephakamisa izibuyekezo emnothweni. Abakhethiweyo bangena embusweni, behlonipha imiphakathi. Ukuphendula kwabantu kwaphinde kwavuselela isithakazelo, kuvumela abantu ukuba bakhumbule imikhankaso yabo. Namuhla, ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlonishwa, njengoba abantu bephokophela emisebenzini yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthuthuka okwenzekayo, nezinga lokwaziswa kwabantu. Izinkulungwane zabantu zikhumbula indlela eyayithathwa, futhi nakuba izinhlelo zingakapheki kahle, abantu bayazi ukuthi ezizayo zikhona. Ngakho, ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhona kuphela okwenziwa ngezinsuku ezithile, kodwa lukhombisa izifiso zabantu ngesikhathi samanje. Noma izinkinga zikhona, umoya wabantu uyavuma, ngoba lokho kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umzabalazo ungenzeka, kodwa ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlala luhlaza.
Ingxoxo Ngemiphumela Yokulamula Kwe-Life Esidimeni Okwesithathu: Ngiyabonga ngokungithokozisa ukuthi sibe nalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma ngempilo yalesi simo esibalulekile. Ungangitshela ukuthi uyini umbono wakho ngalokhu kulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni? Umnikazi: Ngiyabonga. Ngikholelwa ukuthi kulamula kwe-Life Esidimeni kube nezindlela eziningi ezihlukene zokubhekelela imiphumela, futhi lokhu kucacile emiphumeleni esiyibonile. Lokhu kulamula kubonise ukuthi kunezinkinga ezinkulu ezidinga ukulungiswa, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo. Okwesithathu: Ngicela ungitshele kabanzi ngokuthi lezi zinkinga zingaba ziphi? Umnikazi: Okokuqala, sithole ukuthi izinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo kulabo ababephakathi kwe-Life Esidimeni alifanele. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke, futhi abanye baphinde baphile ezimweni ezingezinhle. Lokhu kulamula kube yithuba lokukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, futhi kwavula indlela yokuthi abantu baphendule. Okwesithathu: Lokhu kubonakala kuhamba phambili. Ingabe ubonile ukuthi abathintekayo baphendula kanjani kulokhu? Umnikazi: Yebo, ngibona ukuthi abantu bephendula ngendlela ehlakaniphile. Abafundi, omama, nabanye abantu abathintekayo baqala ukukhuluma ngezinto eziphawulekayo. Lokhu kudalile ukuthi kube nezinsizakalo ezenzakalayo ezizama ukusiza abantu abathintekayo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo. Okwesithathu: Ubonisa umbono omuhle. Ngabe ukhona umphumela omkhulu ocacile ovela kulokhu kulamula? Umnikazi: Impela. Ubufakazi bokuthi kumele kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo buvele ngokusobala. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezikhona kufanele zishintshwe ukuze zifaneleke. Lokhu kulamula kubuye kube yithuba lokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi banelungelo lokuphila kahle futhi banakwe kahle. Okwesithathu: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani ezinjenge-Life Esidimeni zizophendula kanjani kulolu shintsho? Umnikazi: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izinkampani kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezibhekene nezidingo zabantu. Akufanele kube khona izinkampani ezizimele kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganyela nabantu ukuze kwenziwe izinguquko eziwusizo. Izinkampani kufanele ziqonde ukuthi zenza umsebenzi obalulekile, futhi kufanele zihlale zikhumbula lokho. Okwesithathu: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ucabanga ukuthi ikhona imfundo engaphumelelayo kulolu shintsho? Umnikazi: Yebo, imfundo ibalulekile kakhulu. Uma abantu behluleka ukuqonda amalungelo abo, bayoba nzima kakhulu ukufuna usizo. Ukukhuluma ngempilo, amalungelo, nokuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde ukuthi bangamukela kanjani usizo. Lokhu kufanele kube ingxenye yohlelo lokusebenza lwempilo. Okwesithathu: Ngabe ubona izinselelo ezithinta imiphumela yokulamula? Umnikazi: Yebo, izinselelo zikhona. Kunezinkinga zokuxhumana, izinsiza ezinganele, nokukhathazeka kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kungenzeka kube yingozi. Kodwa uma kuxoxwa kahle, ziningi izindlela zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Kufanele sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nalezi zinsizi. Okwesithathu: Ngabe ungathanda ukushiya umyalezo kubafundi, noma nabantu abaphakathi kokusebenza kulolu shintsho? Umnikazi: Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube nethonya. Akusikho kuphela ukuthi abantu baphendule, kodwa badinga ukwenza izinyathelo ezithile. Ukubambisana, ukukhulumisana, nokwakha isikhala sokusiza, yizona zindlela ezibalulekile zokwakha ikusasa elihle. Akufanele kube yinsakavukela, kodwa kufanele kube yisiko lokwazisa, lokuhlonipha, nokuxhumana. Okwesithathu: Ngiyabonga ngokukhuluma nathi namuhla. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuwusizo olukhulu. Umnikazi: Ngiyabonga futhi. Ngiyethemba ukuthi le ngxoxo izobeka izimpande zokukhuluma ngalezi zihloko ezibalulekile.
Othisha: Abakhulisi Bezemfundo Abalulekile Emphakathini Ezweni lanamuhla, othisha bahlala bebaluleka kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi, bephakamisa izinga lemfundo nokwakha isizukulwane esinobuhlakani. Njengoba imfundo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo, othisha bayizikhali ezinamandla ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlanga Lwemfundo Othisha bahlala bephakathi kwezinhlelo eziningi ezihloselwe ukuthuthukisa imfundo. Ngemva kokuhlola izifundo ezitholakalayo, kubonakala ukuthi abanye othisha baphokophele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukufunda, njengokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi othisha abavumeli izithiyo, kodwa bahlala bephokophele ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abafundi babo. Izinkinga Zokusebenza Nokho, othisha baphinde babhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, izikhala ezincane zokufundela, kanye nezimo zokusebenza ezingezinhle, konke lokhu kubangela ukuthi othisha bahlupheke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuhola zihlala zikhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuba othisha baphokophele ekwakheni imfundo engcono. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo baphendule ngamahlelo afanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi othisha bayakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle. Ukwaziswa Nokwakha Ubudlelwano Ukwaziswa nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi nothisha kubalulekile empumelelweni yemfundo. Othisha bahlala bephokophele ukwakha isimo sokwethembana, lapho abafundi bezizwa bekhululekile ukuveza imibuzo yabo. Lokhu kudala indawo yokufunda enempilo, lapho abafundi bekhuthazwa khona ukuba baphendule kahle ezimfundo zabo. Izifundo Zokuphila Othisha akugcini nje ngokufundisa izifundo ezisemthethweni, kodwa baphinde babe nemisebenzi ebalulekile yokufundisa izifundo zokuphila. Ngokusebenzisa izimo ezithile, othisha bahlala befundisa abafundi ngezindlela zokuphila, ukuziphatha kahle, kanye nokubaluleka kokubambisana. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala beqonda ukuthi imfundo ayigcini nje ngezifundo, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umuntu ophelele. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kothisha Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lemfundo, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kothisha zibalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono, izinkambo zokufunda, kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezihloselwe ukwakha ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Othisha baphinde bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zabo zokufundisa, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela abafundi ngendlela efanele. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kucacile ukuthi othisha bahlala bebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Njengoba bephokophele ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi wonke ubabheke njengabakhulisi bezemfundo abanezibopho ezinkulu. Uhlelo lwezemfundo luthanda ukuxhomeka kubo, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nesithakazelo sokubavikela, sibanikeze izinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi banokuthula emsebenzini wabo. Othisha, ngempela, bangabakhulisi bemfundo abathinta izimpilo zethu zonke.

Ikhansela izodinga idiphozi engabuyiselwa emuva yokufaka imibhalo yokubhida. Inani lediphozi lizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke. UMphathi Wezimali noma umuntu ogunyaziwe uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhokisi okubhida avaliwe kuze kube kuvulwa ngokusemthethweni futhi ukuthi aqinisekiswe ngendlela efanele. Ngesikhathi sokukhangiswa, ibhokisi lokubhida lizovulwa futhi livalwe ngabasebenzi ababili: omunye ovela eMnyangweni Wezinsizakalo Zezimali nomunye ovela eMnyangweni Wezokuphathwa Kwezokubambisana, lapho kufanele, umphathi ovela emnyangweni lapho kubhidwa khona. Ibhokisi lizovulwa emphakathini, okusho ukuthi kukhona imibhede kanye nezithakazelo ezikhona. Umphathi Wezokuphathwa Kwezokubambisana uzovula imibhalo yokubhida (endaweni echazwe emibhalweni yokubhida) nomphathi ovela eMnyangweni Wezokuphathwa Kwezokubambisana, umnyango ofanele, kanye nanoma yiziphi izithakazelo ezikhona.
