Amatekisi: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinsiza Zokuhamba Amatekisi, njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuhamba emadolobheni nakwezinye izindawo, abamba indawo enkulu ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Ukuphuma emsebenzini, ukuya ezikoleni, noma ukuhamba ngezizathu zokungcebeleka, amathuba okusebenzisa amatekisi ayanda. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ekubalulekeni kwamatikisi, izinzuzo nezinselelo zawo, kanye nezici ezithinta izinkonzo ezitholakalayo. Ukubaluleka Kwamatekisi Amatekisi anikeza indlela elula, esheshayo, futhi ethokomele yokuhamba. Ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamahlathi noma ezikhungweni eziningi, amatekisi akhombisa ukwanda okukhulu kokuhamba. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqasha izimoto noma ukuthola izindawo zokupaka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amatekisi avumela ukuhamba okukhululeka, okwenza kube lula ukwenza izinhlelo zokuhamba ezisheshayo. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Amatekisi Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa amatekisi wukuthi akudingeki ukuba umuntu abe nemoto yakhe. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kumuntu ongenayo imali yokugcina noma osebenza edolobheni elikhulu, lapho izindleko zokuphila zikhula. Amatekisi akhombisa ukuphuma okuhle kokuhamba, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo eziningi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempilo yomgwaqo. Ngokwezinye izinhlelo, amatekisi ahlinzeka ngezinsiza ezenzakalelayo, njengezinhlelo zokubhalisela ukuhamba. Lokhu kukhombisa ukusebenza kahle, njengoba abahambi bengakwazi ukuhlela izikhathi zabo kahle. Amatekisi abuye abe nezinselelo ezithile, kodwa, kanti lokhu kudinga ukwaziwa ukuze kube nokuhamba okusezingeni eliphezulu. Izinselelo Ezinzima Noma kunjalo, amatekisi anenkinga ezithile. Inkinga enkulu ibangelwa ubuningi bemoto emigwaqweni, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwezimo zomgwaqo. Lokhu kudala isikhathi sokulinda eside kumahamba, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunokukhathazeka ngokuqashwa kwabashayeli. Abashayeli abaningana bahlala bejolise ekwenzeni imali, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinqumo eziphuthumayo ezithinta ukuphepha kwabahambi. Futhi, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili busebenza kahle ematekisini. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezitholakalayo kakhulu zenza kube lula ukuhlela ukuhamba, kepha lokhu kukhombisa izinselelo ezithile, njengezinkinga zokuxhumana. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi, angathola kunzima ukuhlela ukuhamba ngendlela efanele. Izici Zokuhamba NgeMatekisi Ngokubheka izici ezithinta amatekisi, kudingeka sihlole umthelela wezindlela zamatekisi emiphakathini. Amatekisi avame ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yokuhamba, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu. Lokhu kudala amathuba okusebenza, njengoba abantu bezothola izisebenzi ezithile ukuze basize abantu abafuna ukuhamba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amatekisi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, njengoba abashayeli behlinzeka ngolwazi oluwusizo kumahamba ngezindawo ezithile. Ukubuka Phambili Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka buhamba phambili, amatekisi azobhekana nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizimele, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthuke kakhulu, kanye nokuqonda okuphezulu kwezidingo zamahamba kuzokwenza amatekisi abe ngcono. Amathuba okwandisa izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuqhubekisela phambili, kuzokwenza amatekisi abe yinsiza ebalulekile emiphakathini. Isiphetho Amatekisi, ngaphandle kokungabaza, abamba indawo enkulu ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Njengoba sikhuluma ngothando lokuhamba, imizamo yokwenza amatekisi abe nezinzuzo ezinkulu iyadingeka. Ukubuyekezwa kwalezi zinsiza kukhombisa ukuthi amatekisi akhuluma ngempilo yethu, futhi kumele sikhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwawo ukuze sithole izinsiza ezinhle nezithembekile zokuhamba. Ukubuka phambili, sithola ukuthi amatekisi azoba isixazululo esibalulekile sokuhamba ngesikhathi esizayo, sihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kumphakathi.
Umthetho Wokuphatha Omdala 38 ka-1927, isigaba 11 (b): Wonke umkakhe owenziwe ngokwesiko (ngaphandle kwabesifazane eKwaZulu-Natal) uzobhekwa njengesiguli. Isimo somkakhe silingana nesomntwana ngaphandle kwamalungelo omuntu omdala (ongakafiki eminyakeni engama-21). Umkakhe akanalo ilungelo lokugcina umntwana ngoba ubhekwa ngumuntu. Umkakhe akakwazi ukusayina isivumelwano somthetho ngaphandle kosizo lwemshado wakhe noma uyise. Umkakhe akakwazi ukufakazela amalungelo kodwa ungumfanekiso okumele wenziwe yilowo onelungelo. Umthetho wesiko unethonya kanjani emandleni okugcina umntwana? Ngaphansi komthetho wesiko, ukugcina umntwana kungelungelo elinikezwa umuntu nempilo yakhe ngokushada. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umuntu esehleli lobola/umshado, yena nomndeni wakhe bathola amalungelo aphelele okuba abazali phezu kwabantwana abavela kulomshado. Umthwalo wokugcina abantwana emshadweni uphakathi komuntu, umkakhe, nomndeni wakhe. Umthwalo wokugcina abantwana bomama abangashadile uphakathi kukayise wombala wabantwana nomndeni wakhe. Uma intombazane ishada futhi ibe nomntwana ekhaya, amandla okugcina le ntombazane kanye nabantwana bayo transferwa kumuntu ohlawule lobola nomndeni wakhe omusha. Ngakho-ke, umthwalo wokugcina umntwana ngokwesiko ushintsha ezandleni zomuntu kuphela (emshadweni), futhi abantwana baba yingxenye yomndeni womuntu. Ukugcina umntwana kwenziwa ngumuntu egameni lomndeni wakhe. Umntwana noma abantwana abavela ekhaya abavunyelwe ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngoba umntwana bekukhona ekhaya, kwesinye isikhathi ehlala nabazali bomama babo (ngaphambi komshado) noma ehlala nomndeni omusha wombala lapho umama wakhe eshade, okukhuluma ngenye yezisho ethi "inkunzi ithengwa ngebhubezi". Kukhona isidingo sokucacisa uhlobo lomshado umkakhe angaba kuwo. Abantwana abavela emshadweni: Laba ngabantwana bomuntu nomndeni wakhe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela uyise. Kulindeleke ukuthi uyise wombala wabantwana wamukele laba bantwana njengabomdabu wakhe futhi agcwalise zonke izibopho zomzali eziphathelene nabo. Ukufa komuntu akusho ukuphela kobudlelwano bomshado. Abantwana bomama abashadile bahlukaniswa kanje: (i) abantwana bomuntu oshade nomama. Ngaphansi komkhuba wokushada kwe-levirate, umshado okhona uqhubeka nomama nomuntu ofaka esikhundleni somufi futhi uqhubeke ngezizathu zakhe. Umama nabantwana bakhe banakekelwa ngumuntu ofaka empilweni yomama. Umuntu ofaka kumama uvame ukuba omunye wabangane bomndeni womufi. Umndeni womufi unomthwalo wokunakekela umama impilo yakhe yonke nokuzibophezela ekuthwaleni abantwana abazofakwa emntwaneni ohlanganyela naye. Abantwana abavela kumama nomuntu ofaka kumama bazobhekwa njalo njengabantwana bomuntu omufi. Ngisho nasemikhubeni lapho umuntu efaka umkakhe, uma umama ethwala abantwana, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela umama noma abantwana babo, bazobhekwa njalo njengabantwana bomuntu omufi kanye namalunga omndeni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuhlukana, abantwana bavame ukusala nomndeni womuntu. Imithetho eminingi yesiko ayivumeli umkakhe ukuba ashade futhi esaphila ngaphansi komndeni womuntu. Kumele abuyele emndenini wakhe uma efuna ukushada. Uma eshade, umntwana ophuma kumama ophumile emshadweni wakhe wesibili ubhekwa njengomntwana wombango, ngakho-ke ungowomndeni womuntu wesibili. Umuntu wesibili umphathi noma umgibeli walaba bantwana. Emshadweni wesibili, umama ophumile akamukelwa ngumuntu wesibili ukuba aze nabantwana bakhe emshadweni wabo. (okukhuluma ukuthi abantwana baphuma ngesikhathi benakekelwa ubaba babo ngemuva kokubuyela kubo ngemuva kokuhlukana), ngaphansi kwalolu suku, umuntu omusha ufaka abantwana bakhe emshadweni. Imithetho yesigaba 11 (b) yeMithetho Yezokuphatha Omdala yayihloselwe ukuphatha isimo lapho umkakhe ezohlala engumntwana kuyilapho umuntu ezoba umphathi wakhe. Umphumela walolu sigaba uthi: Abesifazane abangashadile babhekwa njengabantu abadala (okudlula eminyakeni engama-21) kuyilapho abesifazane abamnyama abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abashadile ngokwesiko babhekwa njengabantwana. Umkakhe omnyama oshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko unamalungelo akhe omdala aphazanyiswa ngenxa yomshado noma uma engaphansi kweminyaka engu-21, ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphakama Kwezimali Nokukhululwa. Isimo sabo sikhawulela ikhono labo lokungena ezivumelwaneni zomthetho, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bodwa noma uma befuna temsilwa abantwana babo. Ngakho-ke, umthetho wesiko lwama-Afrika awuqinisekisi abesifazane base-Afrika isithunzi esifanele nokuphathwa ngaphansi komthetho ngendlela eyasungulwa nguMthethosisekelo wesizwe. Ngakho-ke, lesi sigaba sikhuthaza ukwehlukaniswa kwabantu besifazane ngokugxila ebudlelwaneni, ngakho-ke kuhlangana noMthethosisekelo. Lesi sigaba siqinisa isiko elilawula elinika amandla wonke abantu ukuba balawule izimpilo nezimpahla zabesifazane. Umthetho wokugcina abantwana unika bobabili abazali amandla okugcina abantwana. Umuntu ubhekwa njengoyise babantwana futhi akakwazi ukubaphika. Ngenxa yemvelo yokukhulelwa kwabo nokuzalwa, abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa futhi abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa nabanye abantwana abavela emshadweni. Umuntu ungumgibeli nomphathi wabantwana, enomthwalo wokubamukela njengabanye abantwana abavela ngemuva kokuthi umshado uqinisekiswe. Laba bantwana bangamalunga omndeni womuntu. Uyise wombala akanakho izwi noma amalungelo phezu kwabo. Ngaphansi kwesigaba esifanayo, abantwana abavela ngemuva kokufika komkakhe nabo bayafakwa. Ngale ndlela, umthetho wesiko uhambisana nesigaba 8 soMthethosisekelo futhi awuhlukanisi phakathi kwabantu abantwana ngokusekelwe emvelweni yabo nasekuzalweni. Bahlale emndenini wombala. Uma umkakhe eshade nomama wakhe, yena nomyeni wakhe bazogcina labo bantwana. Umuntu uthola amandla okuba abazali ngabantwana abavela ngokuhambisana nalesi sisho esithi "inkunzi ihamba ngebhubezi." Akuzokwenziwa ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwalezi zinsizwa nabantwana bomshado. Ngakho-ke, akukhona ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwabantu abantwana ngendlela engase ihlasele uMthethosisekelo. Uma umama eshiya umndeni womuntu, ushiya abantwana. Uma efuna ukuphikisa lesi simo, yena nomphathi wakhe kufanele bathathe izinyathelo zokukhombisa ukuthi umuntu akafaneleki futhi akafaneleki ukuba aphile nabantwana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi njalo kukhona ukukhombisa okhetha umuntu nomndeni wakhe njengabantu okufanele banakekele abantwana. Banikezwa amandla angaphikiswa okugcina abantwana. Ezinye izimo lapho abantwana bangashiywa ezandleni zomama babo zenzeka lapho besaphila (bephuza). Lokhu kuyisibonelo esisodwa lapho izidingo zomntwana ziba phambili kunamandla angaphikiswa ayise okugcina abantwana. Ngakho-ke, izinkantolo zendabuko zinika uyise wombwana
Isithombe 1: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa engakaze ifafazwe ngempushana, ngakho izihlahla zibhakabhaka. Isithombe 2: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa efafazwe ngempushana ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala. Isithombe 3: Zama ukuthola isitshalo seziphuzo kulesi sithombe! Isithombe 4: I-filter ye-nozzle yokufafaza igcwele. Isithombe 5: Imikhono yomshini wokufafaza igcwele. Isithombe 6: Ukuvimbela kwale mikhono kungenzeka uma umshini ungcolile futhi ungagcinwanga kahle. Izithombe 1 no-2 zithathwe ensimini efanayo eMpumalanga Kapa - isithombe 1 sikhombisa lapho impushana ingafakwanga - isithombe 2 sikhombisa lapho ifafazwe khona ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala - umehluko ubonakala kahle! Singasho ukuthi zonke izitshalo ezikhulayo ezindaweni lapho zingadingeki khona zingama-weed. Ama-weed ayinkinga uma kukhuliswa izitshalo zokudla ngoba ancintisana nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi nezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, kuholela ezinkingeni ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kucasula izitshalo zokudla, imbewu yazo ingangenisa ama-toxins ekudleni, futhi zingaba nezilokazane nezifo ezibangela ubungozi. Ama-weed akhula ngokushesha futhi akha kalula. Ahlala enezimpande eziqinile futhi akwazi ukuzivumelanisa kahle nezimo zezulu ezahlukene. Kunzima ukuwakhupha; aqinile futhi ancintisana ngokushelela nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi nezinto ezidingekayo. Ama-weed anendlela ezahlukene zokuphindisela, ngakho kufanele siqaphele ngalokhu uma sizama ukuwakhupha. Ama-weed angakhiqiza imbewu (ngokuvamile ngokushesha nangokulula), ezinye izinhlobo zine-rhizomes phansi komhlaba, ezinye zine-stolons phezulu komhlaba, ezinye zine-tubers, kanti ezinye zineziphuzo ezinkulu. Omunye umkhiqizo, ofana ne "nut grass," unakho konke lokhu - ukhiqiza imbewu, unama-tubers, futhi unama-rhizomes phansi komhlaba - lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuwakhupha. Imbewu ye-weed ivamise ukuhlala isebenziseka futhi ingaphila emhlabathini isikhathi eside kuze kube nezimo ezifanele zokukhula. Imbewu ye-weed nayo ayikhuli ngasikhathi sinye - ezinye zizokhula ngokushesha, kanti ezinye zizolinda. Ngokuvamile, ziqala ukukhula uma umhlaba uphazamisekile. Izimpande ze-weed zivame ukungena kakhulu emhlabathini, zidlula izimpande zezithako zokudla, zivumela ama-weed ukuba aphumelele ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ama-weed akhulayo unyaka nonyaka agcina izinto ezidingekayo ezimpandeni zawo phansi komhlaba - ngesikhathi sezikhathi ezinzima zokukhula, angaphumelela. Ama-weed angaba yonyaka (akhula unyaka owodwa), ezinye izinhlobo ziba yizinyanga ezimbili (akhula iminyaka emibili), kanti ezinye ziba yizinyanga eziningi (akhula iminyaka eminingi). Kungani kubalulekile ukulawula ama-weed ezitshalo zokudla? Ama-weed ancintisana nezitshalo ngamanzi emhlabathini, ngezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, nendawo yokukhula, kanye nokukhanya (ilanga). Le mncintiswano ibangela ukuthi izitshalo zingakhuli kahle, futhi umkhiqizo unciphe. Kungase futhi kucasule imbewu futhi kwehlise izinga lempilo yembewu. Le mncintiswano iyahluka - ezinye izinhlobo zama-weed azibeki ingozi enkulu ezitshalo ezithile - ingozi ingaba phansi, njenge 10%, kodwa ingakhuphuka ibe ngu-98%. Ama-weed aqala ukuncintisana nezitshalo uma sekuqinisekisiwe izimpande eziqinile - ngemva kokukhula. Ukulawula ama-weed kusho ukuvimbela le mncintiswano, nokuvimbela ama-weed ekukhiqizeni imbewu ezokhula futhi ancintisane nezitshalo ezizotshalwa ngonyaka olandelayo. Bonke abalimi abafuna ukuphumelela ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zokudla kufanele balwe nama-weed ngaso sonke isikhathi - ama-weed ayinkinga enkulu. Ngokuvamile, ama-weed alawulwa usebenzisa imishini ngokusebenzisa umhlaba noma ngekemikhali - kaningi lezi zindlela zombili zisetshenziswa. Uma umlimi ephumelela ekulawuleni ama-weed, insimu izoveza kuphela izitshalo ezitshaliwe - akukho ma-weed! Kodwa kaningi lokhu akwenzi kalula, futhi ama-weed aqhubeka. Kungani ama-weed engase alawulwe kahle? Kukhona izinto ezintathu ezingenza ukulawulwa kwama-weed kungaphumeleli - okokuqala kungaba indlela yokulima kanye nomshini osebenzisayo, okwesibili kungaba impushana efakwe, futhi okokugcina kungaba izimo zezulu. Izilungiselelo zomshini zingase zingabi seduze, futhi kungase kube nezikhala, kuvumela umhlaba phakathi kwezihlahla ukuthi ungafakwa kahle (uma ziqinile, azizosebenzi kahle). Ukuphakama kokulima kungase kungafiki kahle - izimpande zama-weed ezihlala isikhathi eside zihlala ziqinile emhlabathini, futhi ama-weed angaphinda akhule. Isivinini somshini singase sibe siphansi kakhulu - kufanele sisebenze ngokushesha ukuze siphazamise umhlaba kahle. Umhlaba ungase ube manzi kakhulu - ama-weed afakwe asaqhubeka nokuxhumana nomhlaba ongena manzi futhi angaphinda akhule. Ukulungiswa komshini kungase kube phambene. Isikhathi sokufafaza ama-weed singase singabi sesimweni esifanele. Impushana esetshenziswayo ingase ingasebenzi kahle kulolu hlobo lwe-weed. I-filter ye-nozzle yokufafaza igcwele (isithombe 4). Imikhono yomshini wokufafaza igcwele (isithombe 5). Ama-nozzles angafaneleka asetshenziswa (khumbula ukusebenzisa i-nozzle enesimo se-cone uma ufafaza phezu kwezihlahla, futhi i-flat fan nozzle uma ufafaza phezu komhlaba). Umshini ungase ungakahlanzwa kahle ngonyaka odlule - izinto eziningi zingavimba, futhi ngeke usebenze kahle uma kukhona okushiywe okungcolile. Ingxenye yekhemikhali idinga imvula ngemva kokufafaza ukuze isebenze kahle - uma kunganaki, impushana ayikwazi ukuqala ukusebenza. Izimo zezulu ezishisayo kakhulu nezomile zingavimbela impushana ekusebenzeni kahle. Imvula eningi ngemva kokulima ingabangela ama-weed ukuba 'aphinde akhule.' Ukuphatha nokulawula ama-weed kubalulekile kakhulu - uma singakwenzi kahle, ngeke sithole umkhiqizo omuhle. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokungaphathi ama-weed kahle esikhulume ngazo ngenhla - kodwa ekugcineni kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphatha yonke imisebenzi yakho yokulima kusenesikhathi kubalulekile. Lo nyaka ububalulekile ekulungiseni lezi zinkinga, kodwa lokho esikufundile kungasiza ekuthuthumeleni phambili konyaka olandelayo. Iphutha elidala esalenzile esikhathini esedlule kufanele lisifundise ukuthi singaliphindi esikhathini esizayo; kungcono ukwenza amaphutha amasha!
Imvume yokusebenza ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano iyidokhumenti enikezwa abantu ababuya ngaphandle kokungena eNingizimu Afrika ukuze babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezivumelwene phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezizwe ezithintekayo kulezi zivumelwano. Gcwalisa ifomu BI - 1738 ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni oseduze. Incwadi evela kwinhlangano kahulumeni efanele esivumelwaneni, eqinisekisa uhlelo. Le ncwadi izoqinisekisa ukuvumelana kohlelo olusetshenziswa, ukubamba iqhaza komfakisicelo okukhulunywa ngaye kuhlu, kanye nemisebenzi elindelekile ezokwenziwa ngumfakisicelo ngaphansi kwesivumelwano. Isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka komphakathi somfakisicelo esivela kuzo zonke izizwe lapho umfakisicelo nabantu abaxhomeke kuye bahlala khona, kusukela eminyakeni engu-18, kanye nezingane ezixhomeke kuye ezineminyaka engu-18 nangaphezulu, ezizohamba nomfakisicelo ziye eNingizimu Afrika. Imibiko yezempilo kanye nemibiko ye-x-ray. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-12 kanye nabesifazane abakhulelwe kumele zibe nemibiko ye-x-ray. Incwadi yokuzibophezela evela kumqashi, lapho bevuma ukukhokhela izindleko zokubuyisela umfakisicelo, kanye nalabo abaxhomeke kubo uma kudingeka. Uma umqashi engumnyango kahulumeni futhi engakwazi ukukhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela, izwe elithumele lowo muntu lingakhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela. Amadokhumenti ahlobene nesimo somshado, i-affidavit yabantu abaxhomeke kumfakisicelo noma izingane ezincane ezixhomeke kumfakisicelo azizokwenza kube khona abantu abaxhomeke kubo nezingane. Isitifiketi sokugomela i-yellow fever uma uhamba noma uhlela ukuhamba endaweni eyaziwa ngokuba ne-yellow fever.
Abadlali Bebhola Abadumile Ibhola lezinyawo, elibizwa nangokuthi ibhola, liyinsika enkulu emhlabeni, linabantu abaningi abathanda ukuhamba, ukudlala, nokuxoxa ngalo. Phakathi kwale midlalwano, kukhona abadlali abaninzi abavelele nabathandwa kakhulu ngenxa yemiphumela yabo. Kulokhu, sizobheka abadlali bebhola abadumile, imisebenzi yabo, kanye nomthelela abawenza emhlabeni jikelele. Ukwaziswa Ngabadlali Abadumile Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningi, kodwa ikhono labo lokudlala libaluleke kakhulu. Abanye baziwa ngempumelelo yabo kumqhudelwano omkhulu, njengeFIFA World Cup, iChampions League, noma emakhampasini emazwe. Abanye baziwa ngamaqembu abawadlalela, njengamaqembu afana neBarcelona, Real Madrid, Manchester United, neBayern Munich. UMessi noRonaldo: Izinkanyezi Zamanje Omunye wabadlali abaziwa kakhulu nguLionel Messi. UMessi, odlalela iParis Saint-Germain (PSG), ubhekwa njengomunye wabadlali abakhulu besikhathi. Uthole izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise neBallon d'Or, okuyisicoco esinikezwa kumdlali ophakeme. Ubuye abe nekhono elikhulu lokudlala, ukuhamba, nokuphosa amabhola, okwenza kube nzima kubavikeli ukumvimba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uCristiano Ronaldo, odlalela iAl Nassr, naye ungomunye wabadlali abaziwa kakhulu. U-Ronaldo uphinde wathola izindondo eziningi, futhi ubalulekile emlandweni wezemidlalo. U-Ronaldo unamandla amakhulu, futhi uyaziwa ngokuphosa amabhola anamandla, okwenza kube nzima kubavikeli. Abanye Abadlali Abadumile Ngaphandle kukaMessi noRonaldo, kukhona nabanye abadlali abavelele. UNeymar, odlalela iPSG, ungomunye wabadlali abathandwa kakhulu ngenxa yokudlala kwakhe okuthokozisayo. UMbappe, osemncane, naye ungomunye wabadlali abavelele, futhi ubhekwa njengomunye wabadlali abasha abakhombisa ikusasa elihle. UDavid Beckham, owayedlalela iManchester United, ungomunye wabantu abaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Umthelela Wabadlali BeBola Emphakathini Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini yabo. Bahlala bephakamisa izinga lezemidlalo, futhi bahlala bejabulisa abantu. Abanye bazo basebenzisa udumo lwabo ukusiza abanye, ngokwesibonelo, ngokuxhasa imikhankaso yokusiza, izikhungo zemfundo, noma imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abadlali bebhola bahlala benomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini, bukhulisa imikhiqizo, futhi baphakamisa izinga lokuthengisa, okwakha amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini. Isiphetho Abadlali bebhola abadumile bahlala bephakamisela abantu ithemba, futhi bahlala benomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele. UMessi, uRonaldo, uNeymar, noMbappe baveza ukuthi ibhola akusikho kuphela ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abadlali abavelele bahlala benza okuningi ngaphandle kokudlala, futhi baphakamisa umoya wokubambisana, umphakathi, kanye nezifiso zabantu. Ibhola liyinsika yokuxhumanisa abantu, futhi abadlali bayo bahlala bephakamisela umhlaba umoya ophakeme.
Ezokusakaza: Umthelela Wazo Emphakathini Wethu Ezokusakaza, okuyindlela yokusakaza ulwazi, ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu yansuku zonke. Lezi zindlela zokuxhumana zixhumanisa abantu, izinkampani, nohulumeni, futhi zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umbono wethu ngezinto ezahlukene. Iziteshi zethelevishini, umsakazo, nezinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emiphakathini yethu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ezokusakaza azikhona nje ukuze ziqhube ulwazi, kodwa futhi ziwumthombo wokwakha umphakathi. Iziteshi zethelevishini nezomsakazo zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, zifaka izingxoxo eziphusile, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu bengatholi kalula izinsiza ezitholakala ezindaweni ezinkulu. Ngakho, ezokusakaza ziba yindawo yokuhlangana, yokuxoxa, nokwabelana ngemicabango. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokusakaza zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umbono wobuntu bethu. Izindaba eziphuma eziteshini zethelevishini nezomsakazo zikhombisa izimo ezahlukene zomphakathi, zikhuthaza ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, lapho abantu bejabulisa izinkolelo zabo, izinkolelo, nemibono. Uma izindaba zikhuluma ngempilo yabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, futhi zikhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Futhi, ezokusakaza zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umbono wezombusazwe. Iziteshi zethelevishini nezomsakazo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ezinqubweni zomphakathi, zikhuthaza ukhetho, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba umphakathi onolwazi ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqumo ezinhle. Uma abantu bekwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi oluqondile nolunembile, bazoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ezokusakaza nazo zinezinselelo zazo. Ukusakaza okungelona iqiniso, izindaba eziphambene, kanye nezinkampani ezithile ezithanda ukulawula ulwazi, konke lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi emphakathini. Uma abantu bephathwa ngolwazi olungelona iqiniso, bangase benze izinqumo ezingalungile. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokulawula ezokusakaza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi olutholakalayo luyiqiniso, luhlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi lukhuthaze umoya wokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka buhamba phambili, futhi ezokusakaza kufanele zihlale zishintsha ukuze zifanele izidingo zabantu. Izinkundla zokuxhumana ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile yokusakaza, futhi abantu bathola ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubavumela ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. Nokho, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana nazo zinezinselelo zazo, futhi kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokulawula ulwazi olutholakalayo. Ekugcineni, ezokusakaza zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi, zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, futhi zenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emiphakathini yethu. Nokho, kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokulawula ezokusakaza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi olutholakalayo luyiqiniso, luhlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi lukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Ngakho, kumele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, lapho ezokusakaza ziba yinsika yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nokwakha umbono wobuntu bethu.
Ucwaningo olwenziwe uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luthole ukuthi kunezinto eziningi ezenza kube nzima kubalimi abasha ukufaka esikhundleni sabalimi bezinhlanzi. Ama-traktor nemishini esetshenziswa abalimi abasha awasebenzi kahle, futhi bangenamali yokuthenga imishini emisha noma engcono - inzuzo etholakala ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu incane, futhi abakwazi ukuphatha amaphutha. Abaningi babalimi abakwazi ukusebenzisa imishini emisha ngendlela efanele - isibonelo, uMnyango Wezolimo waseMpumalanga Kapa unikeze abanye abalimi ama-traktor nemishini emisha, kodwa bahluleka ukuyisebenzisa nokuyigcina. Abaningi babalimi badinga imishini ebalulekile efana ne-boom sprayer, futhi abakwazi ukuphatha izitshalo eziphilayo nezifo ngezikhemikhali. Akukho nezinhlangano ezithanda ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuthenga imishini endala, esasebenza, futhi imishini emisha ibiza kakhulu, okungakwazi ukukhokhwa ngababalimi. Okwamanje, izinga lenzalo liphezulu, futhi uma lihlanganiswa nezindleko zokukhiqiza, ukulima kwezinye izindawo akusasebenzi, okwenza kube nzima. Kuneziningi izimfuno zomhlaba ezitholwe ngaphansi komthetho wokwabiwa komhlaba, kodwa lowo mhlaba awuhambisani nokukhiqiza ukudla - labo balimi bafisa ukulima kodwa abakwazi ukuvezwa ukuthi balime emhlabeni ongena ngaphansi kuka-700 mm wezikhukhula - ingozi yokwehluleka iphezulu kakhulu. Enye inkinga okufanele ibhekwane nayo ukuthi: izindaba zomthetho ezihlobene nokwabiwa komhlaba aziphathwa kahle. Ngokuvamile, umhlaba wabiwa kubantu abaningi (iTrust) abangabalimi, kuvame ukufaka abantu abangaphezu kuka-30 abazuza. Ekuqaleni, bacabanga ukuthi bonke bazosebenzisana emasimini, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwavela izinkinga eziningi, kushiya kuphela abazuzi abambalwa abenza yonke imisebenzi, kodwa bangenakukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bazokwazi ukuziphilisa esikhathini esizayo. Ukuqinisekisa imali yokuqala yokutshalwa kwezimali kuyinxenye yenkinga, kodwa kukhona abanye abazame futhi baphumelele, isibonelo: iphrojekthi yethu ivuselelwe noMnyango Wezolimo waseFree State kanye ne-OVK ukuze kusekelwe abalimi abakhethiwe - i-OVK ihlinzeke ngazo zonke izimali ukuze abalimi bakwazi ukufaka imbewu emhlabeni ngesikhathi esifanele, kanti uMnyango uthe uzobuyisela u-50% walezi zindleko ku-OVK ukuze labo balimi babe nezinzuzo. Konke lokhu kuhamba kahle, futhi bonke abalimi bakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo nokwenza inzuzo, kodwa lapho sifuna ukwandisa leli hlelo njengokuvumelana, uMnyango uphendule ukuthi awunayo ibhajethi yale mali! Lapho abalimi bephumelele ekubolekeni imali, izikhungo zokuxhasa azifuni ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyengeziwe yokulungisa nokugcina imishini - uma abalimi bengekho nemishini esebenzayo, abakwazi ukuba abalimi bezentengiselwano. Ezindaweni zeBronkhorstspruit neLichtenburg, i-AFGRI isekela abalimi abasha - basebenzisa abaqashi abamhlophe abakhulu, benza yonke imisebenzi yokulima (i-AFGRI ihlinzeka ngezindleko zokuqala futhi ithatha u-50% wenzuzo). Abalimi abafundi amakhono okulima futhi abatholi amakhono ezolimo. Akukho inzuzo ethola ngabalimi ngabanye - yonke imifula ilimwa ngokuhlanganyela, futhi bonke abakhiqizi bathola inzuzo ehambisana nosayizi bemifula yonke, hhayi umkhiqizo owenziwe emifuleni yabalimi abodwa. Uma sekungekho inzuzo kulolu work, i-AFGRI izokhawulela ukulima, futhi abakhiqizi bazobhekana nezinkinga ngoba abakwazi ukuziphilisa. Ukwanda kwezindleko ze-fertilizer kusho ukuthi abakhiqizi abasebenzisi inani elifanele le-fertilizer - kuholela ekutheni kube nezithelo eziphansi nemifula ebulalayo. I-Maize Trust ivuselele uhlelo oluhle lokuxhasa uxhaso lwezinto ezifana nokufaka imbewu, ukulima, imfundo, nokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa. Kodwa le misebenzi ihlinzekwa yizinkampani zezolimo. Ngokuvamile, umbulali akayena ilungu lenkampani yezolimo, noma bahluleka ukuboleka imali ezinkampanini zezolimo. Ngezinye izikhathi awekho amabhizinisi ezolimo (njengaseMpumalanga Kapa) - bese umkhiqizi engakwazi ukufinyelela usizo olunikezwa yi-Maize Trust. Ukwabelana ngolwazi oluvela kuMnyango Wezolimo akusebenza kahle - ngokuvamile, iziphathimandla zokwabelana ngolwazi zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, futhi kuvame ukuba bengenandaba yokuxhasa abakhiqizi. Ukufinyelela emhlabeni wokulima kuyinkinga kwezinye izifundazwe - ikakhulukazi lapho kungekho mhlaba wombuso, njengaseFree State. UMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba awusebenzi kahle - bayawuphika ukukhokha izindleko eziphezulu uma umhlaba wezolimo omuhle uthengiswa, futhi uma bethenga umhlaba, abacabangi ukuthi abalimi banemishini yokulima - umbulali akadingi kuphela umhlaba onokukhiqiza, badinga nezinye izinto eziningi ukuze babe umkhiqizi ophumelelayo ekulimaleni.
Izinsiza Zamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka: Indaba Yomlando Emikhakheni eminingi yempilo, amanzi abe yinsika ebalulekile, evula amathuba okuphila. Abantu bokuqala bahlala eduze kwemithombo yamanzi efana nemifula, izigodi, nezilwandle, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kulokho okwakubalulekile empilweni. Ukuphila eduzane namanzi kwaba yinto ebalulekile, kodwa lokhu kuza nezinkinga eziphathelene nokungahlanzeki. Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, izinkinga zokuhlanzeka zaba yisithiyo esikhulu emadolobheni asathuthuka. Izindawo eziningi zazingenazo izinhlelo ezilungile zokuphatha amanzi, futhi abantu babesahlala ezindaweni ezihlala khona izinkanyezi, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezifo ezifana necholera ne-typhoid, okwadala ukufa kwabantu abaningi. Ngalesi sikhathi, abacwaningi nabaphathi baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. UJohn Snow, udokotela waseNgilandi, waba nomthelela omkhulu ekuqondeni ukuthi izifo ezithile zixhumene nokungcola kwamanzi. Ngemva kokuhlola izimo ezahlukene, wathola ukuthi umthombo wamanzi owawusetshenziswa abantu bendawo waba yindlela yokudlulisela izifo, futhi lapho umthombo uhlanzekile, izifo zancipha. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile angasiza ekuvikeleni izifo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka zathuthuka. Emadolobheni amaningi, kwasungulwa izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi ahlanzekile kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha udoti. Izindlu zakhuliswa, futhi abantu baqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. Izikhungo zempilo zaba nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ngalezi zindaba, zikhuthaza imikhuba emihle yokuhlanzeka. Ngemva kweminyaka, iMpi Yezwe Yesibili yabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka. Amazwe amaningi aqonda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esiyinhloko, hhayi kuphela empilweni yabantu, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Izinhlelo ezinkulu zokuhambisa amanzi zathuthukiswa, futhi izikhungo zempilo zathola uxhaso olukhulu ukuze ziqhubeke nokwakha imikhuba emihle yokuhlanzeka. Namuhla, sikhumbula ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esibalulekile sokuphila, hhayi kuphela emadolobheni nakumakhaya, kodwa nasezindaweni zokuhlala, zomphakathi, nezokusebenza. Nokho, izinkinga zihlala zikhona. Kunezindawo eziningi emhlabeni ezisathola ubunzima ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka azikafinyeleli kubo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphila kwethu kuxhumene kakhulu nokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sifundisa, siphakamise izinga lokuhlanzeka, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Izifundo emlandweni zifundisa ukuthi ukuhlanzeka akukona nje umkhuba, kodwa kuyinselelo esidinga ukuxazululwa. Uhlelo lokuhlanzeka aluhambisani kuphela nezinsiza, kodwa luhambisana nempilo, umnotho, nezimo zokuphila. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza imikhuba emihle, siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayatholakala kubo bonke, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi izimpilo zabantu zihlala ziphila kahle. Ngokubheka emlandweni, sithola ukuthi izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka lapho abantu beqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezinhle, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sikhumbula lezi zifundo, siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayatholakala, futhi siqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Njengoba sithokozisa izinkanyezi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esiyinhloko, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sigcine impilo yethu.
Ibhokisi: Umsebenzi Wokuzikhandla Nendlela Yokuphila Ibhokisi, le midlalo ekhula ngokushesha emhlabeni, iyinsika empilweni yezinhliziyo ezilwela ukuphumelela, ukungenelela ezinkingeni, nokuqhubekisela phambili umphakathi. Njengoba izinsuku zidlula, ibhokisi liphinde libe umthombo wezimpendulo ezisheshayo kumaphuzu athile, kusukela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu siqu kuze kube ukwakha umphakathi ozinikele. Kulesi sihloko, ngizobalela izizathu engicabanga ukuthi ibhokisi lihlala libalulekile, ngisho nangemva kokuhlangenwe nakho okuningi. Ibhokisi, ngendlela yalo, akuwona nje umdlalo odlalwa ezinkundleni; uyindlela yokwakha isimo sengqondo, uthando, nokuzikhandla. Umdlalo ungumzila wezemidlalo ohuqulekile, ugqugquzela abantu ukuba baphumelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngokuqonda izisekelo zebhokisi, umphakathi ubona okungagqugquzela ukusimama kwezobuchwepheshe bokufunda, njengokunciphisa umdlandla osheshayo emiphakathini eminingi. Ukwazi ukulwa kungathuthukisa impilo yomuntu siqu. Abadlali, ikakhulukazi, bahlala beqonda ukuthi izinhloso zifinyelelwa kanjani ngokusizana, ukusiza abanye, nokuthi kufanele baphawule ngalokho abakufunayo. Lokhu kwenza ibhokisi libe yinsiza futhi elibalulekile empilweni. Inselelo yokulwa, ukuhlose ukwakha izinzuzo, kanye nokulwela ukuphumelela, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kwekhono lokubhekana nezinkinga. Ubhokisi, ngokuhlanganyela, luqukethe izimfundiso ezifanele nezidingo zemvelo, hhayi nje zokuqhuma nesizathu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhokisi nemiphumela yalo iyakhanga kakhulu. Abantu abaningi basebenza njengeqembu, bejabulisa izidingo zomoya wezokuncintisana. Ibhokisi lidala ubudlelwane obusha nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abantu baqonda ukuthi ukuphumelela akulindelekile, kuchaza ukuthi kumele baziphathe kahle, baphinde bafunde kokubili ukuhamba phambili nokumba phansi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokunakekela, umoya wobumbano phakathi kwabantu, futhi umphakathi uyahlala unempilo. Kunoma yimiphi imidlalo, izici ezahlukene zithinta izinzuzo zomphakathi. Ibhokisi lihlala liphumelela kakhulu. Umphakathi uthola laba abakhumbula izimfundiso zabo. Ngisho nangesikhathi sokubi, ibhokisi lisiza abantu ukuthi bathole ukuvikeleka, ikakhulukazi abasha. Umphakathi uvuma ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze udale izikhathi ezibalulekile, futhi ibhokisi liphinde libakhumbuze ukufanelekela izimo ezinzima. Ukubuka ibhokisi, sibona ukuthi akukona nje ukuqhuma: kuyabhekwa izizathu ezinzima. Ukubamba iqhaza ebhokisini kuhlanganisa imizamo eminingi. Abadlali baphathwa ngokuqinile, bemukela ukuzenzakalelayo futhi befumana ukwesekwa komphakathi. Kuthuthuka ulwazi nokukhula, ngaphandle kokubandakanya ukuphazamiseka ngokuphelele. Ukubaluleka kobudlelwane phakathi kwabantu nempilo ibalulekile. Ibhokisi, njengoba sikhuluma, kuhlanganisa izinzuzo eziningi. Ngaphandle kwesimo sokukhuthazwa, abantu bayakwazi futhi bakhumbuleka. Uqaphela ukuthi akukona okuphikisanayo, kodwa kudinga umoya wokuthintana nokuxhumana. Ngaphezu komphakathi, ibhokisi linzima enhlosweni yokwakha izinganekwane. Uhlelo lwezokubambisana luhamba phambili olukhuthaza ukuhlela isikhathi esihlukile. Lokhu kuholela ekubumbaneni komphakathi onenqubekelaphambili, ukukhulisa indlela yokuphila ebumbene. Uhlanga lwezokuhlala lungabona izithiyo ezikhaliphile ezinqubeni zomphakathi. Njengoba kuncintisana, umoya uhlaselisa futhi ubudlelwane bukhula. Amaphuzu athuthukiswa kuhleke izimfanelo eziqinile zokuphila, futhi imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi ibhokisi lithuthukisa izimpendulo ezivamile zokuhlangana kwemiphakathi. Ekugcineni, ibhokisi liyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Kuyivulelekile, izinzuzo zayo zidalwa ngendlela ezinzima, futhi ithuthukisa izimpendulo zempilo zethu. Abasebenzisi bebhokisi basiza umphakathi ukuba uhlale umphakathi ophilayo, bazame ukufaka izinkumbulo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, ibhokisi akukhona okwenziwa kuphela; kuyisiqiniseko sokuba nezephula. Ukwengeza, ibhokisi liwakhiwe ezisizayo nezinsizakalo ezithinta abadlali, labanye abaphanda ezimbonini zempilo. Uma sigcina ibhokisi lisebenzisa zonke izinkulungwane zokubenga, imiphakathi izogqoka isigaba sokuphumelela. Ngokungazelelwe, ibhokisi lihlala liyo-aphenda elikhiphayo emphakathini, futhi izimpumelelo zitholakala kalula. Ngakho lo mdlalo weboka, ngaphakathi kwengqondo, usifundisa ukubona izinto ngcono. Yiqiniso, ibhokisi izovuma izinselelo ezibalulekile ukuze idalule okuningi empilweni. Akukho okujulile, futhi ibhokisi linomkhankaso oncomekayo, salt kanti umphakathi umele uzithathe kahle. Lokhu kusebenza kulesi sigaba, nakuba ifanele ukusiza abanye, ibhokisi yinto eyodwa egcwele izinkumbulo zezimfundiso.
Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yathola ithuba elikhulu lokwakha ikusasa elisha. Ngalesi sikhathi, izwe lalisaphila ngaphansi kokuhlukumezeka, ubandlululo, kanye nezinkinga ezinzima ezazithinta wonke umuntu. Kodwa, phakathi kwalesi sikhathi esinzima, kwavela ithemba elisha, elalikhanya njengenkanyezi ebusuku. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokwakha umthethosisekelo, owawuzoba yisisekelo sokuphila kwabantu bonke. Umgwaqo wokuqala walesi sikhathi wathatha uMnu. Nelson Mandela, owayengumholi we-ANC, owaphuma ejele ngemuva kweminyaka engama-27. UMandela wayezimisele ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha, lapho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungowasendaweni ethile, ezokwazi ukuphila ngokukhululeka. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano nabaholi bezepolitiki, abaholi bezinhlangano ezahlukene, kanye nabamele izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMandela wathola ukwesekwa okuqinile kumalungu e-ANC, i-IFP, nezinye izinhlangano ezazihlanganyela ekwakheni umthethosisekelo. Kwakukhona umuzwa wokuthi abantu badinga ukuhlanganiswa, baphinde bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle. Umhlangano wokuqala obalulekile waba seKapa, lapho abaholi bezepolitiki behlangana khona ukuze baxoxe ngempilo yelizwe. Kwakuyisikhathi sokukhuluma, sokuxhumana, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula. Ngemuva kwemihlangano eminingi, kwavela umbono wokwakha umthethosisekelo ophathelene namalungelo abantu. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavuma ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungowasendaweni ethile, kufanele abe namalungelo alinganayo. Umthethosisekelo wawuhloselwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho muntu ozokwenqabela abanye ukuba baphile ngendlela abathanda ngayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwavela ababhali abaninzi ababeqhamuka nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwakha umthethosisekelo. UProf. John Dugard, uProf. Kader Asmal, noMnu. Cyril Ramaphosa, babebambe iqhaza elikhulu ekubhaleni nasekucabangeni ngalezi zinhlelo. Kwakukhona imihlangano eminingi, izinkulumo, nezifundo ezazihlelwa ukuze kuqondwe kahle ukuthi umthethosisekelo kufanele ube kanjani. Ngonyaka ka-1996, umthethosisekelo watholwa, futhi kwaba yisikhathi sokujabula. Abantu beNingizimu Afrika babebonisa injabulo enkulu, behlanganyela emigubuzweni, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezazikhanya phezulu. Umthethosisekelo wawuhlanganisa izimiso ezibalulekile, ezifana nokulingana, ubulungiswa, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abantu. Kwakuyisikhathi sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Nokho, ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo akuzange kube lula. Kwakukhona izithiyo eziningi, izinkinga ezazivela phakathi kwabantu, nezinkulumo ezazihamba kancane. Abanye abantu babengavumi ukwamukela izinguquko, bephikisana nemigomo emisha. Kodwa, uMandela nozakwabo babenqaba ukuhamba emuva. Baphikelela ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, beqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uzothola ithuba lokukhuluma, lokwazisa, nokuhlonishwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthethosisekelo waba yisisekelo sokwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha. Kwakukhona izinhlelo eziningi ezazihlelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila kahle, futhi bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Umthethosisekelo wawuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwakha izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, ezemfundo, nezempilo. Kwakuyisikhathi sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuthula. Namuhla, iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa umthethosisekelo usaqhubeka nokuba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Abantu bahlala bephokophelela ekuthuthukiseni izwe, beqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa. Uthando, ubumbano, kanye nokuhlonipha kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe yizwe elihloniphekile, elihlangene. Ukwakhiwa koMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika kuwumlando obalulekile, owakhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izifiso zabo, baphinde bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo sokuthi, noma izinkinga zingavela, uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. Umthethosisekelo ungumfanekiso wokuhlanganyela, uthando, kanye nokuqhubeka phambili, ukuze iNingizimu Afrika ibe yizwe elinokuthula, elinokuthula, nelinokuthula.
Izimpi ZamaZulu Kwathi kudala, emhlabeni wezinkanyezi, lapho izinkanyezi zazikhanya khona njengemibala emihle, kwavela isizwe esikhulu, esaziwa ngokuthi amaZulu. Leli qembu labantu lalingabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinhle, ezimnandi, ezisemaphandleni, lapho izinkomo zikhula khona, futhi izihlahla zikhula zikhanya. Kodwa, njengokujwayelekile emlandweni, izimpi zazingekho kude. Ngaleso sikhathi, uShaka, umholi ophakeme, wathola ukuthi isizwe sakhe sithwele kanzima. Izitha zazingamnyama, zifuna ukuthumba izwe labo. UShaka, owayenobuhlakani obukhulu, wathola ukuthi kumele enze okuthile ukuze avikele isizwe sakhe. Waqala ukuhlela izimpi, wathuthukisa amasu, futhi wakhulisa umoya wokulwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe. UShaka wayengumuntu onobuhlakani, futhi wayazi kahle ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqale kuphela emadodeni, kodwa zazingabantu bonke. Waqala ukufundisa abantu bakhe indlela yokulwa, wababonisa ukuthi umoya wokubambisana ungabavikela. Ngaleso sikhathi, izimpi zokuqala zenzeka, futhi amaZulu aqala ukuhamba phambili, edlula izitha zawo. Kwathi ngesikhathi seMpumalanga, uShaka wahlangana nezitha ezazivela eMthethwa. Lezi zitha zazihlasela izwe lamaZulu, zifuna ukuthumba izinkomo nezinsizwa. UShaka, enesibindi, wahola umkhankaso, wathumela amabutho akhe ukuze avikele izwe. Kwakungelula, kodwa umoya wokulwa wawukhona. AmaZulu abamba izikhali zabo, behlakanipha, behlula izitha zabo. Izimpi zaba ziningi, futhi uShaka waba yisithonjana phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa izindlela zokulwa, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Kwakukhona izimpi ezinkulu, ezazihlanganisa izizwe eziningi, kodwa amaZulu ayebonisa amandla akhe. Ngemuva kokuhlasela, uShaka wathola ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqedele izitha, kodwa zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima. Izimpi zashiya izilonda ezinzima, kodwa zashiya nezifundo ezibalulekile. UShaka wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ubuhlakani, hhayi kuphela amandla. Waqonda ukuthi isizwe sakhe sasingaphumelela kuphela uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Kwathi ngesikhathi seMfecane, izimpi zashintsha ubuso bezwe. AmaZulu abamba izikhali, kodwa izitha zaba ziningi. Kwakukhona izizwe ezazihlasela, zifuna ukuthumba izwe lamaZulu. UShaka, enesibindi, wathola ukuthi kumele ahlale eqaphile. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa amasu, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Izimpi zaba ziningi, futhi uShaka waba yisithonjana phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa izindlela zokulwa, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Kwakukhona izimpi ezinkulu, ezazihlanganisa izizwe eziningi, kodwa amaZulu ayebonisa amandla akhe. Ngemuva kokuhlasela, uShaka wathola ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqedele izitha, kodwa zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima. Izimpi zashiya izilonda ezinzima, kodwa zashiya nezifundo ezibalulekile. UShaka wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ubuhlakani, hhayi kuphela amandla. Waqonda ukuthi isizwe sakhe sasingaphumelela kuphela uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Izimpi zaba ziningi, futhi uShaka waba yisithonjana phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Waqhubeka nokwakha ubuholi obuqinile, wathuthukisa amasu, futhi wathola izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe. Kwakukhona izimpi ezinkulu, ezazihlanganisa izizwe eziningi, kodwa amaZulu ayebonisa amandla akhe. Ngemuva kokuhlasela, uShaka wathola ukuthi izimpi azizange ziqedele izitha, kodwa zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima. Izimpi zashiya izilonda ezinzima, kodwa zashiya nezifundo ezibalulekile. UShaka wathola ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ubuhlakani, hhayi kuphela amandla. Waqonda ukuthi isizwe sakhe sasingaphumelela kuphela uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Izimpi zamaZulu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni, zashiya izifundo ezibalulekile zokubambisana, ubuhlakani, nokuhlonipha. UShaka, njengomholi, waba yisibonelo sokuthi umoya wokulwa ungavikela isizwe, kodwa umoya wokubambisana ungakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Izimpi zashiya izinkumbulo, kodwa zashiya nethuba lokwakha isizwe esiqinile, esihloniphekile, nesizokwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, izimpi zamaZulu zaba yisifundo esibalulekile, esifundisa ukuthi amandla akhona emoyeni, hhayi kuphela ezikhali. UShaka, umholi ophakeme, waba yisibonelo sokuthi isizwe esihlangene singakwazi ukuhamba phambili, sithole impumelelo, futhi sikhulise izimpilo zethu. Izimpi zashiya umthelela, kodwa umoya wamaZulu wahlala uqhakazile, uqhubeka nokukhanya njengenkanyezi emhlabeni.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sokuqashwa (GEMS Employment Status Verification) Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kubaluleke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni ethile efana nezempilo, ezemfundo, kanye nezokuphatha. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi kungani ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlola akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, kodwa futhi kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabaphathi, abasebenzi, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yini i-GEMS. Le mfundiso iyinsiza yokwelashwa eyenzelwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi. Ukuze lezi zinsizakalo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi i-GEMS iqinisekise ukuthi abantu abathola lezi zinsizakalo bangempela bangabantu abasebenzayo. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa kwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi ngubani ofanele ukuthola izinzuzo, futhi kuvikela izinsiza ezithile ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele. Ngokubheka lezi zinsiza, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo kubalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Abasebenzi kufanele babe nezinzuzo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuqinisekiswa okucacile. Uma i-GEMS ingaqinisekisi isimo sokuqashwa, lokho kungaholela ekutheni abantu abangenayo imisebenzi bathole izinzuzo, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali okukhulu. Lokhu akukhombisi kuphela ukungabi nabulungiswa, kodwa futhi kubeka engcupheni impilo yabantu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye bangase baphikise ukuthi le nqubo yokuhlola ingase ibonakale iyinkimbinkimbi futhi ithathe isikhathi. Lokhu kungenzeka kubeqiniso, kodwa kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zinyathelo zenzelwe ukuvikela izinsiza zomphakathi. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, akufanele kube nezithiyo ezithinta ukwelashwa kwabantu. Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubo ezicacile nezisebenzayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathola izinzuzo bahlala bephila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Uma abasebenzi benelisekile ngezinsizakalo abathola ku-GEMS, bazoba nekhono elingcono lokusebenza, okukhuthaza ukukhiqiza okukhulu. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umnotho oqinile, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa akukhona nje okwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi le nqubo ingase ibangele ukunganeliseki kwabanye abasebenzi. Abanye bangase bazwe sengathi lezi zinyathelo zikhawulela amathuba abo, noma zibabangele ukungabi nempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhumana, ukuze abasebenzi baqonde kahle izizathu zokuthi kungani lezi zinyathelo zibalulekile. Ukuze le nqubo isebenze kahle, kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwe-GEMS, abaphathi, kanye nabasebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza le nqubo ibe lula, ngaphandle kokunciphisa izinga lokuqinisekiswa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ezizokwenza kube lula kubasebenzi ukufaka izicelo zokuhlola isimo sokuqashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula futhi kube nesikhathi esincane sokulinda, okuzokwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bekhululekile. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu akukhona nje okwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze le nqubo, sithuthukise izindlela zokuxhumana, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi kahle izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onokuthula.
Okutholakele Kuphenyo Lomlilo Wesakhiwo eGoli 1. Isingeniso Le ngxenye ibonisa okutholakele kuphenyo olwenziwe ngemuva komlilo owenzeka esakhiweni esithile eGoli. Umsebenzi wethu ugxile ekutholeni izizathu zomlilo, umthelela kubantu abathintekayo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwezakhiwo ezifanayo esikhathini esizayo. 2. Uhlaka Lwenqubo Yokuphenya I. Ukuqoqwa Kwedatha - Ukuqoqwa kwemibiko evela kubantu abathintekayo, abashayeli bezimoto zomlilo, kanye nezisebenzi zikamasipala. - Ukuhlola izithombe nezincwadi ezitholakele ezivela ezikhungweni zokuphepha. II. Ukuhlaziywa Kwedatha - Ukuhlaziya imibiko ukuze kuqondwe izizathu zomlilo. - Ukuhlola izimo zokuphepha ezazikhona ngaphambi kokuba umlilo uqale. III. Ukubika - Ukubika okutholakele kumphakathi, iziphathimandla, kanye nezinkampani ezithintekayo. 3. Izizathu Zomlilo Uphenyo luveze ukuthi umlilo uqale ngenxa yokushisa okukhulu okubangelwe ukungasebenzi kahle kwemishini yokushisa. Ukuhlaziywa kwemboni yokwakha kuveze ukuthi izinsiza zokuphepha, njengezixhumi zomlilo, bezingasebenzi kahle. 4. Umthelela Kubantu I. Abantu Abathintekayo - Abantu abahlala esakhiweni baphenduleka kakhulu. Kukhona abathintekile, abanye baphumile ngaphandle kokulimala, kodwa abanye bahlupheke ngenxa yokungasebenzi kahle kwezinsiza zokuphepha. II. Ukwelashwa - Abantu abathintekayo bathole usizo lwezempilo, futhi izikhungo zezempilo ziqinisekisile ukuthi banikezwa ukwelashwa okufanele. 5. Izinyathelo Ezithathiwe I. Ukulungisa Izinkinga - Izisebenzi zikamasipala ziqalile ukuhlola izakhiwo eziseduze ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi azikho ezinye izingozi. II. Ukuqeqeshwa - Ukuqeqeshwa kwenziwa kubantu abahlala esakhiweni ukuze bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphepha. III. Ukwenza Izinguquko - Izinyathelo zokwenza izinguquko ezinhlelweni zokuphepha zethulwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkinga ezifanayo aziphindi. 6. Ukubuyekezwa Kwenqubo Yokuphenya Uphenyo luzoqhubeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo zithathwa. Iziphathimandla zizoqhubeka nokubuyekeza izinqubo zokuphepha ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. 7. Isiphetho Uphenyo lomlilo wesakhiwo eGoli luveze izinkinga eziningi ezikhona emkhakheni wezokuphepha. Kubalulekile ukuthi iziphathimandla ziqhubeke zisebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhiwo zihlala ziphephile, futhi abantu bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphepha. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye neziphathimandla kuzodlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni izakhiwo zibe ziphephile esikhathini esizayo. 8. Izikhumbuzo - Qhubeka uvuselela izinhlelo zokuphepha. - Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bazi izinqubo zokuphuma uma kwenzeka umlilo. - Hlanganisa izinsiza zokuphepha ezisebenzayo. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nalesi sikhathi esinzima, futhi ubonisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwe zingasiza kanjani ekuvimbeleni izigameko ezifanayo esikhathini esizayo. Ukubambisana nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsiza ezahlukene kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela impilo yabantu.
Ukufunda Ku-inthanethi - Ingxoxo Ngemikhuba Nezindlela Isingeniso Namuhla sizokhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile yokufunda ku-inthanethi, okuyindlela esheshayo nekhululekile yokufunda. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndlela, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumfundisi onolwazi olukhulu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokufunda. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Thabo, ngokuba lapha namuhla. Ingxenye 1: Ukufunda Ku-inthanethi - Yini? Thabo: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukufunda ku-inthanethi, noma ukufunda nge-inthanethi, kusho ukufunda ngezinsiza ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, amavidiyo, izincwadi ezidijithali, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Le ndlela ivumela abafundi ukuba bafunde ngesikhathi sabo, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngendawo yokufunda. Umbuzo: Ingabe le ndlela yokufunda iyasebenza? Thabo: Yebo, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izinzuzo eziningi. Abafundi bangafunda ngezikhathi zabo, futhi bangakhetha izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zabo. Lokhu kwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula. Ingxenye 2: Izinzuzo Zokufunda Ku-inthanethi Umbuzo: Yiziphi ezinye izinzuzo zokufunda ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Okokuqala, ukufunda ku-inthanethi kukhulisa ukuzimela kwabafundi. Abafundi badinga ukuba bazitholele izinsiza, baphendule imibuzo, futhi benze izinqumo ezithinta ukufunda kwabo. Okwesibili, lokhu kubavumela ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, bezifunda emikhakheni ehlukene nabafundi abavela emhlabeni wonke. Umbuzo: Ngabe kukhona nezinselelo? Thabo: Yebo, kunezinselelo ezithile. Abafundi bangase babe nezinselelo zokuzikhandla, njengoba kungase kube lula ukuphazamiseka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abafundi bangase bangabi nekhono lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, okungaholela ekutheni bahluleke ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Ingxenye 3: Izindlela Zokufunda Ku-inthanethi Umbuzo: Yiziphi izindlela ezinhle zokufunda ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Kunezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, abafundi bangasebenzisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi ezitholakala kumasayithi afana neCoursera, Udemy, noma iedX. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bafunde ngezifundo ezihlukene, kusukela kwezobuchwepheshe kuya kwezokuphatha. Okwesibili, ukufunda ngevidiyo kuyindlela ethokozisayo, lapho abafundi bangabuka amavidiyo afundisayo ukuze baqonde kahle izifundo. Umbuzo: Ingabe izinkundla zokuxhumana zinezindima ezibalulekile? Thabo: Impela! Izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukufunda ngokubambisana. Abafundi bangaxhumana, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhulume ngezifundo. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, okubalulekile ekufundeni. Ingxenye 4: Ukubaluleka Kokuzikhandla Umbuzo: Kungani ukuzikhandla kubalulekile ekufundeni ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Ukuzikhandla kubalulekile ngoba ukufunda ku-inthanethi kudinga ukuzimisela. Abafundi kufanele bazitholele izinsiza, baphendule imibuzo, futhi benze izinqumo ezithinta ukufunda kwabo. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ophusile nokuzimisela. Uma umfundi engazikhandli, angase aphuthelwe amathuba amaningi. Ingxenye 5: Ikusasa Lokufunda Ku-inthanethi Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda ku-inthanethi lizinzile? Thabo: Ngempela! Ngobuchwepheshe obukhulayo, ukufunda ku-inthanethi kuzoba nethuba elikhulu. Izinhlelo zokufunda zizoba nezici ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezifundo ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokufakelwa (augmented reality) nezinye izindlela ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula. Isiphetho Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imiyalelo yokugcina kubafundi abafuna ukufunda ku-inthanethi? Thabo: Yebo, ngincoma abafundi ukuba bahlale bephapheme futhi bazitholele izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Bafunde ngezikhathi zabo, kodwa bahlale beqaphelekile ukuze bangaphazamiseki. Ukufunda ku-inthanethi kuyindlela enhle yokwandisa ulwazi, futhi uma benza kahle, bangathola amathuba amaningi empilweni. Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Ukufunda ku-inthanethi kuyindlela esheshayo, ethokozisayo, futhi enezinzuzo eziningi, futhi sizokwazi ukujabulisa izifundo zethu uma sizikhandla.
AmaSotho: Uhlanga Olukhulu Nempilo Yabo Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Namuhla ngifuna ukuxoxa nawe ngamaSotho, lezi zizwe ezinhle ezitholakala eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eLesotho naseMpumalanga yeNingizimu Afrika. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho anemvelaphi ehlukile, futhi bahlala ezindaweni ezithile ezimangalisayo? Ngithanda ukuhamba ngalezi zindawo, ngibona izintaba eziphakeme nezindawo ezinhle ezihlotshiswe ngamaSotho. AmaSotho, mngani, abavela ezweni elibizwa ngeLesotho, elingaphansi kweNingizimu Afrika. Lesi sikhathi esidlule, amaSotho ayengabantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme, futhi lokhu kwawenza babe nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi zezulu. Kodwa, ngiyavuma, ubuhle bempilo yabo bukhona. Bahlala bejolisa emindenini yabo, futhi bahlonipha izinkolelo zabo zendabuko. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho anamasiko amaningi? Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sikhulume ngamasiko abo. Isibonelo, umkhosi wabo obizwa ngeMokhotlong, lapho behlangana khona ukuze bagubhe izithelo zomsebenzi wabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubasiza ukuba bahlale bexhumene nomphakathi wabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaSotho akhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngikhumbula ngesikhathi ngihamba eLesotho, ngihlangana nomuntu omuhle owayengumSotho. Wakhuluma ngempilo yakhe, wathi: "Siyaziqhenya ngamasiko ethu, futhi sizama ukuwugcina." Lokhu kwangijabulisa, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi amaSotho abahlala bephila ngamasiko abo, futhi bahlonipha izinkolelo zabo. Ngabe nawe uyavuma ukuthi amasiko abalulekile empilweni yethu? Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaSotho anokudla okumnandi! Ngabe uke wazama 'pap' ne 'samp'? Lokhu kudla kwabo kudla okwenziwe ngempela, futhi kubalulekile emindenini yabo. Ngiyakhumbula lapho ngidla khona, ngizwa umoya omuhle, futhi ngathokozisa umndeni owangemukela. Lokhu kwangikhumbuza ukuthi ukudla akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabantu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho banokuthanda okukhulu kwezobuciko? Bakhuluma ngezinkanyezi, futhi bahlala bephila ngezinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubasiza ukuba baqonde izimo zezulu, futhi bahlale bejolisa emhlabeni wabo. Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukubona abantu bejabulile, futhi amaSotho bahlala bejabulile. Ngokuphathelene nezilimi, amaSotho akhuluma isiSotho, okuyilimi elihle kakhulu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi isiSotho sinezincazelo eziningi ezinhle? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuba bahlale bexhumene, futhi bahlale bejabulile. Ngiyakhumbula lapho ngizama ukukhuluma isiSotho, ngazama ukufunda amagama ambalwa, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. Lokhu kwangijabulisa, ngoba kubonisa ukuthi abantu bayakwamukela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaSotho bahlala bephila impilo enobuhlakani. Bahlala bejolisa emindenini yabo, futhi bahlala bephila ngezinkolelo zabo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amaSotho bahlala bephila ngezinkanyezi? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kubasiza ukuba bahlale bejabulile, futhi bahlale bejolisa emhlabeni wabo. Ngokuphetha, amaSotho abantu abahle kakhulu, futhi bahlala bejabulile. Bahlonipha amasiko abo, futhi bahlala bejolisa emindenini yabo. Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukuhamba ezindaweni zabo, futhi ngithanda ukuhlangana nabo. Ngabe nawe uyavuma ukuthi amaSotho bahlala bejabulile? Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, mngani! Ngithemba sizohlangana futhi ukuze sikhulume ngamasiko amahle amaSotho.
Ezokumbiwa Kwezinsiza: Ukubaluleka Nokuhlangenwe Nakho Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, akukhona okungabalulekile njengokumbiwa kwezinsiza. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba izinsiza zethu zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi zisebenza njengesisekelo sempilo yethu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinsiza ezinjengamalahle, uwoyela, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka zidinga ukumbiwa ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili? Ngakho, ake sihlole lokhu ndawonye. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukumbiwa kwezinsiza akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili kwezomnotho. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqonde kahle ukuthi izinsiza zethu zikhona kanjani. Uma sikhuluma ngensiza, sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo yethu. Uthola umoya ophilayo, izinsiza zokwakha, ukudla, nezinto eziningi ezithinta impilo yethu nsuku zonke. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi singaphila ngaphandle kwalezi zinto? Ngempela, akunjalo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukumbiwa kwezinsiza kudinga ukuba siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nakho. Njengoba sithola lezi zinsiza, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wethu uyazithokozisa. Uma sithola amalahle, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lokhu kudinga izinqubo ezithile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile ukuze sithole izinsiza ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela eziphusile ukuze zinciphise umthelela emvelweni? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma sithola izinsiza, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wethu uyazithokozisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukumbiwa kwezinsiza kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezihlonipha abantu, imvelo, nezinsiza. Uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo kufanele babizwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinqubomgomo ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zisebenza ngokubambisana nabantu bendawo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ngendlela efanele? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu bejabule, umphakathi uba namandla. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona izinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokumbiwa kwezinsiza. Njengoba sithola izinsiza, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wethu uyazithokozisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma sithola amalahle, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lokhu kudinga izinqubo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile ukuze sithole izinsiza ngaphandle kokulimaza imvelo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela eziphusile ukuze zinciphise umthelela emvelweni? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma sithola izinsiza, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba wethu uyazithokozisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi ukumbiwa kwezinsiza kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kudinga ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezihlonipha abantu, imvelo, nezinsiza.
