Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) Sawubona, mngani! Namuhla ngifuna ukukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, ethinta abaningi bethu — ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni, ikakhulukazi i-GEMS. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi kungani lokhu kubalulekile? Ake ngikuchazele kahle. Inombolo yempesheni ingumgomo ophawulekayo empilweni yempesheni yethu. I-GEMS, okungukuthi, i-Government Employees Medical Scheme, ibandakanya izisebenzi zikahulumeni ezithola izinzuzo zezempilo. Kodwa, ngaphambi kokwakha noma ikuphi ukuhwebelana, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inombolo yakho yempesheni iyasebenza. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma ungena emhlabeni wokuhlola izinzuzo, kudingeka uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Uqala kuphi? Okokuqala, udinga ukufinyelela kwi-inthanethi. Manje, akujwayelekile ukuba nabantu abangakaze babe nekhono lokusebenzisa i-inthanethi, kodwa ngikholelwa ukuthi ungakwenza. Gcina unaka, uzodinga ukuvakashela ku-GEMS's official website. Lapho, uzothola isixhumanisi esikushayela phezulu, esikuthumele emnyangweni wezempilo. Ngemuva kokungena, uzobona ukuthi kukhona izinketho eziningi. Khumbula, kuhle ukuthi uhlale uhlonipha izinqubo. Ukufaka imininingwane yakho, ikakhulukazi inombolo yempesheni, kubalulekile. Faka inombolo yakho kahle, ngoba uma ungafaki kahle, ungazithola usubhekene nezinkinga. Hamba kahle, umngani — ungavele uphuthume! Uma usufakile, uzothola imiphumela esheshayo. Lokhu kukhulisa ukwethembeka kakhulu, ngoba uma inombolo yakho ibhalwe kahle, uzokwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo ezihambisana nezempilo. Kodwa uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, ungase ube nesikhathi esinzima. Lokhu akufanele kube yisizathu sokukhathazeka. Ungabuyela emuva, ubhale phansi iziphakamiso ezitholakalayo, bese uxhumana nezinsiza ezikhona ukuze uthole usizo. Kulokhu, kufanele sikhumbule nokuthi ukuphathwa kwemali yempesheni kusemthethweni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma usuhamba phambili, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo zenziwe ngokufanele. Ngakho, uma uqinisekisile inombolo yakho, ungabheka izinketho zokwenza izicelo zokuthola izithandani zomshuwalense wezempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujabulela impilo engcono. Kodwa ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma nge-GEMS. Imibuzo ibalulekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungakatholi impendulo oyifunayo, ungabathintana nomnyango wezemphelo. Abantu abanzima, bahlale bekulungele ukusiza. Ungakhohlwa, ukuxhumana kungasiza kakhulu. Ekugcineni, uma usuthole konke okudingayo, qhubeka ube nekhono lokuhlola izinzuzo zakho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungenza izinqumo ezinhle ngokuphila kwakho. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba phambili; kuyisinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho, mngani, khumbula lezi zinyathelo — ubuchwepheshe buyinsiza, kodwa futhi umqondo wakho omuhle ubalulekile. Hamba phambili, uqinisekise inombolo yakho yempesheni, futhi ujabulele izinzuzo ezihambisana nayo. Ngiyabonga ngokungithokozisa, futhi ngithemba lokhu kuzokwenza umehluko empilweni yakho! Hamba kahle!
Umbhalo: Ukusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa (Drug Abuse) Umbuzo 1: Yini ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, noma ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ngokweqile, kuchaza indlela abantu abathola ngayo noma bejwayela izidakamizwa ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ezivunyelwe ngokwezimiso, kodwa ngendlela engafanele, noma ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa ezinqatshelwe. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima empilweni yomuntu, empilweni yomphakathi, kanye nasekuthuthukiseni izimo zempilo ezimbi. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izizathu zokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Izizathu zokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa zihluke kakhulu. Abanye abantu bangase basebenzise izidakamizwa ukuze balwe nomuzwa wokucindezeleka, baphumeze izifiso zabo, noma bacindezele izinkinga zabo. Abanye, ikakhulukazi abancane, bangase bathelelwe umqondo wokuthi ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa kubavulela umhlaba omusha noma kuzwakale njengokufaneleka emphakathini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zomphakathi, ezifana nezinkinga zokuphila, imfundo engalungile, noma umndeni ongenamkhawulo, zingaholela ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izimpawu zokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Izimpawu zokusebenzisa izidakamizwa zingahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezidakamizwa ezisetshenziswa. Abantu abathanda izidakamizwa bangase banemikhuba yokuziphatha engajwayelekile, njengokuphazamiseka kokugxila, ukuhamba ngale kwezifiso zabo, noma ukungathandi izinto ezazijabulisa ngaphambi kokusebenzisa izidakamizwa. Abanye bangase baziveze ngemizwa yokukhathazeka, ubuhlungu, noma ukungabi nandaba. Lokhu kungenzeka kube nezimpawu eziphawulekayo, njengokushintsha kwemikhuba yokudla, ukulala, noma izimo zokuxhumana nabantu. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izingozi ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Izingozi zokusebenzisa izidakamizwa zihluke kakhulu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinkinga zempilo, njengezifo zenhliziyo, umqondo ophazamisekile, nezinye izifo ezinzima. Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kungaholela ekufeni, uma kungenziwa kahle noma uma kudliwa izidakamizwa ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusetshenziswa kwesikhala sokudlula emigqeni ejwayelekile kungaholela ezinkingeni zomphakathi, njengez crime, ukuhlukunyezwa, nokuphazamiseka kwezimo zempilo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 5: Yini engakwenziwa ukusiza abantu abathinteka ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa? Ukusiza abantu abathinteka ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa kudinga ukubambisana komphakathi wonke. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokwelapha ezisebenzayo, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi kukhona usizo olukhona. Izinhlelo zokwelapha ezihlanganisa ukwelashwa, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi zingasiza abantu abathinteka ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa. Kubalulekile ukuba umphakathi uqonde imiphumela yokusebenzisa izidakamizwa, futhi uqonde ukuthi abanye abantu badinga usizo. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe imiphakathi ingaba nomthelela ekunciphiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Yebo, imiphakathi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekunciphiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa. Uma imiphakathi ikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, ibamba izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo engcono, futhi ibambisana ukuze ixazulule izinkinga ezihlobene nezidakamizwa, inganciphisa izinga lokusetshenziswa. Ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi eqinile, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, kungasiza kakhulu. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuqedwe ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa? Ukuze kuqedwe ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, kudinga izinyathelo eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundisa abantu ngempilo engcono, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithinta impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezitholakala kalula. Kubalulekile ukwenza imikhankaso yokwakha ukuqonda, ukuxhumana, nokuxhaswa, ukuze abantu bathole usizo uma bethola ukuthi badinga ukusiza. Futhi, izinyathelo zokuvikela abantu abasha ekusetshenzisweni kwezidakamizwa kufanele zihlale zikhona. Umbuzo 8: Yini okubalulekile ekufundiseni abantu ngalesi sihloko? Ukufundisa abantu ngalesi sihloko kubalulekile ukuze kuqwashiswe abantu ngezingozi nezimo ezingase zenzeke. Lokhu kuhilela ukwazi izimpawu zokusebenzisa izidakamizwa, ukukhuthaza indlela yokuphila enempilo, nokwakha indawo yokuxhumana eyamukelekayo. Ukwazi ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa akukwazi ukubona njengokujwayelekile, kodwa njengokuphazamiseka, kuyasiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi badinga usizo. Isiphetho: Ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa kuyinkinga enkulu emiphakathini yethu, kodwa kungenzeka ukuvimbela nokulungisa. Ngokuqonda izizathu, izingozi, nezindlela zokuxhasa abantu, singasiza ekunciphiseni le nkinga. Kumele sisebenze ndawonye, sikhuthaze impilo engcono, futhi sinikeze abantu ithuba lokuphila ngaphandle kwezidakamizwa. Lokhu kuzoholela empilweni engcono, emiphakathini enempilo, nakwimindeni enempilo.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekisela kumuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala okuphakade ngoba unikezwe umsebenzi ophakade eNingizimu Afrika. Isicelo kumele sibe ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ethile yonyaka ngezikhathi ezithile. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo senziwa ngaphandle. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29E, ukhombise isikhundla kanye description yomsebenzi njengoba kukhangiswe ngendlela echaziwe. Akufanele kubandakanye umuntu ongumCitizen waseNingizimu Afrika noma umphakathi ophakade owayezokwazi ukufaneleka kulolu sikhundla. UMnyango Wezabasebenzi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi imigomo nemibandela yomsebenzi ayiphakeme kunezikhungo ezikhona, futhi ukuthi zikhona kulolu hlobo lomsebenzi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nalabo abanamalungelo okuhlala okuphakade. Ngokwenza lokhu, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi kumele uhlinzeke ngama-akhawunti okuxoxisana phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi kanye nezinye izigaba ezisebenza ezimbonini nasezindaweni. Akukho sikhathi esichaziwe salolu sevisi. Amandla okuphatha mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala kwesikhashana noma sokuhlala okuphakade, i-BI-29E.
Ngemuva kokutshala kusukela ngo-Okthoba kuya kuDisemba 2010, izindawo eziningi lapho kukhuliswe khona ujeqe zathola imvula eningi. Ezindaweni eziningi zokufuya, lokhu kube yinkinga kubalimi ekulawuleni izitshalo eziphikisanayo phakathi kwemigqa yejeqe. Abalimi abangakaze basebenzise amakhemikhali ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele ukuze baphule izitshalo eziphikisanayo, kanye nalabo abangakaze baphonse ngemva kokuthi izitshalo zivele, bazobhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu ngonyaka ozayo nezitshalo eziphikisanayo. Izitshalo eziphikisanayo ezisunguliwe ezivele zikhule zivele zikhule zizoqhubeka zikwazi ukusabalalisa imbewu zazo emapulazini esizayo. Abakhiqizi abangasebenzisi imishini kakhulu ngesikhathi sokutshala (ukuhlwanyela okuncane) nabo babhekane nezinselelo eziningi ezindaweni lapho imishini ingasebenzi khona ngaphambi noma ngemva kokutshala. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ngokucophelela amapulazi lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukutshala ukuze kutholakale ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezithombo eziphikisanayo ezizokhula ezindaweni ezithile. Amakhemikhali afanele nezibulala-zinambuzane angathengwa - xhumana nomphathi walawa makhompiyutha ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ezindaweni eziningi, imvula ifike nango-Agasti, okuzophinde kuvimbe abalimi ekulawuleni izitshalo eziphikisanayo ngemishini emapulazini noma ekusebenziseni amakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, uma ubesebenzisa imishini kuphela ukuze uthuthukise (ukuhlwanyela) izitshalo eziphikisanayo, kungase kube ngcono ukuhlela ukuthenga umshini ophonsa (spray rig). Imishini ehlukene ingatholakala emakethe - kukhona imishini exhunywe kulawa ma-hitch amathathu anama-tank aphakathi kuka-600 liters no-1,000 liters anama-boom (izandla) aphakathi kuka-12 m no-16 m. Imishini enama-tank angakwazi ukuthwala u-1,000 liters kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela kumatraktori akwazi ukuphatha u-1.5 tons noma ngaphezulu. Imishini eyakhiwe lapha ezweni lethu ayibizi kakhulu, futhi izingxenye ezithile zitholakala kalula ngesikhathi sokutshala. Uma uthenga umshini ngaphandle, qiniseka ukuthi umthengisi angaqinisekisa ukuthi uzokwazi ukuthola amapompo amasha, amafremu, nezibulala-zinambuzane noma nini lapho udinga khona. Indlela eyodwa yokuphonsa amakhemikhali idinga izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanele le ndlela - umumo wokuphonsa kanye nokuvula kwezibulala-zinambuzane. Ukuhlola ingcindezi kwelinye ibhande kubalulekile ngoba kufanele kukhiqize i-cone ethile ehambisana nohlobo lwezitshalo eziphikisanayo kanye nohlobo lwekhemikhali. Uma ungathenga umshini ophonsayo, uzokunikeza izinzuzo ezahlukene uma uqhathanisa nomshini oxhunywe kumahitch amathathu. Amatraktori anedrayivu ye-hydraulic yehlile ngentengo, futhi amatraktori asebenza kangcono ngoba awanalo umthwalo ophucukayo umhlabathi. Izibulala-zinambuzane ezikwazi ukuthatha u-2,000 liters zikuvumela ukuba uphonse indawo enkulu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uhlanganise ikhemikhali. Khumbula ukuhlola ububanzi bezinyawo zomshini ukuze kuhlangane nezikhala zemigqa yokutshala ukuze wena, opharetha, ukwazi ukuhlela indlela umshini osebenza ngayo. Ngokuvamile, itanki enomthamo we-200 liters isetshenziselwa ukuphonsa ihektare eyodwa. Ngokufanayo, itanki ye-hitch ethathu ethwala u-600 liters izophonsa amahektare amathathu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uqhubeke uphonse. Uma ucabanga ukuphonsa i-herbicide, kufanele ucabangele okulandelayo: ukuthi yisiphi isikhala esidinga ukuphonswa, isikhathi onaso sokuphonsa, ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele ukuze uhlanganise ikhemikhali, umthamo we-traktor kanye nemishini - kanye ne-trailer enetanki engakwazi ukuthwala u-5,000 liters. Kuzosiza futhi ukufaka ipompo kule tank ukuze ugcwalise amanye ama-tank ngokushesha. Kufanele ulungiselele kahle kusenesikhathi futhi uphathe kahle yonke imishini yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga emapulazini ngesikhathi sokutshala. Namuhla, kunzima ukwenza inzuzo ekulimaleni uma ungakabi nolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwezitshalo eziphikisanayo ngamakhemikhali, ukuphonsa leyo khemikhali ngendlela efanele, nokusebenzisa imishini efanele. Ngaso sonke isikhathi funa usizo kulabo abanokuhlangenwe nakho kanye nochwepheshe ukuze bakusize ngokuqhuba nokuphonsa ama-herbicides. Uma ungakabi ne-traktor enamandla noma ungabi nemali yokuthenga le mishini, cabanga ngokuqasha umphakeli onemishini enkulu yokuphonsa. Labo bantu bavame ukukhokha phakathi kuka-R65 no-R100 ngehektare, kuhlanganiswe nezindleko ze-diesel. Amapulazi amakhulu angaphonswa phakathi nosuku nangezinyanga usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-GPS. Nokho, ngaphambi kokungena esivumelwaneni, qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli angafika ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi uzofika ngesikhathi esifanele uma kudingeka nokuthi iyiphi imishini ezodingeka ukuhlinzekwa umphakeli noma umphakeli. Khumbula, abanye abaphakeli abanakho itanki yamanzi noma amabhokisi. Uma ungakwazi ukukala amanzi adingekayo ngekhemikhali efanele okufanele uphonse, uzobhekana nezinkinga nomphakeli, futhi umsebenzi uzomisa. Kufanele uhlolisise izindleko zokuthenga imishini yakho, ukuba nekhono lokuphonsa ihektare ethile ngesikhathi esifanele, nezindleko zokuhola umphakeli ukuze enze lo msebenzi wokuphonsa. Enye into engakusiza ukuthi abaphakeli abaningi banolwazi mayelana nezinhlobo nezifomulamu zamakhemikhali asebenzisa njengamanje. Kuzokusiza ukuhlola ukuthi ukuphonsa kwenziwa kanjani ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kungase kube kuhle futhi ukukhuluma nabeluleki abasebenza kumafemu ahlukene athengisa amakhemikhali, bese uzokwazi ukuhlola izindleko zamakhemikhali ngehektare kanye nokwesekwa kulawa mafemu athengisa amakhemikhali. Khumbula ukuthi abahlinzeki bekhemikhali bahlala bejabulile ngesikhathi sokutshala futhi bangase bangakwazi ukweseka bonke abalimi ngokuhlanganisa amakhemikhali etankini. Uma ungenalo ulwazi, ungase uphonse amakhemikhali kancane kakhulu noma kakhulu.
Uhlelo Lokweseka Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezamabhizinisi Kwabezizwe Abamnyama (BBSDP) luhlelo lokwabelana ngezindleko ngengxenye engu-80:20%, olweseka amabhizinisi owned by abantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo lunikeza lezi zinkampani indlela yokufinyelela ezinsizeni zokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono abo, kuthuthukiswe amakhono okuphatha, futhi kuhlelwe kabusha ukuze kube nokuncintisana okwengeziwe. Imikhakha eminingi inamabhizinisi owned by abantu abamnyama (ane-shareholding engu-50+1), futhi kukhona nezinye izinkampani eziningi eziphethwe abantu abamnyama. Izinkampani zingathola usizo oluvela ku-BBSDP grant olungafika ku-R12 million ngonyaka. Isimo esibalulekile sokufaneleka ukuze uthole usizo ukuthi inkampani kumele ibe sebenza okungenani unyaka owodwa futhi ibambe iqhaza ekuthengiseni. I-BBSDP ihlose ukukhulisa amabhizinisi owned by abantu abamnyama ngokuwaxhumanisa nezinkampani ezincane eziphethwe abantu abamnyama (SMMEs) futhi ihlanganise nezinkampani ezinkulu kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo wombuso. I-BBSDP ibambisana futhi ixhumanisa nohlelo lokwabiwa kwezinsiza kulabo abake babhekana nezinkinga zokuthi bangenamathuba, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokuphuma, ezihlinzekwa yizinkampani ezinkulu nezomphakathi. Inhloso wukuthi imikhakha ithole ukwabiwa okumele kuxoshwe ekutholeni izikhwama ezivela ezinkampanini ezinkulu kanye nezohwebo zombuso kanye namathuba okuphuma emsebenzini. Inani eliphezulu le-grant elingatholwa yimikhakha ngayinye lingafika ku-R100,000 (izinkulungwane eziyishumi rand). Inkampani eyodwa ingavunyelwa ukufaka izicelo zephrojekthi ezahlukene, kodwa inani eliphelele le-grant alinakudlula ku-R100,000. Zonke izindleko ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo zamabhizinisi, kuhlanganise nezokuhamba nezinye izindleko zokuphila, zizokwenziwa ngokuqhathaniswa kwezindleko. Izindleko zokushicilela izinto kanye nezindleko ezihlobene nekhompyutha, kuhlanganise nezindleko zokuqala zephrojekthi, nazo zizohlinzekwa, uma zingadluli ku-50% wezindleko zephrojekthi eziphelele. Izinkampani zingakhetha ukuthi zizosebenzisa kanjani abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kulandela isimo sokuthi okungenani abathathu kumele babe khona ekukhetheni kulabo abathumele izikhwama. Iphrojekthi ezihlosiwe ukuthuthukisa inqubo yokuphatha ephumelelayo, ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wendawo kanye nokuhlela ukukhiqiza ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ze-ISO 9000 ne-ISO 14000, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zebhizinisi zesikhathi eside, phakathi kokunye. Ukusekelwa ngokwabelana ngezindleko kuzotholakala lapho kudingeka kwezidingo ezihlobene nekhompyutha nezifanekiso noma ama-brochure asekelayo inqubo yokuphatha ephezulu nephumelelayo. Iphrojekthi ezihlosiwe ukusiza ithimba lokuphatha lenkampani ngokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuqeqesha emikhakheni ehlukene, ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kwabaphathi abaphezulu, izinhlelo zokuphatha noma ukuphathwa kwezimali, ama-workshop wokulungiselela izikhwama ezivela ezinkampanini zombuso nezinkampani ezinkulu, phakathi kokunye. Iphrojekthi ezihlosiwe ukusiza inkampani ukuthi ingene emkhakheni othile wemakethe, ngokwesibonelo, ucwaningo lwemakethe nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokumaketha, izifanekiso, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinto zokumaketha, njengezinhlelo zewebhusayithi, phakathi kokunye. Ukwabiwa kwezindleko ezithile kuzohlinzekwa ukusiza ekushicileleni ama-brochure alwazi nezinto ezihlobene ezizosebenza ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokumaketha.
UUber Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elikhulu, lapho izimoto zisheshayo ziphithizela khona, uSipho wayehlala ebuka izithombe ku-smartphone yakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi edlala nabangane bakhe, wathola ukuthi udinga ukuthola indlela yokuhamba. Wazama izinkampani ezahlukene, kodwa uUber, inkampani eyaziwa kakhulu, wavula umnyango. UUber, uSipho wayeziqhenya ngawo, wawungumngane wakhe omusha, owamsiza ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene ngezikhathi ezithokozisayo. Wathola ukuthi akadingeki ukuba ahambe eziteshini zezimoto noma azame ukubangisana nezithuthi zomphakathi. Njengoba ehlala eGoli, uSipho wayevame ukuhamba emsebenzini, ethokozisa izinsuku zakhe ezinzima. Uhambo lwakhe no-Uber lwaqala ngempelasonto ethile. Uthole isiphakamiso esivela kumngane wakhe, uThando, owayevame ukuhamba noUber. UThando wamchazela ukuthi uUber ungumkhankaso omuhle, ovumela abantu ukuqasha izithuthi ngama-application. USipho wathatha isinqumo sokuzama, wathi: "Ngizozama!" Ngesikhathi ethatha uhlelo lokusebenza ku-smartphone yakhe, wayezwa ukulangazelela. Waqala ukufaka imininingwane yakhe, wathola umshayeli ogama lakhe linguSibusiso. Uhlelo lwakhe lwenziwa lukhanya, lwaphoqa uSipho ukuba alinde okuncane. "Uzofika emaminithini ambalwa," kusho uhlelo. Waqala ukucabanga ukuthi mhlawumbe lokhu kuzoba yinto emnandi. Ngokushesha, imoto kaSibusiso yafika, futhi uSipho wathola ukuthi uSibusiso wayenobungane. Bakhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi uSipho waphawula ukuthi uSibusiso wayekwazi ukuhamba kalula emiphakathini eyahlukene. "UUber uyindlela yokuhamba efanele," kusho uSipho, enokuthokoza. Kuze kube manje, wayekhuluma nezinye izinkampani, kodwa uUber wayesebenza kahle kakhulu. Njengoba behamba, uSipho wathola ithuba lokucabanga. Wayefuna ukufunda okwengeziwe ngenkampani, futhi uSibusiso wamxoxela ngempumelelo ye-Uber. "Bakhuluma ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa umnotho, benza kube lula abantu ukuhamba," kusho uSibusiso. USipho wabona ukuthi le nkampani ayibukeki njengezimali kuphela, kodwa ibonakala ithinta nezimpilo zabantu. Ngemva kokuhamba, uSipho wathola ukufika endaweni yakhe, wagcwalisa i-rating, futhi wanikeza uSibusiso umbono omuhle. "Ngiyabonga, Sibusiso. UUber ungumngane wami omusha," kusho yena. Uthokoze kakhulu, washaya isithupha, futhi wayezizwa enelisekile. Lokhu bekukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabo, okwakungukuthandana okwakusuka kumakhasimende kuya kubashayeli. Ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwezinye izinsuku, uSipho waqhubeka ezama uUber. Uthole izimo ezimnandi, izikhumbuzo ezinhle, kanye nezinkanyezi ezivela kubashayeli abahlukene. Abanye babebonisa uthando, kanti abanye babenokukhulumisana okuhle. USipho waqala ukufunda ukuthi uUber akukhona kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuthinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Uhlelo lokusebenza luye lwahamba lwathuthukiswa, futhi uSipho waqala nokucabanga ngezindlela zokukhangisa uUber. Waqala ukusiza abanye abantu, wakhuthaza abangane bakhe ukuba basebenzise uUber. "Kuhle kakhulu, kuzokwenza izinto zibe lula," wayesho ngenkuthalo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi uSipho ezama ukwakha ibhizinisi lakhe. Ngesikhathi edinga ukuthola izinsizakalo, uUber waba uhlobo lwenqubomgomo yempilo yakhe. Uthole ukuthi akufuneki ukuba uhlale ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa ungahamba noma kuphi lapho udinga khona. UUber waba isixazululo esihle sokuphila kwansuku zonke. Wazizwa ekhululekile, engasondelene nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uSipho waqala ukufunda ngendima ye-Uber emnothweni. Wabhala izincwadi, wazama ukuxhumana nabantu abaningi, futhi waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye. Wafunda ukuthi uUber ungumsebenzi ongcono, ogcwele amathuba, futhi ungaba yinkonzo eyakha umphakathi. Uhlelo lwakhe lokuhamba lwenza impilo yakhe ibe lula. Waqhubeka noUber, wahamba nabangane, emangalisa ngezinselelo ezithile, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umkhankaso ungaba yinzuzo. UUber waba umhlali, umngane, nezinsiza ezibalulekile empilweni yakhe. Ngemuva kokuhamba isikhathi eside noUber, uSipho wathola ithuba lokubuyela emuva, abheke phambili kwelanga elisha. Wazisa uUber, ngoba wawuphendula kahle impilo yakhe. Wathokoza kakhulu, ethola izifundo eziningi, futhi waqhubeka nempilo yakhe, edinga uUber ngempela. Ngaleyo ndlela, uSipho waba nesikhathi esihle, futhi uUber waba umngane wakhe omuhle. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, ekhuluma ngezinto ezithokozisayo, futhi ebhalela abanye izindaba ezimnandi. UUber waba uhlobo lwezimpilo zabantu, futhi uSipho wayenomsebenzi omkhulu; ukuzama ukusiza abanye ukuze bazi kahle uUber. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola lokho okwaziyo; uUber akuyona nje indlela yokuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, ubudlelwano, nezinsizakalo ezikhuthazayo. Ngakho, akakhumbuli nje uUber, kodwa uphinde alubhekele ngothando nomsebenzi. Lokhu kwaba yinkanyezi empilweni yakhe.
Ukuphila Emadolobheni: Izinsiza Nezinkinga Zokuhlala Kwezakhamuzi Ukuphila emadolobheni kungenye yezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu ezithinta izimpilo zethu namuhla. Emadolobheni, siphila eziqhingini ezinamandla, ezikhanya ngobuchwepheshe, ezikhangayo nezinezinsiza eziningi. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinsiza ziveza izinselelo ezithile, ezidinga ukuba sikhulume ngazo ukuze sithole ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngempilo yethu edolobheni. Ukwanda kokukhula kwamadolobha kuhlobene kakhulu nomnotho. Imisebenzi eminingi itholakala emadolobheni, okwenza kube lula ukuthola umsebenzi. Lokhu kwenza abantu abaningi baphume ezindaweni ezithile besiya emadolobheni, befuna ukuphila okungcono. Izakhamizi zifinyelela kalula ezinsizeni ezifana nezikole, izibhedlela, kanye nezitolo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, kodwa kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi ukuhlala emadolobheni akuhambisani kuphela nezinzuzo; kunezinkinga eziningi ezithinta izakhamuzi. Okokuqala, kumele sikhulume ngengcindezi yokuhlala. Njengoba abantu abaningi behlaliswa emadolobheni, izindlu ziba nzima ukuthola, futhi amanani okuphila akhuphuka. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubantu abaningi ukuba baphile kahle. Inkinga yokuntula izindlu ezithengekayo ibangelwa ukukhuphuka kwezimali ezidingekayo ukuze uthole indawo yokuhlala, okuholela ekwenzeni abantu bahlale ezindaweni ezinyangeni ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kudala ukungahleleki kwezakhamuzi, okukhathaza kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphila emadolobheni kuholela ekwandeni kwezingqinamba zokuphila. Izingqinamba ezinjengokungcola, izithuthi eziningi, nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezindawo zokuhlala nezokusebenza kukhulu. Izakhamuzi zihlala zikhathazekile ngempilo yezenhlalakahle, futhi lokhu kubangela ukukhathazeka okuhlelekile. Ukuze sithole impilo engcono, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuthutha, siphinde siphakamise izinqubomgomo ezinhle zokulawula ukungcola. Uma sikhuluma ngezinzuzo, asinakukwazi ukungabazi ukuthi amadolobha anikela ithuba elihle lokuhlangana nabanye. Izindawo eziningi zenkululeko, imicimbi yokuhlala, nezindawo zokusebenza zibhala izinkanyezi zamasiko. Lokhu kugqugquzela ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu, futhi kuhlelwe imicimbi eminingi yokubambisana. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubudlelwane obusha phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene, okwandisa umqondo wokuhlalisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, emadolobheni, sithola amathuba okufuna intuthuko. Izinsiza eziningi zaziwa kakhulu emazingeni omhlaba, futhi kukhona ubuchwepheshe obusha obuvumela izakhamuzi ukuba zibe nempilo engcono. Ukuphila emadolobheni, anikela ngempela ithuba lokuthi sithole ukwazi okuningi, siphinde sibe neqhaza elikhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Kodwa-ke, imiphumela yokuphila kwethu emadolobheni kumele ibhekwane ngokucophelela. Udaba lwezokuphepha luhlala lukhathaza izakhamuzi. Izinga lokuphila eliphezulu alithinti kuphela izindleko, kodwa futhi lihlanganisa nemiphumela yokungapheli kwemigudu yokuphepha. Izakhamuzi zidinga ukuxhaswa ukuze zibe nokuphepha emadolobheni, nokubaluleka kokuba nezinhlelo ezilungile zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungqubuzana kwezinhlanga ezahlukene nokuphila kwazo kungaholela ekuhlukaniseni okujule. Ukuphila emadolobheni kudinga ukuqonda okukhulu kokuhlukahluka kwezakhamuzi, ukuze siqonde ngezinselelo ezibhekene nazo. Sizokwazi kanjani ukufaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo uma singakwazi ukubheka izinkinga ezikhona? Ekugcineni, ukuphila emadolobheni kudinga ukucabangela okujulile. Izinsiza ezikhona ziwusizo, kodwa kunezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukusizakala. Kubalulekile ukufaka izinhlelo ezihamba phambili ukuze sithuthukise impilo yezenhlalakahle, siqinisekise ukuphepha, futhi sikhuthaze ubudlelwane phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Udaba lokuphila emadolobheni alupheli; kumele sikhumbule ukuthi kuliqhaza eliqhubekayo lokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, okhulayo, futhi ohloniphayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okukhulu phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, umphakathi, nohulumeni ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo.
Esihlokweni mayelana nokulahla ngokuphepha izinsalela ze-pesticide ku-February 2008 Pula-Imvula, enye yezihloko ezingaxoxwa ngayo yisimo se-boom sprayer. Kungase kubonakale ukuthi lokhu kuyinkinga ebanzi - ngakho-ke lesi sihloko sikhona. Ukugcinwa kahle kanye nezindlela zokugcina akukhona okwanele ukuhamba phambili njengokulungiselela ngaphambi kwesizini yonyaka ozayo kuphela, kodwa kukhulisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer njengoba kwengeza iminyaka empilweni yayo yokukhiqiza. Ukuba khona kwezinto eziningi eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kungalimaza ezinye izindawo ze-sprayer, uphahla, kanye nezixhumi zikagesi. Izinsalela zalezi zimpahla zingaba yingozi kunoma ubani osebenza nemishini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga elincane lezinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ezihlala ku-sprayer lingalimaza izitshalo njengoba zidluliselwa esizini yokuphalela esilandelayo. Ukuvikela ukuphepha kwakho siqu kanye nokuphepha komndeni wakho, abasebenzi, nezitshalo kubalulekile ukuhlanza kahle nokukhipha noma yikuphi ukungcoliswa ku-sprayer yakho ngesikhathi, phakathi kwezitshalo futhi ngaphambi kokuyigcina ngezikhathi zonyaka. Khumbula ukuthi izinsalela zamakhemikhali asetshenziswa kwezolimo ziyiingozi ezitshalweni nakuma- / izilwane, ngakho-ke zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqondwe ubungozi obuhambisana nalokhu ukuze isimo sibe phansi kokuphathwa kahle ngangokunokwenzeka. Inqubo ephelele yokugcinwa nokuhlanzwa ihlanganisa izinyathelo ezinhlanu. Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuhlanza i-sprayer yakho, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka ilebula lezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ozisebenzisile. Iphakamisa indlela efanele yokulahla umkhiqizo osele. Iphinde inikeze imiyalelo ethile yokuhlanza engase ibe yadingeka. Iphakamisa ngemikhiqizo yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. Iphinde ikunikeze amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana Nezokuphepha Zomuntu (PPE) okufanele uzigqoke ukuze uhlanze kahle i-sprayer yakho. Inhloso yokuhlanza ngamanzi ukuhoxisa noma yikuphi umkhiqizo osele noma izinqwaba ezinkulu ezingase zibe ku-sprayer. Imishini yokuhlanza i-sprayer ifaka ukujikeleza kwamanzi ngaphakathi kohlelo ngemva kokugcwalisa ngamanzi njengoba kukhombisa ilebula lezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ozisebenzisile (ngamanye amazwi, ukuhoxisa ngamanzi / inhlanganisela yokuhlanza okuncishisiwe, manje ebizwa ngokuthi yi-rinsate, endaweni ephephile). Ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi uhlanza ne-tank kanye nezintambo nezizinda, gcwalisa amanzi ahlanzekile kuze kube uhhafu wetanki ukuze ugijime i-tractor kancane emgwaqweni ophakathi kwezimboni - ukujikeleza kuzohambisa amanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuphonsa umphakathi wetanki wonke. Izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokuhlanza ngamanzi amancane (ukuze kufike ku-10% yendawo ye-tank ye-sprayer) kungcono kunokugcwalisa i-tank ye-sprayer ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Kunconywa ukuphinda inqubo yokuhlanza kathathu okungenani. Khetha indawo lapho i-rinsate ingakwazi ukungcolisa imithombo yamanzi, ukugeleza, izitshalo, noma ezinye izitshalo futhi lapho izingcezu ezincane zingakwazi ukuhlanganiswa, njengoba lokhu kungaba yingozi kubantu, izilwane, kanye nemvelo. Ungaphonsa emathafeni noma emgwaqweni wefarm. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha amanzi ku-tank ye-sprayer ngokuhambisana nelebula lezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni. Ungavuli nje ama-valve njengoba lokhu kuzophonsa emhlabeni. Faka ezinye izizinda ezikwazi ukubamba okuningi ukuze udale indlela esheshayo futhi evumelekile yokulahla i-rinsate ku-sprayer. Izingxenye zangaphandle ze-sprayer nazo kufanele zihlanzwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lapho uhoxisa i-sprayer ngamanzi, ungakhethi amanzi angabamba abantwana, izilwane, izinkomo, noma izilwane zasendle. Lahla i-rinsate yezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ngokuhambisana nemihlahlandlela kulebula, ufake i-rinsate endaweni lapho imikhiqizo izosetshenziswa khona ngokuhambisana nenhloso yayo (futhi, emathafeni lapho ikhemikhali iphonsiwe kubhekwa njengendawo efanele). Phinda inqubo yokukhupha ngaphakathi ngemuva kokukhipha ukungcoliswa nokuhlanza kabusha i-sprayer. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha noma yiziphi izitanki zamanzi ezisetshenziswe ekuhlanzeni ngaphambi kokugcinwa ukuze uvimbele ukulimala okubangelwa ukuhamba kwamanzi ngaphakathi. Ngemuva kokuhlanza kokugcina ngamanzi, ungabheka i-sprayer yakho futhi wenze izilungiselelo noma ukulungisa okudingekayo. Nakuba i-sprayer ihlanzekile, hlale ugqoke izinto zakho zokuvikela. Kukhona izinsalela ezithile ezingase zihlale ku-sprayer. Isakhiwo se-boom, esithola noma yiziphi izimbobo, kufanele silungiswe. Njengoba i-sprayer manje ihlanzekile, ungase ufise ukususa izingxenye ezilimele ngesikhathi sokugcina. Susa ama-filters futhi uhlanze ngesandla ngamanzi anomuthi (khumbula ukugqoka izigqoko ezivikelayo ezivumelana namakhemikhali), hlanza ngamanzi futhi mhlawumbe ugcine noma ubuyisele ku-sprayer. Bheka ngokuqhubekayo izizinda, ama-cap ezizinda, kanye nama-valve. Izinsalela zamakhemikhali zingaba khona kulezi zindawo futhi zibe nzima ebusika, ngaleyo ndlela zinciphisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer esizini elandelayo. Susa ama-nozzle tips, ama-screens, bheka ama-valve, ama-cap, kanye nezizinda ze-nozzle ukuze ubone noma yiziphi izimpawu zokugqokwa. Qaphela ukufaka kabusha ama-plugs. Hlanza futhi uhlole izizinda, ama-cap ezizinda, futhi uhlole ama-valve. Gcina ezitsheni ezibhalwe phansi. Gcina ama-valve ekamelweni lokushisa ebusika ukuze uvimbele ukulimala okungase kubangelwe yizinga lokushisa elibandayo. Susa wonke ama-pressure gauges futhi ufake ama-cap ezindaweni ezivulekile ze-sprayer. Gcina ama-gauges lapho engakwazi ukubonakaliswa ekubandeni noma ukulimala. Ekugcineni, jikeleza i-antifreeze ku-sprayer, kuhlanganise ne-boom, ama-valve, imikhawulo, ama-pressure gauges, kanye nemigudu yokubuyisela. Vumela i-antifreeze ijikeleze phakathi kwezintambo ze-boom. Lokhu kuzovala ngaphakathi kwezintambo ukuvimbela ukuvuthwa nokuphuka. Ukufaka ama-caps kuzo zonke izizinda ze-boom kuzosisiza ukuvimbela i-antifreeze ohlelweni, kodwa kungase kudingeke ukuvula enye noma ngaphezulu kwezizinda ukuze ivumele i-antifreeze ijikeleze ngokuphelele phakathi kwe-boom. Vala lezi zizinda uma i-antifreeze isigcwalise ngokuphelele uhlelo. Lapho kugxilwa esigabeni sokugcina, i-antifreeze kufanele ikhiphe noma yikuphi amanzi asele angase abe ohlelweni futhi ivale zonke izingxenye ze-sprayer. Vumela i-antifreeze ihlale kupompo nasezivalvini ukuze uvimbele ukugqwala nokulimala okungase kubangelwe umswakama ovalwe ohlelweni. Njengoba ezinye zikhishwa ngaphambi kokugcina, ukufaka ama-valve okukhuphuka ngakolunye uhlangothi lwepompo kungasiza le nqubo. I-antifreeze eyenzelwe izimoto zokuzijabulisa (RVs) ifanele ukusetshenziswa ezimotweni zokuphalela ezol
uMangosuthu Buthelezi: UButhelezi ungumholi obalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu, owaziwa kakhulu njengomholi weqembu le-Izindaba ezimnandi, futhi wayengumuntu onamandla kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Wazalwa ngo-1928 eMlabathini, KwaZulu-Natal, futhi waphumula emhlabeni ngomhla zingama-9 kuNtulikazi 2023. UButhelezi waba neqhaza elikhulu emlandweni wezwe, edlula ezinselelweni eziningi ezaziphathelene nesikhathi sobandlululo. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo, uButhelezi wathola ulwazi eMnyangweni waseBantwini, lapho aqala khona ukugxila ezindabeni zomphakathi. Ngemuva kokuthola iziqu zeDiploma, waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengophini lweSikhulu seKhabhinethi yaseBantwini. Phambi kwezinguquko ezinkulu emzabalazweni wamaNtu, uButhelezi wayengumholi ohlonishwayo, onamandla ezinqumweni zakhe. Ngonyaka ka-1975, waqukatha uMntwana uGadфa, wokwakha i-Black Consciousness, okwakuhloswe ngokuqinisa ukuzimela kwabantu abamnyama, nokuphikisana nenqubomgomo yokucindezela. Nokho, uButhelezi akazange azizwe ethokozile; impi yokuzimela kwama-Afrika yaholela ekuphikisaneni phakathi kwe-ANC ne-IFP, okuholele emaphusheni amakhulu. UButhelezi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuliseni izivumelwano zomphakathi, okukhombisa umbono wakhe omuhle. Umlando kaButhelezi ubonisa izinselelo, ukuvivinywa, nokuphakama phakathi kwezinsuku ezinzima. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga, wayekwazi ukubekezela, efuna izindlela zokuvuselela izinhlelo, ubudlelwane bezenhlalakahle, kanye nezenhlalo zabantu abampofu. UButhelezi wayengumxhumanisi, ehlangana nabanye abaholi ukuze kube nokuxazulula izinkinga. Waqhubeka waba nguNgqongqoshe wezeMisebenzi, ethola ukwamukelwa emsebenzini wakhe ngenxa yokubona izinselelo ezikhulayo. Iziphakamiso zakhe eziphethwe kahle zikhombisa ubuqili bakhe. UButhelezi wajabulela ukubona izinguquko eNingizimu Afrika, ngesikhathi lapho izimfanelo zakhe, umqondo onobuhlakani, kanye nezindlela zokuphila kwabantu zikhanya. Umlando wokuphila kwamaNtu eNingizimu Afrika uhlanganisa abakhuluma iZulu, umbono obonisa izinqumo zamasiko ezide. UButhelezi wayehlonishwa njengomholi ophumelelayo ekuphatheni izinkinga, edinga ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Uhlonishwa kakhulu emlandweni wezombangazwe, wakhangela izindlela ezithinta umnotho, impilo, nezinhlalakahle. Ababhali abambalwa bahlola lo msebenzi, behlola umbono omphakathi. UButhelezi waphinde waba nesandla ezindabeni ezinzima ezithinta abaholi bezenhlalakahle, ebamba iqhaza ezingqungqutheleni ezibalulekile. UButhelezi wayengomunye wabalwela ukuzimela kwama-Afrika, waba nesithangami esiyinhloko sokugcina izinkonzo ezibizwa ngaphezulu kwemiphakathi yethu. Umlando wakhe ubonisa ukuzinikela ekwakheni indawo engcono, ehambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. UButhelezi waziwa ngokuchaza uhlelo lwezithuthi oluqhubekela phambili, lokho kwaba ufakazi wombandela wamaMvela. Ubutfutfukwazi bakhe bobuzana nobuhlakani bamukelekile. Ekugcineni, uMangosuthu Buthelezi, ubonakale njengobaba omuhle wezimila emkhakheni. Waguqula izikhathi, umbono wakhe wezombusazwe, kanye nemizamo yokwakha ubudlelwane obugqamile. Ngisho noma esehamba, umoya wakhe uzohlala ungacaphuni, usalindele abafundi nabanye abavela ebuhleni bemiphakathi yethu, uyokwakha impilo ezuzisayo. UButhelezi uyinkanyezi engapheli, isihlangu somphakathi ngendlela engavumelekile okulungiswa.
Ukutholakala Kukagesi Emakhaya Isingeniso Kuyaziwa ukuthi ugesi udlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngaphandle kukagesi, izimpilo zethu zingaba nzima, futhi ukusebenza kwezinsiza eziningi kuyaphazamiseka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukufinyelela kukagesi kubalulekile emakhaya ethu. Kulesi sikhumbuzo, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokuthola ugesi emakhaya, izinzuzo nokubaluleka kokutholakala kukagesi, kanye nezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unokufinyelela kukagesi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Ukutholakala Kukagesi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukutholakala kukagesi kusho ukuthini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela kumasistimu kagesi asezingeni eliphezulu, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu basebenzise amandla kagesi ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Ugesi usiza ekukhanyiseni izindawo, ekwakheni izinsiza zokuphehla, nakweminye imisebenzi ethile efana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zemfundo, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuthengisa. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuxhumana Nezikhungo Zokuthola Ugesi Uma uthanda ukuthola ugesi, isinyathelo sokuqala ukuhlela ukuvakashela izikhungo ezikhipha ugesi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuxhumana nezikhungo zikagesi ezisemthethweni, njengama-ESCO (Electricity Supply Companies) noma amabhizinisi azimele anikela ngalesi sikhungo. Abanikezeli balesi sikhungo bazokwazi ukukwazisa ngezinhlelo ezikhona zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, izindleko ezihambisana nezinsiza, kanye nemigomo yokufinyelela kukagesi. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izidingo Zakho Zokuthola Ugesi Ngemuva kokuxhumana nezikhungo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izidingo zakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi ukuthi udinga ugesi kangakanani, nokuthi uzowusebenzisa kanjani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba izikhungo zikagesi zikuhlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka, kanye nezindleko. Ukubeka phambili izidingo zakho kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola ugesi owanele, owanele, nolungile. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubhalisela Ugesi Uma usucacisile izidingo zakho, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukubhalisela ugesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugcwalisa ifomu lokubhalisela ugesi, lapho kudingeka ukuba uqedele ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu, ikheli, kanye nezinye izidingo ezithile. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela yonke imiyalelo efanelekile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthumele konke okudingekayo ukuze ugesi wakho uthole ukwamukelwa. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlola Isimo Sengxenye Yakho Ngemuva kokubhalisela ugesi, izikhungo zikagesi zizohamba zihlola isimo sengxenye yakho ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi kulungile ukufaka ugesi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola izintambo, izinsiza, kanye nezidingo zomhlaba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ugesi ungafakwa ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Lokhu kungenziwa ngochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe, abanolwazi lokuhlola izindawo ukuze baphendule izidingo zakho. Isinyathelo 6: Ukufakwa Kukagesi Uma isimo sengxenye yakho sihamba kahle, izikhungo zizoqala ukufaka ugesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izintambo, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokuphakela ugesi. Kubalulekile ukuthi ukufakwa kwenziwe ngochwepheshe abanenhlonipho, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqubo ziyalandelwa futhi ukuthi ugesi uzohamba kahle. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuqeqeshwa Nokusebenzisa Ugesi Ngemuva kokufakwa kukagesi, uzodinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi ungawusebenzisa kanjani ugesi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda indlela yokusebenzisa izinsiza ezintsha, ukuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ugesi, nokugcina izindlela zokuphepha. Ukuqonda kahle lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ugesi uwusizo empilweni yakho. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuhlola Ukutholakala Kukagesi Ngemuva kokufakwa kukagesi, kubalulekile ukuhlala uhlola ukutholakala kukagesi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqapha amandla kagesi, ukuthola izinkinga ezingase zibe khona, nokuxhumana nezikhungo zikagesi uma kwenzeka izinkinga. Ukuhlola njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina ugesi uphila kahle, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi ubunjalo buhle. Isiphetho Ukutholakala kukagesi emakhaya kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngendlela efanele yokuhlela, ukuqonda izidingo zakho, nokulandela izinyathelo ezichaziwe, ungathola ugesi owanele futhi owusizo. Ukusebenza nosokhaya, abahlinzeki bagesi, kanye nochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukusebenzisa ugesi ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho. Ngakho-ke, qhubeka uqhubeke, ungavumi ukuthola ubunzima; ugesi uwusizo, futhi ungakuhlanganisa nempilo yakho.
Ukuqashwa KweMisebenzi: Uhambo Lwethu Lokukhula Ngiyavuma, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuyinto ethokozisayo, kodwa futhi ingaba yinkimbinkimbi. Njengoba siphila emhlabeni oshintsha njalo, kudingeka sihlale siphakanyiswa, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole amathuba amasha. Ngicabanga ukuthi sizoqala ngokuqonda ukuthi yini lezi zinto ezibizwa nge-"career development." Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje ukufuna umsebenzi. Kukhona okukhulu okungaphezulu kwalokho. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle emsebenzini. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, akusizi nje ukuba nomsebenzi, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokukhula kulolo msebenzi. Ngabe ubani owenza lokhu? Ngicabanga ukuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi usaqalayo noma usuphezulu emsebenzini. Uhlelo lokuqashwa kwemisebenzi lungaba yinto ethokozisayo, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezilungile. Ukuze sithuthukise, kudingeka sithole izifundo, sibhale izincwadi, futhi sibe neziqu ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kufanele sishayele amakhono amasha, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi umhlaba uyashintsha, futhi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhambisana nezinguquko. Ngiyavuma, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe necebo. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kufanele sibe necebo elihle lokukhula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinyathelo zethu, nokubeka imigomo. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kufanele sibe necebo eliqinile, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona amathuba lapho ethola khona. Ukubona amathuba akusizi kuphela, kodwa kufanele sibe nesibindi sokuwathatha. Ngabe ubani ongasiza kulolu hambo? Ngicabanga ukuthi abanye bethu singaba nomthelela omkhulu. Abaholi bethu, ozakwethu, nabangani bethu bangasiza kakhulu. Ukuxhumana nabanye abantu emkhakheni wethu kungaba yindlela enhle yokufunda. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlala bejabulile uma bekhuluma ngempumelelo yabo? Lokhu kungenza sithole izeluleko ezibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akupheli. Kukhona njalo okuthile okusha okufanele sikufunde. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimo zethu, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Lokhu akusizi kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuzivumelanisa nezimo. Ngabe ubani owaziyo ukuthi imisebenzi emisha iyavela njalo? Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimakethe, sithole izinkampani ezithakazelisayo, futhi sithole ukuthi yini edingekayo ukuze sibe neqhaza. Kukhona izinkampani ezithokozisayo ezithola abaqashi, futhi kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona lezi zinkampani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona nje ukufuna umsebenzi. Kukhona okukhulu okungaphezulu kwalokho. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle emsebenzini. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokubona amathuba, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphumelela akufani nokuphumelela kwabanye. Umuntu ngamunye unendlela yakhe yokukhula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nekhono lokubona ukuthi yini esiyithanda, nokuthi sithanda ukwenza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimo zethu, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akupheli. Kukhona njalo okuthile okusha okufanele sikufunde. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlola izimo zethu, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ngokuphetha, umhlaba wokusebenza usushintshile kakhulu, futhi ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kuyindlela yokuphila. Kukhona okukhulu okungaphezulu kokufuna umsebenzi; kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuhlela, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ethu. Ngakho, qhubekani, thuthukani, futhi nithole amathuba amasha. Uhambo lokukhula luhlala lukhona, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ukuze sibe neqhaza elihle emsebenzini. Ngiyabonga.
Ukuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane - Isidingo Sokuvumelana Nokuqwashisa Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuyindaba edabukisayo edinga ukunakwa okukhulu emphakathini wethu. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokuvikela izingane, ngoba ziwukuhlola kwekusasa lethu. Uma sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo ngokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zehlakalo azikhanyi kalula, futhi ziphakathi komphakathi wonke. Ukuhlukunyezwa akusikho kuphela ukuphathwa kabi, kodwa kungaba futhi ukuhlekiswa, ukuvikelwa, nokuhlangabezana nezimo ezinzima emndenini. Kulesi siqeshana, ngifuna ukucacisa ukuthi le nhlobo yokuhlukunyezwa ithinta kanjani umqondo wethu wobuntu, nempilo yezingane ezithintekayo. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akuvamile nje kuphela ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa kulolu hlobo lwesimo, luhlangana phakathi kwabantu, emakethe yokusebenza, nasemakhaya. Ubudlelwane bezingane nomphakathi, umndeni, nabangani bukhulu, futhi uma ubudlelwano buwohlokile, imiphumela ingaba yinhle kakhulu. Ukuhlukunyezwa emazingeni ahlukene kudala umuzwa wobuhlungu obungapheli, buphinde budale izinkinga ezinzima zesikhumba nezingqondo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi izingane ezihlukunyezwayo zihlupheka ibhadi empilweni yazo, zithandabuzeka, zikhathazekile, ziba nezinkinga zokuphepha, futhi kunezingozi ezinkulu ezifaka ukuphila kwazo engozini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase bacabange ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kudlalwa kakhulu ngezinto ezilula, okungavela emndenini noma ezingeni lokuhweba. Noma kunjalo, abanye baxwayisa ngokuqonda kahle ukuthi izimo ezinjalo zingathiwa kube iqiniso, kwaqhamuka izincwadi eziningi ezibhala ngazo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi abanye abazali bavele badinga ukuchaza kahle kumafomu ahlukahlukene ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi banganikeza kanjani abantwana babo ukwesekwa kakhulu. Ukuze sithole incazelo ethile, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izimo ezithile, sijabulele izinkanyezi zempilo ezikhombisa ubuhlakani bethu bemiphumela emibi. Kodwa singakwenza kanjani ukuze wehlise lezi zingozi? Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokubambisana, sishayisana nemigozi yokuhlonipha izingane zethu. Ukuze sithuthukise indlela yethu yokuphila, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngalezi zinkinga. Uma kungaziwa ukuthi ezinye izingane zibhekene nezimo ezinzima, kungenzeka ukuthi sizoba nezenzo eziphusile. Izingane zidinga ukubhaliswa nezifundo ezithathelwa phezulu, ukuze zikwazi ukubona phezulu lezi zimo, nezindlela zokuzikhulula. Lokhu kudinga ukusiza, ukusebenza nbantu abahlala nazo, namaqembu ezokwelapha. Ngaphandle kwalokho, imphakathi kumele iqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikazwelonke zikhona ukudlula emendeni, ukuze izinsizakalo zempilo zikhululeke ngokuphelele kubabantwana. Uhulumeni kufanele ahlale ekhumbula izinsiza ezidingekayo ezifanele, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ezithakazelisayo zidinga ukuphathwa kahle, isikhathi eside. Lokhu kuzoba nempilo engcono ezingeni eliphelele. Izinhloso zoxhaso, umfundaze, kanye nezinhlelo zokuletha izinsiza ezikhethiwe zidinga ukukhishodwa kubantu bonke. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sikhuluma ngenhlonipho ehloniphekile. Okokugcina, kufanele sikhumbule njalo ukuthi izingane zinemigomo ehlukene, futhi akufanele sithathe imiphumela yethu ngokweqiniso. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokubambisana ukuze senze umhlaba wethu ube ngcono, siphendule izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa. Kuphehla nokubhala izindatshana, sicebise, sikhuthaze, nabanye, sihlonipha izingane zethu, sikhuthaza umoya wokuxhumana phakathi kwethu. Ukuthanda nokuhlonipha kuyimfihlo yokwakha ikusasa elinempilo lezingane zethu. Akukwazi ukusisiza kwazulu osuku lonke, siphinde sikhumbule ukuthi asikho isinyathelo esincane sokuvikela imiphakathi yethu. Ngakho, sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane, ukuze sikhumbule ukuthi sizogxila kwi-tangent yethu. Akusikho ukwenza okuncane kakhulu, kodwa kufanele sibhakabhise umqondo wokuthi ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane akuyona into engalungile, futhi singakwazi ukuvikela izingane zethu. Njengoba sizokhanda izindululo ezihambelana nezidingo zabo, sizogubha umphakathi ophumelele nezimpilo ezilungile. Ngakho-ke, asifanele sihluleke, asifanele sihoxise. Izingane zethu zidinga impilo ezinganeno zokuqwashisa, kanye nenhlonipho, ukuze zikhulise ubumba bomphakathi okhululekile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa ukuziphatha kwethu, sithuthukise umphakathi, siphile ngezinsiza ezinhle, sizobe sikhuluma ngempilo ewusizo. Ngemuva kwalokho, sigcine umphakathi uzinzile. Ngalokhu, sizokwakha umhlaba onempilo nezingane eziphila ngokukhululeka, ngempela.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezidakamizwa Entsheni Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo eMkhumbane, lapho amahlathi ahlanzekile ahlangana khona nezindlu ezincane. UThando, intsha enezinsizwa eziningi, wayengumfana owayenamaphupho amaningi. Wayefisa ukuba udumo emhlabeni, kodwa ubunzima bemihla ngemihla bukhona. Izinkinga zempilo, ukungabi nemali, kanye nezinkinga zomndeni zamsiza ukuba akhumbule izindlela ezimbi. Ngelinye ilanga, uThando wahlangana noSipho, umngane wakhe owayezitholele indlela yokuphila. USipho wayephila impilo ethokozisayo, engazange akhathazeke ngezinkinga ezaziphakathi. Wayejabulela izidakamizwa, ethanda ukucacisa ukuthi ziwusizo empilweni yakhe. "Thando, ungazama lezi zinto, uzobona ukuthi konke kuzoba lula," kusho uSipho, enikeza uThando umkhiqizo omncane. UThando, ongenalo ulwazi ngalezi zinto, wathola ukuthi wayezizwa ethokozisa. Ngemuva kokucabanga, wanquma ukuzama. Kwakungumsebenzi omkhulu, kodwa wayefuna ukujabulisa impilo yakhe. Ngemva kokuthola umuzwa omuhle, waqala ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa njalo. Kwakubonakala sengathi izinkinga zempilo zaphenduka zaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, kodwa empeleni, uThando wayengazi ukuthi wayesebenza emkhakheni wokuphila okungalungile. Njengoba izinsuku zidlula, uThando waqala ukubona izinguquko. Umsebenzi wakhe waphuma phambili, kodwa imiphumela yokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa yayingalungile. Waqala ukulahleka emsebenzini, futhi ubudlelwano bakhe nabangane baphuma phambili. USipho, owayesebenzisa izidakamizwa ngokujabulisayo, waqala ukushiya uThando, eshiywa wedwa enezinkinga ezinzima. UThando wathola ukuthi izidakamizwa zashintsha impilo yakhe yaba yinto engalungile. Kwakuphela izinsuku ezinzima, futhi wathola ukuthi udinga usizo. Wakhumbula umama wakhe, owake wathi: "Thando, uma udinga usizo, ungabazi ukufuna." Ngaleso sikhathi, wathola isibindi sokukhuluma nomama wakhe. Wamtshela konke okwenzekile, futhi umama wakhe wamamukela ngothando. Ngemuva kokuxoxa, umama kaThando wathola ukuthi udinga ukuxhaswa. Wamthola udokotela, owamnika isiqondiso sokuphila impilo engcono. UThando waqala ukungena ezinhlelweni zokwelapha, futhi wathola ukuthi izidakamizwa zazingekho emhlabeni wakhe. Wafunda ukuthi impilo ingaba mnandi ngaphandle kwezidakamizwa, futhi wathola ubungane obusha nabangane abaqotho. Njengoba edlula ezinyangeni, uThando waqala ukubona izinguquko empilweni yakhe. Waphinde wathola umsebenzi omusha, futhi waqala ukuthola izifundo ezinhle. Wafunda ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabangane, futhi wathola ukuthi umphakathi ungumthombo omkhulu wempilo. UThando waphinde wathola umoya wokuphila, futhi wathola ukuthi izinkinga zempilo zingaxazululwa ngaphandle kwezidakamizwa. Ngesikhathi uThando ebuyela emkhumbaneni, wayezizwa esebenzisa amandla akhe. Wafunda ukuthi impilo ingaba yinhle, futhi wathola ukuthi udinga ukwethembela kwabanye. Wenza umgomo wokuphila impilo engcono, futhi wathola ukuthi ubungane, uthando, kanye nempilo engcono kuyizinto ezibalulekile. UThando, owayekhuluma ngezinkinga zakhe, wathola indlela yokuphila. Wafunda ukuthi izidakamizwa azizange zibe yisixazululo. Waba yisibonelo esihle kwentsha, efundisa abanye ukuthi impilo ingaba yinhle ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izidakamizwa. Waqhubeka nokuphila impilo enothando, efundisa abanye ukuba baphile ngendlela efanele. Ngakho, uThando waba yisithombe sokuphila okungcono, esebenzisa amandla akhe ukuze akhuthaze abanye. Wafunda ukuthi ukuphila empilweni eyinqaba kuyinto enhle, futhi wathola ukuthi uthando nolwazi kungamandla amakhulu. Impilo yakhe yaphenduka, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa akusona isixazululo, kodwa uthando, ubungane, kanye nezifundo ezinhle ziyindlela yokuphila.
Isizulu sokuqala sokusebenza kwehlobo sokukhiqiza sesiphelile ezindaweni eziningi, futhi abaphathi basebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola umkhiqizo. Sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola lezo zinsiza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zizokwazi ukukusiza ngonyaka ozayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho ama-leak emaphaketheni nasendaweni yephampu. Hlola ukuthi amaphakethe amanzi asasebenza kahle ngoba avamise ukujula uma uwoyela ewela kuwo. Hlola ukuthi i-radiator cap isasebenza kahle. Uma ubona ukuthi amanzi aphansi kodwa ungatholi enye indawo evulekile, kungase kube le cap evulekile - shintsha ngayo entsha. Kubalulekile ukukhokhela wonke amanzi ezinhlelweni zokupholisa minyaka yonke futhi ufake i-anti-freeze entsha. Khumbula ukuthi ubusika bujwayelekile, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba ne-anti-freeze entsha. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthenga i-anti-freeze efanele, futhi ungahlanganisi izinhlobo ezahlukene ezinemibala ehlukile ngoba azifani. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-fan belts asasebenza kahle. Hlola futhi uqine ibhande. Uma kukhona ama-belts amabili futhi elilodwa likwi-risiko lokuphuka, kufanele ushintshe kokubili ngama-new ukuze asebenze ngokufanayo. Hlola ukuthi awekho ama-leak ukusuka ethankini kuze kube lapho i-diesel ingena khona kumajektha. Qinisekisa ukuthi ithanki likhanya, futhi hlola ukuthi i-internal filter isasebenza. Faka ama-diesel filters amasha kuzo zonke izindawo. Hlanza i-water trap. Kubalulekile ukuthi ithanki le-diesel lihlale ligcwele ngoba uma kukhona umoya ethankini, uyaguquka ube amanzi. Lawa manzi angalimaza ipump ye-injector. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi ukuthi umphathi wakho kufanele uthuthukiswe - kungase kube isikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela futhi ufake i-filter entsha. Uma sekuyisikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela we-differential kanye ne-gearbox, khumbula ukushintsha lezo filters futhi (khumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwe-hydraulic lusebenzisa lowo mwela futhi, ngakho hlola noma yiziphi ama-leak). Uma ubuyisela umphathi, hlola ukuthi awekho uwoyela ophukile lapho ufake khona i-filter noma ku-sump cap. Hlola zonke izindawo lapho uwoyela ungase uphume - faka ama-seals amasha uma kudingeka. Faka i-grease kuzo zonke izindawo (ku-drive shaft nakwezinye izixhumi). Hlola ama-air filters - ngabe asasebenza kahle futhi akhanya - faka amasha uma kudingeka. Hlola amaphakethe lapho umoya uphume, uqine zonke izixhumi. Ibhethri - ibhethri kufanele igcwale ngokuphelele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele, uma ephansi, thela amanzi ebhethrini (ungawathola esitolo sebhethri). Khulula ama-cables ebhethri futhi uwahlanze. Xhuma ama-cables kabusha ngokuqinile futhi faka i-grease encane lapho exhunywe khona ukuze uvimbele ukugqwala kwe-asidi. Hlola ukuthi ikhebuli exhunywe kumshini kanye nekhabeli exhunywe ku-starter iqinile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-cables kagesi awanawo ama-grease nowoyela futhi ahlanzekile kuzo zonke izindawo (lokhu kuvimbela ukushisa, ukuvuvukala, nokumanzisa). Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izibani zokwazisa nezilinganiso zisebenza kahle - uma uthinta ukhiye wokuvula, konke kufanele kukhanye. (Izibani zok pressure yewoyela nezibani ze-alternator kufanele zikhanye uma uthinta ukhiye, kufanele zicime uma umshini uqala - ezinye izibani zizovuleka uma kukhona inkinga endaweni ethile). Hlola zonke ama-fuses njalo. Ama-tire kufanele abe sesimweni esihle njalo - akufanele kube neziphuka, izindawo ezilimazekile, noma ama-bulges. Hlola ukuthi ukujula kuhle futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ibhalansi yamanzi nomoya kumatire angemuva ilungile. Hlola izinyathelo zamathayi adlulisayo umshini - uma zikhululekile, azizokwazi ukubamba nokudonsa kahle. Hlola ukuthi izinyathelo zamathayi wonke ahlale ahlale phambili. Izingxenye zokuhamba zomphathi zineqhaza elikhulu, ngakho kunezinto eziningi ezingase zishiswe ngokushesha. Kubalulekile ukuthi ama-bushings, ama-bearings, kanye ne-gearbox kube sesimweni esihle. Uma kukhona izingxenye ezishisiwe, kungadala ukuthi umphathi ungasebenzi kahle endleleni - lokhu kungadala ingozi ngoba umshayeli akanawo amandla okulawula umphathi kahle, futhi kudala ukugqoka kwamathayi. Kukhona ama-plates akhethekile okuvikela kumphathi (umbala wawo uvamise ukufana nalowo womphathi). Inhloso yalezi ziplate ukuvikela umshayeli kanye nezingxenye ezihambayo. Njalo lezi ziplate zishiswa, futhi kwesinye isikhathi azisatholakali. Kubalulekile ukuzifaka kumphathi, shintsha lezo ezilahlekile, futhi hlola ukuthi ama-bolts abamba aqinile. Izingxenye lapho ezinye izinto zixhunywe futhi ziqinisiwe ngumphathi kufanele zihlale ziqinile. Sebenzisa ama-pins afanele usayizi uma uhudula ezinye izinto ngoba azikwazi ukuba nesisindo esifanayo - ama-pins amancane athwala isisindo sonke sokuhudula, futhi yibo kuphela abamba ibha yokuhudula. Iziphumo eziningi zenzeka uma lezi zingxenye zingahlolwanga kahle.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke: Isibuyekezo Esibalulekile Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisikhathi esibalulekile emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izakhamizi zifaka khona izinketho zazo ukuze kukhethwe abaholi abazobhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kuhambisana nezifiso, izimvo, nezidingo ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Njengoba sihamba kule ndaba, sizodingida izici ezihlukahlukene, izinselelo, nemiphumela ethinta umphakathi ngokujwayelekile. Ukuhlaziywa Kwezenzo Ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlanganisa izigaba eziningi, okuhlanganisa imikhankaso, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani. Imikhankaso igxile ezinselelweni ezithinta umphakathi, njengezisebenzi, imfundo, nezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bethu baqonde izidingo zabantu futhi basize ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ngesikhathi sokhetho, umphakathi uhlanganyela emicimbini ehlukene, njengemihlangano nezinkulumo, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphatheke ndawonye futhi bahlale behlanganyela emibonweni ehlukene. Ukwaziswa kwabantu ngamalungelo abo kanye nezinyathelo zokubamba iqhaza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokukhuluma. Izinhlelo Zokuvota Nezobuchwepheshe Ngesikhathi sokhetho, izinhlelo zokuvota zidlala indima ebalulekile. Ubuchwepheshe buye bukhula, futhi izinhlelo zokuvota ezisheshayo nezilula zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuthi bavote. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvota okuphephile, izikhumbuzo zokuvota zisetshenziswa, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangavota kanjani, bazi isikhathi, kanye nezindawo zokuvota. Nokho, kukhona nezinselelo, njengoba ukuvota kwezobuchwepheshe kudinga ukuqapha okukhulu ukuze kuvinjwe ubugebengu. Izinhlangano ezizimele nezokubambisana zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane iyavikelwa ukuze kube nokwethembeka emiphumeleni yokhetho. Imiphumela Yokhetho Imiphumela yokhetho ibonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini. Kukhona abaholi abasha abavela ezinkampanini ezahlukene, okukhombisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zifuna ushintsho. Lokhu kuholela ezinguqulweni ezibalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu, ezifana nokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, izinhlelo zokufundisa, kanye nokwabelana ngezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukhetho lukazwelonke kudinga ukuqonda okujulile phakathi kwabantu, ukuze bazi ukuthi izinqumo ezithathiwe zinezimpempe ezinzima emiphakathini yabo. Abaholi kufanele bahlale bexhumene nezakhamuzi zabo, beqinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso zabo zisebenza futhi zikhuthaza umphakathi. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Kokubamba Iqhaza Ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhona nje ukubalwa kwezikhumbuzo, kodwa kuyisikhathi esibalulekile sokubamba iqhaza. Ukuvota kuwumsebenzi ongenzeka kuphela uma abantu bejula izizathu ezithinta impilo yabo. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bavote, bahlale bexhumene nabaholi, futhi bazi kahle amalungelo abo, kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi ukhetho lukazwelonke luhamba phambili ngokubambisana. Umphakathi, abaholi, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo ezithathiwe zikhuthaza ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kwabo bonke. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwakha isisekelo sambusazwe esiqinile, esizogcina sihamba phambili ekukhuleni nasekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngakho-ke, masibambe iqhaza, sizibophezela ekuthuthukiseni izwe lethu, ngoba ukhetho lukazwelonke luwumsebenzi wethu sonke. Izenzo zethu namuhla zinezimpempe ezinzima kusasa, futhi lokhu kudinga umoya wokubambisana, ukuqonda, kanye nezifiso ezithinta wonke umuntu.
Ukugcina imibhalo ngokomthetho kuyisibopho somthetho esidinga bonke abashicileli (nokukhiqiza) eNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izinhlobo zemibhalo, kuhlanganise naleyo eshicilelwe ngobuchwepheshe, ukuthi bathumele inani elithile lezi zinkampani abazishicilelile ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ezibekwe ukuze zigcinwe. Kuyisiko emhlabeni wonke ukuthi uhulumeni badinge abakhiqizi bezinhlobo zonke zemibhalo, kuhlanganise namavidiyo namathrekhi abhalwe, ukuthi bahlinzeke ngenani elithile lemikhiqizo yabo kulezi zindawo ezisemthethweni ezibekwe. Okwamanje, amazwe emhlabeni jikelele abuyekeza futhi aguqule imithetho yabo ephathelene nokuhanjiswa kwemibhalo ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze kuhlangabezane nokwanda kwemibhalo eshicilelwe ngobuchwepheshe efana namavidiyo, ama-CD, nama-DVD. Inhloso yokugcina ulwazi endaweni esemthethweni ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokuhlinzeka abasebenzisi balo msebenzi, kokubili ngesikhathi samanje nakusasa, ngolwazi nemibhalo equkethe imisebenzi namagugu amasiko abalulekile kuzwelonke. Ukugcina ulwazi ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kwaqala ngo-1842 ngokwethulwa kokuqala kweMthetho Wamalungelo Ababhali waseBrithani, ovikela ilungelo lombhali lokuba ngumthombo wemibhalo kuyo yonke iMpire yaseBrithani. Kwakukhona futhi izinguquko emthethweni ngesikhathi seMthetho Wamalungelo Ababhali ka-1965 kanye neMthetho Yokugcina Imibhalo Eseshicilelwe ka-1982. Okwamanje, iMthetho Yokugcina Imibhalo (Umthetho 54 ka-1997) yakhishwa ngomhla kaJulayi 1, 1998. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwemibhalo, izincwadi, neminye imithombo equkethe ulwazi olufana namafilimu, amavidiyo, ama-CD omculo, nama-DVD, wonke ashicilelwe noma akhiqizwe eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo somthetho esibanzi mayelana nenani lezi zinkampani okufanele zigcinwe, isimo sokufika kwazo, ulwazi oludingekayo kubashicileli nabakhiqizi, isikhathi sokuhanjiswa kwezinkampani, kanye nezinyathelo okufanele zithathwe uma abashicileli nabakhiqizi behluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho. Imibhalo iyinto enzelwe ukugcina noma ukudluliselwa njengolwazi olubhalwe, kungaba kokubhaliwe, kokubukwayo, noma okurekhodiwe ukuze kulalelwe, nangendlela ethile ebonakalayo nangeminye imithombo ebonakalayo. Lokhu kubhekisela kwimibhalo ekhiqizwe ukuze isetshenziswe emphakathini, ehlelelwe ukukhiqizwa nokusabalalisa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, egcina noma idlulisa ulwazi olubhalwe, ulwazi lokubukwayo, ulwazi olurekhodiwe ukuze kulalelwe, olufundwa ngama-mishini, noma lwethulwa nganoma iyiphi enye ifomethi ehlolwe noma esanda kushicilelwa eyahluka kakhulu kulokho okwakukhona ngaphambili ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi luhlukile noma indlela nesimo sokuthi luthunyelwe kulokhu kushicilelwa eNingizimu Afrika noma ehlelelwe ukusetyenziswa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcina ifa elibhalwe nelirekhodiwe kusiza ukufinyelela kwabantu emisebenzini yonke eshicilelwe eyakhiqizwe ezweni labo. Ngakho-ke, ukugcina ulwazi ngokomthetho kuyisici esibalulekile sokukhululeka kolwazi. Kusiza izwe lethu ukuba ligcine izibopho zakhona zokwethembeka kubantu bonke, kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wombhali awulahlekile futhi uyatholakala ukuze ucwaningwe esikhathini esizayo, kuvumela indawo yokugcina ukuba ikhulume ngokuqwashisa kubo bonke abasebenzisi balemisebenzi mayelana nalokho okukhishwe nokushicilelwe njengesisekelo sokwakhiwa kwezincwadi zendawo nezinye iziqoqo zolwazi ezazisa abasebenzisi-bokugcina nalabo abazozisebenzisa ezwenikazi nasemhlabeni jikelele ngencwadi ezikhona neminye imibhalo, ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthaza ukusabalala kwayo nokuthengwa, kuba isisekelo sokuhlanganiswa kwezibalo ezikhiqizwe yi-UNESCO emhlabeni jikelele, okuyinsiza ewusizo yolwazi emsebenzini wezincwadi nezohwebo. Kungase futhi kusebenze le njongo kwezinye izindlela.
Sicela ubike zonke izifo zokukhulelwa ezibulalayo ezenzeka endaweni yakho. Xhumana neklinikhi, isibhedlela, noma inhlangano eseduze ehlinzeka ngempilo yabesifazane esifundazweni sakho. Emhlabeni jikelele, cishe abesifazane abangu-600,000 bafa ngenxa yezizathu ezihlobene nokukhulelwa unyaka nonyaka. Iphesenti elingu-99% (99%) yalezi zifo zenzeka ezweni elithuthukayo noma elingakathuthukiswa. Ukufa kwabafazi abakhulelwe kuyindaba edabukisayo ngoba iningi layo lingavikeleka. Izimo umama okhulelwe azibhekene nazo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, ikakhulukazi isifo senhliziyo, zingaholela ezinkingeni. Umama okhulelwe angabhekana nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma sokubeletha. Nokho, izimo namathuba ahluka. Abesifazane abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-34 kufanele baqale ukubonisana nomthandazi noma udokotela ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Labo abaqedile ukukhulisa izingane kufanele bacabangele ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela noma ukwenza abalingani babo (obaba) bazise. Abesifazane abakhulelwe izikhathi eziyisihlanu noma ngaphezulu kufanele bahlale bebona umthandazi noma udokotela ukuze bahlolwe kahle ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Abesifazane abanesifo senhliziyo kufanele baphendule udokotela wezifo zenhliziyo mayelana nesimo sabo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Omama abathinteka kakhulu yisifo senhliziyo bencike ekucabangeni izindlela zokuvikela. Omama abakhulelwe abake benza ukuhlinzwa kufanele bahlale bebeletha esibhedlela esingahlinzeka ngempilo yokuhlinzwa ngaso sonke isikhathi sosuku, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemva kwemini noma ebusuku. Abesifazane abakhulelwe abahlangabezana nezinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuza, ubuhlungu obuqhubekayo besisu, ukuphefumula okuphuthumayo, noma ukukhishwa okukhukhumezayo kufanele babike ngokushesha esikhungweni esiseduze noma esibhedlela. Hlela ukukhulelwa kwakho uma kungenzeka, futhi kufanele uphathwe umuntu onolwazi nolufundisiwe ekubeletheni. Vakashela iklinikhi yendawo noma udokotela uma uphumelele izinsuku zakho ezimbili ukuze uhlolwe. Iya ekilinikhi noma kudokotela uma ungafuni ukuqhubeka nokukhulelwa futhi ufune usizo. Hlale usebenzisa ikhondomu ngesikhathi sokwenza uthando uma ungafuni ukukhulelwa noma uma usukhulelwe. Sekela umuntu okhulelwe ekhaya ngenkathi ekhulelwe, ngesikhathi sokubeletha, noma ngemuva kokubeletha. Khuthaza ukuvakashela iklinikhi yokuhlinzeka ngaphambi kokukhulelwa (ukunakekelwa kwangaphambi kokukhulelwa) futhi uhlela imisebenzi ukuze umuntu okhulelwe akwazi ukuhamba. Sekela iklinikhi yendawo yakho ukuze inikeze usizo oluphakeme.
Yini udlame lwasekhaya? Umdlalo wempilo yomuntu ophazamisa wena noma ongakwenza uphathwe kabi empilweni yakho, ukuphepha kwakho, noma impilo yakho. Uma lezi zinhlobo zokuhlukunyezwa zenzeka kuwe noma kumuntu owaziwayo, ungafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa ukuze uvimbele umhlukunyezwa ekungeni endaweni yokuhlala eyabelwe noma engxenye ethile ebekwe njengengxenye yendawo yokuhlala; noma ukuthatha noma iyiphi isinyathelo esifakiwe ohlelweni lwezokuvikela enkantolo. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa enkantolo? Noma ubani onakekela noma okhathazekile ngempilo yomfaki-sicelo. Abantu abalandelayo bangafaka isicelo ngovuma komlamuli ebhalwe phansi, ngaphandle uma umlamuli engumntwana, noma uma engumuntu onengqondo engalungile, okhishwe njengomuntu ongekho emthethweni, noma uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi leyo muntu ayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngovuma lwabo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. Igama lesiteshi samaphoyisa lapho umlamuli angabika khona ukuphulwa kwesivumelwano sokuvikelwa asifakile. Umuntu okhishwe njengomuntu ongekho emthethweni noma ongumntwana angaba nomuntu ofaka isicelo ngaye uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi leyo muntu ayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngovuma lwabo noma ukuhlinzeka ngovuma oludingekayo. Qedela ifomu bese ulithumela kumqondisi wenkantolo. Uma ifomu lamukelwe, umqondisi uzothumela isicelo sakho kumjudge ozobeka usuku lokuthi ubuye enkantolo ukuze uxoxe ngesicelo sakho. Ujaji uzophinde alungise isaziso sokwazisa umhlukunyezwa ngokuqinile, kanye nokubazisa ngesikhathi sokufika enkantolo. Uma udaba lufika phambi kwenkantolo, ujaji angakhipha umyalo wokuvikela. Umyalo ungatholwa ngalolo suku, kodwa lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka kuye ngobunzima bedaba lakho. Umyalo uqhubeka usebenza kuze kube umphakathi ophazamiswe uyawukhansela. Uma umhlukunyezwa efaka isikhalazo, umyalo uqhubeka usebenza kuze kube ukhanselewa yiNkantolo Yokubuyisela. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Ezobunjiniyela: Umhlaba Wokwakha Nokuqamba Ngiyakwemukela, mngani! Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ethokozisayo, ezobunjiniyela. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ubunjiniyela bukhona ezindaweni eziningi empilweni yethu? Yebo, ngempela! Akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo ezinkulu, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuhlela, ukudala, nokwenza izinto zisebenze kahle. Ngakho, ake sihlole le ndaba ngokujulile. Ukuqala, ake sikhulume ngencazelo yobunjiniyela. Ngabe ubunjiniyela buwukwakha kuphela? Cha, mngani! Ubunjiniyela buhlanganisa izimfanelo eziningi, kusukela kumakhono okucabanga, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nekhono lokuxazulula izinkinga. Umjikelezo wokwakha uhlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi, kusukela ekucabangeni ngempela, ukuya ekwakheni, bese ekugcineni, ukwakha umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu, futhi akulula, kodwa kuyajabulisa! Ngabe ubunjiniyela bukhona emikhakheni ehlukene? Impela! Sinezakhiwo, ubunjiniyela bezokwakha, ubunjiniyela bezokuthutha, ubunjiniyela bezobuchwepheshe, nokunye okuningi. Ngicabanga ukuthi ubunjiniyela bezokwakha bukhona obala kakhulu. Cabanga nje ngalezi zikhumbuzo ezinkulu ezikhaliphile, ezinjengezikhumbuzo zezimoto, izakhiwo ezinkulu, noma izinhlelo zokuhamba. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha, kodwa futhi nokuhlela kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubunjiniyela buye buguquka. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ubunjiniyela bukhona emhlabeni wonke? Yebo, mngani! Abantu bahlala bejolise ezintweni ezintsha, futhi lokhu kudala amathuba amasha. Ngabe ubunjiniyela bukhona ezindaweni ezinjengokwakha izimoto ezisebenza ngogesi, noma izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile? Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubunjiniyela bukhona ukuze buphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Ngabe ubunjiniyela buhamba kanjani nezobuchwepheshe? Lokhu kuyinto ebalulekile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ubunjiniyela bukhona ukuze buphendule. Cabanga nje ngama-drones, izinhlelo zokusebenza, noma izimoto ezizimele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ubunjiniyela buhamba phambili ukuze buphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zidinga ubunjiniyela ukuze zisebenze? Lokhu kudinga abantu abanolwazi ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezisebenzayo.
