IPhalamende leNingizimu Afrika linezindlu ezimbili: iNational Assembly (eyaziwa njenge-NA), enamalungu angama-400, kanye neNational Council of Provinces (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP), enamalungu angama-90 okungenani. Umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP temsilisela izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kohlelo lukazwelonke. Lokhu kwenziwa ikakhulukazi ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokuwina imithetho kazwelonke nokunikeza umphakathi ipulatifomu kazwelonke yokubamba izingxoxo ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta izifunda. I-NCOP iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zokuphatha zendawo zicatshangelwa ezingeni likazwelonke. Abameleli baholwa nguMphakathi wezifunda ngasinye, ongomunye wababambiqhaza abakhethekile. Uma kudingeka, uMphakathi angabeka omunye umuntu endaweni yakhe. Umphakathi, kanye nababambiqhaza ababili, ubheka umsebenzi we-NCOP futhi uphatha izingxoxo, uqinisekisa ukuthi abameleli bakhuluma ngokukhululeka uma behambisana nemithetho ebekwe yiNdlu. Ubabambiqhaza ukhethwa ukuze asebenze isikhathi esigcwele seminyaka emihlanu, kanti oMphakathi bezifunda bayashintshashintsha njengababambiqhaza isikhathi esiyisithupha. I-NCOP kufanele ibonwe njengendawo engasiza ekuphathweni kokubambisana kanye nenhloso enkulu yokubambisana, futhi ikhuthaza ukucatshangelwa kwezidingo zokuphatha zendawo kanye nezifunda ezingeni likazwelonke. I-NCOP inikeza izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zeNingizimu Afrika izwi futhi inikeza nohulumeni bendawo ipulatifomu yokubamba iqhaza ekuhlinzekeni kwemithetho ezingeni likazwelonke. Kumele icabangele yonke imithetho kazwelonke. Iphinde ikwazi ukuhlinzeka noma ukulungisa imithetho ephansi kuSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo (lezi zindaba lapho kokubili imithetho kazwelonke nezifunda zinamandla okwenza imithetho ndawonye) nezinye izinqubo ezithinta izifunda. Iningi lale misebenzi yokuwina imithetho yenziwa emaqenjini, kodwa yonke imithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwi-NCOP ukuze ixoxwe futhi ivote ukuthi le mithetho yamukelwa noma iyalahlwa. Imithetho engathinti izifunda iphathelene nemisebenzi kazwelonke; njengezokuphepha, ezangaphandle, kanye nezenzo zomthetho. Uma le mithetho yamukelwa yiNational Legislature, ithunyelwa kwi-NCOP ukuze ivotwe. Izibonelo zemithetho ethinta izifunda zifaka phakathi imfundo, ukuthuthwa, inhlalakahle, kanye nezempilo. Iningi lemithetho lingangeniswa kwi-NCOP nganoma iyiphi yalezi zindlu; nokho, kukhona ezinye izinqubo ezidinga ukuqala kwiNational Legislature. Uma kukhona ukungavumelani phakathi kwe-NA ne-NCOP ngemithetho ethinta izifunda, le mithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwiKomidi Lokuxazulula. Uma umthetho owenza ushintsho kumthethosisekelo uthinta ngqo izifunda, okungenani eziyisithupha zezifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye kwi-NCOP kumele zivume. Uma umthetho owenza ushintsho kumthethosisekelo ungathinti ngqo izifunda, umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP kumele ibe nengxoxo ngalolo mthetho (ngaphandle kokuvotwa) ngaphambi kokuba ithunyelwe kwi-NA ukuze ivotwe. Ukuhlola okwenziwa uhulumeni njengoba kukhishwa umthethosisekelo kuhlanganisa ukuthi amaLungelo Ezifunda alandele futhi ahlaziye izenzo zohulumeni. I-NCOP yenza ukuhlola kwezindaba zikazwelonke ezivela ezifundeni nasemaphandleni. I-NCOP ingacela ilungu leKhabhinethi, osomabhizinisi bakazwelonke, noma osomabhizinisi bezifunda ukuba baphathe umhlangano wayo noma umhlangano wekomidi. I-NCOP noma noma yisiphi sezikomidi zayo zingamukela izicelo, izethulo, noma izincwadi ezibhaliwe ezivela kubantu noma izinhlangano ezinomdlandla. I-NCOP iphinde ibambisane nemiphakathi ukuze ihlole izenzo zohulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iqoqe ulwazi ngezidingo nezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo. Ikomidi ngalinye lihlola umsebenzi wesigaba ngasinye soHulumeni. Ikomidi iprocessa futhi ilungisa imithetho, futhi ikhuthaza ama-foramu omphakathi uma kukhona udaba olubalulekile lokwazisa umphakathi. AmaKomidi angamema noma ubani ukuba ahlinzeke ubufakazi noma athumele imibhalo, futhi angacela noma ubani noma inhlangano ukuthi ibike kubo ngezindaba ezithile. Abameleli bezifunda ngasinye banokhetho oluthile oluphakanyiswa ngumholi wokuqhamuka kwezifunda egameni lesifunda. Amalungu omphakathi angadlala indima ebonakalayo ekuhloleni okwenziwa uhulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula ezidingweni zabantu. Ukuphakela kumakomidi ephalamende kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokwabelana ngemibono yakho namalungu ekomidi ngenkathi bexoxa futhi beprocessa umthetho othile ngaphambi kokuba uqedwe. Isicelo siyindlela yokuletha ePhalamende izikhalazo noma izindaba ezithinta umphakathi ukuze ikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngaphakathi kwamandla ayo. Ilungelo lokuphakela ePhalamende liyilungelo labantu bonke baleli zwe futhi linikezwa umthethosisekelo wethu. Noma ubani, noma amaqembu abantu noma noma iyiphi inhlangano inelungelo lokuphakela ePhalamende. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana namalungu ePhalamende emahhovisi abo ezokwakha ezweni lonke noma ePhalamende uma befuna ukuthi babasekele ngodaba olushisayo abafuna ukuxoxwa ngalo noma uma bedinga usizo ngendaba ethile.
Kufanele ugweme izenzo ezingase zibe nomthelela omubi emfanekisweni noma egameni lemakethe. Sebenzisa ulimi olufanele futhi ugweme ukusebenzisa izinsolo. Kufanele ugweme ukusebenzisa amagama abantu abanye ngaphandle kwemvume yabo. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokucwaswa. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokuhlambalaza futhi ugweme ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi, impi, nokuhlukunyezwa kwengqondo. Khuthaza ubumbano futhi ugweme ukusabalalisa ukungaboni ngaso linye. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ziyaqhutshwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabanye. Gwema ukuzithokozisa, ukuphatha, noma ukuhlukunyezwa kwezinto ezithokozisayo. Khuthaza indawo ehlanzekile yokusebenza. Gxila emsebenzini wakho. Hlonipha isikhathi sokusebenza uma wenza imisebenzi yakho. Landela izindlela ezifanele uma uphakamisa izikhalazo. Ziphatha ngendlela ethuthukisa noma ekhuthaza umfanekiso/igama elihle emakethe. Khuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende/izivakashi ngokuba nobungane, ukuthobeka, nokusiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswa kumakhasimende iyakhwalithi ephezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengwe ilethwa ngesikhathi. Phendula izikhalazo zamakhasimende ngokushesha futhi wamukele impendulo. Yamukela ukubaluleka kwamakhasimende ngokuvulekile nangokwethembeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi intengo yemikhiqizo yakho ilungile futhi iyamukeleka. Khuthaza ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabo bonke osomabhizinisi. Ukuze kube sobala, ubambisane nebhodi ngangokunokwenzeka. Hlonipha izibopho zenkontileka yakho. Hlonipha izinqumo zebhodi. Landela ikhodi yokuziphatha kanye nenqubo yokuhola izikhalazo ezibekwe yibhodi. Kuzoba nezindlela ezimbili zokuphikisana, ezisemthethweni nezingenamthetho. Lokhu kuqhutshelwa ngamalungu amane osomabhizinisi. Kubhekana neziphazamiso ezinzima zekhodi yokuziphatha. Lokhu kuqhutshelwa ngamalungu amahlanu, amathathu awo evela ebhodini kanti amabili anikezwe osomabhizinisi. Kubhekana neziphazamiso ezinzima kakhulu zekhodi yokuziphatha. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa uphenyo uma kukhona izinsolo zokwephula ikhodi yokuziphatha. Kuthunyelwa amalungu amabili ukuze kuphenywe lezi zinsolo. Kuqhutshelwa icala lokuhola izikhalazo. Yena okhetha ukuthi izinsolo zokwephula ikhodi yokuziphatha kufanele zilandele inqubo esemthethweni noma eyingenamthetho. Noma ubani onenkinga angafaka isikhalazo mayelana nokwephula ikhodi, futhi kunconywa ukuba kube okubhalwe phansi. Abantu ababili bazothunyelwa ukuze baphenye ukwephula ikhodi. Ithimba lokuphenya lizohlanganisa ubufakazi obufanele mayelana nalezi zinsolo. Osomabhizinisi abasolwa ngokwephula ikhodi kumele banikezwe ithuba lokuphendula kulezi zinsolo. Uma ikomidi lezikhalazo lithola ukuthi kukhona ubufakazi obucacile, lizokhipha izijeziso ezibhekiswe kosomabhizinisi abasolwa ngokwephula ikhodi.
Izinyathelo ezizolandela uma iziphathimandla zezimboni zikhona ezinyathelweni eziphikisana nokuncintisana. Ukuphathwa nokugcinwa kweMthetho Wamazwe Wamaphakheji kuyingxenye yemisebenzi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Ibhodi ibhekisela ebhodini labaphathi beZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ezakhelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 6. IZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ibhekisela kumphakathi wamaphakheji eNingizimu Afrika. "Abasebenzisi bamaphakheji" babhekisela kulabo abaqondile abasebenzisa iphakheji (abanikazi bezikebhe), nalabo abangasebenzisi iphakheji ngqo (abangenisi bezimpahla ezivela phesheya nezithunyelwe zezimali kwezinye izizwe), kanye nabaphakathi emisebenzini yamaphakheji (abamele) kanye nabasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphakheji (abakhiqizi nabathengi). Abasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphakheji bangabantu abakhokha ngezinsizakalo zamaphakheji. Ngakho-ke abakhiqizi nabathengi bezwe yibo abasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphakheji. "Amaphakheji" abhekisela kumaphakheji ezentengiselwano akhishwe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wamaphakheji eNingizimu Afrika. Kuzokwakhiwa isikhungo esizophathwa yiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji, esizoba nebhodi, umkomishana, nabasebenzi. Ukuvikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla nokwenza kube nezehlakalo ezilungile zokusebenzisa amaphakheji. Ukuqapha nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele, uma kudingeka, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iTransnet ayihlanganyeli ekuziphatheni okuphikisana nokuncintisana emisebenzini yayo yokuhweba neZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji futhi ukuthi imali eqoqwe yiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji isetshenziswa ukuze izuze iziphathimandla, abathengi, futhi ibe nomthelela ezimweni zezimali nezokuxhumana zomphakathi. Ukuhlela iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ekwenzeni imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Ukuphatha izinyathelo ezifanele ezizolandela uma kukhona izinsolo zokuziphatha okuphikisana nokuncintisana. Siqapha futhi silawula iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wamaphakheji. Sivikela futhi sithatha njengendawo yokudluliselwa kwezikhalazo nokunganeliseki okuqondiswe kwiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. IZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji iqapha, ihlola, futhi ithatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukusiza ekwenzeni lo mthetho kanye nezinye izinqubo ezihlobene. Sivikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla futhi siqinisekisa ukufinyelela okulinganayo kumaphakheji nokutholakala kwezinsizakalo zamaphakheji, siqapha futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ayitholi izinzuzo ezingafanele phezu kwezinye izinkampani zokuhamba nokuthi imali eqoqwe ngamaphakheji isetshenziswa ukuze izuze futhi ithuthukise izakhiwo nezinhlelo zamaphakheji ukuze kuzuze abasebenzisi bamaphakheji. Siqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuphathwa kweMthetho Wamaphakheji yiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Siqapha futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphakheji atholakala, nokuthi izinsiza zamaphakheji zikhona ngaphandle kokubandlululwa, kahle, nangokucacile. Ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha; ukuvikeleka kwezomnotho, kanye nokusebenza kahle kwamaphakheji. Ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kwesikhathi esifanele nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezisetshenziswa kumaphakheji ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo nezilindelo zabasebenzisi bamaphakheji, siqinisekisa ukuhlela kahle kwezohwebo phakathi kwalabo abenza emaphakheji nalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kumaphakheji, siqinisekisa ukuthi iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji inikeza usizo olufanele futhi ihambisana nezindinganiso zamazwe omhlaba ezamukelekayo, ibambisane nezinsizakalo zikamasipala nezinye izithakazelo ezibalulekile emkhakheni wamaphakheji, futhi iqoqe futhi igcine ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Sisebenzisa noma yiziphi amandla, siqedela noma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwalomthetho, noma ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano somhlaba. IZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji izoba namalungu angaphansi kuka-5 futhi angaphezu kuka-13 abekwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze bisebenze isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu, futhi la malungu angaphinde abekwe. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, lobuchwepheshe, lobuholi, lwezomnotho, lokuthuthukiswa, nolunye ulwazi olufanele olusebenza embonini yokuhamba kwezokuthutha. Kumele bakhethwe noma bathathe indawo yabanye ngendlela ekhuthaza intuthuko nokwakhiwa kwamakhono. UNgqongqoshe angabeka isikhundla eMnyangweni Wezokuthutha ukuze kube nguSihlalo weZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ezizimele. Uma ilungu leBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ngaphandle kwalungu elibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3 ngezizathu ezithile lishiya ukuba ilungu, uNgqongqoshe angabeka noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise le ndawo engatholakali isikhathi esisele. Ilungu leBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji lingakhokhelwa ngenkonzo yalo, ngemali ethathwa nguNgqongqoshe ngezikhathi ezithile. Ilungu elinokungqubuzana kwezithakazelo noma elingase libe nokungqubuzana kwezithakazelo okungase kuphazamise isikhundla sako njengelungu kumele likhombise izithakazelo zalo kwiBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Bonke amalungu kumele akhombise izithakazelo zawo kwiBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zikhona ezomuntu, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezihlobene nezohwebo, futhi azise uSihlalo nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. Noma yisiphi isiphazamiso kunoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalomthetho singase singafezekisi izidingo ezibekwe esigabeni 6. Bangakhokhelwa umholo futhi bangakhokhela abasebenzi imiholo, izinzuzo, nezinye izinzuzo ezamukelwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umkomishana kumele aqaphe zonke izinkulumo zokukhala nezikhalazo ezilethwa kwiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Kumele abhale futhi athumele umbiko wonyaka mayelana nokusebenza kweZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. IZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ingabamba imihlangano uma kudingeka ukuze ikwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yayo. Ngemva kokwamukela isicelo esibhaliwe esivela kumalungu amane, uSihlalo angabiza umhlangano ozobanjwa phakathi kwesonto kusukela ngosuku alwamukela ngalo isicelo. Izinyathelo ezizolandela emihlanganweni kumele zisetshenziswe. Inani lamalungu okumele abe khona emhlanganweni weZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji kumele kube iningi lamalungu. Isinqumo seningi lamalungu abakhona emhlanganweni sizobhekwa njengesisombululo seZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Uma kukhona ukuhamba okulinganayo endabeni ethile, uSihlalo uzoba ne
Ukwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni: Isidingo Sokuhlonipha Uhlanga Lwethu Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili futhi izinkulumo zethu zikhula, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi izilimi zethu ziwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngesiNgisi nesiZulu, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni akukhona nje kuphela isidingo sokuhlonipha, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa isiZulu nesiNgisi ezikhungweni ezifana nezikole, ezindlini zokusebenza, nasemphakathini jikelele. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekuthuthukiseni ukufunda nokuxhumana, kodwa futhi kudala indawo yokuhlonipha izizinda zethu. Uma izilimi zethu zikhuliswa, sithola ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngokwesibonelo, ezikoleni, ukufundisa ngesiZulu nesiNgisi kubalulekile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili ezifundweni zabo. Abafundi abakhuluma isiZulu njengolimi lwabo lokuqala kufanele bakwazi ukufunda isiNgisi, kodwa futhi kufanele baziqhenye ngesiZulu sabo. Lokhu kudala ukuzethemba nokuzazi, okubalulekile empilweni yabo. Uma izikole zisebenzisa izilimi ezimbili, zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahloniphe izilimi zabo, futhi lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano. Ezindlini zokusebenza, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukuveza imicabango yakhe. Uma abasebenzi bekhuluma isiZulu, bazizwa bekhululekile futhi bekwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuxhumana okungcono, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezihlonipha izilimi eziningi zikhombisa ukuthi zikhathalela abasebenzi bazo, okwenza kube nokwaneliseka emsebenzini. Kodwa-ke, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi akukhona nje kuphela emkhakheni wezokusebenza nezemfundo. Emphakathini, kufanele sikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi ezindaweni zokuhlangana, ezifana nezinkonzo, imicimbi, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi kuzokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Uma sikhuluma ngesiZulu nesiNgisi, sikhombisa ukuthi siyavuma ukuhlonipha izizinda zethu, futhi sikhuthaza abanye ukuba benze okufanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kudinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Uhlelo lokufundisa oluhlanganisa izilimi eziningi kufanele luthuthukiswe, futhi izinsiza ezifanele kufanele zibe khona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka emiphakathini yethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izilimi zethu ziwumgogodla wezimpilo zethu. Ukusebenzisa isiZulu nesiNgisi ezikhungweni akukhona nje kuphela isidingo sokuhlonipha, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Uma sikhuthaza ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi, sithuthukisa ukufunda, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha izizinda zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula, ubumbano, nokukhula emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho-ke, asithathe isinyathelo sokweseka izilimi eziningi ezikhungweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka, futhi kuzokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Uhlanga lwethu luyingxenye yethu, futhi kufanele siluhloniphe. Ukusebenzisa isiZulu nesiNgisi ezikhungweni akukhona nje kuphela isidingo, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Asiqhubeke sikhuluma, sikhuthaza, futhi sihloniphe izilimi zethu.
Ipasipoti yesikhashana iyidokhumenti edingekayo ngokushesha uma uhlela ukuhamba ezweni elizungezile elingadingi ivisa. Ipasipoti yesikhashana ingasetshenziswa futhi ukuze ubuyekeze ngokushesha eNingizimu Afrika. Ivalidi ezinyangeni eziyishumi nanye kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa, kodwa iyahamba kuphela ngohambo olunye oluya ezweni ofuna ukuya kulo nokubuyela eNingizimu Afrika. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezithombe ezine zefomethi ye-pasipoti. Isicelo singathatha izinsuku eziyisihlanu zokusebenza ukuze processing.
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, izinsizakalo zokubeletha zazihamba phambili emakhaya, lapho abesifazane bebelokhu bebelana ngolwazi lokubeletha. Lokhu kwenzeka emiphakathini eminingi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya, lapho izinsiza zezempilo zazincane kakhulu. Abesifazane bebelokhu benza lokhu ngokusekelwa kwababesifazane abangabazali, ababeziqhenya ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile sokuphila. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izidingo zokubeletha zashintsha, futhi kwavela isidingo sokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela. Ngeminyaka yama-1900, izibhedlela ziqala ukuvela njengezindawo ezisemthethweni zokubeletha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abesifazane baphumule, ngoba izibhedlela zazihlinzeka ngempilo, izinsiza nezokwelapha. Izinhlaka ezilungiselelwe kahle zathuthukiswa, futhi izinyathelo zokuphepha zafakwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane nabantu abasha baphila kahle. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, okwakuhlanganisa abezempilo, odokotela, nabahlengikazi. Ukwakhiwa kwezibhedlela ezinkulu, ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubeletha, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabesifazane. Abesifazane babenethuba lokuthola ukunakekelwa okungcono, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi. Izibhedlela zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezinsiza ezifanele, njengama-ward ahlukeneyo, iziguli ezizimele, nezindawo zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Lokhu kwavumela abesifazane ukuba bazizwe bekhululekile, futhi lokhu kwaba yinto eyayibalulekile ekubeletheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bukhula, futhi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zathuthuka kakhulu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane bathola ukunakekelwa okuhle, odokotela baqala ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni kube nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nokuhlolwa kwezitho zomzimba, izithombe ze-ultrasound, kanye nezindlela zokulawula ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Lokhu kwaba yinzuzo enkulu, njengoba abesifazane baziwa ukuthi bazoba nokwaneliseka okukhulu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Naphezu kokuthuthuka kwezinsizakalo zokubeletha, izinselelo zihlala zikhona. Izibhedlela eziningi zikhumbula izinselelo ezihlobene nezinsiza ezikhona, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Abesifazane abaninzi basathola izinkinga zokufinyelela ezibhedlela, ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhamba. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye bakhethe ukuhlala emakhaya, lapho bebelana khona ngolwazi lokubeletha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuhlukumeza, izinkinga zezezimali, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana zathinta abesifazane abaninzi. Abanye abesifazane babengakwazi ukukhokhela izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, okwakwenza kube nzima kakhulu. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinzima, futhi kwadingeka ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane bathola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezibhedlela, uhulumeni, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi zathuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubo ezithuthukisiwe zokubeletha, okuhloswe ngazo ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela. Abesifazane manje baziwa ukuthi bangathola izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Namuhla, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi zikhuluma ngempilo yabesifazane. Abesifazane baziwa ukuthi bangathola ukunakekelwa okuhle, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokuzethemba. Izibhedlela zikhumbula ukubaluleka kokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo, futhi zikhuthaza abesifazane ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabesifazane. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi, futhi kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Abesifazane baziwa ukuthi bangathola izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokuzethemba. Umphakathi uqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokubeletha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane bathola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Kulesi sikhathi samanje, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zikhumbula ukubaluleka kokuhlonipha abesifazane, futhi ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zazo ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abesifazane bayakwazi ukujabulela isikhathi esiyigugu sokubeletha, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ziye zaba yisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungathuthukisa kanjani izinsiza zawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
U-Mnu. Jan Botha ovela e-Thaba'Patchoa uveze ukukhathazeka okuningi mayelana nabalimi abasafufusa emhlanganweni waminyaka yonke we-Grain SA ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa, 2011. Ukhulume kakhulu ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye nokwehluleka kuk government ukubasiza. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka ngezibonelo zezinkinga ezibhekene nabalimi kanye nokwehluleka kuk government ukusiza, u-Jan wathi, "Thina, njengabakhiqizi abamnyama abasafufusa, sibhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo nezabathengisi bezolimo, kodwa kaningi izinkinga zethu zinkulu ngoba asinalo usizo lwezimali olwenziwe." Uqale ngokukhuluma ngezinga lokuphila komhlabathi. Uveze ukuthi ngonyaka odlule i-DAFF yapromisa abakhiqizi ukuthi izohlinzeka ngofulawa. Ngonyaka odlule, amaplanethi akhiwe asetshenziswa i-GPS, izibonelo zomhlabathi zithathwe, umyalezo wakhishwa, futhi kwaboniswa ukuthi kudingeka malini ofulawa, futhi bekukhona imali etholakalayo ebhajethi. Konke lokhu kwenzeka ngoMeyi 2010, kodwa okwamanje, ofulawa awakaze asetshenziswe emapulazini. U-Jan wathi, "Lokhu kuholele ekutheni umkhiqizo wesizini yelanga yonyaka odlule ube phansi, futhi kuzophinde kusho ukuthi kuzoba nomkhiqizo omncane kulonyaka." Isimo esibi semishini kanye nezithuthuthu kuyinkinga enkulu enye ku-Jan. Uthe i-Grain SA ihlole kahle isimo semishini yabalimi abangu-42 e-Free State. I-Grain SA icele i-DAFF ukusiza labo balimi ngama-R2.5 million ukuze balungise le mishini. Konke lokhu kwenziwe yi-Grain SA kwakulungiselelwa ngoMashi 12, 2010, kodwa okwamanje, i-DAFF ayikwenzi lutho. Enye ukukhathazeka yizijeziso zabakhiqizi emapulazini nasemaphandleni lapho amanzi flow. Uthe, "I-DAFF inhlelo ezinhle ze-Land Care ezisebenza kahle, kodwa ibhajethi yabo incane kakhulu; umhlaba uyashabalala ngaphambi kokuba bakwazi ukuwuvikela." U-Jan uphinde wakhuluma ngesimo sezindlela endaweni yethu, okwenza kube nzima kubakhiqizi ukuhamba kahle nemikhiqizo yabo - izindlela zindala futhi zingozi ngoba zibhujiswa izithuthuthu. Wabe esedlulela kwenye inkinga, inkinga yokweqisa. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezimbili ezikhathazayo ku-Jan. Okokuqala, uthi izindawo zikhathazeka ekuphathweni komhlaba womphakathi kahle. Okwesibili, uthe ukhulume ngezinkinga zabakhiqizi zokufinyelela imali yokuqala yokukhiqiza. U-Jan uchaze ukuthi ngonyaka odlule, abakhiqizi abamnyama bahlakulele kuphela u-25% wezindawo ngoba bahluleka ukuthola uxhaso lokuqala lokukhiqiza. Inzuzo incane kakhulu ukuze kutholakale uxhaso. I-Grain SA ithuthukise izinhlelo zebhizinisi zabakhiqizi abangu-152 kuleli hlelo ezizosiza abakhiqizi abafuna ukuhlinzeka ngemifino yesizini yelanga. Abakhiqizi badinga izibonelelo zesikhashana, kodwa uhulumeni akakaze athathe isinyathelo kulolu daba. "Izinkulungwane ezingama-27,000 zendawo azikhulwanga kulonyaka ngabakhiqizi abamnyama - izindawo ezinhle. Uhulumeni akakwenzi lutho ukusiza labo balimi, kodwa bahlale bephakamisa ukukhathazeka ngokuqhamuka kokuntuleka kokudla esikhathini esizayo." U-Jan uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi unenkinga ngokuthi iziphathimandla zabelana ngemininingwane ngoba zihluleka ukusiza abakhiqizi. "Bahluleka ulwazi nezakhono ngoba bangezange balime ngokwabo; abaningi abafinyeleli ngisho ezindaweni zokulima." Isibonelo sokugcina sokwehluleka kukahulumeni ukusiza abalimi abasafufusa yile: I-Department of Land Affairs inikeza umhlaba kubantu abangabalimi. "Abalimi abanolwazi baqhubeka nokuhlupheka ngoba bengenalo umhlaba wabo wokulima, kodwa abantu abangakwazi ukulima manje banikezwa umhlaba ongasebenzi." U-Mnu. Jan Botha uphethe ngokucela uMongameli weKomidi lePhothifoliyo ukuthi athumele le mibiko kuhulumeni. "Bahluleka ukusiza abalimi abamnyama futhi ngeke bakwazi ukushintsha le nkathi yokuphila uma bengahlinzeki abantu ngalokho okudingekayo."
Umbuzo 1: Yini iTikTok? iTikTok iyinsiza yokwabelana ngama-video amafushane, eyasungulwa nguByteDance, inkampani yaseShayina, ngo-2016. Le nsizakalo ivumela abasebenzisi ukuba benze, bahlele, futhi babelane ngama-video ahlukeneyo, avame ukuba nobude obuphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15 kuya kwezingu-60. I-TikTok isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokufaka umculo, izihlungi, nezithombe ezithokozisayo ukuze ikhulise ubuchwepheshe bokudala babasebenzisi bayo. Umbuzo 2: Kungani iTikTok ithandwa kangaka? I-TikTok ithandwa kakhulu ngenxa yokuba lula kwayo. Abasebenzisi bangakha ama-video anomthelela omkhulu ngokushesha, okudala umoya wokuncintisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTikTok inezici eziningi ezithokozisayo ezifana nezihlungi ezihlukahlukene, umculo, nezinsiza zokuhlela ezithuthukile, okwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukuziveza. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa iTikTok? Izinsizakalo zeTikTok zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe bokudala, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele emkhakheni wezobuciko. Okwesibili, iTikTok iyinsiza yokuxhumana, ivumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuba baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, nokuhlangenwe nakho. Okwesithathu, iTikTok iyindawo yokufunda; abasebenzisi bangafunda ngezinto ezintsha, izindlela, nezifundo ezivela kwabanye. Umbuzo 4: Zikhona izingozi ezihambisana neTikTok? Naphezu kwezithako ezinhle zeTikTok, kunokukhathazeka okuthile. Okokuqala, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngempilo yengqondo, njengoba abasebenzisi bangase bahlupheke ngenxa yokucindezeleka kokuncintisana. Okwesibili, kukhona izinkinga zokuphepha kwedatha, njengoba iTikTok idinga ukufinyelela emithonjeni ethile ukuze isebenze kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abasebenzisi bahlale beqaphela ukuthi bangabelana ngani, bahlale bephapheme ngezinkinga zokuphepha. Umbuzo 5: Ngabe iTikTok iyinsiza yokukhangisa? Yebo, iTikTok iyinsiza ewusizo yokukhangisa. Amabhizinisi amaningi asebenzisa iTikTok ukuze afinyelele izithameli ezintsha, ikakhulukazi abantu abasha. Ngemikhankaso yokukhangisa efanele, amabhizinisi angathola ukufinyelela okukhulu, okuthuthukisa ukubonakala kwabo emakethe. Izikhangiso kuTikTok zihluke kakhulu, zisuka ezikhangisweni ezijwayelekile kuya kumavidiyo akhuthazayo. Umbuzo 6: Ungawusebenzisa kanjani kahle iTikTok? Ukuze usebenzise kahle iTikTok, kubalulekile ukuba necebo. Qala ngokwenza ama-video akho ahluke, akhangayo, futhi anomqondo. Sebenzisa izihlungi nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uthuthukise izinga le-video yakho. Futhi, zama ukuhamba phambili nezitayela ezisha, njengoba lokhu kungakusiza ukuthi uthole abalandeli abaningi. Qiniseka futhi ukuthi uxhumana nabanye abasebenzisi, uphendula iziphakamiso, futhi ubonise ukweseka abanye. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokuphila ezitholakala kuTikTok? I-TikTok iyindawo yokwabelana ngezindlela zokuphila ezahlukene. Abasebenzisi bahlala bebamba izifundo zokupheka, izindlela zokuzivocavoca, izifundo zokuhlela, nomqondo wokuphila ophilayo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu bengafunda khona izinto ezithokozisayo futhi benze izinguquko ezinhle empilweni yabo. Umbuzo 8: Yini ezayo kuTikTok? Ngokukhula okuqhubekayo kweTikTok, kubalulekile ukuthi silindele izinguquko ezithile. I-TikTok izothuthukisa izici zayo, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nokuphepha kwedatha, ukuze ivikele abasebenzisi bayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizobona ukukhula kwezinkampani ezisebenzisa iTikTok ukuze zikhangise, kanye nokwanda kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Isiphetho: iTikTok iyinsiza ethokozisayo, enezinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi inezingozi ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi ukuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani le nsizakalo ukuze bathole okuhle kuyo, futhi bahlale beqaphela izingozi. Njengoba iTikTok iqhubeka nokukhula, sizobona izinguquko ezithokozisayo ezizokwenza le nsizakalo ibe ngcono nakakhulu.

Izinsolo zokuthi imali yomphakathi isetshenziswe yiMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi eGauteng ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhloso zeqembu lezepolitiki azizange ziqinisekiswe, njengoba kuboniswe ucwaningo lweHhovisi Lomvikeli Womphakathi (OPP). I-OPP yacwaninga udaba lapho ilungu lePhalamende likhalela ukuthi i-African National Congress (ANC) ibikhona esikhundleni seMEC ngaleso sikhathi, sithi inkulumo ethula ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali nguKgaogelo Lekgoro ayifanele futhi ayilungile. Ukuhumusha okuhleliwe kwashicilelwa njengokukhangisa ephephandabeni. Umkhalazi uphikile wathi ukukhangisa kufana nokukhuthazwa kweqembu lezepolitiki okuxhaswe ngempahla yomphakathi. Nokho, ucwaningo lwathola ukuthi "akukwazanga ukuba okuthile okusha noma okungafanele" ukuthi "izikhulu zezombusazwe ezimnyangweni ziveze imibono yazo mayelana nokusebenza kweqembu lezepolitiki elibusayo uma zikhuluma nelegislature ngemicimbi ethinta umphakathi." Umnyango unikezwe amandla nguMthethosisekelo ukuze ubike umphakathi ngomsebenzi wawo kanye nezimali zomphakathi ezabelwe wona, kubika i-OPP ngemuva kocwaningo. Izindleko ezitholakele ekubekeni ukukhangisa ephephandabeni okukhuluma ngokuqukethwe kwenkulumo yeMEC azinakubhekwa njengokungagunyaziwe noma okungafanele. Umvikeli Womphakathi uthole ukuthi izindleko ezihlobene nokukhangisa azizange zikhokhelwe mahhala ngakho-ke azinakubhekwa njengokungadingekile noma ukuchitha.
Unyaka ungaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha. Bafaka umuthi emzimbeni wonke kusukela emathangeni kuya ezindleleni. Linda umuthi owomile. Shiya umuthi emzimbeni usuku oluphelele (24 amahora) bese uwageza ngemuva kwalolo suku. Phinda ngosuku olulandelayo. Kubantwana abangaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha, landela inqubo efanayo njengokwenziwa kwabantu abadala. Kungase kudingeke ukuphinda ngemuva kwesonto, qhubeka usebenzisa umuthi. Gqoka izingubo ezihlanzekile ngemuva kokusebenzisa umuthi. Bonke abantu bomndeni kumele bahlolwe. Nciphisa izinzipho futhi uzigcine zihlanzekile. Geza yonke imibhaco nezingubo ngamanzi ashisayo. Omisa elangeni. Geza umzimba ngamanzi afudumele nesepha, uqhubeke ugeza izindawo ezithintekayo ngombhoxo noma ithawula lokugeza. Hlanza indawo ethintekayo ngendwangu bese uyomisa ngethawula elihlanzekile. Umuzi wonke kumele uhlanzwe ngempahla yokuhlambulula. Ukutheleleka kuhanjiswa kakhulu ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuhlanzeka, ukugcina umuntu ehlanzekile kuzovikela ezilimazweni, ngakho-ke geza umzimba njalo, futhi ugcine izingubo nemibhaco ihlanzekile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Abantu abanezikhalazo kumele basheshe bayofika esibhedlela futhi balandele konke abakutshelwa ngababheki. Abazali kumele bakhuthaze izingane ukuba zihlale zihlanzekile. Izimpawu zikhombisa ezindaweni ezishisayo zomzimba (ezindaweni zokuhlanza nezitho zangasese), ukushaya kungenzeka kube kubi ebusuku. Isikhumba singase sibe nomthelela. Inhliziyo nezitho zomzimba zingase zingasebenzi kahle. Isinyathelo esilandelayo ukufa uma kungenziwa. Ngemva kwesikhathi, izilonda ezingapholi zingase zivele. Ukutheleleka kuhanjiswa kanjani? Kuthintwa kanjani? Ukutheleleka kungathinta izinyoni ezincane. 1. Ukuhlanzeka komuntu: - kulabo abathintekayo (kufana nezinsikazi kodwa zincane kakhulu). Uma lezi zinyoni zikhona, zingadala ukushaya esikhumbeni futhi zikhokele ekugcineni izingubo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi zifaka amaqanda. Ngokuthintana nomuntu onokutheleleka, umuntu angase ahlanze izingubo noma imibhaco, beqaphela elangeni ukuze babulale amaqanda. Kubantu abake baba nokutheleleka, izimpawu zingavela kusukela ezinsukwini eziyodwa kuya kwezine emva kwalokho. Izingane akufanele zidlale nezilwane uma ziba nokuthintana nomuntu noma isilwane (njengokhukhamba) onokutheleleka. 6. Abantu abakha amanzi ezindaweni kumele baqaphele. Ubani ongasondela ekuthelelekeni? Ukutheleleka kungathinta abantu bazo zonke izigaba, kungakhathaliseki ngeminyaka, ubulili, ubuhlanga, noma izinga lokuhlanzeka. Kuqhamuka ngegciwane. Izigameko eziningi noma ukuvela kokutheleleka kuvame ukubonwa ezindlini zabagibeli, kanye nasezikhungweni zokunakekelwa kwezingane. 1. Bonke abantu bomndeni kumele baphathwe ngasikhathi sinye nangendlela efanayo ukuze ukutheleleka kungathinti abanye.
2.1 Uhlelo lweMpi lunguhlelo oluzithandela oluhlangene neSikhungo seMpi saseNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngokungaphelele. Usizo lendawo luhlanganisa umphakathi wonke wendawo, ngakho-ke ngisho nomuntu ongowomphakathi ongum member wohlelo lweMpi uzothola ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo nakuba engatholi zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba yilungu lohlelo. 2.2 Labo abahlanganyela kulolu hlelo lweMpi abanakho umthwalo wemfanelo wokuvikela ngaphandle kwemingcele yezindawo abenza kuzo; banomthwalo wemfanelo kuphela wokuvikela nokuvikela imiphakathi yabo. 2.3 Lolu hlelo lungachazwa ngokufushane njengokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zibe izifunda ezincane, izingxenye ezilawulwayo. Iziqukathi ezincane zinezinombolo ezithile zamafamu noma/nomakhaya, kuye ngesisindo sendawo kanye nokwabiwa kwezindawo lapho abantu behlala khona. Amalungu endaweni axhumana nomholi wabo (okhethwe ngamalungu) onendlela yokuxhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuphendula okusheshayo kwabaphoyisa uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Umholi Wohlelo angazisa umphathi waleso sithangami uma kudingeka amandla amakhulu. 2.4 Inqubo yokuxhumana ingathatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke, amalungu endaweni kumele akwazi ukuzivikela futhi athembe usizo lwabangane nabanye amalungu endaweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula okusheshayo esimweni esiphuthumayo. Ngalesi sizathu, indawo kumele ihlele ukuze ibhekane nezimo ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Umphathi Wendawo uzosiza lolu hlelo lendawo uma luhlela uhlelo lokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo. 2.5 Ukhiye wokusebenza kahle kwalolu hlelo ubambisene ngokulinganayo kwamalungu endaweni wonke. Uphiko lwe-SATI lubambe umhlangano walo wakamuva ngomhla kaFebhuwari 14, 2009. Nansi isifinyezo sezihloko ezisemqoka ezaxoxwa. Iningi lezingxoxo emhlanganweni belihlobene neMthethosisekelo kanye nohlaka (lwalolu hlangano) lokuhamba phambili. Amalungu azokwaziswa ngesikhathi esifanele mayelana nezichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe kuMthethosisekelo, futhi isimemo sokunikezwa kwamagama abantu abazofakwa kuluphiko nasezinhlelweni eminyakeni emibili ezayo sizothunyelwa maduze. Izigaba nemithetho mayelana nale Mklomelo seziqediwe, futhi isimemo sokuhlonza lezi zigaba sizothunyelwa ngoMashi. Khumbula ukuthi umklomelo ojwayelekile usuphakanyisiwe, futhi manje imiklomelo yomuntu siqu izonikezwa kulezi zigaba: ukubhala izincwadi, okungelona iqiniso, izincwadi zezingane, ukuhumusha kwemisebenzi, nezichazamazwi. Amalungu akhuthazwa ukusabalalisa ulwazi ngalolu Mklomelo kanye nesimemo sokunikezwa kwamagama phakathi kwabathengi nabanye abangase babe nentshisekelo. Umcimbi wemiklomelo uzokwenzeka ngoSepthemba 2009 (cishe ngesikhathi esifanayo neSuku Lomhlaba Lokuhumusha). Imali yokufunda ye-SATI engama-R25,000 inikezwe abafundi abane kule nyanga yokufunda ka-2009. Imali ethunyelwa kumalungu angena kuMfundisi Wokuthuthukiswa isetshenziselwa ukusiza abafundi abangenayo enye indlela yok继续 ukufunda ukuhumusha. Kwavunyelwana ukuthi kusukela ngonyaka ozayo, izicelo zabafundi bonyaka wokuqala zizokwamukelwa. Amalungu akhunjuzwa ukuthi kukhona nezinto ezicabangwayo mayelana nezicelo zokufunda eziphathelene nezifundo ezimfishane. Ikhompiyutha yoktraining okwamanje iqhuba uphenyo lokuhlonza izidingo zokuqeqeshwa zamalungu, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezifundo ezimfishane ezihlobene nokuhumusha. Lokhu kuzothunyelwa kumalungu maduze. Ikhompiyutha yewebhusayithi ibike ukuthi inguqulo ephelele ye-Afrikaans yewebhusayithi ye-SATI kulindeleke ukuthi iqale ukusebenza maphakathi no-April. Ukuhumusha kuXhosa naseTswana kuzophinde kuqhubeke, nakuba kuhamba kancane. Amalungu akhuthazwa ukuba azinikele ukusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le webhusayithi temsilwe zonke izilimi ngokulinganayo. Ngaphandle kokuthi, sithathe isinqumo sokuphelisa isivumelwano i-SATI enaso ne-NAATI (i-Australian National Accreditation Authority for Translators and Interpreters), esivumele ukuvunywa kwemisebenzi yabahumushi abasebenza nezilimi ezisetshenziswa kancane kuleli, ngenxa yemithetho emisha e-NAATI kanye nezindleko zokuhlola eziphakeme kakhulu. Amalungu akhunjuzwa ukuthi kuzoba nephephabhuku elikhethekile kuwebhusayithi ye-SATI elizobala imininingwane yabahumushi abafuna ukwenza izinsizakalo zabo zitholakale kule Mqhudelwano Womhlaba. Uma ungakathumeli ulwazi lwakho futhi ufuna igama lakho libonakale kuleli phephabhuku, sicela uxhumane nehhovisi le-SATI ngokushesha okukhulu. Umhlangano olandelayo wobuholi uzoba ngoJuni 2009. Isingeniso Ibhola lomnqakiswano, elaziwa kakhulu njenge-basketball, liyithuba elidumile emhlabeni jikelele. Lo mdlalo wasungulwa e-United States ngonyaka ka-1891 nguJames Naismith, futhi usuphenduke umkhiqizo wezokungcebeleka, umjaho wezinkanyezi, kanye nendlela yokuhlanganyela kwabantu. Ibhola lomnqakiswano linezithameli ezinkulu, kusukela ezikoleni kuya ezingeni lempumelelo, futhi linomoya ophakeme wokuhlanganyela. Kuleli bhakede, sizobuyekeza ibhola lomnqakiswano, sihlolisise izici zayo ezithokozisayo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona emphakathini. Izici Ezithokozisayo Zombhoxo Umdlalo we-basketball udinga abadlali abanezinhloso ezifanayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umdlalo uqala ngokuphosa ibhola phansi, ukudlula, kanye nokuphosa, okudinga amakhono ahlukahlukene, njengokusheshisa, ukugijima, nokuphosa. Umphakathi ubona ukwakheka kwabantu kuhle, njengoba abadlali badinga ukuxhumana ukuze bafeze imigomo yabo. Umphakathi ophakathi kokudlala, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nomoya wokuncintisana, unikeza ithuba lokubambisana. Izinzuzo Zempilo Nezokuhlalisana Ibhola lomnqakiswano, ngaphandle kokuba umdlalo owaziwayo, linikeza nezinzuzo ezinkulu zempilo. Ukudlala ibhola lomnqakiswano kukhuthaza ukuzivocavoca, okukhuthaza impilo enhle. Lokhu kudala izimo ezithuthukisa amandla, ukucabanga, kanye nokuphathwa kwempilo. Abadlali baqeqesha imisipha yabo, baqeqesha izinga lempilo, futhi bahlala bephila kahle. Umphakathi uthola izinzuzo, njengoba umdlalo uhlinzeka ithuba lokugcina ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola lomnqakiswano linikeza ithuba lokuthola amakhono amasha, ukwakha ubudlelwano, kanye nokuhlonipha imithetho. Ukuqonda imithetho yomdlalo kudinga ukucabangela nezenzo zomphakathi, okuthuthukisa umphakathi njengoba abadlali beqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlonipha abanye. Umdlalo Wokuncintisana Umdlalo we-basketball ungumjaho wokuncintisana, okuholela ekutheni abadlali bazithuthukise. Izimpi zihlala ziba nezinselelo, okukhuthaza abadlali ukuba balwe umphumela omuhle. Abadlali bangowabo, kodwa umphakathi ubahlanganisa, bafenya izinjongo ezihambisanayo, okukhuthaza umoya wokuhlanganyela. Umgomo Wezobuchwepheshe Ubhola lomnqakiswano luthuthuke kakhulu ngobuchwepheshe. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, ubuchwepheshe buhlanganiswa emidlalweni, izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinsiza zothando ziba yinsiza enkulu kubadlali. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba nezici ezithokozisayo, njengoba abadlali bekhuthazeka ukuthuthukisa imikhawulo yabo. Imiphumela Emphakathini Ibhola lomnqakiswano linomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Umdlalo unikeza amathuba okukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana, bahloniphe, futhi bahlanganyele. Ukubamba imicimbi ye-basketball kungaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene, okukhuthaza ukuhlela izenzakalo ezithuthukisa umphakathi. Isiphetho Ibhola lomnqakiswano liyinto ethokozisayo edinga abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, banikeze umphakathi ithuba lokukhula. Lo mdlalo uhlinzeka ngezinzuzo eziningi, kusukela empilweni yomuntu siqu kuya emiphakathini. Umjaho wokuncintisana, izici ezithokozisayo, nezindlela zokuhlalisana zenza ibhola lomnqakiswano libe umdlalo ohlukile. Ngakho, wonke umuntu ungaba yingxenye yomphakathi we-basketball, ubambe iqhaza, futhi ufinyelele empumelelweni, okubalulekile ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, ophilayo, futhi ohloniphekile.
Ukushoda KweMithi Ezibhedlela Ezweni elikhaliphile, lapho ukukhanya kwelanga kuhlangabezana nezingxoxo zansuku zonke, kwakukhona umphakathi ophilayo ogama lawo linguMkhukhwini. Le ndawo yayidume ngothando lwayo lwezempilo, abantu baziwa ngokulalela imiyalelo yezokwelapha, bagcizelela ukuhlinzwa nobuchwepheshe bokwelapha. Nokho, kube kwenzeka okuthile okwehlela wonke umphakathi, okwaholela ekudabukeni. Okwakukhanya kulobu busuku, uDkt. Mthembu, udokotela owayengumholi wezempilo endaweni, wagcotshwa nguMnumzane Nkosi, umphakathi waziwa ngensiza enhle. UPhethakele, owaziwa ngabazali, wacela imishanguzo eminingi, kodwa imiphumela yalesi simo yathokozisa umphakathi. "Rhoqo, sishodayo emithini," kuphetha uDkt. Mthembu ngaphambi kokubona uhla olwaludlulisiwe phakathi labantu. Kwathi lapho umakhishi esukuma lapho engazi, uDkt. Mthembu washaywa yiphupho elingalindelekile. Ubuso bami babunokukhathazeka, futhi umoya omubi wawugubha izibhedlela. Abantu babebukeka bekhononda, bebona ulimi lwemithi oluphezulu, kwabe sekucacile ukuthi izibhedlela zazingatholi imithi eyanele. Uhlanga loyisa, umama uThandi, owayevame ukusiza abantwana abakudinga ukwelashwa, wayeboshwe ngokuqinisekile. “Ngiyazama ukugcina izingane zethu ziphilile, kodwa imithi ayitholakali,” echelekea nohudo, ubuhlungu bepulazi bukhula kuma visis, bokuphila kwethu. Ukuze siqonde kangcono lokhu, wanquma ukuhlola, afikele lezinyanga zekhaya ngobubele babo. Kodwa kunokubheka phansi, abathandi bezehlisa kabuhlungu beseya emithini. Kwasungulwa umoya omusha. Njengoba elihamba, uMnumzane Nkosi wabhala phansi wonke amanqaku, nyanya kaphethandaba zindatshana ezidingekayo. Ngokwenzeka, kubonakala ukuthi umphakathi uhamba phambili emphakathini nakubantu abampofu. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavela umcabango omusha owaqala ukuba nempilo. UJeff, umhlekazi wamakhaya, wagxila ekutheni umphakathi udinga ukwakha izinsiza ezinokuthengiswa kwesikhathi eside. “Kham phaya, umphakathi kufanele ulungise umphakathi. Mhlawumbe singenza izifundo zokwelapha ukuze sithole isimiso esihle,” waqhamukela. Lokhu kudala isimanga ezweni, kwavuma ukukhanya kokufuna impilo ephilayo. Kwathi emva kwezinsuku eziningana, kwavuka umoya olandela onobuchwepheshe. Umphakathi wabamba imihlangano yokuhlola izinkinga, lokhu kwaphumelela futhi kwaqala ukufakazela i-ejenti ezindaweni ezinxephezelayo. Omakhalekhukhwini babezithokozile ngokukwazi ukuphila kahle, umphakathi wasaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuphuma emthonjeni. Uhlanga lwezokwelapha lwaqala ukwakha izinsiza ezithintekayo, izindlu zesikole zaguquka izikhungo zokwelapha, uDkt. Mthembu waze wathola izinsiza ngendlela ezikhokhelwayo, kanti uhulumeni wanika isandla. Ngaphezu kokuba nemithi, abantu baqala ukufunda indlela yokuziphilisa. Uthando lwezokwandisa umphakathi lukhula njalo, luzolisa kahle. Umoya osemqoka wawuwukukhumbula ukuthi imithi ngaphandle komoya othandweni iyoma. Bazama ukuzinika kahle, okukhanya kwakungamathuba. Ekugcineni, umphakathi waMkhukhwini wathola imithi eyidingekayo, umoya ofuna ukuhamba kahle wakho. Ukushoda kwemithi kwavulelwa umoya wokukwazi ukuphila, indawo yabadlali bezemidlalo ngezithombe zezimoto ezihamba phambili. Ukwakha isimo esiphilayo, umphakathi uyazama, futhi uhulumeni uphumelele ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo. Ngale ndlela, uMkhukhwini waqala ukuveza umphakathi onobuchwepheshe, owenza impilo ibe ngcono. Futhi ngaphansi kwemigudu, umoya wabahlaseli onobuchwepheshe wawujabulela impilo engcono. Okwangempela, ukushoda kwemithi kwakungumthombo ophilayo wempilo, kwakhombisa ukuthi umphakathi unempilo uma bahlalisana. Ngakho-ke, lesi isifundo sokuthi uma kuvela izinkinga, kumele sithathe isinyathelo sesibili, singashiyi muntu ngaphandle, sikhumbule ukuthi imithi itholakala ezandleni zethu. Umoya kaMkhukhwini uhlala uhamba phambili, ungavumi ukuphuka!
UCristiano Ronaldo: Umuntu Ohloniphekayo Emhlabeni Webhola UCristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, owazalelwa eMadeira, ePortugal, ungumngane odumile emhlabeni jikelele. Ubonisa isibonelo esihle sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzikhandla, nokuphumelela emkhakheni webhola. Impumelelo yakhe ayiveli nje kuphela kumakhono akhe, kodwa ibuye ibonise indima yakhe emphakathini nasemhlabeni wonke. Ukwamukelwa Kwakhe Emhlabeni UCristiano Ronaldo uthole udumo olukhulu edlalela amaqembu afana noManchester United, Real Madrid, neJuventus. Ukuze abe yimpumelelo, udinga ukuba nekhono, amandla, kanye nomsebenzi oncomekayo. Lokhu kudale ukuthi impilo yakhe ithuthuke futhi umphakathi umbandakanye, njengoba esebenzisa udumo lwakhe ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuphila zentsha emhlabeni, ezikhuthaza amathuba amasha. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impumelelo yakhe ibuye ibe nezindleko. Ubufakazi bokuthi ukuncoma uCristiano kuhlanganisa ukungakholwa komphakathi, okukhuthaza abanye abadlali, futhi kubangela izinkinga ezihlobene nezokuziphatha. Ubonisa ubungozi phakathi kokuba isibonelo esihle sokusebenza kanzima kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Ukwalwa Nempumelelo: Ukuziphatha Nokuhlukaniswa Uma sikhuluma ngempilo kaCristiano emphakathini, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela abukeka ngayo. Lokhu kubandakanya izinqumo azenzayo, izinkinga zokuziphatha, kanye nemiphumela yokuphila kwakhe. Lokhu kudala umbuzo: Yini eyenza uCristiano Ronaldo abe ngumsebenzi ongajwayelekile empilweni yethu? Izenzo zakhe zomuntu siqu zikhanga, kodwa zikhombisa ukungahambi kahle ezicini eziningi. Umfanekiso Wokuthi Kufanele Kwenze Nini? Njengoba sihamba phambili, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uCristiano ungumuntu ophumelelayo, kodwa impilo yakhe yangaphandle ibalulekile. Lokhu kuhilela izinguquko ezithinta izifundo ezisemqoka emphakathini. UCristiano ungumthombo wokukhuthazela, kodwa umphakathi udinga ukuvuselela izindawo zokuphila. Isiphetho: Ngabe UCristiano Ronaldo Ungumsunguli Ohloniphekayo? Ukuqonda uCristiano Ronaldo kudinga ukuhlola imibono ehlukene. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa umuntu ohloniphekayo, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule izithiyo ezikhona. Ubugebengu bokuziphatha bungabangela ukungqubuzana, okudinga ukuqondwa kahle. UCristiano ungaba ngumholi ohloniphekayo, kodwa kufanele siqhubeke sihlole izifundo ezinhle ezithinta impilo yakhe.
Ithuluzi lokudoba ngokuvamile lihlinzekwa ngezinto ezizosetshenziswa ekudobeni noma kwezinye izenzo ezihlobene. Ithuluzi liqukethe zonke izinto, imishini esetshenzisiwe, indawo yokugcina, impahla, kanye nefuels yokusebenza kwethuluzi. Ithuluzi langaphakathi lingabandakanya noma iyiphi enye ithuluzi, eyodwa noma ngaphezulu, olwandle elwenziwa emisebenzini ehambisana nokudoba. Akekho ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa ithuluzi lokudoba, noma iyiphi enye ithuluzi ukuze asebenzise ilungelo lokufinyelela ngaphandle kokuthi kube ne-licence ekhishwe, ngokuhambisana nevumelekile uma umnikazi wethuluzi enelungelo lokudoba. Uma umnikazi wethuluzi engenalungelo lokudoba, kufanele kube nekhontileka yokusebenzisa lelo thuluzi. Thola ifomu lesicelo kwiMnyango Wezinsiza Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha. Kufanele ube nelungelo lokudoba. Uma ungumnikazi welungelo lokudoba onethuluzi, kufanele uthumele, noma ufake ikhontileka, ozinayo nomnikazi wethuluzi ukuze usebenzise lelo thuluzi uma ufaka isicelo se-licence yethuluzi. Gcwalisa ifomu ngokuphrinta usebenzisa izincwadi ezinkulu kuphela, bese ubhala incazelo yalesi sicele lapho kudingeka. Khombisa isikhathi sokusebenza okuhlose futhi isicelo somkhakha wokudoba lapho lo mkhakha uhlose ukusebenza. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku ezintathu zokusebenza noma ngaphezulu, kuye ngokuthi isicelo sithunyelwa ngokuhambisana nenqubo efanele. Izindleko zihluka ngokwesikhathi sobude bethuluzi.

Funda: Nikeza igama nesibongo sabo bonke abantu abangalindelekile ukuthi bahlale kuleli khaya okungenani ezinsukwini ezine ezedlule, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babekhona noma babengekho izolo. Nikeza ulwazi ngomuntu owayehleli kuleli khaya izolo njengomvakashela. Ungakhohlwa ukubala izingane, abantu abagulayo ababelezi, kanye nabadala. Kumndeni, faka bonke abantu abahlala ndawonye nawe ababelana ngokudla nezinye izinto ezisemqoka zokuphila, noma umuntu oyedwa ongashadile ophila yedwa. I-Questionnaire eyodwa iphendulwa ngumndeni owodwa okhethiwe. Qala ngokuqinisekile nomphakathi noma umuntu ophatha leli khaya, isibonelo, umuntu 01. Umphakathi noma umuntu ophatha leli khaya ngu-owenza izinqumo kuleli khaya. Uma abantu ababili noma abaningi benza izinqumo ngokulinganayo, qala ngowokhokho. Bhala phansi izihloko. Ukehlile kuleli khaya okungenani ezinsukwini ezine ezedlule? Ube khona kuleli khaya izolo? Kubantu ngabanye kuleli khaya, chaza inani labantu abaphendulile imibuzo eminingi ehlobene nabo. Ngaphandle kwezidingo zomthetho, akukho olunye ulwazi oluqoqiwe yi-Statistics South Africa ngezizathu ezisemthethweni noma ezinye izibalo ezihlobene nabantu ezingavunyelwe ukuba zivezwe kumuntu. Noma ubani obandakanyekayo ekuqoqweni kwedatha, ongasebenzisa le mininingwane noma idatha, kumele kuqala athathe isifungo sokugcina imfihlo. & 18 (g) Noma yimuphi ummember we-Statistics South Africa ophumelele ukuveza ulwazi ngenkuthalo ngesikhathi esebenzile angase abhekane necebo elingaphezu kuka-R10,000.00 noma ukuvalelwa iminyaka engaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, noma kokubili. Inhloso yale mivuzo yokuhlola abantu iwukuhlola izimo zokuphila kwabantu ezindaweni ezikhethekile kanye nezimo zabo zokuphila. Lokhu kuzosisiza ekwakheni izinhlelo zesikhathi esizayo, ezimali, kanye nokuphumeza izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi nezifunda. Ngabe ngingakhuluma nomphakathi noma umuntu ophatha leli khaya? Ngalesi sizathu, umxhumanisi kufanele abe ngumuntu owazi ulwimi olusetshenziswe ezindaweni ezikhethiwe futhi uphinde abe nolwazi ngencwadi ezihunyushiwe ukusiza labo abafuna ukusebenzisa izilimi zabo. Ngubani okufanele agcwalise le mivuzo yokuhlola? I-Statistics South Africa ikhetha ukuthi abahloli abaqeqeshiwe bagcwalise le mivuzo yokuhlola. Kuphela ezimweni ezingajwayelekile kufanele umuntu omunye avunyelwe ukuba agcwalise le mivuzo yokuhlola. Ngubani okufanele abalwe ngokuhambisana nemivuzo yokuhlola? Bonke amalungu aleli khaya abahlala kule ndlu okungenani ezinsukwini ezine ngesonto ezedlule, kanye nezivakashi ezahlala ubusuku ngaphambi kokuhlola lo mndeni. Umndeni uhlanganisa abantu abahlala ndawonye, babelana ngokudla nakho konke okudingekayo kokuphila, noma umuntu oyedwa ongashadile ophila yedwa. Le mivuzo yokuhlola igcwaliswa kanjani? Lapho izimpendulo zinikezwa, umxhumanisi kufanele abhale ibhokisi elifanele nge-X. Ngemibalo efana nonyaka wokuzalwa, umxhumanisi kufanele abhale impendulo efanele ebhokisini njengombalo (isibonelo, "007", "025"). Ngemibuzo evulekile ehlobene namagama ezindawo zokuhlala, umsebenzi, imboni, umxhumanisi kufanele abhale impendulo ecacile endaweni enikeziwe. Zama ukugwema ukubhala endaweni yomunye umuntu omndeni. Ungabhalela "akukhona" uma kudingeka, ngaphandle uma impendulo icacile futhi ifanele kahle kulekholomu. Sebenzisa ipeni eliphakeme; uma wenza iphutha, sebenzisa i-eraser ukulungisa lelo phutha bese ubhala impendulo efanele futhi. Ukusebenzisa ipeni eliphakeme kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ungakwazi ukulungisa amaphutha, kusiza enhlanganweni yokubhala, futhi kunciphisa amaphutha okubhala abonakalayo. Izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 Kulezi zinsuku, ukuhlinzekwa kwezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele, izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zibalulekile. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) inezinqubo ezithile zokwazisa ngesibhedlela, ezidinga ukuthi iziguli ziqinisekise ukuthi ziwazisa izibhedlela ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48. Lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukuvikela iziguli, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle, futhi zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ukuze uqale, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinqubo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondile nokuphumelelayo. Uma isiguli sithola udokotela, kufanele sithumele isaziso esisemthethweni esibhedlela esithintekayo. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuthi uma isiguli sifika esibhedlela, sizoba nezinqumo ezithile ezithathwe ngaphambi kokufika. Lokhu kuzosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde izidingo zempilo zesiguli, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinsiza ezifanele zikhona. Izinqubo zokwazisa zidinga ukuthi isiguli sithumele isaziso esisemthethweni ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-48. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma isiguli sithola usizo lwezempilo, kufanele sithumele isaziso esibhedlela esithintekayo ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngoba kusiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde iziguli ezizofika, futhi zibe nezinqumo ezithile ezithathwe ngaphambi kokufika kwesiguli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinqubo ezithile ezilungiselelwe iziguli ezizofika. Ngokuhambisana nalezi zinqubo, kubalulekile ukuthi iziguli ziqonde ukuthi zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa igama lesiguli, inombolo yokukhumbula, kanye nemininingwane ethile yokwelashwa edingekayo. Le mininingwane izosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde kahle izidingo zesiguli, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zikhona. Ukuze lokhu kube lula, iziguli zidinga ukuxhumana nezibhedlela zazo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ziqonda kahle izinqubo zokwazisa. Ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, iziguli zidinga futhi ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izinqubo ziqondile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuzosiza iziguli ukuba ziqonde ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zikhona, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzosiza izibhedlela ukuba ziqonde kahle izidingo zeziguli, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinqumo ezithile ezithathwe ngaphambi kokufika kwesiguli. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 zikhombisa ukuthi ziwusizo kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziphila kahle. Ukuze lezi zinqubo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi iziguli ziqonde kahle izinqubo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zixhumana nezibhedlela zazo. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokwazisa ngesibhedlela zamahora angama-48 zidinga ukuba ziqondwe kahle, futhi zisebenze kahle ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele. Lokhu kuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zihlala ziphila kahle. I-GEMS ibalulekile ekwenzeni lokhu kube ngempumelelo, futhi iziguli zidinga ukuxhumana ne-GEMS ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ziqonda kahle izinqubo zokwazisa. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe (Content Creators) Umbuzo 1: Abadali bokuqukethwe bangobani? Abadali bokuqukethwe yibo abantu abakhiqiza futhi babelana ngezinto ezithokozisayo zokuxhumana, njengezithombe, amavidiyo, izindatshana, nezinhlelo zomsakazo. Lezi zinto zisetshenziswa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kumasayithi e-inthanethi, nasezinhlelweni zethelevishini. Bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi okuqukethwe abakudalayo kuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala umthelela kubadali bokuqukethwe? Umthelela kubadali bokuqukethwe ungavela ezicini eziningi, okuhlanganisa izifiso zababukeli, izitayela ezikhona, nezidingo zomphakathi. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, abadali bokuqukethwe badinga ukujwayela izinguquko ukuze bagcine ababukeli benelisekile. Ukubambisana nabanye, ukusebenzisa izinkundla ezihlukene, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokudala okuqukethwe kubalulekile ukuze bakhe umthelela omuhle. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba umdali wokuqukethwe? Umdali wokuqukethwe uthola izinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kunezindlela eziningi zokwenza imali, njengezikhangiso, ukuhweba, noma ukubambisana nezinkampani. Okwesibili, abadali bokuqukethwe bangakha umphakathi wabo, okuvumela abantu ukuthi baxhumane futhi babelane ngemicabango. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba baveze ubuciko babo, benze izinto ezinhle, futhi baphumelele emhlabeni wabo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo abadali bokuqukethwe abahlangabezana nazo? Ngaphandle kwezinzuzo, abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwabanye abadali kudinga ukuthi bahlale bephakamisela izinga eliphezulu. Okwesibili, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zingaba nomthelela ekubeni neziqu ezimangalisayo. Okokugcina, ukuthola isikhathi sokwenza okuqukethwe okuhle phakathi kwezibopho zomsebenzi nezinhloso zomuntu siqu kungaba inselelo enkulu. Umbuzo 5: Singafunda kanjani kubadali bokuqukethwe? Ukuze sibe ngabafundi abahle, kufanele siqonde izidingo zethu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufunda izitayela ezihlukahlukene, ukujula ekwakheni okuqukethwe, nokuhlola izinkundla ezahlukene ukuze sithole ukuthi yini esebenza kahle. Ukubambisana nabanye abadali, ukufunda ezincwadini, kanye nokubuka izifundo eziku-inthanethi kungasiza ekwakheni amakhono ethu. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa amakhono okudala? Ukuthuthukisa amakhono okudala kudinga ukuzikhandla. Ukuze ube umdali ophumelelayo, ungazama ukufunda izifundo eziku-inthanethi, ukulandela izifundo ezihlobene, noma ukuhamba emihlanganweni yabadali bokuqukethwe. Ukwenza izivivinyo ezihlukahlukene, njengokudala amavidiyo, izithombe, noma izindatshana, kungasiza ekwakheni amakhono akho. Ukubuka abanye abadali, ukuthola impendulo, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokudala, konke kubalulekile. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyicabangele uma uqala njengomdali wokuqukethwe? Uma uqala njengomdali wokuqukethwe, kubalulekile ukuba necebo eliqinile. Qiniseka ukuthi unokucacisa ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyifeza, futhi ubeke phambili izinjongo ezithile. Hlala unethemba, futhi ungavumeli izinselelo zikudikibale. Futhi, ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukwakha umphakathi kubalulekile; xhumana nababukeli bakho, futhi uthole impendulo ukuze uthuthukise okuqukethwe kwakho. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izinkundla ezinhle zokwabelana ngokuqukethwe? Kunezinkundla eziningi ezinhle zokwabelana ngokuqukethwe. Izinkundla ezifana ne-YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, ne-Facebook zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngezithombe, amavidiyo, nezindatshana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amasayithi afana ne-Blogspot, WordPress, ne-Medium angasiza abadali bokuqukethwe ukuthi babelane ngemicabango yabo ngezindatshana. Ukukhetha inkundla efanele kuncike kumphakathi ofuna ukufinyelela kuwo. Umbuzo 9: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abadala bokuqukethwe nababukeli bukhulu kangakanani? Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abadala bokuqukethwe nababukeli bukhulu kakhulu. Abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bezama ukuqonda izidingo, izifiso, nezinkathazo zababukeli babo. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhe okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuhamba phambili futhi okuxhumana kahle. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu abadala bokuqukethwe nababukeli buvame ukuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, owabelana ngemicabango, futhi ohlanganyela ezindabeni ezithokozisayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo kubadali bokuqukethwe? Kusasa, abadali bokuqukethwe bazobhekana nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ubuchwepheshe buzothuthuka, futhi izinkundla zokuxhumana zizoqhubeka nokuba nezici ezintsha. Lokhu kuzodinga abadali bokuqukethwe ukuba bahlale bephakamisela izinga eliphezulu, behlola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, futhi bahlale bejolise ekwakheni okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo. Ukubambisana nabanye, ukuthola izixazululo ezintsha, nokugcina umphakathi ophilayo kuzoba yizinto ezibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile kubadali bokuqukethwe. Ngale ndlela, abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala bejolise ekwakheni okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okukhanga, futhi okuxhumana nabantu abaningi. Njengoba beqhubeka nokukhula, badinga ukuhamba phambili, bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi bephumelela emhlabeni wabo.
Isingeniso Ukugonywa, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-vaccination, kuyinqubo ebalulekile emhlabeni wonke, futhi kudlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Le nqubo yenziwa ngenhloso yokuvikela abantu ezithweni ezithile, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibangela izifo ezinzima nezingaba yingozi. Kulesi sihloko, sizohlola ukuthi ukugonywa kuyini, ukuthi kusebenza kanjani, kanye nezinzuzo zayo. Ukwazi Ukugonywa Ukugonywa kuwumsebenzi wokufaka umuthi othile emzimbeni ukuze kuvuselelwe amandla okuphikisa izifo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusebenzisa umjovo, ophakathi kwakhe kukhona izakhi ezincane ezivela ezilwaneni, noma izakhi ezithile ezitholakala kwi-pathogen (umgibeli wezifo). Izinhloso zalesi sikhungo zifaka phakathi ukuthuthukisa ukuvikeleka, ukwakha imimoya yokukhuthaza, nokunciphisa ukuhlaselwa kwezifo. Indlela Ukugonywa Okusebenza Ngayo Uma umuthi we-vaccine ufakwa emzimbeni, uhlelo lokuvikela (immune system) lwenza izakhi ezibhekelela ukuhlasela. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokwakha ama-antibodies, okuyizakhi eziqaphela futhi zikhombise izifo. Uma umuntu ebhekene ne-pathogen yangempela, lezi zidakamizwa, ezakhiwe ngesikhathi sokugonywa, zikhona ukuvikela, zinciphisa ithuba lokukhula kwesifo, futhi zinciphisa ubungozi bokufa. Izinhlobo Zokugonywa Kunamakhono ahlukene okugonywa, ahlukaniswe ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, kunezivivinyo ezivamile ezifana ne-vaccines ze-measles, mumps, rubella (MMR), i-polio, ne-hepatitis. Okwesibili, kukhona ne-vaccines ezithuthukisiwe, ezitholakala kuphela ngezimo ezithile, njenge-vaccines ezivikelayo ku-COVID-19. Lokhu kubonisa indlela umhlaba wezokwelapha ushintsha ngayo, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ukuze busebenzise izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuvikela. Izinzuzo Zokugonywa Izinzuzo zokugonywa azinakuphikiswa. Okokuqala, kugcina impilo yomphakathi. Uma abantu abaningi bekwazi ukuvikeleka ezifo, lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, okunciphisa umthelela wezifo. Okwesibili, ukugonywa kunciphisa izindleko zezokwelapha ezingase zibe khona. Lokhu kunciphisa izindleko zokwelashwa nezindleko ezihambisana nezifo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugonywa kunciphisa ubungozi bokwanda kwezifo emiphakathini, kudala umphakathi ovikelekile, okuyinto ebalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethwele izifo ezinjengemalaria, i-tuberculosis ne-HIV. Izinselelo Nezinkinga Naphezu kwezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona nezinselelo zokugonywa. Abanye abantu bangase babe nezinkinga zokwamukela imithi yokugonywa ngenxa yokukhathazeka ngezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza abantu, ukuze bazi ukuthi izinzuzo zikhona futhi zibalulekile. Ukufundisa abantu ngalesi sihloko, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, kubalulekile ukuze kube nomphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ukugonywa kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bavume ukugonywa. Ukukhuthaza ukugonywa akusizi kuphela abantu ngabanye, kodwa kuthinta nomphakathi wonke. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka phambili, sizobe sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela, kanti ukugonywa kuzoba yisixazululo esisebenzayo ekunciphiseni izifo. Ngakho-ke, ukukhuthaza ukugonywa kubalulekile ukuze sithole umphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, futhi ophephile.
Abadali Bokuqukethwe: Uhambo Lwabo Lokudala Nokwabelana Ekuqaleni, emadolobheni amakhulu, lapho izikhala zabantu ziqhamuka khona, kwavela isigaba esisha somphakathi. Abadali bokuqukethwe, noma "content creators," babezobambisana nemibono yabo, bezama ukwabelana ngezinto ezithokozisayo, ezixakile, nezifundisayo. Babengabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, bejolise ezinhlakeni ezahlukene zokuphila. Lokhu kwakubanjwe nokukhuthazwa kokuxhumana, okwakwenziwa ngamasiko ahlukahlukene. UThandi, ungumfana ophuma eThekwini, wayehlala ethanda ukudweba. Ngokuvamile, wayebhala izinkanyezi ezinhle emaphepheni, kodwa wazibuza: "Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi ngabelane ngalokho engikudalayo?" Ngemuva kokuthi abona amavidiyo abanye abantu abawabelana ngawo ku-inthanethi, wathola umdlandla. Waqala ukudala amavidiyo akhe, edweba izithombe ezithokozisayo, ezihambisana nomculo, futhi wabelane ngazo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukudala akuphumelelanga kuphela, kodwa kwaba yindlela yokuxhumana nabantu abaningi. Abantu abazungezile, abaphuma emhlabeni wonke, baqala ukuveza izimvo zabo. UThandi wathola umphakathi omkhulu, lapho abalandeli bakhe bejabulisa lapho bebona imisebenzi yakhe. Lokhu kwazisa uThandi ngawe, futhi wathola ukuthi akagculiseki kuphela ngamakhono akhe, kodwa futhi nabanye abantu abavuma ukubuka nokuxoxa naye. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uNandi, intokazi ephuma eGoli, naye wayebona indlela abantu ababelana ngayo bokuqukethwe. Wabona abanye bephuma ezindaweni ezinzima, kodwa baphumelela ngenxa yokwakha imiphakathi eyakhiwe ngezinhloso ezifanayo. U-Nandi wayelithanda ukucula, futhi wathola ukuthi uyakwazi ukudala izinkanyezi ezimnandi. Waqala ukucula amaculo akhe, futhi wahamba phambili wabelana ngazo ku-YouTube. Izinto zokuqala zaze zikhona, izithombe ziqhubeka zikhula, futhi uNandi waqala ukuthola ukwaziwa. Abantu bejabuliswa yizwi lakhe, futhi umphakathi wakhe wakhula. Wazithola esebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze abheke izimvo, axoxe nabalandeli, futhi abhalise izifundo ezithile zokucula. Lokhu kwafaka uNandi endaweni ephakeme, evumela ukuba abone ukuthi ukudala bokuqukethwe kungaba nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela empilweni yakhe, kodwa nasempilweni yabanye. Njengoba ababili, uThandi noNandi, beqhubeka nezifundo zabo, baqonda ukuthi ukudala bokuqukethwe akukhona kuphela ukucula noma ukudweba. Kukhona namanye amafomu, njengokubhala, ukudala imifanekiso, nemidlalo yokudlala. UThandi wathola ukuthi ungumbhali omuhle, evula iminyango emisha yokuxhumana. Abantu bacela izindaba, izinkanyezi zempilo, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wabantu abathanda ukudala bokuqukethwe waqala ukuvuthwa. Abanye babantu baqala ukuba nezinhloso eziningi, behlola izindlela zokuthola imali ngale ndlela. Abadali baqala ukufunda ukuthi bangathola kanjani ukuhweba ngezinto abazidalayo, bephuma ngaphakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. UThandi noNandi, njengabanye abaninzi, baqala ukufunda ukubaluleka kokubambisana. UThandi noNandi, behlanganisa amakhono abo, benza umkhiqizo owodwa. Bahamba ndawonye, beqhamuka nemicabango emisha, benza ukufana kumavidiyo, izithombe, nemicimbi. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuthola amakhono amaningi, futhi abantu babenqaba ukuzithokozisa. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokuguquka, abaphakathi bokuqukethwe baqonda ukuthi kufanele balandele izitayela ezintsha. UThandi noNandi babekwazi ukufunda njalo, bejolise ezintweni ezintsha, bephendukela ezinkundleni ezihlukahlukene, nezindlela ezintsha zokukhuluma. Babengazi nje kuphela ukuthi babezokwakha imiphakathi, kodwa futhi babezokwakha izinkumbulo ezizohlala njalo. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula, izinkundla zokuxhumana ziba nezinto eziningi ezintsha, futhi abadali bokuqukethwe baqala ukusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha. UThandi noNandi baqonda ukuthi imiphakathi yabo ayizange ibaluleke kakhulu. Ukuhlanganyela, ukufunda, nokuhlanganisa imicabango zabo kwaba yindlela yokuphila. Ekugcineni, abanikazi bokuqukethwe, njengabanye, baqonda ukuthi umhlaba wabo ungcono uma bekhuthazana, behlanganyela, futhi bephumelela bonke. UThandi noNandi bahlala bematasa, besebenzisana, bequbuka, futhi bephinde bahlanganyela imisebenzi yabo emisha, bejabulisa abantu abaningi. Ubuqotho, uthando, nokubambisana kwaba yizinto ezijulile emphakathini wabo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo esihle sokuthi ukudala bokuqukethwe akusona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngakho, abadali bokuqukethwe bahlala behamba phambili, beqhubeka nokwakha, bahlola, futhi behlanganyela izindaba zabo emhlabeni wonke. Uthando lwabo lokudala luhamba phambili, futhi imiphakathi yabo ikhula, ithokozisa, futhi ibalulekile njengokuthi izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo phezulu kwezulu.
Umkhiqizi (umlimi) oqasha wena njengomqashi ufuna ukuqonda kahle ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa kanjani. Wena, njengomqashi, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokusebenza kulowo mlili ngendlela efanele ngoba uthola umsebenzi kuye. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi wonke umsebenzi wokulima uhlose ukuhlela izinkambu zokutshala izitshalo zokudla. Uma isimo somhlabathi siba nzima kakhulu, kungcono kumqashi ukuthi abike ummili ukuthi ukulima akukwazi ukwenziwa kahle - akufanele aqhubeke nomsebenzi aphelelwe umphumela omubi ngenkathi efuna ukuphila. Uma umhlabathi ungakulungelanga kahle, kuzoholela ezindlekweni kumlili ezizomenza angaphumeleli ekulimaleni ngonyaka ozayo. Lapho ummili engakwenzi kahle, umqashi naye ngeke abe nomsebenzi. Ukulima okubucayi kulandela ukuvuna kwezitshalo ezitshaliwe. Ezindaweni lapho kunenhlama ehlobo kodwa izitshalo zezimvula zenyanga (njenge canola) zizotshalwa, kungcono ukulima ngokushesha ngemva kokuvuna. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi inhlama yehlobo ingena emhlabathini ngokushesha. Ngemva kokuvuna izitshalo zehlobo (njenge ummbila), kufanele kulimwe ngaphambi kokufika kwemvula yephunga ukuze imvula ingene emhlabathini kahle. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezithombo ezindaweni ezahlukene zidinga izikhathi ezahlukene zokutshala ezinhle. Ukutshala ngesikhathi esifanele kubalulekile uma ufuna ukufinyelela umphumela omuhle. Ukulima nokulungiselela izinkambu kufanele kwenzeke ngaphambi kokufika kwesikhathi sokutshala esinqunyiwe. Umqashi omuhle uzokwazi ukuthi kusebenza kanjani endaweni ethile futhi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwazisa ummili uma ecabanga ukuthi isikhathi sesidlule kakhulu noma ukuthi izimo zemvula nomhlabathi zibi kakhulu ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi othile. Akunamsebenzi wokutshala uma isikhathi sesidlule ngoba kungase kube nezingozi eziningi (njengokushoda kwamanzi nokuphuma kwezitshalo ngesikhathi sokukhula) futhi ummili ngeke enze inzuzo. Uma umqashi eqhubeka nokutshala ngemva kwesikhathi, uzophula umsebenzi wakhe kanye nebhizinisi lommili. Kunzima ukusungula izidingo zomsebenzi wonke ezindaweni zonke. Kufanele kube nesivumelwano phakathi kommili nomqashi ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi othile. Isibonelo, uma ummili efuna izinkambu ezithile zibe zikhululekile ku-dephth ethile, bobabili kufanele baqonde kahle lokhu futhi kufanele kubhalwe phansi - isibonelo, kufanele kulimwe i-30ha ku-dephth ye-300 mm. Ukutshala okwenziwayo kunezinga elithile. Ummmili uzodinga inani elithile lezitshalo nge-hectare kanye nenani elithile le-fertilizer nge-hectare. Kubalulekile kakhulu kumqashi ukuthi aqinise ukuhlangabezana nalezo zinga - umphumela omuhle ulandela ukuthi kuzotshalwa kanjani futhi nini. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi unekhono lokwenza umsebenzi odingekayo kahle. Lapho kukhishwa amakhemikhali ngumqashi, kubalulekile futhi ukuthi zonke izinto ezihlobene zilinganiswe kahle - inani lamakhemikhali akhishwayo kanye nenani lamanzi afanele okuzosetshenziswa nge-hectare. Ngokuvamile, abaqashi bavame ukuthatha umsebenzi ongaphezu kwamandla abo okwenza lowo msebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele nangendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba umqashi ufuna ukulima izinkambu eziningi ukuze enze inzuzo eningi. Kukhona ingozi lapha ngoba uma ummili (umqashi) engathandi indlela umqashi asebenza ngayo, angase angamqashi futhi esikhathini esizayo. Kukhona izimo ezivamile ezamukelekayo ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi zingaki ama-hectares umshini othile ungawulima ngosuku olunye (Ithebula 1). Ukuhlela izindleko zalokhu kusebenza kungaba yinkinga ngoba kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezindleko okufanele zifakwe kulokhu kuhlola. Imishini kufanele ithengwe kuqala (izindleko zokusebenza) bese kukhona nezindleko zokuyisebenzisa nokuyigcina. Umshini othile nemishini ethile inempilo ethile yokusebenza uma isetshenziswa kahle futhi igcinwe kahle, futhi kungase kudingeke ukuthenga imishini emisha noma ukuyilungisa. Lapho sikhuluma ngalokhu, singathi ngokuvamile kukhona umhlahlandlela walomsebenzi okhombisa ukuthi impilo yokusebenza komshini ingaba yiminyaka eyi-12 (ama-1,000 amahora ngonyaka, okusho: ama-12,000 amahora = iminyaka eyi-12). Impilo yokusebenza kwaleyo mshini ibonwa lapho umshini wakhiwa, futhi ngenkathi umshini usebenza kahle. Lapho kuhlelwa izindleko zokuthenga nokusebenza kwemishini, izindleko kufanele zihlukaniswe ngo-12 - bese izindleko zonyaka zingatholakala ngokuhambisana neminyaka umshini ongawusebenza. Ngakho-ke, singathi imali esetshenziselwa ukuthenga umshini ibolekiwe, futhi inzalo (izindleko) zokusebenza kwemishini kufanele ifakwe ekuhleleni izindleko zokulima i-hectare eyodwa. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini okumele wenziwe ngenyanga ethile. Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi umsebenzi wezolimo uhambisana nezimo zezulu - kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imvula ingaba nomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini womqashi. Izinsuku eziningi zokusebenza zingalahleka uma kunemvula futhi umhlabathi ungena kakhulu ukuze usebenze. Xoxa nesiteshi sezulu sendawo yakho (i-ARC yeMhlabathi, Isimo Nezamanzi ePitoli (012) 310-2500 xoxa noDerick Vermaak). Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu uma ungene ebhizinisini lokuqasha. Khumbula ukuthi uma imishini ingasebenzi, ayisebenzi, akukho okuzophuka - izinto zizophuka uma imishini isebenza ngokuphelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukwenza umsebenzi wokugcinwa (insizakalo) ngenkathi umsebenzi uthule. Uma wena, njengomqashi, uhlela ama-hectares, kufanele uhlole ukuwulima ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokutshala, khumbula ukushiya isikhala kulolo suku lapho ungasebenzi ngoba imishini iphukile. Akuvamile ukuthi abantu basayine isivumelwano esibhaliwe ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingashintsha kulomsebenzi - isibonelo: ukuphuka kwemishini, isimo sezulu, nezinye. Izimo zesivumelwano kufanele zibekwe ngendlela efanele ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingahamba kahle - ngakho-ke, lezi zinkinga esivumelwaneni zingadala umqashi nommili bobabili baphumelele kulolo hlelo. Izivumelwano ezifana nalezi zingaba yizivumelwano zomlomo noma izinhlelo zokuthi kwenzeke okuthile. Bobabili bazovuma ukuthi umsebenzi othile uzokwenziwa ngenani elithile. Ingxenye yezinkinga ezingadala izinkinga phakathi kommili nomqashi ubukhulu bezinkambu. Ummmili uzozama ukwenza izinkambu zibe zincane, umqashi uzokhetha ukuthi ama-hectares azolima amaningi. Ubukhulu bezinkambu kufanele kuqinisekiswe kahle ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga kamuva. Ukusebenzisa i-GPS kwenze kube lula futhi kucace kahle ukuthola ubukhulu bezinkambu. Nokho, abaningi abantu abanayo le teknoloji. Kukhona nezinye izindlela ezilula zokuthola ubukhulu bezinkambu. U-Mnu. Lo mhlahlandlela (umhlahlandlela) ungakusiza uma ucabanga ngezindleko zalo msebenzi. Ungaxhumana noMnu.
