Ukufunda Online: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini ukufunda online? Ukufunda online, noma ukufunda nge-inthanethi, kuwumqondo ohlanganisa izindlela zokufunda ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, izifundo ezivela ezikoleni, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala kumapulatifomu ahlukene. Abafundi bangafunda ngezikhathi zabo, besebenzisa amakhompyutha, amaphilisi, noma ama-smartphones. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokufunda online? Izinsiza zokufunda online zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zenza ukufunda kube lula, ngoba abafundi bangafunda noma kuphi, noma kunini. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba balungise izifundo zabo nezikhathi zabo zokufunda. Okwesibili, ukufunda online kuvame ukuba nezindleko eziphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezifundo ezisemakhaya, njengoba abanye abafundi bangagwema izindleko zokuhamba noma zokuhlala. Okwesithathu, kunezinketho eziningi zokufunda, okuvumela abafundi ukuba bakhethe izifundo ezihambisana nezithakazelo zabo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo zokufunda online? Noma kunjalo, ukufunda online akukhululekile ezinselelweni. Abafundi bangase babe nezinselelo zokuzikhandla, njengoba kungase kube nzima ukuzigcina bephapheme futhi beqotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abafundi bangase babe nezinkinga zokuxhumana, njengoba ukufunda online kudinga ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ezindaweni ezingenayo inethiwekhi esheshayo noma ezindaweni ezikude. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela zokufunda online ezitholakalayo? Kunezindlela eziningi zokufunda online. Izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi zingaba zifushane noma zide, futhi zingahlanganisa izifundo ezivela ezikoleni, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, noma izikhungo ezikhethekile. Abafundi bangasebenzisa amavidiyo, izincwadi, izifundo ezibukhoma, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana ukuze bathole ulwazi. Amathuluzi afana ne-Zoom, Google Classroom, kanye ne-Moodle ayasiza ekufundeni. Umbuzo 5: Kungani ukufunda online kubalulekile? Ukufunda online kubalulekile ngoba kuhlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, abantu badinga ukufunda amakhono amasha ukuze bahlale bephambili emsebenzini. Ukufunda online kuvumela abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokufunda, noma ngabe baphila kanjani. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezobuchwepheshe, ezempilo, kanye nezokuxhumana. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izeluleko zokuphumelela ekufundeni online? Ukuze uphumelele ekufundeni online, kubalulekile ukuba necebo. Qala ngokwakha isheduli yokufunda, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola isikhathi esanele sokufunda. Futhi, zama ukwakha indawo ethule nekhululekile yokufunda, ukuze ugweme ukuphazamiseka. Ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi nabafundisi kungasiza ekwakheni umuzwa wokubambisana, okungaba usizo ekufundeni. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe ukufunda online kuzoba yindlela yokufunda esikhathini esizayo? Ngokubheka izitayela zokufunda ezikhulayo, kubonakala sengathi ukufunda online kuzoba yindlela yokufunda esikhathini esizayo. Izikhungo zemfundo ziyaqhubeka nokwandisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, futhi abantu abaningi baye bahlola lezi zindlela zokufunda. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ukufunda online kunikeza ukufinyelela okukhulu, izinketho eziningi, kanye nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele ngiyicabangele ngaphambi kokukhetha ukufunda online? Ngaphambi kokukhetha ukufunda online, kubalulekile ukuthi ucabangele izidingo zakho. Qonda ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ezithakazelisayo, futhi uhlole izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalezi zifundo. Futhi, cabanga ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokuxhumana nabafundisi, izinsiza zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhetha uhlelo olufanele. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe ukufunda online kuyahambisana nezifundo ezisemakhaya? Yebo, ukufunda online kungahambisana nezifundo ezisemakhaya. Abafundi bangasebenzisa izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi ukuze baqedele izifundo zabo, noma bangezelela ulwazi lwabo. Lokhu kuvumela abafundi ukuba baqhubeke nokufunda, noma ngabe baphila kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufunda online kungaba yindlela yokufunda eyengeziwe, evumela abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olujulile. Umbuzo 10: Yini engiyifunda ekufundeni online? Ekufundeni online, ungafunda amakhono amasha, izifundo ezithakazelisayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, futhi kukusize ube nolwazi olunzulu. Ukufunda online akugcini nje ngokufunda izifundo, kodwa futhi kukuvumela ukuba ube nekhono lokuzikhandla, ukuzimela, nokuphumelela. Isiphetho Ukufunda online kuyindlela eyinqaba yokufunda, enezinzuzo eziningi nezinselelo. Kubalulekile ukuba abafundi baqonde lezi zinto ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukufunda online kuzoba yindlela ebalulekile yokufunda esikhathini esizayo. Ngakho, thina sonke kufanele sizame ukufunda ngendlela efanele, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphumelela.
Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa: Ukubuyekezwa Ekuhlangabezaneni nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi, amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa akhombisa ukukhula okukhulu nokwakha amathuba amasha. Le ndawo, eqhakazile ngezinsiza zemvelo, ibhaliswe njengenye yezindawo ezihamba phambili ekuchaphazeleni amandla avuselelekayo eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzoqonda ukuthi imiphumela yalezi zinhlelo zishintsha kanjani umphakathi, umnotho, kanye nezimo zokuphila. ### Ukukhula Kwamandla Avuselelekayo Amaphrojekthi afana nezezimali ze-solar, umoya, namafutha amancane ahlanzekile aqhubekele phambili eNyakatho Kapa. Ukushintsha kokusetshenziswa kwamandla, ikakhulukazi kumasipala, kubonakala kulula. I-Solar Cape, isibonelo, iyiphrojekthi ephelele yokutshala izinsiza zomoya ezikhiqiza amandla amaningi, okuholela ekunciphiseni kokuncika kumithombo yamandla anganeni. ### Umthelela Emphakathini Ukwakhiwa kwamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo kuye kwaholela ekuthuthukiseni amathuba emisebenzi. Izisebenzi zikhulisiwe ekwakhiweni nasekugcinweni kweziteshi zamandla, lokhu kudala ukuhamba phambili okuhle emiphakathini. Abantu bahlala bezwa izinzuzo zempilo ezikhula ngezinga eliphakeme, njengoba amandla avuselelekayo akhulisa ukufinyelela kumandla kuzo zonke izinhlaka. ### Ukubambisana Neminyango Kahulumeni Ukwakhiwa kwalezi zinhlelo akuhambisani nezinhloso zomphakathi kuphela, kodwa futhi kukhuthazwa kakhulu yiminyango kahulumeni. Iziphathimandla zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezibhekelela ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwama-initiatives wamandla avuselelekayo. Kwakuhloswe ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo ezivumela ukusetshenziswa kwama-solar panels kumakhaya, okuphucula izinga lokuphila labahlali. ### Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Naphezu kokukhula okuvelele, amaphrojekthi awamukeli wonke umuntu. Ukukhathazeka ngezindleko zokufaka, noma ngabe izinsizakusebenza zikhona, kusemqoka. Lokhu kudinga ukuba abahlinzeki bemali babambisane nokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo eziphumelelayo ezisheshayo. Imali yokubambisana ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaphrojekthi awama-solar akwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. ### Ukubheka Ikusasa Iziphathimandla zikhumbula ukuthi amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa awaqediwe. Ukuze kuqhubeke nokuthuthuka, kudingeka izinhlelo ezingqondweni ezizoshintsha indlela yokuphila. Ucwaningo lwezokuthuthukiswa kufanele luthuthukiswe, futhi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa zabantu zifanele ukwenziwa ukuze kugcinwe ulwazi olufanayo. ### Ukuphetha Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anikela ithuba elihle lokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo. Ukukhula okuqhubekayo kwemithombo yamandla avuselelekayo kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha ikusasa elinothile. Ngakho-ke, amaphrojekthi amaningi aphesheya kokuphila kwansuku zonke kumele aqashelwe, avunyelwe, futhi asizakale emiphakathini engabaphila. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba abantu baphile impilo engcono, baphile ngokuhlanganyela, futhi baphile ethubeni eliqhakazile. Ukubuyekezwa kwamaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa kufakazela ukuthi ngempela, amandla avuselelekayo angumkhiqizo wesikhathi esizayo. Lokhu kusebenza kumaphrojekthi akhula ngempumelelo nangokubambisana, okukhombisa ukuthi ukwethembeka kumakhasimende, umphakathi, kanye nezokuphila kuzoba yinto ebalulekile emzamweni wokwakha umhlaba omusha.
Umculo we-Gospel: Umthombo Wokholo Nothando Umculo we-gospel ungumculo ogcwele imizwa futhi onomlando ocebile. Ubonisa uthando, ithemba, kanye nokholo. Namuhla, umculo we-gospel ungaphezu kokuba nje umculo; ungumthombo wokukhuthaza, ukwelapha, nokuhlanganisa abantu. Kubalulekile ukuhlola umthelela nomsebenzi walo emiphakathini yethu. Umculo we-gospel uqala emlandweni, lapho izinkolo zikhula khona, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama eMelika. Lolu hlanga luhlanganisa izitayela eziningi, kusukela kumculo wesintu, i-blues, kanye ne-jazz, okwenza umculo we-gospel udlule imingcele, ufinyelele ezindaweni eziningi, futhi ube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Umculo we-gospel uyakhumbuza ukuthi, noma izimo zingase zibe nzima, kukhona ithemba, futhi sikhona umthombo wokholo. Abaculi abanjengoMahalia Jackson, Aretha Franklin, noKirk Franklin baveza ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima empilweni. Uhlanga lwe-gospel lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi bahlale bephakeme, baphokophele phambili, futhi bahlale bejabulile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima. Umculo we-gospel uhlanganisa abantu, futhi izinkonzo ze-gospel zihlala zikhanga abantu abaningi, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umphakathi. Lapho abantu behlangana ukuze baphile umculo, bahlala bejabule, bephila izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile. Umculo we-gospel ungumgogodla wokuhlangana, uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi ubakhumbuza ukuthi sonke sabelana ngempilo, izinkinga, nezifiso. Nokho, umculo we-gospel ubhekene nezinselelo. Njengoba uqhubeka nokukhula, izinselelo eziningi zikhona. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, izitayela ezintsha, kanye nezinguquko emiphakathini zenza kube nzima ukugcina umoya wokuqala we-gospel. Abaculi abasha bahlala bezama ukuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene, kodwa lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekeni komoya we-gospel. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaculi bahlale beqaphela imvelaphi yomculo wabo, ukuze bahlale bephila umoya wokholo nothando. Umculo we-gospel udinga ukugcinwa. Abaculi, abaphathi, nabalobi badinga ukugxila ekwakheni umculo onenhloso, onokuthinta, futhi ophilayo. Umculo we-gospel kufanele ube yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile, njengobulungiswa, uthando, kanye nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuzokwenza umculo we-gospel ube yinsika eqinile emiphakathini yethu, uqhubeke nokukhuthaza abantu. Ekugcineni, umculo we-gospel ungumthombo wokholo, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Ubonisa ukuthi, noma izimo zingase zibe nzima, sikhona isikhumbuzo sokuthi sitholakala ndawonye, sikhuthaza, futhi sithokozisa. Umculo we-gospel ungumgogodla wokuphila, uhlanganisa abantu, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umhlaba ungaba yindawo engcono uma sabelana ngothando. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuxhasa umculo we-gospel, siwugqugquzele, futhi siwugcina, ukuze uqhubeke nokukhanya njengomthombo wokukhuthaza nokuqinisa imiphakathi yethu.
Ukwenza umshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiko kulawulwa umthetho wesiko wombango. Uma umyeni eshintsha umthetho futhi efuna ukushada omunye umkakhe, abanye abashadile bazovunyelwa ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Umshado kumele uhlelwe, kumele kube nomcimbi, futhi kumele wenziwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesiko. Abafakizicelo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kumele bathole incwadi kumholi wesiko. Abafakizicelo abahlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kumele banikeze isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe ngendlela ye-affidavit. Ukuze umshado ube khona, bobabili abashadayo kanye nezithunywa ezivela emindenini yomabili kumele babe khona.
UBlack Coffee: Umculi Ohloniphekile Isingeniso UBlack Coffee, ogama lakhe langempela linguNkosinathi Maphumulo, ungumculi odumile emhlabeni jikelele. Uthandwa kakhulu ngenxa yomculo wakhe opholile, owaziwa ngokuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene, kuhlanganise ne-house ne-afro-house. Kule ndatshana, sizobheka indlela uBlack Coffee akhule ngayo, izimpumelelo zakhe, kanye nomthelela wakhe emculweni nasempilweni yabantu. Isigaba 1: Ukuqala Kwakhe UBlack Coffee wazalelwa eLanga laMafene, eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukhula kwakhe kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yakhe, njengoba ababephila ezindaweni ezinzima. Uthando lwakhe lomculo lwaqala esencane, lapho eqala khona ukudlala i-dj emicimbini yasemakhaya. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe emculweni, futhi kwamsiza ukuba aqonde ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila. Isigaba 2: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwemisebenzi Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uBlack Coffee waqala ukusebenza njengomculi ophakathi nendawo. Waqala ukwakha igama lakhe emculweni, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wathola ithuba lokubamba imicimbi emikhulu. Uthando lwakhe lokudala umculo oluhlukile lwamvumela ukuthi aqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izitayela zakhe. Ngalesi sikhathi, waqala ukusebenzisana nabanye abaculi, okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile emhlabeni womculo. Isigaba 3: Izimpumelelo Zomhlaba Wonke UBlack Coffee wathola udumo olukhulu ngemva kokukhulula ama-albhamu akhe, afana no "Africa Rising" no "Pieces of Me." Lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa ubuchule bakhe bokuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene, futhi zathola izindondo eziningi. UBlack Coffee waba yisithonjana emhlabeni, futhi waqala ukuhamba emhlabeni wonke, edlala emicimbini emikhulu, efana ne-Coachella ne-Tomorrowland. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abanye abaculi baphinde bamlandele, futhi umculo wakhe waba nomthelela omkhulu ezizweni ezahlukene. Isigaba 4: Umthelela Emphakathini Ngaphandle kokuba umculi ophumelelayo, uBlack Coffee ubonakala njengomholi emphakathini. Uthanda ukusiza abanye abaculi, futhi usebenzisana nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa umculo eNingizimu Afrika. Ubuye abe nesandla ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi kubantu abasha, eqinisekisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila. UBlack Coffee ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungaphezu kokuzijabulisa; ungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Isigaba 5: Ukubhekisisa Ikusasa Njengoba uBlack Coffee eqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi aqhubeke nokwakha umculo opholile, okhuthaza abantu. Umsebenzi wakhe ubonisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuxhumana, futhi ungafaka isandla ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. UBlack Coffee ubalulekile emculweni, futhi umthelela wakhe uzohlala ukhanya ezizweni eziningi. Isiphetho UBlack Coffee ungumculi ohloniphekile, onomthelela omkhulu emculweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ukukhula kwakhe kusukela ezingeni eliphansi kuya phezulu kubonisa ukuthi ngeqhaza, uthando, nokusebenza kanzima, umuntu angafinyelela impumelelo. Umculo wakhe uyakhuthaza, futhi umphakathi uyamthanda. UBlack Coffee ungumfanekiso wokuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi umphakathi ungathola izinzuzo eziningi kulokhu. Njengoba eqhubeka nokudala, sizobona ukuthi umculo wakhe uzohlala unomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni.
Isibopho selungu ngolwazi olungamanga (GEMS member liability for false information) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-GEMS? Impendulo: I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano enikeza imishanguzo nezinzuzo zempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ihloswe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayo athola ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhle, okuphumelelayo, futhi okuthengekayo. Umbuzo 2: Yini esichaza ngayo isibopho selungu? Impendulo: Isibopho selungu sisho ukuthi amalungu e-GEMS banesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eqondile, enembile, futhi ephelele uma befaka izicelo zokuhlala kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 3: Kungani kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile? Impendulo: Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile kubalulekile ngoba lokho kuthinta izinqumo ezithathwa yi-GEMS mayelana nezinsizakalo nezinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Uma amalungu e-GEMS enza amanga noma ahlinzeka ngemininingwane engalungile, lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, kufaka phakathi ukulahlekelwa kwezinsiza noma ukuxoshwa kwi-GEMS. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izingozi uma ummember enza amanga? Impendulo: Uma ummember e-GEMS ethola ukuthi unikeze ulwazi olungamanga, kungaholela ezicini eziningi ezinzima. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi: - Ukulahlekelwa kwezinsizakalo - Ukuvinjelwa ekutholeni izinsiza zesikhathi esizayo - Ukubhekana nezinyathelo zomthetho, okuhlanganisa ukuxoshwa kwi-GEMS. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe i-GEMS iyakhipha izinyathelo ezithile uma kutholakala ulwazi olungamanga? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inezinqubo ezithile ezithathwayo uma kutholakala ulwazi olungamanga. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola udaba, ukufaka izinyathelo zokuphendula, nokuhlinzeka ngesixazululo esifanele. I-GEMS ikholelwa ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amalungu ayo ayakwazi ukuphila ngokukhululeka futhi akhuthazwe ukuba ahlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile. Umbuzo 6: Uyangithanda yini ukusinika izibonelo zezimo ezingenzeka? Impendulo: Impela! Isibonelo esivamile singaba ummember ophakamisa ukuthi unayo idokhumenti ethile yokwelashwa, kodwa empeleni akunayona. Lokhu kungaholela ekukhokheni izindleko ezibhaliwe, futhi uma kutholakala ukuthi lokhu bekungamanga, ummember angase abhekane nezinyathelo ezibucayi. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele uyenze uma ungazi ukuthi ulwazi lwakho luyinembile? Impendulo: Uma ungazi ukuthi ulwazi lwakho luyinembile, kubalulekile ukuthi uthintane ne-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Ungabufuna ukuthi bakhombise ukuthi kula maphuzu kufanele uthumele ulwazi olunembile, nokuthi ungabavala kanjani ukufaka kahle esikhathini esizayo. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe i-GEMS inikeza izifundo noma izinhlelo zokwazi ukuze amalungu aqonde kahle? Impendulo: Yebo, i-GEMS inikeza izifundo ezithile ezihloselwe ukusiza amalungu aqonde kahle izinqubo zayo, izidingo, nezibopho zabo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo zokuphatha, imihlangano, nezinsizakalo zokusekela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu afaka ulwazi olunembile. Umbuzo 9: Yini ongayenza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unikeza ulwazi olunembile? Impendulo: Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unikeza ulwazi olunembile, kubalulekile: 1. Ukuhlola izincwadi zakho zomuntu siqu, 2. Ukugcina amarekhodi anembile, 3. Ukuthola usizo uma ungazi noma ungathandeki ngemininingwane ethile. Umbuzo 10: Uthini umyalezo wokugcina kubo bonke amalungu? Impendulo: Umyalezo wokugcina kubo bonke amalungu e-GEMS uwukuthi: "Ihloniphe izinqubo zethu, uhlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile, futhi uzothola izinzuzo ezitholakala ku-GEMS ngendlela efanele." Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi osebenzayo, ophilayo, nolondekile. Ngamafuphi, ubufakazi bokuthi ulwazi olungamanga lungaba nemiphumela emibi kubalulekile. Ngakho-ke, amalungu e-GEMS kumele aqaphele futhi ahloniphe isibopho sawo sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile.
Noma ubani onenhlalakahle engapheli eNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukufaka isicelo sokuba yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi ukujwayela emva kweminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngumhlali ongenamkhawulo. Noma ubani oshadile nesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukuba yisakhamuzi esivela kwezinye izwe ngemva kweminyaka emibili kulandela ukunikezwa kwesikhumbuzo sokuhlala esinokuphela kwalesi sikhathi sokushada. Ingane eneminyaka engu-21 enenhlalakahle engapheli iyafaneleka ukuba yisakhamuzi esivela kwezinye izwe, ngokushesha ngemva kokunikezwa kwesikhumbuzo sokuhlala. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, xhumana neMnyango Wezasekhaya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-63 ne-BI-757 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMvelo. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Nikeza iphepha elisemthethweni lokuhlala elingapheli noma ukuhoxiswa. Qedela ifomu le-SAP kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe ukuze uthole isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka kwezokuphepha. Thumela ifomu le-BI-9 eliqediwe kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe nezithombe ezimbili ezinomumo we-ID uma ungena eminyakeni engu-15. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthola ub identification ngemva kokwamukelwa kwesicelo sakho sokuba yisakhamuzi esivela kwezinye izwe. Umdali onengane angafaka isicelo egameni lezingane nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho ingane isendaweni yokuhlala ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Abafakizicelo abamukeliwe bazoxwayiswa ngokufanele. Izicelo zingathatha izinyanga ezi-2 kuya kwezi-4. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Izingo, ukulimala, nezifo zingaphazamisa impilo nezinkampani. Izixazululo zivame ukuba lula futhi zingabizi, futhi abantu bangakwenza kube kuphephe ezindaweni zabo zokulima kubalimi nabasebenzi babo. Impilo nokuphepha kuyizidingo ezibalulekile zebhizinisi lokulima elizinzile. Imizamo kahulumeni yodwa ayizukwenzela ukuphepha nempilo emkhakheni wezolimo, kodwa wonke umuntu ophakathi kwezolimo nasemkhakheni wezokudla kumele abe nendima yokudlala. Unyaka nonyaka, abantu bafa ngenxa yomsebenzi abawenzayo kwezolimo nasemithini. Abaningi bahlupheka ngokulimala okukhulu futhi baba nezifo emsebenzini. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bangakwazi ukusebenza nokuqeqesha labo abathintekayo. Izindleko zokuphatha - ukuhlola izigameko, ukubika, njll. Ukulimala kwemishini, izakhiwo, nemikhiqizo. Izindleko ze-inshurensi, izimali zomthetho, nokukhishwa kwemidiya. Zonke lezi zindleko zingagwenywa, okungaholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Le bhukwana iphumelelwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane engasiza abaqashi nabasebenzi kwezolimo nasemithini ukuthuthukisa impilo, ukuphepha, nezingozi zempilo ezihlobene nomsebenzi kulesi sikhala. Le bhukwana ayikhulumi ngezidingo zomthetho kulo mkhakha. Le mininingwane ingatholakala kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezabasebenzi: www.labour.gov.za. Ukuphatha impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi kufana nokuphatha uhlelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo nezilwane zigcinwa ziphilile, zikhulisa njengoba kulindelekile, futhi zigcine ibhizinisi lakho. Abasebenzi kumele bahlale bephila ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi basebenza kahle futhi bahlala beqashwe. Zonke izinhlangano zidinga umthetho ukuze ziqale izinhlelo zazo zokuphepha nempilo, ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa amazinga endaweni yokusebenza. Lokhu kumele kubhalwe phansi, kulungiswe kahle ngokusekelwe ekuzinikeleni kokuphatha okuphakeme. Beka wonke amagatsha akho mayelana nempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Umqashi kumele asayine futhi achaze kahle usuku lwemigomo ukuze akhombise ukuzinikela kwakhe. Khombisa ukuthi umthwalo wemfanelo wokuphepha nempilo kwabasebenzi ukhona kuwe njengomqashi. Chaza izinhlelo ezikhona nezindlela ezizokuqinisekisa impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi bakho. Kumele zihlolwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi zilungiswe uma izimo zakho zishintsha noma uma izingozi ezithile zivele. Ukuhlonza izingozi nezinkinga ezidalwa yizo kubalulekile. Ngaphandle kokwazi izingozi ezikhona endaweni yakho yokusebenza kanye nezinga lezingcuphe ezibekwe kubasebenzi bakho, awuzokwazi ukuthi kufanele kuthathwe isinyathelo, nokuthi kufanele senziwe kanjani. Ukuhlola ingcuphe kusho ukubheka ngokucophelela ukuthi yini ebhizinisini lakho engalimaza abantu, ukuze ubone ukuthi uthathile izinyathelo ezifanele noma uma kudingeka ukuthi wenze okuthile okunye. Uma usunqume izinga lezingcuphe, kufanele uthathe izinyathelo zokuvikela izingozi ekwenzeni. Kukhona izindawo eziningi lapho ungathola khona izeluleko kulabo abanolwazi lokwenza lokhu uma uhlola ingcuphe; ungasebenzisa lezi zindlela ezinhlanu ezilandelayo ukukusiza. Bheka indawo yokusebenza futhi ubheke ukuthi abantu basebenza kanjani. Futhi, hlola amarekhodi ezigameko ezedlule, izingozi, noma izinkinga zempilo. Inhloso yalezi zihloko ukuhlole izingozi ezibalulekile ezingaholela ekulimazeni abantu abaningi. Hlonza abantu abangase babe sengozini bese ubala ukuthi bangaki. Uma ucabanga ukuthi uzokwenza lokhu, ungakhohlwa ukuhlela imisebenzi enobungozi. Bheka ukuthi izinto ezibucayi ziphathwa kanjani. Izindlela zokuhlola lezi zingozi zingaba ngokubheka noma ezinye izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Abasebenzi bavame ukuba nemibono ewusizo egxile ezinkingeni abahlangabezana nazo emsebenzini wabo wansuku zonke, ngakho kuhle ukubabandakanya ezinqumweni ozithathayo. Ngemuva kokuba usunqume ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe, kufanele uhlela ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani futhi nini. Ukubhalela phansi kuzokusiza ukufaka leli phrojekthi. Kufanele uhlolisise ukuhlola kwakho uma kukhona izinguquko ezinkulu endleleni ophila ngayo noma uma unamanxeba okukholelwa ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ukusebenza endaweni enezimo zezulu ezishintshashintshayo, umsindo, noma ukuhamba. Ukuphakamisa imithwalo emikhulu nokusebenza ezikhundleni ezinzima kungadala ubuhlungu bemisipha. Lokhu kubuhlungu emalungeni, ezithweni, nasehliziyweni kungadala ukucindezeleka kwemisipha. Gwema ukuphakamisa imithwalo emikhulu noma ukusebenza ezikhundleni ezinzima lapho kungenzeka. Phakamisa izinto ngendlela efanele - gcina izinyawo zakho zihlukaniswe, gcina umhlane uqondile, futhi ugcine imithwalo oyiphakamisayo ibhande eduze komzimba wakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ihlelwe kahle ukuze amathuluzi nemikhiqizo kube lula ukufinyelela ngaphandle kokuphula imisipha futhi uzame ukujikeleza imisebenzi edinga ukwenza noma uhambise ukuze usebenze imisipha ehlukene emzimbeni. Izithuthi ezisebenza ngesandla, ukuhamba ibanga elide, nezitshalo kufanele kugwenywe uma kungenzeka ukuvikela impilo yabasebenzi. Izingozi eziningi ezisemafamu zihilela imishini. Ezinye zenzeka ngoba imishini isetshenziswa emsebenzini ongafanele, ezinye zenzeka ngoba izivikeli zokuphepha azikho noma zikhishwe. Kumele kube nohlelo lokuhlola ukuthi amathuluzi nemishini esingathembela kuyo iphephile ukuyisebenzisa. Uma amathuluzi esetshenziswa ezimeni ezingaphephile, kufanele ahlolwe njalo ukuze kubonakale ukuthi yini engaholela ezingozeni, ikakhulukazi uma kukhona isimo esingajwayelekile esingase senze amathuluzi angaphephile. Izivikeli zokuphepha zidingeka ngokomthetho. Amathuluzi okutshala izihlahla kumele aklanywe ngenhloso leyo. Amathuluzi ezolimo ngokuvamile awafaneleki ukutshala izihlahla. Izibambo zamathuluzi kumele ziqinisiwe ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala kwezandla uma ithuluzi lishaya itshe elingafihlekile noma imizi. Uma uthenga noma uqasha imishini, umthetho uthi umhlinzeki kufanele anikeze izivikeli zokuphepha ezifanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi wena nabasebenzi bakho uqeqeshwe ukuze usebenzise imishini ngokwezincwadi ezibhaliwe kuyo. Gcina izivikeli zokuphepha ezindaweni zazo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Hlola ukuthi amasondo okuma okuphuthumayo abhalwe kahle ukuze akhombise ukuthi enza ini nokuthi imishini ethinta ini, futhi aklanywe futhi abekwe ngendlela engavunyelwe ukuthi ivulwe ngengozi. Abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe ukuze basebenze ngokuphepha futhi banikezwe izingubo zokuvikela. Izigameko eziningi ezihilela imishini zenzeka ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwemishini. Abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe kahle ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo. Amathuluzi anele nezincwadi zokusebenzisa imishini kufanele anikezwe ukuze imishini iphathwe, ibonakale, futhi isetshenziswe ngokuphepha. Imithombo yamandla, ngokwesibonelo, kufanele ivela kumishini eqinisa izikhala noma amandla avela emanzini, futhi kufanele ibe endaweni ephephile ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umsebenzi. Imishini esebenzisa amandla emanzini kufanele ivinjelwe ukuwa ngokusebenzisa imishini yokuphakamisa efana nezivikeli nezijakethi uma abantu besebenza ngaphansi kwayo. Kumele bakwazi
Iphuzu elivunguzayo: "Umhlabathi uyifa labantu bonke kanye nabantu abaphumelelayo benhlangano: umhlaba ungowethu. Umhlabathi ungumkhathi wezinhlobo zonke zokudla futhi udala umsebenzi wezolimo. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakuthatha indawo. Ngakho-ke, thina njengabantu sinomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina leli th treasure lethu ngokukhuthaza njalo, silisebenzise ngendlela efanele, ukuze sakhe umhlaba onempilo ngoba umhlaba onempilo ungakha kuphela ezimbonini zomhlabathi eziphilayo." - JC Ross. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakuthatha indawo. Ngaphakathi kwawo, akukho okushintshayo. Konke okwenzeka, njengokuphuma komhlabathi, kudale umhlabathi uvelwe ezintweni ezinjengamatshe. Nokho, kumele sihlukanise phakathi kokushintsha kwemvelo nalokhu okwenziwa ngenxa yokungenelela kwabantu. Ukwakhiwa komhlabathi kwemvelo kuthatha izinkulungwane zeminyaka, kodwa umuntu angawuchitha konke lokhu ngosuku olulodwa uma engasebenzisi umhlabathi ngendlela efanele futhi engalimi ngendlela ehambisana nezimiso zokulima ezisindayo. Ukuphatha kahle ukuphuma komhlabathi kuzinzile kuzosiza umlimi nakwabanye abantu emhlabeni jikelele - kusiza umnikazi ukuthi agcine umhlabathi nomswakama (amanzi) ngaphakathi komhlabathi, kusiza abanye ukuvimbela imifula ukuthi ingawashiyi impahla yabo, kuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi emifula acacile futhi kuvikela umhlaba emhlabeni jikelele. Ukulahleka komhlabathi kanye nokukhiqiza kwawo. Ukulahleka kwamanzi agijimayo angasetshenziswa. Ukwehla kwemikhakha nezindawo ezingakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ukuqubuka (kwamanzi amaningi) nezomiso ezinzima. Ukwehla kwenani lemakethe yomhlaba. Ukwehla kwemikhakha yokwenza inzuzo ekulimalini. Izinkambu azikasebenzi, zishiywe. Izitshalo ezikhula kahle. Kukhona izinto ezintathu eziyinhloko ezibangela ukuphuma komhlabathi: amanzi, umoya, kanye neqhwa. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sithola ikakhulukazi ukuphuma kwamanzi, bese sibheka ukuphuma komoya. Ukuphuma kwamanzi kwenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuhamba kwamanzi phezulu kanye nokwakhiwa kwemithombo. Ngokuvamile, umhlabathi lapho kuzolima khona ulungiswe kahle, uvalwe, uhlelekile, uqinile. Okwamanje, sisebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi ukuguguleka okuncane - umhlabathi awusulungiswa ngendlela evamile ukuvimbela ukulahleka komhlabathi ophakeme. Isikhathi sokulima siphinde sibe yisikhathi sezikhukhula ezinzima. Lapho kunetha kakhulu kulomhlabathi olungisiwe, umhlabathi uvame ukuba buthakathaka, kodwa kuvame ukuba nezinsalela zomhlabathi ezincane ezizohamba namanzi. Ngemuva kokunetha kokuqala, amanzi amaningi aqala ukuhamba futhi agijime lapho kukhona ukwehla, ethwele umhlabathi nezinye izinto. Lokhu kungaqhubeka isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokubona kalula. Ekugcineni, umlimi uzobona ukuthi izinkulungwane zamathani omhlabathi zilahlekile unyaka nonyaka. Ngokuvamile izinkambu azilingani, ezinye ziphakeme, ezinye zisezingeni eliphansi, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Amanzi avame ukuhamba ngaphansi kwezindawo eziphakeme, akha imithombo emincane yokukhula. Lapho ukuphuma kwenzeka endaweni ethambile, lezi zinsizakusebenza zihlangana ukuze zakhe imithombo engameleke emagatsheni ezihlahla - bese kwakhiwa imithombo emikhulu. Lapho amanzi eqala ukuhamba emithonjeni ethile, amandla alezi zinsizakusebenza ayanda futhi ukuphuma kwanda kakhulu. Lapho ukuphuma okufana nezithupha kufika endaweni lapho imithombo eyakhiwe ingaphinde ilungiswe, kufika ezingeni lokuphuma okufana nezithupha. Le nqubekela phambili esheshayo yemithombo ingalimaza izindawo ezinkulu zomhlaba futhi ivimbele ukulima okwengeziwe kulezi zindawo. Izigaba zethu ezizayo zinethemba lokuthi sizogcina umhlabathi ukuze bakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ngokuphatha umhlabathi kahle, singaqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uzosetshenziswa kusasa nakusasa.
Isimo Somnotho WaseNingizimu Afrika: Ingxoxo Ngobuchwepheshe Isingeniso Sanibonani, nonke abathandi bezindaba. Namuhla sizobe sikhuluma ngesimo somnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, esibucayi kakhulu kulezi zinsuku. Ngikhuluma noMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumcwaningi wezomnotho, ukuze sihlole izinselelo nezinkinga ezibhekene nomnotho wethu. Mnu. Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokusivumela ukuba sikhulume nawe. Isimo Sokukhula Komnotho Mnu. Mthembu, ngicela uqale ngokuchaza isimo sokukhula komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthi sikhona yini ukukhula okuhle okukhona? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Yebo, isimo sokukhula komnotho wethu sikhombisa izimpawu ezithile ezikhathazayo. Ngonyaka owedlule, sathola ukukhula okuncane, okungama-1.2%. Lokhu kuncane kakhulu uma sikhumbula izinga lokukhula elidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu bethu. Izinkinga ezinjengokungasebenzi, ukungabi khona kwemisebenzi, kanye nezindleko eziphakeme zokuphila, zenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Izinkinga Zokungasebenzi Ngabe ungachaza kabanzi ngalesi sikhathi sokungasebenzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela. Isinga sokungasebenzi phakathi kwentsha sifinyelela ku-60%, okuyinombolo ephakeme kakhulu. Lokhu kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, kuhlanganisa ukungabi khona kwemfundo efanele, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona ezingahlangabezani nezidingo zemakethe, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu zemfundo nezokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Izimakethe Nezomnotho Kukhona izimakethe ezithile ezithuthuka, noma izimboni ezithola impumelelo, noma izimboni ezibhekene nezinkinga? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, kunezimboni ezithile ezifana nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, kanye nezobuchwepheshe obuphakeme ezikhombisa ukukhula okuhle. Kodwa-ke, sizithola sithwele kanzima emkhakheni wezolimo nezimboni ezindala, ezinjengokukhiqiza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu zokuxhasa lezi zimboni ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Umnotho Kuyini okudingekayo ukuze sithuthukise umnotho wethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Kudingeka izinyathelo eziningi. Okokuqala, kumele sithuthukise imfundo ukuze sithole abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe. Okwesibili, kumele sikhuthaze ukutshalwa kwezimali, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Okwesithathu, kufanele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, ngoba lawa mabhizinisi angaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana Nezizwe Ngabe ukubambisana namanye amazwe kubalulekile emnothweni wethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Yebo, ukubambisana namazwe angaphandle kubalulekile. Lokhu kusivumela ukuthi sithole ukufinyelela ezimakethe ezinkulu, sithole ubuchwepheshe obusha, futhi sithuthukise ubudlelwano bezohwebo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izivumelwano zokuhweba zingasiza ekunciphiseni izithiyo zokuhweba, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhula. Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Kukhona yini izinselelo ezithinta ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomnotho? Mnu. Mthembu: Impela, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomnotho, njengezimali, izinsiza zemvelo, kanye nezinsiza zabantu, kudinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Ukungabi khona kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, ukungasebenzi kahle, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila kwabantu. Kumele sibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha ukuze sithuthukise ukusebenza kwethu. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho. Ngabe unayo imiyalo yokugcina kubabukeli bethu? Mnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi, umnotho wethu ungathuthuka uma sonke sizibophezela ekwakheni ikusasa el better. Kumele sibe nezinqumo eziphusile, sikhuthaze ubumbano, futhi sithuthukise imfundo. Ngiyabonga nonke. Isiphetho Sezingxoxo Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Mthembu, ngokuba lapha namuhla. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzosisiza ukuba sithole ukuqonda okungcono ngesimo somnotho wethu. Ngiyethemba sizobona izinguquko ezinhle esikhathini esizayo. Ngiyabonga nonke ngokulandela, futhi sizobonana kwenye ingxoxo.

Yisiphi isivuno engisitshala futhi kungani ngikhethe leyo ndlela ethile? Ngifuna ukutshala inani elithile lezivuno ezinganele? Ekugcineni, zingaki izivuno ezimile? Ngihlose ukufaka malini umanyolo futhi kwaba yini umphumela? Yiziphi izinyathelo engizithathayo ukuphatha izilokazane nezifo ezindaweni zami? Ngibhekana kanjani nezihlahla? Ngiyazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezibeka ingozi ezindaweni zami? Ngimile malini ukuze ngitshale lezi zikhukula? Ingakanani intengo yemakethe yokukhiqiza engiyitholile futhi ihluke kanjani nentengo etholelwe abanye abalimi? Ingakanani intengo yokukhiqiza ngehektare? Ingakanani intengo yokukhiqiza ngekhukula? Ngemva kokuvuna lezi zikhukula, yisiphi isivuno engihlose ukusitshala kuleyo ndawo ngonyaka ozayo? Ngizothola kuphi imali yokutshala ukudla konyaka ozayo? Ingabe ama-tractor ami azokwazi ukulima lezi zindawo engihlose ukuzilima? Ingabe ngizoba nekhono lokwenza wonke umsebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele? Ngabe nginazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze ngikhiqize ukudla okuthile? Lapho ungaphendula khona le mibuzo kungakusiza ubuyele futhi ubuyekeze umhlahlandlela wakho noma ungase udinge ukubuyela kwi-courses entsha zokuqeqeshwa. Konke lokhu kubalulekile, izinto okufanele uqale ngazo ekulimaleni uma uhlose ukuba ngumlimi wezomnotho - kufanele ukwazi ukuphendula yonke le mibuzo engenhla. Ubani olima lezi zindawo? Yini ofuna ukuyenza nalezi zindawo kusasa? Sicela uzibuze le mibuzo ukuze uthole impendulo ecacile mayelana nentuthuko yakho njengomlimi ofuna ukukhula - ngempela, uyafuna ukuba ngumlimi noma ufuna nje ukuhlala phansi uzuze inzuzo ngoba ungumnikazi wendawo ongafinyeleli kulezo zilimo?
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo Kwakukhanya emini, izinyanga zishintsha, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, zikhuluma ngothando lwezulu. Emzaneni omncane, uMkhumbane, abantu babebhekene nezinkinga ezinzima. Izikhungo zezempilo zazikhona, kodwa zazingekho ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi abantu babengakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha nabadala abahlala emakhaya. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNandi, intokazi enomoya ophakeme, wathola umqondo omusha. Wayefuna ukusiza umphakathi wakhe, futhi wacabanga ukuthi ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kungaba yisixazululo. Waqala ukuhamba emzaneni, ebamba izinkulumo nabantu, efuna ukwazi izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. U-Nandi wayazi ukuthi abantu badinga ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe kahle ukuze bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Ngemuva kokuhlangana nabantu abaningi, uNandi wathola ukuthi abantu bahluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi. Abanye babengazi ukuthi bangabhalisela izivivinyo zezempilo, kanti abanye babengazi ukuthi izinkinga ezithile zingaxazululwa kalula uma bezithola ngesikhathi. Lokhu kwenza uNandi wacabanga ukuthi kudingeka isikhungo esisha, esizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele, olutholakala kalula. U-Nandi waqala ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu emzaneni. Wabiza abantu bonke, wathi: “Sizokwakha isikhungo sokwazi ngezempilo! Sizofunda, sizokhuluma, sizokwazi!” Abantu baphendula ngothando, bejabulile ngalesi sikhumbuzo esisha. U-Nandi wathola usizo kubangani bakhe, ababejabulile ukusiza. Bahlanganyela emsebenzini, behlela izifundo, izinkulumo, nezinsuku zokuhlola. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, isikhungo sokuqala sokwazi ngezempilo saqala ukusebenza. Kwakukhanya, izinsuku zishintsha, abantu bejabulile. U-Nandi waba umholi, futhi abantu bamlandela. Isikhungo sakhula, sathola izinsiza eziningi, futhi sathola abahlengikazi nabachwepheshe abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Kwakukhona izifundo ezihlukahlukene, ezazihlanganisa izihloko ezinjengokudla okunempilo, ukuvimbela izifo, nokubaluleka kokuzivocavoca. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, behlanganyela ezifundweni, bephendula imibuzo, futhi bexoxa ngezinkinga zabo. U-Nandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona ukuthi abantu baye bahlakanipha, bazi kahle ukuthi bangazithola kanjani izinsiza. Isikhungo sakhula sathola udumo, futhi abantu baveza izifiso zabo zokuba nezinye izikhungo ezinjalo ezindaweni ezikude. Kodwa, njengokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi kunezithiyo ezithile. Abanye abantu babengakholwa ukuthi izikhungo zezempilo zingabavikela, futhi abanye babengathandi ukuvuma ukuthi badinga usizo. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga, futhi uNandi waba nesibindi sokubhekana nayo. Waqala ukuhlela izinkulumo ezikhethekile, ezazihlanganisa izinkanyezi zomphakathi, abaholi bendawo, nabantu abavela ezikhungweni zezempilo. U-Nandi wakhuluma ngempilo, wakhuluma ngothando, wakhuluma ngempumelelo. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi ukufuna usizo akuyona iphutha, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphila kahle. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo eziningi, abantu baqala ukuzwa ukuthi isikhungo sikhona ukuze sibasize, hhayi ukubahlulela. Lokhu kwashintsha umqondo wabantu, futhi isikhungo sathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isikhungo sathola izinsiza eziningi, sathola uxhaso oluvela ezikhungweni ezinkulu, futhi sathola abavakashi abavela emiphakathini ehlukene. U-Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu oyedwa angashintsha impilo yomphakathi. Abantu baphendula, bahlala bejabulile, futhi isikhungo sakhula sathola udumo. Ekugcineni, uNandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izikhungo, kodwa futhi ukufundisa abantu, ukubakhuthaza, nokubavikela. U-Nandi waba umholi, futhi umphakathi waba yindawo yokuhlala enempilo, enothando, futhi enokuthula. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphila, indaba yokubambisana, indaba yokuthi abantu bangashintsha impilo yabo uma behlanganyela. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zingashintsha impilo, zikhulise umphakathi, futhi ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. U-Nandi waba yinkanyezi, futhi abantu bahlala bemkhumbula, bejabulela impilo enempilo, futhi bephila kahle. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yokuphila, indaba yokuthi umphakathi ungashintsha uma ubambisene.
Izindlela Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Indaba Yomlando Ezikhathini zakudala, ukubeletha kwakuyinqubo eyayibhekwe ngeso elibukhali. Abesifazane bezalwa emaphandleni nasezindaweni ezikude, lapho izikhungo zezokwelapha zazikhona, kodwa zazingatholakali kalula. Ngenxa yalokhu, imikhuba yokubeletha yesintu yayikhula, ihlukaniswe ngezindawo, izinkolo, nezifunda. Lokhu kwaholela ezinqubweni ezahlukene zokubeletha, lapho izimfundiso nezindlela zamasiko zazibhekwa ngokubaluleka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukwakha izibhedlela eziphakeme, okuyizikhungo ezinzima zokwelapha ezadlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokubeletha. Emazweni amaningi, izibhedlela zathuthukiswa ukuze zibe nezinsiza zokwelapha eziphambili. Ngaleso sikhathi, abesifazane abaneminyaka ethile bayesaba ukubeletha ezibhedlela, ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle nezinkolelo ezazikhona. Izibhedlela zokuqala zazinezinsiza ezilula, kodwa zanquma ukwamukela abezinhlangano ezihlukene. Abesifazane bebelingani, bezwakala, besekela omunye nomunye. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kube nezinkolelo, izinkumbulo, nezifundo eziphuma kulokhu. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkinga zokubeletha zazikhona, futhi abesifazane babebhekene nezinsizi eziningi. Kodwa-ke, umoya wokubambisana wawuhamba phambili, ubonisa amandla nokuhlakanipha komphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zathuthukiswa. Abelaphi bebelokhu bephokophela ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokubeletha, behlonipha izidingo zabesifazane. Kukhona izifundo eziningi ezaziphuma ezibhedlela, ezisiza ukwandisa ulwazi lwezokwelapha. Abesifazane babezifundisa ngezindlela eziphumelelayo zokubeletha, bejolise ekugcineni impilo yabo kanye nezingane zabo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kwaba yinsika yokuthuthukiswa kwalezi zinhlelo. Ukwanda kwamathuba okuthola izinsiza eziphambili, njengokwelashwa kwezesekeli, kwaholela ekutheni abesifazane babe nesibindi sokukhetha izibhedlela njengendawo yokubeletha. Ubulili bezokwelapha bube nezinguquko ezithakazelisayo, njengoba abelaphi besebenzisa imithombo ethuthukile. Izibhedlela zamukele abezinhlangano, ukuze baphathe izikhala ezithile, bese bephinde baqhamuka nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwezingane. Kodwa, isimo sishintsha. Kunezinkinga ezazivele zikhona, njengezinkinga zokuhlala ezibhedlela, izindleko, kanye nezinsiza ezikhona. Abesifazane babebhekene nezinkinga ezithile, njengoba umphakathi wawubheka ukubeletha njengomsebenzi obalulekile. Ukuze kudlulekile lezi zinkinga, izikhungo zabe ziqhamuka nezinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokubeletha. Abesifazane baphenduka lapho, behola, bejabulisa imindeni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zaphinde zathuthuka. Kukhona ukwanda kokuhlinzwa, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukile. Abesifazane baye babona ushintsho, behamba phambili ekwakheni izimo ezinhle zokubeletha. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kwaba yinsika yokuthuthukiswa, kuhlanganisa abelaphi, abesifazane, nemindeni. Ukwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana, kwenza kube lula ukuhlonipha izinqubo zokubeletha. Ubuchwepheshe obuphambili buphendule izinkinga ezinzima, kuhlanganise nezinkinga zokwelashwa. Abesifazane baphenduka, behlola izinketho ezahlukene, besanda nokufunda ngezindlela zokubeletha ezibhedlela. Lokhu kube yinqaba yokuhlala ephephile, lapho abesifazane bezizwa bejabulile. Njengoba sidlula eminyakeni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zishintsha. Abesifazane baye baphumelela ekwakheni izinkolelo ezintsha ezichaza impilo. Izibhedlela zaphinde zaba yizikhungo zokuqonda, lapho abesifazane bezifundisa ngokwabo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kube yinsika, kuhlanganisa abelaphi, abesifazane, nemindeni. Namuhla, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Abesifazane baye baphumelela ekwakheni izinkolelo ezintsha, behlola izinhlelo ezithuthukile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu kuqhubekile, kuhlonipha izidingo zabesifazane, nezinto ezithinta impilo. Lokhu kubonisa uqhubeko olukhulu empilweni, lapho izinqubo zokubeletha zishintsha izindlela zempilo zabesifazane nemindeni yabo. Ngakho-ke, indaba yokubeletha ezibhedlela ibalulekile, ibonisa amandla, ukuhlakanipha, nokubambisana komphakathi. Izinqubo zokubeletha zaguqulwa yizikhathi, zaba yindlela yokwakha impilo engcono kubo bonke. Ngaleso sikhathi, izibhedlela zaba yizikhungo eziphakeme zokwelapha, zihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu kuhlale kukhulu, kuhlonipha izidingo zabesifazane, futhi kubonisa ukuthi impilo iyisibusiso.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi - Ingxoxo Umxhumanisi: Ngiyakwemukela, Mnumzane Dlamini. Ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukuxoxa nathi ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile – iziteleka zabasebenzi. Ukuqala, singakucacisela ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zisho ukuthini? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zisho ukuthi abasebenzi bayavuma ukusebenza ukuze baphakamise izikhalazo zabo. Lokhu kungaba ngokuhamba emgwaqweni, noma ngokungavumi ukusebenza, ngenhloso yokucela izinguquko ezithile, njengokwenziwa kwemiholo, izimo zokusebenza, noma amalungelo abanye. Umxhumanisi: Kuhle. Zikhona izizathu ezithile ezenza abasebenzi babe neziteleka? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, izizathu zihluke-hluke. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi ukunganeliseki ngemiholo, ukungahambisani kwemigomo yokusebenza, noma izimo ezimbi zokusebenza. Kwezinye izimo, abasebenzi bangase bazwe ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonishwa, okwenza kube ngcono ukuthi baphume ukuze bacacise izikhalazo zabo. Umxhumanisi: Uthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zikhona emikhakheni ehlukene, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yiziphi? Mnu. Dlamini: Impela. Iziteleka zitholakala ezinyangeni ezahlukene, ezikhiqizweni, ezokuxhumana, ezempilo, nakwezinye izimboni. Isibonelo, umhlinzeki wezinsiza kusebenza ungase ube neziteleka ngenxa yokungabikhona kwemali eyanele yokubakhokhela, kanti umphakathi wezokwelapha ungase ube neziteleka ngenxa yokucindezelwa futhi ungathola imiholo engafanele. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe iziteleka zaba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, umphakathi ubona iziteleka njengendlela yokuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi. Zivame ukuthuthukisa isimo sokuphila kwabantu noma umphakathi, njengokwandisa umholo noma ukuhlinzeka ngezimo zokusebenza ezingcono. Kodwa, zibuye zibe nemiphumela engemihle, njengokuphazamiseka kwemisebenzi, ukuncipha kwemali engenayo, noma ukungqubuzana phakathi kwabaholi bezisebenzi nabaphathi. Umxhumanisi: Yini okudingeka ukuze iziteleka zabasebenzi zibe nempumelelo? Mnu. Dlamini: Ukuze iziteleka zibe nempumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezihlelekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela okuhle, ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuhlonipha imithetho. Abaholi bezisebenzi kumele babe nezinhlelo ezicacile, futhi kufanele baqonde ukuthi kudinga isikhathi nezinsizakusebenza ukuze bafeze izinjongo zabo. Umxhumanisi: Kukhona yini izindlela zokugwema iziteleka? Mnu. Dlamini: Ngokuqinisekile. Ukuze kugwenywe iziteleka, abaphathi badinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana njalo, ukulalele izikhalo, nokuhlinzeka ngezimo zokusebenza ezithokozisayo. Ukukhuluma ngezimali ezivumelanayo nezimfuno zabasebenzi kungasiza kakhulu ekuvimbeleni iziteleka. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe ukhumbula iziteleka ezithile ezashintsha izinto? Mnu. Dlamini: Yebo, kuningi engikukhumbulayo. Isibonelo, iziteleka zabasebenzi ezavela eminyakeni edlule zashintsha isimo sokusebenza emikhakheni ethile, kuhlanganisa nezimboni ezinkulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinguquko ezibalulekile ezimisweni yokusebenza, njengokubuyekezwa kwemiholo kanye nezimo zokusebenza eziphephile. Umxhumanisi: Ucabanga ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zizoqhubeka nokuba yingxenye yesiko lethu? Mnu. Dlamini: Njengoba izimo zokusebenza zishintsha, ngiqiniseka ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zizohlala zikhona. Abasebenzi bazohlala bephikisa uma bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonishwa. Kuwo wonke umphakathi, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezwi elithwasa amalungelo abantu, ukuze sithole impumelelo eqhubekayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnumzane Dlamini, ngalesi sikhumbuzo esibalulekile. Kuyacaca ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi zibalulekile kakhulu futhi zidinga ukuqashelwa. Mnu. Dlamini: Ngiyabonga, ngiyavuma. Ngiyabonga ngokungicela ukuba lapha namhlanje.
Isahluko 1: Ukwakha Umqondo Wokubhikisha Komphakathi Ukuze uqale ukuhlela ukubhikisha komphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukubhikisha akuwona umcimbi owenziwa ngempela, kodwa uhlelo olwakhiwe ngokucophelela. Umqondo wokuqala ukuthi abantu abahlangene bahlanganyele futhi baveze izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukucacisa izinjongo, izizathu, kanye namasu okukhuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza. Isahluko 2: Ukuhlonza Izinkinga Nezizathu Umsebenzi wokuqala wokuziqhenya komphakathi uwukuhlola izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kungafaka izindaba zokungabi nendawo yokuhlala, izinkinga zezempilo, noma ukunganeliseki ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Bheka izizathu ezithinta imiphakathi, bheka ukuthi abantu baphila kanjani, futhi ucacise ukuthi kungani lezi zinkinga zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Abantu bazothokozela ukuzibandakanya uma bezwa ukuthi izinkinga zabo ziqondwa kahle. Isahluko 3: Ukuhlanganyela Nabanye Ngaphambi kokubhikisha, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uhlanganisa imiphakathi ehlukene. Lokhu kufaka izigaba ezahlukene zabantu, okuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, izizinda, nemibono ehlukene. Ukuze kubonakale ukuthi ubuhlakani bukhona, ungakha imihlangano yokuhlanganyela lapho abantu bezokwazi ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubamba amehlo ngamazwi ahlukene, futhi kukhuthaze umqondo wokubambisana. Isahluko 4: Ukudala Uhlelo Lokubhikisha Uhlelo lokubhikisha kufanele lube nolwazi olucacile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele ucacise usuku, indawo, nesikhathi sokubhikisha. Uhlelo kufanele lubhalele phansi izinjongo ezithile, futhi uthumele izincwadi zokumema abantu bonke. Ukudala uhlelo olubhaliwe kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphatha, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuphumelela. Isahluko 5: Ukushiwo Kwendlela Yokubhikisha Lapho uhlelo lukhona, kufanele ucacise indlela yokubhikisha. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuvota, noma ukwakha izikhumbuzo. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi yini okufanele ayenze, futhi uphinde uhlinzeke ngezinsiza ezifana nezikhumbuzo, izimpawu, nezinsizakalo zokuphepha. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uzizwa ephephile, futhi angabi sengozini. Isahluko 6: Ukuphatha Ukubhikisha Ngalesi sikhathi, ukuphatha ukubhikisha kubalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa ngobuchwepheshe bokuphatha, futhi unikeze abaholi abaqeqeshiwe ukuze baqondise abantu. Bamba imihlangano yokugxila ngaphambi kokubhikisha ukuze ubheke izinkinga ezisuka phakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, futhi abantu bazokwazi ukuhamba bezolile. Isahluko 7: Ukubika Nokuqhubeka Kwesimo Ngemuva kokubhikisha, kubalulekile ukubika nokuqhubeka nesimo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi udinga ukugcina abantu benolwazi ngezinyathelo ezithathwayo ngemuva kokubhikisha. Lokhu kungafaka izinyathelo zokuxhumana neziphathimandla, ukuxhumana nemidiya, nokugcina abantu bephakathi kwezindaba. Uma abantu bejwayele ukuhamba phambili, bazoba nokholo lokuthi izwi labo lizwa, futhi bazothokozela ukusiza. Isahluko 8: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuhlola imiphumela yokubhikisha. Lokhu kusebenza ngokubheka ukuthi izinjongo zafeziwe yini, futhi kuthiwani ngezinto ezitholakale. Bamba imihlangano yokuhlola ukuze uqonde ukuthi kwenzekeni, futhi uthole impendulo kumphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizayo, futhi kukhuthaze abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhiqizayo emiphakathini yabo. Isiphetho Ukubhikisha komphakathi kuyindlela yokubeka izinkinga zethu phambili, kodwa kudinga ukuhlela ngendlela efanele. Ngalezi zigaba, ungakha uhlelo olusebenzayo lokubhikisha, oluzokwenza umphakathi wakho ube namandla, futhi ube nesimo esiqinile sokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile. Qhubeka uhlanganise, uhlele, futhi uthathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izwi lomphakathi lizwa. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusiza ukwakha ikusasa elinokuthula nelinempilo.
Imali Yokufunda Emanyuvesi: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukufunda emanyuvesi sekuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngempumelelo yomuntu siqu kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Nokho, lezi zifundo zifaka izindleko ezinkulu, okwenza kube khona ingxoxo-mpikiswano mayelana nemali yokufunda. Ngabe le mali iyadingeka, noma ingabe iyisithiyo esikhulu kubafundi abasha? Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nemali yokufunda emanyuvesi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imali yokufunda iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni izikhungo zemfundo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Imali ethathwa emafundweni isiza ekwakheni izinsiza ezifanele, njengemithombo yokufunda, izikhungo zokucwaninga, kanye nezifundo ezihamba phambili. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu, okubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emikhakheni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imali yokufunda isiza ekukhokheni othisha abaqeqeshiwe, abahlinzeka ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi le mali yokufunda ingaba yinkinga enkulu kubafundi abaningi. Ezweni elinokuntuleka kwemali, abafundi abaningi bahlushwa ukungakwazi ukukhokhela izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni badinge ukuthola izikweletu ezinkulu, okungase kube nzima ukukhokha emuva. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abafundi baphazamiseke emsebenzini wabo, futhi kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngempela ngalesi sithiyo esikhulu esibhekene nabafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akuwona wonke umuntu ongena emanyuvesi. Abafundi abaningi bahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho ukufinyelela emanyuvesi kungaba nzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi kube nezinselelo ezinkulu, njengoba abanye abafundi bengenakukwazi ukuhamba emuva kwemali yokufunda. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise ukufinyelela emfundweni, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufunda. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kunezindlela ezithile zokunciphisa izindleko zokufunda. Izinhlelo zokuxhaswa ngemali, izikhwama zokufunda, kanye nezinhlelo zokubolekwa kwemali zingasiza abafundi abangenamali. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukufunda ngaphandle kokukhathazeka kakhulu ngempilo yabo yezezimali. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zemfundo zingase zisebenzise izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko, njengokuhlinzeka ngezifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, ezivumela abafundi ukuba bafunde besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindleko zokufunda zihlala zikhula. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze sithuthukise izinhlelo zokufunda. Izinhlelo zokuxhaswa ngemali kufanele zibe nezinga eliphezulu lokuhlinzeka, ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abafundi abaningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukufunda, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ngokuphetha, imali yokufunda emanyuvesi iyinkinga enkulu, kodwa futhi iyinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sithuthukise ukufinyelela emfundweni, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuthi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini yabo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhulume ngalezi zinkinga, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise imfundo emhlabeni jikelele.
Ingxenye 10 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kumininingwane (Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000), (okubizwa ngokuthi Umthetho lapha) waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002. Le ngxenye ivumela iKomidi Lezokuhlalisana Nabantu, phakathi nezinyanga eziyishumi nambili ngemva kokuthi le ngxenye iqale ukusebenza, ukuba yenze lo mhlahlandlela wemininingwane utholakale ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ngendlela elula nephumelelayo, evumela wonke umuntu odinga ukujolisa amalungelo atholakala kulomthetho ukuba akwenze lokho. Imigomo eyenziwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 92 yalomthetho kumele ilandelwe. IKomidi Lezokuhlalisana Nabantu kumele, uma kudingeka, ibuyekeze, ithuthukise, futhi iphinde iphumeze lo mhlahlandlela njalo eminyakeni emibili. Ikhophi yalomhlahlandlela kumele itholakale ku-inthanethi yeKomidi Lezokuhlalisana Nabantu ku-http://www.sahrc.org.za. Okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yalomhlahlandlela, ebhalwe ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ezisetshenziselwa izidingo zohulumeni bezifunda, kumele itholakale kuZOZONKE IZINDAWO zeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. KuZOZONKE IZINDAWO ZOHULUMENI, kumele kube nekhophi eyodwa, ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ezisetshenziselwa izidingo zohulumeni bezifunda, lapho le ndawo ikhona. Noma yimuphi umnyango kahulumeni noma izikhungo zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke noma ezingeni lesifunda ngaphansi kukahulumeni noma kwidolobha, njengokuthi: Isevisi Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika, Umnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, njll., ezisebenzisa amandla ayo noma zenza imisebenzi ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo noma ngaphansi kwemithetho yesifunda; noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umthetho; isibonelo: Umphenyi Jikelele Wezincwadi, Umvikeli Wabantu, njll. UMGQIBI JIKELELE: UKUXHUMANA KuZOZONKE IZINDAWO ZAMAPOSI, kumele kube nekhophi eyodwa yalomhlahlandlela, ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ezisetshenziselwa izidingo zohulumeni kulolo suku lapho le ndawo yeposi ikhona. Uma umuntu efuna ikhophi yengxenye ethile yedokhumenti ngaphandle kokufuna ukuhlola okuthile, phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza, bangakhokhiswa noma badinge ukukhokha imali ethile - lezi zinqwaba zikhuluma ngazo kumhlahlandlela wokuqala we-Annexure A yemigomo [njengoba kushicilelwe kuGazethi No. 23119 ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002 kuMthetho Wokubika No. R.187 owashicilelwa ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002]. 5.1 INHLANGANO YALOMTHETHO Inhloso yalomthetho ukuvumela ukufinyelela kwamalungelo ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo, ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwemibiko noma imininingwane, ethathwa noma ilawulwa nguHulumeni noma yimuphi umbiko othathwa noma ulawulwa omunye umuntu futhi odingekayo ukuqinisekisa noma ukuvikela noma yimaphi amalungelo. Inhloso ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okukhanya nokubambisana ezikhungweni zikahulumeni nakwezizimele, futhi ukukhuthaza kakhulu umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinyelela imibiko ukuze bavikele kahle amalungelo abo. Noma iyiphi imininingwane ebhaliwe ethokozisayo ingacelwa, noma ingabe yenziwe yiSevisi Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika noma umnyango kahulumeni. Lo mthetho usebenza lapho eminye imithetho esunguliwe ingavimbela noma ivimbe ukukhululwa kwemibiko futhi ingaphikisi nemigomo ngaphansi kwalomthetho. IZIZATHU ZOKUPHIKA UKUFIKILELA KUMININGWANE EPHATHWE Ngaphakathi kweSahluko 4 salomthetho, "Izizathu zokuvimbela ukufinyelela kumarekhodi," kubekwe isimo sokuthi ngaphansi kwalomthetho, isicelo sokufinyelela kumamininingwane aphathwe singamukelwa noma singenakwamukelwa. IZINHLANGANO ZABASEBENZI Izinhlangano zabantu abasebenzi zinegunya lokufinyelela noma yimuphi umamininingwane ophathwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 16 yeMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, 1995 (Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995). Lo mthetho awusebenzi uma inhlangano yabasebenzi icela imininingwane evikelwe ukuze isize umqashi mayelana nesikhalazo noma ukuqhubeka nokucubungula izinkinga (ukuthola leyo mininingwane evikelwe mahhala ngaphansi kweMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, 1995 (Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995). Uma inhlangano yabasebenzi icela ukuthola imininingwane kodwa ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa ukusiza umqashi ngesikhathi sokucubungula izinkinga noma ukusiza umqashi ophakamise isikhalazo, isicelo sizothunyelwa kumnyango ofanele, ongase ube ezingeni likazwelonke noma lesifunda, ophatha izindaba zabasebenzi kulolo suku noma ezingeni likazwelonke. Lo mnyango uzokhombisa ukuthi leyo mininingwane evikelwe ihambisana nokuxoxisana okuqhubekayo nenhlangano yabasebenzi. Uma kunjalo, ikhophi yeminininingwane evikelwe izonikezwa enhlangano mahhala ngaphansi kwengxenye 16 yeMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi. Ukukhululwa nokutholakala kweminininingwane evikelwe ngenhloso echazwe engxenyeni (i) kuhlelwe ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Noma iyiphi imininingwane evikelwe etholelwe ngendlela ephikisana nengxenye (a) ngeke yamukelwe njengobufakazi enkantolo noma ekwenzeni izindaba zomphakathi ngaphandle kokuthi ukungasetshenziswa kwaleyo mininingwane, ngokwayo, kungalimaza ukuphathwa kwezobulungiswa ngandlela thize. Inqubo yokubanga iqala lapho icala libhaliswa encwadini yeMnyango Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi. Ukubanga kwezindaba zomphakathi kuqala ngemva kokukhishwa kwezikhumbuzo noma ezinye izincwadi, kuhlanganise ngemva kokwaziswa kwaleyo miphakathi ethile edlula ngaphansi kweMnyango Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi ngokuhambisana nengxenye 3(1) yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nokusebenza komthetho ophikisana neMithetho Yezakhiwo Zikahulumeni, 2002 (Umthetho No. 40 ka-2002) kutholakele. Indlela ejwayelekile yokuyithola kumele ilandelwe, noma uma izikhumbuzo zisetshenziselwa ukubiza enkantolo, ukuthola indlela yokuthola leyo mininingwane evikelwe kulolo cala. Kumele kuqapheleke ukuthi ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwezikhumbuzo nezinye izincwadi noma izikhumbuzo mayelana nalomthetho, lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma isiphi isicelo sokufinyelela kumamininingwane evikelwe, noma ngabe isicelo senziwe ngenhloso yokubona umthetho ophatha izinqubo zomphakathi. IZINDAWO ZEVULANDLELA Qaphela ukuthi indlela yokuthola umbiko wezingozi ayifaki indlela yokuthola amarekhodi endaweni evulekile njengoba kuxoxwa kule ngxenye. Ukuthola umbiko wezingozi kuxoxwa ngasohlangothini lwengxenye 7. Lo mthetho awusebenzi. Isicelo sizovunywa futhi imvume izonikezwa mahhala (njengoba eminye imithetho ibhangele lokho). Lo mthetho awusebenzi uma sekuqalile ukubanga. Isicelo kumele senziwe ebhalwe phansi (incwadi) futhi yonke imininingwane yesicelo kumele icaciswe. Isicelo sizothunyelwa kumphakathi ophakanyisiwe kanye ne-rekh
Imemorandamu Yomthetho 136 yeMithetho Yesifunda yaseGauteng. Incazelo entsha ye "isitshalo" ifakiwe ukuze ifake indawo esetshenziselwa imisebenzi ehambisana ngqo nokusebenza nokuphathwa kohlelo lwezitimela kanye nokuhamba kwabagibeli abafika nabephuma esiteshini. Isiteshi sizofaka izindawo zokupaka, ama-garage okupaka, izindawo zokulahla nokuphatha abagibeli, izimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi, kanye nezinsiza ezifana nalokho. Kuphakanyiswe kakhulu ngokuvumelana nezikhulu zomphakathi ezithintekayo ngemva kokuxoxisana ukuthi ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okuthile endaweni yesiteshi akufanele kulawulwe yizinhlelo zokwakha edolobheni futhi akufanele kube ngaphansi komthetho, okungavimbela izinqubo ezithatha isikhathi eside ekushintsheni izinhlelo zokwakha edolobheni. Lokhu kufaka imisebenzi ethile yezezimali ehambisana ngqo nokuphathwa kahle kwabagibeli, kuhlanganise nokukhangisa, ukuthengiswa kokudla neziphuzo, amaphephandaba nezincwadi, imishini yokuthengisa ethengisa izinto ezithengwe, izingcingo zomphakathi, kanye nemishini yokubhanga (lezo ezamukela amakhadi futhi zikhokhe imali). Nokho, kubhekwa ukuthi ezindaweni eziningi, kungase kube nesidingo semisebenzi yezezimali ezindaweni eziseduze nesiteshi. Njengoba le misebenzi yezezimali ingase ithinte izindawo eziseduze neziteshi futhi ingase iphinde ithinte isakhiwo sedolobha, kunesidingo sokuthi amalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba ahambisane nokusetshenziswa kwawo kwezezimali alawulwe uhlelo olusebenzayo ngaphakathi komkhakha wezokwakha edolobheni. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba nomthelela emphakathini walesi sikhathi, kanye nesinqumo somkhandlu, ngaphambi kokuthi la malungelo anikezwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokwakha yalesi sikhathi. Le misebenzi izokwenziwa esiteshini, futhi kufanele yenziwe ngokuhambisana namalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba endaweni kanye nemithetho yokwakha efanele. Ngokuphathelene nokukhuluma ngendlela entsha yesifunda yomgwaqo nezitimela, ingxenye 4 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha, 2000 (Umthetho No. 3 ka-2000) ibhekisela ezinqubweni ezimbili ezishintshashintshayo lapho umphathi wehhovisi kufanele akhiphe isinqumo esingase sithinte kahle noma kabi amalungelo omphakathi, ngokukhuluma nje ngocwaningo lomphakathi noma inqubo yokuphendula. Ingxenye 6 ekhona ikhetha inqubo yokubuyekezwa komphakathi. Le nqubo ingaba nenkinga futhi ithathe isikhathi eside futhi ingase iphinde ikopishe isidingo solwazi olufanele ekwenzeni izinqumo okukhulunywe ngakho kahle ngokuhambisana nenqubo ethinta ukuhlola indawo kanye nebika elibhekiwe engxenyeni 6(a) yeMthetho oyinhloko. Ngalezi zimo, inqubo yokwazisa nokuphendula njengoba kuboniswe engxenyeni 4 yeMthetho 3 ka-2000 izosebenza futhi izosebenza kahle uma umbiko wendawo usuhlanganisiwe, kuyilapho inqubo yokubuyekezwa komphakathi ingagcinwa kulokhu lapho izinkinga zivele ngqo eningizimu yokwazisa kanye nemibiko emibili eminye, engase idinge ukubuyekezwa nokuphendula okwengeziwe. Ngakho-ke, ingxenye 6 iyashintshwa ukuze isetshenziswe inqubo yokwazisa nokuphendula ukuze i-MEC yenze isinqumo, futhi isetshenziswe kuphela enezinkinga ezithile. Ngakho-ke, ubulungiswa bokuphatha obufinyelelwe buphakeme kunalokho okudingekayo nguMthetho 3 ka-2000 ngokuthi kokubili izinqubo zilandelwa. Umthetho okhona awuqondi kahle ngokuphelele isivumelwano okumele senziwe nguNgqongqoshe mayelana nokwakha, ukwakha, ukusebenza, ukuphatha, nokubhekelela uhlelo lweGautrain Rapid Rail Link oluphakanyisiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-MEC igunyazwe, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho, ukuqedela izivumelwano ezifana nesivumelwano esikhona sokwakha ngokuhambisana ne-MEC enesibopho sezimali. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa ngumthengisi ophumelelayo noma i-MEC egameni lakhe, okwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe amandla nokusetshenziswa kwawo ezingeni lokuzimela nakhulu. Ukusetshenziswa kwala mandla uma kunikezwa ukuze kuzuze umphakathi kungase kuphinde kube nezithiyo noma kuthinteke ekupheleni kwezivumelwano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kube nesidingo sokwakha ingxenye ebhekisela ekudlulisweni kwamalungelo phezu komhlaba womunye noma amalungelo abanjwe yi-MEC adluliselwa kumthengisi ophumelelayo. Amalungelo phezu komhlaba womunye kanye namalungelo abantu awakwazi ukusetshenziswa ngokomthetho noma adluliselwe kumuntu wesithathu, futhi kube nesidingo sokuhleleka okukhuluma ngqo ngalokhu. Enye inhloso yeBhili ukuhlela isimo mayelana nezilinganiso zezakhiwo ezithathwayo. Izilinganiso ezimbili zokuqala zanikwa ngoba ngasikhathi sinye kungathatha isikhathi eside phakathi kwesigaba sokunquma izindlela kanye nesigaba sokuqala sokwakha. Nokho, ukuhlola kwesibili akudingekile uma lezi zilinganiso ezimbili kufanele zenzeke ngasikhathi sinye noma ngesikhathi esifanayo, njengoba kuzoba khona ukuhlola kwemigwaqo yeRapid Rail Link. Ngakho-ke, iBhili iyashintsha ingxenye 8(b) yeMthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akudingeki ukuhlola indawo uma umphakathi onekhono lokwenza lo msebenzi ubona ukuthi akudingekile. Ezinye izinguquko ezincane ezenziwe ngalolu shintsho zenziwe kule ngxenye. Ingxenye 5 yeBhili iyashintsha ingxenye 10 yeMthetho ukuze ilungiselele ukuhambisana nengxenye entsha 6. Ingxenye 7 yeBhili iyashintsha ingxenye 51 yeMthetho ukuze ilungise iphutha elenzekile ekubhaleni. Ingxenye 8 yeBhili iletha ingxenye entsha 51A kuMthetho ukuze ibhekisele ezivumelwaneni ezingaqedwa zokwakha, ukwesekwa kwezimali, ukusebenza, ukuphatha, ukulawula, nokubhekelela uhlelo lwezindlela nezitimela eziphakanyisiwe, njengoba kukhulunywe ngenhla, ngokuhambisana noNgqongqoshe wesifunda onobulungiswa bezimali. Ingxenye 9 yeBhili inikeza isihloko esifushane.
Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngemva Kwamaholide Umbuzo: Yini ezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo? Impendulo: Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibandakanya izinhlelo ezithile ezihlinzekwa ukuze ziphendule ezimweni eziphuthumayo, njengezimo zokwelashwa, ukulungiswa kwezimo zokuhlala, nokusiza uma kwenzeka izingozi. Zisiza abantu ukuba baphume ezimeni ezinzima futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu. Umbuzo: Kungani izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile ngezikhathi zamaholide? Impendulo: Ngemva kwamaholide, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela kalula ngenxa yokunyakaza kwabantu, izivakashi eziningi, kanye nokwanda kokusebenza ezindaweni zokuphumula. Ukuthola usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo kumele kube okusheshayo futhi kube nethezekile, ukuze kuqedwe noma yiziphi izinkinga ezingase zivele. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinsizakalo ezitholakala ngezikhathi zamaholide? Impendulo: Izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukwelapha: Izibhedlela zihlala zikhona ukuze zinikeze usizo lwezempilo oluphuthumayo, njengezimo zokulimala noma ukugula. 2. Ukuthutha: Izimoto eziphuthumayo, njengezithuthi zezimo ezimbi, zisebenza kakhulu ukuze zisize kulabo abadinga usizo ngokushesha. 3. Izinsizakalo zokuphepha: Amakomidi aphephile anendawo ezihlinzeka ngokuphepha ezindaweni zamasiko nezokuphumula, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Umbuzo: Kuthiwani uma kwenzeka ingozi ngesikhathi samaholide? Impendulo: Uma kwenzeka ingozi, kubalulekile ukugcina ukubekezela. Xhumana nezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo bese ubika isimanga. Uma ungabaza, ungafonela inombolo yokuphuthumayo ukuze uthole usizo futhi uqinisekise ukuba uthola usizo lwezempilo uma kudingeka. Umbuzo: Yini okufanele uyenze ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha kwezakhamuzi ezibambene nezimo eziphuthumayo? Impendulo: Ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha, lazima ukuba: 1. Uqwashiswe: Thola izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezitholakalayo endaweni yakho. 2. Ube nezinye izinqumo: Faka izinhlelo eziphuthumayo, okubandakanya izixhumanisi lezi zinsizakalo. 3. Hlonipha imithetho: Landela imithetho nemigomo yokuphepha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi zabantu. Umbuzo: Ingabe kukhona ubungozi bokungatholi usizo ngesikhathi samaholide? Impendulo: Yebo, impela. Ngenxa yokwanda kwezimoto zabavakashi, izinkinga zingavela, okuholela ekunciphiseni ithuba lokuthola usizo oluphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baqaphele, baqinisekise ukuthi baqonda indlela yokufinyelela usizo lapho kudingeka. Umbuzo: Yiziphi izindlela zokubika izimo eziphuthumayo? Impendulo: Izindawo eziningi zinezindlela ezahlukene zokubika izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kungafaka: - Ucingo oluya kwi-ambulensi noma kwi-911, - Izinhlelo zokubika ezisebenzisa amaphoyisa, - Ukuthumela izizathu eziphuthumayo kumakhalekhukhwini aphakathi, noma - Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezikhethekile zokubika ezitholakalayo ku-inthanethi. Umbuzo: Kuthiwani ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ezithuthukile ezikhona? Impendulo: Izinsizakalo zezempilo ezithuthukile, njengezinhlelo zokwelashwa okuphuthumayo, zisebenzisana nezinye iziqu zezikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola usizo bahlala behluleka ezindaweni eziyingozi. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana obuphuthumayo, izibhedlela ezihlinzekayo, nezinye izizindalwazi. Umbuzo: Uxhumano lwabantu kulezi zinsizakalo lusemqoka kangaka? Impendulo: Ngokwenyuka kwezinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo, uxhumano phakathi kwezakhamuzi nezinsizakalo lukhombisa ukwakha umphakathi ofunda njalonje, ukusiza ngempumelelo ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Uxhumano lwenzakalo lungakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imithetho yokuphepha nohlelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola usizo bahlale bephila ngokushesha. Umbuzo: Yini okufanele uyiqaphele uma uhamba ngezikhathi zamaholide? Impendulo: Uma uhamba, qaphela: - Ukulawula izimo, - Qiniseka ukuthi uthola izinsiza eziphuthumayo endaweni, - Ungavuli izinkinga ezinkulu kulabo abavakasha, - Futhi uhlale uxhumene nabangane nomndeni ukuze benze izinqumo ezihamba kahle uma kwenzeka izimo eziphuthumayo. Isiphetho: Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu ngezikhathi zamaholide. Kungumsebenzi wethu wonke ukujabulisa uhambo lwethu ngokuqaphela izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze uma zingaveli, sibe nolwazi nolwazi lokuthi sizophenduka kanjani. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi wethu ube yindawo esebenza kahle, ephephile, nenobungane.
Osomabhizinisi: Iphrofayela Yomuntu Uhlelo lwezomnotho luhlala luhamba phambili ngenxa yosomabhizinisi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Osomabhizinisi, noma osomabhizinisi, bangabantu abahlakaniphile, abanesibindi, futhi abathanda ukuthatha izingozi. Bahlala bephusha imingcele, befuna izixazululo ezintsha nezindlela zokwenza izinto, futhi bangabavulindlela bezinguquko emiphakathini yabo. I. Isizinda Somuntu Ngokwesiko, osomabhizinisi bahlala bephuma ezimpilweni ezihlukahlukene. Abanye baphakathi kwemindeni emikhulu, lapho bezifundisa khona ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha, kanti abanye baphuma ezimweni ezinzima, lapho behluleka khona ukuthola amathuba. UThandi Nkosi, osomabhizinisi ophumelelayo, ungumzekelo omuhle. UThandi wazalwa edolobheni elincane eMpumalanga, lapho ababephila khona impilo elula. Uthando lwakhe lokwenza izinto lwalukhula kusukela ebuncaneni, lapho eqala khona ukuthengisa izithelo ezincane emgwaqweni. II. Ukuqala Kwezimali Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThandi wathola umsebenzi emnyangweni wezokuphatha, kodwa akazange abone imisebenzi yakhe iyamthokozisa. Ngakho, wathola ukuthi kufanele azame ukuvula ibhizinisi lakhe. Ngemali encane ayitholile, waqala ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo yokudla enempilo, efaka phakathi ama-smoothies nezibiliboco ezilula. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bakhe bokumaketha bamsiza ukuba abone amathuba amasha, futhi waqala ukwakha igama elihle emiphakathini. III. Ukukhula Kwebhizinisi Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, uThandi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngamasu okuphatha. Waqasha othisha abanolwazi ukuze bamfundise ngamasu ahlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza, ukumaketha, nokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kwamsiza ukuba akhe ibhizinisi eliqinile, elinokuthenjwa. UThandi waqhubeka nokwandisa imikhiqizo yakhe, wengeza iziphuzo ezihlukahlukene, futhi waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano namakhasimende. IV. Ukubambisana Nezinye Izinhlangano UThandi akazange agxile kuphela ebhizinisini lakhe. Waqonda ukubaluleka kokubambisana nezinye izinkampani. Waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano namafemu amancane, abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, ukuze benze imikhiqizo yabo ibe nekhwalithi ephezulu. Lokhu kubambisana kwaholela ekwandeni komkhiqizo wakhe, futhi waqala ukuthola izivakashi ezivela kwamanye amazwe. V. Ukuphendula Emiphakathini UThandi ubelokhu eqaphela ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe alihlinzeki kuphela ngemali, kodwa futhi linomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Waqala imikhankaso yokubuyisela emiphakathini, ethuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa izingane, nokuxhasa abalimi bendawo. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi ibhizinisi lakhe libe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. VI. Ukuqhamuka Kwezinkinga Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, uThandi ubhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana, izinguquko ezimakethe, kanye nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zaba yizithiyo. Nokho, uThandi akazange ayekele. Waqhubeka efunda, efuna izixazululo, futhi ehlola izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha ibhizinisi lakhe. Lokhu kumenza waba ngusomabhizinisi ophumelelayo, owaziwa ngokuqonda okukhulu kwezomnotho. VII. Iziphakamiso Zokuphumelela UThandi ufunde izifundo eziningi ngesikhathi sokwakha ibhizinisi lakhe. Ubonisa ukubaluleka kokuba nesibindi, futhi akekho owaziyo ukuthi ukuphumelela kudinga isikhathi, ukuzikhandla, nokuzinikela. Uthanda ukusho ukuthi "ukuphumelela akukhona ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokufunda." UThandi ubonisa ukuthi osomabhizinisi bangaba yizikhumbuzo ezinhle zomsebenzi, umdlandla, nokuzinikela. VIII. Ikusasa Elikhanyayo Namuhla, uThandi Nkosi ungumholi emkhakheni wezokudla, futhi ibhizinisi lakhe selikhule laba nezinhlaka eziningi. Ubuye abambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. UThandi uyazi ukuthi ikusasa lamasiko amasha lincike ezinqubweni ezithathwa namuhla, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela zokwenza ibhizinisi eliqhubekayo. UThandi Nkosi ungumzekelo omuhle wosomabhizinisi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, abathanda ukwakha, futhi abavula amathuba. Ubonisa ukuthi ngeqhaza, umdlandla, kanye nesibindi, konke kungenzeka. Ukuphumelela kwakhe akugcini nje ekwenzeni imali, kodwa kuphinde kube yindlela yokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abaseduze kwakhe. UThandi uyisibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangaba yizikhumbuzo ezinhle, futhi umphakathi udinga abantu abanjengaye ukuze ube ngcono.
Ukukhathala Kwaphezulu Kwabahlengikazi E-Helathcare Sector Isingeniso Ezimeni eziningi, abahlengikazi bavelaphiwa njengenhlangano yokugcina impilo, kodwa eminyakeni edlule, ubunzima obandayo ababhekana nabo bufake impilo nokusebenza kwabo engcupheni. Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi, okubangelwa izimo ezihlukahlukene, sekuthathe isikhala esikhulu ezinkulumweni zomphakathi, okukhombisa iziphumo ezinzima emsebenzini wabo nasempilweni yabo. Ukukhathala Kwamazinga Aphezulu Ngokwezifundo ezenziwa emikhakheni ehlukene, kubonakala ukuthi abahlengikazi bahlupheka ngokukhathala okukhulu ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Kwesinye isikhathi, ukulwa namazinga kokuphila, ukunqoba ubuningi bomsebenzi, kanye nezinsuku zokusebenza ezide, kudala ukukhathala okukhulu ezingqondweni nasemzimbeni. Lokhu kudala izimo zengqondo ezinzima ezifana nokuphazamiseka kwemizwa nokukhathala komqondo. Imiphumela Emibi KweZempilo Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi kusebenza kakhudlwana, okukhombisa imiphumela emibi ezimweni zempilo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abahlengikazi baqhubeke ngesimo esibi sanoma yiliphi ibhodi lokwelapha, yize behamba phambili ekutholeni izixazululo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, uma abahlengikazi behlupheka, imiphumela ibalulekile kubaguli, okwenza ukuthi inkinga ikhokhelwe ngempilo yomphakathi. Izizathu Zokukhathala Izizathu ezibanjwe zabahlengikazi zihlanganisa ukungabi namathuba okuphucula izimo zokusebenza, ukuncipha kwezinsiza, kanye nokungahleleki kwezinsizakusebenza. Ukwenza kwesimo sokusebenza kube nzima emithonjeni yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakusebenza zezeMpilo ngesikhathi esiningi sokukhathala esivela kumakhosikazi nabadali bezinqubomgomo. Isixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuphumelele ukulungiswa kwalesi simo, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabaphathi bezempilo benze izinyathelo ezinqala. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubahlengikazi, ukwakha izikhathi zokuphumula ezanele, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinsiza kusebenza zempilo, kungasiza ekwehliseni ukukhathala. Ukusebeni Komphakathi Umphakathi nawo udinga ukwakha isimo sokusebenzisana. Kuyaqondakala ukuthi uma abahlengikazi bethola ukusekelwa okuvamile, kuzothuthukisa impilo yabo kanye nezinga lokusebenza. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola ezinhloko ezithuthukisiwe nezokwelapha. Isiphetho Ukukhathala kwabahlengikazi akuyona nje inkinga yomsebenzi, kodwa iyinkinga ebucayi esithinta bonke abantu.
