Izenzo kufanele zenziwe ukuze kuncishiswe lesi simo futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlengikazi banempilo enhle, ukuze baqhubekele phambili bezinikele ekwelapheni umphakathi. Uhlelo lwezempilo kumele lube nemigomo yokuphila esebenzile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yezeMpilo nezinkonzo zezenhlalakahle.
Izindaba Zomphakathi: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwabantu Bendawo Ngomhlaka 15 Kwananga, emzini ohloniphekile waseMpoqweni, kubanjwe umcimbi okhethiwe owawuhloselwe ukuhlanganisa abantu bendawo. Umcimbi lo, obizwa ngokuthi “Usuku Lwabantu Bendawo,” wawuhanjiswa ngezinsuku ezithile ezedlule njengoba izakhamuzi zakha umqondo wokubambisana ukuze ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwazo. Usuku lwaluhlelwe kahle, futhi ngosuku lokuqala, izimpahla zendawo zabe seziqhamuka ezitolo ezincane nezindawo zokudla, lapho izakhamuzi zazihanjiswa khona ukudla okumangalisayo nempahla yokuthula. Kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezicishe zidalwe abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, benamalungelo azimele ukufaka isandla kumphakathi. Umkhankaso wokuqala wathinta abancane, abasha, nabadala, bonke belindele ukuxoxa, ukuhlekisana, nempilo yabo yangempela. Imidlaliso ibihlelwe kahle phambi kwesikhumbuzo esikhulu senza sibe nesithombe esihle sokuhlangana. Umdlalo wezenzo zempilo zasekhaya, owayehlanganisa ukudlala imidlalo yasendaweni, wakhuluma kakhulu kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Abantu babegubha umoya wezokuhlala, bebumbene, baphinde bazwakalise ukwaziswa okuhle ngemikhosi nezenzakalo ezithembekile ezazithuthukisa umphakathi. Kubonakala ukuthi wonke umuntu uzihlanganisa ngendlela eyayingenza kube nokuhlangana okuhle. Phakathi nemidlalo, abasha benza amaqembu, benza imiqhudelwano yokudansa neyekhono lokudlala, kwathi phakathi kwalokhu, bekukhuluma ngenhlonipho nezifundo ezitholwa empilweni. Abanakekeli bezemidlalo baphinde babe khona, babonisa abantu indlela yokuhlala behlakaniphile nohlanga. Umoya wokugcina umphakathi uqinisekiswe ngezithako zemvelo ezinhle, bathokozele ubuhle bezempilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkulumo ezinkulu ezivela kubantu abadumile bendawo abakhuluma ngempumelelo yabo emakhaya. Lezi zinkulumo zazihambisana nezindaba ezihambisanayo nezinhle ezithinta umphakathi. Abaziqhenyi bamagugu ezakhamizi, baxoxa ngomthelela wokuhlangana nemiphakathi, baveza indlela lezi zindawo zikwazi ukwenzela umphakathi ukuze uthuthuke. Abantu babethokozisa lapho bebhala izincwadi ezincane, behlanganyela imicabango nezindaba zabo, kuthi futhi bakhulume ngezifiso zabo, izinkinga nezinhloso ezifanele uhulumeni. Usuku Lwabantu Bendawo lwaphumelela ngokuvezwa ngazo zonke izindlela, lapho izakhamuzi zigcwele uthando, umoya wokubambisana, kanye nezinhloso ezilungile. Abavakashi, abathintekayo, nabanye bezicelo bahlala benethuba lokuxoxa, behlangana, benza ubungani obusha. Umcimbi ube yindlela yokwakha imizwelo emisha, kuhlanganiswa izizukulwane ezahlukene, kungaholela ekwakheni umuzwa wokuba yinto eyodwa. Umphakathi ubonese uthando nolwazimagama phakathi kwalabo abavakashele emcimbini. Uhlobo lokuxhumana olubonakalayo phakathi kwezizukulwane lwenze ukuba izinsuku zibe nezinkumbulo ezihamba phambili, abantu beyaqhubeka bekhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokuba kanye. Izindaba zomphakathi zazivuma ukukhipha izithombe ezinhle, okwakwenza kube necala lamakhosazane, nobungani obungapheli. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubuyisela izinhlelo ezinhle ezazizungeze uMpoqweni, uqinisekisa ukuthi ukuqhubeka kokubambisana nemisebenzi yokukhuthazelela kuyavela endaweni. Lokhu kungahlala kuqhubeka kuzo zonke izinsuku, njengoba umphakathi uvuselela izinkumbulo ezintsha, unomphela uvame ukuphindaphinda lawo mASIZO ayathokozisa, engalahli isithunzi sokuhlangana. Umoya opholile uhlala ukhululekile, ubonisa ukuthi izindaba zomphakathi ezihlangene zihlala zinqoba, ziveza ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, nohlelo olwaziyo ukudala ikhaya. Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwabantu Bendawo ubukhona, futhi kube yimpumelelo engapheli. Ngamunye wethu ungumgibeli kulesi siqalo esisha, lapho izindaba zomphakathi ziqhubeka zihluma, zigqugquzela izimo ezinhle, futhi zakha ikusasa eliqhakazile emiphakathini yethu.
Ilayisensi ye-television inika umuntu igunya lokuthenga ithelevishini eyodwa ukuze abuke ithelevishini. Uma uthenga ilayisensi ye-television okokuqala, ukhokha imali ephelele yonyaka engu-R225. Imali ye-licence esheshayo kwabanye abantu ingu-R65 ngonyaka. Noma ubani oneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-70 noma odla izinsuku, ongahlali nabantu abasebenzayo noma ongancikile kubo, ukhululekile. Izinhlangano zidinga ilayisensi ye-television nganye ithelevishini abayithengile enhlanganweni. Imizi idinga ilayisensi eyodwa ukuze zonke ithelevishini ezikhona emzini. Umthengisi we-television kufanele azise amakhasimende ukuthi awakwazi ukuthenga ithelevishini ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi belayisensi ye-television. Abafuna ukuthenga ithelevishini bangafaka izicelo zelayisensi ehhovisi leposi eliseduzane, noma bacele umthengisi ukuthi abathengele ilayisensi. Ilayisensi ivuselelwa minyaka yonke. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela ku-website www.tvlic.co. Faka isicelo ehhovisi leposi eliseduzane noma nomthengisi ogunyaziwe ukukhipha ama-licences e-TV. Ungafaka isicelo ku-inthanethi endaweni: www.tvlic.co. Kungathatha amahora ambalwa.
UMnyango wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi nobuchwepheshe wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1994 wabe usahlukaniswa uMnyango wezobuciko nesiko noMnyango wesayensi nobuchwepheshe ngonyaka ka-2002. Inhloso yalolu suku iwukuchaza izakhiwo nemisebenzi yoMnyango nokuchaza izinhlelo zokugcina amarekhodi ukuze kuhambisane nezinhloso ze-PAIA. Kubandakanya izaziso ezihlinzekwe ngokuhambisana nezinsika ezingu-22 no-54 mayelana nezindleko okufanele zikhokhwe mayelana nezicelo zokufinyelela; kanye nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba sika-92 soMthetho. Umhlahlandlela ungatholakala eKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi athile agcinwe ngummnyango kufanele kucelwe kumphathi wezokwazi ngokulandela izinqubo ezichazwe ezinsikeni ezingu-17 kuya ku-32 zoMthetho. Bheka ulwazi lokuxhumana nomphathi wezokwazi esigabeni sika-3. Amafomu okucela abekwe kufanele atholwe ehhovisi leMphathi wezokwazi loMnyango wezobuciko nesiko. Bheka esigabeni sika-3. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi angahlolwa kunikezwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ezifana nezikhungo zokufunda ngaphansi kokuhlola kwamalungu abasebenzi, angahlinzeka ngokuqondisa ekukhululeni nasekufakeni ulwazi kumarekhodi nasekuvikelweni kokuqukethwe komlando. Inhloso yoMnyango iwukukhuthaza nokugcina amasiko aseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubumbano nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe nokwandiswe ubuciko nesiko eNingizimu Afrika nokuhola igunya layo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuze kukhuthazwe futhi kwandiswe izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseNingizimu Afrika nokwandiswa kwezinhlobonhlobo zezilimi zezwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe amathuba omnotho nezinye izinkambo ezihlobene nobuciko nesiko laseNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlanganyela kanye nobudlelwano obunenzuzo, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisekiswe ukwesekwa komkhakha. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe nokubhekwa kokusetshenziswa kwemigomo, imithetho, nezinhlelo ezicacile zokukhombisa, ukuvikela, nokukhuthaza ifa lesizwe. Ukuze kugcinwe, kusekelwe, futhi kuthuthukiswe izinsiza zezakhiwo zomlando, kanye nezihlobene nomsebenzi nolwazi lwezwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela kulezi zinsiza ngokuphelele nangokukhululekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekutholeni nasezincwadini ezihlobene nezakhiwo zomlando mayelana nezindleko ezibekwe ohlwini lwamanani olushicilelwe. Ezinye izinsiza zinikezwa ngummnyango wezokuphatha kuphela, isibonelo, izinsiza zokuphatha amarekhodi, ukuqeqeshwa kwabaphathi bamarekhodi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezakhiwo zomlando. Amarekhodi omphakathi agcinwe ngababheki isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka engama-20. Amarekhodi omphakathi aqhubekayo kanye namarekhodi okungcwaba kwabashonile. Izibalo zonyaka zoMnyango unyaka nonyaka. Amadokhumenti okuphatha amarekhodi atholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NARS.
Le mhlahlandlela ubhalwe ngenhloso yokuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Akukhona ukuhlinzeka ngesikhundla seMthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993. Inhloso eyinhloko yale mhlahlandlela ukusho lo mthetho ngezindlela ezilula, usebenzisa ulimi oluqondile ukuze kucaciswe kubo bonke abantu abathintekayo empilweni nasekuphepheni endaweni yokusebenza lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wababheki bezempilo nokuphepha eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi uchazwe. Amalungelo nezibopho zabasebenzi, njengoba kuchazwe emthethweni, ahlaziywa. Imisebenzi nezibopho zabaphathi, abakhiqizi, abaqashi, abangenisi, abahlinzeki, nabathengisi ekuqinisekiseni impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi nakho kugqanyisiwe. Ekugcineni, imisebenzi yabalobi bezempilo nokuphepha kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo icaciswa. Umthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 udinga ukuthi umqashi aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile, ingenazo izingozi ezimpilweni zabasebenzi, futhi ugcizelela ukuthi umqashi kufanele enze lokhu ngezinga elingcono kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ayinazo izinto eziyingozi, ezifana nebenzene, izidakamizwa, nezinto eziyingozi, imishini, nezindlela zokusebenza ezingaphephile. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi kufanele axwayise abasebenzi ngalezi zingozi, indlela yokuzigwema, ukusebenza ngokuphepha, futhi enze izinyathelo zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi akukhona kuphela umqashi onenhloso yokufeza le msebenzi wezempilo nokuphepha. Umthetho ususelwa kumgomo wokuthi izingozi endaweni yokusebenza kufanele zixazululwe ngokwakha umgudu wokuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi nomqashi. Abasebenzi nabaphathi kufanele babelane ngalesi sabelo sokuphepha nempilo endaweni yokusebenza. Bobabili kufanele bahlaziye izingozi ezingaba khona futhi baphakamise izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze benze indawo yokusebenza iphephile. Ngale ndlela, umqashi nabasebenzi basebenza ndawonye ezinhlelweni lapho ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha bengahlola njalo indawo yokusebenza futhi banikeze imibiko kwiKomidi Lezempilo Nokuphepha. Le komidi ingase iphakamise iziphakamiso kumqashi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le sistimu isebenza kahle, bonke abasebenzi kufanele bazi amalungelo nezibopho zabo njengoba kushiwo emthethweni. Kukhona izinhlinzeko eziningi ezikhuluma ngezihloko ezithile ezihlanganiswe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Umthetho noma izinhlinzeko zitholakala kwiHhovisi Lezokuphrinta, noma kwiGazethi noma ezikhiqizwe abanye abashicileli. Umthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi uphathwa yiSikhungo Esikhulu Sezempilo Nokuphepha ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi, amahhovisi asunguliwe kuzo zonke izifunda. Okwamanje, ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza kanye nalabo abakhokhelwe ezifundeni benza ukuhlola nokuhlola lapho kudingeka khona ezindaweni zokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuhlola ziqhutshwa ngokulandela izinkomba ezithile esingazibona; ukuvela kwezinto eziyingozi, ukusetshenziswa kwebenzene lapho imikhiqizo iphumelelwa, noma ezindaweni lapho imishini eyingozi ikhona. Kukhona nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezingenziwa ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke, ezifana nezicelo ezenziwe, izikhalazo zabasebenzi, abaqashi, noma amalungu omphakathi. Lezi zikhalazo noma izicelo zigcinwa zifihliwe. Uma umbhali ethola okuthile okungaba yingozi noma okungenzeka kube yingozi endaweni yokusebenza, angabeka imiqathango ethile kumqashi. Ezimeni ezikhombisa ingozi engaba khona, umbhali angavimbela isenzo, inqubo, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini ngokukhishwa kwesaziso esifanele ukuze kuvinjwe. Akekho umuntu ovunyelwe ukuhoxisa ukubaluleka kwalolo xwayiso; umlayezo ophumelele kufanele ulandelwe ngokushesha. Uma kukhona umthetho othile ophuliwe, umbhali angakhupha isaziso sokuphulwa kumabasebenzi noma kumqashi. Ukuphula umthetho kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuphathwa ngokushesha. Uma inqubo ethile iphuliwe, umqashi anganikezwa ithuba lokulungisa iphutha phakathi nesikhathi esithile, ngokuvamile izinsuku eziyi-60. Uma umbhali ethola ukuthi izimo zempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi azaneliseki, umbhali angalayisha umqashi ukuba athuthukise le ndawo. Isaziso sokuthuthukisa sikhishwa kumqashi, sichaza indlela elindelekile yokuthuthukisa okungamukeleki kumbhali. Ukuze kubhekwane kakhulu, bavunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo noma izakhiwo lapho imishini, izinto eziyingozi, noma lapho zisetshenziswa khona, futhi banephuzu lokubuza imibuzo nokucela abantu abathile ukuba bavele phambi kwabo. Umphakathi ungacela noma yiziphi imibhalo ukuba izethule, ahlolisise, futhi enze amakopi yale mibhalo, futhi afune ukucaciswa ngokuqukethwe kwabo. Umphakathi ungahlola isimo noma impahla, athathe amasampula ale nto, noma abambe impahla engase ibe ubufakazi. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthini ngokuqinisekisa ukuphepha nendawo engaphephile emsebenzini nasezimpilweni zabasebenzi? Umqashi kufanele agcine imishini nezinsiza zokusebenza ezifanele, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo ezidingekayo ukuze umsebenzi wenziwe, esimweni esingaphazamisi impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imishini nezinsiza zokuphepha, umqashi kufanele kuqala akhiphe noma akhiphe noma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zibe nomthelela omubi empilweni nasekuphepheni kwabasebenzi. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi angasebenzisa izinsiza zokuvikela nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngabasebenzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvikela impilo nokuphepha ezingozeni ezingase zivele ekukhiqizeni, ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ekusetshenzisweni, ekuphathweni, ekugcinweni, noma ekuthuthweni kwemikhiqizo noma izinto. Ngamanye amazwi, noma yini engase ibonakale kumsebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, ukuqeqesha, nokuphatha abasebenzi kuqinisekiswe njengokuhlangenwe nakho kwabo emsebenzini. Ngamanye amazwi, lokho okufanele bakwenze nokuthi yini okufanele bangayenzi. Akekho umuntu ovunyelwe ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphambi kokuthatha zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abaphansi komqashi balandela umthetho futhi baphoqelelwe ukuthatha izindlela ezifanele zokugwema izingozi ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umgomo wokuphepha nempilo enhle. Ukuqonda ukuthi umsebenzi nemishini zisetshenziswa umuntu ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu oqeqeshiwe kulolo msebenzi noma imishini ukuze aqonde izingozi ezihambisana nalolo msebenzi noma imishini. Lo msebenzi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi imizamo yokuvikela iyalandelwa futhi igcinwa. Bonke abasebenzi banelungelo lokwaziswa. Abaphathi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi futhi baqonde ngokuphelele izingozi zempilo nokuphepha ezihambisana nomsebenzi ngamunye abawenzayo, imikhiqizo ekhiqizwayo, ephumelelwayo, egcinwayo, ephathwayo, noma ethuthwayo, kanye nemishini noma amathuluzi asetshenziswayo. Umqashi kufanele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane mayelana nemizamo
Umphikisi omkhulu onezinkinga ezinkulu kubalimi abasha yizihlahla - ngakho-ke sihlose ukuwulwa nale nkinga ngazo zonke izindlela zethu kulo nyaka ozayo! Ezindaweni eziningi lapho izitshalo zikhula khona ehlobo, kube nokukhiqiza okuhle kulo nyaka. Kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi ukukhula kwezihlahla kuyanda. Kube nezinkundla kulo nyaka lapho kungabonakali khona ukuthi izitshalo zokudla zifakwe noma ukuthi izihlahla zifakwe. Izindleko eziphezulu nokulahleka kokukhiqiza akusikho okuthanda ukukucabangela. Eminyakeni edlule, kube nzima ukuf farming ukuze uthole inzuzo - manje asikwazi ukuhamba kalula nokulahlekelwa izitshalo zokudla ezidingekayo. Ungase uzibuze ukuthi kungani sikhathazekile ngale nkinga yezihlahla ngoMsombuluko. Okwamanje, akusizi ukuzama ukubulala izihlahla ngoba ingozi isivele ibekwe (ngaphandle kokuthi uvimbe izihlahla ekukhuleni kwezim seed ezizokhula kulo nyaka ozayo). Nokho, uma sifuna ukuwulwa nomphikisi, kumele sazi ukuthi iyiphi uhlobo lomphikisi - awukwazi ukuwulwa nento ongayazi noma ongakaze uyibone. Le yisikhathi esihle sokuhamba ezinkundleni zakho futhi ubone ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhona - izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhona njengamanje zifanele ukuba khona kulo nyaka ozayo (mhlawumbe nasezinyangeni ezizayo uma ungathathi izinyathelo eziqinile zokuzisusa manje). Zisabalala kanjani - zikhula kusuka ezitsheni, emithini, emithanjeni, noma ngenye indlela? Yisiphi isindlela esingakhetha ukusiza ukuphatha izihlahla ezitsheni zethu (ukushintsha izinhlobo zezitshalo, ukulima ngezinsiza, noma ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali)? Nini kufanele siwule izihlahla ezinjalo (kungenzeka kube ebusika ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukufaka izitshalo zonyaka ozayo)? Yiziphi amakhemikhali abhaliswe ukubulala izinhlobo ezithile zezihlahla? Nini kufanele amakhemikhali afakwe emhlabathini noma ezihlahleni? Uma uqoqe lonke ulwazi mayelana nezinhlobo zezihlahla ezibeka ingozi kuwe, uzimisele ukuziphatha kahle kulo nyaka ozayo - zilungiselele ukuphumelela kule mpi ngokumelene nalomphikisi wezihlahla!
Ubufakazi obethulwa ngabaphathi bakwa-Eskom kwiKhomishini kaZondo buwumsebenzi obalulekile ohloswe ukuveza izinkinga ezithinta ukusebenza kwe-Eskom, izinqubo zokuphatha, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi. Ukuze uqonde kahle ubufakazi, landela lezi zinyathelo ezilandelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Umongo Wobufakazi 1.1. Funda kahle izincwadi ezihlobene neKhomishini kaZondo, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibhekisela kwi-Eskom. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde izizathu zokubizwa kwabaphathi. 1.2. Bheka izinkinga eziphakanyisiwe, ezifana nezinkinga zokuphatha, ukungabi khona kokuphathwa kahle kwemali, nezinkinga zokusebenza. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlola Ubufakazi Obethulwe 2.1. Bheka ubufakazi obutholakele, okuhlanganisa imibiko, izitatimende, nezincwadi ezithunyelwe kwiKhomishini. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle izizathu zabaphathi bakwa-Eskom. 2.2. Qhathanisa ubufakazi obutholakele nezinkinga ezikhuluma ngazo, ukuze uqonde ukuthi ubufakazi buhambisana kanjani nezinkinga eziphakanyisiwe. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlaziya Izizathu Zokubizwa KweKhomishini 3.1. Bheka izizathu eziholele ekubizweni kweKhomishini, okungabandakanya izigameko ezithile noma izinqumo ezithathwe abaphathi. 3.2. Qonda ukuthi lezi zizathu zikhombisa kanjani ukungabi nempumelelo kwe-Eskom, ukuze uqonde umthelela wezinqanaba ezithathwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Yobufakazi 4.1. Bheka imiphumela yobufakazi obethulwe, okuhlanganisa izinguquko ezidingekayo nezinyathelo zokulungisa. 4.2. Qhathanisa imiphumela yobufakazi nezinhlelo ezikhona, ukuze uqonde ukuthi zidinga ukuvuselelwa noma cha. Isinyathelo 5: Ukubeka Phambili Izixazululo 5.1. Phakamisa izixazululo ezithile ezizokwenza kube nokuphuculwa kwe-Eskom, okuhlanganisa izinguquko ezinkulu noma izinyathelo ezincane. 5.2. Bheka ukuthi izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zingasebenza kanjani ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubika Imiphumela 6.1. Bhala umbiko ophathelene nobufakazi obethulwe, uhambise izigaba ezahlukene kusukela ekuhloleni ubufakazi kuya ekubekeni phambili izixazululo. 6.2. Qinisekisa ukuthi umbiko uqukethe imininingwane ecacile, izibalo, nezibonelo ezisekela iziphakamiso zakho. Isinyathelo 7: Ukubamba Izingxoxo 7.1. Hlela izingxoxo nabaphathi bakwa-Eskom ukuze uthole ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngezinselelo ezikhuluma ngazo. 7.2. Bheka ukuthi abaphathi bakwa-Eskom baphendula kanjani ezinkingeni eziphakanyisiwe, ukuze uqonde izinqumo zabo. Isiphetho Ubufakazi obethulwe ngabaphathi bakwa-Eskom kwiKhomishini kaZondo buwumsebenzi obalulekile ohloswe ukuveza izinkinga ezithinta ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukuhlela, ukuhlaziya, nokubika ubufakazi ngendlela efanele, okuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Qinisekisa ukuthi ubufakazi buhamba phambili ekwakheni izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokuphuculwa kwe-Eskom, ukuze kube nokwaneliseka komphakathi.
Sebenzisa ipeni emnyama noma eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lezintela futhi ugcine ukubhala kwakho ngaphakathi kwezikhala ezitholakalayo. Sicela usebenzise izinhlamvu ezinkulu lapho ugcwalisa le phepha. UNGASHIYI izikhala ezingenalutho ezingadingeki. Sicela ungasebenzisi ukulungisa umswakamo uma wenza iphutha. Siphinde sicele ukuthi ungayigudluki ifomu lakho lezintela njengoba lokhu kuzobambezela ukuhlela kwalo. Kufanele uqedele zonke izingxenye ezihlobene nephepha lezintela. Noma yisiphi ifomu lezintela elingagcwaliswanga ngokuphelele lizobuyiselwa kuwe libhalwe "alithunyelwanga" kuze kube ubuyisela ngokuphelele. Lokhu kungaholela ezijezweni zokuthunyelwa kwezimali ezibambezelekile. Ukusayina: ifomu lezintela liyisivumelwano esisemthethweni esidinga ukuthi udalule yonke imali engenayo, intela, nezikhala unyaka wonke. Ngaphandle kokusayina kwakho, akusho lutho. Imali etholelwe uma ungazange uthole imali engenayo unyaka wonke kufanele igcwaliswe kulolu hlobo ngokufaka zero (0). AZIKHO izingxenye okufanele uzihlanganise nefomu lakho uma uthumela ku-SARS. Nokho, zonke imibhalo ehambisanayo kufanele igcinwe iminyaka emihlanu uma i-SARS ifuna lezi zinto. Ukuze kube lula, kulonyaka i-SARS isethule amafomu amabili amasha ezintela zabantu. Uma uthole ifomu IT12C kodwa uzwa ukuthi ungaphansi kwesigaba se-IT12S, kufanele ugcwalise futhi uthumele lelo fomu le-IT12C; ungaceli ifomu lezintela le-IT12S. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela, i-SARS izoshintsha uhlobo lwefomu ngokususelwa kulwazi olunikeziwe kufomu lakho lamanje futhi izolungisa uhlelo ngokufanele ukuze ikhiphe ifomu elilungile ngonyaka olandelayo. Qinisekisa ubuqiniso bolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze ufake imininingwane efanele. Isimo somshado njengoba sikhona ngoFebhuwari 28, 2007: Beka ibhlogo efanele nge "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) usebenzisa "X" futhi uma ushade, khombisa nge "X" ukuthi umshado ungaphansi komphakathi wezimpahla noma cha. Qinisekisa ubuqiniso bolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze unikeze imininingwane efanele. Sicela ugcwalise imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho wamanje. Uma usebenze endaweni engaphezu kweyodwa phakathi kwesikhathi sikaMashi 1, 2006, kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2007, gcwalisa imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho omkhulu - lapho usebenze khona amahora amaningi. Uma ungasebenzi, shiya lesi sikhala singalungile. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimali ezibuyiswayo kwenziwa kusetshenziswa ikhodi yephoyinti, hhayi igama lebhange. Ngakho-ke, akudingeki ukuthi unikeze igama lebhange olisebenzisayo. Qaphela: i-SARS ikhipha ama-cheque kuphela ezimweni ezikhethekile, ngakho kufanele unikeze imininingwane zebhange ukuze uthole ukubuyiselwa. Akukho ukubuyiselwa okuzobekwa kwi-akhawunti yebhange yomuntu wesithathu. Khombisa indlela yakho yokuxhumana oyikhethayo ngokubeka ibhlogo efanele usebenzisa izinombolo 1 kuya ku-5. Inombolo 1 ibonisa ukukhetha okuthandwa kakhulu kanti 5 ibonisa ukukhetha okuncane. Uma usebenzisa umthengisi wezintela ukuze ugcwalise iphepha lakho lezintela, lowo mthengisi uzogcwalisa ulwazi. Uma uthola imali ekhombisa kumasertifika IRP5/IT3(a), udinga ukuyiphatha njengoba kukhombisiwe ngezansi. Ikhodi esigabeni sokuqala ikhombisa umthombo wemali yakho kanti isigaba sokugcina sikhombisa inani olitholile. Lezi yizigaba kuphela ozodinga ukuzigcwalisa kulolu hlobo lwefomu. Uma uthola kuphela i-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, uzogcwalisa inani bese ufaka ikhodi yomthombo efanele esigabeni se-fomu njengoba kukhombisiwe ngezansi. Uma unezigaba eziningi ezingaphezu kwezishiyagalombili, udinga ukuxhumana neCall Centre ku-0860 12 12 18 ukuze uthole usizo ekuqedeni ifomu lakho lezintela. Izimali zitholakala esigabeni semali engenayo ye-IRP5. Sebenzisa inani elikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 ukuze ugcwalise lesi sigaba - uma uthole ama-IRP5/IT3(a) amaningi, zonke izimali ezikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 kufanele zengezwe ndawonye bese inani eliphelele lifakwa kufomu njengekhodi 2697. Ngokwezimali zezintela, imali yokutshala ibalwa njengemali engenayo njengezintshisekelo zendawo, izintshisekelo zangaphandle, nezinsizakalo zangaphandle. Izintshisekelo zendawo zikhonjiswa ekhasini lesibili lephepha lakho lezintela futhi izinhlelo zenziwa ekhasini lesithathu lephepha lakho lezintela ukuze kudalulwe imali etholelwe ezintshisekelweni zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle kanye nanoma yiziphi izikhala zezintela zangaphandle, uma zikhona. Hlanganisa izimali ezihlobene nezintshisekelo zendawo ezikhonjiswe kumasertifika atholwe mayelana nawe nomkakho. Gcwalisa inani eliphelele lezintshisekelo ezitholwe ngu wena nomkakho - ingxenye engakhokhiswa izintela izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezintshisekelo zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle. Khumbula futhi ukuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izikhala zezintela ezihlobene nawe nomkakho futhi ugcwalise inani eliphelele eduze kwekhodi efanele ekhasini lesithathu lefomu lakho. Izinhlelo zenziwe kufomu ukuze kudalulwe izikhala zezintela ezihlobene nezintshisekelo zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle. Hlanganisa izimali ezikhonjiswe njengezintshisekelo zendawo kumasertifika owatholile. Gcwalisa izimali zezikhala zezintela ezingakhokhiswa - ingxenye engakhokhiswa izintela izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezintshisekelo zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle futhi udalule izimali eziphelele ekhasini lesithathu lefomu lakho ezikhala ezifanele. Qaphela: Le yisigaba esisodwa sephepha lezintela lapho i-RAND NE CENTS isetshenziswa. Ukuze ugcwalise lesi sigaba, usafuna ama-IRP5/IT3(a) akho. Ifomu lezintela livumela ama-sertifika amathathu ngakho-ke lihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Khombisa inani labaxhasi abakhokhelwayo. Ulwazi oludingekayo lukhomba emalini oyikhokhele emfundweni yezokwelapha kuze kube nguFebhuwari 28, 2007, mayelana nawe nabanye abantu abaqashwe kule mfundo yezokwelapha. Lolu lwazi ngokuvamile lukhonjiswa kumashadi owatholayo evela emfundweni yakho yezokwelapha. Ingabe inani lishintshile phakathi nonyaka wokuhlola? Beka ibhlogo "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) nge "X". Uma impendulo iyebo, khombisa inani labaxhasi ngenyanga. Uma wena, umkakho, noma ingane enokukhubazeka, inani lezindleko ezihlobene nalokho kukhubazeka kufanele kufakwe lapha uma kungakhokhelwa emfundweni yezokwelapha. Khombisa izinkokhelo zePension Fund yakho. Okwaman
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-Smart Meter kwa-Eskom Isingeniso I-smart meter iyithuluzi elibalulekile elisetshenziswa yi-Eskom ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Lezi zinsiza zenza kube lula ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kukagesi, zinciphisa izindleko, futhi zandisa ukusebenza kahle. Kulokhu, sizobheka indlela yokusebenzisa i-smart meter, izinzuzo zayo, nezinyathelo okufanele uzithathe ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono kakhulu kuyo. Izinyathelo Zokusebenzisa i-Smart Meter 1. Thola i-Smart Meter: - Qinisekisa ukuthi u-Eskom unikeza i-smart meter endaweni yakho. Ungavakashela ku-inthanethi ku-website ye-Eskom noma uxhumane ne-ofisi yendawo ukuze uthole ulwazi oluthe xaxa. - Uma uthola ukuthi i-smart meter iyatholakala, cela ukufakwa kwayo. Lokhu kungafaka ukugcwalisa ifomu lokucela noma ukuxhumana nomhlinzeki. 2. Faka i-Smart Meter: - Uma usuthole imvume yokufaka, umhlinzeki uzohlela usuku lokufaka. Qinisekisa ukuthi ungatholakali ngosuku lokufaka ukuze kube lula. - Umhlinzeki uzofaka i-smart meter, aqinisekise ukuthi isebenza kahle, futhi akutshele ukuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani. 3. Qonda Ukusebenza Kwayo: - Ngemva kokufakwa, thola isikhathi sokufunda indlela yokusebenzisa i-smart meter. Lokhu kungafaka ukufunda izinkomba ezisemqoka, njengokuthi ungabala kanjani ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. - Bheka izinkomba ezikhanyayo ezikwi-smart meter ukuze uqonde ukuthi imaphi amamitha akho akhombisa ukusetshenziswa. 4. Sebenzisa i-App ye-Smart Meter: - I-Eskom inikeza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezitholakala ku-smartphone. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luzokwenza kube lula ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. - Landa uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Eskom ku-Google Play noma ku-App Store, bese ulandela izinyathelo zokubhalisela i-akhawunti. 5. Bheka Ukusetshenziswa Kwakho: - Sebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze ubheke ukusetshenziswa kwakho kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi ungayinciphisa kanjani. - Bheka izibalo ezitholakala ku-smart meter ukuze uqonde izikhathi lapho ukusetshenziswa kukho kuphezulu kakhulu. 6. Phatha Izindleko: - I-smart meter ikuvumela ukuthi ubone izindleko zakho zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukwazi ukuhlela kahle izindleko zakho. - Qinisekisa ukuthi uyayiqonda indlela yokubala izindleko zakho eziphathelene nokusetshenziswa kukagesi. 7. Thola Izaziso: - I-smart meter ingakuthumelela izaziso uma ukusetshenziswa kukho kuphezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqaphele futhi uthathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo. - Qinisekisa ukuthi uvula izaziso kuhlelo lokusebenza ukuze uthole lezi zixwayiso. 8. Thuthukisa Ukusetshenziswa Kwakho: - Sebenzisa izeluleko ezitholakala kuhlelo lokusebenza ukuze uthuthukise ukusetshenziswa kwakho kukagesi. Lokhu kungafaka ukusebenzisa izibani ezisebenza kahle, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamadivayisi angadingeki, nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezisebenza kahle. - Bheka izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, njengama-thermostats aphathwayo. 9. Xhumana Ne-Eskom: - Uma uhlangabezana nezinkinga noma unemibuzo, xhumana ne-Eskom. Ungabathinta ngefoni, nge-imeyili, noma uvakashele i-website yabo. - Qinisekisa ukuthi unemininingwane yakho yokuhweba ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana. 10. Qhubeka Ufundisa: - Qhubeka ufunda ngama-smart meters nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqhubeke uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. - Bhalisela izinhlelo zokufundisa ezitholakala ku-Eskom ukuze uhlale unolwazi olusha. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa i-Smart Meter - Ukulawula Okungcono: I-smart meter ikuvumela ukuthi ubone kahle ukusetshenziswa kwakho kukagesi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela. - Izindleko Eziphansi: Ngokwazi ukusetshenziswa kwakho, ungathola izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko. - Ukusebenza Kahle: I-smart meter ikuvumela ukuthi uthole izinsiza ezisebenza kahle, okwenza kube lula ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa. - Izaziso Zokuxwayisa: Izaziso ezitholakala ku-smart meter zikusiza uqaphele izinkinga ezithile. Isiphetho Ukusebenzisa i-smart meter kwa-Eskom kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokulawula ukusetshenziswa kukagesi. Ngalezi zinyathelo ezilula, ungathola izinzuzo ezinkulu, unciphise izindleko, futhi uthuthukise ukusebenza kahle. Qhubeka ufunda futhi uhlale unolwazi olusha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola okungcono kakhulu kwi-smart meter yakho.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Ukuvuka Kwezimvo Nokuhlukumezeka Emsebenzini Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziteleka zabasebenzi seziphumelele kakhulu ezindaweni zokusebenza eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi ziteleka ziveza ukunganeliseki kwabasebenzi ngezimo zabo zomsebenzi, imiholo, nezimo zokuphila. Izizathu eziholela kulezi ziteleka zihluke kakhulu, kuhlanganise ukungavumelani kwezinkampani nemigomo yokusebenza, ukungabi nempilo, kanye nezimo zokuphila eziyinkimbinkimbi. Muva nje, iziteleka zikhombisa ukuthi abanye abasebenzi baphikisana nezinkampani zabo, befuna amalungelo abo. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emikhakheni efana nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezamandla. Abasebenzi baveza ukukhathazeka kwabo ngokusebenza ezimeni ezingezinhle, lapho imiholo inganele ukufeza izidingo zabo zansuku zonke. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphume baye ezitelekeni, befuna ukuzwa izwi labo. Isibonelo, eGauteng, abasebenzi bezinkampani ezinkulu zokwakha baphume baye ezitelekeni ngenxa yokunganeliseki ngemiholo yabo. Bafuna ukunyuselwa emholweni, futhi bakhombisa ukuthi imisebenzi yabo ibalulekile empumelelweni yezinkampani. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi, okukhuthaza izinkulumo ezinzima. Iziteleka zabasebenzi zihlala zikhombisa izinselelo ezinzima. Abaphathi baziwa ngokuphikisa izicelo zabasebenzi, bephikisa izindleko eziphezulu. Lokhu kudala ukungaboni ngaso linye, futhi abanye abasebenzi bahlala bephikisana nezinkampani zabo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ukubheka izidingo zabasebenzi ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga ezinzima. Kodwa-ke, iziteleka azigcini nje ngokukhombisa ukunganeliseki; zibuye zibe nethonya elikhulu kwezomnotho. Izinkampani eziningi ziqaphela ukuthi iziteleka zingaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuba ziqonde izizathu eziholela kulezi ziteleka. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani zihlala zisebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziteleka zikhuthaza ukuguqulwa kwemithetho emsebenzini. Abasebenzi, ngokuhlanganyela, baveza izinkinga ezikhona, okwenza kube nezinguquko ezithile ezimbonini. Lokhu kukhuthaza uhlelo lokusebenza olungcono, okuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo kubo bobabili, abasebenzi nabaphathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziye zashintsha indlela umphakathi obheka ngayo izisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi, izinyunyana, nezinkampani sekuyinto ebalulekile. Abasebenzi baziwa ngokuthi bangamandla, futhi lokhu kukhuthaza abanye ukuba balwe amalungelo abo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi azikhona nje kuphela ezindaweni ezinzima, kodwa zikhombisa umoya wokubambisana nokukhuthaza izinguquko. Nokho, iziteleka zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe ngokuqondile. Abasebenzi kufanele baqonde ukuthi iziteleka zingaholela ekuphumeleleni, kodwa zidinga ukuxhumana okuhle ukuze zibe nempumelelo. Izinkampani nazo kufanele ziqonde ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle nezisebenzi kungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izimo zomsebenzi. Ekugcineni, iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyinsika yokukhombisa ubuhlakani babasebenzi. Zikhombisa ukuthi abanye abantu baziqhenya ngempilo yabo, futhi bahlala bephikisana nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeka nokusebenza kahle, kanti abasebenzi bahlala benelisekile. Iziteleka zikhombisa ukuthi amandla abathengi asendaweni, futhi lokhu kuveza ukuthi umphakathi unamandla okwenza izinguquko ezinkulu.
Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yisiphi isevisi ethuthukisiwe? I-TISSA inikeza izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngocingo ukuze kube lula kubo bonke obala ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikamasipala. Kungani i-TISSA ikwenza lo msebenzi? I-TISSA ikhuthaza amalungelo okuthuthukisa ulimi futhi ikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendawo ezisemthethweni. Ingabe umphakathi ungacela izinsizakalo zikamasipala ngolimi lwabo lokuqala? Yebo, uma kuyilimi lesi siko esisemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lwezimpawu lubandakanywa? Yebo, abantu abaphethekile bazothola izinga elifanayo le sevisi njengomuntu ophilayo. Izindawo zokusebenza zikhona ezikhungweni ezinkulu zizwe. Le sevisi isebenza kanjani? Le sevisi inikeza umhumushi ozohumusha isicelo sakho. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma umnyango kahulumeni ungisiza? Kuzoba nezimpawu ezikhombisa ehhovisi likamasipala ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuhumusha zikhona. Uma ihhovisi likamasipala lingakhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngingakucela le sevisi? Yebo, ungacela le sevisi, kuphela uma abasebenzi bekulungele ukuyinika. Le sevisi izongisiza kanjani? Umhumushi oqeqeshiwe uzokwenza kube lula kuwe nomsebenzi kahulumeni ukuba nemininingwane eqondile. Unelungelo lokukhuluma ulimi lwakho. Uhulumeni uzosiza ukuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izikhala zokuxhumana ezikhona. Khuluma ulimi lwakho, kuyilungelo lakho. Izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngocingo zikhona lapha. Ukuhumusha ngocingo kuyatholakala lapha.
Thola ukudla okunempilo nezidingo zezempilo. Izidingo zokuphepha nezokuxhumana. Ukunakekela abasebenzi bezempilo. Ulwazi mayelana nokwelashwa nokunakekelwa ngendlela umntwana angayiqonda kalula uma kufanelekile. Ukuhlonipha ubuntu, ubumfihlo, ubumqoka, isithunzi, ukuphila okukholelwa, nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ngokuvuma komguli, ukuthola ulwazi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokwelashwa komguli kusukela kuzihlobo zabo. Ukwelapha lokhu ngenhlonipho nangesithunzi ngokubheka izidingo zomoya nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ukuveza ukukhathazeka nokuthola izincazelo ngokuphuthumayo. Ukuqinisekiswa ngemicimbi engajwayelekile eyenzeka ngesikhathi umguli elashwa, njengokwehla embhedeni nokunye. Ilungelo lokungena ukuze ubone umguli ngezikhathi ezingezona ezokuvakasha uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sihamba kahle. Ukusekelwa kokomoya, nolwazi uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sihamba kahle. Ukusekelwa kokomoya, nolwazi lokuthi kuphi ukusiza okungatholakala ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwesibhedlela. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele mayelana nempilo yomguli nokwelashwa ngaleso sikhathi uma kudingeka. Ngemva kokukhishwa komguli esibhedlela, umndeni ubamba iqhaza, uqinisekisa ukuthi bathatha imithi, futhi babuyele ngendlela efanele ukuze baqhubeke nohlu lokwelashwa njengoba kuzohlelwa. Ukuhlonipha abanye abaguli, izivakashi, nabasebenzi besibhedlela. Ukuqonda ukuthi izidingo zabanye abaguli nemindeni zingase zibe ziphuthumayo kunezidingo zabo. Ukuqinisekisa nokuhlonipha izinsiza, imishini, nokuhambisana nemigomo. Ukuqinisekisa isibhedlela ngezinguquko kulwazi lomguli njengokuthi ikheli, inombolo yocingo, nezinye. Ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokwelashwa komguli njengoba kulindelekile.
iMercedes-Benz Umbuzo 1: Yini iMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz iyinkampani eyaziwa kakhulu yokukhiqiza izimoto eJalimane, esungulwe nguKarl Benz noGottlieb Daimler ngo-1926. Le nkampani ibalulekile emhlabeni wezokuthutha, ithole udumo ngezithuthuthu eziphusile, izimoto ezisheshayo, kanye nezimoto ezikhululeka kakhulu. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izici ezihlukile zeMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz inezici eziningi ezihlukile. Izimoto zayo ziqinile, zinekhwalithi ephezulu, futhi zinezinhlobo zobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Zikhiqiza izimoto eziphephile, ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuhlola ukuhamba, okwandisa ukuphepha kwazo. Umbuzo 3: Yini etholakala kumamodeli eMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz inama-model amaningi ahlukahlukene, asezingeni eliphezulu, atholakala kalula kubathandi bezimoto. Ungathola izimoto ezifana ne A-Class, C-Class, E-Class, S-Class, kanye ne G-Class, eziklanyelwe ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezahlukene zabathengi. Umbuzo 4: IMercedes-Benz ihlola kanjani ubuchwepheshe bayo? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz ihlola izinhlelo zayo zobuchwepheshe ngokusebenzisa imikhakha ehlukene, kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlola, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokuphepha. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwe-‘Autonomous Driving Technology,’ okwenza izimoto zikwazi ukuhamba ngaphandle kokushayelwa. Umbuzo 5: Kukhona yini imikhiqizo ethile eMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: Yebo, iMercedes-Benz inezimoto eziphezulu ezihlanganisa umkhiqizo weMercedes-AMG, okwenza ukuthi izimoto zibe namandla amakhulu, zisheshise kakhulu, futhi zibe nekhono lokuphuma emgwaqeni. Umbuzo 6: Kwenzekani uma ungahamba nezinkinga zezimoto zeMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: Uma ungahamba nezinkinga zezimoto, iMercedes-Benz inezikhungo zokukhombisa ezitholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zikhungo zihlola izithuthi, zisebenza nezinsizakalo zokulungisa, futhi ziqinisekisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwabathengi nezinkampani. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuthenga iMercedes-Benz? Impendulo: Izinzuzo zokuthenga iMercedes-Benz zifaka umkhiqizo onokuhlonipheka, wokwakheka okuphezulu, kanye nezici ezithembekile. Iphinde inikeze izinsiza ezahlukene kubathengi bayo, okuhlanganisa nezinketho zezimali. Umbuzo 8: IMercedes-Benz ibheka kanjani umthelela wayo emphakathini nendalo? Impendulo: Yebo, iMercedes-Benz ibheka umthelela wayo emphakathini nasemvelweni. Ihlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphepha kwemvelo, izinhlelo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwekhabhoni, kanye nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza umsebenzi ophumelelayo. Umbuzo 9: IMercedes-Benz izama kanjani ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo yayo? Impendulo: IMercedes-Benz iqhubeka ithuthukisa imikhiqizo yayo ngokuhlola izibuyekezo zobuchwepheshe, ukwamukela izimiso zakamuva, kanye nokuba nomqondo wokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Umbuzo 10: Yini elindelekile kuMercedes-Benz esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Esikhathini esizayo, iMercedes-Benz ibheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimoto ezizimele, nezokuhamba zepulani ezinjenge-electrification, ukuze ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezimoto ezingcono neziphumelelayo. Le nkampani izophinde ibambe izikhala ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wezokuthutha.
UJacob Zuma: Uhlobo Oluphikisanayo lokuKhokhela Kukhona abanye abantu abahlukene emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi uJacob Zuma ungomunye owanikeza abantu izinkulumo ezinzima. UJacob ungumuntu wezinhlobonhlobo zezinto, futhi abantu banemibono ehlukene ngaye. Lokhu kuyiqiniso kakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngezinsuku yakhe njengomengameli wezwe. Sizokwakha izigaba ezahlukene zempilo kaZuma, sihloko ngezinto ezithile ezimhlobene, sihamba kancane. UZuma wazalelwa eNkandla, eKwaZulu-Natal, emndenini ojwayelekile. Kwakuyisikhathi esinzima, kodwa waba nomdlandla futhi wachuma. Ubuyele emuva, ezithola ezimbalwa njengoba efundile, kukhulu lapho enza imizamo yokuziphatha kahle, kodwa futhi enza amaphutha athile. Izinsuku zakhe zokuqala ezintsha emlandweni zakhombisa ukuthi baningi abangasaphila befundile, kodwa iZuma yahamba phambili. Ube ngumholi wenhlangano ye-ANC, obhekiwe futhi uphethe umthwalo omkhulu. Umphakathi wahamba naye lapho azama ukuthola izikhali ezizodingekile para intando yeningi. Uyingxenye ye-ANC, abanye babekholelwa kuwo, abanye bephikisana naye. Indaba yakhe iqala ukuba nzima kakhulu njengoba iminyaka yezenhlalo yayidlula. Izikhathi ezinzima zaqala lapho ethola ukuthi izinsuku zomhlangano zibuhlungu. UZuma waba neholo, kodwa kakhulu isikhathi esiningi ukukhokha uhlelo lwezombangazwe. Abantu bamenza izigebengu, beze baqagela izimpendulo zalo mholi obhujiswa ukwenza noma okungaziwa, kepha akavumeli ukuthola ingxoxo echwepheshile. Ngexesha elithile, uJacob Zuma waba nesimo esinzima emndenini, okukhuluma ngasikhathi. Ukuze athole izimiso ezibalulekile, uZuma wanquma ukuba noxolo. Uhlangane nezinselelo ezinkulu ezimphikelela, okujoyina ukuxhashazwa kwezimali zezombusazwe. Amathuba akhe wokuba uMongameli awazange adlulela emuva. Kodwa-ke, izizathu ezintsha zavela phakathi kokukhuluma, zabuza impilo yakhe yokuhola. Kwakukhona abahlali abaningi abethiyayo ngempilo kaZuma, kodwa abanye kwakungabavumelani. Kususelwa ezenzakalweni ezithile, ukheshe efuna ukunciphisa imiphumela yezezimali nezombusazwe. Umsuka wezinkantolo bamfaka ezinsizeni eziningi, okwandisa izinkinga nemiphumela emibi. Ubuye wahlangabezana nezinye izinhlelo, uZuma wava phansi kwezinkanyezi zethuba lesibili. Kodwa akayi phansi ngashonywa kwavela umbono omkhulu. UZuma ube ngabantu abuningi abakhethiwe kodwa abasaphila. Umphakathi wawungaphesheya kwezilwandle, kuvela nezinto ezithile ezimthokozisayo. UZuma waba yinduna, kodwa ezindabeni zaziningi izinkanyezi ezigxikayo. Imiphumela yobuholi bakhe ikhuluma ngempilo yakhe. Imiphumela yezenhlalakahle ibingcono, kodwa izinkinga zokubuyisa bekusobala. Ukudlula kwakhe kokusebenza kukholwa kukhula, uncanny, isiZulu se-angle sikhetha kulezi zigele. UZuma waba nomfanekiso wobuholi, kodwa akagcini nje ngale. Umphakathi wathola imiqondo ehlukene yokumba. Umbhalo kaZuma uveza izimo ezilula, ezinhle, noma ezimbi. UZuma uthanda ukuxoxisana, futhi lokho kuyahambisana nemibono ehlukene ekhanyisela isimo. Uhlelo lwakhe lungaphakanyiswa, kodwa khehlisa ukuze uqonde izici ezinzima zono. UZuma, umholi wezwe, uthinta izizathu ezixakile, izimpendulo, nezinye izinto ezithinta noma ubani. Okokugcina, uJacob Zuma ubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi nabazi ngendlela abaphila ngayo. Manje ngabe imithetho yahluleka enhliziyweni zomphakathi, kukhona okumbalwa okukhombisa abanye abantu. Ukwaziswa ngokulangazelela kukaZuma usakazekile. Abantu baphila, baphumula ezindabeni zakhe. UZuma ungadalula izinkumbulo eziningana emhlabeni, zihlanganisa ubusuku bezimosh, izigcawu zokuhlala. Kwakuma bezekhamuzi ezingaziwayo, ubungcweti bakhe kugxila ezingeni lokuhlola. Ngakho-ke, indaba kaJacob Zuma ayigcini nje ngakho, kodwa ithinta lezi zinkanyezi eziningi ezivusa isithakazelo. Unamalungelo namathuba okulandisa ngale, umyeni endabeni ezinzima zeNingizimu Afrika. UJoseph Zuma, omuntu obhekelwe ngazo zonke izikhathi, kuhlala kukhona okuthusayo ezimpilweni zethu. Izigaba zethuba lethu zokwakha umphakathi, buza manje, uZuma udinga ukuqonda ukuthi uma izinkanyezi zikhanya, ungathola ukuthula kwephupho.
Imvume kadokotela wezokwelapha izilwane iyadingeka ukuze kuthunyelwe izilwane nemikhiqizo yezilwane eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona inqubo yomthetho okufanele ilandelwe mayelana nezilwane nemikhiqizo yezilwane. Njengoba izidingo zempilo zihlala zishintsha, sicela uxhumane neDreykhthori yezeMpilo yezilwane ukuze uthole izidingo zakamuva. Sicela uqaphele: Umthumeli wemikhiqizo unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhokha izimali zebhange, futhi uMnyango ngeke unikeze imvume uma inani eliphelele le-ZAR110.00 lingakakhokhwa. Ezimweni lapho ufaka isicelo egameni lomunye, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi ukhokhela lowo muntu noma inkampani. Sicela ukhombise efomini ukuthi imvume izotholwa noma idingeka ukuthi ithunyelwe. Isiteshi sokuhlukaniswa kwezilwane singatholakala nezinye iziteshi zokuhlola, eThekwini, okwamanje engasebenzi, kodwa ulwazi lungatholwa ehhovisi enombolo: +27 31 368 6011 noma ngefeksi kule nombolo: +27 31 337 7469. Lapho uthumela izikhumba ezimanzi noma ezomile nezicoco, ifomu lesicelo kumele liqinisekiswe udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane ohambisana nendawo lapho isikhungo sitholakala khona. Ifomu lesicelo kumele futhi sigunyazwe omunye umuntu futhi sigunyazwe udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane, ozothumela ifomu ngefeksi. Lapho uthumela izilwane eziphilayo ezifana nezinkomo, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezihlahla, kufanele uthole imvume yokuthuthukiswa kwezilwane ngaphambi kokuthi imvume yokuthumela izilwane iphume. Lezi mvume zokuqala kufanele zinikezwe udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane endaweni yokungena, kanye nesitifiketi sempilo sezilwane, okuyisitifiketi sokuqala esinikezwa udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane ophumelelayo ezweni elithunyelwa khona imikhiqizo. Isicelo ngokuvamile sithatha izinsuku ezine zokusebenza ukuze kuqedwe udaba lwemvume, uma udokotela wezokwelapha ezilwane evumile isicelo.
Yini efakwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ubani ongafaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ingabe isenzo noma isinyathelo esikhala ngaso singaphula amalungelo akho emvelo afakwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ingabe kukhona isixazululo ngezinkinga eziphakanyisiwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Kwenzekani ngemuva kokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amalungelo akho emvelo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Funda lapha kuqala. Ukusebenzisa iNational Environmental Management Act (NEMA) kungaba lula. Awudingi ukuba nommeli ukuze ufake isikhalazo kumuntu okwamanje ebulala imvelo noma kumuntu okukholelwa ukuthi angase abulale imvelo esikhathini esizayo. Awudingi futhi uma ufuna ukubamba iqhaza njengomuntu wesifunda ezinqumweni eziphathelene nemvelo. Kuyisicwangciso esihle ukufuna usizo kumuntu onolwazi nge-NEMA ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Umthetho ungaba nzima futhi udidekile. Inkinga yakho ingase ibe nezimpande ezijulile. Kungase kube nezindlela ezingaphezu kwesisodwa zokuyixazulula. Ungase futhi udinge ukubuza umuntu onolwazi ngalezi zindaba noma izinkinga ezingafakwanga kulolu hlelo. Ungase ufune ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi lokho okwenziwayo kusemthethweni. Uhlu lwezizinda zikahulumeni nezinsiza zomthetho kanye nolwazi olunomthelela lutholakala ekugcineni kwalolu hlelo. Bangakunika usizo mahhala ekuvikeleni imvelo yakho. Uma inkinga yakho ihilela ezinye izindaba, bangakudlulisela endaweni efanele yokusiza. Yini amalungelo emvelo? Ngo-1994, umthethosisekelo omusha wasungula ilungelo lokuba nemvelo enempilo njengelungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Lapho umthetho uthi into ethile iyilungelo eliyisisekelo, kusho ukuthi konke okwenziwa uhulumeni kufanele kuhambisane nalokho okuchazwe ngalolo lungelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imithetho, izinqubo, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Abantu, kanye nemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezinhlelo kufanele zenze ngokuhambisana nelungelo. INkantolo yeZwe ingaqeda imithetho ephikisana nalolu lungelo, futhi izinkantolo zingaqeda izinyathelo zikaHulumeni noma zomphakathi eziphula lo mthetho. Ukuqeda kusho ukungabambeleli noma ukuguqula. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo lemvelo lithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuba nemvelo engalimeleli empilweni yabo noma ekuphileni kwabo. Futhi lithi uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezilungile nezilindelekile ukuvikela imvelo, njenge ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa komoya, ukukhuthaza ukugcinwa kwemvelo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa okuzinzile kokukhula komphakathi nezomnotho. Ngaphandle komthethosisekelo, kunezinye izinqubo eziningi ezivikela imvelo, njenge mthetho wokugcinwa, umthetho wamanzi, nomthetho wokungcoliswa komoya. Le mithetho ivikela eziningi izinto ezingalimaza imvelo. Noma ngabe akukho mthetho ovikela ingxenye ethile yemvelo, kukhona njalo ilungelo lempilo elingasetshenziswa ukuvikela impilo yakho nokuphila kahle nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu benza kahle ukuvikela imvelo. I-NEMA iyimthetho omusha osiza ukuvikela amalungelo akho emvelo kangcono. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokusungulwa kwemigomo yemvelo ehola uhulumeni kulokho okufanele akwenze. Isibonelo, ukwazisa uHulumeni ngalokho okubizwa ngokuthi "ukuthuthukiswa okuzinzile," okusho ukuthi wena njengomphakathi noma njengomuntu walo kufanele ubambe iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithinta imvelo. Usiza ukuvikela imvelo ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni ucabangela zonke izimpawu (ukuthonya kwemvelo) ezingavela ekuthuthukisweni ngaphambi kokuvuma ukuthi kuqhubeke. Ukuvikela labo abasebenza abaphikisa ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezilimazayo emvelweni, kanye nababika (labantu abahlinzeka ngemininingwane) ngabaningi abalimaza imvelo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kithi ukusiza izinkinga nezimpikiswano (ukuxazulula ukuphikisana kwemibono nokuphatha). Ekugcineni, kunciphisa ingozi yokuthi uzothola ukuthi uphakathi kwenkantolo ukuvikela amalungelo akho uma ezinye izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga zihluleka. I-NEMA ichaza imvelo njengendawo yemvelo nezomzimba, izici zamasiko, nezinto ezithile ezithinta impilo yomuntu noma ukuphila kahle. Lolu hlelo lusetshenziswa kanjani? Luchaza ukuthi ungafaka kanjani isikhalazo, ufune isixazululo, noma uthathe isinyathelo somthetho mayelana nento engase yenzeke noma esivele yenzekile futhi ilimaze imvelo. Luchaza ukuthi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emizamweni yokuthonya izinqumo ezizothinta imvelo nezicwangciso zokuvikela imvelo ngokuqhamuka nezivumelwano noHulumeni. Uma ufuna ukufunda kabanzi nge-NEMA, funda lezi ziqondiso. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalazo mayelana nokulimala kwemvelo okwenzekile noma okungenzeka kube khona esikhathini esizayo, kunezinyathelo ezinhlanu kulolu hlelo. Lezi zinyathelo zizokukhombisa ukuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani i-NEMA. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma udinga olunye ulwazi, bheka isigaba kulolu hlelo lapho kukhona inombolo efanayo nalowo mbuzo bese ufunda. Buyela bese ubheka lombuzo. Uma ungaphendula ngempela, qhubeka nembuzo elandelayo. Uma uqhubeka ungakuqondi ukuphendula kombuzo, noma ufundile le ndatshana, noma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha, bheka Isigaba 10 lapho uzothola khona ikheli. Uma uphendule ngempela kuyo yonke imibuzo, funda Amakhasi 8 no-9 ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nalokho okwenzeka uma uthatha isinyathelo. Ukuthatha isinyathelo somthetho. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma ucabanga ukuthi impendulo ayikho, ungawulahli ithemba. Funda lesi sigaba selolu hlelo futhi uxhumane neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha wesifunda sakho noma ngesizwe. Umbuzo 1: Ingabe isikhalazo sikhuluma ngento ezokwenzeka noma ngento esivele yenzekile noma yenziwe ngemuva kosuku lukaJanuwari 29, 1999? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 2. Umbuzo 2: Ungafaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 3. Umbuzo 3: Ingabe isikhalazo sihilela ukuphulwa kwamalungelo emvelo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 4. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe ucabangele ezinye izindlela ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 5. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe unolwazi olwaneleyo ukwenza izinqumo? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 6. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona isixazululo sesikhalazo sakho ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 7. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe wenze isinqumo sokuthatha isinyathelo? Yebo, bheka Isigaba 8. Umbuzo 8: Kwenzekani uma uthatha isinyathelo? ISIGABA 1: Yini efakwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? I-NEMA yasungulwa ngomhla kaJanuwari 29, 1999. Ingasetshenziswa ezinkingeni ezizovela noma lezo ezenzekile ngemuva kosuku lukaJanuwari 29, 1999. Ayisizi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezenzekile ngaphambi kwalolu suku ngaphandle kwezinkinga eziqhubekayo. I-NEMA yenza kube lula ukuvikela amalungelo akho emvelo kunakuqala. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakudingeka ukuthi uye enkantolo kuphela uma impilo yakho
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabazali babezali bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho esingakwenza ukuze sigweme lezi zifo. Singadla ukudla okunempilo, futhi ngisho naleso sikhathi, uma singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa indlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuze ugweme lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho-ke, nakekela wena. Ukunakekela thina siqu kuyisibopho sethu. Ukudla kuyidingo ebalulekile empilweni. Ukudla kusenza sijabulele ukuphila. Cabanga nje ukuthi sithokozisa kangakanani ukudla okunambitheka kahle nemindeni yethu nokuthi kubi kanjani emihlanganweni uma kungekho ukudla okunambitheka kahle. Ngenkathi sijabulela ukudla okunambitheka kahle, kubalulekile ukudla ngokuhlakanipha. Funda le bhukwana ukuze uthole ukuthi kungani ukudla kubalulekile nokuthi kufanele sidle kangakanani. Funda indaba kaDudu... Qedela i-milkshake yakho, izingane, isikhathi sokuthi niye esikoleni. Ukudla okunempilo kusiza ukufunda kahle. Imizimba nemiqondo yezingane ezikhulayo idinga inani elifanele lokudla nsuku zonke ukuze zikhule kahle. UDudu uthi, ungakuthola kanjani konke okudingayo njengemfene enkulu efana nelanga emathafeni? Umzimba womuntu usebenza ngendlela ehlukile. Sidinga ukudla okunempilo okuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ukuze sihlale sikhulile futhi siqinile. Woza uphuze itiye, Dudu, kukhona futhi ikhekhe elinambitheka kahle esilethele udadewethu edolobheni lapho esebenza khona. Ngizokucela ukuthi ungiphe ingxenye yekhekhe, ngiyabonga. Kodwa ukuba nolwazi lokuthi kufanele sidle ini kungasiza ukuvikela ingozi yokukhuluphala, kugcine isisindo esinempilo ngokudla ukudla okufanele nokwanele. Lezi yizithombe zomjaho wesokisi wendodana yami. Ungumlandeli omkhulu weBafana Bafana. Lapha ungabona umehluko wokuthi lezi zinsizwa zidinga ukudla okuhlukile ngoba ukudlala kubenza bahlale bephilile, hhayi njengodadewethu osebenza ehhovisi. Kule bhukwana, sikhuluma ngakho ukudla ngendlela enempilo. Ukudla yikho esikudlayo noma esikuphuza ukuze siphile. Kufanele udle ukudla okufanele ukuze uhlale unempilo, usebenze kahle, futhi uphile isikhathi eside. Konke ukudla kunezinto ezimbili ezisigcinayo siphile: amandla nezinto eziphilayo. Imoto kumele ibe nefuela ukuze ikwazi ukuhamba. Ngendlela efanayo, ukudla kukunika umzimba wakho amandla okunyakaza nokwenza izinto ofuna ukuzikwenza. Izinto eziphilayo yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zinegama elihlukile futhi zenze imisebenzi ehlukene emzimbeni wethu. Izinto eziphilayo ezakhiwa umzimba wakho futhi zigcine uqine zibizwa ngama-proteins. Izinto eziphilayo ezivikela ekuguleni zibizwa ngama-vitamins kanye nezinsimbi. Lokhu kudla kunezinto eziningi ezivikela, ama-vitamins, nezinsimbi. Khumbula njalo ukuhlanza izithelo nemifino ngaphambi kokuzidla. Lokhu kudla kukunika amandla. Ezinye izidlo ezihambisana nalokhu zifaka ama-nuts nezimbewu. Ukudla kusho ukudla okudlayo nsuku zonke. Ukuze uthole zonke izinto eziphilayo namandla odinga, kufanele udle ukudla okuhlukile nsuku zonke. Ukuze ukudla kwakho kube nempilo, kufanele ufake okukodwa noma okungaphezulu kokudla okukhona ezitheni eziphilayo nezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezivikela kuzo zonke izidlo ozidlayo. Zama ukukhetha ukudla okuhlukile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle kabili noma kathathu ngosuku. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle ekuseni. Izingane kufanele zibe nezibiliboco ngaphambi kokuhamba esikoleni. Khumbula ukuthi izingane kufanele zibe nezibiliboco phakathi nezidlo ngoba izibiliboco zazo zincane futhi azikwazi ukudla okuningi ngasikhathi sinye. Ukudla kwethu kuleli lizwe kufanelekile ukudla okunempilo. Empeleni, ukudla kwendabuko kwabazali bethu (okulandwa abantu abaningi) ukudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo okudliwayo nsuku zonke njenge-maize, irayisi, ama-cereals, ubhontshisi, kanye nepapa kubizwa ngokuthi ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu kudla kukunika amandla, kwakha umzimba wakho, futhi kuvikele futhi. Lokhu kudla kugcwalisa. Ngoba akucutshunguliwe, kukunika izinto ezidingekayo umzimba wakho. Into embi ukuthi abanye abantu bayakhohlwa ukudla okuyisisekelo. Bathi bangakwazi ukukhokhela ukudla okudlayo. Abantu bavame ukufaka iziphuzo nezithako ekudleni (njengokukhukhula, usawoti, uphizi, noshukela) ukuze kudle kahle. Iningi lezi zinto nezithako azinazo izinto eziphilayo zokunikeza umzimba. Nakuba umzimba wakho udinga usawoti, kufanele kube ngezinga elincane kakhulu nsuku zonke; ingxenye yesipuni ngosuku. Ngokuvamile, gwema ukudla okunoshukela njengezikhukhukazi nezimbewu ezifakwe amafutha. Izibiliboco yizidlo ezilula ezidliwayo phakathi nezidlo. Ukudla izibiliboco phakathi nezidlo kusiza ukugcina umzimba wakho usempilweni kahle usuku lonke. Izingane zidinga ukuba nezibiliboco phakathi nezidlo. Ukudla izibiliboco kubalulekile kodwa kufanele uqaphele ngezinhlobo zokudla ozisebenzisayo kulokhu. Abantu abaningi badla ukudla okufana nezimbewu ezifakwe amafutha, izithako, ama-chocolates, iziphuzo ezibandayo, ama-kekhe, ama-biscuits, itiye, kanye nekhofi. Into embi ukuthi zonke lezi zinhlobo zokudla azikho ukudla okunempilo. Futhi zikhokha kakhulu. Khuthaza ingane yakho ukuthi ithenge izithelo kuphela kubathengisi. Khumbula ukuthi izibiliboco akufanele zishintshe ezinye izidlo eziphilayo. Cishe u-2/3 wombono womuntu wenziwe ngamanzi futhi zonke izinto zomzimba ziqukethe amanzi. Amanzi awanazo izinto eziphilayo ezitholakala ezithelweni ezahlukene kodwa adingeka emzimbeni. Empeleni, zonke izinto eziphilayo kuhlanganise nezilwane nezitshalo zidinga amanzi ukusiza umzimba ukhiphe udoti ngaphakathi. Umuntu udinga ukuphuza okungenani izinkomishi eziyisithupha zamafutha ngosuku ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umzimba unamanzi anele. Umzimba wakho ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi uma kushisa, ngokuphuma kokushisa nangisho lapho uphumeza. Uma kushisa, uzwa umuzwa wokuphuma amanzi, lokhu kungenxa yokuthi umzimba wakho udinga amanzi. Impilo yethu incike kulokho esikudlayo. Ukudla okunempilo kuzokunikeza amandla anele futhi lezi zinto eziphilayo zizosisiza ekukhuleni, zigcine umzimba wakho unempilo ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza, ukudlala, nokwenza ezinye izinto ofuna ukuzikwenza. Lezi zinsizwa zidinga amandla amaningi. Yini inani elifanele lokudla elinika umuntu "amandla" okufanele adle? Ake sibheke inani lokudla okufanele udle. Kangakanani (ikakhulukazi ukudla okunika amandla) okudlayo kuzoncika kulokho okudingayo. Abantu abahlukene banemithwalo ehlukene yamandla. Izingane zidle inani elanele lokudla okunika amandla uma zikhula kahle. Khuluma nomhlengikazi wesikhungo ukuze uthole ukuthi ingane yakho ikhula kahle. Umuntu omdala udla inani elifanele lokudla okunika amandla uma egcina is
Ithelevishini: Umhlahlandlela Wokusebenzisa Nokuyiqonda Ithelevishini iyithuluzi elibalulekile elithokozisa abantu, libanikeza ulwazi, nezokungcebeleka. Ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi ithelevishini isebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukwazi izigaba ezahlukene zokusebenzisa kwayo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nemiyalelo yokuyisebenzisa kahle. Isigaba 1: Ukwakha Indawo Yokubuka Okokuqala, udinga ukukhetha indawo efanele yokubuka ithelevishini. Qiniseka ukuthi le ndawo inokukhanya okwanele, kodwa hhayi kakhulu ukuze ungakhathazeki. Faka ithelevishini endaweni ethule, lapho ungaphazamiseki khona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukugxila kulokho okubukayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi isikhala sikhulu ngokwanele ukuze ubukele kahle, futhi udinga ukuba nezihlalo ezikhululekile. Isigaba 2: Ukuxhuma Ithelevishini Uma usukhethiwe indawo, kulandele ukuxhuma ithelevishini. Qala ngokuxhuma ikhebuli yombane. Qiniseka ukuthi uxhumano luhlala lukhona ukuze ungaboni izinkinga zokungasebenzi. Uma unezixhumi ezifana ne-HDMI, qiniseka ukuthi zixhunywe kahle kumadivayisi afana ne-DVD player noma i-set-top box. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukushintsha phakathi kwezinhlelo. Isigaba 3: Ukusetha Ithelevishini Ngemuva kokuxhuma, sebenzisa umyalo wokusetha ithelevishini. Vula ithelevishini bese ulandela imiyalo ebhaliwe. Lokhu kuzokuholela ekwakheni izilungiselelo ezifanele. Ungakhetha ulimi olufunayo, ubone izinketho zokubuka, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ithelevishini iyakwazi ukuthola iziteshi ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubuka izinhlelo ozithandayo. Isigaba 4: Ukukhetha Iziteshi Nokuqonda Izinhlelo Uma ususethile ithelevishini, ungakhetha iziteshi. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi ukuthi iziteshi ezithile zingatholakala kuphela uma ubhalisile kumphakeli wezinsizakalo. Funda uhlu lweziteshi ukuze uqonde ukuthi yiziphi ezitholakalayo. Ungasebenzisa umphakeli wezinsizakalo noma imiyalo ye-thelevishini ukuze uthole izinhlelo ezikhethwayo. Isigaba 5: Ukusebenzisa Izici Zethelevishini Ithelevishini yanamuhla inezici eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokurekhoda, izinhlelo zokubuka kabusha, nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Qonda ukuthi ungazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zici ukuze uthole okuhlangenwe nakho okungcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina izinkumbulo ezinhle noma ukubuka izinhlelo ozithanda kakhulu. Isigaba 6: Ukuphatha Izilungiselelo Zokubuka Qiniseka ukuthi uyakwazi ukuphatha izilungiselelo zokubuka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukulungisa ivolumu, ukushintsha izilungiselelo zokuqapha, nokulawula izikhathi zokubuka. Ungasebenzisa umphakathi wezilungiselelo ukuze uthole izinketho ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujabulisa bonke abathandi bezokungcebeleka. Isigaba 7: Ukuzijabulisa Ngezinhlelo Zethelevishini Uma usuphethe konke, sebenzisa ithelevishini ukuze uzijabulise. Khetha izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, izimidlalo, noma amafilimu. Ungabuka izinhlelo ezithokozisayo nezingezona ezokungcebeleka, ukuze uthole ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangani. Isigaba 8: Ukuhlola Izinkinga Nokuxazulula Noma kunjalo, kungase kube nezinkinga ezithile. Uma ithelevishini ingasebenzi kahle, hlola ukuthi zonke izixhumi zixhunywe kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli wezinsizakalo uyasebenza. Uma ungakatholi iziteshi, zama ukusetha kabusha ithelevishini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga ezivamile. Isigaba 9: Ukugcina Ithelevishini Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukugcina ithelevishini. Qinisekisa ukuthi iyahlanzwa njalo ukuze igcine ukubukeka okuhle. Ungasebenzisa isicoci esithambile ukuze uhlanze ifreyimu nezinye izingxenye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ithelevishini yakho ihlala isebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ithelevishini iyithuluzi eliwusizo elinikeza abantu ithuba lokuzijabulisa, ukufunda, nokuxhumana. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukujabulisa umndeni nabangani, uthole ulwazi, futhi ujabulele izikhathi ezinhle. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyayiqonda kahle ithelevishini yakho, ukuze ukwazi ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Ngalolu hlelo, ungaba nekhono lokusebenzisa ithelevishini yakho ngendlela ephumelelayo.
Amahlaya - Umqondo, Umsebenzi, Nokubaluleka Kwawo Isingeniso Amahaha, noma amahlaya, ayingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yomuntu. Ukumamatheka, ukuhleka, nokuzizwisa kahle kuyizinto ezithokozisayo ezitholakala kumahlaya. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngamaahlaya, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi awafaneleki kuphela njengokuhlekisa, kodwa futhi anomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu. Kulokhu, sizobheka ukuthi amahlaya ayini, ubuchwepheshe bawo, nezizathu ezenza kube kubalulekile ukuba siwasebenzise empilweni yethu. Umqondo WamaHlaya Amahaha angabhalwa, akhulunywa, noma adlalwe, futhi ahluka kakhulu ngokwamasiko, izinkolo, nezindawo. Umqondo wamaahlaya ungabhekwa njengokuhlekisa okwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlaya angaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima ngendlela ethokozisayo, okwenza kube lula ukuziqonda. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amahlaya awasizi kuphela ukuhlekisa, kodwa futhi angaba yindlela yokuxhumana ngezinkinga ezithile. Umsebenzi WamaHlaya Uma sikhuluma ngomsebenzi wamaahlaya, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amahlaya angaba nemisebenzi eminingi. Okokuqala, amahlaya anikeza abantu ithuba lokuphumula. Emhlabeni ogcwele ingcindezi, ukuhleka kungaba yindlela yokukhulula umoya. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amahlaya angaba yindlela yokwelapha, njengoba ukuhleka kukhulula imizwa emibi. Okwesibili, amahlaya angaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinkinga zomphakathi. Abahlekisi basebenzisa amahlaya ukuze baveze izinkinga ezinjengobandlululo, ubuphofu, noma izinkinga zempilo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuveza imicabango ehlukene, futhi abantu bangakuthola kulula ukuhlekisa ngezinto ezinzima. Izinselelo ZamaHlaya Nokho, amahlaya awanqobi ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Kukhona izinselelo ezithile ezihambisana namaahlaya, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekubhaleni nasekudlaleni. Okokuqala, amahlaya angaba nezithiyo uma kungenziwa ngendlela engafanele. Abanye abantu bangase bahlulele amahlaya ngokwenkolo, ubuhlanga, noma ubulili, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela kubo. Okwesibili, kunobungozi bokuthi amahlaya angase abangele ukungaqondi kahle. Abantu bangase bahlulele amahlaya ngendlela engafanele, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi amahlaya kufanele abe nokuqonda okukhulu, ukuze akwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlonishwa KwamaHlaya Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amahlaya akhuluma ngezinto ezithile, futhi kufanele sihloniphe imikhuba nemigomo yamasiko ahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahlekisi kufanele baqonde izilaleli zabo, futhi bazi ukuthi yini efanele futhi yini engafanele. Ukuhlonipha izinkolelo nezinkolelo zabanye abantu kubalulekile ukuze amahlaya akwazi ukudlula ezitheni. Ukubaluleka KwamaHlaya Empilweni Yansuku zonke Empilweni yansuku zonke, amahlaya anendima enkulu. Amahaha angaba yindlela yokuxhumana, yokuhlekisa, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ukusebenzisa amahlaya empilweni yethu kungasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amahlaya awasizi kuphela ukuhlekisa, kodwa futhi anomthelela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ngakho-ke, amahlaya ayingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yethu. Akukhona okukhuluma kuphela ngokuhlekisa, kodwa futhi akhombisa indlela yokubheka izinkinga zomphakathi. Ukuhleka akusizi kuphela ukuphumuza, kodwa futhi kukhulisa ukuqonda. Ngakho, kufanele sihloniphe amahlaya, siwasebenzise empilweni yethu, futhi siqonde imithelela yawo. Ekugcineni, amahlaya awasizi kuphela ukuhlekisa, kodwa futhi anomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.
iNdlovukazi u-Elizabeth II: Umfanekiso Wempilo Nobuholi U-Elizabeth Alexandra Mary Windsor, owaziwa kakhulu njengendlovukazi u-Elizabeth II, wazalwa ngoMgqibelo, 21 kuNhlangulana 1926, eLondon, eNgilandi. U-Elizabeth, owakha umlando njengendlovukazi yokuqala yeNgilandi, waba yisibonelo sokuhlonipha, ubuholi, kanye nokuzinikela emsebenzini wakhe. Ngemuva kokushona kukayise, uMnumzane u-George VI, ngoFebhuwari 1952, u-Elizabeth wathola isikhundla sokuba yindlovukazi, waphinde wathatha isikhumbuzo sokuhlonipha izinkolo ezahlukene, izizwe, kanye nezinkolo ezihlukahlukene. U-Elizabeth II wakhula emndenini ophakathi kokuphila okuthokozisayo, kodwa okwakunzima. Uthando lwakhe lwezincwadi, umculo, kanye nezilwane, ikakhulukazi izinja, lwamnika amandla okuphila impilo ejabulisayo. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, u-Elizabeth waba neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho asebenza khona njengomhlanganyeli wezokwelapha. U-Elizabeth wathola umshado noPrince Philip, uDuke weEdinburgh, ngoNovemba 20, 1947. Umshado wabo waba yisibonelo sokuhlanganyela, uthando, kanye nokubambisana. Babenabantwana abane: uCharles, uAnne, uAndrew, noEdward. U-Charles, uMprince wokuqala, waba yindlovukazi yokuqala yokuhola izwe, futhi ubudlelwano bakhe no-Elizabeth bahlala bukhanya emhlabeni jikelele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elizabeth II waba yindlovukazi eyaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni. Waqhubeka nokuhola iButho leNgilandi, futhi waba yisithonjana sokuhlonipha izinkolo ezahlukene, izizwe, kanye nezinkolo ezihlukahlukene. U-Elizabeth waba yindlovukazi yokuqala ukuvakashela eChina, futhi waphinde waba yindlovukazi yokuqala ukuvakashela e-Ireland ngemuva kweminyaka engama-100. U-Elizabeth II waba nesikhathi esinzima, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokushona kukaPrince Philip ngoAprili 2021. Lokhu kwashiya umphakathi ungenalutho, kodwa u-Elizabeth waphinde waba yisibonelo sokubekezela. Uhlale eqhubeka nokusebenza, ebamba izinkulumo ezibalulekile, futhi eqhubeka nokuhola izwe ngothando.
