Imali Yokufunda: Ukubhekisisa Kwethu Ngiyabingelela, mngani! Ngicela sikhulume ngendaba emqoka, okuyi-imali yokufunda, noma ngezinye izikhathi sithi "tuition fees." Njengoba sikhuluma, sithola ukuthi le mali ingaba yinkinga enkulu kubafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela emindenini engatholi kahle. Kukhona umqondo ophawulekayo lapha: uma uthanda ukufunda, kufanele ube nezezimali ezithile. Kodwa ke, asikufuni ukukhalaza, ngoba sinesikhathi sokukhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Ngicela ukucacisa kancane: imali yokufunda iyinqubo yokukhokha ukuze ufinyelele ezikhungweni zemfundo, izikhungo zesayensi, nezinye izindawo zokufunda. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuzosiza abafundi ukuba bathole ulwazi olufanele, balungiselele ikusasa labo. Manje, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi, empeleni, imali yokufunda ingahluka kakhulu. Kunezikhungo ezihlukahlukene eziphethe izimali ezahlukene. Uma sithanda ukukhuluma ngama-universities, imvamisa, izikhungo eziphezulu zinezindleko eziphezulu. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubafundi abavela emindenini engenamali. Ngabe ubona kahle? Ukuze uthole iziqu, udinga ukukhokha le mali, kodwa uma ungakukwazi, kanjani? Ngalesi sikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngenketho yokuxhaswa. Kukho izinhlelo eziningi zokweseka abafundi, ezifana neziqinisekiso, ama-bursaries, nezinhlelo zokubolekwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi abanye abafundi bakwazi ukuthola izikhwama zokufunda ezikhokhelwa uhulumeni? Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kuphonsa umphakathi emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa izinga lemfundo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bangenza izinqumo ezinhle, baqhubeke nezifundo zabo, futhi baqonde ukuphila kwabo. Ngabe uhambisani nami? Lokhu kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezemfundo. Uma sikhuluma ngama-universities, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi imfundo ayiyona nje imali yokufunda kuphela. Iphinde ibandakanye izindleko zempilo, ukudla, nezindawo zokuhlala. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ubheka imali yokufunda, kufanele ubala konke okunye okuthinta impilo yakho esikhathini eside. Futhi, akusizi noma ubani osola ukuthi lezi zindleko zikhuphuka kakhulu. Ngabe ubona lokho? Njengoba iminyaka idlula, izindleko ziya zikhula, futhi lokhu kudinga abantu ukuba babe necebo elihle. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi kubafundi abasha, abavela ezindaweni eziphansi. Kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi imfundo iyigugu, kodwa kufanele sibe nesikhathi sokuhlola izinketho zethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhumbule ukuthi kunezikhungo ezithile eziphakela izifundo ezibiza kancane. Lokhu kuyathandeka uma ungathanda ukufunda, kodwa ungafuni ukuchitha imali eningi. Unendawo yokufuna, futhi ngicela ungakhalazi kakhulu. Izikhungo eziningi zithi uma ungenayo imali yokufunda, ungase uthole izinketho ezinhle. Kukhona imithombo eminingi yokuxhaswa, kufaka phakathi abaxhasi bezemfundo, abezimali, nabanye. Ngakho, mngani, uma uhambisana nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa, ungavula amathuba amaningi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqhubeke nezifundo zakho. Ngabe ubona izinto zishintsha? Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukusebenzisana nezinye izikhungo, kubalulekile. Uma ufisa ukuxhumana nabanye abafundi, ungathola izindlela zokuthola imali yokufunda ngendlela ewusizo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akusikho konke okungabizwa ngempumelelo. Ukufunda akusikhona nje ukuthola iziqu, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukuthola ulwazi. Ngabe ubona? Ukuze uthole ulwazi olufanele, kufanele udinge izindlela zokuxhaswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi uqhubeke nezifundo zakho. Ngokugcina, mngani, ngiyakholwa ukuthi kufanele sibe nomqondo omuhle mayelana nemali yokufunda. Lokhu akusikhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuhlobene kakhulu nezifundo. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi uma imfundo ingatholakali, sizokwehla. Ngakho, kufanele sikhulume, sabelane ngolwazi, futhi sibe nomoya wokuxhasana. Umphakathi kufanele uvule izindlela ukuze abafundi baphumelele. Ngakho, sikhuluma ngezindleko, izinketho, nezindlela zokuxhaswa. Ngabe ubona ukuthi kunokukhanya ekugcineni? Kukhona umphakathi ogxile ekuhleleni, futhi uma sihlanganyela, singaba neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha, mngani, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi sizophumelela ndawonye. Uhlungwini, qhubeka ufunde, futhi ungavumi!
Unyaka wezimali odlule bekuyinyanga enzima kakhulu kuBhodi ekhona njengoba bekudingeka baqedele izakhiwo nemigomo futhi babeke isisekelo seBhodi entsha ukuze ithathe izintambo ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Le bekuyiqembu elisebenze iminyaka emihlanu, iPANSALB, kusukela ngoMsombuluko 24, 1996, kuze kube uMsombuluko 25, 2001. Le mibiko ibonisa izenzakalo ezenzeke unyaka wezimali odlule mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nomgomo wezilimi ezweni. Le bekuyinyanga ebalulekile kubabhalisi beBhodi njengoba bekuyonyaka wabo wokugcina ezikhundleni zabo. Ibhodi igxile kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi zonke izinqubo, imigomo, nezakhiwo zizosekela iPANSALB ekufezeni izinhloso zayo. Iqedele ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lezilimi ZaseMaphandleni kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye, Imibhalo Yezilimi Zesizwe, kanye Nezikhungo Zokubhala Ngemibhalo Yezilimi Zesizwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izogcina izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihloselwe abasebenzi kanye neBhodi Yabaqondisi abazobamba iqhaza ezikhungweni zokubhala ngolimi lwezizwe. Imikhosi Yezilimi Zesizwe kanye namalungu ezikhungo zokubhala ngolimi lwezizwe kufanele anikezwe imihlahlandlela ebanzi mayelana nokusebenza kwalezi zikhungo futhi ukusebenza kwazo kufanele kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zemigomo ezisunguliwe. Imibhalo yokweluleka izosiza kokubili iBhodi kanye nezishayamthetho zendawo ekutholeni ulwazi mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nezilimi emiphakathini emelelwe lezi zikhungo. Le Bhodi ekhona iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi imihlahlandlela emkhakheni ngamunye igxilwe ukuze isekele iPANSALB emsebenzini wayo ophakanyisiwe. Imisebenzi eyenziwe unyaka wezimali odlule, kuhlanganise nocwaningo nemikhankaso yokuthuthukiswa, izosiza iPANSALB ukuqhubeka nokuhlola isu layo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphansi komgomo ocwaningweni lwezilimi mayelana "nokusetshenziswa nokuxhumana kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika," kusize iBhodi ukuba iqonde kangcono isimo sezilimi futhi iqinise imihlahlandlela nezinqubo zemigomo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi nokubheka. Idokhumenti ejwayelekile yemihlahlandlela yashicilelwa ukusiza izikhungo ekuthuthukiseni imigomo yezilimi. Ucwaningo oluxhaswe ngezimali ngalokhu, kanye nocwaningo oluqhubekayo, luzoba usizo eqenjini elisha njengoba lihlola izinhlelo zeBhodi ukuze lenze izincomo ezihloselwe uhulumeni kanye nezikhungo zawo mayelana nemigomo yezilimi. Nakuba bekungelula ukusungula ubudlelwano bokubambisana phakathi kweBhodi kanye neHhovisi likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ngenkathi sisenkathini, sithemba ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izokwazi ukwakha lelo budlelwano. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yocwaningo nemikhankaso eyaxhaswa ngaphansi kwezilimi mayelana nemfundo eminyakeni emihlanu edlule iyabelwana nalabo abasezikhundleni zemfundo ezingeni likazwelonke nasezifundazweni. Kungenzeka ukwethula imikhankaso engaphumelela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yezilimi emfundweni ingasebenza ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda nokuqhubeka kwendaba eyodwa ethinta umnotho, kanye nokukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka. Mayelana nokuphakanyiswa kobuchwepheshe ekuguquleni nasekuhumusheni, iPANSALB iphumelele ekukhiqizeni idokhumenti ezosetshenziswa ekubhaleni umthetho ozoba umgomo wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi, kanye nobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqhubeke nalesi sici somthetho. Ibhodi entsha izodinga ukubambisana nomzimba ozosungulwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlonishwa kwalolu suku. Inselelo enkulu iPANSALB ebhekene nayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi ezake zaba nezehlakalo zomlando, ikakhulukazi izilimi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezisemthethweni, ziyaqhubeka zithuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzovumela lezi zilimi ukuba zisebenze njengezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ukusungulwa kweZikhungo Zokubhala Ngemibhalo Yezilimi kuyisinyathelo esisodwa. Ezinye izindlela ezithathwe yiBhodi zifaka ukuqeqesha ababhali bethelevishini, umsakazo, kanye nevidiyo kulezi zilimi, kanye nokuxazulula izinhlelo ezizosheshisa ukuhlinzeka ngencwadi yamasiko. Lokhu kuyisigaba esisodwa okufanele sigxilwe kuso ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo ezizosiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakanyiseni lezi zilimi, kanye nabanye abalingani abathintekayo ezinhlelweni ezifana nalezi. Ibhodi iphinde yenze uphenyo ngezikhalazo eziningi ezethulwe phambi kwayo. Ngeshwa, le misebenzi isadinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze isetshenziswe kahle ukusiza ekubhekeni izilimi nokukhuthaza izikhungo ukuba ziqhubeke zithuthukisa imigomo yazo yezilimi ezizokwazi ukubhekana nezimbangi zomlando. Kuyinjongo yePANSALB ukubona abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu bephila amalungelo abo ezilimi. Isu lokuqinisekisa ukuthi amaKomidi Ezilimi ZaseMaphandleni aphakanyisa ukuqwashisa ngezilimi phakathi kwabakhuluma izilimi ezake zaba ngaphansi kwengcindezi liyasetshenziswa. Impumelelo yalo izobonakala eminyakeni ezayo futhi izokwakhiwa, uma kudingeka, ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo. I-PANSALB iphinde yabambisana nezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze ifinyelele empumelelweni. Ubudlelwano obakhe nezikhungo ezifana neNhlangano Yezobuciko Yezwe, iNhlangano Yezithombe Nevidiyo Yezwe, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele kufanele bukhuliswe. Umsebenzi owenziwe kuBhodi ungaphathwa kuphela yiBhodi; kufanele ibambisane nezinye izikhungo ezisebenza ngokuqondile kumigomo efana neBhodi. Le Bhodi ekhona izibophezele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nezikhungo ezifana neSABC, abashicileli, kanye nezinye izikhungo ezizimele. Nokho, sikhuthaza leli qembu elisha ukuba liqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano bokubambisana nezikhungo zazo. Ukuba nabasebenzi abanele, ulwazi lokubambisana nokuxhumana kuzosisiza ekufezeni le njongo. Ekuphetheni, ngiyabonga uMphakathi Okwesibili uNkk. Zubeida Desai, bonke ababhalisi beBhodi, uMphathi Omkhulu, uProfesa Cynthia Marivate, kanye nabasebenzi bakhe ngomsebenzi ophezulu abawenzayo nokuzinikela kwabo ekuthuthukiseni izilimi nezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika.
Isingeniso U-Cassper Nyovest, ogama lakhe langempela lingu-Refiloe Maele, ungumculi odumile waseNingizimu Afrika, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emculweni, kodwa futhi nohlanga lwezokuxhumana. U-Cassper ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wezinguquko ezinkulu emculweni waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi uzinikele ekwakheni umculo ophilayo, ohloniphekile, nolwakha umphakathi. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinyathelo ezithile zempumelelo kaCassper Nyovest, ezivela ekwakheni umculo wakhe, ekwakheni ibhizinisi, kanye nendlela abathanda ngayo abalandeli bakhe. Isinyathelo 1: Ukwakha Umculo Ukuze uCassper Nyovest abe ngumculi ophumelelayo, waqala ngokwakha umculo wakhe. Lokhu kwenziwa ngezinyathelo ezithile: 1. Ukwazi Izithakazelo Zakhe: U-Cassper uqale waqonda ukuthi umculo wakhe kufanele ube nekhono lokuhlanganisa izitayela ezahlukene. Uhlanga lweHip-Hop, iKwaito, nezinye izitayela zamasiko zafakwa emculweni wakhe. 2. Ukubhala Izingoma: U-Cassper ubhala izingoma ezithinta izihloko ezahlukene, njengothando, impilo, nezinto ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kwenza ukuba umculo wakhe ube nezinhlobonhlobo, uthokozise abalandeli abahlukene. 3. Ukubambisana Nabanye Abaculi: U-Cassper ubelokhu ebambisana nabanye abaculi abanjengo-K.O, Nasty C, no-Black Coffee. Lezi zixhumanisi zikhulisa umphakathi wakhe futhi zenza umculo wakhe ube nomthelela omkhulu. Isinyathelo 2: Ukukhulisa Ibhizinisi Ngaphezu kokuba ngumculi, uCassper Nyovest ungumuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuphatha ibhizinisi. Nansi indlela abaphatha ngayo ibhizinisi lakhe: 1. Ukusebenza Ngokuqinile: U-Cassper uthanda ukusebenza kanzima. Uhlala efuna amathuba amasha, futhi akavumi ukuhlala phansi. Lokhu kwenza ukuba ibhizinisi lakhe likhule. 2. Ukwakha Umkhiqizo: U-Cassper wakhe umkhiqizo wakhe, i-Cassper Nyovest Brand, ehlanganisa clothing, iziphuzo, nezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kumvumela ukuba ahlukanise imali eyengeziwe ngaphandle komculo. 3. Ukuxhumana Nabalandeli: U-Cassper usebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze axhumane nabalandeli bakhe. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile, futhi abalandeli bakhe bazizwa behlanganyela empumelelweni yakhe. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuthuthukisa Umphakathi U-Cassper Nyovest akagxili kuphela empumelelweni yakhe, kodwa futhi ubonisa ukuzibophezela emiphakathini. Uthanda ukusiza abantu abadinga usizo: 1. Ukweseka Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa: U-Cassper uthanda ukweseka izinhlelo ezithinta imfundo, impilo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Uhlanganyela ezinhlelweni eziningi zokupha, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. 2. Ukukhuthaza Abanye Abaculi: U-Cassper uhlanganyela nabanye abaculi, abavula amathuba emisebenzi. Uvikela abaculi abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba balandela amaphupho abo. 3. Ukwakha Amathuba: U-Cassper udala amathuba emisebenzi emiphakathini, ngokwakha imicimbi, imikhosi, nezinhlelo ezihlanganisa abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuphumelela Nokuhlonishwa U-Cassper Nyovest uphumelele kakhulu emculweni nasezinhlelweni zakhe zebhizinisi. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kwenziwa ngezinyathelo ezithile: 1. Imiklomelo: U-Cassper uthole imiklomelo eminingi emculweni, okuhlanganisa ne-SAMA (South African Music Awards). Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umculo wakhe uyathandwa futhi uhamba phambili. 2. Ukwamukelwa Emphakathini: U-Cassper uyaziwa kakhulu, futhi abalandeli bakhe bamamukela njengomholi. Lokhu kumenza abe nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. 3. Ukwakhiwa Kwendlela: U-Cassper wenza indlela yokuthi abanye abaculi baphumelele. Ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuhlala uqotho kuyindlela yokuphumelela. Isiphetho U-Cassper Nyovest ungumculi ophumelelayo, umphakathi, kanye nomphakathi. Ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayifiki kalula, kodwa idinga ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzinikela, nokuhlonipha. Ngendlela ayakha ngayo umculo, ibhizinisi, kanye nomphakathi, u-Cassper ubonisa ukuthi ungumholi ongakha izinguquko ezinkulu. Lokhu kuyisifundo kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abasha, ukuthi bangathola impumelelo uma behlale bephikelela emaphusheni abo.
Inhloso yewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ukuhlinzeka ngendawo eyodwa yolwazi mayelana nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso ukuvulela indlela phakathi kwabaphakeme nabaphansi, phakathi komnotho wokuqala nowesibili. Le webhusayithi iyazama ukuhlinzeka ngengxenye ebalulekile yokuxhumana nokusiza ngenhloso yokwenzela wonke umphakathi ithuba lokuxhumana nohulumeni. Abasebenzisi abaqondiwe ngababantu baseNingizimu Afrika bavelaphi emhlabeni jikelele, amabhizinisi akhona kanye namabhizinisi azayo eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezikhungo noma abantu bangaphandle abafuna izinsizakalo ezivela kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Le webhusayithi iqukethe ulwazi ngezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ezinikezwa nguhulumeni ezingeni lesizwe. Izinsizakalo zabantu bangaphandle: ulwazi oluthile lwabantu bangaphandle abafuna izinsizakalo ezihlobene nohulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Ngamunye walawa magatsha ahlelwe ngendlela ehambisana nezikhathi zokuphila komuntu noma ibhizinisi. Izikhathi zokuphila zihlukaniswe ngokulandela izigaba zokuphila. Ulwazi ngezinsizakalo nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo luhlelwe ngokwezindawo eziyisixhenxe ezibalulekile, okukhuluma ngazo: incazelo, izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe, imithetho nemigomo, amazinga okuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo nezikhathi, izindleko, amafomu okufanele agcwaliswe, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Njengoba ulwazi lwabhalwa kuqala ngesiNgisi bese luhunyushwa kwezinye izilimi, ulwazi ngezinsizakalo kwezinye izilimi lufakwa kwiwebhusayithi ngemuva kokuhunyushwa. Sebenzisa ikhasi lokuxhumana nathi ukuze uphawule noma ubuze ngalesi siza seZinsizakalo Zikahulumeni. Imephu yewebhusayithi ihlinzeka ngezithombe nezichazamazwi zokwakheka kwewebhusayithi. Ihlelwe ukusuka phansi kuya phezulu, okwenza ulwazi kwiwebhusayithi luhlelwe ngamagatsha nezihloko ezithile. Lokhu kusiza ukubona kahle nokuqonda ukuhlela nokuqukethwe okukhonjiswa yiwebhusayithi. Ikhasi eliyinhloko likhombisa izinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula. Lezi zindawo zokungena ziza ziwusizo ekutholeni izinsizakalo eziyishumi ezivakashelwe kakhulu ngabasebenzisi. Uhlu luhlelwe futhi luhlelwe ngokuhlinzeka ngamanani avakashi epage. Ibhokisi lokusesha likhona kuzo zonke amakhasi ewebhusayithi. Uma ufaka igama lokusesha, lizosesha kwiwebhusayithi yonke leyo mibhalo, likhethe izixhumanisi lapho kwenzeka khona ukufuna okuyinhloko. Umsebenzi wokusesha uwukufuna ulwazi kwezinye iziza zikahulumeni. Izixhumanisi kwezinye iziza zangaphandle zikhonjiswa futhi ngamazwi 'ixhumanisi langaphandle - livula efasiteleni elisha' ezovela ebhokisini uma ikhursi yakho ihambisana naleyo xhumanisi. Le webhusayithi izovuleka efasiteleni elisha ukuze uhlole ezinye iziza. Le webhusayithi izoqhubeka ibuyekezwa ngolwazi olusha. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi noma ngabe lukhona. Nokho, abaklami nabathuthukisi bewebhusayithi yeZinsizakalo Zikahulumeni abakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluvela kwezinye iziza esixhumanisa kuzo luzoba lunembile ngaleso sikhathi. Bheka Izimo Nezimo, isigaba 4.3. Ulwazi luhlelwe kakhulu kule webhusayithi ku-HTML format. Nokho, amanye amadokhumenti atholakala ku-PDF format, ahlinzekwe ngendlela yokuthi ahlale ku-format okufanele abe kuyo ukuze ahlelwe futhi atholakale. Kungathatha isikhathi eside ukuvula amadokhumenti e-PDF. Kulokhu, siphakamisa ukuthi ulande amadokhumenti kukhompyutha yakho bese uwavula lapho. Sebenzisa imouse yakho, u-right-click kumadokhumenti ofuna ukuwadlula. Ku-'Save as' window, khetha indawo ofuna ukuyigcina kumakhompyutha akho, bese uchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Save'. Ifayela lizogcinwa endaweni oyikhethile. Ingabe udinga usizo ngezinkinga ozihlangabezana nazo kule webhusayithi? Sicela uxhumane nathi ku-imeyili: uma unenkinga ngewebhusayithi.
Ukwanda Kwesifo Sikashukela: Izinyathelo Zokuzivikela Nokuphatha Isingeniso Sifo sikashukela, esaziwa nangokuthi i-diabetes, sikhula ngokushesha emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu abaningi bahlupheke futhi badinge ukuphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ukuze uqonde kahle lesi sifo, kubalulekile ukuba nokuqonda okujulile ngalesi sifo, izimbangela zaso, nezinyathelo zokuzivikela. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Isifo Sikashukela Sifo sikashukela siwuhlobo lwesifo sokushoda kokudla kwegazi (insulin) noma ukungasebenzi kahle kwemijikelezo yokudla. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko: i-Type 1 ne-Type 2. I-Type 1 ivame ukuvela kubantu abancane, kanti i-Type 2 ivame ukutholakala kubantu abadala, ikakhulukazi labo abanezinga eliphezulu lesisindo. Ukukhulu kwesifo sikashukela kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zempilo, ezifana nezinkinga zenhliziyo, izinkinga zamehlo, nezinkinga zamathambo. Isigaba 2: Izimbangela Zokwanda Kwenkinga Izimbangela zokwanda kwesifo sikashukela ziningi. Ukudla okungafanele, okungama-carbohydrate aphezulu, ukungasebenzi, nokwanda kwesisindo konke kudlala indima enkulu. Ukucindezeleka nokungaphatheki kahle kwezempilo yengqondo nakho kunomthelela. Ukwaziswa ngalezi zingxenye kubalulekile ukuze uqonde ukuthi ungazivimbela kanjani. Isigaba 3: Izinyathelo Zokuzivikela 1. Ukudla Okunempilo: Qiniseka ukuthi udla ukudla okunempilo. Khetha ama-fruits, imifino, okusanhlamvu okuphelele, nemithombo yeprotein enempilo. Gwema ukudla okunezinga eliphezulu le-sugar ne-fat. 2. Ukuzivocavoca: Zama ukufaka ukuzivocavoca empilweni yakho nsuku zonke. Ukuzivocavoca okulinganiselwe, njengo jogging, ukuhamba, noma ukuhamba ngebhayisikili, kungasiza ekwehliseni isisindo nokugcina izinga le-sugar ligcinwe kahle. 3. Ukwazi Izimpawu: Thola ukuqonda izimpawu zalesi sifo, ezifana nokukhathala, umkhuhlane, nokungakhululeki. Uma ubona lezi zimpawu, hamba kudokotela ukuze uthole ukuhlolwa. 4. Ukuphathwa Kwezempilo: Qhubeka uvakashele udokotela ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi impilo yakho iyaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela izinkinga eziphakeme. Isigaba 4: Ukuphatha Isifo Sikashukela Uma usuthole isifo sikashukela, kubalulekile ukufunda ukuphatha lesi sifo. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Ukwazi Ukudla Okufanele: Funda ukuhlonza okokudla okunempilo nokuthi ungakudla kanjani ukuze ugcine izinga le-sugar ligcwele kahle. 2. Izibalo Zesifo: Qonda ukuba nemiphumela yokuqinisekisa izinga le-sugar emzimbeni wakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba wazi uma kudingeka ushintshe indlela ophila ngayo. 3. Ukusebenza Nabadokotela: Sebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala kubadokotela ukuze uthole ulwazi olusha mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha lesi sifo. Ukubambisana nodokotela bakho kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila kahle. Isigaba 5: Ukuxhumana Nabangane Nezihlobo Ukwabelana ngolwazi nezihlobo zakho kubalulekile. Cela usizo lapho udinga khona, futhi uzizwe ukhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zakho. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukuqonda phakathi kwabantu abaseduze nawe. Isiphetho Ukwanda kwesifo sikashukela akuyona into okumele siyijabulele, kodwa singenza izinyathelo ezithile ukuze sizivikele. Ngokulandela izinyathelo zokudla okunempilo, ukuzivocavoca, nokuphatha kahle, singanciphisa umthelela wokwanda kwesifo sikashukela empilweni yethu. Qhubeka uzinakekele, futhi uhlale unolwazi olusha ukuze uphumelele ekuphathweni kwempilo yakho.
Imboni yokumbiwa kwamaminerali eNingizimu Afrika idlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni womhlaba. Ngo-2001, ukumbiwa kwamaminerali kwaba nesandla esingaphezu kuka-6% ku-Gross Domestic Product (GDP) yelizwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhiqizwa kwekholi kuyinsiza eyinhloko yokusebenza kwamandla kubakhiqizi bokukhanyisa eNingizimu Afrika, abaphinde bayithumele kwamanye amazwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhiqizo yensimbi nemikhiqizo engeyona insimbi ibalulekile embonini yokwakha futhi isekela ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwengqalasizinda yelizwe. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) ibheka ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi bemigodi nabanye abathintekayo ezindleleni zokumba. Iphokophela ekwehliseni izigameko zokulimala nezifo, ngaleyo ndlela ibonisa izinselelo ezibhekene nomkhakha wokumbiwa kwamaminerali. Impilo yomsebenzi iyinselele ukuyilinganisa nokuyilawula, njengoba imiphumela yomsebenzi empilweni yomuntu ingase ingabi sobala ngokushesha. Izifo zamaphaphu nokulahleka kokuzwa ngenxa yezwi yizinkinga ezinkulu zempilo emkhakheni wokumbiwa kwamaminerali, ezidalwa ukusebenza ezindaweni ezinothuli nezinyembezi isikhathi eside. Imigodi yegolide ithola abasebenzi abaningi kakhulu emkhakheni wokumbiwa kwamaminerali uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izimboni; ngakho-ke, abasebenzi bayo bahlala besengozini enkulu yezifo zokuphefumula uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abakwiwezinye imigodi. Isifo samaphaphu esikhathazayo kakhulu emigodini yegolide yi-silicosis, etholakale kuwo wonke amagodi aqinile, ngesikhathi sokumba nokugaya imayini, lapho izingcezu ze-silica zingaba phezulu komoya. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezibeka abasebenzi engozini ye-silica nesifo se-silicosis kudala ingozi yokuthola i-tuberculosis. I-silicosis iphinde ibe yinkinga enkulu emigodini yekholi. Kukhona ukuqaphela okukhulayo kwezwi njengengozi yempilo kubasebenzi abangaphansi komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika. Imboni yethule uhlelo lokuvikela ukuzwa (HCPs) ngo-1988, njengoba imisebenzi eminingi eyenziwa ekukhishweni kwemaminerali yaholela enanini elikhulu labasebenzi abavulelekile ezingeni lokuzwa eliphakeme kakhulu elamukelekile futhi eliphephile elingu-85 dB. Nakuba izinyathelo zithathwe ukuze kulawulwe izingozi zezwi, le nkinga isaqhubeka. Kubalwa ukuthi phakathi kuka-68% no-80% babasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ezingeni lokuzwa elingu-85 dB noma ngaphezulu, okukhombisa ukuthi iningi labasebenzi laba bahlala besengozini yokulahlekelwa ukuzwa. Imigodi ebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu mayelana nokuphepha emsebenzini iyimigodi yegolide neplatinamu. Eminyakeni yakamuva, ukumbiwa kweplatinamu kukhule, kuholela emisebenzini eminingi. Ngeshwa, lokhu kuphinde kuholele ekwandeni kwezinga lokulimala. Kutholakale ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa nokwaziswa emkhakheni weplatinamu kuphansi kulokhu kukhula. Imboni yokumbiwa kwamaminerali yegolide ihola ezimeni zokulimala ngenxa yokujula kokusebenza nokwehla kwezinsimbi. Nakuba ukusebenza kwemigodi yegolide kwehle kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, le nqubo ayibonisi ukuthuthuka kwezinga lokuphepha ngesikhathi esifanayo. Nakuba kungase kube nokuhluka ngenxa yezinhlobo zomsebenzi wokumbiwa ngaphansi komhlaba nezinga leengozi ezimeni zokumbiwa, lezi zingozi zomsebenzi zidinga ukuphathwa kahle okwandisiwe. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuwa komhlaba kuhlala kuyindlela evamile futhi ebangela ukufa emigodini yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukulahleka kokuphila kanye nenani lokulimala okwenza abasebenzi bahluleke emsebenzini kule mboni kungancishiswa ngokukhetha nokusebenzisa izinyathelo zokulawula ezifanele nokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izinga eliphezulu lokuhambisana nemithetho lihlala ligcinwa. Ukuphepha emigodini emincane nakho kuyakhathaza ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokulimala okukhona lapho. Kutholakale ukuthi imbangela yale nkinga ukuqeqeshwa okulinganiselwe nezinsiza ezinganele. Abasebenzi kulomkhakha badinga usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwemigodi, futhi imikhankaso ehlukahlukene iqalile ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oludingekayo. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) isekela imikhankaso ebanzi, njengokukhuthaza imigodi emincane. Ekugcineni, le ofisi iyingxenye yokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS. Isekela imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi nezinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokwehlisa ukuvela kwe-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wokumbiwa. Iphinde yasungula ikomidi le-tripartite elibhekelela i-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wokumbiwa. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi nezibanzi ezibhekene nomkhakha wokumbiwa, uhlelo oluqinile lokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo, kuhlanganise nabaqashi nohulumeni, lungahlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. UMbutho wezinsiza zamaminerali namandla (DME) ubheka kahle imikhakha yamaminerali namandla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa. Omunye wemigomo yawo ukuqinisa ukuthi lezi zinkampani zibe nezindawo zokusebenza eziphephile nezempilo. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) ikwenza lokhu egameni le-DME, futhi lo mbhalo ugxile kakhulu kuyo. I-MHSI yasungulwa ukuvikela ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi nabanye emigodini. Umbono wayo uwukubhekana nezibopho zayo ngokuqinile nangendlela ekhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kahle, nemiphumela emihle ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe kuleli kanye nakwamanye amazwe zokuphepha nempilo emkhakheni wokumbiwa. Izenzo eziholayo ze-MHSI zifaka phakathi ukuhlola imigodi, ukuhlola nokuhlola izingozi nezinye izigameko ezihlobene nokuphepha nempilo, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana noMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwamaminerali (MHSA) ka-1996, okuwumgomo walolu hlelo lokuhlola. Amandla e-MHSI okuqhuba umthetho afaka phakathi ukukhipha izaziso zokuhambisana kanye nokuvalela imigodi, ukufaka izijeziso, nokwenza izincomo mayelana nokudluliswa kwabaphula umthetho. I-MHSI ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukukhipha okuphephile kwamaminerali nokuthi ukusebenza kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziphilayo. Ukulawulwa okungcono kusungulwa ngemva kokuxoxisana okuningi nazo zonke izithakazelo embonini. Ubudlelwano be-tripartite, ukuhlola izingozi, ukucubungula izinhlelo ezihlelwe, ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kanye nezibalo ezijwayelekile, ucwaningo, nokuhlola konke kubalulekile emisebenzini ye-MHSI ukuze kufezwe imiphumela. Nokho, ihhovisi lokuhlola lidinga ukwesekwa komphakathi wonke wokumbiwa ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo, njengoba bonke bazothola inzuzo. Abasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezingaba yingozi ngenxa yezwi, ukunyakaza, ukushisa nokubanda, umsebenzi ophindaphindiwe onzima, amakhemikhali ayingozi, uthuli, namagesi anama-toxicity aphezulu. Bahlupheka ngokulahlekelwa ukuzwa, i-silicosis, i-pneumoconiosis, i-tuberculosis, isifo sezinhlayiya
b Thuthukisa ukuvikelwa nokufinyelela ekuqinisekiseni ubulili obulinganayo; futhi c ukuqapha, ukuhlola nokuhlonza ukuhlonishwa kokulingana kobulili namalungelo abesifazane lapha eRiphabhulikhi. I-Sekretariyethi ibandakanyeka nasezinhlelweni ezahlukene zomnyango futhi iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu, uNkk. Chana Majake. Imiphumela ebhaliwe mayelana nezindaba ibibe yisihloko sokuhlola nokuphenya. Amadokhumenti okukhala aqediwe ahlobene nezinsongo ezahlukene eziphathelene nokucwaswa ngokobulili. Umfakisicelo kumele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe ku-Government Gazette [Isaziso soMnyango inombolo R187- edlulelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002] (ifomu A). Umfakisicelo kumele futhi akhombise ukuthi uyacela yini ikhophi yedokhumenti noma ufuna ukuyibona mathupha ehhovisi leKomishini. Uma umuntu ecela ukuthi akhombiswe amadokhumenti ngendlela ethile, kumele akhombiswe ngendlela ayicelile. Ngaphandle kokuthi ukwenza kanjalo kuzophazamisa ngokungadingekile ukusebenza kwaleyo miphakathi yomphakathi noma kudale umonakalo kudokhumenti, noma kuphule ilungelo ledokhumenti elingelona idokhumenti yomphakathi. Uma ngenxa yezizathu ezithile idokhumenti ingakhombiswa ngendlela eceliwe, ingakhombiswa ngenye indlela, futhi imali ekhokhwayo kumele ibalwe ngokwesimo lapho idokhumenti izokhombiswa. Uma umfakisicelo ecela ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kumele akhombise isikhundla lapho isicelo senziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 182f. Uma umfakisicelo engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma engasebenzi kahle, angafaka isicelo ngomlomo. Umfakisicelo ocela idokhumenti equkethe ulwazi lwakhe siqu akadingi ukukhokha imali. Umphathi wolwazi kumele azise umfakisicelo (ngaphandle kwalowo ocela ulwazi lwakhe) ngokuthumela isaziso sokuthi kumele akhokhe imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo siqhubeke. Imali yesicelo ekhokhwayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi ingama-R35. Umfakisicelo angafaka ukukhala ngaphakathi, uma kudingeka, noma afake icala enkantolo uma ephikisa ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi umphathi wolwazi enze isinqumo mayelana naleso sicelo, umfakisicelo kumele aziswe ngaleso sinqumo ngendlela ayicelile ukuba aziswe. Uma isicelo samukelwa, imali eyengeziwe yokufuna, yokuhlela, noma yokuphinda ikhokhiswa, kanye nesikhathi esichithwa sokuqhubeka nedokhumenti kumele ikhokhwe uma sidlula isikhathi esichaziwe sokufuna nokuhlela amadokhumenti okufanele akhishwe. Usizo lweKomishini luwumsebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo noma iminyango eyenziwa yiKomishini ukuze igcwalise umthwalo wayo. Kungase kube nezinye izinhlelo ezihlukene ezihlanganisiwe ngaphansi kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ezichaza umsebenzi weKomishini: isibonelo, uMnyango Wezobulungiswa, Ucwaningo, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola, Imfundo Yomphakathi, nolwazi. Izinhlelo eziphakathi kweUcwaningo, ukuqapha, nokuhlola zingaba yisisekelo solwazi. Umthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili inombolo 39 ka-1996 yinto esungula umsebenzi weKomishini okungukuthi ukuvikela, ukukhuthaza, nokuthuthukisa ukuvumelana kobulili nokuthuthukisa isimo sabesifazane kuhulumeni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, ebhizinisini, nasemkhakheni ongezansi. Ukuqapha nokuhlola noma yisiphi Isinqumo sePhalamende noma noma yimuphi omunye umthetho noma isivumelwano sokuhlola izikhalazo ezivela noma ngemuva kokuthola isikhalazo bese kuzama ukuxazulula noma yisiphi isimo noma ukulungisa isenzo noma ukwehluleka ukwenza okuthile. Izinqubomgomo zokuhlola nokuhlola, izinhlelo zokusebenza zikahulumeni, abamele uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nomkhakha ongezansi. Ukuze uthole usizo kwiKomishini, isicelo kumele senziwe sithunyelwe kumphathi omkhulu weKomishini usebenzisa ulwazi olunikeziwe ku-B ngenhla. Amakhomidi ngokuya ngesigaba -5 - seMthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili mayelana nalabo okufanele baphakanyiswe kulawo makhomidi. Izinhlelo zokuzithandela kanye nomsebenzi wesikhashana - kunenqubomgomo yokusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze kuqashwe abantu bendawo ukuze bagcwalise lezi zikhala. Abacwaningi besikhashana - kunenqubomgomo mayelana nokuphakanyiswa kwabacwaningi. IKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili nezinye izikhungo ezisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesahluko sesishiyagalolunye (seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho inombolo 108 ka-1996) azinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokudlulisa izikhalazo njengamanye amahhovisi omphakathi. Umuntu onenkinga kumele asondele enkantolo uma kukhona isikhalazo mayelana nokungahambisani nomthetho yiKomishini. IKomishini izobuyekeza le dokhumenti ngokuya ngesigaba 14, phakathi nesikhathi esingadluli unyaka owodwa. Ukumelwa ngolimi ezintathu olukhuluma kule ndawo yokugcina idokhumenti okukhulunywa ngayo kuMthetho Wokugcina Amadokhumenti ka-1997; zonke izikhungo zeKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili kanye neKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu.
Ukhetho lokuqala lwezokhetho olukhululekile ezweni lethu lwenzeka ngomhla ziyi-27 kuMbasa, ngonyaka ka-1994, futhi manje sesiseduze nokugubha iminyaka eyishumi yalolu suku. Ilungelo lokuphila emphakathini okhululekile lingathathwa kalula ngoba abaningi benu babancane ngo-1994 futhi bazi kuphela okwenzeka ngesikhathi samanje. Ukulwa ukuze kube nokukhululeka nokulingana komphakathi, lapho kukhona isikhala phansi kwelanga kubo bonke abanye abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, kungakhathaliseki ubuzwe, ubulili, inkolo, ulimi, noma yimuphi omunye umehluko, akuzange kube lula. Akuthathanga izinyanga, iminyaka, noma ngisho neminyaka eyishumi ukufezekisa, kodwa okungukuthi, kuthathe amahlandla amakhulu eminyaka ahlanganisa umlando weNingizimu Afrika. Ilungelo kanye nenhlanhla yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika okufanele ikwaziwa ngokuqinile, futhi nina njengentsha yalesi sizwe ninamandla abalulekile okumele nibambe. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo emphakathini okhululekile yilungelo lokuvota. Ilungelo lokuvota linika imvume yokuba yingxenye yenqubo ethatha isinqumo sokuthi iyiphi iphathi yezenkolo noma amaphathi aphatha izwe. Ukhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo kuthinta ngqo nangokungaqondile izinqubomgomo nemithetho ephatha umphakathi wethu, okugcina kuthinta impilo yomuntu ngamunye. Umuntu ngamunye kumele enze izinqumo ngokwakhe, izinqumo ezenziwa ngesisekelo somphakathi abahlala kuwo - futhi ngokuvota kwabo ezikhethweni zokuphatha bendawo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bangashintsha uhlobo lomphakathi. Ukuze ukwazi ukuvota, kumele ubhaliswe njengomvoti. Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-16 abanencwadi yokuhlonza enebhakhodi bangafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengabavoti. Kulabo abaneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu ngosuku lokhetho bazofakwa ohlwini lwabavoti. Abasasele ngaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ngosuku lokhetho lwezindawo nezwe bazofakwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ohlwini lwabavoti ngosuku lwabo lokuzalwa lwe-18. Lokhu kuzobavumela ukuba babambe iqhaza ezikhethweni ezizayo zamaphathi omasipala njengoba kuzokwenzeka ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi ngesikhathi sokhetho olujwayelekile lwamasipala lwango-2005/6. Abanye benu banelisa ukuvota futhi bayazi ukuthi iyiphi iphathi enizimisele ukuyisekela. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yenu. Nokho, abaningi benu bangase bazizwe bengaqiniseki ngokuvota ngempela noma ukuthi bangavota ngubani. Lokhu kuyavuma uma ukhumbula ukuthi uzoba nesithakazelo kulolu daba kuphela uma ubhaliswe njengomvoti. Ukubhaliswa njengomvoti kuzokunika ithuba lokubamba iqhaza noma ungabambi iqhaza ekhethweni, kukushiya nezinye izinketho zokuthi iyiphi iphathi yokuyisekela. Futhi kumele uhlale ukhumbula ukuthi ungowodwa owaziyo ukuthi iyiphi iphathi oyisekelayo - ukuvota kwakho kuyimfihlo empeleni. Intsha iyazibuza ukuthi ukuvota kwabo kubalulekile yini futhi ukuthi kwenza umehluko. Ngaphezu kokukwazi kwakho ukufaka umthelela njengomvoti obhalisiwe, kumele kube sobala ukuthi uvota noma ungavoti. INingizimu Afrika inohlelo lokhetho oluphakathi kokwakhiwa. Lolu hlelo lokhetho, njengasezinye izizwe, lapho ophumelelayo ekhethweni ethatha konke. Uhlelo lwethu lunesisekelo lapho amaphathi amancane nalawo anokwesekwa okuncane athola ukuveza ngokulandela ukwesekwa kwawo. Okumele ukhumbule ukuthi ohlelweni nasekuvezeni, ukuvota kwakho akukhuphuli kuphela ingxenye yokuvota kwazo zonke izinkanyezi zephathi oyisekelayo, kodwa futhi kwehlisa ngokufanayo ingxenye yazo zonke ezinye amaphathi abamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuyiqiniso lemathematics ongakuhlola ngempela nomthelela wentsha eyizigidi eziyisithupha ezingaphansi kweminyaka engama-25 ezingaba nomthelela emiphumeleni yokhetho. Konke okukhuluma ngenhla kuncike ekubhaliseni kwakho njengomvoti. Ukubhaliswa kwakho kukunika amandla okufaka umthelela futhi kukwenza ufaneleke. Uma ungabhaliswanga njengomvoti, kubi ngoba ngeke ukwazi ukufaka umthelela futhi uzokwenza ungafaneleki ezinqubweni zethu zokukhululeka. Nokho, ukuthi uvota kanjani nokuthi uzovota kanjani kuyisinqumo ongakwenza esikhathini esizayo, kodwa okwamanje, ungazithuthukisa ngokubhaliswa. Izinsuku zokubhaliswa ziyi-24 kuJanuwari no-25 kuJanuwari, 2004, futhi kumele ubhaliswe endaweni okhulele kuyo. Uyanxusa ukuthi ukhuthaze amalungu omndeni wakho nabangane ukuba babhaliswe ngaphambi kokhetho.
Izikhukhula ZaseKZN: Ukuphila Ngaphakathi Kwemvelo Ngiyabonga, ngiyavuma, izikhukhula zaseKZN ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu kulezi zinsuku. UZululand, uMkhanyakude, noThekwini, lezi zindawo ziye zathinteka kakhulu. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi izikhukhula zenzeka kanjani? Ngizokutshela. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula zidalwa izimo zezulu ezinzima. Uhlanga lwezulu lungashintsha ngokushesha, futhi uma imvula ikhuluma, amanzi adlula emakhaya. Ukuhamba kwamanzi emadolobheni, emakhaya, nasezindaweni zokulima sekuyinto evamile. Ingabe ubona izithombe ezikhombisa amanzi adlula ezindlini? Lokhu akukhona nje okungokwemvelo; kudinga abantu bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zishiya umonakalo omkhulu. Abantu balahlekelwa yizimpahla zabo, futhi abanye bahlala bephuma ezindlini zabo. Ukuphila kwabo kuncike kakhulu ekutholeni usizo. Njengoba sikhuluma, izikhungo zokuhlala zikhona, kodwa akukhona bonke abathola usizo olufanele. Abantu badinga ukuxhaswa, okudinga izinhlelo ezinhle zokuphendula. Kodwa akukhona konke okubi. Ingabe uyazi ukuthi abantu bayazama kanjani ukusiza? Izikhungo zomphakathi, izinkampani, nabantu ngabanye baye bahlala bezama ukusiza. Ingabe ubona izithombe zabantu bephakathi kokusiza? Lokhu kuveza umoya wokubambisana. Uthando lomphakathi luyasivusa, futhi luthuthukisa umoya wethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo yezenhlalakahle. Izikhukhula zishiya abantu bezwa ubuhlungu, futhi lokho kudinga sikhulume ngempilo yengqondo. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile bangase babe nezingqinamba ezinzima. Ukuze sikwazi ukusiza, kudinga izinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa abantu. Ingabe siyazi ukuthi izikhungo zokwelapha zingasiza kanjani? Lokhu kufanele kube yinto esiyihloniphayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubo ezinhle zokuphendula. Ukuphathwa kwezimo ezinjalo kudinga izinhlelo ezilungile. Abantu badinga ukufundiswa ukuvikela. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokweluleka, futhi lokho kumelwe kwenziwe ngempela. Ngabe sikhumbula ukuthi izikhukhula zenzeka kanjani? Ngabe sikhumbula ukuthi imvula ingashintsha impilo yethu? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo. Ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela abantu, kudinga izinqubomgomo ezinhle. Lokhu kumelwe kube yinto esiyihloniphayo. Ekugcineni, izikhukhula zaseKZN zifundisa ukuthi impilo iyashintsha. Ngabe sikhumbula ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle? Lokhu kudinga izinyathelo. Uthando lomphakathi, ukusizana, nokubambisana kuyasivusa. Ingabe sikhumbula ukuthi imvelo iyasithinta, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela? Lokhu kudinga izinqubomgomo ezilungile, futhi lokho kumelwe kube yinto esiyihloniphayo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukusiza abanye. Izikhukhula zikhumbuza ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubomgomo ezinhle, futhi lokho kumelwe kube yinto esiyihloniphayo.
Ushintsho kuMthetho 1. Ukuqonda kahle i-GNSS kusho ukuthi izinga lokuhambisana phakathi kokulinganiselwa okucatshangwa, ukukala okutholakele, noma isimo esidingekayo noma ikhono lesistimu ngesikhathi esithile kanye nesimo sangempela noma amandla, kuvame ukuvezwa ezilinganisweni zephutha zezibalo ohlelweni futhi kuchazwa njengento engalindelekile, ephindaphindwayo ngokusebenzisa ukuqhathanisa. Umgwaqo we-C4 nezinga lokulawula ukuhamba kuphela uma umshini udinga uhlelo lokulawula ukuhamba oluqondile ukuhlinzeka ngezinga lobuchwepheshe be-GPS elilingana nalokho okukhona ku-RAIM. Qaphela: Uhlelo lwe-GNSS lwezinga C luzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezinkulu ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nangaphandle. Inqubo yokunyakaza kwefu ichaza amasu ahlukahlukene athinta ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokundiza ezihlobene nezivikelo ezitholakele ukuze kugwenywe ukuphazamiseka ngesikhathi sokusebenza kuze kube yilapho indiza ixhumana ngempela nomhlaba lapho yonke insiza yokubamba umhlaba noma ukuqala kabusha komjikelezo wokundiza kuqedile ngenxa yokwehluleka ukugcina iphethini ejwayelekile; uma indiza yehluleka ukugcina kahle, ibuyela esimweni lapho ingakhokha khona emoyeni noma ilinde isimo sokubamba esifanele. I-GNSS ichaza uhlelo lwe-Global Navigation Satellite System olusetshenziselwa ukubeka izindiza endaweni. Uhlelo nesikhathi esichaziwe endaweni kufaka phakathi ubuchwepheshe noma ukuqeqeshwa kwabo okuhamba phakathi kwezinkanyezi, izithuthukisi zokundiza, kanye namakhono okuqapha asiza ekusekeleni ukuhlola nokubona izimoto ezihamba phakathi kwezinkanyezi. Umcimbi we-GNSS uchaza umcimbi onjengalowo kanye nezimo ezifanayo nezokuphazamiseka komshini, izinkomba, noma iphutha lomuntu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Uhlelo lokuhola indiza lwezinga lokuqala luchaza uhlelo lokuhola umoya oluvunyiwe yiKhomishini yokusebenza ethile noma isikhathi sokundiza esithembekile nokuqondile kodwa akusho ukuthi ihlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala nokusebenza ngendlela engaphazamiseki. Ukwamukela, Ukuhlola, Nokwethembeka Kolwazi Olutholakele Ngobuchwepheshe Bezinkanyezi (RAIM) kuchaza isu lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS lunquma ukwethenjelwa kwezimpawu zokulawula indiza nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakala ngosayizi ukuya ezinkanyezini. "I-RVSM" ichaza umehluko okhona phakathi kwezinga lokundiza elingaphezu kuka-290 kuya ku-1000 amaphakethe uma kubhekwa ohlangothini lokuphuma ngalolu suku kanye no-1000 amaphakethe ubheka lapho indiza ihamba khona." "I-RVSM airspace" ichaza indawo yomoya phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 kanye ne-410." "I-RVSM authorization certificate" ichaza isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuhambisana kwendiza kanye nekhono leqembu lokundiza ukusebenzisa indawo yomoya ye-RVSM."
