Uma ufuna ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho lokulima ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukusetha imigomo nezifiso zakho. Awukwazi ukuhamba endleleni ungazi ukuthi uhamba kuphi. Ngokuvamile, abakhiqizi babizwa ngokuthi abakwazi noma abaphoxekile ngokungasethi imigomo yebhizinisi noma yezomuntu. Kunzima ukuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima ngoba izimo zalesi sisebenzi azilula; awazi ukuthi ikusasa lizokubamba ini. Kudinga isikhathi esiningi ukuhlanganisa imigomo ecacile yebhizinisi lokulima. Kokubili lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa izifiso kuyinto engafanele ishiywe emuva, nakuba kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi. Imigomo nezifiso (amasu) zikhombisa indlela phambili; ngaphandle kwazo, awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi uzophumelela noma uphumelele. Ngaphandle kwemigomo, awukwazi ukukala ukuthi usebenza kahle yini ngoba awunankanyezi ofuna ukuyifinyelela. Ukuhlanganisa inhloso nokusetha imigomo emsebenzini wokulima kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi, kodwa kubalulekile ukwenza lo msebenzi; kumele siwenze. Ukusetha nokuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima kuvame ukuza nezinkinga. Isizathu salokhu sitholakala lapha: ukulima kuyindlela yokusebenza komlimi futhi kuyindlela umlimi aphila ngayo (yimpilo yabo). Umndeni wabo ungowengxenye yezinto ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabo wokulima nempilo yabo. Ngokuvamile, siyazi ukuthi umgomo omkhulu webhizinisi ukuwenza inzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kodwa ekulimaleni, lokhu akuhambisani njalo ngoba ibhizinisi nempilo yokuphila kuhlangene. Singasho ukuthi imigomo yalolu sizo ingaba ukufinyelela inzuzo enhle, kodwa akufanele ilethe umlimi nomndeni wakhe ubunzima. Izifiso ezihlanganisiwe ngenhla azichazi kahle futhi zingabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kodwa uma zisetshenziswa, lezi zifiso zicacile ngoba awekho abantu ababili abacabanga ngokufanayo noma baphila ngendlela efanayo futhi abavumi umndeni omuhle ngendlela efanayo. Ngakho-ke, isifiso somlimi sokwenza inzuzo sizohluka ngoba omunye ngeke abuke lezi zinto ngendlela efanayo futhi ngeke alandele indlela efanayo yokwenza inzuzo. Nokho, kubalulekile kumlimi othile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi impilo enhle izobiza malini uma kuqhathaniswa nomsebenzi wabo wokwenza inzuzo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele kubo nasemaphusheni abo. Umphakathi udinga umkhakha wezolimo ukuze ukhiqize izinto ezithile - lokhu kuzohambisana namakhono ezwe elithile - ikakhulukazi ukudla nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ngentengo ephansi, futhi siqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngaleyo nto. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abalimi kufanele basebenzise izinsiza zemvelo ikakhulukazi isikhathi eside. Kodwa imigomo evamile kuphela ngeke ikwanele. Umsebenzi ngamunye udinga umgomo othile, kodwa lowo mgomo kufanele uhambisane nenhloso evamile. Isibonelo: umlimi ofuna ukukhiqiza ufulawa kufanele abe nomgomo othile mayelana nomsebenzi wokukhiqiza ufulawa, masithi uhlose ukulima amahektare angu-500 efulawa elibomvu ngonyaka. Kodwa akupheli lapho. Kumele bazi futhi ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo mayelana nemisebenzi edingekayo nezindleko ezizovela ngoba lokhu kuzobakhombisa ukuthi amasheya abo ahambelana kanjani nezidingo zamaseyidi nezimuncu. Um limi ngamunye kufanele uqonde ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo. Siphinda sithi kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izifiso; um limi kufanele aqonde kahle ukuthi ufuna ukuya kuphi ngebhizinisi lakhe lokulima. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kulezi zifiso, um limi kufanele ahlale phansi acabange ukukhetha imigomo efanele kubo, empilweni yabo, nasezidingweni zabo. Lapho beqala ukwakha amasheya amasha ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambisana nezifiso ezivamile nezidingo zabo. Konke esikushilo mayelana nokuhlanganisa izifiso kungafingqwa kulezi zisho ezimbalwa: umgomo webhizinisi lokulima ukufuna ukufinyelela inzuzo enkulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza zemvelo (izimpahla) ezifana nomhlabathi, amanzi, izifunda, njll., ukuze zisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezinhle isikhathi eside. Kumele baphathe izinhlelo zokubheka ukuze baqhubeke behlanganisa ulwazi oluzobavumela ukuba baphendule indlela yabo yokusebenza masinyane uma umonakalo utholakala. Ukuhlanganisa izifiso kufana nokubuza "lokhu kusho ukuthini" emsebenzini wokulima, okusho ukuthi sifuna impendulo embuzweni "Yini esifuna ukuyenza, yini esifuna ukuyifinyelela, kuphi esifuna ukufika?" Ezinye imigomo nezifiso zikhathaza. Kubalulekile ukusungula inani elithile lemikhiqizo ngehektare - lokhu kusho ukuthi inani lemikhiqizo elibekwe ebhajethi yonyaka kufanele likwazi ukufezeka. Lokhu kuhluka phakathi kwezindawo zokulima ezithile. Qinisekisa ukuthi umkhiqizo wakho uhambisana nezidingo zemakethe - umphathi womkhiqizo kufanele abeke phambili izifiso ezizohlangabezana nalezo zidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinto ezifana nosayizi, umbala, ikhwalithi yangaphakathi, njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo - lokhu kusho ukuthi izici zemvelo zingase zibe sengozini lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, njengezinto zokwakha ezibulala izilokazane, izimuncu, njll. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kule ndawo kuzokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi usebenza ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeZinhlelo Zokulima Ezinhle (GAP) - i-GAP ifuna ukuthi izinto zokwakha zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela ngoba zingaba sengozini kulabo abasebenza nazo. Izibulala-zilokazane, izibulala-zilokazane, nezimuncu kufanele zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela; amanzi akufanele angcoliswe, futhi izinyathelo kufanele zithathwe ukuvimbela ukulahleka, ukungcoliswa, nokugeleza. Kungase kube nezinye izifiso ezizosebenza ezindaweni zokulima ezithile, kodwa lezi ezichazwe lapha zizokwenza kube lula ukuthi umsebenzi wakho uphumelele.
Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngemva Kwezimali Zamaholide Ngaphambi kokuhlola izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo ziwusizo olukhulu emphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zamaholide. Njengoba abantu behamba bezindaweni ezahlukene, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela kalula, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuba nezinsizakalo ezilungiselelwe ukusiza abantu ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuqonda Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zifaka phakathi izinsizakalo zokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezokuthutha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izibhedlela, amaphoyisa, nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumisa. Ngemva kokuhamba kwabantu, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela ngenxa yokuhlaselwa kwezifo, izingozi zomgwaqo, noma ezinye izimo eziphuthumayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezilungile ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abantu ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Izinsizakalo Zokwelapha Ezikhathini zamaholide, izibhedlela ziba nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe ukuze ziphathe izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukwandisa abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwelapha, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuphuthumisa. Izibhedlela zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha iziguli eziningi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha Ngaphezu kwezinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuphepha zibalulekile. Amaphoyisa, izisebenzi zokuphepha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumisa kudingeka ukuba zibe nezinhlaka ezilungile ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhululekile kubasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokuphepha, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuphuthumisa eziphumelelayo. Ngemva kokuhamba kwabantu, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela ngenxa yokwephulwa kwemithetho, izingozi, noma izimo zokuphila eziphuthumayo. Izinsizakalo Zokuthutha Izinsizakalo zokuthutha zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangeniswa ezibhedlela noma ezikhungweni zokwelapha ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhilela izimoto zokuphuthumisa, izinsizakalo zokuthutha zomphakathi, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuthutha ezizimele. Ngemva kokuhamba kwabantu, izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela ngenxa yokuhlaselwa kwezifo, izingozi zomgwaqo, noma izimo zokuphila eziphuthumayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezilungile ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abantu ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Izinhlelo Zokuphuthumisa Ukuze izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezilungile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwelapha, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuphuthumisa eziphumelelayo. Izinhlelo zokuphuthumisa zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlaka ezilungile ukuze zikwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhululekile kubasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokuphepha, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuphuthumisa eziphumelelayo. Ukubaluleka Kokuhlela Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezilungile zokuhlela izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwelapha, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuphuthumisa eziphumelelayo. Ukuhlela kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukusiza abantu ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhilela izinsizakalo zokwelapha, ezokuphepha, nezokuthutha. Kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezilungile ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abantu ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo, futhi ukuhlela kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sihlale siqaphele futhi silungiselele izimo eziphuthumayo, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi zamaholide lapho izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela kalula.
Izingxenye zezihlahla ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa ezingakaze zithengiswe eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Zikhona ngendlela yezinhlobo zezihlahla, noma amahlamvu, izingxenye ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa, ezingatholakali kwenye izwe, ngokuhweba noma emiphakathini isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha, noma kunoma iyiphi indlela yezinhlobo zezihlahla, iminyaka emine. Kumele zihluke kwabanye ngendlela ecacile ehluke kwezinye izinhlobo ezisondelene nale, futhi kumele zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo, okusho ukuthi zonke izihlahla ezitshaliwe ngesikhathi esifanayo kumele zifane futhi zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo. Kumele zibe zizinzile, izihlahla zohlobo oluthile, emva kokutshala okuphindaphindiwe, kumele zihlale zifana nezihlahla ezindala. Kumele zibe uhlobo olwamukelekayo. Uma izinhlobo zezihlahla zingekho ohlwini, thumela isicelo sokwazisa nencwadi echaza isizathu esivumelekile kuMphathi weMikhakha Yokukhulisa Izitshalo. I-questionnaire yobuchwepheshe egcwele, izimali ezibekwe ukuthi zikhokhwe ngesicelo, kanye nokuhlolwa kwezimpande noma izitshalo ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa izinhlobo zezihlahla, imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kumnikazi, uma ungusabalalisi, izinhlobo ezikhethiwe noma ezithuthukisiwe. Sicela uchaze kwi-questionnaire ukuthi iyiphi izinhlobo le kufanele iqhathaniswe nezinhlobo ezaziwa eNingizimu Afrika, izinhlobo ezintsha kumele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kubonakale umehluko wazo. Ungafaka isicelo sokuvikeleka kwesikhashana kwezinhlobo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlobo zivikelwe ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa. Kumele unikeze ukuzibophezela okubhalwe phansi ukuthi ngeke uthengise noma yiziphi izitshalo zezinhlobo ezihlolwayo kuze kube sekupheleni kokuhlolwa okuphelele futhi amalungelo okukhulisa izitshalo anikezwa. Kunconywa ukuba neziqinisekiso zesikhashana zezihlahla lapho kwenziwa ukuhlolwa kwezinhlobo ezithatha isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Uma uhlu lwezinhlobo lukhona lwezinhlobo zezihlahla ezicela amalungelo okukhulisa, thumela izicelo ndawonye ngezikhathi zonke nezindleko. Inqubo yokuhlola amalungelo okukhulisa isitshalo ithatha cishe isikhathi sesizini sokutshala esisodwa.
Ithensi: Uhambo Lwemfazwe Nayise Kwake kwaba nesixuku esikhulu sezingane eNqabeni, idolobha elikhulu elikhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Phakathi kwazo, uSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyishumi nanye, wayengumthandi ophawulekayo wezemidlalo. Ngaphandle kokuphuma emnyango, wayehamba nomoya okhishwe umdanso omuhle, ethanda umphakathi nempilo. Uthanda kakhulu ukudlala ithenisi, umdlalo obucayi owenza umoya wakhe ube ovuthuza. Njengoba elandela izinyathelo zokuba umphakathi ovelayo emlandweni wezothando, uSipho wayesebhodini eliphathekayo, ebonisa amakhono akhe. Wajabula kakhulu ngesikhathi athola ithuba lokudlala emqhudelwaneni wethenisi wezifunda, phakathi kwemidlalo ebibanjwe ngonyaka. Uxolo lwezinyembezi kwadingeka uSipho ukufunda ukunciphisa imizwa, njengoba imikhuba emisha ingaholela ezinguqukweni ezintsha. Usuku lweqhaza lwalwehlukile. USipho waphuma endlini efake izinto ezidingekayo nemishini yakhe, ezimbalwa ezikhethiwe ezazivumelekile emzamweni. Wangena ngethuba elisha, ewumfana okhula ezinkulumweni zomndeni wakhe. Kulungile, wasebenzisa izinyathelo ezimnyama zomgibeli, evula umoya ozokwenza impumelelo. Esitezi, wabona abanye abantwana bezijabulisa, bejolise kumakhadi nezinkumbulo zomkhathi ophilayo. U-Sipho wavusa ukuthokozisa empilweni yakhe, edlula phakathi kwabantu abashaya izinkanyezi zesibhakabhaka. Wayefuna ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kubonakala sengathi ubude bejuba lwalungaphezu kwempumelelo. Umphakathi, walungile ukwenza izivivinyo, UNkk. Mthethwa, uthisha wakhe owaziwa kakhulu ngezithombe ezithokozisayo, uzomphakamisa. Wafaka izifundo emqondweni wakhe, ukuze angakhulumi ngendlela adinga ukuthi atholakale, kodwa eqhubeka nokuhambisa umoya opholile. U-Sipho wayezwa isizungu, kodwa wavuma ukuqhubeka nokwenza kahle. Umphakathi wanikeza amathuba amaningi, lapho uSipho waqhamuka nabo. Nakuba wathola ubunzima, waqina, ejoyina umjaho oyingozi. Kukho izinyathelo ezizwakalayo ezaziphathelene, nezinyembezi zentokazi yena nomphakathi. Waphakanyiswa izimfumbe zomhlaba, ezimnandi, efaka embonini izimanga zosuku. U-Sipho waba nethuba lokuhlangana nomphakathi wezithombe ezimnandi. Wafunda ukwenza izinto ezithokozisayo, nendlela yokubuyisa imiphumela emihle. Uzwela ukukhuluma noSipho, owawuthokoza ngempela, ngenkathi abanye bezama izinto ezintsha. Kwakunemizamo emisha emkhatsini wabo. U-Sipho waphakanyiswa igama elisemqoka emzabalazweni, ukwandisa ubuchwepheshe. Uthisha wakhe, UNkk. Mthethwa, umemezela ukuthi iqhaza lakhe livuma ukufunda izifundo, ukuhlola amakhono akhe, noSipho. Hhayi njalo, uSipho wakhasa isisusa esikhulu sokuhlangana nemifantu emisha. Wabona ukuze abezwe ukwenziwa okuhle, ebonisa amakhono obuchwepheshe endaweni ethize. Uthando lwakhe lweqhawe, ku-Nkosi, waphumelela ngezinyathelo ezimnandi. Kwathi emcimbini, uSipho waqala ukudlala namaqhawe amakhulu, ulungiselela umphakathi wezempilo. Vele, kurhwebo olwakheka umthombo, umhlathi omusha bekhuphuka phakathi kwakhe, udumo lwezenzo ezinhle. Kwaba ugqozi lokuba uSipho abuyele emkhathini, umkhathizwe wethu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa umphakathi ‘nemizamo, ngaleyondlela, wenza umphakathi ubone. Wenze abantu bajabule nempilo zibe ngcongwana, besebenzisa uthi lomoya wengomeza. U-Sipho, uthando lokuphishekela izimpumelelo, wakhombisa ukuthi umphakathi akuyona into eyokwenziwa njengenkanyezi, kodwa ngempela omunye ovuswa nempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba isibonelo sabanye, eqhubeka nokudlala ithenisi, evula umhlaba omusha. Imigudu yakhe yaphetha ekugcineni ngempumelelo enkulu, ihlale ihlonishwa. Uthando lwakhe nolwazi, lwaba wumbono obonakala mkhulu, waqina, wagcina izakhiwo zendawo ezaziwayo. Ngemva kokuhlangana nezinye izigameko, uSipho waphuma eziteshini zomphakathi ezilungile. Uthando lwezemidlalo lwalwakha indaba yakhe. Kwaze kwaba impumelelo ezihamba phambili, ungqongqoshe, uma kunikeza umphakathi ophilayo izinguquko eziningi phambili. Uhambo lwakhe lwemizwa, lwasijabulisa. Eminyakeni eminingi, uSipho ubephakathi kwebhodi ethe xaxa, eqhubeka nempilo yakhe ethokozisayo, ukuphila ezikoleni ezinkulu, engawa wedwa, kodwa ngokuhamba isikhathi, waba umphakathi obonisa izimanga ezinhle, eqhubeka nezifundo. Noma ngabe imimbangadla yayishiwo, umoya ohloniphekile waba yisifundo esikhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo. Uthando lweqhawe olwalukwazi ukufezekisa iziphuphutheki, lwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophakathi kwamaqhawe angabhalwa, omkhulu nosuku oluthokozisayo. U-Sipho ubalansiwe, ubufuphuma nezinyathelo ezimfundisa ukuba neqhaza kulezi zinsuku ezikhanyayo. Ithempelra, uSipho wayesekela uthando lwakhe. Endabeni ye-ithensi, umphakathi uthokozisa, uchaza uSipho ongalahlwa isikhathi, kuzo zonke izinkanyezi eziphila ngokuphelele. Le ndaba ibonisa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uhloniphe imizamo ebanzi, edlula izimfuno zobuchwepheshe, ubufanele ukufakazela ubuchwepheshe ngempela. U-Sipho, watshala umphakathi, wasiza ophumelele, nokuthi umoya wempumelelo ubalulekile. Ngakho, uhambo lwakhe lwalungcono. U-Sipho waba nesibonelo esihle, galayisha imizwa, rawomkhosini wezimpilo ezithokozisayo. Izinyathelo zakhe zabeziyiphuma, zizesha izinyembezi zeqiniso, zakha umoya onenhlonipho nomdaki. Ngenxa yokuhamba phambili, uSipho ube umkhwabo nomphakathi, kwavela umoya opholile, zonke izinkanyezi zembongolo, umkhathi ophakeme.
Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezokudlala: Umgomo Wokuphumelela Nokuqhubeka Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo sekuye saba yinto ebalulekile empilweni yabaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abathanda imidlalo. Ukuqeqeshwa akukhona nje kuphela ukulungiselela umjaho, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni impilo enempilo, uthando lwezemidlalo, kanye nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Izikhungo eziningi zokuzivocavoca, izikole, kanye nezinhlangano zokuqeqesha ziye zathuthukisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kwabadlali. Izizathu Zokuqeqesha Izizathu zokuthi abantu baqeqeshe ziningi. Okokuqala, ukuqeqeshwa kukhuthaza impilo enhle. Abadlali abaqeqeshayo bahlala bephila kahle, bephucula amandla abo, futhi beqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala bephila impilo enempilo. Okwesibili, ukuqeqeshwa kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isithombe somuntu. Abadlali abaqeqeshwa kahle bahlala bejabulile futhi beqonda kahle imisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emakhazeni lapho umphakathi ubheka khona abanye njengemodeli. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlaka Zokuqeqesha Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zihluke kakhulu kuye ngohlobo lwezemidlalo. Ngokwesibonelo, emhlabeni wezemidlalo yebhola, ukuqeqeshwa kuhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene ezifana nokuzivocavoca, ukwakha amandla, nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Abadlali bahlala behlola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kahle emidlalweni yabo. Ukuze bakwazi ukuphumelela, kudingeka ukuthi bahlale beqeqesha njalo, bahlale bejolise emigomweni yabo, futhi bahlale bephokophele phezulu. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, ukuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo sekuye kwathola izindlela ezintsha. Izinsiza ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlola ukusebenza, izibalo zokusebenza, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ziye zaba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuthuthukisa abadlali. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bahlale benolwazi olwakamuva mayelana nokusebenza kwabo, bahlale beqonda izindlela zokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buvumela abaqeqeshi ukuba baqonde kahle izidingo zomdlali ngamunye, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Imiphumela Yokusebenza Imiphumela yokusebenza kokuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo ibonakala kakhulu. Abadlali abaqeqeshwa kahle baveza izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza emidlalweni yabo, futhi lokhu kubavumela ukuba baphumelele ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi kubadlali abaqhamuka ezindaweni ezithile, lapho umphakathi ubabheka njengabavela ezindaweni eziphakeme. Uhlelo oluhle lokuqeqesha luholela ekwandeni kwamathuba okuthola izikhala emakhazeni, okubavumela ukuba baphumelele futhi baphumelele. Izifundo Zokuthola Izifundo ezitholakala ekuqeqesheni zibalulekile. Abadlali bahlala befunda izinto ezintsha, bahlola izindlela ezintsha, futhi bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo. Ukuqeqeshwa akupheli nje ekupheleni komjaho; kuqhubeka njalo, njengoba abadlali behlola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokuncintisana, futhi kubavumela ukuba bahlale bejabulile emsebenzini wabo. Ubuhlobo Phakathi Kweqembu Ubuhlobo phakathi kwabadlali nabaphathi bayo busemqoka ekuqeqesheni. Ukuqeqeshwa akuyona into eyodwa kuphela; kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabo bonke abathintekayo. Abadlali badinga ukuxhumana nabaphathi ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo zabo, futhi abaphathi badinga ukwazi ukuthi abadlali bahlala bejabulile futhi bephokophele phezulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umoya wokubambisana, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphumelelayo. Isiphetho Ukuqeqeshwa kwezemidlalo kusebenza njengesisekelo sokuphumelela. Akukhona nje kuphela ukulungiselela imijaho, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza impilo enempilo, uthando lwezemidlalo, kanye nokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaqeqeshi, abadlali, kanye nomphakathi bahlale bejolise ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuqeqesha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lezemidlalo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezokudlala.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana (GEMS Doctor Authorization and Communication) Kulezi zinsuku, ukubaluleka kokuxhumana kahle phakathi kwezokwelapha nezinsizakalo zezempilo kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela, ikakhulukazi ngaphansi kwe-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokuhlonipha izinqubo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola usizo lwezempilo bathola ukwelashwa okufanele. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ekubalulekeni kokugunyazwa kodokotela, izinqubo ezidingekayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela kuhilela inqubo lapho udokotela efaka isicelo sokuthi umtholampilo noma insiza ethile ivunyelwe. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokuhlola ukuthi ukwelashwa okukhulunywayo kuhambisana nezidingo zomtholampilo kanye nezimfuneko ze-GEMS. Ukuze le nqubo ibe yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi udokotela ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ecacile mayelana nesimo sempilo somtholampilo, izizathu zokwelashwa, kanye nezinkomba zokuthi kungani le nsiza ibalulekile. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela, abathola usizo, kanye ne-GEMS kubalulekile. Ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezindlela ezicacile zokwabelana ngemininingwane. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izincwadi, noma izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezikwi-inthanethi. Ukuze abathola usizo baqonde kahle inqubo yokugunyazwa, udokotela kufanele abelane ngemininingwane ecacile, futhi kube nokuxhumana okuvamile ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga noma izidingo ezenzakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathola usizo baqonda izinqubo zokugunyazwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele ngalesi sikhathi sokugunyazwa, izikhathi ezithile zokuphendula, kanye nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze kube nokuphumelela. Uma abathola usizo benolwazi olunembile, bazoba nethuba elingcono lokuba nesimo esihle sokwelashwa. Ngokubheka izinselelo ezikhona, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile nezilula zokugunyazwa kodokotela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo bonke abathintekayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngabe udokotela, umtholampilo, noma abathola usizo. Izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuphatha izicelo zokugunyazwa zingasiza ekwenzeni le nqubo ibe lula futhi ibe nesikhathi esifanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezokwelapha nezinsizakalo zezempilo kunciphisa amathuba okuthi kube nezinkinga ezivela ekugunyazweni. Ukuze lokhu kufezeke, udokotela kufanele ahlale ethintana nabathola usizo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi bazi kahle izinqubo, izidingo, kanye nezikhathi ezithile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza futhi kunciphise izinkinga ezingavela ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Ngokuphetha, ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana ngaphansi kwe-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola usizo lwezempilo bathola ukwelashwa okufanele. Ukuze le nqubo ibe yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile, ukuxhumana okuhle, kanye nolwazi olunembile kubo bonke abathintekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abathola usizo babe nempilo engcono, futhi kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo, kusukela kodokotela kuya kubathola usizo, basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuhle, baphumelele ekugunyazweni, futhi bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zezempilo, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ukwelashwa abakufunayo, futhi kube nokuthula phakathi kwezokwelapha kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo.
iFacebook - Umcimbi Wokuxhumana Nokuqukethwe Namuhla, iFacebook ibonakala njengesikhungo esibalulekile sokuxhumana emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Iphakathi kwezindawo ezinkulu zokuxhumana, iFacebook inikeza abantu ithuba lokuxhumana, ukwabelana ngempilo yabo, nezindaba zansuku zonke. Lapha, sizohlola ukusebenza kweFacebook, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nemithelela emiphakathini yethu. IFacebook yasungulwa nguMark Zuckerberg nabangane bakhe ngo-2004, futhi yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu, ikhombisa izici eziningi ezisiza abantu ukuba baxhumane, noma bahlale kude. Abantu babelana ngezithombe, izindaba, nezinto ezenzakalayo, okwakha umuzwa wokuba seduze, nakuba kukhona isikhala esithile. Esinye sezici ezibalulekile seFacebook siwukuthi ivumela ukuxhumana kwamahhala, okuhlanganisa izingxoxo eziphilayo nezithombe, okuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iFacebook iyinsiza enkulu yokwabelana ngolwazi, lapho abantu bengahlola izihloko ezahlukene, behlela imicimbi, futhi babelane ngemibono emisha. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo ogxile ezintweni zansuku zonke. Nokho, iFacebook ibonakala futhi njengenye yezinkinga ezikhulayo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. Ukushintsha kwemizwa, imizwa yokuthula, kanye nezinselelo zokugcina ubudlelwane obuphumelelayo, kuhlobene nezindlela ezithile zokusebenzisa lesi sikhala. Lokhu kudinga imizamo yokuphakamisa ukuqwashisa ngempilo yengqondo. Nakuba kunezinselelo, iFacebook iphumelela ekwakheni amathuba amaningi. Izinkampani zisebenzisa iFacebook njengezindlela zokuhweba, zandisa ukufinyelela kwazo emhlabeni jikelele, okukhuthaza umnotho. Kodwa, kufanele sikhumbule nezingozi zokuphepha, njengokuphazamisa kwabanye nokukhathazeka kokubeka abantu ezimeni ezingezinhle. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu, kanye nomthetho ovumelanayo phakathi kwabahlali. Namuhla, iFacebook ayisiyona nje indawo yokuxhumana, kodwa iyisiqalo sokwakha imiphakathi enobudlelwano. Izithombe, ama-video, nezincwadi zikhombisa ubuhlakani bomuntu kanye nenhlonipho esiyifakayo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinto zingase zibe nomthelela omuhle noma omubi ekuthatheni izinqumo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iFacebook ithuthukisa izici ezintsha njengeMeta, okukhombisa umqondo wokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kukhuthaza umqondo ophambene, obonisa uthando lobuntu. Ngakho, lokhu kuxhumana okumangalisayo kuhamba phambili endimeni yezezimali, kuhlanganise nentuthuko yalabo abathanda ukuphila kahle. Emaphuzwini aphethwe emcimbini, iFacebook iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi ukuxhumana, ubumba, nokuhlangana nabanye kuyasiza. Njengoba sizohlulela uhlelo lokuxhumana, kufanele sithokozise izifundo ezitholakala kulesi sikhala, siqhubeke sithokozisa, siqonde, futhi sihloniphe abanye. IFacebook, njengomcimbi wokuxhumana, iyisithombe esihlanganisa ubumba bempilo yezenhlalakahle. Njengephuzu lokuphila, ibalulekile ekwakheni isimo esikahle sokuxhumana, nokubumbanisa umoya wedlanzana ngolwazi. Ngokuhlanganyela, umcimbi weFacebook ungumcimbi okhuthazayo, ukhuthaza ubuntu, nenhloso. Kulesi sikhala, sonke singaba yingxenye yehlathi lezinhloso ezinhle, sihlale siphila ngenhlonipho, umoya, nokuhlonipha ubumba bempilo bethu. Ngakho, siyakuthokozisa, siphumelele, futhi sibe nempilo ebumbene.
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okuhlangabezana Nezidingo Zabasebenzisi: UThandiwe Mthethwa UThandiwe Mthethwa ungumuntu ophumelelayo, onothando lokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Wazalelwa edolobheni elincane eMpumalanga, lapho akhulela khona, ebona izinselelo eziningi abantu abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kukhula kumenze abe nomdlandla wokwenza umehluko emphakathini wakhe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezeMvelo eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uThandiwe waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengomklami wezikhungo. Waqala emnyangweni wezokwakha, lapho afunda khona izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwakha izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. UThandiwe uhlala eqhubeka nezifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono akhe, efunda ngezindlela zokwakha ezihlala isikhathi eside, eziphumelelayo, nezihambisana nemvelo. Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi akukhona nje ukwakha izakhiwo ezinhle, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuqonda izidingo zabantu. Uthandiwe uqonda ukuthi izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinto ezithokozisayo, ezilula ukufinyelela, futhi ezihlangabezana nezidingo ezahlukene zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala emisebenzini yakhe, lapho ehlanganisa izimvo zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze akhe izikhungo ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. UThandiwe uphinde abe nomdlandla wokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ekwakheni izikhungo. Uhlale ebheka izindlela ezintsha, ezifana nokusebenzisa izinto eziphinde zisetshenziswe, ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela emvelweni. Ubuye abambe iqhaza emisebenzini yokwakha izikhungo ezihlala isikhathi eside, ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uThandiwe uphinde abe nomsebenzi omkhulu wokufundisa, evuleka ukwabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye, futhi ubamba izifundo ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. UThandiwe ukholelwa ekutheni ukufundisa abantu indlela yokwakha izikhungo ezilungele abasebenzisi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zihlala zisebenza kahle. UThandiwe ungumholi ophumelelayo, futhi ubonakala emisebenzini yakhe yokwakha izikhungo ezihambelana nezidingo zabantu. Uhlale efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto, futhi ubamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokwakha izikhungo ezizokwazi ukuxhasa umphakathi. UThandiwe ungumuntu onomdlandla, onothando, futhi onokubona okuhle, futhi ubona izikhungo njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe uqhubekile nokwakha izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, futhi ubona ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe ungumsebenzi ongenakuphuthelwa. Uthanda ukubona abantu bejabule, bephila kahle, futhi bejabulela izikhungo ezakhelwe bona. UThandiwe ubonisa ukuthi ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi uyakwenza lokhu ngenhloso yokwakha umphakathi ongcono. UThandiwe Mthethwa ungumuntu onomdlandla, onothando, futhi onobuchwepheshe bokwakha izikhungo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu. Ubonisa ukuthi ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi uyakwenza lokhu ngenhloso yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. UThandiwe uqhubeka nokwenza umehluko, futhi umphakathi wakhe uyamthokozisa ngempela.
Izilwane nezitshalo eziyingozi zingancishiswa ngokuhlanza. Ngokuwasha nokuhlanza: Hlanza izithelo nezitshalo uma kungenzeka ukuze unciphise uthuli, amabhaktheriya, nezibulala-zinambuzane. Phonsa ngaphandle amashidi angaphandle ezithelo aneziqhamo. Hlanza amafutha enhliziyo kanye nesikhumba sezinhlanzi nezinkukhu ngoba ezinye izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ziqoqwa lapho nasemafutheni. Ukuhlanza kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zabe zidle. Ukupheka kusiza: Ukupheka kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane kokudla ngokuhlanza nokuhlanza. Uhlanga lwezokudla: Dla uhlanga lwezokudla oluvela emithonjeni ehlukene. Ezinye zezibulala-zinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi zisetshenziselwa izitshalo ezithile. Ukudla uhlobo lokudla oluhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zokudla kuyindlela enempilo. Lokhu futhi kuvikela ukudla ekubeni nezinhlayiya eziyingozi zohlobo oluthile noma izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zibe khona. Inani lezibulala-zinambuzane ezisetshenziswa kokudla kanye nezinsalela zazo ezidinga ukuba zibe khona emikhiqizweni ezingeni lemakethe kulawulwa yimithetho ehlukene futhi kubhekwa yiMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wezolimo ngokwehlukana. Imikhiqizo eminingi yasekhaya iqukethe izibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi. Amafungicides; izibulala-zinambuzane ezithile nezibulala-ziqhamo, njengezibulala-zinambuzane; kemikhali ethile esetshenziswa emanzini okubhukuda. Izibulala-zinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi ezibhekiswe ezilwaneni, njengezibulala-zinambuzane ezikhiqizwa ezilwaneni zokubulala izilwane noma izitshalo eziyingozi, ziya zaziwa kakhulu futhi zivame ukuba ziphephe kunezibulala-zinambuzane ezijwayelekile noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Izibulala-zinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi kokudla. Yini izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Izibulala-zinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi yizinto ezihloselwe ukuvikela, ukubulala, ukuheha, ukwehlisa, noma ukulawula noma yiziphi izinhlayiya eziyingozi, kuhlanganisa izinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane ezingase zingadingeki ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza; ukuze zisetshenziswe ekuthumeleni; ukuze zabelwe nokulungiswa kokudla; ukuze zibe imikhiqizo yezolimo; noma ukuze zisetshenziswe njengokudla kwezilwane noma noma yini enikezwa ezilwaneni ukuvimbela izinto eziyingozi ekungeni kwezinye izinhlayiya. Lokhu futhi kuhlanganisa izinto ezihloselwe ukusetshenziswa njengokulawula ukukhula kwezilwane; njengokubulala amashidi; njengokuwomisa; njengokunciphisa izithelo noma njengokuvimbela ukukhula nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa ezitshalweni ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuvuna ukuvikela umkhiqizo ekubeni ungathinteki ngesikhathi sokugcina noma sokuthutha. Yini izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Lokhu kuyinto ethile kokudla; imikhiqizo yezolimo noma ukudla kwezilwane okuvela ekusetshenzisweni kwezibulala-zinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Le misho iphinde ifake noma yiziphi izinto ezivela kuzinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nokungcoliswa kwezinto eziyingozi nokungcoliswa okucatshangelwa njengokubalulekile ocwaningweni lwezinto eziyingozi. Zingena kanjani izibulala-zinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi kokudla? Kukhona ukucwaninga okungaqinisekisiwe okuhlola izibulala-zinambuzane eziyingozi ezisetshenziswa ekukhiqizeni kokudla ukuthi lezi zinto zingahlala emikhiqizweni efana nezithelo nezitshalo ngisho nangemva kokuba zisetshenziswe. Zisetshenziswa kanjani izibulala-zinambuzane? Zisetshenziswa ngoba zinezinzuzo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo nasekudleni kwazo. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zinto, abalimi bangakhulisa imizamo yabo emapulazini ngenkathi behlisa izindleko zokukhiqiza kumthengi. Ubudlelwano bokudla bunokuxhumana okuningi futhi buhlanganisa zonke izigaba zenqubo yokukhiqiza, kusukela ekusebenziseni izikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo nezinga eliphansi lokukhiqiza kuze kube sekusetshenzisweni kwalokho kudla. Ukudla kungaba umthwali obalulekile wezinto ezibangela izifo, njengezilwane ezincane ezibangela izifo nezinto eziyingozi zazo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla kudinga ukuhlela nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bonke nohulumeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokudla. Ukuphepha kokudla kuqala kubanikezeli bezikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo kubalimi nakubantu abathintekayo ekukhiqizeni kokudla, njengoba izinto ezifana nezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi nezinto (ezokwelapha) ezilwaneni zinezinselelo ezahlukahlukene, ngakho kudinga ukunakwa okucophelela. Ukudla kwezilwane okuqukethe (okubangela) izifo, kuhlanganisa amabhaktheriya nezinto eziyingozi, kungase kube nezinselelo ezithile. Njengoba izibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi zinezinhloso eziningi, zingavulwa ngezindlela eziningi.
Isahluko 1: Umsebenzi Wamaphoyisa Amaphoyisa, njengomfanekiso wesimo sezokuphepha, adlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini. Uhlelo lwamaphoyisa luhlanganisa ukugwema ubugebengu, ukuvikela abantu, kanye nokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisebenza kahle. Nokho, lezi zinkampani zihlala zibhekene nezinkinga eziningi. Ukuze siqonde kahle indima yawo, kufanele sihlole izinzuzo nezinselelo ezihambisana nomsebenzi wamaphoyisa. Isahluko 2: Izinzuzo Zokusebenza Kwamaphoyisa Okokuqala, amaphoyisa anikeza ukuphepha emphakathini. Ngenxa yokuba khona kwawo, izakhamuzi zizizwa zikhululekile ukuhamba ezitaladini, zazi ukuthi kukhona abaphathi bezokuphepha ababezobavikela uma kudingeka. Lokhu kwandisa ukuzethemba kwabantu, okubasiza ukuthi baphile impilo ejabulisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa ayakwazi ukuvimbela ubugebengu ngokugcina imithetho nemigomo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuhlonishwa kwemithetho, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Isahluko 3: Izinselelo Zokusebenza Kwamaphoyisa Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle emsebenzini wamaphoyisa. Okokuqala, izinga lokuphikiswa phakathi kwamasiko ahlukene liyanda. Amaphoyisa abhekene nezinselelo zokuxhumana kahle nezakhamuzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho kukhona ukungaboni ngasolinye. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhekeni kokungaqondi kahle, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi. Umphakathi udinga amaphoyisa avumelana nezimo, abheke ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zikhona yini ukuze zisetshenziswe kahle. Isahluko 4: Izinyathelo Zokwenza Ngcono Ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwawo nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlanganyela komphakathi, njengokubamba imihlangano yokuxhumana, kungasiza ekuqiniseni lesi sikhathi. Amaphoyisa angase futhi adinge ukufunda izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana, ukuze aqonde kangcono izidingo zomphakathi. Isahluko 5: Ukuqinisekisa Ubuqotho Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuqotho bamaphoyisa bukhona kakhulu. Ukuze abantu bakhuthazwe ukuthi babekezelele amaphoyisa, kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa abenzele imisebenzi yawo ngendlela efanele. Ukuphula umthetho kwamasela akufanele kuthathwe njengokujwayelekile; kudinga ukuba nemiphumela. Amaphoyisa kufanele agxile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imithetho iyahlonishwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuphatha amaphoyisa, ukuze kuqedwe ubugebengu ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Isahluko 6: Ukubuyiselwa Kwezimali Empeleni, inkinga enkulu yokusebenza kwamaphoyisa iwukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo azikhona. Ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kudinga izinsiza ezanele, okungukuthi, izimoto, amathuluzi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemuva, umphakathi kufanele ube nezezimali ezanele. Ukubuyiselwa kwezimali kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ngokwawo. Isahluko 7: Umphakathi Ohlanganyela Umphakathi ohlanganyela ungaba nethuba lokuphendula izinkinga ezithinta ukuphepha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izakhamuzi zibe nesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yamaphoyisa. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamasiko ahlukene, izinkolo, nezigaba zomphakathi kudinga ukwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile. Isahluko 8: Ukubheka Phambili Ekugcineni, amaphoyisa adlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Noma izinselelo zikhona, kuningi okungafinyelelwa uma amaphoyisa nezigameko zomphakathi zisebenza ndawonye. Ukubheka phambili, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi amaphoyisa athuthukiswa, futhi abambe isikhundla esihle emphakathini. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumulele wonke umuntu. Ngakho-ke, kudingeka ukuthi sibe nesibopho sokuxhasa amaphoyisa, ukuze sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Umkhandlu wezindawo ubiza bonke abantu okungenzeka ukuthi amalungelo abo angathinteka kule msebenzi ophakanyisiwe wokuthengwa komhlaba ukuba babhale kumkhandlu, beqondisa izincwadi zabo kumphathi wezakhamuzi, ukuze zifike kungakapheli umhla ka-5 kuMfumfu 2009 (kanye nakwezinye zezikhungo ezishiwo ngezansi), ukuze baveze imibono yabo ngezindaba ezingabathinta mayelana nalokhu kuthengwa komhlaba okusemthethweni. KUZOBHIDLA eMawoti. Izindlu ezingezansi. Njengoba lo mkhandlu uthengile lo mhlaba ngaphansi komthetho ka-1975, futhi isigaba 25 somthetho sisho ukuthi umkhandlu unamaZINHLOZI E-MAWOTI: ahloselwe ukwakhiwa angakha izivumelwano nomkhandlu njengesisekelo sezwe. Umkhandlu unazo zonke izindaba ezihambelanayo. ISIMEMO ukuba kube ngu-946 kanti bangu-1500 abanikazi ngabaphuma isaziso salokhu ngenkathi kuxoxwa nabanikazi abaziwayo - Inhloso yalesi saziso ukuwazisa IZINGA EZITHINTWE abahlelwe ukuba babe nalezi zindawo, eziphakanyiswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 9 salo mthetho mayelana nalezi zindawo kanye nezinye izingxenye ezithintekayo EZIHLELWE NOMKHANDLU zinikezwa ngezinsiza. Ukuze umkhandlu usebenzise amandla awo phezu kwezindlu, umthetho wezindlu uyasebenza. Nakuba lo mhlaba uzame ukuthengwa ngokomthetho. Umkhandlu ubiza bonke abantu okungenzeka ukuthi amalungelo abo angathinteka kule msebenzi ophakanyisiwe wokuthengwa komhlaba ukuba babhale kumkhandlu, beqondisa izincwadi zabo kumphathi wezakhamuzi, ukuze zifike kungakapheli umhla ka-13 Novemba 2009 (kanye nakwezinye zezikhungo ezishiwo ngezansi), ukuze baveze imibono yabo ngezindaba ezingabathinta mayelana nalokhu kuthengwa komhlaba okusemthethweni.
Umqondisi Wohlelo: uMnu. Sipho Sithole UMongameli weCongress: uMnu. Jacob Zuma Unobhala S.W. uMnu. S.M. Zondi uMnu. O.T. Zondi Induna N. Namuhla sihlangene lapha ukuze sikhumbule ngenhlonipho uNduna Mbongeleni Zondi, umzukulu kaNduna Bhambatha KaMancinza Zondi - igwala elahola ukuphikisana noHulumeni wezobukhosi ngo-1906, owafaka intela yeKhanda Pondwe kubo bonke abesilisa abahlala kule ndawo. UNduna Bhambatha Zondi wahlaselwa ngamasosha obukhosi eMome Gorge ngoJuni 1906. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi naye wahlaselwa ngokuqinile edolobheni laseUmlazi, ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalolunye ezedlule, ngomhla ka-22 kuJanuwari. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi waba nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kukahulumeni wesifunda saseKwaZulu-Natal nomphakathi wakwaZondi ngesikhathi sokukhumbula iminyaka eyikhulu yokuphikisana kweKhanda ngo-1906. Amaphoyisa asondela kulabo ababi njengoba elandela umkhondo ojulile. Izinsalela zobufakazi ziqoqwa ezizoholela ekuboshweni okusheshayo kwalaba badlali. Ububi nobugebengu kuyinkinga enkulu ekhathaza imiphakathi yethu. Abantu bethu baphila besaba ngenxa yalezi zinsizwa. Ngenkathi abaningi bezakhamuzi besebenza kanzima ukuze kulethwe ukuthula nokuzinza lapha eKwaZulu-Natal, lezi zinsizwa ezimbalwa zikhathalela isikhathi sazo zokuhlela ukuceba ukuphila kwabanye. Nokho, sinehope nokuqhakambisa ukuthi, uma sihlangana, singashintsha konke lokhu, silwe nobugebengu, futhi siphumelele emkhankasweni wethu. Omunye wemizamo ephakanyisiwe ukuvula ngokushesha iCentre for Reconciliation and Dialogue ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthula nokusiza intsha ukuthi ibhekane nodlame nobugebengu. Isifunda sethu sesidlulile esikhathini sodlame nokuphulwa kwegazi. Siphumelele lesi sahluko kulesi sifunda. Manje sikhuluma ngentuthuko nokuthula. Sifuna ukuphila impilo engenabubi. Uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ngosuku nosuku, ngaphandle kokuphumula, ukuze wehlise izinga lobugebengu. Ngaphezu kwamaphoyisa akhona, uhulumeni wesifunda useqhamuke nohlelo lwe-Volunteer Social Crime Prevention Programme. Lolu hlelo lwabavolontiya lugxile ekulweni nobugebengu emphakathini, luhlanganisa abavolontiya emphakathini ukuze kwehliswe izinga lobugebengu nezenzo eziphikisana nezenzo zokwahlulela. Laba bavolontiya basebenza ngokubambisana namaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bavikelekile emphakathini yabo. Lolu hlelo lusiza ukuhlanganisa umgudu phakathi kobugebengu nokwesaba izenzo zobugebengu. Kuze kube manje, sinezivolontiya eziyi-1,200 ezamukelwe ziqeqeshwe ezinhlelweni zokuqala usizo nokuzivikela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, osomabhizinisi abavela eGreater Manchester Police (Scotland Yard) baqeqeshe abavolontiya abazokwenza ukuhamba ukuze bahlola ubugebengu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nomnyango wethu wamaphoyisa, iSouth African Police Service. Ukuthunyelwa kwalaba bavolontiya kuthunyelwa ezindaweni ezithile ezibekwe. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana okukhulu, uhlelo lwe-Volunteer Social Crime Prevention Programme luqale ukuhlolwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ezifana noGu, Uthukela, Amajuba, eThekwini, Umgungundlovu, kanye noMkhanyakude. Ezinye izifunda ezisele nazo zizothola lolu hlelo. Sizophinde silwe nobugebengu. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi washona ngesikhathi lapho izinhlelo zikaHulumeni zokuthuthukisa ubuholi bendabuko esifundeni ziqala ukuvuna. Umthetho Wokuhola Nokuphatha, 2003 (Umthetho No. 41 ka-2003) kanye neKwaZulu-Natal Traditional Leadership and Governance Act, 2005 (Umthetho No. 05 ka-2005) kwazisa uhlelo olusha lokuphatha izikhungo zobuholi bendabuko. Ngo-2006, uhulumeni wasungula iHouse of Traditional Leaders kanye nezindlu eziyi-11 zeTraditional Council. Uhlelo lokulungisa ubuholi bendabuko luveze ukuthi ngaphezu kuka-90% kwezinduna ziguqulwa zaba ngababusi bendabuko. Lokhu kuhambisana noMthetho Wobuholi Bendabuko kanye neFramework yokuphatha lapha eKwaZulu-Natal, umthetho ka-2003 (Umthetho No.41 ka-2003) kanye neKwaZulu-Natal Traditional Leadership and Governance Act ka-2005 (Umthetho No. 5 ka-2005). Okwokuqala, abesifazane nentsha kulindeleke ukuthi babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezihlobene nezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko. Ngo-2007, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezindaba Zendabuko wanikela ngemiholo yama-Headmen abanguye amalungu ezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko. Ama-Headmen azothola izinsiza zezimali ezizosiza ukuthi basebenze kahle, ngokuphumelelayo, nangokwethembeka ezindabeni zezikole zobuholi bendabuko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngo-2008 kwanqunywa ukuthi zonke izindleko zokuhamba ezithathwe ngamalungu ezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko zizokhokhelwa uMnyango. Imiholo yama-Headmen yanda ukuze ihambisane naleyo ebekwe uMnyango Wezokuthutha. Ngo-2008, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezindaba Zendabuko waqasha abaqondisi bazo zonke izikhungo zobuholi bendabuko nezindlu zendawo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko nezindawo, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezindaba Zendabuko ubambe umhlangano we-EXCO phakathi kwezindawo nezinduna. Ngo-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yasungulwa njengedemokhrasi. Namuhla siphila ngesikhathi sethemba, ukuhlonishwa kwesithunzi somuntu. Siphila ngesikhathi sethemba sokuthula, idemokhrasi, nentuthuko. Iningi lokuphila kukaNduna Bhambatha, futhi walwa ngalokhu kuze kufe, futhi manje sesikufeze. Iningi lokuphila kukaNduna Mbongeleni Zondi nakho kwaba yikho, wakholwa kulokhu, futhi namuhla sesikufeze. Ngakho-ke, uNduna Zondi ubuyiselwa endimeni yakhe efanele yokuhola, ngemuva kokushona, lokhu kunguhulumeni wethu onakekela. Ukuphumelela kokukhumbula kukaNduna Bhambatha ngo-2006 bekuyiqiniso nobuhlakani bukaNduna Mbongeleni Zondi ekubeni nombono obheke empilweni ngobuhlakani. Wayengumuntu ophakamisa igwala nobuciko futhi waguqula eminye imikhuba ukuze ihambisane nezikhathi zanamuhla. Waphakamisa iziphakamiso eziningi kuhulumeni ezihlose ukulethela abantu impilo engcono lapha eNgome. Walwa ngentuthuko nenkululeko kubantu abahluphekayo bomphakathi wakhe, abawathola kumkakhe, uNduna Bhambatha Zondi. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi wayen gift enhle yokwakha ubudlelwano, okuyisibonakaliso esihle sokuthi induna kufanele ibe ngumuntu onakekela ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bakhe. Ngomhla ka-3 kuJanuwari 2009, uMongameli weCongress, uMnu. Jacob Zuma, nami sasi lapha eNgome simenywe yile nduna eshiywe, uNduna Mbongeleni Zondi, kanye nomphakathi wonke wakwaZondi.
