I-Mercedes-Benz: Umkhiqizo Wokuhamba Okuyingqayizivele I-Mercedes-Benz iyinkampani edumile emhlabeni wonke, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezithuthi zayo eziphezulu nezisezingeni eliphezulu. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1926, kwathi eminyakeni eyalandela, yaba yisibonelo sokuhamba okukhulu kwezobuchwepheshe, umklamo, kanye nokuphepha. I-Mercedes-Benz isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo yayo ihlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende, futhi igcina isithunzi sayo njengebhendi elihloniphekile. I-Mercedes-Benz iyingxenye yeDaimler AG, okuyinkampani enomlando omude emphakathini wezokuthutha. Uhlanga lwezokuthutha lweMercedes-Benz luhleliwe kahle, luqukethe izimoto ezihlukahlukene, kufaka phakathi izimoto ezincane, ezinkulu, kanye nezimoto ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi ezahlukene, kusukela kubantu abafuna izimoto zokuhamba eziphumelelayo, kuze kube sezingeni eliphezulu lemikhiqizo yokuhamba. Ukwakhiwa kwezithuthi zeMercedes-Benz kugxile emaphethini amahle, okwenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi komsebenzisi nezithuthi. Ukugxila ekwakhiweni okuhle kusekela umbono wokuthi imoto ingaphezu kokuhamba. I-Mercedes-Benz ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okukhombisa ukuzinikela kwayo ekwenzeni izimoto eziphezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umklamo wenziwa ngendlela efanele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zihlala zinhle ngisho nomnyaka edlule, okwenza kube yizimpahla ezilondekile. Ukwanda kwezimoto zeMercedes-Benz akukhulumi kuphela ngohlangothi lwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwenkampani ekuphepheni. I-Mercedes-Benz ikholwa ukuthi ukuphepha kuzoba yinsika eyinhloko ezimotweni zayo. Ngakho-ke, ibhande lokuphepha, izinhlelo zokubona izingozi, kanye nezinto zokulwa nezingozi zifakwe kuzo zonke izimoto ezikhiqizwayo. Lezi zinhlelo zenzelwe ukuvikela abashayeli nabagibeli, kube yisibonelo sokuhlonipha impilo yomuntu. Ngaphezu kokwenza izimoto ezinhle neziphephile, iMercedes-Benz ibuye ibonakale njengomholi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezemoto. Uhlobo lwezithuthi oluhambayo, olufana nezimoto ezisebenzisa ugesi, lukhombisa ukufuna kweMercedes-Benz ukusiza ekunciphiseni umthelela emhlabeni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi inkampani iyawuhlonipha umhlaba, futhi ibonisa ukuthi izimoto zayo zixhumene nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMercedes-Benz iye yathola izindondo eziningi, ikhombisa ukuthi iyikhanda emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nokwakhiwa. Lezi zindondo zikhombisa ukuzibophezela kwenkampani kumphakathi, nasekuthuthukiseni izimoto ezithuthukisiwe. Ukusebenza kwenkampani ngokuhlanganyela nezikhungo zocwaningo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kuvumela iMercedes-Benz ukuba ikwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokwakhiwa nokwenza izimoto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMercedes-Benz ibonisa umgomo wokuhlonipha izidingo zamakhasimende. Ngalesi sizathu, inkampani ibeka phambili ukukwazi ukuthola impendulo kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuzimisela kwabathengi, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi izimoto zihlala zihlala zifaneleka nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kubuyisela emuva ekutheni iMercedes-Benz iyinkampani okufanele ibhekwane nayo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abafuna umkhiqizo ophakeme. Ekupheleni, iMercedes-Benz iyimpahla yezenzo ezinhle, umkhiqizo onobuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nesithunzi esihle emakethe. Ukubona indlela inkampani ebambisana ngayo nezidingo zomphakathi, nokuhlonipha impilo yomuntu, kubonisa ukuthi iMercedes-Benz iyakha isithunzi esiqinile emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Njengoba ibhizinisi leli liqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi lihlale ligxile ekwakheni izimoto ezinethezekile, eziphephile, nezihamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Lokho kuzoqhubeka kwenza iMercedes-Benz ibaluleke emphakathini wezokuthutha emhlabeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe obuhlanganiswe neMercedes-Benz buzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezidingweni zomphakathi, kanti izimoto zayo zizohlala zikhumbuleka njengesibonelo sokuhamba okuphumelelayo, okuphumelelayo, nokuphephile. I-Mercedes-Benz iyindlela yokuhamba esebenzayo, enezinga eliphezulu, futhi iyinsika ehlonishwayo emhlabeni wezokuthutha.
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemiphakathini yabo. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kuqhutshwa kakhulu ngamaKhothama noma Abaholi Bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaKhosi nababusi futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulukazi ngezindlela zomthetho wendabuko. Ngaphansi kweSigaba 211 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wendabuko uyavunyelwa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho eziphila ndawonye nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wendabuko njengoba bekunjalo ngaphambi kokuba kudalwe iMthethosisekelo omusha, kodwa lo mthetho kufanele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuvumelana nemithetho ekhona kanye neMthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhiwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 16 seSheduli 6 seMthethosisekelo, enikeza ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neKhothama elikhona ngesikhathi sokuqala kweMthethosisekelo ziqhubeka nokusebenza futhi zisebenzise amandla azo omthetho njengoba kunikezwe. Ukusebenza kwezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ifaka phakathi eminye eyakhelwe ngaphambi kweMthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezaziyizindawo ezazikhona. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yakudala eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngokuqashelwa komthetho, uMongameli wezwe uthumele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuvumelana neSigaba 14 seSheduli 6 seMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko NgamaKhothama & Imisebenzi Yezomthetho Yabaholi Bendabuko: owabhalwa ngoJanuwari 21, 2003: iKomidi Lomthetho laseNingizimu Afrika ikhasi 1. Ububanzi bemandla bungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwekhosi yokuzwa udaba nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho-ke, ububanzi bemandla busitshela ngamandla nemikhawulo enikezwe enkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe endabeni lapho inkantolo ingenamandla sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Lapho sibheka umthetho okhona, imibono yobubanzi ivela ezindleleni nasezithethweni eziningi. Le mithetho ivela emthethweni ojwayelekile kodwa ingase yenziwe njengemithetho. Isibonelo sokwenziwa kwale mithetho nguMthetho Wezinkantolo Zasemadolobheni. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ehlobene nobubanzi. Ngokuhambisana nalo mthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe nobubanzi, kufanele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kufanele ibe nobubanzi phezu komuntu wephikiswa kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wemikhawulo uhambisana nomgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanelekile. Umkhawulo wobubanzi uhambisana nomkhawulo wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Umkhawulo wobubanzi wenkantolo uhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echazwe kahle. Le ngqondo ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphikisi ulandela indawo lapho umphikisi ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphikisi kufanele avule icala enkantolo enobubanzi phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Kuvamise ukuba inkantolo yasendaweni lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphikisi ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezihlukene ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho: isibonelo; inkantolo inobubanzi ngoba isizathu sokuphikiswa saphuma endaweni elawulwa yile nkantolo. Mayelana neSigaba 28(d) seMthetho Wezinkantolo ZamaMagistrate uMthetho No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sikhombisa ukuthi ukuze le nkantolo ibe nobubanzi, isizathu sokuphikiswa kufanele sibe sikhona ngokuphelele endaweni enikezwe le nkantolo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe nobubanzi phezu kwendaba eyodwa. Njengoba umphikisi enelungelo lokulawula icala, bangakhetha inkantolo ezoyizwa indaba yabo. Ngokujwayelekile, umphikisi ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana nabo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isimo sifaneleka kangakanani kumphikisi. Ububanzi buqinisekiswa ngesikhathi umuntu ethola imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha leyo miyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula ububanzi bayo, isebenza ngaphezu kwamandla ayo kuze kube icala liphothuliwe. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ku-819. Uma inkantolo yayinobubanzi ngesikhathi umuntu ethola imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho ezimweni lungashintsha ububanzi benkantolo. Isibonelo: inkantolo inobubanzi ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi ethola imiyalo yenkantolo, bephila endaweni yayo, iqhubeka nokuba nobubanzi phezu kwendaba noma ngabe ngemva kokunikeza imiyalo, umphikisi akasahlali endaweni yale nkantolo. Le ndawo ihambisana nomkhawulo wobubanzi. Kungumsebenzi wanoma iyiphi inhlangano ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkantolo yayo inobubanzi ukuze iwulalele udaba oluphakanyisiwe phambi kwayo. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi mayelana nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwendaba kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kufanele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezimiso zezimali, akukakabi khona umgomo okhona ophatha inani lemali. Ngisho nasekuntulekeni kwemikhawulo yemali, iKomidi Lomthetho mayelana Nezisebenzi Zomthetho Wendabuko lenza iziphakamiso zokuqala zemigomo ezizosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo somthetho wendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo engenamandla okuphikisa icala labo futhi engakwenzi ukwenqaba ukujolisa phambi kwenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okuzwa udaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuthi abhekelelwe yimithetho yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) seMthetho Wezinkantolo ZamaMagistrate uMthetho No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kuguquliwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenaleli, umphakathi ophakanyisiwe unomsebenzi wokubuza ngokwakhe (mero mutu) mayelana namandla obubanzi ukuze aphikise udaba kule nkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli womphikisi, umphakathi wenkantolo ngeke ubuze ngokwakhe mayelana namandla obubanzi benkantolo ukuze aphikise icala. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo ingenamandla okuphikisa icala, umuntu owafaka kufanele alethe ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ifanele ukuphikisa icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weKomidi Lomthetho ngamaKhothama, ikhasi 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokuthi inkantolo ayinamalungelo okuphikisa icala ingabaphoqa ukuba baveze ubufakazi mayelana nokuthi kungani besho kanjalo. Umqondo wobubanzi uhambisana nokuhlukaniswa kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa amandla nemigomo yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lobubanzi nemikhawulo, inkantolo yomthetho ihlala njengenkantolo yokuqala noma njengenkantolo yokuphikisana. Inkantolo
Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa Kwe-TV Licence Ye-SABC Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC kube yinkinga ethusayo emlandweni wezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule. I-SABC, iSouth African Broadcasting Corporation, iyinhlangano enobukhulu obukhulu kwezokuxhumana, eyasungulwa ngekhulu le-20. Njengoba izwe lishintshe ngezikhathi ezinzima, izinqumo ezithathwe mayelana ne-TV licence ziye zaba nemthelela omkhulu ekuphathweni kwezimali ze-SABC. Ekuqaleni, i-SABC yathola uxhaso olukhulu oluvela kuhulumeni, kodwa njengoba izwe laqhubeka lishintsha, izinsiza zancipha. Uxhaso lwe-TV licence, olwakhiwe ngemuva kokuthi i-SABC iziveze njengomthombo obalulekile wezindaba, lwalubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-SABC iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi, izinhlelo, nezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, lokhu kuhlangabezana nezinkinga ezinkulu. Ngonyaka we-1999, umthetho wezakhamizi wathuthukiswa, uvumela izakhamizi ukuba zikhokhele i-TV licence ukuze zikwazi ukusebenzisa iziteshi ze-SABC. Lokhu kwaba yisinqumo esibi, njengoba amanani e-TV licence agcizelela izinkinga zezimali ezibhekene ne-SABC. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izakhamizi ziqale ukucabanga ngokuphikisana nokukhokha i-TV licence. Izizathu zalesi sikhathi zazihlanganisa ukuthi abanye babekholelwa ukuthi i-SABC ayihlinzeki ngezinhlelo ezihambisana nezifiso zabo, kanti abanye babengafuni ukukhokhela izinhlelo ezithile ezingabathandayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zimpikiswano zaqhubeka zikhula. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ngonyaka we-2010, ukunganeliseki kwabathengi kwanda. Lokhu kudalwe yizizathu ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nokucwaswa kwabezindaba, ukungabikhona kwezimangaliso zothando, nezinkinga zezimali ze-SABC. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa ukunciphisa izinhlelo, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe obusha namakhono e-inthanethi baphinde baphazamisa isimo se-SABC. Abantu baqala ukuthola izinhlelo ezinguqhamuka ku-inthanethi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi i-SABC igcine umphakathi emakhaya. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izakhamizi ziqonde ukuthi kungani zidinga ukukhokha i-TV licence uma zingathola okuqukethwe okungcono mahhala. Ukuphikisana kokuze kube nomthelela emthethweni, kwavula ithuba lokuhlola izinqubomgomo ezithile. Ngonyaka we-2015, umthethosisekelo wathuthukiswa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abakhokhi be-TV licence bangathola izinzuzo ezithile, kodwa lokhu akukwazanga ukususa izimpikiswano. Izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuvuselela i-SABC zazingenza umonakalo, njengoba nabantu beqhubeka bethola izinkinga ezithile, futhi izinhlelo zikaHulumeni zazingazange zibaluleke kakhulu. Ngemva kokuhlangenwe nakho okungajabulisi, ngonyaka we-2020, i-SABC yathola uhlelo lokwakha ithemba phakathi kwabakhokhi be-TV licence. Lokhu kwahlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo eziningi ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, njengezinhlelo zokukhuthaza ubunikazi bezomnotho, izinhlelo eziphathelene nezokwelapha, nezokuzijabulisa. Lokhu kwavuselela ithemba phakathi kwabakhokhi be-TV licence, kodwa kube nenkinga yokuthi ukunyuka kwezindleko zokuphila kwaba nomthelela omubi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC akukhona kuphela okwenziwa ngabantu ngabanye, kodwa ziyaqhubeka nezinkinga ezinkulu zomphakathi. Ukuphikisana phakathi kwezakhamizi, ohulumeni, kanye ne-SABC kufanele kubhekwe njengengxenye yezenzo zomphakathi, okwandisa ukuqonda okungcono kwezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqiniswa kokukhulumisana phakathi kwe-SABC nabakhokhi be-TV licence kuzodingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo yokuxhumana ibhekelela izidingo zabasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuqonda okukhulu phakathi kwezakhamizi nezinhlelo ze-SABC, ukuze kubhekwe izinkinga ezikhona, kanti imiphumela izothinta izizukulwane ezizayo. Izimpikiswano ngokuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC zibonisa ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu kanye nezinhlelo zezokuxhumana kudinga ukubhekelelwa. I-SABC kufanele iqhubeke nokufuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhlinzeka ngemicimbi ehambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende ayo, kanti abakhokhi be-TV licence kufanele bazi ukuthi imizamo yabo ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elikhanyayo lezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umphakathi ophelele, onobuchwepheshe, nolwazi.
Ama-Drone: Izinkanyezi Zesibhakabhaka Kwasekuqaleni, emhlabeni omncane ohlangene nezinsuku ezimnandi, kwavela umqondo omusha. Umqondo owawubizwa ngokuthi “ama-drone.” Lawa ma-drone, ayebukeka efana nezinyoni ezincane ezindizayo, ayenokukwazi okukhulu. Abantu babebuka phezulu, benethemba lokuthi lezi zinto eziphilayo zizobasiza ezimpilweni zabo zansuku zonke. UThandi, umphakathi omncane ohlala edolobheni elisemaphandleni, wayenothando olukhulu lokuhlola. Wayejabule kakhulu uma efunda ngezobuchwepheshe, futhi ngesikhathi ethola ithuba lokusebenzisa i-drone, wathola umuzwa omusha. UThandi wayefuna ukwazi ukuthi lezi zinto ezindizayo zingamphatha kanjani. Ngakho, wathola i-drone encane, eyayihamba phansi kancane, kodwa yayinekhono elikhulu. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wanquma ukuba ahambe nendiza yakhe ye-drone. Waqala ukuyindiza phezulu kwezintaba ezisemhlabeni wakhe. Njengoba i-drone yakhe yandiza, wahamba phansi, ebona izitshalo ezihlaza, izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, nezilwane ezithokozisayo. Kwakukhanya kakhulu, futhi uThandi waba nomuzwa wokuthi uzokwazi ukubona izinto eziningi ngendlela engeke ayicabange. Njengoba i-drone yakhe iqhubeka nokundiza, uThandi wabona umfula omkhulu, ogcwele amanzi acwebile. Wathola ukuthi i-drone ingathola izithombe ezinhle kakhulu, futhi wayefuna ukwabelana ngalezi zithombe nomphakathi wakhe. Wabhalela abahlobo bakhe, ebachazela ukuthi lezi zinto zingamphatha kanjani, nokuthi kufanele bazame ukuyisebenzisa. Ngesikhathi edlula ezindaweni ezahlukene, uThandi wathola ukuthi ama-drone ayenokukwazi okukhulu. Abantu bokuqala baphendula ngezithombe, bethi bayawathanda. Kwakukhanya ukuthi uThandi wayesebenzisa i-drone yakhe ukuze abone izinto ezithokozisayo, kodwa futhi wayefuna ukusebenzisa lezi zinto ukuze asize abantu. Waqala ukucabanga ngezindlela ezahlukene ama-drone angasebenza ngazo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukuhlela umcimbi omkhulu. Wafuna ukuba abantu baseThandeni bazi kahle ukuthi ama-drone angasiza kanjani emiphakathini yabo. Wabiza abantu abaningi, wathi bazobona ukuthi ama-drone angathola izithombe ezinhle, futhi angasiza ekuphatheni izinsiza. Waqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uzoba nethuba lokubona lezi zinto ezindizayo. Ngelanga lomcimbi, abantu bahlangana, behleka futhi bejabula. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha impilo yabo. Waqala ukwakha umbono, wathi: "Bheka, ngizokuthumele i-drone phezulu, ukuze ubone konke okuthokozisayo." Abantu babebukeka bejabulile, behamba phansi, bephakamisa izandla zabo. UThandi waqala ukufundisa abantu ukuthi bangasebenzisa kanjani ama-drone. Wabakhombisa ukuthi bangathola izithombe ezinhle, futhi bangawasebenzisa kanjani ukuthola izinsiza. Kwakukhanya ukuthi abantu babezofunda okuningi, futhi uThandi waba ngumholi omuhle. Njengoba i-drone yakhe ibhampa phezulu, wayebona abantu behleka, bejabule, futhi bephokophela phezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi wahlangana nabantu abaningi ababephila ezindaweni ezahlukene. Wafunda ukuthi ama-drone angasiza ekuphatheni izinhlelo zokudla, ekuboniseni izinkanyezi, nasekutholeni izinsiza ezisemqoka. Abantu babebona ukuthi lezi zinto ezindizayo zazingaba usizo olukhulu empilweni yabo. UThandi wayengakaze acabange ukuthi ama-drone azoshintsha impilo yakhe, kodwa manje wayebona ukuthi lezi zinto zazingamphatha kahle. Waqhubeka nokufundisa abantu, ebakhuthaza ukuthi baphinde bazame. Kwakukhanya ukuthi uThandi wayethanda ukwazi, futhi wayefuna abantu bakhe bazi kahle. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseThandeni waba ne-drone eqinile. Abantu babebona izithombe ezinhle, futhi baqala ukuhamba phansi, bejabule. UThandi waba ngumholi, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise ama-drone ukuze bathole izinsiza ezisemqoka. Kwakukhanya ukuthi lezi zinto zazingasiza abantu, futhi uThandi wayejabule kakhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ukuthi ama-drone ayenokukwazi okukhulu. Abantu babebona ukuthi lezi zinto zazingasiza ekuphatheni izinsiza, futhi zazingasiza ekutholeni izithombe ezinhle. UThandi waba umholi omuhle, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise ama-drone ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseThandeni waba ne-drone eqinile, futhi abantu baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zinto ezindizayo. UThandi waba umholi, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono, bejabule, futhi bephokophela phezulu. Kwakukhanya ukuthi ama-drone ayenokukwazi okukhulu, futhi uThandi waba umholi ophumelelayo, umholi wezinkanyezi zesibhakabhaka.
Ukusebenza kwezikhungo okufana nama-ATM Umhleli: Sawubona, ngiyakwemukela kulesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Namuhla sizobe sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokusebenza kwezikhungo okufana nama-ATM. Lezi zikhungo zibalulekile kakhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ngabe ungachaza kanjani lo msebenzi? Umxhumanisi: Sawubona! Ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ukusebenza kwezikhungo ezifana nama-ATM kuyisici esibalulekile emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Ama-ATM anikeza izinsiza zokudawunsekela imali, kuyilapho izikhungo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ehlukahlukene. Umsebenzisi angathola usizo lwezikhungo ezahlukene ngezinsizakalo ezihlukene ezifana nokufaka izicelo, ukufunda, noma ukuthola ulwazi oluthile. Umhleli: Kuyathakazelisa! Ungakuchaza kabanzi kanjani indlela lezi zikhungo ezisebenza ngayo? Yini evumela ukuthi zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi esesikhathini? Umxhumanisi: Impela. Izikhungo zisebenza njengamathuluzi axhumeka ku-inthanethi, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emalini, ezinsizeni, nemininingwane. Uhlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lwenza umsebenzi uhlale uhamba kahle. Umsebenzisi angangena kuhlu lwezinketho, bese ekhetha okudingayo, kungenzeka kube ukusizakala ngezinsizakalo ezithile ezitholakalayo. Umhleli: Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi noma kunini, noma kuphi? Umxhumanisi: Yiqiniso! Lokhu kwehlisa izithiyo zokufinyelela. Uhlelo lokusebenza lukhona ezandleni zabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zikhona ezindaweni eziphakeme nezishibhile, ezikwenza kube lula kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi kwabo abanezidingo ezithile. Umhleli: Ngabe ukusho ukuthi izikhungo zisiza ekwehliseni ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezinsiza ezithile, njengoMnyango Wezempilo noma izikhungo zezimali? Umxhumanisi: Impela. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, futhi kudala isu lokuxhumana elikahle phakathi kwezinye izikhungo. Lokhu buxazulula inkinga yokungafinyeleli kulwazi oludingekayo, ngaphandle kokudinga izabelo eziphambili. Umhleli: Lokhu kudinga ukuba lunothi emsebenzini. Ingabe kunzima ukuhlela lokhu kuhlanga kokuqhubeka okufanele kwenziwe kuze kube sekupheleni? Umxhumanisi: Yebo, lokhu kudinga ukuqapha okuningi. Ukuhlela izikhungo njengama-ATM kudinga ukukhulumisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukahlukene, ukuze konke kuhambisane. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zisebenza kahle kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngeresethi ethile yokuhlanza, ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nokubambisana okuhle. Umhleli: Yini ethinta izikhungo ezikhiqizayo uma ziqhathaniswa ne-ATM? Umxhumanisi: Kukhona umehluko ophakathi kwalezi zinto. Ngenkathi ama-ATM egxile kakhulu ekuphatheni imali, izikhungo zisebenza kancane, zigxile kumaqoqo nezinye izinsizakalo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umsebenzisi angathola izinsiza ezihlukene, izincazelo, nezinsizakalo ezithile. Umhleli: Lokhu kuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuthile? Ngabe izikhungo zithola izinzuzo ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili? Umxhumanisi: Impela, ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka buhamba phambili nezigaba ezintsha. Ukusebenzisa ama-sensors, ama-software akhethekile, kanye nezinto zokuhlola umsebenzisi, kwenza kube lula ukuvumelanisa izinsizakalo. Lokhu kudala ingqondo ehlakaniphile ezilindelekayo ukuletha ukuqonda okukhulu kokusebenza kwezinhlaka. Umhleli: Ngabe usakugxilisa lapho kuvelayo izithiyo? Umxhumanisi: Yebo, kunezithiyo ezithile. Omunye wazo kuba ukukwazi ukuvikela idatha yomsebenzisi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane igcinwa ngokuphephile. Phinde kube nezingqinamba zokufinyelela ezikhungweni, izinsizakalo ezithile sezivame ukuba zishesha zomthwalo. Umhleli: Ingabe ungathanda ukwabelana ngamasu angasetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngezikhungo ezintsha ngemva kokuhlangenwe nakho? Umxhumanisi: Kukhona futhi, ukufaka imibono emisha kuyadingeka. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele, imihlangano yabasebenzi, kanye nokuqapha izidingo zabantu kuyafuneka. Ukuzitholela emishinini egudlile nakuba kuncike kuzo zonke izinsiza eziphakeme, okuwukuhlomula. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngesikhumbuzo sakho sokubamba okukhululekile. Izikhungo zisebenza ngendlela efana nama-ATM, kudinga ukugxila kwabo ukuze kuvikelwe izidingo zabantu. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga! Ngikholwa ukuthi izikhungo ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngendlela ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, zikhuthaza ukwenziwa kwethu. Kudingeka ukuqonda okuhle phakathi kwazo zonke izinsiza, ukuze zisebenze ngendlela efanele. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngesikhathi sakho nesithakazelo. Lokhu kusebenza kwezikhungo kusho ukunweba amathuba ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ezahlukene ezithinta umphakathi wethu. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga futhi. Ngizokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izikhungo zihlala zenzeka emhlabeni wethu, zinika abantu ithuba lokuphila kahle, nezixazululo ezilawulayo ukuze bakwazi ukuphila kahle.
Abadlali Abasha: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezithombe Zomnotho Nobungcweti Umhlaba wezomdlalo wabantu abasha, ophumelele ezemidlalo, udinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nezifiso zomphakathi. Abadlali abasebasha, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bakhombisa amakhono abawatholile futhi bahlala beqhutshwa ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabo nezemidlalo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuthandwa kwemidlalo, kodwa futhi kugqugquzela impilo engcono, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela ezahlukene zokudlala. Ukukhula komdlali omncane kudinga izici eziningi, ezifana nokufaneleka kwezokuphila, ukuqeqeshwa okujulile, nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Ukuze umphakathi, umndeni, nabachwepheshe bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abasha. Uhlaka Lwezokuphila Kwabadlali Abasebasha Impilo yomdlali omncane ibalulekile ukuze aqinisekise impilo yakhe. Lokhu kubandakanya ukudla okunempilo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlala ephilile emoyeni, nokunakekela impilo yakhe. Ukudla okunempilo kudinga ukuba kube yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila komdlali, ikakhulukazi ukudla okuqukethe izakhamzimba ezihlukahlukene ukuze kufinyelelwe imigomo yakhe. Ukuze umdlali akwazi ukuhlala enempilo, udinga ukugxila ekuhambeni, ukuhamba ngezinyawo, nasekusebenziseni izitho zomzimba ukuze agcine imizwa yakhe iphilile. Ukuzivocavoca kuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha nokunciphisa ingozi yokulimala. Ukwakhiwa Kwamakhono Nezinhlelo Zokuqeqeshwa Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abadlali abasebasha. Abadlali kufanele baqonde izimiso ezisemthethweni zemidlalo abawazikhandla, okuhlanganisa ukufunda amasu namakhono okudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqhuba umkhankaso oqondile kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umqondo oqinile nolwazi olunzulu. Izifundo ezenzakalayo, njengemikhankaso yemidlalo, zikhulisa ulwazi nolwazi lomdlali. Ulimi lwemidlalo luhlukile futhi luthathwa ngokwehlukana, ngakho umphakathi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zihlala zihlangene. Ukubaluleka Kokusebenza Ngamafutha Kebuli Umndeni udlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sezemidlalo. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwemindeni kugqugquzela abadlali abasebasha. Umzali, umnakekeli, noma umngani udlala indima ebalulekile ezinyathelweni zomdlali. Ukuba seduze nabo, abadlali bakha izifundo ezenzakalayo eziphumelelayo, okwakha izimfanelo ezifana nokuzwela, ubuchwepheshe, nokuzimisela. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ukuzikhandla nokuzimisela, okuyizakhi ezibalulekile empilweni yomdlali. Ubukhona Bebachwepheshe Kwezokuhlala Umphakathi, kanye nabachwepheshe abanjengabaqeqeshi, odokotela, nabanye, banikeza ulwazi oluwusizo ekuthuthukiseni abadlali. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabachwepheshe kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umqondo oqondile, kuvikela abadlali ukuzibophezela ezintweni ezithile ukuze bathole imiphumela emihle. Abachwepheshe bayazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe, impilo, nokuxhumana kuncike kumphakathi, ngakho baphakamisa isiko lokusebenza okuhle. Izifundo Nokuqhubeka Ngokuhamba Kwempilo Njengoba abadlali abasebasha beqhubeka nezifundo, kubalulekile ukuthi babe nezincwadi ezisemqoka ukuze bagcine ulwazi olufanele. Ukubamba iqhaza kumaphrojekthi nezifundo kuzovumela abadlali ukuba bahlale bejabulile futhi bakhulise ubuhlobo. Abafundi, abaqeqeshi, nabaphathi kufanele basebenzisane ukuze bahlanganyele imibono emisha futhi bakhe abadlali abasha. Uhambo lwezemidlalo luhlala lungashintsha, futhi akufanele kube nemingcele yokuphakanyiswa. Isiphetho: Umsebenzi Wokuhlola Nezikhathi Zokuhlola Umehluko emdlalweni ungasebenza njengenjini yokukhuthaza ubuchopho. Abadlali abasebasha kufanele baqhubeke nokuhlola, baphumelele ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi basebenzisane ukuze bafeze izifiso zabo. Ngokugxila kubantu abasha, sithuthukisa isisekelo esiqinile sokuphumelela, sokuqinisa umphakathi. Njengoba sithuthukisa izifundo zempilo, sikhulisa abadlali abasha futhi sithokozisa abalandeli babo. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza umkhiqizo ofisa ukwenziwa kanye nobuchwepheshe obukhulu emhlabeni wemidlalo. Ngakho, abadlali abasebasha bahlala besebenzisa amathuba ukuze bathuthukise impilo yabo.
ISAHARA DESERT: I-SANDY KINGDOM I-Sahara Desert iyindawo engaphezu kwezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane nezitshalo, iyinhlokodolobha yehlathi elikhulu lehlathi elinamahlathi abanzi azungezwe yizindonga zezimpophoma ezimhlophe. Lesi sikhala esiyisikhumbuzo sokuhle nokubi, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngezimo zokuphila kanye nezingcindezi ezibhekene nehlobo elishisayo, izigameko ezinzima, kanye nezikhathi zobunzima. Ukwazi kahle le ndawo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-Sahara iyabhakabhaka impela, ibhalwe ngemihlobiso yokwakheka kwemvelo. Izindawo ezihlukahlukene zinemibono ehlukile, kusukela ezindaweni ezichwepheshile, lapho umoya opholile uvuselela khona, kuze kube sezindaweni ezikhukhulayo eziphezulu ezikhumbuza umhlaba omkhulu wezigidi zamathafa ezihlahla zomdabu. Ngelinye ilanga, lapho umoya ungena ngesithukuthuku, abavakashi bavakashela eSaharani kumasango eTassili n'Ajjer, indawo edume kakhulu ngemicimbi yamasiko namaqhawe. Lokhu kubukeka kukhombisa umhlaba wesibani onokuthula, lapho abavakashi behamba ngezinyawo, beshaya izinyathelo ezincane emsandleni wabo, nofana nendaba eshukumisa inhliziyo. Izinsuku zishintsha, izimo zezulu zishintsha, kodwa umoya weSahara uhlala unguye owamukelekile. Ngenxa yokuba yisikhumbuzo esingapheli, umoya ube uhlezi unqamuleka phakathi kwezinyoni eziluhlaza, izihlahla eziphilayo, kanye nezinyoni ezindizayo ezithokozisayo. Nakuba iSahara ingabukeka ingasondelene, ibambene kakhulu nezimpilo zabantu bayo. Abantu abahlala kule ndawo banobuchwepheshe bokuphila ezimeni ezinzima. Kukhona imiphakathi emikhulu, ezikhulumayo, nezikhumbulayo izinkumbulo eziyinqaba. Lezi zimphakathi zikhombisa indlela yokuphila ngendlela yokukhula, zikhuthaza ukujula emithonjeni yokuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umuzwa ophakathi kwale ndawo ungatholakala, uvezwe ngendlela yokuphila kwansuku zonke kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kwazulu-ke izinkumbulo eziphilayo zempilo yomphakathi. Ubuciko bokuphila kwemvelo buhlezi bukhona, buvuselela izinkumbulo ezijulile ezihlobene neSahara. Ekuqaleni kwempilo, i-Sahara yaziwa ngokuba yindawo yokuhlola izimo zokuphila. Abantu baphakathi kwayo banemikhuba yokuziphatha ehambelana nemvelo, benza imisebenzi yokuhamba, yokuhlanza, nokuhlonipha izinsiza zemvelo. Lokhu kuhlangana phakathi kwabantu nemvelo kubonisa ubudlelwano obujulile obukhona phakathi kwabo. Ngaphandle kokukhula komphakathi, iSahara iyindawo yokuhlola. Izifundo ezitholakala kule ndawo ziqhubeka zikhula, zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile zokuphila, ezifaka phakathi ukujula empilweni, ukuhlanganisa imikhuba, nokuhlonipha izinsiza zemvelo. Abafundi bahlala bejabulile, behlola izimo zemvelo ezithokozisayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala emazweni endabuko noma ezindaweni zamasiko amasha. I-Sahara, iyinhlokodolobha yemvelo, ibonisa ubudlelwane obujulile phakathi kwemvelo nabantu. Lesi sikhala sinesimo sokwakheka esiyingqayizivele, esigcwele izindaba eziphilayo zempilo. Abavakashi, abahlala, nabafundi, bonke bahlanganyela emizimbeni ethokozisayo, behamba phambili ekufundeni nasekuthokoziseni okuhlangenwe nakho kwabo. Ekupheleni kosuku, i-Sahara iyindawo yokubona, yokuhlola, nokucabanga. Okwamanje, ibonisa ubuhle bezenzakalo zempilo, ibalulekile ekwakheni izinkumbulo eziphilayo. Umoya opholile, izinkanyezi ezikhanya phezulu, kanye nemihlobiso yemvelo, konke kubonisa indlela yokuphila, ukuphila kwansuku zonke kwabo bonke abahlala kule ndawo engamaSand. I-Sahara iyakhanga, iyakhumbuza, futhi ibambene nezinkumbulo. Iphakathi kwethu izifundo ezaziso, izinkumbulo ezikhumbulekayo, nezinkanyezi ezihlaba umxhwele. Ngaphandle kokuhlala phezulu, i-Sahara iyisiqalo esisha sokuhlola, injabulo yokuphila, kanye nemigqa emisha yokubona izinto ezinhle. Noma ubani ophezu kwayo, uyakwazi ukufunda, ukuhamba, nokuhlonipha le ndawo engamaSand.
Kube nokudideka okuningi mayelana namagama wemithi, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zakamuva, ikakhulukazi mayelana namagama ezinto ezisebenzayo kule mithi. Ngiyethemba ukuthi namuhla ngizokwenza kube sobala kubantu. Ngamanye amazwi, umkhiqizi wemithi nguwo ophawula le mithi ngamagama abawanikayo. Manje ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ungabona ukuhlukaniswa kwamagama ezinkampani ezikhiqiza imithi efanayo kodwa ibizwa ngegama elihlukile. Ngakho-ke, kufanele uqaphele ngezinguquko zamagama ngoba kuvame ukushintshwa ngababhalisi abahlukene. Kubalulekile ukwazi ngemithi oyisebenzisayo. Ukuba nesisindo esikhulu kakhulu uma uqhathaniswa nekhanda lakho kungaba yingozi kakhulu empilweni yakho, kukubeka engcupheni yezifo ezinzima ezifana nokukhuluphala, isifo sikashukela, nezifo zenhliziyo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukwazi isisindo sakho ukuze ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokuthi uzisize. Odokotela bathanda ukusiza bonke abantu abakhuthazekile ukuba banakekele impilo yabo ngokwethula le program yokwehlisa isisindo. Bazohlola isisindo sakho, ukuphakama kwakho, bese bebona ukuthi isimo sakho sempilo sikhona noma uma ungase ube sengcupheni yokuthola lezi zifo ezishiwo ngaphambili ngokususelwa endleleni ophila ngayo. Uzothola inzuzo ngokuthola uhlu lwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla okufanele ulandele nokuthi ungawalahla kanjani isisindo uma kudingeka. Uzodingeka ubuye ngemva kokuvakasha kwakho kokuqala, bese kubonwa ukuthi kukhona yini umehluko. Le program izobanjwa kanye ngeviki, kuphela ngoMsombuluko. (Kubalulekile ukubhalisela kuqala). Bhalwe ngu: T.C.
Amanani Okudla: Uhlanga Lwenhlalo Yethu Ngiyavuma, uma sikhuluma ngamanani okudla, akukhona okuthile okungathinta impilo yethu njengokudla. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Ngiyazi, sonke sithanda ukudla, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngamanani, sithola ukuthi izinto zishintsha njalo. Ngiyazi, ngiyazi, ungase ube nesithakazelo sokwazi ukuthi kungani lokhu kwenzeka. Kukhona izizathu eziningi ezithinta amanani okudla. Okokuqala, sikhumbula ukuthi izimo zezulu zidlala indima enkulu. Uma umhlaba ungena emoyeni, izitshalo zethu ziba nezinkinga, futhi lokho kuholela ekwandeni kwamaholo. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani izithelo zikhula zibe zishibhile ngonyaka othile, bese ziba phezulu ngonyaka olandelayo? Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izimo zezulu zishintsha, futhi lokho kuthinta ukukhiqizwa kokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngempilo yomnotho. Uma umnotho uphila kahle, abantu banelungelo lokuthenga okungaphezulu. Kodwa uma umnotho ungena ezinkingeni, abantu bahlala bejolisa ekuthengeni okuncane. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi amanani okudla akhuphuke, ngoba abathengisi bazi ukuthi abantu badinga ukudla, ngakho-ke baphakamisa amanani ukuze benze inzuzo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kudinga ukucabangela? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu bahlala bezibuza ukuthi kungani izinkampani zokudla zikhuphula amanani. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izindleko zokukhiqiza zikhuphuka. Uma izindleko zokuthenga izinto ezisemqoka, njengezithako, zikhuphuka, abathengisi badinga ukwenyusa amanani ukuze balinganise. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo onzima, lapho abantu bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale bejolisa ekuthengeni okuncane. Kodwa akukhona konke okubi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi kunezindlela zokunciphisa izindleko zokudla? Ukuthenga ezitolo ezincane noma ezisemaphandleni kungaba yindlela enhle yokuthola ukudla okungabizi kakhulu. Futhi, uma ungathanda, ungazama ukutshala izitshalo zakho. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekunciphiseni izindleko, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngamasiko ethu. Ezinye izindawo zinezakhamuzi ezithanda ukudla okwenziwa ngamasiko. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, futhi abantu bahlala bejolisa ekuthengeni ukudla okwenziwe ngamasiko. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo omuhle, lapho abantu bejolisa ekuthengeni okuthile, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo kubathengisi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi amanani okudla awanqotshwa kalula? Kukhona izici eziningi ezithinta lokhu, futhi kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sithinta impilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, uma uhamba esitolo, cabanga ngalezi zinto. Ucabanga ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuze unciphise izindleko zakho? Futhi, ungakuthola kanjani ukudla okungcono, okungabizi kakhulu? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi amanani okudla azoshintsha. Kodwa uma sikhumbula lezi zinto, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, hamba phambili, thola izindlela zokuthola ukudla okungabizi, futhi ungakhohlwa ukujabulisa umndeni wakho ngempilo enempilo. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lokhu kukhuthaze ukuba ucabange ngamanani okudla nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuze uphile kahle. Hamba phambili, futhi ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukudla akukhona nje kuphela ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila.
Ukuthengiswa kwezinhlanzi kubandakanya imisebenzi ehlobene nokuthumela izinhlanzi kwamanye amazwe ukuze uthole inzuzo. Ukuze uthumele izinhlanzi eNingizimu Afrika noma ukuze uzithumele ngaphandle kwemingcele yelizwe, kumele ufake isicelo sokuthumela esikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMnyango ophathe izenzo zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuthumela izinhlanzi ngaphandle kwalolu phiko. Faka isicelo sesikhumbuzo esisha uma lesi onaso siphelelwe yisikhathi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wesikhumbuzo, isikhumbuzo sakho singase sithathwe noma sikhanselwe. Qaphela: Isikhumbuzo sokuthumela izinhlanzi asifaki izinhlanzi ezitholakala emanzini angaphakathi. Lezi zinhlanzi zilawulwa umnyango wezolimo. Izicelo zesikhumbuzo sokuthumela izinhlanzi ezitholakala emanzini angaphakathi, kanye nezinye ezitholakala ezindaweni ezithile, zithunyelwa emnyangweni wezolimo. Lona umnyango ophumelelayo ekukhishweni kwesikhumbuzo. Izinhlanzi ezibhalwe esivumelwaneni sokuhweba ngezinhlobo eziyingozi azivunyelwe ukuthunyelwa. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi ngale nhlangano, vakashela ku-http://www.cites.org. Isikhumbuzo sokuthumela i-abalone kumele sibe ne-CITES certificate yokuthunyelwa ngakunye. Isikhumbuzo sokuthumela i-bigeye tuna, i-southern bluefin tuna, i-swordfish, i-Antarctic toothfish, kanye ne-Patagonian toothfish kumele sibe nedokhumenti echaza inani lazo ngakunye. Amadokhumenti enani lezinhlanzi atholakala emnyangweni ophathe izenzo zomphakathi zendawo nezokuvakasha, ehhovisi lephoyisa elibhekele izindaba zezimayini nezokwakhiwa, kanye nehhovisi likamqondisi omkhulu wezindaba zezimayini nezokwakhiwa. Faka isicelo sesikhumbuzo sokuthumela. Thola amafomu okuthumela kanye nama-CITES forms ehhovisi lezimayini nezokwakhiwa noma emnyangweni ophathe izenzo zomphakathi zendawo nezokuvakasha, noma uwathole ku-http://www.mcm-deat.gov.za. Gcwalisa ifomu uqinisekise ukuthi uqedile zonke izidingo zokufaka isicelo. Amakhophi amadokhumenti enani lezinhlanzi nawo adingeka kuzo zonke izinhlanzi ezifana ne-bigeye tuna, i-southern bluefin tuna, i-swordfish, i-Antarctic toothfish, kanye ne-Patagonian toothfish ezathunyelwa ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo sangaphambilini, kanye nenani lezinhlanzi ofuna ukulithumela. Bika ehhovisi le-South African Bureau of Standards eliseduze mayelana nokuthunyelwa kwakho uma izinhlanzi ozithumelayo zingaveli emanzini angaphakathi noma zingafaneleki ukudliwa ngabantu. Uma izinhlanzi zakho zivela emanzini angaphakathi futhi zizodliwa abantu, bika emnyangweni wezempilo. Imali yokufaka isicelo ingu-R225. Qedela, podpishe, futhi uthumele ifomu lakho kanye namadokhumenti adingekayo ehhovisi lezimayini nezokwakhiwa endaweni yakho; kungenjalo, isikhumbuzo ngeke sikhishwe. Amadokhumenti okuqala yilokho okufanele ufake; ngaphandle kwabo, ngeke uthole isikhumbuzo. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma isikhathi eside uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele. Ingxoxo Ngomthombo Wokuphila: iMount Everest Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ithuba lokukhuluma nomhambi ophumelelayo, uMnu. Thabo Mthembu, owakha igama lakhe njengomgibeli ophumelelayo eMount Everest. UThabo, oneminyaka engama-35, ube nezinsuku eziningi ezikhumbulekayo ezinyakazweni zakhe eziphakeme. Ngiyajabula ukukwazi, Thabo. Ungasichazela kanjani ukuthi waqala kanjani uhambo lwakho lokukhuphuka iMount Everest? UThabo Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukuqala, ngifuna ukusho ukuthi uthando lwami lwezintaba lwaqala ngisemncane. Ngakhula eMpumalanga Kapa, lapho izintaba zazingamaqhugwane. Ngazithokozela kakhulu, futhi ngafuna ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zindawo eziphakeme. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami, ngathola ithuba lokuhamba nezinkanyezi eziphakeme, futhi lokho kwangikhuthaza ukuba ngifinyelele iMount Everest. Umbuzo: Kuyajabulisa lokho! Yini eyakwenza wathanda ukuhamba eMount Everest, ikakhulukazi uma kukhona izingozi eziningi ezihambisana nalokhu? UThabo: Ngiyavuma, iMount Everest iyindawo enobungozi, kodwa umoya wokuphumelela ungaphezu kwezingozi. Ngithanda ukucabanga ngalezi zinto njengemithwalo engiyithwele. Ngiyazi ukuthi izingozi zikhona, kodwa ngifuna ukufunda nokukhula. Ngithanda umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela emhlabeni wonke, bonke bejolise ekufinyeleleni umgomo ofanayo. Lokhu kwenza kube mnandi futhi kukhuthaze. Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imikhuba ethile yokuzilungiselela ngaphambi kokukhuphuka? UThabo: Yebo, ngiyaziqhenya ngokuthi ngiyazilungiselela kahle. Ngithatha isikhathi sokuzivocavoca, ngihamba ngezinyawo ezinzima, futhi ngifunda ngempilo yezintaba. Ngiyazi ukuthi udinga amandla, kodwa futhi udinga ukwazi ukulawula imizwa yakho. Ngifunda ukucabanga kahle, ngiyazithokozisa, futhi ngithola izindlela zokuphila eziphusile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze ngikwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Umbuzo: Ngabe ungabelana nathi ngolwazi oluthile olukhona ngempilo yakho ngesikhathi sokukhuphuka? UThabo: Ngempela, ngikhumbula kahle usuku engangikhuphuka khona. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, futhi izimo zazinzima. Ngafika endaweni ethile, ngazizwa ngikhathazekile, kodwa ngazithola ngikhumbula ukuthi ngingedwa. Ngabheka emuva, ngabona abanye abahambi, futhi lokho kwanginika amandla. Ngafunda ukuthi umoya wokubambisana ungaphezu kokuphumelela. Ngithole ukuthi ngingakwazi ukuhamba, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza. Umbuzo: Ngabe ubona izinguquko ezithile emhlabeni wezintaba, ikakhulukazi eMount Everest? UThabo: Yebo, ngiyabona izinguquko ezinkulu. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kubonakala kakhulu. Izinga lokushisa liphansi, futhi izindawo eziningi zishintsha. Lokhu kuthinta izimo zokukhuphuka, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela lezi zindawo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi kufanele sibe nomthwalo wemfanelo ukuze sigcine lezi zindawo zihlala zikhangayo. Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imiyalo ethile kubantu abafuna ukuhamba eMount Everest? UThabo: Ngiyabonga, ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle. Abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi akukhona nje ukuhamba, kodwa kudinga ukuzilungiselela. Futhi, badinga ukwazi ukuthi umoya wokubambisana ubalulekile. Ngiyakhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, baphinde baziqhenye ngezinto abazifundayo. Lokhu kuzobasiza kakhulu uma befika ezindaweni eziphakeme. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga, Thabo, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinto ezibalulekile. Uhambo lwakho lukhombisa ukuthi umoya wokuphumelela ungaphezu kwezithiyo. Ngiyabonga futhi ngokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enempilo futhi bahlale bejolise emigomweni yabo. Ngiyabonga!
Izinkambiso ze-apartheid kanye nekoloni zazihlosiwe ukudala izimo lapho iningi labantu bezwe lingagcinwanga kuphela kodwa laphinde lahlukunyezwa kakhulu. Lokhu kuholele ekungalinganeni lapho isiNgisi nesiAfrikaans kwanikezwa isimo esisemthethweni futhi kwakhuthazwa ngendlela ehlelekile kuyilapho izilimi zomdabu zezwe zashiywa zinganakiwe. I-Gauteng Provincial Language Policy Framework ithuthukiswe njengomphumela oqondile we-Constitional Assembly yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, kanye ne-National Language Policy Framework (evunyelwe futhi yashicilelwa ngoMashi 2003) ethuthukisa amalungelo emthethweni mayelana nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kolimi. I-National Language Policy Framework ifuna zonke izifundazwe ukuthi zithuthukise izinqubomgomo zazo zolimi ngokuhambisana nayo. I-Gauteng Provincial Policy Framework iyimiphumela yokubambisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifundazwe, kanye lesizwe. Lezi zithakazelo zifaka phakathi i-National Language Centre yeMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, i-Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG), iminyango kanye nokugxila okukhulu okuvela kuMnyango Wezokufunda waseGauteng, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izikhungo, iLegislative Assembly, kanye nabaphathi bezilimi. Le nqubo yokubambisana yakhuthazwa nguMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukujabulisa, Ubuciko namasiko ngosizo lwabaculi abahlukene emikhakheni yolimi. Lo mcimbi, ohambisana nokubambisana okuhlakaniphile (futhi kwesinye isikhathi okukhulu) phakathi kwabaphathi bezilimi nabavukeli, ubonisa inselelo ejabulisayo ku-Gauteng Language Policy Framework, efuna ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo ebanzi yokuphumeza uhlelo oluphumelelayo lwezilimi eziningi. Iphinde ibhekane nemiphumela ebalulekile yocwaningo lwezizwe nolimi oluvunyelwe yiSouth African Languages Board ngo-2001, lapho kwathathwa isampula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanezinyanga eziyi-16 naphezulu abahlolwe kuyo yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Imikhakha egcizelelwe ifaka phakathi ulimi lwasekhaya nokusetshenziswa kolimi emikhakheni yomphakathi neyomphakathi, izimo zomphakathi nezikhungo, ulimi lomsebenzi kanye nezemfundo, izimo ezicatshangelwa ezinqubweni zolimi, kanye nekhono lokushintsha izilimi nokukhuluma izilimi eziningi. Umthethosisekelo ubheka imfundo njengengxenye ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi. I-Gauteng Language Policy Framework iphinde ibheke izinhlinzeko zeSouth African Schools Act ka-1996 mayelana nokusetshenziswa kolimi ezikoleni nokuthi kanjani iLanguage Policy in Education ihlangana nesimo semfundo. Inhloso ye-Gauteng Language Policy Framework ukuhlinzeka nokuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu eGauteng ezake zashiywa ngaphandle. Isigaba 29 sithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ezilimini ezisemthethweni azikhethile ezikhungweni zomphakathi lapho imfundo ingatholakala khona. I-PANSALB Act ka-1995 njengoba ilungisiwe, kanye nezinye izinhlinzeko, ihlinzeka ngokuqashelwa, ukusetshenziswa, nokukhuthazwa kokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezake zashiywa ngaphandle. Iphinde igcizelele ukusungulwa kwamakomidi ezilimi zesifundazwe okumele akhuthaze ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi ezweni. I-Gauteng Provincial Government, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukujabulisa, Ubuciko namasiko, isungule iGauteng Language Committee. Nakuba iSouth African Schools Act (SASA) ihlinzeka ngenqubo yokuthi ilungiswe kwezinye izindawo, okwamanje inikeza uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo nangemva kokuxoxisana neKhansela leMinisters, igunya lokubeka izindinganiso zezinqubomgomo zolimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Iphinde icacise ukuthi umzimba ophatha isikole somphakathi ungakhetha izinqubomgomo zolimi ngokulandela umthethosisekelo, lo mthethosisekelo (SASA), nezinye izinqubomgomo zesifundazwe ezihambelana. Izinhloso ze-Promotion of Access to Information Act kufanele zihlinzeke ngokuqinisekiswa kwesikhala somthethosisekelo sokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso, imiphakathi ezimele, noma abantu ngabanye ngaphansi kwemikhawulo efanele. Ukufinyelela akumele kube kuphela ukuthola ulwazi ngempela kodwa kufanele futhi, lapho kungenzeka, kube ngolimi olukhethiwe ngumfaki-sicelo. Njengoba iSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo ibhala, ulimi luwumkhakha osebenzayo wokwakha nolwazi phakathi kwesifundazwe, iNational Language Policy Framework ibeka ukuthi zonke izikhungo zombuso (ezingeni lendawo, lesifundazwe, kanye lesizwe) nezinye izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezisebenza emisebenzini yomphakathi zibophelelekile nguMthetho. Izifundazwe kulindeleke ukuthi zithuthukise izinqubomgomo zazo zolimi ezihambisana neNational Language Policy Framework ngenkathi zicabangela izimo zesifundazwe, izidingo, kanye nezinto ezikhethwa yimiphakathi yazo. Le nqubo izodluliselwa kuzinhlelo zendawo ezizothuthukisa izinqubomgomo zazo zolimi ngokuhambisana neProvincial Policy Framework. Uhulumeni uphinde ukhuthazwe, lapho kudingeka, ukuxhasa umkhankaso ozimele wokuthuthukisa nokuphumeza izinqubomgomo zawo zolimi ngokulandela lezi zinqubomgomo. I-Language Policy in Education iyinqubomgomo yolimi yesizwe esebenza ngaphakathi kwesimo semfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano ngokuhlanganisa ubuhlanga, amasiko, izilimi, kanye nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudalwe indawo lapho ukuhlonishwa kwezilimi ezingezona ezomuntu siqu kukhuthazwa. Ukuxhumana ezilimini eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zesizwe kuzohlonishwa futhi kukhuthazwe. Njengengxenye yezimiso zayo, i-Language Policy in Education ikhuluma ukuthi bonke abafundi kumele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi olulodwa lomdabu, zonke izikhala zolimi zizothola isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla ezihlobene ezingeni lesifundazwe zizothola iziqondiso zezinguquko ezidingekayo zokukhuthaza izilimi njengemikhakha, ngokuhambisana nemithetho yesizwe. Umkhakha we-Language Policy Framework uzobheka iminyango ye-GPG, iGauteng Legislature, izikhungo ezinakekela ukusetshenziswa kwazo kolimi lwesifundazwe nokukhetha, nezikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezisebenza emisebenzini yomphakathi. Amabhizinisi azimele kanye nezinhlangano ezingezona ezikahulumeni nazo zizokhuthazwa ukuba zithuthukise izinqubomgomo zazo ngokuhambisana nalezi zinqubomgomo. Lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi isiZulu yisilimi sasekhaya esikhuluma ngaphezu kuka-20% wabantu ezingeni lesifundazwe nasemhlabeni jikelele. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba isiNgisi sisetshenziswa kabanzi njengolimi lwezohwebo nesayensi, sithola indawo yesine neshumi ezingeni lesifundazwe nasemhlabeni jikelele ngokulandelana. Lokhu kuqhubeka kukhombisa ukuthi akukho silimi esisodwa esiphakeme kakhulu esikhuluma emkhakheni wesifundazwe kodwa kunokukhuluma izilimi eziningi lapho izilimi eziphezulu ezinhlanu zikhuluma ngaphezu kuka-10% wabantu, okuhlanganiswe
