Busi Nyembezi, uqinisekisile ukuthi uzokwethula izinguquko ezintsha ezizoholela ekuthuthukiseni indlela umnyango owahlinzeka ngayo usizo emphakathini. Ekhuluma noNwele Olude ekuqaleni kwale nyanga, ngemva kokuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uNkk. Neliswa Peggy ekhombise isifiso sokusebenza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, uDkt. Nyembezi uchaze ukuthi baphazamisekile ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokwenza umsebenzi wabo nokunye. Uqhubekile wathi umnyango uthuthuke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zezempilo, kodwa okudingekayo ngokuphuthumayo yizindlu zabasebenzi bezempilo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, okuyisidingo esiphuthumayo. Kukhona isidingo sezikhungo zezempilo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nokwandiswa kwenani lezibhedlela, kodwa kudingeka sithuthukise indlela usizo oluhlinzekwa ngayo emphakathini, washilo. Ubuye waqinisekisa ukuthi uzokwakha izinhlelo zokulwa nokwanda kwe-HIV/AIDS. Uhlele ukwenza lokhu ngokwakha izinhlelo zokubambisana nezinye izigaba zikamasipala kanye nabantu besebhizinisi abaseduze nomnyango wethu. Ukubakhona kwakhe kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi siqhubeka nokuqhubeka kokwakha izikhungo ezintsha ezifana nezikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, kusho uNgqongqoshe. Umnyango wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo esifundazweni manje usendleleni yokufaka abantu ukuze abhekane nezimo eziphuthumayo emigwaqweni. Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo olwaqala ngonyaka odlule lapho abantu abangu-50 baqeqeshwa futhi manje sebebenza emnyangweni. U-Ntsobi uthe iningi labantu abazobanjwa kuzobekwa ezindaweni zasemaphandleni uma beqeda izifundo zabo, ezilindelekile ukuthi zithathe izinyanga ezintathu. Manje siqala isigaba sesibili sokwandisa izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kulandela impumelelo yesigaba sokuqala ngonyaka odlule lapho sathola nabantu abangu-50, kuchaza uNtsobi. Umphathi walesi sikhungo uthe ngaphezu kwe-90% yalabo abaqeqeshwayo bazoba ngabesifazane. Sibone ukuthi kungcono ukuthatha abesifazane abaningi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi nabo bayanda kulo mkhakha wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Eminyakeni edlule, umsebenzi wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo wawaziwa ngokuba namadoda. Sibone ukuthi abesifazane bangakwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi kahle njengabantu besilisa, kusho uNtsobi. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo kuyingxenye yohlelo lukamasipala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo kulesi sifundazwe zithola usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo uma kudingeka. Sizokuqinisekisa futhi ukuthi imiphakathi enezinketho ezilinganiselwe ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ibhekwa kuhlelo. Umnyango uqinisekisile ukuthi izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zikhanga ngokwakha izikhungo zezempilo nezibhedlela ezisezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuvinjwe ukufa okungadingekile okubangelwa ukulibaziseka kwabantu ukuthola usizo, kuchaza uNtsobi. Uthe labo abazotholwa emsebenzini ngeke babe bonke abavela esifundazweni sonke. Kudingeka kube nabantu abangakaze bathole ithuba lokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Uqhubekile wathi kumele babe nematriki, izitifiketi zokushayela (ikhowudi 10), kanye nezitifiketi zokushayela zomphakathi (PDP). Labo abaqeda izifundo zabo bazoba namathuba okuqhubeka nezifundo zabo kulo mkhakha lapho ekugcineni bazothola khona izikhungo nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. Sifundisa ukuzimisela, ukuhlela, ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzibophezela, nokuzinikela njengokhiye wokuphumelela. URonald Green-Thompson, lapho sibuyela, sifunda kuye ukuze sibe abantu abangcono. Usifundisile ukuthi kumele sikhule ngokwanele ukuze sikwazi ukusiza imiphakathi yethu. UGreen-Thompson uthe uyajabula ngentuthuko yezibhedlela ezintsha ezimbili, ezilindeleke ukuvulwa maduze, futhi njengoba waziwa ngokusebenza nabo emkhakheni Wezempilo Kazwelonke kanye nazo zonke izimpumelelo zezibhedlela zeMahatma Gandhi, sivuma lapho sikhuluma ngalokho, nalabo asebenza nabo kanye neBhodi, ngidlulisa amazwi kaMnyango ngesikhathi seMnyango Wezempilo onezibhedlela ezingu-340, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, abasebenzi kulo mnyango abanjalo abawazisa kakhulu uProfesa osanda kuba yisikhulu. Lezi zibhedlela ezingu-340 noKing Albert zikhona kukho konke esikwenzayo, wamiswa njengesikhulu sikaGreen-Thompson ngenxa yokufaka kwakhe. "Noma kukhona okuningi okusele ukwenza, iLuthuli Central Hospital kumele ifune okungcono, kodwa umnyango ngonyaka ka-1995. kulo mnyango. Sibonga wonke umuntu ngalokho okwenzekile, kodwa ezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu nakubantu esisebenzisana nabo." UGreen-Thompson ungumphathi wezobuchwepheshe osinikeze ithuba lokusiza labo abaneziguli ezingu-840," kusho yena. Umnyango Wezempilo uqaphele ukuthi uProfesa Green-Thompson ukwazi ukufaka izinzuzo ezivela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezingu-122. Umcimbi wokuhamba kwenhlonipho kaProfesa wabanjwa ngenhlonipho owakhiwe ngo-2003. Ngemuva kokuba uGreen-Thompson ebambe iqhaza emcimbini wokuhamba kwenhlonipho kaProfesa Green-nokuzinikela nokuzinikela kulokhu kuphinde kwathengwa umnyango izinto eziningi eminyakeni eminingi njengomphathi uThompson. Ukuphakela inkulumo yakhe, umsebenzi wakhe njengomphathi ube yimpumelelo kanye nemiklomelo yoMnyango Wezempilo. Lo mcimbi wawuhanjelwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uNkk. woMnyango. onezikhungo zezempilo ezingu-56. wawubanjwe yalo mnyango. Wawubanjwe eThekwini, e-ICC. Lapho umcimbi uphela, uProfesa wanikezwa izipho zakhe kanye neposi eliqukethe imiyalezo evela kubasebenzi balo mnyango. Njengoba sonke sazi, umcimbi awuwona umcimbi ngaphandle kwegayi, wonke umuntu ujabule ngegayi eyenziwe kulomcimbi omkhulu wokuhamba kwenhlonipho kaProfesa Green-Thompson. Umyalezo ovela kuNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uthi thina siyiMnyango Wezempilo futhi sikhona esifundazweni sikaMphakathi ngonyaka Wempumelelo ekutholeni nasekuthengiseni izinkampani ezizimele. UPEGGY NKONYENI ukufaka owesifazane ngonyaka ka-1996 wakhushulwa esikhundleni sokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS. Kukhona u-R2.4 billion njengomphathi weMnyango. ukuba umqondisi wesifundazwe Sijolise kakhulu ekuvikeleni okungasetshenziswanga kulokhu Kanjalo njengonyaka wokuqala, Sinethuba elihle njengoba sikhona eMgungundlovu. nokukhuthaza izindlela zokusebenza. Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba uDkt. Nyembezi uyazi kahle Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukuze ngithuthukise Njengoba kube unyaka ukuze ngikubingelele Ngifisela unyaka izidingo zabantu bethu futhi ngihlale ngibonga uDkt. Nyembezi mayelana nokudla, ukuqina Ngikhona kulo mnyango, ngiyajabula ngo-200
Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Umbuzo 1: Yini i-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant? Impendulo: I-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant iyisibonelelo esenziwe nguHulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokusiza izakhamuzi ezithintekile kakhulu yilezi zimo ze-COVID-19. Inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngempilo ngemali kubantu abangenayo ngenxa yokuncipha kwemisebenzi. Umbuzo 2: Ubani ongawufaka isicelo salesi sibonelelo? Impendulo: Abantu abanemali encane, abaphila ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile, bangafaka isicelo salesi sibonelelo. Lokhu kuhilela labo abavela emindenini engatholi imali ethile, abaphila bodwa, kanye nalabo abangenayo imithombo yokusebenza ngenxa yokuphelelwa yisikhathi kwemisebenzi. Umbuzo 3: Umsebenzi walesi sibonelelo ungakanani? Impendulo: Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sinikela ngempahla ethile yemali, eyi-R350 ngenyanga. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abantu ukuthi bafeze izidingo ezisemqoka ezifana nokudla, izindleko zokuhlala, nezokuthutha. Umbuzo 4: Ziyini izinyathelo okufanele zilandwe ukuze ufake isicelo? Impendulo: Ukuze ufake isicelo, udinga ukuvakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-SASSA (South African Social Security Agency) noma usebenzise izinhlelo zefoni ezitholakalayo. Isicelo sifaka imininingwane yakho, isikhumbuzo esiqinile, nezimpawu zokuqinisekisa ubunikazi. Umbuzo 5: Kungakanani isikhathi sokucubungula isicelo? Impendulo: Isikhathi sokucubungula singaba phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 kuya kwezingu-21, kuncike ekutheni isicelo sithunyelwe kahle futhi zonke izidingo zifakiwe. Umbuzo 6: Ingabe kukhona imikhawulo yokusebenzisa le mali? Impendulo: Yebo, le mali ibhekelelwa kuphela ezidingweni ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubandakanya ukudla, izindleko zokuhlala, nezindleko eziyisisekelo. Akukhuthazeki ukuyisebenzisa ezinhlelweni ezingekho emthethweni noma ngenye indlela engafanele. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezikhona zokusebenzisa lesi sibonelelo? Impendulo: Le mali inikeza usizo olubalulekile kubantu abavela ezimeni ezinzima, ikakhulukazi lapho kungekho msebenzi. Iphinde ithuthukise umnotho wendawo ngokukhuthaza ukuthengwa kwezimpahla ezisemqoka. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe kukhona isikhathi esinqunyiwe sokuthola lesi sibonelelo? Impendulo: Yebo, lesi sibonelelo sikhona kuze kube uJuni 2024, kodwa kungaba nezinguquko ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuhlala ubheka izimemezelo ezivela kuhulumeni ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinselelo abantu abahlangabezana nazo lapho befaka isicelo? Impendulo: Abantu abaningi babhekana nezinkinga zokufinyelela ku-inthanethi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Kwesinye isikhathi, izicelo zingabhekwa isikhathi eside, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imali ngesikhathi. Umbuzo 10: Ingabe kukhona izindlela zokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bafake izicelo? Impendulo: Ukuze kukhuthazwe abantu, kungaba kuhle ukuhlela imihlangano nemisebenzi yokwazisa emphakathini, lapho abantu bangathola khona ulwazi olunembile. Ukubambisana nezinkampani ezithile ezibandakanya imiphakathi kungasiza ekukhuthazeni abantu. Umbuzo 11: Zithini izindlela zokulandelela isimo sesicelo? Impendulo: Ungakwazi ukulandelela isimo sesicelo sakho ngokuxhumana ne-SASSA, noma uvakashele kuwebhusayithi yabo. Abantu bangasebenzisa futhi izinhlelo zefoni ezitholakalayo ukuze bathole izibuyekezo. Umbuzo 12: Yini okudingeka abantu bayazi mayelana nesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant? Impendulo: Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde izimiso nezimo ezihambisana nale mali. Futhi kufanele bazi ukuthi lesi sibonelelo akumele sithathwe njengokuhlala, kodwa njengezinyathelo zalesi sikhathi esinzima. Umbuzo 13: Ingabe le mali izosizwa ngabanye abantu? Impendulo: Yebo, imiphakathi ingakwazi ukusiza abanye ngokwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, noma ngempela, ngokuthola izinto zokuphila. Ukuhlanganyela komphakathi kubalulekile ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezibangelwa yilezi zimo. Umbuzo 14: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezilandelayo uma isicelo singenamphumela? Impendulo: Uma isicelo singenamphumela, ungathintana ne-SASSA ukuze uthole izizathu. Kungenzeka futhi ufake isicelo esisha uma ungazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ezikhona. Umbuzo 15: Ingabe i-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant izoqhubeka ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi? Impendulo: Lokhu kuncike ezinqumweni zikaHulumeni. Uma kudingeka, kungenzeka kube nezinhlelo ezintsha ezizokwakhiwa ukuze zisize abantu abathintekile. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu bahlale bekwaziswa. Ngokuhambisana nalezi zihloko, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lesi sibonelelo singenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi. Ukwaziswa kahle nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zokufaka izicelo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola usizo lwezezimali abaluqhamukayo.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile Umbuzo 1: Yini amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Amanzi ahlanzekile angamafutha amanzi anobumsulwa futhi awanazo izifo. Akukhona nje ukubukeka kwawo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuze siphile, izilwane, nezitshalo zibe nempilo. Amanzi ahlanzekile akhuthaza impilo enempilo, futhi ahlale efaneleka ukusetyenziswa ezindaweni zokudla nasemiphakathini, njengoba izinga lawo lithinta impilo yethu. Umbuzo 2: Kungani amanzi ahlanzekile ebucayi? Impendulo: Amanzi ahlanzekile abalulekile ukuze siqhubeke siphila kahle. Amanzi angahlanzekile angaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, njengezifo nezinkinga ezahlukahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanzi ahlanzekile adinga ukugcina imvelo iphila, asiza izitshalo nezilwane. Ngakho, ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile kubalulekile empilweni yemiphakathi yethu. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinsiza eziqhubekayo zokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Ukuze sithole amanzi ahlanzekile, kudinga imithombo ethile njengezithombe, izigodi, nemithombo emihle. Ukuze amanzi abe ahlanzekile, kumele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlanzwa, ukuphathwa, kanye nezinto eziphuzwayo. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufanele, njengezinhlelo zokuhlunga amanzi, kungasiza ekwandiseni ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Umbuzo 4: Yini esingayenza ukuze sigcine amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Kukhona izinto eziningi esingazenza ukuze sigcine amanzi ahlanzekile. Okokuqala, kufanele sigweme ukungcolisa imithombo yamanzi, okuhlanganisa ukuhoxisa imfucumfucu, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo enokungcolisa, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise amanzi ngokucophelela. Futhi, izinhlelo zokubhaliswa zidingeka ukuze abantu benze kahle. Umbuzo 5: Kuthinta kanjani amanzi ahlanzekile izimpilo zomphakathi? Impendulo: Amanzi ahlanzekile athinta izimpilo zomphakathi ngokuqondile. Uma abantu bethola amanzi ahlanzekile, lezi zinto zinciphisa izinkinga zezempilo, njengezifo zokudla. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni ukuziphatha kwabantu nasekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezamabhizinisi. Futhi, uma amanzi ahlanzekile ekhona, umphakathi ujabulela impilo engcono. Umbuzo 6: Yisiphi isimo samanzi ahlanzekile emhlabeni jikelele? Impendulo: Isimo samanzi ahlanzekile emhlabeni jikelele sikhathazekile. Ezinye izindawo zithola amanzi ahlanzekile kalula, kodwa ezinye zibhekene nezinselele zokungcola. Izimo zezulu nezinsiza ezikhona zihlala zithinta imithombo yamanzi. Kunezinhlelo ezihamba phambili, kodwa kusekhona imiphakathi ethola amanzi angahambisani nezidingo zabo, okudingeka izixazululo eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 7: Kukhona yini izinhlelo ezikhona zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Yebo, kunezinhlelo eziningi zomphakathi nezamazwe wonke eziqhubekayo ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Lezi zinhlelo zifaka amaphrojekthi okwakha izinsiza, imithombo yokuhlunga, kanye nemfundo kubantu mayelana nokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Imali ethile iphumeza imithombo yokuhlola amanzi, ukusiza ukugcina izinga lempilo. Umbuzo 8: Yini esingayenza njengomphakathi ukuze sisekele amanzi ahlanzekile? Impendulo: Njengomphakathi, singagqugquzela izinhlelo zokuhlalisana ezithinta ukuphathwa kwamanzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwazisa abantu ngezindlela zokusebenzisa amanzi kahle, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana nemiphakathi yendawo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ukwazi ukuvikela amanzi ahlanzekile kuzothuthukisa umoya wokulondoloza phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe amakhono ezokuhlanzeka amanzi awama ikhono lokuziphatha kahle? Impendulo: Impela, amakhono ezokuhlanzeka kwamanzi afuna ukuthi sithole ulwazi olunembile. Lokhu kuhilela ukufunda ngezinto ezihamba phambili, izingozi ezithinta amanzi, kanye nezindlela zokuziphatha ezihlukene. Sonke singaba nezinsiza zokuvikela amanzi ahlanzekile ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezihlalayo. Isiphetho: Izinselelo zikhona, kodwa umphakathi unamandla okwenza umehluko. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile kudinga ukuba sithandazele impilo engcono, ukuze sithole ubuhle bemvelo bokuphila. Njengoba sikhuluma ngamanzi ahlanzekile, asijoli lapho—phaqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi ophephile, onempilo, kanye nomoya wokuhlalisana. Amanzi ahlanzekile, impilo enempilo!
Umbiko Ngemidlalo ye-Minecraft: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezwe Lokuqala Isingeniso Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokuphila kwempilo yezenzakalo, iMinecraft isikhule saba yinsika yokudlala emhlabeni. Ijolise ekwakheni, ekuphileni, nasekuhlanganyeleni. Iphakathi kwama-players abaneminyaka ehlukene, futhi ithandwa ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha. Lo mbiko uzogxila ezimpilweni, amathuba, nezinselelo ezihlobene nokudlala iMinecraft. Ukwakhiwa Kwendawo IMinecraft iyinsika yokwakha, lapho abadlali benza izakhiwo eziphakeme, izinqaba ezinamandla, nezimo zokuhlala. Lokhu kuhilela ukusebenzisa izinto ezitholakala emhlabeni, njengezinkuni, amatshe, nezinsiza. Abadlali bangaqala ngokwakha amakhaya alula, bese beqhubeka bavula izindawo ezinkulu eziphumayo ezifana namadolobha, izinqaba ezinkulu, noma izindawo zomhlaba ezithakazelisayo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphila nokwakha, okwenza abadlali bazizwe bekhuthazekile. Izinto Zokwakha Nezinhlelo Zokudlala I-Minecraft inezinhlelo ezinkulu ezihlanganisa izigcawu ezahlukahlukene, njengokwakha, ukuhamba, nokuqhuba izinkanyezi. Abadlali bangakhetha phakathi kokudlala bodwa, kakhulu ngokwakha, noma ukuza ndawonye nabanye ukuze banikeze izinhlelo zokudlala ezinomthelela. Lokhu kubangela ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, lapho bejabulisa futhi befundisa ukuba basebenzisane. Izinsiza ezitholakala emhlabeni zenza kube lula ukudala izinto eziphathelene nokwakha, futhi lokhu kusebenza ekudaleni izindawo eziphilayo neziphilayo. Izinselelo Nezinto Zokufunda Noma iMinecraft ibonakala njengemidlalo elula, inezinselelo eziningi ezithinta abadlali. Ukuze ufinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuhamba emhlabeni, ukwakha izinsiza ezinamandla, nokuzivikela ezitheni ezitholakalayo. Uhlanga lwezinto ezifana ne-zombies, ama-skeleton, nemikhuba engalindelekile ingabangela ubunzima kumadoda nabesifazane. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokufunda, lapho abadlali benza izinqumo eziphusile ukuze baphumelele. Umphakathi Nokuhlanganyela Umphakathi weMinecraft uyingxenye ebalulekile yokuhlangenwe nakho komdlalo. Abadlali bangakha amaqembu, babe nezinhlangano, futhi baqhamuke nezinhlelo eziningi ezikhuthaza ukuhweba, ukwakha, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana, njengezinkundla, imiphakathi ye-inthanethi, nezingxoxo, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngamasu, izimfundiso, nemikhiqizo yokwakha. Lokhu kugqugquzela ubudlelwano obujulile phakathi kwabantu abavela emhlabeni wonke. Izinga Lokwenza Nempumelelo Kufanele kuphawulwe ukuthi iMinecraft inikeza abadlali ithuba lokuthola amakhono amasha, ukuze kube nokusebenza okukhalipha nokuvelela. Ngaphezu kokwakha, abadlali bahlola, baphila, futhi bahlola umhlaba. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezifundo ezibalulekile zokuphila, njengokuhleleka, ukucabanga kahle, nokuhlola izinketho ezahlukene. Noma ngabe umgomo uwukwakha, ukuhweba, noma ukusindisa umhlaba, iMinecraft ikhulisa amakhono ezinkanyezi. Isiphetho IMinecraft ayikhuli nje kuphela njengomdlalo, kodwa futhi ithuthukisa ubudlelwano, ibeka izinselelo, futhi igqugquzela amakhono empilo. Njengoba abadlali behlanganyela, bejabulisa, futhi befunda, iMinecraft ibonisa ukuthi umhlaba wezobuciko ungaba yindawo yokuhlola, yokudala, nokuhlanganyela. Iphinde ibonise indlela yokuphila okukhulayo, okuyinto ebalulekile empilweni yanamuhla. Ngalokhu, iMinecraft ingaphezu kwemidlalo, iyindawo yokwakha izinkumbulo, ubudlelwano, nokuhlanganyela emhlabeni.
Umkhakha Wamazwi Kazwelonke (NLS) ukhuthaza futhi uqhuba ukuxhumana ngezilimi ezahlukene. Njengengxenye yokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, i-NLS ilawula ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emphakathini wethu futhi inesibopho sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilimi zethu kulolu suku, ngokusebenzisa lokho okukhuluma ngakho emthethweni ophakanyisiwe wokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi, kanye nazo zonke izilimi ezishiywe ngaphandle emlandweni waleli lizwe. Umsebenzi omkhulu we-NLS ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthethosisekelo ngokwenza kube lula, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlinzeka ngosizo lokuhumusha nokuhlela kuzo zonke izilimi ezamukelwe ngokomthetho, kanye nokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngokuhlela izilimi nezincazelo ezinhlelweni ezithile. I-NLS isebenza njengengxenye yoHulumeni bezazi zelizwi ngokuhumusha imibhalo ebhalwe ngolimi olulodwa olwamukelwe ngokomthetho iye kwezinye izilimi ezamukelwe ngokomthetho. Isevisi yayo yokuhumusha ihlinzeka ngosizo ekuthuthukiseni nasekuthuthukiseni izilimi ezamukelwe ngamagama obuchwepheshe. Umsebenzi wabo wokuhlela izilimi ubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuhulumeni mayelana nokuthuthukisa umthetho wezilimi nezindlela zokuwusebenzisa. Umsebenzi omkhulu weMkhakha Wamazwi Kazwelonke (NLS) mayelana noHlelo lwezilimi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhululekile nokuhlonipha zonke izilimi ezikhona lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba uhlelo lwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika lwenziwa ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa komphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezishiywe ngaphandle kuzobekwa phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa komthetho wezilimi ngokwakha amasu, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezizokwazi ukusiza ekufezeni lo msebenzi. Ukuqaliswa komthetho wezilimi kuhilela ukuhlinzeka (i) ukufinyelela nokuthonya (ii) nokukhuthaza ukuhlinzekwa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlola ukusetshenziswa komthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwawo kubalulekile. Lo mkhakha weHlelo lwezilimi wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1993 ukuze unikeze uHulumeni izeluleko mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuhlinzekwa komthetho wezilimi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 6 somthethosisekelo. Ukuveza nokufaka bonke abathintekayo kulolu hlelo kugcizelelwe. Umsebenzi omkhulu nokuqala walomkhakha kwakuwukuphatha inqubo ende yokusungula iBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South Africa. Le nqubo yaqala ngonyaka ka-1994 ngengqungquthela yokubonisana kazwelonke ebizwa ngokuthi iNgqungquthela Yezilimi Zabo Bonke, kulandela uchungechunge lwezingxoxo nemiphakathi ezweni, okuholele ekubhaleni kweBill yeBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South Africa ngonyaka ka-1995. Ibhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South Africa yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1996. Umthetho wezilimi kanye nomqondo weNingizimu Afrika kwathuthukiswa ngokuhambisana neziphakamiso ezenziwe nguLangtag nezinye izingxoxo nezifundo ezithathwe. Ngomhlaka 1999, uNgqongqoshe wathumela ithimba lezinsizakusebenza ukuze liqedele umthetho wezilimi nomqondo weNingizimu Afrika, owawethulwa kubo bonke abathintekayo eNgqungqutheleni Yezilimi eyabanjwa ngoMashi 2000. Ngemva kweziphakamiso ezenziwe yilabo ababekhona eNgqungqutheleni, ithimba lezinsizakusebenza laphinde laphinde lathola umthetho wezilimi nomqondo weNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kweziphakamiso lezi, kwenziwa ucwaningo olunzulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala nasemaphandleni ukuze kutholakale ubukhona bezinsiza zolimi. Okwamanje, inani lemali elidingekayo ukuze kuqaliswe umthetho ophakanyisiwe liyahlolwa, ngokubambisana neMali Kazwelonke. Le nqubo iyingxenye yokuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo ezisunguliwe kumthetho wezilimi ophakanyisiwe. Izithiyo zolimi zisathinta abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu, ekubeni bekhulumisana nohulumeni. Usizo lokuhumusha eNingizimu Afrika lungakwenza kube lula kubo bonke ukukhulumisana nezikhulu ngolimi lwabo, isibonelo, ezindaweni ezifana nezibhedlela, eziteshini zamaphoyisa, kanye namahhovisi kahulumeni. Lokhu kusizo kulindeleke ukuthi kuhlolwe ngonyaka ka-2000/2001 ezindaweni ezikhethiwe amahora angama-12 ngosuku, kusukela ngowe-07:00 ekuseni kuze kube ngu-19:00, ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngesonto. Lo msebenzi wenziwa ngokubambisana ne-PANSLAB ukuze kuqhutshwe ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlinzekwa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umqondo ohlelekile emkhakheni wezilimi zomdabu ubalulekile ukuze kuhlelwe kahle imizamo yokucwaninga ezweni lonke nokwakha amandla noma izinsiza zezilimi zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ikhompiyutha yokuphatha yasungulwa ukuze ibhale umbhalo ozophakamisa inqubo engasetshenziswa ukusungula imboni ye-HLT ezothuthuka futhi ikhuthaze izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bonke abantu bayazi ngamalungelo abo njengokubhalwe emthethweni mayelana nolimi; futhi ukuthi ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi kuyakhuthazwa ukuze abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babone ukuthi ukwazi izilimi eziningi kuyinzuzo. Umkhakha wokuqala walolu shintsho wagxila ekusebenzeni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanti umkhakha wesibili wagxila emphakathini wonke. Umphumela walolu shintsho uhlanganisa amakhalenda ezilimi, amaposta, amabhroshwana ezilimi (anezibingelelo ngolimi lwezizathu eziyi-11), namavidiyo, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kolimi lwakho olukhuluma ezikhungweni. I-UNESCO okwamanje ilungiselela umbiko weZilimi Zomhlaba okukhuluma ngokuqonda ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emhlabeni jikelele, ukufunda ngemvelaphi yezilimi kanye nesimo sazo samanje, nokuhlonza izinkinga ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-UNESCO ihlose ukuveza isidingo sokuphatha noma ukuhlela ubukhona bezilimi emhlabeni jikelele. Umkhakha Wamazwi Kazwelonke (NLS) wacelwa yi-UNESCO ukuba ibambe iqhaza ocwaningweni lokuqoqa ulwazi ukuze kudalwe umbiko ngazo zonke izilimi ezamukelwe ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezilimi zamaKhoisan kanye neNama. Njengoba ulwazi olunzulu ngalezi zilimi lwaludingeka kulolu cwaningo, imibuzo yathunyelwa kubachwepheshe bezilimi abaziwayo ukuze banikeze ulwazi. Ulwazi olunothile luqoqwe ezimkhakheni ezahlukene mayelana nezilimi eNingizimu Afrika, njengolwazi ngendawo, ukuhlukahluka, inani labantu abakhuluma ulimi oluthile, ulwazi ngokuqhuba, umnotho wempilo yomphakathi okhuluma ulimi oluthile, indlela okuthathwa ngayo noma ukuvunyelwa, imizamo yokuphatha umthetho wezilimi, kanye nezinhlelo ezihlobene nalolo limi nezindlela zokufunda nokubhala. Umbiko weZilimi Zomhlaba we-UNESCO uzokhishwa ngonyaka ka-2001 futhi uzophakamisa uchungechunge lweziphakamiso mayelana nokuvikela nokukhuthaza ubukhona bezilimi zomphakathi.
Obeautiful one phezulu kwesihlangu uyisicoco sesifunda. Ingemuva kwesihlangu iyisibonakaliso sobukhosi namandla, isihlangu temsilayo ukuvikelwa kwethu kanye nesinqumo sethu sokuvikela isifiso sabantu abaningi. Idlala indima ebalulekile emasikweni, ibhubesi, inkosi yamaZulu ichazwa njengobhubesi. Ibhubesi futhi idlala indima ebalulekile emifanekisweni yezwe lamaZulu. Ibonisa ukuxhumana nokubambisana kwabantu bonke endaweni. Iyi mifanekiso yezintaba zeDrakensberg eziluhlaza ehlobo, ziphumula phansi kweqhwa ebusika. Le mfundiso iyakhumbuza ngemithetho yakudala yesifunda. Le ndaba sekuyisibonakaliso esidala sesifunda, iphinde imele ubuhle bemvelo beKwaZulu Natal. Masivuke sakhe lokhu njengomlomo wesifunda sethu. Itholakala kumfanekiso ophansi kwesibonakaliso sesifunda. Ukuveza isibonakaliso sesifunda kukhombisa isikhathi esisha kubantu beKwaZulu Natal. Manje sihlangene ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele athathe ingxenye emkhakheni wokuthuthukiswa, ekukhuleni komnotho wesifunda. Isibonakaliso sethu esisha sihlanganisa izici ezahlukene zesifunda sethu, sihlanganisa izinto zomlando nezamanje ezisiholela esikhathini esisha. Manje ngikhuthaza bonke abantu besifunda ukuba bathathe ingxenye, babambisane ukuze sikhule ndawonye ekwakheni ikusasa eliphumelelayo.
Isingeniso Ukusebenzisa izithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni ezifana nezikoleni kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthuthukiswa kokufunda. Izithombe nemidwebo zenza kube lula kubafundi ukuqonda izinto ezinzima ezimfundisweni. Kulesi sihloko, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Izithombe Nemidwebo Okokuqala, izithombe nemidwebo zinciphisa ubunzima bokufunda. Abafundi bangakwazi ukubona izibonelo ezicacile zezinto abazifundayo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ukuqonda okujulile. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umfundisi efundisa ngama-animals, ukuhlinzeka ngezithombe noma imidwebo yazo kungasiza abafundi ukuba baqonde kahle, bazi kahle izinto ezihlobene nezilwane. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukufunda kudinga ukubona, hhayi kuphela ukufundiswa. Okwesibili, izithombe nemidwebo zikhuthaza abafundi ukuba bakhe imicabango ebanzi. Lokhu kubavulela amathuba okudidiyela ulwazi olunhlobonhlobo, ngokuqhathanisa izithombe ezahlukene nezifundo, okwenza kube lula ukuthola ukuqonda okuphelele. Izinkinga Zokusebenzisa Izithombe Nemidwebo Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ukuthi izithombe ezikhethiwe zingahle zingahambisani nezifundo, okungaholela ekuqondeni okungafanele. Uma umfundisi ekhetha izithombe ezingafanele, lokhu kungadala ukukhathazeka kwabafundi. Futhi, ukuncika ezithombeni kungavimbela abafundi ekuthuthukiseni amakhono okucabanga, njengoba bengase bacabange ukuthi badinga ukubona izithombe ukuze baqonde kahle, okungaholela emiphumeleni yokungabi namasu. Ukubaluleka Kwezakhiwo Zezithombe Nemidwebo Ngaphezu kokuba izithombe nemidwebo zisebenze njengamathuluzi okufunda, ziwusizo ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafundi nemfundiso. Ukudweba imidwebo noma ukusebenzisa izithombe ezithile kungasiza abafundi ukuba bagxile kulokho okukhulunywa umfundisi. Lokhu kudala umqondo ohlangene, okwandisa ukufunda. Izinselelo Zokusebenzisa Izithombe Nemidwebo Ngokufanele Umphakathi udinga ukuqonda lezi zinselelo ukuze ubhekane nazo. Abafundisi kufanele babe nolwazi oluqinile lokukhetha izithombe ezihambisana nemigomo yezifundo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuba baqaphele izakhamuzi ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi, futhi bagweme izithombe ezingezinhle ezithinta ukucwaswa. Ukuhlonishwa kwemvelo yethulwe esikhungweni sokufunda kufanele kucacise izindlela ezidala ezihambisanayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izithombe nemidwebo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, abafundi kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi yini efanele. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukusetshenziswa kwezithombe nemidwebo ezikhungweni kunemiphumela emihle emikhulu yokusiza abafundi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuba neziqondiso ezicacile nezilungile ukuze kuzuze abafundi. Ukuze lezi zinsiza zisebenze kahle, kudingeka ukwakheka okuhle, nokukhuluma okukhuthazayo ukuze kudaleke umfutho nokubambisana phakathi komfundisi nabafundi. Lokhu kuzovula amathuba okuthuthukisa ukufunda okungcono, okuhle, nokwakha ulwazi oluthuthukisa impilo yabafundi.
Ukuqinisekiswa Kwesimo Sokusebenza (GEMS Employment Status Verification) Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kubalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphathweni kwezinsiza, izinzuzo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelashwa. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, ehlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze kube nokuphathwa kahle kwezinsizakalo, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa isimo sokuqashwa kwabantu abahlanganyela kule nhlangano. Isizathu Sokwenza Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezimali Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kuhloswe ukuvimbela izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abathola izinzuzo ze-GEMS bangabantu abaqashwe ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zifinyeleleka kubantu abafanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kusiza ekugwemeni ubugebengu bokukhwabanisa, lapho abantu bezama ukuthola izinzuzo ezingekho emthethweni. Indlela Yokwenza Ukuqinisekiswa Ukuze uqinisekise isimo sokuqashwa, umsebenzisi kufanele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa igama, isibongo, inombolo ye-ID, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngale mininingwane, i-GEMS izobheka lezi zinsiza ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzisi uqashwe ngokusemthethweni. Lokhu kusebenza ngokuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela ye-GEMS, futhi kudinga ukuthi umsebenzisi abe neziqu ezithile ezivumelekile. Izinyathelo Zokwenza Ukuqinisekiswa 1. Ukufaka Isicelo: Umsebenzisi kufanele aqale ngokufaka isicelo sokwenza ukuqinisekiswa. Lokhu kungafakwa ku-inthanethi noma ngokuqhafaza ehhovisi le-GEMS. 2. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemininingwane: Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, umsebenzisi kufanele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane edingekayo, efana ne-ID, igama, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. 3. Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali: I-GEMS izobuyekeza le mininingwane ukuze iqinisekise isimo sokuqashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinhlelo zokusebenza zabasebenzi, izinkontileka, kanye nemininingwane ethile ethathwe kumqashi. 4. Ukwaziswa: Ngemuva kokuphothula inqubo yokubuyekeza, umsebenzisi uzothola isaziso sokuthi isimo sokuqashwa sakhe siqinisekisiwe noma cha. Uma kunenkinga, umsebenzisi uzothola izeluleko zokuthi angayilungisa kanjani. Izinzuzo Zokuqinisekiswa Kwezimali Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zokwelashwa zifinyeleleka kubantu abaqashwe ngokusemthethweni, okwenza kube nokwethenjelwa. Okwesibili, kuvikela i-GEMS ekukhwabaniseni, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu zezimali. Okwesithathu, kuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abaqashwe noHulumeni, njengoba kubonisa ukuthi i-GEMS iyazimisela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Izinkinga Ezivamile Nezixazululo Noma kunjalo, kunezinkinga ezithile ezivamile ezihambisana nokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa. Enye yezinkinga ezivame ukubonwa yikhona ukungahambisani kwemibhalo. Lokhu kungavela uma umsebenzisi enza amaphutha ekufakeni imininingwane, noma uma izinkampani zisebenzisa amagama ahlukene kumadokhumenti. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi aqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ayihlinzeki iyahambisana. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sokuqashwa ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zokwelashwa zifinyeleleka kubantu abaqashwe ngokusemthethweni. Le nqubo ayigcini nje ngokuvikela i-GEMS, kodwa futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathola izinzuzo ezidingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abasebenzi baqonde le nqubo futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala beqinisekisiwe ukuze bathole izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abaqashwe noHulumeni kuzokwenza kube nokwethenjelwa, futhi kuqinise umnotho wethu.
Ezinye izindatshana ezibhaliwe lapha kuPula/Imvula zikhombisa izinto ezibalulekile uma kukhethwa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zentshonalanga ezizophumelela efemini yakho, kubhekwa izinsiza zemvelo ezikhona, ukwakhiwa kwezindlela zokushintshisana kwezinhlobo zezitshalo, kanye nezintengo zazo emakethe ezizayo. Le maphakathi noMgqibelo kuPula/Imvula inezindatshana ezithile ezihlobene nalabo abakhiqizayo abakhulume ngamaqhwa emasimini abo njengoba bekhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo ezizofakwa ngonyaka ozayo. Izintengo zesikhathi esizayo zamaqhwa abomvu kanye namaqhwa amhlophe zashintsha zaba ziqinile ngoAgasti 2011, zikhombisa ukuthi intengo yemakethe ezayo izofinyelela ku-R1,840 (kwamaqhwa abomvu) kanye no-R1,815 (kwamaqhwa amhlophe) uma lezi ziqhwa zikhonjiswa ngoJulayi 2012. Singathi umkhiqizi uzokwazi ukuthola u-R1,615 ngentoni yamaqhwa emaphaketheni akhe ngemuva kokukhipha izindleko zokuthutha ezingafinyelela ku-R215 noma ku-R225 ngentoni. Intengo yamaqhwa engathengiswa phesheya ingafinyelela ku-R1,717 ngentoni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi intengo ebonakalayo efana nentengo yokuthumela phesheya. Amaqhwa athengwa phesheya ukuze aze lapha eRandfontein abiza u-R2,894 ngentoni. Singavuma ukuthi izintengo zamanje nezizayo ezweni lethu zisuselwa entengo yokuthumela phesheya. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kusekhona amaqhwa amaningi atholakalayo emakethe yethu yendawo, futhi kukhona umbono omuhle ngoba kungase kube namaqhwa anele ngonyaka ozayo. Ukunqunywa kwentengo yemakethe kubheka zonke izinto ezihlobene nokukhiqiza ezifana nezimo zezulu, izimo zomhlaba (ukuphuma), isidingo salokhu kudla ngabathengi, ukudla okukhona, kanye namaqhwa azosatshalaliswa; ukuqhathaniswa kwenani lokushintshisana phakathi kwe-rand ne-dollar, izimo zokukhiqiza phesheya, kanye nezindleko zemali ebolekiwe lapha konke kusiza ukunquma le ntengo. Ikhwalithi yamaqhwa athunyelwa ezikhungweni zokugcina ngababikazi ingase ibe phansi ngenxa yemvula eningi ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa kungase kubangele ukuthi intengo emakethe ye-spot ikhule uma amaqhwa amahle atholakala. Khumbula ukuthi konke lokhu kungashintsha uma amaqhwa evunwa ngonyaka ozayo ngoJulayi 2012.
Uhlelo lwezimali lwezinga le-2005/06 leHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng luhlangana nonyaka esiwugubha i-50th anniversary yeFreedom Charter. Njengoba sigubha lo mcimbi wonyaka, sithumele izimali kulesi sabelomali ukuze siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhloso zeFreedom Charter futhi sikhulise izinzuzo esizitholile kuze kube manje ekwandiseni ukufinyelela ezempilo engcono. Kusukela ngo-1994, siphumelele ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile esivumela ukuba siqhubeke nokuqhubeka kwezinhloso zethu ezicacile. Imiphumela yomsebenzi wethu iqala ukuvelela kakhulu ngokwanda kokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, nokukhula komnotho. Siphumelele ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono osuselwe ekuqondeni nasekudumeni kwabantu bonke. Ukufeza ukukhula komnotho nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Lesi sabelomali sichaza ukuthi sizobhekana kanjani nezinto ezibalulekile ngezinhlelo ezahlukene kanye nemikhankaso yeHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Isu lokukhula nokuthuthukiswa kweGauteng lihambisana ngqo nezibopho zethu zokubeka umgomo emkhankasweni kazwelonke wokunciphisa ubuphofu nokungasebenzi ngokukhulisa umnotho ngendlela ehlangene. Sizogxila futhi ezinselelweni zesigaba sesibili somnotho wethu, esichazwa ngezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ukungabi namakhono, kanye nezinga eliphansi lokukhula ngokujwayelekile. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zenza u-81% wesabelomali esiphelele, okukhombisa ngokusobala ukuzibophezela kwethu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi ezingeni eliphezulu kubo bonke abahlali baseGauteng. Siphinde sithumele izimali ukuze sibhekane nemikhankaso yokwakha izinsiza kanye nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukuvuselela umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokulwa nobuphofu ephondweni. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uzothola le dokhumenti iyasiza kakhulu ekuqondeni nasekuhlaziyeni isabelomali sePhondo laseGauteng sika-2005. Kungani sidinga isabelomali? Isabelomali isu elibonisa ukuthi izimali ezitholakalayo zizosebenza kanjani. Isabelomali lisivumela ukuba sihlela ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ngendlela ezothola khona izinhloso esizibekile phambili. Sinomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina umphakathi unolwazi ngesenzo sokuhulumeni nokuthi izimali zisetshenziswa kanjani. Ngokwethula isabelomali, sikhombisa isu lokwabelana nokuhlola izimali zokwenza izenzo zokuhulumeni. Ekusebenziseni kahle umhlaba wezolimo nasekusekeleni abalimi abasafufusa. Ukwethulwa kohlelo lwezokwakha oluhlanganisiwe nolwakhiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Izinsiza zomphakathi zingaguqulwa njengoba umphakathi ushintsha. Isibonelo, izikole emiphakathini ekhula zingaguqulwa zibe izindawo zokuhlangana zomphakathi. Yiziphi izidingo ezisemqoka zephondo, izidingo ezibalulekile, kanye nezinhlelo ezivunyelwe yiHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng? Ukukhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kokudla okunempilo nokuphila impilo enempilo futhi evumelekile. Yiziphi izidingo ezisemqoka zephondo, izidingo ezibalulekile, kanye nezinhlelo ezivunyelwe yiHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng? Sithola kuphi izimali zethu? Sisebenzisa kanjani izimali zethu? Sisebenzisa kanjani izimali zethu? Siphinde sikhulise kanjani amandla okusebenzisa izimali?
Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika uveza ukuthi iNhlangano Yezifunda (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-NCOP) kumele iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kombuso. Lokhu kufezwa ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokuwina imithetho kazwelonke nokuhlinzeka ngendawo kazwelonke yokuthi umphakathi ubhekane nezindaba ezithinta izifunda. Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-NCOP ukuhlela izingxoxo, ukudlulisela imithetho, nokubheka (ukuhlola) izenzo zikamasipala. I-NCOP temsilisa izifunda ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kombuso. Indima ye-NCOP ukuveza imibono yokuphatha izifunda kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Yini iViki Yezifunda ye-NCOP? I-NCOP yasungula iViki Yezifunda ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izifunda zidlala indima ebalulekile emsebenzini wePhalamende likazwelonke. Ngalesi sikhathi, abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP kanye nabalingani babo ezifundeni bazovakashela imiphakathi emele uhulumeni ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bathola ulwazi ngqo ngezidingo nezinselelo zabantu. I-Viki Yezifunda iqala ukusebenza kwemigomo yomthethosisekelo wezwe, iphoqa i-NCOP ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kombuso. I-Viki Yezifunda iqinisekisa ukuthi abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP bahlale beqaphele izinguquko, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nezifunda zabo. Iphakela abamele ithuba lokuxhumana nezifunda zabo nokubika emuva ngomsebenzi wabo kwi-NCOP ngenhloso yokuthola imandate emisha ngezindaba ezidinga ukufakwa ohlelweni lokusebenza lukazwelonke. I-Viki Yezifunda inikeza indawo yokwabelana nokushintshisana ngemicabango ngezindaba ezihlobene nokubhekana nezidingo, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nezifunda ukuze zifeze imandate zazo. Iphinde idale ithuba lePhalamende nezifunda ukuba zisebenze ndawonye ekutholeni izixazululo nasekuvezeni izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nezidingo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Yini ezokwenzeka ngesikhathi seViki Yezifunda? Abanye ababambiqhaza; njengababusi bendabuko, izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezisekelwe emphakathini, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuphatha Yezindawo yaseNingizimu Afrika (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-SALGA). Abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP, kanye nabalingani babo ezifundeni, bazovakashela imiphakathi emele uhulumeni. Abamele bazophinde babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe nguHulumeni kazwelonke kanye nohulumeni bezifunda ezizifundeni zabo. I-Viki Yezifunda izothuthukisa kanjani isifunda sakho? Ngokuvakashela imiphakathi ngesikhathi seViki Yezifunda, abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP bazothola ulwazi ngqo ngezidingo zabantu ezifundeni. I-Viki Yezifunda ivumela i-NCOP ukuba ifake isandla ekusebenzeni kukamasipala ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izikhalazo zezifunda nezendawo zicatshangelwa ekwakhiweni kwenqubomgomo kazwelonke. Iphinde ivumele uhulumeni bezifunda, bendawo, kanye nohulumeni bezwe ukuba basebenze ndawonye ngempumelelo nangokulinganayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufezeka kwezidingo.
Ezabantwana (Children’s Welfare) Umbuzo 1: Yini eyaziwa ngempilo yebantwana? Impendulo: Impilo yebantwana ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esinempilo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukudla okunempilo, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokunakekela, kanye nemfundo ewusizo. Ukuze abantwana bakhule kahle, kudingeka baphumelelise izinselelo ezithile nolwazi oluqinile. Umbuzo 2: Kanjani ukondla abantwana ngendlela efanele? Impendulo: Ukondla abantwana ngendlela efanele kuhilela ukunikeza ukudla okunempilo okwakha izakhi ezisemqoka emzimbeni. Lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amandla, ubuchopho, nezinhlelo zokulawula izifo. Iziphuzo ezifanele, ukudla okwakha amathambo, izithelo, nemifino kubalulekile ekudleni kwansuku zonke. Umbuzo 3: Kazi izinsiza ezingatholakala ezindaweni zokuhlala kwabantu abaningi? Impendulo: Ezindaweni eziningi, izinsiza ezifana nezikole, izikhungo zokunakekela, nezikhungo zokwelapha ziyatholakala. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwamakhandidethi, ohulumeni, kanye nomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana baziqonda kahle futhi banelungelo lokuthola lezi zinsiza. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, izinhlaka ezizimele zingaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani imfundo ibalulekile empilweni yebantwana? Impendulo: Imfundo ibalulekile empilweni yebantwana njengoba ikhuthaza ukukhula kwengqondo, ivula amathuba emisebenzi, futhi ibasiza ukuba bahlale bejabulile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfundo idala isisekelo sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ifundisa nezindlela zokubhekana nezinselelo. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani ukudlala kudlala indima enkulu empilweni yabantwana? Impendulo: Ukudlala akuwona nje umphakathi, kodwa kubalulekile empilweni yabantwana. Kubasiza ukuba bahlakulele amakhono, bakhulume nabanye, futhi bejabulele. Lokhu kudala umhlaba owakhayo, owanelisayo, obalulekile ekukhuleni kokomoya. Abantwana badinga isikhathi sokudlala ukuze bahlale bephila kahle. Umbuzo 6: Izinselelo zempilo yabantwana zikhona yini? Impendulo: Yebo, izinselelo zempilo yabantwana zikhona, njengekushoda kwemithwalo yokunakekela, ukugula, nemfundo engaphelele. Abantwana abaningi babhekana nezinkinga zokudla okungafanele, izinkinga zomndeni, kanye nemiphumela yokuhamba kwabo kwemali. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo ezisemthethweni ukuze kuzothuthukiswa izinyathelo ezizobasiza. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezinokwenziwa ukuvikela abantwana? Impendulo: Ukuze kuvikelwe abantwana, kumele kube nemithetho eqinile yokuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Lokhu kuhilela izinhlelo zokuvikela, izimiso ezivulekile zokwazi ngemithetho, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi onokuxhaswa. Ukuze lokho kwenziwe, uhlelo lokubambisana phakathi kwabaphethe imibono yempilo, izikhungo zemfundo, nabazali lungaba wusizo olukhulu. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani umphakathi ungasiza ekunakekeleni abantwana? Impendulo: Umphakathi unendima enkulu empilweni yebantwana. Ngokuhlanganyela, umphakathi ungaba nomthelela omuhle ngokwakha izinhlelo ezihlanganisayo zokusebenza. Izifundazwe zingase ziqhube imicimbi ethile ukuxhasa abantwana, ukuvuselela umoya omuhle, futhi zikhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwabazali nezingane. Umbuzo 9: Yini ekhuthaza abantwana ukuba babe nemiphakathi emihle? Impendulo: Ukuze abantwana baziqhenye, kumele bakhule enhlalithelweni ethokozisayo, evulelekile, nezinsiza ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabazali, abafundisi, nabantu abahamba phambili emiphakathini. Ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokudlala nemihlangano engaphezulu kwezemfundo kungakhuthaza impilo yokuhlala phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 10: Uthini umyalezo wokugcina ngempilo yabantwana? Impendulo: Umphakathi kumele uqhubeke uqonda ukuthi impilo yabantwana iyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komphakathi, abazali, nabaholi bezenhlalakahle kumele baqinise izinhlelo ezisiza abantwana. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha isizukulwane esiqinile, esinesibindi, nesineke, esizokwakha umhlaba ohloniphekile.
UMark Zuckerberg: Umholi Wobuchwepheshe Oguqula Umhlaba UMark Zuckerberg, owazalwa ngoMfumfu 14, 1984, eWhite Plains, eNew York, ungumuntu ophawulekayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. UZuckerberg waziwa kakhulu njengomqondisi we-Facebook, inkampani eyasungulwa ngo-2004, eyashintsha indlela abantu abaxhumana ngayo. Wakhulela ezindaweni ezinhle, okwamnika ithuba lokukhulisa amakhono akhe okwakha izinto eziphumelelayo. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eHarvard University, wathola umqondo wokwakha iwebsite yokuxhumana. Nakuba waqala nezinselelo eziningi ngemuva kokungena ku-inthanethi, wahlala eqinile. UFacebook waqala njengesayithi lokuxhumana labafundi beHarvard, kodwa ngokushesha wakhula waba ibhizinisi elikhulu elihlanganisa abantu abaningi. Ngemuva kokuphumelela kwe-Facebook, uZuckerberg waqala ukugxila kumaphrojekthi ahlukahlukene, njengokuthengwa kwe-WhatsApp ne-Instagram, okwakha umthelela omkhulu ekuxhumaneni kwabantu. UFacebook waba yinkampani enkulu emhlabeni, futhi uZuckerberg waba ngumholi ophakeme embonini. Nokho, akagcinanga nje ngokuphumelela kwezimali; uhlale efuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Waqala imizamo yokwakha izixazululo ezihlakaniphile ezizosiza abantu emhlabeni wonke, futhi uFacebook waba ngumholi emizamweni yokwakha ubuchwepheshe obuhlala buhlelwe. Uhlale ebhekana nezinselelo, njengokuphepha nokuvikela idatha yomsebenzisi, okuholele ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqubomgomo zenkampani. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukuphumelela kudinga ukwethembeka phakathi kwabantu. UZuckerberg ungumholi onemibono emisha, futhi uphinde ube nesibopho sokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ngokwesibonelo, usebenzisile ubuchwepheshe bokufunda ngomshini ukuze athuthukise izinqubo zokuxhumana, eqinisekisa ukufinyelela kolwazi olufanele. Ngo-2015, uZuckerberg waba nesibopho sokwakha i-Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, enhlosweni yokuthuthukisa imfundo, impilo, kanye nemisebenzi, okukhombisa ukuthi akakaze azibekele umgomo wokwenza imali kuphela. Uhlala efuna ukusiza abanye, futhi uzama ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubonakala ezinhlelweni zakhe zokuxhumana, lapho ehlosile ukudala indawo evulekile nehlanganyela. UZuckerberg ungomunye wezithunywa eziphambili zokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo idinga ukuzimisela nesibopho sokubhekana nezinselele. Uhlale efuna izindlela zokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono, futhi useqokweni elihle phakathi kwabantu. UZuckerberg ungumfanekiso wezizathu ezithandwa kakhulu ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, futhi uphinde akhuthaze ukuthi umphakathi ungaba nethuba lokuthuthuka.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal Izikhukhula ezibangele umonakalo omkhulu eKwaZulu-Natal (KZN) ziye zaba yinkinga ebalulekile ebonisa izinkinga eziningi ezikhona kwezokuphathwa kwezinhlekelele. Nakuba kaningi abantu bejwayele ukugxila ekulimazweni kwempilo nezindlu, kubalulekile futhi ukuhlaziya ukuthi kungani ukusabela kuk government, ezokuphatha, kanye nenhlangano zomphakathi kuhlale kungaphumeleli. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphusile nezisebenzayo ezizothuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinselelo ezizayo. Okokuqala, ukuhlela ngaphambi kwesimo esiphuthumayo kubaluleke kakhulu. Uma sikhuluma ngezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuvikela ezivele zenzelwe izindawo ezinomngcele wezikhukhula. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwemithombo yolwazi, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuphuma, nemigudu yokwehlisa umthelela wezikhukhula. Izinhlangano ezifana ne-Disaster Management Centre kufanele ziqinise imizamo yazo yokuhlola izindawo ezithintekayo, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi imiphakathi iyaziswa ngalesi sikhathi esinzima. Ukukwazi ukuphendula ngempumelelo ekusabalaleni kwemisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza, kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekunciphiseni umonakalo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekayo bathola usizo ngokushesha. Ukwehluleka ukusiza abantu ngokushesha kungaholela ezimweni ezinzima, futhi lokhu kuboniswa yizibalo ezikhombisa ukuthi abantu abaningana baphila kanzima ngemuva kwezikhukhula. Ukwakha izikhungo eziphuthumayo nezokwelapha kulezi zindawo ezithintwayo kufanele kube umgomo ophakanyisiwe. Hhayi kuphela ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela usizo, kodwa kuzokwandisa nokunciphisa ukulinda okungadingekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubomgomo zikamasipala nezikahulumeni zidinga ukuba ziqinise izinqubomgomo ezikhona futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza. Ukukhawulelwa kwezinsiza, umnotho, nezinhlelo ezinzima zokuphatha kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphenduleni kwezikhukhula. Uma kungekho ukuhlela okuhle nokukhulisa izinsiza, izinkinga zikhula, futhi umphakathi ubhekana nobunzima obuningi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zamazwe, izindawo, kanye nezilawuli zomphakathi kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwenza ngcono ukusabela kuzikhukhula. Kodwa-ke, akusiyona nje kuphela imizamo yoHulumeni nezikhungo ezisemthethweni; imiphakathi nayo idinga ukuba ibambe iqhaza. Ukuqwashisa nokuhlakanipha kwezakhamuzi kufanele kube kuhlelwe ukuze kuhlonishwe izinqubo zokuphendula. Izifundo ezitholwe ezikhukhuleni ezedlule zikhombisa ukuthi imiphakathi enolwazi iyakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukusiza omakhelwane babo. Ukufundisa abantu malunga nezinyathelo zokuvikela, izinqubo zokuphuma, nokuthi bangasiza kanjani omunye nomunye kungakhuthaza ukuzimela komphakathi. Izikhukhula zibuye ziveze izinkinga ezinkulu ezihlobene nephatha nokuphathwa kwemithombo. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekayo kudinga izinsiza ezanele. Ukuze umphakathi uthole ukusizakala, izinhlelo zokuphatha kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi kukhona imithombo eyanele efanele yokuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziphuthumayo. Ukungabi naleso sikhathi kokuhlinzeka kuzokwenza kube nzima ukubuyisela umphakathi esimeni esijwayelekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zikhombisa futhi izindlela eziphambili zokuphila, ezinjengokwakha izikhungo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Ukugxila ezindaweni zokwakha ezimweni ezinzima kufanele kube yinto efaneleka kakhulu. Izinhlaka zempilo nezokwakhiwa kufanele ziqinise imizamo yazo yokwakha izindlu ezihlala isikhathi eside, okuyinto ebalulekile ukuze imiphakathi ibhekane nezimo ezinzima. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsiza ngaphambi kokuba zikhukhule, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha kabusha. Ekugcineni, ukuhamba phambili ekuphathweni kwezikhukhula eKwaZulu-Natal kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Ukusabela kuzikhukhula akumele kube yindaba kuphela yokuphendula ngemuva kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa kufanele kube yisiphakamiso esihamba phambili ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezizayo. Ukuhlela, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izinsiza ezinhle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela umphakathi, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuba nomphakathi oqinile. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphendula kuzikhukhula akuyona nje imisebenzi ethile, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha umphakathi onempilo futhi ophumelelayo. Izikhukhula zidinga ukusabela okuphelele, okukhombisa ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezinemisebenzi eqondile. Lokhu kuzodala isimo sokugcina izikhukhula ziphansi, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zabantu.
Le nsizakalo itholakala kubantu abafuna ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sabo sokubhaliswa kwezono, kungaba ngoba bafuna ukuhamba phesheya noma ngoba befuna ukusebenza phesheya isikhathi eside. Kuzokwenziwa isitifiketi esizokhombisa ukuthi kukhona yini amacala ezono abhaliswe ngokumelene nomfakisicelo. Hamba neminwe yakho yonke, ezothathwa esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduzane, eSAPS Criminal Record Centre. Qiniseka ukuthi amagama akho aphelele, isibongo, usuku lokuzalwa, indawo yokuzalwa, kanye nenombolo yokuhlonza kugcwaliswe efomini lokuthatha iminwe. Bring your identification to the police station as proof of identity will be required. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ezinye iziteshi zamaphoyisa zamukela izicelo kuphela phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlala ngaphandle kwelizwe bangafaka izicelo eziteshini zamaphoyisa kulezo zizwe noma ezikhungweni zeNingizimu Afrika. Iminwe ingathathwa efomini elivunyelwe lelo zwe. Ifomu lokuthatha iminwe kumele lisayinwe ngumuntu othatha iminwe. Zonke iminwe kanye kophi yokuhlonza yomfakisicelo noma ipasipoti kumele kuhambisane nesicelo. Isitifiketi sokukhululwa sizokwenziwa mahhala uma siceliwe phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela esicelweni sokuqala. Njengoba izitifiketi zigcinwa emarekhodini kuphela ezinyangeni eziyisishiyagalolunye, kufanele kufakwe isicelo esisha ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye. Ukuvuselelwa phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kwenziwa mahhala. Amafomu afanele okuthatha iminwe agcwaliswa ngophoyisa.
Kuphethwe, ingxenye ebizwa nge-octane iyadingeka ukuvikela injini ekuphazamisekeni noma ekukhulumeni. Ukuqhamuka kokuphazamiseka kwenjini kwenzeka lapho kukhona ukushiswa okungalawulwa kokuhlanganiswa komoya ne-fuel esilindeni, okungalimaza injini. Ingxenye ye-octane etholakala ezimotweni iyisilinganiso esivimbela injini ekuphazamisekeni - uma ibanga le-octane liphakeme, amathuba okuthi i-fuel ibangele ukuphazamiseka ancipha. Ukwengeza izixazululo ze-lead ku-petrol bekuyindlela ejwayelekile yokuthuthukisa amabanga e-octane. I-lead yayisetshenziswa kabanzi njengokungezelela ku-petrol kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1920. Nokho, i-petrol ayizange isetshenziswe ezimotweni ezihlanganiswe ne-catalytic converter ukuze kuncishiswe ukukhishwa, ngoba i-lead isheshisa ukuvimbela lezi zengezo. Lokhu, kanye nokutholakala kokuthi ukukhishwa kwe-lead kungalimaza impilo yomuntu, kuholele ekutheni kuncishiswe kancane, kuqala eNyakatho Melika, kulandela iYurophu, bese kusakazeka kwezinye izizwe emhlabeni. Kusukela nini i-petrol enelead izobe ingatholakali eNingizimu Afrika? Uhulumeni ubeke ukuthi kuzoba nezinhlobo ezintathu ze-petrol ezine-octane rating ngaphandle kwe-lead (ULP) ezizovunyelwa eNingizimu Afrika (ezindaweni ezisemanzini nasezindaweni ezisemakhaya) ngemuva kosuku lukaJanuwari 1, 2006, ezingu-91, 93, kanye ne-95 Research Octane Number (RON). Ukucelwa kwalezi zinhlobo kuzokhombisa ukuthi iyiphi efunwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele balindele ukuthi ngeke bathole zonke izinhlobo yonke indawo, kodwa bangalindela ukuthola uhlobo oluhambelana noma olufanele ezimotweni zabo noma kuphi abahamba khona eNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izimboni zokucubungula uphethiloli eNingizimu Afrika zifake imali noma zifaka imali kumishini noma ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhiqize izengezo ze-octane ngempumelelo. I-octane additive ibaluleke kakhulu kunomkhiqizo okhiqizwa yizimboni zokucubungula zendawo, ezizothenga izingxenye zokuhlanganisa eziphezulu ze-octane noma i-petrol ye-octane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi icelwa kwenziwa. Iziphi izindleko ezizobekwa ezinhlelweni ezahlukene ze-petrol? Izindleko ezilawulwa zizobekwa kusetshenziswa indlela efanayo naleyo esebenzayo njengamanje. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindleko zezinhlobo ezikhona ezingenalead (95 octane emanzini kanye ne-93 emakhaya) zizohlala njengoba zikhona. Izindleko zezinhlobo ezinelead zizoba ezifana nezindleko ze-petrol ezingenalead ezine-octane efanayo. Ezindaweni ezisemakhaya lapho uhlobo lwe-95 olungenalead luzoqala ukutholakala, kuzokwenziwa imali noma "intela yokucelwa," ezokwenza ukuthi intengo ikhuphuke phakathi kwayo ne-93, iqala ngophawu lwe-10 cents nge-litre. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi izimoto eziningi ezisemakhaya zaneliseka nge-fuel ye-93 octane, okuyiyo ephezulu etholakalayo, empeleni, iyona kuphela etholakalayo. I-fuel ye-95 octane izotholakala emakhaya ukuze ihlangabezane nezimoto zobuchwepheshe besimanje ezethulwe embonini yezimoto. Ngoba abanikazi bezimoto bazokwazi ukukhetha phakathi kwezinhlobo ukuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kabi kwe-octane additives, kulindeleke ukuthi labo abadinga i-95 octane bayisebenzise - intela ekhokhwayo emakhaya ihloselwe ukukhuthaza abanikazi bezimoto ukuthi bacabange ngezinketho zabo. Emhlabeni, lapho i-fuel ye-octane ephezulu noma eyengeziwe ivame ukufunwa (ngokuvamile eduze nolwandle kukhombisa ukucelwa okuphezulu kwe-octane ezimotweni), i-95 octane unleaded iyona kuphela etholakalayo, futhi ngeke kube nenye intela kulolu hlobo. Ngizokwazi kanjani ukuthi iyiphi i-petrol efanele imoto yami? Kuzokwenziwa idatha yolwazi ukuze kuboniswe cishe zonke izinhlobo ezitholakalayo ezindaweni zethu. Lokhu kuzotholakala yonke indawo, kuhlanganise nedatha yolwazi yeNational Association of Automotive Manufacturers (NAAMSA - www.naamsa.co.za) kanye neSouth African Petroleum Industry Association (SAPIA - www.sapia.co.za). Kulolu dbhasi, uhlobo lwe-fuel efanele izindawo ezisemanzini nasezindaweni ezisemakhaya luzokhombiswa ngokwehlukana (ukuze umkhiqizi asebenze kahle) nokuthi yiziphi ezinye izinhlobo ezingahambisana (lezo ezingakwenza imoto ihambe kahle ngaphandle kokulimaza injini, nakuba ingase ingasebenzi ngempumelelo ephelele kwezinye izimoto). Abanikazi bezimoto bangakhetha ukusebenzisa noma iyiphi uhlobo olukhombiswe njengokunconywa noma olufanele imoto yabo. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi isitayela sabo sokushayela singathinta ukuthi iyiphi i-octane additive abayithola ihlangabezana kangcono nezidingo zabo. Kuzoba nomhlahlandlela okhombisa ama-fuel afanele ukusetshenziswa kulolu dbhasi nolwakho emastations aphethiloli. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimoto zidinga izengezo ezahlukene ze-octane. Ukusebenzisa i-petrol enebanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yakho edinga akudingekile futhi kuyinkohlakalo yemali, ikakhulukazi ngoba akuthuthukisi ukusebenza kwenjini. Ukusebenzisa i-petrol enebanga le-octane eliphansi kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kunciphisa ukusebenza kwenjini, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni noma ekulimazeni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi isidingo se-octane semoto ethile sincike kwezinye izinto, kuhlanganise nokusetshenziswa nendlela yokushayela, izidingo ze-octane zemoto ethwele umthwalo omkhulu, ukuphakama okuphezulu, nezimo zezulu. Kungani kumele ngingasebenzisi ibanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yami edinga? I-petrol enebanga le-octane eliphezulu idinga ukucutshungulwa okuningi futhi isebenzisa amandla amaningi lapho ikhiqizwa. Uma la mandla engasetshenziswa kahle noma engasetshenziswa kahle yimoto yakho, kusho ukuthi amandla ayengeziwe abekwe phansi ayaphuma noma alahleka. Le nkohlakalo iholela ekukhishweni kwe-hydrocarbons ezingashiswa noma i-carbon dioxide, okulimaza imvelo yethu. Ukusebenzisa uhlobo lwe-octane additive oluphakeme kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kuzokwenza noma kuhlasele umnikazi kakhulu, futhi kunomthelela omubi emvelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngeke kube nezinzuzo ekusebenzeni noma ekushayeleni. Ingabe i-petrol engenalead ifanele ama-motorcycles, ama-lawnmowers, kanye nezinjini zemikhumbi? I-petrol engenalead ivamise ukufaneleka kuma-motorcycles, ama-lawnmowers, kanye nezinjini zemikhumbi ngaphandle kwezinye ezincane ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obudala. Hlola noma ubuze umthengisi wemishini uma unemibuzo. Ingabe izimoto ezidala nezimodeli ezindala zingasebenzisa i-petrol engenalead? Ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga, lezi zimoto kufanele zisebenzise i-petrol enelead, nakuba ezinye zingasebenzisa i-petrol engenalead. Uma ufuna ukusebenzisa i-petrol engenalead, xhumana nomkhiqizi wale moto. Uma ngisebenzisa i-petrol engenalead, ingabe ipayipi lokuphuma kwemoto yami lizoshintsha libe mhlophe njengoba kwenzeka lapho ngisebenzisa i-petrol enelead? Cha, lokhu akukhombisi ukwehla kokusebenza kwenjini. Ipheya elisha liba mhlophe uma use
Ukwakhiwa Kwezikhungo Ezisezingeni Lokusebenzisa: Umgomo Wokuhlakanipha Kwangempela Kulo mkhakha osakhulayo, ukubhekana nezinselelo ezahlukene usuku nosuku kubonisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhlela izikhungo ngendlela ezokwazi ukwaziwa kalula ngabantu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula futhi umhlaba ushintsha, izikhungo kumele zihlale zibhekelela izidingo zabantu ukuze zibe nezindawo ezikahle zokusebenza, ukuhlala, noma ukuzijabulisa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izikhungo zidinga ukuhamba phambili nezimo zamanje. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwazo kufanele kugxile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Isikhungo esiklamayo kahle sizobe nendawo ethokomele yokusebenza, imingcele enezithiyo ezithuthukile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabavakashi. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izikhala ezivulekile, ezihambisana nezimo zokuphila zanamuhla, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlanganisa, basebenze ndawonye, noma baphathe imisebenzi yabo ngendlela ehlelekile. Okwesibili, ukwakheka kwesikhungo kunomthelela omkhulu ekwenzeni abantu bezizwe bekhululekile. Izikhungo ezingahlelwa kahle zingaba izindawo zokuphumula, zokuxhumana, noma zokwakha imiphakathi. Izicabha ezivulekile, izikhala ezinkulu, nezindawo zokuhlangana zidinga ukuba zibe khona ukuze abasebenzisi bazizwe bejabulile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezibandakanya abantu abaningi. Futhi, izikhungo eziklama abantu kumele zihlale zifaka bonke. Ukuze ubuchwepheshe bube usizo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukufakwa kwezinto ezifana nezithuthi zomphakathi ezibhekelele abantu abadala, abakhubazekile, kanye nezinye izigaba zomphakathi. Ukuze izikhungo zisebenze kahle, zidinga ukuhamba phambili nezifundo zokwakha ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Izinqubo zokwakhiwa kumele zibe namathuba okwenza izikhungo zibe zizimele, ziphinde zifinyeleleke kalula. Lokhu kuhilela ukubandakanya izinhlelo zokuvikela izindawo, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala ezithinta izindawo ezithile. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigwaqo, izinsiza zokuhamba, nezinsiza zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kuncishiswe izithiyo ezithinta ukuhamba noma ukufika ezikhungweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuze kube nokwakheka okwanelisayo, izikhungo zidinga ukuklama imithwalo yokusebenza efanele. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, ezifana nezikhangiso zemininingwane, ukuxhumana kagesi, nemithombo ethokozisayo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke ukuthi izikhungo zisezingeni eliphezulu; kudinga kube nezizathu ezithile. Ukuklama okukhombisa ukuqonda kwezidingo zomphakathi kubalulekile. Imigomo yokwakha kumele igxile ezidingweni zabantu, hhayi nje kumaklayenti. Lezi zinto kufanele ziqhutshwe ngemuva kokubandakanya abathintekayo, ukuqonda isimo sabo, nezinhloso zabo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlinzeka ngezikhungo eziklama ukuze zibe nezimo eziphathekayo kubasebenzisi akukona nje umqondo omuhle, kodwa kuyadingeka. Ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi eqinile nehloniphekile kudinga izikhungo eziphumelelayo ezikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwabantu, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Uma sikha izikhungo eziklama kahle, sizobona umphakathi ophila kahle, onothile, nolwandle oluqukethe amathuba amaningi. Lokhu kungenza kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu, kubavikela ezinkingeni, futhi kulungise kakhulu izikhala eziseduzane. Ngakho-ke, uhla lwezikhungo eziklama ngokucophelela kufanele lube umgomo, njengoba kuhambisana nezidingo zethuna. Lokhu akukhanyiswanga nje njengemigomo yokwakha, kodwa njengokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Uhambo lokwakha izikhungo ezinomqondo wokuqonda nomphakathi ludinga ukubekezela, kodwa impumelelo yempilo yokuphila kubantu izongena kuphela uma sithatha isinyathelo sokwakha izikhungo ezenza ubuhlakani bethu bube ngempela, kakhulukazi kumphakathi oshintsha njalo.
### Ukungondleki Ezinganeni: Isimo Esiphuthumayo Esifuna Ukuxazululwa Noma ngabe sikhuluma ngobusuku obuphakathi kodumo lwemikhosi, kuzomele sikhumbule ukuthi emhlabeni wethu, phakathi kokukhanya, kukhona izithiyo eziningi ezithinta izimpilo zezingane. Ngaphezu kokubukisa izithombe ezinhle, sithola udumo, futhi sizikhumbuza ukuthi kukhona izingane ezinganakekela kahle—zinganikezeli ngokwanele. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokungondleki, okukhula kancane kancane, njengomlilo ongafikanga, kodwa ongenzeka kaningi. Ukungondleki, futhi ikakhulukazi ukungondleki kwengane, akukhona nje ukujwayela okukhona emaphandleni. Kukhona izigidi zezinkulungwane zezingane emhlabeni jikelele ezithola ukungondleki nsuku zonke. Lezi zingane azitholi ukudla okunempilo, okwenziwa kanjani kube nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo. Ukwenza okungcono, kudingeka ukuthi siqaphele ukuthi abantwana bethu baphila phakathi kwensakavukela-mali, abanye besaba indlela yokuphila, kanti abanye bahlupheka kakhulu ekudleni. Izizathu zokungondleki zingabangelwa ukuntuleka kwemithombo yokudla, ukungabi nalwazi oluhle ngezokudla, nezimo zomnotho eziphazamisayo. Izingane eziyinqaba—ezimaphakathi phansi—zivame ukuba nemiphumela emibi ngenxa yokungondleki, ukuvalelwa emakhaya okungafanele, noma ngabe zikhona izinhlelo zokwelulekwa. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima kubantwana ukuba bafunde kahle, kuhloswe ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila. Ukwakhisa ifa lokuphila — kuyadingeka. Ukudinga ukuyiqonda indlela yokuvuselela ubuchopho kanye nezezimali, kungekho okufanele kuphume. Izingane ezihlushwayo zidinga ukuba zixhaswe ngokwezimali. Izinhlelo zokulima ezisemthethweni, ezijolise ekwakheni izinsiza ezidingekayo, zidinga ukuba zigqugquzeleke. Kuyinto efanele yokukhuthaza lokho; sikhumbule ukuthi ibhizinisi elikhulu lokwazisa ukuphila abashumayeli, bazama ukujabulisa abantwana. Sikhumbule futhi, izingane zidinga uthando nokwaziswa. Abazali bethu, othisha, nabaxhasi bomphakathi badinga ukuba bahlale beqonda ukuthi izingane zidinga ukudla okuphakathi, elingaphezu kokugaya izinto ezilula. Izifundo ezikhuluma ngempilo, ezikhuthaza ukudla okunempilo, zidingeka ukuze zikhuthaze izingane. Izithiyo eziphambi kwethu zidinga ukuthunyelwa, zisheshiswe izandla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi kubekhona uhlelo lwezempilo ezithinta abantwana. Izikhungo zempilo ezitholakala kumaphuzu ahlukene zingasiza ekuphatheni ukungondleki. Izinhlelo ezikhuthaza imifino namagilebhisi, kanye nocwaningo olwenziwa ezikhungweni zokuphatha, zingasiza kakhulu. NgoMgqibelo, ukuxhaswa ngothando lwenhlalo, nomphakathi maphakathi, uhlose ukuqeda ukungondleki. Kufanele siyibuke ngokubona uqobo isimo sokungondleki. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kufanele silandele izinqubo zokwelapheka. Abantu bakithi, caphe, banye izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Izikhungo, ohulumeni, nomphakathi bonke bayadingeka ukuthi benze okufanele. Sidinga impumelelo yothando, enobungane, lokho kuzokwenza ukusebenza. Uma sikhumbula, akukhona nje abantwana abahamba phambili—kukhona abahlala phezu kwezinkulungwane zezinhlanga zokuphila ngokujwayelekile. Ekugcineni, izingane zifanele ukuziswa. Lokhu akubeki phansi udumo, kodwa kudinga ukuba silandele izifundo. Abantwana bethu bangaba iqulu phakathi phakathi nezinsuku ezinzima, futhi lokho kudinga ukuthi sizilungiselele. Noma kudinga izinsiza ezahlukene, kufanele sigweme imiphumela engemihle. Abantwana bethu bayoqala ngokuphelele, njalonje badinga ukuthokozisa ngempilo. Ukungondleki kwabo kumele kube okwakha, okwakha, kuhlomulise abantwana bethu! Lokhu kuyinkululeko, ukufika esikhathini esisha. Ukukhuluma ngempilo kufanele kube yisibopho somphakathi. Azikho izimfanelo ezenzakalayo ekugcineni, kodwa ukungabi naso isiphakamiso. Uma sikhuluma ngezifundo zempilo, sikhuluma ngesimo esibalulekile. Ukukhula kwemindeni, ukukhuluma ngezifundo, kufanele kube yindlela yokuthuthukisa impilo. Izikhathi ziyashintsha, kodwa impilo yengane ifanele ukuba phezulu. Ukulandela ezinsukwini ezizayo, siphokophela umfutho. Lokhu kusebenza uma sikhumbula, angizithokoziswa ekuphileni okukhuluma ngakhona ವಿಚಾರ ezokuthi, ukuphila kwabantwana bethu kubalulekile, futhi kufanele kusebenza. Ngalesi sizathu, sithumele ukungondleki ezithakazelweni zethu. Lokhu kwenza siqonde engrave, sihlose ukuphila ngempumelelo, sihlaleke kahle. Ukuphila kahle kuzotshala umphakathi onempilo. Akukhona nje ukuncelisa, kodwa kuhlonipha. Noma yikuphi ukuhamba, sikhuluma ngesiZulu, sithakazelela. Ingabe lesi sikhathi asiyibhalile? Sihole qanday line, akumele kube sephakame. Ngempela, umphakathi uyavuma—silungile. Ngiyanithokozisa.
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Umthombo Wempilo Ngiyanemukela nongakholwa, sonke siyavuma ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile yinto ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Hhayi kuphela ukuthi asisiza siphuze, kodwa futhi anendima enkulu ezintweni eziningi eziphilayo. Ngokweqiniso, uma uthanda impilo, umkhuba wokuphila kahle udinga amahlanga amanzi ahlanzekile, akusaphumi ebuhleni. Siyazi ukuthi emiphakathini eminingi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, amanzi ahlanzekile awatholakali kalula. Abantu basalokhu besebenzisa amanzi angahlanzekile okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu ezifana nezifo. Abantwana, izinsizwa, nabantu abadala bakhathazekile ngama bacteria nezifo ezihamba ngamanzi. Ngakho, kulungile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile iyinto ebalulekile kangangokuthi zingaba nemithelela eminingi empilweni yethu. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi sizuze amanzi ahlanzekile? Kunezindlela eziningi, ezithokozisayo ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uqale, singasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo endaweni yethu. Akukhona konke okungama-filter akhulu nababili. Kulungile ukufaka izinto ezilula ezifana nokuhlunga ngensimbi noma imithombo yemvelo, lokhu kuzodala indawo yokuphila engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kumqoka ukuthi sifunde indlela yokugcina amanzi. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi amanzi akhanyisa? Uma sikhuluma ngemuva kokutsha, sikhuluma ngezinto ezinjengokuhlanza izinto, ukoma nokususa imfucumfucu. Lokhu akuhlungu, kodwa ukufaka ingqondo yokubheka izinsiza eziphumelela kakhulu, sizofinyelela kuhlo lwamazwe anenhlanzeko. Futhi, asikho isikhathi sokuyengela, kudinga ukusitsha umoya wokuzisholo. Uma senze kube yinqaba ukuba sikhuthazelele labanye abantu ukugcina amanzi ahlanzekile, sizoba nemiphumela emihle. Nakanjani, ukuhlangana kwemiphakathi kwenziwa njalo, sikushiya isikhathi sokubambisana ukuze sibe neqhaza ekwenzeni la manzi sizithokozise. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sikhuthazelele amaqhinga akhuluma ngokulondoloza amanzi, ngaleyo ndlela siphephe ezinkingeni. Uma sithenge imiphakathi sihlale sinesikhumbuzo sokuthi amanzi ahlanzekile awatholakali kalula, kufanele sikhulume ngezinsiza ezinhle, ezizofaka esikhaleni, ukuhlanganyela nezinsiza ezikhiqiza amanzi ahlanzekile. Ubufakazi bokhuzi obuphumile, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuze sithole amahle. Ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile kusho impilo engcono nokusiza izimpilo zabantu, kukhulisa umqondo wempilo. Ungekho omncane, kusho lolu daba lunemvela enkulu. Ngakho, bonke abanye, sambulela ngezimpendulo, zisesikhathini senhlalakahle, singafinyelela emiphumeleni ethokozisayo. Kubalulekile ukwakha amandla empilo, lapho amanzi ahlanzekile ayingxenye ebalulekile yonke. Hhayi ukuhlola, kodwa ukunikela emiphakathini yethu, sizobe sikhanyisa umhlaba. Sekukhona konke kufanele kudingedwe, lawula abanye, ukubhaqa nokuhlukana kethu. Uma sazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile akhishelwe emhlabeni, sizoshintsha umbono wethu. Sizokwazi ukuphila ngokuphelele, phakathi kwezithako nezimo ezintsha, nezinye izinto ezenzakalayo. Ngasikhathi sinye, asikwenzi buhlungu, sithanda ukwenza umkhumbulo. Umthombo wempilo usimele sithole amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngakho-ke, asiweni emqondweni uma sesihamba kumathuba ohluzi nomthombo wempilo, kepha asimukele ukuhamba nolwazi. Noma imithombo yethu iyimpunga, sikhumbula ibhizinisi likaThuli, kumele siqhubeke senze kahle. Hamba, hamba kahle nathi, sibe nezilungiselelo ezibalulekile, akusikhumbulo, kodwa sizobambisana, khona-ke sisho ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba siphetha, amanzi ahlanzekile awusizo kuphela kithi, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi sibhale izinhlelo ezinzima, ngesiqalile, besigcinile esikhahlelweni somoya wayo. Noma bekuhlonishwa nabantu, hamba uqhubeke, sasithanda amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngiyabonga!
Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 ngezinguquko empilweni Ngonyaka ka-2023, umphakathi wethu wathola isaziso esibalulekile esivela kwiGEMS, okuyinhlangano eyaziwa kakhulu emkhakheni wezempilo. Lesi saziso saphakamisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezizokwenziwa ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukusiza abantu abaningi abathintekayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokucabanga, nokuhlela izinyathelo ezizayo. Ekuqaleni, abantu abaningi babengazi kahle ukuthi lezi zinguquko zizothinta kanjani impilo yabo. Abanye babebona lokhu njengokuphazamiseka, kanti abanye babekubona njengethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezingcono. Kwakukhona ukungabaza, kodwa futhi kwaba nokukhanya okukhanyisayo. Umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinguquko ezizayo, futhi izinkulumo zaba ziningi. Izinsuku zokuqala zalesi saziso zazigcwele ukungaqondi. Abantu babebuza imibuzo eminingi: “Yiziphi izinguquko ezizokwenzeka?” “Ngabe sizokwazi ukuthola usizo olufanele?” “Kuyini okudingekayo ukuze sihlangabezane nezidingo ezintsha?” Le mibuzo yayiyingxenye yokuphila kwansuku zonke, futhi kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, umphakathi waqala ukujula ekuqondeni izinguquko. Izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo zaba neziqubulo ezithile, zakhuluma ngalezi zinguquko ezizayo, ziqinisekisa abantu ukuthi izinguquko zenzelwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Lokhu kwavusa ithemba, kwavula umqondo wokuthi izinguquko zingaba yithuba lokuthola izinsiza ezinhle kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsuku ezingama-30 zaba yisikhathi sokuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona. Abantu baqala ukuhlela izinyathelo ezizothathwa ukuze baphendule kulezi zinguquko. Kwakukhona imihlangano eminingi, izifundo, nezinkulumo ezazihloselwe ukusiza abantu baqonde kahle izinguquko ezizayo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, njengoba bexoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, kwavela izinkampani eziningi ezazihlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule kahle ezinguqukweni. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukuthi izinguquko azizwakali kuphela, kodwa zidinga ukuba baphendule ngempumelelo. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo kudinga ukuba bube namandla. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, umphakathi waqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana, lapho abantu bexoxa khona ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokwakha umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi izinguquko zidinga ukuxhaswa. Kwakukhona imihlangano eminingi, lapho abantu bexoxa khona ngezindlela zokuphila eziphumelelayo, nezindlela zokuphendula ezinguqukweni ezizayo. Ekugcineni, izinsuku ezingama-30 zaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokubambisana, nokwakha umoya wokuxhumana. Umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko njengethuba lokuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi izinguquko azizwakali kuphela, kodwa zidinga ukuba baphendule ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zazingezokuthuthukisa impilo, futhi abantu baqala ukujula ekuqondeni izidingo zabo. Lokhu kwavula umqondo wokuthi izinguquko zidinga ukuba zibe yinsika yokwakha impilo engcono. Umphakathi waba namandla, futhi abantu baqala ukubona izinguquko njengethuba lokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi izinguquko zidinga ukuba zibe yinsika yokwakha impilo engcono. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba abantu beqonda ukuthi izinguquko azizwakali kuphela, kodwa zidinga ukuba baphendule ngempumelelo.
