Ifilimu: Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, ifilimu edume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, yadalwa nguSipho Mthembu, umqondisi ophumelelayo owayengumlingisi ophumelele emkhakheni wezokwenziwa. U-Sipho wazalelwa eThekwini ngo-1985, lapho aqala khona ukuthanda ifilimu. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwakhe, wathola ugqozi kumafilimu akhuluma ngezimpilo zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwakuhambisana nezimo zempilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. U-Sipho uqale ukufunda ubuciko bokwenza amafilimu eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona iziqu. Ngalesi sikhathi, wathola ithuba lokusebenza kumafilimu amancane, kodwa ubuchwepheshe bakhe baphuma phambili, kwaze kwaba sekutholeni ithuba lokuba ngumqondisi kumafilimu amakhulu. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, owawukhuluma ngempilo yentsha eNingizimu Afrika, waba yimpumelelo enkulu futhi wathola imiklomelo eminingi emhlabeni jikelele. Le filimu ibonisa izinselele ezibhekene nentsha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. U-Sipho usebenzise izimo zangempela nezindaba zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze akhe indaba ethinta inhliziyo. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi akukhulumi nje ngothando, kodwa futhi kukhuluma ngezinkinga ezifana nezidakamizwa, ubuhlanga, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza ifilimu ibonakale iyinsiza yokufundisa, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. U-Sipho Mthembu akazange akwenze lokhu yedwa. Wasebenzisana nabanye abaculi, ababhali, nabalingisi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze akhe umkhiqizo ophumelelayo. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi waba yisibonelo sokubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okwakuhambisana nemigomo yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Sipho wathola ithuba lokuhola imikhosi emikhulu yezehlakalo zamafilimu, lapho abelokhu ethola khona izindondo eziningi. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi wathola imiklomelo eminingi, kuhlanganisa ne-‘Best Film’ kumkhosi wezokwenziwa eCannes. Lokhu kwenza u-Sipho waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezokwenziwa, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu angaphumelela uma esebenza kanzima. Ngaphezu kokuba umqondisi, u-Sipho ungumfundisi. Uthanda ukufundisa abanye abaculi abasha, futhi uhlala ebakhuthaza ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. U-Sipho ubelokhu ebamba izifundo ezahlukene ezikoleni, lapho efundisa khona ngempilo, ubuciko, kanye nezindlela zokwenza amafilimu. Ubuye abe nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuxhasa abaculi abasha, ukuze baqale izindlela zabo emhlabeni wezokwenziwa. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi akukhulumi nje ngempilo yentsha, kodwa futhi kukhuluma ngothando, ubuhlobo, nokuhlanganyela. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi ifilimu ingaba yinsiza yokuxhumana, yokufundisa, nokwakha umphakathi. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ifilimu ingashintsha izimpilo zabantu, futhi ingaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Sipho Mthembu uqhubekile nokwakha amafilimu amasha, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa umkhakha wezokwenziwa eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokukhuluma, yokufundisa, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho ubonisa ukuthi, noma izinselele zikhona, uma umuntu enza umsebenzi oncomekayo, angakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi ifilimu yakhe, Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, iyinsiza ebalulekile emhlabeni wezokwenziwa. Ubonisa ukuthi ubuciko bungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokukhuluma, nokwakha umphakathi. U-Sipho uhlala efuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa umkhakha wezokwenziwa, futhi uhlala ethokozisa abantu ngama-filimu akhe. Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi, ifilimu eyaziwa kakhulu, izohlala ibalulekile emlandweni wezokwenziwa eNingizimu Afrika.

Ngiyavuma ukuthi lo muntu unikeze imvume yakhe ngokuzithandela. Ngifunde noma ngibone ngempela ukuthi ifomu lokuvuma lifundwe ngokucophelela kumphenduli ongase abe khona, futhi banikezwa ithuba lokubuza imibuzo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lo muntu unikeze imvume yakhe ngokuzithandela. Umxhumanisi: Usuku: / ... /... Q0453. Ingabe ifomu lokuvuma mayelana nomndeni lamukelwe futhi lasayinwa / Lamukelwe kodwa lasayinwa ngumfakazi noma Laphikiswa? Le mvume iyimvume yokuphendula eyodwa emndenini okhethiwe. Uma uneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwengu-49, sikukhetha ngaphandle kwemigomo phakathi kwamalungu omndeni abuye abe nethuba elilinganayo lokukhethwa, futhi sikumema ukuba ubambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Uma uneminyaka engu-50 noma ngaphezulu, sifuna ukukumema wena nabanye abantu emndenini wakho abaxhumene nawe ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Ukhethwe ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga, yingakho sifuna ukukhuluma nawe. Le mininingwane elandelayo izochaza inhloso yocwaningo, lokho okuzokwenziwa, kanye nokuzwela nezins benefits ongazilindela. Kuzochaza futhi ukuthi awubopheleki ukuba ubambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Kufanele ubuze imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi ufuna ukubamba iqhaza, noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi nenqubo yokubuza. I-Human Sciences Research Council ifuna ukukhuluma nawe njengengxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngababonisi abangochwepheshe [njengami] abaphinde babuyela kwi-Human Sciences Research Council. Lolu cwaningo lukhona njengamanje ezweni lonke nasemazweni ambalwa. Uyamukelwa ukukhuluma nomxhumanisi [mimi], umcwaningi ophambili, noma noma ubani ofuna ukukhuluma naye ngalolu cwaningo lapho unquma ukuthi ubambe iqhaza noma cha. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama abaphenduli... Umxhumanisi [mimi] uzokunikeza ulwazi oluthile oluhambisana nalolu cwaningo - okungase kufake ezinye amagama, imisho, noma imibono ongayiqondi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, uzizwe ukhululekile ukuvula imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi sizokunikeza ithuba lokuphendula. Uma uvuma ukubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo, ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqondwe kangcono izindaba ezibalulekile eziphathelene nempilo emphakathini nasemhlabeni - ikakhulukazi impilo nokuphila kahle kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka uhulumeni ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphila kahle nezokuxhaswa. Lolu cwaningo ngeke lunikeze izinzuzo ezinqala kuwe. Ukubamba iqhaza kwakho kulolu cwaningo kuzohilela ukuphendula imibuzo ngawe, kuhlanganise nempilo yakho nokuphila kahle, isimo sakho sokuxhumana, isimo sakho sezomnotho nomphakathi, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zempilo. Sizokwenza kuphela ukuqoqa ulwazi oludingekayo kulolu cwaningo. Le ngxenye ye-questionnaire izothatha cishe imizuzu engu-90. kanye nemibuzo ephathelene nomndeni wakho, umlando wakho wokusebenza, isimo sakho sezomnotho, impilo yakho kanye nokufinyelela kwakho kwezempilo, kanye nemibono yakho mayelana nokuphila kahle kwakho kanye nesimo sakho sempilo. Siphinde sikumeme ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekuhloleni ukuphefumula kwakho, ukubona, amandla, ukuhamba, kanye nezinkumbulo. Sizokala ingcindezi yegazi lakho, ukuphakama, isisindo, kanye ne-circumference ye-waist ne-hips zakho. Enye ifomu lokuvuma izosetshenziselwa ukukumema ukuba uhlinzeke ngesampula encane yegazi, lapho sifinyelela kulolu hlobo locwaningo. Ezinye zezimibuzo ozobuzwa zingase zibe ngqo ngawe futhi zingadala ukudideka noma ukungakhululeki. Ungacela ukubona imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi uzobamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo noma cha. Ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luyimfihlo futhi luyimfihlo futhi ngeke lukhululwe kumuntu. Luzosetshenziswa kuphela ngocwaningo nasekucwangcweni. Igama lakho, ikheli, neminye imininingwane yakho siqu izosuswa ku-questionnaire, futhi kuzosebenza kuphela amakhodi ukuze kuhlanganiswe igama lakho nezimpendulo zakho ngaphandle kokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho. Iqembu locwaningo lingase likuthinte futhi uma kudingeka ukuze kuqedwe ulwazi locwaningo noma ukuqoqa olunye ulwazi esikhathini esizayo. Uma kudingeka lokhu, kuzokwenzeka ezinsukwini ezingu-14 ezilandelayo. Lolu cwaningo luzoqhubeka isikhathi eside, futhi sizobuyela kule ndawo cishe ezinyangeni ezimbili ezizayo. Sizozama ukuthinta lo mndeni futhi, futhi sifuna ukukhuluma nawe futhi. Le mininingwane iyokwakha futhi ayidingi imvume yakho. Ukusayina le mvume kukhombisa ukuthi uqonda ukuthi kuzolindelwa kuwe futhi ukulungele ukubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Awubopheleki ukubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo uma ungafuni ukwenza kanjalo. Unesikhala sokuhoxa kulolu cwaningo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uzizwe ukhululekile ukuvula imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uma ufuna ukuvula imibuzo kamuva, ungathintana nanoma ngubani kulokhu okulandelayo: uProfesa Nancy Phaswana-Mafuya (Ucingo: 021-4667914), uProfesa Karl Peltzer (Ucingo: 012-3022000), noma uMargie Schneider (Ucingo: 012-3022000) bevela kwi-Human Sciences Research Council. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama abaphenduli... Ngifunde ulwazi olukhona kule fomula yokuvuma, noma ifundwe kimi. Ngibe nethuba lokubuza imibuzo, futhi noma yimiphi imibuzo engiyibuzile iphendulwe ngokwanelisayo. Ngivuma ngokuzithandela ukubamba iqhaza njengomphenduli kulolu cwaningo futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi nginela ilungelo lokuhoxa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kulolu cwaningo. Kubaphenduli abangenayo imfundo: Kumele basayinwe ngumfakazi ongakwazi ukufunda nokubhala (uma kudingeka, lo muntu kumele akhethwe ukuba abe umphenduli futhi akufanele axhumane neqembu locwaningo). Ukuhlaziywa kwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan I- Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan (ERRP) iyisinyathelo esibalulekile esithathwe uhulumeni ukuze kubuyiswe umnotho wezwe elibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ngemva kokuphazamiseka okubangelwe yizimo ezihlukahlukene ezifana neCOVID-19, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zomnotho ezikhona. Le plan ibhalwe ngenhloso yokwakha umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi obandakanya bonke abantu. Isizathu sokwakhiwa kwe-ERRP Ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwe-ERRP, uhulumeni ubhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu ezifana nokukhula kwamazinga okungasebenzi, ukuncipha kwemali engenayo, kanye nokungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kubangele ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Ngakho-ke, i-ERRP yadalwa ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga, ibuyise umnotho, futhi iqinise izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Izinto eziyinhloko ze-ERRP I-ERRP ibandakanya izigaba eziningi ezibalulekile ezizokwakha umnotho. Lezi zigaba zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuphuculwa Kwezinsiza Zomphakathi: Lokhu kuhilela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezifana nezikole, izibhedlela, nezindlela zokuhamba. Ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola imfundo nezinhlaka zempilo ezinhle, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba nokukhula komnotho. 2. Ukukhuthazwa Kwezokwakha Nezokuthuthukiswa: Ukuze kube nokukhula komnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokwakha. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakhiwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, izakhiwo zezimboni, kanye nezindawo zokuhweba. Lokhu kuzokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, okuzokwandisa umnotho. 3. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuxhasa Amabhizinisi: I-ERRP ibheka ukusiza amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuxhasa, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza. Amabhizinisi ahlume kakhulu angasiza ekunciphiseni amazinga okungasebenzi. 4. Ukwakha Umnotho Ohlangene: I-ERRP ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi umnotho uhlanganisa wonke umuntu, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihlaselwe kakhulu. 5. Ukuvuselelwa Kwezobuchwepheshe: Ukuze umnotho ube phambili, kubalulekile ukuvuselela ubuchwepheshe. I-ERRP ibheka ukusiza izinkampani ukuthi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokukhiqiza. Izinyathelo Eziyinhloko Zokuphumelelisa I-ERRP Ukuze i-ERRP iphumelele, izinyathelo ezithile zidingeka: 1. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Ezizimele: Uhulumeni kumele ubambisane nezikhungo ezizimele, ezifana nezinkampani ezinkulu, amabhizinisi amancane, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. 2. Ukuhlinzeka Ngemali: Ukuze i-ERRP iphumelele, kudingeka imali eningi. Uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. 3. Ukukhuthaza Umphakathi: Umphakathi kumele uqondiswe ukuze uqonde izinzuzo ze-ERRP. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nokufundisa abantu ngendlela yokuthola amathuba kuzokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi. 4. Ukusebenza Ngokuqhubekayo: I-ERRP akumele ibhekelelwe kuphela ngesikhathi esithile, kodwa kufanele kube nesu eliqhubekayo lokuhlola nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo ezidingekayo uma izinto zingahambi kahle. Izinto Ezinzima Ezibhekene Ne-ERRP Naphezu kwezinhlelo ezinhle ze-ERRP, kunezinto ezinzima ezibhekene nayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Izinsiza Ezinganele: Ukuze i-ERRP iphumelele, kudingeka izinsiza eziningi, kodwa uhulumeni angase abhekane nezinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza. 2. Ukungaboni Ngasolinye: Abantu abaningi bangase bangathandi izinguquko ezizokwenzeka. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphikisaneni nasekuphazamisekeni kwezinqubo. 3. Izimo Zomnotho Eziguquguqukayo: Umnotho ungase uguquke ngokushesha, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizophumelela. Isiphetho I- Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan iyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi obandakanya bonke abantu. Noma kunezinkinga ezithile ezibhekene ne-ERRP, uma uhulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nomphakathi basebenzisana, le plan ingaba yimpumelelo enkulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukusebenza ndawonye, singenza umnotho wethu ube ngcono, ube nezinzuzo kubo bonke abantu.
Ingxoxo Ngentsha YaseNingizimu Afrika Ngaphakathi kwenkulumo-mpikiswano emnandi, sihlangane noThandi, intombazane eneminyaka engu-22, ophuma eGauteng, naye ohlanganyela izinkumbulo zakhe, amaphupho, nemicabango ngentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika. UThandi ungumfundi ophothula izifundo zakhe zezamabhizinisi, futhi uveza umbono wakhe ngobuhlakani nokuqonda okujulile ngezinto ezithinta intsha. Uhlanga Lwesizukulwane “Ukukhula eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha, akusoze kwaba lula,” kusho uThandi. “Sihlala sinesithunzi somlando, okwenza kube nzima kithi. Kodwa, kube nezinguquko eziningi ezithinta impilo yethu. Ngifisa ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi intsha ilwela ukwakha ikusasa el better. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi, sinemithombo eminingi yokufunda, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni we-inthanethi. Lokhu kusinika ithuba lokufinyelela ulwazi olusha.” Izifundo Nezinto Ezinzima “Kwazulu, sithola izifundo ezinzima kodwa ezithakazelisayo,” kuqhubeka uThandi. “Njengomfundi, ngibona ukuthi izifundo zethu zidinga ukuhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise amakhono ethu, okwenza kube lula ukuthola umsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ungenza kube lula kumina njengomfundi, uma uhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokusebenza ezichaza imisebenzi ethile.” Izinkinga Nezixazululo UThandi akagcini nje ngezinselelo zokufunda, kodwa futhi ubheka izinkinga ezibhekene nentsha. “Ukungasebenzi kwesigaba esikhulu sabantu, ikakhulukazi abasha, kuyinkinga enkulu. Lokhu kudala ukucindezeleka; kukhulu ukungabi nendlela yokusebenza. Kunemizamo ethile yokuthuthukisa imisebenzi, kodwa kudinga ukuthi yonke imiphakathi ivuleke futhi ibambisane ukuze kwenziwe ushintsho.” Ubuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokuxhumana UThandi uthi ubuchwepheshe buye buba yinsika enkulu empilweni yentsha. “Siyakwazi ukufinyelela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, imithombo yolwazi, nokuhlanganyela nemicabango. Ngithanda ukuhamba phambili nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukwakha imisebenzi. Ukuxhumana kwenza kube lula ukusungula amabhizinisi amasha. Njengoba sikhuluma, ngihamba phambili ekwakheni ibhizinisi lami elincane.” Izimvo Zomphakathi Ngokwemibono kaThandi, umphakathi ubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. “Sicela abantu bazi ukuthi kumele sibe nomoya wokubambisana. Udaba lokusiza abanye luhlobene kakhulu nokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Uma sizokwazi ukusiza abanye, sizokwazi nokwakha izisekelo ezinzima zokuphila kwethu.” Amaphupho Nethuba “Njengoba ngikhula, ngifisa ukuba nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Amaphupho ami ahlanganisa ukwakha isikhungo sokufundisa, lapho intsha ingafunda khona amakhono ahlukahlukene. Ngifuna ukuba nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi yethu, ukuze bazi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani ukuze baphumelele.” Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi ukhomba ukuthi intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ikhuluma ngothando, ubuhlakani, nokubambisana. “Ukwakha ikusasa elingcono kudinga ubuhlakani bethu. Akukhona kuphela ukuthi sikhulume, kodwa kumele senze. Sidinga ukuhamba ndawonye, sikhule, siphumelele.” Le ngxoxo ibonisa isimo sendlela intsha ibheka ngayo ikusasa. Ukukhulumisana, ukubambisana, nokusebenza kanzima kuzoba yizinto ezisemqoka ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onogqozi. Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ikhulisa imiphakathi, iqhubekisela phambili izimvo, futhi ibonisa amandla obuhlakani obufanele. Lokhu kuyinsika yephupho elihle elizayo.
UMangosuthu Buthelezi: Umlando Nempumelelo Yomholi Wokuhola UMangosuthu Buthelezi, owazalwa ngo-27 kuMfumfu 1928 eBabanango, eNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabaholi ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe zalesi sizwe. UButhelezi ubenomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni nasekuqondiseni izinqubo ezithinta ubuhlanga, isizwe, kanye nezepolitiki, ikakhulukazi ngenkathi ye-Apartheid. Ngaphezu kokuba ngumholi, uButhelezi ungumculi, umbhali, nomfundisi, futhi ungena kubalulekile emlandweni wamaZulu. Ngemva kokuthola imfundo yakhe eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, uButhelezi waqala umsebenzi wakhe wezombusazwe njengomfana ophakeme, lapho aqala khona ukuqonda izinselelo nobunzima obuhambisana nezombusazwe ezweni lakhe. Waqala ukusebenza nezikhungo ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ne-ANC (African National Congress), kodwa wathola ukuthi izindlela zabo zokulwa ne-Apartheid zazihambisana nezinhlelo zakhe zamasiko nezokuphatha. Ngonyaka ka-1975, uButhelezi waba nguSihlalo we-Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP), iphathi eyasungulwa ukuze ik representing izidingo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi amaZulu. UButhelezi waphakanyiswa njengomholi ohloniphekile, ophikisana nezinqubomgomo ze-Apartheid, kodwa owazisa kakhulu izimiso zokuzimela kwamaZulu. Ukuphikisana nobuholi be-ANC, okwakuhambisana nezinqubomgomo ezazithathwa ngaleso sikhathi, kwaholela ekubeni kube neziyaluyalu phakathi kweIFP ne-ANC. Ngaphezu kwezombusazwe, uButhelezi uphinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ezokwakha, nezokuhlalisana. Ubuye waqhakambisa izinsiza zomphakathi, njengokwakha ezemfundo nezempilo, okuhlangene nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho wendawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uButhelezi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu emiphakathini ethile, ikakhulukazi kwabaseZulwini, lapho abanye bemthanda kakhulu ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe, kanti abanye bembona njengomholi ophikisana nezinhlelo eziningi zokulwa ne-Apartheid. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni yama-1980s, lapho izimpi zomphakathi zashintsha izimo zezimali nezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uButhelezi waba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezokuthula eNingizimu Afrika, ukuze kube nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga ezazikhona phakathi kwamaZulu, amaXhosa, nabanye abantu. Uhlanganyele ezinkulumweni eziningi zokuthula, lapho wahola khona izinkulumo ezibalulekile, esebenzisa amandla akhe njengomholi wezombusazwe ukuze axazulule izinkinga ezazikhona. Naphezu kwezinkinga nezithiyo, uButhelezi ugcinile isikhundla sakhe njengephini lempilo yomphakathi, ebonisa ukuthi ubuholi buphathelene nokusebenza ngentshisekelo yomphakathi. Uthembisa ukubuyisela emuva izinsiza, ukwakha i-inkonzo efinyelela kubantu abaningi, futhi agqugquzele ubuhlobo phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uButhelezi ubenesithakazelo esikhulu emfundweni, ethinta kakhulu izifundo zabantu abasha, enza kube lula ukufinyelela emfundweni ethuthukile. Umsebenzi kaButhelezi ubalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, njengoba ebonisa ukuthi ubuholi buhlobene nezindlela eziningi zokuphila kwabantu. Uthi umholi kumele azinikele emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa umphakathi, futhi ahloniphe izimiso zokuhlukana kwamasiko. Ngesikhathi sokuphela kwe-Apartheid, uButhelezi waba yisibonelo sokuqonda ukuthi iziphakamiso nezinhlelo zidinga ukubhekwa ngendlela ebanzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Ekugcineni, uMangosuthu Buthelezi ungomunye wabaholi ababalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, onomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi amaZulu. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi wezombusazwe, uButhelezi ungumfuziselo wokuthi ubuholi buphathelene nokuhlonipha, ukuxhumana, nokusebenza ngokubambisana nabanye, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa futhi zifezekiswa. Njengoba uhamba phambili, uButhelezi usazoba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, ethinta izizukulwane ezizayo.
I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi (PSC) iyisikhungo somphakathi esizimele esakhelwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. I-PSC inezibopho nezimvume, phakathi kokunye, zokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi kahulumeni. Le mvume ifaka phakathi ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle noma okungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni. Ehlanganiswe nalezi zikhala, i-PSC inezibopho zokukhuthaza izindlela zokwenza kube nokusebenza kahle nokusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni nokukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphatha umphakathi njengoba kubhalwe kwiMthethosisekelo kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. I-Commission ithola amandla ayo ezigabeni 195 no-196 zoMthethosisekelo, 1996. Isigaba 195 sichaza izindinganiso nezimiso eziphathelene nokuphathwa komphakathi okufanele i-Commission ikhulume ngakho. Izinga eliphezulu lezimiso zobungcweti. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kusekelwe ekuthuthukiseni. Izinsizakalo kufanele zinikezwe ngendlela engakhethi, ngokulinganayo, ngokufanele, futhi ngaphandle kokuphambuka. Kumele ziphendule ezidingweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi kufanele ukhuthazwe ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube nesibopho. Ukuveza kufanele kukhuthazwe. Ukusungulwa kokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube yindlela ethatha wonke umuntu ngokusekelwe kumakhono abo, ukucabanga okuzimele, ubuqotho, nokulungisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili. Ukukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 195 soMthethosisekelo, 1996 kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ukuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela, ukuphathwa, nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni, ikakhulukazi ukuhambisana nezindinganiso nezimiso ezishiwo esigabeni 195, kanye nasekusebenzeni kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke nasezindaweni mayelana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuveza imiphumela neziphakamiso okungenani minyaka yonke kwiZikhulu Zikazwelonke noma ezikhungweni zendawo njengoba zenzeka. Ukuveza izindaba eziphuthumayo eziphathelene nomsebenzi ezikhungweni ezifanele. Ukuhlola izikhalazo zabasebenzi nokwenza iziphakamiso ezifanele zokulungisa. Ukuhlela nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa nokusebenza komsebenzi. I-Commission isunguliwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. UMthethosisekelo udinga i-Commission eyodwa yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enamalungu alishumi nane, amahlanu kubo aqokwa nguMongameli ngokuhlonza kweZikhulu Zikazwelonke, kanti ilungu elilodwa lisuka kuzo zonke izifunda likhethwa nguMphakathi weSifunda. I-Commission ibophelelekile kwiZikhulu Zikazwelonke okufanele ibike okungenani minyaka yonke. Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo ezikhungweni zendawo. Ngokwemithetho yeMthethosisekelo njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amalungu amahlanu akwiPretoria nolunye olwakho zonke izifunda. I-PSC isekelwa yiHhovisi le-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, eliholwa nguMphakathi-Jikelele (ongumphakathi ophakeme), enehhovisi elikhulu ePretoria kanye nehhovisi lesifunda esisodwa kuzo zonke izifunda. Lezi zikhungo zisebenza njengesisekelo samalungu eCommission ezifundeni futhi ziphathwa ngabaqondisi bezifunda, ngosizo lwamalungu ambalwa abasebenzi. Imisebenzi ethile nezisebenzi ezibalulekile zikhuluma ezikhungweni zendawo. Amalungu eCommission aqokwa nguMongameli, aqala ukusebenza kusukela ngoJanuwari 1, 1999. Nokho, ukuqala ngokusemthethweni kwemisebenzi yeCommission kwabambezela kuze kube nguJulayi 1999 ngenxa yezinkinga zomthetho phakathi kwezinye izindaba zeMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997. NgoJulayi 1, 1999, uMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997 kanye nemigomo yeMthetho weCommission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997, kanye nokuphulwa kweCommission yeZokuphatha Komphakathi, 1984, kwaba nomthelela, kwavumela i-Commission ukuba isebenze ngokuphelele. UCommisioner Mgijima wathatha indawo kaCommisioner Vusi Mavuso owashiya isikhundla sakhe. Uhlaka lwezokuphatha lwe-PSC lwasungulwa ukuze luhambisane nezinhloso zayo zamasu futhi kamuva nemikhakha yayo yokusebenza. Umsebenzi weCommission uhlelwe ngezikhala zayo eziyisithupha zokusebenza kanye nezindawo ezimbili ezengeziwe ezikhuluma ngazo njengokukhuluma kwenombolo 1 ngenhla. Ukuphathwa - kubhekisela kokubili ukuphathwa jikelele nokuphathwa kwezimali; ukuphatha abasebenzi nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza kubasebenzi; nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomthetho nezinye ezisizayo ezisetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa inqubomgomo. Ibhulokhi: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu Nezobudlelwano Bomsebenzi - Le bhulokhi ivumela i-Commission ukuba iqhube imisebenzi yayo mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; ukuqapha ubudlelwano bomsebenzi; nemithetho yomsebenzi kahle. Ibhulokhi: Ukuphathwa Okuhle Nokuhlinzekwa Kwezinsizakalo - Le bhulokhi iyasebenza amandla eCommission ngokubhekelela nokuhlola; ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo; ukuziphatha kobuchwepheshe kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni nezinhlelo zokubhekana nezingozi emsebenzini kahulumeni. I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi: Amadokhumenti akhishwe ngamalungu eCommission nezincwadi zemihlangano nezinkulumo abebekhona. Imizuzu yemihlangano yokuphatha yonke. Amadokhumenti wezinsizakalo ezivela kubahlinzeki. Izivumelwano nabahlinzeki. nokuhlola izikhalazo nezikhalazo ezithunyelwe ngabasebenzi bakahulumeni neziphakamiso ezifanele zokulungisa ezikhungweni zikazwelonke nasezindaweni. nokuhlola izikhalazo eziphathelene nezicelo ezithunyelwe ngabasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa komphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba eziphathelene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola izinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. ukuqapha nokuhlola izimo zokusebenza nokuphathwa kokusebenza ngabaphathi bezigaba. kanye nokuhlola nokubika ngezinkinga zokuthanda kumphathi nokugcina isikhala sokwazisa kwezimali; nokukhuthaza nokuhlola ukusebenza kahle ekubhekaneni nezingozi. nokulwa nokukhwabanisa emsebenzini kahulumeni ngokuhlola okuqondile; nokufaka isandla empini yokulwa nokukhwabanisa ezweni. Ukuthuthukisa Ukuphathwa Nokuhlinzekwa Kwezinsizakalo: izindaba eziphathelene nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuphathwa nezisebenzi zokuhlinzeka kwezinsizakalo emsebenzini kahulumeni. ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo, okusebenzayo, nokonga kwezinsiza; nokuhambisana nezinqubo ezifanele emsebenzini weZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba eziphathelene
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwezemfundo Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19, izikole zamabanga aphansi zazigcwele izingane ezazizama ukufinyelela emhlabeni wezemfundo. Nokho, le nqubo yayingenamathuba alula. Kwamanye amazwe, ukufunda kwakuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezinzima, okwakuthinta kakhulu intuthuko yabalimi. Abafundi babezibandakanya ezincwadini ezindala, lapho abasha bephikisana nezinqumo ezithile ezithinta impilo yabo. Njengoba lezi zinkomba zikhula, izikole zamanyuvesi zathola ukuvuselelwa kancane. Isahluko 2: Intuthuko Kwezobuchwepheshe Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zemfundo zathuthuka, futhi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zaba yisisekelo sokwakha izinhlelo eziphakeme. Ngonyaka we-1900, abafundi basemanyuvesi baphenduka izigidi ezahlukene emhlabeni jikelele, behluka ngezindawo abavela kuzo. Lezi zifundo zayinikeza umoya omusha wezobuchwepheshe, futhi abafundi babengabafundi abavusa izinhlelo eziguqula izibalo zabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izimfundamakhwela zaziqala ukuvela, futhi abafundi bafunda ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, benza izinhlelo ezithokozisayo ukuze baqhubekele phambili ezimpilweni zabo. Isahluko 3: Ukujula Kwezombusazwe Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, umkhankaso wezombusazwe wathola amathuba amasha. Abafundi basemanyuvesi baphinde baba nezwi elikhulu ebuhleni bomphakathi, behlanganyela ezimeni ezinzima, futhi beqeqeshwa ngokubambisana. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinyathelo ezinzima zavele zafaka izidingo zokubonisana phakathi kwabafundi nezikhungo zemfundo. Izikhungo zabafundi zashintsha, zaba yizindawo ezahlukahlukene zokufunda, okuvulela amathuba okuhlola imibono emisha. Isahluko 4: Ubuhlakani Nobuhlungu Ngaphandle kwemfundo, abasha babephikisa. Ubuhlakani bahlala buphakeme, futhi abafundi basemanyuvesi baveza izifiso zabo zokufunda. Baziqonda kahle ukuthi impilo ibalulekile, futhi baphokophele ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabanye. Izinkumbulo zabafundi zazikhombisa ukuzimisela okukhulu, okuqinisekisa ukuthi baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo. Bafunda ukuthi abazali babo bahlupheka, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhuthazo sokufuna impumelelo. Isahluko 5: Ukuvuka Kwesiko Ngonyaka we-1960, abafundi basemanyuvesi baqala ukuveza isimilo esisha. Bahlanganisa izinhlelo zezimali ezithuthukisiwe, okwavula iminyango emisha yokwakha izifundo ezizothuthukisa imfundo. Ukuhlangana kwabo kwaholela ekutheni bafune ukuxhumanisa imicabango yabo yokuphila, behlanganyela nemikhosi yokuhlonipha izinkumbulo. Isahluko 6: Ukugubha Ibanga Abafundi basemanyuvesi bakhombisa isithakazelo esikhulu emakhonweni abawathola ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisayo. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokwakha imikhankaso ezothuthukisa imfundo, kulotshwe izincwadi ezizokhumbuza ngezizathu ezithakazelisayo. Abafundi bahlola izinkinga zomphakathi, behlanganyela emisebenzini eyahlukene. Ukuhamba kwempilo kuphonsa izinyathelo eziyisithupha, okuqinisekisa impumelelo yomphakathi. Isahluko 7: Umphumela Ophelele Igalelo labafundi basemanyuvesi alihlinzeki kuphela ngekhwalithi yokufundisa elungile, kodwa futhi liqhubeka nokuhlola izinhlelo ezinhle. Abafundi bahlala benesibopho sokwakha umphakathi. Ukubambana kwabo kuveza amandla, kanti izindaba zabo zikhumbuza ukuba baphokophele phambili. Umphumela uphumelele, ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungathuthuka uma abafundi benikela ngempumelelo yabo ezimfundweni. Lokhu kuphilisa umphakathi ngezinsiza zefunda, futhi abanye bazithokozisa, benza izinqumo ezinhle zokwakha ikusasa labo. Iziphumo zikhombisa ubuhle, futhi isikhathi eside sokuhlola umlando wabafundi basemanyuvesi sikhona, sikhuluma ngempumelelo. Ekugcineni, ukuqonda kwemfundo kuyisisekelo sezinguquko ezizayo.
Isahluko 1: Uhlanga Lwama-Influencer KwakunguMsinsana, owayeyintombazane ezalelweyo ngasemzaneni oguquguqukayo. Ntombokazi, wayehlala ephakathi kwabanye abantwana abazalwe emakhaya aphethwe ubuchwepheshe. Uhambo lwakhe lwokuqala lohlelo lwezokuxhumana lwenzeka ngenkathi ethola umakhalekhukhwini wakhe wokuqala eminyakeni eyishumi nanye. Njengoba ethola ithuba lokuxhumana nabangani, waqala ukujabulisa ngokwabelana ngempilo yakhe, ezithombeni nezindaba ezincane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uMsinsana waqala ukuzibonela ukuthi izithombe ezincane zamenza waphumelela kuhwebo lwezokuxhumana. Kanjalo, eminyakeni embalwa, waba yisibonelo esihle sabantu abanyakazayo abasebenzisa izinkundla ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kokuthumela izithombe, waqala ukuphatha izinsiza zezezimali, izifundo zokupheka, nezokuhamba. Khumbula, uMsinsana wayevame ukuthola izinkanyezi ezivela emhlabeni wonke, ezimemeza ukuthi uzuze izinkanyezi ezilandelayo. Isahluko 2: Ubuhlakani beSikhumbuzo Njengoba uMsinsana eqhubeka nokukhula, wathola nabanye abakhe bahlala bejabule benza imisebenzi efanayo. Isidumbu sazo sabakhe saphuma ebuhleni— behlangana, bephokophele, benza ubuhlobo obukhulu phakathi kwabo. Bangakaze baqonde ukuthi omunye nomunye wayengaba yinsika emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Kwenzeka into ethokozisayo; uMsinsana wahlangana noLwandle, indoda ebingaziwa, eyaziwa kakhulu ngama-video ayo afundisayo. Lwakha uvuko lwezemfundo kumaphuzu ahluke kakhulu. UMsinsana noLwandle bazithola bejabulisa ngesikhathi bamba izifundo ezihlasimulisayo. Bahlanganyela imibono, baphumeza ukuvumelana okukhulu, kube sesiyimfumbe yokugcina izinqumo eziningi zikwazi amakhono anothile. Isahluko 3: Ibhuku Lami, Ibhuku Labanye Njengoba uMsinsana nalabo abakhuluma naye behamba phambili, baqala ukubona ukwenza ngendlela yokubhala izincwadi. UMsinsana wayebona imihlangano, indawo yokuqhunyiswa kwengqondo. Izinsuku zenzeka nemizuzu, futhi kwaba nesigameko esikhulu sokwakha ibhuku elalisukuluza izifundo zakhe. Umsuka wakhe wabe usuhamba ngomoya. Ngokoqobo, leli bhuku laqalwa ukwenziwa kube yinzuzo empilweni yabo, kwavula iminyango emisha. Abantu abaningi bacela ukufunda ngezinto abavela kuzo; kwakungaphezu kokuqhakambisa impilo yabo, kwaba yindlela yokuphila. Isahluko 4: Izinkinga Nezithokoziso Nokho, impilo yabo yayihamba ngaphandle kwezithiyo. UMsinsana, nobuhlakani bakhe, wabona izinkinga ezithile nokuqhubeka kokusebenza. Ukuhamba phambili, kwaba nezinselelo ezithile zokwakha izinhlelo ezinhle. Kukhona abanye ababytes abavela emapulazini cushenyiwe, balandela ikhono lokuphila phakathi kokubona, kodwa bebhekene nezifiso eziphezulu, ezazinqoba ukugula ngokwaphakade. Naphezu kwemivimbo yempilo nobunzima, uMsinsana wafunda ukuthi uuidisa bangabaphucuzi abafuna ukuhlanganisa abantu, khona la waqala ukukha umphakathi wakhe, wabeesephose kadlule, ngesikhathi ehambisana noLwandle. Bazise benze ubudlelwano obuhle, ngempela kwathokozisa. Njengoba behlanganyela, bakhumbuza abantu ukuthi uhlelo lwezokuxhumana akuphili nje, kodwa ungumngane ukuze uphumelele. Isahluko 5: UkuThula Okungapheli Ukwaba yisibonelo, uMsinsana noLwandle bajabula ukufaka isandla esikhulu emiphakathini yabo. Bathola izithombe ezinamagama emizweni yangezikhathi eziningi, edlula izithombe zabo. Imingcwabo, imihlangano, imicimbi, nobuhlakani bakho bezezimali naye. Ngomsebenzi omuhle, kuqhuba imiphakathi eminingi, uvuliwe umqondo wokuthi ungafaniswa nemizwelo, kwazulu kwenzele izithombe ezinzima zokusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akukhona okudinga. Isahluko 6: Umqondo Omusha Ngaleso sikhathi, uMsinsana wacabanga ukuthi akuyona kuphela impilo ngenxa yezithombe, kodwa empilweni, kudinga ukuthokozisa. Kwakukhona imiqondo emisha njengoba eba umoya oqinile. Kwabe sekufika umqondo omusha - owayewumsebenzi owandile. Ibhuku, izithombe, nabangane babezobanza bakhulume ngezinto ezinzima. Umphakathi ozozibophezela kokubili baba yindida ejabulisayo. Umhlaba ugxile ekuthuthukiseni umkhakha wakho, uMsinsana esekwenzeniye eyaziqhenya ngempilo yabanye. Kukhona okwaziyo ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlala bukhona, nomphumela uzithokozisa. Isiphetho: Ingabe Uthando Luhlale Lukhona? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMsinsana noLwandle bahlala bejabulisa futhi bejabula. Lokhu akukhona ukwenza imali kuphela - kuhlangene uthando, ubungani, nokukhombisa izinkanyezi. Kwakungobuchwepheshe nempilo, kukhuluma imeko yokunakekela abantu. Iziphetho eziwu-365 zoshisizela umphakathi nasemazweni, kanti ama-social media influencer abavumela abantu ukuthi banqamule phezulu. Njengoba bekephula izimpilo zabo, bavezile umphakathi omkhulu wokuqala. Futhi njengezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, bahlala ngabaholi bokuphila, behlanganyela izimpilo zabo ngokukhululeka, bethemba okuyinto engaphezu kwenkwenkulu yomhlaba.
Umbiko: Ukusekela Kwezilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni (IsiNgisi NesiZulu) Isingeniso Ukusekela izilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo, nowaphilayo. Ezweni elihlukahlukene ngezizilimi, njengaseNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo nezinhlaka ezikhuluma izilimi ezahlukene ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezikole, izibhedlela, nezinsiza zomphakathi. Izinselelo Zokuxhumana Ezikhungweni eziningi, isiNgisi sithathwa njengolimi olusemthethweni, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abakhuluma ezinye izilimi, ikakhulukazi isiZulu, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekuxhumaneni, futhi kungaholela ekutheni abanye bazizwe bephucwa amalungelo abo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokukhuluma, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zisebenzise izilimi eziningi ezimbonini zazo. Ubukhulu Bokwesekwa Kwezilimi Ukuze izikhungo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo efanele, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqonde ubukhulu bokwesekwa kwezilimi. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinsiza ezifanele, njengezincwadi, izinhlelo zokufunda, nezinsiza zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo ngolimi oluthile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abakhuluma isiZulu ukuthi bakwazi ukufunda, ukuthola ulwazi, nokuxhumana nezinsiza ezikhona. Izindlela Zokweseka Izilimi Eziningi Izikhungo zingasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izilimi eziningi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezindlela zokuxhumana ezihlukene, ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezikhethekile zokufundisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zingase zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bangezelelwa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Nababambisene Ukusekela kwezilimi eziningi akupheli ezikhungweni kuphela, kodwa kudinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezikhungo nemiphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo kufanele zixhumane nabantu bendawo ukuze baqonde izidingo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo efanele, futhi kuzokwenza abantu bazizwe beyingxenye yomphakathi. Izifundo Ezinikezwa Ngokweseka Kwezilimi Eziningi Kukhona izifundo eziningi ezitholakalayo ezikhungweni ezisekela izilimi eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufundiswa kwezifundo ezihlukene ezibandakanya isiZulu, isiNgisi, kanye nezinye izilimi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubafundi ukuqonda izifundo zabo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda nokuxhumana. Izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi lezi zifundo zikhona, futhi zikhuthazwa emiphakathini. Imiphumela Yokwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ukusekela kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kunemiphumela emihle emiphakathini. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, ophumelelayo, nowaphilayo. Abantu bahlala bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni babe nesithakazelo ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kudala amathuba amaningi okukhula, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini ezahlukene. Isiphetho Ukusekela kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokufinyelela ezinsizeni. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo nemiphakathi. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi eziningi ziyasetshenziswa, futhi zihlala zikhona ezikhungweni zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
IPhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika isungule uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinsalela njengohlelo oluhlangene lokuphatha kahle indawo yokusebenza ephephile. UMthethosisekelo uthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banelungelo lokuba nendawo ephephile ukuze baphile kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvikelwa kwemvelo okuhlanganisa imithetho ecacile nezinhlelo zokuvimbela ukungcoliswa nokwehla kwemvelo, ukukhuthaza ukonga, nokugcina ukuthuthukiswa okungaguquki. Singashintsha omunye wemicimbi eyenzekayo ezungezile uma sonke senza okuthile ukuze sishintshe. IPhalamende izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni impilo nokuphepha kwawo wonke amalungu nezisebenzi zayo, kanye nazo zonke abantu abasebenza ngokomthetho noma abangena ezindaweni zayo. Isikhungo sizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izindawo zePhalamende zihlala zisesimweni esihle ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezimo zokusebenza eziphephile nezempilo, nokuphatha nokubhekana nezingozi endaweni yokusebenza. Umthetho Wempilo Nezokuphepha Emsebenzini (OHSA) uphoqa iPhalamende ukuba ihlinzeke futhi igcine indawo yokusebenza ephephile nephilile engabazisi ezempilo zabasebenzi bayo. Kunethemba lokuthi abasebenzi bazosebenzisana nomqashi ukuze baqinisekise ukuhambisana nezimfuneko zomthetho. IPhalamende isungule uhlelo oluhlangene lokuphatha kahle indawo yokusebenza ephephile nephilile, okuhlanganisa ukusungulwa komthetho wokuphathwa kwezinsalela. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esifanele esitholakalayo, nokwethula izinsizakalo zomphakathi ezizinzile endaweni yokusebenza nasemphakathini ezindaweni zePhalamende. Umthetho uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukususa izinsalela ngokuphepha ukuze kuncishiswe ukungcoliswa, kukhuphuke ukugaywa kabusha, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsalela ezikhiqizwa ePhalamende ziphathwa ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi ezikule mthetho. IPhalamende ithuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwamalambu anegunya lokonga amandla ukuze kuncishiswe ukungcoliswa, kugcinwe amandla, futhi kuncishiswe izindleko. "Izinsalela" zisho noma iyiphi into, kungaba igesi, liquid, noma solid, noma inhlanganisela yazo, njengoba kuchazwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha ngezikhathi ezithile, kuhlanganisa nezaziso kuGazethi Yomphakathi. Izinsalela ezomile ziqoqwa nsuku zonke ezitsheni zeplastiki ezibekwe endaweni ethile futhi zithunyelwa endaweni yokulahla izinsalela evunyelwe. Izinsalela zezempilo zifakwa ezitsheni zeplastiki ezibekwe (eziphuzi) futhi zikhishwa njalo ngumhlinzeki wesevisi oqashwe noma njengoba kudingeka. Zonke izibani ezingenamsebenzi zithunyelwa endaweni yokugaywa kabusha ukuze zikhishwe ngokuphepha. Izinsalela ezimanzi zifakwa ezitsheni/izikhwama ezibekwe futhi zikhishwa njalo. Imichiza igcinwa endaweni yokugcina imichiza evaliwe ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusetshenziswa okungagunyaziwe. Zonke imichiza kumele ifakwe ezitsheni ezinemibhalo, futhi inani elincane lemichiza eyingozi kumele libhalwe ngokufanele. Umhlinzeki wesevisi uthathe izinyathelo ngokushesha ukuze akhishwe ama-silinda angadingeki ezindaweni futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ama-silinda aphathwa ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko zomthetho, avimbela ukusetshenziswa okungafanele. IPhalamende isesimweni sokuthola izitsheni zokugaywa kabusha uwoyela wokupheka ongaguqulwa ube yi-biodiesel. Le ndlela yokulahla uwoyela wokupheka ezithombeni zomoya iyavinjwa. IPhalamende ifuna umhlinzeki wesevisi omusha ukuze akhishwe izinsalela zephepha ukuze zibe yizinsalela ezigaywayo. Zonke ofisi ePhalamende zizohlinzekwa ngezikhwama zekhadi ukuze ziqoqe izinsalela zephepha. Lezi zikhwama zizokhishwa ngesonto. Zonke izenzo ezenziwa zenzelwe ukuvikela imvelo, ukonga amandla, nokunciphisa izibalo zezinsalela. Kungumthwalo wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kuhlanganisa wonke amalungu nezisebenzi zePhalamende, ukuvikela imvelo yethu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezizukulwane ezizayo nokukhuthaza isiko lokuthuthukiswa okungaguquki.
Ukunakekelwa KweZinsizwa Nezinsizwa: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, emiphakathini yamaZulu, abantu abadala babebhekwa njengemithombo yokuhlakanipha, ubuhlakani, kanye nesiko. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kwakuyisiko elijulile, elalikhombisa ukuhlonipha nokubonga labo abahamba phambili empilweni. Abantu abadala babenendima ebalulekile ekwakheni nasekugcineni isiko, futhi imiphakathi yayiqonda ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabo kwakubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luhlala lukhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokunakekela abantu abadala zashintsha. Phakathi nezikhathi ezinzima, njengempi nezinhlekelele, imindeni yayithola kunzima ukunakekela abantu abadala. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta indlela abantu ababephila ngayo. Nokho, imiphakathi yamaZulu yahlala ibambisene, ibonisa umoya wokubambisana, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu abadala bayathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zokunakekela abantu abadala zakhula, ziqala ukuvela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zikhungo zazihlinzeka ngempilo, ukudla, kanye nezinsizakalo ezahlukene ezazidingeka ukuze abantu abadala baphile kahle. Abantu abasha babefundiswa ukuthi ukunakekela abantu abadala akuwona umthwalo, kodwa kuyisibopho esikhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umqondo wokuhlonipha, lapho abantu abasha bejabulisa abantu abadala ngenkonzo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkolo zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekunakekelweni kwabantu abadala. Ezinye izinkolo zifundisa ukuthi abantu abadala banelungelo lokuhlonishwa, futhi kufanele baphile kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithile zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlanganisa imikhankaso yokubasiza, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. Imiphakathi yamaZulu yathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina isiko, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo zabantu abadala zanda. Ukugula, ukuguga, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezinzima zaba yizinto ezazidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlanganisa izinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhasa. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abantu abadala bekwazi ukuthola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ezizimele zathuthukisa izinhlelo zokunakekela abantu abadala, ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izikhungo ezikhethekile zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlinzeka ngempilo, ukudla, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha. Abantu abadala baphinde bathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emisebenzini ehlukene, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzilibazisa, imidlalo, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokugcina abantu abadala bejabulile, bephila impilo enempilo. Kodwa-ke, nakuba izinhlelo zokunakekela abantu abadala zikhula, zikhona izinselelo ezithile. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu imiphakathi. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu abasha baphinde baphinde bahlale bephokophele ekunakekeleni abantu abadala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bahlala bejabulile. Imiphakathi yamaZulu yathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela umthwalo, kodwa kuyisibopho esikhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu abadala baqala ukuveza izidingo zabo, bephakamisa izwi labo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokunakekela abantu abadala, ezazihlanganisa izinsizakalo zokwelapha, izinhlelo zokuphila, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhasa. Imiphakathi yamaZulu yathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina isiko, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ekugcineni, ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Imiphakathi yamaZulu ibonisa ukuthi ukuhlonipha abantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela umthwalo, kodwa kuyisibopho esikhulu. Lokhu kuhlonipha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi, isiko, kanye nezifundo zihlala zikhona, futhi abantu abadala bahlala bejabulile. Ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina isiko, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, lapho wonke umuntu ehlonishwa, futhi wonke umuntu ethola ukunakekelwa okufanele.
Umdlavuza Kwabesifazane: Ingxoxo Nompilo Mbatha, Udokotela Ochwepheshe Isingeniso Namuhla sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, umdlavuza kwabesifazane. Umdlavuza ungomunye wezifo ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yabesifazane emhlabeni jikelele. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, sithole ithuba lokuxoxa noDkt. Nompilo Mbatha, udokotela ochwepheshe emkhakheni wezokwelapha, owaziwa ngempumelelo yakhe ekwelapheni umdlavuza. Ingxenye 1: Ukuqonda Umdlavuza Umbuzo: Dkt. Mbatha, ungachaza ukuthi umdlavuza kwabesifazane uyini futhi ubuhlungu bawo bukhona kanjani? Impendulo: Umdlavuza kwabesifazane ubandakanya izinhlobo eziningi, kodwa ezivame kakhulu zifaka umdlavuza wesifuba, umdlavuza wombungu, kanye nomdlavuza wesitho sangaphakathi. Umdlavuza uveza izinkinga ezinkulu empilweni, ngoba ungase ube nomthelela omkhulu emzimbeni nasempilweni yengqondo. Abesifazane abaningi bahlushwa ukwesaba, ukungaqondi kahle, kanye nokubandlululwa ngenxa yokuthi umdlavuza ungaba yinkinga engathandeki. Ingxenye 2: Izimbangela Nezimpawu Umbuzo: Yiziphi izimbangela ezivame ukuholela emdlavuzweni kwabesifazane? Impendulo: Izimbangela zingahluka, kodwa ezinye zezinto ezidumile zifaka phakathi izinguquko ezithinta ama-hormone, ukungahlali kahle, kanye nomlando wezokwelapha emndenini. Izimpawu zihluka futhi zingafaka phakathi ukuvuvukala, ubuhlungu, noma ukwehla kokudla. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bazi lezi zimpawu ukuze bakwazi ukufuna usizo ngokushesha. Ingxenye 3: Ukuhlolwa Nokutholwa Umbuzo: Ingabe abesifazane kufanele benze ukuhlolwa njalo ukuze kuvinjwe umdlavuza? Impendulo: Yebo, kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane benze ukuhlolwa njalo. Ukuhlolwa kwe-mammogram, ukuhlolwa kwe-pap smear, kanye nezinye izivivinyo zingasiza ekutholeni umdlavuza ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okuthi umdlavuza ube mubi futhi kube lula ukuwulawula. Ingxenye 4: Ukwelashwa Umbuzo: Yiziphi izindlela zokwelapha ezitholakalayo uma umdlavuza utholakele? Impendulo: Kunezindlela eziningi zokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukuhlinzwa, ukwelashwa nge-chemotherapy, kanye nokwelashwa nge-radiotherapy. Uhlelo lokwelashwa luncike ekutholeni umdlavuza, umumo womuntu, kanye nezidingo zomuntu siqu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bakhulume nodokotela babo ukuze bathole uhlelo olufanele. Ingxenye 5: Ukusekelwa Nokuphila Ngemva Kokwelashwa Umbuzo: Njengomuntu ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokwelapha, ungakupha izeluleko zokuthi abesifazane bangazithola kanjani izinsiza zokusekelwa? Impendulo: Izinsiza zokusekelwa zibalulekile. Abesifazane bangathola usizo ezikhungweni zokwelapha, emiphakathini, nasezinhlelweni zokwelapha ezikhethekile. Ukuxhumana nabanye abesifazane abahlangabezana nezinkinga ezifanayo kungaba usizo olukhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana nezihlobo nabangane kungasiza ekwenzeni kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ingxenye 6: Ukubaluleka Kokukhuluma Ngendaba Umbuzo: Kungani kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngendaba yomdlavuza kwabesifazane? Impendulo: Ukukhuluma ngale ndaba kubalulekile ukuze sithole ukuqonda, sikhulise ulwazi, futhi sithuthukise ukwesekwa. Umdlavuza akuyona into okufanele siyihloniphe noma siyigcine imfihlo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sithuthukisa amathuba okuthi abesifazane bathole usizo oludingekayo. Isiphetho Umdlavuza kwabesifazane ungumkhankaso omkhulu, kodwa ngokukhuluma, ukufundisa, nokuxhumana, singakwazi ukusiza abesifazane baphile impilo engcono. Njengoba sithola ulwazi olushisayo nolwakamuva, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukweseka abesifazane abathintekayo kubalulekile. Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mbatha, ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi oluwusizo ngale ndaba ebalulekile.
Odokotela Nabahlengikazi: Abagibeli Bephila Nathi Emhlabeni wanamuhla, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala besebenza njengabaphikisi abakhulu empilweni yethu. Njengoba sithola izinsiza zezempilo, kubalulekile ukuqonda indima yabo, ubunzima abahlangabezana nabo, kanye nomthelela abawenza empilweni yethu. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bephila nathi, besebenza ngenkani ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Odokotela, njengabaphathi bezempilo, banomsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlola, ukuxilonga, nokwelapha iziguli. Bafundiswe iminyaka eminingi ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezihlukahlukene zempilo, futhi lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu. Kodwa, akukhona nje ukuthi bahlala behlola iziguli; baphinde babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle neziguli zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma isiguli sikhuluma kahle nodokotela, kuba lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abahlengikazi bahlala bephakathi kokusebenza kanzima. Bahlala besebenza ezindaweni ezinzima, bephatha iziguli eziningi ngasikhathi sinye. Umsebenzi wabo awupheli nje ekunakekeleni iziguli, kodwa ubandakanya futhi ukuxhumana, ukweseka, nokuhlinzeka ngothando. Abahlengikazi bahlala bejabulisa iziguli ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga umoya ophakeme nokuzinikela. Ngaphandle kwabo, odokotela bangase bahluleke ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukusebenza ngezinsuku ezinde, ukungabi nesikhathi sokuphumula, kanye nomthwalo omkhulu wezibopho, konke lokhu kudala ingcindezi enkulu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphatheke kabi, futhi lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo nasempilweni yeziguli. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza ziqinisekise ukuthi odokotela nabahlengikazi banesikhathi sokuphumula, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezanele kubalulekile. Ezinye izibhedlela zihlala zihlupheka ngezinsiza ezincane, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi odokotela nabahlengikazi benze umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabanye abaholi bezempilo baphendule ngokushesha ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izibhedlela zikhona izinsiza ezanele. Uma izinsiza zikhona, odokotela nabahlengikazi bazokwazi ukusebenza kahle, futhi lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yeziguli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukubaluleka komsebenzi wabo. Odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bephila ezinsukwini ezinzima, futhi umphakathi kufanele ubabonge. Ukubonga kungaba yindlela elula yokubakhuthaza, futhi lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza ngenkani. Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi impilo yethu incike kakhulu emsebenzini wabo, futhi kufanele sibabheke njengabalingani bethu empilweni. Ekugcineni, odokotela nabahlengikazi bahlala bephila nathi, besebenza ngenkani ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi sithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Umsebenzi wabo awupheli nje ekwelapheni iziguli, kodwa ubandakanya futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, ukweseka, nokuhlinzeka ngothando. Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde ukubaluleka komsebenzi wabo, futhi uhulumeni kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi banezinsiza ezanele ukuze bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo kahle. Ngaphandle kwabo, impilo yethu ingase ibe sengozini. Ngakho-ke, masibabonge, masibakhuthaze, futhi masiqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bephila nathi, ngoba impilo yethu incike kubo.
UMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguhulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimali zakhe, futhi ukuthi umthetho kazwelonke kumele usungulwe ukuze uthuthukise leli lungelo. Ngokwezinhlinzeko zalesi sikhathi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela unqunyelwe njengomphakathi wezolwazi (IO), kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli ophakathi (RA) weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Abaphathi Bokwesekwa Nabantu Bokuqashwa bamenywa njengezikhonzi eziphakeme zezindaba (DIOs). Lezi zikhonzi zizohlinzeka ngosizo olwamukelekayo kubalaleli bomphakathi ekufinyeleleni ulwazi uma kwenziwa izicelo zokurekhoda ezivela eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Ikomidi Lezokwelulekwa Kolwazi (IAAC) lisunguliwe ukuze lihlolisise umphakathi wezolwazi ngeziphakamiso ezenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezindaba eziphezulu mayelana nezicelo zolwazi futhi linciphise umphakathi wezolwazi kanye nomgibeli ophakathi mayelana nezinqubo zokuphikisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaKhomidi Amancane Ezokwelulekwa Kolwazi (IAASC's) asunguliwe ukuze ahlinzeke ngokuqonda kwabaphakanyisi bezindaba mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. Isikhungo Solwazi seMnyango Wezokuvikela sisunguliwe njengendawo yokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Isikhungo Solwazi sizosiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalungu omphakathi ukuthi abone uhlobo noma uhlobo lwezincwadi ezigcinwe eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela futhi kufaka phakathi izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani ulwazi nezincwadi nokuthi bangazithola kanjani ngqo noma ngqo. Ulwazi ngokweSigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000). Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwazwelonke, futhi ikhuthaza ukuphepha ezingeni lesizwe, lesifunda, kanye nezwe jikelele ngokulandela amakhono avikelekile, anamuhla, atholakalayo kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inikezwa ukuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule futhi ethuthukayo kubo bonke. Iphinde ibheke noma yimuphi umnyango kahulumeni ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela iqukethe uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli onamandla, uNobhala Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophethe ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nomphakathi weMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti umphakathi weMpi unomsebenzi wokuyala nokulawula iMpi. Ukuba Isikhungo Solwazi seMnyango Wezokuvikela esizophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali lukamasipala eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), nemithetho yeTreasury, kanye nezikhumbuzo ezithunyelwe kubo bonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwezokuphepha kwazwelonke nezindaba zokuhola indlela yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, ukubheka, nokwamukela umthetho, isu, kanye nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nemigomo kazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, okucophelela, nokuphumelelayo kwemisebenzi yokuvikela. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Umsunguli ungumHead of Equal Opportunities and Support for the previously Discriminated. Ukuphatha nokulawula iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ahlobene nokuvikela umhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa mayelana nenqubomgomo yokuvikela umhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwempi ngosizo oluhlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ahlobene nokwesekwa nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula umkhankaso wezokwelapha wokwesekwa kwezempilo ezinhlelweni zempi kanye nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukwesekwa kwezempilo okubalulekile kubalaleli beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezixhaso zabo noma labo abaxhaswa ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokwesekwa nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezobuhlakani ekuzivikeleni nasekulawuleni ulwazi lwezobuhlakani mayelana nokuphikisana ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina uxhaso lwezobuhlakani lweMpi, ukusiza ekwesekeni, nakwezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezinto ezisebenzayo. Ukuhlela umsebenzi wabasebenzi beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubo bonke abalaleli beMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezixhaso zabo futhi kukhuthaze ukukhula kokomoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuqondisa okuvela enhlanganweni yempi. Ukusungula umthetho wokuxhumana wezokuvikela, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nemigomo yeMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nemigomo yokuxhumana kazwelonke (GCIS) futhi kube isikhungo sokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okucophelela, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezithakazelo zayo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olukhethekile, usizo oluqinisekisiwe nolusekelayo ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono mayelana nezinsiza zokuvikela zangaphandle nezinsiza ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezobupolisa kuMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe ukuvimbela nokwakha amathuba okufunda ngokuqashwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo olungahlangene nokulwa kumuntu ngamunye weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekudluliseni kolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene kuMnyango Wezokuvikela nokweseka lokho okwenziwa nguMnyango Wezokuvikela. Inhloso yalolu mthetho ukuveza ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela noma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe uMbuso noma olunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze lusetshenziswe noma luvikelwe nganoma yiluphi ilungelo. Inhloso ukuhlela isiko lokuvuleka nokubopha emiphakathini yomphakathi nezizinda ezizimele futhi ukukhuthaza umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika
Izimpi Zomlando: Ukuhlola Umthelela Wazo Emphakathini Nempilo Yethu Izimpi zomlando ziwumfanekiso ophilayo wezinto ezenzakalayo ezithinta abantu, izizwe, nezifunda. Ziyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando, zikhombisa indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, izinqumo abazithathayo, kanye nemiphumela ethinta izizukulwane ezizayo. Njengomuntu ohlola lezi zimpilo, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi izimpi azikhombisi kuphela ubudlova, kodwa zibuye ziveze izifundo ezinzulu mayelana nobuntu bethu. Ekuqaleni, izimpi zikhona ezindabeni zomhlaba, ziqala ezikhathini zakudala. Izimpi ezifana neMpi Yezwe Yokuqala neMpi Yezwe Yesibili zashintsha ubuhlakani bomhlaba. Lezi zimpi zathinta izigidi zabantu, zashiya izinkumbulo ezinzima, kodwa zafaka isikhumbuzo sokuthi ubudlelwane phakathi kwezizwe buhlelekile, futhi buphelele ngezikhathi ezinzima. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zimpilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukuhamba kwempilo, kodwa kukhona nezinselelo ezibhekene nomuntu ngamunye. Noma izimpi zikhombisa ubudlova, zibuye ziveze amandla abantu okukhuthazela. Isibonelo, iMpi Yezwe Yokuqala yakhombisa ukuthi abantu bangabambisana kanjani ukuze balwe nezimo ezinzima. Izixuku zabantu zashintsha izinqumo zazo, zafaka izwi lazo emkhankasweni wokulwa. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba izimpi zidalela ubuhlungu, zibuye zikhuthaze umoya wokubambisana nokuzimisela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimpi zishintsha izinkolelo nemigomo. Iziphakamiso ezivela ezimpini zenza ukuthi abantu bacabange kabusha ngezinto ezibhekwa njengokujwayelekile. Ngokwesibonelo, iMpi Yezwe Yesibili yakhuthaza ukwakheka kwezinhlangano ezinjenge-United Nations, ezazisungulwa ngenhloso yokugwema izimpi ezinjalo esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izimpi, nakuba zikhombisa ubudlova, zibuye zibe yizikhumbuzo zokuthi abantu bangakha izixazululo ezihlanganyela. Kodwa, akukhona konke okuhle. Izimpi zishiya izinkumbulo ezinzima, zishiya imiphumela emibi emphakathini. Izimpilo ezilahlekile, izifunda ezibhujiswe, nezizukulwane ezithintekile zikhumbuza ukuthi izimpi zihlala zishiya izilonda ezinzima. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni sibe nezinselelo zokwakha kabusha, ukuhlela kabusha, nokubuyisela emuva lokho okuphukile. Njengomuntu ophila kulezi zinsuku, ngithola ukuthi lezi zinkumbulo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Ngokubheka izimpi zomlando, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Zifundisa ukuthi ubudlova akusona isixazululo, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bephila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano, ophila ngokuhloniphana, futhi ophokophele ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ngokuphetha, izimpi zomlando ziwumfanekiso ophilayo wezinto ezithinta izimpilo zethu. Zifundisa, zikhumbuza, futhi zikhuthaza. Njengomuntu, ngiyavuma ukuthi izimpi zikhona, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubudlova abuyisona isixazululo. Kumele sibe nesibindi sokufunda ezimpini, sithathe izifundo, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, ophokophele phambili. Umhlaba wethu udinga abantu abakhuthazayo, abahlanganyela, futhi abavuma ukufunda ezimpilweni zabanye ukuze bakhe ikusasa elingcono.
Ukuphakamisa izinto, imisebenzi ephindaphindwayo, nokucindezela komzimba kuthinteka ngezinto ezithile ezilimazayo. Bahlaselwa yizinto ezilimazayo ezithinta imizimba yabo - baphinde bahlangabezane nezimo ezivumela amagciwane ukuthi angene emzimbeni wabo ngokuphefumula nasekufakeni izinto ezifana nothuli nokusebenza ezindaweni eziphakeme ezinezinga elikhulu lokushisa. Basebenza ezindaweni ezishisayo nezibanda. Le mboni ivame ukuba nezimo zokushisa ezihlukahlukene nezibanda ezindaweni zokusebenza njengoba imikhiqizo ihlale ishisa kanti eminye iyabanda. Abasebenzi bavame ukubekwa ezimeni ezinzima ngesikhathi besebenza nem food efakwa ezitsheni. Bangasebenza nasezindaweni ezincane. Ezinye zalezi zindawo zifaka: izikhungo zokugcina, amathangi nezitsheni, imayini nezikebhe ezinkulu, amathangi omoya, izitsheni zokukhipha uwoyela, amathangi okuvuthwa, nezinye izikebhe ezinkulu. Kumele kwenziwe amalungiselelo afanele ukuze lezi zindawo zifinyeleleke futhi izikhungo zokuhlanza kumele zigcinwe dry ngokususa zonke iziphuzo. Abasebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ekuphakamiseni izinto futhi ezinye izindawo kumele zakhiwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi banendawo eyanele. Ezinye imisebenzi efana nokufaka imikhiqizo ezitsheni, ezibhotela, nokusebenzisa imishini ethutha imikhiqizo ngebelts ivame ukuveza abasebenzi ezingeni eliphezulu lokukhala. Kumele kube nezilawuli zobunjiniyela zokunciphisa umsindo, futhi abasebenzi kumele basizwe ekusebenziseni izinyathelo zokuvikela kulokhu. Abasebenzi kumele banikezwe imishini yokuvikela, izinsiza, nokuqeqeshwa kokuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani. Ukuhlanzeka komuntu kufanele kugcizelelwe futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uhlukaniswe nezimo zokuphepha. Abasebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ngezici zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kufanele kufake izinyathelo zokuphuthumayo. Kumele kube nodokotela ofanelekayo noma umhlengikazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umsebenzi uphila kahle ukuze asebenze kule mboni. Abaphathi badinga ukusungula izindawo ezinezidingo ezihlukene endaweni yokusebenza. Uma zikhona, kumele kube nezimpawu ezikhombisa indlela yokufinyelela lezi zindawo ukuze zibe lula ukuzibonakalisa. Amalayisense alezi zindawo kumele abe khona futhi afanele imisebenzi ethile eyabelwe lezi zindawo. Abasebenzi kumele banikezwe usizo lokuphefumula olufanele uma besebenzisa lezi zindawo, futhi laba basebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto ezigcinwe phezulu (njengalezo ezigcinwe ezitsheni zokugcina) azinakuphuma kalula ukuze kugwenywe ukuwa okungase kuholele eziphumeleni. Uma kupakishwa izinto, izinto ezinzima kufanele zibekwe phansi kanti ezilula zibekwe phezulu kwezinto ezinzima. Izindlela zokupakisha ezifanele kufanele zikhethwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto azishintshi. Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi izinto eziphakanyisiwe (njengama-cylinders kagesi) noma izinto ezibekwe ngendlela engazinzile zingawa kalula noma ziqhume. Izitsheni zivame ukuba yimbangela yezingozi eziningi, ngakho kufanele zibekwe endaweni ephephile noma ziqiniswe ebhakedeni uma zingasetshenziswa. Amathuluzi wezandla kumele agcinwe engcono ukuze kugwenywe ukufaneleka okukhulu uma esetshenziswa. Izinto ezifana nezimoto zangaphakathi, ama-hoists ezinto, nemishini esetshenziswa ngabagibeli kumele zabelwe ukusetshenziswa ezindaweni ezingafinyeleleki kwabanye abasebenzi uma kuvunyelwe. Umuntu owonakele ngesikhathi edonsa enye yalezi zinto kumele aye endaweni lapho angabonakala kalula. Izinyathelo zokuphepha kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi izindawo ezilimazayo ziyaziwa (njengemishini enezingxenye ezihambayo, ama-hooks, nezinto ezingawa emishinini). Imboni yokudla nezokuphuza ivame ukuba nezinhlobo ezihlukahlukene ezedlula amathathu. Lokhu kufaka izinkomo, imishini yokwenza ushukela, nemishini yokwenza okusanhlamvu ehambisana nezikhungo zokukhiqiza kanye nalabo abakhiqiza iziphuzo ezithile. Idatha ephathelene nezingozi emikhakheni yokudla nezokuphuza ikhombisa ukuthi izinga liphezulu kakhulu lapha. Nokho, lezi zinga zihluka phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene yale mikhiqizo. Kuwo wonke la, izimoto zivame ukuba yimbangela enkulu yezingozi endaweni yokusebenza, kuhlanganise nezindawo eziphakeme nokulimala okubangelwa imishini. Ukukhiqiza ukudla kunezinga ezintathu - izinga lempesheni, ukucubungula, nokuthengisa. Ukukhiqiza ukudla nezokuphuza kwenzeka ezinkampanini ezihluka ngosayizi kusuka kulabo abaqasha abantu abambalwa kuya kulabo abaqasha izinkulungwane. Kulezi zinkampani ezinkulu noma ezincane ezikhiqiza ukudla nezokuphuza, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zisebenza ezweni noma emhlabeni jikelele, ezinezikhungo eziningi zokulawula, zivame ukuqasha izinkulungwane zabantu. Umnyango Wezabasebenzi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokubheka izinga lokuqala lempesheni - izinga lomsebenzi wezolimo nokukhiqiza. Ukuthengisa nokusabalalisa imikhiqizo kuyimfanelo yohulumeni bendawo kanye neminyango yezempilo yomphakathi, nakuba Umnyango Wezabasebenzi ubambisana nalezi zinsiza ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho yezempilo nokuphepha. Ngokuvamile, kunzima ukuphatha impilo endaweni yokusebenza kunokuphepha kuphela. Izimbangela nemiphumela yezimo ezimbi zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza yizinto ezingaphathwa kalula. Lokhu okunzima ukukhipha kungase kungaveli njengokugula okubangelwa izimo zokusebenza. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kuthatha isikhathi ukuze lezi zifo ziveze izimpawu. Kuvame ukufaneleka ukuthi lezi zimpawu zivele ngaphambi kokuba zibhaliwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, izinyathelo zingabhalwa ukuze kuvinjwe lezi zifo. Izinkinga ezifana nezinkinga zomzimba ziba nzima ngoba zingase zingabi yizimbangela ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Abasebenzi bavame futhi ukuba nenkinga yokungafuni ukuveza ukuthi baphila kahle ngenxa yomsebenzi ngoba besaba ukuphuma emsebenzini. Lezi zinkinga ziveza isidingo sokulwa nokwanda kwezifo ezikhona endaweni yokusebenza. Naphezu kokuba nezixazululo ezikhona ezinkingeni zempilo endaweni yokusebenza, izixazululo ezaziwa kahle azitholakali kabanzi. Lokhu kungakho izinkampani ezinkulu seziqale ukuqasha abantu abagxile kuphela empilweni yabasebenzi. Izinkampani ezinganikezi lezi zinketho ngokuvamile zincane. Lapho abantu behlangabezana nalezi zinkinga ezixoxwe lapha, bavame ukuvakashela odokotela bomndeni babo, kodwa khona-ke kukhona inkinga yokuthi labo odokotela abaqeqeshwe ukuhlela izinkinga zempilo ezibangelwa izimo zokusebenza. Izinkampani eziningi azikhuthazwa ukuba zifune abantu abaqeqeshwe ukuvikela izifo zabasebenzi ezibangelwa izimo zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zifo phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo aziningi ngaleyo ndlela. Lokhu kungakho abaninzi abasebenzi bengakwazi ukubambisana njengomphakathi ukuze balwe nalezi zifo. Iqiniso liwukuthi ukuthola abantu abaqeqeshwe kulolu hlobo lomsebenzi kuyaziwa ukuthi kulethe imiphumela engcono. Ukulimala kwesikhumba: okubangelwa ukugeza ngezandla, ukuthinta ukudla, njll.
