Imidlalo Yamakhompiyutha: Uhlobo Oluthokozisayo Lokudlala Uhlelo lokudlala kumakhompiyutha, olwaziwa ngokuthi imidlalo yamakhompiyutha, luthokozisa abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukuqala ngezinsuku zokuqala lapho imidlalo yemishini yokuqala yakhiwa, lezi zinhlelo zehlile ngezindlela eziningi futhi zathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Namuhla, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha isikhala esihamba phambili, esinesiphazamiso esiza ukwedlula imingcele yokukhetha, ubuchwepheshe, nemidlalo eqondile. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizogxila emlandweni, ekuthuthukisweni, nasekuthokoziseni kwabantu kule midlalo. Ukudala izipho ezintsha ezimnandi, abathuthukisi bemidlalo bahamba phambili emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Kuthe kuqala imidlalo yobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, imidlalo eminingi yagxila kumkhiqizo, lapho abadlali bazi ukuthi bakhetha ukudlala imidlalo ethile. Lokhu kudale ukwanda kwemali yokudlala ngebhajethi, okwenza abyale ukuzibandakanya kwamakhasimende okukhulu. Iminyaka edlule ibonakale iyinhlekelele; umkhiqizo owawuhlinzekwa yizinkampani ezinkulu ufike waba ngowama-industry ayizigidi. Lokhu kulindelwe ekuqaleni kwamakhompiyutha, lapho imidlalo yokuqala ibonakala yehlukile, kodwa ibikhipha impilo emisha kumakhasi amasha. Abadlali baphakathi kwemidlalo yamakhompiyutha kubalulekile ukuthokoza ngokwama-culture ahlukene. Imidlalo ayilokothi ihlale efana; ithokozisa abantu abahlukene ngezinhloso ezifanayo, izinsiza ezihlukene, nezindaba ezithile ezithokozisayo. Umdlalo we-'The Legend of Zelda' wakhuluma ngokuziqhenya ngamasiko eJapane, kanti 'Grand Theft Auto' udlalisa izinselelo zempilo eceleni kwezilwandle. Lokhu kwenza imidlalo ibe nendaba eqondile ngesikhathi abafundi bejolise emhlabeni jikelele. I-competitive gaming, noma i-esports, ibe yintsha phakathi kwezinye izilimi zitholakala phesheya. Njengoba imidlalo iyishayeli yesikhumbuzo, abaqeqeshi, nabadlali bamalungu abahlonishwayo, bezama ukufaka izitayela ezenzakalweni ezikhulayo. Ukuxhasa izimbangi ezinkulu, imidlalo iyinqubo ethokozisayo ekwandiseni izinselelo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni imijamo, izixhumo nezinhlelo zamasiko eziphathelene nemidlalo. Kodwa-ke, zikhona izinkinga ezihambisanayo nezinhlelo zokudlala. Ukudlala isikhathi eside kungaholela ezinkingeni zomzimba nokuhlupheka okujwayelekile, nokwehlukaniswa ebudlelwaneni. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, izinto ezenzakalayo zaba nezimo ezihlukile; abanye abantu bazithola bephazamisekile, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlali benelisekile phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ibonakaliswa njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abadlali bakha ubudlelwano nezinye izindawo, benza abanye abaphumelele, bese ke abanye befunda ukuhlonipha. Lokhu kudala umhlaba omusha wezenzo, mkhulu ngokuziqhenya ngempela. Umphakathi ludinga ukuzwana, futhi imidlalo yamakhompiyutha inikeza amathuba amaningi okukhuluma nokuxhumana. Umdlalayo, njengoba babizwa ngalesi sikhathi, ubugqugquzela ukubaluleka kobuchwepheshe empilweni yabadlali. Abadlali bahlola izinkampuni ezikhonjiwe nezinhlelo eziningi zesiqhamo, zibona okuhle. Ukudlala kuqedela ubuchwepheshe ukuze kuphazamise izinkumbulo zomphakathi, kuholela ekunqobeni imicabango endala. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha iye yathuthuka kakhulu, yaba yinsiza yokukhumbula, yokuxhumana, neyokudlula imingcele. Ihlanganisa abantu, ihlotshaniswa nezimo ezahlukene, futhi ibonisa umhlaba obuthakathaka. Lokhu kwenza kube ngokwedlulele lokho okwenziwa ngabadlali, okwakha umphakathi ogcwele izinkumbulo. Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ayiyona eyodwa, kodwa imizwa ehlukile evela kumphakathi, izakhiwo, nezinkumbulo okungaholela ezimpilweni ezikhethekile kubadlali. Hamba ube nengqondo, hamba, uqhubeke, futhi uphume kweminye imikhiqizo eyinqaba emakhompiyuthweni, njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula, nathi sizohlala siqhubeka sithokozisa kulolu hlobo oluthokozisayo lomsebenzi.
Izinkinga Zokungcola Komoya: Ukuhlaziywa Nokuqonda Ukungcola komoya kuyinkinga ethinta bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, imvelo, noma umnotho. Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani lokhu kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu, futhi lesi sihloko sizohlola izinkinga ezihambisana nokungcola komoya, imithombo yawo, kanye nemiphumela yawo empilweni yethu. Imithombo Yokungcola Komoya Kukhona izinto eziningi ezibangela ukungcola komoya. Okokuqala, izimoto zenza umoya ube nomoya ongcolile. Izimoto ezidla uphethiloli, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamapaki amakhulu, zikhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwamagesi anobungozi afana ne-carbon monoxide ne-nitrogen oxides. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umoya ube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu, kube nokwanda kwezifo zokuphefumula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imboni iyona enye yezizathu eziyinhloko zokungcola komoya. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinto, ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo, kanye nokuhanjiswa kwezimpahla, konke lokhu kudinga amandla amaningi, okukhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwemikhawulo eminingi. Lokhu kudala ukungcola komoya, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziseduze nezimboni, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Imiphumela Yokungcola Komoya Empilweni Imiphumela yokungcola komoya ibonakala ngokucacile empilweni yethu. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinomoya ongcolile bahlushwa yizifo eziningi, ezinjengokuphefumula okungahambi kahle, izifo zenhliziyo, kanye nezinkinga zesikhumba. Abantu abanesithakazelo empilweni yabo kufanele baqaphele izimpawu ezihlobene nokungcola komoya, njengokukhwehlela, ukuvuvukala, noma ukuvuvukala kwesikhumba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungcola komoya kuthinta impilo yezilwane nezitshalo. Izilwane ezihlala ezindaweni ezithintekile zikhombisa izimpawu zokuhlupheka, kanti izitshalo ziba nekhono eliphansi lokukhula. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwemithombo yokudla, okuthinta umnotho wezwe. Uma umoya ungcolile, izitshalo azikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokudla okwanele, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila. Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Zokulwa Nokungcola Komoya Ukuthola izixazululo zokungcola komoya kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqwashisa abantu ngale nkinga. Imikhankaso yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izimoto ezisebenza kahle, njengezimoto ezisebenzisa ugesi, ingasiza ekunciphiseni ukungcola komoya. Ukuze abantu baqonde kahle, kudingeka imithombo ethile yokufundisa, njengemihlangano, izifundo, kanye nemithombo ye-intanethi. Uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezithile zokulawula ukungcola komoya. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufaka imithetho eqinile yokulawula imoto, imboni, kanye nezinsiza ezikhiqizayo. Ukuze imithetho ibonakale, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinsiza zokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho iyagcinwa. Izinkampani nazo zinqoba indima ebalulekile. Zingase zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zinciphise ukungcola okukhishwa emoyeni. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezihlanzekile, kanye nokwenza izinqubo zokukhiqiza ezihlanzekile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani ezahlukene kungasiza ekwakheni imikhiqizo ethuthukisa impilo yomoya. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokungcola komoya zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu, njengoba zikhombisa imiphumela emibi empilweni yethu, emvelweni, nasezinhlelweni zomnotho. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Ngale ndlela, singakwazi ukwakha umoya ophilayo, onempilo, futhi ongenazinkinga zokungcola. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yethu, imvelo yethu, kanye nomnotho wethu, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizoba nempilo engcono. Ukubambisana kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza ekulwisaneni nokungcola komoya.
UMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezindaba zikazwelonke kanye namaMEC anegunya lamakultura, ukhethe ithimu ethi "Ukwazisa Izelamani Eziphilayo ('Izinto Esiphila Nazo') ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili wethu wokuthula" ngesikhathi somhlangano wabo we-MINMEC ngoMashi 2004. Le thimu izosetshenziswa eminyakeni emithathu ezayo, iphelelwa nguSepthemba 2007. UMnyango uhlose ukusebenzisa inyanga yeZelamani njengendlela yokukhuthaza umbono wesikhathi eside sokuhlanganisa, ukugcina, ukuvikela, ukuthuthukisa, nokwabelana ngamasiko aphilayo/amasiko kazwelonke angathinteki. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba imibhalo yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika nemithetho ivame ukubhekisela ezamasikweni aphilayo, emhlabeni jikelele (e-UNESCO) ibizwa ngokuthi amasiko angathinteki. Le ndlela entsha iyathandwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esanda kusungulwa yiMibandela Yomhlaba Yokuvikela Amasiko Angathinteki, lapho abaqhuba nezisebenzi ezisebenzisana namasiko baqala ukusebenzisa Amasiko Aphilayo kanye neMisebenzi Yamasiko Angathinteki ngokufanayo. Uma othile ekhuluma ngamasiko aphilayo, kuqondwa ukuthi ingxoxo ibhekisela kumasiko angathinteki kanye nokukhula kwawo. Incazelo, njengoba iboniswe kwiMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye neMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ifaka inqubo ephelele yemvelo, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi seMibandela, "Amasiko Angathinteki" abhekisela ezimisweni, izithombe, ukuveza, ulwazi, amakhono - kanye nezinsiza, izinto, nezindawo ezihlobene nazo - ezikhumbulelwe, amaqembu, nabantu abaziwa njengengxenye yamasiko abo, edluliselwa ezizukulwaneni, eqhubeka nokwakhiwa ngamaqembu nomphakathi ngokuhambisana nemvelo yabo, ukuxhumana kwabo nemvelo, kanye nomlando wabo, futhi ibanika umqondo wokuhlonipha nokuhlala, ngaleyo ndlela ikhuthaza ukuhlonishwa kokwehlukahlukana kwamasiko nokudala kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi seMibandela, ukuqashelwa kuzokwenziwa kuphela kumasiko angathinteki ahambisana nezimiso zezimfanelo zabantu njengemfuneko yokuhlonipha phakathi kwemiphakathi, amaqembu, nabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okusekelwe. Izinkolelo zomsindo nezokukhuluma, ezihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwamasiko angathinteki, nazo zifakiwe. Lezi zincazelo ezandulelelayo (kokubili ngokwezimiso zomthetho waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nomthetho wamazwe omhlaba) zibhekisela kumqondo oxhumene kakhulu. Umkhuba ojwayelekile ufaka izinkolelo zomsindo, imisebenzi, imikhuba yokuxhumana, nolwazi lwezinto, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Uma othile engabona umehluko, akuwumehluko ngokwakhiwa kodwa ngokuchazwa kwamagama. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenzisa lezi zinkolelo ngokufanayo, njengoba abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika benza, akuhambisani nokwephula noma iyiphi imithetho kodwa kunalokho kukhona ukukhetha. Amasiko aphilayo afana nanoma iyiphi into yomuntu ehlobene nesikhathi sokwakha ubukhosi bamazwe omhlaba kanye nabakhi benhlangano engayiyo. Kuyisakhiwo futhi kuhlala kuyisakhiwo solwazi oluphilayo lwemiphakathi ehlukene ezimweni zomlando ezithile. Lolu lwazi oluphilayo balunayo; indlela abaphatha ngayo ukuzalwa, ukukhula, ukuhlala, umshado, nokufa; indlela abakhumbula ngayo lezi zinyathelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu, indlela abaphatha ngayo ubumpofu nokushoda, indlela abakha ngayo umnotho wabo, nokuthi baphila kanjani nemiphakathi eminye kanye nemvelo yabo, indlela abachaza ngayo izindaba zabo, indlela abakhuluma futhi badansa, njll. Uhlobo lwamasiko aphilayo esinalo namuhla luyingxenye yamasiko avela ebantwini abavela ezikhathini ezingakhumbuleki. Amasiko aphilayo aqhamuka ezinkolelweni zomsindo, umlando owethulwe ngomsindo, imikhuba yokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi ezijwayelekile ezithuthukile futhi ziqhubekile noma zathathwa noma zengezwa ngezici ezintsha ngenxa yokuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene yomhlaba eyayihlukene ekuqaleni ngenxa yesikhala nesikhathi. Lokhu kuxhumana kuqhubekisela phambili ukuhlanganiswa kwezamasiko zomhlaba okuvele ngenxa yokuphuma kobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ukukhuphuka kokuhamba nokuvakasha, nokuncipha kwesikhala phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. INingizimu Afrika imele isithombe esiphelele senhlangano eyisithombe samazwe akhiwe phezu kwamasiko anothile futhi ahlukene - ngakho-ke umqondo weRainbow Nation. Ngakho-ke, kufanelekile ukuthi uhulumeni wakhe indawo yokwethula nokubonisa Amasiko Aphilayo ahlukene wezigaba zonke zabantu. Lokhu kufanele kwenzeke ngendlela esekela izimiso zenhlangano engahlukanisi ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, kanye nokukhubazeka, futhi ngendlela ehlanganisayo. Kufanele futhi kwenzeke ngaphakathi komqondo wokuzama ukuthuthukisa ukwabelana ngolwazi lwamasiko aphilayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ngoba kuyasiza ngalokhu ukwabelana nokwazisa okufanayo nokwehlukile kwamasiko angathinteki ukuthi sizofinyelela ekuxolelweni kwenhlangano, ekwakheni isizwe, nasekuhlanganiseni komphakathi. Kuzofundisa zonke izindawo ukwabelana ngolwazi ngendlela ethokozisayo, njengoba kuboniswe ngamasiko abo aphilayo. Lokhu kungathatha ifomu lokuqashelwa kokubili umehluko nokufana. Kuzoba kubalulekile ukufunda ukuthi lezi zamasiko ezihlangene zakha amasiko akhula ezivela ezizindeni ezahlukahlukene ezinekhono elihlukile laseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukuthi izinqubomgomo nemithetho esunguliwe kusukela ngo-1994 ikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa nokugcina amasiko abantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamasiko amaqembu onke emphakathini wethu. UMsunguli ophathelene nezobuciko, amasiko, kanye nezinsiza zamasiko kanye nemigomo yayo uthi iMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye neMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999) uqukethe ubufakazi bomqondo owakhiwe ukuze ufinyelele le njongo. Iminyango kahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezisekelwa umphakathi, kanye nabantu bakhe izakhiwo zokwenza kube lula ukugcina nokukhuthaza amasiko aphilayo. Nakuba lezi zikhumbuleka futhi zikhunjulwa, inqubo ehlanganisayo ephethwe nguhulumeni kanye nezinhlelo eziholwa umphakathi zidingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe uhlelo olubanzi oluhlanganisa imicabango yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo kumele luthinte ukuhlanganiswa kwezici zamasiko aphilayo futhi luqedeleke ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo nemithetho edingekayo ukuze kuvikelwe (njengesibonakaliso sokuhweba/nokufaneleka). Abameli/baphakanyisi bamasiko aphilayo abangakwazi noma abathola kunzima ukugcina ulwazi oluwusizo kumele baziwe futhi banikezwe ulwazi olufanele. Mphakathi ohloniphekile weSisonke District Municipality, uMphakathi J.P. Omunye wababhali abahloniphekile emhlabeni wakho uthe la mazwi: "izimo nokuthi umuntu ukhula kanjani kunomthelela esikhathini esizayo salo muntu." Umthethosisekelo wezwe lethu uveza kahle ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlala endaweni ephephile futhi enhlonipho. Leli lungelo lifaka wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nezingane, ngoba intsha iyisikhathi esizayo sezwe lethu. IBill of Rights nayo iveza kahle ukuthi akekho okufanele akwenze ukuhlukumezeka mayelana nosizo lokuthola izindlu. Simi lapha eKokstad namuhla ukuze sifinyelele lezi zinhloso ezishicilelwe emthethosisekelweni wezwe lethu. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sakhe ukuqala okusha ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi lezi zomphakathi ezisemathubeni aphansi, okuhlanganisa izingane nabesifazane. Simi lapha namuhla ekhaya lehope ukuze sinikeze ithemba futhi sakhe ikusasa elingcono ezinganeni zethu. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, siphila ngesikhathi lapho sibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Phakathi kwezinselelo esibhekene nazo kukhona ukususa ubumpofu nokwenza kube nokuphila kahle emiphakathini yethu. Kuyiqiniso elingaphikiswa ukuthi ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS lungesinye sezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nabantu bethu. Emakhaya ambalwa, izindlu zivalwe, zishiya izingane zibe yizintandane ngenxa yale mpilo. Kukhona emathunjini ethu njengomphakathi nakuhulumeni ukuvimbela le mpi ekubhubhiseni ikusasa lesizwe lethu, okuyizingane zethu. Umnyango wethu ukhona lapha namuhla ukuze ubeke itshe esisekelweni sokugcina ikusasa lethu ngokunakekela izingane ezibe yizintandane, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yale HIV/AIDS. Namuhla sizovula ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esikholwa ukuthi siyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekulweni nale mpilo. Lesi sakhiwo sizoba yindawo yokuphepha ezinganeni zethu ezinganawo umuntu ngenxa yale ntshontsho. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezihlinzeka ngezingane, njengale Ndlu Yokunethezeka, kuyindlela eyodwa uhulumeni akholelwa ukuthi angabhekana nayo inkinga yezingane ezibe yizintandane ukuze nazo zikhule ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele futhi zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu akusho ukuthi sikhuthaza izingane ukuba zifakwe ezindlini zentandane. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi izingane zethu ziphume emigwaqweni ngenkathi thina, njengomphakathi, sithanda ukungazikhathazi ngazo. Ubumfucu kanye nobhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS kunezimpempe ezimbi ezithinta izici zomphakathi nezomnotho. Lokhu kudala inani elikhulu labantu bomphakathi abangasekela ngokwabo. Uhulumeni onakekelayo, njengethu, ngeke uhlezi phansi ubheke indlela yokuthi isizukulwane sibhujiswe emigwaqweni. Njengohulumeni, sikholwa ukuthi isifundazwe sethu kufanele sibe yisifundazwe esinakekela kahle izingane. Sikholwa ukuthi akekho umntwana okufanele aye embhedeni engekho ukudla futhi akafanele aye esikoleni ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Sikholwa ukuthi amalungelo ezingane zethu kufanele ahlonishwe njengamalungelo omuntu wonke. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sivule ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esizoba yisibani sethemba ezinganeni zethu ezinganawo ikhaya ngenxa yobhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS. Kulesi sakhiwo, izingane zizothola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo ukuze zikhule kahle futhi zijabulele ubuntwana bazo. Ukukhula ngaphandle kwabazali akuyona into ejabulisayo neze, kodwa ngalezi zifiso, uhulumeni wethu uyanciphisa ubuhlungu obubhekene nezingane zethu ezilahlekelwe abazali bazo besencane. Njengohulumeni, sikhathazekile kakhulu nge-HIV/AIDS kanye nemiphumela yayo. Izinga lokwanda kwezintandane liyashaqisa. Inani lezindlu eziholwa izingane liyakhula. Njengomnyango wezokwakha, sithole umthetho wokubamba iqhaza ekunikezeni izindlu kulabo abathintekile kakhulu ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS. Umthethosisekelo wethu kanye neBill of Rights kube lula kithi ukuhlola imithetho ukuze usizo lwezindlu lufinyelele kulabo abathintekile kule mpilo. Kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esisanda kuziqala esifundazweni sethu. Ngikhuluma ngezinhlelo ezifanayo eHlabisa, eManguzi, naseThekwini. Inhloso yethu ukuqhubeka nalesi sikhathi, sigxile ezindaweni zethu ezisemathubeni aphansi njengemakhaya asendaweni ezisemaphandleni. Kulomsebenzi, sibambisene nezinye izigaba zohulumeni kuzo zonke izigaba. Sisebenza ngokubambisana eduze neMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Inhloso yomnyango wethu ukuthi maduze ngizobuyela eHlabisa naseManguzi ngohlelo oluphelele lokwakha ezingeni lezingane ezithintekile ngalesi sifo. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, ngalesi sikhathi esizokhombisa lapha namuhla, sizokuqinisekisa ukuphila kahle nokuhlonipha izingane zethu. Siyanihalalisela iMunicipality lapha eKokstad kanye nabaphathi beNdlu Yokunethezeka ngokuba phakathi kwabatholi balolu hlelo olusivumela ukuba sifake imali ekwakheni nasekukhuleni izinsiza ezifana nalezi. Kulesi sigaba, ngifuna ukubonga zonke izigaba ezisebenze kanzima ukuhlaziya imithetho yazo ukuze sikwazi ukubambisana. Ngivumele ngichaze kafushane izinyathelo ezisemqoka emthethweni wethu ezisilethele lapha namuhla. Okokuqala, samukela wonke umuntu njengomuntu onezizathu ezilinganayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isimo sabo sempilo kanye nesimo somnotho. Okwesibili, sihlole izidingo zabaphila nalesi sifo futhi sabeka imigomo ecacile yokwakha izindlu zabo ngokubambisana neMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Okwesithathu, sabuyela emuva ukuhlaziya ukuthi ngubani abatholi. Phambilini, sakhuluma ngama-families aphila ngaphansi komholo othile. Ukuze sakhe lezi zinsiza, saguqula umthetho ukuze kufakwe labo abangasebenzi kodwa bangazuza uma bekwi-sakhiwo esifanele. Bacela ukuthi umnyango wethu usize ngama-57 amabhentshi. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukuveza ukuthi umnyango wami uphumelele ukweseka ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo esingu-362 square meter. Izindlu ezakhiwe zinkulu ngesisindo. Zihlanganisa izindawo zokulala, izindlu zangasese, amahhovisi, indawo yokuwasha, kanye nendawo yokulinda abagulayo. Lesi sakhiwo sakhiwe ngendlela evumela izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo njengoba lesi sikhungo sikhula futhi inani labantu likhula. Ngithanda ukumema izinkampani ezizimele ukuba zibe nobambiswano nathi njengohulumeni ekunakekeleni nasekukhuleni impilo engcono yezingane zethu. Siyazi ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukunqoba ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS ngesikhathi esifushane, kodwa uma sihlala sithembekile, sinakekela, futhi sisebenza kanzima, ngosuku oluthile sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngithemba kulabo abathintekile ngale HIV/AIDS. Ngikhuthaza umphakathi wethu ukuba ubhekane nokwanda kwalolu sifo ngqo. Kuyadabukisa ukuva ukuthi naphezu kokwazi kabanzi ngalesi sifo, izibalo zak
UShakespeare uthe, "Ungabi ngumfundi noma umphakeli, ngoba ukwefa kuvame ukulahlekelwa yikho kanye nabangane." Lokhu kuyiqiniso. Nokho, uma ungumlimi okwamanje, uzobhekana nengcindezi yokwefa imali ukuze ungene ebhizinisini lokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani abalimi bedinga ukwefa imali? Nokho ungumnikazi wendawo noma wazi indlela yokulima ngenye indlela, khumbula ukuthi ukulima kuwubuhlakani futhi uzodinga imali ukuze uphumelele ebhizinisini lakho. Akukhathalekile ukuthi uthola kanjani indawo yokulima. Mhlawumbe uthola indawo ngokuhlelwa komhlaba, noma mhlawumbe uyithenga ngemali oyitholile kwenye indawo - kodwa uma ufuna ukulima, uzodinga imali. Umhlaba ubiza kakhulu, ngakho abantu bahlala becabanga ngezindlela zokwandisa imali ukuze bathenge umhlaba. Kodwa umhlaba ungowesigaba esisodwa sobuhlakani bokulima. Uma ulima ngezilwane, uzodinga ukuthenga izilwane (izinkomo noma izimvu, izinkukhu, izinkabi, noma izinkukhu). Uma ufuna ukukhiqiza okusanhlamvu noma imifino, uzodinga ukuthenga ama-traktor nemishini yokulima umhlaba. Akupheli lapho; uzodinga ukuthenga nezinye izinto ngaphambi kokuthi uqale uk planting (izimpande, umanyolo, amakhemikhali, idizili, njll.). Kungenzeka ukuthi inani lezi zindleko lidlula inani lokuthenga umhlaba. Yini esivumelwaneni sokwefa? Ukwefa imali kuwubuhlakani - kukhona umuntu onemali ofuna ukwandisa le mali. Kodwa bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngeke balahlekelwe le mali futhi kamuva bafuna ukwenza inzuzo engaphezulu kwalokho okwefayo. Abafuni ukuthatha izingozi. Lapho kukhona ingozi, bazokwandisa izinga lenzalo futhi uzokhokha inani eliphezulu ukuze ufele le mali ekuqaleni. Ngokuvamile, uma ufele imali, uzodinga ukuhlinzeka ngempahla njengempahla. Lokhu kuvikeleka kumphakeli ekulahlekelweni yimali yabo; bazothengisa lezi zimpahla uma ungakabuyisi imali yakho. Esikhathini esedlule, abantu bavame ukufela imali endaweni eyodwa, futhi uma behluleka ukukhokha le mali, babengeza kwenye indawo ukuze bakweze imali yokukhokha imali yokuqala. Abantu babephakanyiswa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nazo zonke izikweletu zabo. I-NCA (Umthetho Wokukhokha Kwamazwe) ishintshe lokhu. Abantu abaphakela imali kumuntu bayazi ukuthi uma bengakwazi ukukhokha, bazobanjwa. Manje sekukhona imininingwane ngazo zonke izikweletu zabantu; uma inhlangano ephakela imali ingakwazi ukuthola konke kumlimi, bangabona ukuthi umlimi unazo izikweletu ezingaki futhi bangase banqume ukuthi bangamphakeli le mali entsha. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bayakhathazeka uma bengakwazi ukuthola imali, kodwa uma ungakakwazi ukukhokha le mali, kuzobhalwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho liphumelele - bese kwenzeka izinto ezimbili ezimbi. Inhlangano ephakela imali izolahlekelwa le mali, futhi ngeke ukwazi ukufela imali futhi. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imali efelwayo kumele ibuyiswe - ufele imali, akusiyo nje isipho noma umnikelo. Kungani kunzima kubalimi abasha ukufela imali? Ikhono lakho lokukhokha imali kuxhomeke esimweni sezimali zakho nakusasa lakho. Umuntu ophakela imali kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uzokwazi ukukhokha le mali ngempela ekupheleni kwesikhathi esichaziwe. Uma sibheka uk planting izitshalo, sibona ukuthi uzodinga R5,000 ngehektare. Ngamanani wamanje (amanani eminyakeni edlule ayengaphansi kwe-R2,000 ngentoni), uzodinga ukuvuna ama-tonu angu-2.5 ngehektare ukuze ufinyelele izindleko. Khumbula ukuthi ngokuqhelekileyo ezindaweni eziningi, kuvunwa ngaphansi kwamatonu amabili ngehektare. Uma umlimi efuna ukufela imali ukuze abeke izitshalo, umphakeli uzobheka umkhiqizo ojwayelekile unyaka nonyaka, amanani azotholakala, kanye nezindleko zokubeka izitshalo. Ngakho-ke, okwamanje, akukhona abantu abavuma ukuphakela imali yokubeka izitshalo. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo akukwazisi. Umkhawulo wenzuzo ovela emalini oyifakayo uncane. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo kukhathazekile, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imisebenzi yokukhiqiza ukudla ivame ukuba ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Manje sekukhona ukuhlinzeka okweqile kokudla, amanani ehla, kodwa izindleko zokukhiqiza ziyaqhubeka nokwenyuka. Ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zokuphakela imali azisathandi ukuphakela ngoba umphakeli ngeke akwazi ukukhokhela umphakeli inzuzo eyanele. Ubuchwepheshe bomlimi. Uma uqala ibhizinisi elisha, awunalo ulwazi oluningi, ngakho uzokwenza amaphutha. Lokhu kuyiqiniso nakubalimii abasha - abakhombisanga ukuthi bangalima iminyaka eminingi. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukufela imali. Impahla yokwefa. Sishilo ukuthi umphakeli ufuna ukwazi ukuthi uma ungakabuyisi imali, bazokwazi ukuthengisa izimpahla zakho ukuze babuyise imali yabo. Ngokuvamile, umlimi ngeke akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokulima njengempahla (okujwayelekile ekulimaleni). Abalimi abaningi abawona abanikazi bezindawo zokulima (njengomhlaba womphakathi noma umhlaba uqashwe), noma umhlaba unebhondi eyinhloko esiza umlimi ukuthenga le ndawo. Uma umlimi engakakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempahla, umphakeli uzophika ukuphakela imali ngoba besaba ukulahlekelwa yimali yabo. Bangabalamini bamehluko ukuze bazame ukuthola imali yokubeka ngaphandle kwempahla? Imali edingekayo yokubeka ngokuvamile ifinyelela ku-R4,500 ngehektare (sithatha lokhu lapha njengomfanekiso). Uma umlimi efuna ukubeka amahektare angu-100, udinga ukufela R450,000. Lokhu kuyimali eningi. Ake sithi umlimi unama- fields amahle, anokuhlala okwaneleyo, umkhiqizo uvame ukuba muhle, futhi imakethe ivumela ukwenza inzuzo, khona-ke umlimi angaya eLand Bank, ezinkampanini zokulima, noma ezinkampanini zokubambisana ukuze athole imali yokubeka. Ake sithi umlimi ngeke akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokulima njengempahla, manje umlimi kufanele athole enye indlela yokuhlinzeka ngempahla. Lapha, ukuqinisekisa izitshalo kungase kube yindlela (ukuqinisekisa okokufaka). Le nqinisekiso ivikela "izenzakalo zikaNkulunkulu," hhayi ukulima okungafanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi kufanele alime kahle, akhombise ukuthi uvame ukuthola umkhiqizo omuhle unyaka nonyaka, bese engazama ukuthola le nqinisekiso. Inkampani ye-inshurensi izobheka inqubekela phambili yomhlaba ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi ingaphika ukuqhubeka ne-inshurensi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi - bahlola uhlobo nobukhulu bomhlabathi, bahlola amasampula omhlabathi, bahlola indlela yokubeka, uhlobo lwezimpande, umanyolo osebenzisiwe, ukuphathwa kwezifo nezitshalo - uma konke lokhu kungahambisani nezidingo zabo, inkampani izophika ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa. "Izenzakalo zikaNkulunkulu" ezihlinzekwa ngokuqinisekisa zingafaka ukushoda, umoya, imvula eningi, ifiriji, kanye nomlilo. Khumbula ukuthi ukuqinisekisa akuvikeli ukuphathwa okungafanele. Uma umkhiqizo wakho uphansi ngoba awulimi kahle, ngeke ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekisa. Uma uvunyelwe ukuthola ukuqinisekisa ok
Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Isidingo Esibalulekile Emphakathini Wethu Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo enhle, futhi anendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yabantu. Uma kungenawo amanzi ahlanzekile, umphakathi ubhekana nezinkinga eziningi ezifana nezifo ezithathelwanayo, ukungaphumeleli kokudla, nezinkinga zokuhlala. Izinhlaka zomhlaba jikelele ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile kubalulekile, njengoba lokhu kudinga umphakathi onempilo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezimiso Zamanzi Ahlanzekile Ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile kudinga izinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kweziteshi zokuhlanza amanzi nezinhlelo zokugcina. Izinhlelo zokuhlanza kufanele zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile avelayo avala izinkinga zokuphepha. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, udinga ukuxhaswa kwezimali, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Izenzo Zokugcina Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ngaphezu kokuhlanza, kubalulekile umphakathi uqonde indlela yokugcina amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kubandakanya imikhuba yokuphatha udoti, ukugwema ukungcola kwemithombo yamanzi, nokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Ukuqwashisa umphakathi ngalezi zindlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile agcinwa. Umthelela Wokungabi Nawe Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ukungabi nawa amanzi ahlanzekile kunomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Izifo ezithathelwanayo ezifana ne-cholera ne-typhoid zikhula emiphakathini engatholi amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zezempilo, ukwehla kwezimali, nezinkinga zokuthola ukudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi ophila ngaphandle kwamanzi ahlanzekile ubhekana nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuthuthukiswa. Izixazululo Zokuthola Amanzi Ahlanzekile Izixazululo zokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile zifaka phakathi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlanza ezisebenzayo, ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nokukhuthaza imikhuba yokugcina amanzi. Ukuze lezi zixazululo zisebenze, kubalulekile ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, uhulumeni, nomphakathi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola ukufinyelela kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Isiphetho Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenza ekutholeni nasekuhlanzeni amanzi. Ukuze sithole impilo engcono, kudingeka siqonde izindlela zokugcina amanzi ahlanzekile, sikhuthaze imikhuba emihle, futhi sisebenzise izixazululo ezithuthukisiwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, sithola ithuba lokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onokuthula. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuphatha amanzi ahlanzekile luzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nelinokuthula.
Izinga Lokufunda Kwamafundi Ukufunda kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zanamuhla lapho ulwazi lukhula ngokushesha. Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala lihlola izici eziningi ezithinta impumelelo yabo emkhakheni wezifundo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izici zomuntu siqu, izimo zokufunda, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuze siqonde kahle izinga lokufunda, kubalulekile ukuhlola lezi zici ngokujulile. Okokuqala, izici zomuntu siqu zidlala indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokufunda. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimfanelo ezifana nokuzimisela, ukuzikhandla, kanye nokuba nesithakazelo ezifundweni. Abafundi abanesithakazelo esikhulu ezifundweni zabo bavame ukufunda kahle, njengoba bejabuliswa yizifundo abazifundayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abafundi abangenalo leli thuba lokuzimisela bangase bahluleke ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokufunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi othisha nabazali bakhuthaze abafundi ukuba babe nesithakazelo ezifundweni zabo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola imiphumela emihle. Okwesibili, izimo zokufunda zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Izimo zokufunda zifaka phakathi indawo yokufunda, izinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nezindlela zokufundisa ezisetshenziswayo. Indawo yokufunda kufanele ibe nekhwalithi ephezulu, ihlanzekile, futhi inezinsiza ezifanele, ezifana nezincwadi, amakhompyutha, nezinsiza zokufundisa. Uma abafundi befunda endaweni enokuthula, bahlala begxile futhi bakwazi ukufunda kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindlela zokufundisa ezisebenzayo, ezifana nezifundo ezibandakanya abafundi, zikhuthaza ukufunda okuphumelelayo. Othisha kufanele basebenzise izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufundisa ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo ezahlukene zabafundi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza ezitholakalayo zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokufunda. Izinsiza ezifana nezincwadi, amavidiyo, nezinhlelo zokusebenza zedijithali zenza ukufunda kube lula futhi kujabulise. Abafundi abathola ukufinyelela kulezi zinsiza bavame ukuba nekhono eliphezulu lokufunda, njengoba lezi zinsiza zikhuthaza ukufunda okwakhiwe. Ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, nabazali kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokufunda. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi kudala isimo sokwethembana, okwenza abafundi bazizwe bekhululekile ukubuza imibuzo nokucaciselwa. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukufunda okuphumelelayo, njengoba abafundi bezwa ukuthi imizamo yabo iyabhekwa futhi iyavuma. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabazali nabafundi kubalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokufunda. Abazali kufanele babe neqhaza elikhulu ekukhuthazeni abafundi babo, futhi bahlale bexhumana nothisha ukuze baqonde kahle izidingo zabafundi. Ekugcineni, izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala lihlola izici eziningi ezithinta impumelelo yabo emkhakheni wezifundo. Izici zomuntu siqu, izimo zokufunda, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni lezi zinga. Ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokufunda, kubalulekile ukuthi othisha, abazali, kanye nomphakathi bahlanganyele ukuze bakhe isimo esikahle sokufunda. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impumelelo yabafundi, okuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokufunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokufunda kwabafundi, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezimpumelelweni ezinkulu empilweni yabo.
Bonke abasebenzisi bamanzi, abawatholi amanzi kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, uhulumeni bendawo, ibhodi yamanzi, ibhodi yokufafaza amanzi, uhlelo lukahulumeni lwamanzi, noma abanye abasebenzisi bamanzi abakhulu, kumele babhalise ukusetshenziswa kwabo kwamanzi kwiSikhungo Samanzi Nezinkuni. Ukukhishwa kwemfucumfucu noma amanzi angcolile aphambukisa imifula nemifula, noma aguqula ukuhamba kwemfula kanye nokungena emfuleni noma ezindaweni zokuhlangana kwemifula, noma ukubukeka kwemfula. Ukugcina amanzi - Noma ubani ogcina amanzi ngenjongo ethile, njengokwakha insimu ye-golf endaweni ethile, nezinye izenzo ezifanayo, kusuka endaweni yokubamba, amanzi aphansi, noma emthonjeni owahamba ngenani elingaphezu kwama-10,000 cubic meters, noma lapho amanzi esetshenziswa endaweni edlula ihektare elilodwa lokuba noma ukuhlala, noma inhlangano, umuthi noma imvume. Izenzo ezivimbela ukuhamba kwemifula - Noma iyiphi ukufafaza kwezihlahla ngenjongo yebhizinisi, kuhlanganisa nezihlahla zomphakathi ngenjongo yebhizinisi, ezenzeka ngaphambi konyaka ka-1972, kumele zibhaliswe. Abanikazi bezihlahla abanemvume eyakhishwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkuni, 1998, abadingi ukubhaliswa, njengoba sizobathumela imibhalo yokubhaliswa ephelele, ukuze baphinde baphendule uma kudingeka, b signing futhi bayibuyisele kwiSikhungo. Ukusetshenziswa nguhulumeni bendawo kanye nabasebenzisi abakhulu bezinhlaka zabo zamazwe, kanye nezenzo zokuhlanza. Izenzo ezilawulwayo ezifana nokufafaza ngamanzi angcolile, ukukhiqiza ugesi emanzini, ukuguqula umoya, noma ukukhokha nokubamba endaweni ethola amanzi. Ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuthile. Ukuxhumana nehhovisi lesifunda leSikhungo Samanzi Nezinkuni. Ulwazi lomfakisicelo, indawo lapho amanzi azosetshenziswa khona, ulwazi lomnikazi wendawo, isaziso kumfakisicelo, isaziso kumnikazi wendawo, ulwazi lapho isitatimende se-akhawunti kufanele sithunyelwe, ukuhlinzeka ngekhophi eqinisekisiwe yencwadi yakho yokuphatha, ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesivumelwano sokuhlala, ukuze uhambisane nazo zonke izimo ezidingekayo zezinsizakalo ezihlukene ezihlobene nesicelo. Ukubhaliswa kuzothatha inyanga eyodwa. Kubiza u-R114.00. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ezicelweni zemvume.
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okulungele Abasebenzisi Isingeniso Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi kubaluleke kakhulu emiphakathini yanamuhla. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabasebenzisi, zigqugquzele ukuxhumana, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Uhlelo oluhle lokwakha izikhungo lungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, kuqinisa ubudlelwano, futhi kukhuthaze impumelelo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izidingo Zabasebenzisi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zabasebenzisi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwenziwa kokuhlolwa kwezidingo, lapho uthola impendulo kubantu abahlala endaweni ethile. Qiniseka ukuthi ubheka izici ezahlukene ezithinta abasebenzisi, njengobudala, ubulili, nezifiso zabo. Ukucwaninga okucacile kuzokwenza kube lula ukudala isikhungo esihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukudala Umklamo Osebenzisanayo Ngemva kokucacisa izidingo, isinyathelo sokwakha umklamo osebenzisanayo siba sesibalulekile. Umklamo kufanele ube nokwaziswa okwakha izikhala ezikahle nezikhandlayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakheka kwezindawo zokuhlangana, izikhala zokuphumula, nezinsiza zokusebenza. Qiniseka ukuthi umklamo uqinisekisa ukuhamba kalula, ukusebenzisa izindawo, futhi udala umoya opholile. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlanganisa Izinsiza Ezilungile Ezikhungweni, izinsiza zibalulekile ekwakheni indawo enempilo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinto ezifana nezinsiza zokuxhumana, izinsiza zokusebenza, nezinsiza zokuphumula. Qiniseka ukuthi izinsiza ezikhethiwe zitholakala kalula, zisebenza kahle, futhi zigcina umkhiqizo. Futhi, bheka izindlela zokwenza isikhungo sibe nemvelo, njengokwakha izikhala ezineziqondiso ezilula nezilungele ukusetshenziswa. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubandakanya Abasebenzisi Emkhakheni Wokwakha Kunoma iyiphi inqubo yokwakha, kubalulekile ukubandakanya abasebenzisi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imihlangano, izinkulumo, noma imihlangano yokubuyekeza. Lokhu kuzokwenza abasebenzisi bazizwe bebalulekile, futhi kuzohlinzeka ngeminye imicabango engabamba kahle ekwakheni isikhungo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukulungisa izinkinga ezingase zivele, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi isikhungo sihlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhlola Nokuhlola Ngemva kokwakha, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukusebenza kwesikhungo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlola izinsiza, ukuphumela kwezakhiwo, kanye nokubuyekezwa kwabasebenzisi. Futhi, lokhu kusebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokubuyekeza futhi kulungiswe izinkinga ezitholakala. Ukubuyekezwa okuqhubekayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha isikhungo esihamba phambili, esingaguquki kumakholwa nezidingo zabasebenzisi. Isinyathelo 6: Ukukhuthaza Ukubambisana Nokuqhubeka Kokusimama Ukwakheka kwezikhungo akupheli lapho sekuphothuliwe. Kubalulekile ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isikhungo siqhubeka nokuhlangabezana nezidingo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinhlelo zokufunda, imihlangano yokuxoxisana, nezinkampani ezisebenzisana nezikhungo. Ukwakha umoya wokubambisana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezintsha nezindlela zokwakha. Isiphetho Ukwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi kubalulekile ekwakheni imiphakathi enempilo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha isikhungo esihlangabezana nezidingo zabasebenzisi, esigqugquzela impumelelo, futhi esikhuthaza ukuxhumana. Ukubandakanya abasebenzisi, ukuhlola ukusebenza, nokukhuthaza ukubambisana kuyizinto ezibalulekile ezisiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isikhungo sithuthukiswa ngempumelelo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha izikhungo ezizogcina zikhona, zisebenza, futhi zibe nezimpilo ezinhle ezizayo.
Iphasi lokushintshaniswa linganikezwa kumuntu ongaphandle ohlanganyela ohlelweni lokushintshaniswa emikhakheni yesiko, umnotho, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, okukhuthazwa noma kuphathwa yinhlangano yangaphandle noma umnyango wezokuphatha, noma inyuvesi ephakeme ngokuhambisana nomnyango wezokuphatha wangaphandle. Faka isicelo sephasi lokushintshaniswa ehhovisi lezakhamuzi laseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini eseduze. Qedela ifomu le-BI-1738. Thumela ipasipoti yakho kanye nesicelo. Nikeza incwadi evela enhlanganweni, inhlangano, noma emndenini lapho uhlela khona ukuba nengxenye ohlelweni eNingizimu Afrika, iqinisekisa isimo noma ukuhlala kwalolo hlelo lokushintshaniswa. Le ncwadi kumele ibe ubufakazi bokuthi uyafaneleka ukubhalisela noma ukuhlanganyela ohlelweni, futhi kufanele iphinde ikhombise ukuthi inhlangano, inhlangano, noma umndeni uzokwamukela ngesikhathi ukhoyo eNingizimu Afrika. Thola incwadi evela kumnyango wezokuphatha ofanele noma enhlanganweni esekelayo ezweni lakho, eqinisekisa isimo noma ukuhlala kohlelo lokushintshaniswa neNingizimu Afrika kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi wamukelwe ukubhalisela uhlelo. Isicelo sithatha izinsuku eziyi-30 ukuze processing.
Isingeniso IMicrosoft iyinkampani enkulu emhlabeni wonke, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezinqubo zayo zokwakha isoftware, imikhiqizo, nezinsizakalo ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe. Yasungulwa ngo-4 kuMfumfu 1975 nguBill Gates noPaul Allen, futhi ithole udumo olukhulu ngokwakha iWindows, okuyisoftware yokusebenzisa imishini yokusebenza esetshenziswa ezigidini zabantu emhlabeni. Lokhu kwenza iMicrosoft ibe yinkanyezi kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezinhlelo zokusebenza. Umgomo neMikhiqizo IMicrosoft inezinjongo ezihlukahlukene, kodwa umgomo wayo omkhulu uwukuphakamisa ukusebenza kwezobuchwepheshe emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kusebenza kubonakala ezinhlelweni zayo ezahlukene, ezifana neMicrosoft Office, iAzure, neXbox. IMicrosoft Office ihlanganisa izinhlelo ezinjenge-Word, Excel, ne-PowerPoint, ezisetshenziswa kakhulu emisebenzini, ezikoleni, nasezikhungweni. I-Azure, ngakolunye uhlangothi, iyinsiza yokugcina idatha, yokwenza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi, esiza izinkampani ukuba zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. I-Xbox ibonisa ubuchwepheshe bokudlala, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Izinguquko Zebhizinisi IMicrosoft ibonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emsebenzini wayo, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni edlule. Ngemva kokuphumelela kweWindows, inkampani yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi ezihlanganisa izidingo ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi ekusebenzeni kwe-inthanethi kanye nezinsizakalo ezivamile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudluliselwa kokwakhiwa kwe-software ukuze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene kumakhasimende. IMicrosoft ikwenze kahle lokhu ngokwandisa imikhiqizo yayo, nokuhlinzeka ngesoftware nezinqubo ezizokwenza ukuphila kwabantu kube lula. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Enye yezinto eziphawulekayo ezithuthukisiwe yiMicrosoft izinhlelo zayo zokufunda ngomshini, ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokucabanga komshini. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwe-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ezinsizweni zayo, okubandakanya ukukwazi kokuthi izinhlelo zisebenze ngenqubo yokufunda ezithombeni, ezwi, nezinto eziphilayo. Ukusungulwa kwe-AI kuMicrosoft kudale amathuba amaningi, okwenza kube lula ukuphathwa kolwazi, ekuboniseni izixazululo ezithile kumakhasimende. Ukwakha Izenzo IMicrosoft ibuye ibhekelele izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi, ngakolunye uhlangothi. Ilwela ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude nezisemadolobheni, ukuze bonke abantu bathole ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula kakhulu, futhi abantu abaningi badinga ukufundiswa ngendlela yokusebenzisa lezi zinsizakalo. Ukuphathwa Kwemikhiqizo IMicrosoft iphatha imikhiqizo yayo ngendlela ehloniphekileyo, ibheka izidingo zabathengi bayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokweseka, ezisiza abathengi bokugcina nabakhiqizi ukuba baqonde futhi basebenzise imikhiqizo yabo kahle. Lezi zinsizakalo zifaka ukufundiswa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezikhethekile ukuze kukhuthazwe ukusebenza kahle. Ukubheka Esikhathini Esizayo IMicrosoft ibheka phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zayo, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe obusha. Kulindeleke ukuthi izinkampani zisebenze ngokubambisana, zihlola izindlela zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuguqula izinqubo zokuphatha, ukuhlinzeka ngobuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili, nokwenza kube lula ukusebenza. Isiphetho Ngokujulile, iMicrosoft iyinkampani eyinhloko emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, esiza abantu abaningi, izinkampani, nezikhungo ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Ubulungiswa bokuphatha, ubuchwepheshe obuphelele, kanye nezinqubomgomo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kuveza ukuthi iMicrosoft izimisele kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ikusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kungenzeka ukuthi le nkampani izothola izixazululo eziphakeme, ezithinta kakhulu impilo yabantu, futhi iqhubeke nokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza emhlabeni. Izifundo ezitholakala kuMicrosoft zifaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi onobuchwepheshe obuphezulu, ogxile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bonke.
Ama-Drone - Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Obushintsha Umhlaba Isingeniso Ngokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone asebephenduke ithuluzi elibalulekile emikhakheni ehlukene, kusukela kwezokuthutha, ezolimo, kuze kube ezokuphepha. Lezi zindiza ezingenamuntu, ezaziwa nangokuthi ama-UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles), ziye zathandwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele. Kuleli sonto, sizobheka ukuthi ama-drone asebenza kanjani, izinzuzo zawo, kanye nemithetho ethinta ukusetshenziswa kwawo. Ukusebenza Kwamadrone Ama-drone asebenza ngokuqhubekayo, enza imisebenzi ehlukahlukene ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Zinezinhlobo ezahlukene, ezihlanganisa ama-drone amancane angasetshenziswa ngabantu ngabanye, kanye nama-drone amakhulu asetshenziswa ezinkampanini. Ama-drone anama-sensors ahlukahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuqoqa idatha, ukuthola izithombe, noma ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezithile. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ama-drone angakwazi ukuhamba ngokuzenzakalelayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela imisebenzi. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Ama-Drone Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa ama-drone ukuthi zinciphisa izindleko. Ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wezolimo, ama-drone angasetshenziswa ukuhlolela izitshalo, ahlole izimo zezulu, futhi anikeze izixazululo ezisheshayo zokulima. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi esidingekayo sokuhlola izindawo ezinkulu, futhi kunciphisa izindleko zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone asebenza kahle kakhulu ezindaweni ezinzima ukufinyelela. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezithintekile yizinhlekelele, lapho ama-drone angasiza ekutholeni abantu abalahlekile noma ekuhlinzekeni ngosizo lwezokwelapha. Ngamanye amazwi, ama-drone ayithuluzi elibalulekile lokuphendula ezinhlekeleleni. Izinhlelo Zokuphepha Nezokuhlola Ama-drone asebenza kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokuphepha. Izikhungo zokuphepha, izikhumulo zezindiza, kanye nezikhungo zokuhlola zisebenzisa ama-drone ukuze zihlola izindawo ezinkulu. Lokhu kusiza ekutholeni izingozi noma izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba zibe yingozi enkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasetshenziswa ekuqapheleni izindawo ezibucayi, njengemikhankaso yokuvota, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabavoti. Imithetho Nezikhala Zokusebenzisa Ama-Drone Noma ama-drone enza izinto eziningi ezinhle, kukhona imithetho ethile okufanele ilandelwe. Emhlabeni jikelele, izikhungo eziphethe izindiza zifaka imithetho yokusebenzisa ama-drone ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhamba phezulu, ukungahambi edolobheni ngaphandle kwemvume, kanye nokuhlola izindawo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi le mithetho ukuze bagweme izinkinga zomthetho. Emazweni amaningi, kunezikhala ezikhethekile zokusebenzisa ama-drone. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abanikazi bama-drone kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi bangawasebenzisa kuphi ama-drone abo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-drone awaphazamisi izindiza eziphethwe ngababheki bezindiza. Ikusasa Lama-Drone Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ama-drone azoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa. Izinkampani eziningi zisebenza ekuthuthukiseni ama-drone anokusebenza okuthuthukisiwe, okuhlanganisa ama-drone angakwazi ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezinzima, noma ama-drone anokuxhumana okuhle kakhulu. Lokhu kuzovumela ama-drone ukuba abe neqhaza elikhulu emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, kusukela kwezokuthutha, ezokuphepha, kuze kube ezokwelapha. Isiphetho Ama-drone asebephenduke ithuluzi elibalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, enza imisebenzi eminingi ebalulekile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kulindeleke ukuthi ama-drone azoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi imithetho ethinta ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuhlonipha imithetho. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kufanele siqaphele futhi sihlole izindlela zokusebenzisa ama-drone ngendlela efanele.
uElon Musk Umbuzo 1: Ubani uElon Musk? U-Elon Musk ungumholi ophambili kwezobuchwepheshe, umphakathi wezomnotho, kanye nomphakathi. Uzalwe ngoMfumfu 28, 1971, ePretoria, eNingizimu Afrika. Uyi-CEO yeTesla, Inc. neSpaceX, futhi uphakathi kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengokuhamba ngezithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi, izikhala zokuhamba, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyamthuthukisa uElon Musk? U-Elon Musk wakhula enothando lwezobuchwepheshe. Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yasePretoria, wathuthela eMelika, lapho aqhubeka khona nezifundo eStanford University. Nokho, wathola ithuba lokwenza umehluko emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Waqala izinkampani eziningi, kuhlanganise neZip2, PayPal, neX.com, okwaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinkampani ezinkulu eziholwa nguMusk? U-Elon Musk ungumholi weTesla, Inc., eyaziwa ngokwakha izithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi. Ubuye abe ngumqondisi weSpaceX, inkampani eyenza izikhala zokuhamba eziphakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubambe iqhaza kwiNeuralink, eyenzela ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezobuchwepheshe, kanye neThe Boring Company, ehlose ukwakha izindlela zokuhamba eziphumelelayo phansi komhlaba. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenza uMusk ahluke kwabanye? U-Elon Musk ubonakala enomqondo ophusile, onokubona phambili. Uhlale efuna izixazululo ezintsha ezinkingeni zomhlaba, njengokushintsha indlela esihamba ngayo, ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, nokwenza ukuhamba kwesikhala kube yinto ejwayelekile. Ubuye abe nesibindi sokuthatha izinqumo ezinzima, ezivame ukuhamba phambili nezingozi, okwenza kube nzima ukuziqhathanisa nabanye abaholi. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo uMusk abhekana nazo? Njengomholi, uMusk ubhekana nezinselelo eziningi. Ukuncintisana emakethe yezithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi, izindleko eziphezulu zokwakha izikhala, kanye nezinkinga zokuphatha izinkampani ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uthola ukugxekwa okuvela kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Nokho, uMusk uyaziqhenya ngokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, futhi uthanda ukufunda eziphuthumayo. Umbuzo 6: U-Elon Musk ubona kanjani ikusasa? U-Elon Musk ubona ikusasa elinokuthuthuka okukhulu kwezobuchwepheshe. Uthemba ukuthi izithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi zizoba yindlela ejwayelekile yokuhamba, futhi ubona umhlaba ophilayo, onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ubuye abe nezinhloso zokuhamba kwesikhala, efuna ukuthumela abantu emhlabeni wonke, kuhlanganise noMars. U-Musk ukhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ngalezi zinto, futhi ubakhuthaza ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. Umbuzo 7: Yini uMusk ayifundisile kwabanye? U-Elon Musk ufundisa abantu abaningi ukuthi ukucabanga ngaphandle kwemikhawulo kuyadingeka ukuze ufinyelele empumelelweni. Ubonisa ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga isibindi, ukuzimisela, nokusebenza kanzima. Ubuye akhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlale bephokophele phambili, bahlale befuna izixazululo ezintsha, futhi bangesabi ukuphumelela. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izifundo esingazithola kuMusk? Izifundo ezibalulekile esingazithola kuMusk zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuzimisela: U-Musk ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza kanzima nokuzinikela kuyadingeka ukuze ufinyelele imigomo. 2. Ukucabanga Okungajwayelekile: Ukucabanga ngaphandle kwemikhawulo kungaholela ezixazululweni ezintsha. 3. Ukubhekana Nezinselelo: U-Musk ufundisa ukuthi izinselelo zingaba yithuba lokukhula. 4. Ukubambisana: Ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza nabanye kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu. Umbuzo 9: U-Elon Musk uyathandwa noma uyagxekwa? U-Elon Musk ungumuntu ophawulekayo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni abathandwa kakhulu nabagxekwayo. Abanye abantu bamhlabela njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye baphikisa izinqumo zakhe nezindlela zokuphatha. Nokho, akekho ongenakuphikiswa ukuthi uMusk ungomunye wabantu abavelele kakhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Umbuzo 10: Yini ezayo ku-Elon Musk? U-Elon Musk uqhubeka nokusebenza ezinhlelweni ezinkulu, efuna ukwakha umhlaba ongcono. Uqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izithuthi ezisebenza ngogesi, izinhlelo zokuhamba kwesikhala, kanye nezixazululo ezithinta ubuchwepheshe. U-Musk ubonisa ukuthi ikusasa lisezandleni zethu, futhi ubakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphokophele phambili, bahlale bephokophele phambili, futhi bahlale bephokophele phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Elon Musk uzoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, futhi izifundo zakhe zizohlala zikhumbuleka. Ubonisa ukuthi ngekhono, isibindi, nokusebenza kanzima, konke kungenzeka.
Ukukhulisa Izingane: Izimiso Nezindlela Zokwakha Umphakathi Oqinile Ukukhulisa izingane kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kwezingane akukhathalekile kuphela, kodwa futhi kufaka phakathi ukwakha izimiso zokuziphatha, ukuhlonipha, nokuqonda umhlaba ozungezile. Ukuze kubekhona impumelelo ngesikhathi sokukhulisa, kubalulekile ukuba abantu abadala babenolwazi olufanele, babe neziqu ezithile ezihlobene nezinkinga zokukhulisa izingane, futhi baqonde izidingo zezingane, okuhlanganisa nezemfundo, emotweni, nasempilweni yengqondo. Izimiso Zokukhulisa Izingane Ngaphambi kokuba sithathe izinyathelo zokukhulisa izingane, kubalulekile ukuqonda izimiso eziyisisekelo ezikhona. Lezi zimiso ziqukethe umoya wokuthandana, ukunakekela, nokwakha isisekelo esiqinile semfundo. Abazali banomsebenzi wokwakha isimo esiphumelela ukusiza izingane zikhule ziqinile, zikhululekile, futhi zinesibindi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abazali baqonde futhi bamukele izidingo ezihlukahlukene zezingane zabo, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokukhulisa ezihambisana nobudala nezinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Ukubaluleka Kokuxhumana Ukuxhumana kahle phakathi kwabazali nezingane kubalulekile empilweni yengqondo yengane. Ukuvula indlela yokukhuluma ngendlela efanele kuholela ekwakhiweni komoya ophilayo, lapho izingane zizizwa zikulungele ukwabelana ngezinkinga, imicabango, kanye nemizwa yazo. Izingane ezifundisiwe ukuba zikhulume ngazo idinga ukuba zibe namandla okwenza izinqumo eziphusile kanye neziqu zokuhlakanipha. Abazali kumele baphendule ngezinhloso ezinhle, bahlale bezinikezela ukwazisa nokuqonda nokuzwakalisa ukunaka okukhulu. Izemfundo Nezindlela Zokufundisa Izemfundo iyinsika esemqoka ekukhuliseni izingane. Abazali badinga ukwakha umqondo wokufunda, okungabandakanya ukufaka isandla emfundweni yezenhlalo, ukufunda izincwadi, nokuqonda cwe oluvela ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuvula amathuba amaningi okuhweba ngolwazi olwakhelwe phezu kwemfundiso, olungaphezulu kokufunda kwezincwadi, kunikeza nokuqonda kokuhlalisana komphakathi. Umqondo wokufunda kufanele ubuye ugxile ekwakheni ezinye izinqubo ezithokozisayo, okufaka phakathi imidlalo, izifundo ezenzakalayo, nezinhlelo eziyindida, okwenza ukufunda kube mnandi. Ukwakha Izimiso Zokuziphatha Nokuhlonipha Okwengeziwe, kubalulekile ukusiza izingane zikhule zisendaweni efanele yokuziphatha. Abazali kumele babe nezimiso ezicacile, ezihloniphekile, ezizothuthukisa ukuhlonipha kokuziphatha, okuyisisekelo sabantu abangamaqhawe. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kokuthi izenzo zinomthelela kumphakathi jikelele, kubalulekile ekwakheni umqondo wokuthi umhlaba uhamba njengenhlangano eyodwa, kwazulu umphakathi uthola umphumela omuhle lapho lezi zimiso zisetshenziswa. Izindlela Zokuxhasa Izingane Emigwaqweni Zokukhula Ukuxhaswa kwezokuthuthuka kungenye indlela ezokhusela izingane. Abazali kanye nemiphakathi bangathola izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezithuthukisa izifiso zamakhosikazi, ukwakhiwa kwemiphakathi eqinile, kanye nezinsiza ezivulelekileyo. Ukukhuthaza imithombo yamandla kubalulekile empilweni yezenhlalo. Izinhlelo ezibandakanya amakhono, ubuciko, nesigaba somphakathi, zikhuthaza ubuhlakani ngangokunokwenzeka. Ngale ndlela, abafundi bayakwazi ukuzuza izizathu eziyisisekelo ezizobathuthukisa. Ukuhlaziya Nezimo Zokukhathalela Izingane Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuhlola izimo zokukhathalela izingane. Abazali kufanele baqaphele ukuphazamiseka okungase kube khona empilweni yezingane zabo. Noma kunjalo, ukufaka izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukuphatha imiyalo, nokwakhiwa kwezindawo zokugcina izinto kuyasiza ekwakheni umoya omuhle wokukhulisa. Ngokuvumelanisa izidingo zezingane nezizathu ezingabonakali, abazali bangathuthukisa isimo sokukhula sezingane, benza ngcono indlela yokuphila. Isiphelo Ukukhulisa izingane kumele kube yinqubo ehlelekile, enesizotha, futhi enobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma, izinhlelo zokufunda ezikhuthazayo, kanye nezimiso ezifanele zokuziphatha, abazali bangasiza izingane zikhule, zifunde, futhi zibe abantu abazophila kahle. Lezi zinyathelo zidinga ukuzinikela okuqinile kwabazali, komunomphakathi, njengoba sizithola indawo ebalulekile ekukhuleni kwezingane zethu. Umphakathi onempilo uqala ezandleni zabazali, ngakho-ke, kumele siqhubeke sikhuthaza izindlela ezinhle zokukhulisa izingane.
Izinsizakalo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngemva Kwezikhathi Zamahloli Isingeniso Ngenkathi zamaholide, abantu bavame ukuhamba, bejabulela izikhathi zokuphumula, kanye nezinsuku ezikhethekile zokuhlangana nomndeni nabangani. Nokho, lokhu kuhambo nokujabula kuza nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokunakekelwa kwabantu. Kulesi sikhathi, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo ziba nomthelela omkhulu ekuphathweni kwezimo ezingalindelekile, okuhlanganisa izigameko zokwelashwa, ukuhambisa abantu ezindaweni eziphuthumayo, kanye nemisebenzi yokuvikela. Izinsizakalo Zokwelashwa Ngokujwayelekile, izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zibandakanya izikhungo zokwelashwa eziphezulu, ezihlinzeka ngempumelelo ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze zifeze izidingo zabantu ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Emazweni amaningi, izikhungo zokwelapha zihlala zifinyeleleka, futhi abezempilo bahlala bekulungele ukusiza, kungakhathalekile ukuthi umphakathi usendaweni yokuphumula noma ehamba. Ngokwengxenye, izikhungo zempilo zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlangano ezimaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ezindaweni ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuhlinzeka izivakashi ngendawo yokwelashwa elula uma izimo ziphuthuma. Ubuye ubone ukuthi izinsizakalo zokwelashwa zenzeka ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bakhona lapho kufanele. Ukwenza Imisebenzi Yokuhamba Ezinsukwini zamaholide, ukuhamba kubaluleke kakhulu. Izinsizakalo zokuhamba, ezifana nezokuthutha, zikhonza njengezinto ezisemqoka ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Uhlelo lokuhamba luhlala luthuthukiswa ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ngezikhathi zamaholide, izimo eziphuthumayo zingase zenzeke, njengokuphazamiseka kokuhamba noma izingozi ezithinta abantu. Izinsizakalo zokuhamba zisebenzisa izimoto ezikhethekile, okuhlanganisa izithuthi ezithutha abantu abanezimo eziphuthumayo ezidinga ukunakekelwa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baye ezikhungweni zokwelapha noma ezingxenyeni zokwelapha ngempumelelo. Ukwengeza, abantu bahlala bezazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuhamba zikhona, okuyinto edala ukuthula kwengqondo. Ukubambisana Kwezikhulu Zomphakathi Ngokweqile, ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhulu zomphakathi, izikhungo zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuthutha kubalulekile. Lokhu kubambisana kuhlanganyela izinsiza ezifanele, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola usizo olusheshayo. Izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zidinga ukuhlela kahle izinsizakalo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhona ezindaweni ezidinga kakhulu. Izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zingathuthukiswa ngokuhlanganyela, kuthuthukiswe izinqubo zokuphendula ngokushesha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izigameko eziphuthumayo ziphathwa kahle, futhi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Ukubambisana okuhle kuholela ekuphumeleleni kwezinsizakalo, okuthuthukisa izinga lokuphepha emphakathini. Ukuqwashisa Komphakathi Ngokuphumelelayo, ukukhuthaza ukuqwashisa komphakathi ngalezi zinsizakalo kubalulekile. Imiphakathi kufanele iqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo zitholakala, futhi zihlala zikhona uma kudingeka. Izinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi zingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinsizakalo ezikhona, nezindlela zokufinyelela kuzo. Ukukhuthaza ukuqwashisa kumayelana nokuhlanganyela nabezimpilo, izikhungo zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuthutha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela izinsizakalo, futhi baqonde izinyathelo okufanele zithathwe uma behlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuqwashisa komphakathi kuzohlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphepha, nokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi. Isiphetho Ngokuhlonipha izinsizakalo zezimo eziphuthumayo, ukwaziwa kwemisebenzi ethile kubaluleke kakhulu. Njengoba izikhathi zamaholide ziwusuku lokuphumula, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe neziqu eziphuthumayo ezitholakalayo. Ukwaziswa ngobuchwepheshe nokuqwashisa komphakathi kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinsizakalo zibe ngcono, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka ukuthi sikhuthaze ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izinsizakalo zokwelashwa, kanye nezokuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala zikhona, ngakho-ke, abantu bazothola usizo oludingekayo.
Amabhange: Ukuhlola Umsebenzi Wawo Nezinguquko Eziqhubekayo Amabhange, njengemithombo ebalulekile yezomnotho, adlala indima enkulu empilweni yomphakathi. Njengoba sithuthuka emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, amabhange nawo abhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu, ezithinta indlela esisebenzisa ngayo izinsiza zabo. Kulesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi amabhange asebenza kanjani, izinzuzo ezihambisana nawo, kanye nezinkinga ezithinta abathengi. Umsebenzi Wamabhange Amabhange anomsebenzi obalulekile wokugcina imali, ukuhweba, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezezimali. Ngaphandle kokugcina imali, amabhange ahlinzeka ngama-akhawunti, izikweletu, nezinsizakalo zokutshala imali. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuphatha kahle izimali zabo, futhi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuboleka, amabhange akwazi ukusiza amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi ukuthi akhule. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu. Ngakho-ke, amabhange awagcini nje ngokuba izikhungo zezimali, kodwa futhi abe yizikhungo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, amabhange abhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe, njenge-inthanethi nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zamabhange. Namuhla, abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela ama-akhawunti abo, ukwenza ukudluliswa kwemali, nokuphatha izimali zabo kalula, konke lokhu kungenziwa ngefoni yabo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zamabhange zenza kube lula ukuhweba, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe izimali zabo ngokwakho. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa kwezomnotho, njengoba abantu beqonda kangcono izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Nokho, lezi zinguquko zibuye zibe nezinselelo, njengoba kudingeka ukuthi amabhange aqinisekise ukuphepha kwedatha yomsebenzisi. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Amabhange Ukusebenzisa amabhange kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, amabhange ahlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha kwemali. Uma umuntu egcina imali yakhe ebhange, ubeka imali yakhe endaweni ephephile, engakhathazeki ngokulahlekelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezimweni ezinzima, lapho umuntu angase abhekane nezinkinga zezimali. Okwesibili, amabhange ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezahlukahlukene ezithuthukisa ukuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikweletu ezitholakalayo, ezivumela abantu ukuba bathenge izinto ezinkulu, njengezindlu nezimoto. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange anikeza amathuba okutshala imali, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bakhe impesheni yabo. Izinkinga Eziqhubekayo Noma amabhange enezinzuzo eziningi, kukhona nezinkinga ezithinta abathengi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yikhono lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zamabhange. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethuthukayo, abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezithiyo ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, njengoba abantu besala emuva ekutholeni izinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Enye inkinga ibangelwa ukungaqondi kahle izinsizakalo zamabhange. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zisebenza kanjani, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphathe izimali zabo ngendlela engafanele. Ukuze amabhange akwazi ukusiza abantu, kubalulekile ukuthi ahlinzeke ngokuqwashisa okwengeziwe, ukuze abantu baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Isiphetho Amabhange adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisa umnotho. Nokho, izinguquko zobuchwepheshe kanye nezinkinga ezithinta ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zidinga ukuthi amabhange abheke phambili, aqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezidingekayo. Ukuze amabhange aqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi bazi kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi amabhange aqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa okuhle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umnotho oqinile, ophumelelayo, nolwazi olunembile.
I-Bio-ethanol - kwenzekani mayelana nezombusazwe? Uma ufunda amaphephandaba, uzokwazi ukuthi kukhona ingxoxo enkulu mayelana nomthetho ozophatha ama-biofuels. Uzokwazi futhi ukuthi abalimi abaningi abakhiqiza ufulawa bahlupheka ngoba bacindezelwa ukuba bakhiqize ukudla okudingekayo, futhi manje baphakanyiswa ukuthi baphinde bakhiqize ufulawa ukuze bakhiqize uphethiloli noshukela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona ochwepheshe abahola phambili abathi inqubo yokwenza i-ethanol izosiza ekukhiqizeni ukudla esikhathini esizayo. Abalimi abakhiqiza ufulawa bahlupheka ngoba imakethe yefulawa iyashintsha kakhulu, ikhuphuka kakhulu bese yehlisa kakhulu, okuhambisana nokuba khona kokuvuna okukhulu noma okuncane. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, kube nokuvuna okukhulu kakhulu kwefulawa, kodwa intengo yemakethe yehlile kakhulu - ngaleyo ndlela abalimi bahlupheka ekutholeni ezinye izindlela zokuthengisa ufulawa wabo. UWessel Lemmer, umnotho ophakeme e-Grain SA, uthe iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza ama-toni ayizigidi eziyi-8.6 zefulawa ngonyaka, kodwa inekhono lokukhiqiza ama-toni ayizigidi eziyi-12. Ngaphezu kwezigidi eziyodwa zehektare ezingasetshenziswa zilahlekile ngenxa yezintengo eziphansi zemakethe eminyakeni eyishumi edlule. Abalimi bahlupheka ukubhekana nezindleko ezikhulayo zokulima, futhi abazi ukuthi bangathola malini isidingo semakethe njengoba sishintsha. Konke lokhu kuholele abalimi ukuba baqale ukungabaza ukuthi ukukhiqiza ufulawa kuzobabazisa inzuzo ethembekile. Ngamazwi akhe: "Uma sinesikhala semakethe sema-toni amathathu ayizigidi, sithokozisa kakhulu ukukhula komnotho kuleli." Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma kukhona imakethe yalolu hlelo, izosiza ukukhula komnotho ezweni lethu ngendlela emangalisayo. Nokho, kukhona abanye abanezinkinga ngoba bakholelwa ukuthi uma ufulawa usetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amandla, kuzokwenyusa imakethe yefulawa ngendlela ezokwenza kube nzima kubantu ezweni elithembela kufulawa ukukwazi ukuthola ukudla. NgoJulayi 2007, uNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, uMosibudi Mangena, uthe iziphathimandla seziqale ukungabaza ukuthi ukusebenzisa ufulawa ukukhiqiza amandla akuwona umqondo omuhle. Baphakamisa le mibuzo elandelayo: Kuzokwenzekani ekukhiqizeni ukudla kwabantu uma sikhulisa i-ethanol kusukela kukashukela nofulawa ekugcineni? NgoAgasti 2007, umongameli webhange elikhulu laseNingizimu Afrika, uTito Mboweni, waphakamisa ukuthi ukukhiqiza i-ethanol kukhulu kakhulu emhlabeni, kukhuphule izindleko zokudla. Watshela uhulumeni ukuthi uyakuqonda ukuthi ama-biofuels adingeka ukukhiqizwa, kodwa ukhathazekile ukuthi ukusebenzisa ufulawa ukwenza i-ethanol kuzoba iphutha - ukholelwa ukuthi ukusebenzisa ushukela (i-cane) kuyindlela engcono. I-Grain SA, kanye ne-Agribusiness Chamber, i-National Agricultural Marketing Council, kanye nabaholi be-SA Biofuels Association (SABA) bahlangana noNkk. Mboweni ukuze banikeze umbiko ophawula izinzuzo ezingenzeka zokusebenzisa ufulawa ukukhiqiza i-ethanol kanye nosizo olungatholakala ekukhiqizeni ufulawa, phakathi kwezinye izinto. U-Andrew Makenete, umongameli we-SABA, ukholelwa ukuthi inqubo yokukhiqiza ama-biofuels ivula amathuba emisebenzi amasha ngezizathu ezahlukahlukene. Izosiza ukukhiqiza imali ezindaweni zasemaphandleni futhi umsebenzi wezolimo odingekayo uzothuthukiswa kulezo zindawo, usiza abalimi abasha ezweni lethu. I-SABA ifuna iNingizimu Afrika igxile ekukhiqizeni izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ezifana nofulawa, ushukela, i-sugar beet, i-sorghum, nezinye ukuze kwenziwe ama-biofuels futhi kukhiqizwe ukudla. Omunye ophakamisa ukuhweba kwefulawa-ku-ethanol nguKobus Lindeque, i-MD ye-Monsanto yeSub-Saharan Africa. Ukholelwa ukuthi inqubo yokwenza i-ethanol kusukela kufulawa ibalulekile futhi izonikeza uhulumeni ithuba elihle lokunika abalimi abamnyama abasha ithuba lokubuyela emsebenzini wezolimo mayelana nenqubomgomo kahulumeni yokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokulima. Ngemva kwesikhathi eside, ngoDisemba 2007, uhulumeni wakhulula umbiko wabo nge-Biofuels Strategy. Okulandelayo yikho esikutholile kulowo mbiko. Sikubhala ngesiNgisi lapha, kodwa ekugcineni, sizozama ukuchaza lokho abakushilo ngamagama abo. Ukushintsha okukhulu kumkhankaso wombono wukwamukela ukugxila kwesikhashana (ukuhlola kweminyaka emihlanu) ukuze kufezwe izinga lokungena le-2% lama-biofuels ekunikezeni uphethiloli wesizwe, noma amalitha angama-400 million ngonyaka. Umgomo usuphendukile phansi kusuka kumgomo we-4.5% owawuphakanyisiwe ekuqaleni emibhalweni yombono. Lezi zitshalo ezilandelayo ziphakamisiwe ukuze kukhiqizwe ama-biofuels ezweni: ukuze i-bio-ethanol, ushukela noshukela beet, futhi ukuze i-biodiesel, i-sunflower, i-canola, kanye ne-soya beans. Ukuhlukana kwezinye izitshalo nezitshalo ezifana nofulawa ne-Jatropha kusekelwe ezinkathazweni zokuphepha kokudla. Ucwaningo olungeziwe lusemthethweni ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa kwalezi ezweni. "Inani labatshalizimali abangenakuphika libonise intshisekelo ekuthuthukiseni ama-biofuels. Abanye abadlali embonini yeshukela sebekhiqiza i-bio-ethanol emakethe yotshwala yokuphuza nokuthunyelwa phesheya futhi bathuthukisa amandla e-ethanol yokuphepha ezweni elizungezile. Abanye abalimi befulawa, ngokubambisana nabatshalizimali abazimele, baveze inhloso yabo yokwakha amafektri amaningi efulawa-ku-ethanol. Lokhu kuphumelele ngenxa yokungaqiniseki ngokuqondiswa kanye nezikhuthazo kanye nokukhuphuka okukhulu kwezintengo zefulawa zendawo nezomhlaba. Ukukhuphuka kwentengo yefulawa kwenzekile kakhulu ngenxa ye-USA, ekhiqiza cishe u-50% wamafulawa athengiswa emhlabeni, idlulisa u-25% wezithombo zayo ekukhiqizeni i-ethanol, kanye nokwehliswa kokwesekwa kokuthunyelwa kwezolimo. Ukukhuphuka kwentengo yefulawa emhlabeni kanye nokushoda kokudla okuyisisekelo eMexico, okwakuxhunywe ngqo nezimali ze-biofuels, kube nomthelela eNingizimu Afrika ukuze ikhiphe ukusetshenziswa kwefulawa ezinyathelweni zayo zokuqala zokuthuthukiswa kwama-biofuels." Ngamafuphi, uhulumeni uthe kukhona inkinga mayelana nenani lokudla kwabantu ezizokhishwa esikhathini esizayo uma ufulawa ungasebenzisi ukukhiqiza ama-biofuels ekuqaleni, kodwa izinhlelo zabo ezihambisana nezikhathi ezizayo zithi kufanele kube khona umkhiqizo we-2% we-biofuels ngo-2013. UNgqongqoshe uLulu Xingwana wamema i-Grain SA, i-Agri SA, ne-NAFU ukuze baxoxe. Ingxoxo yayihloselwe ukuchaza isinqumo sikahulumeni sokukhipha ufulawa ekukhiqizeni ama-biofuels. Watshela umhlangano ukuthi isinqumo sikahulumeni sihlose ukuvimbela isimo lapho kungabi khona ukud
Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika: Umhlahlandlela Wokukhula Nokuphumelela Isingeniso Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika iyingxenye ebalulekile yezenhlalo, lapho ibamba izikhundla ezibalulekile emiphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuba nomqondo ocacile wokuthi intsha ingazuza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zayo nakuzo zonke izici zomphakathi. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka ezizothuthukisa impilo nempumelelo yokuphila kwentsha. Isinyathelo 1: Ukufunda Nokukhula Ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuphumelela, kufanele iqale ngokuqonda ukuthi ukufunda kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubhalela Isikole: Intsha kufanele ibhalisele izikole noma izikhungo zemfundo ezihlinzeka ngemicimbi ehlukene yokufunda. Akukhona kuphela ukufunda izifundo ezisemthethweni, kodwa futhi nokuqonda ukuthi imfundo ifaka phakathi amakhono empilo. 2. Ukufuna Ulwazi Oluphakeme: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intsha kufanele ibone ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yayo ngesikhumbuzo, njengokuhamba ezikoleni eziphakeme, izifundo ezikhethekile noma imiphakathi yokufunda. 3. Ukwakha Izinhloso: Kubalulekile ukuthi intsha ibeke izinhloso ezicacile zokufunda. Izindlela zokwenza lokhu zifaka phakathi ukwenza izinhlelo zezenzo ezicacile zokufinyelela lezi zinhloso. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuthuthukisa Amakhono Ukukhula empilweni akuhambisani kuphela nemfundo, kodwa futhi nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Izifundo Zamakhono: Intsha ingabhalisela izifundo zamakhono ezehlukene, ezifana nezifundo zokusebenza ngezandla, ubuchwepheshe, noma izifundo zokuphatha. Lokhu kuzowasiza ekuthuthukiseni amathuba emisebenzi. 2. Ukwakha Izingxoxo: Kumqoka ukuthi intsha ihlanganyele ezingxoxweni ezingebanga kube izinkulumo zempilo, njengezinkulumo ezihlobene nomsebenzi, umnotho, noma ibhizinisi. 3. Ukuqhuba Imisebenzi Yezandla: Ukuzama imisebenzi yezenzo, njengo-okusiza emiphakathini, kuzokwakha ulwazi nolwazi lwezindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhokha Imibono Nancyakazayo Emphakathini wethu, intsha ibalulekile ekubumbeni ikusasa. Izinhlobo ezihlukene zezinhlaka zempilo, ezokuxhumana, nemfundo zidinga imibono emisha. Ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuveza imibono yayo: 1. Ukubamba Izingxoxo: Izinkulumo ezivulekile phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza, iziphathimandla, nezifiki ezisemphakathini kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba intsha ibonise izimvo zayo. 2. Imibono Yokwabelana: Intsha ingavula izinkundla zokuxhumana, ezikhamanga noma ezibukwayo ukuze ibonise imibono. Lokhu kuzovumela ukuthi ibonakale kanjani engqondweni yabantu abahlukene. 3. Ukwamukela Izimpendulo: Izinselelo zokuqonda ngezimvo ezahlukahlukene zibalulekile. Intsha kufanele ikwazi ukuzama ukwabelana ngemibono yayo futhi ithole izimpendulo ezivela kwabanye. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlala Nempilo Impilo iyasiza ekuthuthukisweni kokuphila kwezinhlaka zomphakathi. Ukuze intsha iphumelele, kufanele ifunde ukuzithiba: 1. Ukudla Okuhle: Kubalulekile ukufunda ngokudla okunempilo, nokuthi kudlichwa kanjani impilo. Izivakashi zempilo zidinga ukugqugquzela ubulungiswa bokudla. 2. Uhlelo Lokuzivocavoca: Ukuzivocavoca kuyindida ebalulekile yokuphila okunempilo. Intsha kufanele ibone ukuthi ukujolisa emisebenzini yokuzivocavoca kuzosiza ekugcina amandla. 3. Ukuphila Ngemoyeni Othokozisayo: Ukuze kube nempilo enhle yengqondo, intsha kufanele ifune izindlela zokuphila zenkolo, ezokuzijabulisa, nezokuhlala nabantu abasukela phezulu. Isinyathelo 5: Ukusebenzisana Emphakathini Ukubambana nezinye abantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ekusebenziseni amakhono akho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Izinhlelo Zebhizinisi: Intsha kufanele ibone izinkampani zendawo ezingabavumela ukuba babe neqhaza emkhakheni wezempilo. 2. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano: Ukwenza ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza, abaholi, nabanye abantu emiphakathini kuzokwakha indlela yokuthi intsha ibonise amandla ayo. 3. Ukubamba Izenzakalo: Ukuhlela nokubamba izenzakalo ezikhamanga, ezempilo, noma ezokufunda kuyindlela yokusebenza embonini. Isiphetho Intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo ezibekiwe, intsha ingakwazi ukufinyelela impumelelo, ukwakha ukuphila okungcono, futhi ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukuthola imfundo, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, ukwakha imibono, ukuhlala nempilo, nokusebenzisana kungaba nemiphumela emihle futhi kwenze impilo yentsha ibenokuphila okuphezulu. Njengoba siqhubekela phambili, kabili kubalulekile ukuthi intsha iqonde ukuthi inamandla okuzenzakalelayo nokuzithuthukisa.
Isivumelwano seKhartoum sika-1988 sathi: "Ngoba umuntu uyisisekelo sokuthuthuka konke, isimo somphakathi somuntu yiso kuphela esingalinganiswa ukuthuthuka. Ukuthuthukiswa kwalolo simo somphakathi sabantu kubalulekile kakhulu kulabo abampofu nabasengozini, abawumsebenzi omkhulu e-Afrika. Okwamabhulu nabesifazane base-Afrika bangabantu okufanele baqinisekise futhi bathuthukiswe yisiphi na uhlelo lokuthuthuka." Sekuphele iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili selokhu lesi sivumelwano sasiqinisekiswe ngabantu besilisa nabesifazane abathwele umthwalo wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, kodwa kuze kube manje umsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlonipha isithunzi sabantu ngokubaphelezela usizo lwezempilo awukaphelelanga. Mphakathi ophakeme, ngicela ngithumele umcabango kancane. Ngiyashoda ngamazwi okukhombisa ukubonga ngezwi elikhuthazayo nelisekelayo engilitholile kubalimi baleli zinga kanye nabantu abaningi esifundazweni sethu nakwezinye izindawo ngenkathi ngigcwele amafu amnyama. Ngonyaka odlule, umnqobi wami engimthandayo, engimsebenzelayo, washona engozini yemoto, kwalandela ubaba bami ezinyangeni ezimbalwa kamuva. Ukushona kwabo kuthathe uthando nokwesekwa okwakuyisisekelo sempilo yami. NgoJanuwari walonyaka, indodana yami uMonde washona engalindelekile. Ukushona kwakhe kwangithinta kakhulu. UMonde wayengowafunwa yizwe lethu, isizukulwane esisha sabaholi abazosisiza kulonyaka nakweminye iminyaka ezayo. Ukusekela kwenu nokukhuthaza kwenu kwangisiza ngaleso sikhathi esinzima. Angazi ukuthi ngabe ngingubani ngaphandle kwenu. Niyakhumbuza sonke ukuthi noma ngabe imizuzu ikhululekile ezimpilweni zethu, niyohlale nikhona ukusisekela, okuyinto esenza sikhumbule ubuntu. Ngiyabonga nonke kakhulu. Mphakathi ophakeme, madoda namakhosikazi, ngicela ngithumele le nkulumo egameni labantu abathathu engibasebenzelayo. Ngifisa futhi ukuthumela le nkulumo egameni labasebenzi bonke bezempilo abashiya kithi ngonyaka odlule nalo nyaka kuze kube namuhla. Ngifuna ukuthatha leli thuba ukuletha izinhlelo zami zokudabuka emindenini nasemnganweni abashiywe. Njengomnyango, kuyasijabulisa kakhulu ukusala kwabasebenzi, ikakhulukazi ngoba sidinga ithimba eliqinile ukuze silwe nezifo nobuphofu. Ngomhla ziyi-7 kuMbasa, sakhumbula Usuku Lomhlaba lweZempilo. Isihloko salonyaka sithi "Sisebenzisana ukuze sithuthukise impilo." Ngalesi sikhathi, sahlonipha iminikelo yabasebenzi bezempilo, futhi saphinde sakhumbula izinselelo ezibhekene nabasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Lo msebenzi ungumsebenzi odinga abantu abaningi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinhlelo, hhayi nje zokuhola abasebenzi, kodwa nokugcina labo basebenzi bejabule, bethuthukiswa, futhi besekelwa emsebenzini wabo. Kulo nyaka sizokwandisa uhlelo lwethu lokunakekela impilo yabasebenzi siqala ngezinhlelo ezizokwenza ukuthi abasebenzi bomnyango wethu baqhubeke befunda njalo ukuze lo mnyango ube yindawo yokufunda okuqhubekayo nokuthuthukiswa. Njengengxenye yohlelo olwaqala ngonyaka odlule lokuhlela kabusha umnyango wethu, ekuqaleni konyaka, kwanikezwa ithimba labaphathi abaphezulu eliholwa nguDkt. Busi Nyembezi, elathatha esikhundleni sikaProfesa Green-Thompson, owahola lo mnyango iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili. Sifuna ukubonga uProfesa Green-Thompson ngendima ayidlalile ekuletheni usizo lwezempilo esifundazweni sethu. Simfisela kahle endimeni yakhe entsha njengomeluleki kuNgqongqoshe weZempilo kazwelonke. Ithimba elisha labaphathi lizosebenza phezu kwesisekelo esisunguliwe ukuze liphakamise umsebenzi wezempilo ezingeni eliphezulu ngokulwa nezifo, ukulwa nobuphofu, nokunikeza ithemba kubantu.
