Kulo nyaka sizokwakha uhlelo lokuguqula izinsizakalo zezempilo, iHealth Service Transformation Plan, esizosebenza kuyo kuze kube unyaka ka-2014. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zezempilo zifinyelela ngokulinganayo ezindaweni ezahlukene nasemaphandleni. Ngalesi sikhathi, usizo lwezempilo kumele luhambisane nezidingo zabantu, lube nekhwalithi ephezulu, futhi lube nezindleko eziphusile. Lolu hlelo kumele luphinde luhlolisise udaba lokushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo ngohlelo lwabasebenzi bezempilo lwamazwe olwenziwe ngokusemthethweni ngosuku lweZempilo Lomhlaba. Lolu hlelo lubalulekile kakhulu ngoba ukushoda kwabasebenzi kuvimba ukufezekisa izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kweMillennium nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu ezingeni eliphansi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lolu hlelo lwenziwa. Njengomnyango kulo nyaka, sizophinde sihlolisise izindlela ezintsha zokuhola, ukuthuthukisa, nokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Umbiko owaziwa ngokuthi iWealth Report 2006 ubonisa ukuthi isifunda saseMelika seHhovisi leMhlaba leZempilo, esinama-10% ezifo, sinama-37% abasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni futhi sisebenzisa ama-50% wonke uxhaso lwezempilo emhlabeni, ngenkathi isifunda sase-Afrika, esinama-24% ezifo, sinama-3% abasebenzi futhi sisebenzisa ama-1% uxhaso lwezempilo emhlabeni. Lo mbiko uqhubeka uthi ukuhamba kwabantu abaqeqeshiwe bezempilo abanezidingo eziphuthumayo kwenza i-Afrika ibe yindawo ethinteka kakhulu ukushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ukuze sifinyelele umgomo womnyango wethu - okuwukwethula uhlelo lwezempilo oluhlanganisiwe, oluhlangene nolwakhiwo olusebenzisa indlela yokunakekela impilo eyisisekelo kuzo zonke izifunda - sizosiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ngokuthenga ama-75 ama-clinic aphathekayo, sakhe ama-30 ama-clinic, kanye nezibhedlela ezintathu ezinkulu kulo nyaka wezezimali. Ukuze sithuthukise ukunakekelwa kwezeMpilo eyisisekelo, odokotela bezempilo bazophinde baqeqeshwe futhi bandiswe ukuze sikwazi ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo. Ukuphathwa kokunakekelwa kwezeMpilo eyisisekelo kuzobuyekezwa futhi kuqiniswe. Sizophinde sihlole izinqubomgomo zethu zokwabiwa kwabasebenzi abasha abaphumelele ezinhlelweni zokusebenza komphakathi, kanye nalabo abake bafunda ngaphansi kwezibonelelo zomnyango wethu. Sihlose ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa kulokhu kwabiwa nokuthi wonke umphakathi uthole inzuzo. Izibonelelo zethu zinikezwa kubafundi abampofu okwenza umehluko omkhulu, futhi sizoqhubeka ngalokhu. Mphakathi ophakeme, sizophinde sikhombise ukuzibophezela kwethu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bafinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ngokuqhubeka sithuthukisa uhlelo lwethu lokuhambisa iziguli, oluhambisa iziguli ukusuka ezibhedlela ziye kwezinye izikhungo noma ukusuka kuma-clinic ziye ezibhedlela. Ngonyaka ka-2004/2005, sahambisa iziguli eziyi-99
Izithombe zisitshela okuningi... Isithombe 1: Indawo yokufunda eMalekutu. Isithombe 2: Insimu eduze nendawo yokufunda eMalekutu. Isithombe 3: Indawo yokufunda eMbuzini. Isithombe 4: Ucwaningo lokukhombisa eMatibidi. Isithombe 5: Indawo ethile yomlando eduze nendawo yokufunda eMatibidi. Isithombe 6: Ezinye izindawo zomlando eduze nendawo yokufunda eMatibidi. Isithombe 7: uMnu. Jerry Mthombothi, umqondisi wezokuthuthukiswa wesifunda: eMpumalanga endaweni yokufunda eBronkhorstspruit. Isithombe 8: uMnu. Jerry Mthombothi (ngakwesobunxele) noMnu. Boy Mokoena (umlimi) endaweni yokufunda eBronkhorstspruit. Isithombe 9: Indawo yokufunda eDundonald. Isithombe 10: Indawo yokufunda eDundonald. Ingxenye yalokho esifuna ukukufeza kulolu hlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi, olusekelwa yiMaize Trust, wukuthi: sifuna ukuqhubeka nokutshala nokuphatha izindawo zemfundo ezithile. Isizathu salokhu wukukhombisa izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza nokusebenzisa lezi zindawo lapho kunamathuba abalimi minyaka yonke. Isithombe sokuqala sikhombisa indawo yokufunda eMalekutu, ethola u-30 km enyakatho-mpumalanga kweNaspoti. Isithombe sesibili sikhombisa insimu eduze nendawo yokufunda. Kukhona okuningi okungaxoxwa ngalezi zithombe ezimbili - kuhlanganisa nokuhlukahluka komkhiqizo kwalezi zinsimu ezimbili. Ukuphakama komhlabathi (pH): ukuphakama kukalwa endaweni yokufunda. Umanyolo osetshenzisiwe: amasampula omhlabathi athathwe futhi umanyolo nokuphakama kwawuhanjiswa ngokuhambisana nezivivinyo zamasampula - bheka ukwehluka kombala phakathi kwalezi zinsimu ezimbili. Izinhlobo zezimbewu: endaweni yokufunda, izimbewu ze-hybrid (ezihlukile kulolu hlobo) zatshalwa, kanti kwenye insimu, izimbewu zomkhiqizo wonyaka odlule zatshalwa. Inani lezitshalo nokuhlelwa phakathi kwezithombo: esithombeni, akukhombisi kahle ukuthi kuhamba kanjani ukuhlela phakathi kwezithombo endaweni yokufunda, kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi kwenye insimu, izitshalo zikhona kakhulu. Isithombe sesithathu sikhombisa insimu yokufunda eMbuzini, ethola u-150 km eningizimu-ntshonalanga kweNaspoti iya eSwatini. Le maize ibukeka kahle kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma sicabangela i-maize yabalimi abanye kule ndawo. Kubalulekile ukukhuluma kulezi zindawo ngezindaba ezihlobene nalezi ezilandelayo: ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi ukuze kuhlolwe, ukuphakama komhlabathi (pH), inani lezitshalo ngehektare, ukukhetha izinhlobo zezithombo, nokuphatha izitshalo eziphikisanayo nezifo. Izithombe 4, 5, no-6 zithathwe eMatibidi (enyakatho kweGraskop). Le ndawo isetshenziswa umphakathi wonke, ikakhulukazi abesifazane ngesandla (uJerry Mthombothi, umqondisi wezokuthuthukiswa wesifunda saseMpumalanga uthi cishe sekuphenduke umthwalo - ukuphathwa okungafanele - kwabantu besifazane). Isithombe sesine sikhombisa abantu ezinsimini bebamba izambulela ngesikhathi socwaningo lokukhombisa. Izithombe 5 no-6 zikhombisa izinsimu zabanye abantu. Uhlelo lwezokulima lweMpumalanga lulethe abalimi kule ndawo ama-tractors nezinye izinsiza, kodwa iningi lomsebenzi wenziwa ngesandla - kusekhona izinkinga eziningi mayelana nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uhlinzeka ngenzuzo. Kucace bha ukuthi ama-tractors nezinye izinsiza zingaqashwa, kodwa uma kuziwa ekuphatheni nasekugcineni lezo zinsiza, asazi ukuthi ubani ozobhekana nalolo work. Izithombe 7 no-8 zikhombisa uMnu. Jerry Mthombothi (ngakwesobunxele), umqondisi wezokuthuthukiswa wesifunda saseMpumalanga, noMnu. Boy Mokoena (umlimi) endaweni yokufunda eBronkhorstspruit. I-maize ibukeka kahle, kodwa imvula eningi iyenze yaba nzima ukuyilima ngezinsiza. UMnu. Mokoena ubeyingxenye yabalimi ababephikisana ukuba uMlimi Wonyaka ngo-2007 - lapho simbona ngoJuni 2007, wayecabanga ukunciphisa ukulima ngenxa yokushoda kwamanzi. Kodwa bheka lezi zithombe! Kulo nyaka utshale amahektare angama-400 e-maize! Kukhona abalimi abaningi kulezi zindawo abasaqhubeka nokulima ngokwezimali - inkinga enkulu ukuphatha izitshalo eziphikisanayo. Unyaka ozayo sizogxila ekutheni singasebenzisa kanjani amakhemikhali ukuze sibhubhise izitshalo eziphikisanayo ngempumelelo. Izithombe 9 no-10 zikhombisa ucwaningo eDundonald, empumalanga iya eSwatini uma uvela eBadplaas. Isithombe 9 sikhombisa ukuphathwa kwezinsimu okuhle - kucacile ukuthi yini ehlukile uma sibheka isithombe 10. Siphinda sithi izinkinga ezikhona kulezi zindawo (njengakwamanye amakhaya) zimi kanje: ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, isikhathi sokutshala, umanyolo, nokuphathwa kwezitshalo eziphikisanayo. Kulezi zindawo, abalimi bavame ukulima izinsimu ezincane ngoba zisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke. Sifuna ukusho "Hooray!" kuMnu. Jerry Mthombothi ngomsebenzi wakhe omuhle ekuqedeni izifundo zokukhombisa futhi silindele lokho abalimi abazokufunda phakathi nezinsuku ezizayo zabalimi ezizayo ezinyangeni ezizayo.
Umbiko: Ukusebenza Kwama-Ambulensi Isingeniso Ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi kubalulekile emiphakathini yethu, njengoba la ma-ambulensi edlala indima enkulu kwezokwelapha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni zokuphuthuma. Lezi zinsiza zenza kube nokwenzeka ukusiza abantu ababezidinga usizo ngokushesha. Kuleli mbiko, sizobheka indlela ama-ambulensi asebenza ngayo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwawo. Ukusebenza Kwama-Ambulensi Ama-ambulensi atholakala ezindaweni eziningi, njengezibhedlela, izikhungo zokwelapha, kanye nasemaphandleni. Abashayeli bama-ambulensi bahlala bexhumana nezinhlaka zezempilo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi imishado yokuphuthuma iyaphumelela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubika izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana neziguli. Ama-ambulensi ahlukaniswe ngamaqembu ahlukene, njengezokwelashwa okuphuthumayo, ama-ambulensi okuhamba ngemigqa, kanye nama-ambulensi okuthutha iziguli ezivela ezindaweni ezikude. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kusiza ekukhetheni isimo esifanele. Izinsiza Ezibekwe Emabhalweni Ama-ambulensi anemishini ethile enza kube nokwenzeka ukusiza ngemuva kokuhamba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinsiza zokuhlola, imishini yokuphila, kanye nezinto zokwelapha. Abaphathi bemishina bahlala beqeqesha izisebenzi ukuze bazise kahle lezi zinsiza, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo oluphuthumayo. Izinselelo Ezinzima Nokho, ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi kuhlangabezana nezithiyo eziningi. Izimo ezinzima, njengokungaphumeleli kwezithuthi, zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezidinga usizo. Ukuncipha kwemithombo yemali yezeMpilo kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwenani lama-ambulensi, okuthinta ukusebenza kwawo. Izimo zezulu ezinzima nazo zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempilo esheshayo. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukusebenza Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezilungiselelwe kahle. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kwabashayeli ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha izimo ezinzima. Futhi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza ekwandiseni ukuxhumana phakathi kwama-ambulensi nezikhungo zezempilo. Ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-ambulensi athola usizo oludingekayo, okwandisa amathuba okusebenza futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isiphetho Ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi kubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi izinselelo ezibhekene nazo zidinga ukuphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha, ukuhlinzeka ngamasu okuxhumana, kanye nokukhuthaza ukubambisana, singaqinisekisa ukuthi ama-ambulensi ahamba kahle futhi ahlinzeka ngempilo esheshayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kuzobhekelela ikusasa eliqhakazile lokusebenza kwama-ambulensi, okuholela ekutheni abantu bathole usizo lwezempilo oluphuthumayo ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukuqinisa ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi, ngaleyo ndlela sithuthukise izinga lokuphila komphakathi wethu. Sifanele sibe nesibopho sokwenza kahle, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza abanye uma bephakathi kwenkinga. Ukusebenza kwama-ambulensi akugcini nje ngokuba izinsiza ezisemqoka, kodwa kuyisixazululo esibalulekile empilweni yethu.
Imidlalo Yesikole: Ukukhula Ngezinyawo Zokuncintisana Ngaphambi kokuba sibhale amagama olwandle, akufanele sikhumbule izikole zethu, lezi zindawo lapho imiphefumulo yethu ikhula khona. Imidlalo yesikole iyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila, igcwele izinsuku ezinzima nezijabulisayo. Ngizokunikeza indaba yami, ngikhuluma ngezikhathi ezijabulisayo enganginazo, kanye nezikhathi ezinzima zalokhu okubizwa ngokuthi imidlalo yesikole. Kumina, lo mncintiswano wawungumumo wempilo. Saqala ngezinsuku zeMgqibelo, lapho abathandi bempilo yesisindo behlezi phezulu kagesi kancane, bejabulile. Umoya opholile wawuhamba ezinyaweni zethu, kube sengathi umhlaba ujabule ngathi. Uma kuthiwa imidlalo yesikole iphawula ukwedlula izinyanga zonyaka, kwakukhona umoya ophuma ezinkanyezi, uthinta izingane ezincane ezilindele leso sikhathi sokukhanya. Ngaphambi kokuba siqale, isigaba sokuqala sakhuluma ngempilo yethu esikoleni, uMsizi umphakathi, owawusiza imiphakathi ngenzondo yokuhamba. UMsizi kwakungumngane wami ophakathi nobungane. Sikhuluma ngezifiso zethu, kodwa izifiso zethu zaphuma. Thina njengabazali besikole sathokozisa sinqobile, njengoba waqonda ngempela imiqondo yethu. Izinsuku zokuzilolonga zazikhangayo. Njengoba sithokozisa, sasigijima kuphi lapho imidlalo yesikole iphethe abavakashi. Umoya opholile wokuncintisana wawwenza sibe nabantu abavulekile. Abazali bethu babekhumbula izinsuku ezinjalo, bejabulisa izinyathelo zethu. Njengoba umoya ushashalaziye, impilo yethu ibhujiswa izakhamuzi ezinkulu, zibhakabhaka izinyathelo zethu zibe namaqhawe. Kwafika nosuku lokugcina lomncintiswano. Umoya wawuwumhlophe, futhi sisebenzisana ukuze sihambise imijaho yethu, ikhanda lethu belikujahozile. Umsebenzi wethu wawuhambisana ne-Mathematics – izibalo ezikhuluma ngempela nezizimele. Abantu babefika bejabulile, bephunga iziphuzo ezishisayo, bejabulisa izwi labo. Ngemuva komjaho, amalangabi ebhasi eliphezulu alimene njengoba abavakashi bavele benza izinyawo. Umphakathi umhlinzekela indlela eyanelisa, umakhelwane eba umkhombandlela. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi nathi safika, sibona imiphumela ehlukene. Umqhudelwano wawuphumelela, nezimpumelelo zethu zazikhombisa! UMsizi waba uthando lwethu, ngokuchaza umphakathi, edinga injabulo. Sibafundele ayonakele emiqondweni yethu, kube yithuba lokubona ukudlondliza kokudlondlobala. Le midlalwandla yavesha okumele ibekwe ethaleni. Njengoba twalunywa, sizozama ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze sibe nekhono, ukuphila lobungcweti. Ikakhulu, uqhoqho lo mdlalo ungowokukhuluma. Imidlalo yesikole ikhubaza, ithokozisa, futhi ikhuthaza ekukholweni kwethu. Izifiso ezinqala zibhidla isizathu sefilimu esiyinto engokomoya. Uthando, ukufunda, nerme relationship kusebenza ukusebenzela emkhakheni. Abaculi baphumeza izifenqo, kwezinkanyezi zethu zabo bonke abavakashi. Inhloso yethu yabe isenhle, umgudlu wethemba, sigqoka futhi sithanda imidlalo yesikole. Lokho kwenzeka, kuhlobise izikhathi. Ngamafuphi, imidlalo yesikole iyingxenye ebalulekile yephupho lethu, isikhumbuzo sokukhula nempilo. Yikuphi lapho izinyathelo zethu ziya kuthola umhlaba wempilo, lapho sdizile yiphupho lothando! Ngakho, ngilandele ngezithombe ezikhumbulekayo, izinyathelo zempumelelo, ungidedele ngizokuhlola ezinkanyezi, thina abagibeli, njengamazwi ezithombe ezincane ezibonga umphakathi, sithi: “Kuyajabulisa!” Ngakho, imidlalo yesikole ibithi kumina, uhlelo lwemisebenzi eyayijabulisa impilo yami. Lokhu kukhula. Ngabe uMsizi uyakwenza? Ngabe siyasongela? Thina sikhumbula izinhliziyo zethu, imidlalo yesikole iyinkanyezi yempumelelo yethu, ibizwe njengokuguquguquka, ukukhula kwethu, nokukhanya kwezinkanyezi phakathi koMhlobo. Imidlalo yesikole ifaka udumo nesiyalo kumasu ethu. Asibambisani, sithokozise impilo!
Lena ucwaningo ejwayelekile mayelana nendlela isiko lokufundisa amalungelo abantu likhule ngayo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokusekelwe kumadokhumenti omhlaba wonke kanye nezivumelwano zendawo, umlando wamalungelo abantu uvela ezindaweni ezikude neziseduzane. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga eziphathelene nokufundisa okugcizelelwa yikhono lokuthi umqondo wamalungelo abantu uyinto eyamukelekayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, le ngxenye ihlose ukuhlaziya izivumelwano zomhlaba wonke, zendawo, nezwe. Ubulili obubhekene nabantu ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili baholele ekutheni iZizwe Ezihlangene zenze isinqumo sokuzibophezela ngokomphakathi ekuhlonipheni nasekuvikeleni amalungelo abantu. Lesi sinyathelo saqala ngo-1946 lapho iZizwe Ezihlangene zakha khona iSikhumbuzo Esivamile SamaLungelo Abantu. ENingizimu Afrika, njengelungu lesimo, yadlala indima ebalulekile kulolu sikhumbuzo ngoba uMongameli wezwe, uJan Smuts, ubhale lesi sikhumbuzo. Ezinye zezindatshana zalesi sikhumbuzo ziqinisa iZizwe Ezihlangene ukuthi "ikhuthaze ukuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kanye nezimfanelo eziyisisekelo kubo bonke ngaphandle kokukhetha ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ulimi, noma inkolo." Indatshana 56 ifuna wonke amazwe elungu ukuthi ahambisane nezivumelwano. Nokho, kwavela ukuthi ENingizimu Afrika kuqhubekile nokwephula amalungelo abantu. Nakuba iZizwe Ezihlangene iqhubeka igcizelela isinqumo sokuthi umqondo wabantu uhlose ukuvimbela ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, uhulumeni baseNingizimu Afrika waqhubeka nezinhlelo eziphula amalungelo abantu. Lo mbono ubekwe kuNdaba 2.7 yesikhumbuzo, evimbela iKhansela Lokuphepha ekungeneleleni "ezindabeni zangaphakathi" ezisetshenziswe kabi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zokwephula amalungelo abantu. Ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga eNingizimu Afrika kubonakala kuphikisana nezibopho zesikhumbuzo, ngakho ngo-1982, iZizwe Ezihlangene yanquma ukusola iNingizimu Afrika. Indatshana 2.7 yakha impi phakathi kwamalungelo abantu nezibopho ezilindelekile kumazwe elungu ngoba le ngxenye yaqhubeka ibeka ukuthi akukho okukhuluma ngalesi sikhumbuzo okuzovumela iZizwe Ezihlangene ukuba ingenelele ezindabeni ezibalulekile zangaphakathi ezweni elikwazi ukuzilawula noma ezizodinga amazwe elungu ukuba alethe izindaba zokuxoxwa ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo, futhi le ndlela ngeke ibangele ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza kwemishini yokulungisa nokuphumelelisa ngaphakathi, ngokwezinganekwane zeNgxenye VII. Naphezu kwezinkinga, lesi sikhumbuzo sidlale indima ebalulekile ekukhuthazeni nasekuhleleni amazinga nezimiso zamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Isibonelo salokhu yizikhungo eziningi ezasungulwa ngaphansi kokuphathwa kweZizwe Ezihlangene ukuze kuqedwe izibopho zesikhumbuzo. Lezi zifiso zafika ngendlela yezikhumbuzo noma imihlangano. Izikhumbuzo zemihlangano zawela emkhakheni obanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubuqotho bezivumelwano. Isikhumbuzo sokuqala samukelwa ngo-1948, esaziwa njengeSikhumbuzo Esivamile SamaLungelo Abantu. Lo mbhalo waqala wamukelwa yizizwe eziyi-48 ezinemibuso engama-56 ngoba eziyi-8 zazihlangene neNingizimu Afrika, eyayiphika. Nokho, lo mbhalo wamukelwa yizikhungo eziningi ngaphakathi kwamazwe nakwamanye amazwe. Ukubaluleka kwesikhumbuzo kubonisa ukusebenza okujulile kwesikhumbuzo seZizwe Ezihlangene. Le mbono iboniswa embikweni wezindaba owaziswa kakhulu otholakala ehhovisi leZindaba Zomthetho lapho kuthiwa, "mayelana nokubaluleka nokubaluleka kwesikhumbuzo, kungabhekwa njengesenzo esinomthelela ezikhungweni ezamukelayo, ngakho kukhona izinkomba eziqinile zokuthi amazwe elungu azokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, uma lokho okulindelekile kuholela ekwephuleni okwenziwe ngamaZwe, lesi sikhumbuzo singakhombisa isimo sokwakha nokuqinisa imithetho ebophelelayo kumazwe." Ukukhuthaza ubuqotho bamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele kumukelwa yiSivumelwano Somhlaba Ngamalungelo Okwakha Nezombusazwe kanye neSivumelwano Somhlaba Ngamalungelo Ezezimali, Ezenhlalo Nezamasiko ngenhloso ecacile yokuguqula isikhumbuzo esingabopheleli sibe izimiso zomthetho ezibophelelayo, lezi zivumelwano zibizwa ngokuthi "Amalungelo Abantu Emhlabeni Jikelele." Amalungelo Abantu Emhlabeni Jikelele aqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1962. Enye indlela yokuvikela amalungelo abantu yakhuthazwa ukwethulwa kwezivumelwano zendawo ezifana neSivumelwano SaseYurophu ngo-1950 esihloselwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu nezimfanelo zomuntu. ISivumelwano SaseYurophu saqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwamalungelo abantu eBophuthatswana kodwa lo mbono waphulwa nguhulumeni wangaphambili baseNingizimu Afrika owawenamandla okulawula ohulumeni bendawo. Engxoxweni edlule, kubonakala ukuthi isiko lamalungelo abantu kufanele likhule ngokulandela izinhlinzeko zeSikhumbuzo seZizwe Ezihlangene. Isibonelo; Indatshana 56 ithi amalungu abophekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokubambisana ndawonye nangokuhlukana nenhlangano mayelana nokufeza izinhloso ezibekwe nguNdaba 55. ENingizimu Afrika, ukuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kwavinjwa inqubo yokucindezela, ngakho iZizwe Ezihlangene yaqala ukuphumelela ekuzameni ukuvusa izinguquko kumgomo wokuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga kuze kube yathumela izijeziso ngo-1982. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isiko lamalungelo abantu langena e-Afrika lapho iNgqungquthela Yobumbano Lwase-Afrika yasungula iCharta Yase-Afrika ngo-1961. Nakuba inqubo ibihamba kancane ngonyaka we-20, ngaphakathi komkhakha wokuqala wokwamukela isivumelwano ngo-1981 njengeBanjul Charter, lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwamukela umkhankaso wamazwe ngamazwe wamazwe e-Afrika. Indawo eyaziwa kakhulu yesivumelwano bekungukwamukela "amalungelo abantu" njengophawu lokuzibophezela ekukhuthazeni umqondo wamazwe ngamazwe wamazwe. Lezi zibopho zigcizelelwa yisingeniso esikhombisa ukuzibophezela okwenziwe ngamalungu "ukuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu base-Afrika." Lezi zibopho zaba inselelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika ngoba ayikakabi nezibopho zokwamukela nokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Inkinga ibihlobene nokuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu anikezwa yiCharta Yase-Afrika nezimfanelo zomuntu ezifunwa yizivumelwano zamazwe. Ngakho-ke, kwavela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika idinga ukuhlela ukuvuma amalungelo abantu ngaphambi kokuba kuqale iCharta Yase-Afrika lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Inselelo yakhuphuka iye kwenye izinga ngama-Advocates of the Human Rights Organization asungulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1979. Inhloso eyinhloko yenhlangano ukuvikela nokuqinisa amalungelo abantu ngokuhambisana nokuphathwa ngokuhlonipha ubulungiswa bezomthetho nokuv
Ezobuhlakani Bokwenziwa: Ukuqonda Nokubaluleka Kwayo Emhlabeni Wanamuhla Isingeniso Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa (Artificial Intelligence, AI) kusemqondweni wokwenza izinto ezithile zenzeke ngokwahlukana ngaphandle kokufaka ukucabanga kwabantu. Le nqubo yokwakha ubuhlakani obufana nobomuntu ibalulekile emhlabeni wezemfundo, ezobuchwepheshe, nezomnotho. Lokhu kubaluleka kuveza ukuhlakanipha kokwenza izinqumo, ukufunda, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezimo, okwenziwa ngama-algorithms nemishini. Umlando wobuhlakani bokwenziwa Ubulukhuni bokwakheni ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvela emkhakheni wezinye izifundo ezinjengoMthetho, Isayensi, neZibalo. Ukuqala kwayo kunxulumene nokuqulwa kwemibono emisha ngeminyaka ewu-1950, lapho abacwaningi basebenzisa izinkanyezi zamakhompyutha ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizenzakalelayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, imizamo yokwenza imishini eqonda ifana neyezenzo zomuntu yathi nemizamo yokukala imikhiqizo yokubala kwahuqulwayo. Manje, amakhono e-AI asebenza ezindaweni eziningi, eziningi zazo eziyiphikisa. Izinhlobo ze-hlakani bokwenziwa Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa zihlukaniswa ngezigaba eziningana. I-AI engaphansi (Narrow AI) igxile emisebenzini ethile, njengokuhumusha ulimi, ukwazi ukuhamba, noma ukudlala imidlalo. I-AI ephezulu (General AI) ingakha ukuqonda okunjengokwakhiwa komuntu, ikwazi ukufunda nokwenza izinqumo ezinzima. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-AI ethuthukisiwe (Superintelligence) ibonisa ukucaciswa okuphezulu, okungaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezingaphezu kwemikhawulo yomuntu. Ubuchwepheshe be-AI Ubuchwepheshe obusekelwa ku-AI buqukethe imishini yokufunda (machine learning), imishini yokufunda kwemishini (deep learning), kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokuqonda ulimi (natural language processing). Lezi zindlela zisetshenziswa kabanzi emikhakheni ebanzi, njengemisebenzi yokuphatha, ukwelapha, kanye nezokuxhumana. Imishini yokufunda ikwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphathelene nedatha ethile, kuyilapho imishini yokufunda kwemishini ikhipha imiphumela ethuthukisiwe ngokusebenzisa amanethiwekhi ajulile. Izicelo ze-hlakani bokwenziwa Kuyaphawuleka ukuthi ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa zisebenza ezindaweni eziningi zempilo yansuku zonke. Umphakathi ubona izinzuzo kukhuluma kwethu, uma kuxoxwa ngobuchwepheshe bokuhlola izifo, ukwakhiwa kwezikhumbuzo, kanye nokusebenza kwamasistimu okuphathwa kwezimali. Kanjalo, ibhizinisi liphumelela ngempumelelo ngokusebenzisa ama-AI ezinhlelweni zentela, ukucwaninga kwemakethe, kanye nezokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa abuyona nje ithuluzi, kodwa yindlela ebalulekile yokuphucula ukusebenza okungapheli. Izingozi nezinselelo Noma izinzuzo ze-AI zifakazelekile, zikhona nezinselelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwazo. Ukwenza izinqumo ezizenzakalelayo kudinga ukucabangela izinto ezifana nobulungiswa nokuphepha kwedatha. Izingozi ezinjengokuthi indlela yokuphatha idatha ingaqhamuka nezingozi ezimphakathini, ngakho ukufaneleka kwezombusazwe nokuxhaswa kwemithetho kubalulekile. Okwamanje, ukuvikeleka kwabantu nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo ze-AI zisebenza ngendlela ehlelekile kuyinkinga ethinta abacwaningi, osomabhizinisi, nabaphathi. Ukwakhiwa komhlaba munye ophumelelayo Ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa ziletha ithuba lokwakha umhlaba ophumelelayo. Kukhona umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu ne-AI, okubangela ukuba sizwe izinzuzo zokwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe obusha. Ukuze kulungiswe izinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokwenziwa ngendlela ethanda ukwakha impilo engcono, ukunciphisa ubumpofu, ukuphucula imfundo, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, neminyango eyahlukene kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemiphakathi eqinile nehlelekile. Isiphetho Ngokubuka phambili, ezobuhlakani bokwenziwa ziza nezinketho eziningi ezisebenzayo nezitholakala kumakhono. Ukwenziwa kombono wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu ne-AI kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izixazululo zalolu hlobo. I-AI, njengoba ikhula, izoba yinhlanganyelo ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ohlakaniphile, onobuchwepheshe, noshintshe kahle. Kungakho kubalulekile ukuqonda lezi zinguquko umazisi uhambisana nazo njengoba sizele phambili emhlabeni onezinselelo eziningi. Amaqhubu ethu okuphila kahle adinga ubuhlakani nokuhlinzeka kwethu, okwenza i-AI ibaluleke kakhulu ezindleleni zethu zokuphila. Ngakho, ngesikhathi sobuhlakani bokwenziwa bukhula, izwi lokusebenza, ukucabanga, nohambo oluhlangeneyo luzofaka isandla kulokhu ukukhanyisa umgwaqo ukuya phambili.
Ukugonywa Kwezingane: Izinyathelo Eziyinhloko Ukugonywa kwezingane kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle nokuvikeleka kwazo. Le nqubo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi kudingeka yenziwe ngendlela efanele. Lapha sizobheka izinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokugonywa kwezingane, ukuze abazali nabakhulisa baqonde kahle izidingo zalesi simo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Ukubaluleka Kokugonywa Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi kungani ukugonywa kwezingane kuyingxenye ebalulekile. Lokhu kuvikela izingane ezimeni eziningi ezibuhlungu, ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana kalula, njenge-measles, polio, ne-hepatitis. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugonywa kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, njengoba izingane ezivikelekile zinciphisa ukusabalala kwezifo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlela Ukuvakashela Kwezokwelapha Ngemuva kokuba uqonde ukubaluleka kokugonywa, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuhlela ukuvakashela kudokotela. Kubalulekile ukuhlola abantwana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi baphila kahle ngaphambi kokugonywa. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, lapho udokotela ezobona khona ukuthi ingane ikulungele ukugonywa. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhetha Uhlobo Lokugonywa Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, udokotela uzokweluleka ukuthi yiziphi izigaba zokugonywa ezidingekayo, okuvamise ukuhluka kuye ngempilo yengane, ubudala, kanye nezimo zendawo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abazali baqonde lezi zigaba ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zithola ukugonywa okufanele. Isinyathelo 4: Ukugonywa Lapho sekufika isikhathi sokugonywa, kubalulekile ukuthi abazali bahlale bejabulile futhi bephumule, ukuze ingane ikhululeke. Udokotela uzobe eqinisekisa ukuthi ukugonywa kwenziwa ngendlela efanele, futhi abantwana kufanele bahlale bephumule ngemva kokugonywa ukuze bagcine impilo enhle. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqapha Impilo Ngemva Kokugonywa Ngemva kokugonywa, kubalulekile ukuqapha impilo yengane. Abazali kufanele bazi ukuthi izimpawu ezithile, njengokukhwehlela, ubuhlungu besikhumba, noma ukungakhululeki, zingavela. Lokhu akukhathalekile, kodwa uma izimpawu ziba zimbi kakhulu, kufanele kube khona ukuvakashelwa kudokotela. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuqinisekisa Ukugonywa Okuqhubekayo Ukugonywa akupheli ngemuva kokugonywa kokuqala. Abazali kufanele baqonde ukuthi kunezikhathi ezithile zokugonywa ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane ihlale ivikelekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvakashela kudokotela ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izigaba zokugonywa zifeziwe. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuxhumana Nabanye Abazali Ukuxhumana nabanye abazali kungasiza ekwaziseni kabanzi ngale nqubo. Abazali bangabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zithola ukugonywa okufanele. Lokhu kungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, lapho bonke abazali bejolise ekugonyeni izingane zabo. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Yokugonywa Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuhlola imiphumela yokugonywa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ukuthi ingane isaphila kahle yini, nokuthi izimpawu zokugonywa zikhona yini. Ukuhlola lokhu kuzokwenza abazali bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle mayelana nokugonywa kwezingane zabo esikhathini esizayo. Isiphetho Ukugonywa kwezingane kuyinqubo ebalulekile ekwakheni impilo enhle. Abazali kufanele baqonde kahle izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zikhululekile futhi ziphilile. Ngokuqhubeka nokugonywa, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, lapho izingane zethu zikhula ziqinile, ziphilile, futhi zikhululekile ezimeni ezimbi. Ukugonywa akuyona nje inqubo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuvikela ikusasa lezingane zethu.
Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhamuka, ukukhombisa, nokusebenzisa impahla yezenzakalo zezilwane ngokweqile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhiqizwa nokuphila kwezilwane ngothando lweRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. Lo Mthetho uhlanganisa iziqondiso; futhi ingxenye 'udokotela wezilwane' ibhekisela kumuntu obhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezilwane kanye noMthetho Wempilo Yezilwane, 1982 (Umthetho 19 ka-1982), ukuze prepares for veterinarians njengoba kuchazwe engxenyeni 1 yoMthetho. Lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezilwane, noma isilwane esihlukile ngokwenkolo yalolo hlobo njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhangisa ngomyalezo kwiGazethi ukuthi isilwane sikhona ngenhloso yalo Mthetho. Mayelana nohlobo olusha lwezilwane noma uhlobo olusha lwalesi silwane okufanele lungene ezweni noma lukhulunywe eRiphabhulikhi, uNgqongqoshe uzokwenza isimemezelo ngemva kokubheka isicelo, futhi ephinde acabangele umthetho wamazwe omhlaba, futhi ngemva kokuthola imibono ukuze aphendule isaziso somphakathi okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngaphambi kokuba kube nesimemezelo esinjalo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane noma izizukulwane zalolu hlobo lwezilwane zingamenyezelwa njengokuhambisana nezimo zalo Mthetho: Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isilwane noma impahla yezenzakalo njengoba kubhekiswe engxenyeni 17 izomenyezelwa kuphela ngemva kokuthi isicelo sithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe ngenhlangano efanele yokukhulisa izilwane. a endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu eRiphabhulikhi; noma b ezweni elilodwa noma ngaphezulu elichaziwe. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha umphakathi kwiSikhungo, onemfundo efanele ephezulu ekuthuthukiseni izilwane, njengomphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izilwane, ozosebenzisa amandla futhi enze imisebenzi ethunyelwe kuye noma ethunyelwe kuye ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. a Umqondisi angadlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 ngokubhala kumphakathi onemfundo efanele namakhono, noma anganika amandla noma aqondise umphakathi ngokubhala kubo ukuze basebenzise lawo mandla noma benze leyo misebenzi. c Noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe noma umyalo onikezwe umphakathi osebenzisa amandla ngaphansi kwengxenye a singaqedwa noma sishintshwe nguMqondisi, futhi njengoba kukhishwe nguMqondisi kuze kube sekuphelweni noma kuguqulwa ngaphandle kokuhlosiwe kwalesi sihloko. Amandla kaMqondisi okusebenzisa isinqumo a Noma yiziphi amandla okuthola anikezwe uMqondisi ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ngaphandle kwalawo anikezwe ngengxenye 16 noma 17, awazukusetshenziswa ukuze aphikise noma yimuphi ummangali noma omunye umuntu ophuma phambi koMqondisi njengothando, ngaphandle kokunikeza lowo mmangali noma umuntu ithuba lokuzwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingase sikhishwe noma, uma isikhathi singakukhishwanga, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esifanele njengoba kuzokhombiswa nguMqondisi. b Ummangali noma omunye umuntu osebenzisa amandla ngaphansi kwengxenye a angakhipha leli thuba lokuzwa. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ngokuhambisana nalolu Mthetho isikhathi sikhishwe lapho noma yini kufanele yenziwe, uMqondisi angakwandisa leso sikhathi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuphela kwaso. UMqondisi uzogcina uhlu lwabakhulisi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezinhlamvu, abathumeli bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulisi, imiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe noma ezivunyelwe futhi ulwazi olurekhodiwe mayelana nalezi zikhungo, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezinhlamvu, abathumeli bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulisi, imiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe kuzobhalwa. Uhlu luzovuleka, ngemva kokukhokhwa kwezindleko ezikhishwe, ukuze luhlolwe ehhovisi likaMqondisi phakathi nezinsuku zomsebenzi. UMqondisi uzohlinzeka nganoma yimuphi umuntu, uma ecela futhi ngemva kokukhokhwa kwezindleko ezikhishwe, ikhophi yolwazi oluthile olurekhodiwe kuhlu noma isitifiketi esihlobene nakho. Uhlu luzoba ubufakazi obuqinile bazo zonke izindaba ezihlosiwe noma ezinikezwe amandla ngalo Mthetho okufanele zibhalwe lapho. Isitifiketi esithi sibhaliwe nguMqondisi sizoba nomthelela wokuthi ubhaliso kuhlu alwenziwanga noma ukuthi noma iyiphi enye indaba enikezwe amandla ngalo Mthetho ukuba yenziwe, yenziwe noma ingakwenziwanga izoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezindaba ezichaziwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ikhophi yokufakwa kuhlu noma ukukhipha kuhlu, ethi iqinisekiswe nguMqondisi, izokwamukelwa njengobufakazi nanoma yisiphi isikhungo somthetho ngaphandle kokwengeza ubufakazi noma ukukhipha okwakungukuphela. b umkhulisi obhaliswe nguMqondisi ngenhloso leyo uqinisekisile ngendlela ethile enikezwe nguMqondisi ukuthi umkhulisi, umhlinzeki, umqoqi wezinsalela, kanye nomthumeli wezinsalela, unayo, ngaso sonke isikhathi, ulwazi olwaneleyo, okuhlangenwe nakho, kanye nobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuqoqwa kwemikhono, izinsalela, noma mayelana nokuqoqwa kwezinsalela, izinsalela, noma izinsalela zomfazi ezitholakele, zihlolwe, zisetshenziswe, zifakwe, noma zigcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho, futhi ukuthi ezilwaneni, mayelana nomkhulisi, umhlinzeki wezinsalela, noma umqoqi wezinsalela, kungase kube ukuthi izinsalela zikhishwe noma, mayelana nomqoqi wezinsalela noma umthumeli wezinsalela, zingeniswe ngensalela yomfazi noma izinsalela; futhi c ukuhambisana nezinye izidingo ezithile ezikhishwe. Umthumeli kufanele futhi abhaliswe uma ethatha isinqumo sokubhalisela uMqondisi ukuthi uzosebenzisa ama-laboratories namalungelo okukhulula izintela ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhishwe zezimali zezenzakalo ezingeniswe nguye ezweni noma ezingeniswe komunye umuntu. b abasebenzisi bezobuchwepheshe kule ndawo, mayelana nokunakekela izilwane ezigcinwe lapho, bangase baqoqe, bahlolisise, basebenzise, bafake, benze amalebula, futhi bagcine impahla yezenzakalo, kubhekwa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwale ndawo kwenziwa ngumuntu olandela izidingo ezikhishwe; futhi c le ndawo kufanele ilandele lezo zidingo ezikhishwe. b izilwane zalezi zinhlobo zilandele ezinye izidingo ezikhishwe njengokuhambisana. a le ndawo ibhaliswe njengendawo; noma ii isilwane sivunyelwe njengempahla yezenzakalo yohlobo oluthile, kufanele ifake isicelo ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguMqondisi nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezehlakalo ezikhishwe zohlobo lokubhaliswa noma ukuvunywa okufunwa. Iqembu labantu elifuna ukubhalisela njengemiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane kufanele lifake isicelo kuMqondisi ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguMqondisi nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezinye izimiso zomphakathi wabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezindleko zokufaka isicelo ezikhishwe. Izinyathelo Zokuthunyelwa Kwama-Ambulensi: Ukuqonda Inqubo Yokuhlinzeka Usizo Oluphuthumayo Izinsuku zethu zinezinkinga eziningi, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi kube nezimo ezingalindelekile ezidinga ukuphuthuma. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, lapho ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kudlala indima enkulu ekuvikelekeni kwabantu abalimele noma abagulayo. Ukuze siqonde kahle le nqubo, kubalulekile ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezithile, kusukela ekuqhamukeni kwesigameko kuze kube sekuthumeleni usizo. Izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uma umuntu edinga usizo, okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthintana nomnyango wezokwelapha noma i-ambulensi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezindlela ezahlukene, kodwa ukusebenzisa ucingo noma i-SMS kumakhalekhukhwini, njenge-10111 eNingizimu Afrika, kuyisinyathelo sokuqala esibalulekile. Ngemva kokuxhumana, umbono walesi simo uthola imininingwane ewusizo - ikakhulukazi, isimo esibucayi, izimo zomsebenzisi, kanye nendawo ethile yalesi sigameko. Lokhu kuqonda kuxhumana no-Dispatcher, osebenza njengomxhumanisi phakathi komuntu odakisayo nomsebenzi wezokwelapha. U-Dispatcher kufanele akwazi ukuhlaziya ngempumelelo ukuze akhethe ama-ambulensi afanele. Uma izidingo seziqedile, u-Dispatcher uzothumela i-ambulensi. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke kahle, udinga ukufanisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo nendawo yesigameko. I-ambulensi ethumeleke kufanele ibe neziguli ezinesikhumbuzo sephrofayela yabasebenzi abakwazi ukwenza okukhona okufunwa ukuze abesinenkinga. Lapho i-ambulensi ifika, abafudukayo, umsingathi, nomsebenzi wezempilo kufanele benze konke okusemandleni abo ukuze balondoloze impilo yesehlakalo. Umsebenzi wezempilo kufanele akhulume ngezimpawu ezikhona nesehlakalo esiqhamukayo, enza isiqiniseko sokuthi uyaziswa ngokuya phambili ukuze abanye osebenza nabo bahlale besanda. Ukwamukela iziguli, umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana kahle, futhi lokhu kubandakanya ukwenziwa kwesivivinyo sokuphuthuma, ukwenziwa kwemithwalo, nokunikeza imiyalelo ethile. Lokhu kubalulekile njengoba iziguli zidlula ezindaweni zokwelashwa ezisheshayo, kanti umphakathi unendima ebalulekile ekunciphiseni ukuphuma komuntu ophuthumayo ezindaweni ezinzima. Kubhalwe phansi, kubalulekile ukuthi abezinsiza zempilo bazi kahle izinqubo zokuthumela ama-ambulensi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqonda ubaluleka bokuhlonipha, njengoba izenzo ezingalungile zingaphazamisa ukuqonda komsebenzisi. Uma umsebenzi we-ambulensi uphelile, iziguli kufanele zifezeke ezindaweni ezifanele zokwelashwa. Ukuxhumana okuhle nezinye iziphathimandla, nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kubalulekile kuzo zonke izinyathelo zomsebenzi. Ngakho, lokhu kudinga ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukuze kuhlangabezwe nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo, kudinga ukuqeqeshwa, uxhaso, ukuxhumana, nokuqonda izidingo ezahlukahlukene zomphakathi. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo phakathi kwezinsizakalo zempilo ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kwenzeka ngendlela ephumelelayo, futhi kukhombisa indlela eya phambili emkhakheni wezempilo.
Isingeniso Ukukhempa nokuhamba emahlathini kuyizinto ezithokozisayo ezinezinzuzo eziningi empilweni yomuntu. Lezi zenzo zisiza abantu abaningi ukufinyelela emvelweni, ukuthola injabulo, nokuvuselela izingqondo zabo. Ukuze siqonde kahle ukubaluleka kokukhempa nokuhamba emahlathini, kubalulekile ukubheka izinzuzo, izindawo ezikahle, izinqubo zokuphepha, kanye nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze sithole isipiliyoni esihle. Izinzuzo Zokukhempa Nokuhamba Emahlathini Okokuqala, ukukhempa nokuhamba emahlathini kukhuthaza ukuphumula emsebenzini nasemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Umoya opholile, amahlathi anempilo, nezinyoni ezicula kudala umuzwa opholile. Ukuhamba emahlathini kuthuthukisa impilo, kuthuthukisa ukugijima, futhi kunciphisa ukukhathala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni umqondo opholile emzimbeni nasemoyeni. Ngokujwayelekile, ukukhempa kuhlinzeka ngempilo yomphakathi njengoba abantu behlangana, behlola ubuhlobo, futhi bezijabulisa emvelweni. Lokhu kuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu futhi kuthuthukisa ukuthandwa kwezindawo, okwenza kube lula ukunciphisa ukukhathazeka komphakathi. Izindawo Eziphumelela Kokukhempa Nokuhamba Emahlathini Uma sikhuluma ngezindawo zokukhempa, kunezinketho eziningi ezikhangayo. Izindawo ezifana nezinkanyezi eziphakeme, izihlahla ezinkulu, nemifula emihle zenza kube nezindawo ezikhethwayo. E-South Africa, izindawo ezifana neKruger National Park, i-Mount Table, kanye neDrakensberg zaziwa kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukukhetha indawo enezinsiza ezifanele, njengezindawo zokuphumula nezindawo zokuhamba, ukuze kube lula ukuhamba. Ukuvakasha kulezi zindawo kudinga ukuzinikela ekuvikeleni imvelo, okuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Izinyathelo Zokuphepha Lapho uhamba emahlathini, ukuphepha kubalulekile. Ukuze uqinisekise uhambo oluphumelelayo, kufanele uhlole izinto ozidingayo, isimo sezulu, nezimiso zomthetho endaweni. Ukwazi izimpawu zendalo, njengezivanani zezilwane, kubalulekile ukuze unciphise ingozi yokuhlaselwa. Futhi, ukufaka indawo yomlilo ngendlela efanele kuqinisekisa ukuthi umlilo awupheli. Ukunakekela ukungena amanzi anempilo nokudla okunempilo kuzokwenza uhambo lube ngcono. Izinsiza Ezidingekayo Izinsiza ezidingekayo zokukhempa nezokuhamba zihluka ngokuya ngesimo nendawo. Umhambi kufanele athenge izinto ezifanele, njengezindwangu, izikhwama zokulala, nezinsiza zokupheka. Ukuze uqinisekise impilo enhle, udinga isitsha sokuphuza amanzi, ibhodi lokupheka, kanye nezinto zokupheka. Kubalulekile ukuhamba nenduku yokuhamba nezimpahla ezikhethekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha. Ukwenzeka Kwezinkanyezi Ngaphezu kwezinzuzo zomzimba, ukukhempa nokuhamba emahlathini kuthinta nemizwa yomuntu. Ukuphila emvelweni, ukuphuma endlini, kunika umuzwa opholile. Lokhu kusiza ekwehliseni ukucindezeleka. Ukuhamba nokukhempa kwenza kube lula ukuhlela, futhi ukuhamba phakathi kwezinyoni kulethe umqondo omuhle. Ukwazisa umhlaba nokuhlanganyela nezilwanyana nezimbali kukhulisa ukuqonda nokunciphisa ukucindezeleka. Isiphetho Ngakho, ukukhempa nokuhamba emahlathini kungumsebenzi owusizo empilweni, kuholela empilweni engcono, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa ezinye izindlela. Ukuhlela izinsiza, ukulandela izinyathelo zokuphepha, kubalulekile ukuze kube nesipiliyoni esihle. Lokhu kwenza kube nesithombe esihle sokwenza izinkanyezi nomoya opholile, kuphatha uMhlaba ngendlela enhlonipho.
Umbiko: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Isingeniso Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, izimo eziphuthumayo ziba yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kubandakanya izimo ezifana nezinhlekelele zemvelo, izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa, nezimo zempilo. Ukuze siphendule kahle kulezi zimo, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula. Lo mbiko uzohlola izindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu, izinselelo ezihambisana nazo, kanye nezixazululo eziphakanyisiwe. Isimo Samanje Ngokwezinhlangano ezahlukene, isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo sikhombisa ukwehla okukhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokwanda kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengama-ambulensi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo. Nokho, izifunda eziningi zisakhungathekile ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza, imithombo, kanye nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlupheke kakhulu, futhi izinga lokuphila lincishiswe. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Isikhathi Sokuphendula 1. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwabasebenzi: Ukuqeqeshwa kwezakhamuzi nezisebenzi ezibandakanyekayo ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Ukuqeqeshwa okuhle kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphendula, okwenza kube lula ukuphendula ngokushesha. 2. Izinhlelo Zokuxhumana: Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisheshayo, kungasiza ekusheshiseni ukuphendula. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza ezahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokuphendula. 3. Ukubambisana Nezinhlaka Zokuphendula: Ukuhlanganisa amandla phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza ezahlukene, njengeminyango kahulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele, kuyasiza ekwandiseni ukusebenza kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. 4. Izinhlelo Zokuhlola: Ukuhlola njalo izinqubo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola imiphumela yokuphendula, ukuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa, nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Izinselelo Eziqhubekayo Naphezu kwezinyathelo ezithathwayo, kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nezinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yizinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ezindaweni eziningi, izinsiza zihlala zincishisiwe, okwenza kube nzima ukuphendula ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaqondi kahle izinqubo zokuphendula kubangela ukungaboni kahle phakathi kwezinsizakusebenza, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela. Izixazululo Eziphakanyisiwe Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinselelo, kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile. Okokuqala, kufanele kube nokwanda kwemali yokuxhasa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwengeza kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, okwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuxhumana kufanele zibe zisebenziseka kalula, ukuze wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza abasebenzi bahlale beqeqeshwa ngezindlela ezintsha nezamakhono, okwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kahle. Isiphetho Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Noma kunezinselelo eziningi, izixazululo ezithile zingasiza ekwandiseni ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zokuphendula. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukwakha izinhlelo eziphumelelayo, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, ngaleyo ndlela sithuthukise izinga lokuphila komphakathi. Ukusebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, lapho abantu bazi ukuthi bangalindela usizo olusheshayo nezinsiza ezitholakalayo uma kudingeka.
