uMfula iNile Ingxoxo noDkt. Sipho Mkize, Ucwaningo lweMvelo Umhlangano wethu wawuqale kumhlanganyeli wezimbali, imvura ihla kancane, kanti uDkt. Sipho Mkize, uchwepheshe kwezempilo, wemvelo, nenkululeko yokucabangela izimpilo zabantu nezinto eziphilayo, ubungakanani, kanye nemvelo yeNile, wenza umusa wokubamba le ngxoxo. Umbuzo: Dkt. Mkize, ngicela usitshele ngokubaluleka komfula iNile emlandweni nasekuziphileni kwabantu base-Afrika. Impela, umfula iNile, njengoba sazi, uyindlela ewumgogodla yokuphila kwabaningi eNkulunkulu. Iphakathi nendawo ye-Afrika, uNile utholakala e-Egypt, uSudan, kanye nezinye izindawo eziningi. Ngokwenkolo, uNile ungumfanekiso wokuphila, nokuthi usuku nosuku uphuphela ngempilo, uma izivunguvungu zikhona; lapho iNile igcwele, uMhlaba uvula izandla zawo. Ngaphambili, izizwe eziningi zifundile kuNile, futhi ubudlelwano bayo nemvelo yenza ihlale ibalulekile kumasiko nezinkolelo zabo. Umbuzo: Kukhona izinkolelo noma imihla yokukhumbula ethinta iNile? Kunjalo, iNile ibhidliza ukuthokoza kwabantu. Ngokwesiko, abantu bakwaNile bahlonipha umfula njengeMoya. Ngempela, kwiMibhalo Engcwele, iNile ibhalwe khona. Kwazulu, izinkolelo ezithinta umfula zihlobene nezinsuku ezithile, ezifana neMikhosi yokuvuselela, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona ukuze bahloniphe umfula, bakhumbule izinsuku ezithile zomlando. Umbuzo: Uthinteka kanjani umfula iNile ekuthuthukisweni komnotho? Uphinde uphinde ukhokhe ukudla komhlaba. I-Nile inika umhlaba inhlabathi efanele yokukhulisa imifino, futhi lokho kukhuthaza uhwebo. Kakhulu kakhulu, abantu basendaweni besebenzisa umfula wokuhamba izimpahla nemikhiqizo ehlukene. Ngamafuphi, umfula unika abantu amandla okuphila, futhi ubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wabo. Umbuzo: Uthinta kanjani ubudlelwano bomphakathi nezokulima phansi komfula? Ngokukwazi ukusho, uNile udlalwa ibhizinisi emithonjeni yokuphila kwabaningi. Izinkampani zikhula, futhi abantu bakhulakulana nezinsizakalo ezikhona, njengokubona ukuhamba kozoshukuma. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi umphakathi uthole imisebenzi, futhi kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano phakathi kwezizinda zomphakathi. Ubuqhawe bomfula buncishiswa yizinkinga zomoya, ngakho sidinga ukusebenzisana ukuze sizame ukugcina umfula umgogodla wobudlelwano bethu. Umbuzo: Ucwaningo lwakho lweMvelo luthinta kanjani ukufundiswa ezindaweni ezizungezile? Ubuchwepheshe besayensi besebenzisa indlela yokuhlanza amanzi eNile ukuze siphephe ezimweni ezinzima. Ucwaningo lube negalelo, kubalulekile ukwenza abantu baqonde ukuhlonishwa kwemvelo nokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela umfula. Sihlanganyela nezikhungo zemfundo, futhi sidlulisela ulwazi kubantu ukuze bazi kahle ukubaluleka kokugcina umfula uhlanzekile. Izinqumo ezithathwayo kufanele ziqaleke emiphakathini ukuze sikhulise abantu. Kulungile, ngabe lokho kubalulekile ukuze akukho emkhakheni wesintu lapho umfula uhlanzekile. Umbuzo: Yini ezokwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomfula iNile? Kubalulekile ukuvuselela izindlela zokuphila nabantu, ukusebenzisa izinsizakusebenza eziphilayo, nokuxhumana kwezitho zomphakathi. Ukuhlola izinkinga, ukunciphisa ukungcoliswa, ukugcina izinyathelo ezilungile zokuhlanzeka – konke lokhu kubalulekile. Uhlelo lokuvuselela nokwenza izinqumo ezisekelwe olwazini lwangempela kuyadingeka, ukuthuthukisa impilo kodwa nokuvikela umfula. Umbazo: Ngabe uhwebo nemvelo zomhlaba kuzo zikhuluma kanjani? U-Africa ungumhlaba okhula ngogqo. Njengoba umhlaba wethu usushintsha, izimpendulo zomndeni, uhwebo nemvelo, zidinga ukubambisana. U-Nile unikeza amandla okubumba ukuphila; akufanele sikhumbule lokho, uma sizama ukuphila kahle, kufanele siqinisekise ukuhlanzwa kwempilo esizungezile. Ukubambisana kwezindawo ezahlukahlukene kukhuthaza ukuhweba, ngakho-ke kuhle ukuhlonishwa, okuzenzakalelayo nezinto eziphilayo. Umbuzo: Sifakele umbono wakho ngempilo nomfula iNile. Uphakathi nokuphila kuzothi umfula ube umgogodla, ukugcina imvelo ihle; akukhona kuphela ukuzinakekela kodwa nomphakathi ukuze sikwazi ukubumbana. Kufanele silwele ukuphila kwe-Nile, futhi singakwazi ukwakha ikhaya elihle lapho umfula uthola igugu. Umfula uhlala uyisifundo, umthombo wokuphila okwephula. Kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe lokhu, ngaphandle kokuphula imvelo. Ubuqhawe obufuna ukuba buyiNile, ubukhulu bemvelo bukhona kumngcele wethu. Ngiyabonga. Kukhumbule, umfula iNile akusiyona nje imithombo yamandla, kodwa uthinta zonke izici zokuphila, kuhlanganiswe nemvelo, ubudlelwano, nezinsizakalo. Sifuna ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha, futhi ubungane bethu nomfula buphila njalo. Lokhu sikwazi kuphela uma sihlonipha umfula iNile. Umbiko ubonakala ungenakuhambisana kodwa kuhambisana nezinye izimpilo, aphephe izimo, bheka ubungane bethu nomfula, uzithole uhamba phambili. Ngiyabonga!
UMnyango Wezolimo ubheka inqubo yeMthetho Wokuguqulwa Kwezinto, 1997, mayelana nezimo zamavume. Bheka ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lokugunyazwa oludingayo bese ugcwalisa ifomu elifanele. Izicelo zokuph continued under a specific activity zizovunywa kuphela uma lelo activity ivunyelwe esikhathini esedlule. Thumela isicelo kanye nenombolo ethile yezinkophi kumqondisi we-GMOs. Thumela enye ikhophi yesicelo, ehambisana nolwazi lwezohwebo olungayimfihlo kumqondisi we-GMOs. Khokha imali ethile okufanele ikhokhwe. Thumela umbiko wezinto ezenziwe esikhathini esedlule. Thumela ubufakazi bokwaziswa okujwayelekile. Inqubomgomo yokuhamba kwe-GMO. Umqondisi uhlole ukuthi isicelo sihambisana neMthetho Wokuguqulwa Kwezinto, 1997. Ikhono lokweluleka lihlole ulwazi lwezesayensi oluthunyelwe nesicelo bese lenza isiphakamiso mayelana nokuphepha komsebenzi ophakanyisiwe, okukhulunywa phambi komkhandlu ophakeme. Umqondisi uthola imibono yomphakathi ngesikhathi esivunyelwe. Umkhandlu ophakeme wenza isinqumo ngesicelo, ucabangela isicelo, isiphakamiso sekomidi lokweluleka, imibono yomphakathi, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona emikhakheni efana nezolimo, impilo, imvelo, umsebenzi, ukuhweba, kanye nentuthuko yesayensi nobuchwepheshe. Uma isinqumo somkhandlu ophakeme sihambisana nesicelo, umqondisi utholelwa igunya lokukhishwa kwemvume. Umqondisi ukhishwa imvume efanele. Zonke izimvume zihlala ngaphansi kwezimo zokukhawulelwa. Ukuphikiswa okuvela kuMnyango Wezolimo kuqapha ukuhambisana nezimo zemvume.
Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubamba iqhaza ehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-A (H1N1) 2009 i-pandemic influenza emiphakathini obakhonzile. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni leli gciwane nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walonyaka. Ekuqaleni, yayaziwa njenge-swine flu ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi ivela ezinkukhu. Manje kuqondwa ukuthi umthombo wayo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, leli gciwane alinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yengulube noma imikhiqizo yengulube. Manje ibizwa nje ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngegama layo elisemthethweni i-A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walonyaka, leli gciwane selisabalalise ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane selithinte abantu abangu-177,457 (okuqinisekiswa yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. eNingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 enezigameko eziyisithupha zokufa. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo okwenzeka ngomhla ziyi-11 kuJuni 2009, iHhovisi leMhlaba (WHO) laphawula ukuthi izimfuneko zokubiza leli gciwane njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke seziphumelele, futhi uMphathiswa-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, useveze ngokusemthethweni le ndawo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho nje ukuthi leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni kuzo zonke izifunda ze-WHO futhi lenzeke ngokushesha okukhulu. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukusho ukuthi leli gciwane liyi-pandemic akusho ukuthi linamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi liqhubeka lisabalala yonke indawo. Ngomhla ziyi-6 kuJulayi, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwaleli gciwane ezweni elithintekile nakwamanye amazwe njengokungapheli futhi okungavinjwa. Ngiyabonga, naphezu kwalokhu, iphinde yaphawula ukuthi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngale gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina sikhuluma njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasekhaya, sikhathazekile ngokuqhubeka kokufa okwenzekile kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane libhekana kakhulu nabantu abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya kwengu-29 - iningi labo ngababhalisile noma basemazingeni aphezulu ezemfundo. I-WHO iphakamisa ukuthi amazwe ahlobene agxile ekwehliseni umthelela wale gciwane emiphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lidluliselwa ngezinsalela zomoya, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ekhala, uthatha lezi zinsalela abakhwehlela noma abakhale. Nokho, uma bekhwehlela endaweni evaliwe, ungase uthathe umoya lapho ungathinteka khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banemiphumela elula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onemiphumela elula noma enzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule i-branch eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesiphakamiso sikadokotela. Abaguli abadinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka esikhungweni socwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwamanje kwenzeka emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukuhlosile i-WHO. Odokotela kufanele bakwelaphe amacala abekwe engcupheni ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliselwa kolwazi (protocol) ezitholwe nguMnyango Wezempilo. Izinketho zokwelashwa zifaka iTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela emiphumeleni engcono yokwelashwa uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangase basindise izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi lomhlaba jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zokuthenga, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwalesi gciwane. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi onemiphumela elula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi nabaqeqeshi abakhokhelwayo abakhoyo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenza nezikhulu zezempilo ukuze banikeze izinyathelo ezifanele okufanele zithathwe. Uma unemiphumela elula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabantu. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuze bazame ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sesixazululo kanye namandla okukhiqiza anele - amandla angatholakali e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukubonga isikhathi osithathile sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubeka kwakho kokuba nendima yokusabalalisa ulwazi nokunciphisa imiphumela yale gciwane.
Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini Ngomphakathi wonke ubumbene, umcimbi obalulekile wezemfashini, owaziwa ngokuthi "Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini," ubungcweliswa ngempumelelo enkulu eGoli. Lo mcimbi, obuhlanganisa abathandi bezemfashini, abaklami, nababukeli, waba yisigcawu esikhulu sokukhombisa ubuciko, ubuhle, kanye nemigomo yokuphila enempilo. Uhlelwe ngempela ukuze ugqugquzele ubuchwepheshe bezemfashini obuhlonipha imvelo, umcimbi wasetshenziswa njengendlela yokubonisa ukuthi imfashini ayikhulumi kuphela ngesitayela, kodwa futhi ithinta impilo, umphakathi, kanye nezinsizakusebenza zomhlaba. Umsakazo uqale ngengxoxo ebukhoma phakathi kwabachwepheshe bezezimali, abaklami, nabadlali emkhakheni wezempilo, bechaza indlela imfashini engathuthukisa ngayo impilo yomuntu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ethinteka kakhulu. Leli sonto, abathandi bemfashini bacelwe ukuba banake umphakathi, baqondise ukuqonda kwabo ngezinselelo ezibhekene nabaklami abasha, nokubaluleka kokusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakala kalula. Ngemva kokukhuluma, umcimbi udlulela ezinhlelweni ezithakazelisayo zokwakha, lapho abakhangisi bemfashini bebonisa imiklamo yabo emisha ehlanganisa izinsiza ezihamba phambili nezindawo zokukhiqiza ezihlanzekile. Ubuchwepheshe obuphambili buhlinzeke ngamathuba okukhombisa izitayela ezintsha ezithinta umoya wezemfashini, futhi abavakashi bayaziswa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuphila engcono, iqhakambisa impilo, ubuhle, kanye nezinselele zethu zansuku zonke. Umsakazo wahlanganisa nezinye izingxenye zomhlaba wezempilo, lapho abathandi bezokudla bebonisa ubuchwepheshe bokudla okunempilo, kuboniswa amathuba amaningi okukhuluma ngalokho okuphakanyisiwe. Ngemva kokudlalwa kwamafilimu afundisayo, abavakashi bathola ithuba lokuxoxa nabasebenzi emikhakheni ehlukene, bephawula ngemicabango nemibono ehlukahlukene. Kwathi ngesikhathi sokudansa, abaculi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe baphakamisa umoya, bengeza ubuchwepheshe bokudala izifiso zomphakathi. Ubuciko bazo bukhombisa umdlandla, ubuhle, kanye nezikhathi ezinhle ezihlobene nezezimali. Umcimbi wawuhloselwe ukusiza abantu baqonde ukuthi imfashini ingabhalela izindaba ezenzakalayo, iyaziqhenya, futhi ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni. Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini wahlanganisa abavakashi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganiswa nezinkanyezi zomhlaba wezokwakha, abathandi bemfashini, kanye nabadali bezindaba. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imfashini iyingxenye ebalulekile yempilo kanye nempilo yomuntu, engafaka isandla ekwakheni umphakathi okhululekile. Uhlelo lwemfashini yathi lwabe luhlala lukhombisa izitayela ezihamba phambili, uhola abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono, bejabulile, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Umgomo wokugcina lo mcimbi kwakuwukuthi ukhiphe abantu emkhakheni wezempilo, kubangele ukuthi bahlale bejabulile, bephila impilo enempilo, futhi benza izinqumo ezithinta umphakathi wabo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uzokwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemfashini nezempilo, ngenkathi kudaleka izinkanyezi ezintsha emhlabeni wezobuciko. Njengoba umcimbi uphumelela, izivakashi zaphuma nezifundo eziningi, zikhumbula ukuthi imfashini ingaphezu kokugqoka, kodwa ingumphakathi, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuphila kahle. Umdlalosezindebeleni aluhlanga lokuqala, kodwa umgomo wawo uhleliwe kahle — ukusiza abantu ukuba bakhe imfashini enempilo, ebumbene, futhi ephilayo. Umoya ophilayo, ubuchwepheshe obuphephile, kanye nempilo ehlanzekile, konke kuhlangene emphakathini ukuze kudaleke ikusasa eliqhakazile kulabo abahamba phambili emkhakheni wezempilo nezezimali. Ucwaningo luphinde lwaba yinsika yokwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuphila, okuhloswe ngazo ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezikahle kumiphakathi yethu. Ngale ndlela, Umsakazo Wezempilo Nezemfashini ube yisigcawu esibalulekile, esikhumbuza abantu ukuthi imfashini ingamathuba okukhula, ukwakha, nokuhlonipha impilo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obuhle nobulelwe emphakathini, sithuthukise izimpilo zethu, futhi sisize abanye. Lokhu kuzoya phambili, kuqhakazise, futhi kuhloniphe imvelo, futhi ngokuqhubekayo, lo mcimbi uzoba sebenzisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Ekugcineni, kulindeleke ukuthi lo mcimbi uzophinde ube yisibonelo sokwakha imfashini ethokozisayo, enempilo, futhi esebenzayo, ehlonipha umhlaba kanye nomphakathi.
Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Kwezebhizinisi (GEMS Business Use Restrictions) Ezweni elishintsha ngokushesha, ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomgibeli ophakeme emhlabeni wezebhizinisi. Kodwa-ke, uma kukhulunywa ngokuqhuba ibhizinisi, kubalulekile ukuqonda imikhawulo ethile yokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emikhakheni ethile, njengezezimali, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana. Kulokhu, sizobheka imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi, okwaziwa nangokuthi yi-GEMS (General Enterprise Management System) business use restrictions. Ukwazi Imikhawulo Yokusetshenziswa Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ihlose ukuvikela izinsiza, ukugcina ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu. I-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi bazi kahle imithetho nemigomo ethile. Izinsiza Zokusebenza Izinsiza ezisetshenziswa emabhizinisini zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokusebenza, isoftware, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. I-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile mayelana nokuthi lezi zinsiza zingasetshenziswa kanjani. Ngokwesibonelo, isoftware ethile ingase ibe nemikhawulo yokuthi ingasetshenziswa kuphela ezinhlelweni zokusebenza ezithile, noma ingase ifune ukuthi kube nezeluleko ezithile ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukusebenzisa Izinsiza Ngokuhambisana Nezidingo Abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele baqonde ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale behlola izidingo zabo zokuqhuba ibhizinisi futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza abazisebenzisayo zihambisana nalezi zidingo. Uma izinsiza zingasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, njengokuphazamiseka kokusebenza noma ukusilela ekwenzeni inzuzo. Ukulawulwa Kwezinsiza I-GEMS ikwenza kube lula ukulawula izinsiza. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba ukungasebenzisi izinsiza ngendlela efanele kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwemali, isikhathi, kanye nezinsiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele babe nezinhlelo zokulawula ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza, ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokusetshenziswa, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi. Imiphumela Yokwephula Imikhawulo Ukwephula imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi kungaholela eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi izinyathelo zokuphatha ezinzima, ezinjengokulahlekelwa kwezimali, ukulahlekelwa yithemba, noma ngisho nokubekwa enkantolo. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi lihlala lisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale beqaphela izinqubomgomo ezithile ezibekiwe futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazazi lezi zinqubomgomo. Ukubaluleka Kokuhlinzeka Ngokuqeqeshwa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa iyahlonishwa, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okukhona kubasebenzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abasebenzi ngezinsiza ezithile, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izinsiza. Ukuqeqeshwa okuphumelelayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi liphumelele. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezebhizinisi ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. I-GEMS ibeka imikhawulo ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi lihlala lisebenza kahle, futhi abanikazi bamabhizinisi kufanele baqonde le mikhawulo ukuze bagweme izinkinga ezinkulu. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, ukulawula izinsiza, nokuhlola izidingo, abanikazi bamabhizinisi bangakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa iyahlonishwa, okuzoholela empumelelweni yebhizinisi.
Ukusebenza kahle kweMisebenzi Eyinhloko Yezwe (SOEs) kubalulekile kunoma iyiphi uhulumeni ophumelelayo. Ukungaqiniseki nokukhula komnotho womhlaba, amandla emakethe, kanye nokungena kwemithombo yezezimali zomhlaba kudala izinselelo kuzo zonke iziphathimandla njengoba ziqinisa izinqubo zazo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Ngakho-ke, sithathe isinqumo sokusebenzisa amandla kaHulumeni ezindaweni ezibalulekile zomnotho ukuze siqinisekise izinjongo ezizinzile. Imisebenzi kahulumeni kumele ibe nokuzinza futhi ibe nezimali ezizimele ukuze ihlangabezane nazo zonke izidingo zemakethe yezezimali kazwelonke nezamazwe omhlaba. Nakuba uhulumeni engase usize lezi zinkampani ngezimali ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwazo nakwezinye izimo kamuva, kumele zikwazi ukukhula ngezimali zazo kanye nemakethe yezezimali. Ukusebenza kahle kuyisici esibalulekile kakhulu kumabhizinisi kaHulumeni. Lokhu ukusebenza kahle kudinga izinga lokuphathwa, abasebenzi, kanye nobuchwepheshe obuhambisana nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinkampani zikahulumeni zingadlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni ngokusebenzisa ukuzinza kwazo kwezezimali, abasebenzi, ucwaningo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa. Njengoba uhulumeni efuna ukuthuthukisa imali ethathwa kumadijithi e-diamond eNingizimu Afrika, i-Alexkor iyimoto yokufeza lokhu. Nokho, kunezindima ezimbili ezingeziwe ezidinga uku fulfilled futhi ezibalulekile ngezizathu zokuthuthukiswa. Eyokuqala, njengemoto yokuhweba, kufanele ibandakanye umphakathi waseRichtersveld ekuthuthukisweni kwayo. Okwesibili, okwenziwe muva nje kodwa kunenjongo ehlanganisiwe, ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwakha kabusha izindawo zedijithi eNamaqualand. Nokho, ukungaqiniseki komhlaba kubeke i-Alexkor esimweni esinzima kwezezimali nasekusebenzeni. I-Infraco isunguliwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi sithuthukisa izinsiza zokuxhumana ezibalulekile. Akulula ukuncintisana nolwazi lwezezimali zomhlaba ngaphandle kokuba ne-bandwidth ephansi, ethembekile, futhi ethengiswayo. Kukhona amabhizinisi angase aqhubeke nokuba khona emnothweni wethu kodwa ngeke akwazi ngoba amanani ethu e-bandwidth yokuxhumana awakwazi ukuwathwala. Ukukhula komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika kube nokuphazamiseka ngenxa yokungatholakali nokubiza kakhulu kwe-bandwidth yokuxhumana. Manje, kukhona ukugxila okuqinile ekuphothuleni izidingo zezimali nokwakha kabusha amasu e-SAA, okuzokwenza i-SAA ithembele kakhulu ezimalini zayo. Nokho, ukuhoxiswa nokwakhiwa kabusha kwezinye izingxenye kungase kudingeke. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha uhlelo lwabasebenzi, ukubandakanya ozakwethu, nokususa imisebenzi engadingekile. Ukuxoxisana kokubonisana nezinyunyana kuqhubeka. Nakuba le nkampani inengxenye enkulu engu-30% embonini yokulima, manje isiphinde isiza kuphela ngo-2.5% emnothweni jikelele wemboni, kanye no-3.5% wokemployment. Ngakho-ke, ikhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi ingxenye esele yeSafcol, izinkanyezi zeKomatiland, kufanele ithengiswe. Ngonyaka ka-2006/07, ibhodi labaphathi lavuma uhlelo lwezimali lweminyaka emihlanu olufinyelela ku-R64.5 billion. Lolu hlelo lweminyaka emihlanu lwabuyekezwa ngonyaka ka-2007/08 futhi manje lufinyelele ku-R78 billion. Lolu hlelo lwezimali lwaluhloselwe ukuqinisa nokwandisa ukusebenza ngokwandisa amandla okukhiqiza izinsimbi ezihlanganisiwe namalahle, kuthuthukiswa izinsiza zephothi, nokwandisa iphayiphi elivela eThekwini liya eGoli. Njengamanje, sibambisene nebhodi ohlelweni lokwakha kabusha ukuze kube nokubambisana ekusebenzeni ezikhungweni ezintsha zokuthutha ezakhiwa njengamanje eNgqura, futhi sizokwenza isaziso esinemininingwane ngalesi sikhathi. Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwezinto ezibalulekile, ngakho-ke indlela engcono yokufeza lokhu ukuqinisa amandla ethu. Nokho, umkhiqizo wethu kumele uhambisane nezindinganiso zamazwe omhlaba mayelana nenani nekhwalithi. Imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwe-JPF, uMnyango Wezemfundo, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, kanye neziqu ezihambelanayo ze-SETAs ne-SOEs iqhubeka igxile ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha, ezikoleni, nakubantu abanemfundo abangase bakwazi ukuqedela ukuqeqeshwa kwabo emisebenzini kahulumeni ngaphambi kokuhlolwa ukuze bathole imisebenzi efanele.
USibongile Victor Michael Mahlinza wazalwa e-Estcourt ngomhlaka 14 kuJulayi 1961, wakhulela endaweni yaseNtabamhlophe (iWhite Mountain). Uqale ukuya esikoleni samabanga aphansi ngo-1968 eCornfield Primary School. Ngo-1976, waqala ukuya eMtshezi High School futhi waphothula ibanga leshumi nanye ngo-1982. Ngo-1983, wathuthela eJohannesburg futhi wasebenza kumkhandi njengomphakathi. Wasebenza lapho unyaka owodwa. Ngemuva kwalokho, uVictor wasebenza enkampanini yezemithi eJohannesburg, lapho ayengumgibeli wezimpahla. Waphuma lapho ngo-1986. Kusukela ngo-1987 kuya ku-1988, uVictor wayengumshayeli wezimoto eM & L Distributors. Kusukela ngo-1989 kuya ku-1995, wathumela impahla ye-AMCA Construction. Ngo-1996, uVictor wayefuna ukuba umkhiqizi futhi wabuyela ekhaya. Uqale ukulima futhi wakhulisa ngezinkomo. Wathenga ithrekhtha ngo-2003. UVictor ushade noLinah, futhi banezingane ezinhlanu: amantombazane amathathu namadoda amabili. UFikile (26) unezingane ezimbili. USizwe (19) uphothule ibanga leshumi nambili ePietermaritzburg eZakhe Agricultural College, uphothule futhi ikhosi yokutshala imifino eBuhle College eDelmas, futhi okwamanje usebenza noVictor epulazini labo. UZandile (15) ukwiBanga lesi-9 eAbantungwa High School, kanti uMpumelelo (11) ukwiBanga lesi-4 eMathamo Primary School. UVictor uphinde ashade noNorah, futhi banezingane ezintathu: indoda eyodwa namantombazane amabili. U-Ayanda (24) uphothule ibanga leshumi nambili eMtshezi High School futhi uphinde athole isitifiketi se-N3 kuCivil Engineering eBerea Technical College eThekwini. U-Ayanda uphinde usebenze noBaba wakhe epulazini. Amantombazane, uThakasile (20) okwamanje ukwiBanga leshumi nanye eAbantungwa High School, kanti uBongeka (12) ukwiBanga lesi-6 eMathamo Primary School. UVictor unama-traktori amabili: iMassey Ferguson 440 4 x 4 kanye neMassey Ferguson 5465, futhi unemoto, iColt 2.8. Uzoqhubeka nokulima ngoba wakhulela epulazini. Unombono wesikhathi esizayo nangesibindi sokubhekana nezinselelo ezingase zivele kumuntu ofuna ukuba umkhiqizi wokudla. Uthola kanjani imali yokutshala ezitshalweni zakhe? UVictor akaboleki imali kumuntu noma kuphi; usebenzisa imali yakhe. Lokhu okwamanje kuyinkinga ngoba usebenzisa kakhulu yonke imifula yomndeni futhi uqasha amahektare angama-15 kumfarmers omkhiqizo. Uthola kuphi impahla yokutshala? Uthenga zonke izimpahla ezidingekayo zokutshala e-TWK eWinterton futhi uthenga imithi e-Farmers Agri-Care eWinterton. UVictor uthenga imbewu ePannar noma eMonsanto, futhi bammukela kahle. Yimuphi umsebenzi uhulumeni owenzayo ekulimaleni, futhi benza kanjani lowo msebenzi? UVictor ubona ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo endaweni ayilima khona wenza umsebenzi wawo futhi umsekele ngezindlela eziningi. UMnyango Wezolimo kule ndawo usize abalimi bakhe imbewu ye-SAB red maize. Impumelelo yakhe ekulimaleni ivela ekuhlelweni okuhle nasekusebenzeni kanzima. Yini engaba yingozi engavimbela intuthuko yakhe nempumelelo? Ubona ukuthi inkinga enkulu evimbela intuthuko yakhe ukuthola imali eyanele yokuphatha kahle umkhiqizo wakhe kuze kube ukufika emakethe. Izindleko zomsebenzi nazo zikhathaza kakhulu. Yiziphi izithuthukisi azifuna ukuzifeza ekulimaleni? UVictor ungathanda ukuthuthukisa ukulima kwezinkomo nezinkunzi ngoba ubona ukuthi kuzosekela ukutshala kwakhe. Amasu akhe empumelelo kulo nyaka ahlanganisa ukulima ngezithako ezihlukahlukene; okwamanje, unenkontileka neNestle yokutshala ummbila, ubhontshisi omncane, nemifino ye-chicory.
Ukwesekwa Kwezilimi Eziningi Ezikhungweni: IsiNgisi NesiZulu Kulezi zinsuku, umhlaba wethu ub faced with an unprecedented challenge—ukukhula kokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile futhi ezibambisene, ikakhulukazi ezikhungweni ezifana nezikole, ezemfundo, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, kubalulekile ukufaka isandla ekusekeleni izilimi eziningi, okuhlanganisa isiNgisi nesiZulu. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi isiZulu, njengolimi lwezizinda, linomlando ocebile futhi luwusizo ekwakheni ubunye phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kube nokusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kwabafundi, abafundisi, nabazali, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokweseka isiZulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa kahle isiZulu ezikoleni, ukwakha izinsiza ezifanele, kanye nokudala indawo yokukhuluma nokuqonda phakathi kwabafundi. Kodwa-ke, isiNgisi sibuye sibe nendima ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lomhlaba. Njengoba uNingizimu Afrika ihamba phambili ekukhuleni komnotho, isiNgisi siba ulwimi oluyinhloko emikhakheni eminingi, okuhlanganisa ezokuxhumana, ezemfundo, nezobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganisa isiNgisi, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili ezingeni lemfundo nasemisebenzi. Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi akugcini nje ngokufundisa izilimi; kubalulekile futhi ukukhuthaza umqondo wokuhlonipha izilimi ngendlela ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi banethuba lokukhuluma isiZulu nesiNgisi, ngasikhathi sinye, ukuze bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokhulisa ukuzethemba kwabafundi, kubavumele ukuba bakhulume kahle futhi bahloniphe izilimi zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhuthaze ukusekela izilimi eziningi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza, ama-webinars, nemithombo ye-inthanethi kufanele kube yinto evamile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda nokuhlanganyela ngolimi oluthile, futhi kuzokwenza ukuthi abafundi bakwazi ukufaka izimvo zabo ngesiZulu nesiNgisi ngempumelelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo, ukuze zabelane ngempumelelo nezindlela zokusebenza. Izikhungo ezahlukene zingafunda komunye nomunye, zabelane ngamasu okuphumelela, futhi zixhumane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi kuqhubeka nokuqiniswa. Ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo kuzo zonke izilimi kudinga ukusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Ekuqedeni, ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi ezikhungweni kumele kube yisivumelwano phakathi kwezindlela eziningi zokufunda, izinhlelo, nezinsiza. Ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi onobumbano, izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zonke izilimi zikhuliswa futhi zisetshenziswa ngokulinganayo. Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabafundi, kubavumele ukuba bakhule, baphumelele, futhi bagcine isiko labo liphila. Ukwesekwa kwezilimi eziningi akukhona kuphela ukwakha izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukwakha umqondo wokuhloniphana nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu abakhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukukha amathuba, ukwakha ubumbano, nozwelonke olukhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi osebenzisanayo, ophumelelayo, nolungiswayo, lapho bonke abantu bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi baveza izimvo zabo ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo ziqhubeke nokweseka izilimi eziningi, ziqinise amakhono ebhizinisi, futhi zikhuthaze ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa umphakathi wesizwe esihloniphayo, esikhaliphe, futhi esisheshayo.
Umnikelo wezindlu kumuntu ngamunye uyisinyathelo sik government esinikezwa abantu abafuna ukuba nefa lendawo ethuthukisiwe noma impahla. Umnikelo uvumela abatholi ukuba babambisane nezinkampani zokwakha noma bathenge indlu esele engaphansi kwephrojekthi yomnikelo wezindlu esivele ivunyelwe. Lo mnikelo uphinde usize labo abafuna ukuthuthukisa amazinga abo okuxhaswa ngokuthola izikweletu, kanye nalabo abangakwazi ukuthola izikweletu. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma abantu abanokuhlala okungapheliyo abashadile noma abahlala nomunye umuntu isikhathi eside, abaphezulu kweminyaka engu-21 futhi abanabantu abaxhomekeke kubo, kanye nemali engenayo yomndeni engama-R3,500 noma ngaphansi, noma labo abangakaze babe nekhaya ngaphambi, bangafaka isicelo. Abafakizicelo abakhubazekile bangafaka isicelo sokushintshaniswa okuthile. Qedela ifomu lesicelo elitholakala kuphela eMnyangweni Wezindlu WasePhalamende, ezinkampanini zezimali, nasezindaweni zokwakha. Thumela ifomu kumamele umthetho ophathelene nokudluliswa kokuba nefa kusuka kumuntu oyedwa kuye komunye ukuze uqedele isigaba G. Thumela ifomu kumthengisi noma enhlanganweni yezezimali ukuze uqedele isigaba H uma isicelo sithinta ukuthola isikweletu. Thumela ifomu kumConveyancer ukuze uqedele isigaba I uma kuhlobene nendlu eyakhiwe muva. Futhi thumela yonke imibhalo esekelayo, njengemibhalo yokuhlonza, isitifiketi somshado, isitifiketi sokuzalwa, ubufakazi bemali engenayo, kanye nesitifiketi sokuba nefa. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala.
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Indaba Yomlando Ngaphambi kokuba sizwe izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72, kufanele siqale sihlolisise umlando wezempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Izikhungo zezempilo zihlala zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zisebenza njengendawo yokwelashwa, yokufundisa, nokuxhasa abantu abaningi. Ngesikhathi sokubusa kwabantu abadala, imikhuba yokunakekelwa kwezempilo yayihamba kancane; izikhungo zazincane futhi zihlala zisebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-1994, ngemva kokuphuma koMbuso wobandlululo, izwe laqala ukwakha izikhungo zezempilo ezinkulu. Kwakuwumkhankaso omkhulu wokwakha izakhiwo ezazizohlomula umphakathi, zikhuthaze impilo engcono, futhi ziqinise izinsiza zokwelapha. Njengoba izwe lawela emuva kwedemokhrasi, izikhungo zezempilo zazifuna ukwakha isithombe esisha futhi sibe yisibonelo sokuthi impilo ingathuthukiswa kanjani. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zakhiwa ezindaweni ezahlukene, zifaka phakathi izifunda ezisemadolobheni nasemaphandleni. Lezi zikhungo zabeziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazoze banelisekile uma kukhulunywa ngezinqubomgomo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa azikhungo ezitholakala ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu badinga khona usizo lwezempilo, kodwa benganakile. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo lokhu kwaba nemiphumela emihle emiphakathini. Izikhungo zashintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo ngezempilo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zakhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uthole ukwelashwa okuthuthukile, kuholele ekwandeni kwempilo nokunciphisa izifo ezithathelwanayo. Imizamo yokwakha izikhungo eziningi yaphinde yaholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakusebenza zokwelapha, umphakathi waba nethuba lokufunda, futhi waqonda ukuthi impilo enhle iyadingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zahamba phambili ekuxhumekeni phakathi kwemiphakathi, abezindaba, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, kusiza ekwandeni kolwazi nokwabelana ngezindlela zokwelapha. Abantu babefunda ngokubaluleka kokuthola usizo olunembile kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala eduze kwabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zazithuthukiswa ukuze zithuthukise izinsiza zazo. Kwakukhona imizamo emikhulu yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinsiza zokuxhumana, nokunye okwakwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emithini nasemitholampilo. Lokhu kuvulekelele izikhungo, kwaholela ekwandeni kokubandakanyeka komphakathi, abantu baye bathola ukudlondlobala emkhakheni wezempilo. Njengoba izikhungo zihlala zikhula, zathola ukuvuma okuningi kumphakathi. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelapha ezithokozisayo, izifundo zomphakathi, nezinhlelo zokuxhasa eziphakeme. Izikhungo zafaka izinhlelo zokunikeza izinsiza zokwelapha ezitholakalayo ebantwini. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale beqaphele izimo zabo zezempilo, bagcine impilo yabo kahle. Kanye nokwakha izikhungo, izinhlelo zokufunda zathuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abezempilo banolwazi olufanele. Izikhungo zaba nemisebenzi eminingi yokuhlola, yokufundisa, kanye nokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekukhuleni kwabantu abaqeqeshiwe, ababe khona ukuze basize abanye, futhi kwakha umphakathi ozinikele empilweni. Namuhla, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zisekhona, zigcwele ithemba, zicela ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Zibhekelela izidingo zomphakathi, ziqhubeka ziqinisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa impilo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhuthalele ukuzinakekela. Imizamo yokwakha izikhungo ezinjalo ibonisa ukuthi uma umphakathi ubambisene, imiphumela iyakhula, futhi impilo iyathuthukiswa. Izindawo zezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72, ezakhiwe ngothando, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi impilo ibalulekile. Lezi zikhungo zifana nezingadi ezithokozisayo, lapho abantu bengeniswa khona, befunda, futhi bephila impilo engcono. Ngakho-ke, ukuze siqhubeke sizama ukusiza, ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, kufanele siqonde imithombo yethu, sizinike isikhathi sokuxoxa, futhi sihlanganyele empilweni yethu. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zikhumbuza umphakathi wethu ukuthi, nangaphandle kwezinkinga, sinamathuba amaningi okwakha, sithola impilo engcono, futhi siphila impilo egcwele umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kudala umphakathi okhuthazayo, ogcwele ithemba, kanye nempilo enhle, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Izikhungo zethu zezempilo ziyisibonelo sokuthi uma sikhuthaza, sihlanganyela, futhi sithokozisa, sizokwazi ukufinyelela phezulu.
Imvume yokusebenza yezikebhe inikezwa abantu bangaphandle abangamalungu eqembu elisebenzela ezikebheni. Imvume yokusebenza yezikebhe inganikezwa isikhathi esingafika ezinyangeni ezintathu ngasikhathi sinye. Izicelo zingafakwa ezindaweni zokungena eNingizimu Afrika. Thumela ipasipoti esebenzayo. Nikeza incwadi yesicelo evela kumphathi wezikebhe, kuhlanganiswe nemvume yabo yokuvumela lowo muntu ukuba ahambisane nemigomo yeMithetho Yokufuduka, 2002. Thumela ubufakazi obanele bokuba nemali eyanele kumphathi wezikebhe ukuze ahlangabezane nezindleko zokuphila zansuku zonke nezindleko zezokwelapha. Khokha idiphozi ethathwa njengokufanele nguMnyango Wezangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela yemvume yokusebenza yezikebhe. Le diphozi izobuyiselwa kuwe ngemuva kokuhamba kwabo kokugcina noma ngemuva kokuthi imvume ikwenziwe. Idiphozi ingakhokhwa ngecheque eqinisekiswe yibhange noma ngekhadi lesikweletu ezindaweni lapho le nsiza itholakala khona. Nikeza ubufakazi bokukhokha noma noma iyiphi i-invoyisi engakhokhwa ngumthengisi. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku ezingu-30.
Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, No. 2 ka-2000 ("umthetho") waqala ukusebenza ngo-9 Mashi 2001, unikeza ilungelo leziqondiso lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olunikezwe noma yiliphi ibhodi elisemthethweni noma elizimele elidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ibhodi lapho isicelo senziwe khona kumele ikhulule lokho kulwazi, ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ukuthi ulwazi lungakhululwa noma lungakhululwa. Umthetho uchaza izimo eziphathelene nezinqubo ezidingekayo ezihlobene nalolo suku. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukukhuthaza ukuveza nokuvuleka ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (DTI) ngokunikeza ilungelo lolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe futhi kuvikelwe amalungelo abantu noma izinhlangano. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuphathwa kahle kwamabhodi omphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi futhi ufundiswe ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe mayelana nomthetho. Ngendlela elinganisa lelo lungelo namanye amalungelo, kuhlanganise nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kuMthethosisekelo. Isigaba 14 somthetho sidinga amabhodi omphakathi ukuthi athuthukise umhlahlandlela ukusiza ekufinyeleleni kulwazi olunikezwe amabhodi omphakathi futhi sethe izidingo ezincane okufanele umhlahlandlela ulandele. I-DTI izibophezele, nokho, ekusebenzeni ngokukhanya, ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi inikeza ulwazi olukhululekile emphakathini wezohwebo, amakhasimende, kanye nomphakathi ngokusebenzisa imibhalo, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye nesikhungo solwazi. Lo mhlahlandlela uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesicelo, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ngemininingwane edingekayo yokuxhumana, kanye nezinyathelo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile oluvela kwi-DTI. Umhlahlandlela uphinde uzibophezele ukuhlinzeka ngesithombe esiphelele mayelana nesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye nenhlangano yolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-DTI ukusiza isicelo ekutholeni lapho ulwazi lungatholakala khona. Umhlahlandlela uphinde uhlinzeke ngamafomu adingekayo kanye nezimali ezisebenzayo zokucela ulwazi. Okungenani u-40% wesabelomali se-DTI unikezwa inethiwekhi yezikhungo ezisemthethweni ezakha ithimba le-DTI. I-Council of Trade and Industry Institutions (COTII) yasungulwa, ifaka phakathi iBhodi Labaphathi be-DTI, Abaphathi Abaphezulu, kanye Nezikhulumi zendawo ngayinye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kweqembu le-DTI kanye nezinhloso zeMnyango. Lo mhlahlandlela uhlinzeka kuphela ngerekhodi ze-DTI, hhayi zeqembu le-DTI (COTII). Noma yiziphi izicelo zolwazi, kunoma yiziphi izikhungo ze-DTI, kufanele ziqondiswe ehhovisi lolwazi lelo bhodi. I-Competition Commission kanye ne-Competition Tribunal ikhuthaza ukuncintisana, ihlola futhi ibhekane nezindlela eziphikisana nokuncintisana, futhi ithuthukisa ukugxila kwezomnotho emakethe ezihlobene ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuncintisana ka-1998. Yasungulwa ngo-1945, manje isiphathwa nguMthetho Wokucwaninga Kazwelonke ka-1998, iNational Research Council izibophezele ekuhlinzekeni ngezixazululo zobuchwepheshe nolwazi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nezomnotho. Inhloso yenhlangano ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele oluzohlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngamasu obuchwepheshe adingekayo, kanye nokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukufundwa kwesayensi nobuchwepheshe. I-Council izibophezele ekuholeni ukuqwashisa ngobuchwepheshe nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabasebenzi nobuchwepheshe. I-Industrial Development Corporation, ephethwe nguhulumeni, ihlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali olukhuthaza ukudalwa kwamabhizinisi ngokwakha imboni nezinkampani ezisebenza ngokuncintisana ngokusekelwe ezimisweni ezinhle zebhizinisi. Le nkundla iphethwe ngezinhlinzeko zomthetho we-Industrial Development Corporation Act ka-1940 njengoba kuguqulwe kanye nezinye izingxenye zomthetho wezinkampani. I-Khula yasungulwa ngo-1996 futhi igxile ekuqinisekiseni ukufinyelela okulula ezikweletini nasekuxhaseni amabhizinisi amancane nezaphakathi nezincane. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondile ngezikhwama zokwazisa nezimali zokusebenza kumabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezincane. I-Khula ibhaliswe njengomshuwalense ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushuwalense futhi iphethwe ngezikhombisi-ndlela zeBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali. Iwings yayo yokwazisa izikweletu ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke ngokwezimali njengoba kucacisiwe yiBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ukuze kutholakale izinga eliphezulu lezimali ezingabolekiswa. I-National Framework for the Integration of Product Advisory Institutions ihlinzeka ngemikhakha yokukhiqiza ngolwazi nezinsizakalo zokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezincane. IBhodi yasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokugembula Kazwelonke ka-1996 ukuze ilawule ukugembula, ihlinzeka ngeluleko lesizwe. Umthetho omusha we-Liquor ka-1998 wadlula kwiZikhungo Zombuso ngonyaka ka-1998 kodwa wathunyelwa kwiNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo nguMongameli ngenxa yemibuzo ephathelene nokuba semthethweni kwawo. Umthetho uhlose ukuhlela imboni ye-licor ngokwethula umhlahlandlela wezokugunyazwa ohlukanisa izimvume zibe izingxenye ezintathu; ukusungula iNational Liquor Advisory Committee, iNational Liquor Regulatory Authority, iNational Liquor Tribunal, izikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokulawula i-licor, kanye nezikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokubuyekeza; nokuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokulawula ukuze kutholakale ukufinyelela nokuthola izinzuzo ngenkathi kubhekwa nezindaba zomphakathi, ezomnotho, nezempilo. IFoundation yasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane ka-1996 njengenkampani yesigaba 21 ukuze ihlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zokuxhasa ezingezona ezemali kumabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezincane. IFoundation ihlinzeka ukufinyelela ekuqeqesheni, ulwazi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, ukumaketha, nobuchwepheshe. I-Standards Organization ilawula uMthetho Wamazinga, No. 29 ka-1993, ophakamisa ukujolisa emandleni nasekuphathweni kwekhwalithi embonini nasezohwebeni futhi uphinde ulandelele izilinganiso nezindinganiso zezimboni. Iphakela ubuholi emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngokuwuqonda, ulwazi lwawo lwamathuba nezinto ezingaba khona, nokubheka ikusasa. Iphromotha uguquko nokuthuthukiswa komnotho futhi ibhekana nezinselelo namathuba kubantu abathintekayo emnothweni, ukuze kusekelwe izinhloso zikahulumeni zokuthuthukisa umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa. Iphendula izinselelo namathuba emnothweni nasemphakathini. Iphakela indawo elindelekile esebenzisanayo, efanelekile, futhi elungile ukuze kube nokutshalwa kwezimali, imisebenzi, nezohwebo. Ngokwandisa umnikelo wamabhizinisi amancane ku-GDP. Ukwandisa izinga lokutshalwa kwezimali okuqondile emnothweni nasemikhakheni ebekwe phambili
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwefarmers luhloselwe ukusungula nokuphatha izindawo lapho kwenziwa khona izivivinyo ezizama ukukhombisa abalimi imiphumela yezindlela ezihlukene zokulima, njengokulungisa kahle umhlabathi, ukufaka ifertilizer efanele, ukukhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo, ukuphatha izihlahla nezifo, nokuvuna. Sikwazile ukuvula izindawo ezingu-46 zokuvivinya eziphathwa uhlelo lwethu. Lezi zivivinyo zihlose ukukhombisa izindlela ezifanele zokulima - noma ukufaka ifertilizer noma cha, inani leziqhamo: kakhulu noma kancane, noma ukuhlela izihlahla noma cha. Ikakhulukazi, kusiza abalimi ezindaweni ezithile nakwabantu abangafundile, njengoba lezi zivivinyo zikhombisa izindlela ezifanele zokulima ngesikhathi esifanele. Izinsuku zabafarmi zinikeza ithuba kubo bonke abathintekayo kwezolimo ukufundisa nokuxhumana nabalimi. Ngesikhathi lezi zinsuku zabafarmi, kukhona abasebenzi bethu, kanye nezithunywa ezivela ezinkampanini ezinikeza zawe zokulima, amabhizinisi ezolimo, umshwalense, abanikazi bezimali, njll. Ngonyaka owedlule sibe nezinsuku zabafarmi ezingu-65 - inani labalimi ababe khona kulezi zinsuku laqala ku-8 lafika ku-250!
Yini uGrain SA ethumele? Umqondisi: Jane McPherson, Umphathi Wohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA luhloselwe ukuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama ngezakhono zokuba abalimi bezomnotho. Ukukhiqiza ukudla okufana ne-maize, i-soybeans, i-wheat, kanye ne-barley kuhambisana nokukhiqiza okufanele, ukumaketha, ukusebenzisa imishini, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha umhlaba. Izinkinga ezihlobene nomhlaba nokuba nomhlaba. Izihloko esizifakile kulolu hlelo ziyi: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Maize," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Soybean," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Wheat," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Barley." Njengomlimi othuthukayo, sikholelwa ukuthi kufanele uqale ngalezi zifundo ezihlobene nezitshalo ezikhuliswa endaweni yakho yokulima. Uma ungakabi nalesi sikhathi, uzobhekana nezinkinga zokufunda izifundo ezinzima futhi uzobe uhamba ngemuva kwabanye abafundi. Ulwazi olukhona mayelana nezindlela zomnotho ngokuvamile lukhathaza, ngakho kube inselele ukukhetha lokho okufanele kufundiswe ngoba kunolwazi oluningi. Nokho, kunezihloko ezibalulekile esifuna ukuzifundisa kulolu hlelo. Ngakho, sikwazile ukufaka zonke izici ezibalulekile kulolu hlelo lokwethulwa oluhlobene nokukhiqiza nokumaketha, bese sihlanganisa no "Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza i-Maize Nokumaketha." Ukuqinisekisa izitshalo nokuphathwa kwezingozi kuyizinkinga ezingaba khona. Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza i-Maize sihamba nezobuchwepheshe ezihlobene nokukhiqiza umhlabathi kanye nokuphakama komhlabathi. Uma ufuna usizo ngalolu hlelo, kufanele uqale uye esifundweni sokwethulwa, futhi kufanele manje ukhiqize ukudla okuthengiswayo. Lolu hlelo lungase lungafaneleki kumlimi ophila phansi. Kukhona iziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezisebenza emnyangweni wezolimo ohlukene, futhi kufanele zinikeze ulwazi nosizo kubalimi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, iziphathimandla eziningi azifundisiwe kahle futhi zihluleka ukuba nekhono lokukhiqiza ukudla. Abanye baphendule (banama-certificate) kodwa bangezange basebenze ezindaweni zokulima - okuyinto ebalulekile ekulimaleni. Ngakho, sihlanganisile lolu hlelo: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Maize Kubaphathimandla Ababelana Ngolwazi." Sifundise lezi zifundo kaningi eziphathimandla futhi sizame ukubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kanjani emasimini - sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusize emsebenzini wabo. Isici esiyinhloko sokukhiqiza i-maize esizokwenza inzuzo sihamba nezithuthuthu nemishini. Sithole ukuthi isimo semishini kubalimi abathuthukayo sibhujiswa kakhulu - ngakho singenise leli hlelo. Lolu hlelo luyadingeka kubo bonke abafuna ukuba abalimi bezomnotho - kufanele uqonde ukuthi imishini yakhiwe kanjani, bese uzokwazi ukuyiphatha kahle. Ukuphatha kahle imishini kuyisihluthulelo esizovula umnyango wokungena ekulimaleni kwezomnotho. Awukwazi ukuvula lowo mnyango uma ungaphathi kahle izithuthuthu nemishini. Sithole ukuthi kukhona abalimi abaningi abancane, ikakhulukazi eMpumalanga Kapa, abangenamishini nezithuthuthu (Uhlelo Olukhulu Lokudla lweMnyango Wezolimo eMpumalanga Kapa lujwayele ukusebenzisa abakhiqizi kodwa alusebenze kahle). Sibone ukuthi kuzoba usizo kubakhiqizi be-maize ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sifundo esichaza umsebenzi wabakhiqizi, ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe kanjani, nini, njll. Abakhiqizi bavame ukungasebenzi kahle. Nokho, kunezindawo lapho abalimi balima ezindaweni ezincane ukuze bathenge izithuthuthu nemishini, ngakho-ke kudingeka abakhiqizi. Sikholelwa ukuthi lesi sifundo sabakhiqizi sizokhombisa abakhiqizi abasebenza kwezolimo ukuthi kubalulekile ukulima kahle, ngezindlela ezifanele, ngesikhathi esifanele, kanye nemali efanele. Uma umlimi engakwenzi inzuzo, abakhiqizi ngeke babe nomsebenzi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphambi kuka-1994, abalimi abaningi balima ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi "izindawo zokuhlala." Eminyakeni edlule, abalimi abaningi abazi ukuthi kunezinkinga eziningi ekulimaleni nokuthi izinhlobo zomhlabathi ezahlukene nezimo zezulu azifaneleki ekutshaleni ezinye izitshalo ezizokwenza inzuzo. Isifundo esibizwa ngokuthi: Ukusetshenziswa Kwezimali Nokuhlola Izinsiza sihlanganiswe ukusiza abalimi baqonde ukuthi isimo sezinsiza zabo sikhona kanjani bese bezokwazi ukusisebenzisa ngezindlela ezizobenza benze inzuzo esikhathini esizayo ekulimaleni. Ukusebenza nabalimi abanguye amalungu ezigabeni zokufunda iminyaka kube kukhombisa ukuthi kudingeka esinye isifundo. Siqale uhlelo olusha olubizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo Lwabalimi Oluphakeme," oluvumele abaholi bezifunda ukuba basondeze kulabo abalimi abazama ukuthuthuka. Sikhongele futhi ukuthi abalimi abaningi abawasebenzisi kahle kahle izinsiza ezikhona; badinga usizo lokubheka izici ezibalulekile ukuze baphumelele ekulimaleni. Izindawo nezinto ezibalulekile ukuze kuqhubeke nomsebenzi. Imnyango Yezolimo yezifunda ineziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezifundile kodwa azinakho amandla okwenza umsebenzi emasimini. Ngokuqhubeka komsebenzi wethu woktraining nabalimi, sisebenze eduze kakhulu neMnyango Wezolimo futhi sifundise izifundo eziningi. Sikholelwa ukuthi uma singahlinzeka iziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi ngezifundo ezizobasiza bathole amandla okwenza umsebenzi, bazokwazi ukusiza abalimi abaningi bakhule ngokwezomnotho. Asihlanganisi abalimi neziphathimandla esifundweni esisodwa ngoba iziphathimandla zikhathazekile ukubuza imibuzo phambi kwabafundi - azifuni ukuhleka. Izifundo zethu zifaka abafundi nemishini, kodwa sithole ukuthi ngokuvamile bahluleka ukukala imishini ngokwabo. Ukukala nokuphatha umshini wokuphonsa. Abalimi abaningi abahambile esifundweni sokuphatha imishini nezithuthuthu bacela esinye isifundo esizobafundisa ukuthi injini isebenza kanjani nokuthi kufanele bayilungise kanjani. Abalimi abaningi banokukhathazeka ngoba bangenalo ulwazi lokulungisa injini. Sifuna ukukhombisa lapha ukuthi lesi sifundo asihlosile ukufundisa (ukufundisa) abahloli. Lesi sifundo sihlose ukufundisa umlimi izingxenye zenjini nokuthi kufanele ziqhathaniswe kanjani. Ukulungisa injini yinto okufanele yenziwe ochwepheshe. Ukulungisa injini noma ibhande lenjini kubiza kakhulu - uma ungenalo ulwazi, uzobe uphonsa imali uzama ukulungisa lezo zinto. Lapho abantu behambela lezi zifundo, babona ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kanjani, kodwa bese beqonda ukuthi kunezinye izidingo. Kukho abakhiqizi ezindaweni ezifana neTaung/Hartswater abangakwazi ukungena, nakwezinye izindawo eNyakatho NgesiNdebele naseFree State. Nokho, izindlela zokutshalwa kwe-maize ziyafana, kunezinye izinto okufanele zicatshangelwe uma kukhuluma ngokuqhuba. Ngakho-ke, sihlanganisile izifundo ezimbili: "Ukukhiqiza i-Maize Ngokuhlinzwa," "Ukukhiqiza i-Wheat Ngokuhlinzwa." Ukukhiqiza i-maize/i-wheat ehlinziwe. Njengomlimi eqhubeka nokuthuthuka ngokwezimali, ukubal
Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Umfanekiso Wokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Ezweni Lethu Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, zikhonza abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenamali yokukhokhela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezizimele. Lezi zibhedlela zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle futhi bathola usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda indima yazo, izinselelo ezibhekene nazo, kanye nezinto ezinhle ezenzakalayo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziqala emakhulwini eminyaka edlule, lapho uhulumeni aqala khona ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izibhedlela zazikhona, kodwa zazikhiqiza izinsizakalo ezincane, futhi zazingatholakali kalula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezikude. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uhulumeni uqhubekile nokwakha izibhedlela eziningi, ezihlanganisa izikhungo zokwelapha, izibhedlela ezinkulu, nezikhungo zokuhlola. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola usizo lwezempilo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. Izinsiza Nezinsizakalo Ezinikezwa Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zinezinsiza eziningi ezihlanganisa iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo, iziguli ezidinga ukuhlinzwa, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezijwayelekile. Abahlali bangathola imishanguzo, ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezithile, njengokwelashwa kwezifo ezithile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi kunciphisa izingozi zokugula okukhulu. Izinselelo Ezibhekene Nezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Noma izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibalulekile, zibhakabhile ezinselelweni eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yisixazululo sokushoda kwezinsiza, okungaholela ekutheni iziguli zihlale isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthola usizo. Lokhu kungenxa yokwanda kwabantu, kanye nokuntuleka kwemali yokuxhasa izibhedlela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abahlali abaninzi bahlushwa yizinkinga zokungabi nalwazi olufanele mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukufinyelela usizo lwezempilo. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ukuze uthuthukise izibhedlela zikahulumeni. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa izinsiza, ukuqasha abasebenzi abanekhono, kanye nokwakha izikhungo ezintsha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezempilo ziqhubeka zikhula, ukuze abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo lwezempilo. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwezempilo kubantu bonke. Umthelela Wokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zinemithelela emikhulu empilweni yabantu. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi zinciphisa izinga lokugula. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokukhula komnotho, njengoba abantu abaphilayo kahle benza imisebenzi eminingi, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemindeni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhuthaza umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abantu behlangana ukuze bathole usizo lwezempilo. Isiphetho Izibhedlela zikahulumeni ziwumgogodla wezempilo eNingizimu Afrika, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Noma zikhona izinselelo eziningi, uhulumeni uqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze uthuthukise izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zikhona ukuze ziwusizo, futhi bazi kahle ukuthi bangazithola kanjani lezi zinsizakalo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onempilo, futhi onokuthula.
Ukuphendula Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo Ngezimoto Eziningi Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukuxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile kakhulu, okungukuthi, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ezihilela izimoto eziningi. Njengoba sikhuluma, sithola ukuthi izimo ezinjalo zenzeka njalo, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sibe neziqondiso ezicacile zokuthi singaphendula kanjani. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zingaba yingozi kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma izimoto eziningi zikhona, ingozi ingaba yinhlekelele. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abaqeqeshiwe, abazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abashayeli, abaphathi bezimo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Uma kwenzeka ingozi, okokuqala okumele kwenziwe ukuvikela abanye. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abashayeli kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi bangayeka kanjani izimoto zabo ukuze bangaphazamisi abanye. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezimpawu zomgwaqo, kanye nezindlela zokuphuma eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezithile ezizokwazi ukusiza, njengokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma kwenzeka ingozi enkulu, abashayeli kufanele bazi ukuthi kufanele baxhumane nabaphathi bezimo. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokushesha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi usizo lufika ngokushesha. Abaphathi bezimo bazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani ukuze baphathe isimo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabiza kanjani izinsizakalo ezifanele, njengemoto yokuhlola, abezimo zokuphuthumayo, noma abezokwelapha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphendula. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani ezithintekayo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezihlelelekile zokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, ukuhlela izinsiza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile yokuthi bangaphendula kanjani. Kukhona futhi izindlela zokuxhumana ezibalulekile. Uma kwenzeka ingozi, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abakwazi ukuxhumana kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezindlela ezilula zokuxhumana phakathi kwabashayeli, abaphathi bezimo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela ukuphendula, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi usizo lufika ngokushesha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zidinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Abashayeli kufanele bazi ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani ukuze bavikeleke, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabiza kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuqeqeshwa okuhle, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo zokuhlola. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinhlelo zokuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izimoto, ukuqeqesha abashayeli, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile yokuthi bangaphendula kanjani. Ekugcineni, ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abaqeqeshiwe, abazi kahle ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abashayeli, abaphathi bezimo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuphendula, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana ezibalulekile. Uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, sithola ukuthi singakwazi ukuvikela abantu, futhi sithuthukise ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo ngezimoto eziningi akuyona into elula. Kudinga ukucabangela, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezinhlelo ezicacile. Uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, sithola ukuthi singakwazi ukuvikela abantu, futhi sithuthukise ukuphendula kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila, futhi bazi ukuthi bangaphendula kanjani uma kwenzeka ingozi. Ngakho, ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, futhi ngithemba ukuthi lezi zinto ezikhuluma ngazo zizokwenza umehluko omkhulu ekuphenduleni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Qhubekani nokuqonda, nokuqeqesha, ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphendula kahle ezimweni eziphuthumayo.
Izindlela zokugcina nokugcina zikusiza ukuthi ulungiselele unyaka ozayo kalula, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umshini wakho wokufafaza usebenza kahle kokubili manje nangesikhathi esizayo. Uma amakhemikhali engena futhi aphuma emshinini wakho wokufafaza kaningi isikhathi eside, kungaholela ekuboleni kwezingxenye zomshini, ukwehla kwezinga, nokudliwa kombala kanye nezixhumanisi zikagesi. Izinto ezisele (amakhemikhali) zingaba yingozi kubantu abasebenza nalolo mshini noma eduze kwalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amakhemikhali asalele angadala ubungozi uma usebenzisa lowo mshini unyaka omusha. Ukuphepha kusho ukuthi kufanele uzinakekele, umndeni wakho, abasebenzi bakho, nezitshalo zakho, ngakho kubalulekile ukuhlanza umshini wokufafaza njalo ngesikhathi usebenzisa wona nangemva kokuwugcina. Khumbula ukuthi amakhemikhali amaningi asetshenziswa kwezolimo angaba yingozi ezitshalo nasemathunjini - qaphela indlela owasebenzisa ngayo ukuze ugweme noma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zenzeke. Indlela ephelele yokuphatha nokugcina umshini wokufafaza ihlanganisa izinyathelo ezinhlanu. Izokhombisa izinhlobo zezinto zokuvikela zomuntu (PPE) ezizokuvikela ezinhlelweni. Ukuhlanza kusho ukususa wonke amakhemikhali angaphezu kokuphuma noma ngaphakathi emshinini. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele udlule emanzini ahlanzekile kuwo wonke amagama omshini, futhi ilebula izokutshela ukuthi ungayilahla kuphi leyo mansi ukuze ugweme ukudala izingozi. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ithangi lihlanziwe, ligcwalise ngamanzi ahlanzekile kuze kube phakathi, uhambise umshini wokufafaza emgwaqweni omncane - lokhu kuzokwenza amanzi athokozise ethangini futhi ahlanze zonke izindawo. Ukuhlanza ngamafutha amancane (10% yethangi) kungcono kunokugcwalisa ithangi bese uhlanza kanye kuphela. Kufanele uhlanze kathathu noma ngaphezulu. Khetha indawo efanele yokulahla noma ukufafaza amanzi owahlanzile, indawo engasondelene nalapho amanzi ahlanzekile asetshenziswa khona, lapho kunezinye izitshalo, nendawo lapho amanzi azomisa khona isikhathi eside edala izingozi kubantu, izinto, nomhlaba. Ungawalahla eduze kwegadi noma emgwaqweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukhupha amanzi ethangini ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo ilebula yekhemikhali. Ungavuli nje ama-valve emanzini ukuze avumele ukuhamba phansi. Sebenzisa ama-nozzles amakhulu ukuze ukhiphe amanzi ngokushesha. Uhlaka lomshini wokufafaza kufanele luhlanzwe kahle. Siphinda: uma uhlanza umshini, qaphela ukuthi amanzi awagxili ezindaweni lapho izingane, izilwane, izinkomo, nezinye izilwane zingangena khona. Lahla amanzi owahlanzile ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo ilebula, ufafaze leyo mansi endaweni lapho wawufafaza khona ikhemikhali (izindawo zemifino lapho wawufafaza khona iyindawo efanele). Futhi, lahla amanzi ngemva kokuhlanzwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amanzi asuswe ethangini ngaphambi kokugcina umshini ngoba amanzi asalele angadala izingozi uma eba iqhwa. Ngemva kokuhlanzwa, ungabheka umshini ukuze ubone ukuthi kukhona yini izingxenye eziphukile futhi uhlole. Nokho, umshini ohlanzekile kufanele ugqoke izingubo zokuvikela. Kungase kube namakhemikhali asalele kwezinye izindawo. Isimo nokuhlala kwepampu kufanele kulungiswe uma ikhululekile. Uma umshini uhlanzekile futhi umisiwe, kufanele shine, futhi ungacabanga ukususa ezinye izingxenye ezingase zibe nomonakalo uma umshini ugcinwa. Susa ama-filters futhi uwashise ngesandla ngamanzi nesepha (khumbula ukugqoka amagilavu ukuze uvikele izandla zakho ekuthinteni amakhemikhali), bese uhlanza futhi ubeke endaweni ethile noma ubuyisele emshinini. Bheka isimo sama-nozzles nama-valve ngokucophelela. Kungase kube namakhemikhali asalele angase aqinise ebusika, futhi umshini ungase ungasebenzi unyaka ozayo. Susa ama-tips, ama-filters, nama-valve, uhlole kahle, bese ubuyisela. Washa wonke lawo owahlanzile. Gcina endaweni evaliwe - khumbula ukuhlabela ukuthi kukhona ini ngaphakathi. Beka ama-valve endaweni engasoze yahlala ibanda kakhulu ebusika njengoba angase abe nomonakalo. Susa wonke ama-pressure gauges futhi uvale izimbobo lapho usuwasuse khona. Gcina endaweni engasoze yahlala ibhujiswa futhi ingaliboni ubanda obukhulu. Ekugcineni, engeza i-antifreeze kuzo zonke izingxenye zomshini. Engeza i-antifreeze kumapayipi epampu. Lokhu kuzokwenza amapayipi avikeleke ukuze angabandi. Vala wonke ama-nozzles ukuze i-antifreeze ihlale ngaphakathi, uvule kancane ukuze i-antifreeze ikwazi ukuhamba kuyo yonke indawo. Vala uma ubona ukuthi umshini ugcwele. Inhloso yokwenza konke lokhu ukususa wonke amanzi asalele emshinini nokufaka i-antifreeze ezinhlelweni. Kufanele ushiywe i-antifreeze ngaphakathi emshinini ukuze uvikele ukuhamba okungase kwenzeke uma kusekhona umswakama ngaphakathi. Abanye abantu basusa ipampu ngaphambi kokugcina umshini, ungabeka ama-valve kule pampu evaliwe ukusiza ngalolu suku. I-antifreeze yezimoto zokuzijabulisa (RVs) ivamise ukusetshenziswa emishinini yokufafaza esebenza kwezolimo. Akuyona efana ne-antifreeze evamise ukusetshenziswa ezimotweni ngoba ayiqukethe amakhemikhali ayingozi angalimaza izilwane. Izinhlobo eziningi ze-RVs zizoba ziqinile ezimweni ezibandayo, kodwa ngokuvamile ziqinile njengeqhwa. Nokho, funda ngokucophelela ukuthi ilebula lithi ngalesi sikhathi ukuze ukhethe okukhona okufanele kuwe. Manje njengoba umshini wokufafaza uhlanzekile, ulungiselelwe ukugcina ebusika, kufanele ubekwe. Uma kungenzeka, gcina ngaphakathi lapho ungatholi khona umonakalo ngenxa yesimo sezulu. Kodwa le ndawo akufanele ibe seduze nalapho kukhona udaka. Noma yisiphi uthuli olungase lube khona luzobola umbala nezinsiza zensimbi zomshini. Uma ungafuni ukusebenzisa i-antifreeze uma ugcina umshini, kungaba kuhle ukususa ipampu bese uyibeka phezulu emgodini kuze kube unyaka omusha. Ngokuvamile, amanzi ahlala epampu, futhi ebusika, ukuhamba kungaholela ekutheni ipampu ingasebenzi.
Uma uhamba ukuya kubona udadewenu noma udokotela wakho, chaza ukuthi uhlela ukuba nomntwana, ikakhulukazi uma unesimo esithinta wena njenge-diabetes, epilepsy, noma isifo senhliziyo. Uma wena nom partner wakho nithintana, gwema ukuthatha imishanguzo ngaphandle kokuba ibhalwe udadewenu noma udokotela. Yenza kube yisiko ukuya esibhedlela sabesifazane abakhulelwe noma kudokotela wakho. Uma kukhona umuntu emndenini wakho noma emndenini womlingani wakho owazalwa enenkinga ethile yokukhubazeka noma enezinkinga zengqondo, zokubona, noma zokuzwa, cela udadewenu noma udokotela ukuba akuthumele esibhedlela sokwelashwa kwezakhamuzi ezikhethekile eduze kwakho. Thola ukuphumula okwanele futhi unakekele umzimba wakho ngokucophelela. Thola ulwazi ngokuqhuba. Xhumana nesibhedlela noma nodokotela wakho ngokushesha uma uhlangabezana nokopha ezindaweni zakho eziz private noma uma unezimpawu ezilandelayo: ukushisa okungapheli, ukuhamba, izinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuvukala kwezinyawo noma imilenze, ukukhula kwesisindo ngokushesha, izinhlungu zesisu, ukuncipha kokukhipha amanzi, noma ukukhipha amanzi ngokweqile ezindaweni zakho eziz private. Vakashela esibhedlela noma kudokotela wakho cishe ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngemuva kokuba umntwana wakho uzalwe ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa okuphelele kokuphuma. Yenza kube yisiko ukuthatha ingane yakho esibhedlela sezingane ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kanye nezivivinyo ezidingekayo. Xhumana nesibhedlela sokuhlela umndeni ukuze uthole ukuthi kufanele usebenzise ini ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa.
uTrevor Noah Uhlelo olukhuluma ngempilo, ubuhlakani, kanye nezimo zomphakathi, uTrevor Noah, umhumushi wezindaba, umculi, nomlobi, uzobamba umcimbi omkhulu eNingizimu Afrika. UTrevor, owaziwa kakhulu ngohlelo lwakhe lwezokuhlola, "The Daily Show," ulethe izwi elisha emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, lapho ehlola khona izinkinga ezinzima ngendlela ehlekisayo, kodwa enobuhlakani. Umcimbi uzobanjwa eTheater eJohannesburg, lapho izinkanyezi eziningi zikhanya khona. Abantu abaningi bazobe bejabulile, behlelele ukuza ukuze baphinde bazwe uTrevor ethokozisa, efundisa, futhi edlalisa. Uhlelo luzoba nezingxoxo ezithokozisayo, izinkumbulo ezihlekisayo, kanye nezifundo ezinzulu ezivela empilweni yakhe, kusukela ebuntwaneni bakhe eNingizimu Afrika, kuya ezimweni ezinzima abhekane nazo njengomuntu omnyama ophuma ezweni elinokuhlukumezeka. UTrevor Noah, owazalelwa eJohannesburg, ubonisa indlela yokuphila ehluke kakhulu. Uhlangabezana nezithiyo eziningi, kodwa uthole amandla akhe ekuthuthukiseni izimo ezinzima. Umcimbi uzoba yithuba lokubona uTrevor edlulisela izifundo ezibalulekile, ezikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo, baphinde bakhuthaze abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uTrevor uthole udumo emhlabeni jikelele, futhi umcimbi uzoba yithuba lokuhlangana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejabulile futhi bejabulisa. Uhlelo luzoba nezingxenye ezihlukahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinkulumo ezimnandi, izimvo ezijulile, kanye nezinsiza ezithokozisayo ezizokwenza abantu bacabange futhi bahlekise. Ukwazi ukuthi uTrevor Noah ungumuntu ophuma ezimweni ezinzima, uzokwenza umcimbi ube neqhaza elikhulu. Uhlanga lwezinto ezithokozisayo, izinkumbulo ezihlekisayo, kanye nezifundo ezinzulu kuzokwenza umcimbi ube yinto engasoze yalibaleka. Abantu bazobe bejabulile, behlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi bezokwazi ukufunda okuningi ngempilo, uthando, kanye nezifundo ezibalulekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi uzoba yithuba lokuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha. UTrevor Noah uzoba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi, noma ngabe izimo zikhathaza, umuntu angathola indlela yokuphila impilo enenjongo. Uhlelo luzoba yithuba lokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enenhloso, baphinde bakhuthaze abanye ukuba benze okufanayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi uzoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza, uTrevor Noah ubonisa ukuthi kukhona ithemba. Uhlelo luzoba yithuba lokuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha.
