Iphrofayela kaThando Mthembu: Umholi Wezokuthengisa UThando Mthembu, owazalwa emadodeni amancane eThekwini, udume njengomholi wezokuthengisa onolwazi olunzulu nolubanzi. Ngesikhathi eseyingane, uThando wakhula ebona ubunzima abantu abahlangabezana nabo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa, lapho abantu bephakathi kwezinkampani ezihlukahlukene bekhombisa ukukhathazeka ngokuthi izimpahla zabo zingathengiswa kanjani. Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla wakhe wokufuna ukuqonda izimfihlo zokuthengisa. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe ephakeme eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uThando waqala umsebenzi wakhe njengejaji kwezokuthengisa. Lapho, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngamasu ahlukene okuthengisa, ehlanganisa izindlela zokumaketha ezisematheni ezinjengezokuxhumana nabantu, izikhangiso eziku-inthanethi, nokwakhiwa kwegama lomkhiqizo. UThando wayengasithandi ukusho ukuthi udinga ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezokuthengisa, futhi wathola amathuba amaningi okusebenza ezinkampanini ezinkulu, ezazizama ukuthola izixazululo ezintsha zokuhweba. Ubuye wakhombisa ubuhlakani obukhulu, ethola amacebo amaningi okwakha ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kwabathengi nezinkampani. Waqala ukwakha izinhlelo zokumaketha ezihlanganisa ukuthengisa okwenziwe ngqo, ukuhweba ngodaba, nokusebenzisa izithombe ezithakazelisayo. Lokhu kwenze ukuthi izinkampani azisebenzelayo zibe neqhaza elikhulu emakethe, zikhula zibe nesithakazelo esikhulu kubathengi. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza, uThando waqubuka emkhakheni wezokuthengisa, waba nguMphakathi Wokuthengisa oMkhulu enkampanini enkulu yokuthengisa eNingizimu Afrika. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphezulu zokuthengisa ezazihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuhamba phambili, njengokusebenzisa ama-analytics ukuze kuqondwe kahle izidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kuqonda kahle izimfuno zabathengi kwenze ukuthi izinkampani zikwazi ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zabo, zenze ukwakhiwa kwempumelelo. UThando ungumuntu ophokophelelayo, njalo efuna ukufunda nokuthola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto. Ubuye abe nomoya omuhle wokubambisana, ethanda ukusebenza nabanye ukuze athuthukise imiphumela. Izifundo zempilo zikaThando zifaka phakathi Ukuzenzela, Ubuqotho, kanye Nobuchwepheshe, ezimkhuthazayo ukuba ahlale esebenzisa izindlela zokuqonda ezokuthengisa. Ngaphandle komsebenzi wakhe, uThando unothando lokuhlanganyela emphakathini. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni imifino yezokuthengisa ezizokhulisa ubuchwepheshe bempilo, edala amathuba emisebenzi nokukhuthaza abantu abasha ukuba babe neqhaza emnothweni. UThando ubelokhu ehlanganisa izifundo zempilo nezokuthengisa, ethuthukisa izinhlelo zokuhweba ezihlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa ezokuthengisa ezikoleni. UThando Mthembu ungumholi onemibono emikhulu, othanda ukusebenzela abantu, futhi ubamba iqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezokuthengisa. Izifundo zakhe, umoya wakhe, kanye nezifiso zakhe zokwenza ngcono izimpilo zabantu zenza abe ngumholi ophawulekayo emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Njengoba eqhubeka nokwakha igama lakhe, uThando uphakathi kokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo, eliqhakazile, nolwazi oluqinile emhlabeni wezokuthengisa. Njengoba eshaya izigaba ezintsha, uThando uhlala eqhubeka nokuhlola imikhakha emisha, ethola izindlela zokwenza izinkampani zikhule futhi zikhule, kanti ngaleso sikhathi, ubamba iqhaza lokwakha umphakathi oqinile, onobuchwepheshe, nokwazisa izimfuno zomphakathi. UThando Mthembu ungumholi ophambili kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi umhlaba wezokuthengisa usawuhambela phambili ngenxa yomsebenzi wakhe omuhle.
Umbiko: Inkolo Nomoya Isingeniso Inkolo nomoya kuyizinto eziyisisekelo empilweni yabantu emhlabeni wonke. Lezi zinto ezimbili zixhumene kakhulu, ziqukethe izimfundiso, imikhuba, nezinkolelo ezahlukene ezakhiwa impilo yabantu ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene. Kulokhu, sizohlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkolo nomoya, sihlole izinzuzo zazo, ukufana, kanye nokwehlukaniswa kwazo. Inhloso Nezinhloso Zenkolo Inkolo ithathwa njengendlela yokuphila, ibonisa indlela esikhetha ngayo ukuphila nokuhlola umqondo wokuphila. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zenhlalo, ezifana neKristu, iSlam, iHinduism, neBuddhism, zinikeza izimfundiso ezihlukene, ezihlanganisa imikhuba yokukhuleka, imikhosi, nemikhosi ethile. Inkolo ibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu noMdali, futhi ihlale ibandakanya izinkulumo zokuhlala kuxhumene, kuhambisana nemithetho, ukuze kuzuze umphakathi ogculisayo. Umoya: Ukuxhumana Ngesipiritu Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umoya ubhekisela emoyeni ongenamkhawulo, okuhlanganisa imicabango, imizwa, nemikhuba yokusondela kumandla aphezulu. Umoya uhlanganisa izinkolelo ezihlinzeka ngencazelo yempilo, ubuhlakani, nezinsiza zokuphila. Ezinye izindawo, umoya uthathwa njengendlela yokuxhumana nemimoya, imithwalo, nezinsiza ezithuthukisa ukuphila kwabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umoya awuhlangene kuphela nomoya wenkolo, kodwa uthinta futhi indlela umuntu aziveza ngayo. Ukufana Phakathi Kwenkolo Nomoya Noma inkolo nomoya kubonakala njengezinto ezihlukene, zikhona izindawo lapho zihlangana khona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinkolelo ezibhalwe emandleni amahle, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza kwezomoya ezithinta impilo kaNkulunkulu. Izinkolo eziningi zingafaka umoya, ziqinisa ukholo, futhi zifundise ukuphila kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwalezi zinto ezimbili kubonisa impilo ethile yokuphila ngendlela ehloniphekile. Ubufakazi Bokuhlangana Kwenkolo Nomoya Abantu banothando lokuhlola umoya ngokufunda imibhalo engcwele, ukucabanga, nokwenza imikhuba ethile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nomoya ongaziwa, kubandakanya imikhuba efana nezikhathi zokuhlola, izikhumbuzo, kanye namazwi okukhulula. Imicabango yomoya ibonisa ukuzitika, ukujula, kanye nocwaningo oluhlola impilo. Abantu abafunda ngempela umoya bazama ukuzithokozisa ukuze baqonde umqondo wabo wempilo. Izinzuzo Zokuhlanganiswa Kwenkolo Nomoya Ukwesekwa kwenkolo nomoya kudala umphakathi onenhlalakahle, uthando, nokwazisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu bahlala bexhumene, befundanisa imibono, futhi baphila ngendlela ethulile. Izinzuzo zalesi sikhathi ziqukethe ukuzola, ukuthola umphakathi, nokukhuthaza ukucabanga. Umoya uhlanganisa ukujula kokucabanga, ukuthula kwengqondo, kanye nokubheka umqondo wokuphila. Imiphumela Emibili: Ukuqhubeka Nobudlelwano Obomile Umoya nomoya kufanele kuxoxwe ukuze kuqondwe ngokuphelele izinzuzo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa uthando nethuba lokuphila lapho abantu bezwakala bejabule. Abantu kufanele baqhubeke bezilungiselela izikhalazo ngezinkolo nomoya ukuze baqhubeke bezithokozisa. Isiphetho Ukuhlanganiswa kwenkolo nomoya kudinga ukunakwa, ukufunda, nokubambisana. Lokhu kuqhuba izintuthuko ezinhle, nezindlela zokuphila ezigcwele uthando. Ngakho, abantu bahlola lokho okukhona, bazi ukuthi amaqhawe ethu asuka kuphi, futhi bahlanganise umoya, inkolo, kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili empilweni. Lokhu kudala amandla okuthula, ukujula kwezimfundiso, nemisha efanelanga empilweni yethu, okwenza impilo ibe nokuqonda okukhulu.
### uCassper Nyovest: Umculi, Umphakathi, Nomphakathi U-Cassper Nyovest, igama eliqhakazile kwabezindaba, ungumculi odumile ongowaseMzansi, kanti uye wavula indlela ezintweni eziningi ezithinta umculo, ubuciko, nezokuxhumana. Uqale ukuheha ukunakwa kwabantu ngesikhathi ethola ithuba lokudlala emculweni, futhi ashiye umthelela omkhulu emhlabeni womculo we-hip hop. U-Cassper akakhulumi nje kuphela ngezingoma, kodwa uthinta izimpilo zabantu, ikakhulukazi abasha, ngempilo yakhe, izifundo, nezifiso. U-Cassper, ogama lakhe langempela lingu-Refiloe Maele Phoolo, wazalelwa eMamelodi, eTshwane. Njengomntwana, wayenohlanga olukhulu lokuhlupheka, kodwa lokho akuzange kumthinte kakhulu. Uthole ukuthi umculo ungumgibeli wokuphunyuka ezintweni ezinzima. Waqala ukufunda ukudansa, nokuhlanganisa umculo, wakhula esebenza kanzima ukuze abe ngumculi ophumelele. Uthole ukuthi uma uzama, akukho okungafinyelelwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uCassper wathola ithuba lokukhuluma ngezimpilo zabantu bakhe. Izingoma zakhe zihlala zixoxa izindaba ezihanjiswa ezimpilweni zabo, zikhuthaza abalandeli bakhe. U-Cassper uthanda ukwakha izingoma ezinezincazelo ezijulile, ezithinta imizwa nemicabango yabantu. Izinhlelo zakhe zihlala zikhangisa uthando, ithemba, kanye nesibindi sokulwa nezinkinga. U-Cassper udume ngempela ngempumelelo yakhe eMzanzi. Ubuye waba neqhaza elikhulu emsebenzini wezokuxhumana. Uthola amandla amakhulu kubalandeli bakhe, eba umphakathi ophilayo nabantu abasha abamlandelayo. U-Cassper uchaza izinto ezinjengokwenza umculo, ukuphila, kanye nokuhlonipha. Uye waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi, uma unethemba, ungakwenza konke. Ngaphandle kokuba umculi, u-Cassper uphinde abe neqhaza elikhulu kumphakathi. Uhlala ebamba imicimbi ehlukahlukene, eqhuba imikhankaso yokusiza abantu abavela ezimweni ezinzima. U-Cassper uvame ukuxhasa imikhankaso yokunakekela impilo, ukusiza abantwana, kanye nokukhuthaza imfundo. Lokhu kusebenza kwempilo yakhe kudinga ukuhlonishwa, njengoba ayehlala edlulisa umyalezo wokuthi umphakathi ubaluleke kakhulu. U-Cassper akagcini nje ngempumelelo yakhe, kodwa uveza izifiso nezifundo zakhe. Uhlale efundisa abanye ngezenzo zakhe. Umsebenzi wakhe unjengomfanekiso wokuhlola, nokukhuthaza abanye ukuthi bafeze amaphupho abo. U-Cassper uyazi ukuthi impumelelo ayifinyelelwa kalula, kudingeka umsebenzi, ukuzikhandla, kanye nesifiso sokwenza ngcono. Ezinye zezinto ezithokozisayo ngempilo kaCassper zimi kanje: ungumuntu oqhubeka ethuthukisa izifundo nemikhuba emisha. U-Cassper uyalwela ukuba nomsebenzi omuhle, futhi akafuni ukuthola umphakathi ophuthumayo. Uye wayengumholi, aphinde abe nesandla sokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi abasha. U-Cassper uyazi ukuthi umculo ungumsebenzi ongenakwenziwa ngokuphazamiseka, futhi uphinde akhumbuze abantu ukuthi izinqumo ezinhle zingaba nemiphumela emihle. Uhlale ebonisa ukuthi kudinga ukuhamba phambili, nokugcina ithemba. U-Cassper akasabi ukuba phambili, futhi lokhu kuyamkhuthaza. Ngokuphetha, uCassper Nyovest ungumculi, umphakathi, kanye nomholi. Ubonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayigcini nje emculweni, kodwa ikhulisa abantu, ibakhuthaze, ibavule izindlela. U-Cassper uyisibonelo sokuthi, uma unethemba, ungagcina unyaka wakho uhlelekile. Uthanda abalandeli bakhe, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umculo unamandla, ungakwazi ukusiza, futhi ungakwazi ukwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu. Ngakho, uma ubuka uCassper, ubona ukuthi akugcini nje ngomculo, kodwa ubonisa indlela yokuphila.
Ukukhokha intela kuvamise ukuba kudingeke ngosuku olukhululiwe esikhangisweni sokuhlola intela noma yisiphi isikhangiso sokukhokha esikhishwe yiMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Uma le mali ingakhokhwa ngosuku olukhululiwe, uzothola izinzalo nezijeziso. Uma ungakwazi ukukhokha le mali edingekayo ngosuku olukhululiwe, ungafaka isicelo sokuhleleka kokukhokha ukuze ukhokhe le mali ngemuva kwesikhathi. Ukukhokha le mali ngemuva mayelana nebhala lakho kungavunywa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, kuye ngezizathu zalesi sicelo. I-SARS izobheka isicelo sakho futhi yenze isinqumo sokuthi ivumele ukuhlela kokukhokha kamuva. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi i-SARS igcina ilungelo lokwenqaba isicelo sakho. Kufanele usayine isivumelwano sokuhlela ukukhokha ngaphambi kokuthi lezi zinhlelo ziqoshwe kwi-rekhodi yakho yentela. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wokukhokha intela owehlulekile ukukhokha ngemuva njengoba kuchaziwe esivumelwaneni osayine ne-SARS, izinhlelo zesivumelwano zizokhanselwa, futhi inqubo ejwayelekile yokubolekwa izimali izoqala. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa. Akudingeki ukuthi ugcwalise amafomu.
Isinqumo somnyango sikhonjiswa encwadini yokuvuma noma yokwenqaba. Imigomo yokuvuma itholakala kumarekhodi wesinqumo (ROD), okufaka phakathi encwadini yokuvuma. Isicelo sokuphikisa kumele sihambisane nawo wonke amadokhumenti afanele noma amakhophi aqinisekisiwe wale midokhumenti athunyelwe kumkomishana ophakanyisiwe. Isicelo sokuphikisa kumele sikhombise wonke amaqiniso nezizathu zokufaka isicelo sokuphikisa. Ingabe ufaka lesi sicelo sokuphikisa njengomuntu siqu noma egameni lomphakathi/isenzo? Uma ufaka egameni lomphakathi noma inhlangano, sicela unikeze ubufakazi obuvumela ukuthi wenze kanjalo. Ingabe isicelo sakho sokuphikisa sincike ezindaweni ezihlobene nenqubo eyalandelwa umfaki-sicelo wokuvuma? Ingabe isicelo sakho sokuphikisa sincike ezindaweni ezihlobene nemiphumela yemvelo engamukeleki eyayingenakucwaswa umnyango ngesikhathi wenqaba noma uvuma isicelo? Ingabe uyavuma ukuqhubeka nale msebenzi uma ukukhathazeka kwakho kungaxazululwa ngokuhlela kabusha uhlelo noma ngokucacisa noma ukususa okukhona njengomphumela walomsebenzi? Ingabe uqinisekile ukuthi uphikisa ukuhlinzekwa kwalomsebenzi endaweni eyenziwa kuyo? Ingabe isicelo sakho sokuphikisa siqukethe ulwazi olusha olungazange lunikezwe umxhumanisi wemvelo noma umnyango ngaphambi kokuba umnyango ucabangele isicelo sakho? Uma impendulo yakho phezulu iyavuma, sicela uchaze ukuthi kungani umphathiswa engafanele ukukubheka nokuthi kungani lokhu kungazange kunikezwe umxhumanisi wemvelo noma umnyango ngesikhathi senqubo yesicelo. Angiphikisi ukuthi lesi sicelo sokuphikisa sithunyelwe yiliphi iqembu lesithathu elithakazelisayo nelithintekayo kanye/noma ilungu lomphakathi, njengoba ngiqonda ukuthi inqubo ye-EIA iyinzuzo yomphakathi.
Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi Lwezempilo Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ithuba lokukhuluma noDkt. Sipho Mthembu, ongumcwaningi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezempilo, ukuze sixoxe ngokuqhubekayo kokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ezweni lethu. U-Dkt. Mthembu, ungumholi emkhakheni wezempilo, futhi ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Ngiyabonga, Dkt. Mthembu, ngokuthatha isikhathi sakho ukusinika lo mbhalo obalulekile. Umbuzo 1: Uhlonze kanjani ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? U-Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle kubantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo ezifana nezibhedlela, izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, nezikhungo zokucwaninga. Ukufakwa kwalezi zikhungo kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinsiza, kanye nezisebenzi ezinamakhono ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lufinyelela kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? U-Dkt. Mthembu: Kunezinto eziningi ezibhekene nezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo. Okokuqala, sinesidingo sokwandisa ukufinyelela kwemininingwane. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abasemaphandleni, abazi kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani ulwazi lwezempilo. Okwesibili, izinsiza zethu zihlala zinciphile. Izikhungo eziningi zidinga ukwandiswa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi eziphezulu. Futhi, okokugcina, kudinga ukuba kube nokusebenzisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze ulwazi lutholakale kalula. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasiza kanjani ekufakweni kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? U-Dkt. Mthembu: Ngempela, ubuchwepheshe bukhona njengomngane wethu. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo zokuphatha iziguli, zenza kube lula ukugcina amarekhodi nezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-inthanethi iyinsiza enkulu yokwabelana ngolwazi. Izikhungo zingasebenzisa amawebhusayithi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokugcina abantu benolwazi olwakamuva. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi lwezempilo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenawo amathuba okukhuluma nabachwepheshe. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? U-Dkt. Mthembu: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile. Okokuqala, sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze baqonde izidingo zomphakathi. Okwesibili, kudinga ukuba kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze kube nokwabelana ngolwazi. Futhi, sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana nabantu ukuze sithole impendulo ngempela mayelana nezidingo zabo. Umbuzo 5: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo? U-Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ikusasa lisezandleni zethu. Uma sithuthukisa izikhungo zethu, sithuthukisa nempilo yomphakathi. Ngibona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buzodlala indima enkulu, futhi uma sikwazi ukuxhumana kahle nabantu, sizokwazi ukwakha izikhungo ezizokwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza ekwakheni lezi zikhungo, ukuze sibe nezinsiza ezithuthukile ezizokwazi ukusiza bonke. Isiphetho Siyabonga, Dkt. Mthembu, ngokwabelana ngalezi zihloko ezibalulekile. Ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Sizobheka phambili ekusebenzeni ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo kubantu bonke. Ngiyabonga futhi!
Uma umuntu ethola imali ethintwa intela kodwa engakhishwa ku-SITE noma ku-PAYE, kumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kulokho kuhlomula. Intela yesikhashana ikhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Inhloso yentela yesikhashana ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zabo zentela kancane kancane kunokukhokha inani elikhulu ekupheleni konyaka lapho umthwalo wentela uqashelwa. Intela yesikhashana izokhokhwa ukuze kuncishiswe inani elikhokhwayo uma kuqhathaniswa nemali yonke okufanele ikhokhwe ngumuntu kulonyaka wentela ofanele. Umuntu okumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kumele athumele isicelo esibhaliwe sokubhaliswa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezimali laseNingizimu Afrika phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemva kokuba sebecabanga ukukhokha. Ukwehluleka ukwenza lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni kube nezintshisekelo nezijeziso zokukhokha sekwedlule, kanye nentela eyengeziwe ehambisana nezinkokhelo eziphuthumayo. Inkokhelo yesithathu ibizwa nangokuthi "eyengeziwe" noma "ukwengeza" kwentela yesikhashana. Lapho le nkokhelo yenziwa, kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina. Usuku "lokusebenza" lubhekisela esikhathini lapho unyaka wentela uphela khona ngosuku lwe-28 noma lwe-29 kuFebhuwari, ezinyangeni eziyisixhenxe ngemva kokwamukelwa kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, ophela ngosuku olungelona lwe-28 noma lwe-29 kuFebhuwari, ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ngemva kwalokhu. Inkokhelo yesithathu yenziwa ngumuntu okhokha intela yesikhashana ngenhloso yokuba umkhokhi wentela. Abakhokhi bentela abanomthwalo wentela ophakeme kune-R50,000 noma amabhizinisi anomthwalo wentela ophakeme kune-R20,000 bangakwenza inkokhelo yesithathu ngenhloso yokugwema ukukhokhwa kwezintshisekelo zokungakhokhi kahle uma kuhlolwa umthwalo wentela. Inhloso yale nkokhelo ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukukhokha umehluko phakathi kwentela yabasebenzi nentela yesikhashana esivele ikhokhiwe kulonyaka kanye nomthwalo wentela ophelele wokuhlola unyaka. Inkokhelo yesithathu imele umthwalo wentela ophelele wonyaka, kuncishiswe intela yabasebenzi ekhokhiwe wonyaka noma enye intela evunyelwe yokuphuma wonyaka, ngokusekelwe ezimalini ezikhokhiwe phakathi nezikhathi zentela yesikhashana zokuqala nezesibili. Kusemthethweni kumkhokhi wentela nomuntu okhokha intela yesikhashana ukusetha isikhathi esifanele sokwenza inkokhelo yesithathu eyengeziwe. Thola ifomu lokukhokha elisha kwi-SARS noma ulilandele kwi-inthanethi, ugcwalise, bese ulithumela nekhokhelo oyenzayo. Njengoba isaziso sokukhokha sifana kubo bonke futhi singafaki imininingwane ethile yomkhokhi wentela, kubalulekile ukuthi abakhokhi bentela yesikhashana banikeze imininingwane efanele ye-akhawunti kulolu fomu. Uma imininingwane efanele inganikezwa, inkokhelo ngeke ihlale iqondile kumkhokhi wentela. Inombolo yokubhekisela kufanele ibhalwe ngokulandelayo: 1234567123P00032005. Izinkokhelo zentela yesikhashana zingakhokhwa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela eliseduzane kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu phakathi kwehora le-8:00 AM kuya ku-3:00 PM, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi. Uma izinkokhelo zenziwa ngeposi noma zifakwa ebhange, abantu kufanele bavumele isikhathi sokulethwa kweposi noma sokucubungula izinkokhelo zebhange. Uma inkokhelo ithunyelwa ngocingo, abantu kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi ibhange linomkhawulo wesikhathi sokucubungula futhi liphinde lidinge isikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthumeli unama-akhawunti anele, okungathatha izinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu. I-akhawunti lapho imali izofakwa ibizwa nge-akhawunti yokwamukela. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe ingahambisani noma ingahambisani nalokho okukhulunywa ngenhla, ngokwesibalo sentela kanye nenombolo ye-akhawunti yokwamukela, futhi ngeke yamukelwe. Uma usuku lokugcina lokukhokha luhlangana nosuku lokuphumula noma weviki, abantu kufanele bakhokhe inkokhelo ngosuku lokugcina lokusebenza ngaphambi kosuku lokuphumula noma weviki. Inkokhelo yesithathu kumele ibalwe ngaphezu kwenani langempela elikhokhwayo lentela, njengoba inhloso yale nkokhelo ukusiza ukukhokha umehluko phakathi kwentela yabasebenzi nentela yesikhashana ekhokhiwe kulonyaka kanye nomthwalo wentela ophelele walonyaka wentela. Akukho sikhathi esibekwe kulolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahala.
Umkhiqizo kufanele uncike emakethe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uthole ukuthi abathengi bafuna ini (izidingo), bese ukhiqiza (ukuhlinzeka) lowo mkhiqizo ukuze uthengise ukuze uthole inzuzo. Uma intengo ikhula, abathengi bazothenga kancane, kodwa uma intengo yehlile, bazothenga okuningi noma izinhlobo ezahlukene zemikhiqizo. Thola izidingo nezintandokazi zabathengi ngokwenza ucwaningo lwemakethe. Ikhwalithi ibalulekile kakhulu. Kumele ibe mnandi futhi ibukeke kahle! Intengo ibalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ube nenqwaba yokuthengisa. Ukuhlinzeka kubalulekile kakhulu. Kumele ngithole njalo futhi ngesikhathi. Thola ukuthi yiziphi zalezi zimpahla ezifanele ukukhiqiza. Hlela ukukhiqizwa komkhiqizo. Phanda isivuno bese uthola uma sesilungele ukuvuna. Khetha umjikelezo wokumaketha osebenza kahle kakhulu futhi lapho ungathola khona inzuzo enkulu. Uhlelo lokuthengisa lunezinto ezihambisana nezinyathelo ezithatha umkhiqizo usuka kumlimi ufinyelele kumthengi. Ungazuza ngokwengeza inani emikhiqizweni ukuze wandise intshisekelo yakho ngokubandakanyeka ekucwengezeni, ukupakisha, ukugcina, ukucubungula, nokuhweba. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi imbewu, umanyolo, ama-pesticides, amathuluzi, imishini, uphethiloli, umsebenzi, njll. Izindleko zokuhweba zifaka phakathi ukuthuthwa, ukukhangisa, nokugcina. Izindleko zokupakisha zifaka phakathi ukuphawula, izinto zokupakisha, umsebenzi, ukugcina, umshwalense, njll. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi izinto, ukuthuthwa, ukupakisha, ukuhlanganisa, umsebenzi, ugesi, njll. Ukuze unciphise izindleko emjikelezweni wokuthengisa, ungasebenzisa umjikelezo omfushane ngokuthengisa ngqo kumthengi. Ukwengeza inani ngokupakisha nokugcina amanani ukuze kube nentshisekelo kukhiqiza imali eningi. Ukwengeza inani ngokucubungula kukhuphula inani ngomkhiqizo futhi kukhuphula imali engenayo... Abalimi bathengisa imikhiqizo ngqo kubathengi. Abalimi bathengisa kubathengi noma abantu abathenga ukuze bathengise. Ukuthengiswa kwenziwa ngababambiqhaza bemakethe abathengisa kumlimi futhi bathola ikhomishini. Ikhwalithi, ukupakisha, nokubukeka kubalulekile kakhulu, futhi umkhiqizo kufanele uhambisane nezindinganiso zokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi ezamukelekayo nezindinganiso zokupakisha. Izindawo ezivaliwe zokukhiqiza izinkomo zinikeza umsebenzi wokuthengisa kubalimi. Umlimi uthengisa ngqo kumthengisi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokuhweba. Ikhwalithi, intengo, nokulethwa kubalulekile kakhulu. Inhlangano yabalimi ithengisa isivuno ngokuhlanganyela emakethe esemthethweni. U relationship phakathi kwezindleko nentengo = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa.
Inqubekela Phambili Yokuqedwa Kwezindlu Zangasese Zemigodi Ezikoleni Isingeniso Ukuze kuqedwe izindlu zangasese ezisemigodini ezikoleni, kudingeka uhlelo olucacile nolusebenza kahle. Lezi zinyathelo zizokwenza kube lula ukuqeda izindlu zangasese ezingasebenzi kahle, ukuze abafundi bahlale endaweni enempilo futhi ephumelelayo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlola Isimo Samanje 1. Bheka Izindlu Zangasese: Qala ngokuhlola zonke izindlu zangasese ezikoleni. Bheka isimo sazo, ubude bazo, kanye nezinkinga ezikhona. 2. Thola Imibiko: Xhumana nabafundi, othisha, nabazali ukuze uthole imibiko mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. 3. Bhala Uhlolo: Qopha imiphumela yokuhlola, ubhale izinkinga ezitholakele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlela Uhlelo Lokwakha 1. Hlela Uhlelo: Dala uhlelo lokwakha oluhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi izindlu zangasese zizobuyiselwa kanjani. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinsiza, izinsuku, nezindleko. 2. Thola Abahlinzeki: Xhumana nabahlinzeki bezinsiza zokwakha ukuze uthole iziqu zokwakha, izinto ezidingekayo, nezindleko. 3. Thola Imvume: Qinisekisa ukuthi uthola zonke izimvume ezidingekayo ezivela kuhulumeni noma ezikhungweni ezifanele. Isinyathelo 3: Ukubandakanya Umphakathi 1. Bika Umphakathi: Thumela izaziso kumphakathi mayelana nohlelo lokwakha, ubalule izinzuzo zokuphuculwa kwezindlu zangasese. 2. Bamba Imihlangano: Hlela imihlangano ukuze ubonise uhlelo, uphendule imibuzo, futhi uthole iziphakamiso. 3. Bamba Abantu Abavela Emphakathini: Khuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza, kungaba ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza noma ngokusebenza ngezandla. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuqala Ukusebenza 1. Hlela Usuku Lokusebenza: Nquma usuku lokuqala lokwakha. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abahlinzeki, abasebenzi, nababambiqhaza bayavuma. 2. Qala Ukusebenza: Qala umsebenzi wokwakha. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi iyenziwa ngendlela efanele futhi iphephile. 3. Bheka Inqubekela Phambili: Bheka inqubekela phambili yomsebenzi nsuku zonke, uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqedela Nokuhlola 1. Qeda Ukusebenza: Uma umsebenzi usuphelile, qinisekisa ukuthi izindlu zangasese zihlanzekile futhi zilungile. 2. Hlola Izindlu Zangaphandle: Bheka izindlu zangasese ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Qiniseka ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezifanele, njengezibani, amanzi, nezinto zokuhlanza. 3. Bika Umphakathi: Thumela imibiko kumphakathi mayelana nokuphothulwa komsebenzi. Bika izinzuzo ezitholakele. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuqhubeka Nokugcina 1. Hlela Ukuhlola Okuvamile: Hlela ukuhlola okuvamile kwezindlu zangasese ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisesimweni esihle. 2. Thola Impendulo: Thola impendulo kubafundi, othisha, nabazali ukuze uqonde ukuthi izindlu zangasese zisebenza kanjani. 3. Phucula Uhlelo: Sebenzisa impendulo ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokugcina izindlu zangasese, uqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ukuqedwa kwezindlu zangasese zemigodi ezikoleni kudinga ukuhlela kahle, ukubandakanya umphakathi, kanye nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Ngalezi zinyathelo, singaqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bahlala endaweni enempilo, ethokomele, futhi ethuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda nokukhula, futhi kuzothuthukisa impilo yabafundi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kuzokwenza leli phrojekthi libe yimpumelelo, futhi kuzokhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izimo zokuhlala.
ukusekela imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ezindaweni zokusebenza zikamasipala. Ukuqinisa ukuhlonipha phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo kanye phakathi kwabaphethe nabantu abasebenzayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphethe nabantu abasebenzayo banokuqonda okuvumelekile mayelana nokuziphatha okungalungile nokuziphatha okufanele. Ukukhuthaza indlela evumelekile yokuphatha. Ukuhlinzeka abaphethe nabantu abasebenzayo ngomsindo osheshayo nolula wokubika ukuziphatha okungalungile. Futhi ukuvimbela ukungabheki umthetho noma ukucwasa abantu abasebenzayo ngabaphathi. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyindlela yokulungisa, hhayi eyokuhlukumeza. Ukuziphatha okufanele kufanele kwenziwe ngesikhathi, okuvumelekile, okujwayelekile, nokuthuthuka. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuy umsebenzi wobuphathi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithetho kuyadingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe izinkinga ngokushesha nokwelashwa okufanele kwabantu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo: a. banethuba elilinganayo lokukhuluma ngezinhlelo ezihlelwe nezingeziwe. b. bagcinwa beqaphele ngezimo zokuziphatha okungalungile ezenzakalayo kubo. c. bathola izizathu ezibhaliwe zazo zonke izinqumo ezibhaliwe, futhi d. banelungelo lokuphikisa noma iyiphi inqumo. Yonke imizamo izokwenziwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlahlandlela yokuziphatha okungalungile iyenzeka ezindaweni zokusebenza futhi ibikwe kubo bonke abantu abasebenzayo. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ephatha kabi, lokho kungaba yicala, icala elibi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungalungile zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isinyathelo sokuhlukanisa ngokwezindlela zokusebenza ezindaweni zokusebenza asithinti inqubo yomthetho. Lezi zimo nezindlela ziyizikhombandlela kuphela futhi zingashintshwa ngokuya ngezimo ezifanele. Lokhu kuyasebenza kuwo wonke amakhansela ahlobene nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, noma aqukethwe emthethweni noma ezinqubweni. Imithetho, izinqubo, nezindinganiso zokuziphatha. Ukuziphatha ezindaweni zokusebenza okungase kudinge ukuthi umuntu osebenzayo abhekane nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa kuchazwe ku-Anneksure A. Lezi zihloko aziphelele. Ubuphathi bungahola umuntu osebenzayo mayelana nokuziphatha kwabo, inqobo nje uma beqaphele, noma kufanele baqaphele ukuthi lokho kuziphatha kudinga isinyathelo sokuhlukanisa. a. izinsolo zokuziphatha okungalungile zinefuthe elikhulu emsebenzini kahulumeni, emnyangweni wezabasebenzi, nasekukhuleni. Izindlela zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungalungile. Izeluleko zokulungisa ukuziphatha okungalungile. Ezimweni lapho kubalulekile ukusungula ukubaluleka kokuziphatha okungalungile, umphathi kufanele akwenze lokhu. a. azise umuntu osebenzayo ngokuziphatha kwabo okungalungile. b. Chaza kumuntu osebenzayo icala elibhekiswe kubo, bese unika ithuba lokukhuluma ngale cala abhekene nakho. d. Thatha isinyathelo sokulungisa esivumelwene. Isixwayiso sokukhuluma. Uma umuntu owonile edinga isixwayiso, isixwayiso singanikezwa ngokukhuluma. Umphathi kufanele azise umuntu osebenzayo ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokuziphatha kabi, bangabhekana nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa, futhi isixwayiso sizobhaliswa. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso esibhaliwe, umphathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhishwa isixwayiso esibhaliwe. b. umphathi kufanele anikeze umuntu osebenzayo ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele basayine. Uma bengavumi ukusayina, umphathi kufanele anikeze omunye umuntu osebenzayo ukuze asayine njengofakazi wokuthi umuntu owonile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela lempilo yomuntu osebenzayo. d. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe sithintwa umthetho isikhathi esiyizinyanga eziyisithupha. Ekupheleni kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, kufanele kususwe kufayela lempilo futhi kuqedwe. e. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ethola icala phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa okufanele athole. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe, umphathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhishwa isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. b. umphathi kufanele anikeze umuntu osebenzayo ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele basayine. Uma bengavumi ukusayina, umphathi kufanele anikeze omunye umuntu osebenzayo ukuze asayine njengofakazi wokuthi umuntu owonile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela lempilo yomuntu osebenzayo. d. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe sithintwa umthetho isikhathi esiyizinyanga eziyisithupha. Ekupheleni kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, kufanele kususwe kufayela lempilo futhi kuqedwe. e. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ethola icala phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa okufanele athole. Izigameko ezifanayo ezihlobene nabantu abasebenzayo kufanele zithole izixwayiso ezifanayo ukuqinisekisa indlela ejwayelekile yokuhlukanisa noma yokubhekana nokuziphatha okungalungile. Uma icala elibhekiswe kumuntu osebenzayo libaluleke kakhulu, kudinga ukuthi kube nepenalty ehlukile kunalezo ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni esingu-15, umphathi angase aqale uphenyo mayelana nepenalty. Umphathi kufanele aqoke ummeli ukuze aqale uphenyo, okumele kube umphathi. Isaziso sokuphenya a. umuntu osebenzayo kufanele anikezwe isaziso okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela. b. Umuntu osebenzayo kufanele asayine isaziso esiqinisekisa usuku lokulalela. Uma bengavumi ukusayina, kufanele banikezwe omunye umuntu osebenzayo ozosayina ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umuntu owonile uthole isaziso. Incazelo ephelele yokuziphatha okungalungile, ubufakazi umphathi ozosebenzisa. Ulwazi mayelana namalungelo abantu abasebenzayo, abamele abantu abasebenzayo noma abamele inhlangano yezabasebenzi eyamukelekayo, kanye nalabo abazobeka ubufakazi. a. umphathi angamphumula umuntu osebenzayo noma amukele imali yakhe ngokuphelele, noma amtransfer kuMnyango omunye wenhlangano. Ngaphansi kwalezi zimo; uma umuntu osebenzayo ebhekene noma enza icala elibi, futhi umphathi ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela komuntu osebenzayo emsebenzini kungaphazamisa uphenyo lwecala elibhekiswe kubo, noma kube yingozi empilweni yomuntu noma impahla kahulumeni. c. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ephumuliwe noma ethunyelwe, umphathi kufanele abambe ukulalela phakathi kwenyanga. Umphathi wokulalela uzokwenza isinqumo sokuthi icala lizophumelela yini. a. Ukulalela kufanele kwenziwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokuthi isaziso sinikezwe kumuntu osebenzayo. b. Umphathi wokulalela kufanele abe sezingeni eliphezulu kunommeleli womuntu osebenzayo. Uma umuntu osebenzayo obhekiswe icala engumholi womnyango, umphathi wokulalela kufanele abe yisikhulu esip
I-Folio strap: Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi. Ngesikhathi se-NAMPO 2009, ingxenye yeziqu ze-250 Ton Club kanye nabanye abalimi abasha bamenywa emhlanganweni. Sikholelwa ukuthi isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi abakhiqizi abamnyama abasha bakhuphule izwi labo futhi baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. I-inshurensi yokuqala iwukulima. Kunombuzo obalulekile okufanele ubuziwe thina lapha eNingizimu Afrika - ingabe sifuna ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele lapha, noma ingabe sifuna ukubhekana nengcuphe yokuthola ukudla kwamanye amazwe? Ukwenza inzuzo ekulimeni ukudla okuyisisekelo kun压力 okukhulu kangangokuthi abalimi abaningi abakwazi ukuphumelela manje nakusasa? Abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bavame ukulima ezindaweni ezomile, futhi manje baphikisana nokudla okuyisisekelo okuvela kwamanye amazwe. Njalo lokhu kudla kukhula ezindaweni ezinokunethezeka, futhi abanye abalimi bathola ukwesekwa kuhulumeni wabo. INingizimu Afrika akufanele ivumele ukudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe athengiswe lapha. Ukuhamba ngemigwaqo kubi futhi uhlelo lwezitimela alusebenzi kahle. Uhlelo lokuhamba ngezitimela ludinga ukuvuselelwa. Azikho izintela zokudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe ezivikela abalimi bendawo. Izintela zokudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe kufanele zethulwe ukuze zivikela abalimi bethu. Eminyakeni emihle sibe neziphumo ezinkulu ze-maize, manje awekho amanye amaqhamuka angafakwa ukuze kulethwe inzuzo kubalimi - ama-grains, amabele, kanye ne-soybeans nakho kukhiqizwa ngezinga elikhulu, intengo yemakethe iphansi kakhulu, abalimi abakwazi ukufaka izitshalo uma amapulazi ebhekene kuphela nezimvula. Uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi "ukuguqulwa komhlaba" kufanele lwenziwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ezindaweni ezihluphekayo, ukudla akufanele kufakwe, utshani kufanele bufakwe ukuze kukhiqizwe inyama. Imakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele yande. Izindlela zokulima ezintsha kanye nobuchwepheshe kuholele ekukhuleni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, manje sekukhona ukudla okuningi. Abalimi kufanele basebenzise izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko ezifana nokulima "okungagqokile". Kunokwehluka okukhulu phakathi kwentengo yemakethe ethola umalimi kanye nentengo ekhokhwa umthengi esitolo - uma othile phakathi ethatha inani elincane kokubili, bobabili umalimi nomthengi bazothola inzuzo. Ulwazi ngalokhu kufanele lutholakale kalula ukuze bonke ababamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokukhiqiza nokuthenga ukudla bazi. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphansi. Lapho kuba nesivumelwano sokwakha izinto ezimbi mayelana nemakethe, kufanele kuhlolwe kahle. Izindleko eziphezulu zokubolekwa kwemali. I-Land Bank kufanele ihlinzeke ngemalimboleko ngentela ephansi. Imakethe yokudla ingaba phansi kakhulu. Ibhonasi ingakhokhwa ngokusekelwe ekukhiqizweni kwabalamini abasha. Lokhu kungasiza labo abasebenza ngokuzikhandla. Izindawo eziningi ezibekwe zilahlekile, zingakhiqizi lutho - imizamo eminingi iphelelwe yisikhathi. Izindlela zokukhetha kufanele zifake ukuqeqeshwa ekulimeni komlimi othile nolwazi lwabo. Ubufakazi obudingekayo obukhombisa ulwazi lwabo abafuna ukuwina. Khuthaza (azise) indlela yezinhlangano ezithenga futhi zithengise izinto lapho kukhethwa abatholi kanye nokwesekwa abakhiqizi. Sekela labo abanikwe amathuba. Abasebenzi boMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba abazi lutho ngezindaba zokulima. Abapolitiki abaqondi kahle okwenzeka ekulimeni. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela - izivumelwano eziningi zilahlekile. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthola uxhaso. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Imigomo ephethe lezi zindaba iyashintsha njalo. Lokhu okufundwayo kufanele kufakwe emsebenzini. Ukuba nomhlaba kuphela akusizi ekugcineni. Kukhona nezinye izidingo ezifana nezilwane, imishini, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ekuqaleni. Abakhiqizi banomfutho omkhulu wokuthola izimali futhi bayakhohlwa ukuthi abanamandla noma izinsiza zokulwa nezindleko zemalimboleko nezindleko zokuqala zokulima. I-Land Bank kufanele ihlinzeke abakhiqizi ngokuqonda ukuze bakwazi ukuvusa izindleko eziphezulu zemali. Abakhiqizi badinga ukwesekwa nokuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane mayelana nokumaketha ukudla kwabo okuyisisekelo. Abakhiqizi badinga imiyalezo eqondile mayelana nemakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo. Izinhlangano ezithole uxhaso oluvela kwi-Land Bank ne-IDC azitholi inzuzo ezingeni eliphansi. Kufanele kube nokwaziswa okungcono mayelana nezintela. Imalimboleko ivame ukuvunywa sekwedlule. Imalimboleko kufanele ivunywe ngokushesha ukuze abakhiqizi bakwazi ukuhlela ukufaka izitshalo ngonyaka ozayo. Izaphulelo ngenani lemali ekhokhwa yizinkampani ezinikeza izinsiza zokuqala zokulima azinikezwa kubalimi. Abalimi abasha badinga ukuwina kulezi zaphulelo zezimali. Uhulumeni kufanele enze ini? I-tariff yokungenisa ukudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe kufanele ivikele abakhiqizi bendawo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko ezingu-35% ze-inshurensi yokuqala yokulima esingakavikelwanga. Kufanele kube nesisekelo kuhulumeni sokuguqula amapulazi ahluphekayo abe yizinkomo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa i-pH yomhlabathi ngokufaka i-lime lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa amazinga e-phosphate lapho ehla kakhulu emhlabathini. Izinhlelo ezivela emaphandleni ahlukene asekelayo abakhiqizi kufanele zihlanganiswe. Izikhungo ezabelana ngemininingwane kufanele ziye ezinhlakeni ezinikeza izinsiza zokuthuthukisa lokhu kuhanjiswa. Kufanele kube nokugxila ekuthengeni kabusha kwezinto ezomnotho nokuvuselela imishini ekulimeni. Izigaba ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezokulima ophatha umhlaba nokulondolozwa komhlabathi kufanele ziqinisiwe ngababonisi bokwazi.
