"isici esingamukeleki" sisho okuthile okungcolile ngokwezincazelo zomthetho ngaphansi koMthetho Womkhiqizo Wezinsiza, uMthetho Wokuhlobisa Nezibulali-zinambuzane, kanye "nezimo zokudla eziphakanyisiwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezempilo" kuchaza izimo ezijwayelekile zezindawo zokudla ezithile kanye nezokuthutha kwakho njengoba kushicilelwe kuGazethi Yesaziso No. izinkomo eziyishumi noma izinkunzi eziyisithupha; noma izinkomo ezincane ezine noma izinkomo ezimbili ezibhalwe noma inkunzi eyodwa. Ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokubulala, udwebo lwesakhiwo esiphakanyisiwe kumele lunikezwe kumphakathi wesifunda ukuze luhlolwe futhi lwamukelwe. b iyisethi ephelele yezithombe zesakhiwo sesikhungo, uma kungesakhiwo esifanayo nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho ku-21 ngenhla. b kufanele kuthunyelwe kuleli bhokisi; noma c kufanele kuthunyelwe ngekhoriyeli, i-imeyili noma ezinye izindlela eziphuthumayo kum owner, uma nje idokhumenti yokuqala ithunyelwa kum owner phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe zokuthumela isaziso. q uma kungekho izinsiza zokunakekela izilwane ezilindele ukuhlolwa ezikhungweni zokubulala, lezo zinsiza kufanele zitholwe kwenye indawo, ngokuvunywa komphakathi wesifunda. ukuze kuhlanzeke futhi kuhlanzeke imishini esetshenzisiwe z kufanele kube nendawo yokuhlanza imoto ethutha inyama. gg akukho facility yokuhlanza imoto enikeziwe yokuthutha inyama. k akukho zinsiza ezitholakalayo zokumunca ukuze kulawulwe ukuhamba. ivikelwe ngezinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokuvikela ukungena kwezinto eziyingozi noma ukungcoliswa, igesi, ukuhamba, iphunga, umusi, uthuli, umswakama, izinyoni, nezinye izinto noma ukuphazamiseka kwenyama, amakhemikhali, noma okunye okukhuluma ngokungcoliswa. Zonke izindawo zangaphandle kufanele zibe zihlanzekile futhi zingabi nothuli. Akukho mfula namanzi okukhukhuleka anikeziwe. Izikhungo zokubulala kufanele zibe nohlelo oluvinjelwe lwamanzi nezinsiza zokulahla odakeni ukuze kungene endaweni efanele yamapayipi amanzi angcolile. Izindawo zokulayisha nokukhipha izimoto kufanele zivikela, ziqinile, futhi zibe nephiko. d ukugcina inyama ethunjiwe nokuhlolwa kwayo kufanele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokungcolisa leyo nyama. n yonke imishini, izakhiwo, nezinsiza ezibekwe odongeni kufanele zibe okungenani 50mm kude. c akufanele kube ne-oyili yenyama. iziqukathi zokugcina inyama kufanele zihambisane nesigaba 1, uma phezulu naphansi kunezikhala kufanele zenzelwe ukuthi inyama ingaphumi ezikhala noma ithinte phansi. Amathoyilethi nezindawo zokuhlala kufanele akhiwe endaweni ehlukile enikeza emnyango ehlukile ezindaweni zokushintsha. wonke amathoyilethi kufanele ahlome ngezikhwama zokubeka iphepha lokuhlanza, izikhwama zokuhlanza izandla, izikhwama zokuphakela ugesi ezibulala amagciwane, nezinsiza zokomisa izandla. Izindawo zokushintsha nezitho zokuhlala akufanele zifinyelele ngqo endaweni noma igumbi lapho inyama igcinwa khona. Abasebenzi kufanele bahlinzekwe nendawo yokuvula izinto zabo lapho begcina izinto zabo zomuntu zihluke kwezokusebenza, lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto zomuntu nezokusebenza zihlanzekile azihlanganisi. Abasebenzi kufanele bahlinzekwe ngezinto ezivikela ezivela ezinyonini lapho begcina ukudla. b gwema ukungcoliswa nezinsiza zokuhlanza ngokupheka imishini nezinsiza zokusebenza, okungabandakanya amahhashi namabhakede, kuzohlanza ngamanzi afudumele ku-82°C ngesikhathi sokubulala. c kufanele kube ne-oyili yokufaka nokuphuma kanye ne-pipe yokukhipha eholela endaweni evulekile, amanzi akhishwe kule ndawo akufanele aphume endaweni edlule izimoto. Noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuhlanza ngokupheka kufanele ivunywe umphakathi wesifunda. f kufanele bahlinzekwe ngebhakede elibamba ugesi obulala amagciwane kanye nezinsiza zokomisa izandla ngaphandle kokuthi kungekho mfuneko yokomisa izandla endaweni lapho kukhona isikhwama sokuhlanza izandla. Amakabine okugeza adingekayo ezikhungweni zokubulala ezikhiqiza ngaphansi nangaphezulu kufanele abekwe eduzane nezindawo zokusebenza ukuze kuvinjwe ukuhamba kwamanzi lapho abasebenzi behlanza ama-apron abawasebenzisayo futhi la makabine kufanele avumele ukuhamba kwamanzi ngqo endaweni efanele yephunga elingcolile noma umfula. Amanzi kufanele abe namandla futhi ahambisane okungenani neKholomu II esunguliwe ku-SANS 241 yokuphuza. c isondo eligcina ama-pipes akufanele lihlale phansi ngaphandle kwamapayipi abekwe odongeni. Izinsiza zokugcina ukuvikela ukuhweba nezinto ezingabuyiswanga ezihambisana nezikhwama ezivala ngokuqinile futhi zihambisane ne-clause-14 kufanele zikhishwe ukuze zigcine futhi zithuthe izinto eziphukile futhi kufanele zibe nokubhalwa "AKUSIYONA IMISEBENZI". Kumele kube nezikhwama zokuhlanganisa nokugcina izinto eziphukile ezidinga ukulahleka. Kumele kube nendawo yokuhlanganisa nokugcina igazi ngaphambi kokuthi ilahleke. Isikhwama sokulahla kumele sikwazi ukuhamba udoti ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphakathi kwezindawo. Izindawo zokugcina udoti nezikhwama zodoti ngaphambi kokukhipha kumele zibe zihlanzekile, zikhukhuleke, futhi zingabi namanzi futhi kumele zivalwe noma zibe nezikhwama eziqinile. g kufanele kube nokukhanya okwanele uma izilwane zikhishwa ebusuku. d kufanele kube nezimo ezingaphansi kuka-1m ezisetshenziselwa ukubeka izilwane ezitholakele kufanele zakhiwe ngodonga oluqinile kanye nesango futhi akumele kuvunyelwe ukuba zixubane nezinye izikhala noma kudaleke ingozi yokungcolisa ezinye izilwane. c ukudla kwezilwane kufanele kugcinwe endaweni evikelwe yokugcina ezinyonini futhi eyenzelwe lokhu, uma ukudla kufanele kugcinwe ngaphakathi kwezindawo. c 0.50m² inkunzi encane, imbuzi noma ingane. Izikhala kufanele zibe nezaziso ezikhombisa inani lezinhlobo ezithile ezingangena esikhala noma endaweni. c akufanele kube ngaphansi kuka-1. d kufanele kugcinwe kahle futhi kungabi nezinto eziphakanyisiwe. Izindawo zokudla kufanele zibe zihlanzekile futhi zingabi nezinto eziphakanyisiwe. kufanele kube ngendlela egcina indawo yaphansi nezikhala zokukhipha amanzi aziphume. Indawo yokudla izinkomo phakathi kwesikhala nendawo lapho zibulawa khona kufanele ibe nobubanzi obungaphezu kuka-0.9m. Indawo yokudla kufanele ihlelwe ngendlela efihlekile endaweni yokubulala. Ingxenye yendawo yokudla eholela ebhokisini lokubulala kufanele ibe nez sides eziqinile. d noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuvimbela evunywe umphakathi wesifunda. c enye ithuluzi elivunywe ngumbuso. Izindawo zokubulala ezibekwe kahle kufanele zikhonjiswe ezindaweni zokubulala izilwane noma endaweni ethile. Imishini kufanele ihlinzeke ngokuqinisa nokuphakamisa izilwane ezibekwe kahle ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwegazi. Kumele kube nezinto zokuhlanganisa nokugcina igazi ezikhwameni ezivaliwe ngaphambi kokuthi kukhishwe. a mayelana nokuphuma kwegazi kwezinkomo, ukusuka emfuleni phansi, ngama-4.8 meters
Izinkinga Zemfundo: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yiziphi izinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nemfundo namuhla? Imfundo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezifanele, izinga eliphansi lokufunda, kanye nezinkinga zokufinyelela imfundo. Ezinye izifunda zihlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemali, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele ezifana nezincwadi, izikhungo zokufunda, kanye nezifundo ezithuthukile. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ukungabi khona kwezinsiza kubalulekile? Ukungabi khona kwezinsiza kubalulekile ngoba kuthinta ikhwalithi yemfundo. Uma abafundi bengatholi izincwadi ezanele noma izikhungo zokufunda ezikahle, kuba nzima kubo ukufunda kahle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni bahluleke ezivivinyweni nasekufundeni kahle, okugcina kubangela izinga eliphansi lokuphumelela. Umbuzo 3: Yini eyenza izinga lokufunda liphansi? Izinga lokufunda liphansi ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, abanye othisha bangase bangabi neziqu ezanele noma ulwazi olufanele lokufundisa. Okwesibili, izimo zokuhlala zabafundi, ezifana nezinkinga zomndeni noma ukungabi namandla ezimali, zingathinta kakhulu ukugxila kwabo ekufundeni. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abanye abafundi bahluleke ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokufunda. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa imfundo? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe imfundo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganyela phakathi kukahulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nomphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kothisha, ukwakha izikhungo zokufunda ezithuthukile, kanye nokwandisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokufunda, kungasiza kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha izinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abafundi abanezidingo ezikhethekile kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Umbuzo 5: Ingabe ubuchwepheshe bungasiza ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga? Yebo, ubuchwepheshe bungaba yinsiza enkulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga zemfundo. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokufunda eziku-inthanethi, izifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala ku-inthanethi kungasiza abafundi abaningi ukufinyelela ulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukufunda, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude noma ezingenazo izinsiza ezanele. Umbuzo 6: Yini eyenza abafundi bahluleke? Abafundi bahluleka ngezizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungabi namandla okuxhumana kahle, ukungabi nesikhathi esanele sokufunda, noma ukungabi nentshisekelo emfundweni. Abanye bangase babe nezinkinga zokuphila, ezifana nezinkinga zomndeni noma ezempilo, ezithinta ikhono labo lokugxila ekufundeni. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi ukuze baphumelele. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele yenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokuphumelela kwabafundi? Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokuphumelela, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganyela phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo, othisha, nabafundi. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kothisha, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, kungasiza ekwandiseni izinga lokuphumelela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha umoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Umbuzo 8: Ingabe imfundo ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu? Yebo, imfundo ibalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Iphakamisa amathuba okusebenza, ithuthukisa ulwazi, futhi ikhulisa ukuzethemba. Abantu abaneziqu eziphakeme bavame ukuthola amathuba angcono emsebenzini, futhi imfundo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imfundo iyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komnotho, njengoba abantu abaneziqu eziphakeme bangaqhuba izinguquko ezinhle emiphakathini yabo. Umbuzo 9: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze imfundo ibe yinsiza yokuthuthukisa umphakathi? Ukuze imfundo ibe yinsiza yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezihlanganyela phakathi kukahulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nomphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kothisha, ukwakha izikhungo zokufunda ezithuthukile, kanye nokwandisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokufunda, kungasiza kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi abanezidingo ezikhethekile kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni imfundo. Umbuzo 10: Yini esingayenza njengomphakathi ukuze sithuthukise imfundo? Njengomphakathi, singathatha izinyathelo eziningi ukuze sithuthukise imfundo. Singasebenza ndawonye ukuze sakhe izikhungo zokufunda, sikhuthaze abafundi ukuba baphumelele, futhi sihlinzeke ngoxhaso kubafundi abadinga usizo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabazali, othisha, nabafundi kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise imfundo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, singasebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze sithuthukise ukufunda nokufundisa. Ngokuhlanganyela, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, lapho imfundo iyinsika yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuzinikela, ubuhlakani, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi.
Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini Emiphakathini eminingi eNingizimu Afrika, izinkinga zamanzi ziba yinkinga enkulu, ethinta impilo, umnotho, kanye nezimo zokuhlala kwabantu. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinsiza ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi, kubangela izinselelo ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Lezi zinkinga zikhombisa ubuhlungu obukhulu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho abantu bahlala khona ezindaweni ezingenamathuba amaningi. Ukuqala, sithola ukuthi ukuntuleka kwamanzi kuhlobene kakhulu nezimo zezulu eziguquguqukayo. Izimo zokushisa eziphezulu, izikhukhula, kanye nezomiso zenza kube nzima ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kudala ukuthi imiphakathi ibhekane nezinkinga zokuphila, njengoba amanzi eba yinto eyigugu kakhulu. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphile, balime, futhi baphile kahle. Ngaphandle kwamanzi, izimpilo zabantu ziba sengozini, futhi lokhu kudala umphumela omubi emnothweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kuyinkinga enkulu. Izinsiza ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi zihlala zinganele, futhi lapho amanzi ehlanzekile engatholakali, abantu bahlala bephila engozini yokugula. Izinsiza eziningi zikhombisa ukungcoliswa okukhulu, okuvela ezimbonini, emaphandleni, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kudala ukuthi amanzi angase abe yingozi, futhi abantu badinga ukusebenzisa amanzi angcolile, okukhombisa ubungozi obukhulu empilweni yabo. Izinkinga zamanzi zikhombisa ukuthi imiphakathi idinga ukusebenzisana ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi uqobo. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile akusikho kuphela ukuxazulula inkinga, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho oqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi ibonisa amandla okuzimela. Abantu baqala ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezibandakanya imiphakathi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza wonke umuntu. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imiphakathi ibheke izindlela zokuvuselela amanzi. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezihlakaniphile, ukusebenzisa amanzi aphindaphindiwe, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amanzi, kungasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zamanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa nokufundisa abantu ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha amanzi, ukuze baziqhenye ngempilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa nguhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi uqobo. Ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile akusikho kuphela ukuxazulula inkinga, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho oqinile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi ibonisa amandla okuzimela. Abantu baqala ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zabo ukuze bakhe izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwakha izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezibandakanya imiphakathi zikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza wonke umuntu. Ngokuphetha, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinsiza ezikhona zokuphatha amanzi, kubangela izinselelo ezinkulu ezidinga ukuxazululwa ngokushesha. Imiphakathi idinga ukusebenzisana ukuze kutholakale izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nempilo engcono, umnotho oqinile, kanye nezimo zokuhlala ezinhle.
Izisekelo zeMkhankaso Wokufunda (FFL) zigxile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono okufunda, ukubhala, nokubala kwabantwana bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloswe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa nokukhuthaza kuzo zonke izigaba zohlelo lwezemfundo kanye nasezindlini nasezindaweni zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ngonyaka ka-2011, bonke abafundi bangakhombisa amazinga afanele okufunda nokubala ngokwezinga labo. Lo mkhankaso uphendula ocwaningweni olwenziwe ezweni, ezindaweni, nasezinhlelweni zomhlaba wonke ezikhombisile ukuthi eminyakeni eminingi, abantwana eNingizimu Afrika bebengakwazi ukufunda, ukubhala, nokubala ezingeni elilindelekile, futhi abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ekhombisa amakhono abalulekile ahlobene nokufunda nokubala. Lo mkhankaso uzophothulwa ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwezinga lesizwe ekupheleni konyaka ka-2011 ukuze kuhlolwe amazinga okufunda/izilimi nokubala/izibalo phakathi kwabafundi beGrade 3 neGrade 6 eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kutholakale ukuthi lokhu kuthinta kanjani. Izisekelo zeMkhankaso Wokufunda (Inombolo yeGazethi yoHulumeni 30880, Isaziso soHulumeni inombolo 306, 14 Mashi 2008). Inqubomgomo Yezwe Yokuhlola Nezinga Elincane Ezikoleni kuMkhakha Wokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa (Inombolo yeGazethi yoHulumeni 29626, 12 Febhuwari 2007). Inqubomgomo Yezwe Mayelana Nokuvunyelwa KweZinhlelo Zokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezemfundo Jikelele Yezinga R-9 (izikole) (Inombolo yeGazethi yoHulumeni 23406, 31 Meyi 2002). Ulimi kuInqubomgomo Yezemfundo (UMnyango Wezemfundo 1997). Isakhiwo Sokuhlola Ikhwalithi. Ukuhlola kudlala indima ebalulekile enqubweni yokufundisa nokuqonda. Isitatimende seNqubomgomo Yezwe, kanye neNqubomgomo Yezwe Yokuhlola Nezinga Elincane Ezikoleni kuMkhakha Wokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa (Gazethi 29626), kucacile ngenhloso yaso yokufaka ukuhlola ekwakhiweni, ekwenzeni, nasekuhloleni ohlelweni lwezemfundo. Izisekelo zeMkhankaso Wokufunda ziqhubeka ngalokhu futhi zifuna ukwandisa nokwakha ukuhlola okuphakeme ngenhloso yokwakha izindlela ezisekelwe ezifakazela nezithuthukisayo. Kubalulekile ukuqhakambisa ukuthi iFFL ingaphezu kokuhlola kuphela. Ihambisana nokuhlinzeka ngesakhiwo esigxile kuwo wonke amaphuzu abalulekile okwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokufunda, ikakhulukazi kumakhono ayinhloko okufunda nokubala. Nokho, ukuhlola kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekwaziseni nasekukhombiseni izinyathelo zeMkhankaso. Eminyakeni edlule ku-2011, ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kuzovumela izikole ukuthi zilinganise intuthuko yazo ngokumelene nemiphumela yokufunda eyisisekelo ehlose ukufezekisa imigomo ebekiwe yesikhashana nezikhathi ezide. Isibonelo, umgomo othile weFFL ukuthi akukho mfundi okufanele afinyelele ngaphansi kuka-50% ekuhlolweni kokufunda nokubala. Ukuze kufezwe lo mgomo, kufanele kube khona uhlelo lokuhlola oluqhubekayo nolokulandela. Lolu hlelo luzophothulwa ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwezinga lesizwe ukuze kuhlolwe umthelela womkhankaso ka-2011. Ukukhiqiza ulwazi oluthembekile, oluhlanganisiwe olusekelwe ekuhlolweni okujwayelekile ukuze lusetshenziswe izikole, izifunda, nezifunda ukusetha imigomo nokulandela intuthuko yabo ukuze kufezwe ukuthuthukiswa ezinjengokuhlosiwe. Nakuba kunezizathu zendawo zokuhlola ezifanayo, kukhona umehluko omkhulu ezinhlotsheni nasezingeni zokuhlola ezwenziwa futhi ziphathwa yisikole ngasinye. Ukuhlinzeka izikole ngezibonelo zamathuluzi okuhlola njengokubalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikoleni ezisazothola amazinga afanele okufunda nokufundisa. Ukusiza othisha ekwakheni amathuluzi abo okuhlola aphezulu ezingeni lesikole. Ukuqeqeshwa nokuxoxisana okwengeziwe nothisha kuqhubeka kugcizelela ukuhlola njengendawo enzima ebhekene nokwenziwa kweNCS. Ukuhlolwa kwonyaka kuzoba nesandla ekuxazululeni le nkinga ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene nezicwangcisi zokuhlola amakhono ahlukahlukene. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi ezifundeni ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele noma/ukuhlanganyela ezikoleni ezimibandela ehlukene nasezingeni ezihlukene zokusebenza. Ukuhlolwa kwonyaka akufanele kusetshenziswe njengesisekelo sokuphakamisa abafundi; nokho, izikole zikhululekile ukusebenzisa ukuhlola njengengxenye yemisebenzi yokuhlola esemthethweni echazwe kuGazethi yoHulumeni 29626. Inqubomgomo yokuhlola okuqhubekayo nokuthi izinqumo kufanele zenziwe kanjani mayelana nokuhamba kwabafundi, njengoba kuchazwe kwiNqubomgomo Yezwe Yokuhlola Nezinga Elincane Ezikoleni kuMkhakha Wokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa, kusala kufana. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwonyaka akuzosetshenziswa ukwahlulela izikole noma/okanye othisha. Kunalokho, kuhlose ukusiza othisha nezifunda ekulandeleni isivinini sokuthuthukiswa kwamazinga kanye nezinga lemiphumela yokufunda. Lokhu kuhlola ngeke kuthinte noma yiziphi izinqumo ezihlobene nezinhlelo zokusebenza zothisha. Othisha kufanele babone izinzuzo zokuhlola njengezinsiza zokuhlola ukuze bathuthukise izicwangciso zabo zokufundisa nokusebenza kwabafundi ekufundeni, ekubhaleni, nasekubaleni. Ukuhlolwa kwonyaka kuzokwenziwa kubo bonke abafundi ukusuka kuGrade 1 kuya kuGrade 6 ezindaweni ezimbili zokufunda noma izifundo, okungukuthi, Ukufunda/Izilimi kanye Nokubala/Izibalo. Umgomo wakho uwukusiza wonke umfundi ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yabo yokufunda. UMnyango Wezemfundo (DoE) uhlinzeke ngesakhiwo sokuhlola ukufunda ezigabeni zeSisekelo neziPhakathi zeZindawo Zokufunda/Izilimi kanye Nokubala/Izibalo. Lesi Sakhiwo Sokuhlola sihlanganisa "izinyathelo" ezibalulekile ezisebenza njengesiqondiso sothisha ukuze bahlanganise ulwazi oluyisisekelo namakhono abafundi abadinga ukuwathola ezingeni ngalinye lesigaba unyaka wesikole. Ukuhlola kuzohambisana nezinyathelo futhi kugxile ekuhloleni amakhono ayinhloko okufunda nokubala. Kubalulekile ukuqhakambisa ukuthi kokubili izinyathelo kanye nokuhlola akuzona izinto ezengeziwe kulokho okuhlanganiswe yiNCS, kodwa kuhlose ukugxila ekucaciseni amakhono abalulekile nasekulungiseleleni izingane ukufunda kabanzi kuFunda/Izilimi kanye Nokubala/Izibalo. Isethi yokuqala yamathuluzi okuhlola kuFunda kanye Nokubala/Izibalo yathuthukiswa ngonyaka ka-2008, futhi konke lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngaphezulu ngesikhathi sokugcina somkhankaso. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iDoE izohlinzeka ngezibonelo zezikhungo zokwenza ukuhlola ezindaweni zokufunda ezahlukene. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kufanele kwenzeke ezikoleni nasezifundeni. Izikole zikhululekile ukuhlinzekwa ngesakhiwo sokuhl
Ukuze kwenziwe eminye imisebenzi efana nalena eyalelwe nguNgqongqoshe, iBhunga Lezimpawu, iKomidi Lezimpawu ngokuhambisana nale mthetho. Ngaphezu kwalolu hlelo lweMnyango Wezimpawu, lo Mnyango onehlelo lokusiza umphakathi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhuthaza izimpawu zesiNtu, ukwenza izimpawu zibe ne-Afrika ngokwenza ucwaningo, nokuvikela Izimpawu Zesizwe njengempahla eyasungulwa nguMbuso. Impumelelo yale Mnyango Wezimpawu ibonakala ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhishweni kwemiklomelo yesizwe; ngeflegi yesizwe entsha, iEmblem yesizwe, kanye neNgoma yesizwe. Inhloso yokugcina nokugcina ama-akhawunti iwukwenza kube nokufinyelela komphakathi kumarekhodi angaphezu kweminyaka engamashumi amabili. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe ivulekile emphakathini kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-8:00 kuya ku-16:00, futhi ngosuku lwesithathu lwesabatha ngenyanga yonke kusukela ngo-9:00 kuya ku-13:00. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe isebenza ukuqoqa; igcine futhi ikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwamarekhodi omphakathi nalawo angawomphakathi njengempahla engabalulekile; igcina uhlelo lwekhompyutha olugcina ulwazi ngezimo nezimpawu zesizwe; ukusungula izindinganiso zokweseka izinsizakalo zokugcina umlando nezimpawu ezindaweni. Ukuqoqa ulwazi ngempahla yesizwe nomlando kubalulekile empahleni yesizwe, futhi kusebenza njengendlela yokusiza uhlelo lokukhomba njengombuso, ukwakha isizwe, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo ezweni. Ukuqoqa izincwadi zezakhamuzi nezomlando kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthi ohulumeni bagcine ukuziphendulela emphakathini. Njengoba ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kuthuthuka kancane kancane emphakathini, kubonisa kakhulu imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ngakho-ke, i-archive yempahla yesizwe innehla yonke imininingwane edingekayo yokuvikela izakhamuzi nezinsizwa. Ingxenye enkulu ye-Archive Yempahla Yesizwe ayikhombisi iziphetho zezingxenye eziningi zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlangabezane nezinselelo. Ngokwesibonelo, labo abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika ababephathwa kabi ngezikhathi ze-apartheid, abesifazane, nokunye. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe ingene emkhankasweni wokuhlanganisa umlando ngokuxhumana nabantu abakholelwa ukuthi banolwazi lokurekhoda nokulondoloza, ngaleyo ndlela beparticipate emsebenzini wokwakha inkumbulo yezakhamuzi ezihlukahlukene zaseNingizimu Afrika. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe Yempahla Yesizwe igcina amarekhodi kazwelonke ezincwadi zomphakathi nalawo angase abe nenzuzo futhi adingeka ukugcinwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikhuthaza ukubambisana nokusebenzisana phakathi kwezikhungo eziqoqa futhi zigcine amarekhodi angawomphakathi. Ngehlelo lwayo lokusiza umphakathi, i-Akhawunti Yesizwe Yempahla Yesizwe ihlose ukufinyelela ezakhamuzini ezingazi ngokuqhamuka kwalolu akhawunti nezinhlelo zayo. Lolu hlelo lugxile ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwalokhu kuqoqa "ngokukhipha kubantu" ngokuvakashela ezikhungweni zemfundo nasezindaweni zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika nangokusebenzisa imikhosi, izinsuku zokwazisa, nezinhlelo zokufinyelela. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe idala futhi igcina uhlelo lolwazi oluphakeme oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo ezahlukene zokweseka ukuthuthukiswa okuphelele komphakathi. Umthetho Wokugcina Umthetho uqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yomsebenzi owashicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika ithunyelwa mahhala ezikhungweni ezichazwe nguMthetho kulo lonke izwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, impahla ebhaliwe eNingizimu Afrika igcinwa futhi iyatholakala emphakathini uma kudingeka.
Isiteshi sokuhlola izimoto yindawo ehlola izimoto futhi ikhishwe isitifiketi sokufakazela ukuthi imoto inelungelo lokusebenzisa imigwaqo yomphakathi. Kukhona iziteshi ezizimele abantu abazakhele zona, futhi kukhona neziteshi ezilawulwa uhulumeni. Zonke iziteshi zokuhlola izimoto kumele zibhaliswe futhi zihlukaniswe ngaphambi kokuba zikwazi ukukhipha izitifiketi zokufakazela ukuthi izimoto zinegunya lokusebenzisa imigwaqo yomphakathi. Lapho bethola incwadi yesicelo sokubhaliswa, umnyango wezokuthutha wesifunda uzothumela abahloli ukuze bahlolisise indawo efuna ukubhaliswa ukuze bazi ukuthi iyahlangabezana nezindinganiso ezidingekayo ngokwezimiso ze-SABS. Izinga elidingekayo yizinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlola izimoto, kanye nezinga lemfundo labahloli bezimoto. Iziteshi zokuhlola izimoto zinegunya lokuhlola izimoto kuphela ngaphakathi kwesigaba esinikezwe zona. Ukuze ubhalise isiteshi sokuhlola izimoto esizimele, xhumana nehhovisi lesikhungo sokubhaliswa kwezimoto esiseduze nawe ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile. Qedela ifomu le-TS1, isicelo sokubhalisela isiteshi sokuhlola izimoto, ehhovisi lesikhungo sokubhaliswa kwezimoto esiseduze nawe. Thumela incwadi yakho yokukhomba kanye nokukhomba kwalabo abaphatha le ndawo oyibhalisayo. Ungacelwa ukuthi uthumele nemibhalo eyengeziwe njengoba kudingwa yilungu lekhansili. Khokha imali echazwe. Kungathatha izinyanga eziyisithupha ukubhalisela isiteshi sakho.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana: Umqondo Ohloniphekile Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela neziguli kubalulekile empilweni. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kuhambisana nezimo ezithile ezithinta ukunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukuhlonishwa kwemigomo yokuxhumana phakathi kwezinsizakalo zezempilo, njengeGEMS, kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale impilo engcono. Ukugunyazwa kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kodokotela neziguli, okudinga ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo, okuhlonipha. Uhlelo lweGEMS, oluhlinzeka ngemali yokwelashwa, lufaka izinyathelo eziningi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqonda phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo neziguli. Udokotela uhlale engumholi emhlanganweni, futhi abezempilo kumele bakhuthazwe ukuba baqhube ukuxhumana okucacile. Ukuze ukuxhumana kube kahle, kudinga ukusobala, ukuqonda, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kudala isizinda esihle phakathi kodokotela neziguli, okwenza kube lula ukuthi iziguli ziveze imicabango nemibuzo yazo. Iziguli kufanele zazi kahle ukuthi yini elindeleke kubo, kanti udokotela kufanele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane edingekayo. I-GEMS ibhekelela izindleko ezinkulu zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, futhi lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Nokho, abanye odokotela bathi izinqubo zokuxhumana nezokugunyazwa zingaba nzima futhi zishintsha kalula, okukhathazayo ngoba kudinga ukuthi iziguli zenze izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezimpilo zabo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi umsebenzi odokotela uqukethe izingxenye ezinzima, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezithombe zempilo. Udokotela kufanele abe nemfundo eqinile ukuze akwazi ukuxhumana kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi bahloniphe izinqubo zokwelapha, futhi ukugunyazwa kodokotela akugcini nje ngokuphakela ama-oda. Umqondo wokwakha isikhalazo esinzulu uyingxenye ebalulekile yokuxhumana. Iziguli zidinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukucelwa kwemvume yokwelashwa akuphikisi izidingo zazo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zeziguli azishodi, futhi udokotela kumele azame ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele. Ubudlelwano phakathi kodokotela neziguli buhamba kahle uma kudlalwa izinyathelo ezivulekile. Ukuvuleka kwengxoxo kuzoziphatha ezokwelapha nezokugunyazwa kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithembekile kumkhakha wezempilo. Ngemuva kwezinkulumo ezinjalo, ukuphila kahle kwezempilo kuhlobene kakhulu nokwakhiwa kwezimpendulo eziguquguqukayo. Uma iziguli zikhuluma ngendlela ecacile, udokotela uyakwazi ukuhlola izinkinga ngendlela engcono. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile ezithinta impilo yeziguli. Ngokubheka phambili, iziguli kufanele zikhumbule ukuxhumana, ziqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zazo ziqokwe. Ukuxhaswa kwemali kweGEMS kudinga ukuqonda okukhulu, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekuxhumaneni okuphumelelayo. Umqondo weGEMS ulayisha izindawo ezintsha zempilo, kodwa udinga ukuxhaswa ngokuqonda phakathi kodokotela neziguli. Ukugunyazwa kodokotela kudinga nothando nokwakhiwa kobudlelwano ukuze kube nokwelashwa okwanelisayo. Ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ukuze uhlelo lweGEMS lusebenze kahle. Ngalesi sizathu, kubalulekile ukuba udokotela, iziguli, kanye nezinhlangano zezempilo basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinsizakalo ezinhle. Uma sakha le mikhuba, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi sizokwazi ukuthola indlela yokuphila engcono nenempilo.
Iyiphi iqembu lesifundo elakha ibhena elihle kakhulu? Faka: Umncintiswano wezibhengezo zeqembu lesifundo ezihamba phambili! Ingxenye yalokho esifuna ukukwenza lapha ohlelweni lwethu lokuthuthukisa abalimi lokhu: sifuna ukwakha nokweseka amaqembu ezifundo. noPhillip Olivier eMpumalanga Kapa. Izinhloso zamaqembu ezifundo: Ukuqhakambisa abalimi abasafufusa abanezimila ukuze bakhe amaqembu ezifundo ahlangane njalo ukuze ahlaziye ukuqeqeshwa nokuthola ulwazi mayelana nokukhiqiza u-mazing. Kule nyanga uJohan Kriel uqale umncintiswano phakathi kwamaqembu ezifundo ukuze akhe izibhengezo futhi ibhena elihle kakhulu lizokhethwa kulawo wonke amanye. Lezi zibhengezo zizosebenza noma nini lapho kuhlangana khona futhi ezinsukwini zabalimi ukuze zikhombise ukuthi amalungu amaqembu ezifundo azithokozisa ngokuba yilungu. Le mifanekiso ikhombisa ubuhle bezibhengezo ezithile. Silindele ukubona imifanekiso evela kubaphathi bezifunda ukuze sikwazi ukukhetha ibhena elihle kakhulu!
I-Grain SA iphethe uhlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi oluxhaswe yi-Maize Trust, Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust, Sorghum Trust, kanye ne-Winter Cereals Trust, oluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngolwazi ngokufundisa, ukwesekwa, nokusiza ngezindlela ezahlukene ezitholakala kalula kubo. Njengoba i-Grain SA inethimba lezingcweti (ochwepheshe) elihola ekuhlinzekeni ngemininingwane enembile kubalimi abasha lapha eNingizimu Afrika, manje seyiqashelwa ngokuba phambili ekuthuthukiseni abakhiqizi. Amalungu e-Grain SA akholelwa ukuthi lolu hlelo luzosiza ukuguqula umkhakha wezolimo ukuze labo abashiywe ngemuva esikhathini esedlule manje babe nethuba lokusebenza ngokulingana nabanye emkhakheni wokukhiqiza ukudla. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle ukuthi i-Grain SA iyini nokuthi iyiphi indima edlalayo kwezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Ubani i-Grain SA? I-Grain SA iyinhlangano eyakhiwe ngokuqonda futhi igxile ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu ezweni lethu nakwamanye amazwe. Ihloselwe ukuthuthukisa bonke abakhiqizi bokusanhlamvu lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Bonke abakhiqizi abavulelekile abaxhasa izimiso ze-Grain SA bangangena kule nhlangano uma bekhokha imali edingekayo. Yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa yi-Grain SA kwezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika? I-Grain SA iyisikhungo esisemthethweni mayelana nezindaba zokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu kokubili kwendawo nakwamanye amazwe futhi ikhuluma egameni bonke abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngendlela ezothuthukisa imisebenzi yabalimi lapha nakwamanye amazwe. I-Grain SA isebenza njengomgibeli emkhakheni wezolimo ukuze ibheke izinyathelo nemithetho elawula le misebenzi ukuze ivikele amalungu ayo. I-Grain SA iphinde ibekezelele ukukhathazeka kwamalungu ayo - nezindlela abacabanga ngazo bese ithumela lezi zinkinga kuhulumeni ukuze ixazulule izinkinga futhi iqinise imithetho emisha. Inhloso eyinhloko ye-Grain SA ukuhlinzeka ngokukhiqiza nokumaketha okuphezulu kokudla ngendlela ezuzisa bonke abalimi. Le nhlangano ivame ukusebenza ukuze ixhumane nabanye emkhakheni wezolimo ukuze bakwazi ukuncintisana nabakhiqizi abakhulu emhlabeni jikelele, njengezikhungo e-USA naseBrazil. Kulezi ziqephu, kukhona abantu abasebenza kwi-Grain SA, ochwepheshe, nabakhiqizi abawamalungu nabaphathi benhlangano. Bahlola isimo mayelana nokungena kwabalamli abasha futhi banweba amathuba abo okuzibandakanya ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu nasemazweni lapho ukudla kungathengiswa khona. Leqembu liphinde lilawule uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabalimi. Kubonakala ukuthi i-Grain SA ayixhasi ngokwezimali amalungu ayo, kodwa ihlinzeka ngesisekelo esidingekayo esizosiza wonke amalungu ngemininingwane lapha ezweni lethu. Umsebenzi wale nhlangano uvula iminyango yokuthi abakhiqizi bagxile kulokho abangakwenza kahle - ukutshala nokumaketha okusanhlamvu! Bonke abalimi kufanele bazi ukuthi i-Grain SA inikeza okuningi kakhulu kunokufundisa nokuqeqesha abalimi! Bonke abalimi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kufanele bafise ukuba amalungu aphelele e-Grain SA anamalungelo okhetho. I-Grain SA iyizinyembezi, izindlebe, kanye nezwi labakhiqizi bokusanhlamvu emkhakheni wezolimo, obhekene nezinselelo ezivela ezizindeni zangaphandle ezifana nokuncintisana nemakethe zangaphandle. Abalimi emnothweni bamanje babhekene nezinselelo ekuncintisaneni nasekuqiniseni izikhundla zabo kule makethe yamanje - ngakho-ke kunzima kakhulu kubalimi abasha ukuzibandakanya kulomkhakha wezolimo. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa yinhlangano eqinile, enolwazi efana ne-Grain SA, ukuvikelwa, ukwesekwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwabalimi bokusanhlamvu ezweni lethu kusemngceleni.
Umculo WaseNingizimu Afrika: Isiko, Uhlanga, Nezinguquko Umculo waseNingizimu Afrika ungumfanekiso ohloniphekile wezinkolelo, izinkumbulo, nezimpilo zabantu bethu. Uhlanga lwezizukulwane ezahlukene, izinkolo, nezindawo zethu kukhombisa ubuhle obuhlukahlukene obutholakala emculweni wethu. Njengoba sihlola umculo wethu, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi awuwona nje umculo, kodwa uyindlela yokuxhumana, yokukhumbula, nokuhlanganyela. Uma sibheka emuva, umculo wethu uqala ezikhathini zasendulo, lapho izizwe zethu zazisebenzisa izinsimbi ezilula, njengezinkanyezi, izigubhu, nezinsimbi zomoya. Lezi zinsimbi zazisetshenziswa ukuh recall izigigaba, izinkanyezi, nezinkolo. Umculo wawuhlanganisa abantu, ubavusa, futhi ubakhumbuza ngezimpilo zabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, umculo wawungelona nje uhlobo lokuzijabulisa, kodwa wawuwumthombo wokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika wathola izinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezamasiko ahlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sobandlululo, kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezindlela ezintsha zomculo. Umculo weKwaito, owavela emaphandleni eGauteng, waba yisithombe esihle sokuphila kwabantu abasha, ubuhlungu, nokuphumelela. U-Kwaito uhlanganisa umculo weHip-Hop, iHouse, nezinye izitayela, futhi ubonisa indlela abantu abasha abaphila ngayo, izifiso zabo, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umculo weGospel ubonisa ukukhanya nokhopeka. Uhlanga lwezinkolo ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama, luhlanganiswe emculweni, futhi umculo weGospel ube yindlela yokukhuluma noNkulunkulu. Ubuqotho, uthando, nokholo kubonakala emculweni, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika uqhubekile nokukhula. Izitayela ezinjengeJazz, iMaskandi, neAfro-Pop zathola udumo emhlabeni jikelele. Umculi onjengoHugh Masekela, uMiriam Makeba, noJohnny Clegg baveze ubuhle bomculo wethu, futhi baphakamisa izwi lethu emhlabeni. Lezi zinkanyezi zikhombisa ukuthi umculo wethu ungaphezu kwemikhuba yendawo; ungumkhiqizo wezinto eziningi ezihlangene. Namuhla, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika ubonakala emhlabeni wonke. Abaculi abasha, njengeNasty C, uSho Madjozi, noBlack Coffee, baphinde baqhubeke nokwakha izitayela ezintsha, behlanganisa izithako ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umculo wethu awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokukhula, uhlanganisa izizukulwane ezintsha nezinkolelo ezahlukene. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sikhuthaza umculo wethu. Umculo ungumthombo wokuxhumana, futhi kufanele siwusebenzise ukuze siqhakambise izinkolelo zethu, izinkumbulo, nezimpilo zethu. Abaculi bethu badinga ukwesekwa, ukuze bakwazi ukuveza izwi labo, futhi baphinde bahloniphe izimpande zethu. Umculo ungumthombo wokuhlanganyela, futhi kufanele siwusebenzise ukuze sakhe umphakathi onobunye. Ekugcineni, umculo waseNingizimu Afrika ungumthombo wokuphila, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Ubonisa ubuhle bethu, izinkolelo zethu, nezimpilo zethu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokukhula, kufanele sihloniphe izimpande zethu, futhi siqhubeke sikhuthaza umculo wethu, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bawo. Umculo wethu ungumthombo wokuphila, futhi kufanele siwusebenzise ukuze sikhulise umphakathi wethu, sikhumbule izimpande zethu, futhi sithokozise izizukulwane ezizayo.
Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall, oqale ngonyaka we-2015, ube nemiphumela eminingi emikhulu ezinqolobaneni zethu, ezemfundo, nasezimpilweni zabantu abasha eNingizimu Afrika. Njengomuntu obona izinguquko emkhakheni wezemfundo, ngifuna ukwabelana ngombono wami mayelana nomthelela wesikhathi eside walomkhankaso. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall wawungeyena nje umholi wezidingo nezifiso zabafundi, kodwa waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantwana bethu badinga ithuba lokufunda ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphezulu. Lokhu kugqugquzela izwi elisha lwemibono, ngesikhathi lapho abantu bahlola izinkinga ezinkulu zempilo, ezemfundo, kanye nezomnotho. Umkhankaso ube nomthelela oqondile ezinqubweni zokufunda, njengoba izikhungo zemfundo ziphinde ziqhubele phambili izindlela ezilula zokufunda, ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nabantu abavela ezizindeni eziphansi, banethuba lokufunda. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwenhlonipho kwezobuchwepheshe, njengoba abafundi abaningi bephumelela ezikhungweni eziphezulu. Lokhu kubonakala ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa, lapho abaFundi bahlola izifundo zabo, bephumelela kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkathi zangaphambili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni umqondo wokuzimela phakathi kwabafundi. Abafundi abavela ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomphakathi baqonda ukuthi uma bebonke, bangaba namandla okwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. Lokhu kuqhakambisa ubudlelwane obukhulu phakathi kwabafundi, okwakha umphakathi onamandla, okwazi ukulwa nezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi jikelele. Nokho, umkhankaso awudluleli nje ebuhleni; ube nemiphumela emibi nakakhulu. Ngaphezu kokukhathazeka ngempilo yabafundi, izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhombisa ukuthi kwaqhamuka nezinselele ezinkulu ezimbonini eziningi, njengoba abanye abafundi bebengakwazi ukufunda ngenxa yokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuholele ekukhuleni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba abantu abaningana bahlala bephelelwa yithemba lokuthola imisebenzi. Noma kunjalo, umkhankaso ubuye waholela ekubeni kube nezinqumo ezinzima mayelana nezindleko zemfundo. Izikhungo zemfundo ziqalile ukuxoxa ngendlela yokuthola izimali ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abafundi bangenza izifundo zabo. Lokhu kuholele ekubeni kube nezinqumo ezinzima, kanye nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa abafundi abahlwempu, okungavunywa yiphi indlela yokuphila. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall awuqediwe; ungomunye wemikhankaso eyisikhumbuzo sokuthi imfundo iyisisekelo sokukhula komnotho, futhi kufanele iqhutshekiswe. Abafundi bahlukumezekile, futhi umqondo wokuthi imfundo kufanele ibe mahhala kufanele uqhubeke ukuphakama. Ukuphumelela kwabafundi kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi imfundo yindawo yokwakha ikusasa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uyabonakala ukuthi ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onengqondo, lapho imfundo iyinsiza yokukhulisa umnotho. Abafundi, osonhlamvukazi, kanye nezinye izinhlangano kumele babambisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinguquko eziyinqaba ziqhubeka. Ngokuphetha, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezemfundo, wokwakha umphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi abahlwempu. Noma kunezinselelo eziningi, umbono wokuthi imfundo kufanele ibe mahhala uyaphumelela, futhi ukhuthaza abantwana bethu ukuba baphokophele impumelelo. Umkhankaso kufanele uqhubeke, futhi sonke kufanele sizibophezele ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.
Pamela wahamba ngaphandle wathola umoya. Wakhulula, ezama ukugxila emnyango uma kwenzeka othile engena. Nokho, wabona ukuthi akekho muntu obonakala. "Ngikhona, ngitshilo ukuthi impungushe izohlangana nebhubesi," kusho yena eshaya uZongile ngenyawo etafuleni. Lo mbono wenza uZimu azizwe kakhulu sengathi ubona ukuthi uhambo lwalesi sithandwa alukho emandleni kayise. Wasekela ngokuphelele umbono uZimu owawukhuluma, ethi bekuyiphutha kusukela ekuqaleni ukuthi umakoti wakhe kufanele afunde ngenkathi ethwele. Ngakho, kwakungekho okwakungakwenziwa ngoba umntwana wacelwa ukuba avume ukuba akhuliswe kayise. Empeleni, wayejabule kakhulu ukuthi ubuyela ezintabeni zaseDlangezwa. "Ngiyabiza uThula. Uthi awukwazanga ukumtshela lutho ngokuqhutshelwa," wabuzwa ngesikhathi elinda noma yini. "Yebo, ngiyena, uZongile. Ngidinga ukukubona ngokuphuthumayo, kuyaphuthuma." "Oh, mntwana wami, kunzima ukukwazi," kusho uMaNgwenya ngomsindo opholile. Waqhubeka echaza kumntwana wakhe uZongile ukuthi uyise akazwakali umshini ngokukhipha imali yomsebenzi eMgungundlovu. Wayethatha yonke inkulumo yokuthi uGiyani usashaya, ngenkathi ekhumbula ukuthi uMama Ntulo akufanele azwe ingxoxo. Waphinde wachaza ukuthi ngeke abuzwe, etshela uZonke ukuthi lokhu yindlela ahamba ngayo, akekho intombazane eyake yafika noNyoka. Ubonile, Thula, phuma ngoba ungumuntu othule njengokuthi igama lakho futhi awujwayele muntu ngaphandle kwami. UPhumla, kubonakala ukuthi utshele uPamela ukuthi uqhutshwa ngebhayisikili ngenkathi ehleli. Le nto kaPamela ibonakala ifundeka ngokwayo. Okungcono ukuthi kufanele uhlangane edolobheni noThula. Awunazo izinto eziningi, akunjalo? Wafaka imoto egumbini lokugcina waphuma waya endlini, edlula iye egumbini lakhe lapho azivalela khona. Wazizwa kakhulu ekhumbula umkakhe. Wathatha i-albhamu enezithombe zabo zomshado. Wayivula ngenkathi ebheka ngayo ngenkathazela enkulu. Wama kumakhasi lapho wayenokwakhe. Wakhumbula kahle ukuthi kwakuyisikhathi umfundisi banikela ngamalungelo okwamukela phambi kwabantu. Wafuna kuze kube yilapho evula lapho bebefuna ikhekhe lomshado. "Ngingaba yihlaya kubazali bami uma bebebona ngibuya ngaphandle kokukhulelwa ngalo msebenzi engiwuphathayo ngensimbi. Bathi kusasa ngeke ngife ezindlini ezikhona," kusho yena ngesikhathi ebheka uZongile, kwakucacile ukuthi uma kungamthumeli kusasa kuzomgibisela. "UNyoka akangitshelanga lutho ngendaba yakho." "Kulungile madoda, inhlanhla futhi ubusuku obuhle. Ungakwenzi iphutha kusasa, uhamba kahle," wakhumbuza ngocingo olusha engakakwenzi. UPamela wayezama ukuvusa uZongile owayesalindile ngamanzi ebusweni kodwa engashintshi. Kwakubonakala kuye ukuthi uZongile usukhathalela izingane. Ukwabona lokhu kwenza uPamela wamangala futhi waphazamiseka ngoba okwenzekile bekungeyona inhloso yakhe. Waqhuba umuzi wonke ngephutha futhi ebona ukuthi mhlawumbe babekhona lapho bephikisana, uzothi uma evula bazobona le mhlola ophumile. Nokho, wazitshela ukuthi mhlawumbe abazange bazwe ngoba iradiyo nayo ayizange ibathole bephikisana. "Indaba yakho," kusho uPamela eshaya ikhanda. "Ngidinga nobabili; kukhona indaba okufanele sikhulume ngayo." UPamela wakhuluma ngesikhathi ebheka bobabili emehlweni njengokuthi amaphoyisa abheka abasolwa ukuze babone ukuthi lokho abakukhulumayo kuyikho. "Ngiyesaba ukuhlala lapha ekhaya njengoba ngingeyena umndeni futhi singase singakuthandi. Futhi okwenzekayo manje ngenxa yokuthi ngabe ngithwele, futhi ngisho manje umqondo wakho usaqhubeka ungidla ngenxa yalokho. Ngiyesaba kuphela ukuthi uma kuvela ukuthi angiphelele, ngizothi ngithi kubazali bami," kusho uZongile ngesikhathi esula izinyembezi zakhe. "Kukhona uNyoka, sawubona," wayekhuluma ngenkathi ehleka. "Yebo Zola, ngiyena. NgiseDolobheni futhi ngidinga ukukubona ngaphambi kokuhlangana noThula," wayekhuluma kancane ukuze agweme imali. "Kungcono ungakusho lokho mama, uma le ntombazane ifika nami, ngiyabonga," wakhupha imali eyayiphakanyiswe uNyoka emama owamukela futhi wamthokozisa ngenkathi eshaya amahlombe akhe. UZongile wayethule futhi engenalo impendulo, kwakucacile ukuthi bekucacile ukuthi umsebenzi abawunikezwe ungase ungatholakali. Uthule olwakukhona luphazamiswe yifoni kaNyoka ethi sweetly umndeni. Wayephendula, ephendula ngaphandle kokubheka ukuthi ubani inombolo. Ngesikhathi abangane bakhe bekhuluma ngokubiza umzalwane kaPhumla, uPamela Mvubu, ukushaya kwefoni kaPhumla kwaphazamiseka. Umbiko wokusetshenziswa kwe-District Development Model Isingeniso Le mfuneko ibalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuthuthukisa izindawo. I-District Development Model (DDM) iyithuluzi elisetshenziselwa ukuhlela, ukuphatha, nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo. Umbiko lo uzohlinzeka ngemicimbi ethile yokusebenzisa i-DDM, izinqubo ezisemqoka, kanye nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Izinqubo Zokusebenzisa i-District Development Model 1. Ukubona Isidingo Sokuthuthukiswa - Qala ngokuhlola izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungenziwa ngocwaningo, izinkulumo zomphakathi, noma ngokuqoqa idatha ethile. - Bheka izinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, njengezokuthutha, imfundo, nezempilo. 2. Ukubandakanya Abahlanganyeli - Thola abahlanganyeli abahlukene abafaka phakathi ohulumeni bendawo, izinkampani, nezakhamizi. - Hlela imicimbi yokuhlanganyela ukuze uthole imibono ehlukene nokuxhumana. 3. Ukwakha Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa - Dala uhlelo olucacile oluhlanganisa izinjongo, izinsiza, nezikhathi. - Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi ezitholakele. 4. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali - Thola izinsiza zezimali ezidingekayo ukuze uhlelo luphumelele. - Hlela indlela yokuphatha izinsiza zezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisetshenziswa kahle. 5. Ukusebenza Nokuqhuba - Qala ukusebenzisa uhlelo ngokuhleleka. Hlela imihlangano yokuhlola inqubekela phambili. - Bheka ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ziyaqhubeka nezinhlelo ezibekiwe. 6. Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza - Beka uhlelo lokuhlola ukusebenza kwe-DDM. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlola imiphumela, izinkinga, nezinsiza. - Thola impendulo kubahlanganyeli ukuze uthuthukise uhlelo. 7. Ukuphakamisa Izifundo Eziphumelele - Qopha izifundo ezitholakele ukuze zisetshenziswe kwezinye izinhlelo. - Hlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngalezi zifundo nabanye abahlanganyeli. Ukubaluleka Kwe-District Development Model - Ukubambisana: I-DDM ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kubambisana kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. - Ukuhlangabezana Nezidingo: I-DDM ikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo. - Ukuphucula Ukuphathwa: I-DDM ithuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuphatheni izimali nezinsiza. Izinto Ezidingekayo Ukuze Uhlelo Luphumelele - Ubuholi Obuqinile: Ukuphathwa kwe-DDM kudinga ubuholi obuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zithathwa ngendlela efanele. - Ukuxhumana Okuphumelelayo: Ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bonke abahlanganyeli kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi yini elindelekile. - Izinsiza Zokuxhasa: Izinsiza ezifanele, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza, idatha, kanye nezinsiza zezimali, zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo. Isiphetho I-District Development Model iyithuluzi eliwusizo ekuthuthukiseni izindawo. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo ezichazwe ngenhla, izindawo zingathuthukiswa ngendlela efanele, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abahlanganyeli babambe iqhaza ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo ye-DDM. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo zabantu, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho wesifunda.
### Isomiso: Indaba Yomlando Njengoba izinyanga zishintsha, izinkanyezi zikhanya, umhlaba ubona izinguquko eziningi. Kodwa phakathi kwalezi zinguquko, kwesinye isikhathi, kudinga ukubhekana nezinkinga. Lokhu kuhlobene kakhulu nezwe lethu, lapho isomiso siba yinkinga enkulu, sithinta impilo yabantu abahlala kule ndawo. Uma sibuyela emlandweni, sithola ukuthi isomiso sasiwumthwalo omkhulu ezindaweni nasemiphakathini. Lezi zimo azikabi ezintsha; izizukulwane eziningi zidlule ezimweni ezinjalo. Ezikhathini ezedlule, abantu babekhumbula lezi zimo ngezingoma, izinkolelo, nezinkolelo ezikhuthazayo. Enyanga eyaziwa ngokuphila, abantu babenombono omuhle wempilo, owawukhula emhlabeni. Kwakukhona izinyanga ezomile, lapho izinkomo nezitshalo zazithola khona ubunzima. Ngesikhathi sikaMdumazi, isomiso sahlala isikhathi eside, sithinta imfuyo nezolimo, okubangele ukungabi nokudla. Uthando nemithetho yokubambisana phakathi kwemindeni yayibalulekile, futhi izigebengu zazibe qhawe ezihlahleni. Izazi zezulu zathi isomiso siphuma ngaphansi kwempilo yemvelo. Kwezinye izikhathi, izimo zokuhlala zabantu zaziphikisana nemizamo yokuhlanza imithombo, okwakuholwa ngothando lwezizukulwane ezedlule, izinkanyezi, nemvelaphi yemvelo. Ukukhanya kwelanga, izinyanga eziphuma ngezikhathi ezithile, kuveza izinselele ezithile, nezinkinga ezithinta impilo yomhlaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqala ukufuna izixazululo ezizokwazi ukubhekana nesimiso. Basungula izindlela zokugcina amanzi, badala amathafa, futhi baqala ukuphila ngokugcwele esizindeni ezivunguvungwini. Izinhlobo ezintsha zokulima, ezazikhuthazwa yizimfundiso zabokufika, zimele umsebenzi wokulima. Abantu bafunde ukusebenzisa izinsiza zomhlaba ngokuhlakanipha, behlukanisa izinkomo nemifino, benze i-direct planting, njalonjalo. Njengoba izinyanga ziqhubeka, izindlela eziningi zaziqala ukugcina impilo yezilimo. Izimvula ezincane ziqhathaniswa neziqhingi zemimo ezejwayelekile, ukuphakamisa izinga lomhlaba, ukuphuma kwezinto ezintsha, nokukhula kwemifino. Abantu bajabule ngalezi zinguquko, futhi imifino yabuya, kwavela izinhlobo ezintsha zokudla nemikhiqizo, okuyinto eyayiqhuba ubuhlobo phakathi kwemiphakathi. Futhi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isomiso sakhula imfundiso. Abantu baqala ukuhlosele izinyathelo ezihlangene, benza imihlangano nezinkulumo ezimfushane zokubambisana. Izithombe zempilo zabantu, imicabango, nezindawo zomhlaba zaqinisekisa ukuba isimo somhlaba siyashintsha. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, futhi kwehlisa isizathu sokungqubuzana. Naphezu kwezizama, isomiso sasisakwenza kancane kancane konke okukhona, kudinga ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani. Uma sihamba emkhakheni wezinsizakalo, kungokwakho ukuyobona izindlela eziningi zabathintekayo baphila ezindaweni ezithile, bethola izindlela ezahlukene zokuqhubeka. Ngamanye amazwi, isomiso sathinta imibhikisho; imikhankaso yokubambisana yasungulwa, izingcaca zavela, amasu ahlukene atholakala ukuba abenze izinqumo ezinhlangothini ezahlukene. Lokhu kubuyisela amandla nentuthuko kulezi zindawo. Ekupheleni kokuqukethwe kwale ndaba, kumenyezelwa ukuthi izinyathelo zokuqwashisa, zokubambisana, kanye nemisebenzi yokwakha udumo alisali, kodwa umphakathi uqhubeka uhlala qotho emizweni yokuhamba phambili. Isomiso sasiqonda ukuthi izingxenye zomhlaba, izinsiza, nezinsizakusebenza zidinga ukwelashwa, futhi kuphela abantu abazokwazi ukukhuluma ngomphakathi. Izinyanga zifika janji, ngenkathi abantu bahlala bephethe izinsizakusebenza zabo. Umoya wabantu ubumbene, futhi impilo iqhubeka nokukhula, futhi ngakho, kwesinye isikhathi, inhlalakahle yabantu ibizwa ngamadla nemithombo engapheli. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi waphila, wagcina izinyathelo zokuphila ezifundise abanakho ukuzimela, ngothando nemizwa eyakhayo. Ngakho, ngaleso sikhathi okwakuyisomiso, abantu bakwazi ukuyidinga inyama, kwezokuphuza, umnotho, nezinye izinsiza. Sazibonakalisa izithombe zempilo, izinkanyezi, emathafeni, ngemva kwezinsuku ezinzima, ukuvusa imizwa. Isomiso sasiwukuhlala kwesisekelo somhlaba, imposi iwubumnandi, kodwa kube nokuhlushwa — konke lokhu kudinga ukucubungula, futhi okuhlangenwe nakho kwaba yisisetshenziswa esiveza impilo. Namuhla, isithombe sokuphila sihamba emkhakheni wempilo — izinyanga zihlala zinenqangi, abantu bazithandela imicabango yokwakha. Ngalendlela, isimoniso singaphansi kweziyalezo zobuhlobo, sihlala phakathi kwezinga, kubaluleke kakhulu. Umhlaba ubonisa amandla obumbano, futhi kulapho impumelelo ibuswa khona. Le ndaba yalesi sicefe sothando, sithinta lapho kuxoxwa khona izinkonzo zikaJehova, ezibiza ubuhlobo, nezithombe ezithinta izizukulwane zabantu. Kulezi zikhathi, izinto zishintsha, kodwa izifundo zihlala zikhona — zingamalungelo okuphila. Ubuza kufanele kugxiliswe kokubili ebuntwini nasekusebenzelaneni. Umphakathi awudingi ukulangazelela; kudinga ukukwazi okuhle — ubumoya uma ukwazi impilo nenhlalakahle njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isomiso sathinta impilo, sakhulisa izinjongo, senze abantu bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga. Ubulunga buyaqabula, umhlaba uhleli ngokuphelele, futhi impilo iqhubeka.
Ezokuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Indaba Yezinguquko Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eThekwini, lapho umphakathi wawuhlangana khona emaphandleni, ubusuku obubhalwe ngothando, ubungane, nezinkumbulo ezinhle. UThandi, intombazane encane, wayehlala emndenini ophakathi nendawo, kodwa wayenothando olukhulu lokufunda. Wayenombono omuhle wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungamphatha kanjani empilweni yakhe. Njengoba uThandi efunda esikoleni, waqala ukuthola izifundo ezithokozisayo ngama-computer. Uthisha wakhe, uMnu. Dlamini, wayephawula ngokuqhubekayo ngendima ebalulekile yobuchwepheshe ekuxhumaneni. "Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busisize, bukhulise, futhi buphucule impilo yethu," wayekhuluma. UThandi wayezwa umoya wokuthakazelela, efisa ukufunda kabanzi. Ngemuva kwesikole, uThandi wayevame ukuvakashela emtapo wolwazi. Lapha, wathola izincwadi eziningi ezikhuluma ngama-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezindlela zokuxhumana. Waqala ukufunda ngama-social media, lapho abantu bekhuluma khona, behlanganyela izinkumbulo, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile. Lokhu kumjabulisile, ngoba wayefisa ukuba yingxenye yalokho. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umngane wakhe omusha. USipho wayenolwazi oluningi ngama-computer, futhi wayejabule kakhulu ukwabelana ngakho. "Ngabe uyazi ukuthi ungakha kanjani i-website?" ubuza uSipho. UThandi waphendula, "Cha, kodwa ngiyafuna ukufunda!" USipho wamkhombisa izinyathelo ezilula, futhi uThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona kuphela ezandleni zabantu abaphezulu, kodwa bukhona nakubo bonke. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uThandi noSipho baqala ukwakha i-website yabo. Babefuna ukwabelana ngemicabango yabo, izithombe, nezindaba ezithokozisayo. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze bukhulise izwi lakhe. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana zokusebenza kanzima, i-website yabo yaphuma, futhi babeyijabulela kakhulu. Ngesikhathi uThandi eqhubeka nokufunda, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili. Kwakukhona izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile, ama-smartphones, nezinsiza eziningi ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu bangaxhumana kalula, babelane ngemininingwane, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kumjabulisile, ngoba wayefisa ukuba yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esisha. Kodwa, uThandi waqala futhi ukubona izinselelo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe. Kwakukhona abantu ababephikisana nezinto ezithile, njengokuphepha kwemininingwane. Uthisha wakhe, uMnu. Dlamini, wakhumbuza abafundi ukuthi "Ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busisize, kodwa kufanele siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nakho." Lokhu kwavusa umcabango kuThandi, futhi waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zingozi. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emcimbini wezobuchwepheshe. Lapha, wabona abantu abaningi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, behlanganyela izimvo, bexoxa ngezinto ezintsha, futhi bekwazisa ubuchwepheshe. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona kuphela ezandleni zabantu abaphezulu, kodwa bukhona nakubo bonke, futhi bonke bangaba neqhaza elikhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wathola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza emsebenzini wobuchwepheshe. Waqala ukufunda izinhlelo zokusebenza, wathola izifundo ezithokozisayo, futhi waba neqhaza elikhulu emsebenzini. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize abantu, bukhulise imiphakathi, futhi buphucule impilo. Lokhu kumjabulisile, ngoba wayefisa ukuba yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esisha. Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka nokufunda, waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo nabanye. Waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona kuphela ezandleni zabantu abaphezulu, kodwa bukhona nakubo bonke, futhi bonke bangaba neqhaza elikhulu. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize abantu, bukhulise imiphakathi, futhi buphucule impilo. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi wathola ithuba lokuhola emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Waqhubeka nokufunda, wabelana ngolwazi, futhi waba yisibonelo esihle kubanye. UThandi wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze busize abantu, bukhulise imiphakathi, futhi buphucule impilo. Lokhu kwaba yindaba yakhe, indaba yokukhula, yokufunda, nokuhlanganyela. Ngakho, uThandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni, futhi bukhona ukuze busize abantu baphumelele. Indaba yakhe ibonisa ukuthi, uma sithatha ithuba lokufunda, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinobuchwepheshe obuhle. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngothando, ukuzikhandla, nokufunda, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu, sibe yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe.
Isingeniso Namuhla sithokozile ukuba nezingxoxo ezijulile ngendawo yezinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okuhle, sikhulumisa uMnu. Sipho Ndlovu, ongumxhumanisi wezokuphathwa kwemali osebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene zomnotho. USipho, siyakwamukela! Uhlanga 1: Ukwethulwa kwezinga lentela USipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Izinga lentela liwumqondo obalulekile emnothweni wethu. E-Ningizimu Afrika, sinesistimu yeziqondiso ezibalulekile ezihlanganisa intela yengeniso, intela yokuthengisa, nezintela ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza uhulumeni ukuba aqoqe imali yokuxhasa izinhlelo zomphakathi. Uhlanga 2: Izinga lentela likasomabhizinisi Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi izinga lentela likasomabhizinisi lenza kube nzima kubanikazi bamabhizinisi? USipho: Yebo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile. Izinga lentela likasomabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika liphakathi kwezinga eliphakeme, lokho kubangela ukuthi abaninimabhizinisi bahlupheke. Lokhu kungenzeka kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhuleni kwamabhizinisi amancane, njengoba bekudingeka ukuthi baphathe izindleko eziphakeme. Uhlanga 3: Intela yengeniso Umbuzo: Ungasichazela kancane ngentela yengeniso? USipho: Impela. Intela yengeniso iyintela ekhishwa kubantu ngemali abayitholayo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, sinezinga elihlukahlukene lentela yengeniso eliqondene nezinga lemali etholwa. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuba kube nezinga eliphansi kubantu abathola imali encane, kanti abathola imali enkulu bahlawuliswa kakhulu. Uhlanga 4: Izinguquko kwezinga lentela Umbuzo: Zikhona izinguquko ezilindelekile kwezinga lentela? USipho: Yebo, uhulumeni uhlala ebheka indlela yokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Izinguquko zingahlanganisa ukuhlaziya izinga lentela, ukunciphisa izindleko zabantu, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo ezithile kubanikazi bamabhizinisi. Lokhu kuzosiza ekukhuliseni umnotho nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Uhlanga 5: Izinyathelo zokwenza ngcono izinga lentela Umbuzo: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lentela? USipho: Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani, izinyunyana, kanye nabantu ngabanye. Ukuxhumana nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezikahle. Ukubambisana kuholela ekutheni umphakathi uqonde kangcono izinga lentela, kanti nokwazisa ngalezi zinyathelo kubalulekile. Uhlanga 6: Umthelela wezinga lentela emnothweni Umbuzo: Umthelela wezinga lentela emnothweni ubaluleke kangakanani? USipho: Umthelela mkhulu. Izinga lentela eliphezulu lingaholela ekunciphiseni kwemali engenayo kumphakathi, okwenza kube nzima ukufaka izinhlelo ezithuthukisa umphakathi. Lokhu kuvame ukuholela ekunciphiseni kokutshalwa kwezimali nokukhula komnotho. Ngakho-ke, ukubeka izinga lentela eliphusile kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise umnotho. Uhlanga 7: Isiphetho Umbuzo: Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubaphakathi mayelana nezinga lentela? USipho: Yebo, ngicela bonke abantu baqonde ukuthi izinga lentela akukhona okungokwezezimali kuphela, kodwa kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umphakathi kumele ubambisane ukuze uphumelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngemfundo ngezinga lentela, ukuze abantu baqonde kangcono izimpikiswano ezihlobene nokuthola izinzuzo ezivela kulezi zinhlelo. Isiphetho Siyabonga, Mnu. Sipho Ndlovu, ngalesi sikhathi esijulile sokucacisa izinga lentela eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga lentela libalulekile emnothweni wethu, futhi ukuqonda kwethu konke okuhlobene nalokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga!
Ezokuphathwa Kwezimali: Ingxoxo Ehlakaniphile Sanibonani, bahlobo! Namuhla sizoxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile empilweni yethu: ezokuphathwa kwezimali. Ngiyazi ukuthi le ndaba ingase ibonakale iyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa ngizokwenza kube lula futhi kujabulise. Ngakho, masiqale! Okokuqala, ake sixoxe ngencazelo yokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu akukhona nje ukugcina imali, kodwa kuyinqubo yokuphatha izinsiza zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungafinyelela imigomo yakho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokuhlaziya izimali zakho. Abantu abaningi bahlala bephila impilo enezinkinga zezimali ngenxa yokungahlelwanga kahle. Ngakho, umgomo wethu wokuqala kufanele kube ukufunda ukuhlela. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuhlela izimali? Kulula! Uma ungahleleli kahle, ungase ube nebhajethi engalungile, okungaholela ekutheni ube nemali encane yokuphila, noma ungakwazi ukugcina imali yokuthenga izinto ezibalulekile. Ukuhlela kahle kusho ukuthi uzokwazi ukugcina imali yokuphila, yokuthenga, kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile empilweni yakho. Ngaphandle kokuhlela, kubalulekile futhi ukufunda ukuhlela ibhajethi. Ibhajethi iyithuluzi eliwusizo elikusiza uqonde ukuthi ungakanani imali onayo, nokuthi iyiphi imali ozoyisebenzisa. Uma usuhlele ibhajethi, kubalulekile ukuyigcina, lokho kusho ukuthi kufanele uqaphele izindleko zakho. Ungase uqale ngokuqopha zonke izindleko zakho zansuku zonke, lokho kuzokwenza kube lula ukukubona ukuthi kuphi lapho ungase unciphise khona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhuluma ngokuqapha izimali. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uhlale ubheka izimo zezimali zakho. Uma ubona ukuthi izindleko zakho zanda kakhulu, kufanele ubheke ukuthi kungani. Kungenzeka ukuthi kudinga ukuba uphinde uhlole ibhajethi yakho. Ukubheka izimali zakho njalo kuzokwenza uqonde kahle ukuthi uhamba kanjani. Kukhona ezinye izindlela ezilula zokuphatha izimali. Isibonelo, ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile ezikusiza ukuthi uqaphe izindleko zakho. Lezi zinhlelo zenza kube lula ukugcina amarekhodi, futhi zikusiza ukuthi uqonde kahle ukuthi imali yakho isendaweni efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ungasebenzisa ama-akhawunti ahlukene ukuze uhlukanise izinjongo zakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho. Ngabe uke wacabanga ngokutshala imali? Lokhu kuyindlela enhle yokukhulisa imali yakho. Kodwa, kufanele uqaphele, ngoba ukutshala imali akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili. Kufanele ufunde kahle ngezinkampani noma izimakethe ozifaka imali kuzo. Ukutshala imali kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi uma wenza kahle, ungathola imali eyengeziwe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume nangokugcina. Ukugcina imali kubalulekile, ngoba kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi unayo imali yokuphila uma kwenzeka okuthile. Lokhu kungaba yinto efana nokugula, ukulahlekelwa umsebenzi, noma okunye okungalindelekile. Ukugcina imali kuzokwenza uzizwe uphephile, futhi ungabi nengcindezi enkulu uma ubhekene nezinselelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sikhuluma ngezimali, akufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinjongo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sicele izinjongo ezithile, njengokuthenga indlu, imoto, noma ukuhamba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho, ngoba uzobe wazi kahle ukuthi yini ofuna ukuyifinyelela. Ukubeka izinjongo kuzokwenza uqonde kahle ukuthi kufanele usebenzise kangakanani imali yakho. Kukhona okunye okubalulekile okufanele sikukhumbule: izikweletu. Izikweletu zingaba yingozi uma ungaziphathi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uma uthola isikweletu, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukukhokha. Ukuphatha izikweletu kahle kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awuphumi emkhakheni wezinkinga zezimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi kahle izinga lezindleko zakho, futhi ungazami ukuthola izikweletu ezingaphezu kokwaziyo ukukhokha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo yezezimali. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izimali zakho zikhona njalo. Ukuphila kahle kwezomnotho kusho ukuthi kufanele ube necebo elihle lokuphatha izimali. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi ungakwazi ukuphila kahle, futhi ungakhathazeki ngezinkinga zezimali. Ngokuphetha, ezokuphathwa kwezimali akukhona nje ukugcina imali, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokuphatha izinsiza zakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyakwazi ukufinyelela imigomo yakho. Ukuhlela, ukuqapha, nokugcina izimali zakho kubalulekile. Futhi, ungakhohlwa ukufunda nokutshala imali ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyakhula. Ngakho, bahlobo, masithathe lezi zinyathelo ukuze siphile kahle, futhi sibe nezezimali ezinhle. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela!
Ngonyaka ozayo, le mceleko izobuyela futhi ithathe esinyathelweni esisha. Kulolu suku, umkhankaso wokufundisa nokwandisa ukuqwashisa ngezifo ezahlukene uqhubekile eClermont. Ngokubambisana noNompilo, lo mcimbi wawukhanya. Abantu abaningi abanesimo sengqondo esinzima babephakathi kwalomkhankaso. Iningi labo belidansa futhi lezingoma ngenjabulo. Abakhulumi abavela kuMnyango Wezempilo bagcizelela indima yokunakekela kanye nemindeni ekusizeni abantu abanezimfanelo zokucabanga. Abanye abagulayo banikezwa ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo zempilo ezindaweni ezahlukene. KwaDabeka kuyisibonelo esihle sokukhuthaza ukuncelisa izingane. Akubalulekile ukuthi uthumele umntwana wakho ukudla okunjani, kodwa ukuncelisa kuzohlale kuyindlela ephakanyisiwe yokukhulisa umntwana. Cishe sonke sethu sathola ukunceliswa.
