Uma othile ethi, "Ngiyamthanda uNkulunkulu," kodwa emthanda umfowabo, uyamanga. Ngoba noma ubani ongamthandi umfowabo, abona, ngeke akwazi ukumthanda uNkulunkulu, ongakaze ambone. Umjaho oqeqeshiwe washeshisa endaweni yengozi yemoto njengoba bekulindelekile. Isixuku sabantu sasha, kwenza kube nzima kumareporter wezindaba ofisa indaba ukuba asondele. Umjaho wazama isu. Baqala ukuhlabela phezulu: "Nithumele, nithumele, ngingumntwana walowo owashaywa le moto." Isixuku lapho saqala ukunyakaza, simvumela ukuba adlule. Phakathi kwalokho, phambi kwemoto, kwelapha idonki.
Umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane Emhlabeni wanamuhla, amabhizinisi amancane abalulekile ekukhuleni komnotho. Lokhu kudalula ubudlelwane obuqinile phakathi kokuphatha amabhizinisi nezinselele ezibhekene nawo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekucishweni kukagesi. Lo mcimbi obalulekile uzoletha umbono wokuthi lezi zimo zisebenza kanjani ezimpilweni zabanye ngokwezimali, ukukhula, kanye nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ngemuva kokuhlaziya izimo eziningi, siyakubona ukuthi ukuciswa kukagesi kungathinta kanjani amabhizinisi amancane. Okokuqala, sizocabanga ngempumelelo yokuphatha amabhizinisi, njengoba izinsuku zokukhiqiza, ukuletha, kanye nezinsiza zidinga ukuxhumana okungapheli. Lokhu kuzodingeka uma sikhuluma ngezinye zezinselelo ezithinta ukudayiswa nokuphathwa kwezimali. Okwenqaba, ukucishwa kukagesi kuvame ukuvimbela amabhizinisi amancane ekutholeni imikhiqizo, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo, opharetha ababevele bephila ezinhlakahleni ezinzima. Imakethe ibhunqwa ngezikhathi, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphila - okuhlanganisa ukhokho bezimboni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusilela kwezinsiza ezisemthethweni, okubangela ukuhamba kwesikhathi emsebenzini kanye nezinkinga zezimali. Okwesithathu, ukucishwa kukagesi kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ezindleleni zokujika kwemali. Njengoba amabhizinisi amancane evame ukwenza kahle, kuba nempikiswano yokuthi imikhiqizo ethile isebenzisa izinsiza eziza nalesi simo esiphuthumayo. Ukuze kube khona umkhuba wokugwema ukuncika ekuhlinzekeni kwamandla, abafakizwayo badinga izindlela ezikhetheke kakhulu ezizokwenza umkhuba ube ngokwemfundo. Njengoba sithola ukuthi ukucishwa kukagesi kuhlobene nemiphumela ethile emsebenzini wansuku zonke, sibuye sithole nokwehluka okukhona kumphakathi. Lokhu kuveza umthelela ohluke kakhulu phakathi kwabahlinzeki bemisebenzi, abathengi, nezinye izinsiza. Amabhizinisi amancane akwazi ukuphendula umqondo omusha nezindlela zokwakha ukuze azikhulise ekunciphiseni izingozi. Okwesine, sizohlola izindlela ezingasetshenziswa amabhizinisi amancane ukuze avikela izingozi zokucishwa kukagesi. Amabhizinisi angase athathe izinyathelo zokusungula indlela yokusebenza esezingeni eliphakeme ngokwakha izinhlelo ezokwazisa abantu mayelana nenkinga yokuncika kumandla kagesi ahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzovula umnyango wokuvikela imithombo yokugenqulwa kwemali. Umhlanganiso wezinsizakalo ezibalulekile, ukuhlinzeka ngemini, nokubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi kufanele kwenziwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuncintisana. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani kungaphinde kube nomthelela ophusile, oqhubekelayo futhi oligugu kakhulu. Ekugcineni, ukucishwa kukagesi kukhulu kakhulu emabhizinisini amancane, kuhlobene nezinsizakalo nezinsizakusebenza kumanje. Lo mcimbi uzosikhumbuza ukuthi, nakuba singalindela ukuthi ugesi uqhubeke noma unqamuke, amabhizinisi amancane kufanele aqhubeke edlondlobala, ethuthukisa izixazululo, futhi athole izindlela zokuphila ezikahle nezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukufundisa amabhizinisi amancane ngezindlela zokuzilungiselela okuhambisana nokuncika ekucishweni kukagesi. Lezi zinyathelo zingahlanganisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezahlukene, ukwakha izinhlelo zokuhlela, kanye nokwenza izinto ngendlela ephumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwakha imfundo eqinile, enobuchwepheshe ezinsizakalweni, futhi kubalusise ekwakheni ikakhulukazi. Ngemuva kwalokho, umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane akukhona nje kuphela ezinzima ezisemqoka, kodwa futhi uvula umyalezo wokuqhubekela phambili emazweni nasezizweni, lapho amabhizinisi amancane kufanele aqhubeke ezwikela ekwakheni izinsiza ezinomthelela omuhle ekuziphatheni. Lokhu kuzobhekelela izimo zezimali, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezinxusa eziyi-orthodox, ebhalwe ukubambisana phakathi kwemindeni nezizinda. Ngaphandle kokucishe kudlule isikhathi semizamo, umthelela wokucishwa kukagesi emabhizinisini amancane ungathinta indlela esiphila ngayo, silungiselela ubuchwepheshe, izinkampani, nabathengi ukuze babe nemiphumela emihle emsebenzini wabo. Lo mcimbi, okhombisa ubuchwepheshe obungcono, uzobamba iqhaza elikhulu ekukhuleni kwamabhizinisi amancane.
10.1 Hlonipha amalungelo akho njengomnikazi wepulazi. Abantu abangaziwa nababambe umoya omubi kumele bathole imvume kuqala ngaphambi kokungena epulazini. Buza esiteshini samaphoyisa sendawo yakho ukuthi umthetho uthi ungakwenza kanjani nokuthi ungawusebenzisa kanjani amalungelo akho. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bepulazi. Khuthaza abasebenzi ukuba bazi ngokuqinisekile ngokuphepha nokuthi babike noma yiziphi izenzo ezimbi. Khuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqaphele abantu abangaziwa endaweni futhi bakwazise ngabo. Reward abasebenzi uma behlinzeka ngama-tips noma ulwazi olusizo. Vikele kahle izindlu noma izindawo zokuhlala zabasebenzi nemindeni yabo. 10.3 Ungavumeli muntu ukuba angene epulazini noma endlini, ikakhulukazi ebusuku, ngaphambi kokuthi azive. 10.4 Kumele ugcine okungenani inja eyodwa ngaphakathi endlini. 10.5 Qinisekisa ukuthi amathuluzi anzima okusebenza afana nezikhukhula, ama-picks, ama-hoe, nezinye zivalwe kahle uma engasetshenziswa. Sebenzisa izivalo ezinemigqa noma uphinde ulabela okhiye. Zama ungathwali umjovo wezikhumbuzo. Sebenzisa okhiye abasebenza nezivalo ezinemigqa. Imigqa kufanele iguqulwe njalo. Susa okhiye ezimotweni uma engasadingeki. Guqula okhiye uma okhiye bakho bokuvula lost. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izicabha (kuhlanganise nezicabha ze-garage), amawindi, nezicabha zivalwe kahle uma engasetshenziswa. Ngaphambi kokuvula noma yini, qinisekisa ukuthi unokhiye wakho. Ungazami ukufihla okhiye ezindaweni ezilula ukufinyelela ezifana phansi kwemats noma ezitsheni. Uma ushiyela okhiye emgibeni ngaphakathi kwendlu, kufanele ujikele okhiye ukuze ugweme ukuvalwa ngaphandle. 10.7 Ngaso sonke isikhathi wazisa umndeni wakho lapho uya khona, ukuthi iyiphi indlela ozoyithatha, nokuthi uzobuya nini. 10.8 Hlola ifoni yakho njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iyasebenza. Beka ifoni endaweni lapho ingafinyelelwa kalula, ikakhulukazi kude newindi lapho ingashaywa kalula. 10.9 Ngaso sonke isikhathi gcina isibani esikhaleni sakho ebusuku; uma usebenzisa isibani, yenza kanjalo ngendlela engakhombisi indawo yakho. 10.10 Zama ukudala izithiyo zokuvimbela ukuhlaselwa kwezilwane nezimpahla. 10.11 Ungawenzi umsebenzi ofanayo noma umsebenzi owodwa nsuku zonke. 10.12 Yenza kube umkhuba wokungahambi embhedeni ngokushesha ngemva kokucisha ukukhanya ebusuku. Hlala uqaphele okwesikhashana. Ungalali endaweni lapho ungabonwa khona umuntu ngaphandle kwendlu. 10.13 Ungami phambi kwewindi uma uvalela noma uvula ama-curtains. Vala ama-curtains ngendlela engakhombisi kalula. Ama-curtains akufanele abe sobala ngaphakathi. Ukunyakaza kwabantu noma imithunzi yabo akufanele kubonakale ngaphandle ngaphakathi kwemitha eyi-10 kwendlu. 10.14 Thatha izithombe nemigqa yeminwe yazo zonke izisebenzi ukuze uvimbele ukuba zifeze noma zibe nengxenye ezinhle. 10.15 Ukuqeqesha ukuhamba ngebhande epulazini (endaweni ephephile) kungavimbela nabafuna ukwenza izenzo ezimbi. 10.16 Izingane zakho kufanele zikwazi ukuphendula ifoni ngenhlonipho. Akufanele zikhulume nabantu abangaziwa noma zamukele izipho kubantu abangaziwa. Bonke abakhona ekhaya kufanele babe nengxenye yokuzivikela. 10.17 Ngaso sonke isikhathi gcina ikhamera endala emotweni. Thatha izithombe zabantu abangaziwa endaweni noma abavakashele epulazini lakho. 10.18 Uma ungazi ukuthi ungabuyela kanjani ekhaya ngokuphepha ngemva kohambo, xhumana nomakhelwane wakho ukuze akusize uhlole ikhaya lakho. Lokhu kungavimbela ukuba ube yisithiyo kwababi. 10.19 Chaza izindawo ezivame ukuba ziphephile, ezifana nezindawo zokuhlala, ama-shower, noma izindawo zokugcina. Kungcono ukuba nezicabha nezama-windows ezincane. 10.20 Ungagcini izinto ezingabamba ukunakwa ngaphakathi endlini. 10.21 Qonda indawo ukuze ukwazi ukuphuma, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. 10.22 Fika ekhaya ngenkathi kusemhlabeni noma phakathi nosuku. 10.23 Qonda noma yiziphi izinqubo ezihlobene nezivakashi zamaphoyisa, uMphathi, noma omakhelwane. 10.24 Ukuxhumana kubalulekile kakhulu ekuzivikeleni emaphandleni. Ngakho-ke, ipulazi ngalinye kufanele libe nendlela yokuxhumana namanye amapulazi endaweni, amaphoyisa, kanye neNhlangano Yokuphepha. 10.25 Kumele kube nezindlela ezimbili zokweseka noma ukusiza esimweni esiphuthumayo, ezifana nefoni noma iradiyo yomphakathi. Ifoni ephathekayo iyasiza kakhulu ngoba ayixhunyiwe emgibeni ongafinyelelwa. 10.26 Uhlelo lokuxhumana olusebenzisa ama-radios kufanele lwenziwe futhi luhlale lwenziwa njalo. Umuntu onokwethenjelwa kufanele aqokwe ukuphatha lo msebenzi. 10.27 Abasebenzi bepulazi nabo bangengxenye yale qembu futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphepha. 10.28 Abasebenzi bepulazi kufanele babambe iqhaza ngokulinganayo ekugcineni ukuphepha epulazini. 10.29 Abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe ukusebenzisa amagama akhodiwe ukuze baphakamise izimpawu ezithile uma kukhona ingozi noma isimo esiphuthumayo. 10.31 Bonisa futhi wazise bonke abakhona epulazini mayelana nezindlela zokuphuma nezicabha. 10.32 Izindlela zokuxhumana (kuhlanganise nezinye izinhlobo zokuxhumana) kufanele zihlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza. 10.33 Uma kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuphepha phakathi kwabantu abasebenzi, kufanele kuphendulwe. 10.34 Zama izindlela ezahlukene. Thumela ulwazi kwabanye amalungu endaweni, uMphathi, noma iSikhungo Samaphoyisa ukuze kuhlolwe. 10.35 Ubudlelwano obuhle bokubambisana bubalulekile kakhulu.
Le nsizakalo isebenza kumuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika; noma kumuntu osevele enevumelekile yokusebenza ibhizinisi ezweni; noma kumuntu ofuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini elikhona ezweni. Izicelo zingafakwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi esifundazweni lapho ibhizinisi lihlelwe khona. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Umphakathi wezimali ophumelelayo okhulumela wena kufanele uthumele isiqinisekiso sokuthi inani elibekwe phansi lingempela lilingana nomkhawulo obekwe kumadokhumenti ebhizinisi. Umkhawulo wenani elizobekwa phansi ubekwe ku-R2.5 million, futhi le mali ingabekwa eceleni noma yehliswe kuphela uma izohlangabezana nezidingo zendawo, noma uma iceliwe yiMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuthi kwenziwe njalo. Uma ukuhlala okungapheli kunikezwa, isiqinisekiso somphakathi wezimali kufanele sihlaziywe njalo eminyakeni emibili ngemuva kosuku lokukhishwa kwemvume yokuhlala okungapheli, futhi eminyakeni emithathu elandelayo. Ukungahambisani nale mfuneko kuzoholela ekutheni imvume yakho yokuhlala okungapheli ibuyiswe. Umthetho Wokufuduka, 2002, njengoba ushintshiwe. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu service.
Abaguli banezimfanelo! Ngomhla kaMashi 21, sizokhumbula Usuku Lwamalungelo Abantu. Lolu suku lubalulekile emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngoba lusikhumbuza ngezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo bephikisana namalungelo abantu. Abaningi benu bangase bazi ukubaluleka kwalolu suku, kodwa kulabo abancane, nansi imlandvo. Ngomhla kaMashi 21, 1960, kwaba nokuphikisana okukhulu ezweni lonke ngokumelene nemithetho yokuphasa eyayidinga bonke abantu abamnyama abasebenza ezindaweni zasemadolobheni ukuba babe nemigomo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Labo abangazange balandele le mithetho bazoboshwa. Kulolo suku, abantu baya emaphoyiseni bengaphethe imigoqo futhi bekulungele ukuboshwa. Inhloso yabo kwakuwukuthi abantu abaningi bazo boshwa ukuze izinto zingahambi kahle ezweni ngalolo suku, okwakuzoholela ekupheleni kwemithetho yokuphasa. ESharpeville, eJohannesburg, lapho izinkulungwane ziqoqekile emaphoyiseni, kwaba nokuphikisana, futhi amaphoyisa avula umlilo. Cishe abantu abangama-70 babulawa, kanti abanye abangama-180 baphukile. Laba bantu babebhekene nemithetho engafanele futhi bephikisana namalungelo abo. Iningi lamaqembu lawo manje sekuhlanganiswe kwiBill of Rights esigabeni sesi-2 seSivumelwano sethu. Nokho, lawa malungelo awawona kuphela abantu abathile; awahlukanisi ngokuthi wenza muphi umsebenzi, futhi awabheki ukuthi ungumuntu ocebile noma omncane. Kukhona neBill of Rights yabaguli. Ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuze sibe nolwazi ngesimo sethu sezempilo. Ukukhetha uhlobo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo esifuna. Ukwamukelwa umuntu owaziwa emkhakheni wezempilo. Ukuze isimo sabo sezempilo sikhulunywe kubo bonke, futhi sigcinwe ngasese. Ukukhetha ukwelashwa kunikezwa yonke imininingwane mayelana nalokho okuzokwenziwa. Ukufuna umbono wesibili kudokhumenti noma esibhedlela uma singathembi lokho okukhuluma. Njengoba wonke umuntu enamalungelo abantu kusukela ekuzalweni, futhi akekho ongawathatha, abaguli akufanele baphatheke noma bacele amalungelo abo. Khumbula, kufanele futhi uhloniphe amalungelo abanye. Ukuntuleka kwez nurses ezibhedlela ezilawulwa uMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal kuyakhathaza, ikakhulukazi ngohlelo lokuqeqesha lwez nurses olunikezwa yile mnyango kulo nyaka. Lokhu kukhathazeka kuboniswa njengomphumela wezinqola ezinde nezikhathi zokulinda emaphoyiseni. Kuphinde kuboniswe njengomphumela wokuthi abaguli abatholi ukunakwa ngokushesha kuze kube baphuma ezihlalweni. Lezi zifundo zinez nurses zizokwenziwa ezikhungweni ezingu-25 ezizobe ziqhamuka kulo mnyango. Kuzodingeka ukuthi baqedele isivumelwano nomnyango zobuchwepheshe obuzobavuma ukuba basebenze ezikhungweni zezempilo ezilawulwa yile mnyango uma sekuqedile ukuqeqeshwa kwabo. "Lokhu yikho okuzokwenziwa ngababheki," kusho udokotela. Ngisebenza ezindaweni zokuhamba, ngiyajabula ukuba nethuba lokuzibophezela kulabo abazimisele ukusebenza kuMnyango, ngibona ukuthi kuhle ezindaweni zasemakhaya, inkinga ukuthi ukushiya ithimba eliqinile ukuze lisebenze kumnyango ngeke kusebenze kahle emphakathini. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhokhiwe ezindaweni zokuphatha lapha e-EMRS, sisebenze iminyaka. "Iz nurses ziyisisekelo sonke isisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa." Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngethimba elizokwenziwa ngalo mnyango. Uqhubekile wathi ukwelashwa kuyinto ethokozisayo ngoba kudinga ukuzinikela. UNgqongqoshe ukholelwa ukuthi labo abazinikela bazoqinisekisa ukuthi baqeqesha futhi bazibophezela kulabo abafuna abasebenzi bezempilo. Nakuba kunzima kimi kulo mnyango, NGIKHOLWA ukuthi abanye benu bezwe ngengubo emnyama eyashaya umndeni wami ngenkathi ngilahlekelwa ngendodana yami, uMonde. EKwaZulu-Natal, kanye nakuzo zonke eNingizimu Afrika, ngiyabonga ngenkxaso yenu ngesikhathi umndeni wami nami besesimweni esinzima. Ngakho-ke ngifuna ukuthatha leli thuba, engilithole kulolu shicilelo, ukubonga ngempela wonke umuntu ngama-akhawunti enu, ngokuthatha isikhathi sokungibona, kulabo abathumele izimbali, baphakamisela thina, nabanye abakhululekile kithi. Anginayo imishwana eyanele yokuchaza ukuthi kwangijabulisa kangakanani lokho enikwenze kimi, kubantu engingabazi, abangane, izihlobo, ozakwethu, nomphakathi wonke. Konke engingakusho ukuthi uNkulunkulu akubusise kakhulu. EKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukuqala unyaka omusha ngenjabulo enkulu ngokwamukela uMphakathi omusha. Ngingase ngiphazamiseke uma ngithi omusha ngoba akasiyena umusha kulo mnyango; ube yingxenye yawo iminyaka eminingi. UDr. Busi Nyembezi ungumuntu ozinikele, ophumelele kakhulu emfundweni, enolwazi lwezempilo aluthole lapha esifundazweni futhi wafinyelela nakwamanye amazwe. Ngiyamemukela kulo Mnyango ngempilo efudumele. Nginezithemba eziphakeme zokuthi uzohola lo mnyango ngendlela ezokwamukelwa ngabaguli kanye nemindeni yabo. Uzosebenza nethimba elihlanganisa othisha abasha nabanolwazi, okuzosiza ukuhamba phambili kulo mnyango ukuze ubhekane nezinhlelo zawo ezivunyelwe. Lo msebenzi ubalulekile kithi sonke kuMnyango. Isikhathi seHope, ukhuluma ngodokotela wezitho uma ethula inkulumo yakhe ekuvuleni kwePhalamende. UMnyango wethu ubeke izinto ezimbalwa okumele zigxilwe kuzo ngokushesha. Ukuqinisa izinhlelo ezibalulekile, kugxilwe kakhulu ezinhlelweni ze-tuberculosis (TB), ukuvimbela i-HIV, nokuphila kahle. Emihlanganweni yami elandelayo, ngizochaza ukuthi siphokophelele ukwenza kulawa makhaza engikhuluma ngawo. Okwamanje, kuhle ukusho ukuthi sizothola ukunakwa okuzoletha ushintsho ezimpilweni zabantu. Siyajabula ukuthi sizokwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinhloso zethu zokwenza abantu abangu-30,000 bathole ama-ARVs kule nyanga esiqala ngayo. Njengoba uMholi wesifunda uDr. Sbu Ndebele esho enkulumweni yakhe kwiLegislature, kukhona abantu abangaphezu kuka-28,000 okwamanje abathola ukwelashwa. Ngenkathi kuyibhizinisi lethu ukunakekela nokunakekela abaguli, kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhulume ngenkolo yokuvimbela, ukuze ngenkathi sikhathalela abaguli, sigcine nabantu abaphephile bephila kahle. Yingakho kule nyanga sikhona emkhankasweni wokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi kufanele bazinakekele futhi bavikele ezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Lokhu okukhuluma sikukhuluma kulula; kusho nje ukuthi impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Singakusiza ngemininingwane, sikusize ngokuqeqeshwa nokunakekelwa, kodwa ekugcineni, kuyena kuphela okufanele avikele impilo yakhe. Sizophinde sikhulume ngale nkolo ikakhulukazi ngosuku lweHIV, ekupheleni kukaMashi. Ekupheleni, ngifuna ukukhuthaza labo abafanele ukuvota ukuthi baphume en masse kusasa
Le ncwadi isekelwe kulwazi olunikezwe yizikhungo ezifanele, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngokuqondile noma ngamawebhusayithi azo. Abacwaningi bacabange ukuthi lonke ulwazi lunikezwa ngenhloso enhle futhi luyiqiniso. Asikwazi ukubekwa icala ngokunembile nangokuphelele kolwazi olunikezwe kithi. Uma ufuna ukuthi inhlangano yakho ifakwe ezibuyekezeni ezizayo zalesi sithombe, sicela uthumele i-imeyili ku: kmosweu@deat.gov. Iziphakamiso ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu (SMMEs) ziyizinjini zokuthuthukiswa. Zifaka isandla ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi nasemnotfweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi ama-SMME ezokuvakasha asungulwe ukuze azimele futhi akhule. Ukuze kusizwe ngalokhu, uMnyango Wezemvelo Nezokuvakasha, ngokuqhuba iBhange Lezokuvakasha, uthuthukise iqoqo lezinsiza ezihloselwe ukusiza osomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha bakhuphule amabhizinisi abo futhi babe nezinzuzo. Le ncwadi ibalulekile kakhulu njengoba inikeza indawo eyodwa, efanele yokufinyelela ulwazi, ikakhulukazi kubasomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha, ngoxhaso lwamabhizinisi olukhona kubo. Lapho iqalwa, le ncwadi izotholakala nakwezinye izilimi ezisemthethweni, okungukuthi isiZulu, isiSetswana, nesiAfrikaans. Sizokwenza ukuqhubeka nokubuyekeza le ncwadi minyaka yonke futhi sihunyushe nakwezinye izilimi eziningi. Anginankinga yokuthi uzothola le ncwadi iyinsiza ewusizo emizamweni yakho yebhizinisi, futhi ngifisa ngenhliziyo ukuthi uphumelele ekusunguleni ibhizinisi lezokuvakasha elizinzile nelinenzuzo. Nginecebo elihle! Ngaphi engingathola khona uxhaso lokuqala ibhizinisi lami? Imibuzo - Yini engangenza ngibe umthengisi? Yisiphi isakhiwo sebhizinisi okufanele ngikhethe? Wamukelekile kulo mhlaba omuhle wezokuvakasha. Sithemba ukuthi uzothola le ncwadi ewusizo. Le ncwadi izokunikeza ulwazi oluwusizo ukusiza emizamweni yakho yokusungula ibhizinisi elihlobene nezokuvakasha. Ihlanganisa izihloko ezivela ekubhaleni kwezinhlelo zebhizinisi kuya ekufuna uxhaso lwezezimali nasekunikezeni ulwazi olubalulekile lokuxhumana. Sicela ukhumbule ukuthi le yindlela ejwayelekile, ngakho-ke siphakamisa kakhulu ukuthi ubheke emithonjeni yolwazi ehlukene. Enye yezici ezibalulekile zalesi sithombe ukuthi inikeza ulwazi ngazo zonke iziqalo ezikhona ukusiza ukusungula ibhizinisi elisha noma ukukhulisa elikhona. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuze uthole ukuthi ubani ongcono kuwe futhi uxhumane nabo ngqo. Khumbula ukuthi izikhungo eziningi zinikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene nokuxhaso. Ukuze sigcine isikhala kule ncwadi, asiphindaphindi imininingwane yabo kodwa sikunikeza ikhasi elihambelana nalokho ukuze ubheke. Izifundazwe eziningi zineziqalo zazo kanye nezincwadi eziphezulu ezishicilelwe. Xhumana nabo ngqo usebenzisa ulwazi lokuxhumana olunikezwe eMkhakheni 5. Ukusungula ibhizinisi lakho akuyona into elula futhi kudinga umsebenzi onzima nokuzinikela. Izokuvakasha zihluke futhi zisebenza ngendlela ehlukile kunezinye izimboni kulokhu. Sifake imibuzo ejabulisayo eMkhakheni 5 ukuze sikunikeze umqondo wokuthi unakho yini okudingekayo ukuze ungene ebhizinisini. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuqoqa ulwazi oluhambelana kakhulu. Funda ngokusemandleni akho - lokhu kuhlanganisa amaphephandaba, amajornali, kanye namawebhusayithi. Kubalulekile ukubheka le ncwadi njengendawo yokuqala, hhayi njengomhlahlandlela oqinile wokuba nebhizinisi lezokuvakasha eliphumelelayo. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuze uthole ulwazi olungeziwe futhi ungamisi ukufunda ngempilo yakho yebhizinisi nezokuvakasha. Ithuluzi Lezebhizinisi. Siphakamisa ukuthi ufike kulolu lwazi ukuze uthole ulwazi olunzulu, uma kudingeka. Sikufisela inhlanhla futhi sikwamukela kulo mhlaba omuhle wezokuvakasha! Kube nokuxoxisana okuthile mayelana nokuchazwa kwesisho "umtraveller" nokuthi yiziphi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngempilo kubavakashi. Umtraveller ungumuntu ovakashela futhi ohlala ngaphandle kwendawo ehlukile kulokho akujwayelekile isikhathi esithile futhi angaba umtraveller "wendawo" - umuntu ophila eNingizimu Afrika kodwa ovakashele ingxenye ehlukile yelizwe nomndeni nabangane ukuze ajabulele; umtraveller "webhizinisi" ohamba evela kwelinye izwe noma ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika ukuze enze imisebenzi yebhizinisi noma umtraveller "wamazwe omhlaba" ovakashela eNingizimu Afrika evela kwelinye izwe ukuze abone lokho esingakunikela. Izokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika zihlanganisa zonke izigaba ezisebenza ukwenza ulwazi lomtraveller ezweni lethu lujabulise futhi lukhumbuleke. Ukuhlinzeka ngamaTravellers (ukuhlala) kuhilela ukunikeza indawo yokuhlala, isibonelo, ukuphumula nokudla kwasekuseni, izindlu zokwamukela, izikhungo zokuzihlalela, amaholo amasha, izindawo zokuhlala, amahhotela, njll. I-MICE (Imihlangano, Izikhuthazo, Imicimbi, Nezenzakalo) iyisigaba esihloselwe ikakhulukazi ukuhlela nokuphatha imihlangano nezinye izenzakalo ezifana nemibukiso nokwenza ukuthi abamele abakhethiwe bathole itiye nelunch. Ndawonye sizokwakha umkhiqizo wezokuvakasha ongathengiswa emhlabeni jikelele ngama-exhibitions omhlaba, sikhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zize zibone lokho ezweni lethu elihle elinokunikeza, isibonelo, amabhishi amahle, izikhumbuzo zomlando, abantu abahle, izindawo zokuthenga, nezindawo eziningi ezihlukile nezithokozisayo eNingizimu Afrika. Izokuvakasha zihlobene cishe nazo zonke ezinye izenzo ezweni ngendlela ethile. Kodwa isebenzisa eyodwa noma ngaphezulu (umuntu ophakathi). Ndawonye nokuthi konke kusebenze ndawonye, kuletha abavakashi kusuka ezindaweni zabo emhlabeni jikelele beze eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthola ukuqonda okuhlakaniphile kokuthi ubani ozosebenzisa imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho ekugcineni, nobani okufanele uxhumane nabo ohambweni lwakho lokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi. Sifake umdwebo ngezansi ukuze sikhombise ukuthi le nqubo ingasebenza kanjani kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela nokuthi ubani ozothola izinzuzo kule nqubo. Uzobona ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi zithola izinzuzo kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela - empeleni, bangaba abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo kumphakathi wezokuhlala. Khuluma neNhlangano Yezokuvakasha yendawo ukuze uthole izeluleko zokukhulisa ibhizinisi lakho. Ulwazi olungeziwe luhlanganiswe esigabeni Sokumaketha seMkhakheni 4. Uhlelo luzosungulwa kanjani futhi umsebenzisi uzothenga kanjani iholidi? Kube nolwazi oluningi muva nje mayelana nezimboni zezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi sithokozisa kakhulu ukwanda kwenani labavakashi abavakashela ezweni lethu elihle. Izenzakalo ezibalulekile ezifana neMidlalo yeFIFA ye-2010 nayo izoba nomthelela omkhulu embonini yethu, futhi kufanele kube namathuba okuthi abathengisi bakwazi ukukhombisa izinsiza zabo. Ngokuvamile
Imvelo yamanje ukuthi kukhona abangu-28. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kweMasingana ngo-2002, iKabinet yayala uNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe ukuba presents isicwangciso seSizwe sokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa. Le ndlela izoba yisihluthulelo ekukhuleni komnotho futhi isekela ezinye izicwangciso ezifana neStrateji Yokuthuthukiswa Komuntu, iStrateji Yezimboni Ezisebenzayo, kanye neStrateji Yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika. Ukwehla okubonakalayo kokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe (isibonelo; ukugxila kakhulu ekuvikeleni nasekuzimeleni kwezidingo zamandla) okwakuvamile kuhulumeni ophakathi kuka-1990 no-1994. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokuxhaswa kohlelo lokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa kwezizwe kusuka ku-1.1% ngo-1990 kuya ku-0.7% ngo-1994. Lokhu kwehla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uhlelo lweZizwe Zokwakha Ezintsha lwaludinga ukukhula ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu abangu-40 million uma kuqhathaniswa nabangu-6.5 million. Ukubhekana nezinkinga zesikhathi eside, ukuthuthukiswa komuntu, ezomnotho nezokuphepha. Izimpendulo ezifanele ezihlobene nezifo ezintsha nezindala, noma lezi zifo zithinta abantu noma izilwane, kufanele ziphathwe ngohlelo lokucwaninga lendawo. Uma sicabanga ngezokuphepha, ngisho nomthengi onolwazi wezobuchwepheshe obukhona obungakabi phezulu udinga abacwaningi abaningi abenza ucwaningo ezindaweni ezifanele. Izindaba zomsebenzi nabantu. Umkhakha wethu wabacwaningi nezobuchwepheshe awuqinile kahle noma awuqinile. Inani elikhulu labacwaningi abamhlophe, abesilisa, nabadala abahambisani nabantu abancane ngendlela ebonisa isithombe esifanele sokuxubana kwabantu bezwe. Iziphakamiso ezilula zithonywe kakhulu yizinguquko ekubambisaneni kwamazwe omhlaba eziholela ekwehleni kwezinga lokutshalwa kwezimali nasekusebenzeni komkhakha wezobuchwepheshe nezokuthuthukiswa ezizimele eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokulawula ngaphakathi kwesisekelo solwazi esiyisisekelo esibalulekile empumelelweni yezinkampani zethu ezincintisanayo. Imithetho efanele ephathelene nezimpahla zengqondo nezinsiza. Ukuthuthukiswa okusha kwezobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha kukhuphule ingozi yokuhlukumezeka kokucwaninga emkhakheni wezokwelapha, kuyilapho izicwangciso zokucwaninga ezisekelwa uhulumeni ezintsha zingavikelwe futhi aziphathwa ngendlela efanele. Izakhiwo zokwahlulela ezihlukene. Nakuba izikhungo zokucwaninga zibe sezibuyekeziwe futhi izinkomba eziyisisekelo zisetshenzisiwe, indima yamapharamitha ekwahluleleni nasekufakeni izindinganiso ezilindelekile ezikhungweni zokucwaninga kukahulumeni ayikacacile. Uma sibheka ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali, akukho mbono obanzi wokuchitha kukahulumeni kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe. Ukudala uhlelo oluqinile lwezobuchwepheshe nezocwaningo kukahulumeni. Iphuzu lezindlela ezintsha libandakanya ukusungulwa nokutshalwa kwezimali ezinhlelweni ezihlukahlukene zobuchwepheshe ezibalulekile ekukhuthazeni ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amapulatifomu amabili abalulekile ezobuchwepheshe esikhathini samanje, ahlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuthinta imithi nolwazi. Enye indlela yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokukhiqiza nobuchwepheshe obwenza izinguquko ezinsizeni ezisekelwe noma ezinsizeni zemvelo. Ekugcineni, sizobumba indlela, ubuchwepheshe bokwehlisa ubuphofu obuzobhekana nezinselelo esihlangabezana nazo manje. Le ndlela izophathwa yisikhungo esisha esaziwa njengeSikhungo Sezindlela Ezintsha Zobuchwepheshe (FTI) esizosebenza njengendawo yokutshalwa kwezimali egxile kulwazi, le ndawo izogxila kakhulu ezicwangcweni ezintsha ngaphakathi kwazo zonke izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. I-FTI izotshala imali ezicwangcweni ezintsha kuwo wonke imikhakha yomphakathi nasekhanda elizimele kanye nasezikhathini ezihlukahlukene kusukela ekwakhiweni kwesicwangciso kuya ekwethulweni komkhiqizo emphakathini ngenkathi igxila kakhulu esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa kwesicwangciso esinezimali eziphezulu kanye nokwamukelwa komkhiqizo emphakathini lapho uthengiswa, ulethelwa, noma usatshalaliswa. Indlela esihamba ngayo ukuze sithuthukise abantu ibonwa ngakolunye uhlangothi ngokudingeka kokukhuphuka okusheshayo kwenani labantu abakhishwa kumathuba esikhathini esedlule, abesifazane abangena emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe ukuze bahlale kuwo, kuyilapho ngakolunye uhlangothi sithumele umgomo wokwakha isicwangciso sokuhlangabezana nezinselelo zokuhweba nokubambisana nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba. Ukuqonda okujulile komphakathi mayelana Nezinhlelo ZeSayensi kungaphumelela ekwandiseni lezi zibalo kuphela uma intsha ingabona amathuba akhangayo futhi ajabulisayo emisebenzini elindelekile. Ngeminyaka yama-1970 kanye ne-1980, lezi zindawo zomsebenzi zaziningi ngenxa yezinselelo zendawo eyayikhona ngaleso sikhathi - nakuba zazivame ukugxilwa ohlangothini oluthile lomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, iphuzu labantu libaluleke kakhulu ukuba lihlangane nephuzu lezobuchwepheshe. Emhlabeni jikelele, indlela yokukhiqiza abacwaningi abaphezulu abakwazi ukudlulela kwezinye izikhala ibandakanya ukugxila kakhulu emandleni okwenza kahle emsebenzini. Enye indlela ephezulu ezingeni likazwelonke iwukugxila kakhulu ezidingweni zomsebenzi ophansi kwezobuchwepheshe ezindaweni lapho sinesikhathi esihle sokuphumelela ngenxa yokuba khona kwezinsiza zemvelo nolwazi olutholakalayo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lezi zindawo zifaka ulwazi lwezulu nolwazi lwezemvelo. Isikhungo esihamba phambili uma kukhulunywa ngalesi sicwangciso, esikhuthaza isayensi, yiNational Research Organization esebenza ngokubambisana nomkhakha wezokufunda ophakeme ngohlelo lweZokufunda Oluphakeme Lwenhlangano. Nakuba umsebenzi kahulumeni wangaphakathi waba nesakhiwo esisha ngo-1994, izibopho eziningi ezinamandla zeNational New Strategies Program zaphazamiseka. Ukuqonda indima yamapharamitha anikezwe imisebenzi efana neMnyango Wezolimo Nezempilo ophakamisa izinhlelo ezimkhakheni ethile kanye neMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe (DACST) kufanele udlale indima ethile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezilindelekile emhlabeni jikelele mayelana nokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe zilandelwa, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yokucwaninga ethuthukile (ukukhiqiza ulwazi), izicwangciso ezintsha (amabhizinisi amasha, imikhiqizo, nemisebenzi) kanye nokwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi. Indima ye-DACST izoba ukuhlela uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka umnikelo wezokusebenza zezilabhulali eziphethwe uhulumeni futhi ibe nesibopho esiqondile ezikhungweni ezinhlanu ezigxilile, njengeNational Research Center, iScience Promotion Center (eyaziwa ngaphambili njengeFEST), iCenter for New Technological Strategies, iCouncil for Scientific Research and Industry, kanye neCouncil for Human Science. Imikhakha efanele izoba nezibopho zokun
Ubudlelwano: Umgogodla Wokuphila Kwethu Ubudlelwano bukhona phakathi kwabantu bonke, kungaba phakathi komndeni, abangane, noma othandweni. Lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yethu, njengoba ubudlelwano buvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe izinkumbulo ezihlaba umxhwele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano buphathelene nokuxhumana, ukwethembana, nokuhloniphana. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlaka Zobudlelwano Ubudlelwano bokuqala obubalulekile empilweni yami bukhona phakathi kwami nomndeni wami. Umndeni ungumgogodla wethu, lapho sithola khona uthando, ukwesekwa, kanye nokuqonda. Ngaphandle komndeni, ubudlelwano bethu nabangane bukhombisa indlela esithanda ngayo ukujabulisa, sabelane ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi sikhulume ngezinto ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba ubudlelwano bethu nabangane bukhuthaza ukuvuleka, ukuxhumana, nokwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala isikhathi eside. Ukwethembana Njengesisekelo Sobudlelwano Ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo busekelwe ekwethembaneni. Uma abantu bephila ngokwethembana, bakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi emshadweni, lapho ukwethembana kudinga ukuba kube phezulu. Ukungathembeki kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ebudlelwaneni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sikhulume ngokuqondile, sabelane ngezinkinga zethu, futhi sithole izixazululo ezihlanganyelwe. Ukwamukela Umehluko Ubudlelwano buphinde buhlangane nezimo ezahlukene. Abantu bahluka ngezindlela eziningi, okuhlanganisa izinkolelo, izizinda, nezifiso. Ukwamukela umehluko phakathi kwabantu kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu akusho ukuthi kufanele sithathe konke okukhuluma abanye, kodwa kufanele sibe nekhono lokuhlonipha imibono ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, lapho abantu bezizwa bekhululekile ukuveza imicabango yabo. Ukuxhumana Okuphumelelayo Ukuxhumana kuyisihluthulelo sobudlelwano obuphumelelayo. Ukuze ubudlelwano buphumelele, abantu kufanele bakwazi ukukhuluma ngokukhululeka, bezwakalisa imizwa yabo, futhi baphendule ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchule bokulalela, lapho umuntu engalalela ngempela okukhuluma omunye, ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Ukuxhumana okuhle kudala umoya wokwethembana, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ezinkingeni. Izinkinga Ezingavela Ebuhlotsheni Noma ubudlelwano bukhona, akukhona njalo kube lula. Izinkinga zingavela, futhi kubalulekile ukuzibhekisisa. Ukungaboni ngaso linye, ukungathembeki, noma izimo eziphazamisayo zingaholela ekuphuleni ubudlelwano. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi izinkinga ziyingxenye yempilo, futhi kufanele bazame ukuzixazulula ngokukhuluma. Ukuxhumana okuhle nokuhloniphana kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano Obuqinile Ubudlelwano obuqinile busekelwe ekuzinikeleni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu kufanele bazibophezele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlela isikhathi sokuchitha ndawonye, ukwenza izinto ezithokozisayo, noma ukusiza omunye uma edinga usizo. Ubudlelwano obuqinile buvame ukuhlala isikhathi eside, futhi buvumela abantu ukuba bakhule ndawonye. Isiphetho: Ubudlelwano Njengomgogodla Wokuphila Ubudlelwano buphila, bukhula, futhi buguquka. Kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu buphathelene nokuxhumana, ukwethembana, nokuhloniphana. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele siqhubeke sifunda, sithuthukise ubudlelwano bethu, futhi sithole izindlela zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. Ubudlelwano bethu bukhona ukuze busisize, bukhuthaze, futhi bube umgogodla wempilo yethu. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sithanda, sikhuluma, futhi sakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, ukuze sibe nekhono lokubhekana nezinkinga zempilo. Ubudlelwano bethu buphathelene nokuphila kwethu, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle.
Hhawu, unjani? Ngicela sikhulume ngento ethile ebalulekile – izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng. Uyazi, lezi zikhathi zibalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhuluma ngempilo yabantu. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi kungani izikhathi zokuphendula zibalulekile? Ngicabanga ukuthi uma umuntu edinga usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo, ukufika kwama-ambulensi ngesikhathi kuyasiza kakhulu. Njengoba sikhuluma ngama-ambulensi, akusikho konke okukhuluma ngempilo kuphela. Kukhona nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo ezifana nezingozi zomgwaqo, izifo eziphuthumayo, noma ngisho nezimo ezinjengokushayisana. Ngakho-ke, uma ama-ambulensi efika masinyane, lokho kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomuntu. Kodwa-ke, ngabe uyazi ukuthi izikhathi zokuphendula zingahluka? Kukhona izindawo ezithile eGauteng lapho ama-ambulensi efika khona ngokushesha, kanti kwezinye izindawo kungathatha isikhathi eside. Lokhu kuncike ezintweni eziningi, njengezimo zomgwaqo, ukuvuleka kwemigwaqo, kanye nenani labantu abakhalayo. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi kungani lokhu kubalulekile? Ngithanda ukucabanga ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngezikhathi zokuphendula, kumele sikhulume nangokutholakala kwezinsiza. Uma ama-ambulensi engatholakali kalula, lokho kungadala izinkinga ezinkulu. Ngabe ubona izinkinga ezinjalo? Uhlanga olukhulu lwezindawo ezisemadolobheni lungaba nezinselelo ezithile, kodwa ezindaweni ezikude, izikhathi zokuphendula zingaba zinde kakhulu. Futhi, akukona kuphela ukuphendula okukhuluma ngakho. Kukhona nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhathi zokuphendula. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zikhona? Njengoba sikhuluma ngalesi sihloko, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni lezi zikhathi. Uma abantu bekwazi ukusiza, lokho kungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngithanda futhi ukukhuluma ngendaba yokufundisa abantu. Uma abantu beqonda ukuthi kumele baphuthume uma bebona isimo esiphuthumayo, lokho kungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. Ngabe ubona ukuthi ukufundisa abantu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu? Kukhona nezinhlelo eziningi ezikhona ukuze kufundiswe abantu ukuthi baphendule kanjani ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, kubalulekile ukuthi ama-ambulensi abe nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze aphendule ngokushesha. Lokhu kubandakanya izimoto ezinhle, abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ngabe uke wacabanga ukuthi izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza kanjani? Uma ama-ambulensi enezinsiza ezinhle, lokho kungenza kube lula ukuhamba nokuphendula. Futhi, akukona kuphela ama-ambulensi. Kukhona nezinye izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezikhungo zezokwelapha eziseduzane. Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuthola usizo uma kudingeka. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izikhungo zezokwelapha zibalulekile? Uma abantu benokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwama-ambulensi nezikhungo, lokho kungasiza kakhulu. Ngokuphetha, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng zibalulekile kakhulu. Kukhona izinselelo, kodwa futhi kukhona nezindlela zokuthuthukisa. Uma umphakathi ungena esithombeni, singakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ngabe usukhumbule ukuthi umphakathi unendima enkulu? Ngiyazi ukuthi uma sithola usizo, kumele sibe nesineke futhi sibe nomoya ophusile. Ngiyabonga ngokukhuluma nami ngalesi sihloko. Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukukwazi? Noma ungathanda ukwabelana ngeminye imibono yakho? Ngithanda ukukuzwa.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Uhambo Kwakuyinsuku ehlanzekile, ilanga lishaya, futhi uSipho wayephumile endlini yakhe, ezilungiselela uhambo olukhulu. Njengomuntu oqeqeshiwe kwezobuchwepheshe, wayenamagama amaningi afanele emsebenzini, kodwa uSipho wayelokhu ehlangabezana nenkinga enkulu — ukufuna umsebenzi. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe ezikhaliphile, wacabanga ukuthi kuzoba lula ukuthola ithuba, kodwa kwaba kudingeka ukuba abhekane nezithiyo eziningi. U-Sipho wayebona umhlaba unemathafa amakhulu angamathuba, kodwa iminyango eminingi yayingavaliwe. Wazi ukuthi ukufuna umsebenzi akukhathaleli nje ukukhangela, kodwa kudinga umsebenzi omkhulu, ukusungula, nokuzimisela. Ngakho, uSipho wathola ukuthi usuku lokuqala lokufuna umsebenzi lwalungelula, kodwa kudinga ukuthi aqhubeke. Isahluko 2: Uhlolo Nezinhlelo Ngemuva kokuhlangana nabangane bakhe, uSipho wathola izeluleko eziningi. UThandi, umngani wakhe osebenza emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, wakhumbuza uSipho ukuba achaze kahle izifundo zakhe, ahlale ehlanganyela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, futhi abhalise emaphusheni ukuze athole amathuba. "Kusukela manje, kufanele ube necebo," kusho uThandi. Lokhu kwamjabulisa uSipho, ngoba wayesebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, efuna ithuba elilodwa. U-Sipho waqala ukwenza uhlu lwemisebenzi angathanda ukuyifaka. Waqala ngezimboni azithandayo, futhi waqonda ukuthi kunemisebenzi eminingi ethokozisayo efana ne-IT, ubuchwepheshe besimanje, nokukhangisa. Ngemva kokuchaza izifiso zakhe, waqala ukuhlela indlela yokubhalisa izicelo, agcine esebenzisa izinkundla ezahlukene zokuxhumana ukuze athole imininingwane emisha nezikhala ezivulekile. Isahluko 3: Ukukhuluma Nabangani Njengoba edlula ezikhathini ezinzima, uSipho wathola isikhathi sokukhuluma nabangane bakhe abakhuluma ngezinto abanesipiliyoni kuzo. UPhindi, owasebenza emnyangweni wezisebenzi, wakhumbuza uSipho ukuthi kufanele abhale incwadi yokufaka isicelo esiyingqayizivele. "Thola indlela yokuziveza, ubonise ukuthi ungubani. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle imisebenzi ofuna ukuyifaka," kusho uPhindi. U-Sipho wahamba phambili, wabhala izincwadi ezinhle, ezichaza kahle izifundo zakhe, nezinjongo zakhe. Wafunda futhi ukuthi uma ubhalela umsebenzi, kubalulekile ukufaka izizathu zokuthi kungani efanele le ndima. Lokhu kumjabulisile, njengoba wayecabanga ngempumelelo yakhe. Isahluko 4: Ukuhlolwa Kwamathuba Ngemva kokuhambisa izicelo, uSipho waqala ukuthola izimpendulo. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezithile, wakwazi ukuthola umcalls yokuhlanganisa nezinye izinkampani. Uhlelo lokuhlola lwalubukeka lukhulu; wayethembekile, kodwa ngaphakathi, wayezizwa esaba. Wazi ukuthi lezi zikhathi zihlala zibalulekile empilweni yakhe. Uhlanga lokuhlola lwakhe lwalubandakanya izizathu eziningi, ezazithinta imisebenzi yebhizinisi. U-Sipho waba nezingxoxo ezinhle, futhi eziningi zazo zamsiza ukuba akhulume ngempela ngezifiso zakhe. Ngemva kokuhlolwa, waqonda ukuthi akancikile kuphela emsebenzini, kodwa imvelo yakhe, izifiso, kanye namakhono akhe okukhuluma. Lokhu kwaba uhambo lokuzithuthukisa. Isahluko 5: Izifundo Zokuphumelela Ekugcineni, emva kwezinsuku eziningi zokuhlolwa, uSipho wathola umphumela ophumelelayo. Wamukelwa emsebenzini ohambisana nezifiso zakhe, futhi waqala ukufunda izifundo ezibalulekile. Waqonda ukuthi ukufuna umsebenzi akuyona nje indlela yokuthola ithuba, kodwa kuyindlela yokufunda nokukhula. U-Sipho waba nomdlandla wokuba neqhaza elikhulu emsebenzini wakhe. Waqonda ukuthi ukufuna umsebenzi bekungaphezu kwenhloso, bekuyindlela yokwakha impumelelo. Ngaleso sikhathi, wakhumbula izeluleko zabangane bakhe, waba nesibindi sokwenza izinqumo ezinzima, futhi wathola injabulo enkulu emsebenzini wakhe omusha. Isahluko 6: Ukushiyeka Kwamathuba U-Sipho, sekuphele iminyaka ethile emsebenzini, waqala ukubona ukuthi ukuthola umsebenzi akupheli lapho uthola ithuba. Kukhona imisebenzi eminingi emisha, izifundo ezintsha, nezifiso ezintsha ezidinga ukulandela. Waqonda ukuthi ukuqhubeka nokukhula, ukufunda, nokwenza izinqumo ezinhle, kwakuwumgomo wakhe. Ngenxa yalokho, uSipho wahamba phambili, eqhubeka nokuzithuthukisa, futhi waba umholi emkhakheni wakhe. Waqinisekisa ukuthi amaphupho akhe awagcini ngokuthola umsebenzi, kodwa aqhubeka nokwenza izinguquko empilweni yakhe. Ngalesi sikhathi, waqonda ukuthi ukufuna umsebenzi kwakuwuhambo olungapheli, futhi wonke amahlandla, kuhlanganise nezinselelo, kwakuyisifundo esinothisa impilo yakhe. Ngale ndlela, uSipho waba isibonelo sabanye, futhi wathola indlela yokukhuthaza abanye abakhona emhlabeni wokufuna umsebenzi, ukuthi bonke bazi, uhambo lokuthola umsebenzi luhlala lukhona, futhi luhlala luhlobene nokufunda, ukuziqhenya, nokuzimisela.
MANJE, ngokulandela isigaba 14 seMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000, uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi, njengomsebenzi wombuso weBhodi Yamanzi, kumele abhale incwadi ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oluhambisana neBhodi Yamanzi. NGAKWAZI, MANJE uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi uletha lokhu, emphakathini, incwadi yeBhodi Yamanzi ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yiBhodi Yamanzi, njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi komthetho. Ukulalelwa kwezicelo zokukhokhelwa njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Isicelo sokukhokhelwa kumele sithunyelwe kwiBhodi Yamanzi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela esinqumweni esithathwe yiziphathimandla ezibhekelelayo. IBhodi Yamanzi inegunya lokunquma inani lokukhokhelwa kanye nenani elizokhokhwa kulandela lesi sigaba. Azikho izinsiza ezikhona. Izinsiza zizolandela umsebenzi. Uma ummangali enganelisekile nganoma yisiphi isinqumo mayelana nolwazi, ummangali angafaka isikhalazo kuNgqongqoshe Wamanzi Nezihlahla kulandela isigaba 74 seMthetho. Uma ummangali (ummangali) enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wamanzi Nezihlahla, angaphikisa leso sinqumo enkantolo kulandela izigaba 79 kuya ku-82 zeMthetho. Ummangali noma noma ubani omunye angafaka icala emaphoyiseni kulandela isigaba 90 seMthetho.
Ukuthola imali - yini edingekayo futhi yini abayidingayo? Sonke sidinga ukweleta imali nganoma yisiphi isikhathi - ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezolimo wamanje. Empeleni, awukwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokusebenzisa imali eyalwe. Inkinga, nokho, ukuthi uma ulethela imali, ibhizinisi lakho lingase lingakwazi ukuyikhokha. Khumbula, inani lemali eliwelile kanye nesikhathi esithathwa ukukhokha le mali, intshiseko (izindleko) zalesi sikhwama ziya zanda ngaso sonke isikhathi. Intshiseko - Lezi yizindleko zokweleta le mali. Ngokuvamile, iyiphesenti ngonyaka lenani eliwelile. Izinga lentshiseko lishintsha njalo ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko noma izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni ezishintshayo. I-capital yokusebenza - Le yimali oyelile mayelana nohlelo lwakho lwezohwebo. Uma ulethela R100,000, imali yokubolekwa kweminyaka emihlanu izokwenza kube R130,000 kanti imali yokubolekwa kweminyaka eyishumi izokwenza kube R155,000. Kubonakala ukuthi le minyaka emihlanu ikhulisa izindleko ngama-R24,000 ukuze ulethele R100,000. Izinqubomgomo zebhizinisi zigxile kakhulu ekutholeni imali ukuze kuthuthukiswe ibhizinisi. Izinqubomgomo zakho kufanele zifake okulandelayo: imigomo yakho, izinto ezibalulekile, ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho lisebenza kanjani njengamanje nokuthi lizothola kanjani inzuzo esikhathini esizayo uma uthola imali ofuna ukuyelisa. Kufanele ukhombise kahle ukuthi uzophatha kanjani le bhizinisi elisha nokuthi unamandla okuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphuma kwemali kukhombisa ukuhamba kwemali ebhizinisini lakho. Lokhu kuzokhombisa umbolekisi ukuthi mangaki amaholo angena ngenyanga bese ubona ukuthi uzokwazi yini ukukhokha le mali ezinyangeni ezithile. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nezimali zakho - noma iyiphi imali noma ukuthi ivela kuphi. Kuyiphutha uma ungahlinzeki ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nezindaba zakho zezimali uma ufaka isicelo semali. Ngokwalesi simiso, amabhange awavunyelwe ukuhlinzeka abantu ngemali uma kungenzeka ukuthi bazophumelela ukukhokha le mali. Lokhu kuvikela ibhange futhi kuvikela umbolekisi. Uma ungakwazi ukukhokha imali oyelile, ungabhaliswa njengomuntu ongakwazi ukweleta imali noma kuphi. Akekho ofuna igama lakhe kulolu hlu ngoba abazi ukuthi bangase badinge imali kusasa futhi ngeke bakwazi ukuyelisa. Lo mthetho usize amabhange ngesikhathi bekukhona ingozi enkulu ezindabeni zezimali ngo-2009 emhlabeni jikelele. Amabhange amaningi emhlabeni jikelele aphuka ngoba abolekisi abaningi bahluleka ukukhokha le mali. Umthetho wezeMali kazwelonke ukhona ukuvikela abantu namabhange ekukhokheni imali abengenayo. Usiza amabhange ngoba ngeke babe nemali eningi yokubolekwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abakhiqizi nezolimo baqashe uchwepheshe onolwazi ngezindaba zezimali emkhakheni wezolimo. Abalimi abakwazi ukwazi zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokuphatha izindaba zezimali ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi bonke abalimi, njengabaphathi bamabhizinisi abasebenza ngemali eyalwe, bakhombise ukuthi bayathembeka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uma kukhona inkinga yokukhokha imali, kufanele ixoxwe kusenesikhathi ukuze bakwazi ukuvumelana ekugcineni. Zonke izinto ozithengayo ngemali oyelile zisho ukuthi unethemba lokuthi uzothola le mali emuva kusasa - ufuna ukuthi isebenze ngawe. Umfuyi kufanele azibuze ukuthi uqinisekile yini ukuthi uzothola le mali emuva. Ikakhulukazi njengamanje uma ubheka kahle emakethe, uma becabanga ngokutshala imali emkhenketheni, ngezintengo eziphansi nezindleko ezikhuphukayo, bazothola yini imali abayelile futhi kuzoba yini inzuzo? Sonke sibona ukuthi njengamanje, kukhona umkhenkethi omningi - kuzosisiza yini ukutshala imali emkhenketheni bese intengo yehlisa futhi uma kukhona umkhiqizo omuhle ngo-2010 - 2011? Ngokucabangela kahle, kungase kube ngcono ukungaboleki imali ukuze utshale emkhenketheni. Izindaba zezimali zihlupha futhi zihlale ziba yinkinga uma uphatha ibhizinisi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezolimo ngoba kunezingozi eziningi ezingavela. Umfuyi othile uzokhetha ukuba ngaphandle elungisa izinkuni, engahlali etafuleni elwa nephepha. Kodwa uma singanaki lezi zindaba zezimali, ngeke kube nezinkuni noma umhlaba ekugcineni! Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthola abantu abanolwazi abangakusiza.
Izokuxhumana Nomphakathi: Ukusungula Ubuhlobo Kanye Nokwakha Ukwethembeka Ezokuxhumana nomphakathi (public relations) zidlala indima ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Njengoba izinkampani, uhulumeni, nezinhlangano zikhula ngokushesha, kumele zazi ukuthi ukuxhumana kahle nabantu kubaluleke kakhulu. Lokhu akusho kuphela ukuxhumana ngezinto ezithile, kodwa kusho ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile nokuhlonipha izifiso nemibono yabantu. Ngokuya kwesimo samanje, sengibona ukuthi kudingeka ukuba sithathe lesi sikhala sithandazele ngokwakhiwa kobuhlobo obenziwe ngothando, ukuqonda, nokwethembeka. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi akuyona nje indawo yokukhangisa, kodwa kuyisisekelo sokwakha isithombe esihle senhlangano. Kulokhu, izinkampani kufanele zibe necebo eliqinile lokuxhumana elithokozisayo, eliyingxenye ethokozisayo yamasiko nezidingo zomphakathi. Kunezinto eziningi ezisemqoka okufanele zicatshangelwe, futhi kufanele sihlole indlela lezi zinto ezithinta ngayo ubudlelwano bezimpahla ezikhiqizwayo nezikhungo zomphakathi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthanda nokungathandi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izidingo zabo, ukuzwa imibono yabo, nokubahlola ukuze baqonde izinkampani. Ukucubungula indaba yomphakathi, izinkampani zidinga ukukwazi ukwakha umkhiqizo noma insiza ehlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Izenzo zami zenkampani kufanele zibe nemiphumela engathuthuka, okwenza umphakathi uqaphele nokuthi kumele uxhumane nezinhlaka ezithinta izimpilo zabo. Okwesibili, ukuziqhenya ngempumelelo zabo kufanele kube yisisekelo esinamasiko ahlukahlukene. Imiphakathi esetshenziswa kwizinkampani ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho inkinga zokukhangisa zikhona. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nezinhlelo ezakhiwe ngempela, ezikhuthaza imiphakathi ukukhiqiza izinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. Isibonelo, izinkampani zingaxhumana nezinkampani ezivela endaweni ukuze zakhe amakhono nezinhlangano ezithinta umphakathi ukuze ziqhube izinhlelo zokwakha imiphakathi emihle. Okwesithathu, ukuthuthukiswa kobudlelwano bezindaba kufanele kube yiqiniso. Akukhona nje ukuba ne-press release noma izincwadi ezibhalwe kahle; kumele kube noxhumano oluqinile nolwazi oluqondile. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani zikhulume ngezenzakalo zazo kodwa futhi zibe nezinto ezizocacisa ukuthi zikhona ukuze zisebenzise. Njengoba kuxhumana nababambiqhaza, kubalulekile ukuba baqhubele phambili umoya wokuxhumana, benza umphakathi wazi kahle ngalezi zindlela ezithinta izinkampani zomphakathi. Okwesine, ukuziphatha kahle kumqoka. Ukuthi uhlelo lokuxhumana luthuthukiswe nje kuphela ukuze lubonise izifiso zokukhumbula, kodwa futhi kube neqhaza elithile lokusebenza. Ukuze ukwazi ukuba yinkampani ethandwayo, kudinga ukuziphatha okulungile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkampani kufanele ziphendule imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, zithathe izinyathelo ezithile zokuqonda izinkinga zomphakathi futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona ezindabeni. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bumqoka kangakanani, uma ungathobeli izinqumo zomphakathi, izinkampani zizoswakswe indawo zabo ngemiphumela engathuthuki. Ekugcineni, ezokuxhumana nomphakathi kufanele ziqhubeke zishintsha njengoba umphakathi ushintsha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele sibe nethuba lokuhlola izindlela zokuxhumana ezintsha, sidlulele phambili kumanani nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Kulokhu, kumele sikhumbule ukwakha izinqubo ezihambisana namagama esithombe sethu. Izinkampani kufanele ziqonde ukuthi izinkampani ezizithola zihamba phambili emishinini yokuxhumana kumele ziqhubeke sawula izinkanyezwayo ezivela ezingqungqutheleni zomphakathi, zinikeze abantu indawo yokulalela abahlanganyela khona. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zinto zonke, izinkampani zingakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nomphakathi. Lokhu kuzozuzisa bobabili - izinkampani kanye nomphakathi. Zizoba nezindlela zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene nezindlela ezithokozisayo. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi akuyona nje imikhuba yokukhangisa, kodwa kuwumsebenzi woke, owamukeleka, nokufundisa. Ngakho, mela izinkampani, ukuqinisa ubuhlobo nemiphakathi, zazi izinkinga ezithinta izimpilo zethu, bese zikhuluma ngempela. Kulokhu, sizobona imiphumela emihle, futhi umphakathi uzoba nempilo engcono.
Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Ukukhula Kwesidingo Nezinguquko Eziyinhloko Ngaphakathi kweminyaka ethile edlule, izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ziye zathuthuka kakhulu, ziba yisisekelo sokuxhasa abesifazane nabazali abasha. Njengoba umphakathi usukhula futhi uhamba phambili, izidingo zokubeletha ziya zikhula, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela zibe nezinsizakalo eziphelele nezisezingeni eliphezulu. Ekuqaleni, abesifazane abaningi babesebenzisa izikhungo ezincane zokubeletha, kodwa namuhla, izibhedlela ezinkulu zikhombisa ukuba nethuba lokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezisekela abesifazane abakhulelwe, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile, kanye nezinsiza ezithuthukile ukuze kuphumelele uma kwenzeka kube nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Okwamanje, izibhedlela zinezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokubeletha ezihlanganisa amaqembu ahlukene, okuhlanganisa odokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nochwepheshe bokwelapha. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kakhulu, njengoba bonke abathintekayo besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze bafeze imisebenzi yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abesifazane banikezwa ithuba lokuthola ukwesekwa kwezemizwa, okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa okuhlobene nezinkinga zokukhathazeka ngemuva kokubeletha, okubizwa ngokuthi i-Postpartum Depression. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zikhuluma ngempumelelo yokuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile nezinsiza ezithuthukile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abesifazane banokuphila okumnandi ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukuze lokhu kwenziwe, izibhedlela zisebenzisa izinhlelo ezibizwa ngokuthi “Maternal Health Programs” ezihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhiqizi bazo bazi kahle izidingo zabesifazane. Ubulili, ubudala, kanye nezimo zempilo zenzeka zibe neqhaza elikhulu ekutheni abesifazane bakhethe izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezithile. Kwezinye izindawo, izibhedlela ziyaqhubeka nokuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izidingo zempilo zikhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana namakhaya omphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olukhanyayo nolwakhiwe, ukuze abesifazane bazi kahle okukhona emakethe. Kunokudlulisela ezinsizakalweni ezithile, izibhedlela zishaya umoya ekwenzeni kube lula ukwenza izinqumo ezihambelana nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kunciphisa ukwesaba nokungaqondi kahle okuhambisana nezinsizakalo zokubeletha. Ukuze izinsizakalo eziqondile zibe khona, kubalulekile ukuthi abesifazane bazi ngalezi zinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuzenza izinqumo eziphusile ezifanele izidingo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abesifazane bahlala bejabulile ngokuba nezeluleko ezihlukahlukene ezitholakalayo, okuhlanganisa nokwakhiwa kwemindeni. Izibhedlela zikhombisa ukuthi ziyaziqhenya ngeqhaza labo ekuthuthukiseni lokho, futhi lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubamba imicimbi yehlangano engama-seminar, izinkulumo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha ezihambisana nezinsizakalo zokubeletha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi komphakathi nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukunxenxa abesifazane ukuthi babonise izidingo zabo, ukuze abantu abenziweyo bazi kahle lokho okudingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukubambisana kuvumela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezihlukene, ezihambelana nezimo zomphakathi, okuholela ekutheni kube nezinyathelo ezinomthelela omuhle empilweni yabesifazane. Kodwa-ke, nakuba kunezinyathelo ezithathwayo, kusekhona izinselelo ezithile ezithinta izinsizakalo zokubeletha. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezithile, izinhlelo zokufundisa abahlinzeki, kanye nezindlela ezinzima zokubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi izibhedlela ziqhubeke nokuhlola izinkinga ezikhona, ukuze zikwazi ukuzenza izinguquko ezidingekayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zihlala ziphumelela, izibhedlela kufanele ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zabo, zihlale zenze izinqumo ezikhiqizayo, zisebenze ngokubambisana nezimboni ezihlukene, kanye nokuhlanganisa izinsizakalo ezihambelana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, izinsizakalo zokubeletha eZibhedlela ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile, kanye nokwazisa abesifazane ngamalungelo abo, kuzoqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile labazali, abesifazane, kanye nomphakathi jikelele.
Ishadi lokufa liyidokhumenti esemthethweni elikhishwe kumndeni woshonile uma kubhaliswa ukufa komuntu. Uma umphakathi ongaphandle efela eNingizimu Afrika, irekhodi liphothulwa futhi ishadi lokufa likhishwa kumndeni. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi le-embassy noma umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sithunyelwa phesheya. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezasekhaya. Qedela ifomu le-BI-132. Bhala incwadi enemininingwane yomuntu oshonile bese uyithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya eliseduze uma kungekho ihhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya endaweni yakho. Akukho ukufakwa komhlaba okuzokwenzeka ngaphandle kwe-oda yokufaka umhlaba. I-oda yokufaka umhlaba iyisitifiketi esivumela ukufakwa komhlaba nokuhanjiswa komzimba ukusuka endaweni yokufa ukuya endaweni yokufaka umhlaba. Kuphela abaphathi abhalisiwe abanegunya lokukhupha i-oda yokufaka umhlaba. Isitifiketi sokufingqa: Sikhishwa uma kubhaliswa ukufa. Isitifiketi esigcwele: Izicelo zingathatha phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kwezishiyagalolunye ukuze processing.
Imishini: uyazithenga, uyazirenta, noma uthola omunye umuntu ozosebenza ngawe? Umfuyi wamanje uhlale efuna inzuzo futhi unciphise izindleko mayelana nezindlela zokusebenzisa ama-tractors, ama-harvesters, neminye imishini. Lokhu kubalulekile uma ufuna ukuhweba. Imishini emisha ingabukwa njalo ngesikhathi se-NAMPO Harvest Day minyaka yonke, futhi kubonakala ukuthi yonke imishini isenamandla aphezulu (horsepower noma kilowatt). Lokhu kuhambisana nosayizi namandla emishini ekhula njalo - ama-tractors, imishini eyenza i-mulch, ama-ploughs, neminye imishini ethuthukisa izindawo ezinkulu kakhulu. Izindleko zokuthenga nokugcina imishini ziyaqhubeka nokukhula ngokushesha unyaka nonyaka. Futhi, qaphela ukuthi awukwazi ukuhweba ngezikhathi ezingafanele ngoba lokhu kuzokwehlisa umkhiqizo. Lapho ubeka izicwangciso zakho zokuthola umkhiqizo othile ekulimaleni kwakho ukuze uthole inzuzo, kubalulekile ukuhlela amandla emishini onayo. Ngemuva kokuhlola ukuthi imishini enjani ethile iyatholakala, umfuyi uzokwazi ukuthi i-tractor idinga amandla angakanani. Usayizi we-tractor namandla ayo okudonsa kufanele kuhambisane nosayizi wemishini edonswayo. Uma uqonda ukuthi le mizwa ibukeka kanjani, uzokwazi ukubona ukuthi isikhathi, amandla okuhweba, ukulima, ukutshala, nokunye kuyalinganiswa. Manje umfuyi kufanele acabange ukuthi unayo imishini eyanele yokwenza umsebenzi odingekayo. Mhlawumbe ungacabanga ukuthenga imishini eyengeziwe noma uqashe omunye umuntu ukuze enze umsebenzi othile. Isibonelo: ungakwazi ukuqasha umphakeli ukuze enze imisebenzi emikhulu efana nokulima, ukuvuna, nokunye. Ngemuva kwalokhu, umfuyi angaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi osele nemishini anayo (sicela ubheke ibhrosha elibizwa nge-"Contractors Course" uma ufuna olunye ulwazi). Umfuyi kufanele aqonde ukuthi uzokwazi ukusebenzisa imishini yakhe ukuqeda umsebenzi wakhe ngesikhathi esithile, noma kungase kube ngcono ukuqasha imishini eyengeziwe noma ukuthola umphakeli ozosebenza ngawe. Kubalulekile futhi kumfuyi ukuthi aqonde kahle ukuthi izindleko eziphelele ezihilelekile ekuthengeni le mishini zikhona, inani lokwehla kwesikhathi, inani lezintela, izindleko zokusebenza, zokugcina, umshwalense, nokunye. Kufanele acabangele lezi zinto zonke. Izindleko ezitholakala uma umfuyi ezama ukukhokha imali ebolekiwe ukuze athenge imishini zingaholela ezinsongweni ekulimaleni kwabo. Nokho, uma ungenayo imishini efanele, ngeke ukwazi ukuhweba, ukutshala, nokuvuna ngezikhathi ezidingekayo.
Sebenzisa ipeni emnyama noma eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lezi zinsiza futhi ugcine ukubhala kwakho ngaphakathi kwezikhala ezitholakalayo. Sicela usebenzise izinhlamvu ezinkulu lapho ugcwalisa le phepha. UNGASHIYI izikhala ezingenalutho ongazidingi. Sicela ungasebenzisi umuthi wokulungisa uma wenza iphutha. Siphinde sicela ungawufoldi ifomu lakho njengoba lokhu kuzobambezela ukucutshungulwa kwalo. KUFANELE ugcwalise zonke izingxenye ezihambisanayo zefomu. Noma iyiphi ifomu engagcwaliswanga ngokuphelele izobuyiselwa kuwe ibhalwe "ayithunyelwanga" kuze kube ubuyisela ngokuphelele igcwaliswe. Lokhu kungaholela ezijezweni zokuthunyelwa kwangemuva kwefomu lakho. Ukusayina: Ifomu lezi zinsiza liyisitatimende esibophelelayo ngokomthetho esidinga ukuthi uvumele yonke imali, intela, nezikhala zonyaka. Imali etholelwe uma ungazange uzuze imali ngonyaka kufanele iboniswe ngokufaka zero (0). Ukuze kube lula kuwe, kulonyaka i-SARS ilethe ifomu elisha lezi zinsiza zabantu ababili. I-IT12S iyifomu lezi zinsiza zomuntu. Liyakhiwa ukuze igcwaliswe ngabasebenzi abathola umholo futhi bathola izikhala zokuhamba nezikhala zezindleko zezokwelapha kanye nezinkokhelo zokuthatha umhlalaphansi. Banikeza ulwazi lokubala izindleko zokuhamba. Uma ukhetha ukubala usebenzisa izindleko zangempela, kuzodingeka ukuthi unikeze ulwazi oluhambisanayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izindleko ezimisiwe zizosebenza. I-ITC12C iyifomu elinzima labantu abanemali efana nemali yokurenta, imali yangaphandle, imali yebhizinisi, imali yokulima, kanye nezindleko/ukulahleka kwebhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwe-IT12S njengoba kuxoxiwe ngenhla, ifomu linikeza abatshali bemali ithuba lokukhombisa noma iyiphi enye imali engafakwanga kwi-IT12S. Qinisekisa ukunemba kolwazi oluphrintiwe, futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho ezitholakalayo kulolu lwazi oluphrintiwe ukuze ufake imininingwane enembile.
