Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyi-15, waphuma endlini yakhe eThekwini, efuna ukuhlangana nozakwabo uThabo. UThabo wayenolwazi olunzulu emidlalweni yevidiyo, futhi uSipho wayefisa ukufunda okuningi ngalolu lwazi. UThabo wayenendawo yokudlala emnandi, igcwele imishini yokudlala nemishini ehlukahlukene. Lapho befika, uThabo wamukela uSipho ngenjabulo, wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi uthanda imidlalo yevidiyo, ngakho ngizokukhombisa okuthile okukhulu.” USipho waphendula, “Ngiyabonga, Thabo! Ngifuna ukufunda konke ukuze ngibe umdlali ophumelelayo.” Baqala ukudlala umdlalo obizwa ngokuthi “I-Quest of Legends,” owawuhlanganisa izigigaba, izitha ezinzima, nezimfihlo ezithokozisayo. UThabo wakhombisa uSipho amakhono ahlukahlukene omdlalo, waphinde wamchazela ukuthi umphakathi wabadlali ungaba nomthelela omkhulu empumelelweni. Umdlalo uqale, uSipho wathola ukuthi udinga ukucabanga, ahlaziye izimo, futhi enze izinqumo ezisheshayo. UThabo wamsiza wathi: “Khumbula, Sipho, akukhona kuphela ukudlala; ukufunda nokukhula kubalulekile. Umdlalo ungakufundisa ngezindlela eziningi.” Ngemuva kokudlala isikhathi eside, uSipho waqala ukujabulisa. Waqonda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ayiyona indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa iyindlela yokuxhumana nabanye, yokwakha ubungane, nokufunda amakhono amasha. UThabo wakhumbuza uSipho ukuthi imidlalo ingaba yinsiza yokukhulisa ubuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi uma umdlali efuna ukwenza kahle. Njengoba beqhubeka, uSipho waqala ukucabanga ngempilo yakhe, wahlele ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ibaluleke kangakanani empilweni yakhe. Waqonda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo imvumela ukuba aphume esikhathini esinzima, akhululeke, futhi adlale ngendlela enobungane. UThabo wathi: “Umdlalo ungakunika ithuba lokuphila izimpilo ezahlukene, ungaba yisiboshwa, umphakathi, noma ungumuntu wezinkanyezi.” Ngemuva kokudlala, uSipho waphawula ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokufunda. Waqonda ukuthi imidlalo ethile ifundisa amakhono afana nokuhlela, ukuphatha isikhathi, nokuxhumana nabanye. UThabo waphinda wathi: “Uma udlala, ungafunda ukubamba izinqumo ezinzima, futhi ungabhekana nezimo ezinzima.” Umdlalo waphothulwa, futhi uSipho waba nomuzwa wokuphumelela. Wazizwa ejabule, futhi uThabo wamsiza ukuba aqonde ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo ingaba yinsiza enkulu empilweni yakhe. UThabo wathi: “Khumbula, Sipho, imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa kufanele uyisebenzise ngokucophelela. Ungavumeli ukuba ibangele izinkinga empilweni yakho.” U-Sipho waphendula: “Ngiyavuma, Thabo. Ngizokwenza kahle, futhi ngizokusebenzisa imidlalo yevidiyo ukuze ngithuthukise amakhono ami.” UThabo wamamatheka, wathi: “Ngiyazi ukuthi uzokwenza kahle, Sipho. Umdlalo ungakunika ithuba lokukhula, kodwa kufanele uqaphele.” Ngemuva kokuhamba noThabo, uSipho wathola ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuxhumana nabantu, yokwakha ubungane, nokufunda. Waqonda ukuthi akufanele ayivumele imidlalo yevidiyo ibangele izinkinga empilweni yakhe, kodwa kufanele ayisebenzise ukuze akhule. U-Sipho waphuma endlini kaThabo, enomuzwa wokuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyinsiza enkulu empilweni yakhe. Wazizwa ejabule, futhi wathola ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuzijabulisa, yokufunda, nokwakha ubungane. Waqonda ukuthi kufanele ayisebenzise kahle, ukuze akhule futhi aphumelele empilweni. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba nesifiso sokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngemidlalo yevidiyo, efuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono akhe, futhi waqonda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyindlela yokuphila, yokukhula, nokwakha ubungane. U-Sipho wathola ithemba lokuthi uzoba umdlali ophumelelayo, futhi wafunda ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo iyinsiza enkulu empilweni yakhe.
Ukuphathwa KweMfucuza Emadolobheni Isingeniso Ukuphathwa kwemfucuza emadolobheni kuyisici esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Njengoba izixeko zikhula, inani lemfucuza elikhiqizwayo lenyuka, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuphatha le mfucuza. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlanganiswa kwezindlela ezahlukene zokukhipha, ukuhlela, nokuphinda kusetshenziswe imfucuza, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthelela wayo emvelweni uncishiswa. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphatha Imfucuza Ukuze ukuphathwe kahle imfucuza emadolobheni, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela imfucuza, ukususa, nokuphinda kusetshenziswe. Izinhlelo zokuhlela imfucuza zidinga ukuba zibe nezinhlaka ezithile ezihlanganisa izikhungo zokuhlunga, izikhungo zokuphinda zisetshenziswe, kanye nezindawo zokugcina imfucuza. Ukuphathwa kwemfucuza kufanele kube yinkqubo ehlanganisa imiphakathi, izinkampani, nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izigaba zisebenza ndawonye. Izindlela Zokuphatha Imfucuza Izindlela zokuphatha imfucuza zihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukususa, nokuphinda kusetshenziswe. Ukuhlela imfucuza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfucuza ihlukaniswa ngokwezinhlobo zayo, njengezinto eziphilayo, ezingenampilo, nezinto eziphindwayo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuthi imfucuza ethile ingathathwa ngendlela efanele. Ukususwa kwemfucuza kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfucuza engafaneleki ayigcini emadolobheni. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezisebenzayo zokuhamba kwemfucuza, okuhlanganisa izimoto ezikhethekile zokuthutha imfucuza, kanye nezinsiza zokugcina imfucuza. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo. Ukuphinda kusetshenziswe imfucuza kuyindlela ebalulekile yokunciphisa umthelela wemfucuza emvelweni. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yokuphinda kusetshenziswe, njengokwakha izikhungo zokuhlunga ezithuthukisiwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi mayelana nokubaluleka kokuphinda kusetshenziswe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuthi baphinde basebenzise imfucuza, okunciphisa inani lemfucuza elingena ezindaweni zokugcina. Izinkinga Ezinzima Ekuphathweni KweMfucuza Naphezu kwezinhlelo ezikhona, ukuphathwa kwemfucuza emadolobheni kuhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yindlela yokuhlela imfucuza. Abantu abaningi basathanda ukuhlanganisa imfucuza yabo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlela kahle. Lokhu kudinga imizamo eyengeziwe yokufundisa umphakathi mayelana nezindlela zokuhlela imfucuza. Enye inkinga enkulu yindleko zokuphatha imfucuza. Izinhlelo zokuphatha imfucuza zidinga izinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa abasebenzi, izimoto, nezikhungo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa kwezimali okuqhubekayo, okungaba nzima kakhulu emadolobheni anemithombo yemali elinganiselwe. Ukuze kube nezinqubo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezivela kuhulumeni, ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi. Izixazululo Zokuphathwa KweMfucuza Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle kwemfucuza, izixazululo ezithile zingasetshenziswa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukwakha imikhankaso yokufundisa umphakathi mayelana nokubaluleka kokuhlela imfucuza. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikoleni, izikhangiso zomphakathi, kanye nemihlangano yokuxhumana. Ukuze abantu baqonde kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi imikhankaso ibe nezinhlaka ezihlukene, ukuze ifinyelele kubantu abaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngama-akhawunti okuphinda kusetshenziswe imfucuza kubalulekile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izikhungo zokuhlunga ezithuthukisiwe, ezitholakala kalula kubantu. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo. Okwesithathu, ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ezinhlelweni zokuphatha imfucuza kubalulekile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhaswa kwezimali okuvela kuhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukuze kube nezinqubo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezivela kuhulumeni, ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi. Isiphetho Ukuphathwa kwemfucuza emadolobheni kuyinselele enkulu, kodwa futhi kuyithuba lokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngokuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha imfucuza, kanye nokwakha imikhankaso yokufundisa umphakathi, singakwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wemfucuza emvelweni. Kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi imfucuza iphathwa kahle, ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu, kanye nezemvelo esiphila kuyo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe.
Izinsiza Zokwesekwa Kwabantu Abakhubazekile: Ukubaluleka Nobunzima Obubhekene Nabo Ezweni lethu, abantu abakhubazekile babhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukuphila, imfundo, nezinsizakalo. Ukuthi bangakwazi ukujabulisa impilo yabo ngendlela efanele, kudinga ukwesekwa okuhle nokufinyeleleka. Izinsizakalo zabantu abakhubazekile zibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi olungile, ophumelelayo, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokwezinhlolovo zakrecent, kutholakele ukuthi umuntu omunye kwabahlala eNingizimu Afrika uyakhubazeka. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinsiza ezikhona kufanele ziqinise ukwesekwa kwabantu abakhubazekile. Lezi zinsiza zifaka phakathi imfundo, amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza zempilo. Nokho, abavoti bangakhethi kahle izinsizakalo ezidingekayo, ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi nokuqonda. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bangabantu abanelungelo lokufinyelela ezinsizeni ezahlukahlukene. Ngakho-ke, uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi kumele bakhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezikhona. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqapha izinhlelo ezikhona, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zifinyeleleka kubantu bonke, ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. Izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinye izinsiza ezikhethekile zidinga ukusekelwa ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ehloniphekile. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephikisana nezithiyo eziningi. Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo lusebenza kahle uma kuhlonishwa imibono yabantu abakhubazekile ngokwabo. Ukuze lokhu kuzuze abantu abakhubazekile, kubalulekile ukufaka phakathi imiphakathi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene kuyasiza ekwakheni izinsiza ezihambisanayo nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela imicimbi, imihlangano, kanye nemihlangano yokwazisa, ukuze abantu bazi izinsiza ezitholakalayo. Umphakathi udinga ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba okusebenza, ukuze abantu abakhubazekile bakwazi ukuzenzela. Izinkampani kumele ziqaphele ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bangaba nethalente elikhulu. Ukusiza abantu abakhubazekile ukuba bathole imisebenzi, kudala amathuba okuphila kahle, okwandisa umnotho wabo kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsiza zokwelapha kumele zibe khona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bathola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Lokhu kuhilela izikhungo zezempilo ezitholakalayo, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo edingekayo, kanye nokwelashwa okwenziwa ngodokotela abanolwazi. Ukuze kube nempilo enhle, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bazizwe bekhululekile futhi bezwakala. Izinsizakalo zezemfundo nazo zibalulekile. Abantu abakhubazekile kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela ezikoleni ezihlinzeka ngemfundo efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izikole zibe nezinsiza ezidingekayo, njengezinto zokufundisa ezivumelana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, abafundi abakhubazekile kumele bazi ukuthi bahlonishwa futhi banezinga elifanayo lokufunda. Noma kunjalo, abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bephikisana nezithiyo eziningi, ezivela emiphakathini yabo. Ukubandlululwa, ukungabi nalwazi, nokungafinyeleli ezinsizakalweni zikhona. Umphakathi kumele uqonde ukuthi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni akukhona okwenziwa kuphela nguhulumeni, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lukhona ukuze lweluleke abantu abakhubazekile. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisa imfuno yezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukugcina abantu benolwazi olufanele kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobungane. Njengoba sihamba phambili, sinesibopho sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ogcwele izinsizakalo ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu abakhubazekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela, ukubambisana, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zabantu abakhubazekile kufanele kube umgomo wethu, ukuze sibe nomphakathi ohlonipha, onobungane, futhi ophumelelayo kubo bonke. Ngokuhlanganyela, singenza umehluko empilweni yabantu abakhubazekile, sibavumele ukuba baphile impilo egculisayo, futhi baphumelele ezimpilweni zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, ukukhuthaza, kanye nokwakha izinsiza eziphathelene nezidingo zabo. Umphakathi wonke unendima yokudlulisela phambili lezi zinsiza, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abakhubazekile bahlala bejabulile futhi bephila impilo enempilo.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Isingeniso Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act, owamukelwa ukuze uthuthukise izinqubo zokhetho nezokubhaliswa kwabavoti, ulethe izinguquko eziningi ezibalulekile kumthetho wokhetho. Nokho, lezi zinguquko ziye zahlala nezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Le dokhumenti igxile ekuchazeni izinselelo ezithinta lo mthetho, izizathu ezisemqoka eziholela kulezi zinselelo, kanye nezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuxazululwe lezi zinkinga. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko 1. Ukungaqondi kahle izinguquko Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ukuwaqonda kahle amazwi nemigomo ethile. Abanye abantu, ikakhulukazi abavoti nabamele, bahlala benokungaqondi kahle ukuthi izinguquko zisho ukuthini empeleni. Lokhu kuhlangene nokungabi nolwazi olwakhiwe kahle, okuholela ekutheni kube nokuphazamiseka ezinqubweni zokhetho. Kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa imikhankaso yokwazisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyawuqonda umthetho. 2. Izinsiza zokubhaliswa Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act uphinde wacacisa izinqubo zokubhaliswa kwabavoti, kodwa izinsiza ezitholakalayo zihlala ziphansi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nesibalo esiphansi sabavoti ababhala ngaphambi kokhetho. Ukuze kube nokubhaliswa okuphelele, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele, ezifaka phakathi izikhungo zokubhaliswa ezitholakalayo, imikhankaso yokukhangisa, kanye nezinsizakusebenza zokuxhumana. 3. Ubuthakathaka bezinqubo zokhetho Izinqubo ezivamile zokhetho, ezifaka phakathi lezi ezithinta ukuhlela, ukusabalalisa, nokuphathwa kwemiphumela, ziye zaba nzima njengoba umthetho uthuthuka. Lokhu kudala ukungahleleki nokungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwama-komidi okhetho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi yokhetho iyahamba kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlela kabusha lezi zinqubo, kufaka phakathi ukuqeqesha abakhethiweyo ukuthi basebenze kahle. 4. Izinkinga zokuphepha Uhlelo lokuvota lungabekwa engcupheni uma kunganakwa izinkinga zokuphepha. Ukushintshwa kwabantu emigqeni yokuvota, ukuqinisekiswa kwabavoti, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha imiphumela, kudinga ukuqashelwa okukhulu. Izinselelo zokuphepha zingaholela ekuhlulekeni kokuvota nokuphetha kwezinkinga zokhetho. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinile kwezokuphepha, kuhlanganise nomthetho ophathelene nezinsizakalo zokuphepha eziphelele. 5. Ukuhluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho Ukuze umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ufezeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo eziphethe izindaba zokhetho. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, kudingeka izinhlelo ezihlelekile zokuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwemikhiqizo yokhetho, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Ukuhluleka kokubambisana kungaholela ekuhlulekeni kokuvota kanye nezinkinga zokuphepha ezinzima. Izinyathelo Zokuxazulula Izinselelo 1. Ukuqinisa imikhankaso yokwazisa Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene zokubambisana, imikhankaso yokwazisa ingabekwa emqoka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana nezakhamuzi ukuze ziphumelele ekubhaliseni. Ukwakha izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukubamba imihlangano emphakathini, kanye nokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulabo abangakabhalisile. 2. Ukwandisa izinsiza Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abavoti banethuba lokubhaliswa, izinsiza zokubhaliswa kufanele zande. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezikhungo zokubhaliswa eziningi, imikhankaso yokukhangisa, kanye nezinsiza ezibambekayo ezinokuthola kalula. Ukubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezokuxhumana, kanye nezinye izinhlangano kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela. 3. Ukwenza kube lula izinqubo zokhetho Ukuze kugwenywe ubuthakathaka bezinqubo zokhetho, kunesidingo sokuhlela kabusha lezi zinqubo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha okuqhubekayo kumalunga ama-komidi okhetho, ukuhlinzeka ngama-manuals nezinsiza zokusebenza, kanye nokufaka ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi yokhetho. 4. Ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima kufanele zisetshenziswe. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufaka izinhlelo zokuhlola izinsiza, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha kumaphoyisa, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho. Ukuhlola njalo izinqubo zokuphepha kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabavoti. 5. Ukuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokhetho ziqhubeka kahle, kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezikhungo zokhetho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ukusungula imihlangano evamile, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokubambisana ezizokwenza kube lula ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezivela. Isiphetho Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ulethe izinguquko ezibalulekile emkhakheni wezokhetho, kodwa uhlanganisa nezinselelo eziningi ezidinga ukunakwa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lo mthetho uyafezeka, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo eziphumelelayo zokuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda, izinsiza, nezinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima, singathuthukisa imiphumela yokhetho futhi siqinisekise ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ufinyelela izinhloso zawo.
Ukudoba ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, lapho abantu behamba khona ukuze bathole izinhlanzi emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuzithengisela, kulawulwa. Ukuze ulethe izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kufanele ufake isicelo sesikhwama esikhishwe yisigaba esibhekelele ezokuhlalisana zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe. Izinhlanzi ezitholiwe kwamanye amazwe ezizothengiswa kufanele zisetshenziswe ngabantu uqobo. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulethe izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngaphandle kwesikhwama. Faka isicelo esisha sesikhwama sokudoba ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika uma esikhona sesiphelelwe yisikhathi. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wesikhwama, isikhwama sakho singase sithathwe noma sikhanselwe. Abantu abavunyelwe ukuza nezilwane eziphilayo. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma wonke amadokhumenti egcwele. Imali yokufaka isicelo sesikhwama sokudoba ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ukuze kudliwe ngabantu uqobo ingu-R120. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kuthathwa umphakathi ophumelelayo wezokuhlalisana zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe ngokuxoxisana nomphakathi wezezimali.
Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kumininingwane, No. 2 ka-2000 ("umthetho") waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa 2001, unika ilungelo lemthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe yinoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi noma eyaziwayo edingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo ngokuhambisana nomthetho, inhlangano ethunyelwa isicelo iphoqeleka ukukhulula lelo ulwazi, ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ngokusobala ukuthi ulwazi lungakhululwa noma lungakhululwa. Umthetho uchaza izimo eziphathelene nezinqubo ezidingekayo ezihlobene nalelo sikhathi. Le ncwadi ihlose ukukhuthaza ukuveza kahle nokuvuleka ngaphakathi kweSikhungo Sokuhweba Nezimboni (DTI) ngokuhlinzeka ngelungelo lolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe futhi kuvikelwe amalungelo abantu noma izinhlangano. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuphathwa kahle kwezikhungo zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi futhi ufundiswe ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe mayelana nomthetho. Ngendlela elungisa lelo lungelo namanye amalungelo, kuhlanganise nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kuMthethosisekelo. Isigaba 14 somthetho sidinga izikhungo zomphakathi ukuthi ziqambe imanuwali ukusiza ekufinyeleleni kulwazi olugcinwe izikhungo zomphakathi futhi zibeke izidingo ezincane okufanele imanuwali ihambisane nazo. I-DTI izibophezele, nokho, ekusebenzeni ngokukhanya, ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi ihlinzeka ngolwazi olukhululekile emphakathini wezohwebo, amakhasimende, kanye nomphakathi ngokusebenzisa imibhalo, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye nesikhungo solwazi. Le manuwali ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka umceli, ngokusebenzisa umthetho, ngemininingwane edingekayo yokuxhumana, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile ku-DTI. Imanuwali iphinde ibophezele ukuhlinzeka umceli ngombono ophelele mayelana nesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye nenhlangano yolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-DTI ukusiza umceli ekutholeni lapho ulwazi lungatholakala khona. Imanuwali iphinde ihlinzeke ngezifomu ezidingekayo nezimali ezifanele zokucela ulwazi. Okungenani u-40% wombuso we-DTI uhlinzekwa ngenethiwekhi yezikhungo ezisemthethweni ezakha ithimba le-DTI. IKhansela Lezikhungo Zokuhweba Nezimboni (COTII) lasungulwa, lifaka phakathi iBhodi Yabaqondisi be-DTI, Abaphathi Abaphakanyisiwe, kanye Nezikhulumi zendawo ngayinye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle kweqembu le-DTI kanye nezinhloso zeSikhungo. Le manuwali ihlinzeka kuphela ngerekhodi ze-DTI, hhayi lezo zeqembu le-DTI (COTII). Noma yiziphi izicelo zolwazi, kunoma yiziphi izikhungo ze-DTI, kumele ziqondiswe ehhovisi lolwazi lelo nhlangano. IKomidi Lokuncintisana kanye neTribunal Yokuncintisana kukhuthaza ukuncintisana, kuhlola futhi kubhekane nezindlela ezingalungile zokuncintisana, futhi kuthuthukisa ukugxila kwezomnotho ezimakethe ezihlobene ngaphansi komthetho wokuncintisana ka-1998. Lasungulwa ngo-1945, manje liphathwa nguMthetho Wenkampani Yezocwaningo Kazwelonke ka-1998, iNational Research Council izibophezele ekuhlinzekeni ngezixazululo zobuchwepheshe nolwazi ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nezomnotho. Inhloso yenhlangano ukuhlela ulwazi olufanele oluzohlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngamakhono obuchwepheshe adingekayo, kanye nokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukufunda kwesayensi nobuchwepheshe namakhono. IKhansela lizibophezele ekuholeni ukuqwashisa ngobuchwepheshe nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabasebenzi nobuchwepheshe. I-Industrial Development Corporation, ephethwe nguhulumeni, ihlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali olukhuthaza ukudalwa kwamabhizinisi ngokusungulwa kwemikhakha nezinkampani ezisebenza ngokuncintisana ngokusekelwe ezimisweni ezinhle zebhizinisi. Isikhungo siphathwa ngezinhlinzeko ze-Industrial Development Corporation Act ka-1940 njengoba kuguqulwe kanye nezinye izingxenye zeMthetho Wenkampani. I-Khula yasungulwa ngo-1996 futhi igxile ekuqinisekiseni ukufinyelela kalula ezikweletini nasekuxhaseni amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo kanye nezinkampani ezincane. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondile ngezivumelwano nezimali zokusebenza kumabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezincane. I-Khula ibhaliswe njengomshuwalense ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushuwalense futhi iphathwa ngezikhombisi zeBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali. Iphiko layo lokuqinisekisa izikweletu lihlolwa minyaka yonke ngokwezimali njengoba kucacisiwe yiBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ukuze kutholakale izinga eliphezulu lezimali ezingabolekwa. I-National Framework for the Integration of Product Advisory Institutions ihlinzeka ngemikhakha yokukhiqiza ngolwazi nezinsizakalo zokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokweseka amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezincane. Ibhodi lasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokugembula Kazwelonke ka-1996 ukuze ilawule ukugembula, ihlinzeka ngeluleko likazwelonke. I-Bill entsha yeLiqour ka-1998 yaphasiswa nguMphakathi Kazwelonke ngo-1998 kodwa yathunyelwa kwiNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo nguMongameli ngenxa yemibuzo ephathelene nokuba semthethweni kwayo. I-Bill ihlose ukuhlela imboni yeLiqour ngokwethula uhlaka lokuthola amalayisense olwakha amalungiselelo amathathu; ukusungula iNational Liquor Advisory Committee, iNational Liquor Regulatory Authority, iNational Liquor Tribunal, izikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokulawula i-liquor, kanye nezikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokubuyisela; nokuhlinzeka ngohlaka lokulawula ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela nokuthola izinzuzo ngenkathi kuhlonishwa izindaba zomphakathi, ezomnotho, nezempilo. I-Foundation yasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wamabhizinisi Amancane Kazwelonke ka-1996 njengenkampani yesigaba 21 ukuze ihlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zokweseka ezingezona zezimali kumabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo kanye nezinkampani ezincane. I-Foundation ihlinzeka ukufinyelela ekuqeqesheni, ulwazi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, ukumaketha, kanye nobuchwepheshe. I-Standards Organization ilawula i-Standards Act, No. 29 ka-1993, ekhuthaza ukujwayeleka nokulawulwa kwekhwalithi embonini nasemakethe futhi ibheka futhi ilandele izilinganiso nezindinganiso zemboni. Iphakela ubuholi emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngokuwuqonda, ulwazi lwawo ngezithuba nezinto ezikhona, nokucabangela ikusasa. Iphromotha uguquko nokuthuthukiswa komnotho futhi ibhekana nezinselelo nezithuba zabantu abathintekayo emnothweni, ukuze kusekelwe izinhloso zohulumeni zokuthuthukisa umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa. Iphatha izinselelo nezithuba emnothweni nasemphakathini. Iphakela indawo elindelekile ethokozisayo, elinganayo, futhi enobulungiswa ukuze kube lula ukutshalwa kwemali, imisebenzi, nokuhweba. Ngokwandisa umnikelo wamabhizinisi am
Amaphoyisa: Umsebenzi Wokugcina Ukuphepha Nobulungiswa Isingeniso Amaphoyisa adlala indima ebalulekile ekuphepheni nasemphakathini. Njengoba izinselelo zokuphepha zikhula, kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle umsebenzi wabo, imithwalo abayithwele, kanye nezinto abahlangabezana nazo nsuku zonke. Lesi sihloko sihlose ukuhlola lezi zici ezihlukahlukene, ukuze umphakathi uqonde kangcono ibhizinisi eliyinhloko labaphoyisa. Umsebenzi Wokugcina Ukuphepha Umsebenzi wokuqala wamaPhoyisa uwukugcina ukuphepha komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhamba ezindaweni ezihlala abantu, ukukhipha izexwayiso, kanye nokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Amaphoyisa banesibopho sokuphendula ezinsongweni ezahlukene, ukusuka ezimweni zokwephulwa komthetho kuya ezinhlekeleleni. Lokhu kudinga ukuba babe neziqu eziphakeme kanye nemisebenzi eqinile yokuqeqesha ukuze bakwazi ukuqondisisa izimo ezinzima. Ukubambisana Nomphakathi Ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo ngendlela ephumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abambisane nomphakathi. Ukukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi kubalulekile ekwakheni ukwethenjwa. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokubambisana, lapho abantu bezwa bekhululekile ukuveza izinkinga zabo, bekhuthaza amaphoyisa ukuba enze umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele. Izinhlangano ezihlukene zomphakathi zenza imizamo yokubambisana namaphoyisa, okuholela ekwandeni kokuphepha. Izinkinga Amaphoyisa Abahlangabezana Nazo Nokho, amaphoyisa abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ukukhula kobugebengu, izidakamizwa, kanye nezindaba zokuhlukunyezwa kwezobuhlanga kuyizinto ezinzima ezithinta umsebenzi wabo. Amaphoyisa kumele abhekane nalezi zinkinga njengoba kufanele bagcine umphakathi uphephile. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zokucwaninga, ukuthola ubufakazi, nokuthola ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kuyadingeka ukuze baphumelele. Ubuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Ubuchwepheshe buye baba yinsika ebalulekile emsebenzini wamaPhoyisa. Ukusetshenziswa kwezokuxhumana, amakhamera, kanye nezinhlelo zokucwaninga zisheshisa izinqubo zokusebenza. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwenza umsebenzi wamaPhoyisa ube lula, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabo. Ubufakazi obutholakala ngalesi sikhathi busebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu ukuze buphumelele ezinkantolo, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasolwa batholwa benecala. Ukwesekwa Komphakathi Ukuze amaphoyisa akwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wawo ngendlela efanele, kudingeka ukuthi ahlale ethola ukwesekwa komphakathi. Izinhlelo zokugqugquzela impilo ehlanzekile, imfundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwamaphoyisa nabantu zidingeka. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bezizwa bephephile futhi bejabulile. Isiphetho Amaphoyisa badlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophephile nonobulungiswa. Ngokuvumelana, ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphoyisa nomphakathi, kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili, kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wamaPhoyisa uyaphumelela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba umphakathi uqonde izinselelo ezihambisana nomsebenzi wabo, ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisana ngempumelelo ekwakheni izindawo eziphephile. Amaphoyisa, njengomphakathi, banelungelo lokuphila endaweni ephephile, futhi lokhu kumele kube umgomo wethu sonke.
Umthetho Wokulwa Nokukhwabanisa kanye Nokulwa Nokukhwabanisa wenza ukukhwabanisa kube yicala. Uqondisa kubo bonke abasebenza kuhulumeni (njengabaphathiswa, abasebenzi bezigaba, kanye namaphoyisa) kanye nabantu abangaphandle kukahulumeni (njengomuntu osebenza ebhizinisini). Ubuye ubhekane nezimo zokugembula nezemidlalo (njengokukhokhela umgibeli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi enye indaba iwina). Umthetho uchaza izinhlobo ezahlukene zokukhwabanisa, zonke ezifanayo - umuntu ophakamisayo (noma onikayo) okuthile komunye ukuze asebenzise amandla akhe, ngokungekho emthethweni nangokungathembeki, ukuze azuze yena - noma omunye umuntu. Umuntu owenza izithembiso njalo zokuhlinzeka ngento uhlala enecala lokukhwabanisa. Bobabili bazoba necala uma umnikelo wamukelwa. Icalo lokukhwabanisa ngokuvamile lihilela imali. Nokho, ezinye izinhlobo 'zokukhokha' nazo azivumelekile - njengokunikela, izipho, nokuhlinzeka umuntu ngendawo yokusebenza. Abantu abatholakala benecala lokukhwabanisa babhekana nezijeziso ezinzima noma izigwebo zentolongwane ezinde. Bangase baphinde banqatshelwe ukusebenza kuhulumeni esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abanegunya (njengomphakathi ophatha noma umphakathi webhange) kumele babike ukukhwabanisa nezinye izigebengu zezimali ezibhalwe emthethweni ezihilela u-R100,000 noma ngaphezulu kumaphoyisa. Uma behluleka ukubika, bazoba necala.
Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yisiphi isevisi ethile enikezwa? I-TISSA inikeza izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngefoni ukuze kube lula kubo bonke obala ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni. Kungani i-TISSA ikwenza lo msebenzi? I-TISSA ikhuthaza amalungelo okuthuthukisa ulimi futhi ikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke izilimi zendabuko ezisemthethweni. Ingabe umphakathi ungacela izinsizakalo zikahulumeni ngolimi lwabo lokuzalwa? Yebo, uma nje kungulimi lwesizwe olusemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lwezimpawu luhlanganiswe? Yebo, abantu abaphuphuthekayo bazothola izinga elifanayo le sevisi njengomuntu ophilayo. Izindawo zokusebenza zikhona ezikhungweni ezinkulu zendawo. Le sevisi isebenza kanjani? Le sevisi inikeza umhumushi ozohumusha isicelo sakho. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma umnyango kahulumeni ungisiza? Kuzoba nezimpawu ezikhombisa ehhovisi likahulumeni ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuhumusha zikhona. Uma ihhovisi likahulumeni lingakhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngingakwenza lokhu isicelo? Yebo, ungacela le sevisi, kuphela uma abasebenzi bekulungele ukuyinika. Le sevisi izongisiza kanjani? Umhumushi oqeqeshiwe uzokusiza wena nomsebenzi kahulumeni ukuba nemininingwane enembile. Unelungelo lokukhuluma ulimi lwakho. Uhulumeni uzosiza ukuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izikhala zokuxhumana ezikhona. Khuluma ulimi lwakho, kuyilungelo lakho. Izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngefoni zikhona lapha. Ukuhumusha ngefoni kuyatholakala lapha.

Abaguli banezimfanelo! Ngomhla kaMashi 21, sizobungaza Usuku Lwamalungelo Abantu. Abaningi benu bangase bazi ukubaluleka kwalolu suku, kodwa kulabo abancane, nansi imbali. Ngomhla kaMashi 21, 1960, kwaba nokuphikiswa okwenziwa emhlabeni wonke ngokumelene nemithetho yokuphasa eyayidinga ukuthi bonke abantu abamnyama abasebenza ezindaweni zasemadolobheni baphathe amaphepha ngaso sonke isikhathi. Labo abangaqondi balindele ukuboshwa. Kulolo suku, abantu bahamba baye eziteshini zamaphoyisa ngaphandle kokuphatha amaphepha futhi babefuna ukuboshwa. Inhloso yabo kwakuwukuthi kube nabantu abaningi ababoshwe ukuze izinto zingahambi kahle ezweni kulolo suku, okuzoholela ekupheleni kwemithetho yokuphasa. ESharpeville, eJohannesburg, lapho izinkulungwane ziqoqana eziteshini zamaphoyisa, kwaba nokuphikisana, futhi amaphoyisa avula umlilo. Cishe abantu abangu-70 babulawe, kanti abangu-180 baphukile. Labo bantu babebhekene nemithetho engafanele futhi bephikisana namalungelo abo. Iningi lalawa malungelo manje sehlanganiswe kuMthethosisekelo wethu kuSahluko 2. Nokho, lawa malungelo awawona kuphela abantu abathile; awahlukanisi ngokuthi wenza muphi umsebenzi, futhi awabheki ukuthi ungumuntu ocebile noma omncane. Kukho futhi uMthethosisekelo wamalungelo wabaguli. Ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuba nolwazi ngempilo yethu. Ukukhetha uhlobo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo esifuna. Ukwamukela ukwelashwa ngumuntu owaziwayo emkhakheni wezempilo. Ukuthi isimo sabo sezempilo kufanele sithunyelwe kubo bonke, futhi sigcinwe sithule. Ukukhetha ukwelashwa kunikezwa yonke imininingwane mayelana nokuthi kuzokwenziwa ini. Ukufuna umbono wesibili kudokodo noma esibhedlela uma singathembi lokho esikukhuluma. Njengoba wonke umuntu enamalungelo abantu kusukela ekuzalweni, futhi akekho ongawathatha, abaguli akufanele baphokophele noma bacele amalungelo abo. Khumbula, kufanele uhloniphe namalungelo abanye. Isinqumo seNkantolo yeMithetho mayelana necala 'Bhe nabanye v Magistrate Khayelitsha nabanye Inombolo yeCala 49/03, isinqumo esakhishwa ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2004, sathola ukuthi ingxenye 23 yeMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu 38 ka-1927 kanye neSaziso soMphakathi R200 semithetho ekhishwe kuSaziso soMphakathi 10601 sika-6 February 1987 ayihambisani nemthethosisekelo. Ngokuhambisana nomongo wesinqumo seBhe, uMnyango wezeMthetho kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMithetho kufanele uthuthukise futhi usebenzise uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu ezishonile ngendlela ehambelana nezidingo zomphakathi zamaNingizimu Afrika bonke ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, noma ukuzalwa. UJaji Omkhulu kufanele athathe ukulawula ukuhlela zonke izindlu ezishonile. Zonke izindlu kufanele ziphathwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Zonke izindlu zabantu abashonile abangakabeki ukuthi bafuna ukuphathwa kanjani kufanele ziphathwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle 81 ka-1987, njengoba kuguqulwe. UMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle uthola ulwazi esinqumweni seBhe ukuhlinzeka ngalesi simo lapho umufi wayeshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Abaholi bendabuko bayalahlekelwa amandla abo okuphatha nokubheka izindlu zabantu abashonile. Nokho, kuzodingeka baqedele izindaba ezibikwe kubo ngaphambi komhla ka-15 Novemba 2004 noma ngaphambi kwalolo suku. Kumele baqedele zonke lezi zindlu ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle. Ngemuva kwesinqumo seBhe, phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kosuku lwe-6 December 2002, lapho isinqumo sikaMoseneke sathatha amandla, umthwalo wokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu ezishonile wawugxile kakhulu kubuholi bendabuko. UJaji Omkhulu wabheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu zabamhlophe, abamnyama, amaHindi, nabantu abamnyama abangakabeki abalandeli. Amandla kaJaji Omkhulu kanye namandla akhe (okstill asebenza) abekwe kuMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Umphakathi endaweni lapho umufi wayehlala khona wayenobungozi bokubheka ukuphathwa kwempahla yomuntu omnyama oshonile ngaphandle kokubeka abalandeli kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla yakhe. Umphakathi wathola amandla esigabeni 23 seMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu 38 ka-1927 kanye nemithetho ekhishwe kuSaziso soMphakathi R200 kuGazethi yoMphakathi 10601 ka-6 February 1987. Impahla yomuntu omnyama ngemuva kokushona kwakhe ayiphathwanga nguMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle 81 ka-1987. Lokhu kwenzeka ezimweni ezimbili. Esimweni sokuqala, lapho umufi akhombisa ngesikhathi ephila ukuthi akafuni ukuphila ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. NgokweSaziso soMphakathi R200, le mfuno iboniswe ngezindlela ezimbili: lapho umufi efaka isicelo sesitifiketi sokukhululwa ekusebenzeni komthetho wamaZulu, ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 seMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu, kanye lapho ebeka umshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiNgisi ngaphandle kokubanjwa ubuholi bendabuko. Okwesibili, impahla yomufi ayikwazi ukuphathwa nguMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle uma uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho wayenombono wokuthi kuzoba kubi kwezinye izimo ukusabalalisa impahla ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. Izithakazelo ezithintekayo zizokwenza uNgqongqoshe athole isinqumo ngalesi. Esikhathini sesibili, phakathi kosuku lwe-6 December 2002 no-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu wayenamandla okuphatha zonke izindlu zabantu abashonile ngokulandela izimiso zomthetho wesiNgisi kanti umphakathi wayenamandla okuphatha izindlu zabantu abashonile ngokulandela umthetho wesiko. UJaji Omkhulu wayebamba amandla akhe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu kanti abaphakanyisi babebamba amandla ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu kanye nemithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalolo mthetho. Esikhathini sesithathu, ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu uzobheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu zonke zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle. Zonke izindlu ezishiywe ngabantu ngaphandle kokubhala izifiso zabo zizophathwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle ezihambelana nezinguquko ezidingekayo ukuhlinzeka ngoshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinguquko ezilethwe yisinqumo seBhe zinefekthini yokubuyisela isimo emuva ku-27 March 1994 mayelana nezindlu ezingakaze ziphothulwe. Impumelelo yohlelo olusha izoqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baphathwa ngokufanayo futhi inhlonipho yabo iyahlonishwa. Ngokubheka isimo sangempela mayelana nabantu abashonile ngaphambi kosuku lwe-27 March 1994 kanye nezimo ezingabikiwe, lezi zindlu kufanele ziqondiswe kuJaji Omkhulu. UJaji Omkhulu (ofisi kaJaji Omkhulu kanye nezikhungo zikaJaji Omkhulu) kufanele aphathe zonke izindlu lapho umufi ashona ngemuva kosuku lwe-27 March 1994. Impahla izophathwa futhi iphathwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu. Uma umufi eshona ngaphandle kokubeka abalandeli noma ekhuluma izifiso zabo, impahla kufanele ihlukaniswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle. Lezi yizindaba okufanele ziphothulwe umphakathi ngokuhambisana nesinqumo seBhe. Isimo lapho umufi ebhala izifiso zabo zokwabelana ngempahla yabo (umbhalo). Inani lempahla (noma inani elilinganisiwe) lidlula u-R50,000. Impahla iyisikhala esingenalutho (izikweletu zidlula impahla). Omunye noma abaningi bezinzuzo kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi basizwe ngummeleli wabo. Omunye noma abaningi bezinzuzo kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi impahla inenani eliphelele noma elingxenye elidlula u-R20,000. Uma noma iyiphi yezizathu ezishiwo ngenhla ifaneleka, impahla kufanele idluliselwe kwiOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu endaweni umufi ayekhona. Bonke abatholi kufanele babe namandla okusebenza ngokuzimela noma omunye noma abaningi balabo abatholi kufanele babe ngabantwana futhi basizwe ngummeleli wabo, kanti impahla yezezimali ibalwe ku-R20,000 noma ngaphansi. Isikhungo sokusiza sizoba namandla phezu kwempahla yomuntu owayengumuntu ojwayelekile ngesikhathi sokushona ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu lapho Isikhungo Sokwesiza sitholakala khona. Lapho isicelo siqedile ngokuphelele futhi akukho ezinye izimfuneko ezidingekayo ukuze kukhishwe isitifiketi sokubekwa. Lapho isicelo singaqedelwa ngenxa yezinye izimfuneko ezidingekayo futhi kukhona Isikhungo Sokwesiza esiseduzane neOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu yomfaki-sicelo, uJaji Omkhulu kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ngalesi simo. Amandla okubeka iOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu ngalolu sizo akhishwa kumuntu onolwazi owafakile isicelo. Uma ethumela ummeleli wakhe ngaphansi kwesigaba 18, uJaji

Indawo ephakanyisiwe ithe xaxa indawo njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 soMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, 2002 Umthetho No. ilungelo lokukhetha kusho ilungelo njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 soMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, 2002 Umthetho No. imvume yokuthola ulwazi ngento ethile ithe xaxa imvume njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 soMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, 2002 Umthetho No. imvume yokumba ithe xaxa imvume njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 soMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, 2002 Umthetho No. Lo Mthetho uhlanganisa uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezemvelo Kazwelonke, 1998 Umthetho No. Le Nqubomgomo ithe xaxa izinhlinzeko zokuhlola umthelela wemvelo, zonyaka ka-2006. izindawo zokuzijabulisa, izindawo zokulala, amahhotela noma ezinye izikhungo zezivakashi nezokuphumula endaweni evikelwe ekhethwe kuMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezemvelo Kazwelonke ka-2003 Umthetho No. n ukugcina amanzi emfuleni affecting enye indawo, kuhlanganisa nemifula nezindawo ezigcina amanzi anomthamo ongu-50,000 cubic meters noma ngaphezulu, ngaphandle kokuthi le ndawo egcinwayo ibhekiswe emisebenzini ebhalwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 6 soMbiko Wezokuphatha No. R. Ibhodi elithintekayo lemisebenzi ebhalwe kule ngxenye yohlu yiziphathimandla zemvelo endaweni lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphandle kokuthi kuwukufaka isicelo somsebenzi njengoba kuboniswe esigabeni 24C soMthetho, lapho isiphathimandla singuNgqongqoshe noma ilungu leziphathimandla elinikezwe lezo zikhono ngaphansi kwesigaba 42 soMthetho njengoba kushintshiwe. Ukuvinjelwa kokuhamba kwamahhala kwesihlabathi, kuhlanganisa ukugqwala nokwakheka, ngokutshala izitshalo, ukufaka izakhiwo ezakhiwe ezindaweni zesihlabathi nezihlabathi ezithambile ngaphakathi kokuphakama okungama-100 meters ukusuka kumkhawulo wamanzi aphezulu. Ukumba, ukuhamba, ukususa umhlabathi, isihlabathi noma itshe okudlula ama-5 cubic meters emfuleni, emfuleni, emaphakathini emfuleni, imifula ethinta umfula, ezindaweni ezinomfula ophakeme noma ezindaweni ezinomvula ephezulu. Ukususa noma ukusabalalisa izitshalo ezindaweni eziphakeme okungama-10 meters endaweni enokuphakama okungama-100 meters ukusuka kumkhawulo wamanzi aphezulu olwandle. Ukumba, ukuhamba, ukususa, ukudiliza noma ukuhlanganisa umhlabathi, isihlabathi, itshe noma udoti ugcwalisa indawo edlula ubukhulu obungama-10 meters olwandle noma indawo enokuphakama okungama-100 meters ukusuka kumkhawulo wamanzi aphezulu olwandle. Ukugcina izinto eziyingozi emhlabeni, kuhlanganisa uphethiloli, idizili, igazi le-petroleum njengelula noma i-asphalt, ezikhwameni ezinomthamo odlula ama-30 cubic meters kodwa ngaphansi kwama-1,000 cubic meters kunoma iyiphi indawo noma isizinda. Ukuhlola, ukubikezela, umsebenzi wokumba noma imisebenzi yokumba njengoba kuhlelwe kuMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, 2002 (Umthetho No. 28 ka-2002), mayelana nalezi mvume, amalungelo, amalayisense, kanye nezivuselelo zawo. Ibhodi elithintekayo lemisebenzi ebhalwe kule ngxenye yohlu yiziphathimandla ezimbonini noma ilungu leziphathimandla elinikezwe amandla ngaphansi kwesigaba 42 soMthetho njengoba kushintshiwe. Mayelana nemvume, amalungelo, namalayisense kanye nezivuselelo ezitholwe ngaphansi kuka-8 ngenhla, noma yiluphi ilungelo elifanayo elinikezwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yezinsiza noma imithetho yokumbiwa yangaphambili, ukuqhubeka kwanoma yimuphi umsebenzi wokumba ophakanyisiwe noma ophathelene endaweni ephakanyisiwe, owawumbiwa noma owumbiwa, njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 soMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zamakhemikhali Nezokumbiwa, 2002 (Umthetho No. 28 ka-2002). Ibhodi elithintekayo lemisebenzi ebhalwe kule ngxenye yohlu yiziphathimandla zemvelo endaweni lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphandle kokuthi kuwukufaka isicelo somsebenzi njengoba kuboniswe esigabeni 24C soMthetho, lapho isiphathimandla singuNgqongqoshe noma ilungu leziphathimandla elinikezwe lezo zikhono ngaphansi kwesigaba 42 soMthetho njengoba kushintshiwe. Ukususa idamu lapho ingxenye ephezulu yephaneli yedamu, njengoba ikalwa kusukela ezansi kuya phezulu, ingama-5 meters noma ngaphezulu noma lapho izinga lamanzi aphezulu ledamu lihlaba indawo edlula ama-10 hectares. Ukushintsha noma ukususa izitshalo zemvelo ezindaweni ezingu-3 hectares noma ngaphezulu noma nganoma iyiphi usayizi lapho ukushintsha noma ukususa kuzokwenzeka endaweni ehlolwe njengokuthi inengozi enkulu noma ibhalwe njengengozi ebhalwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 52 soMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezemvelo Kazwelonke Wobuchwepheshe, 2004 (Umthetho No. 10 ka-2004). Ukuvinjelwa kokuhamba kwamanzi emhlabeni lapho noma iyiphi imvume inikezwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke, 1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998) izodluliselwa. a izinsika ezingu-15 meters nezakhiwo ezisetshenziswa kuphela zokukhuluma eziphansi; noma b izinhloso zokukhanyisa; futhi c izakhiwo zepholisi yokukhanyisa. Ukwakhiwa komgwaqo ophakeme kunama-4 meters noma endaweni yokumbiwa edlula ububanzi obungama-6 meters, akuhlanganisi imigwaqo ngaphansi kwemisebenzi ebhalwe noma lezo migwaqo ezandleni ezindaweni ezingu-30 meters. a ukusungula uhlelo lokugcwalisa endaweni ethatha ama-hectares angama-5 noma ngaphezulu, kodwa ngaphansi kwama-hectares angama-20; noma b ngezizathu zokuhlala, zokuhlanganisa, zokuhweba noma zezimboni noma izikhungo lapho leyo nkulumo ingeyona yokugcwalisa futhi lapho yonke indawo ezogu
Ifilimu, njengemifanekiso ehambayo, idlalela indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umbono omusha, isivumela ukuba sihlole izikhathi ezahlukene, izindawo ezikude, kanye nezimo ezithokozisayo. Namuhla, ifilimu ibhekwa njengenye yezindlela eziyinhloko zokuxhumana nezilaleli, ihlanganisa izindaba zansuku zonke, izifundo zempilo, nemicabango ethokozisayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ifilimu ayiyona nje indlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa iyithuba lokuxhumana nezilaleli eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma ibhalwe futhi iqhutshwa kahle. Ifilimu ingase ibe yindaba ethokozisayo, ibhuku, noma ingxenye ye-biography, kodwa okubalulekile ukuthi isithombe sabelane ngemizwa nokuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu. Isinyathelo sokuqala sokwenza ifilimu siqala ekucabangeni ngendaba: ubani ophakathi kwendaba, futhi yini eyenzekayo? Lokhu kubeka isisekelo sokucwaninga okujulile ukuze kuqondwe kahle izimo zomphakathi nezemvelo ezithinta indaba. Uma sesikhethile indaba, kudingeka sithobele umthetho othi ubuchwepheshe budlala indima enkulu, kusukela ebhalweni lo mlingo kuze kube uhlelo lokukhangisa. Umqondisi, ophakathi kokuhola nokuxhumanisa, udinga ukuba nekhono lokuqonda izethameli zayo, ebhalela abalingisi abavela ezindaweni ezithile ezikhuluma ngendaba. Kulokhu, kudingeka ubuchule bokwakha izimo, izakhiwo, nezithombe ezikhethiwe, okwakha ubuhle obuhlobene nezimo eziyingqayizivele. Akukona nje ukwakha umhlaba ohluke, kodwa kubalulekile ukulinganisa izithombe zamakhono abalingisi abalwa nezindleko eziphambili. Njengoba siqhubeka nohlelo lokwenza ifilimu, kudingeka sisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, njengezithombe ezihambayo, umculo, nezwi, ukuze kubonakale kahle umoya nezinhloso ezithile. Umculo udlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni imizwa ethile futhi uyinsika yokugcina umoya ophakathi kwendaba. Lokhu kudinga abaculi abanolwazi ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezihambelana nezimo zomlando ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele kulandelwe imithetho yenkampani yezenhlalo ukuze kuthintwe iziphetho ezithile, isikhathi sokwenza izinqumo, nezithameli ezahlukene. Uma sekuqediwe, ifilimu iba semukelweni emphakathini, lapho izilaleli zikhumbuza emlandweni wombono, zenze amaqiniso ajulile ezimweni ezithile, futhi ziqhathanise lezi zinhlelo nezinto ezenzakalayo empilweni yazo. Ukwazi ukuheha izithameli ngebhajethi ephansi nokuqonda kahle izidingo zalezi zihloko kubalulekile kule ndawo yomsebenzi. Ngenkathi ibhajethi ingavumeli ukwenza yonke imihlangano efiselekayo, kuhle ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga lekhwalithi. Lokhu kuzothinta umphakathi ngendlela yokuthi kube neqhaza elisemqoka ekwenzeni ifilimu idume futhi ithakasele. Lapho ifilimu isiqediwe, kumayelana nokuthengisa. Izingosi zokuxhumana, izikhangiso zezindaba, nemicimbi yokwazisa ifilimu kubalulekile ukuze izilaleli zihlale zikhumbula ifilimu, kuze kube sekuwusuku lokuthola ukumukelwa. Uxhumano lwemithombo yezindaba lungaba nendima ebalulekile ekwenzeni ifilimu iqhubeke nokufinyelela ezihlalweni zamaphiko amaningi. Uma sithanda ukuphinda sikukhumbuze, ifilimu ayiyona nje indlela yokubuka ubuwula noma izinkanyezi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana ngemithombo ethile, ivuliwe kakhulu ngokwakha kwesikhathi, indaba, nezimo ezithile ezimnandi nezinobuhlungu. Kubalulekile ukuzithokozisa, ukwandisa umqondo wethu, futhi sibe yingxenye yalesi siko esikhaliphile sefilimu. Lokhu kuhlonishwa ngokuphelele, kwazise ifilimu iyinsika yokuzijabulisa, ikakhulukazi uma ibhalwe kahle futhi iphathwa ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, umkhakha wefilimu ungowokuxhumana, okukhumbuza ukuthi sithinteka kanjani kulokho okuletha indawo esiyiphilayo emhlabeni wezenhlalo, imicabango, nezinkolelo zethu. Ifilimu iyijubane lempilo, ibhalwa kusuka enhliziyweni, igcinwa engqondweni, futhi ibhalwa ezithombeni — futhi lokho kuzozikhumbuza ubuchule besikhathi sokuphila kwethu.
Inkinga yamanzi eKapa, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Day Zero, ibonisa isimo esinzima sokushoda kwamanzi, esikhumbuza ukuthi imithombo yethu yamanzi iyancipha. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yezinguquko ezinzima emhlabeni. Njengom resident eKapa, ngiyavuma ukuthi le nkinga ayikhona nje kuphela ekushodeni kwamanzi, kodwa ibonisa futhi izinselelo ezithinta ukuphila kwethu nsuku zonke. I-Kapa ibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuntuleka kwamanzi, futhi umkhankaso wokuqwashisa ngamanzi ubonisa ukuthi izinga lokuhlola amanzi alikakhuphuki. Ngempela, ubuhlungu bokuthi umuzi omkhulu, owaziwa njengendawo yokuvakasha, ungafika ezingeni le-Day Zero, kukhombisa ukuthi uma izinga lamazinga amanzi lehla, sizofika esimweni sokuthi amanzi abe yimpahla engatholakalanga kalula. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuphila ngaphansi komondli, okuthinta abantu abaningi eKapa. Ngikhumbula ngo-2017, lapho uhulumeni waseKapa waqala imikhankaso yokunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Izinyathelo ezifana nokubeka imikhawulo kumakhosikazi, ukunciphisa izinga lokuhlanzeka kwemithi, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basize ekugcineni imithombo yamanzi, kwakuwumzamo wokubhekana nale nkinga. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zikhombisa ukuthi kudinga ukuba necebo elibanzi elihlanganisa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inkinga yokushoda kwamanzi ayiyona nje eyomphakathi, kodwa ibonisa izinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene nezimboni. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi laba basemakhaya, bahluleka ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, okukhombisa ukuthi le nkinga ye-Day Zero iyinkinga yezenhlalakahle. Ngabe singakwazi ukuthola izixazululo zokwakha umphakathi onempilo uma abanye bethu besaphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima? Ngaphezu kwalokho, inkinga yamanzi ibonisa ukuthi umnotho wethu uyahluleka. Imikhakha efana nezokuthutha, ezokwakha, kanye nezokuphepha kwamanzi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Kodwa lezi zinhlelo zidinga amanzi, futhi uma amanzi eshoda, umnotho uba sengcupheni. Lokhu kuhambisana nezinkinga zokungasebenzi kahle ezikhathini ezahlukene, okusho ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bayabe besebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ngokungafani. Ukubheka izixazululo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezihlakaniphile zokuphatha amanzi. Ukusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, njengokwakha izinhlelo zokuvuselela amanzi, kungasiza ukunciphisa umthelela we-Day Zero. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukwakha umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ukuze kube nokuxhumana okungcono ekulondolozeni imithombo yamanzi. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene ezazithathwa ezindabeni zethu ezingu-2020, lapho sizama ukuqonda indlela yokuphuma kule nkinga. Ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nezindlela zokulondoloza amanzi, ukwenza imikhankaso yokuqwashisa, nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi ezisebenza kahle, kuzothuthukisa umphakathi wethu. Uhlelo lokuhlola amanzi, olwakhiwe ngokuhlakanipha, lungaba yisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho, ngikholwa ukuthi inkinga ye-Day Zero eKapa iyisixwayiso esibalulekile. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi asikwazi ukuncika kuphela emithonjeni engcolile, kodwa kumele sithathe izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngabe singakwenza kanjani lokhu? Ngabe singaba necebo eliphumelelayo lokuphatha amanzi? Ukuphila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokushoda kwamanzi akufanele kube yinto esijabulela, kodwa kufanele kube yinto esiyithokozisayo. Siphila emhlabeni ogcwele izinselelo, kodwa kufanele sibe nokholo lokuthi sizokwazi ukuvula amathuba amasha. Ngakho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-Day Zero akuyona nje imiphumela yokushoda kwamanzi; iyisifundo sokuthi kudinga ukuba sibe nokubambisana ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ekugcineni, ngifuna ukusho ukuthi sonke thina singaba nesandla ekuthatheni izinyathelo. Akukhathaliseki ukuthi sihlala kuphi, sitholakala kuphi, noma sithanda ini; sonke singakwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, omuhle, nokhaliphile. Izinkinga zokushoda kwamanzi azifanele ukuba yinkinga yokuphila, kodwa kufanele kube yindlela yokuthi sithuthuke, sithole izixazululo ezisha, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo. Ngiyabonga.
I-Folio strap: Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi. Ngesikhathi se-NAMPO 2009, ingxenye yamalungu e-250 Ton Club nabanye abalimi abasha bamenywa emhlanganweni. Sikholelwa ukuthi isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi abakhiqizi abamnyama abasha bavumelele izwi labo futhi baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. Ukuqinisekisa kokuqala kukhulu kakhulu. Kukho umbuzo obalulekile okumele siwubuze lapha eNingizimu Afrika - ingabe sifuna ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele lapha, noma sifuna ukubhekana nengcuphe yokuthola ukudla ngaphandle? Ukwenza inzuzo ekulimeni ukudla okuyisisekelo kubangelwa ingcindezi enkulu kangangokuthi abalimi abaningi abakwazi ukuphumelela manje nakusasa? Abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bavame ukulima ezindaweni ezomile, futhi manje baphikisana nokudla okuyisisekelo okuvela phesheya. Njalo lokhu kudla kukhula ezindaweni ezinomoya omuhle, futhi abanye abalimi bathola ukwesekwa kuhulumeni wabo. INingizimu Afrika akufanele ivumele ukudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe athuthukile "ukuphonswa" lapha. Ukuthutha emgwaqweni kubi kakhulu futhi uhlelo lokuthutha ngezimoto alusebenza kahle. Uhlelo lokuthutha ngezimoto ludinga ukuvuselelwa. Azikho izintela zokudla okuvela phesheya ezivikelayo abalimi bendawo. Izintela zokudla okuvela phesheya kufanele zethulwe ukuze zivikela abalimi bethu. Eminyakeni emihle sithola imbewu enkulu ye-maize, manje akukho ezinye izitshalo ezingatshalwa ezizoletha inzuzo kubalimi - ama-grains, ama-beans, nama-soybeans nawo akhiqizwa ngamanani amakhulu, intengo yemakethe iphansi kakhulu, abalimi abakwazi ukutshala izitshalo uma amapulazi ebhekene kuphela nezimvula. Uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi "ukuguqulwa komhlaba" kufanele lunikezwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ezindaweni ezilimalayo, ukudla akufanele kutshalwe, utshani kufanele lutshalwe ukuze kukhiqizwe inyama. Imakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele ikhuliswe. Izindlela ezintsha zokulima nobuchwepheshe kuholele ekwandeni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, manje sekukhona ukudla okuningi. Abalimi kufanele basebenzise izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko ezifana nokulima "okungatshalwanga". Kukho umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwentengo yemakethe ethola umalimi nentengo ekhokhwa umthengi esitolo - uma othile phakathi ethatha imali encane kokubili, bobabili umalimi nomthengi bazothola inzuzo. Ulwazi ngalokhu kufanele lutholakale kalula ukuze bonke ababambiqhaza enqubweni yokukhiqiza nokuthenga ukudla bazi. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakeme. Lapho kunesivumelwano sokwakha izinto ezimbi mayelana nemakethe, kufanele kuhlolwe kahle. Izindleko eziphezulu zokubolekwa kwemali. IBhange Lezindawo kufanele linikeze imali ebolekiwe ngentengo yokwazisa ephansi. Imakethe yokudla ingaba phansi kakhulu. Ibhonasi ingakhokhwa ngokusekelwe embewu yabalimi abasha. Lokhu kungasiza labo abasebenza ngokuzikhandla. Izindawo eziningi ezibekwe zilahlekile, zingakhiqizi lutho - imizamo eminingi iphelelwe yisikhathi. Izindlela zokukhetha kufanele zifake ukuqeqeshwa kokulima komlimi othile nolwazi lwabo. Ubufakazi obudingekayo obukhombisa ulwazi lwabo abafuna ukuwina. Khuthaza (tshela) indlela yezinhlangano ezithenga futhi zithengise izinto lapho kukhethwa abatholi kanye nokwesekwa abakhiqizi. Sekela labo abanikwe amathuba. Abasebenzi boMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba abazi lutho ngezindaba zokulima. Abaphathi bezombusazwe abaqondi kahle ukuthi kwenzekani ekulimeni. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela - izivumelwano eziningi zilahlekile. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthola uxhaso. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Imigomo ephethe lezi zindaba iyashintsha njalo. Lokhu okufundwayo kufanele kufakwe ekusebenzeni. Ukuba nomhlaba kuphela akusizi ekugcineni. Kukho ezinye izidingo ezifana nezilwane, imishini, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ekuqaleni. Abakhiqizi bayafisa ukuthola imali ebolekiwe futhi bayakhohlwa ukuthi abanamandla noma izinsiza zokulwa nezindleko zokubolekwa kwemali nezindleko zokuqala zokulima. IBhange Lezindawo kufanele linikeze abakhiqizi ukuqonda ukuze bakwazi ukuphikisa izindleko eziphezulu zemali. Abakhiqizi badinga ukwesekwa nokuhlinzekwa ngolwazi mayelana nokumaketha ukudla kwabo okuyisisekelo. Abakhiqizi badinga imiyalezo eqondile mayelana nemakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo. Izinhlangano ezithole uxhaso kuBhange Lezindawo ne-IDC azitholi inzuzo ezingeni eliphansi. Kufanele kube nokucaca okungcono mayelana nezinga lokwazisa. Imali ebolekiwe ivame ukuvunywa sekwedlule. Imali ebolekiwe kufanele ivunywe ngokushesha ukuze abakhiqizi bakwazi ukuzilungiselela ukutshala ngonyaka ozayo. Izaphulelo kumali ekhokhwa yizinkampani ezinikeza izinsiza zokuqala zokulima azinikezwa kubalimi. Abalimi abasha badinga ukuwina kulezi zaphulelo zentengo. Yini okufanele uhulumeni ayenze? Intela yokungenisa ukudla okuvela phesheya kufanele ivikele abakhiqizi bendawo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko ezingu-35% ze-inshurensi yokuqala yokulima engakavikelwa. Kufanele kube nesisekelo kuhulumeni sokuguqula amapulazi alimalayo abe yizinkomo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa i-pH yomhlabathi ngokufaka i-lime lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa amazinga e-phosphate lapho ehla kakhulu emhlabathini. Izinhlelo ezivela emaphandleni ahlukene asekelayo abakhiqizi kufanele zihlanganiswe. Izikhulu ezabelana ngolwazi kufanele ziye ezinhlakeni ezinikeza izinsiza zokuthuthukisa le miphumela. Kufanele kube nokugxila ekubuyiseni "izinto zokufaka ezomnotho nokuvuselela" imishini ekulimeni. Izigaba ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezolimo ophatha umhlaba nokuvikelwa komhlabathi kufanele ziqiniswe ngabantu abanolwazi.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal Izikhukhula ezibangelwe imvula eningi ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu eKwaZulu-Natal, zishiya izinkulungwane zabantu bezama ukuphila phansi kwezimo ezinzima. Njengomuntu ophila kule ndawo, ngiyazizwa ngithinteka kakhulu yalesi simo, futhi ngifuna ukwabelana ngembono yami ngalesi sikhathi esinzima. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi izikhukhula akuzona izenzakalo ezivamile. Zenzeka ngenxa yokuhlangana kwezimo eziningi, okuhlanganisa izimo zezulu, ukungabi bikho kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, kanye nokungabikhona kwezinhlelo zokuvikela abantu. Ezinye izindawo zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokwakha ezimisiwe, kodwa eKwaZulu-Natal, kubonakala sengathi asikazitholi lezi zixazululo ezidingekayo. Ngokubona kwami, umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuqedeni le nkinga. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izingozi ezikhona, bazi ukuthi bangazivikela kanjani, futhi baphathe izinsiza ngendlela efanele. Abantu badinga ukufundiswa ngezindlela zokuphila ezivikelekile, njengokwakha izindlu eziphakeme, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokugcina amanzi, kanye nokuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokwakha. Kodwa, akukhona kuphela umphakathi okudingeka ube neqhaza. Uhulumeni kumele abheke lezi zimo ngeso elibukhali. Izinsiza ezisetshenziswayo ukuze kuvinjwe izikhukhula zidinga ukwenziwa kahle. Imali edingekayo yokwakha izinhlelo zokuvikela kufanele ibekwe phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kumele anikeze izinsiza ezanele ezindaweni ezibhekene nezikhukhula, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlala bezolile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zikhombisa ububi bokungabi bikho kwezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Amathuba okwakha izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi kumele abhekwe. Izikhukhula zenzeka kakhulu lapho amanzi engakwazi ukuhamba kahle, okwenza kube nokwakheka kwezikhukhula. Ukuze sithole isixazululo esiqinile, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, sigcine izindawo ezithile zihlanzekile, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahamba ngendlela efanele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi izikhukhula zidinga izixazululo eziphusile, kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ulindele uhulumeni kuphela. Umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izixazululo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuvikela, ukwakha izindlu eziphakeme, nokubambisana nezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila ezindaweni eziphephile. Kodwa, ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zinto azilula. Abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezinzima, futhi abakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu. Izinhlelo zokuphila ezivikelekile kufanele zibe sezingeni eliphezulu, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhlala bezolile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izikhukhula azithinti abantu kuphela, kodwa zinezimpempe ezinzima emnothweni. Izinkampani ezincane ziye zathinteka kakhulu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhasa lezi zinkampani. Uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokuxhasa abantu abathintekayo, ukuze baphinde bakhe kabusha impilo yabo. Ngokubona kwami, izikhukhula eKwaZulu-Natal zidinga ukuqonda okujulile, kanye nezixazululo eziphusile. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila ezindaweni eziphephile. Kumele sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, siqinisekise ukuthi izindlu zakhiwe ngendlela efanele, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo. Ekugcineni, izikhukhula zikhombisa ukuthi sinesidingo sokubambisana. Akukhona ukuthi umphakathi noma uhulumeni kufanele benze lokhu bodwa, kodwa kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Uma sithanda ukuphila ezindaweni eziphephile, kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izixazululo eziphusile. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yethu, futhi kuzovikela abantu ezikhukhuleni ezizayo. Ngakho, asihlanganyeleni, sibe nesibopho sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile eKwaZulu-Natal.
Iqembu Lokucwaninga i-Imperani (eFicksburg). Kunamahektare angama-1,510. Kungani umhlaba ophumelelayo ungakhuliswa? Futhi umhlaba ophathelene nezixuku zabantu, ngakho kungase kungabi lula ukuthola imali yokukhiqiza. Iqembu Lokucwaninga lihlangana kangaki? Iqembu lethu lokucwaninga lihlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngehlelo lezolimo, futhi futhi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili, mayelana nehlelo lokukhulisa ufulawa. Yini inzuzo yokuba yilungu leQembu Lokucwaninga? Manje sesiyazi ukuthi kwenzekani embonini yezinhlamvu futhi siphinde sazi ngamathuba atholakalayo kwezolimo. Sinehlelo lokweseka esingalithembela kukho uma kukhona inkinga. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweQembu Lokucwaninga nebhizinisi lezolimo? Ngezinye izikhathi sihlangana nabakhiqizi ngabanye abathengisa ukuze bathole inzuzo emakethe futhi sizizwa sengathi siyingxenye yomphakathi obanzi babalimi. Ingabe ufuna ukuhlangana neQembu Lokucwaninga labakhiqizi abafuna inzuzo, futhi kungani ucabanga ukuthi kubalulekile? Kubalulekile kithi njengabakhiqizi ukukhuluma ngolimi olulodwa. Umkhiqizi omncane usendleleni yokuba umkhiqizi ofuna inzuzo yokudla. Ukuqala ndawonye, ukuxhumana, nokwesekana kuzokwenza ukuthi bonke abakhiqizi babe namandla.
### Izinselelo Zempilo: Indaba Yempilo Yezizukulwane Isingeniso Emhlabeni wethu, impilo ibhekene nezinselelo ezinzima, ezingaphandle kokucabanga. Izinselelo zempilo zihlala zikhona, zihlala zishintsha, futhi ziguquka ngaphakathi kwemigudu yokwakha komphakathi. Lezi zinto zilethela abantu ubuhlungu, kepha futhi zikhuthaza ukuqina nokuqhubeka ekuphileni. Ukukhuluma ngezimpilo zempilo kudinga ukuthi sihlole izinkathi ezahlukene, nakanjani izibonelo ezikhumbulekayo ezivela ezizukulwaneni. Njengoba sihlola lezi zimo, sizobona ukuthi izinselelo zethu zishintsha, kepha ukuqina kokuphila kukhula unomphela. Ukuqala Kwesizathu Sezinselelo Ezikhathini zasendulo, abantu babebhekene nezimo ezinzima, ezihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukushoda kokudla, kanye nezinye izimo zokuphila ezinzima. Ngokwesibonelo, emakhathini amadala, izizwe eziningi zazibhekene nezikhathi zokuhlaselwa, okubangela ukuba izakhamuzi zifune ukuvikela impilo nokuhola impilo eyejwayelekile. Eqinisweni, izinkathi zebhadi zokuhlaselwa kwabantu, ziningi izifundo esizithola kulolu hlobo lwezikhathi. Kulezi zinkathi, kwavela izimpawu zokuqina nokubambisana kwabantu. Isikhathi Sezinqaba Zokuphila Ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, abantu baqala ukuhlangabezana nezinselelo ezintsha. Ukukhula komnotho, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, nezinguquko kwezepolitiki kwaholela ekutheni kube nezidingo ezintsha. Abantu baqala ukuveza isidingo sokufunda, ukwakha imikhakha emisha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphila eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba kwezikhulu kwezepolitiki nokwakhiwa kwemiphakathi yamakhosikazi kuholele ekwandeni kwezinselelo emphakathini. Izinselelo Zekhanda Nezenhlalakahle Ngokuya phambili emlandweni, izinselelo ezibhekene nezizukulwane zomphakathi zithinta abantu ngobuchwepheshe bombono nemizwa. Ukuze kulungiswe izinqumo ezibuhlungu, abantu bahlala bexhasa omunye nomunye. Izinkinga zempilo zikhona, futhi zinciphisa umqondo wempilo. Lokhu kuhlonipha ubuhlungu bempilo kudinga ukuba kubekwe izixazululo ezimnandi, nokusiza abantu abahlala bephila kahle. Lolu shintsho olukhula emcabangweni nakwezemiphakathi, lwazisa ukuthi ukuzinikela nokuzikhethela kubalulekile. Izinselelo Zobuchwepheshe Nempilo Yomphakathi Ngesikhathi sikaMandela, ukubuyiselwa kwezimpilo emphakathini kwabamba iqhaza elibalulekile. Lokhu kuveza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphila ezifanele, okuyinto eyayinikeza umuntu ngamunye ithuba lokuphila impilo eyanelisayo. Ngakho-ke, yize izinselelo zazikhona, kodwa abantu babesagubha okuyinto engaziwa — umoya ophakamisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, ngamunye unesisekelo sokwenza izinqumo obala, nokuthi ukudlula ezintweni ezinzima okufanele. Izimpilo Zesibhedlela Nokuqhubeka Kwezinkinga Zempilo Izinkinga zempilo zihlala zikhona, futhi zihlala zidla umoya wethu. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma ngezimo ezinjalo, abantu baphila, baphilekarisile, futhi baphinde bazame ukuphila ngempilo. Lokhu kwakhombisa ukuthi imizamo yokwakha izra no mleko yempilo kube yinzuzo, kungakhathaliseki impilo obekuhamba ngayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuba 'ukufunda' ukuthi izinselelo zempilo zilapho ukuze ziqinise ubungane phakathi kwabantu. Isiphetho Izinselelo zempilo zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu ngamunye. Njengoba sithola izifundo emlandweni, izinkumbulo ezinzima zikhombisa ukusindiswa kokuphila okusha. Kuhlala kudingeka ukucabangela izimo ezahlukeneyo, ngenhloso yokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Yize izingqinamba zempilo zihlala zikhona, ukuqina nokuphila okuqinisekisiwe kuyindlela yokuphila ejabulisayo. Izinselelo zempilo ziyiqiniso, kepha ukukwazi ukuhamba phambili yikhono eliqinile elihlanganisa umphakathi, lwenza umhlaba wethu ube ngcono.
Abadlali Abasha: Indaba Yomlando Ngaphakathi kwezinkanyezi zezemidlalo, abadlali abasha bahlala bejabulisa izinkulungwane zabantu. Le ndaba ikhuluma ngokukhula, ubuhlakani, kanye nezifiso ezinzima. Izinyathelo zabo ziqala ezindaweni ezincane, kodwa umcabango wabo uphakamisa kakhulu. Ekuqaleni, sithola abadlali abasha bejolise emaphusheni abo, njengeSipho, umntwana oneminyaka eyishumi, owawuthanda ibhola. Ngemva kokuhamba esikoleni, uSipho wayehamba ngqo emadlalweni, edlala ibhola nabangane bakhe. U-Sipho wayengazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku zibalulekile, njengoba ezithola amakhono okudlala, kodwa futhi ezithuthukisa umqondo wakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukudlala ibhola akukhona nje ukujabulisa, kodwa kudinga ukuzinikela. Waqhubeka nezifundo eziningi, efunda ngezindlela ezahlukene zokudlala, futhi ekugcineni, wathola ithuba lokudlala eqenjini lendawo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu empilweni yakhe, njengoba wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bonke bejolise emgibeni ofanayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, sithola uThandi, intombazane enesibindi esikhulu, eyayithanda umjaho. UThandi wayehlala ebhoda emigwaqweni, efuna ukujabulisa umndeni wakhe. UThandi wayekwazi ukuthi umjaho ungamvulela iminyango eminingi, ngakho waqala ukujolisa emqhudelwaneni wendawo. Ngemva kokuzilolonga ezinyangeni eziningi, uThandi waphumelela emqhudelwaneni omncane, kwavula amathuba amasha. Waqala ukuhamba nezinye izifundiswa, ezithola izifundo ezinkulu emhlabeni wezokugijima. Abadlali abasha, njengabanye, babenobunzima. Kwakukhona izikhathi zokuphoxeka, lapho bengenakufeza okuhlosiwe. U-Sipho wayephakathi kwalesi simo, eqhathanisa impumelelo yakhe nabanye. Kodwa uThandi, yena, wayefunda ukuthi ukuphoxeka akukhona ukuphela, kodwa isinyathelo sokuqala sokuphumelela. Waqhubeka nokuzikhandla, futhi lokhu kwaba yisifundo esikhulu kumina. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadlali abasha baqala ukuthola ukwaziwa. U-Sipho, ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, wathola ithuba lokudlala eqenjini lesifunda. Lokhu kwakuwumlando omusha empilweni yakhe. Waqala ukuhamba nezinye izinkanyezi, ezithola ithuba lokudlala emqhudelwaneni omkhulu. U-Sipho wayebona ukuthi umphakathi wawumlandela, futhi lokhu kumjabulisa kakhulu. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uThandi wathola ithuba lokuba yinxusa lesifunda emqhudelwaneni omkhulu. Waqala ukuhamba nezinye izintokazi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kwamnika ithuba lokuhlangana nabantu abasha, bonke bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezinkulu. UThandi wayefunda ukuthi ubuhlobo bukhulu, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsika empumelelweni yakhe. Abadlali abasha bahlola imingcele yabo. U-Sipho noThandi, bobabili, baphendukela emhlabeni wezemidlalo, behlola izifiso zabo. U-Sipho wajabula kakhulu lapho ethola umklomelo, kanti uThandi wayejabula ngokufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba bobabili bazi ukuthi bayakwazi ukufinyelela izinjongo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho noThandi baba neqhaza elikhulu emiphakathini yabo. Bafundisa abanye abadlali abasha ukuthi ukuzikhandla nokuzimisela kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. U-Sipho waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuthaza abanye, kanti uThandi waba uhlelo lokuqeqesha abanye abantwana. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba bobabili bazi ukuthi banganika umphakathi wabo okuthile. Abadlali abasha bahlala besebenzisa izifundo abazitholile. U-Sipho noThandi bazi ukuthi impumelelo ayizwakali kalula, kodwa ifuna umsebenzi onzima. Babefunda ukuthi ukuhamba phambili kudinga ukuzimisela, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsika empumelelweni yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abadlali abasha bahlala bejabulisa izinkulungwane zabantu. U-Sipho noThandi, bobabili, bazi ukuthi umhlaba wezokudlala awupheli, futhi bahlala bejolise emaphusheni abo. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esikhulu, njengoba bazi ukuthi abadlali abasha banganikela umphakathi wabo okuthile, futhi lokhu kwaba yinsika yokukhula kwabo. Le ndaba ibonisa ukuthi abadlali abasha bangenza umehluko. U-Sipho noThandi bazi ukuthi impumelelo ayigcini nje ngokuphumelela emqhudelwaneni, kodwa futhi ibonisa ukuthi bangaba yizibonelo ezinhle kwabanye. Le ndaba igcwele izifundo, uthando, nokukhula, futhi ibonisa ukuthi abadlali abasha bangaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wezemidlalo.
Kubuhlungu kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azi ukuthi iKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ngaphansi kweSigaba 11 seMthetho weKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 46 ka-1997) ifundwa ndawonye neSigaba 196 (f) (ii) soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) isungule imithetho ebhalwe kuSheduli 1 lapha. Kubalulekile ukuthi kucatshangelwe ukuthi omunye umqashi, ummeleli noma usemthethweni wenhlangano evunywayo ubamba iqhaza. Ukuphathwa noma ukuphathwa kwezikhalazo kufanele kube ngokushesha, kungakhethi, futhi kube nokulingana, kube nezixhumanisi eziqinile emsebenzini, kanye nokuxazululwa kwezikhalazo zomuntu ngamunye ezingeni eliphansi lelo department. Isikhalazo kufanele sixazululwe ngumqashi lapho sivelayo noma ezingeni eliseduzane. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izikhalazo zixazululwa ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokukhetha, futhi ukuthi izimiso zokulunga zilandelwa. Le nqubo kufanele isize futhi ivumele umqashi nomqashi ukuthi baxazulule ukunganeliseki. Akekho umqashi okufanele aphathwe kabi noma akhethwe ngqo noma ngokuqondile ngenxa yokuthi ubeke isikhalazo. Uma umqashi ethola isinyathelo sokubopha, ukusebenzisa le nqubo ngumqashi ukuze abhekane nalesi simo esihlobene nesinyathelo sokubopha ngeke kube yinqubo yokubopha. Isikhalazo kufanele sibhaliwe lapho sithunyelwa, futhi zonke izinqumo ezenziwe kule nqubo kufanele zibhaliwe. Uma ucabanga ngezikhathi ezinqunyiwe, lokhu kufanele kubalwe ngokukhipha usuku lokuqala bese kubalwa usuku lokugcina. Ababandakanyekayo kufanele balandele isikhathi esibekwe kule nqubo, ngaphandle uma bevuma ukwandisa isikhathi. Isikhalazo kufanele sithunyelwe kumqashi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 kusukela ngosuku umqashi ethole ngalo isenzo esamphoxile noma ukungasebenzi. Umqashi angacela ukuthi isikhalazo sakhe sithunyelwe kuKomishini phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 ngemuva kokuthola isinqumo kusuka kumphakathi ofanele. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze abeke futhi aqhubeke nesikhalazo, uma kuceliwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwalolo lwazi kuncike ezithintweni zomthetho. Umqashi kufanele aziswe ngesimo sesikhalazo sakhe nokuthi sithuthuke kangakanani ekuxazululweni ngosuku oluhlongozwayo. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ikhophi yefomu lesikhalazo ngemuva kwezinga ngalinye lapho isikhalazo sithathwa khona ngempahla. Umqashi angathumela isikhalazo sakhe kumqashi oqokwe noma kumqondisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izikhalazo kulolo department. Ifomu elibekiwe i-Annexure A kufanele lisetshenziswe lapho kuthunyelwa isikhalazo. Umqashi oqokwe kufanele axhumane nomphakathi ofanele kulolo department ukuze azame ukuxazulula isikhalazo. Isikhalazo singaxazululwa nganoma yimuphi umuntu kulolo mkhakha ofanele onegunya lokwenza njalo. Umqashi obeke isikhalazo uzokhunjulwa ngumqashi oqokwe ngesimo nangesinyathelo esithathwe ekuxazululeni isikhalazo. Uma isikhalazo sixazululwa ngendlela efanele, umqashi obeke isikhalazo uzothola ukuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe ngalokhu kumqashi oqokwe. Uma isikhalazo singaxazululwa, umphakathi ofanele kufanele wazise umqashi obeke isikhalazo. Idepartment (kuhlanganise nomphakathi ofanele) inezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nesikhalazo. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngenkontileka ebhaliwe. Umphakathi kufanele, ngokwemigomo yeSigaba 35 (1) seMthetho weSevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994, uthumele isikhalazo nemibhalo efanele kuKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ukuze yenze izincomo phakathi nezinsuku ezi-5 zokwaziswa ngumqashi onesikhalazo. Uma isikhalazo sihilela ukuvuma kokungafaneleka kwezokusebenza njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi ka-1995, umqashi angazisa umphakathi ofanele ukuthi ufuna ukusebenzisa inqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano esunguliwe kuMthethosisekelo weBhodi yeZokuxhumana zeSevisi Yomphakathi, noma iyiphi ibhodi efanele (noma iyiphi imbody efanele) futhi ukuthi iKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ayikwazi ukucabangela leli sikhalazo. a ngqo kuKomishini; noma b uma kuwukuxabana kwezokusebenza nebhodi yeZokuxhumana zeSevisi Yomphakathi noma iyiphi ibhodi efanele noma imbody efanele mayelana nenqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano. Uma iKomishini isitholile yonke imininingwane evela kumphakathi ofanele, kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku ezi-30, icabangele leli sikhalazo futhi ibhale kumphakathi ofanele ngezincazelo zayo nezizathu zesinqumo sayo. Ngemuva kokuthola izincomo zeKomishini, umphakathi ofanele kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku ezi-5, ubhale kumqashi kanye neKomishini ngesinqumo sawo. a thumele isikhalazo sakhe kuMongameli uma kuyinhloko yephalamende lesizwe; noma b thumele isikhalazo sakhe kumphakathi ofanele uma kuyinhloko yephalamende lesifunda. UMongameli noma uMphakathi unezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nesikhalazo. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngokuvumelana. Imithetho F9 no-F10 ifundwa nemishwana edingekayo futhi izosebenza kuzo zonke izikhalazo zezinhloko zezigaba. Inhloko ye department kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi ukuxazululwa kwezikhalazo kuqoshwa ngokugcina amarekhodi enani lezikhalazo ezixazululiwe kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka ngamunye futhi ibike kuKomishini ngalokhu njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. IKomishini kufanele ibike ePhalamende okungenani kanye ngonyaka mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinkinga nezindlela zokuphumelela zenqubo yokuxazulula izikhalazo kanye nezisebenzi zayo, esifundazweni kuMphakathi wesifunda. Uma isikhalazo sithunyelwa ngaphansi kwale nqubo, umqashi obeke isikhalazo kufanele avule uma ethanda ukusebenzisa ezinye izinqubo. Isikhalazo esibekwe ngaphambi kokukhululwa kweMithetho Yesikhashana, ngaphambi kosuku luka-1 kuJulayi 1999, sizophathwa futhi siqedwe ngokuhambisana neMithetho Yesikhalazo Yesikhashana ekhishwe ngaphansi kokukhululwa kuGazethi yoHulumeni No. 20231 ka-1999. Usuku lokusebenza kwale mithetho ngu-19 kuZibandlela 2003, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe kuMthetho K. Le fomu kufanele isetshenziswe ukuze kubekwe isikhalazo (ukukhishwa kokuphuma okungalungile) uma unganelisekile ngesenzo noma ukungasebenzi futhi ungakaze uxazulule le ndaba ngezingxoxo ezingekho emthethweni ngokomthetho. Ungase uthole usizo noma umeleke omunye umqashi noma ummeleli noma usemthethweni wenhlangano evunywayo. Kubalulekile ukuba ugcwalise yonke imininingwane ngokunembile. Uma ifomu igcwaliswe, kufanele inikezwe kumqashi oqokwe ukuze alungiselele noma abe umxhumanisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izikhalazo kule ndawo. Idepartment izobophela le fomu kumanye amadokhumenti ezikhalazo futhi izosetshenziswa kuzo zonke izigaba zenqubo yokuxazulula izikhalazo.
