Ukuphepha Ku-Inthanethi: Izinyathelo Zokuzivikela Ukuphepha ku-inthanethi, noma i-cybersecurity, kubalulekile emhlabeni wamanje lapho ubuchwepheshe buhlala buhamba phambili. Njengoba sithola ulwazi futhi sixhumana, siphoqeleka ukuba siqonde izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa i-inthanethi. Kulolu hlobo, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwethu, izimpahla zethu, kanye nokuphepha kwethu. Isigaba 1: Ukuqonda Izingcuphe Zokuphepha Ku-Inthanethi Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izingcuphe ezikhona. Izingcuphe zifaka phakathi: 1. Ubulungu obungafunwa - Lokhu kuhilela abantu abangenalo igunya lokufinyelela ulwazi lwakho. 2. Izingcezu zomkhonyovu - Ama-virus, ama-malware, kanye nezinhlelo ezilimazayo zingangena kumakhompyutha ethu. 3. Izinsiza ezivulekile - Ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezivulekile ngaphandle kokuzivikela kungaholela ekubeni ulwazi lwethu lutholakale kalula. Ukuze uqonde kahle lezi zingcuphe, kufanele ube nesithakazelo sokufunda kepha ungaziphazamisi. Funda izindaba eziphathelene nezokuphepha, bheka izibonelo zokwephulwa kokuphepha, futhi uhlale uvumelana nezinguquko ezweni lobuchwepheshe. Isigaba 2: Izinyathelo Zokuzivikela Ngemva kokuba usuwuqondi kahle umqondo wezingozi, ungathatha izinyathelo ezilandelayo ukuze uvikeleke: 1. Sebenzisa Amakhasi Anokuphepha: Qiniseka ukuthi amakhasi owavakashelayo anekhodi yokuphepha (HTTPS). Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oluthunyelwa nolwamukelwa luyavikelwa. 2. Faka Isofthiwe Yokuvikela: Kubalulekile ukufaka isofthiwe yokuvikela efana nezivikeli ze-virus, ezivumela ukuvuselelwa njalo ukuze zihlale zisesimweni esifanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza luhlale luhlaziywe. 3. Sebenzisa Amagama Wokungena Aqinile: Amagama wokungena akho kufanele abe mde futhi ahlanganise izinhlamvu ezinkulu, ezincane, izinombolo, nezimpawu. Gwema ukusebenzisa amagama alula noma alula. 4. Thuthukisa Ukuzivikela Kwemibhalo: Ukusebenzisa izinkanyezi zokuphepha kuzo zonke izinhlelo zakho - izinhlelo zokusebenza, amakhasi, nezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi - kuzokwenza kube nzima ukungena. 5. Qaphela Izixhumanisi Nezimemo Zokungena: Ungavuli izixhumanisi ezivela kumthumeli ongaziwa. Lokhu kuvame ukuba yindlela yokuhlasela yokuphanga ulwazi. Isigaba 3: Ukuqapha Nokuqhubeka Nokuvikela Ukuphepha ku-inthanethi akupheli nje lapho uthathile izinyathelo zokuqala. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokwazisa: 1. Bheka Ukuhlaselwa: Qaphela uma kukhona okungajwayelekile okwenziwa kumakhompyutha noma kumadivayisi akho. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuvuleka kwezinhlelo ezingalindelekile noma izaziso ezivela kumaseva ongawaziyo. 2. Funda Ngokuqhubekayo: Ukuze uhlale uphephile, kufanele uhlale uvumelana nezinto ezintsha ezitholakala ku-inthanethi. Thola izifundo, hlola izinsiza eziphathelene nokuphepha, futhi uzenzele isikhathi sokufunda. 3. Sebenzisa Izinqubo Zokwakha Izinhlelo Zokuphepha: Qinisekisa ukuthi unezinhlelo ezilungiselelwe uma kwenzeka usukhumbule ukuhlaselwa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha amakhodi amasha, ukuvuselela izinhlelo zokuphepha, nokuhlangana nabachwepheshe uma kudingeka. Isigaba 4: Ukuthuthukisa Imikhuba Yokuphepha Kwezezimali Uma usebenzisa i-inthanethi ukuze wenze izimali, qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ngezinyathelo ezithile: 1. Sebenzisa Izinsiza Zokukhokha Ezivikelekile: Thola izinsiza zokukhokha eziphephile, ezinjengezokukhokha ezikwi-inthanethi ezihloniphekile. 2. Bheka Izibuyekezo Zokuphepha: Qiniseka ukuthi i-akhawunti yakho yezezimali ikhululiwe njalo, futhi ungashiyi ulwazi lwakho lwezezimali lutholakele kumakhompyutha angavikelekile. 3. Faka Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukwamukela Imali: Uma uthola imali ku-inthanethi, qinisekisa ukuthi imithombo iyahambisana nemigomo yokuphepha, futhi ungavuli izixhumanisi ezingekho emthethweni. Isiphetho: Ukuphepha Ku-Inthanethi Njengomsebenzi Oqhubekayo Ukuphepha ku-inthanethi akuyona into eyenziwa kanye. Kubalulekile ukuba nokuqhubeka nokuvikela ulwazi lwakho, ukuqonda izingozi, nokuba nezinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela. Njengomsebenzisi, ungabambisana nabanye ukuze wenze i-inthanethi ibe indawo ephephile. Ngokuqhubeka nokufunda nokuzivocavoca ngezinyathelo ezilungile, ungavikela kahle ulwazi lwakho nezinsizakusebenza zakho. Ngakho-ke, qhubeka uvikelekile, ngoba ukuphepha ku-inthanethi akupheli, kodwa kusemkhakheni wokuphila wansuku zonke. Futhi, khumbula: ukuvikelwa kuqala ngaphambi kokuba kube sekwenzekile.
Kunzima ukukholwa ukuthi intengo ye-maize ku-Safex ngoFebhuwari 2007 yayiphansi kuka-R1880 ngotoni uma sicabangela ukuthi yafinyelela ku-R3,460 ngotoni ngoSepthemba 18. Ukuhamba phambili kwentengo kw brought ukukhanya kumakhiqizi be-maize, kodwa iqiniso ukuthi labo abathole inzuzo babe yibo ababe nesigamu sokuvuna sabo sika-2006/2007, noma labo ababe sebenze izivumelwano zesikhathi eside ne-Safex. Ngeshwa, akukho abakhiqizi abakwazi ukugcina futhi bagcine izivuno zabo isikhathi eside emva kokuvuna, ngakho-ke kukhona ingozi yokungatholi intengo enhle. Abakhiqizi bangazibuza ukuthi kuphi ochwepheshe abafanele ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nalolu daba. Kungani abalimi (abakhiqizi) bengatholi imiyalezo eqondile? Lokhu kuyalimaza, kodwa imininingwane etholakalayo ngesikhathi esithile akusiyo into engakusiza ukwenza isinqumo esiqondile mayelana nokumaketha izivuno zakho. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezingaba nomthelela, mhlawumbe isimo sezulu singaba yinto enkulu, esingaholela ekwandeni kwentengo. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukusho ngokuqiniseka ukuthi kuzokwenzekani esikhathini esizayo. Ithebula 1 libonisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele kusukela ngo-2005, futhi kukhona umbono ongazelelwe wezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 okwehlisiwe ngokusekelwe ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari, konke kuhambisana nezibikezelo ezivela esikhathini esifushane edlule. Ukubikezela okujolile kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 kubonisa inani elingafinyelela ku-623.7 million tons, njengoba bekukholelwa ukuthi kunezindawo eziningi ezintsha ezitshalwe. Uma le mibono iqinile, lokho kuzophakamisa ukuthi kuzoba ne-33.5 million tons (6.7%) ye-maize ethengisiwe ngo-2006. Emhlabeni jikelele, ukusetshenziswa kwe-maize kungaba cishe ku-620 million tons, okusho ukuthi kuzoba ne-maize eyanele kuzo zonke izindawo ezidingayo. Ithebula 1: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni (million tons). Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezingalindelekile, amazwe ahlukene akhiqiza i-maize wehlise izibikezelo zawo mayelana nenani lokukhiqiza ngonyaka ka-2007 njalo, futhi ekupheleni kukaSepthemba 07, ukubikezela kokukhiqiza kufinyelele ku-601.4 million tons. Lokhu kube ukwehla kwe-22.3 million tons kusukela ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari 2007 - lokhu kuholele ekwandeni okungazelelwe kwezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni. Umthombo (lapho sithole khona: International Grain Board, Safex kanye nedatha ye-Grain SA). Intengo ye-maize e-Argentina yayingu-$177/ton ngoFebhuwari 07 yabe isanda kwanda yaba ngu-$355/ton (I-Grafu 1). Lokhu kusho ukuthi yanda ngo-$158/ton noma u-89%. Lokhu kwenzeka ngaphandle kokwanda kokukhiqiza okwakuphakeme kunezibalo zangoFebhuwari. Intengo ebizwa ngokuthi "free-on-board" ye-USA Hard Red evela eGulf nayo yenza okufanayo ngaphandle kokwanda kokukhiqiza kwe-maize okungama-1.5 tons eMelika kusukela ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari (Ithebula 1). Ngenxa yesimo sezulu esibi e-Australia, eCanada, nase-European Union, izivuno zehla kakhulu - lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kwentengo ye-maize emhlabeni ngo-2007 - futhi lokhu kuphakamisa izintengo ze-maize emhlabeni. I-Grafu 1 ibonisa intengo ye-Safex (ngenyanga eseduze), ku-$ / ton kulandela intengo yomhlaba ngo-2007. Kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007, intengo ye-Safex yanda ngo-$200/ton, uma kuqhathaniswa nokwanda kwentengo ka-$158/ton e-Argentina, kanye nokwanda kwentengo ka-$143/ton ye-USA Hard Red. Ukwanda okukhulu kwentengo ye-maize lapha uma kuqhathaniswa nemakethe yomhlaba kwenzeka ikakhulu ngenxa yokwanda kwezindleko zokuhamba i-maize lapha ngempahla. NgoFebhuwari 2007, bekukhokhwa u-$43/ton ukuze kuthunyelwe i-maize e-Argentina, futhi u-$48/ton ukuze kuthunyelwe eGulf. Kwakukhona futhi isidingo esikhulu sezikebhe ezithutha i-maize, okwaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuhamba kabili. Okwamanje, kukhokhwa u-$73/ton ukuthumela i-maize e-Argentina, kanye no-$88/ton ukuthumela i-maize ezikhumulweni zeGulf ukuya lapha (I-Grafu 2). Ngentengo yokushintshanisa ka-R6.85/$, lokhu kusho ukuthi ukwanda kwezindleko zokuhamba kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007 sekuhlinzeke u-R219/ton. Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni kulindeleke ukuthi kwehle, okwaholela ekwandeni kwezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni, futhi ngenxa yesidingo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sidinga ukungenisa ingxenye yesithathu ye-maize edliwayo/eyidingekayo, ukwanda kwezintengo zomhlaba kuphinde kwaholela ekwandeni kwezintengo lapha. Ukwanda kwezindleko zokuhamba i-maize evela phesheya kuphinde kwapressha izintengo zendawo. Ukwanda kwezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni kuphinde kwaveza ukuthi izimo zezulu zinefuthe elikhulu uma sibheka imakethe yokudla evela kwezolimo. Siyazi kahle ukuthi asikwazi ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo noma isimo sezulu sizokwenzenjani.

Kukhona okuningi okungaxoxwa ngalezi zithombe ezimbili - kuhlanganisa nezinhlobonhlobo zomkhiqizo kulezi zinsimu ezimbili. Ukuphakama komhlabathi (pH): ukuphakama kukalwa endaweni yokufunda. Umanyolo osetshenzisiwe: izibonelo zomhlabathi zithathwe futhi umanyolo nokuphakama kwafakwa ngokuhambisana nezivivinyo zezibonelo - bheka umehluko wombala phakathi kwezi nsimu ezimbili. Izinhlobo zezithombo: endaweni yokufunda, izithombo ezihlanganisiwe (ezihlukile kulolu hlobo) zatholwa, kanti kwinsimu ethile, izithombo zomkhiqizo wonyaka odlule zatholwa. Inani lezitshalo nendawo phakathi kwezithombo: esithombeni, akucacile ukuthi indawo phakathi kwezithombo ibukeka kanjani endaweni yokufunda, kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi kwinsimu ethile, izitshalo zikhudlwana kakhulu. Umhlahlandlela onenzuzo ukusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okuzokugcina uqine ngesikhathi ugula. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kubalulekile kubo bonke, kodwa uma uneguli ethile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukukhetha izinhlobo zokudla ngokuhlakanipha! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukudla okukhprovides umzimba wakho ngazo zonke izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze usebenze kahle futhi kusiza ukuvikela izifo. Izakhi ziyizinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukahlukene zezakhono ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi ama-proteins, ama-carbohydrates, amafutha, ama-vitamins, kanye nezimayini. Uma uneguli elingapheli (njenge-asthma, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela luyancipha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho awukwazi ukuvikela kahle ezifo njengokwakwenza phambilini. Uhlelo lokuvikela oluncishisiwe lungaholela ezifo emlonyeni, emaphashini, nasemathunjini. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzohlinzeka umzimba wakho ngezithako eziqinisa uhlelo lokuvikela ukuze luphikise izifo, kukunikeze umuzwa wokuba nempilo; futhi kukusize ujabulele impilo engcono. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzokusiza ukuphikisa izifo futhi kukuvumele ukuba ube nekhono elingcono uma uneguli. Izifo ezifana ne-asthma, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV zivame ukuholela emzimbeni ongenamafutha. Ukudla okungafanele kuholela ekunciphiseni uhlelo lokuvikela lomzimba, okwenza kube lula ukuba izifo zifake. Uma umuntu ebanjwe yi-virus ye-HIV, ukudla okungafanele kungaholela ngokushesha kwi-AIDS. Kukhona izinhlobo eziningi zokudla okunempilo ongakhetha kuzo. Umzimba wakho udinga ukudla okuhlukahlukene. Akukho ukudla okukodwa okuqukethe zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Khetha futhi ujabulele ukudla okutholakala kalula, okungathengwa futhi okuthandayo. Qaphela kakhulu ngalokho okudlayo uma usuwazi ukuthi uneguli ethile. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuphikisa izifo futhi kuvinjeze ukulahleka kwesisindo. Ukuze uthole konke okudingayo ekudleni kwakho, dlala ukudla okuhlukahlukene okungatholakala. Ukudla okuhlukahlukene kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Uma uthola kunzima ukudla okuningi, zama ukudla okuncane kaningi ngosuku ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla okwanele. Ukudla okune-starch njenge-bread, ama-potato, ama-cereal, irayisi, ama-sweet potato, ufulawa, kanye ne-pasta kufanele kube ingxenye enkulu yanoma iyiphi im meal. Ukudla okune-starch kuhlinzeka umzimba ngamandla nezinye izakhi ukuze usebenze kahle. Faka noma yiziphi ezinye izidlo ezifana nemifino, amabele, inkukhu, noma amaqanda ezidleni ezine-starch ukuze wenze isidlo esinambithekayo. Ukudla esikuthola ezilwaneni kuhlinzeka emzimbeni wethu ngezithako eziningi ezahlukene. Omunye wabo ngu-protein, osiza ukuqinisa uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela futhi wakhe izicubu eziqinile. Uma ugula, udinga kakhulu lezi zinto zokudla. Ushukela namafutha nawo ayingxenye yokudla okunempilo. Anika amandla extra ukuze ubhekane neziguli futhi enze ukudla kube mnandi. Kufanele sonke sizame ukusebenzisa usawoti omncane, ngoba usawoti omningi ungaholela ekwandeni kwegazi. Nokho, uma unokuhlanza noma uphume emlonyeni, ulahlekelwa usawoti nomoya omningi. Ukuphuza amanzi kubalulekile kithi sonke. Phuza amanzi amaningi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubuyisela amanzi alahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhlanza, ukuphuma emlonyeni, noma ukuvuvukala ebusuku. Amanzi aphuma emthonjeni, emfuleni, noma emathunjini kufanele aphekwelwe ngaphambi kokuwuphuza. Ungaphuzi noma yiziphi iziphuzo zothando. Iziphuzo zothando zihlupha umphimbo futhi zenza umzimba ulahlekelwe ama-vitamins avikela emizameni. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi ungaphuzi utshwala ngesikhathi uthatha imithi ngoba kungalimaza umphimbo wakho. Hlala usebenza ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze ugcine izicubu zakho ziqinile. Ukunyakaza komzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukuhlanza indlu, nokulima, kuzothuthukisa umuzwa wakho wokuba nempilo. Hamba njalo ugeza izandla zakho ngensipho ngaphambi nangemva kokuphatha ukudla. Hlanza zonke izinsiza nezindawo lapho ulungisa khona ukudla. Faka ukudla ukuze uvikeleke ekuthintweni yizinyoni nezilwane. Bheka usuku lokusebenzisa ezicini ozithengayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awuthengi ukudla okudlulelwe usuku lokuphelelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi awudli inyama, inkukhu, inhlanzi, noma amaqanda angaphekiwe. Pheka ukudla kahle ukuze ubulale amagciwane. Uma unomshini opholile, gcina konke ukudla okusele emshinini opholile noma ugcine kukhishwe endaweni epholile. Ukudla okuphekiwe akufanele kugcinwe ngaphezulu kosuku olulodwa futhi kufanele kuphumelelwe ngaphambi kokudliwa. Gcina ukudla endaweni epholile ngangokunokwenzeka. Zama ukungavumeli ukudla okuphekiwe ukuthi kube ngaphandle kokupholiswa isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora amabili. Ukudla okunempilo kuyinzuzo kubo bonke! Uma ugula, kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukubuyisela ngokushesha ezifo kusiza izilonda ziphumelele ngokushesha. Ukuphatha kahle nokusebenzisa imithi nokwelashwa.

Intela yesikhashana ikhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Inhloso yentela yesikhashana ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zabo zentela, kunokuba balinde ukukhokha kanye ngonyaka lapho isimo sabo sentela sihlolwa. Intela yesikhashana, uma ikhokhwa, isiza ukunciphisa inani lentela eliphelele okumele likhokhwe ekupheleni konyaka wentela uma imali ihlolwa, okumele ikhokhwe ngumuntu kulowo nyaka. Usuku lokugcina lokukhokha intela yesikhashana yesibili alukwazi ukuba sekwedlule ngosuku lokugcina lokwenza ukuhlolwa kwezimali noma ukuphela kwemali eyamukelekayo. Uma ukuphela konyaka wezezimali kuvela ngoFebhuwari, kuholela ezinkingeni zezimali, futhi imvume itholakala ku-SARS yokuthumela izitatimende zezimali ngosuku oluhlukile kunoFebhuwari, abantu abanjalo bangacela imvume yokuthumela izimpendulo zentela yesikhashana ngokuhambisana nokuphela kwemali eyamukelekayo. Yonke eminye imali kumele ithunyelwe ngaphambi kokuphela kokuhlolwa kwezimali okuphuma ngoFebhuwari 28/29. Inani lentela leminyaka ephelele likhishwa ngokukhipha intela ekhokhwe ngabasebenzi unyaka wonke kusuka kumkhawulo ovunyelwe wemali engenayo yonyaka ophelele, kuncishiswe nenani elikhokhiwe lesikhathi sokuqala sonyaka. Izinkokhelo zingakwenziwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi le-SARS, kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, phakathi kuka-08:00 ekuseni no-15:30 emini, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi. Uma ukhokha ngeposi noma usebenzisa i-ATM, ukukhokha kumele kwenziwe ngesikhathi sokuthi ifomu lakho lifike kusenesikhathi ehhovisi le-SARS. Uma ukhokha ngedijithali, lokhu kumele kwenziwe ngesikhathi sokunikeza ibhange lakho ithuba lokucubungula ukukhokha ngokushesha, futhi uhlole ukuthi kukhona imali eyanele akhawuntini yakho, njengoba lokhu kungathatha phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu. Inombolo yentela kumele ibe nezinombolo eziyishumi, futhi inombolo lapho imali izokwenziwa khona ibonisa i-akhawunti ezothola le mali. Noma iyiphi ukukhokha okwenziwayo akumele kuhambisane noma kuhlangane nalokho okubhalwe ngenhla, ngokuhambisana nenombolo yentela kanye nenombolo ye-akhawunti ethola, futhi ngeke yamukelwe. Uma usuku lokugcina lokukhokha lufika ezinsukwini zokuphumula noma ngempelasonto, abantu kumele bakhokhe ngosuku lokugcina lokusebenza ngaphambi kwezinsuku zokuphumula noma ngempelasonto. Ifomu le-IRP 6 lesibalo sesikhathi sesibili kumele lithunyelwe, noma ngabe ukubala kwakho kukhombisa ukuthi ngeke kudingeke ukukhokha intela yesikhashana. Ukuze ukhokhe intela yakho yesikhashana yesibili, kufanele uhlinzeke ngokuqagela kwemali engenayo okumele ukhokhe, okuhambisana nenani langempela noma ngokuhlinzeka ngemali ethile yonyaka okumele ukhokhe intela. Ungase udinge ukukhokha intela eyengeziwe uma ukuqagela kwakho kwemali engenayo kuncane kune-90% yemali yangempela, futhi kungase kube ngaphansi kwenani langempela. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafomu e-IRP6 athunyelwa ehhovisi le-SARS elifanele ngaphambi kokuthi wenze ukukhokha. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe ngesikhathi sokucubungula, futhi ngeke kudingeke izijeziso noma izintshisekelo. Imiyalelo yokukhokha ingxenye yentela efomini le-IRP6 manje itholakala kukhasi elihlukile. Ngakho-ke, ungathumela impendulo yakho yentela ngokuhlukile kulapho wenza khona ukukhokha. Umnyango wentela usungula izinga le-service elizokwenziwa eminyakeni emibili ezayo. Uma ucelwa omunye umuntu ukuba akusize ukuthumela impendulo yakho yentela, kubalulekile ukwazisa ihhovisi lezezimali likamasipala. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo bakho futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnyango wentela awukhulumi ngemininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu. Le sevisi ayikhokhelwa. Izitifiketi Zobungcweti Zabasebenzi Bakahulumeni Q1: Yini eyenza izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zibalulekile? A1: Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi bakahulumeni zibalulekile ngoba zikhombisa izinga lokufunda, amakhono, nezifundo ezenzakalayo zabasebenzi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abaqashwayo banamakhono adingekayo ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele. Izitifiketi ziyaqinisekisa izinga lokukhula kwemisebenzi, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi abasebenzi bazigxile ezindleleni zokuthuthuka. Q2: Zikuphi izindlela ezitholakalayo ukuze abalamuli basebenzi bakahulumeni bakwazi ukuthola lezi zitifiketi? A2: Ukuze abalamuli basebenzi bakahulumeni bakwazi ukuthola izitifiketi zobungcweti, badinga ukulandela izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, izifundo eziyimfihlo, noma izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhiqizwa nguhulumeni. Abasebenzi baphinde banezinketho zokubhalisela imikhosi yokubhalisela ukuthola lezi zitifiketi, ezitholakala ezikhungweni zomphakathi nasemaphandleni. Q3: Kungani umphakathi kumele unakele izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi? A3: Umphakathi kumele unakekele lezi zitifiketi ngoba zikhombisa ukuqhubekela phambili kwezokuphathwa kwezakhamuzi. Njengoba izikhungo zikahulumeni ziqhubeka nokwakha izinselelo ezenzakalayo, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi babe neziqu ezifanele. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa izinga lokusebenza kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ukwethembeka, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha emiphakathini. Q4: Yimiphi imiphumela emihle yokuba nezitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi? A4: Imiphumela emihle yokuba nezitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi ibandakanya ukukhushulwa kwemisebenzi, ukwandiswa kwemisebenzi, nokwandiswa kokuhlonishwa phakathi kwabasebenzi. Phela, izitifiketi zenza kube lula ukumisa izigonqo ezithile, okwakha kokubili ubuntu nokuhlonishwa enkampanini. Njengoba okutholakalayo kuncintisana, izitifiketi zifaka isandla ekwandiseni amathuba okuthola imisebenzi. Q5: Kukhona okungadlalelwa phansi uma kungekho izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi? A5: Yebo, ukungabi ne zitifiketi zobungcweti kungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okukhula, ukungasebenzi kahle, nokungahleleki kokuqashwa. Abasebenzi bangase benze izinqumo ezingalungile, akukhuthazi ukholo phakathi kwabantu, futhi kungenza khona izinkinga emsebenzini. Lokhu kwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zikahulumeni ziphakamise futhi zikhuthaze izinyathelo zokuthuthuka. Q6: Abasebenzi bakahulumeni bangabhalisela izitifiketi zabo zakamuva kanjani? A6: Abasebenzi bangabhalisela izitifiketi zabo zakamuva ngokuxhumana nezikhungo zabo, noma ukuhamba ezinhlelweni ezisemthethweni ezivunywa uhulumeni. Ukubhalisela izifundo ezihlongozwayo, ukulandela awọn imfuneko zokubhaliswa, nokuhlola izinhlelo zokuhlola, zonke lezi izinyathelo ezibalulekile. Ukuze kwenziwe kahle, kumele kube nekhono lokuphatha isikhathi nokuhlonipha izinqubo zokugcina. Q7: Yimaphi amakheli ezinkampani eziphethe izitifiketi zobungcweti? A7: Amakheli ezinkampani eziphethe izitifiketi zobungcweti zingabekwa kwi-inthanethi. Lokhu kusebenza njengokukhumbuza abashayeli bemisebenzi nezikhungo zomphakathi ngesidingo sokubhaliswa okuqhubekayo. Izikhungo ezifana nezikole zokuqeqesha zisebenza njengamanxusa wesikhungo sokufunda, futhi ziya hintela embhalweni wokuhlola, okungafaka ukwakha isithombe esihle somphakathi. Q8: Uhlelo lokuthola izitifiketi zobungcweti lungabhekeleka kanjani esikhathini se-digital? A8: Uhlelo lokuthola izitifiketi zobungcweti lungashintsha kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi se-digital. Ukuze kube lula ukufunda, abalamuli bangaqala izinhlelo zokufunda online, okuvumela ukuvuleka kwezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuvumela baphakathi kwezikhula nezitifiketi ezingaphezukokutholakala emotweni. Ukuze kuvunyelwe izimpela, izinsizakalo zothethathethwano eziku-inthanethi nazo zidingwa. Q9: Yini engathuthukisa izitifiketi zobungcweti zabasebenzi basemphakathini? A9: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izitifiketi zobungcweti, umsebenzi kufanele uhambisane nezinqubomgomo ezilungile, izinhloso, nomthethosisekelo. Imfundiso eyodwa iyafuneka ukuze umphakathi uthole izinzuzo ezenzakalayo. Ukuhlinzekela izinsiza ezinhle zokuthuthuka, izikhungo zokuqeqesha, nezezimali ezitholwayo kuyaqoqwa ukuze kuqhubeke kulandela izinkanyezi. Q10: Singabhalela kanjani indawo yokusebenza ukuze sibe yindawo elungiselelwe izitifiketi? A10: Ukuze sibe yindawo yokusebenza efanelekile kwezokweluleka, abasebenzi badinga ukwakha ibhodi yezinsizakusebenza, baphinde bakhuthaze ukufunda kwabo. Ukuze bazikhumbuze, kudinga ukufakwa izinhlelo ezisemthethweni zokukhuthaza imisebenzi. Kuyaqabukela ukuhlela izinsuku zokuhlanganyela, izithangami, nokutshala inhlonipho phakathi kwabantu kulesi sikhungo. Ngokusebenzisa le mikhombiso, abalamuli bangahola phambili ukuze bathokozise izimpumelelo zabo. Izitifiketi zobungcweti zabeBantu kubalulekile ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle, ukuzithuthukisa, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
iShoprite Isingeniso I-Shoprite Holdings Limited iyinkampani edume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuqhuba inethiwekhi enkulu yezitolo ezithengisa ukudla nezinsiza eziphathelene nokuphila kwansuku zonke. Le nkampani, esunguliwe ngonyaka ka-1979, isiza ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini engaphansi komnotho. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka imisebenzi ye-Shoprite, izinzuzo zayo emphakathini, nemigomo yezenhlalo nezoqoqosho ehlangene nebhizinisi. Ukwakhiwa KweShoprite I-Shoprite yaqala njengethuluzi lokusebenza kwezemali, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, yanda kakhulu futhi yaphinde yathuthukisa imikhiqizo yasekhaya. Uhlobo oluhloniphekile lwe-Shoprite lwandisa imikhiqizo etholakalayo, okuhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, izinkwa, kanye nezinye izinsiza. Ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezikhiqizayo, i-Shoprite ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo yezezimali, yenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwabathengi abavela ezingeni elihlukene lempilo. Le nkampani, ngaleso sikhathi, isungule amafiliyal esiteshi esiphezulu, lapho othintana nabo bengahlanganyela khona imikhiqizo eyahlukahlukene. Ubuhle BeShoprite Emphakathini Ibanga lokuhweba le-Shoprite alikhulisi nje kuphela inani lemisebenzi, kodwa futhi lithuthukisa umphakathi lapho likhanya khona. Ngenxa yokwandisa izitolo ezikwiindawo ezihlukene, ibhizinisi le-Shoprite libe nezinyathelo ezithile zokwakha umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi eminingi, ezindleleni ezihamba phambili, kanye nemihlangano yokwakha imiphakathi. Ezinye izinhlelo ze-Shoprite zifaka izifundo zokulima, ezokwakhiwa kwezimali, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelulwa kwezidingo zabathengi abancane. Lawa maphrojekthi ayasiza ukwakha umnotho wezwe, okukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuze ibambe iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Izimiso Zezenhlalo Nezomnotho Ngenkathi i-Shoprite ihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile emphakathini, ibhizinisi layo linaso nesibopho sokuhlala sithobela izimiso zezenhlalo nezomnotho. I-Shoprite igcizelela umgomo wokuba yinkampani ethokozisayo, enesibopho, futhi ekhuthaza ukusizakala kokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusiza izinhlelo zokuphila eziphephile, ukunciphisa imfucumfucu, nokuqinisa umoya wobumbano phakathi kwezabasebenzi. Ngale ndlela, i-Shoprite iyazama ukuhlinzeka ngezenzo ezilungile kubathengi bayo, nokuqinisa ukuthi iyinkampani engathokoziswa ngabo bonke. Ukuqhubeka Nokuthuthuka Ngesikhathi i-Shoprite iqhubeka nokwandisa ibhizinisi layo, ibhekelele kakhulu izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvuselela izinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokuphila, imikhankaso yokuvikela imvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa umphakathi. I-Shoprite ibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuphothulweni kwezinhlelo zokwakha imiphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezingxenyeni ezisemadolobheni. Futhi, ukuze iqhubeke nokufinyelela izingqikithi zayo, ibhizinisi lenza izinhlelo ezinhle zokuhweba ezinqwabelanayo nezokuzinakekela, okuhlobene nezidingo ezishiwo ngababheki bemikhiqizo. Isiphetho I-Shoprite iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ibhizinisi lingakwazi kanjani ukuhlanganisa umnotho nokusebenza kwezenhlalo. Ngaleyo ndlela, le nkampani ithuthukisa imiphakathi, isekela imisebenzi, futhi inikela ngothando nokuqwashisa ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Ukube i-Shoprite ikwazi ukugcina le mikhuba, izokwazisa imiphakathi eminingi, iqhubeke ibe yisikhumbuzo sokuqala sokusiza umphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Shoprite izobamba iqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezohwebo, ibaluleke kakhulu emqoka wempilo yomphakathi, ibonisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lingaphandle kokuhweba futhi lingahamba phambili ekuqedeni izinkinga zomphakathi. Lokhu kwenza i-Shoprite ibe yinkampani engaphezu kokuhweba; iyinqwaba yezenzo ezenza umphakathi ungeze isimo esihlanganyele sokwakha umnotho osebenzayo.
Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhola abaholi bendabuko emsebenzini wabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphathwa kokwahlulela kufezwa kahle kakhulu lapho bephatha njengezikhulu ezifungile futhi basungula izinqubo ezidingekayo ezimele zilandelwe ekuphathweni kwemifungo noma ukuqinisekiswa, ukuthathwa kwemifungo esemthethweni noma eqinisekisiwe, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo. a Amandla okugebenga ngaphandle kwesikhwama: umuntu ophula umthetho noma ozama ukuphula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi uzophuma ekuboshweni okusemthethweni; umuntu otholakale enezinsiza zokweba noma/nomathuluzi okweba imoto; umuntu otholakale enezinto ezikholakala ukuthi zibe zebiwe noma otholakale ezimweni eziphazamisa; umuntu otholakale ebusuku ezimweni ezikhuphula ukungabaza ukuthi uphule umthetho noma uzophula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi ubevele ebanga izinkomo, njll. b Amandla okusebenzisa isikhwama sokubamba. Bonke abaholi bendabuko bangabaphathi bezokuthula, ngakho-ke ngenxa yezikhundla zabo (ex officio) - bangizikhulu ezifungile. Ngenxa yesikhundla sabo - isikhulu esifungile ngumuntu, ngenxa yesikhundla sabo noma isikhundla, okwenza kube isikhulu esifungile ngokuzenzakalelayo. Lapho abanye abantu kufanele bafake isicelo kuNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo ukuze baphathwe njengezikhulu ezifungile, lo muntu akafaki isicelo. Uma izikhulu ezifungile zikhishwa ngamakhasi okuphathwa, ngenxa yesikhundla sabo isikhulu esifungile asidingi iphepha, njengoba sinesitifiketi sesikhundla noma isikhundla. Isikhulu esifungile sithunyelwa endaweni ethile futhi sisebenza kule ndawo lapho sithunyelwe khona. Indima yesikhulu esifungile ukusiza amalungu omphakathi wendawo ngokuphatha imifungo noma ukuqinisekiswa noma ukwenza isimemezelo esifungile kumuntu ongena. Enye imisebenzi yesikhulu esifungile ukuqinisekisa amakhophi emibhalo njengamakhophi aqinile wemibhalo yokuqala. Akukho imali ekhokhwayo yokuphatha imifungo noma ukuqinisekiswa, ukuqinisekisa isimemezelo, noma ukuqinisekisa imibhalo. Isikhulu esifungile asivunyelwe ukuphatha imfuno noma ukuqinisekiswa okuhlobene nendaba enomsebenzi wabo. Isizathu ukuthi umuntu oqinisekisa i-affidavit kumele abe ngumuntu ongahlangene futhi ongenawo umqondo endabeni equkethwe kwi-affidavit ukuze umuntu oqinisekisa akwazi ukuba free kunoma yisiphi umthelela wendaba equkethwe kwi-affidavit. Lo msebenzi owenziwa yisikhulu esifungile unciphisa isidingo sokuthi abantu bahambe ngezindawo ezinde ukuya eziteshini zamaphoyisa eziseduze noma ezikhungweni zezimali ukuze bafune usizo. Uma umholi bendabuko, ngenxa yemisebenzi okufanele ayenze noma ezinye izizathu, engakwazi ukusebenza njengezikhulu ezifungile, umphakathi noma noma yimuphi umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe umholi bendabuko angaba isikhulu esifungile kule ndawo, kuphela ngokuphathwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Amafomu wesicelo (J5) atholakala ehhovisi lemagistrate. Le fomu inamakhasi ayisithupha. Amakhasi amahlanu okuqala kumele agcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo, kanti ikhasi lokugcina lidinga ummagistrate ukuthi agcwalisise iziphakamiso mayelana nesicelo. Ngokomthetho, lokhu kusho ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uzoba nezingxoxo zemibuzo nommagistrate, ezihlelwe nguMphakathi Wenkantolo Yomphakathi. Lapho kukhona umphakathi wombhali wezimali noma omunye umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe umholi bendabuko, kubalulekile ukuba kube nephepha lokuphakamisa elibhalwe ngumholi bendabuko ukuze lihambisane nesicelo. Umagistrate uzothumela ifomu lesicelo kanye nephepha lokuphakamisa kwiMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Abasebenzi beMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo bazobheka isicelo kuze kube isikhathi sokubonisana sitholakala nguNgqongqoshe/Ngqongqoshe noma abameli babo, okujwayelekile kubandakanya amalungu eMnyango ezikhundleni eziphakeme. Isitifiketi sizothunyelwa emuva kumagistrate ozosithumela kumfaki-sicelo. Umuntu oqinisekisa (umuntu owenze i-affidavit) angaya esikhungweni esifungile ne-affidavit ukuze afunge noma aqinisekise. Nokho, uma kukhona ukungabaza mayelana nemfuno njengoba kutholwe ngumthetho; futhi iii Uma imfuno ethathwe ngumthetho ibonwa njengokubopha enhliziyweni yabo. Imfuno ethathwe ngokomthetho yenziwa ngumuntu ofungayo ethi lezi zisho ezilandelayo: "Ngifunga ukuthi okuqukethwe kule affidavit kuyikho, uNkulunkulu angisize." Umuntu ofungayo uzocelwa ukuba uphakamise isandla sakhe sokunene ukuze afunge. Uma umuntu ofungayo evuma ukuthi uqonda okuqukethwe kulokho afungayo futhi utshele isikhulu esifungile ukuthi baphikisa imfuno noma ukuthi ababona imfuno njengokubopha enhliziyweni yabo, isikhulu esifungile sizokwenza ukuqinisekiswa. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenziwa ngumuntu ofungayo ethi lezi zisho ezilandelayo: "Ngiyiqiniso ngiqinisekisa ukuthi okukhuluma kuyikho." Umuntu ofungayo kumele asayine lokho akufungayo phambi kwesikhulu esifungile. Uma umuntu ofungayo engakwazi ukubhala, kumele abeke uphawu ekupheleni kwezwi afungayo. Uma isikhulu esifungile siba nezehlakalo zokungakwazi komuntu ofungayo ukubhala, kuzodingeka lokhu kuqinisekiswe ngaphansi kwezwi ofungayo ngomunye umuntu onokwethenjelwa. Ngemuva kokuthi umuntu ofungayo esayine noma abeke uphawu, isikhulu esifungile sizokwenza ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi umuntu ofungayo uvumile ukuthi bangakwazi futhi baqonde okuqukethwe kwezwi ofungayo futhi bazokhuluma indawo, indawo, nosuku lokwenza imfuno. Isikhulu esifungile sizosayina imfuno futhi sibhale igama lazo eliphelele kanye ne-adresi yomsebenzi phansi kokusayina kwabo, futhi sisho nesikhundla sabo nendawo lapho bekwazi khona noma ihhovisi abakhona. "Adresi yomsebenzi" ibonisa ikheli langempela hhayi ikheli leposi. Izikhwama ezifanele zikhona ukuze zisize izikhulu ezifungile ekwenzeni imfuno noma ukuqinisekiswa ngaphandle kokulibazisa. Ikhophi yemibhalo okufanele iqinisekiswe njengekhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala kumele iqhathaniswe nemibhalo yokuqala futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le mibhalo emibili iyafana. Uma isikhulu esifungile saneliseka ukuthi ikhophi iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi akukho okukhombisa ukuthi imibhalo yokuqala ishintshiwe ngabantu abangagunyaziwe, isikhulu esifungile kumele libhale ukuthi liqinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi akukho okukhombisa ukuthi imibhalo yokuqala ishintshiwe ngabantu abangagunyaziwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, isikhulu esifungile kumele sibhale futhi sibhale igama labo, isikhundla, imininingwane yokuxhumana, nosuku. Izikhwama ezifanele zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe imibhalo. Uma imfuno noma ukuqinisekiswa kungenziwa kahle njengoba kutholwe ngumthetho, khona-ke le ndaba iyothunyelwa enkantolo, i-affidavit izobhekwa njengeyinqaba futhi ingaba nemiphumela emibi, njengokuthi ezimweni zobugebengu, kuholele ekukhululweni komsolwa. Uma isikhulu esifungile sibona ukuthi
Isaziso Sezinsuku Ezingama-30 Ngamazinga Ezinguquko Empilweni (GEMS 30-day Notification for Life Changes) Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, impilo yethu iyashintsha, futhi lezi zinguquko zingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ukuze sikwazi ukuphatha lezi zinguquko ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezaziso ezicacile nezihlelelekile. Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 ngezinguquko empilweni, esikhuluma ngaso lapha, sihlose ukusiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izinguquko ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo yabo, futhi banikeze isikhathi esanele sokulungiselela. Ukuqonda Izinguquko Empilweni Izinguquko empilweni zingaba eziningi, zifaka phakathi ukushintsha kwemisebenzi, izimo zokuhlala, noma izinguquko ezithinta ubudlelwano. Lezi zinguquko zingaba nemiphumela emihle noma emibi, kuye ngokuthi ziqhutshwa kanjani. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinqumo ezicacile, ezihlelwe kahle, ukuze sikwazi ukuphila kahle phakathi nalezi zinguquko. Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 sikhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabangele kahle izinqumo zabo, ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi izinguquko ezizayo zizothinta kanjani impilo yabo. Isikhathi Sokulungiselela Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 sinikeza abantu ithuba lokulungiselela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umuntu ethola isaziso sokuthi kuzoba nezinguquko empilweni yakhe, unethuba lokucabanga, ukuhlela, nokwenza izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze abhekane nalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kungaba ukufuna ulwazi oluthe xaxa, ukuxhumana nabanye abantu abanolwazi, noma ukuhlela izinhlelo ezithile zokuphila. Isikhathi esinikezwa sikhuthaza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ezizokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinguquko ezizayo. Ukwaziswa Nokuxhumana Enye yezinto ezibalulekile ezithinta izinguquko empilweni wukuxhumana. Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 sikhuthaza abantu ukuba baxhumane nabanye, babonise imizwa yabo, futhi babelane ngemicabango. Lokhu kungaba ngokuxhumana nomndeni, abangane, noma ochwepheshe. Ukwaziswa kahle kungasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izinguquko ezizayo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ekuphatheni kwabo lezi zinguquko. Ukuxhumana kahle kungasiza ekwakheni uxolo nokuthula phakathi kwabantu, okubalulekile uma kuziwa ezinguqukweni ezinzima. Ukubhekana Nezinkinga Izinguquko empilweni zingaholela ezinkingeni ezahlukene, futhi kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezindlela zokubhekana nazo. Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 sikhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabangele izinkinga ezingase zivele, futhi bahlele izixazululo. Lokhu kungaba ukufuna usizo, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, noma ukuhlela izinyathelo ezithile zokuphila. Ukubhekana nezinkinga ngendlela efanele kungasiza abantu ukuba baphumelele ezinguqukweni ezinzima, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Ukukhula Nokuthuthuka Ngaphezu kokubhekana nezinkinga, izinguquko empilweni zingaba nethuba lokukhula nokuthuthuka. Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 sikhuthaza abantu ukuba babheke lezi zinguquko njengamathuba okukhula. Lokhu kungaba ukufunda izinto ezintsha, ukuthola amakhono amasha, noma ukujula emqondweni. Ukukhula nokuthuthuka kungasiza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ekuphileni kwabo. Isiphetho Isaziso sezinsuku ezingama-30 ngezinguquko empilweni sikhombisa indlela yokuphila enempilo, enobuhlakani, futhi enobuhlakani. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezaziso ezicacile, sithathe isikhathi sokulungiselela, sixhumane nabanye, futhi sibe nezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga. Ngale ndlela, singenza izinguquko empilweni zibe yithuba lokukhula, ukuthuthuka, nokuphila impilo enempilo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinguquko ezizayo, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yethu. Ngakho-ke, masithathe lezi zinguquko njengamathuba, futhi sibe nesibindi sokubhekana nazo.
Thatha isinqumo sokuthi yiziphi izilwane ozothengisa nokuthi uzothengisa ngani. Ukuhlela lezi zilwane ngokuhlukanisa kuqondwa ngokweminyaka, isisindo, impilo, ukulimala, kanye nobulili. Umuntu osiza ngezokuthengisa angakusiza ukuhlukanisa lezi zilwane. Xhumana nomthengisi ukuze ubuze ngamanani nezindlela zokuthengisa. Nikeza ulwazi olufanele mayelana nekhwalithi nokuhlukaniswa, isimo sokuwela, isisindo, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, inani lemali lemfuyo yakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imfuyo yakho inophawu lokukhomba olusemthethweni. Hlela ukuhamba. Thola isitifiketi sokuhamba esivela kwiSigaba Sokweba Imfuyo sendawo. Ngaphandle kwalezi zimpapasho, ungase uthole isijeziso noma imfuyo yakho ingase ibanjwe. Gcwalisa ifomu lokwamukela ngegama lakho, ikheli, indawo, kanye nemininingwane yokukhomba imfuyo. Qonda ukuthi imfuyo yakho isekhaya lakho futhi unomthwalo wemfanelo ngayo. Ukuhweba kuphela uma uthi "ithengisiwe." Qedela inqubo yokuthengisa. Yenza isitatimende sokukhulula imfuyo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ilungile. Ukukhokha kungaba ngemali noma ngecheki. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane ku-cheki ilungile. Indlela ephephile wukuthi imali yakho ibhange kwi-akhawunti yakho yasebhange. Umthengi udinga incwadi yokukhulula etholakala kwiSigaba Sokweba Imfuyo ukuze athwale imfuyo. Kuyaqondakala ukuya esigabeni ngaphambi kokuthengisa imfuyo yakho okokuqala. Noma hamba nomuntu oseke waya khona. Khuluma ngesilinganiso esifanele sesilwane ngaphambi kokuhamba uye esigabeni. Indawo yokuphawu lokukhomba olusemthethweni. I-tattoo ibekwe endlebeni yesobunxele noma yesokudla. Ukubhalwa kwenziwa enyameni yangemuva nasemahlombe.
Uma umphenduli ephula i-Protection Order ngokuphindaphindiwe ehlasela ngokomzimba noma ngokuqhuba ngendlela echazwe ekuqaleni kwalolu documet, ungafaka isikhalazo emaphoyiseni bese unikeza i-Warrant of Arrest emaphoyiseni azobamba umphenduli. Isinqumo sokusebenzisa i-Warrant of Arrest ngemuva kokuphulwa kwe-Order sisonke. Ungafaka isicelo sokuthi i-Order yakho ikhanselwe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kodwa umphakathi ubonisa ukuthi i-Affidavit akufanele ikhanselwe noma cha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-Protection Order izobhekwa njengengasebenzi. Umthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwangaphakathi 116 ka-1998 uvumela umonakalo wokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi ukuba ufune i-Protection Order eNkantolo yeMagistrate ngokumelene nomonakalo. Inhloso yale Mhlahlandlela ukuhlinzeka umonakalo ngemininingwane abayidingayo ukuze bafake isicelo se-Protection Order ngokuhambisana nomthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwangaphakathi. Bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa bangaba abahlukunyezwayo futhi bangaba nabahlaseli ezimweni zokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi. Nokho, ngenhloso yale Mhlahlandlela, sikhombisa ukuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi okuhlobene nabesifazane ngoba lokhu kuyinto evamile kakhulu. Lokhu kusebenza kumuntu owabelana naye ngephromise yokushada, ubudlelwano bendabuko, noma ubudlelwano bokuphola, okubandakanya ubudlelwano bokuthandana obukhona noma obubonwa, okubandakanya umuntu owabelane naye ngendlu noma osanda kwabelana naye ngendawo yokuhlala. Le ndaba ingabambezeleka ngosuku oluthile lokubakhona enkantolo. Umqondisi weNkantolo uzokweseka noma akuholele kumuntu ozokwenza ukukubhalela impendulo. Ngosuku lokulalela, ummagistrate uzozama ukwenza isinqumo ngokusekelwe kuma-Affidavit afakwe yizigaba zombili. Umagistrate angacela omunye wenu noma bobabili ukuba baphendule ngezinkinga ezithile. Umagistrate angakwenza isinqumo sokuvuma i-Order futhi akhanselwe i-Order futhi aqinisekise ukuthi ubufakazi bukhulunywa. Ingabe umphenduli uzobanjwa ukuze i-Protection Order? Umphenduli ngeke abanjwe uma ethola i-Protection Order. Yini i-Contempt of Court? Lokhu kwenzeka uma umphenduli engahambisani ne-Order, noma ehluleka ukuvela eNkantolo yezeMpi ukuze aphendule ezinsolweni ezibhekiswe kuye. Uma ucabanga ukuthi ungaba umonakalo nganoma iyiphi indlela yokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla, hamba uye eNkantolo yeMagistrate eduze bese ucela usizo lokuthi ufake isicelo se-Protection Order. Umqondisi weNkantolo uzokusiza ugcwalise amafomu adingekayo futhi akuthumele phambi kommagistrate ozokwenza isinqumo sokuthi ukukwenzela i-Order noma cha. Ulwazi ngababoneleli bezinsizakalo abangakweluleka ngalesi sihloko lunikezwa ekuqaleni kwalolu Mhlahlandlela. Umqondisi weNkantolo uzokusiza uqedele amafomu adingekayo futhi akuthumele phambi kommagistrate. Yikuphi ukwakha okufanele ngiye kuyo? Hamba uye enkantolo eduze lapho uhlala khona noma ubenza khona. Uma uphume emzini owuhlala ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa futhi uphila kwesinye isikhathi kwenye indawo, ungaya enkantolo eduze nalapho uphila khona kwesikhashana. I-Protection Order yesikhashana izocela umphenduli (uhlukunyezwayo) ukuthi angakuhlukumezi ngendlela echazwe kwi-Affidavit yakho. Ezimweni ezinzima kakhulu, ummagistrate angathola ukuthi kubalulekile ukuvumela umphenduli ukuba ahambe endlini ababelana ngayo nawe noma avimbele ukuba angene ezindaweni ezithile zendlu ababelana ngayo nawe. Uma izingane zihlukunyezwa, iNkantolo ingaqinisekisa ukuthi umphenduli akavumi ukubona izingane nhlobo noma abe nezikhathi ezithile zokubona. INkantolo ingakhupha i-oda yokusiza kwezimali ngokuphuthumayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma udinga ukufaka isicelo sokukhokha izindleko zezokwelapha noma izindleko zokuhlala ezivela ngokuqondile ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa, kufanele uhlinzeke ngobufakazi bezindleko ezitholakele bese uceli iNkantolo ukuthi icabangele lesi sicelo. INkantolo ingalayisha amaphoyisa ukuba athathe isibhamu somphenduli uma benze noma yiziphi izinsongo empilweni yakho. Ukuze kuphendulwe ngokugcwele uhlobo oluthile lokuhlukunyezwa okukhuluma ngalo, iNkantolo ithembele kwi-Affidavit owakwenze lapho ufaka isicelo. I-Protection Order yesikhashana kufanele ihanjiswe kumphenduli (uhlukunyezwayo) ngokushesha okukhulu. Awukwazi ukuya wedwa ukuhlinzeka umphenduli nge-Protection Order njengoba lokhu kungaba yindlela engafanele yokwenza lo msebenzi ngokomthetho, okusho ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe ngamaPhoyisa. Kufanele uhlinzeke i-Protection Order yesikhashana ehhovisi le-Sheriff noma endaweni yokuphumula eduze kwendlu yomphenduli noma endaweni yokusebenza. Emaphoyiseni, uyacelwa ukuthi ukhumbule ukubhala phansi igama kanye/noma inombolo ye-badge yomphakathi okukhombisa i-Order. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuba ulandele i-Order kalula esikhathini esizayo. Emaphoyiseni amaningi kukhona umphakathi oqokwe ukukhandlela izindaba zokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi. Hlela namaphoyisa ukuqoqa i-Return of Service (Ubufakazi Bokuhlinzeka). Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi i-Protection Order ihanjiswe kumphenduli futhi ukuthi lowo muntu uyamukela ngokwakhe. Awukwazi kulindele ukuthi amaphoyisa athumele noma athumele i-Return of Service enkantolo njengoba lokhu kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi akufiki enkantolo ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyisela.
Umlando Wokhetho Luka-1994 Ngonyaka wezi-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yahamba emzuliswaneni omkhulu wokuguqulwa, lapho izakhamizi zokuqala zavuza amalungelo azo okukhetha. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko esiyingqayizivele embhalweni wezwe, njengoba izimpande zalesi sikhathi ziqhamuka emlandweni onzima we-apartheid. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinguquko, kubalulekile ukubheka izizathu, izinyathelo, kanye nemiphumela yokhetho luka-1994. Ukhetho lwezi-1994 lwakhelwe phezu kokubambisana phakathi kwezixazululo ezizayo ezazisemqoka, lapho abaholi bezenkolo nezombusazwe behlanganyela, kanti uNelson Mandela, owayengumholi we-ANC, waba yisithonjana sokuphakanyiswa kwamalungelo abantu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuhlupheka, imibhikisho, kanye nezinkulumo, kwavulwa indlela yokuthuthukisa izifunda ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngaphambi kokhetho, izinsuku zixhunywe nezinqola zokukhulumisana, ezaqhakambisa imikhankaso yokuvota. Abantu bebebonisa imizwa emihle, behambele izikhangiso eziningi ezazihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bezehlakalo nokuxhaswa kwemikhankaso. Lokhu kwaba ithuba lokuvumela izakhamizi ukuthi zikhulume ndawonye, zishintshe imibono, nezinsiza zokwazisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izifundo ezithathwe ezinyangeni ezingama-90, zaveza izinkinga ezinzima ezazithinta umphakathi. Kwakusobala ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yayidinga uhlelo oluhlangene ukuze ibhekane nokuphikisana okuvuthayo kokuhlukana phakathi kwezinhlanga. Ukubambisana kwezombusazwe, okwakuhlanganisa abaholi bezenhlalakahle, abanye bezakhamuzi, nesikhumbuzo sokuhlukaniswa, kwavula indlela yokwenza ibhande lesikhathi esisha, nawe ngaleso sikhathi, ubuhlobo. Izwe laseNingizimu Afrika lavuleka ezindleleni zokuvota, lapho uphiko lwe-ANC lwamukela imiphumela emihle yomsebenzi walo maqondana nokuhlonishwa kwamaqiniso emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwaba yisigameko, ngoba kwabeyisisekelo sokuguqulela ubuholi obufanele somnqamulajuqu, njengoba uMandela esebenza khona phezulu. Ngokwecala lokhetho, abasebenzi bezeNhlangano yezenzakalo zomphakathi baphakanyiswe ukuziphatha ngendlela efanele, njengoba izikhumbuzo zomlando zanezela udumo emithonjeni yezenzakalo. Umthelela wokhetho luka-1994 wawuphakeme, kuwukuphuma ebuhlungwini bokuhlukumeza, kwavula umnyango wokujabulela imiphumela yokuthula nothando. Kubalulekile ukusikhumbula ukuthi, nakuba izigameko zokhetho zibe nomphumela omuhle, umsebenzi omningi wawusafaneleka, njengoba sahlasela imikhakha eyisicefe, njengezikhala ezisemthethweni ngezinkinga zobuhlanga. Ngokwezimali zomphakathi, kube nomuzwa ophakathi, nobulunga buphakanyiswe kwazulu. Abahlala endaweni yokuxhumana nokuxhumana kumsingathi bazi ukuthi ukhetho lwabathakathi luhamba phambili. Ukwenza kube ngcono izwe, ububha obunje neholi ezingahambisani nezindinganiso nokuziphatha ngendlela efanele, kwaqhamuka izinselele ezintsha. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokuxoxisana phakathi kwezihlahla, phakathi kwezinhlangano ezihlukene nezabaqhamuki. Ukuhweba ngezihlahla ezihlukene, njengezinkampani eziphila ngamafutha, zihlala zibhalwe emlandweni, njengomoya omusha wokuhweba. Njengoba imizamo yokwakha iNingizimu Afrika engcono iqhuba, kube khona ubunzima obukhulu, kodwa ubudlelwano bomhlaba bobabili - iNingizimu Afrika nezinye izizwe - buphinde buqinise umphakathi. Uhlelo lwezokuxhumana lwathela imiphumela emihle, nezinkampani ezibhekele ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe zavula amasango emisha. Umphakathi ungabuyiselwa emlandweni, njengoba ubuholi bukaMandela, kanye nezindlela zokuhlanganisa, zakhuthaza izinkulumo eziqinile ngemiphakathi emibini. Imisebenzi yokuphakanyiswa kokuhlalisana phakathi kwezizwe yayiphakamisa umoya wokuhlanganyela, lokho kube yisisekelo sokwakha isizwe esiqinile. Ekupheleni, ukhetho luka-1994 lwalungasenza sikhumbule ngezehlakalo ezimqoka, ukuze sithuthukise iziyaluyalu zomphakathi. Lolu hlelo luchaza umbono, lapho umuntu ngamunye ethatha isikhumbuzo sokuqala sokuhola, asize ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika esebenzayo. Izakhamizi zanikezwa ithuba lokuba yizakhamizi zomhlaba, nokubakhumbuza ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhanya ngempela uma zisebenza ndawonye.
Izinselelo ze-Acid Mine Drainage eGauteng Ukwakhiwa kwemigodi eGauteng kuthole indawo enezinhlobonhlobo zokugcina nezimfuno zomnotho, kodwa kwaholela nasezinselelweni ezinkulu, lapho i-acid mine drainage (AMD) ingesinye sezinkinga eziphambili. I-AMD ibonakala ngokukhipha amanzi anokungcola okubangela acid, okuphuma emigodini emikhulu yokumba. Lokhu kuqhamuka ngokumayelana nokwakheka kwamaminerali, ikakhulukazi lapho uwoyela, umhlaba, nezinye izinto ziwandiswa, okwandisa ukukhululeka kwe-acid kulawa manzi. Izakhiwo Zeziqu zikaMhlaba I-Gauteng iyindawo ekhangayo yokumba amaminerali, ikakhulukazi i-gold ne-platinum. Ukumba kwezakhiwo zomhlaba kuveza ama-rainfall acids, ahlwanyela umhlaba, ahlangene nezinsiza ezithile ezifana ne-sulfides. Lapho lezi zinsiza ziguqulwa, i-sulfuric acid ikhiqizwa, okukhuthaza ukuqhathaniswa kwe-acid mine drainage. Lokhu kuthinta izindawo eziningi eziseduzane, kubangela ukonakala kwemifula, imifula, nezinsiza zamanzi. Imiphumela Emibi Imiphumela ye-AMD ibonakala kulwazi olulungile nolungahlanzeki, okuthinta imvelo, impilo yomphakathi, nezenzo zomnotho. I-acid mine drainage ibangela ukushoda kwezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane nezitshalo, okwandisa izinga le-acid emanzini, okwenza kube nzima ukuphila kwezinto eziphilayo ezisondelene. Imininingwane iyakhombisa ukuthi, lapho i-phosphate ne-nitrate ziphathwa ngamandla, i-AMD ingabhekana nezibalo eziningi zezimali ezingabalulekile ezindaweni ezikhatheleyo. Lokhu kuholela ekubeni izitshalo zihlale zibuthakathaka, futhi kwezimbobo ezithile, imiphumela ibangela ukungcoliswa okungapheli kwezinhlaka zemvelo. Izinkinga Zokuphatha Amanzi Ukubhekana ne-AMD kudinga izindlela ezibucayi zokuphatha amanzi. Ukulawula amanzi angcoliswe yi-acid kudinga izinqumo eziqondile zokuhlanzeka. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lamazinga amanzi, izinhlelo zokuqinisa izinsiza zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. Nokho, izigaba zikahulumeni azilungile, futhi lapho izinsiza ezinokwenzeka zikhona, zikhona izithiyo zokwenza ikusasa eliqinile. Lokhu kudinga ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo eziqinile, ezingafaka izigaba zokuhlola, ukugcina izimpahla, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabavikelayo bemvelo nezokuphepha. Izinhlaka Ezakhiwe Zokulawula Izincwadi zomthetho eNingizimu Afrika zikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, njengoba umthetho wezokuphila komuntu udinga ukuba ubhekele ezokuhlala komphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo zikhombisa ukuba khona kwezindlela zokukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabavikelayo bemvelo, abakwaMnyango wezamaMali, nezinkampani ezisebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukwakha imigudu esatyhidwa yokuvikela ama-acid mine drainage, kanye nezindlela zokuphelezela nezinyathelo ezithinta imiphakathi yendawo. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukuze kuqedwe i-AMD, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele ziqhutshekwe. Lokhu kubandakanya: 1. Ukuqwashisa: Umphakathi kufanele uqwashiswe ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze abantwana nezizukulwane ezizayo bazi ngemiphumela emibi. 2. Ukwakha Izinhlelo Zokuphepha: Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle zokuphatha amanzi, ngokwelula izinsiza zomphakathi kuma-pipeline ahlanzekile. 3. Ubumba Nezifundo: Ukuhlanganyela ngezifundo ezithinta imiphakathi, eziqinisekisa ukuzazi kahle kwezemvelo. 4. Ubambiswano: Ukubambisana phakathi kweminyango kahulumeni, abahlali, kanye nezinkampani ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga. Isiphetho Izinselelo ze-acid mine drainage eGauteng zithinta kakhulu ukuphila kwezilwane, izitshalo, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuze kube nezindlela ezinempilo zokuphila, kubalulekile ukuthi kuqondwe nezinqwaba ezivikelekile. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo eziqinile ezicacisa izinyathelo, imihlahlandlela, nezinhlelo zokuhlola kuzobaluleka ekuqedeni lezi zinkinga. Ngakho, impikiswano mayelana nezinsiza ezinamathiselwe emithonjeni yamanzi iyoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa elinempilo eGauteng. Lokhu kuzokwandisa izimo zempilo, izinhlelo zomnotho, kanye nezinselelo ezizayo zokugcina izinsiza.
Izithombe: Isithombe 1.1: Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo: mm/ngonyaka. Isithombe 1.2: Ukuphuma kokuphuma okuphakathi nendawo: mm/ngonyaka. Umoya uyinto ebalulekile uma sith planting ukudla. Zonke izindawo zinezinombolo ezirekhodiwe zokwehla kwemvula. Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo kuzokhombisa ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezingasetshenziswa ezindaweni ezithile lapho uk planting kwenziwa kuphela ngemvula. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona ithuba lokunisela, kufanele sithathele phezulu ezinye izimo zezulu ngoba amanzi atholakala ngokunisela. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uma imvula ingena enanini elithile, akusho ukuthi wonke la manzi azothathwa isitshalo. Uma imvula ingena kakhulu, amanzi amaningi aphuma futhi alahleka. Uma insimu ikhululekile, ukuhamba kwamanzi kuyanda. Ngokwesimo sokuthi insimu isetshenziswa kanjani, umhlabathi ophakeme ophakeme uzovimba amanzi ekungeni. Uma kungekho zitshalo ensimini, ukuphuma kokuphuma kuyanda. Uhlobo lomhlabathi lukhombisa futhi ukuthi umhlabathi unekhono lokugcina amanzi, futhi kungase kube nezinambuzane ezizovimba amanzi ekufikeni ezitshalweni. Ukwehla kwemvula nokuphuma okuphakathi nendawo kuboniswa ezithombeni 1.1 no 1.2 (DWAF, 1986). Ngaphansi kuka-20% komhlaba lapha eNingizimu Afrika, okungama-1.05 million square kilometers, kunezimo zezulu ezithola u-750 mm/ngonyaka futhi kunezinga lokwehla kwemvula elingaphansi kuka-1,400 mm/ngonyaka - kulezi zindawo, isimo sezulu sifaneleka ek planting ukudla. Izindawo lapho inani lokwehla kwemvula lidlula u-500 mm/ngonyaka futhi linezinga lokwehla kwemvula elingaphansi kuka-1,800 mm/ngonyaka zifaka: iphakathi nendawo, izindawo ezisemazweni asentshonalanga, nezindawo eCape Town lapho kukhona imvula yehlobo. Ukunisela nokulima okujwayelekile kwenzeka kulezi zindawo, lapho kukhula khona ummbila, ushukela, nezitshalo. Ezinye izindawo zomhlaba zomile kancane kanti ezinye zomile kakhulu, kodwa imvula iyenzeka, nokho amanzi adingekayo angaphansi kuka-50%. Ngakho-ke, ukunisela kuyadingeka kulezi zindawo ukuze kugcinwe izitshalo zokudla.
Bafowethu, umnyango ubize umhlangano okhethekile ukuze sixoxe ngombiko wezinhlelo ze-workshop ezabanjwa ngonyaka ka-2000 kulo lonke izwe. Lezi zinhlelo ze-workshop zazihloselwe ukubuyekeza intuthuko yokuguqulwa kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo. Sifunde ngokucophelela yonke imibhalo ethulwe, sihlole izinkinga ezikhulunywe kanye nemibono ewusizo kanye nenhloso ehlelekile yokwakha indlela enhle nephumelelayo. Okokuqala, sifuna ukubonga ngenhliziyo yethu ngempumelelo nezimpendulo ezisheshayo eziphathelene nalezi zinhlelo ze-workshop. Ukuhlola intuthuko eyenziwe mayelana nezinguquko, sikhumbula ubuhlakani bezicwangciso, izinhlelo, nezinqubo ezisetshenziswe ukuhlela isiphakamiso sokuguqulwa, ukusetha imigomo ngokusekelwe ekuhloleni intuthuko noma ukuwina kwayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ama-workshop aphumelele ekubandakanyeni nasekutholeni ukwesekwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuguqulwa, njengoba kuhloswe nguhulumeni, kubonakala kuyinto ebalulekile emehlweni abasebenzi. Sigcizelela ubudlelwano phakathi kwalabo abaphethe noma abaphatha nezisebenzi ezisebenzela bona, sithole ngenjabulo ukuthi ama-workshop abhekwa njengethuluzi eliwusizo kanye nepulatifomu yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuguqulwa ngamalungu onke abasebenzi, okukhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayakufuna ukuba yingxenye yalesi senzo futhi bazibophezele ekuhlinzekeni ngoguquko kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo, nakuba bekukhona abanye abaphikisa uguquko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sijabule ukuthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abaningi sebeqonde imigomo ye-workshop, njengokuxoxa ngezaba zokwesaba ezikhona phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinkinga eziphathelene nokuguqulwa kanye nezinselelo zedemokhrasi, ukuxoxisana nokuxoxa ngesithombe esiphelele sokuguqulwa njengoba kuboniswe ezishintshweni zomthethosisekelo nakwezinye izinqubo. Umphumela wama-workshop obhekwa phezulu njengethuluzi eliwusizo ubonisa ukuthi abasebenzi badinga leli thuba, indawo ephephile yokuxhumana kangcono nabangane babo ngokujulile kwezihlukahlukene zabo, okuhlangenwe nakho, namasiko, hhayi njengabantu abodwa abasebenza enhlanganweni eyodwa. Nokho, izinkinga eziphathelene nokungaboni ngaso linye ngokobuhlanga noma ukungahloniphi izihlukano zamasiko zihlala zikhona futhi zidinga ukulungiswa, futhi sizokwenza lokhu masinyane. Kucace bha ukuthi kukhona ukuvumelana phakathi kwabasebenzi bonke mayelana nesidingo sokuguquka enhlanganweni yethu. Lo mphumela ubonisa izinto ezahlukene kubasebenzi abahlukene. Kubasebenzi abathile, isiko elikhona kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo alikaguquki ngendlela eyanele ukuze babone izifiso zabo zohulumeni baseNingizimu Afrika zedemokhrasi zifeziwe, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokusebenza. Izinga lokuphatha eliphakathi lisagcwele kakhulu ngabantu abamhlophe, kuyilapho iningi lomsebenzi wesekelo lenziwa ngabantu abamnyama. Nakuba kukhona izinqubomgomo ezikhona mayelana nokuqashwa kwabantu ababephakanyiswa ngaphambili, amathuba okuthi abantu abamnyama bathole izikhundla zokuphatha awabonakali, njengoba kuqokonyiswa ngesikhathi sama-workshop. Bonke abasebenzi bazizwa ukuthi umoya, noma ukuqeqeshwa kokuguquka, akutholanga ukubaluleka okudingekayo. Abanye abasebenzi abamhlophe baphinde bathi akukwanele ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bavume uguquko njengomgomo, kodwa kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okubavumela ukuthi basebenze njengabaphathi noma njengalabo abaguqukile ngempela. Ngaphansi kwezimo zokungaqondi izindlela zokuphatha kule nkathi entsha yokuguqulwa, kungenzeka ukuthi abaphathi babonwa njengabantu abaphikisa uguquko, ngenxa yokungazi ukuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngendlela ehlukile. Kukhona izinkomba eziqinile phakathi kwabantu abamhlophe zokuthi uguquko luyinqubo eyodwa. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama bacabanga ukuthi kuphela abantu abamhlophe abadinga uguquko, hhayi bona. Abasebenzi abamhlophe bazizwa ukuthi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama abahloniphi imizamo yabo yokwenza izinto ngendlela ehlukile. Thina, emnyangweni, siyawuqaphela lo mzwa. Ngokuhlanganisa isakhiwo sokuphatha abasebenzi endaweni eyodwa, izinkinga nezinkathazo eziphathelene nenqubo yokuqasha engathathi hlangothi zingaxazululwa kalula kunakuqala lapha kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo. Umnyango usemsebenzini wokuphromotha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zabaphathi abaqavile, izinhlelo eziqeqesha ngoguquko nezizokhuluma ngezinkinga ezikhulunywe ngabantu. Indima yethu izoba ukuhlanganisa lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Sizophinde sithinte isakhiwo sokuqeqesha somnyango ukuze sithuthukise izakhiwo zokweluleka ezithembekile ezizohambisana nenqubo yokuqasha engathathi hlangothi futhi ehlose labo ababephakanyiswa ngaphambili. Sizosebenzisa isu lokweluleka, elichazwe kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo, njengesisekelo sokwenza iziphakamiso. Siphinde saqaphela ukuthi izinkinga zokuguqulwa eziphathelene nezokusebenza emkhakheni womphakathi wezincwadi nezikhumbuzo zathathwa ngababambiqhaza abaningi ema-workshop. Izinkinga eziphathelene nezindawo ezithile zokuguqulwa, njengokushintsha ekubhekeni ukukhiqizwa kwabasebenzi, ukuthengwa nokutholwa kwezimpahla, ukuhlela nencazelo yayo, azizange ziphikwe ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuthazwe yilabo abaphatha uhlelo. Abasebenzi abakhulume ngemibono yokuthi bangayisheshisa kanjani izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Sifuna ukubona ama-workshop exoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene ngqo nemisebenzi emisha nezinselelo zayo ezivela ekuguquleni, lapho singakwazi khona ukuveza inqubo yedemokhrasi yokuphatha abantu, isiko elisha lokubhekelela, ukusebenza kahle kweqembu nokuvuselelwa, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga zomsebenzi wobungcweti azidingi ukubhekwa ngokufana nezinguquko eziphathelene nabasebenzi, futhi sicela abasebenzi baqonde ukuthi izinguquko emikhakheni yomsebenzi njengoba kubhalwe emthethweni zizosekela isizinda nemisebenzi yeMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo ngokugqamisa indlela ebonakalayo nezinikela yokusebenza. Sizobhekana nalezi zinkinga njengengxenye yesu elisha lokwenza izinto nokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babambe iqhaza. Umnyango uqaphela ngenhlonipho nangokujabula ukuthi izinqubo eziningi nezicwangciso zokuguqulwa seziqale ukusebenza kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo. Isibonelo salokhu kungaba ukufezwa kwenqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa nokuqashwa kwabo ababephakanyiswa ngaphambili kanye nokuqasha okungakhethi. Ngesikhathi sokukhetha umphathi wokuguqulwa, kwavela isithombe sabasebenzi emnyangweni esinokukhombisa izinkomba zezinhlelo ezindala zokucwasa. Isaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba-15 sichaza izigaba zamadokhumenti ezikhungweni ezikhona ezingadingi umuntu ukuthi athumele isicelo esivunyelwe ngumthetho. Ulwazi ngesaziso seKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa elibhalwe esigabeni-15 alutholakali njengamanje. Umbiko wonyaka obhekiswe kwiPhalamende. Ukuhlola indawo egcina amadokhumenti agciniwe. Iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kuMongameli. ukufinyelela kumadokhumenti akwenqabiwe ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo emthethweni. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni [Isaziso soHulumeni R187-15 sikaDecember 2002] (Ifomu-A). Umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhombise uma isicelo singekho ikhophi yedokhumenti noma uma umfaki-sicelo efisa ukungena kudokhumenti ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma idokhumenti ingeyona incwadi, ingafundwa ngendlela efunwayo, uma kukhona indlela esigabeni -292. uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela kuhlobo oluthile lwefomu, umfaki-sicelo uzofinyelela ulwazi ngendlela abacela ngayo. Ngaphandle kwesimo lapho imvume ingaphazamisa ukusebenza kahle kwenhlangano yomphakathi ethintekayo, umonakalo kudokhumenti noma ukuphazamiseka kwamalungelo akhethekile okuphathwa kwedokhumenti kahulumeni. Uma kunezizathu ezinkulu zokungamukeli isicelo ngendlela efunwayo kodwa kukhona indlela ehlukile, izindleko zokuhambisana nesicelo zizokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesicelo sokuqala esenziwe ngumuntu ngaphansi kwesigaba -293 no-4. uma kunezimp responses ezibhaliwe eziphendula isicelo, umfaki-sicelo ofuna ulwazi ngesinqumo ngenye indlela, ngokwesibonelo; ngefoni, kufanele akhombise lesi sigaba -182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kufanele kuchazwe ukuthi baphakanyiswa ngelinye futhi kufanele kube neziqinisekiso ezisekelayo ezihambisana nesicelo esigabeni -182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala noma unokukhubazeka, bangathumela isicelo sedokhumenti ngokukhuluma. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele aqedele ifomu egameni lomfaki-sicelo futhi anikeze umfaki-sicelo leyo doko/ikhophi esigabeni-183. Umfaki-sicelo ofuna ukufinyelela kumadokhumenti aqukethe ulwazi lomuntu mayelana nomfaki-sicelo akadingi ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele wazise umfaki-sicelo (ukuhlukanisa umuntu ofuna ulwazi ngaye) uma umfaki-sicelo edinga ukukhokha imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nesicelo. Imali ethile engu-R35 ikhokhwa ngokuthenga izimpawu zentela ezitholakala ehhovisi leposi. Inani elifanele lezimpawu kufanele lifakwe efomini lesicelo (Ifomu A). Uma izimpawu zingafakwanga, isicelo ngeke processing kuze kube sekukhokhwa imali ethile noma ethile. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka isicelo enkantolo ephikisana nokuhanjiswa noma ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Ngemva kokuthi umphakathi wezokwazi wenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela efunwayo ngumfaki-sicelo. Uma umfaki-sicelo ethola imvume, kukhona enye imali yokufinyelela kudokhumenti okufanele ikhokhwe ukuze kufunwe, kulungiswe, kuphinde kuphumelele, futhi kukhokhwe isikhathi esengeziwe sokufuna nokuhlelwa kwamadokh
Idokhumenti losizo oluvela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini linikeza amakhasimende alo ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi okulindelwe umphakathi mayelana nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo kuhambisana nezinga elibekwe lokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Umphakathi uyazi ukuthi angaxhumana kanjani neMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini. Ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende kusekelwe ekukhetheni ukuhambisana nezinga lokulethwa kwezinsizakalo elishicilelwe ngenkathi kuhambisana nokuhlonipha amalungelo amakhasimende. IMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini izokweseka futhi ikusekele njengamakhasimende ethu, izinga lenkonzo ongakulindela njengamakhasimende ethu, indlela ongasisiza ngayo ukuthi sikusebenzele kangcono, nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa, kanye neziteshi ongazilandela njengamakhasimende uma ufuna ukuveza ukwaneliseka kwakho ngezinga lethu lenkonzo. Zonke ofisi zikhomba lapho izindaba ezihlobene namanzi ziphathwa khona. Ukulethwa kwamanzi aphehlwa ngokpressure kuza ngqo emakhaya kusuka kumapayipi omasipala. Amalitri angama-200 wamanzi ngosuku atholakala kumathangi aphansi agcwaliswa nsuku zonke - alingana namalitri angama-6,000 wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga. Amathangi emigwaqo afakwe emiphakathini ethintwe okwethulwa kwesikhashana. Amathangi amanzi afinyelela lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okwandile. Isewage ithuthwa ngepiphu ezingeni elijwayelekile isebenzisa amanzi - ixhunywe kumasistimu e-sewage. Ukulethwa kwe-sewage ngepiphu esebenzisa amanzi kudluliselwa emgibeni - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nakho. Lapho amanzi esetshenziswa, kudluliselwa emgibeni lapho ithrekhi izofika khona ukuze igcwalishe ithangi layo futhi ithwale i-sewage iye kwenye indawo. Wonke amakhasimende athola ama-kilolitri ayisithupha wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga, nezindleko zikhuphuka kulabo abakhasimende abathola amanzi aphehlwa ngokpressure noma aphansi, nezindleko eziyisisekelo kulabo abakhasimende abane amanzi aphehlwa ngokpressure asebenzisa ngaphezulu kwama-kilolitri ayisithupha ngenyanga futhi bahlala ezindaweni ezibiza ngaphezulu kwe-R40,000 ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Noma yimuphi umthengi onenani lempahla elingaphansi kwe-R36,000 ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi futhi ongakhokhi ukuthuthwa kwe-sewage uzothola le nsizakalo mahhala. Noma iyiphi ithoyilethi ye-VIP ihlinzekwa mahhala iminyaka emihlanu. Ukuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngemininingwane ye-GIS, izithombe zomoya, izikhalazo, nezinye izibalo... I-A4 nayo iyamahhala. Ukwamukela/Ukudlulisela kwezinhlelo zokwakha mayelana nokuthuthwa kwe-sewage. Izindaba eziphuthumayo zixazululwa phakathi kwamahora amane.
Ukusebenza Kwamaphoyisa: Umqondo Wokubheka Phambili Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezithinta ukuphepha nokuthula. Amaphoyisa, njengomnyango obalulekile ohlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo, adlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. Nokho, ukusebenza kwawo kudinga ukucwaningwa, ukuze siqonde kahle izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kwabo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amaphoyisa akha isithombe somphakathi. Njengoba behlola izigameko, behlola izigameko, futhi besebenzisana nabantu, amaphoyisa adinga ukuba ahloniphe futhi abheke phambili ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kuhlonipha kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bazizwa bekhululekile ukuvuma ukusiza amaphoyisa, ngokubika izigameko noma ukuxoxa ngempilo yabo. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi buyisisekelo sokwakha ukuphepha okuqinile. Nokho, izinselelo eziningi zikhona. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu amaphoyisa abhekana nazo yisithombe esibi esitholakala emiphakathini ethile. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokungabi namqondo ophusile wokusebenza kwabo, noma ngenxa yezigameko ezithile ezithinta amaphoyisa, eziholela ekutheni abantu bakhathazeke. Ukuze amaphoyisa athole ukwethembeka, kudingeka ukuthi aqhubeke nokwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezizokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kudinga ukwenziwa ngokuqhubekayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amaphoyisa kumele aqhubeke nokufunda, akhuthazwe futhi abuyekezwe ngokuqhubekayo ukuze bahlale behlakaniphile. Izifundo ezitholakala ezimeni ezahlukene zingasiza amaphoyisa ukuba aqonde kangcono izidingo zomphakathi, futhi akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuthuthukisa amakhono, nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe buye baba nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwamaphoyisa. Izinsiza ezifana nezokuxhumana, izithombe ezikhamera, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola ziye zashintsha indlela amaphoyisa asebenza ngayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa aqonde kahle indlela yokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze zisebenze kahle, futhi zibe usizo emsebenzini wabo. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwamaphoyisa nabanye abahlinzeki bezobuchwepheshe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe buye bulethe izinselelo ezintsha. Ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kudinga ukuba bahlale bephapheme, bazi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungenza kube lula ukuphula amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa aqhubeke nokuhlola izinqubomgomo zabo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi basasebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile, futhi bagcine amalungelo abantu. Kuyaphawuleka futhi ukuthi amaphoyisa adinga ukusebenzisana nabanye abezinhlaka, njengemiphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzokwenza kube lula ukusiza umphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi izixazululo ezitholakalayo zisebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi amaphoyisa abheke phambili, futhi aqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa kudinga ukuba kube nokuheha, ukwakha, nokuzinikela. Amaphoyisa kumele aqhubeke nokusebenza ngokubambisana nomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyaqondwa. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amaphoyisa abe nezinhloso ezicacile, futhi aqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze athuthukise izinsizakalo zawo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, ophila ngokuthula, futhi onokwethembeka. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi. Njengomphakathi, sinesibopho sokuxhasa amaphoyisa, futhi sikhuthaza ukuthi bahlale bephokophele phambili, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngendlela enjalo, sizokwakha umphakathi onokuphepha, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo.
Hamba emgwaqweni. Uma kungekho emgwaqweni, sebenzisa uhlangothi olufanele lomgwaqo, kude nomgwaqo. Uma uhamba emgwaqweni, qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ohlangothini olufanele, kanti ubheke izimoto ezisondelayo. Izimoto eziningi zihamba ngezikhathi ezahlukene emigwaqweni ehlukene, ngakho-ke kub dangerous kakhulu ukuba izingane zidle emgwaqweni/noma ohlangothini lomgwaqo. Uma ingane idlala emgwaqweni, umshayeli osondelayo angase angakwazi ukuyigwema noma ukumisa ngokushesha. Lokhu kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Hamba njalo ubheke izimoto ozihlangabezana nazo ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezisondelayo ngesikhathi. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 azinakho ukukwazi ukukala ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze imoto ifike kuzo. Ngaphandle kokuba kuphephile, ungaweli emgwaqweni. Ungagijimi. Ungaweli emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezifihlekile ezifana nezikwele noma izintaba ngoba kubi kakhulu kumashayeli ukubona wena ngesikhathi. Abahambi ngezinyawo abavunyelwe EMIGWAQWENI ENGAMAKHANDA. Linda ibhasi/taxi liqede ukuhamba ngaphambi kokuphuma. Linda ibhasi/taxi lihambe ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezivela kokubili ohlangothini lomgwaqo. Le bhasi/taxi oyiphumayo ingakushaya. Ungashaywa/ushaywe imoto edlula lapho ibhasi/taxi okuphume kuyo likhona. Wela kuphela uma uphakathi kokukhanya kwabahambi ngezinyawo okukhanyayo futhi kuphephile ukukwenza. Uma ukukhanya kwabahambi ngezinyawo kushintsha kusuka kokuhlaza kuya kokubomvu ngenkathi uwela, qhubeka ubheke emuva naphambili ukuze ubone izimoto ezisondelayo. Uma ukukhanya kokuhamba kukhanya kokubomvu kushintsha kube kokuhlaza, izimoto ezivela phambili nasekhaleni nazo zinegunya lokuhamba manje. Qiniseka ukuthi abashayeli bayakubona futhi bame ngaphambi kokuwela. Umgwaqo uhlinzekelwa bonke; ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuwela ngokushesha ukuze abashayeli baqhubeke. Ukwela emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kubi kakhulu futhi kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Abashayeli balindele ukukubona ezindaweni zokuwela ezibekwe: njengezindawo zokuwela zabahambi ngezinyawo ezinezithiyo, lapho kukhona izimpawu zokumisa noma ukukhanya kwemigwaqo, nokho, kufanele uhamba ngokushesha ukuze abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo baqhubeke. Lokhu kubizwa ngokwabelana ngomgwaqo nokuhlonipha abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Gwema ukusebenzisa umgwaqo ngemuva kokuphuza utshwala/nokwelapha ngoba kuthinta ukubona kwakho nokulinganisela kwakho, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, wela emgwaqweni ngokushesha. Ukuhamba uphuzile kubi njengokushayela uphuzile. Yini ukugcwalisa? Ukugcwalisa kuwukwenza komuntu onebhizinisi lokuhamba asebenzisa umgwaqo, umshayeli noma umgibeli, ukudlula umkhawulo wokukhwabanisa wemoto, kungaba ngenhloso noma ngokungafanele. Ukugcwalisa nezimpahla ezingafanele zenza kube nokufa nokulimala emigwaqweni yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo onguzigidi zamaRandi emigwaqweni nasezimotweni ezigcwele. Imoto egcwele ithatha isikhathi eside ukuyeka uma kwenzeka okuphuthumayo. Uma ufuna ukuhamba ukuze ugweme ingozi, isikhathi sokwenza lokho sandele ngenxa yokugcwalisa. Kunzima ukuphatha imoto egcwele futhi ngeke ukwazi ukujula kalula njengoba ungakwenza emoto ejwayelekile, okwenza kube kubi ukuhamba phambili kwezinye izimoto. Amathayi emoto egcwele afudumala futhi abe mncane - lokhu kungabangela amathayi ukuba aphume. Ukugcwalisa kubangela ukuthi imoto yakho ibhujiswe, okwenza kube nzima ukukubona izimbobo noma ezinye izithiyo emgwaqweni. Ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo emgwaqweni ngakho ungase uphumelele kakhulu. Abantu abaningi bathuthwa emsebenzini noma ezindaweni ezahlukene behlezi ngemuva kwamathrekhi nezivande ezivulekile nsuku zonke - behlezi phezulu kwezimpahla. Abanayo imishayo, abanakho ukuhamba. Ngaphandle kwalokho, lokhu kuthinta kakhulu inani eliphezulu lokufa nokulimala emigwaqweni yethu. Umthetho 247 uthi abantu bangathuthwa kuphela ngemuva kwemoto yezimpahla uma le ndawo abahamba kuyo ivikelwe ngezinto eziqinile ukuze ivimbele ukuwa kwabo. Abashayeli bamabhasi nezitaxi bavame ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Sivame ukuzwa ezindabeni "I-taxi noma ibhasi elagcwalisa kakhulu libe nengxenye." Kumele kube nesaziso ebhasini/itaxi esikhombisa inani labagibeli abavunyelwe ukuhamba nokuma emotweni. Umshayeli othuthwa abantu nezimpahla kumele ahlolwe ngalolo msebenzi futhi kumele afundiswe indlela yokushayela. Abashayeli kumele basebenzise lesi saziso ukuze balahlekelwe ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Ungayithola kanjani imoto egcwele? Ihamba kancane uma ihamba phezulu. Yini enye ongayibona ukuthi igcwele emotweni? Isimo sayo esiyisisekelo. Gcina isikhathi: Akukho ukuhamba kancane, isibonelo, uma uthutha noma uthulula impahla. Izinkinga ze-inshurensi uma ubamba ingozi futhi kutholakala ukuthi imoto igcwele. Ukuhamba ngebhayisikili sekube yinto ethokozisayo futhi indlela yokuhamba eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abaningi bayakujabulela ukuhamba ngebhayisikili empilweni yabo yansuku zonke. Kubantu abaningi, ibhayisikili iyindlela yokuhamba ehlukile kunemoto yokuhamba nsuku zonke. Ibhayisikili iyindlela yokuhamba efana nanoma iyiphi imoto. Nokho, ibhayisikili ayifani nezinye izinhlobo zemoto, ibhayisikili iphathwa amandla abantu. Unamalungelo, imithwalo, nemisebenzi efana nabashayeli abanye. Khumbula, abahambi ngebhayisikili abavunyelwe emigwaqweni engamakhanda. Ngaphambi kokuhamba ngebhayisikili emgwaqweni omphakathi, kumele uqonde imithetho eyisisekelo yomgwaqo futhi ube nekhono lokuhamba ngebhayisikili ngokuphepha emgwaqweni. Kumele uhambisane nazo zonke izimpawu zomgwaqo nezikhumbuzo zemoto. Kumele unikeze abahambi ngezinyawo ithuba. Shiya ibanga eliphephile uma ulandela ezinye izimoto ukuze uvumele umshayeli ophambi kwakho ukuba akwazi ukumisa ngokushesha uma kudingeka. Ungahambi ngebhayisikili ngendlela engafanele futhi engalungile. Bheka izimoto; yenza iso elibukhali nabashayeli ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bayakubona. Qaphela izinja ezingakuphonsela. Lokhu kubi ngoba izinja zingase zikhuphuke emgwaqweni ophumayo futhi zibe nengozi. Qaphela ezindaweni ezibunjiwe uma kube nezikhukhula ezinzima noma kube nezikhukhula isikhathi eside. Gqoka i-helmet eyenzelwe ukuvikela ikhanda lakho uma kwenzeka ingozi. Gwema ukubheka ngqo ezikhanyisweni ezikhanyayo zezimoto ezisondelayo, njengoba lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima ukubona ngesikhathi ebusuku. Ungahambi ngokumelene nomgwaqo. Umthetho ulindele ukuthi abahambi ngebhayisikili bahambe nomgwaqo. Akufanele bahambe ezindaweni zokuhamba ngezinyawo. Ungathwali abagibeli ngaphandle uma ibhayisikili ifakwe esihlalweni esengeziwe somgibeli. Ungangeni emjaho wama bhayisikili emgwaqweni omphakathi ongavunyelwe nguhulumeni noma eziphathimandla.
