Izimpikiswano Ngokuxhaswa Kwe-TV Licence Ye-SABC Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wethu ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, futhi enye yezinto eziphawulekayo yindlela i-SABC (South African Broadcasting Corporation) ethola ngayo uxhaso lwezezimali. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC kudala impikiswano enkulu phakathi kwabantu, abezindaba, kanye nohulumeni. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zinkinga zidinga ukucaciswa, futhi ngithanda ukwabelana ngombono wami ngalolu daba. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi i-SABC iyinhlangano ebalulekile emlandweni wezokuxhumana eNingizimu Afrika. Iphinde ibe yinsika yokwazisa abantu ngezindaba, imicimbi, nezinhlelo ezithinta impilo yabo. Nokho, ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi baphikisa ukuthi kungani kufanele bakhokhe imali ukuze babe ne-TV licence, ikakhulukazi uma bengahlanganyeli ezinhlelweni ze-SABC. Ngokombono wami, ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kudinga ukwenziwa kabusha. Kukhona abanye abantu abathi, uma i-SABC ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezinhle, kungani kufanele sikhokhe? Lokhu kuveza umbono wokuthi abantu bahlola izinga lempumelelo ye-SABC, futhi uma benganakile, baphikisa ngokukhokha. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi abantu baphikisana nezinqubomgomo zohulumeni, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuxhumana. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC iyinhlangano esebenza ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile. Ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kuhloswe ukusiza i-SABC ukuthi iqhubeke nokusebenza, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo yamaNingizimu Afrika. Uma abantu bephikisa ngokukhokha, kufanele bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothinta izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, futhi kungaholela ekwehleni kwezinga lemisebenzi ye-SABC. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-SABC ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi, kuhlanganise nokwehla kwemali engenayo ngenxa yokuncipha kokubukwa. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi i-SABC ibhekane nezinkinga zokuphila, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okukhulu ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza. Uma abantu bephikisa ngokukhokha i-TV licence, kufanele bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothinta izinhlelo ezitholakalayo, futhi kungaholela ekwehleni kwezinga lemisebenzi ye-SABC. Ngokubheka lezi zinto, ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele kube nezinguquko ezithile ekuxhasweni kwe-TV licence. Kungenzeka ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abheke izindlela zokwenza kube lula kubantu ukukhokha, noma mhlawumbe banikeze izaphulelo ezithile kubantu abahluphekayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abaninzi ukuthi bakwazi ukukhokha, futhi kuzokhulisa uxhaso lwe-SABC. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza izinhlelo zayo zibe nezinga eliphezulu, ukuze abantu babe nesizathu sokukhokha. Uma i-SABC ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, abantu bazoba nesifiso sokukhokha i-TV licence. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela ukuxhaswa kwezezimali, futhi kuzokhulisa izinga lokubukwa. Ngokuphetha, ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence ye-SABC kudinga ukucabangela okukhulu. Abantu baphikisa ngokukhokha, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothinta izinhlelo ezitholakalayo. I-SABC ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi, futhi ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence kubalulekile ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza. Kumele kube nezinguquko ezithile ukuze kube lula kubantu ukukhokha, futhi i-SABC kufanele ibheke izindlela zokwenza izinhlelo zayo zibe nezinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela ukuxhaswa kwezezimali, futhi kuzokhulisa izinga lokubukwa. Ngakho, kufanele sithathe lezi zinto zibe yizifundo, sihlanganyele ukuze sithole izixazululo ezithile, futhi sikhuthaze i-SABC ukuthi iqhubeke nokusebenza ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu, futhi kuzokhulisa izinga lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu ne-SABC. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, i-SABC ingase ingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezithokozisayo, futhi lokhu kuzothinta impilo yamaNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhaswa kwe-TV licence, ukuze i-SABC iqhubeke nokusebenza, futhi ibenesisekelo esiqinile sokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile.
ULombiko unama-plan ayishumi ezindaweni (njengoba kudingwa ihhovisi le-PIMSS) alungiselelwe isigaba sesine sohlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Inhloso yombiko ukuveza umbono wezindawo ngayinye nokukhombisa ukuthi kanjani imigomo ephumelele ezimphethweni ezisemqoka embikweni wesigaba sesibili ihambisana nalezi zindawo. Umthelela weHIV/AIDS ubuzwa kuyo yonke iPhondo naku-Okhahlamba. Ubuphofu, ukungasebenzi, ukusebenza kude nasesigodlweni, kanye nokwehla kwemikhuba emihle kwezempilo yomndeni nomphakathi kwenza kube nzima ukuvusa leli gciwane, futhi izixazululo zokwelapha zisakhuluma, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokudluliselwa phakathi komama nezingane. Le ndlala ingenye yezimbangela eziholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokufa. Ukukhula komphakathi wase-Okhahlamba kwehle ngenxa yale ndlala, kukhombisa ukuthi kudingeka ukunakwa okukhulu uma kuhlelwa ukwengeza izinsiza nezidingo ngenxa kokubaluleka kokuphila kwesistimu yokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Umbono wezindawo kanye nemigomo ehambisanayo kudingeka ihlaziywe ngokwezinga lokuxhaswa kwezimali nokuthi zifinyelelwa kanjani. Ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokwazisa ngemicimbi yezomnotho kanye nokwakha izinsiza ezihlinzeka ngensiza yezobuchwepheshe kanye nezixazululo zokuthuthukiswa. Ngokwezibalo zokubalwa kwabantu zonyaka ka-1996, umphakathi wase-Okhahlamba ulinganiselwa ku-119,319, iningi labo bahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni ezibekwe. Kubikwa ukuthi umndeni ngamunye wase-Okhahlamba unamalungu angama-7. Inani elikhulu labantu lapha yintsha, ethole ukuthi izinga lemfundo liphansi futhi amathuba emisebenzi limited. Le simo sikhuthaza ubuphofu nezinga eliphansi lezempilo. Umbono wezindawo kanye nemigomo ehambisanayo. Ukubhekana nezimbangela zobuphofu ngokusondela amathuba wezomnotho emphakathini. Umkhandlu kufanele uhlole izinga lokuxhaswa kwezimali kwezokuhlaliswa komphakathi futhi wenze ulwazi mayelana nokutholakala kwabo lufinyeleleke. Izinsiza zifaka ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile kanye nalokho okuhlelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene, ukuhlinzeka, ukuthutha, ukuqoqa nokulahla udoti, ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kusukela ngo-1994, uhulumeni ufake imali enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza, futhi kutholakale ukuthi i-Okhahlamba inezindlela ezisebenzayo. Mhlawumbe uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe luzosiza ekwakheni umuzwa wokuthi kudingeka izinsiza. Uhlelo lokuhlela luhlose ukusungula amawebhusayithi. Amawebhusayithi achazwa ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuhlela izindawo. Ukuze kusebenza kancane izinsiza ezingenakufinyelelwa kalula kuzokwakha ukuqina ukuze izinga lezempilo liphumelele kubo bonke abahlali base-Okhahlamba. Ezolimo yindawo eqinile ekuthuthukiseni isimo sezomnotho kulomkhandlu. Kukhona umkhakha wezohwebo lwezolimo oqinile namathuba akhona okuthuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kule ndawo nokukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwezindawo ezinhlelweni zokuhlelwa komhlaba nezindawo eziphathwa ngokwesiko lapho umhlaba utholakala khona ukuze ube nokulima. Ukuhweba kwezolimo kuthatha cishe u-70 emakhanda angu-100. Le ndawo iqinisekile ukuthi iyalima ngempumelelo. Imifino elandelayo ikhuliswa (ukudla, amabhontshisi, kanye nesorghum - ikhuliswa ngokunakekela, kanye nemifino eyomile), izitshalo eziluhlaza, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwezinkomo kanye nezinkomo. Ukuhweba kwezinkuni kwenzeka endaweni encane elinganiselwa ku-1.9 emakhanda angu-100. Indawo esele elinganiselwa ku-30 emakhanda angu-100, ngaphandle kwamadolobhana amancane, igcwele abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezibekwe nezindawo zokuphatha eziphathwa ngokwesiko lapho imikhiqizo yezolimo iyinsiza kuphela yokuphila komndeni. Ukuvulwa komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1994 kuphumelele ukuvimbela abalimi ngokumisa ukuxhaswa kwezimali, okwenze ukuthengwa kokudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe kube nezehlakalo eziphansi kunokudla kwendawo. Lokhu kwabangela izinguquko ezimfashini zokuphatha imikhiqizo, ukuguqulwa kwebhizinisi, nokwehla kwezindleko ezibuya ezindleleni zokulima ezinkulu. Izindleko zomhlaba ziqhubekile nokwehla, nakuba kubonakala sengathi lokhu kuyathuthuka. Ukukhiqizwa kwezinkomo kuyibhizinisi elibhekene nesidingo sokwehlisa izindleko, okuholela ekubuyeleni ezinkomeni ezidinga ukudla okuncane. Ngesikhathi lesi, izindleko zabasebenzi ezihambisana nale nyama zehle kakhulu. Kukhona umoya omubi phakathi kwabapheki bezolimo nabantu abasebenza ezindaweni zokulima kanye nabangane; futhi abalimi baphoqeleka ukukhokha izintela zomhlaba. Izindawo ezine-ownership ehlangene zibhekene nenkinga yokungabi nomnikazi oyedwa, okuholela kakhulu ekubeni abantu bahlale ezindaweni ezibekwe, bephuma kulezi zindawo ezibekwe zokuhlala. Izindawo zokulima zincane, inani lezinkomo alilinganisiwe, izinkomo zihlala zikhululeka zenza umonakalo emifino, futhi ukulima kwenziwa ukuze kudle imindeni ngaphandle kwemikhiqizo ethengiswayo. Imifino ekhuliswa ukuze kudle imindeni incane futhi ayithengiswa endaweni. Ukusungula ubudlelwano nomkhakha wezokuvakasha ukuze kudalwe izivumelwano zokuhweba ngemikhiqizo. Kukhona futhi ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi bezolimo emindenini. Lokhu kukhuphukile ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS, ebonakala iphula imindeni eminingi ngesikhathi zikhathazekile ngesimo sezomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wezolimo kuzofinyelela ezingeni lokuzinza kwezomnotho nezimo zendawo futhi kuzovuleka kulabo abangena kulesi sikhala ezindaweni zokuphatha ngokwesiko nasezindaweni ezibekwe. Ukulwa nokwakha ibhalansi phakathi kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Uhulumeni kazwelonke ubona umkhakha wezokuvakasha njengomkhakha odinga ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu. Lo mkhakha awukathuthukiswa kahle ezintabeni zase-Okhahlamba, futhi kukhona amathuba okuthuthukiswa kwawo. Ukuvula umkhakha wezokuvakasha ukuze kube nabantu bendawo abaninzi ukuba babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zomhlaba nezendawo. Ukulwa nokwakha ibhalansi phakathi kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Umnotho uwukuhlanganiswa kwemikhiqizo yonke yokuxhumana kwabantu nemvelo abahlala kuyo. Uhlobene namandla okwakha ingcebo nokuthi le ngcebo ihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo futhi iphathwe ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuqina. Uhlobene nokuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo ngenkathi kushiywa imikhakha yezokuvakasha nezolimo ukuba zibe nezimpendulo zazo. Ukuqinisa umnotho ukuze ukwazi ukubhekana nemakethe ezintsha namathuba ngendlela ezothuthukisa imikhiqizo yesifunda nezinga lokuphila kwabantu bayo bonke. Ukulwa nokwakha ibhalansi phakathi kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Ukwanelisa izidingo zemfundo zabantu bendawo ukuze kudalwe amathuba okukhula komnotho nokuzinza. Isimo sendawo kulo mbiko sikhuluma ngqo ngesimo sendawo mayelana nemvelo nezinsiza zendawo,
Lo mkhakha usebenza kumuntu ongaphandle oneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-21 oyiwumntwana wombuso waseNingizimu Afrika noma onamalungelo okuhlala permanently. Iphasi lempilo yokuhlala liyanikezwa ngezimo zokuthi lizophela eminyakeni emibili, kuqala ngosuku olufika khona eminyakeni engu-21, ngaphandle kokuthi kufakwe isicelo sokwandisa isimo sokuhlala. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi lemboni yaseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Abazali kumele banikeze ubufakazi bokuba ngababusi noma ukuba namalungelo okuhlala permanently eNingizimu Afrika ngokuhambisa imibhalo yokwaziswa noma amaphasi okuhlala permanently. Ukuze kukhombise ubufakazi bokuba ngumzali, hlanganisa isitifiketi sokuzalwa komntwana. Abazali kumele benze ukuzibophezela ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi.
I-sunflower iyinsimu ebalulekile yokukhiqiza uwoyela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, ngokwesiko ikhiqiza cishe ama-ton angama-650,000 ngonyaka. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe okuphezulu kwe-oyela - 44% - iyingxenye enkulu yokukhiqiza kwethu. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe okuphansi kwe-oyela - 25% kuya ku-38% - isetshenziswa ekubhakeni amakhekhe nasekudleni kwezinyoni. I-sunflower ingakhuliswa ezindaweni eziningi zelizwe lethu lapho imvula iphakathi kuka-475 mm no-675 mm ngonyaka. Nokho, kunoma iyiphi indawo, ukukhiqizwa kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela ezokwenza inzuzo. Intengo ye-sunflower ikhulile kakhulu muva nje, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi izohlala iphezulu unyaka wonke. Imbewu yekhwalithi ephezulu, efanayo ngaphandle kwembewu yezinambuzane kufanele icatshangelwe lapho kukhethwa izinhlobo zembewu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isivuno sakho asibanga sengozini. Imbewu yokukhiqiza ephezulu yalo nyaka ayikwazi ukufakwa kabusha ngonyaka ozayo. Le mibewu izokhiqiza amakhanda amaningi, okwenza ukuvuna ngezindlela zomshini kube nzima futhi kuzokhiqiza imbewu encane. Ukuqala kokushoda emanzini ezindaweni eziningi kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuya ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari kufanele kucatshangelwe ngokucophelela njengoba kubalulekile lapho kukhethwa isikhathi sokuf planting. Isikhathi sokuphuma kwe-sunflower sibalulekile ngoba ngesikhathi lesi izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi, futhi zingathinteka uma kushoda. Ngakho-ke, isikhathi sokuf planting kufanele sikhethwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuvinjelwe isikhathi sokushoda sibe ne-sunflower. Ingozi yokwehluleka kokuvuna iyanda uma i-sunflower ifakwe emhlabathini omanzi. Uma imvula ikuhle ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuf planting, futhi umhlabathi ungena, ama-sunflower afakwe kusenesikhathi anethuba elihle lokuphumelela. Isinqumo sokuf planting kusenesikhathi noma sekwephuzile sihambisana nenani lokungena elitholakala emhlabathini. Umlando wokushoda kokungena phakathi nezikhathi zonyaka kufanele futhi ucabangele. Nokho, awukwazi ukulinda isikhathi eside kakhulu ngoba ukwanda kokudla emibewwini kungase kwenzeke uma isimo sezulu sishisa, bese isivuno sincipha. Ngokuvamile, izikhathi zokuf planting zingalandela le mikhombandlela: ezindaweni ezibandayo empumalanga, ungafaka kusukela ekuqaleni kukaNovemba kuze kube ngesonto lokuqala likaDisemba; ezindaweni ezisemaphakathi nezwe lethu, ungakwazi ukuqala ukuf planting ngesonto lokugcina likaNovemba kuze kube sekupheleni kukaDisemba; ezindaweni ezomile empumalanga, ungafaka kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuze kube ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari. Khumbula ukuthi uma ufaka sekwephuzile, kunganciphisa isivuno. I-sunflower ingafakwa ezindaweni ezijulile ezivela ku-2.5 cm kuya ku-5 cm, kuye ngohlobo lomhlabathi nesikhathi sokuf planting. Ujule kufanele ube phezulu emhlabathini onzima (njengokhula) kodwa ungaba phezulu emhlabathini opholile. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi imbewu ifakwe emhlabathini ongena kahle ukuze isize ukuvutha. Kubalulekile ukuthi umhlabathi ube nokuxhumana okuhle nembewu. Sebenzisa indlela yokuf planting ethembekile. Imbewu kufanele ibekwe ngokulinganayo. Ukuphuma phakathi kwezitshalo kubalulekile ngoba izitshalo kufanele ziqhube ngokufanayo; akufanele kube khona ezinye eziseduze kakhulu ukuze ziqhube ukudla nokukhanya. Inani lezitshalo ezingaphumelela endaweni ethile lihambisana nenani lokungena elitholakala emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke kakhulu kunezikhala phakathi kwemigqa. Izikhala phakathi kwemigqa ezindaweni ezithola kuphela imvula zingahluka ukusuka ku-0.91 m kuya ku-2.1 m noma ku-2.3 m. Lokhu kuzohambisana nohlobo lwemishini esetshenzisiwe kanye nendlela yokulima. Inani eliphansi kakhulu lezitshalo lizonciphisa isivuno esingaba khona, kodwa inani eliphezulu kakhulu lizokwenza izitshalo ziqhube, kuholele ekwehliseni isivuno. Izitshalo eziseduze kakhulu zihlala zithinteka ezilimini (njengokubola kwemizi) futhi zihlala ziwela phansi. Inani elinconyiwe lezitshalo (akufanele libe ngaphansi kwama-20,000 ezitshalo ngehektare kuzo zonke izindawo). (I-hektare ingama-100 amamitha ngama-100 amamitha). Kunconywa ukuthi ubungako bokuf planting bushintshwe ukuze ufake imbewu engama-10% engeziwe kunenani elinconyiwe ngoba ezinye zizophumelela ukuvutha ngenxa yokushoda, umonakalo wezilokazane, kanye nokucindezela komhlabathi ngemuva kwemvula enkulu ngesikhathi sokuqala sokuvutha. Ngempela, uma uthola ukuthi kunezitshalo ezingaphansi kwama-20,000 ngehektare, kufanele ucabangele ukufaka kabusha ngesikhathi kusasele isikhathi esanele sokuvutha okuhle.
Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngaphambi kokuthi ngiqhubeke nesikhulumi engizokwenza, ngithanda ukucela ukuthi sithathe umzuzu ukuze sithobe amakhanda ethu ngenhlonipho kubafowethu nodadewethu abangekho emhlabeni, abavela kwamanye amazwe esixhumene nawo lapha kwi kontinent yethu yase-Afrika, abashiywe yileli zwe ngenxa yezenzo zabantu abaphephethelwe umoya wothando nokungahloniphi amalungelo abanye. Ngiyabonga. Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngiyajabula ukuthi namuhla nguMgqibelo, usuku lokugcina lukaMeyi, sihlangene lapha eKwaDinane ukuze sethule uhlelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukudla okwanele emiphakathini yethu. Ngiyasho lokhu, mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngoba udaba olukhuluma ngalo kulezi zinsuku emhlabeni jikelele ngempela yizindleko zokudla eziphakeme ezikhombisa ngokucacile ukuthi azikhombisi izimpawu zokwehla kodwa zizoqhubeka nokwenyuka. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule, iZizwe Ezihlangene kanye nezinhlangano ezinkulu zokuboleka ezizimele ezweni elithuthukile njengeMali Yezwe kanye neBhange Lomhlaba zikhombisile ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngalesi simo sezindleko zokudla ezikhuphukayo, ikakhulukazi umthelela omubi lokhu okukhona kubantu abampofu ezweni elithuthukayo njengezethu. UNgqongqoshe wezeMali wezwe lethu, uMhlonishwa uTrevor Manuel, utshele umhlangano weMali Yezwe owawubanjelwe eMelika ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule ukuthi le nkulu yokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla ibonisa into eyodwa: abantu nemiphakathi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezweni elithuthukayo, kumele babuyele emasimini ukuze baziphathe. Le ndaba yokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla ibuhlungu kakhulu uma sithola ukuthi ezweni elithuthukile, abalimi khona bathola ukwesekwa okukhulu nguhulumeni wabo ngokwezimali ngezimikhiqizo ezisemazweni, kudala isimo esingalingani. Ngibone lokhu ngamehlo ami njengoba ngangikwiBelgium ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule eNtshonalanga Yurophu. Ngokwezazi emkhakheni wezolimo, isifunda sethu saseKwaZulu-Natal, uma siqhathaniswa nezinye eziyisishiyagalombili, sikhombisa ukuba phambili ngendawo enomhlaba ophilayo futhi siphinde sibe nenhlanhla yokukwazi ukuqoqa amanzi emvula ezindaweni ezahlukene zesifunda sethu. Le nhlanganisela (umhlaba ophilayo namanzi emvula) ibonisa ngokucacile ukuthi kumele sibe thina abapheka ukudla kwaleli zwe lethu eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, ngenxa yokungazikhandli kanye nalolu hlobo olubi lokuthi abantu bathi bazolinda uhulumeni, sithola ukuthi sihlangabezana nenkinga uma sizama ukukhuthaza abantu bethu ukuthi basebenzise umhlaba ukuze baziphathe. Abafowethu nodadewethu, impilo iyanda ibe nzima. Namuhla, ibharelwe le-oyela ibiza cishe amadola ayikhulu namashumi amathathu, kuyilapho kungakabi kudlule isikhathi eside ibiza kuphela amadola amathathu. Le nkulu yokwenyuka kwezindleko ze-oyela ibe nomthelela omubi ezindlekweni zokudla nasekutholakaleni. Ukudla okufanele sikwazi ukukudla njalo ukuze sihlale siphilile (ukudla okuyisisekelo njenge-rice, ufulawa, kanye ne-maize) njengokudla okwenziwe ngogwava, ne-maize kubiza kakhulu. Akupheli lapho; ngisho ne-oyela yokupheka noma lokho esikubiza ngokuthi i-margarine namuhla kubiza okuthile okungakholakali. Iningi labomama esinabo lapha lizokwenza ubufakazi ngalokho engikushoyo njengoba bengabathengi bokudla ekhaya. Namuhla, i-1000 rand (R1000) ingathenga izinto ezimbalwa kuphela uma sithenga ukudla noma ukuthenga ukudla emndenini. Yingakho thina, njengohulumeni bezolimo nezindaba zemvelo eKwaZulu-Natal, sikhumbuza amazwi kaNgqongqoshe uManuel ukuthi abafowethu nodadewethu, isimo asizoshintshi kulokhu okwamanje, kodwa siba sibi kakhulu njengoba sonke sizwile ukuthi intengo ye-petrol izonyuka kule mpelasonto. Ukwengeza kulokhu, kukhona izingxoxo zokuthi iBhange leMali leli lungase lwenze ukwenyuka kwentela ngo-2% (ukwenyuka kwentela) uma ikomidi elibhekelele inqubomgomo yezezimali lihlangana ngenyanga ezayo. Lokhu kusho into eyodwa: abantu abanemizi abathengwe ngezikweletu noma izimoto ezisabuyiselwa kuzodingeka bahlupheke ukuze bagcine behlangabezana nezikweletu zabo njengoba abantu sebesingakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo njengoba kuvunyelwene. Ngiyasho lokhu ngoba kumuntu noma ngubani lapha emhlabeni, okokuqala abakucabangayo yizimali uma bebhekene nezimo ezingezinhle empilweni yabo uma kuziwa kwezezimali, ukuthi bathenge okuthile ukuze baphile (ukudla) ngaphambi kokubhekana nezinye izikweletu. Ngokocwaningo lwe-IMF, izindleko zokudla emhlabeni jikelele zikhuphukile cishe ngempela kokwakukhona ngo-2006. Izindleko zokudla emhlabeni zikhuphukile ngo-48% kusukela ngo-2006. Ukuze ngichaze lokho engikushoyo, uma ngo-2006 ibhagi ye-12.5kg yefulawa ibizelwa ku-R15, okwamanje ibhagi efanayo ingathengwa ngama-R28. Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, abaningi bazobuza kungani uNgqongqoshe uMthimkhulu ekhuluma ngento engasondelene nathi. Cha, abafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyasho lokhu ngoba nakwezwe lethu, udaba lwezindleko zokudla eziphakeme nokuthi luthinta kanjani abantu abampofu noma imiphakathi eqhume kakhulu kubonakala, futhi thina njengohulumeni, ikakhulukazi uMnyango wezolimo kuzo zonke izifunda nasemazweni, sikhathazekile kakhulu ngalolu daba. Ngokocwaningo kanye nezibalo zakamuva ezikhishwe yiNational Agricultural Marketing Council, kube nokwenyuka okukhulu kwezindleko zokudla eminyakeni edlule. Ucwaningo lweCouncil lukhombisa ngokucacile ukuthi ukudla okukhuphukile kakhulu kwezindleko yikhona okukhona emadleni abantu abaneholo eliphansi (Abathengi bokudla okuyisisekelo bahlupheke kakhulu). Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi thina njengemiphakathi sihlanganyele nohulumeni kanye nomnyango uma kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esizozethula lapha namuhla. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukusho ukuthi thina, njengomnyango wezolimo nezindaba zemvelo, sikwazile emnyakeni yezezimali ka-2007/2008 eyaphela ngoMashi kulo nyaka ukuba nezinhloso ezifana nalezi engizozethula namuhla lapha eKwaDinane. Lezi zinhlelo zokutshala ubhontshisi ne-maize ezindaweni ezimbili zeBaqulusini neDumbe zibe nezinzuzo ezingaphezu kwamakhulu amane (ngaphezu kwabantu abangu-4,200). Lapha endaweni yeThaka, satshala ubhontshisi endaweni engama-200 hectares, futhi thina njengomnyango sathola uxhaso lwezimali lwezinkulungwane eziyisithupha (R1.4 million). Njengoba ngishilo ngenhla mayelana nohlelo lokutshala ubhontshisi, abantu abazothola izinzuzo bangama-2,000 (abantu abangu-2,000). Ukuzalwa kokhetho olungacwasi futhi olungahloniphi ubulili eNingizimu Afrika kudinge ukuhlolwa okuphelele kwezimpawu zethu zesiqhelo. Uhlelo lwangaphambili lwaluhlanganisa ukuqashelwa okukodwa nezikhumbuzo ezine, ezamehlo esikhathini esedlule. Sifuna ukuphuma esikhathini esedlule; ngoMeyi 1998, iKhansela leziMvo leMphakathi elisha lasungulwa ukuze liphathise ukuhlola izimpawu zesiqhelo nezikhumbuzo. Njengengxenye yohlelo, uMnyango wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi nobuchwepheshe, ngokubambisana noMnyango wezokuxhumana kanye neMithetho Yolwazi, wenza ucwaningo olunzulu ngezimpawu nokuthi zimele ini ngenhloso yokuthola ubuhle obusha obubonisa umoya weNingizimu Afrika entsha. Kwacelwa ithimba labafundisi nabachwepheshe abanolwazi olunzulu ngezimpawu zomdabu kanye nemiqondo yazo ukuba bacabangele izinto ezimele ubumbano, umlando wonke, kanye nesipiliyoni samaAfrika, ikakhulukazi egxile eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela jikelele walolu hlelo waholela ekwakhiweni nasekudizayineni kwezimpawu zesiqhelo ezintsha. INingizimu Afrika iqale uhambo olude lokuzihlukanisa nomlando wokucwasa okususelwa kubulili, umbala, kanye nenkolelo. Izwe lethu liyaqhubeka ngokuzinzile endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu kanye nobungcweti bawo wonke abantu. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu bawo wonke abantu, kukhona isiko elisha lamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonishwa kobungcweti bomoya womuntu, okuyinto echaza ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Omunye wemizuzu engasoze ilibaleke yokuhlukanisa nesikhathi sethu esedlule kwaba ukuphakanyiswa kwefulegi elisha ngo-1994. Le mizwa yakhulisa ukuzigqaja kwethu nobungcweti besizwe esijabulela ubungcweti bawo wonke abantu. Okwesibili kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwezikhumbuzo zesiqhelo ezintsha, ezikhumbuza umlando wabo bonke abantu besizwe, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 2000. Ngokwenza lokhu, lokhu kukhombisa ubuhle be-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuvuselelwa nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Izikhumbuzo zesiqhelo ezintsha ziqinile emoyeni walolo vuselelo lwesizwe.
Ukugcina umhlabathi wethu - singakwenza kanjani? Singasho ukuthi ukungabi nolwazi kuholele ekwehlisweni komhlaba onenani elikhulu ngokusetshenziswa okungafanele. Kubalulekile ukuthi abalimi baphathe umthwalo wabo emapulazini ukuze bafunde ukuthi ukwehla komhlabathi kwenzeka kanjani nokwamukela izindlela zokugcina umhlabathi ezizogcina umhlaba wonke. UProfesa N.S. Shaler waseHarvard University, ngo-1896, wathi: "Uma abantu behluleka ukuthola izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba ngendlela efanele, ngezindlela ezigcina umthombo wokuphila, kufanele sibheke phambili esikhathini - kungathatha isikhathi eside, kodwa kubonakala kahle, lapho sizobe sithulile ifa elikhulu, futhi lizonyamalala ngoba sidale ingozi enkulu." Lezi zisho zabhalwa ngo-1896; okwamanje, asikwazi ukwenqaba ukuthi le nkinga isekhona. UDalai Lama ubone ukuthi kukhona ukwehla okukhulu komhlabathi, kodwa kuza kancane kancane, futhi asikuboni njalo. UDalai Lama uphinde wathi: "Ingozi yezikhali ze-nuklear kanye nekhono lomuntu lokubhidliza imvelo kuyakhathaza kakhulu. Nokho, kukhona nezinye izinguquko ezizwakala kancane. Ngicabanga ngokukhathala kwezinsiza zethu zemvelo ikakhulukazi ukuguguleka komhlabathi futhi lezi mhlawumbe zikhona ezingaphezulu kwezingozi, ngoba uma sesiqala ukuzizwa imiphumela yazo kuzobe sekuphume isikhathi." (Ikhasi 144 leNcwadi encane kaDalai Lama yeNhlalakahle: 2002, Element Books, London). Ukwehla komhlabathi kuyenzeka njalo emhlabeni, kodwa inkinga ivela lapho thina, njengabantu, sithinta lokhu kwenzeke ngokushesha, sisheshisa ukwehla kwemvelo okujwayelekile. Uma umhlabathi uguguleka emapulazini, izakhamzimba, ukudla kwezitshalo, izinto zokulawula izifo, kanye nalokho okusele ngemva kokuvuna kuyalahleka. Abalimi abakwazi ukuphatha izindleko nezinye izingozi emvelweni yemvelo uma umhlabathi washiywa. Ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi unyaka nonyaka lapha eNingizimu Afrika, ukulahleka komhlabathi kufinyelela ezigidini zama-ton - ama-300 kuya kwama-400 ezigidi zama-ton, okuhunyushwa kube mhlawumbe ama-ton amathathu ngehektare. Inani lomhlabathi elilahlekile emifuleni engena olwandle unyaka nonyaka lifinyelela ezigidini zama-ton. Uma umkhiqizo owodwa wekhono ofana nokhukhamba, ummbila, ummbila, kanye noshukela ukhiqizwa, iNingizimu Afrika ilahlekelwa ama-ton amashumi amabili omhlabathi minyaka yonke. "Inhlangano Yezokudla Nezolimo yase-United States of America" ibala ukuthi ukwehla komhlaba emhlabeni lapho kukhula khona izitshalo kufinyelela ezigidini eziyisixhenxe zama-ton unyaka nonyaka. (Iziqinisekiso ze-Enviro, iNyuvesi yaseWestern Cape). INingizimu Afrika iyindawo evame ukuhlupheka ukushoda kwemvula - kwezinye izindawo, imvula ayiqhubeki. Amanzi emvelo ayisithiyo esibalulekile ekulimaleni. Ukufinyelela emanzini ngokwethembeka ezimweni zamanje nezangaphambili kuncike emkhathini, ezindleleni zokusebenzisa amanzi akhona, nasekulawuleni la manzi ngendlela efanele uma usebenzisa umhlabathi. Njengoba amanzi engatholakali kalula, kubalulekile ukuthi abalimi basebenzise amanzi atholakalayo ngezindlela ezigcina amanzi emhlabeni wethu. Uma imvula iphezulu, idala ukuhamba (okuhambisa umhlabathi emapulazini) bese umhlabathi uguguleka njengoba amanzi ehamba ngokushesha. Ukulima kwe-contour kuvame ukusetshenziswa lapho amapulazi enza izigaba. Umfuyi wakhe udala imithombo emapulazini ukuze aguqule indlela amanzi ahamba ngayo, evimbela amanzi ukuthi ahambe ngqo phansi; le mithombo (ama-contours) iyasiza ukuvimbela lokhu. Ama-contours asiza ukuhamba kwamandla amanzi, avimbela ukulahleka okusheshayo futhi avumela umhlabathi ukuthi wamukele amanzi. Lokhu kukhuphula ukufakwa kwamanzi emhlabathini. Ezinye izindlela zokugcina zinezindleko, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izithelo zizokhuphuka, futhi ama-contours azosiza ukugcina umhlabathi ophakeme nokugcina amanzi. Ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi ama-contours angakhuphula izithelo ngo-5 - 10%. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko ze-diesel nemishini ziye zancipha. Ochwepheshe bethi ukulima ngokwakha ama-contours kuvimbela ukwehla komhlabathi. Inani lomhlabathi elilahlekile lihambisana nokuthi ulima kanjani. Ukulima okungaphakanyiswa kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuvimbela ukulahleka komhlabathi nokugcina amanzi. Uma umhlabathi ungaphakanyiswa, uhlala ungathinteki, futhi izitshalo ezintsha zifakwe ezinsalweni ezishiywe ngonyaka odlule. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi izindlela zokulima kufanele zihambisane nezimo zamapulazi nezidingo zomfuyi. Izindlela zokugcina ezifana nokwakha ama-contours zilawula amanzi ngokuphepha futhi zivimbela izingozi ezidalwa umoya. Nokho, isu lokugcina kufanele lihambisane nokusetshenziswa kwezitshalo ezifanele, ukuphathwa ngokucophelela kwezibulala-zinambuzane, nokuphathwa kahle kwemifula. Ukugcina kuzovikela umhlaba futhi kukhuphule amandla omhlaba ukukhiqiza ukudla. Kuzokwandisa nenani lomhlaba. Ubuchwepheshe nolwazi lobunjiniyela kudingeka ukuze kuqale ukwakha ama-contours. Yini ezokwakhiwa eduze kwama-contours, njengezintaba noma ukutshala utshani? Sidinga ukuxhumana nezinhlelo ezisekelayo ngaphakathi kukahulumeni, ezifana noMnyango Wezolimo kanye nezikhungo ezabelana ngolwazi ukusiza abalimi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane namakhono okuphatha umhlaba ngendlela efanele. Thina, njengabangabalimi, kufanele samukele indima yethu ekuphatheni umhlaba wethu nezinsiza zethu zendawo. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sithola ini emhlabeni nasekuthinteni lokhu emvelweni yemvelo. Omunye wabaqhamukeli bethu abaphumelelayo abakhiqiza imifino endaweni yaseRustenburg, uKarabo Phele, uthola imifino ngaphandle kwezitshalo ngoba umhlabathi wakhe unomhlabathi ophilayo. Uphendule umbuzo mayelana nekhono lakhe lokuthola izithelo ezinhle ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izitshalo: "Uma uthatha izakhamzimba emhlabathini unyaka nonyaka kodwa ungabuyiseli lutho, uzothola ukuthi umhlabathi uyancipha, futhi wena nalabo abakulandela uzothola ukuthi umhlabathi awukwazi ukusiza izakhamzimba njengoba wayejwayele." Amapulazi anomhlabathi ophilayo alahlekelwa umhlabathi ophakeme futhi ikhono lokukhiqiza ukudla liyanqotshwa, futhi umfuyi akasatholi izithelo ezanele noma inzuzo. Ukwehla nokulahleka komhlabathi kanye nokuncipha komhlabathi kubangela umhlabathi ukuthi ufile! Akusiyo imvelo kodwa abantu abadala inkinga. Ukugcina umhlabathi wethu namanzi kubalulekile uma thina, njengabantu, sifuna ukuqhubeka siphila!
UNelson Mandela Nomlando Wenkululeko UNelson Mandela, owaziwa njengomholi ophambili emzabalazweni wokulwa nobandlululo eNingizimu Afrika, ungumfanekiso obalulekile emlandweni wenkululeko. Ubulili bakhe, ubudala, kanye nezimo ezithile zempilo yakhe zamenza waba yisibonelo esihle sokuzinikela, uthando, kanye nokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. UMandela wazalwa ngo-18 Julayi 1918 eMvezo, eMpuma Koloni, futhi wakhulela emndenini owawuhlonipha izinkolelo zamasiko nezokholo. Ukwaziwa kukaMandela kwanda ngesikhathi esebenza njengomfundi e-University of Fort Hare, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abaholi abanjengoWalter Sisulu noOliver Tambo. Lezi zinkanyezi zaba yisisekelo sokwakha umbono omusha wokulwa nobandlululo, okwakuhlosiwe ukuvuselela amalungelo abantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uMandela wathola umsebenzi njengomeluleki wezomthetho, kodwa akazange akhumbule ukuhlala ethule. Waqala ukujoyina i-African National Congress (ANC) ngo-1944, lapho aqala khona khona khona ukulwa ngokusemthethweni. Ukwakha umkhankaso wokulwa nobandlululo kwaholela ekubeni uMandela abe yisikhumbuzo sokuzimisela. Ngonyaka ka-1960, ngemva kokubulawa kwabantu eSharpeville, uMandela waba ngumsunguli weMkhonto weSizwe, umkhankaso ophikisana nezinqubomgomo zobandlululo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni aboshwe ngo-1962, lapho wahlala khona ejele iminyaka engama-27. Noma kunjalo, le minyaka ibiyisikhathi sokucabanga, sokuhlola, nokwakha amasu amasha okuphikisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMandela waba yisithonjana sokuphila kwenkululeko, futhi imizamo yakhe yokukhulisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bamaZulu, abamnyama, nabamhlophe yathuthukisa umqondo wokubumbana. Ngonyaka ka-1990, ngemva kokukhululwa ejele, uMandela waba ngumholi ophambili emzabalazweni wokwakha iNingizimu Afrika entsha, enobulungiswa. Ukuphumelela kwakhe ekutholeni inkululeko kwaholela ekubeni abe nguMengameli wokuqala omnyama weNingizimu Afrika ngo-1994, lapho ahola khona uhulumeni obumbene. Ukwamukela uMandela njengomholi wezwe akukhombisi kuphela impumelelo yakhe, kodwa futhi kukhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezenzeke eNingizimu Afrika. UMandela waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngisho noma ubunzima bujabulisa, umoya wokulwa ungavusa ithemba. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinkolelo zabo ukuze bakhe ikusasa elingcono. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi, uMandela waba yisikhumbuzo sokubambisana, uthando, nokuxolelana. Wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuhlonipha, baphile ngokubambisana, futhi baphile ngokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ezihlosiwe ukuvuselela umnotho, imfundo, nezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Umlando kaNelson Mandela ungumlando wenkululeko, umqondo wokuthi abantu banelungelo lokuphila ngaphandle kokucwaswa. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza, umoya wokulwa ungavusa ithemba. UMandela waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungalungisa izinkinga zawo uma ubambisana, futhi lokhu kuhlonishwa kuzoqhubeka kuholela emiphumeleni emihle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMandela waba yisithonjana emhlabeni jikelele, futhi imizamo yakhe yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa yathuthukisa izinkolelo eziningi. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ukuze sithole inkululeko, kufanele sihlale sizimisele, sikhuthazelele, futhi sibe nesibindi. UNelson Mandela, ngempela, ungumholi ongasoze wakhumbuleka, futhi umqondo wakhe wenkululeko uzohlala ungena ezimpilweni zethu. Ngokuphetha, uNelson Mandela ungumfanekiso obalulekile emlandweni wenkululeko, futhi imizamo yakhe yokulwa nobandlululo izohlala ibalulekile. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngisho noma izimo zikhathaza, umoya wokulwa ungavusa ithemba. UMandela waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungalungisa izinkinga zawo uma ubambisana, futhi lokhu kuhlonishwa kuzoqhubeka kuholela emiphumeleni emihle. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ukuze sithole inkululeko, kufanele sihlale sizimisele, sikhuthazelele, futhi sibe nesibindi.
Usain Bolt: Iqhawe Lezemidlalo UUsain Bolt, owazalwa ngo-21 kuNhlangulana 1986 eSherwood Content, eJamayika, ungomunye wabagibeli abavelele emlandweni wezokugijima. Ubulili bakhe, obuqhakambisa ubuhlakani nobuchule, buveza impumelelo emkhakheni wezokugijima. Uthole udumo olukhulu emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yokuphumelela kwakhe emqhudelwaneni, ikakhulukazi emijikeni emide, lapho abebonakala khona eshaya izikhathi ezinhle kakhulu. UUsain wakhula emndenini ophilayo, lapho ababejwayele khona ukuzijwayeza imidlalo. Uthando lwakhe lokugijima lwaqala ngenkathi esencane, lapho athola khona ithuba lokugijima ezindaweni zomphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uBolt wabonisa amakhono akhe, okwaholela ekutheni aqashelwe njengomgibeli onamandla. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole, uBolt waqala ukuqeqeshwa ngokusemthethweni, waphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu kumphakathi wezokugijima. Uqala ukuthola udumo olukhulu emqhudelwaneni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emqhudelwaneni we-World Championships, lapho ahlula khona abanye abagibeli abaziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Ngonyaka ka-2008, uBolt waba yinkanyezi emhlabeni wezokugijima, ewina izindondo ezintathu ze-gold emqhudelwaneni we-Olympic eBeijing. Ukwenza kahle kukaBolt akugcinanga lapho; wathola izindondo eziningi emqhudelwaneni we-World Championships, waphinde wahlula irekhodi lesikhathi emijikeni emide. Ubulungisa bakhe, obubhalwe ngempumelelo, bahlonishwa emhlabeni wonke, futhi waba isibonelo esihle kwabanye abathanda ezemidlalo. Ngonyaka ka-2012, uBolt waphinda wathola izindondo ezintathu ze-gold emqhudelwaneni we-Olympic eLondon, lapho abebonakala khona eshaya izikhathi eziphakeme kakhulu. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uBolt waba yisithombe esidumile, futhi abantu abaningi baqala ukumlandela, befunda ezifundweni ezitholakala emsebenzini wakhe. Ubuye wathola izikhumbuzo eziningi, ezihlanganisa izinkanyezi zomhlaba, izikhumbuzo zezimali, nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abasha emkhakheni wezokugijima. UUsain waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi, uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, kufanele azinikele, aqhubeke eqeqesha, futhi angayeki, noma ngabe ubunzima bukhona. UUsain Bolt akagcinanga nje ngokuba umgibeli ophumelelayo; ubephinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi eJamayika, lapho abanye behlonipha khona imizamo yakhe yokuphakela izifundo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uBolt wagcina esehla emsebenzini wakhe, kodwa impumelelo yakhe izohlala ikhumbuleka. Uhlonishwa njengomgibeli ophakeme, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. UUsain Bolt ungomunye wabantu abaziwayo emhlabeni, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka. Ngempela, uBolt uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi, uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, kufanele azinikele, aqhubeke eqeqesha, futhi angayeki, noma ngabe ubunzima bukhona.
Kulendawo, kune-2152 hectares ezingakhuliswa ngamalungu ezigaba zokufunda. Lezi zindawo zisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke kodwa ziqashwe ngokusemthethweni ngumuntu ngamunye, futhi ziphathwa nje yikhandidethi lendawo. Umfuyi ngamunye unesivumelwano sokuhlala (PTO) salelo thafa, esifana kakhulu nesivumelwano sokuhlala. Umfuyi akakwazi ukuba ngum owner walelo thafa, kodwa futhi akakwazi ukuphuma kule ndawo. Ngonyaka ongenhla, abafuyi bahluleka ukukhulisa ama-hectare angu-857. Kunezizathu eziningi zokwenza lokhu, ikakhulukazi izindleko zokuqala eziphakeme zokufuya nezindleko eziphakeme zokuboleka abaqashi. Abafuyi bahlupheka ukuthenga imishini yabo ngoba intengo yemakethe yezitshalo zokudla iphansi futhi inzuzo incane. Abafuyi abaningi abasasebenzisa le ndawo sebekhulile futhi baphila kakhulu ngezikweletu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, laba bafuyi abadala abakwazi ukwesekwa ngamabhange ngama-loan, futhi abakwazi ukuvuselela izinkambu abazikhulisa ngemali abanayo. Izinhlaka eziningi ezingenziwa zikhulisiwe azihlanganisiwe, futhi manje abafuyi babhekana nezingozi ngoba izinkomo zikhuluma ngokukhululeka. Uhlelo lwe-CASP lweMnyango Wezolimo luhamba kancane, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezinkambu. Uhlelo olukhulu lokukhiqiza ukudla luncipha ngoba abafuyi abaningi abakatholi ukwesekwa kulolu hlelo lokutshalwa kokukhiqiza ukudla. Abafuyi basemaphandleni bacela usizo kuhlelo lwe-ASGISA ukuze bakhulise izinkambu zomphakathi wonke, kodwa lokhu akusizi abanikazi bezwe. Lokhu akusona isixazululo esiqinile ngoba siyazi ukuthi lapho i-ASGISA ingakhulisi izinkambu, lezo zinkambu zizoshiywa zingakhuliswa ngoba ngeke kube khona ukuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane futhi abafuyi ngeke babe namandla okuqhubeka bodwa. Amalungu eqembu lokufunda ahlangana njalo ngenyanga. Kukhona inzuzo enkulu ekubeni yilungu leqembu lokufunda ngoba abafuyi bangabelana ngemicabango yabo, bakhomba izidingo zabo mayelana nokuthola ulwazi, futhi basekela omunye nomunye. Abafuyi basemaphandleni bahlupheka futhi abafuyi bezomnotho ngakho-ke abakho abafuyi abaningi abafuyayo ngezomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa kulezi zindawo kuhamba kancane, kodwa ngiyajabula ukuthi intuthuko iyabonakala. Abafuyi basebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zembewu), ama-fertilizer afanele, futhi bazama ukususa izitshalo ezingafuneki ezinkambini lapho kukhuliswe khona ummbila.
Ukufakwa Nokucutshungulwa Kwezicelo Zezimangalo Ze-GEMS Ekuqaleni kweminyaka ye-2000, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wathola indlela entsha yokuphatha izinsiza zezempilo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) yasungulwa ukuze ihlinzeke ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Le mfundiso yenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo zezimangalo, okwakuhloswe ngakho ukusiza abantu abaningi. Ukufakwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokuthola izinsiza zezempilo. Abasebenzisi badinga ukufaka izicelo zabo ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko ezithile. Lokhu kwahlanganisa ukufaka amaphepha afanele, njengemibhalo yokwelashwa, izincwadi ezivela kubadokotela, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu babefanele ukuhamba ngezinyawo baye ezikhungweni zezempilo ukuze bathole lezi zinsiza, okwakuhambisana nezikhathi ezinzima zokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa uhlelo lokucutshungulwa kwezicelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, okwakwenza kube lula ukufaka izicelo. Abasebenzisi bangakwazi ukufaka izicelo zabo nge-inthanethi, okwakuholela ekunciphiseni isikhathi sokulinda. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, njengoba kwavumela abantu abaningi ukuba bathole izinsiza zezempilo ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi esiningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinqubo zokuhlola izicelo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izicelo zihlolwa ngokushesha, kwafakwa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, njengoba izicelo zihlolwa ngokushesha futhi abantu bathola izimpendulo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwenzeni kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo, futhi kwavumela abantu ukuba baphile impilo engcono. Nokho, nakuba i-GEMS yenza intuthuko enkulu, kwavela nezinselelo. Abanye abantu babebhekene nezinkinga zokungaqondi kahle izinqubo zokufaka izicelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye bahluleke ukufaka izicelo zabo ngendlela efanele, okwakuholela ekubeni bahlupheke. Ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinqubo zokufaka izicelo. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izinqubo, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi baphile impilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa ubudlelwano bayo nabahlinzeki bezinsiza zezempilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabahlinzeki, okwakwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni. Abasebenzisi babenokuthula kwengqondo, njengoba bekwazi ukuthi izicelo zabo zizobhekwa kahle. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola impendulo enhle emphakathini. Abantu baqala ukubona izinzuzo zokufaka izicelo zezimangalo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukujabulisa izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu baphile impilo engcono. I-GEMS yathola udumo olukhulu, futhi abantu baqala ukuyibona njengomphakathi ophumelelayo. Njengoba i-GEMS iqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izinqubo zayo, kwavela nezinselelo ezintsha. Ukukhula kwabantu abathola izinsiza zezempilo kwaholela ekwandeni kokufakwa kwezicelo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni i-GEMS ibhekane nezinkinga zokuphatha izicelo eziningi. Nokho, i-GEMS yathola izixazululo ezithuthukisiwe, futhi yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ikwazi ukuphatha izicelo eziningi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwenzeni kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Ekugcineni, i-GEMS ibonakala njengomphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi abantu bahlala bejabule ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimangalo ze-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. I-GEMS ibonakala njengomphakathi ophumelelayo, futhi abantu bahlala bejabule ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kubangela umonakalo kuwo wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika emnothweni. Umthetho ophakanyisiwe wehlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kwabantu Abamnyama (obizwa ngokuthi "umthetho ophakanyisiwe" lapha) ungomunye wezinyathelo eziphumelelayo ezithathwe nguhulumeni ukuze abhekane nalolu daba. Ikomidi Lezeluleko Lehlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kwabantu Abamnyama (obizwa ngokuthi "ikomidi" lapha) iyinhlangano yokweluleka ephakanyisiwe. Usizo nokuxhaso kuzohlinzekwa yiPhalamende Lezohwebo Nezimboni (obizwa ngokuthi "DTI" lapha) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugcina amabhizinisi abamnyama futhi aphathwe ngabantu abamnyama. ukuze kugqugquzelwe imiphakathi yasemakhaya nezasekhaya. Kulindeleke ukuthi amalungu e Ikomidi angakhokhelwa izindleko zawo futhi ukuthi ukusungulwa nokusebenza kwe Ikomidi kuzoxhaswa ngombono ohloswe kuPhalamende Lezohwebo Nezimboni (DTI). Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi i-GCIS (Uhlelo Lokuxhumana Nokwazisa Hulumeni) kanye ne-DTI kuthuthukiswe uhlelo oluphelele mayelana nokuthuthukiswa komnotho kwabantu abamnyama jikelele kanye nalolu mthetho ophakanyisiwe ngokukhethekile.
Umdanso Wokuphila Kwakukhanya usuku oluhle eNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinyanga zazikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo. Emzaneni waseMhlabeni, abantu babekhuluma ngokuhlangana okwakuzokwenzeka emnyangweni omkhulu. Le mnyango ibibizwa ngokuthi "Umdanso Wokuphila". Kwakuyisikhathi sokuhlonipha imvelaphi, ubungane, kanye namasiko. Umdanso wawuwumcimbi obalulekile emphakathini, owawuhlanganisa abantu bahlukene, bejolisa emhlabeni jikelele. Abantu babefika bejabulile, bejolisa ngezihlangu zabo ezihlotshisiwe, izigqoko eziphakeme, nemibala ehlukahlukene. U-dada uNandi, ongumlimi, wayeziqhenya ngekhono lakhe lokuhamba phambili emdansweni, eyaziwa kahle ngamakhosi emzini. "Umdanso akukhona nje kuphela ukunyakaza," kusho uNandi, "kodwa kuyindlela yokuzwakalisa imizwa, ukukhumbula abathandekayo, nokuhlonipha imvelo." Bese ivalwa umculo opholile, ophethe izithako ezithokozisayo. I-violin yabe isikhipha imisindo emikhulu, ihlanganisa izwi le-harmonica, i-djembe, kanye ne-piano. Njengoba umculo uqala, umoya wezothando nohombe wathinta wonke umuntu. Kwathi lapho uNandi eqala ukuqhubeka, wazithokozisa emdansweni. Izinyawo zakhe zashaya phansi, zishaya umhlaba, zikhombisa isibindi esikhulu. Abantu behlabelela, bejabulile, bejabulisa omama nabantwana. Umndeni kaNandi, owawuhlanganiswa nguBaba wakhe, uMkhulu, noMama, babemamatheka behlabelela, bejabulela ukuvuma umdanso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umdanso wathola ukucasuka, abantu bejabulile bejabulisa, bekhumbula izinto ezinhle. U-Nandi wahamba phambili, enza izinyathelo ezihlukene, ezazikhombisa izilokotho zomphakathi. Kwakukhona umdanso owawuhlonishwa kakhulu, owawubizwa ngokuthi "Umdanso Wokuzalwa". Le ndaba yayikhuluma ngempilo, ukukhula, kanye nokuphila phakathi komphakathi. Emva kwesikhashana, uNandi wabona umama wakhe, owayebukeka ejabule, edansa eduze. Wathola umuzwa wokuthi umdanso wawuyindlela yokuxhumana, ukuxhumana nomphakathi. Kwakungelula, kodwa umoya wawukhanya, futhi abanye abantu banyuko, bejabulile bejabulela. Umdanso wawuwumcimbi wokubuyisana, lapho abantu behlangana baphinde babuyise imizwa. Ngenxa yokuthi umdanso wawwuhambela phambili, umphakathi wawuhlanganyela, ukuxhumana kwabantu. Abantwana bejabulile, begijima, bejabulisa, behamba ngezinyawo zikaNandi, behlanganyela emdansweni. Umdanso wawuphuma enhliziyweni, futhi wanika amandla. Abantu babejabulile, behlabelela, behlanganyela, bebonisa izinyathelo ezihlukene. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, umdanso wagcwala, abantu bejabulile, bejabulisa, behamba ngezinyawo, behanjiswa yi-music. Umdanso wawuhamba phambili, uNandi, uMkhulu, noMama behlanganisa iminyango yokubuyisana. Kwakukhona umoya omuhle, umoya wokuphila, umoya wokuhlonipha. Ngenxa yokuthi umdanso wawusendaweni, kwabakhona abathandi bemvelo nabantu ababejabulile, bejabulisa. Umdanso wawuhlanganyela imizwa ehlukene, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, nokuhlonipha imvelaphi. Kwakukhona umoya omuhle, umoya wokuphila, umoya wokuhlonipha. Ekugcineni, umdanso wawuhamba phambili. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi umdanso akukhona nje kuphela ukunyakaza, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana, ukuhlonipha, nokuphila. Umdanso wawuhlanganisa abantu, wenza umphakathi uhlanganyele. Umdanso wawuhamba phambili, njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokukhula. Umdanso waba yimpilo, waba yindlela yokuphila, waba yindlela yokuhlonipha. Umdanso Wokuphila wawungaphezu kokunyakaza; wawuwumoya, ukufudumala, ukuxhumana, nokuhlonipha abanye. U-Nandi waqonda ukuthi empilweni, umdanso uyinqubo yokuphila, yindlela yokuhambisana. Njengoba izinyanga zazikhanya phezulu, abantu baphinde bahlangane, behlabelela, bejabulile, baphinde baphinde bakhumbule imvelaphi yabo. Umdanso Wokuphila, umdanso wokuhlonipha, umdanso wokuphila.
Ukuhlaziywa kokusabela kuzikhukhula zaseKwaZulu-Natal KwaZulu-Natal, leli khona elibhalwe emlandweni wokuthula neziphithiphithi, libhekene nezinselelo ezinzima ezibangelwa yizikhukhula ezinkulu ezihambisana nezimo zezulu ezingalindelekile. Izinsuku ezimbalwa ezedlule, izikhukhula zaphazamisa izimpilo zezakhamuzi, zashiya umonakalo omkhulu ezindlini, ezikoleni, nasezimotweni. Ukuhlola indlela uhulumeni nabanye abathintekayo abaphendula ngayo kulezi zimo, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka nokuthuthukiswa kwamasiko ahluphekayo. Ngokwezinhlangano ezibhekelele izimo zokuphila, abahlali abangephi ngalokho basebekhuluma ngezinkinga ezivela kulezi zikhukhula. Abanye baveze ukuthi imifula ithule kakhulu ingahlulwa, zinalo imithombo yamanzi engapheli kahle, okukhona kudala ukukhala ngezinkinga zempilo nezokuhlala. Lokhu kuphumeza ezamanzi angalungile nemiphumela eyingozi empilweni yabo. Uhulumeni waseKwaZulu-Natal uvule amehlo amahle kulokhu, ugxile ekupha usizo kulezi zindawo ezithintekayo. Ukukhuluma nabezindaba, umphakathi uthe uHulumeni unikeza usizo lwezinhlelo zokuphuma kobubha nokuhlinzeka ngonyaka ngemali yokubuyisela izindawo ezilimele. Lokhu kubonisa isinyathelo esihamba phambili sokuvikela izakhamuzi ezinye izimo eziphuthumayo ezibangelwa izikhukhula. Ngaphezu kokubhekana nezinselelo zokuhlala, kubalulekile ukuhlola indlela abantu bezinhloso ezintaundweni yokuphila. Ukuhlangana kwezenhlalakahle kudinga ukuhlomula ngokuhlukile, ukuze kunciphise ukungakhululeki phakathi kwabantu. Izinsizakusebenza zokusiza kufuneka ziphumelele ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi, kuhlelwe izinhlelo zokuphila ezilula zokubona izinkinga. Ezindaweni ezithintekayo, abahlali bahlala babyazo imiphumela emibi yesikhukhula. Izinhlangano ezikhethekile ezikusasa zenzeka zikhombisa ukuthi abakha izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-wellness days nokushintsha indlela yokuphila kube nethonya elikhulu emiphakathini ethintekayo. Lokhu kuphumeza akhululi amazwi ayinkimbinkimbi kanti kwenze kwehlise umthelela wezinguquko. Ngokubukwa kabanzi, abezindaba begxile kumqathango wamanje, imiphakathi isidinga ukwakha izinqubo ezibambekayo zokushintsha izimo zempilo. Ukuhambisana nezinzuzo ezibamba abahlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, izinkampani ezisebenza kahle zengeza isixazululo esinembile. Ngaphandle kwalesi simo, umphakathi ungaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi onokuphila ngempumelelo. Ngokwezinzakalo eziningi, umphakathi udinga uhlelo olucacile lokuphuma kulesi simo esinzima, olwakha imvula engenaphi na. Ukuhloliwe ngezinto eziluhlaza nezokwakha izindawo eziqinisekisiwe, isikhathi sokuphila asiqhamuki. Ubuchwepheshe bahlukahlukene bungafakwa ekuphenduleni, ukusiza ukuvikela izindawo ezithintekayo ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinhle. Ngokuya phambili, umndeni owandulelayo nesimo somphakathi odinga ukusizelwa kuzalo kuhlangene. Ukuze uHulumeni ubambe isiqiniseko sokuthi uhlinzekela abahlali abavamile izidingo zofakelo ezidingekayo njengoba kudinga ukuhlinzeka ngezisombululo ezingenamkhawulo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwenza abantu bahlale bephila, futhi izinsimu zikhuluphalisa umphakathi oqinile. Abahlengethisi bexhasa izinsiza ezimnandi kwabanye bephakathi, badala okuhlelwe okuphathelene nezokuphepha. Njengoba uHulumeni efuna ukubona izinselelo ezithile, okutholakala ezimpahleni, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izinga lokuhlala ngokuvumelanayo. Kobhusheni, kuhambisana nokusabalalisa izinaso ezincane ezivela ezindaweni ezilimele, abahlali baveze umuzwa wokufaka isandla nelawulwa; izinkampani zenza okuthile ukuze zithole izikhala zokuphumelela. Nokho, njengoba uHulumeni ezuza embusweni, izinzuzo ezithile zizinga eliphakeme. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhathi ezinzima sekufike etafuleni lokuqala, izinkampani ziqhubekela phambili neziqhamuka ezinhlosweni eziza nezinjongo. Ngalesi sikhathi eside, umphakathi uqhamuka nendawo eyamukelekayo yokusiza, okuholela emihlalweni emisha. Izinkampani zifuna ukusiza ukuze zibuyisele ekuqhulwini umphakathi, ukuze umzamo uholele empumelelweni. Ekugcineni, ukuba nezinhlaka eziphumelelayo, uHulumeni ulindele ukuvuma izigameko zomphakathi ezinhle. Ukuze izinsizakusebenza zibe lula, ukuhlola izindawo ezikuyiwonga umphakathi ucuthe, kubalulekile ukuvuselela. Umphakathi ukhiqiza okungako, uhulumeni kufanele ubuke bonke abacatshangwayo, ukuze kuhlelwe izinsiza zabantu bonke njengomkhankaso wokubuyisela isikhumbuzo kumphakathi. Izikhukhula seziqhubeka nesimo esinzima, kodwa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezinzima kuzoholela empumelelweni esizayo. Lokhu kuyahlinzeka ngezakhamizi umoya omusha, kanye nezenzo eziqondile zomphakathi zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi ehluphekayo. Ngaphandle kokulindelekile, kuyaluleka ukuba nokuqhuba umsebenzi wokubuyisa umphakathi, uqhubeke nezindlela eziphumelelayo, ukuze kube nempilo ehambisana namathemba ezakhamizi. Uhlanga lwebhizinisi kumele luhlale lukhula, kuhlelwe izinto ezinhle, nezinselelo zezakhamizi ziqhubeka. Lokhu kuphumelela okungakonti, umphakathi ubetha umoya, ubomvu kahle, umoya ohlanzekile, umphakathi ohlanga. Ukubonga isikhumbuzo sokubuka, ukuze kube nempilo ejabulisayo, kuzokhulisa intuthuko.

Ngonyaka ongenhla sizame kakhulu ukuphatha izihlahla, kodwa sathola ukuthi abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuphatha izihlahla ngendlela efanele ngoba isimo sezulu sibe namanzi amaningi. Lo nyaka ubuyisibonelo esihle sokukhombisa ukuthi ukuphatha izihlahla ngamakhemikhali kuyindlela efanele! Ezindaweni eziningi kube namanzi amaningi kakhulu, abalimi bangenakukhulisa phakathi kwemigqa, futhi abaningi bahluleka ekugcineni ukulwa nezihlahla. Manje yisikhathi esifanele sokubheka izinkambu zakho ngoba ngaleyo ndlela uzobona ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ongahlangabezana nazo ngonyaka ozayo. Izihlahla akufanele zikukhathaze - kungaba nezihlahla ezikhula eminyakeni eminingi, uzobona nje ukuthi seziqala ukukhula, noma izihlahla ezizokhula ngonyaka ozayo zizokhula ezithombeni ezawela emhlabathini ngenkathi usebenza enkambini kulo nyaka. Kusasele isikhathi sokushintsha indlela osebenza ngayo ezinkambini zakho. Ungashiyi izindawo ezincane lapho izihlahla zikhula khona, phatha le ndawo kahle kakhulu. Bheka ukuthi lezi zihlobo zikhona - kufanele wazi isitha esifuna ukudala inkinga, sishaye masinyane. Ungavumeli isitshalo sehlahla sibe nezithombo, izitshalo eziningi zehlahla eziphila isikhathi eside zingakhula ezithombeni nasemagxeni. Phatha izihlahla ngendlela ejwayelekile uma uphonsa. Khumbula njalo ukufuna amakhemikhali amasha abulala izinhlobo ezahlukene zezihlahla. Uzovimbela izihlahla ekukhuleni emaphethelweni ezinkambu (wenakker). Ukwanda kwezihlahla lapha kungasakazeka emkhakheni wonke. Qiniseka ukuthi ulungiselela kahle inkambu ngaphambi kokuphonsa, akufanele kube khona izihlahla enkambini ngaphambi kokuphonsa. Lokhu kuzokunika ithuba lokukhula ngaphandle kokuncintisana nezihlahla zokudla. Uma kukhona izitshalo eziphila isikhathi eside ezikhulayo, cabanga ngokusebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi "ukungaphonsi" uma uphonsa. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukubulala izihlahla ngamakhemikhali. Khulisa izinkambu lapho kukhona izitshalo zehlahla eziphila isikhathi eside ezikhulayo. Ukukhulisa kulimaza lokhu kakhulu (Bheka 7 ngenhla, kwesinye isikhathi kungaba ngcono ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali ukuze ubulale). Qaphela ungakwandisi izihlahla ngemishini uma uya enkabeni entsha - amagxeni nezithombo zehlahla zingasala emshinini. Uma usuzobe uqala ukukhulisa inkambu entsha, ungakhohlwa ukuhlanza imishini yakho. Yenza imephu yephanga lakho futhi ukhombise lapho lezi zinhlobo zezihlahla zikhula khona, ukuze ukhumbule ukuphatha lezo zindawo ngonyaka ozayo. Sijabule ngoba kubonakala ukuthi imakethe yokudla iyakhula - ngikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokuqhubekela phambili ukuze wena njengomkhiqizi ukwazi ukwenza inzuzo ngemva kokuvuna nokuthengisa imikhiqizo yakho. Khumbula ukuthi ukuhweba akukhona nje indlela yokuphila - kuyibhizinisi, ngakho kufanele uqonde ukusebenza ukuze wenze inzuzo ukuze ube umkhiqizi osiza leli bhizinisi manje nangesikhathi esizayo.
Isingeniso Ama-social media, noma imithombo yolwazi yokuxhumana, abe negalelo elikhulu empilweni yabantu abayizigidi emhlabeni jikelele. Le mithombo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ukwabelana ngolwazi, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zomphakathi. Ngaphandle kokuba imithombo yokuxhumana ithuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, nayo iphinde ivule amathuba amasha emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abanabile. Kulolu chungechunge, sizohlola imiqondo ebalulekile mayelana nezinzuzo, izingozi, nezimo ezingavela ngokusebenzisa ama-social media. Izinzuzo zama-Social Media Okokuqala, ama-social media afaka izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana. Ngokuvamile, abantu banganikeza imicabango yabo, babelane ngezinto abazifunayo, futhi baxoxe ngemicabango ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kudala umphakathi ozimele futhi okhuluma ngezinto ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kukhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okuholela ekwandeni kokubambisana. Okwesibili, ama-social media adlulisela ulwazi olusheshayo. Ngokusebenzisa ama-platform afana ne-Facebook, Twitter, ne-Instagram, abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olunembile futhi oluqondile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukukhipha imibiko emisha, izindaba zomphakathi, nezinye izinto ezithinta umphakathi. Izinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezahlukene zisebenzisa lawa ma-platform ukwenza izimemezelo, okunikeza abantu ulwazi lwakamuva ngempela. Okwesithathu, ama-social media ayivula iminyango emisha emsebenzini. Abantu bangaqala izinkampani zabo, baqale imikhankaso yokuthengisa, noma babe yizinhlelo ezidonsa abantu. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi kuhambisana nephuzu lokuthi ama-social media akha amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasebasha. Ngokukhuluma nabantu abaningi online, bangadonsa amakhasimende, bahlakulele izivumelwano, futhi bathuthukise ibhizinisi labo. Izingcuphe Nezingcindezi Nokho, noma kunezinzuzo eziningi, bakhona nabezindaba abakhombisa izingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa ama-social media. Okokuqala, i-cyberbullying iyinsakavukela. Abantu abathanda ukufaka imibono yabo bavame ukubhekana nezinsolo nokuhlukunyezwa online. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zokuphila, kubangele ukucindezeleka, kanye nezinye izimo zokuphila ezingezinhle. Abantu kumele babe neziqu ezanele nezindlela zokuvikela ukuze baziqinisekise ukuthi baphila kahle empilweni yomphakathi. Okwesibili, imithombo yolwazi yokuxhumana ingaba yinsiza embi yokusabalalisa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Ukuhlanya kwezindaba ezimbi, okuthiwa i-fake news, kudala ukufaniswa kokucabanga okungafanele. Lokhu kudala ukufutheka, ukudideka, nokuphikisana phakathi kwabantu. Kuhle ukuthi abantu babe nehloso enembile ukuze bathole ulwazi oluqondile oluhamba phambili. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana kakhulu kwamahhala okubhalwe kwi-inthanethi kungaholela ekwehliseni abantu emiphumeleni eyinqaba. Abantu bahlala behluleka ukulinganisa isikhathi abachasayo ema-social media, okuthatha isikhathi sabo esingokwemvelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baphile kahle, bazi ukulawula isikhathi sabo ukuze baphile impilo enempilo. Izindlela Zokuvikela Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu basathokozisa izinzuzo zama-social media, kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kudinga ukuba nezifundo ezithile ezivula izinsizakusebenza zokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazi izingozi nezinzuzo. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophusile nolwazi. Abafundi kufanele baqeqeshwe indlela yokubheka ulwazi, bakwazi ukusizakala ngalezi zinsizakusebenza. Okwesibili, izinkampani ezisebenzisa ama-social media kufanele zifake izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izivumelwano ezithathwa ngamakhasimende ziqiniswe, futhi bazi kahle ngezinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni isithombe esihle sebhizinisi, kanti izivakashi zikhuthazwe ukuba zisebenzisane ngempumelelo. Isiphetho Ngasohlangothini, ama-social media ayinsiza enkulu ekwenzeni umhlaba ubonakale. Noma kunjalo, njengazinye izinsiza, kudinga ukuba siqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nazo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba abantu bakwazi ukulawula indlela abaxhumana ngayo, bazi izimo eziyingozi, futhi bathathe izinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela. Ngemva kokuhlola zonke lezi zinto, kulindeleke ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-social media bube nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu, nakanjani uma kusebenza ngokucophelela.
Lena ucwaningo olujwayelekile mayelana nendlela isiko lokufundisa amalungelo abantu likhule ngayo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokusekelwe kumadokhumenti omhlaba kanye nezivumelwano zendawo, umlando wamalungelo abantu uvela ezindaweni ezikude neziseduze. Ngaphandle kwezindaba eziphathelene nokufundisa okugcizelelwe yilesi simo sokuthi umqondo wamalandawo abantu ungumqondo osanda kwenziwa uphumelele lapha eNingizimu Afrika, le ngxenye ihlose ukuhlaziya izivumelwano zomhlaba, zendawo, nezwe. Ubulungiswa obubhekene nabantu ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili buholele ekwenzeni isinqumo seZizwe Ezihlangene sokuzibophezela ngokomphakathi ekuhlonipheni nasekuvikeleni amalungelo abantu. Lesi sinyathelo saqala ngo-1946 lapho iZizwe Ezihlangene yasungula iSitatimende Sokuhlonipha Amalungelo Abantu. ENingizimu Afrika, njengelungu lezwe, ibambe iqhaza elikhulu kulesi sitatimende ngoba uMongameli wezwe, uJan Smuts, wabhala lesi sitatimende. Ezinye zezindima zesitatimende ziqinisa ukuthi iZizwe Ezihlangene "kufanele ihloniphe amalungelo abantu nezikhala ezisemqoka kubo bonke ngaphandle kokuhlukanisa ngokobuhlanga, ngocansi, ngolimi, noma ngenkolo." I-athikili 56 ifuna ukuthi wonke amazwe amalungu ahambisane nalesi sivumelwano. Nokho, kwaba sobala ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yaqhubeka nokwephula amalungelo abantu. Nakuba iZizwe Ezihlangene yayigcizelela njalo isinqumo sokuthi intshisekelo yabantu ibheke ekupheleni kokucwaswa ngokobuhlanga, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqhubeka nezinhlelo eziphula amalungelo abantu. Lo mbono uveza i-athikili 2.7 yesitatimende, evimbela iSishayamthetho sokuphepha ekungeneleleni "ezindabeni zangaphakathi" ezazisetshenziswe kabi ukuze kuzuzwe izinhloso zokwephula amalungelo abantu. Ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga eNingizimu Afrika kubonakala kuphikisana nezibopho zesitatimende, ngakho-ke ngo-1982, iZizwe Ezihlangene yanquma ukusola iNingizimu Afrika. I-athikili 2.7 yadala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwamalungelo abantu nezibopho ezilindelwe kumazwe amalungu ngoba le ngxenye yaqhubeka nokukhuluma ukuthi akukho okukhona kulesi sitatimende okuzovumela iZizwe Ezihlangene ukuthi ingenele ezindabeni ezisemqoka zangaphakathi ezweni elikwazi ukuziphatha kahle noma ezizodinga amazwe amalungu ukuthi kulethwe izindaba zokuxoxwa ngaphansi kwesitatimende, futhi le ndlela ngeke ibangele ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza kwemishini yokulungisa nokuphatha ngaphakathi, ngokwezinganekwane zeNgxenye VII. Naphezu kwezinkinga, lesi sitatimende sibe nendima ebalulekile ekukhuthazeni nasekuhleleni amazinga nemigomo yamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Isibonelo salokhu yizikhungo eziningi ezasungulwa ngaphansi kwemibono yeZizwe Ezihlangene ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezibopho zesitatimende. Lezi zifiso zafika ngendlela yezitatimende noma imihlangano. Izitatimende zemihlangano zawela emgqeni obanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvuma kwezivumelwano. Isitatimende sokuqala samukelwa ngo-1948, esaziwa ngokuthi iSitatimende Sokuhlonipha Amalungelo Abantu. Leli dokhumenti laqala lamukelwa amazwe angama-48 ezweni elinamalungu angama-56 ngoba ama-8 axhumene neNingizimu Afrika, eyayiphika. Nokho, leli dokhumenti lamukelwa yizikhungo eziningi ngaphakathi kwamazwe nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukubaluleka kwesitatimende kubonisa ukusebenza okukhulu kwesitatimende seZizwe Ezihlangene. Le mbono iboniswa embikweni wezindaba ophumelele kakhulu otholakala ehhovisi leMisebenzi Yezomthetho lapho kuthiwa, "mayelana nomoya nokubaluleka kwesitatimende, kungabonakala njengesenzo esinethonya ezikhungweni ezamukelayo, ngakho-ke kukhona izinkomba eziqinile zokuthi amazwe amalungu azohlonipha." Ngakho-ke, uma okukhulunywa ngakho kuholela ekwephuleni okwenziwa ngamaZwe, lesi sitatimende singakhombisa isimo sokwakha nokuphatha imithetho ebophelelayo kumazwe." Ukukhuthaza ukuvuma kwamalungelo abantu emhlabeni wonke kuvamile kumthetho weZivumelwano Zomhlaba Ngamazwe Ngamalungelo Okwabelana Nezombusazwe kanye neZivumelwano Zomhlaba Ngamazwe Ngamalungelo Okwabelana Nezomnotho, Ezokuxhumana Nezamasiko ngenhloso ecacile yokuguqula isitatimende esingabopheleli sibe yizimiso zomthetho ezibophelelayo, lezi zivumelwano zibizwa ngokuthi "Amandla Abantu Emhlabeni Wonke." Amandla Abantu Emhlabeni Wonke aqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1962. Enye indlela yokuvikela amalungelo abantu yakhuthazwa ngokwethulwa kwezivumelwano zendawo ezifana neSivumelwano saseYurophu ngo-1950 esihloselwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu nezikhala zomuntu. ISivumelwano saseYurophu saqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwamalungelo abantu eBophuthatswana kodwa lo mbono waphulwa nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika owayenamandla okulawula ohulumeni bezifunda. Engxoxweni edlule, kubonakala ukuthi isiko lamalungelo abantu bekufanele likhule ngokulandela izinhlinzeko zeSitatimende seZizwe Ezihlangene. Isibonelo; I-athikili 56 ithi amalungu abophekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokubambisana ndawonye nangokwehlukana nenhlangano mayelana nokufeza izinhloso ezibekwe nguMthetho 55. E-Ningizimu Afrika, ukuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kwavinjwa inqubo yokucindezela, ngakho-ke iZizwe Ezihlangene yaqala ukuwa empumelelweni yayo yokukhuthaza izinguquko kumthetho wobuhlanga kuze kube yathumela izijeziso ngo-1982. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isiko lamalungelo abantu langena e-Afrika lapho iMibutho ye-African Unity yasungula iSivumelwano sase-Afrika ngo-1961. Nakuba inqubo ibihamba kancane iminyaka engama-20, ngaphakathi komgomo wokuqala wokwamukela isivumelwano ngo-1981 njengeSivumelwano saseBanjul, lokhu kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwamukeleni umkhankaso wamalandawo abantu e-Afrika. Into eyaziwayo kakhulu ngesivumelwano kwakuwukwamukelwa "kwamalungelo abantu" njengokukhombisa ukuzibophezela ekukhuthazeni umqondo wamalandawo abantu. Lezi zikhumbuzo ziqiniswa ngesiqalo esikhombisa ukuzibophezela okwenziwe ngamalungu "ukuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu base-Afrika." Lezi zikhumbuzo zaba inselelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika ngoba kwakungekho ukuzibophezela ekwamukeleni nasekuvikeleni amalungelo abantu. Inkinga ibihlobene nokuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu anikezwa yiSivumelwano sase-Afrika kanye namalungelo umuntu afuna ngazo izivumelwano zamazwe. Ngakho-ke, kwaba sobala ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika idinga ukubambisana ekwamukeleni amalungelo abantu ngaphambi kokuqala kweSivumelwano sase-Afrika lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Le nselelo yakhuphuka kwelinye izinga ngamaAdvocate weMibutho Yamalungelo Abantu asungulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1979. Inhloso eyinhloko yalesi sikhungo wukugcina nokuqinisa amalungelo abantu ngokuh
Umsebenzi wezolimo awupheli. Lapho sicabanga ukuthi ukuvuna nokuthengisa isivuno kuphelile, umsebenzi wonyaka omkhulu omusha uqala. Manje yisikhathi esihle sokubheka okwenzekile ngonyaka odlule, ukuhlola izinqubo zokuphatha, nokubona ukuthi yiziphi izindlela ezisebenze kahle kakhulu. Uma ungakagcini amarekhodi wezinkambu ezithile eminyakeni edlule, kungaba kuhle ukuqala ngamarikhodi wonyaka odlule. Okulandelayo kufanele kufakwe kulawa marekhodi minyaka yonke: igama lephalamende, igama lesifunda, usayizi wephalamende, usayizi wezindawo ezilimiwe, ukujikeleza kwesivuno, izitshalo ezitshalwe, izindawo ezithola amanzi, izakhiwo, kanye konke okwakhiwe. Iphalamende ngalinye lingahlolwa mayelana nalokhu okulandelayo: indawo yalo (phezulu, eduze kwamanzi, njll.), ukujula komhlabathi, uhlobo lomhlabathi, umkhiqizo wombhali, nezinguquko ezimhlabathini ngokuhamba kwesikhathi (uma unama-result ezivivinyweni zomhlabathi), izinguquko ezitshalweni minyaka yonke, isivuno esatshalwe ngonyaka odlule (nangesikhathi sokutshala), ubunikazi besivuno, ukuqala kwemvula, inani lemvula ngaphambi kokutshala, inani lemvula ngesikhathi sokutshala, izindlela zokuphatha izihlahla (njengokusebenzisa amakhemikhali nokuthi zisebenza kanjani), ukulawulwa kwezinsongo, inani lesivuno, kanye quality. Izindleko zokufaka umanyolo zibalulekile kakhulu ohlelweni lwakho lwezolimo. Ukuthuthukisa isu elihle lokufaka umanyolo minyaka yonke kungaholela ezivunweni ezinhle. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi isimo sokukhiqiza somhlabathi sishintsha kanjani minyaka yonke. Ikakhulukazi, kufanele uhlolisise izimo zomhlabathi ngemuva konyaka omuhle. Isivuno esikhulu sithatha inqwaba yezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini, futhi uma kube nemvula eningi, izinto eziphilayo emhlabathini zingashintsha. Ngonyaka odlule, sabona ezindaweni eziningi ukuthi umumbu (nezinye izitshalo) ububomvu ngoba kube nokushoda kwe-nitrogen kanye ne-sulfur. Uma kube nesivuno esihle, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ubuyisela zonke izinto eziphilayo ezithathwe izitshalo emhlabathini. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kubonakala ukuthi ama-samples kufanele athathwe njalo ezinkambini lapho izitshalo zikhula khona ehlobo. Imiphumela yalezi zivivinyo ingasetshenziswa ukukhetha isivuno ofuna ukusitshala - umumbu, ubhontshisi, i-soybeans, i-sorghum, ama-nuts, ama-patato, ama-peas, noma okunye konke - lezi zivivinyo zizokutshela ukuthi ungathola kanjani inzuzo enhle ngoba zonke lezi zitshalo zidinga izinto eziphilayo ezahlukene. Imakethe yezitshalo ezithile izosiza futhi ukukhetha ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo okufanele uzihlanganise. Kunendlela ehlukene okufanele ilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwezinga lezinto eziphilayo nomanyolo kulungile ngendlela yakho yokulima. Lokhu kufaka izinto ezifana nokuthatha nokuhlola ama-samples ngendlela efanele, izindlela zokuhlola ezifanele, kanye nemiyalezo efanele ezokusiza ekulimaleni kwakho manje nasekusaseni. Ukuhlolwa komhlaba kuhlose ukuthola amazinga ezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini ezizosiza izitshalo zikhule kahle. Kuhlose futhi ukuthola izinkinga ezingaba khona ezingavimbela izitshalo ekukhuleni kahle. Ukuhlola amazinga ezinto eziphilayo akusiza futhi lapho ufaka ama-herbicides. Kubalulekile ukuthatha isampula ezomela yonke inkambu. Esampula engu-0.5 kg, kuzohlolwa kuphela amagremu amabili noma amathathu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhetha izinkambu ezifanayo ngobukhulu nangohlobo lomhlabathi. Ukuhlola kuhlola kuphela isampula; akukwazi ukuhlola yonke inkambu. Ngisho naphakathi kwenkambu eyodwa, kunezindawo ezahlukene zomhlabathi. Esikhathini esedlule, sasinjengokuthatha isampula eyodwa endaweni efanayo nehektare eziyishumi. Okwamanje, kungcono ukuthatha ibhola bese uzigcwalisa kulo lonke ibanga, uthatha ama-samples kuyo yonke inkambu bese uwabeka ezikhwameni - ukujula kufanele kube phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm, kodwa akufanele kudlule u-20 cm. Uma usebenzisa isikhwama somanyolo esidala, jikelezisa isikhwama ngoba umanyolo osele esikhwameni ungashintsha imiphumela yokuhlola yalowo mhlabathi. Ungathatha ama-samples amaningi, kodwa uma uzigcwalisa, ungathatha ama-samples njalo emamethri angama-100 kuya kwangama-200. Thatha ama-samples phakathi kwemigqa njengoba kungase kube nezindawo lapho bekungekho izitshalo eziningi ngonyaka odlule - lezi zindawo zingase zikhombise ukuthi kunezinto eziningi eziphilayo kuyo yonke inkambu. Zonke lezi zampula kufanele zihlanganiswe, bese uthatha isampula engu-500 gm bese uyibeka ezibhokisini ze-lab. Ibhokisi eline-samples kufanele libe nelebuli ekhombisa inombolo yenkambu, igama lephalamende, ikheli lomnikazi, izinombolo zocingo, kanye nesikhathi sokuthatha isampula. Lokhu kuzovimbela ama-samples ukuthi angahlanganiswa nezinye. Kungaba kuhle ukukwenza lokhu enkambeni lapho uhambisa khona ama-samples. Uma kunezindawo ezikhiqiza ukudla okuhle, kungaba kuhle ukuthatha isampula kule ndawo ethile. Lokhu kungasiza ukuqhathanisa le sampula nezinye, futhi kuzoba sobala ukuthi yiziphi izindawo ezikhiqiza kahle futhi yiziphi ezidinga umanyolo owengeziwe ukuze kukhuphuke ukukhiqiza kulezo zindawo. Ama-samples akufanele athathwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile - izindawo ezingavamile ukulima, ezifana eduze kweminyango, ezindaweni zokuphosa, nezindawo lapho umhlabathi uhlehlisiwe. Ubuchwepheshe besimanje busivumela ukuthi sisebenzise i-Global Positioning System (GPS) ukuze sakhe i-grid lapho izindawo enkambeni zingaphawulwa (0.5m kude). Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zindawo zingahlolwa ukuze kubonakale ukuthi umhlabathi kulezi zindawo ushintshile noma uhlala unjengoba unjalo. Imiphumela ingahlolwa ngokusebenzisa i-Ground Information System (GIS) ukuze kutholakale 'ichati' ekhombisa i-pH, i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-phosphorus, i-sulfur, i-nitrogen, nezinye izinkomba, zonke ezimele ngokuqondile. Isikhathi esihle sokuthatha ama-samples yileso lapho kungekho umsebenzi omningi epulazini, lapho ungabona khona kahle zonke izinkambu ukuze uzihlukanise kahle (izindawo ezifanayo) futhi ngasikhathi sinye minyaka yonke ngemuva kokuvuna. Kungasiza futhi ukuthumela ama-samples lapho ama-labs engabusi. Ngokuvamile, athokozisa kakhulu ngaphambi kwesizini yokutshala ngoSepthemba no-Okthoba. Hlangana nabathengisi ngokushesha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unalesi sikhathi somyalezo. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlolwa komhlaba - i-phosphorus (P), i-potassium (K), i-nitrogen, ne-pH, kufanele kuthathwe ngokuqina kuka-0 cm kuya ku-15 cm. Mhlawumbe isampula eyodwa ingathathwa ifike ku-20 cm. Qiniseka ukuthi isikhwama esine-mhlabathi sikhombisa kahle ukuthi iyiphi inkambu lapho isampula ithathwe khona futhi sibe nenombolo yaso. Vala kahle izikhwama, ubeke ezindaweni ezibandayo, bese uthumela ngokushesha ukuze kuhlolwe. Okulandelayo kudingeka: imephu yezinkambu, izinombolo zezinhlobo zomhlabathi, ama-GPS coordinates ebhola noma isikhwama, izikhwama ezinkulu
Umlando: Le ngqungquthela inikeza ithuba eliyingqayizivele kithi sonke lokho okwenza sikhulume futhi siqinise ubukhona bethu njengabantu abanolwazi, futhi sonke singabamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezibonakalayo, ezitholakalayo futhi sithuthukise amasu nezinhlelo ezizosisiza ukuthi siphile impilo ehambisana neNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi (Esekela uMongameli uJacob Zuma). I-MRM iyinhlangano esekelwe emiphakathini engafanele isetshenziswe ngababusi abaphezulu kodwa ngumphakathi uqobo. Inhloso yayo ukuhlanganisa zonke izindaba eziphathelene nomphakathi ezithinta ubuqotho. Ukuziphatha okuhle kuboniswa kuzo zonke izinkolo, futhi abantu bafuna ukuguqula zonke izindlela ezingamukeleki emiphakathini nezinyathelo eziphazamisa izwe lethu. I-MRM izogcizelela umgomo wokuthi umuntu ngamunye kufanele anakekele impilo yabanye, kuqala ngokuqonda ukuthi sikhululeka ezicindezelweni ze-apartheid futhi kufanele sikhululeke emiphumeleni ye-apartheid - uMongameli uThabo Mbeki. I-MRM iyisakhiwo sokukhuthaza, ukusekela, ukwazisa, nokuxhumanisa zonke imibono evela emiphakathini ehlukene. Igxile emphakathini onokwethenjelwa onemigomo emihle. Inhloso yale nhlangano ukuvuselela umoya we-Ubuntu/Botho, sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezivela kuhulumeni nasemphakathini. I-MRM izibophezele ekwakheni amazinga amahle okuziphatha ngokusekelwe kumthethosisekelo wezwe, "okuyisisekelo esichaza izimiso esizibophezele futhi sifisa zonke izizwe zomhlaba zibe nathi." Ukuhlinzeka ngama-ithuba okucabangela okwedlule, okwamanje mayelana nezimiso eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuveza amasu nemizamo yokwakha izimiso zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi. Ukusiza ekwakheni inhlangano enkulu yokweseka uhulumeni nomphakathi emizamweni yokuhlela izinhlelo ezingavuselela imiphakathi ngokwezimiso. Ukwakha izinhlelo ezizinzile zokuvuselela izimiso. Ukwandisa imizamo kazwelonke yokwakha ukuqwashisa ngokuqinisa umphakathi onemigomo emihle, onakekelayo futhi okhululekile ekukhwabaneni. Ukuqinisa izisekelo zenkululeko yethu esiyitholile kanzima kanye nedemokhrasi ngokwakha umphakathi onemigomo emihle ogxile ekuziphatheni okuhle nasekukhulumeni. Ukuveza uhlelo lwezwe oluzolandela, oluzosuka ezinhlelweni zenkululeko nezasezifundazweni ngokubheka izilinganiso ezijwayelekile. Ukusebenzisa isu elivumela amaphephandaba nabakhangisi ukuba babambe iqhaza ekusakazeni imibiko mayelana neMoral Regeneration Movement (MRM) kulo lonke izwe. Ukwakha uhlelo lokubambisana oluhlanganisa umphakathi wonke, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nohulumeni. Ukwakha amasu ajulile asebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene anganikeza izixazululo zokukhwabanisa emiphakathini. Ukwethulwa kwe-MRM kube umcimbi oyingqayizivele ngoba kuhlanganise abantu abangu-1,300 abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe, befinyelela ngezindiza, amabhasi, nezimoto, befuna izindlela zokwakha umphakathi onobuntu. Kwakukhona othisha, abaphathiswa, amalungu ePhalamende, abaholi bamaphele, intsha, abaholi bezinkolo, izinhlangano ezizimele, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nezinhlelo zomsebenzi. Bakhombisa ukuzinikela kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo lokwakha isisekelo sokuvuselela izimiso kulesi sizwe. Ukwethulwa kuhlinzeke ithuba kubantu baleli zwe ukuba bahlale behlangene ekuphatheni nasekukhulumeni ngolimi olulodwa ezindabeni eziphathelene nokuvuselelwa kwezimo. Umphakathi we-MRM, uMnu.
