Ukubulawa!, ukuhweba!, ukuhlukunyezwa!, izidakamizwa, ukukhwabanisa, ubuhlanga, ubugebengu, ukwephula amalungelo abesifazane nezingane, umehluko phakathi kwabacebile nabampofu, ukungaboni ngasese, ubuhlobo, ukukhwabanisa kuhulumeni nomphakathi. Kungani konke lokhu kwenzeka kithi? Kufanele siqale ngokuhlola imbangela yephutha. Siphathwe kabi ngenxa yokwehluleka kwedlule, umthelela wokuphathwa kwamanye amazwe, kanye ne-apartheid, ebulala umcabango wethu nendlela esibona ngayo izinto, isishiya nezinkinga ezinkulu. Futhi kukhona ukwehluleka okuningi okwamanje. Inkululeko yenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo zokushintsha kusuka ekucindezelweni kwamandla angaphandle kuya esikweni ledemokhrasi elihambisana nezibopho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nendlela entsha yokubhekana nokuphila kusukela ngo-1994. Abaningi bayagxeka imidiya, ngokuvamile begcizelela lokho esingakufuni ukuthuthukisa: ukuhluleka kwamaphoyisa ukubamba abaphula umthetho, izinkantolo, nababhekele izimiso, noma bagxeka uhulumeni. Kodwa kufanele sizibuze. Ukuba nefa namandla kuyaphambanisa umbono wezwe elisha ngokuqondiswe ekuphathweni kokufuna amandla amaningi nokuhlukumeza kuleli zwe. Singabuyisela kanjani umqondo wethu kubuntu - uma imali iba unkulunkulu abaninzi abamkhonzile, uma izinqubo zethu zenza abaningi bahlupheke, futhi uma umoya wobuntu nezimiso ezinhle uqhubeka nokuncipha? Ithemba lethu lokuphendula kulezi zindaba ligxile kahle. Ezinye izizwe zinezinselelo ezifanayo, kodwa izindlela esizibophezele ekuphenduleni kulezi zindaba zihluke. Amandla ethu ukuthi izinkolo zethu zibophezele ekuphileni okuhle kithi sonke. Izimpande zethu zisesigodini sethu lapho abantu bahlala, basebenza, futhi badlala ndawonye. Singakha isizwe esisha ngokubambisana kwabantu bonke baleli zwe. Inhloso yethu ukuvuselela izinhlangano zethu nezakhiwo zethu, hhayi ukuqala kabusha. Ukuvuselelwa kwezimo kuyindawo esikuyo. Lapho sikhona nasezinhlakeni, futhi thina sonke, singaphendula kulezi zindaba ngokubhekana nezinselelo zokuvuselelwa kwezimo. Iseshini yasekuseni yayiholwa nguMnu. Tim Modise, owabandakanya izithameli, okwenziwa ngokucula, ukudansa, namazwi agxile empumelelweni nakho okunye esingakwenza. Lokhu kuqinisa izimiso esinazo ngaphakathi, isithunzi, kanye nobuhle bomoya wobuntu. Labo ababephuza izidakamizwa, baphila ne-HIV, amaqembu omculo ejele, amaqembu edansa entsha - bonke bakhombisa ngesenzo nasezobuciko umoya wethemba lapho ukudangala kukhula, ukuzimisela lapho kunenkinga, ukuzibophezela uma bebhekene nokwehla kwezimo. Le mthetho ikhishwa lapho kwenziwa isicelo sokubeka inani elithile elizokwenziwa emholweni womuntu okhokhayo. Umqashi kufanele uthumele lesi sicelo egameni labasebenzi. Lezi ziqondiso azidluliselwa, futhi uma umqashi eshintsha isimo sokusebenza, kufanele kwenziwe isicelo esisha. Uma unamaqashi amaningi, isicelo seziqondiso kufanele senziwe kumqashi ngamunye. Amakhophi wezivumelwano zomsebenzi, izivumelwano zomsebenzi, neminye imibhalo efanele iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe imigomo nemibandela yokusebenza. Iziqondiso zephesenti elithile zizokwenziwa isikhathi esingama-12 months futhi kufanele zihlaziywe ngemuva kwalokho. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zentela zisesimweni esihle uma ufaka isicelo seziqondiso zentela. I-SARS ngeke ikhiphe isiqondiso sentela uma unenkokhelo yentela. Inombolo yokubhekisela ye-PAYE yomqashi wakho iyadingeka. Incwadi echaza kahle iyadingeka uma ungenayo inombolo ye-ID noma inombolo yokubhekisela ye-PAYE. Faka isicelo sakho seziqondiso zephesenti elithile mathupha ehhovisi le-SARS, njengoba umqashi kufanele athumele isitatimende seziqondiso zemiholo nezindleko. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwa yi-SARS, uzothola ukuqinisekiswa phakathi nezinsuku ezimbalwa. Nokho, isiqondiso esisemthethweni sentela singathatha cishe amasonto amane. Ama-Drone: Uhlanga Olusha Kwezobuchwepheshe Nokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi Eminyakeni yamuva, ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe kubonakale kakhulu emikhakheni ebanzi, futhi phakathi kwalezi zinto ezisho ukuguquka okukhulu, ama-drone abambe iqhaza elikhulu. Ama-drone, noma ama-‘unmanned aerial vehicles’ (UAVs), asungulwa ngokuqhubekayo, futhi asebenza ezindaweni eziningi okubandakanya ezokuphepha, ezokuthutha, nezikhungo zomphakathi. Lezi zindiza ezingathathi muntu ziguqule indlela umhlaba osebenza ngayo, zifaka izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, zikhulisa ukusebenza, futhi ziphendula izidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Igama Nencazelo Igama elithi "drone" libhalwa lishintshile kusukela enkathini yokusebenzisa abantu, liqhamuka ku-‘drone’ elichaza ithuluzi lempi noma ivenkile yempi. Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone abhekisela ezindizeni ezingenamkhumbi, ezakhiwe ngezinto ezilula kakhulu nezisebenza kahle. Lezi zindiza zifakwe izinjini ezincane, izinhlelo zokubhalela, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukile ezikuvumela ukuba ulethe imishanguzo, udlule ngaphezu kwezithiyo, noma uqaphele izimo ezithile zomhlaba ngokwenziwe. Ukusetshenziswa Kwezezimali Nezemidlalo Ama-drone asheshe avunyelwe emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Ekuqaleni, ama-drone asetshenziswa kakhulu ezindaweni zempilo, okuthiwa "drone delivery services," okuvumela ukuhanjiswa kwemishanguzo ezindaweni ezinzima ukufinyelela. Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu ezifundazweni ezisemakhaya, lapho abantu behlangabezana nezinkinga zokuthola imishanguzo edingekayo. Uhlamvu lwezempilo lwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo ngokuqhubekayo, luthuthukisa impilo yabantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone ahlonyiselwa izinjini zokubhalela ezithuthukile ziye zathathwa ngabathandi bezemidlalo, okuhlanganisa ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukugijima, nokunye. Lezi zinto ziveza ulwazi olunembile, futhi zithuthukisa ukufundwa kwezemidlalo, zenza kube lula ukugxila ezindaweni ezithile ngesikhathi esifanele. Izinselelo Nezinkinga Zokuphepha Nokho, nakuba ama-drone enza izinto eziningi ezinhle, ubuchwepheshe bawo bukhona nezinkinga. Ukuze ama-drone asebenze kahle, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokulawula ezimfanele. Ukuntuleka kwezinhlelo ezivikelekile, kudala ingozi yokusebenzisa ama-drone ngezindlela ezingekho emthethweni, okubangela ukungabikhona kokuphepha. Lokhu kuphinde kudinge izinqubo ezithile kumthetho. Izinkinga ezinkulu zihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa okungafanelekwanga kwamadrones, njengokubhekelwa okuphathelene nemfihlo, lapho ama-drone angase abhekelele abantu noma izindawo ezingafanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi, ohulumeni, nezinkampani zisebenze ndawonye ukuze kwehliswe lezi zinkinga, kufakwe imithetho eqondile yokusetshenziswa kwamadrones. Ikhono Lokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-drone abamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuthola ulwazi nezinsiza. Imithetho ethile isebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-drone asetshenziswa kahle, aqhubele phambili ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, futhi akhulise amathuba okuthuthukisa imiphumela emihle. Ubuchwepheshe balo bulandela indlela yokwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo ekusesheni, kulinganise ukusetshenziswa okungafanele, ngaleyo ndlela kuphumelele ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Iziphetho Ngamafuphi, ama-drone ayizinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezithuthukisa izinqubo eziningi emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, futhi zishintsha izindlela zokuphila zabantu. Nokho, kunezinselelo ezikhona ezidinga ukuhlaziywa ukuze ama-drone asindiswe ngendlela efanele. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke ubambisene ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezizothuthukisa ukuphepha nempilo yawo wonke umuntu, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-drone akha amathuba kumphakathi wonke. Iqiniso lokuthi lezi zinto zisebenza ezindaweni eziningi, libonisa ukubaluleka kokuhlola nokuqonda izinzuzo ezisa nazo uhlelo lokusebenza lwama-drone, futhi kuyasiza ekukhetheni ukuthi imiphakathi ifanele ukusebenzisa kanjani lezi zinhlelo ezintsha.
Isahluko 1: Ukuqala Kwenkathi Ezikhathini ezedlule, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kwaba yinkinga evame ukubonwa emiphakathini ehlukene. E-Afrika, ikakhulukazi, lezi zinkinga zaziqhakanjiswa kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi, ezinkolelweni, nasezindlela zokuphila. Ngalesi sikhathi, imikhuba yokukhulelwa kwentsha yayihambisana nezinkolelo zamasiko, lapho intsha ifunda khona izifundo ezibalulekile zokuphila. Abantu abasha babebhekene nezinselele ezinzima, ezivame ukuhambisana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nokuntuleka kwemfundo, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Isahluko 2: Izizathu Zokukhulelwa Kwentsha Izizathu zokukhulelwa kwentsha zihluke kakhulu. Ezinye zazo zifaka phakathi ukuntuleka kwemfundo efanele, ukungazi kahle ngezindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezimo zomndeni. Ezinye izindawo, ukungabi namathuba okukhuluma ngempilo yokuziphatha, kanye nezinkolelo ezithile ezivumela ubudlelwano obungajwayelekile, kwaholela ekukhulelweni kwentsha. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yentsha, okwandisa izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, ukushoda kwemali, kanye nezinkinga zempilo. Isahluko 3: Umthelela Emphakathini Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akuthinti umuntu oyedwa kuphela, kodwa kubangela umthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Abantwana abakhulelwe bahlala bephakathi kwezimo ezinzima, okwandisa izinga lokungasebenzi, njengoba abantwana abakhulelwe bengenakuphothula izifundo zabo. Umphakathi ubhekana nezinselele eziningi, ezifana nokwanda kwezinga lokuhlukumezeka, ukungabi namathuba emisebenzi, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo. Isahluko 4: Izixazululo Nezinyathelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imiphakathi yathola izixazululo ezihlukahlukene zokubhekana nale nkinga. Izinhlelo zokufundisa intsha ngempilo, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantwana abakhulelwe zaba zinyathelo ezibalulekile. Izikhungo zemfundo zathuthukiswa, futhi izinhlelo zokuxhumana zakhuliswa ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi intsha ifinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa, okwakwenza kube lula ukuba intsha ibone izindlela zokuphila ezihamba phambili. Isahluko 5: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinkolelo Izinkolelo zomphakathi zashintsha. Imiphakathi yathola ukuthi ukukhulelwa kwentsha akuyona into eyamukelekayo, futhi kwadingeka ukuba kube nezinguquko ezinkulu. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha iyakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono, izinhlelo zokuxhumana zathuthukiswa, futhi abantu baphendukela ezindleleni ezihamba phambili zokuxhasa abantwana abakhulelwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nohulumeni. Isahluko 6: Ukubheka Phambili Namuhla, ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuseyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, imizamo yokubhekana nale nkinga iyaqhubeka. Izinhlelo zokufundisa, izikhungo zokuxhasa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ziyaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda, futhi intsha iyakwazi ukuthola amathuba angcono. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokwakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuba intsha ibone izindlela ezinhle zokuphila. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kuyinkinga eyinkimbinkimbi, enezizathu eziningi nezimo ezithinta umphakathi. Nokho, imizamo yokubhekana nale nkinga iyavuma, futhi umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda. Ngokuqhubeka nokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokwakha izixazululo, singasiza intsha yethu ukuba ibone izindlela ezinhle zokuphila, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa lethu sonke. Ukukhulelwa kwentsha akufanele kube yimpilo yokuhlupheka, kodwa kufanele kube yithuba lokukhula, ukufunda, nokuphila impilo engcono.
Izimo ezisemqoka zomthetho zivezwe kule mthetho. b 'Bid' ibhekisela esicelweni esibhaliwe ngendlela ethile noma esivezwe ngokuphendula isimemo esivela enhlanganweni kahulumeni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo, imisebenzi, noma izinto. m 'Abasebenzi BeSupply Chain Management' baphinde babhekisele kuMphathi Wezezimali, uMphathi Wezikhwama: Izimpahla, Ababhalisi Bezikweletu, nababhalisi bezitolo kanye noMphathi Wezezimali; futhi 'Tender' esetshenziswe enqubweni yokuthengwa kusho 'bid' emkhakheni wenqubo yokubhida kanye 'nencazelo' elandela inqubo yokuthengwa kwezimpahla noma izinsizakalo ukuze kutholakale izindleko ze-R100,000. Ingxenye yokuthengwa ibhekelele ukulungiselela umsebenzi wezokuphatha ongazelelwe. Umphathi nguMphathi Wezezimali obika kuMphathi Wezezimali wombuso. Amanzi avela kwiMnyango Wezamanzi noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi, emnyangweni omunye, noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi; kanti ugesi uvela ku-Eskom noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi, emnyangweni omunye, noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi. ngokubhala, kuchaza kahle uhlobo nenani/isikhathi lezimpahla nezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ukulungiselela imininingwane ethile okuhloswe ngayo ukuthenga izimpahla noma izinsizakalo ezivela kubanikezeli abathile kanye/noma amagama ezigaba akufanele asetshenziswe. Kuqinisekiswe ngokuphelele nguMphathi wesigaba esifanele, noma umuntu ogunyaziwe, ukuthi isimo esanele senziwe ebhajethi yokuthengwa. UMphathi Wezezimali uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona uhlelo lokuphatha olufanele lwezidingo, olunikeza izidingo zokuthengwa kumasipala. Lezi zidingo zizofaka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla zifinyelelwa nezinsizakalo zinikezwa ngesikhathi, endaweni efanele, ngentengo eyavunyelwene, nasemazingeni afanele nenani. Uma ukuthengwa kunezimo zebhajethi ezizayo, isigaba 33 se-MFMA mayelana nezinkontileka sizolandelwa. Ngemuva kokuthengwa kwalomthetho, isigaba 33 ngeke sibe khona ezinkontilekayo ezinomsebenzi ongaphansi kwe-R1 million noma njengoba kubekwe yiMali Yezwe. Ukwengeza okulandelayo kufaka phakathi izingxenye 19 no-33 ze-MFMA. b Isicelomali esibhaliwe esinokulinganiselwa phakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000; kanye c Inqubo yokubhida yokuncintisana enokulinganiselwa okudlula ku-R100,000. Izimpahla nezinsizakalo ngeke zihlukaniswe zibe izingxenye noma ziqoqwe njengemali encane ukuze kugwenywe izidingo zomthetho. Izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiswe ezindlekweni eziphakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000 zingathengwa ngokuthola okungenani izincwadi ezintathu zokubhala ezivela ohlwini lwabanikezeli abavunyelwe. Zonke izincwadi zokubhala zizofaka izindleko zokuhamba. Abanikezeli bazohlinzeka ngamanani aqinisekisiwe ngokubhala kanye nokutholakala kwesitokwe ngaphambi kokufaka i-oda. Igama labanikezeli kanye namanani abawabhalile azogcinwa ngumuntu ophumelele ngaphakathi kwengxenye yokuthengwa, njengoba kugunyazwe nguMphathi Wezezimali. Uma kungenakwenzeka ukuthola okungenani izincwadi ezintathu zokubhala, isizathu salokhu sizogcinwa nguMphathi Wezezimali, futhi lezi zizathu zizobikiswa kuMphathi Wezezimali okungenani njalo ezinyangeni. Izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiselwa ezindlekweni eziphakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000 zingathengwa ngokumema izincwadi zokubhala ezivela kubanikezeli abavunyelwe abangu-3 okungenani. Isicelo sezincwadi zokubhala sizokwenziwa yiNgxenye Yokuthengwa yeMnyango Wezezezimali. Ngempahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiselwa ezindlekweni ezedlula ku-R30,000, izikhumbuzo zokubhala zizoboniswa ebhodini lesaziso lesifunda elinikezwe umgomo wokubonisa izincwadi zokubhala nezinsizakalo, kuwebhusayithi yesifunda, futhi zingakhangiswa nganoma iyiphi indlela efaneleka nguMphathi Wezezimali. Lezi zikhumbuzo zizoboniswa okungenani izinsuku eziyi-7 kusukela ngosuku zishicilelwe futhi zizokhombisa usuku lokugcina lokufaka, ngaphandle uma izimo zesigaba 10 zisebenza. Uma kungenakwenzeka ukuthola izincwadi ezintathu zokubhala, izizathu zalokhu kuzokwenziwa nguMphathi Wezezimali futhi kuzovunywa nguMphathi Wezezimali futhi kuzovunywa nguMphathi Wezezimali ngaphambi kokwamukela incwadi yokubhala. Kumele ihambisane nanoma iyiphi imibhalo edingekayo nguMphathi Wezezimali (CFO). Uma nganoma yisiphi isizathu, le nqubo ayilandeli, izizathu zalokhu kuzogcinwa nguMphathi Wezezimali futhi kuvunywe nguMphathi Wezezimali. Izincazelo zokubhida zizokwenziwa ngokukhethekile ngezinto ezikhonjiswe esigabeni 7. Ukuze i-bid ibhekwe, kumele ihlangabezane nazo zonke izidingo zemibhalo yokubhida (njengokuchazwe esigabeni 5.1) futhi ibekwe ebhokisini le-bid elisemthethweni elinikezwe njengokukhangiswa. Ibhodi izodinga idiphozi engabuyiselwa emuva yokufaka imibhalo yokubhida. Inani lediphozi lizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke. UMphathi Wezezimali noma umuntu ogunyaziwe uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhokisi okubhida avaliwe kuze kube sekuvuliwe ngokusemthethweni futhi aqinisekiswe kahle. Ngesikhathi sokukhangiswa, ibhokisi lokubhida lizovulwa futhi livalwe ngabasebenzi ababili: omunye ovela eMnyangweni Wezezimali nomunye ovela eMnyangweni Wokubambisana, lapho kufanele khona, isisebenzi esivela emnyangweni lapho i-bid ihlosiwe. Ibhokisi lizovulwa emphakathini, okusho ukuthi kukhona izibhedlela kanye nezithakazelo ezikhona. Umphathi WeSupply Chain Management uzovula imibhalo yokubhida (endaweni echazwe embhalweni wokubhida) nomuntu ovela eMnyangweni Wokubambisana, emnyangweni ofanele, kanye nanoma yimuphi omunye ozithakazelayo. Njengoba isikhathi nendawo yokukhangiswa efanele ilandelwa, ibhokisi lokubhida lingavulwa noma ngabe amalungu omphakathi awatholakali. Amagama ababhidayo kanye nezimali zokubhida zizofundwa futhi zigcinwe kwi-rejista yokubhida, ezotholakala ukuze ibonwe emphakathini uma kucelwa. Irekhodi lokuqala lizogcinwa ehhovisi likaMphathi Wezezimali, futhi ikhophi yerekhodi kumele ihlinzekwe kumphathi wesigaba ofanele. Ezimweni zezenzakalo ezinkulu zokubhida ezithatha isikhathi eside ukufundwa, kuphela ababhidayo abaceliwe bazofundwa, futhi uhlu oluphelele luzohlinzekwa ngokushesha okukhulu. Imiphumela ye-bid izoshicilelwa kuwebhusayithi noma ebhodini lesaziso lesifunda. Ezinhlelweni ezinkulu eziyinkimbinkimbi noma ezinhlelweni ezikhethekile, lapho kungadingeki futhi kungabizi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango yezobuchwepheshe ngaphambi, ukubhida kungaqhutshelwa ezigabeni ezimbili. Isigaba sokuqala ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango yezobuchwepheshe ngaphandle kokulinganiselwa kwentengo ngokusekelwe ezithombeni zomqondo noma ezichazayo zokuphumelela. Lezi zicebiso zizoba ngaphansi kokulungiswa nokucaciswa kanye nezilungiso zob
Wena, njengomnikazi wemishini nezinsiza, kufanele wazi ukuthi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokubheka abantu abasebenza nalezi zinto. Izimo ezifana nalezi zivame ukudala ubungozi. Ukungasebenzisi imishini yokuvikela. Ukusebenza ngemishini ngesikhathi isahamba. Ukusebenzisa amathuluzi afanele: ungasebenzisi amathuluzi amancane ukwenza umsebenzi wamathuluzi amakhulu. Gcina amathuluzi esimweni esihle: qinisekisa ukuthi akhanyisiwe futhi alinganisiwe kahle futhi uwahlanzile njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-pins aqinile. Sebenzisa izing glasses zokuvikela uma usebenza. Sebenzisa umask uma kukhona uthuli oluningi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokuphepha iyasebenza kahle. Vimba izingane ekungeni. Bonke abavakashi endaweni yokusebenza (isitolo) akufanele basondele endaweni lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Gcina indawo yokusebenza ikhazimula kahle. Izinto eziphukile yonke indawo zidalela ubungozi. Beka amathuluzi kude ngemva kokuwasebenzisa - awadingeki lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Vala wonke amathuluzi aphethwe ngogesi. Gqoka izingubo ezifanele. Izingubo ezikhululekile zingabamba emishinini. Qinisa umsebenzi wakho: sebenzisa ama-clamps nezinsiza zamathuluzi owasebenzisayo. Kungcono ukubamba ngezandla zakho ngoba manje uzokwazi ukusebenzisa bobabili izandla uma usebenza. Ungazami ukwenza amathuluzi akho enze imisebenzi emikhulu kakhulu. Ungazami ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Qinisekisa ukuthi ume ngokuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Donsa i-lever - ungapushi. Uma kunzima ukudonsa, sebenzisa isikhumba sesandla sakho ukuphusha. Amathuluzi akhanyisiwe akufanele aqondiswe emzimbeni wakho. Lokhu kungavimbela izingozi uma ithuluzi lishayisa. Xhuma yonke imishini ephethwe ngogesi emhlabeni (umhlaba). Sebenzisa ipulaki enezinhlangothi ezintathu kuphela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukukhanya okwanele nokuhlinzekwa komoya endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-bench akhazimulayo futhi ukuthi umoya ongcolile uqhubeka uphume esitolo. Ngokufanayo, gcina ithuluzi lokwelapha elibalulekile liseduze. Bhekisisa noma yiziphi izingozi ezincane ngokushesha ukuze uvimbele ingozi enkulu ekwenzekeni.
Izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa Izibhedlela zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi njengoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola izinsizakalo zempilo eziyisisekelo. Nokho, eMpumalanga Kapa, njengasemaphandleni amaningi eNingizimu Afrika, izibhedlela zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezithinta ukusebenza kwazo. Lezi zinkinga zihlanganisa ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukusweleka kwezisebenzi, kanye nezinsiza eziphumelelayo. Okokuqala, izinsiza zempilo eMpumalanga Kapa ziningi, kodwa zisezingeni eliphansi. Izibhedlela zisebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza ezanele, okuhlanganisa imithi, izinsiza zokuphatha, kanye nezinto ezisemqoka zokunakekela iziguli. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokukhula, izibhedlela zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngensiza efanelekile. Ukuntuleka kwemithombo yokusebenza kuholela ekutheni izisebenzi zempilo zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuphumelelayo kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangamaZulu. Okwesibili, ukusweleka kwezisebenzi zempilo, ikakhulukazi odokotela nabanye abasebenzi, kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. EMpumalanga Kapa, ubukhulu bokushoda kwezisebenzi buhambisana nezimo zokusebenza ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuheha abasebenzi abasha. Lokhu kuthinta kakhulu ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezithuthukisa impilo yabantu. Izibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zihlala zibhekene nezinselelo zokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Imisebenzi emisha ibhekana nezinselelo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phambili. Ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezithembekile kudinga ukugxila ekuthuthukisweni kwezokwakha ukuze izibhedlela zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kokuntuleka kwemithombo, ezinye izinkinga ezinzima zihlanganisa ukungabi khona kukagesi, izinsiza zokuphatha, kanye nezinkinga zokusebenza kwemishini. Izibhedlela zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zinezinsiza eziphathekayo ukuze zigweme ukungasebenzi kahle. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo ezinhle zokufaka ezibhedlela ukuze zithuthuke. Imininingwane eqoqiwe ingasiza ekuboneni izinkinga ezitholakalayo. Ukuze impilo ithuthuke, izinkinga zengqalasizinda zidinga amasu nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo. Imiphakathi idinga ukwaziswa ngokubaluleka kokukhululwa kwemali ukuze izibhedlela zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukusiza ukuhlela ukuhlinzeka, kubalulekile. Abantu bangenwa ukuhamba-bhuku, imibiko evumayo, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo eziphathelene nezinsizakusebenza. Iziqu zobuchwepheshe zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ezikhungweni ezahlukahlukene. Ukuze impilo eMpumalanga Kapa iphumelele, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokubambisana phakathi kwezokwakha, izinhlelo zomphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zempilo. Imiphakathi ingabamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela ngokuba nemihlangano, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kanye nokukhuthaza ukutshalwa kwezimali. Uma izinkinga zengqalasizinda ziqhubeka, impilo yabantu izothinteka, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izibhedlela. Ekugcineni, izinkinga zengqalasizinda yezibhedlela eMpumalanga Kapa zidinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlelo ezithintekayo. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezisebenzayo, ukufaka izinsizakusebenza, nokuthola izixazululo eziphathekayo kuzothuthukisa isimo sezibhedlela, kuthuthukise impilo yomphakathi, futhi kwandise ukutholakala kwezinsiza ezihamba phambili. Ukusebenza ndawonye kuzoguqula izibhedlela zibe yizikhungo eziphumelelayo ezikhuthaza impilo engcono kubantu baseMpumalanga Kapa.
Ezomlando: Ukuqonda Ihluko Nezincazelo Ezomlando, noma i-‘history’ ngesiNgisi, iyinsika ebalulekile ekuqondeni ubuchwepheshe, isiko, nezinto ezenzakala emhlabeni. Umqondo wezomlando uhilela ukuhlola izenzakalo eziphumelele, izinguquko, nemiphumela eba khona kubantu, izizwe, nezindawo. Ukuze siqonde kangcono, kubalulekile ukuthi siqale lapho, sihlole izikhumbuzo zethu zomlando, bese siyahamba phambili, sithola ukuhunyushwa kwezinto ezibalulekile. Umqondo Womlando Umqondo wezomlando ungachazwa njengokuhlola amagugu, amathuba, nezifundo ezitholakele endulo. Umphakathi uqala emlandweni wakhe, wezinye izikhathi ezikhethekile, lapho abantu bezama ukuqonda imvelo yabo, ubuqhawe, nemibono yabo. Lokhu kuhlola kudinga ukucwaninga, ukufunda, nokubhala, ukuze iphinde ihlola izinqubo ezithile ezidalwa abantu. Umphakathi omkhulu, ezombusazwe, intuthuko yesayensi, nezinkolo zonke zinezindaba eziphawulekayo ezifanele ukusetshenziswa njengezikhumbuzo zethu. Izincwadi Zomlando Izincwadi zomlando, noma imibhalo, zibalulekile ekwakheni isithombe sokuqonda komlando. Lawa magama ahlukanisa izigaba ezihlukahlukene zempilo yomuntu: ezpolitiki, ezomnotho, ezamasiko, nezokuxhumana. Izincwadi eziningi zikhuluma ngezikhathi ezikhanyayo, ezifana nezimpi, ukuvuka kwemiphakathi, nempumelelo yezinkanyezi ezishumayeziweyo. Lokhu kukhuluma ngokunembile kungenza kube nezezilimi kwezokwemvelo, okuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphenyi nabezindaba bangawuthola umphakathi ophilayo. Izici Zomlando Ezomlando zinesici esibalulekile sokuhlonza izolo nezesikhathi samanje. Umphakathi udinga ukwazi ukuthi izenzakalo zesikhathinelo azigcini kuphela ezikhathini ezithile zomlando kodwa zikhona nanamuhla. Izizathu ezingenza izenzakalo zomlando zifezeke zifana nezinguquko kwamasiko, izimpi, noma izinyembezi ezidla umphakathi. Isibonelo, impi yeMpi Yezwe I neII zashintsha kakhulu indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, bezokuphila, nemithetho eyayikhona. Izifundo Ezitholakala Emlandweni Izifundo ezenzakalayo emlandweni zigcina zikhumbulelekile. Ukufunda ngoMartin Luther King Jr. kusinika umqondo wokuthi abantu bangavuka kanjani ukuvusa imiphakathi yabo. Izenzakalo ezifana nezimpi, ukuphela kwekoloni, nokuphumelela kwezinkampani zempilo kudinga ukuhlelwa okuhle, ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela ethinta abantu. Ubuqhawe obunjengoba behola izinkampani phakathi kwamakholoni kubalulekile ukugcina izimiso, amagugu, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi. Imiphumela Yamanje Emlandweni Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela yemisebenzi emlandweni isakhiwa indlela esikhuluma ngayo ngesikhathi samanje. Ukuqonda imiphumela yokwenziwayo kuyadingeka, ukuze abaqondisi bepolitiki, osomabhizinisi, nezinye izikhulu bakwazi ukuhlela izinto ezizayo. Ubuqiniso nokuhlonzwa kwalezi zifundo kudala ukusho okufanele ukuze imiphakathi iphumelele. Ngokufa kwadezeko komphakathi, kumele sithole amandla okuvuka, ngaphandle kokuphinda, ukuze sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukwamukela Umphakathi Emlandweni Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, kumele siqonde futhi simukele imiphakathi eyahlukene eyake ehlanganyela emlandweni. Umphakathi wonke ukwazi ukufunda kelokhu, ubona ukuba bheke emlandweni yakhe ngokuhlonipha imvelaphi kaZulu, amaKhoisan, nabanye abaphila eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinto zikhuluma ngempilo yabo, ukudlula kwabo, nezifundo ezifanele ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwezizwe. Isiphetho Ezomlando zibalulekile ekwakheni umbono obanzi futhi oqondile wezakhamuzi zokwakheka komphakathi. Ukuhlakanipha kuqhutshwa emlandweni ohlakaniphile, njengoba senza isiqiniseko sokuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zizokwazi ukufunda, zifunde, futhi zikhule kulo lonke. Kumqoka ukuthi siqhubeke sibhala futhi sifunde ezomlando, ukuze sikwazi ukufakelwa kwengcwele, kulondolozwe isiko nemigomo eyaziyo ukwenza umhlaba indawo engcono kumakholwa ethu. Izifundo ezitholakala emlandweni zibusisa, ziphila, zikhula, futhi ziphinda zifika, kanti lezi yizinto ezisemqoka ezihlala zikhumbulekayo.
Kubantu abanokwephuka, abathathwe, noma abahlukunyezwa. Kubantu abafaka isicelo sokushintsha ulwazi lwabo. Kubantu abashintshile isimo sabo sibe sabantu. Kubantu besifazane abangena emshadweni, noma labo abafuna ukushintsha amagama abo okuzalwa. Kubantu abahlala phesheya kwesikhathi esithile kodwa abanokwephuka. Kubantu ababuya phesheya nabaphethe imvume yokuhlala njalo evumelekile. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-9 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emisebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela isitifiketi sokuzalwa noma ipasipoti endala ekhishwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaJulayi 1, 1986. Thumela izithombe ezimbili ezinomumo wepasipoti. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwa izithombe zezinzwane zakho ukuze zirekhodwe kwi-rejista yokuhlala kwabantu. Nikeza isitifiketi somshado uma ushade. Owesifazane ofaka isicelo sokwephula umthetho ofuna ukubuyela egameni lakhe lokuzalwa kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa lelo gama. Umuntu obuyela phesheya ofaka isicelo sokwephula umthetho kumele futhi athumele imvume yakhe yokuhlala njalo, noma isitifiketi sokwenziwa umphakathi noma isitifiketi sokukhululwa ngaphansi kwemibandela. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze leziphathimandla elikufanele.
Ukuhlaziywa kohlelo lokondla ezikoleni Umbuzo 1: Yini uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni? Impendulo: Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlelo olwenziwe ukuze luhlinzeke abantwana ngokudla okunempilo ezikoleni. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bathola izidingo zokudla ezibalulekile, ukuze bakwazi ukwandisa amandla abo okufunda nokuqhuba kahle imisebenzi yabo yokufunda. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuhlinzeka ukudla ezikoleni? Impendulo: Izinhlelo zokondla ezikoleni zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Okokuqala, zisiza ekunciphiseni ukuntuleka kokudla kwezingane. Okwesibili, zikhuthaza ukufunda kahle, ngoba ukudla okunempilo kukhuthaza ukusebenza kahle kobuchopho. Okwesithathu, zikhuthaza impilo enhle, njengoba ukudla okunempilo kulethe injabulo nezinga eliphezulu lamandla ezinganeni. Umbuzo 3: Kuthiwani ngama-engeli ahlukene ohlakeni? Impendulo: Ukuhlaziywa kuhlinzeka ngezinto ezahlukene zohlelo lokondla ezikoleni. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlola izinsiza ezikhona, ukunakekela ukudla, izinkinga zokuhlinzeka, kanye nemiphumela yokudla ezikoleni. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlinzeka ngoxhaso kubakhiqizi bendawo, okwenza kube nokwaziswa okufanele emiphakathini. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nohlelo lokondla ezikoleni? Impendulo: Ziningi izinselelo ezibhekene nohlelo lokondla ezikoleni. Isibonelo, ukungabi nemali eyanele kungenzeka kube yinkinga, njengoba abanye abasebenzi bezehlisa izinga lokusebenza. Futhi, izinqubo zokuphatha kanye nokudla okunempilo zingase zingatholakali kalula, okuholela ezindleleni ezincane zokuhlinzeka. Umbuzo 5: Uhlelo lokondla lungashintshwa kanjani ukuze lusebenze kangcono? Impendulo: Ukuze uhlelo lokondla lusebenze kangcono, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izikole, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokuhlola izidingo zokudla, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokudla okunempilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa umphakathi ngomthelela wokudla. Ukwakhiwa kobudlelwano namakampani akhiqiza ukudla endaweni kungasiza ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakusebenza. Umbuzo 6: Kungani kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zibe nezinhlelo zokondla ezizenzakalelayo? Impendulo: Izinhlelo zokondla ezizenzakalelayo zibalulekile ngoba zisiza ukufaka izinqubo eziphezulu zokuphatha, zigcine izindleko ziphansi, futhi ziqhube umphakathi odinga ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kukhulisa imiphumela yokufunda ukuze abafundi bazuze ekukhuleni nasekugcineni impilo enempilo. Umbuzo 7: Uhlelo lokondla luzoba nemiphumela emihle kulabo abazingela ukufunda? Impendulo: Yebo, uhlelo lokondla luthinta ngqo imiphumela yokufunda. Abafundi abathola ukudla okunempilo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi baveza ukusebenza kahle, benza kube lula ukubamba ulwazi. Lokhu kuphinde kwehlise izinga lokuhlukumezeka okuhlobene nesimo sokudla. Umbuzo 8: Ngabe izinhlelo zokondla ezehlukene ziyiwo kuphela ezikhiqizayo? Impendulo: Yebo, kunemibono eminingi efana nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezahlukahlukene zokuqonda izidingo zempilo. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zingase zihambisane nezifundo zezemfundo, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuphila komphakathi, ukuze kube nokuhlanganiswa okuhle. Umbuzo 9: Ingabe izikole ezinkulu kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile zokondla? Impendulo: Yebo, izikole ezinkulu kufanele zibe nezinqubomgomo eziqinile ezihlanganisa ukuhlonishwa kwemithombo yasemhlabeni, ukugcina izinga lokudla, kanye nezimiso zokuphathwa kokudla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqhuba izinqubo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo nezidingekayo. Umbuzo 10: Yini oyikhuthazayo kumphakathi ukuze uhlelo lokondla luzuze? Impendulo: Ikhuthezeleke ukuncenga umphakathi ukuba ubambisane nabantu abaninzi. Lokhu kufaka ukudala izinhlelo zokweluleka ezifanele, izifundo zokuphila ezibandakanya nezinsiza ezithile. Ubulunga abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene kuzokwenza kube nokuhlanganyela ezinyathelweni ezikhuthazayo ezimele izinqubomgomo eziphumelelayo. Ngamafuphi, ukuhlaziywa kohlelo lokondla ezikoleni kudinga ukuxhumanisa zonke izikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana bathola ukudla okufanele, okwandisa amathuba okuphumelela ekufundeni nasekuphileni kwabo. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lungaba nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zezingane, umphakathi, kanye nasezifundazweni.
Umhlaba wezolimo ongathengwa kuhulumeni uthengwa ngenhloso yokulima, futhi ungase ungabi nethuba lokuthengiswa, kuye ngaleso sikhathi somhlaba. Izivumelwano zokuhlala nezinketho zokuthenga zihlaziywa njalo eminyakeni emithathu. Iphondo Lezolimo linomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha kahle nokuthengisa umhlaba wezolimo kahulumeni, otholakala ngaphansi kweBhodi Yezikweletu Zolimo. Lapho umhlaba wezolimo kahulumeni utholakala ukuze uthenjwe, Iphondo Lezolimo lishicilela izikhangiso ngokufaka izaziso ezindaweni ezibalulekile endaweni, ezifana namahhovisi omasipala, iziteshi zamaphoyisa, nasemabhodini wezaziso. Izicelo zenziwa kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kuzaziso. Umphathi Omkhulu Wezokuhlala Kwabalimi ehhovisi likamasipala ubheka ukuhlinzekwa kwezindawo ze-FALA, uma lokhu sekuvunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezolimo Nezindaba Zomhlaba. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezindawo kwenziwa ngokulandela ifomula ehlinzeka ngentengo ephelele yomhlaba.
Ufundiswe ngemininingwane kuze kube ngu-Okthoba 2023. Do you do the things we taught you? Ungahola ihhashi emanzini, kodwa awukwazi ukusho ukuthi liphuze uma lingafuni! Ngonyaka owedlule, abantu abangaphezu kuka-2,000 babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha ezanikezwa uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi lweGrain SA. Mhlawumbe manje yisikhathi esihle sokuzibuza - yiziphi impumelelo zalesi sifundo uma sibheka izindlela zonke lezi zifundo ezilima ezindaweni zazo? Yisiphi isihlabathi engikhiqiza kuzo ukudla? Ngakanani amahektare engiwafaka? Ubude bami besihlabathi buphakeme kangakanani lapho izitshalo zingakhula khona? Yisiphi isimo se-pH sesihlabathi sami? Yisiphi isimo sokudla kwesihlabathi sami (N, P, noma K)? Ingakanani imvula ejwayelekile endaweni engilima kuyo? Ngokuvamile, ingakanani umkhiqizo engingalindela ngonyaka endaweni engilima kuyo? Ngihlose ukufaka malini umanyolo futhi kwaba yini umphumela? Yiziphi izinyathelo engizithathayo ukuphatha izilokazane nezifo ezindaweni zami? Ngibhekana kanjani nezihlahla ezingafuneki? Ngiyazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezingaba yingozi ezindaweni zami? Ngibeke malini ukuze ngifake lezi zikhukula? Ingakanani intengo yemakethe yokukhiqiza engiyitholile futhi ihluke kanjani nentengo ethola abanye abalimi? Ingakanani intengo yokukhiqiza ngamahektare? Ingakanani intengo yokukhiqiza ngempahla? Ngemuva kokuvuna lezi zikhukula, yisiphi isivuno engihlose ukusithumela kulowo mhlaba ngonyaka ozayo? Ngizothola kuphi imali yokufaka ukudla ngonyaka ozayo? Ingabe ama-tractors ami azokwazi ukulima lezi zindawo engihlose ukuzilima? Ingabe ngizoba nekhono lokwenza wonke umsebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele? Ngabe nginazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze ngikhiqize ukudla okuthile? Konke lokhu kubalulekile, izinto okufanele uqale ngazo ekulimaleni uma uhlose ukuba ummeli wezomnotho - kufanele ukwazi ukuphendula yonke le mibuzo engenhla. Ubani olima lezo zindawo? Uhlosile ukuthini ngaleyo mhlaba kusasa? Sicela uzibuze le mibuzo ukuze uthole impendulo ecacile mayelana nentuthuko yakho njengomlimi ofuna ukukhula - ngempela, uyafuna ukuba ummeli noma ufuna nje ukuhlala phansi uzuze inzuzo ngoba ungumnikazi wendawo ongafinyeleli kulezo zindawo?
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Ukubaluleka Nokuhlola Izikhungo zezempilo zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, zisebenza njengendawo yokwelashwa, yokuvikela, kanye nokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Ezweni lethu, sithola izikhungo eziningi, kodwa uma sikhuluma ngezindawo zezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72, kubalulekile ukuhlola ukuthi lezi zindawo ziwusizo kanjani empilweni yomphakathi, nokuthi zikhona yini izinselelo ezihambisana nazo. Okokuqala, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, zifaka phakathi izindawo zasemadolobheni, ezisemaphandleni, kanye nezindawo ezikude. Lokhu kuhluka kwendawo kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezisemaphandleni, bathola ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu abaningi basemaphandleni bahlushwa yizinkinga ezihlukahlukene, ezifana nokuntuleka kwezinsiza, ukungabi nalwazi olufanele, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngakho-ke, izikhungo eziningi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zidinga ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinsiza ezanele, abelaphi abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nezinto zokwelapha ezitholakalayo. Uma izikhungo zingasebenzi kahle, abantu bangase bahlupheke, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ukwehla kwezinga lokuphila, kanye nokwanda kwezindleko zezempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zihlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zezempilo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuxhumana nabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona, futhi bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi kalula. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuhlela izivakashi, ukuthola izeluleko, kanye nokuthola imishanguzo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zihlala zibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yizinsiza ezikhona. Ngaphezu kokuntuleka kwezinsiza, izikhungo zidinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu bendawo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuzethemba ezikhungweni zabo zezempilo. Uma abantu bengazethembi, bangase bangavumi ukuya ezikhungweni, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zezempilo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuvikela abantu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephephile, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola usizo uma kudingeka. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikhungo kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangazithola kanjani lezi zinsizakalo. Ekugcineni, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, kodwa zidinga ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nezinsiza ezanele, abelaphi abaqeqeshiwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinhlelo zokuvikela abantu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephephile. Uma lezi zinto ziqinisekisiwe, izikhungo zezempilo zingaba yinsika eqinile empilweni yomphakathi, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola usizo uma kudingeka. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo zisebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zisebenza kahle, futhi ziqinisekisa impilo engcono kubantu bonke. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle, bazi ukuthi bangathola usizo uma kudingeka. Izikhungo zezempilo kufanele zibe yindawo yokwethembeka, yokuxhumana, kanye nokwelapha, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle.
Ukufika kuk governo ye-democratic kulethile imithetho eminingi emphakathini wethu, imithetho efana nelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi, ukuba namandla, nokuba ngum citizen. Ukuze lokhu kube nencazelo futhi ukuze uhulumeni wethu omusha we-democratic ukhule, ukufinyelela ulwazi kubalulekile. Ukufinyelela ulwazi kuyilungelo eliyisisekelo elivumela abahlali ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile futhi kubavumela ukuba bafinyelele ezinsizeni ezihlinzekwa yizigaba zikahulumeni. I-Department of Social Development ibhekele ukukhuthaza amalungelo abantu. Ngalesi sizathu, sakhe futhi siqhubeke nokugcina i-manifesto, ephendula njengethuluzi lokukhuthaza ukufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwe yi-Department. "Ukuqhubekisela phambili ukuphela kobuphofu": kuyisihloko esibekwe nguMongameli Thabo Mbeki, kuyisibopho sethu njenge-Department of Social Development futhi sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu akukwazi ukwenzeka ngaphandle kokuthi abahlali babe nokufinyelela ulwazi esizibophezele ekunikezeni ngokuzikhandla. Inhloso yethu ukuthi le manifesto ifinyeleleke kuzo zonke izinhlangano ezihlelwe ngohlanga, ubuzwe, nolimi ngokusebenzisa zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye kuhlanganise ne-braille nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana ukuze kubhekwe zonke izinhlobo zokukhubazeka. Nokho, le manifesto izoshicilelwa kuqala ngesiZulu, isiSetswana, isiTshivenda, nesiSepedi. Sithemba ukuthi ukushicilelwa kwesibili kuzohlanganisa nezinye izilimi kuze kube zonke izingxenye zomphakathi zikhululekile. Ngithemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula kini i-manifesto ye-2002/2003 ye-Department of Social Development, ezokwazi ukwazisa ngensizakalo esihlinzekayo. Ngithemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula le manifesto kini - abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yale manifesto ukukhuthaza ukufinyelela kwenu kalula kulwazi olunikezwe yi-Department of Social Development ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho emthethweni, ikakhulukazi isigaba 32, esithi "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwe uMbuso." Le manifesto yakhiwe ngokulandela umthetho wokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi, (Umthetho No.-2 ka-2000). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele zivumela ukufinyelela okufanayo ezinsizweni, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinsizakalo zomphakathi okuyilungelo lenu lokuthola. Ngithemba ukuthi niyozithola le manifesto iyasiza futhi iyazisa. I-National Department of Social Development - Umthetho No. 3 Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi. Imininingwane ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 somthetho wokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi, No. I-Department of Social Development ibhekele ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo nezimiso zikazwelonke, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezwe nezindinganiso, ukusekela umsebenzi oqhubekayo ezigabeni ze-Department of Social Development, ukuqaphela nokuhlola izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinqubomgomo zokuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo ehambisana nesibopho sezinhlelo ezahlukene ezihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emphakathini okuyisibopho ezikhwameni zezigaba. Ukubuyisela ubuntu bokunakekela nokuthuthukisa abantu kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvuselela imindeni nemiphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa amasu aqondile ukuze kuqedwe ubuphofu ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziqondile kulabo abadinga usizo, ngokusekelwe kumandla kanye nokwabelana kokuthuthukiswa emphakathini. Ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokuphepha komphakathi oluyisisekelo oluhlanganisa imizamo yokuhlinzeka nokungahlinzeki ngosizo nokuphakamisa imindeni ethintekile kakhulu. Ukubhekana nemiphumela yezinhlobo zonke zokuhlukunyezwa okukhuluma ngabantu besifazane nezingane, kanye namasu okuphatha abahlaseli bokuhlukunyezwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lokuthanda nokunakekela abantu abahlala ne-HIV/AIDS noma i-AIDS uqobo kanye nalabo abathintekile, isibonelo, abantwana abashonile be-AIDS. Ukuthuthukisa isu lesizwe lokunciphisa ubugebengu bes youth nokungasebenzi ngaphansi kwe-National Framework for Crime Prevention. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ufinyeleleke futhi utholakale kubantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ezindaweni ezikude nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kanye nokuqinisekisa ubulungiswa ekufinyeleleni usizo. Ukusekela umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ngokuzibophezela ekubambeni uhulumeni okuhlanganisa umsebenzi wezikhungo zikahulumeni ezahlukene nemiphakathi. Ukuqeqesha, ukufundisa, ukuhlela kabusha, nokuhlinzeka ngabasebenzi abasha. I-Department of Social Development igcina imibhalo enezihloko ezahlukene. Lonke ulwazi olufanele lokukhululwa luhlukaniswe ngesisekelo sezikhungo njengoba kuchaziwe etafuleni elingezansi. Imibhalo ihlelwe ngendlela yethebula. Ezinye imibhalo ziqondiswe ezinhlelweni ezithile, kanti ezinye zisezingeni eliphezulu, kanti ezinye zisesikhungweni. "Imibhalo" iqondiswe kumithombo yezindaba ezehlukene, isibonelo. Imibhalo egxile noma ethathwe kumarekhodi, imibhalo egcinwe emithonjeni yemishini noma kumabhrosha okukhangisa kwamakhompyutha. Isakhiwo: Njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla embhalweni, kube nezinguquko kwesakhiwo senhlangano. Imibhalo yokucwaninga eshicilelwe ngezibalo zabantu nezindaba zokuthuthukiswa, ezikhiqizwe yi-HSRC, MRC, DBSA, Izikhungo Zokufunda Eziphezulu, njll. Le mibhalo egcinwe ihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezilandelayo, isibonelo: ezomthetho, ezimali, ezokuphathwa, izindaba zomsebenzi, nezinye. Imizuzu yemihlangano, njll. Imibhalo yokuphatha, imibhalo egcinwe ezindaweni, njll. ## Izinqubo Zokuthunyelwa Kwama-Ambulensi: Umsebenzi Obalulekile Empilweni I-ambulensi iyithuluzi elibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izimo eziphuthumayo ezidinga ukusiza okusheshayo. Ukuhamba kwama-ambulensi kudinga izinqubo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abadinga usizo bafezwa ngesikhathi. Kulokhu, kunemisebenzi eminingi edingekayo, okuhlanganisa ukunxenxa, ukuxhaswa, nokuhamba kwezimoto. Ngalesi sikhathi, ngizovula umbono mayelana nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuthuthwe iziguli ngempumelelo. Okokuqala, ukuhlela kahle izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kubalulekile. Ukuze kube nesixazululo esisebenzayo, abaphathi bezinhlelo badinga ukuhlela izikhungo zezempilo nezinye izikhungo ezifanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-ambulensi angaphuma ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga uxhumano oluqinile phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zokuphuthumisa, nezisebenzi zemigwaqo. Kulokhu, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili busiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Okwesibili, ubuchwepheshe bukhona emsebenzini wokuthuthwa kwama-ambulensi. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphezulu, kube nokwanda kokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukile. Izimpawu ze-GPS, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, nezinhlelo zokulandelela zenza kube lula ukusebenzisa ama-ambulensi ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Lokhu kuphazamiseka umkhakha wezempilo, owenza ukuba abezempilo bakwazi ukuthola iziguli ezidinga usizo ngokushesha. Ngalolu hlobo, ubuchwepheshe bunciphisa isikhathi esidingekayo sokufika endaweni yesigameko, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukusindisa izimpilo. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana nabantu kudinga ukunakwa okuningi. Umphakathi kufanele uqinisekiswe ukuthi uyazi ukuthi yini okufanele ayenze uma kuvela isimo esiphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundiswa ngokubaluleka kokushaya ucingo ku-ambulensi, imiyalo yokuhlinzeka, nokuphendula ngendlela efanele ngesikhathi sokuphuthuma. Ukwazisa umphakathi ngezinhlelo zokuthuthwa kwezokwelapha kungenza iziguli zithole usizo ngokushesha, ngoba ukwehluleka kokuxhumana kungaholela emaphutheni amaningi. Ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zokukhuthaza ulwazi kumphakathi zidingeka ukwakha ubudlelwano obuyaqondile nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zidinga ukuhlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziphumelele. Ukuhlola izikhungo, ama-ambulensi, nezisebenzi kuyasiza ukuze kuqedwe amabala nemiphumela engalindelekile. Ukwenza izivivinyo ezihambisana nezehlakalo zangempela kudinga ukuba izikhungo zezempilo zikhuthaze inqubomgomo yokuhlolwa nokuhlola, ukuze kuphuculwe izehlakalo zokuthuthwa kwama-ambulensi. Ukwenza kuphela izinqumo ezihambisana nemigomo yezenhlalakahle, abaphathi bezokuthuthwa kwama-ambulensi kumele bazi kuhle ukuthi izinqubo zabo zidinga ukuba zihlome ngezinsiza ezanele. Ukuze iziguli zifinyelele amaphuzu ahloliwe, kufanele kube nesikhungo esinamandla sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlinzekwa ngokwakhiwa kwezimali ezanele kanye nezinsiza ezisebenzayo. Ukwengeza, akuyona kuphela imitholampilo ne-ambulensi ezidingekayo, kodwa futhi, izisebenzi ezihlohlelwe zizodingeka ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi kufanele uqonde nokuthi ama-ambulensi akhiwe ukuze awafinyeleleke kalula, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinzima ukufinyelela kuzo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinhlelo zokuqhubekisa izinsiza yesiguli ziqondise kahle nokuthi kuhlonishwe izidingo zabantu. Ukuze kube nezehlakalo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuba nomdlandla wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili kulabo abadinga usizo. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zidinga ukuba zihlonishwe futhi ziphuculwe njalo. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinyathelo, iziguli zingaba sengozini, okungaholela ezimweni ezinzima. Njengoba sihamba phambili emhlabeni wobuchwepheshe, kufanele sibheke phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo ezinembile, ezibambekayo, nezisebenzayo. Ukuphucula izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kungasiza empilweni yomuntu, ukunciphisa izingozi, futhi kuvuselele ithemba emiphakathini yethu. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokugcina izinsiza zezokwelapha zisebenza kahle, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomuntu ngamunye nempilo yezenhlalo.
