Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bempesheni bakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo eziphezulu zezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma sebesondela ekupheleni kwesikhathi sabo sokusebenza. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka ukuthi inombolo yempesheni iqinisekiswe. Le nqubo ihilela izinyathelo ezithile ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathola izinsizakalo zempilo bahlala bephila kahle futhi benokwesekwa okudingekayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bempesheni bahlale befika ezinsizakalweni zempilo ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ukuze uqinisekise inombolo yakho yempesheni, kubalulekile ukuthi uqale uhlole ukuthi unayo yini inombolo efanele. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuxhumana ne-GEMS ngqo, noma uvakashele kuwebhusayithi yabo. I-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene ezihambisana nezidingo zempilo, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungathola lezi zinsizakalo. Uma usuthole inombolo yakho yempesheni, ungasebenzisa le nombolo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubhaliswe kahle kwi-GEMS, okuhlanganisa ukufaka imininingwane yakho, efana negama, ikheli, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ukuqinisekisa lezi zinto kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zempilo ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inikeza izinsizakalo zokuxhumana ezitholakala ngokuqondile kumakhasimende. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma unezinkinga noma imibuzo mayelana nenombolo yakho yempesheni, ungaxhumana nethimba le-GEMS ukuze uthole usizo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bempesheni bahlala benolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezinsizakalo zempilo ezitholakalayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabathengi nezinsizakalo zempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abaholi bempesheni bahlala bekwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili, okuyinto ebalulekile ukuze bahlale bephila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS izama ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, futhi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile ukuze abaholi bempesheni bahlale befika kulezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kufaka izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nezinsizakalo zokuxhumana. Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaholi bempesheni bahlala bekwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zempilo ezisemthethweni, ukuze bahlale bephila kahle futhi bethola ukwesekwa okudingekayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu ohlanganyela kwi-GEMS aqinisekise inombolo yakhe yempesheni ukuze aqhubeke nokuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle nezisemthethweni.
Izindleko zokuqala zokuqashwa - kufanele uthole ukuqashwa kwemifino? Njengoba ukulima kwenziwa kakhulu ngaphandle, kunezingozi eziningi ezingavela, ngokuvamile izindleko zokutshala zidlula inani lokuthenga lezo zinkambu lapho imifino itholakala khona. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bacindezelwa ukuthi babole imali ezinkampanini zezimali noma ezolimo ukuze baqale ukutshala. Ukubolekwa nokuboleka imali kuyibhizinisi elinobunzima, ngoba labo ababelayo imali abafuni ukuyilahlekelwa. Ngokuvamile, umbolekisi kumele anikeze umphakathi wezimpahla zokuqashwa - ngamagama amanye, umbolekisi kumele akwazi ukubuyisa leyo mali uma kungekho ukunciphisa. Uma ungumnikazi wepulazi lapho ulima khona, umbolekisi uzodinga ukuthi ubhalise ibhondi kulolo pulazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungakhokhi imali obolekisiwe, umbolekisi uzothengisa lelo pulazi ukuze abuyise imali ebolekiwe. Kubalimi abasafufusa, lokhu kungadala izinkinga eziningi - kuyoba yicala ukulahlekelwa yipulazi uma ungatholi umkhiqizo omuhle. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abasafufusa abangaboni amapulazi abo - abanye bahlola izinkambu, ngokuvamile lezo pulazi ziqashwa emzaneni wonke (umhlaba wombuso ophathiswa yikhandidethi yesifunda). Wena njengomlimi awukwazi ukuthola ibhondi kulolo mhlaba ngoba awunayo isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi ungumnikazi walelo zona. Esikhathini esedlule, abalimi ababephila ezinkambeni zomphakathi babengenakuboleka imali ngoba babengenayo impahla yokuboleka. Manje, ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala zokulima kuqala ukuvela - manje umlimi angathola ukuqashwa kwemifino ezinkambeni, uma kwenzeka ingozi engatholakala, inkampani yokuqashwa izokhokha imali ebolekiwe. Ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla ekulimaleni kanye nokwehla kokuboleka kwabagibeli, isidingo sokuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala sikhula njalo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Le nqola isungulwa ngokubheka umkhiqizo okhiqizwe ngumlimi othile isikhathi eside (isikhathi eside, umkhiqizo ojwayelekile (LAPY)) epulazini ethile. Indawo yephulazi. Iphulazi elihlonziwe nge-GPS elikhombisa zonke izinkambu, inani lezinkambu, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izindawo. Isimo sokuba ngum owner womhlaba - ingabe umlimi ungumnikazi, ingabe ipulazi liqashwe, ingabe umhlaba ungowomphakathi (womphakathi), njll.? Ubani ozohlinzeka umlimi ngemali yokuqala yokulima? Futhi umkhiqizo otholwe eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Umphumela wocwaningo lwesimo somhlabathi phakathi neminyaka emibili ukhombisa isimo somhlabathi epulazini nasemakambeni. Ulwazi oluthile lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani umsebenzi epulazini ethile - izindlela zokulima izinkambu, imifino etshalwe, izithako ezisetshenzisiwe, izindlela zokuphatha izihlahla, izifo nezilokazane, njll. Ulwazi oluthile mayelana nomqashi ozokwenza umsebenzi. Izikhathi zokutshala nokukhula kokuqala - kunezikhathi ezithile ezivunyelwe, imifino etshalwe ngaphandle kwaleyo zikhathi ngeke iqashwe. Umhlaba uvikelwe kanjani ekubeni uphume? Imifino izovikelwa kanjani ekudliweni izilwane? Ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala ezindaweni lapho kunokushisa kuhambisana nokuqashwa kwehayi - inani leziqashwa lihambisana nomkhiqizo ojwayelekile otholakala isikhathi eside kulolo pulazi. Umlimi ukhetha inani leziqashwa zehayi. Ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala ezindaweni lapho kunokupholisa kuhlala yedwa, akuhambisani nokuqashwa kwehayi. Lapha ihayi ifana nezinye izingozi ezingavela futhi ukuqashwa kuzokhokha ngokuhambisana nezinye izingozi uma ihayi ivela. Izingcuphe ezivikelwe ukuqashwa ezinkambeni zingabandakanya: ihayi, umlilo, ukuthutha, ukushisa, umswakama omningi, imvula eningi, ukuwa komhlabathi ngenxa yamanzi, ukuwa, umoya, imimoya emikhulu, nezinye ukulahleka komkhiqizo ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezimbi, izifo zezihlahla ezingalawulwa, izilokazane, nezingozi zezilwane. Abalimi abathola ukuqashwa bazohlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezifanele. Izithako kufanele zisetshenziswe ngesikhathi esifanele. Izingcuphe ezivikelwe ukuqashwa uma ihayi ivela zifaka: ihayi, umlilo, ukuthutha, ukushisa, imvula eningi, ukuwa komhlabathi ngenxa yamanzi, ukuwa, umoya, imimoya emikhulu, nezinye ukulahleka komkhiqizo ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezimbi, izifo zezihlahla ezingalawulwa, izilokazane, nezingozi zezilwane. Ukushoda akuvikelwa. Ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala kudinga imali eningi. Manje sibona ukuthi izindleko zokuqala ziya zikhula kodwa intengo yemakethe yomkhiqizo ivame ukuwa (okwakukhona okwamanje ngemifino eminingi). Kubalulekile ukuthola le nqola, kodwa ekugcineni, akusasele lutho oluzongena ephaketheni lomlimi ngemuva kokuvuna. Ungase ulahlekelwe leyo mali, futhi ungase ube nekhono lokukhokha lelo bhondi, kodwa kuzoba malini inzuzo yakho? Wena njengomlimi unethuba lokukhetha ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani. Empeleni, awukwazi ukukhetha - kuzodingeka ubeke ipulazi lakho njengomphakathi, noma uzocindezelwa ukuthi uthole ukuqashwa okuzovikela ibhondi lakho. Ekugcineni, ngeke ukwazi ukuthola imali yokuba uqale ukulima? Kodwa lokhu akukhona nje okubi ngoba: uma wenza yonke imisebenzi edingekayo yinkampani yokuqashwa kahle, uzolima kahle, uzosebenzisa izindlela zokukhiqiza ezintsha, futhi amathuba akho okuthola umkhiqizo omuhle azovela kahle.
Ezamandla Kudala, emzaneni oseduze nehlathi elijulile, kwakukhona umndeni ohluke kakhulu. Lo mndeni wawunomkhuba oqinile wokuhlala enobudlelwano obuhle nezinsiza zemvelo. Ubaba, owayenohlonze, wayelawula umnyango wezokwakha, kanti unina, owayeyinduna ekuphileni, wayehlonishwa kakhulu ngabantu bendawo. Kodwa omama namakhaya amaningi ayezwe ukuthi amandla awamukelekile emndenini wabo. Kwathi uma umusi wagcwala emakhaya, umndeni wabo wathola umbono ophakeme: ukuzama ukulondoloza amandla. Ngenxa yokukhathazeka okukhulu ngezimo ezinzima emhlabeni, umndeni wahamba lapho udinga ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokugcina amandla. Uhlelo lwabo lokugcwalisa izidingo zabo lwaluhamba ngezinyathelo ezilula nokukhula komthwalo wokuphila. Njengoba beqala, kwakumele bahlangane nemvelo. Umama, uNandi, wathola umqondo omusha wokusebenzisa imithombo ye-solar. Ngokuyihola kokuthanda kwabe, waqonda ukuthi ungalugcina kanjani amandla elangeni ukuze basebenzise lesi sikhathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, umama uzama ukuphefumula umoya opholile, ebona ukukhanya kwayo kuthandeka. Umlingo wenjabulo owawukhipha phansi, bonke abantwana befunda ukwakha izijwabu ezivela ezindaweni ezincane zokuviva. Kwaba isihloko sendaba phakathi kwalabo abavela emakhaya ahlonishwayo, bejabuliswe uma besho ukuthi, "Sizobe siphila kahle! Amandla awaphumi kalula; mancane emthandazo!" Nakanjani, abantwana babefuna ukuphakamisa isiko lemvelo elihambisana nokwakha amandla. Babeyizibani ezikhanyayo, bejabulisa nazo zonke izifundo ezimnandi i-physics nabangani babo. Bahamba benza amatheku phezulu koqotshana, kanti uNandi ubavumele ukuthi babashebandla babandakanye imisebenzi. Enkosi ezinsizweni ze-maketa, uZola, indodana kaNandi, wajabulela ukuthola igalelo elisha ekwakheni amandla acacile. Ngezinsuku ezichumisa umhlaba uNkulunkulu, kwazalwa izithombe ezithokozisayo ezithinta umoya. Wabafundisa ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kuyo yonke into ayikwenzi abusho; zonke izinsiza zibhala indaba eya ekupshelweni kwezinsiza zemvelo. Uyibona le mpi yeqhawe, umndeni uzihlinzekile ngemithombo ethokozisayo. Kwakujabula ukwenza amafutha ezokuphepha emakhaya abantwana, behlunguza izinkampani ezimnandi ezandiwe ngombani obhodlwayo. Njengoba bephuma ebandezelwe uNandi, uzwa umswakama wombuthu wekhaya, umoya uphuzile. Abantu bendawo balanga wonke amanzi omhlaba ngokukulinda. Babefuna konke ukufaka izinyathelo ezintsha ezizothuthuka. Ubaba wayevele azinyakaze ngaphakathi kwezinkanyezi zamanje, abephakathi kweziqu zesibhakabhaka, efunda imithetho yokusingatha amandla kangcono. Basizwa ngothando lwemvelo, ngakho Umoya kusetshenziswa amandla okukhanya okukhuluma ukwazisa lokho. Ngokusho kwabantu, umoya waba yinkanyezi yobuchwepheshe. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwababusi bekhaya nobuchwepheshe bezemvelo kwaba yinsizakalo ethokozisayo. Njengoba basebenzisa ulwazi olwakheke ebantwini abakulungele ukushintsha ukuthandwa kwemikhiqizo yendabuko, abantu bangase bathe bahlala futhi balindele. Mhlawumbe, lo mzuzu oyinqaba uzokwenza ukuthi uhlogo lwenqwaba lokuhlala ehlathini lube namandla azindayo. Isigameko sokugcina sasinolwandle olujulile ngaphansi kwemithombo emikhulu, zonke izingane bejolisa izinkanyezi ziphila ngobuqhawe obuhle. Kanti uqobo umoya wathokozisa umhlaba. Wathumba umbala omhle ozokwenza bagcine izinkanyezi zabo zikhazimula. Eminyakeni eyalandela, umndeni wenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izinto ezincane ezinjengamanzi nezinhlaka zamagange kumele zihlale lapho njalo, ziqhubeke nokwakha ezisebenzayo. Babefunda ukuthi uhlelo oluphumelelayo lokuhlanza kanye nokutshintshisana kwezinsiza kungathinta izimpilo zabo nemvelo. Umoya, ukubaluleka kwesimo zemvelo, kwaba yinkanyezi yomculo, uMoya weMithombo! Ngokwenza izinyathelo ezincane, umndeni unqanda ukwenza izinqumo ezivuma ukuncipha kwandla, onke amanzi azotholakala emhlabeni, inguquko ibonakala. Yize umhlaba uthanda ukuphindeka, ubuhlobo nemvelo baphakade. Lena indaba efaka isinohwebo nolwazi, umndeni uhamba phambili ekwakheni amandla. Njengokuthokoza komdabu, kwazalwa umoya ophefumlayo, awushintshi lapho kwenzekile. Umndeni wapha lokho obekungakanani engosini bazinjengamazwi amabili, behlezi bezihlonipha. Ngakho-ke, umndeni uhlezi esezidingweni ezisemqoka, ubona ukuthi amandla ayithinta yonke into izinto ezenzeka. Kwathi umhlaba uvuka waphenduka, umndeni waqinisa amandla abo ahlabahlayo, uthando lwemvelo lukwazi ukugcina inhlonipho yayiyo. Ngemva kokuphela, umndeni uqwashisa ezamandla, kwathi lapho ilanga liphuphuma, ithemba elisha lahamba, umoya owazisa uNkulunkulu.
Ezokuxhumana Nomphakathi Umbuzo 1: Yini ezokuxhumana nomphakathi? Impendulo: Ezokuxhumana nomphakathi, noma i-public relations (PR), ibhekisela enhlanganisweni yezindlela nezindlela ezisetshenziselwa ukwakha, ukuphatha kanye nokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinkampani, izinhlangano, noma abantu nomphakathi. Izinhloso zayo eziyinhloko zifaka phakathi ukwakha isithombe esifanele, ukwandisa ukufaneleka, nokugcina ukwethembeka kumphakathi. Umbuzo 2: Kungani ezokuxhumana nomphakathi kubalulekile? Impendulo: Ezokuxhumana nomphakathi kubalulekile ngoba kuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezinkampani. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umfanekiso ohloniphekile, okwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, kanye nokuphendula ezimeni ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezokuxhumana nomphakathi zenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oludingekayo kubantu abathintekayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izindlela ezisetshenziswa ezokuxhumana nomphakathi? Impendulo: Izindlela eziningi zisetshenziswa ezokuxhumana nomphakathi. Lezi zifaka phakathi: 1. Izikhangiso: Ukusetshenziswa kwezikhangiso ezibhaliwe, ezizwakalayo, noma ezibukwayo ukuze kuzuzwe izithameli. 2. Izindaba Nokuqhamuka: Ukuphuma nezindaba ezinhle mayelana nenhlangano ukuze kuthuthukiswe isithombe sayo. 3. Ukwakhiwa Kwezindawo Zokuxhumana: Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana njenge-Facebook, Twitter, ne-Instagram ukuze kuhlanganyelwe nezilaleli. 4. Izenzakalo: Ukuhlela izenzakalo ezifana nemicimbi yokwazisa, ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathintekayo. 5. Ukuxhumana Nabezindaba: Ukuxhumana nababhali babezindaba ukuze kube nokusakazwa kwempilo yenkampani. Umbuzo 4: Ubulungiswa bempumelelo bukhona kanjani? Impendulo: Ubulungiswa bempumelelo bukhona uma izinhlelo ezokuxhumana nomphakathi zihlelwe kahle. Lokhu kubandakanya: - Ukuqonda kahle izithameli ezihlosiwe. - Ukucwaninga ngempela izimfuno nezifiso zabathengi. - Ukuthuthukisa imiyalezo efanele neyokukhanga. - Ukuze ube nezeluleko ezivela kubasebenzi nakuqonda okukhona ngesikhathi. - Ukuhlaziya impendulo ukuze uthuthukise izinhlelo zesikhathi esizayo. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izinselelo ezitholakala ezokuxhumana nomphakathi? Impendulo: Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezithinta ezokuxhumana nomphakathi, ezihlanganisa: - Ukuguquka kwezidingo nezifiso zabathengi. - Ukuphendula ezimeni ezinzima, lapho izinkampani zidinga ukuphendula ngokushesha nangempumelelo. - Ukubhekana nokwaziswa okungalungile, okungase kubangele ukulahleka kokwethembeka. - Ukuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwezinkampani, okwenza kube nzima ukuvelela. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izigaba zokuphumelela ezokuxhumana nomphakathi? Impendulo: Ukuze ufinyelele impumelelo ezokuxhumana nomphakathi, kubalulekile: 1. Ukucwaninga: Qonda izithameli zakho, izinkampani eziphikisanayo, nezimakethe. 2. Ukwakha Ubudlelwano: Sebenzisa izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathintekayo. 3. Ukuthuthukisa Imiyalezo: Qiniseka ukuthi imiyalezo ihlanzekile, icacile, futhi inezithakazelo. 4. Ukulalela: Phendula ezimpendulweni zabathengi nabasebenzi. 5. Uhlolo: Hlola njalo imiphumela ukuze uthuthukise izinhlelo zakho. Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izinzuzo ezikhaliphile zokusebenzisa ezokuxhumana nomphakathi? Impendulo: Izinkampani ezisebenzisa ezokuxhumana nomphakathi ngempumelelo zithola izinzuzo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukukhulisa umkhiqizo nokuthengisa. - Ukwandisa isithombe somkhiqizo. - Ukwakha ukwethembeka phakathi kwabathengi. - Ukusiza ekuphenduleni ezimeni ezinzima, okwenza kube lula ukuvuselela isithombe. Umbuzo 8: Kuthiwani ngempumelelo yezenhlalo? Impendulo: Impumelelo yezenhlalo ibalulekile ukuze uthole ukuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwezinkundla zokuxhumana, izithangami, kanye nemicimbi yokuxhumana ukuze kuhlanganyelwe nolwazi. Izinkampani ezibambisana kahle nezokuxhumana nomphakathi zithola ukuba neqhaza elikhulu emphakathini, okwandisa ubudlelwano bazo. Umbuzo 9: Yini engafundwa kwabanye emkhakheni wezokuxhumana nomphakathi? Impendulo: Abanye bangafunda ukuthi ukuxhumana nomphakathi akukhona nje kuphela ukuxhumana nezinkampani, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso kumphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle, ngakho-ke abanye bangase babe nolwazi oludingekayo lokwenza kube ngcono izinhlelo zabo. Umbuzo 10: Yiziphi izitayela ezikhula ezokuxhumana nomphakathi? Impendulo: Izitayela ezikhula ezokuxhumana nomphakathi zifaka phakathi: - Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-AI ne-data analytics, ukuze kube lula ukuqonda izithameli. - Ukugxila kumphakathi, lapho izinkampani zisebenza ukuze zenze umehluko. - Ukusebenzisa izindaba ezivela kubantu (user-generated content) ukuze kubhekelelwe izithameli. Isiphetho: Ezokuxhumana nomphakathi zidlala indima ebalulekile empumelelweni yenkampani. Ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezihambisanayo, izinkampani zingaqinisa ubudlelwano bazo nomphakathi, zithole ukwethembeka, futhi zibe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokufunda nokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezikhulayo ukuze kuhlale kudlula emkhakheni.
Izithombe: Isithombe 1.1: Ukuphuma kwemvula okujwayelekile: mm/ngonyaka. Isithombe 1.2: Ukuphuma kokupholisa okujwayelekile: mm/ngonyaka. Ukuhlanzeka kuyinto ebalulekile uma sibhakabhisa ukudla. Zonke izindawo zinezinombolo ezirekhodiwe zokuphuma kwemvula. Ukuphuma kwemvula okujwayelekile kuzokhombisa ukuthi iyiphi imbewu engabhalwa ezindaweni ezithile lapho ukutshala kwenziwa kuphela ngemvula. Ezindaweni lapho kunethuba lokunisela, kufanele sicabangele ezinye izimo zezulu ngoba amanzi atholakala ngokunisela. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uma imvula ingena enanini elithile, akusho ukuthi wonke la manzi azothathwa yisitshalo. Uma imvula ingena kakhulu, amanzi amaningi aphuma futhi alahleka. Uma insimu iphansi, ukuhamba kwamanzi kuyanda. Kuya ngokuthi insimu ikhululiwe kanjani, umhlabathi ophakeme ophakanyisiwe uzovimba amanzi ukuthi angangeni. Uma kungekho zimbali ensimini, ukuphuma kokupholisa kuyanda. Uhlobo lomhlabathi lukhombisa futhi ukuthi umhlabathi unekhono lokugcina amanzi, futhi kungase kube nezinhlamvu ezizovimba amanzi ukuthi afinyelele ezitshalweni. Ukuphuma kwemvula nokuphuma kokupholisa okujwayelekile kuboniswa ezithombeni 1.1 no 1.2 (DWAF, 1986). Ngaphansi kuka-20% wendawo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, okuyi-1.05 million square kilometers, kunezimo zezulu ezithola u-750 mm/ngonyaka futhi kunezinga elingaphansi kuka-1,400 mm/ngonyaka lokuphuma kwemvula - kulezi zindawo, isimo sezulu sifaneleka ekutshaliseni ukudla. Izindawo lapho inani lokuphuma kwemvula lidlula u-500 mm/ngonyaka futhi linezinga elingaphansi kuka-1,800 mm/ngonyaka lokuphuma kwemvula zifaka: iphilisi eliphakathi, izindawo ezisemaphandleni empumalanga, nezindawo eKapa lapho kunemvula yasebusika. Ukunisela nokulima okujwayelekile kwenzeka kulezi zindawo, lapho kukhishwa khona u-mazey, ushukela, nezitshalo. Ezinye izindawo zomhlaba zomile kancane kanti ezinye zomile kakhulu, kodwa imvula iyenzeka, nokho amanzi adingekayo angaphansi kuka-50%. Ngakho-ke, ukunisela kuyadingeka kulezi zindawo ukuze kugcinwe izitshalo zokudla.
Ingcebo - uyisebenzisa kanjani? Ingcebo ibhekisela kumithombo yokusebenza engasetshenziswa umbulali emsebenzini wakhe wezolimo. Ukuhlola nokusebenzisa kahle le mithombo kubalulekile uma umbulali efuna ukuphumelela ekulimaleni nasekutholeni inzuzo enhle. Umhlaba kanye nefarm - lapha singahlanganisa indlela yokusebenzisa umhlaba, inani lezomnotho lomhlaba, ubunikazi bomhlaba, nezinhlelo zokuphatha amafamu. Amanzi nomhlaba ohlwanyelwe - lapha singahlanganisa izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezintengo zamanzi, izinga lamanzi, isimo sezindawo ezimanzi, nezici zazo. Ulwazi nokuzikhandla ekukhiqizeni - lapha singahlanganisa i-genetics yezitshalo nezilwane, ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa, ubuchwepheshe bezolimo, nokukhula kokukhiqiza ukudla. Ukuphatha ukukhiqiza kwezolimo - lapha kukhona ukuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo, ukuphatha nokugcina umhlabathi, izindlela zokuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuphatha imithombo yokudla, izindlela zokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukuphathwa kwemvelo, ukuphatha amanzi okukhanyisa, ukuphatha ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ezihlobene nezindlela zokugcina umhlaba. Enye ingxenye ehlobene nokuphatha le mithombo yonke yokusebenza ukumaketha - lapho kungekho emakethe yomkhiqizo, ukukhiqiza akuphumeleli. Nokho, konke okukhuluma ngenhla kubalulekile ekuphatheni ibhizinisi lezolimo eliphumelelayo; le dokhumenti izogxila kakhulu ekuphatheni izimo zomhlaba nokukhiqiza umhlabathi ngendlela enenzuzo ezokwenziwa esikhathini esizayo. Kufanele ukhumbule konke okukhuluma ngenhla uma uhlole izindlela zokukhiqiza ezizokukhombisa uhlelo lwamanje lokukhishwa kwemali nezidingo ezibalulekile. Ngakho-ke, uzokwazi ukuhlela ukuthi yimaphi imali ezongena ezindaweni ezithile zebhizinisi lakho lezolimo. Umhlaba uyisici esibalulekile sengcebo kunoma iyiphi izwe. Ukukhetha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kwenziwa nsuku zonke ngabaphathi befarms - bacabangela izimo zemakethe, balalele lokho uhulumeni akushoyo mayelana nemithetho yokuphatha umhlaba, futhi bahlola isimo somhlaba othile. Phakathi kwezi zindawo zomhlaba, kusekhona umhlaba osebenzisa le ndlela: imigwaqo yokuhamba, amapaki nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, izindawo zomnyango wezobunhloli, nezinye izimboni, izindlu zezimali, imigwaqo ye-farm, nezindawo zasemaphandleni. Umhlaba osele usetshenziswa kanje: izindawo ezimanzi, izindawo ezimanzi, amachibi, imifula, amadamu, izindawo eziwukuhlala, nezindawo lapho kungakhuli lutho. Zandisa ubuningi bezinhlobonhlobo. Abalimi eNingizimu Afrika bangasebenzisa le ngcebo ngezindlela ezingaxhunyiwe ngqo ekukhiqizeni ukudla; bangathola inzuzo ngokukhokhisa imali uma abantu befuna ukuhamba, ukuhamba, noma ukubuka izinyoni. Ingxenye yengcebo ethathwe emhlabeni iyahluka ngokuya ngokuqina komhlabathi kanye nendawo yomhlaba. Umhlaba wezolimo onokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi ungachazwa kanje: umhlaba lapho izimo zomhlaba zemvelo zihlangana nezici zamakhemikhali ezikhona zokukhiqiza ukudla, izitshalo, kanye ne-oyela. Umhlaba onjalo kufanele ube khona lapho kukhona umhlabathi onokukhiqiza, lapho isikhathi esidingekayo sokukhula kwezitshalo sikhona, futhi lapho kunamanzi anele (amanzi). Lokhu kubalulekile ekukhiqizeni ukudla uma umhlaba uphathwa ngendlela efanele yezolimo, futhi uma imithombo yamanzi iphethwe kahle futhi umhlaba wemvelo ugcinwa ngendlela efanele. Ungangenisa amanzi nomoya. Awuvikelwe ekukhukhulekeni ngamanzi. Izinhlobo zezithako ezingahlwanyelwa emhlabeni wezolimo omuhle zifaka: u-mazey, u-wheat, u-barley, u-oats, u-sorghum, u-canola, u-soybeans, u-tobacco, imifino, izimbali, u-cotton, nezinsiza zezilwane ezifana nezinkomo, izinkomo zokukhiqiza ubisi, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezilwane zasendle. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokukhiqiza konke lokhu zisetshenziswa abalimi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukushintsha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kungathinta izimo zezulu ekuphumeleleni kokukhiqiza ukudla, nokunye. Ngezinye izikhathi, ukwehla kwezimo zemvelo ezifana nokuguguleka komhlabathi, izinga lamanzi, nezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane zasendle akuthathwa kakhulu ngoba abalimi bagxila ku-inzuzo kuqala, ngaphandle kokucabangela ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo komhlaba. Ukusebenzisa umhlaba kungasiza umuntu ngokushesha kodwa kungase kungasizi abantu emhlabeni jikelele kwesikhathi eside. Umnikazi womhlaba uzozama ukusebenzisa lowo mhlaba ngendlela ezokhiqiza inzuzo enhle.
Ngidinga usizo - ngifuna ukulima! Kukhona abantu abaningi abathi kithi ngalolu cela - "Ngidinga usizo, ngifuna ukulima." Abanye balaba bantu abanankanyezi, kanti abanye banomhlaba nezinsiza. Ukulima kuyibhizinisi futhi ukuphumelela ebhizinisini kunzima - udinga ukuba nezinsiza, ugqozi, nolwazi. Labo abafuna ukuba abakhiqizi bokudla kodwa bengenamhlaba nezinsiza babhekana nenkinga enkulu. Kodwa khumbula ukuthi awudingi njalo ukuba nomhlaba ngaphambi kokuba ube umkhiqizi. Ngempela, wonke umhlaba uwukubolekwa kuphela - thina singabapheki balo mhlaba, futhi uma sishiya, umhlaba uzohlala khona. Uma unomfuno onamandla wokulima, zama ukuthola umhlaba nganoma iyiphi indlela, noma ngabe kuyisicucu esincane ukuze uqale ukulima. Ungaqasha umhlaba (khumbula ukuthi ungakwazi ukuqasha amapulazi kwabanye abanomhlaba, futhi emakhaya amaningi kunezindawo zomhlaba ezizokwenziwa ziqashwe). Kufanele uqale phansi futhi uhlale ufunda - awukwazi nje ukuthola ulwazi ezincwadini, udinga ukufunda ngokusebenza ngezandla zakho, akulula. Manje udinga ukuthola ulwazi - ukulima umsebenzi ohlukahlukene. Ngokwesimo sokulima ofuna ukukwenza, kufanele uthole ulwazi oluhambelana nalokho ofuna ukukulima; uma ufuna ukutshala izitshalo, uzodinga ulwazi lokutshala (okudla, imbewu ye-oyela, imifino, izithelo, njll.), ulwazi lokulima izilwane (izinkomo ezinkulu nezincane, izinkukhu, imidlalo, nezinkabi), ulwazi lwemishini (amatraktori, ama-ploughs, ama-harrows, ama-hoes, nama-shovels), futhi kubalulekile, udinga ulwazi lokuphatha zonke ezinye izici ezihlobene nokulima (izindaba zezimali, abasebenzi, izinsiza, nezinto zonke ozosebenza nazo). Uma unelungelo lokusebenzisa indawo encane, mhlawumbe eyodwa hectare, qala ukusebenza! Uma usuqalile, uzobe usendleleni eholela phambili, uye kubalimi bezomnotho. Uzofunda ukuthi ungasebenza kanjani - yenza kahle. Njalo sithola ukuthi abantu bafundiswa ukusebenza kahle kodwa bese bephendukela ezindleleni ezindala. U-Oprah Winfrey uthi, "Uma abantu beqonda kangcono, benza kahle." Uma usufundile ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi ukuze unqume okuqukethwe kwezakhamzimba - thatha lawo masampula! Uma uthola ulwazi mayelana nohlobo olufanele lwezithako - sebenzisa lezo zithako (noma ngabe ulima kuphela ihektare eyodwa). Thenga imbewu efanele yokutshala, qinisekisa ukuthi utshala inani elifanele emgqeni othile. Phatha izitshalo eziphikisanayo - izitshalo eziphikisanayo zingumngani omkhulu uma utshala ukudla, ziba phanga ukudla kwakho! Ziphanga amanzi, izakhamzimba, ukukhanya kwelanga, nomoya - akekho ofuna izinto zakhe ziphangewe abanye, futhi nakho akufuneki kumitshalo yakho. Uma uqonda kahle ukuthi yiziphi izidingo zokulima, kuzobe sekuyisikhathi sokwandisa indawo okhulima kuyo. Njalo sithola abantu beklama ukuthi indawo abakhulima kuyo incane kakhulu - kodwa usebenzisa le ndawo kahle. Khumbula ukuthi njalo kukhona abanye abanolwazi oluningi kunalokho okukhona, futhi uzothola ukuthi bavame ukuthanda ukusiza abanye abalimi - funda kubo?
Ukubhujiswa Kwendalo Ngenxa Kwezimpawu Zokumba Kwakukhona idolobha elincane elalibizwa ngeNkanyezi, elaliseNingizimu Afrika, phakathi kwezintaba eziphakeme nezizungezile ezazivulekile emhlabeni. Abantu bahlala ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka esikhulu, bezithokozisa ngezinsuku zabo zokusebenza emasimini nasemizimbeni yabo. Kwakukhanya ilanga, futhi imvula yayivame ukuhamba ngokwejwayelekile, izihlahla zikhula zikhazimula. Kodwa, kancane kancane, izimpawu zokuthuthukiswa zeqala ukuvela; izinkampani ezinkulu zezokumbwa zemali zafika, zifuna ukwakha izimayini ezinkulu ezizoholela emlandweni omubi. Kwakukhona uMnumzane Mthethwa, owayengumholi wesifunda. Wayenethemba lokuthi lezi zimayini zizoletha umnotho, zandise amathuba emisebenzi, futhi zikhulise izinga lempilo labantu. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, waphakamisa izandla zakhe, wakhuluma emhlanganweni omkhulu, "Hamba, sizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile!" Abantu babemdumisa, bekhumbula izinsuku ezinzima bezama ukuthola imisebenzi. Kodwa, akuzange kube lula. UThandi, owayenothando lwemvelo, waba nezinselelo ezinzima. Wayebona izithiyo ezithile ezingaqondakali, ezazihamba phambili njengemibhalo emincane edlalayo. Waziqonda kahle ukuthi izimayini zabeziqhubeka nezinhlelo zokuhlola umhlaba, kodwa wayezibuza ngokwengeziwe. "Ngabe lokhu kuzoba yinzuzo, noma kuyoba yisithiyo esizobangela ukubhujiswa kwemvelo?" Wayengaboni kahle, kodwa wayezwa umoya ungena ezindlebeni zakhe. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, umhlaba waqala ukuguquka. Kukhona njalo ukungabaza phakathi kwabantu, nakuba uMnumzane Mthethwa eqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqinile. Izihlahla ezazimile ngesikhathi eside zaqala ukushabalala, amakhaza abamba izandla zawo emanzini ahlanzekile. Abantu abavunyelwe ukuhamba emathafeni, ngoba izinsuku zashintsha, izimayini zathinta nezindawo ezazikhula kahle. UThandi waba nesithukuthezi, futhi wathola ukuthi uzama ukuxhumana nabanye. UThandi wakhuluma noMnumzane Mthethwa, wathi, "Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane, kodwa kudinga ukuba sithathe izinyathelo. Lokhu okwenziwayo kuzoziphendulela, kubalulekile uthando lokuthola izimali, kodwa akufanele sigcine ukuphila kwethu." Ubuze, "Ngabe uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu uma sishiya imvelo yethu ibhujiswe?" UMnumzane Mthethwa wagxila, kodwa wayezwa imizwa kaThandi. Wabona ukuthi abantu benza izinqumo eziphusile, kudinga ukuthi babe nezinqumo eziphusile. Ngakho, wathi, "Ngithanda ukuthola izimpendulo ezithile. Ngizokwenza ucwaningo, sizohamba, sizobona." Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi wahlangana nezinye izakhamuzi, bahlanganyela amehlo abo emhlabeni, behlanganyela ngezinkumbulo zabo. Bakha umphakathi ophusile, owabe ubopha izixhumanisi ezinzima phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo. Bahlela imihlangano, benza izimemezelo, bexoxisana ngezinkinga ezinzima ezibhekene nabo. Bafunda ngobuhlungu obuphuma ezinsukwini ezedlule, baphendula izinqumo ezinzima. Izinyanga zashintsha, izimayini zaqhubeka nokumba, kodwa abantu baqhubeka nokushumayela. UThandi wagcina enza umkhankaso ophumelelayo, wagcina edume njengomholi ophakeme. Abantu bayeza begijima, bevuma ukuvikela umhlaba, bezama ukuhlanganyela izimfuno zabo. Ngenkathi izimayini ziqhubeka, indawo eyaziwa ngothando nolwazi, ikhululeke, yaphila. UMnumzane Mthethwa wathola ukuthi imiphumela yayinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu babezolile, behamba phambili, beqonda ukuthi imvelo iyinhliziyo. UThandi waphakanyiswa njengezwi, efuna ukusindisa izwe lakhe. Njengoba izimayini ziqhubeka, kwaba nezinkinga ezinzima, kodwa abantu babemangaliseka, becela ukusiza, bephakamisa izwi labo. Ekugcineni, uThandi wakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, owawubophele izinkumbulo. Abantu babefunda, bephila ngempilo emnandi, behlonipha imvelo yabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi imiphumela yokukhuthaza izimayini ibiyinqaba, kodwa ubudlelwane obuqinile nesimo sokubambisana bahlala bukhona. Izimayini zazingenza abantu bakhumbule ukuthi ukugcina imvelo kuyisimo esibalulekile, kunikeza impilo esikhathini esizayo. Ngaleyo ndlela, uThandi waba umholi ophumelelayo, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokuxhumana nezwe labo. Izimayini zaba yindaba yokufunda, bahamba phambili, futhi le ndaba ibalulekileyo yatholwa phakathi kwesigaba sabantu, ihlanganisa izifundo ezibalulekile zokugcina imvelo. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi izwi elivulekile lingaguqula umhlaba, futhi umphakathi ungalweba amandla awo ukuze uvikele umhlaba eminyakeni ezayo.
I-soybean - isitshalo esiyisimanga kanye nokudla okungajwayelekile! Kukho ingxoxo eningi mayelana ne-soybeans kanye nokubaluleka kwazo ekushintshaneni kwezitshalo kanye nommbila. Njengokunye ukudla okukhuliswa ekhaya, ubudlelwano be-soybeans besimanjemanje nezinye izinhlobo ezikhula ngokwemvelo abunakulandwa ngempela. Njengengxenye yeGrain SA Farmer Development Program, sithemba ukusungula uhlelo ne-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust ukuze sikhuthaze abalimi abasha ukuba bakhulise i-soybeans - njengokudla okuthengiswayo, futhi njengomthombo walolu hlobo lwepothini oluyinhloko kuleli. I-soybeans ihluka ekukhuleni nasekuziphatheni. Ukuphakama kwesitshalo kungafinyelela phansi kuka-20cm kuya ku-2 meters. Amakhanda, imithambo yesitshalo, nezinhlamvu zifakwe ngama-ukhuni amancane abomvu noma aphezulu. Izinhlamvu zinezinhlamvu ezintathu kuya kwezine, futhi lezi zinhlamvu zingaba ubude obuyi-6 kuya ku-15 centimeters, ngobubanzi obuyi-2 kuya ku-7 centimeters. Izinhlamvu ziwela phansi ngaphambi kokuthi imbewu iphume. Izimbali ezingabonakali, ezizithola zikhula ezindaweni zezinhlamvu futhi zingaba mhlophe, pinki, noma purple. Imikhiqizo yayo iyikhanda elinokhuni elikhula ezixubeni ezingu-3 kuya ku-5, ngalinye ikhanda liphakathi kuka-3 kuya ku-8 centimeters ubude futhi ngokuvamile liqukethe imbewu engu-2 kuya ku-4 (ngokwejwayelekile), imbewu ibalelwa ku-5 kuya ku-11 millimeters ububanzi. I-soybeans iza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene nosayizi bamakhanda, kuhlanganise nemibala emnyama, ebomvu, eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ophuzi, oluhlaza, nolumhlophe. Ikhanda le-soybean elithuthukile lihlala lihlala, alithathi amanzi, futhi livikela imbewu ekonakaleni okungenzeka. Uma ikhanda elihlanganisa imbewu liqhekeka, imbewu ngeke ikwazi ukuvuthwa. Okuqukethwe kwe-oyili kanye neprotein kubalwa cishe ku-60% wesisindo se-soybeans ezomile uma kuhlanganiswe, lapho i-protein ibamba u-40% ne-oyili u-20%. I-35% esele iyisitashi (ama-carbohydrates) kanye no-5% uyashisa. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-soybeans kuqukethe cishe u-8% wembewu ezihlanganisiwe, u-90% wezihlanu, no-2% wemithambo yezinhlamvu. Ukuze kudliwe ngabantu, i-soybeans kumele iphakwe emlilweni "omisiwe" ukuze ibhubhise ama-trypsin inhibitors (okuyizithiyo ze-serine protease). I-soybeans ezingashisiwe, kuhlanganise naleyo engakathuthukiswa ngokugcwele, iyingozi kubantu, izinkukhu, izinkomo, futhi ngempela kuyo yonke imfuyo enesisu esisodwa. Abathengisi abaningi bacabanga ukuthi i-soybeans iyinsiza ephelele yeprotein. I-protein ephelele iyona equkethe ama-amino acids abalulekile okumele atholakale emkhakheni wokudla kwabantu ngoba umzimba womuntu awukwazi ukuhlela lezi amino acids. Ngenxa yalokho, i-soy iyinsiza enhle yeprotein, phakathi kwezinhlobo eziningi zokudla, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangadli inyama kodwa badla kuphela imifino noma labo abafuna ukunciphisa ukudla kwabo kwenyama. I-proteins ye-soy empeleni ifana nembewu yezinye izitshalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-soybeans ingakhiqiza okungenani kabili i-protein ngaphezu kwe-hectare uma kuqhathaniswa nanoma iyiphi enye imifino noma isitshalo sezitshalo. Ngaphansi kwe-hectare, lezi protein zingaba phezulu kakhulu, zibe izikhathi eziyisihlanu kuya kwezishiyagalombili ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze zifuywe izilwane, futhi i-protein ngaphezulu kwe-hectare ingaba izikhathi eziyishumi nanhlanu phezulu ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze kukhiqizwe inyama. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-soy kunganciphisa nengozi yokuba ne-cancer ye-colon. I-soybeans iyisitshalo esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, inikeza i-oyili ne-protein. E-United States, ivolumu yalezi zitshalo iphathwa ngesisombululo esisebenzisa i-hexane, kanti i-soybean meal engafakiwe (i-50% protein) inikeza ithuba lokusetshenziswa ekukhuliseni izilwane (isb., izinkukhu, izinkomo, nezinkomo) ezingeni elikhulu lokuhweba. Ingxenye encane yalolu hlobo lokudla idliwa ngabantu. Imikhiqizo ye-soybeans itholakala ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokudla eziphathelene. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, i-soybeans yayibalulekile eNyakatho Melika naseYurophu, ikakhulukazi njengomthombo wokudla ongashintsha emithonjeni yeprotein futhi njengomthombo we-oyili ongadliwayo. I-soybeans yatholwa njengokudla ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili yiMnyango Wezolimo wase-United States. Iphumelela ezindaweni ezishisayo futhi ikhuliswa kahle ezishisayo phakathi kuka-20 kuya ku-30 °C; izinga lokushisa elingaphansi kuka-20 °C noma eliphezulu kuka-40 °C linciphisa kakhulu ukukhula kwayo. Ingakha ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene zomhlabathi, kodwa iphumelela kakhulu emhlabathini ongena i-organic matter. I-soybeans, njengama-legumes amaningi, isebenzisa i-nitrogen ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhlanganyela ne-bacteria i-Bradyrhizobium japonicum. Nokho, ukuze kutholakale imiphumela engcono, i-strain efanele ye-bacteria kumele ixutshwe nembewu ye-soybeans (noma iyiphi i-legume) ngaphambi kokutshala. Izinhlobo zesitshalo zesimanjemanje ngokuvamile zifinyelela ukuphakama okungama-1 meter futhi zithatha izinsuku eziyi-80 kuya kweziyi-120 ukuze zikhule zisuka ekutshalisweni ziye ekuthunjweni. I-soybeans iyinsizwa eMpumalanga Asia, kodwa kuphela u-45% wemikhiqizo ye-soybeans ivela lapho. I-U.S. ikhiqize ama-tonu angama-75 million e-soybeans ngonyaka ka-2000, kanti ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu yathunyelwa phesheya. Abakhiqizi abahamba phambili baphinde bafake iBrazil, iArgentina, iParaguay, iChina, kanye ne-India. Izitshalo ze-soybeans zithinteka kalula yizifo ezithile ze-fungal, izifo ezibuhlungu, izifo ze-viral, nezilokazane ezidla izicubu zesitshalo. I-soybeans yayiyisitshalo esibalulekile eMpumalanga Asia ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bakwazi ukubhala. Ihlala iyisitshalo esihamba phambili eChina, eJapan, naseKorea. Ngaphambi kokuphuma kwemikhiqizo ephathwayo efana ne-soy sauce, tempeh, natto, kanye ne-miso, i-soy yayibhekwa njengesitshalo esingcwele ekushintshaneni kwayo nezinye izitshalo njengendlela yokubuyisela i-nitrogen. Izitshalo zazikhuliswa phansi ukuze kuvule indawo yezitshalo ezinikeza ukudla kwabantu. I-soy yethulwe eYurophu ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-18 futhi e-United States ngo-1765, lapho yaqala khona ukukhiqizwa njengezinkomo zokudla. I-soybeans azizange zibe zibalulekile e-Asia kuze kube ngu-1910. E-America, i-soy yayibhekwa njengomkhiqizo wezohwebo kuphela kodwa yaqala ukusetshenziswa njengokudla ngama-1920s. I-soy yafika e-Afrika ivela eChina cishe ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19 futhi manje isiyins
Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imigomo yokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi abanelungelo lokuthola izinzuzo zokuhamba ngesikhathi belindele umsebenzi bakwazi ukuzifinyelela. Iqondiswe ngokuya ngomsebenzi othile owenziwayo, hhayi ngokuya ngesikhundla noma usayizi. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuxazulula izindleko ezibhekene nabasebenzi uma bengaseduze nezindawo zabo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Ukukhokhelwa okufanele kunikezwa ngumnyango uma abasebenzi bekhaya emsebenzini, okuzothokozisa nomnyango. Kuvele ukuthi lezi zinzuzo zifana kubasebenzi bazo zonke izigaba ngaphakathi komnyango. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhamba kunikezwa kuphela kubasebenzi abaphakathi kwezimo ezivumela ukuba bakwenze, futhi ukuthi kuzobasiza ngokungabi khona emsebenzini. Izinhlelo ziye zenziwa ngezikhathi zokuhlola, ukuya ezikoleni, ukuthuthwa ukusuka lapho umuntu ehlala khona, ucwaningo, nezemidlalo, uma umuntu engumamele abasebenzi ezinkulumweni, uma umuntu eya participating emkhandlwini wezamasipala, nokunye. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula izibopho zomnyango uma kudluliswa umsebenzi ukusuka endaweni eyodwa ukuya kwenye. Umnyango uzokhokhela izindleko zokuthutha, kungakhathaliseki izinga noma isikhundla. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula umhlahlandlela wokukhokhela abasebenzi abahambiswayo ukuze kuzuze umnyango, kanye nalabo abasebenzi abakhishwe emsebenzini, noma labo abashonile. Kugcizelelwa lapha ukuthi kuphela abasebenzi abaphakathi kwezindima ezithile bazosebenzisa lezi zinhlinzeko. Kucaciswe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izothola izinzuzo ezifanele kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma ubulili. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imigomo nezinhlinzeko mayelana nokuphela komsebenzi womuntu emnyangweni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuvula uhlelo oluzoba nolungile nolucacile kubo bonke abasebenzi emnyangweni. Ngokufanayo, noma iyiphi indlela yokucwasa eyenzekile esikhathini esedlule kufanele ikhawulwe. Ukugxila kukhulu emsebenzini othile okumele wenziwe ezingeni elithile lohlelo lomsebenzi. Ukukhokhelwa kuzohambelana nemholo yabasebenzi, futhi ukukhokha akwenziwe ngamahora. Ukukhokhelwa kwe-ovetime kulawulwa ukutholakala kwezinsiza zezimali. Ukukhokhelwa kwe-ovetime akufanele kudlule u-30% wemholo yabasebenzi. Lo mthetho uhlole ukuthi umuntu kufanele enze ini mayelana nomsebenzi, bese ucabangela isikhundla sabo. Bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi babhale izivumelwano zabo ezihlobene nokuphathwa komsebenzi wabo nezicwangciso ezizosebenza lapho kuhlolwa ukusebenza kwabo. Lo mthetho unikeza uhlaka oluphatha umsebenzi kanye nezinga lalo ngendlela yokubambisana, futhi ubeka nezilindelo kubantu mayelana nomsebenzi wabo. Ekupheleni, umthetho ophatha izinga lomsebenzi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono abantu asetshenziswa ngokuphelele futhi ezinye izinsiza zithinte kahle imiphumela yomsebenzi, okuyisizathu sokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuguqula eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezihlahla. Le mthetho ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bahambisana nohlelo lokuguqulwa komsebenzi futhi iphinde ibheke ukuthi iziphambeko kumagugu omthetho ziphathwa kanjani. Iphinde inikeze uhlaka lokuhlola uma kukhona iziphambeko futhi ibeke umthetho. Ikhuthaza futhi iphakamisa ukuveza kahle nokuvuleka, futhi ukuze abasebenzi babambe iqhaza ukuze baqinise ubudlelwano bokwethembana, ukubambisana, nokwethembeka kubaphathi, kanye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinhlelo zabasebenzi ezizoba isisekelo salolu hlelo. Ukususwa kwezinyathelo zokucwasa ezihlobene nobuhlanga, ubulili, nezinye izinto... Abasebenzi abanecebo lokuhlola umsebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ngesikhathi sokuhlola umsebenzi wabo, kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwesimo sabo, futhi kungenzeka futhi ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwabo kungancishiswa. Lapho kudingeka ukunciphisa isikhundla somsebenzi, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo yokuvimbela lokho ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile kulowo msebenzi. Izinqubo zokuhweba kufanele ziqinisekise ukuhamba kahle, ukungacwasi, nokufinyelela emathubeni, kanye nokuba nesigaba esisebenzela umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Zonke izikhala kufanele zivuleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, inkolo, ubuzwe, izinkolelo zezombusazwe, isiko, ubudala, ulimi, ukukhubazeka, isimo sokushadile, nezinye izimo ezihlukahlukene. Izikhangiso kufanele zicacise kahle ukuthi iSikhungo Sezikhungo Sikamasipala sizibophezele ekungacwaseni emsebenzini, ekuvumelaneni kwabasebenzi, nokuthi izicelo ezivela ezindaweni ezithile zomphakathi ezake zaba phansi zikhuthazwa. Izimiso ezisetshenziselwa ukukhetha abasebenzi kufanele zibe neqiniso futhi zihlobene nezidingo zomsebenzi futhi kufanele zisetshenziswe ngokufanele ngaso sonke isikhathi. Inqubo yokuhweba izohlanganisa wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nalabo abavela ezindaweni eziphansi nezizinda, futhi ngenkathi belemukelwa ukuthi bafake izicelo zomsebenzi, akufanele bacwaswe futhi kufanele baphathwe ngendlela efanele nengxenye. Uma umuntu engenayo imfundo edingekayo, iziqu, noma amakhono olimi, noma ufunde ngaphezu kwezidingo zomsebenzi, noma usebenze isikhathi eside, zonke lezi zinto ezingahlangene nomsebenzi akufanele zibe izizathu zokukhetha umuntu ophuma emphakathini owake waba phansi, futhi ngenxa yalokho, amathuba abantu abavela ezindaweni eziphansi akufanele ancishiswe.
Abantu abanezikhalazo bangathola ukwesekwa kwe-R25,580 nangaphezulu ngenxa yezidingo ezengeziwe ezifana nezitini zokwakha engadini nasemgwaqweni oya emnyango wendlu, izithiyo, nezindawo zokugeza; imigudu eya emnyango kanye nebhokisi lesignali labantu abaphefumula. Lokhu kusekela kutholakala kubantu abafuna ukuthenga indlu noma ipulazi exhunywe nokwesekwa kwemakethe okukhona. Le ndlela yokusekela itholakala ngokokuqala, okokuqala. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abahlanganisiwe izakhiwo ezikhethwe, ezingaba kubantu noma amaqembu akhiwe ngokomthetho angakha futhi aphathe isakhiwo esihlanganisiwe sokuhlala. Le ndlela yokusekela ivumela i-R23,100.00 kumuntu ngamunye noma emndenini ophuma ngaphansi kwe-R3,500.00 ngenyanga. Le nkqubo yokubolekwa isebenza ngendlela yokuphuka. Le ndlela yokuphuka iphethwe ngqo umphakathi, futhi le nkqubo yokubolekwa isekela lezo zihlobo ezineholo eliphansi ukuze zikusize ekwakheni, ukonga, nokukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwazo nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala ngaleso sikhathi esithile. Kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinezindawo ezithengwe nguhulumeni, ungathola le nkxaso echazwe. Lezi yizindlu ezakhiwe ngababambiqhaza abaqashwe nguhulumeni wesifunda noma uhulumeni bendawo kulezi ziqephu ezihambisana nokwesekwa. Esifundazweni saseLimpopo, ukwesekwa okukhona okuhlelwe kuvela kuhlu lwezinhlelo zokwesekwa kwezindlu, kuhlukanisa abanikazi bezimali be-Angishana, okuhambisana nezinsiza zokonga zomndeni obolekayo. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abafuna ukwakha izindlu zabo. Le nkqubo ihluke kulena ehambisana nezinye izinhlelo lapho abaqashi bekha izindlu zabantu abaningi, kuyilapho le nkqubo yabantu ivumela abantu ukuba bakhe noma balungiselele futhi bakhe izindlu zabo. Abantu banikezwa amathuba okwakha izindlu zabo, bese besizwa ngohlangothi olusekela, ngokukhokha kulolu hlangothi olusekela ngokuya ngamandla okusekela. Uhulumeni uthe umnqobi kufanele akhokhe ukuze afinyelele kwi-program yokweseka. Inhloso yale nto iwukuthi umnqobi aphinde abe nesandla ekuxazululeni inkinga yezidingo zezindlu, ukukhuthaza isiko lokonga, nokuthi umnqobi akwazi ukuqonda le nkxaso evumelekile kusukela ngomhla ka-1 kuNdasa 2002, umnqobi kulindeleke ukuthi abambe iqhaza futhi. Abadala, abanezikhalazo, kanye nalabo abahluphekayo kodwa abaneholo elingaphansi kwe-R3,500 ngenyanga. Lokhu kusekela kuhlelwe kulabo abanezimvume zendawo abazisebenzisayo kodwa abangazitholi. Le ndawo ayikakabhalwa ngaphansi kokulawula kukahulumeni ngaphansi komthetho wezikhulu zendabuko. Lokhu kusekela kungafezwa kuphela ngezinye zezinhlelo lapho kukhona abaxhasi noma izinhlangano ezisiza. Umnqobi unenketho yokukhetha ukuthi ukwesekwa kuzoba nomthelela. Uma kukhuluma ngempumelelo yokubolekwa, noma ekwakheni indlu noma ukuhlanganisa kokubili. Phambilini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezimnyama ezifana neSoweto, eMamelodi, nakwezinye, uhulumeni wangaphambilini wakha izindlu zokuhlala. Abahlali ababeqashwe kulezi zindlu ngaphambi kosuku lukaMashi 15, 1991, bangafaka isicelo sokwehliswa kwentengo yokuthenga lezi zindlu zibe ku-R7,500.00. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, lezi zindlu zivame ukunikezwa mahhala ngenxa yokwehliswa kwentengo kwe-R7,500.00 okudlula inani langempela lendlu. Izinga langaphambilini lokwesekwa le-R579.00 lingasetshenziswa ezingeni eliphansi lobuchwepheshe bokwakha. Imali esele ye-R12,521.00 ingasetshenziswa ekwakheni okuphakeme, bese okungena ngaphansi kwemitha eziyi-30 (30m) yendawo yokuhlala. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu kumele kuqala bakhokhe imali engu-R2,479.00. Uhlelo lwezindlu ezizimele, uhlelo lokukhipha amanzi, kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kuyizidingo ezibalulekile. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu zabantu kumele bafake izimali zabo. Ozakwethu ohlelweni lokwakhiwa kwezindlu nokuqhubeka kwenziwa? Uhlelo lokususa ezindlini luya kuba isu lokulungisa izimo ezifanele zalezi zindlu, le nkqubo yenziwa ngokubambisana nezinkampani zebhange nohulumeni ukuze kuhlanganyelwe ekusebenziseni uhlelo lokwakha ukuze kulungiswe izimo ezifanele zezindlu. Isidingo solwazi nemininingwane mayelana nezindlu ezidingekayo ngaphezu kwenani elijwayelekile. I-Servcon izoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka i-Thubelisha Homes ngemininingwane ejulile mayelana nezindlu ezihambile esivumelwaneni esijwayelekile. Le mininingwane izosetshenziswa yi-Thubelisha Homes ukuze iqhathanise futhi ihlaziye isimo sendawo nokuthi kukhona yini amakhono akhona uma kucatshangwa inani, indawo, kanye nekhadi lezindlu ezidingekayo. I-NURHA igunyaziwe ukuba ihlole ukutholakala kwemali kulezi zindawo ezihluphekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zabantu abaneholo eliphansi. Futhi ibheke uhlelo lokonga imali yokwakhiwa kwezindlu. Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa amakhono ezakhiwo zezindlu. Ukukhuthaza nokusabalalisa kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwelizwe, ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa noma ukuhlanganisa bonke ababambiqhaza ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlanganyela, ukuze babelane ngolwazi namakhono futhi basebenze ngokubambisana. I-NHBRF igunyaziwe ukumelwa kwamalungu ohlelo lokwakhiwa kwezindlu ngokuhlinzeka ngesiqinisekiso sokuvikela izakhiwo eziphukile ezindlini ezintsha, nokuvikela abanikazi bezindlu, abaqashi, labo abakhethwe ngezidingo, kanye nezibopho lapho kungase kube nezinkinga, ukuze kulungiswe ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Izwe elakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile sezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle.
Impilo Yasemakhaya Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle, izinkanyezi zazingakabi seziqhamukile. Emzaneni omncane, uMkhondo, abantu babebuthene emaphandleni, bejabulile, bephila impilo ejabulisayo. Kwakukhona umoya opholile, uphonsa izinyembezi zothando nezokuthula. UZanele, intombazane encane, wayehamba ngebhodi lehlathi, efuna izimbali ezinhle zokuhlobisa indlu yabo. Umama wakhe, uNokuthula, wayesebenza emakhaya, efuna ukudla okwakuzokwenziwa ngempelasonto. UJabulani, umngane kaZanele, wayehamba naye. UJabulani wayenothando olukhulu lwemvelo; wayejabulela ukuhamba phakathi kwezihlahla, ezithokozisayo, nezinyoni ezidansayo. "Zanele, bheka lezi zinyoni! Zibukeka zifana nezithombe ezinhle," esho, elingisa izinyoni ezibhakabhakayo. UZanele wahlala phansi, wathokoza, "Yebo, Jabulani! Impilo yasemakhaya iyamangalisa." Njengoba behamba, bahlangana noMkhulu uSizwe, umphakathi omdala, owaziwa ngazo zonke izindaba zomphakathi. UMkhulu uSizwe wayehamba nebhuku, efunda izinkanyezi. "Sanibonani, bantwana! Nikhona emhlabeni omuhle," esho. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhuluma ngempilo yethu? Ziyazisa ukuthi sikhona." UZanele noJabulani baphendula, "Yebo, Mkhulu! Sifuna ukufunda kakhulu." Ngemva kokuhamba isikhathi esithile, bahamba baphuma emapulazini. UZanele wabona umama wakhe, uNokuthula, esebenza emasimini. "Mama!" abiza, "Siyavuma izimbali ezinhle!" UNokuthula wamamatheka, "Ngiyabonga, Zanele. Izimbali zikhombisa ubuhle bemvelo, kodwa khumbulani, umsebenzi wethu udinga uthando." UJabulani waphendula, "Siyavuma, Mama. Sizokwenza umsebenzi omuhle." Ngemuva kokuphuma emasimini, uNokuthula wabathokozisa ngempela. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi umhlaba unikeza konke okudingayo? Njengoba sikhuluma, umhlaba uyakhula, izitshalo zikhula, futhi sithola ukudla." UZanele noJabulani babebuka umama wabo, begcwele umuzwa wokuhlonipha. Ngempelasonto, umndeni kaZanele wahlela umcimbi wokudla. Babebuthene emakhaya, bekhumbula izinsuku ezinhle. UZanele noJabulani bahlabelela izinkanyezi, bejabulela ukuxoxa izindaba. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya inezinkanyezi eziningi?" kubuza uJabulani. "Yebo, zikhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo," kuphendula uZanele. "Futhi zikhumbuza ukuthi sikhona." Umlilo wawukhanya, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu. UZanele noJabulani babebuthene nabangane babo, bejabulela ukudla okwenziwe ngothando. Umama kaZanele wayebathokozisa ngamaqanda, uMkhulu uSizwe wabelana ngezindaba zomlando. "Ngabe niyazi ukuthi umhlaba wethu unothando olukhulu?" kubuza uMkhulu. "Yebo, Mkhulu! Umhlaba unikeza impilo," kuphendula uZanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZanele noJabulani baqala ukuqonda ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya iyingxenye enkulu yokuphila kwabo. "Siyabonga, Mkhulu, ngokusifundisa," kusho uJabulani. "Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sihloniphe umhlaba." UZanele wamamatheka, "Yebo, sizokwenza." Njengoba ilanga lishona, umndeni kaZanele wawuhamba emuva endlini, bezithokozisa ngezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. UZanele wayejabule, eqonda ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya iyigugu elikhulu. "Siyabonga, Mama, ngokusifundisa ukuthi umhlaba unothando," kusho uZanele. "Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze sihloniphe umhlaba." Ngale ndlela, impilo yasemakhaya yahlala igcwele uthando, ukuhlonipha, nokuhlanganyela. UZanele noJabulani baqhubeka nempilo yabo, bejabulile, bephila impilo ejabulisayo. Futhi, izinkanyezi zakhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza bonke ukuthi impilo yasemakhaya iyigugu elingapheli.
Funda kahle umhlahlandlela wesicelo sokungena, njengoba uqukethe ulwazi olubalulekile oluzokusiza uqedele ifomu lesicelo kahle. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo sokungena ngemuva futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthumela wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo kanye nesiginesha yakho lapho kudingeka. Izikhungo ongangena kuzo ziseduze nawe: Bheka umhlahlandlela wesicelo ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi. Isicelo sakho sizobambezeleka uma ungahlinzeki i-GEMS ngawo wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo. AWUKWAZI UKUPHINDE USEBENZE LO MHLALANDLELA KANYE NEFOMU LESICELO EQEDILE. SICELA UQEDILE YIZIGABA ZONKE EZIHLOBENE NGOKUCOPHELA NGENKATHI UZIBHALA. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlinzeka ngawo wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo. Sicela ubheke isigaba B somhlahlandlela wesicelo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abantu ofuna ukubabiza njengezincikile zakho bayafaneleka. Asizophumelela ngefomu lakho uma ulwazi lukaMazisi lungahlinzekwanga. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqedela lesi sigaba ngokuphelele. Abafakizicelo abavulekile: Sicela ukhombise umholo wakho wanyanga zonke. Uma ukwi sikhundla sokuphatha esiphakathi noma esiphezulu, sicela ukhombise iphakethe lakho lanyanga zonke ngaphandle kokubekwa emkhawulweni. Faka iphephandaba lakho lokugcina noma incwadi ekhombisa ukuthi uqashwe uma ungumsebenzi omusha. Abafakizicelo abathola umhlalaphansi: Sicela ukhombise imali yakho yomhla wanyanga zonke. Uma kunjalo, ungumsebenzi ophakeme noma ungumuntu oncikile? Uma ungumsebenzi ophakeme/oncikile, sicela uthumele isitifiketi sakho sokuhlanganyela emkhakheni wezokwelapha esidala siqinisekisa usuku lokugcina (amakhadi wokuhlanganyela awanele). Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ukuhamba kwakho emkhakheni wezokwelapha okudala kuyakhanselwa. Zonke izinkokhelo zabasebenzi zikhishwa ngokuzenzakalelayo emiholweni yabo lapho kudingeka. Uma ukhetha ukukhokha nge-oda lokudebit, udinga ukuqedela Imininingwane yeBhange yeNhlangano ngezansi (Isigaba H). Imininingwane ye-akhawunti yasebhange: Idingeka ukuze kubuyiselwe imali yamalungu, futhi ukuze kukhishwe izimali ezikhokhwayo kuHlelo. Asizophatha ukubuyiselwa uma singanawo ama-akhawunti asebhange. Abahlinzeki bezempilo abanolwazi bangakudalula, njengoba kudingeka ukuze kubhaliswe futhi kube nezizathu zokubala, uma lelo lwazi lithathwa njengokuyimfihlo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka i-GEMS noma abasebenzi bayo imvume yokuxhumana nodokotela wakho, esibhedlela, noma kunoma iyiphi indawo ehlinzeka ngempilo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukunakekelwa okukhanga. Ulwazi olukhona kule fomu lungempela, luyiqiniso, futhi luphelele. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle noma ulwazi olungaqondakali, ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukuhamba kwami kungakhanselwa futhi ngingase ngidinge ukubuyisela iHlelo nganoma yimiphi imivuzo eyakhishwa ngokungafanele egameni lami, ngokuhambisana nezinyathelo zokubiza. Ngikhetha lokho engikukhethile futhi ngiyaneliseka ngesimo semivuzo ngaphansi kwalokho engikukhethile. Ngiyavuma ukuhambisana nemithetho yeHlelo. Abancikile bami, ngaphandle komkakho/umlingani, baphendukela kimi ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye ngendlela yokuthi abatholi umholo waminyaka yonke ophakeme kunoMhlalaphansi wombuso noma baqashwe ngokuphelele ngosuku lokusayina le fomu. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami nolwazi lokwelashwa (olutholwe kubahlinzeki bezempilo ngovuma lwami) kumele kugcinwe kuyimfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami lwezempilo oluyimfihlo nolwabangane bami lungasetshenziswa ngezinjongo zocwaningo, idatha yezibalo, ukuphathwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinjongo zokubika, futhi noma iyiphi ukuphulwa kwalokhu kubhekwa njengokwephula imfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi uma i-GEMS ifuna ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwami oluyimfihlo noma lwabangane bami ngezinjongo ezingashiwongo kulokhu kuvuma, i-GEMS kumele ithole imvume ehlukile kimi nabangane bami. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami siqu nolwazi lwezempilo luzodingeka lungasetshenziswa ngezinjongo zebhizinisi noma kuthengiswe ngezinjongo zebhizinisi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS inikeze abantu abathile ngaphakathi kwenkampani kanye nezithunywa ezixhunywe nayo ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi oluhlobene namalungu nolwazi lwabo lwezempilo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS kanye nezithunywa ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lokwelashwa/ezempilo/ukuthola izifo/ukuhlinzwa oluhlinzekiwe ngezinjongo ezilandelayo - ukuze processing isicelo sokuhlanganyela, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlamuli kwemivuzo, nokuphatha ubungozi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ingene ezivumelwaneni zokugcina imfihlo nazo zonke izithunywa ezixhunywe nayo ezinomthetho wokufinyelela ulwazi lwamalungu ngenjongo yokudluliswa kwedatha nokuphathwa, ukuphatha uhlelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa. Ngizokwazisa iHlelo nganoma yiziphi izinguquko empilweni yami noma yezehlakalo zami, njengoba kudingeka ngemithetho yeHlelo, ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokushintsha. Ngizokwazisa i-GEMS okungenani amahora angama-48 ngaphambi kokungena esibhedlela okungelona udaba oluphuthumayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukungakwenzi lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni ingxenye yemali ekhokhwayo ikhishelwe kimi. Imithetho izohlala isebenza njalo futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi ama-imeyili, izincwadi zangaphakathi, nezincwajana azikh substitute imithetho yeHlelo. Ulwazi lwamalungu (ulwazi lwakho siqu nolwazi lwezempilo) aluzosetshenziswa ngezinjongo zebhizinisi noma kuthengiswe ngezinjongo zebhizinisi. Kukhona izindlela zokuhlola ulwazi ezikhona. I-Hlelo nezithunywa ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lokwelashwa/ezempilo/ukuthola izifo/ukuhlinzwa oluhlinzekiwe ngezinjongo ezilandelayo - ukuze processing isicelo sokuhlanganyela, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlamuli kwemivuzo, nokuphatha ubungozi. Sicela ungathumeli lo mhlahlandlela nefomu lakho eliqediwe. Ikhophi ye-ID yomlamuli ophakeme. Iphephandaba lakho lokugcina/incwadi yokusebenza. Amafomu M2 no-Z583, uma uthola umhlalaphansi/noma ubungumsebenzi wombuso. Kubalulekile ukuqedela lonke ulwazi esigabeni A, lapho kudingeka. Abathola umhlalaphansi: Sicela uhlinzeke ngenombolo yakho yomhlalaphansi etholakala kumadokhumenti owabhalisile noma kuSitifiketi somhlalaphansi esivela kwiMali Kazwelonke. Sicela ukhombise igama nekhodi yomqashi wakho wamanje. Ikhodi yenkampani ingatholakala kuphephandaba lakho uma ungumsebenzi wombuso. Sicela uqedele imininingwane yabancikile bakho esigabeni B sefomu lesicelo. Kubalulekile ukuqedela imininingwane kaMazisi yabancikile kule ndawo. ### Ukuzivocavoca: Umgomo Wokuphila Okunempilo Isingeniso Ukuzivocavoca, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-fitness ngesiNgisi, kubalulekile ekuphileni okunempilo. Ngaphandle kokuzivocavoca, singabhekana nezinkinga eziningi zokuphila. Ukuze sithole izinzuzo zokuzivocavoca, kufanele siqonde kahle ukuthi ziwusizo kanjani empilweni yethu. Izinzuzo Zokuzivocavoca Okokuqala, ukuzivocavoca kuthuthukisa impilo yamasosha omzimba, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela umzimba ekuguleni. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulu ezimweni ezifana ne-diabetes ne-high blood pressure, lapho umzimba onempilo ungakwazi khona ukumelana nezifo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba phambili kwezinto ezinjenge-hormone, ezifana ne-adrenaline ne-endorphins, ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca, kwenza kube lula ukuphila kahle nsuku zonke. Futhi, ukuzivocavoca kulethe izinzuzo zempilo engokwengqondo. Ukusebenza kwemizwa, ukucindezela, kanye nokugxila kwengqondo kuthuthukiswa uma uzivocavoca njalo. I-Endorphins, ethulwa ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca, idlala indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni kube nokuthula nokucabanga okuhle, okuholela ekutheni abantu bakwazi ukugxila emisebenzini yabo futhi babe nenjabulo. Uhlobo Lokuzivocavoca Kunezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuzivocavoca, okungafaka phakathi ukuhamba, ukudlala imidlalo, ukwenza i-yoga, noma ukusebenzisa izinsiza zokuzivocavoca. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uhlobo lokuzivocavoca luhlobene nezinga lokuphila, isikhathi sokusebenza, kanye nezinsiza ezisetshenziswayo. Ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle, kubalulekile ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemisipha, ukuhlola imisebenzi yokuphila, nokusebenza kwezinsizakusebenza. Izinyathelo Zokwenza Ukuziqhenya Ukuze ube nomkhuba wokuzivocavoca, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Hlela isikhathi: Thola isikhathi sokuzivocavoca nsuku zonke. 2. Khetha uhlobo lokuzivocavoca: Khetha okuthandayo ukuze ujabulele. 3. Zibophezele: Sebenzisa abanye ukuze nikuthokozise. 4. Faka udizayini: Dala imihlangano ehlukene ukuze ugcine intshiseko. 5. Qapha ukuthuthuka: Bheka ukuthi uthuthuka kanjani ukuze ugcine umoya ophakeme. Ukuzivocavoca Nezimo Zempilo Ngezinye izikhathi, ukufinyelela emgqeni wokuzivocavoca kungaba nzima ngenxa yezimo ezithile. Kubalulekile ukuthola iseluleko kumuntu osezingeni eliphezulu, njengodokotela, uma uthanda ukuqalisa noma uma unezinkinga ezithile. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuhamba phambili Ukwazi ukuthi kudingeka imizamo eyengeziwe noma ubuchwepheshe obungaphezulu ukuze ufeze izinhloso zakho, kubalulekile. Izinhlelo ezichwepheshile zingaba usizo kakhulu. Ukuphetha Ukuzivocavoca akukhona nje umsebenzi; kuyindlela yokuphila egcwele izinzuzo. Ukujabulisa, ukuhlela, nokuphila kahle kuncike ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele. Zama ukuhlola izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuzivocavoca ukuze uthole okuhambisana nawe. Ngakho, thokozisa umzimba wakho, uqhubekele phambili, futhi uthuthukise impilo yakho!
Ngiyavuma, amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu zihlale zikhangayo futhi ziwusizo empilweni yethu. Ukuqala, cabanga ngendlela abantu abavame ukuhamba ngalezi zinto. Uzoqonda ukuthi amabhayisikili abalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abafuna ukunciphisa izindleko, ngoba zishibhile futhi umoya ubuyela endleleni. Enye yezinzuzo zamabhayisikili, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezindaweni ezinamabhayisikili amaningi, ukukwazi ukwenza umkhankaso wokuhamba, okwenza kube yinto ethokozisayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu nazo zikwazi ukuheha. I-motorbike noma i-motorcycle, njengoba sikhuluma ngayo, ihamba kancane kodwa iyashesha, idala umuzwa wokukhululeka lapho uthola umoya. Abanye abantu bathanda ukuzenzela izithuthuthu zabo, bejabulile ngalezi zinto. Ngaphambilini, izithuthuthu zifunwa kakhulu ngoba zenza ukuhamba kube okukhawulezayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Uma sikhuluma ngama bhayisikili, kufanele sikhumbule ubukhulu bazo. Uhlanga olukhanyayo nezithuthi ezindala, uma sizithathela phezulu, kuyacaca ukuthi amabhayisikili angathuthukiswa, kodwa izithuthuthu zihlala zikhangayo. Akekho ongawuphika umoya omuhle wezimoto, ikakhulukazi ngoMgqibelo. Abantu bangahamba ezithuthuthu zabo, bejabulisa emakhaya nasemakethe. Kodwa uma sikhuluma ngempilo, amabhayisikili awahloni. Izithuthuthu zidinga abashayeli abanobuchwepheshe, kungenzeka kube nzima ngoba zidinga ukucwaninga okungcono. Ngizocacisa emathubeni okuphumelela. Abahlobo bakha ubudlelwano ngezithuthuthu ngoba bazi ukubaluleka kokuphepha. Sithandazela ukukhipha injabulo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqonda umoya. Ngaphandle kwalokho, amabhayisikili angashintsha kakhulu. Kuhle ukujula emizameni yokugcina ukuphepha. Uhambo lwamabhayisikili lujabulisa ngokukhulumela. Ngingakukhumbuza ngezindaba ezahlukene, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi sidinga ukuhamba. Ngenhlanhla, kunezinhlangano ezithobekile ezisiza ekuhlinzekeni ngamacala amahle emakethe. Abanye abantu bazithokozisa ngendlela ezicabangele ngayo. Umanqoba usinika umuzwa omuhle. Ngiye ngaba nephupho lokuphuma emakhaya, ngizumbule amabhayisikili, ngicophelese ezithuthuthu. Ukukhanya kwenyanga kuphakama, yonke into izinzile. Uhlanga nemiphakathi kufanele zihlale zithokozile, futhi uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinto, ukujabuliswa kufikile. Akukwazi ukukholwa ukuthi kancane enhliziyweni yami, ingithokozisile, sikhumbula nezimpilo zabantu. Uhambo lwethu lungama-unique, uthando lwethu lwezithuthi luhlanganisa abantu abaningi. Noma yisiphi isikhathi, uma sibuyela phambili, sizokwazi ukudala izinkumbulo ezilungile. Futhi, uma ubonisa ubuchwepheshe, uzobe uthola abaphile. Ngokuphathelene nalesi sikhathi, qiniseka ukuthi uthola isikhathi sokuphumula, futhi uma uthanda, zibuze ukuthi owayekhona bangakujabulisa kanjani. Ngiyazi, ubuhle balolu suku buhambisana namabhayisikili nezithuthuthu. Ngicabanga ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele akhumbule ukuba aphile, abekwazi ukufaka usizo endabeni. Khumbula, amabhayisikili nezithuthuthu akho konke kuyazisa. Futhi, umoya obhalwe lapha awupheli, iziphakamiso zethu zikhona, futhi lokho kugcwalisa izithuthuthu, izinhlelo zethu zihlala ziphuphumile. Hamba ujoyine uhambisane nabo.
Isingeniso I-Bolt iyinsiza yokuhamba esheshayo, ethokozisayo, futhi esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze inikeze abantu indlela elula yokuhamba. Le nsiza, eyaziwa ngaphambili njengeTaxify, yasungulwa e-Estonia ngonyaka ka-2013. I-Bolt ibonakala njengomphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukuhamba kalula, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphezulu noma izinkinga zokuhamba. Kulokhu, sizobheka ukuthi i-Bolt isebenza kanjani, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezinto ezithile okufanele zicatshangelwe uma usebenzisa le nsiza. Indlela i-Bolt Esisebenza Ngayo I-Bolt isebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza olutholakala kumafoni, olwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukufaka izicelo zokuhamba. Umsebenzisi udinga nje ukulanda uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Bolt, avule, bese ekhetha indawo ayafuna ukuyofika. Ngemva kokukhetha indawo, uhlelo luzobonisa izinketho ezahlukene zokuhamba, okuhlanganisa izimoto ezincane, ezinkulu, noma izinsizakalo zokuhamba ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzisi uthola ukukhetha okufanele kuye, ngokwezidingo zakhe. Ngemva kokufaka isicelo, uhlelo luzothumela umshayeli ophakathi nendawo, futhi umsebenzisi uzothola imininingwane yomshayeli, kuhlanganise negama, inombolo yefoni, kanye nemoto. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuphepha komsebenzisi, njengoba engakwazi ukuxhumana nomshayeli uma kudingeka. I-Bolt iphinde inikeze umsebenzisi ithuba lokubona izindleko ezihambisanayo nezinsuku ezithile, ukuze akwazi ukuhlela kahle. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa i-Bolt Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa i-Bolt ukuthi inikeza izindleko eziphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinsiza zokuhamba. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-Bolt isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze ikwazi ukunciphisa izindleko, okwenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela le nsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Bolt inikeza izinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezikhethekile, ezinjengezokuhamba kwabantu abakhubazekile, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba. I-Bolt iphinde ibonakale njengenkampani enobungane, ethanda ukusiza umphakathi. Iphakathi kwezinhlelo zayo, i-Bolt ibamba imicimbi yokuhlanganyela nomphakathi, futhi ibamba izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezithile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi i-Bolt ayigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngensiza yokuhamba, kodwa iphinde ibhekelele izidingo zomphakathi. Izinto Okufanele Zicatshangelwe Noma i-Bolt inezinzuzo eziningi, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzisi bazi izinto ezithile okufanele zicatshangelwe. Okokuqala, kufanele baqaphele ukuthi izindleko zingashintsha ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka noma ezinsukwini ezikhethekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umsebenzisi kufanele ahlale eqaphela izindleko ezihambisanayo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi aqinisekise ukuthi umshayeli ophumayo unelungelo lokushayela, futhi imoto yakhe ihlanzekile futhi iphephile. I-Bolt inezinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuphepha, kodwa umsebenzisi kufanele abe nesibopho sokuhlola ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle ngaphambi kokuhamba. Isiphetho I-Bolt iyinsiza yokuhamba ethokozisayo, esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze inikeze abantu indlela elula yokuhamba. Ngemva kokuhlola indlela i-Bolt esebenza ngayo, izinzuzo zayo, kanye nezinto okufanele zicatshangelwe, kubonakala ukuthi le nsiza iyindlela enhle yokuhamba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinamathuba okukhula. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, i-Bolt izoba yinsiza ebalulekile emiphakathini eminingi, inikeza abantu ithuba lokuhamba kalula, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko eziphezulu. Ngakho-ke, uma ufuna indlela elula, esheshayo, futhi engabizi yokuhamba, i-Bolt ingaba yisinqumo esihle.
"Namuhla ngiy umuntu ophakeme futhi ojabulisayo. Ngiyabonga uNkulunkulu ngoba yena ongiphe uthando lokulima." Lezi yizisho zikaLepati Macaphasa, umkhiqizi weNyanga yeGrain SA/Absa; kukhombisa ukuthi uthando lokulima lusiza umuntu ukuba aphumelele. ULepati wazalelwa efemini endaweni yaseFouriesburg futhi wathuthukisa uthando lokulima esebancane. Ngemva kokuhamba esikoleni iminyaka emithathu, uLepati waqala ukusebenza efemini eFouriesburg futhi wakhula ngokushesha waba umholi - usemhlabeni wokulima iminyaka engu-54. Ekugcineni, walandela inhliziyo yakhe wathenga efemini yakhe. Naphezu kokungabi nemfundo ephezulu, waguqula leyo femu yaba ibhizinisi eliphumelelayo ezinyangeni eziyi-14. "Ngiy umuntu owaziwa kahle othanda ukukhiqiza ukudla kwabanye. Lolu thando lungumsebenzi kaNkulunkulu enhliziyweni yami." "Ukuqala ukulima kwami bekulula ngoba bengisebenza efemini isikhathi eside," kusho uLepati. Okwamanje, unamahektare angu-506 futhi uqasha amahektare angu-200 endaweni yaseKestell. Ibhizinisi likaLepati liqukethe izingxenye ezimbili: ukukhiqiza okusanhlamvu kanye nokulima izilwane. ULepati ungum membro weqembu lezifundo labalimi abasha leGrain SA, futhi usebenza noJohan Kriel, umphakathi wohlelo lweGrain SA Emerging Farmers eFree State. UJohan uthi, "ULepati ungumuntu onezinga. Wonke umuntu ohlangana naye uyamhlonipha. Uphatha abanye ngenhlonipho futhi uthanda kakhulu ozakwabo." ULepati ulima amahektare angu-320 futhi unohlelo lokushintsha izitshalo ezihlukene ezifana ne-maize, ama-soybeans, kanye ne-sugar beans. Uthatha amasampula omhlabathi njalo eminyakeni emibili ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umanyolo osetshenzisiwe ufanele umhlabathi. Uqapha izilokazane ngezinto zokwakha kanye nokuhlwanyela. Ngonyaka owedlule, uLepati uphumelele ukufaka i-GM maize. Uthi, "Ngizophinde ngilime i-GM maize eminyakeni ezayo ngoba izifo ziba lula ukuphathwa." Uthatha kahle imishini yakhe, futhi kubonakala ukuthi zikhululekile kahle. Ngo-1974, umnotho wezolimo umnikeze iFord 5000. Le tractor isasebenza kahle - ayidli kakhulu uphethiloli! Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi likaLepati likhule; manje unamaMassey 188, iFord 66, iFord 7610, kanye neNew Holland 6640. Ama-tractors ayahlolwa njalo, futhi amarekhodi agcinwa. Abafana bakhe ababili nabo basebenza naye futhi baqhubeka ama-tractors. Kunabasebenzi ababili abaqashwe, kodwa uma kudingeka, uqasha abanye abasebenzi besizini. Akukho ibhizinisi lokulima elingenazinkinga zayo. ULepati ubhekene nenkinga yokuntuleka kukagesi. Uthumele isicelo ku-Escom sokufaka ugesi efemini yakhe, okuzomsiza kakhulu emsebenzini wakhe. ULepati uphakamisa izinkomo nezimvu. Izinkomo ziyiBonsmara ezixubene nezinye izinhlobo. Unenkomo eziyi-85 nezimvu eziyi-100. ULepati uthi izilwane zakhe zimlethela inzuzo enhle - uthengisa izimvu ezikhethiwe entwasahlobo emakethe eziseduze. Lezi zimvu zikhuliswa kahle, futhi kanye wanqoba umncintiswano wezimbuzi ezikhethiwe. Lo mcintiswano ubanjwa endaweni, futhi uphumelele ngokumelene nabalimi bezohwebo.
