Osomabhizinisi: Indaba Yomlando Ekuqaleni, emhlabeni wonke, osomabhizinisi babenobuhlakani obuhlukile, bephila ezikhathini ezinzima, kodwa bephinde babe nezinselelo eziningi. Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkampani ezinkulu, abantu babengosomabhizinisi abancane, bephila ngokuhweba ngezimpahla ezincane, izithelo, nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha umnotho, futhi kwaba yindlela yokuphila kwabantu abaningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wosomabhizinisi waqala ukujula. Emazweni amaningi, abantu baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphumelelayo. Uhlelo lwezohwebo lwakha izimakethe, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izinkampani ezinkulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkampani ezinkulu ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza eziningi, zenza kube lula kubantu ukuthola imikhiqizo abayidingayo. Ngokubheka emlandweni, uHenry Ford ungomunye wabasunguli abaziwayo. Waqala imboni yokukhiqiza izimoto, futhi wathuthukisa indlela yokukhiqiza eyaziwa ngokuthi i-assembly line. Lokhu kwashintsha indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, kwavula amathuba amaningi emisebenzi, futhi kwakhuthaza abanye osomabhizinisi ukuba baphinde baphumelele. UFord waba isibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangaba nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, eNingizimu Afrika, osomabhizinisi baye bahlala bebalulekile emlandweni. USolomon Tshekisho Plaatje, owaziwa njengomlobi, umbhali, nomphakathi, waba nesandla ekwakheni umqondo wosomabhizinisi phakathi kwabantu abamnyama. Waqala imikhankaso yokuthuthukisa umnotho wendawo, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba bazimele. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokwakha osomabhizinisi abasha, ababephikisana nezithiyo eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wosomabhizinisi wathuthuka, futhi abantu baqala ukwakha izinkampani ezinkulu ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezahlukene. URichard Branson, umnikazi we-Virgin Group, ungomunye wabantu abavelele emhlabeni wezohwebo. Waqala ibhizinisi lakhe elincane, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, wakhulisa ibhizinisi lakhe laba yinkampani enkulu. UBranson waba isibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangakwazi ukwakha imiphakathi emisha, futhi baphinde baphumelele ezimakethe ezinzima. Kodwa-ke, osomabhizinisi abavumi ukuhamba kalula. Bahlala bephikisana nezithiyo eziningi, ezifana nezomnotho, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinguquko ezisheshayo emhlabeni. Lokhu kubenza bahlale bephokophele phambili, befuna izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi labo. USteve Jobs, owasungula i-Apple, waba nesandla ekwakheni imikhiqizo emisha, futhi wathuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obusha. Waba isibonelo sokuthi osomabhizinisi bangakwazi ukushintsha umhlaba ngezinto ezintsha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umqondo wosomabhizinisi uqhubekile nokukhula. Namuhla, sikhona isizukulwane esisha sabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, abaqala amabhizinisi amancane, bephinde bephakela izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umqondo wosomabhizinisi awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokukhula, uhamba phambili nezikhathi. Osomabhizinisi bahlala bebalulekile emnothweni, futhi baphinde babe nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Bakhuthaza abantu ukuba bazimele, baphinde bakhe amathuba emisebenzi. Umhlaba wethu udinga osomabhizinisi abavuma izinselelo, abaphokophele phambili, futhi abashintshe umhlaba ngendlela engcono. Ekugcineni, indaba yosomabhizinisi iyindaba yokuphila, yokuzimisela, nokwakha. Iphakamisa umoya wokuphumelela, futhi ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinselelo zingaba zinkulu, osomabhizinisi bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bephumelela, futhi benza umehluko emhlabeni. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umqondo wosomabhizinisi awupheli, kodwa uqhubeka nokukhula, uhamba phambili nezikhathi. Osomabhizinisi bahlala bebalulekile, futhi umhlaba udinga abantu abanjalo ukuze uqhubeke phambili.
Ubani ongafaka isicelo? Noma ubani ophethe izifundo, ikolishi, noma univesithi futhi okwamanje ungasebenzi. Abantu abangasebenzi kufanele babhalise njengabafuna umsebenzi eMnyangweni WezokuSebenza. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, hamba eMnyangweni WezokuSebenza. Cabanga ngohlelo lokuqeqeshwa kanye nomsebenzi ofuna ukuwuthola. Ngamanye amazwi, uma uthanda ukuba ngaphandle, ungafaki isicelo somsebenzi ehhovisi. Okuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini, amagama abaqashi obebusebenza nabo, kanye nomsebenzi owawenza. Amakhono amanye onawo, njengamakhono wekhompyutha, uma unelayisensi yokushayela, nokunye. Bhalisela ukuba umfuna umsebenzi endaweni yokusebenza eseduze. Lokhu kuzomsiza abaqashi bakuthole uma befuna ukusungula ukufundiswa. Xhumana neSETAs ukuze uthole ukuthi yibaphi abaqashi abanokufundiswa. Buza abangane nomndeni ukuthi bakunikeze iziphakamiso lapho kukhona amathuba emisebenzi ezincwadini. Xhumana nesikhungo somsebenzi ukuze uvuselele ulwazi lwakho uma lungashintshile. Isikhathi sokufundiswa sihluka, kodwa ngokuvamile asingaphansi konyaka. Le nsizakalo iyamahala.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimo eziphuthumayo ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini yethu, njengoba zidinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okukhulu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni ezinjalo kubaluleke kakhulu, futhi eminyakeni yamuva, izindlela ezahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe le nqubo. Ezikhathini ezedlule, izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zazingakwazi ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo, ukulimala okukhulu, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezazithinta imindeni eminingi. Ukuze kubhekwane nalezi zinkinga, izinhlelo ezahlukene ziye zashintshwa, kuhlanganiswa nezobuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifika ngesikhathi esifanele. Enye yezindlela ezibalulekile zokuthuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula kube ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-GPS. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo eziphatha izicelo zokuphuthumayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinsiza eziphuthumayo zingathola ngokushesha indawo yokwakha, ziqinisekise ukuthi zifika lapho kudingeka khona. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nesikhathi sokuphendula esisheshayo, okwandisa amathuba okuthi abantu abathintekayo basindiswe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo ziye zathuthukisa izinqubo zazo zokuxhumana. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe, njengokuxhumana ngocingo, izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo, kanye nezixhumanisi ze-inthanethi, kuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bayakwazi ukuxhumana kalula. Lokhu kubalulekile ekutholeni ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi eziphusile. Ukusebenza ngamasu afanele nawo kubalulekile ekwandiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ziye zathuthukisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bazo, ukuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nokwenza izivivinyo ezihlukahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bazi kahle ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani uma kwenzeka ingozi. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kusebenza njengendlela yokwakha amakhono, okwenza kube lula ukuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngokwandiswa kwemizamo yokuthuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula, imiphakathi ibonisa ukukhula okukhulu. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo ziye zanda ukufika ezindaweni ezidingekayo ngaphezu kokuthola izimo eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuxhumana kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ziye zanda ukuthuthukiswa, okusheshisa izinqubo zokusebenza. Kodwa-ke, akusikho konke okukhanya. Kunzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zisebenza ngendlela efanele, ikakhulu ezindaweni ezikude noma ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezengeziwe, kuhlanganise nezimoto ezinhle, amathuluzi, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Abaholi bendawo badinga ukusungula izinhlelo ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bahlala bephephile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinhlelo zokuzivikela emiphakathini ziye zabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu bendawo kumasu okuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kungasiza ukunciphisa umthwalo ezinsizakalweni. Lokhu kuvumela umphakathi ukuba ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuphenduleni ezimeni eziphuthumayo, okusiza ekubhekaneni neziyaluyalu ezithile. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwababusi, izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo, nemiphakathi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwababheki, kuhlanganisa nemizamo yokwakha ulwazi, kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuba imiphakathi ibhekane neziyaluyalu ezinzima. Njengoba sikhula, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokwenza ngcono lezi zinhlelo ukuze sibe nekhono lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, sigcine imiphakathi yethu iphephile futhi inempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umgomo wethu kumele kube ukuhlinzeka ngethuba lokuhlola izinhlelo zethu, siqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenziseka, futhi sithuthukise amasu okuphendula ukuze baqede izingozi ezithinta izimpilo zabantu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha impilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi isikhathi sokuphendula esisheshayo siyisisekelo sokuphila komphakathi.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom: Ukubuyekezwa Eskom, njengomphakathi omkhulu wezokwakha amandla eNingizimu Afrika, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi zokuphathwa kwamandla, ikakhulukazi ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamandla nokwenza ngcono ukusetshenziswa kwamandla. Ngalesi sikhathi, ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kube yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Lezi zinsiza zihlala zikhuluma ngempumelelo, kodwa zidinga ukuhlolwa ukuze kuqondwe kahle izinzuzo zazo, izinselelo, kanye nomthelela wazo kumakhasimende. Izinzuzo ze-Smart Meter Okokuqala, i-smart meter iyithuluzi eliqinile elithuthukisa ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwamandla. Lezi zinsiza zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamandla, okwenza kube lula kumakhasimende ukuba baqonde ukuthi bangawasebenzisa kanjani amandla abo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko, njengoba amakhasimende engakwazi ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa kwawo kwamandla ngesikhathi esifanele, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokuphakama kwezindleko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-smart meter iyasiza ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamandla. Ngendlela yokuxhumana ngqo, i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuthola imininingwane yokusetshenziswa kwamandla ngesikhathi sangempela, okwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezithile ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa kwamandla. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezinkingeni, okuholela ekwenzeni ngcono ukusebenza kwe-Eskom. Izinkinga Nezinselelo Noma kunjalo, ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter akukhululi i-Eskom ezinkingeni zayo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukile obudingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kahle. Ukufaka i-smart meter kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu, futhi lokhu kungaba yinkinga kumabhizinisi amancane noma kumakhasimende angatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemininingwane yabo. Ukuphathwa kwemininingwane yomuntu siqu kubalulekile, futhi i-Eskom kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zayo zokuvikela imininingwane ziqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amakhasimende azizwa ephephile futhi ethembekile. Umthelela Kumakhasimende Umthelela we-smart meter kumakhasimende ungathathwa njengomphumela ophambene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amakhasimende athola ithuba lokuphatha kahle ukusetshenziswa kwawo kwamandla, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izindleko. Lokhu kunciphisa umthwalo wezindleko eziphakeme, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokuphakama kwezindleko zamandla. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abanye amakhasimende bangase bazizwe bephazamisekile ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle indlela i-smart meter esebenza ngayo. Ukuze i-Eskom iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amakhasimende ayawuqonda kahle umqondo we-smart meter, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezithuthukile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumakhasimende ukuba baqonde izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter. Isiphetho Ngokubheka konke, ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom kubonisa izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqashelwa izinselelo ezithile. Lezi zinsiza zikhombisa indlela yokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kwe-Eskom, kunciphise izindleko kumakhasimende, futhi kuthuthukise ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwamandla. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom iqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuqinile ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amakhasimende ayawuqonda kahle umqondo we-smart meter, futhi aqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uma i-Eskom ingakwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, i-smart meter ingaba yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwayo, futhi ikwazi ukusiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile nelinempilo lamandla eNingizimu Afrika. Ukubambisana phakathi kwe-Eskom, amakhasimende, kanye nezikhungo ezithintekayo kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela kokusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter.
Ukukhuphuka Komsebenzi Wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika NgoMgqibelo, uMgqibelo njengoba kuqhubeka umkhankaso wezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, izikhangiso zobuholi nemizamo yokubuyisela ithemba kubantu ziqhubekile. Kwaqhutshekwayo imihlangano emikhulu yokuxoxa ngamasu nezinhlelo ezingabhekelela izinselelo ezibalulekile ezifaka phakathi ubuphofu, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokuphila ezinzima. Izinkampani ezisheshayo, izigidi zabantu ziqhuba umkhankaso wokusekela izikhundla eziqavile. Abantu bazwakalisa ukunaka okukhulu ekutheni iziphathimandla zisebenzise amandla azo kahle. Ngenkathi nohlu lwezikhulu zokulindela oluqukethe abaphathi abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, umphakathi uvuma ukuthuthukiswa kwempilo yawo. Ngemuva kokuthola imibono emisha, uMnu. Thabo Mbeki, owayengumengameli, uhlonziwe ngokuqhubeka komsebenzi wakhe wokudala umphakathi ophumelelayo. Uthe ukuphila kwabantu akukhona nje ukukhula komnotho, kodwa futhi ukubandakanyeka kwabantu ekuthatheni izinqumo. Lokhu kukhuthaza imboni enkulu yokuzimela, lapho abantu bezikhuluma ngezindaba ezibakhathazayo. Kuvela ukuthi abaphakanyisi izinkulumo eziphusile, abaholi bezombusazwe baye baphendula izidingo zabasebenzi, bezama ukuhlinzeka ngamacala okufanele abavule iminyango emisha. UMsasazi wezombusazwe uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, ubelokhu ebekezela ekuhlinzekeni ngobuhle bendlela yokuhlonipha imiyalo yomthetho. Ngesikhathi evidwayo, ugcizelele ukuthi ukuthi izinyathelo zamuhla zizosiza ikusasa labantu. Kule miphakathi ethuthukayo, izinhlelo zokwenza ngcono izimo zempilo zimenywa kakhulu. Kwazulu, umphakathi ulandela izinyathelo eziphawulekayo zokwenza ngezinga elikhulu. Lokhu kube ngesinye sezizathu zokuthi umphakathi uqiniseke ngokuthi abaholi babo basebenza ngempela ukuze kube nezinguquko ezibuhlungu. Ukwanda kwamathuba emisebenzi kubalulekile emiphakathini ethuthukayo. UJohn Khumalo, umphakathi wakwaZulu-Natali, uncomile inqubekela phambili, esho ukuthi ukwanda kwezinto eziphilayo, kuyazikhukhumeza izifundo ezintsha. “Emaphakathini ethu, yilapho sithola izikhala eziningi. Sinokukholelwa kithi, sizobe sihamba phambili,” kusho uKhumalo emhlanganweni. Ubugebengu, nokungalungile kwezomnotho kuholela ezinkingeni ezithile. Lokhu kungenza kube nezinkinga zokuphepha. Abaholi bezombusazwe baphendule kulesi simo, bezama ukwakha uhlelo oluzosekela ukukhula nokuphepha kwezindawo ezithile. Lokhu kudinga uchwepheshe abahlolisisa izindlela zokubhekelela lezi zinkinga. Sikhumbula ukuthi abaholi bezombusazwe kumele babe nethuba lokuzilolonga, ukuze bakwazi ukukhuthaza ukusebenza emiphakathini yabo. Lokhu ngaphezu kwalokho kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazinikele ekwenzeni izinqumo ezenzakalelayo. Isikhumbuzo sokwenza kube okwakhe, wukuthi umphakathi uthwele umthwalo wezombusazwe, kuyilapho amaqembu ezombusazwe efuna ukufaka ingxenye yawo endleleni yokwakha ubuhlobo. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi, izigidi zabantu zibhala iziphakamiso ezihambisana nempumelelo, kukhona izinyathelo ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuvumela abantu ukuzwakalisa imizwa yabo, nokuthi baxhumane nezikhungo zokuphathwa kwezombusazwe. Lokhu kuqukethe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisemthethweni nezithakazelo zomphakathi. Umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe uyasetshenziswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo ezidingekayo emiphakathini. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuba kudaleke imisebenzi emisha, futhi kunciphise ukuntuleka kwezinsizakalo. Ukukhula kwezinhlelo eziyimpumelelo, kudinga ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwabantu, iziphathimandla, nezikhungo. Ubugebengu busa eNingizimu Afrika, bunokuphendula nokwakha izindlela zokubhekelela ukudlula izinselelo. Ekugcineni, ukuxoxisana phakathi komphakathi nabaholi bezombusazwe kubalulekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuzola, futhi abaholi badinga ukuqinisekisa izindlela eziphumelela. Ngokuvamile, imiphakathi edinga ukuba igqugquzelwe, ukuze ingabi sikhanyiso esifundisayo kuphela, kepha ikhululeke ngokuphelele. Lokhu kumanje kubonisa umoya wezimoto eziphusile ezidinga ukwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile. Imizamo yezenhlalakahle ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono. Abaholi bezombusazwe, kufanele bahlomule emizamweni yabo, bese bezehlisa izindleko, ukuze kube nezinsiza eziningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uzokwazi ukuba nempilo engcono, futhi lokhu kuzokwenza kube yisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni yabantu. Isifiso somphakathi wethu usuku nosuku siqhubeka sisebenzisana nabaholi bethu ngaphansi kokucabangela izidingo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokhuthaza kahle ukuzazisa, nokwenza umehluko omkhulu emiphakathini yethu. Kukhona umoya wokuxhumana phakathi kwemibono nezinhlelo ezih-win. Uhlelo olungcono luzoqinisekisa ukuthi siqhubeka sithuthuka, futhi impilo yembimbi izokhula ngokwempela.
I-visa yomndeni inikezwa kumuntu wangaphandle ongumndeni oseduze wombuso noma umhlali ongenamkhawulo ophila eNingizimu Afrika. Umphakathi noma umhlali kufanele ahlinzeke ngezimali ezivikelekile. I-visa yomndeni iyasebenza isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emibili. Hlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuba umndeni oseduze kumphakathi osekelayo noma umhlali. Thumela isiqinisekiso esivela kumphakathi ophakanyisiwe noma imibhalo esekelayo eqinisa isicelo sokuthi umphakathi noma umhlali osekelayo unamandla ezimali noma inhlanganisela yezinsiza zezimali zokukweseka. Inani lokweseka akufanele lidlule ku-R5,000 ngenyanga kumuntu ngamunye ngesikhathi sokuvakasha, okungafaki umkakho noma izingane ezincane ezincike kuwe. I-visa esebenzayo idinga izitifiketi zezempilo eziphathelene nomfaki- sicelo nakubo bonke ozakwethu abahambisana naye. Isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka kwamaphoyisa sidingeka uma ungena eminyakeni engu-21 ubudala mayelana nawo wonke amazwe owahlala kuwo ngaphezu konyaka owodwa, ukuze sikhishwe ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-12, uma singakakwazi ukuhlinzekwa ngaleso sikhathi. Imibiko yezempilo nezimiphumela ze-X-ray zidingeka kumfaki-sicelo ngamunye. Imibiko ye-X-ray ayidingeki ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 noma kwabesifazane abakhulelwe. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.
Isitifiketi sokufa siyidokhumenti esemthethweni ekhishwe kumndeni womuntu ofile uma kubhaliswa ukufa komuntu. Uma umforeign (ongowasekhaya) efela eNingizimu Afrika, irekhodi liqedelwa futhi isitifiketi sokufa sikhishwa kumndeni. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini uma isicelo sifakwa phesheya. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Qedela ifomu le-BI-132. Bhala incwadi enemininingwane yomuntu ofile bese uyithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi eliseduze uma kungekho ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi endaweni yakho. Akukho ukungcwaba okuzokwenzeka ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesiyalezo sokungcwaba. Isiyalezo sokungcwaba siyisitifiketi esinika imvume yokungcwaba kanye nokuhanjiswa komzimba ukusuka endaweni lapho umuntu efile khona ukuya endaweni lapho bezokungcwaba khona. Kuphela abathengisi abhalisiwe banegunya lokukhishwa kwesiyalezo sokungcwaba. Isitifiketi sokufingqa: Sikhishwa lapho kubhaliswa ukufa. Isitifiketi esigcwele: Izicelo zingathatha phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kwezishiyagalolunye ukuze ziqedwe.
Ukwehluleka kwama-boiler eMedupi Power Station, eyakhelwe ukuthuthukisa umthombo wamandla eNingizimu Afrika, kubonakala njengomkhakha obucayi kwezobuchwepheshe. Nokho, le mboni ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, lapho ukwehluleka kwama-boiler kubonakala ngokusobala. Ukuhlaziywa kwalesi simo kuveza izizathu eziyisisekelo, okudinga ukuxoxwa okujulile ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela nemithelela yalesi sikhathi. Okokuqala, kudingeka sihlole izimbangela zokwehluleka kwama-boiler. Izikhungo eziningi zikhombisa ukuthi ukungasebenzi kahle kokwakhiwa kwe-boiler kwakuwumqondisi ophawulekayo. I-Medupi ithole usizo lwemininingwane yezobuchwepheshe evela kwamanye amazwe, kodwa kungekho ukuqonda okwanele kwezimo zasendaweni. Lokhu kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezingxenye ezisemqoka ezakhiwe ngendlela engafanele, okukhombisa ukuthi izinsiza ezithile azizange zifinyeleleke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabikhona kokuhlola okwanele ngesikhathi sokwakha kwabangela izinkinga ezinzima. Ukungahambi kahle kwamasu okukhulisa izinga lokuhlola nokubheka ukwakhiwa kwamafektri kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemiphumela engachazeki. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwama-boiler, okwaholela ekunciphiseni ukukhiqizwa kwamandla. Njengoba ama-boiler engatholakali, umkhiqizo wamandla awufinyeleli ezingeni elihlongozwayo. Uchungechunge lweziqiniso zocwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi le miphumela ayithinti kuphela ukukhiqizwa kwamandla, kodwa futhi inezimpempe emnothweni wesizwe. Ukwehluleka kwamandla kuhlanganiswa nezindleko ezinkulu, okudingeka ukufaka uhlelo lokwakha kabusha ukuze kuhlonishwe lezi zinkinga. Lokhu kuphazamiseka kuthinta i-Eskom, okuyinkampani ehlinzeka ngamandla, futhi kuhlangana nezinkinga ezibucayi zemali. Umphakathi kumele uqaphele futhi uxoxe ngalolu daba ngoba umthelela omkhulu ungenzeka ezimpilweni zomphakathi. Ukwehluleka kwamandla kubeka engcupheni izinhlelo eziningi zokwakhiwa ezithinta izimboni, imidlalo, nezinsiza eziyisisekelo. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni ukusimama komnotho, okusho ukuthi umphakathi kufanele ube neqhaza ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga. Futhi, izindleko ezihambisana nokuthengwa kwezinye izinsiza zifaka ingcindezi emkhakheni wezomnotho. Abantu abaningi balahlekelwa yimisebenzi yabo ngenxa yokuthi amabhizinisi awakwazi ukuhlinzeka amathuba, ngakho-ke ukwehluleka kwama-boiler akuhambisani kuphela nezinkinga zamandla kodwa nakwimiphumela eyinqaba. Lokhu kubeka ingcindezi kumphakathi ukuba uzame ukuvuselela imizamo yokwakha amanye ambozi aqukethe ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ngokubheka phambili, kunemikhakha eminingi ezodinga ukunakwa ukuze kubonakale izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ukwanda kokuxhaswa kwezimali ekwakhiweni kwe-boiler amahle kudingeka ukuze kwandiswe lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kungahlanganiswa nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo ukuze kusizakale osomabhizinisi abasha namabhizinisi amancane. Hhayi nje ukuthi kuhlinzekwa ngama-boiler, kodwa futhi kumiswe izinhlelo ezizokwenza ukuthi bakwazi ukugcina izinga lokuhlola. Ngokuphathelene nokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwe-Eskom nezinkampani zomhlaba. Ukuqonda okuhle phakathi kwalezi zinhlelo kuzokwenza kube nokubambisana okuyophumelela, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zifinyelela ezindaweni ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandiseni amathuba okukhulisa izinga lokuhlola, okuzokwenza ukuthi ama-boiler asebenze kahle. Ekuphetheni, ukwehluleka kwama-boiler eMedupi akuwona umqondo oguquguqukayo, kodwa umphumela wokungasebenzi kahle okukhona emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukuqonda imikhakha ehlobene, izinxephezelo ezisetshenzisiwe, kanye nokukhuluma ngemiphumela ehlobene nalokhu kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekufinyeleleni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Umqondo wokwakha, ophambili ezindaweni ezithuthukayo, ubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhlangabezana nezidingo zomnotho ozayo. I-Eskom, imiphakathi, kanye nezehlakalo zomhlaba wonke kufanele ukuba uhlanganise ukuze kube khona ukwaneliseka kokwehluleka kwama-boiler, nokufezekiswa kwemigomo yeNingizimu Afrika.
Isimo ngalendlela asikwazi ukusebenzisa isivumelwano sokwenqabela abantu amalungelo abo noma labo abafuna ukufinyelela empahleni. Abasebenzi nabantu abafuna ukufinyelela empahleni kumele bakhombise ukuqonda isimo esibucayi samanje emapulazini futhi akufanele bazizwe benecala ngokuziphatha ngendlela yokwesaba noma yokuphikisana, futhi akufanele baphakamisela imikhawulo ezicelweni zokuvunyelwa ukuba bangene emapulazini ukuze bavakashele okubalulekile noma okufanele. Sifuna ukubonga lezi zikhungo ezilandelayo ngempumelelo yazo nokusiza ekwenzeni le ndatshana ibe khona. Uma umphakathi wehluleka ukuthola isikhathi ngoba engakwazi ukuxhumana nomnikazi noma umuntu ophethe umhlaba, noma ngoba isicelo sokufinyelela siyenqatshelwa, kufanele baxhumane nensizakalo yezolimo noma inhlangano yezolimo yasendaweni noma i-SAPS ukuze bathole usizo kulolu daba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abantu abanephuzu lokuvakashela abantu emapulazini ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikela Ukusetshenziswa Komhlaba, ngokwesibonelo. Kuphela uma kuhlelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi/ngezikhathi ezibekiwe nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophethe umhlaba. Umvakasheli kufanele asebenzise indlela eshiwo ngaphambili ukuze aye ezindlini zabasebenzi epulazini noma emathuneni okhokho babo. Kumele kube nesivumelwano esicacile ngesikhathi sokuvakasha. Umvakasheli akufanele abambe iqhaza kunoma yiziphi ezinye izinto ngaphandle kwalokho abavunyelwe. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abacwaningi, abahleli bezepolitiki, abahlela imicimbi, abasebenzi bezinkolo, njll. Abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi babo bayahlanganyela kulezi zinkomfa futhi, lapho kungenzeka, banikeze ukuhamba kulezo zindawo. Ezimweni ezikhethekile lapho abantu kumele bangavunyelwa ukuba bangene epulazini, kufanele kube kuphela uma kuhlelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngokucacile nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophethe, futhi kuncike ezimweni ezishiwo nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophethe. Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zezolimo kanye nomphakathi wezolimo jikelele kufanele kube ukuvuselela ukuphepha esimweni esijwayelekile. Ngo-2002, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zamukela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi akufanele sithinte noma yiziphi izenzo zabo ezisemthethweni. (Bheka inothi elingezansi). 1 Ngasikhathi sinye, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zizobe ziqaphele ukukhathazeka komphakathi wezolimo futhi zizolandela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngangokunokwenzeka. Abanikazi bomhlaba bazibophezela ekubambisaneni ngokuphelele nezikhungo zokuvikela ekwenzeni izenzo zabo. Le qembu lifaka phakathi abahloli abavela emnyangweni wezempilo, ezokuphathwa kwasekhaya, ezemisebenzi, ezolimo, njll. Kuphela uma kuhlelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi/ngezikhathi ezibekiwe nomnikazi noma omunye umuntu ophethe umhlaba. Uma uthola ilungelo lokungena noma ukungena emhlabeni noma ezindlini, bika ngokushesha kumnikazi noma kumuntu ophethe umhlaba. Umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngaye kufanele azive kahle, achaze uhlobo lomsebenzi wakhe, futhi akhulume isikhathi esilindelekile sokuhlala kulowo mhlaba. Umsebenzi akufanele enze noma yisiphi umsebenzi noma izenzo abengenalo ilungelo lokwenza. a. Ukwephula umthetho ngazo zonke izigameko - Ukuhlasela, ukubulala, ukushisa, ukulimaza ngokuqondile impahla, noma noma yiziphi izizathu zokwenza lokho. Kuwo wonke amacala lapho ukungena kuvinjelwe ngamandla emhlabeni oqashwayo, amarekhodi kufanele agcinwe kahle njengobufakazi. Ngo-2001, ngenxa yokubulawa okukhulu kanye nenani eliphezulu lezi zinsongo emapulazini, kanye nenani elikhulu labantu ababulawa noma abalimazwayo, i-Agri SA yenza isivumelwano sokusebenza ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa kwabantu abahamba noma abahamba emhlabeni wepulazi. Ezinye zalezi zinsongo zenzeka ngeshwa ngabantu abenza sengathi bangamalungu ezinsizakalo zokuphepha futhi begqoke izingubo zazo. Isivumelwano Sokusebenza sakhuluma ngezinsizakalo zokuphepha (i-SAPS ne-SANDF) kanye nezinsizakalo zabo zomthetho. Izichibiyelo ezithile zenziwe nguMsizi wecala ngoMeyi, ozosungula ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlinzeko zokuxoshwa ezindaweni ezithile. Ezinye izimo lapho kukhona ulwazi olwaneleyo olukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi nomsebenzi wakhe bangase babe sengozini yokulimala, ukufa, noma ukulimala kwempahla, i-South African Police Service izophula umthetho futhi ikhiphe izinhlinzeko, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Abangena ngokungekho emthethweni kufanele baboshwe ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka futhi baphonswe phambi kwecala. Umnikazi noma umuntu ophethe umhlaba kufanele afake isikhalazo esisemthethweni ngokushesha kwi-South African Police Service. Uma kucace bha ukuthi umsuspect uhlala kulowo mhlaba isikhathi eside, umnikazi kufanele axwayise ukuthi umgibeli ongavumelekile kufanele axoshwe ngomyalo wecala. c. Ukuthi umnikazi, umphakathi onemvume, noma umuntu ophethe akavumelanga; futhi d. U- suspect akanalo ilungelo elisemthethweni lokungena emhlabeni, ngokwesibonelo. Uma uphoyisa waziswa ngokuqhamuka komhlaba endaweni enkulu, kubalulekile ukuthi kwenziwe ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka. Ukuhlasela komhlaba kuvame ukuhlobene nokuhlala okungekho emthethweni emhlabeni. Umnikazi angathola umyalo wokuxoshwa ngokushesha ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlalwa Okungekho Emthethweni (PIE). Abasebenzi abavumelekile bangaxoshwa kuphela ngomyalo wecala ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Umhlaba (isigaba 5 se-LTA). Lo myalo utholwa umnikazi ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Abahlali abavumelekile bangaxoshwa kuphela ngomyalo wesigungu somasipala noma wecala eliphezulu. b. Uthola umyalo wecala uma umhlali engashiyi umhlaba ngesikhathi esibekiwe; futhi c. Futhi ukusetshenziswa komyalo wokuxoshwa. Abahlali abangenamvume bangaxoshwa kuphela ngomyalo wesigungu somasipala noma wecala eliphezulu. Lo myalo utholwa umnikazi ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Kuyicala elibi ukuthola ngqo noma ngokuqondile noma ukufuna ukukhokha noma yimuphi imali noma noma yini ebhekwa njengokukhokha noma ukuhlela noma ukuvumela umuntu ukuba ahlale emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi noma umuntu ophethe lowo mhlaba. Umhlali ongavumelekile ungumuntu ophatha umhlaba ngaphandle kwemvume eshiwo ngumkhiqizi ngokuqondile. Abahlali ngaphansi ko-ESTA abavumelekile. Amalungelo abahlali abangenamvume avikelwe nguMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlalwa Okungekho Emthethweni kanye Nokuhlala Okungekho Emthethweni, 1998. Le ngxenye yabahlali izoba kakhulu labo abaziwa njenge "squatters" abahlala ezindaweni ngaphandle kwemvume. Umthetho we-PIE uhlanganisa umthetho wokuvikela ukuhlala okungekho emthethweni we-1951. Umuntu ongavunyelwe ukungena ungumuntu ongena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi, futhi uphoyisa angababamba. Uma umuntu ongene ngaphandle kwemvume "uhlala" emhlabeni womnikazi, kufanele abhekwane njengomhlali ongavumelekile. "Uhlala" kusho ukuthi umuntu unendawo yokuhlala noma uhlala khona okungapheli. I- court ithola umuntu ongene ngaphandle kwemvume enecala ngaphansi kwesig
Umbuzo 1: Yini iFacebook? iFacebook iyinsiza yokuxhumana ethokozisayo esebenzisa i-inthanethi, eyasungulwa nguMark Zuckerberg nabangane bakhe eHarvard University ngo-2004. Le nsiza ivumela abantu ukuba basebenzisane, babelane ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Umbuzo 2: Kungani abantu besebenzisa iFacebook? Abantu basebenzisa iFacebook ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, iyinsiza elula yokuxhumana nabangane, umndeni, kanye nezihlobo, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala kude. Okwesibili, iFacebook inikeza ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango, izithombe, nezindaba ezithokozisayo. Okwesithathu, ibhizinisi nabathengisi bangasebenzisa iFacebook ukuze bafinyelele amakhasimende amaningi. Umbuzo 3: IFacebook isebenza kanjani? IFacebook isebenza ngokwakha iphrofayela yomsebenzisi, lapho umuntu engabeka khona ulwazi lwakhe, izithombe, nezithakazelo. Umsebenzisi angakha "amakhasi" noma "amaqembu" ukuze axhumane nabanye abantu abanezimfanelo ezifanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iFacebook inezici ezifana ne-"News Feed" lapho umsebenzisi engabona khona okuthunyelwe kwabanye abantu abalandelayo. Umbuzo 4: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa iFacebook? Izinzuzo zokusebenzisa iFacebook ziningi. Okokuqala, ivumela abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene, ngisho noma bahlala kude. Okwesibili, iyinsiza yokwabelana ngolwazi, lapho abantu bengathola khona izindaba ezisheshayo nezokwakha. Okwesithathu, ibhizinisi lingasebenzisa iFacebook ukuze lithole amakhasimende, lishicilele izikhangiso, futhi likhuthaze imikhiqizo yalo. Umbuzo 5: Zikhona izingozi zokusebenzisa iFacebook? Yebo, kunezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa iFacebook. Okokuqala, ukuvikeleka kolwazi lomuntu siqu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu bangase babe sengozini yokukhwabanisa noma ukweba imininingwane. Okwesibili, ukusebenzisa iFacebook ngokweqile kungaholela ekunciphiseni kwesikhathi sokuxhumana ngqo. Okwesithathu, kukhona ingozi yokubona okuqukethwe okungafanele, okungase kube nomthelela ongemuhle empilweni yomsebenzisi. Umbuzo 6: IFacebook ithuthukisa kanjani ubudlelwano? IFacebook ithuthukisa ubudlelwano ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana. Abantu bangathumela imiyalezo, babelane ngezithombe, futhi baphendule ezithombeni zabanye. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuba seduze, ngisho noma abantu behlukaniswe yizikhala ezinkulu. IFacebook iphinde inikeze ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, njengoba abantu bengathola abanye abanezimfanelo ezifanayo. Umbuzo 7: Yini okufanele ngiyicabangele uma ngisebenzisa iFacebook? Uma usebenzisa iFacebook, kubalulekile ukuba uqaphele ukuvikeleka kwakho. Qiniseka ukuthi ulwazi lwakho lomuntu siqu luhlala luphephile, futhi ungabelani ngemininingwane eyimfihlo. Futhi, zama ukugcina isikhathi sokusebenzisa iFacebook sibe semthethweni, ukuze ungaphuthelwa yizikhathi ezibalulekile empilweni yangempela. Umbuzo 8: IFacebook izoba kanjani esikhathini esizayo? Esikhathini esizayo, iFacebook ingase ithuthukise izici zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zomsebenzisi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwakha izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, ukuthuthukisa ukuvikeleka, kanye nokwandisa amathuba okuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iFacebook ingase ibhekane nezinkinga ezihambisana nokuphepha nokuvikeleka, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzisi bayo bahlala bephephile. Umbuzo 9: Ngabe iFacebook iyinsiza ewusizo? Ngokuvamile, iFacebook iyinsiza ewusizo, ikakhulukazi uma isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Inezici eziningi ezithuthukisa ukuxhumana, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuba abasebenzisi baqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nayo, ukuze bakwazi ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 10: Yini engingayenza ukuze ngithuthukise ulwazi lwami lweFacebook? Ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho lweFacebook, zama ukufunda ngezici ezintsha ezitholakala kule nsiza. Hlanganyela emakhasi nasezinhlelweni ezithokozisayo, futhi ungabhalisela izifundo ezihlobene nezokuxhumana. Futhi, zama ukuxhumana nabanye abantu abanezimfanelo ezifanayo, ukuze uthole ulwazi olusha nolwakha. Ngamafuphi, iFacebook iyinsiza enamandla yokuxhumana, kodwa kufanele isetshenziswe ngokucophelela. Ngokuhlonipha izinqubomgomo zokuphepha nokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle, abantu bangazuza kakhulu kulolu hlelo lokuxhumana.
ISAHARA DESERT Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo, izinkanyezi ziqhakaza phezulu, zikhanya njengemibala emihle emkhathini. I-Sahara, umhlaba omkhulu wezihlahla ezincane, izihlahla ezimnyama, nezihlahla eziphilayo, yayingaphansi kwelanga elishisayo. Le ndawo, eyaziwa njengendawo enkulu kakhulu yehlathi elingaphansi kwamanzi, ibonakala iyinhle, kodwa iyingozi. Kwathi ngosuku oluthile, uThabo, umfana osemncane ohlala edolobheni eliseduzane, wanquma ukuhamba phesheya kweSahara. Wayefisa ukubona ubuhle bayo, nokuhlangenwe nakho okwakungakaze kube khona. UThabo wayenothando lokuhlola, futhi wayazi ukuthi le ndawo iyimfihlo enezinto eziningi ezithakazelisayo. Uhambo lwakhe lwaqala ekuseni, lapho ilanga lishisa kancane. Wathatha amanzi, ukudla, nezinto ezidingekayo, waphuma emzini wakhe. Njengoba ehamba, wathola izihlahla ezincane, izinyoni ezibhakabhakayo, kanye nezilwane ezincane ezijabulela ukuphila. UThabo wayejabule, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kufanele aqaphele, ngoba iSahara iyindawo enobungozi. Ngemva kokuhamba isikhathi eside, uThabo wafika endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi yi-"Uhlanga LweMimoya." Le ndawo yayigcwele imimoya ethokozisayo, futhi izihlahla zayo zazikhanya ngombala ophuzi. Wathola umthombo wamanzi, futhi wathokozisa umoya omusha. Wazizwa ethokozile, kodwa waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe, wathi: "Ngabe ngiyakwazi ukuhamba phambili?" Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo wahlangabezana nezinselelo. Izinsuku zashintsha, kwavela izivunguvungu ezinamandla, futhi umhlaba waba mnyama. Wazama ukufihla, kodwa umoya wawumshaya, wamshiya edangele. Wazama ukukhumbula izifundo azifundile, wathi: "Ngiyakwazi ukuhamba, ngizobona indlela." Ngemuva kokuhlala isikhathi eside, uThabo wathola indlela yokuphuma. Waqhubeka nokuhamba, wathola izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, ezamkhombisa indlela. Wazizwa eqinile, futhi waphuma emoyeni. Waqhubeka, wathola umhlaba omusha, lapho izihlahla zikhanya khona, futhi izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu. Ekugcineni, uThabo wafika endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi yi-"Iphupho LweSahara." Le ndawo yayigcwele ubuhle, futhi izinkanyezi zazikhanya kakhulu. Wazizwa ethokozile, futhi waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe. Wathi: "Ngiyakwazi ukuhamba, ngizobona izinto ezinhle." UThabo wathola abantu abahlala kule ndawo, futhi waphendula izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo. Babemjabulisa, futhi bamfundisa ngezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo. Wafunda ukuthi iSahara iyindawo enobuhle, kodwa futhi iyingozi. Wazithokozisa ngempilo yakhe, futhi wathola ubungane obusha. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana, uThabo waphinde wahamba emuva. Wazizwa ejabule, futhi waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe. Wafika emzini, wathola umndeni wakhe, futhi wabelana ngalesi sihambo esiyingqayizivele. Wafunda ukuthi iSahara iyindawo enezimfihlo, kodwa futhi iyindawo yokuhlola. UThabo wathola ukuthi ukuphila kuyajabulisa, futhi izifundo azifundile zamsiza ukuba abe umuntu ongcono. Wazithokozisa ngempilo yakhe, futhi waphinde wacabanga ngempilo yakhe. Wafunda ukuthi iSahara iyindawo enobuhle, futhi kufanele siyihloniphe. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThabo waba nesifiso sokubuyela eSahara, ukuze aqhubeke nokuhlola, futhi afunde izinto ezintsha. Wazi ukuthi le ndawo iyimfihlo, futhi izimfihlo zayo zikhona ukuze zifundwe. Uhambo lwakhe lwaba yindaba, futhi wathola ukuthi ukuphila kuyajabulisa, futhi izifundo zempilo zibalulekile. Ngakho, uThabo waphinde wacabanga: "Ngiyakwazi ukuhamba, ngizobona izinto ezinhle." I-Sahara, umhlaba wezimfihlo, yabe isiyindawo enothando, futhi uThabo waba nesifiso sokuyivakashela njalo.
Imigomo Yokugoma: Ukubaluleka Nokubuyekezwa Umhlaba ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu ezithinta impilo, ikakhulukazi izifo ezithathelwana kalula, okwenza udlame ezempilo. Ukuze lezi zifo zinqandwe, kubalulekile ukugqugquzela ukugoma. Imigomo yokugoma iyisihluthulelo sokuvikela abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, abantu abadala, kanye nabantu abanezimo zempilo ezithile. Le migomo ibandakanya izinqubo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabantu. Lokhu kubandakanya ukugoma abantu abaneminyaka ethile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iziguli ziyaqhubeka nezinhlelo zokugoma, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezingozi zokungagomi. Ukuze le migomo ibe neqhaza, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde kahle izinzuzo zokugoma nezingozi ezihambisana nokungagomi. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukugoma kunciphisa amathuba okuthola izifo ezithathelwana kalula, njengo measles, polio, ne-hepatitis. Uma abantu bephumelela ekugomeni, kudaleka umphakathi onempilo, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela labo abangasakwazi ukuzivikela, njengabantwana nabantu abadala. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho izinsiza zokwelapha zingatholakali kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imigomo yokugoma ikwakha umoya wobumbano emphakathini. Uma abantu beqonda ukuthi ukugoma akukhona nje ukuvikela umuntu, kodwa nokuvikela umphakathi, bazoba nesithakazelo ekugomeni, okuholela ekubambisaneni. Kodwa-ke, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nemigomo yokugoma. Abanye abantu bahluleka ukuvuma ukugoma ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma ukukhathazeka ngezingozi ezihambisana nezivivinyo zokugoma. Lokhu kudinga imizamo yokwazisa abantu ngendlela efanele ukuze baqonde izinzuzo zokugoma. Abaholi bemiphakathi, odokotela, nabanye badinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Izinhlelo zokugoma kumele ziqinisekiswe ukuthi zifinyeleleka kubo bonke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvuma ukugoma, izinhlelo kumele zibe lula nezifinyeleleka, ukuze zibe neqhaza elihle ekutholeni ukuvikeleka. Izinselelo ezihlobene nemigomo yokugoma zidinga ukuhamba phambili, sikhuthaza abantu ukuba beqonde ukubaluleka kokugoma. Umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukuvikela impilo yomphakathi, futhi lokhu kungenziwa kuphela uma sikhuthaza ukugoma. Ekugcineni, imigomo yokugoma ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, kubalulekile ukukhangisa ukugoma, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanele, nokwenza izinhlelo zokugoma zifinyeleleke kubo bonke. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvikela izizukulwane ezizayo nokuqinisekisa impilo yomphakathi. Ukugoma akukhona nje isinqumo somuntu, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onempilo.
Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho 8 ka-1996 uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguhulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezilungelo zakhe, futhi umthetho kazwelonke kumele wenziwe ukuze kuphumelele leli lungelo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 (Umthetho 2 ka-2000), ophumelelisa leli lungelo, waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa 2001. Inhloso eyinhloko yalomthetho ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okucacisa nokubika ezikhungweni zomphakathi nasemiphakathini yangasese nokukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ufinyelele ulwazi oluwusizo ukuze bakwazi ukuwasebenzisa ngokuphelele amalungelo abo. Ngokusho kwalomthetho, uMphakathi-Jikelele weMnyango Wezangaphandle ungumsebenzi Wolwazi walowo Mnyango. UMphakathi-Jikelele uqoka oMsebenzi Baphakade beMnyango. Ihhovisi leMphakathi-Jikelele lizoba yisisekelo sokwamukela izicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yalo mbhalo ukuhlinzeka amalungu omphakathi ngokuqonda izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole imibhalo egcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle. Umbono weMnyango Wezangaphandle ukuhlela i-Afrika eyandile, ethule, enedemokhrasi, engabandakanyi ubuhlanga, eyodwa futhi nokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umhlaba ofanele futhi onobulungiswa. UMnyango Wezangaphandle uzinikele ekukhuthazeni izintshisekelo nezindinganiso zaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuvuselela i-Afrika, nokwakha umhlaba ongcono kubantu bonke. Ukwakha nokuphatha ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba baseNingizimu Afrika nokukhuthaza izinhloso zomthetho wezangaphandle. Ukuqapha intuthuko yamazwe omhlaba nokunikeza izeluleko kuhulumeni ngezinhlelo zezangaphandle nezindaba zangaphakathi ezihlobene nazo. Noma yiluphi ulwazi olubhaliwe olugcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle lungacelwa. Gcwalisa ifomu elichazwe kuGov Gazette inombolo R187 enedethi ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2002 (bona isheduli 2); futhi ukhokhe imali echazwe eshedulini 1 yalombhalo. Nokho, umceli ofuna ukuboniswa imibhalo equkethe ulwazi lwakhe lomuntu akadingeki akhokhe imali yokufaka isicelo. Lo mcela kumele akhombise ukuthi isicelo sikhona ezithombeni zemibhalo egcinwe noma ukuthi ufuna ukubona imibhalo uqobo ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ukutholakala kwalolu lwazi kuzothunyelwa kumceli ngendlela abacela ngayo ukuba kuboniswe, ngaphandle uma le ndlela eceliwe ingaphazamisa ngokungamukeleki ukusebenza nokusebenza kweMnyango Wezangaphandle noma idale umonakalo noma ibhidlize imibhalo noma iphule amalungelo emibhalo. Uma, ngezizathu zokusebenza, imibhalo ingatholakala ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngenye indlela, imali yokuthola imibhalo izobalwa ngokwezinga lokuthi umceli ufisa kanjani ukuboniswa. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma engakhubazekile, angabeka isicelo somlomo, lapho-ke uMsebenzi Wolwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu ngaye futhi amnikeze ifomu eliphelile. Uma efuna ukwaziswa ngempumelelo yesicelo ngefoni noma ngenye indlela. Isikhundla esisetshenziselwa ukufaka isicelo, uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Umceli kumele athumele isicelo sakhe ehhovisi elinikezwe ukwamukela izicelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, elizobe lenza lelo sikhathi sokucubungula leso sicelo. Ngemuva kokuba uMsebenzi Wolwazi enze isinqumo ngesicelo, umceli kumele waziswe ngalolo suku ngendlela akhethe ukuyaziswa. Uma, ngemuva kokulandela zonke izidingo zenqubo ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 4. Uma umceli efuna ukufaka isikhalazo, ifomu lesikhalazo elichazwe nguMthetho kuGov Gazette inombolo R187 enedethi ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2002 kumele ligcwaliswe. Uma umceli enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaMsebenzi Wolwazi okukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 4.3.1 ngenhla, isikhalazo singathunyelwa kuNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Umceli angathatha le ndaba enkantolo uma enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Bona Isheduli 1. Ngokusho komthetho, eminye imibhalo ingatholwa ngaphandle kokwenza isicelo ngokomthetho. Le mibhalo ingafinyelelwa kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezangaphandle kule ndawo: www.dfa.gov. UMnyango Wezangaphandle ugcina ulwazi ngezihloko ezilandelayo ezidinga ukufakwa ngokusemthethweni ngokwesigaba 4.2. Imiklomelo, amagama, imiklomelo, nezinye. Lo mbhalo uzovuselelwa ngokwezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14 soMthetho, okungenani ngezikhathi ezedlula unyaka. Futhi kuwebhusayithi yephakathi yomphakathi, njengoba kuchaziwe kule ndawo: www.dfa.gov. E. Imali a Isicelo sokuthola imibhalo, ngaphandle kwemibhalo equkethe ulwazi ngomceli uqobo, sizophathwa kuphela ngemva kokukhokha imali yokufaka is
Isithombe 1: Izitshalo zekhanda lekhanda zazinkulu kakhulu ukuze zifake ezikhungweni zokuhlwanyela - azizange zihlanyelwe. Isithombe 2: Imvula eningi ingaqinisa umhlabathi phezulu futhi ivimbele ukukhula kwezitshalo. Isithombe 3: Izitshalo zekhanda ezazihlanyelwe ngokujulile zazibhekene nezinkinga zokukhula kahle. Isithombe 4: Ingxenye yezinto ezivame ukudala ingozi ngemva kokukhula yizilokazane. Umsebenzi omningi okudingeka wenziwe ngesikhathi sokuhlwanyela ehlobo uvame ukuncipha ngalesi sikhathi - manje umnini wezolimo unethuba lokuhlola izitshalo zakhe ezikhulayo emapulazini akhe. Sikholelwa ukuthi konke kubukeka kahle: inani lezitshalo lihambisana nezintandokazi zakhe, umbala wezithombo ubumnyama obuhle, zikhula futhi akukho okuncintisana nezitshalo ukuze zibe nokudla namanzi - ngokufingqa, konke kukhombisa ukuthi kuzoba nokuvuna okuhle. Nokho, imvamisa izinto azihambi njengoba besicabanga ukuthi zizohamba, futhi umkhiqizo awuhambisani nezilindelo zethu. Ngalesi sikhathi, sidinga ukuhlala phansi futhi sihlolisise ukuthi kungani izinto ezingahambi kahle njengoba besifuna. Ingabe inani lezitshalo libalulekile noma cha? Lapho kuhlwanyelwa ukuze kuvinjwe, umnini wezolimo kufanele ahlaziye ukuthi mangaki izitshalo ahambisana nezincwadi zezazi zezolimo. Isitshalo esisodwa sinekhono lokukhiqiza inani elithile lokudla - izinto ezithinta ikhono lalo lokukhula kahle zifaka: inani lamanzi emhlabathini, izakhamzimba ezitholakalayo emhlabathini, ukukhanya (ukukhanya kwelanga), kanye noshukela. Ikakhulukazi, inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile lihambisana nomswakama emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke kakhulu kunokuhlukaniswa kwemigqa lapho zihlanyelwe khona. Ukuhlukaniswa kwemigqa ezindaweni ezithola imvula kuphela kuhluka, kusuka ku-0.9 m kuya ku-2.1 m noma ku-2.3 m. Lokhu kuhlobene futhi nemishini esetshenziswayo noma indlela yokulima kule ndawo. Imigqa ebanzi ivame ukuhlanyelwa lapho umkhiqizo uphansi, lapho kunezinkinga zomhlabathi ngenxa komoya, lapho inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile kufanele libe phansi kunezinye izindawo, futhi lapho imishini isasetshenziswa ukuze ikhulise phakathi kwemigqa. Imigqa eduze ivame ukutholakala lapho kunemvula eyanele futhi lapho kunomswakama emapulazini ukuze kudluliselwe amanzi, futhi lapho izihlahla ziqondiswa ngezikhemikhali (kulula ukukhiqiza ngemishini uma imigqa ibhajwe kakhulu, futhi i-traktor ayikwazi ukuhamba phakathi kwemigqa). Umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwufinyelela uhambisana nenani lezitshalo ohlanyelwe. Uma uhlanyela inani eliphansi lezitshalo, ngeke ufinyelele umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwufinyelela, futhi uma uhlanyela inani eliphezulu, izitshalo zizoncintisana ukuze zikhule futhi umkhiqizo uzokwehla. Izitshalo eziseduze kakhulu zivame ukuthola izifo (njengokubola kwemizi) futhi ziba nezehlakalo. Ezinye izindawo nezitsha ezithile zinezinga elifanele. Uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela ubukhulu bezitshalo obufunwa, umkhiqizo ngeke ufinyelele umgomo ofunwa (ngokufingqa, ngeke kube nezitshalo ezanele ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo ofunwa). Kungani kunenani elinganele lezitshalo? Kunemibandela eminingi engadala inani eliphansi, futhi lokhu kuhlobene nesikhathi sokuhlwanyela nokukhula kwezitshalo. Lokhu kuyinto enkulu ekugcineni eholela enanini eliphansi. Kungenzeka ukuthi ubukhulu bokuhlwanyela ngesikhathi sokuhlwanyela abukuhle, kuholela enanini eliphansi lezitshalo ezihlanyelwe. Kungenzeka ukuthi izitshalo zazinkulu kakhulu futhi azizange zifake ezikhungweni zokuhlwanyela (bona Isithombe 1). Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi izitshalo (izinkwa) zazincane kakhulu futhi ezimbili zazizama ukufaka endaweni eyodwa, zivaliwe ngaphandle kokuthi kukhishwe okuthile. Kungenzeka ukuthi umshini wokuhlwanyela obizwa ngokuthi 'ticker' wawenokuhlukumezeka futhi wacindezela izitshalo. Emshinini wokuhlwanyela ophathwa ngumoya, kungenzeka ukuthi umoya wokukhwabanisa awunamandla anele ukuze ubambe isitshalo endaweni efanele kuze kube sekukhuleni. Ngokuvamile, imishini yokuhlwanyela engalungile ivame ukudala izinkinga ngoba ibhajwa izitshalo eduze kakhulu noma ibhajwa. Ikhwalithi yezitshalo ingase ibe phansi - izitshalo ezimbi, lezo ezineziqu ezimbi ezingakhuli kahle. Kungenzeka ukuthi isimo sezulu siwumswakama kakhulu futhi izitshalo zimanzi kakhulu, zingatholi umoya (okhanyayo) emhlabathini ukuze zikhule. Ngokufanayo, umswakama ungavimba izitshalo ekutholeni umswakama owanele ukuze ziqale ukukhula. Kungenzeka ukuthi kube nezikhemikhali ezisele emhlabathini ezivela konyaka odlule ezabulala izitshalo. Kungenzeka ukuthi zihlanyelwe masinyane konyaka lapho umhlabathi wawubanda kakhulu ukuze usize izitshalo zikhule. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi izitshalo zihlanyelwe ngokujulile futhi zaphumelela ukuphuma (bona Isithombe 3). Izilokazane, izinyoni, noma ezinye izilwane ezincane zingadla izitshalo ngaphambi kokuthi zikhule. Inkinga evamile ukuvama izilokazane ezilimaza izitshalo - ikakhulukazi i-cutworm edla isitshalo njengoba sikhula emhlabathini (bona Isithombe 4). Izinyoni zingadla izitshalo (kodwa lokhu akuyona inkinga enkulu). Emhlabathini owomile, umoya (ukuhlukumeza) ungafaka izitshalo ngempahla njengoba zizama ukukhula. Ukushisa okweqile kungadala izitshalo ukuba zome futhi zife. Iqhwa elisheshayo konyaka lingabulala izitshalo. Kungenzeka futhi emapulazini lapho isivuno sahlanyelwe bese imvula eningi iqinisa umhlabathi. Uma uzama ukukhiqiza umhlabathi onzima ngensimbi, ungalimaza izitshalo. Ukufa kwezitshalo ngesikhathi zisakhula. Izilwane ezidla izitshalo zingaba yinkinga ezindaweni eziningi. Ukukhiqiza ngemishini kungalimaza izitshalo - uma imigqa ingahlukaniswanga kahle, noma umshayeli engashayeli kahle (lapho imigqa yezitshalo ingahambisani kahle futhi ayishayeli kahle kungalimaza izitshalo). Izifo zingaba yingozi. Lapho izihlahla zikhula kakhulu, zingabulala izitshalo zakho. Singaphumelela kanjani kulolu daba lokuntuleka kwezitshalo? Uma kusenesikhathi, ungaphinde uhlanyele (kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi kuzoba nezitshalo eziningi ezintsha). Uma kubonakala ukuthi kukhona umugqa owawungekahlanyelwa (ngoba umshini wokuhlwanyela wawungasebenzi kahle), lowo mugqa ungaphinde uhlanyelwe. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi izinkinga ezavela ngenxa yenani eliphansi lezitshalo zihlolwe futhi zilungiswe ukuze lezo ziphutha zingaphindi zenzeke ngonyaka ozayo.
Eminyakeni yethu yokuqala eyishumi njengohulumeni obusayo, siqondise amandla ethu nemizamo yethu ekushintsheni kusukela ekunakekeleni komphakathi kuya ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi ngokuhlela kahle ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza nemigomo. Njengomphakathi omusha, sithuthukise imigomo nezinsiza zomthetho ezivule indlela yokuthi singanikeza kanjani izinsiza kubantu abampofu nabasengcupheni njengoba bekulindeleke ngamalungelo abo. Umnyango eminyakeni eyishumi edlule ugxile ikakhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ekubhekaneni nezidingo zezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukubaluleka kwesabelomali sokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuholele ekwehliseni nasekuphuthumeni kwezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kuphinde kwanda ngenxa yokuthi izinsiza zokuvikela umphakathi zithuthukiswa ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, izinsiza ezinganele zokuhlinzeka ngeminye imisebenzi yomphakathi kubantu abadingayo, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono phakathi kwabachwepheshe ababalulekile, kanye nokubhekelelwa kwemibutho yomphakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuholele nasekuphuthumeni kwemibutho enjalo nokulahlekelwa ngabasebenzi bakahulumeni, okuthinte kabi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga, uMnyango Kazwelonke Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uqale inqubo yokuthuthukisa uMthetho Wezimali Zokukhuthaza abahlinzeki bezinsiza. Izimo zangempela zezwe zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababe baphucwa. Ukuze kuhanjiswe imigomo, kwathuthukiswa nezifanekiso zezindleko ukuze kubhekwe izinkinga ezibanzi ezizothathwa. I-PFA ingenye yezinsiza ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqhutshekwe nezinguquko kokubili ekwethulweni kwezinsiza nasekusekeleni kwezimali kubahlinzeki bezinsiza. Uhulumeni, ngokuqhuba uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, kumele wethule le mvume, futhi siyazi ukuthi asikakwazi ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso nemigomo sodwa. Ngakho-ke, siwavule amaphiko ethu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana, ukusebenzisana, nokubandakanywa nemibutho Engahulumeni (NGOs), Imibutho Ekholelwayo (FBOs), Imibutho Ebasemphakathini (CBOs), imibutho ehambisana nohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Kumele zixhaswe kahle futhi kumele kube nezindinganiso ezibekwe ngendlela ezixhaswa ngayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe izifunda. Izifanekiso Zezindleko Zohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ziqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukusethwa kwezindinganiso nokulingana ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza. Iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa, njengoba kuchazwe ku-PFA, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ziqondiswa emiphakathini nasezikhungweni ezidinga kakhulu futhi ukuthi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithengekayo. Ngemuva kwalokhu, uhulumeni uthuthukise futhi wavuma amathuluzi okuphatha nezikhombisi-ndlela, ezihlanganisa ingxenye yesikhungo esibanzi sokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza okumele kuhlanganiswe noMthetho Wezimali Zokukhuthaza kanye neSifanekiso Sokwethulwa Kwezinsiza. Njengohulumeni, ngeke sikhohlwe ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nemiphakathi ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza. Sibone amaphrojekthi afana nezinhlelo Zomsebenzi Womphakathi Ewandisiwe (EPWP), Izinhlelo Zokunciphisa Ubumpofu (ukubala ezimbalwa), ezihlanganisa umphakathi nohulumeni ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza. Yile moya yokubambisana ezosisiza sibone imiphumela engcono nokubandakanywa kwabantu bethu kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Izinsiza nezinsizakalo ezenziwe ngababambiqhaza, abahlinzeki bezinsiza ezizimele, kanye namalungu omphakathi zibalulekile kakhulu. Ngempela, ngempumelelo yeqembu singenza sithi isisekelo sesakhiwe, nakuba kunobunzima obuningi esibhekene nabo ekwenzeni izinkokhelo ezibalulekile kubantu abangujwayelekile abangujwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika abalahlekelwa ithemba ezinsizeni zethu. Umnyango uphinde ufise ukuqaphela abantu nezikhungo ezisizile ekuthuthukiseni le mthetho, iminyango ezingeni lesifunda, amalungu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi ngeziphakamiso zabo nemibono. Ukubambisana komnyango nomphakathi kuhlala kuyisici esiyinhloko sezinhloso zokweseka ukusebenza kahle nokufeza umgomo wethu. Uhulumeni namuhla ubhekene nezinkinga ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza ezinhle kakhulu kubantu abakhathazekile nabaphucwa emphakathini. Emlandweni, izinsiza zokunakekela umphakathi zaziyimfuno yokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni nemibutho yomphakathi, lapho uhulumeni ayengumxhaso ophambili wemibutho ngokwesekwa kwawo. Izimo zangempela zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababe baphucwa. Izinyathelo zithathwe esikhathini esedlule ukuze kuthuthukiswe umthetho wezikhuthazo zezimali ze-NPOs. Nokho, lo mthetho awukakafiki ezidingweni zombili zikahulumeni kanye nomkhakha we-NPO. Manje sekukhona isidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthuthukisa umthetho ozokuqinisekisa ukuthi umnyango ungahlinzeka ngezinsiza ukuze uthembise ukuphila okungcono kubantu bonke. Umthetho wezikhuthazo zezimali uhlose ukuhlela ukuxhaswa kwezimali zezwe kubahlinzeki bezinsiza emkhakheni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, usheshise ukuletha izinguquko nokuhlela izinsiza nezimali, futhi uqinisekise izinsiza ezisebenzayo nezisebenzayo emiphakathini ebuthakathaka nabampofu. Lo mthetho uzinikele ekuqedeni ukufinyelela kwezinsiza kubampofu nabaphucwa ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila okungcono kubo, ngokubambisana nalabo abafuna ukwakha umphakathi onakekelayo. Umthetho nezinsiza zomthetho zezwe zenza indawo efanele yokuthi umnyango ufeze izinhloso zawo, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokusatshalaliswa okufanele kwezinsiza. Igunya eliphethwe umkhakha we-NPO ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza liyavuma. Ezinye ze-NPOs ziye zenza izinguquko ezibalulekile mayelana nezidingo zokunakekelwa komphakathi zezwe. Nokho, ukuguqulwa okudingekayo kuseyinkinga enkulu kuhulumeni. Ukufinyelela kulokhu kanye nokwethulwa kwemvume yakho, umnyango udinga ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izinhloso okufanele zifezekiswe, ukuthi zizofezekiswa kanjani, nokuthi zingakhalipha kanjani ukusebenza kohlelo. Umthetho ubeka phambili izinselelo nezindawo ezibhekiswe kuzo, ezizokwenza ukuthi kuqondiswe kanjani izinsiza, kuphi, futhi ngubani, nokuthi zixhaswe kanjani nguhulumeni. Uveza izindinganiso zokukhethwa kokuxhaswa. Izindinganiso zokufaneleka, kanye nezindlela zokukhokha nezidingo zokuxhaswa. Njengoba kwenziwa emhlabeni jikelele, abaxhasi bomphakathi nabazimele bafuna ukubhekelelwa kwezimali abazixhasayo, kuhlanganise nokukhalipha ukusebenza kahle. Umnyango uzongena ezivumelwaneni nabahlinzeki bezinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza okulindelekile kuyafezekiswa nok
uKabza De Small: Umculi Ohlonishwayo Nophumelelayo U-Kabza De Small, ogama lakhe langempela linguKabelo Motha, ungumculi ophumelelayo, umkhiqizi, kanye nomdansi odumile eNingizimu Afrika. Wazalelwa eSoweto, eGauteng, ngomhla ka-27 kuNhlangulana ngo-1992. U-Kabza, owaziwa kakhulu ngokuqamba izigqi ezijabulisayo neziphumelelayo, ungomunye wabaculi abahamba phambili emkhakheni we-Amapiano, uhlobo lomculo olwakhiwe ngama-sounds ahlukahlukene, okubandakanya i-house, jazz, ne-kwaito. U-Kabza De Small uqale ukuthanda umculo kusenesikhathi empilweni yakhe. Njengomfana, wayevame ukuhamba nabangane bakhe, edlala umculo ezindaweni zomphakathi. Uthando lwakhe lomculo lwamkhuthaza ukuba aqale ukufunda ukudlala izinsimbi, futhi wathola ukuthi ungakha umculo wakhe. Ngemuva kokuphothula isikole, u-Kabza waqhubeka nezifundo zakhe zomculo, lapho athola khona amathuba okusebenza nabanye abaculi abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Ngonyaka ka-2016, u-Kabza De Small waqala ukwakha igama lakhe emhlabeni womculo, lapho ethola khona ithuba lokubambisana nabanye abaculi abanjengo DJ Maphorisa. Lezi zibopho zakhula zaba yimpumelelo enkulu, zenza ukuthi umculo wakhe udume kakhulu, futhi kwavela imisebenzi eminingi ethokozisayo. U-Kabza waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni i-Amapiano, futhi waba ngumholi walesi sitayela, enza izinkanyezi zikhanye emculweni. U-Kabza De Small uthole udumo olukhulu ngempumelelo yakhe emculweni. Uvele ezinkundleni ezinkulu zomculo, ezihlanganisa imicimbi emikhulu, futhi uthole izindondo eziningi, kuhlanganise ne-National Arts Festival, i-SAMA (South African Music Awards), kanye ne-MTV Africa Music Awards. Ubuye abe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni abanye abaculi abasha, ebakhuthaza ukuba balandele amaphupho abo emculweni. Ngaphezu kokuba umculi ophumelelayo, u-Kabza De Small ungumuntu ophilayo impilo ethokozisayo. Uthanda ukuhamba, ukudla, nokuchitha isikhathi nabangane bakhe nemindeni. U-Kabza ubonakala engumuntu ophansi, onobuntu, futhi uhlala eqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima ukuze athuthukise umculo wakhe. Uhlonipha izimpande zakhe, futhi uhlala ebonga abathandi bakhe, abamthandayo futhi bemsupporta emsebenzini wakhe. U-Kabza De Small uyisibonelo sokuthi ngempela, uma ungasebenzela iphupho lakho, ungakwenza. Ubonisa ukuthi umculo unamandla okushintsha izimpilo, futhi uhlala ezama ukufaka umoya omuhle emphakathini. U-Kabza uyazi ukuthi umculo wakhe ungathinta abantu abaningi, futhi usebenzisa leli thuba ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi abasha abaphila ezindaweni ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Kabza De Small uqhubeka nokwakha igama lakhe emhlabeni womculo. Uhlale eqhubeka nokwakha, efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza umculo wakhe ube ngcono. U-Kabza ungomunye wabaculi abahle kakhulu e-Afrika, futhi ubukeka ezokwenza izimpumelelo eziningi ezizayo. Uthando lwakhe lomculo, ubuhlakani, kanye nomsebenzi onzima kwenze waba yisithombe esihle emculweni wezwe. Ngokubuka phambili, u-Kabza De Small ubheka amaphupho amakhulu. Uhlale efuna izindlela zokwakha umculo ophumelelayo, futhi ubheke phambili ekubambeni izinkanyezi ezinkulu emculweni. U-Kabza uyisibonelo sokuthi umculo ungashintsha izimpilo, futhi ubalulekile empilweni yabaningi. Ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe kanzima, u-Kabza De Small uzoba yinkanyezi engapheli emculweni, futhi sizobona izimpumelelo ezinkulu ezizayo.
Phakathi kwehlelo eliphelele lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo, uhulumeni uzohlinzeka ngosizo ezixhweni ezibuthakathaka ezingakwazi ukufinyelela ukudla okwanele nokunempilo ngenxa yobumpofu kanye nokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla. Uhulumeni ubeke eceleni u-R1.2 billion eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Inani le-R400 million selivele labekwa ukuze lisetshenziswe ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2002/3, kanti u-R170 million usetshenziswe ukusiza abadinga usizo ezweni elizungezile. U-R230 million ubekwe eceleni ukuze kuzuze imindeni engama-200,000 ebuthakathaka ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo. Izikhwama zokudla zizohlukaniswa emakhaya angenayo imali naleso esingakwazi ukukhokhela ukudla okungafika ku-R200 ngenyanga. Le mikhankaso eqhubekayo ibonwa ngokuxoxisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlangano zokukholelwa, amaqembu ezabasebenzi, izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni, kanye nohulumeni uqobo. Inhloso enkulu yale hlelo wukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu bonke ngokwandisa amandla angaphakathi emindeni ebuthakathaka ukuze ibhekane nobumpofu nokuhlupheka, ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo, nokuthola ukuvikelwa ezindlekweni zokudla eziphakeme. Usizo lokudla luzohlinzekwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezikhwama zokudla emakhaya abuthakathaka phakathi nezinyanga ezintathu. Ukuhlinzekwa kokuqala kwezithombo kuzohlinzekwa ukusiza le midlalo ikhulise ukudla kwabo futhi ithuthukise izimpilo zabo. Kuzohlinzekwa ukwesekwa kwemisebenzi yokwenza imali. Ukuqinisa umnikelo wohlelo lokudla ezikoleni. Ukubhalisela usizo lokudla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ukudla okunempilo okugcwele ama-vithamini namaminerali. Izingane, ikakhulukazi lezo eziyizikhonzi zemakhaya: amafutha nezinsizwa ezithintekile yi-HIV/AIDS nemindeni yazo zizothola kakhulu. Kwamanye amazwe, ezindaweni nasemakhaya, lezi zinsizakalo ezilandelayo zisebenzisana; uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, uMnyango Wezempilo, uMnyango Wezolimo, uMnyango Wezemfundo, iBhodi Yocwaningo Ngezokwakha Nezobuchwepheshe (CSIR), uMnyango Wezibalo eNingizimu Afrika, iNational Development Agency (NDA), kanye ne-Independent Development Trust (IDT). Izinhlangano ezahlukene zokukholelwa, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, nezinkampani zisebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bathola ukuphepha kokudla. Imisebenzi eminingi ihlelwe ukuze kuqwashiswe ngohlelo lwezokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Ubumpofu buyisitha esiyinhloko sabantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sisebenze ndawonye njengababusi bezombusazwe, abakhokheli bendabuko, izinhlangano zokukholelwa, amaqembu ezabasebenzi, imiphakathi, nezinkampani uma sifuna ukuphumelela. Ukuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe impumelelo. Le Comprehensive Food and Nutrition Security Program ilethwa nguHulumeni.
Imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa yiphepha elikhishwe nguMnyango WezamaNandi Nezamandla, elikuvumela ukuthi wenze imisebenzi yokumbiwa. Akekho ongenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ngaphandle kokuthola imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa. Imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ayikwazi ukudluliselwa komunye umuntu. Inhloso yemvume ukuhlela ukuhlolwa kwezinsiza zamaminerali kanye nokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ngokuhlinzeka ngempilo nokuphepha, ukuphathwa kwemvelo, kanye nokukhipha kahle kwezinsiza zamaminerali. Imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa kumele isebenze ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo emvume, kodwa engadluli eminyakeni emibili. Ingavuselelwa kathathu, kodwa ukuvuselelwa ngakunye akukwazi ukudlula unyaka owodwa. Imineral ephathelene nayo ingambiwa isikhathi esingaminyaka emibili, futhi indawo yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ayikwazi ukudlula 1.5 m². Akekho omunye umuntu onelungelo lokuhlola izinsiza zamaminerali, ilungelo lokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa, imvume yokwenza imisebenzi yokumbiwa, noma imvume yokukhipha izinsiza zamaminerali noma umhlaba. Faka isicelo kumphathi wesifunda woMnyango WezamaNandi Nezamandla endaweni lapho umhlaba utholakala khona. Qedela Ifomu F: Faka isicelo semvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa etholakala ehhovisi leMphathi Wesifunda. Ungathola le fomula nasewebhusayithi kuleli qophelo elingezansi. Thumela ifomu kanye nezindleko ezinqunyiwe ezingabuyiswanga ehhovisi leMphathi Wesifunda, lapho umhlaba utholakala khona. UMphathi Wesifunda uzokwamukela isicelo uma zonke izidingo zihlangatshezwana. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uMphathi Wesifunda uzocela ukuthi uthumele uhlelo lokuphathwa kwemvelo, kanye nokuxhumana nomnikazi womhlaba kanye nezithakazelo zomthetho, nezinye izinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Thumela umbiko wokuxhumana kumphathi wesifunda ezinsukwini eziyi-30. Umphakathi uzokhipha imvume uma zonke izidingo zihlangatshezwana. UMphathi Wesifunda uzokwazi ukukwazisa ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele, okusho ukuthi uhambisane nazo zonke izidingo. Umnyango uzobeka izindleko, futhi le mali ayibuyiswanga. Izinhlamvu zezindleko zihluka kuye ngemininingwane yeminerali ofuna ukuyisebenzisa.
Izikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Ukubaluleka Kwazo Emphakathini Wethu Emphakathini wethu, izikhungo zezempilo zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni impilo engcono. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zikhungo ezingama-72, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ziwusizo olukhulu emiphakathini. Lezi zikhungo azigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo, kodwa futhi zikhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nempilo engcono, futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zikhungo zikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezibhedlela, izikhungo zokwelapha, nezindawo zokuhlola. Lokhu kuhluka kwenza kube lula kubantu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni abazidingayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhungo zitholakala nasemaphandleni, okwenza kube lula kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba impilo ingenamkhawulo, futhi wonke umuntu kufanele akwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezidingekayo. Okwesibili, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zikhuthaza imfundo ngezempilo. Ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngwelashwa, lezi zikhungo zifundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilile, izindlela zokugwema izifo, kanye nezidingo zomzimba. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba uma abantu beqonda kahle izindlela zokuphila eziphilile, bangakwazi ukuvikela impilo yabo. Imfundo ngezempilo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi izikhungo zezempilo zidlala indima enkulu kulokhu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lapho abantu behlangana ezikhungweni zezempilo, bakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, obuvumela ukuxhumana okuhle okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ubudlelwano obuhle buvumela abantu ukuba babelane ngolwazi nezinsiza, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo lwezempilo. Okwesine, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izisebenzi zezempilo zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni impilo engcono. Lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi izisebenzi zikhathalela impilo yabo, bakhuthazwa ukuba baphendule kahle ezinsizeni ezitholakalayo, okudala umoya wokwethembana phakathi kwabo. Ngokuphetha, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. Zikhuthaza ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, imfundo ngezempilo, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi zezempilo nabantu. Njengoba sikhula njengomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zikhungo zihlala zikhona, zisebenza kahle, futhi zikhuthaza impilo engcono. Impilo yempilo yethu iyinhloko, futhi izikhungo zezempilo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke nokuxhasa lezi zikhungo, siqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhona ukuze ziqhubeke nokusiza abantu bethu. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokuphila impilo enempilo, futhi kufanele sizisebenzise ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi wethu.
Izindlu Zomphakathi: Ingxoxo Nezidingo Zomphakathi Umqondisi: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokubambisana nathi namuhla. Ngifuna ukuxoxa ngendaba ebalulekile – izindlu zomphakathi. Ngabe unganginika umbono wakho ngokubaluleka kwezindlu zomphakathi emphakathini wethu? Umphakathi: Sanibonani! Ngiyabonga futhi ngalesi sikhathi. Izindlu zomphakathi zibaluleke kakhulu. Zisiza abantu abaningi abafuna indawo yokuhlala, ikakhulukazi labo abangenamali eyanele ukuze bathenge izindlu. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, indawo yokuhlala ibalulekile ekwakheni impilo enempilo. Umqondisi: Ngempela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlu zomphakathi zidingeka kwi-eco­nomy nabantu. Zikuphi izinselelo ezibhekene nezinhlaka zokwakha lezi zindlu? Umphakathi: Kuneziningi. Okokuqala, izinsiza zihlala ziphansi – uma sikhuluma ngezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwakha. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwemali kubangela izinhlelo zokwakha zihlale sezibhujiswe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo ziningi zidinga ukuhamba phambili nezidingo zezakhamizi, ezivame ukungabi lula ukuziqonda. Umqondisi: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zomphakathi zingathuthukiswa kanjani? Umphakathi: Yebo, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni nezinkampani ezizimele kubalulekile. Umphakathi kufanele uthumele izicelo nezidingo zabo ukuze izinhlelo zibe yimpumelelo. Futhi, ukusebenzisa izinsizakusebenza ezivela endaweni kungadambisa izindleko. Uhlelo kufanele lube nezindlela zokuhlola impumelelo ukuze kube nezenzo ezilungile. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kulungile. Ngabe unakekela isimo sokuhlala esikhona? Yikuphi okukhathazayo kulokhu? Umphakathi: Yebo, ngikhathazekile ngezindawo eziningi ezibikwe njengezindlu zomphakathi. Kwezinye izindawo, izindlu zikhula kakhulu, futhi kubonakala sengathi zikhula ngokushesha kunokuthi ziqhubeke zisebenze ngempumelelo. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga zokubonakala kokuphila, ngezinye izikhathi ezindaweni ezithandwa abantu. Umqondisi: Lokho kuyinkinga enkulu. Kuthinta kanjani izakhamizi ezihlala kulezi zindawo? Umphakathi: Izakhamizi zikhathazekile kakhulu. Uma izindlu zingalungile, lokhu kuthela izandla ezingekho emthethweni, lokhu kuveza izinkinga zempilo kanye nezinye izinkinga zomphakathi. Kukhona ubudlelwano obubuhlungu phakathi kwesimo sabo kanye nesimo sezimo ezandleni. Umqondisi: Ngabe kunendlela ethile yokuxazulula lezi zinkinga? Umphakathi: Ngikholelwa ekutheni indlela yokuxazulula lezi zinkinga kudinga ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Ukuhlanganyela kwabo kubalulekile; izihlalo zomphakathi zokwakha zidinga ukusizwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni kufanele ahehlela izinhlelo ezithuthukayo ukuze kuphumelele ukufunda ngempilo yendawo. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuveza umbono ophakeme. Kuze kube manje, unayo imisho yokugcina okufanele uyiphephe? Umphakathi: Yebo, ngithanda ukusho ukuthi izindlu zomphakathi ziyisikhumbuzo sokuthi sinemithwalo engama kuleli. Uzokwazi ukusisiza uma ukhona nesiyaziyo. Ngakho-ke, ngicela abantu ukuba bahlale bezivakashela izidingo zomphakathi, kuphumelele ukufaka izwi labo, bese sikhuthaza uhlelo lwezindlu ezithuthukayo. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi, futhi ngiyabonga ngemicabango yakho ecacile mayelana nezindlu zomphakathi. Yilokhu okudingeka ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Umphakathi: Ngiyabonga futhi, ngithemba lokuthi lezizwi zizokhuthaza abanye. Futhi, kuzofanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukuzwana kwemiphakathi kusebenza lapho kanjani.
Abafundi Basenyuvesi Umbuzo 1: Yini eyenza abafundi basenyuvesi bahluke kwabanye? Impendulo: Abafundi basenyuvesi bahluke kwabanye ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, baphakathi kweminyaka yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa, lapho behlangabezana nezinselelo ezahlukahlukene. Baphinde babe nethuba lokufunda okuningi, okungabathuthukisa emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ezokuxhumana, kanye nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okuphatha. Lokhu kubenza babe neqhaza elibalulekile emphakathini, njengoba behola izinguquko eziningi ezibhekelele ikusasa. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabafundi basenyuvesi? Impendulo: Abafundi basenyuvesi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nezimali, isikhathi, nokucindezelwa kokufunda. Abanye bahlupheka ngokungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokukhokhela izifundo, izindleko zokuphila, kanye nezinsiza zokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, isikhathi esithathwa ukufunda, ukwenza imisebenzi, kanye nokuzijabulisa kungaholela ekucindezelekeni. Lokhu kudinga abafundi ukuba bakwazi ukuphatha kahle izinsiza zabo ukuze baphumelele. Umbuzo 3: Abafundi basenyuvesi bangazithuthukisa kanjani? Impendulo: Ukuze abafundi basenyuvesi bazithuthukise, kubalulekile ukuthi benze izinhlelo zokuphila ezicacile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufunda kahle, ukuhlela isikhathi, nokuzibandakanya emisebenzini ehlukene. Ukuze bazithuthukise, bangabamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzijabulisa, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi. Futhi, ukufuna izeluleko kubafundisi noma kubangani kungasiza ekutholeni izindlela ezintsha zokufunda. Umbuzo 4: Yini ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi? Impendulo: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi busekelwe ekuxhumaneni nasekuqondeni. Kubalulekile ukuba abafundi bakwazi ukuxoxa ngezinto ezithinta impilo yabo, izifundo, nezifiso zabo. Ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, kufanele bakhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, benze imihlangano, futhi baphathe izimo ezinzima ngokubambisana. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba babe nempilo engcono, futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ekufundeni kwabo. Umbuzo 5: Yini abafundi abangayenza ukuze bathuthukise imiphumela yabo yokufunda? Impendulo: Abafundi bangathuthukisa imiphumela yabo yokufunda ngokwenza izifundo zibe nenjongo. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusetha imigomo ecacile, ukufunda izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda, nokusebenzisa izinsiza ezifanele. Ukuze baphumelele, kufanele bahlale bephuma emakhonweni abo, bahlale bejolise ezintweni ezibalulekile, futhi baphathe izifundo zabo njengomsebenzi obalulekile. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphumelele ezivivinyweni nasemiphumeleni yokugcina. Umbuzo 6: Yini edinga ukwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokufunda ezikoleni? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokufunda ezikoleni, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinhle zokuxhasa abafundi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezifanele, ukufundisa izindlela zokuphatha isikhathi, kanye nokwakha imiphakathi yokufunda. Abafundisi, abaphathi bezikole, kanye nohulumeni kumele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizothuthukisa izimo zokufunda. Lokhu kuzokwenza abafundi bazizwe bejabulile futhi benesithakazelo ezifundweni zabo. Umbuzo 7: Yini eyenza abafundi basenyuvesi babe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini? Impendulo: Abafundi basenyuvesi banomthelela omuhle emphakathini ngenxa yokuba neqhaza elikhulu ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa. Bahlala bephakamisa izinhlelo zokuziphatha, ezokwelapha, nezokuxhumana. Ubudlelwano babo nabanye abantu, kuhlanganise nezinkampani, izikhungo, kanye nohulumeni, buvumela ukuthi benze izinguquko ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubenza babe nokwazisa okukhulu emphakathini, futhi balingana nezimo ezikhona. Umbuzo 8: Yini okufanele abafundi bayikhumbule ngesikhathi sokufunda? Impendulo: Abafundi kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi ukufunda akupheli kuphela ezincwadini, kodwa kuthinta impilo yabo yonke. Kubalulekile ukuba bahlale bejolise ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo, baphathe izifundo zabo ngokuzimisela, futhi bazi ukuthi impumelelo itholakala ngokusebenza kanzima. Ukuzijabulisa, ukuxhumana nabanye, kanye nokuphila impilo enempilo nakho kubalulekile ukuze baphumelele. Isiphetho: Abafundi basenyuvesi bahlala bephila empilweni egcwele izinselelo nezithakazelo. Ukuphumelela kwabo akuncike kuphela ezifundweni, kodwa nakubudlelwano, ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, nasekuphatheni izinsiza zabo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi ukuthi banganqoba kanjani izinselelo zabo, benze izinhlelo ezicacile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile ukuze baphumelele empilweni nasemsebenzini wabo.
Ingxoxo noMartin Luther King Jr. Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukwanda komlando, sikhumbula uMartin Luther King Jr., umholi ophawulekayo emizamweni yokulwa nokucwaswa. UKing, owazalwa ngo-1929 eAtlanta, eGeorgia, waba yisithonjana sokulwa nokungalingani, futhi imizamo yakhe ibalulekile emlandweni we-United States. Kulokhu, sizobheka imibono yakhe, izifundo, nezifiso ezazihambisana nomsebenzi wakhe. Umlando kaMartin Luther King Jr. UMartin Luther King Jr. wakhulela emndenini ophilayo, owawuqhakambisa izimiso zokuhlalisana. Udadewabo, uAlfred Daniel King, kanye noMama wakhe, uAlberta Williams King, bamfundisa ukubaluleka kokuhlalisana kwabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ngemibala yabo. UKing wathola imfundo ephakeme, waphothula izifundo eMorehouse College, eCrozer Theological Seminary, naseBoston University. Lezi zifundo zamsiza ukuba aqonde kahle izinkinga zomphakathi, futhi zaba yisisekelo sokuba abe umholi. Imibono kaKing UKing wayekholelwa ekutheni uthando lungaphezu kokuphikisana. Wathi: "Uthando lungumgibeli ophakeme, olungabheki emuva." Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokusebenza kwakhe. Waqonda ukuthi ukulwa nokucwaswa akufanele kube nokuhlukumeza, kodwa kufanele kube nokukhuthaza. UKing wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele ngokuthula, futhi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu emfundisweni kaMahatma Gandhi, owafundisa ukuthi ukulwa nokucwaswa kufanele kube ngokuthula. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nokucwaswa UKing waqala ukuhlela izinyathelo eziningi zokulwa nokucwaswa. Ngonyaka ka-1955, waqala umkhankaso ophumelelayo wokumisa uhambo lwezitimela eMontgomery, eAlabama, lapho abesifazane abamnyama, uRosa Parks, engavumelanga ukuhamba emuva kwesitimela. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu bahlale phansi, baphikise ukucwaswa. UKing waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu bangahlangana ukuze baphikise ukungalingani. Izenzo Zokuthula UKing waba nomthelela omkhulu emihlanganweni eminingi, efana neSikhumbuzo seMpi Yezwe Yezokuhlalisana eWashington, lapho wakhuluma khona khona lapho. Uthando lwakhe, ubuhlakani, nokukhuthaza kwabantu kwaba yizinto ezazihamba phambili. Wathi: "Ngiyafisa ukuba nekhaya elinothando, elinokuthula, elinokuhlalisana." Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uKing wayengumholi ophumelelayo, owazama ukwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Izithiyo Nezimpumelelo Noma kunjalo, uKing wabhekana nezithiyo eziningi. Waboshwa, wathola izinsolo, futhi waba nezinselelo ezinzima. Nokho, akazange ayeke. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile ngokuthula, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu angashintsha umhlaba.
