UKing waphumelela ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinkulu, ezifana neCivil Rights Act ka-1964, eyavuma amalungelo abantu abamnyama. Ukufa Nokuphila Kwakhe Ngokudabukisayo, uMartin Luther King Jr. wabulawa ngo-1968, kodwa imiyalezo yakhe isaphila. Uthando, ubuhlakani, nokukhuthaza kwabantu bahlala bukhona. UKing waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu bangashintsha umhlaba, futhi imizamo yakhe ibalulekile emlandweni. Uthando lwakhe luhlala lukhanya, futhi imiyalezo yakhe isafundiswa ezikoleni nasemiphakathini. Isiphetho UMartin Luther King Jr. ungumholi ophawulekayo, owashintsha umhlaba. Imizamo yakhe yokulwa nokucwaswa, uthando, nokukhuthaza abantu ibalulekile. UKing usifundisa ukuthi uthando lungaphezulu kokuphikisana, futhi ukuthi abantu bangahlangana ukuze baphikise ukungalingani. Ngakho, asiqhubeke sikhumbula uMartin Luther King Jr. futhi sithathe izifundo ezivela emsebenzini wakhe, ukuze sakhe umphakathi ophilayo, onothando, nolungile.
Othisha Ngonyaka owodwa, emzaneni ophakathi kwezimfunda, kwakukhona isikole esincane esaziwayo ngothisha bazo abahloniphekile. Lesi sikole sasingaphansi kwezimvula eziningi, futhi sasiqonda ukuthi ukufunda ngesikhathi semvula kube yinto ebalulekile empilweni yabantu bendawo. Phakathi kwalezi zinkanyezi, bekukhona othisha abaningi, kodwa ababili baye baba yizibonelo eziphawulekayo: uMfundisi Thandiwe noMfundisi Sipho. UMfundisi Thandiwe wayengumama opholile, othathekile ngothando lokufundisa. Wayekhuluma kahle futhi ewusizo kulabo ababephansi komuthi omkhulu ophakathi kwezinkanyezi. Ubani ongakukhohlwa ukuthi uThandiwe wayejabula ngokufundisa, futhi wayenothando lokuqonda izidingo zabafundi bakhe. Wayengowesifazane owayekwazi ukubamba inhliziyo yomfundi, engaba ngumphefumulo wabo emizamweni yabo yokuphumelela. UMfundisi Sipho, ngakolunye uhlangothi, wayengumuntu onobuchwepheshe, onomdlandla kakhulu. Wayenolwazi olunzulu ngazo zonke izifundo, futhi wayekwazi ukuphendula imibuzo engakaze ibuzwe. Uthando lwakhe lokufunda lwalukhula, futhi wayevame ukujabulisa abafundi bakhe ngezinkanyezi nemiyalezo emihle. Nokho, bekukhona okuthile okwakungahambisani phakathi kwalaba bobabili othisha, kokubili abaziphatha kahle, bedlula ezinye izimfanelo zabafundi. Ngesizini, uMfundisi Thandiwe waphawula ukuthi abazali bokuqala babasekela kakhulu ezikoleni, kodwa ukuntuleka kwemali kwakufuna ukuthi bazifundise ngemfundo. Wayebazi kahle – ukuba uSipho ababekhuluma ngokuncane, wayengavumi ukuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Ngenhlanhla, wayenothando lokufunda, kodwa uThandiwe wayenendlela yokuxhuma nomphakathi. Kwakuyiphupho lakhe ukuba nabafundi bakhe bazi kahle ukuthi ukuhlakanipha akuwona umgomo kuphela, kodwa umuzwa wokuthula nokubumbana. Esikhathini esithile, uSipho wayehamba phambili, egxila emiphumeleni emihle, kodwa uThandiwe wayeqinile kakhudlwana. UThandiwe wakha umphakathi, wathi, "Uma sizama ukufundisa, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abafundi bethu bangabantu abanezinkanyezi ezihlukahlukene." Wayekwazi ukubanikeza izifundo zenhlonipho, ukudlula phezu kokukwazi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uSipho wayengathandi ukusebenza nomphakathi. Wayefuna ukubona izimpumelelo zabo ngamazinga abhalwe phansi, okwakwenza uThandiwe akhathazeke uma ebheka isimo somoya ophakathi kwabo. UThandiwe wakwazi ukuhamba naphakathi kwabo, ewusizo nephumelelayo, eqhubeka ukufundisa abafundi bakhe ngezizathu zokuhlonipha. Ngelinye ilanga, kwenzeka ingaphakathi elibalulekile emabenzi. Bafuna ukukhipha isixazululo sokukhuluma nabazali ukuze babonane nomphakathi. Lokhu kwakubhalwe emuva kokuheha komunye umqondisi, owayecabanga ukuthi kusekude isizathu sokuhambisa izifundo, kodwa omunye odlalayo, ikakhulukazi uMfundisi Thandiwe, wathi, "Kumele sikukhumbuze okujulelwe emtsheni. Umphakathi ufuna upande." Ngaleso sikhathi, kusho ngokubonisa, bekuyovela izolo umqondisi wezokuxhumana. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho wakhumbula ngokufana naleso sikhathi, "Kuyabalulekile ukuvuma izinqumo ezizokwenza sibe ngcono." Umzwangedwa uThandiwe wenza imizamo emisha, ukwazisa emsebenzini wabo bahlonipha. Babengaphosi wonke uma behamba ndawonye, behamba bejezisa abafundi. Ukuze bakhumbule, kulandela usuku, babeqhuba umhlangano wokuxoxisana. UThandiwe wayekhala engathokozile, "Siyalindela izimpilo zabafundi." Lekhono labezinhlaka ezimbili. Kukhona okuhle nokubi ephakeme, kodwa abahlali bephikweni leziqhamo kwezokufundisana. Kulokhu, uSipho wayekhumbula kahle, "Ngabe sizokwenzenjani ukuze sizame ukudala ngamunye." Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandiwe nabanye othisha baphuma nezinye izinhlelo ezichazwe kuzwi, basebenzisa uSipho ukuxhobisa nokuqeqeshwa kwezizathu eziphakeme zokufundisa. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe noSipho bazifundisa nabanye, bazixhumanisa, bekwazi ukuveza ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukufundisa ngempela. Kwaphela izinyanga, kwanezelwa ikusasa elikhanyayo, ukufunda kube isimanga, kuthokozisa umphakathi. Uthando lwahlahlisa izinkanyezi, kwagcizelela ukusebenza kwabafundi, kwazoba umbono ophakeme ngothando lokufunda. Nakuba baphuma phezu kwalezi zinsuku, uThandiwe noSipho basengaphakanyiswa umoya wobuciko, umoya wokuhlonipha. Izizwe zokufunda zazingalungiswa, kodwa imizwa yokuhlonipha yaqhubeka isinikela, ilima eliqinisekisa omunye nomunye. Ngenhlanhla, ukuphila kwemfundo kwabafundi babebahlonipha, bekhumbula izifundo ezihlobene nezintho ezimbalwa. Othisha abababawa, baba nomphakathi, baphefumula ubukhazikhazi bacela umhlaba. Lezi zinkanyezi zakhumbula ukulingana okukhanyayo phakathi kokubili, bezama ukuthola izimpendulo. Kwakuyisifundo esikhulu, uThandiwe noSipho babengamakhosi omphakathi, bejabulile ngothando lobuchwepheshe, kuze kube sekupheleni kwabo nosuku, kwaze kwashintsha izimpilo zihambe phambili.
Kubhalwe kahle ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi noma iyiphi INKONZO YOKUXHUMANA NEMFUNDO/IMIGOMO YOKUXHUMANA ibe ngaphansi kwenkampani ye-inshurensi ebhalisiwe yesikhathi eside. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ummember uthola izimali zokuxhaswa uma efuna ngesikhathi senzeka okuthile okudingayo inshurensi (ukufa). UMHLOBO WEMIGOMO/UMMEMBER kumele anikezwe ISITIFEKETI SOMMEMBER. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise ngokucacile igama lenkampani enikeza le migomo; inani elizokhokhwa; izinzuzo ezizokhokhwa; izinqubo zokufaka izicelo zezimali nezinye izinto ezibalulekile mayelana ne-MASTER POLICY. I-MASTER POLICY kumele ibonise ngokucacile ukuthi abaphathi bezemihlangano noma abasebenzi abaqashwe yinkampani yemigomo abawukhokhi le migomo. Kubalulekile kubanikazi bemigomo ukuthi bazi ukuthi bangakhetha ukuthola izinzuzo zemigomo njengenzuzo yesevisi yokungcwaba noma ukuthola imali. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo ezidingekayo kumHLOBO WEMIGOMO/UMMEMBER ezifana nezikhathi zokuqala zokukhokha nokuthi yini ekhokhwayo nokuthi yini ENGAKHOKHIWE; izikhathi zokulinda, njll. Idokhumenti esemthethweni ethunyelwe yinkampani kumele ibe nezinhlaka zezinzuzo, izimali, imithetho, neziqondiso futhi ibe nenombolo ye-inshurensi, okufanele ibonakale esitifiketini sommembership. I-Friendly Society iyisikhungo sezezimali esakhelwe ngamaqembu abantu abanezidingo ezithile, abahlanganisa imali futhi bagcine ndawonye ukuze basizane ngokwezimali ezidingweni ezithile, njengokungcwaba. Inzuzo eyinhloko ngu-R5000. I-Friendly Society ayiyona ibhizinisi elenzela inzuzo, kodwa inzuzo ethathwa emalini egcinwe ngamalungu iyabelwa phakathi kwabo. Kufanele uqiniseke ukuthi uthola lesi sitifiketi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungummember. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo zemigomo yakho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi inkampani evunyelwe yinkampani ye-inshurensi ithengisa inshurensi ngegama layo. Inkampani ye-inshurensi yesikhathi eside ebhaliswe neBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ithola imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga futhi ibhekele ukukhokha izinzuzo uma kwenzeka ukufa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi wena njengommember ufaka imali ekhokhwayo kubantu abakhethile emigomweni. Imali oyikhokhayo uma uthola inshurensi njalo ngenyanga. Lokhu kuy umuntu ozimele ongaxhumana naye uma ungajabule ngempendulo evela lapho uthole khona inshurensi. Imininingwane yokuxhumana iboniswa esikhangisweni esisemthethweni nasemuva kwaleli phephandaba. Inkampani ye-inshurensi izohlola izimo noma izifo ezisemigomweni ezingaholela ekufeni komuntu ophethwe yimigomo, futhi akukho zinzuzo ezizokhokhwa. Qaphela: Kufanele kube nobufakazi obuhlinzekwe kumuntu othengisa inshurensi futhi kufanele kube kufomu lesicelo nasemagunyeni akhishwe. Qaphela: Le mali oyikhokhayo ibonisa zonke izindleko ezizokhokhwa kuwe nezimali. Lezi zimalini ozokhokhwa kufanele zikhonjiswe ngokucacile. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngenyanga, ngenyanga yesithathu, noma ngonyaka? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi uzodinga ukukhokha nini. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngaphambi noma ngabe ngikweletile? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi udinga ukukhokha ekuqaleni kwenyanga noma ekupheleni kwenyanga. Umbuzo: Uma ngikhokha ngempahla, ngizothola isitifiketi? Impendulo: Yebo, kufanele kube isitifiketi esisemthethweni. Umbuzo: Le mali ekhokhwa ngenyanga izokhula esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Imali ekhokhwa ingakhula uma kukhona izicelo eziningi kule migomo. Umbuzo: Le mali ekhokhwa iqinisekisiwe isikhathi esingakanani? Umbuzo: Nini kuqala inshurensi yami? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ukufa kubangelwa yengozi? Impendulo: Ezimweni eziningi, isikhathi sokulinda asisebenzi uma umuntu efile ngenxa yengozi. Umbuzo: Ingabe kukhona okukhishwayo? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ngiphuthelwa ukukhokha noma ngiyeka ukukhokha? Impendulo: Awusoze ube ngaphansi kwenshuro futhi uma uqala ukukhokha futhi, isikhathi sokulinda singase sibe khona futhi. Umbuzo: Ingabe ukuba ngaphansi kwenshuro kuyokwenziwa kumuntu ngamunye kuphela? Umbuzo: Ngizothola ubufakazi bokuba ngummember? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ISITIFEKETI SOMMEMBER, isifinyezo sokuthi ubani ophathwe yile inshurensi, inani elizokhokhwa, zonke izikhathi zokulinda, nokuthi yini ephathwe yimigomo. Impendulo: Yebo, ungakhulisa inzuzo yemigomo yakho uma i-Master Policy ivumela, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, lokhu kuzokhulisa nenani ozokhokha ngenyanga. Izinzuzo nezikhathi zokulinda zingase zisebenze ezinuzweni ezandisiwe. Umbuzo: Ngizofaka kanjani isicelo sezimali uma othile efile? Impendulo: Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sezimali kufanele ihlinzekwe ngokuphelele kuwe emithethweni naseziqondisweni zemigomo. Impendulo: Ungakhansela imigomo yakho phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokukhokha ukukhokha kwakho kokuqala futhi uthole yonke imali yakho ngaphandle kokuthi usuhambisile isicelo sezimali zokungcwaba. Ngemuva kwalokho, imigomo ingakhanselwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kodwa imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga ngeke ibuyiswe. Impendulo: Lokhu kungakwenziwa, kodwa kufanele uqinisekiswe futhi uqondiswe ngendlela okuthinta ngayo abantu ababephakathi kwemigomo leyo esikhathini esedlule, mayelana nalokhu okukhuluma ngenhla. Inkampani entsha kumele ikuhlinzeke ngesitifiketi sommembership. Uma uzwa ukuthi awusekho esimweni efanayo noma engcono, kufanele uxhumane nenkampani ekhona ngokushesha. Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma unok complaint noma umbuzo? QAPHELA: Imininingwane ye-Ombudsman kanye ne-FSB kumele kube esikhangisweni sommembership nasemuva kwephephandaba lolwazi.
Amagwinya - Ingxoxo Ngesiko Lokudla Kwethu Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozisa ukufika komlobi wethu, uMnu. Sipho Mthembu, ongumculi, umphakathi, futhi ongumsebenzi wezokudla. U-Sipho uyaziwa kakhulu ngempela ngamagwinya akhe, okwenziwa ngezindlela ezahlukene, futhi sithanda ukwazi kabanzi ngalesi sidlo esidumile. Umbuzo 1: U-Sipho, ungachaza kanjani amagwinya? U-Sipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Amagwinya, uma ngicabanga ngawo, angumkhiqizo othandwayo emakhaya ethu. Ziyizinkwa ezincane, ezivame ukujiywa, ezikhiqizwa ngempela ngempela ngezithako ezilula ezifana nophuthu, amanzi, noshukela. Zinezindlela eziningi zokupheka, kungaba ngefrypan, oven, noma ngisho nangemva kokuhlanza emlilweni. Amagwinya ayingxenye ebalulekile yemikhosi yethu, izinsuku zokuhlala, nokudla kwasekuseni. Umbuzo 2: Yini eyenza amagwinya akho ahluke kwabanye? U-Sipho: Ngicabanga ukuthi okokuqala, amagwinya ami akhiwa ngothando. Ngisebenzisa izithako ezisezingeni eliphezulu, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi umoya owenziwe lapho ngipheka udlala indima enkulu. Ngikhetha izithako ezivela ezindaweni ezithile, futhi ngiyazama ukuhlanganisa izindlela zakudala nezamanje. Ngithanda ukufaka izithako ezikhethekile, njengemifino noma amafutha anempilo, ukuze ngenze amagwinya ami ahluke. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi amagwinya adlala kanjani indima empilweni yamasiko ethu? U-Sipho: Amagwinya ayingxenye enkulu yesiko lethu. Ziyizinkwa ezihlanganisa abantu, zenza kube lula ukufika ndawonye. Ngaphandle kokudla, zikhumbuza abantu ngezikhathi ezinhle, imicimbi, nezikhathi zokuthokozisa. Ngiyakhumbula, ngesikhathi sokuhlangana komndeni, sithokozisa amagwinya, sikhuluma, sibhakabhaka izinkumbulo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe unayo imfihlo ethile yokwenza amagwinya? U-Sipho: Yebo, ngicabanga ukuthi imfihlo ingekho kuphela ezithakweni, kodwa nasekuthandeni lokho okwenziwayo. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ungeze uhlelo oluthile, njengokupheka amagwinya ngothando, kuyashintsha konke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyazama ukugcina izinga lokushisa elilungile, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi isikhathi sokupheka singaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukuxhumana nezithako, ukuzwa umoya, konke lokhu kubalulekile. Umbuzo 5: U-Sipho, ungakuchaza kanjani umphakathi wakho? U-Sipho: Umphakathi wami ungowabantu abathanda ukudla, abahlala bexhumene. Siphila emiphakathini ehlukene, kodwa sonke sithanda amagwinya. Ngiyavuma ukuthi emakhaya ethu, amagwinya akhumbuza abantu ngezinsuku ezinhle. Ngiyazi ukuthi abanye abantu baye bazama ukwenza amagwinya ahluke, kodwa umoya wokuhlanganyela uhlale uqinile. Umbuzo 6: Ucabanga ukuthi amagwinya angashintsha kanjani esikhathini esizayo? U-Sipho: Ngicabanga ukuthi amagwinya azohlala ebamba indawo ebalulekile. Nokho, ngicabanga ukuthi kuzoba nezinqumo eziningi ezizokwenziwa. Abantu bazoba nezinselelo zokwakha, bazokwenza amagwinya anempilo, bese behlola izindlela ezahlukene zokupheka. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi amagwinya akhule, futhi kube nezindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganyela. Isiphetho U-Sipho Mthembu ubonisa ukuthi amagwinya awanqatshelwa kuphela njengokudla, kodwa njengomkhiqizo ohlanganisa abantu, imikhuba, nezinkumbulo. Ngaphandle kokuba umphakathi ubambe iqhaza, amagwinya akhe akhombisa ubuciko, uthando, kanye nomoya wokuhlanganyela. Ngiyabonga, u-Sipho, ngokwabelana ngalesi sikhathi esihle nathi. Amagwinya akho ayohlala enza izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi sizokubona emicimbini yethu ezayo.
Imali Yokufunda: Ingxoxo Ngezithiyo Nezindlela Zokuxazulula Imali yokufunda, noma inani elifunekayo ukuze abafundi bakhande ezikoleni, izikole, noma ezikhungweni zemfundo, iwumqondo obalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Lokhu kumiswe kahle emiphakathini ehlukene, njengoba kunezinselelo ezibalulekile ezihambisana nemali yokufunda. Emva kokuhlola lezi zinkinga, kuyacaca ukuthi lesi sihloko sidinga ukuba sithathwe ngokujulile, kungezelelwa izixazululo ezivulekile ezizokwazi ukusiza abafundi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imali yokufunda inamathuba amakhulu kanye nezithiyo. Abafundi abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abavela emindenini engathuthukile, bahlupheka ekutholeni le mali. Ukuphazamiseka kwalokhu kudala ukuthi abanye bahlalise thina ekutholeni imfundo ephakeme, baye bahluleka ukufinyelela ezikhungweni eziphakeme ezifanele izifiso zabo. Lokhu kuyiqiniso uma sikhuluma ngezinsiza zezemfundo ezikhokhwayo, amafutho okuphila, kanye nemiholo engatholakali. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi imvamisa kube khona ukwehluka okukhulu phakathi kwabafundi abathola amathuba nemali yokufunda, okuholela ekwehlisweni kwezinga lempumelelo emphakathini. Enye yeziqhamo ezivela efundweni ephezulu ikakhulukazi yasemakhaya, ukuthi abanye abangatholi imfundo elungile, bangase bahlukaniswe ezindaweni ezithile zezemisebenzi, okwandisa ubumpofu. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imali yokufunda isishintshile kube yinto eyisiyingi, okuwukuthi inani elidingekayo alisondeli kulowo osebenza naye, kuhlanganisa nezinsiza ezikhona, kodwa konke kudinga ukucabangela ukuthi imininingwane idinga ukusethwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izikhungo zemfundo zithola ukuthi imali yokufunda iyazuzisa ngoba ivumela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezinhle nezinhle, ezisemqoka ezifundweni nasezivivinyweni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzekwa kwabezindaba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, okufaka phakathi ama-laptops, amasiko ophando, kanye nezikhungo zokufunda. Imininingwane iyabonakala lapha; uma imfundo ibhujiswa, yonke imithombo iyahlupheka, izigidi zabafundi ziyoba ngaphansi kokucindezela. Izixazululo zalesi simo zidinga ukuba ziphume kulezi zinkinga ezinzima. Ukubamba amaqembu akhuluma ngezizathu ezahlukene kwi zinkolelo ezingcwele ezihambisana nemali yokufunda kudinga ukugxila emizamweni yokugcina imfundo itholakala kubo bonke. Sikufanelekela ukugqugquzela izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, ezinjengezinhlelo zomphakathi, izimali zokufunda zamasiko noma zendawo ezivulekile. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwabo bonke abafundi kumathuba emfundo. Ukwenza kucace, izinhlelo zomphakathi ezixhumene nezikhungo zemfundo zithintela ukuphuma emthunzini, zinika ithuba kubafundi abaningi. Uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinhlelo, izinhlelo ezikhipha imali yok ukufunda ziba neqhaza elikhulu ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kwabafundi ezikoleni eziphakeme. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, abazi, nezikhungo zikahulumeni nezithunywa ezikhokhayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusiza abahluphekayo nokwabelana ngolwazi ngezindlela ezahlukene zokufunda, izinzuzo zokuhlanganisa amasevisi ahlukahlukene ezimfuneko zemfundo, kuyoholela ekutheni imfundo ibaluleke kakhudlwana, futhi ibenze bakhombise ubuthakathaka. Yilapho-ke lapho kuhloswe khona ukudala umphakathi ophumelelayo, osebenzisa kahle neze zimali. Isikhumbuzo sikaHulumeni sabazali, izikole kanye nezikhungo zemfundo kumele siqinisekise ukuthi zonke izifiso, izidingo nezifiso zabafundi ziyaziswa. Ngokuhlanganisa, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imali yokufunda ibalulekile, kodwa futhi ingase ibangele izithiyo. Ukwakhiwa kwezixazululo ezithuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabafundi kwemfundo kubaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu unethuba lokufunda. Lokhu kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikole, abahlali, nohulumeni, ukuze kuzuzwe imiphumela emihle emphakathini. Imfundo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, ngakho-ke kufanele sicabangele indlela yokwenza kube lula yokufunda ukuze sikhulise izinga lempumelelo. Ukuba nemali yokufunda kweqiniso kufanele kube isikhumbuzo sothando, ukuhamba phambili nokuxhumana, hhayi umthwalo omkhulu.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Umhlahlandlela Wokuthuthukisa Izimfuno Zabasebenzi Isingeniso Iziteleka zabasebenzi zenzeka lapho abasebenzi behlangana ukuze baveze ukunganeliseki kwabo, kakhulu uma kubhekwa izimo zokusebenza, imiholo, noma amalungelo abawathola. Lokhu kuhlangana kubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zomsebenzi. Lezi ziteleka, nakuba ziningi izizathu ezihlukene eziyenza zenzeka, zifaka phakathi ukulwa nokungabi nabulungisa emsebenzini, ukucela ukuhunyushwa kabusha kwemiholo, nokufuna ukuvikeleka kwesikhala sokusebenza. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izizathu Zokuhlanganisa Ukuze kube neziteleka eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle izizathu eziholela ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuhlangana. Abasebenzi kufanele baphawule kahle ngezinkinga ababhekene nazo. Lezi zingaba zihilela imiholo enganele, izinzuzo ezithile ezingenalutho, noma izimo zokusebenza eziyingozi. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukusungula ukuhlangabezana kwabantu bonke ukuze bahlale bezisola ngezinkinga zanguye. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzobasiza ukuba baziqonde kahle izizathu zabo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlanganisa Iqembu Lokuphatha Ngesikhathi sokuhlangana, kubalulekile ukuthi kube neqhaza elikhulu elibamba iqhaza. Abasebenzi kumele bahlukane ngamaqembu, njengoba ukuxhumana nomunye kubalulekile. Inhloso yokuhlanganisa iqembu lokuphatha izinto ezizokwenziwa ngesikhathi sezi teleka. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhetha abamele iqembu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu benza izinkulumo, nokudlulisa imiyalezo ngendlela ecacile. Isinyathelo 3: Ukufunda Ngezindlela Zokuxhumana Ngaphambi kokuqala iziteleka, kubalulekile ukufunda indlela yokuxhumana. Abasebenzi badinga ukuba nolwazi oluqinile lokuthi bangasizakalela kanjani. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufunda ngezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezifana nezikhalazo zomphakathi, amabhodi ezindaba, noma izinhlelo zokuxhumana. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zindlela, abasebenzi bazokwazi ukudlulisa izikhalazo zabo kalula. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlela Izinyathelo Zokusebenza Ngemuva kokuthi sekubanjwe okukhulumile, kufanele kuhlelwe izinyathelo zokusebenza. Abasebenzi kufanele bahlale bejolisa emigqeni yokusebenza ethile. Lezi zinyathelo zingahlanganisa: 1. Ukubhalisela isiteleka: Kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baphinde baziqhenye. Ukubhalisela isiteleka kuzobasiza ukwenza inhloso yabo ibe sobala. 2. Ukuhlela isikhathi nezindawo: Abasebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi isikhathi socwaningo sokuqhakambisa izikhalazo zabo sinqunywa kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela kahle, kubhengeze izinsuku, nezindawo ezizoba neziteleka. 3. Ukubamba umhlangano nezinkampani: Uma abaphathi bempela bephendule izikhalazo, abaphathi kumele bazicabangele izinyathelo ezithile. Ukubamba umhlangano okhulu nokukhuluma nabasebenzi kungenza kuhlale phambili. Isinyathelo 5: Ukumisa Izicelo Nezivumelwano Izicelo ezihlobene neziteleka kufanele zicace futhi ziqinile. Abasebenzi kufanele baqonde ukwamukela ukuzikhandla kokuthuthukisa izimo zabo. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukuxhaswa kwezabasebenzi. Ukuzinikela kudingeka ukuze amaqembu abumbe izivumelwano ezithile. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuphathwa Kwezimphendvuli Ngemuva kokuhlanganisa izidingo nomphakathi, umphakathi kufanele uthole izimpendulo. Abasebenzi kumele bakhumbule ukuthi iziteleka zingathatha isikhathi, futhi okubalulekile ukuthi bahlale benza kahle. Isinyathelo 7: Ukuqhubeka Nokuxhumana Ngemuva kokuphumelela kokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi kube khona ukuvuselelwa kokuqonda ngezinyathelo ezithatiwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukubuyisa umbono wabo bonke abaphatheli - Ukuhlele imihlangano yokuhlanganyela ngemuva - Ukuthola impendulo ezithile kumphakathi Isiphetho Iziteleka zabasebenzi, uma zisetshenziswa kahle, zingcono kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi bahlale behlangile futhi basebenzise izindlela zokuxhumana ezivulekile. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kubalulekile ekutholeni imiphumela emihle. Kukhona ukwenza inzuzo, kookhuza izimo eziphambili kubasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuthi uthole izimpendulo ezijulile ezifundiswayo naphakathi. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa umphakathi futhi kunikeze amajoka ezokuhlalisana ngendlela ehambisanayo.
R50.00 kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka ka-2003 bese kuba R70. Abanikazi bezindawo zokuhweba kumele bathenge ugesi bona. Imali yokurenta ikhokhwa ngenyanga ngaphambi kosuku lweshumi lwanyanga ngayinye. Isikhala sokuhweba esinikezwe umuntu sizosetshenziswa ukuthengisa nokukhangisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zemikhiqizo njengoba kuvunyelwe yiBhodi yabaPhathi ngezikhathi ezithile. Umqashi kumele anikeze umninimzi ikheli lakhe lokuhlala, ikheli leposi, kanye nenombolo yefoni. Umqashi kumele abe ngumuntu ongasebenzi, futhi kuzoqokwa labo abaxhasa imindeni yabo bodwa. Zonke izinto kumele zibe sesimweni esifanele sokuthengiswa ezivakashi futhi zibe nekhwalithi ephezulu nezinhlobonhlobo. Isikhala sokuhweba kumele sibe niphephile, futhi umqashi kumele ahambisane nemigomo ebekwe kuMthetho Wokuphepha Nokuphila Kwezisebenzi No. 85 ka-1993. Isikhala sokuhweba asikwazi ukuqashwa komunye umuntu ngumqashi. Abaqashi abathathu bazovunyelwa ngaphansi kwaleli sivumelwano. Abaqashi bazokhuthazwa ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yabanye abantu abasebenza ekhaya. Ukulahla udoti/ukuphuma akuvunyelwe, futhi udoti akumele uqoqeke ezindaweni zokuhweba. Ukuphuza utshwala ezindaweni zokuhweba akuvunyelwe, futhi umqashi akumele afinyelele emsebenzini ethwele umthelela utshwala noma eminye imishanguzo. Ukulwa noma ukusebenzisa ulimi olubi ezindaweni zokuhweba akuvunyelwe. Umsindo ophakeme noma umculo ezindaweni zokuhweba akuvunyelwe. Umqashi unomthwalo wokugcina isikhala sakhe sokuhweba nezindawo ezizungezile zihlanzekile. Abaqashi bazothatha izikhathi zokuhlanza igumbi lokugeza nezinye izindawo ezivamile. Imikhiqizo ingakhiqizwa kuphela ezindaweni zokuhweba uma kuvunyelwe ngaphambi kumninimzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wokuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngoshintsho. Kuzosetshenziswa kuphela izinto zikagesi ezivunyelwe ngumqashi. Akukho shintsho okungafakwa ezindaweni zokuhweba mayelana nezifaki zikagesi, uphahla, noma okunye. Abaqashi kumele bathathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvimbela ukuvinjelwa noma ukuphazamiseka kwemithombo yamanzi, amapayipi, kanye namapayipi okuphakelwa kwamanzi lapha ezindaweni zokuhweba. Abaqashi kuzodingeka bakhokhe ugesi ngokuya ngezidingo zabo. Izindawo zokuhweba kumele zivuleke kusukela ngo-9:00 AM kuya ku-5:00 PM kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuMgqibelo. Imakethe izovalwa ngeSonto. Izindawo zokuhweba zingavulwa ngezikhathi ezinde ngokuthanda komninimzi. Uma umqashi, noma abalingani bakhe noma abasebenzi baphula noma yiziphi zalezi zimo ngenhloso ethile, futhi baqhubeka benza kanjalo ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyishumi zokwaziswa ukuze balungise, lesi sivumelwano sokurenta sizopheliswa ngokushesha, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume kulolo sikhala sokuhweba ngokushesha. Kuzonikezwa isaziso esisheshayo uma kwenzeka isenzo sobugebengu noma ukuphulwa kokuziphatha. Uma kutholakala ukuthi umqashi unikeze ulwazi olungelona iqiniso ukuze athole lesi sikhala sokuhweba, iBhodi izosebenzisa amandla ayo uma ikhetha ukuphelisa lesi sivumelwano ngokushesha. Uma umqashi ethola umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, lesi sivumelwano sizopheliswa, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume esikhala sokuhweba ezinsukwini eziyisixhenxe. Uma umqashi efela, lesi sivumelwano sizopheliswa ngokuhambisana nemigomo yeMthetho Jikelele. Umninimzi unelungelo lokukhokhisa umqashi ngemali nezijeziso.
Bonke izitshalo zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule, futhi iphuzu elibaluleke kakhulu ekulimaleni kwezilimo ezithile emhlabeni owomileyo kube khona amanzi anele ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezitshalo zakho ze-maize. Ukuqala kule nyanga, i-bulletin ye-maize ye-Pula Imvula izothunyelwa kubafundi bonke, hhayi kuphela kubakhiqizi abakhuluma isiSisuthu eFree State. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iWestern Cape inezimo zokukhanya ezaziwa njengeMediterranean, okusho ukuthi ithola imvula yayo ebusika, isikhathi esifanele sokulima i-maize. Ukubaluleka kokugcina amanzi emhlabathini kubakhiqizi be-maize eCape akubalulekile njengokuphathelene neNingizimu Afrika yonke, lapho sidinga ukugcina imvula yasehlobo emhlabathini ukuze izitshalo zisebenzise ngesikhathi sebusika obomileyo. Ukulima kudinga amanzi. Izitshalo ezahlukene zinezimfuno ezahlukene okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuthi kunqunywe ukuthi iyiphi isitsha efanele ukulima. Amanzi adingeka futhi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuwohloka kwezinsalela zezithombo zangaphambili nokwandisa izakhamzimba ezitholakala emhlabathini, okuvumela izitshalo ukuthi zifinyelele ezakhamzimbini. Ungase ungakakwenzi isinqumo sokuthi uzolima i-maize noma cha; isinqumo sakho sincike ezinzuzweni ezitholakala ekulimaleni kwe-maize nasekuhlelweni kwakho kwesikhathi esizayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa komhlaba. Abakhiqizi abaningi benza izinqumo zokulima izitshalo ezithile ngokususelwa ezinguqukweni ezithile, ngaphandle kokugxila kumagugu entengo ahluka-hluka. Ukulima i-maize unyaka nonyaka kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi unokulima uma unyaka ubuhle, futhi ukuthi unama-maize okuthengisa uma amanani emakethe ephezulu (kodwa kungenzeka futhi ukuhweba ngalokhu - uzoba ne-maize ngisho nasezinyangeni ezimbi, futhi uzodinga ukuyithenga ngamanani aphansi uma itholakala). Kubalulekile ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zakho zizokwazi ukufinyelela amanzi anele emhlabathini ngesikhathi sonke sokukhula kwazo. Bonke umhlaba ungagcina amanzi, kodwa abanye banamandla angcono okugcina amanzi emhlabathini. Umhlaba onesihlabathi unamandla aphansi okugcina amanzi njengoba amanzi angadonsa emhlabathini futhi alahleke, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezendlalelo ezingenakudlula (njengokhuni noma i-clay, ngokwesibonelo) ezovimbela amanzi ekudlula nasekulahlweni. Umhlaba onama-layers angadluli (njenge-clay ngokwesibonelo) ezindaweni ezijulile ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 m ufaneleka ekugcineni amanzi emhlabathini nasekukhiqizeni izilimo zonyaka. Izinhlobonhlobo eziningi zomhlaba onesihlabathi eFree State empumalanga zifanele le mfanekiso, yingakho zifaneleka ekulimaleni kwe-maize ebusika nakuba kuyindawo ethola imvula yasehlobo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ube nenhlanhla yokuba namanzi anele okokufafaza, kuzodingeka uthembeke emvuleni ukuze umhlaba uthole amanzi. Iphansi lelo phansi elithambile livumela imvula ukuthi ingene emhlabathini. Kufanele ubone ukuthi imvula igijima kanjani emhlabathini onzima. Ukuvuthwa kwamanzi emhlabeni kusiza ekungeneleleni kwamanzi; kuphinde kunciphise ukuhamba kwamanzi futhi kunikeze isikhathi eside sokuthi amanzi angena. Amanzi agcinwa ezikhala phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba. Izihlabathi zingahluka phakathi kwezihlabathi ezilula nezimnyama bese ziba yi-clay, futhi uhlobo ngalunye lomhlaba lungagcina izinga elihlukile lamamitha amanzi. Umhlaba onesihlabathi, i-clay, kanye nomhlaba omnyama ungagcina ama-25 mm wamanzi emhlabathini angu-150 mm. (Umhlaba onjengokujulile okusebenzayo okungu-1 m wezimpande ungagcina ama-180 mm emvula). Ikhono lokugcina amanzi emhlabathini lincike ohlotsheni lomhlaba, isakhiwo somhlaba kanye nesikhala somhlaba. Amanzi emhlabathini angalahleka emhlabeni ngenxa yokukhanya kwelanga. Iphansi lomhlaba lingashisa, okwandisa ukuvuthwa, okubangela amanzi ukuthi ahlale phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba, afike phezulu emhlabathini lapho evutha emoyeni; asetshenziswa izitshalo ezikhulayo noma izitshalo ezithile ezingabhekwa njengezihlahla emasimini (lokhu kuyisizathu esikhulu sokulahleka kwamanzi emhlabathini). Singagcina kanjani amanzi kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula engena emhlabathini ingangena kulowo mhlaba; gcina iphansi lomhlaba lisesimweni esihle. Iphansi eliphezulu elingaphezulu komhlaba lisebenza njengezithiyo eziqinile ukuze amanzi emvula angagijimi kodwa agcine emhlabathini. Gcina izinsalela zezithombo zangaphambili ziningi ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze unciphise umthelela oqondile wezinyembezi zemvula emhlabathini futhi ngaleyo ndlela unciphise ukwakheka kwe-crust yomhlaba. Kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi izitshalo zingase zidinge ama-nitrogen fertilizers engeziwe ngenxa yokuncipha kwezinsiza ezivela ezinsaleni zezithombo zangaphambili, okuzoncika ekudluliseni kwezithombo ezindala ezisele. Ngemuva kwemvula enkulu, phula noma iyiphi i-crust engase ibe sekupheleni komhlaba. I-crust ayivimbi kuphela ukungena kweminye imvula kodwa iphinde ikhulise ukuvuthwa ukuze spread amanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba, okubangela umhlaba ukuba umiswe. Gcina umhlaba ungenazihlahla kusukela ngesikhathi sokuvuna izilimo zangaphambili kuze kube sekulimaleni kwezilimo ezilandelayo. Ukwakhiwa kwesembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe amanzi okwakhiwe ngothuli emhlabathini kuba yisithiyo sokuvutha kwamanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwamanzi emhlabathini emoyeni. Nakuba isembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli olomile sigcina amanzi ngokumunca ukushisa kokukhanya kwelanga, ukuvuthwa kungaqhubeka kodwa ngezinga eliphansi emhlabathini elomile elingu-5 cm. Isembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe amanzi singaba yizinsalela zezithombo (uma kukhulunywa kabanzi) noma singaba yisembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli okufanele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi akufanele kuphazanyiswe ngokulima komhlaba ngama-machinery. Ezinye izinto eziphathelene nokukhiqiza izilimo zibalulekile ukuze uphumelele. Udinga ukugcina amanzi ngangokunokwenzeka futhi ugcine umhlaba wakho ungenazihlahla ngaso sonke isikhathi. Amanzi kuyinto eyinhloko yokukhawulela ekukhiqizeni izilimo.
Inhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana, noma yiliphi ilungu lenhlangano noma umuntu omunye ophazamisekile, angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuthi impahla yenhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana igcwaliswe nguMphathi-Jikelele noma ivaliwe futhi ithengiswe. Inkantolo ethula lesi sicelo kumele ibe yisigaba seNkantolo Ephakeme noma iNkantolo yeM magistrate enamalungelo okuphatha le ndaba endaweni lapho inhlangano itholakala khona noma isebenza. Izinkantolo zingakhupha lesi sikhungo uma kukhona okungcono kakhulu futhi okufanele kule ndaba. Isinqumo kumele sithathwe ngabaningi balabo abakhona noma abamele emhlanganweni; futhi zonke izinto ezihlobene okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesikhungo sokudilizwa, kuhlanganise nokuthi impahla nezikweletu zenhlangano zizophathwa kanjani, noma seziphathwe, kumele zicaciswe. Uma inkantolo inquma ukuvalela inhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana, izonquma ukuthi impahla yenhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana izophathwa kanjani ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Inkantolo izobheka noma yiziphi iziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphathi-Jikelele mayelana nokwabiwa kwempahla. Kumele ichaze isizathu sokuthi kungani inkampani noma i-CC ingafaka isicelo sokudilizwa. Uma kufanelekile, kumele ibonise inombolo yentela yenkampani noma ye-CC. Bonke abaphathi kanye nelungu lenkampani noma ye-CC kumele bsign le ncwadi uma kuyisicelo sokudilizwa abakwenza bona ngokuvuma kwabo ukuze inkampani idilizwe. Ukudilizwa kuthatha cishe izinyanga eziyisithupha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi akukho mafomu adingekayo ukuthi agcwaliswe.
Ukusebenza kwe-Eskom: Izinkinga Nezixazululo Ngokubheka izimo ezinzima ezibhekene ne-Eskom, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuqonda ubunzima obukhona kanye nemiphumela yalo emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. I-Eskom, njengomphakeli omkhulu wamandla kagesi eNingizimu Afrika, ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi ezihambisana nokusebenza kwayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithile. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngempumelelo ye-Eskom esikhathini esedlule. Kukhona isikhathi lapho i-Eskom yayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ogcwele, futhi abantu babengakha izinhlelo zabo zokuphila ngokwethembeka. Nokho, lezi zinsuku seziyisikhathi esedlule. Ukungabi namandla kagesi okuvamile, okubizwa ngokuthi i-load shedding, sekwenze kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuphazamiseka kokuphila kwansuku zonke, kodwa futhi kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu emnothweni, njengoba izinkampani zikhubazeka futhi abantu behluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabo. Esikhathini esiningi, izinkinga ze-Eskom zixhumene nezinsiza ezindala, ukungabi namali yokutshala, kanye nezinkinga eziphathelene nokuphathwa kwezimali. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezindala zidinga ukwenziwa kabusha, futhi lokhu kudinga izimali ezinkulu. Kodwa-ke, lapho sikhuluma ngempumelelo ye-Eskom, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi izinkampani eziningi zidinga ukutshala imali ukuze zithuthukise izinsiza zazo. Ukuze i-Eskom ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, kudingeka izinqubo eziphusile zokuphathwa kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi namandla kagesi kubangela ukunganeliseki phakathi kwabantu. Abantu bahlala bephuma ezindaweni zabo ukuze bahlale emakhaya ngenxa yokungabi namandla. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokuphepha, njengoba abantu bephuma ezindaweni zabo ezivikelekile. Ukungabi namandla kagesi kusebenza njengomphumela omubi emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bephila ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Ukwengeza, i-Eskom ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu eziphathelene nezinguquko ezisemthethweni. Izinguquko ezithile zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-Eskom iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, abanikazi bamabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamizi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwalezi zinhlaka kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezixazululweni ezisebenzayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kufanele sikhulume ngezixazululo ezingase zibe khona. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Eskom ithole ukuxhaswa kwezimali ukuze ikwazi ukuthuthukisa izinsiza zayo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuxhaswa okuvela kuhulumeni, abaninimasheya, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele. Ukutshala imali ezinsizeni ezintsha, ezifana nezinsiza ezisebenza ngelanga noma umoya, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Okwesibili, i-Eskom kufanele ibheke izindlela zokuphatha eziphusile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwakha izinqubomgomo ezihambisana nezidingo zabantu, kanye nokwandisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphatha amandla. Ukuze i-Eskom ikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphatha amandla, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bekwazi ukuthola ugesi. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izinqubomgomo ze-Eskom. Ukuqwashisa abantu ngalezi zinqubomgomo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu baqonde ukuthi yini okufanele bayilindele, nokuthi bangaphatha kanjani izimo ezinzima. Ekugcineni, ukusebenza kwe-Eskom kudinga ukuba kube nezinqubomgomo eziphusile, ukuxhaswa kwezimali, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Uma sikwazi ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabantu, kanye nomnotho wezwe. I-Eskom iyisikhungo esibalulekile emnothweni, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ophumelelayo esikhathini esizayo.
uThabo Mbeki: Umholi Ohloniphekayo UThabo Mbeki, umholi owayengumengameli weNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wezikhumbuzo ezibalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe kuleli. Uthabo wazalwa ngo-18 kuNhlangulana 1942 eIdutywa, eMpuma Koloni. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi uMbeki akazange abe umholi wezwe kuphela, kodwa futhi ungumuntu ophumelele ezindabeni eziningi, ezemfundo, nezamasiko? Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuqonda ukuthi kungani abantu bemhloyi. Ngaphambi kokuba abe ngumengameli, uMbeki waba neqhaza elikhulu emzabalazweni wokukhulula iNingizimu Afrika. Waqala ukufunda eNyuvesi yaseFort Hare, lapho ahlangana khona nabanye abafundi ababesebenzela ukulwa nobandlululo. Uthabo waba neqhaza elikhulu kwi-African National Congress (ANC) futhi waba neqhaza elibalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube nokuguquka ezombusazwe. Ngemuva kokuphunyuka emzabalazweni, uMbeki waba ngumsunguli omkhulu wezinhlelo eziningi ezazihlosiwe ukusiza abantu abampofu. Ngabe ubungazi ukuthi uMbeki wayekholelwa ekutheni ubumbano lwabantu luyisihluthulelo sokwakha isizwe esiqinile? Lokhu kwakukhombisa ukuthi wayenobuhlakani bokuhola, futhi wayekwazi ukuhlela izinhlelo ezizoshintsha impilo yabantu. UThabo Mbeki waba ngumengameli ngo-1999, futhi wathatha izinqumo eziningi ezibalulekile. Phakathi nezinsuku zakhe, wayefuna ukwakha umnotho ophumelelayo, futhi wayephokophele ukunciphisa ubuphofu. Ubuye waba nohlelo lwe-African Renaissance, olwaluhloselwe ukuvuselela umnotho nezenhlalo e-Afrika. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni jikelele, lapho azama khona ukuveza izinkinga ezikhungethe i-Afrika. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uMbeki wayebhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izinqumo zakhe ngezinye izikhathi zazibhekwa njengokungahambisani nezidingo zabantu. Isibonelo, ngesikhathi seHIV/AIDS, ukungavumi kwakhe ukwamukela imithi yokwelapha kwabangela ukugxekwa okukhulu. Lokhu kwaba yinkinga enkulu, njengoba abantu abaningi bahlupheka ngenxa yokungabi nokwelashwa okufanele. Uthabo Mbeki akazange agcine kuphela emzamweni wokwakha iNingizimu Afrika, kodwa waba nomthelela omkhulu kwezinye izindawo e-Afrika. Waba yisithwathwa sokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamazwe, futhi waba nomthelela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezombusazwe nezomnotho e-Afrika. Naphezu kwezinkinga, uMbeki waphumelela ekwakheni imishado phakathi kwezizwe. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni i-African Union, okuyinhlangano ehlanganyela amazwe ase-Afrika. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwamazwe, futhi kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ngemuva kokuphuma esikhundleni sikaMengameli ngo-2008, uMbeki akazange aphumule. Waqhubeka nokusebenza emikhakheni ehlukene, efaka isandla ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho e-Afrika. Ubuye waba nesandla ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube nokuthula nokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe. UThabo Mbeki ungumuntu okhumbuleka kakhulu, futhi umthelela wakhe uzohlala ukhanya emlandweni. Ubonisa ukuthi umholi ongcono akakhulumi kuphela, kodwa futhi uhola ngezinyathelo eziphusile. Ubuye waba yisibonelo sokuthi, noma ngabe ub faced with challenges, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo zakho. Ngokuphetha, uThabo Mbeki ungomunye wabantu ababalulekile emlandweni weNingizimu Afrika. Uthando lwakhe lwezwe, kanye nomsebenzi wakhe wokwakha ubumbano, kubonisa ukuthi umholi angaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Uthando lwakhe lwe-Afrika luhlala lukhanya, futhi umbono wakhe wokwakha isizwe esiqinile uzohlala ukhumbuleka. UThabo Mbeki ungumholi ohloniphekayo, futhi impilo yakhe iyisifundo sokuthi, uma sinesifiso sokwenza kahle, singakwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Iphasi noma ilayisensi ayikwazi ukudluliselwa futhi kumele ihlinzekwe uma iceliwe ngumsebenzi wezinkanyezi, umphakathi ophakeme, iphoyisa, noma umsebenzi ogunyaziwe. Imisebenzi ethinta ukuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukufezekisa izinhloso zokomoya ingaqhutshelwa ezindaweni ezibekwe phambili (emamephini, ezindaweni ezichaziwe, ezindaweni ezibhalwe phansi lapho ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe, nezinye izimpawu). Ukungena ezinkalweni zikamasipala kungavinjwa ngaphandle kokuchaza isizathu, futhi izicelo zokubhukha zingakhanselwa noma ziphumelelwe yiMnyango. Ukuqoqwa kwezinkuni akuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwezindawo ezibekwe phambili. Akekho onelungelo lokuphazamisa imisebenzi yomphakathi wezinkanyezi noma ezindaweni zikamasipala. Noma yimuphi umonakalo owenziwe emithonjeni yezinkanyezi noma kunoma iyiphi impahla kahulumeni ngenxa zenzo zomnikazi welayisensi uzobuyiselwa kulowo mnikazi welayisensi. UKWAZI OKUNGEZELELE, IMAMEPHU, NOKUHLANGANISA, UYACELWA UKUXHUMANA NOMSEBENZI OTHILE noma umphakathi - isibonelo, uMphakathi Omkhulu Wezinkanyezi, Ikheli, Ucingo, Ifeksi, ikheli le-imeyili. Bheka uhlu lwezenzakalo kuMthetho Wokuhlanganiswa A. Ngokwezinga 19 noma 20 loMthetho Wezinkanyezi Kazwelonke ka-1998 (UMthetho Wezinkanyezi Kazwelonke, 1998 - Umthetho 84 ka-1998), ilungelo lokungena ezinkalweni zikamasipala limi ezindaweni ezikhonjiswe emamephini anexhunywe (noma lezo ezichaziwe) futhi kumele kulandelwe imithetho esunguliwe. Qaphela ukuthi imithetho eyengeziwe evimbela ukufinyelela kwezinye izinkanyezi njengoba kuchaziwe ezimpawu, emamephini, kumabhroshwe, nakwezinye izindlela ibhekwa njengokuhlonishwa. Lolu hlobo lweleyisensi lusebenza kulokho okukhuluma ngakho umceli, bese kuthi kuncike ezimweni ezithile nasezinhlelweni ezitholakalayo noma ohlwini lwezenzakalo ezivunyelwe.
Ithimba ligxile ekuxazululeni izidingo zabantu ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphakathi komphakathi ophuhlayo mayelana nezindaba ezikhombisa izindawo ezifana nokuphatha, imfundo, nomnotho, phakathi kwezinye, ngenkathi liphinde lihambe phakathi kokuhlukana nokugcina intuthuko yeziqhingi emkhakheni wezindaba kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Ithimba lihlose ukusungula uhlelo oluzoba nendima ebalulekile ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezinkulu ezweni lonke futhi luzokwenza imicimbi ehloselwe ukukhuthaza lezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Imfundo nababambiqhaza bakhulise ucwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kokufinyelela nokusebenza kwabantu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezilimi. Ithimba libona ukuthuthukiswa komkhakha we-HLT eNingizimu Afrika okufana nalokho eYurophu ngezilimi ezihlukahlukene, kodwa kulungiswe ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zendawo. Ithimba lizozenzela ukwethula ngo-2002. Ithimba lihlangana kaningi futhi lizobamba iqhaza nababambiqhaza abafanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Noma ubani onentshisekelo uyamenywa ukuthi axhumane nomqondisi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ukuze athole olunye ulwazi. Ukusekelwa kwalesi sikhungo kuyamukeleka kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuvela kuphi.
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqwa ngesikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi wayo wansuku zonke wokuhlanganisa imali yentela kahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezintela zebhizinisi ezisiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zikhangiso. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, abangabakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, kubaphikisi bebhizinisi, kubameli, nakubathengisi ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke inzuzo zibikwa ku-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokuvikeleka kolwazi oluqoqwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi mayelana nabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi luyimfihlo futhi alunakukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphoqelelayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kulolu lwazi, uhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuvikeleka kwalo ngokomthetho, ngaphandle kokuthi kube kumuntu onelungelo lokuluthola noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukuze athole lolwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekana nokuvikeleka okuhlobene nokudluliswa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kube kubalulekile. Lezi ziqephu ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti olwazi lwe-SARS, futhi, uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS yenze kube lula ukuphatha izicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandela nokuphendula ngesikhathi njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezingase zenzeke ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nesiko le-SARS lokukhanya, njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuhambisana kwe-SARS nezimiso zokubophela, ubuqotho, nokwethembeka kulabo abahlanganyela ne-SARS. UKomishana weNhlangano yezeMali yaseNingizimu Afrika nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali, uMnu. Pravin Gordhan. Ngaphansi kwakhe, kukhona abaphathiswa abane abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona ku-SARS njengoba kudingeka umthetho nsuku zonke. Omunye nomunye uMphathiswa unikezwa indawo ethile yokusebenza ngokuya ngolwazi lwabo kanye nesipiliyoni somsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo yokusebenza ngokuya ngolwazi lwabo nesipiliyoni. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona ku-SARS, kufanele ugcwalise ifomu lesicelo elitholakala kuSheduli 1 bese ulithumela kumphathiswa ofanele. Abaphathiswa basebenzisa ihhovisi elifanayo kanye nekheli leposi. Umpathiswa ofanele uzophendula phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 (izinsuku eziyi-60 kwezinye izimo) ukuze akwazise ukuthi isicelo sakho siye savunywa noma siye saphikiswa. Kwezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma ufinyelele kumarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukuphathwa kwesicelo sakho kuthatha isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungisa ulwazi oluceliwe ngemuva kokukhokha imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela oyicelile noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwe ngayo kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho ndlela ethile oyicelile. Lokhu kuyiphephandaba lokuqala lokwakhiwa komthetho we-SARS. Kuzothuthuka njengoba i-SARS nabaceli bolwazi behlola ukusebenza kahle kokusebenzisa lo mthetho, kanye nokulinganisa phakathi kwes right to access information and other rights protected by the Act, such as privacy, and the need to keep the State functioning effectively. Imigomo ngaphansi komthetho, amanothi achazayo, nokuningi. Ulwazi lokuxhumana nezikhulu zomnyango. Ulwazi olutholakala ngaphandle kwesicelo. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo. Ukwenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho. UKomishana weMihla Yezakhamuzi. ukuqoqa izintela; nokulawula ukufika kwezimpahla ezweni, ezithunyelwa ngaphandle kwezwe, ezikhiqizwayo, ezithwalwayo, ezigcinwayo, nezisetshenziswayo ezimpahleni ezithile ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo. Umthetho ophatha ukuqoqa izintela uma kudluliswa ubunikazi beMali ka-1949 noma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophakanyisiwe, isaziso sikahulumeni, noma umyalo ophume ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla noma yimuphi umvumelwano owenziwe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho noma uMthethosisekelo noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokuhlawulwa kwentela noma ophatha ukukhululwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile ezingase zidluliselwe ku-SARS noma umvumelwano phakathi kwe-SARS nenhlangano kahulumeni noma igunya elihlobene (njengokuhlawulwa kwentela ngaphandle kokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinkokhelo ze-insurance yokungasebenzi). nakho konke okuhlobene nezintela; namandla anikezwa uNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla; nokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni mayelana nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokulawula ukukhululwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile. Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuqoqa izintela ukuze kukhule izinzuzo ezibonakalayo, kusiza ukuhweba futhi kwandise abakhokhi bentela ngokuhlanganisa abakhokhi bentela abasha ezincwadini ngokukhuthaza ukuqwashisa ngentela ukuze abantu bazi futhi babhekane nesibopho sabo sokuxhasa lo mnyango nemithetho yentela nezohwebo yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphezulu olungahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nakuba i-SARS inomsebenzi wokubhala imithetho yentela, iyakwenza lokhu ngaphansi kokubhekwa nokuphathwa kukaNgqongqoshe wezeMali, futhi kwesinye isikhathi uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Ngakho-ke, amadokhumenti akhishwe uMnyango WezeMali kahulumeni kanye noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ngokuhambisana nalomthetho kufanele abhekwe mayelana nendima yomphakathi ekwakhiweni kwemigomo. Ngokwesimo nokuqina komthetho ophakanyisiwe, kungase kuqale ngokukhishwa kwedokhumenti yokuxoxisana echaza inqubo okufanele ilandelwe futhi imema umphakathi ukuba uphinde uphakamise umqondo. Njengoba iPhalamende njengamanje ingenamandla okwenza izinguquko kuMthethosisekelo WezeMali uma usukhululiwe, kuqaliswe uhlelo lokukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uphakamise imibono futhi abambe iqhaza engxoxweni ngaphambi kokuba kuvezwe. Le nqubo iqala ngokukhishwa kwe-SARS kwesakhiwo somthetho ezinsukwini eziyishumi zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuhlangana kweKomidi lePhalamende. Kokubili i-SARS neKomidi lePhalamende baphinde bamema imibono yomphakathi ngesakhiwo somthetho, okungaqhutshelwa ngokuhanjiswa kwemibhalo ebhaliwe noma izingxoxo ezibukhoma. Uma umphakathi usukhulumiwe ngalesi, izingxoxo neKomidi lePhalamende ziba khona lapho imibono iboniswa. Ekupheleni kwalezi zingxoxo, i-SARS neMali Kazwelonke kulungiselela idokhumenti yokuphendula kulezi zingxoxo
Yini isimo (mhlawumbe singathi)! Ngesikhathi sikhula njengabantwana, sifundiswe ukuthi akufanele sibhale izinkukhu ngaphambi kokuba amaqanda aphume. Nokho, uma usuvunile, ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyinto oyitholile. Manje kufanele ucabange ukuthi uzokwenza ini ngalokhu kuvuna - uzokuthengisa ngokushesha noma uzokugcina ukuze ulinde intengo ikhule (noma yehlise uma ungaphumeleli). Lokhu kungenzeka uma ungenayo inkontileka yokumaketha - uma unayo, kufanele ulandele imigomo yayo. Yiziphi izinto okufanele ngicabangele uma ngifuna ukuqoqa ukuvuna kwami? Ngabe nginendawo epulazini yokuphatha, ukuhlanza, nokugcina lezi z food? Ngabe kufanele ngithuthe umkhiqizo ngiya emapulazini ukuze ngiwuhambise kumphathi wesilo ongumuntu ozimele, mhlawumbe kumfarmers omunye, noma emakethe noma kumuntu omunye osebenzisa ukudla okuvela emapulazini? Uma ufulawa kufanele ubekwe epulazini noma endaweni lapho kukhona isilo somuntu osebenza ngokwakhe, kuzobiza malini ithani? Qonda ukuthi izindleko zokuhlanganisa ufulawa endaweni ethile ngeke zidlule izindleko zentela nezinye izindleko ezihlobene nokubeka ukuvuna kwakho. Funda ngokucophelela lokho okukhuluma kulokhu kukontileka, ngesiNgisi baziwa ngokuthi "ukuphrinta okuncane" okuvame ukutholakala ekupheleni kwalokhu kukontileka - qaphela ukuthi bangakukhokhisa? Yisiphi isithembiso esinakho mayelana nentengo yokudla ehla futhi ikhula? Njalo ngesonto kufanele ushintshe amasu akho okuthengisa ngokuya ngezimo zezulu nezimakethe, kodwa kufanele ukhulume nomphathi wakho wezimali noma nesikhungo esabelana ngemininingwane endaweni yakho. Yini edala ukuthi intengo ye-fulawa eNingizimu Afrika yehlise futhi ikhule? Uma kukhona ukukhiqiza okukhulu kakhulu kwe-fulawa eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2004 no-2005), intengo ye-fulawa ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo esondele kwentengo ye-fulawa ethengiswa phesheya. Uma kubonakala ukuthi ufulawa kuzodingeka ukuthi ulethe phesheya kwezinye izindawo lapha eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2006 no-2007), intengo ye-fulawa ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo esondele kwentengo ekhokhelwa ukuthenga ufulawa phesheya. Intengo ye-fulawa yomhlaba ithonywa yizinto ezinkulu lapho intengo ye-fulawa ethengiswa phesheya noma ye-fulawa ethengwe phesheya ikalwa. Intengo ye-fulawa yomhlaba iyashintsha futhi iyashintsha nsuku zonke nangasikhathi. Ukushintsha kwentengo yomhlaba kuzoshintsha nentengo ye-fulawa ethengwe phesheya. Intengo ye-fulawa ethengwe e-USA nase-Argentina ivame ukukhombisa ukuthi intengo ye-fulawa eNingizimu Afrika izoba kanjani. Izindleko ezihlobene nentengo yokungenisa ukudla noma ukukuthutha phesheya (njengentengo yokuthenga ufulawa ezimakethe zomhlaba - noma ezindaweni ezithile) ikalwa ngokumelene nezindleko zokuthutha ukudla ngolwandle kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlobene nalokhu. Konke lokhu kubizwa futhi kukhokhelwa ngamaRandi aseMelika. Ukuhlela zonke lezi zindleko neRand yaseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuhambisane nezinga lokushintshanisa leRand/amaRandi aseMelika. Ukushintsha kwansuku zonke kwezinga lokushintshanisa leRand/amaRandi aseMelika kuzoshintsha nentengo ye-fulawa ethengiswa kanye ne-fulawa ethengwe phesheya. Ufulawa waseNingizimu Afrika uthengiswa nsuku zonke ezimakethe zokudla ezikhiqizwayo kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika e-Safex, okuyingxenye yeJohannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE). I-Safex ingachazwa njengohlelo lwe-elektroniki oluphatha futhi luhlola abathengi (njengabo abamila ufulawa ukuze benze ufulawa) kanye nalabo abathengisa (njengabakhulisa). Ngakho-ke, abathengi nabathengisi bangabeka intengo noma inani lemali ye-fulawa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi (ngokuvamile njalo ngenyanga). Ukuhamba kwe-Safex (ukuthenga nokuthengisa imikhiqizo yezolimo) kuqhubeka kusukela ngo-09:00 kuya ku-12:00 nsuku zonke. E-Randfontein (Gauteng), uzothola uphawu olukhombisa intengo ye-fulawa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi intengo ye-fulawa ye-Safex iyatholakala uma ufulawa ufika e-Randfontein. Uma ufulawa unikezwa kwezinye izindawo ngaphandle kwe-Randfontein, intengo kufanele ilungiswe ngokuya ngezindleko zokuthutha nezinye. Uma ungakwazi ukuhambisa ufulawa e-Randfontein, kufanele ucabangele izindleko ezizovela uma uhambisa ufulawa wakho kwezinye izindawo (izilo) ezibhaliswe ku-Safex. Kukhona izimali ezizokhokhiswa. Okokuqala, kukhona izindleko zokuthutha (kusukela endaweni yakho kuya kule silo e-Randfontein). Lezi zindleko zibhaliwe kahle emqulwini we-Safex ophumelele minyaka yonke. Uma ufulawa uhambiswa endaweni enesilo somnotho (um owner wesilo), kuzodingeka ukhokhe imali yokuphatha bese ubeka ufulawa wakho. Ngokuvamile, kuzoba nezindleko ezizokhokhiswa yinkampani ethengisa ufulawa wakho uma ungathengisi ukuvuna kwakho kumhlinzeki ngokushesha (isibonelo: ibhizinisi lezolimo lizokuthengisela ufulawa wakho futhi uzokhokha ngalokhu). Uma leyo fulawa ingathengiswa ngokushesha ngemva kokuhanjiswa (mhlawumbe kufanele igcinwe isikhathi esithile), kuzoba nezindleko ezengeziwe zokugcina leyo fulawa. Kubalulekile kumfarmers ukuqonda ukuthi inani lemali abazolithola kule silo ethile lingase libe phansi kunenani abangakuthola kwezinye izindawo. Ungazama futhi ukuxoxa ngqo nabaphathi bezimila, kanye nezinye izinkampani ezisebenza nemikhiqizo yezolimo nabanye abathengi nabathengisi bezinhlamvu zokudla ukuze uthole intengo engcono. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ungumnikazi kuphela walokhu kuvuna - kuyakho ukuyithengisa ngokuthanda kwakho - uma ungathandi intengo yokuthengisa, zama ukuthola intengo engcono. Intengo ekhombiswa yi-Safex iyona okufanele uzame ukuyithola.
Chaza ukuthi ungayithuthukisa kanjani imithetho ekhona kulolu cwaningo mayelana nokuthengiswa kwezocansi ngabantu abadala? Chaza zonke iziphakamiso ezahlukene ezenziwe emphakathini? Okokuqala, ngaphansi komthetho wethu kazwelonke, ukuthengiswa kwezocansi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, kanye nokuthenga ucansi kumuntu omdala ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, kanye nezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuthengiswa kwezocansi, akuvumelekile. Okwesibili, zonke iziphakamiso ezinemininingwane kulolu Bhuku Lokuxoxa zibheka njengobugebengu ukuthengisa ucansi ngabancane; ukuphonsa umuntu ukuthi athengise ucansi ngaphandle kwemvume; nokuhweba abantu ngenhloso yokuthengisa ucansi. IKomidi ibona ukuthi ukuphonsa umuntu ukuthi athengise ucansi akuvumelekile futhi le siphakamiso kufanele ifakwe embikweni wokugcina weziphakamiso zeKomidi. Isiphakamiso sesibili sithi izenzo zabantu abathintekayo ekuthengiseni ucansi, amabhizinisi wezocansi, kanye nabathengi bezocansi akufanele abhekwa njengobugebengu. Abantu abathengisa ucansi abaphuli umthetho ngoba babhekwa njengabantu okufanele bavikelwe. Isiphakamiso sesithathu sithi ukuthengiswa kwezocansi kufanele kulawulwe futhi kuvunyelwe ukuthi kuqhubeke ngendlela ethile, njengokukhishwa kwemvume yamabhizinisi wezocansi, ukubhaliswa kwabantu abathengisa ucansi, nokuhlonza izindawo eziyingozi lapho abathengisi bezocansi benza khona. Ngaphansi kwalesi siphakamiso, ukuthengiswa kwezocansi ngabantu abadala kuvunyelwe, kodwa kufanele kuqhubeke ngendlela echaziwe. Ukuthengiswa kwezocansi okungahambisani nendlela echaziwe akufanele kube ubugebengu. Isiphakamiso sesine sithi ukuthengisa ucansi akufanele kubhekwe njengesenzo esingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kuhambisana nombono wokuthi ukuthengisa ucansi kubhekwa njengendlela evumelekile yokusebenza - kodwa ukufakwa kwemithetho yokusebenza kulolu daba akusho ukuthi lokhu kuyimbangela yokuphula umthetho. Akufanele kuthathwe njengomgomo obekwe nguhulumeni. Chaza kafushane ukuthi kungani ungakwenzi umbono ngomdlalo weMidlalo yeHlabathi? Ucwaningo jikelele mayelana nezimo ezihlobene nocansi (okukhuluma ngePhrojekthi 107), eyasungulwa ngo-1998, inegunya elibanzi. Inhloso yalolu cwaningo ukuthuthukisa kakhulu ukuhlinzekwa kwezobulungiswa mayelana nazo zonke izimo ezihlobene nocansi nokuthengiswa kwezocansi ngabantu abadala, nokuhlola imithetho elawula lezi zimo ukuze kwenziwe iziphakamiso-nezincwadi ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngobulungiswa ukuze kulwe nezinsolo zokuhlukumeza kwezocansi futhi lezi ziphakamiso-nezincwadi zilethe izinguquko.
Intshisekelo noma ukuhlanganiswa kwentshisekelo emalini noma empahleni kanye nesabelo sentshisekelo kumashares ethempilo uma kukhona intshisekelo noma ukuhlanganiswa kwesabelo sentshisekelo kumashares empahla noma imali etshaliwe ezweni langaphandle uma kukhona intshisekelo noma ukuhlanganiswa kwentshisekelo kumashares ngaphakathi kwelizwe, inani eliphelele lemali yokurenta ekhokhwa ngababolekisi noma eqoqwe ngababambiqhaza abasebenza komunye umuntu mayelana nephepha elichazwe, likhona, kanye nemali ekhokhwayo ngelungelo lokusebenzisa le mpahla, kanye nemali etholakala ezindaweni zokubambisana zokuphatha izinto ezithile ezakhelwe kudala, njengokubhala izincwadi nezinye, noma kukhona imali ekhokhwayo yokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani, imiklamo, amalungelo emikhiqizo, ubuhlakani, amalungelo omthetho wezincwadi noma ulwazi lobuhlakani, noma ukuze kudluliselwe ulwazi oluhlobene nokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani bezinto ezithile ezakhelwe ulwazi lwezintela. Gcwalisa amafomu e-IT 3: Gcwalisa amafomu olwazini lwezintela ngokunembile kanye nekhophi yokuqala ye-IT 3. Thumela lawa mafomu ezintela ehhovisi le-SARS eliseduze. Akukho sikhathi esibekwe. Le sevisi iyatholakala mahhala futhi ayikhaliswa.
Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery, ethokozisa izakhamuzi zokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, iyinhloko-mbumbulu emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza uwoyela nezinsiza zamafutha. Ukuqala kwayo kwaba maphakathi nekhulu lama-21, lapho uhulumeni wezwe ubona udinga ukunciphisa ukuncika kwamafutha avela kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwalesi sikhungo esikhulu sokucubungula uwoyela, esikholwa ukuthi sizokwandisa umnotho wendawo, sidale amathuba emisebenzi, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo yabantu. Umlando wephrojekthi uqala ngonyaka we-2012, lapho kwaqala khona ucwaningo lokuhlola izindawo ezihambisana nezidingo zokwakha i-refinery. Kuhlolwe izindawo ezahlukene, kodwa ekugcineni, kwakhiwa isinqumo sokwakha i-refinery eMthomboni, eduze kweMiddelburg, eMpumalanga. Le ndawo yakhethwa ngenxa yokuba seduzane nemithombo yamanzi kanye nezinsiza zokuhambisa izimpahla, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kokuthunyelwa nokuthathwa kwezimpahla. Ngemva kokuphothulwa kokuhlola, iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery yathola ukwesekwa okuqinile kuhulumeni, izinkampani ezizimele, kanye nabahlali bendawo. Lokhu kwaba nemiphumela emihle, lapho izinkampani zakuwo zazinikezela ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, zathumela abaqeqeshi nabasizi abanezinga eliphezulu, futhi zakha ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi. Lokhu kubambisana kwaziwa njengomgomo omkhulu wephrojekthi, njengoba kuveza ukuthi izinkampani ezizimele nazo zingaba neqhaza elihle ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ngonyaka we-2015, kwaba nezithiyo ezithile ezazithinta iphrojekthi, njengokungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabaphathi bezokwakha, imithetho yokuvikela imvelo, kanye nezinkinga zezezimali. Nakuba lezi zinkinga zaba yinkinga, umphakathi waba nethemba lokuthi le phrojekthi izogcina isiqhuba njengoba izakhamuzi zazi ukuthi izoba nesandla ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yokwakha, iMthombo Oil Refinery yavulwa ngempumelelo ngo-2017. Lokhu kwaba umcimbi omkhulu, okwenziwa ngempumelelo edolobheni, lapho abaholi bendawo, osomabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi babonisa ukusekela kwabo. Umphakathi wawujabule kakhulu, njengoba izinkampani eziningi zathola amathuba emisebenzi, futhi abanenhlonipho kule ndawo baphendukela emsebenzini. I-refinery yathola ukwenziwa kwezimoto, ukukhiqizwa kwezinsiza zamafutha, kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezihambisanayo. I-refinery, ethokozisa izidingo zendawo, ihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezibalulekile, ezinjengamafutha, uwoyela, nezinye izinto eziningi ezidingekayo ezimbonini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwemikhiqizo engaphezulu, okuthi, phakathi kwamanye, kube nezinhlangano ezithengisa imikhiqizo ehlukene kulabhathi zomhlaba. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni, njengoba uhulumeni wathola izinsiza ezisemqoka zokuqinisa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMthombo Oil Refinery ibonakale ifisa ukusiza umphakathi ngendlela ehlukahlukene. Ngemuva kokuvulwa kwayo, yaqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsiza ezithile ezibalulekile, ezifana nezinhlelo zokufundisa, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokwelapha, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zakhuthaza ukuphila kahle nokwakha umphakathi ozimele, ophethe imibono emihle ngempilo. Ngonyaka we-2020, i-refinery yathola izindondo eziningi zokuhlonishwa ngokusebenza kwayo kahle, ukunakekela imvelo, kanye nokuthuthukisa umnotho. Lokhu kwavusa umoya omuhle phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaninimabhizinisi nabahlali bebonisa ukwazisa ngokuhlonishwa kwezinsiza eziphathelene nemiphakathi. Umphakathi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ukwesekwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisayo, futhi uqhubeka nokusebenza ngempumelelo. Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery ufakazela ukuthi ingxenye yokwakha imikhiqizo yezokwakha ingaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Iphrojekthi ibonisa ukuthi ukusebenzisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, izinkampani, nohulumeni kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu, lapho izinsiza zikhuluma ngokwakhiwa komphakathi ozimele. Njengoba i-refinery iqhubeka nokukhula, izikhumbuzo zayo zikhumbuza abantu ngokubaluleka kokubambisana, ukwakha amaphrojekthi afanele, nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Njengoba sibhala le ndaba, sizimisele ukuqhubeka sithuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizokwenza iMthombo Oil Refinery ibaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wezwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi ibhizinisi liqhubeke nokukhula, futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi nemikhiqizo emisha, okuhlangene nokwakha umphakathi ohlala phansi. Iphrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery, ngezinselelo zayo, izinkinga ezitholwe, kanye neziphumo zayo, ibonisa indlela yokwakha umphakathi ongcono. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana, ukusekela le phrojekthi, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza iMthombo Oil Refinery ibe yimpumelelo eqhubekayo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, sinesiqiniseko sokuthi le phrojekthi izoba yisibonelo sokuthi ngempela, uma abantu bephumelelayo, bangakha umhlaba ophilayo, ogcwele amathuba nempumelelo.
Ekusungulweni kwe-NER (Umphakathi Wezokukhanyisa Kazwelonke) ngoMashi 1995, i-NER yazibophezela ekwenzeni izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emkhakheni wezokukhanyisa (ESI). Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo laqokwa futhi lavunywa nguMlawuli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa baqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bathola izinga elamukelekayo lezinsizakalo. Omunye umsebenzi okwamanje owenziwa yi-NER ukuhloleka iminikelo yabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa ngokubabheka ngezinga elibekwe. Umphakathi uphinde uqaphele ukuthi abathengi banendima okufanele bayidlale ohlelweni lokulawula. Kukholwa ukuthi uma abathengi beqonda izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo elikhona, bazokwazi ukuphikisa abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa futhi babe nezwi ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngakho-ke, abathengi kufanele bazi ngezinga lezinsizakalo abaneleyo. Kuze kube manje, i-NER isungule idokhumenti elula ukuyifunda futhi eyamukelekayo kubathengi. Le dokhumenti isekelwe kulokho okukhona ngaphandle kokushintsha umqondo wayo. Umphakathi Wezokukhanyisa Kazwelonke (NER) usuku olude uqaphele isidingo sokusungula izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emkhakheni wezokukhanyisa; izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zagesi lingalindelwa ngabathengi bempahla ehlukene yokusetshenziswa kagesi kanye nezinga okufanele lihlangabezane nalo ngabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa. Abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa kufanele babike ku-NER ngezinga labo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga elibekwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bayagcina izinga. Le bhukwana ihlose ukwazisa abathengi abakhokhayo ngezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo abangalindela kubahlinzeki bokukhanyisa futhi inikeze abathengi ukuqonda okungcono kwekholomu ye-NRS 047 ngendlela ethinta ngayo. Ukulinganiswa kukagesi okwenziwayo kuvumela abathengi ithuba lokuthenga ugesi ngamanani abawakwazi ukukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi abangahlangabezani nezikweletu zabo zagesi ekupheleni kwenyanga bangase baphumelele ukukhokha. Le bhukwana iphinde ichaze izindlela ezitholakalayo kubathengi lapho kuvela izingxabano phakathi kwabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa nabo mayelana nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER ilindele ukuthi abathengi nabahlinzeki abafanele bazame ukusombulula izingxabano zabo ngaphambi kokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER. Ngokuvamile, i-NER ngeke ingenelele ngaphandle kokuthi le ngxabano ingaxazululwa ezingeni lendawo. Imithetho ethile ivame ukusetshenziswa emkhakheni wezokukhanyisa, futhi kubalulekile kubathengi bokukhanyisa ukuba bazi ngemisho yale mithetho. Ukuhlukaniswa kukagesi okuhleliwe: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi okuhleliwe okwenziwa ngabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa ngesikhathi besebenza. Ukuhlukaniswa kukagesi okwenziwe ngenkani: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi okwenziwa ngenxa yokuphazamiseka okuthile emigqeni kagesi noma ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwezinsiza kagesi. Imigqa kagesi yasemakhaya: imigqa kagesi ehlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezikude, ezifana nemiphakathi yasemakhaya namafamu, avame ukungabi nezinsiza ezinhle ezifana nezindlela. Imigqa kagesi yasemadolobheni: imigqa kagesi ehlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezinamakhaya amaningi ezivame ukuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi okwesikhashana: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kumthengi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kungase kungahambisani nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo elibekwe. Ugesi ophansi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni abathengi bezindlu noma amabhizinisi amancane. Ugesi ophakathi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni ugesi nasekuhlinzekeni imboni noma abathengi abangathengisi. I-voucher yagesi: Lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokukhokha (ithikithi) esitholakala ngemuva kokukhokha ugesi futhi sivumela umthengi ukuthi asebenzise inani elithile legesi. Isebenza ngokulayishwa kumitha yagesi ekhokhelwayo. Umitha yagesi ekhokhelwayo: idivayisi yokulinganisa ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izilinganiso ezahlukene zagesi ezithengwe zifakwa kulomitha. Isikhungo sokuhweba nokuqasha ugesi: Umshini oxhunywe ezindaweni zebhizinisi osetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amanani kagesi athengwe ngababhalisile bagesi ekhokhelwayo. Izinga Lokuhlinzekwa Kagesi: izinga elilindelekile lokuhlinzekwa kagesi, njengamandla kagesi, ukuhlinzekwa, ukwehla, nokwenyuka kwamandla, njll., njengoba kuchazwe kuSigaba 2 se-NRS 048. Ikhredithi/Abathengi abasebenzisa ama-voucher kagesi ekhokhelwayo: laba ngabathengi abasebenzisa ugesi ngekhredithi futhi umhlinzeki kagesi uza ukufunda inani legesi elisetshenzisiwe. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo elichazwe ngaphansi kwe-NRS 047 kuSigaba 1 yilezo ezincane okungenani umhlinzeki kagesi okufanele azame ukuzihlangabezana nazo, kodwa abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa bencitshwa ukuba bedlule ezingeni elincane elibekwe. Ezimweni lapho umhlinzeki kagesi ehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezinga elilindelekile ngenxa yezizathu ezingaphansi kokulawula kwabo, ngeke babhekiswe icala lokuhluleka ukusebenza ezingeni elibekwe. Lezi zimo zifaka phakathi izenzo zempi, ubugebengu nokuhlukumeza, iziteleka zezimboni, izingozi zemoto, nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Lezi zimo ezishiwo ngenhla aziphelele kodwa ziqondwa njengemibono yokuthi kufanele kube nenqubo ethile. Uma kwenzeka ingxabano nomthengi mayelana nezinga lokuhlinzeka okukhuluma ngalo, umthwalo wemfanelo uphakathi komhlinzeki kagesi ukuzama ukusombulula le nkinga ekhona ngama ndlela afanele zokubonisana. Ngale ndlela, uma isikhalazo sesifakiwe, umhlinzeki kagesi kufanele azise inkantolo, isikhathi, nendawo lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukuzama ukusombulula udaba. Kufanele kuqokonyiswe ukuthi i-NER izongena kuphela uma izingxoxo zokuxazulula zihluleka. Kubalulekile kubathengi ukulandela imithetho ebekwe ngabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukuqedela yonke imibhalo edingekayo, nokukhokha zonke izindleko ezibekiwe. Uma ingxabano ivela mayelana nezinga lezinsizakalo, ngokwesibonelo, ukunemba komitha ekhokhelwayo yomthengi, kubalulekile kumthengi ukukhokha imali ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuba udaba luhlolwe. Le mali izobuyiselwa uma kutholakala ukuthi ukunemba kokufundwa komitha akulungile. Umthengi kufanele aqale ngokunikeza umhlinzeki kagesi ithuba lokuxazulula noma iyiphi inkinga. Kufanele baphakamise udaba ku-NER uma bengahlangabezani nesivumelwano. Izinsuku eziyishumi uma imigqa ekhona ingasetshenziswa noma ikhebuli exhuma kunethiwekhi yangaphakathi engadini. Izinyanga eziyodwa uma ugesi ophansi udingeka (amandla kagesi ahlinzeka ngezindlu zokuhlala namabhizinisi amancane) noma
Ukusiza nokufundisa abalimi ngabanye kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kubiza imali eningi. Kungcono ukuhlanganisa abalimi ndawonye, kwakha i-cooperative enamalungu anemibandela efanayo, bese bekwazi ukuthola usizo ngokuqhubekayo emihlanganweni evamile. Le phrojekthi iqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wayo - ikhuluma ngokuqeqesha, ulwazi, nolwazi kubo bonke abalimi ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwesikhathi, sibone ukuthi inani lamalungu kuma-cooperatives okufunda lehle, ngoba kuphela abalimi abaqotho abafuna ukukhula kwezomnotho bahlala. Lokhu kubonakala ikakhulukazi eNyakatho Ntshonalanga lapho le phrojekthi isiqhuba khona iminyaka eminingi. Ezindaweni lapho saqala khona ukusungula ama-cooperatives amasha, sibhekene nezinselelo ngoba kunezabalimi abaningi abafuna ukujoyina. Kukhona izindawo lapho kunezabalimi abasha abangafika ku-200 abafuna ukujoyina! Kule nyanga, sihlangane namalungu angu-128 alezi zifundo ze-cooperatives ezindaweni eziphethwe amahhovisi esifunda. Phakathi kwalezi zifundo, kukhona eziyi-8 ezilungu zephrojekthi yezenkolo eFree State Mpumalanga. Indlela yokuthuthukisa amasu ukuze kulungiselelwe ukulima ngonyaka ozayo uma uzwa ukuthi izimo zezulu zizoba nzima ekulimeni. Ezinyangeni ezedlule, sihlangane nawo wonke amalungu ama-cooperatives okufunda ukuze siqoqe ulwazi mayelana nenani le-hectares elimiwe, inani lemishini kanye nesimo sayo njengamatraktha, abakhangisi, imishini yokuphalaza, nezithuthi. Sikholelwa ukuthi sizothola uxhaso nokwesekwa kwephrojekthi ezozama ukuqapha nokulungisa le mishini - imishini enempilo ibalulekile uma ufuna ukulima ngokomnotho. Okwamanje, ukulima kukhishwa ingcindezi ngoba inzuzo iphansi, ngakho akukho mali yokubheka nokulungisa imishini. Le ndaba idinga ukuhlolwa kahle uma abakhiqizi abamnyama befuna ukuthola indawo yabo ekulimaleni kwezomnotho.
UNapoleon Bonaparte: Indaba Yempumelelo Nesiphelo Esinzima Kwakhanya ebusuku eFransi, lapho uNapoleon Bonaparte, indoda eyaziwa ngokuhlakanipha kwayo, ehlola indlela yokuba yisikhulu sezempi. Wazalwa ngo-15 kuNhlolanja 1769 eKorsika, izwe elincane elaliphikiswa kakhulu. Wakhulela emndenini obhekene nezinkinga, okwakwandisa umbono wakhe wokuphumelela. Njengomfana, uNapoleon wayefuna ukufunda futhi waqala ukufunda ezikoleni eziphezulu. Waqopha izimpawu zothando lwezempilo, waphothula izifundo zakhe ngempumelelo. Ngemuva kweminyaka ethile, waba umphakathi ophumelelayo, waqhubeka phambili emkhakheni wezomlando, uthola izikhala ezinhle futhi eveza amakhono akhe okuphatha. Njengoba ubuholi bakhe buhamba phambili, abanye babhekelele impumelelo yakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNapoleon waba yinsika enkulu embusweni wezompi, wahamba phambili ezimpini eziningi, waba ngumbusi omkhulu. Ngemuva kokuphumelela empini efana neBattle of Austerlitz, owaziwa ngokuthi “Impumelelo Yomkhiqizo,” waqala ukudlala indima enkulu kwezomnotho, enza izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, izimali, nemithetho. Uhlelo lweNapoleonic lwaba isibonelo sokuphathwa kwalesi sikhathi. Nokho, uNapoleon akazange abhekane kuphela nezinhliziyo ezimnandi; kwavela nezinsuku ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-1812, wathumela amabutho akhe empini yokuhlasela iRussia, enethemba lokuthola ukuthula. Kodwa izithiyo ezinkulu zamholela empini enezingozi. Umoya opholile, ukudla okuncane, neziphazamiso ezihlala zenzeka, kwashiya amabutho akhe ebhekene nezinselelo ezinzima, kanti le mibuzo yahlukanisa umhlaba. Ngesikhathi ehlolisisa iphutha lakhe, uNapoleon wabuyela eFransi efisa ukubuyisela ukuthula, kodwa izikhulu azizange ziqonde, futhi zaba nemibono emisha yokuhola izwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uNapoleon wathola usizo oluncane ezinkampanini. Ekupheleni, waba nguMongameli, kodwa akazange abuyele ezifisweni zakhe. Ngemuva kwalokho, wathunyelwa kwi-South Atlantic, e-Elba, lapho akathola khona ubunzima bokuphila. Nokho, wanikela esikhathini sokubhalela iziphakamiso, futhi uthando lwakhe lwezombusazwe lwahlala lukhona. Ngemuva kokuphuma kwakhe e-Elba, wabuyela eFransi, wadlala izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze athole ubumqoka. Waqala impi yokuqala, kodwa amaphupho akhe ahluleka ngenxa yokuphikiswa okukhulu. Ngemuva kokudlula izinkanyezi, uNapoleon ongeke abe neze alahlekelwe emzabalazweni. Impi yakhe yokugcina, ethiwa yiBattle of Waterloo, yaphumelela futhi yabuyisela emuva umhlaba. Uthando, ukungaphumeleli, kanye nomsebenzi wakhe kukhombisa indlela yokuthi izinto zingaphezu kweziyalezo ezivamile. Le ndaba yokuphila kaNapoleon Bonaparte ibhalwe phansi, ifanekisela izinja zomlando. Akusizi uNapoleon kuphela, kodwa kubalulekile kubantu abaningi. Lokhu kuhlangana kwezinto, uNapoleon Bonaparte uhlala njengomfanekiso wezinto ezimnandi, njengoba iAfrika, iYurophu, nezindawo ezikude zibheka imfundo ngalolu chungechunge lwezimpilo.
Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubamba iqhaza ehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana nesifo se-influenza A (H1N1) 2009 esigamekweni se-pandemic emsebenzini wakho nasemphakathini okhonza kuwo. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni lesi sifo nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walonyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa ngokuthi i-swine flu ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi iqale ezinkalweni. Manje sekuqondwa ukuthi umthombo wayo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, lesi sifo asinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sekuhlonishwa ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngegama layo elisemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walonyaka, leli gciwane lisabalale ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalale ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane lihlasele abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. ENingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 anokufa kwezingu-6. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lokuphendula Okusheshayo okwenzeka ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi leMhlabeni (WHO) laphumela ematheni ukuthi izimfanelo zokumemezela lesi sifo njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke zifeziwe, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, umemezele ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njengePandemic (izinga le-6). Lokhu kusho nje ukuthi lesi sifo sesabalale ezweni kuzo zonke izifunda ze-WHO futhi senze kanjalo ngokushesha. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi lesi sifo sinezinga elikhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi iyaqhubeka nokusabalala yonke indawo. Ngomhla kaJulayi 6, i-WHO ichaze isimo esiqhubekayo salo msebenzi emazweni athintekile nasezwenikazi ezintsha njengokungamukeleki nokungavinjwa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ikwakhulume ukuthi abantu abaningi abahlaselwe yileli gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina sabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasesifundazweni, sikhathazekile ngokuqhamuka kokufa okwenzekile kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abahlaselwe eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane liba nomthelela ikakhulukazi kubantu abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya kwengu-29 - iningi labo lingabafundi noma lisezikoleni eziphezulu. I-WHO iphakamisa ukuthi amazwe afanele agxile ekwehliseni umthelela walolu sifo emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Lesi sifo sithunyelwa ngama-droplet okuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu ohlaselwe ekhwehlela noma ehlanza, ungaphuza ama-droplet abawakhwehlelayo noma atholakala emoyeni. Nokho, uma bekukhona abantu abaninzi abahlala endaweni encane, ungase uphuzise umoya lapho ungahlaselwa khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani ongezimpawu ezilula noma ezinzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa yiNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesiphakamiso sodokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka ebhizinisini locwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka okwamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akuhambisani nalokho i-WHO efuna. Odokotela kufanele baphathe amacala athintekayo ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliselwa kolwazi (protocol) ezinikezwa uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu.
