Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela eziphethweni zokwelashwa ezinhle uma lo muthi usebenza futhi kungavimbela labo abangakwazi ukusindisa izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi olutholakala emhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekumelaneni nokusabalala kwesifo. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi ongezimpawu ezilula ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi noma/okanye othisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekayo kufanele sixhumane noMnyango WezokuFunda, ozosebenza nezikhungo zezempilo ukuze anikeze umhlahlandlela ofanele wokuthi kumele kuqhubekwe kanjani. Uma ungezimpawu ezilula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwethusela ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuze bazame ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sesixazululo kanye nokukhiqizwa okukhulu okunganele - isikali esingekho e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukubonga isikhathi osithathile ukufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngendima yakho elindelekile ekusakazeni ulwazi nasekwehliseni umthelela walolu sifo.
Amalungelo Abantu: Indaba Yokulwa Nempilo Nobulungiswa Ngaphakathi komlando womuntu, amalungelo abantu avele njengomgogodla wokuphila kahle, ubulungiswa, kanye nomqondo wokuhlonipha ubuntu. Lokhu kuqala emaphakathini amaningi, lapho abantu bebebhekana nezinkinga eziningi, kufaka phakathi ukucindezelwa, ubuhlanga, kanye nezinhlekelele zokukhwabanisa. Uhlanga lwezinto lungabuyiselwa emuva ezikhathini zakudala, lapho izinsika zempilo zafakwa khona ezincwadini eziningi. Kukhona amaMthetho kaHammurabi, akhiwe eBabiloni ngonyaka ka-1754 BCE, lapho kwafakwa khona iziqondiso ezichaza amalungelo nemisebenzi yabantu. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokubhekwa kokubaluleka kokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, nakuba lezi ziqondiso zazingabi nemiphumela emikhulu ezimpilweni zabaningi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngamazinga ahlukahlukene, abantu baqala ukwazi ukulwela amalungelo abo. Iqhawe elalizwakalisa lesi sifo sokuqonda amalungelo abantu nguSocrates, owakholelwa ekutheni umuntu ngamunye unelungelo lokukhuluma nokuphila ngendlela afuna ngayo. Lesi sikhungo sekhuluma ngempela ngezinguquko ezinkulu ezazizobanga ezikhathini ezizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyaka yeMpi Yezwe I neMpi Yezwe II yafaka izikhumbuzo ezinzima ezizobangela ukuphakanyiswa kwamalungelo abantu. Ngemuva kwempi, abantu abaningi baqonda ukuthi ukuphila kwabo kuhlale kwehluka, nokuthi kufanele kube nezivumelwano eziphathelene namalungelo abantu. Kulokhu, ngonyaka ka-1948, iMibhalo YamaNgxenye Wezikhulu Zomhlaba yadalwa, okwakuwumsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Le mibhalo yafaka izinqubo ezisemqoka ezithinta ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi, ukudala umhlaba onobulungiswa, nokukhulisa umoya wezokuthula. Ngemva kokwakhiwa kwalezi zinsiza, izizwe eziningi zathatha izinyathelo ezinzima zokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Kodwa-ke, izithiyo zazikhona. Kwakukhona izinkinga ezinjengobuhlanga, ubuhlanga obuhlukile, kanye nokuphathwa kabi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala imiphumela emibi, njengoba abantu behlukunyezwa, beboshwa, futhi bephoqelelwa ukuba baphile ngendlela engafanelekile. Ngesikhathi se-1960s, emhlabeni jikelele, kwaqala ukuvela izinyathelo ezinzima zokulwa nobandlululo, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezazihlose ukuvikela amalungelo abantu. Abaholi abafana noMartin Luther King Jr. e-United States, nabanye abaholi bezokuhlanganyela, baphakamisa izwi labo ukuze baphakamise amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi abantu kufanele bazimisele ukulwa ukuze bathole amalungelo abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani zemisebenzi zikhipha izikhumbuzo ezinzima, lapho zifuna ukukhangisa ngokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezifana neGoogle neApple, ziqale ukwazisa amalungelo abantu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavunyelwe ukucindezelwa noma ukuphathwa kabi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi amalungelo abantu akuyona kuphela indaba yempilo yabantu abavela ezizweni ezithile, kodwa yindaba yokusebenza komhlaba wonke. Nokho, nakuba izinyathelo eziningi zenzekile, kusazoba khona imikhawulo ethile. Izinkinga zokuhlukumeza, ukungavunyelwa kwezwi, kanye nokungabi nalungelo lokukhetha zisazoba izinselelo ezinzima. Kulokhu, kudinga ukuba sibe nomdlandla, siqhubeke sikhuthaza amalungelo abantu, sishiye umhlaba ungcono kubantu bethu. Ngokuhamba kweminyaka, abantu baqhubeka nokulwa ukuze bahloniphe amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imikhankaso ehlukene, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezinkampani ezazithanda ukuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. I-United Nations, ngokwazisa iMibhalo YamaNgxenye Wezikhulu Zomhlaba, iqhubekile ibeka izindinganiso eziphakeme zokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, iqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila, ukufunda, nokuqhuba impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, indaba yamalungelo abantu ayigcini nje kuphela emlandweni, kodwa iyindaba eqhubekayo. Abantu basebenza kanzima ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu ayahlonishwa, futhi bazimisele ukulwa nalabo abahlaselayo amalungelo abo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amalungelo abantu akukhona ukuvota kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ukugcina amalungelo abantu kuphakamisa ubungani, uthando, kanye nokuhlonipha phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ngakho-ke, njengomphakathi, kumele siqhubeke sikhuthaza amalungelo abantu, sikhumbule ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila, futhi sikhuthaze ukwakhiwa komhlaba onobulungiswa. Indaba yamalungelo abantu iyindaba yethu sonke, futhi kumele sizibophezele ekuthuthukiseni lezi zinto ukuze umhlaba ube ngcono kulabo abazayo.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekiselwa kumuntu ongaphandle ofisa ukuhlala emuva eNingizimu Afrika. Akukho umkhawulo weminyaka obekiwe. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ehhovisi lemboni laseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sifakwa phesheya. Kufanele uhlinzeke ubufakazi kuMnyango Wezangaphandle bokuthi unelungelo lokuthola umhlalaphansi, umhlalaphansi ongeniswe emuva ngonyaka, noma i-akhawunti yokuhola umhlalaphansi ezokunikeza umkhawulo ophakanyisiwe we-R20,000 ngenyanga. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kufanele uhlinzeke ubufakazi kuMnyango Wezangaphandle bokuthi unempahla engahlanganiswa ukuze ikwazi ukukhiqiza imali engu-R20,000 ngenyanga. Akukho umkhawulo wesikhathi obekiwe kulolu sevisi.
Ukwazi Ukungondleki: Indaba Yomlando Ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyinzima yokuphila kwabantu, ukungondleki (malnutrition) kube yinkinga enkulu ebonakalayo ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Njengoba sihamba emlandweni, sizobona ukuthi ukungondleki akukhona nje kuphela ukungabi nokudla okukhulayo, kodwa kuhambisana nezimo zomnotho, zendawo, nezemvelo. Le ndaba ithinta abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi izingane, abakhubazekile, nesizukulwane esisha esiphila emiphakathini ehluphekayo. Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abantu bebebhekene nenkinga yokungondleki. Ezindaweni ezithile, izinkanyezi zazingekho, izivunguvungu zazingasiza ekuphumeleleni kokufuya. Kanjalo, izivunguvungu zafaka udaba lokungondleki. Uhlelo lokufuya izilimo nemfuyo lwaluyinsiza yokukhulisa imfuyo, kodwa uma kwaba nezinkinga ezinjengokushoda kwamanzi noma ukungahambi kahle kwezulu, abantu bahlupheka kakhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba yaveza izinselele ezinkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Izinkampani zashiya imiphakathi eminingi ibhunuza impilo. Ukushoda kokudla, ikakhulu ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu yempi, kwaba yinkinga enkulu, futhi kwavela izigameko zokungondleki ezibucayi. Abantu abanjengoLwandle, ophila ebheke ebhakabhakeni bakhumbula ubunzima bokuba nezidingo ezisisekelo ezinjengokudla, futhi lezi zimo ezinzima zashiya umthelela omkhulu emlandweni wabantu nabantu abavela ezizweni ezihlukene. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yomhlaba, iMelika yenza imizamo emikhulu yokugcina abantu bephila. Uhlelo lweNkosi weMali lwezokudla lwaluhlose ukusiza ukuhlinzeka ukudla ezindaweni ezithintekile. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokunciphisa ukungondleki, kepha iMpi yakhumbuza abaninimakhaya ukuthi inkinga yokungondleki ayipheli kalula. Abantu baye basala benethemba, kodwa izimo zomnotho ziqhubekile nokubahlupha. Abantu bahlala bezama ukuhamba phambili, besebenzisa amasu ahlukahlukene ukuze bagweme ukuphila ezimo ezinzima. Njengoba umhlaba usuqubuka, imizamo yokuxazulula ukungondleki ibilokhu iqhubekela phambili. Ezindaweni ezifana neNyakatho ye-Afrika, abanishi bezinto bathumele izixazululo zokwakha izinhlelo zokulima ezihlonipha umkhathi. Ukwethula izinkambo zokufundisa abantu indlela yokulima ngomhlaba njengezinyathelo ezivumela ukuvuna okuhle. Lokhu kwenze abantu babe nezinketho eziningi, kanti ukungondleki kuncipha kancane kancane. Naphezu kwalezi zinyathelo, ukungondleki kusemqoka emhlabeni. Uthando nokuhlonipha izidingo zabanye konga izimoto ezitshaliwe. Izinhlelo ezisizayo kumele ziqhubeke, futhi ukubamba iqhaza okuhle kuzobonisa ukuthi sibhakabhakela phambili. Umphakathi kumele uthole ukudla okunempilo, kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila, ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo. Okwamanje, sithola izinkambo zokwazisa ulwazi nolwazi lwesayensi ezikhanyisela abantu abaningi ngobungozi bokungondleki. Imikhankaso yokwakha umphakathi uqobo isiza ukusiza abantu bazi ngempilo, bese besiza ukudla okunempilo nemikhankaso yokuphila kwabadlula kancane. Lezi zinyathelo, njengoba zigcinwa ziqhubeka, zibonisa umoya wokujula nokhuthaza. Ngokubheka emuva, kubalulekile ukufunda emlandweni. Ukuze silwe nokungondleki, kudinga isibopho sezinhlaka ezahlukene - osomabhizinisi, abakhiqizi bokudla, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi. Lezi zinyathelo zingasiza ukudala umhlaba onempilo, unokudla okunempilo, umphakathi ophumelelayo. Siyacela, asibheke phambili nokwakha umhlaba ophilayo kuye phezulu komuntu, emtholampilo owanelisayo nangempilo, ombuschisayo. Ukungondleki akufanele kube yinsolo yomunye umuntu, kodwa umphakathi wonke. Qhubekela phambili, sizokwazi ukuhamba phambili futhi sinikeze indlela yokuphila ezolile. Ihlathi lokuphila liphila kumphakathi ophilayo, futhi abantu abakhula ngezindlela ezilungisile bayokwanisa ukufika lapho beyofinyelela ngokusebenza kanzima, bethembisa umphakathi onempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, sithi: "Ngokuhlanganyela, sikwazi!" Ukungondleki kusemqoka, kepha siyakwazi ukukwenza kube yinto eyadlula emhlabeni uma sizohlanganyela. Umhlaba unethuba lokwakha ikusasa elikahle, kodwa lokho kudinga imizamo yethu kuqala. Khetha ukwakha!
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhloselwe ukusiza labo balimi abaphumelele ekufundeni. Lezi zinkampani zidinga usizo ngabanye mayelana nokwakha isu lokukhiqiza, ukuphatha imisebenzi yokulima, ukuphatha izindaba zezimali, njll. Abalimi abakhethiwe bazothola ukwesekwa okukhulu unyaka wonke. Unyaka nonyaka, abalimi abasha bazokhethwa ukuze bathole le nsizakalo, emva kwalokho bazophila ngokuzimela kodwa bazothola usizo lwefoni kubaphathi ababelana ngolwazi ezindaweni zabo. Uma umbulimi ekhiqiza ngaphezu kwamathani angama-250 ngonyaka, bazokwethulwa kwabanye abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo - lokhu kuzosheshisa ukungena kwabamnyama ezimakethe zomnotho. Bonke abalimi abawamalungu ale nhlangano bathola ukwesekwa ekwakheni ipotfoliyo yabo, ehlanganisa isu lebhizinisi lonyaka. Ipotfoliyo izohlinzeka ngethuba lokufaka isicelo semali ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zinkampani zizovakashelwa njalo ngababoni bezifunda abazozisiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo nokubheka imisebenzi yabo efana nokulungisa umhlabathi, ukuf planting, ukususa izitshalo, ukuchela, ukuvuna, nokumaketha. Sikholelwa ukuthi le nqubekela phambili kwezomnotho kufanele ibhekwe ngokucophelela futhi kufanele sithokozise labo abenza intuthuko. Sabe nesivumelwano sokumema abalimi abathile ukuba bajoyine i-250 Ton Club. Kukho izahluko ze-250 Ton, 500 Ton, kanye ne-1,000 Ton - siyabonga abalimi futhi sinikeze izimpawu ezikhombisa isimo sabo kulezi zinkundla. Sizama ukukhombisa ibhizinisi lokulima jikelele ukuthi kukhona inqubekela phambili emsebenzini wethu wokuhlanganisa abalimi nomnotho.
Ukusebenza Kwezikhungo Ngendlela Efanayo Nezikhwama Zokukhipha Imali (ATM) Ukusebenzisa izikhungo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zezimali kudlalwe indima ebalulekile emlandweni wezobuchwepheshe. Ukuqhamuka kwezikhungo ezisebenza njengama-ATM kwashintsha indlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Kulo mbhalo, sizogxila emlandweni wokwakhiwa kwalezi zikhungo nezinguquko zazo ezibalulekile ekwenzeni izimali zibe lula kubantu. Kuqala, sizibheka izimo ezikhona ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwama-ATM. Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1960, izindlela zokufinyelela ezimalini zazilinganiswa kakhulu. Abantu bekwazi nje ukusenga imali emabhange kuphela, okwakuhilela ukuhamba kwesikhathi okukhulu ezindaweni zokuhweba. Lokhu kwakuholela ekuphazanyisweni kwezinhlelo zempilo yansuku zonke, njengoba abantu besebenzisa isikhathi sabo esiningi beyohlola izimali zabo emabhange. Ukwakhiwa kwe-ATM kuqale ngomqondo omusha wokuthi kungani abantu kufanele bangaphinde bejikeleze emabhange uma sebekwazi ukukhipha imali ngezikhathi ezinzima. Ngonyaka we-1967, uJohn Shepherd-Barron, umphakathi waseningizimu yeNgilandi, wagcizelela le mbono. Waqala ukucabanga ngezikhungo ezizokwazi ukunika abantu imali bezingeni lokungaphazanyiswa, kwazise izikhungo ezithinta ngqo ukuhweba zazingakabi nakho ukuphendula lezi zidingo. Ngemuva kokukhishwa kokuqala kwe-ATM, kwaqhamuka enye inkinga: ukuvikeleka. Abasebenzisi babefuna ukuziqinisekisa ukuthi imali yabo iphephile. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni amadivayisi ahlakaniphile athuthukiswe, aqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuphepha zikhona ukuze zigweme ubugebengu. Ukufaka amakhodi okungena kwaba yikhono elibalulekile, okuvumela abasebenzisi ukuba babe nolwazi olwakudala ngokusebenzisa imishini enobuchwepheshe obuhle. Ekubhekaneni nezidingo ezikhulayo, ama-ATM aqhubekile nokuthuthuka. Izinhlaka eziningi zafaka izinketho zokwenza ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, njengokuhlawula izikweletu, ukwakha izinkokhelo noma ukuthola izinkampani zezimali zendawo. Lokhu kwathuthukisa umuzwa wezenhlalo, kokubili emizileni nasemiphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-ATM agcwala ezindaweni eziningi, okuhamba phambili kwezimali kwahlala kuncike kulabo ababeqhamuka nezinsizakalo ezivelele. Lokhu kwagcizelela umqondo wokuthi isikhungo sezezimali akusikho nje okwenziwa emabhange kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube nezinketho eziningi ezitholakalayo kunoma yisiphi isikhathi. Kabani, umqondo wokuthi kuhle ukuthola ulwazi lokwakha ezokuthutha, ukwehlisa isikhathi sokuxhumana nebhange elijwayelekile, waba yimpumelelo. Ukufika kwezikhungo ezisebenza ngokusemthethweni kungenza kube lula kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezingathuthukisiwe ukuthi bathole imizwa yezezimali. Lokhu kuholela ekuqhamukeni kwezinkampani ezintsha ezabhalisa izikhungo ezinzima kakhulu zokukhipha imali, ezigcwalisa izikhala ezikhona kwezokuthuthukisa. Ngesikhathi nakhu ezishayelayo, izikhungo ezinjenge-ATM zibe nezithakazelo ezivela ezinkampanini ezinkulu zezimali, futhi zashintsha izelekezo zezimali emhlabeni jikelele. Ukusebenzisa amandla ezobuchwepheshe, ama-ATM aqhubeka nokuba isehlakalo esiyinqaba sokwenza imisebenzi yezimali. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela yokuxhumana nezinhlaka eziphakeme zempilo, okuzoba nesihe esikhulu ekunciphiseni izikhalazo ezivela kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Namuhla, ukuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe kuholele emishinini ye-ATM ezizenzelayo, ethwalwa kalula kumafoni, e-inthanethi nakwenye imishini yokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoba yithuba lokulandela imikhuba entsha yezebhange, nokuhlonipha izidingo zansuku zonke zabantu. Ukusebenza kwezikhungo ngezinjongo ezinjengezikhwama zokukhipha imali kuqhubeka nokuba inhlangano eyinqaba yokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomhlaba wanamuhla. Ngakho-ke, isigaba sokugcina sokuphunguza umfutho omusha kwaholela ezintweni ezintsha, okukhombisa ukuthi izikhungo zezezimali ziphinde zikhula emhlabeni. Ukuze siqhubeke nokuqhuba nokuthuthukisa izindawo ezisebenza njenge-ATM, kuliwekuhlonipha impilo yansuku zonke yabantu, kuqinisekisa ukuthi azikho izinqezelekile ezithinta uxhumano lwemali. Muva nje, kukho imithetho eminyakeni ezayo elindeleke impumelelo eyahlukene ezindabeni zezimali, engase inikeze amandla amasha ezikhungweni zezezimali. Ukusebenza kwalesi sikhungo, njenge-ATM, kuzothatha uhlelo oluthile oluthinta empilweni yethu yonke. Ngakho, ngomlando omuhle, izikhungo ezinjenge-ATM ziqhubeka zokwenza ushintsho oluhlukile emhlabeni wezokuhweba nezimali, benza kube lula ukufinyelela ezimalini. Lokhu kwenze ukuthi abantu bangakhathazeki ngokuthi bazothola kuphi imali, kodwa ukubamba i-athikili encane ethinta impilo yabo. Ngale ndlela, inhloso yokugcina yokwakha izikhungo ngezakhiwo eziphumelela kakhulu ivumelekile, ikhipha khona kubantu abasha bejhava emuva, bebelokhu befuna izindlela ezintsha zokwakha izinkampani zabo. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwezikhungo kufanele luthandwa kakhulu, njengendlela yokukhumbula ukuthi impumelelo iyindlu eyakhelwe ukuphuma kwezimali.
UMphakathi wezobulungiswa kanye nentuthuko yeMithetho usungule lezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 30 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvikela Ukwehlukaniswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). Isicelo sokubekwa njengomqondisi obhekiswe kuso esigabeni 17 soMthetho kumele sibe sobala ngokubhalwe phezu kwefomu efana neFomu 1 enamathelwe ku-Anexure bese sithunyelwa kuMphathi-Jikelele. Ubufakazi bezincwadi zomsebenzi ezivela kubasebenzi babafakizicelo, uma zikhona; kanye namagama, amakheli, nezibalo zocingo zabantu ababili abangaxhumana nabo mayelana nesimo somfakizicelo. Ukubekwa kwabamqondisi kuncike ekuphothulweni kwemfundo ethile evunywe nguMphathi-Jikelele. UMphathi-Jikelele angabeka umuntu ukuba abe ngumqondisi isikhathi esivumelwano phakathi kukaMphathi-Jikelele nomfakizicelo, futhi umfakizicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola inani eliphelele lemali elilinganayo nenani eliphelele elamukelwe ngabamqondisi ngezizathu zokuphatha eMnyangweni. Imigomo yokubekwa komuntu njengomqondisi njengoba kuqondiswe esigabeni 1 ngenhla ifana nemigomo yokusebenza efanele umuntu obekwe njengomqondisi wecala ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuxhumana Kwabasebenzi BezeMisebenzi ka-1994, Isaziso No. 103 ka-1994. Xwayisa abafakizicelo ukuthi banelungelo lokuthola imali yokufakiza futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umfakizicelo uyasizwa ngalokhu, uma kudingeka; futhi ukuthi benza imisebenzi yomqondisi wecala ezimweni zomphakathi uma kudingeka ukuze kufezwe okukhulunywe ngakho ngumthetho. Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikhomishini ebhekiswe esigabeni 20 salo Mthetho, efuna ukulethela udaba phambi kwenkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ingakwenza lokho ngokwazisa umqondisi wecala ngenhloso yabo yokwenza lokho usebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 2 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Xwayisa umphikisi usebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 3 enamathelwe ku-Anexure, ukuthi baphikiswa; futhi ucele umphikisi ukuba ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ebhaliwe ebhekiswe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 enamathelwe ku-Anexure phakathi nezinsuku eziyishumi kusukela ngosuku abathola ngalo lesi sikhumbuzo. Umqondisi kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola impendulo evela kumphikisi obhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma ikhophi yalolu phendulo kumfakizicelo noma kumuntu owafaka udaba. Umqondisi kumele, phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, okumele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nodaba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzokwenziwa enkantolo noma ludluliselwe kwenye inkantolo. Uma umphathi ophakanyisiwe ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kumele lwenziwe enkantolo, kumele adlulisele udaba kumqondisi, okumele, phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuthola udaba, abeke usuku lokwenziwa kodaba. Umqondisi kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokwenziwa kodaba, wazise umfakizicelo nomphikisi ngaleso sikhathi sokwenziwa kodaba usebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 4 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Kumele bathumele ikhophi yesinqumo senkantolo kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kudaba; futhi bazise/benze bonke abantu abathintekayo kudaba ngezincwadi ezithunyelwe kule nkantolo ebhekiswe esigabeni a. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokwenza udaba ithole amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isikhumbuzo esibhalwe esazisa zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kudaba nomqondisi wecala ngokwamukelwa kodaba. Le nkantolo ethunyelwe udaba kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8, ithumele umbiko kumqondisi wecala, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolo daba. Uma le nkantolo ibuyisela udaba emuva enkantolo, le mbuyiselo kumele ibe sobala phezu kwefomu efana naleyo engxenyeni B yeFomu 5 enamathelwe ku-Anexure, ichaza izizathu zokuthi kungani udaba buyiselwa emuva. Inkantolo kumele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisixhenxe kusukela ngosuku udaba lubuyiselwa emuva enkantolo, iqondise ukuthi udaba luzoxoxwa kanjani. Umqondisi kumele asheshise ukuwazisa labo abathintekayo kudaba ngosuku lokwenziwa kodaba ngemihlahlandlela ngaphansi kwalezi ziqondiso ezibhekiswe esigabeni 6. Kuthunyelwa kumphikisi noma kufakwe enkantolo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela engaphathwa umphathi ophakanyisiwe. Isikhumbuzo esibhekiswe kuMthetho 66 kumele sinikezwe kumsebenzi wenkantolo noma kumqondisi kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kudaba ngokwakhe. Umuntu ofuna ukuthumela isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo ukuze avele phambi kwenkantolo kumele akwenze okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kosuku lokwenziwa kodaba, ecela umqondisi wecala ukuba alungise futhi akhiphe isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo ngokushesha. Isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo esikhiphwayo kumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 ku-Anexure. Lokhu kuyindleko yomsebenzi wenkantolo; noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ongabekwa umphathi ophakanyisiwe. Umuntu ohambisa isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo kumele aqedele ingxenye B yesigaba sesibili seFomu 6 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Ukubakhona komfakizicelo phambi kwenkantolo ngokuyalelwa kwenkantolo kwenziwa ngokuthumela leso sikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo, esikhiphwayo ngumqondisi, okumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo esibhekiswe esigabeni a kumele sithunyelwe kumfakizicelo ngumsebenzi wenkantolo ngezindleko zik 정부. Umuntu obizwayo ukuba avele phambi kwenkantolo njengomfakizicelo angacelwa ukuba akhiphe amadokhumenti athile noma amaphepha noma isitatimende noma noma yini enye ehambelana nalolo daba.
