Usweleka Kodokotela Ezibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Isimo Esikhathazayo Ezibhedlela zikahulumeni eNingizimu Afrika, kudlula eminyakeni embalwa edlule, ziye zabhekana nenkinga enkulu yokusweleka kodokotela. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, ikakhulukazi kulezi zindawo ezihluphekayo, ezithola usizo lwezempilo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kuphela. Ukuswelakala kodokotela kubonakala njengomphumela wezinselelo eziningi, ezihlanganisa izimo zokusebenza, imali ethunyelwa emnyangweni wezempilo, kanye nezimo zomsebenzi ezinzima. Izizathu Zokwehla Kwendawo Yokusebenza Okwamanje, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zibhala izikhala eziningi zokusebenza, kodwa inani lamadokotela elitholakalayo lincane kakhulu. Lokhu kubangelwa yizizathu eziningi, ezibandakanya imiholo engaphansi, izimo ezinzima zokusebenza, nezidingo eziyinkimbinkimbi zomsebenzi. Amadokotela abaningi bakhetha ukushiya izibhedlela zikahulumeni ukuze bathole amathuba angcono kwezokusebenza ezizimele noma ezizimele. Lokhu kuholela ekuphumeleleni kokusweleka kodokotela, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela usizo lwezempilo olufanele. Umthelela Kubantu Ukusweleka kodokotela kudala umphumela omkhulu ezibhedlela, njengoba iziguli zihlale zwaiting isikhathi eside ukuze zithole ukwelashwa. Lokhu kungenza kube nezimo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ezibhedlela eziphethwe kahle, lapho iziguli zikhungathekile zixhamazela ukwelashwa. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zempilo, njengoba iziguli zingatholi usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Izinyathelo Zokubhekana Nesimo Uhulumeni, ukuze abhekane nale nkinga, sebenzisa izinyathelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nokwandisa imiholo yamadokotela, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle ezibhedlela, kanye nokuthuthukisa izimo zokusebenza. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinyathelo azikakabi nemiphumela emikhulu, njengoba kudinga isikhathi ukuze kuhlanganiswe izinguquko ezizwakalayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izinyathelo zokugcina ezisemqoka zomphakathi zingase zibe nomthelela wakhe. Imiphakathi Izama Ukuzivumelanisa Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphakathi izama ukuvuselela impilo yezokwelapha, njengoba ezinye izikhungo ezingezona ezikahulumeni ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kungenza kube nokuncintisana kwezinkampani ezizimele, okungaholela ekwandeni kokuhlinzeka. Nokho, kunzima kakhulu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezinhle, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude. Isiphetho Ukusweleka kodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kube yinkinga enkulu, eyawela phansi izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Izinyathelo zikaHulumeni zidinga ukuba zikhuthazwe, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhaswa okwenele kwezokwelapha. Ngaphandle kwalokho, iziguli zizoqhubeka nokubhekana nemingcele emikhulu, okuzoholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinzima zempilo. Umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo kudinga ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo ezikhona ezibhedlela, ukuze wonke umuntu athole usizo lwezempilo olufanele.
Ukulima – Umsebenzi Wokwakha Ikusasa Ukulima, umkhakha othokozisayo nonomsebenzi omkhulu, ube yinsika yempilo emhlabeni. Ngaphandle kokulima, impilo yethu ibingeke ibe lula. Ukudla esikudlayo, imikhiqizo esiyisebenzisayo, konke kuvela ezindaweni eziliminiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi ukulima akukhona nje ukuphila, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ngiyavuma, ukulima kudinga ubuchule, uthando, kanye nesineke. Ukwazi ukuthi izinto eziningi ezithinta ukulima zishintsha ngokushesha, kubalulekile ukufaka izindlela ezintsha. Njengoba sikhula nobuchwepheshe, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukulima kwasendulo kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Abalimi bethu banele ukufundiswa ngezindlela ezihamba phambili, kodwa kufanele sihloniphe izindlela ezikhona, ezithathwa njengomlando wethu. Abalimi bethu balotshwa emlandweni, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi bahlala bezama ukugcina umkhakha ophilayo, obalulekile ekwakheni umnotho wethu. Namuhla, sithola imikhakha emisha yokulima, efana nezolimo eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke nokuba nobuchule, kodwa futhi sihloniphe izindlela zethu zendabuko. Ngakho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abasha nabadala kubalulekile. Abantu abadala banolwazi oluningi, futhi kumele sibe nokukhuluma ukuze sithole ukufunda. Ngokwenza lokhu, siza ukuvikela imvelo. Ukulima okuphumelelayo akuhlangene kuphela nokukhiqiza, kodwa futhi nokugcina imvelo. Uma sikhuluma ngezemvelo, ukudala ibhalansi phakathi kokulima nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zethu ziyahlala zikhona, kubalulekile. Umhlaba, amanzi, nemifino, konke kufanele kuhlonishwe. Ngiyavuma, ukulima namuhla kudinga ukushintsha okukhulu. Izinkinga ezinjengokushintsha kwesimo sezulu zidinga izixazululo eziphusile. Abalimi kufanele bakwazi ukujwayela izimo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kudinga ukufundisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma sicabanga ngokudla, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokunciphisa ukungcoliswa kokudla, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola okungcono emhlabeni. Esikhathini esizayo, umhlaba uzodinga abantu abanakho ukuzithiba. Abantu kufanele baziqhenye ngomsebenzi wabo, baphinde basebenzisane ukuze baphumelele. Ukulima akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa ukuhamba ngemigudu emisha, okuhloswe ngayo ukudala umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kumele kube yinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kukhona nezinkinga ezikukhathazayo, njengokungabi bikho kwezimali ezinganele ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinkinga. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi ukulima akuphili ngaphandle kokuxhaswa. Ukuze impumelelo yeze, kudinga izinsiza ezanele, imfundo, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezikahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza abalimi bazizwe behloniphekile, futhi kunciphise ubunzima obuhambisana nomsebenzi wabo. Ngokuphetha, ukulima akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa umkhankaso wokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo. Njengobo sikhuluma, kufanele sihloniphe izindlela zethu zendabuko, kodwa futhi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ukulima kudinga ukubambisana, uthando, nolwazi. Ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukwakha umhlaba ophilayo, lapho ukulima kuhlonishwa futhi kukhuthazwa. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho olukhulu, hhayi kuphela ezimpilweni zabalimi, kodwa nakwempilo yethu yonke.
Ukusebenza Kwezinkantolo: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekezwa Izinkantolo zidlala indima ebalulekile emiphakathini yethu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho uyahlonishwa futhi ubulungiswa buyatholakala kubo bonke. Ukusebenza kwezinkantolo, ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zifanele, ziqondile, futhi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzogxila ezicini ezahlukene zokusebenza kwezinkantolo, kuhlanganise nezinsiza, izinqubo, kanye nemiphumela yokusebenza kwazo. Izinsiza Nezisebenzi Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezinkantolo. Izinkantolo zidinga izinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izakhiwo, izinsiza zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezisebenzi ezifanele. Uma izinkantolo zinganikezwa izinsiza ezanele, kungenzeka ukuthi zibe nezinselelo ekuphathweni kwezindaba. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni anikeze uxhaso olufanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinkantolo zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Izisebenzi ezisebenza ezinkantolo, njengezikhulu, abameli, nabahlali, zidlala indima enkulu ekuphathweni kwezindaba. Ukuze izinkantolo zisebenze kahle, kumele kube nezisebenzi ezinamakhono, ezihloniphekile, nezizimisele. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo nokuthuthukiswa kwezisebenzi kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihlala zisesikhathini ngezinguquko zomthetho nezidingo zomphakathi. Izindlela Zokusebenza Okwesibili, izinqubo zokusebenza kwezinkantolo zidinga ukuba ziqinile futhi ziqondile. Ukuze izinkantolo zikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha ezicelweni zabantu, izinqubo kumele zibe lula futhi ziqondakale. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqubo zokufaka izicelo, ukuhamba kwezindaba, kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo kumele zibe lula ukuze abantu bangabhekana nezinkinga zabo ngaphandle kokudideka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkantolo kufanele zibe nezinqubo eziphusile zokubuyekeza izinqumo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uma umuntu enganelisekile ngesinqumo, unelungelo lokubuyekeza. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izinkantolo kumele zibe nezinqubo ezicacile zokubuyekeza, ezizokwenza kube lula kubantu ukufaka izicelo zabo. Imiphumela Yokusebenza Okwesithathu, imiphumela yokusebenza kwezinkantolo ibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Uma izinkantolo zisebenza kahle, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe umthetho. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuthula emphakathini, njengoba abantu bezwa ukuthi izinkantolo zikhona ukuze zivikela amalungelo abo. Uma abantu bekwazi ukuthi izinkantolo zisebenza kahle, bazoba nesithakazelo sokubamba iqhaza ezinqubweni zomphakathi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma izinkantolo zingasebenzi kahle, kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphenduke ezindleleni ezingekho emthethweni ukuze bafune ubulungiswa. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenza kwezinkantolo kudinga ukuba kube phezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi uhlangabezana nezidingo zawo. Izixazululo Nezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwezinkantolo, kudingeka izixazululo ezithile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwandisa izinsiza, ukuthuthukisa izinqubo, kanye nokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabantu ezinkantolo. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinkantolo, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa, ezifana nezinsizakalo zokweluleka ezitholakala kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi bezinkantolo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi bahlale bephendula ezidingweni zomphakathi. Ukuze izinkantolo zikwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinkantolo, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukusebenza kwezinkantolo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthetho uyahlonishwa futhi ubulungiswa buyatholakala kubo bonke. Izinsiza, izinqubo, kanye nemiphumela yokusebenza kwezinkantolo kudinga ukuba kube phezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila ngaphansi komthetho. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izixazululo ezithile zidingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwezinkantolo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu, sikhuthaze ukuthula, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo.
Izins challenges zempilo: Ukubuka Okuhlangene Uhlanga lwempilo luhlobene nezinkinga ezahlukene ezivame ukubhekana nazo abantu. Konke kuqala empilweni yethu, lapho uma sithola ubudala, simukela izinselelo eziningi ezilokhu zikhona. Izinselelo zempilo zingaba yizinkinga zomuntu siqu, izinkinga zokusebenza, noma izinselelo zempilo yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nendlela yokubhekana nezinkinga zempilo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlala siphila impilo enempilo futhi eyanelisayo. Isimo sokuphila nokubhekana nezinselelo Okokuqala, kudingeka siqonde ukuthi isimo sokuphila singaba nethonya elikhulu ezinselelweni zempilo. Emiphakathini ethile, ukungabi nalwazi olufanele, izinsiza zokunakekela impilo, noma izimo zomnotho ezinzima kuba yizinto ezithinta ukuphila kwabantu. Izimo ezinjalo zenza kube nzima ekugethweni kwesixazululo, futhi zikhokelela ekwandeni kwezifo, ukufutshane komphakathi, kanye nokwanda kwamacala okudangala. Isimo esinjalo singenza abantu babe nezingcindezi ezingavumi bona, begcwele ubuhlungu bemizwa. Ukwamukela izinselelo njengengxenye yokukhula Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zempilo ngezinye izikhathi zifaka nethuba lokukhula. Noma lokhu kungase kubonakale njengokungajabulisi, ikakhulukazi uma sibhekana nezimo ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi izinselelo zingasetshenziswa njengendlela yokuwina amandla. Ukubhekana nezinkinga zempilo kungaba yindlela yokubona amandla ethu okuphila, sithole ukukhula okungaphakathi. Izifundo ezitholakala ezimpilweni zethu zifana nemithiya ebalulekile ekuphuhliseni abantu. Asifuni ukungena engozini yokukhula kuphela, kodwa futhi sibe nezindlela zokwakha imibono ecacile kanye nemigomo. Ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nokweseka Ukuxhumana nokweseka abanye kusho ukufaka isandla ezimweni ezinzima. Izinselelo zempilo zingenza kube nzima ukubhekana, kodwa khumbula ukuthi awuwedwa. Ukuxhumana nabantu abakuzungezile, kungaba ngabangani, amalungu omndeni, noma ozakwethu, kungenza kube lula ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuphawula, ukusizwa, noxolo kungaba nezithelo ezinhle emzimbeni nasemoyeni. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuzwana nokweseka kungakhulisa amandla empilo, futhi kuchaze indlela yokufeza izimpumelelo. Inselelo yokuphumelela nokukhula Ekuqedeni, kubalulekile ukuthi sithole izindlela zokuphumelela ngisho nezins challenges zempilo. Inselelo enkulu ihlale ikuphi ekuthumeleni emakhaya amaningi, lapho abantu bahlala bephokophele ekubeni abantu abaphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuba siqonde izinselelo zethu futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele, ukuze sithole izixazululo. Yingakho i-mentality yokuthola amathuba ukuze uhlose ukuthuthuka ibaluleke kakhulu. Noma izinselelo zempilo zithinta zonke izimpilo, ukuphila okubunjwe ngendlela eqondile kuyoba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokuzenzela uzimele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo zempilo zingaholela ekwakheni umbono ophusile nokufunda izinto ezibalulekile. Njengoba sithola amandla okuphila, sizoba nokuzimisela lokho okuhlangene, sibe abantu abangcono. Ngaleyondlela, sizokwenza siphile kwemvelo, sithole imfundo ebanzi ngezinselelo zempilo, futhi sibe yizibonelo ezinhle zokusebenza emiphakathini yethu. Izins challenges zempilo akuzona nje izinkinga, kodwa ziyinsiza yokukhula komuntu siqu, kanti lokho kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Isiphetho: Ukuhlonipha izinselelo zempilo Izins challenges zempilo ziyingxenye yomjikelezo wokuphila. Kubalulekile ukuthi siwubheke kanje: izinselelo azikwazi ukwehlukaniswa nempilo, kodwa ziyingxenye yethu. Ukuhlonipha lezi zins challenges futhi sizithathele izifundo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthuke, kuyisimo esibalulekile sokwakha impilo enamandla. Ekugcineni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi empilweni, ukuhamba ngendlela yokuthuthuka nokuxhumana, kuzoqhubeka kugcizelela uqobo lwethu noshintsho njengoba sisoze saphuma ezinselelweni zempilo.
Ezobuchwepheshe Beselula: Ukuguqulwa Kwezimpilo Zethu Kusukela ekubukeni okubukekayo okwenziwa abantu bethu, ubuchwepheshe beselula buvele baphendula izimpilo zethu ngendlela engakaze ibonakale. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, futhi sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana, ubuchwepheshe beselula buyaqhuba ekwakheni umhlaba omusha. Ngiyazizwa ngothando nangenjabulo ngalokhu, kodwa njalo kunezinkinga ezithile ezidinga ukuhlohla. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela ubuchwepheshe beselula obusishintshile ngayo umhlaba wethu. Ucingo lweselula, oluqala njengomsebenzi wesimanje, sekuphenduke ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yethu. Manje, singakwazi ukuxhumana nabantu abahlukahlukene, sithumele imiyalezo, noma sikhulume ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kuxhumana okungapheli kudale umphakathi ophilayo, wonke umuntu ekwazi ukuthola ulwazi olulandelayo, okukhuthaza ukuhweba, ukufunda, ningakukholwa! Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu busezingeni eliphezulu, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe beselula bufundisa izingane namathalente amasha. Ukuze umuntu aziwa kahle emsebenzini, udinga ukuba nekhono lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuze kube sezingeni, abezindaba, abathengisi, kanye nosomabhizinisi bahlale befuna abaqeqeshwayo abakhetha ukuphila beselula. Lokhu kumele kufunywe kumakhaya nasezindaweni zokufunda. Kukhona umuzwa owengeziwe wokuthi ubuchwepheshe bufundisa abantu ukuba babe nokuqonda okwengeziwe kwezokuxhumana, benza ukuthi kube nezinselelo eziningi ezingaholela ekuphumeleleni. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngalezi zinhlelo ezithokozisayo, kudingeka sikhumbule nezinselele ezithile ezithinta ubuchwepheshe beselula. Okwaziyo kakhulu, ubuxhakaxhaka bensuku zonke businika izinselele ezinzima. Ukuvula izinsiza eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo, okukhona ezigijimayo, nakuba zidinga ukubonwa ngokujulile, zishiya abanye bengaphumeleli, ngaphandle kokukwazi ukugcina isikhala esifanele. Ubufakazi balokhu buvele kahle emiphumeleni yokungabikho kwamakhono avamile emiphakathini yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe beselula bukhombisa izinselele zokuphepha. Njengoba siba namafoni ahlakaniphile, ukuzwelonke kwethu kuvezwa kalula ezinkingeni ezinjengokuphephisa idatha, izinsizakalo, noma ukubandakanyeka ekuhloleni. Imiphakathi yethu idinga ukuziqhenya nokuqonda kahle izinsiza ezikhona. Yiqiniso, ubuchwepheshe beselula bulethe izinzuzo, kodwa zibheka futhi izindlela zokuvikela izimpilo zethu nokuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezikhona. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umnotho wethu uxhunywe nezobuchwepheshe beselula. Uhlelo lokusebenza lokuphayona, amabhizinisi amaningi asebenzisa izinhlelo zezelula ukudala imikhiqizo noma amasevisi amasha. Ukuhweba online kudinga amafoni afanele, futhi lokho kudale amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kusebenza ekwakheni imikhakha ehlukene, okwenza ukuthi umnotho wethu ube namandla, futhi ungeqiniso ukuxhomeka kakhulu ezobuchwepheshe. Kungaba nomthelela omuhle, kodwa kumele ndawonye sihloniphe izinhlelo ezimeni ezingama-bubble. Ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngempela ngalezi zinkinga, indlela esibona ngayo ubuchwepheshe beselula kuze kube yinkathazo, iguqula imicabango yethu ngokuqhubekayo. Siphila emhlabeni wesimo se-digital, futhi lokho kuyashintsha indlela esicabanga ngayo, sikhuluma ngayo, sithokozisa ngayo. Ukuthola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe beselula buyaqhubeka ngokuphathelene nezimpilo zethu, lokho kumele kube nomthelela omuhle. Ubulungiswa, ubudlelwano, kanye nekhono lokwazisa abanye kuyinto engapheli. Ekugcineni, ubuchwepheshe beselula buyinselele engapheli. Njengoba sithola ubuchwepheshe obusha, kufanele sibuye sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi wethu ungenza izinqumo ezahlukene. Ukuze sikhulise umnotho wethu, kufanele sihlole nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ubuchwepheshe beselula bungomunye wezinsizakalo ezinkulu zezisombululo, kodwa kumele kuhlale kuphumelele izimfuno zomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi, ngifuna ukufuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe beselula ukuze sithole umphakathi obumbene futhi ozinza. Kulabo abathintekayo, kumele sikhulume ngezinkomba ezilungile zomphakathi. Ubuchwepheshe beselula bungumgibeli omuhle, kodwa sekuyisikhathi sokuba kudalwe ingxoxo eyhlabeni ukuze sikhumbule impilo yempilo yokujabulela ubuchwepheshe levuka. Sihamba phambili, kodwa kumele sibone umphakathi wethu, nintlilaze ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa ezijabulisayo. Sihamba phambili, kodwa kumele sikhumbule impilo yethu futhi sizame ukufinyelela izinjongo ezigcwele phezulu.
Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokudla, ikakhulukazi kwezinto ezivamile ukudliwa, kube nokukhathazeka kubathengi ezinyangeni ezedlule, futhi bakhathazekile ngokukhuphuka kwezindleko zebhodi. Kuthiwa izizathu zokukhuphuka kwentengo zidalwe ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zezimpahla zokulima emhlabeni jikelele kanye nokuntuleka kwalezi zinto ezweni lethu. Lapho kuqhathaniswa umkhawulo wentengo yeSafex kanye nomkhawulo wentengo yephansi ezinyangeni ezedlule, kubonakala ukuthi intengo yempuphu ikhuphukile kakhulu kunezindleko zebhodi (Ithrekhi 1). Kucacile ukuthi izindleko zokudla kungenzeka ziqhubeke nokukhuphuka ezinyangeni ezizayo. Abathengi njengamanje bahlupheka, kodwa kubonakala sengathi bangase babhekane nezimo ezimbi kakhulu esikhathini esizayo. Ithrekhi 1: Umkhawulo wentengo yephansi kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye neStatistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi yeSagis). Ingxenye yezindleko zokudla ezitholakala ezolimini ikwenze abaningi abanolwazi bakholelwe ukuthi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kubiza kancane futhi kukhiqiza inzuzo enkulu. Abalimi abaphumelele eminyakeni edlule ngokugcina bephila emaphandleni ngesikhathi esinzima ngenxa yezindleko eziphansi nezomiso, njengamanje baphumula kancane. Nokho, uma sicabangela ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima, ukwehla kwezindleko zokudla kungase kube iphupho kuphela. Ithrekhi 2 ikhombisa ukuthi phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi kuka-2004 no-2007, intengo yempuphu ayihambelani nokukhuphuka kwezindleko ze-diesel nezokufaka - lokhu akukaze kube yinto eqhubekayo. Izindleko eziphansi ezikhokhelwa abakhiqizi kanye nokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima kube nomthelela omkhulu kubalimi abaningi ukuba bayeke ukutshala ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu akusiyo isimo esihle uma sicabanga ngekusasa labalimi abasha - ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kube nenzuzo ukuze abalimi abasha baqale futhi baqhubeke nokulima. Ukukhuphuka kwamanje kwezindleko zokudla kube nomthelela omubi kubalimi, kodwa ukukhuphuka kwezindleko kube nomfutho omkhulu kubo - abalimi bathola kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo uma befuna ukwenza inzuzo. Ithrekhi 2: Umkhawulo wentengo yokufaka, i-diesel, kanye nempuphu kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye neStatistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi yeSagis). Ithrekhi 3 ikala umkhawulo wentengo wezindleko zokufaka ezifana ne-diesel nezokufaka uma kuqhathaniswa nentengo yephansi kanye nempuphu. Kucacile ukuthi abalimi bahlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima uma kuqhathaniswa nezindleko zokudla ezikhathazayo kubathengi. Intengo yokuthengisa yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele isebenze kahle ukuze kukhiqizwe ukudla okuningi ngokuhambisana nezindleko zokuqala zokufaka - ngaphandle kwalokhu, abathengi bazopresswa ukuba bakhokhe kakhulu ukudla. Ithrekhi 3: Umkhawulo wentengo yephansi emhlophe, impuphu, yokufaka, kanye ne-diesel kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye neStatistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi yeSagis). Impela, ukukhuphuka okukhulu kwezindleko zokudla kwezinto ezivamile ukudliwa kudalwe ukwehluleka kuk gouvernement ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezifanele zokulima, futhi ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni wehluleka ukusebenzisa lezi zinhlelo ezikhona isikhathi eside. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) abakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla ukuze kudle abantu emhlabeni wethu bodwa - badinga usizo olufanele kuhulumeni.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Ukhetho lukazwelonke yisigameko esibalulekile emlandweni nasempilweni yomphakathi. Lezi zinkulumo ezibucayi zikhuluma ngokwakha izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwabantu nezwe ikakhulukazi. Ngaphambi kokuba siqonde kahle ukuthi ukhetho lukazwelonke lusebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi luhlanganisa izici eziningi, kusukela ekuhlelweni, ekukhethweni, nasekuphathweni kwemiphumela. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinqubomgomo Ukhetho lukazwelonke luhamba phambili ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza nezinhlelo zokuphila kwabantu. Ukuze lokhu kukhule, izinhlelo zokusungula izinqubomgomo zidinga ukuhamba phambili. Izinhlelo zihlala ziqhuba ngokuhlanganyela, kuhlanganiswe imiphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze izinqubomgomo zibe neqhaza elihle mustazwe ngokuqonda izidingo zomphakathi. Ukweseka Ukhetho Ukuze ukhetho lube neqhaza, kudingeka kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle kubavoti. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhethwa kwezikhumbuzo, izikhangiso, nezinkundla zokuxhumana ezikhuluma ngemicabango emisha. Izinhlaka eziphakathi, njengezikhungo zokuphatha ukhetho, zenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukusabalalisa, nokuvikela ukhetho. Izinyathelo Zokhetho Lapho sekusondela isikhathi sokhetho, abantu bahlukahlukene bazobamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusungulwa kwezinsuku zokhetho, ukuhlinzeka ngama-ballot, kanye nezikhungo zokuvota. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zokuvota zikhona kuwo wonke amandla, ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukuvota ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Imiphumela Nokubika Ngemuva kokuvota, imiphumela iyahlaziywa futhi ibikwa. Izinhlaka ezisemthethweni ziqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ibhalwe phansi kahle, ukuze kube nokukhanya nokuthembeka. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwaziswa ngemiphumela yokhetho, futhi baqonde ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zinegunya elivela emiphumeleni. Ukwamukela Imiphumela Umphakathi kufanele wamukele imiphumela yokhetho, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ophumelelayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, abaholi, nezikhungo zomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyahlanganyela ekwakheni ikusasa elihle. Ukuhlonishwa kwemiphumela kubalulekile ekwakheni izinga lokwethembana phakathi kwabantu nezinhlaka eziphethe. Ukwakhiwa Kwezakhamizi Ukhetho lungumkhankaso owakha izakhamuzi ezinobuhlakani, ezithintekayo, nezizimele. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlela imicimbi yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi, ukufundisa abantu ngamalungelo abo, kanye nokubazisa ngemicabango emisha. Uma abantu bejabulela ukhetho, bakwazi ukusungula umphakathi onempilo. Isiphetho Ukhetho lukazwelonke aluwona nje umcimbi, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha isizwe esinempilo. Ngalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi silwele ukhetho olukhululekile, olungcono, nolwaziyo. Ukuqonda, ukufunda, nokuthatha icala kulezi zinyathelo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu nomphakathi jikelele. Umphakathi wonke kufanele uvote, ubambe iqhaza, futhi ube neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukhetho lukazwelonke lukhombisa amandla abantu, uthando, nokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle.
Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi - kwenzekani uma kuqhutshwa ukutshala? Izindawo ezisebenzisa amanzi kanye nenani lawo amanzi kunikezwa nguMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka. Izibalo ezivela ku-2000 zizolandela. Inani lamanzi likalwa ngama miliyoni emitha cube asetshenziswe ngonyaka. Ngokubheka lokhu, kuyacaca ukuthi ukutshala ezolimo kudla uhhafu wamanzi atholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, singasho ukuthi isibalo sabantu ezweni lethu sizokhula sibe ngaphezulu kwezigidi eziyi-47. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sikhungo sezolimo sizobanjwa ngengcindezi yokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, futhi ukukhiqiza ukudla kuphela. Ochwepheshe bathi ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi lapha eNingizimu Afrika sekuhamba phambili - uma kudingeka ukuthuthuka okwengeziwe ngale ndlela, kuzobiza imali eningi. Kungenzeka kube nezinkambu ezithile ezingu-1.3 miliona zamafamu anokutshala eNingizimu Afrika okwamanje, kodwa kungenzeka kube nezinkambu ezingu-233,600 ezisasele ezingasetshenziswa ngale ndlela. Bakholwa ukuthi izinkambu ezingu-178,000 zizokwazi ukusetshenziswa esikhathini esizayo ngenxa yenkinga yokuntula amanzi okuthembekile, angase angatholakali.
Ukwakheka Kwezikhungo Okulungele Abasebenzisi: Ingxoxo NoMnu. Mthembu Isingeniso Namuhla, sizobe sikhuluma noMnu. Mthembu, ongenza kahle emkhakheni wezokwakha, futhi ungumeluleki ophumelelayo ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezibhekana nezidingo zabantu. Izikhungo ezifanele abasebenzisi zibaluleke kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi wonke ungathokozela izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo. Ngizokhuluma noMnu. Mthembu ukuze sithole umbono wakhe kulolu daba oluwusizo. Uqala Kodwa Kanjani? Ngiyabingelela, Mnu. Mthembu. Kuhle ukukuhlangabeza. Ngithanda ukuqala ngombuzo ophathelene nokuqala kokwakhiwa kwezikhungo. Ucabanga ukuthi kungani kubalulekile ukuhlela izikhungo ngezinto ezikhethekile zabantu? UMnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukwakheka kwezikhungo kumele kuhloniphe izidingo zabantu, unganqikazi. Lokhu kuhilela ukukhetha izinzuzo ezifanele, izikhala ezikahle zokusebenza, kanye neziqu zempilo ezithola ukuhlela kahle. Uma izikhungo zikhuluma ngezidingo zabasebenzisi, zifeza umsebenzi wazo, zigcine zisezingeni eliphezulu. Izinselelo Abazibona Kubantu Ekhaya Iqiniso kufanele kuxoxwe ngalezi zinto. Ziningi izinselelo abantu ababhekana nazo ezikhungwini, ikakhulukazi labo abanezimfuno ezikhethekile. Ucabangani ngalokhu? UMnu. Mthembu: Yebo, lezi zinsolo zikhona. Abantu abanezimfuno ezikhethekile, njengezinyathelo zothando, izimpawu zokukhubazeka, noma ezinye izimo zempilo, kufanele bakwazi ukusebenzisa izikhungo ngaphandle kokuthola ubunzima. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakheka kwezikhala ezivulelekile, izinsiza ezifanele, nemithombo ebonisa izindlela ezingcono zokuhamba. Lokhu kwakha ukuzinza ebantwini. Umqondo Wezikhungo Ezenzakalelayo Sikhuluma ngezinselelo, kodwa ngabe uthanda ukusigcizelela ukuthi yini eyenza izikhungo zibe ngcono? UMnu. Mthembu: Ngokuqinisekileyo. Umqondo wezikhungo ezenzakalelayo ubalulekile. Lokhu kuhilela izinhlelo ezingemuva ezisebenzayo. Izikhungo ezenzakalayo zikhuthaza ukusizakala kwalezi zinsizakusebenza, zigcine zonke izinsiza zomphakathi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kusiza imiphakathi ukuthi ibambelele ekutheni kube nesimo esihle. Izindlela Zokubandakanya Abasebenzisi Uthanda ukusho ukuthi ukuqhakambisa abasebenzisi kubaluleke kangakanani ohlelweni lokwakha izikhungo? UMnu. Mthembu: Hhayi, akusho nje ukuthi kuyinkqubo yokwakha – ukubandakanya abasebenzisi kumqondo wobuchwepheshe nasemakhosini amasha. Lokhu kuhilela ezintweni ezinjengemibuzo, izincwadi zokubuyekeza nezivumelwano, ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu. Ukuze silungise izikhungo, kufanele sicabangele imicabango nezidingo zabantu, njengoba kunqoba isithombe esibanzi sokwakha. Ukwakha Uzwelo NoMbango Ngabe uyabheka ukuhlonishwa kolwazi noshintsho uma sikhuluma ngabantu ngaphakathi? UMnu. Mthembu: Yebo, kudinga ukuqaphela çokuvumela izindlela ezamukelekayo. Lokhu kungenza kube khona umuzwa wokubambisana. Amathuba okuxhumana phakathi kwabathintekayo kufanele abe kwazulu, ukuze abantu bezwe umphumela wabo, ngokwakha izikhungo ezithokozisayo, ezihloniphekayo. Ikhono Lokubandakanya Yolwazi Nomasu Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi iminyango efanele ihlola lezi zimo? UMnu. Mthembu: Ngempela, kufanele kuqiniswe iminyango yokubambisana nezikhungo. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokwenza ucwaningo olunembile, kube nentuthuko enezizathu ezivumiwe. Isakhiwo esiyindida sinezindlela ezibalulekile, ngakho siphakamisa imizamo yokuhlelwa kwabantu. Lokhu kunciphisa ukujolisa okungenalutho. Isiphetho Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle okukhulume ngaso. Akukhona okwenzekile, kodwa sizama ukuhamba phambili, simathisele umoya ophephile. Ngiyabuka phambili kulwazi olukhulu ohlanganyele nathi lamuhla. UMnu. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngithemba lokhu kuzovula izingxoxo eziningi ezenzakalayo zokwakha ikusasa elifanele. Izikhungo ozenzayo zibalulekile, futhi singabamba iqhaza ekwakheni izikhungo ezibhekelele imihla ngemihla yethu. Ngiyabonga. Uphiko Lwengxoxo Ukukhuluma noMnu. Mthembu kungenze ngiqonde kabanzi ngokwakheka kwezikhungo okulungele abasebenzisi. Ukubandakanya abathintekayo kube yisinyathelo esiphumelelayo esihloniphekayo, okwakha izikhungo ezithuthukile nezilungele wonke umphakathi. Lokhu kuyathakazelisa kakhulu, futhi kuthinta impilo yabo bonke abantu. Ngiyethemba le ngxoxo izovuselela imibono emisha nokuqhubeka kokwakhiwa kwezikhungo ezizokwenza umehluko emiphakathini yethu.
Ukwenza izilinganiso zokusebenza zonyaka: Ukwenza izilinganiso zokusebenza zonyaka njengengxenye yokuhlola umsebenzi kwenziwa ekupheleni komjikelezo wokusebenza. Imiphumela yalezi zilinganiso ifaka zonke izilinganiso zokusebenza zabasebenzi zonyaka phakathi komjikelezo wokusebenza. Ithuluzi lokuhlola: Ithuluzi lokuhlola lisetshenziselwa ukuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngamunye mayelana nokufeza izindawo ezibalulekile zokuphumelela kanye nomongo wezindlela zokuphatha ezihambisana nezithuluzi zokuhlola ezifanele njengoba ziqukethwe esivumelwaneni sokusebenza. Ukuqonda: Ukuqonda (njengengxenye yokusebenza) kuvame ukuchazwa njengokuba nezinhloso ezinhle, ubuntu, nokuzazi. Ukuze kube nekhono: kuhambisana nekhono lomsebenzi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomsebenzi (ukuba nekhono lomsebenzi). Ikhono lokusebenza: Ikhono lokusebenza kuyinhlanganisela yolwazi, amakhono, nokusebenza okudingekayo ukuze umuntu enze umsebenzi kahle. Isilinganiso sokuhlola esiqinisekisiwe: Ukuhlola okuphelele komsebenzi oqinisekiswe yiKomidi Lezokuphatha Eliphezulu (bona futhi izilinganiso eziqinisekisiwe nezihlinzekwayo). Amakhono Okuphatha Abalulekile (CMC): Ingxenye yolwazi, ikhono, noma amandla ku-SMS PMDS ahlobene ngqo nokusebenza emsebenzini, athinta amalungu e-SMS. Abathengi: Abantu bobabili ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango abaxhumana nabasebenzi bomnyango ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo. Umnyango: Umnyango njengoba uchazwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, 1994. Ukuthuthukiswa: Imisebenzi yoktraining nokuthuthukiswa ehlose ukuthuthukisa ikhono lomsebenzi wabasebenzi nokuthuthukisa amazinga okusebenza. Igunya Eliphezulu: Ngokuqondene nomnyango, imisebenzi noma izinhlangano zikamasipala, uMongameli, uNdunankulu, noma ilungu leKhansela Eliphezulu/UMphathiswa. Impendulo: Ulwazi olunomgomo nolwakho olunikezwa nguMphathi/umqondisi mayelana nokusebenza komsebenzi mayelana nezilindelo nezindinganiso ezibekwe, eziqondwa ngabasebenzi, futhi ezihloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Isici Sokuhlola Esijwayelekile: Into esetshenziselwa ukuchaza nokuhlola izingxenye zokusebenza, ihlola ulwazi, amakhono, nezinga lomsebenzi. Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo: Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzi kuMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, ezashicilelwa yiKomidi Lezikhungo Zomphakathi kuGazethi Kahulumeni R 1012 elandela umhla zingu-25 kuJuni 2003, Gazethi Kahulumeni No. 25209. Uhlaka lweMithetho Yokuphakanyiswa: Izinga lempesheni 1 kuya ku-12: DPSA 1/7/1/4/1, elandela umhla zingu-27 kuJanuwari 2003: "Ukusebenza kohlelo lwezokuphakanyiswa oluhlobene nezinhlelo zokuphatha zokusebenza zomnyango ezikhona ezingeni lempesheni 1 kuya ku-12." Uhlelo Lokuphathwa Kokusebenza Nokuthuthukiswa (IPMDS): Uhlelo lokuphatha ukusebenza olwakhiwe yiDPSA ngo-2003 ukuze lusetshenziswe ngokukhululeka kuMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi. Indawo Yokuphumelela Ebalulekile (KRA): Ingxenye yomsebenzi lapho ukusebenza kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokusebenza zomnyango, izinhloso, nezinhloso. Ukulawula: Ukuhlola izilinganiso zokuhlola zabasebenzi okwenziwa yiKomidi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nokulingana phakathi kwezingxenye zomnyango ngokulandela ukuqonda okufanayo kwezinga lokusebenza elidingekayo kuzo zonke izigaba zokuhlola ukuze kusizakale ekuthobeleni isidingo sokuthi izindleko ze-bonus zingadluli ku-1.5 percent ye-bhajethi yemiholo. Uhlelo lomsebenzi (noma uhlelo lwebhizinisi): Uhlelo lweminyaka elandela futhi lwenza uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokusebenza lube sebenzayo ngokucacisa izinhloso zezinhlelo zokusebenza ezichazwe kuhlelo lokusebenza njengengxenye yeziphumo ezibalulekile nemisebenzi ebonakalayo, yonyaka othile womnyango, amaBranji, amaDirekhtha, namaDirektha. Umphumela: Isitatimende esibanzi mayelana nenhloso ethile, inhloso, noma umphumela ohlosiwe, odinga ukwenza okukodwa noma okuningi ukuze kuqedwe ngempumelelo. Ukufeza: Umphumela onejazi noma impumelelo (okungukuthi, umkhiqizo, izenzo, noma umsebenzi) ohlanganyela empumelelweni yendawo yokuphumelela ebalulekile. Okufanele kwenziwe. Izinga lokusebenza: Umsebenzi owenziwa ngabantu ufaka (1) izenzo zomsebenzi kanye (2) umphumela noma umthelela walezo zenzo. Ukusebenza kuyinqubo eqhubekayo lapho izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, ephumelelayo, futhi enenzuzo ukuze kukhiqizwe imiphumela ehambelana nezidingo zesikhathi, izinga, kanye nenani futhi ethinta noma ibangelwa yizenzo noma ukuziphatha komuntu osebenza enqubo yokusebenza eqhubekayo. Isivumelwano sokusebenza: Idokhumenti evunyelwene ngayo futhi eyasayinwa ngumsebenzi nomqondisi wabo, ifaka incazelo yomsebenzi, izindawo ezikhethiweyo ze-KRA, ne-GAF, uhlelo lomsebenzi, kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi. Izincomo/ukuhlola kwezinga lokusebenza: Ukulinganisa, ukuhlola, izilinganiso, noma izincomo mayelana nokusebenza komsebenzi. Inqubo yokuhlola yokusebenza yonyaka ivamise ukubizwa njengencazelo noma ukuhlola kokusebenza, kanti eyingxenye engazwakali ibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlolwa kokusebenza. Uhlelo lwezinga lokusebenza: Isikhathi esiyiminyaka eyi-12 esihlelwe sokusebenza, ukuphathwa, nokuhlola. Kumele kuhambisane nesikhathi esifanayo njengohlelo lokusebenza lweminyaka yomnyango, olusuka ku-1 kuMbasa kuya ku-31 kuNdasa wonyaka olandelayo. Izikhuthazo zokusebenza: Ukuhlangana (a) kwemiklomelo yezezimali ehambisana nemiphumela yokusebenza okuhlinzekwayo, kuhlanganisa nezinyuso zemiholo, ama-bonus wokusebenza, kanye (b) ezinye izikhuthazo ezahlukene ezingase zibe khona ohlelweni lwezikhuthazo zokusebenza zomnyango. Uhlelo lwezikhuthazo zokusebenza: Uhlelo lomnyango oluhlobene nokuphakanyiswa kokusebenza oluhambisana nohlelo lwakho lokuphatha ukusebenza, olwakhiwe ngokuhambisana ne-PSR 1/VIII F no-G. Isikhombisi sezinga lokusebenza: Isilinganiso esisetshenziselwa ukuhlola ukuthi impumelelo ingakanani efinyelelwe kulokho okufanele kwenziwe (ukwakhiwa kwemigomo, ukuhlinzeka ngethuba, ukusabalalisa imisebenzi). Ukuphathwa kokusebenza: Uhlelo olunomgomo, oluqhubekayo oluhlose ukuphatha nokuthuthukisa ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zezinhlelo zokusebenza; ukuthola imisebenzi efanele kanye nokuhlola nokubona ukuqala kwemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuphumelelayo nokufanele; futhi kuyindlela yokuthuthukisa imiphumela emnyangweni, emaqenjini, nakwabanye ngokuphatha ukusebenza ngokuhambisana nezinhloso, izinhloso, amazinga, nezikhuthazo ezivunyelwene ngazo. Uhlelo lokuphatha ukusebenza: Uhlaka oluvunywa lokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, oluhlanganisa uhlelo lwezokuphatha kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene nazo zonke izici zomjikelezo wokusebenza, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukusebenza nezivumelwano, ukuqapha ukusebenza, ukuhlola, nokulawula; ukuhlinzeka ngezincazelo zokusebenza nokuphatha kanye nokuphatha imiphumela yezincazelo. Izinga Lokusebenza: Izindlela zokuvumelana ngezinga lokuchaza umsebenzi ngezikhathi, izindleko, nezinga
Ngifuna ukukwazisa ngendaba ethokozisayo mayelana neTheku. Ngiyazi ukuthi ungathanda ukuyazi, ngoba iTheku iyindawo egcwele impilo, isiko, nemigudu yokuhlola. Ngizokhuluma ngempilo yansuku zonke, izindawo ezinhle, namathuba ahlukeneyo okwenza izinto ezahlukene. Uma uhlela ukuhamba eThekwini, ungakhetha phakathi kwezitimela, izithuthi zomphakathi, noma ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Umoya weTheku uthokozisa, futhi uma uhamba ezitaladini, uzobona abantu abahlukene, imiphakathi, nemisebenzi ehlukahlukene. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi, izindonga ezinezithombe zokwakha, nemigwaqo engama-pavement, konke lokhu kudala umoya omuhle. ITheku iyindawo yokuhlangana, lapho ungahlangana khona nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nabase-Afrika nabavela kwamanye amazwe. Kodwa akujabuli nje umoya, kufanele sikhulume ngamasiko. Uthando lwamasiko lukhanya uma ubona abantu bejabula emishadweni, ezinkonzweni, nasemijukujukwini. ITheku inezinkonzo eziningi, okusho ukuthi ungakuhlala ubona izigigaba, imicimbi, namathonya amakhulu. Uthanda ukudla? Kulungile, iTheku inezindawo zokudlela ezihlukahlukene, lapho ungathola khona ukudla kwamasiko ahlukene. Uthanda izindawo ezinhle? ITheku inezindawo eziningi ezinhle. Uthanda ogwini? Tye! Uthanda amajuba? ITheku inezindawo ezibhalwe kahle, futhi ungathola izindawo ezinhle zokuphumula. I-Beachfront iyindawo edumile, futhi ungathokozisa lapho uhleli phansi, ubuka abantu, noma udlala emanzini. Uma ufuna ukuvuselela umoya, ungavakashela eShaka Marine World, lapho ungafunda khona ngempilo yasemanzini, ubuke ama-saquiatters, futhi uthokozise ngezinto ezahlukene. Lezi zindawo zenza iTheku ibe yindawo ethokozisayo yokuvakasha, futhi abavakashi bavame ukubuyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iTheku inemithombo eminingi yokuhlola. I-Old Fort, i-Durban Botanic Gardens, kanye ne-Moses Mabhida Stadium konke kuhle kakhulu. Ungavakashela lezi zindawo, uzithokozise, futhi ube neziqiniseko ezinhle. I-Old Fort ibalulekile, iyisibonelo sezakhiwo zomlando, kanti i-Durban Botanic Gardens iyindawo yokuphumula enezitshalo ezinhle nezindawo zokuhlala. Ngithanda ukusho futhi ukuthi iTheku ibalulekile emsebenzini. Imisebenzi ehlukahlukene ixhumene nezimboni, izimakethe, nezokungcebeleka. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile, beyazisa lezi zindawo eziphilayo. Ukuhamba edolobheni kunganikeza ithuba lokufuna umsebenzi, noma ukuphakamisa amakhono akho. Ngaphezu kwezinto ezinhle, kufanele sikhulume ngalokho ongathanda ukukubona. Uthanda izinkanyezi? ITheku ineziqhingi ezinhle, futhi uzothola izinkanyezi ezithokozisayo ezibhakabhakayo. Uthanda lezo zinto? Ungakuthola lokho lapha! Noma ungase ubone izimpahla ezimnandi zesiko, eThekwini ungathola amakhaya ahlukeneyo, amabhizinisi amancane, nezitolo ezithengisa izinto eziphathekayo. Lokhu kuhle, ngoba udinga ukuthenga izinto, ungakhetha phakathi kwemikhiqizo yendawo, noma ungathanda ezinye izinto ezikadeni. Kodwa ekugcineni, iTheku ifana nokuphila. Ihlangene kakhulu, futhi umoya uyazwakala. Ngiyazi, uma uvakasha eThekwini, uzothola izinto eziningi ezinhle. Uthando lwezindawo, abanye abantu, namasiko kubonakala, futhi lezi zinto zenza iTheku ibe yindawo ethokozisayo. Ngakho, uma ungakaze uvakashele eThekwini, ngikukhuthaza ukuba uhlola lezi zindawo. Uzojabula, futhi uzokwazi ukuhamba phakathi kwezinto ezithokozisayo. ITheku izokwenza uqonde ukuthi impilo iyajabula, futhi ungathola izifundo eziningi eziphuma ezindabeni zansuku zonke. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, ngithemba ukuthi uzothokozisa ukuvakashela eThekwini, futhi ungaba nesipiliyoni esihle. Hamba phambili, uthathe ithuba, futhi ujabulele konke okukhona!
Izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba Ngaphakathi kwezwe laseNingizimu Afrika, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba ziye zabamba iqhaza elibalulekile emlandweni nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Lesi sikhathi sihlobene nezinguquko ezinkulu ezweni, ezikhombisa ukuthinta okukhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Umqondo wokuthathwa komhlaba uqala ngezikhathi zamasiko amaZulu, lapho umhlaba ubhekwa njengento enomqondo omkhulu. Lapho uhulumeni bahlala bequbuka izizathu, bebenza i-aphoyintimenti yokuthatha umhlaba kubantu bendawo ukuze vidipho umhlaba wezakhamizi. Lokhu kwadalwa yizinguquko zezimiso zomthetho ezazithi zingenisa imithombo efanele ekuthathweni komhlaba. Ngemva kokuhlukaniswa kwesizwe ngemuva kokufika kwabantu baseNgilandi nezinye izizwe, kwaba nokudlula umhlaba ophethwe ngabantu bendawo, okuyinto eyayimpilo yabo. Kwakukhona imithetho ehlukahlukene ewazwayo, njengemithetho yeTrek, eyayiqukethe ukuhamba kwezinhlanga ezahlukene kumhlaba. Lokhu kwaholela ezimpikiswaneni ezinkulu malunga nezinhlelo zokutholwa komhlaba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Union of South Africa yasungulwa ngo-1910, kwathi ngalesi sikhathi yayisenza kube lula ukuthatha umhlaba, ikakhulukazi kumuntu ongumZulu. Lokhu kube koqobo, ngenkathi abaphathi bebelokhu beqhubeka nezinhlelo ezintsha zokuthuthukisa umhlaba ngaphandle kwemvume yalabo abawuthandayo. I-Land Act ka-1913 yayibalwa njengomthetho obalulekile, ophikisana nokwabiwa komhlaba phakathi kwamazinga. I-Land Act yayikhumbuza imikhuba emibi yokuhlukaniswa kwezakhamizi ngokwehlukana kwemibono. Iyahlaba ikhwela ngesigidi sabantu, ikakhulukazi labo ababesebenzisa umhlaba. Lokhu kudala ukungahambisani phakathi kwabantu abahlala endaweni ezahlukene nezukanye nezizaba zomthetho. Lokhu kudalwa ezinkulumweni ngemizamo engama-oda emibili: isifunda sabelana nomhlaba nomengameli. Ngemuva kwempi yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili, imithombo yokuthola umhlaba iye yaholela ezimpikiswaneni ezenzeka ukusuka phambili. Ngokuhlanganyela, izishoshovu zafuneleka ngempela ukwakha izinhlelo ezizwakalayo eziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bembali babuyiselwa umhlaba. Kuvele ukuba nemizamo yokukhuluma ngoMthetho Wokutholwa Komhlaba ka-1991, owayekhanga kakhulu kulokhu, ulesi sikhathi esizoba sekuqala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imithetho eqondiswayo ibikhuluma ngebhodi yokuphila komhlaba. Lokhu kwavakasha umuntu ngamunye, nendlela yokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlelo zenhlalo nezizindeni zomhlaba, lezi zigaba zafuna ukuxazulula ezimfanelo zalezi zinhlelo. Ngo-1994, lapho kwaba khona izinguquko ezinkulu ezweni, imithetho yayiqala ukubuyekezwa, ukuze kuphume isivumelwano esisha. Baphawula ukuthi umhlaba wawufanele ukuzubekela gugu, futhi abahlali benza izinqumo eziyinqaba zokubuyiselwa komhlaba. Lokhu kwakhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba bahlanganyele ezintweni eziphakeme, benze amathuba avulekile ukuze kube nokubuyiswa okuphumelela. Kubantu abaningi, lezi zinguquko zazisebenza njengendlela yokuphila emhlabeni, kodwa inkinga yayiqhubeka. Kuzinyathelo ezithile, izinsiza zomthetho zazingazali ukwenziwa ukuze kubuyiselwe umhlaba kulabo abakufanelekayo ngenxa yokuhlupheka. Yize kwagcwala ukungavumi kuhlangene, ikusasa lithumele ikhono lokulawula izinsiza ezifanayo. Esikhathini esiningi, imishado emisha yahlabelela umphakathi, yethule izinhlelo zamazwe ahlanganelayo anokuthatha umhlaba komphakathi okwakha inhlangano efanele yokuhola ubulungu. Izinhlelo zashintsha ukuze zisizakale kubo bonke ophilayo, snakho ezizondelayo ezigunyaziwe. Ubulawa obufanele kulo mhlaba wawungathwetshulwa emigqeni yamazwe amaningi, kotayela kokuziphatha ngendlela evumayo. Ukwazi ukukhetha indlela yokwenza kube nemiphumela emihle kwalandela kuzinsuku ezinzima, uma kunezinyathelo eziphumelelayo. Iqembu labaholi bezizwe elizimele emazweni ehlukahlukene likhuthaza ubufakazi bokuchithwa, bahlazile ukuthi umhlaba ungottshengisa ezizweni ezithi zibhaliselwe. Kulokhu, izimpikiswano zomthetho ziye zaba yisikhumbuzo semizamo yokuthola ubulungiswa nokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokwazisa abantu ngale ndlela yokuphila emhlabeni, edala umphakathi omusha, owakhayo, futhi ogcwalisa ubumnandi. Noma izimpi zishoda, ukwakha ubuhlobo nezinyathelo ezikhanyayo kuzoba inhlansi efaneleko ekubuyiseni umhlaba. Ekugcineni, izimpikiswano zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela, ukuze izifunda nezinhlelo zithole ukufinyelela kokubili kwi-ngakuko umhlaba. Lokhu ukube kungaphetheki ngokuphelele, kube yisixazululo esingadliwa phansi ngempela, kulindeleke ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kuveza imiphumela eyingxenye ende yomlando wethu, etholakala ngangokuningi, kuze kulandwe izithunzi ezilukhuni ezingase zibhalwe emlandweni wesintu.
UMkhandlu we-eThekwini uhlela ukwakha izindlu ezibiza kancane endaweni yaseMawoti. Inani elihlosiwe lezindlu ezizokwakhiwa lingu-1,650, kanti abantu abangu-3,000 kulindeleke ukuthi bathole izinsizakalo. Ukuze uMkhandlu ukwazi ukwakha lezi zindlu, kudingeka uthenge umhlaba okukhuluma ngawo ngezansi. Njengoba uMkhandlu ungakwazi ukwenza izivumelwano zangasese nabanikazi balemiphakathi, kuphakamiswa ukuthi uMphakathi weDolobha asebenzise amandla akhe ngaphansi kwesigaba 40.2 somthetho weSishayamthetho sikaDisemba 10, 2007, ukuze lo mhlaba uthenjiswe uMkhandlu ngokukhishwa kwesaziso ngaphansi kwesigaba 9 somthetho kazwelonke ophathelene nezindlu, iHousing Act, 1997, efundwa ngezinsuku 2.4, 6 kuya ku-15 no-18 - 23 ze-Expropriation Act, 1975, kanye nesigaba 25 seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi. UMkhandlu uxhumene nabanikazi abaziwayo balemiphakathi nabanye abanamalungelo kuyo. Nakuba kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana nabanye nokuhlanganisa ulwazi ngabo, akukwaziwa ukuthi uMkhandlu unawo wonke ulwazi olufanele. Inhloso yale saziso ukwazisa abanye ababandakanyekayo ngenhloso kaMkhandlu yokuthola lo mhlaba ngokomthetho.
Ubufakazi bomshado busebenza njengobufakazi bokuthi ushade. Umshado kumele wenziwe phambi kwabashadayo, abafakazi ababili abanama-ID, kanye nomphakathi. Qinisekisa isimo sakho somshado ngokuhlola le webhusayithi: online. Abashadayo kumele babe nama-ID futhi bagcwalise ifomu le-BI-31. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-130 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Umshado ungaphathwa ngumuntu okhethwe ngu-opharetha ophuma eqenjini lokholo, inhlangano, noma ummeleli weMnyango Wezasekhaya. Umshado kumele wenziwe ekhaya leziqu, endaweni esetshenziselwa kuphela izinjongo zokholo, ehhovisi likamasipala, noma endaweni yokuhlala yomuntu siqu. Uma umuntu ozoshada elimele kakhulu noma egula kakhulu, umshado ungaphathwa esibhedlela. Abantu bangaphandle abashadayo eNingizimu Afrika kumele babe namapasipoti futhi bagcwalise ifomu lesicelo: BI-31. Abashadayo ababili, abafakazi ababili, kanye nomphakathi kumele basayine iMbhalo Yomshado ngokushesha ngemva kokwenziwa komshado. Abancane, abachazwa njengabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abake bashade ngaphambili, kumele balandele umthetho. Ngokwemithetho, abantu abake bashada esikhathini esedlule, futhi imishado yabo iphelelwe ngenxa yokufa noma ukwehlukana, ngeke baphinde babhekeleke njengabancane ngokomthetho. Kumele bathumele incwadi yokuvuma ebhalwe phansi evela kubo bobabili abazali kanye/noma umgibeli wezomthetho ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-31. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa eNkantolo Yezingane uma abazali bakho bengatholakali noma uma kungacacile ukuthi ungayithola kanjani incwadi yokuvuma. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa eNkantolo Ephakeme endaweni yakho uma abazali bakho kanye/noma uMphakathi bephika ukwamukela umshado. Abantu abahlukanisile abafuna ukujola kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole umyalo wokuhlukanisa eNkantolo. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma kukhona isizathu esiqinile sokuthi abakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa, noma uma behlukanisile kwelinye izwe, ngeke bakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa. I-affidavit kumele ibonise ukuthi umceli uhlelwe ngokomthetho, igama lenkantolo, kanye nosuku lokuhlukanisa. Abafazi abashonile noma abesilisa abashonile abafuna ukujola kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole incwadi yokufa yomkakabo ophumile. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma incwadi yokufa ingatholakali. I-affidavit kumele iqinisekise igama nesibongo somuntu oshonile, kanye nosuku lokufa. Incwadi yokushada efingqiwe: ikhiphwe ngokushesha. Incwadi engashintshwanga: izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kw eight.
Ukuthola: Ukuthuthukisa umhlabathi wakho ngamasimu okumboza kungaba yinto enkulu! Lapho sibheka izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuvuthwa komhlabathi eNingizimu Afrika kuye kwehla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi inani lezitshalo ezingakhula ezindaweni ezithola imvula liyasinciphisa, kunezizathu eziningi zokucabangela ukutshala isimu yokumboza, ikakhulukazi uma imvula ingaqinisekile futhi izindleko ezikhulayo zivame ukuvimbela abalimi ekutshaleni ufulawa. Ngokuvamile, amasimu okumboza atshalwa uma kushintshwa izinhlobo zezithelo, kodwa okwamanje, abalimi bakhetha ukusebenzisa amafutha nezinto zokwenziwa. Kucace bha ukuthi abakhiqizi abaningi manje sebethutheleka ekushintsheni izinhlobo zezithelo ukuze bagcine imvelo ngoba kuzosisiza esikhathini eside. Izimo zomhlabathi zingathuthuka uma isitshalo singaqala izimpande emhlabathini, kuvumela umhlabathi ukuthi uvuleke futhi wamukele umswakama. Uma insimu ishiywe ingatshalwanga isikhathi eside, umhlabathi ophakeme uba mncane, futhi amanzi awakwazi ukungena, kuholela ekulahlekelweni. Amasimu okumboza avikela umhlabathi emandleni elanga njengokhakhayi, avimbele ukuhlanganiswa komhlabathi, futhi asekele ezinye izinhlobo zokuphila ezifana nezintwala zomhlabathi ezisiza ukuhluza izinto eziphilayo zibe ukudla kwezithelo zesikhathi esizayo. Amasimu okumboza asiza ukuhlanganisa umhlabathi, ehla kakhulu ukulahleka komhlabathi ngenxa yokuphahlazeka ngamanzi noma umoya. Amasimu amaningi okumboza aphinde anikeze izinto eziphilayo emhlabathini - asebenza njengomanyolo ophilayo. Uma utshala ngezinto ezanele eziphilayo ngesikhathi esifanele, kungashiya inani elikhulu le-nitrogen emhlabathini ngoba kungase kube nezimo zokushoda kwemvula, futhi ungase ungatholi umkhiqizo omuhle; lezi zinto emhlabathini zingasetshenziswa nakusasa ngokutshala amasimu okumboza azosiza ngoba uzoba nohlelo olunokudla okuningi ukusekela isitshalo esifana nezitshalo ezitholakalayo, njengoba kuzoba ne-potassium ne-phosphorus eyanele. Inkinga evamile ekulimaleni yile: ukushoda kwezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini, ikakhulukazi i-nitrogen ne-phosphorus. Lokhu kungalungiswa kalula ngomyalo ofanele, kodwa kaningi umalimi endaweni encane akakwazi ukukhokhela lowo manyolo, futhi ukushintsha izinhlobo zezithelo ezitshalwayo nezinye amasimu okumboza kuzogcina ukuvuthwa komhlabathi futhi kube nezindleko ezincane. Sonke sivuma ukuthi ukutshala amaqanda ezinkomo ngokuhamba kwezimali nofulawa ehlobo kuzokwandisa imikhiqizo, kuthuthukise ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, futhi kwehlise izindleko zomanyolo. Ukukhula okuqinile kwamasi okumboza afana namaqanda ezinkomo noma i-teff kuvikela emandleni elanga futhi kuvimbele ukukhula kwezinhlamvu eziningi. Ngezinye izikhathi uma izitshalo ezifana namaqanda ezinkomo (akkersbonen) ne-teff (eragrostis tef) zitshalwa, lezi zitshalo zisiza isimo somhlabathi uma ezinye izitshalo zingase zikhule ngokushesha, kodwa zisiza umalimi ngokuhlinzeka ukudla kwezilwane zakhe ngesikhathi sokoma. Ngokuvamile, izitshalo eziningi zikhokha izindleko zokuhamba ukuze zidluliselwe lapho zikhuliswa khona ziye lapho zithengiswa khona, kodwa amasimu okumboza awakhokhi lezo zindleko ngoba asetshenziswa lapho atshalwe khona. Uhlobo lwamasimu okumboza kumele lukhethwe ngokususelwa endleleni umalimi athuthukisa ngayo. Yini okufanele yenziwe ngalowo mkhiqizo? Yiziphi izitshalo ezivame ukukhula kahle endaweni engithuthukisa kuyo? Yisiphi isitsha esidingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe umhlabathi kule nsimu? Khumbula ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo (izitshalo ezitholakalayo) zandisa umthamo we-nitrogen emhlabathini ngoba ziqinisa lokhu kusuka emoyeni, kodwa izitshalo ezingezona ezitholakalayo zizosebenzisa i-nitrogen esivele ikhona emhlabathini? Izitshalo ezitholakalayo zifana nezimbuzi, ama-soybeans, ama-lentils, ama-peas, njll. Izitshalo ezingezona ezitholakalayo zifana ne-teff, utshani, i-millet, amahlamvu, kanye ne-radishes. Amaqanda ezinkomo atshalwa ehlobo futhi aqinile ngokwanele ukuvikela ukoma nokushisa. Ayiminyaka futhi angakhula afinyelele ku-80 cm, anezimpande ezijulile. Asiza isimo somhlabathi ngoba angatshalwa emhlabathini anokushoda kwe-nitrogen futhi akhule kahle emhlabathini angatshalwanga nasemhlabathini esandleni. Awadingi umanyolo omningi, kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi akhiqiza ukudla okuhle okungadliwa abantu nezilwane ngoba amahlamvu, imbewu, nezikhumba zinohlanga oluningi. Le pea ingaphinde yome futhi igcinwe isikhathi eside. Le plant ikha umboza omuhle uma itshalwe, ikhula ngokushesha, ithatha cishe amasonto 8 - 12 ukuze iphume, kodwa iyiminyaka. Ikhula kahle ehlobo futhi ithanda umhlabathi omanzi. I-teff ithuthukisa umhlabathi kahle, futhi uma ikhula kahle, izovimbela ukukhula kwezinhlamvu. Isetshenziswa kakhulu njengokudla kwezilwane futhi ingatshalwa kabili ngonyaka. Kufanele ikhawulelwe ngaphambi kokuthi imbewu iphume. Kunamathuba amaningi avela uma kushintshwa izitshalo ngokutshala amasimu okumboza, futhi uma umalimi evinjelwe ekutshaleni izitshalo ezijwayelekile ukuze athole inzuzo ehlobo, izinzuzo zizobonakala esikhathini esizayo. Emhlabeni jikelele, abakhiqizi bathi ukutshala amasimu okumboza kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuvikela umhlabathi" ngoba kugcina ukuvuthwa komhlabathi. Kucace bha ukuthi ukuthuthukisa umhlabathi wakho kungaba yinto enkulu esikhathini eside!
Isigaba Somcimbi: Abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali Isikhathi: 15 Mashi 2024 Indawo: Ikhaya leMisebenzi, eGoli Umsuka: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM Ngabe uyazibuza ukuthi ungawuqala kanjani umkhankaso wokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana? Kanjani ungathuthukisa izinga lakho lokubuka futhi ukhulise izethameli zakho? Hamba kithi emcimbini ophawulekayo, "Abadali bokuqukethwe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana nemisebenzi yedijithali," lapho sizocobelelana khona ngamathiphu, amasu kanye nezinsiza zokwakha umphakathi ozinikele endaweni yezezimali, ezobuchwepheshe, nezokuxhumana. Lo mcimbi uzoba nendawo yokubambisana lapho abadali bokuqukethwe, osomabhizinisi, nabathandi bezokuxhumana bezoba nethuba lokuhlangana, baxoxe ngamaqiniso nezindaba ezithinta imikhakha ehlukene yomsebenzi. Sizoba nezingxoxo ezimnandi ezihlanganisa ohulumeni, abaholi bezomnotho, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele eziphumelela ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bokuqukethwe. Abaphakathi bazoba nezinhlaka ezazisayo ezifanele amalungu ahlukene, ukusuka kwabasaqalayo kuze kube kwabama-expert. Sizoba nezifundo ezimfishane ezihlanganisa izihloko ezifana: - Ukukha iBrand yakho ku-Social Media: Thola ukuthi ungazakhela kanjani igama eliqinile kukhulu kwi-Instagram, Twitter, ne-Facebook, ungachitha isikhathi esinankinga. - Ukwakha Okuqukethwe Okuhlinzekayo: Hlanganyelani nabachwepheshe abahamba phambili ekwakhiweni okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, ngokuphathelene nezincwadi, amavidiyo, nezithombe. - Amasu Okukhulisa Izibalo: Ukuthola izindlela eziningi zokukhulisa izibalo zakho kuhlu lwezithakazelo nabalandeli, ngohlu lwezimpendulo, ugcizelela izithako ezibalulekile zempumelelo. - Ukusebenzisa Izigaba Zokukhangisa: Hlola indlela yokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ngendlela efanele ukuze ufinyelele izithameli ezikhulayo. Ngaphezu kwezingxoxo, sizoba ne-‘networking session’ ngesikhathi sonke somcimbi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi uzwe okwengeziwe, uxhume nabanye abadali, futhi uthole izinzuzo ezinkulu zomsebenzi wakho. Uzokwazi ukuyixhumana imicabango, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuthola amathuba amasha okusebenza, okungase kuveze imizila emisha yokubambisana. Izigaba Zombukiso Nezihlangano: - Ubuchwepheshe Bokwazisa: Khuluma nabakhiqizi bokuqukethwe abaphumelelayo, begxile embonini yedijithali. - I-Panel Discussion: Abaphathi bezehlakalo abavela ezinkampanini ezinkulu bazobe behlaziya ukwakhiwa kokuqukethwe okuhle, nokuthi umsebenzisi angasebenza kanjani ukuze avikele umkhiqizo wakhe. - Umdlalosemthethweni: Hlanganyela kwezemidlalo ye-social media, bese uziqhenya ngamalungu akho angavamile. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwalezi zicathulo kanye nezingxoxo, umcimbi uzobhekelela impumelelo yabadali bokuqukethwe, bahlanganyele futhi bafunde ukuthi bangawakhulisa kanjani amaqhinga abo ezinhliziyweni zabathandi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nezinye izinto ezizokhipha izikhumbuzo nezinsiza ezibucayi. Izenzo ezithile zokuqina, dabuka izincwadi zokufunda ezithinta izinkundla eziningi, kanye nemiyalezo yokwakha izifundo ezikufundisayo, kuyajabulisa ukuphuma. Ukwabelana ngezindlela eziningi zokwazi ezokuxhumana kwezalokhu, sizobangani bokuqala ezikhathini ezimnandi zokuxhumana. Hamba naye, uze ukumo kuwona imicabango, udale, faka isikhumbuzo! Umcimbi uzokhulisa ukukhululeka kwakho kokucabanga ngalezi zinhlelo zedijithali, umnyango wezezimali, nezokuxhumana. Zikhiphe, uphendule izimpendulo, futhi uwine ibhodi yokuqeda. Ngakho, ungamali ukwenza lokhu. Bhalisela imicimbi etholakalayo futhi ubhalise ukuze uthole ngesikhathi sokuqonda ukuthi ungaba kanjani umdali ophumelelayo, naye udinga okufana nokwenzeka! Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, sizoba nezinye izenzakalo ezizokuqondisa phezu kwalezi zifundo. Phinda uphume lula, uhambisane nezinto ezinzima, ushiye indawo yakbozwayo. Bafika, ujabule, ufinyelela izithongoi ezikhulayo, ukwazi ukuba ngumqondo othembekile phansi kwezezimali. Futhi okokugcina, ukuze uthole ukuqhubekela phambili, khumbula ukufaka izinkumbulo zakho, ubhalise manje, bese uxhumana ngokuhamba phambili! Sibheke phambili ukuze sihlangane khona!
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Ngemva kokuhlwa, umuzi wawugcwele ukukhuluma nokuxoxisana phakathi kwabantu. Izakhamuzi zazilindele usuku olukhulu – usuku lokhetho lukazwelonke. Umoya wawugcwele umdlandla, ithemba, kanye nesifiso sokwenza ushintsho empilweni yabo. U-Naledi, intombazane eneminyaka eyi-18, wayechazela umngane wakhe, uThabo, ukuthi ubani ofuna ukumkhetha, kanye nemicabango yakhe ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile. “Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sikhethe umuntu ozosikhumbuza ukuthi sikhona, onomoya wokuhola, hhayi nje omunye ongena esikhundleni,” kusho uNaledi, ebuka izithombe zabaholi ezazikhanyiswe emikhankasweni. UThabo wavuma, “Yebo, kufanele sithathe isinyathelo sokwakha ikusasa lethu. Kumele sibe nomqondo obonakalayo.” Ngesikhathi usuku lokhetho lufika, umuzi wawuthule. Izakhamuzi zazingekho ezikhaliphile, kodwa zazilungele ukuvota. U-Naledi noThabo bahamba behamba bejabulile, befuna indawo yokuvota. Njengoba bephuma emnyango, babona ubuhlalu bomoya bumile phansi, bukhumbuza ukujula kokuhluka kwemibono phakathi kwabantu. U-Naledi wabona abanye abafundi behlabelela, bejabulisa umphakathi, bezwakalisa izinto ezinhle ezihambisana nezihlandlo ezinkulu. “Bona, uThabo, abanye abantu bayavuma, baziqhenya ngemiphumela yokhetho. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ivoti lethu linomthelela omkhulu,” kusho uNaledi, ethokozisa umoya wakhe. UThabo wavuma, “Ngiyavuma, akumele sithathe lokhu kungenangqondo. Noma ubani okhetha umholi ungasondela futhi akhombise uthando komunye nomunye. Sizonqoba!” Ngemuva kokufika endaweni yokuvota, uNaledi noThabo bathola imizamo yokuvota. Babona abantu abaningi, bonke bephethe amaphepha avota, befuna ukukhetha umuntu abazokhumbula. Uthando lwabantu lwalukhanya. Izinhliziyo zabantu zaziphezu kwemvelo, zikhumbula imizamo yabo yokwakha ikusasa elihle. U-Naledi wagcizelela, “Noma unqumayo, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi kunomoya wokubambisana. Akekho umuntu ongaqonda ukusho okukhuluma.” Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukhetho lwavula izinkanyezi zempilo, umphakathi waqhamuka nezinto ezithakazelisayo. U-Naledi noThabo banezinto ezinhle ezikhuluma ngempilo, izifiso zokwakha imiphakathi, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihambisana nezifiso zabo. U-Baba uMali, umholi omdala, waba sesimweni sokwakha umphakathi, waqhakambisa ubumbano. “Uhlanga lwethu lufanele ukusebenza futhi luhlale luthokozisa. Umphakathi wethu udinga uthando, hhayi ukulwa,” kusho uBaba uMali, ememeza emkhankasweni. Uthando lwakhe lwavusa uNaledi noThabo, bahlala beletha izwi elisha. UThabo wakhala, “Ngabe umphakathi wethu ungakha isinyathelo, uma sizokhetha umuntu ozoba njengomholi esiqhubekayo?” Ngemva kosuku lokhetho, umoya wawufudumele. U-Naledi noThabo bahlala bejabulile, bejabulisa imiphakathi yabo. Umphakathi wabonisa ubumbano, futhi izinkanyezi zezimanga zavela. U-Naledi noThabo, ngaphambi kokuthi benze isinyathelo esilandelayo, banquma ukuhamba nabo bonke abantu abavota, baphinde bakhumbule imizamo yabo. “Akukhona nje ukukhetha umuntu, kodwa lokhu ukwakha ikusasa. Umoya wethu udinga ukukhanya, futhi sizoba nabantu abasha abahola impilo yethu,” kusho uNaledi, ethokozisa umoya wezakhamuzi. UThabo wavuma, “Ngiyavuma, asikhumbule ukuthi lokhu kungokuhola okuhle, kusho ukwakha umphakathi.” Njengoba behamba, umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubumbano, kanye nezinhloso ezinhle. Ukhetho lukazwelonke lwaba yisifundo esikhulu sokukhumbula ukuthi abantu badinga ukuhlanganiswa, bahlale bezwakalisa amandla abo. U-Naledi noThabo, njengabavoti abasha, babona ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ngaleyondlela, uthando lwabo lwazalelwa esikhathini eside, balandela izinyathelo zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wawuhlangene, unamandla, futhi ukhanya njengezinkanyezi ebusuku. Ukhetho lwavula umnyango omkhulu wezinto ezinhle, futhi abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa ukuphila. U-Naledi noThabo, njengabavoti abasha, babonisa ukuthi ukhetho akusikho kuphela ukukhetha, kodwa kusemqoka ukukhetha ukuphila okukhanyayo. Umphakathi wawuqhubeka, uthi uhambe phambili, uthando lwabo lungabavimba. Ngalesi sikhathi, umoya wawugcwele uthando, ubumbano, nempilo, futhi u-Naledi noThabo bazi ukuthi lesi sikhathi sikhumbuza abantu ukuthi baziqhenye ngempilo yabo, bahlale bekhuthaza ukusho okukhuluma. Izinhliziyo zazo zazinothando, zaziqhakambisa izifiso zokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ukhetho lwakuphakamisela phambili, ngenxa yobumbano, uthando, nempilo. Njengoba umuzi usuku lusondela, umoya wawuhamba phambili, ubumbano lwakhe lwalukukhanya. U-Naledi noThabo, njengabavoti abasha, babona ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhanya, ziqhakambisa ikusasa elihle. Ukhetho lwavula umnyango omkhulu wezinto ezinhle, futhi abantu baqhubeka bejabulisa ukuphila.
Ukukhuphuka Kwezindleko Zokuphila: Izizathu Nezixazululo Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima zomnotho, sazi ukuthi ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila sekuphenduke umkhuba osukhula ngokushesha emhlabeni jikelele, futhi ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuhlobene nezinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ezimakethe, izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni, kanye nezimo zomhlaba. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izizathu zokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila, imiphumela yalesi simo, kanye nezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukuze kuncishiswe ukuvuvukala kwezindleko. Okokuqala, uma sikhuluma ngezizathu zokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila, kufanele sikhulume ngentengo yokudla. Izifundo zibonisa ukuthi intengo yokudla ibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Lokhu kungenxa yokwanda kwezindleko zokuthutha, izinkinga zokukhiqiza, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima ezifana nezomiso neziqhwa. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umkhiqizo uthunyelwa emakethe kumele uhambisane nezindleko eziphezulu zokuthutha, okugqamisa ukuthi intengo yokudla iyanda. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuthenga ukudla okwanele, okukhombisa ukuthi ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila akukhathaleli kuphela abampofu, kodwa kube nomthelela wonke umuntu. Okwesibili, izindleko zokuhlala zikhuphukile kakhulu. Lokhu kubangelwa ukuncipha kwezindawo zokuhlala ezitholakalayo, okudlulela ekwandeni kwemali yokurenta nezindleko zokwakha. Abantu abaningi bahlala ezindaweni ezibiza kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziyisisekelo. Lezi zindleko ziphinde zandise ukukhathazeka, njengoba abantu bephoqeka ukuba bahlale ezindaweni ezithile ukuze bahlale befinyelela emisebenzini, kodwa lokho kudinga imali eningi. Ngalesi sikhathi, siba nesimo lapho izindleko zokuhlala ziphakamisa ingcindezi emndenini, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina impilo enhle. Ngokwemiphumela, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kuhlobene nokuncipha kwesimo sezimali somphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukhula kokwehla kwemali engenayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka. Abantu banqunywa ukuthi benze izinqumo ezinzima mayelana nezidingo zabo, okukhuthaza umkhuba wokungabikhona kwemali eningi yokuthenga imikhiqizo eyisisekelo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho abantu bephoqeka ukuba baqoqe imali, kodwa ngenxa yezindleko eziphezulu, bahluleka ukufinyelela ezidingweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kulethe umthelela omubi emisebenzini. Abantu abaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi izinkampani zithuthukisa ukusebenza kwazo ukuze zikwazi ukuzama ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza. Lokhu kudala ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, okukhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zidinga ukunciphisa izindleko ukuze zihlale zikhona emakethe. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungasebenzi, okukhathaza umphakathi, ikakhulukazi abantu abasha abafuna umsebenzi. Ngakho, yini engase yenziwe ukuze kuncishiswe ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila? Okokuqala, uhulumeni kumele athathe izinyathelo ezithile zokuvikela abathengi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukunciphisa izintela ezithinta ukudla nezindawo zokuhlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufaka izinqubomgomo ezithuthukisa ukukhiqiza kwasemakhaya kungasiza ekunciphiseni izindleko zokudla. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuthutha nezokwakha kungasiza ekwehliseni izindleko zokuthutha, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwezimpahla. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi imiphakathi ibambe iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemisebenzi yokwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphusile, ukuze kube nezinqubo eziphumelelayo, kungasiza ekwandiseni izindawo zokuhlala ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu basebenze ndawonye nabaholi bendawo, ukuze bakhe izixazululo eziphathelene nezimo zendawo. Ekugcineni, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila kusemthethweni, kanti imiphumela yalesi simo ibonakala kubantu abaningi. Ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa imizamo yohulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze sifeze impumelelo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo nemfundo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izindleko zokuphila ziphakamisa izinselelo ezinzima, kodwa ngokubambisana, singathola izindlela zokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika Ngonyaka ka-2023, umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika ubone ukukhula okukhulu, okuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nokwandiswa kwezinsizakalo. Lokhu kukhula kubonakala ngokuthi izinkampani eziningi zikhulisa izikhala zazo ukuze zifeze izidingo zamakhasimende, futhi lokhu kuveza ithuba elihle lokuthola imisebenzi kubantu abaningi. I-Call centre iyindawo lapho abathengisi, abaphakeli, nabanye abasebenzi bexhumana namakhasimende ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezifana nezokuxhumana ngefoni, i-imeyili, kanye nezinkundla zokuxhumana. E-Ningizimu Afrika, le mboni ibonakala iyinsiza ebalulekile emnothweni, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu afana neGauteng, eKapa, naseThekwini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani ziqaphele ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle namakhasimende kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwenza umkhakha wama-call centre ube nethuba lokukhula. Ngokwenyuka kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, umkhakha wama-call centre ube nokwanda kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezihlukene, okuholele ekwandeni kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kubonakala ekutheni izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-AI (Artificial Intelligence) kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, ukuze ziqhube imisebenzi yazo ngendlela ephumelelayo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ekwandiseni ukusebenza kahle kwama-call centre, kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda samakhasimende, futhi kukhuphule ukwaneliseka kwamakhasimende. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre kuxhumene nokwanda kokusebenzisa izilimi eziningi. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lapho kunezilimi eziningi ezikhuluma, izinkampani ziqaphele ukuthi ukwazi ukuxhumana ngolimi lwekhasimende kubalulekile. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi, ukuze bakwazi ukuxhumana kahle namakhasimende abakhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi amakhasimende abhekwa kahle, futhi kunciphisa ukukhungatheka. Ngokubheka izimo zomhlaba jikelele, umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukuze baqhubeke nokukhula, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenzisa izindlela zokusebenza eziphumelelayo, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi ziqhuba izifundo ezithuthukisayo kubasebenzi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephambili emkhakheni, futhi bakwazi ukuncintisana nezinkampani ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Kodwa-ke, ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre akuhambisani kuphela nezinsizakalo ezinhle. Ubugebengu bokuxhumana, lapho abanye abantu bezama ukukopela amakhasimende, bukhona futhi bukhathaza umkhakha. Izinkampani zidinga ukuthuthukisa izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende azizwa ephephile. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhakha uhlale uphila futhi uthuthuka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika uzoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo, ziqhube izifundo ezithuthukisayo kubasebenzi, futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi amakhasimende anelisekile. Ngokuphetha, ukukhula komkhakha wama-call centre eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa ithuba elikhulu lokuthuthukisa umnotho, ukwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkampani namakhasimende. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha uqhubeka nokukhula, uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, futhi uthuthukisa impilo yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuzoba nempumelelo emnothweni, futhi kuzosiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
I-Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC) iyisikhungo esibalulekile esaqalwa eNingizimu Afrika ngemva kokuphela kobandlululo. Le komidi yaziwa ngokuqhathanisa, ngenhloso yokwenza ubulungiswa, ukuthola iqiniso, kanye nokwakha uxolo phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. U-Mnu. Desmond Tutu, umfundisi onobuhlakani, wayeyinhloko ye-TRC, enenjongo yokuhlanganisa abantu abahlukanisiwe. Le nhlangano yaqala ukusebenza ngo-1995, ngemva kokhetho lokuqala olukhululekile, lapho abantu benqoba ubandlululo. I-TRC yayigxile ekuhloleni izigameko ezinzima ezenzeka ngesikhathi sobandlululo, ikakhulukazi ezokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu. Umgomo wayo wukuvula izimfihlo, lapho abantu bekhuluma ngezinto ezibathintele, futhi benza lokhu ukuze bathole induduzo. Isigaba sokuqala se-TRC sasingokwehlola, lapho abahlali bezwe babhalisela ukuveza izigameko zokuzenzakalisa, baphinde baphendule nezinkampani ezazibandakanyeka. Abantu babenelungelo lokukhuluma izindaba zabo ngaphandle kokwesaba, okwakubalulekile ekuqondeni izinkinga ezazihambisana nezinhlekelele zezenhlalo. Abafundi be-TRC basebenzise lezi zindaba ukuze baphumelele ekwakheni imibiko echaza izigameko ezinzima zothando, ubandlululo, nokuhlukunyezwa. Isigaba sesibili saziwa ngokubuyisela ubuntu, lapho i-TRC yayihlose ukuhlanganisa abantu abahlukanisiwe. Lokhu kwakhuthazwa ngokubuyisana phakathi kwabantu abaphikisana. Umqondo wokubuyisana wawuwumgogodla wezinhlelo zika-TRC, obhekisela ekwakheni uxolo. Abantu ababeqale ngezinsolo ezinzima banikezwa ithuba lokukhuluma, futhi uma behlonipha izinqubo, babenikezwa ithuba lokuxolelwa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-TRC ayikabazisanga abathintekayo, kodwa yahlinzeka futhi ngamaqhaza okwenza iziphakamiso ezazizothuthukisa umphakathi. Izibuyekezo ezatholakala zifaka phakathi iziphakamiso zokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwakha isiko lokuxolelwa, ukwakha imiphakathi eqinile, nokugcina izinkumbulo zokuhlukunyezwa. I-TRC ibhalise imikhuba yokuhlonipha ubumqoka bezinkumbulo, ukuze lezi zinkumbulo zingasuki engqondweni zabantu. Ukwenza izinqumo ezithile, i-TRC ibuyisela abantu emndenini, ibonisa ukuthi abantu baphinde bazitholele izindlela zokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kwahlose ukuhlinzeka ithuba lokukhuluma nokuhlonipha konke okwenziwe kwabanye. Injongo enkulu yahamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi ofanele, lapho ubuholi busebenza ukuze bukhumbule izinto ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-TRC ibheke kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokufundisa, ngenhloso yokwabelana ngolwazi ukuze abantu bathole ukuqonda okungcono kwezinto ezihambisana nezinhlekelele. Ukuze ubuholi busebenze kahle, bekudingeka ukuthi abantu bavule imihla yokukhuluma, baphathe izinkumbulo ezinzima, ukuze kulungiswe ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-TRC yaboniswa njengendlela yokwakha uxolo, nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu, futhi yaba yinto ebalulekile emlandweni weNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwaba isibonelo esihle sokuba nezinhlangano ezikhuthazayo ezithile, ezitholakalayo ukuze zikhuthaze ukuxolelwa, ukuqonda, nokwakha umphakathi ozimele. Ekugcineni, i-Truth and Reconciliation Commission ibonisa ukuthi isimo esinzima singabizwa ngokuhlanganyela, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukuzama ukuhlanganisa izinkumbulo ezintsha, ukuze bakhe umphakathi ophilayo nonobunye. Ukubuyisana akuyona inqubo elula, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni isiko lempilo ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Uhlanga lwe-TRC lwaluyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, ngaphezu kwezinto ezinzima, abantu bangakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho izinkumbulo ezinzima zingahlangana khona nezifiso zokwakha ubudlelwano obuhloniphekile. I-Truth and Reconciliation Commission ibonisa ukuvuselelwa kokholo, nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu abahlukeneyo, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi ohloniphayo, ophila ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni isiko lokuxolisa, kanye nokuqonda ukuthi izinkumbulo ezinzima zingaba yizinsiza ezinamandla ekuqedeni izinkinga zethu zansuku zonke. Njengoba sihamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuba siqhubeke sifunda nokwakha, ukuze imiphakathi yethu ibenobudlelwano obuhle, nolwazi olujulile lwemfundiso ezitholakele.
Ekupheleni, le mhlahlandlela inikeza uhlu lwezinombolo zokuxhumana ukuze uthole usizo lokubhalisela nokwaziswa kwabantu ongaxhumana nabo emahhovisi ahlukahlukene ale Ndaba kulo lonke izwe lapho abasebenzisi bamanzi bengathola khona amafomu nosizo ekugcwaliseni lawa mafomu.
