ISIGABA 7: UKUQEDILELA AMAFAKU WOKUBHALISWA INGCEBO 2 Ingxenye 2 yamaFomu... Isigaba 2 Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi Inqubo yokubhaliswa: Kungani, ubani, kanjani, nini. Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi kucaciswa nguSigaba 26 © noSigaba 34 weMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi abasebenzisi bamanzi badinga ukubhalisela ukusebenzisa amanzi kule Ndaba. Ukuze kulawulwe futhi kulawulwe izinsiza zamanzi ukuze kuhlelwe kahle futhi kuthuthukiswe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kwamanzi kubasebenzisi bamanzi. Ukubhaliswa kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuthola izindleko ezifanele nezichanekile zokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Imali eqoqwe lapha izosetshenziselwa ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukubhaliswa akusizi kuphela abasebenzisi bamanzi kodwa kuzophinde kusebenzele izwe lonke. iNingizimu Afrika ingelinye lamazwe anezinsiza zamanzi ezinganele. Siseduze kokubizwa emhlabeni jikelele ngokuthi "izwe elinamanzi anqabile." Ukuhlola kukhombisa ukuthi zonke izinsiza zamanzi ezintsha zizokwenziwa phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 kuya kwengu-30 ezayo, kuye ngokukhula komnotho. Ukuhlukumezeka kwezinsiza zamanzi ezintsha ngenxa yokungcoliswa kunganciphisa inani lamanzi angasetshenziswa. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo kanye nokonakaliswa kwemvelo. Ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zamanzi nokuhlinzeka ngekusasa kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi sinamanzi amangaki okwamanje, ubani osebenzisa wona, nokuthi kuphi. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kubhalwe kuSheduli 1 yeMthetho (buka Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungahlanganisiwe ezidingweni zokubhaliswa ngokuhambisana nesaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kweNqubomgomo Yokubhaliswa noma ngaphansi kweMvume Ejwayelekile (buka Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungxenye yosizo olunikezwa yilabo abahlinzeka ngamanzi njengohulumeni bendawo (Izindawo) noma iBhodi Yamanzi. Isibonelo salokhu yamanzi nokuphuma kwamanzi ezindaweni zokuhlala eziphathwa nguMphakathi. Akudingekile ukuthi umndeni ngamunye ubhalise, nokho, uMphakathi kumele ubhalise ukusetshenziswa kwawo kwamanzi. Umuntu ngamunye - njengabalimi, abanikazi bezindawo, noma abaqashi. Imiphakathi - njengamabhizinisi omphakathi, izinhlelo zababalimi bendabuko. Izinkampani namabhizinisi - kuhlanganisa ubudlelwano, izinkampani zomphakathi, izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinkampani zangaphandle, ubambiswano, kanye nezinkampani zokubambisana. Abahlinzeki bamanzi, kuhlanganisa iBhodi Yamanzi kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Kusukela ngo-October 8, 1999, bonke abasebenzisi bamanzi abasha kumele babhalise njengoba kuchaziwe kwiMvume Ejwayelekile (buka Isigaba 4). Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le Ndaba izoshicilela Izaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni enemininingwane yezimo zokuhamba kwemifula nezinqwaba zamanzi noma izindawo zokuhlola amanzi, ibize abasebenzisi bamanzi ukuthi babhalise ukusetshenziswa kwamanje kwamanzi. Lezi Zaziso zizokwenza kube sobala isikhathi lapho abasebenzisi bamanzi kumele babhaliswe. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sitholakala cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-60 kusukela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kweZaziso. Ngemuva kokukhishwa kweZaziso, abasebenzisi bamanzi bazokwaziswa nangeminye imigudu ukuthi kumele babhalise, njengokushicilela izaziso eziphephandabeni noma ukuveza emsakazweni. Ungabaza emahhovisi Amanzi endaweni yakho uma iZaziso yokubhaliswa yale ndawo ikhishwe. Amafomu okubhaliswa atholakala kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi le Ndaba (buka Isigaba 8). Ukuze ubhalise ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwamanzi, thumela ifomu eliphelele kule Ndaba. Ukubhaliswa akungaphikiswa noma kuphumelelwe uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuhlosiwe kufanelekile. Amafomu angaphelele angabuyiselwa kubasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukubhaliswa kuzophakanyiswa kuze kube ifomu libuyiselwa ngemininingwane edingekayo yonke. Lapha uthola incazelo yezisho (nezisho) ezivame ukusetshenziswa kule nqubo yokubhaliswa ukusiza umsebenzisi wamanzi lapho egcwalisa ifomu. Uthola futhi amagama ezobuchwepheshe asetshenziswa engxenyeni 2 yamaFomu. noma ukonakaliswa kwemvelo njengensimbi noma udoti omkhulu ongekho maphakathi. Ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kokuphuma kwamanzi ezinsizeni zamanzi ngenxa yezinqubo zokumbiwa. Noma iyiphi imayini enezinqubo zokukhishwa kwensimbi kuhlanganisa nokuphuma kwedoti. Zonke ezinye izimayini, kuhlanganisa izimayini ezinkulu ezinezingcuphe ezincane ezinsizeni zamanzi, nezimayini ezinezingcuphe eziphansi nezinqubo zokumbiwa ngaphansi. IMIFULA EYINQABA Ukugcina amanzi kuyindlela yokusebenzisa amanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuSigaba 21(b) ngezansi. Ukuphepha emifuleni kulawulwa futhi kuyisahluko 12 seMthetho kanye neNqubomgomo Yokuphepha KweMifula (kuGazethi yoHulumeni No. R1560 edlule ngoJulayi 25, 1986). Ukubhaliswa kwemifula eyinqaba kucaciswa nguSigaba 120 seMthetho. Lezi yimifula enekhono lokugcina ngaphezu kwe-50,000 cubic meters wamanzi enobude bezindonga obungaphezulu kwe-5 meters noma eyamukelwe nguNgqongqoshe njengohlobo lomfula oluyingozi. Umfula noma noma iyiphi isakhiwo esingagcina noma sithwale noma sibe nezinhlaka zamanzi. Imifula yakhiwa emifuleni noma ngabe ayakhiwe ukuze igcine amanzi (ama-weirs). Amanzi anokungcoliswa kwasekhaya avela emathunjini omndeni abangelwa uma kuhlanzwa izingubo, kuhlanzwa imizimba, nasemathoyilethi. IMITHOMBO YOKUNGCOLISA Ukuphuma kwedoti ngendlela engaphazamisa insiza yamanzi kuyindlela yokusebenzisa amanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuSigaba 21(g) ngaphansi kwezincazelo zokusebenzisa amanzi ngezansi. Izindawo lapho kudotiwe khona kufanele futhi zibhaliswe ngaphansi kweSigaba 20 seMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kwezemvelo. Izinhlobo zokungcoliswa ezingekho emthethweni azidingi ukubhaliswa njengama-sitsha edoti nezindawo lapho izimayini zikhupha khona udoti. Lezi zinhlobo azidingi ukubhaliswa
I- National Electronic Media Institute of South Africa (NEMISA) yasungulwa ngaphansi kwegama leSouth African Broadcasting School; inhlangano eyasungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 21, futhi yashintsha igama yayo ngomhla ziyi-8 kuJuni 1999. Ngokusho kwesheduli 3 ingxenye A yePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA) ka-1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999), njengoba kuguqulwe, futhi ngenxa yalomthetho ophakanyisiwe, i-NEMISA inezibopho zokubhala le manuwali ezosiza njengedokhumenti yomphakathi ngendlela yokuthi umphakathi ungafinyelela emarekhodi ethu. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhambahamba inani labathuthukisi be-ICT abanolwazi kanye nabasebenzisi abavela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo, kanye nokwandisa amakhono emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. I-NEMISA ihlose ukugcina umzimba wabafundi obuhlukahlukene onenani elikhulu labesifazane. Umbono we-NEMISA uwukuba ibe yisikhungo semfundo esilandela izindlela ezintsha ezigxile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Sihlose ukuba yisikhungo esihamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphatheni izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihlinzeka ngezidingo zezimboni emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngempahla egxile kubantu, eshibhile, ethinta izimboni ngokudlulisa ulwazi nobudlelwano. Isu le-NEMISA ukuhlinzeka nokuqeqesha abaphothuli abanolwazi oluphakeme abazoba ngabahlanganyeli abavelele emikhakheni yokusakaza nezokuxhumana ngohlelo oluhlukahlukene, izifundo, nezinto ezintsha. IBhodi Yabaqondisi ibophezelekile kubanikazi bezabelo ngokulandela izimiso ezibekwe yi-PFMA. Umphathi Omkhulu, ongumuntu omdala kwiBhodi, uqokwa ngokuhambisana nememorandum kanye nemibhalo yenhlangano ye-NEMISA. IBhodi Yabaqondisi ibheka izindaba ze-NEMISA futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ze-NEMISA zisebenza, kanye nokuhola, ukuqondisa, nokulawula izenzo ze-NEMISA. I-NEMISA igcizelela indlela yokuphatha ebambisanayo kanye nokuziphatha okuhle, njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-King Report ngokuqondisa kwezinkampani kanye nePublic Finance Management Act. Ikomidi le-Audit liqokwa yiBhodi ngokuhambisana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla. Ikomidi le-Audit lisungulwa ukuze liqinisekise ukuthi i-NEMISA igcina indawo yezezimali, yokubhekelela izingozi, kanye nokulawula ngaphakathi eqinile, ebanzi, futhi ecacile. Okwamanje, linamalunga kuphela eBhodi, kodwa le komidi linokhetho lokuqoka amalunga angeziwe. Le komidi ibika kwiBhodi ye-NEMISA ngemiphumela ye-audit kanye nokwethembeka nokuba khona kokuphila okukhulunywe ngakho. I-NEMISA, ngokubambisana neNational Services Commission (USA), ikwi ndlela yokusungula ikomidi le-audit langaphakathi elinamalunga amathathu, elilodwa lisuka enhlanganweni ngayinye kanye nomuntu ozimele. Le komidi izosebenza ngokuzimela kokuphathwa, kwiBhodi ye-NEMISA, kanye nekomidi le-audit. Inhloso enkulu yale komidi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango nezindlela eziphathelene nokuphathwa kwangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Le komidi izobika kokubili ukuphathwa kanye nekomidi le-Audit ye-NEMISA. I-NEMISA ikhuthaza ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi bayo ngezinhlelo zokubambisana eziphathelene nezindaba zabasebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwabelana ngolwazi. I-NEMISA ibheka isenzo esiqinisekisayo njengokubalulekile ezinqubweni zayo zokuhola, igxile kakhulu ekuthengeni abesifazane. Le nkampani izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni indawo yokusebenza ephephile. Umbiko wonyaka we-NEMISA. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele achaze ukuthi ufuna ikhophi yesi rekhodi noma ufuna ukuyibona ehhovisi le-NEMISA. Isigaba 292. Umfaki-sicelo uzoyithola ngendlela abacelile ngayo. Nokho, ukufinyelela kolwazi kuzoncika ekutheni isicelo asiphazamisi izinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile ze-NEMISA, noma kudale umonakalo rekhodi, noma kuphazamise idokhumenti engelona idokhumenti yesimo. Isigaba 293. Uma, ngezizathu ezithile, ulwazi lungakhululwa ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngendlela ehlukile, imali izobala ngokuhambisana nendlela umfaki-sicelo akhethe ngayo. Isigaba 294. Uma, ngaphezu kokuphendula okubhaliwe esicelweni sabo sesi rekhodi, umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela ehlukile, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kufanele kuchazwe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efaka isicelo egameni lomunye umuntu, kufanele akhombise ukuthi unegunya lokwenza leso sicelo. Isigaba 182f. Uma abafaki-sicelo bengakwazi ukubhala noma ukufunda, noma banezinkinga ezithile, bangacela rekhodi ngenkulumo. Umphathi wehhovisi kufanele aqedele ifomu labo futhi abahlinzeke ngekhophi. Isigaba 183. Umphakathi wolwazi uzobhekana nesicelo solwazi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kokulithola noma ngokushesha okukhulu. [Isigaba 25]. Kwezinye izimo, le nqubo yezi-30 zinganda ngenye izinsuku eziyi-30. [Isigaba 26]. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwazi ukuvezwa nganoma yiziphi izimali ezikhokhwayo ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo solwazi processing. [Isigaba 22]. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka ukukhala mayelana nokukhokha izimali phakathi naleso sikhathi. [Izigaba 74 no-75] noma afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze athole usizo olufanele ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwenqubo eshiwo ngenhla. [Isigaba 78]. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwazi ukwaziswa ukuthi bazokwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi. [Isigaba 25]. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlinzeka ngamakhono, ukusakaza kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokusakaza ezizokwenza abaphothuli babe namakhono okusebenza kwezobuchwepheshe ezingeni le-strategic. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zitholakala emikhakheni ehlukahlukene yokusakaza, umsakazo kanye ne-TV, futhi zifaka izifundo ezimfishane, izifundo zomphakathi, izifundo eziphelele, kanye nemikhankaso ebonakalayo. Uhlelo lunemakethe ethile eqondiwe. Abantu abavela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo. Thumela ukukhala kwakho kwiBhodi Yokukhala mayelana nesinqumo somphakathi wolwazi. Uma umfaki-sicelo enganelisekile ngesinqumo seBhodi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olufanele enkantolo. Le ngolwazi izotholakala kuphela uma iceliwe.
Ukulalelwa Komphakathi Mayelana noMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) Uhlelo lweMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo luhloswe ukuba luthuthukise ukufinyelela kwezempilo, lwenze kube lula ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo, futhi lunciphise izindleko zezempilo kubantu. Ukuze lolu hlelo luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube nolwazi oluqondile ngalo, futhi kube nokulalelwa komphakathi ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuveza imibono yabo, izinkinga, nezidingo zabo. 1. Yini iNHI? IMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) iyindlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni. I-NHI izohlinzeka ngempilo kubantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi banelungelo lokukhokha noma cha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abangenamali yokukhokha izinsiza zezempilo bazokwazi ukuthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nezinhlaka ezahlukene ezizohlinzeka ngezinsiza, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela, odokotela, nezikhungo zezempilo. 2. Kungani kubalulekile ukulalela umphakathi? Ukulalela umphakathi kubalulekile ngoba abantu bazi kahle izidingo zabo. Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nezinselelo eziningi, futhi uma umphakathi ungabandakanyeki, izixazululo ezitholakalayo zingase zingahambisani nezidingo zabo. Ukulalelwa komphakathi kuzosiza ohulumeni nabaholi bezempilo ukuba baqonde kahle izinkinga ezikhona, izifiso, nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza, ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. 3. Izindlela zokulalela umphakathi Ukuze umphakathi ube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni kwe-NHI, kunezindlela eziningi zokulalela. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Imihlangano yomphakathi: Ukuhlela imihlangano lapho abantu bengavula khona izinkulumo, bevezwa imibono yabo, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa imibono ehlukene. - Uphenyo: Ukuqhuba uphenyo ukuze kuqoqwe imibono nemibuzo evela kubantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezidingekayo. - Izinkundla zokuxhumana: Ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze abantu bakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela abantu abaningi. - Izinhlelo zokufundisa: Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana ne-NHI ukuze abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi lolu hlelo luzosebenza kanjani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza. 4. Izinzuzo ze-NHI Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzoba nezinzuzo eziningi, okuhlanganisa: - Ukufinyelela kwezempilo: Abantu bazokwazi ukuthola ukwelashwa ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezindleko. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. - Ukunciphisa izindleko: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono ngenkathi kunciphisa izindleko. - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinsiza zezempilo, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela, odokotela, nezikhungo zezempilo. - Ukubandakanywa komphakathi: Uhlelo lwe-NHI luzokwenza kube lula ukubandakanya umphakathi ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza zezempilo, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. 5. Izinselelo ze-NHI Noma uhlelo lwe-NHI lunemigomo emihle, kunezinselelo ezithile ezidinga ukubhekwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: - Ukuxhaswa kwezimali: Ukuze uhlelo lwe-NHI luphumelele, kudingeka uxhaso lwezimali oluqinile. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuhlela kahle izinsiza zezimali. - Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza: Ukuze uhlelo lwe-NHI luphumelele, kudingeka ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi abaphathi bezempilo bazi kahle izidingo zomphakathi. - Ukubandakanywa kwabantu: Ukuze uhlelo lwe-NHI luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi abantu bazi kahle izidingo zabo. 6. Isiphetho Uhlelo lweMshwalense Wezempilo Kazwelonke (NHI) luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukulalela umphakathi kubalulekile ukuze lolu hlelo luphumelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babambe iqhaza, baveze imibono yabo, nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Ngokubambisana, singakha uhlelo lwezempilo oluphumelelayo noluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lwe-NHI lungaba yinsika yokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, futhi uma umphakathi ubambisene, sizokwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinhloso.
Umbiko Ngokuqhubeka Kokubhaliswa Kweziguli Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kubalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, njengoba kuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zezokwelapha. Le nqubo ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele, futhi idinga ukuphathwa kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kahle kwezinsiza kanye nezinqubo zokwelapha. Kulolu mbiko, sizobheka izinqubo zokubhaliswa kweziguli, izinselelo ezitholakala, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa le nqubo. Izinyathelo Zokubhaliswa Ukubhaliswa kweziguli kuvamise ukuqala lapho isiguli singena ebhedlela. Lokhu kuqukethe ukuthola ulwazi oluyisisekelo, njengokuthi igama, ubudala, ikheli, nezinombolo zocingo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ulwazi oluthinta impilo yesiguli, okufaka phakathi izimo zempilo ezedlule, imithi ethathwayo, kanye nezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nengqondo. Lezi zinyathelo zibalulekile ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukuqonda kahle isimo sesiguli futhi benze izinqumo ezifanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iziguli zidinga ukugcwalisa ifomu lokubhaliswa kwegama, eliqukethe amalungelo nezibopho zazo. Kubalulekile ukuthi iziguli ziqonde kahle ukuthi imininingwane abayinikezayo izosetshenziswa kanjani, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kwemininingwane yabo. Izinsiza Zokubhaliswa Ezibhedlela eziningi seziqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zedijithali zokubhaliswa kweziguli, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukugcina, nokwabelana ngemininingwane. Lokhu kusebenza kahle ngoba kunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda, futhi kukhulisa ukunemba kokubhaliswa. Izinhlelo zedijithali zenza kube lula ukufaka imininingwane, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho imininingwane edlulelwa phansi. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle, njengoba kudingeka ukuba kube nezinsiza ezifanele ukuze kuthuthukiswe lokhu kubhaliswa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ukuze bazi kahle ukusebenzisa lezi zinhlelo, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezinqubo eziphumelelayo zokubhaliswa kweziguli. Izinselelo Eziqhamukayo Nakuba ukubhaliswa kweziguli kubalulekile, kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nale nqubo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu iwukuntuleka kwemithombo. Ezibhedlela eziningi zihlupheka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwamathuluzi nemishini edingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukubhaliswa kuhamba kahle. Lokhu kungaholela ekubhalisweni okungalungile, okungase kubangele izinkinga ezinkulu ekwelashweni kweziguli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezinselelo ezithinta imiphakathi engabaziyo noma engakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizweni zezempilo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni ezinye iziguli zingabhaliswa kahle ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi, okungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukubhaliswa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukubhaliswa kweziguli, kubalulekile ukufaka izinhlelo zokuqwashisa. Lokhu kuzosiza iziguli ukuthi ziqonde kahle izinqubo zokubhaliswa, nezidingo zazo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo nabasizayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bazi kahle izinqubo zokubhaliswa, futhi banikeze usizo olufanele ezigulini. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezibhedlela nemiphakathi kuyasiza ekwakheni ukwaziswa okwanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokubhaliswa kweziguli, njengoba iziguli ziba nokwaziswa okwanele ukuze zifinyelele ezinsizweni. Isiphetho Ukubhaliswa kweziguli ezibhedlela kudinga ukunakwa okukhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Noma kunezinselelo eziningi, izinsiza zedijithali nezinhlelo zokuqwashisa zingasiza kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni le nqubo. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bahlanganyele ekuthuthukiseni le nqubo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola ukwelashwa okukhululekile, okuphumelelayo, futhi okunembile. Ukubhaliswa okuhle kweziguli kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yeziguli, futhi lokhu kumele kube yinto ebalulekile ezibhedlela zethu. Ngakho-ke, ukuqhubeka nokwenza ngcono izinqubo zokubhaliswa kweziguli kufanele kube yinjongo yazo zonke izibhedlela, ukuze kuhlonishwe impilo nezidingo zomphakathi.
Umbiko: Impilo Yengqondo Yentsha - Isingeniso Impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esinempilo, esiqinile, nesikwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ezijwayelekile empilweni. Njengoba intsha ibhekene nezinguquko eziningi, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta impilo yengqondo, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa intsha ukuze ibhekane nalezi zinkinga. Lo mbiko uzogxila ezicini ezahlukene ezithinta impilo yengqondo yentsha, izimbangela zalesi simo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Izici Ezithinta Impilo Yengqondo Yentsha Impilo yengqondo yentsha ithonywa yizinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa izimo zomndeni, ubudlelwano nabangane, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Ubudlelwano obuhle nomndeni bungasiza intsha ukuba ibhekane nezinkinga, kanti ubudlelwano obubi bungaholela ekwandeni kwezinkinga zengqondo. Izimo zomphakathi, ezifana nezinga lokuhlupheka, ukungasebenzi, kanye nezinkinga zokufunda, nazo zineqhaza elikhulu empilweni yengqondo yentsha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bukhona njengomthombo wezinkinga. Ukusetshenziswa kwezingxoxo zokuxhumana, izithombe, nezindaba ezitholakala ku-inthanethi kungaholela ekutheni intsha ibhekane nezinga eliphezulu lokucindezeleka, ukungazethembi, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhethekile ezibhekana nalezi zinkinga. Izinselelo Zempilo Yengqondo Yentsha Izinselelo ezithinta impilo yengqondo yentsha ziningi. Okwamanje, ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, kanye nokuziphatha okungafanele kuyizinkinga ezivamile. Intsha ibhekene nezimo ezinzima, ezifana nokuhlukumezeka, ukucwaswa, kanye nezinkinga zokuxhumana. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlukana, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuba bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zingaholela ekutheni intsha ibhekane nezinkinga ezinzima, ezifana nokuziphindisela, ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa, noma ukuzibulala. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi kubhekwe ngokushesha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi intsha ithola usizo oludingekayo. Izixazululo Nezindlela Zokuxhasa Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo yengqondo yentsha, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukufundisa intsha ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana. Izikole, imindeni, kanye nomphakathi kumele basebenzisane ukuze bakhe izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza intsha. Ukwenza izifundo ezithinta impilo yengqondo ezikoleni kungasiza intsha ukuba iqonde izinkinga zayo, futhi ibone ukuthi akayedwa kulolu hlobo lwezinkinga. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukufuna usizo uma kudingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana, lapho intsha ingakhuluma khona ngezinkinga zayo, kungasiza ekwakheni umuzwa wokuxhaswa. Isiphetho Impilo yengqondo yentsha ibalulekile ekwakheni isizukulwane esinempilo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta impilo yengqondo, izinselelo ezikhona, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa intsha. Ngokubambisana, imindeni, izikole, kanye nomphakathi bangakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukusiza intsha ukuba ibhekane nezinkinga zayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuba bakhe impilo yengqondo eqinile, futhi bakwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zempilo yansuku zonke. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise impilo yengqondo yentsha yethu.
Akukwazi ukusho ukuthi wonke amaphutha atholakala ezitshalweni awanobungozi. Ayingxenye yamaphutha alethela izifo ezitshalweni. Labo abanenkinga bangadla imbewu efakwe, abanye badla isitshalo ngesikhathi sikhula, abanye uma isitshalo sesiqinile, abanye badla imizi kanti abanye badla amahlamvu uma esephumile. Ukuphatha amaphutha kuhlobene kakhulu nezinto zokwakha (izinto zokwakha ezibulalayo amaphutha). Kukhona izinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala wonke amaphutha abuhlungu ezitshalweni. Izindlela zokuphatha amaphutha ezihlanganisiwe zingaba nomthelela omuhle - izindlela ezihlukene zisetshenziselwa ukuvimbela ukukhula kwamaphutha nokunciphisa izingozi abakhayo. Kukhona amaphutha ahlukene adla imbewu nezitshalo ezisanda ukuqala ukukhula, isibonelo: ama-wireworms, ama-beetles anama-spots, ama-cutworms, njll. Lawa maphutha anciphisa inani lezi mbewu ezifakwe futhi kuzodingeka ukufaka kabusha. Ukuphatha kahle lawa maphutha kuhlobene nokufaka umuthi wokubulala amaphutha ngendlela efanele, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka. Ukulima ebusika kuzosisiza ukuphatha amaningi ale maphutha - kudingeka ezinsukwini ezingu-35 noma ngaphezulu lapho engatholi isitshalo sokudla futhi abaningi bazofa. Imbewu ezizofakwa ingaphathwa ngombulala-maphutha, noma umuthi wokubulala amaphutha ungafakwa emhlabathini lapho kuzofakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokubeka isithako phezulu emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Insimu ye-maize ingaphonswa nomuthi wokubulala amaphutha ofanele. I-beetle enkulu enama-spots edla i-maize (Astylus Atromaculatus), i-cutworm (Agrotis Segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ingalive "doodhouertjie" (Protostrophus Sulcatifrons) kanye ne-harpalus beetle kungadala ubungozi obukhulu futhi kunciphise inani lezitshalo ensimini ethile. Ekugcineni, ngeke kutholakale inzuzo kule nsimu. I-African bollworm (Helicoverpa Armigera) ibhujisa isitshalo se-maize futhi ivule indlela yokungena kwezifo ezifana ne-Rhizopus Microsporus. Amaphutha adlayo afana ne-Nysius Nataensis angaphinde abhubhise imbewu ye-maize ekhula. Kukhona izinhlobo ezihlukene zezinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala izinhlobo ezihlukene zamaphutha angena esitshalo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi i-pest enobungozi bese ukhetha umuthi wokubulala amaphutha ofanele ukuze uwufake ngendlela efanele nangasikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwamaphutha kanye nokukhula kwesitshalo. Ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha ukuze ubulale amaphutha kungasiza ukuvimbela izingozi ezitshalweni, kodwa kubiza imali eningi - ngakho umnini wezolimo kufanele abale kahle ukuthi izindleko zizoba ziningi kangakanani. Kubalulekile ukuthi kubhekwe kahle lapho kudingeka ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha - kuzofika isikhathi lapho umnini wezolimo ebona ukuthi kubalulekile ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha ngoba ingozi ezitshalweni izoba phezulu kunezindleko zokufaka umuthi. Akukhuthazwa ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha ezitshalweni lapho amaphutha engakakhethi ingozi enkulu. Isizathu salokhu: kukhona ezinye izinhlobo zemvelo ezidla lawa maphutha, kodwa nazo zibhujiswa umuthi wokubulala amaphutha futhi amanye amaphutha athola amandla okuphila emithini ethile yokubulala amaphutha. Ukulima ngaphambi kokufaka imbewu kuyindlela enhle yokuvimbela izingozi zamaphutha. Kodwa inani lamaphutha kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zokuvimbela zingakhuphuki kakhulu. Kukhona ezinye izinhlobo zezithombo eziqinile ngokumelene namaphutha - lokhu kuzosisiza esikhathini esifushane ngoba ngeke kudingeke ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha, futhi esikhathini eside kuzosisiza ngoba inani lamaphutha azokwehla. Kungcono ukubheka konke bese usebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene ukuphatha lezi zifo - sebenzisa indlela ethile ngesikhathi esifanele esitshalo esithile. Ukuphatha amaphutha kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezolimo jikelele ngoba kunganciphisa noma kukhulise umkhiqizo kanye nezindleko zokukhiqiza ekugcineni. Izifo zezithombo zinciphisa umkhiqizo kanye nekhwalithi yokudla futhi zingadala izimpahla nabantu abathokozela leyo ndawo. Ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus adala izifo ezitshalweni. Lezi zingalimaza isitshalo sonke - imizi, iziqu, amahlamvu, kanye nezithelo. Lezi zifo ezihlukene zidinga izimo ezihlukene ukuze zikhule futhi zisakazeke. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma izimo zezulu zifanele, uma kukhona isitshalo lapho singakhula khona, futhi uma isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingabizwa ngokuthi (i-triangular) i-triangle eyinhloko yesifo. Uma eyodwa iphuthumile, isifo ngeke sikhule. Isifo esingase sibe khona ngesikhathi esithile endaweni ethile singase singabi khona ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba izimo zezulu zingashintsha. Njengoba i-maize ibiza kakhulu ukufaka, kuvame ukuthatha umzamo omningi ukubulala nokuphatha izifo ngezinto zokwakha. Ezinye izifo zivame ukuba khona kodwa azikhuli ngoba eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle iphuthumile. Kungcono ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela ezifo futhi zizophathwa kangcono. Kukhona izinto ezihlukene ezingakusiza ukuvimbela izifo ekukhuleni. Ezinye izinhlobo zezithombo zithola amandla okulwa nezifo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zindlela zokulwa nezifo zivame ukulwa kuphela nesifo esithile, hhayi wonke. Kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi isifo esingase sikhule endaweni ethile bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungakwazi ukulwa naleso sifo. Ukuphatha ngezinto zokwakha kusho ukusebenzisa umuthi wokubulala amaphutha obhalisiwe ukuze ubulale ama-fungi namabhaktheriya ezimweni ezithile zezulu. Kufanele ucabangele kahle izindleko zomuthi ngaphambi kokuwathenga. Izindlela zokulima emhlabathini zingaba yinto ebalulekile lapho sifuna ukuphatha izifo - iziqu ezisele ensimini zigcina ezinye zalezi zifo. Indlela esilima ngayo kufanele ibhekane nalokhu futhi kufanele sazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona. Ukushintsha izinhlobo zezithombo ensimini eyodwa kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinsuku ezanele ukuze iziqu ezisele ziqhume futhi zisebenze nomhlabathi. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezilindeleke ukuba zingene ezitshalweni, ukuze izitshalo ezifanele zikwazi ukukhethwa lapho zishintshwa. Isikhathi sokufaka imbewu singahambisana nokuphuma kwesifo esithile - ukufaka masinyane noma sekwephuzile kunganciphisa ukusakazeka kwesifo esithile. Ingxenye yezinto ezidalayo ingcindezi ihlobene nezifo. Izinto ezidalayo ingcindezi ezitshalweni zifaka: umswakama (ongaphezulu noma ongaphansi), ukushisa, ukubanda, ukungabi nezinto ezanele emhlabathini, ukungafaneleki, kanye nokulimala kwamaphutha. Uma sifuna ukuphatha izifo ngempumelelo, kufanele sizame ukususa eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle zalawo mazi. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sisebenzisa uhlelo lokuphatha izifo oluhlanganisiwe (ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezihlukene). Amahlamvu anama-spots adalwa yi-Septoria. Isifo se-Alternaria sitholakala ngama-spots amnyama emahlamvu, ez
Uthatha kahle izinkomo zakho noma izinkomo zezimboni zakho zikhombisa ukuthi uzinika ukudla kahle. Uzwakala kanjani uma ubheka umkhiqizo wakho omuhle? Ubuye ubheke izinkambu zakho ngemuva kokuvuna? Yini eyenza umlimi oyedwa aphumelele kanti omunye ehluleka? Singaxoxa ngalesi sihloko isikhathi eside. Kodwa konke lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izizathu zalokhu zihlobene nokuthi ibhizinisi lezolimo liphathwa kanjani - indlela yokuphatha umhlaba nezolimo? Kunezincazelo eziningi zokuphathwa kwezimboni, kodwa uma sihlanganisa zonke, zisho into efana kakhulu, zithi ukuphathwa kwezimboni "kuwukusebenzisa nokuhlanganisa zonke izinsiza ngendlela ezokwenza umphumela omuhle ebhizinisini lezolimo." Abanye bangase bashiye ukuthi lokhu kungase kwenzeke, kuyisiphephelo nje, kodwa ake sibheke incazelo esiqale ngayo: inhloso nenhloso yebhizinisi lezolimo. Singasho ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko ngaphezu kwazo zonke ezinye wukwenza inzuzo, hhayi kuphela inzuzo yamanje kodwa nezinsiza ezizotholakala esikhathini esizayo. Yebo, kuzoba nezinye izinhloso ezifana nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yokuphila kwakho, ukukhiqiza okuthile okuzodingwa ngabathengi, nezinye izinhloso. Kodwa zonke lezi zinhloso zingafezeka kuphela uma kukhona inzuzo. Nokho, akusiyo ngempela inhloso; abakhiqizi abaningi bakhetha ukuhlala emasimini futhi baphathe ibhizinisi labo lezolimo ngoba kuyimpilo enhle nepholile. Kodwa uma inzuzo ingasekho, le mpilo epholile ayisapholile. Lapho sikhuluma ngezindaba zezimali, inhloso izoba lokhu: imali oyifakile kufanele ibuyisele kuwe futhi engeziwe, ngamagama amanye, sifuna ukwenza inzuzo. Ngamafuphi, singasho ukuthi inani lenzuzo (P) lizotholwa uma sithatha imali engenayo (I) bese sithatha izindleko (E): (P = I - E noma I - E = P). Incazelo engenhla ikhuluma ngezinsiza njengabantu nezinto zomzimba; singasho ukuthi zihlobene nokukhiqiza: njengokuphatha ibhizinisi, abasebenzi, umhlaba, nemali etholakalayo. I-labor ihlobene nabasebenzi obaqashile. Umhlaba uhambisana nomhlaba (umhlabathi (izinkambu), izinkomo (izindawo zokugaya), amanzi). Imali etholakalayo ibhekisela emalini esandleni nakwezinye izinto ezingasuswa zafakwa kwenye indawo, njengezakhiwo, izithiyo, izinkanyezi, nezindawo zokugcina, njll., nezinto ezingahanjiswa zafakwa kwenye indawo, njengezithuthuthu, imishini, izimoto, izinkomo, nemali ezokhiqizwa, njll. Umsebenzi wokuphatha uhambisana nemisebenzi emine: ukudala amasu, ukuhlanganisa la masu, ukuwaphumeza, nokuphatha le misebenzi. Ukudala amasu kusho ukuthi kuzokwenzekani, kanjani, nini. Ukuhlanganisa amasu kusho ukuthi ubani ozokwenza okuthile, nini, kuphi kuzokwenzeka (izinsiza zizoya kuphi). Ukuwaphumeza kusho lokho kuphela: ukwenza nokuhlanganisa le misebenzi ezinkambini. Ukuphatha kusho ukuhlola okwenzekile - mhlawumbe bekulungele, mhlawumbe bekubi - nokuthi kwaba khona ini ngesikhathi amasu adalwa futhi ahlanganiswa, bese sithola izizathu ezizochaza izinto ezingahambanga kahle ukuze amaphutha angaphindiwa esikhathini esizayo; konke kufanele kuhambisane kahle. Ngesikhathi umphathi esebenzisa imisebenzi ethile ehambisana nemisebenzi emine, kufanele aqhubeke futhi abambe izigubhu; yibo abakhombisa indlela phambili, yibo abathumelelayo ukuxhumana nabasebenzi babo kwezolimo nakwabanye ngaphandle, yibo ababelana imisebenzi ethile kumuntu, yibo abahlanganisa izingxenye zebhizinisi labo, yibo abakhuthaza abasebenzi babo ukuba basebenze kahle, futhi yibo abaphatha kahle ngoba kufanele balandele futhi balalele lokho abakukhulumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma ibhizinisi lezolimo lifuna ukwenza inzuzo njalo futhi lifinyelele zonke izinhloso ezibekiwe, leli bhizinisi kufanele likwazi ukukhiqiza nokuthengisa le mveliso - ngakho-ke umkhiqizo kufanele ube okuthile okuzodingwa ngabathengi. Lapho sikhuluma ngomkhiqizo ojwayelekile, singasho ngokujwayelekile ukuthi kungaba ukudla, umkhiqizo (ukhukhamba), izinkomo (izinkomo), noma inyama nezinye izilwane. Lapho sikhuluma ngezidingo zabathengi, sikhuluma futhi ngezinto ezifana nekhwalithi nentengo yomkhiqizo, isikhathi esizotholakala noma ukufinyeleleka, indawo ezotholakala kuyo, nokuthi iyiphi uhlobo lokupakisha ezoba nakho. Ake sibuyisele ekubalwa kwenzuzo: inzuzo - izindleko = inzuzo/ukulahleka (I - E = P/L). Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi konke esikwenzayo noma esingakwenzi lapho siphatha ibhizinisi lethu kuzoboniswa kulokhu kubalwa kwenzuzo. Inzuzo ingakhula futhi yehlise, futhi ngendlela efanayo, izindleko zingakhula futhi zehlise. Siyacabangela lokhu ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho sisebenzisa ifoni ngaso sonke isikhathi; kuyadingeka ngempela noma cha. Siyacabangela lokhu uma sihamba edolobheni kaningi. Ingabe sinika izinkomo zethu ukudla okukhuthazayo uma kudingeka? Ingabe izithuthuthu nemishini zihlolwa njalo, zilungiswa uma kusen isikhathi? Ngakho-ke, ukuphathwa kwezimboni kungachazwa kanje: ukudala amasu, ukuhlanganisa, ukuwaphumeza, ukuphatha abasebenzi bakho, umhlaba wakho, nezinto zonke ezingafakwa kwenye indawo, nokuphatha zonke izinto ezingafakwa kwenye indawo nemali yokukhiqiza. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke kuphela uma umlimi eqhubeka, ethatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, exhumana nabasebenzi ukuze balalele, bese ekwazi ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo okudingwa ngabathengi futhi ezokwenza inzuzo. Imibuzo obuzile ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi ingabuye ibuzwe: ingabe udala amasu, ingabe uhambisana nawo, ingabe uwaphumeza, futhi ingabe uphatha kahle ukuze ube nempilo yezinkomo zakho? Ingabe udala amasu, ingabe uhambisana nawo, ingabe uwaphumeza, futhi ingabe uphatha kahle ukuze ube nezinkambu zakho? Ingabe udala amasu, ingabe uhambisana nawo, ingabe uwaphumeza, futhi ingabe uphatha kahle uma uqala ukukhiqiza ukudla - ingabe uthathile amasampula omhlabathi ukuze uhlole? Imisebenzi emine ingaqhathaniswa nezinqola zezimoto noma izithuthuthu. Iwashi ngalinye linomsebenzi walo; kumele likhishwe kahle ukuze imoto iqhubeke kahle. Uma iwashi elilodwa lingakhishwanga kahle noma linganawo umoya, imoto izokwazi ukuqhubeka kodwa ngezinselelo, ekugcineni, kuzokwenzeka ingozi, imoto izoma, futhi ngeke ikwazi ukuqhubeka. Lokhu kuyi-challenge (vuka!) esikhathini esizayo: uma indlela yakho yokuphatha ibhizinisi lakho ingathuthukisi unyaka nonyaka, ekugcineni ibhizinisi lakho lizoma, alizukuhamba, ngoba ngeke ukwazi ukwenza inzuzo. Awukwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho ngendlela efanayo unyaka nonyaka; kumele uthuthukise ngokwandisa imali engenayo nokwehlisa izindleko. Inzuzo ingakhuliswa ngokuthuthukisa ukumaketha noma ngokwandisa umkhiqizo ngehektare (ukhukhamba - ama-ton/hektare) noma ngokulima ngendlela ehlukile, njengokwenza ngcono amasu athile okukhiqiza noma ungashintsha izitshalo ozivamile ukuhlinzeka ngazo noma uhlanganise nezozikhumbulayo. Izindleko zingancishiswa ngokuzama ukuthola isivumelwano esingcono sentengo uma ufuna imali yokuqala yokutshalwa, noma ngokusebenzisa amasu
Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail Ngaphandle kokungabaza, u-Transnet Freight Rail (TFR) udlala indima enkulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika, ugqugquzela ukuhamba kwezimpahla ezisemqoka ezifana nezinsimbi, amalahle, kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Nokho, lo msebenzi ungenalo igatsha elingenazinkinga; kunezinselelo ezahlukene ezithinta ukwakheka nokusebenza kwezitimela, ezihilela konke ukusuka ezinhlelweni zokuhamba kuze kube yizinsizakalo zethu zamakhasimende. Njengomsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, u-Transnet Freight Rail uhlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi ezinjengokwakha izinhlelo ezisebenzayo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, kanye nezinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zemakethe. Uma kucutshungulwa izinhlelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezihlukahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwezitimela, okugcizelelwa umphakathi wobuchwepheshe kanye neziphakamiso ezithile ezaziswa ekwakheni izinhlelo eziqinile. Okwokuqala, enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezibhekene noTransnet Freight Rail wukugcinwa kwegatsha lezitimela elihamba phambili. Ngobuchwepheshe besimanjemanje, ukuthengwa nokugcina kwezinsiza kubalulekile, kodwa izintela eziphezulu nezindleko zazo noshintsho kwemakethe kudala enkinga enkulu. U-Transnet kufanele aqhamuke nezixazululo eziphumelelayo ukuze aqhube ukusebenza komnyango, ukukwenza kube lula ukufika nezimpahla endaweni efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokuphambene, izinqubo zokuhamba kwezimpahla zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kokusebenza. Ukungagcinwa kwezitimela, ukwenziwa kwezibuyekezo, kanye nezimfuneko zezokuphepha zidinga ukuphakanyiswa. Noma izimoto ezihamba phambili zithuthukiswa, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yokuphepha kuhlelwa, okuqukethe ukugijima ngezivivinyo ezijulile, ukwenza izifundo zokwakha, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwemithetho. Lezi zimo zingadala izinkinga phakathi nalesi sikhumbuzo sezinsuku, okungaholela ekwehleni kokuphepha kumgibeli. Ukwanda kwemikhuba yokuthutha ehlakazekileyo kuholela ekwandeni kwezinsizakalo zezimoto. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuncinta okuthile emsebenzini wezitimela, kanti izinkampani ezincane zidinga ukwakha izinsizakalo ezihlanganisa ukwakheka kwezitimela, okuholela ekwandeni kwemigqa ethile. U-Transnet kufanele abheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezincane, ezizaqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisebenzayo. Ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngesivinini, futhi lokhu kuchaza ukuthi u-Transnet kufanele uhlale uphezu kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha—kufaka phakathi izinhlelo zokuphatha, ukubhaliswa kwemoto, kanye nezinjini ezisebenza ngogesi—kunomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini wezitimela. Ngaleso sikhathi, inqobo kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisheshayo, izimfuno zamakhasimende zibe nezimpilo ezinzima. Umphumela oyinhloko walesi sikhumbuzo unendlela yokugcina amakhona amaningana, okufanele amukelekayo futhi ahambisane nokuhamba kahle komnyango. Izinkinga zokusuliswa kwezimpahla ezindlini zikhuphuka kakhulu, kubonakala sengathi abathengisi abahambisani nemithetho yeTransnet. Ukuze u-Transnet ahlale engaphansi, zidingeka izindawo ezinhle zokuhamba, ezizohlinzeka ngokuqina kokuhamba kwezimpahla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungakwazi ukuya phambili ezindleleni, umgwaqo, izindawo zokuhweba nezikhumulo zayo ezithokozisayo. Ekugcineni, uTransnet Freight Rail uphila phakathi kwezinselelo ezinzima ezithinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Izinkinga zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izicelo zobuchwepheshe, kanye nokuphepha kwezimoto zikhombisa ubuhlungu futhi zibekiwe kwikhalenda. Nokho, lezi zinselelo zingase zibe yithuba lokukhiqiza izixazululo ezintsha, nokukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha ukuze kuqede impumelelo yokusebenza. Ukuba uTransnet uthathe izinyathelo ezithile, sizokwazi ukubona intuthuko enkulu emkhakheni wokuhamba ngezitimela, engasiza ubuchwepheshe bwayo besimanje, kanti ezithinta izimfuno ezinkulu zomphakathi. Lokhu niphezulu kuzo zonke izinyathelo kanye nokuhamba phambili kwezinto ezishintshashintshayo emikhakheni yakhe yokusebenza. Lezi zinselelo zidinga izixazululo ezinkulu ezinhle, futhi uTransnet uzohamba phambili uma uphumelela kulolu hlelo.
INyuvesi yasePitoli: Umhlahlandlela Wokungena Nokufunda Isingeniso INyuvesi yasePitoli, enezimpande ezijulile emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika, iyinhlangano yemfundo ephakeme edumile, enikeza abafundi amathuba amaningi okufunda, ukukhula, nokuthuthukiswa. Le nyuvesi ibekwe edolobheni elikhulu lasePitoli, inikeza izifundo ezihlukahlukene ezivela ezindaweni eziningi, kubandakanya ezemfundo, ezobuchwepheshe, nezokwelapha. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezisemqoka zokungena, izinhlelo zokufunda, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kubafundi. Isinyathelo 1: Ukufaka Isicelo Ukuze ufinyelele kwiNyuvesi yasePitoli, umphakathi kufanele uqale ngokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kusebenza ngale ndlela: 1. Thola Ulwazi: Vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeNyuvesi yasePitoli ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile ngezinhlelo zokufunda, izidingo zokungena, nezinsuku zokugcina zokufaka izicelo. 2. Khetha Uhlelo: Bheka izifundo ezitholakalayo futhi ukhethe uhlelo oluhambisana nezifiso zakho nezifundo ozifundile. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izimfuneko ezithile ezihambelana nohlelo olukhona. 3. Faka Isicelo: Uma usukhethile uhlelo, landela izinyathelo zokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukugcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile, nezincwadi ezifanele ezikhombisa izifundo zakho zokugcina. 4. Thola Imiphumela: Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo, linda imiphumela. Ukuze uthole ulwazi olungcono, ungahamba ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zeNyuvesi ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi uthola izibuyekezo eziwusizo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukubhaliswa Uma usuthole imvume yokufunda kwiNyuvesi yasePitoli, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukubhaliswa: 1. Hlela Ukuze Ube Nendawo: Ngaphambi kokubhaliswa, qinisekisa ukuthi unayo indawo yokuhlala, nokuthi uhlanganise izinsiza ezidingekayo, njengamakhadi okukhumbuza, izincwadi zokuhamba, nezincwadi ezisemthethweni. 2. Bhalisela Izifundo: Ukuze ubhalise ezifundweni, sebenzisa i-portal yeNyuvesi. Landela imiyalelo ethile yokubhaliswa, uqinisekise ukuthi uhlela izifundo zakho kahle ukuze uthole umqondo omuhle wezifundo ozokwenza. 3. Qedela Izinkokhelo: Phakathi kokubhaliswa, kudingeka uqedele izinkokhelo ezihambisana nezifundo zakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela izindlela ezimisiwe zokukhokha ukuze ungabhekani nezinkinga. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuqala Ukufunda Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, sekuyisikhathi sokuhlela ukuqala nezifundo: 1. Thola Izinsiza Zokufunda: Vakashela emtapo wolwazi, uzitholele izincwadi, amaphephabhuku, nezinsiza zedijithali ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho. Umsebenzi wokuqala uwukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze uqonde kahle izifundo zakho. 2. Hlangana Nabanye Abafundi: Xhumana nabanye abafundi, uzame ukujoyina amaqembu okufunda ukuze uthole ukuxhaswa. Ukwazi abanye abafundi kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda. 3. Bamba Izifundo: Hamba ezifundweni zakho, uqinisekise ukuthi uthuthuka nezifundo zakho. Qhubeka uhlole izidingo zenkambiso yakho yokufunda futhi ube nekhono lokuphendula izimfuno zakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukusebenzisa Izinsiza ZaseNyuvesi INyuvesi yasePitoli inikeza izinsiza eziningi kubafundi. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazisebenzisa: 1. Umsebenzi Wokweseka Abafundi: Izinsiza zokweseka abafundi zikhona, njengezikhungo zokweluleka, izikhungo zokuphatha, nezikhungo zokufunda. Thola isikhathi sokuxhumana nabahloli ukuze uthole usizo. 2. Izinhlelo Zokubambisana: Bamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokubambisana, njengezinhlelo zokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuxhumana nabanye, noma imisebenzi yokuzithandela. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukujwayela impilo yaseNyuvesi. 3. Ukufinyelela Ezindaweni Zokuphumula: Sebenzisa izindawo zokuphumula, izindawo zokudlela, nezikhangiso zamaholide. Ukuhlanganyela kulezi zindawo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuyeka isikhathi sokuphumula. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuhola Izifundo zakho Ukuze uphumelele kwiNyuvesi yasePitoli, kubalulekile ukuhola izifundo zakho: 1. Hlela Isikhathi: Bhala phansi izinsuku zokuhlola, izinsuku zokugcina zokufaka izincwadi, nezinsuku zokuhlangana nabafundi. Ukuhlela isikhathi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphumelela. 2. Thola Umeluleki: Xhumana nomeluleki wakho ukuze uthole izeluleko ezithile mayelana nezifundo zakho. Umeluleki angasiza ngokunikeza iziphakamiso ezizokwenza ukuthuthukisa izifundo zakho. 3. Hlola Izifundo: Phatha izifundo zakho, uhlole ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ezidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqonda kahle izifundo zakho. Isiphetho INyuvesi yasePitoli iyindawo enezinhlobonhlobo zemfundo ethokozisayo, futhi ukufunda kule nyuvesi kungaba yithuba elikhulu lokukhula. Ngemiyalelo echazwe ngenhla, ungakha izinyathelo ezinhle zokungena, ukubhaliswa, kanye nokuqhubeka neziqu zakho. Qhubeka ufunde, uphumelele, futhi ube neqhaza elihle emiphakathini yakho nasemhlabeni. Ngethemba lokuthi uzoba neziqu eziphakeme kule nyuvesi kanye nezifundo ezizokwenza ube ngumholi ophumelelayo.
Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu Kwake kwaba khona emaphakathini amancane, izindawo ezinhle ezazikha phezulu ezindaweni ezimhlophe, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya khona ngobuhle bazo. Kule ndawo, uMnumzane Jabulani, oneminyaka engama-60, wayehamba ngebhasi lakhe lezemidlalo, edabula izintaba eziphakeme nezimfudumalo. UJabulani wayehlonishwa ngababukeli, ngenxa yokuhlonipha nokunakekela imvelo. Njalo ngoMsombuluko, ubaba Jabulani wayeqala usuku lwakhe ngokuhamba uye emoyeni, ethanda ukuzwa umoya opholile uhamba phakathi kwezihlahla. Kodwa namuhla kwaba nokuthile okungajwayelekile. Izinyoni, ezazithokozisa ngengoma yazo, zazithule. Izihlahla, ezazihamba phezu kwendawo, zaziza nezinyembezi. UJabulani wacabanga ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ngemuva kokuhamba, uJabulani wabona umbala obomvu, owawukhanya emkhathini. Uma ebheka phezulu, wabona izinkanyezi zihlala zikhanya, kodwa kube khona umoya omkhulu, okwakuhambisana nezinto ezishisayo ezazikhipha umoya omubi. UJabulani wanqena ukuba konakalisa imvelo, kodwa akazange athathe lezi zimo kalula. "Kukhona okungahambi kahle," wacabanga. UJabulani wathola ukuthi izitshalo ziqala ukushabalala, izilwanyana ziya phezulu zibhakabhaka, nokuthi izinkanyezi eziluhlaza ziye zashintsha zaba mnyama. Umphakathi wawusokhakhathini, futhi abantu babengaphili kahle. UJabulani, njengomfowethu, wathatha isinqumo. Waqala ukuhlela umhlangano wesigceme, lapho abantu bangaba khona ukuze baxoxe ngalesi simo esinzima. Kuzongxoxwa ngezindlela zokuvikela imvelo nokubuyisela indlela esiphila ngayo. "Siyabonga uNkulunkulu, kodwa sinesibopho sokukhulisa imvelo yethu," kusho uJabulani. Abantu bacasuka, behlola ubukhona bezinkanyezi, bejabulisa ngempela, kodwa bebona ukuthi izinguquko zikhona. UJabulani wabona ukuthi kudinga umzamo ongenamkhawulo. Bafaka izinhlelo zokukhulisa izihlahla, baqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuvuselela imvelo. UJabulani wabona ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akukhona nje ukuphazamiseka, kodwa kuyinselele efinyelela kubo bonke. Izindlela zokuvikela imvelo zaba yimpumelelo, futhi abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo idinga ukunakekelwa. Kwaze kwaba yimpumelelo, izitshalo zabuya zakhula futhi izilwanyana zafika, izinyoni zaphinda zathokozisa, futhi izinkanyezi zikhanya kakhulu emkhathini. UJabulani wababiza bonke babukele lezi zinkanyezi, ukuze bazethembe, futhi baveze lokhu okubhalwe emandleni. "Umhlaba wethu uhlezi, kodwa udinga ukuba sibe nesibopho. Ngaphandle komhlaba, asikho," wakhuluma uJabulani. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi waba nolwazi, walwela ukugcina imvelo, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela lezi zinto ezinhle. Ngalesi sikhathi, uJabulani wakwazisa osomabhizinisi ukuthi bangasebenzisa izinsiza zabo ukusiza ukugcinwa kwemvelo. Bafaka izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela imvelo, bese benza izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokulima. UJabulani waba yisibonelo, umholi wezinguquko, futhi umphakathi wawuhlala ungena emhlabeni omusha. Ngesikhathi uhamba emkhathini, uJabulani wathokozisa umoya opholile, wabona izinkanyezi zikhanya kakhulu. Wayezazi kahle ukuthi umhlaba ubuhlungu, kodwa abanye babekwazi ukuguqula, futhi ukuthi bonke kumele basebenze ndawonye. "Akekho ongakwenza yedwa, kodwa uma sikhonza ndawonye, sizokwazi ukuvuna," wakhuluma uJabulani. Ngale ndlela, umphakathi wathola isifundo esijulile, ngokuqonda ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akusona isimo esiphakeme, kodwa yisinyathelo esifanele sokubhekana nemvelo. Ngakho, uJabulani waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi imvelo iyigugu, futhi kufanele siyinakekele, ukuze kuzotholakale izinkanyezi ezikhanya njalo. Ngale ndlela, uJabulani waqhubeka nohambo lwakhe, enza umhlaba ube ngcono. Kanjalo, izinkanyezi zenza ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi imvelo iyisisekelo sokuphila kwethu, futhi kufanele sizithande, sizigcine ukuze zihlale zikhanya.
Umbiko: Ukushoda Kwamithi Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela sekuyinkinga enkulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu kubantu abanesidingo semithi, kubandakanya abazithola ezibhedlela, emitholampilo, nasemakhaya. Ukushoda kwemithi kudinga ukuthi kukhishwe izixazululo eziphusile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola imithi abayidingayo ukuze baphile impilo engcono. Ukwanda Kokushoda Kwamithi Ezemitholampilo eNingizimu Afrika zikhombisa ukuthi ukushoda kwemithi akukhona nje kuphela ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza, kodwa futhi kubangelwa yizizathu ezihlukahlukene. Okokuqala, imitholampilo ikhalela ukungabi khona kokwanele kwemali yokuthenga imithi. Ngaphandle kwemali eyanele, abahlinzeki bezempilo abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemithi eyanele kubantu abadinga ukwelashwa. Okwesibili, izinkinga zokuhamba kwemithi zikhona. Imitholampilo eminingi ibhekene nezinkinga zokuthola imithi efanele ngesikhathi, okwandisa isikhathi sokulinda kwabantu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abahlinzeki bemithi badinga ukuxhumana nezinkampani ezinkulu ezithengisa imithi, futhi uma lezi zinkampani zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka, imithi iyashoda. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kwamithi Ukushoda kwemithi kudala umthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Abantu abangenayo imithi abayidingayo bahlala besaba ukuvela kwezifo, okwandisa umphumela wokugula. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokungaphili kahle, okwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuqhuba imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Isibonelo, abantu abaneziguli ezinzima ezifana nesifo sikashukela, umkhuhlane, noma isifo sezinso, badinga imithi ethile ukuze baphile. Uma le mithi ingatholakali, izinga labo lokuphila lincipha, futhi bangaqhubeka bephila ngokweqile, kwandise umthwalo wezempilo ohlinzekwa ohulumeni. Izixazululo Zokulwa Nokushoda Kwamithi Ukuze kuphumelele ekulweni nokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela, kudingeka izixazululo eziphusile. Okokuqala, uhulumeni kufanele aqinise izinsiza ezikhona ukuze akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemithi efanele. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokwandisa imali ethunyelwa ezibhedlela, kanye nokuqinisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabahlinzeki bemithi nabathengi. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni abambisane nezinkampani ezithengisa imithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imitholampilo iyathola imithi ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ekuhlinzekeni ngemithi ngesikhathi, okuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka kubantu abadinga imithi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisiza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela imithi online kungasiza kakhulu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imithi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Isiphetho Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela kuyinkinga ebalulekile edinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Imiphumela yokushoda kwemithi ibonakala kahle, futhi izixazululo eziphusile kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola imithi abayidingayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngemithi efanele akusizi kuphela abantu abanesidingo, kodwa kuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi jikelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abathintekayo, kufaka phakathi uhulumeni, abahlinzeki bemithi, nezinkampani, basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle kakhulu kubantu bonke.
Ukuhlinzeka ababhali bezinqubomgomo ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze bahlolisise ukusebenza kweMthetho Wenkqubo Yezobugebengu eNingizimu Afrika ngokusekelwe ezinzwaneni zesayensi. Izinguquko noma izichibiyelo ezidingekayo mayelana nezindlela nemithetho yokwethulwa kwezinsiza ezimfanele ezimweni zobugebengu, ibhayi nezindlela nemithetho yokwahlulela, iziboshwa ezilindele ukuhamba phambili, kanye nokugcwala eziboshweni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle nokusebenza kahle kohlelo lwezobulungiswa. Uma kudingeka, umhlangano wokuhlanganisa nokubambisana nabatholi bezinzuzo zeMthetho Wenkqubo Yezobugebengu, kufaka phakathi abamele iminyango kahulumeni, othisha ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, kanye nomphakathi wasemadolobheni. Ithimba lokubuyekeza ubulungiswa bezobugebengu (Ithimba Lokubuyekeza); kanye nethimba lokuphatha ubulungiswa bezobugebengu nocwaningo ngezindlela ezingasiza (Ithimba Locwaningo). Ukuqinisekisa ukusabalalisa imiphumela yokugcina kubo bonke ababambiqhaza abathintekayo. UNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo kumele abe uSihlalo weThimba Locwaningo. Ukukhulula yonke imiphumela ekhulumayo ngenhla. Ibhodi ehlinzeka ngosizo lwezomthetho; kanye nethimba labacwaningi abaqonda umsebenzi wabo, kuhlanganise neKomidi Lokulungisa Umthetho laseNingizimu Afrika. UMsunguli-Jikelele weMnyango wezeMthetho Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo kumele abe uSihlalo weThimba Locwaningo. Iofisi ye-secretariat kumele isungulwe ukuze ixhase amaThimba Ocwaningo Nokubuyekeza, futhi i-secretariat kumele ibekwe eMnyangweni wezeMthetho Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. Umbiko wokugcina kumele uthunyelwe kuMongameli wezwe, unyaka owodwa kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lomhlangano weThimba, ngemibiko yesikhashana, uma kudingeka.
Umshado Nomndeni: Indaba Yomlando Umshado, njengomcimbi obalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ubalulekile emiphakathini eminingi. Ngaphambi kokuba sithathe uhambo olujulile emlandweni, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umshado akukhona nje kuphela ukuxhumana phakathi kwababili, kodwa futhi kuyisixhumanisi esiqinisa imindeni, imiphakathi, nezinkolo. Ekuqaleni, umshado wawuhlonishwa kakhulu, futhi wawuhlanganisa izinkolelo namasiko ahlukahlukene. Emazweni amaningi, umshado wawuhlinzekwa ngamalungelo nezibopho, okwakuhlanganisa imindeni emibili. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha imindeni eqinile, lapho abantwana bephuma khona, beshaya izinyathelo ezilandelayo emlandweni. Ngokwesibonelo, emiphakathini yamaZulu, umshado wawuhlanganisa izinkanyezi eziningi, ezazihlanganisa imishado yesintu, imishado yezinkolo, kanye nemishado yezenhlalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindlela zokwenza umshado zashintsha. Kwamanye amazwe, umshado waba yinto ethokozisayo, lapho izivakashi zifika khona ukuze zibhakabhake imishado emikhulu. Emazweni amaningi, izinkampani ziqala ukwakha izinhlelo ezizimele zokuhlela imishado, okwakuhlanganisa izinsiza eziningi, kusukela ezindaweni zokuhlala, izipho, kuze kube nezinsiza zokudla. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umshado ube yinto ebizayo, kodwa futhi ube yinto ethokozisayo. Emiphakathini ethile, umshado wawuhlanganiswa nezinkolelo ezinzima. Ngokwesibonelo, emiphakathini yamaXhosa, umshado wawuhlanganiswa nemikhuba ethile, efana nokuhlonza izinsiza ezithile nezimfanelo zomuntu ofuna ukushada. Lokhu kwakuholela ekwakheni umshado onobudlelwano obuqinile, lapho umyeni nomkakhe benza izivumelwano ezithile ukuze bagcine ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umshado waba nempilo ehlukile. Ekuqaleni, umshado wawuhamba nezinselelo eziningi, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ezinkolweni. Kwamanye amazwe, umshado wawuhlotshaniswa nezinkinga ezinkulu, ezifana nezimpi, izifo, kanye nezinguquko zezombusazwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezinselelo ezinzima, futhi umshado waba yindlela yokugcina ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka emshadweni. Izinkampani ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukahlukene, ezihlanganisa izinsiza zokuthenga, izindawo zokuhlala, kanye nezinsiza zokudla. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwemishado emikhulu, lapho izivakashi zifika khona ukuze zibhakabhake imishado emikhulu. Nokho, lezi zinguquko zashintsha indlela abantu abakhuluma ngayo ngempilo yomshado. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umshado waba yindlela yokwakha imindeni eqinile, lapho abantwana bephuma khona. Imindeni yathola amandla okukhulisa abantwana, futhi umshado waba yindawo yokufundisa izimiso ezibalulekile. Abazali babefundisa izingane zabo ukuthi umshado uyisibopho, futhi kufanele uhlonishwe. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni imindeni enobudlelwano obuhle, lapho abantwana bephila khona ngaphakathi kwemikhuba ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umshado waba yindlela yokuhlanganisa imiphakathi. Emazweni amaningi, imishado ibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemindeni, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile, lapho abantu bephila khona ngokuhlanganyela. Umshado wawuhlanganisa abantu abaningi, futhi kwaba yindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemiphakathi. Ekugcineni, umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Umshado unikeza abantu ithuba lokwakha imindeni eqinile, futhi uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhula komphakathi. Nokho, kumele sihloniphe izinkolelo nemikhuba ehlukahlukene, ukuze siqonde kahle ukuthi umshado ungenza kanjani umthelela empilweni yethu. Umshado awuwona nje umcimbi, kodwa uyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando wethu, futhi kufanele siwuhloniphe. Ngakho-ke, umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezihambisana, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sikhuluma ngempilo yethu, sihlinzeke ngothando, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imindeni yethu iqinile. Umshado ungumthombo wothando, ubudlelwano, kanye nezinselelo, futhi kufanele siwuhloniphe ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Amagama akhanyisiwe achaza izichibiyelo ezenziwe emthethweni osekhona. Kubandakanya ukuphathwa kukamasipala ngokuphumeza ukuqoqa intela yezindlu; ukulungisa umthetho weMiphakathi: Umthetho Wokwakhiwa Kwamakhaya ka-2000, ukuze kuqhubeke futhi kuqinisekiswe izinhlinzeko zokuthi amakhaya athumele izaziso; ukulungisa noma ukususa eminye imithetho; kanye nokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene. Isihloko esifingqiwe kanye nokuqala komthetho. Imetropolitan municipality noma i-local municipality ingakha intela yezindlu ezindaweni ezibekwe yibo. I-district municipality ayikwazi ukuklama intela yezindlu ngaphandle uma indawo ingaphakathi kwedolobha elibekwe yilolo dolobha. Ezinye izinhlinzeko zalo mthetho; kanye nenqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu okumele amakhaya avume ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sesi-3. Ikhansela likamasipala kumele ivume inqubomgomo ehambisana nalomthetho mayelana nokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu ezindlini noma ezindaweni ezibhekene nentela yezindlu kumakhaya. Ivumela amakhaya ukuba akhuthaze intuthuko yendawo; futhi kulandela ukuhlaziywa okujulile mayelana nezindleko nezinhlelo zenzuzo, zonke izindlu noma impahla ezingase zingafakiwe ngaphansi kohlelo lokuhlola ngenhloso yokwakha intela yezindlu. Noma iyiphi imali ebuyisiwe, ukulungiswa, noma ukuncishiswa okukhulunywa ngesigaba sesi-2 futhi kucatshangelwa enqubweni yenqubomgomo evunyelwe kumasipala kumele ihambisane nezinga likazwelonke elingase lilawulwe ukuze lisetshenziswe. Ikhansela likamasipala kumele libheke zonke iziphakamiso ezamukelwe nezibhalwe ezithunyelwe kulo ngesikhathi sokucubungula izinga lenqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. Ikhansela likamasipala kumele lihlaziye minyaka yonke, futhi uma kudingeka, lishintshe inqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. Izigaba ezi-3 nezingu-4, ezifundwa ndawonye nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo njengoba kuxoxiwe, zisetshenziselwa noma yiziphi izinguquko zenqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. I-local municipality kumele ivume ukuthi imithetho yamasipala ifaka isandla ekusebenzeni nasekuphumezeni inqubomgomo yayo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. a ngezigaba ezihlukene zezakhiwo nezindawo; futhi b ngezizinda ezihlukene zabaphathi abaphethe ukukhokha intela yezindlu. Uma i-municipality inquma ukuklama intela yezindlu, kumele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala, iklame intela yezindlu kuzo zonke izakhiwo noma ezindaweni okufanele zibe nezibopho zokukhokha intela yezindlu ngaphakathi kwamasipala noma endaweni engaphansi komthetho we-local municipality efanele ukukhokha intela yezindlu. i uma i-municipality uqobo noma enye i-municipality ingum sahibi; noma ii njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni b encazelweni yomhlaba noma impahla esigabeni sokuqala; noma iii lapho ilungelo lokuba nomhlaba lingavikelwe ngokomthetho ngenxa yemithetho eyayiphikisana nezinhlelo noma ezinye izizathu ezenza kube nzima noma kungenzeka ukuba kutholakale inani; noma b ukuvimbela i-municipality ekunikezeni amalungelo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sika-14 mayelana nezimali ezibuyisiwe, noma ukukhokha okweqile noma ukuncishiswa ekukhokheni intela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala. b ukusetshenziswa okugunyaziwe kwempahla noma indawo; noma c indawo lapho impahla ikhona. Imali yentela yezindlu ohlelweni lwendawo lapho yakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela empahleni eyodwa kumele iklanywe ngokuhlukile ngokuhambisana nosayizi walowo mhlaba okufanele ube nezibopho zalolu hlelo hhayi iklanywe njengemali eyodwa ehlanganisa yonke indawo. a kufanele kube yimali esekelwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenani lentela yezindlu yaleyo mpahla njengoba kuboniswe ephepheni lokuhlola likamasipala ngaleso sikhathi; noma b intela efanayo empahleni noma endaweni emkhakheni okhethekile, kuye ngokuthi leyo ndawo ingaphansi kwesilinganiso sokuhlola esisemthethweni. Imali efanayo yentela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala b akufanele idlule imali okufanele ikhokhwe empahleni noma emhlabeni ezingeni eliphansi lokuhlonza ngokuhambisana nokuhlola ukuthi le mali iklanywe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala a. Intela yezindlu ingaklanywa ngamasipala ngaphezu kweminyaka eyodwa yezezimali ngaphandle kokugunyazwa nguNgqongqoshe wezokuphatha. a iqala ekuqaleni kweminyaka yezezimali noma ngosuku olukhulunywe njengoba lokhu kungase kubonise isinqumo esixoxiwe esigabeni sika-13 mayelana nokwakhiwa kwenani lentela yezindlu; futhi b ayikwazi ukuklanywa ukuba ibuyiselwe emuva. Imali yentela yezindlu iklanywa ngamasipala kulandela isinqumo esithathwe ikhansela likamasipala esekelwa ukhetho olunengi lwamalungu ale khansela. i ukuthi ikhansela lamukele isinqumo sokwakha inani lentela yezindlu; futhi ii ikhophi yesinqumo kumele itholakale ukuze icubungulwe emphakathini phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ehhovisi elikhulu lokuphatha le municipality nezinye izindawo ezichaziwe kule nsiza. a uhlu lwabo bonke abathola imali ebuyisiwe, labo abakhokhelwe, nalabo abathole ukuncishiswa ngonyaka odlule ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala; futhi b isitatimende sikhombisa imali ethole i-municipality yangaphambili ngemuva kwemali ebuyisiwe, ukulungiswa, kanye nokuncishiswa. b imisebenzi yezomnotho engagciniwe kulolo masipala; noma c ukuthuthwa kwezimpahla ngaphakathi kwelizwe, ukuthumela izidingo, imali, noma abasebenzi. h Okungenani inani lokuqala le-R15,000 lenani lezindlu zonke lapho zakhiwe khona futhi zihlala khona, ngaphandle kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi uNgqongqoshe, ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali, angakhuphula le mali ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ukuze ihambisane nezinga lezomnotho ngaleso sikhathi; futhi i Impahla/umhlaba noma izigaba zezakhiwo/umhlaba njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni sika-3, noma inani lentela yezindlu elibekwe enanini elibekwe njengemkhawulo empahleni/indawo noma emkhakheni wezindlu noma indawo. i izindawo zomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zokulima isilinganiso esixoxiwe esigabeni sika-1 b singashicilelwa kuphela ngokusemthethweni ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali nangesaziso, abeke umkhawulo kumaphesenti okukhuphuka kwenani lentela yezindlu ngonyaka. a kanye nezinhlobo zamakhaya angase, kulandela lesi sigaba, achazwe esazisweni njengokuhambelana nezigaba noma izinhlobo zamakhaya ngaphansi kohlobo lomthetho wezakhiwo zikamasipala nangokunye; noma b izinhlobo zezakhiwo/izigaba uma kukhona isizathu esihle, uNgqongqoshe angavuma ukubuyiselwa kumakhaya ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ebekwe kulandela isigaba sokuqala. Inani lentela yezindlu eliklanywe endaweni entsha ebhekene nentela yezindlu noma endaweni lapho umnini enamalungelo ngaphansi kohlelo lokulungiswa komhlaba kumele ngok
Le ncwadi iqukethe ulwazi olujwayelekile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola. Ulwazi oluthile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola ofuna ukuhlanganyela kuzo noma okukhuthazwa ukuba uhambisane nazo kumele lunikezwe yilabo abahola uphenyo lwezifundo. Uphenyo lwezokwelapha luyisifundo sokucwaninga esihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, nokusebenza kwemithi emisha noma ekhona, izindlela zokwelapha, noma amadivayisi wezokwelapha, usebenzisa abahlanganyeli. Ukuphepha kubhekisela ekutheni indlela yokwelapha noma umuthi ingase ibe nezingozi noma ibangele umonakalo empilweni yomuntu. Ukusebenza kahle kusho ukuthi kukhona umphumela ekuhloleni, ekwelapheni, ekuvimbeleni, noma ekwelapheni isifo. Lokhu kungase kudinge ukufanisa imiphumela phakathi kwemithi/emithini emibili. Ikhwalithi ibhekisela ekuqinisekiseni okuphelele komuthi noma indlela yokwelapha, noma ukungenelela kwezokwelapha okuvumela ukuthi kusebenze kahle nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kulezo zimo ezilindelekile ngesikhathi sokwelashwa komuntu ogulayo, ngaphandle kokubeka engcupheni umsebenzisi womuthi. Igama elithi "umuthi" libhekisela kumithi esetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo (imithi yokwelapha), ukuvimbela izifo (imithi yokuvimbela, efana nezivithamini), kanye nemithi esetshenziselwa izifundo ezithile (imithi yokuhlola, efana naleyo esetshenziswa kuma-X-ray ukuze kutholakale izitho zomzimba). Ngaphambi kokuthi umuthi noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwe kubantu, kuqala ifundwa isikhathi eside emalabhorethri nakweminye imfuyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwayo nokusebenza kahle. Ukuhlola imithi emisha, izivithamini, nezindlela zokwelapha kubantu kuvame ukudlula ezinyathelweni eziningi njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Isigaba sokuqala: Lesi yisigaba sokuqala lapho umuthi, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwa eqenjini elincane labazithandayo abaphilile. Izifundo zokuhlola isigaba sokuqala zihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha okuphelele, umthamo ophephile, kanye nemiphumela engase ibe khona yomuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha. Isigaba sesibili: Esigabeni sesibili, umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwa eqenjini elikhulu labantu, imvamisa amahlandla amakhulu abavolontiya abaphilile kanye nalabo abanesifo okufanele silashwe ngalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesibili wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle komuthi, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iyasebenza. Isigaba sesithathu: Kulesi sigaba, umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwa ezinkulungwaneni zabantu abanesifo okufanele silashwe ngalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesithathu wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukusebenza kahle kanye nemiphumela engase ibe khona yomuthi, isivithamini, noma enye indlela yokwelapha emisha uma kuqhathaniswa nomuthi, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ekhona (enelayisensi). Isigaba sesine: Kulesi sigaba, ukuhlolwa kwenziwa ngemuva kokuthi umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ibhaliswe yi-MCC, okusho ukuthi ngemuva kokubhaliswa, itholelayisensi yokuthengiswa. Ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nemiphumela emide ibhekwa kumuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo njengabantwana, abadala, abantu abanezinselelo zomzimba, nezifo zezinso, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa (izinkomba) umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha. Izigaba zonke zalesi sifundo zinezinhloso zazo ezithile kanye nezinzuzo, izingozi, nezingozi. Kuwo wonke amazinga okuhlola, abahlanganyeli ocwaningweni bavame ukukhokhelwa nganoma yiziphi imiphumela emibi abangase bayihlangabezane nayo noma nganoma yiziphi imiphumela engalindelekile. Imiphumela emibi ingabandakanya noma yisiphi uhlobo lwezimpawu ezimbi nezingenalindelekile, izimpawu, noma izifo ezihlobene nomuthi/ukwelashwa okukhuluma ngakho. Umuthi ophenywayo ungumuthi omusha noma osanda kutholakala (ukwelashwa) okwamanje kusemkhakheni. Umuthi othengiswayo ungumuthi osevele ubhaliswe nezinhlaka zokulawula (MCC) futhi ungasebenzisa njengendlela yokwelapha yezifo ezithile. Lo muthi udlule esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa, futhi ikhwalithi yawo, ukuphepha, nokusebenza kahle sekuvele kwaziwa. Imithi ethengiswayo ibizwa nangokuthi imithi enelayisensi noma imithi ebhalisiwe. Umkhiqizo ophenywayo ungumuthi (ukwelashwa)/isivithamini (izivithamini)/noma indlela yokwelapha (imikhiqizo yezokwelapha) ethwetshulwa ukuze kuhlolwe ikhwalithi, ukuphepha, kanye/noma ukusebenza kahle ngesikhathi kuqhutshelwa phambili isifundo sokuhlola esithile. Kungase kube nemikhiqizo engaphezu kweyodwa esifundweni esithile. Imikhiqizo ephenywayo ingabandakanya imithi, izivithamini, noma imikhiqizo yezokwelapha ezibhalisiwe noma ezingabhaliswanga noma imikhiqizo esaphenywa. Umxhaso ungumuntu, inkampani, isikhungo, noma inhlangano enesibopho sokusungula, ukuphatha, kanye nokuxhasa isifundo sokuhlola. Abaxhasi bavame ukuba abakhiqizi bemithi, izikhungo zikamasipala, izikhungo zocwaningo, iHhovisi leMhlaba leZempilo, uhulumeni bezwe, njll. Umphenyi ungumuntu ofanelekile onobungcweti obuphathelene nokuhlela, ukuqhuba, ukuhlaziya, kanye/noma ukubika ngesifundo esithile. Abaphenyisi bavame ukusebenza ndawonye njengethimba. Umphenyi ophambili ubizwa ngokuthi uMphenyi Ophambili (PI). U-PI unesibopho sezinyathelo ezihilela umxhaso kanye nezikhungo zokulawula. Abaphenyisi bangabandakanya odokotela abelapha, ososayensi bezokwelapha, abaphenyi bemithi, ochwepheshe bezempilo yengqondo, noma amalungu omkhakha wezokwelapha, njll. Noma ubani othanda ukuhamba phambili noma osevele uhambisile ocwaningweni (okufanele kubo) esifundweni sokuhlola unelungelo lokuhlinzeka ngovuma okwaziwayo. Umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika inombolo 108 ka-1996: Isigaba 12 sisho ukuthi "wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlonishwa kokwakhiwa komzimba nangokwengqondo, okuhlanganisa nelungelo - (c) lokungasetshenziswanga ocwaningweni lwezokwelapha noma lwezesayensi ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngovuma okwaziwayo kuqala." Yini evuma okwaziwayo? Ukuvuma okwaziwayo kuyinqubo ekhona mayelana (futhi ethinta) ukuhamba phambili ocwaningweni okuhlobene nokufunda ngamaqiniso abalulekile mayelana nesifundo sokuhlola esithile esizokwenziwa ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza isinqumo sokuthi aqhubeke noma cha futhi ahlanganyele kulolo suku lokuhlola. Ukuvuma okwaziwayo akusona nje ukusaina ifomu lokuvuma futhi akusona isivumelwano, kodwa kuyisigaba sokuvuma somuntu ozohlanganyela ocwaningweni. Ukuvuma kwakho okwaziwayo kuyisidingo esibalulekile ocwaningweni esihambisana nezindinganiso zokuziphatha nezocwaningo lwezesayensi. Ulwazi kumele lunikezwe ngendlela elula necacile usebenzisa ulimi lwakho. Isinqumo sakho sokuhlangany
Isihloko 1: Le mfanekiso ikhombisa izingxenye zohlelo lokugaya ukudla kwephoyisa. Isihloko 3: Isithombe esiseduze se-stomach. Isihloko 4: I-stomach ye-stomach yesibili. Isihloko 5: Isithombe sezitho ngaphakathi kwe-stomach yesithathu. Njengoba sonke sazi, ukuhweba kwezolimo kuyibhizinisi futhi ukuze kuphumelele kufanele kube nenzuzo. Eminyakeni edlule, ubunzima bokwenza inzuzo kumikhiqizo ye-maize bukhule kakhulu. Izindleko zokufaka ziya zanda kanti intengo yezitshalo zezinhlamvu ayikhuphuki ngokufanele. Abakhiqizi namuhla bazama ngazo zonke izindlela ukukhulisa ikhono labo lokwenza inzuzo ekulimaleni kwe-maize. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokufeza lokhu, futhi enye yalezi zindlela ukufaka ukuhweba kwezilwane. Abakhiqizi abaningi bakhulisela izinkomo, izimvu, noma/ kanye nezinkukhu. Lezi zinkampani zingafinyelela emhlabeni wezolimo ovame ukuba wanele ngesikhathi sasehlobo, kodwa kaningi akukhona ukuhlela okwanele ukuze kudle izilwane ezinyangeni zenyanga. Uma ufuna, noma ucabanga ukuba umkhiqizi wezilwane, kufanele ucabangele ukuba umkhiqizi wokudla (forage); ekugcineni, ungakhulisa izilwane kuphela uma unokudla ukuze uzigcine. Ukuze uthuthukise umthelela wokuhweba kwezilwane, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uhlelo lokugaya ukudla kwezilwane ezishisayo lusebenza kanjani. Ngamafuphi, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zokugaya ukudla ezilwaneni: monogastric, isibonelo, izinkukhu, amahhashi (nababantu), kanye ne-ruminants, isibonelo, izinkomo, izimvu, izinkukhu (nezinye izilwane ezidla izitshalo). I-ruminant inezinhliziyo ezine, ngayinye inomsebenzi wayo othile. Usuku olujwayelekile lwephoyisa, amahora ayisishiyagalombili azosetshenziselwa ukudla (ukudla), amahora ayisishiyagalombili ukuze ulale, kanti amahora ayisishiyagalombili asele azosetshenziselwa ukuhamba. Ngemuva kokudla utshani, iphoyisa iphuza amanzi bese iqala ukuhamba ukuze iqale inqubo yokugaya. Ubukhulu betshani obudliwayo bukhulu, ngakho ukuze iphoyisa ikwazi ukukhipha, utshani obuthile buyabuyiselwa ukuze kudliwe kabusha ukuze lezo ziqephu zibe zincane futhi zixube ne-saliva (okubalulekile ukuze kudliwe). Le mpumelelo yokuhlukanisa ukudla iyenza kube lula ukuze izilwane ezincane zikwazi ukudla le nkukhu (lokhu kuzoxoxwa ngakho kamuva kulolu doc). Ake siqale le ngxoxo ngokubheka uhlelo lokugaya ukudla kwezilwane ezishisayo. Umlomo uyisiqalo senqubo yonke njengoba ukudla kufanele kungene ngaphakathi. Umlomo uqukethe uphahla lomlomo, amazinyo (aphuma ngemva kokuzalwa), ulimi, kanye nezitho zokukhipha umswakama. Kulula ukubona ubudala bezilwane ezishisayo ngokubheka amazinyo azo, njengoba amazinyo athile ephuma ezingeni elithile lobudala. I-rumen iyitube elixhumanisa umlomo ne-stomach yokuqala (ebizwa nge-rumen). I-rumen noma i-stomach yokuqala isebenza njengendawo enkulu yokuphendula. Ayikho umoya noma umoya kule ndawo, yingakho ibizwa ngokuthi i-anaerobic. I-rumen iqukethe ukudla nokuphuma (izinto zezithako) ezidliwe yiphoyisa futhi ingabamba phakathi kuka-100 kuya ku-120 amalitha. Usuku nosuku, iphoyisa elikhulile lidinga ukudla cishe amakhilogremu ayishumi okudla okomile kanye namalitha angamashumi amahlanu wamanzi. Okuqukethwe kwe-rumen kuhlangene njalo. Ku-rumen, kukhona izilwane ezincane eziphula ukuphuma kube yifomu elingagayiwe yiphoyisa. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinsalela ze-rumen (ama-microbes) kanye ne-protozoa (izilwane ezincane), iphoyisa ngeke likwazi ukudla noma yini. Ama-bacteria e-rumen agaya ukuphuma ukuze akhiqize amafutha, amaprotheni, kanye namavithamini. Izilwane ezincane ku-rumen zisebenza ngezinhlobo ezithile zokuphuma; kukhona futhi ama-microorganisms ahlukene ezithelweni ezahlukene. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi ukudla kwephoyisa kuhlale kuqondile ngangokunokwenzeka futhi izinguquko zokudla kufanele zenziwe kancane kancane. Uma ukudla kushintshwa, kudingeka kube nezilwane ezahlukene ezincane ezikwazi ukuphatha ukudla okusha, okuthatha cishe ezinsukwini ezintathu. I-reticulum ibizwa ngokuthi i-stomach yesibili. Isebenza njengendlela ethile phakathi kwe-stomach yokuqala neyesithathu (i-stomach yesithathu lapho ukuhamba kwamanzi kwenzeka). I-stomach yesibili iphinde isebenze njengokuthola noma yiziphi izinto ezingagayiwe ezingeniswe yiphoyisa, isibonelo, ingxenye yensimbi, noma itshe, njll. I-omasum iyisitshalo sesithathu futhi yakhiwe ngama-fold amaningi. Umsebenzi wayo omkhulu uwukuhamba kwamanzi. I-abomasum iyisitshalo sesine nesokugcina lapho ukudla okudliwayo nokuphenduliwe kuhlangabezana nezinsiza ezivumela ukuba kudliwe yi-intestine encane. Ukuhamba kokudla kwenzeka kwi-intestine encane. Ekugcineni, ukudla kungena emathunjini ephoyisa ukuze kuthunyelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene zephoyisa lapho inqubo eqhubekayo iqhubeka. Ngalolu chungechunge olukhuluma ngenhla, uqala ukubona ukuthi kubaluleke kangakanani ukufaka ukudla kahle ezilwaneni zakho. Isizathu sokuhweba kungaba ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yezilwane (njengobisi, uboya, noma izinwele zezingulube), noma ukuthengisa abantwana bazo (amathole, izimvu, nezinkukhu), noma ukusebenzisa inyama yazo. Uma izilwane zifakwe kahle futhi zikhathalelwa, zizokwazi ukukhipha imikhiqizo kuwe futhi ngaleyo ndlela zibe nomthelela ekwenzeni inzuzo kwebhizinisi lakho lezolimo.
Noma iMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 ungumthetho. Manje, uMphakathi-Jikelele weMnyango weMvula neZihlahla, njengomholi wehhovisi lolwazi kulo Mnyango, ukhishile incwadi yolwazi yomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe nguMnyango njengoba kudingwa ngengxenye 14 yoMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi. Le ncwadi iyincwadi yeMnyango weMvula neZihlahla ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi, 2000 (Umthetho 2 ka-2000) [lo Mthetho]. Incazelo yesimo seMnyango nemisebenzi yawo. UMnyango, umholi wehhovisi lolwazi, kanye nazo zonke izinsizakusebenza zawo. Ulwazi olunembile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMnyango. Isaziso sakamuva ngokwesigaba 15 soMthetho, esiqukethe lonke ulwazi, olugcinwe nguMnyango futhi olufinyeleleka kalula kubo bonke ngaphandle kwesidingo sokufaka isicelo kuMnyango. Incazelo yezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo emphakathini nokuthi lezi zinsizakalo zingafinyelelwa kanjani. Ukulandela izinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokunciphisa isidingo semvula, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukongiwa kwemvula ngokuphatha isidingo sayo. Ukukhuthaza ukusabalalisa okufanele, ukusetshenziswa okuhle, kanye nokuphathwa okunokuphelela kwezinsiza zamanzi nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhangayo. Izinsizakalo Zamanzi a Ukungenelela ngokuthatha izinyathelo zokutshala imali ekunikezeni insizakalo yokuletha amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nokuhambisa udoti kulawo maphuzu angakaze athole le nsizakalo b Ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kwehlelo lezinsizakalo zamanzi elibanjwe nguMnyango ukuze wabelane ngezinsika zezinsizakalo zamanzi c Ukuphatha nokuhola izenzo zamabhodi emvula d Ukusekela iziphathimandla zendawo ekuqaliseni inqubo yokuthatha umthwalo wokunikeza amanzi, nokuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zamanzi e Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zamanzi nezinsizakalo zolwazi f Ukuhlola indlela yokunikeza izinsizakalo zokuhambisa udoti ngenhloso yokufeza ukuzinza, ukwaneliseka, ukungabizi kwezinsizakalo, nokuphakamisa umkhankaso kazwelonke wokuhlaziya inqubekela phambili ethile yokuhambisa udoti g Ukwakha uMnyango njengomthuthukisi wenqubomgomo yezinsizakalo zamanzi, isisekelo sokusekela, ukuphatha, nokuletha. Ngokusho koMthetho, uMphakathi-Jikelele ungumholi wehhovisi lolwazi lwe-DWAF. U-Mphakathi-Jikelele, ngokweMthetho, unegunya nemisebenzi edluliselwe ezinsizakalweni zeHhovisi Lolwazi ukuze akhuthaze uMthetho Wokufinyelela Kulwazi. Amagama abo kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana itholakala etafuleni elingezansi. Umphakathi-Jikelele: Imininingwane Yokuphathwa Kwelwazi. Ngokusho kwesigaba 1 sesigaba 10 soMthetho, uMphakathi weMikhakha Yezokwahlukanisa kumele, phakathi nezinyanga eziyi-18 ngemuva kokuqala kwalesi sigaba, akhiqize idokhumenti equkethe lolu lwazi ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni, ngendlela elula neyiqondakalayo, njengoba kungadingeka ngumuntu ofuna ukuzisebenzisa noma yiluphi ilungelo elinikezwe nguMthetho.
