Umfaki-sicelo kumele futhi achaze ukuthi ngabe ufuna ikhophi ephrintiwe yedokhumenti eqoshiwe noma ufuna ukuza ukuyibona edokhumenti eqoshiwe ehhovisi lomphakathi. Noma uma idokhumenti eqoshiwe ingeyona incwadi, ingabukwa ngendlela edingekayo, lapho isigaba 292 singasebenza khona. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela ngendlela ethile, umfaki-sicelo kumele anikezwe ukufinyelela ngendlela efunwayo, ngaphandle uma lokho kungaphazamisa ngokungafanele ukusebenza kwehhovisi elithintekayo, noma kulimaze idokhumenti eqoshiwe, noma kuvinjezele ukuhlinzekwa kwedokhumenti engemthethweni. Uma ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngendlela efunwayo ngenxa yezizathu ezinzima kodwa kunganikezwa ngenye indlela, imali yokufinyelela kumele ibalwe ngendlela umfaki-sicelo afuna ukufinyelela esigabeni 29 cha. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela ehlukile, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kumele kukhunjulwe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, izimo lapho isicelo senziwa kumele zicaciswe esigabeni 18 2f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enokukhubazeka, angafaka isicelo sokukhuluma ukuze athole idokhumenti eqoshiwe. Umphakathi-Jikelele weHhovisi Lolwazi kumele aqedele ifomu lomfaki-sicelo futhi amnikeze ikhophi ngokwesigaba 18 3. Usizo lweHhovisi Lolwazi kumele lunikeze umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwabafaki-sicelo abazenzela) izidingo zokukhokha imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi kuqhubeke nesicelo. Imali yesicelo ethathwa yihhovisi lomphakathi ingu-R35. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka isikhalazo phakathi, lapho kufanelekile, noma afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze aphikise isikhangiso noma akhokhe imali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi Usizo lweHhovisi Lolwazi lwenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswa ngalesi sinqumo ngendlela umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngayo. Uma isicelo samukelwa, imali yokufinyelela kumele ikhokhwe ukuze kuhlolwe, kulungiswe, futhi kukhiqizwe, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esedlula amahora abekwe ukuze kuhlolwe nokulungiselela idokhumenti eqoshiwe ukuze ikhululwe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimiso zoMthetho ezibanjwe nguMnyango ziyagcinwa, ngokulandela nokuhlanganisa ulwazi. Isikhalazo singafakwa kuNgqongqoshe weMvula neZihlahla. Isicelo senkantolo singafakwa ngemuva kokuthi ihhovisi elinganeliseki lidlule zonke izinqubo zokukhala ngaphakathi, kodwa akukho okwenziwayo mayelana nesikhalazo sakhona. Ngokwethu, ulwazi olukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 14 (i) lungakakhanjiswa nguNgqongqoshe wezobuLungisa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Le ncwadi izobuyekezwa futhi iphume njalo ngonyaka ukuze ibikele umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingase zenzeke kwi-DWAF. Izinqubo ezilandelwayo ukuze kwenziwe le ncwadi itholakale zizogcinwa ekubuyekezweni kwencwadi. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ixhumene kakhulu nemisebenzi yezinye izigaba, uNgqongqoshe, uma efisa noma ngabe ngabe, angacela lezo zigaba ukuthi zikhulise incwadi eyodwa. I-DWAF kanye nezinye izigaba ezingaphezu kweyodwa kumele zabelane ngezindleko zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyitholisa njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakucacisa. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ingahlangene nanoma iyiphi isigaba somphakathi, zonke izindleko ezitholakele zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyitholisa zizokwenziwa yi-DWAF. UNgqongqoshe wezobuLungisa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo angakhulula i-DWAF ekunikezeni ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 soMthetho, nganoma yisiphi isizathu sokuvikela, ukuphatha
Ingabe ukuphuza kukhulu kahle kimi? Ngidinga ukususa ibhokisi lami lempendulo. Kubaluleke kangakanani ukuyeka ukuphuza? Kungani kufanele uyeke ukuphuza? Yini ekubambezela? Ingabe ufuna ukuyeka ukuphuza kodwa awazi ukuthi uqale kuphi? Uma kunjalo, le bhukwana izokusiza. Sizokusiza ukuthi uyeke ukuphuza unomphela - ngokuchaza ukuthi kwenzekani uma uyeka ukuphuza, nokuthi kungani kwenzeka, futhi sizophinde sichaze ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezinkinga ongahlangabezana nazo. Usebenza ekungathinteni izigarette futhi. Ngabe ngabe ngiyesaba ukuyeka ukuphuza. Ngazitshela: "Nginepressure enkulu, ngiyesaba, angiboni ukuthi ngingakwenza kanjani. Konke kubonakala njengomthwalo omkhulu. Ngazama ukuyeka, futhi manje ngisazibuza ukuthi yini eyangikhathaza." (Umuntu ophuzayo izigarette ezingama-30 ngosuku iminyaka eyi-12). Abanye abantu bathola kulula ukuyeka ukuphuza. Abanye bathola kunzima kakhulu. Kodwa kubaningi, ukuyeka ukuphuza akuyona into elula noma engatholakali. Ngikhethe usuku futhi ngagcina kulolo suku. Ngazama izikhathi ezintathu. Ngagcina nginophakethe. Umngani wami kanye nami sanquma ukuyeka ndawonye. Ngizizwa ngijabule futhi ngikhululekile. Babesho ngama-40 million amaMelika abaye bayeka ukuphuza unomphela, ama-11 million amaBrithani, kanye nezinkulungwane lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Izinyathelo zalaba bantu zikhombisa ukuthi uma uzitshela ukuthi ufuna ukuyeka ukuphuza, kuyinto ongayenza. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuyeka ukuphuza. Kukhona ithuba elihle lokuthi uzophila isikhathi eside futhi uvikele wena kokubuhlungu kanye nokuqhamuka kwezifo. Ukuqeda umkhuba wokuphuza kuzokwenza uzizwe ujabule ngokuba nguye. Nansi eminye yemisebenzi emihle yokuyeka ukuphuza. Beka phansi lezo ozicabangayo ukuthi zibalulekile kuwe. Cabanga nje ngempilo yakho, ungayeka ukuphuza futhi uphile kahle. Manje qeda lesi sitatimende ngokubhala phansi izizathu ezibalulekile zokuyeka ukuphuza. Nginqume ukuyeka ukuphuza ngoba... ENingizimu Afrika, izifo ezibangelwa ukuphuza zibulala abantu abangu-25,000 ngonyaka. Le nombolo ifana nokuhlasela kweJumbo jet nokubulala wonke umuntu ophakathi kwayo nsuku zonke. Kungani ukuphuza kuyingozi enkulu? Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingane ezizalwa kumama abaphuzayo zinekhono eliphezulu lokuzalwa zincane, zifile emhlabeni, noma zife ngaphambi kosuku lokuzalwa. Ngilahlekelwe yintombi yami yokuqala ngosuku olufanayo engiqala ukuphuza. Abaphuzi baqala ukuba nezinkinga lapho besendaweni yabo ye-30s ne-40s, kodwa futhi, umphuzi oneminyaka engu-18 akaphili kahle njengabalingani bakhe abangaphuzi. Umndeni nabangane bangase benze kahle uma uyeka ukuphuza. Izingane ezikhula ezindlini ezinezingane eziphuzayo zinekhono eliphezulu lokuthola i-asthma noma zifakwe esibhedlela ngenxa ye-pneumonia ne-bronchitis. Umvuzo wokuyeka ukuphuza ubona wena, umndeni wakho, nabangane bakho uma uqala ukuyeka ukuphuza. Umoya ophuma ezigarette ungumxube wezinto eziyi-4,500 eziyingozi. Ngezinye izikhathi ngihlala phambi kwesibuko ngibuka ngiziphuzisa lo moya onobuthi. Ngaphakathi kwamahora amabili, akukho nicotine esesimeni sakho. Ngaphakathi kwamahora ayisithupha, izinga lenhliziyo yakho lehla futhi ingcindezi yegazi iyancipha. Kungathatha izinsuku ezi-3 kuya kweziyi-30 ukuze ingcindezi yegazi ibuyisele ezingeni elijwayelekile. Phakathi kwamahora ayi-12 kuya kweziyi-24, i-carbon monoxide iyakhishwa emzimbeni wakho. Umsebenzi wezimpaphe uthuthuka. Awuzukuba nenkinga yokuphefumula uma wenza umsebenzi onzima, futhi ukuzimisela kwakho ukuyeka ukuphuza kuzothuthuka. Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa, uzothola uzizwa uhlanzekile futhi unuka kahle. Izithako zakho zokunambitha zizovuselelwa njengoba kuzothuthuka nomuzwa wakho wokunuka. Ungazizwa ujabule kakhulu ngokukwazi ukwenza okuthile obukholwa ukuthi awukwazi ukukwenza. Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa, umswakama ophumile emaphashini akho uzothola ukuqala ukuthamba, bese uzokhwehlela lokho ezinsukwini ezilandelayo. I-cilia, okuyisistimu yokuhlanza yomzimba, izoveza ukuthuthuka. Kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu ukuze uhlelo lwe-cilia luthuthuke ngokuphelele ukuze lungahlanza kahle izimpaphe. Ezinsukwini ezintathu, izimpaphe zakho zizosebenza kangcono. Kuzoba lula futhi ukwenza umthambo. Ngaphansi kwezinyanga ezimbili, kuzoba nokuthuthuka kokuhamba kwegazi ezindaweni ezahlukene zomzimba wakho. Uzoba namandla amaningi (uzozizwa ujabule futhi uzithokozisa). Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu, inqubo yokuhlanza izimpaphe zakho izosebenza ngokujwayelekile. Uma ungumuntu, i-sperm yakho izobuyela ejwayelekile futhi inani layo lizokhula. Kancane kancane, ukwakheka kwegazi lakho kuzobuyela ejwayelekile njengoba kuzobuyela nezicubu ezihlangene nezimpaphe zakho. Lokhu kungathatha isikhathi eside. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-12, ubungozi bezifo zenhliziyo buyehliswa ngempela uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abaqhubeka nokuphuza. Ngaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu, ubungozi be-cancer yezimpaphe buyehliswa ngempela. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyi-15, ubungozi bezifo zenhliziyo buphuma cishe buphuma njengalabo abangaphuzi. Ake sithathe lokhu "ukujabula." Ukuphuza kukwenza ukwehla, kukhathaza ithambo lakho, kushiya imivimbo ezandleni zakho, kudala imihuzuko, kunuka kabi, kuyingozi yomlilo, futhi ngemuva kokujabula kwakho, awutholi ukwaneliseka futhi udinga ukukwenza futhi. Ukuphuza kubonakala njengomkhuba omuhle, kodwa kuyabheda. Kuthatha isikhathi sakho, amandla akho, nemali yakho. Okubi kakhulu, kungathatha impilo yakho. Uhlobo luni lwesithandwa lokho? Iqiniso ukuthi u-pressure okhululiwe yi-cigarette kuyisifiso sokuthola enye i-cigarette. Kukhona izindlela ezingcono empilweni yokubhekana nengcindezi kunokuthembela ezigarette. Akukho umkhawulo weminyaka yokuyeka ukuphuza. Nokho, uma ungumuntu omdala, ubungozi bokuthola izifo ezibangelwa ukuphuza buyehla uma uyeka ukuphuza. Yebo, kuba ngcono uma uyeka ngokushesha. Futhi akukho umkhawulo weminyaka yokuyeka. Le possibility ingahluka. Ungathola usizo ngokwenza ucingo. Izeluleko kule bhukwana zisize izinkulungwane zabantu ukuthi bayeke ukuphuza. Funda eziphuthumayo zakho ukuze uphumelele kulokhu. Khetha usuku ozoyeka ukuphuza. (Ungazami ukuyeka, kodwa YEKELA UKUPHUZA). Khetha usuku olungakubekeli ingcindezi, kodwa ungasebenzisi lokho ukuthola izizathu zokulibazisa usuku ozoyeka ukuphuza. Beka usuku olungaphezu kwesonto ukuze ukwazi ukuzilungiselela ngengqondo. Amalungu omndeni, abangane, nabalingani bangaba usizo olukhulu kumuntu ofuna ukuyeka ukuphuza. Ngiyacela ungixolele uma ngikhombisa izimpawu zokwehla ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngemuva kokuyeka ukuphuza. Ngesikhathi sasehlobo, kuvame ukuba nesidingo sokuphuthuma ukuze kuqedwe umsebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esitholakalayo. Ikakhulukazi ngonyaka odlule, imvula yafika sekwedlule isikhathi, ngakho kwakungekho isikhathi esiningi. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlola nokugcina ama-tractors nemishini akubalulekile kakhulu ngoba umsebenzi kumele uqedwe ngokushesha. Kodwa manje njengoba konke sekwenzekile, sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola nokugcina imishini yakho. Hlanza umhlabathi, uthuli, kanye nokwakheka kwe-grease emshinini bese ususa noma yiziphi izinsalela. Lokhu kuzovimbela imishini ekukhuleni ubulukhuni futhi kuzosisiza ukuthi ihlale isikhathi eside. Faka ama-lubricants kuwo wonke amishini ngokwezincazelo ezihlinzekwe umkhiqizi walowo mshini. Uma ufuna ukugcina imishini ngokuphepha, qiniseka ukuthi uma kukhona izinto ezingakwazi ukuhlinzekwa, phonsa lezo zinto phansi. Gwema ukuvuvukala noma ukungena kwe-grease kulezo zinsiza zensimbi. Hlanganisa uhlu lwazo zonke izinto eziphukile noma ezidinga ukuvuselelwa. Thenga lezo manje; ungabambeleli kuze kube unyaka ozayo. Beka imishini endlini uma kungenzeka, futhi ungayibeki ezithelweni. Beka amabhokisi ezinkuni phansi ukuvimbela ukuxhumana nomhlabathi okungaholela ekukhuleni ubulukhuni. Susa ama-hydraulic cylinders noma hlola ukuthi abuyiselwa emuva ukuvimbela ama-rods ekukhuleni ubulukhuni. Ukuphatha kahle ukulima kuzoveza ukuthi uzothola umkhiqizo omuhle noma ulahlekelwe kakhulu. Ukukhetha izinhlobo zamakhowe, izindlela zokulima, ukuvulela, nokugcina amakhowe emhlabathini kubalulekile uma kukhiqizwa ukudla. Uma ukulima kungahambi kahle, umkhiqizo ngeke uhambisane nalokho okulindelekile. Susa zonke izinsalela ezivela ezibhokisini: umanyolo, ama-herbicides, nama-pesticides, kanye nezitsha zamakhowe ukuvimbela ukuvuvukala. Hlola noma yiziphi izingxenye ezonakele noma eziphukile bese uzifaka ngezintsha. Faka i-lubricant emshinini nasemakhanda apholile ngamanzi noma i-grease ukuvimbela ukuvuvukala. Faka i-lubricant kuwo wonke ama-bearings. Qinisekisa ukuthi izihlahla zifakwe ngendlela engazithinti umhlaba bese ubeka ukulima endlini. Beka ukulima ngendlela yokuthi amawheels angathinti umhlaba.
Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo IMphakathi yaseLimpopo ibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya. USimphiwe Moyo ungumfundi wezokwelapha oyisifiso somphakathi, ogxile ekubhekeni izinselelo ezibhekene nodokotela kulezi zindawo. USimphiwe, owazalelwa edolobheni elincane laseLimpopo, ubonile izidingo ezinkulu zomphakathi emakilasi akhe. Uhlangabezane nobunzima obukhulu phakathi kokulandela izifundo zakhe, ebanjwa ngaphansi koxhaso oluncane. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi indawo yaseLimpopo iphethwe yizikhala ezinkulu zokungabi khona kodokotela. USimphiwe ukhumbula ukuthi, "Ngaphakathi kweminyaka emithathu, ngiphumelele ukuthola udokotela oyedwa kuphela, ngenkathi umphakathi ungaphezu kwamathathu amajenti, lokho kuye kwaba yinkinga enkulu." Lokhu kusebenza kokushoda kodokotela kudinga isixazululo esiphusile futhi esibanzi. Ubusuku obuhlukahlukene bobuhlungu, uSimphiwe uthanda ukufunda ngendaba yokwelapha. Uhlala ezindaweni ezithile zasemakhaya, ethola ukuthi abanye abantu bahlala behluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokwelapha ngenxa yokungabi khona kadokotela, izithuthi, noma imali yokuhamba. Lokhu kucacisa ukuthi ubunzima bakhe bungaphezu kokungabi khona kodokotela. Uthole isibopho esikhulu emiphakathini yokuthi, "Abantu bethu badinga ukusizwa, imibiko yempilo yabo iyakhathaza." Ngenxa yalokho, uSimphiwe uqala inhlangano emasha ebizwa nge-"Izinyosi Zempilo," ebanjwe ngemigomo yokuqinisa isimo sezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Le nhlangano yokuxhasa iyazama ukudala imfundiso ezinzulu nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi komphakathi nabodokotela. USimphiwe uchaza ukuthi bahlangana nabantu, bejolisa ezintweni ezisemqoka, besebenzisa izindlela ezithokozisayo zokwakha ubudlelwane. "Hhayi kuphela ukufinyelela ekwelapheni, kodwa nokuqonda izidingo zabantu," kuphawula uSimphiwe. Ngokwakha lo mnyango, uSimphiwe ubona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo zokuqhakambisa ukuzinikela komphakathi. Amakhosikazi aneminyaka ethile edlulile kusenesikhathi bakwazi ukufunda izindlela zokwelapha ezisheshayo ezisemqoka phakathi kwezenzakalo zomndeni. Lokhu kukhuthaza abasha nogogo nabodwa ukuba babe nesibopho sokuphila ngokwempilo. USimphiwe ubona lokhu njengesinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphuma ezinkingeni, abhekele kahle imiphakathi yabo. Uyasiza abanye abafundi ukuba babe neziqu zobudokotela ngosuku olwandulela. Lokhu kusebenza kuze kube sekuhamba phambili, kunendlela yokuhlola izidingo zomphakathi ngesikhathi esisodwa. USimphiwe usebenzisa izindlela zokuxhumanisa abanye odokotela abakhululekile ezindaweni zasemakhaya, okukhuthaza udlame lokwakha amakhono asezingeni. Uqaphela ubukhulu bezingozi ezidlula phambili, akakhumbuli ukufundisa abahlanganyeli indlela ehloniphekayo yokwelapha. Njengomphakathi, uSimphiwe uqhakambisa izinzuzo zokuxhumana nokubambisana ngezihloko ezithinta impilo - kokubili ukuphila komuntu nomphakathi. Uthembisa umphakathi ukuthi uzoletha izinguquko ezinhle emkhakheni wezempilo, ngenhloso yokwakha indawo engcono. Uqhuba imihlangano ethile ukuze afake imizwa nemibono emaqondiseni abanye ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhumbuzo, uSimphiwe ucinisa umdlandla ngokubeka phambili indlela yokuba nabodokotela abaningi ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Ukukhula kweshishini labodokotela kuncike kumphakathi. USimphiwe uyazi ukuthi njengoba kudinga ukunciphisa amandla okubonga ukuze kube noshintsho, kuzodingeka ukuhlinzeka ngezemfundo ezinzulu kubo bobabili abahola ezempilo kanye nomphakathi ukuze babekezelele izinkinga. Ukushoda kodokotela ezindaweni zasemakhaya eLimpopo kuveza ukuthi izinkinga zezempilo zihambisana nezinhlelo zokuphucula izithuthi nezinsiza. USimphiwe uhlose ukusiza futhi ahlukanise umphakathi. Ubonisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zingafinyelela izivuno ezinkulu ezifana nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngalesi sikhathi sokubhekana nezinkinga, uSimphiwe ubonisa ukuthi ikhono lokusiza abanye kungenza umehluko omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu. Ekugcineni, uSimphiwe Moyo ungumfanekiso obonakalayo wokuthi abantu bangenza kanjani umehluko omkhulu ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ikakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngezempilo. Ukufuna izixazululo eziphusile nokubambisana nabondli, usebenzisa ulwazi lwakhe ukuze akhulise lezi zimo ezibucayi. Ubuye akhuthaze ukuzibandakanya komphakathi, kucacisa ukuthi umehluko ungaholela emiphumeleni emihle engakwazi ukwenziwa. USimphiwe ungumsebenzi onamandla, enza isizathu sezenzo ezinhle, ukuze kuholele emiphumeleni engaphezu kokuphefumula kuphela.
Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakukhona kuphela indawo yokudoba i-tuna enezintambo ezinde ezisetshenziselwa indawo yokuhlola noma yokucwaninga le fish. Izindawo zokudoba ezihlola zikhombisa ukuthi abalobi bezinhlanzi baseNingizimu Afrika bangakwazi ukuhamba inqwaba ye-swordfish. Nokho, futhi kukhombisa ukuthi kukhona isidingo sokuthuthukisa ubuhlakani nomlando wezokusebenza mayelana nokudoba i-tuna. Inhloso kwakuwukwakha indawo enkulu yokudoba usebenzisa izintambo ezinde eNingizimu Afrika; kanye nokwakha umlando wezokudoba kanye nolwazi olugcinwe ngenani lezinhlanzi ezibanjwe endaweni yokudoba. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezindawo zokudoba i-tuna, i-swordfish, kanye ne-shark ezijulile akuphumelelanga enqubweni yokwabiwa kwamalungelo ngonyaka ka-2005. Izindawo zokudoba i-shark ezijulile zathuthukiswa ngomhla zingu-31 kuZibandlela, 205, kodwa amalungelo anikezwa kuphela kubantu abangu-9 ngaphansi kwe-MLRA ngenhloso yokudoba i-shark ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde. Kulaba bangu-9, amabili alezi zikhwama awaqinisekiswanga, kushiya abaninimandla abangu-7 okwamanje bedoba i-shark ngezintambo ezinde. I-quota yezenhlanzi evunyelwe ukubanjwa ezindaweni ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde ivumele ukwabiwa kwamalungelo okubamba i-20 swordfish kanye ne-30 tuna ngonyaka ka-2005. Amalungelo angama-17 anikezwe i-swordfish, kanye nelungelo elilodwa elengeziwe elinikezwe ngemuva kokuhlaziywa okwenziwe yinkantolo. I-total ye-tuna rights eyabiwe yaba ngu-26. Lokhu kusishiya namalungelo amabili e-swordfish kanye namalungelo amane e-tuna angakabiwa. Kubaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana abanezikweletu eziyisikhombisa ezindaweni zokudoba i-shark ezijulile, amabili awo anikezwe amalungelo okudoba ezindaweni ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde ngonyaka ka-2005. Lokhu kushiya abaninimandla abahlanu bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana ngaphandle kwamalungelo abawabiwe okudoba ezindaweni ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde. Uma laba baninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana befaka izicelo futhi bengavinjwa ngokungahlangabezani nezimfuneko ezibekiwe, bazonikezwa amalungelo enqubweni entsha yokwabiwa kwamalungelo. Uma laba baninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana befaka izicelo, abasoze badinge "ukuncintisana" nabanye abafaka izicelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana nabanye abafaka izicelo bazovunyelwa ukufaka izicelo zamalungelo okudoba i-tuna kanye ne-swordfish kufomu elilodwa lokufaka izicelo, bebonisa ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lokudoba abathanda. Ngemuva kokuthi izicelo zamukelwe, umphathi onegunya uzokwenza imizamo yokubheka inqwaba yabaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana uma kudingeka ukuthi umphathi onegunya afake isicelo sokushintsha noma sokuguqula amalungelo e-tuna asekhona abe amalungelo e-swordfish noma ngokuphambene. Inhloso ebalulekile yale mthetho ukuhlanganisa izindawo zokudoba i-shark usebenzisa izintambo ezinde nezindawo zokudoba ezijulile zezinhlanzi ezinkulu kanye nokwabiwa kwamalungelo angakabiwa. Njengoba kushiwo, uma abaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana bengekho namalungelo okudoba ezindaweni ezijulile, bahlala behlangabezana nezimfuneko ezibekiwe kulomthetho, kufanele babekwe ohlwini labo abazodoba kulezi zindawo zokudoba. Noma yiziphi amalungelo angakabiwa azowabiwa ngokuhambisana nenqubo yokuncintisana, efana naleyo esebenziswe yiMnyango kule minyaka edlule mayelana nokwabiwa kwamalungelo. Nokho, abafaka izicelo abangaphumelelanga abahlangabezani nezimfuneko ezilindelekile ngeke baphoswe. Bazobekwa kwisikimu esithile futhi babekwe ohlwini "lokulinda" futhi banikezwe amalungelo uma amalungelo ethola ukutholakala, ngaleyo ndlela kuvumela iNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ithuthukise izinga lokubamba izinhlanzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inhloso yokwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba ngezinhloso zokuhweba ezindaweni zokudoba ukuhlinzeka ngezindawo zokudoba ezizinzile emanzini ajulile eNingizimu Afrika usebenzisa izintambo ezinde ngezinhloso zokuhweba, kuhlanganise ne-sharks ezindaweni ezijulile ezidobayo ngezintambo ezinde nokufeza izinhloso ezishiwo ngezansi. Ukuguqula nokwakha kabusha imboni yokudoba kuyinjongo kahulumeni futhi inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokubhekana nale mfuneko ebalulekile. Amalungelo awabiwe ngokuhambisana nalomthetho azophela kanye namalungelo awabiwe okudoba ezindaweni zokudoba ngonyaka ka-2005. Ngamanye amazwi, wonke amalungelo okubamba izinhlanzi ezinkulu usebenzisa izintambo ezinde emanzini ajulile azophela ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari 2015. Kukhona isidingo sokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa umlando wezibalo zezinhlanzi eNingizimu Afrika emanzini ajulile, ikakhulukazi i-tuna; kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu okudingekayo ukuze kufinyelelwe ezindaweni zokudoba ezinkulu zomhlaba. Zonke izicelo zizohlolwa ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko ezibekiwe "ezinezimfuneko." Abaninimandla bamanje bamalungelo okudoba i-shark ngezintambo ezinde abangekho namalungelo bazonikezwa amalungelo ngaphandle kokuphikiswa ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko ezinezimfuneko. Abanye abafaka izicelo abangakhethwanga bazohlolwa ngokwehlukana ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko "ezihambelanayo" ezisetshenziswe ekuhloleni. Isikali noma izimfuneko ezisetshenzisiwe zizokwenziwa ukukhetha abafaka izicelo abaphumelele mayelana nale qembu labafaka izicelo. Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, lo Mnyango ngeke uqhubeke nenqubo yokwabiwa kwamalungelo kuze kube amalungelo akhona ephelelwa yisikhathi. Uma kukhona amalungelo atholakalayo ngaphambi kwalolo sikhathi ngenxa yokuhoxiswa noma ukwenqaba kwamanye amalungelo, isikali esisetshenzisiwe lapho kucaciswa le nqubo yokwabiwa kwamalungelo sizosetshenziswa ukuze kwabiwe amalungelo esikhathini esizayo, uma atholakala. Uhlu "lokulinda" luzophinde lwenziwe ukuze luhlinzeke ngalokhu. Ukufaka izicelo ngendlela engafanele: Isicelo sithathwa njengokufakwa ngendlela engafanele uma samukelwa sekwedlule; uma umfaki-sicelo engakhokhanga noma ekhokhe isilinganiso esiphakathi noma sekwedlule sokukhokha izimali zesicelo; noma uma sithunyelwa ngendlela engahambisani nemiyalelo, njengokusebenzisa umgudu, noma ngendlela ethile engabekiwe yokufaka izicelo. Umphathi onegunya kanye noNgqongqoshe abakwazi ukwephula umthetho mayelana nezimfuneko zokufaka izicelo. Iphutha kufomu lesicelo: Isicelo liqukethe iphutha uma umfaki-sicelo engasayinanga i-affidavit, noma uma i-affidavit yomfaki-sicelo ingaqinisekiswanga nguMphakathi Wokuhlola, noma uma izicelo ezingaphezu kwesisodwa zamukelwe kumfaki-sicelo
Izinhlelo ziyaqhutshwa ukuze kusungulwe iNational Ports Authority; kanye nezindaba ezihlobene nalokho. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukwandiswa kobudlelwano emhlabeni jikelele, kanye nokwenza kube nokuqinisekisa ukulondolozwa, ukuphathwa, nokusebenza kwezikhumulo zezikebhe njengoba zikhona. I-buoy ibizwa njengomthombo osebenzela ukusiza lapho umkhumbi uhamba emanzini ukuze uxwayise umkhumbi ngezingozi emanzini noma i-radio buoy esiza umkhumbi uma uhamba olwandle. I-"buoy" ibhekisela kumshini omncane ophumile emanzini, ohlangene emaphethelweni omfula, obonisa noma oxwayisa izikebhe ngezingozi, izikebhe ezidliwe, noma ezinye izithiyo. "Umthwalo okulindelwe," ubhekisela kumthwalo okulindelwe ongcarrywa izikhumulo zezikebhe zaseNingizimu Afrika. Abasebenzisi bezikhumulo zifaka phakathi abasebenzisi abaqondile (abanikazi bezikebhe), abasebenzisi abangaqondile (abangenisi bezimpahla zangaphandle kanye nabathumeli bezimpahla zendawo), abasebenzisi abangekho emkhakheni wezohwebo (abathumeli), kanye nabasebenzisi bokugcina bezohwebo (abakhiqizi nabathengi). Usizo ekunyakazeni kwezikebhe lubhekisela kunoma iyiphi indlela esetshenziselwa ukulawula noma ukuhlela ukuhamba kwezikebhe ukuze kuvikelwe imvelo. a Ukuhlukanisa imisebenzi yokusebenza njengomnikazi wendawo b Ukukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babambe iqhaza, ukuze bagqugquzele abaphathi nabasebenzi c Ukulungiselela ukudluliswa kwamakhono nobuchwepheshe, ulwazi, nokuphathwa ngokubambisana nokuhlanganisa umkhakha ozimele ongaphansi kukahulumeni. a I-National Ports Authority iphethwe ngokuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalesi sikhumbuzo, uNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokusungula futhi abhalise iNational Ports Authority njengenkampani yomphakathi engathengisa amasheya noma izitokwe futhi ikhishwe isitifiketi sokwakhiwa, ngokuhambisana neCompanies Act kanye nePFMA. Ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhuluma esigabeni 2 seCompanies Act okungahambisani nalokhu, kuzosebenza kule National Ports Authority. UNgqongqoshe njengomnikazi, ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiNational Ports Authority angase athumele izeluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuthi akhombise ukuthi ezinye izinhlinzeko noma izingxenye zeCompanies Act azisebenzi kule National Ports Authority. Isicelo esikhuluma esigabeni 1 kumele sibe nokwesekwa okuphelele nolwazi oluhambelana nalokhu kwesicelo kumele kudalulwe nguSekela seNkampani, kanye nalokho, ngokushicilela isaziso kwi-gazette kahulumeni. Kulesi saziso, uSekela seNkampani kufanele abize abantu ukuba bathumele iziphakamiso zabo nezikhalazo kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kulesi saziso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichazwe kulesi saziso. Unyaka wezezimali weNational Ports Authority uzohamba kusukela ku-1 kuMbasa kuya ku-31 kuNdasa wonyaka olandelayo, kokubili izinsuku zifakiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma nganoma iyiphi umthetho, iNational Ports Authority ngeke ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu ophathwe yinkantolo noma ngaphansi kwenqubo yokuhlanza inkampani engakhokhi izikweletu, ngaphandle kokugunyazwa nguMthetho othile wePhalamende. m ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, ukwethembeka, kanye nezindleko zabelungu, ngokuhambisana nezinga elamukelekayo emhlabeni jikelele nezidingo zomphakathi. I-National Ports Authority kufanele yenze konke okudingekayo ukuze iphathwe kahle nangokuphumelelayo, ihlele futhi ilawule izikhumulo. a ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwezikhumulo ezihweba b ukuqinisekisa ukuqapha kahle kwezikhumulo c ukulungiselela ukwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi d ukunciphisa ukuphindaphinda kwalezi zisebenzi nezinhlelo mayelana nokwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi. e ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwemisebenzi efanayo. a nesikhathi nenqubo, kuhlanganisa nenqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi nezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga, mayelana nokusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokubambisana ezikhuluma esigabeni 2. k ukukhuthaza izinyathelo zokuphepha ezikhumulweni. Akukho okukhuluma esigabeni 1 kuzovimba iNational Ports Authority ekwenzeni noma yini edingekayo ukuze iphathwe kahle nangokuphumelelayo, ihlele futhi ilawule izikhumulo. I-National Ports Authority yaseNingizimu Afrika inamandla afana nalawo enkampani njengoba kuxoxwa esigabeni 34 seCompanies Act, ngaphandle kokukhishwa noma ukuncishiswa ngokubhalwe ngalesi sikhumbuzo. e Ukukhokha kokukhishwa kwamalayisense kanye nokudluliswa kokukhokha kwezinsizakalo nezinsiza ezisetshenziselwa izikhumulo ezihlinzekwa yiNational Ports Authority ngokuthanda kwayo ngokuhambisana nokuvunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali f Ukungena ezivumelwaneni zokudluliswa kwemali nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni nomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi bezikhumulo abaqeqeshiwe ukuze banikeze usizo ezikhumulweni futhi basize ukuphatha umthwalo ukuze basungule amazinga okusebenza, ikhwalithi yomsebenzi, futhi bagcizelele ukuhambisana nomthetho. Ngaphezu kokunciphisa amandla akhuluma esigabeni 1, le nkampani izoba namandla okukhokha emithonjeni eminingi ngaphandle kwezintela, ukukhokha okuhlanganisa noma okungahlanganisi kuphela amandla okuphatha ukuhambisana nezivumelwano mayelana nezindlela zokuthola imali ngokubolekwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 66 sePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-National Ports Authority izophatha futhi ilawule ngokuhambisana nalesi sikhumbuzo ngophiko lwezikhulu. Izikhulu kufanele, ekusebenziseni amandla azo, zenze ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zenkampani ngokulandela uhlelo lwebhizinisi lwesikhashana kanye nohlelo lwezikhathi ezide oluthunyelwe noluvunywe nguNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 52 sePublic Finance Management Act njengoba kuguqulwe nguMthetho No. 29 ka-1999. j ukuvuma ukuqashwa kwabanye abasebenzi abawumsebenzi weNational Ports Authority; kanye kokuqhuba umgomo kaHulumeni mayelana nezohwebo zezikhumulo. Ibhodi lezikhulu lizokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi. UNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi angakhetha amalungu angaphezu kwezingu-7 ngokubiza abantu abavela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuze benze iziphakamiso. ezohwebo, ezimali, ezomthetho nezomnotho; noma v ulwazi oluthile olungasiza inkampani ekwenzeni umsebenzi wayo 4 Amalungu ebhodi akufanele amele iqembu elithile kodwa kufanele akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhumulo ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke abasebenzisi bezikhumulo. b ukuhlela imibono nezikhalazo ezitholakele ngenxa yesaziso. h ukuba yilungu lePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, noma ube yilungu leZigaba zendawo noma ube yilungu lekhansela lezakhamuzi, okuzobavimbela ekubeni yisikhulu ngaphansi kweCompanies Act No. 61 ka-1973. Umgibeli angabamba isikhundla isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku lokukhethwa kwakhe. Ukufunda Nge-Inthanethi Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso Uhlanga lwethu lwenziwa ngezindlela eziningi zokufunda, futhi namuhla sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile – ukufunda nge-inthanethi. Ukuze sithole umbono ophusile, sithintane noMnu. Thabo Mthethwa, ongumfundisi ophumelele, futhi usebenzisa izinkundla ze-inthanethi ukuze afundise abafundi bakhe. Ingxenye 2: Ukufunda Nge-Inthanethi Mnu. Mthethwa, ngingathanda ukwazi ukuthi yini eyenza ukufunda nge-inthanethi kube yindlela efanele yokufunda? “Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunikeza abafundi ithuba lokufunda ngezikhathi zabo. Abafundi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziningi, njengezincwadi, amavidiyo, nezifundo ezikwi-inthanethi, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngezikhathi ezithile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufunda, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezibopho eziningi.” Ingxenye 3: Izinsiza Zokufunda Ngabe ungabelana ngezinsiza ezithile ozisebenzisayo ukuze uthuthukise ukufunda kwe-inthanethi? “Yebo, kunezinsiza eziningi ezitholakalayo. Ngithanda ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana ne-Khan Academy, Coursera, ne-EdX. Lezi zinkundla ziqukethe izifundo ezilungiselelwe kahle, ezivela ezikhungweni ezihlonishwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana ne-YouTube, lapho ngithola khona amavidiyo ahlukahlukene anikeza izifundo ezithile.” Ingxenye 4: Izinselelo Zokufunda Nge-Inthanethi Kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokufunda nge-inthanethi, akunjalo? “Yebo, kunjalo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuzibophezela. Abafundi bangathola kube nzima ukuzigcina bephokophele ekufundeni, ngoba akukho msebenzi ophathekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuxhumana, njengokungabi ne-inthanethi esheshayo noma izinsiza ezikude, zingaba yinkinga enkulu.” Ingxenye 5: Ukubaluleka Kwezifundo Ezihlanganayo Ngabe ucabangani ngokuqhathanisa ukufunda nge-inthanethi nezifundo zendabuko? “Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyindlela ehlukile, kodwa akukwazi ukwehlisa ukubaluleka kwezifundo zendabuko. Zombili zinezinzuzo zazo. Izifundo zendabuko zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nothisha, kuyilapho ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunikeza ukufinyelela okukhulu. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa lezi zindlela ukuze sithole imiphumela engcono.” Ingxenye 6: Ukubhekisisa Ikusasa Lokufunda Nge-Inthanethi Ucabanga ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda nge-inthanethi liza kanjani? “Ngikholelwa ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda nge-inthanethi lizoba nempumelelo enkulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona izindlela ezintsha zokufunda ezitholakala. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukufunda kube lula nakakhulu, futhi kuzokwandisa ukufinyelela kwabafundi emhlabeni jikelele.” Ingxenye 7: Isiphetho Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Mthethwa, ngokwabelana ngombono wakho ngale ndaba ebalulekile. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyindlela eguquguqukayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokufunda ukuze sithole imiphumela engcono. Njengoba sithokozisa ubuchwepheshe, kufanele siqhubeke sithuthukisa izindlela zethu zokufunda, ukuze sikwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona ukuthi ukufunda nge-inthanethi akusiyo nje indlela yokufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okukhula kwabafundi emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sithuthukisa lezi zindlela, ukuze siphumelele emhlabeni osashintsha njalo.
Ezokukhangisa: Umthelela Wazo Emphakathini NakuMakhasimende Ezokukhangisa, noma advertising, ziwumkhakha obalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo. Uhlelo lokukhangisa luhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene zokwazisa, ukukhuthaza, nokukhanga amakhasimende, ukuze kuthuthukiswe imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo. Umgomo omkhulu wezokukhangisa uwukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, ukuze kube nokwaziswa okukhulu ngemikhiqizo ethile, kukhuthazwe ukuthengwa, futhi kuncishiswe umkhankaso wokuncintisana. Isigaba sokuqala sokuhlola ezokukhangisa siqala ngokuqonda imvelaphi yalesi sikhala. Ezokukhangisa ziqale zaba khona ngesikhathi sokuhweba, lapho abathengisi babengadinga izindlela zokwazisa abantu ngempahla abahlinzekayo. Ngaleso sikhathi, izindlela zokukhangisa zazilula futhi zifaka phakathi izikhangiso ezibhaliwe, izithombe, kanye nezinkulumo zomlomo. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, izindlela zokukhangisa zathuthuka zaya emhlabeni we-digital, lapho izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zifinyelele kubathengi abaningi. Okwamanje, ezokukhangisa zifaka phakathi iziteshi eziningi, njengezikhangiso zomsakazo, ezemidlalo, ezokuxhumana, nezikhangiso ze-inthanethi. Lokhu kuhluka kweziteshi kukhombisa ukuthi abathengisi badinga ukuqonda izitayela nezifiso zabathengi ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela imikhankaso yabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ucwaningo olunzulu ukuze kuqondwe kahle izidingo zabathengi, izinkanyezi zomkhiqizo, kanye nezimo zemakethe. Isigaba esibalulekile sokukhangisa siwokwakha imiyalezo esebenzayo. Imiyalezo kufanele ibe nomthelela, icacile, futhi ihambisane nezidingo zabathengi. Ukuze imiyalezo ibe neqhaza, kufanele ibonise izinzuzo zomkhiqizo, ikhuthaze ubudlelwano phakathi komkhiqizo nomthengi, futhi ibonise indlela umkhiqizo ungathuthukisa ngayo impilo yomthengi. Lokhu kudinga ubuciko obukhulu bokuhlela, ukwakha, nokuhlola imiyalezo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iyafinyelela futhi iyathinta. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde imithetho nemigomo ethinta ezokukhangisa. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ecacile, yokwethembeka, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abathengi. Ukuze kube nokwethenjelwa, izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izikhangiso zazo aziphuli imithetho, futhi zihlala zihlola umthelela wezokukhangisa emiphakathini ethile. Ukuhlonipha umphakathi nokugqugquzela izimiso zokuziphatha eziyinqaba kubalulekile ekwakheni isithombe esihle somkhiqizo. Umthelela wezokukhangisa emiphakathini ungahluka, kuncike kumkhankaso owakhiwe. Kwezinye izimo, ezokukhangisa zingaba nomthelela omuhle, zikhuthaze abantu ukuba bathenge imikhiqizo ethile, zikhuthaze umnotho, futhi zikhuthaze ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi. Nokho, uma ezokukhangisa zisetshenziswa ngendlela engafanele, zingaholela ekutheni abantu bathenge imikhiqizo engadingekile, okungaholela ekudluliseni izinkolelo ezingezinhle. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde kahle, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlela imikhankaso yazo ngendlela ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa umthelela omkhulu ezokukhangisa. Izinkampani zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nezokuxhumana ukuze zifinyelele kubathengi. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha okubambisana phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuthi abathengisi baqonde kahle izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, abathengisi kufanele bakhuthaze ukuxhumana okuvulekile, baphendule imibuzo, futhi baphendule izidingo zabathengi. Ekugcineni, ezokukhangisa zidlala indima ebalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo. Zihlinzeka ngezindlela zokwazisa, ukukhuthaza, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi. Ukuze kube nempumelelo, izinkampani kufanele ziqonde kahle izidingo zabathengi, zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi zihlale zihlola umthelela wezokukhangisa emiphakathini. Ngale ndlela, ezokukhangisa zingaba yinsika yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo, okhulisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kukhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu.
Umbiko Ngokuqhubeka Kwenkululeko YaseNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Inkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika ibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wezwe. Iphakathi kwezinto eziphawulekayo ezashintsha ubuso bezwe, ikakhulukazi phakathi nekhulu lama-20. Le nkululeko ibonisa isifiso sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika sokuphila ngaphandle kokucwaswa, ukungalingani, nokuhlukunyezwa. Umbiko lo uzogxila emlandweni, ezicini ezahlukene zenkululeko, kanye nezimpumelelo ezitholakele. Umlando Wokulwa Nenkululeko Umlando wenkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika uqala ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwempucuko yesikhumbuzo, lapho abantu abamnyama baqala ukubona ububi bokuhlukaniswa. Ngemva kokutholwa kokuzimela kwaseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1961, izinhlelo zokuhlukaniswa kwabantu, ezaziwa ngokuthi yi-Apartheid, zathuthukiswa. Lezi zinhlelo zashiya abantu abamnyama, abamhlophe, nabanye abantu bezizinda ezahlukene behlukaniswe, bephila ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi bephathwa ngendlela ehlukile. Ngalesi sikhathi, izigameko eziningi zenzeka. I-ANC (African National Congress) yasungulwa ngo-1912, futhi yabe isiba yinsika yokulwa ne-Apartheid. UNelson Mandela, owayengumholi we-ANC, waba yisithonjana sokulwa nalesi simo. Ukuboshwa kwakhe ngo-1962 kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, esakhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphakame balwe. Izinyathelo Zokulwa Nenkululeko Ukulwa nenkululeko akuzange kube lula. Izinhlangano eziningi, njenge-ANC, i-PAC (Pan Africanist Congress), ne-SACP (South African Communist Party), zaba neqhaza elikhulu. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlakulela imikhankaso ehlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinsuku zokuzindla, imibhikisho, nokuphikisana ngenkani. Umkhankaso we-Defiance Campaign ngo-1952, ophakanyiswe nguMandela, wawusiza ekukhuthazeni abantu ukuba baphikise izinqubomgomo ze-Apartheid. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imibhikisho efana neSharpeville Massacre ngo-1960, lapho abantu abangu-69 babulawa, yakhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokulwa. Lezi zenzakalo zashiya umthelela omkhulu, zakhuthaza umhlaba wonke ukuba ubheke eNingizimu Afrika. Izinguquko Zomhlaba Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinguquko zomhlaba nazo zaba nomthelela. Ukuqhamuka kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili kwashintsha umbono wabantu ngezobulungiswa. Izwe laseNingizimu Afrika laqala ukubona ukwesekwa okuvela kwamanye amazwe, ikakhulukazi eminyakeni ye-1980. Izwe elijulile elalikhuluma ngezobulungiswa, njenge-United Nations, laqala ukucela ukuthi izwe laseNingizimu Afrika lenze izinguquko. Ukufika Kwenkululeko Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokulwa, inkululeko yafika ngo-1994. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esibalulekile, lapho uNelson Mandela, emva kokuphuma ejele, waba nguMongameli wokuqala omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweDemocracy, lapho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungubani, enelungelo lokuvota. Ukhetho lwango-1994 lwaluyisigameko esikhulu, lwabhalisa umlando omusha. Izithiyo Nezinkinga Zamanje Nokho, nakuba inkululeko ibonakala, izithiyo zikhona. Ukuhlukaniswa komnotho, ububha, nezinkinga zokungalingani ziyaqhubeka. Abantu abaninzi basakhumbula ubuhlungu be-Apartheid, futhi izinkinga zempilo, imfundo, nezokusebenza ziyaqhubeka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni, izakhamuzi, kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele zisebenze ndawonye ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi inkululeko iyatholakala kubo bonke. Isiphetho Inkululeko yaseNingizimu Afrika iyisifundo sokuthi abantu bangakwazi kanjani ukuhlanganisa amandla abo ukuze balwe nezinhlelo ezimbi. Iphinde ibonise ubuhlakani, ukuzinikela, nokubambisana kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Nakuba kukhona izinselelo, umhlaba kufanele uqhubeke uvuselela umoya wokubambisana, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inkululeko iyaphila, ibalulekile, futhi iyatholakala kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi izifiso zabantu zikhona, futhi izifiso zenkululeko zihlala zikhanya.
