Ngokwemigomo yephakheji yomhlalaphansi, wonke umhlalaphansi kumele unikeze abaphathi bephakheji ubufakazi bokuthi basaphila. Amafomu abizwa ngokuthi "Isitifiketi Sokuphumelela Komhlalaphansi" athunyelwe kubo bonke abathola umhlalaphansi, kanye ne-envelopu ekhokhelwe ngaphambi kokubuyisela lawa mafomu mahhala. Umhlalaphansi ongakwenzi lokhu uzothola umhlalaphansi wakhe uvunyelwe ekupheleni kukaSepthemba unyaka nonyaka. Enye into ebalulekile kubathola umhlalaphansi ukuthi umhlalaphansi awupheleli kodwa utholwa kuze kube isikhathi sokufa. Ngokufanayo, uma umhlalaphansi efela, umkakhe uzophinde athole umhlalaphansi impilo yakhe yonke kuze kube isikhathi sokufa kwakhe. Kubalulekile ukuthi noma yimiphi imibuzo ibhekiswe kuDerrick Radebe ocingweni 031-311 1603, otholakala kwiNtu 6; Florence Mkhize Building, 251 Anton Lembede (Smith) Street, eThekwini.
Kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi injongo yokulima ukuhweba ekugcineni. Kudinga imali eningi ukuze uqale ukutshala ummbila. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla zibalulekile kakhulu uma uphatha ibhizinisi lokulima. Sidinga ukuhlela izindleko ngezindlela ezimbili - izindleko eziqondile nezindleko ezishintshashintshayo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezindleko eziphelele zokuphatha ibhizinisi lokulima epulazini - lezi yizindleko ezingabangelwa ukutshala isivuno esithile. Lokhu kungabandakanya izindleko zokuhlola amarekhodi ezimali, imali yasebhange, amaholo, ugesi, amalayisense, ukuphathwa nokulungiswa, inzalo yemali ebolekiwe, ukuphathwa kwemoto, izinto zokubhala, njll. Lezi zindleko zingahluka kumlimi nomlimi ngoba usayizi wezinkambu awufani, inani lesikweletu lihlukile, futhi abanye abalimi abaphathi ukulima ngendlela efanayo. Lezi zindleko zihambisana nohlobo lwesivuno esithile esitshaliwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindleko ezifana ne-diesel, umanyolo, imbewu (ukutshala), amakhemikhali, ukuvuna, ukuthengisa, kanye namaholo abasebenzi. Njalo lezi zindleko endaweni eyodwa yehektare zingahluka kakhulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ulima ngendlela ethile noma utshala isivuno esithile, zifana kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukucabanga kahle ngezimali ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukutshala noma yisiphi isivuno. Kungcono kakhulu ukuhlela ukutshala indawo enkulu kahle ukuze uqinisekise umkhiqizo omuhle.
Umlando Wezinyunyana Zabasebenzi Umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi uhlanganisa izigigaba ezibalulekile emsebenzini, lapho izisebenzi ziqoqa ukuze zixoxe ngezinkinga ezithinta umsebenzi wazo. Lokhu kuhlangana kwenzeka eminyakeni engama-19, ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezimboni, lapho abesifazane nabesilisa bejolise ekwenzeni imisebenzi eminingi ukuze baphile. Izinyunyana zabasebenzi zafika ukuze zikhuthaze amalungelo abasebenzi, ziqinise izwi labo, futhi ziqhube izinguquko emisebenzini. Ekuqaleni, izinyunyana zokuqala zaziyizinhlelo ezincane, ezazihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimo zokusebenza. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane nabodadewethu, ababehlale besebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Izinyunyana zokuqala zenza imizamo yokuvikela abathengi nemithetho yokusebenza, okuhlanganisa isikhathi sokusebenza esifanele, ukukhokhelwa kahle, kanye nezinsizakalo zempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinyunyana zathola ukusekela kwezinkampani ezinkulu, lapho ukuhweba kwaba yindlela yokuphikisa ezimeni ezinzima. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezibuhlungu, okubalwa kuzo ama-strike, lapho abasebenzi bezama ukufaka izicelo zabo zokuphila kangcono nezimo zokusebenza. Lezi zimo zanquma indlela abanye abantu abaphila ngayo, futhi zaveza izidingo zokuba nezinqubomgomo ezihle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyunyana zashintsha indlela iNingizimu Afrika ibuka ngayo amalungelo abantu. Ngesikhathi sokulwa nezinhlekelele zomphakathi, izinyunyana zaba yisikhumbuzo sokukhuthaza ukulingana nokuphikisana nobandlululo. Lokhu kwaholela ekuqhamukeni kwezinyunyana eziningi ezikhuthaza amalungelo abantu, zifaka phakathi nezinyunyana zezimoto, ezamapulazi, nezeluleko. Umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi ubonisa ukuthi ukusebenza ndawonye kubalulekile ekufezeni izinjongo ezinkulu. Izinyunyana zaba izinkanyezi zokukhanya ezikhuthaza abafundi nabanye abantu ukuthi bakhuthalele amalungelo abo. Zasiza ekwakheni umqondo wokubambisana, lapho wonke umuntu ebonakalisa ukusizakala kokusebenza ndawonye. Namuhla, izinyunyana zabasebenzi ziqhubeka nokuba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Zikwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa abantu, zikhuthaza izwi labo, futhi ziqinisa umoya wokubambisana. Ngesikhathi esithile, izisebenzi ziba nemisebenzi yokugcina izinyunyana zikhona nezinsiza ezikhona ukuze ziqhubele phambili amalungelo abantu. Okwamanje, izinyunyana zabasebenzi zibonakala njengezinto eziyisisekelo empilweni yomsebenzi. Zikwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazitholele umphakathi, futhi zikhuthaza ukuthi amalungelo abantu kufanele aqhubeke nokuvikelwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi uyinqaba yesikhathi, lapho izisebenzi ziqinisa umoya wokuqina, zikhuthaza izinguquko ezinhle, futhi ziqhubeka nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngakho-ke, umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi uwuhlobo lwemidlalo yokulwa, lapho abathathi-nxaxheba bephikisana namathuba ukuze bafeze izidingo zabo. Lokhu kuhlangana kukhombisa ukuthi kumele sibe nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Izinyunyana zabasebenzi ziyinsika yempumelelo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izwi labantu liyaqondwa futhi lithokoziswa. Lokhu kuphakamisa umehluko phakathi kokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela nokusebenza phansi kwezimo ezinzima. Umlando wezinyunyana zabasebenzi ubonisa ukuthi, ngenkathi izinkinga zikhula, umoya wobumbano uyakhula. Ukuhlangana kwabantu, ukuxoxisana, nokusebenzisana kufakazela ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuqhubeka njalo, bezama ukufezekisa izinjongo ezibekiwe. Lona umqondo obalulekile ekwakheni isizwe esiqinile nesisebenzisanayo, lapho wonke umuntu ekwazi ukuthola ithuba lokukhula. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizoxhumana nezinyunyana zabasebenzi ukuze sikhumbule ubuhlakani bokubambisana, futhi sizibophezele ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono, elinokulingana nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi izinyunyana zihlale zikhona, futhi ziqhubeke nokukhuthaza amalungelo nezidingo zabasebenzi emhlabeni wonke.
Izibulala-zinambuzane zisetshenziswa kakhulu ezinhlelweni ezilawula izihlahla ezimbi. Lezi zibulala-zinambuzane kufanele zisetshenziswe ukweseka ezinye izindlela ezikhona. Lezi zindlela zifaka phakathi izindlela zokulima ezinhle ezifana nokufaka umanyolo owanele kanye ne-mulch ukuze kuvumele izitshalo ukuba ziqinise kahle, ukujikeleza izinhlobo zezitshalo, kanye nokulima kahle. Konke lokhu kubalulekile lapho izihlahla ezimbi kufanele zilawulwe kahle. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa ngemuva kokulima lapho kusasele isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokutshala. Izibulala-zinambuzane ngokuvamile zixutshwa nomhlabathi ophakeme usebenzisa umshini oxuba umhlabathi nezibulala-zinambuzane. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa emhlabathini ngemuva kokulima kanye nokulungiselela umhlabathi wokutshala kodwa ngaphambi kokutshala. Ixhunywa nomhlabathi ophakeme futhi hhayi kakhulu; kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zemishini ezisebenza kule nqubo. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa ezitshalweni ngemuva kokukhula kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele emhlabathini. Umoya emhlabathini, imvula encane, kanye nokunyakaza okuncane komhlabathi kungasiza ekusebenzeni kahle kwezibulala-zinambuzane ngaphambi kokukhula. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa ezitshalweni ngemuva kokukhula. Le yisinyathelo esiphakathi esivumela izibulala-zinambuzane ukuba spread futhi zibe neqhaza elilinganayo uma zixhumana nezitsha noma nomhlabathi. Kunezisho eziningi ezichaza le nhlangano yezibulala-zinambuzane ezifana ne-adjuvant, i-detergent, i-emulsifier, i-spreader, i-sticker, kanye ne-wetting agent. Izinhlobo eziningi zezibulala-zinambuzane ezisetshenziswa kwezolimo zikh selectiv. Uma zisetshenziswa kahle, zizobulala noma zibe nomthelela kwezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo ezimbi kodwa azizukulimaza izitshalo ezikhulayo lapho. Uma usebenzisa izibulala-zinambuzane ezikhethiwe, kufanele ulandele imiyalelo yokufaka ngokucophelela ngoba uma uxuba izibulala-zinambuzane eziningi, ungabulala noma ulime izitshalo zakho. Umthwalo uzobe usezandleni zakho uma ungahambisani nemiyalelo esetikini. Funda itikiti futhi ulandele imiyalelo. Ukulinganisa kahle kubalulekile kakhulu uma ufaka izibulala-zinambuzane. Kunezinto ezintathu okufanele sizinakekele uma sithululela: usayizi wezimpaphe, usayizi wesiphumuli, kanye nesivinini sokuthululela. Imiyalelo ekhombisa inani lezibulala-zinambuzane okufanele zifakwe iyahluka ngokuya ngendawo yomhlabathi (umhlabathi ophakeme, umhlabathi ophakathi, umhlabathi we-clay) kanye nenani lempaphe zomhlabathi ezikhona. Inani lezibulala-zinambuzane ezifakwe emhlabathini ophakeme onempaphe eziningi ngokuvamile lincane; emhlabathini we-clay onempaphe eziningi, inani lezibulala-zinambuzane linyuka. Bheka itikiti ukuze uthole inani elifanele lezibulala-zinambuzane kanye nesimo somhlabathi wakho. Izinhlobo zezitshalo ezimbi ezingakwazi ukumelana nezibulala-zinambuzane zingavela uma izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanayo zifakwa kaningi nangendlela efanayo. Ukujikeleza izinhlobo zezitshalo ezitshaliwe, ukushintsha izinhlobo zezibulala-zinambuzane ezisebenza ngezindlela ezahlukene kungavimbela ukuvela kwezihlahla ezimbi ezingakwazi ukumelana nezibulala-zinambuzane. Isidingo semvula ngemuva kokufaka izibulala-zinambuzane ezifakwe ngemuva kokukhula kubalulekile. Khumbula ukuthi isikhathi esithile ngaphandle kwemvula sidingeka ngemuva kokufaka noma iyiphi izibulala-zinambuzane. Uma imvula iwela ngesikhathi, kungase kudingeke ukufaka kabusha izibulala-zinambuzane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle ukuvusa izihlahla ezimbi. Izibonelo: 2,4-D amine 6-8 amahora; 2,4-D ester 1-2 amahora; Atrazine 4 amahora; Basagran 8 amahora. Isikhathi esibalulekile sokulawula izihlahla ezimbi siyisici esibalulekile se-Integrated Weed Management (IWM). Lesi sikhathi sikhombisa lapho isivuno sokudla sisesimweni lapho singafanele sithinteke ezihlahleni ezimbi ngoba kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokukhiqiza. Le mbono isiza ukukhomba isikhathi esifanele sokufaka izibulala-zinambuzane ngemuva kokukhula okungahlali emhlabathini isikhathi eside, ivimbele futhi isebenzise izibulala-zinambuzane ezihlala isikhathi sonke sokukhula kwesitshalo futhi ifake kabusha izibulala-zinambuzane ngemuva kwesikhathi. Isikhathi esibalulekile sihambisana nosayizi besitshalo, isimo somhlabathi, isimo sezulu, kanye nesikhathi sokukhula esingase sahluke ezindaweni ezithile. Lesi sikhathi esibalulekile sihlose ukufinyelela ingozi yezihlahla ezimbi engaphansi kuka-5%. Isivuno akufanele sithinteke ezihlahleni ezimbi ngesikhathi lesi ukuze kuvinjelwe ingozi engaphezu kuka-5%. Uma izihlahla ezimbi zilawulwa kahle phakathi kwalesi sikhathi esibalulekile, izihlahla ezimbi ezivela ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi azizukulimaza isivuno. Isikhathi esibalulekile singahluka ngokuya ngezimo zezulu kanye nendawo lapho isivuno sikhula khona. Ukuhlola lokhu emasimeni nase-soybeans kukhombisa ukuthi isikhathi singahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomhlabathi kanye nezindlela zokulima, isikhathi sikhula futhi uma kutshalwa emasimeni futhi uma kungenalutho okutholakalayo. Isikhathi esibalulekile sihamba phakathi kwezinyanga ezi-3 kuya kwezi-8 (nxa izinyanga ezingu-4-10 noma izigaba ze-V2-V6 zikhula). Izihlahla ezimbi kufanele zilawulwe kahle phakathi kwalesi sikhathi. Ummbila ongekho ngaphansi kwengcindezi yezihlahla ezimbi ezinsukwini ezi-34 ngemuva kokutshala noma lapho kunezinyanga ezi-6-8 (nxa izinyanga ezi-8-10 zibonakala) ukhombisa ingozi yokukhiqiza engama-0-5% futhi kukhona izihlahla ezimbi ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi. Izithiyo zezezimali zisiza ekukhombiseni ukuthi inani lezihlahla ezimbi likhombisa ingozi ethile futhi ukubona uma kuzosisiza ukubulala izihlahla ezimbi - lokhu kusho ukuthi kukhombisa ukuthi ingozi yezihlahla ezimbi izoba phezulu kunezindleko zokufaka izibulala-zinambuzane. Isikhathi lapho izihlahla ezimbi ziqala ukuvela sikhombisa kakhulu izinga lengozi. Izihlahla ezimbi ezivela ngokushesha eduze kwezivuno zenza ingozi enkulu kune-ingozi eyenzeka uma izihlahla ezimbi ziqala ukuvela kamuva uma isivuno sesiqinile. Ngokwesibonelo, ukuhlola izithiyo zezezimali uma 'pigweed', 'ragweed', kanye 'barnyard-grass' ziqala ukuvela kukhombisa ukuthi isikhathi sokuvuleka kwezihlahla ezimbi sibalulekile kakhulu sithola inani lezihlahla ezimbi ezivela kamuva uma kuqhathaniswa nezingozi. Ingozi nokulahleka kokukhiqiza kuhlobene nesikhathi lapho izihlahla ezimbi ziqala ukuvela. Ithebula 1 izama ukukhombisa izinga lengozi elingavela uma izihlahla ezimbi ezahlukene ziqala ukuvela emasimeni nase-soybeans. Iphesenti lokulahleka kokukhiqiza ngenxa yezihlahla ezimbi ezivela ngesikhathi esifanayo nezivuno zokudla lapho zingakaze zil
iGautrain: Uhlelo Lokuhamba Olusha E-Gauteng Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuhamba, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwabantu emadolobheni. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziyiphusile nezisebenzayo. Uhlelo lweGautrain, olwakhiwa ngenhloso yokwenza uhambo phakathi kwamadolobha amakhulu kube lula, luthathe izinyathelo ezinkulu ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga. ### Isingeniso iGautrain, okuyinhlangano yokuhamba ngemabha, yethulwa ukuze ithuthukise izinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisebenza kahle. Ihlanganisa iziteshi ezikhethekile ezihlanganisa amadolobha aseGauteng, njengeJohannesburg, Tshwane, ne-Ekurhuleni. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubahambi ukuhamba, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuqhuba izimoto zabo, okwenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini nasezindleleni. ### Ukusebenza Kwe-Gautrain Uhlelo lweGautrain luhlinzeka ngohambo olukhawulezayo noluphephile, olunokusebenza okukhuthazayo kubahambi. Izitimela zihlala zifika ngesikhathi, zisheshisa uhambo lwabantu, futhi ziqukethe izinsiza ezithuthukile. Iziteshi zihlala zihlanzekile futhi zinesimo esikahle, okuhlinzeka ngamava amahle kubahambi. Ngokuhlanganyela nezinye izindlela zokuhamba, iGautrain iba yisixazululo esihle kulabo abafuna ukuhamba ngendlela elula. ### Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa iGautrain Enye yezinzuzo ezinkulu zokusebenzisa iGautrain ukukhululeka okutholakala kubahambi. Abahambi bavame ukukhokha imali encane uma bekhetha ukuhamba ngeGautrain uma kuqhathaniswa nezingozi zokuhamba ngemoto. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhamba, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahamba njalo emsebenzini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iGautrain ikhulisa isikhathi sokusebenza, njengoba abahambi bengachitha isikhathi esincane ezimotweni. ### Ukuhlola Ukusebenza Kwe-Gautrain Abanye abadlali bezokuthutha baseGauteng baveza izinkinga ezithile ezithinta iGautrain. Njengoba iGautrain ithuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zabahambi. Abanye baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi iziteshi ezithile zixhaswa kakhulu, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola indawo yokuhlala. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaphathi beGautrain bahlale beqaphela ukubaluleka kokuphuculwa kwalezi zindawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo esihamba phambili. ### Umphakathi Nezimoto Uhlanga lweGautrain luthinta umphakathi jikelele, njengoba luhlinzeka ngohambo olukhawulezayo noluphephile ngezinsizakalo ezihambisanayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba okukhulisa umnotho, njengoba abahambi bengahamba beya emabhizinisini, ezikhungweni zokungcebeleka, nasezikhungweni zemfundo. I-Gautrain ivumela abantu abaningi ukuba bahlale behlanzekile, benciphisa umthelela wabo emvelweni. ### Izinselelo Noma kunjalo, iGautrain ibhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ngaphezu kwezinkinga zokuxhumana phakathi kweziteshi, abanye abantu bahlala bekhuluma ngentengo yokuhamba, ethintwa yamanani okuphila. Ukuhlola kabusha kwentengo kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabahambi. Abanye abahambi baphawula ukuthi ukudlula komphakathi uma kuqhathaniswa nemoto kubangela ukusilela okuthile ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila. ### Ikusasa Le-Gautrain Ngokubheka phambili, iGautrain inethuba elikhulu lokukhula. Njengoba iGauteng iqhubeka nokukhula, udinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokwenza ukuthi uhlelo luhlale lusebenzela umphakathi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezobuchwepheshe obusha, njengokuhlola amakhadi amasha nezinhlelo zokuhamba, kuzoba nethuba lokwandisa ukusebenza kahle. Ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwezakhamizi nezinkampani, iGautrain ingaba yisixazululo esiyingqayizivele sokuhamba. ### Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kweGautrain, umphakathi waseGauteng uthole ithuba lokuhamba kalula, okwandisa umphumela wokuphila kwabantu. Noma izinselelo zikhona, ukuqhubeka kokuthuthukiswa kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi iGautrain iyinsiza ewusizo yempilo yansuku zonke. Ukusebenza ngempumelelo kungaholela emiphumeleni emihle, okukhombisa ukuthi umoya wokubambisana nokuhamba okukhululekile kuyinselelo ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi. I-Gautrain ibhekwa njengomgibeli obalulekile eGauteng, ikhombisa indlela yokuthuthuka nokuqhubeka.
Inkululeko isifinyelelwe, manje sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babambe iqhaza ekuguquleni izwe lethu kube yilokho esilwe ngakho. Okokuqala emlandweni wethu nasezweni lethu, abantu bethu banikezwe ithuba lokuba nezwi ekubizeni izindawo. Ngale ndlela, kumele sikhombise ukuthi izinto zishintshile, ukuthi sesihambile phesheya kwesikhathi sobandlululo. Kumele sishintshe isithombe sezwe lethu ukuze singaveli njengengxenye yeYurophu kodwa kube njenge-Afrika. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezizoholela ekushintsheni lezo ziqu ezaziyisikhumbuzo nezicaphuna, amagama ezizwe atholakala kwamanye amazwe kanye nalawo abhalwe ngokungalungile. Lokhu kuyimfanelo eqondiswe kuNgqongqoshe wethu Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempela. Kuyimfanelo yethu njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka. Impumelelo yalokhu izoba uphawu lokuguqulwa kweqiniso ezweni lethu elisebuhleni bokushintsha. INingizimu Afrika inohulumeni obalulekile futhi kumele ibonise lokhu kushintsha kulabo abavotele yona nalabo abaseduze kwayo. Kumele isebenze ngokushesha njengamazwe angomakhelwane asevele akhombisile le mfuno ngokususa konke okwakukhumbuza ngezikhathi zokucindezelwa nobandlululo. Bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinhlangano ezikhona zikhululekile ukufaka iziphakamiso zisebenzisa amafomu atholakalayo eHhovisi Elikhulu, iGeographical Names Unit, esekelwe eMnyangweni Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe, P/Bag X894, Pretoria, 0001. Kulawa mafomu, abantu banelungelo lokuphakamisa amagama amasha kanye nezinguquko kumagama akhona, uma kuphela iziphakamiso zikhona nezizathu ezihambisana nazo. Le mibiko ilungiselelwe kusukela ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kweBhodi kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka wokuqala wokuhlinzekwa kwezimali. Ukusekelwa komsebenzi wehhovisi kuBhodi kuvela eMnyangweni Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe (DACTS). Ekuqaleni, bekungaphansi kweNational Language Body yale Mnyango. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kudluliselwe kwiNational Heritage Body yalolu Mnyango. Izinqumo zeBhodi ziqinisekiswa futhi ziqashelwa nguNgqongqoshe. Abantu nezikhungo ezingahambisani nezinqumo ezenziwe yiBhodi bangabhekana nezinyathelo zomthetho. UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe wamukela iziphakamiso zokunqoba abantu abalandelayo, abakhethwe yiKomidi Lokukhetha. Abanqobi bazosebenza kwiNingizimu Afrika Council for Naming Places. Ibhodi ithathe indawo yeNational Names Committee eyayicebisa uhulumeni ngokuqinisekiswa kwamanye amagama ezindawo kusukela ngo-1940. Omunye umehluko obalulekile phakathi kweBhodi kanye nomnyango owasebenza esikhathini esedlule ukuthi le Bhodi inikezwe amandla amaningi ukuze ibhekane nazo zonke izinhlobo zezindawo kuhlanganise; ukufuna lezo zindawo ezidinga ukwenziwa kabusha noma ziqanjwe okokuqala futhi ukuthi izinqumo zayo zizobopha, uma kuphela zamukelwa nguNgqongqoshe. Ibhodi isungule umgomo nezindlela, kulandela izinqumo nezindlela zeZizwe Ezihlangene. Ibhodi inegunya phezu kwazo zonke izindawo namagama nezinto kanye nezakhiwo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeNingizimu Afrika nasezindaweni lapho leli zwe liphatha khona, noma lezo zindawo ezitholakala ngezinkulumo ezithile. Ezinye izizathu ezisemthethweni zingatholakala futhi kumagama abantu abaphilayo. Ukunquma igama noma amagama endaweni kudinga ukuqhathaniswa ngokucophelela phakathi komlando nesidingo solimi, ukuhamba kalula kokuxhumana, umphakathi kanye nenhloso yezwe. Ukuhweba ngolwazi mayelana nezinzuzo zezimali kanye nokuhlangana komphakathi ngenxa yokufana kwamagama ezindawo. Ukuveza isu lokususa, ezinye izindawo ezabizwa ngaphansi kokucindezelwa kufanele zifakwe. Ukuze kube lula, ukusabalalisa ulwazi nokudlulisa ulwazi ngenqubo ehlelekile lapho amagama ezindawo akhiwa, angashicilelwa ezincwadini noma ngezingxenyekazi ze-computer. Ukusungula amaqembu wezindawo ezihlukahlukene (PGNC's), ngaphansi komthetho weNingizimu Afrika Place Names Act kanye nemithetho ephathelene nokufana kwamagama ezindawo. Ibhodi ikhethile amaqembu amancane alandelayo. Ngaphezu kwalabo abakhethwe ekuqaleni, kukhona abanye kanye namalungu angasetshenziswa ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsebenzi wayo ukuhola nokwakha ukufana ekubizeni izindawo: ukuhlola amagama amaningi; lawo asevele ekhona kodwa angamukelekile ngokomthetho, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene ezingenziwa yiBhodi. Ikhono layo: ukusungula isisekelo sokubamba iqhaza; ukuhlela izifundo zokufundisa nezokubuyisela kubafundi; ukuqopha imibhalo yokufundisa nokwakha ithimba ezingeni lesizwe nezasezifundazweni. Emhlanganweni obubanjwe ngomhla ziyi-7 kuNdasa, 2000, kwanqunywa ukusungula ikomidi lokuxhumana nezindaba zomphakathi, ukusabalalisa, nokwazisa umphakathi. Isizathu salokhu ukuhlela nokwabelana ngomsebenzi phakathi kwalezi ziqembu. Ekuqaleni kuka-2001, kwasungulwa ikomidi elincane elisha ngenhloso elandelayo, kanti uNkk. Dichabe wakhethwa njengomphakathi walo. Ukuze usebenze ngesicwangciso sebhodi; ukuya emcimbini wokwethulwa kosuku lwezindawo zezwe; ukuthola imikhakha nezixhumanisi zokuxhumana nezikhungo ezingekho phansi kwemali kanye namathimba akhethiweyo. Ukuqopha ikhodi yokuziphatha; ukukhuthaza indlela iBhodi ebambisana ngayo nezinye izikhungo, ezingeni lezifundazwe nezifunda; ukuhlola imithetho nezindlela eziphathelene nokufana kokubiza izindawo. Le mibhalo iyisisekelo nesingeniso esichaza indlela nezinto iBhodi ehlose ukuzenza. Iphatha izinto ezifana nenhloso yokusungula iBhodi, lokho ikhokhelwa ukukwenza, imisebenzi elindelekile, indawo yegunya, izinqubo nemigomo, isu elikhulu lebhodi, kanye nezimali ezihlinzekwayo. Ngokwemithetho, enye yezinto ezisemqoka zeBhodi ukukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamakhamphani wezindawo eziphakeme. Lezi zikhungo kufanele zisungulwe nguMnyango Wezifundazwe ophatha Ezobuciko neZamasiko, ngemva kokubonisana neBhodi. Ibhodi ibhalile uhlu lwezikhombisi zemigomo yalezi zikhungo. Lezi zikhombisi zikhombisa izakhiwo eziphakanyisiwe futhi zinikeza isibonelo sokuthi ingxube yeziqu ingakhiwa kanjani, iziphakamiso zokusebenza kwamalungu nezilindelo, kanye neziphakamiso zokwakha amakhamphani ezindawo ezizokwenziwa ngabasebenzi bezikhungo. Lezi zikhombisi zizophatha umsebenzi weBhodi ngokuhlola amagama alindile nalawo angakakhethwa yiBhodi. Emhlanganweni ngamunye, iBhodi ihlola uhlu lwamagama athunyelwe ukuze aqinisekiswe ezivela kumasipala, eziphakanyisiwe, abathuthukisi bezwe, nezinye izigidi ezithakazelisayo. Kukhona ugqozi oluqinile lokuthi igama libhalwe ngokuhambisana nomthombo wolimi olukhuluma ngalo, kanye nokucabangela izinto ezifana nomlando wokubiza le nto, indawo
Umbiko Ngemidlalo Yamakhompiyutha Isingeniso Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha, eyaziwa nangokuthi imidlalo yevidiyo, isibe yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Kusukela ekwakhiweni kwayo kwasekuqaleni, imidlalo yevidiyo ibonile intuthuko enkulu, yaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ezemidlalo, kanye nasemasikweni. Lo mbiko uzogxila emlandweni, ekuthuthukisweni, nasekuthandeni kwemidlalo yamakhompiyutha, kanye nemithelela yayo emphakathini. Umlando Wemidlalo Yamakhompiyutha Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha yaqala ngonyaka we-1950, lapho abathuthukisi beqala ukudala imidlalo elula efana ne-"Tennis for Two" kanye ne-"Spacewar!". Le midlalo yayingekho ezandleni zabantu abaningi, kodwa yabe isiqala ukusungula umqondo wokudlala imidlalo ngekhompyutha. Ngonyaka we-1970, imidlalo yevidiyo yathuthuka kakhulu, lapho abathuthukisi beqala ukukhiqiza imidlalo ye-arcade efana ne-"Pong" ne-"Space Invaders". Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokudlalwa kwemidlalo, futhi kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezimidlalo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bukhule kakhulu, kwaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemidlalo eyinkimbinkimbi. Namuhla, imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ibonisa izinga eliphezulu lokubukeka, izwi, nokudlala. Izinkampani ezinkulu ezifana ne-Activision, Electronic Arts, kanye ne-Sony ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imidlalo emisha, ethokozisa abadlali. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwezokuxhumana, njenge-PlayStation Network ne-Xbox Live, luye lwavumela abadlali ukuba baxhumane, badlale ndawonye, futhi babelane ngemicabango ngemidlalo. Ukwamukelwa Kwezimidlalo Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha isithole ukwamukelwa okukhulu emiphakathini eminingi. Abantu abavela kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi bathanda ukudlala, kusukela ezinsaneni kuya kubantu abadala. Lokhu kuhlangene nokwanda kokutholakala kwemidlalo ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengeziteshi ze-TV, ama-inthanethi, kanye nezikhangiso. Imidlalo yevidiyo isiphenduke umkhakha omkhulu wezokungcebeleka, inikeza amathuba amaningi emisebenzi, njengokwakha, ukuhlela, kanye nokudlala. Imithelela Emphakathini Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha ayinayo kuphela imiphumela emihle, kodwa futhi inemiphumela emibi. Abanye abantu baveza ukukhathazeka ngokuthi imidlalo ethile ingaholela ekuziphatheni okungafanele, ikakhulukazi emadolobheni amakhulu. Izingane ezidla isikhathi eside zidlala imidlalo zingase zibe nezinselelo ezithile, ezifana nokuntuleka kokuxhumana nabanye, ukuncipha kokugxila, kanye nezinkinga zezempilo. Nokho, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi imidlalo ethile ingathuthukisa amakhono okucabanga, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokusebenza ndawonye. Imidlalo Njengendlela Yokuxhumana Ngokukhula kwemidlalo yevidiyo, abathandi bayo bakwazi ukuhlanganisa imiphakathi emisha. Imidlalo ye-multiplayer ikuvumela ukuba uxhume nabanye abadlali emhlabeni jikelele, udlale ndawonye, futhi wabelane ngemicabango. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obusha, futhi abanye abantu bahlala bexhumana nabanye abadlali emiphakathini ye-inthanethi. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kudala umuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomphakathi, okubalulekile kumuntu ngamunye. Isiphetho Imidlalo yamakhompiyutha isibe nesithakazelo esikhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Iphinde yaguqula indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, bakhuluma, futhi bazijabulisa. Nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nemidlalo, imiphumela emihle ibonakala kakhulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kulindeleke ukuthi imidlalo yevidiyo izophinde ikhulise umphakathi, ibangele izinguquko ezinkulu, futhi iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngothando, ubungane, nokujabula kubantu abaningi. Iminyaka ezayo izobonisa ukuthi imidlalo yamakhompiyutha izoba nendima enkulu empilweni yethu, futhi sizokwazi ukubona izinguquko ezithokozisayo.
Umthelela wesikhathi eside womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall Ngiyavuma, lo mkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ube nomthelela omkhulu, hhayi kuphela ezikhathini eziqondile ezadlalwa, kodwa nasemhlabeni jikelele. Asiqale ngokuqonda. Wasuka ngempela onke amakhamphani, imiphakathi, nezikole, ubizwa ngempela ngokuthi "umkhankaso." Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kwenzekile? Ngaphandle kokuba kudlalwe umoya phakathi kwabafundi, izinsuku zodwa, kodwa lezi zinsuku zikhumbula amadolobha amaningi, ukufundisa, nokuhlanganyela. Ngicabanga ngezinhloso zokuqala. Umsebenzi wokuqala waba ukufaka isithombe, ukubhekana nemfundiso ebanzi, nokwenza ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi umphakathi wethu udinga ushintsho. Abafundi baqale bazwakala, izinkulumo zaba phezulu, futhi abantu babebona ukuthi lezi zifundo azizange zifinyeleleka kuphela ezikoleni ezithile. Kunjalo, uma ubheka lokhu, kunokugonyama okuphakathi, njengoba umoya wokusebenza, udinga ukuba yinto edinga izinyathelo. Ubani owawazi kahle ukuthi izifundo zizoshintsha kanjani? Okokuqala, kwakukhona umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabafundi. Abantu babefuna ukuba nezezimali. Ngabe ubona lokhu? Nokho, akuphali nje, ngenxa yokuhlukana kwezemali, uthishanhloko awazange ahambisane. "Thina sizokwenza okuthile," bekulokhu kukhulu. Umfundisi ubenobunzima empilweni yakhe, kepha abanye bezwa, lokhu kwaqala ukufaka izinqumo zawo ezinzima. Izikhathi zashintsha, abanye abavakashi bamukela izifundo ezithile eziphakeme, nezikhangiso zitholakala. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Kukhona izinyathelo eziningi ezithathelwe nenhloso yokududuzela abafundi. Abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi akusho ukuthi angama-70% akhona kuphela. Lokhu kwaholela ekubeni abantu bakwazi ukubona ukuthi umnyango ubukhona, baphakamisa izwi labo. Futhi, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall awuphumelelanga kuphela kwi-education system, kepha futhi kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Abantu baziwa kakhulu, ukusebenza kwabo kwezemfundo kudinga ukusizwa. Lokhu kwaba umgogodla, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bazi ukuthi abakulindele ekuphuzeni, ukudala izikhalazo namalungelo abantu. Ngabe umphakathi wazifaka kanjani? Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi basebenze izisekelo. Umsebenzi waba yinto ethokozisayo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umphakathi uqhubeke uhamba phambili. Kwaholelwa futhi ezintweni ezinjengokuhumusha iziphetho zokuthola imfundo, nezinsuku ezinzima. Sazomangalisa ngendlela abafundi bakhombisa izithakazelo zabo kumaphoyisa. Ngaphakathi kwalokho, iminyango yokuqala yokuqala yathatha izinyathelo zebhande, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu. Abantu bazi kahle ukuthi imfundo iyatholakala, futhi imiphakathi iqhubeka, kudinga ukufuna ukuba umsebenzi udinga ukuthokozisa. Ngokubuza lezi zindaba, kuphinde kuvimbe, abantu bazi ukubona ukuthi izinto sezisiphendukile. Thembisa lokhu, sizokwenza ukusika umcabango. Hhayi-ke, lokhu umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall kube umcimbi omuhle empilweni, kepha akukhona ukuthi akukhona nephutha. Kukhona ukungabaza okufana nokuthi "ngabe sifuna ukushintsha imithetho,?" kepha lokhu bekungesona isizathu esingaba yisinyathelo esisha. Umkhankaso uveze izifundo ezithile, ngabe lokho kudalwa yikuphi ukungabazeki? Futhi akukhona nje esikhathini esisha, kukhona abavota abasha, izinsiza zikaMasipala. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umphakathi naye uyashintsha. Umsebenzi wezemfundo uyathokoziswa kakhulu. Ukubhekwa kwezemfundo kokuqhubeka nezinhlelo zokufunda kuqabula izixhumanisi ezithile. Ngabe abathinta abathinta? Abafundi bahlala baphumelela emhlabeni jikelele, kepha umkhosi ubonisa ezinye izigwegwe ezithandwayo. Abafundi baqala ukufunda ukuthi banakho. Lokhu kunika umhlaba umbono omusha. Isikhathi sihamba, kepha umthelela womkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall ufuna ukuxhaswa, izikhangiso ezidingeka, nokubamba iqhaza emazweni ahlukile. Kukho abaqhoshayo, abathokozelayo, nabe nezinhlangano ezithile abangenazo izinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umkhankaso uqhubeka, ngisho naphakathi kwezinhlekelele. Ubufakazi bokuthi abafundi babekwenza akukho kuphumelelayo nakancane. Mhla ubona izimpi ezinzima, sinokukhumbula ukuthi lokhu akupheli. Umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall uvula amathuba, kepha uthinta igunya, ngabe lokho kuyinto edinga ukubhekwa? Ngokuvamile, umsebenzi omuhle we-Fees Must Fall awukupheli, futhi sizokwazi ukuxoxa ngo-2016. Ngokubungaza lokho, sithi umphakathi udinga ukwenza ukufuna impilo. Ngabe kunokuthile okungashintsha lokhu? Lo mkhankaso uzobonisa ukuthi ubungcweti busemathubeni. Ngiyazi ukuthi imfundo iyadingeka, nokho, umkhankaso we-Fees Must Fall waphakanyiswa ngezinyathelo ezinzima, futhi umthelela unamandla. Funda, hamba phambili! Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi imfundo iyinsiza, futhi lokho kuzoletha ushintsho. Uhambo nutshwala, futhi akupheli!
Umbiko: Amanzi Ahlanzekile Isingeniso Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sempilo yomuntu, imvelo, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala. Ukuze siphile impilo enempilo, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe namanzi ahlanzekile. Nokho, emhlabeni jikelele, kuningi okwenzeka okubangela ukuthi amanzi angase abe neziphungo ezimbi, okubangela izinkinga eziningi empilweni yabantu. Lo mbiko uzobheka izinzuzo zamanye ahlanzekile, izinkinga ezihambisana nokungahambi kahle kokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela nokuthuthukisa izinsiza zamanzi. Ukuhlukaniswa Kwezinhlobo Zamanzi Amanzi angahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezimbili ezinkulu: amanzi aphesheya (surface water) namaqhwa (groundwater). Amanzi aphesheya afaka izixazululo ezinjengemifula, amathafa, nezixazululo ezincane ezifana nezinkanyezi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, amaqhwa atholakala ngaphansi komhlaba, avame ukuba nekhwalithi engcono kunezamanzi aphesheya. Nokho, nokho, bobabili bahlushwa yizinkinga ezifana nokungcoliswa, ukuchithwa, nokungabi khona kokufinyelela. Izimbangela Zokungcoliswa Kwamazwe Ukwanda kwabantu, imisebenzi yokuhweba, kanye nezinsiza ezahlukahlukene ezifana nezimboni, kuba nemithelela emibi ekutholeni amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kugcwalisa amanzi ngezinto ezingcolisayo, okuhlanganisa nezehlakalo ezifana nezibhamu, izidakamizwa, nezinye izinto ezimbi. Ubulungiswa bezemvelo buye buba yinkinga enkulu, lapho izindlela zokukhiqiza ezintsha zenza ukuthi izindawo eziningi ziguqulwe, zibe nezingozi ezinkulu. Imiphumela Yokungcoliswa Kwamazwe Ukungcoliswa kwamazimphumela kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yomuntu. Amanzi angcolile angaholela ezigulweni ezinzima ezifana ne-cholera, i-typhoid fever, nezinye izifo ezihlobene nezinkinga zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abaningi abathola amanzi ahlanzekile bahlushwa yizinkinga zempilo, okungaholela ekutheni bahlwempuze, baphumelele. Lokhu kuthinta kakhulu izindawo eziningi ezikude noma ezinezinsiza ezincane. Izinyathelo Zokuthuthukisa Ukutholakala Kwamazwe Ahlanzekile Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola amanzi ahlanzekile, ziningi izinyathelo ezingenziwa. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu mayelana nokubaluleka kokuhlanzeka kwamanzi. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngolwazi olubalulekile lokuthi abantu bangagcina kanjani amanzi abo ehluziwe. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokuhlunga amanzi kufanele zithuthukiswe, futhi izinsiza ezifanele zidinga ukwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Umthetho nawo udinga ukuqiniswa ukuze kuvikelwe izinsiza zamanzi. Ukubhekelela izindawo ezisemathafeni, ukwakha izikhungo zokuhlanzeka, nokuvimbela ukungcoliswa kwayo yizinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele zithathwe. Hhayi kuphela kuzodingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, kodwa futhi izisebenzi ezikhethekile zidinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze ziqinisekise izinqubo eziphumelelayo. Ukwenza Ngcono Uhlelo Lokuphathwa Kwamazwe Ukuze sithole amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukuzenzela amasu amahle. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinsiza zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nezizinda ezizimele. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuhlunga, ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo abantu, kanye nokuvikela ubuchwepheshe kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela amanzi ahlanzekile. Ukwenza kahle, umphakathi kumele ube nengqondo yokuhlonipha imithombo yokuphila. Izinhlelo zokulondoloza amanzi azigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka amanzi ahlanzekile, kodwa futhi zakhayo izinzuzo ezinkulu kumphakathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kokuphathwa kwamanzi kudinga ukuba kuyisimo esihlangene esihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Isiphetho Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisisekelo sokuphila. Ukutholakala kwawo kubalulekile empilweni yomuntu, impilo yomphakathi, nezindawo. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kuholela ezinkingeni ezinzima, futhi kudinga izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuvikela lezi zinsiza ezibalulekile, siqinisekise impilo engcono, futhi sakhe umphakathi onempilo. Ngokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, ukufundisa abantu, nokwakha imizamo yokuvikela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba wethu uhlala unamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kuzoba yinsiza enkulu emigomeni yokulwa nokungcoliswa, ukuqinisekisa impilo yempilo emhlabeni wonke.
I-Mount Everest: Ubukhazikhazi Benjabulo Nokungabaza Ngikhumbula ngisebenza endaweni ethile lapho abantu bebebuza khona, "Ucabanga ukuthi kungani abantu behamba phezulu e-Mount Everest?" Ngempela, i-Mount Everest ikhangayo futhi iyingxenye yesiko lethu lendawo yokuphila. Itholakala eHimalayas, le ntaba enkulu ibizwa ngokwenziwa kwayo, kodwa ngaphakathi, ingaphezulu kwezinye izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezikhanyela emkhathini. Njengoba ngibuka le ntaba, ngithola kungabazeki ukuthi ibonisa ubukhulu bezinselele ezikhona empilweni. Izinkulungwane zabakhuphukeli bahamba, benza imizamo yokufinyelela phezulu, kodwa akukwazi ukuba kube lula. Kuye ngempela, lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile nokukhuthazela okukhulu. I-Mount Everest kayilungeli, ifuna labo abanobuchule nemizwa ethile, kube thina sithokozisa izimanga zayo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi imengameli ye-Mount Everest ikhipha umoya. Ingxenye ethokozisayo yokuphuculula impilo ngaphezu kokwenziwa lokho, ivuleka ngaphansi kwenqubo yokuphila. Kodwa ke, ngiyazibuza, "Ingabe ukuchuma kwalezi zifundo ngezinhlekelele ezithile? I-Mount Everest iyingxenye yokuphila lokhu, kodwa kuyini okwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kubanzima kuhamba phambili?" Bazalwane, lokhu kubonakala kuhle, kodwa akukhona nje ukusebenzisa lezi zinto ngabanye. Lokhu kubangela inkinga enkulu kithi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yasendaweni, inhlabamkhosi yesimo sezulu, nemiphumela yokwenziwa kwezemvelo. I-Mount Everest, ngokuyinhloko, ikhuluma ngamakhono abantu, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izifundo ezifundwe phezulu kule ntaba ziza nesibopho sokuthinta wonke umuntu. Abanye bahamba ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene – abanye babheke uhambo lokuzithokozisa, abanye bangeqa abahlengikazi, kodwa ngabe kukhona ukusangana phakathi kwemiphakathi? Uhlanga luzakuva lapho ufinyelela phezulu, kodwa kufanele futhi siqaphele ukuthi silokhu silokhu sinesidingo sokwenza imisebenzi efanele ukuze sigcine lezi zindawo ziqhakazekile. I-Mount Everest ikhiqiza umoya omusha, umoya ohlanzekile, nomoya wempilo engapheli. Ngabe sishiya izinkanyezi ezazisebenzisela abantu abaningi abahlala ezinhlobonhlobo zezimvula, imiphakathi emihle? Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube yisinyathelo esikhuluma ngenhlalakahle, ukuze sizohlala sithokozisa impilo yethu. Emiphakathini eminingi, abantu baphila ngezixhamazela nezinkinga ezikhungethe, kusho ukuthi abaningana abaqondile. Ubukhazikhazi be-Mount Everest bucebisa abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, basebenzisane, futhi babelane ngemicabango. Ngicela ifa lethu eliqinile, elihlobisa izimanga zeHimalayas, ukuze sizithole izifundo ezingaba yinsika yokukhuthaza abazali bethu bamanje. Ngokuphathelene nomoya wezemvelo, sibona ukulwa okukhona ekuphatsweni kokwaziswa, ukuzama ukudlula okuhle phakathi kwethu. Abanye bakhuthazwa uhambo, ngesikhathi esifanayo, kudinga kube nephakathi kwezinto. Sifuna isikhathi esanele sokuphila ngendlela efanele. Ngenkathi sihlonipha i-Mount Everest, asinakulibala ukuthi izimpilo zethu zihambisana nempilo yemvelo; zenze ukuba imiphakathi iqhubeza ibambisane. Kuba usuku olubi uma sikhuluma ngazo zonke lezi zinkinga, kodwa sikhumbula njalo ukuthi i-Mount Everest izigubha izifundo eziphila. Uhambo olwenziwa phezulu akukhona nje ukukhuphuka, kunalokho, kube yindlela yokusebenzisa amandla ethu, amabhizinisi ethu, nemindeni yethu njengabantu. Ukuhlanganyela, uma sikhuluma ngempilo ye-Mount Everest, sikhuluma ngathi; kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi, nangaphandle komthwalo obalulekile lapho ukuhamba kwethu, akufanele sidlule engozini, ngaphandle kwamalungelo nezimiso ezenzakalayo. I-Mount Everest iyingxenye yokuphenya ngaphakathi kwabantu besintu, ukufiphaza imikhuba engalungile, ukuhlanza umoya, nezifundo zakwaHimalayas. Tina, njengabantu, kufanele siphendukele kwi-Mount Everest yethu siqonde izifundo ezichaza ukuthi singabaphila baphakathi. Uhambo lungacela ukukhanya kwemfihlakalo, lungavuleka kokubalulekile, uhambo olukhuluma ngethemba lalezi zifundo zamathekhnoloji nemiphakathi emihle. Ngokuhamba kwangempela, i-Mount Everest iyinsika, ibonisa ukuhamba kwezinto ezinkulu, imiphakathi ezithokozisayo, nezithunywa zempilo. Njengoba sizama ukufinyelela emaphakathini ethu, kufanele sikuphathe kahle uhambo, sihlose ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela ukuze sifeze izimanga ezimbi kule ntaba, sihlanganyele ezimfundisweni, futhi sikhuthaze abanye. Uthando lwezangoma nemindeni yethu, akuyona nje i-Mount Everest; kuyinto eyenzeka phakathi kwethu.
Ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi lwe-GEMS Ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi kubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezeMali, ezempilo, nezokuxhumana. I-GEMS, okuyinhlangano eyaziwayo yokunikezela ngezinsizakalo zezempilo, ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lwemigomo, abantu, kanye nezinsizakalo luhlala lufihliwe futhi lutholakala kuphela kulabo abanezimvume ezifanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangathembela kwi-GEMS futhi bazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luthathwa ngokungathí sina. Ubumfihlo: Incazelo Ubumfihlo buhlanganisa amalungelo abantu ukuba bagcine ulwazi lwabo luhlala lufihliwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imininingwane yomuntu siqu, izinkcukacha zezempilo, nemininingwane yezezimali. I-GEMS ibeka phambili ubumfihlo njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuphatha izinsizakalo zayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, uma umuntu ebhalisela izinsizakalo ze-GEMS, ulwazi lwakhe luhlala lufihliwe, futhi alukwazi ukwabelwana ngalo ngaphandle kwemvume yakhe. Ukuvikelwa Kolwazi: Izinyathelo Zokuphepha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikelwa kolwazi, i-GEMS ithatha izinyathelo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuvikela ulwazi, njengezinhlelo zokuphepha ezivimbela ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inamalungiselelo aqinile okuphatha imininingwane, okwenza kube nzima ukuthi ulwazi lwezokwelapha noma lwezezimali lufinyelelwe ngaphandle kokugunyazwa. Izimiso Zokuvikelwa Kolwazi I-GEMS ilandela izimiso ezithile zokuvikelwa kolwazi. Lezi zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukugunyazwa: Ulwazi lungabelwana kuphela nabezindaba abanezimvume ezifanele. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangenayo imvume abakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi. 2. Ukunciphisa Ulwazi: I-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluqoqiwe luncane ngangokunokwenzeka. Lokhu kusiza ukuvimbela ukuvuza kolwazi okungafanele. 3. Ukuhlola Nokuhlola: I-GEMS ihlola njalo izinqubo zayo zokuvikela ulwazi ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izingozi nokubuyekeza izinqubo ukuze zihlale zisesikhathini. Izingozi Nezixazululo Noma izinyathelo ezithathwayo ziqinile, zikhona izingozi ezihambisana nokuvikelwa kolwazi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlaselwa kwe-cyber, lapho abahlaseli bezama ukufinyelela kulwazi olufihliwe. Ukuze kuvinjwe lezi zingozi, i-GEMS ibeka phambili izinhlelo eziqinile zokuphepha, kuhlanganiswe nezifundo zokuqwashisa abasebenzi mayelana nezingozi ezihambisana nokuvikelwa kolwazi. Umthelela Wokungahambisani Nezimiso Zokuvikelwa Kolwazi Uma i-GEMS ingahambisani nezimiso zokuvikelwa kolwazi, kungaholela emiphumeleni emibi. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuvuza kolwazi, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwethemba kwabantu, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Ukungahambisani nalezi zimiso kungaholela ekutheni i-GEMS ibhekane nezinyathelo zomthetho, okungase kube nemiphumela emibi emalini nasekutheni ibhizinisi layo. Ukubaluleka Kokuxhumana I-GEMS ibalulekile ekuxhumaneni nabantu ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi bazi kahle izinqubo zokuvikelwa kolwazi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuxhumana ngokuqondile nabantu mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha ulwazi lwabo, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela ulwazi lwabo. Ukuxhumana kahle kusiza ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu, kuqinisekisa ukuthi bazi ukuthi ulwazi lwabo luthathwa ngokungathí sina. Isiphetho Ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi lwe-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangathembela ezinsizakalweni zayo. Ngokusebenzisa izinyathelo eziqinile zokuvikela, i-GEMS iqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwemigomo, abantu, kanye nezinsizakalo luhlala lufihliwe. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuvikela ulwazi, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo zayo. Umsebenzi wokuqhubeka nokuhlola nokuvuselela izinqubo zokuvikela ulwazi uzosiza i-GEMS ukuba ibhekane nezinguquko ezizayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, iqhubeke nokuphatha ulwazi ngendlela efanele.
Imithetho ngeke isebenze kumakhono athile nakwabanye. Isahluko 1 - Ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi badinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Amakhono asebenza eNingizimu Afrika awavunyelwe ukuvimbela noma ukuhlinzeka ngokuphumelelayo kwezinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. UMsizi-Jikelele angayala ababambiqhaza ukuba baphinde bahlolisise izinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Ukususwa kwezinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle kuyadingeka. Abasebenzi bemikhumbi bangahlola izinhlelo zokuphepha zamakhono. IBhodi ingayala abasebenzi bemikhumbi ukuba bahlolisise izinhlelo zokuphepha zamakhono. Le mithetho izobizwa ngokuthi Imithetho Yezokuthutha Kwezokuthutha (Ukwelapha Kwezokuphepha Kwezokuthutha) ka-2004. Lezi yizinye zezimiso ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kwiGazethi Yombuso. Ukuze kufezwe le njongo, le mithetho isungula uhlaka oluhlose ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha zamakhono kanye nezinye izinyathelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Ukusetshenziswa kwalolu hlaka kuzovumela iRiphabhulikhi ukuba ihlangabezane nezibopho zayo ngaphansi kwesahluko IX - 2 seSivumelwano Sokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Olwandle kanye ne-ISPS Code. Umkhumbi wezimpahla ubhekisela kunoma iyiphi imikhumbi engesiyo imikhumbi yabagibeli, futhi ifaka... umqashi wezimpahla ubhekisela kumuntu osebenza nezimpahla ezisetshenziswa emkhumbini... I-ISSC esemthethweni uma ibhekisela kumakhono ngaleso sikhathi ibhekisela ku-ISSC yomkhumbi osebenza ngaleso sikhathi. Ngokwenzela le mithetho, umkhumbi uhlobo olubhekiswe ku-regulation-10 1 uthathwa njengokuthi usetshenziswe kwezokuthutha olwandle uma usetshenziswa njengomkhumbi waleso sikhathi. Iphothi elilawulwa ukuze kuphumelele ukuphepha, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi noma noma yisiphi isikhathi lapho le phothi, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi ilawulwa kuphela nguMnyango Wezokuphepha Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha komkhumbi osengozini ngokudlulisa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Iphothi iyindawo yamanzi, umhlaba namanzi (kuhlanganise nezakhiwo, imishini ehlobene futhi esebenzayo etholakala kulowo mhlaba noma emanzini) ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke noma ingxenye yayo ephathelene nokunyakaza, ukulayisha, ukuhlinzeka, ukugcinwa noma ukuhlinzekwa kwemikhumbi. Indawo yamanzi evulekile ehlelelwe ukuxhasa noma ukubamba imikhumbi ngaphambi kokuthi ingene endaweni yamanzi ebhekiswe esigabeni a; futhi c indawo yamanzi evulekile phakathi kwezindawo zamanzi ezichazwe ezigabeni a no-b. a ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke noma ingxenye yayo ephathelene nokunyakaza, ukulayisha noma ukuhlinzeka, ukulungisa noma ukuhlinzeka ngemikhumbi elawulwa ukuphepha; futhi b echazwe ngokuxhumana 1. UMsizi-Jikelele ngokuphuma kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yombuso, angakhetha umuntu ukuze asebenze ephothini elawulwa ukuphepha. c imibono yomuntu, abantu abathintekayo ekuphathweni kokusebenza kwephothi. b umkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe. c indawo yokuwela ehlala noma ekuthuthweni emanzini aseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kugwenywe ukudideka, indawo yokuwela ehlala ebhekiswe ku-regulation-1 c ithathwa njengomkhumbi ngenhloso yale mithetho. Umkhumbi ungumkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe uma lowo mkhumbi... omunye umkhumbi; noma v iphothi, esetshenziswa ephothini noma ngenye indlela ixhumene nephothi; futhi d isenzo sibalulekile kulolu simo. a umuntu udinga ukuhambisana nemiyalo yokuphepha; futhi b ukuhambisana nemiyalo kusho ukuthi lowo muntu uphule umthetho ngokwephula leyo mfuneko noma ukuphula umthetho noma le mithetho, lowo muntu, uma ehambisana nemiyalo yokuphepha, uthathwa njengokungakwenzi icala noma ukuphula okudingekayo. Umuntu, uma ehambisana nemiyalo yokulawula, uthathwa njengokungakwenzi icala noma ukuphula okudingekayo. Ngokwenzela le mithetho, umuntu anganikeza isaziso noma imiyalo noma axhumane nokusebenza komkhumbi ngokunikeza lowo muntu isaziso noma imiyalo noma axoxe nommeleli walowo mkhumbi. c iphothi elawulwa ukuphepha; futhi d ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi. e Imisebenzi eyenziwa yilabo ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi ephathelene noma ngokuhambisana nezindawo ezilawulwa ukuphepha. UMsizi-Jikelele ngokubhala angakhipha umthetho futhi izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle-2 noma izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle-3 elisebenza kumakhono asebenza kwezinye izizwe. a ngemuva kokubonisana ne-NICOC; futhi b kuqinisekiswa ukuthi ilungile ukuze kwakhiwe ukuphepha okuphezulu kule phothi, umkhumbi, indawo noma ababambiqhaza ngenxa yokuphazamiseka okuphezulu kokuthutha olwandle okungavunyelwe okungase kubonakale. b uma isikhumbuzo sikhanseliwe ngokubhala nguMsizi-Jikelele. b noma yisiphi isenzo esithathwe ngumuntu ophakathi embonini yezeMkhumbi. Uhlelo lokuphepha lwalesi sikhumbuzo lungalandelwa uma kuphela izinyathelo ezibhekiswe kulolo hlelo lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle zisetshenziswa. Imiyalo yokuphepha inikezwa mayelana nephothi, umkhumbi, indawo, ababambiqhaza noma ukusebenza, amazinga okuphepha akhona aqhubeka nokusebenza. Uma uMsizi-Jikelele ekhuluma ukuthi izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle elisebenzayo ephothini ethile, uMsizi-Jikelele angazisa ngokushesha... i ukulawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle ii ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. i ukulawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle; noma ii ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi elawulwa ukuphepha; futhi b umphathi womkhumbi olawulwa ukuphepha kule phothi noma mayelana nokungena kule phothi. Uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kwehluleka ukuhambisana ne-regulation-3, kuzoba icala elizokwenziwa uma kutholakala icala, kuzofanele kube necebo noma baphathwe isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili. I-regulation 3 ayisebenzi uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kunesizathu esifanele. a ukusebenza kwalowo mkhumbi; noma b umphathi womkhumbi. Uma uMsizi-Jikelele ezisa ukusebenza komkhumbi njengoba kuchaziwe ku-regulation 1 ngenhla, ukusebenza komkhumbi kumele ngokushesha kudlulise leso saziso kumphathi ofanele womkhumbi. Uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kwehluleka ukuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ku-regulation 2 ngenhla, kuzoba icala, uma kutholakala icala, kuzofanele kube necebo noma baphathwe isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili. I-regulation 3 ayisebenzi uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kunesizathu esifanele. a ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi abaphethe le ndawo; futhi b Uma ababambiqhaza engesiyo ukusebenza komkhumbi, azise ukusebenza komkhumbi. a ababambiqhaza; futhi b uma ababambiqhaza benza isenzo esikhulunywe esikhaleni ngaphakathi kwephothi elawulwa ukuphepha futhi engesiyo ukusebenza komkhumbi,
Ukuthola isisho: Uma ungalinganisi zonke izinto, ngeke ukwazi ukuphatha (ukusebenza) ibhizinisi lakho. Sonke siyazi ukuthi ukuhweba kwezolimo kuyibhizinisi. Uma ufuna ukuba umphakathi wezolimo, kunezinto eziningi okufanele uqaphele uma ufuna ibhizinisi lakho likunikeze inzuzo. Inhloso eyinhloko iwukwenza inzuzo futhi uqhubeke uyithola esikhathini esizayo. Konke okwenziwayo epulazini kunomthelela ezinzuzweni ozitholayo. Inzuzo - Izindleko = Inzuzo noma Ukulahleka. Kukho umlayezo okhombisa ukuthi yini engaba khona futhi/noma ukuthi yini okufanele kwenzeke futhi/noma ukuthi yini edingekayo mayelana nezici zomthetho ezihlobene nokuphatha izinto ezihlukene ezihambisana nokusebenza kwebhizinisi lepulazi. Nokho, lo mlayezo ulandelwa umphathi wepulazi noma cha, usenkathini yephathi/umkhiqizi. Ulwazi - kokubili ngaphandle nangaphakathi (amarekhodi) kubalulekile kakhulu. Ibhizinisi lepulazi eNingizimu Afrika ingxenye yamabhizinisi omhlaba avulekile manje (idolobha lomhlaba), ngakho-ke kuzothinteka yilokho okwenzeka emhlabeni. Iphulazi lingabhekwa njengohlelo olungcwele oluthinta zonke ezinye izinhlelo zokulima - luhlobene nazo zonke izinto emhlabeni. Ngokuvamile sizwa okulandelayo: "Kungani abanye abalimi endaweni ethile bephumelela kanti abanye abalimayo endaweni efanayo ngezimo ezifanayo behluleka, noma kungani abanye abalimi bephumelela ezikhathini ezinzima kanti abanye ozakwabo behluleka?" Impendulo ithi: abanye abakhiqizi baphatha ibhizinisi labo lezolimo ngendlela efanele. Kodwa yini ukuphatha (ukusebenza), njengoba lapha, ukuphatha ipulazi? Ukuphatha ipulazi kungachazwa njengokwenza izinqumo ezifanele mayelana nezinsiza zabantu nezinsiza zezinto umlimi asebenza nazo ukuze afeze ngempumelelo izinhloso zaleso bhizinisi. Ukuze umkhiqizi aphumelele mayelana nalokho okukhulunywe ngenhla, kufanele asebenzise amasu amane okuphatha: amasu okuhlela kusenesikhathi, ukuhlanganisa lawo masu, ukuwasebenzisa, nokubheka lelo work ngendlela efanele. Singahlukanisa lezo zinhloso, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umsebenzi wokuphatha ibhizinisi ungumsebenzi oqhubekayo, umsebenzi awupheli. Inqubo yokuphatha, umkhiqizi kufanele ahlaziye izici ezihlobene nokuphatha ibhizinisi: ukwenza izinqumo, ukuhweba, ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenze ngenhloso, ukukala zonke izenzo, ukuphatha abantu ngokuqinile, ukudlulisa eminye imisebenzi kubantu abanamakhono, nokuhamba phambili. Ukuphatha ipulazi kungachazwa njengokwenza izinqumo ezihlosiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekwe ekuqaleni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nepulazi yilokho abaphatha. Ukuphathwa okujwayelekile - umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuphepha, ukuphatha ingozi yomlilo, ubugebengu, nokuphepha okuphelele kwepulazi. Ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yokuphatha lezo zinto ezishiwo ngenhla nokwandisa inzuzo esikhathini esizayo kuzoxoxwa kulolu shwankathelo (Pula/Imvula) ezinyangeni ezizayo. Imiyalezo engakusiza ukwandisa inzuzo esikhathini esizayo mayelana nohlelo lokuphatha izophakanyiswa. Izidingo zokuhambisana nomthetho nazo zizobekwa phansi. Kodwa kusezandleni zomlimi ngamunye ukusebenzisa lezo zindlela. Asikwazi ukuphonsa umphakathi ukwenza konke. Mayelana nezimo zomthetho, kusezandleni zomlimi, futhi uma bengahambisani nalezo zimo, icala lizobekwa kubo, futhi asizokwazi ukubasiza.
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuguqulwa kwemiphakathi engakhethi, oluhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, luhamba phambili ekusizeni uhulumeni bendawo ukuba banikele ngempumelelo ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lokuphakela umthetho ngokusebenzisa iMthethosisekelo Wabaholi Bendawo kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kwehlaka elisha lezomthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomkhandlu kubalulekile. Ngemva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngoDisemba 5, 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zikamasipala zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela okwakukhona, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphatha umkhandlu futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukufinyelela ezinqumweni ezimayelana nezabelo zebhajethi yomkhandlu, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, kanye nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxoxisana, ehlelekile, futhi eqondile. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza kuphela ukuphathwa komkhandlu kodwa kufanele futhi ziqhube ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze kukahulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomkhandlu. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi ivame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu ngenqubo yokuhlela i-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho hlelo lwezomthetho. Imiphakathi eminingi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okudlula) yayingenazo izinsiza kanye namakhono okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezivivinyiwe kulolu suku, noma izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kulolu hlelo bathole inzuzo enkulu kulwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona imiphakathi embalwa ethole intuthuko enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Izincwadi zokuhola ze-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elinobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene oluvela kwi-DPLG olusekelwe yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula. Kukhona uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwesizwe lwabaphathi bomkhandlu, abasebenzi abachwepheshile, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kufaka bonke ababambiqhaza abavela kumasipala. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zikamasipala (PIMSS) luyakhiwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Inani elikhulu lemiphakathi, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda kahulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi yezezimboni zikahulumeni ezweni lethu ingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kuleli qoqo elisha lezincwadi ze-IDP. Nginehope enkulu yokuthi leli qoqo lezincwadi ezishicilelwe lizoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enhlanganweni ye-IDP nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela eyakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umhlahlandlela VI: Ukuphatha umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokukhuthaza izidingo ezithile kulolu suku lwecebo lokusebenza, ngaleyo ndlela kucacisa phakathi kokuthi yini okufanele kwenzeke njengoba kudingeka umthetho kanye nenqubomgomo neziphakamiso ezingadingeki kulabo abafuna izeluleko ezithile emisebenzini yokuhlela. a. Kungani kwenziwa? b. Yini elindelekile emiphumeleni yokuhlela? c. Yini okufanele inqubo noma uhlelo lubukeke ukuze kufezwe umphumela ofunwayo? e. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani? Incazelo ejwayelekile ye-IDP guideline booklet collection. Ukubika amaqembu abamba iqhaza ngemicimbi elindelekile kanye nezibopho ezidingekayo kule nqubo. Lokhu kufaka iminyango yesifunda kanye nesizwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ejwayelekile kanye nokubuka okusheshayo kwe-IDP ukuze kulabo abaphethe ukuphatha inqubo. Indaba efingqiwe ihlelwe ukusiza abantu baqonde imvelaphi nenqubo ye-Integrated Development Plan ngaphandle kokugxila kakhulu encwadini. Uma ababambiqhaza befuna ulwazi olunembile, kufanele babheke ezikhombisweni abazithakaselayo. I-Integrated Development Plan inqubo lapho imiphakathi ilungiselela isu lokuthuthukiswa leminyaka emihlanu. I-IDP iyithuluzi eliyinhloko lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa. I-IDP iyindawo yokuqala yokuhlela umthetho futhi ibonisa indlela phambili futhi ihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokuhlela, ukusabalalisa ibhajethi, ukuphathwa, kanye nokwenza izinqumo kumaKhansela noma kumasipala. Yini isimo somthetho se-IDPs? Ngokusho kweMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomkhandlu ka-2000, zonke izindawo (lezo zamadolobha amakhulu, izindawo zomphakathi, kanye nezifunda) kumele zilandele inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ukuze zikhulise i-IDPs. Njengoba i-IDP iyimfuneko yomthetho, inegunya lomthetho futhi idlula ezinye izindlela ezihola ukuthuthukiswa ezingeni likamasipala. Ngokusho kweMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomkhandlu, wonke umkhandlu omusha kanye nalabo abavula amahhovisi ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala kumele balungiselele i-IDP ezothatha iminyaka emihlanu. Ngakho-ke, i-IDP ixhunyaniswe nesikhathi sokusebenza kwamaKhansela. Umkhandlu omusha ungakhetha ukuthatha i-IDP eyasungulwa yilabo abahamba ezikhundleni uma ubona kufanelekile noma ungase ube ne-IDP entsha kodwa kufanele ucabangele imibhalo yezinhlelo ezikhona. iv. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda inqubo? Inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ifaka ukubambisana nokuxhumana futhi ibandakanya izakhiwo eziningi ezibamba iqhaza. Ngenxa yesidingo sokubambisana, kuthatha cishe izinyanga eziyisithupha kuya kweziyisishiyagalombili ukuqeda i-IDP, futhi lesi sikhathi sihambisana kakhulu nesikhathi sebhajethi yomkhandlu. Kubalulekile, ngesikhathi lesi, ukwethulwa kwemisebenzi yomphakathi nokuthuthukiswa akusimeme kodwa kuqhubeka. I-IDP ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke, kuholela ezinguqukweni zamasu uma kudingeka. v. Yiziphi izingxenye ezisemqoka noma izimo ze-IDPs? Ukuhlola isimo samanje sokuthuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa nokugqamisa imiphakathi engenazo izinsiza ezibalulekile zezempilo. Ngamafuphi, i-Integrated Development Plan ibhekana nemiphakathi lapho ihlaziya izidingo eziphuthumayo/izinkinga, izinhloso, nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kubhekwe lezi zinkinga. Isigaba esibaluleke kakhulu se-IDPs ukuhlanganisa uhlelo nebhajethi yomkhandlu (ukuhlukanisa izimali ezitholwe ngaphakathi nezitholwe ngaphandle kwezinto ezivumelwene ngazo) ngoba impumelelo yezinhlelo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kuxhunywe ku-IDP. vi. Ubani ophatha inqubo? I-Integrated Development Plan

Lezi zindlu zezinhlanzi zisebenza njalo
Ithenda yokucubungula inhlanzi ingaba yimoto, umkhumbi, isakhiwo, noma indawo lapho kukhiqizwa khona isithako noma into yehlanzi. Isithako singakhiqizwa nganoma iyiphi indlela efana nokusika, ukufilitha, ukuhlukanisa izingxenye, ukuhlanza, ukuqoqa nokuhlela ukusika, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokuvimbela ukuwohloka kwezinhlanzi. Ukwenza lo msebenzi kungase kubandakanye indawo lapho izinhluzi zibekwe ezitsheni, ziphakanyiswa, zomele, zikhishwe izinsipho nezinsalela, zifakwe usawoti, zifakwe iqhwa, zifakwe emathinini, zomele ngokubanda, noma zicubungulwa ukuze zithengiswe eNingizimu Afrika noma phesheya. Ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wokucubungula inhlanzi, umuntu kumele aqale afake isicelo sokuba ne-FPE/ilungelo lokubhaliswa bese kuthi kulandelwe ukuvunywa. Ukuze usebenzise ilungelo lokubhaliswa noma ilungelo lokwenza umsebenzi we-FPE, kufanele kufakwe isicelo sokuvuselela nsuku zonke, esikhishwe yiMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha. Labo abavunyelwe kufanele balandele imigomo nemibandela echazwe ku-permit. Ukwehluleka ukwenza kanjalo kungaholela ekulibazisweni noma ekukhanselweni kwe-permit noma ekukhanselweni kwelungelo. Faka isicelo selungelo lokubhaliswa kuphela uma kukhona isimemo somphakathi esishicilelwe kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Ukuze ufake isicelo, thola ifomu kwiMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha noma ezindaweni lapho amafomu atholakala khona noma anikezwa khona, okuyindawo ezokwenziwa yizinsiza ze-DEA&T. Funda ngokucophelela, uqonde, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uhambisana nezidingo nemibandela yesicelo. Qedela, signing, futhi uthumele ifomu lesicelo kanye nemibhalo esekelayo eqinisekisiwe kanye nezindleko zesicelo ezingabuyiswanga. Inqubo yokubuyekeza izoqala ngemuva kosuku lokuvala kwezicelo, futhi imiphumela izokhulumelwa ngokubhala yi-DEA&T. Uma ilungelo le-FPE livunywa, kufanele ufake isicelo sokwakhiwa kwe-FPE futhi uhambisane nezidingo zayo ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Isicelo selungelo le-FPE singathatha inyanga eyodwa kuya kwezintathu noma ngaphezulu ngenxa yenani lezicelo. Isicelo se-FPE permit singathatha usuku noma ngaphezulu, kuye ngokuthi isicelo silandela inqubo efanele. Imali ekhokhwayo ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke/ibekwe minyaka yonke nguNgqongqoshe noma umthunywa wokugunyazwa, ohlanganyela noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. R1,330 kanye nezindleko zesicelo ezingu-R125 - Isicelo sokubhaliswa: ukwenza umsebenzi wokucubungula inhlanzi.
Amanani Okudla (Food Prices) Umbuzo 1: Amanani okudla ayini manje? Ngokwezinhlolovo zamuva, amanani okudla eNingizimu Afrika abheke phezulu, ikakhulukazi emaphandleni nasezindaweni ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abaningi, njengoba ukunyuka kwamanani kudinga ukuthi abantu bahlunge izindleko zabo ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezidingo zabo zansuku zonke. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izizathu ezibangela lezi zinguquko? Izizathu ezahlukahlukene zikhona. Okokuqala, ukwanda kukaloliwe kanye nezindleko zokuhamba zikhuphukile, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukudla ngamanani aphansi. Okwesibili, izimo zezulu, njengokukhukhuleka noma umswakama, zithinta ukukhiqizwa kokudla, okukhulisa izinkinga zokukhiqiza. Lokhu kuholela ekushodweni kwemikhiqizo ethile, okukhuphula amanani. Umbuzo 3: Iziphi izitolo ezithengisa ukudla ngamanani aphansi? Izitolo ezinkulu zihlala zikhangisa amanani aphansi, kodwa abantu abaningi bangase bangatholi izinzuzo ezivela kuzona. Kuhle ukuba baqaphele izindawo ezithengisa imikhiqizo yasendaweni, njengoba lezi zindawo zivame ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo enempilo ngamanani aphansi, ngokuhlanganisa nezimakethe zokudla ezisemaphandleni. Umbuzo 4: Yini abantu abangayenza ukuze banelise izindleko? Abantu bangasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukuze bahlale bephila kahle ngaphandle kokuchitha imali eningi. Okokuqala, bangathenga imikhiqizo yesizini, njengoba lokhu kuvame ukuba manzi kakhudlwana. Kwesibili, ukwakha uhla lokudla okuhle kusiza ukugwema ukuchitha imali engekho emthethweni. Okokugcina, ukuhlela izigcawu zokudla lapho umndeni ubuthana khona ukuze ufinyeleleke ezindlekweni. Umbuzo 5: Ukwenza kanjani ukuhamba ngebhajethi? Ukuze uhambisane nebajethi, kubalulekile ukuba noukandunana ngayo. Thola izimbalelwano okufanele uzithenge bese uhlela ukudla kwesonto. Futhi, zama ukuhamba nemali ethile ngempela ukuze ungachithi okwengeziwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela kahle izindleko zakho. Umbuzo 6: Iziphi izindlela zokuvikela ukuphepha kokudla? Ukwavikela ukuphepha kokudla kubalulekile emndenini. Qiniseka ukuthi ungakhetha imikhiqizo ehlanganisiwe, ubulale izilokotho noma izichitho ezithintekile. Phakathi nokupheka, qiniseka ukuthi ushisa ukudla ngokwanele ukuze ubhubhise amabhaktheriya athile. Ukugcina ukudla endaweni ehlanzekile nasemazingeni afanele kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kokudla. Umbuzo 7: Ingabe zikhona izinhlelo zomphakathi ezisiza abantu ngalezi zimo? Yebo, kuneminyango kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezihlinzeka ngempumelelo yokudla ukuze zisize abaningi. Ezinye iziFundiso zikhuthaza ukuthenga okuhle, ukufunda ngezindlela zokulima, nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kumakhono okufanele. Lokhu kungenza abantu bakwazi ukuphila kahle futhi baphumelele ezindlekweni zabo. Umbuzo 8: Ubulungiswa bokudla bunjani? Ubulungiswa bokudla buhlale buhlala busembhizeni. Izinkinga ezifana nokungabi nalokho abantu abakudinga, njengokudla kwemvelo nangolimi olufanele, zihlala zikhona. Kubalulekile ukuthi amabhizinisi akhulume ngalokhu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bonke bayathola ukudla okuphila kahle. Umbuzo 9: Zingaki izimboni ezihlinzeka ngana izimbuzi ezithengekayo? Izimboni ezahlukene zikhona ezithengisa ukudla, kusuka ezitolo ezinkulu kuya ezindaweni zokuhweba ezincane. Phakathi kokuthengwa, abathengi banikeza indawo ezithengwa ezilungile, ezithuthukile ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhala, Nakanjani, izindawo ezizimele zidinga ulwazi olukhuluma kakhulu ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela efanele. Umbuzo 10: Ubani ongathinta kulezi zindaba? Wonke umuntu ungaba nesandla ekuthatheni izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa isimo sokudla. Lokhu kudinga ukuvuma izindleko zabo, ukusebenzisana nomphakathi, nokuhlinzeka ngezimpendulo ezisebenzayo. Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi sithola isixazululo esihle sokudla. Umphumela: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwazulu kuzodingeka ukuthi siqaphele amanani okudla futhi sithathe izinyathelo eziphumelelayo ukuze silwisane nezinselelo ezikhona. Imikhankaso yokudayisa, ukuhweba, nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane efanelekile ingaholela ekuvulekeni kwemizamo yokuhlala sithola izinga eliphezulu lokuphila. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi kube khona okuthile esikufisayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu ukuthola ukudla okwanelisayo.
Siphinde sisondele ekupheleni konyaka ophumelelayo kuhlelo lweGrain SA Farmer Development Programme. Yonke imisebenzi esiyenzile ngalesi sikhathi kuleli hlelo ibingavela kuphela ngosizo olukhulu oluvela kuMaize Trust. UJane McPherson noWillie Kotzé, bobabili lapha ehhovisi elikhulu leGrain SA eBothaville, baphatha uhlelo lweFarmer Development Programme. Isikhundla esisha esibizwa ngokuthi "Specialist: Field Services" sidalwe, futhi uDanie van den Berg uthathe le ndima. U-Danie uyazi kahle leli hlelo futhi uqeqeshe abaningi ngendlela ephezulu eminyakeni emithathu edlule. U-Danie ubheka labo basebenzi emasimini - abakhiqizi bezifunda abasebenza ekuthuthukiseni abalimi. E-Table 1, kukhona amagama abo bonke abasebenza kulolu hlelo. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona abalimi abaninzi bezomnotho, sigxila kakhulu kulabo abakhiqizi abathuthuke, ngoba Sikholelwa ukuthi ukuze sifinyelele inhloso yethu yokuthi "Sithuthukise abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono ukuba babe abakhiqizi bezomnotho," kumele sixhase umkhiqizi ngamunye njengoba eqhubeka nalesi sikhumbuzo sokuba nomnotho. Ezindaweni ezineziqhamo ezikhulayo, sisengxenyeni enkulu nezifundo ngoba kuyindlela engcono yokuxhumana nabakhiqizi abaningi. Uhlelo lokuqeqesha luqhubeka nokukhula - kunezifundo eziningi ezitholakalayo futhi inani labalimi abafuna ukuya kulezi zifundo liqhubeka likhula. Siphinda sikhumbuze ukubonga kwethu ngosizo oluvela kuMaize Trust, oluqhubeka nokusekela leli hlelo - sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuphatha leli hlelo ngendlela efanele futhi sixhase abalimi ngendlela efanele. Thina, ithimba lokuthuthukisa, siyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokusebenza nabalimi abasha.
Umculo we-Hip Hop: Ukuphikisana Ngezimpande Nezimpumelelo Umculo we-hip hop, okwaziwa kabanzi emhlabeni, ungomunye wemikhakha ethokozisayo futhi edumile. Waqala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni eMelika, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwemiphakathi yabamnyama, futhi usuphenduke isiko elikhulu elihlanganisa umculo, ubuciko, nezinkulumo. Nokho, uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo ye-hip hop, kufanele sithathele phezulu nezinkinga ezihambisana nayo, okuhlanganisa izinkolelo eziphikisanayo mayelana nemiphumela yayo emphakathini. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngempumelelo ye-hip hop. Lo mculo ube nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni izwi labantu abavela ezindaweni ezihluphekayo. Abaculi abanjengo-Tupac Shakur no-The Notorious B.I.G. baveze izinselelo ezihambisana nabantu abamnyama, njengobandlululo, ubuphofu, nokungabi nandlela. Lokhu kwenze umculo we-hip hop ube yindlela yokukhuluma, ukuchaza, nokuphikisa. Ngakho-ke, umculo we-hip hop ungumthombo wokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphakamise izwi labo, baphikise izinhlelo ezimbi, futhi baphokophele impilo engcono. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona abaphikisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop uveza izithombe ezingezinhle. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi izinkanyezi ze-hip hop zikhuthaza izenzo ezimbi, ezifana nokubhema, udlame, nokuhlukunyezwa. Lokhu kubonakala ezinkondlweni eziningi, lapho abaculi bechaza izimo ezinzima, kodwa futhi behlaba umxhwele ngezinto ezimbi. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuthi umculo we-hip hop ungase ube nomthelela omubi empilweni yabantu, ikakhulukazi ezinsaneni. Abanye baphakamisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop kufanele ube nomthwalo wokwakha izithombe ezinhle, hhayi ezimbi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umculo we-hip hop ungumkhakha obonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini. Njengoba umculo uthuthuka, ubona izinguquko ezinkulu ezimbonini zomculo, ezokuxhumana, nezokuthengisa. Abaculi be-hip hop baye baba neqhaza elikhulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, bephendula izinkinga zomphakathi, futhi bephakamisa izindaba ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop ungaphezu kokuba umculo; ungumsebenzi wobuciko obonisa izinguquko zomphakathi. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umculo we-hip hop awuhambisani nezimiso ezithile. Abaculi bahlala bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene zokubona izinto, futhi lokhu kudala izinkulumo ezinzima. Abanye bacula ngezinto ezithile, kanti abanye baphikisa ukuthi umculo we-hip hop kufanele ube nezinjongo ezithile, njengokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kudala ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwabaculi, abalandeli, kanye nababukeli. Ekugcineni, umculo we-hip hop ungumkhakha obalulekile emhlabeni wezobuciko, kodwa futhi uveza izinkinga ezinzima ezibhekene nomphakathi. Ukuze umculo we-hip hop uqhubeke nokukhula, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umculo ungaphezu kokuba umculo; ungumsebenzi wobuciko obonisa izinguquko zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaculi bahlale bephikisana, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi bahlale bephokophela impilo engcono. Umculo we-hip hop ungumthombo wokukhuthaza, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umculo ungase ube nomthelela omubi uma ungasebenzisi kahle. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umculo we-hip hop onobuhle, ohloniphekile, futhi onomthelela omuhle empilweni yabantu.
Imvume noma ilayisense ayinakudluliselwa futhi kumele ikhishwe uma iceliwe ngumsebenzi wezihlahla, isiphathimandla esihloniphekile, uphiko lwezepolitiki, noma umsebenzi ogunyaziwe. Imisebenzi ephathelene nokuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukufezekisa izinhloso zokomoya ingaqhutshelwa ezindaweni ezibekelwe (emamephini, ezindaweni ezichaziwe, ezindleleni ezibhalwe lapho ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe, nezinye izimpawu). Ukungena ezihlahleni zikamasipala kungavinjwa ngaphandle kokuchaza isizathu, futhi izicelo zokubhukha zingakhanselwa noma ziqedwe yiMnyango. Ukuqoqwa kokhuni akuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwezindawo ezibekelwe. Akekho onelungelo lokuphazamisa imisebenzi yabaphathi bezihlahla noma ezindaweni zikamasipala. Noma yimuphi umonakalo owenzeka emithonjeni yezihlahla noma kunoma iyiphi impahla kahulumeni ngenxa zenzo zomnikazi welayisense uzokhokhelwa yilo mnikazi welayisense. UKWENZA OKUNGEZELELWE, IMAMEPHU, NOMA IZIMBANGELA, UCELWA UKUXHUMANA NOMSEBENZI OBEKWE - isibonelo, uMphathi Wezihlahla, Ikheli, Ucingo, Ifeksi, ikheli le-imeyili. Bheka uhlu lwezenzakalo kuMthetho Wokulungisa A. Ngokusho kweSigaba 19 noma 20 seMthetho Wamazwe Ngaphandle Kwezimali we-1998 (Mthetho Wamazwe Ngaphandle Kwezimali, 1998 - Umthetho 84 we-1998), ilungelo lokungena ezihlahleni zikamasipala limi ezindaweni ezikhonjiswe emamephini anexhunywe (noma lezo ezichaziwe) futhi kumele kulandelwe imithetho esunguliwe. Qaphela ukuthi imithetho eyengeziwe evimbela ukufinyelela kwezinye izihlahla njengoba kuchaziwe ezimpawu, emamephini, emabhukwini, nangokunye ibhekwa njengokuhlonishwa. Le ndlela yelayisense isebenza kulolu hlobo lokufinyelela oluchazwe ngumfaki-sicelo, bese kuthi emva kwalokho kuncike ezinsukwini ezithile nakumaphrojekthi atholakalayo noma ohlwini lwezenzakalo ezivunyelwe.
Izinselelo ze-acid mine drainage eGauteng Umbuzo 1: Yini i-acid mine drainage (AMD)? Impendulo: I-acid mine drainage (AMD) iyinhlangano yamanzi aphumayo ahlanzekile futhi anama-asidi, atholakala lapho umhlaba ophukile uhlangana ne-oxygen ne-hydrogen sulfide. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhekeni kwe-asidi, okwenza amanzi abe ne-pH ephansi. I-Acid mine drainage ivame ukwenzeka ezindaweni ezinomsebenzi wezokumbiwa phansi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinezimayini zamalahle, i-gold, noma amaminerali. Umbuzo 2: Yini edala i-acid mine drainage eGauteng? Impendulo: E-Gauteng, i-acid mine drainage ikhiqizwa ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokumba ezintanjeni zezimayini ze-gold, okuyinto eyenzeka eminyakeni edlule. Lapho lezi zimayini ziqukethwe, ama-minerals agqokile, afana ne-pyrite, ahlangana nomoya, okuholela ekwakhiweni kwe-asidi kanye nezinhlayiya ezimbi ezilandelayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izingozi ze-acid mine drainage? Impendulo: I-acid mine drainage ingaba nemiphumela emibi emithonjeni yemvelo, okufaka phakathi: 1. Ukuncipha kwezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane nezitshalo: I-asidi ingalimaza izitshalo kunye nezilwane eziphilayo emanzini, kubangela ukuncipha kwezinhlobo eziningi. 2. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi: AMD ithinta amanzi angaphansi komhlaba, ikhulisa amazinga e-heavy metals afana ne-arsenic, lead, ne-cadmium, okuthinta impilo yabantu nezilwane. 3. Ukuphazamiseka kwezinsiza: Izinsiza ezifana namanzi nemifula zingase zibe yingozi kumphakathi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abaphila ezindaweni eziseduze nezimayini. Umbuzo 4: Uhlangabezana kanjani nezinselelo ze-acid mine drainage? Impendulo: Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezinselelo ze-acid mine drainage, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene, ezifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuphuculwa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha: Ukubeka imithetho eqinile yokuphatha amanzi emisebenzini yokumbiwa phansi. 2. Ukuphinda usebenzise indawo: Ukubuyisela izindawo ezithintekile, ukwakha imithombo emisha yamanzi ahlanzekile, nokuthuthukisa isimo sezimo eziphilayo. 3. Ukubambisana nezakhamuzi: Ukuqwashisa izakhamuzi ngalesi sifo nokubandakanya umphakathi ekuphathweni kwemithombo yemvelo. Umbuzo 5: Imaphi amaphuzu okusebenza angathuthukisa isimo se-acid mine drainage? Impendulo: Amaphuzu okusebenza angathuthukisa isimo se-acid mine drainage afaka: 1. Ucwaningo olunzulu: Ucwaningo lwemvelo oluqinile ukuze kuqondwe kangcono imiphumela ye-AMD. 2. Izinhlelo zokuhlola: Ukubeka izinhlelo zokuhlola ezilungile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho yokuphatha amanzi iyagcinwa. 3. Izinhlelo zokukhuthaza: Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlangano ezizimele ezibambisene nezinhlaka zomphakathi ukuze zisebenze ndawonye ekuphathweni kwe-AMD. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinhlelo zokulawula ezikhona eGauteng? Impendulo: E-Gauteng, kunezinhlangano eziningi ezisebenza ukulawula i-acid mine drainage. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi: Imithetho ethile yokuphatha amanzi edingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile. 2. Uhlelo lwezokuhlola: Ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kokungcoliswa kwamanzi nemiphumela yokusebenza kwezimayini. 3. Ukwanda kwesayensi: Ukuxhumana nezikhungo zocwaningo ukuze kuqondwe imiphumela emisha ye-AMD. Umbuzo 7: Uwusizo lwemiphakathi emhlabeni jikelele? Impendulo: Imiphakathi emhlabeni jikelele ingafunda kulesi simo eGauteng. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Ukwakha ubudlelwano: Ukuxhumana nabanye ukuze kwabelwane ngolwazi nezindlela eziphumelela. 2. Izinqubomgomo ezihlala zisebenza: Ukubeka izinqubomgomo ezicacile zokuphatha imithombo yemvelo. 3. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana: Ukuqhuba izinhlelo zokuxhumana nokuqwashisa umphakathi ngezingozi ze-AMD. Umbuzo 8: Yini okudingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo se-acid mine drainage eGauteng? Impendulo: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo se-acid mine drainage eGauteng, kudingeka: 1. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana: Ukuze izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nomphakathi basebenze ndawonye. 2. Ukwandisa imfundo: Ukuqwashisa abantu ngale nkinga ukuze bazibandakanye. 3. Izibopho ezinhle: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abezindaba bavuma ukubheka izinqubo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zixazululo, eGauteng ingathuthukisa isimo se-acid mine drainage, ivikele imithombo yayo, futhi iqinise impilo yomphakathi.
Ithimba ligxile ekuxazululeni izidingo zabantu ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphakathi komphakathi ophuhlayo mayelana nezincwadi ezikhombisa izindawo ezifana nokuphatha, imfundo, kanye nomnotho, phakathi kokunye, ngenkathi kudlula ekwehlukaniseni nasegcineni intuthuko ye-Afrika emkhakheni wezincwadi nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Ithimba lihlose ukusungula uhlelo oluzodlala indima ebalulekile ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezinkulu ezweni lonke futhi luzokwenza imicimbi ehlose ukukhuthaza lezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Imfundo nabathintekayo baphumelelisile ucwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kokufinyeleleka nokusebenza kwabantu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezilimi. Ithimba libona ukuthuthukiswa komkhakha we-HLT eNingizimu Afrika okufana nalokho eYurophu ngezilimi ezihlukene, kodwa kulungiswe ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zendawo. Ithimba lizokwenza isethulo ngo-2002. Ithimba lihlangana kaningi futhi lizobamba iqhaza nabathintekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Noma ubani onentshisekelo uyamenywa ukuba axhumane nomqondisi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ukuze athole olunye ulwazi. Ukusekelwa kwalesi sikhungo kuyamukelwa kungakhathalekile ukuthi kuvela kuphi.
Umphakathi uhlinzekwe ukuze ubeke izitshalo nezithako emhlabathini ngendlela eqondile ukuze izitshalo zikwazi ukuvuthwa kahle futhi zingabi seduze kakhulu ngesikhathi zithola izithako ezifanele. Ububanzi phakathi kwemigqa. Ububanzi phakathi kwezithako emgqeni. Ukujula, inani, nendawo lapho izithako zibekwe khona. Ukujula nendawo lapho izitshalo zibekwe khona. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezithako nomhlabathi onomswakama.
