Umphakathi uphonsa emhlabathini, uvule umhlabathi, ubeka isitshalo kulowo mhlaba ovuliwe, uvalele isitshalo ngomhlabathi, futhi ucindezela kancane umhlabathi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwesitshalo nomhlabathi onomswakama. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zomphakathi, kodwa ekugcineni zenzelwe ukwenza umsebenzi ofanayo - kukhona ingxenye evula umhlabathi, indlela yokubeka izithako, nendlela yokuthatha izitshalo nokuzibeka emhlabathini ngendlela efanele nangenani elifanele. Ngokuvamile, izithako zibekwe emhlabathini ngaphambi kwezithako - lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo nezithako azithintani ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi izitshalo zingavuthi kahle. Ngakho-ke, izithako zibekwe phansi kwezithako. Ingxenye yokuvula umhlabathi lapho izithako zibekwe khona ibanzi futhi igoba kakhulu. Ingxenye ebeka izitshalo ifushane futhi ibekwe ngasohlangothini, futhi isitshalo sibekwe kancane ngaphezu komhlabathi. Ingxenye yomhlabathi ingawa phezu kwesitshalo ngemuva kokutshala, kodwa kungase kube nezikhala phakathi kwezithako nezicucu zomhlabathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitshalo nomhlabathi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle (okubalulekile ngoba izitshalo zidinga ukufaka umswakama ukuze ziqale ukuvuthwa), kuzodingeka ucindezele umhlabathi kancane. Lokhu kucindezelwa kwenziwa ngalezi zinqola ezibizwa ngokuthi izinqola zokucindezela.
Ukugunyazwa Kodokotela Nokuxhumana: Umqondo Wokubaluleka KweGEMS Ezinsukwini zanamuhla, ukuxhumana phakathi kodokotela nabaguli kubaluleke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngamasistimu afana neGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukugunyazwa kodokotela akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezokwelapha nabaguli. Uma sicabanga ngempilo yethu, sithola ukuthi ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kudinga imizamo emikhulu. Odokotela badinga ukuqonda kahle izidingo zabaguli babo, kanti abaguli nabo badinga ukuba nokuqonda okuhle ngezinsiza ezitholakala kubo. Ngokuqondile, lokhu kudinga ukugunyazwa kodokotela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza ezidingekayo zikhona. Uma kukhulunywa ngamaGEMS, kubalulekile ukuthi odokotela baqonde izinqubo ezithile ezihambisana nokugunyazwa, ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ngokwesibonelo, uma isiguli sithola ukuthi kudingeka ukwelashwa okuthile, udokotela kumele aqinisekise ukuthi lezo zinsiza zikhona ngaphambi kokuba aqhubeke. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kodokotela nabaphathi beGEMS, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokugunyaza ziqhutshwa ngendlela efanele. Uma lezi zinto zisebenza kahle, sizobona ukuthi abaguli bathola ukwelashwa okudingekayo ngaphandle kokulibaziseka. Ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo akugcini nje ngokuxhumana phakathi kodokotela nabaguli, kodwa futhi kudinga ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kodokotela nabaphathi beGEMS. Odokotela kumele bazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bagunyazwe, kanti abaphathi beGEMS badinga ukuqonda izidingo ezithile zabaguli. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, okungase kube yinkinga uma kudingeka izinqubo ezithile ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, udokotela kufanele abe nekhono lokuphendula imibuzo yabaguli ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi udokotela abe nolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe, ukuze akwazi ukusiza isiguli sikwazi ukuqonda kahle izinqubo ezihambisana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwakha ukwethembana, kodwa futhi kudala umuzwa wokuthi isiguli sikhululekile ukusho imizwa yaso. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nokugunyazwa kodokotela. Ezinye zezithiyo zifaka phakathi ukungabi nolwazi olufanele, ukungabi namathuba okukhuluma, noma izinqubo ezinzima ezithinta ukugunyazwa. Lokhu kungaholela ekubambezelekeni kokwelashwa, okungase kube nomthelela omubi empilweni yesiguli. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana phakathi kodokotela, abaguli, nabaphathi beGEMS. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa okukhululekile kodokotela ukuze baqonde kahle izinqubo zokugunyaza, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo ukuze abaguli bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uma lezi zinto ziqhutshwa kahle, sizobona ukwanda kokwaneliseka kwabantu abathola ukwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube nokwaneliseka okukhulu phakathi kodokotela nabaguli. Ekugcineni, ukugunyazwa kodokotela nokuxhumana kuyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwethu. Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinto zisebenza kanjani futhi ziqhuba kanjani empilweni yethu. Ngakho, kufanele sikhuthaze ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi sithole ukwelashwa okuphumelelayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza siphile impilo engcono, futhi sibe nokuqonda okuhle ngezinsiza esizitholayo. Ngakho, masiqhubeke silwela ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kodokotela, abaguli, nabaphathi beGEMS, ukuze sithole impilo engcono, futhi sithuthukise izinga lokuphila kwethu sonke. Ukuxhumana okuhle kuzoba isisekelo sokuphumelela kwethu empilweni.
Isingeniso Ukulimala kwezemidlalo kuyinto evame ukwenzeka ezindaweni zokudlala, ngakho kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde izindlela zokuvikela lezi zingozi, kanye nezinyathelo okufanele ziqhutshelwe uma zenzeka. Ukuze sikwazi ukuzivocavoca nokujabulela izemidlalo, kudingeka siqonde kahle ukuze sigcine impilo yethu iphephile. Kulokhu, sizobheka izindlela zokuvikela, ukuhlola, nokwelapha ukulimala kwezemidlalo. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukulimala Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izimbangela eziningi zokulimala. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukungazivocavoci kahle, ukujolisa kakhulu emsebenzini, noma ukwenza imisebenzi yokuzivocavoca ngokweqile. Ukuze uvikele ukulimala, qinisekisa ukuthi: 1. Uziqeqesha Ngempumelelo: Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela uhlelo lokuzivocavoca olwakhiwe kahle, oluhlanganisa ukujolisa emithini ehlukene. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni amandla, ukujula, kanye nokuthuthukisa amandla akho okuphila. 2. Phumula Ngempela: Ukuphumuza phakathi kwezifundo zokuzivocavoca kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzosiza ukuvimbela ukugula kwemisipha, okungaholela ekulimazeni. 3. Gqoka Izingubo Ezifanele: Qiniseka ukuthi ugqoke izingubo ezihambisana nezemidlalo yakho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze unciphise amathuba okulimala. 4. Thola Imishini Eyanele: Uma udlala imidlalo ethile, qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa imishini efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthole ukweseka okwanele. 5. Bheka Izimo Zokusebenza: Qaphela isimo sezulu nokuhlala, ikakhulukazi uma uhamba phambili. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi yini ongayilindela. Ukuhlola Ukulimala Noma ngabe uqaphele zonke izinyathelo zokuvikela, ukulimala kungase kwenzeke. Uma ungazizwa kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlola isimo sakho. Nazi izinyathelo okufanele uzithathe: 1. Zwa Uhlanga: Qaphela izimpawu ezinjengobuhlungu, ukuvuvukala, noma ukungakwazi ukuhamba kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi udinga usizo. 2. Faka Iphunga Lokuqala: Uma ulimele, sebenzisa umthetho we-RICE: - Rest (phumula): Nikeza isikhathi sokuphumula endaweni elimele. - Ice (qhwa): Faka iqhwa endaweni elimele ukuze unciphise ukuvuvukala. - Compression (cindezela): Sebenzisa ibhande lokucindezela uma kudingeka. - Elevation (phakamisa): Phakamisa indawo elimele ukuze unciphise ukuvuvukala. 3. Thola Usizo Lwezokwelapha: Uma ubuhlungu bungenakubekezelwa, khumbula ukuthi udinga ukubona udokotela. Lokhu kuzokwenza uthole ukuhlolwa okudingekayo. Ukwelashwa Kwezimoto Zokulimala Uma usutholile usizo, udokotela uzokwenza ukuhlolwa okujulile. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni uhlelo lokwelashwa olufanele. Izindlela zokwelapha zingafaka: 1. Ukwelashwa Kwezimoto: Lokhu kungaba ukujolisa emithini ethile, ukwelashwa ngama-physiotherapy, noma ama-massage therapy. 2. Izifundo Zokuqina: Uma usuphilile, ungase udinge izifundo zokwakha amandla ukuze ubuyisele emuva amandla akho. 3. Ukuphinda Uhlanganyele: Ngemva kokuphila kahle, qinisekisa ukuthi ubuyela emsebenzini kancane kancane. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi awubanga ukulimala futhi. Isiphetho Ukulimala kwezemidlalo akuyona into okufanele sithathe kalula. Ukufunda indlela yokuvikela, ukuhlola izimpawu, nokuqonda izinyathelo zokwelapha kubalulekile ukuze sibe nesimo esinempilo. Qhubeka uzivocavoca, kodwa khumbula ukuthi impilo yakho ibaluleke kakhulu. Ngezi zinyathelo, unganciphisa amathuba okulimala, ugcine ujabule emidlalweni yakho. Hamba phambili, kepha uqhubeke uqaphile.
Umshado Nomndeni: Ukuhlola Ubudlelwano Obubalulekile Umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu, ziqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwezimpilo zethu, zikhulisa ubudlelwano, futhi ziqinisa izimpande zomphakathi. Umshado, njengomcimbi wokuhlangana kwababili, akukhona nje kuphela ukuvuma ukuba ndawonye, kodwa futhi kuyisivumelwano sokwakha ikusasa elihlangene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umndeni ubonisa ubudlelwano obujulile phakathi kwabantu, obuhlanganisa izizukulwane ezahlukene, futhi ubonisa indlela esiphila ngayo njengomphakathi. Umshado: Isivumelwano Sokuhlangana Umshado ungumcimbi ophawulekayo empilweni yomuntu. Uqala ngokuthandana, lapho ababili behlangana, bezwa uthando, futhi besebenzisa isikhathi ndawonye ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela, ukuqonda, nokuxhumana. Umshado awupheli lapho umcimbi uqeda; kunalokho, uqala impilo entsha, lapho abashadile bahlala bexhumene, bephokophelela empilweni engcono. Ngokwesiko, umshado uhlanganisa imicimbi ehlukene, efana nemishado yendabuko, lapho imindeni yomshado ihlangana khona ukuze ibonise ukwamukela. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhlanganyela, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi umshado ube nemigomo ethile, efana nokuhloniphana, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izingxabano. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umshado uthuthuka, futhi abashadile bahlala bejabule. Umndeni: Isikhungo Sokuxhumana Umndeni ungumgogodla wezimpilo zethu. Ubonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali, abantwana, nezizukulwane. Umndeni unikeza uthando, ukweseka, nokukhula. Abazali banomsebenzi omkhulu ekwakheni isizinda esiqinile, lapho abantwana befunda khona izimiso zokuphila, njengokuhlonipha, ukuzithiba, nokusebenza kanzima. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabazali nabantwana bukhulu kakhulu, futhi kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Abazali kufanele babe yisibonelo esihle, bebonisa indlela yokuphila enempilo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantwana bakhule babe ngabantu abakhathalelayo, abahlonipha, futhi abakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Noma umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezinhle, zikhona izinselelo ezithile. Ukungaboni ngaso linye, izinkinga zezimali, noma ukungabi nesikhathi sokuba ndawonye kungaholela ezinkingeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abashadile nabazali bazi ukuthi lezi zinkinga zingavela, futhi bazi ukuthi zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokuxhumana. Ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekuxazululeni lezi zinkinga. Abashadile kufanele bakhulume ngokukhululeka, baphendule izinkinga zabo, futhi bahlale bephokophelela ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzokwenza umshado ube namandla, futhi kuzokwenza umndeni ube yindawo yokuthula. Isiphetho: Ukubaluleka Komshado Nomndeni Umshado nomndeni kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Ziqinisekisa ukuthi sikhula, sithuthuka, futhi sithola uthando. Umshado ubonisa isivumelwano sokuhlangana, kanti umndeni ubonisa ubudlelwano obujulile. Noma zikhona izinselelo, ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuqonda, nokuhloniphana kuzokwenza umshado nomndeni ube yimpumelelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuhlonipha umshado nomndeni, siwasebenzise njengesisekelo sokwakha impilo engcono, futhi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Umshado nomndeni akukhona nje kuphela izigameko, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sikhuthaze lezi zinto ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo.
Intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese UJacob Zuma, owayengumengameli waseNingizimu Afrika, ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima zomthetho ezihlobene nezinsolo zokushushiswa kwakhe ngasese. Lokhu kushushiswa kuhilela izinsolo ezinzima zokuphula umthetho, ezifaka phakathi ukukhwabanisa, ukungathembeki, kanye nokuphula izinqubomgomo zezwe. Ukuze siqonde kahle intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaZuma, kubalulekile ukuhlola izigameko zomlando, izinqubo zomthetho, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona. UZuma wakhuluma kakhulu ngesikhathi esebenza njengomengameli, lapho abezindaba bahlala bemkhumbuza ngezinsolo ezihlobene nezinto ezahlukene. Ukubhekana nalezi zinsolo, uZuma wathola izeluleko eziningi ezivela kubameli bakhe, okuhlanganisa izinyathelo zokuzivikela. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithile zokuphendula, ezazihloselwe ukuvikela isithunzi sakhe, ngenkathi kuqhubeka nokuhlola izinsolo ezibhekiswe kuye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinsolo zokushushiswa zathuthuka zafinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu, lapho iziphathimandla zokuqala ziqala ukucwaninga ngokuqinile izenzo zikaZuma. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinsuku zokuphikisana ezibucayi, lapho abavoti, izikhungo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele ziqala ukuveza ukukhathazeka ngempumelelo yokuphatha kukaZuma. Izinhlangano eziningi zaphakamisa izwi lazo, zikhumbuza umphakathi ngokuqakathekiswa kokuphatha kahle kwezomnotho, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwemithetho. Intuthuko enkulu yenzeka ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwezinsolo ezihlobene nezimangalo zokukhwabanisa. Izinsuku eziningi zokuqhubeka nokuhlola zakhombisa ukuthi uZuma ubhekene nemiphumela emibi, njengoba izinsolo zakhula zaba yinkinga enkulu. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinyathelo ezinzima ezithathwe ngabezinhlaka zomthetho, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokubamba uZuma ukuze abhekane nezinsolo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inqubo yokushushiswa kaZuma yathuthuka yaba yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini ehlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima phakathi kwabantu, lapho abanye bebona uZuma njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye bemkhumbuza ngezinsolo zokuphula umthetho. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima emiphakathini. Izinyathelo zokushushiswa ziqhubekile, futhi uZuma waphakanyiswa ukuba abhekane nezinsolo ezinzima. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokubamba uZuma, ezazihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziphathimandla zazingazimisele ukungaboni lutho, futhi zazithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uZuma ubhekana nezinsolo ngendlela efanele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaZuma yathuthuka yaba yinkinga enkulu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo eziningi ezihlobene nezombusazwe, lapho abantu bephikisana ngezindlela ezahlukene zokubhekana nezinsolo. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima emiphakathini. Ukwengeza, izinsolo zokukhwabanisa zathuthuka zaba yinkinga enkulu emiphakathini, futhi uZuma wathola ukwesekwa okuhlukahlukene. Abantu abaningi babona uZuma njengomholi ophumelelayo, kanti abanye bemkhumbuza ngezinsolo zokuphula umthetho. Lokhu kudala ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinkulumo ezinzima emiphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, inqubo yokushushiswa kaZuma yathuthuka yaba yinkinga enkulu, futhi iziphathimandla zathatha izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziphathimandla zazingazimisele ukungaboni lutho, futhi zazithathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uZuma ubhekana nezinsolo ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, intuthuko ecaleni kokushushiswa kukaJacob Zuma ngasese ibonisa ukuthi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka, noma ngabe izinsolo zikhula zibe nzima. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umthetho unamandla, futhi iziphathimandla zikhuthazekile ekutheni ziqinisekise ukuthi abaphula umthetho babhekana nezinsolo zabo. Lokhu kudala ithemba kubantu, njengoba kubonisa ukuthi umthetho uyasebenza, futhi izinqubo zomthetho ziyaqhubeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka.
Izifo Ezingamahlalakhona Ekhaya elikude, elimi phakathi kwezintaba eziluhlaza, kwaphila umama uMiriam. Wayeyingane ethokozisayo, enamaphupho amakhulu. Kodwa, njengoba izinsuku zedlula, ubuhlungu obunqabileyo bamsiza kwabanye abantwana. U-Miriam waba neziguli eziningi ezingamahlalakhona. Kwakungelula, kodwa wayenokubekezela. Ukuphela kosuku, uMiriam wayephuma noMama, behamba ngezinyawo, besuka emakhaya babheke esikoleni. Ng izinto eziningi abazifundile, baqonda ukuthi izifo ezingamahlalakhona azifuni ukusula amaphupho. Kukhona okuningi okwakuhlangene nemvelo, futhi izidingo zempilo zidinga ukunakekela. Ngonyaka wesithathu, uMiriam wathola ukuthi unekholesterole ephezulu. Lokhu kwaba umthwalo omkhulu kumama wakhe, uMama Joy, owayemthanda unyana wakhe. UMama Joy wayenempilo enhle, wamtshela ukuthi: "Ubaba, sizodinga ukwenza izinguquko empilweni yethu." Baphuma bayabheka ukudla okwakhe. Kuthathwa isinqumo sokudla okusemthethweni, okujolise emifino, ezithelo, nezinto ezilula. Njengoba izinyanga zedlula, uMiriam waqala ukuhamba emsebenzini, ehlanganisa umphakathi. Ukuze akhulise impilo yakhe, wahlangana nabanye abakhathazekile ngesimo esifanayo. Umphakathi waba ngumthombo wamandla, obasiza bazi ukuthi izifo ezinjengalezi zidinga ukuxhaswa. Bahlanganyela izifundo zokudla, ukugijima nempilo engcono. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, uMiriam waqala ukuzizwa umuhle kakhulu. Ubulili bakhe buphumule, futhi emoyeni kwakukhanya indlela entsha. U-Mama Joy wathola inkuthazo eningi, futhi uMiriam waba yisibonelo sobufakazi bokuphila kahle. Izinsuku zabe zisengaphezulu, beqhubeka nokuwina lezi zimpilo. Kodwa, impilo ayikaze ibelula. Kwakukhona izinsuku ezinzima lapho uMiriam ethola izinkinga ezithile. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho lezi zifo zingamahlalakhona zimshiya edinga ukukhululeka. Ukuze adlule kulezi zikhathi, wafunda ukuba yindoda eqinile, eyazi ukuthi ukuphila kumele kube kulo msebenzi. U-Doctor Kwezi waba umngane wakhe omkhulu. Wabahlola njalo, ewakhumbuza ngezindlela zokuphila impilo enhle. U-Miriam waya empilweni enempilo, ebona ukuthi ukwelashwa kuyabanzima. Ngaphezulu kwalesi sikhathi, waqala ukufunda izincwadi zokufundisa, ukuze abhekane nezimo ezingalindelekile eziphakanyiswe yizifo ezingamahlalakhona. Ngesinye isikhathi, uMiriam wenza umcimbi ophakeme emhlabeni, lapho ahlabelelwe khona abanye besekhulwani. Izifo zikhombisa amandla okuphila, futhi zifundisa abanye ngaphandle. Kwakubukeka ezinye izinsizwa, kwabakhe abanye befundiswa ngesimo sabo. Kuthathe isikhathi, kodwa umphakathi uqhubeka nokuvumelana. U-Miriam, noMama Joy, baba ngaphezu nje kokuhamba kwezinyawo. Bafundisa nabanye abantu abakhuluma ngezifo ezinjalo, bezama ukuthuthukisa izimo zempilo. Kwaqala ukufana nomphakathi okhuthazayo. Izifundo zabo zama njengokuthokozisa. Ekugcineni, uMiriam wayephila impilo egcwele. Wayesebenzisa isikhathi sakhe sokuphakela abantu, uqhakambisa indlela yokuphila impilo enempilo. Indlela yakhe yaphenduka umthombo wothando, ububele nemikhuba emisha. Ubulili bakhe bukhule futhi buthola umuntu othokozayo. Ibhalwe le ndaba ukuze ibonise ukuthi izifo ezingamahlalakhona azimele impilo yethu. Kulungile ukufaka izinqumo ezithile, ukubala isizathu sokuphila ajabule. U-Doctor Kwezi, uMama Joy, noMiriam washintshana nezimo, besebenza ngokukhalipha. Bawaqondisa umphakathi. Phakathi kwabasiza, babe nezinhloso ezinhle, beqhuba izifundo ezintsha. Ngakho, yonke indaba yempilo kaMiriam ibonisa ukuqhubeka, umoya, nokuqhubeka ngokwakha impilo, nempilo engcono. Ubuyele emlanjeni, ezinzwaneni zokuphila, efundisa abanye bonke ukuthi ukuthula neziqu зiphelele. Indaba yakhe izoba yinsika yokuthi impilo ayisongeleki, futhi izifo ezingamahlalakhona zingamukelwa ngokukhulumela uthando nethuba lemfiso.
Iziteleka Zabasebenzi: Ukuhlola Umthelela Nokubaluleka Kwazo Iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyingxenye ebalulekile yokulwa nokungalingani emsebenzini, futhi zinezimpande ezijulile emlandweni wezokusebenza. Zivame ukwenzeka lapho abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonitshwa, noma lapho bezwa ukuthi izimo zabo zokusebenza zidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lezi ziteleka zikhombisa ubuhlakani, ubuholi, nokuzimisela kwabasebenzi ekufuneni izinguquko ezinhle. Ukwethulwa Kweziteleka Ngokujwayelekile, iziteleka ziqala lapho abasebenzi behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kungaba ngenxa yokunganeliseki ngemiholo, izimo zokusebenza, noma ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo kahle. Ngalesi sikhathi, abasebenzi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo, ukuze bakwazi ukuveza izidingo zabo ngendlela ehlelekile. Izizathu Zokuziphakamisa Iziteleka zenzeka ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, imiholo engaphansi iyisizathu esivamile sokuthi abasebenzi baphakamise izwi labo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokusebenza ezimbi, njengokungabi khona kwezokuphepha, izinsiza ezinqala, noma isikhathi eside sokusebenza, nazo zingaholela ezitelekeni. Abasebenzi bahlala beqonda ukuthi uma behlangana, banamandla okwenza izinguquko ezinkulu. Umthelela Kwezomnotho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zinezimpawu ezithile ezithinta umnotho. Ngokweqiniso, uma abasebenzi bephuma ezitelekeni, lokhu kungaholela ekwehleni kokukhiqiza, okungathinta imali engenayo yenkampani. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izinkampani zicabangele izinhlelo ezinzima zokuphendula, okuvame ukuhamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uma iziteleka ziphumelele, lokhu kungaholela ekwenzeni izinguquko ezithinta wonke umkhakha, okuvumela abasebenzi ukuba babe nempilo engcono. Ukwaziswa Nokuxhumana Ukwaziswa kubalulekile ekwakheni amandla ezitelekeni. Abasebenzi kumele babe nolwazi olunembile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, izinqubomgomo zenkampani, kanye nemithetho evikela amalungelo abo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwababusi nabasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi iziteleka zifaneleka kanjani, futhi ukuthi izinqumo zithathwa kanjani. Izindlela Zokuxazulula Izinkinga Iziteleka zabasebenzi zidinga izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga ezivumelana nazo. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukuhlangana nezikhulu zenkampani, ukuxhumana nezinyunyana, noma ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxoxisana. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi kungasiza ekunciphiseni iziteleka, njengoba kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuxoxisana. Isiphetho Iziteleka zabasebenzi zikhombisa amandla okwenza izinguquko ezinkulu emsebenzini. Ziwumthombo wokukhuthaza izinguquko ezinhle, futhi zikhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi bangabamba iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza engcono. Ukubaluleka kweziteleka akukhawulelwanga kuphela kumasiko, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwezomnotho, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga. Njengoba sikhula, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi iziteleka zabasebenzi ziyindlela yokukhuluma, yokubambisana, nokwakha ikusasa elingcono kubo bonke.
Izilwane Ezifuywayo: Uthando Olungapheli Izilwane ezifuywayo ziwumthombo omuhle wokuthokozisa, uthando, nokuxhumana. Emhlabeni wethu, lapho abantu behlupheka khona ngezinkinga eziningi, izilwane ezifuywayo ziba yizithunywa ezinhle ezisiza ukunciphisa ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kubonakala ngokukhethekile uma sikhuluma ngama-pets afana nezinja, amakati, nezinye izilwane ezincane. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukuveza umbono wami ngokubaluleka kokuba nezilwane ezifuywayo empilweni yethu. Okokuqala, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhulisa umuzwa wothando phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izilwane zikhombisa uthando olungapheli kum owners bazo. Uma ubheka inja, ngokwesibonelo, uzobona ukuthi iyakwazi ukujabulisa umnikazi wayo ngisho noma usuku lube mubi. Izinja zikhombisa uthando nokwethembeka, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukujabulisa. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izilwane ziba yizinsiza zokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene. Okwesibili, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhuthaza impilo enempilo. Ukuhamba nezinja, ngokwesibonelo, kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomuntu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukujolisa emoyeni, ukugijima, nokudlala. Ukuzivocavoca kuholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomzimba, okwenza abantu babe nempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilwane zifundisa abantu ukuba babe nozwelo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini lapho abantu behlupheka khona. Ukunakekela izilwane kudinga umoya wokuzithiba, okwenza abantu babe nomoya omuhle. Okwesithathu, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhuthaza umqondo wokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Izilwane zifundisa abantu ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nokubambisana. Uma umuntu enezilwane ezifuywayo, ubona ukuthi izilwane zidinga ukunakekelwa, ukudla, nempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umnikazi abekezelele, ahlele, futhi asebenze ngokubambisana nezilwane zakhe. Lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yomuntu, njengoba kufundisa abantu ukuba babe nezinhloso ezihlangene, futhi lokho kukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilwane ezifuywayo zikhuthaza ubuhlakani. Ukunakekela izilwane kudinga ukuthi umnikazi abone izidingo zazo, aqonde indlela yokuziphatha kwazo, futhi akwazi ukuhlela isikhathi sokudlala. Lokhu kukhuthaza ubuhlakani, njengoba kudinga ukuthi umnikazi afunde ngezinto eziningi ezihlobene nezilwane. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini ezinzima lapho abantu behlupheka khona ngempilo. Nokho, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ukunakekela izilwane ezifuywayo kudinga umthwalo. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ngezindleko zokudla, kodwa futhi kudinga isikhathi, uthando, nokunakekela. Abantu kufanele baqonde ukuthi izilwane azitholakali kalula, futhi zidinga ukunakekelwa okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izilwane zihlala ziphilile, zikhululekile, futhi zikhona empilweni yomnikazi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izilwane ezifuywayo ziwumthombo omuhle wokuthokozisa, uthando, nokuxhumana. Zikhuthaza impilo enempilo, umqondo wokuphila ngokuhlanganyela, nobuhlakani. Nokho, zidinga ukunakekelwa nokuhlonishwa. Ngakho, uma unomqondo wokuba nezilwane ezifuywayo, qiniseka ukuthi uzilungiselele kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba ube nobudlelwano obuhle nezilwane zakho, futhi kuzokwenza ukuphila kwakho kube mnandi kakhulu. Ekugcineni, izilwane ezifuywayo ziwumthombo wokujabula nokuthokozisa, kodwa zidinga umthwalo. Uma sithatha isinqumo sokuba nezilwane, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokunakekela, ukuhlinzeka, nokuthokozisa izilwane zethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba siphile impilo enempilo, ethokozisayo, futhi egcwele uthando. Ngakho-ke, ngikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba acabangele ukufaka izilwane ezifuywayo empilweni zabo, ngoba zikhona izinzuzo eziningi ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono.
UMnyango Wezolimo ubheka amasampula ezithombo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ahlanzekile, akhule kahle, futhi angakwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhula. Zonke izithombo, kokubili ezithengiswayo kanye neziqinisekiswe, zihlolwa. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokukhetha ngokucophelela noma yiziphi izithombo eziphawulwe njengezinkinga. Amasampula azohlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ahambisana noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezitshalo, ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izithombo zihlanzekile futhi ukuthi zizokhula kahle. Abahloli bayaziswa ngemiphumela. Uma imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi izithombo azihambisani nomthetho, zingasuswa emakethe ukuze zingathengiswa noma zifakwe uphawu. Njengoba le nqubo yokuhlola izithombo yenziwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho kazwelonke, ayikhokhiswa. Nokho, uma umuntu ophuma endaweni lapho kuthathwe khona isampula efuna imiphumela yokuhlola ngendlela yeSikhumbuzo Sokuhlola Izithombo, kufanele kube nesikhwama esiqinisekiswe nguMnyango Wezezimali okumele sikhokhwe. Kuzokwenziwa i-invoyisi. Khumbula ukufaka inombolo yokukhokha ukuze ihambisane ne-invoyisi ekhishwe. Isiteshi esisemthethweni sokuhlola izithombo sisebenzisa inqubo ehlinzeka ngezidingo ezibalulekile nezidingekayo zokuhlola. Njengoba izitshalo ezahlukene zinezimfuno ezahlukene zokuhlola, isikhathi sokuhlola singathatha ezinsukwini ezimbalwa kuya ezinsukwini eziningi. Uma unemibuzo mayelana nenqubo uqobo. Le nkonzo iyatholakala mahhala. Azikho ifomu okufanele zigcwaliswe.
Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama esedlule Ngosuku olulodwa, uMnumzana Ndlovu, ohlala edolobheni elincane laseMpumalanga, wathola ithuba lokushintsha impilo yakhe. Njengoba ehamba edolobheni, wabona izikhangiso ezikhuthaza impilo engcono kanye nezinsizakalo zezempilo eziphambili. Lokhu kumkhuthaze, kwathi emva kokucabanga, wanquma ukukhansela ubulungu bakhe besikhwama sokunakekelwa kwezempilo esedlule, iGEMS. Wafisa ukukwazi ukuhlola izinketho ezintsha ezitholakalayo. Nokho, ngaphambi kokuba aqhubeke, wayedinga ubufakazi bokukhansela lesi sikhwama. Lokhu kwakubalulekile, njengoba umthetho wezempilo udinga ubufakazi bokuthi akasekho ngaphansi kwesikhwama esidala. Umlando wokuqala wokuqonda ubufakazi bokukhanselwa waqala ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezedlule, lapho uMnumzana Ndlovu efika kwi-ofisi yeGEMS. Lapho efika, wabona abantu abaningi bekhuluma ngezinkinga ezihlobene nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngemuva kokulinda emgqeni, wathola ithuba lokukhuluma nomphakathi ophathelene nezinsizakalo. Ummeli, uNksz. Mbali, wamkhombisa ubuhlakani bokuphatha izinqubo zokuqhubekisela phambili izicelo zamakhasimende. "Mnumzana Ndlovu," kusho yena, "ukukhansela ubulungu bakho kudinga amaphepha athile. Ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ukusiza." U-‘GEMS’ wayekwazi ukukhokha izindleko ezithile zempilo, kodwa ezinye zazinzima. Ngemuva kokukhuluma, uNksz. Mbali wamnika ifomu lokukhansela ubulungu, elalidinga ukuba ligcwalisiwe ngokucophelela. Njengoba uMnumzana Ndlovu ebuya ekhaya, waqala ukucabanga ngalesi sikhathi esisha sokuphila. Wazibuza ukuthi angakhetha kanjani isikhwama esizomthokozisa. Wayenombuzo omningi mayelana nobufakazi bokukhanselwa, kodwa wayenethemba lokuthi uNksz. Mbali uzomqondisa. Ngemuva kokugcwalisa ifomu, uMnumzana Ndlovu wathumela izicelo ezidingekayo kuGEMS. Waqhubeka nokulinda izinsuku ezimbalwa, ethokozisa impilo yakhe ngokuqhubeka nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, wathola umyalezo obalulekile: “Siyavuma! Ubhalisele ukuphuma kuGEMS. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa buhlelwe.” Wajabula kakhulu, usuku lwakhe lwenyuka. Wazisa uNksz. Mbali ngeziphumo zakhe, futhi umfana omncane wakhumbula izinsuku ezinzima ezedlule. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile, esikhombisa ukuthi wayesebenzisa isikhathi sakhe kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMnumzana Ndlovu wakhetha enye insiza yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, eyayihambelana nezidingo zakhe. Lokhu kwenza waba nokuqonda okukhulu ngempilo, futhi wanqoba izithiyo ezingalindelekile. Wazi ukuthi ukulandelela impilo yakhe kwaba yinto ebalulekile, futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola usizo lapho kudingeka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uMnumzana Ndlovu wathola umyalezo ovela esikhwameni esisha. Lezi zinsuku zazigcwele ukujabulisa, njengoba umndeni wakhe wawuhlangene, bejabulela impilo engcono. Ibhuku lempilo elisha lalifana nensika, elibamba izifiso zakhe zokwakha ikusasa elihle. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayazi kahle ukuthi konke kwenzeka ngenxa yokuphikelela nokuhlakanipha kwakhe. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kobulungu besikhwama esedlule babufana nendlela yokukhulula indlela, yokudala impilo engcono. Kwakungokwakhe, futhi lokho kwaba yisiqalo sokuphila okujabulisayo. Ubufakazi bokukhanselwa kwaba yisikhumbuzo sezinqumo ezinhle ezithathwe empilweni, futhi uMnumzana Ndlovu waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuchule nemizamo yokwakha ikusasa elingcono kuholela ekuphumeleleni. Njengoba ehamba phambili, uMnumzana Ndlovu waba nethuba lokukhuluma nabanye, abakhuthaze ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile eziphathelene nezempilo. Kwaba yindaba yokuthi ubufakazi bokukhanselwa akukona nje iphepha, kodwa kuyisithombe sokuphila, sokukhula, nokuhlakanipha. Lokhu kwenze uMnumzana Ndlovu aqonde ukuthi impilo yempela iqala lapho sithatha izinyathelo ezibalulekile. Futhi ke, impilo yakhe yaphenduka yimpumelelo, ibonisa ukuthi konke kungenzeka uma unethemba nokuzikhandla.
Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ezimpilweni zethu, izimo eziphuthumayo zenzeka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi zidinga ukuphendulwa ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zethu zokuphendula, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza abantu abadinga usizo. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo akukhona nje kuphela udaba lwamathuluzi nezinsiza, kodwa futhi kudinga umqondo omusha wokubheka izimo, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zifaka phakathi izenzakalo ezifana nezikhukhula, imililo, noma izigameko zokuhlaselwa. Lezi zimo zidinga ukuphendulwa okusheshayo, futhi isikhathi sokuphendula singaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Ukuze sithuthukise lesi sikhathi, kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezicacile ezibandakanya wonke umuntu, kusukela kubaphathi bezinhlelo zokuphendula, izisebenzi zomphakathi, kanye nabantu abajwayelekile. Ukuxhumana kahle phakathi kwezinsiza ezahlukene kungaba yisixazululo esikhulu. Uma izikhungo ezahlukene zikwazi ukuhlela kahle, lokho kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, zingasiza ekusheshiseni ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo, abantu bangakwazi ukuthola usizo ngokushesha, baphinde bazi kahle ukuthi bangabiza kuphi usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abantu badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula kahle ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuhle kuzokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuziphatha kahle, bazi ukuthi kufanele benze kanjani, futhi bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani abanye. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu benolwazi olufanele, bazokwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi kumele ube neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni isikhathi sokuphendula. Ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba babe neqhaza ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphendula. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela imihlangano yokwazisa, lapho abantu bengafunda khona ngezindlela zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nekhono lokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisebenze ndawonye. Uma izikhungo zempilo, izikhungo zokuhlala, kanye neziphathimandla zisebenzisana, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngosizo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlela okukhulu, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinsiza ezahlukene. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izinsiza zingase zisebenze ngokuhlukana, okungaholela ekubeni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu ngesikhathi sokuphendula. Ngesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhumbule izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sibe nezinqubo ezihlonipha abantu, futhi sikhumbule ukuthi abanye abantu bangase babe nezimo ezikhethekile. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, kufanele sibe nezinqubo ezicacile ezihlonipha izidingo zabantu, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza bonke abantu. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo akukhona nje udaba lwamathuluzi nezinsiza, kodwa kudinga umqondo omusha wokubheka izimo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu, sikhuthaze ukuxhumana, sithuthukise ukuqeqeshwa, futhi sibe nezinqubo ezihlonipha abantu. Uma sikwazi ukwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukusiza abantu abaningi ezimeni eziphuthumayo, futhi sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi wethu. Ngakho-ke, sithumele imiyalezo emihle, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu, futhi sibe nomqondo ophumelelayo wokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphendula, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi ube nekhono lokuphila kahle, ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma sisebenza ndawonye, singakwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu.
Osomabhizinisi: Umsebenzi Ohlukile Olwenziwa Ngonembeza Osomabhizinisi, noma abakwa-entrepreneurs, bahlala beziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo kanye nomsebenzi abakwenza. Lezi zikhala zikhomba abantu abanolwazi oluthile, abanamandla okwenza izinqumo ezinkulu, futhi abakhathazeki ngemiphumela. Kulezi zinsuku, osomabhizinisi baphinde baba nezibopho eziningi, njengoba besebenza emhlabeni obalulekile kakhulu, lokhu kudinga ubuchule, ukuzinikela, nokuhlakanipha. Ukuze sithole ukuqonda okujulile ngalesi sikhala, kufanele siqale ngokuqonda ukuthi ubani osomabhizinisi. Abantu abaningi bacabanga ukuthi osomabhizinisi bayabhalisela imisebenzi ethile yokwenza imali, kodwa empeleni, lo msebenzi uhamba phambili. Abantu abanjengoSteve Jobs no-Elon Musk baveza ukuthi osomabhizinisi akukhona nje ukuvula ibhizinisi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila. Ukusebenza njengosomabhizinisi kudinga ubuhlakani bokukhiqiza amasu amasha, ukwakha izixazululo ezintsha, nokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezingezinhle. Ngokwesiko, osomabhizinisi bahlala benendawo enkulu ezimpilweni zethu. Bahamba phambili ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, baphinde baphumelele ekwakheni izitolo ezithokozisayo, izinkampani zobuchwepheshe, nezinsizakalo ezinjalo. Lokhu kudala umnotho ozinzile, kuholele ekwenzeni izimpumelelo ezinkulu kulezi zindawo. Ubusuku obubi bomnotho buzokhuphula umoya ophakathi kwabantu, kepha osomabhizinisi bafaka imali eningi ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zabo, bacela osomabhizinisi baphumelele. Njengoba sikhuluma ngosomabhizinisi, akukhona nje ukuzithokozisa kwabo, kodwa nokuphila kwezinye izindawo. Ubuhlakani babo bokusungula buphumela ngaphandle kokuba nezizathu eziningi. Uma ubheka izinkanyezi ezinezimpumelelo, u-Jeff Bezos, owaziwa ngokwakha i-Amazon, ubonisa ukuthi osomabhizinisi bangakha izimakethe ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, osomabhizinisi bahlala bephusha umkhakha wezokuthengisa, bejabulisa abantu futhi benza kube lula ukuthenga. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, osomabhizinisi baye baqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungumngane wabo. Izinkampani eziningi ziye zathuthuka ngenxa yokusebenzisa izindlela zobuchwepheshe obuphambili. U-Instagram, isibonelo, ubonisa ukuthi osomabhizinisi bangakha imiphakathi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, benza ukuthi imikhiqizo yabo itholakale kalula. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, osomabhizinisi baphakamisa imikhiqizo yabo emhlabeni wonke, benza kube lula ukuthola izimakethe ezintsha. Nokho, ukuhamba phambili kwezimali nokudinga izinsiza ezithile kudinga umoya obalulekile wokubambisana. Osomabhizinisi bahlala bejabula ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende, abahlinzeki, nabanye osomabhizinisi. Lokhu kudala ikhono lokusebenza njengeqembu elihlangene, lapho wonke umuntu enza umsebenzi wabo, okwenza kube lula ukuthola umgomo omkhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo akugcini nje ekwenzeni imali, kepha kuphinde kuthuthukise izimpilo zabantu. Osomabhizinisi abavumi ukuhamba bodwa, kodwa badinga abantu abazokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela phezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, osomabhizinisi baye baqonda ukuthi izinkinga zikhona. Ukuphumelela akufani nempumelelo. Abantu abaningi bahluleka, kodwa lokhu akubavimbi ekubeni neqhaza. Osomabhizinisi bahlala besebenzisa izifundo ezifundwa ezinkingeni, bezama ukuhamba phambili. Izinselelo ziyisifundo esiwusizo, futhi osomabhizinisi bahlala beqonda ukuthi ukuzama nokuphumelela kudinga isikhathi. Ukuphila kwemali akuyona kuphela, kepha kumane kuyindlela yokuphila. Ekugcineni, osomabhizinisi bahlala benza umhlaba ube ngcono. Bakha imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, baphumelele emisebenzini yabo, futhi baveza izimfuno ezihlukahlukene. Ngokuqhubeka bezama, bahlala benza umthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Ubuchwepheshe, ubudlelwano, nezifundo ezivela ezinkingeni kulokhu kubalulekile. Osomabhizinisi bahlala behlola ulimi lwemakethe, bephendula ezidingweni zabantu, futhi benza ukuthi imiphakathi ibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, uma ubheka osomabhizinisi, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje ukuthola imali, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umhlaba ongcono.
Imicimbi Yomphakathi: Ukuhlola Ukubaluleka Kwayo Emphakathini Ukubamba imicimbi yomphakathi kubaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Imicimbi efana noMkhosi Wezithelo, imishado, nezinkumbulo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuhlela le micimbi ngendlela efanele ukuze ihlale ibalulekile, ibekwe kahle, futhi ifinyelele kulabo abayidingayo. Sizofunda izinzuzo nemiphumela emibi emicimbini yomphakathi ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu. Izinzuzo Zemicimbi Yomphakathi Okokuqala, imicimbi yomphakathi idala ithuba lokuhlangana. Abantu bathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela, babelane ngemibono, futhi basebenzisane. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhekeni kobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, imindeni, nezinkampani. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuwina ezinkingeni eziphathelene nezimpilo zabo, kudingeka isikhala sokwabelana ngezimvo nemibono. Imicimbi ibuye ibe yithuba lokuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile emphakathini, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuziphilisa, amandla phakathi kwabantu, kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Okwesibili, imicimbi yomphakathi iyakhuthaza ukwakhiwa komnotho. Izinkampani ezithinta le micimbi, njengezindawo zokudlela, abahlinzeki bezinsiza, nezokuthengisa, ziba nomthelela ophumelelayo emnothweni. Lapho umcimbi ubamba iqhaza, abantu baya emaphethelweni edolobheni, okukhuthaza ukuthenga nokuthengisa. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kukhuphula imali engenayo kumabhizinisi amancane. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi imicimbi ethile ikhanga izihambeli, okuholela ekufakweni kwezimpahla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yomphakathi iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Lapho abantu behlangana, bakha ukuqonda nokuqwashisa, okuvulela amathuba okuba neqhaza emphakathini. Imicimbi efana nemikhosi yokuhlonipha, izinkulumo, noma imfundo ibalulekile ekuqwashiseni abantu ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi wabo. Imiphumela Emibi Yemicimbi Yomphakathi Nokho, imicimbi yomphakathi ingaholela emiphumeleni emibi uma ingahlelwa kahle. Ukuze abantu bahlale bephumulele emicimbini, kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi. Ukuntuleka kokuhlela kahle kungaholela ezinkingeni ezifana nokungezwani, izingozi, noma izinkinga zokuphepha. Lokhu kungalimaza umphakathi, kudala ingqondo yokuthi imicimbi zingaba yingozi. Futhi, imicimbi yomphakathi ingadala ukuhlukumezeka kumalungelo abantu uma imizwa yabo ingalalelwa. Izinqumo ezithathwa ngumphakathi zingase zithinte abantu ngendlela engafanele, okuholela ekutheni bahlupheke ngengqondo. Umphakathi Ohlangene Ngemibono Ekugcineni, imicimbi yomphakathi ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Iphakamisa ukuxhumana, izinkumbulo, nokukhuthaza ukholo, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi osebenzisanayo. Ngaphezu kwezizathu ezinhle, kubalulekile ukufaka umfutho emicimbini yokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kanye nokwenza imicimbi ibe yithuba lokukhula komnotho. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuhlela imicimbi ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziwusizo ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano, ophumelelayo, futhi onempilo. Uma sikhumbula lokhu, sizoba nolwazi lokuphila kahle ngokwamukela imicimbi yomphakathi, kusukela ezingeni eliphansi lokuhlangana, kuze kube phezulu ekwakheni umphakathi okhongayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imicimbi yomphakathi akusikho okwenzekayo kuphela, kodwa kuyinqubo ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa elikhanyayo.
Izindlela zokonga ngokusebenzisa nokwakha izakhiwo zomdabu ezifana nezinhlelo zokubhaka nez stokvels. Ukwakha umkhakha omncane osebenzayo wezezimali eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhaswa kwezezimali ukuze kwakhiwe amandla omthetho ezinhlelweni ezibamba iqhaza kanye namakhasimende azo ukuze kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwazo emisebenzini yezezimali ephumelelayo. Ukonga njalo nokuhlinzekwa kwemali kubalulekile kokubili izinhlelo kanye neziqu zezezimali (RFIs) njengendlela yokwandisa nokujulisa ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezimali zabampofu nokuthuthukisa isimo sabo sezezimali ukuze baphile kahle. Ukwenza bazi ngokuqonda ukonga akuyona indlela yokukhetha, kodwa ukuqala nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezisekelwe kulwazi lwempilo kuyakhuthazwa. I-Fund yeSikweletu Esincane: Le nkqubo ihlinzeka ngama-loan angafika ku-R10,000 kumakhaya kanye nabashintshi abanguye amalungu ezinkampanini ezincane ukuze baziphilise. Ikhredithi yebhizinisi elincane yezinkampani ezincane. I-fund yokunciphisa amazinga obuphofu kumakhasimende avela kumakhaya athola ngaphansi kwe-R1,500. Inhlangano ebamba iqhaza izosebenzisa ithuluzi lokuhlola ubuphofu. Ukwakha amandla omthetho: Ngaphansi kwalesi siphakamiso se-fund, uxhaso lunikezwa ukuze kuqiniswe isikhungo nokuqinisekisa ukwesekwa kwaso kwesikhathi eside. Ukonga njalo: Lokhu kusiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhuthazeni ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zezimali nezinye izikhungo zokonga zomdabu ezifana nezinhlelo zokubhaka nez stokvels ukuze kuqoqwe ingcebo yendawo. I-Apex ikwenza umsebenzi wayo ngezinhlelo ezibhalisiwe, ngakho-ke ukukhetha kwabo kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kuqhubeka. Ngalesi senzo, ihlinzeka ngamanani amaningi ezinhlelo ezibhalisiwe, izikhungo zebhizinisi lendawo, izikhungo zabazithandayo, kanye nemiphakathi efanele isebenzisa izici ezijwayelekile. Ekutholeni inani enhlangano, i-Apex ilandela imihlahlandlela ecacile engahlukaniswa ngezindawo ezilandelayo: inhlangano, umhleli, ukuphathwa, ubuholi, ubudlelwano bezabasebenzi, indawo yokusebenza, imisebenzi yesigaba, ukusebenza ngaphezu kokuhambisana, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamakhanda.
Uxhumana namalungu omndeni noma abangane eNingizimu Afrika egameni labantu baseMzansi abakwizinye izwe uma kukhona udaba oluthile. Ukuxhumana nezikhulu zendawo ukuze sithole usizo lokuthola abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abakwizinye izwe. Lokhu akuhlanganisi labo abafunwa ngenxa yezono abenze, abatholakala befuna ukujolwa. Ukusiza imindeni ngokwenza uqiniseke ukuthi imali abayithumelayo ifika kulabo abahluphekayo kwezinye izwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso kanye nezinsiza kubantu abathola sebephakathi kwezimo zokuphanga. Uhlobo lwezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo kanye nokuvikelwa kwezisebenzi zik gouvernement kungavimbela ukuphendula kwethu okuphuthumayo ukusiza. Sihlanganyela nemindeni yalezi zinsizwa eziboshwe kwezinye izwe uma sicelwa ukwenza kanjalo. Siqinisekisa ukuthi imali abayithumelayo ifika kulabo abashiywe kwezinye izwe, ngenkathi sihlonipha imithetho yalezo zizwe, kanye nemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nezimali ezithunyelwa phesheya. Siqinisekisa ukuthi izincwadi abazihambisayo, kanye nemithi abayithumelayo, ifika kulabo abahluphekayo kwezinye izwe. Lokhu sikwenza ngokuhambisana nemithetho yephalamende yezangaphandle kanye nezindleko ezifanele uma sithumela izinto phesheya, ngenkathi sihlonipha imithetho yezwe eliboshwe lezi zinsizwa. Izindleko ezithintekayo uma sithumela izinto phesheya zingabuyekezwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukusiza ekuthumeleni imibhalo esemthethweni kubaboshwe kwezinye izwe ngokulandela izinqubo zethu zenkantolo. Ukusiza uma abanye bethumela izicelo zokuthi ummangalelwa athunyelwe ezweni labo ukuze abhekane nezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuye, noma uma becela ulwazi oluthile mayelana nezimangalelo ezihilela abantu bethu kwezinye izwe, kanye nokushintshisana ngemithetho ethile ukusuka ezweni elilodwa ukuya kwelinye, ngokuhambisana nezinsiza ezidingekayo ngokulandela izinqubo zethu zenkantolo. Siphinde sithumele izitifiketi kanye nemibhalo ethile esemthethweni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela zikhona ezivela kuhulumeni. Sihlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuvikela ubugebengu ngezindlela ezahlukene ngaphandle kokuxhaswa kwezezimali. Sinikeza izeluleko, ubuholi, kanye nosizo kubazali abathola sebephakathi kwesimo esinzima sokuthi izingane zabo zithathwe ngamandla ngomunye wabazali bezingane abahamba nazo ziye kwezinye izwe ngokubambisana nehhovisi lemmeli yomndeni. Uma kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi impilo nokuphepha kwezingane zikhona engozini, le ndaba ibhekwa njengokuphuthumayo. Sinikeza uhlu lwemaleli kule ndawo. Singakunika imali encane yokuphuthuma. Sazisa imindeni uma othile eshonile kwezinye izwe, noma ebanjwe yisifo esinzima noma elimele. Sihlinzeka ngosizo kanye nezinsiza mayelana nezinsalela zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abashona phesheya, kodwa asihlinzeki ngosizo lwezezimali. Sifuna izikhulu zendawo zihlolisise uma umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika eshona ngaphansi kwezimo eziphawulekayo noma ebulawa. Sinikeza ubuholi kanye nezinsiza uma abantu befuna ukuthatha izingane ezingenamzali ngokubambisana nomnyango wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Sihlinzeka ngosizo kanye nobuholi kubantu bangaphandle mayelana nabantu babo eNingizimu Afrika. Siyasiza labo abafuna ulwazi noma sibakhombise ukuthi baphumephi ukuze bathole usizo abaludingayo. Yiziphi izinsizakalo noma usizo esingakwazi ukungahlinzeka njengabamele kuhulumeni? Asihlanganyeli ezindabeni zomthetho, asingangeni ezinqubweni zenkantolo zamanye amazwe, asihlinzeki ngeluleko lezomthetho, asingaphazamisi noma siqale izinqubo zenkantolo, asiceli izikhulu zendawo ukuba ziphathe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngendlela ethile, asihlanganisi nezinkinga zobugebengu noma izifo kwezinye izwe, asihlanganisi nezinkinga zobugebengu kwezinye izwe, asikhokhi izindleko zokubuyisela izinsalela, futhi asisizi ngokuhamba kwezinsalela zibuye eNingizimu Afrika, asithathi umthwalo wengane ethunjwe ngaphansi komthetho waseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuthi ingane kufanele ibekwe kuphi enkantolo, futhi asiceli inkantolo kwezinye izwe ukuba ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi ingane kufanele ibekwe kuphi, asikhokhi izindleko zehhotela, izimali zabeli, noma ezinye izindleko, asikhokhi izindleko zokuhamba ukuze sithumele noma izindiza, futhi asihlele indawo yokuhlala, umsebenzi, noma sithole umsebenzi, asigcini impahla noma sithole izinto ezilahlekile, asamukeli imiyalezo yakho, asihlinzeki ngezinsiza zakho zokuthola umhlalaphansi noma izabelo ezithile, asisizi abantu abanguye abavela ezweni elilodwa kwelinye. Xhumana ne-embassy yelizwe eliseduze nawe, noma ihhovisi leMenenja Jikelele, umnyango wezokuhweba emnyangweni wezangaphandle edolobheni elikhulu. Kuzoncika ohlotsheni losizo oludingayo, futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi ubonise ubunikazi bakho bokusebenza; uma ungathandeki, shayela ukuze ubuze. I-embassy isebenza amahora angama-24 ngosuku, izinsuku eziyi-7 ngesonto, kuhlanganise nezimpelasonto nezinsuku zokugcina, usizo lunikezwa ngokubambisana nehhovisi losizo lomnyango edolobheni elikhulu.
Ukuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezizathu Nezixazululo Isingeniso Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi, okwaziwa ngesiNgisi njengokuthi "unemployment," kuyinkinga enkulu ebanzi emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi emazweni angathuthukile. Le nkinga ibhekene nezici eziningi ezithinta umnotho, umphakathi, nezombusazwe. Ukuhlola izizathu zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi kubalulekile ukuze siqonde izixazululo ezitholakala ukuze siphendule lo mkhuba. Kulo mbhalo, sizobheka izizathu ezihlukahlukene zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, izimpempe ezithinta abathintekayo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Izizathu Zokuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi Ekuhlaziyweni kwempilo yomsebenzi, izizathu zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi zingahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningana. Okokuqala, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kungavela ngenxa yokushoda kwemathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi emhlabeni wanamuhla, izimboni eziningi ziye zashintsha, ziye zaphuma emsebenzini wezemisebenzi eziningi ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe. Izinkampani zifuna ukunciphisa izindleko, okwenza kube nokuncipha kwamathuba okusebenza, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi ezidinga ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Okwesibili, izizathu zezomnotho nazo zibalulekile ekuntulekeni kwemisebenzi. Izimo zomnotho ezingezinhle, ezifana nezinga lokukhula eliphansi, ukuncipha komkhiqizo, kanye nokukhululeka kwemali, kungenza kube nzima kunezinkampani ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi. Lokhu kudala umthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, njengoba abantu abaningi behluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanele, okukhombisa ukuntula kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izici zomphakathi nazo zidlala indima ebalulekile. Ukuhlukaniswa kwempilo yomphakathi, ukuhlupheka, kanye nezinga lokufunda eliphansi kuholela ekutheni abantu bangakwazi ukungena emsebenzini. Ukuhlupheka kungenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uthuthukise amakhono, okwandisa ubunzima bokuthola umsebenzi. Lokhu kudala isithombe esinzima, lapho abantu abaningi behluleka ukufinyelela emathubeni alungile. Imiphumela Yokuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi akukwazi ukubhekwa njengemphumela nje kuphela, kodwa kuholela emiphumeleni eminingi engathandeki. Okokuqala, kubangela ukwanda kokuhlupheka, njengoba abantu abaningi behluleka ukuthola imali yokuphila. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka emphakathini, okungase kubangele ukwehla kwempilo yomphakathi. Ukuntuleka kwemali yokuthola, kubangela ukuncipha kokuthenga, okukhawulela ukukhula komnotho. Okwesibili, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yomuntu. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokucindezeleka, ukuphazamiseka kwempilo yengqondo, kanye nezinkinga zokwelapha. Abantu abahlala bengekho emsebenzini bavame ukuzizwa bephansi, okukhulisa izinkinga zengqondo, okungabangela ukucindezeleka nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kubangela imiphumela emibi ezimpilweni zabo kanye nasezimfundisweni zabo, kuthinta umphakathi wonke. Izixazululo Zokuntuleka Kwezemisebenzi Ukuze kuphumelele ekwehliseni izinga lokuntuleka kwemisebenzi, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithintekayo. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono zibalulekile. Ukuphucula imfundo kanye nezifundo ezihambisana nezimboni kunikeza abantu amathuba okuthola imisebenzi engcono. Izinhlelo zokufundisa abantu amakhono amasha, ezifana nezobuchwepheshe, zingasiza ekwandiseni amathuba omsebenzi. Okwesibili, izinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo zingasiza ekuhlinzekeni ngokuqhubekayo amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kusebenza kahle uma izinkampani zenza izinhlelo zokufaka abantu abasezingeni eliphezulu emisebenzini ethile, okwenza kube nokukhula kwemisebenzi. Abaholi bamasipala bangase benze izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umnotho walendawo, okuholela ekwandeni kwamathuba omsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni ungakha izinhlelo zokusekela abavela ezimweni ezinzima. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokwelashwa kwabantu abathintekayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokufundisa. Isiphetho Ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kuyinkinga enkulu ethinta wonke umuntu emhlabeni jikelele. Izizathu zakhona zihluke kakhulu, zihlala zixhunyaniswa nezimo zomnotho, ezomphakathi, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Ukuze siphendule le nkinga, kudingeka izixazululo ezihlukahlukene ezithinta abantu abahlukene. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, ohulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi kubalulekile ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi, okuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sihlose ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi, ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphelele zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi.
Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu komasipala 1. Isingeniso I-Eskom iyinhlangano ehlinzeka ngogesi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukuze iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kubalulekile ukuthi iqoqe izikweletu ezikhokhwayo kumasipala. Le dokhumenti ibonisa izinyathelo ezisemqoka ezizothathwa ukuze kuqoqwe izikweletu kumasipala, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathengi bayakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo. 2. Inhloso Inhloso yale dokhumenti iwukuchaza izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqoqwe izikweletu kumasipala, kuhlanganise nezinyathelo zokuxhumana, ukuhlela, nokuphatha izikweletu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza, ukunciphisa izikweletu ezingakhokhiwe, nokwandisa imali engenayo ye-Eskom. 3. Izinyathelo Zokuhlela 3.1 Ukuhlonza Izikweletu - Qala ngokuhlola uhlu lwezikweletu ezikhokhwayo kumasipala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikweletu ezikhokhwayo ezivela kumakhasimende ahlukene, izikhungo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlobene. - Bheka izikhathi zokukhokha ezihlukene, ukuze uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izikweletu ezidinga ukunakwa okuphuthumayo. 3.2 Ukuxhumana Nabasizi - Thumela izaziso kumasipala mayelana nezikweletu ezikhokhwayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya izincwadi, ama-imeyili, noma izikhangiso ezisemphakathini. - Qinisekisa ukuthi abathengi banolwazi olunembile mayelana nezikweletu zabo, izinsuku zokukhokha, kanye nezinyathelo ezizothathwa uma izikweletu zingakhokhwa. 4. Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izikweletu 4.1 Ukuqoqwa Kwezikweletu - Hlela imihlangano yokuhlanganyela nabaphathi bamakhaya ukuze baxoxisane ngezindlela zokukhokha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezikweletu. - Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe ukuze uqoqe izikweletu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izikweletu, ukulandela izinkokhelo, nokubika izimo ezithile. 4.2 Ukuqinisekisa Ukukhokha - Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkokhelo ezitholakele ziqinisekiswa ngokushesha. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezitholakalayo. - Bheka izikweletu ezingakhokhiwe njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abathengi bayakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo. 5. Izinyathelo Zokuxazulula Izinkinga 5.1 Ukuxhumana Nabathengi - Uma umthengi engakhokhi, thumela izaziso ezisemthethweni. Lokhu kuzobavusa ukuthi bakhokhe izikweletu zabo. - Hlela imihlangano yokuxoxisana nabathengi ukuze baxazulule izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezihlangene. 5.2 Ukusebenzisa Izinyathelo Zomthetho - Uma izikweletu zingakhokhwa, sebenzisa izinyathelo zomthetho ezisemthethweni ukuze uqoqe izikweletu. Lokhu kuzobandakanya ukufaka izicelo enkantolo ukuze uthole imvume yokubuyisa izikweletu. - Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinyathelo zomthetho zilandela imithetho nemigomo efanele. 6. Ukuhlola Nokubika 6.1 Ukuhlola Izinyathelo Zokuhlela - Hlela ukuhlola njalo izinqubo zokuhlela ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. - Bheka izibalo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ukuze uqonde ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa kanjani. 6.2 Ukubika Imiphumela - Bhala imibiko ethile mayelana nezikweletu ezikhokhwa kumasipala. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane kubaphathi be-Eskom. - Thumela imibiko kumasipala ukuze bazi ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa kanjani, nokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqoqwe izikweletu ezingakhokhiwe. 7. Isiphetho Icebo lakwa-Eskom lokuqoqa izikweletu kumasipala libalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zikhona ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, i-Eskom izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngogesi ngendlela efanele, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi izikweletu zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uphumelele.
UMnyango Wokuhumusha Nokuhlela WeNkonzo YeziLimba Zesizwe (NLS) uhlukaniswe ngezigaba zezilimi ezilandelayo: Afrikaans, IsiNgisi, Izilimi Zangaphandle, IsiZulu, IsiXhosa, IsiNdebele, IsiSepedi, IsiSesotho, IsiSetswana, IsiSwati, IsiTshivenda, neIsiXitsonga. Uhulumeni omusha uhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seMthethosisekelo, uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi "uHulumeni WaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nohulumeni bezifunda basebenzisa noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni ngezizathu zohulumeni, kubhekwa ukusetshenziswa, ukufinyeleleka, izindleko, nesimo sezifunda kanye nezinye izintandokazi zabantu." Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala indawo lapho iminyango kahulumeni ixhumana kahle, phakathi kwezinye izinto, nabo bonke amalungu omphakathi ngezilimi zabo ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. INkonzo YeziLimba Zesizwe (NLS) isebenza njengengqalasizinda yokweseka ulimi kwezobuchwepheshe kuhulumeni. Kukhona uhlelo lokuthola ulwazi ngocingo. Izinhlobo zemibhalo ehunyushwayo ikakhulukazi zifaka phakathi lezo eziqondiswe emphakathini, ezifana namaphepha amhlophe, amaphepha aluhlaza, umthetho ophakanyisiwe owashicilelwa ukuze uthole imibono yomphakathi, izaziso zikahulumeni, imithetho, imibiko yonyaka yeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni, imibiko yeziKomidi nemikhandlu, izivumelwano zomhlaba, izinkulumo zomongameli, izinkulumo zabaminisitiri, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikahulumeni, imibhalo yezinkontileka, amaphepha alwazi nezikhangiso, ulwazi lwezindaba, njll. Uma umbhalo kufanele uhunyushwe ube ngezilimi ezingaphezu kweyodwa, kuyasiza ukuhlela ngaphambi kokuhumusha ukuze kugcinwe umoya nobungako bawo. Umbhalo ohuqhuqhiwe uqhathaniswa nomthombo ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa nendawo yolimi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukubhalwa ngokucophelela nokuphelele kombhalo, kanye nokuhlelwa kahle kwemibhalo yezomthetho nezaziso zikahulumeni, njll. Iminyango esebenzisana nohulumeni, izinhlangano, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ithola izinsizakalo zeNkonzo YeziLimba Zangaphandle, futhi zisebenza ngemibhalo efana nezivumelwano zomhlaba, imibiko yeDivayisi yeInterpol, izincwadi ezibhaliwe ngababhalisile, njll. Uhlelo lwocingo lunikezwa ukuze kuqedwe ngokushesha izinselelo zokusebenzisa, ukupela, nokufaka lezi zilimi ezisemthethweni ngochwepheshe bezilimi bomnyango abaphatha lezo zinkinga. Lapho kudingeka, ucwaningo lwenziwa. Nokho, akukho ukuhumusha okuzokwenziwa ngocingo. Uma kubonakala ukuthi umsebenzi okhona uphuthumayo futhi unomthamo omkhulu futhi isikhathi esidingekayo siseduze, ngeke silinde ochwepheshe abasebenza kuMnyango Wezilimi; kuzothunyelwa ngaphandle ukuze kwenziwe ngokushesha. Umthamo omkhulu womsebenzi ovela kwiDivayisi YeziLimba Zangaphandle uthunyelwe ngaphandle kubachwepheshe bangaphandle njengoba isidingo eNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe siqhubeka sikhula ngokushesha. Ngokuhambisana nezigaba 3, 6, kanye no-31 weMthethosisekelo, izinsizakalo zokuhumusha nokuhlela zeNLS zisiza uHulumeni ekufezeni izibopho zawo kubantu ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo. Abathengi abakhulu balolu mnyango wokuhumusha nokuhlela yizinyango zikahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni ezinomsebenzi nezinyanga zikahulumeni. Kukhona iminyango kahulumeni enezinsizakalo zayo zezilimi, futhi ihumusha yona, njengeMnyango Wezokulungisa, iMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanye neSevisi yePolisa. Nokho, iNLS isiza lezi zinyango uma zikhathazekile ngomsebenzi noma uma kudingeka ubuchwepheshe obuthile, njengokuthi uma kukhona imibhalo edinga ukuhunyushwa ezilimini zangaphandle noma ukususwa ezilimini zangaphandle. Ezinye izifunda zinezinsizakalo zazo zezilimi, kodwa zibuye zifune usizo kuNLS uma kudingeka. I-NLS ingancoma izifunda ngababhalisi abathembekile bezilimi ezithile abangazisebenzisa. Ukuze kusebenze ngendlela ezokhiqiza imiphumela esezingeni eliphezulu nephumelelayo, ihhovisi lezilimi kumele libe nokuqonda ngezidingo zalo ukuze abahumushi nabahleli bakwazi ukugxila emsebenzini wabo ngenkathi abasebenzi behhovisi besiza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Umbhalo kanye nomdwebo kulandela indlela futhi kudlula ezigabeni ezithile, ezinye zazo zingase zibe zokuphatha kanti ezinye zixhumene nokuhumusha nokuhlela. a. Umbhalo utholwa kuRegistry bese kufakwa uphawu ekhasini langaphandle okukhombisa usuku owatholwe ngalo futhi uthunyelwa kumqondisi walowo Mnyango ukuze processing kanye nesinqumo sokuthi kufanele usebenze. b. Uma umbhalo kufanele uhunyushwe ube ngezilimi ezisemthethweni ezingaphezu kweyodwa, labo abaphethe umsebenzi wehhovisi benza amakhophi ezilimi lapho kucelwa khona ukuhunyushwa. c. Amakhophi athunyelwa kumaphoyisa alezo zigaba zezilimi ezidingekayo ukuze kuhunyushwe lowo mbhalo. d. Umqondisi waleyo zigaba yezilimi ubuyekeza umbhalo, uxhumana nabanye, bese ethatha isinqumo sokuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle. e. Umbhalo uthunyelwa kubabhalisi noma kumuntu osebenza ezilimini ogcina incwadi yokurekhoda lapho bezobhala khona zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo ezifana nosuku umbhalo utholiwe, inani lamakhasi, igama leMnyango elivela noma umthengi, kanye nalowo ozokwenza umsebenzi wokuhumusha noma wokuhlela. f. Umbhalo uthathwa umgibeli we-rekhodi bese uthunyelwa kumuntu ozosebenza kuwo, futhi uma kufanele uthunyelwe ngaphandle, uthunyelwa kumqondisi ukuze uthole imvume yokuthi umbhalo uthunyelwe ngaphandle. g. Ngemuva kokuthola le mvume, umbhalo uthunyelwa ehhovisi lokuphatha ukuze unikezwe inombolo efanele bese uthunyelwa kumhumushi wangaphandle, ozobe esekwenze amalungiselelo ngaphambi kokukhuluma njengoba kushiwo emgqeni (d) ngenhla. Umuntu osebenza ehhovisi lokuphatha wenza amakhophi emsebenzini ohunyushiwe futhi uthumele eyodwa kumthengi kanti enye iya esigabeni lapho umsebenzi ophelile ugcinwa khona, bese kuthi incwadi ecela ukukhokhwa kumhumushi ibhekelelwe ukuze kulungiselelwe lokho okufanele kubo. Ngokulandela le nqubo, umsebenzi wehhovisi lezilimi wenziwa ngendlela ehlelekile kakhulu ngoba isinyathelo ngasinye esithathwa ngombhalo siyaziwa njengoba kubhalwa. Ngaso sonke isikhathi, izikhathi ezahlukene kumele zilandelwe ukuze kuhunyushwe imibhalo yezinyanga ezidingekayo ngaphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezingama-20 nezilimi ezahlukene zangaphandle, okuy umsebenzi onzima, kodwa kwenziwa kube lula ngosizo nolwazi lehhovisi lezilimi. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi ezivela, amalungu eNLS azinikele ekukhiqizeni umsebenzi osezingeni eliphezulu. Kulokhu, kuvamile ukuthi basebenze ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile noma uma becelwa ukuthi benze kanjalo noma uma kudingeka ukuthi benze kanjalo. Abathengi balolu mnyango bababheka njengomthombo wokuba khona kwehhovisi lezilimi labo. Njengoba laba bathengi bengabalingani, njengabanye bonke abasebenza kuhulumeni
Abesifazane benza ingxenye enkulu yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, yingakho izwi labesifazane kufanele lifakwe ezinqumweni nasekudalweni kwemithetho. Lokhu kufakwa kwabesifazane ezinqumweni kuyilungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Abesifazane kumele babambe iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngoba ukwenziwa kwemithetho nemigomo yohulumeni kuthinta impilo yabo nsuku zonke. Kubalulekile, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi lapho abesifazane bebamba iqhaza ezinqumweni, kuholela ekutheni kube nokunakwa okwengeziwe nokwabiwa kwezinsiza okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu. Ukwanda kokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho kungaholela ekutholeni kalula kwezinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. UMsunguli waseNingizimu Afrika uthi umphakathi kumele wazi futhi ubambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende nasemigomeni yalo. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Abesifazane bangabamba iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngokuvota iqembu lezepolitiki abakholelwa ukuthi lizomela kangcono imibono nezinkathazo zabo kwiPhalamende. Bangaphinde babambe iqhaza ekuhlela nasekusebenzeni kweqembu abakhethe. Abesifazane baphumelele ezikhundleni eziphezulu ngalendlela. Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuwukuthi umphakathi unentshisekelo yokuzwa ngendaba ethile, iKomidi leNdlu Yezinhlaka noma iBhodi Yezifunda lingase lenze izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze iziphakamiso. Umphakathi ungazisa iKomidi leNdlu Yezinhlaka noma iBhodi Yezifunda ngemibono yabo ngezindaba eziphikisanayo. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana neMenenja yePhalamende ukuze aveze umbono wabo ngengxenye ethile yemithetho. UMsunguli waseNingizimu Afrika uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhuthaza ukuvumelana kwezobulili nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho. UMsunguli uqukethe izinhlinzeko ezithuthukisa ukuvumelana kwezobulili. IBill of Rights iqinisekisa ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika. Ibanqanda ukwehlukaniswa okungadingekile ngokobuhlanga nangobulili. IBill of Rights igcizelela ukuthi izinyathelo kumele zithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kokulingana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. UMsunguli uhlinzeka ngezikhungo ezisekela ukuveza kwabantu abaningi nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane. Lezi zikhungo zifaka iKomidi Lokulingana Kwezinhlanga kanye neKomidi Lezobulungiswa Lwabasebenzi BaseNingizimu Afrika. Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuthi abesifazane babambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende ngesikhathi sokhetho. Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweNdlu Yezinhlaka kanye neBhodi Yezifunda. Ukhetho lwezizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abalikhethayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi ibeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa. Umnyango omusha wabesifazane, izingane, nabantu abanokukhubazeka usunguliwe ukuze uqinise imizamo kahulumeni yokukhuthaza nokuvikela abantu abahluphekayo emphakathini wethu. Nakuba abesifazane beningi emiphakathini yaseNingizimu Afrika, bahlala bengabantu abancane uma kuziwa ezinqumweni. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezivimbela abesifazane ukuba badlale indima ephelele nefanele, futhi eyodwa enkulu yalezi ubumpofu. Ubumfucu buwumsebenzi obhekene nabesifazane abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane basemaphandleni. Ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile ezifana nemfundo, amanzi, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kuvinjwa ubulili, ubuhlanga, nezifundo. Ukuze abesifazane bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ngokuphelele ekudalweni kwemithetho, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile kwabesifazane kumele kuthuthukiswe. Abesifazane abampofu banokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ezikhungweni zokudala imithetho. Abaningi babesifazane babhekene nezinselelo zokukhulisa umnotho. Abesifazane ngokujwayelekile bangumphakathi ongenamathuba kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi bangase babe ngaphansi kokusebenza noma bangenamsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS luthinta kakhulu ingxenye enkulu yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasha eminyakeni yabo yokubeletha.
Chaza ngokubekezela ukuthi ungawuhlola kanjani umphumela wezimpilo zamehlo, ubonisa kahle ezithombeni ezilandelayo umphumela noma umphumela wokulimala mayelana nesimo samanje samehlo. Ukulahlekelwa ukubona kufanele kubikwe ngokugcwalisa izithombe 7, 8, no-9 (ngemuva). Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kudingeka amehlo ngenxa yomphumela oqondile wokulimala? Uma isimo sokubona sithuthuka ngenxa yokulungiswa, kodwa ungazange unqume ngamehlo, sicela ukhombise izizathu. Ingabe kukhona ukuhlinzwa okwenzekile? Uma kunjalo, chaza isimo nemiphumela? a. Kusukela ngosuku luni umqashi ulungile ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe ejwayelekile? b. Yisiphi usuku okukhombisa ukuthi akasakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe ejwayelekile? Ingabe kukhona ukulahlekelwa ukubona kulolu hlelo Yebo/Cha? Uma kunjalo, chaza iphesenti yokulahlekelwa kwamehlo ngamunye. R L? Ingabe kukhona ukulahlekelwa kokunyakaza kwamehlo? i-diplopia ngaphakathi kwe-20 percent yokubona. i-diplopia ngaphandle kwe-20 percent yokubona. i-diplopia ngaphandle kwe-20 percent yokubona kodwa ubheke phansi.
Ingxoxo: Umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kwezohwebo Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngibe lapha namhlanje. Ngithanda ukuxoxa ngendaba ethokozisayo yokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini, kanye nomthelela wayo kwezohwebo. Ngabe ungazichaza izinzuzo ezitholakala ngenxa yokuminyana kwedolobha? Umphenyi: Sanibonani! Ngiyabonga ngokungibiza. Ukuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini kunemiphumela eminingi emihle kwezohwebo. Okokuqala, kukhula amathuba okuthengisa. Uma abantu behlala edolobheni, izitolo nezinkampani ziba nekhono lokukhulisa ukuthengisa kwazo. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kahle. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungawuthinta kanjani umnotho wendawo? Umphenyi: Impela. Umnotho wendawo uthola amandla lapho abantu abaningi behlala edolobheni. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, njengoba izinkampani zidinga abasebenzi abaningi ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umnotho wendawo uthola ukwesekwa okuhle, njengoba izinkampani zikhula futhi zikhuthaza ukutshalwa kwezimali. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umnotho wendawo uthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Kodwa-ke, ngabe kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuminyana? Umphenyi: Yebo, zikhona nezinselelo. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu yikhono lokuphatha izinsiza. Uma abantu behlala ndawonye, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele, njengamanzi, ugesi, nezokuthutha. Uma lezi zinsiza zingekho, kungaholela ekudumazekeni kwezohwebo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umnotho ungase ube nezinselelo zokuncintisana, njengoba izinkampani eziningi zifuna ukwanelisa izidingo zabathengi. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe umthelela wokuminyana ungathinta kanjani izimakethe ezahlukene? Umphenyi: Umthelela wokuminyana ungathinta izimakethe ezahlukene ngendlela ehlukile. Ngokwesibonelo, izimakethe ezincane zingazuza kakhulu, njengoba abantu abaningi befuna izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezithile. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokukhula kwezohwebo ezincane. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimakethe ezinkulu zingase zibe nezinselelo zokuncintisana, njengoba izinkampani ezinkulu zifuna ukuthola izabelo ezinkulu emakethe. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungaba nezinselelo ezahlukene. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi izinkampani zingazithuthukisa kanjani ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle? Umphenyi: Izinkampani zingazithuthukisa ngezindlela eziningi. Okokuqala, kufanele ziqonde izidingo zabathengi. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza ucwaningo lwemakethe ukuze zazi ukuthi yini efunwa kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani kufanele zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo nezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ngabe kukhona izibonelo ezithile zokuthi ubuchwepheshe buphumelele kanjani ekuthuthukiseni izinkampani? Umphenyi: Yebo, kunezibonelo eziningi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinkampani ezisebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhamba zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisheshayo kubathengi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokwaneliseka kwabathengi, okwenza kube lula ukuheha abasha. Futhi, izinkampani ezisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ubudlelwano bamakhasimende (CRM) zikwazi ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nabathengi bazo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba nomthelela omuhle. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ungathinta kanjani izinkampani ezincane? Umphenyi: Umthelela wokuminyana ungaba nomthelela omuhle ezinkampanini ezincane. Njengoba abantu behlala edolobheni, izinkampani ezincane ziba nekhono lokukhula. Lokhu kudala amathuba okukhula, njengoba izinkampani zingakwazi ukuheha abathengi abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ezincane zingase zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa. Ngabe unazo iziphetho noma izeluleko zokugcina? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga. Ngiyafisa ukusho ukuthi umthelela wokuminyana ethekwini laseThekwini ungaba yithuba elikhulu kwezohwebo, kodwa kudingeka ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde izidingo zabathengi futhi zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abathengi futhi kuqinise umnotho wendawo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zihloko zibalulekile. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela nathi namuhla. Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha.
Izinkinga Zemfundo: Izinyathelo Zokubhekana Nazo Emhlabeni wanamuhla, imfundo ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Nokho, imfundo ibhekene nezinkinga eziningi ezidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokufunda. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinkinga ezinkulu zemfundo kanye nezinyathelo ezithile zokubhekana nazo. Isigaba 1: Ukuhlonza Izinkinga Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuhlonza izinkinga ezithinta imfundo. Lokhu kungabandakanya: 1. Ukuntuleka Kwezinsiza: Izikole eziningi zihlupheka ngokuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele, njengezincwadi, amathuluzi okusebenza, nezikhungo zokufunda. Lokhu kudala ubunzima kubafundi ukufinyelela ulwazi oludingekayo. 2. Izinga Lokufundisa: Abafundisi abahlangabezani nezidingo ezanele zokuqeqeshwa, okuholela ekutheni abafundi bangatholi ukufundiswa okufanele. 3. Ukungalingani Kwezokufunda: Abafundi abavela emiphakathini ehlukene bahlushwa ukungalingani ngenxa yezimo zomnotho, izinkinga zomndeni, kanye nezimo zempilo. 4. Ukwanda Kwezimfuno: Njengoba izidingo zomsebenzi zishintsha, imfundo kufanele ilungiswe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zamanje, kudinga izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe nezifundo ezihambisana nezimfuno zomsebenzi. Isigaba 2: Ukubheka Izixazululo Ngemva kokuhlonza izinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Nazi izinyathelo ezithile ezingathathwa: 1. Ukuthuthukisa Izinsiza: Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele, kungafaka ukufaka izinhlelo zokuxhaswa, ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali, noma ukwakha ubudlelwano nezinkampani. 2. Ukuqeqesha Abafundisi: Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lokufundisa, kubalulekile ukuqeqesha abafundisi ngama-programmes okuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. 3. Ukwenza Imfundo Ibe Ngenxa Yomphakathi: Imfundo kufanele ibandakanye umphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abafundi bayathola ithuba lokufunda. 4. Ukuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokufunda: Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zokufunda zihlala zisesikhathini, zihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi. Isigaba 3: Ukubeka Phambili Ubufakazi Ukuze izinyathelo ezithathwayo zibe neqhaza, kubalulekile ukubeka phambili ubufakazi bokuthi izinguquko zisebenza. Lokhu kungafaka: 1. Ukubheka Imiphumela: Izikole kufanele zihlaziye imiphumela yokufunda ukuze ziqonde ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zisebenza yini. 2. Ukwabelana Ngolwazi: Ukuze kube nokwabelana ngempumelelo, izikole kufanele zabelane ngolwazi ngezindlela ezisebenzayo zokufundisa. 3. Ukwamukela Izimvo: Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zamukele izimvo ezivela kubafundi, abazali, kanye nomphakathi. Isigaba 4: Ukugcina Uxhumano Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukugcina uxhumano phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo, umphakathi, kanye nohulumeni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola uxhaso nezinsiza. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganyela: 1. Ubudlelwano Nezinkampani: Izikole zingasebenza ndawonye nezinkampani ukuze zithole uxhaso lwezimali nezinsiza. 2. Ubudlelwano Nomphakathi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfundo ithuthukiswa, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezibandakanya umphakathi. 3. Ubudlelwano NoHulumeni: Ukuze kutholakale uxhaso lwezimali, izikole kufanele zibe nezinhlaka ezihlanganyela nohulumeni. Isiphetho Izinkinga zemfundo zidinga ukuxazululwa ngokubambisana. Ngokuhlonza izinkinga, ukuthola izixazululo, ukubeka phambili ubufakazi, nokugcina uxhumano, singakwazi ukwakha imfundo engcono, ethuthukisa abafundi, umphakathi, kanye nezwe. Imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise le ndawo ebalulekile.
UJacob Zuma: Ukuhlola Umthelela Nokuphikiswa UJacob Zuma, owayengumengameli weNingizimu Afrika, ungomunye wabantu abaphawulekayo emlandweni wezombusazwe kuleli. Ukuphila kwakhe, izinqumo zakhe, kanye nezinkinga abhekane nazo, ziye zaba yizihloko ezivusa impikiswano enkulu phakathi kwabantu abaningi. Kulesi sikhathi, sizobheka izici ezihlukahlukene zempilo kaZuma, umthelela wakhe ezombusazwe, kanye nezimpikiswano ezivela ngaye. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uZuma wayenendawo ebalulekile emlandweni wezombusazwe waseNingizimu Afrika. Wazalwa ngo-1942 eNkandla, eKwaZulu-Natal, wakhula ezimweni ezinzima, kodwa waba nesibopho sokuba ngumholi weqembu le-ANC (African National Congress). Ukuphikiswa kwezakhamuzi eziningi, okuhlanganisa nezinkulumo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, kwaholela ekutheni uZuma abukeke njengomholi ophikisiwe, kodwa futhi ophumelelayo. Ukhetho lwakhe njengoMengameli ngo-2009 lwabhalela umlando omusha, kodwa lwavula iminyango eminingi yokuphikisana. Ngokubheka izinqumo ezithathwe nguZuma, kubalulekile ukuqonda imithelela ethile ezweni. UZuma waphakamisa izinhlelo eziningi ezazihlose ukuthuthukisa umnotho, njengezinhlelo zokwakha ezikoleni, izibhedlela, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza.
