Nokho, lezi zinhlelo ziye zaphikiswa kakhulu, njengoba abanye bekubona njengokungaphumeleli. Abaphikisi baveze ukuthi izinhlelo zikaZuma zazingekho ezinqubweni ezithuthukisayo, futhi izinsiza zomphakathi ziye zathinteka kakhulu ngenxa yokuphathwa okungafanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uZuma waphinde waba nezinselelo ezinkulu ezimweni zokuphatha. Ukuphikiswa kwakhe kokuqala kwavela ngesikhathi sezinxushunxushu zeNkandla, lapho abaphikisi baveza khona ukuthi uZuma wathola izinzuzo ezingekho emthethweni zokwakha indlu yakhe. Lokhu kwaholela ekubizweni kwezinsolo zokwephula umthetho, okwakuholela ekutheni kube nezinsuku eziningi zokuhlolwa kwezokuphepha. Lokhu kwavusa impikiswano enkulu phakathi kwezakhamuzi, abezindaba, kanye nezikhungo zomthetho. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, abalandeli bakaZuma baphikisa ukuthi izinsolo ezikhuluma ngaye ziwumqondo wokubandlulula, futhi zikhombisa ukungaboni ngaso linye kwezombusazwe. Baphinde baveze ukuthi uZuma ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuthi ungumholi ophikisiwe, futhi lokhu kwenza kube nzima kuye ukuphumelela. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impikiswano ngempilo kaZuma akukhona nje kuphela okukhuluma ngempumelelo noma ukuphumelela, kodwa futhi kubonisa izinselelo ezinzima abhekene nazo njengomholi. Kodwa-ke, impikiswano ayipheli lapho. UZuma ubhekene nezinsolo eziningi zokungathembeki, futhi lokhu kuhlobene nokugxekwa okukhulayo kokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kwaholela ekubizweni kwezinhlaka ezahlukene zokuhlola, kuhlanganise neKomidi Lezokuhlola, okwakuhlose ukuhlole izinsolo zokungathembeki. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izinqumo zikaZuma ziye zathinta kakhulu ukwethembeka kwemiphakathi, futhi zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni abantu bakholelwe yini ezikhungweni zomthetho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uZuma waba neqhaza elikhulu ekuphakamiseni izinkulumo ezahlukene ezithinta ubumbano lwezombusazwe. UZuma, njengomholi, ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi, kodwa futhi ubonise ukuthi ubumbano lungabhekwa ngendlela ehlukile. Abanye baphikisa ukuthi uZuma ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi ngenxa yokuthi ubheke izinqumo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubumbano lwezombusazwe alukho ezimweni ezinzima. Ekugcineni, uJacob Zuma ungumholi ophikisiwe, futhi impilo yakhe ibonisa izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nabaholi bezombusazwe. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezinsolo zokungathembeki, izinqumo ezithathwe, kanye neqhaza lakhe emlandweni wezombusazwe, konke lokhu kudala impikiswano enkulu. Lokhu kuhlola impilo kaZuma kubonisa ukuthi abaholi bahlala bephikisana nabantu, futhi lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuthi umphakathi uqonde kahle izinqumo ezithathwe. UZuma ungumfanekiso ophawulekayo wezinkinga ezibhekene nabaholi, futhi impikiswano ngaye izoqhubeka, njengoba izwe lihamba phambili.
Ukuphatha kahle ithuluzi lokutshala kungaholela ekukhiqizeni okukhulu noma ekuchithweni kwemali enkulu. Izinto ezibalulekile uma ufuna ukutshala zifaka: ukukhetha izinhlobo ezinhle zezinhlamvu, ukuzibeka kahle emhlabathini, ukuzifaka kahle emhlabathini, nokuzicindezela ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuthi kunezixhumanisi ezinhle phakathi kwezinhlamvu nomhlabathi. Uma ithuluzi lingasebenzi kahle ngenxa yokuphathwa kabi, ungase ungafinyeleli ekukhiqizeni okukhululekile. Ithuluzi lokutshala liyimishini eyenzelwe ukusebenza kahle, ngakho kufanele igcinwe ngokucophelela. Ake sibheke okumele sikwenze. Hlanza ithuluzi kahle kuzo zonke izindawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho izinto ezingaphandle ezingavimba izingxenye zethuluzi ekusebenzeni kahle. Bheka ukuthi izingxenye ezifana nomunwe ohlanganisa izinhlamvu aziphukile noma zibhujiswe; lungisa noma shintsha izingxenye ezidala. Bheka umoya noma ithuluzi elisebenza ngempahla; futhi qinisekisa ukuthi ama-seal awavuzi, ikakhulukazi uma usebenza idiskhi noma idrum. Qinisekisa ukuthi ingaphansi kwamapulazi ebhakede isaqinile. Shintsha izingxenye ezidala, ezifana nezinsimbi zokusika, ama-opener, ama-spring, kanye nepulazi eliphansi lebhakede - zonke izinto eziphukile nezibhujiswe. Bheka zonke izikhonkwane ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ziqinile; futhi qinisekisa ukuthi ama-hoses awavuzi uma usebenzisa umanyolo wamanzi. Uma izingxenye zemishini ezikhipha umanyolo owomisiwe noma ama-herbicides zifakwe ngophethiloli noma uwoyela uma ithuluzi lisetshenziswe, susa lowo mphethu. Ngesikhathi sokutshala, kufanele ubeke ithuluzi endaweni yokugcina noma ulifake ebusuku ukuze uvimbele umswakama ukuthi ungene emabhakede. Lubricate ithuluzi lokutshala njalo ngokuhambisana nesheduli ekhombisa kwincwadi yokusebenza. Sebenzisa amafutha afanele. Ukuze uvimbele umswakama ukuthi ungene ezindaweni zokuhlanza, hlambulula njalo ngaphambi kokuhlobisa. Phuma kuyo yonke imikhiqizo ethunyelwa emabhokisini omanyolo kanye nama-herbicide futhi uwashe. Futhi, hlanza amapulazi ngaphansi kwamabhakede abamba izinhlamvu ukuze uvimbele ukuvimbela nokugqokwa. Bheka ukuthi awekho izingxenye zemishini eziphukile noma zibhujiswe futhi uzishintshe ngaphambi kwesizini entsha yokutshala. Lubricate izinsimbi zokuvula nezindawo ezithambile ezixhumana nomhlabathi ngophethiloli noma uwoyela ukuze uvimbele ukuvimbela. Lubricate zonke izindawo zokuhlanza. Phakamisa izingxenye futhi uqinisekise, bese ubeka ithuluzi endaweni yokugcina. Phakamisa ithuluzi bese ulifaka ezisekelweni ukuze amakhanda angahlali emhlabathini. ISIXWAYISO: Ungabeki ithuluzi uma kusasele ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesilinda se-hydraulic. Ukuze unciphise ingcindezi ye-hydraulic, vala itrekta bese ushintsha ama-levers phambili naphambili. Bese ungaxhuma ama-hoses e-hydraulic bese ususa isilinda uma uthanda. Iziqondiso ze-tractor kanye neziqondiso zethuluzi ziqukethe imiyalezo yokuphepha. Lapha sizoxoxa ngengxenye yale miyalezo. Lezi ezilandelayo ziyiziqondiso ezijwayelekile zokusebenzisa ithuluzi ngendlela evimbela izingozi ezifana nezilonda. Njalo phakamisa ithuluzi emhlabathini uma lingasetshenziswa. Uma kungenzeka, zama ukususa ithuluzi noma nini lapho kudingeka izilungiso noma ukulungiswa. Njalo qinisekisa ukuthi ubeka izisekelo uma udinga ukusebenza ngaphansi kwethuluzi ukuze uvimbele ukuthi lingawela kuwe. Vumela umuntu oyedwa kuphela, umsebenzisi, ukuba ku-tractor uma itrekta kanye nethuluzi kusebenze. Ukuhlanza, ukuhlinzeka, nokulungisa ngenkathi imishini isebenza kungadala ingozi yokulimala. Ukuma nokuhamba phezu kwethuluzi ngenkathi isebenza kungase kube yingozi ngoba ungawa. Phatha amakhemikhali ezolimo ngokucophelela futhi ugqoke izigqoko zokuvikela. Ukusebenzisa izinhlobo ezingafanele zamakhemikhali kungabeka abantu, impahla, izitshalo, nomhlabathi engcupheni. Landela iziqondiso zalabo abakhiqize amakhemikhali.
iGrammy Awards: Ubuqhawe BeMculo Nobumnandi Bempilo Ngonyaka, umcimbi omuhle kakhulu emhlabeni wezokumculo, iGrammy Awards, ubuyela emakhaya ethu. Lezi zinkanyezi zomculo zajolisa amehlo ezinkulungwane zabathandi bomculo emhlabeni jikelele. Kodwa-ke, njengoba imicimbi eyahlukene ibhekana nezinguquko ezithokozisayo, ukusungulwa kweGrammy Awards kukhombisa into eyodwa ebalulekile: ukumangaliswa komculo awupheli, kodwa kunalokho, kuqhubeka nokuthokozisa, kusikhumbuza ukuthi imculo uyinselele, uyinkanyezi, futhi uyinsika yokuxhumana. Uma sikhuluma ngeGrammy Awards, asikho isimo sokudlala phansi. Lokhu akusona nje umcimbi wokuncoma, kodwa kungumcimbi ohlanganyela isiko, ubunjalo, nemizwa yokwakha. Ubani owayecabanga ukuthi imicimbi yokuhlola imiklomelo izoma kanjani? Kuye kwaba nezinguquko ezinkulu, kusukela ekukhulisweni kwemithombo, izigaba eziningi, kanye nabaculi abasha abavela kwezobuciko. Lokhu kuveza ukukhula okuqhubekayo kwezwe lomculo, okuthokozisa kakhulu. Kodwa-ke, njengoba lezi zinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokuhlonishwa, kudingeka ukuthi sibuye sihlole imiphumela yalesi sikhumbuzo. Imicimbi yeGrammy Awards isiyinsika ekulondolozweni kwamasiko nezilimi ezahlukene. Noma kunjalo, sithola nesithombe esingalungile, sokuthi izinto ezithile ziqhubeka zixhaswa, kanti ezinye imizamo iphucwa. Lokhu kungukuthi, abaculi abakhombisa ubuciko obuhle bagcina beshiywa emuva, mhlawumbe ngenxa yokunganakwa kwabahloli. Kungakuhle lokhu kuncishiswe, ukuze umbono wezobuciko ungabulawa. Izinselelo zifana nemizuzu eyinkimbinkimbi, lapho umculi ethola khona ithuba lokuziveza, athole ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ezihlupha umphakathi. Umcimbi awuzange ube yisigameko esingabhalile, kodwa kube yisikhumbuzo sokuba abaculi baphakeme. Ngaphandle kokubakhumbuza, abaculi badinga ithuba lokuvuma izifundo zeqiniso kanye nezifundo ezinzima. Sha, njengendoda yebhasi elinamandla, abaculi bandenqa umhlaba, begubha imiphakathi ngempumelelo. Isikhathi sishintsha, futhi kuxhaswe abaculi abasha abazokwenza umehluko. kodwa lokhu kudinga ukuba babe nethuba lokucelwa. Njengoba isiGodi seGrammy sikhula, izithombe zomculo kumele sibe nemisebenzi ehlukene ebonisa izinhlelo zomculo ezibalulekile. Manje, njengoba imicimbi yeGrammy ingenye yezinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni, kufanele sihlale siqaphela ukuthi abaculi namathalente amasha azitholele izikhala ezidingekayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, iGrammy Awards ibonisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuqinisekisa ukuthi umculo uhlala uthandwa. Leli qophelo liyisikhumbuzo sokuthi kumele sixhase ngezimali kanye nezinsiza ukuze kubangelwe umsebenzi omuhle. Akukhona nje ukugubha kodwa kukhona ukudlulisela umyalezo, ukubalisa izindaba ezithi uk-folder lenkululeko. Ngalolu hlobo, iGrammy Awards ibalunisile umhlaba wonke. Ekupheleni kosiko, kufanele siqonde umqondo wokuhlanganyela, lokhu kuhlanganyela kuveza abantu. Umculo kufanele ube umgibeli othokozisayo, ungumbhoro wokuzihlanganisa, nomhlaba bonke abaculi bebamanzi. Abazimisele ukucabanga ngezinto ezintsha, ubuciko bembula amakhono amaningi. Kakhulu njengoMculi, indlela yokungena kwemicabango ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umhlaba ufaneleka. Ngokuphetha, iGrammy Awards akusona nje umcimbi, kodwa kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umculo ungaphila, uhlanganise, futhi ubuyise ubuntu. Kulesi simo, sithokoze ngokuphawula nokubamba izinkanyezi zethu ngezimali ezdobekayo. Ake sibe nombono omusha futhi sikhuthaze ukudlulisela umyalezo omuhle emhlabeni wonke, umculo ufanele ukujabulisa, ube yisiteshi sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizombona umculo uhamba phambili, ufinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu, ube yinsika yokwakha umhlaba wakho ozohamba phambili.
Isithombe 1: USamuel Moloi (Umfuyi Wonyaka ngo-2009) uthole u-3.5 tons we-wheat ngehektare kulonyaka. Isithombe 2: USamuel Moloi uthola i-wheat. Emazweni amaningi emhlabeni, abantu babheka ubhontshisi njengokudla okuyisisekelo kunokuthi kube yinto yokunethezeka. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, bekunjalo; iminyaka eminingi, abafuyi babeveza i-wheat eyanele ukuze bagcine ubhontshisi ezitobheni zethu. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, abafuyi babhekana nezinselelo ngoba babebhekene nobunzima bokukhiqiza i-wheat futhi benze inzuzo - izindleko zokuqala zokufuya zaziphezulu kakhulu futhi amanani emakethe ayephansi kakhulu. Abafuyi bezamabhizinisi, njengabanye abathengisi, kudingeka benze inzuzo uma befuna ukuphumelela. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla kufanele zibe phansi kunezinga lemali emakethe lokudla. Nokho, eminyakeni yamuva, izindleko zokuqala zokufuya zikhuphukile kakhulu; imishini yokufuya, i-diesel, umanyolo, imbewu, amakhemikhali, umshwalense, ukusika, kanye nokuhamba konke kukhuphukile. Nokho, amanani emakethe ayephansi. Abafuyi njengamanje babhekana nezinselelo ngoba kubonakala ukuthi abakwazi ukutshala i-wheat. Lapha, ngizohlola ukukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni zokufuya ezingenamanzi. Lokhu kuhlukile ezindaweni zokufuya ezinomjikelezo. Ezindaweni zokufuya ezinomjikelezo, ukutshala kwenzeka kabili ngonyaka futhi abafuyi bayazi ukuthi bazothola umkhiqizo ophakeme. Inzuzo ethola ezindaweni zokufuya ezingenamanzi ivame ukuba phezulu kunezindawo zokufuya ezinomjikelezo. Kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi asikwazi ukujikeleza zonke izindawo zokufuya ngoba izwe lethu alinamanzi anele. Futhi asikwazi ukucabanga ukuthi abafuyi bezindawo ezingenamanzi baphila kalula; akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi basebenzisa ugesi ukuphumpa amanzi ezindaweni zabo zokufuya. Sonke siyazi ukuthi i-Eskom ifuna ukukhuphula amanani kagesi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kuzokhuphula izindleko zokukhiqiza, mhlawumbe kuvinjeze abanye abafuyi ekukhiqizeni ukudla. Kungani abafuyi besaqhubeka nokutshala i-wheat? Abafuyi baqala ukutshala i-wheat ebusika eMpumalanga Free State ngenkathi ye-1950. Ngaleso sikhathi, izindleko zaziphakathi kuka-0.5 tons ngehektare, futhi ngokufuya okuhlakaniphile, bavame ukuvuna ithoni ephelele. Lokhu kungabhekwa njengomkhiqizo omncane, kodwa khumbula ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi, lezi zaziyizimbewu ezikhethekile futhi akukho umanyolo owawufakwe. Kodwa abafuyi benze inzuzo. Ezindaweni eziningi zeFree State, umhlabathi ungagcina amanzi. Imvula yasehlobo nemp autumn igcina emhlabathini, futhi i-wheat isebenzisa leyo mansi kuze kube imvula yasehlobo ifika. Abafuyi bebelokhu betshala i-wheat iminyaka eminingi, futhi ama-oats angaphandle angena ezindaweni. Lokhu kwaba inkinga ngoba le plant ifana kakhulu ne-wheat, okwenza kube nzima ukuyibulala ngaphandle kokulimaza i-wheat uqobo. Abafuyi baphushwa ukuba bafune ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo ezifana ne-maize ne-barley ukuze baphinde bazitshale ne-wheat. Ukujikeleza izithelo zonyaka obandayo nezinyanga ezishisayo kwasebenza kahle. Ikakhulukazi kusize ukubulala amahlamvu. Ama-oats angaphandle akhula ebusika angabulawe ezindaweni ngaphambi kokutshala izithelo zonyaka obandayo. Futhi amahlamvu asehlobo angabulawe kalula ezindaweni ze-wheat ngoba lezi zinhlobo zamahlamvu zineziqu ezibanzi, okwenza kube lula ukufaka amakhemikhali. Abafuyi baqala ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokujikeleza izithelo - olunye lungabukeka kanje: i-wheat ne-wheat, bese kuba ne-maize ne-maize, i-barley, bese kuphinde kube i-wheat. Umfuyi ngamunye ulandela uhlelo lwabo oluthandayo. Ngezinye izikhathi ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo - ngokuvamile izinhlobo ezinehlamvu. Manje abafuyi babhekana nenkinga - kudingeka bakhulise isithelo esikhula ebusika kodwa abakwazi ukutshala i-wheat ngoba i-wheat ayinikezi inzuzo. Bazokwenzenjani manje? Ingabe iNingizimu Afrika idinga abafuyi abakhiqiza i-wheat? Le yindaba enhle okufanele siyiqonde - ngisho nohulumeni kufanele abuze le mibuzo. Kungani kufanele sikhathazeke ngababuyayo? Ngubani ozonakekela uma beqeda ukukhiqiza i-wheat? Kuyiqiniso ukuthi umhlaba emhlabeni wonke uyancipha - izinto zithengwa futhi zidayiswa emakethe yomhlaba. Yebo, kungenzeka ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingathenga yonke i-wheat edingekayo kwamanye amazwe, kanye ne-wheat edingekayo kwamanye amazwe afana neLesotho, eSwatini, naseBotswana. INingizimu Afrika inemali eyanele yokuthenga kwamanye amazwe. Khumbula ukuthi uma ufuna ukuthola imali yokukhokha kwamanye amazwe, kufanele ube nezimpahla zokuthengisa kwamanye amazwe ukuze uthole leyo mali? Amazwe angaphandle azoba ne-wheat eyanele edingekayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika unyaka nonyaka. Kuzokwenzekani uma bethatha i-wheat abanayo bese befuna ukwenza i-ethanol? Sizothola kuphi i-wheat? Ingabe kukhona imikhumbi ezoletha i-wheat lapha eNingizimu Afrika? Ingabe izikhumulo zethu zizokwazi ukuphatha yonke imikhiqizo yokudla edingekayo lapha nakwamanye amazwe asondelene? Ingabe imigwaqo yethu izokwazi ukuphatha ukuhamba kokudla konke okuvela olwandle? Sizothola kuphi abantu bonke abasebenza ezindaweni lapho i-wheat itholakala khona? Sizothola kuphi abantu bonke abasebenza ezinkampanini nasezindaweni zokugcina i-wheat? Kunabantu abaningi abampofu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni - kudingeka sakhe amathuba omnotho kulezi zindawo. Ukufuya kuyinto engcono engaholela ekukhuleni komnotho. Abafuyi bethu banelungelo lokwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nokukhiqiza. Kwenzekani kubafuyi abasha abamnyama? Sonke sisebenza kanzima ukuze sishintshe ukuhweba lapha eNingizimu Afrika - kunabafuyi abasha abamnyama abaningi abadinga ukutshala i-wheat ezinhlelweni zabo zokujikeleza izithelo. Njengamanje, sisaphumelela ekuxhaseni abafuyi abangena emkhakheni wezolimo ngoba banethuba lokuthola izibonelelo ezivela kuWinter Cereals Trust kanye neMnyango Wezolimo waseFree State. Uma sifuna ukuxhasa abafuyi abasha abamnyama emkhakheni wezolimo ongenamkhawulo, kudingeka sihlole kahle inzuzo yokutshala i-wheat. Yini isimo sokuthenga kwamanye amazwe? Kwamanye amazwe, isimo sezulu sikhona kahle sokutshala i-wheat - umhlabathi uyakhula futhi imvula iyanele (imvula iyawa njalo), futhi umswakama unikeza amanzi emhlabathini ngesikhathi sebusika (i-wheat encane ayibizi kakhulu uma kubanda). Izindleko zokukhiqiza kwamanye amazwe nazo ziphansi - intengo ye-diesel nomanyolo iphansi kunezaseNingizimu Afrika. La mazwe angakhiqiza i-wheat eningi bese ethengisa ngaphandle i-wheat eyengeziwe. Yebo, iNingizimu Afrika ingathenga i-wheat kwamanye amazwe - kodwa khumbula imibuzo esiyibuzile ngenhla. Sikholelwa ukuthi ingxenye yesixazululo salolu daba kungaba ukufaka umthetho wokuthenga i-wheat evela kwamanye amazwe. Uma i-wheat ifika evela kwamanye amazwe, umthengi walesi
Ithimba ngalinye linikezwa ngezithombe ukuze libheke bese livuma lokho abakubona. Umphakathi uhlukanisa izithombe ngezindlela ezintathu: "ezinhle," "ezimbi," kanye "neziqondile." Iziqondile - ukungaqiniseki ukuthi kuhle noma kubi. Le shadi iyasiza ngoba ivumela umphakathi ukuba uhlolisise, ahlaziye, futhi abheke isimo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuqonda ukuthi izifo zidluliselwa kanjani kumuntu oyedwa komunye nokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezingavikela ukudluliswa kwezifo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba xoxa ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezilula ukuzisebenzisa. Inqubo yokuchaza ngokobulili: Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezintathu zabesifazane nabesilisa, kanye nabesifazane nabesilisa ndawonye. Izithombe zabesifazane zikhona ezisebenzini ezahlukene. Enye imfuneko uk counting beans. Le thuluzi ihlose ukuba abantu bazi ngobulili babo emphakathini. Bangabona ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ababhekana nazo emihlanganweni yabo yezempilo futhi baphinde bacabange ukuthi lezi zinkinga zingavimbela kanjani ukuthuthukiswa kwabo. Kukhona izithombe eziyi-20-25 zezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, njengokusebenzisa izihlahla ukuze kube nezindawo zokuhlambela ezisebenzisa amanzi kanye nokusebenzisa amanzi avela emifuleni ukuze kube nezitsha ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba abheke izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi avela emifuleni ukuze kube nezitsha ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba ibone izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza emphakathini. Ibhokisi lemibuzo: Le thuluzi isebenzisa ibhokisi elilodwa elinovuli ukuze umphakathi uthumele imibuzo yabo. Umphakathi unethuba lokubuza imibuzo ngendlela engabaphoqi ukuba bakhulume ngezinkinga zabo emphakathini. Lokhu kusiza umphakathi ukuba ubuze imibuzo ngendlela engabonakali, engabashiyi bephoxekile noma ibangele ukungqubuzana. Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezahlukene zezenzakalo ezedlule nezamanje ukuze ibonise umehluko phakathi kokuthile okuphukile nokuthile okuphucukile. Uhlelo lwe-PHAST lwakhiwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ushintsho lwezenzo oluqhubekayo mayelana nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela ezifanele zokulahla udoti. Lwakhiwe ukuze kube nokulahla udoti okufanele, ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, kanye nempilo yemvelo, njengoba lokhu kwaziwa njengamanye wezinkinga ezihlobene nalokhu. Le ndlela isebenzisa izithombe ezivumela abantu ukuba babone ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza emphakathini ngendlela ebonakalayo. Le ndlela isebenzisa izindlela nezinto ezikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, abesifazane, nabantwana. Ukuphakamisa ukuqwashisa, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, nokulahla udoti ngendlela efanele. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba babhekane nezinkinga ezihlobene noshintsho lwezenzo. Ngokuhlola ulwazi lwabantu. Ukuhlola izimo abantu abahlala kuzo. Ngokubheka izimo ezingase zenzeke esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlaziya izinkinga ezingavimbela ushintsho. Ukulungiselela ushintsho. Ekugcineni, ukwenza ushintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokubambisana. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungaxazulula kanjani izinkinga. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ngokusekelwe kulwazi abanakho. Ukwamukela izindlela ezahlukene emphakathini ngokuqonda ukusabalala nokuvikela kwezifo. Ukubonakala kwezinkinga: Umphakathi uxoxa ngezinkinga zempilo ezikhona emphakathini. Ukuhlaziywa kwezinkinga Uma sibheka izinkinga, asicabangi ngesimo samanzi nokulahla udoti emphakathini kodwa siza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi umphakathi ushintsha uhambo lwawo lube ngcono ezindleleni zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Kubhekwa futhi ucwaningo lwezenzo zomphakathi futhi kubonwa ukuthi izifo ziwela kanjani. Ukuhlela izixazululo Ngesikhathi umphakathi uthole ukuthi kuphi inkinga, kufanele baphume nezindlela zokuvikela ukusabalala kwezifo. Ukukhethwa kwezindlela. Lapha umphakathi uveza izindlela ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza emphakathini futhi ukhethe izindlela ezinhle zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza njengoba behlola izindlela ezinhle nezimbi. Ukuhlela ushintsho lwezenzo nezinsiza ezintsha. Lapha umphakathi uhlunga abantu ukuze bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezizoletha ushintsho. Umphakathi uphinde ubheke ukuthi yini engase iphumelele emihlanganweni yabo. Lezi yizithombe eziyi-15 ezisetshenziswe ezinhlelweni ezimbili zikhombisa izindawo ezinezimfanelo ezahlukene. Umphakathi uhlukaniswe ngezigaba ezincane ukuze udale ithimba ngalinye elinikezwa ngezithombe ezikhuluma ngezindaba ezigcwele. Bese amaqembu axoxa ngezindaba zabo. Ngesikhathi usebenzisa le thuluzi, kunenjongo yokucwaninga ngezinkinga zomphakathi nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nalolo suku.
USteve Jobs: Umholi Wobuchwepheshe Nezinguquko USteve Jobs, igama elaziwa emhlabeni wonke, ungumuntu obalulekile emlandweni wezobuchwepheshe. Njengomfoundi we-Apple Inc., uJobs waba nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni imikhiqizo ethokozisayo, efana ne-iPhone, iMac, ne-iPad, eyashintsha indlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Ubuye waba nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wezobuciko, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, lapho imikhiqizo yakhe ibonakala njengemigqa yokuhola. UJobs wazalelwa eSan Francisco ngo-1955, wakhulela eMountain View, eCalifornia. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole, waqala ukufunda eReed College, kodwa waphuma esikoleni ngemva kokuhamba unyaka owodwa. Lokhu akukaze kumphazamise, ngoba wathola ithuba lokusebenza ne-Atari, inkampani edume ngogesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uJobs waqala ukwakha izinjongo zakhe, wathola umngane wakhe uSteve Wozniak, owaba yisibambiso esikhulu ekwakheni i-Apple. Ngonyaka ka-1976, uJobs noWozniak basungula i-Apple Computer, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, baqhamuka ne-Apple I, umshini wokuqala wabo. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuphumelela kwabo, kodwa uJobs akazange ayeke lapho. Ngonyaka ka-1984, wakhuluma ngempumelelo ye-Macintosh, umkhiqizo owawuhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okungcono kumsebenzisi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, njengoba iMac yenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumakhompyutha. Nokho, impilo kaJobs ayizange ibe lula. Ngonyaka ka-1985, wakhishwa kwi-Apple ngenxa yokungavumelani nezinhlelo zenkampani. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, kodwa uJobs akazange ayeke. Waqhubeka nokwakha, wathola iPixar Animation Studios, lapho aqala khona ukuhlela amafilimu anjenge "Toy Story," okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemikhiqizo emisha. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uJobs wayengumuntu ongenamkhawulo, owayezimisele ukufuna izixazululo ezintsha. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi, uJobs wabuyela kwi-Apple ngo-1997, lapho aqala khona ukuhlela kabusha inkampani. Waqala ukwakha imikhiqizo emisha, efana ne-iPod, iTunes, ne-iPhone. Lezi zinto zashintsha umkhakha wezokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezobuchwepheshe. UJobs wayaziwa ngokuqonda kwakhe okukhulu kwezidingo zabantu, futhi lokhu kwaba yisizathu sokuphumelela kwe-Apple. UJobs wayengumuntu onobuhlakani, kodwa futhi wayenobuntu obukhulu. Waziwa ngokuba nekhono lokukhuthaza abantu, nokubakhuthaza ukuba benze kahle. Wayekholelwa ekutheni ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube lula, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokwakha imikhiqizo yakhe. UJobs wayenobuhlakani bokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe nobuciko, okwenza imikhiqizo yakhe ibonakale kahle futhi ibe nekhwalithi ephezulu. Ngeshwa, uSteve Jobs washona ngo-2011, kodwa umthelela wakhe usaqhubeka. Imikhiqizo yakhe isaqhubeka nokushintsha izimpilo zabantu, futhi izifundo azishiye emhlabeni zihlala zikhumbuleka. UJobs waba yisibonelo sokuthi umbono, ukuzikhandla, nokungapheli ekufuneni izixazululo ezintsha kungaholela empumelelweni enkulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSteve Jobs uzobonwa njengenye yezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe. Ubuye waba yisibonelo sokuthi umuntu oyedwa angashintsha kanjani umhlaba, uma enomgomo, umbono, kanye nesifiso sokwenza okuhle. Ubuye waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi ubuchwepheshe kufanele bube yinsiza yokuphila, hhayi nje umkhiqizo. USteve Jobs, ngempela, ungumholi ophawulekayo, futhi umhlaba uzohlala ukhumbula igama lakhe.
Izikhukhula ZaseKZN: Umthelela Nokubhekana Nezimo Ezibucayi Izikhukhula ziye zaba yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal (KZN). Lezi zikhukhula, ezivame ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sezimvula ezinkulu, zishiya umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo ezinzima. Kulokhu, sizobheka imiphumela yeziqhumane ezibangelwa izikhukhula, izinyathelo ezithathwe ukuze kubhekwe lezi zimo, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Umthelela Wezikhukhula Izikhukhula ezivamile eKZN zishiya umphakathi uthukile, zibhubhisa izindlu, zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka, futhi zishiya abantu behluleka ukuhlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amanzi angcolile angaba yimbangela yokusabalala kwezifo, okukhulisa izingozi zokugula. Abantu abaningi baphila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, behluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezifana namanzi ahlanzekile, ukudla, kanye nezikhungo zezempilo. Izikhukhula zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni, zibhubhisa izinsiza, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nezinkampani ezincane, okuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo. Izinyathelo Zokubhekana Nezimo Uhulumeni kanye nezinhlelo ezizimele basebenza ngokubambisana ukuze baphendule kulezi zimo ezibucayi. Izinhlelo zokuhlenga zisetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekile bathola usizo. Lokhu kuhilela ukusiza abantu abahlala ezindlini ezibhujiswe, ukuhlinzeka ngokudla, kanye nokusebenzisa izikhungo zezempilo. Uhulumeni uhlose ukukhulisa izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu eziphumelelayo, ezikwazi ukumelana nezimo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu eziphephile. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele kubalulekile ukuze imiphakathi ikwazi ukuvuselela. Izixazululo Zesikhathi Esizayo Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhukhula aziphindi zenzeka ngendlela efanayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuvikela ezibanzi. Lokhu kubandakanya ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, ukuhlola izindawo ezibucayi, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukuqwashisa imiphakathi ngalezi zimo, kanye nokubafundisa ngezindlela zokuvikela, kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima. Isiphetho Izikhukhula zaseKZN zishiya umphakathi ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu, kodwa izinyathelo ezithathwayo zikhombisa ukuthi kunezindlela zokubhekana nalezi zimo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemizamo phakathi kukahulumeni, izinhlelo ezizimele, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abathintekile bathola usizo oludingekayo. Izixazululo eziphusile nezinhlelo zokuvikela zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhukhula ezinjalo aziphindi zenzeka, futhi umphakathi ungathuthuka ngokuzinzile. Kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo eziphusile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu baphila kahle, futhi izindawo zethu zihlala ziphephile. Izikhukhula zikhumbuza ukuthi umhlaba unamandla, kodwa nathi sinamandla okwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukuvikela umphakathi wethu.
UBill Gates: Umholi Wobuchwepheshe Nezinguquko Emhlabeni UBill Gates ungomunye wabantu abanethonya elikhulu emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. Uzalwe ngoJanuwari 28, 1955, eSeattle, eWashington, e-United States. Wakhulela emndenini ohloniphekile, futhi kusukela ebuntwaneni, wakhombisa amakhono akhe kwezobuchwepheshe. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eHarvard University, wahlanganyela nomngane wakhe uPaul Allen ukuze basungule inkampani ye-Microsoft ngo-1975. I-Microsoft yaziwa kakhulu nge-software yayo ye-Windows, eyenza kube lula kubantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele ukuthi basebenzise amakhompyutha. UBill Gates waba nesandla esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni le software, okwaholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwamakhompyutha ezindlini, ezikoleni, nasemabhizinisini. Ngaphezu kokuba umholi wezobuchwepheshe, uBill Gates ungumfundisi ophawulekayo. Ubonisa umgomo wokuphila ophusile, okukhuthaza ukusiza abanye. Ngemuva kokuhola i-Microsoft, uBill noMrs. Melinda Gates basungula iBill & Melinda Gates Foundation ngo-2000, eyabeka phambili izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo, imfundo, kanye nokulwa nobuphofu emhlabeni. Le nsizakalo ibhekene nezidingo zabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithintekayo, ukuze bathole amathuba angcono empilweni. UBill Gates waba nomthelela omkhulu ezinhlelweni zokulwa nezifo ezinzima, ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS kanye nomkhuhlane we-malari. Ufundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buwusizo ekwakheni izixazululo ezinzima. UBill Gates akagxili kuphela emalini, kodwa uthanda ukusiza abantu ngezindlela ezithile. Uphinde abe nomthelela omkhulu emkhakheni wemfundo, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni imfundo ye-STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics). Ubonisa ukuthi imfundo iyisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi uhlala efuna izindlela zokwenza ukufinyelela emfundweni kube lula. Ngaphandle kokuba umholi wezobuchwepheshe, uBill Gates ungumuntu ophawulekayo ngenxa yokuzinikela kwakhe emisebenzini yokuphila. Ubonisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabanye, futhi umbono wakhe wokuthi "ukuphila kahle kusho ukusiza abanye" ubonisa umoya wokubambisana. Uhlala ekhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile ngendlela ehloniphekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uBill Gates uqhubeka nokuba umholi ohloniphekile emhlabeni, futhi ubalulekile emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nasekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungaba yinsiza enkulu ekwakheni umhlaba ongcono. UBill Gates ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi umuntu angaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni ngenxa yokuzinikela, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokuphila ophusile. Ngakho-ke, akagcini nje ngokuba ngumholi wezobuchwepheshe, kodwa ungumfundisi, umnikelo, nomuntu onomthelela omuhle emhlabeni. Ukusebenza kwakhe, izinhlelo zakhe, kanye nemigomo yakhe zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba benze kahle, baphile kahle, futhi basize abanye. UBill Gates uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela omkhulu, ngenxa yokusebenza kanzima, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokuphila ophusile.
ULWAZI OLUQONDISWA NGEZWI EZIKHUNGWENI Isingeniso Ulwazi lwenza umphakathi ube nesizotha, lunikeze amandla, futhi luthuthukise izinga lempilo. Ezingeni lezakhamuzi, kulapho kutholakala khona izindlela ezithile zokwabelana ngolwazi. Kulokhu, ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni lukhona njengendlela ebalulekile yokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi emphakathini. Izikhungo Zokuxhumana Ngezwi Ezikhungweni, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana kuyasiza ekwabeleni ulwazi phakathi kwabantu. Izikhungo zokuxhumana, ezifana nezikhungo zokufunda, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zezokwelapha, zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana, okubandakanya imihlangano, izikhangiso, nezifundo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi luhanjiswa ngokushesha, futhi ilungele ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Izinhlelo Zokufundisa Ngezwi Enye yezindlela ezidume kakhulu zokwabelana ngolwazi ezikhungweni ukuhlela izinhlelo zokufundisa. Kulokhu, izikhungo zihlela imihlangano ethile yokufunda lapho abantu bebhala, beshukuma, noma bekhuluma phambi kwabanye. Imihlangano ethile, njengemihlangano yabafundi, ibalulekile ukuze uhlu lwesifundo luqondiswe nokuthi abafundi bathole imiqondo emisha. Ubuhlakani Bokukhetha Izeluleko Ezikhungweni, kunemithetho ethile ekuqondiseni ukunikezwa kolwazi. Izikhungo zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwayo luyasebenza futhi luhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukukhetha izeluleko ezivela kochwepheshe, ngoba lokho kuqinisa ukwethembeka kolwazi oluqondiswayo ezikhungweni. Ukwazisa Ngezinselelo Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi akuhambisani nezinkinga ezithile. Ukukhuluma phambi kwabanye kungabhakabhaka ukujabulisa, kodwa kukhona nabanye abakhathazekile, okwenza kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma evulekile. Izikhungo kumele zisize abantu abahlukene ukuze bakwazi ukwakha ukuxhumana okuhle nokwabelana ngolwazi. Ubuchwepheshe Besimanje Ngokwehlukana kwezobuchwepheshe, izikhungo azisakwazi kuphela ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, kodwa ziyakwazi nokufaka izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana. Izikhungo zisebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana njengezindlela zokwabelana ngolwazi ngendlela esheshayo. Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuqondiseni ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi, njengoba abantu besebenzisa amavidiyo, izithombe, nezithangami ukuze bathuthukise ukuqonda kwabo. Ukwakha Imibono Nezincazelo Kulokhu, ukufundiswa ngezimvo ezihlanganyelwe nezincazelo kuyinto ebalulekile. Ulwazi olunikezwayo kumele luhambisane nezinkolelo zomphakathi ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuphumelelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezimpande zomphakathi kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwemibono ehlukene nezincazelo ezithile, okuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi lubaluleke kakhulu. Ukweluleka Ngamathuba Izeluleko ezivela ezikhungweni zingenza umehluko omkhulu emphakathini. Ngakho, izikhungo kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayathola amathuba okuchaza nokuphakela izeluleko ezizothuthukisa impilo yabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuvulekile, futhi kuzoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu kulabo abathanda ukumamela. Isiphetho Ngemva kokuhlola ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi ezikhungweni, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo kuncike ezintweni eziningi, kubandakanya nezindlela zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokufundisa, nezinkolelo zomphakathi. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwe impumelelo, izikhungo kumele ziqhubeke nokwenza imizamo yokuthuthukisa ukuxhumana nokwabelana ngolwazi, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola ithuba lokukhuluma, ukufunda, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuzokwakha umphakathi onesibopho, onolwazi, nolwazi.
Amathayi asetshenziswa ezindaweni zokulima abiza kakhulu, kodwa kukhona imiyalezo ebalulekile ezokusiza ukuthi ulondoloze le mali oyichithile futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amathayi ahlala isikhathi eside. Uma ushintsha amathayi aphakeme kakhulu noma aphansi kakhulu, awaguga ngokushesha, umzimba wethayi ufinyelela kakhulu futhi uzoguga ngokushesha - into ethatha imali eningi! Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukulungisa ingcindezi yethayi ngokuya ngomsebenzi owenziwayo, futhi uhlole ingcindezi njalo. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kanye noma kabili ngesonto, futhi khumbula ukushintsha ingcindezi yethayi uma udonsa umthwalo onzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, hlola nesimo samathayi nokuthi aphelile kuphi. Uma kubonakala kunenkinga, kungase kube uphawu lokuthi ithayi likhukhuleka, noma ingcindezi ayifanele, noma izingxenye zokushayela azihambisani kahle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isondo lihamba ngegazi elifanele kuzokusiza ukuthi ithayi ibambe kahle phansi, izohlala isikhathi eside, futhi ngeke udle i-diesel eningi, okwenza kube lula ukubona lapho ingozi noma ukuvuza kungase kwenzeke. Khumbula ukuhlola ingcindezi uma ithayi ipholile, ngaphambi kokuthi ihanjiswe ngoba uma ihanjiswe iyashisa futhi ingcindezi iyanda. Ukulungisa amathayi - hamba kumuntu onolwazi! Umyalezo weGoodyear uthi amathayi kufanele afakwe noma alungiswe abantu abanolwazi ngoba lo msebenzi ungaba yingozi. Isibonelo: uma ithayi ingafakiwe kahle esondweni, uma iphakanyisiwe ingaphuka ngamandla amakhulu. Futhi ithayi ingashintsha esondweni uma idonswa kanzima, kudala ingozi kuthayi, emhlabeni, nasekhasini. Ithayi nesondo kufanele kubekwe endaweni ephephile uma kuhlangene. Uma ulungisa i-valve stem, khumbula ukuthi ingavula futhi kule ndawo. Uma ithayi ihanjiswa ngaphandle komoya noma ngegazi eliphansi, ungayiphakanyisa ngaphandle kokuyikhipha esondweni ukuze uhlole ukuthi ayilimazwanga - kungcono ukuba ihlolwe umuntu onolwazi. Okwesibili okumele kukhunjulwe: hlale usebenzisa ikhefu le-valve; ungashayi isondo noma ithayi ngensimbi uma iphakanyisiwe ngokuphelele; ungafaki i-valve stem engalingani; ungafaki i-valve stem egebhezi noma elimele; landela imiyalelo yomkhiqizi futhi ungafaki ithayi elikhulu kakhulu noma elincane kakhulu; qiniseka ukuthi ungazami ukulungisa isondo elilimazekile ngokuwelda noma ngokulilungisa ngezinye izindlela. Nokho, abantu beGoodyear bazama ukusebenzisa izinto ezizovimbela ukuguga kwamathayi, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi irhasi ithanda ukumunca uwoyela, i-grease, i-diesel, nezinye amakhemikhali, futhi ingalimala ukushisa naselanga. Ngakho-ke, amathayi afanele kufanele agcinwe endaweni epholile, emnyama, hhayi eduze kwemishini yokuwelda, ama-generator, noma eminye imishini ngoba lokhu kungadala ukulimala kwamathayi futhi azophuka uma esetshenziswa futhi. Ngokufanayo, geza zonke izinkemikhali kumathayi ngemuva kokuwaphonsa ngokwelashwa. Uma ubeka amathayi ezindaweni, wehlise ingcindezi ibe ngu-10 psi bese uwabeka phezulu. Amathayi akhishwe ezindaweni angabekwa phansi noma abekwe phezulu kodwa hhayi amaningi kakhulu ngoba uma engaphansi kwengcindezi azogcwala. Umshini onama-wheels kufanele uphakanyiswe ukuze ama-wheels angathintani nomhlaba. Uma umshini ubunzima kakhulu, phakanyisa ingcindezi yethayi ngo-25% futhi uhambise umshini kancane kancane ukuze amathayi angathintani nomhlaba endaweni eyodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Odoti athuthwa ngama-pipes ajwayelekile asetshenziswa amanzi - axhunyiwe kwi-infrastructure yokulahla udoti. Odoti uhlinzekwa ngama-pipes asetshenziswa amanzi akhishwe kwi-sewer - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nalo. Lapho amanzi esetshenziswa, akhishwa ethangini lapho itroli izokhipha khona futhi iyithumele kwenye indawo. Noma yimuphi umthengi onenani lempahla elingaphansi kuka-R36,000 ngokwezinhlelo zomkhandlu futhi ongakhokhi ukuthuthwa kodoti uthola le nsizakalo mahhala. Heee, ngiyavuma, asiqaleni! Uma sikhuluma ngezitolo zama-spaza, kuyajabulisa ukwazi ukuthi ziningi izinkinga ezibhekene nomnotho wasekhaya. Ngabe usuke ubone ukuthi lezi zinto zisebenza kanjani? Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zitolo zibalulekile emphakathini. Kuthiwani uma sikhuluma ngezitolo ezincane? Zivamise ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zansuku zonke zabantu. Hhayi nje ukudla, kodwa nezinto zokubhalela, iziphuzo, nezinsiza ezincane ezinjengemali. Kuhle, akukhona? Kodwa, sikhuluma ngazo, kudingeka sikhumbule nemithetho ethile ezibophezele kuyo. Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi lezi mithetho? Ngabe uyakwazi ukujwayela? Umthetho wokuqala, kanti, ungakuchaza njengokuphathwa kahle kwezimpahla, akunjalo? Lokhu kusho ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukusiza ukugcina lesi sitolo sisesimweni esihle. Lokhu akukhona nje okuningi. Khumbula uma uhamba uye esithathu, kunezinto ezidingeka ukuthi zifezekiswe ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga. Kumele kube nezimvume ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi yonke into ikulolu hlobo. Uma ungaphethi kahle, kwenza kube nzima kancane. Lokhu kusemthethweni, futhi abantu kumele bayiqonde le mithetho, ukukwazi ukuhweba ngokukhululeka ngezizathu ezihlukene. Ngabe ubona? Ngithanda ukuthi umphakathi ukhuthaze ithuba. Hhayi nje ukwenza imali, kodwa nokuthuthukisa umnotho. Njengoba lezi zindawo zikhula, ziqhuba ukwakha imisebenzi eningi. Uzobona, kuhle ukubona abantu behola imihlola, lokhu kuhle kakhulu! Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umphakathi ookhuluma ngabo kumele uqaphele izinto ezithile. Uma kwenzeka umphakathi ungenzi kahle, abanye abantu bazophuma bazama ukuthola ubugebengu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele kube nenhlangano eqinile ezindaweni zokuhweba. Kukhona umthetho wezokuphepha okumele ulandelwe. Kukhona izinto ezinzima ezingase zenzeke, kanti umphakathi kumele ungathathi izinto alula. Ngokusho kwayo, ukukhula kwezinto kudinga ukwenziwa komphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma usuthola imvume, kumele uhambisane nezimfuneko. Ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi abanye abantu baphumelele ngaphandle kokulawulwa? Kumele bazi ukuthi wonke umuntu bobabili udinga ukuqonda imithetho, ukuze konke kuhambe kahle. Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukusebenza ngokubambisana, futhi umphakathi uthokozise. Noma kunjalo, uma sikhuluma ngezimali okufanele zifakwe kulezi zindawo, sikhona isidingo sokuthi kube nezimali ezithile ezisiza ukusiza uphuhliso. I-Local Economic Development, noma i-LED, ibalulekile kukho konke lokhu. Kwanele ukusiza ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi, kodwa kumele kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezohwebo kanye nohulumeni. Ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani? Umphakathi kufanele uhambisane, ukuze ube nezinye izinhlelo ezihle. Lokhu kuletha imisebenzi emisha, futhi umphakathi uyawuthokozela ukukwazi ukusiza umphakathi. Ubuza ukuthi kungani kubalulekile? Ucabanga ukuthi kukhona abanye abantu obathanda ukuhweba, bese ifa elibandlululayo lenza kube nzima? Kulokhu, bazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukusiza. Ngakho-ke, uma ngiphakamisa, sathuthukisa izinto ezibalulekile ukuze sithole ubuchwepheshe obuqinile. Ucabangani ngezindlela ezithile ezizokwakha umnotho omuhle? Kumele sithuthukise imikhankaso esiza abantu. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lezi zinto zisebenza futhi ziqhuba umnotho wonke. Akungabazi, lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi uthokozise izimvume ezahlukahlukene. Ngabe uyayiqonda imithetho ewubukhali yokuhweba? Kuhle kakhulu, lokho kuyisigaba esibalulekile. Ngokuphetha, imithetho yezitolo zama-spaza ibalulekile emnothweni wasekhaya. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele sibheke izinto ezilula. Njengoba sikhuluma, kufanele sithole indlela yokuthi abathengi baphumelele, ukuze umphakathi ungaxhaphazeki. Khumbula, umphakathi wethu uqhubeka phambili kuphela uma sizibophezela kumthetho. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukusiza umphakathi wethu!
Umbiko: Ukuhlaziywa KweMpi YaseSandlwana Isingeniso Impi yaseSandlwana, eyenzeka ngomhla zingama-22 kuJanawari 1879, ibalulekile emlandweni wombango phakathi kwamaNgisi namaZulu. Le mpi ibonisa ubuhlakani, amandla, nokuzimisela kwabantu baseZulwini, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezihambisana nempi. Iphuma emuva kwemizamo yeButho laseBrithani yokuhlasela iZululand ngenhloso yokuthola izinsiza ezicebile. Isizathu Sokuhlasela Ngaphambi kokuhlaselewa, iButho laseBrithani, elibizwa ngeBritish Imperial Army, lanquma ukuhlasela iZululand ngenxa yokufuna ukwandisa amandla awo eNingizimu Afrika. Isizathu esiyinhloko sokuhlasela kwaba ukuvinjwa kokuhweba, kanye nezimpikiswano ezazikhona phakathi kwezakhamuzi zendawo. Ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kweBrithani noMnyamandlovu, umholi wamaZulu, kwaholela ekutheni kube nokungqubuzana okukhulu. Izimo Zokulwa Phakathi kokulwa, iZulu Army, eyaziwa nangokuthi yiButho leSizwe, yayiholwa nguCetshwayo, owabelana ngempumelelo yokuphumelela kwezokulwa. Njengoba impi iqala, amaZulu akhombisa ubuhlakani obukhulu, kwazise babenobuchwepheshe bokulwa obuhambisana nezimo zendawo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ubukhulu beButho laseBrithani buphumelele ukwakha izikhali ezinamandla, kodwa abawazanga kahle amandla avuthayo amaZulu. Ukuqala KweMpi Impi yaseSandlwana yaqala ngegagasi elikhulu. AmaZulu aqukethe izithunywa eziningi, ahlasela phezu kwemikhumbi yezikhali zeBrithani. Le mpi ibibanjwe edolobheni elincane laseSandlwana, elalingenamandla ukuze liqedele izinkanyezi ezazihlasela. Ubulukhuni bokulwa kwamaZulu bubonakala lapho behlasela iButho laseBrithani, balwa ngendlela eqinile, bahlasela ngenhloso yokuvikela impilo yabo, nezwe labo. Imiphumela Yempi Impi yaseSandlwana yagcina ibuhlungu, njengoba amaZulu aphumelela empini. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni ithonya lempi likhule, futhi kwavusa umdlandla kubantu baseZulwini. Nokho, lempi yahlasela futhi yathinta kakhulu izinhlelo zeButho laseBrithani, okwaholela ekubeni kube nezinye izimpi ezinzima ezalandela. Ukwakha Iminyaka Yezokuxhumana Ngemuva kokuphumelela kweZulu, kwavela izinkinga eziningi. Izinhlelo zeButho laseBrithani zashintsha, kwazise kwadingeka ukuba bazame ukufinyelela impumelelo emizileni emisha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezintsha zokuxhumana, lapho izimpahla zenzeka khona, futhi amaZulu aqhubeka nokufaka umoya wempumelelo. Isiphetho Impi yaseSandlwana ibalulekile emlandweni wamaZulu, njengoba ibonisa ubuhlakani, isibindi, nokuzimisela kwamaZulu ekulweleni inkululeko yabo. Ngisho noma izimo zazinzima, amaZulu akwazi ukulwa futhi aphumelele empini, akhombisa amandla akhe emlandweni wezwe. Le mpi ibalulekile ekwakheni isiko lempi, futhi iyingxenye ebalulekile yomlando waseNingizimu Afrika. Izifundo ezitholakele kule mpi ziyaqhubeka nokuba nomthelela ezimpilweni zabantu baseZulwini, njengoba zibonisa ubuhlakani nokuzimisela kokulwa ukuze kuvinjwe ukungena kwezithunywa zempahla ezivela ngaphandle. Ngakho-ke, impi yaseSandlwana iyinsika yokukhumbula, futhi ibalulekile ukuze sikhumbule ubuhlakani bamaZulu, kanye nezinselelo abahlangabezane nazo emlandweni wabo.
Le mklomelo inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaveze ubuchule obuphakeme emikhakheni yobuciko, isiko, ubhalomfundo, umculo, ezokungcebeleka, nezemidlalo. Izigaba zesithathu = Uxube lwezinsimbi. Isithelo se-gourd (iPumpkin) simela ubuhle obukhulu bokuphumelela kwabantu abesilisa nabesifazane abaphakamisa iNingizimu Afrika emikhakheni yokwakha, ubuciko, isiko, umculo, ezokungcebeleka, nezemidlalo. Izinhloko zeLydenburg - ubuciko - izinhloko ze-terracotta zimelela ubuciko bokubona kanye nekhono lokudala ngokuhamba phambili phambi kwabantu. Idrum yase-Afrika - ihambisana nazo zonke izinkolo nemizamo yobuciko. Imela isipho esikhulu ekuxoxeni izindaba nasekugubheni amasiko ethu. Iphakethe / Ilanga - umqhele umele ikhanda elikhanyisiwe ngama-feather agqokwa ngabaculi nobukhosi kanye nabantu abahlonishwa. Imisebe yelanga ichaza amandla amakhulu, udumo, nokukhanya, konke okumele kube yimpumelelo yabaculi emikhakheni ehlukene. Isisho sokuthi asifani neqanda ngaphakathi - (Udlame emidlalweni) simela ukuqaphela ukuthi abantu baphumelele kakhulu emikhakheni yezemidlalo nesiko. Izindlela - (Impumelelo nokuthokozisa) - zimelela zonke izindlela eziya e-Afrika lapho abantu bevela khona, zimelela indlela ende yokuphumelela nokubekezela.
Ama-Robot Ingxoxo noDkt. Sipho Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Kwezobuchwepheshe Be-Robotics Umqondisi: Sanibonani, Dkt. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha namuhla ukuze sikhulume ngama-robot. Ngabe ungakuchaza kahle ukuthi ama-robot ayini? Dkt. Mthembu: Sanibonani, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ama-robot, ngokuyisisekelo, yizinto ezisebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo, ezakhiwe ukuze zifeze imisebenzi ethile. Zingaba nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ekwenzeni imisebenzi elula efana nokuhlanza, kuya ekwenzeni imisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi efana nokuhamba, ukuxhumana nabantu, noma ngisho nokwenza izinqumo. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinto ethokozisayo. Ngabe ungakuchaza ukuthi ama-robot asebenza kanjani? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, ama-robot asebenza ngokuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza, izinzwa, nezinhlelo zokulawula. Izinsiza ezinjengama-sensors ziwusizo ekutholeni ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze ama-robot akwazi ukwenza izinqumo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma i-robot ihlanza, izinsiza zayo zihlola ukuthi yikuphi okukhona phambi kwayo, bese ikhetha indlela efanele yokuhamba. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkimbinkimbi. Ngabe ama-robot angakwazi ukufunda noma ukuthuthukisa amakhono awo? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, ama-robot angafunda. Lokhu kuthiwa yi-artificial intelligence (AI). Ngamanye amazwi, ama-robot angafunda kumaphutha awo futhi athuthukise amakhono awo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi ama-robot akwazi ukwenza imisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, njengokuhumusha ulimi noma ukuxhumana nabantu ngendlela efanele. Umqondisi: Lokhu kuzwakala kuyinselele. Ngabe ama-robot asebenza kanjani emikhakheni ehlukene? Dkt. Mthembu: Ama-robot asebenza emikhakheni eminingi. Esikhathini samanje, sithola ama-robot emkhakheni wezokwelapha, lapho asetshenziswa khona ukusiza odokotela emisebenzini ethile. Futhi, emkhakheni wezokuthutha, ama-robot asebenza njengama-drones, ahambisa izimpahla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, emkhakheni wezokwakha, ama-robot angasiza ekwakheni izakhiwo, okwenza kube lula futhi kusheshe. Umqondisi: Ngabe kukhona izinzuzo ezithile zokusebenzisa ama-robot? Dkt. Mthembu: Impela, izinzuzo ziningi. Okokuqala, ama-robot angasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi ethile ngokushesha nangempumelelo, okwandisa ukukhiqiza. Okwesibili, angasiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi engathandeki kubantu, njengokusebenza ezindaweni ezinzima noma eziphazamisayo. Lokhu kunciphisa ingozi yokulimala kwabantu. Umqondisi: Kodwa-ke, kukhona nezinkinga ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwama-robot, akunjalo? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, kukhona izinkinga. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu yindaba yokuphepha. Uma ama-robot engalawulwa kahle, angaba yingozi. Futhi, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngempilo yomsebenzi, njengoba ama-robot engase athathe imisebenzi ethile, okungaholela ekunciphiseni amathuba emisebenzi kubantu. Umqondisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinselele enkulu. Ngabe ubona kanjani ikusasa lama-robot? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngibona ikusasa lama-robot linethemba elikhulu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, sizobona ama-robot ethuthuka kakhulu, eba nekhono lokusebenza nabantu ngendlela engcono. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezintsha ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono. Umqondisi: Ngabe unayo imiyalo ethile kubantu abathanda ukungena emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe be-robotics? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, yebo. Ngiyabonga kubantu abasha abathanda ukungena kule ndawo. Kubalulekile ukufunda izifundo ezihlobene nezobuchwepheshe, njengezibalo, isayensi, ne-computer science. Futhi, kufanele bazibandakanye emisebenzini yokwakha ama-robot, ukuze bathole ulwazi oluqinile. Umqondisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Dkt. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngama-robot. Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwakho nolwazi lwakho. Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazothola ulwazi oluwusizo kulokhu esikukhulumile.

Kuthiwa umhlaba wethu lapha eNingizimu Afrika ungama-90% umhlaba omile noma ubhekene nezinsuku zokoma. Ukulima kwenziwa ngaphandle - ukukhiqizwa kokudla kuthinteka yizimo zezulu: imvula, ukukhanya kwelanga, umkhovu, izilokazane, ukoma, nemoya onamandla - kodwa ezindaweni ezithile, kungaba ngcono ngoba abalimisi abathile bangakwazi ukujova (ukuphonsa) izitshalo zabo. Kubalulekile kumlimi ukuthi acabangele izimo zezulu nezinye izinto ezingase zibe yingozi uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ukulima kuyibhizinisi, futhi ibhizinisi lingaphila kuphela isikhathi eside uma lenza inzuzo njalo ngonyaka. Nokho, akusiyo impumelelo ukuthi kuzokwenziwa inzuzo, ngakho zonke izingozi ezingaba khona kufanele zicatshangelwe uma efuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini lokulima. Ukungalingani okungafani kokukwazi komlimi ukukhiqiza ngezinsiza abanazo (izinkambu, imali, umsebenzi, imishini) kwehlisa ithuba lokuba nezingcuphe. Lokhu kunciphisa kungafezwa ngokukhetha izitshalo ezihlukene, kungalimi konke ngesikhathi esisodwa endaweni eyodwa, futhi kungabheki kakhulu inani lemali yokuvuna ngasikhathi sinye. Zama ukudlulisa izingozi ngokuthola umshwalense nokuvikela izinkontileka kusenesikhathi. Zama ukunciphisa ithuba lokuba nezingcuphe ngokuzilungiselela uma ingozi ivela - faka ezinye zezinto zakho ezinamandla ukuze ukwazi ukuphatha izingozi ezintsha. Isimo sokwabelana ngengozi yomshwalense sithi: wamukela izinkokhelo ezivela kubalimisi abaningi ukuze inkampani yomshwalense ikwazi ukuhlanganisa imali engenayo ukuvikela ezingozeni ezingaba khona. Inkampani yomshwalense izosebenzisa ulwazi oluhambisana nenani lezindawo zokulima lapho ibeka khona inani lempahla ukuze ikwazi ukukhokhela izicelo futhi iqhubeke nemisebenzi yayo ngenzuzo. Ngamafuphi, inkampani yomshwalense ithatha izinkokhelo kubo bonke abalimisi abavikelekile ukuze ikwazi ukukhokhela izicelo endaweni ethile. Nokho, umshwalense uthokozisa kakhulu lapho ukukhiqizwa kuvame ukubhekana nengcuphe futhi lapho ingozi iphezulu, khona-ke umkhiqizi uzocabangela ukuthi zingaki izinkokhelo nezicelo ezizoba khona uma kuqhathaniswa nengcuphe engaba khona. Izingcuphe ezincane ngokuvamile azidingi umshwalense, kodwa uma kukhona ingozi engase ibulale yonke imisebenzi yokulima, khona-ke umshwalense uyadingeka. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zomshwalense ezivikela ezingozeni zonke ezingase zivele emisebenzini yokulima. Ukulahlekelwa kokuvuna ngenxa yokulimala okubonakalayo kwezitshalo - ukulimala kwengxenye yendawo yokulima noma zonke izitshalo. Izinto ezivikelekile zingabandakanya: izithelo eziwile ezilimazekile, izindawo zokulima lapho sizama khona, amaqabunga alimazekile noma awile, izimpande eziphukile noma ezilimazekile. Umshwalense ubalulekile lapho ulima imbewu nezitshalo ekuqaleni kwesizini yokukhula. Ukulimala okunjalo okubangelwa umkhovu: imbewu elahlekile, amaqabunga aphukile, nezimpande eziphukile. Njengokulimala okubangelwa umkhovu, umshwalense uvikela ekulimazeni ingxenye yezinto zokulima noma zonke izitshalo. Ukulahlekelwa kokuvuna uma kuthuthwa ngemuva kokuvuna ezinkampini ezivikelekile. Lokhu kungabangelwa ubungozi bomlilo, ukuhlinzeka kwezimoto, nokuphahlazeka kwezimoto. Umshwalense uvikela lokhu kuphela ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwama-100 km ukusuka epulazini. Izingxenye zezinto zokulima zingavikelwa: imbewu nezitshalo lapho kukhona ukulimala okubangelwa imvula eningi ngesikhathi ukudla kuqhakaza. Ukulimala kwezingxenye zezinto zokulima okubangelwa umlilo kungavikelwa. Umuntu othola umshwalense womlilo kufanele alandele imihlahlandlela ejwayelekile yelizwe mayelana nokwakha izikhala zomlilo (ukuvikela umlilo) ngaphambi kokuthola lo mshwalense. Ukulimala okuvikelekile kwenzeka uma amaqabunga, izimpande, nezinye zifa ngenxa yomkhovu. Ukulahlekelwa kokuvuna kuhlolwa ngalokhu kulimala okubonakalayo kwezitshalo. Ukulimala okungabonakali, njengokukhula okuphazamisekile ngenxa yokubanda, akuvikelwa. Kukhona izingxenye zezinto ezingabonakali, ezingakwazi ukuhlolelwa kahle, ezingavikelwa ngalo mshwalense. Lokhu kungaba ukoma okukhulu (ngaphandle kwezinkambu ezijovayo), ubungozi obukhulu bezilokazane, umkhovu, umoya, njll. Ngakho-ke, umkhiqizi uvikelwe ezimfanelweni zemvelo ezingaphathwa abantu. Ngaphi engingathola usizo? Amabhange amaningi nezinkampani zokulima zingabamele abathengisa umshwalense wezitshalo. QINISEKISA UKUTHI UFUNDA NGOKUCOPHELELAYO OKUTHI KUBHALWE NGEMISHAYO EMINCANE KULO MSHWALENSE BEFORE SIGNING - AWUFUNI UKUVUKA UTHOLE IZIPHUMO ZOKUMANGAZA NGEMVA KWESIKHATHI.
Ukuthathwa kwezingane kusho ukwamukela ngokomthetho ukuba ngumgadi wengane, kulandela inqubo yamasiko kanye nomthetho yengane engazalwanga kubazali abathathayo. Ingane engakabi yakho ngokwenziwa oyithathayo ukuze uyinakekele ithathwa kubazali bayo ngokwenziwa futhi ibekwe ngokomthetho kubazali abathathayo noma endaweni yokunakekelwa. Ingane ingathathwa engakabi yakho ngokwenziwa. Ubaba ongena emshadweni ongumzali wengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele abe nezinsiza zokunakekela nokukhokhela imfundo yayo. Kufanele ube negama elihle, ube umuntu omuhle, futhi ube nethemba futhi ukwazi ukunakekela ingane. Uma umzali wengane engum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele futhi ube ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika futhi ubehlala eNingizimu Afrika. Uma ungum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele ube neziqu zokuba ngum citizen noma ube ufake isicelo sokuba ngum citizen. Ukuthatha ingane ngokuqinisekile, lapho abazali bayo bengavunyelwe ukwazi ukuthi abazali abathathayo bangobani, noma lapho abanikazi bezingane bezozishiya ngemva kokuthatha ingane, kulawulwa nguMthetho 18 weMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983, futhi kungenzeka uma inkantolo yezingane ikholwa ukuthi lokhu kuzothuthukisa ingane futhi kuhambisane kakhulu nezidingo zengane. Uma inkantolo yezingane ithola ukuthi ingane noma izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa, umgibeli wenkantolo yezingane uzobeka lezi zingane ekunakekelweni, endlini yezingane, esikoleni sezimboni, noma endaweni ephephile. Nokho, ingane noma izingane zingabekwa ngaphansi kokunakekelwa komzali, umnakekeli, noma umgadi, lapho zizobe ziphathwa khona ngummeli wezokuxhumana. Kulokhu, uMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uzohlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kumzali onakekela ingane. Isiphakamiso sokuthatha ingane kufanele sibe sesisekelweni sezidingo zengane kanye nenzuzo empilweni yengane. Ukuze uthole eminye imininingwane, vakashela ku-inthanethi yeMnyango Wezemvelo Nezokuvakasha, uMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Hamba kumgibeli wenkantolo yezingane esifundazweni lapho ingane ihlala khona. Qedela Ifomu 11, Isicelo sokuthatha ingane, sengane ofuna ukuyithatha. Lapho Ifomu 12, Ukuvuma komzali noma umgadi sokuthatha ingane, ifanele, iqukethe ukuvuma okubhaliwe kwabazali sokuthathwa kwengane komunye, futhi Ifomu 13, Ukuvuma kwengane sokuthathwa, iqukethe ukuvuma okubhaliwe kwengane. Ingane uqobo, uma ineminyaka engaphezu kweyishumi, kufanele iqonde ubunjalo nobaluleka balo mvume. Umzali owamukele ingane ukuze ayinakekele, owayinakekela leyo ngane, kufanele afake isicelo sokuthatha leyo ngane. Uma umzali owamukele ingane ukuze ayinakekele ehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngovume lwezokuthatha ngaphakathi kwenyanga emva kokucelwa ukuba enze kanjalo ngumqondisi wenkantolo, inqubo yokuthatha ingane ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kwemvume yabo edingekayo. Akudingi ukuvuma okubhaliwe ngaphansi kwezimo ezilandelayo: uma behoxisa ukuvuma kwabo ngesizathu esingafanele. Ukuvuma ukuthathwa kwengane ngumuntu ongumzali kuvame ukuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kungathatha isikhathi eside uma udaba lukhona oluyinkimbinkimbi. Mayelana nezindleko zokuhlola, xhumana nezikhungo ezifanele zokuvuma ukuthathwa kwezingane, izinkantolo zezingane, kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Ifomu 12A: Ukuhoxiswa kwemvume yokuthatha ingane ngumzali noma umgadi wengane.
Izinsuku Zokuqala Zama-Social Media: Uhlanga Olwakha Umhlaba Wokuxhumana Ngonyaka we-1971, umhlaba wabona inguquko enkulu uma umyalezo wokuqala we-imeyili uthunyelwa. Lokhu kwaba yisiqalo sokuxhumana okuhlangenwe nakho ngefoni, okwakukhuluma ngebanga elikhulu lezakhamizi ezazizokwazi ukuxhumana ngaphandle kwemikhawulo yesikhathi nolwazi. Njengoba iminyaka yayiqhubeka, amandla okuxhumana aphesheya kokuthi ulwazi lungadluliselwa kalula, alithola ungeqondi. Ngonyaka we-1997, i-website eyaziwa ngokuthi iSixDegrees.com yathokozisa umhlaba ngenkathi ibonisa umqondo wokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu. Lesi situs sethula izici zokuhlanganyela, kugcina kube yisiqalo se-social media njengoba siyazi namuhla. Umqondo wokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okwakuhlanganisa ukuxhumana kwabanye, kwavula indlela yokuthi abantu bawamukele kabanzi amasejima okuhle nabanye. Ngemva kwalokho, ngo-2003, kwavela iLinkedIn, ipulatifomu ehloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngesikhala sokuxhumana kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ezahlukene. Kwaba yinkanyezi eziletha abantu ubumqoka bezokuxhumana kwezebhizinisi. Ukuthi uhwebo, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinkampani kungenziwa ku-inthanethi, kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana kabanzi phakathi kwabantu abavela emhlabeni jikelele. Kodwa, izikhathi zashintsha ngesivinini sokuqhamuka kwezinye izinkundla ezinzima. Ngo-2004, iFacebook yathuthukiswa futhi yachuma ngokushesha. Lesi site sathola ukunakwa kwabantu abaningi abavela ezintweni ezahlukene. Abantu bakwazi ukusungula amakhasi, ukwabelana ngezithombe, nemicabango yabo. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuhlanganyela izinkumbulo, izigameko, kanye nemicabango engokwenyani, okuhlanganisa abantu phakathi kwezimfuno zabo nezifiso. Ngemuva kwalokho, ngo-2006, kwaphuma iTwitter, eyayihloselwe ukuxhumana okusheshayo. Ubudlelwane bovimba obubhalwayo bekuhlanganiswe ne-tweet, okuvumela abantu ukuthi babelane ngolwazi ngokushesha. Lokhu kuqhakambisa umqondo wokuthi abantu bangabelana ngemicabango yabo ngokuqondile, okwaholela ekutheni iTwitter ibe yinsiza ebalulekile ekuthumeleni imiyalezo esheshayo, ikakhulukazi ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Ngo-2010, iInstagram yathuthukiswa, igxile ekuhlinzekeni abasebenzisi ngezithombe ezisheshayo kanye nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kwaqhubekela phambili umqondo wokuqala wokuheha abantu kusuka kumavidiyo ukuya ezithombeni, okwakudinga ukuthi ubudlelwano bube nemikhuba ethile. Ukuthi izithombe zithokozisa, kwavula indlela yokuxhumana yokubona izinto eziphilayo, okuwubuhlakani bokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene. Esikhathini samanje, ama-social media awashintshile kakhulu. Imithombo yezokuxhumana njengamaTikTok, WhatsApp, kanye neminye yehlushwa kahle, inikeza abantu ithuba lokuhlanganyela, ekwakheni ubudlelwano ezikhuthazayo. Abantu basenweba inethiwekhi yabo yabadlali abahlala bexhumana, babona amandla nobuhle balesi sikhala. Kodwa, njengoba ukuxhumana kwandile, kuphinde kuvele nezinselelo. Umbhalo wesigameko sobuzwe ubhalwe ngokuphuthuma, izindaba zezinhlaka zingase zibe lula, kepha kube engcupheni yemiphumela engafanele. Ukuqonda ubuhlungu bokuxhumana okungafanele bukhona; abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinsuku ezinzima zingakhinyabeza ubudlelwano nobungane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zokuphepha nokuziphatha zisaqhubeka zikhula. Ubuqotho bokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiyalezo iyahlonishwa, njengezithombe nokubhalwa kwezindaba, kube yinsiza ebalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa umqondo wokuthi ubudlelwano obwakha phakathi kwezokuxhumana kufanele buhlonishwe, kuhambisane nezindinganiso ezivunyiwe. Nokho, ama-social media awaphumi ngokuphelele ekutheni anika abantu ithuba lokuxhumana ngezindlela ezinhle. Noma kunzima, ubuchwepheshe obusha buyaphuma njalo, buvikela izimo ezintsha zokuxhumana. Ubufakazi bomsebenzi wabo bukhuluma kakhulu, lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ama-social media azoba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wethu, kuze kube sekupheleni. Ngakho, njengoba sihamba kancane ngaphakathi kwalezi zinsuku ezinzima, sesikhona ithuba lokuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi eziwusizo kithi. Ama-social media asihlanganisa, asihlanganisela, asithokozisa; futhi nokho, kudingeka sihlale siqapha indlela esisebenzisa ngayo lezi zinsiza. Lokho kumfumbezi ozokwenza siqhubekele phambili ngethuba elisha, ngethemba lokwakha umhlaba omuhle, okunobudlelwano obunempilo. Ezinsukwini ezizayo, ama-social media ayoba yisixhumanisi sokugcina sokuxhumana. Kufanele sihloniphe umqondo wokuzethemba, silungise izikhathi zethu zokuxhumana, sizibophezele emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Lokhu kuzodala ubudlelwano obuqinile, obuqinisa ingqikithi yokuxhumanisa ezizayo. Futhi sizodinga futhi sihlale sihamba phambili, sihamba nohlanga lokuxhumana, ukwakha umhlaba obumbene.
