Ifomu iqukethe indlela yokubika ngokuqondile emsebenzini obikwe kwiMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Le fomu ifaka phakathi nezidingo zokubika abaqashi abakhethiwe, labo abasebenza ngaphansi kuka-150 noma ngaphezulu kuka-150. Ifomu iphinde ifake umbiko wokuqhubeka okumele uqedwe ngemuva kwesikhathi sokuqala sokubika. Bonke abaqashi abakhethiwe kumele bathumele umbiko njengoba kuchaziwe nguMthetho Wobudlelwano Babasebenzi u-55 ka-1998. Noma ubani oqashiwe ophumelele ngokuzithandela ukuhlinzeka ngombiko wezobulungiswa bezabasebenzi kumele athumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaJuni 1, 2000, bese elandela ngomunye unyaka, ngosuku lokuqala luka-Okthoba 2001. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zefomu ngaphandle kwengxenye G embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zale fomu, kuhlanganise nengxenye G embikweni olandelayo. Kumele bathumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaDisemba 1, 2000, bese elandela nabanye ngemva konyaka, ngosuku lokuqala lomsebenzi ngo-Okthoba, kuqala ngo-2002. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, no-H embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, G, no-H emibikweni elandelayo. Kumele baqedele umbuzo 8.2 (izigaba zendawo yokusebenza) kuwo wonke imibiko. Ngokuzithandela, kumele baqedele izingxenye C, D, no-E kuwo wonke imibiko.
Le nqubo ithunyelwa kwiMisebenzi yeZimali yaseNingizimu Afrika uma kudingeka umyalo wentela mayelana nenani lemali elinikezwe ngendlela engajwayelekile ngumqashi. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zentela zisesimweni esifanele uma ufaka isicelo somyalo wentela. I-SARS ngeke ikhiphe umyalo wentela uma ungakafaki amafomu wentela noma uma unedipho. Inombolo yokreference ye-PAYE yomqashi wakho iyadingeka. Uma i-SARS ivuma isicelo, uzothola ukuqinisekiswa phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa umyalo wentela rasmi ungathatha cishe amasonto amane. Indlela elula yokufaka isicelo somyalo wentela ukwenza lokhu ku-inthanethi kwiwebhusayithi ye-eFiling. Isicelo sakho somyalo wentela ngalendlela ngokuvamile sivunywa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-48. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Qedela futhi uthumele ifomu lakho ku-inthanethi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, layisha bese uqedela ifomu lesicelo somyalo wentela: Gratuities IRP3.
U-Novak Djokovic: Umphenyi Wezempilo Nezimpumelelo Emhlabeni Wamathenisi UNovak Djokovic ungomunye wabadlali abavelele kakhulu emlandweni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wamathenisi. Ubulili bakhe, ubunzima ayebhekana nabo, kanye nezimpumelelo zakhe, kubonisa ukuthi ungubani ngempela, kanye nendlela akhethile ngayo ukuphila kwakhe ukuze abuyele ekulweni kobuhlungu bezenhlalakahle, ezempilo, kanye nokuphumelela. U-Djokovic wazalelwa eBelgrade, eSerbia, ngomhla ziyi-22 kuNdasa ngonyaka we-1987. Umdlalo wakhe wamathenisi waqala ngesikhathi esencane, waphoqeleka ukufunda amathalente akhe ngemuva kokuhlangana nomphakathi wokudlala. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waqala ukubonisa ubuchule obuphakeme, kwazise ngaphambi kokuba abe yilungu elisemthethweni leqembu lezemidlalo leSerbia. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNovak wathola izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthuka ukuze akwazi ukufinyelela izinjongo zakhe. Umdlalo wakhe umuhle, unokungajabuli, futhi ubonisa ubunzima obuphakeme, okuyizici ezimqoka ekudlalweni kwamathenisi. U-Djokovic uphinde waba ngumgayisani wezifundo ezithinta impilo nokudla okunempilo, okuholela ekudlaleni kwakhe okukhuluma phansi ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa izinto ezinhle nezimpumelelo ekuphileni. Nakuba uNovak Djokovic engomunye wabantu abaphethe umhlaba, udlale kakhulu emiphefumulo yokuhlonipha nezimfanelo zomphakathi. Ukuhlawulwa okuningi kwezinkanyezi, ukudela izikole okufanele zishintshwe, kanye nezimindeni ezihloniphekile, uDjokovic ubonisa ukuthi unombono ofanele wokukhula, umphakathi, kanye nezenhlalakahle. Uhlobo lwakhe lokudlala lukhombisa uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo, ubunzima obumhlupha, nokuthi unomlande owakhe afuna ukuzenza ngemuva. U-Djokovic unakekela impilo yakhe futhi ubonisa isithakazelo esijulile esidlangalaleni nasezinhlelweni zomphakathi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubandakanywa kakhulu, hhayi kuphela kumathenisi, kodwa nasemphakathini. U-Djokovic uphinde waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, ngaphandle kwezikhumbuzo zokuphumelela kwakhe kwi-Grand Slam, lapho efinyelela khona phambili kumakhono akhe okwenza izimbangi zikhathazeke. Uqale ukukhipha ukubumbana okukhulu nempilo yakhe, nokuqhubeka nokwenza izinkanyezi zifune impumelelo efana naye. U-Djokovic uyinhloko yethu yokwakheka yemidlalo, udalwa izimanga zempilo, nesiphepho sokugcina. Ngaphandle kokuphathwa kwezinkanyezi emhlabeni, uDjokovic uphinde abe nesithakazelo esikhulu sezokwelapha nangokwezemidlalo. Ubonisa ukuphendula kwezingxoxo ezithinta imikhuba yokuphila okuhle, ethokozisa izigidi zabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu okubhaliwe ayilona uhambo oluncane; kuyindaba yokukhula ebuhlungu, okwenza kahle empilweni, kanye nempumelelo. UNovak Djokovic ungadingeki awusakaze umbala wakhe emhlabathini wezempilo kuphela, kodwa futhi uyakudala ibhuku lesigaba sokuqala lesikhumbuzo sesimanjemanje. Isithombe sakhe sihlanganiswa nezizathu ezinzulu zempilo, ukudla okunempilo, nokuphila ngendlela efanele. U-Djokovic ungumholi wemikhankaso yempilo ebonisa abanye ukuthi sebenzisa izingqondo zabo ukuze bakhule emihlalweni yangempela. Ekugcineni, uNovak Djokovic ungujaho wezenhlalakahle ngendlela yokuphila ayitholiweyo ehloswe ngempumelelo, angakhumbuleki kumakhono akhe, kodwa futhi ubonisa ukuthi ukhiye wempumelelo ubelokhu utholakala ezimpilweni zethu kunoma isiphi isikhathi. Ubukhona bakhe emhlabeni wamathenisi busitshela ukuthi ukukwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga akukhona kuphela kumandla, kodwa kumele ube nomqondo oqondile ophusile nezinhloso ezisezingeni eliphakeme. Njengomgibeli ophumelelayo, uNovak Djokovic uyiphuzu eliqinile, elithinta abanye bonke ngokwakha umphakathi ozinzile, oguqula impilo.
Ukuthuthukiswa kubalulekile abantu - kuhilela ukuxhumana nomuntu. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, kukhona abalimi abaningi abathintekayo emnothweni abanezinga lokwazi ukufaka umkhiqizo, abangakhiqiza noma iyiphi imbewu noma bakhule noma iyiphi impahla. Akukho ukuntuleka kolwazi - manje sekuyadingeka ukuthi leli nolwazi lidluliselwe kulabo balimi abamnyama ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuthola amandla okukhulisa ngokwabo ngokuqhubekayo. Iziqu zokuthuthukiswa eziqinile kanye nokuphila kwezindawo ezisemaphandleni okunempilo kuhilela ukubheka izinsiza/izimpahla ezikhona ezingasetshenziswa ngumuntu nokwandisa amandla alelo muntu okusebenzisa lezo zinsiza. Lezi zinsiza zihluka, zingaba abantu, ezomnotho, ezemvelo, njll. Uma sifuna ukuthuthukiswa kube namandla, kumele sisebenzise izinsiza ezikhona ezisetshenziswa abantu ukuze sithole ukudla nemali. Impilo engcono ibonisa ukuthola imali engcono, ukuphila kahle, ukudla kahle, nokusebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo ngendlela eqhubekayo. Umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa wakhe izisekelo namandla asetshenziswa abantu. Izimbangela zokuhlupheka zihluka, kodwa kunezinto ezivamile - imali ephansi, ukukhiqiza okuphansi, nokuntuleka kolwazi. Abantu abahluphekayo bavame ukungabandakanyi ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukudla, baqhubeka nezindlela zakudala ngoba bengenalo ulwazi mayelana nezindlela zokulima ezintsha. Futhi abantu bavame ukwenqaba ukushintsha ngoba besaba okungaziwa. Bavame ukuhlala ezindleleni zakudala ngoba bayazi ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Khumbula ukuthi abazi ukuthi kunezindlela ezintsha ezinhle zokulima. Bavame ukukhetha izindlela ezinganqamuki. Abazozama ukufaka imbewu ehlukile ngoba besaba ukuthi umndeni wabo ungase ungabi nokudla kusasa. Ngezifundo zethu nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa, sivula umnyango kulaba balimi ukuze babandakanye nezindlela zokulima ezintsha, kodwa kumele siwavikele ekwehlulekeni, ngoba uma behluleka kungaholela ekuntulekeni kokudla ekhaya. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezigcina abantu behlupheka, ezifana: umswakama, izifo, izifo ezithathelwana emanzini, ukuhlaselwa yizilokazane, ukuwa komhlabathi, ukonakala komhlaba, nokuphakama kwenhlabathi. Uma uhluphekile, awukwazi ukuvikela ezinsongweni - mhlawumbe awazi ukuthi kukhona umshwalense nokuthi ungawuthola kanjani. Lapho umswakama uthinta imbewu yakho, uzophela ungena nokudla. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi umuntu ungumuntu ngokwakhe futhi ubamba ikusasa lakhe ezandleni zakhe. Kodwa imvamisa labo abaphatha umhlaba wethu banamandla okuzama ukulawula nokukhomba izimpilo zabantu abangaphansi kwabo. Ukuthuthukiswa kumele kuqale ezingeni eliphansi. Abantu abadinga usizo kumele baqonde kahle ukuthi usizo luzonikezwa kanjani bese bekhuphuka. Imvamisa izinhlelo ezibheka phansi labo abafuna usizo zenze laba balimi baziqhelanise nokwamukela usizo, abakwazi ukusiza ngokwabo. Lapho siqonda ukuthi umuntu ubamba ikusasa lakhe ezandleni zakhe, sizokwazi futhi ukuthi akusizi ukuhlinzeka umuntu ngentlanzi ngoba lokho akuthuthukisi, akufundisi ukuthi akhangele ngempela. Ukuthuthukiswa ngokwakha amandla kunika abantu amandla okusebenza ngokwabo. Ukunikeza kuphela ukudla kwenza abantu bahlale bephumule futhi bamukele kuphela, abakhuli ngokwabo, abafundi ukusebenza ngokwabo. Emphakathini wonke, kukhona abantu abaphatha umhlaba ngendlela engafanele futhi abahluphekayo bayahlupheka. Kukhona izici ezahlukahlukene zomnotho ezidalela ukuhlupheka, abantu abanemali yokonga, labo abakwazi ukuboleka, labo abangasebenzi ngokwabo, ukuntuleka kwezindawo zokugcina ukudla, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza nemishini, ukukhuphuka kwentengo, ukuthengisa, amanani aphansi, ukuntuleka kokuhamba, ukuxhumana, nokuguquguquka kwamanani. Kukhona izifunda ezibonisa ukuhlupheka lapha ezweni lethu. Abantu bayaphumelela, kodwa baqhubeka behlupheka, nakuba kunezinsiza zemvelo ezingasetshenziswa. Izindawo ezinkulu zinomhlabathi ojulile, onothe, kunezinga elanele lokushisa, kanye nezikhukhula ezanele zokukhulisa ukudla okuyisisekelo nezithelo zamafutha. Ukuhlupheka kuletha ukusaba kokuntuleka kokudla ekhaya. Abantu basaba ushintsho ngoba bezama ukuphumelela. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwezinsiza - ikakhulukazi imigwaqo, izikhungo, nezindawo zokomisa ukudla okuyisisekelo. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwemishini yokulima - ama-tractor, ama-ploughs, ama-planters, imishini yokufafaza, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokwesekwa kwezinto eziyisisekelo zokulima. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokufinyelela emalini yokukhiqiza. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokungena emakethe. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokwesekwa okujolile ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Isimo sokuhlinzeka (sokuqala sathuthukiswa nguhulumeni wokuqala sakhula sibe yohlelo olukhulu lokuhlinzeka ng ukudla eMpumalanga Kapa). Kukhona ukuntuleka kolwazi namakhono. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwabantu abahola, abakhiqizi - bonke bephila ezindaweni ezincane futhi bekhulisa ukudla kuphela kubo. Ukuqasha abaqashi kwandisa ingozi yokuhlupheka ngoba basebenza kabi futhi izindleko zokukhiqiza zikhuphuka. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni Zokudla lwe-Grain SA lugxile kakhulu ekukhiqizeni ufulawa. Singazibuza ukuthi kungani sigxila kakhulu kufulawa? Ufulawa uyinsiza yokudla, ngakho ukukhulisa ukukhiqizwa kwefulawa kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuzoba nokudla esikhathini esizayo futhi kukhona imakethe ekhona lapha (kusuka kufulawa oluhlaza (ama-cobs) kuya kumagilebhisi athuthukile). Ufulawa ukhiqizwa ngababalimi lapha, okusho ukuthi kukhona ulwazi olungasetshenziswa ukuze kuqhubeke. Iningi lefulawa lisetshenziswa lapha, futhi ligcinwa ngababalimi ekhaya - ngakho akudingeki ukuhamba, indawo yokomisa, nezindawo ezinkulu zokugcina. Ufulawa uyinsiza ekhula kalula futhi iningi lomsebenzi lingaqedwa ngesandla (lapho kungekho imishini). Lapho kukhona ufulawa oluningi, lungasetshenziswa umndeni wonke, abantu, izinkomo, izimvu, amahhashi, nezinkukhu, nezinkunzi. Ufulawa owanele wenza ukuphila kube ngcono kubo bonke. Kungani ukuthuthukiswa kwababalimi kuthatha isikhathi eside? Ukulima akusiyo into elula, ababalimi kumele bakwazi ukuphatha imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, futhi njalo kube nezinkinga nezingozi ezingavela. Izindleko zokuqala zokufaka ziphakeme futhi amanani okudla aphansi, ngakho kunzima lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukwenza inzuzo ezindaweni lapho kukhona kuphela ukulima okuncike emvula. Intengo yemishini iyamangaza. Ababalimi abanamava nalabo abaphakathi komnotho bayazama - singakuthi yini ngababali abathuthukayo abasaqhubeka nokukhula? Nabo bayazama kakhulu. Sikholelwa ukuthi yini esebenzayo uma sizama ukuphakamisa ababalimi? Wonke umuntu osebenza kulolu hlelo kumele asebenze ngokuzikhandla, ngokwethembeka - ukulima kuhlobene kakhulu nokuphakamisa umbulali, ngemuva kwalokho sizobheka umhlaba. Kumele siqale ngezimboni ezilula zokufaka, bese sihamba siye kwezinye izimboni eziyinkimbinkimbi. Nika umbulali ithuba lokuqala
Kwatholakala emzaneni onomswakamo, ikheli elithi "Bhedlela Lethu" lalingazwelonke, kodwa lalingumfanekiso oncomekayo wokugaya izimo eziphuthumayo. Leli bhedlela lalisendaweni engama-10 amamayela ukusuka phezulu ebhishi, futhi lalingadlalelwa ngabantu bonke, abakhubazekile bahamba ngezinyawo ezinzima, kodwa behamba ngaphansi kwezinhlawulo eziwu-40. Kodwa-ke, njengoba sonke sizwa, ukukhathazeka ngezimo eziphuthumayo kuxhiywa kakhulu uma kuxoxwa ngezimpi ezibhedlela. Usuku lokukhanya kwelanga lungabukeka lungapheli, kanti ukufika kokuqala kugxila umfundi, uThandi. Thandi wayengumfundi omncane, owayefisa ukuba udokotela. Ithuba elinika ithuba lokubona izinqubo ezibalulekile ezibhedlela laye lalikuthakazelisa. Ngobusuku obukhulu obukhanyayo, kwavela umbiko othi, “Umfana osemncane ubhujiswe! Ubonisa izimpawu zokugula okukhulu.” Ngaphandle kokukhubazeka, uThandi wathelwa yimilayezo ngeziteshi kanti ubusuku buyamelana nezinsuku. UThandi, owayeqiniseka, walungiselela ngendlela ekahle. Wabhekwa ngokwakhe njengoMnyango weZimo Eziphuthumayo. Kwathi ngokuhamba kwemizuzu, uThandi ubona umkhosi owawuqhwakaza ebhodini elikhulu labathile. Umfana omncane, uSipho, wayekhalela, ubusuku buphuza, kanti izinyawo zakhe zazimfuna. Izinyanga zethi, “Dedele, dedele!” kukhuluma kodokotela. UThandi, ongenanhloso yokungabaza, wakhumbula zonke izifundo. Odokotela baphenduka, bembesisa izinyathelo zabo, bahlola izinkomba. Njengoba besetha umsebenzi wokusiza, bezibophezela kulokhu babezokwenza. Kwakukhanya ubuhlakani obukhulu, kwagcwala amakhanda, imiqondo iphakanyiswa, izinyathelo zixheguza. Ngalé ndlela, umkhankaso wabophezeleka eluhlaza. Kwakubonakala izithombe zasemoyeni, umoya uthisha imiqondo, uSthandi noMafikizolo. Kwathi ama-oda amaningi eza kuqala, uSiyabonga kwaba yindawo yaphaya. Ama-oda eza ezokwakha, uMafikizolo owayengumqashwa ohamba noMthobisi. Ngokushesha uThandi wahamba nabanye, ukuphakanyiswa kaphayini. “Hamba, yiba mehluko kubuhlungu bentombazane,” kwakhuluma odokotela. “Khumbula amadrol, uphume uphazamiseke kuhannela.” Bonke abamele umngcele maphakathi, kubhajwe indaba yomlilo kulapho okhalayo. UThandi wacabanga ngalokhu: “Kwenziwa kube nezinye izinyathelo. Kukhona udaba lwe-chill, makhulu okubhabhuza, ukuhlaziya lokho hamba hawula. Uhlanga luhlanga lweziqondiso. Gcina unsinda, ubabazeke izinyuma, qhubeka.” Umsuka uqhubekile, amagezo akhanya kucinga ngobumnandi. UThandi wayefisa leliphakanyisiwe, ukuze zikhanya izinkanyezi. Kwenziwa kube nezinye izinyathelo, kwathi konke kwavuka endhausen, izinyathelo ziqhubeka. Uthando lwakhe alulahlwa; ubuhlakani bakhe babhalwa. Njengoba behamba benza izinqumo ezinkulu, uThandi waveridisa. Kwakubhalwa usuku oluthokozisayo oludala. UThandi waphindyeka, waphenduka wathi kuziphiso zakhe, “Zomele zibe neze! Phela, sahamba lwezokinde.” Izinsuku zabo zakhaliwe, zischezuka ngephupho; kube nezinkanyezi. UThandi, oqhube zonke nezinkumbulo, akukwenzeki; akukholwanga; ngaphandle kokubambezeleka. Wazisa izifundo zodokotela, wathi lokhu kudinga ukuhamba kuphela, wayeqonda ukuthi lokho kulishaya. Ekugcineni, ukuqhuba kwaba nomthelela ogcwele. Izinyembezi zathokoziswa phezulu emkhanyeni. UThandi, umnqobi kanye nemikhambi, wahamba phambili ebusuku, aqukethe ikhono lokuqonda izinqubo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela. Umthelela wakhe waba mkhulu, eboleka abantu, wadalela ukukhanya okungapheli. Khumbula, emzini, ukukbala indaba yempumelelo, umnyango wezimali uthokozisa. Kusho kancane, usuku nosuku, izinqumo zikhanya. UThandi waba yindlalifa aphenya ekhanda, woundaba eze, walandela izinyathelo zenqubo. Njengoba elama, izinkanyezi ziqhakaza ezithombeni ezinhle. Bhadali, ezinyakazeni ezavuliwe! UThandi wahamba, futhi yaziwa ukuthi izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ziwuhlengahlanga obubhalwe kahle enkundleni. Ukuba nengqondo, kuza kufanele ibhala, ukuzizwisa, kuyancomeka. Ngakho-ke abantu, izinyathelo ezimbi, izinsiza zanda, ndawonye. Hamba phambili, udokotela wethu osemncane! Zama, kanti ukuphila kuhlotshaniswa nokubambisana. UThandi, imbewu ethokozisayo! Ukukhethela impumelelo, kwavuka umoya, kwavuka sothando. Lokhu kuyoba yindaba ebhaliwe. Futhi izinqubo, ezimbalwa, ikakhulukazi kulesi sikhathi, zijabulisa abathokozayo.
Ukudala Okuqukethwe: Umsebenzi Wokwakha Nokwabelana Ngemibono Emisha Ngomhla ziyi-15 kuNhlaba 2023, izwe liqhubeka nokuhamba phambili kwezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wokudala okuqukethwe. Lokhu kudala okuqukethwe kubalulekile, hhayi kuphela emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, kodwa nasezindaweni eziningi ezifana nezohwebo, ezokungcebeleka, kanye nezokufundisa. Kubantu abaningi, ukudala okuqukethwe kusho ukuveza imibono, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwandisa ubukhona babo kwi-inthanethi. Izingcweti zikhomba ukuthi intuthuko kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi izinsiza ezinjengezinkundla zokuxhumana, kuveze amathuba amasha okwakha okuqukethwe. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokusebenzisa amafoni, amakhompyutha, kanye nezinye izinsiza, kudingeka ukuba babe nekhono lokudala okuqukethwe okuhehayo, okukhanga, futhi okuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baqhubeke nokukhula, befinyelela ezithameli ezinkulu, futhi bahlale bephambili emncintiswaneni. Ubuciko Bokudala Ukwakha okuqukethwe akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyinkonzo yokudala. Abaculi, ababhali, nabachwepheshe bokumaketha bahlala befuna izindlela ezintsha zokuxhumana nezithameli zabo. Ukudala okuqukethwe okuhehayo kudinga ubuciko, ukucabanga ngaphandle kwemikhawulo, kanye nekhono lokuhumusha imizwa nezifiso zabantu. Isibonelo, ababhali bama-blog, abakhiqizi bevidiyo, nabaculi bezithombe badinga ukuqonda kahle izithameli zabo ukuze bakhe okuqukethwe okufanele. Kulezi zinsuku, ukwakha okuqukethwe kuhilela ukuthola umqondo ophusile. Abadala bokuqukethwe bahlala beqhuba ucwaningo, befunda izitayela ezihamba phambili, futhi bezama ukuhamba phambili nezitayela ezisha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi okuqukethwe abakudalayo kuyavumelana nezinguquko, kuphendula izidingo nezifiso zababukeli, futhi kubavumele ukuthi bahlale bephambili emncintiswaneni. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinsiza Ubuchwepheshe buguqule kakhulu indlela esikhiqiza ngayo okuqukethwe. Ama-algorithms, izinhlelo zokusebenza, nezinsiza ezikhulayo zenza kube lula kubantu abaningi ukufinyelela kokudala. Izinsiza ezifana ne-Canva, Adobe Spark, kanye ne-WordPress zenza kube lula kubantu abangaqeqeshelwa ubuchwepheshe bokwakha. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kokuhlangenwe nakho kokudala, lapho abantu abaningi bengakwazi ukwabelana ngemicabango, izindaba, nezithombe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana ne-Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, kanye ne-Twitter zisebenza njengama-portal okuxhumana. Lokhu kudala isiko lokwabelana, lapho abantu bejabulisa futhi bechaza imibono yabo. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zisheshisa inqubo yokukhiqiza, zivumela abantu ukuba bahlale bexhumene, futhi ziqhubekisela phambili izifiso zabo zokwabelana. Izinsiza Zokwakha Okuqukethwe Abadala bokuqukethwe badinga izinsiza ezihlukahlukene ukuze bakhe okuqukethwe okuhle. Lokhu kuhilela izinhlelo zokuhlela, izinsiza zokusebenza, nezinsiza zokuhlola imiphumela. Uhlelo lokusebenza olufana ne-Google Analytics lwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi yini esebenza kahle nokuthi yini engasebenzi. Abadala bokuqukethwe badinga ukuqwashisa ngokuqhubekayo ngezinguquko ezimakethe nasemkhakheni we-inthanethi. Ukwazi izitayela ezisha, imikhuba yokubukela, kanye nezifiso zezitshalo kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okunempilo, okukhanga, nokwanelisayo. Izitayela Zokudala Izitayela zokudala okuqukethwe zihluke kakhulu, kusukela kokubhaliwe kuya kokubonwayo. Ababhali bama-blog bahlala beqhakambisa izindaba ezithokozisayo, bekhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahlale bejabule. Abakhiqizi bevidiyo, ngakolunye uhlangothi, benza okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo nokuqondisayo, okuhlinzeka ngezifundo noma izikhumbuzo ezithokozisayo. Izithombe, imidwebo, kanye nomculo kubalulekile ekwakheni okuqukethwe okuhlangene, okuthokozisayo. Ukwakha okuqukethwe kuhilela ukucabanga ngamasu ahlukahlukene. Ukuhlanganisa izithombe ezinhle, ukwakha izindaba ezithokozisayo, kanye nokuhlola izindlela zokwakha ubudlelwane nezithameli kuyasiza ekuqhakambiseni okuqukethwe. Lokhu kuholela ekwakhiweni kweqoqo elihlangene, elibandakanya zonke lezi zici, ngoba okuqukethwe okuphumelelayo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa kwezinto eziningi. Isiphetho Ngokubheka phambili, kubalulekile ukuthi abadala bokuqukethwe baqhubeke nokuba nomthelela emhlabeni jikelele. Ukudala okuqukethwe akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni izixhumanisi, ukuvusa intshiseko, kanye nokuthuthukisa ubuhlobo. Emhlabeni osakhula ngokuqhubekayo, abantu badinga izindlela zokwakha, ukwabelana, nokuhlanganyela ukuze baphumelele. Ukudala okuqukethwe kubalulekile, futhi kumele kuhlale kubuyekezwa ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zababukeli, kuthuthukiswe ubuhlakani, futhi kugcinwe umoya wokuhlangenwe nakho.
Ngikhuluma ngedokhumenti "enamanani alinganayo" futhi ngizojabula uma ngazi ukuthi impendulo ingalindelwa nini. Inani eliphelele lokudla okukhululekile kanye/noma indawo yokuhlala, uma lingafakiwe ku-2.2.1 noma ku-2.2. Inani eliphelele elilindeleke ukuthi likhokhwe kubo bonke abasebenzi ngaphandle kwabaphathi noma amalungu enkampani noma ikomidi limisiwe ku-R179,088 ngomuntu ngokwesikhathi esichaziwe ngenhla, bheka ku-3.2. Inani eliphelele lokudla okukhululekile - isigaba sesine, uma lingafakiwe ku-3.2.1 noma ku-3.2. Inani eliphelele 3.2.1 + 3.2.2 + 3.2. Qaphela: Uma abasebenzi abanye kanye/noma izimali zabo zihluka kakhulu kulabo bonyaka odlule, chaza kafushane izizathu zalo. Qaphela!! Izitatimende zezimali zingacelwa ngophenyo/ucwaningo lwezimali. Umsebenzi ubhekisela kumuntu oqashwe noma osebenza ngaphansi kwesivumelwano somsebenzi noma sokufunda nesisebenzi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lesi sivumelwano sikhuluma ngokuqondile noma sithiwe ngokuqondile ngempela noma ngobufakazi, noma imali ikalwa ngaleso sikhathi noma ngokuqhuba umsebenzi, noma ngokukhokha noma ngentokozo, kuhlanganisa: umsebenzisi wesikhashana/owesivumelwano oqashwe ukwenza umsebenzi kumqashi, umphathi webhizinisi osebenza enkampanini, noma ilungu lenhlangano yabasebenzi elingene esivumelwaneni somsebenzi noma sokufunda nenhlangano yabaphethe, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi umsebenzisi akashiyi abanikazi bezabelo noma ozakwethu abakhokhelwa kuphela inzalo noma ingxenye yemali engenayo. Qaphela: Umnikazi oyedwa noma ozakwethu bezebhizinisi noma ozakwethu bezolimo abathathwa njengama "basebenzi" njengoba kuchazwe umthetho, ngakho-ke imali yabo yokukhokha akufanele ibonakale. Ukukhokha kuyizinkokhelo zonke ezenziwa njalo, ngaphambi kokuthi kube nezinkokhelo ezithile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziwumsebenzi noma ngokukhipha, kubasebenzi. Uhlu olulandelayo aluphelele kodwa luhloselwe ukukhombisa izinto ezingaba ukukhokha futhi zingadala ukudideka mayelana nokufakwa kwazo noma ukukhipha. Ikhomishini, noma inani lihluka inyanga nenyanga. Lilingana nenani lokudla kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwabasebenzi njengengxenye yemali. Izinkokhelo ezenziwa kubaphathi benkampani noma amalungu e-Close Corporation asebenza kufanele zivezwe ngendlela ehlukile esigabeni 2.2. Uma umsebenzi wakho uqediwe, chaza usuku lokupheliswa kwawo ekhasini elandulele bese uveza izinkokhelo zokugcina ezenziwe ngalolo suku. Le ncwadi ingatholwa uma umqashi ehambisana nezidingo zomthetho, kuhlanganisa: a Ukuthunyelwa kwefomu lokukhokha lakamuva b Ukukhokhwa kwezinkokhelo noma indlela ezizokhokhwa ngayo ihlelwe. c Isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kusenesikhathi ngesonto elilodwa ebhalwe phansi enkampanini d Inombolo yokubhaliswa kufanele iboniswe, kanye nenombolo yocingo ne-fax enekhodi yokushaya e. Izicelo ezithunyelwe ngababonisi noma abamele amaqashi kufanele zenziwe ebhalwe phansi futhi zibe neleta yokugunyazwa - iPower of Attorney. f Izicelo ezithunyelwe zamukelwa g Imizamo yokushintsha okukhulunywe kulezi zinkampani kuyiphutha elinzima.
Ifomu iqukethe indlela yokubika ngezemisebenzi ezilungile emsebenzini ethulwe kuMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Le fomhu ifaka nezidingo zokubika abaqashi abakhethiwe, labo abasebenza ngaphansi kuka-150 noma ngaphezulu kuka-150. Ifomu iphinde ifake umbiko wokuqhubeka okumele uqedwe ngemuva kwesikhathi sokuqala sokubika. Bonke abaqashi abakhethiwe kumele bathumele umbiko njengoba kuchaziwe nguMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi u-55 ka-1998. Noma yisiphi isisebenzi esiqedela umbiko wezobulungiswa bezabasebenzi ngokuzithandela kumele sithumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaJuni 1, 2000, bese kulandela omunye unyaka, ngosuku lokuqala luka-Okthoba 2001. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zalesi formu ngaphandle kweG embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zalesi formu, kuhlanganise neG embikweni olandelayo. Kumele bathumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaDisemba 1, 2000, bese kulandela abanye emva konyaka, ngosuku lokuqala lomsebenzi ngo-Okthoba, kuqala ngo-2002. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, noH embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, G, noH embikweni olandelayo. Kumele baqedele umbuzo 8.2 (izigaba zendawo yokusebenza) kuwo wonke imibiko. Ngokuzithandela, kumele baqedele izingxenye C, D, noE kuwo wonke imibiko.

Amalungu ekomidi lokuhlola aye nguKarabo Peele (Maize Trust), Gerhard Mamabolo (AgriSETA), Jenny Mathews (iqembu elisebenzayo), Dirk van Rensburg (iqembu elisebenzayo), Willie Kotzé, noJane McPherson (abantu abasebenza kulolu hlelo). Sijabule kakhulu ukuthola imoto evela kuVolkswagen eKlerksdorp ukuze sisebenzise kulolu hambo, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba ndawonye. UKoos wazalwa ePaul Roux epulazini likaJulius Bobbert. Waya esikoleni epulazini kuze kube sefinyelela kuStandard 1. Ebusweni bakhe, wadlala nabafana bempesheni kuze kube seqala ukwenza imisebenzi ehlukahlukene epulazini. Waqala ukusebenza endaweni yokudayisa lapho behlaba izinkomo ezikhiqiza inyama nezinye izilwane. Ngemuva kwalokho, waqala ukushayela ithrekta nokusebenza ngemishini iminyaka emihlanu. UKoos uqhubekile nokuba umshayeli wesithuthuthu epulazini futhi wafunda ukuwelding emsebenzini nokwakha nokulungisa imishini. Lapho efika eminyakeni engu-26, wathuthela eMieliebult, epulazini likaFrikkie du Preez, lapho afunda khona okuningi ngemishini, ukuwelding, nokutshala izitshalo. UFrikkie wamsiza kakhulu ukuba akhule, eqala njengomsebenzi nje epulazini waba umkhiqizi wezomnotho ngokwakhe. Ufunde izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esebenza noFrikkie. UFrikkie futhi wamthengisela imishini ehlukahlukene, futhi uKoos wakhokha uFrikkie ngemali ayitholayo. Ngokusebenzisa imishini ayithengile kuFrikkie, waqala ukwenza umsebenzi wezinkontileka, esiza abalimi kwezinye izindawo zokukhula ezizungeze uSenekal. Lo msebenzi wamhelpa ukuhweba ukuze akhokhe isikweletu semishini yakhe. UKoos wabe esethenga iJohn Deere 3140 ne265 Massey Ferguson neminye imishini yokwenza umsebenzi wezinkontileka. Ezinye zezimali ezivela kulolu msebenzi wazisebenzisa ukuthenga izinkomo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, wathenga indawo engu-55 hectares, watshala ummbila, waphuma ithoni ezintathu ngehektare emnyakeni yokuqala. Ngonyaka ka-2007, wanikezwa isithembiso nguMnyango Wezolimo ukuba abe umkhiqizi ophathwayo epulazini laseAstoria lapho ekhuluma khona. UKoos ungumlimi onobuchule futhi uyawazisa usizo aluthola kuGrain SA kanye noMnyango Wezolimo, kodwa ubona ukuthi ukutshala izitshalo ezithengiswayo emapulazini ezomile akukwazi ukuqhubeka unomphela. Isivumelwano phakathi kwakhe noMnyango Wezolimo siba seminyakeni - saqala ngomhla ka-10 kuNovemba 2008, saphela ngoNovemba 2009. Ngaleso sikhathi, uKoos wayengacela ukuthi isivumelwano sihlaziywe ngonyaka olandelayo uma uMnyango ubona ukuthi ipulazi liphathwa kahle. Esikhathini esedlule, umkhiqizi wayengaba nendawo, futhi umlimi wayengathenga ipulazi ukuze libe lakhe, kodwa le mthetho ushintshile; akusacaci ukuthi uKoos uzoba ne-pulazi lelo noma cha. Okwamanje, uMnyango Wezolimo uthi umsebenzi kaKoos uyawajabulela, futhi isivumelwano sokuba umkhiqizi ophathwayo sizophinde sihlaziywe. UKoos ubona ukuthi kunenkinga yokwenza inzuzo ngokulima emhlabeni omile endaweni yaseSenekal; lokhu kuyamkhathaza, futhi manje ufuna ukwandisa ibhizinisi lakhe lokulima ngezinkontileka. Ubuye afune ukuthola umhlaba onokukhiqiza okuhle ukuze aqashe ukuze akhiqize ummbila nemifino. Ubuye ufuna ukwandisa inani lezinkomo epulazini. Enye inkinga mayelana nezinsizakalo ezimbi zikaMnyango Wezolimo ukuhlinzekwa kwemishini kubakhiqizi; uKoos ubuye afune ukuqhubeka ethuthukisa izinhlelo zokunisela kuwo wonke amapulazi epulazini, athenge izinkomo eziningi, futhi atshale izindawo ezintsha zokufuywa emhlabeni omile. UKoos ungumfanekiso omuhle womuntu oqale kwi-zero futhi wasebenza kanzima ukufinyelela lapho ekhona namuhla. Kulungile ukuvakashela kuye epulazini ngoba zonke izinto zakhe zigcinwe kahle efasiteleni lakhe. Zonke izinsiza zakhe zisebenza kahle futhi zigcinwe efasiteleni. Ubandile noLydia, futhi banezingane ezintathu, amantombazane amabili nomfana, uClifford. UPetunia, omunye wamantombazane, ufunde ezolimo futhi manje ungumxhumanisi wokuqhubeka wabelana ngolwazi; usebenza endaweni yaseFicksburg. UClifford ufunde ukumaketha iminyaka emibili futhi wasebenza iminyaka emibili emaphoyiseni; manje usepulazini esebenza noyise. Uthanda nemishini, njengoba kubonakala uma ubheka zonke izinsiza zakhe eziphathwe kahle. UKoos nomndeni wakhe bahlala epulazini; bangumfanekiso omuhle wokuguqulwa okudingekayo kulolu hlelo lokulima. Uqale esikoleni eMotswenyane Primary School ngo-1966 waphuma ngo-1971 ngemuva kokuphumelela kuStandard 5 (Grade 7). Ngo-1997 waqala ukusebenza eStilfontein Panelbeaters enza imisebenzi ehlukahlukene. Wabe esethuthela ukusebenza eMarico Foodstar ezinyangeni ezithile. Waphuma lapho waya ukusebenza eStilfontein Goldmine njengomshayeli wesitimela esigodini. Ubandile noAtholia Lolwane, futhi banezingane ezinhlanu, amantombazane amabili namadodana amathathu. Indodana enkulu, uJoseph (32), usebenza eMnyangweni Wezempilo eSchweizer-Reineke. UProgress (30) usebenza eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. UGladwin (28) usebenza eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela kodwa manje usebenza noyise epulazini. Isingeniso Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ama-social media asebenza njengendlela ebalulekile yokuxhumana nokuqhakambisa imicabango, izenzakalo, nezindaba. Ukuze uthole izinzuzo eziphelele ezivela kumapulatifomu ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuqonda indlela yokuwasebenzisa kahle. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa ama-social media ngendlela efanele, ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo 1: Khetha I-Pulatifomu Efanele Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukukhetha ipulatifomu efanele yokuxhumana. Ama-social media ahlukene anemigomo ehlukene. Isibonelo, uma uhlose ukwabelana ngezithombe nezindaba zomphakathi, i-Instagram ingaba yindlela efanele. Uma uhlose ukuxoxa ngezindaba ezinzima, i-Twitter noma i-Facebook zingaba izinketho ezinhle. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi kahle izithameli zakho nokuthi iyiphi ipulatifomu ezohlangabezana nezidingo zakho. Isinyathelo 2: Dala Iphrofayela Ehlelekile Ngemva kokukhetha ipulatifomu, isinyathelo esilandelayo ukudala iphrofayela ehlelekile. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufaka isithombe esifanele, igama elihambisana nomkhiqizo noma umqondo ofuna ukuwethula, kanye nolwazi olufanele. Qiniseka ukuthi ulwazi olufakiwe lukhombisa ubunikazi bakho futhi luhambisana nezithameli ozihlosile. Iphrofayela yakho iyisikhangiso sokuqala, ngakho kufanele ibonakale kahle. Isinyathelo 3: Thuthukisa Okuqukethwe Okubalulekile Ukuze uheha abantu, kubalulekile ukuphehla okuqukethwe okubalulekile. Lokhu kungaba izithombe, amavidiyo, noma imibhalo ethokozisayo. Qiniseka ukuthi okuqukethwe kwakho kuhlobene nezithameli zakho futhi kubonisa ubuchwepheshe bakho. Futhi, zama ukusebenzisa izithombe eziphezulu nezincazelo ezicacile. Ukuqukethwe okuthakazelisayo kuzokwenza abantu babuyele njalo. Isinyathelo 4: Xhumana Ngezikhathi Ezingafanele Ukuxhumana nabalandeli bakho kubalulekile. Ungakwazi ukwenza lokhu ngokuphendula imibuzo, ukwabelana ngemicabango, noma ukudala izingxoxo ezithokozisayo. Hlanganisa imicabango yakho nezithameli zakho, futhi ungabazi ukusebenzisa ama-hashtag ukuze uthole abalandeli abaningi. Ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kuzokwakha umphakathi ozungezile, okuzosiza ekwandiseni ukufinyelela kwakho. Isinyathelo 5: Hlala Uvuselelwa Ama-social media avame ukushintsha, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuhlala uvuselelwa ngezinguquko ezisemkhakheni. Landela izitayela ezintsha, ubuke ukuthi abanye abantu bakhuluma ngani, futhi ube nekhono lokushintsha indlela ophila ngayo ukuze ufinyelele izithameli zakho. Ukubona izinguquko ezibalulekile kuzokwenza uqhubeke uthokozisa abalandeli bakho. Isinyathelo 6: Qapha Imiphumela Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuqapha imiphumela yokusebenza kwakho. Sebenzisa amathuluzi wokuhlaziya ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi izikhangiso ezisebenza kahle kakhulu, nokuthi yiziphi izindlela ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kangcono izidingo nezifiso zezakhamuzi zakho, okuzokwenza uthuthukise okuqukethwe kwakho. Isiphetho Ama-social media angaba ithuluzi elinamandla uma esetshenziswa kahle. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukwenza iphrofayela yakho ibonakale, uheha abalandeli, futhi wakhe umphakathi ozungezile. Khumbula, ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo kudinga isikhathi nokuzinikela, kodwa imiphumela izoba yinhle. Qhubeka uqhubeke, uvuselele, futhi ujabulele ukuhamba kwakho emhlabeni wama-social media.
uWinston Churchill: Umholi Ohloniphekile Noma Umuntu Othakazelisayo? U-Winston Churchill, igama elidumile emlandweni, ubonakala njengomholi onamandla, kodwa futhi ungumuntu ophikisanayo. Njengoba sibheka impilo yakhe, sithola izici eziningi ezithokozisayo nezithakazelisayo, ezihlanganisa ubuholi bakhe, izinqumo zakhe, kanye nemibono yakhe. U-Churchill wayengumuntu ophikisanayo, owazalelwa eNgilandi ngo-1874, futhi waba yisithonjana sokuhola ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili. Ukwaziwa kukaChurchill kuqala ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe yokuqala, lapho abamba khona izikhundla ezahlukene kuhulumeni. Nokho, kwaba ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili lapho waba khona khona umholi ophambili. U-Churchill waba nguNdunankulu weNgilandi ngo-1940, ngesikhathi esinzima lapho izwe lalisengozini yokuhlaselwa yiJalimane. Ubuqotho bakhe, ubuholi obuqinile, kanye nezwi lakhe elinamandla kwasiza ukuvusa umoya wokulwa phakathi kwabantu baseNgilandi. Izinkulumo zakhe, ezaziwa kakhulu, zashukumisa izinkanyezi zenkululeko, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bangayeki, baphikelele ekulweni. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle ngalesi sikhathi. U-Churchill wayenobuntu obuphikisanayo, futhi izinqumo zakhe zathinta izimpilo zabantu abaningi. Ngokwesibonelo, izinqumo zakhe mayelana nezimpi zempucuko zashiya umphakathi we-India uphakathi kokuphikisana. U-Churchill wayengakuthandi ukuhlinzeka ngenkululeko, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqumo zakhe. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba engumholi ophumelelayo, wayenobuntu obungathandeki, obuholela ekuphikisaneni. U-Churchill wayengumuntu onobuhlakani obukhulu, futhi lokhu kwavela emisebenzini yakhe yokubhala. Wabhala izincwadi eziningi, ezihlanganisa izincwadi ezithinta umlando, ezokupolitiki, kanye nezincwadi ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi wayengumuntu onothando lokufunda, futhi wayezama ukuchaza izimo ezinzima ezazibhekene nezwe. U-Churchill wayengumuntu ophokophelelayo, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezombusazwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, u-Churchill wayengumholi owayekwazi ukuhamba phambili ngezikhathi ezinzima. Ubuqotho bakhe, ubuholi obuqinile, kanye nezwi lakhe elinamandla kwasiza ukuvusa umoya wokulwa phakathi kwabantu baseNgilandi. Izinkulumo zakhe, ezaziwa kakhulu, zashukumisa izinkanyezi zenkululeko, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bangayeki, baphikelele ekulweni. Lokhu kwenza uChurchill waba yisithonjana sokuhola, futhi abantu bahlala bemkhumbula njengomholi onamandla. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uChurchill wayengumuntu ophikisanayo. Izinkolelo zakhe zashiya umphakathi uphakathi kokuphikisana, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqumo zakhe. U-Churchill wayengakuthandi ukuhlinzeka ngenkululeko, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqumo zakhe. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, nakuba engumholi ophumelelayo, wayenobuntu obungathandeki, obuholela ekuphikisaneni. U-Churchill uphinde abe nesandla esikhulu ekwakheni umhlaba wanamuhla. Ngemva kwempi, waba nesandla ekwakheni izivumelwano ezibalulekile, ezazihlanganisa izizwe ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe, futhi kwasiza ekwakheni umhlaba ophumelelayo. U-Churchill wayengumholi owayekwazi ukuhamba phambili ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezombusazwe. Ngokuphetha, uWinston Churchill ungumholi ohloniphekile, kodwa futhi ungumuntu ophikisanayo. Ubuqotho bakhe, ubuholi obuqinile, kanye nezwi lakhe elinamandla kwasiza ukuvusa umoya wokulwa phakathi kwabantu baseNgilandi. Nokho, izinqumo zakhe zashiya umphakathi uphakathi kokuphikisana, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abanye baphikise izinqumo zakhe. U-Churchill ungumholi owayekwazi ukuhamba phambili ngezikhathi ezinzima, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni wezombusazwe. Ubuqotho bakhe, ubuholi obuqinile, kanye nezwi lakhe elinamandla kwasiza ukuvusa umoya wokulwa phakathi kwabantu baseNgilandi. U-Churchill ungumholi ohloniphekile, kodwa futhi ungumuntu ophikisanayo. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukusho ukuthi uChurchill ungubani ngempela, kodwa okukhona kucacile ukuthi umthelela wakhe emlandweni awukwazi ukwenqaba.
Uhlelo lokutshala imali ku-Just Energy Transition (JET) luhloswe ukuthuthukisa ikusasa elihlanzekile futhi elizinzile, ikakhulukazi njengoba sikhathazekile ngempilo yomhlaba kanye nezinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wamandla. Lokhu kubhekwa njengendlela yokuhlangabezana nezidingo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon, ngenkathi kuqinisekiswa ukuthi imiphakathi ethintekayo ithola izinzuzo. Uhlelo lwe-JET luhlanganisa izinyathelo eziningi, ezifana nokutshala imali ezinhlelweni zamandla avuselelekayo, ukwakha izinhlelo zokugcina amandla, nokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe obusha obungasiza ekwehliseni ukuncika kumafutha emvelo. Kubalulekile ukuba kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo. Njengamanje, izifunda eziningi zikhathazekile ngempilo yomphakathi kanye nomthelela wezinguquko zesimo sezulu. Ukuze uhlelo lwe-JET luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuxhumana kahle phakathi kwabathintekayo, okuhlanganisa ukufaka izidingo zomphakathi kanye nezisebenzi ezikhona ezindaweni ezithintekayo. Uhlelo luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamathemba emisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikude nezithintekayo kakhulu, ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela emisebenzini kulabo abavela emiphakathini ethintekayo, abavame ukuba nezinselelo ekutholeni imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lwe-JET luhlose ukunciphisa ukuncika kumafutha emvelo, okuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokukhiqiza amandla. Uhlaka lwe-JET luhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yamandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha iziteshi zamandla avuselelekayo, izinhlelo zokugcina amandla, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwakha. Uhlelo lwe-JET luhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokwakha izinhlelo ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemithombo yamandla. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo zokufundisa nokuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela emisebenzini emisha. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ithola izinzuzo ezivela ekuhlinzekeni kwamandla avuselelekayo. Ukuze uhlelo lwe-JET luphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinkampani ezizimele, uhulumeni, kanye nemiphakathi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yokwakha, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza amandla.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubonakale ungumgogodla wokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, njengoba izwe lethu lidlula ezikhathini ezinzima zokuphikisana kwezombusazwe, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngezinsongo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalolu shintsho. Ngaphandle kokungabaza, lesi simo sithinta izimpilo zethu njengabavoti kanye nokwakha isizinda esiqinile sezombusazwe. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act uhlose ukuvumela ukuthi kube nezinguquko ezithile ezindleleni zokhetho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwandiswa kokufinyelela kwabantu abaningi emisebenzini yokhetho, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokuvota. Nokho, lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuphatha izinguquko ezinjalo ngendlela efanele. Izinselelo ezivela kulokhu zikhona, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutheni abantu bazi kahle ukuthi lezi zinguquko ziwusizo kanjani. Okwesibili, umthetho lo uzama ukwakha isithombe esisha sokuphatha izinkampani ezimaphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala njengokuhlosiwe okuhle, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavoti bayazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza kanjani. Uma abantu bengazi kahle ukuthi bangabamba kanjani iqhaza, lokhu kungaholela ekunciphiseni inani labantu abavota, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokwakha isithombe esihle sokhetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubeka izinkinga ezithile mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Izinsiza ezikhona kufanele zibe sezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abavoti, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlelo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni abeke izinsiza ezanele ukuze kube nokwenzeka kokuvota. Uma lokhu kungaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthi abantu abaningi bayashesha ukuvota, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokuphepha zihlala zikhona. Ngaphandle kokuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubeke izinhlelo zokuvikela, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zokuphepha zingaholela ekunciphiseni ukwethenjwa kwabavoti. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi ukuvota kungaba yingozi, kuzobangela ukuthi baphume ezinkampanini zabo bangenandaba nokuthi baphinde bavote. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezinamandla zokuvikela abavoti, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abantu bangavota ngaphandle kokwesaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho lo ubeka izinqubo ezinzima ezihambisana nokubhaliswa kwabavoti. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangabhalisela ukuvota kanjani, futhi kube nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze basize labo abangenazo izinsiza ezanele. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubhaliswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abavoti bazi kahle ukuthi bangabhalisela kanjani ukuvota. Uma lokhu kungaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthi abantu abaningi bayashesha ukuvota, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile. Okwamanje, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabavoti. Umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubeka izinhlelo ezithile zokwakha ukwethenjwa, kodwa lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezibucayi phakathi kwabavoti kanye nohulumeni, ukuze abantu bazi kahle ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo ziyavumelana nezidingo zabo. Uma lokhu kungaqinisekiswa, sizobona ukuthi abantu abaningi bayashesha ukuvota, okuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile. Ekugcineni, umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ubonakala ungumgogodla wokuthuthukisa izinqubo zokhetho, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukufinyelela kulolu hlelo. Izinselelo ezikhona zidinga ukuthi sibe nekhono lokuphatha izinguquko ezinjalo ngendlela efanele. Uma sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezanele, ukuvikela abavoti, nokwakha ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabavoti, sizobona ukuthi umthetho lo uzoba yimpumelelo enkulu ekwakheni isithombe esihle sokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, akusizi kuphela ukuba nomthetho omuhle, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nezinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangabamba kanjani iqhaza. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela enembile, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izwe lethu lihlala likhululekile, linobulungiswa, futhi linokuthula. Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act zidinga ukuba ziqhutshekwe, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili njengabantu abavota, sizwakalise izwi lethu, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemiphakathini. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemakhaya kuphathwa kakhulu ngamaKhosi noma abaholi bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaKhosi nabaphathi futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulukazi ngezenzo zomthetho wendabuko. Ngaphansi kweSigaba 211 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wendabuko uyavunywa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho ezihambisana nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wendabuko njengoba kwenzeke ngaphambi kokuba kuqaliswe umthethosisekelo omusha, kodwa lo mthetho kufanele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona kanye nomthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhiwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 16 seSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo, eyenza ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neNkantolo Yendabuko ezazikhona ekuqaleni komthethosisekelo ziqhubeke nokusebenza futhi zisebenzise amandla azo omthetho njengoba kunikezwe. Ukusebenza kwalezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ifaka phakathi ethile eyakhiwe ngaphambi komthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezazikhona kanye nezigodi. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yangaphambilini eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngokubika komthetho, uMongameli wezwe udlulisele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuhambisana neSigaba 14 seSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko ngeNkantolo Yendabuko & Imisebenzi Yezobulungiswa Yabaphathi Bendabuko: osuku lwe-21 kuJanuwari 2003: iSA Law Commission ikhasi 1. Umkhawulo wamandla ungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwenkantolo yokuzwa udaba nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho-ke, umkhawulo wamandla usinika ulwazi ngamandla nemikhawulo enikezwe enkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe endabeni lapho inkantolo ingenawo umkhawulo sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Uma sibheka umthetho okhona, imiqondo yomkhawulo ivela ezinhlelweni nasezithile zemithetho. Le mithetho ivela kumthetho ojwayelekile kodwa ingase ibhalwe njengezibopho. Isibonelo sokubhalwa kwalezi zinto umthetho wezinkantolo zamasipala. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ehlobene nomkhawulo. Ngokuhambisana nalomthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe nomkhawulo, kufanele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kufanele ibe nomkhawulo phezu komuntu wephikiso kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wemikhawulo uhambisana nomgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanelekile. Umkhawulo wenkantolo uhambisana nomkhawulo wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Umkhawulo wenkantolo uhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echaziwe. Le misho ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphikisi ulandela indawo lapho umphikiswa ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphikisi kufanele alivule enkantolo enomkhawulo phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Kuvame ukuba yinkantolo yendawo lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphikisi ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezahlukene ngaphansi kwalomthetho: ngokwesibonelo; inkantolo inemkhawulo ngoba umphumela wesenzo wenzeka ngaphakathi kwendawo elawulwa leyo nkantolo. Mayelana neSigaba 28(d) seMagistrates' Courts Act No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sikhombisa ukuthi ukuze le nkantolo ibe nomkhawulo, umphumela wesenzo kufanele uvele ngokuphelele ngaphakathi kwendawo enikezwe le nkantolo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe nomkhawulo phezu kwendaba eyodwa. Njengoba umphikisi enelungelo lokulawula icala, bangakhetha inkantolo ezoyizwa indaba yabo. Ngokuvamile, umphikisi ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana nabo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isimo sifanele kangakanani kumphikisi. Umkhawulo unqunywa ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha leyo miyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula umkhawulo wayo, isebenza ngaphezu kwamandla ayo kuze kube icala liphothuliwe. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ku-819. Uma inkantolo yayinomkhawulo ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho ezimweni aluzoshintshi umkhawulo wenkantolo. Ngokwesibonelo: inkantolo inemkhawulo ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo bephila ngaphakathi komkhawulo wayo, iqhubeka nokuba nomkhawulo phezu kwendaba noma ngabe emva kokunikeza imiyalo, umphikisi akasahlali endaweni yenkantolo. Le ndawo ihambisana nomkhawulo wenkantolo. Umsebenzi wazo zonke iziphathimandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkantolo yayo inemkhawulo yokuzwa indaba ethulwa phambi kwayo. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi mayelana nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwenkambo kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kufanele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezakhamuzi zendabuko, kusekhona umgomo okhona ophathelene nenani lemali. Ngisho nasekutheni kungekho umkhawulo wemali, iLaw Commission mayelana Nezisebenzi Zomthetho Wendabuko yenze izincomo zokuqala zamagugu azosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo somthetho wendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo engenawo amandla okuphikisa icala lakhe futhi engakwenzi ukuphikisa ngaphambi kwenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okuzwa indaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuba alawulwe yimithetho yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) seMagistrates' Courts Act No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kulungisiwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenalo ummeli, isiphathimandla esiphethe sinesibopho sokubuza ngokwabo (mero mutu) mayelana namandla omkhawulo okuphikisa indaba kule nkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli kumphikisi, isiphathimandla senkantolo ngeke sibuze ngokwabo mayelana namandla omkhawulo wenkantolo okuphikisa icala. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo ingenawo amandla okuphikisa icala, umuntu owafaka kufanele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ilungile ukuphikisa icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weLaw Commission ngeNkantolo Yendabuko, ikhasi 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokukhuluma ukuthi inkantolo ayinayo ilungelo lokuphikisa icala ingabavusa ukuba baveze ubufakazi bokuthi kungani bekwenza njalo. Umqondo womkhawulo uhambisana nokuhlukaniswa kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa amandla nemigomo yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lomkhawulo nemikhawulo, inkantolo yomthetho ihlala njengenkantolo yokuqala noma njengenkantolo yokuphikisa. Inkantolo yeMthethosisekelo iyinkantolo ephezulu ezweni mayelana nezindaba zomthethosisekelo. In
Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha Impilo Yomphakathi Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba, umphakathi wethu ubuhlangana endaweni ethokomele eMphakathini, ukuze kuqhutshwe umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72. Lo mcimbi wawuhloselwe ukukhuthaza impilo, ukwazisa umphakathi ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zezempilo. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo evulekile, lapho umholi wendawo, uMnu. Mthembu, ethula umbono wakhe ngempilo yomphakathi. Uthe, "Impilo yethu iyigugu, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izikhungo zethu zezempilo." Le nkulumo yakhuthaza abantu ukuba babonise intshiseko yabo ngempilo, futhi yakhuthaza izinhlelo ezizayo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zezempilo. Ngemuva kwalokho, abezindaba baphinde bathola ithuba lokuxoxa nabaholi bezikhungo zezempilo. UDokotela Ndlovu, ophatha isikhungo sezempilo esikhulu, wabelane ngempumelelo ezikhungweni zabo. Uthe, "Siyazi ukuthi izikhungo zethu zidinga ukwesekwa, futhi sizimisele ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza eziphezulu ukuze sithuthukise impilo yomphakathi." Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezibhekene nezikhungo, kanye nezixazululo ezitholakalayo. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nemisebenzi ehlukahlukene, efana nezifundo zokwelapha, izikhumbuzo zokuhlola impilo, kanye nemidlalo yokukhuthaza impilo. Abantu babenethuba lokuhlola izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengokuhlolwa kwegazi, ukuhlolwa kwecholesterol, kanye nezifundo zokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kwavula amehlo abantu abaningi, futhi kwakhuthaza ukwakha imikhuba emihle yokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nabantu abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izibhedlela, izikhungo zokwelapha, kanye nezikhungo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokuxhumana, futhi kwasiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezikhungo. UMsizi, ophatha isikhungo sokwelapha esincane, uthe, "Siyajabula ukuba sikhona lapha, futhi sithanda ukuxhumana nabanye ukuze sithuthukise izinsiza zethu." Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokuhlonipha abaholi bendawo abenze umsebenzi omuhle emkhakheni wezempilo. UMsizi Nandi, ophatha isikhungo sokwelapha esiphakathi kwedolobha, wathola umklomelo wokuhlonishwa. Uthe, "Ngiyabonga, kodwa lokhu akukona kuphela umsebenzi wami; kuyinsiza yomphakathi wonke." Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokukhumbuza abantu ukuthi impilo ayiyona eyomuntu oyedwa, kodwa iyinsiza yomphakathi wonke. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi abantu baphuma bejabule, bephuma nemibono emisha yokuthuthukisa impilo yabo. UMsizi Mthembu uthe, "Siyabonga kubo bonke abathatheke kulo mcimbi. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yethu." Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi uma umphakathi uhambisana, ungakha izikhungo zezempilo ezizokwenza umehluko empilweni yabantu. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi wezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 ubonise ukuthi impilo iyigugu, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zethu. Umphakathi ubonise ukuthi uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngempilo yethu sonke. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu, futhi sikhumbuza ukuthi impilo iyinsiza esiyidingayo ukuze siphile kahle. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi sithuthukise izikhungo zethu ukuze sibe nempilo engcono.
Izinkondlo: Uhlanga Lwezwi Kwakukhona edolobheni elincane, elalaziwa ngempela ngothando lwezinkondlo. Abantu bahlala bejabule, bephila impilo enothando nolwazi. UThandi, umntwana ophakathi kweminyaka eyishumi nambili, wayenothando olukhulu lwezinkondlo. Wayezithokozela kakhulu izinkondlo ezazibhaliwe, kodwa wayefisa ukuba naye umoya wokubhala. Ngolunye usuku, uThandi wanquma ukuthi uzokwakha izinkondlo zakhe. Wathatha iphepha elikhulu, wanikeza umoya wakhe ithuba lokuphuma. Waqala ukubhala ngezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo ezisemkhathini, ezazimangaza izinkanyezi ezincane ezazikhanya phezulu. "Ngiyabonga, Moya, ngokunginika ubuhle," wabhalela. UThandi wathola ukuthi izinkanyezi zikhuluma naye, zimbuza ngezifiso zakhe, nezinkumbulo ezimnandi. Wabhalela izinkanyezi, wathi: "Nginomoya omuhle, ngifuna ukwakha umhlaba wezinkondlo, lapho uthando lungakhanya khona." UThandi wathola injabulo enkulu ekubhaleni, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zathokozisa umoya wakhe. Ngesikhathi edlula emgwaqweni, uThandi wahlangana noMama Nandi, umphakathi owaziwa ngempela ngothando lwezinkondlo. UMama Nandi wayengumculi ophumelelayo, futhi wathandwa kakhulu. UThandi wamtshela ngothando lwakhe lwezinkondlo. UMama Nandi wamomotheka, wathi: "Ngiyazi ukuthi ungumshayi wezinkondlo, kodwa kufanele ufunde nokubhala kahle. Ngizokuthokozisa ngalezi zinsuku." UThandi wathola ithuba lokufunda noMama Nandi. Wafunda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, ezinjengothando, ubuhlungu, nemizwa. UMama Nandi wayefundisa uThandi ukuthi izinkondlo zifana nehlathi, lapho izithombe zikhula khona. "Uhlanga lwezwi luthokozisa, lwenza umhlaba ube mnyama," kusho uMama Nandi. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uThandi waqala ukubhala izinkondlo ezinhle. Wawathokozisa abantu ababephila edolobheni. UThandi wabhala izinkondlo ezazikhuluma ngothando, ubuhlungu, nemizwa eyahlukene. Abantu babefunda izinkondlo zakhe, babethokozisa, futhi uThandi waba yinkanyezi edolobheni. Kodwa, kwaba nesikhathi lapho uThandi waba nesikhathi esinzima. Wazizwa engazizwa kahle, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zathola ubunzima. Wazama ukubhala, kodwa amagama awazange aphume. Wazizwa njengomoya opholile, ungakwazi ukukhuluma. UMama Nandi wabona lokhu, wathi: "UThandi, khumbula, izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ungazikhathazi, phumula, futhi uzobona umoya wakho uphinde uvulekele." UThandi wathola ithuba lokuphumula, wagcina esebenzisa isikhathi sokuhlola imizwa yakhe. Waqala ukubhala izinkondlo ezazikhuluma ngaleso sikhathi esinzima. Wabhalela izinkanyezi ezazimkhumbuza ukuthi ubuhlungu bungaba yinsika yokukhula. Wafunda ukuthi izinkondlo azikhulumi kuphela ngothando, kodwa futhi zikhuluma ngempilo yonke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi waphinde waba namandla. Wabhalela umphakathi izinkondlo ezazihamba phambili. UThandi waqonda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinselelo, kodwa zikhuluma futhi ngempumelelo. Waqhubeka nokubhala, futhi abantu baphenduka, bejabulile. UThandi waba yisibonelo somphakathi, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zaba nesithakazelo esikhulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waba umbhali wezinkondlo owaziwa emhlabeni wonke. Izinkondlo zakhe zaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, zikhanya emhlabeni. Wafunda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, kodwa zikhuluma futhi ngothando, ubuhlungu, nemizwa. UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinkondlo zingaba yindlela yokukhuluma, nokuthi umoya wokubhala ungathokozisa abantu. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba nomoya ophakeme. Waqonda ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngempilo, zikhuluma ngothando, nezinkumbulo. Waqhubeka nokubhala, futhi izinkanyezi zakhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi izinkondlo zikhuluma ngezinto ezimnandi, nezinto ezinzima. UThandi waba yinkanyezi, futhi izinkondlo zakhe zaba yizinkanyezi ezikhanyayo emhlabeni.
Okwamanje, kukhona impumelelo kwezomnotho, umgomo kahulumeni obanzi wokuhlukahluka okukhulu, izinhlelo zamasu, nezinye izinhlelo, lapho ukuhlukahluka komlando kuqhubeka nokuba yingxenye yomnotho wezolimo, kuveza njengokuphikisana nokukhula, kuthuthukisa umnotho, kudala imisebenzi, futhi kwehlisa ubumpofu. Ukungalingani okukhulu emrace nasebantwini abesifazane ekufinyeleleni emnothweni, emalini, emakhono, nasekusebenzeni kuqhubeka. Njengomphumela, lesi sikhungo siqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphansi kwamathuba awo. Lo mbhalo rasmi we-NAMC uhlose ukwazisa bonke abathintekayo emkhakheni wezolimo mayelana namandla e-NAMC kanye nezinhlelo zayo ezahlukene ezihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lesi sikhungo sikhona futhi sishintshile. Ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana, sinikeza amatafula anemininingwane yokuxhumana ngezinhlelo ezahlukene zezolimo kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni. Ukunikeza iseluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezolimo kanye namathimba afanele ngqo ngezinto zonke ezihlobene nokumaketha kwezolimo emikhakheni yokudla nezolimo, ngenkathi kuqashelwa izidingo zabahlanganyeli. Ukuba umeluleki obalulekile kuNgqongqoshe, i-DoA, kanye nomkhakha wokumaketha kwezolimo nemikhiqizo. I-NAMC iqhuba imisebenzi yayo ngezinhlelo ezine zobuchwepheshe kanye nohlelo lokweseka olusebenza ngokuhambisana. Izindawo ezisemqoka zokusebenza ze-unit zifaka phakathi Izinhlelo Zokumaketha/AgriBEE, Ukumaketha, kanye Nokuncintisana. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ziyizinhlelo eziyinhloko ezitholwe yi-NAMC ezihloselwe ukukhuthaza nokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwabafama abasafufusa emkhakheni wezolimo nokumaketha, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo evela kubafama abamnyama emaketeni. Imikhakha ye-red meat kanye ne-citrus igqamile njengemikhakha ebalulekile kule nhlelo yesikhathi esifushane. Lesi sikhungo siphinde sibe nesibopho sokunikeza iseluleko kuMkhandlu ngezindaba ezihlobene nezintela nokumaketha nokwenza ucwaningo oluhambelana nalesi sikhala. Ekugcineni, umkhakha Wokumaketha Nokuthengisa uzoba namandla abalulekile ekuhlinzekeni ngocwaningo nasezingxoxweni eziphathelene nezimo zokuncintisana emkhakheni wezolimo, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokumaketha kwezolimo. I-NAMC okwamanje iyathuthukisa izinhlelo ezahlukene Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ezihloselwe ukusiza umnotho wezolimo. Inhloso eyinhloko yezi zinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakethe ukuhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo emakethe ukuze kuthengwe kubakhiqizi abasafufusa. Inhloso wukwakha nokusebenzisa okungenani lezi zinhlelo ezintathu ngonyaka. Lokhu kubhekwa njengomsebenzi obalulekile osekela Ukumaketha Kwezolimo kwe-DoA kanye necebo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi kanye necebo Lokumaketha Kwezolimo ukuze kuqaliswe izinhlelo ezine Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ngaphambi kukaMashi 2006. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe zizohlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlanganisa abafama abamnyama ngaphakathi kwezi zinhlelo. Umgomo wezintela ubhekisela ekufakweni kwezintela noma ekukhipheni kwezintela noma ekuhlinzekeni kwezintela ezikhona ezithengiswayo emhlabeni jikelele ngenhloso yokufeza izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kukahulumeni. Inhloso eyinhloko yomgomo wezintela, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuvikela imikhakha yendawo, ukuthuthukisa isikhundla sokuncintisana kwabakhangisi bendawo, nokuhlanganisa izintela zokungenisa nemikhiqizo efanayo yendawo. I-NAMC, ngokusebenzisa umkhakha wayo Wokumaketha Nokuthengisa, izozama ukuqhubeka nobudlelwano bokubambisana ne-ITAC futhi iqale ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ezingxoxweni zomgomo wezintela eziphathelene nezolimo. Iphuzu lokuqala lizoba ukwakha amandla ethu ngaphakathi esizokwazi ukufinyelela ngokuqasha abantu abasebenza kwezomnotho wokumaketha kwezolimo ngesikhathi sokwethulwa kwalesi sibalo. Umgomo wesigaba ukuhlela nokubhala, kusetshenziswa izibonelo zocwaningo, izindlela ezinhle zokusekela abafama. Lesi sikhungo sizothuthukisa futhi sikwazise ama-template azokhuthaza ukuxhumana kokumaketha okuzohlanganisa Amabhizinisi Ahluphekayo Ngaphambili emnothweni wezolimo wesibili (umnotho oyinhloko). Ibhizinisi kufanele likwazi futhi likwazi ukungena esivumelwaneni sokwabelana ngezindleko nosizo oludingekayo ngesisekelo sokuthola i-NAMC. I-NAMC ihlose ukusungula ifa elihloselwe ukusiza lezi zibalo ukufinyelela kudathabheyisi yabanikazi bempahla ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kwabo emakethe futhi ngaleyo ndlela bakhule futhi baqinise amabhizinisi abo. Usizo luzobhekana ngqo nezindaba ezifana noktraining, ukuthuthukiswa kwecebo lebhizinisi, izinhlelo ezifanele zokufakazela, ukuhola, njll. Lokhu kuzohlinzekwa ngababoneleli bezinsizakalo abavunyelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezifundo. Umgomo ohlobene nokusetshenziswa nokuphathwa kwemali uzothuthukiswa. I-ATAF ayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo yezimali (ukukweleta noma izipho) noma ukuthenga izimpahla zohlobo oluthile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimoto, izakhiwo, imishini, nezakhiwo zomzimba. I-ATAF futhi ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengofundo lwezikweletu noma nganoma iyiphi enye injongo. I-DoA AgriBEE ifa lizokwakhiwa maduze ukuze liqondise lezi zenzo ezifanele ezithuthukiswe ngokusebenzisa i-ATAF. Ukwakha idathabheyisi yabanikazi bempahla abahluphekayo ngaphambili eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhumanisa labo abakwi-database nezimakethe ezifanele. Ukuqhubeka Nokuthuthukiswa Kokuthunyelwa. Umsebenzi obalulekile weMkhakha Wokuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi (ED Sector) ukuhlela izivakashi eziphumelelayo ezikhangisweni zokuhweba zamabhizinisi akwi-database yabanikazi bempahla. Lezi zivakashi zizosebenza ukusiza lezi zibalo ezahluphekayo ngaphambili kwi-database yabanikazi bempahla ukuze ziveze ukuncintisana emakethe yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze zifinyelele emakethe yokuthunyelwa. Ukuxhumana komphakeli kuqala ngokukhiqiza ngenkampani yezolimo noma ngokukwazi kwayo ukukhiqiza. Imakethe kumele itholakale ukuze kukhiqizwe. Umkhakha we-ED uzosebenzisa i-ATAF lapho kudingeka ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana komjikelezo wokuhlinzeka. Ukuxhumana kokufuna kuqala ngemandla emakethe. Amabhizinisi amakhulu ezolimo adinga abakhiqizi abancane ukuze babahlinzeke ngezimpahla ukuze bahlangabezane nezintengo ezibekwe ngaphakathi emakethe noma izivumelwano zokuhlinzeka nabaphakeli nabathengisi. Umkhakha we-ED uzosebenzisa i-ATAF ukweseka lezi zinkampani zezolimo ezikwazi ukusebenzisa ukuxhumana okwakhiwe kabi. Lesi sikhungo sithatha zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokuhambisana nomthetho. Ngiyavuma, akukho okukhuluma ngakho. Izimo eziphathelene ne-cybersecurity kumasipala ziya ziba zinkulu, futhi zidinga ukubhekwa. Ngabe ucabangani, abantu abaningi bazi kahle yini i-cybersecurity? Ngikholelwa ukuthi akukhona, ikakhulukazi lapho sikhuluma ngamasipala. Ungakubona kanjani lokhu? Umkhandlu wezamasipala uthola uhlelo lokusebenza olusha, kodwa bahluleka ukuvikela idatha yabo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abanye abantu bangene kuzo zonke izinhlelo, bathathe idatha, basuse imali, noma baphule imithetho. Lokhu kube yinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngedatha yomphakathi. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezikhona. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi i-cyberattack ingaba yingozi kangakanani? Ngicabanga ukuthi abantu abaningi abazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zomphakathi zingase zibe sengozini. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezikhuluma ngalezi zinto, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngazo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Futhi, akukhona ukuthi izinkampani ezinkulu kuphela ezithola ukuhlaselwa. Nakamasipala, izinsizakalo ezifana nokuthengwa kwemithi, imfundo, nezokuthutha zidinga ukuvikela idatha yazo. Uma umphakathi ungavikeleki, lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu baphumelele, futhi lokhu akukuhle. Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise ulwazi lwethu ngalezi zinto. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo? Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi i-cybersecurity ayiyona into yokudlala. Uma ungavikela idatha yakho, ungase ube sengozini yokulahlekelwa yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zingathuthukiswa kanjani? Kukhona izindlela ezilula, njengokusebenzisa amaphasiwedi aqinile, ukuvuselela izinhlelo, nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima kubantu abangafunwa ukuba bangenise izinhlelo. Futhi, umphakathi kufanele ube nezinhlaka ezithile zokuphepha. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi uma umphakathi ungathathi izinyathelo, izingozi ziya ziba zinkulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kusebenza kanjani? Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zingasiza ukuvimbela izingozi. Ngabe ubona kanjani ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni i-cybersecurity? Lokhu kusebenza kakhulu uma sikhuluma ngamasipala. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zidinga ukuvikela idatha yazo ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abantu. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela ngedatha, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izinhlelo zokuvikela zidinga ukuvuselelwa njalo? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zihlala ziphephile. Uma ungathathi izinyathelo, ungase ube sengozini yokulahlekelwa yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zomphakathi zidinga ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubasebenzi? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde izingozi ezihambisana ne-cybersecurity. Uma abasebenzi beqonda kahle, bazokwazi ukuvikela idatha yabo. Futhi, abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi izingozi zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kusebenza kanjani? Uma umphakathi ungavikeleki, izingozi ziya ziba zinkulu. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezikhuluma ngalezi zinto, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngazo ukuze sithole izixazululo. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi i-cybersecurity ingaba yinkinga enkulu uma ungayithathi seriously? Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uphephile. Uma ungathathi izinyathelo, ungase ube sengozini yokulahlekelwa yizinsiza ezibalulekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele sithuthukise ulwazi lwethu ngalezi zinto. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo? Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi i-cybersecurity ayiyona into yokudlala. Kukhona izigameko eziningi ezitholakele. Ingxoxo Ngokushoda KweMithi Ezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Umxhumanisi: Sanibonani nonke, namuhla sikhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile efana nokushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Sinezithameli ezithokozisayo, uDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo, ongudokotela ophumelelayo endaweni yethu, uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, ongumsizi wezempilo, kanye noNkk. Zanele Mthembu, ongumzali omdala, ukuze sithole imibono eyahlukene ngalesi sihloko. Ngiyabonga nonke ngokuba lapha nanamuhla. UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kudinga ukuxoxwa kakhulu. Ngaphezu kokuba kuhlobene nempilo yomphakathi, kwenze kube nzima ukuze sithole imithi edingekayo; lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi zempilo. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngempela, uDokotela Ngcobo. Ngiyavuma, imithi ayitholakali kalula ezibhedlela, ikakhulukazi leyo ethinta izimo ezimqoka ezifana neziguli ezinesifo sdiabetes, uhlobo lwezifo zenkohlakalo, kanye nezifo zengqondo. Lokhu kudala ukuvuselelwa kwezinkinga zempilo ezinokuthinta wonke umuntu, ikakhulukazi abahlwempu. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Ngenhlanhla, ngiyavuma. Njengomama, ngizithola sengithola izinkinga ezinkulu lapho ngizama ukuthola imithi yokwelapha ingane yami. Ukudinga ukulinda isikhathi eside ezibhedleni ngenxa yokushoda kwemithi kungaba yingozi. Umxhumanisi: Uxoxe ngezinkinga ezikhona. UDokotela Ngcobo, kungani omasipala bezokwelapha behluleka ukuthola imithi eyanele? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Kunezizathu ezimbalwa. Okokuqala, izinsiza ezikhona ezikhishwayo akanele ukuhlinzeka ngemithi efanele. Ikhono lokwakha nokuqinisa imikhiqizo yezenhlalakahle akuvumelani nezidingo zabantu. Okwesibili, kuphakamisa izinkinga zemali. Ukukhula kwamanani emithi nakho kudala umthelela omubi. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngaphezu kwalokho, futhi kumele sikhulume ngokuphathwa kwendleko. Njengoba izikhungo zezempilo zikhula, izinsiza ezikhona azikhuli ngokufanayo. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Ngiyavuma, kusho uMnu. Dlamini. Angikaze ngicabange ukuthi lezi zinkinga, azithintanga kuphela iziguli ezithintekayo kodwa zenza nokuphila kwazulu kube nzima ngokubanzi. Unezizathu ezithile ozithanda zokuwufaka? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Ngizwa umbono wakho, Nkk. Mthembu. Ukwaneliseka kweziguli kumele kube kuhle. Ukuze kuvimbe ukushoda kwesibhedlela, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezibheke phambili. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuphathwa kahle kwemithombo ezikhona, ukukhiqiza imithi ngendlela engcono, nokuxhumana nozakwethu, njengoba izinkampani ezithengisa imithi zibhekene nezinkinga ezimqoka. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubamba iqhaza kokuqwashisa umphakathi kuphumelelayo. Uma umuntu efunda ukuthi imithi ingatholakala kalula, umphakathi uyakwazi ukufaka izicelo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzothuthukisa impilo yazo zonke iziguli. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Njengomama, ngicela ukuthi ubhale phansi lokhu. Uhlelo lokuqwashisa lezi zimali kulungiselelwa abantwana bethu. Ngiyafisa ukufaka isandla ekwakheni isibonelo esihle. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe yisiphi isinyathelo esithathwayo ukuze kuqashelwe lezi zinkinga? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Uhlelo lokulungisa imithombo kufanele lube neso elibukekayo. Ukusebenza nabavikeli bemithi, nokwenza iziphakamiso kubasebenzi bezempilo. Ukwanda kwamathuba okukhuthaza ubudlelwane phakathi kukamasipala, izibhedlela, nabanye abathintekayo. UMnu. Sipho Dlamini: Ngicela ukugqamisa ukuthi kufanele kuphume imizamo emisha. Idokodo elingeqondakali kuzodingeka ukwenziwe ukuze kusebenze izinhlelo ezindala. UNkk. Zanele Mthembu: Ngabe sinempendulo edingekayo esizathola? UDokotela Thandiwe Ngcobo: Yebo, uhlelo lokubambisana lumele lwehlise izinkinga phakathi kukamasipala. Ukuleleka kwempilo komphakathi kusho ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezibambanayo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga nonke ngale ngxoxo ebuhlungu nebalulekile. Njengamazwi anelisayo, sizobhekana nokwakhiwa ngezindlela ezintsha ukuze sithole izixazululo zempilo ezizohlala ziqhubeka. Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngiyanibona.
Mphakathi ophakeme weDolobha leGu, uMphakathi S.B. Kuyajabula kakhulu ukuba sikhulume nomphakathi wethu lapha eSimahla, ngesikhathi lesi somcimbi esibalulekile esihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu ngokwakha izindlu. Ngolimi lwesiZulu, sithi akekho umthunzi wesigodlo, okukhombisa kahle ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kokuba nekhaya. Ungaya noma kuphi, kodwa ekugcineni kufanele ubuyele ekhaya. Ikhaya liyisisekelo sokuphila komuntu. Namuhla sikhona ukuze sithathe umsebenzi obalulekile wokuhlinzeka umphakathi wethu ngezindlu ezizoba yisisekelo sezindlu zabantu bethu lapha. Lapho umuntu ekhaya, kufanele azizwe ephephile futhi ekhululekile, hhayi esaba. Inkinga emphakathini wethu ekhaya isimo sezindlu lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona. Ngenxa yokunganakwa nguhulumeni we-apartheid, abantu bethu ekhaya baye bazama ukwakha izindlu zabo, eziningi zazo zingezingeni eliphansi. Inselelo ephakathi kwemiphakathi yethu ekhaya ukuthi ngesikhathi sezimo ezimbi, izindlu ezikhona zihluleka ukumelana nezimo ezinzima. Njengomphumela, imiphakathi yethu ishiywe ibuthakathaka, isaba ukuphila kwabo. Ikhaya liyikhaya kuphela uma kukhona indlu ephephile; asifuni abantu bethu bahlale besaba ngalokho okungase kwenzeke noma nini uma isimo sezulu sishintsha ngoba bahlala ezindlini ezinganele. Umphathi wohlelo, umnyango wethu uqale umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo kakhulu nguhulumeni we-apartheid ngokubahlinzeka ngezindlu. Namuhla sijabule kakhulu ukuthi umkhankaso wethu wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi wethu ekhaya ufike kule ndawo lapha eSimahla. Sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze sisheshise ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlu zabantu bethu ekhaya ngoba sifuna ukubuyisela isithunzi sabo esathathwa nguhulumeni we-apartheid. Ukubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele abe nendlu esimweni efanele. Akekho okufanele aphile esabayo lapho ekhaya. Ngaphambi kokuthi uhulumeni wethu wamanje we-democratic ufinyelele emandleni, bekungathi kuyiphupho kubantu ukuba bakhiwe izindlu ekhaya. Umbono wethu njengoHulumeni ukwazi ukubona wonke imiphakathi iphila izimpilo ezingcono ngendlela efanele. Sigcizelela ezinhlelweni zethu ukuthi abantu bethu kufanele bakhiwe izindlu ezindaweni eziseduze namadolobha, kanye nasezindaweni zasemakhaya; sifuna abantu bethu baphile izimpilo ezifanayo nezabanye abantu, benazo izindlu ezinhle, ugesi, nezindlela. NjengoHulumeni wabantu, asikholwa ukuthi ukuze abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele baphume emadolobheni; sifuna abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni abahlala kuzo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka kwendlela yabo yokuphila. Ukuhamba kancane ekuthuthukiseni izindlu kule miphakathi kusekelwe kakhulu eqinisweni lokuthi izindawo eziningi lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona lapha zashiywa ngaphandle kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa. Inselelo yethu njengoMnyango ukuguqula lesi simo. Isivinini esihlinzekwayo emiphakathini yethu ekhaya ngezindlu senze uhulumeni ezingeni lesizwe nasemaphandleni aqaphele ukuthi uxhaso olusetshenziswa umnyango wethu ekwakheni izindlu zabantu bethu kumele lwenyuswe. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi sisheshise ukufinyelela kwezinye izindawo esingakazifinyeleli. Manje sizokwazi ukusiza ngokushesha uhlelo lwethu ukuze sithinte ngqo ukususa izindawo ezibucayi nokwakha izindlu zabantu ezindaweni zasemakhaya njengezindawo ezinjalo, sibuyele isithunzi sabantu bethu ezindlini zokuhlala. Umnyango Wezindlu uyazi ukuthi umsebenzi ophakathi kwezakhamizi ukuze sisheshise ukuthuthukiswa ubunzima. Nokho, sikhuthaza izindawo ukuba zifake izicelo kumnyango ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo kwezinye izindawo. Abantu ezindaweni zasemakhaya bangabantu abahamba kancane kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni. Sifuna abantu bethu eThoyana, eMaphumulo, nakwezinye izindawo baphinde benze izinzuzo ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlu; ngiyazi ukuthi kunezinye izinhlelo umnyango ozithathayo ukuze uthuthukise umphakathi kulezi zindawo. NjengoMnyango, sihamba yonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukuze sikhombise izinhlelo ezindaweni ezifana nalezi. Lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi uhulumeni wamanje uzinikele ekuthatheni izidingo zabantu ngqo. Izindlu esizethulayo namuhla zizogcwalisa isivumelwano phakathi kukahulumeni nabantu sokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, futhi sizinikele kulokho. NjengoHulumeni wabantu, siyaziqhenya ngokuba yihulumeni wokuqala kuleli elingakha izindlu emiphakathini eyakhiwe ukuze kube nezikhulu. Ezinye izizinda ngaleso sikhathi zisebenzisa umthetho ukuze zakhe izindlu zomphakathi wazo. Kwakungekho msebenzi wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi eyakhiwe ukuze kube nezikhulu. Abaningi bakwamukela ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa ngeke kufike kulezi zindawo. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi abantu basemakhaya babone izindlu ezinhle zihlala kwezinye izizinda abahlala nazo. Umlando ukhombisa kahle ukuthi ngisho nabakhi bezindlu abakhulu ababebambe iqhaza kuhulumeni bangaphambili bavuma ukuthi izindlu zasemakhaya azikwazi ukwenza lutho. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba sazi lo mlando ngoba ukuze siqonde lapho siya khona, kumele sazi lapho siphuma khona futhi siqonde izinselelo esibhekene nazo njengoHulumeni wabantu. Ngenxa yokunganakwa kwezidingo zabantu bethu, kudingeka siqale kabusha ngokwakha imithetho emisha nezinhlelo ezintsha ukuze sikwazi ukwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabantu bethu. Kunemikhankaso eminingi esihlela ukuyihlinzeka ngemiphakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kule ndawo. Kubalulekile kimi ukuchaza emphakathini izinyathelo esizithathayo lapho sithumele uhlelo olukhulu njengalolu lwamanje. Siyazi ukuthi izinkinga esinazo ekuthuthukisweni zenzeka ngenxa yemithetho ye-apartheid. Ngamanye amazwi, umphakathi wonke lapha awunalo ilungelo lokuba ezindaweni ezithuthukisiwe. Imithetho emisha nezinhlelo esizenzile njengoHulumeni wabantu iphelisile lokho. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu akuphinde kwenzeke, sisebenza nezindawo ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zibe ngaphansi kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezakhamizi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sifuna ukubona wonke ukuthuthukiswa okuhleliwe. Ngamanye amazwi, sifuna ukubona izindlu kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuphelele oludingekayo abantu abazokwakha lezi zindlu, kuhlanganise nezinye izidingo zomphakathi. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazothola ukuthuthukiswa ezicini ezahlukene zokuphila. Uma izindlu zakhiwe ngaphandle kokucabangela ezinye izindawo nezinye izici zokuthuthukiswa, lezi zindlu ngeke zibe yizindlu ezifudumele. Ikhaya liyikhaya kuphela uma izidingo zabantu abahlala kuyo zicatshangelwa. Umuntu ongakaze azwe ubuhlungu bokungabi nendlu angase athathe kalula ukubaluleka kosuku olunjalo. Kodwa thina esazi ubuhlungu nobuhlungu bokungabi nezindlu sizokwazi ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwalesi sikhathi ezimpilweni zabantu bethu lapha eSimahla namuhla.
