Ngokuvamile, ukuhweba kwezolimo kuyinselele enzima. Futhi singasho ukuthi abalimi bethu abesabi ukusebenza kanzima. Nokho, okwamanje, ukuhweba kwezolimo kudinga okungaphezu kokusebenza kanzima. Kuyajwayeleka lapho uqala umsebenzi omusha ukuthi izinto zingahambi kahle, futhi ukuhweba kwezolimo akuhlukile. Amaphutha azokwenzeka. Okwamanje, izindleko zokuqala ziphakeme, futhi intengo emakethe yezitshalo iphansi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Abalimi abaphumelelayo benza inzuzo encane, futhi ngakho-ke abakwazi ukukhokhela ama-traktor nemishini emisha. Baqhubeka nokusebenza ngemali ebolekiwe. Lokhu kudala ingozi ngoba kuyabakhathaza. Ukuze uthole imali ebolekiwe, abalimi bahlukunyezwa ukuba bakhokhe umshwalense, okwehlisa inzuzo yabo. Ukuhweba kwezolimo kuwumsebenzi ophathelene nezinto eziningi; kufanele ukwazi ukuqonda izinto ezahlukene kakhulu. Ukuba nolwazi (imfundo) kuphela akukwanele - abalimi bafunda unyaka nonyaka kuze kube bathola ubuchule. ENingizimu Afrika, abalimi abasafufusa baqala ukungena emkhakheni wezolimo futhi bathola ukuthi ukuhweba kwezolimo kunzima - uma ufuna ukuphumelela, kufanele ube nomfutho oqinile! Ngalezi zinzuzo eziphansi, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Uzothola kanjani ubuchule futhi ngubani ozokuphakamisa uma ufika ezingeni eliphansi? Abalimi abasafufusa bathola kunzima kakhulu ukuthola imali yokukhiqiza. Lokhu kusibonisile: inzuzo incane futhi izingozi ziningi. Siyazi ukuthi labo abahlinzeka ngemali ebolekiwe abafuni ukulahlekelwa yimali yabo. Okwamanje, sigxile ekutholeni ukwesekwa kwiBhange Lezindawo ukuze sikwazi ukukhiqiza - kuyisibopho sabo ukuhlinzeka ngemali ebolekiwe kubalimi abasafufusa - ngakho kufanele sisebenze kahle nabo kulolu hlelo. Kweminyaka, inzuzo ibiphansi, futhi impilo yemishini iphinde yehlise - udinga ukwenza inzuzo ukuze ukwazi ukugcina nokulungisa imishini yakho noma ukuthenga izinto ezintsha. Kukhona abalimi abanomhlaba lapho bengakwazi khona ukuhweba, kodwa okwamanje, abakwazi ukwenza inzuzo ekuhwebeni (ngenxa yezindleko zokuqala eziphakeme/intengo ephansi/umhlabathi omubi). Kukhona abanye abanomhlaba omuhle kodwa bengenamanzi, futhi abakwazi ukuhweba ngempumelelo. Abanye badinga inani elikhulu lempuphu neminingi yephosphate ukuze bathuthukise umhlabathi. Bese kuba abanye abanamakhono okuhweba kodwa bephazamiseka ukuthola umhlaba ngenxa yezinkinga neMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba (sizokhuluma ngalokhu futhi kwesinye isikhathi). Kucacile ukuthi kunezinkinga ezahlukene zomhlaba ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwabalamini abasafufusa ezibenza bahlupheke. Siphikisana nabo emsakazweni.
Siphinde sisondele ekupheleni konyaka ophumelelayo kuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabafama lwe-Grain SA. Yonke imisebenzi esiyenzile ngalesi sikhathi ngalesi sihloko yenziwe kwaba nokwenzeka ngokusekelwa okukhulu okuvela kuMaize Trust. UJane McPherson noWillie Kotzé, bobabili lapha ehhovisi elikhulu le-Grain SA eBothaville, baphatha uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabafama. Isikhundla esisha esibizwa ngokuthi "Ispecialist: Field Services" sidalwe, futhi uDanie van den Berg uthathe le ndima. U-Danie uyazi kahle uhlelo futhi uqeqeshe abaningi ngendlela esezingeni eliphezulu eminyakeni emithathu edlule. U-Danie ubheka labo basebenzi emaphandleni - abaholi bezifunda abasebenza ekuthuthukiseni abafama. KuTebula 1, kukhona amagama abo bonke abasebenza kulolu hlelo. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona abafama bezomnotho abaningi, sigxila kakhulu kulabo bakhiqizi abathuthukayo, ngoba sikholwa ukuthi ukuze sifinyelele inhloso yethu yokuthi "Sithuthukise abafama abamnyama abanekhono ukuba babe abakhiqizi bezomnotho," kumele sixhase umkhiqizi ngamunye ngokuqhubeka nalesi sikhathi sokuba nomnotho. Ezindaweni ezikhulayo lapho kukhona abafama abasha, sisengxenyeni enkulu nezifundo ngoba kuyindlela engcono yokuxhumana nabakhiqizi abaningi. Uhlelo lokuqeqesha luyaqhubeka nokukhula - kunezifundo eziningi ezitholakalayo futhi inani labafama abafuna ukuya kulezi zifundo liyaqhubeka nokwanda. Siphinda sikhumbuze ukubonga kwethu ngesehlakalo esivela kuMaize Trust, esiqhubeka sikhuthaza lolu hlelo - sizozama ngazo zonke izindlela ukuphatha uhlelo ngendlela efanele futhi sixhase abafama ngendlela efanele. Thina, ithimba lokuthuthukiswa, siyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokusebenza nabafama abasha.
Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela: Ukuhlola nokwazi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile empilweni yomntwana nasekuthuthukiseni umndeni. Lesi sikhathi sokuqala sikhulu ekwakheni impilo enhle, imfundo, kanye nokunakekelwa kwezingane. Lokhu kubuyekezwa kuhlose ukuhlola izindlela zokunakekela, ukuhlukanisa izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ezibhedlela, kanye nomthelela walesi sikhathi empilweni yomntwana. Izinsizakalo Zokunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela zifaka izinsiza eziningi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okuhle. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukuxilongwa kwezinkinga ezithile, kanye nemiyalelo kubazali. Uhlelo lokunakekelwa luqukethe izigaba ezibalulekile, kusukela ekutholeni umntwana, ukuxilonga izinkinga, kuya ekunikezeni ukunakekelwa okuqhubekayo. Abahlengikazi nabodokotela bahlala behlaziya izidingo zomntwana, bebona ukuthi umntwana uyaphila, ubunzima bokukhula, nezimpawu ezithile zokuphila. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akupheli nje ekulawuleni izinhlelo zempilo, kodwa kudinga ukuqonda okujulile kwemikhuba yokukhula komntwana. Izinga Lokunakekelwa lingahluka ezibhedlela; ezinye zinezinsiza eziphakeme, kanti ezinye zingase zibe nezinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yengane, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinokuncipha komnotho. Abazali badinga imihlahlandlela ecacile ukuze baqonde izidingo zomntwana wabo, futhi baqonde izinsuku zokuqala zokuphila. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuxhumana nabahlengikazi ukuze bathole izimpendulo ezisebenzayo. Ukwelashwa Nokuqhubeka Nokunakekelwa akupheli ekudleni nasekuhlinzekeni ngamanzi, kodwa kudinga uthando, ukunakekelwa, nokuxhaswa okuqhubekayo. Ubuqotho bezinhlelo zokwelashwa buhlose ukuhlinzeka ukuxhaswa okuhle, ukuhlola impilo, kanye nokuxhumana nabazali. Uma umntwana engaphokophela kahle, abahlengikazi kufanele bakhuthaze abazali ukuba bahlale bexhumene, baqonde izidingo zomntwana. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi komndeni nezinye izinsiza, okungaholela ekutheni umntwana akhule kahle. Ubuhlakani Bokunakekela buhamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokunakekelwa. Ukuqonda izidingo zomntwana, ukuhlola izimpilo, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngempilo kahle kufanele kube yinto ebalulekile ezibhedlela. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokubhekelela impilo yomntwana, kodwa kukhuthaza futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwemindeni. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ezibhedlela, njengezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nezisebenzi zomndeni. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umntwana uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele, futhi abazali banesithakazelo ekwazisweni ngempilo yomntwana. Isiphetho, ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa ezibhedlela kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yokukhula komntwana. Izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, izinga lokunakekelwa, kanye nokwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabazali nabahlengikazi kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni kokunakekelwa. Ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukile, umntwana uyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, kube lula, futhi kube nempilo engcono. Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akuwona umkhakha ophumile, kodwa kudinga ukuqhubeka, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokunakekelwa okuqhubekayo ukuze kukhule umntwana ngendlela efanele. Lokhu akuhambisani kuphela nezidingo zomntwana, kodwa futhi kugqugquzela izimpilo ezinhle emindenini. Izibhedlela kufanele ziqhubeke zithuthukisa izinhlelo zazo zokunakekela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle, ziphilile, futhi zikhuthazwa ngothando nolwazi.
UMBIKO NGOKWELASHWA KWEZIFO ZENGQONDO Isingeniso Kuyaziwa ukuthi izifo zengqondo ziba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu. Lezi zifo zifaka phakathi ukucindezeleka, ukuhlinzwa kwezinkolelo, kanye nezinkinga zokuziphatha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle yengqondo, kubalulekile ukuthola ukwelashwa okufanele. Kule mibiko, sizobheka izindlela ezahlukene zokwelapha izifo zengqondo, okuhlanganisa ukwelashwa ngokomoya, ukwelashwa ngodokotela, kanye nezindlela zokuxhasa. Ukwazi Izifo Zengqondo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izifo zengqondo zingahlukaniswa ngezizathu ezahlukene. Ukucindezeleka, isibonelo, kuvame ukuvela ngenxa yezimo zempilo, ukuhamba kwezinguquko empilweni, noma imicabango engalungile. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezifo zengqondo zidinga izindlela ezahlukene zokwelashwa, ngakho ukuqonda isimo somuntu kuyisinyathelo sokuqala esibalulekile. Ukwelashwa Ngomqondo Ukwelashwa komqondo, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-psychotherapy, kubaluleke kakhulu ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo. Le ndlela igxile ekuxhumaneni phakathi komtholampilo nom患者, lapho bephendulana khona ngezimvo, imicabango, nezizathu ezibangela izinkinga. Lezi zifundo zigcizelela ukuthi umuntu uthola ukufundiswa okukhuthazayo, okwenza kube lula ukuzazi izimo zabo. I-Psychotherapy ingatholakala ngezinhlobo ezahlukene, njenge-Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) ne-Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), ezihlosiwe ukunceda abantu baphume ezinkingeni zabo. Ukwelashwa Ngomuthi Ngemuva kokuhlola izifo zengqondo, odokotela bahlola ukuthi ngabe kudingeka ukwelashwa ngodokotela, okubandakanya imithi ethile. Imithi yokwelapha izifo zengqondo, njenge-antidepressants ne-anxiolytics, iqhuba ukulinganisela kwezinto ezithile emzimbeni, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba baphile impilo ejwayelekile. Kubalulekile ukubona ukuthi imithi kumele ithathwe ngaphansi kwenkomba kadokotela, njengoba iziphenduli zomzimba zihluka kumuntu nomuntu. Izindlela Zokuxhasa Ngaphezu kokwelashwa ngokomoya nangokomuthi, kunezinye izindlela zokuxhasa ezibalulekile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufaka abantu emiphakathini yokuxhasa, lapho abantu bahlangana khona ukuze babelane ngamava abo. Izinhlelo zokuxhasa, ezinjengezokwelapha ezihambisana nomphakathi, zingasiza ekwandiseni ukuziqhenya kanye nokwakha umphakathi. Ukuxhumana nabanye abantu abakuthandayo nakho kudlala indima enkulu ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo. Isizathu Sokubhekelela Izifo Zengqondo Kuyacaca ukuthi kunesidingo sokubhekelela izifo zengqondo, hhayi kuphela kubantu abathintekayo kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Ukungabhekelwa kwezingqinamba zengqondo kungaholela ezimpilweni ezimbi, okuhlanganisa ukungasebenzi kahle emsebenzini, ukuwohloka kwemithwalo, kanye nokuxhumana okuhlulekile. Izenzo ezithathwayo ukuze zihlolwe lezi zifo zingaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwemiphakathi. Isiphetho Njengoba sibheka lezi zindlela zokwelashwa, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo akupheli lapho umuntu ethola ukwelashwa. Ukuqhubeka nokuxhaswa, ukufunda, nokwakha umphakathi okhulayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayaphila impilo enhle nengqondo. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuthi kube nomoya wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu, odokotela, nabahlobo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo oludingayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, siyabiza wonke umuntu ukuba abheke izifo zengqondo ngendlela ehloniphekile, eqonda, futhi ephelele, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yengqondo yomphakathi wethu.
Ukuba nomqondo ophumelelayo, ukusebenza kahle, nokugxila ekuthuthukiseni ngokukhula kungaba umphumela wezinyathelo zabantu abadala ngokwabo, ngokukhula kwenani labo kanye nomthelela wabo. Ulwazi oluqoqwe ndawonye mayelana nokuguga, njengomqondo wokuhlanganisa emphakathini, lungaba yinto enhle (Uhlelo Lwamazwe Ngamazwe Lokusebenza Ngokuqhubeka Nokuguga 1/para. 32). Inani elikhulayo lemindeni ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS lithinta impilo yabantu abadala. Imiphumela yezenzakalo ze-HIV/AIDS iphula imindeni. Inani elikhulayo lezingane ezingenabazali ngenxa yokufa kwabazali ngenxa yezifo ezihlobene ne-HIV/AIDS kusho ukuthi kuphela abantu abadala abasala ukuze banakekele lezi zingane. Abantu abadala emindenini ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS bathola ukuthi babhekene nomthwalo omkhulu wokunakekela umuntu ogulayo noma ophumile emndenini kanye nokunakekela abazukulu babo ababe sebezingeni lezingane ezingenabazali. Kuvame ukucatshangwa ukuthi imindeni ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS inganakekela amalungu ayo agulayo. Abantu abane-HIV/AIDS badinga impilo, amandla, izinsiza zezimali, kanye nokuzinikela okuqinile ukuze bazame kakhulu ukuthola lezi zinto. Izitifiketi zokuzalwa zezizukulwane zabo. (Lokhu kuyinkinga evamile kubantu abadala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ikakhulukazi kulabo abantwana babo bahlala emadolobheni noma ezweni elizungezile). I-stigma ehambisana ne-HIV/AIDS ibangela abantu abadala ukuba babe nokukhathazeka kakhulu njengoba bezama ukubhekana nokufa kwamalungu omndeni. Njengoba abantu abadala kufanele babhekane nokusiza izingane zifanele ukujwayela indawo entsha ngaphandle kwabazali bazo. Abantu abadala bangaba abakhathaleli bemvelo futhi kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okuyisisekelo abakudingayo ukuze babhekane nomthwalo owengeziwe wokunakekela amalungu omndeni agulayo kanye nezizukulwane zabo ezingenabazali, ikakhulukazi ngenxa ye-HIV/AIDS. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela abantu abadala ngomsebenzi wabo emnothweni wezwe ngezandla zabo futhi banakekele abazukulu babo uma abazali babo besebenza noma befile ngenxa yesifo se-HIV/AIDS. Izinsizakalo zokwelulekwa kwezempilo yengqondo zemindeni ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS. Lokhu kwenziwa futhi ngamaqembu omphakathi asebenzisanayo, abhekana nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo nezemizwa zamalungu omndeni athintekile. Ulwazi olusakazwa ngezinhlaka ezichazayo mayelana nokuthi ungathola kanjani usizo lomphakathi nokwazi amalungelo akho njengomfana kubalulekile. Umkhakha wezebhizinisi, izwe, izinhlangano zenkolo, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni nazo ziye zanceda ngokunikeza usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi ezidinga usizo zithola lokho.
Nokho, ngithanda futhi ukugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubuyekezwa kwesu lesigaba okwenziwe ngoNovemba, lapho abaphathi abaphezulu behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga ezihlobene nokusebenza. Isigaba siqinisekisile izakhiwo eziningi zokuhlinzeka ngokomthetho ezivikela futhi zikhuthaze abesifazane. Uhlelo luhlola ukuthi iMthetho Wokwamukela Imishado Yendabuko u-120 ka-1998 uthuthukise kanjani impilo yabesifazane emishadweni yendabuko. I-Charta Yezisulu inamalungelo ayisixhenxe athinta abantu abaye baba yizisulu zobugebengu. Kubalulekile ukwazi la malungelo ukuze ukwazi ukuwabelana nabangane, kuzala, kanye namalungu omphakathi. Kwakuyonyaka omude, futhi abantu abaningi bathatha ikhefu. Ngiyethemba uzoba nesikhathi sokuphumula esithule. Hamba ngokuphepha. Masihlangane futhi kuNyaka Omusha. Ekhulumela emcimbini wokudla kwesigcawu, uMphakathi Ophakeme, uSandile Ngcobo, wazisa abamele ukuthi indima yeNhlangano Yokuphathwa Kwezikhalazo Entsha yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomthetho ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. UMphakathi Ophakeme wabonga abahleli bomcimbi ngokumema yena ukuba wabelane ngombono wakhe ngohlelo lwezinkantolo olusebenza kahle kakhulu. Wathi, "Umsebenzi wami emkhakheni wezobulungiswa ungitholele ithuba lokubheka izinkantolo nokuthi singathuthukisa kanjani ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zethu zezinkantolo." Waphawula ukuthi wamemelwa nguMongameli uZuma ePhalamende ukuze amukele isikhundla sakhe esisha sokuba uMphakathi Ophakeme. UMphakathi Ophakeme wabelane ngombono wakhe ngekusasa lezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika. Wachaza, "Namuhla ngithanda ukukwazisa ngombono wami ngohlelo lwezinkantolo lwesikhathi esizayo. Ngine mbono yohlelo lwezobulungiswa oluqinile, oluphila, olusebenza kahle, noluzimele. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkantolo zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Ngokwehlukile kumakhasimende ebhizinisi, amakhasimende ezinsizakalo zethu zezinkantolo awanendawo yokuphendukela. Abampofu bathembele kuHlelo Lwezobulungiswa Ukuze baphumelele ekutholeni ubulungiswa njengoba kungekho enye inhlangano engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi kubo. Okwamanje, kumele sizame ukugcina ukugxila ekusebenzeni kwamakhasimende. Kumele uqale ukubonisa indlela efanele yokuphatha izinkantolo." Ekhulumeni kwakhe okubalulekile, uNgqongqoshe uJeff Radebe wamukela uMphakathi Ophakeme futhi wagcizelela ukwesekwa kwesigaba kwiNhlangano Yokuphathwa Kwezikhalazo Entsha. Waqinisekisa uMphakathi Ophakeme ngenkxaso yesigaba emsebenzini wakhe njengomphakathi ophakeme. Ekwethuleni umbono wakhe wesu lesigaba, uNgqongqoshe uRadebe wathi isigaba manje sesiyinhlangano ehamba phambili yeHlelo Lwezobulungiswa, Ukuvimbela Ubugebengu, kanye neSikhungo Sokuphepha. Wathi, "Lokhu kusho umsebenzi owengeziwe kuNgqongqoshe nasemnyangweni. Manje sibhekene nomsebenzi wokuhola lesi sikhungo ukuze sifeze umgomo waso." UNgqongqoshe ukhuthaze abaphathi ukuba bafune izindlela ezithile zokwenza ukuthi isigaba siqinisekise ukuthi lesi sikhungo sisebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Kwamanye amahlandla, isigaba sithole umbiko ngokuqhuba izitatimende zezimali kusuka ehhovisi le-Auditor General. Ekukhulumeni ngalolu daba, uNgqongqoshe ukhuthaze abaphathi ukuba baphakamise uhlelo lokuphathwa kwezimali ngesigaba. "Sidinga uhlelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ngonyaka ozayo sithola isitatimende sezezimali esihlongozwayo esizoholela ekuhlolweni okuhlanzekile," kusho uNgqongqoshe uRadebe. NgokukaNgqongqoshe, isakhiwo sesigaba sidinga ukubuyekezwa. "Isigaba sibizwa ngokuthi uBulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo. Sihlale sizwa ngengxenye yobulungiswa kodwa asizwanga ngengxenye yokuthuthukiswa komthethosisekelo. Isisekelo sedemokhrasi yethu nguMthethosisekelo wethu. Uma singekho isakhiwo esifanele sokuthuthukisa uMthethosisekelo wethu, ngicabanga ukuthi asiqhubele phambili emsebenzini ophusile kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika." UNgqongqoshe ubeke inselelo kubaphathi ukuba baphakamise uhlelo oluzokwazisa ingxenye yokuthuthukiswa komthethosisekelo yesigaba. UNgqongqoshe uphinde wagcizelela ukuzibophezela kuk governo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibamba iFIFA World Cup yokuqala emhlabeni wase-Afrika ngempumelelo nangokuziphatha. Isigaba sithole umsebenzi wokwenza ukuthi kube nezindlela ezifanele zokuphatha nokusebenza kweHlelo Elihlanganisiwe Lwezobulungiswa ukuze kubhekwe noma yiziphi izinkinga zomthetho ezivela ngesikhathi somcimbi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukwesekwa kwezinhlangano ezithuthukisa umthetho ekuphatheni kahle, ngendlela efanele, nangokuphuthumayo ngezinkinga zokuphathwa kobulungiswa. UNgqongqoshe uveze ukukhathazeka ngensizakalo yeHhovisi leMaster. "Sidinga ukubheka ukuthi iHhovisi leMaster lisebenza kanjani nokuthi lisiza kanjani abantu bethu. Sidinga ukulungisa okukhulu kwehhovisi." Wabe esecela abaphathi ukuba babe nohlelo lokuthi bazohlela kanjani ukuhlela ihhovisi ukuze lisebenze kahle nangempumelelo. IKomidi LeziNhlangano Zokwethembeka eNingizimu Afrika lasungulwa nguHulumeni weZizwe Zobumbano ukuze lisize ekubhekaneni nezimo ezazenzeka ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Ukungqubuzana ngaleso sikhathi kuholele ekuhlukunyezweni nasekwephulweni kwamalungelo abantu kuzo zonke izinhlangothi. Le komidi inefundisi ebhekiswe ekusizeni izisulu zohlelo lwe-apartheid. Le fundisi ayihloselwe ukwandisa amabhange. Ihloselwe ukusiza izisulu ze-apartheid. Ngakho-ke, kumele sithole uhlelo oluqinisekisa ukuthi imali isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kusho uNgqongqoshe uRadebe. Ekuphetheni, uNgqongqoshe ufisela abaphathi inhlanhla kulomcimbi wezinsuku ezimbili futhi ukhuthaze ukuba basebenze ndawonye ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banokufinyelela kalula kobulungiswa. "Ngalezi zindaba zonke, ngikholelwa ukuthi uma kwenziwa kahle, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kobulungiswa kubantu bethu bonke." Umcimbi waxoxa ngezindlela zokwenza ukuthi izinhloso zesigaba zifezeke kahle nangempumelelo. Izinhlelo zaphakanyiswa kanje: UkuPhathwa, UkuSebenza Kwezinkantolo, Izinsizakalo Zomthetho ZikGovernment, Amandla Okuphakanyiswa Kwamazwe, kanye Nezinsizakalo Zokweseka nezisebenzi ezihlobene. Le nhlelo ibhekisela ezindleleni zokuphathwa kwesigaba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle nangempumelelo kokuphathwa kwesigaba, kuhlanganise nabasebenzi, izimali, impahla, nezidingo zezakhiwo, izinhlelo zolwazi nolwazi, izinhlelo, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuphathwa kwemigomo, izinhlelo, nezinhlelo. Uhlelo lokusebenza kwezinkantolo luhlola ukuhlinzekwa nokuphathwa kwezinkantolo, ukusiza ngezindaba zomthetho ezihlob
Ukuguquka Kwesimo Sezulu Ingxoxo noDkt. Sipho Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Kwezokuhlaliswa Kwezemvelo Umxhumanisi: Sawubona, Dkt. Mthembu. Ngiyabonga ngokuthi uvume ukusikhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile sokuguquka kwesimo sezulu. Ukuqala, ungachaza kancane ukuthi yini ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu? Dkt. Mthembu: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu kubhekisela ezinguqukweni ezinkulu ezibangelwa izici ezihlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwanda kwezinga lokushisa emhlabeni, ukushintsha kwemvula, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima ezifana nezikhukhula nezomiso. Lezi zinguquko zenzeka ngenxa yokwanda kwegesi ye-carbon dioxide nezinye izinsalela ezikhishwayo emoyeni. Umxhumanisi: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinkinga enkulu. Yiziphi izizathu ezisemqoka zokuthi lokhu kuqhubeke? Dkt. Mthembu: Izizathu ezisemqoka zifaka phakathi ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto, imboni, kanye nezolimo. Lezi zinto zikhupha amagesi abamba ukushisa, okwenza kube nzima ukugcina izinga lokushisa elijwayelekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuncipha kwemithi nezindawo zokuhlala kwemvelo, njengamahlathi, kukhulu kakhulu, njengoba lezi zindawo ziwusizo ekunciphiseni amagesi abamba ukushisa. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe lezi zinguquko zinezimpawu ezithile ezithinta abantu? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, ziningi izimpawu ezithinta abantu. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ukuncipha kwezinsiza zokudla, kanye nezimo zokuhlala ezinzima. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezithinteka kakhulu, njengezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Ukushintsha kwemvula kuholela ekuntulekeni kokudla, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abahlala kulezi zindawo. Umxhumanisi: Yini eyenziwa ukuze kulwe nale nkinga? Dkt. Mthembu: Kunezinyathelo eziningi ezithathwayo. Uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nezakhamuzi kumele basebenzisane ukuze banciphise ukukhishwa kwamagesi abamba ukushisa. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izindlela zokuhamba ezihlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngale nkinga ukuze baqonde ukuthi bangasiza kanjani. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo ezinhle zokuthi abantu baphumelele kulokhu? Dkt. Mthembu: Yebo, kunezibonelo eziningi ezinhle. Emazweni amaningi, abantu basebenzisa amandla elanga newind, okunciphisa ukuncika kumafutha. Ezinye izindawo zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanzekile, njengezithuthi zomphakathi ezisebenza ngogesi. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uma abantu benza izinguquko ezincane, bangaba nomthelela omkhulu. Umxhumanisi: Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bazokwazi ukuhamba phambili nokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi uma abantu beqonda ubukhulu balolu daba, bazokwazi ukwenza izinguquko. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, nezinkampani ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhuluma ngalesi sihloko zingasiza kakhulu. Umxhumanisi: Ngabe kukhona okunye ofuna ukukugcizelela? Dkt. Mthembu: Ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu akuyona inkinga yomuntu oyedwa, kodwa yinkinga yomhlaba wonke. Kumele sibe nomoya wokubambisana ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhuthaze izizukulwane ezizayo ukuba ziqonde ukubaluleka kokuvikela imvelo. Umxhumanisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Dkt. Mthembu, ngalesi sikhathi esihle sokukhuluma ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ngithemba ukuthi abantu bazokwazi ukufunda futhi benze izinguquko ezidingekayo. Dkt. Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle emhlabeni wethu.
Ubuhle Bemvelo: Ukuhlonishwa Nokugcinwa Kwezemvelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuhle bemvelo buye buba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Izindawo ezinhle zemvelo, ezifana nezintaba eziphakeme, izihlahla ezinkulu, nemifula ehlanzekile, zikhombisa ubuciko bemvelo obungapheli. Lezi zindawo azigcini nje ngokuba yizindawo zokuphumula, kodwa futhi zibalulekile empilweni yethu, zisinika umoya opholile, amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze siphile. Izindawo Zokuhlola Ubuhle Bemvelo Emazweni amaningi, izindawo zemvelo zikhangisa izivakashi eziningi. Izindawo ezifana neKruger National Park eNingizimu Afrika, iYosemite National Park eMelika, kanye neGreat Barrier Reef e-Australia, zikhombisa ubuhle obungapheli bemvelo. Lezi zindawo zihlala zikhangisa abantu abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomhlaba, abafuna ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo, kanye nokuhlola izilwane ezihlukahlukene nezitshalo ezitholakala kulezi zindawo. Izindawo zemvelo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahloniphe imvelo. Ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuhamba ngebhayisikili, noma ukuhamba emanzini, kubalulekile ukuze abantu baqonde ubuhle bemvelo. Lokhu kubanika ithuba lokubona izilwane eziphilayo, izitshalo ezihlukahlukene, kanye nezimo zemvelo ezithokozisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zindawo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bagweme ukungcola, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Ubuhle Bemvelo Nezinkinga Zokugcinwa Kwayo Nokho, ubuhle bemvelo buhlushwa yizinkinga eziningi. Ukukhula kwabantu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, konke lokhu kudala ingozi ezindaweni zemvelo. Izilwane eziningi ziyaqhubeka zishabalala ngenxa yokuphathwa kabi kwemithombo yemvelo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi izindawo ezinhle zibe sengozini yokulahleka, okungaholela ekutheni izizukulwane ezizayo zingakwazi ukujabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Izinhlelo zokuvikela imvelo zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubuhle bemvelo bukhona futhi buhlala bukhona. Izinhlelo zokuvikela izilwane, izinhlelo zokuphatha kahle imithombo yemvelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu ngobaluleka kokugcina imvelo, zonke zidinga ukusekelwa. Ukuze sikwazi ukugcina ubuhle bemvelo, kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu abambe iqhaza, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungumuntu siqu, umphakathi, noma uhulumeni. Ukubaluleka Kokufundisa Ngemvelo Ukufundisa abantu ngobaluleka kokugcina imvelo kubalulekile. Izikole, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuzithandela, zonke zingaba nendima enkulu ekufundiseni abantu ngalesi sihloko. Ukuze abantu baqonde ukuthi imvelo ibalulekile, kufanele bazi ukuthi izinsiza zemvelo zidingeka empilweni yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza abantu babe nesifiso sokuvikela imvelo, futhi bazibophezele ekugcineni ubuhle bemvelo. Isiphetho: Ukuhlonipha Nokugcina Imvelo Ubuhle bemvelo bukhulu futhi bukhulu, kodwa bukhona engcupheni. Ukuze sikwazi ukujabulela lezi zindawo ezinhle, kufanele sibe nesibopho sokuzigcina. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezilungile, sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahloniphe imvelo, futhi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuvikela izindawo zemvelo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukugcina ubuhle bemvelo, ukuze izizukulwane ezizayo zikwazi ukujabulela lezi zindawo ezinhle, futhi zifunde ukubaluleka kokugcina imvelo. Ubuhle bemvelo abukhona kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethekile, kodwa bukhona nasemakhaya ethu, emizini yethu, nasemaphandleni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sibe nesibopho sokugcina lezi zindawo zihlanzekile, ziphilile, futhi zihlala zikhangisa ubuhle bazo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizokwazi ukuvuselela uthando nemfundo ngempilo yemvelo, futhi sibe nesibopho sokugcina ubuhle bemvelo buphila.
Isikole Sikahulumeni: Ukubaluleka Kwaso Emphakathini Wethu Izikole zikahulumeni, ezaziwa njengesikole samabanga aphansi ukuya phezulu, zihlala zithokoziswa njengemithombo ebalulekile yokufunda nezifundo eziletha umphumela omuhle empilweni yabantu. Kulezi zinsuku, sikhuluma kakhulu ngempumelelo yezikole ezizimele, kodwa kunjalo, asikwazi ukukhohlwa indima ebalulekile edlalwa izikole zikahulumeni. Lezi zikhungo zifana neqhaza elikhulu, zikhombisa indlela yokuphila, nezifundo ezithokozisa izingane zethu. Ukuqala, izikole zikahulumeni zinikeza ukufinyelela emfundweni kumphakathi wonke, ikakhulukazi kubantu abaphakathi kwezinga eliphansi. Bamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuqiniseni umphakathi, zingasiza ukuthuthukisa imiphakathi ibe namathuba alinganayo. Ukusiza ukuthi izingane zokwenyama, ezinemfundo ephakeme nezidingo ezithile ziphumelele, izikole zikahulumeni zenza umphakathi ube namandla. Lapha sizithola izingane ezivela emazweni ahlukene, ezidlangile ezizayo, kanye nemisebenzi enenhlonipho. Ngokuhambisana nalokho, izikole zikahulumeni zikhulisa ukuzazi okuhle, lokhu kubalulekile empilweni yengane. Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi izingane ezithola imfundo ezikole zikahulumeni ziba nekhono lokuthola izinkundla eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Kusho ukuthi, ukuthola imfundo oyithola emkhakheni wakwaHulumeni kudala izinga eliphezulu lokuwina izifundo ezinzima, ezikhona emhlabeni jikelele. Njengoba izingane zikhula, zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe nesibopho, futhi ziqonde imithetho yomphakathi nezimiso zempilo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kudinga kubhekwane nezinkinga ezisemqoka ezibhekene nezikole zikahulumeni. Ngokuvamile, lezi zikole zibhekene nezinsiza ezikhudlwana, ngokwesibonelo, umnotho omubi. Ukuvama, izikole zikhathazekile ngezezimali eziphezulu zokufundela, eziholela ekunciphiseni izinsiza ezisemqoka ezifana nezincwadi, ama-laptops, nezinsiza zokufundela. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uHulumeni abeke imizamo eyengeziwe yokuthuthukisa lezi zikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izingane zithola imfundo efanele. Futhi, kumqoka ukwazi ukuthi ukungabi nezinsiza ezanele kungaholela ekubeni nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabafundi. Izingane ezikhaliphile nezinomsebenzi omuhle zingaphenduka zingathola ukuqashelwa okungaphansi, ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi umphakathi ube neqhaza, ofuna ukuhlanganisa ukuhlobana, ukuze athuthukise izikole zikahulumeni. Okokugcina, ngithanda ukugqamisa ukuthi izikole zikahulumeni zithokozisa kakhulu ngesimo esihle esigcwele amathemba. Ukuhamba kwezingane ezindaweni eziphezulu kumiphakathi, ezithokozisayo, kumele kwenze kucace ukuthi ziningi izinzuzo ezivela kumfundiso ephezulu. Ukuba nemfundo ejulile kuvula iminyango yokuxhumana nezinye izinkampani, lokhu kumqoka empumelelweni yomsebenzi. Ngokuhlanganisa, izikole zikahulumeni zibalulekile empilweni yethu nakumphakathi. Zinikeza ithuba lezingane zokufunda, besebenza kumholi ngokuthola imfundo yomhlaba wonke. Ngalesi sikhathi, udinga ukuthi umphakathi usondele ezikole zikahulumeni futhi ube nohlanga lokuthuthuka. Lokhu kuzosiza ekuphuculeni imiphakathi, kulindeleke ukuthi abantu bagcine belokhu bekhalipha nekhanda eliqinile. Umbono wami uwukuthi, kumele sithathe izifiso zabafundi bethu sizame ukuhamba phambili sithuthukise izikole zikahulumeni, ukuze sithole imiphumela emihle empilweni yethu sonke.
Amahlathi: Ubukhulu Babo Ekuphileni Komhlaba Isingeniso Amahathi, lezo zindawo ezigcwele izihlahla, ziningi kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi zidlala indima ebalulekile kwi-ecosystem. Ziyindawo ethokomele yokuhlala izilwane, zikhuthaza inhlanzeko yomoya, futhi zifaka isandla ekulondolozeni amanzi. Kodwa njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula, izingozi kubantu nezinhlobo eziphilayo zingazala umonakalo omkhulu kumahlathi. Kule ndaba, sizabheka ukubaluleka kwamaahlathi, izinselelo abhekene nazo, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kulondolozwe lezi zindawo ezisemqoka. Indima YamaHlathi Ekuhlaleni Amahathi ayilondolozo lesimo, anikela ngokuphila kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Ikhaya lezinhlobo eziningi zezilwane nezimila, amahlathi anikezela ngamaconsi amasha, uthuli lwezulu, kanye nezinsiza zokufuywa kwezilwane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amahlathi asiza ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa komoya, njengoba izihlahla zithatha umoya-mpilo futhi zikhulula i-oxygen. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo abantu avikelekile ekuphileni kwansuku zonke. Umphakathi wasezindaweni ezithintekayo amahlathi angama-hassoll, imvuselelo ye-ecosystem, phakathi kokuphila komuntu. Abalimi, abavukuzi, nababhizi bathing odliwa ibangawo ngokuphuza izimpande. Ngakho-ke, kukhuthazwa ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke unakekela amahlathi, ngoba lokhu kuzokwakha ikakhulukazi umnotho wendawo. Izingozi Zokonakala KwamaHlathi Nokho, amahlathi abhekene nezimo ezinzima. Ukugugulelwa kwamahlathi nokuwahlakulela kuchaphazela izilwane nezitshalo. Lokhu kudalwa kekhulu yizimo ezinjengokulungiselela umhlaba wokuhlala, izinhlelo zokwakha, nemisebenzi yokuphuza phansi. Lezi zinto zikhombisa ukuthi umehluko uyahluka, ikhono lezemvelo lincipha, futhi izindlu zezilwane zishabalala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwakhiwa kwezimboni nezindawo zokuhlala zenza ukwanda kokungcoliswa kwendawo. Uhlanga luhlala lungakhuli kahle, ezomnotho zinyuka, kodwa lokhu kulimaza imvelo. Okuningi kokwehlisa amanzi kuphinde kunciphise izinsiza ezingokwenkolo obalulekile kumahlathi, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukwakhiwa okufanele kwamasiko. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Amahlathi Ukuze kuvinjezelwe lo mthelela, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela amahlathi. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, uhulumeni, nezakhamizi zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amahlathi asukuma. Imikhankaso yokulondolozwa kwezindawo ezisemqoka iyahlomula, futhi izinhlelo zokuphila, ezifana nezokufuywa kobungane nemihlangano nemphakathi, ziye zakhuliswa. Abantu basezindaweni ezithintekayo baphinde bahlomulelwe kwi-international partnerships ezilwela ukuhlanza amahlathi. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, kuyasiza ukudala izinkumbulo ezinhle ngezinhloso zokuvikela amahlathi. Ukubuyiselwa kwemithombo emisha, kunciphisa ukwenziwa kwezimbiwa, futhi kuvula ithuba lokwakha izifundo ezingcono kumahlathi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Isiphetho Ngokudabuka, amahlathi ayizikhumbuzo zemvelo nezenhlalakahle. Ziyingxenye ebalulekile yomhlaba wethu, futhi ukuzikhumbuza ngempilo yazo kuyasiza ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizophila izizukulwane ezizayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke siqinisa imizamo yethu yokuvikela amahlathi, ukuze siqhakambise ubungane nempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaleso sikhathi, singahamba nendlela yokulondolozwa kwesimo somhlaba, sazi ukuthi amahlathi ayindawo ephilayo eyiyo zonke inhlangano zethu.
Imidlalo Yeshashalazi (Theatre) Umbuzo 1: Yini i-theatre, futhi ibaluleke kangakanani emiphakathini yethu? Imidlalo yeshashalazi, noma i-theatre, iyindlela yokubonisa imisebenzi yokudlala, lapho abadlali bejabulisa izethameli ngendaba, izimo, nemizwelo. I-theatre ibalulekile emiphakathini ngoba ihlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana, ukuxoxwa, kanye nokuqonda izinkinga zomphakathi. Ibuye ibe yinsiza yokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu, njengoba izethameli zabelana ngemicabango nemizwa ngemisebenzi eboniswe. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izingxenye eziyisisekelo zomsebenzi weshashalazi? Umsebenzi weshashalazi unezinhlangothi eziningi, ezifaka phakathi: abadlali, umqondisi, abakhangisi, nabanye abanikeza izinsiza ezidingekayo. Abadlali bembula karakteri, kanti umqondisi uba nomsebenzi wokuhlanganisa zonke lezi zici ukuze akhe umbono ophusile. Isethulo, noma i-stage, ibalulekile futhi, njengoba ingakhiwa ngale ndlela yokushintsha izindawo, ukwenza umbono ube muhle. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinhlobo ze-theatre ezaziwa kakhulu? Kunamakhulu ezindlela nemikhakha ehlukeneyo ye-theatre, kodwa ezinye ezaziwa kakhulu zifaka: i-dramatic theatre, i-musical theatre, i-comedy, ne-tragedy. I-dramatic theatre igxile ezindabeni ezinzima, ngesikhathi i-comedy igxile ekwenzeni abantu bahlabela. I-musical theatre ibamba umculo nezinsizwa ebhajini, kuyilapho i-tragedy iphakamisa izimo ezinzima nezihlukumezayo, ikakhulukazi eziphathelene nezifundo zempilo. Umbuzo 4: Kanjani imidlalo yeshashalazi iyaguquka ngezikhathi? Imidlalo yeshashalazi iguquka kakhulu ngezikhathi nezindawo. Ngaphambi nangemva kukaMachiavelli, izinkanyezi zikaWilliam Shakespeare zengeza ubuhlanga obuphezulu. KwaZulu-Natal, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola ukukhanya nokuhlola, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola izindaba zabantu bendawo. Ezinye izinsuku ziveze izincwadi ezinzima, kanti ezinye zikhombisa ubuhle bomoyizothando. Umbuzo 5: Yini efanele ukuyicabanga uma udlala emidlalweni yeshashalazi? Uma udlala emidlalweni yeshashalazi, kubalulekile ukuba nekhono lokuthola izimo zomoya, ukusiza abadlali ukuhumusha imizwa yabo eqondile. Ukwazi kahle indaba, ukuthanda karakteri nokubona umbono womqondisi kuyisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Ngokuhlanganyela, abanye abadlali, umqondisi, kanye nezisebenzi zomkhosi, kudingeka ukuze kube nesizinda esiqinile, okuholela kumphumela omuhle. Umbuzo 6: Yiziphi izinselelo abadlali abahlangabezana nazo? Abadlali bahlangabezana nezinto eziningi ezinzima, njengezikhathi ezinzima zokusebenza, ukwesaba isikhashana esidala, nokuphimisela imizwa. Ukuxhumana okukhona phakathi kwabantu bejabulisa kudinga ukubhaliswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kwendaba. Izimo zempilo zangaphandle zingase ziphazamise ukusebenza, okuyinto abadlali banqweneleka ukuyilungisa. Umbuzo 7: Kungani imidlalo yeshashalazi ibalulekile njengomphakathi? Imidlalo yeshashalazi ibaluleke kakhulu, ngoba ihlinzeka umphakathi nethuba lokukhuluma ngezindaba ezinzima. Imidlalo ingakhiwa ngezinto ezithinta umphakathi, ezifana nepolitiki, ubudlelwano, nemiphumela yempilo. Ukulandela nasezindabeni ezikhona, izethameli zikhuthazwa ukuba ziqhubele phambili, zikhumbule nezehlakalo ezinhle nezingezinhle ezithintela umphakathi. Umbuzo 8: Yiziphi izindlela zokuxhasa imidlalo yeshashalazi? Ukuxhasa imidlalo yeshashalazi kudinga izindlela ezilukhuni. Zhang’Isithunzi, ungahlinzeka ngezinsiza, imali, noma izinsizakusebenza. Unothando lwakho lwezobuchwepheshe, ungagqugquzela umphakathi, ufake imisebenzi emisha, uthathe izinqumo zokukhethwa kwemiphakathi, noluphi uhlobo lokuhlanganyela olungase kuzokhuthaza amaqembu ahlelwe imidlalo. Umbuzo 9: Uthini umbono wakho ngempumelelo ye-theatre esikhathini esizayo? Ngokubuka esikhathini esizayo, i-theatre ihlale ithuthuka, kanti izinkolelo ezintsha nezobuchwepheshe kuqhubeka kushiwo. Ngenkathi ubuchwepheshe befika, emidlalweni yeshashalazi, ingxoxo izosithokozisa. Ukubona ukusebenza okwakudala, ukuxhumana okuhlukahlukene, nokuqhubeka kokufunda nokukhula, kuzosiza i-theatre ukuba ibambe iqhaza elikhulu emaphusheni nasezimpilweni zabantu. Umbuzo 10: Kanjani umbono wakho wobuchwepheshe bungase busebenze kanjani emidlalweni yeshashalazi? Ubuchwepheshe bungeke buphatheki nje kuphela izethameli eziningi, kodwa bufeza amakhono okukhulisa umqondisi futhi buvumelanisa ebudlelwaneni. Noma qhubeka unina, bazokwazi ukufunda ngemisebenzi efana nezinkanyezi ezaziwayo, ukuthola imizwelo, nenjabulo okwakhaliphile ngaleso sikhathi. Ngakho-ke, umbono wobuchwepheshe bangase bahlale bekuhlu lwempilo yomphakathi phakathi kwabadlali kanye nezethameli.
Uhambo Nokuzijabulisa: Indaba Yomlando Kusukela ezikhathini zakudala, abantu bahlale bejabulela ukuhamba, ukufuna izindawo ezintsha, nokuzijabulisa. Uhambo akukhona kuphela ukuhamba ngezinyawo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana namasiko ahlukene, ukufunda izifundo, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Uma sithatha isinyathelo emlandweni, sithola ukuthi uhambo lwaluwumgubho wokuphila, nokuthi izizukulwane eziningi zaluqhuba ngendlela ehlukahlukene. Ngasekancane, emakhulwini ambalwa edlule, uhambo lwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu bezizwana ezahlukene. Abantu baseMali, njengezinduna zohambo, babengabashayi phansi, bejolisa ekufundeni izizinda ezahlukene. Kwakukhona nezinsuku lapho ukugibela izinkanyezi kwaba yindlela yokuphila, abafana noHammurabi, uMongol uGenghis Khan, kanye nabantu abavela eBhagavad Gita, basiza ekwakheni imikhankaso yokuhamba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindawo ezinjengeGibhithe, iGrisi, neRoma zaba nezikhumbuzo eziningi ezithokozisayo. Lezi zindawo zathakazelisa uchwepheshe nabavakashi. Izindawo ezinjengalezi zazifaka izindawo zokuhlala, izimakethe, nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, lapho abantu bezokwazi ukuxoxa, bahlangane, futhi bazijabulise. Uhambo lwaba yindlela yokuthola ubuhle bempilo, futhi lwaluhambisana nemicabango emisha. Ngemuva kokuhlupheka kukaMhlaba, uhambo lwaphinde lwavuselelwa ngesikhathi sokuhlwaya. Abantu bahlola izindawo eziningi ezazikhona, futhi umkhankaso wokuhamba ube usubiza kakhulu. Izitimela, izindiza, nezikebhe zaba izindlela eziyinhloko zokuhamba, futhi abavakashi baphumelela ekufinyeleleni izindawo ezikude. Lokhu kwashintsha kakhulu indlela abantu ababheka ngayo ukuhamba, kwavula amathuba amasha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zokuhlala zakhula, izindawo zokuzijabulisa zanda, futhi izimakethe zathuthuka. Uhambo lwakha umnotho omkhulu, abantu babefuna izindawo zokudla, izindawo zokuhlala, nezinsizakalo ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi izindawo zibe nezinhlobonhlobo ezihambelana nezidingo zabavakashi, futhi kwavula amathuba emisebenzi. Kodwa uhambo akukhona nje ukufuna izinzuzo; bekukhona nemibuzo ethinta imvelo. Njengoba abantu behamba, izindawo zaba nezinkinga. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhumba, ukungcoliswa, kanye nokungaziphathi kahle kwezinto eziphilayo kwaba yizindaba ezibalulekile. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi kube nesidingo sokubuyisela emuva, sithuthukise izindlela zokuhamba ngempumelelo, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuthi baphatheke kahle emvelweni. Ngesikhathi samanje, uhambo luhamba phambili, futhi izinkampani ezithengisa izindawo zikhula. Uhambo lwemisebenzi, izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngezinto zokuhamba, nezinhlelo zokuhamba ezilula zanda. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhamba, futhi abantu bangakwazi ukufuna izindawo ezithokozisayo, izindawo zokuphumula, nemikhosi eminingi. Uhambo selwaba wumkhankaso omkhulu, futhi abantu bangathola izindawo eziningi ezihlukahlukene, bezijabulisa futhi bejabulela ubuhle bemvelo. Kubuhlungu ukuthi, nakuba uhambo luhamba phambili, sikhumbula njalo izifundo ezitholakele emlandweni. Kubalulekile ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yethu ixhumene nokuhamba, futhi kufanele sibe nomqondo wokuhamba ngempumelelo. Ukuze sithole injabulo, kufanele sihlole izindawo ezihlukene, sifunde ngempilo, futhi sikhuthaze ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuzokwakha umhlaba ophilayo, ogqugquzelayo, futhi ogcwele ukujabulisa. Ngakho-ke, uhambo nokuzijabulisa akukhona nje ukuhamba, kodwa yindlela yokuhlola, yokuxhumana, nokwakha umphakathi. Njengoba siqhubeka sithuthuka, kufanele siqaphele izifundo zomlando, futhi siphinde sihlole izindlela zokuhamba ezihlangabezana nezidingo zethu, nezizukulwane ezizayo. Uhambo luyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sihamba ngayo ngenhlonipho nangezwi elihle, ukuze sithole imfundo, injabulo, nokuhlangenwe nakho okungapheli. Ngalendlela, sizokwazi ukuhamba kahle, futhi sizokwazi ukujabulisa, sithole izifundo eziningi emhlabeni omkhulu. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, uhambo luyindlela yokuxhumana nemvelo, nabantu, nezinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kube yisifundo sokubambisana, sokuthuthukisa, nokuqonda okukhulu phakathi kwethu sonke.
Kuyiqiniso elaziwayo ukuthi izwe lethu, njengamanye amaningi emhlabeni, libhekene nokwehla komnotho. Igama elithi "ukwehla" sekuwumusho ojwayelekile futhi ngandlela thize, sonke sithinteka kulokhu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlangabezana nezinkinga zomnotho, ezidinga ukuba siqinisekise ukuthi sikhona ngokwezimali, ihhovisi lami liqhubeka nokusebenza ngezikhalazo eziphathelene nokumiswa kwemali yokuthola umhlalaphansi. Abatholi balemali bangabantu abadala, abavame ukuba phakathi kwemiphakathi ethwele kanzima ephila ngaphansi kwezinga lokuphila. Omunye umphumela wokumiswa kwemali yokuthola umhlalaphansi nguMnu. Mphephu ovela eLimpopo, oneminyaka engu-86, imihlalaphansi yakhe yemisiwe cishe eminyakeni emithathu ngenxa yokuthi kukhona okukhuluma ukuthi usebenzisa inombolo yokuhlonza yomunye umuntu evela esifundazweni saseFree State. Ngemva kokungenelela kwehhovisi lami, imihlalaphansi kaMnu. Mphephu yabuyiselwa futhi uthole izinkokhelo zakhe eziphakeme. Ngiyakhuthaza iNhlangano Yezokuphepha Komphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika eLimpopo ukuba ibize ithimba lokuhlola udaba lokumiswa kwemali yokuthola umhlalaphansi njengoba kubonakala kuyinkinga ejwayelekile. Ukwenziwa kwalezi ziphakamiso kuzoba usizo olukhulu. Ngenkathi uhulumeni eqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali oluncane lwezindlu kulabo abadingayo, izinselelo zisekhona kulowo mkhakha. Ihhovisi lami muva nje lihlola isikhalazo esivela kubantu base-Unit R nase-S eLebowakgomo mayelana nokwehluleka kokwakha noma ukuqedela izindlu ze-RDP zomphakathi nguMnyango Wezokubambisana Nezindaba Zamasiko eLimpopo. Iziphakamiso ezivela ehhovisi lami zazithi uMnyango kufanele wakhe futhi aqedele izindlu kubo bonke abatholi abavunyelwe izicelo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imali yokuxhaswa yamanje kufanele isetshenziswe ukusiza abakhala njengoba izindleko zokwakha zikhuphukile eminyakeni edlule. Ukubika ubugebengu kuqinise ngempela imiphakathi, ngakho-ke ihhovisi lami lihlola isikhalazo esivela kumuntu ophikisanayo mayelana neNhlangano Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS) ngokwehluleka kwabo ukugcwalisa promises yabo yokukhokha u-R75,000 njengemivuzo ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eholele ekubanjweni nasekugwetshweni kwenhlangano yokweba. Ngemva kokuhlola, ngiphakamise ukuthi i-SAPS ikhokhe umphikisi umvuzo ophelele njengoba bekupromisiwe futhi bagcine izithembiso zabo esikhathini esizayo. Sikhuthaza ukuba uveze izikhalazo zakho; ihhovisi lethu likhona ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni futhi sinefoni yokuxhumana engenamali: 0800 11 20 40 ongayisebenzisa ukufaka isikhalazo. Sibheke phambili ekusebenzeni nawe ukuze siqinise isifiso sabantu njengomyalelo wombuso.
Ulwazi olungamanga ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ngesikhathi sokhetho Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, indima edlalwa kulezi zikhathi zokhetho ibalulekile, kodwa kufanele siqaphele ukuthi zikhona nezingozi, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kulwazi olungamanga. Lezi zinkundla zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu futhi zisheshisa ukwaziswa, kodwa zibuye zibe umthombo wezinkinga. Kumele sikhulume ngalesi sihloko ukuze sikhumbuze abantu ukuba baqaphele. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinkundla zokuxhumana azilawulwa kahle. Noma kukhona izinqubomgomo ezibekwe yizinkampani ezifana ne-Facebook ne-Twitter, lokhu akusizi uma abantu beqhubeka nokusabalalisa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ngesikhathi sokhetho, lapho abaculi, izinkanyezi, kanye nabanye abantu abathandwayo bezithola nezwi elikhulu. Uma umuntu ethumela ulwazi olungamanga, kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu, okungaholela ekutheni abantu benze izinqumo ezingalungile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ulwazi olungamanga lwenza kube nzima kubavoti ukuthola iqiniso. Abantu bavame ukuphazamiseka phakathi kwezindaba ezisemthethweni nezithunyelwe ngabanye, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana lapho izimvo ezingalungile zikhuluma kakhulu. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu bangakwazi ukubona isithombe esiphelele. Kukhona izibonelo eziningi zokuthi ulwazi olungamanga lungakha kanjani izinkinga. Ngokwesibonelo, uma umphakathi uthola ulwazi elichaza ukuthi ungathola izinzuzo kuphela uma uvota eqenjini elithile, lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi abavoti abakwazi ukukhetha kahle. Izindaba ezikhaliphile ezivela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana zingaba nomthelela omubi, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bacabange ukuthi kukhona okuthile okuhle, kanti empeleni isimo siba sibi. Uma abantu behluleka ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwezindaba eziyiqiniso nezisemthethweni, izinqumo zabo zingaphazamiseka, okwenza kube nzima ukukhetha abaholi abaqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ngesikhathi sokhetho, lapho izinqumo ezithathwayo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi abantu abaningi abavoti ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umphakathi ungabi nalwazi olufanele, futhi kungase kubangele ukungavoti, okuyinto engathinta umphakathi. Ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ukuhlakanipha nokuhlola ulwazi kubalulekile. Lezi zinkundla zingaba yinsiza ebalulekile uma zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kodwa uma zisetshenziswa kabi, zingaba yingozi. Ngakho, ngicela wonke umuntu aqaphele ulwazi athola kulo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi sithathe izinqumo eziphusile. Ulwazi olungamanga lungakha izinkinga, lungaphazamisa umphakathi, futhi lungathinta indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo. Ngakho, ngaphambi kokuvota, khumbula ukubheka kahle ulwazi onalo, uqinisekise ukuthi luyiqiniso, ukuze sikwazi ukudala ikusasa eliqinile nelithokozisayo.
Imicimbi Yezempilo Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi: Ukubaluleka Kokubambisana Emphakathini Wethu Imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle inendima enkulu ekwakheni impilo engcono phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le micimbi ingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu nasemphakathini. Lokhu akugxili kuphela ezinhlelweni zokwelapha, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni izimo zokuphila zabantu. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo ayigcini nje ngokwelashwa kwezifo; ihlanganisa nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa impilo yomphakathi, ezifana nezinhlelo zokudla okunempilo, imikhankaso yokuvikela izifo, kanye nezinhlelo zokugqugquzela ukuzivocavoca. Impilo enhle iqala ekudleni okunempilo nasekuzivocavoceni, futhi umphakathi onempilo uthola izinzuzo eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yezempilo ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Izinhlelo zokwelapha ezibandakanya umphakathi, njengezinhlelo zokuhlola impilo, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlanganyele, babelane ngolwazi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwakha umphakathi onempilo. Okwesibili, imicimbi yezempilo inikezela ithuba lokufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila ezinhle, njengezinhlelo zokuvikela izifo, okubalulekile ekunciphiseni ukusabalala kwezifo. Ukuze abantu baqonde izinzuzo zokugoma, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imicimbi yezempilo iyindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze bathuthukise impilo yabo, njengokufaka izinhlelo zokuzivocavoca ezithokozisayo noma imikhankaso yokudla okunempilo. Uma abantu beqonda izinzuzo zokuphila kahle, bazoba nesifiso sokwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo empilweni yabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhaswa okuqinile ukuze imicimbi ibe nempumelelo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imicimbi yezempilo kufanele ibhekelele izinselelo ezithile, ezifana nokungabi namali yokwelashwa, ukungabi khona kwezinsiza, kanye nezinkinga zokufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zikamasipala, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola usizo oludingekayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imicimbi yezempilo kufanele ibheke phambili futhi ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, ukuze ihlale ibhekelele impilo yabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abantu bahlala bephila kahle. Ekugcineni, imicimbi yezempilo nenhlalakahle yomphakathi ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nohulumeni kufanele kube yisisekelo sokwakha imicimbi ethuthukisa impilo. Sizame ukwenza umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuhle, ukuze sonke sithole ithuba lokuphila impilo egculisayo.
Ithuba lezingane liphethwe ngaphansi kohlelo oluphathwa uMphakathi weNkantolo Ephakeme. Lokhu kuyifund lezakhiwo eyakhelwe ukugcina nokuphatha izimali ezikhokhelwe kuMphakathi weNkantolo Ephakeme kubantu abaziwayo noma abangaziwayo, njengabantwana nabantu abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo, abalandeli abangenaminyaka, abantu abalahlekile, noma labo abangabandakanyeki ezindabeni zokuhlala, izinzuzo, noma ezihlobene. Lapho uthola noma yiziphi izimali, uMphakathi weNkantolo Ephakeme uvula ifund emarekhodini ezimali zabantu abanikwa igama lempahla kanye nomnikazi walezi zimali. Uma kungaziwa ukuthi lezi zimali zikhona kubani, ifund ivulwa egameni lomuntu owazilethela noma egameni lempahla echazwe ngaphakathi, kuye ngaleso simo. Imali egcinwe efundini yeziqinisekiso ifakwa kwiKomidi Lokutshalwa Kwezimali Kwamaphakheji, elihlolwa ngumhloli ozimele minyaka yonke. Intshisakalo ikhokhwa ngemali efakiwe efundini yeziqinisekiso, eyenzelwe abantwana abangakwazi ukuzimela, labo abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo, abalandeli abangenaminyaka, kanye nabantu abahilelekile ezimalini, ukuze kusetshenziswe ezindaweni, izimali ezishiywe kubo, kanye nezinzuzo ezihlobene. Intshisakalo ibalwa ngenyanga ngokuya ngesilinganiso esibekwe sonyaka, ngezilinganiso ezibuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile nguNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Intshisakalo ikhokhwa kanye ngonyaka ekupheleni kukaMashi 31 konyaka wezimali. Intshisakalo iyanda ngenyanga ngemva kokwamukela izimali kuze kube sekuqedile iminyaka emihlanu, ngaphandle uma izimali zikhishwa umnikazi ngaphambi kokuphela kwalolo suku. Umuntu obhaliswe efundini angafaka isicelo semali yokuphila efundini yeziqinisekiso. UMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme unelungelo lokukhokha yonke intshisakalo nezimali zifika ku-R100,000 ezimalini eziqoqiwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokuphila ezifana nezimali zesikole, imfundo ephakeme, izingubo, izindleko zezokwelapha, indawo yokuhlala esikoleni, nezinye izidingo ezichazwe esicelweni. Ukuphila kungacelwa ngumuntu ophethe ingane/umgibeli/umlandeli noma othile ophatha i-akhawunti yomuntu obhaliswe, kwenziwa ngokufaka isicelo usebenzisa ifomu J341 kanye nezinkokhelo nezitifiketi zedebhithi. Minyaka yonke ngoMeyi, uMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme uyakhangisa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni izimali ezingakafunwa ngabanikazi bazo. Izimali zingakhokhwa ngqo kumphakeli wesevisi, njengesikole, isikhungo semfundo ephakeme, isitolo sezincwadi, njll. Ingane engakwazi ukuzimela ingafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe kanye nentshisakalo ethathwe uma ifika eminyakeni evumela ukuzimela, okuyiminyaka engu-21, umshado, noma umyalo wenkantolo owenza ukuba izimela. Nokho, umuntu obhala isivumelwano angachaza eminyakeni ethile lapho umlandeli enelungelo lokwamukela izimali zezakhamuzi. Izimali zingacelwa ngumuntu obhaliswe kwi-akhawunti uma uthole imvume yesicelo esibhaliwe kusebenzisa ifomu J251, elandela ikhophi yokukhomba/umbhalo wokuhamba/isitifiketi somshado noma umyalo wenkantolo oqinisekisiwe. Labo abanamalungelo entshisakalo bangathola intshisakalo eyandisiwe ekupheleni konyaka, ngemuva kukaMashi 31. Isicelo sezinzuzo sibhaliwe, kanti umceli uthola umthelela oholela ezizalweni noma imvelaphi yezithelo ezidliwayo (intshisakalo). Umnikazi we-akhawunti angafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe uma enelungelo lokwenza kanjalo (ngokuvamile ngemuva kokufa komuntu oshiya impahla) ngokufaka isicelo esibhaliwe kusebenzisa ifomu J251 kanye nekhophi eqinisekisiwe yokukhomba noma umbhalo wokuhamba. Imali ikhokhwa kanjani? Imali/intshisakalo noma ukugcina ikhokhwa ngecheque ebhalwe egameni lomuntu ofanele. Le cheque ibhalwe ngolayini ukuvimbela ukudluliselwa komunye umuntu. Ngezinye izikhathi, imali ifakwa kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yomuntu ofanele. Kwenzekani ngemali uma ingafunwa ngesikhathi? Ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yezimali ezingakafunwa, uMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme udlulisa lezi zimali ezingakafunwa kwiFund yeMali. Lokhu akusho ukuthi umnikazi ulahlekelwa ilungelo lokufuna lezi zimali kwiFundo yeZingane. Nokho, ekupheleni kweminyaka engamashumi amathathu, lezi zimali ezingakafunwa ziya kuhlinzekwa kuhulumeni. Minyaka yonke ngoMeyi, uMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme uyakhangisa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni izimali ezingakafunwa.
Izinselelo zolayini emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs 1. Isingeniso EmaHhovisi akwa-Home Affairs, izinsizakalo ezinikezwa kubantu zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezidingo zomphakathi. Nokho, abavakashi bayabhekana nezinselelo eziningi uma befika emahhovisi, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela izinsiza abazidingayo. Le dokhumenti izobheka izinselelo ezivamile ezithinta abavakashi, izimbangela zazo, kanye nezinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuze kuphuculwe lezi zimo. 2. Izinselelo Eziyinhloko 2.1 Ukuhlangana nezimo ezinzima Abavakashi bahlala behlangabezana nezimo ezinzima njengokuthi ukuhamba kungazelele, izimo zezulu, noma izigameko eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudala ukuhamba okungalingani, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba phezulu emigodini yokubhalisela izinsizakalo. 2.2 Izinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhubazekile Izinhlelo zokuphatha emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs azilingani kahle, okwenza kube nenselelo yokuphatha izicelo. Imishini yokubhalisela, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zedijithali zihlala ziphuthumayo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni abavakashi balinde isikhathi eside. 2.3 Umthwalo Wokufaka Imibhalo Abavakashi badinga ukufaka imibhalo eminingi ukuze bathole izinsizakalo ezifanele. Lokhu kubandakanya amakhophi wezimvume, izincwadi zokuhlala, nezincwadi zokuhamba. Ukuhamba kahle kwezinqubo zokufaka le mibhalo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavakashi bathola izinsizakalo zabo ngesikhathi. 2.4 Ukuntuleka kwezinhlaka ezihambisanayo Izinhlaka ezihambisanayo, njengeminyango yokubhalisela ezempilo, iminyango yezemfundo, nezinye izinsizakalo zomphakathi, zihlala zingahambisani kahle. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle phakathi kwezinhlaka, okwenza kube nzima kubavakashi ukufinyelela izinsizakalo abadinga ngempumelelo. 3. Izimbangela Zalezi Zinselelo 3.1 Ukuntuleka Kwamathuba Anezinga Eliphezulu Ukuntuleka kwamathuba okulungiselela abavakashi, kubangela ukuthi abavakashi bahlupheke ekutholeni izinsizakalo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuntuleka kwezingcweti ezikwazi ukusiza abavakashi ngenqubo yokufaka izicelo. 3.2 Ukungabi Nazo Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Izinsiza zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinsizakalo eziku-inthanethi, azitholakali kalula, okwenza kube nzima kubavakashi ukuthola ulwazi olunembile. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle nokungahambi kahle kwezinqubo. 3.3 Ukungaboni Njengokubalulekile Imiphakathi eminingi ayiqondi kahle ukubaluleka kokubhaliswa nezinsizakalo zamahhovisi. Lokhu kuholela ekuthi abavakashi bangase benze iziphakamiso eziphuthumayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhamba kahle kwezinsizakalo. 4. Izinyathelo Zokuphucula 4.1 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokuphatha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abavakashi bathola izinsiza zabo ngokushesha, izinhlelo zokuphatha kumele zithuthukiswe. Lokhu kubandakanya ukukhiqiza izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle, ezinekhono lokuphatha ngempumelelo. 4.2 Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi Izisebenzi ezikhona emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs kumele ziqeqeshwe ukuze zikwazi ukusiza abavakashi ngempumelelo. Ukuqeqeshwa okufanele kuzothuthukisa ikhono lezinhlaka zokuphatha izicelo. 4.3 Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zokuxhumana Izinsiza zokuxhumana zidinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze kube nokuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwabavakashi nezinsiza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwezingosi zokuxhumana ezikhona ku-inthanethi, ezikuvumela abavakashi ukuthi bathole ulwazi olulula nolunembile. 4.4 Ukubambisana Nezinhlaka Eziphakeme Ukuze kwandiswe ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, kube nokubambisana phakathi kweminyango ehlukene. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubavakashi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisanayo, kunciphise nokuphazamiseka. 5. Isiphetho Izinselelo zolayini emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs zidinga ukuqashelwa nokuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo. Ukuthola izinsiza ezisebenzayo, ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle, nokuqeqesha izisebenzi zibalulekile ekuphuculeni izimo zabavakashi. Ukuze sithole umphakathi ophumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sihlanganyele ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo ezitholakala emahhovisi akwa-Home Affairs, ukuze abavakashi bakwazi ukufinyelela izinsiza abazidingayo ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo namuhla zingaba nomthelela omkhulu kokuthuthukiswa kokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu athathe isinyathelo sokwenza ngcono lezi zimo.
Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Phuma udoti wezinsana endlini yangasese noma uwufake phansi. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi ahlanzekile ngemva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Ngokuthatha amasampula kule ndawo okukholelwa ukuthi kunamagciwane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kukfood, amanzi, noma umoya, kungahlolwa elabhorethri. Khuthaza umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izindlu zangasese. Dala uhlelo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lwesikhashana kuze kube isikhathi lapho abantu bezoba namanzi okusebenzisa njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi udoti uphume endaweni efanele. Khumbula ukuthi amanzi angcolile yindawo evamile lapho kutholakala khona iTyphoid. Ekuphetheni, iTyphoid yisifo esingavinjwa. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhambisana nezixwayiso ezishiwo ngenhla, lesi sifo singavinjwa. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi lo mgci awuboniwe ngamehlo alula. Ngakho-ke, uma ubona izandla zakho zingcolile, akusho ukuthi uphephile; noma zibonakala zihlanzekile, kufanele uzigeze ngaphambi kokuthinta ukudla. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kufanele baqaphele kakhulu. Lezi zindawo ngokuvamile azinamanzi ahlanzekile nezindlu zangasese. Le simo sithuthukisa ukusabalala kwesifo. Uma umuntu ethola umkhuhlane, headache, ubuhlungu besisu, efuna ukuhlabela, noma enokuhlushwa, kufanele asheshiswe aye kudokotela noma esibhedlela. Khumbula, impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Lesi sifo sikhishwa ngumgci obizwa ngeSalmonella typhi futhi sitholakala ngokuphuza amanzi, ubisi, noma ukudla okungcoliswe ngalo mgci weSalmonella.
