UThabo, umfundisi esikoleni esincane eTshazi, wayezithokozisa emshinini wakhe omncane, ethanda ukuxoxa nabafundi bakhe. Abafundi baphakathi kweminyaka eyisithupha kuya kweyishumi, bezama ukuqonda izifundo zabo ngokusebenzisa izwi elikhuluma, hhayi ngezincwadi kuphela. UThabo wayethanda ukuhamba phakathi kwezigaba zomdabu, efundisa abafundi bakhe indlela yokusebenzisa umculo, izinkanyezi, nezithombe ezikhuluma. Ngelanga elithile, uThabo wanquma ukukhulisa ulwazi kubafundi bakhe ngendlela eyahlukene. Waqoka ukuba bawine umjaho wezemidlalo owawuhlose ukukhombisa amakhono abo, kodwa akekho umjaho ojwayelekile. Kunalokho, umjaho wayeyisithombe sokuxhumana ngeziqephu ezihlekisayo, ezizwakalayo, nezinenhlonipho. UThabo wakwazi ukubakhuthaza abafundi bakhe ukuba bakhe izinganekwane eziphathelene nezimpilo zabo. Njengoba umjaho ufika, bonke abafundi babebonakala benelisekile. UThabo wagcizelela ukuthi amaphuzu awathola kumphumela omuhle, kunokuba atholeke ngezinga eliphezulu. UJosh, umntwana ophakathi, waziwa ngokuba nekhono lokuxoxa izindaba. Wayesebenzisa izwi lakhe ngempumelelo, wakha indaba ezwakalayo ngesiqhwaga sothando, egcizelela ukuthi ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu kufanele buhlonishwe. Naphezu kokuthi uJosh engakaze ahlale phansi abhale, yena wayebonakala echuma ngokukhuluma. Abafundi bahlabelela, bakhuluma izinkulumo ezihlekisayo, abanye baphakela izimvo zabo. UThabo wancoma ukuthi "umqondo omkhulu uphume ezandleni zethu, hhayi phansi." Lezi zisho zakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bahlanganyele kakhudlwana, benza imumnozolo wokuxhumana. Lapho umjaho uphothulwa, uThabo wathola ukuthi ufunde okukhulu kubafundi bakhe. Ubona ukuthi talkative Josh, noSam, noSindi, bonke bayeza phambili ngokunikeza imishwana embalwa, futhi balahlekelwa umcabango wobulili, kodwa baqhubeka besekela omunye nomunye. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThabo waqonda ukuthi ulwazi oluqondiswa ngezwi alukhulumi nje kuphela ngobuchwepheshe; ludinga ukufana nezimo, ukujabulisa, nokwenza umhlaba ube ngowabaqondi nobumbano. Ngalesi sikhathi saziwa ngokuya kulolo suku, kwasuka kwenzeka umdlandla ongu-‘ukulungisa’ impilo yomphakathi. UThabo wazama ukuhlanganisa izindaba zabafundi nabantu abavela emiphakathini yahlukeneyo. Lokhu kwadala ukuzethemba kubazali, abavela emadodeni athi “ningakunqandi” kuphela, balalela ubomi deň zifundisa izingane zabo ukuba zikhulise izwi lazo. Njengoba izinyanga zedlula, uThabo waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abafundi bakhe ukuba bazikhumbule kahle izinkulumo zabo. Wabafundisa ukuthi ulwazi oluningi lungafundwa uma kuqhutshekwe nokukhuluma, ukufingqa, nokuzithokozisa. Abafundi bayeza sezibophele ngaphakathi kwezingxoxo ezikhuluma ngezihloko ezahlukene, besebenzisa imilayezo ethandwayo ngemva kohambo lwezwi. UThabo wathi: “Lapha ekhaya, silapha ukuze siqonde owabanye.” Ekuqaleni, bajabulela ukudlala, kodwa emuva kwalokho, kwaba umhlangano wokuhlonipha. Izithombe ezicolisayo nezimyanjana zaba yizikhumbuzo zabo. Ekupheleni kwesikhathi semfundo, abafundi babehamba beshaya izikhumbuzo ngokukhuluma nezinye izinsizwa nezintombi. UThabo wangabi namazwi akhe nokuloba, kepha wayebona ubungcweti ezinzwaneni zabo, eyizamile ukucacisela amakholwa ababhale izindaba zabantu namuhla. Wakhumbula phansi kwehlisa izindleko zothando lokusebenzisa izwi njengendlela yokufundisa. Lokhu kwakhuthaza nabanye, kwadabukisa abafundi abathokozisayo, baveza umnqamulajuqu omangalisayo. Ngalesi sikhathi, uThabo wagcizelela ukuthi ulwazi, uma lukhuliswa ngezwi, luveza ubunjalo bokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, kuveza amandla okuhlakanipha. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, uThabo wazihlonipha izwi lezingane, lathokozisa njengemihla. Indaba yakhe yawela emlandweni wezifundo, nolwazi lwezwi lwaluyisihluthulelo sokuxhumana. Imphilo yenkolo, ubudlelwano, ukuhamba, nokuxhumana konjengozothile, kwavula iminyango emisha kulabo abawuqonda umsebenzi wabo. Ngesikhathi échaza izithombe eziphathelene nezingane, baveza ukuthi lokho kube yimfundiso ebalulekile kakhulu - ulwazi lwenza umhlaba ube ngowadala. Ekugcineni, uThabo wayekwazi ukukhumbula ukuthi imfundo yeqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni abantu abahlanganyela. Izwi, njengoba uThabo ubekuhlonipha, kwavula umqondo, kwavula izinyathelo, futhi kudala ubuhlakani phakathi kwezizukulwane. Le ndaba igcina ibaluleke kakhulu, njengoba amandla okukhuluma, wokulalela, nemizwa kaThabo nabasekeli bayehluka, kodwa bahlala besebenzisa izwi elihloniphekile. Uhambo lwezwi lubonakala kuphela lukhanya, nomsebenzi kaThabo ungumthombo wamandla emiphakathi.
Ibhola Lombhoxo: Umlando Walo Ibhola lombhoxo, elaziwa nangokuthi i-rugby, ungumdlalo owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele, futhi unezinhlobo ezahlukene ezithokozisayo. Umlando walo uqala ngasekuqaleni kwekhulu le-19 eNgilandi, lapho abantu bezama ukuhlela imihlangano yokuzijabulisa. Ngesikhathi lapho izikole zisebenzisa imidlalo ukuze ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, umqondo wokudlala ibhola elihlukahlukene waqala ukuvela. NgokweJoseph Strutt, imiphakathi yamaNgisi yayijwayele ukudlala imidlalo efana ne-football, kodwa eRugby School, esifundazweni saseWorcestershire, kukhona okuthile okuhlukile okwenzeka. Ngo-1823, umfundisi uWilliam Webb Ellis, owaziwa kakhulu, wathatha isinyathelo esisha. Waphosa ibhola elisindayo, elalidlalwa ngamalungu omphakathi, wabe esithatha waphosa ngesandla, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemithetho emisha. Lokhu kwadala uhlobo olusha lomdlalo, olwaluhloselwe ukukhuthaza amandla, ukuhweba, nokuhlangana. Abanye abafundi baseRugby School baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zinguquko emdlalweni wabo, bathola injabulo nokwaneliseka. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokukhula kweRugby, kanti mqhudelwano eminingi yaqala ukwakheka, kuhlanganisa nezikole eziningi ezazisebenzisa indlela efanayo yokudlala. Umdlalo wakhula waze waphuma ezindaweni eziningi, waba nomthelela omkhulu ezingeni labantu abasha. Ngo-1871, kwasungulwa iRugby Football Union (RFU), okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokudlala ezizwakalayo. I-RFU yaqala ukuhlela imiqhudelwano emikhulu, okuhlanganisa amaqembu avela ezikoleni, ezindaweni ezisemadolobheni, nakwezinye izifunda. Lokhu kwavusa ibhola lombhoxo, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini, kukhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, le midlalwano yakhula yathola imikhuba emisha, efana nemidlalo eyayihlanganisa amaqembu amabili anama-15, namathuba okwenza izigaba zomphakathi ezihlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezifundo ezikhethekile zokudlala ibhola lombhoxo, ezasiza abadlali ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola lombhoxo laba usuku olwaziwa emhlabeni jikelele, kwavela amaqembu ahlukene ezizweni ezahlukene. Ngo-1900, umphakathi waba nesifiso sokwandisa umdlalo, kwavela iRugby League, eyahlanganisa izindlela ezihlukile zokudlala. Lokhu kwaholela emiqhudelwaneni emikhulu efana neNdebe yeRugby World Cup, eyaba yisikhumbuzo sokuhlanganyela kwabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Namuhla, ibhola lombhoxo siwumdlalo odumile, ohlanganisa izigidi zabantu, ikakhulukazi eNew Zealand, e-Australia, eNgilandi, naseFransi. Amaqembu ahlukeneyo abamba imiqhudelwano emihle, futhi abalandeli balokhu bezizwa bejabulile, behlabelela emavikini okukhumbula amaqhawe abamba iqhaza emiqhudelwaneni emikhulu. Umdlalo usuphenduke umphakathi, lapho izizukulwane eziningi zikhula zikhuthazwa ukuba zibe neqhaza emikhankasweni ethuthukisa ubudlelwano bomphakathi. Ibhola lombhoxo, njengomdlalo wendabuko, ubonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungaba yisikhumbuzo sokuhlangana, ukuphila kahle, nokuxhumana. Ubonisa ukuthi nakuba sihluka ngezizinda zethu, singaba nomphakathi ophumelelayo, okhulisa izimfanelo ezinhle, ubungane, nokuzwana. Ibhola lombhoxo akusona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganisa abantu, ukudala izinkumbulo, nokwakha isizwe esinamandla. Kubalulekile ukufundisa izizukulwane ezizayo ngalesi siko, ukuze siqhubeke nokuthuthukisa umphakathi, sigcine izimfanelo ezinhle zenkululeko, ubumbano, nokuhlonipha. Ibhola lombhoxo luhlaza, futhi luhlala lukhanya, lukhumbuza abantu ukuthi umdlalo nabangane bethu babalulekile empilweni yethu. Sokuqhubeka, asishiyi emuva, kodwa sikhumbule izinyathelo ezithathwe abaphambili bethu, siqhubeke nokwakha izinkanyezi ezintsha emkhakheni wezemidlalo.
iXbox: Umbiko Ngempumelelo neKusasa Kwezemidlalo Isingeniso Emhlabeni wamanje, ubuchwepheshe buhlanganisa izimpilo zethu ngendlela ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wezokuzijabulisa. Okwamanje, ukukhetha kwezokuzijabulisa kubalulekile kakhulu, futhi iXbox, eyaziwa yonke indawo, iyisibani sokuxhumana, ukudlala, nokusebenza kube ngcono. Ngalesi sikhathi, sijolise ekubhekeni impumelelo yeXbox, izinguquko ezibalulekile ezithathe indawo, kanye nekusasa eliqhakazile elibhekene nomkhiqizo. Ukwakhiwa KweXbox iXbox yasungulwa nguMicrosoft ngo-2001, kwaba umkhiqizo wokuqala wombukiso wezokudlala owakhiwe ngenkampani ehamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe. Le mkhiqizo wahlelelwa ukuhlinzeka amalungelo amakhulu emidlalweni yevidiyo, kanye nemibono emisha yokuxhumana. I-Xbox Classic, iXbox 360, iXbox One, kanye neXbox Series X/S baye bahlala behlukanisa izinhlelo zokudlala ngendlela ephezulu, bephendula izidingo zabathandi bemidlalo. Ukukhula Kwezimboni Zokudlala Ngesikhathi sokukhula komkhiqizo, iXbox ibhekelele ukukhiqiza imidlalo ehlobene nezimo zokuphila zabantu, izinkanyezi zomhlaba, nezithombe zezimanga. Lokhu kwavula ithuba lokudlala ngomkhiqizo owaziwa ngeXbox Game Pass, okwakha induduzo yokuthola imidlalo eminingi ngenyanga. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMicrosoft yakhuthele ekubandakanyeni abathandi bemidlalo olwazini olunembile, ivula izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze babe nethuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabo. Ubuchwepheshe Obuphambili Ubuchwepheshe beXbox buye buhlala bukhula, bukhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza. I-Xbox Series X, eyethulwa ngo-2020, yethula ukusebenza okusheshayo kakhulu, ukuxhomuza kwamahhala, kanye nemisebenzi ethuthuke kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izici zokudlala ezilula, ezinjenge-haptic feedback kwezilawuli, kanye nezinketho zokuxhumana ezivumela abadlali ukuba baqedela imishado yabo ngezinto ezingcono kakhulu. Imikhiqizo YeXbox neMidlalo Ehamba Phambili I-Xbox ibinenezinhlobo eziningi zemidlalo ezithakazelisayo, ezihlanganisa imidlalo yama-adventure, ama-RPG, ama-shooter, nezinye. Izihloko ezinjenge "Halo", "Gears of War", kanye ne "Forza Horizon" zigqugquzela abadlali, kwenze kube nenhlonipho futhi kube nomphumela omuhle kumphakathi. Ubuchwepheshe bezokwakha imidlalo obukhona, njengokubekwa kweDijithi (Digital Reality) ne-Virtual Reality, buye bukhombisa umphakathi imidlalo engakaze ibonakale phambilini. Izinguquko Zokuxhumana Ngaphezu kokudlala, ukuhlanganiswa kweXbox ne-inthanethi kube nomthelela omkhulu. Ukuze kwenziwe ngempumelelo, kubalulekile ukudala izinkundla zokuxhumana ezifana neXbox Live, evumela abadlali ukuthi badlale ndawonye, baphinde baxhumane. Lokhu kubonisa indlela yezehlukanisa umphakathi wezokudlala, wenza kube lula ukuba abadlali baxhumane, futhi baphinde babelane ngemininingwane nokuhlangenwe nakho. Ikusasa LeXbox Ukubheka phambili, iXbox ibonakala ngenkuthalo emisha. Ngezimbangi ezifana neSony PlayStation neNVIDIA, iMicrosoft ibhekelela ukufezekisa izinjongo ezinkulu zokuba umholi emkhakheni wezokudlala. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibheke ekuqhamukeni nezinye izinhlelo zokudlala ezingama-cross-platform, ukuvikela imidlalo emisha nokuthuthukisa izinto ezintsha zokuxhumana. Isiphetho Ngokubheka emuva, iXbox ibonise ubuhlakani namandla amakhulu ekwakhiweni kwabathandi bemidlalo. Kwaba umkhiqizo ophumelelayo, uhlanganyela izimfuno zabantu, futhi ulokhu uthokozisa ingqondo yabadlali. Ukutholakala kweXbox Game Pass, izinguquko zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezici ezithuthukayo zalesi sikhathi, kudala ikusasa eliqhakazile leXbox. Ngakho-ke, iXbox izohlala ibamba isikhala esihle emhlabeni wezokudlala, iphumela phambili ekwakheni umphakathi ophelele wokuzijabulisa.
Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail Ukusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail kunendima ebalulekile ekuhwebeni nasekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo zokuthutha ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe umnotho ophelele. Nokho, le misebenzi ibhekene nezinselelo ezihlukahlukene ezidinga ukusizakala ngazo ukuze ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Lapha, sizobheka izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuqonda nokuphatha lezi zinselelo. ### Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlonza Izinselelo Ukuze uqonde kahle izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela, kubalulekile ukuhlolela lezi zinto ezilandelayo: - Izimo Zesikhala: Kubalulekile ukuba uhlole izimo zesikhala ngenxa yokuthi izinkinga zendawo zingaholela ekutheni izitimela zibe nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuhamba. - Izinsiza Zokugcina: Qiniseka ukuthi izinsiza zokugcina zikhona. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinto ezifana nezitimela eziningi, imithwalo nezitimela ezihamba phambili. - Izinkinga Zobuchwepheshe: Ubuchwepheshe obuphuma phezulu bungase bube nomthelela ekusebenzeni kwezitimela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zamakhompyutha ziyahambisana kuyadingeka. ### Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlelwa Kwezinsizakalo Ngemuva kokuhlonza izinselelo, uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza kufanele lwenziwe ukuze kubhekelwe izimo ezithile: - Ukuhlelwa Kokusebenza: Gcizelela ukuhlelwa kwezimoto ukuze uthole ukuthi yiziphi ezidingekayo endaweni ethile. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. - Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezimali luhlala luhlangene, ukuze ube nezezimali ezanele zokusebenza kwezitimela. - Ukubambisana Nabanye: Kuhle ukwakha ubuhlakani phakathi kwezinkampani ezithutha imithwalo, ngoba lokhu kuzogqugquzela ukusebenza kahle. ### Isinyathelo 3: Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi Abasebenzi banendima ebalulekile ekusebenzeni kahle kwezitimela. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi basebenza kahle, lezi zinyathelo kufanele zicatshangwe: - Ukuhlinzeka Ngokuqeqeshwa: Ukwenza ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze baqonde izinqubo ezihlukahlukene nokuqonda izingozi ezenzeka. - Izinhlelo Zokuhlola: Beka izinhlelo zokuhlola ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa kuyathinteka yini emsebenzini. - Imiklomelo Nokuqwashisa: Phakamisa imiklomelo ukuze uthokozise ukusebenza kahle nokuzinikela kwabasebenzi. ### Isinyathelo 4: Ukusebenzisa Ubuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe bujwayelekile emhlabeni wanamuhla futhi bungasetshenziswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwezitimela: - Izinhlelo Zokulawula: Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokulawula ezihamba phambili ukuze uphathe izitimela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi zisebenza ngendlela ephumelelayo. - Ubuchwepheshe Be-Tracking: Faka ubuchwepheshe bokulandelela ukudla ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi imithwalo ithunyelwa ngesikhathi. - Ukubambisana Nezinkampani Zobuchwepheshe: Hlanganyela nezinkampani ezikhethekile bobuchwepheshe ukuze uthole izixazululo eziphumelelayo nezisemqoka. ### Isinyathelo 5: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezimali Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukusebenza kuhlelekile, izinyathelo zokubuyekezwa kwezimali zidingeka: - Ukuhlola Imali Engenayo: Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlole imali engenayo njalo ukuze uthole izinkinga eziphakeme. - Ukunciphisa Izindleko: Faka izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zihamba kahle ngesikhathi esifanayo. - Ukwenza Izibalo Zokusebenza: Qhathanisa izibalo zokusebenza ukuze ubone izindawo ezidinga ukuthuthukiswa. ### Isinyathelo 6: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezokuphepha Ukuphepha kwempahla nokuhamba kwezitimela kufanele kube ukuhlanganyela: - Izivivinyo Zokuphepha: Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izitimela zihlolwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha. - Ukwenza Amathuluzi Okuphepha: Vula izinhlelo zokuphumelela kuphrojekthi yezehlakalo ukuze unciphise ubungozi bokusebenza. - Ulwazi Nokuqwashisa Ngenhlekelele: Nikeza abasebenzi ulwazi lokuthola nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. ### Isinyathelo 7: Ubufakazi Bokusebenza Ukugcina ikhono lokusebenza kwesitimela, kubalulekile ukuhlola ubufakazi bokusebenza: - Ukubuyekezwa Kwemiphumela: Hlela ukubuyekezwa kwemiphumela ukuze uqonde ukuthi ibhizinisi lisenza kahle kangakanani. - Amaphrojekthi Wokuthuthukisa: Qhuba amaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa onke amakhono nezinsizakalo ezitholakala. - Ukubambisana Nabasindisa: Hlanganyela nabaqeqeshi nabasindisa ukuze uthole okokusebenza nokubuyekezwa ### Isinyathelo 8: Ukuqhubeka Nelson Ukwamukela izimo ezizayo, kudingeka ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza: - Ukuhlela Uhlelo Lwakho: Bhalela phansi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi usebenza kahle. - Ukujwayela Izinguquko Zobuchwepheshe: Bezelwe ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, bese uqhubeka ubuyekeza uhlelo lwakho. - Izinhlelo Zokuphatha: Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphatha ukuqhuba imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo. ### Isiphetho Ukwenza kahle kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail kuncike ekuphathweni kahle kwezinselelo ezibhekene nakho. Ngokuqonda izinyathelo ezibalulekile nezindlela zokusebenza, inkampani inganqoba lezi zinselelo futhi iqhubekele phambili emsebenzini wayo. Ngalolu lwazi, iTransnet Freight Rail ingazi ukuthi ithuthuka kahle futhi iqhuba umsebenzi wayo ngendlela engcono.
Odokotela eNingizimu Afrika Ekuqaleni, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, odokotela eNingizimu Afrika benza umsebenzi obalulekile wokuhlinzeka ngempilo kubantu. UDr. Thandiwe, udokotela ophumelelayo, wayengomunye walabo. Wakhulela emndenini ophakathi, kodwa wayenombono omkhulu wokuba udokotela. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wathola ithuba lokusebenza esibhedlela esikhulu eGoli. Lapha, wabona izimo ezinzima, abantu abahluphekayo, nezifo eziningi. Noma kunjalo, uThandiwe wayenokholo, futhi wayazi ukuthi umsebenzi wakhe wawubalulekile. Waqala ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye odokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nezisebenzi zempilo. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandiwe wathola isimo esinzima. Umfana omncane, uSipho, wayelimele kakhulu emgwaqweni. UThandiwe waphuthuma, wathola ukuthi uSipho udinga ukuhlinzwa ngokushesha. Wakhumbula izifundo zakhe, waba udokotela onobuchule, waqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abanye odokotela bazi ukuthi uSipho udinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Ngemuva kokuhlinzwa, uSipho waphila. UThandiwe waba isibonelo sokuba odokotela baseNingizimu Afrika bangabantu abanesibindi, abakhuthazayo, futhi abahlala bephokophele ukuphila kwabanye. Kodwa, uThandiwe waphinde wabhekana nezithiyo eziningi. Ngesikhathi esebenza, wathola ukuthi izinsiza ezitholakalayo zazinganele. Izibhedlela zazigcwele, futhi abanye abantu babengenakho ukufinyelela emithini. Lokhu kwenza uThandiwe azizwe edabukile, kodwa akazange ayeke. Waqala ukuhlela imihlangano nabanye odokotela, abahlengikazi, kanye nezinkampani ezizimele ukuze bathole izinsiza ezidingekayo. UThandiwe waba isibonelo sokuhlanganyela, waqala umkhankaso wokwakha izikhungo zokunakekela impilo ezindaweni ezikude, ukuze abantu bahlale befinyelela usizo. Waqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana, abakhubazekile, nabantu abadala bahlala benakekelwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhankaso kaThandiwe waba yimpumelelo. Izikhungo eziningi zakhululwa, futhi abantu baphila kahle. UThandiwe waba yisithonjana emphakathini, futhi abantu bamthanda. Wafunda ukuthi odokotela akumele babe yizigidi ezithile, kodwa kufanele babe nabantu abakhathalelayo, abathanda ukusiza abanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe wathola ithuba lokuhola umnyango wezempilo. Waqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, eqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zikhona kubo bonke abantu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala kuphi. UThandiwe waba isibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwenza umehluko omkhulu. Ekugcineni, uThandiwe waba udokotela ophumelelayo, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu, waba ngumuntu ophumelelayo empilweni. Wafunda ukuthi impilo ayinayo imingcele, futhi odokotela baseNingizimu Afrika bahlala bephokophele ukusiza abantu, benza umhlaba ube ngcono. Ngakho, uThandiwe waphila impilo egcwele, enza umsebenzi wakhe ngothando, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima, umoya wokuzinikela ungaguqula impilo yabantu. Odokotela baseNingizimu Afrika, njengomoya opholile, bahlala bephokophele ukusiza, bephila impilo enenjongo.
Abathengisi Basemgwaqeni: Izinqubo Zokuphila Nokusebenza Abathengisi basemgwaqeni, noma abathengisi bezimpahla ezithengiswa emgwaqeni, banendima ebalulekile emphakathini. Imfundo yethu iqala ngokuqonda ukuthi ungubani umthengisi wase mgwaqeni nokuthi udlala kanjani indima ekwakheni umnotho. Ubuchwepheshe bethu bukhulu kumakhono okuphila abafundisile, okubasiza ukuba baphile kahle nasemhlabeni onzima. Isinyathelo 1: Izidingo Zokuqala Ukuze ube umthengisi ophumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda izidingo zakho zokuqala. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka izicathulo ezikahle, ukugcina okuhlanzekile, kanye nokuba nempahla ethengisayo efanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthenga impahla ezokwanela izidingo zabathengi bakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ngoba abathengi bazofuna izimpahla ezikhanga futhi ezisemthethweni. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhweba Nobuqotho Bheka kahle indlela ozohweba ngayo. Ubuqotho bubalulekile ekuthandeni kwabathengi. Uma uveza ubungcweti bakho, lokhu kuzokwenyusa ukukholwa kwabathengi. Hlalani niyavuma ukuhweba ngenani elifanele, futhi nizinikeze ithuba lama promosions, okungakhuthaza abathengi ukuba bakuthenge. Isinyathelo 3: Ukukhangisa Ngebhizinisi Lakho Ukuze ukwazi ukukhulisa ibhizinisi lakho, kubalulekile ukuthi ukhange abathengi. Lokhu kungafeza ngendlela yokusebenzisa izikhangiso ezilula, ezifana nezikhangiso ezibhalwe phansi kwezimoto, noma izikhangiso ezisemigwaqeni. Ungasebenzisa izithombe ezipholile ukuze uthuthukise imikhiqizo yakho. Ukukhangisa, qhubeka uvule ukubonisana nezinye izitolo ezingakuthanda ukuzimbandakanya. Isinyathelo 4: Hlalani Nibheke Phezu Kwezidingo Zabathengi Thola ukuthi abathengi bakho bakhathazekile ngani. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufika ezidingweni zabo, futhi nazi iziphi iziphakamiso ezilungile. Funda ngendlela abantu abakhuluma ngayo nezindlela abaziphatha ngazo. Umthengi ufanelwe, futhi uma ungenza imizamo yokuqonda, uzothola imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo 5: Imithetho Nezikhumbuzo Khumbula ukuthi abathengisi basemgwaqeni kumele bazi imithetho yendawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthola ama-athikili afanele nezidingo zokuhweba. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezinkinga zomthetho. Ngokwenza kahle, uzokwazi ukukhetha indlela efanele yokuhweba. Isinyathelo 6: Ukuxhumana Nabanye Abathengisi Uxhumano lwabathengisi luwusizo emsebenzini. Xhumana nabanye abathengisi basemgwaqeni ukuze wabelane ngama-sampling, banalise izimpahla ezenzakalayo, futhi niphumelele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhweba kahle, ukwakha ubudlelwano, kanye nokuthola izinzuzo ezinkulu. Isinyathelo 7: Thola Impendulo Kubathengi Bakho Ukuthola impendulo kubathengi kubalulekile. Babuze, thola imibuzo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyaphendula. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuba uqonde uma abathengi befisa okuthile, futhi kuholele ekwandeni kwebhizinisi lakho. Hamba phambili futhi uhlale uvulelekile eziphakamisweni, njengoba lokhu kuzokwenza ube nomqondo ophusile. Isinyathelo 8: Phumelela Ngezinsiza Zokuphila Ukwakha ibhizinisi eliyimpumelelo kudinga izinsiza zokuphila. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imali, amandla, impilo, nezinsizakalo ezithandwa abathengi. Hlala uhlale uvumelana nezimo, futhi ulandele izindlela ezidingekayo ukuze ubhekele imisebenzi yakho ngosuku nosuku. Isinyathelo 9: Bhala Isu Lokukhula Hamba phambili ngosizo lwezinhlelo ukuze uqonde umgomo wakho. Yazi ukuthi uyobheka kuphi, futhi uphumelele kuphi. Lokhu kuhle uma uhweba ngokuhlakanipha. Ake ubhalise izinhlelo zakho, ngesikhathi sokukwazi ukuphumelela ngempela. Isinyathelo 10: Qhubeka Ufuna Uthando Nobuqotho Ekugcineni, akubalulekile kuphela ukuba umthengisi ophumelelayo, kodwa udinga ukuba umthengisi onothando. Uthando lukhona lapho unakekela abathengi bakho, njalo uzibophelele ukwenza okungcono; lo mkhuba uzokwenza ibhizinisi lakho likhule njalo. Ngemuva kokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathola abakuthandayo, uhlale ulungile, futhi ube nomsebenzi onempumelelo. Njengoba abathengisi basemgwaqeni bephakathi kwezimo ezingezinhle, ukudlalwa kwemali akuhambisani nezidingo zabathengi, futhi lezi zinyathelo zizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela impumelelo ehlukile. Ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokwabelana ngothando, kungenza ukuthi umbono wakho upeyintwe nempumelelo empeleni.
Ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena, kanye nabanye abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Umphakathi ungumuntu oqokwe nguMphakathi weNkantolo noma iNkantolo ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Izingane zibhekwa njengabantu abanokukhubazeka ngoba umthetho uthathe ukuthi azikwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Uma lezi zingane zine mpahla, kubalulekile ukuba kube nomuntu oqokwe ukuphatha ifa. Ngokuvamile, umntwana unabangane abaphethe impahla yabo nezindaba eziphathelene nabo, ngakho akukho sidingo sokubabiza njengoba bengabakhulumeli babo. Nokho, kungase kwenzeke ukuthi izingane zingabi nabakhulumeli noma abazali, futhi kudingeka ukuba kube nomphakathi wengane oqokwe ukuphatha ifa noma impahla. Noma umntwana enomphakathi wemvelo, iNkantolo inganquma ngokuhlukile. Uma impahla yomntwana ihlanganisa imali efakwe kwi-akhawunti yomphakathi, akudingeki ukuba kube nomphakathi ophathayo, nakuba umphakathi angase aqokwe. Ukuphathwa komphakathi ezindabeni zezingane kudlala izindima ezimbili ngaphansi kwalesi simo. Ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Isimo eNingizimu Afrika siqonda ukuthi umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ungumuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 ongakhululiwe ngesimo somshado noma umyalo wenkantolo. Ukukhala kufakwa eNkantolo. Ifomu J243 lichaza impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Ukuphathwa komuntu ofanele njengomphakathi, oqokwe ngumndeni womntwana (ngokuvamile abantu abaqokwe baveza emhlanganweni obizwa nguMphakathi weNkantolo ngenhloso yokuxoxa ngale ndaba). Isicelo sokuphathwa njengomphakathi senziwa sisebenzisa ifomu J197. Ubaba ophilayo ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana. Umama womntwana owazalwa ekhaya ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela lowo mntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Ubaba onikwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Itestamente lapho kuthiwa umphakathi kufanele ibhaliswe kahle futhi yamukelwe nguMphakathi weNkantolo. Inani lesikhashana lempahla yomntwana kufanele liboniswe kufomu J243. Umbiko ochaza ukuthi umphakathi oqokwe ukhethwe ngumuntu onegunya emqulwini oqukethwe ku-testamente nokuthi umuntu obhale i-testamente wayenelungelo lokwenza kanjalo. Umsebenzi kanye neziqinisekiso zomphakathi oqokwe ziqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokuthi umphakathi akhululwe yi-testamente ekwethuleni lezi ziqinisekiso. I-Nkantolo, njengomgibeli wezingane onamandla amaningi, ingaqoka umuntu njengomphakathi ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana nokuphatha impahla yabo nefa. Kuvame ukuba ngumuntu onokukhathazeka ofaka isicelo eNkantolweni. Ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo, iNkantolo iqoka umgibeli wefa ukuvikela amalungelo omntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ukuze ihlole isimo futhi ibone ukuthi isicelo sikhona kanjani. Umgibeli wefa noMphakathi weNkantolo kufanele baveze imibiko eNkantolweni. Uma iNkantolo isiqedile ukucubungula isicelo, iqoka umphakathi, futhi uMphakathi weNkantolo kufanele aqale isinqumo seNkantolo ngokukhishwa kweMibhalo Yomphakathi nokubavumela ukuba baqale njengomphakathi. Lo mbhalo ofanayo wesicelo seNkantolo ulandelana nemibiko ekhishwe ngumgibeli wefa noMphakathi weNkantolo. Isinqumo seNkantolo sokuphatha umphakathi. Ifomu J242 liqukethe inani lempahla nefa lomntwana. Umsebenzi kanye neziqinisekiso zomphakathi oqokwe ziqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokuthi iNkantolo ikhulule ekwethuleni lezi ziqinisekiso. Ukuphatha ifa labantu abashonile abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Abantu abachazwe yiNkantolo njengokuphatha kabi impahla. Ukuphatha ifa labantu kanye nemali ethathwe ngokomthetho yiMnyango Wokuphatha Izimpahla ngomyalo wenkantolo. Ukuphatha ifa lomuntu okungasekho (umuntu ongaziwa ukuthi uphi futhi ongekho nommeli wakhe eNingizimu Afrika). Akuyona indawo yeMphakathi weNkantolo ukuhlela umuntu ukuba anakekele umntwana noma umuntu ophatha isimo nempilo yomntwana. INkantolo Ephakeme ingaqoka omunye umuntu ngaphandle komndeni womntwana njengomuntu ozosiza umntwana. Ngokufanayo, iNkantolo Ephakeme ingathathela lowo muntu osiza umntwana ilungelo lokuba umxhaso walo mntwana. Mayelana nokugcina umntwana ophazamisekile, iMthetho Wezingane No. 74 ka-1983 uveza ukuthi uMphakathi Wokunakekela Izingane endaweni lapho umntwana ehlala khona ungakwazi ukuhlela umuntu ukuze anakekele umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena, uma kutholakala ngemuva kokuhlola ukuthi umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa. Isigaba 14 seMthetho Wezingane sichaza izimo lapho umntwana ethathwa edinga ukunakekelwa, okuhlanganisa isimo somntwana ongenabo abazali noma abakhulumeli noma isimo lapho abazali babo bengatholakali. Umuntu oqokwe nguMphakathi Wokunakekela ungumuntu onakekela umntwana nsuku zonke. Nokho, umgibeli womntwana akanalungelo lokuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakabi nakho amandla okuphatha yena.
Ukushayela ngejubane elidlula lezo ezibekwe ezimpahleni zomgwaqo kuyimbangela yokwenzeka kwezingozi zemoto eziholela ekulimazeni okukhulu noma ekufeni kwabantu ngaphezu kuka-50% eNingizimu Afrika. Ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kuyingozi ngoba kwenza konke ukuhamba kube yingozi kakhulu. Uma ushaya ngesivinini, kuba nzima ukumisa noma ukulawula imoto yakho. Unesikhathi esincane sokuphendula uma ubhekene nesimo esibalulekile. Imikhawulo yesivinini ibekwe ngokwakheka kanye nokuhlala kwabantu emgwaqweni. Imigwaqo yasemadolobheni, lapho kukhona khona abantu abaningi, inemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi kunezindlela zasemakhaya ezinezimoto ezincane. Imigwaqo eduze kwezikhungo zemfundo nezinye izindawo ezinabantu abaningi ingase ibe nemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi. Abahamba ngezinyawo: Hamba uhlale ubheke abahamba ngezinyawo. Izikhathi zokuhlala kwabantu: Nciphisa isivinini futhi uqaphele. Iphutha labantu liyimbangela enkulu yokwenzeka kwezingozi zemoto. Isimo sezulu esimanzi: Uma umgwaqo umanzi, ibanga lokumisa liyanda. Isivinini kumele sincishiswe kakhulu. Isimo sezulu esinefu kanye nokushayela ebusuku: Nciphisa isivinini uma ukubonakala kungesihle. Khumbula ukuvula izibani zakho zebhasi ebusuku, hhayi nje izibani zokumisa. Izimo zomgwaqo ezimbi: Ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo kanye nemigwaqo embi kunciphisa izinga lokuphepha. Bheka izindawo ezimbi emgwaqweni. Ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kuyingozi noma emigwaqweni emihle futhi ephephile ngokuphelele. Umshayeli oshayelayo ngesivinini esikhulu uphazamisa ukuhamba kwemoto futhi angase abangele ingozi kwezinye izimoto. UMTHETHO AWUVUMELI NABANI NA UKUDLULA IMIKHULULO YESIVININI EBUKELWE. Umkhawulo we-alcohol emzimbeni wezinyathelo zomshayeli ngu-0.05 g/100 ml. Noma ngabe uphansi komkhawulo, ungase uphathwe icala lokushayela uphuzile uma kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi ukuphuza kwakho kuthinte ukuhamba kwakho. Ngakho-ke, kungcono ukulandela umthetho omuhle: Ungazami ukuhamba uphuzile!! I-alcohol ithinta zonke izisebenzi ezidingekayo zokuhamba ngokuphepha. Iphazamisa ukuqaphela kwakho, ukuhlela, ukubona, ukuhlela, ukulalela, ukuqapha, kanye nesikhathi sokuphendula. Awukwazi ukulawula imoto yakho kahle. I-alcohol ikwenza uzizwe ungathinteki futhi ungazi ngezinto ozihlayo. Ungalahlekelwa yimpilo yakho, noma ubulale noma ulimele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Ungabhekana necebo elingafika ku-R24,000 NOMA ubhekane neminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ejele. Ilayisensi yakho ingavinjwa isikhathi esingama-3 ezinyangeni uma uphula umthetho okokuqala, unyaka wesibili, kanye neminyaka emihlanu wesithathu. Ngamafuphi, isivinini ne-alcohol kuyinhlanganisela ebhubhisa. Ungaphuzi futhi ushaye.
Abaholi bendabuko banamandla okwenza izinqumo zomthetho kanye nezinqumo zokuphatha. Kubalulekile ukuqonda umehluko phakathi kwalezi zisebenzi ngoba imithetho ebaholelayo ihluke. Izinqumo zomthetho zenzeka uma umholi wendabuko ebizwa ukuze axazulule ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi noma ukuze abhekane nezikhalazo ezenziwe yilungu lomphakathi elilodwa ngokumelene nelinye. Uma amalungu amabili omphakathi ekholelwa ukuthi banelungelo lokuvumela izinkomo zabo ukuba zidle endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko ubizwa ukuze acacise ukuthi ubani phakathi kwabo onelungelo lokusebenzisa leyo ndawo. Lezi zinqumo zomthetho ngoba inhloso yazo ukuvuselela ukungaboni ngaso linye. Uma ilungu lomphakathi likhalaza elinye ngokweba izinkukhu zawo futhi le ndaba ilethwa kumholi wendabuko, kusho ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe isinqumo somthetho. Uma ilungu lomphakathi lithumela isicelo kumholi wendabuko sokuthola indawo yokuvuna izinkomo zawo noma ilungelo lokwakha indlu yalo endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko uzokwenza isinqumo sokuphatha mayelana nokuthi leli lungu kufanele livunyelwe yini. Ukwenziwa kwezinqamuleli zokuphatha kulawulwa isigaba 33 seMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha, 2000. Ngokusho kwale mthetho, zonke izinqumo noma izenzo zokuphatha ezithathwa umholi wendabuko kufanele zihambisane nomthetho, zibe neqiniso, futhi zilandele indlela efanele. Umholi wendabuko owenza isinqumo sokuphatha noma othatha isenzo sokuphatha kufanele, uma eceliwe, anikeze izizathu zaleso sinqumo noma isenzo kubo bonke abathintekayo. Uma umholi wendabuko ehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zizathu, umceli angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokubacela ukuba bahlinzeke ngalezi zizathu. Uma izizathu zikhona futhi iphathi ethintekayo ikholelwa ukuthi azilungile futhi azilandelani ngendlela efanele futhi evumelekile, le phathi ethintekayo kufanele ifake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi leso sinqumo sibuye sithathwe kabusha. Umthetho ophathelene nokwenza izinqumo zokuphatha uvela emthethweni ojwayelekile, kodwa manje usuphakathi komthetho ophathelene Nokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha. Ikhophi ye-boeklet enesihloko esithi 'Umhlahlandlela Osebenzayo Wokuphatha Ubulungiswa' izonikezwa bonke abahlanganyeli kulolu cwaningo. Le booklet inikeza uhlaka lwezinyathelo ezihilelekile ekwenzeni izinqumo zokuphatha, lapho isinyathelo sokuqala siba ukucabangela isizathu esenza umuntu athole amandla okwenza isinqumo noma ukuthatha isenzo. Uma abaholi bendabuko benza izinqumo zomthetho, kufanele bahambisane neMthethosisekelo, izimiso zomthetho ojwayelekile mayelana nokwenza izinqumo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izimo zokuthuthukiswa komthetho. Iningi lezi zihloko ezizoxoxwa kulolu cwaningo zizohambisana nokwenza izinqumo zomthetho. Izinqumo zomthetho kufanele zenziwe uma isicelo sithunyelwa noma uma izinqumo zihlolwa.
Amalungelo Abantu: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezimiso Nezithiyo Amalungelo abantu, njengokwaziwa kwethu, ayizimiso ezisemqoka ezihlonipha ubuntu bomuntu nomphakathi. Lezi zinkolelo ziqhakambisa isidingo sokuthi wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungubani, unelungelo lokuphila, ukuthula, nokuqhuba impilo enempilo. Amalungelo abantu akha isisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo, nolwaziyo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amalungelo abantu awawona umqondo omusha; imibono yokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu ibhalwe emlandweni, ikakhulukazi ezincwadini ezisemthethweni ezifana neSivumelwano Sokuhlonipha Amalungelo Abantu, esayiswa ngo-1948. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umhlaba onobulungiswa, lapho abantu bejabuliswa khona ngokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abo. Nokho, nakuba lezi zinkolelo zikhona, izithiyo eziningi zikhona ezivimbela abantu ekutholeni amalungelo abo. Izinkinga ezihlobene namalungelo abantu ziye zakhula, zidalwa yizimo zomphakathi, ezombangazwe, nezomnotho. Ezinye zezinkinga ezinkulu zifaka phakathi ukucindezelwa kwabantu, ubuhlanga, ubudlova, kanye nokungabi nandlela emnothweni, okuvusa ukungalingani emphakathini. Kukhona izifunda ezithile emhlabeni ezibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, lapho amalungelo abantu engahlonishwa khona, futhi abantu bahlukunyezwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Izinkampani ezinkulu, ezizimele, nazo zineqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izinkampani zikhula zibe namandla emhlabeni jikelele. Uma izinkampani zingahambisani nemigomo yokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, zingadala umonakalo omkhulu, okungaholela ekuphulweni kwamalungelo abantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqinise izinqubomgomo ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi yazo ayilimazi abantu. Ukwaziwa nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abantu akukhona kuphela emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa nakumaqembu amancane, izizukulwane, nezinhlangano. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu, uqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ngalokhu, futhi ubonise indlela yokulwa nezinsolo zokuphulwa kwamalungelo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kukamasipala, izikhungo zemfundo, nezinhlangano ezizimele. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujule ngamalungelo abantu, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangawathola kanjani. Lokhu kudinga ukufundiswa, ukuze abantu bazi amalungelo abo, nezindlela zokuzivikela uma lezi zinkinga zenzeka. Ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokufundisa amalungelo abantu ezikoleni nasemiphakathini kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa. Ekugcineni, amalungelo abantu ayisisekelo sokwakha umhlaba onobulungiswa, ophumelelayo. Nokho, izithiyo eziningi zikhona ezivimbela abantu ekutholeni amalungelo abo. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, lapho amalungelo abantu ehonishwa khona. Lokhu kudinga ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bazi amalungelo abo, baphakamise izwi labo, futhi balwele ukwakha umhlaba onobulungiswa. Ngakho, amalungelo abantu awawona nje amagama, kodwa ayisixhumanisi esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa elingcono.
Ukhetho Lukazwelonke Isingeniso Ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlale luwumcimbi obalulekile empilweni yabantu besizwe. Luhlanganisa inqubo yokukhetha abaholi nemigomo ezothatha izinqumo eziyohlukanisa isizwe, futhi luhlanganisa umsebenzi wokukhuthaza intshisekelo yomphakathi. Lezi zinguquko zenzeka ngezindlela ezihlukene, kuya ngentuthuko yezombusazwe, izifiso zomphakathi, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo ezisemthethweni ezihambisana nokhetho lukazwelonke, izinselele, kanye nezinzuzo ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ukwakhiwa Kwesikhashana Ngaphambi kokhetho, kube nezinyathelo ezihlukahlukene ezibalulekile ezithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inqubo iyasebenza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kwezinhlaka ezihlukene ezibhekelela ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluchachile lokuthi abavoti bangakhetha kangakanani. Abalawuli bezokhetho, njengeKomidi Elibusayo, banenqubo ethile yokubhalisa abavoti, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababhaliswayo bahlala bezimele futhi bekwazi ukukhetha ngokukhululekileyo. Ukwaziswa Nokuqwashisa Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ube nolwazi olwaneleyo mayelana nezikhangiso zokuqhakambisa, imishwana yokhetho, nezinhlelo ezithile ezithintekayo. Lokhu kuxhunyaniswa nokukhuthazwa kwempilo yesifunda, isimo somnotho, kanye nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi. Ukuvezwa kwemibono ehlukene emathubeni okhetho kunciphisa ubuphofu bokuqonda kwabahlanganyeli, okwadlalela indima enkulu ekuthatheni izinqumo ezizwakalayo. Izinqwaba Nezinselelo Zokhetho Naphezu kwezinzuzo eziningi ezihambisana nokhetho, izinselele zikhona. Ukuphikisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zezombusazwe kuvamise ukwenzeka, okungaholela kudlame noma ukungalungi. Futhi, kungenzeka ukuthi kube nezinkinga zokusebenza eziholela ekuqoqweni kolwazi olungelona iqiniso noma olungamanga. Lokhu kungaba nemiphumela emibi kumphakathi, okubangela ukuthi abavoti bangalindeli kahle izithombe ezizwakalayo nezihlongozwayo. Ubucayi beMiphumela Isikhashana ngasinye sokuqhuba ukhetho luthinta ukubuyiselwa kwesithunzi nokwethembeka komphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile emiphumeleni yokhetho ehlanganisa isikhathi eside sokubusa okuyimpumelelo. Izinqumo ezithathwa nguhulumeni kumele zifake izidingo zomphakathi, kukhuthazwe ukukhula kokumbi kanye nokuphila kahle, kubonise ukuthi ukhetho liluhlobo oluthile lwezidingo zomphakathi. Ukukhuthazwa Kokuthola Amathuba Noma kunjalo, ukhetho lukazwelonke akukhanyi nje njengokukhetha kuphela kodwa futhi kungumthombo wokwakha amathuba amaningi. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi kwabantu abasha, okukhuthaza ukuthola amandla okuba neqhaza ezinqumweni zomphakathi. Ngakho, imikhankaso yokuxhasa abantu abasha ukuthi balandele izikhungo zezombusazwe iyadingeka ukuveza amandla abo. Ukuhlonishwa Kwezimvo Izinyathelo ezithathwa ngaphambi, phakathi, nangemva kokhetho zidinga ukuhlonishwa. Kubalulekile ukuba abaholi bahloniphe imizwa yomphakathi kanye nemibono ehlukene, ukuze kube nokuphila okukhona entabeni yobumbano. Ukuhlonishwa kwamazinga okuphathelene nabavoti nokuqinisekisa ukuthi basubathi ekubaleni - lokhu kuqinisekisa ukwethembeka nokufaneleka kokhetho. Imiphumela Yakusasa Njengoba sikhuluma ngempilo yesimo sokhetho, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela oyibona namuhla izoba nemthelela emiphumeleni yelokhu kuzokwenziwa kwesikhathi esizayo. Umphakathi onenhlonipho ubonisa amandla okuphila kahle, futhi ubuchwepheshe obusheshayo bendawo buphinde bubonakale. Ukukhula ngokuhleleka ezindabeni zezombusazwe kuzongena ngegoli lokuphila kahle, okukhombisa izifiso zabantu. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukhetho lukazwelonke luhlaba umxhwele wokusebenza kwezinhlaka ezithile, okukhiphayo nokuhambisa izinqumo ezifanele kumphakathi. Izinyanga zokhetho zenziwa ngendlela efanele, ziphinde zibe umsebenzisi ophumelelayo osiza umuntu ngamunye. Uma umphakathi uqonda inqubo yokhetho, ubambisene ukuze uqinisekise umphumela ophelele, khona-ke ukhetho luzoba umgudu ngempela wokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kumele sihlale siphakamisela ukukhetha okungenamkhawulo, ukuze sibe neqhaza eliyigugu ekwenzeni izinqumo ezithintekayo, okulungiselela imiphakathi yethu ngokukhanyisela izinkanyezi zasemhlabeni.
Mphakathi ohloniphekile, uMphakathi wePhondo, uMphakathi ohloniphekile uDkt. Sibusiso Ndebele, oMphakathi ohloniphekile beMemeber bePhalamende, oMphakathi ohloniphekile beMemeber bePhalamende yePhondo, uMphakathi ohloniphekile, uMphakathi weKomidi Lezempilo, uMphakathi ohloniphekile uMeya kanye nabakhethi, oBuholi bendabuko, uMphakathi oHoli beMnyango uDkt. Yolisa Mbele, abasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo, izivakashi zethu ezahlukene, izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, abafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, ngizizwa ngihloniphekile ukuhlala phambi kwenu nalesi sikhungo namuhla njengom member ohloniphekile nowaziyo we-African National Congress, lapho sibhiyozela iminyaka emihlanu zobuqotho balolu hlangano ekusebenzeni kwabantu, njengoba kushiwo nguMongameli wethu, oMphakathi ohloniphekile uMnu. Thabo Mbeki, ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngenkonzo yokusebenza kwabantu ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobuphofu. Siqhubeka nalolu zobuqotho, futhi ngikholelwa ukuthi senze okungcono kakhulu ukuze sakhe amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobuphofu. Lokhu kuveza isiqubulo sethu eMnyangweni wezempilo, "Ukulwa Nezifo, Ukulwa Nobuphofu, Ukunikeza Ithemba" kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 esifundeni sethu esihle eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Siphinde sahamba ibanga elide ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zokuphucula umnotho wabantu abamnyama. Kaningi, izinselelo esibhekene nazo njengombuso kanye nezwe lethu, kanye nomsebenzi esizibekele wona, zidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu, sibahlanganise bonke ukwenza lokho okudingekayo, futhi siqonde ukuthi ikusasa lomuntu ngamunye sikhona ezandleni zethu! Mphakathi ohloniphekile, uMongameli uthi kufanele sihlolisise lapho siphumelele noma siphumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukuthi sibheke izinselelo esihlangabezane nazo kule minyaka emihlanu yokuzinikela kubantu, njengoba uMongameli eshilo ukuzinikela kubantu baleli zwe nakubantu basemphakathini. Okokuqala, phakathi kwezinkinga ezinkulu esihlangabezane nazo mayelana nezinkulumo ngemiholo yabasebenzi bakamasipala. Lapho lezi zinkulumo zifika endaweni yokungavumelani, kuholele ekutheni abasebenzi baphume emsebenzini ngomhla ziyi-1 kuJuni, 2007. Lokhu akukhange kube ngaphandle kwabasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo. Ukungenelela okuhle kweMnyango kwakwazi ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo ngesikhathi esinzima. Nakuba bekukhona lezi zifiso, izikhungo zethu zezempilo zazihluleka kakhulu futhi izimali ezinkulu zathengiswa ukuqasha abasebenzi bangaphandle, ikakhulukazi abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze basize umphakathi odinga usizo. Siphinde saphoqeleka ukuba sithenge imibhede ezibhedlela ezizimele futhi sathola izindleko ezinkulu. Enye inkinga esibhekene nayo yisifo seKlebsiella esifundeni. Amalungu azokhumbula icala elibi esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial lapho izingane zafa ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa ngenxa yeKlebsiella virus. Ucwaningo lwethu luveze ukuthi le nkinga ivame ukubangelwa; (i) indlela izibhedlela zethu ezakhiwe ngayo, ikakhulukazi izigaba; (ii) izimo zomnotho nezokuhlalisana zabesifazane abasha abadinga ukuthembela kumadoda abo futhi abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba ezihlobene nokuziphatha kwezocansi; (iii) ukudluliswa kwezifo ngenxa yokuthi izindlu zakhiwe kanjani, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni; kanye (iv) indlela imindeni ehlelwe ngayo engasizi empilweni yentsha. Isibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial siwumfanekiso omuhle wokubhekana nalezi zinkinga engizichazile. Okokuqala, idolobha laseUmlazi linabantu abaningi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izindawo ezisemphakathini, kodwa alinazo izinsiza zezempilo ezanele, okwenza isibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial sibe nomthwalo omkhulu wokuletha abesifazane abaningi. Lesi sibhedlela sithola abesifazane abangu-1,000 ngenyanga, futhi kulaba bantwana, cishe abangu-525 bagcinwa kwi-neonatal unit besesimweni esibucayi. Isikhala esitholakalayo sikhulu kakhulu sokwamukela izingane eziningi, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi zidlulisele ezinye izifo. Okwesibili, ukungabi nezinsiza kule ndawo kwenza kube nzima kumphakathi ukuhlela imindeni, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane abasha abavame ukutholakala bephumile. Lokhu kunezixhumanisi ezithile nokudluliswa kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, kuhlanganise ne-HIV nezinye izifo ezifana ne-tuberculosis ne-Gonorrhea. Lokhu kuphinde kubonise kahle ukuthi intsha yethu ayifuni ukuzibandakanya ocansini oluphephile noluvikelekile! Ngalesi sizathu, ngihlala ngikhuthaza ukuthi kufanele siqale ukusebenza kanzima futhi sithathe indima ehamba phambili ekulweni nokwanda kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi (kuhlanganise ne-HIV) nokushintsha imicabango uma kuziwa empilweni yezocansi. Ngenkathi uMnyango uzosebenzisa yonke imizamo ukuvimbela ukufa kwezingane ezizalwayo; sidinga futhi wonke umuntu ukusiza ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanzeka ekhaya, kanye nokufundisa bobabili amantombazane namadoda ngokuvimbela ukukhulelwa okungafunwa kanye nezingozi zezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Sonke sidlala indima ebalulekile ekufundiseni izingane zethu zamantombazane ukuba babe yibo abathatha izikhala zabo zezeMpilo. Sizodinga futhi ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba ukuze sinciphise ukusabalala kwezifo ngenxa yezimo zomphakathi. Isibonelo esihle nguMnyango Wezokuhlala emizamweni yawo yokususa izindawo zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni ngo-2014, isenzo esifanele ukuhalaliswa. Njengomnyango, emalini edlule, senze imikhankaso yezempilo engama-45, okuyimizamo yokufundisa imiphakathi ngempilo engcono, sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokwehlisa umthwalo ezikhungweni zethu ezithola iziguli ezineziguli ezivimbela. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, kube nezikhathi eziningi lapho sithinteka kakhulu ukulahleka kwabasebenzi abanekhono nokwehluleka kwethu ukuheha ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lokhu kungenxa yokungabi nezindlu kanye nezimali ezanele zokwakha izindlu, futhi lokhu kuseyiphupho njengoba silwa nokwakha izikhungo zezempilo. Sisaphuma kude nokumisa ukusebenzisa abasebenzi besikhashana eMnyangweni wethu. Kunezikhungo eziningi eziqhubeka nokuhola abasebenzi besikhashana ukuze ziqinise izibhedlela nezinye izingxenye zeMnyango. Sihlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke lokhu kuphela ngokushesha futhi bonke labo basebenzi baqashwa ngokuphelele nguMnyango. Siqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikhala ezibalulekile zizogcwaliswa ngaphambi kukaJuni futhi sisesikhathini sokwenza lokhu kwenzeke. Kungani amaqembu omphakathi kufanele axhumane? Yiziphi iziteshi amaqembu omphakathi okufanele alandele uma exhumana? Kungani ukukhuluma emphakathini kubalulekile? Kungani imiphakathi kufanele ibhiyozwe ngoxhumano? Amaqembu omphakathi angadlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imiphakathi inezwi ezinqumweni zohulumeni. Ukukhuluma kuyindlela elula futhi engajwayelekile yokuxhumana. Izinzuzo zalesi sikhathi ukuthi iyashesha futhi impendulo iyatholakala ngokushesha. Kodwa-ke, ububi balesi sikhathi ukuthi umyalezo ungaba nengqondo ngenxa yenani labantu, umsindo, njll. Okunye okukhulu ukuthi akukho okurekhodiwe ngalokho okukhulunywe, okungaholela ekuqondeni okungafanele. Ukulalela akufani nokuzwa. Ukulalela kuyinto esiyifundayo kulokho esikuzwayo - ukwenza lokhu kusho ukuzibandakanya ngokusebenzayo. Ezikhungweni, ukubhala kubalulekile. Abantu bangase bangakukhumbuli lokho okukhulunywe uma ukhuluma nabo ngaphandle kokubhala, njengoba kunobufakazi bomyalezo wakho. Izibonelo zokuxhumana okubhalwe zifaka phakathi izinkumbulo zomhlangano, izincwadi, imibhalo yezomthetho, imibiko ebhaliwe ngezihloko, amabhodi ezaziso, izincwadi zezindaba, izincwadi ezichazayo, njll. Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi u-35% wezincwadi zokuxhumana zivela kumyalezo okhuluma kanti u-65% uvela ekuxhumaneni okungathintwa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokufunda ukuxhumana ngolimi lomzimba. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinkomba zokuxhumana ezingezona ezokukhuluma zihambisane nomyalezo okhuluma. Uma umyalezo okhuluma kanye nokuxhumana okungathintwa kungahambisani, kungaholela ekuqondeni okungafanele. Ukuxhumana okungathintwa kufaka phakathi ithoni yakho yomsindo, ukuveza ubuso, izimpawu zezingalo, kanye nezinyathelo zomzimba. Imvelo yemvelo ezungezile ingathinta indlela ophakamisa ngayo umyalezo ocacile; ngokwesibonelo, uma ubamba umhlangano endaweni engcolile, engathokozisi, noma enomsindo, kungase kube kusho ukuthi awunandaba nabantu abazobe bekhona. Ukuxhumana okuhle kungasiza kunoma iyiphi imizamo yokufinyelela noma umsebenzi. Nokho, ukuxhumana kungase kungasebenzi kahle ngezizathu ezithile. Uma kukhona umuntu phambi kwephepha lolwazi, noma uma ulwazi olukhona kuphepha luncane futhi lungafundeki ukusuka kude. Uma abantu beshisa, bangase bangafuni ukulalela inkulumo ende. Abantu abadala bangazizwa bengakhululekile ukulalela abantu abasha noma amadoda elalela abesifazane. Uma umkhulumeli enganiki abantu ithuba lokubuza imibuzo noma ukwabelana ngemibono yabo, abantu bangase baphume uma kukhulunywa kakhulu. Kukhona izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwenza ukuxhumana kube nempumelelo. Bheka ngqo kubantu uma ukhuluma nabo. Qonda kahle ukuthi ulwazi olufunayo abantu bakuthole ngaphambi kokuxhumana. Unganiki ulwazi oluningi ngasikhathi sinye. Bamba imihlangano ngenkathi abantu besabambekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi akukho umsindo ophakeme ozophazamisa abantu. Nika abantu ithuba lokubuza imibuzo nokwabelana ngemibono yabo. Buza imibuzo futhi uthole imicabango yabantu ngalokho abakukhulumayo. Gwema ukuhlinzeka ngamanothi amade ngalokho okukhulunywe. Sebenzisa imisho emifushane, amagama alula, nezibonelo abantu abazokwazi ukuzithola. Sebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zokuxhumana ezimweni ezahlukene. Sebenzisa izithombe ukuze udlulisele imiyalezo ngokucacile, njengokudweba ibhili yezezimali noma imephu ukuze ubonise ukuthi ifundwa kanjani. Sebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ngezikhathi ezahlukene ukuze udlulisele umyalezo ofanayo. Gxila ekuthumeleni umyalezo wakho - uma uqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayakuqonda lokho okukhuluma, ngeke ube nesikhathi sokukhathazeka. Enye imisebenzi ebalulekile yeqembu lomphakathi ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi. Inkinga enkulu ekubambeni iqhaza komphakathi ukuntuleka kolwazi emphakathini. Abantu bomphakathi bangase bangazi ngamaqembu omphakathi noma uhulumeni bendawo nokuthi baphathelene kanjani njengomphakathi ukuze bakhe ukuzibandakanya emphakathini. Ngakho-ke, ukuze kwakhiwe ukuzibandakanya komphakathi, amaqembu omphakathi kufanele enze umphakathi uqaphele. Ukuqonda nolwazi kungase kuvuselele, futhi iqembu lomphakathi kufanele libe nenhloso yokwakha amandla emphakathini walo. Ngesikhathi esingakanani leli ulwazi lungaxhumana emphakathini? Yini edingekayo uma uxhumana ngalolu lwazi emphakathini? Ngokuvamile, uhulumeni udala uhlelo lwakhe lokuxhumana. Yiziphi izinkinga onazo ezaziwa umphakathi wakho? Yiziphi izici ezinhle zokuhola kanye namakhono adingekayo? Yini umehluko phakathi komholi nomphathi? Yiziphi izici okufanele umholi omuhle abe nazo? Okwamanje, uhulumeni bendawo ukulesi sikhathi lapho ukuhola kubaluleke kakhulu kunanini ngaphambili. Izinga likahulumeni bendawo ukuze kushintshwe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo emiphakathini kuzoncika kakhulu ekwethembekeni kwethu abaholi. Amalungu eqembu lomphakathi angabanye abaholi abanye abazothola ukuthi kusemthethweni kwabo ukulethela ushintsho esimweni sokuhulumeni bendawo. Ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuzoncika kakhulu kumakhono okuhola amalungu eqembu lomphakathi. Ukuhola kuyithuluzi elingasiza iqembu lomphakathi ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa umsebenzi walo ngendlela efanele ukuze likwazi ukufezekisa amasu alo. Kungasiza futhi ukukhuphula izinga lokubophela empumelelweni yeqembu, umphakathi, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Izinhlelo zivame ukuncika ku-IDP. Ukuze noma yiziphi izinhlelo ziphumelele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nomuntu ongahola iqembu nomphakathi. Ukuhola kusho futhi ukudlulisa ulwazi kubantu, ukuveza izifiso, amaphupho, imigomo, nezinhlelo zamaqembu omphakathi, nokuhlinzeka ngemicimbi nemiyalezo, nokuthatha noma yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso nokubandakanya umphakathi. Ngokomthetho, ukuhola kumaqembu omphakathi kusho ukufaka umoya nokuhola izenzo zabantu eqenjini lomphakathi nasemphakathini ngendlela ezobenza bazame ukufezekisa imigomo kaMasipala. Ukuphatha iqembu labantu akusho ukuthi unazo zonke izimpendulo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uneqembu labantu abazokusiza ukuthola izimpendulo nokufeza imiphumela edingekayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izikhathi eziningi abaholi basazithola bephazamisekile! Abaholi baphazamiseka ukuhola nokulawula futhi banciphise izwi labantu kanye neqembu abahlanganyela nalo, noma bathathe enye indlela egxile ezikhungweni nasezinhlelweni begqoka ubuntu. Ngaphezu kokuhlakanipha okujwayelekile, ukuhola akukhona ngodlame. Ukuhola kuhlanganisa amakhono okusebenzisana kanye nekhono lokwenza abantu bazame ukufezekisa umsebenzi okudingeka ukwenza. Lawa makhono angafundwa. Umshini wezokuphatha kufanele udluliswe ukuze izinhlelo zabaphathi bomsebenzi zenzeke. Ukuhola kubeka inhlangano emgqeni. Umthwalo omkhulu wamakhono ezingeni lonke lenhlangano ukuhola nokukhuthaza abantu emsebenzini wokufinyelela. Ukuhola kufanele kuphendule kumasu
Amaqembu Ezepolitiki: Iqhaza Labo Emphakathini Wethu Amaqembu ezepolitiki ayingxenye ebalulekile yomphakathi wethu, futhi awakwazi ukugwenywa uma sikhuluma ngempilo yezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba sithokozisa izinqumo ezithathwayo, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde kahle ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki adlala kanjani indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, onobumbano nolwazi. Ngokujwayelekile, amaqembu ezepolitiki ahlukaniswa ngezinhloso zawo, izimiso zawo, kanye nezithakazelo ezihlukene. Lokhu kuhlukaniswa kwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bakhethe ukuthi yiliphi iqembu elihambisana nezimfanelo zabo, izifiso zabo, nezidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma abantu bekhetha amaqembu azoholela ezinqumweni ezithinta ukuphila kwabo, kufanele baqonde kahle ukuthi lezi zinkampani zisebenza kanjani. Ngokwesibonelo, amaqembu amaningi akhona eNingizimu Afrika ahlale ebheke izidingo zabantu abampofu, ababhekene nezinkinga zokungabi namisebenzi, nezinsiza ezilinganiselwe. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki angaba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizokwenza impilo ibe ngcono. Kodwa-ke, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi ezinye izinkampani zingase zibe nezithakazelo ezihlukile, okungaholela ekutheni ziguqule izinqumo zazo ukuze zifanele izifiso zabantu abathile kuphela. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki awamukeli kuphela izinkinga zomphakathi, kodwa futhi adinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwawo nabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaholi bezepolitiki. Uma abantu benza izinqumo ezithinta impilo yabo, kufanele bazi ukuthi izwi labo liyalalelwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baziqhenye ngempilo yabo, futhi bazizwe bephakathi kokwakha umphakathi onobumbano. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle okukhona phakathi kwamakholwa ezepolitiki. Kunezinkinga ezithile ezithinta amaqembu ezepolitiki, okuhlanganisa ukungabikhona kokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungaboni ngaso linye, okungaholela ekutheni izinqumo ezithathwayo zingabi nempumelelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwamakholwa ezepolitiki kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungqubuzana phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki adinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, hhayi kuphela phakathi kwabo, kodwa futhi nabantu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakhuthazwe ukuba babe neqhaza ezinqumweni ezithinta impilo yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki ahlale ebheke izidingo zomphakathi, hhayi kuphela izithakazelo zabo. Ngokubheka phambili, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza emisebenzini yezepolitiki, ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zinezimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bazizwe bephakathi kokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, futhi bazizwe bephakathi kokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Amaqembu ezepolitiki kufanele abe yinsika eqhubekayo yokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, onobumbano nolwazi, ukuze sikwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphila. Ngokuphetha, amaqembu ezepolitiki adlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Kumele sibe nekhono lokukhetha kahle, sikhumbule ukuthi izinqumo zethu zinezimpilo zethu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwamakholwa ezepolitiki, nabantu, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo ezithinta izinkinga zomphakathi. Amaqembu ezepolitiki kufanele abe yinsika yokwakha umphakathi onobumbano, onobulungiswa, ukuze sikwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphila. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi sibe neqhaza elihle empilweni yethu, futhi sibe neqhaza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.
