ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean luyindawo emangalisayo. Lutholakala phakathi kwesinye sezilwandle ezinkulu, lwenziwe phakathi kwe-Afrika, i-Asia, ne-Australasia. Noma ungakaze uvakashele, ngiphakamisa ukuthi uzame, ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezithokozisayo lapha. Kukhona ama-archipelago, izindawo ezinhle zokuhlala, kanye nezilwane eziningi ezikhalweni zasolwandle. Uma uhamba ngolwandle, ungabona izinkanyezi, izigwaca, nezinyoni eziphakeme phezulu. Ngabe ufuna ukuhamba ngebhodi ukuze ubone lezi zinto eziphilayo? ULwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean unomlando ocebile, uhlanganisa izizwe eziningi. Kukhona izindawo ezithokozisayo ezifana neMaldives, Seychelles, neMauritius, ezaziwa ngama-beaches amahle, amanzi acwebile, nezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle. Phakathi nezikhathi, lolu lwandle lwaba yindawo yokuhweba, lapho abantu baye bahlala bezama ukuthola izimpahla ezivela kwezinye izindawo, okwakha izixhumanisi ezinhle phakathi kwezizwe. Nokho, uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Izimo zezulu zishintsha, futhi izingozi zenzeka. Kubalulekile ukuthi sigcine izikhumbuzo zempilo zasolwandle, ukuze sikwazi ukuvakashela lezi zindawo ezithokozisayo. Ngakho, uma uhamba lapha, khumbula ukuthi ungathola izinto eziningi ezinhle, futhi ungajabulela ubuhle bezindawo ezinjengeMaldives, Seychelles, neMauritius. Qhubeka uhamba uLwandlekazi i-Indian Ocean, uzothola izinto eziningi ezithokozisayo.
Ikomishini Yokuhlanganyela, Ukuxazulula Nokuhlonza (CCMA) iyisisekelo sokuxazulula izingxabano esisungulwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi, Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995. Le komishini iyazimela kwiSifunda, ezombusazwe, amaqembu ezombusazwe, izinyunyana, abaqashi, izinhlangano zabakwaqashi, kanye nobuholi bezinyunyana noma izinhlangano zabakwaqashi. Umqondisi we-CCMA unomthwalo wemfanelo oqondile wokusungula izinqubo nemigomo kwi-CCMA. I-CCMA ihlose ukukhuthaza ubulungiswa besocial kanye nentuthuko yezomnotho, ngokubambisana nezithakazelo zomphakathi, ngokuguqula ubudlelwano endaweni yokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka uma kwethulwa uhlelo lokuxazulula nokuvimbela izingxabano olungakhethi. Kithi, ubuchwepheshe, ubuqotho, kanye nokwethulwa kwezinsiza nokwabelana ngobudlelwano obususelwa ethembeni kubalulekile. Emphakathini, sizibophezele ekwenzeni izinguquko kubudlelwano bendawo yokusebenza ngokuxazulula ukungavumelani ngendlela efanele nokwabelana ngolwazi lwethu kabanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukucubungula izicelo zokwamukelwa nokwesekwa ezethulwe ngamaBhodi Okuxoxisana kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. I-CCMA inikeza ukuqeqeshwa nokwelulekwa mayelana: ukusungulwa kwezakhiwo zokuxoxisana ezihlanganyelwe; izinguquko ezimweni zokusebenza; izinqubo zokubonisana; ukuvalwa kwemisebenzi; ukuhlolwa kwendawo yokusebenza nokuvimbela ukungavumelani. I-CCMA inehhovisi likazwelonke eliseGauteng, kanye nohlu lwezihhovisi eziyi-9 zomphakathi. Ihhovisi ngalinye lesifunda lineKomishini ethile yokuhlanganyela imihlangano nokubheka leso sifunda, kanye neRegistrar enesibopho semisebenzi yokuphatha. Iphinde ibe nekomishini ebhekelela ukuhlela nokuhlola lapho kukhona ukungavumelani. Umphakathi uvunyelwe ukusebenzisa ilebhu kodwa awukwazi ukuhweba ngezinto. Umfaki-sicelo kumele akhombise uma efuna ikhophi ye-rekhodi noma efuna ukubona irekhodi mathupha ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Uma irekhodi ingabhalwanga ephepheni noma encwadini, ingabukwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziceliwe, njengokuhambisana nesigaba 292. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela irekhodi ngaphansi kwezimo ezingajwayelekile, umfaki-sicelo kumele athole leyo rekodi ngaphansi kwezimo abaceliwe. Nokho, lokhu kungase kungabi khona uma kuholela ekuphazamiseni ukusebenza kwaleyo nhlangano, kudalule irekhodi, noma kuphikisana nomthetho ovikela amarekhodi abhalwe angawomphakathi. Uma kungabi khona ithuba lokuthi umfaki-sicelo athole ikhophi ngezimo eziceliwe, ukukhokha kufanele kubhekelwe ukuthi kungadluli kulokho okudingekayo ukukhokhwa esicelweni sabo. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukuphendulwa ngokubhala noma ngefoni mayelana nesicelo sabo, kumele akhombise lokhu njengokuhambisana nesigaba 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna olunye ulwazi, kumele achaze ukuthi yisiphi isicelo abahambisa njengokuhambisana nesigaba 182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enezinkinga, angacela irekhodi ngokuqhubekayo. I-Information Authority kufanele iphelele ifomu lesicelo ngaye futhi inikeze ikhophi yefomu njengokuhambisana nesigaba 183. Umfaki-sicelo ocela ukubona irekhodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwakhe akakhokhiswa. I-Information Authority kufanele ibike umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwalabo abafuna ulwazi ngabo) ngesenzo, icela ukukhokha okufanele ngaphambi kokuthi iqhubeke nalesi sikhathi. Imali yesicelo sezakhiwo zikGovernment ingama-R35. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokuhambisa isikhalazo sangaphakathi, uma kudingekile futhi kufanelekile, noma ukuyithumela enkantolo ukuze acela ukuthi bangakhokhi imali edingekayo. Ngemuva kokuthi i-Information Authority yenze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kufanele waziswa ngalowo mkhuba ngendlela abaceliwe. Uma isicelo samukelwa, umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhokhe imali yokucubungula nokusesha ulwazi kwi-rekhodi, ukuhlela, nokwenza amakhophi, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze leyo rekodi ilungiswe ukuze ithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo. Ukuze uthole imininingwane yokuxhumana, bheka Isigaba 14 1 b ukuze uthole amakheli emahhovisi e-CCMA ezindaweni. Uma amalungu omphakathi enezinkinga mayelana ne-CCMA futhi efuna ukuba neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zezimiso, kufanele bacela kuMqondisi noma baxhumane nanoma yiliphi ilungu lenhlangano yomphakathi esebenza ne-CCMA eduze. Ngokwesibonelo, uma ilungu lomphakathi ingxenye ye-nyunyana, kufanele ixhumane nehhovisi elimele abasebenzi. Inhlangano ingaphika ukuhlinzeka ngerekhodi ngendlela eceliwe. Uma umfaki-sicelo eseqedile lelo fomu, kufanele alithumele kwi-Information Authority. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokucela ulwazi mayelana nemiphumela ngendlela engafani nokubhala, njengokufonela noma nge-imeyili. Umuntu ophakamisayo udinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuxhumana futhi angacelwa ukukhokha imali yokuhambisa udaba. I-Information Authority kufanele iphendule isicelo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 zokusebenza, futhi uma isicelo sitholakale singenamsebenzi, i-Information Authority kufanele inikeze izizathu zalokho njengoba kushiwo umthetho. Akukho okukhuluma ngqo kumphakathi weMphakathi Wobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwemithetho okukhuluma lapha, njengokuhambisana nesigaba 92. Isakhiwo seHhovisi leZwe kufanele, uma kudingeka, sithuthukise futhi sishicilele umhlahlandlela ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14, izikhawu ezingadluli unyaka owodwa. Amakhophi amathathu abhalwe ngolimi lwezofficial ezintathu kufanele atholakale ezikhungweni zokwabelana ngolwazi ezichazwe ngummthetho njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 6 soMthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi ka-1997; iKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika; kanye nazo zonke izikhungo zayo. Lo mhlahlandlela kufanele uphume ngolimi lwezofficial ezintathu kwiGazethi yeHhovisi leZwe. Uma imisebenzi yezakhiwo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zikGovernment ibonakala ingahlangene, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha, ngokwakhe noma ngokucela, ukuthi umhlahlandlela owodwa kuphela kufanele ukhishwe. Lezi zakhiwo kufanele zabelane ngezindleko zokubhala nokushicilela lowo mhlahlandlela ngokuhambisana nesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe. Ngezizathu zokuphepha, zezimali, noma ezihlobene nomsebenzi, uNgqongqoshe angakhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yeHhovisi leZwe, ekhupha izakhiwo ezithile ezivela ezinhlinzekweni zalesi sigaba somthetho isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Imali ekhokhwayo yekhophi yomhlahlandlela ngokuhambisana nezimiso ingama-R0.60 ngephepha le-A-4 noma ingxenye yalo. Imali ekhokhwayo yesicelo, ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu ucele ulwazi oluthile ngaye, ngokuhambisana nezimiso ingama-R35.00. Ukuze useshe futhi ulungise irekhodi ukuze ikhishwe, kungakhokhiswa u-R15.00 ngehora noma ingxenye yalo, kanti ihora lokuqala
Iphrofayela Yomuntu: UThabo Mthembu - Umholi Wezemidlalo UThabo Mthembu, umphakathi owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni wezokuncintisana, ungumfana ophuma eThekwini, lapho akhulele khona. UThabo uthanda imidlalo kusukela ebuncaneni, lapho aqala khona ukudlala ibhola likanobhutshuzwayo emijikijeleni yasendaweni. Uthando lwakhe lwezemidlalo luhambisana nesifiso sokwenza kahle, lokho kwaholela ekutheni abe nesithakazelo esijulile emincintiswaneni yezemidlalo. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, uThabo wathola ithuba lokuba umqeqeshi weqembu lezemidlalo lendawo, lapho aqala khona khona ukubonisa amakhono akhe. Ukusebenza kanzima kwaholela ekutheni aqashelwe emincintiswaneni emikhulu, lapho abamba khona izikhala ezihamba phambili. UThabo waphumelela kakhulu emiqhudelwaneni ehlukene, waze waba umholi weqembu lezemidlalo elidumile, elaziwa ngempumelelo yalo. Imincintiswano yezemidlalo yenza uThabo akwazi ukuhlangana nabantu abaningi, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kumenze waba ngumuntu ohloniphekile. UThabo uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yomphakathi wezokuncintisana, futhi uyakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele emikhakheni yabo. Ukuze uThabo abe yimpumelelo, ubelokhu eqhubeka nokufunda, efunda ngezindlela ezintsha zokuphatha amaqembu nokuthuthukisa amakhono abathandi bezemidlalo. UThabo akagcini nje ngokuba umqeqeshi, kodwa futhi ungumfundi oqhubekayo. Uthanda ukufunda ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha imincintiswano, futhi uhamba emihlanganweni ezahlukene ukuze athole ulwazi olusha. Ubuye abe nomqondo omuhle wokuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo waba nesifiso sokwakha umphakathi wezokuncintisana ophumelelayo. Waqala umphakathi wezokuncintisana wezinsizwa ezincane, lapho abantwana behlangana khona ukuze bazifundise imidlalo ehlukene. Lokhu kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, njengoba abantwana baziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yomphakathi ophumelelayo. UThabo uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe, kodwa akakaze akhohlwe izinselele abebhekene nazo. Uhlale ekhumbula ukuthi impumelelo ifika ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, futhi lokhu kumenza abe nesibindi sokubhekana nanoma yiziphi izinselele. UThabo uyakholwa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyithuba lokukhulisa amakhono, futhi uyakuthokozela ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo ube nesifiso sokuhola imincintiswano emikhulu, futhi waba nesibopho sokwakha amakhono abaqeqeshi. Uthanda ukusiza abanye ukuba baphumelele, futhi ubona imincintiswano njengendlela yokwakha isizwe esiqinile. UThabo ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, ukuzithokozisa, nokukhuthaza abanye. UThabo Mthembu ungumholi wezokuncintisana, umqeqeshi, nomfundisi, futhi uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe. Ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi uyakuthanda ukusiza abanye ukuba baphumelele. UThabo ungumfanekiso ophumelelayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele impumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThabo uqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imincintiswano yezemidlalo, futhi ubona ukuthi ukukhula kwempumelelo akupheli. Uthanda ukufunda, futhi ubona imincintiswano njengendlela yokukhulisa ubudlelwano, ukwakha umphakathi, nokukhuthaza abanye ukuba baphumelele. UThabo Mthembu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zikhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophele impumelelo emincintiswaneni yezemidlalo. UThabo ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyindlela yokwakha umphakathi, futhi uyakuthanda ukusiza abanye ukuba baphumelele. UThabo ungumholi wezokuncintisana, umqeqeshi, nomfundisi, futhi uyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe. Ubonisa ukuthi imincintiswano yezemidlalo akukhona kuphela ukuwina, kodwa futhi kuwukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle, ukuzithokozisa, nokukhuthaza abanye.
IFIFA World Cup: Ingxoxo-Mpikiswano Ngomthelela Nempumelelo Yayo I-FIFA World Cup iyinhlangano yeziqhamo zomhlaba jikelele, eyenzeka njalo eminyakeni emine, futhi ibonisa ukuzethemba nokuncintisana okukhulu phakathi kwamazwe. Abaningi bathi le midlalwano ibalulekile, kodwa kukhona abaphikisa, bephakamisa izinkinga ezihambisana nayo. Kulokhu, sizobheka imiphumela yeFIFA World Cup, imithelela yayo kwezomnotho, ezamasiko, nakwezempilo. Okokuqala, sizoqala ngokubheka umthelela wezomnotho. I-FIFA World Cup iyinsiza enkulu yokukhuthaza umnotho wezindawo ezibamba umcimbi. Ngokwesibonelo, eminyakeni edlule, izixhumanisi eziningi zikhombisa ukuthi izindawo ezibamba umcimbi zithola inzuzo enkulu ngenxa yokwanda kwabavakashi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni efana nezokuthutha, ezokungcebeleka, nezokudla. Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa, bethi lezi zinzuzo zihlala zihlukaniswe phakathi kwabantu abambalwa, kanti abanye bahlupheka ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-FIFA World Cup ibalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe. Umcimbi lo uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, okwakha umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kuhlangana kwezizwe kwenza kube lula ukuhweba, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana ngamasiko. Nokho, abanye baphikisa, bethi le midlalwano ibonisa umphakathi omubi, lapho abanye abantu bephikisana khona ngenxa yezinkolelo ezihlukene nemibono ehlukene. Lokhu kungaholela ekungaboni ngaso linye, okungase kube nomthelela omubi emiphakathini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-FIFA World Cup ibalulekile ekukhuthazeni impilo yomphakathi. Imidlalo ibonisa izindinganiso eziphezulu zokusebenza, kuthuthukiswe imiphakathi yokukhuthaza impilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukugijima, ukudlala, nokuhlanganyela emisebenzini ethile. Kodwa-ke, abanye baphikisa, bephakamisa ukuthi imidlalo ibeka ingcindezi enkulu kubadlali, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, ikakhulukazi ezokuphila kwengqondo. Ukuncintisana okukhulu kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka, okungase kube nomthelela omubi ezimpilweni zabantu. Ngokubheka izinkinga ezihambisana neFIFA World Cup, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi imicimbi efana nale ibalulekile emhlabeni wethu. Kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kodwa futhi kunezinkinga ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Umphakathi kufanele ube nezinqumo ezihlakaniphile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphumela yeFIFA World Cup iyathuthukisa, hhayi ukuhlela izinkinga. Ngokuphetha, i-FIFA World Cup iyinsiza enkulu, kodwa imiphumela yayo iyinkimbinkimbi. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukuthi imidlalo ayigcini nje ngokuba yinsiza yokuzijabulisa, kodwa iyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuthuthukisa umnotho, nokukhuthaza impilo. Nokho, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuxazulula izinkinga ezihambisana nayo, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuzuza. I-FIFA World Cup ingaba yinsiza yokwakha umphakathi, uma kuphela sithatha izinyathelo ezifanele.
Ukuqashwa KweMisebenzi: Umcimbi Wokuthuthukiswa KweMisebenzi Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, umcimbi obalulekile wokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, owaziwa ngokuthi “Ukuqashwa KweMisebenzi”, wabanjwa eGoli. Umcimbi lo wawuhloselwe ukusiza abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi abasha, ukuthi bathole amathuba okusebenza, bathuthukise amakhono abo, futhi bakhe izixhumanisi ezibalulekile emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Ngokufika kwabantu, umoya wawugcwele ithemba nokukhuthazeka. Ababambiqhaza bahlala ezindaweni ezihlukene, behlanganyela emihlanganweni yokuxhumana, besebenzisa leli thuba ukuhlela ikusasa labo. Umcimbi waqala ngenkulumo yezenzakalo, eyaphakanyiswa uMnu. Thabo Mthembu, ongumholi emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. UThabo uthe: “Siyazi ukuthi emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukukwazi ukuthola umsebenzi akusiyona kuphela indlela yokuphila, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.” Ngemuva kokwethulwa, abahlanganyeli bahlola izinketho ezahlukene ezitholakalayo. Kwakukhona izinkulumo ezivela kochwepheshe bezemisebenzi, abaqeqeshi, kanye nabamele izinkampani ezahlukene, ababeveza izidingo zabo kanye nezindlela zokuhlangabezana nalezo zidingo. Abantu babenethuba lokubamba izingxoxo ezijulile, bebuza imibuzo ethile futhi behlola izinkampani ezithakazelisayo. Phakathi komcimbi, kwaba nezifundo ezihlukahlukene ezazihlelwe, lapho abahlanganyeli bekhuthazwa ukuba baphendule izinselele ezihambisana nezimakethe zomsebenzi. Lezi zifundo zazihlanganisa izihloko ezifana nokwakha i-CV efanele, amasu okuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokuzithuthukisa ukuze umuntu akwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Uhlelo lwemisebenzi lwaluhlanganisa nezingxoxo ezimfushane phakathi kwabantu abavela ezinkampanini ezihlukahlukene, ababeveza izidingo zabo zokusebenza. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuxhumana okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafuna umsebenzi kanye nezinkampani ezithakazelisayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kwaba nezingxoxo ezithinta izinhlelo zokufunda eziphakanyisiwe, lapho abahlanganyeli bezitholela ulwazi olunembile mayelana nezifundo ezitholakalayo ezikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okucabanga ngale kwalezi zifundo, kubavumela ukuba bacabangele izindlela ezithile zokuthuthukisa amakhono abo. Umcimbi wawuhamba phambili, futhi abantu babenethuba lokuhlola izindawo zokusebenza ezithile, lapho behlangana khona nabaphathi bezinkampani, bezama ukuthola izimpendulo ezizwakalayo mayelana nezikhala ezikhona. Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okuholela ekutheni abantu bazitholele amathuba angcono emsebenzini. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu. Abahlanganyeli baphuma bezithokozisa, bejabulile ngolwazi abaluziwe, futhi beqonda kahle ukuthi izinyathelo ezithile zingabasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni imisebenzi yabo. Umoya wokuxhumana, wokufunda, nokukhuthazeka wawukhanya, umbono ophakeme wokuthi abantu bangenza umehluko emhlabeni wezokusebenza. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi akukhona kuphela ukulandela amathuba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umcimbi lo ubonisile ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuhamba phambili, sithuthukise amakhono ethu, futhi sakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baphokophele impumelelo emsebenzini, baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bakhe izimpilo ezinhle. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi ubonisa indlela eya phambili, ubuhlakani, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabafuna umsebenzi nezinkampani. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuze sikwazi ukuphumelela emhlabeni onzima wezokusebenza. Umcimbi lo ube yisikhumbuzo esibalulekile sokuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.
Lo mbhalo awuqondwanga ukuthi ube ngumbhalo obanzi ongathathwa njengomthombo wolwazi kodwa usebenza njengethuluzi lokuhola ochwepheshe abasebenza emishadweni nasekuhlukaniseni ifa emthethweni wendabuko. Ngenxa yemithetho ephikisanayo, emishadweni ethile yabantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika ayizange ibonwe noma yaba buthakathaka ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo ulethe izinguquko ezinkulu kumasiko njengoba sizobona ebhalweni. Ngokufanayo, indlela yokuphathwa kwezindawo zabantu abamnyama abafa bengakhethanga abashadile yayiphikisana kakhulu nemthethosisekelo, ngakho-ke izigameko zomlando zaphoqelela uMnyango Wezobulungiswa ukuba ulungise imithetho ukuze ihambisane neMthethosisekelo. Kungaphinde kuthiwe umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo awuhambisani namasiko abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kodwa asihlosile ukuphawula ngalokhu kulokhu okukhuluma. Uzoba ngumgibeli. Ngaphambi kokugxila kakhulu ekukhulumeni ngeMthethweni Wokushada Kwendabuko (owaziwa lapha njengoMthetho), kubalulekile ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wesimo somthetho esithinta imishado yombuso "nasezihlanganisweni zendabuko" eziphethwe ngaphambi kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000, (lolu suku lapho lo Mthetho uqala khona). Nokho, ukufakwa kwezindawo kwaphumelela kuphela lapho indoda ishada omunye ngaphansi kwesihlanganiso sendabuko, ehlukile emshadweni wombuso. Ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, uMthetho Wokushada 88 ka-1984 wakhishwa, phakathi kokunye, wakhansela amandla okushada anikezwa indoda phezu kwesifazane uma beshadile ngaphansi komthetho wombuso. Lesi sinqumo saholela ekutheni kusukela ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, amandla okushada anikezwa indoda mayelana nesifazane sayo asathathwa esigabeni esikhanselwe 22. Ngoba labo abashade ngaphansi kwezihlanganiso zendabuko babengakhethwa njengabashadile ngokomthetho, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi omunye wabo ngaphansi kwalolo shado angabopha umshado wombuso nomunye umuntu. Umthelela walolo shado lombuso waholela ekuphelisweni komshado wendabuko okwakukhona. bheka uNkambula v Linda 1951 1 SA 377 A noMalaza v Mndaweni 1975 BAC C 45. Umkakhe ngaphansi kwalolo shado wendabuko wabhekwa njengomkakhe ophuthelwe. Umkakhe walolo shado wendabuko wayengashada nomunye umuntu ngaphansi komshado wombuso, ngakho-ke isihlanganiso esikhona saphuma. Umbuzo wokuthi "lo shado" uyavuselelwa yini nguMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 isigaba 2, lo mbuzo kumele unqunywe yizinkantolo. Nokho, isigaba 22 soMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zabantu Abamnyama 38 ka-1927 sinikeza izama zokuvikela umndeni ophuthumayo uma indoda ifa. Ngokwenzela ukuphawula ngababheki, isimo somfelokazi nezingane zomshado wombuso sithathwa ngokufana nalabo bomshado wendabuko. Kucacile ukuthi isikhundla esingcono esinikezwa umkakhe oshadile ngaphansi komthetho wombuso nezingane zakhe sesiphenduke sehluleka futhi ziphathwa ngokufana nomkakhe nezingane eziphuthumayo. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushintsha Umshado 3 ka-1988 owawuqala ngomhla ka-2 kuZibandlela 1988, uMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zabantu Abamnyama ka-1927 waguqulwa. Umthetho wokuguqulwa ulethe lezi zinguquko ezilandelayo. Umthelela wokukhanselwa kwesigaba wawuchaza ukuthi yonke imishado eNingizimu Afrika yayifana futhi uMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zabantu Abamnyama 88 ka-1984 wawusebenza kumishado yabantu abamnyama eyenziwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988. Imishado eyenzeka ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988 ihlanganisa izindawo ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesivumelwano sokuhlukanisa izindawo futhi kubhaliswe ehhovisi lezincwadi ezithathu ezinyangeni ngaphambi komshado. Isici esisha nesibalulekile ukuthi "isihlanganiso sendabuko" asikwazi ukuphulwa ngomyalo wombuso. Isigaba 221 sivimbela indoda eshadile ngaphansi komthetho wendabuko ukuthi ingazibophezela emshadweni wombuso nomfazi ngenkathi isashadile ngaphansi komthetho wendabuko. bheka uThembisile v Thembisile 2002 2 SA 209 T noKwitshane v Magalela 1999 4 SA 610 TK. Ngeshwa, akukho mpendulo enikeziwe ngesimo lapho umshado wombuso wenziwa ngemuva komshado wendabuko. Kwamukelwa ukuthi umshado wombuso onjalo awunamsebenzi. Isigaba 3 soMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 sivimbela omunye wabashadile abaphakathi komshado wendabuko obonwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ashade ngombuso ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushada 25 ka-1961. Umqondo ofanayo njengoba kukhulunywa esigabeni 2.3.2, futhi lapha akukho mpendulo enikeziwe yokwephula lo mthetho. UMsamo Wokushada eTranskei 21 ka-1978 uvumela indoda eshadile ngaphansi komshado wombuso ukuthi ithathe futhi ngaphansi komshado wendabuko, inqobo nje uma umshado wendabuko ungahlanganisi izindawo. Ngokufanayo, indoda eshadile ngaphansi kwesihlanganiso sendabuko ingashadisa ngaphansi komshado wombuso, ngaphandle kokuphula isihlanganiso sendabuko, inqobo nje uma umshado wombuso ungahlanganisi izindawo. Umthetho uqale ngomhla ka-15 kuNovemba 2000 futhi wathatha isinyathelo esibalulekile sokwamukela yonke imishado yendabuko evunywa ngokomthetho. Umthetho unomthelela wokubuyisela emuva futhi uzoxoxwa isigaba ngesigaba. Umthetho ubhekelela yonke imishado yendabuko eyenziwe ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wendabuko, amasiko, nezindlela zendabuko ezihlonishwa abantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika futhi iyinqubo eyingxenye yesiko labo. Ngakho-ke, kucacile ukuthi umthetho ubhekelela abantu abathile, ubhekelela kuphela abantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika, inqobo nje uma umshado wenziwa ngendlela echazwe ngamasiko noma izinhlelo zabantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika. Imishado yabantu ababili noma imishado yepholigami eyenziwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000. Imishado eyenziwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000 kumele ihambisane nezidingo zomthetho. Izidingo ezibekwe kuMthetho ziqinile futhi ukwehluleka ukuhambisana kunomthelela wokuthi umshado ungasebenzi. Bobabili abashadile kumele babe nesifiso sokushada ngaphansi komthetho wendabuko. Akekho phakathi kwabashadile okufanele abe yingxenye yomshado wendabuko omunye. Kumele kube nezingxoxo ngomshado futhi kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wendabuko. Ukuze umshado wendabuko ube semthethweni, ngaphandle kwezidingo ezichazwe ngenhla, kumele kube nesivumelwano esinikezwe esigabeni 7 (ukuxoxwa okuphelele, bheka isigaba 5.2.2). Isigaba 4 soMthetho sikhuluma ukuthi ngemva kokuthi isicelo sith
IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament libambe umhlangano walo wokuqala e-Addis Ababa ngoMashi 2004, futhi ngoJulayi walowo nyaka, kwanqunywa ukuthi i-PAP izoba seNingizimu Afrika. IPhalamende selokhu libambe imihlangano yalo yesibili neyokuthathu ngokuqhubekayo eMidrand, eNingizimu Afrika. Umhlangano wesibili wawugxile kakhulu ekwamukeleni imithetho nezindlela ze-PAP kanye nezinkampani zayo, kanye nezinkulumo ngemicabango, ingxoxo, nezinhlelo ze-African Union. IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament okwamanje lisasezingeni lokushintsha noma likhunjuzwa okwamanje, isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu eGallagher Estate eMidrand. INingizimu Afrika, ngokusebenzisa iMnyango Wezangaphandle, iPhalamende Lesifunda, ibambe iqhaza elibalulekile empumelelweni yemihlangano yesibili neyokuthathu yePhalamende. INingizimu Afrika igcine ukuzibophezela kwayo ngaphansi kweSivumelwano sokuba yizwe elamukelayo futhi iphinde yanikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe, ngokwesibonelo, ekhirelweni, njengoba iPhalamende lePan-African Parliament lalingakasebenzi ngokuphelele, njengokuhirela abasebenzi. IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament langena emahhovisi awo amasha nomhlangano wesithathu. I-Economic, Social and Cultural Council (ECOSOCC) yamukelwa yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2004, kulandela inqubo yokubonisana ende nezifunda namakhaya. Abamele imiphakathi yase-Afrika bahlangane ehhovisi le-African Union e-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia, kusukela ngoMashi 27 kuya kuMashi 30, 2005, ukuze bazise i-Economic, Social and Cultural Council ye-African Union (ECOSOCC). Lo mcimbi obalulekile waphawula ukuqala kwesigaba esisha somsebenzi we-Union mayelana nokwakhiwa kwezindlela zokusebenza ze-ECOSOCC nokwakhiwa kwenqubo yokukhetha amalungu e-ECOSOCC General Assembly. Komitishi yesikhashana yeminyaka emibili yakhethwa ukuze iqhube le nqubo. Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezakhiwo zezomthetho zezinhlelo zomthetho ze-African Union, i-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yanquma ukuthi i-African Court on Human and Peoples' Rights kanye ne-African Union's Court of Justice kufanele ihlanganiswe ibe yinkantolo eyodwa. Idokhumenti yesakhiwo somthetho ehlobene nokwakhiwa kwenkantolo ehlanganisiwe kumele iphothulwe ukuze icatshangelwe yi-Assembly kanye ne-Executive Council ngoJanuwari 2006. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kuvingele ukuqala ngokushesha kwe-African Court on Human Rights, okukhona okwamanje kulandela ukuvulwa kweSivumelwano se-African Charter on Human Rights ngokwakhiwa kwe-African Court on Human Rights eqale ukusebenza ngoJanuwari 25, 2004. I-AU Commission yanikezwa amandla yi-Executive Committee ukuze iqhube ucwaningo okuhloswe ngalo ukwenza kube lula ukuvulwa kwe-STC. Ukungakuthandi kwe-AU Commission ukukhulula umbiko walolu cwaningo kube nomphumela wokuthi oNgqongqoshe balolu siko baphumeze imihlangano bodwa. INingizimu Afrika ibibe yizwe elamukelayo emihlanganweni yamaNgqongqoshe eMisebenzi, Ezokuxhumana, Izindlu, Isevisi Yomphakathi kanye Nezokuphathwa, Imboni kanye Nezokuthutha ngoJulayi. Nokho, i-AU Commission kulindeleke ukuthi ilethe umbiko ocwaningweni ku-AU Assembly ngoJanuwari 2006. Izinhlelo ze-AU zamukele i-Vision and Policy Statement ye-African Union kanye ne-AU Commission's Action Plan okuhloswe ngalo ukuhola ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Afrika nokuphumeza i-NEPAD. Njengomphumela, uxhaso oluhlinzekwe ngezinhlelo eziphambili ze-AU luhlolwe emhlanganweni okhethekile we-Executive Committee, obubanjwe ngo-6-7 Septhemba 2004. Lo mhlangano wamukela ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$158,384 unyaka wezezimali ka-2005/2006. Ukusabalalisa okuphelele kwezimali kuqukethe ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$63 million kweMisebenzi kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$95,384 kweZinhlelo. INingizimu Afrika ibambelela ku-8.25% wezinsiza ezabelwe iMisebenzi ngokwesikali sokuhlola. INingizimu Afrika, njengomholi weKomidi lamaNgqongqoshe, ibambe iqhaza elibalulekile enhlanganweni yokubhaliswa kweSikali Sokuhlola esiphakanyisiwe. Isikali Sokuhlola esisha samukelwa yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2005, futhi kwavumelana ukuthi sizohlala ku-15% ngaphandle kokuthi kwenziwe okunye. Lesi sikhala esisha sizothatha umthelela ngoJanuwari 2006. INingizimu Afrika, ngokuxhasa ngezimali ucwaningo olwenziwe ngu-Ernest & Young okuhloswe ngalo ukuqinisa izindlela zezimali nezimpendulo emsebenzini we-AU, ibone umbiko ocwaningweni ukhululwa, futhi INingizimu Afrika izoxhasa ukuhlinzekwa okuphelele nokusebenza kahle kweziphakamiso ezenziwe ngu-Ernest & Young ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-AU Commission isebenzisa izindlela eziphumelelayo zezimali nezokusebenza futhi ukuthi izakhiwo ze-Information and Communication Technology (ICT) zeKomishini zihlaziywa. Uma lezi ziphakamiso zamukelwa, kulindeleke ukuthi zisebenze kancane kancane, kuqala kulabo abathinta ukusebenza kwezimali noma abasebenzi. Ukuqaliswa kwesinqumo mayelana nezakhiwo ezathathwa ngo-2003 e-AU Assembly eMaputo, ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi kuqhubeka. INingizimu Afrika izosasebenzisa ingxenye yayo eyabelwe abasebenzi. Kuze kube manje, kube nabantu ababili baseNingizimu Afrika abaqashwe yiKomishini, okungukuthi uDr. B Tema (ovela kwiMnyango Wezesayensi Nezobuchwepheshe) njengoMphathi: Izinsiza Zabantu, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe, noMs. F Lortan (ovela emphakathini) njengomphathi wezombusazwe eSigabeni Sezindaba Zomphakathi Nezokuhlala - esaziwa ngaphambili njenge-CSSDCA. Isifungo sokubhaliswa sinikeza wonke amazwe amalungu ithuba lokuqinisekisa ibhalansi yobulili ekubambeni iqhaza. Amazwe amalungu adingeka ukuthi aqoqe umbiko obonisa imizamo eyenziwe noma ukuwa kwezimali ukuze kuthuthukiswe ibhalansi yobulili. Umbiko wezwe kumele uthunyelwe ku-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yi-AU Commission. INingizimu Afrika iphethe futhi ithumele umbiko wayo ngo-2005 kuKomishini ngaphambi kwe-AU Assembly ebibanjwe eSirte, eLibya ngoJulayi 2005. Kwakukhona nezinguquko ezenziwe kumadokhumenti mayelana nezikweletu ezibophelelwe amazwe ase-Afrika ezweni elithuthukile kanye nezikhungo ezahlukene, kanye nezohwebo lwamazwe, uxhaso lokuthuthukiswa, ulwazi, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana (ICT) kanye ne-HIV/AIDS. I-NEPAD iphinde yahlela izingxoxo nemihlangano emikhulu nemiphakathi kanye nomkhakha ongahleleki. Izinhloso ezisemqoka nemiyalezo ye-NEPAD: Afrika ithatha umnikelo nomthwalo wemfanelo wokuthuthukiswa kwezwe; ukukhuthaza nokuqhubekisela phambili ubudlelwano, amalungelo abantu, ukuphathwa kahle, kanye nobuholi obubhekelele, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki ukuze kuncishiswe ukuncika ezisizini; ukwakha amandla ezikhungo zase-Afrika; ukukhuthaza ukuhweba nokutshalwa kwezimali phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika; ukusheshisa ukuhlanganiswa komnotho wesifunda; ukuphakamisa amandla abesifazane; ukuqina kwezwi lase-Afrika ezinkundleni zomhlaba
Imincintiswano Yezemidlalo: Ukuhlonipha Isiko Nokuqhakambisa Ithuba Lentsha Izwe lethu, eligcwele impumelelo neziqu, liye lakhula nabadlali abashisayo abavela kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyathandwa, futhi ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu. Njengoba iNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nemincintiswano eminingi ezizayo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zenzakalo azigcini nje ngokubeka izicoco zezivakashi, kodwa futhi zikhuthaza ubumbano, ukuxhumana, nokukhula komphakathi. Eminyakeni edlule, imincintiswano yezemidlalo yayilokhu ibalulekile ekwakheni isithombe sethu njengabantu. Izinkanyezi zendawo, abaqeqeshi, nabalandeli bavame ukujabulisa umphakathi ngezokungcebeleka. Kanjalo, imincintiswano ibamba iqhaza elikhulu ekuhlonipheni amasiko nokugqugquzela ubudlelwano. Inhloso yokuqhakambisa ubunye, ukuletha izingane nemiphakathi ndawonye ukuze zifunde, zifunde, futhi ziqhakambise amakhono. Uhlelo lwezemidlalo lwenziwe lwahlala luthandwa ngabantu beminyaka eyahlukene, futhi lukhombisa ubuhle bezenkolo ezahlukene. Umphakathi uneminyaka eminingi usuka kumdlandla wokudlala, uModel-C, nawa athiwe athanda i-rugby, football, ne-cricket, kudala izinkumbulo eziraozi. Lokhu kuloadwa, kuqhuba izimilo zabantu, okunensayo kumphakathi. Njengoba sikhula, ubuchwepheshe b نیز’autres imiphakathi, obubhenela emidlalweni emisha, kukhona okuthokozisayo okuqhakambisa izindida ezinekhefu. Imincintiswano yesikole, imicimbi yasendaweni, naleyo emikhankasweni, ihlukanise ibhande lokuhlola izinga lokusebenza phakathi kwabasha, iziguli zemikhakha yezemidlalo ezithembisayo. Futhi lezi mikhakha ivame ukuklonyeliswa, ibili eliyimbangela yokuthakazelelwa kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. NgoMgqibelo, kumasha ubhikisha izinsuku ezinzima ezikhiphayo, kodwa abavakashi beqala ukufika emicimbini yabadlali bahamba beman-man. Isigamalayo sokudlula, sodlulisana nabameli bamasiko ezemidlalo, kanye nomphakathi ngokuphelele. Phakathi kwalezi zimfuno kwezempilo nokufunda, umphakathi ufaka ezokuthakazelelwa nothando, ukuhlanganyela kungabekela ubungcweti. Ukwenyuka kwemidlalo kwandisa amakhono, akhokha umkhiqizo ophelele wokuhlanganisa umphakathi. Abantwana bangasebenzisa lezi zinsuku ukuze bafunde, bangakhumbuli, bathumele imiyalezo ebalulekile yokubhekana kanjani nezinkinga, ibibhalwa phansi phansi. Nganakekela, akudli sidi, ukuthula, lezi zinsuku komphakathi. Kubalulekile ukufaka isandla esibandayo emincintiswaneni ezemidlalo, izifunda, ukuze kwandiswe umnotho, kuqhakambiswe izinhlelo, kudalwe amathuba okukhula kwentsha. Ngokuba nabantu bahamba phambili, lokho kuhlangene nobungayi, kuchaza izekeli ezicurayo kubantu abangashisa izikhunga ngesikhathi. Imincintiswano, kanti ibhekelela uzwelo ngezifiso zamalungu omphakathi jikelele. Izincintiswano ezisemthethweni zikhuthaza ukuphaka iziluleko, kanti lezi zinhlangano zidinga abakhetheleke eminyakeni eyizinkanyezi ezingama-sport ezehlisa umphakathi, nabasizayo belobungcweti benhloso yokukhulisa izinga. Ukugqugquzela izinhlelo zokuthola ukudlalwa kwezemidlalo emiphakathini, umphakathi ungase ulungise umsebenzi omuhle, uhlelo lokukhiqiza izinsiza, izinhlelo ezinjalo zibalulekile ukuze ablindele lokho. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izimfuno ebantwini, umphakathi uqhubeka othandweni, uMphakathi ungalihlanganisa ngokuqinileyo, ubudlelwano bokuxhumana obukhulu. Ekugcineni, imincintiswano yezemidlalo iyakhumbula kangangokuba ingxenye ebalulekile yempilo yomphakathi wethu. Ngezinye izikhathi, kubalulekile ukusho izinkulumo ezikhuthaza, imikhankaso yokuxhumana, lokho okwenza umphakathi ube ngaphandle kokubekezela. Ubudlelwano benzakalo nezinkanyezi zakhe, izinsuku zesikhathi. Lokhu kuhlonishwayo kwengcebo yethu yezeMidlalo kudinga ukuhunyushwa ngekhono, begodu kuwudlidliza umphakathi wethu. Siyabonga ukuba sithokozisa, siphe abalandeli ithuba lokuthandaza igalelo elijulile imincintiswano emisha, zikhuthazwayo, zigeleza phakathi kwayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlonishwa okukhulu. Ukuba nemincintiswano emisha emincintelelayo!
Izindaba Zempumelelo: Uhlelo Lokuphumelela Kujabulisa ukufunda izindaba ezinhle zempumelelo ezikhombisa umphakathi. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngenhlonipho kulabo abathathe izinyathelo ezinzima ukuze bafinyelele impumelelo emikhakheni ehlukene. Ngaphambi kokuhlola lezi zindaba, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impumelelo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhweba kwezimali noma izikhundla eziphakeme, kodwa kubalulekile futhi ukuthola ukwaneliseka kanye nokufeza amaphupho ethu. Ukukhula kwempumelelo kubonakala ezindabeni eziningi zomphakathi. Njengoba abantu beqhubeka, bakhombisa imibono, ubuciko, nokuzimisela. Isibonelo esihle nguNokuthula, owayengumfundi ophumelele emsebenzini wakhe wokufundisa, owakha isikhungo sokufunda esibiza abantwana abavela emiphakathini ethile. Uhlanganyele nomphakathi ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi abantwana bakhula befunda ngempela. Lokhu kube yindlela yokuhlomulisa umphakathi, kukhombisa umyalezo othi, "Siyakwazi ukwenza kahle uma sibambisene." Izindaba zempumelelo azigcini nje kuphela kulabo abaziwayo, kodwa ziqukethe nezindawo eziningi zempumelelo ezitholakala emakhaya, emiphakathini nasemadolobheni. UThabo, othanda ukubhaka, waphawuleka ngesikhathi edlula ezinyathelweni ezinzima, kodwa kwase kuthiwa "umgibeli wehlisa umoya" ngemuva kokuba eqalile umncintiswano wokubhaka. Njengoba efuna ukuhlinzeka ngezingubo zokudla ezifanele emndenini, akazange ahluleke, waphumelela. Ngaleso sikhathi, wayesevele ethole izifundo eziningi ezibalulekile. Izindaba zempumelelo zibuye zikhanyise umhlaba ngokuqonda nokusebenza okuhle. Ubuchwepheshe buhambisana nokukhula, kuyilapho umphakathi uqhubeka nokuxhasa nezinhlelo ezilungile. Lokhu kuvumela abantu abasha ukuqonda ukuthi banganempumelelo kangakanani uma benolwazi futhi benethezekile. Izikhumbuzo ezinjengokuphishekela ukuya enhliziyweni yeqembu lendabuko lakho, ziphakamisa ukuhamba kwakho empilweni ukuze nezinye izindawo zisize. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kunezinto eziningi ezingachaphazeleka. Empilweni, ukuhlakanipha kujulile. Kukhona izimo ezilakazayo, amaphephandaba, nemihlangano yokwabelana ngempumelelo. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside sokuzuza, abanye abantu bacabanga ukuthi huzunguzela emasahladini akhe. Kunesiteshi esiyinkanyezi esiyinqaba, siphinda siqhamuke sibe sizo. Kulezi zikhathi, sithola ubuhlakani obuncane obukwazi ukusiza kumathuba nezikhathi ezinzima. Uma siphawula indlela izindaba zempumelelo zikhanya, ibhadi emithonjeni ethandwa, uzwa ukuvelela kwenhlonipho. Ukuxhumana kwebhizinisi, ukunakekela, nokuhleka komndeni, kuyaluleka. Lapho kwenzeka lokho, siphumela kakhulu esizweni sokuhlala siphila kahle, silandela izinyathelo ezinhle. Izindaba ezinhle zempumelelo ziyakha amashashalazi ngezindlela ezahlukene, zisithokozisa ngokwandisa izifiso zethu, kwathi umphumela obalulekile waba ukudala ubudlelwane bempilo. Ngakho, uhambo lokufinyelela empumelelweni luhlanganisa izinto eziningi ezimbi nemibono emisha. Futhi unemisebenzi ehlala ibalulekile ebantwini, ivuselela ithemba. Imithetho evamile, efanele, ikhulisa ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuveza indlela ezinhle zempilo, kuhlanganisa izixazululo zabantu abanesisekelo somiselo. Ikhompyutha isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuyisimangaliso, oluvela kumkhiqizo omkhulu, losizakale izinkanyezi zempumelelo. Ngokuphetha, izindaba zempumelelo zikhombisa ukuthi impumelelo ayihambisani nemibono engalungile. Yiba nomoya ophakeme, faka uthando emsebenzini, futhi ukhonze abanye, kulindeleke ukuthi ungaphendula umhlaba uhlebe futhi ube isibonelo sezokwenza izinto ziphumelele. Imizwa iyathinta, izinyathelo zikhona, futhi lapho umqondo uhlangana nomsebenzi, impumelelo izovela. Ngakho-ke, asithokoziseni ngobudlelwane nokuxhaswa, siqhubeke sifuna impumelelo ebushelelezi.
Ukusweleka Kodokotela Ezibhedlela Zikahulumeni Isingeniso Ukusweleka kodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kungumkhuba ophawulekayo ophazamise kakhulu izinsizakalo zezempilo eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkinga ikhubazekile imithwalo yemfanelo yodokotela, idala umthelela omubi kwiziguli nezimo zempilo zomphakathi. Lesi sikhathi sikhombisa ukunganeliseki okuqhubekayo ezinhlelweni zempilo, okusiza ukuhlinzeka ngemfundiso eqondile ngezizathu eziholela kulokhu futhi ukufaka izindlela zokwenza ngcono. Izizathu Zokusweleka Kubhekwa izici ezihlukahlukene eziholela ekuswelekeleni kodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Okokuqala, ukuncipha kwezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo kudinga ukuba abezempilo bahlale besebenzisa isikhathi esiningi ukuze bahlinzeke ngezidingo eziyisisekelo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhola iziguli ezintweni ezingaphezulu. Ukwehla kwesibalo sodokotela, ikakhulukazi kulabo abaqeqeshwe ngokwejwayelekile, kusele nezibhedlela eziningi zikhunya emngceleni wokufinyelela odokotela abalungile. Lokhu kudala ukuncipha kokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo. Okwesibili, ukuntula izinhlelo ezicacile zokugqugquzela abasha ukuba bangene emkhakheni wezempilo kuholela ekutheni abampofu babe nobunzima bokufinyelela imfundo efanele. Ukwehla kwemali yokuphila ezingeni eliphansi kuthinta kakhulu abathanda ukugqashuka ezindabeni zokwelapha. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abanye abantu bathelwe aphezu, bephila impilo engekho emthethweni, lokhu kuze kube yimbangela yokuhamba kancane kwezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwelashwa. Umthelela Ezibhedleni Ukusweleka kodokotela kuthinta ngqo izibhedlela zikahulumeni namagumbi okuxilongwa. Iziguli zihlala zidlula ukusuka kwelinye udokotela kuya kwenye, kanti abanye bahlala bemukela ukwelashwa okungaphumeleli kube nezinga eliphakeme lokuhluleka. Lokhu kubangela ukulinda okude emagumbini, ukuzikhathaza kwabantu, nokuba nezinkinga ezikhiqizayo ezimeni zempilo, okungathinta (ngokubanzi) umphakathi. Umphakathi Wokuhlola Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele kulokhu, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuqeqesha odokotela nezinhlelo zentuthuko ezithinta iziguli ezithintekayo. Izingqungquthela zezemfundo zingaba yinsiza ekukhuthazeni abantu ukuba bejolise emkhakheni wezempilo. Kwakhulukazi, ukwakhiwa kwamathuba okuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zemfundo nezibhedlela kukhulisa amathuba okubamba uqeqesho oludingekayo. Izixazululo Ukuze kuxazululwe le nkinga, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokwelapha nezokuma zodokotela. Imfundo, ukuhlinzeka ngezikhala zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo ezithuthukisa izimo zokuphila kumadokodo kufanele kube izinto ezibalulekile. Ungakubeka nohlelo lokuphakamisa izigaba zempilo ukuthi zihlakaniphe ngezinkinga ezihlobene nezempilo, lokhu kuzokwandisa ukulindela kwezinga lokuphila komphakathi. Ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphakeme nakho kumele kube yindlela yokwenza ngcono le nkinga. Ukuze kufinyelelwe olwazini, izinyathelo zedijithali, okufana nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo, kufanele zisetshenziswe zamukelekile. Lokhu ngeke nje kwandise ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, kodwa futhi kuzothuthukisa ukutholakala kwemali yokulawula izibhedlela ezithuthuke. Isiphetho Ukusweleka kodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kudinga ukufuna isixazululo esiphumelelayo. Izifunda, uhulumeni, nabacebisi badinga ukuhlanganisa izinsiza ukuze bakhe izixazululo ezingcono. Umphakathi kufanele uhlanganyele kanjani ekwakhekeni ngesimo sezinhlaka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezimiso eziqinile ezizogqugquzela inhlalakahle nokwelashwa kwezibhedlela zikahulumeni. Ngokwezimiso zokuhlonipha, ukujula kolwazi, kanye nezinqumo ezicacile ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ezempilo, singaqinisekisa ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zithola usizo oludinga kahle. Lokhu kucela ukusebenzelana kokuphila kwezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene ezebhizinisi, nemindeni, nodokotela ukuze kwandiswe inhlalakahle nokukhula okuhloniphekile. Ukusebenza ngale sizatshana kuzothuthukisa izimo ezinhle zomphakathi jikelele. Siyavuma ukuthi isimo sabodokotela ezibhedlela zikahulumeni sisafaneleka ukulungiswa, kanele, ngaphansi kokuholwa okuhle nokuhlonipha, izibhedlela zingaqinisekisa imiphumela emihle, zenze ingqikithi oyintandokazi kubantu bonke.
### Ezokusakaza: Indaba Yezwi Nezithombe Kwathi ngesikhathi esithile, emhlabeni wezokuxhumana, kwabakhona umhlaba omusha, umhlaba wezokusakaza. Le ndaba iqala ekhuluma ngendaba yokuthi unjiniyela ophumelele emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, uMnu. Thulani Mthembu, wahamba waya emzini owawugqugquzela abantu ngezindaba ezimbalwa. Wayehamba nezinkanyezi ezishisayo, ezazikhanya kakhulu ezinkanyezini zeAfrika, ezazisakaza izindaba ezaziphilayo, ngendlela efana nehlobo elishisa. UMnu. Mthembu wayenombono ovusa umdlandla; wayefuna ukuhlinzeka abantu ngemicabango, izindaba, nezinto ezithokozisayo, ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokusakaza. Waqala ngokwakha isiteshi sakhe, esakhe ngothando, ezindlini ezincane ezingaphezulu kwedolobha, lapho abantu besebenzisa izwi labo ukuze bazwakalise imizwa yabo. Abantu bobabili babekhuluma ngezindaba zomphakathi, izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili, nomculo omusha, futhi lezi zindaba zazikhanya njengezinkanyezi. Ngemva kwesikhashana, isiteshi sikaThulani sathola udumo. Abantu babejabulile, bephendula izinhlelo zakhe ezithokozisayo. Waqala imicimbi emikhulu, ethokozisa izivakashi, unjiniyela abasha, nabaculi bezwe. Izimvo zabantu zazigcwele phakathi kwezikhala, kanti uMnu. Mthembu wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obubukeka bunzima bungaba namandla. Ngaleyo ndlela, isiteshi sakhe sathuthuka saphumelela, sathola izixhumi eziningi. Abantu bacela izinhlelo ezintsha, izinhlelo ezizwakalayo, nezinhlelo ezizwakalayo, kanti uyena uThulani wayefuna ukuqhubeka ekhanga izihloko ezintsha. Waqala ukuhlela uhlelo olwakhiwe ngengwazi, olwakhiwa ngothando, nesiphepho sezinhliziyo, ekwakhiweni kwezingoma. Ngaleso sikhathi, izithameli zabeziqonda kahle ukuthi izwi lethu lingakusiza kanjani, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi silwazi kahle. Ngaphandle kokuthola udumo, uMnu. Mthembu wayekwazi ukuthi ezokusakaza akukhona kuphela ukulalelwayo, kodwa futhi kuyisikhala sokuxhumana. Ngemva kokuphumelela, wanquma ukukhipha uhlelo olwakhiwe ngezithombe, olwakhiwa ngabantu. Walungiselela umcimbi wokubambisana, lapho abaculi bezwe, abathandi bezokwakha, nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene beqhamuka ndawonye ukuze bezwakalise izinkumbulo zabo. Le micimbi yahlala izinsuku ezimbalwa, futhi ibikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyinsika yokwenziwa komhlaba, umhlaba onobungane, nezinye izindlela zokukhuluma. Kwavela abaculi abasha, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, behlanganyela ukuxoxa izindaba zabo, behlola izimo ezahlukene zabantu. Isiteshi sikaMnu. Mthembu saphila, sathola umoya omusha. Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baphinde baphinde bahlangana, besebenzisa izwi labo, nezithombe zabo, ukuze bakhuthaze abanye. Ngesikhathi edlula, kwavela izinselelo. Uhlanga lwezokuxhumana luthuthuka, izimakethe ziqhubeka zishintsha, futhi izithameli zenziwa ngabantu abasha. UThulani wayezama ukuhlela izinhlelo ezintsha, kodwa wabona ukuthi izikhala ezikhona zidinga ukuphendulwa. Wafuna ukuxhumana nezinye iziteshi, ukuze ahlanganyele izinhlelo zabo, evula amathuba amasha. Lokhu kwakungukuphumelela kwezimakethe, okuholele ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Njengoba amakhono akhe abuthakathaka, uMnu. Mthembu wathola ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buyaguquguquka. Kwavela izindlela eziningi zokusakaza, ezazisiza abantu ukuba baphendule izindaba zabo, kodwa wakhumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwakhe lwalufanele ukwaziswa. Waba nemibono emisha, yokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezazivumela abantu ukuba bazwakalise imibono yabo. Wafunda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo akufanele kube yinto eyodwa, kodwa kufanele kuhlanganiswe izimvo ezivela kubantu. Ubuqhawe bakhe bahlala bukhona, futhi izinhlelo zakhe zathola ukuthandwa okukhulu. UThulani wakhumbula ukuthi izwi labantu liyinsika, kanti ubuchwepheshe buyisikhumbuzo sokwazisa. Wayezama ukuvuselela izinhlelo zakhe, ehlose ukuhlinzeka abantu ngezindaba ezikhaliphe, ezithokozisayo, nezikhuthazayo. Ekugcineni, uMnu. Thulani Mthembu wathola ukuthi ezokusakaza akukhona kuphela ukukhipha izwi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Izithameli zashintsha, izindlela zashintsha, kodwa ubungane bahlala bukhona. Waqhubeka nokusebenza, ethokozisa abantu, ethokozisa izithameli, futhi waba ngumholi wemibono emisha. Izwi lakhe, nezwi labantu, lahlangana, lapha kwaba yinkanyezi ekhanya, ekhanyisa umhlaba wezokusakaza. Ngaphezu kwalesi sikhathi, izinhlelo zakhe zabeziqhubeka, nezindaba zakhe zabeziqhubeka zikhanya ezinkanyezini. Lokhu kwenza uMnu. Mthembu waba yisibonelo somphakathi, umholi wezokuxhumana, ovumelanayo nezinguquko, futhi ubuchwepheshe bakhe bahlala bukhona, benza ukuthi izwi labantu liqhubeke lukhanya. Le ndaba yokusakaza, isikhumbuzo sokubumbana, isikhumbuzo sokuphila, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungenza izimanga.

Inzuzo encane etholakalayo ekukhiqizeni ukudla okwenziwe ngembewu. Izinkinga ezihlobene nokuthola umhlaba wokulima. Izinhlaka ezahlukene zokuba nefa ngaphandle kokubambisana. Ukudla KweSintu: Ubonelo Ngempilo Yethu Namasiko Ezimfundisweni zethu ezenzakalayo, ukudla kwesintu kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yosintu, kungaphezu kokudla nje. Ukudla akugcini ngokugcwalisa isisu; kudinga ukuhamba phambili kwamasiko nemigubho, kube yindlela yokuhlangana phakathi kwezizukulwane. Lokhu kuhambisana nenkolo yethu nokuhlobana, kukhombisa ukuhlonishwa kwemvelo nokuqonda kozulu. Abathandi bokudla kwesintu bavame ukuveza izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokupheka, njengoba izinhlobo zokudla zisuselwa endaweni, izimo zomnotho, kanye nezinhlanga. Umuntu ohloniphekile uMaXaba, oneminyaka engamashumi amathathu, uyinsika yokudla kwesintu endleleni ayiphilayo. Njengobaba nomama, usuka emndenini ophila ngamasiko ahloniphekile. Ngokuphila kwakhe, ukugubha izinsuku ezibalulekile ngezingxenye ezikhethwayo zokudla—lezinye zazo zihlanganisa isijingi sikaMsholozi, umphokoqo, kanye nenhlamvu. Umphokoqo, okungokwenene, kufanele ube yisithako esiyinhloko ekudleni kwesintu. UMaXaba uthe uma bephumule, ungashisa okuphilayo okwenziwe ngeziqhamo ezivela emithini, asanhlambele ukumangala nokuqonda. Lokhu kudla kukhumbuza abahlali balapha ngenhlangano yokukhipha umpheki ngomthombo wokudla okukhulayo. Imvuthuluka yokudla ekhula emaphandleni ibhalwe phakathi kwezincwadi zabo zokupheka. Evame ukufana, uMaXaba ubonisa ubuciko bakhe ekwenzeni ucwaningo, eqoqa izithako ezivela ekhaya, ezafika nezisindayo. Ngakhoke, akukhona nje ukudla kuphela; umphokoqo ungubuhlakani obuhlotshaniswa nomphakathi. UMaXaba uhamba ibanga elide ukudala isiqalo esisha, efundisa abantwana ndawonye imikhuba yokupheka ngendlela yesintu. Ngokuzithokozisa, uMaXaba ujabulela ukupheka ngayo yonke imfudumalo, enza ukuthi abantwana bakhe bazi kahle izithako ezivela emahlathini, okudala uthando lokugcina izimfihlo zokuhlanza. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuvuma iziko, okuholela ekwazini inhlangano engokwenyama kwabantu. Ngokukhuluma ngalokhu, uMaXaba uveza indlela yokuphila ethinta amakhosi nokuhlonipha kabanzi. Ukudla akuphili nje kuphela, kodwa kujabulisa futhi kudala izinkumbulo ezizayo. Imithetho yokudla yesintu imayelana nokuhlanganyela—not just for sustenance, but for togetherness. Lokhu kukhumbuza umphakathi ukujola ngezimo eziningi ezibucayi, kwehluka kwabantu baqonda kahle izizathu zokuhlangana. Ungathola uMaXaba esebenza emzini, nezinye izinsiza zomphakathi, lapho kwaziwa khona ukuthi izinyoni zilethe abantu ndawonye. Umuntu ngamunye unomsebenzi wakhe, ohambisana nemigomo yamasiko. KwaMaXaba, ukuhlanganyela kudinga ukuphila njengebhande eliqinisiwe—eyaziwa njengenhlangano, imihlangano, kanye nezikhathi ezinhle. Ukudla ngoxolo, ukudlia ngezibe, yindlela yokudlulisa izindaba; akushiye amehlo alungile, kodwa kudinga ukufakwe ekudleni. Okwaziyo, umphakathi uveza izinhlekelele, kufanele kube nesikhathi sokuhamba ngaphandle, ubuciko obuphendukayo, lapho umphakathi nenkulu bazi ngosuku lokudla. UMaXaba ubonisa indlela yokusebenza kanzima, umphakathi ohloniphekile, uvule izinkanyezi, ulungisa imigubho yamasiko phakathi kwabo. Lokhu kudla kwesintu kudinga ukuklanywa, njengokukhetha, singahamba phambili neNdlovukazi, kuye ngamaqhuzu aphikisana. Ngokuphetha, ukudla kwesintu akukaze kube ngaphezu kokudla noma imihlangano, kodwa kudinga ukuhlanganyela. UMaXaba ubonisa izinto ezilula, ukulawula izindleko, ukukhumbula umoya wokuhlanganyela, ukugcina umoya ophilayo nezinselelo. Ngale ndlela, sakha isiko lesintu, sibhala izinkumbulo, sithokozisa ukuhlonipha, futhi sakhumbula ukuthi ukudla kwethu, empeleni, kudinga ukuphila. I-akhawunti kaMaXaba ibonisa ukuvumelana kwezinto, ukuhlanganisa i-culinary roots kanye nokuhlonipha izimo zokuphila kwansuku zonke. UMaXaba ungumfanekiso ohlanzekile, ubhukuze izinkanyezi zenkulumo, uveza ubuhlakani bakhe nezindlela zokubamba amacala amasha. Lokhu kudla kwesintu akugcini ngokunambitha, kuthi ifa lethu liqhubeke lihlala kwiDlozi, liqhubeke libhalisa izimo zansuku zonke, ezibhaliswe ezinkumbulweni zempilo yethu.

Nakuba kube nezinkulumo eziphikisanayo ngesonto elidlule, inqubo yokulungiselela ukhetho iyaqhubeka. Ezolimi: Umthombo Wokuxhumana Nokwazisa Ezolimi ziwumgogodla wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ziyindlela esebenzayo yokwabelana ngemicabango, imizwa, nezincwadi. Ngaphandle kwezilimi, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bungeke buphumelele. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika, lapho kunezilimi eziningi ezihlukene ezikhuluma abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngokubuka kwami, izilimi zikhombisa ubuhle bamasiko ahlukene. Isibonelo, isiZulu, isiXhosa, isiNdebele, nesiSwati, zonke zinezimpawu zazo ezihlukile, ezikhombisa ubuciko bamasiko. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuhloniphana phakathi kwabantu, njengoba sithola ithuba lokufunda nokuhlonipha izindlela zokuphila zabanye. Ukukhuluma isiZulu, ngokwesibonelo, akukhulumi nje kuphela ngolimi, kodwa futhi kukhombisa ukuhlonipha isiko labantu abakhuluma leli limi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilimi zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni ubunikazi. Abantu bahlala bejabule uma bekhuluma ulimi lwabo, njengoba lokho kubavumela ukuba bazivele kahle. Ukukhuluma isiZulu, noma ngabe ungumuntu ongakakhulumi kahle, kukhombisa isifiso sokuxhumana nabanye, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubumbana. Ngakho-ke, izilimi azigcini nje ngokuba izindlela zokuxhumana, kodwa ziba yizinsika zokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izilimi zidinga ukunakekelwa. Njengoba sithuthuka, sithola ukuthi ezinye izilimi ziya zincipha, kanti ezinye ziba yizilimi ezikhuluma kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi abantu bahlala bejolise ezilimini ezinkulu, njenge-English, ezithathwa njengokubalulekile emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kudala ingozi yokuthi izilimi zethu zendabuko zingalimala, futhi lokhu akufanele kwenzeke. Ngokubona kwami, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela izilimi zethu. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukufundisa izingane zethu izilimi zendabuko ezikoleni, ukuze zazi kahle imvelaphi yazo. Futhi, kufanele sikhuthaze abantu abadala ukuba baphinde bafunde izilimi zabo, ukuze baziqonde kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina izilimi zethu ziphila, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili njengabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izilimi zethu zidinga ukuba zisetshenziswe ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zethu emisebenzini, ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, nakwezinye izindawo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngezinto ezihlukene, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhweba ngamasiko ethu. Ngokuphetha, izilimi ziwumthombo wokuxhumana, ubunikazi, nokuhlonipha. Zidinga ukunakekelwa, ukuze zihlale ziphila. Njengoba sithuthuka, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izilimi zethu zendabuko zibalulekile, futhi kufanele sizigcine ziphila. Ukukhuluma isiZulu, isiXhosa, nesiNdebele akukhulumi nje ngolimi, kodwa kukhombisa ukuhlonipha isiko, ubudlelwano, nobunikazi bethu. Ngakho-ke, masigcine izilimi zethu ziphilile, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili njengabantu, sikhumbula imvelaphi yethu.
Ezamanzi Nokuhlanzeka: Indaba Yomphakathi Wethu Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eNdlovukazi, idolobha elincane elisemaphandleni. Abantu baphila izimpilo zabo, kodwa babhekana nenkinga enkulu: amanzi. Amanzi ayengatholakali kalula, futhi lapho ethola khona, kwakungahlanzekile, okwakuholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu emindenini. UMama Nandi, owesifazane oneminyaka engama-45, wayehlala nomndeni wakhe eduze komfula. Nakuba umfula wawubukeka kahle, uma ubheka phezulu, wawugcwele udoti. Lokhu kwenza uMama Nandi akhathazeke njengoba abantwana bakhe bejolisa emanzini. "Ngabe amanzi lapha ayaphepha?" wayephuza, ehlola ubungozi obubangelwa yilezi zimo. Ngelinye ilanga, uMama Nandi wahlangana noMnumzane Thabo, umholi wendawo onolwazi ngamanzi nokuhlanzeka. "Mama Nandi," esho, "kumele sithathe izinyathelo ukuze sithuthukise isimo samanzi lapha. Amanzi ahlanzekile abalulekile empilweni yethu." UMama Nandi wavuma, kodwa wayazi ukuthi kuzodingeka imizamo eminingi. Ngemuva kokuhlangana noMnumzane Thabo, uMama Nandi wanquma ukuhlela umhlangano nomphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngendaba yokuhlanzeka. Umhlangano waba yimpumelelo, abantu baphuma bezokhuluma futhi bephakamisa iziphakamiso ezahlukene. Abanye bavuma ukusiza ekwakheni iziteshi zokuhlanza amanzi, kanti abanye baphakamisa izifundo zokuhlanzeka. Ngesikhathi edlula emihlanganweni eminingi, umphakathi waqala ukuhlela. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo esihle, eqala ukufundisa abantu indlela yokusebenzisa amanzi kahle. "Amanzi awavunyelwe ukuphuma, kodwa kufanele siwasebenzise kahle," wayeshumayela. Ngemva kwesikhathi, umfula waba nokuthula. Abantu baqala ukuhlela izinsiza zokuhlanzeka, futhi izinsiza zokuhlanza amanzi zatholakala. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwenza konke. Umphakathi waqala ukujabulisa, futhi umfula waba nezinhlobonhlobo zezilwane nezitshalo. Abantwana babengejabulile, bejabulisa emanzini ahlanzekile. UMama Nandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayebona imizamo yabo iyaphumelela. "Siyaphumelela," wayesho, "siyakwazi ukwenza umehluko." Ngemuva kweminyaka, umphakathi waba yisibonelo esihle. Amanzi ahlanzekile ayengumthombo wokuphila, futhi abantu bahlala bejabulile. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwenza konke. UThabo, umholi wendawo, waba nesithunzi esihle, futhi abantu bamthanda. Ngaleso sikhathi, umphakathi wawazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esibalulekile. UMama Nandi waba nomqondo wokuthi kumele baqhubeke nokufundisa abantwana ngezidingo zamanzini ahlanzekile, ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nesithunzi esihle, futhi abantu baqala ukujabulisa. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi imizamo yokuhlangana ingaguqula izinto. UThabo waba umholi ophumelelayo, futhi abantu bamthanda. Umphakathi waqonda ukuthi ngokuhlanganyela, bangakwenza konke, futhi amanzi ahlanzekile ayengumthombo wokuphila. UMama Nandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, bangenza umehluko omkhulu.
Izinselelo zomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act Umxoxisi: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungivumela ukuba ngibe lapha namuhla. Ngifuna sikhulume ngempela ngezizinselelo ezihambisana nomthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act. Ungangichazela ukuthi yini le mthetho, futhi kungani ubalulekile? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. I-Electoral Amendment Act iwumthetho ohloswe ngawo ukuthuthukisa indlela yokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Uhloswe ukusiza ekwenzeni ukuthi ukhetho kube sobala, kube nekhwalithi, futhi kube nezindlela ezinhle zokubhalisela ukuvota. Nokho, kuningi okukhuluma ngalesi sikhumbuzo, futhi kunezinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nawo. Umxoxisi: Ngabe ungakuchaza kahle lezi zinselelo? Umphenyi: Yebo, ziningi. Okokuqala, kukhona izinselelo ezihlobene nezinsiza. Ukuze umthetho ufezeke, kudingeka izinsiza ezanele, ezinjengemali, abasebenzi, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu akukhona njalo, futhi izifunda eziningi zihlupheka kakhulu ngezinsiza ezikhona, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokhetho. Ingabe kukhona okunye okukhathazayo? Umphenyi: Yebo, okunye okukhathazayo yizinkinga zokuhlanganiswa kwedatha. Umthetho ubeka izidingo ezinzima zokuhlanganiswa kwedatha yokhetho, kodwa izinhlelo ezikhona akukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngedatha efanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zokuvota, futhi kungase kubangele ukuphazamiseka ekuphathweni kokhetho. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kudingeka ukuhlola izinhlelo ezikhona. Ngabe kukhona nezinye izinselelo ezihlobene nezepolitiki? Umphenyi: Impela. Izinselelo zezombusazwe zibalulekile. Abanye abantu bangase baphikise le mthetho ngenxa yokuthi bakholelwa ukuthi izinguquko ezithile zingathinta izikhundla zabo. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni zokuphikisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ukuvumelana. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umthetho awunqamuki, kodwa udinga ukuxhaswa ngempela. Ingabe kukhona izindlela ezithile zokuthuthukisa lezi zinselelo? Umphenyi: Yebo, ziningi izindlela. Okokuqala, kudingeka ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuhlinzeka ngensiza. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukufaka izinsiza ezithile ezivela emiphakathini, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni zokuvota. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene, ukuze kube nokuhlanganyela okuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo. Umxoxisi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obuhle bukhona. Ngabe kukhona okunye okubalulekile okufanele sikhulume ngakho? Umphenyi: Yebo, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act awuqondakali kuphela kumalungu ezepolitiki. Ubuye uthetheleleke kubantu bonke, futhi kufanele kube nokwaziswa okwanele ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi le mthetho izosiza kanjani. Lokhu kuzodinga imikhankaso yokwazisa, ukuze abantu bazi izinzuzo zalesi sikhumbuzo. Umxoxisi: Ngabe umthetho ungathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi? Umphenyi: Yebo, umthetho ungathuthukiswa. Lokhu kudinga ukuhlola okuqhubekayo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zomphakathi ziyahlangatshezwa. Ukuhlola njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukubona izinkinga ezikhona, futhi kusize ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokhetho. Umxoxisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngabe kukhona okokugcina ofuna ukusho? Umphenyi: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukuphetha ngokukhumbuza ukuthi umthetho we-Electoral Amendment Act ungumsebenzi obalulekile. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona, futhi kudingeka ukuthi bonke abantu, ikakhulukazi abaholi, basebenze ndawonye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zinselelo zixazululwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokhetho olungcono, nolusiza umphakathi wonke. Umxoxisi: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngiyawuhalalisela umsebenzi wakho, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi sizobona izinguquko ezinhle.
Ishadi lokuhambisana lenziwa lapho kuthathwa khona isampula ngokomthetho phakathi kokunye ukuze ihlolwe ngaphansi kobuholi besikhungo esisemthethweni esinikeze leyo sampula. Ishadi eliluhlaza lenziwa lapho kuthathwa khona isampula phakathi kokunye ngaphansi kobuholi besikhungo esisemthethweni, kodwa ukuhlolwa kwenziwa kwenye isikhungo esisemthethweni kwelinye izwe. Ishadi eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lenziwa lapho isampula ingathathwa ngaphansi kwesikhungo esisemthethweni, kodwa isikhungo esisemthethweni sithinteka kuphela ekuhloleni kwesampula. Uma amaqoqo wezimpande eselungele ukuthathwa, babiza umhloli ukuze athathe amasampula. Amasampula anikezwa ku-OSTS bese ehlolwa ngekhwalithi ngaphambi kokuba ishadi lenziwe. Ukukhokha kungakwenziwa ngokuqondile noma ngediphozithi yasebhange, kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenombolo ye-invoyisi ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ukukhokha okwenziwe nenombolo ye-invoyisi enikeziwe. Akukho umthetho ofanele. Isikhungo esisemthethweni sokuhlola imbewu yi-Official Seed Tasting Station, esihlinzeka kuqala ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwamasampula embewu athunyelwa phesheya. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimbali zinezimo ezahlukene zokuhlola, futhi isikhathi sokuhlola singahluka ezinsukwini ezimbalwa kuya ezinsukwini eziningi. I-OSTS ikulungele ukuthatha amaqoqo wezimpande kumasampula noma ibhatchi eyodwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo zokuhlola. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iklayenti lingacela izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhlola. Ulwazi mayelana nezindinganiso zokuhlola ngeke lunikezwe. Buza ngqo kulowo msebenzi.
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungatheni esingakwenza ukuze sigweme lezi zifo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena ezimpilweni zethu. Lezi zifo kuthiwa zidalwa yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuze ugweme lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho, nakekela wena. Le bhukwana enesihloko esithi "Ukuhlala Usebenza Ukuze Uphile Kahle" ingenye yezi bhukwana eziningi. Uma sithatha isikhathi sokunakekela thina, sizohlala siphilile emqondweni nasemzimbeni. Ukuze sigcine umzimba wethu nomqondo wethu uphilile, kudingeka sihlale sisebenza. Abaningi bethu baphila impilo esheshayo nephithizelayo, okushiya isikhathi esincane sokuphumula. Le ndlela yokuphila isenza sibe nokukhathala nokukhathazeka, okwenza imizimba yethu ibhekane nezinkinga. Kule bhukwana: "Ukuhlala Usebenza Ukuze Uphile Kahle," sibheka ukuthi ukuzivocavoca nokuhlala usebenza kungasisiza kanjani ukuba sibe abantu abaphilile. Le ngubo ikufanele kahle, Fezile, futhi ikwenza ubonakale unamandla. Ngempela, angizizwa nginamandla nhlobo kulezi zinsuku; ngisebenza kanzima. Ngifisa ngabe ngingangena kule mpilo namhlanje. Kodwa uma uqala ukuzivocavoca, uzozizwa uhlukile kakhulu. Ungase uthole indoda ezokuthanda futhi ozoyiphupha njalo. Yebo, Fezile, unethuba lokungabi nenkinga enkulu yomzimba njengami, njengoba ngisebenza ehhovisi futhi ngihlezi usuku lonke, ngiyazibona ngikhuluphala. Yebo, kunjalo, wonke umuntu angagcina ephilile futhi ebukeka kahle. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuzivocavoca, ngizizwa ngcono futhi ngizizwa nginamandla. Nina bobabili anifuni ukuthi sifike sephukile emcimbini. Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalokho okwenzekayo futhi kuyindlela yokuzivocavoca; ngizizwa ngcono kakhulu! Ukuzivocavoca kusiza abantu ukukhulula lezo zinto ezibabamba ngempilo. Ngithathe isinqumo sokuthi impilo yami iyisibopho sami. Ngihamba amakhilomitha amahlanu nsuku zonke, kwesinye isikhathi ngihamba ngokushesha ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi umzimba wami uthola ukuhamba kahle. Ukudansa kuyindlela enhle yokuzivocavoca, futhi ngivame ukuzizwa umzimba wami uthola ukukhanya ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa. Kumele ngiqhubeke ngenza lokhu. Ngake ngaya kudokotela ongihlole wathi ukuzivocavoca kusiza umuntu ukuvimbela izifo eziningi. Yingakho kufanele sonke sizivocavoce ndawonye. Singakhetha ukuzivocavoca ngezindlela ezahlukene ngeviki ngayinye, njengokuhamba, ukuhamba ngebhasi, ukuhamba, nokudansa. Uma sizivocavoca ndawonye, kuzosisiza sikhuthazane. Ngizokwenza ngokuchaza okwenzekayo emzimbeni wakho uma uzivocavoca nokuthi ukuzivocavoca kungakusiza kanjani. Uma uzivocavoca njalo, uzoba nezehlakalo ezithile emzimbeni wakho ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa. Umzimba womuntu uhlelwe ngendlela engalula ukuyiqonda. Uqukethe amathambo, izicubu, ubuchopho, uhlelo lwezitho, uhlelo lokugaya, nokunye okuningi. Ukuze imizimba yethu isebenze kahle, kudingeka sithathe isikhathi sokunakekela. Ukuzivocavoca kuyindlela eyodwa yokunakekela umzimba. Uma sizivocavoca imizuzu engamashumi amathathu nsuku zonke, ngeke sithole izifo futhi sizohlala sibukeka futhi sizizwe siphilile. Masithole ukuthi kungani lokho. Igazi iletha umoya-mpilo namandla ezicubwini zomzimba. Izicubu zidinga umoya-mpilo namandla ukuze zisebenze kahle. Kunezinto ezahlukene ezenzeka emizimbeni yethu uma sizivocavoca. Igazi lishaywa ngokushesha, livumela umoya-mpilo namandla ukufinyelela ezicubwini ngokushesha. Izinga lokusebenza kwezinhliziyo nezitho lishintsha, kuthumela umoya-mpilo ngokushesha. Umzimba wakho udinga umoya-mpilo ukuze usebenze kahle. Ukuzivocavoca kuqinisa izicubu, kube lula ukuthi zifeze izinyathelo ezithile. Izicubu eziqinile zisebenzisa umoya-mpilo kahle. Uma sizivocavoca, ubuchopho bukhulula ama-hormone akhulula ubuhlungu futhi anciphise ingcindezi okubizwa nge-endorphins. Lezi hormone zisebenza njengemithi yemvelo yokukhulula ingcindezi. Zikwenza uzizwe uphilile futhi unamandla. Umzimba ophilile uphinde wenze umqondo ophilile! Zivocavoca ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho! Ukuzivocavoca nokuhlala usebenza kuzokwenza impilo yakho ibe ngcono. Ukukhathala nokukhathazeka kungaholela kalula ekucindezelweni kwengqondo nasekuntulekeni kokuzethemba, ingcindezi yegazi ephezulu, isifo soshukela, izifo zezinhliziyo, kanye nokukhuluphala okweqile okuthinta ukusebenza kwakho kwengqondo nempilo yakho yokuphila. Ngizizwa ngcono ngoba ngibe ngumuntu osebenza kanzima impilo yami yonke. Abantu abadala bavame ukuthola kunzima ukuhamba izindawo ezinde nokuphakamisa izinto ezincane. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi imizimba yabo isibe buthaka (kunzima kubo ukujolisa). Ukuhlala usebenza kungasiza ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abadala. Labo ababe sebenza ngesikhathi sokukhula bavame ukuphila kahle njengoba behlukanisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kunezinto eziningi abangazenza. Futhi kulabo abashiyile ukuzivocavoca ngesikhathi besencane, lokhu akusho ukuthi baphuthelwe ithuba; bangaqala ukuzivocavoca ngokuhamba, ukwenyuka izitebhisi, njll. I-osteoporosis ("isifo sokuncipha kwamathambo") yenzeka uma amathambo emzimbeni wakho eba buthaka, ephuka kalula, futhi athatha isikhathi eside ukuphola. Kube nzima ukuhamba uma uthintekile yile nkinga. Ukuhlala usebenza nokudla ukudla okunempilo yizindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokukusiza ugweme i-osteoporosis. Ingcindezi yegazi ephezulu iyisimo esivamile kakhulu esithinta abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Uma inhliziyo yakho iphilile, iyashaya igazi ngejubane elifanele nangengcindezi efanele emzimbeni. Uma izitho zakho ziqinile noma zivaliwe, kube nzima ukuphumpa igazi ngazo. Lokhu okubizwa ngokuthi ingcindezi yegazi ephezulu. Ukuzivocavoca, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, ukuphatha isisindo somzimba wakho, nokuthatha imithi njengoba kudingwa udokotela wakho kungasiza ukuphatha ingcindezi yakho yegazi. Ukeve ukuthi: "Umzimba ophilile uhamba ndawonye nomqondo ophilile"? Udinga ukudla ukudla okunempilo, uhlale usebenza, uxoxe nabantu, futhi unikeze isikhathi esanele sokuphumula uma ufuna ukuba nomqondo ophilile? Abantu abambalwa bakhuluma ngempilo yengqondo ngoba kuyinto enzima ukuyiqonda. Akekho ofuna ukubizwa ngokuthi "uyahlanya," "uphazamisekile," noma "uphazamisekile." Ungase ube nezingcindezi uqobo. Ungase ube nezingcindezi uma uthola ukuthi usemhlabeni okwenza ube nezingcindezi. Lokhu kungase kube ngenxa yomsebenzi noma izimo zokuhlala. Ungase ube nezinkinga zokwenza umsebenzi wakho
